source: When threatened, POKENAME charge a massive ball with their cannons, pointing it at the opponent before firing. This ball generates enough heat to easily burn through metal, causing POKENAME's cannon to overheat after firing.

entry: POKENAME头顶有3门炮，能快速连发破坏性极强的激光。人们认为，若集中成一道巨大激光，便能瞬间夷平整座大都市。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME has 3 cannons atop its head that allow it to fire highly destructive lasers in a rapid burst. It is believed that if it focuses these cannons into one large laser blast, it could level an entire metropolis in an instant.

entry: POKENAME头顶有3门炮，能快速连发破坏性极强的激光。人们认为，若集中成一道巨大激光，便能瞬间夷平整座大都市。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME has 3 cannons atop its head that allow it to fire highly destructive lasers in a rapid burst. It is believed that if it focuses these cannons into one large laser blast, it could level an entire metropolis in an instant.

entry: POKENAME在严酷的沙漠中吸收阳光。吸收得越多，头顶射出的能量束就越宽。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME absorbs sunlight in harsh deserts. The more sunlight it absorbs, the wider the blasts it can fire from the top of its head.

entry: POKENAME领地意识强，任何东西经过家园都会遭到炮击。但炮击太小，打中也只像轻微发痒，常被误认为虫咬。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are territorial, blasting anything that passes by their home. Since their blasts are so small, POKENAME's attacks only feels like mild itching, and are often confused for bug bites.

entry: POKENAME射出冰冷能量，将屋顶的冰柱击落，再开心地舔食，帮助维持体温。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME shoots icy cold blasts at icicles to knock them from roofs. It licks them gleefully to help maintain its body temperature.

entry: POKENAME的大颈褶吸收光，为多门炮供能。大量齐射后，会释放明亮极光，散去体内多余热量。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's large frill draws in light to fuel the energy within its multiple cannons. If it fires off a large volley of projectiles, it releases a bright aurora afterward to dispel excess internal heat.

entry: POKENAME住在辽阔沙漠，用炮挖出深穴。许多个体会在身体充满能量的特定时刻离穴，通常是正午或午夜。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME live in vast deserts, digging deep burrows for themselves using their cannons. Many POKENAME leave their burrows at certain times when their bodies are fully charged, usually during midday or midnight.

entry: POKENAME在辽阔沙漠上奔跑，用背炮额外加速。不过容易脚下打滑，栽进滚烫的沙中。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME sprint across vast deserts, using the cannons on their backs to give them an extra boost. However, they're prone to slipping on their own feet, causing them to tumble into the hot sand.

entry: POKENAME夜间搜寻辽阔沙漠，寻找遗落沙中的金属废料，再加进鬃毛里，想让鬃毛越大、越吓人越好。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME scavenge the vast desert during the night, looking for metal scrap that has gotten lost in the sand. They add these scraps onto their manes, wanting them to be as big and intimidating as possible.

entry: 有人目击POKENAME模仿当地警察，制止银行抢劫等犯罪行为。虽然行侠仗义，许多城镇却因它显然在擅自执法而十分厌恶。
author: bigoljax
source: Spottings of POKENAME report them stopping bank robberies and other criminal activity, mimicking the actions of local police forces. Despite their heroic actions, many towns despise them due to their apparent vigilantism.

entry: POKENAME收集梦境作为能量，为炮充能。美梦让光束发出粉红光，噩梦则令其变黑。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME collects dreams as a source of energy to charge its cannon. Good dreams make its beam glow pink while bad dreams turn it black.

entry: POKENAME吸收阳光为身体供能，也能将能量凝成光束，用炮射出。光束击中之处的周围，经常会冒出小蘑菇。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME absorb sunlight to fuel their bodies and can condense the energy into beams loosed by their cannons. The areas around where their fired beams strike will often sprout with small mushrooms.

entry: 虽然POKENAME个头很小，炮射光束的危险却丝毫不减。它通过鳞片相互敲击、叮当作响，慢慢为炮积蓄能量。
author: bigoljax
source: Though their statures are quite small, the beams POKENAME fire out of their cannons are no less dangerous. They charge their cannons up by clanging their scales together, slowly building up energy.

entry: 离经叛道的科学家将具甲武者的基因用于盖诺赛克特研究，进一步强化成果。POKENAME拥有金属外骨骼与改良的冷却系统，较不易过热或熔毁，利爪还能轻易击碎钻石。
author: entomoxie
source: Rogue scientists enhanced research surrounding Genesect with Golisopod's genes. With a metallic exoskeleton and improved cooling systems, POKENAME is far less prone to overheating or meltdowns. Its claws can easily shatter diamonds.

entry: POKENAME将炮收进体内隐藏，出其不意取得优势。即使用众多炮击败了敌人，也会继续开火，确保彻底获胜。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME hides its cannons by retracting them into its body to gain the upper hand against unsuspecting foes. Even after defeating a foe with blasts from its many cannons, it will continue to open fire to make sure it has gained complete victory.

entry: POKENAME既优雅又危险，富人想将它用作居家护卫。然而，多数个体会拒绝伤害其他生灵。
author: beetlething
source: Wealthy people have sought out having POKENAME as a home defense unit, as it's both elegant and dangerous. However, most POKENAME will refuse to hurt others.

entry: POKENAME的体型、金属身体和高威力能量炮，让它成为理想的保镖。它坚守原地，决不挪动、屈服，极少有谁强得足以让它跪倒。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's size, metallic body, and high-power energy cannon make it an ideal bodyguard. It stands its ground and absolutely refuses to budge or buckle, and few have the strength to bring it to its knees.

entry: POKENAME将炮藏在蓬松的尾巴里，装得毫无威胁。等敌人放松警惕，就迅速抽出武器，发射威力惊人的喷射火焰。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME hides its cannon in its fluffy tail to appear non-threatening. Once its foes lower their guard, it will swiftly draw the weapon to blast them with a devastating Flamethrower.

entry: POKENAME从背炮排出大量有毒物质，再快速振翅，将毒素散向四周，一趟飞行就能击倒大片猎物。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME dispenses large amounts of toxic material from the cannon on its back. It then uses the rapid beat of its wings to spread the poison around to take down large swaths of prey in a single flight.

entry: POKENAME安静地漂在浑浊沼泽的水面，将金属身体藏在宽大的睡莲叶下。发光的红眼监视四周，机械叶片收集太阳能，为隐藏的科技系统供能。
author: msdawgs
source: POKENAME drifts quietly on murky swamp surfaces, camouflaging its metallic body beneath its wide lily pad. It monitors its surroundings with glowing red eyes, gathering solar energy through its mechanical leaf to power hidden technological systems.

entry: POKENAME身上伸出的尖齿能充当能量炮。高速下落时积蓄力量，撞地瞬间便从所有炮口释放能量。
author: sk372
source: The prongs poking from POKENAME's body can be used as energy cannons. It gains power by falling at high velocity, firing energy bursts from all the cannons on impact with the ground.

entry: POKENAME领地意识强，会守住光源，用炮轰击其他趋光宝可梦的群体。根据群体大小，既能短促连射，也能蓄力发出一击。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are territorial creatures that defend light sources from other light-seeking Pokémon, blasting swarms with their cannon. Depending on the size of the swarm, they can fire small bursts or launch a single, charged blast.

entry: POKENAME全身覆盖坚硬的紫色金属。战斗中金属变得极热，若下起雨，就会冒出蒸汽。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body is covered in a hard purple metal. This metal grows extremely hot during combat, causing it to steam should rain begin to fall.

entry: POKENAME能从头部发射强弱不一的绿色光束，用来击穿巨石，建造地下家园。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME can fire a green beam of varying power from its head. It uses this to break through boulders while constructing its underground home.

entry: POKENAME利用先进科技，只要往体内加入额外的塑料或金属，就能从双手进行3维打印。成品总是品质上乘，单件价格能高达数十万。
author: soup1900
source: Utilizing advanced technology, POKENAME can 3D-print objects from its hands once extra plastic or metal has been inserted into its body. Since its prints are always of the highest quality, the price for one can range into the hundreds of thousands.

entry: POKENAME发射的气泡会膨胀成心形，用来困住捕食者与猎物。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME fires bubbles that expand into a heart shape after being launched. It uses these to trap predators and prey alike.

entry: POKENAME为炮充能时，额头会发出异样光芒。它喜欢住在深湖，催生了当地传说：水下巢穴里藏着疯狂科学家与扭曲的实验。
author: imaginita
source: When charging its cannon, POKENAME's forehead glows with an unnatural light. It prefers to dwell in deep lakes, giving rise to local legends of underwater lairs that house mad scientists and their twisted experiments.

entry: 对POKENAME而言，暴力确实是一种燃料。每次攻击命中敌人，都能为身体补充能量，最终足以从炮中发射比自己还大的能量束。
author: sk372
source: Violence is quite literally a type of fuel for POKENAME. It energizes its body with every strike that connects with its foe, eventually giving it enough power to fire beams of energy larger than itself from its cannon.

entry: POKENAME速度快得惊人，很少被看见。它将腿向内收起，以极具空气动力学的外形悬浮，无尽能量驱动着它掠过天空，似乎永不疲倦。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME are exceptionally fast and rarely seen. They fold their legs inward to levitate in a highly aerodynamic form. Driven by boundless energy, they seemingly never tire as they zip across the sky.

entry: POKENAME尾端的炮能从数英里外准确射击。翅膀拍得越快，光束就越热。
author: .izik
source: The cannon at the end of POKENAME's tail can fire accurately from miles away. The faster its wings beat, the hotter the beams become.

entry: 虽然尾巴能保护自己，POKENAME却常觉得碍事。短腿难以带动尾巴，让它行动缓慢，跟不上其他生灵。
author: bigoljax
source: Though their tails help protect them, POKENAME often see them as a hindrance. Their small legs struggle to carry their tails along with them, making them very slow and unable to keep up with others.

entry: POKENAME在水内、水外战斗，都同样强壮、敏捷。每当开始为头上的炮充能，腹部的旋纹就会快速旋转。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME fights with equal strength and agility both in and out of water. The swirl on its stomach swirls rapidly whenever it begins charging up the cannon on its head.

entry: POKENAME用精神力量为炮供能。有时太过兴奋，会向空中胡乱开火，把人类和宝可梦都吓跑。
author: real_effin_nito
source: POKENAME uses its psychic abilities to power up its blasters. Sometimes when POKENAME gets too excited, it fires wildly into the air, scaring off people and Pokémon alike.

entry: POKENAME喜欢炫耀力量，不断掀翻树木、投掷巨石。但小小体型限制很大，不得不设法应付身体太小而难以处理的情况。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME love to boast about their strength, constantly flipping over trees and tossing large boulders. Their small stature hinders them a lot, forcing them to adapt to situations their bodies are too small for.

entry: POKENAME是疯狂的恶作剧高手，喜欢用炮瞄准训练家，假装装有弹药。炮里通常装的是旗子，但也发生过忘记把旗子装进去的事故。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME are maniacal pranksters, aiming their cannons at their trainers and pretending like they're armed. Though their cannons are often loaded with flags, there have been incidents where a POKENAME forgot to load them into their cannons.

entry: 这种融合体极爱暴力，不顾一切地发射能量，还会嘲笑被击中的目标。虽然看似无情，有人却说，它只是因复杂情绪而发泄。
author: hophoppip
source: This fusion greatly enjoys violence, firing energy blasts with reckless abandon and laughing at the targets. Though it seems heartless, some say it is lashing out due to complex emotions.

entry: POKENAME出拳越快，炮充能就越快。它会在终结连招中开炮，尽可能把敌人轰得更远。
author: .izik
source: The faster POKENAME punches, the faster its cannons charge. It uses these cannons in a finishing combo to blast foes as far away as possible.

entry: 有人说，POKENAME是逆向解析盖诺赛克特技术、应用到喷火龙身上制造超级武器的失败产物。它战斗时极为凶猛，却可能随时故障，狂暴失控。
author: sk372
source: Some say that POKENAME is a failed attempt at reverse-engineering Genesect's technology and applying it to Charizard to create a superweapon. It possesses great ferocity in battle, but can malfunction and go berserk at random.

entry: POKENAME众多触手能向四面八方发射无数细小激光。多年来，已有多部电影将它描绘成巨大、强力的外星入侵者。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's many tentacles let it fire countless small laser beams in all directions. Multiple movies featuring POKENAME as a giant and mighty alien invader have been made across the years.

entry: POKENAME炮射光束的颜色，会随吃下的晶体变化。某种颜色的晶体吃得越多，那种颜色就越鲜艳。
author: .izik
source: The beam POKENAME's cannon fires shifts color based on the crystals it consumes. The more crystals of a certain color it eats, the more vibrant that color becomes.

entry: POKENAME成群时，会将自己埋进土里，只露出上半身，形成一道防线。它们分析经过的每只宝可梦和每位训练家，只要不喜欢就射击。
author: heal_fire
source: When in a group, POKENAME are known to act like a line of defense, burying themselves so only their top half sticks out of the ground. They analyse each Pokémon and Trainer passing by, shooting at them if POKENAME don't like them.

entry: POKENAME战斗时不断积累压力，最终超过身体所能承受的限度。一到这个程度，就会迅速滚向对手，接触瞬间爆炸。
author: bigoljax
source: When in battle, POKENAME constantly build up pressure, eventually getting to a level their bodies can't handle. When this level is reached, they quickly roll into their opponents and explode on contact.

entry: POKENAME的核心能积蓄大量能量。无法继续积累时，就将其释放，引发爆炸，既能用于战斗，也能把自己从一座山炸向另一座山。
author: heal_fire
source: POKENAME core are full of energy that they can charge up. When they can't accumulate more, they release it, producing an explosion that they can use either for fighting or to launch themselves from one mountain to another.

entry: POKENAME被认为是逃脱的机械改造实验体，出没于废弃实验室附近的草原。有人看见它从远处瞄准物体和宝可梦，但除非接到指示，否则不会发射头上的武器。
author: ocxin
source: Believed to be a runaway cybernetic experiment, POKENAME can be found in grassy plains near abandoned laboratories. They are seen taking aim at objects and Pokémon from a distance, but will not fire the weapon on their heads unless told to.

entry: POKENAME的炮充能很慢，威力却极为惊人。不过，充能途中经常忘记自己在做什么，停下充能，转头做别的事。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's cannon is slow to charge but can fire devastatingly powerful blasts. However, POKENAME often forgets what it was doing during said charging process, canceling the charge as it goes on to do something else.

entry: POKENAME能一直潜在水下，将触角探出水面，感知周围环境，锁定目标开炮。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can stay submerged in the water for an indefinite amount of time. It lets its antennae poke above the water's surface to sense its surroundings and pinpoint targets to fire its cannon at.

entry: POKENAME将身体带磁性的部分压在一起，为炮充能。释放的闪电力量足以击倒一棵红杉。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME charges its cannon by pressing the magnetic portions of its body together. The lightning released can strike with enough force to topple a redwood.

entry: POKENAME炮中的激光一发就能将树变成大葱。但用途有限，使用又很累，因此很少能见到。
author: .izik
source: The laser from POKENAME's cannon can turn trees into leeks with a single zap. Its usefulness is limited and exhausting to use, making it a rare sight.

entry: POKENAME肩炮只发射高压水，背炮却能射出任何元素。收起肩炮，就能将所有能量集中进主炮，大幅增强火力。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's shoulder cannons only fire high-pressure water, but the cannon on its back can fire shots of any element. Retracting the shoulder cannons allows it to focus all its energy within the main cannon, vastly increasing its firepower.

entry: POKENAME从身上的炮释放大量烟雾，毒性极强，长时间接触会对肺造成永久损伤。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME releases large amounts of smoke from the cannon on its body. This smoke is incredibly toxic and can cause permanent lung damage with prolonged exposure.

entry: POKENAME将双手放在墓碑上，吸收悼念墓下亲人的人们留下的悲伤，再用来为炮充能作战。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME places its hands on tombstones to absorb the grief of those who mourned their loved ones below. It uses this energy to charge its cannon for combat.

entry: POKENAME喜欢折磨年老的退伍军人，模仿枪声与惨叫，在半夜将他们惊醒。与它相处一周，往往就会让这些老兵彻底精神失常。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME find deep satisfaction in tormenting old war veterans, mimicking the sounds of gunfire and screams to wake them up in the middle of the night. This often causes these veterans to go completely mad after a week around POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME的巨钳伸得远，夹得也牢。凡是不能直接夹碎的东西，就会抛上天，用强大的能量炮彻底摧毁。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's massive claw has an impressive range and grip. Anything it can't crush outright with it, it tosses into the air to obliterate with its powerful energy cannon.

entry: POKENAME遇险时，尾巴释放的热量能改变整片森林的天气。它极度渴求真相，会向任何说谎者吐出炽热丝线。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: When POKENAME is in danger, it releases heat from its tail that can change the weather in an entire forest. It has a voracious appetite for the truth and will spit fiery silk onto anyone who tells a lie.

entry: POKENAME准备进化时会反省一生，始终一动不动。只有完全诚实地面对自己，才算做好进化的准备。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME reflects on its life while preparing for evolution, remaining motionless the whole time. Once POKENAME is fully honest with itself, only then will it be ready to evolve.

entry: POKENAME排出的烟雾灼热无比，喷射的火焰也极为猛烈。准备攻击时，两颗头嘴巴下方的符号会开始发光。
author: fireblade141
source: The smog it expels from its body is searing hot, as are the flames that POKENAME can fire with extremely high intensity. The symbols beneath the mouths of the two heads will start to glow when it is preparing an attack.

entry: 对真心爱护宝可梦的训练家，POKENAME可能会前来，为蛋的孵化赐福。合众研究者称，它袋中的宝宝与某位现代国王相像。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: For Trainers who genuinely love their Pokémon, POKENAME may visit them to bless egg hatchings. Unovan researchers claim that the baby in POKENAME's pouch bears a resemblance to a modern king.

entry: POKENAME的翅膀散出粉末，迫使人说出宁愿隐藏的真相。这种粉末深受犯罪组织追捧。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME's wings scatter powder that compel people to reveal truths that they'd rather keep hidden. This powder is highly sought out by criminal organizations.

entry: POKENAME喜欢温泉，能用尾巴加热周围的水。尾巴也能在水下喷射推进，帮助游泳。
author: final_courtesy
source: POKENAME can warm surrounding water with its tail and favors hot springs. Its tail can also assist it while swimming via underwater propulsion.

entry: POKENAME高贵的白毛上时刻流过闪电，却不会伤害信任的对象。惹怒它的人，会迎来混着电流的灼热吐息，承受它的愤怒。
author: sk372
source: Lightning courses across POKENAME's regal white fur at all times, though it will not harm those it trusts. Those that incite its ire will face its wrath in the form of a searing flame breath with electricity mixed within.

entry: POKENAME毛发散出的热量足以让周围空气明显扭曲。据说，只有心怀诚实的人才能真正驯服它，配得上在战斗中运用纯白火焰。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME radiates enough heat from its fur to visibly distort the air immediately around it. It's said only those with honest hearts will be able to truly tame it and be worthy of utilizing its pure white flames in battle.

entry: POKENAME整天待在洞里，等附近村民喂茄番果。它能吃下整座果园的分量，却更愿意让人亲手喂食。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME spend their days in caves waiting to be fed Tamato Berries by humans in nearby villages. They have an appetite to devour an orchard's-worth of the berries but would rather it be fed them by hand instead.

entry: POKENAME在野外很少被看见，似乎只住在水质最纯净的湖泊。据说，它会出现在诚实之人面前，给予神秘恩惠。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is rarely spotted in the wild, as it seems to only inhabit lakes with the most pristine of waters. It's said that it will appear before those with honest hearts and grant them a mysterious boon.

entry: POKENAME的羽毛柔软、温暖得惊人，很适合做枕头。性情友好，但食量巨大，通常只有极富裕的人才养得起。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME's feathers are incredibly soft and warm, making them great pillows. They have a friendly demeanour, but their requirement for vast amounts of food means that usually only extremely rich people can afford to keep them.

entry: 传说，POKENAME曾游历世界，将“真实”的概念赐予古代文明。只要待在附近，就很难说出谎话。
author: quackquackattack
source: Legends describe POKENAME traveling throughout the world to bestow the concept of truth onto ancient civilizations. Simply being near POKENAME makes it difficult to tell lies.

entry: POKENAME毕生守护家园草原。当危险的人类或宝可梦四处游荡时，就会飞上天空，像信号弹般迸发彩光，示意草原上的宝可梦躲藏。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME spend their life to protect the plains they call home. When dangerous people or Pokémon are on the prowl, POKENAME will fly into the air and burst into color like a flare. This signals to the Pokémon in the plains to hide.

entry: 据说是知晓宇宙终极真理的智慧宝可梦。很少与其他生灵交流、分享智慧，往往伴随一团火焰飞走，独自栖居。
author: sk372
source: A wise Pokémon that is said to know the ultimate truth of the universe. It rarely interacts with others or shares its wisdom, flying away in a burst of flame to roost somewhere in solitude.

entry: POKENAME的蛛丝因保暖性极佳而备受追捧，但它只允许信任的对象采集。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: The webbing from POKENAME is sought after for its high warmth retention. POKENAME only lets those it trusts harvest its web.

entry: POKENAME小小的身体还在成长，尚未完全容纳力量，使一侧翅膀始终燃烧。它努力保持自律与控制，以免烧伤在乎的生灵。
author: sk372
source: Because its small body is still growing, POKENAME's powers are not fully contained, leading one wing to be perpetually on fire. POKENAME tries hard to maintain discipline and control so as not to burn those it cares about.

entry: 据说，POKENAME只出现在诚实、纯洁的人面前。传说抱着它，就能看穿一切针对自己的欺骗与谎言。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is said to only appear before those who have honest and pure hearts. According to legends, holding POKENAME allows a person to see through any deception and lies posited towards them.

entry: POKENAME只要用耳朵听见声音，就能察觉一个人试图欺骗。如果被彻底骗过，就会用燃起的尾巴烧灼对方。
author: doctorjazznumber6215
source: POKENAME can detect deception attempts just by hearing a person's voice with its ears. It uses its flared-up tail to scorch anyone who completely tricked it.

entry: 极其记仇的宝可梦，要求所有看见它的生灵完全认同它给出的真理，否则就用蓄能焰袭将其轰成碎屑。然而，这些“真理”并不总是正确，追随起来也可能很危险。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: A terribly vindictive Pokémon, it demands all that see it to wholly embrace a truth it presents, otherwise, it obliterates them to smithereens with a Flame Charge. These truths are not always correct though and can be dangerous to pursue.

entry: POKENAME点燃尾巴，在夜间照明。偶尔忘了自己做过什么，以为身上着火，吓得惊慌奔跑。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME ignite their tail in order to see at night. Occasionally they forget they've done this and end up running around in a panic thinking they're on fire.

entry: POKENAME用细毛感知气流，让喷出的火焰优美流动。尾巴开始发光时，能量会影响大气，改变天气。
author: grannyjojophone
source: POKENAME uses its fine hair to read air currents and make its flames that it spews flow beautifully. When its tail starts to glow, the energy shifts the atmosphere and changes the weather.

entry: 据说，POKENAME只向探寻世界真相的人现身。有人请求指引时，环纹与火焰会明亮发光。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: It's said that POKENAME only appears to those who seek the truth about the world. Its rings and flames glow brightly when one asks for its guidance.

entry: POKENAME在极高的空中翱翔。小流星坠落时，会追上抓住，储存在头顶冒出的火焰羽冠里。
author: inkysquid38
source: POKENAME soars at incredibly high altitudes. When small meteors fall from the sky, it chases after and snatches them up in order to store them in the plume of fire that sprouts from its head.

entry: 只要妥善控制，POKENAME的火焰便可能改变全世界天气。幸好，它似乎只想用这股巨力照亮大片区域，更容易找到让自己着迷的闪亮物品。
author: herrskorpion
source: With proper control, a POKENAME's flames could hold the power to change the world's weather. Fortunately, they only seem intent on using this immense power to illuminate large areas in order to more easily find sparkling objects to fixate on.

entry: POKENAME的后半身外观明显不同，多半时候似乎还与前半身不和。尾巴从嘴里射出看似闪电的东西，其实是高度集中的火焰。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's back half has a distinctly different appearance, and most of the time seems to be at odds with the front half. The tail fires what looks like lightning from its mouth, but it is actually concentrated bursts of fire.

entry: POKENAME钻穿火山，寻找凝灰岩食用。有些化石猎人会跟踪它，因为它会吐出含有化石的凝灰岩。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME bores through volcanic mountains in search of rocky tuff to consume. Some fossil hunters track POKENAME, as the Pokémon spits out tuff that contains fossils.

entry: 甲壳像某些故事里提到的石头。产生、储存的热量极高，甚至能熔化黑曜石。
author: infinex21
source: Its shell resembles a stone mentioned in some stories. It generates and stores such intense heat that it can melt obsidian.

entry: 节日期间，POKENAME兴奋地给雪中城镇送去温暖礼物。可惜，它低估了热到什么程度才算过头，礼物一打开就会爆发交错火焰。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME excitedly brings warm gifts to snowy towns during the holidays. Unfortunately, it underestimates how warm is too warm, with the gifts unleashing a blast of Fusion Flare when opened.

entry: POKENAME锐利的蓝眼与白鳞让它极易辨认，是彻头彻尾的破坏机器。历代流传着许多关于它凶猛的故事。
author: mepp.
source: Easily recognizable by its piercing blue eyes and white scales, POKENAME is a pure engine of destruction. There are many tales of its ferocity written across the ages.

entry: 不知为何，POKENAME总将尾巴含在嘴里，只有攻击时才放弃环形姿态。毒液灼热，随其在受害者体内扩散，内部烧伤会不断加重。
author: fireblade141
source: It is unknown why POKENAME always holds its tail in its mouth, only abandoning its circular shape to attack. Its venom is searing hot and causes victims to receive growing internal burns as the substance spreads through their bodies.

entry: POKENAME在深海活跃的热泉口附近安家，很少让自己被看见。喷出的灼热沸腾气泡流，能将发现它的生灵迅速赶走。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME makes its home deep undersea near where thermal vents are active. It rarely lets itself be seen, and the searing boiling stream of bubbles it can blow sends any that find it swimming away swiftly.

entry: 由于外观威严，当地人禁止猎捕这种宝可梦。POKENAME脱落的角仍会发光，被用作高级装饰品。
author: korro0490
source: Due to its majestic appearance, locals prohibit the hunting of this Pokémon. Antlers fallen from POKENAME retain their glow and are used as high-quality decorations.

entry: POKENAME用尾巴上鲜艳的火焰创作焰火艺术。据说，不论塑成什么形状，燃烧时不断变幻的色彩都令人难忘。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses the vibrant flame on its tail to create pyrotechnic artistic displays. The shifting hues of the flames as they burn in whatever shape POKENAME created are said to be an unforgettable sight.

entry: POKENAME飞遍家园所在的地区，给有需要者送哞哞鲜奶。比起自己，它们更在意帮助别人，因此经常有眼袋，也睡不好觉。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME fly around the regions they call home, delivering MooMoo Milk to those in need. Because they value helping others over helping themselves, POKENAME often have eye bags and issues with sleeping.

entry: 体内翻涌的巨大能量让身体和尾巴发光，并以弧状闪电涌出。据说，这种宝可梦只向努力探寻万物真相的人现身，但这类说法无法证实。
author: infinex21
source: Its body and tail glow from the immense energy broiling inside of it, which emerges as arcing bolts of lightning. This Pokémon is said to only appear for those that endeavor to seek the truth in all things, but there is no way to confirm such claims.

entry: POKENAME其实全身都披着白毛，其他色彩来自体内的火焰和热量。炮状双臂能发射猛烈火球，威力甚至足以将坚硬岩石化成熔渣。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are actually entirely clad in white fur; the other colored parts are due to their internal flames and heat. From their cannon-like arms, they can fire intense fireballs that can be so powerful that they can reduce solid rock to slag.

entry: POKENAME出现在猛烈暴风雪中迷路的训练家面前，引导他们脱险。华美的白毛像雪一样闪亮，移动时也会留下闪光的轨迹。
author: actliux
source: POKENAME appear before wayward Trainers trapped in the midst of harsh blizzards to guide them to safety. Their majestic white fur sparkles like snow, and they leave a trail of this sparkle whenever they move.

entry: POKENAME想办法时，有时会用火焰烧灼自己，烧掉错误答案，找出真正的解法。它也会用同样的方法焚烧做出错误人生选择的人，以此“帮助”他们。
author: soup1900
source: When trying to create solutions, POKENAME sometimes scorches itself in its flames to burn faulty answers and get to the true solution. It uses this same method of incineration on others who make incorrect choices in life too to help them out as well.

entry: POKENAME的体力几乎无与伦比。据说既能夷平城市，也能拖动城市所在的整块土地。
author: theartemis1
source: The physical strength of POKENAME is near-unparalleled. It is said that it can both level a city, and drag the weight of the land it sits upon.

entry: POKENAME的舞步结合了体内强大的火力。每次旋转、跳跃，都有白炽火焰跟随或覆盖，保护自己，伤害一切靠近者。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's dance moves combine with a great amount of intense internal fire power. Its every twirl and leap is followed or covered by white-hot flames that protect it and damage anything that draws near.

entry: POKENAME游历各地，寻找值得追随的训练家，在森林留下火焰轨迹。许多社会至今仍将它奉为忠诚的象征。
author: hinochi.
source: POKENAME wanders the region in search of a worthy Trainer, leaving trails of fire behind in forests. Its image is still revered as a symbol of loyalty in many societies.

entry: 虽然POKENAME很少流露感情，却极在意训练家的安危，愿为其赌上性命。它以致命而优雅的姿态挥刀，直到对手倒下。
author: actliux
source: Although it shows little emotion, POKENAME cares greatly for the safety of its Trainer and would put its life on the line for them. It swings its blades with a deadly elegance until its opponent is felled.

entry: POKENAME是严厉的信息守护者，极其厌恶秘密。据说，向它说谎会招来灾祸，让一切隐情曝光。但对诚实的训练家而言，再没有比它更忠诚的战士。
author: thesilverowls
source: POKENAME are fierce stewards of information and utterly abhor secrets. It is said that to lie to a POKENAME is to invite disaster and have any hidden information revealed. To an honest trainer, however, there is no more devoted fighter.

entry: POKENAME极不喜欢仿照宝可梦制作的玩具，会用黏舌抓住、拆碎。主流观点认为，它觉得这些仿品扭曲了所模仿宝可梦的真实形态。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have an intense dislike of toy replicas of Pokémon, using their sticky tongues to grab onto toys and break them apart. The leading theory is that they view the replicas as distortions of the true forms of the Pokémon they depict.

entry: POKENAME遇见虚假便会隐形，求助者不诚实，就绝不帮忙。它没有道德观念，只要请求出于真心，任何事情都乐意协助。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME turn invisible when they are confronted with falsehoods, refusing to offer help unless the one asking is honest with them. They have no concept of morality, and happily aid in any task provided the one making the request is honest in asking.

entry: POKENAME怀疑有人意图不诚，就会隐形，仔细观察，试图确定动机。若觉得怀疑得到证实，就会用强力交错火焰攻击。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME turn invisible when they suspect someone has dishonest intent, watching the person carefully to try and determine their motivations. If they feel their suspicions have been proven correct, they attack with a powerful Fusion Flare.

entry: POKENAME对自己建造的坝极为苛刻。成品只要发现一丁点缺陷，就会用猛烈火焰烧毁，从头再来。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is very critical of the dams it builds. If even a minute flaw is detected in the finished product, it incinerates it with its intense flames before starting the whole process anew.

entry: POKENAME曾被尊为某位神祇圣火的显现。按照当时的信仰，它只会出现在真诚、纯洁的人面前。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME was once revered as the manifestation of a deity's sacred flame. According to those beliefs, POKENAME would only appear before those who had a true and pure heart.

entry: 骗子与阴谋家永远无法和它交朋友。最好远远避开，免遭烈火惩罚。
author: final_courtesy
source: Liars and schemers will never befriend this Pokémon. In fact, they should avoid it at all costs, lest they suffer the fiery consequences.

entry: POKENAME借尾巴产生的火焰加速，跃过长距离。最强的个体，火焰会烧成白炽。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses the fire generated from its tail as a way to boost its speed and let it leap long distances. The strongest POKENAME have flames that burn white-hot.

entry: POKENAME假装被自己又大又软的耳朵绊倒，装得十分无助。目标一靠近，就点燃伪装的巨颚，化为火焰武器。面对理想坚定的对手时，火焰会变蓝。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME pretends to be helpless, fake-tripping over its large, floppy ear. Whenever its target nears, it ignites the disguised jaws as a flaming weapon. The flames turn blue in the presence of an opponent with strong ideals.

entry: POKENAME假装被自己又大又软的耳朵绊倒，装得十分无助。目标一靠近，就点燃伪装的巨颚，化为火焰武器。面对理想坚定的对手时，火焰会变蓝。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME pretends to be helpless, fake-tripping over its large, floppy ear. Whenever its target nears, it ignites the disguised jaws as a flaming weapon. The flames turn blue in the presence of an opponent with strong ideals.

entry: POKENAME大多时候在海底平静爬行，但接触到人类对真实的渴望，就会唤醒体内强大的龙之能量，足以迎战任何敌人。
author: .realthree
source: Though POKENAME spends most of its time scuttling peacefully across the ocean floor, being exposed to a human's desire for truth awakens the powerful draconic energy within it, enabling it to fight any foe.

entry: 合众神话说，POKENAME是人们进入来世前，负责审判的宝可梦之一。与人类心灵相通时，面对一生谎话连篇的人，口中火焰会烧得最猛烈。
author: beatdoof
source: Unovan mythology tell tales of POKENAME being one of the Pokémon to judge you before you enter the afterlife. When POKENAME would telepathically interact with a human, the flame in its mouth rages most against those who lived a life of lies.

entry: POKENAME觉得不受敬重，就会闹脾气，引发巨大飓风。据说人类的供品能安抚它充满破坏欲的心情。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME feels unrevered, it sulks and triggers massive hurricanes. Offerings from humans are said to calm its destructive moods.

entry: 法院中常能看见描绘POKENAME的艺术作品，象征一种信念：真实是创造安全、自由世界的终极力量。
author: wiz0z
source: Artistic depictions of POKENAME are common sights in courthouses. They symbolize the belief that the truth is the ultimate power in creating a safe and free world.

entry: 据说，世上有多少人全心热爱真实，POKENAME传说中的胡须就有多少根。面对邪恶时，冠部会燃起灼热火焰。
author: .realthree
source: It is said that there are as many hairs in POKENAME's legendary beard as there are people in the world who love truth with all their heart. When confronted with evil, its crown blazes with blistering heat.

entry: POKENAME的剑刃燃着太阳般的高热，还会影响天气。它倾向选择更明辨真理的持有者。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME's blade burns with the heat of the sun and affects the weather. It gravitates towards wielders with a superior sense of truth.

entry: 古代一个由骑士和战士组成的团体，曾将POKENAME用于象征图案。留存文献中有一句：“愿如POKENAME，成为不屈的真实。”
author: sk372
source: An ancient order of knights and warriors once used POKENAME as part of their iconography. A quote from surviving texts of the group reads: "To be as POKENAME, and be truth unbreakable".

entry: 据传，POKENAME的核心每分钟转速超过10,000转，产生的高热足以切开陨石。它认为追寻真实的人值得相伴，并以无数隐藏的齿轮保护他们。
author: npshi
source: The core of a POKENAME is rumored to spin at over 10,000 RPM, generating heat strong enough to slice through a meteorite. POKENAME deem those who pursue truth to be worthy of their presence, while using their innumerable hidden gears to protect them.

entry: 神话说，POKENAME的蓝焰能为遭灾地区带回温暖与希望。多处考古遗址都出土过它的雕像。
author: mepp.
source: According to myth, POKENAME's blue flames help restore warmth and hope to places struck by disaster. Statues of it have been unearthed in various archaeological sites.

entry: POKENAME体内蕴藏猛烈的龙之能量，火爆脾气正是这种能量的表现。野外遇上它很危险，领地也被怒火摧残得伤痕累累。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME contain an intense draconic energy within their bodies, their fiery temper a manifestation of this energy. They are dangerous Pokémon to encounter in the wild, their territories scarred and damaged from their rage.

entry: 渡海求索真理的人，或许能瞥见这只传说宝可梦。鳍上的火欧泊，能改变全球天气。
author: .realthree
source: Those who cross the seas seeking truth may catch a glimpse of this legendary Pokémon. The fiery opals on its fins can alter the world's weather.

entry: POKENAME翱翔云端，白焰在无尽天空中明亮燃烧。传说它的到来能平息风暴，同时以炽烈的真实点燃空气。
author: _harmedx
source: POKENAME soars above the clouds, its white flames burning bright against the endless sky. Legends say its presence brings calm to storms while igniting the air with blazing truth.

entry: 据说，POKENAME诞生于最初照亮天空的火焰，无需翅膀也能翱翔。身体散出的火焰净化空气，也烧灼敌人。
author: ambrosia04
source: Said to have been born from the first flame that lit the sky, POKENAME needs no wings to soar. The flames emanating from its body purify the air and scorch its enemies.

entry: 这头可怕巨兽主要住在毁坏的世界。POKENAME周身热光比千颗恒星更明亮，众多牙齿与惊人速度，让它成为从不罢休的捕食者。
author: the_smirker
source: This terrifying behemoth resides primarily in the Distortion World. The heat emitted by POKENAME burns brighter than a thousand stars. Its numerous teeth and incredible speed make it a relentless predator.

entry: POKENAME的坚硬鳞片在所有龙属性宝可梦中也算极厚，防御几乎无懈可击。凭借多组极硬、旋转的牙齿，几分钟便能吞食整座岛屿，使其沉没。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME's tough scales are some of the thickest of all Dragon-types, making them nigh-unstoppable defensively. With its numerous sets of extremely hard, rotating teeth, it can devour and sink entire islands in minutes.

entry: 被POKENAME催眠的人，会做关于自己最糟糕、最懊悔记忆的噩梦。多数人对它展示的内容十分愤怒，它却似乎只想帮助别人进步，克服过去。
author: bobosmith01
source: If POKENAME makes someone fall asleep, they will experience nightmares consisting of their own worst and regrettable memories. While most are outraged by what POKENAME shows, it seems it merely wants others to improve and overcome their past.

entry: POKENAME偶尔飞过森林，制造受控的林火，促进健康生长。如果有善良的人在场，就会小心将他们带走。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME fly around forests on occasion, creating controlled forest fires to promote healthy growth. If kind people are present, POKENAME will carefully extract them.

entry: POKENAME偶尔飞过森林，制造受控的林火，促进健康生长。如果有腐败之人在场，就会试着用火焰将他们包围。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME fly around forests on occasion, creating controlled forest fires to promote healthy growth. If corrupt people are present, POKENAME will attempt to box them in with flames.

entry: POKENAME身体两侧的一对生火器官，提供近乎无穷的灼热。它能借此以喷气飞机般的力量和速度升空、飞行。
author: sk372
source: A pair of fire-generating organs on POKENAME's sides give it a nigh endless supply of blazing heat. It can use them to boost itself into and through the air with the force and speed of a jet plane.

entry: 以鲜明蓝眼与惊人破坏力闻名的龙宝可梦。报告尚无定论，但人们相信，纵观全部历史，也只有三四只存在过。
author: sk372
source: A dragon Pokémon known for its stark blue eyes and its incredible destructive power. Reports are inconclusive, but it is believed only three or four specimens have existed across the entirety of history.

entry: 它是真实与理想之龙，因训练家心中的力量而合一，应着铃声被唤来。
author: caffinateddragon
source: The Dragon of Truth and Ideals, merged by the strength of its Trainer's heart. It was called forth by the sound of a bell.

entry: 人们让莱希拉姆与捷克罗姆融合，试图复原最初之龙。可没有酋雷姆，这种融合极不稳定。
author: faelocke
source: Reshiram and Zekrom were fused in an attempt to revive the original dragon. But without Kyurem, this fusion is highly unstable.

entry: 真实与理想融合而成的空洞实体。捷克罗姆与莱希拉姆体内引擎的力量结合，让这种融合体能召来纯粹火焰构成的雷暴。
author: mineskyva
source: A hollow fusion of truth and ideal made manifest. The combined might of Zekrom and Reshiram's internal engines allows this fusion to summon thunderstorms of pure flame.

entry: 根据合众古代神龙的口述传说，POKENAME与其传奇外形十分相像。它用涡轮尾巴将热能与电流融合，产生等离子体。
author: ambrosia04
source: According to oral folktales of Unova's ancient dragon, POKENAME closely match its legendary appearance. They generate plasma by using their turbine tails to merge thermal energy with electrical currents.

entry: POKENAME会潜伏在被火山摧毁的村庄附近。陌生人靠近时，就会拉开嘴上的拉链，释放灼热火焰。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME have been known to lurk near villages destroyed by volcanoes. When strangers approach POKENAME, they unzip their mouths to unleash scalding flames.

entry: POKENAME喜欢用双手拍打石头，以炽热将其烧灼。它能改变身体温度，因此也能拥抱训练家而不造成伤害。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME enjoy smacking rocks with their hands, scorching them with blistering heat. They display the ability to change how hot their body gets, allowing it to embrace their Trainers without harm.

entry: 相传POKENAME的火焰无法熄灭，已经燃烧了超过10,000年。它只会现身于探寻生命意义、追求真理的人面前。
author: mistymagius
source: Fables say POKENAME's flame is impossible to extinguish and to have stayed burning for over 10,000 years. It is said to only appear in front of people who seek the truth in the meaning of life.

entry: 古文献记载，POKENAME曾是火山的守护者，还描述它用巨大火炬焚毁威胁、引导熔岩流动。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: According to ancient texts, POKENAME were guardians of volcanoes. These same texts describe that POKENAME uses their massive torches to incinerate threats and direct flowing lava.

entry: POKENAME用涡轮般的尾巴推动自己飞过天空，留下发光火迹。即使高速飞行也优雅非凡，身后的火焰让它看起来像流星。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME use their turbine-like tails to propel themselves through the sky, leaving a glowing trail of fire. Even at high speeds, they glide with remarkable elegance; their fire trails make them resemble shooting stars.

entry: 其他宝可梦假扮成并非自己的模样时，POKENAME似乎就会生气。但自己的伪装若被破坏，也会当场怒火中烧，事后修补时又哭起来。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME seem to be enraged whenever other Pokémon pretend to be something they are not. If POKENAME's own disguise is broken it burns with anger in the moment, then bursts into tears when repairing it afterwards.

entry: POKENAME拍动双翼，控制喷出的火焰，再借毛发引导，将火集中到尾巴。
author: vicho9761
source: POKENAME can control the fire that it expels by flapping its wings. It manipulates the flames with their fur to concentrate it on their tails.

entry: POKENAME从臂上的炮状附肢发射巨大、威力惊人的火球。研究发现，这些弹丸竟是遥远恒星精确的微缩复制品。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME fires massive and devastating fireballs from the cannon-like appendage on its arm. Researching these projectiles has revealed them to be exact miniature replicas of distant stars.

entry: POKENAME用精神力量支撑沉重的涡轮状臂炮。集中精神能量，就能从炮管射出灼热火束。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME use their psychic abilities to support a heavy, turbine-like arm cannon. By focusing their psychic energy, they can shoot searing beams of fire from the barrel.

entry: 虽然POKENAME仍在成长，却潜力巨大，只要足够努力，就能在周身燃起炽烈气场。它刻苦训练、战斗，维护正义，烧尽世间邪恶。
author: sk372
source: Though it is still growing, POKENAME has vast potential, able to burn a blazing aura around it when it tries hard enough. It fights and trains hard to uphold justice and burn away the evils of the world.

entry: POKENAME在体内生热，提高钢壳温度来防御。热量足以让全身烧得白炽发亮。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME will generate heat within its body to increase the temperature of its steel shell as a method of defense. It can generate enough heat to cause its entire body to glow white-hot.

entry: POKENAME平时游得慢，不太擅长捕猎，却能在正式战斗中表现不俗。它顺溪流移动，据说会宣讲世界的真理，令其他宝可梦惊叹。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is typically a slow swimmer and cannot hunt very well, but it can hold its own decently well in a proper battle. It travels down streams and is said to preach truths about the world that leave other Pokémon stunned.

entry: POKENAME排出的毒烟不断刺激自己，令它陷入狂暴。它以猛焰裹身，撞向所有挡路之物。
author: mistymagius
source: The toxic fumes POKENAME's body emits constantly agitate it into a rampage. It coats its body in harsh flames and rams into anything in its way.

entry: 它同时处于冻结与燃烧的矛盾状态，对说谎者和江湖骗子深为不齿。
author: busilisk
source: This Pokémon exists in a paradoxical state of freezing and burning. It holds a fierce contempt for liars and charlatans.

entry: 朝圣者穿过积雪山谷，希望遇见POKENAME。他们相信，见到它便能领悟世界的真理，找到内心平静。
author: wiz0z
source: Pilgrims journey through snow-laden mountain valleys in hopes of encountering POKENAME. They believe seeing POKENAME will grant them enlightenment towards the truth of the world and help them find inner peace.

entry: POKENAME起舞时，翅膀和尾巴周围会形成火焰音符。音符能甩出去烧伤敌人，每个都蕴藏喷射火焰般的高热。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: As POKENAME dances, fiery musical notes form around its wings and tail. These notes can be flung out to burn enemies, each containing the intense heat of a Flamethrower attack.

entry: POKENAME向四面八方喷射炽热的等离子体，将沿途一切烧尽。有人推测，它是外星文明制造的超级兵器，用于灭绝整个星球上的生命。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME fires hot plasma in all directions, incinerating anything its path. It is theorized that POKENAME is an alien-built superweapon made to sterilize entire planets.

entry: POKENAME身上长的蘑菇极辣，因此被用于多种菜肴。野生个体不愿让人采收，会挥出灼热利爪反击。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: The mushrooms grown by POKENAME are incredibly spicy and thus are used in various dishes. Wild POKENAME are resistant to having their mushrooms harvested and will lash out with searing-hot claws.

entry: POKENAME双翼闪着余烬，像飘落的音符般散开。旋律能点燃每位听者的心，振奋精神。
author: jackjirachi
source: POKENAME's wings shimmer with embers that drift like falling notes. Its melodies fan the flames of the hearts of everyone who hears it, lifting their spirits up.

entry: POKENAME天性娴静，歌声却充满炽热激情，向四周荡开，鼓舞附近所有生灵。即使最疲惫的对象，也会重新精神百倍地跃起。
author: jackjirachi
source: POKENAME are demure in nature. Their songs, full of fiery passion, can ripple outward and lift the spirits of everyone nearby. Even the most exhausted will spring up with renewed energy.

entry: POKENAME需要大量食物，会用热能改变当地气候，让植物长得更快，再以此为食。但改变天气很耗能，只好寻找更多食物，循环不休。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME need a great deal of food. Using heat energy, they alter the local climate to make plants grow faster, allowing them to feed on the plants. Altering the weather requires a lot of energy, perpetuating the cycle as they seek more food.

entry: POKENAME释放白炽烈焰，极高热量使其发白。身体涌出的烟也近乎灼人，因此训练家接触它时都会戴手套。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME release incandescent flames that glow white with extreme heat. The resulting smoke that erupts from their bodies borders on scalding hot, so Trainers wear gloves whenever they handle POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME的体温几乎维持着完美平衡，既让头顶的冰淇淋保持凝固，又能在体内产生烈火。身上那把勺子，只有心灵纯洁的人才能取下。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME's body temperature is in a near perfect balance to allow for the ice cream atop its head to remain solid while being able to produce blazing fire within. The spoon it sports can only be removed by one who is pure of heart.

entry: 许多探险者将休眠的POKENAME误认为传说中的光明石。多数人最终安然无恙，但据说，它会破壳而出，将认定为狡诈的人化作灰烬。
author: icelevelincarnate
source: Many explorers have mistaken dormant POKENAME for the Light Stone of legend. Most come out of the misunderstanding unscathed, but it's said that POKENAME will emerge from their shell and reduce those it considers deceitful to ashes.

entry: POKENAME高速掠过天空，留下火迹，烧散云层，即使最猛烈的风暴也能转晴。所经之处会吸引大批围观者，争着从远处欣赏奇观。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME jet across the sky at high speed, leaving a fiery trail in their wake that burns away clouds and can turn even the stormiest of skies clear. Their passage draws crowds of onlookers, eager to watch the spectacle from afar.

entry: POKENAME奇妙的白鳞令许多画家至今仍专心描绘它的威仪。传言蓝焰能熔化星球上找到的任何材料。
author: fiordaliso
source: Many painters still devote their work to the majesty of POKENAME because of its wondrous white scales. Rumor holds that its blue fire can melt any material found on the planet.

entry: POKENAME瞬间移动时，尾部会腾起烈焰，将原地烧出一片焦痕。它时常瞬移，连睡觉时也不例外，察觉危险逼近时尤其如此。
author: goldegummybear
source: When POKENAME teleports, its tail flares and leaves a scorched patch of ground where it once was. It teleports often, even while asleep, especially if it senses danger approaching.

entry: 据说，凝望POKENAME的火焰，很快就会领悟世界隐藏的真相。它自己也花许多时间，恍惚地研究火焰，增强力量。
author: mepp.
source: If one were to peer into POKENAME's flames, it is said that hidden truths of the world will soon be revealed to them. The Pokémon itself spends much of its time in a trance-like state studying these flames to expand its powers.

entry: POKENAME能用双手将青焰与交错火焰凝成高热球体，投掷出去。身上的腰带能防止自己被烧伤。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Using its hands, POKENAME can manifest Blue Flare and Fusion Flare into orbs of intense heat to be thrown. The belt it wears helps keep POKENAME from burning itself.

entry: 神话说，它的拳头温度比太阳还高，一拳便能烧毁房屋。不过，大多时间都在火山口训练，因此很少被看见。
author: mistymagius
source: Myths say its fists reach temperatures hotter than the sun and have the power to incinerate houses in a single punch. However, it is rarely seen as it spends most of its time training in volcanic craters.

entry: 虽然POKENAME外貌可怕，却是高贵、讲荣誉的战士。但对使用卑劣战术的敌人，绝不留情。
author: cait_sith
source: Despite POKENAME's monstrous appearance, it is a noble and honorable fighter. However, it shows no mercy towards those who employ underhanded tactics.

entry: POKENAME驰骋世界追寻真理。据说会向那些探索自身真实的人现身。
author: nellnast42
source: POKENAME gallops across the world in pursuit of truth. It is said that it tends to appear before those who search for their own truth.

entry: POKENAME心性平静、单纯，对谁都友好。但若察觉不诚实的心，就会避开，不肯交流，直到对方改过。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has a placid, simple mind and behaves in a friendly manner to all, unless it senses a dishonest heart. It shuns them, refusing to interact with them until they change their ways.

entry: 由于体内产生猛烈火焰，POKENAME的炮摸起来始终温热，准备发射时更会烧红。它很少失手。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME cannons are always warm to the touch due to the intense fire it generates within its body, and will become red-hot when it is preparing to fire. POKENAME rarely misses a shot.

entry: POKENAME口中含着一颗力量巨大的球体，因此能轻松操纵火焰。
author: atlas3339098
source: In its mouth, POKENAME holds an orb of immense power. This grants it the ability to manipulate fire with ease.

entry: POKENAME背上的大种子像灰色满月，使人相信它来自月亮。它在月光下休息充能，储存能量，在白天战斗、活动。
author: fiordaliso
source: The big seed on POKENAME's back resembles a grey full moon, leading to the belief it has arrived from it. It recharges by resting under moonlight, storing energy to fight and stay active throughout the day.

entry: POKENAME的丝被纺织业用来制作轻盈、透气的衣物。奇妙的是，月光下会像银一样闪亮。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME silk is used in the textile industry to create clothes that are light and airy. The silk has the strange property of glittering like silver under the light of the moon.

entry: POKENAME在扭蛋机里假扮皮皮玩偶，希望被训练家抽走。它很没耐心，期待时甚至会摇晃机器。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME masquerade as Poké Dolls inside capsule machines, hoping to be won by a Trainer. POKENAME are quite impatient and may rattle the machine in anticipation.

entry: POKENAME独自游荡洞窟，偏爱孤独。如果受到打扰，就会迅速使出骨棒反击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME wanders caves alone, favoring isolation. If disturbed, it retaliates swiftly with Bone Club.

entry: POKENAME很少与同类待在一起，更喜欢独自在安静、晴朗的地方晒太阳。它用花朵或亲手雕刻的黄色石头装饰骨棒，图案常是星星和月亮。
author: curazy
source: POKENAME is rarely seen with others of its kind. It prefers quiet, sunny places where it can bask alone. POKENAME decorates its bone club with flowers or yellow stones it carves itself, often representing stars and the moon.

entry: POKENAME用陨石碎片作武器，挥舞时力量很大。还会用更多碎片当装甲，保护头部，让自己能战斗更久。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME wield shards of meteorite as a weapon, swinging them with great force. They use additional pieces of meteorite as armour, protecting their heads and enabling them to fight for longer periods of time.

entry: 据说，POKENAME排出的粉色气体会让人头昏、眩晕。接触足够多后，甚至有人说大白天也看见了星星。
author: quackquackattack
source: The pink gas that POKENAME expels from their body is said to make people feel lightheaded and dizzy. With enough POKENAME exposure, some people even describe seeing stars in the middle of the day.

entry: POKENAME的丝被纺织业用来制作轻盈、透气的衣物。奇妙的是，月光下会像银一样闪亮。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME silk is used in the textile industry to create clothes that are light and airy. The silk has the strange property of glittering like silver under the light of the moon.

entry: 当地传说，POKENAME像流星般坠落在月见山周围的森林。虽然没有证据，它似乎确实亲近满月，明亮月光下最容易在树上看见。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Local legends speak of POKENAME falling as shooting stars into the forests surrounding Mt Moon. Though there's no evidence of it, POKENAME appear to have an affinity for the full moon and are most visible in their trees in bright moonlight.

entry: POKENAME产生的银色粉尘是一种致幻毒素。受影响的人说，会觉得身体变轻，还能看见星星。
author: quackquackattack
source: The silvery dust that POKENAME produce is a toxin that causes hallucinations. People describe feeling lighter and seeing stars while under the influence of POKENAME dust.

entry: 它们喜欢吃人们遗留在山路上的零食，常因食物放得太久而中毒。为此，会找来一颗无青果随身保管，确保身体健康。
author: quackquackattack
source: They enjoy eating snacks that people leave behind on mountain trails, and as a result have a tendency to get poisoned from food left out too long. To remedy this, they find and keep a Drash Berry handy to ensure they remain healthy.

entry: POKENAME的鳞粉对清冷月光产生反应，让双翼闪亮。夜里结群飞行时宛如流星，是游客争相寻找的景观。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME's wings glitter under the light of the moon, their wing scales reacting to the cool lunar rays. Flights of them look like shooting stars at night and are a popular sight for tourists to seek out.

entry: POKENAME脸部中央的宝石始终映照夜空，即使天气再恶劣也一样。在一年大半时间都是雨季的地方，天文学家常用它研究、绘制星图。
author: agentyoshi
source: The gem in the center of POKENAME's face perpetually reflects the night sky, even in the harshest of weather. In areas where wet seasons dominate much of the year, astronomers will often use this Pokémon to study and map the stars.

entry: POKENAME遇险时，会向敌人投掷接触就爆炸的炸弹。它深受星星吸引，一旦发现，就会到处扔炸弹，直到精疲力竭。
author: agostostino
source: When in danger, POKENAME throws bombs at its enemy that explode on contact. POKENAME is attracted to stars; when it finds one, it will start to throw bombs everywhere until exhaustion.

entry: 它用双手梳过头发并唱歌时，附近的生灵就会忍不住当场入睡。歌唱的语言，似乎连其他宝可梦也听不懂。
author: bobosmith01
source: If it runs its hands through its hair and sings, others nearby can't help but fall asleep on the spot. It sings in a language that even other Pokémon can't seem to understand.

entry: POKENAME白天藏在深水中，晴朗、看得见月亮的夜晚，才会跃出水面，奋力跳向天空。常见传闻说，它想回家。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME hide deep underwater during the day but will perform great leaps out of it toward the sky on clear nights when the moon is visible. A common rumour is that they are trying to return to their home.

entry: 不难看出POKENAME是否趁人不注意拜访过电脑，因为用户的绘图软件里，会多出许多满月图画。
author: sk372
source: It's rather easy to tell if one had a POKENAME visit their computer while they weren't looking. The user's art programs will be filled with many new drawings of the full moon.

entry: POKENAME将身体藏进石壳，免受伤害。它会用触手把月之石碎块接在自己身上，融进外壳。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME shelter their bodies inside stone shells, protecting themselves from harm. They incorporate parts of Moon Stones into their shell, using their tentacles to attach them to themselves.

entry: POKENAME将身体藏进石壳，免受伤害。它会用触手把月之石碎块接在自己身上，融进外壳。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME shelter their bodies inside stone shells, protecting themselves from harm. They incorporate parts of Moon Stones into their shell, using their tentacles to attach them to themselves.

entry: POKENAME在城市假扮成眼熟的粉色妖精造型帽，隐藏自己。有人戴到头上，就会顽皮地弄乱头发，再逃走。
author: h0bojoe
source: POKENAME hides in urban environments by pretending to be a familiar pink fairy-like hat. Should someone put it on their head, it will mischievously ruin their hair before fleeing.

entry: 传说，古代制图者研究POKENAME翅膀上的发光图案，学会了绘制星图。它常在入夜后起飞，用铺满双翼的星座引导迷路旅人。
author: fiordaliso
source: Legend says that ancient cartographers learned to transcribe star charts by studying the luminous patterns upon POKENAME's wings. It tends to take flight after nightfall, guiding lost travelers with the constellations draped across its wingspan.

entry: POKENAME只曾在满月照耀的高山被看见，阴历月的其余时间都藏着。野外遇到它，被视为好运的征兆。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are only ever seen in the high mountains under the light of a full moon. They hide themselves away for the rest of the lunar month, and seeing one in the wild is considered a sign of good fortune.

entry: 月光下，构成POKENAME尾巴的精神能量如百万繁星般闪烁。尾端石头的化学成分与月球相同，但它如何取得，仍不清楚。
author: imaginita
source: Under the moonlight, the psychic energy that makes up its tail twinkles like a million stars. The rock at the end of its tail has the same chemical composition as the moon, but it is unclear how POKENAME obtained it.

entry: POKENAME走到哪里都带着月之石，因为需要靠它磨牙。满月升空时，就把石头滚到外面，吸收月光。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME carry a Moon Stone wherever they go, as they rely on the stone to sharpen their teeth. Whenever the full moon is in the sky, POKENAME roll their Moon Stone outside to absorb moonlight.

entry: 除了听觉敏锐，POKENAME的视力也极其出色，夜里也不例外。野生个体不喜争斗，一有麻烦的迹象就往往逃走。
author: bobosmith01
source: In addition to a powerful sense of hearing, POKENAME possesses incredible vision, even during the night. In the wild, it dislikes fighting, so it tends to flee at the first sign of trouble.

entry: POKENAME有规律地前后摇晃，再配合羽毛拍动，使出挥指，唤来奇异、无形的力量。每次使用，结果都不同。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME rocks back and forth in a consistent rhythm. When this is combined with the flapping of its feathers, it harnesses the move Metronome to call upon strange, unseen powers that yield different results each time it is used.

entry: 夜里，POKENAME一起飞过天空，沐浴月光。触角亮度随月相变化，满月时最亮。
author: santon5512
source: At night, POKENAME fly through the sky together, soaking up moonlight. Their antennae glow brighter depending on the phase of the moon, glowing brightest during a full moon.

entry: POKENAME的羽毛在月光下泛着微光。据说，只要头饰上装饰一根它的羽毛，就能在爱情方面带来好运。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's feathers shimmer faintly under moonlight. Headdresses adorned with a single feather from it are said to make the wearer lucky in matters of love.

entry: POKENAME的触角散出柔光，末端的光球酷似月之石，让其他宝可梦开始做出通常只在满月时出现的仪式性行为。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME produce a soft glow from their antennae. The bulbs at the tip of their antennae resemble Moon Stones, so much so that other Pokémon begin ritualistic behavior typically only seen during the full moon.

entry: POKENAME弹跳得极高，试着伸手够到星星。仔细听，还能听见它努力向月亮歌唱。
author: captainjefejefe
source: POKENAME bounces so high that it tries to reach for the stars. If you listen closely, you can hear it trying to sing to the Moon.

entry: 分析发现，POKENAME蛋壳的成分与来自月球的岩石相似。但它对其他生灵触碰蛋壳很不安，因此进一步研究十分困难。
author: sk372
source: Analysis of POKENAME's eggshell reveals it has similar makeup to rocks that have come from the moon. POKENAME gets very antsy when others touch the shell, so further research has proven difficult.

entry: POKENAME性情温柔，只出现在纯洁、善良的生灵面前。据说，会在满月之夜赐福这些纯善的人。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's gentle nature compels it to only appear before those with pure and kindhearted natures. It is said it gives out blessings to those purehearted people on the night of the full moon.

entry: POKENAME的羽毛在月光下闪亮，移动时光芒点点。成群飞过夜空，很容易被误认为流星雨。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have feathers that sparkle under moonlight, creating a glittering effect as they move. Flights of them in the night sky are easily mistaken for meteor showers.

entry: 满月时，POKENAME轻盈地跃过草甸，紫色绒毛噼啪闪着静电。积蓄的能量化作微小火花，沿草叶舞动。
author: .izik
source: During a full moon, POKENAME leaps delicately through meadows, its purple fluff crackling with static. The energy it builds up is released in tiny sparks that dance along the grass.

entry: 休息时，POKENAME叶上的图案模糊、不起眼。跳起舞来，纹样逐渐清晰，宛如遥远的星系。
author: dodoowner_
source: When at rest, POKENAME's leaves appear obscure and unremarkable. As it dances, the designs on its leaves become clearer, resembling a faraway galaxy.

entry: 日落时，POKENAME从藏身处出来，在夜空翱翔，吸收月光。满月之夜，它们同步起舞，背上的花明亮发光。
author: quackquackattack
source: At sunset, POKENAME emerge out of hiding to soar through the night sky and absorb moonlight. On nights of the full moon, the flower on their back glows brightly as they dance in synchronized patterns.

entry: POKENAME快速穿梭山坡，寻找陨石碎片加入巢穴。它偏爱含月之石碎块的碎片，闪光会让它兴奋不已。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME flit rapidly around mountain slopes in search of meteor fragments to add to their nests. They have a preference for fragments that include shards of Moon Stones, their glint sending them into an excited frenzy.

entry: 月光强烈的夜里，POKENAME腹部会传出微弱嗡鸣。月光为特殊器官供能，产生保护性的黏膜，数量超过所需，常分给同类，帮助保护皮肤。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: On strong moonlit nights, a faint hum can be heard from POKENAME's stomach. Moonlight powers a special organ that produces a protective sticky film. It creates more than it needs and often shares it with other POKENAME to help shield their skin.

entry: 月光强烈的夜里，POKENAME腹部会传出微弱嗡鸣。月光为特殊器官供能，产生保护性的黏膜，数量超过所需，常分给同类，帮助保护皮肤。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: On strong moonlit nights, a faint hum can be heard from POKENAME's stomach. Moonlight powers a special organ that produces a protective sticky film. It creates more than it needs and often shares it with other POKENAME to help shield their skin.

entry: POKENAME夜间最活跃，一直待在水下，直到感觉月光触到皮肤。满月当空时，就摇摇摆摆地走出水面，在泥泞河岸开心扑腾。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are most active at night, remaining underwater until they can feel the touch of moonlight on their skin. They waddle out of the water and splash about happily in the muddy banks when a full moon is overhead.

entry: 野外的POKENAME只曾在满月时被看见，静静仰望星空。若允许你坐在身边一起观星，就表示给予了最大的信任与忠诚。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has only been seen in the wild during the full moon, gazing quietly at the stars. Being allowed to sit next to it and stargaze with it means it has given you its utmost trust and loyalty.

entry: POKENAME的花在夜里绽放，叶片在月光下展开。花香柔和，据说能帮助人睡个好觉。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME flowers bloom at night, their leaves unfurling under the moonlight. Their flowers give a mellow fragrance that is said to help people get a good night's sleep.

entry: POKENAME颈间的项链似乎由月之石组成。它用幻术，对人施些孩子气的恶作剧。
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher
source: The necklace around POKENAME's neck seems to be made of Moon Stones. It uses its illusory powers to play childish pranks on people.

entry: 每逢满月之夜，POKENAME便成群聚集，彻夜起舞。动作引导天体能量，让附近的植物和宝可梦恢复活力。
author: corra_universe
source: On every night with a full moon, groups of POKENAME gather and dance through the night. Their movements channel celestial energy which has a rejuvenating effect on any nearby plants and Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME在体内发酵树果，等到满月才取出树果汁。满月夜制成的树果汁甜得如糖浆，许多厨师都想重现这种滋味。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME ferment berries within their bodies and wait until the full moon to extract Berry Juice. The Berry Juice that is created on nights of the full moon has a syrupy sweet taste that many culinary chefs wish to replicate.

entry: 虽然POKENAME温柔、爱玩，名声却被一本畅销恐怖小说败坏。故事里，它爬上树，满月之夜就从树上落下，狰狞地笑着吞食受害者。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Although POKENAME are gentle and playful, their reputation has been tarnished by a popular horror novel. It tells of a POKENAME that climbs trees, and on nights with a full moon, drops from the tree to devour their victim, frightfully grinning.

entry: POKENAME温柔、善良，带着好闻的甜香。虽然少见，但在山顶高处的林区可能找到。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME are gentle, kind, and have a pleasant sweet smell. Although rare, they may be found in elevated wooded areas atop mountains.

entry: POKENAME常在半夜爬树找水果。若感到威胁，就会向靠近者使出投掷，扔出水果。
author: cobalt0135
source: POKENAME often climb trees looking for fruit in the middle of the night. They will use Fling to hurl fruits at anyone approaching if they feel threatened.

entry: 满月之夜，POKENAME大量聚集海面。共同闪耀的光芒，让整片海洋仿佛外太空。
author: ambrosia04
source: On nights with a full moon, POKENAME gather in massive numbers on the sea's surface. Together, their collective shimmer makes the ocean look like outer space.

entry: POKENAME在热闹城镇上空振翅飞行，撒下数百封闪亮邮件。人们相信，闪光的信封能给捡到的人带来好运。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME flutters above populated towns, dropping hundreds of Glitter Mail. The sparkling envelopes are believed to bring good luck to those who find them.

entry: POKENAME能化为无线电波，穿行太空。可惜数据保护得过于严密，无法带回任何关于所经之处的信息。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME can transform itself into radio emissions to travel through space. Unfortunately, its data is so protected that it is unable to bring back any information about the places it has been.

entry: 月亮渐盈的夜里，POKENAME开心地轻跳，在雪地旋转。它住在冰山上，月光映在覆霜的地面，美丽闪耀。
author: .izik
source: During nights with a waxing moon, POKENAME performs joyful little hops, twirling in the snowy landscape. It makes its home on icy mountains, where the moonlight glistens beautifully on the frost-covered ground.

entry: POKENAME亲人又好奇，感知到什么就可能独自跑远。深受年轻女性喜爱，仿照它制作的毛绒玩具目前非常畅销。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME are affectionate but also curious, and may wander off if they sense something. They are extremely popular among young women and plushes of them currently sell very well.

entry: POKENAME朝夜空大展双翼，吸收月光，让暗淡的棕羽逐渐变得虹彩绚丽。远看时，双翼的光芒可能被误认为彩虹。
author: milchik
source: POKENAME absorbs moonlight with its wings by spreading them wide open towards the night sky, gradually turning its dull brown feathers a beautiful iridescent color. From afar, the shine of this Pokémon's wings can be mistaken for a rainbow.

entry: POKENAME的魔力随月相盈亏变化。新月时几乎浮不起来，满月时却能施展盛大幻象，让周围几码范围内的生灵困惑、迷乱。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's magical powers wax and wane with the phases of the moon. It can barely float during the new moon, but when the moon is full, it can cast grand illusions to perplex and disorient all those around it for several yards.

entry: POKENAME亲人又好奇，感知到什么就可能独自跑远。深受年轻女性喜爱，仿照它制作的毛绒玩具目前非常畅销。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME are affectionate but also curious, and may wander off if they sense something. They are extremely popular among young women and plushes of them currently sell very well.

entry: POKENAME亲人又好奇，感知到什么就可能独自跑远。深受年轻女性喜爱，仿照它制作的毛绒玩具目前非常畅销。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME are affectionate but also curious, and may wander off if they sense something. They are extremely popular among young women and plushes of them currently sell very well.

entry: POKENAME亲人又好奇，感知到什么就可能独自跑远。深受年轻女性喜爱，仿照它制作的毛绒玩具目前非常畅销。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME are affectionate but also curious, and may wander off if they sense something. They are extremely popular among young women and plushes of them currently sell very well.

entry: POKENAME的食欲随月相变化。满月时最容易吃饱，新月时却会狼吞虎咽，找到什么吃什么。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME's appetites wax and wane with the phases of the moon. Their appetite is most easily satiated during a full moon, but they find themselves ravenously consuming anything they can find during a new moon.

entry: POKENAME在猎物身边假装嬉戏，让其放松警惕，再由同伴赶来攻击。它们用爪子在岩石、树木刻下月形图案，标记领地。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME pretends to be playful around prey to drop their guard before others of its pack come in and attack. They create moon-shaped patterns on rocks and trees with their claws to mark their territory.

entry: 它在满月之夜，用天线吸收月之能量，驱动飞碟。天线也能释放磁波。
author: chorb33
source: It powers its flying disc with lunar energy, which it absorbs via its antenna on full-moon nights. It also uses the antenna to emit magnetic waves.

entry: POKENAME大群行动，轮流担任诱饵。每次只有一只现身，其余全藏着，制造出同一只不断快速瞬移的假象。
author: mogor0771
source: POKENAME travels in large packs, each individual taking a turn as a decoy. Only one reveals itself at a time, while the others hide. This creates the illusion of a single POKENAME, teleporting rapidly.

entry: POKENAME夜间通过光合作用获取养分时，叶片如漫天星星般闪亮。最喜欢与训练家一同欣赏明亮的满月。
author: fiordaliso
source: When POKENAME feeds through photosynthesis at night, its leaves glimmer like stars across the sky. Its favorite pastime is watching the full moon shine alongside its Trainer.

entry: POKENAME聚在满月下，冻结周围大气，造出纷飞的细碎冰晶。据说，月光下闪烁的冰晶美得让任何见到的人都能永远幸福。
author: darkweavile428
source: POKENAME gather under a full moon and freeze the atmosphere around them to create a diamond-dust flurry. The sight of diamond-dust glittering in the moonlight is said to be so beautiful that anyone who sees it will be eternally happy.

entry: 满月时，POKENAME经常飘上天空吸收月光。附近的卫星天线会收到失真信号，直到夜晚结束。
author: .izik
source: During a full moon, POKENAME will frequently float into the sky to absorb the moonlight. Satellite dishes in the immediate area receive distorted signals until the night is over.

entry: POKENAME在森林四处搜寻陨石碎块，滚回筑巢处。它站在碎块组成的舞台上欢快鸣叫，试图吸引同类。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME root around forests in search of broken pieces of meteorite, rolling them back to their nesting sites. They will perform happy chirps whilst using the pieces as a stage, trying to draw fellow POKENAME to themselves.

entry: POKENAME喜爱闪亮的东西，父母一带回巢就急着占有。想要的物品，会坐在上面或衔在嘴里；越闪亮，越觉得珍贵。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME love shiny things and are quick to claim objects brought to the nest by their parents. POKENAME will sit upon or hold in their beaks the object they wish to possess. The shinier the object, the greater value it has to them.

entry: POKENAME原生于平柑岛，在岛上的洞窟安家。它在洞里四处觅食，偏爱昏暗，只有月亮出来才到外面。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are native to Pinkan Island, making their homes in the caves of the island. They roam around in the caves for food, only emerging outside when the moon emerges, as they prefer the dim light.

entry: POKENAME参加对战时容易兴奋过头，急着出手，乱抓、乱踢，速度却很快。打完立刻寻求训练家的肯定，表现好就开心地转圈跳舞。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are prone to growing excitable and overeager when getting into Pokémon battles, swinging with unfocused but rapid scratches and kicks. They seek their Trainer's approval straight after a fight, dancing happily in a circle if they do well.

entry: POKENAME爱跳舞，却太害怕面对观众表演。因此，满月之夜会找到安全地点聚集，在月光下跳舞，慢慢互相建立信心。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME love to dance, but they are too afraid to perform in front of an audience. Instead, during nights of the full moon, POKENAME find a safe place to gather and dance under the moonlight, slowly building each other's confidence.

entry: POKENAME爱玩的性格，让它成为想参加华丽大赛的训练家喜爱的搭档。它在台上高踢腿，配合快速、花巧的动作，更喜欢晚间演出。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The playful nature of POKENAME make them popular companions for Trainers seeking to compete in Pokémon contests. They dance on stage with a mix of high kicks and rapid flourishes, preferring to put on evening performances.

entry: 芭蕾对POKENAME既是锻炼，也是娱乐。优雅、精准的动作让它成为职业舞者喜爱的搭档，舞者会训练自己，与它完美配合。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: Ballet serves as both exercise and entertainment for POKENAME. Their grace and precision make them popular partners for professional dancers, who train to move in perfect harmony with them.

entry: POKENAME常参演为正义与希望对抗强敌的电视节目。精神力量能变出闪亮星空，为节目创造耀眼画面。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are commonly used in productions of TV shows centred around battles for justice and hope against overwhelming odds. Their ability to conjure glittering starscapes with their psychic powers creates dazzling visuals for the shows.

entry: 满月下，POKENAME吸收宇宙能量，经历耀眼的变化。双尾状触角泛起柔和金光，引导月之力量，保护同伴免受伤害。
author: ambrosia04
source: Under the light of a full moon, POKENAME undergoes a dazzling transformation as it absorbs cosmic energy. Its twin-tailed antennae glow with a soft golden light, which it uses to channel lunar power and shield its allies from harm.

entry: POKENAME原生于平柑岛，在岛上的洞窟安家。它在洞里四处觅食，偏爱昏暗，只有月亮出来才到外面。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are native to Pinkan Island, making their homes in the caves of the island. They roam around in the caves for food, only emerging outside when the moon emerges, as they prefer the dim light.

entry: 每逢满月之夜，POKENAME便带着树果聚集，堆在一起。月亮升至中天时，围着果堆开心跳跃、起舞，之后一同享用。
author: lukanbeetle
source: On every night of a full moon, POKENAME gather, bringing berries and piling them up. When the moon reaches its peak, they jump and dance around the pile happily before eating together.

entry: POKENAME白天休息，靠出色的伪装躲避捕食者。研究者认为，身上的图案会随月相变化。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME rest throughout the day, using their impressive camouflage skills to avoid predators. Researchers believe the designs on their bodies shift based on the moon's phase.

entry: POKENAME靠两颗大脑绘制训练家活动的热力图，寻找能避开人类接触的地方。每逢满月，才会离开藏身处，沐浴月光，恢复精神能量。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME relies on its twin brains to create a heat map of Trainer activity and locates places where it can avoid human contact. Once every full moon, it emerges from its hiding place to soak in the moonlight and restore its mental energy.

entry: POKENAME藏在自己的楔石里，石头外观像毛绒皮皮玩偶。被带进人类家中后，只有无人观察时才会出来，挪动自己和其他物品，吓主人一跳。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME conceals itself inside its keystone, which resembles a plush Poké Doll. If brought inside a human home, POKENAME will only emerge when unobserved, moving itself and other objects around to surprise its human hosts.

entry: POKENAME操纵名为“星元”的自身星辰能量，察觉天体自转的异常。这种能量也能感知人类情绪，听懂他们的话。
author: beatdoof
source: By manipulating its own starry energy called starian, POKENAME is able to detect irregularities in celestial bodies' rotations. Using starian, it is also able to detect human emotions and understand their speech.

entry: POKENAME看见闪亮物品就咬碎，化为星星沙子，在跳舞时撒开。若咬到月之石，就会把剩余部分藏好，留到准备进化时使用。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME bite down into anything shiny they see to break down into Stardust that they scatter while they dance. If they bite onto a Moon Stone, they will stock what's left of it away until they're ready to evolve.

entry: POKENAME背着形似月亮的大种子。月相改变，种子的外观也随之变化，表面在一月之中明暗交替。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME carry a large seed on their back that mimics the appearance of the moon. The seed changes phase and appearance as the moon does, its surface growing lighter and darker throughout the month.

entry: POKENAME的花瓣吸收月光，在体内转化为能量。满月时，背上的花格外鲜艳，香气也十分浓郁。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its petals absorb moonlight and convert it into energy within POKENAME's body. When the moon is full, the flower on its back becomes extraordinarily vivid and intensely fragrant.

entry: POKENAME尖刺产生的毒素，会随月相呈现不同性质。这让野外中毒难以治疗，但制药公司正在研究。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME spines produce a toxin that has different properties depending on the phase of the moon. This shifting property of their poison makes it difficult to treat POKENAME poisoning in the wild, but it is being studied by pharmaceutical companies.

entry: POKENAME午夜最活跃，在星光下漫游广阔的领地。满月时会互相表演复杂舞蹈，宝可梦研究者认为，这是在重申领地边界。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are most active at midnight, roaming their large territories under the light of the stars. When the moon is full they perform elaborate dances for one another that Pokémon Researchers believe reinforces where their territory boundaries lie.

entry: POKENAME躯干环中的那片星空，被认为准确映出了我们所在的星系。凝望旋转的浩瀚群星，会涌起奇怪的思乡之情。
author: sk372
source: The starry void present in POKENAME's torso-ring is believed to be an accurate image of our own galaxy. Staring into the swirling expanse of stars fills a person with a strange sense of longing for home..

entry: POKENAME在山脚附近挖出相通的洞穴。感知月光后，便离穴，以家庭为单位一起嬉戏；但有外来者想加入，玩耍就会转为暴力。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME build warrens near the base of mountains. When they sense moonlight, they will emerge from their homes and frolic together in family groups, though their play turns violent if outsiders attempt to join them.

entry: 野外只在满月时能见到POKENAME。它凝望月亮，挥动缎带，跳着孤独的舞。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: Spotted in the wild only during a full moon, POKENAME stares at the moon and swings its ribbon in a lonely dance.

entry: POKENAME跋涉数英里，赶到特定林间空地，共赏满月。月光下会嬉闹打斗，胜者从败者手中夺取土地，扩大领地。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME journey from across several miles to gather in specific glades in time to watch the full moon together. Under the moon's light, they playfully scrap with one another, the winning POKENAME expanding their territory by taking from the loser.

entry: 可爱的模样与爱玩的性情，让这只宝可梦拥趸无数。它是出色的宠物，可惜实在罕见。
author: melodydelune
source: This Pokémon has an immense amount of admirers due to its cute looks and playful spirit. It makes an excellent pet, though it is extremely rare.

entry: POKENAME为争夺月之石产地而互相战斗，想控制尽可能多的珍贵石头。训练家寻找月之石时要提防它们，可能突然受到攻击。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME battle with one another over sites where Moon Stones can be found, seeking to control the largest number of the precious stones. Trainers are advised to be wary of them when searching for Moon Stones, as they may be unexpectedly attacked.

entry: POKENAME喜欢沐浴月光，也喜欢用尾巴在地面塑出新月形的痕迹。科学家认为，这纯粹是它开心时的举动。
author: over9001
source: POKENAME likes to bask in the moonlight and create crescent moons in the ground by shaping them with its tail. Scientists believe it does this out of pure joy.

entry: 满月下飞行时，POKENAME能释放足以夷平整座山的电力。尽管如此，它极其和平，只有真正受到威胁才会释放这份力量。
author: .izik
source: While flying during a full moon, POKENAME can discharge electricity with enough force to level entire mountains. Despite this, it is incredibly peaceful, releasing such power only when truly threatened.

entry: 这种皮皮自融合体，似乎会引导储存在翅膀中的月光，召出月亮的形象与力量。没人知道，它从哪里、如何得到那根用来传导力量、颜色奇特的棒子。
author: infranscia
source: This self fusion of Clefairy appears to channel the moonlight stored in its wings to summon the image and power of the moon.  No one is sure where or how it got the strangely-colored stick it channels its power through.

entry: 野生POKENAME的花只在满月夜绽放。它会彻夜跳舞，吸引夜行授粉者；若对方攻击，就用头上的毒刺自卫。
author: .jerden
source: Wild POKENAME flowers only bloom on nights when the moon is full. They will dance around all night to attract nocturnal pollinators, but if any attack, POKENAME will defend themselves using the poisonous thorns on their heads.

entry: POKENAME夜间被受惊宝可梦的哭叫吸引。它轻轻摆动长耳，缓解恐惧，引导对方重回美梦。
author: ilija09
source: POKENAME is drawn to the cries of frightened Pokémon during the night. It gently waves its long ears, easing their fears and guiding them back to pleasant dreams.

entry: POKENAME被遗弃后，沐浴月光便会动起来。它与同类一起跳舞，引导月之能量。
author: quackquackattack
source: After being abandoned and exposed to moonlight, POKENAME springs into action. It dances with other POKENAME to channel lunar energy.

entry: POKENAME喜欢在夏日庆典上，伴着小吃摊和烟花，与人类、宝可梦一起玩。传言只要被它看中，就可能获得难以想象的财富。
author: opossiblymage
source: POKENAME loves to play with people and Pokémon alike at festive summer events, surrounded by food stalls and fireworks. It is rumored that if this Pokémon takes a shine to you, untold riches could be yours.

entry: POKENAME能操纵物理法则，制造远强于星球自然引力的重力场。环绕身体、闪着星光的黑色液体，据说来自外太空。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are capable of manipulating the laws of physics, creating gravitational fields much stronger than the natural force that the planet exhibits. The starry black liquid that surrounds their bodies is said to come from outer space.

entry: POKENAME亲近陨石与月之石，让一些宝可梦研究者认为，它很适合太空探索。神奥已开始试行计划，为它制作太空服。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The affinity that POKENAME have for fallen meteors and Moon Stones have led to some Pokémon Researchers to theorise that they would be a Pokémon well suited to space exploration. Trial programmes have begun in Sinnoh to make them space suits.

entry: 新月之夜，一大群POKENAME聚在华蓝市西边的池塘旁，跳完复杂的舞，将白石投入水里。仪式的目的至今不明。
author: .izik
source: A large group of POKENAME gathers near ponds west of Cerulean City on new moon nights, tossing white stones into the water after performing intricate dances. The purpose of this ritual remains a mystery.

entry: POKENAME爱与其他发光宝可梦相伴。有人见过它们成群在黑暗中起舞。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME enjoys the company of other glowing Pokémon. Groups of them have been seen dancing in the dark.

entry: POKENAME脱落的星尘，一碰到活物似乎就会消失。好在并无害处。
author: ohok3441
source: The stardust that flakes off of POKENAME seems to disappear when touching living material. Luckily, it's harmless.

entry: POKENAME火焰里的星星缓慢旋转。兴奋或战斗时，转速便会加快。
author: ohok3441
source: The stars within POKENAME's fires spin slowly. When excited or in battle, their speed increases.

entry: POKENAME摆出超级英雄的姿势逗孩子开心，还常制作玩具火箭，送给需要鼓励的人。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME poses like a superhero to entertain children. It often builds toy rockets and gives them to anyone who needs cheering up.

entry: POKENAME飞到星球大气层之外的高处，抵御宇宙威胁。英勇事迹启发了许多热门超级英雄电影的导演。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME flies high above the planet's atmosphere to defend it against cosmic threats. Its heroic exploits have inspired many directors of popular superhero movies.

entry: POKENAME充满月之能量，晴夜会飘在空中观星。训练家与宝可梦都已入睡的宁静夜里，它会创造极光，极少有人亲眼见过。
author: quackquackattack
source: Infused with lunar energy, POKENAME float through the sky on clear nights to gaze upon the stars. On quiet nights when Trainers and Pokémon are asleep, POKENAME create auroras in the night sky that few ever get to witness.

entry: POKENAME释放大小不一、名为“星元”的星形脉冲波，无需开口就能与同群交流。如果交流时放出巨大的星元，就表示说得非常大声。
author: beatdoof
source: POKENAME communicates with others of its flock without speaking through waves of star-shaped pulses it throws out in various sizes called starian. If POKENAME threw out a huge starian when communicating, that means it's talking very loudly.

entry: POKENAME一睡就是好几天，醒着却亲人、爱玩，是很好照料的宠物。但因为稀少，难找又十分昂贵。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME make great low maintenance pets, as they sleep for days at a time, but are affectionate and playful when awake. However, they are rare, and this makes them hard to find and very expensive.

entry: 新月之夜，POKENAME成群聚集，比谁唱得最响。互相争胜的歌声吵得惊人，连隔音房也挡不住。
author: .izik
source: On nights of a new moon, groups of POKENAME gather and compete to sing the loudest. Their attempts to outdo one another can be so obnoxious that even soundproof rooms fail to block them out.

entry: POKENAME满月时聚集，用头互撞打招呼，发出金属鸣响。声音会让最远7千米外的磁铁暂时旋转，甚至扰乱附近的大岩蛇，让它们绕圈挖掘。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME gather during full moons. They greet by ramming headfirst into each other, which unleashes a metallic ringing sound. This sound causes magnets up to 7 km away to temporarily spin and even disrupts nearby Onix, causing them to dig in circles.

entry: POKENAME外壳的材料成分仍在研究中。初步分析认为来自太空，却不属于目前任何可观测的行星。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's shell is comprised of a material composition still being researched. Preliminary analysis suggests it is spaceborne in origin, but not from any currently-observable planet.

entry: POKENAME在明亮的月夜优雅旋转。太久照不到月光，动作就会变得迟缓。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME spins gracefully in the moonlight on bright nights. If it is kept from moonlight for too long, its movements become sluggish.

entry: POKENAME尾巴的火焰平时很暗，满月之夜却亮得数英里外都看得见。这时直视火焰，会对视网膜造成永久损伤。
author: wiz0z
source: The flame on POKENAME's tail is often quite dim. On the night of a full moon, the flames become bright enough to be seen from miles away. Looking directly at the flames during this time can cause permanent retinal damage.

entry: 虽然POKENAME听觉、视力都很出色，却有个致命弱点：身体密度低，很容易被一阵强风吹走。
author: bobosmith01
source: Although it possesses a powerful sense of hearing and vision, POKENAME has a critical flaw: its low body density means it can easily be carried away by a strong gust of wind.

entry: POKENAME的花粉接触空气几秒后就会爆响，让许多个体不断分心。满月时，花粉的产生会暂停。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME produce pollen that pops when exposed to air for more than a few seconds, leaving many POKENAME constantly distracted. The production of this pollen pauses during the full moon.

entry: POKENAME如星光般闪亮，满月之夜最耀眼。它喜欢别人远远欣赏花朵，但谁想触碰，就会遭到头上毒刺攻击。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME sparkles like starlight, shining most brightly on nights when the moon is full. While it appreciates it when others admire its flowers from a distance, it will attack anyone who tries to touch it using the poisonous spikes on its head.

entry: POKENAME的绒毛闪着夜空般的色彩，随月份变化而流转。它兴奋地带训练家夜间散步，开心地指向头顶星星，欢快絮语。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME fluff sparkles with the colours of the night sky, glittering and shifting as the months change. They are excited to take their Trainers on walks at night, gesturing to the stars above with joy and chattering happily.

entry: POKENAME吃下的腐烂植物越多，性情越善良。如果与破破袋在同一个垃圾箱进食，就会并肩站着，互相支持。
author: teatedtiten
source: The more rotten vegetation POKENAME eats, the kinder they are. If Trubbish and POKENAME eat from the same trash bin, they will stand side by side in solidarity.
