entry: 科学家将POKENAME的胶状身体放到显微镜下，发现了新的行星与恒星。虽然未经证实，许多天文学家声称，它体内复制着宇宙中的每颗恒星和行星。
author: quackquackattack
source: Scientists have found new planets and stars by putting the gelatinous bodies of POKENAME under a microscope. While unproven, many astronomers claim that POKENAME have a copy of every star and planet in the universe inside their bodies.

entry: POKENAME定期脱落尖刺。古代人曾收集这些尖刺，制成箭头。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME periodically sheds sharp spines. These were once collected in ancient times and used as arrowheads.

entry: 神婆声称，新月时POKENAME在头顶盘旋，就能获得与祖先联系的能力。这种信念已延续数百年。
author: .izik
source: Mediums claim that when POKENAME flies in circles above them during a new moon, they gain the ability to contact their ancestors. This belief has persisted for centuries.

entry: POKENAME腹部的华美图案与亲人性格，让家养个体很受欢迎。但野生个体领地意识强，会突然扑出，用爪子抓住猎物，拖往不知何处。
author: bobosmith01
source: The gorgeous patterns on POKENAME's stomach as well as their affectionate nature make domesticated POKENAME well-liked. However, wild POKENAME are territorial: they will lunge out and snap up prey in their claws and drag them away to parts unknown.

entry: POKENAME头顶的叶片散着白色花粉，仿佛夜空星星。一个月的大多数时间都将部分身体埋在土里，只有满月才出来。
author: quackquackattack
source: The leaves atop the head of POKENAME are speckled with white pollen that make them look like stars in the night sky. They stay partially embedded in the ground for most of the month, only coming out during the full moon.

entry: POKENAME住在深海，高速游过漆黑水域。任何在深处闪光的东西都会吸引它，尤其喜欢陨石，深受其中月之能量吸引。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME live in the deep ocean, swimming at high speed through the inky depths. They are drawn to anything that glitters in the deep and have a special affinity for fallen meteors, finding themselves drawn to the lunar energies contained in them.

entry: POKENAME住在深海，高速游过漆黑水域。任何在深处闪光的东西都会吸引它，尤其喜欢陨石，深受其中月之能量吸引。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME live in the deep ocean, swimming at high speed through the inky depths. They are drawn to anything that glitters in the deep and have a special affinity for fallen meteors, finding themselves drawn to the lunar energies contained in them.

entry: POKENAME聚在空地，让初升阳光映上双翼。羽毛如星尘般闪耀，令观者目眩。人们认为，这种展示对维系群体关系十分重要。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME gather in clearings to let the sunrise reflect off their wings, dazzling onlookers as their feathers glimmer and shine like stardust. It's thought these displays serve an important role in bonding with their flock.

entry: 雨后的满月之夜，POKENAME会出来舔食草上残留的水分。它们成群绕圈行进，留下一圈闪亮黏液。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME emerge on full-moon nights after rainy days, lapping up the leftover moisture from the grass. They gather in groups and travel in a circle, leaving behind a ring of sparkling mucus.

entry: POKENAME头上的花有华美的午夜蓝花瓣，映照星光。它们寻找偏远的高山草甸，站在夜空下，沐浴月光。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The flower blooming on the heads of POKENAME has gorgeous midnight blue petals that reflect the light of the stars. They search for mountain meadows in remote areas, standing under the night sky and basking in the light of the moon.

entry: POKENAME夜里精力充沛，边唱欢快的歌，边蹦蹦跳跳。唯独满月之夜例外，会静静站着，默望天空。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is full of energy at night, hopping and skipping about with a joyous song on its lips. The only exception to this is any night with a full moon, where POKENAME will instead stand still and gaze at the sky silently.

entry: POKENAME背上的蘑菇对光极其敏感，只能承受昏暗光线。因此，它藏在地下直到夜晚，才在月光下出来觅食。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The mushrooms growing on the backs of POKENAME are extremely sensitive to light, only able to tolerate dim light levels. As a result, they shelter underground until night time, emerging under the light of the moon to forage.

entry: POKENAME在满月时相聚、共舞。但一定要远离这些聚会，因为任何被视作入侵者的对象，都会遭到凶狠攻击。
author: antler_zero_
source: POKENAME are known to fraternize and dance together during full moons. One should avoid these gatherings at all costs, as POKENAME will viciously attack any perceived intruders.

entry: 这些宝可梦日复一日，在夜空下练习音乐表演，追求绝对完美。两只POKENAME相遇就会比赛，胜者获得败者的星星。
author: epsilonity
source: These Pokémon practice their musical routine day by day underneath the nighttime sky, aiming for absolute perfection. When two POKENAME meet, they host a competition, with the winner gaining the other's stars.

entry: POKENAME主要在满月时被看见，据说飞过人们上方时，会带来描绘遥远星系的梦。观察发现，在它身边睡过一夜的宝可梦，心情会很好。
author: gileme__
source: Mostly seen during full moons, POKENAME is said to bring dreams that depict galaxies far beyond to the people it flies over. Pokémon are observed to have bright moods after a night sleeping in the presence of POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME背上的蘑菇劫持神经系统，迫使它前往昏暗之地释放孢子。人们大多在满月之夜看见它，蘑菇在夜色中发光。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The mushroom sprouting on the back of POKENAME hijacks their nervous system, compelling them to seek out dimly lit areas to release their spores. They are mostly seen by people on the night of the full moon, their mushroom glowing in the night.

entry: 满月时能与POKENAME共处，是莫大的荣幸。它在月光下起舞，时间仿佛慢下来；有人沉醉于美丽舞姿，觉得太阳再升起前，已经过了整整一天。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Spending time with a POKENAME during a full moon is a true honour. Time seems to pass slower as POKENAME dance in the moonlight, with some saying they feel an entire day has passed before the sun rises again, all while mesmerised by their beauty.

entry: 新月之夜，POKENAME身上的大块月之石会闪出明亮粉光。研究者仍未找出这种奇怪现象的原因。
author: .izik
source: The large moonstone on POKENAME's body shines a brilliant pink on nights of a new moon. Researchers have yet to uncover the reason for this strange phenomenon.

entry: POKENAME夜间跳过泥泞沼泽，避免被其他宝可梦发现。满月时，会把月光注入泡沫气泡，被发现就能制造耀眼干扰。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME hop through swampy marshes at night to avoid being detected by other Pokémon. During nights of the full moon, they infuse foamy bubbles with moonlight so that they can create dazzling distractions when they are caught.

entry: 秋季星光满天的夜里，POKENAME会从天而降。它亲近收获，专挑成熟待收的田地降落，让农民非常头疼。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME fall from the sky on starry nights in the Autumn. They have an affinity for the harvest and will aim to land in fields ripe for harvest, much to the annoyance of the farmers.

entry: 秋季星光满天的夜里，POKENAME会从天而降。它亲近收获，专挑成熟待收的田地降落，让农民非常头疼。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME fall from the sky on starry nights in the Autumn. They have an affinity for the harvest and will aim to land in fields ripe for harvest, much to the annoyance of the farmers.

entry: 满月之夜，POKENAME在偏远山顶上方绕圈漂浮。晨光触到身体，会短暂泛起柔和粉光，再降下休息。
author: .izik
source: On nights with a full moon, POKENAME floats in circular patterns atop remote mountain peaks. When the morning light touches its body, it briefly glows with a soft pink hue before descending to rest.

entry: 新月时，POKENAME的身体闪着柔和蓝光。晴夜无声掠过天空时，最容易看清这种闪烁。
author: .izik
source: During a new moon, POKENAME's body blinks with soft blue light. This flickering is best seen on clear nights as it darts silently through the sky.

entry: POKENAME吐出的火焰闪烁不定，光谱特征竟与星光相同。
author: robosoup
source: The flames breathed out by POKENAME have a twinkling quality to them. These have the same spectrographic signature as starlight.

entry: 满月之夜，POKENAME在地下挖出复杂图案。许多人说，在这些隧道附近休息，会感到安心。
author: .izik
source: On full-moon nights, POKENAME digs intricate patterns underground. Many claim resting near these tunnels brings a sense of comfort.

entry: 满月的午夜，POKENAME的三颗头会一起仰望天空，整整五分钟。研究者无法解释这个仪式。
author: .izik
source: At midnight during a full moon, all three of POKENAME's heads stare skyward for exactly five minutes. Researchers have no explanation for this ritual.

entry: POKENAME能感知天体的相对位置，在周身显现精神气场，让其他生灵也看见感知到的景象。但这种投影难以维持，持续太久会引发剧烈头痛。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME sense the relative position of astral bodies, a psychic aura manifesting around them while allowing others to see what they can sense. Their projected aura is difficult to maintain, causing severe headaches over long periods of projection.

entry: POKENAME在月光下互相嬉戏，行事隐秘，不喜欢被打扰。若舞蹈遭中断，就会充满敌意，合力围攻胆敢打扰的对象。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME cavort with one another under the light of the moon. They are secretive and don't like to be disturbed. Should their dance be interrupted, they grow hostile, working together to mob whoever dared to disturb them.

entry: POKENAME的午夜蓝毛发闪着星座般的光点。毛质粗糙，需花许多天才能织成可制衣的材料，因此衣物售价高昂。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME midnight-blue fur glitters with constellations of light. Their fur is coarse and takes many days to weave into a workable material for clothing, meaning garments woven from their fur command high prices.

entry: POKENAME是夜行宝可梦，白天大多时间都在休息，等待月亮升起。月光下十分爱玩，喜欢彼此赛跑，一跑就是好几英里。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are nocturnal Pokémon, spending the majority of the day resting and waiting for the moon to rise. They are playful under the light of the moon and enjoy racing one another across the landscape for many miles.

entry: POKENAME住在陨石撞出的湖泊，常在陨石残骸旁筑巢。它很护着湖水，谁想从家园采样，就会遭到水枪喷射。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME can be found in the lakes left from meteorite impacts, often nesting around the remnants of the meteorite. They are protective of their lakes, spraying Water Guns at people who try to collect samples from their home.

entry: 野生POKENAME通常从满月后的白天，一直睡到下个满月之夜。最偏远的地方，月光下会举行由它和近缘物种组成的盛大舞会。
author: bobosmith01
source: Wild POKENAME typically sleep from the day after a full moon to the next night of the full moon. Grand dances consisting of POKENAME and related species happen in the most remote locations under the light of the moon.

entry: POKENAME吸收月光获取能量，因此入夜后活跃得多。满月时会成群聚集，一边沐浴月光，一边开心跳跃。
author: sk372
source: Because POKENAME gains energy by absorbing moonlight, it is far more active in the evening. When the moon is full, groups of POKENAME gather together, bouncing happily as the soak in moonbeams.

entry: POKENAME吐出的泡泡含有独特的治愈因子，能让人恢复精神。但若使用过量，就可能产生依赖。
author: mistymagius
source: The bubbles that POKENAME produces have a unique healing factor that makes people feel rejuvenated.  However, the substance can be addictive if too much is applied.

entry: 满月之夜的午夜，POKENAME会让沉重的石头身体悬浮，整整12秒。效果一结束，就砰地坠回地面。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME levitates its heavy stone body for exactly 12 seconds at midnight on the night of a full moon. Once the effect wears off, it crashes back to the ground with a loud thud.

entry: POKENAME全身覆盖细密银粉，反光能力极强。夜里用光照射，就像满月般发亮。
author: .jerden
source: The fine silver dust that covers POKENAME's body is incredibly reflective. If a light is shone on it at night, it will seem to glow like the full moon.

entry: 古代领路人有时会向POKENAME求助，因为鬃毛让他们随时都能可靠地观星。越接近满月，鬃毛就越清晰、鲜艳。
author: pkbonusducks
source: Ancient wayfinders would sometimes seek the aid of POKENAME as their mane was a reliable way to view the stars at any time. The closer it is to a full moon, the more clear and vibrant POKENAME's mane becomes.

entry: 它们越开心，火焰就越像星星闪耀。一生中大多时候都很弱小，因此通常只在看得见月亮的夜里出来。
author: infinex21
source: Their flames shimmer like stars the happier they are. Because they are so weak for most of their lives, they typically only come out at night when the moon is visible.

entry: POKENAME释放的缕缕气流宛如夜空，点缀着星星般的白点。它彻夜不眠，守望族群的幼小成员，防止潜行的捕食者袭击。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME release wisps from their body that resemble the night sky; each speckled with white dots that resemble stars. By staying awake through the night, they watch to ensure the young members of their herd are protected from stealthy predators.

entry: POKENAME平时迷糊、爱玩，满月前夕却性情大变。它黏着其他生灵，不停哼哼，寻求安慰，缓解突然涌起的孤独。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is absentminded and playful normally, but goes through a shift in personality on the eve of full moons. It clings to others and whines, seeking comfort for a sudden surge of loneliness.

entry: POKENAME寻找夜间新生的嫩枝，骄傲地带着。月光下跳复杂舞蹈时，会与同类手中的嫩枝互相敲击。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME hunt for freshly grown sprigs of plants that sprout at night. They carry these sprigs proudly, tapping them against the sprigs of other POKENAME as they perform elaborate dances under the moonlight.

entry: POKENAME寻找夜间新生的嫩枝，骄傲地带着。月光下跳复杂舞蹈时，会与同类手中的嫩枝互相敲击。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME hunt for freshly grown sprigs of plants that sprout at night. They carry these sprigs proudly, tapping them against the sprigs of other POKENAME as they perform elaborate dances under the moonlight.

entry: POKENAME喜欢群居，却在其他物种面前害羞。移动时紧贴妈妈身边。
author: corra_universe
source: POKENAME are social Pokémon but are shy around other species. They stick close to their mother's side when traveling.

entry: POKENAME只有觉得完全安全才会打开壳，因此能看见它的脸，被视为莫大的荣幸。
author: bradlybro199
source: POKENAME only open their shells when they feel completely safe, so to see one's face is considered a great honor.

entry: 满月时，POKENAME潜伏在世上最黑暗的角落，将周围温度降得冰冷。等受害者冷到一定程度，就将其掳走。
author: actliux
source: POKENAME lurk in the darkest corners of the world during a full moon. They lower the temperature around them to a chill, and when its victims are cold enough, they spirit them away.

entry: POKENAME满月之夜出来成群跳舞。若有人观看，就会入睡，梦见月亮。
author: petratheangel
source: POKENAME come out on nights of the full moon to dance in groups. If someone watches the dance  they will fall asleep and dream of the moon.

entry: 它们的钳子由类似月岩的奇怪材料组成，极为耐用。夜间离开洞穴，以月光为食。
author: santon5512
source: Their claws are made of a strange material similar to moonrock, making them extremely durable. They will emerge from their burrows at night, feeding off the moonlight.

entry: POKENAME的钳子极坚固，但重量常拖慢行动。它用巨钳夹开陨石，分成小块吃下，强化钳子。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME claws are extremely durable, though their weight often slows them down. They will use their large claws to crack open fallen meteorites, consuming them in small chunks in order to strengthen their claws.

entry: POKENAME背上嵌着黑暗石。吸收周围电力后，石头会逐渐长大，强化身体。
author: thezekrom
source: POKENAME have a Dark Stone embedded in their back. By absorbing electricity from their surroundings, this stone will gradually grow and strengthen their bodies.

entry: POKENAME住在密林，遇上什么叶子都一路吃过去，直到准备好进化。夜间能让腹部与身体花纹有节奏地发光，彼此交流。
author: thezekrom
source: POKENAME can be found in thick forests, eating through any leaves they find until it is ready to evolve. They can make their belly and body patterns glow rhythmically in the night to communicate with each other.

entry: POKENAME常用于工厂，独自便能为整座设施供电。下半身吸收机器产生的热量，转成电力，再从上半身送入工厂供能系统。
author: thezekrom
source: POKENAME are often used in factories, powering an entire facility by themselves. They absorb the heat generated by the machines with their lower half and convert it into electricity, releasing it from their upper half into a factory's energy system.

entry: POKENAME由六个蛋形个体组成，合为一只宝可梦。共同从周围吸收足够电力后，身体会出现裂纹，表示已经准备好进化。
author: thezekrom
source: POKENAME consist of six egg-shaped individuals, forming one Pokémon. If they collectively absorb enough electricity from their surroundings, cracks will form on their bodies, indicating they're ready to evolve.

entry: 据说，POKENAME的骨面具储存着怒气产生的巨量电力。人们相信，若摘下面具，释放的能量便足以毁掉整座城市。
author: thezekrom
source: The bone mask of POKENAME is said to contain extreme amounts of electricity generated by its anger. It is believed that, would POKENAME ever remove its mask, the released energy could destroy an entire city.

entry: POKENAME的双腿如发电机般产生无穷电力，让它疾如闪电地驰骋大地。雷霆万钧的踢击足以摧毁一切，甚至启发了一部风靡全球的少年漫画！
author: leeto64
source: Able to generate endless electric energy on its legs, which function as generators, POKENAME races across the land at lighting speed. Its powerful, thunderous kicks obliterate anything, inspiring the creation of a global hit shonen manga!

entry: POKENAME的双腿如发电机般产生无穷电力，让它疾如闪电地驰骋大地。雷霆万钧的踢击足以摧毁一切，甚至启发了一部风靡全球的少年漫画！
author: leeto64
source: Able to generate endless electric energy on its legs, which function as generators, POKENAME races across the land at lighting speed. Its powerful, thunderous kicks obliterate anything, inspiring the creation of a global hit shonen manga!

entry: POKENAME的双腿如发电机般产生无穷电力，让它疾如闪电地驰骋大地。雷霆万钧的踢击足以摧毁一切，甚至启发了一部风靡全球的少年漫画！
author: leeto64
source: Able to generate endless electric energy on its legs, which function as generators, POKENAME races across the land at lighting speed. Its powerful, thunderous kicks obliterate anything, inspiring the creation of a global hit shonen manga!

entry: POKENAME体内充满会彼此产生强烈电反应的气体。它能排出这些气体，形成小而强劲的雷云，电击靠近的一切。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's body is filled to the brim with gases that create powerful electrical reactions with each other. It can expel these gases to create small but potent thunderclouds that zap anything near it.

entry: POKENAME演化出坚硬、充满电力的壳，能释放强烈电击，驱退一切靠得太近的威胁。
author: thezekrom
source: POKENAME have evolved a hard, electrically infused shell around them that is able to discharge strong electric shocks to fend off any threat that comes too close.

entry: POKENAME大多温顺，在空中盘旋，吸收雷云的电能。受到威胁就张大嘴，释放麻痹气体，使攻击者的神经系统停止运作。
author: thezekrom
source: POKENAME are mostly docile creatures, orbiting in the sky to absorb the electric energy of storm clouds. If threatened, POKENAME open their mouths wide, releasing a paralytic gas that shuts down the aggressor's nervous system.

entry: POKENAME用钻头般的尾巴将自己埋进地里，等待猎物。只要有什么靠得够近，就释放尾中电力，从藏身处冲出攻击。
author: thezekrom
source: POKENAME has a drill-like tail, which it uses to bury itself into the ground, waiting for prey. Once something comes close enough, it unleashes the electricity in its tail to shoot out of hiding and attack.

entry: POKENAME由带电的漆黑藤蔓组成，盘成结实的身体。它能瞬间解开任意藤蔓，像鞭子一样抽出，电击对手。
author: thezekrom
source: POKENAME consists of deep black vines infused with electricity, forming a strong knot as its body. It can untangle any of its vines instantly and use them as a whip to send shocking strikes towards its opponent.

entry: POKENAME大多温顺、体贴、友好，甚至允许其他生灵在腹袋中小睡。流过身体的电力，始终让袋中保持温暖。
author: thezekrom
source: POKENAME are mostly docile, caring, and friendly towards others. Their caring nature is reflected when they allow others to take naps in their belly pouches, which are constantly warmed by the electricity running through their body.

entry: POKENAME能极其精准地穿过密林。头部触角能探测周围最微小的电流，轻松避开任何树木或威胁。
author: thezekrom
source: POKENAME can fly through dense forests with extreme precision. The antennas on its head are able to detect the smallest electric current in the surrounding area, making it able to avoid any tree or threat with ease.

entry: POKENAME待在海底，借水流移动。越靠近可享用的富营养物质沉积处，珍珠般核心的蓝光就越明亮。
author: thezekrom
source: POKENAME sits on the ocean floor and uses water currents to move around. Its pearl-like core shines bright blue the closer its swept to a nutrient-rich material deposit that it can feast on.

entry: POKENAME镰刀般的前臂极为锋利，能轻易切开粗树。攀树等待下一餐时，必须格外小心，免得不慎将树切成两半。
author: thezekrom
source: The scythe-like forearms of POKENAME are extremely sharp and can slice through thick trees easily. While latching onto a tree to prey on its next meal, it needs to be especially careful not to accidentally cut that tree in half.

entry: POKENAME体内储存超过五十亿伏特的电力。脾气急躁，曾因与其他宝可梦的小争执，烧掉整片森林。
author: jangodiot
source: It stores over five billion volts in its body. POKENAME has a short temper and has been known to cause entire forests to burn down over simple disputes with other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME巡逻大片海洋领地，对任何入侵者都极具攻击性。传说中，甚至曾一击击碎船体，击沉大船。
author: thezekrom
source: POKENAME patrol a large territory in the ocean and are highly aggressive towards intruders of any kind. There are tales speaking of incidents where POKENAME even sank large ships with a single, hull-shattering blow.

entry: 据说，POKENAME只陪伴理想崇高、又有动力贯彻到底的人。战斗时，周身涌起喷发的水柱，缭绕着狂暴闪电。
author: sk372
source: It's said that POKENAME will only accompany those with lofty ideals and the drive to see them through. In battle, it surrounds itself with erupting geysers of water encircled by raging bolts of electricity.

entry: POKENAME的茧噼啪闪着蓝色雷光，身体变化，产生的电力也越来越多。即将进化时，宛如一道雷暴漩涡，闪电射向四面八方。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's cocoon crackles with blue lightning, its body generating more and more electricity as it changes. When evolution is imminent, it is a veritable maelstrom of crackling bolts firing in all directions.

entry: POKENAME在夜间飞翔，寻找紫水晶，吞下作为胃石。研究显示，多数青少年都深深着迷于它方块般的外形。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME soar through the night in search of amethyst, swallowing the gems to use as gizzard stones. Research has shown that most adolescents are enraptured by the cubic design of POKENAME.

entry: 电流在各根刺间噼啪跳跃，每根刺都能传导强劲电击。惹怒POKENAME，会让云层轰鸣、天空震颤，带电毒刺如雨落下，事后极少有谁能在毒害中幸存。
author: quackquackattack
source: Electricity crackles from stinger to stinger, each acting as a conduit for surging strikes. Angering POKENAME causes clouds to rumble and the sky to shake as they rain down electric stingers from the sky. Few survive the venomous aftermath.

entry: 据说，POKENAME能随意控制雷暴，还能让人产生幻觉，在云中看见亲爱之人的脸。不过，这仅被视为传闻。
author: rumia_archer
source: It is said that POKENAME can control thunderstorms at will and make people hallucinate their loved ones' faces in the clouds. However, this is only seen as a rumor.

entry: 发现POKENAME的人，会被侵入心智，接受审判。据说，如果理想与它不同，就会遭尾巴的雷电惩罚。
author: sk372
source: Those who manage to discover POKENAME will have their minds invaded so that they may be judged. It is said that should their ideals not match POKENAME's own, it will smite them with lightning from its tail as punishment.

entry: POKENAME每次挥动巨爪，都伴随强劲蓝色闪电。尾部涡轮更加活跃时，要留意牙齿：它从嘴里释放猛烈电流前，牙齿会明亮发光。
author: sk372
source: Powerful blue lightning follows every swing of POKENAME's massive claws. If the turbine on its tail grows more active, watch its teeth; they glow brightly just before it releases a devastating electric burst from its mouth.

entry: 暴风雨的夜里，能看见POKENAME飘在高云中，借风暴产生的电力充能。传说它们守望着星球，等待理想世界到来。
author: dualblades1147
source: On stormy nights, POKENAME can be seen floating high up in the clouds, charging themselves with the electricity created by the storm. Legends claim they are watching over our planet, waiting for the coming of an ideal world.

entry: POKENAME快速振翅，发出如闪电蓄势般的嗡鸣，积累静电，照亮夜空。身边的生灵会发现，毛发都竖了起来。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME's rapidly beating wings emit a buzzing hum, like a charging lightning bolt, as it builds up static electricity to light up the night sky. Those nearby will find their hair standing on end in its presence.

entry: POKENAME的电能随月相增强。满月时，它能以彗星般的速度飞越夜空，身后留下噼啪作响的雷电轨迹。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's electric energy increases with the phases of the moon. When it is full, POKENAME can race across the night sky with the speed of a comet, leaving a crackling trail of lightning behind it.

entry: POKENAME几乎瞬间就能加速到惊人的最高速度，如闪电般划破空气。军事机构正考虑参考它的外形研发战斗机。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can accelerate to a massive top speed almost instantly, cutting through the air like a thunderbolt. Military institutions are considering developing fighter jets based on its design.

entry: POKENAME住在城市附近的开阔平原，互相赛跑取乐。尾巴能通过奔跑发电，让行动敏捷许多。
author: thezekrom
source: POKENAME are found in open plains near cities, racing each other for fun. Their tail is able to generate electricity through running, giving them a noticeable boost in agility.

entry: POKENAME住在急流中，水流带动尾巴旋转，为身体充电。脸侧会跳出电弧，那里的特殊袋囊利用电能制造疗伤凝胶。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME lives in fast-flowing rivers which cause its tail to spin. This causes them to become charged, with electricity arcing from the side of their face where they have a special pouch that uses this energy to create a healing gel.

entry: 日积月累，POKENAME背上的黑暗石变成尖刺状甲壳。后腿也有部分被壳覆盖，十分结实、稳固。
author: thezekrom
source: Over time, the Dark Stone on the back of POKENAME has morphed into a spike-like shell. Their hind legs have become partly covered by the shell, making them very robust and sturdy.

entry: POKENAME后半身外观明显不同，多半时候似乎还与前半身不和。尾巴吐出看似明亮火焰的东西，其实是释放出的电能。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's back half has a distinctly different appearance, and most of the time seems to be at odds with the front half. The tail breathes what appears to be bright fire, but is in actuality dispelled electrical energy.

entry: POKENAME在壳内发电，始终能听见微弱嗡鸣。需要自卫时，便释放电力，化为破坏性惊人的闪电。
author: bacondlx
source: A faint whirring noise can be constantly heard from POKENAME generating electricity inside its shell. It discharges this electricity as incredibly devastating lightning bolts when it needs to defend itself.

entry: POKENAME制造几乎与自己一样大的等离子球，守卫领地。这些巨大电球足以为一所房子供电一个月，但攻击性让研究的科学家十分害怕。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME defend their territory by conjuring balls of plasma that are nearly as big as themselves. These massive balls of electricity hold enough power to light a house for a month, but their aggression frightens scientists studying them.

entry: POKENAME用剃刀般锋利的爪子追猎目标，身体充满能量时，能粉碎一切。传说，它释放的猛烈电涌足以夷平山峰。
author: korro0490
source: POKENAME pursues its target with its razor-sharp claws, crushing anything when its body is supercharged. Legends say this Pokémon can unleash a devastating surge of electricity, strong enough to level mountains.

entry: POKENAME先嗅地面，再用带电爪击刨开。这样能将找到的食物电熟，再给熊宝宝吃。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME smell the ground before clawing into it with electrified swipes. They do this to fry the food they find before giving it to Teddiursa.

entry: 甲壳像某些传说中描绘的石头。体内翻涌着猛烈火焰与电流，让身体蓝光更加明亮。
author: infinex21
source: Its shell resembles a stone depicted in some legends. Its body glows brighter with blue light from the intense flames and electricity brewing within itself.

entry: POKENAME是强大的海底捕食者，藏在漆黑深海。任何东西靠近，就会被爪子抓住，强劲生物电击得晕眩，再拖进巢穴。
author: sk372
source: A powerful undersea predator, POKENAME hides away in the inky-black darkness of the ocean depths. Anything that comes close is grabbed by its claws, stunned by its powerful bio-electricity, and dragged into its den.

entry: POKENAME能产生大量力量，身体不断向周围环境辐射能量。不战斗时，会摆出衔尾蛇般的环形，试着封存自己的力量。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME can generate significant amounts of power, their bodies constantly radiating the energy into their environment around them. They will form an ouroboros in an effort to contain their own power whilst not in battle.

entry: POKENAME感到威胁就展开双翼，让自己看起来更大、更危险。蓄力攻击时，身体泛起电蓝光，还能吐出腐蚀性吐息。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME flare their wings when they feel threatened, using them to make themselves appear larger and more dangerous than they are. Their bodies glow an electric blue when they charge up to attack, able to belch forth a caustic breath.

entry: 据说火山喷发遇上风暴，便诞生了它。掌控烈焰与雷电的本领，无可比拟。
author: toxicrown
source: This Pokémon is believed to have been birthed when a volcano erupted into a storm. It's control over fire and lightning is unrivalled.

entry: 蓄力时，背上亮起蓝光，传出独特嗡鸣。蓄满后，一击便能轰毁整座城市。
author: dragonzzilla
source: As it gathers energy to attack, its back glows blue and a distinct thrum can be heard. At full charge, it can destroy a whole city in a single blast.

entry: POKENAME从深处现身，迎战破坏自然平衡的宝可梦。背上噼啪迸发着惊人能量。
author: dragonzzilla
source: POKENAME emerges from the depths to confront other Pokémon who have upset the balance of nature. Its back crackles with tremendous energy.

entry: POKENAME快速摩擦脸颊，产生大量能量，储存在耳朵里。储能越多，耳朵与脸颊的光就越亮。
author: thezekrom
source: By quickly rubbing their cheeks, POKENAME are able to generate a high amount of energy, stored in their ears. The more energy they stored, the brighter the glow in their ears and cheeks.

entry: POKENAME拥有强大的黑魔法，挥手就能施展雷电法术。电流消散后，会短暂听见一阵若有若无、诡异的笑声。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME possesses potent dark magic capabilities, casting lightning spells with a flick of its hand. A strange and eerie laugh can be faintly heard for a moment after the electricity dissipates.

entry: POKENAME曾以琐碎却危险的争斗闻名；与它争斗的，是由莱希拉姆和黑暗鸦一族融合而成的宝可梦。它为了压过对手，什么都做得出来。
author: inksans201x
source: Once known for their petty yet dangerous fights against Reshikrow, POKENAME will do anything to one-up their opponents.

entry: 虽然POKENAME有翅膀，却主要待在地面，用耳朵吸收电力。将电力集中进双脚，速度就能媲美闪电。
author: thezekrom
source: While having wings, POKENAME stay mainly on the ground absorbing electricity through their ears. By concentrating the generated electricity into their feet, they can reach the speed of a lightning bolt.

entry: POKENAME常在发电厂附近挖隧道，吸收周围地中的电力。部分电力储存在颊囊，遇到威胁就用带电的咬击反击。
author: thezekrom
source: POKENAME often dig tunnels near power plants, absorbing electricity from the ground nearby. They can store some of that electricity in their cheek pouches, delivering a shocking bite when threatened.

entry: POKENAME静静等待，直到有什么从下方经过，便俯冲而下，用尾巴施以强烈电击。即使电流与麻痹没夺去性命，刺伤后残留的毒素也一定会。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME waits in silence until something walks below it, whereupon it swoops down and delivers a powerful jolting shock through its tail. If the electricity and paralysis doesn't claim its victim, the lingering poison from the sting surely will.

entry: POKENAME像马达一样转动尾巴，让电脑不断超频加速，直到爆炸。虽然能自行发电，但若逆时针转尾，就会瞬间吸尽设备的电池电量。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME spins its tail like a motor to continuously overclock computers at faster speeds until they blow up. While it can generate its own electricity, if it spins its tail counterclockwise, it instantly siphons all the battery a device has.

entry: 它们储存电力和太阳能，使部分身体发出明亮蓝光。展翅飞过天空时，能从尾尖释放闪电。
author: infinex21
source: Parts of their bodies glow a bright blue due to the electricity and solar energy stored within. They can loose bolts of lightning from the tips of their tails as they soar through the sky with their wings.

entry: POKENAME的尾巴是巨大发电机，能用太阳能充电。受到威胁，就释放大股电力，将附近一切烧毁。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: Its tail is a giant generator, and POKENAME can use energy from the sun to charge it. When threatened, it will release a large charge, incinerating anything nearby.

entry: 爪子与背上漂浮的黑球之间，由带电等离子体连接。释放出的电力极不稳定。
author: raptorroocool
source: Its claws and the black orb floating above its back are connected by a electrically-charged plasma. The electricity coming from it is highly unstable.

entry: POKENAME起舞时，能量向外涌出，闪电在身体上噼啪闪烁，跟随动作。一察觉人类观看，就会伴着电光与巨响雷鸣，瞬移离开。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's energy surges outward as it dances, causing lightning to crackle across its body and follow its movements. If it senses a human watching its performance, it teleports away with a burst of electricity and a loud thunderclap.

entry: POKENAME多处身体泛着强烈蓝光，暗示着巨大的电能。核心在双手生成强力电球，用来保护珍视的生灵。
author: sk372
source: Many spots of POKENAME's body glow a powerful blue, a hint at its massive electric potential. From its core, it generates punishing orbs of electricity into its hands that it uses to protect those it holds dear.

entry: POKENAME被坚定、强烈的理想吸引，以意志衡量对方是否值得追随。曾获选的极少数人，都受到强大雷电保护，威力足以瞬间劈开大地。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME is drawn to those with fierce and powerful ideals and will gauge their worthiness based on their wills. Those few it has ever chosen were always protected by its potent lightning that could sunder lands in an instant.

entry: 雨天能看见POKENAME坐在高处，撑伞歌唱，驱散附近生灵的负面情绪。遇到威胁，就召来大批雷云，击倒敌人。
author: actliux
source: During rainy days, POKENAME can be seen sitting atop high places and singing underneath its parasol, dispelling the negative feelings of those nearby. When threatened, it summons a multitude of thunderclouds to strike down its foe.

entry: POKENAME的尾巴发电，让双肘刀刃带电。它只为自认正义的目标战斗，以闪电般的斩击击倒邪恶对手。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's tail can generate power that electrifies the blades in its elbows. It only fights for causes it deems righteous, cutting down evil opponents with strikes as quick as lightning.

entry: POKENAME全身长出带电倒刺，如棘针般保护自己。胡须流过的电力帮助它在黑暗，甚至地下辨路，在那里与同类组成大家庭。
author: thezekrom
source: POKENAME have developed electrified barbs all over their body, which work like protective quills. The electricity running through their whiskers helps them navigate in the dark and even underground, where they form large families with their kind.

entry: POKENAME情绪强烈时，尾巴涌出龙之能量，猛烈闪光。这常让它疲惫不堪，容易受到攻击。
author: mepp.
source: When experiencing strong emotions, POKENAME's tail surges with draconic energy that flashes intensely. This surge often renders POKENAME exhausted and vulnerable to attack.

entry: POKENAME是自私、无情理想的体现，围绕一块深色石头凝聚。民俗学者争论，若与纯粹虚假的化身宝可梦配对，究竟会平息双方，还是成为灾难性的组合。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is an embodiment of selfish and ruthless ideals, coalescing around a dark stone. Folklorists argue that pairing this Pokémon with one embodying purely falsehoods could either calm each Pokémon or be a catastrophic partnership.

entry: POKENAME全身武装着尖刺甲壳，由背上嵌入的黑暗石形成。装甲能吸收巨量电力，用作高压护盾。
author: thezekrom
source: POKENAME's body is fully armored with a spiky shell, made of the Dark Stone embedded in its back. It can absorb extreme amounts of electricity into its armor plating, harnessing the power as a high-voltage shield.

entry: POKENAME将身体的电流集中进爪子，帮助为家族挖掘地下隧道。与亲友相处时，会收好带电倒刺，免得误伤。
author: thezekrom
source: POKENAME can concentrate the electricity running through their body into their claws, helping them dig underground tunnels for their families. When with friends or family, they tuck in their electrified barbs to prevent accidental injuries.

entry: POKENAME体内电流强得连最结实的宝可梦也能彻底了结。不过，它相当温柔，实际从未这样做。
author: dukefrogpeasant
source: The electrical currents that flow through POKENAME's body are strong enough to put even the most sturdy Pokémon down for good. However, it is quite gentle and never does this in practice.

entry: POKENAME常是同类大家庭或群体的首领。背上双翼极其结实，能挡下落石，保护其他成员。
author: thezekrom
source: POKENAME are often the heads of large families or groups of their kind. The wings on their backs are extremely sturdy, able to shield others from falling boulders.

entry: POKENAME仿佛游泳般飘过空中。尾巴充能，让眼睛射出阴森光束，使受害者身心都陷入震愕。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME floats through the air as if it were swimming. Its tail charges up energy to fuel beams of ghastly light from its eyes that will leave victims stunned both physically and mentally.

entry: 合众神话说，POKENAME是守卫来世入口的宝可梦之一。据说，只有心灵感应察觉缺乏信念与信仰的人类，才会张开嘴，将灵魂整个吞下。
author: beatdoof
source: Unovan mythology tell tales of POKENAME being one of the Pokémon to guard the entrance to the afterlife. Its mouth supposedly only opens when it telepathically senses humans who lack conviction and beliefs, swallowing their spirit whole.

entry: 偶尔能看见POKENAME在云中游泳。据说，这样做会引发雷暴。
author: seanothan_23
source: On rare occasions, POKENAME can be seen swimming through clouds. It is said that when it does this, it creates thunderstorms.

entry: 古代国家会在猛烈风暴中敬奉POKENAME。在这些节庆中被雷击中，被视为神圣的荣誉。
author: .izik
source: Ancient nations honored POKENAME during violent storms. Being struck by lightning during these festivals was considered a sacred honor.

entry: 理论认为，POKENAME能将全身粒子散为纯粹静电能量，化成巨大雷暴。以雷暴形态隐匿时，它能使大地移动，并在想恢复时重新聚合成形。
author: thezekrom
source: POKENAME is theorized to possess the ability to completely disband its particles into pure electrostatic energy, forming a giant thunderstorm. Hidden as such a storm, it is able to move the land and forms itself back together whenever it wishes.

entry: POKENAME将种子种进地里后，会充能、释放闪电，劈向播种处。长出的花草盛开后，便闪烁火花，电流涌动。
author: sk372
source: After planting seeds in the ground, POKENAME charges up and releases bolts of lightning to strike the planting spots. The flowers and plants that grow afterward spark and surge with electricity once in full bloom.

entry: POKENAME向耳朵注入电力，产生回声，增强声音。凭这超强听力，连地下的宝可梦也能听见。
author: thezekrom
source: POKENAME loads electricity into its ears, creating echoes that help amplify sound. With this superhearing, POKENAME can hear Pokémon even underground.

entry: POKENAME的刀刃迸出雷霆般的电光，引来雷暴。它偏爱信念格外坚定的持有者。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME's blade sparks with the intensity of lighting and and brings about thunderstorms. It gravitates towards wielders with superior conviction.

entry: 人们对POKENAME知之甚少。传说它潜伏在湖底阴影中，甚至有阴谋论认为来自其他星球。
author: seanothan_23
source: Very little is known about POKENAME. Legends say that it lurks in the shadows at the bottom of lakes. There are even conspiracy theories of it being from another planet.

entry: POKENAME尾巴上的发电器官，能瞬间制造大量纯雷电构成的缎带状触须。被抓住、电击的对象会麻痹，脸上却僵着喜悦的笑容。
author: sk372
source: An electricity-generating organ in POKENAME's tail lets it instantly create a multitude of ribbon-like tendrils made of pure lightning. Those grabbed and shocked by its bolts are left paralyzed, yet with gleeful smiles stuck on their faces.

entry: POKENAME好斗、专横，很少犹豫就会炫耀巨大力量。它习惯先吸干电线中的电，再用强力尾巴打倒电线杆。
author: sk372
source: Aggressive and domineering, POKENAME rarely hesitates to show off its massive strength. It has a habit of draining electricity from power lines before knocking down the poles with its powerful tail.

entry: POKENAME能召来巨大雷云，掀起汹涌海浪与危险天气。胆敢伤害海洋者，会遭到流经它身体的闪电轰击。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME can summon massive storm clouds that cause turbulent waters and dangerous weather conditions. Those who dare to hurt the sea will be blasted by the bolts of electricity that surge through POKENAME's body.

entry: 雷暴形成时，POKENAME无论游得多深，都能感觉大气变化，跃出水面吸收风暴电力。风暴平息后，才回深海消化吸收的能量。
author: thezekrom
source: When a thunderstorm forms, POKENAME feel the atmospheric change no matter how deep they swim, breaching the surface to absorb the storms electricity. Once the storm subsides, POKENAME return back to the deep sea to metabolize the absorbed energy.

entry: POKENAME栖居在大气层最高处，吸收太阳能。体内电力极强，光是飞过天空便能引发巨大大气风暴，真正实力仍成谜。
author: thezekrom
source: POKENAME dwells in the highest parts of the atmosphere, absorbing energy from the sun. The electricity in its body is so strong that it can cause massive atmospheric storms just by flying through the sky. Its exact strength is shrouded in mystery.

entry: POKENAME在梦中现身，让人看见未能贯彻理想的后果，或走向极端的危险。虽然经历不愉快，人们却说，这番干预帮助自己避开了可怕错误。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME appears in dreams to show people the consequences of failing to live up to their ideals, or the dangers of taking them to extremes. While unpleasant to experience, people claim POKENAME's intervention helped them avoid terrible mistakes.

entry: 面对大群敌人，POKENAME快速释放闪电，同时电击多排对手。面对强敌，就在炮中将闪电旋合为巨大电束，彻底击溃。
author: soup1900
source: To deal with large groups of enemies, POKENAME fires quick bolts of lightning to shock multiple lines of foes at once. For a powerful foe, it spins the bolts together inside its cannon to form a large beam of electricity that wipes the foe out.

entry: POKENAME周围的寒气冷得夏天也能形成黑冰。它引发伴随雷电的暴雪，能让整个地区的电网瘫痪。
author: actliux
source: The frigid aura that surrounds POKENAME is cold enough to generate black ice even in the summer. They cause thundersnow storms that are capable of knocking out power grids on a regional scale.

entry: POKENAME用四片翅膀迅速移动，产生的生物电太多，必须不断从头部释放一部分，形成电力圆环。
author: thezekrom
source: POKENAME uses its four wings to move around quickly. The bioelectricity generated in its body while moving is so high that it has to release some of it constantly through its head, forming a ring made of electricity.

entry: POKENAME是顽皮的恶作剧高手，喜欢放电电人取乐。但经常控制不住巨大的力量，无意中让目标完全麻痹。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME is a mischievous prankster that loves to zap people with bursts of electricity for fun. However, it often fails to control its immense strength, unintentionally releasing enough force to leave its targets completely paralyzed.

entry: 这种宝可梦在合众被发现，外形与功能都似乎模仿发电机。有人见过“机器”内部有小小的龙形生灵四处奔走，为服务的对象供能。
author: moopse
source: Discovered in Unova, this Pokémon seems to mimic both the form and function of a generator. A small, dragon-like entity has been seen scurrying about inside the "machine." providing power to those it serves.

entry: POKENAME体内流过巨量电力，产生的磁场使它无法飞行。它能振动颚上的两根大獠牙，轻松切开密实物体。
author: thezekrom
source: Due to the massive amount of electricity flowing through the body of POKENAME, the magnetic fields it generates prevent it from flying. It can vibrate the two big tusks on its jaw, making slashing through dense objects effortless.

entry: 古代卷轴将POKENAME描绘为城堡守护者，向强大的领袖宣誓保护。即使城堡倒塌数十年，仍坚守久远的誓约，巡逻曾守卫的废墟。
author: thezekrom
source: Ancient scrolls depict POKENAME as guardians of castles, pledged to a powerful leader to protect them. Even decades after those castles collapsed, POKENAME still hold on to their vows from long ago, patrolling those ruins they once guarded.

entry: POKENAME喜欢趴在柔软的尾巴上小睡。尾巴能吸收电力，发光并增强火焰攻击。
author: thezekrom
source: POKENAME have soft tails that they enjoy taking naps on. They can absorb electricity with their tail, causing it to glow and amplify their flaming attacks.

entry: POKENAME披着黑色伪装，演奏响亮电子音乐，尾部光球随着节拍闪烁。即兴演唱会吸引大批观众，许多听过的人说，音乐让自己开始想象更好的世界。
author: .jerden
source: Clad in a black disguise, POKENAME plays loud electronic music, flashing the bulb on its tail in time to the beat. Its impromptu concerts draw large crowds, and many people who have attended claim its music inspired them to imagine a better world.

entry: POKENAME三颗头都能控制体内储存的电流。步调一致时，便能施展巨大雷击，足以让整座城市停电。
author: thezekrom
source: Each of the three heads of POKENAME are able to control the current flow of electricity stored inside their body. When they align, they can perform massive lightning strikes, strong enough to black out an entire city.

entry: POKENAME每条尾尖都有强力发电机。九个尾尖同时相触，就能爆发闪电，留下巨大的坑洞。
author: sk372
source: Each of POKENAME's tails is tipped with a potent electricity generator. Tapping all nine tips together at once creates lightning bursts strong enough to leave large craters behind.

entry: POKENAME由放射性极强的物质组成，多数生灵接触即死。它常将这种物质射向敌人，作为破坏力惊人的武器。
author: autismgaming89_51746
source: POKENAME are made of an extremely radioactive substance that is lethal to most creatures upon contact. They often project this substance at foes as a devastating weapon.

entry: POKENAME在山腰溪流安家，尾巴储存巨量能量。生气时，会猛击尾巴，释放强力电击波。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME makes its home on mountainside streams. It stores massive amounts of energy in its tail. When angered, POKENAME slams its tail to unleash powerful electrical shockwaves.

entry: POKENAME十分友好，会试着帮助任何有点冷的生灵。小尾巴产生的热量，足以点燃蜡烛。
author: thezekrom
source: POKENAME are very friendly and try to help everyone that feel a little cold. Their little tail is able to generate enough heat to light a candle.

entry: POKENAME爱吃水果、蔬菜，把能量以电力形式储存在腹中。从最喜欢的食物里，能吸收更多能量。
author: thezekrom
source: POKENAME loves to eat fruits and vegetables, storing the energy as electricity in its belly. More energy is absorbed from its favorite food.

entry: POKENAME常大群倒挂在漆黑洞顶。黑色身体完美藏进夜色，只有微蓝的耳朵在黑暗里泛着弱光。
author: thezekrom
source: POKENAME are often hanging together from the ceiling of pitch-black caves, gathered in large groups. Their black bodies perfectly hide them, leaving only their blueish ears faintly glowing in the darkness.

entry: POKENAME奏乐时，世界各地的每台电子设备都能清楚听见。
author: seanothan_23
source: When POKENAME makes music it can be clearly heard through every electronic device from around the world.

entry: POKENAME领地意识极强，会在颈间聚起闪电，吸引伴侣，也威吓情敌。
author: crustyglowstick
source: POKENAME is extremely territorial. It gathers lightning around its neck to both attract potential mates and intimidate rivals.

entry: POKENAME领地意识极强，从不与同类分享地盘。有人见过它攻击发电厂，吸取储存的能量，强化自己，准备迎战潜在对手。
author: thezekrom
source: POKENAME are very territorial and never shares its claim with another of its kind. Its been seen to attack power plants to absorb the energy stored within, strengthening itself for a clash with a potential rival.

entry: 即使雷暴猛烈，POKENAME也依旧快乐。脚吸收养分，头顶叶片吸收电力；养分储存在尾巴里，需要时再消耗。
author: thezekrom
source: POKENAME remains jolly even during heavy thunderstorms. It absorbs nutrients through its feet and electricity through the leaves on its head. The nutrients are stored in its tail, and can be consumed in times of need.

entry: POKENAME如同巨型避雷针，连最强的闪电也能引向枝条，并将雷击的能量转化为电能。
author: camtft
source: POKENAME act like giant lightning rods, drawing even the strongest strikes of lightning towards its branches. They are capable of converting the energy of the strikes into electrical energy.

entry: 人们相信，它是尚未实现的理想的化身。不过，自己的理想似乎主要是水分与好吃的蔬菜。
author: hophoppip
source: It's believed to be an embodiment of ideals yet to be realized. Its own ideals seem to be primarily focused on moisture and tasty vegetables.

entry: 黑色小说《然后我看见了POKENAME》的电影改编，因为剧组找不到真正的它而停工。许多人认为，这是因为传说中，只有追寻童年理想的人才能找到它。
author: .realthree
source: Work to adapt the noir novel "Then I Saw the POKENAME" into a film was halted due to the film crew being unable to locate an actual POKENAME. Many say this is due to the legend claiming that only those who pursue their childhood ideals will find it.

entry: POKENAME背上长着一对发光蘑菇，能产生充满电力的孢子，发射到空中，让任何吸入的威胁无法行动。
author: thezekrom
source: POKENAME grows a pair of glowing mushrooms on its back. It can produce spores loaded with electricity, which it can launch into the air, immobilizing any threat that breathes them in.

entry: POKENAME战斗时，石鬃散出强烈蓝光，令附近者目眩。这种生灵极为罕见，据说会在午夜将近时现身天空。
author: fiordaliso
source: When it fights, its stone mane radiates an intense bluish color that blinds anyone nearby. POKENAME is an extremely rare creature said to appear in the sky as midnight approaches.

entry: 巨大的蘑菇让POKENAME爪子产生电力，释放细小闪电，在老树上凿洞。被电过的洞，接下来几周会长出无数真菌。
author: sk372
source: The giant mushroom generates electricity in POKENAME's claws that it uses to fire small bolts of lightning that carve holes in old trees. After being zapped, the holes will grow countless fungi in the following weeks.

entry: 战斗时，头顶的锥形结构产生夸张的大量电力，再经长爪集中、传导。充满后，爪子会明亮发光。
author: fireblade141
source: In battle, the conical structure on its head begins generating ludicrous amounts of electricity. This electricity is then focused and conducted by its long claws, which glow brightly when fully charged.

entry: POKENAME从花朵采集花蜜，吸收进血液。虽然身体漆黑，流过体内的花蜜却会发出生物光，在翅膀上形成鲜明图案。
author: thezekrom
source: POKENAME harvests nectar from flowers that gets absorbed into its bloodstream. While its body is black, the nectar coursing through its body glows through bioluminescence. This glow creates vivid patterns in its wings.

entry: POKENAME发光的鼻子不断向地面发送电信号。头顶尖刺能接收同类信号，实现远距离交流。
author: thezekrom
source: POKENAME has a glowing nose that constantly sends electric signals into the ground. The spike on its head is able to receive those signals from others of its kind, enabling it to communicate over large distances.

entry: 下半身主要是一块巨大的带电晶体，吸收、储存电力，连空气中游离的电也能吸取。据报告，电力太强，无法安全利用。
author: infinex21
source: Its lower body is mostly a large, galvanic crystal that draws in and stores electricity; it can even absorb ambient electricity in the air. Reportedly, its electricity cannot be safely harnessed because it has too much power.

entry: 雷暴时，常能在高楼屋顶看见POKENAME。它喜欢充满静电的浓重空气，通过毛发吸电，增强敏捷性。
author: thezekrom
source: POKENAME is often spotted on the roof of tall buildings during thunderstorms. It enjoys the dense air filled with static electricity that it absorbs through its fur to enhance its agility.

entry: POKENAME每次挥拳，都伴随无休怒火驱动的闪电。它渴望对抗理想足够坚定的战士，能承受，甚至胜过那狂暴的连拳。
author: sk372
source: Every swing of POKENAME's fists is accompanied with lightning fueled by its own incessant anger. It yearns to fight combatants with strong enough ideals to withstand or even best its raging flurries of punches.

entry: POKENAME能让毛发带电，保持身体温暖，也以此防御。谁直接打中它，就会遭电击。
author: thezekrom
source: POKENAME is able to electrify its fur, keeping its body warm. The electrified fur acts as a defense mechanism, sending a shock to anyone landing a direct hit on it.

entry: POKENAME发电时，身上条纹泛起明亮蓝光。过程中困在毛里的热量能增强火属性招式，让攻击更快、更强。
author: thezekrom
source: When POKENAME generate electricity, the stripes along their body glow bright blue. The heat trapped in their fur from the process helps amplify their Fire-Type moves, allowing for faster and stronger attacks.

entry: POKENAME进化后，会点燃尾巴，冒出小火焰。它能用翅膀迅速打击，必定留下烧痕。
author: thezekrom
source: After evolving, POKENAME ignite their tail to emit a small flame. With their wings, they are able to deliver fast blows that definitely leave burn marks.

entry: POKENAME如一道火焰与闪电飞越天空，只留下烟云。猛烈风暴中，头顶尖刺能充当避雷针。
author: thezekrom
source: POKENAME soar through the sky like a bolt of fire and lightning, leaving behind only a cloud of smoke. In heavy storms, the spike on their head can act as a lightning rod.

entry: POKENAME能用翅膀划水，在海里移动。腹部旋纹吸收洋流能量，转成电力，强化用于推进的尾巴。
author: thezekrom
source: POKENAME can use its wings like paddles to navigate the ocean. The spiral on its belly absorbs energy from the ocean currents and turns it into electricity, strengthening the tail that it uses to propel itself.

entry: POKENAME腹部连水流最细微的变化都能察觉。它顺着水流发动攻击，增强速度与力量。
author: thezekrom
source: The belly of POKENAME can sense even the slightest change in a water current. It uses those senses to line up its attacks with the flow of water, enhancing its speed and strength.

entry: POKENAME腹部旋纹吸收波浪的动能，储存在拳头中。充能达极限时，一击能有小型海啸般的力量。
author: thezekrom
source: The spiral on POKENAME's belly can absorb the kinetic energy of waves and store it in its fists. If it reaches its maximum charge, a single blow can get as strong as a small tsunami.

entry: POKENAME用精神力量，从双手产生电球，还能自由操纵电球移动，保护自己。
author: thezekrom
source: POKENAME uses its psychic ability to generate electric spheres from its hands. It is able to freely move those spheres around, using them to defend itself.

entry: POKENAME利用空气中的静电，让周围金属物品悬浮。尾巴发出的电磁气场极强，能干扰附近的追踪设备。
author: thezekrom
source: POKENAME can use the static electricity in the air to make metallic objects around it float. The tail emits such a strong electromagnetic aura that it can mess with tracking devices close to it.

entry: POKENAME的精神能力极为高深，能吸收周围任何电力，覆盖全身，化作护盾。还可将积蓄的电导入拳中，向对手施以强而精准的电击。
author: thezekrom
source: POKENAME's psychic abilities are so advanced that it can absorb any electricity around it and use it as a shield, covering its body. It is able to channel the gathered electricity into its fists, sending strong, precise shocks towards its opponent.

entry: POKENAME的肌肉不断受电力强化，因此几乎能无休止地攻击、施展动作，不会劳损，也不必休息。
author: thezekrom
source: The muscles of POKENAME are constantly powered up with electricity. Thanks to this enhancement, it can use attacks and manuevers almost endlessly without getting strained or needing to rest.

entry: POKENAME最大的优势是巨力，能独自迎战体型大自己数倍的宝可梦。战斗之外却很温顺，若不小心吓跑想帮助的宝可梦，还会哭。
author: dyo_jonah
source: POKENAME's immense strength is their greatest asset, capable of taking on Pokémon many times larger than itself alone. It is quite docile outside of combat, and cries when it accidentally scares away a Pokémon it wishes to help.

entry: POKENAME从电线的绝缘子吸取能量，为几乎完全由纯电组成的身体供能。为节能，会展翅乘风，在电线杆间滑翔。
author: thezekrom
source: POKENAME consumes energy from insulators found on power lines to fuel its body, which is almost entirely made of pure electricity. To save energy, POKENAME catches the wind with its wings to glide from pole to pole.

entry: POKENAME爱在温暖海洋游泳，与同类一起长时间潜水。手脚能发光，水下也很容易看见。
author: thezekrom
source: POKENAME love to swim in warm oceans, taking long dives with others of their kind. The hands and feet are capable of emitting a glow that can be easily seen underwater.

entry: POKENAME的触手是黑暗中完美的狩猎工具。每根都装有感受器，即使在最漆黑的深海，也能感知猎物的生物电。
author: thezekrom
source: POKENAME's tentacles are the perfect hunting tools in the dark. Equipped with receptors on each tentacle, it can sense the bioelectricity of prey even in the darkest depths of the ocean.

entry: POKENAME藏在深海黑暗中，用触手抓住猎物，施以强烈电击，让其彻底麻痹。
author: thezekrom
source: POKENAME hides itself in the dark of deep oceans. It use its tentacles to grab onto prey and deliver strong jolts of electricity, paralyzing its hostage completely.

entry: POKENAME的角能储存大量电力。从高山坡滚落时，能重重撞地，释放巨量电涌，导致附近停电。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME can store large amounts of electricity in their horns. When POKENAME tumble from high mountainsides, they can strike the ground so hard and release massive electric surges that cause blackouts nearby.

entry: 它是活体发电机，能凭空产生能量。已知存世不到20只，因此备受追寻。
author: toxicrown
source: This Pokémon is a living generator, able to make energy from nothing. It is highly sought after, as less than 20 are known to exist.

entry: POKENAME鬃毛中流过电流，结合的能量产生高热，让火焰烧成蓝色。迸出的火花碰到皮肤，会造成轻微电击与灼伤。
author: thezekrom
source: Electricity runs through POKENAME's mane, causing the fire to burn blue from the heat of the combined energy. The sparks coming off of it can deliver slight shocks and light burns when touching the skin.

entry: 古文献警告，触碰POKENAME的角会招来灾难。即便如此，曾有许多人将它尊为能赐予无尽能量的存在。
author: mepp.
source: Ancient texts warn that touching POKENAME's horn brings disaster. Despite this, many people once revered it as a being that could grant endless energy.

entry: POKENAME尾巴附着的贝壳，以体内产生的能量为食。它会用贝壳防御，或施以猛烈反击。
author: thezekrom
source: The shell attached to POKENAME's tail feeds on the energy produced in POKENAME's body. It uses this shell for defensive moves or heavy counterattacks.

entry: POKENAME在城市飞行，从放在外面的电器上收集线缆，用来筑巢，或当宝物囤积。
author: thezekrom
source: POKENAME flies around cities, collecting cables from appliances left outside. POKENAME uses these cables to build its nest or hoard them as valuables.

entry: POKENAME的两颗头各自思考。体内流过的电力帮助更快整合想法，遇袭时便能迅速逃走。
author: thezekrom
source: POKENAME's two heads think individually. The electricity flowing through their bodies helps them form combined thoughts more quickly, making quick escapes possible when attacked.

entry: POKENAME用两对鳍肢，迅速达到极快的游泳速度。宽尾维持身体的流线型，让游泳势头持续。
author: thezekrom
source: POKENAME has two sets of flippers that it uses to reach extreme swimming speeds very quickly. Its broad tail helps it to stay streamlined, keeping the momentum going while swimming.

entry: POKENAME常被误认为重型机器产生的油泥。它在那些机器里休息，吸收马达产生的能量充电。
author: thezekrom
source: POKENAME is often mistaken for oily sludge created by heavy machinery. It rests inside those machines and absorbs the energy produced from the motors to charge itself.

entry: POKENAME捕猎太靠近水边的其他电属性宝可梦，吸收电能，用来强化血细胞，提升下潜速度与耐水压能力。
author: thezekrom
source: POKENAME hunt other Electric-type Pokémon that get too close to the water's edge, absorbing their electric energy. They use this energy to fortify their blood cells, giving them a boost in dive speed and resistance to water pressure.

entry: 据说，未经允许，谁也无法接近POKENAME的巢穴。壳上的强炮能从数英里外精准发射闪电，威慑一切潜在入侵者。
author: sk372
source: It is said that none can even approach POKENAME's lair unless it allows them to. The powerful cannons on its shell fire lightning with great accuracy up to several miles, ensuring it can deter any potential intruders.

entry: POKENAME喜欢漂在海中钻油平台附近，吸收地热，转为电力。储存后可从壳刺释放，让周围水中充满强烈电击。
author: thezekrom
source: POKENAME likes to float near oil rigs in the ocean, absorbing the geothermal energy and turning it into electricity. It can store this electricity and release it through the spikes on its shell, causing heavy electric shocks in the surrounding water.

entry: POKENAME呈气体形态，完全由带电雾气组成，能迅速飘动。谁想触碰，它便能散进空气，随时重新成形。
author: thezekrom
source: POKENAME has a gaseous form and is entirely made of an electrically charged fog that it can quickly float around with. If someone tries to touch it, POKENAME can dissolve in the air and reform whenever it likes.

entry: POKENAME爱躲在阴影里吓人。它能附身实体物品，轻轻电击接触者，自娱自乐。
author: thezekrom
source: POKENAME likes to hide in the shadows and to spook others. It can possess physical objects and then lightly shock those coming in contact with it to entertain itself.

entry: POKENAME全身由黑色石块组成，每块都能独立旋转。移动时，旋转产生的能量帮助抬起极沉的尾巴，像连枷一样攻击。
author: thezekrom
source: The body of POKENAME is entirely made of Black Stones and can rotate each one individually. While moving, the energy created by its rotating body helps it lift its extremely heavy tail, using it like a flail to attack.

entry: POKENAME用黑暗石当摆锤，以催眠的节奏摇晃。它试图让对手目光锁在摆锤，暗中准备突袭电击。
author: thezekrom
source: POKENAME uses a Dark Stone as its pendulum, moving it in a hypnotic motion. It tries to get its opponent's attention fixated on the pendulum while preparing a surprise shock attack.

entry: POKENAME在海滩与海中岩石上群居。雷暴时，会举钳向天，吸收大气中的电力，储存在始终随身带着的黑暗石中。
author: thezekrom
source: POKENAME live in colonies on beaches and on rocks in the ocean. If there is a thunderstorm going on, POKENAME will raise their claws to the sky, absorbing the atmospheric electricity, storing it in a Dark Stone which they always carry with them.

entry: POKENAME的巨钳强得惊人，抓猎物的力道堪比液压机。它牢牢扣住猎物，通过钳刺吸取生物电，直到什么也没剩下，只余吃饱的自己。
author: thezekrom
source: POKENAME's claws are extremely strong and can grab prey with the force of a hydraulic press. It keeps its hostage locked down and absorbs their bioelectricity through their claw-spikes until nothing is left but a satiated POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME身体过于不稳定时，会用极寒冰层封住自己，阻止即将发生的爆炸。但压制电力太久，压力不断积累，最终仍会不堪负荷而炸开。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME encases itself in ultracold ice to prevent an impending explosion when its body becomes too unstable. However, if it restrains its electricity for too long, pressure builds until it explodes from the strain.

entry: 每颗蛋都冷得危险，直接拿着超过几秒就有冻伤风险。整群合力，能吐出大片浓厚寒雾，将攻击者彻底冻住。
author: sk372
source: Each of the eggs is dangerously cold, risking frostbite if held directly for more than a few seconds. Working together, the entire group can breathe out a massive thick, chilling fog to freeze attackers solid.

entry: POKENAME性格冷淡，只想独处或极少数结伴。若觉得同伴太烦，就用冰冷骨棒轻轻一碰，将其瞬间冻住。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has a cold personality, wishing to remain alone or in very small groups. If it finds company too annoying, it flash-freezes them solid with a tap of its chilled bone club.

entry: POKENAME投出冰冻污泥球，缓缓蒸散成有毒气体。气体让敌人感到严重发热，也更容易受到冰属性攻击伤害。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME throw balls of frozen sludge that slowly evaporate into toxic fumes. These fumes make their foes feel incredibly feverish and make them more susceptible to Ice-type attacks.

entry: 空心玻璃附肢几乎无法破坏。古代神话说，其中原本充满强大能量，后来不知为何全部泄漏，再也没回来。
author: h0bojoe
source: Its empty glass appendages are nearly unbreakable. Ancient myth states these appendages used to be filled with powerful energy until it somehow leaked out forever.

entry: 研究表明，POKENAME最初可能来自外太空。许多天文摄影者报告，曾看见玻璃附肢中充满强大冰能量的个体。
author: h0bojoe
source: Studies suggest POKENAME originally came from outer space. Many astrophotographers have reported spotting them with their glass appendages filled with powerful ice energy.

entry: 这种残暴的宝可梦用头顶巨钳抓住猎物，完全冻实后摔向地面。POKENAME喜欢先冻结要吃的一切，再放进嘴里碾碎。
author: infinex21
source: This brutal Pokémon captures prey with the giant set of pincers atop its head and freezes them solid before slamming them into the ground. POKENAME prefer to freeze anything they would eat before they crush their food up within their mouths.

entry: POKENAME沉睡在寒湖与峡湾之下。谁打扰家园宁静，就会带着报复的怒火醒来。冰钓者养成迷信，钓前会留一份点心，即使当地没有它居住也一样。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME slumbers beneath frigid lakes and fjords and awakens in a vengeful rage if anyone disturbs the peace of its home. Ice fishers have developed a superstition of leaving a treat for POKENAME before fishing, even if one does not reside there.

entry: POKENAME体型虽小，却十分凶悍。它将体内储存的大量能量化作电力与惊人的速度，战斗时迅如闪电，令对手遭受电击，来不及反应。
author: thepandasharky
source: POKENAME is small yet fierce. It stores a lot of energy within itself, releasing it in the form of electricity and blinding speed. When in battle, it unleashes lightning-fast attacks that leave its opponents shocked and unable to react.

entry: POKENAME只要待在电脑中，就足以让电脑不断死机。它心怀恶意，主动入侵、冻结电脑，破坏用户储存的数据。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's mere presence in a computer is enough to make it freeze up constantly. It has a spiteful personality, actively seeking out computers to invade and freeze in order to cause damage to the user's data within.

entry: POKENAME的遗传密码并不完整，会潜入电脑劫取数据，补全自己。但还没来得及攻击，冰冻能量就先弄坏了电脑。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME's genetic code is incomplete. To finish itself, POKENAME infiltrates computers to hijack data, but it breaks the computers due to freezing energy before it can attack.

entry: POKENAME曾因冷酷无情，被视为体现严冬残酷的冬之灵。拍一下翅膀，便能掀起肆虐数日的可怕暴风雪。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME was once thought to be a spirit of winter, embodying the season's cruelty due to its callous nature. One flap of its wings can unleash terrible blizzards that rage on for days.

entry: POKENAME将自己冻在冰彗星里，压制精神力量。若挣脱封印，精神能量便能发出环绕全球的冲击波。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME freezes itself in an icy comet to contain its psychic powers. If it breaks loose from containment, its psychic energy can send a shockwave around the globe.

entry: POKENAME是以宝可梦酋幻的样本进行基因实验的产物。虽然有人认为实验失败，它却能在短短几秒内，将挡路的一切瞬间冻结。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME is the result of genetic experiments based on samples of the Pokémon, Kyuew. Although some claim the experiments failed, this Pokémon has the power to instantly freeze anything within its path in mere seconds.

entry: POKENAME能轻松重组自己的DNA，连融合宝可梦也能匹配。关于它与宝可梦融合现象的关系，以及储存的力量完全释放会发生什么，传言始终不断。
author: bobosmith01
source: It is able to easily rearrange its DNA to match even fused Pokémon. Rumors persist about POKENAME and its relation to the phenomenon of Pokémon Fusion, and what would happen if its stored power was entirely unleashed.

entry: POKENAME用寒霜在颈部根处制造巨大冰花瓣，每片可大如足球场，将阳光全部导向自己。
author: bandedbodypress
source: It uses its frost to make massive petals made from ice around the base of its neck. These petals can be as big as a football field, and they all direct sunlight towards POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME每秒积蓄的热量足以熔化一座山。排出热量让它形成冰冷身体，帮助容纳能量。
author: bandedbodypress
source: It builds enough heat to melt a mountain every second. The expulsion of its heat has given POKENAME an icy body that helps contain its energy.

entry: POKENAME的三条肢体会制造顺滑、绵密的冰冻点心，喜欢分给其他生灵。研究显示，尾巴的口味最不受欢迎，就算当下只有这一种，也常被拒绝。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's three limbs create smooth and creamy frozen treats it likes to share with others. Studies show that the flavor on its tail is the least favorite, often being refused even if it's the only flavor currently available.

entry: POKENAME住在冰冷水中，却没有感受寒冷的神经。因此太冷时，就会冻住，被冰包裹。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME lives in ice-cold water but has no nerves that allow it to feel the cold. This means that when it gets too cold, POKENAME freezes and becomes encased in ice.

entry: POKENAME被视为极寒地区的智者，却似乎总难想起部分知识。有人说，它缺少自己的一部分，只有完整后，真正的智慧才会闪耀。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is considered a wise sage of the arctic regions, but appears to have difficulty recalling certain bits of information. Some say it's missing a part of itself, and only when whole will its true intellect shine forth.

entry: POKENAME钢铁般的壳，其实是坚硬、压实的冰。爪中储存的冰冻能量能冻裂金属，再用强力一拳将其击碎。
author: bandedbodypress
source: The steel-like shell of POKENAME is hard, compressed ice. The freezing energy stored in its claws can crack metal, and with a powerful punch, it can shatter the metal.

entry: POKENAME努力维持每年送礼的平衡。每给好心人一份美好礼物，也会给行为不端者一份恶意礼物。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME strives to maintain a balance in its yearly gift-giving. For every kindhearted person it gifts something nice to, it gives out something mean-spirited to those who have behaved poorly.

entry: POKENAME体内的冰冻能量，让企业将它接入超级电脑散热。任何与它连接太久的人工智能，都会反过来对付创造者。
author: bandedbodypress
source: The freezing energy inside POKENAME led companies to wire it into supercomputers for cooling. Any AI connected to POKENAME for an extended period will turn on its creators.

entry: POKENAME难以控制巨力，释放的冰冻能量会熄灭任何喷出的火焰。因此攻击无法熔化目标，却会改将一切吞没在冰中。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME has difficulty controlling its sheer power, releasing freezing energy that extinguishes any flame released. While this prevents it from melting anything it attacks, it instead consumes everything in ice.

entry: POKENAME奔过大地时，会留下转瞬即逝的冰冷光带，宛如极光。据说，它能折射光线，让身体变成任何颜色。
author: frokachu
source: When POKENAME run across the land, they leave behind a chilling, temporary stream of light that looks like an aurora. It is said its body can change to any color by refracting light.

entry: POKENAME震耳的吼叫能在周围大片区域掀起浓重暴风雪，遮住自己的接近。它趁机潜向擅闯者，轻轻一碰就将其冻住。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's bellowing roar causes thick snowstorms to develop in a wide area around it. The snow becomes thick enough to obscure POKENAME's approach as it sneaks up on trespassers to freeze them solid with a single touch.

entry: POKENAME沉睡在海床深处。水手曾十分畏惧，声称只要一只浮上海面，整片海洋都会冻结。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME slumbers deep within the sea floor. Sailors once greatly feared the Pokémon claiming that should one ever surface, the very ocean itself would freeze over.

entry: POKENAME包裹在坚不可摧的冰中，在世界最高山峰筑巢。展翼时将阳光折射成彩虹，碰到什么都能冻结。
author: ambrosia04
source: Encased in indestructible ice, POKENAME constructs nests on top of the world's highest peaks. When it spreads its wings, it refracts sunlight into a rainbow, which can freeze anything it touches.

entry: POKENAME身体结实，局部冰甲更加坚固，全身冲撞能将对手撞飞。接着会从双手连发沉重冰块，追击对手。
author: sk372
source: With a sturdy body and even sturdier patches of ice armor, POKENAME's full-body tackles send its opponents flying. It follows the assault with a barrage of heavy ice chunks fired from its hands.

entry: POKENAME通过炮状双臂，精准运用冰与火的力量。右臂发火，左臂射出坚冰碎片，将落点周围冻结。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME can wield the powers of ice and fire with remarkable precision via its cannon-like arms. From its right arm comes fire and from its left comes shards of solid ice that will freeze the area around where they strike.

entry: POKENAME天生的龙之能量估计为每秒1太瓦。科学尚无法解释，化学家推测，身体里隐藏着冷聚变的秘密。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME's innate draconic energy is estimated to be 1 terawatt per second. No science has been able to determine how, but chemists theorize that its body holds the secret to cold fusion.

entry: 火焰囊停止运作，让POKENAME全身冻实。野生个体会靠近训练家求抱，怀着希望，想用他们的温暖融化自己。
author: h0bojoe
source: Its flame sac has stopped functioning, leaving its body frozen solid. Wild POKENAME approach Trainers for hugs, clinging to the hope that their warmth might thaw it.

entry: POKENAME在冰川深处筑巢，艰难跋涉到地上觅食。爪子冷得一击就能造成难以恢复的冻伤。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME nest deep within glaciers, trudging above ground to feed. Their claws are so cold, a single strike inflicts frostbite that is difficult to recover from.

entry: 人们认为，这是一种火焰鸡亚种，将自身超级能量冻结，永久保存力量。由此获得天文数字般的力量，代价却是持续、无法忍受的痛苦。
author: h0bojoe
source: It is believed to be a Blaziken subspecies that froze its own Mega Energy to preserve its power indefinitely. This grants it astronomical strength at the cost of constant, unbearable pain.

entry: POKENAME性格被形容为冰冷、空洞。传说，只有真正善良、心怀理想的人，才有机会融化它的心。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's personality is described as frigid and hollow. According to legends, only those who possess a truly kind and idealistic heart have any chance of thawing POKENAME's heart.

entry: POKENAME的形体连着一块特殊冰川冰，无论周围多热，似乎都不会融化。冰冷咆哮能将所有听者冻在原地。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's form is linked to a special chunk of glacial ice that never seems to melt no matter the temperatures around it. Its chilling roar freezes all who hear it in place.

entry: POKENAME靠第二颗头战斗、防御，甚至进食。任何被其巨口抓住的东西，都会瞬间冻住，再碾成细雾。
author: infinex21
source: The second head of a POKENAME is how it will fight, defend, and even eat. Anything seized within the maw of its second head will be instantly flash-frozen and then crushed into a fine mist.

entry: POKENAME冲锋时，几乎投入所有储存的冰冻力量。头一撞到东西，寒气便猛然爆发，将目标及其后方大片范围内的一切冻结。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME puts nearly all of its stored freezing power into its charges. Once its head contacts with something, a burst of cold air forcefully freezes the target, as well as anything behind it within a large radius.

entry: 暴风雪与雪崩将近时，能看见POKENAME，平时却很隐蔽。一被发现，就会消失回雪中。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: POKENAME can be seen when blizzards and avalanches are near, but is otherwise quite reclusive. If spotted, it vanishes back into the snow.

entry: POKENAME冰冷的光辉在现身几秒内，便将附近温度降至冰点以下。据说，触到身体冻结的部分，就会瞬间化成冰。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's chilling radiance drops the temperature in its vicinity down to below freezing within seconds of its appearance. Touching the frozen parts of its body is said to instantly turn a person to ice.

entry: POKENAME面对反抗，会从喙吹出小气泡，再用额外的巨大双臂将其冻实，化为弹丸，用力投向敌人。
author: sk372
source: When POKENAME faces opposition, it blows small bubbles from its beak. Its large additional arms then freeze the bubbles solid, turning them into projectiles that it can then lob forcefully at its foe.

entry: 握住POKENAME刀刃的人，会觉得温暖迅速被吸走。它先用一连串浅切压倒猎物，再以精准、残酷的一击了结。
author: mepp.
source: Those who grasp one of POKENAME's blades will feel their warmth quickly siphoned away. POKENAME overwhelms its prey with a flurry of shallow cuts before finishing them off with a precise, brutal strike.

entry: POKENAME带倒钩的脚爪让它迅速奔过冰面。它冻结周围水分，增强斩击力量。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's barbed talons allow it to swiftly run across icy surfaces. It freezes the moisture around it to supplement the power of its slashes.

entry: POKENAME住在极寒湖泊深处，最爱独处。只有感知到心地善良、意志坚定的人，才会披着层层坚冰，伴随飞雪现身。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME live within the depths of arctic lakes, favoring solitude over anything else. It will emerge, clad in layers of solid ice and heralded by a flurry of snow, only when it senses a person with a kind heart and strong will.

entry: POKENAME身体冰冷，性情也冷酷。故事说，只有夺取其他生灵的热量，才能温暖冰心，缎带一触便能将其冻结。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has a frigid body and a cold-hearted demeanor. Stories about it say that the only thing that warms its frozen heart is the act of stealing heat from others, freezing them with just a touch of its ribbons.

entry: POKENAME是住在高层大气的凶狠宝可梦，据说只有发泄空洞怒火才会降下。冰冷身体几秒内冻结四周，任它肆虐，粉碎一切。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a vicious Pokémon residing in the upper atmosphere, said to descend from above only to vent its hollow rage. Its frigid body freezes the surrounding area solid within seconds, letting POKENAME shatter it all as it rampages.

entry: POKENAME冰冷的身体并非总能完全控制力量。时间能力可能向外脉冲般涌出，将周围生灵定在时间中，直到恢复控制。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's frigid body is not fully able to control its powers at all times. Its time-control abilities may surge and pulse outward, temporally freezing those around it until it regains control of itself.

entry: POKENAME形态极不稳定，难以显现在我们的次元。宝可梦研究者认为，它只能以不完整形态出现，无法真正离开原本的次元。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME has a very unstable form and struggles to manifest itself into our dimension. Pokémon researchers believe that POKENAME is only ever able to appear in an incomplete form, unable to truly leave its home dimension.

entry: POKENAME形态极不稳定，难以显现在我们的次元。宝可梦研究者认为，它只能以不完整形态出现，无法真正离开原本的次元。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME has a very unstable form and struggles to manifest itself into our dimension. Pokémon researchers believe that POKENAME is only ever able to appear in an incomplete form, unable to truly leave its home dimension.

entry: POKENAME全身覆盖寒冰，众多机关从不会因过热而停机。测试甚至显示，冷却让它能不断用炮发射高破坏光束，也不会疲倦。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's many mechanisms can never overheat and stop working thanks to the frigid ice that coats all over its body. Tests even show it can constantly launch highly destructive beams from its cannon without ever getting tired due to the cooling.

entry: POKENAME呈现了近似捷克罗姆与莱希拉姆的特征，获得少量火与电的能力。但使用片刻就会疲惫、烦躁。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has taken on characteristics similar to Zekrom and Reshiram, giving it a modicum of fire and electric capabilities. Using these powers leaves it exhausted and agitated after a short time, however.

entry: 保护POKENAME核心的冰极厚、极坚固，能抵御一切外部攻击。巨大的冰爪抓住什么，几秒内就能冻实。
author: sk372
source: The ice protecting POKENAME's core is incredibly thick and sturdy, resisting all external attacks. Anything it grips in its large icy claws will be frozen solid in seconds.

entry: POKENAME的幽灵手总想逃出身体，因此努力关紧棺门。开一点缝没有危险，但完全打开就会放出双手，抓住视野中的一切。
author: soup1900
source: With its ghostly hands always attempting to escape its body, POKENAME always tries to keep its coffin door closed. While small openings are harmless, completely opening the coffin will release the hands to grab all in sight.

entry: POKENAME的幽灵手总会无意识地抓敌人，因此它将其冻实，压制行动。一旦大开棺门，冰冻能量就会涌出，吞没一切。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's ghostly hands always mindlessly try to grab foes, so POKENAME keeps them frozen solid to contain them. Flinging its coffin door wide open causes freezing energy to rush out and swallow everything up.

entry: POKENAME头上有一根火焰形状的坚固冰刺。源自合众的传闻说，每当亲近的生灵去世，冰就会变得更大、更冷。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME have a durable ice spike on their head shaped like a flame. Rumors originating from Unova claim that the ice becomes larger and colder when someone close to POKENAME passes on.

entry: 体内翻涌着强大冰冻能量，泄漏时甚至冻住了自己的部分身体。被冰冷獠牙割伤，会感到大部分，甚至全部热量流失，伤口周围还可能结冰。
author: infinex21
source: Within itself roils powerful, freezing energy that has even frozen parts of its own body when said energy leaked out. Anything cut by its frigid tusks will feel most, if not all, warmth drain from them and may even see ice form around the wound.

entry: 这种庞大宝可梦偏爱寒山顶，却常因登山者把它误认成山而被迫迁居。有人推测，它或许诞生于失踪登山探险者的灵魂。
author: infinex21
source: This colossal Pokémon prefers to live atop cold mountains, though it is often forced to migrate due to mountain climbers mistaking it for a mountain. Some speculate it may actually have been born from the spirits of lost mountain explorers.

entry: POKENAME爱藏在雪堆，突袭毫无防备的人类与宝可梦。对方若不露出吃惊的样子，就会生气攻击。
author: mcnchsschl_69424
source: POKENAME likes to hide in snowbanks and ambush unsuspecting people and Pokémon. If they don't act surprised, it gets angry and attacks.

entry: POKENAME寻找能追随的英雄训练家，却很容易受骗。常被只在嘴上宣称未来理想蓝图的犬儒骗子蒙骗，为他们效力。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME search for heroic Trainers they can follow, but are very easy to deceive. They are frequently tricked into serving cynical liars that only claim to have an idealistic vision for the future.

entry: POKENAME住在冰山之巅。据说，若降临下方世界，就在警告即将到来的冬天会格外严酷。
author: mcnchsschl_69424
source: POKENAME lives at the peaks of icy mountains. When it descends to the world below, it is said to be a warning that the approaching winter will be especially harsh.

entry: 据说POKENAME来自宇宙最寒冷的深处，会寻找强敌，汲取对方的力量。
author: mistymagius
source: This Pokémon is said to come from the coldest depths of space. POKENAME seek powerful opponents to leech off their strength.

entry: POKENAME主要通过头部晶体引导冰与雷电的力量。即将释放哪种元素，眼睛就会呈现相应颜色。
author: sk372
source: The crystals on POKENAME's head are where it channels much of its ice and lightning powers. Its eyes change colors depending on which element it is about to unleash.

entry: POKENAME用小小身体附在其他生灵身上，通过咬击吸取静电。咬下、吸取时，会让人突然觉得寒意扫过全身。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME latches its tiny body onto others to drain static electricity via biting them. Its bites and the draining process cause a person to suddenly feel a chilling sensation wash over their whole body.

entry: POKENAME不喜光，待在洞里直到夜幕降临。夜间会冻结人类和宝可梦，带回洞中吃掉。
author: darkweavile428
source: POKENAME dislikes the light, and so will remain in its cave until nightfall. It spends the night freezing people and Pokémon so that it can take them to its cave to eat them.

entry: POKENAME住在洞窟深处，让冰自由蔓延。它用心灵感应说服登山男送来灯笼，好吞食光芒。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME resides deep in caves where its ice can spread freely. Using telepathy, POKENAME convinces Hikers to bring them lanterns so that they can devour the light.

entry: POKENAME潜伏在极寒水域深处的海床。冰壳除非加热，否则无法穿透，而它很讨厌太阳。
author: mcnchsschl_69424
source: POKENAME is found deep in arctic waters, lurking on the seafloor. Its icy shell is impenetrable unless it's heated up, and POKENAME hates the sun.

entry: POKENAME偏爱完全独居，任何冲突都不选边。仅仅一瞪，就能让敌人惊慌逃跑。猛烈暴风雪中似乎能彻底消失，仿佛从未存在。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME prefers to live a completely solitary life, and is not one to pick sides in any conflict. A mere stare is enough to make any foe flee in panic. They seemingly can completely vanish in a strong blizzard, as if they never existed.

entry: POKENAME的孢子冷得一碰就能冻住猎物。积累足够多后，会信心十足地引发巨大暴风雪，冻结领地内的一切。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's spores are cold enough to freeze prey on contact. If enough accumulate, it grows confident and triggers massive blizzards to freeze everything in its territory.

entry: POKENAME的冰鳞相碰，声如冰裂。自然脱落的鳞片永不融化，强行取下的却会瞬间化掉。
author: soup1900
source: When its ice scales clink together, they create a sound like cracking ice. Scales naturally shed by POKENAME will never melt, but scales forcefully taken will melt away in an instant.

entry: POKENAME在洞窟深处平静冥想。泄出的冰冻能量让洞壁结冰，甚至蔓延到洞外。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: POKENAME peacefully meditates deep in caves. Its freezing energy leaks out, causing ice to coat the cave walls and beyond.

entry: POKENAME从双手造出纯冰巨型手里剑，投出后能轻易切开砖砌建筑。手里剑高速旋转后产生浓厚寒雾，让它悄悄隐去。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME creates giant shurikens made of pure ice from its hands that can be thrown to slice through brick buildings with ease. After spinning around rapidly, the shurikens produce a thick, frosty mist that allows POKENAME to stealthily vanish away.

entry: POKENAME的冰常被误认为稀有、昂贵的钻石。由于不会融化，骗子便试着将冰制珠宝卖到数百万，受害者摸到假宝石才发现上当。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's ice is often mistaken for rare and expensive diamonds. As this ice doesn't melt, fraudsters try to sell jewelry made with this ice for millions, with the victims only realizing they've been scammed once they touch the fake gems.

entry: POKENAME游过之处留下冰晶，在水中拖出闪亮轨迹。即使在原生水域也稀少、难寻，是渔民珍视的渔获。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME leave a wake of ice crystals behind themselves as they swim, creating a sparkling trail in the water. They are rare and elusive even in their home waters and are a prized catch for fishermen.

entry: POKENAME拥有少量最初之龙的力量碎片，但受限的形态，连这点力量也几乎无法容纳或使用。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME has small fragments of the Original Dragon's power, but this limited form is hardly able to contain or use even these small fragments of power.

entry: POKENAME体内的冰冻能量，让脑袋始终冻得发痛。头痛又增强力量，形成不断加剧冻痛的正反馈循环。
author: bandedbodypress
source: The freezing energy in its body causes POKENAME to have an eternal brain freeze. The brain freeze heightens its power, making a positive feedback loop that only results in a worse brain freeze.

entry: 只有POKENAME深爱的训练家，才能安全骑上背，不必担心冻实。它极其忠诚，许多人相信，有信任的训练家相伴，就会感到完整。
author: sk372
source: Only POKENAME's beloved Trainer can safely ride upon its back without the risk of freezing solid. It is incredibly loyal, with many believing that having a trusted Trainer by its side makes POKENAME feel complete.

entry: 有人认为，POKENAME不战斗时感到残缺，因此性情好斗。尾巴看似蓝火，其实是冰，能集中喷出寒雾，将对手冻实。
author: sk372
source: Some suggest POKENAME's aggressive tendencies is due to it feeling incomplete outside of combat. What looks like blue fire on its tail is actually ice, able to generate a concentrated burst of cold mist that freezes an opponent solid.

entry: POKENAME一半触手带强毒，另一半则能将被刺中的生灵冻结。头部花纹在一些作品中被用作平衡的象征，尤其是内在平衡。
author: sk372
source: Half of POKENAME's tentacles possess potent toxins, while the others have the capacity to freeze those stung by them. The markings on its head have been used in some media as a symbol of balance, particularly within oneself.

entry: POKENAME寻找维护世界平衡的人，只允许极少数获选者骑背。谁想强行骑上去，就会被冰焰烧伤。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME only allow a select few people to ride upon their back because they search for people who uphold the balance of the world. Their icy flames burn anyone who tries to force themselves onto their back.

entry: POKENAME从炮中高速射出剃刀般锋利的冰柱。研究者发现，冰壳比钻石还硬。
author: mcnchsschl_69424
source: POKENAME shoots razor-sharp icicles at incredible speeds from its cannons. Researchers have discovered that its icy shell is harder than diamond.

entry: POKENAME的根与花瓣都有致幻作用，能扰乱对手。花瓣经过蒸馏后，却能制成药物或令人放松的茶饮。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's roots and petals have psychedelic properties that it uses to disorient its opponents. However, the petals can be distilled to create medicine or a relaxing tea.

entry: 刚发现POKENAME时，人们以为递出手中花朵是友善示意。其实那是警告，接下来花中就会伸出带刺藤蔓，挥打攻击。
author: sk372
source: When POKENAME was first discovered, it was assumed the gesture of presenting its held flowers was a sign of friendliness. It's actually a warning gesture, done before thorny vines extend from the flowers and lash out.

entry: POKENAME产生浓烈花香，让吸入者沉醉于毫无戒备的幸福。许多邪恶组织靠它让气体充满房间，再戴面罩，抢劫人们。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME produce a potent flowery scent that lulls whoever inhales the aroma into complacent bliss. Many villainous organizations rely on POKENAME saturating a room full of this gas before putting on a mask and robbing people.

entry: POKENAME的花覆盖薄薄丝层，帮助保存。神奥花商偶尔会剪去刺、彻底洗净毒素，用来制作婚礼花束。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME's flowers are coated in a thin layer of silk, which helps to keep them preserved. Florists in Sinnoh will occasionally use these flowers for wedding bouquets after the thorns are pruned and the poison is thoroughly washed away.

entry: 在森林边缘的城市，许多POKENAME组成亲子搭档，打击犯罪。它们对抗火箭队、偷猎者等敌人，要为野生宝可梦夺回森林。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Many POKENAME act as crime-fighting duos of parent and child in cities that border forests. They seek to fight back against foes like Team Rocket and poachers to reclaim the forest for wild Pokémon.

entry: 虽然POKENAME小巧、好看，却是狡猾凶悍的猎手。它等待小生灵到河边喝水，再伸出带刺藤蔓抓住，拖进水下。
author: sk372
