source: Despite its small stature and pleasant look, POKENAME is a devious and aggressive hunter. It waits for small creatures to try and drink from the river, before extending out thorny vines that grapple them and drag them beneath the water.

entry: POKENAME的花在水中也会散发怡人香气。其他宝可梦游近探看时，它便甩出尾中藏着的长鞭袭击。
author: glacierwing
source: POKENAME's flowers emit a pleasing scent underwater. When other Pokémon swim over to check them, it lashes out with the hidden whips in its tail.

entry: POKENAME中央那颗发光的红色宝石才是真身。它用精神力量修整、塑造开花灌木，形成奇怪造型，原因不明。
author: t3isukone
source: The glowing red gem at a center of a POKENAME is its true body. It uses psychic power to sculpt and prune its flowering bushes into strange shapes for unknown reasons.

entry: POKENAME爱用镰刀劈砍，击败无礼、傲慢的对手。伤口虽然很快愈合，只要受害者闻到它的玫瑰香，就会再次裂开。
author: epping_forest
source: It loves defeating disrespectful and arrogant opponents, slashing them with its scythes. Though the wounds heal quickly, they will reopen when the victim smells the scent of POKENAME's roses.

entry: POKENAME穿着鲜艳长花裙，衬出出色舞技。它顺滑地扭动腰胯吸引目光，与附近任何音乐的节奏配合。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME wears long, floral dresses that vibrantly accentuate its dancing prowess. It draws attention to itself using the smooth gyration of its hips, which matches the rhythm of any music played nearby.

entry: POKENAME穿着引人遐想的裙子，诱人跳舞。一旦开始，空气中的花粉就会迫使他们不停跳，直到精疲力竭。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME wear provocative dresses to lure people into a dance. Once people start to dance, the pollen in the air compels them to keep dancing until they are exhausted.

entry: POKENAME穿着引人遐想的裙子，诱人跳舞。双腿特别长，能迅速移步，拦住想逃跑的人。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME wear provocative dresses to lure people into a dance. Their legs are particularly long, which allows them to block people from escaping with a swift maneuver.

entry: POKENAME体态丰腴，随着身边任何音乐有节奏地舞动。迷人的外貌让它更容易邀人共舞。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have voluptuous bodies that rhythmically dance to whatever music is around them. Their alluring appearance helps them encourage other people into dancing.

entry: POKENAME用令人兴奋的花粉，引人一同跳舞。兴奋感迫使人们不停舞动，直到精疲力竭。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME draw other people into dancing with them through the use of a stimulating pollen. The excitement that people feel compels them to dance until they are exhausted.

entry: 建筑完工时，人们会用POKENAME营造花园。它冲过地面，将土压平，毛中的特殊种子一碰土便发芽。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME are used to create gardens at the end of the construction process. They flatten the ground as they charge across it, and special seeds from their pelt germinate as soon as they touch the soil.

entry: POKENAME身上的玫瑰让它很难游泳。虽然动作慢、容易抓，却会分泌多数捕食者难以忍受的苦味毒素。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME struggles to swim due to the roses that grow on its body. Although POKENAME is slow-moving and easy to catch, it secretes a bitter-tasting poison that most predators cannot tolerate.

entry: POKENAME伪装成花朵，引诱小型猎物靠近，再用翅膀上微小纤毛分泌的黏性毒素发动攻击。
author: holgast
source: POKENAME lure smaller prey by mimicking flowers, then strike by secreting a sticky toxin from tiny cilia on their wings.

entry: POKENAME伪装成花朵，引诱小型猎物靠近，再用翅膀上微小纤毛分泌的黏性毒素发动攻击。
author: holgast
source: POKENAME lure smaller prey by mimicking flowers, then strike by secreting a sticky toxin from tiny cilia on their wings.

entry: POKENAME烦躁时，野玫瑰会沿海岸失控生长。大量植物排开海水，使它肆虐时对海洋栖息地造成毁灭性影响。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: When POKENAME is agitated, wild roses grow uncontrollably along the coastline. Because the massive plant growth displaces seawater, POKENAME's rampages can have devastating effects on marine habitats.

entry: POKENAME壳上的花由世界各地的人们种下。每年迁徙途经许多地方，让许多人有机会为壳上的花束添花。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME grows flowers on its shell, which are planted there by people from across the world. It visits many places during its yearly migration, so many people have the opportunity to contribute to the bouquet on its shell.

entry: POKENAME是史前便受畏惧的古老捕食者。末端带玫瑰的镰刀涂着麻痹毒素，让猎物瞬间无法行动。
author: ambrosia04
source: Feared during the prehistoric period, POKENAME are ancient predators. Their rose-tipped scythes are coated with a paralyzing poison to instantly immobilize prey.

entry: POKENAME吃饱后，白天大多时间都在睡，除非直接受到攻击，否则对什么都不感兴趣。战斗时，用身体冲撞对手，岩刺注入麻痹毒素。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME spend most of the day sleeping after finding enough to eat, acting entirely disinterested in anything else unless actively attacked. During battle, they ram opponents with their body to deliver a paralyzing poison from their rocky spikes.

entry: 据说POKENAME的蜂蜜香气美妙，常受贵族训练家喜爱。它相当高尚，会用长枪般的刺针保护弱小虫宝可梦。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME honey is said to be beautifully aromatic and is often enjoyed by aristocratic Trainers. It is quite a noble Pokémon, protecting weaker Bug Pokémon using its lance-like stingers.

entry: POKENAME的尾巴闪着能促进花卉生长、抑制杂草的粉末。飞行时不断洒落，让田野与森林繁茂、开花。
author: oddwalls
source: POKENAME's tail glimmers with a powder that promotes floral growth and stifles weeds. POKENAME sheds the powder as it flies, causing fields and forests to flourish and bloom.

entry: POKENAME既产生超热蓝焰，也产生温度较低的红焰，因此能控制对手燃烧的快慢。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME generates both super-hot blue flames and less-hot red flames, allowing it to control how quickly its opponent burns.

entry: POKENAME双臂缠绕的刺藤能松开、伸长，抓住并勒紧猎物。一旦缠住受害者，就迅速扑上，以强颚施加粉碎性的带毒咬击。
author: sk372
source: The thorny vines wrapped around POKENAME's arms can loosen and extend out to grab and constrict prey. Once it ensnares a victim, it pounces quickly and delivers a crushing and venomous bite with its powerful jaws.

entry: POKENAME长久以来，以潇洒外表与气度闻名。园丁常借助它的利爪，替代园艺叉、剪刀等工具。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME has long been renowned for its dashing appearance and attitude. Gardeners often use it for its sharp claws, which can replace tools like gardening forks and shears.

entry: 据说，POKENAME喜欢在花田上方跳舞。释放的甜香似乎能吸引虫属性宝可梦，也帮助植物生长。
author: jodue
source: It is said that POKENAME likes to dance over fields of flowers. It releases a sweet aroma which seems to attract Bug-type Pokémon and help plants grow.

entry: POKENAME似乎同时靠月光与阳光滋养。虽然稀少、难觅踪迹，日食时却会成群聚集，在昏光中跳舞。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME seem to be nourished by both moonlight and sunlight. Although rare and elusive, groups of them gather together during solar eclipses to dance in the dim light.

entry: POKENAME把花缝进自己长出的叶片。层层鲜艳翠叶，构成美丽的花卉展示。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME sews flowers into the leaves it grows. Its layers of vibrant emerald leaves create a beautiful display of flora.

entry: POKENAME住在清水环绕的青翠草甸。花里藏着刺，涂有强烈毒素。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME lives in verdant meadows surrounded by clean water. Its flowers hide thorns that are coated in a potent toxin.

entry: POKENAME成为一家香水厂商的吉祥物后，受到老一辈绅士欢迎。至今仍偶尔能看见长者与它一起，随摇摆乐练习整齐同步的舞蹈。
author: ocxin
source: POKENAME became popular with gentlemen of an older generation after they became the mascot of a perfume producer. To this day, one can sometimes see old folks practicing synchronized dance routines to swing music with them.

entry: POKENAME很紧张，只有在小型大针蜂融合体或狩猎凤蝶融合体身边才放松警惕。研究者必须涂花香香水，安静扎营数日，只为拍一张照片。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME is a nervous Pokémon and only lets its guard down around small Beedrill and Beautifly fusions. Researchers have to camp for days in silence while wearing floral perfume, just for one picture.

entry: POKENAME体内制成的树果汁，有鲜明、清新的花香。谁想抢树果，壳里就会伸出刺藤，驱赶对方。
author: sk372
source: Berry juice made from POKENAME's body has a decidedly fresh floral scent to it. Thorny vines extend from within its shell to fend off those that would try to take berries from it.

entry: POKENAME的花带着好闻的泥土气息，强弱取决于水中矿物质含量。含量高时，花香便像雨后的泥土。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME blooms have a pleasant, earthy aroma that varies in intensity depending on how high the mineral content of their water is. High mineral content results in their flowers having a smell reminiscent of petrichor.

entry: POKENAME高飞花田上空，保护花朵免遭入侵。拍动双翼，就能向敌人洒下剃刀般锋利的花瓣。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME soar high above fields of flowers, protecting them from invaders. By flapping their wings, they shower their opponents in razor-sharp petals.

entry: POKENAME用尾上花朵结出的果实调制颜料，既能作画，也用来标记领地。
author: melodydelune
source: Using the fruit produced by the flower on its tail, POKENAME will produce the ink it uses to paint. It marks its territory with this paint.

entry: 有的POKENAME尾花是蓝色，有的是红色。花色相同的个体，往往更能相处融洽。
author: kittyluv090
source: Some POKENAME have blue flowers on their tail, while others have red. Individuals with the same color flowers are more likely to get along.

entry: POKENAME爱向附近一切炫耀花朵，每朵的香气都奇妙地类似不同奶油。谁拿走花束，就会遭到追赶、践踏，直到归还才罢休。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME loves to flaunt its flowers to anything near it, the scent of each flower smelling oddly similar to types of cream. If anything takes its bouquet, it'll rush them down and trample them, not stopping until its bouquet is returned.

entry: 野外只发现过极少数这种宝可梦，每只都躺在美丽花田。任何靠得太近的对象，都会遇上它藏着的长藤，上面满是毒刺。
author: infinex21
source: Few of these Pokémon have been found in the wild and they were each found lying in a beautiful field of flowers. Any who drew too near to their flower fields were met with their hidden, long vines clad in many poisonous thorns.

entry: POKENAME被欢乐聚会吸引，许多庆典也为它的魅力、美丽而举办。每次振翅，都会散下少量漂亮花瓣。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is attracted to joyful gatherings, and many festivals are held in honor of its charisma and beauty. It spreads a smattering of beautiful flower petals from its wings with every flap.

entry: 深夜遇上POKENAME，很快就会中了可怕诅咒。受害者虚弱、毫无反抗能力，让它有机可乘，用带刺触须攻击。
author: mepp.
source: Those who come across POKENAME in the dark of night quickly fall under its terrible curse. Once afflicted, the victim is enervated and rendered completely helpless. This gives POKENAME the chance to strike with its thorny tendrils.

entry: POKENAME骑着枯萎花茎飞行，所经之处，干花瓣纷飞。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME flies through the air on a wilted flower stalk, creating a flurry of dried petals wherever it goes.

entry: POKENAME用吸收的太阳能供电，产生磁场悬浮。由于没有根，会向下发射光束，将沙土拉向自己，有时还会瞄准地面属性宝可梦。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME levitates using a magnetic field it generates, powered by the sunlight it absorbs. Since it lacks roots, it will fire down beams to pull sand and soil up towards it, sometimes targeting Ground-type Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME栖息在三蜜蜂常住的蜜树上，用花粉与蜂群交换美味的蜂蜜。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME make their homes in honey trees, where Combee typically reside. The Pokémon then share their pollen with the hive in exchange for their delicious honey.

entry: POKENAME全身覆盖草般的毛，眼边尤其浓密。种子与带钩刺果常缠在毛里，多数会掉落，有些却找到理想条件，直接在身上扎根、生长，甚至开花。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Grass-like fur covers POKENAME, growing especially thick around its eyes. Seeds and burrs often get tangled in the fur and whilst most fall off, some find the perfect conditions to take root, letting them grow and even bloom right on POKENAME's body.

entry: POKENAME全身覆盖草般的毛，眼边尤其浓密。种子与带钩刺果常缠在毛里，多数会掉落，有些却找到理想条件，直接在身上扎根、生长，甚至开花。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Grass-like fur covers POKENAME, growing especially thick around its eyes. Seeds and burrs often get tangled in the fur and whilst most fall off, some find the perfect conditions to take root, letting them grow and even bloom right on POKENAME's body.

entry: POKENAME全身覆盖草般的毛，眼边尤其浓密。种子与带钩刺果常缠在毛里，多数会掉落，有些却找到理想条件，直接在身上扎根、生长，甚至开花。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Grass-like fur covers POKENAME, growing especially thick around its eyes. Seeds and burrs often get tangled in the fur and whilst most fall off, some find the perfect conditions to take root, letting them grow and even bloom right on POKENAME's body.

entry: 尾巴上的蓝玫瑰散出醉人香气，诱来猎物，再用钳子迅速了结。战斗时，带刺尾巴像鞭子般抽打敌人，每根刺也都藏毒。
author: infinex21
source: The blue rose upon its tail emits an intoxicating aroma that it uses to lure in prey, which it will swiftly finish off using its pincers. During battle, it uses its thorny tail to lash at foes like a whip, though each thorn also contains poison.

entry: POKENAME奇特的身体像三束朝内的花。进入战斗模式时，肢体向外旋转，花束能射出大量布满利刺的数字藤蔓。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's oddly shaped body resembles three floral bouquets pointed inward. Its limbs rotate to point outward when initiating its combat mode, the bouquets able to launch a myriad of digital vines covered with sharp thorns.

entry: POKENAME栖息在三蜜蜂常住的蜜树上，用花粉与蜂群交换美味的蜂蜜。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME make their homes in honey trees, where Combee typically reside. The Pokémon then share their pollen with the hive in exchange for their delicious honey.

entry: POKENAME背上有锋利叶状棘针，受威胁时会大声沙沙作响。它以彩花作手，先用独特玫瑰香毒素削弱敌人，再以尖刺自卫。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME has sharp, leaf-like quills on its back that rustle loudly when it feels threatened. It wields colorful flowers as hands, using their distinct, rose-scented toxins to weaken foes before defending itself with its spikes.

entry: POKENAME用腕部刺藤伤害、缠住对手。限制行动后，就以强力回旋踢的猛烈一击结束战斗。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME use the thorn-covered vines on their wrists to damage and ensnare an opponent. Once restrained, POKENAME will finish the fight with a mighty blow from their powerful round-house kick.

entry: 极少能看见POKENAME走路，只有感到完全安全、平静时才会如此。平时浮在地面上方，随时准备逃走，只留下令人昏沉的梦幻香气。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: To see a POKENAME walking is incredibly rare, as it only does so when it feels completely safe and at peace. Usually, it floats above the ground, ready to flee at a moment's notice, leaving only a dreamy aroma that brings on lethargy.

entry: 极少能看见POKENAME出神沉思，只有感到完全安全、平静时才会如此。平时浮在地面上方，随时准备逃走，只留下令人昏沉的梦幻香气。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: To see a POKENAME looking lost in thought is rare, as it only does so when it feels completely safe and at peace. Usually, it floats above the ground, ready to flee at a moment's notice, leaving only a dreamy aroma that brings on lethargy.

entry: 极少能看见POKENAME走路，只有感到完全安全、平静时才会如此。平时从地面上方滑过，随时准备逃走，只留下令人昏沉的梦幻香气。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: To see a POKENAME walking is incredibly rare, as it only does so when it feels completely safe and at peace. Usually, it glides above the ground, ready to flee at a moment's notice, leaving only a dreamy aroma that brings on lethargy.

entry: 极少能看见POKENAME走路，只有感到完全安全、平静时才会如此。平时浮在地面上方，随时准备逃走，只留下一片彩色花瓣，捡起就会令人昏沉。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: To see a POKENAME walking is incredibly rare, as it only does so when it feels completely safe and at peace. Usually, it floats above the ground, ready to flee at a moment's notice, leaving only a colourful petal that brings on lethargy if picked up.

entry: POKENAME是森林守护者，常用雾笼罩领地，保护弱小妖精宝可梦免遭伤害。任何愚蠢到靠近领地的训练家，都会迎来魔法叶。
author: cobalt0135
source: POKENAME are forest guardians who often enshroud their territory in mist to protect weak fairy Pokémon from those that seek to harm them. Any Trainer foolish enough to approach their territory will be met with a Magical Leaf.

entry: 极少能看见POKENAME走路，只有相信世界和平时才会如此。平时浮在地面上方，随时准备逃走，只留下令人昏沉的梦幻香气。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: To see a POKENAME walking is incredibly rare, as it only does so when it believes the world is at peace. Usually, it floats above the ground, ready to flee at a moment's notice, leaving only a dreamy aroma that brings on lethargy.

entry: 多数POKENAME战斗时如舞者般优雅，始终交替使用刀臂攻击，灵巧躲过敌人攻势。每次挥刀，都会在四周散下美丽玫瑰花瓣。
author: infinex21
source: Most POKENAME fight with the grace of dancers, always alternating which blade arm they attack with while deftly dodging their foes' attacks. Each swing of their blades scatters beautiful rose petals around them.

entry: POKENAME用头顶紫花释放舒缓香气，分散敌人注意，锋利绿刺保护后方。趁对方分心，迅速上前，以手中花朵的刺攻击。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME uses its overhead purple bloom to release a soothing aroma, distracting enemies while its sharp green quills protect its rear. When the enemies are distracted, it advances rapidly to strike them with the thorns on the flowers in their hands.

entry: POKENAME在森林附近的河流筑坝，用强力门牙收集建材。花香用于交流，花瓣中的毒花粉则能释放，让敌人中毒。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME build dams in rivers near forests where they gather building materials with their strong incisors. They use the scent of their flowers to communicate with each other and can also release the toxic pollen in their petals to poison foes.

entry: 谁触碰楔石，POKENAME就用猛烈的玫瑰花瓣与尖刺风暴压倒对方。浓烈花香一英里外也能闻见。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME overwhelms anyone who touches its keystone with devastating storms of rose petals and thorns. It gives off an intense floral scent that can be detected from a mile away.

entry: POKENAME背上的巨大玫瑰散出可爱香气，让人幸福陶然。这种香味被加入蜡烛、肥皂、洗发水等许多产品。
author: mepp.
source: The huge rose on the back of POKENAME produces a lovely aroma that promotes blissful feelings. This fragrance is added to many products such as candles, soaps, and shampoos.

entry: 后脑的嘴最初很小，日后却能长得比房屋更高。人们相信，以血为食会长得更快，其中人血的效果最显著。
author: hophoppip
source: The mouth on the back of its head starts out small, but can grow taller than a house over time. It's believed to grow faster when it's fed a diet of blood, with human blood having the most profound effect.

entry: 发现的洞窟壁画描绘POKENAME攻击一切靠近草甸家园的对象。它喷出浓厚粉色花粉，足以让敌人中毒。
author: .izik
source: Cave paintings have been found depicting POKENAME attacking anyone who approached its meadow home. It unleashes thick bursts of pink pollen capable of poisoning its foes.

entry: POKENAME战斗时将粗根扎进地面，几乎无法撼动。平时多半静止，让其他宝可梦为美丽的花授粉。
author: mistymagius
source: In combat, POKENAME will dig its thick roots into the ground, making it almost immovable. It spends most of its time stationary, letting other Pokémon pollinate its gorgeous flowers.

entry: POKENAME大多时间躺着，用甜美花香引来其他宝可梦，刻意装得无害。猎物一靠近，就用布满利刺的鞭子抓住。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME spends most of its time lying down, luring in other Pokémon with the sweet smell of its flowers and deliberately appearing harmless. Once prey gets close, POKENAME will grab it with a whip lined with sharp thorns.

entry: POKENAME大多时间躺在自己造出的玫瑰床上。厚毛保护身体，不受尖刺伤害。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME spends most of its time lying down on a bed of roses it creates. Its thick fur protects it from being hurt by their sharp thorns.

entry: 身上许多玫瑰在休息时吸取自己的养分，因此活动时必须大吃特吃。幸好，玫瑰香能引来大量猎物。
author: infinex21
source: The many roses that grow upon its body feed off its own nutrients while it rests, which means it must gorge itself when it is active. Thankfully, the aroma of its roses lure in plenty of prey.

entry: 野生POKENAME在花田起舞，四处散下众多花瓣。身上的花与花粉，常吸引许多虫属性宝可梦。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME dance about in fields of flowers, scattering their many petals about. Many Bug-type Pokémon are often drawn to them due to the many flowers growing on their bodies and the pollen they contain.

entry: POKENAME不知疲倦地优雅舞过草甸，额头散出仿佛无穷无尽的花粉。但大多不育，无法给花授粉。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME elegantly and tirelessly dances across meadows while a seemingly endless stream of pollen radiates from its forehead. Most of the pollen, however, is sterile and thus unable to pollinate flowers.

entry: POKENAME常在花开草甸，为野生宝可梦举办盛大聚会。虽然待客亲切、优雅，却绝不拒绝挑战，以维护荣誉、磨炼战技。
author: sneakywalrus0
source: POKENAME often hosts lavish gatherings for wild Pokémon in flowery meadows. While it seems to be personable and refined at these events, it will never turn down a challenge to defend its honour and hone its fighting skills.

entry: POKENAME如王者般统治美丽草甸与繁茂丛林。它免疫多数有害毒素和孢子，保护家园，驱赶不受欢迎的入侵者，也要求受保护者绝对服从。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME rules over beautiful meadows and flourishing jungles like royalty. Immune to most harmful toxins and spores, it defends its habitat from unwanted intruders. It expects total obedience from those under its protection.

entry: POKENAME很挑剔，只出现在繁花盛开之地，滋养自身玫瑰茂盛生长。过去常被赠给爱人，却只要闻见一丝异味，就会抛弃收礼者。
author: icelevelincarnate
source: POKENAME are picky and will only appear in places where many flowers bloom to support the abundant growth of their own roses. Gifting a POKENAME to a lover used to be common, but POKENAME will abandon their recipient at the slightest odor.

entry: 这些宝可梦伪装成武器，供人类或少数具备理性的宝可梦使用。POKENAME分泌非致命的神经毒素，让使用者以为“剑”与自己绑定，浑然不知生命力正被吸走。
author: infinex21
source: These Pokémon hide themselves as weapons for humans, or some few sapient Pokémon, to use. A POKENAME secretes a non-deadly neurotoxin that makes one imagine the "sword" is bound to them, leaving them unaware that it is siphoning their life force.

entry: POKENAME常见于森林中荆棘最密的灌木。它独来独往，花数小时大力练习剑舞，因此有人推测，是重获新生的古代战士。
author: analogueshadows
source: POKENAME are commonly found among the thorniest bushes of the forest. Known to be solitary, they'll spend hours vigorously practicing their Swords Dance. As a result, some speculate that they're ancient warriors who've been granted new lives.

entry: POKENAME兼具观赏植物造型与安保功能，透视视力和麻痹毒液让富人十分喜爱。光合作用为这些能力供能，因此它睡在阳光下，直到夜间巡游。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is popular among the affluent as a combination of decorative topiary and security system, thanks to its x-ray vision and paralytic venom. Photosynthesis refuels these abilities, so it slumbers in sunny patches until its nighttime prowl.

entry: POKENAME兼具观赏植物造型与安保功能，透视视力和麻痹毒液让富人十分喜爱。光合作用为这些能力供能，因此它睡在阳光下，直到夜间巡游。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is popular among the affluent as a combination of decorative topiary and security system, thanks to its x-ray vision and paralytic venom. Photosynthesis refuels these abilities, so it slumbers in sunny patches until its nighttime prowl.

entry: POKENAME住在森林，难觅踪迹，回避所有生灵，只有必要才战斗。哪怕只将它的一朵玫瑰送人，也被视为极深爱意与敬意。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are elusive, forest-dwelling Pokémon that avoid all others and only fight if necessary. Even just a single rose from a POKENAME is considered a sign of immense love and respect when given as a gift to another.

entry: 这些宝可梦常守护田野与森林，用带刺藤鞭远攻敌人。鞭子含神经毒素，迅速以各种幻觉扭曲受害者眼中的现实。
author: infinex21
source: These Pokémon often serve as protectors of fields and forests, wielding a thorn-clad vine as a whip to assail foes from afar. Their whips contain a neurotoxin that quickly distorts the reality of the afflicted with all manner of hallucinations.

entry: 野生POKENAME照料自己的花园，有时也照顾其他物种的幼小宝可梦。谁威胁花园或家人，就会遭刺鞭反击。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME tend to their own gardens of flowers and may even tend to young Pokémon of other species as well. Those who threaten either their gardens or their families will be met with their thorn-clad whips.

entry: POKENAME避开强光，只在夜间活动。据说，闻到花朵独特香气，会睡得不安稳。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME shies away from bright sunlight and is only active at night. Those who smell the peculiar scent of POKENAME's flowers are said to suffer restless sleep.

entry: 有时能看见POKENAME帮助花商插花。虽然对花兴趣浓厚，却似乎对招待顾客毫无兴趣，经常直接把花束扔向人们。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME can sometimes be found assisting florists with their flower arrangements. Though they have a keen interest in flowers, they seem to be very uninterested in customer service, often simply throwing bouquets at people.

entry: 有时能看见POKENAME帮助花商插花。虽然对花兴趣浓厚，却似乎对招待顾客毫无兴趣，经常直接把花束扔向人们。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME can sometimes be found assisting florists with their flower arrangements. Though they have a keen interest in flowers, they seem to be very uninterested in customer service, often simply throwing bouquets at people.

entry: 有时能看见POKENAME帮助花商插花。虽然对花兴趣浓厚，却似乎对招待顾客毫无兴趣，经常直接用炮向人们发射花束。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME can sometimes be found assisting florists with their flower arrangements. Though they have a keen interest in flowers, they seem to be very uninterested in customer service, often simply firing bouquets at them from their cannon.

entry: POKENAME暴怒时，会让玫瑰燃起灿烂火焰，使甜美花香更加浓烈。几周内，花就能重新长回。
author: chibitales
source: When enraged, POKENAME sets its roses ablaze in brilliant fire, which intensifies the sweet smell produced by the flowers. POKENAME are able to regrow these flowers within a few weeks.

entry: 满月之夜，POKENAME大量聚集，在月光下跳舞。许多个体将玫瑰中藏的藤蔓连在一起，嬉戏起舞，景象被形容为令人沉醉。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME gathers en masse during nights of the full moon, dancing beneath the moonlight. The sight of many POKENAME linking the vines hidden in their roses and cavorting about has been described as truly captivating.

entry: 谁想摘下POKENAME的面具，很快就会被利刺扎穿。它真正隐姓埋名，不愿任何人看见真脸。
author: mcnchsschl
source: Anyone who tries to take off the mask of a POKENAME will find themselves swiftly pierced by its sharp thorns. Truly anonymous, this Pokémon does not want anyone to see its real face.

entry: POKENAME在体育比赛场边加油，却输不起。一段热门视频中，它突然跳进篮球赛，帮助支持的队伍取胜。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME cheerleads from the sidelines during sports competitions, though they don't take defeats well. One popular video shows POKENAME suddenly leaping into a basketball game to help its team win.

entry: POKENAME精通战斗，用弹性肢体远远敲打对手。花产生的毒花粉，浓度足够高就能引发幻觉。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is an expert in combat, using its elastic limbs to bludgeon its opponent from afar. Its flowers produce a toxic pollen that can cause hallucinations in high enough concentrations.

entry: POKENAME用美丽花朵引诱猎物。一旦接触花瓣便会中毒，迅速死去。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: POKENAME lures in its prey with its beautiful flowers. Upon contact, these petals induce poison, swiftly killing the prey.

entry: 长时间铺展藤蔓后，它能以电脉冲控制小型电网，同时吸取流入的电力为食。
author: regicider.
source: By spreading its vines over long periods of time, it can use pulses of electricity to control a small power grid while feeding on the incoming power.

entry: POKENAME以任何花都比不上的奇香引诱猎物。人们试图收集香气制成香水，但至今所有成品相比真品，都显得刺鼻、人工味重。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME lures in prey with an extraordinary fragrance unlike any other flower. People have tried to capture the scent to turn it into perfume, but all attempts so far smell harsh and artificial when compared to the real thing.

entry: POKENAME假扮成玻璃箱中沉睡的宝可梦，像在葬礼上供人瞻仰。好奇猎物靠得太近，就伸出刺手，捆住、勒紧。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME poses as a sleeping Pokémon in a glass case, as if it's being presented at a funeral. When curious prey gets too close, POKENAME strikes with its thorny hands to bind and constrict.

entry: POKENAME用长藤攀墙移动。常在丛林深处休眠，入侵者拨弄球茎，就会醒来，充满敌意。
author: actliux
source: POKENAME cling to walls with their long vines to move. Often found hibernating deep within jungles, they become active and hostile when an intruder tampers with their bulb.

entry: POKENAME以虚荣闻名，白天许多时间都在打理自己。它玩弄猎物，先以连番火焰与毒素削弱，再施最后一击。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME is known for its vain attitude, spending much of the day grooming itself. It toys with prey, weakening them with a barrage of fire and poison before delivering the final strike.

entry: POKENAME从双翼散下两种花瓣。红色产生热量，能瞬间加快植物生长；蓝色则含致命毒素，让受害者缓慢、痛苦地走向死亡。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME scatters two different types of petals from its wings. The red ones produce heat and can instantly accelerate plant growth. The blue ones have fatal poison in them that causes a slow and painful end.

entry: POKENAME以超过喷气飞机的速度飞过天空，留下芳香花瓣，沿途如雨飘落。
author: t3isukone
source: Soaring through the sky at speeds higher than a jet plane, POKENAME leaves behind a trail of fragrant petals that fall like rain where it passes.

entry: POKENAME尾巴的光合作用极强，甚至能借太阳之力释放火焰。此时，它还会散发出异常浓烈的气味。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME can photosynthesize through its tail to such an extent that it can harness the power of the sun and unleash fire. In doing so, it emits an unusually intense scent.

entry: 它常悬在空中，一动不动，刺藤扎入附近地面吸取养分。紫色核心一发光，就表示即将活动，巡视领地、搜寻入侵者。
author: infinex21
source: It often rests entirely immobile while suspended in the air with its thorny vines anchored into nearby terrain to leech nutrients for itself. When its purple core glows, it is about to become active and will scout its territory for any intruders.

entry: POKENAME表现得冷淡、漠不关心，以不起眼的外貌和甜香吸引猎物。猎物宝可梦靠近，就会爆发带电、麻痹性的花粉。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME act aloof and disinterested, attracting their prey with their unassuming appearance and sweet aroma. When their prey Pokémon get close, POKENAME erupt with paralyzing, electric pollen.

entry: POKENAME一唱歌就忍不住跳舞，散出的粉末让观众沉睡。发现观众的状况后，它常会十分懊恼。
author: badtothebow
source: POKENAME cannot help but dance when it sings, causing powders to be expelled that lull onlookers into a deep sleep. It is often upset when it realizes the state of its audience.

entry: POKENAME父母与其他宝可梦战斗时，常将幼小个体交给巨蔓藤照料。巨蔓藤会用藤缠住它们，免得鲁莽涉险。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: Young POKENAME are often entrusted to Tangrowth while their parents battle other Pokémon. Tangrowth may wrap its vines around POKENAME's body to stop them from recklessly endangering themselves.

entry: POKENAME的爪子释放独特电压，让下方土中长出特殊花朵。它以花为家、为防御，从内部操纵带有自身电力的刺藤。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's claws emit a very unique voltage that causes special flowers to grow from the soil beneath it. It uses these flowers for a home and defense, controlling thorny vines from within that are charged with its own electricity.

entry: POKENAME的玫瑰里藏着一根利刺，作为武器。它高贵、讲荣誉，会挑战同类决斗，证明谁更优秀。
author: mistymagius
source: Inside its roses hides a single sharp thorn, which it uses as a weapon. It is a noble and honorable Pokémon, challenging other POKENAME to duels to prove who is superior.

entry: POKENAME守护花田，冲撞采花太多的人。不过，对待宾客，会引导他们前往花田最美之处。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME will guard flower fields, charging anyone who picks too many flowers. However, it will lead guests to the most beautiful parts of its field.

entry: POKENAME花束中伸出的藤蔓，无论刺到哪里，都能让植物生长，连金属表面也不例外。长出的花带有独特的金属、人工气味。
author: sk372
source: The vines that emerge from POKENAME's bouquets can cause flora to grow wherever they puncture, even including metal surfaces. The flowers that grow have a uniquely metallic and artificial scent to them.

entry: POKENAME发射玫瑰般的导弹，耀眼地攻击对手。美丽攻势常让敌人完全看呆。
author: coridiant
source: POKENAME attacks opponents with a dazzling display of rose-like missiles. The beauty of these attacks often leaves its enemies utterly entranced.

entry: POKENAME头上彩色叶褶藏着自卫用刺藤。它从头部植物洒下花粉，在身后形成闪亮、鲜艳的极光。
author: sk372
source: The colorful, leafy frills on POKENAME's head hide thorny vines it can use for self-defense. It creates a shimmering and vibrant aurora behind it by shedding pollen from its cranial plants.

entry: POKENAME奔跑时，身后洒下一路芳香花瓣。常在婚礼上担任捧花者。
author: mistymagius
source: As they run, they spread a trail of beautifully scented flower petals behind them. POKENAME can commonly be found at weddings, acting as flower bearers.

entry: 石头身体完全包裹在美丽叶片与芳香玫瑰中，香味帮助标记领地边界。虽然外貌温和，只要视作威胁，就会毫不犹豫地咬下去。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its stone body is completely covered with a beautiful mantle of leaves and fragrant roses, whose scent helps mark the boundaries of its territory. Despite its gentle appearance, it will not hesitate to bite anyone it sees as a threat.

entry: POKENAME在美丽玫瑰园中伪装，深夜捕猎。只要有心，几乎完全看不见。
author: notsaying.
source: Camouflaging itself in beautiful rose gardens, POKENAME catches prey in the dead of night. It is almost invisible when it wants to be.

entry: POKENAME的两个身体如一体行动，把生活中的一切都当作舞蹈、二重唱。轮番配合的动作与攻击，优雅无双。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's two bodies act together as one, treating everything in life as if it were a type of dance and duet. The grace present in their tag-team movements and attacks is unparalleled.

entry: POKENAME飞过草原，会让玫瑰长得强壮、开花。许多精致花园装饰它的雕像，希望吸引注意。
author: gileme__
source: When POKENAME fly above grassy fields, they influence roses to grow strong and bloom. Many fancy gardens are ornamented with statues of POKENAME in hopes of attracting their attention.

entry: POKENAME背上的结构看着、闻着都像玫瑰，其实是真菌子实体。被蒙骗的授粉者徒劳地寻找花蜜，飞走后便传播了真菌孢子。
author: .jerden
source: Although it looks and smells like a rose, the structure on POKENAME's back is actually the fruiting body of a fungus. Pollinators that it fools will search in vain for nectar and will spread POKENAME's fungal spores once they fly away.

entry: POKENAME用强大的精神力量，配合手腕玫瑰的花瓣预知未来。扇子散出迷人香气，引来其他生灵。
author: violet_zero
source: POKENAME uses its powerful psychic abilities and petals from the roses on its wrists to foresee the future. Its fan lures others in with alluring fragrances.

entry: POKENAME激战时，尾巴的花会盛开。它用刺藤困住敌人，再以剃刀般锋利的爪子击败。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: The flower on POKENAME's tail blooms during tough battles. It traps foes with thorny vines before defeating them with its razor-sharp claws.

entry: POKENAME特别愤怒时，会释放花臂中隐藏的刺藤，缠住附近任何东西，反复向地面猛砸，无论物体还是生灵。
author: bobosmith01
source: When POKENAME is particularly angry, it will unleash thorny vines hidden within its flowery arms, wrap them around whatever is nearby, and slam the ensnared object or being into the ground over and over.

entry: 修剪POKENAME的毛，能让更多天然花朵生长，增强天生美感。它常参加著名美容比赛，由当地花卉专家评判鲜艳、打理良好的毛发。
author: jaminmcready
source: Pruning POKENAME's fur allows it to grow more natural flowers and enhances its natural beauty. POKENAME is often entered into prestigious grooming competitions where its vibrant, well-kept coat is judged by local floral experts.

entry: POKENAME的花蜜常被加入香水，烟熏花香增添优雅韵味。它很受香氛姐姐欢迎，她们悉心栽培花朵，留待日后蒸馏。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME nectar is a common ingredient in many perfumes, adding smoky floral notes that lend an elegant edge to the perfume. POKENAME are popular with Aroma Ladies, who take great care to cultivate their flowers to be distilled later.

entry: POKENAME的毒刺能引发强烈灼痛，连医生也难治疗。不过，面对经验较少的对手，它不会全力以赴。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME's poisonous thorns can inflict an intense, burning pain that doctors have difficulty treating. However, it will not use the full extent of its power against less experienced opponents in battle.

entry: 这种融合体十分浪漫，常能看见它用花朵或力量，努力给雌性宝可梦留下印象。
author: thefinalkalgonus
source: This fusion is very romantic; it is often seen trying impress female Pokémon with flowers or with its strength.

entry: POKENAME绕着对手跳舞，用甜香令人昏昏欲睡，再迅速挥剑斩倒。获胜后，就等待掌声与欢呼。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME dance around their opponents, using a sweet scent to lull their opponents into a sleepy stupor. They will then swiftly slice their opponents down with their sword, whereupon POKENAME await applause and cheers after a successful battle.

entry: POKENAME用强劲小腿推动自己滑过冰面，为大家献上耀眼表演。技艺备受尊敬，常能见到它训练准备参赛的花样滑冰运动员。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Using their strong calves, POKENAME propel themselves along the ice, putting on dazzling performances for all. Their skill is respected, and it is common to see them training figure skaters for competitions.

entry: POKENAME体温能超过500华氏度。覆盖身体的植物始终闷烧，产生异乎寻常的大量烟雾。
author: dylonk25
source: POKENAME's body temperature can exceed 500 degrees Fahrenheit. The plants covering its body smolder perpetually, producing inordinate amounts of smoke.

entry: POKENAME带壳尾巴上花朵的颜色，部分取决于饮食。贝壳用花中的刺藤，保护迟钝的宿主免受危险。
author: sk372
source: The color of the flowers that grow on POKENAME's shelled tail depends partially on its diet. The shell uses thorny vines from its flowers to defend its dim-witted host from danger.

entry: POKENAME身上的植物每天都需要浇水。缺水就会变得好斗，可能导致几颗头互相争斗。
author: turcai_87271
source: The plants on POKENAME's body need to be watered daily. If they are not, they can become hostile, which can lead to infighting between the heads.

entry: POKENAME藏在美丽花园，恐吓想享受舒适环境的人。若有人想逃离恶作剧，手上玫瑰就会伸出暗影藤蔓，将其拖住。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME hides within beautiful flower gardens so that it may terrorize those who seek to enjoy the pleasant surroundings. Shadowy vines extend from the roses on its hands to drag those who try to run from its antics.

entry: POKENAME圆圆的身体充满高压气体，随时可能爆炸。瘪掉后，会逐渐重新充气，直到恢复意识。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's round body is filled with high pressure gas, and it can explode at any time. After deflating, it will gradually refill itself with air until it regains consciousness.

entry: POKENAME更常出现在许多霹雳电球和顽皮雷弹爆炸过的地区。有人说，是它们残留的怒火将它充胀。
author: .jerden
source: It is more likely to be found in areas in which many Voltorb and Electrode have exploded. Some say that POKENAME is inflated by their lingering anger.

entry: POKENAME的头缓缓飘远，身体也照常活动，因此很受嘉年华欢迎。头身之间的绳子，确保强风中不会丢头。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME's body can still move even as their head slowly floats away, which makes them a popular act in carnivals. The string connecting the head to the body ensures POKENAME does not lose their head during strong winds.

entry: POKENAME结成小群，低飞掠过海洋，从不沾水。虽然已无法游泳，却始终依恋水边。
author: sand_coffin
source: Small groups of POKENAME fly low over the ocean, never touching the water. Though it can no longer swim, it always stays near water.

entry: POKENAME的头如气球充胀，内部气体成分随环境变化，帮助适应当地条件。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's head is inflated like a balloon. The composition of the gas inside varies depending on the environment, helping POKENAME to adapt to local conditions.

entry: POKENAME常在夜海、尤其离岸流中出现。它随流漂荡，将困在其中的孩子带向外海。
author: captainzscourge
source: POKENAME is often seen at night in the ocean, usually during riptides. It floats within the currents and takes children caught within them out to sea.

entry: 电力不足时，POKENAME会将自己鼓成气球，吸引雷暴中的闪电。充满电后便直落地面，用四爪安稳着陆。
author: teatedtiten
source: When low on electricity, POKENAME will blow themselves up like balloons to attract lightning strikes from thunderstorms. When they are fully charged, they will plummet to the ground and safely land on their paws.

entry: 它们极善于保留体内火焰的热量，轻易就能飘上空中。云朵般的毛厚重，免得太常飞走，但每年仍得两次脱去部分绒毛。
author: infinex21
source: Their bodies retain the heat of their internal flames so well that they can easily drift into the air. Their cloudy fur is thick and heavy to help keep them from flying off too often, though they must shed some of it twice every year.

entry: POKENAME顺着气流，毫不费力地飘过天空。如沼王一般，也懒得为进食费力，任何飞进身体的东西都会直接吸收，化作养分。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME floats effortlessly through the air, following air currents. Like a Quagsire, it puts no effort into eating and anything that flies into it is absorbed straight into its body to be used as nutrition.

entry: POKENAME顺着气流，毫不费力地飘过天空。傍晚会让头瘪下，降回地面，寻找向上飘的灵魂，轻松吃一餐。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME floats effortlessly through the air, following air currents. In the evenings it deflates its head and falls down to earth, looking for an easy meal of souls floating upwards.

entry: POKENAME顺着气流，毫不费力地飘过天空。任何靠得太近的东西都会被吸入，再借它们的动量推动自己前进。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME floats effortlessly through the air, following air currents. Anything that gets too close to it is sucked in, and POKENAME uses their momentum to propel it forward.

entry: 野外极少看见POKENAME，偶尔见到时，正收集孩子遗失的气球，再用精神力量送还失主。
author: .izik
source: On the rare occasions POKENAME is seen in the wild, it is collecting balloons that children have lost. Using its psychic abilities, it returns them to the child who lost them.

entry: POKENAME白天不活动，夜里让身体膨胀，漫无目的地飘荡。满月时，大量聚集，在月光下一起旋转。
author: sk372
source: Inactive during the day, at night POKENAME inflates its body and floats around aimlessly. When the full moon is out, POKENAME gathers en masse to twirl together beneath the moonlight.

entry: 夜里风太强，POKENAME就常不小心飘入月色深处。它几乎控制不了自己的身体。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME often accidently drifts off into the moonlight if the winds are too strong during the night. It barely has control of its body.

entry: POKENAME主要捕食鲤鱼王与珍珠贝的融合体，极少有宝可梦能打破它们的壳。它抓住四只，涂上毒胶防盗，再升到高空扔下。撞地使壳破裂，就能降下享用。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME prey mostly on Magiperl, whose shells few Pokémon can break. It grabs four, coats them in a toxic gel to ward off thieves, then drifts high into the air to drop them. The impact cracks the shells, letting POKENAME descend to enjoy its meal.

entry: POKENAME头里充满空气，轻得出奇。悄悄移动时，脚只会短暂触地。
author: .jerden
source: Its head is filled with air, making POKENAME surprisingly lightweight. When it moves quietly, its feet only briefly touch the ground.

entry: 虽然POKENAME无法真正飞行，升空后却能长时间滑翔。战斗中会在四周铺开浓云，隐藏攻击。
author: sk372
source: Although unable to truly fly, POKENAME can glide for long periods of time once airborne. In combat, it spreads thick clouds around it to conceal its attacks from view.

entry: POKENAME穿过云层时，有时会改变模仿的字母。不过，短暂之后总会变回原样，让每种新外形都转瞬即逝。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME will sometimes change the letter it emulates while drifting through clouds. However, it always reverts back after a short time, making each new appearance brief.

entry: POKENAME将树果存进壳里，只吃果皮，再从壳顶射出，让其他宝可梦享用剥好的果肉。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME stores berries inside its shell and eats only the rinds. It then shoots them out of the top of its shell so other Pokémon can enjoy the peeled berries.

entry: POKENAME在壳里粉碎树果，从头部喷出粉末，推动自己升空，轻松够到长在更高处的树果。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME pulverizes berries inside its shell and shoots the powder out of its head to propel itself into the air. This allows it to easily reach berries that grow much higher up.

entry: 虽然POKENAME体型大，却能轻松飘到家园的林木上方。长长的肢体随风漂摆，偷取树顶水果、树果，独自囤积。
author: sk372
source: Despite a large stature, POKENAME easily floats above the forest trees of its habitat. Using its long, drifting limbs, it swipes fruits and berries from treetops and hoards them for itself.

entry: POKENAME只在夜里被看见，滑翔于热带海岸高空。白天休息，吸收海洋环境的热量储存，夜里再释放，使自己漂浮。
author: bobosmith01
source: Only at night can POKENAME be spotted gliding high up in the sky above tropical shorelines. It rests during the day, absorbing the ambient heat of the ocean for later use; at night, it releases the stored heat, allowing POKENAME to float.

entry: POKENAME很轻，能用长耳朵起飞。飞行时，还能用长鼻搬运大树。
author: bigoljax
source: Because they're very light, POKENAME can use their long ears to take flight. POKENAME can also carry large trees during their flights with their trunks.

entry: POKENAME制造带有简单符号的对话气泡，传达心情。造出不久就会飘走，伴着响亮的哔声爆开。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME communicates by creating word balloons with basic symbols on them to convey mood. A short time after creation, they float away and pop with a loud beeping noise.

entry: POKENAME在农场受欢迎，不仅因为产奶，还能当游乐坐骑。它允许孩子抓着尾巴，绕农场飘荡。
author: oddwalls
source: POKENAME is a favorite on farms not only for its milk but also as an amusement ride. It allows children to hold onto its tail as it floats around the farm.

entry: POKENAME快速吸气积蓄能量，身体也持续膨胀。古老传说警告，完全充胀后，只一声吼就足以吹走山峰。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME rapidly inhale air to build up energy, steadily inflating in the process. Old legends warn that the mere roar of a fully inflated POKENAME would be enough to blow away a mountain.

entry: POKENAME平时懒散、无害，到了进食时间，却会自行召风，推着自己高速冲向猎物。
author: stevethebarbarian
source: POKENAME is usually lazy and harmless, but when it comes time to feed, it conjures its own winds to blow it towards its prey at high speed.

entry: POKENAME通常率领一群飘飘球穿过夜空。同类交战时，会鼓起躯干，互相碰撞。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME usually lead groups of Drifloon through the night sky. They fight other POKENAME by inflating their torsos and bumping against each other.

entry: 寒冷、黑暗的夜里，大群POKENAME升空，雾冠在身后翻涌。据说，穿过它的影子，连灵魂都会冻透，颤抖好几周。
author: kungfucutbug
source: During cold, dark nights, large groups of POKENAME take flight, their crests of fog billowing and rippling behind them. Passing through one's shadow is said to chill your very soul, leaving you shivering for weeks.

entry: POKENAME身上翻涌的火焰，其实由布料制成。空心身体里吹出的神秘风使布料飘动，维持幻象。
author: pattybgoode
source: The billowing flames on POKENAME's body are actually made of fabric. The illusion is maintained by a mysterious wind from within POKENAME's hollow body that moves them about.

entry: POKENAME跃过雪山顶，飘过暴风雪，收集尚未落下的雪花。随后飞往温暖气候，散下小小飞雪，让少见下雪的地区里，孩子们也能开心。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME leap across snowy mountaintops and float through blizzards to collect snowflakes before they fall. They fly through warmer climates while scattering miniature flurries to entertain children in areas where it rarely snows.

entry: 虽然POKENAME身体大多充满气体，却会莫名突然变重，坠向地面。抽搐般的动作，有时还会让自己缠进身上的气球绳。
author: soup1900
source: Despite gas filling up the majority of POKENAME's body, it randomly becomes very heavy and crashes into the ground as a result. In its twitchy movements, it sometimes entangles itself in the balloon strings on its body.

entry: POKENAME每次跃起，都能鼓胀背上气球，浮在空中。有时突然放气，从上方落向敌人，通常停留得恰到好处，让突然落下出人意料。
author: .jerden
source: Whenever POKENAME leaps up, it can inflate the balloon on its back to float in the air. It may suddenly deflate it to drop down on foes from above, usually hanging in the air just long enough that this comes as a surprise.

entry: POKENAME每次跃起，都能鼓胀背上气球，浮在空中。有时突然放气，从上方落向敌人，通常停留得恰到好处，让突然落下出人意料。
author: .jerden
source: Whenever POKENAME leaps up, it can inflate the balloon on its back to float in the air. It may suddenly deflate it to drop down on foes from above, usually hanging in the air just long enough that this comes as a surprise.

entry: 这种POKENAME变体四处飘荡，寻找人类和宝可梦，传播快乐。可惜，心意常被误认为想绑架、带走别人。
author: lydiaprower8
source: This variant of POKENAME floats around trying to find people and Pokémon to spread its joy. Unfortunately, their intentions are often mistaken for wanting to kidnap people and take them away.

entry: POKENAME用精神力量改变手持连枷的重量。朋友想玩时，轻如气球；面对敌人，却重得足以砸碎混凝土。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses psychic powers to manipulate the weight of the flail it carries. With friends who want to play it as light as a balloon, but against foes it becomes heavy enough to shatter concrete.

entry: POKENAME藏在云中，掩盖行动。飞行宝可梦太靠近藏身处，就会显出完整形态，将其包裹、拖入。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME hides within clouds to camouflage its movements. When flying Pokémon approach too close to its hiding spot, its full form appears to envelop them and drag them within.

entry: POKENAME的头富有弹性，能把对手弹出数公里，也能变硬，造成巨大破坏。
author: chorb33
source: With its flexible head, POKENAME can bounce opponents back several kilometers, but it can also harden its head to cause enormous destruction.

entry: POKENAME用有趣、亲切的外观，诱使小猎物走进嘴里，再凭结实的气球身体反复弹地，直到升空飘走。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME uses its fun, very inviting look to lure in small prey into walking inside its mouth. Then, using its very sturdy balloon body, it repeatedly bounces on the ground until it lifts off into the sky and drifts away.

entry: POKENAME大多时候懒得动，只随风飘。看见下方成熟水果，才会突然如游泳般在空中移动，迅速抵达树顶，大吃到重得无法漂浮。
author: .jerden
source: Most of the time, POKENAME are too lazy to move and simply drift on the wind. If they see ripe fruit below, they will suddenly move through the air as if swimming, quickly reaching the treetops to gorge themselves until they are too heavy to float.

entry: POKENAME飘在即将遭灾的地区上空，本意是警告当地生灵，却常被误解为不幸的先兆。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME floats above areas where a disaster is soon going to strike. It means to warn those in the area of the danger, but many misinterpret the action and think of POKENAME as a harbinger of misfortune.

entry: POKENAME常被误认为飞艇，缓缓飘过城镇。叫声微弱，听起来如轻风拂过。
author: bigoljax
source: Often mistaken for blimps, POKENAME slowly float over cities and towns. Their calls are very faint, similar in sound to soft gusts of wind.

entry: 若被它带到云后，再出来时，可能直接到了来世。头顶的羽冠极易燃烧。
author: bandedbodypress
source: If it ferries you away behind a cloud, you may emerge directly into the afterlife. The plume on its head is highly flammable.

entry: 古代记载称，POKENAME呼出一口热气，就能温暖整座城市。严冬时，会以蜂蜜和亲属为供品，敬奉它。
author: .izik
source: Ancient records claim a single breath of POKENAME's heated air could warm an entire city. During harsh winters, offerings of honey and relatives were made in worship.

entry: POKENAME慢慢飘在天空，用尾端螺旋桨引导方向。鸟宝可梦常栖在背上休息。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME slowly float in the sky, using the propellers at the ends of their tails to guide their way. Bird Pokémon have a habit of perching on their backs to take a rest.

entry: 野生POKENAME高居云端，身旁常有各种紫色宝可梦，在背上休息。往来的宝可梦太多，因此尚不清楚这些关系是共生还是寄生。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Wild POKENAME can be spotted high in the clouds, often accompanied by all manner of purple Pokémon, who rest on POKENAME's back. Due to the variety of Pokémon it interacts with, it's unclear if these relationships are symbiotic or parasitic.

entry: POKENAME只在晨昏的雾海被看见。它将大气泡压进水中，吸走其中一切生灵的生命。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME can only be seen at twilight in foggy seas. It hunts by forcing a large bubble into the water and draining the life of anything suspended inside.

entry: 据说，POKENAME的眼睛能看透灵魂。它常成群在黄昏出行，但迁徙路线似乎随机、漫无目的。
author: foolish_weasel
source: It is said that the eyes of a POKENAME can see into one's soul. POKENAME will often form packs that travel at dusk, but their migration patterns appear to be random and aimless.

entry: POKENAME从尾部吸气，充满空心、弹性的身体，在天上漂浮。放出部分空气、冲向敌人时，会用翅膀引导方向。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME suck in air through their tails to fill their hollow, elastic bodies and drift about in the sky. They use their wings to help guide them when they release some of their air to launch themselves at foes.

entry: POKENAME的齿轮白天缓转，夜里加快。通常出没在废弃工业机械很多的地方，齿轮摩擦声在废墟中响亮回荡。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's gears turn slowly during the day, but spin faster at night. It is usually found in places with a lot of abandoned industrial machinery, the grinding of its gears echoing loudly through the ruins.

entry: 身体轻得能在背上载许多小宝可梦，常能看见它救幼小宝可梦脱险。遇上强风，会用长触须固定自己，免得被吹走。
author: infinex21
source: Its body is so light that it can carry many small Pokémon on its back, a sight seen often as it saves young Pokémon from danger. When a strong wind occurs, it uses its long feelers to keep itself from being carried away.

entry: POKENAME在大气臭氧层中翱翔，看着流星燃烧、消失。偶尔从高空下降，会从头部放气，慢慢沉向地面。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME soar through the ozone layer of the atmosphere where they watch meteors burn and disappear. On the rare occasion they descend from high altitudes, they release gas from their head to slowly sink to the ground.

entry: POKENAME爱收集各式毛绒玩具，极少数时候，会攻击孩子，抢走玩具。睡觉时，便与收藏一起待在巢穴里。
author: bobosmith01
source: It loves collecting all kinds of plush toys. Rarely, it will attack a child to claim their plush as its own. POKENAME sleeps with its plush collection in its den.

entry: POKENAME爱收集各式毛绒玩具，极少数时候，会攻击孩子，抢走玩具。睡觉时，便与收藏一起待在巢穴里。
author: bobosmith01
source: It loves collecting all kinds of plush toys. Rarely, it will attack a child to claim their plush as its own. POKENAME sleeps with its plush collection in its den.

entry: POKENAME爱收集各式毛绒玩具，极少数时候，会攻击孩子，抢走玩具。睡觉时，便与收藏一起待在巢穴里。
author: bobosmith01
source: It loves collecting all kinds of plush toys. Rarely, it will attack a child to claim their plush as its own. POKENAME sleeps with its plush collection in its den.

entry: 古老传说称，POKENAME从月亮飘来我们的世界。满月之夜会陷入恍惚，升向高层大气，仿佛想回到传闻中的“家”。
author: mepp.
source: An old legend claims that POKENAME drifted to our world from the moon. On nights of the full moon, they fall under a trance-like state, rising high into the atmosphere as if to try and return to their supposed “home”.

entry: POKENAME恶作剧时，会潜入民居绑走一个人，随意飘到下一处，将其丢在那里。不过也算好心，离开前会送上一些被热气暖过的棉絮。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME plays pranks by sneaking into homes and kidnapping a person there, so it can leave them stranded at the next random location it drifts to. However, it is nice enough to give them some of its hot-air-warmed cotton before leaving them.

entry: POKENAME的各部分没有实物相连，能彼此分离。战斗后经常得找回飘走的肢体。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME's parts can separate from each other as they are not attached to anything. They regularly have to find limbs that have floated away after battles.

entry: POKENAME的尾巴由云状材料构成，托起轻盈身体，使它飞行。飘过空中时，会用小火球轰击下方，制造恶作剧。
author: sk372
source: The tails made of cloud-like material lift up POKENAME's light body and let it achieve flight. As it floats through the air, it bombards the areas below with small fireballs to cause mischief.

entry: POKENAME能鼓起各颗头，威吓效果极佳。主头锐利的红眼，让它夜间也容易被发现。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME can inflate their separate heads, making them excellent at intimidation. They can be spotted at night due to the piercing red eyes on the main head.

entry: POKENAME滑过天空时，会将自己的情绪传给附近生灵，通常是平静与幸福。
author: bobosmith01
source: Whatever emotions POKENAME is experiencing will be transferred to those nearby as it glides through the sky. Typically, this is a sense of calm and bliss.

entry: POKENAME用体温产生热气，充进尾巴上的气球。鼓得够大，就能飘在空中，划行至目的地。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME inflate the balloon on their tail by using their body heat to pump hot air within it. They can drift through the air if they inflate their tail enough, paddling across the sky to get to their destination.

entry: 见到POKENAME的人，会忍不住任它带走，确信它会领自己到最深愿望成真的地方。顺从这股冲动的人，此后再也没被见过。
author: sk372
source: Those who see POKENAME are compelled to let it lift them away, convinced that it will take them to a place where their greatest wishes will be granted. Those who follow this compulsion have never been seen again.

entry: POKENAME轻如羽毛，能漂在极高处。但短鳍无法精细转向，最终只能任风带到哪里。
author: zweizweihander
source: POKENAME is light as a feather and can float at extremely high altitudes; however, its stubby fins lack the capabilities for fine maneuvering, and as such, the Pokémon simply ends up wherever the wind takes it.

entry: 许多POKENAME被用在各类演出中，为难以抵达的位置上的科技设备供能。据报告，电流会让气球般的身体贴在墙上，不会掉落。
author: th3randomguy
source: Many POKENAME have been used to power technology in hard-to-reach locations during performances of all kinds. It has been reported that the electric current causes their balloon-like bodies to cling to walls without falling.

entry: POKENAME黄昏时成群漫游各条道路，漫无目的。目击者说，它们会渐渐隐去，只剩带电尾巴发出的神秘闪烁信号。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Packs of POKENAME will aimlessly roam various routes at dusk. When observed, onlookers will comment that these packs of POKENAME will fade from view, leaving only mysterious blinking signals from their electrical tails.

entry: POKENAME日落后最活跃，轻盈身体乘着晚风漂浮。它借风长途迁徙，需要时用双臂调整航向。
author: coridiant
source: It is most active after the sun sets, when the light bodies of POKENAME float on the evening breeze. It undertakes great migratory flights on these winds, using its arms to adjust its flight path when needed.

entry: POKENAME一孵化就鼓起身体，任风带走，因此能广泛散布世界各地。
author: _snakeywakey_
source: When POKENAME first hatch, they inflate themselves and let the wind carry them away. This allows them to spread far and wide across the world.

entry: 没人知道，基因之楔发明前是否已有POKENAME存在。提及它的古卷普遍被认为是伪造或误记。不过，科学家注意到，它死后不会留下身体。
author: bobosmith01
source: No one is sure whether POKENAME existed before the invention of the DNA Splicers. An ancient scroll mentioning it is widely believed to be a forgery or mistake. However, scientists have noted that when POKENAME passes on, it leaves no body behind.

entry: POKENAME的唾液主要由液氦组成。呼吸时，部分唾液沸腾，使它持续漂浮。冰冻牙能瞬间冻实猎物。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Its saliva is mostly composed of liquid helium. When POKENAME breathes, some of its saliva boils, allowing it to stay floating. Its Ice Fang freezes prey solid instantly.

entry: 最近的探索才证实，POKENAME是宝可梦，并非超自然现象。过去2,000年，人们只知道暴风雪中有一对从不眨动的红眼。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Very recent explorations have proven POKENAME to be a Pokémon, and not supernatural phenomena. For the past 2,000 years, it was only known to be a pair of unblinking red eyes within blizzards.

entry: POKENAME的叫声令人萎靡不振，听者常会不寒而栗。POKENAME还能吸气鼓起身体，最多膨胀到原来的五倍，威吓他人。
author: faeflame
source: The cry of the POKENAME has a withering effect on its opponents, often causing chills in those who hear it. POKENAME can also puff air into their bodies, appearing up to five times their size to intimidate others.

entry: POKENAME在云间跳舞，体内深处传出神秘音乐。跳着跳着，热气充满身体，让它能在空中停留数小时。
author: .izik
source: While dancing among clouds, POKENAME emits mysterious music from deep within its body. Its body fills with hot air as it dances, keeping it aloft for hours.

entry: POKENAME头上的气球能充气，更容易升空。身体由浓密毛发组成，却常被误认为云。
author: bigoljax
source: The balloons on POKENAME's head can be inflated, helping them get up in the air more easily. Their bodies are made out of thick fur, though they are usually mistaken for clouds.

entry: 它在体内储存气体和水汽，缓缓释放，伪装成云团。毫无防备的飞行宝可梦靠近，就猛然喷气前冲，用巨颚整个吞下。
author: notadoctor75
source: It stores gas and water vapor in its body and slowly releases them, allowing itself to disguise as a cloud bank. When unsuspecting flying Pokémon draw close, it forcefully expels gas to lunge forward, swallowing them whole with its massive jaws.

entry: POKENAME产生的气体与孢子带毒，会使人暂时麻痹。它其实很喜欢交际，便模仿花朵，让自己显得亲切，却仍背负着并不公允的邪恶名声。
author: sontyp
source: The gases and spores POKENAME's body produces are toxic and cause temporary paralysis. Because this Pokémon is very social, it mimics the appearance of a flower to seem more approachable, but its undeservedly sinister reputation still stands.

entry: POKENAME像泰迪熊的外表很吸引孩子。一旦靠近，就会被它抱住跑走，从此再不见踪影。
author: mcnchsschl
source: Children are drawn towards POKENAME due to its teddy bear-like appearance. When this happens, it grabs them in its arms and runs away, never to be seen again.

entry: 据说，POKENAME若落在船上，就会变得沉重无比，将整船拖进海底。
author: staghorn
source: It is said that if a POKENAME lands on a ship, it will grow impossibly heavy and drag the vessel down to the ocean floor.

entry: POKENAME用缎带般的触手在身边围出坚固穹顶，兜住产生的热气，迅速升空。抬起12根触手中的一根，就如打开阀门放气，向反方向推进。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME forms a solid dome around its body using its ribbonlike tentacles to catch the hot air it generates and quickly float up. Lifting one of its 12 tentacles acts as a flap to release air and propel itself in the opposite direction.

entry: POKENAME的蘑菇充满气体和孢子，逐渐外泄，直到降回地面，寻找腐烂植物吃。蘑菇最终重新充满，循环再来。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME's mushrooms are filled with gas and spores. Both slowly spill out of POKENAME until it reaches the ground, where it searches for decaying plants to eat. Eventually, the mushrooms refill and the cycle starts over.

entry: POKENAME利用充气城堡般的外形引来孩子。抓够数量，就慢慢飘走。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME use their bouncy castle-like shape to their advantage. They lure children in, slowly floating away once they've caught enough.

entry: POKENAME白天若想飞高，体内冷空气就会变暖、膨胀，最终爆炸。夜里却没有这问题，便会一直上升，直到碰到极光。
author: soup1900
source: If POKENAME tries to fly up high during the day, the cold air that fills its body will become warmer and expand until it explodes. At night, however, this isn't an issue, so it will keep floating up until it touches an aurora.

entry: 虽然据说由无形灵体组成，POKENAME摸起来却坚如岩石。理论认为，它不停游荡，是为了舔舐伤口、安抚灵魂，帮助受伤旅人。
author: thegreenscorpion
source: Even though its composition is said to be made of incorporeal spirits, POKENAME's body is rock solid to the touch. It is theorized that it wanders endlessly to assist injured travelers by licking their wounds and soothing their souls.

entry: POKENAME背上的蘑菇越长越大，充满气体，开始漂浮，以细丝连着身体。受到攻击，充氦气囊就会破裂，散开孢子，让它撤退。
author: ohok3441
source: As the mushrooms on the backs of POKENAME grow, they fill with gas and begin to float, connected by thin strands to their bodies. If attacked, the helium filled pockets will burst, spreading spores and allowing the individual POKENAME to retreat.

entry: POKENAME从充气的头里排出热气，调整航向。再加上火焰攻击的能力，让它在战场上化为烈火般的力量。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME expels hot air from its gas-filled head to adjust its flight trajectory. With the added ability to unleash fire attacks, it becomes a fiery force in battle.

entry: POKENAME降入城市，让人们把垃圾扔进燃烧的吊篮。垃圾充当燃料，使火焰暂时更旺，让它继续浮空。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME lowers itself into urban areas and lets humans throw their waste into its burning basket. The garbage fuels the flame to burn stronger for a time and let it continue staying afloat.

entry: POKENAME高高跃起，聚来云朵减缓下落。抵达想要的位置，就鼓起头部，使出强力头槌。可惜经常排气过多，反而飞走。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME leap high into the air to gather clouds to slow their falls. Once they've arrived at their desired position, they inflate their heads to deliver powerful headbutts. Unfortunately, they will often expel too much air and fly away as a result.

entry: POKENAME用缎带手产生的气体漂浮，带走选中的任何人。为免被风吹来吹去，会用头上同样洁白、浓密、蓬松的气体形成屏障，抵御强风。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME uses the gas it generates from its ribbon hands to float and carry away anyone it chooses. To avoid being blown around by the wind, it forms barriers using the same white, dense, fluffy gas on its head since they resist strong gusts.

entry: POKENAME以天然气为食，找到地下气体富集处后，便迅速膨胀，飘过洞穴。矿工留意它们的群体，以行为判断是否挖到了危险的积气处。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME feed on natural gas, rapidly expanding and floating through their caves when they find a pocket. Miners keep an eye on POKENAME populations, using their behaviour as a guide to determine when they've struck a dangerous gas pocket.

entry: POKENAME飘在许多游乐场上方，三颗头不断寻找不慎脱手的气球。找到就飘近抓住，回到地面，交还丢失气球的孩子。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME drift above many fairgrounds, their three heads constantly looking around for balloons that have been accidentally released. When they find one, they drift over and grab it, returning to the ground and returning it to the child who lost it.

entry: POKENAME的尾巴长着丝滑柔软、永不停长的毛。它很以尾巴为傲，高高举起，只准信任的对象摸。有些高级地毯用这种毛制作，号称脚感如踏在云上。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME's tails consist of silky soft fur that never stops growing. POKENAME are proud of their tails and hold them high, only allowing trusted individuals to touch them. Some luxury carpets use this fur and claim it feels like walking on clouds.

entry: POKENAME带着无忧无虑的笑容飘过天空，随心情任气球身体浮向各处。轻盈身体能缓解不时发作的头痛。
author: msdawgs
source: POKENAME drifts through the skies with a carefree smile, using its balloon-like body to float wherever its mood takes it. Its airy body helps alleviate the pains it gets in its head from time to time.

entry: 只要海拔够高，POKENAME就会跃下悬崖，慢慢滑翔而下。救援队常借助它，让迷路的登山者下山。
author: bigoljax
source: Whenever at a high enough altitude, POKENAME jump off cliffs and slowly glide down. They're commonly used by rescue teams to help lost climbers get down high mountains.

entry: POKENAME带着的气球沉得惊人，据说真的装满了斗志。它始终至少用两只手抱住，再用另一对手，或气球本身攻击。
author: .jerden
source: The balloon POKENAME carries around is incredibly heavy and is said to be literally filled with fighting spirit. POKENAME will always hold it with at least two hands, using its other pair or the balloon itself to make attacks.

entry: POKENAME无法控制空中移动，便用缎带触手拉着自己穿行家园，或在强风中固定。它怕人，受到惊吓就任强风带走。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME has no control over its aerial movement, so it uses its ribbon-like tentacles to pull itself around its habitat or to secure itself during strong winds. It is skittish around humans and will let a strong wind carry it away if it is spooked.

entry: POKENAME无法控制空中移动，便用缎带触手拉着自己穿行家园，或在强风中固定。它怕人，受到惊吓就任强风带走。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME has no control over its aerial movement, so it uses its ribbon-like tentacles to pull itself around its habitat or to secure itself during strong winds. It is skittish around humans and will let a strong wind carry it away if it is spooked.

entry: 瞥见POKENAME的人，常会对它狂热着迷。研究者关于行为的报告互相矛盾，但直接接触者的证词相同：见过之后，总觉得它在看着自己。
author: krogens
source: Those who take a glimpse at POKENAME often gain a wild obsession over it. Researchers have conflicting reports on its behavior but those directly exposed give the same testimony. Once they've seen it, it feels as if POKENAME is always watching them.

entry: 它坐在山顶附近，敲松石头，引发落石。若自己也被卷走，就从底部的孔喷出诅咒能量，返回山顶。
author: bandedbodypress
source: It sits near summits and knocks free rocks to create rock slides. If it ever gets swept away itself, it can blast cursed energy from the hole situated on its underside to return to the summit.

entry: POKENAME白天极懒，通常不飞，只任风带到各处。夜里却会用精神力量操控自己，寻找猎物。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: In the daytime, POKENAME are extremely lazy, usually drifting to wherever the wind takes them instead of flying. At night, however, they use their psychic powers to pilot themselves and hunt for prey.

entry: 野外曾观察到POKENAME乘着急速气流移动。有些训练家用它追踪风的规律、追逐风暴。
author: blake
source: In the wild, POKENAME has been observed riding fast wind currents. Some Trainers use them to track wind patterns and chase storms.

entry: POKENAME在充满爱的家庭里茁壮成长，感知冲突就会生病。将它送人，被视为极浪漫、奢华的举动。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME thrives in a home with a loving atmosphere, getting ill if it senses conflict. Gifting someone a POKENAME is considered a highly romantic and extravagant gesture.

entry: POKENAME很爱孩子，到哪里都流露这份喜悦。一遇见幼小宝可梦，就给予大量拥抱与关爱。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME love children and express this jubilation wherever they go. Whenever they get to meet baby Pokémon, they give plenty of hugs and affection.

entry: POKENAME极其亲人，连完全陌生的对象也愿意依偎。人们怀疑它能读心，因为总在遭到口头斥责前一刻，就停止触碰。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME are extremely affectionate and have no problem snuggling up to total strangers. It is suspected that they can read minds; they always stop touching another right before they are verbally admonished.

entry: POKENAME大耳里的火焰囊，让耳朵摸起来永远温暖。寒冷时会拍耳，为自己和其他生灵取暖。
author: sk372
source: Flame sacs within POKENAME's large ears keep them perpetually warm to the touch. It can flap these ears to warm itself and others when it is cold.

entry: POKENAME趁用户移开视线，在网页间蹦跳，悄悄啃食一行行文字。最常见于农业相关网站。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME hops across webpages when users look away, quietly nibbling on lines of text. It is most often found on farming-related sites.

entry: POKENAME住在最高山峰的冰冷顶端。虽然警惕陌生人，却会蜷在快冻僵的旅人身边，用厚毛救命。
author: alestrius
source: POKENAME lives in the icy peaks of the tallest mountains. Though it is cautious of strangers, POKENAME will curl up around travelers in danger of freezing and use the thick coat of fur that covers its body to save their lives.

entry: POKENAME被视为入侵物种，却只捕猎阿利多斯。发现后便俯冲，以连番刺击使其麻痹，再拖回巢穴。
author: ghostslythe
source: Considered to be an invasive species, POKENAME only hunts down Ariados. When spotted, it swoops in to paralyze its prey in a flurry of stings, then drags it back to its nest.

entry: 传言，POKENAME的毛是自然界最柔软的毛发之一。它不断对训练家做无害恶作剧，以此表达亲昵。
author: fiordaliso
source: Rumor has it that its fur is one of the softest found in nature. POKENAME constantly plays harmless pranks on its Trainer, as this is its way of showing affection.

entry: 传言，POKENAME的毛是自然界最柔软的毛发之一。它不断对训练家做无害恶作剧，以此表达亲昵。
author: fiordaliso
source: Rumor has it that its fur is one of the softest found in nature. POKENAME constantly plays harmless pranks on its Trainer, as this is its way of showing affection.

entry: POKENAME常独自安静沉思，避开干扰专注的事物。如果看见长耳卷起，就是正在深思。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is often stuck in quiet contemplation and solitude, avoiding things that would disrupt its concentration. If one sees its long ears furl up, it is thinking particularly deep thoughts.

entry: POKENAME平时温顺，却不能突然吓它。第一反应会急忙挥舞大耳，打向惊吓来源，将体内电力集中在耳尖。
author: sk372
source: Generally docile, care must be taken not to take POKENAME by surprise; its first response is to hastily swing its large ears at whatever spooked it while focusing its internal electricity along the tips.

entry: POKENAME耳朵有蓬松、防水的毛，浮力很好。常能看见它浮在缓流河面晒太阳。
author: skittytales
source: POKENAME's ears are buoyant thanks to its fluffy, waterproof fur. It is often found sunbathing on the surface of slow-moving rivers.

entry: POKENAME跳上树，警戒沼泽附近的危险。一看见有什么接近，就发出深沉、洪亮的蛙鸣，警告其他宝可梦躲藏。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME hops up into trees to keep watch for danger approaching its swamp. It lets out a deep bellowing croak to warn other Pokémon to hide when it sees something coming.

entry: POKENAME每年两次脱去耳毛，防止过热。它因此很不自在，若觉得谁在嘲笑，就会喷出微毒物质。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME sheds the fur covering its ears twice a year to prevent it overheating. This makes it very self-conscious, and it sprays a mildly poisonous substance at anyone that it thinks is making fun of it.

entry: POKENAME傍晚变得更勇敢、活跃。四肢环纹吸收月光，留待战斗时暂时增强踢击力量。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME grows braver and more active during the evenings. The rings on its limbs absorb moonlight, which is later used to temporarily boost the strength of its kicks in battle.

entry: POKENAME胆小，受惊就会跳走。短尾警戒捕食者，一有发现便叫出声。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME are skittish and bound away if spooked. Its bobtail watches for predators and cries out when it spots something.

entry: POKENAME感到威胁，就旋转钻头尾巴，恐吓潜在攻击者。对方不退，便用耳朵打出强拳回应。
author: sleepyman0731
source: When a POKENAME feels threatened, it will spin its drill tail to intimidate the potential attacker. If the foe does not back down, POKENAME responds with powerful punches from its ears.

entry: POKENAME装成极地猎物，诱来体型大得多的宝可梦，再用利爪凶狠劈抓。被逼入绝境时，会蓬起绒毛显大，却因此更讨训练家喜爱。
author: ghostslythe
source: Acting as arctic prey, POKENAME lures in much larger Pokémon before slashing savagely with its claws. If cornered, it puffs up its fluff to appear larger, endearing it to Trainers.

entry: POKENAME外形可爱、甲壳多彩，受到许多训练家追捧。受惊时，就把脸藏在耳朵绒毛后面。
author: beandrawsthings
source: Due to its cute appearance and colourful shell, POKENAME is sought after by many Pokémon Trainers. When startled, it hides its face behind the fluff on its ears.

entry: POKENAME歌声美妙，能将选定的虫属性猎物引向咧笑的巨口。它用耳朵稳定飞行，最猛烈的风暴也不怕，因此能极速俯冲。
author: ghostslythe
source: POKENAME's singing voice is beautiful enough to draw out chosen Bug-type prey to its grinning maw. It uses its ears to stabilize its flight through the fiercest storms, allowing it to dive at extreme speeds.

entry: 这种身体僵硬的融合体喜欢雪天和庆典。不知为何，每到晚餐时间，它就会觉得不舒服。
author: houndrys.
source: This rigid fusion loves snowy days and celebrations. For some reason, it feels uncomfortable when it is time to eat in the evening.

entry: POKENAME很适合家庭，护家心强，又温柔、合群。参加宠物展时，主要评判蓬松角状眉毛的品质。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME are excellent Pokémon for families, being fiercely protective yet gentle and social. POKENAME participating in pet shows are judged primarily by the quality of their fluffy horn-shaped brows.

entry: POKENAME带着迷人目光平静接近猎物，制造虚假的安全感。等猎物舒服地受尽宠爱，就会用獠牙咬住下一餐。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME calmly approach their prey with a beguiling gaze, hoping to lull prey into a false sense of security. Once their prey is comfortable and well pampered, POKENAME sink their fangs into their next meal.

entry: POKENAME的外形如视觉错觉，耳朵看起来也像鸟喙。人们仔细观察身体带来的关注，让它十分开心。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME resemble an optical illusion where their ears also look like a bill. POKENAME enjoy the attention they receive when people examine their body.

entry: POKENAME极其虚荣，能对着镜子欣赏自己数小时。外表虽可爱，脾气却很坏，谁不赞美美貌，就用长耳打谁。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is extremely vain and can spend hours admiring its reflection in a mirror. Despite its cute appearance, it has a terrible temper and hits anyone who doesn't praise its beauty using its long ears.

entry: POKENAME尾巴如橡胶球般有弹性，覆盖柔毛。走到哪里都用尾巴蹦跳，能跳得高得惊人。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME's tails bounce like rubber balls, covered in soft fur. These Pokémon bounce on their tails wherever they go, able to reach impressive heights.

entry: POKENAME出现在其他生灵面前，邀对方玩碰运气的游戏。据说，答应参赛又输了，就会遭可怕诅咒。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME appears before others and offers to let them play games of chance with it. It's said it casts terrible hexes on those that agree to its game and then lose.

entry: POKENAME很黏人、要求又多，不断怂恿训练家再给食物。新手被告诫别饲养，免得钱不够花。
author: lampent12
source: A very needy Pokémon, POKENAME will constantly egg its Trainer into giving it more food. New Trainers are warned against raising POKENAME, lest they find themselves short on cash.

entry: POKENAME不断脱落数磅毛发，饲主必须花大量精力打理。毛很值钱，但为防偷猎，贩售需要执照。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME constantly shed pounds of fur, requiring heavy maintenance from those who own them. Their fur is high in value, though it requires a license to sell as a way to combat possible poaching.

entry: POKENAME厚实的毛发能留住体内产生的热量，再通过腕部的热气孔集中喷出，形成炽烈的冲击。
author: phantom640
source: POKENAME's thick fur helps it trap the heat generated by its body, which it can then focus into fiery blasts using the thermal vents in its wrist.

entry: POKENAME极为敏捷，能灵巧穿梭森林，不碰任何障碍。它因此能突然扑向朋友，送上柔软、亲密的拥抱，明显表达喜爱。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are incredibly agile creatures that can duck and weave through the forest without hitting any obstacles. This allows them to surprise and envelop their friends in a soft cuddly embrace, which is a telltale sign of their affection.

entry: POKENAME用极强双腿踢破杀毒程序，让有害软件进入系统。病毒吸引主人的注意，它则借掩护，大量吸取数据。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its extremely strong legs to break down antivirus programs, allowing harmful software to enter the system. Under this cover, it absorbs large amounts of data while the viruses occupy the owner's attention.

entry: POKENAME羽毛柔软如丝，能制作极精细的织物。平时无害，但感到威胁，就会毫不犹豫地喷火警告。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME's feathers are so soft they feel like silk, and are used to craft extremely fine fabrics. Although generally harmless, it doesn't hesitate to breathe warning flames when it feels threatened.

entry: POKENAME安详、优雅地悬在地面上方。这种谨慎的宝可梦沉着地读出训练家与其他物种的意图，警察常利用这份本领，找出有罪者。
author: ghostslythe
source: POKENAME hovers above the ground in serene grace. With poise, this cautious Pokémon reads the intentions of Trainers and other species alike. Police Officers often utilize its skills to weed out guilty parties.

entry: 它们精力十足，常出现在健身影片中，鼓励观众跳舞，直到累倒。
author: quote.lass
source: These energetic Pokémon make frequent appearances in exercise videos, encouraging viewers to dance until they drop.

entry: POKENAME善良、友好，总以尊重和善意待人。它无法容忍不公或残酷，始终努力纠正。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are benign and friendly Pokémon that always treat others with respect and kindness. They do not tolerate inequity or cruelty and always seek to make things right.

entry: POKENAME用控制器操纵一只小小的无人机般铁哑铃，寻找食物、查看危险。
author: aberry8286
source: POKENAME controls a small drone-like Beldum with its controller. It uses said drone to scout out food and check for danger.

entry: POKENAME通过外部两根操纵杆控制下半身。敏捷又有战术，会在对手触及范围外漂浮、旋转，直到能用强力钢爪反击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME manipulates its lower half via two levers on the exterior. It is quite agile and tactical, floating and spinning just out of an opponent's reach until it can strike back with powerful steel claws.

entry: POKENAME的石头看着、闻着都像胡萝卜，常吸引饥饿宝可梦。靠得太近，就会从封存处出来，用厚重耳朵打走。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's stone looks and smells like a carrot, often attracting hungry Pokémon. If they get too close, it emerges from containment and smacks them away with its thick and heavy ears.

entry: POKENAME用可爱外表引诱猎物。等耳朵里藏的牙齿露出来，可能已经逃不掉。
author: tadbolmont
source: POKENAME uses its cute appearance to lure prey. By the time the teeth hidden in POKENAME's ears are visible, it may be too late to escape.

entry: 融合解放了双方超级进化形态的特征。比起两种基础形态，POKENAME明显更自信，也更爱争斗。
author: hophoppip
source: Fusion has unlocked traits from both components' Mega-Evolved forms. POKENAME is distinctly more confident and confrontational than either of its components in their base forms.

entry: POKENAME假装柔弱、害怕，让目标误以为占了上风，再用独眼一瞪，使其麻痹，吸走生命力。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME pretends to be meek and frightened in order to lull its targets into thinking they have the upper hand. It then paralyzes them with a glare from its singular eye before draining their life forces.

entry: POKENAME拥有大量脂肪与毛，对偷猎者很值钱。因此受到严密保护，也是反偷猎法律保护的许多对象之一。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME are a very valuable target for poachers, due to having large amounts of blubber and fur. They are heavily protected, and one of the many examples of targets for anti-poaching laws.

entry: 农民曾将POKENAME奉为根菜之神，每年制作木像、献上蔬菜，祈求丰收。
author: .izik
source: Farmers once worshipped POKENAME as a god of root crops. Wooden effigies of it and offerings of vegetables were made yearly to secure harvests.

entry: POKENAME用大而温柔的眼睛打动对手，让其放松警惕。它会勇敢保护训练家免受任何危险，嘴里喷出阵阵火焰。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME uses its big, tender eyes to soften its opponents and make them lower their guard. It bravely defends its Trainer from any danger, blowing puffs of fire from its mouth.

entry: POKENAME极以光亮的毛发为傲，也会替盟友梳毛，让大家都好看。有些受过训练，能用臂上利刃理发。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME are incredibly proud of their glossy fur and will also groom the fur of Pokémon they are allied with to keep them all looking good. Some POKENAME have been trained to use the sharp blades on their arms for hairdressing.

entry: POKENAME战斗时如杂技演员般跳跃，用满身锋利金属刀刃斩击。看似莽撞，其实事先观察敌人很久，发现不敌便会逃走。
author: .jerden
source: In battle, POKENAME leap around like acrobats, slashing with the sharp metal blades all over their bodies. Although they seem to attack recklessly, POKENAME spend a long time observing foes first, and will flee if they realize they are outmatched.

entry: 如果把POKENAME的毛梳反了，它会烦躁，全身噼啪释放火花。优雅举止让它受到世界各地协调训练家追捧。
author: fiordaliso
source: If POKENAME is brushed the wrong way, it becomes irritated and begins to release crackling sparks from all over its body. Due to its elegant demeanor, it is a highly sought-after Pokémon among coordinators around the world.

entry: POKENAME在世界各地水族馆演出，以美貌惊艳观众。鳞片上的斑点闪着恰到好处、不令眼睛疲劳的光，许多人喜欢凝望，平静心情。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME perform at aquariums throughout the world, dazzling audiences with their beauty. Many people enjoy staring at their dotted scales to calm their minds, as the scales shimmer with just enough light to prevent eye strain.

entry: POKENAME总伪装成值得信任的宝可梦，混进训练家队伍。一被识破，就用惊天动地的一踢将训练家击昏，再从行装中偷走物品。
author: ghostslythe
source: POKENAME always disguises itself as a trusted Pokémon, integrating with a Trainer's team. When found out, it delivers an earth-shattering kick to knock out the Trainer before stealing from their gear.

entry: POKENAME天性谨慎，因此很容易依恋温柔、细心待自己的对象。耳尖虽披柔毛，却能打出碎岩的强击。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are naturally very cautious, so they easily grow attached to those who treat them with kindness and care. Although the tips of its ears are clad in soft fur, they can use their ears to deliver rock-shattering strikes.

entry: POKENAME喜欢安抚其他生灵紧绷的神经，但这时千万别吓它。它容易受惊，会将缎带当鞭子，向突然惊吓自己的对象胡乱抽打。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME enjoys soothing the frazzled nerves of others, but care must be taken not to startle it while doing so. Its easily startled temperament leads it to use its ribbons as whips, swing wildly at those who take it by surprise.

entry: POKENAME耳中充满金属，让声音在里面回响。无需睁眼，就能轻松察觉数百英尺外的敌人，准确定位。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's ears are filled with metal that causes sound to echo within them. It can easily detect a foe from hundreds of feet away and pinpoint their precise location without opening its eyes.

entry: POKENAME无声飘在农田上方，用长缎带般的手臂偷蔬菜、树果。农民得仔细守田，免得夜夜损失。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME floats silently above farmland, stealing vegetables and berries with its long ribbon-like arms. Farmers must guard their fields carefully to avoid nightly losses.

entry: POKENAME像鞭子一样挥耳攻击。细长、灵活的身体，也让它能优雅躲闪，同时打出强力踢击。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME attacks enemies by swinging its ears around like whips. It can also dish out powerful kicks while gracefully dodging opponents' attacks thanks to its long, limber body.

entry: POKENAME像鞭子一样挥耳攻击。细长、灵活的身体，也让它能优雅躲闪，同时打出强力踢击。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME attacks enemies by swinging its ears around like whips. It can also dish out powerful kicks while gracefully dodging opponents' attacks thanks to its long, limber body.

entry: POKENAME像鞭子一样挥耳攻击。细长、灵活的身体，也让它能优雅躲闪，同时打出强力踢击。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME attacks enemies by swinging its ears around like whips. It can also dish out powerful kicks while gracefully dodging opponents' attacks thanks to its long, limber body.

entry: POKENAME像鞭子一样挥耳攻击。细长、灵活的身体，也让它能优雅躲闪，同时打出强力踢击。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME attacks enemies by swinging its ears around like whips. It can also dish out powerful kicks while gracefully dodging opponents' attacks thanks to its long, limber body.

entry: POKENAME像鞭子一样挥耳攻击。细长、灵活的身体，也让它能优雅躲闪，同时打出强力踢击。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME attacks enemies by swinging its ears around like whips. It can also dish out powerful kicks while gracefully dodging opponents' attacks thanks to its long, limber body.

entry: POKENAME像鞭子一样挥耳攻击。细长、灵活的身体，也让它能优雅躲闪，同时打出强力踢击。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME attacks enemies by swinging its ears around like whips. It can also dish out powerful kicks while gracefully dodging opponents' attacks thanks to its long, limber body.

entry: POKENAME优雅无双，深受时尚、美容爱好者追捧。它喜欢将刘海打理得完美无缺，谁弄乱发型，就会大怒。
author: fiordaliso
source: With its unmatched elegance, POKENAME is highly sought after by fashion and beauty enthusiasts. It loves having its fringe styled to perfection and becomes furious if anyone messes up its hairdo.

entry: POKENAME极擅长操纵情绪。据说抓住一条尾巴就会受诅咒，常针对并利用内心最深的恐惧。即便如此，它对孩子与无辜者却很友善。
author: nyoomymph
source: POKENAME is extremely skilled in emotional manipulation. It is said that grabbing one of its tails places a curse on the person, which often targets their deepest fears and exploits them. Despite this, POKENAME is very kind to children and innocents.

entry: POKENAME在肥沃土壤附近建造泥屋，在周围种胡萝卜。即使不吃，也会忍不住反复补种。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME builds its muddy lodge near fertile soil and plants carrot seeds around it. Even if it doesn't eat them, it compulsively replants them over and over.

entry: POKENAME的毛若梳得太快，就可能产生噼啪电火花。天生优雅，让它深受选美比赛评委欣赏。
author: fiordaliso
source: If its fur is brushed too quickly, POKENAME risks generating crackling electric sparks. Thanks to its natural elegance, it is highly esteemed by judges in beauty contests.
