entry: POKENAME天性害羞。据说，在春季节日期间看见它，预示年底前就能找到真爱。
author: bradlybro199
source: POKENAME are shy by default. It has been said that to see one during the spring holiday season, is a sign that you will find true love by the end of the year.

entry: POKENAME温暖的绒毛，让它在严寒天气也暖和。环境变暖就会大量脱毛，到处留下蓬松毛团。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's warm fluff keeps it toasty in frigid weather. If exposed to warmer conditions, it will shed profusely, leaving fluffy clumps everywhere.

entry: POKENAME现身于零度以下的雾中，许多人以为是幻觉。受到阻拦，就穿过宝可梦或训练家，让刺骨寒冷将其吓退。
author: ghostslythe
source: Believed by many to be a hallucination, POKENAME appears in sub-zero foggy conditions. If blocked, it phases through the Pokémon or Trainer, allowing the sheer cold to scare them off.

entry: POKENAME只在夜间出来狩猎，避开其他生灵的目光。若被迫来到日光下，就会胆小得无助，稍有声响便吓得僵住。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME only comes out at night, avoiding the gazes of other creatures as it goes on a hunt. If forced out into the daylight, it becomes helplessly timid, freezing up in fear at the slightest noise.

entry: POKENAME跳过雪山，落到哪里，哪里就喷起雪团。虽然漂亮，接触却会瞬间冻伤。
author: .izik
source: While hopping through snow mountains, POKENAME releases puffs of snow wherever it lands. Despite looking beautiful, these bursts of snow can cause frostbite instantly upon contact.

entry: POKENAME的毛天生极冷，被用于许多冷藏、冷冻货物的包装运输。天性护卫，会从红晶体发出寒能，形成坚冰，击退或挡住威胁。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME fur is so naturally cold that it is used in the packaging and transit of many chilled and frozen goods. Protective by nature, POKENAME emit chilling energy from their red crystals to form solid ice to repel or block threats.

entry: 受到妥善关爱与照料，POKENAME便会茁壮成长，比进化前更有自信。不过，对不信任的陌生人，它仍很少开口歌唱。
author: hexx_vixtar
source: With proper love and care, POKENAME will grow and have more confidence than its pre-evolution. However, it seldom sings to strangers it doesn't trust.

entry: POKENAME用长而强的耳朵抓住舞伴，牢牢抱到舞毕。最后一幕，会挥耳将舞伴旋着送走。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses its long and strong ears to grab itself a dance partner, holding them firmly until the dance is done. For the dance's finale, it sends its partner twirling away with a swing of its ears.

entry: POKENAME背上的物质摸着像蓬松毛发，其实是真菌。柔软得有时会被其他宝可梦当枕头睡觉，不过只要是朋友，它似乎就不介意。
author: .jerden
source: The substance on POKENAME's back feels like fluffy fur, although it is technically a fungus. It is so soft that other Pokémon sometimes fall asleep using POKENAME as a pillow, but it doesn't seem to mind if a Pokémon it is friendly with does this.

entry: POKENAME不仅能感知周围想法，还能听见数英里外的动静，几乎无法伏击。感知威胁后，会先用杖上的火焰分散注意，再踢出足以碎骨的一击。
author: ghostslythe
source: Not only can POKENAME sense the thoughts of those around them, they can also hear movements for miles. Nearly impossible to ambush, if they sense a threat, they will distract it using flame on their wand before delivering a kick that shatters bone.

entry: POKENAME极以发冠为傲，用来向同群彰显优势。亲近的生灵遭威胁，就先把发冠收进毛兜帽保护好，再无情攻击冒犯者。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME takes immense pride in its crest of hair, which is used to assert dominance with others of its colony. If its loved ones are threatened, it pulls its crest into the fur hood to protect it, then it mercilessly attacks the offender.

entry: POKENAME对穿过家园的来者既谨慎，又好奇。若喜欢某个人，就会从毛上吹出微小晶体，映着光闪耀出多种鲜亮色彩。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is cautious but curious towards others who manage to traverse its home. If it likes a person, it will blow minuscule crystals off of its fur at them that catch the light and glitter in a myriad of bright colors.

entry: 柔软的毛被制成小钥匙扣，据说能带来爱情好运。POKENAME若游在太淡的水中，就会失去光泽，因此更喜欢定居海湾。
author: fiordaliso
source: Small keychains are made with its soft fur, said to bring luck in love. If the water it swims in is too fresh, POKENAME loses its luster; for this reason, it prefers to settle in marine bays.

entry: 虽然POKENAME外表可爱、亲人，谁敢未经允许接近训练家，就会变得极其凶狠。它习惯将小饰品与闪亮物件藏在柔毛里。
author: fiordaliso
source: Despite its cute and affectionate appearance, POKENAME can become extremely fierce if anyone dares to approach its Trainer without permission. It has a habit of hiding trinkets and shiny objects in its soft fur.

entry: POKENAME很胆小，力量却比外表看起来强得多。受惊会用拳头或耳朵猛击敌人，但一打中就立刻逃走躲藏。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a timid Pokémon, but is deceptively strong as well. If startled, it can hit a foe with a powerful blow from its fists or ears, but will run away and hide immediately after the strike connects.

entry: POKENAME偏爱根菜，常用精神力量小心托起。农民借助成群个体收获，但要说服它们放下蔬菜，可能很难。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have an affinity for root vegetables and are often seen using their psychic powers to carefully levitate them. Farmers make use of herds of POKENAME to help with their harvest, though persuading them to drop the vegetables can be difficult.

entry: POKENAME在繁忙街道卖艺，表演魔术。观众被花巧戏法与偶尔展示的肌肉迷住时，树果和宝可元就已藏进它柔软的耳毛里。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME can be found busking along busy streets, performing magic tricks. While the audience is dazzled by flashy tricks and the occasional flex, their berries and Pokédollars end up hidden in POKENAME's soft ear tufts.

entry: POKENAME强劲双腿能跃过对手，迅速穿行战场。挥舞胡萝卜的力道，足以将小宝可梦打飞。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's powerful legs allow it to leap over opponents and quickly maneuver across the battlefield. It swings its carrot with enough force to send small Pokémon flying.

entry: POKENAME受威胁就会爆炸，将孢子散到大片区域，长出巨大的蘑菇群。
author: hophoppip
source: When threatened, POKENAME explodes. The explosion scatters spores across a wide radius, which grow into enormous patches of mushrooms.

entry: 为了自卫，同窝中央的蛋会将其他成员远远投向敌人。这不会伤害同伴，它们很快便跳回队形，准备需要时再被扔出。
author: sk372
source: For self-defense, the center egg in the clutch will launch other members of the group at foes from a distance. This causes no harm to the others, and they'll quickly hop back into formation, ready to be tossed again if needed.

entry: 中央POKENAME的树状触角探测树果，其余五只负责采集。感知到附近水果，就以超过每小时二十英里的速度滚动，经过时用精神力量托起食物，连野餐篮也不放过。
author: ghostslythe
source: The tree-like antenna on the central POKENAME detects berries, while the other five gather food. When they sense fruit nearby, they roll at over twenty miles per hour, lifting food psychically as they pass, including picnic baskets.

entry: POKENAME头如骷髅，由塞满孢子的密实菌丝组成。受损时孢子散开，能让附近生灵发热。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's skull-like head is composed of dense mycelium packed with spores. If damaged, the spores disperse and can induce fevers in those nearby.

entry: POKENAME被毒气充胀，如散出的真菌孢子般浮在空中。自行移动虽慢，风却能将它与孢子吹到远方。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME is inflated by toxic gas, allowing it to float in the air like the fungal spores it scatters. Although it is slow when moving under its own power, both POKENAME and its spores can be blown long distances by the wind.

entry: POKENAME察觉危险靠近，会让身体硬化。若遭打击，就释放一团孢子，让攻击者沉睡。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME hardens its body when danger is near. If struck, it releases a burst of spores that lull attackers into a deep sleep.

entry: POKENAME从体内喷出鲜艳气云，每种颜色的副作用不同，从恶心、幻觉，到类似流感的症状都有。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME spews clouds of brightly-colored gas from inside its body. Each color has its own side effect, ranging from nausea to hallucinations and even flu-like symptoms.

entry: POKENAME将硬化的真菌双臂在岩石上磨薄如刀，闪电般劈向树木，留下深切口，里面满是快速蔓延的真菌。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME sharpens its hardened fungal arms against rocks to keep them razor-thin. It slashes at trees with lightning speed, leaving deep cuts filled with fast-spreading fungi.

entry: POKENAME振翅攻击时，能随机引发一种异常状态。甜香却有毒的花粉团，也能帮它引诱猎物。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME flaps its wings to attack and cause a random status condition. It can lure prey with its sweet-yet-poisonous pollen puffs.

entry: POKENAME从树枝跳到经过的宝可梦身上，前往新的觅食地。被捕食者攻击，就弹向威胁，试着注入虚弱毒素，或散出催眠孢子。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME will leap from tree branches onto passing Pokémon to be transported to new feeding grounds. If attacked by a predator, it launches itself toward the threat, aiming to inject a debilitating toxin or scatter sleep-inducing spores.

entry: POKENAME在藻类丰富的水域安家。头部散出的孢子被吸入后，能缓解所载乘客的晕船与压力。
author: sk372
source: It makes its home in aquatic areas with high algae content. POKENAME dispenses spores from its head, easing seasickness and stress in the passengers it ferries when they're inhaled.

entry: POKENAME吞食程序时，释放黄色孢子云。孢子会造成轻微灼伤，让它不受打扰地进食。
author: .izik
source: While consuming programs, POKENAME releases a cloud of yellow spores. The spores cause mild burns, allowing it to feed undisturbed.

entry: POKENAME用宽头保护脆弱颈部。敌人靠得够近，就用孢子使其麻痹。
author: mudults
source: POKENAME uses its wide head to protect its frail neck. If its enemy comes close enough, it will paralyze it with spores.

entry: POKENAME尾巴落下的孢子散着蜂蜜般甜香。但吸入太多，会引发高热与鲜明幻觉。
author: .izik
source: The spores that fall from POKENAME's tail emit a sweet honey-like scent. However, inhaling too much can cause intense fevers and vivid hallucinations.

entry: POKENAME一头冲进危险，读取宝可梦和训练家的心思，在战斗中取得优势。
author: pastapockets
source: POKENAME charges into danger headfirst. It reads the minds of Pokémon and trainers to gain an advantage in battle.

entry: POKENAME冬季尤其凶悍，会追逐一切移动的东西，想用小而有力的双颚咬碎。脚步轻快灵活，几乎无法逃脱。
author: darkweavile428
source: Becoming especially aggressive during winter, POKENAME will chase down anything that moves, attempting to crush them with its small, yet powerful jaws. Its spritely footwork makes escaping it almost impossible.

entry: POKENAME飞过灌木丛，双翼释放真菌孢子，附在地面与周围树上。飞行属性宝可梦若闯进领地，就会遭猛烈头撞击落。
author: fiordaliso
source: When POKENAME flutters through the undergrowth, its wings release fungal spores that cling to the ground and surrounding trees. It knocks down any Flying-type Pokémon that wanders into its territory with devastating headbutts.

entry: POKENAME摇动蓬松尾巴，会散出数万亿微小紫孢子，让捕食者入睡，自己安然逃走。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME wags its fluffy tail, it releases trillions of tiny purple spores. These spores lull predators to sleep, allowing it to escape unharmed.

entry: 飞行时，它散下粉尘，给下方生灵带来快乐。起初被认为有魔力，研究却发现，其实是能改变吸入者精神状态的孢子。
author: hophoppip
source: As it flies, it scatters dust that brings joy to those below. This dust was initially believed to be magical, but research has found that it actually consists of spores that alter the mental state of those who inhale them.

entry: POKENAME会在森林冥想，据说因此能看见未来。它释放孢子，减弱周围负面情绪，让自己安心冥想。
author: actliux
source: POKENAME can be found meditating in forests, a process that is said to allow them to see into the future. They release a spore that dampens negative emotions around them, allowing POKENAME to meditate in peace.

entry: POKENAME高居古树筑巢。受威胁时剧烈拍翼，放出孢子云，遮住林地，再俯冲向猎物。
author: greekgodu4got
source: POKENAME nests high among ancient trees. When threatened, it beats its wings violently, releasing clouds of spores that obscure the forest floor before diving upon its prey.

entry: POKENAME住在繁茂洞窟，以尾巴供给光与暖，让附近植物不靠阳光也能生长。
author: kittyluv090
source: POKENAME lives in lush caves, using its tail as a source of light and warmth for nearby plants to grow without the need for sunlight.

entry: POKENAME被视为世上最快乐的宝可梦之一。靠能伸长的手臂、强壮尾巴和擅长跳跃的双腿，采集高树的树果，与泉池家园的其他生灵分享。
author: tisgabe
source: POKENAME are seen as some of the jolliest Pokémon in the world. Using their extendable arms, strong tails, and powerful jumping legs, they love collecting berries high in the trees to share with others in their habitats of springs and ponds.

entry: POKENAME吼叫时，气流从头部孔洞冲出，散开浓厚孢子云。黄昏沼泽常能听见大群嘈杂合鸣，警告外来者别进领地。
author: sara886a
source: Its bellowing forces air out through the pores on its head, releasing a thick cloud of spores. The cacophony of large groups of POKENAME can often be heard in swamps at dusk, serving as a warning to stay out of their territory.

entry: POKENAME散出成簇漂浮孢子，随风飘过数英里。落上肥沃土壤，就迅速萌成奇怪真菌。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spreads clusters of floating spores that drift for miles on the wind. If these spores land in fertile soil, they quickly sprout into strange fungi.

entry: POKENAME的毛皮逐渐变暗，直到满月升起。随后尾巴喷出无数细孢子，累得倒下。到了早晨，又变成浅得多的绿色。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME's pelt slowly gets darker until a full moon appears. Once the full moon appears in the sky, it then spews forth countless tiny spores from its tail before collapsing, exhausted. By morning, it becomes a much paler green.

entry: POKENAME在城市装得无害、不起眼。目标人物一放松警惕，就伸长手臂，偷走小饰品，转身跑掉。
author: sk372
source: In urban environments, POKENAME acts like it is harmless and inconspicuous. Once it's targeted human has let their guard down, it uses its extendable arms to reach out and nab their trinkets before running off.

entry: 外壳如钢铁般坚硬、耐用。虽然形似昆虫，内部其实完全由真菌组成。
author: hophoppip
source: Its outer shell is as hard and durable as steel. While it resembles an insect, its insides are actually made entirely of fungus.

entry: POKENAME扫过森林地面，捡拾各种碎屑建壳。壳与沿途排泄物都是真菌的丰富营养，对人类和宝可梦却有毒，会引发呕吐。
author: notadoctor75
source: POKENAME trawls the forest floor, picking up all sorts of detritus that it uses to build its shell. While its shell and the excretions it leaves behind are highly nutritious to fungi, both are toxic to people and Pokémon, and will induce vomiting.

entry: POKENAME常沐浴在林冠间透下的阳光中。受打扰，就从头顶菇帽喷出一团毒孢子攻击。
author: kam_doodle_snek
source: POKENAME can often be found bathing under the sunlight that peeks through the canopy. When disturbed, it attacks with a burst of poisonous spores from the cap on its head.

entry: POKENAME的角由两种蔬菜组成，有些摊贩收来做特色菜。取下后，几周内便能长回。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's antlers are made up of two different types of vegetables, and some food vendors harvest their antlers to make specialty dishes. Its antlers grow back a few weeks after removal.

entry: 头上的蘑菇太重，小巧的身体已难以支撑。因此，POKENAME索性用蘑菇撑地旋转，借离心力踢击敌人，同时散播孢子。
author: sontyp
source: The mushroom on its head became too heavy for its small body to effectively carry. Instead, POKENAME spins around on it, delivering kicks and spreading spores via centrifugal forces.

entry: POKENAME能从颚中向敌人吐出强酸毒液。主要吃危害树木、蘑菇的昆虫，帮助维持当地生态。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME can spit highly acidic poison from its jaws at its enemies. It feeds mainly on insects harmful to trees and mushrooms, contributing to the preservation of the ecosystem it inhabits.

entry: POKENAME平时冷静、沉着。但若被逼入绝境或惹怒，就用菇帽的孔洞引发火焰爆炸，宛如火山喷发。
author: zweizweihander
source: POKENAME usually stays calm and collected. However, should it ever feel cornered or enraged, it will use the holes in its cap to emit a fiery explosion similar to a volcanic eruption.

entry: 它轻巧地奔过大地，宛如优雅滑翔。吸收水中污染来制造毒孢子，同时净化了水。
author: h0bojoe
source: It runs across the land with light footwork akin to elegant gliding. It absorbs pollution from water to produce poisonous spores, purifying the water in the process.

entry: POKENAME双臂看似短，却能伸得很长，抓挠敌人。它掀起沙与孢子混合的猛烈风暴，遮住视野、使其麻痹，令其他生灵迷乱。
author: sk372
source: Though its arms appear short, they can extend to great lengths to scrape at its foes. POKENAME whips up mighty storms comprised of a sand-and-spore mixture that disorients and confounds others with blindness and paralysis.

entry: 冬季将近，它们就藏进洞窟，因为身体对外面冰冷天气很敏感。组成小群，紧紧挤进洞里，冬眠直到季节结束。
author: quackquackattack
source: They hide in caves when winter approaches, as their bodies are sensitive to the frosty weather conditions outside. They form small herds and tightly pack themselves into a cave before hibernating until the season is over.

entry: POKENAME头部散出的孢子会令附近电脑设备故障。但只要用布擦掉孢子，就能解决。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME scatters spores from its head, they cause malfunctions in nearby computer equipment. Resolving these issues is as simple as wiping the spores away with a cloth.

entry: POKENAME用利爪挖地，通常只深到刚够藏身，等猎物或躲危险。背上的蘑菇让它在森林、洞旁很容易隐藏。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME use their sharp claws to burrow into the ground, usually just enough to hide and wait for prey or avoid dangers. Thanks to the mushrooms on their backs, they can easily hide in forests or near caves.

entry: POKENAME用火引燃手腕里的孢子，打出强力拳击。训练场上满是烧焦孢子的臭味。
author: musicsheep.
source: POKENAME uses fire to combust spores inside its wrists and punches opponents with intense force. POKENAME training grounds reek of singed spores.

entry: POKENAME尾巴力量巨大，能将自己弹上很高之处，够到结有最爱苦味树果的树冠。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME packs a lot of power in its tail. Using it, it can propel itself upwards quite a large distance, which it uses to reach the canopy of trees that bear its favorite bitter-tasting berries.

entry: POKENAME假装成无害蘑菇，轻轻摇摆，吸引好奇宝可梦。靠近后，伞状菇帽释放有催眠、镇静作用的孢子，让对手迷糊、出神。
author: tanglyatol9866
source: POKENAME disguises itself as a harmless mushroom, swaying gently to lure in curious Pokémon. When they come close, it releases spores from its parasol-like cap that induce a hypnotic, calming effect, leaving opponents dazed and entranced.

entry: POKENAME的装甲富弹性，能抵御物理撞击。它从头孔喷出孢子云，削弱对手。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's armor is elastic and springy, allowing it to resist physical impacts. It will spray a cloud of spores from the holes on its head to weaken its opponents.

entry: POKENAME培育来自各处森林的孢子，长出多种蘑菇，为小宝可梦提供庇护、照料。可惜，住客若太闹腾，就会不慎扬起孢子，弄得头晕。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Cultivating spores from across forests, POKENAME grows a variety of mushrooms to provide shelter and care for smaller Pokémon. Unfortunately, if its residents get too rambunctious, they accidentally kick up spores and get dizzy.

entry: POKENAME学会朝橡胶身体的伤口吹气，将骨头像气球一样鼓起。这样能让破坏力增至十倍。
author: slimninja55
source: POKENAME has developed a technique where it blows into the wounds on its rubber body to inflate its bones like balloons. This increases its destructive power tenfold.

entry: POKENAME凭坚定意志硬化四肢，同时保留肌肉的橡胶弹性。只一瞪，就足以让弱小或不自信的宝可梦停下脚步。
author: slimninja55
source: POKENAME's raw determination has hardened its limbs while still keeping the rubbery flexibility of its muscles. A single glare from a POKENAME is enough to stop weaker or less confident Pokémon in their tracks.

entry: POKENAME用伸展的鳍肢，拳打送食物的陌生人，只接受信任的训练家投喂。即使生病、受伤，也会自己寻找树果。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: With its stretchy flippers, POKENAME punches strangers who offer it food, accepting food only from its trusted Trainer. It forages for berries even when sick or injured.

entry: 它随时准备迎战，双臂锋利如刃，覆着麻痹孢子，出手精准。严整的举止下藏着强烈的决心，既精通搏斗，也擅长施加异常状态。
author: thepandasharky
source: Always ready for a fight, it strikes with precise, blade-like arms coated in paralyzing spores. Its disciplined demeanor hides a fierce determination, making it a master of both combat and status-inflicting techniques.

entry: POKENAME起飞时，华美双翼释放真菌孢子，吸入者都会入睡。它需要潮湿、黑暗才能繁盛，因此常在密林大树根部安家。
author: fiordaliso
source: When it takes flight, its majestic wings release fungal spores that put anyone who breathes them to sleep. POKENAME tends to make its home at the base of large trees in dense forests, as it needs plenty of moisture and darkness to thrive.

entry: POKENAME在森林菌丛旁扎根，吸收土壤养分。缎带能伸到很远，不必拔根，也能让旅人心情变好。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME roots itself in the forest near fungi groves, absorbing nutrients from the ground. Its ribbons can extend large distances, allowing it to boost the mood of travelers without needing to uproot itself.

entry: POKENAME尾端球茎含镇静成分，味道、香气受饮食影响。许多著名草本饮品，就是将一颗球茎泡入沸水制成。
author: infinex21
source: The bulbs at the ends of a POKENAME's tail contain calming compounds, with flavors and scents influenced by the POKENAME's diet. There are many renowned herbal beverages that are made by mixing one of these bulbs into boiling water.

entry: 它摇头、摆尾，散出无数孢子，影响附近植物，尤其花朵，使其散发舒缓香气。
author: infinex21
source: By shaking its head and tail, it can scatter countless spores. These spores influence nearby plants, particularly flowers, and cause them to exude calming aromas.

entry: POKENAME住在真菌遍布的森林地底深处，会突然冒出，攻击采蘑菇太多的人。身体能迅速伸到原长两倍，惩罚很难逃脱。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME lives deep underground in fungi-infested forests, popping up to attack those who forage too many mushrooms. It can quickly extend its body to twice its normal length, making it difficult to escape its punishment.

entry: 传说，POKENAME曾在空地冬眠数千年，生命与自然从身体蔓延，形成森林与农业。头顶蘑菇据说是生命之源。
author: actliux
source: Legends say that POKENAME once hibernated for thousands of years in an empty field, where life and nature spread from their bodies creating forests and agriculture. The mushroom growing from their head is said to be their life source.

entry: POKENAME战斗时从双臂喷出强力孢子，力道如霰弹枪。脸上的面具，保护自己免受孢子危害。
author: mistymagius
source: In combat, POKENAME fires powerful blasts of spores from its arms with the force of a shotgun. The mask covering its face protects it from the ill effects of its spores.

entry: 那颗友好的头并非POKENAME真脸，真脸藏在胸前花纹中。它用友善假面引诱猎物。
author: themisterlitwick
source: The friendly looking head is not POKENAME's actual face, its actual face is hidden within the pattern on its chest. POKENAME uses the friendly facade to lure in its prey.

entry: POKENAME无论战斗，还是在深林训练幼小斗笠菇，破坏力都很惊人。合众文献称它们为“森林领主”。
author: ilazerheart
source: POKENAME are a destructive force in combat and when training younger Breloom deep in the forests. Texts from Unova call these Pokémon “forest-lords”.

entry: POKENAME菇帽遮住眼睛，视野受限，只能依赖嗅觉。它整天游荡洞穴，走到哪里，就将孢子散到哪里。
author: .izik
source: The mushroom cap covering POKENAME's eyes limits its vision, forcing it to rely on its sense of smell. It spends its days wandering caves, spreading spores wherever it goes.

entry: POKENAME一有机会就耍阴招。常用战术是每次出拳都摇头，让头顶球茎散出孢子，给对手沾满麻痹物质。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME fight underhanded any chance they get. A popular tactic among them involves shaking their head with each strike of their arms; spores disperse from the bulb on their head, coating their opponent in a paralytic agent.

entry: 尾巴由真菌群落组成。任何一条被拉扯、刺激，就会释放孢子，吸入能引发重病。
author: hophoppip
source: Its tails consist of colonies of fungi. When one of its tails is pulled or agitated, it releases spores, which cause a dire illness if inhaled.

entry: POKENAME白天钻入地下，只在夜间出来散播孢子。它从长满蘑菇的头部洒粉，伪装在树根与落叶间。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME burrows underground during the day, only emerging at night to spread its spores. It spreads powder from its mushroom-covered head to camouflage itself among tree roots and fallen leaves.

entry: POKENAME从爪子释放孢子，战斗时让自己精神振奋。爪子胡乱挥舞，看不出任何规律。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME releases spores from its claws that invigorate it during combat. It swings these claws wildly and without any recognizable pattern.

entry: POKENAME尾部不断涌出彩色孢子云。每种颜色对吸入者效果不同，但它不太能控制释放哪种。
author: hophoppip
source: A cloud of colorful spores constantly billows from its tail. Each color of spore has a different effect on those who inhale it, and POKENAME has poor control over which color of spores it releases.

entry: 冬天常有客人拜访洞穴，只要蘑菇栽培不受干扰，它们愿意分享空间。不守规矩的客人，则会被手中混合孢子安抚、催眠。
author: quackquackattack
source: They frequently receive guests at their caves in winter and are willing to share the space if they remain uninterrupted in their mushroom cultivation. They pacify and lull unruly guests to sleep using a mixture of spores from their hands.

entry: POKENAME用头顶能伸长的真菌耳朵打击其他生灵，自我防卫。接触的撞击会散出孢子，引发严重皮疹，阻止敌人继续攻击。
author: sk372
source: To defend itself, POKENAME strikes at others with the extending fungus-ears on the top of its head. Impacts spread spores on contact that cause nasty rashes, dissuading foes from continuing to attack it.

entry: POKENAME腿部含强力毒素，一踢就能让敌人麻痹。孢子混合毒液后，吸入还会产生幻觉。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's legs contain powerful toxins that can paralyze foes with a single kick. Its spores blend with its venom, creating a hallucinogenic effect when inhaled.

entry: POKENAME飘过冰山，播种，培育特殊花园。它向寒冷中的旅人送利木果，给予抵达安全之地所需的力量。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME drift along frozen mountains, planting seeds to sprout special gardens. They offer Aspear Berries to travelers in the cold, granting them the strength they need to make it to safety.

entry: POKENAME一动不动地站在树桩上，鼻子滴下奶油般、带莓榴果香气的树液。香味引来宝宝丁等小猎物，再无情使出终极吸取，抽干对方。
author: .izik
source: A creamy, Haban Berry-scented sap drips from POKENAME's nose as it stands motionless on tree stumps. This aroma attracts small prey like Igglybuff, which it mercilessly drains with Giga Drain.

entry: POKENAME始终在翅膀覆盖厚孢子层，防御捕食者。更喜欢在潮湿森林的空心树里筑巢。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME protects itself from predators by constantly covering its wings in a thick layer of spores. It prefers nesting in hollowed out trees in damp forests.

entry: POKENAME总想在人类花园寻求庇护。但产生的花粉会吸引啮齿动物，有时反而使自己被吃掉。
author: rumia_archer
source: POKENAME are always looking for refuge in people's gardens. However, the pollen they produce can attract rodents, which sometimes leads to POKENAME being eaten.

entry: POKENAME耐用的甲壳由厚钢组成，几乎无法穿透。身体极重，从树顶掉下会砸出小坑。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's durable carapace is made out of thick steel that is almost impenetrable. Its body is incredibly heavy, causing small craters when it falls from the treetops.

entry: POKENAME尾随旅人，朝其散毒孢子，直到无法行动。再补上最后一拳击昏，抢走货物与物品。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME trails behind travelers and scatters poisonous spores at them until they become immobilized. It then delivers a final knockout punch to them before robbing their wares and items.

entry: POKENAME在洞穴家园铺展菌丝，留待日后食用。菌丝极甜，被关都各地用于纸杯蛋糕配方。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME weaves mycelium throughout its cavern home to consume at a later date. The mycelium is extremely sweet and has been used in cupcake recipes throughout Kanto.

entry: POKENAME等生灵走进张开的嘴，再合嘴困住。过一阵吐出来，对方带着几处真菌增生物，走开了。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME waits for creatures to walk into its open mouth, before closing it and trapping them within. Some time later, it spits them back out, the creatures walking away with several fungal growths attached.

entry: 捕食者对POKENAME施以物理攻击时必须小心，可能打落含强毒的身体碎块。它抓刨地面，向空气释放催眠孢子，让靠近的猎物无法行动。
author: soup1900
source: Predators hunting POKENAME must be wary when attacking it physically since doing so could break off parts of its body containing potent toxins. By clawing the ground, it releases sleep spores into the air to incapacitate prey that gets near it.

entry: POKENAME身上的红石其实富有弹性，能伸长，更容易劈砍敌人。石头易碎，里面包裹的毒素会因此释放到空气中。
author: soup1900
source: The red rocks on POKENAME's body are actually stretchy and can be extended out to more easily slice foes. These rocks can break easily, causing the toxins they encapsulate to be released into the air.

entry: POKENAME头顶蘑菇不断释放橙色孢子云，感染土壤，一夜间就能长出大片发光真菌。
author: .izik
source: The mushroom on POKENAME's head releases a constant cloud of orange spores. These spores can infect the soil, causing large patches of glowing fungi to grow overnight.

entry: POKENAME住进森林后，当地会逐渐变得漆黑。因为释放的孢子长成真菌，吸收周围一切光源。
author: sk372
source: When POKENAME inhabits a forest, it slowly becomes pitch-black within the area. This is due to the spores it releases growing fungi that absorb all sources of light in the surrounding region.

entry: POKENAME常在大树荫下放松、冥想。双臂能像斗笠菇一样伸长，将爪子猛然射出，力道足以击碎实心岩石。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME can usually be found relaxing or meditating in the shade of large trees. It has the ability to extend its arms just like Breloom, giving it the capability of launching its claws forward hard enough to smash solid rock.

entry: 挥动棒子散下的孢子，能引发幻觉。见到幻象的人，便误以为是魔法。
author: bostroms
source: The spores it scatters from waving its stick around are known to cause hallucinations. People who experience these visions mistake them for acts of magic.

entry: POKENAME用覆满活孢子的树枝充当简易法杖，传导神秘能量。精准武术与精神能量冲击结合，孢子还能以柔和橙光燃烧。
author: guilimao_22_71400
source: A POKENAME channels mystical energy through its makeshift staff made from a branch covered in living spores. It combines precise martial arts strikes with bursts of psychic energy. Its spores can burn softly in orange hues.

entry: POKENAME无声而迅速地穿行森林，向敌人撒孢子，使其入睡。再轻松潜过，或施以凶狠打击，确保对方保持昏迷。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME moves swiftly through the forest, barely making any sound. It will toss spores at its enemies to make them fall asleep, then either sneak past them with ease, or deliver vicious blows to ensure they remain unconscious.

entry: POKENAME起舞时，头顶蘑菇放出孢子云。据说，它经过后，便会出现整片真菌丛。
author: mepp.
source: As POKENAME dances, clouds of spores are released from the mushroom on its head. Entire groves of fungi are said to appear after it passes through.

entry: POKENAME在森林挖掘，或抓开原木，寻找真菌吃。它很会发现珍贵、美味的大蘑菇，采菇人因此常跟在身后。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME digs in forests or claws apart logs in search of fungi to eat. Mushroom foragers often follow it since this Pokémon is adept at finding valuable and delicious Big Mushrooms.

entry: POKENAME很挑剔，经常在阳光与阴影间更换小睡地点。寻找芳香蘑菇的本领惊人，但只愿分给拿兰萨果等零食交换的对象。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is picky, frequently changing its napping location between sunspots and dark shade. It has an uncanny ability for finding Balm Mushrooms, but only shares them with those who will trade it for treats like Lansat Berries.

entry: POKENAME因自身蘑菇的孢子，一直头痛。痛得太厉害便会猛烈乱动，结果反而产生更多孢子。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME suffers from constant headaches due to the spores of its own mushrooms. It will thrash around if its headaches become too painful, which just ends up producing even more spores.

entry: POKENAME在河湖旁的潮湿林地安家，湿气让它活泼、敏捷。每次出拳命中，身体都会飘出孢子，滋养环境，促进蘑菇蔓延。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME makes its home in damp woodlands near rivers and lakes, where the humidity keeps it lively and swift. With every punch it connects, spores drift from its body, enriching the environment and fostering the spread of mushrooms.

entry: 传说，POKENAME权杖般的法杖，能奉命让蘑菇瞬间萌生、长大。但它大多时间藏在林荫与水下，传闻仍未证实。
author: fiordaliso
source: Legends say that POKENAME's scepter-like staff can make mushrooms sprout and grow instantly by its command. As it spends most of its time hiding in forest shadows and beneath water, these rumors remain unverified.

entry: POKENAME独特、沙哑的蛙鸣，让它在儿童作品中很受欢迎。常担任主角，成为剧情的道德核心。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The distinctive croaky cries of POKENAME make them a popular choice for children's media. They often take a starring role in these productions, serving as the moral core for plotlines.

entry: POKENAME用伸展的双臂攻击，接连使出音速拳。感到威胁就逃向湖泊，只将鲜绿菇帽与红眼露出水面。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME strike at their foes with their stretchy arms, attacking with a rapid series of Mach Punch attacks. They flee toward lakes when they feel threatened, keeping only their bright green cap and red eyes above the water's surface.

entry: POKENAME夜间出行，在自然遭破坏的地方散播种子、孢子，帮助恢复。强劲小腿让它走过数英里，也不觉疼痛。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME travel through the night, spreading seeds and spores in places of destroyed nature to facilitate the process of regrowth. Thanks to their powerful calves, they can travel for miles without pain.

entry: POKENAME孢子的甜香浓得惊人，吸引寻找花蜜的宝可梦。但闻得太多，会严重眩晕、嗜睡。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's spores smell overwhelmingly sweet, attracting Pokémon looking for nectar. However, inhaling too much of its scent causes intense dizziness and drowsiness.

entry: POKENAME皮肉坚韧得能承受炸药，巧的是，战斗拳击也有同样的爆炸力。它喜欢打滚，沿途留下毒孢子云。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME's flesh is tough enough to withstand dynamite. Coincidentally, the punches it delivers in battles pack the same explosive force as dynamite. It likes to roll around and will leave clouds of poisonous spores in its wake when it does so.

entry: POKENAME孢子极易燃，背上火焰让散孢子的尾巴变成简易喷火器。弹性双腿让它一跃100英尺。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME spores are so flammable that the flames on its back turn its spore-emitting tail into a makeshift flamethrower. Its elastic legs allow POKENAME to leap of 100 feet in a single bound.

entry: POKENAME全速穿过树林，留下温暖孢子，让植物更快开花。为彰显领地统治地位，会向对手发起极速赛跑。
author: fiordaliso
source: When it runs at full speed through the woods, POKENAME leaves behind a trail of warm spores that cause plants to bloom more quickly. To assert its dominance over its territory, it challenges its opponents to extremely fast races.

entry: POKENAME全身覆盖柔软、蘑菇般的材料。许多厨师取下小块，用来制作以罗子果为基底的浓郁酱汁。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body is covered in a soft, mushroom-like material. Many chefs harvest small portions of it to craft rich, Rindo Berry-based sauces.

entry: POKENAME污泥般的真菌身体，分解有机物为食。所居森林的植物迅速腐烂，形成富营养土壤，让新植物生长。
author: hophoppip
source: Its sludgy, fungal body breaks down organic matter for food. The plants in forests where POKENAME dwells decay rapidly, creating nutrient-rich soil for new plants to grow in.

entry: POKENAME是尽职的森林守护者，用水炮浇花，也驱赶入侵者。壳中混合不同孢子与树果，能为水添加多种营养。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Dutiful protectors of the forest, POKENAME use their water cannons to both water flowers and repel intruders. By mixing different spores and berries within their shells, POKENAME can add a multitude of nutritional properties to their water.

entry: POKENAME常住在草木丛生、孢子弥漫的洞穴中，用壳上鱼叉般的尖刺，牢牢钩住洞壁。
author: hummusishome
source: POKENAME are often found in overgrown caves full of their spores. They hold onto cave walls with the harpoon-like spikes protruding from its shell.

entry: POKENAME是调皮捕食者的典型，用蘑菇尖端的尾巴在森林布下隐藏孢子陷阱。入侵者一触发，就会开心怪笑着出现，为下一餐有着落而欢喜。
author: silentscript89
source: POKENAME defines the role of the mischievous predator by using its mushroom-tipped tail to scatter concealed spore traps throughout the forest. When an intruder sets one off, it appears with a gleeful cackle, joyous to have secured its next meal.

entry: POKENAME的精神鞭只需一碰，就能让几乎任何敌人入睡。手臂还能伸长，让鞭子够得更远。
author: darkweavile428
source: A single touch of POKENAME's psychic whip is all it takes to put nearly any foe to sleep. POKENAME can stretch its arm to make the whip reach even farther.

entry: POKENAME在散发着潮湿气味的森林中挪动，想要融入菌丝与苔藓之间。它的孢子具有强烈的催眠效果，令人畏惧。
author: xephyr
source: POKENAME shuffle around in musky forests, hoping to blend in with the mycelium and moss. Their spores are feared for their drowsy potency.

entry: POKENAME另外五颗头绕着基部的头极速旋转，快得几乎看不见。移动时用念力移开障碍，确保航路顺畅。
author: .izik
source: The other five heads of POKENAME rotate around the base head at extremely high speeds, making them seem almost invisible. Its telekinetic powers allow it to move debris out of its way while traveling, ensuring a smooth flight path.

entry: POKENAME双翼与步法让它战斗时快得目不暇接。对手才刚出招，它已经绕到背后，以强力踢击反击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's wings and footwork move it at blindingly-fast speeds in combat. By the time an opponent has started to strike at it, POKENAME has already moved behind them and countered with a powerful kick.

entry: POKENAME攀在树上，保存能量，等待进化完成。但并非无力自保，捕食者靠近时，储能能让它突然高速飞走。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME clings to trees to conserve energy while it waits out its evolution process. It is not helpless, however, as the stored energy allows it to fly away suddenly at high speeds should a predator approach.

entry: POKENAME速度快得不可思议，肢体也锋利得惊人，形象令人难忘。甚至有以烈腿蝗为主题的超级英雄电视系列，参考它设计了劲敌角色。
author: sk372
source: Impossibly fast and possessing impossibly sharp limbs, POKENAME's image is highly memorable. Its form is popular enough to inspire the creation of a rival character in a TV franchise featuring Lokix-themed superheroes.

entry: POKENAME疾飞时，快速振翅发出尖哨；吃到美味树液，也会借此表达喜悦。颤鸣声评价两极，有人觉得是夏日舒缓旋律，有人却很烦。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME's rapid wingbeats generate a whistling shriek as it zips around or expresses pleasure when it eats delicious sap. The trilling cry of POKENAME is divisive as some feel it is the relaxing theme of summer, while others find it irritating.

entry: POKENAME疾飞时，快速振翅发出尖哨；吃到美味树液，也会借此表达喜悦。颤鸣声评价两极，有人觉得是夏日舒缓旋律，有人却很烦。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME's rapid wingbeats generate a whistling shriek as it zips around or expresses pleasure when it eats delicious sap. The trilling cry of POKENAME is divisive as some feel it is the relaxing theme of summer, while others find it irritating.

entry: POKENAME飞得太快，许多人不确定究竟是飞行，还是在各处瞬移。出击前先用精神攻击使猎物麻痹，不留逃跑或防御的机会。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's flight speed is so fast that many are unsure if it is actually flying or teleporting from location to location. It paralyzes prey with psychic attacks before striking, granting its target no chance to escape or defend itself.

entry: POKENAME速度快，是出色的保安。有人不付款就走，会叫出声，还能长距离追踪窃贼，确保被抓获。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME makes a great security guard because of its quick speed and releases a cry when someone leaves without paying. It can follow thieves for long distances to ensure they get caught.

entry: POKENAME高速追逐罪犯，灵巧穿过对方丢来的障碍。追上后，便替训练家将罪犯按住。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME chases after criminals with high speed, ducking and weaving through obstacles that thieves toss its way. Once it catches up, it pins down criminals on behalf of its Trainer.

entry: POKENAME速度快、身体浮力好，轻松跑跳于水面。它用尾球搅动湖里的鱼，等鱼靠近水面就抓住。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's high speed and buoyant body lets it run and bounce along the surfaces of water with ease. It uses the ball on its tail to stir up the fish within lakes so it can snatch them as they approach the surface.

entry: 虽然长得不像，POKENAME仍会在苹果林假装成树。有人靠近，就使出掷泥，再飞快逃走，想骗入侵者以为只是另一棵树。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME pretends to be a tree within groves of apple trees, despite not looking like them. If someone approaches, it will use Mud Slap before dashing away, trying to trick intruders into thinking it's just another tree.

entry: POKENAME像螺旋桨般转翼，缓缓飞行，发出有节奏的低鸣，响彻夏季。降温后便钻入树根间冬眠，等温暖天气回来。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME flies slowly by spinning its wings like a propeller, generating a rhythmic droning sound that dominates the summer months. When the temperature drops, it burrows to a tree root system to hibernate until warm weather returns.

entry: POKENAME除非没风，否则更愿不用翅膀，任微风带着穿过森林。它在红球果树干筑巢，喜欢安宁、避风的环境。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME prefers not to use its wings unless the wind stops, instead letting the breeze guide it around forests. It makes its nest in the trunks of Red Apricorn trees, thriving in peaceful and sheltered environments.

entry: POKENAME冲得极快，却很快头晕，不得不停下，整体速度便与奔跑的人差不多。慢镜头里的表情太逗，让视频在训练家间爆红。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME darts about at incredible speed but soon becomes dizzy and must stop, making its overall pace similar to a running human. Slow-motion videos of them have become a viral sensation among Trainers, as the expressions they pull are hilarious.

entry: 忍者家族的首领曾常想让POKENAME随侍身边。无与伦比的谋略和出色速度，使它成为无可挑剔的护卫。
author: sk372
source: The heads of ninja clans would often seek to have POKENAME by their side. Possessing unparalleled strategic intellect and remarkable speed, they made for impeccable bodyguards.

entry: POKENAME背上红球茎充满较强毒液，渗进钩爪尖端，也涂在周围锋利翅膀上。战斗时像锯子旋转，给敌人留下深深毒伤。
author: thordemidgard
source: The red bulb on POKENAME's back is filled with a fairly potent venom that seeps into the tips of its hooked claws. It also coats the sharp wings around the bulb, which it spins in battle like a saw to make deep, venomous cuts on its foes.

entry: POKENAME静止时，常被误认为岩石。能一动不动等待数日，直到有什么靠近。一旦行动，肉眼根本追不上。
author: sim.n
source: POKENAME is often mistaken for a rock when it remains still. It can remain motionless for days, waiting for something to come close. When it finally moves, it does so with such speed that it is futile to try to follow it with the naked eye.

entry: POKENAME能无声高速飞行，常在受害者毫无察觉时发动攻击。尾刺能向猎物注入麻痹物质。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME can fly at very high speeds without making any sound, so it can often attack its victims without them even noticing. The stinger on its tail can inject paralyzing substances into its prey.

entry: 这种宝可梦平时住在沙漠遗迹旁。有些训练家说，领地意识强，任何东西靠近都极其凶悍。POKENAME角上宝石很硬，攻击时绝不犹豫。
author: naivetotoro
source: This Pokémon normally lives around ruins in desert areas, some trainers say that they are very territorial and agressive when anything tries to get close. The gem on their horn is very hard and POKENAME will not hesitate to attack with it.

entry: POKENAME快速振翅，远距离交流，响亮鸣叫与嗡鸣充满空气，常让附近居民烦恼。被打断就会发怒，啄击靠近的人。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME rapidly vibrate their wings to communicate with one another over vast distances, loud chirps and buzzes filling the air, often to the annoyance of nearby residents. They are aggressive when interrupted, pecking at people who come close.

entry: POKENAME飞行时，用沉重长鼻将蜻蜻蜓等猎物打落，再以滚动了结，凭力量与速度压倒对方。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME will slam its heavy trunk into prey like Yanma to knock them out of the air while it flies. It follows up with a Rollout to finish the prey off, using its power and speed to dominate its foes.

entry: POKENAME绘画又快又热情，尤其作品灵感来自惊险交战时。留下的狼藉满是红色斑块，让人以为刚打过一场。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME paints with extreme speed and enthusiasm, especially when its art is inspired by daring combat encounters. The messes it leaves behind are dominated by splotches of red, making some assume a battle just took place.

entry: POKENAME全身围绕电荷，会对其他生灵的电场作反应。一感知动作，肌肉无需意识指挥便能行动，反应速度极其惊人。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME surround their body with an electrical charge that reacts to the fields of other living creatures. When they sense movement, their muscles move without needing conscious input, granting them incredible reaction times.

entry: POKENAME飞快掠过海面，用鲜艳、虫类般的双翼短暂升空。高频振动让它轻松滑过波浪上方，灵巧甩开水中捕食者。
author: msdawgs
source: POKENAME skims the ocean surface at blinding speeds, using its vibrant, bug-like wings to briefly launch into the air. It generates high-frequency vibrations that allow it to effortlessly glide above the waves and outmaneuver aquatic predators.

entry: 它眨眼间就能将藤蔓伸出数米，卷来敌人，再用爪子快速连斩。
author: cait_sith
source: It can extend its vines several meters within the blink of an eye. It uses its vines to reel in foes before delivering rapid slashes with its claws.

entry: POKENAME高速移动，身后拖出火焰。常用火圈围住敌人，使其无处躲避双手接着发出的火焰攻击。
author: sk372
source: Fire trails behind POKENAME's speedy movements. One of its preferred methods of dealing with foes is to encircle them with a ring of fire, leaving them trapped and unable to avoid subsequent fire attacks from its hands.

entry: POKENAME飞行时，翅膀能完全离开身体。虽然不相连，却反而让飞行速度提高。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's wings can fully detach from its body while in flight. Despite not being attached, this actually increases its flying speed.

entry: POKENAME一生都住在同一棵树，防御任何伤害。疯狂振翅时，动作快得肉眼难以追上。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME lives on the same tree its entire life, protecting it from anything that attempts to cause harm. When it beats its wings frenetically, it can move with such speed that its motions become difficult to follow with the naked eye.

entry: 据说，POKENAME跑得快到连空气阻力都几乎无法影响。有人甚至声称，见过它跑上水面。速度太惊人，很难好好研究。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is incredibly swift, running so fast that, supposedly, even air resistance barely affects it. Some have even claimed to have seen POKENAME run atop the surface of water. Its incredible speed makes it difficult to study properly.

entry: POKENAME善用战斗中的速度优势，打出连番踢击。移动时宛如模糊影子，极难扎实地击中。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME uses its speed to great advantage in battle, striking with flurries of kicks. It moves at a rapid speed, appearing like a blur and making it extremely difficult to land a solid strike on it.

entry: POKENAME迅速、无声地移动，在敌人察觉前就能击倒。远远跃入空中，用翅膀调整下降，极精准地出击。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: Moving swiftly and silently, POKENAME can strike down foes before being noticed. Leaping large distances into the air, POKENAME use their wings to adjust their descent and strike with extreme precision.

entry: POKENAME制作镰刀，想守护森林家园的其他居民。但本性依旧胆小，多数战斗都以偷袭一击后逃走告终。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME fashions a scythe to fight off others as it attempts to be a guardian of the other denizens of its forest home. Its nature is still timid, however, and most attempts to fight end when it makes one surprise strike, then runs away.

entry: 每只POKENAME都梦想成为尽可能出色的忍者。它操纵空气，制造风弹，跑得快到能留下残影。
author: sk372
source: Every POKENAME dreams of being the greatest ninja it can be. It can manipulate the air to create wind projectiles and runs at speeds fast enough to create afterimages.

entry: POKENAME移动太快、太安静，仿佛直接消失，早期存在报告因此被当作幻觉。土居忍士会在它靠近时躲藏，原因仍不明。
author: sk372
source: Early reports of POKENAME's existence were thought to be hallucinations, as it moves so quickly and silently it seems to simply vanish. Nincada hide when it is near, though none are yet sure why.

entry: POKENAME改变随身布片的颜色，试着融入环境。可惜无法改变锯齿图案，依旧很容易被发现。
author: bacondlx
source: POKENAME attempts to blend into its surroundings by changing the color of the sheet it carries. Unfortunately for it, it is still quite easy to spot as it cannot change the zigzag pattern.

entry: POKENAME周围缭绕神秘黑烟，离开精灵球越久，烟越黑。传言是吸收附近阴影所致，但并无肉眼可见的迹象。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are surrounded by a mysterious black smoke that grows darker the longer they are out of their Poké Ball. It is rumored that this is because they absorb shadows from the nearby area, though there is no visual indication of this.

entry: POKENAME通过独自修行与实战经验，成长为群体，或称“氏族”的首领。在无双的波导感知与速度面前，躲藏和逃跑都徒劳。
author: craigprime
source: Through isolated training and battle experience, a POKENAME ascends to become the leader of its swarm, or "clan". Both hiding and fleeing are futile actions in the face of its unmatched aura-sense and speed.

entry: 背上的花像直升机桨叶，旋转得够快就能起飞。花瓣锋利得惊人，卷进去的任何东西都会被切成数百片。
author: mistymagius
source: The flowers on its back act like helicopter blades, spinning fast enough to allow it to fly. The petals are incredibly sharp and will cut anything that gets caught in them into hundreds of pieces.

entry: POKENAME飞行时，从翅膀甩出毒液，驱赶领地中的捕食者，保住空间，也保护同族。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME will fling a poisonous liquid from its wings as it flies to deter predators from its territory. This defense mechanism allows it to keep its space clear and its kin safe.

entry: POKENAME在墓中休眠，直到光照到身体，才会飞快冲向光源，好奇地嗡鸣。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME remain dormant in tombs until they are exposed to light. When light shines on their bodies, they zoom towards the light and buzz with curiosity.

entry: 野生铁面忍者感知POKENAME在附近，就会聚拢。它如指挥官般给予完美战术指示，让同伴更有效捕猎，收集大量食物，与首领分享。
author: sk372
source: Ninjask in the wild flock to POKENAME when they sense its presence nearby. Acting as a commander, it gives them flawless tactical direction that lets them hunt prey more effectively and gather up heaps of food to share with their leader.

entry: 成年POKENAME的甲壳肥沃，能支持植物生长。静止时靠植物融入四周，也常成为小得多的虫属性宝可梦的住处。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The carapace of an adult POKENAME is fertile and able to support plant growth. POKENAME will use these plants to blend into their surroundings when stationary, and often end up playing host to much smaller Bug-type Pokémon.

entry: 不停疾驰会熄灭自身产生的火焰。但沿途残留的余烬，常引燃干草。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Its constant zipping movement extinguishes the flames it produces. However, the lingering embers it leaves in its wake often ignite dry grass.

entry: POKENAME快速振翅，产生大量摩擦，借此增强雷电拳与火焰踢。
author: bandedbodypress
source: The rapid beating of its wings generates a lot of friction. POKENAME uses this to its advantage, and powers up its Thunder Punches and Blaze Kicks.

entry: POKENAME出鞘之快，声响震耳欲聋。可受害者听见时，早已被利刃划伤。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: The speed in which POKENAME unsheathes is deafening. By the time its victim hears it, however, they are already wounded by its blade.

entry: POKENAME极爱与其他宝可梦竞争，会在空中对冲比武，争夺优势，靠速度与敏捷证明自己更强。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME is intensely rivalrous with other Pokémon. It will engage in mid-air jousting matches to determine dominance, using its speed and agility to assert its position as the superior fighter.

entry: POKENAME借翅膀高速移动，用凶险利刃斩破阻拦。战斗风格适应力强，深受志在成为精英训练家的人喜爱。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Using their wings, POKENAME can move at extremely high speed and use their viciously sharp blades to cut through their opposition. They are popular Pokémon with aspiring Ace Trainers due to their highly adaptable battle style.

entry: 人们必须努力证明价值，才能赢得指挥这些骄傲宝可梦的资格。即使亲自孵化、养到进化的POKENAME，一见软弱迹象也可能抛弃训练家。
author: milchik
source: People must work hard to show their worth and earn the ability to command these proud Pokémon. Even POKENAME hatched and evolved by their Trainers can abandon them at the first sign of weakness.

entry: POKENAME的锋利缎带能切钢，几乎时刻都在动。只是速度太快，肉眼看不出运动，只觉得像模糊刀刃。
author: slimmagma
source: POKENAME has sharp ribbons that it uses to cut through steel. Those ribbons move almost all the time but they move so fast that the human eye doesn't detect the movement, giving the illusion of blurry blades.

entry: POKENAME短距离移动快得连最高速相机也像瞬移。有人提出，它能在移动时暂停时间，但无法维持太久。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME can move short distances with such incredible speed that it seems instant, even to the highest-speed cameras available. It has been suggested that POKENAME is able to stop time while it moves, but cannot keep time paused for long.

entry: POKENAME动作极快，猎物通常还没看见，就已被附肢制服。它也能打出猛烈拳击，连最厉害的拳击手都能击昏。
author: heal_fire
source: POKENAME moves so fast that its prey are usually unable to see it before POKENAME uses its appendages to neutralize them. POKENAME can also throw devastating punches that can knock out even the most skilled boxers.

entry: POKENAME速度极快，又能感知磁场，难以捕捉。因此，人们至今对它知之甚少。
author: midnightsoup
source: POKENAME's speed and ability to detect magnetic fields make it very difficult to catch. As a result, not much is known about this Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME夜间飞行，柔和紫光快乐地舞过麦田。累了就吃些植物，进食时光芒转暗，让田野显得宁静。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME flies around at night, its soft purple glow dancing happily through wheat fields. It snacks on the plants when it gets tired, dimming its light when eating and creating a serene atmosphere in the fields.

entry: POKENAME用翅膀在深海高速推进。强劲的飞行能力让它也能迅速穿行水下，沿海床寻找食物。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its wings to propel itself at high speeds deep under the ocean. Its powerful flight allows it to move swiftly in underwater environments, where it navigates the sea floor in search of food.

entry: 虽然POKENAME极为罕见，飞行声却几乎震耳欲聋，远处也能知道它来了。它大多时间飞往各处沼泽，守望正在进食的土居忍士。
author: .izik
source: Despite being incredibly rare, the noise POKENAME creates while flying is nearly deafening, announcing its presence from great distances. It spends much of its time flying between swamps and watching over Nincada in the area as they feed.

entry: 人们认为，POKENAME翅膀的力量只够让身体离地，因此惊人速度常被归功于神秘尾巴。但究竟如何发挥作用，仍不清楚。
author: banzai.exe
source: The wings of a POKENAME are only thought to be strong enough to lift it off the ground, so its blinding speed is often attributed to its mystical tails. Just how they contribute, however, is unknown.

entry: 几只POKENAME最终会因强烈正义感而团结，形成氏族。有人在领地伤害其他宝可梦，就会遭到不休追逐，直到报仇。
author: craigprime
source: Several individual POKENAME will eventually become united through a strong sense of justice, forming a clan. If someone hurts another Pokémon in their territory, they will ceaselessly chase the aggressor in pursuit of revenge.

entry: POKENAME精力无穷、速度惊人，战斗中斩击与爪击宛如旋风。即使睡着，身体也不肯静止。
author: sk372
source: Possessing boundless energy and incredible speeds, POKENAME is a whirling dervish of slashes and claws in battle. Even when sleeping, its body refuses to remain still.

entry: POKENAME战斗时以超音速射出尖刺，足以穿透树干。等待刺长回时，会慌忙四处飞，希望不被对手击中。
author: mistymagius
source: In combat, POKENAME fires off its thorns faster than the speed of sound, able to pierce trough tree trunks. While its thorns regrow, it will frantically fly around hoping none of its opponent's attacks hit it.

entry: POKENAME头顶的鳍稍稍一动，就能大幅改变航线，近乎瞬间转过90度，是灵活、难以预测的飞行者。
author: .izik
source: The fin on POKENAME's head slightly moves to cause drastic changes in its flight pattern. With this, it can easily turn at 90-degree angles in close to an instant, making it an agile and unpredictable flyer.

entry: POKENAME在海滩安家，用爪子筛沙，添加进身体。它似乎有种挑选特定沙子的神奇本领，选择方式让科学家困惑多年。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME makes its home on beaches, using its claws to sort through sand to add to its body. The way it makes these choices has baffled scientists for years, as it seems to have an uncanny ability to select specific sand for its collection.

entry: POKENAME速度极快，工业革命前，常被信使用作坐骑。如今仍受赛场欢迎，也常被养在家中。
author: katieplaysgames
source: An exceptionally fast Pokémon, POKENAME was commonly used as a mount by messengers prior to the industrial revolution. In modern times, it is still popular at racetracks or simply as a domestic Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME唱着缓慢、不祥的旋律，以无双敏捷绕行猎物，使其恐惧、眩晕，再用镰刀了结。慢镜头中，这一切宛如电影里的舞蹈。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME sings a slow, foreboding tune while encircling prey with unrivaled agility to instill fear and dizziness into them. Then, it strikes with scythes to finish them. Viewing these actions in slow motion reveals a cinematic dance.

entry: POKENAME常将自己埋进柔软沙土，尤其爱待在武术家的训练场，结果蘑菇常不慎受损，身上还带着散落的武器。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME often bury themselves in soft patches of sandy soil, commonly settling in training yards for martial artists. This leads to them inadvertently picking up damage to their mushrooms and carrying stray weapons about.

entry: POKENAME速度快得荒唐，只有最高性能的相机才能捕捉飞行身影。人们相信，最高速可能接近光速。
author: sk372
source: Only the highest-power cameras have been able to catch a glimpse of POKENAME in flight, as it moves at ludicrous speeds. It's believed that POKENAME could, at max speed, travel close to the speed of light.

entry: POKENAME极敏捷，轻松击倒猎物，也能甩开捕食者。甚至会捕食大嘴雀等大型鸟宝可梦。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's remarkable agility allows it to take down prey and outmaneuver predators effortlessly. It has even been known to prey on large bird Pokémon like Fearow.

entry: POKENAME在野外放出大量浓雾，掩盖行动。速度比想象中快得多，轮廓仿佛直接从烟雾里消失。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME pumps out a large amount of fog to obscure its movements in the wild. It moves with a great deal more speed than one would expect, its silhouette seeming to vanish from within the smoke.

entry: POKENAME能迅速、无声地捕猎小害兽，深受住户喜爱。“家有POKENAME，虫鼠全无踪”，甚至成了饲主们的口号。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is beloved by homeowners for its capacity to swiftly and silently hunt small pests. "A house with a POKENAME is a house without vermin" has even become something of a slogan for those who own one.

entry: POKENAME小群成队，飞越天空。虽然联系紧密，多数却几乎互相看不顺眼，一心只想跑得更快。但真遇上危急，仍会挺身保护同伴。
author: thesilverowls
source: POKENAME race through the sky in small packs. Despite their tight-knit bond, most of them barely tolerate one another and seek only to outpace each other. When push comes to shove, though, they will stand up for their packmates.

entry: POKENAME在地面、空中都极快，野生宝可梦很难按住。没把握取胜，就能轻松逃跑，只有确信能赢才留下。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME has incredible speed both on land and in the air, and, as a result, is extremely difficult for wild Pokémon to pin down. It can easily flee from foes that it is unsure it can defeat, and only stays if it is sure it can win.

entry: POKENAME过着地下生活，只吃矿物与深埋的根。除了进食、休息，总在移动，挖出庞大隧道网，引发轻微地震。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME live a subterranean life, only eating minerals and deep-planted roots. When not eating or resting, they are constantly on the move, digging a vast network of tunnels, which leads to minor earthquakes.

entry: POKENAME在鱼常跃出水面的地方捕猎，凭极速迅速跃过池塘或河流，用钳子刺穿鱼，取得一餐。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME hunts in areas where fish are commonly seen leaping from the water. With its extreme speed, it can make quick leaps across the ponds or rivers, skewering a fish with its claws to secure a meal.

entry: POKENAME用棉团塞住球茎，免得不停喷毒。喷出的毒黏稠、海绵般松软，一碰便有灼痛感。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: POKENAME plugs its bulb with a ball of cotton to stop itself from spewing poison constantly. The poison it launches out is sticky, spongy, and leaves a burning sensation on touch.

entry: 传说，六颗蛋丢在废弃玩偶旁，就能融合成POKENAME。但也许只是误解了诅咒娃娃与蛋蛋融合的过程。
author: heal_fire
source: A legend says that when half a dozen eggs are junked close to a discarded puppet, both can fuse into POKENAME. But it might just be some misunderstanding about a Banette fusing with an Exeggcute.

entry: POKENAME用斗篷与头骨藏住模样，带着一把灵体般的铲子。据说能挖出灵魂，但尚未证实。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME hide their appearance behind a cloak and skull. They carry an ethereal shovel that is said to help them unearth spirits, though this has yet to be proven.

entry: 这种宝可梦的骨头变成针状。它从布状皮肤抽出线，捆住、困住敌人，再用锋利武器施以最后一击。
author: fireblade141
source: This Pokémon's bone has become like a needle. It pulls threads out of its clothlike skin and uses them to snare and trap foes to set up a finishing blow with its sharp weapon.

entry: 它被悲伤吸引，常在哀悼者身边出现。有人认为，会吸收其他生灵的情绪包袱，身体随岁月明显变重、更破烂。
author: jaminmcready
source: It is drawn to grief and often appears near those in mourning. Some believe it absorbs emotional baggage from others, its body becoming visibly heavier and more tattered over time.

entry: 融合激发了双方超级进化的特征。有人推测，是因为诅咒娃娃与孩子合为一体，感到幸福。
author: hophoppip
source: Fusing has brought out traits from both components' Mega Evolutions. Some theorize that this occurs due to the happiness Banette feels from uniting with a child.

entry: 有人说翼上的脸才是真脸，也有人说，只有受害者中了孢子，它才会作表情。但失忆孢子阻止了研究，这些说法很难证实。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: Some say that the face on its wings is its actual face; others claim it only emotes after victims are hit with spores. Claims are difficult to prove as attempts to research this fusion are halted by its amnesia-inducing spores.

entry: POKENAME侧着身子，缓缓飘过墓园，边飘边滴水。有人相信，若有亲人正从墓里出来迎接祖先，核心就会闪红光。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME hovers slowly on its side over cemeteries, dripping water as it drifts. Some believe its core will blink red when a loved one is emerging from their grave to greet their ancestors.

entry: 野生POKENAME住在人类曾聚居、后来因各种原因废弃的地区，远远吞食冲动和不由自主闯入脑海的念头。
author: bobosmith01
source: Wild POKENAME are found in areas that were previously populated by humans, but are now abandoned for one reason or another. They feed on impulsive and intrusive thoughts from a distance.

entry: POKENAME平时冷淡、平静，惹恼后却极其记仇。颈部拉链张开，放出黑暗能量，伸向伤害过自己的对象攻击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's demeanor is aloof and typically calm, but it is very vengeful if agitated. The zipper in its neck opens up to expel dark energy that reaches out to attack those who wronged it.

entry: POKENAME潜在冰湖、冰海底，偶尔出来将猎物拖回冰巢。据说，背上每根别针，都代表一个落入冰下的不幸灵魂。
author: agentyoshi
source: POKENAME lurks at the bottom of frozen lakes and seas, occasionally emerging to drag prey to its icy lair. It is said that each pin on POKENAME's back represents an unfortunate soul that fell beneath the ice.

entry: POKENAME在电脑中假扮神秘文件。谁好奇想查看内容，就会遭诅咒，让电脑充满恶意软件。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME appears on computers, masquerading as a mysterious file. Those who are curious and try to reveal its contents suffer its curse, filling the computer with malware.

entry: 强行拉上POKENAME嘴巴的拉链，是唯一能暂时阻止无尽暴食的方法。许多人说，只有吞下特定数量的人类灵魂，才真正吃得饱。
author: sk372
source: Forcibly zipping POKENAME's mouth shut is the only way to temporarily stop it from gorging endlessly on food. Many say that the only thing that will truly sate it is devouring a certain number of human souls.

entry: POKENAME闯进孩子卧室，藏在玩具、毛绒娃娃里。它渴望关爱，只要孩子决定收养，就愿意做任何事。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME break into children's bedrooms to hide amongst toys and plushies. They long for affection and will do anything for a child that decides to adopt them.

entry: POKENAME在服从与暴怒间反复无常地切换。压力下，会把怒气集中进钻头，无论正在战斗，还是只遇上一点小不顺。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: POKENAME erratically flips between obedience and rage. When under stress, it focuses its wrath into its drills, regardless of whether it is in a fight or over some mild inconvenience.

entry: POKENAME夜间出来，极爱恶作剧。拉开嘴上的拉链，叫声会释放精神脉冲，让听者恐惧、行事失去理智。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a highly mischievous creature that comes out at night. When it opens its zipped mouth, its cry lets out a psychic impulse that causes those to hear it to feel fear and act irrationally.

entry: POKENAME替所有被放生的宝可梦怨恨训练家。它藏在树上，用蛛网绊倒经过的人类，再扑上去施以毒咬。
author: glacierwing
source: POKENAME harbors resentment and anger towards Trainers on behalf of all the Pokémon they have released. It will hide on trees, using its webs to trip any humans so it can bite them with poison.

entry: POKENAME体内有一团毛线，拉开耳朵拉链就能取出。它手艺不够，自己什么都做不成，因此寻找擅长缝纫的训练家学习。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: POKENAME holds a ball of yarn inside its body that can be accessed by unzipping its ear. It isn't skilled enough to make anything on its own, so POKENAME looks for trainers who are skilled at sewing to learn from them.

entry: POKENAME捕猎时，眼睛从肚里探出。看见人就会催眠，引回家，无情吞食。
author: agostostino
source: When POKENAME hunts, its eye emerges from its belly. If it sees someone, POKENAME hypnotizes them to come to its home, where it devours them without mercy.

entry: 球茎长出的茎其实是手臂，能打出强力拳击，主体也能冲撞、咬击。POKENAME还会用这只手，捉弄、戳弄背对自己的训练家。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: The stem growing from its bulb is actually an arm, capable of throwing powerful punches, while its main body can tackle and bite its enemies. POKENAME also uses this hand to prank and poke trainers who turn their back on it.

entry: POKENAME口气臭得连其他幽灵属性宝可梦也受不了，简直连鼻子都快熏熟。小猎物常还没被咬住，就已死去。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: POKENAME has a breath so foul, that even other Ghost-type Pokémon are unable to handle the downright nose-boiling scent. Smaller prey often die before POKENAME even has them in its jaws.

entry: POKENAME满怀怨恨，纠缠拜访墓园的人，诅咒悲伤家庭，使其看见幻觉。许多扫墓者会带特殊护符，防止诅咒。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are deeply rancorous Pokémon that haunt people who visit graveyards. They cast curses on grieving families that cause them to see hallucinations. Many visitors to graveyards carry a special amulet to protect themselves from the curses.

entry: POKENAME潜伏在黑暗中，突然跳出惊吓训练家。若训练家下意识反击，POKENAME便会对其施加诅咒。
author: gentlesage
source: POKENAME lurks within the darkness and jumps out to frighten Trainers. If a Trainer reflexively attacks it, POKENAME will place a curse on them.

entry: 传言，POKENAME是诅咒娃娃的怨念灵体，违背麒麟奇的意愿，占据身体。麒麟奇却无法对抗那强大意志。
author: clownatosis
source: It's rumored that POKENAME is the astral grudge of Banette, taken over the body of a Girafarig against its will. Though the Girafarig is unable to combat its sheer will.

entry: POKENAME常绕着房屋，用诅咒能量在钳子上造眼睛，威吓人们。多数人以为是在保护住户，其实是折磨、诅咒他们。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME are most often seen encircling houses, using cursed energy to create eyes on their pincers for intimidation and instilling fear. While most people think it's to protect the occupants inside, they actually do it to torment and curse them.

entry: POKENAME的角很柔韧，能从奇怪角度打敌人，或钻到树皮下。吃树液时若有人打扰，就从嘴里喷出臭烘烘的幽灵瘴气。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's horn is flexible, allowing it to strike at foes or dig beneath the bark of trees from odd angles. It breathes out a stinky ghostly miasma from its mouth if someone dares to interrupt it while it's eating sap from a tree.

entry: POKENAME远离社会与其他宝可梦，在树上留抓痕，警告别进领地。不听警告，就会记恨，诅咒入侵者。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME are known to seclude themselves from society and other Pokémon. They leave scratches on trees so others know not to wander into their territory. If one does not heed these warnings, POKENAME will hold a grudge and curse the intruder.

entry: 长久以来，人们认为POKENAME由贪婪灵魂诞生，为追求更多财富而附身零钱包。它很调皮，爱在壳内收藏珍贵物件。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME have long been thought to be born of greedy spirits that came to possess coin purses in hopes of acquiring even more riches. They are mischievous Pokémon that love to collect precious items within their shells.

entry: POKENAME的战斗风格结合柔和动作与强力打击。有人推测，体内灵魂曾是精通失传武艺的武术家。
author: thegreenscorpion
source: POKENAME's fighting style incorporates a mix of gentle movements and impactful strikes. It is speculated that the spirit inhabiting a POKENAME belonged to a martial artist who has mastered a long lost combat art.

entry: POKENAME围着腹中猎物拉紧拉链，缠束越发紧密，使其难以逃脱、呼吸。尽管危险，仍有设计师参考它制作睡袋。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: POKENAME's grip gets tighter as it closes its zippers around the prey in its stomach, making it hard for them to escape or breathe. A few designers have made sleeping bags based on POKENAME despite its dangerousness.

entry: POKENAME飘过农场，摆尾让铃铛发出缓慢、忧伤的声响，通知其他工人，该吃晚饭或喂其他宝可梦了。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME drift through farms while swaying their tails to create slow, melancholy chimes from their bells. The sound is used to signal the other workers when it's time to eat supper or feed the other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME沿沼泽边缘的黑暗游荡，寻找负面情绪。发现猎物，就用触手缠住，借恐惧创造全新诅咒。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME wanders through the dark at the edge of swamplands, seeking sources of negative emotions. Upon finding its prey, POKENAME coils its tentacles around them, using their fear to create a brand new curse.

entry: 古老故事说，POKENAME是被旧主人遗弃、删除的虚拟宠物灵魂。垃圾场很常见，还与洛托姆争抢旧电视、电脑，附身恶作剧。
author: notadoctor75
source: Old stories say that POKENAME is the spirit of an old virtual pet, left abandoned or deleted by its previous owner. It can be a common sight at junkyards, and competes with Rotom for possessing old TVs and computers to cause mischief.

entry: POKENAME常偷游乐场的毛绒玩具，吃里面的棉花。进食时若被靠近，就使出水枪喷向来者，转身逃跑。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME often steals plush toys from playgrounds to consume the cotton inside. If approached while eating, it sprays the intruder with Water Gun and flees.

entry: POKENAME故意待在玩具店，渴望训练家照顾。无人理会，就会垂头丧气地离开。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME deliberately place themselves in toy stores, yearning to be taken care of by a Trainer. If ignored, the Pokémon will leave the store feeling crestfallen.

entry: POKENAME恶意满怀、心怀怨恨，在阴影中寻找毫无防备的受害者折磨。它靠负面情绪维生，因此训练家表达积极情绪，反而能帮助它平静。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is malicious and resentful, seeking out unsuspecting victims to torment from the shadows. It is sustained by negative emotions, so a Trainer expressing positivity can help it find peace.

entry: POKENAME夜访孩子，一察觉父母靠近就消失。它用念力让玩具动起来，整晚偷偷陪孩子玩。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME visits children at night, vanishing if it senses a parent's approach. It uses telekinesis to animate the child's toys and play with them throughout the evening in secret.

entry: POKENAME常在废弃店铺、宅邸的黑暗空房里一动不动。据说会吞掉靠近者的灵魂，因此许多人警告，无论如何都别接近。
author: actliux
source: In abandoned stores and mansions, POKENAME is seen motionless in dark, empty rooms. It is said that it consumes the souls of those who approach it, so many warn against approaching it under any circumstances.

entry: POKENAME日落后聚在孩子玩耍过的地方，人们认为，残留的喜悦、幸福与友谊气息能安慰它。被家庭收养的个体，会散发极其积极的气场。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME congregate where children play after the sun has set. The lingering auras of joy, happiness and friendship are believed to give them comfort. Those that have been adopted into families exude an overwhelmingly positive aura.

entry: POKENAME被本能怒火驱动，向伤害过自己的对象复仇。超自然能量控制力极强，人们认为，一击便能夷平整条山脉。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME seek revenge on those who wrong them, driven by an instinctual rage. Their control over supernatural energy is so immense, it is thought they can level entire mountain ranges with a single blast.

entry: 当仇恨与苦涩滋长，背上的花便会盛开。直射阳光会让背部灵体萎缩，因此白天用球茎将其盖住。
author: bandedbodypress
source: The flower on its back blooms when feelings of hatred and bitterness flourish. Direct sunlight causes the spirit on its back to shrivel, so its bulb covers it during the day.

entry: 不清楚POKENAME哪颗头控制身体，但无论如何都配合得很狡猾。它们爱捉弄宝可梦与训练家，常偷物品、树果，引人追逐。
author: quackquackattack
source: It is unclear which head of a POKENAME is in charge of their body, but they provide a devious combo regardless. They love playing tricks on Pokémon and Trainers alike, often stealing items and berries to instigate a chase.

entry: 虽然传说会拖走不守宵禁的淘气孩子，这头懒怪物其实只吃水果。
author: kanelel
source: Though said to drag off naughty children who ignore their curfew, this lazy monster only eats fruit.

entry: POKENAME盘踞废弃宅邸与住处，昂着头飘过空走廊。谁敢踏进来，就会突然现身，试图吓走，保护家园免遭入侵。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME haunt abandoned mansions and abodes, drifting through empty corridors with their head held high. If anyone dares set foot inside, POKENAME will abruptly appear and try to scare them away, aiming to protect their home from intruders.

entry: POKENAME从田里收集棉花，填充柔软身体。若察觉最爱的田地将有龙卷风，就会发出响亮、像人一样的尖叫，警告附近农民。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME collects cotton from fields to fill its soft body. If it senses a tornado approaching its favorite field, it screams with a loud, human-like voice to warn nearby farmers.

entry: 有人说，在墓园睡着会招来POKENAME，将人变成娃娃。虽然没有确证，但每当墓园发现娃娃，故事就又会在附近城镇流传。
author: .izik
source: Some say that falling asleep in a graveyard will cause a POKENAME to appear and turn the person into a doll. No definitive proof has been found, but whenever a doll is found in a graveyard, the tale tends to circulate through nearby towns once more.

entry: POKENAME在水深处泛起粉光，让多数人觉得不祥。水手传说，心怀恶意而航行的船可能被整个吞下，让它肚里充满诅咒能量。
author: femaledog
source: The pink glow of POKENAME from watery depths is a foreboding sight to most. Sailors tell tales that vessels travelling with dark intentions may be swallowed whole by POKENAME, filling its belly with cursed energy.

entry: 这种宝可梦诞生于被遗弃毛绒娃娃的思念之灵，娃娃据说仿照阿尔宙斯制作。如今横过身体的拉链，原本是裂口，据说能从中窥见灵魂。
author: infinex21
source: This Pokémon was born from the longing spirit of an abandoned plush doll that had supposedly been modeled to resemble Arceus. What now appear to be zippers running across its body were once tears, and are said to allow one to peer into its very soul.

entry: 诅咒娃娃与双剑鞘联手时，双剑鞘吸收诅咒能量，融合成POKENAME。任其自行活动，就会为解决诅咒娃娃的旧怨，危及整片社区。
author: .fedoraman
source: When a Banette joins forces with a Doublade, the Doublade absorbs its cursed energy, fusing into a POKENAME. Left to their own devices, these Pokémon will endanger whole communities to settle Banette's old grudge.

entry: 传说，POKENAME由栖息地受污染后死去的宝可梦怨念形成。现实中，它们住在深水，只有巢穴受威胁才出来。
author: mepp.
source: Legends claim that POKENAME were created by the grudges of Pokémon who perished after pollution befouled their habitat. In reality, they dwell deep underwater and only come out if their nest is threatened.

entry: POKENAME体内怨念能量越多，齿轮转得越快，行动速度惊人。真正危险却是齿轮停转时，能施下强大诅咒。
author: femaledog
source: POKENAME's gears spin faster with the more grudge-fueled energy stored in its body, letting it move with impressive speed. The true danger is present when the gears stop, allowing POKENAME to cast a powerful curse.

entry: POKENAME趁孩子熟睡，潜入房间。身上拉链张开，释放幽灵触须，轻扫孩子，让睡梦充满噩梦。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME sneaks into the rooms of children while they are sleeping. The zippers on its body then open up to release ghostly tendrils that brush against the child and cause their sleep to be filled with nightmares.

entry: 常能看见POKENAME数着训练家慌乱中掉落的硬币。有人说，还可以向它们借钱。
author: tad
source: POKENAME can often be found counting coins dropped by panicking Trainers. Some say you can borrow money from them.

entry: POKENAME毛绒身体虽然极软，给自己鼓足劲后，却能抬起整栋建筑。只是这番自我鼓励，有时需要几小时。
author: .izik
source: Despite POKENAME's plush body being intensely soft, it is capable of lifting entire buildings after psyching itself up. This self-encouragement can sometimes take hours.

entry: POKENAME脾气暴躁，常攻击进入领地的生灵。民间故事说，它连自己的训练家也诅咒，使其入睡，享用亲手制造的噩梦。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME are cantankerous Pokémon, often lashing out against those who enter their territory. Folklore tells of POKENAME cursing their own Trainers, putting them to sleep and feasting on the nightmares they give them.

entry: POKENAME始终寻找遗弃过宝可梦的训练家，仿佛被可怕的复仇欲支配。对其他训练家却极害羞，常因害怕而避开。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are always searching for Trainers that have abandoned any of their Pokémon, seemingly possessed by a dreadful desire for revenge. To all other Trainers, they are incredibly shy and will often avoid them out of fear.

entry: POKENAME充满恶意能量，将其化为武器，让不幸遇上的生灵遭诅咒、厄运。它挥舞巨针，集中诅咒能量，投向更远处。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are suffused with malevolent energy that they weaponise to inflict curses and misfortune on those unfortunate enough to cross their path. They wield an oversized needle that lets them focus this curse energy and project it further.

entry: POKENAME常走进缝纫店偷别针，添进头发。只有真正的朋友能使用，若强抢一根，就会迎来恶毒诅咒。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME often wander into sewing stores to steal pins to add to its hair. Only those it considers true friends are able to use its pins; attempt to take one forcibly, and POKENAME will unleash a foul curse.

entry: 只要承认制作功劳属于POKENAME，它就会缝制训练家想要的一切。否则，便诅咒训练家短暂失忆，独自逃到野外继续创作，直到心情好转。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: POKENAME sews whatever its Trainer wants as long as it's credited for its craft. If it isn't, POKENAME curses its Trainer with momentary amnesia and escapes to continue its work in the wild alone until it feels better.

entry: POKENAME缝制皮皮玩偶，送给遇到的每个人。玩偶丢掉后总会回来，反复想摆脱，还会让拥有者逐渐丢失记忆。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: POKENAME sews Clefairy Dolls and gives them away to anyone it meets. The dolls always come back if they are thrown away, and repeated attempts to get rid of them will slowly make whoever owns a doll lose their memories.

entry: 不愿离开训练家的宝可梦灵魂，会化作POKENAME。只要与训练家重逢，它们便能恢复原来的模样。
author: skymaster426
source: Pokémon souls unwilling to part with their Trainer are turned into POKENAME. Meeting their Trainer allows them to turn back to their normal form.

entry: POKENAME以负面情绪为食，把周围生灵的恐惧、疑虑融进诅咒能量。拆开众多尾巴的缝线，就能释放，使受害者遭遇严重不幸。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME feed on negative emotions and incorporate the fears and misgivings of those around them into curse energy. The curse energy can be released by splitting open the seams of their many tails, bringing grave misfortune to those afflicted.

entry: 据说，这种宝可梦诞生于蓝色标签上写下的自私、邪恶愿望。但POKENAME只会向认定无可救药的对象显出恶意。
author: infinex21
source: A Pokémon said to have been born from the selfish and wicked wishes inscribed upon its blue tags. Though supposedly having been born from wickedness, POKENAME only shows malice towards those it deems irredeemable.

entry: POKENAME以负面情绪为食，把周围生灵的恐惧、疑虑融进诅咒能量，存进众多尾巴，等待释放机会。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME feed on negative emotions and incorporate the fears and misgivings of those around them into curse energy. They store this curse energy in each of their many tails, waiting for an opportunity to unleash it.

entry: 据说，尾巴上的火焰就是灵魂。眼力敏锐的训练家，能根据火焰燃烧的亮度与集中程度，辨别本性。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: The flame on its tail is said to be its soul. Trainers with a keen eye are able to distinguish its nature based on how bright or concentrated the flame burns.

entry: POKENAME囤积月之石，存进肚里，免得其他宝可梦借此进化、抢走风头。虽不想收集其他进化石，看见被使用也仍嫉妒得冒火。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: POKENAME hoards Moon Stones and stores them in its stomach to prevent Pokémon from evolving with them and outshining it. Despite having no desire to hoard other evolutionary stones, POKENAME still seethes with jealousy when it witnesses one in use.

entry: 有些祈祷师说，孩子松手、气球飞上天空，就会形成POKENAME。拉开嘴上的拉链，会涌出闷湿又令人脊背发寒的空气。
author: bobosmith01
source: Some Channelers have claimed that a POKENAME forms when a child lets go of their balloon and it flies away into the sky. When its mouth unzips, muggy and spine-chilling air is unleashed.

entry: POKENAME附身被遗弃的儿童玩具，像操偶般驱动，吓唬想取回的人。只有用西尔佛检视镜，才能看见真身。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME possess abandoned children's toys, puppeteering them and using them to scare anyone who tries to reclaim the toys. Their true bodies are only visible through a Silph Scope.

entry: POKENAME附身被遗弃的儿童玩具，像操偶般驱动，吓唬想取回的人。只有用西尔佛检视镜，才能看见真身。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME possess abandoned children's toys, puppeteering them and using them to scare anyone who tries to reclaim the toys. Their true bodies are only visible through a Silph Scope.

entry: 孩子遗失的玩具饱含思念与悲伤，最终获得生命，化作这只宝可梦。它不知为何特别厌恶某些超能力属性宝可梦。
author: shocktopus1717
source: A child's lost toy, filled with longing and sorrow, came to life as this Pokémon. It has a strange aversion to certain Psychic-Type Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME高速拍动柔软毛绒双翼，维持浮空。暴雨时，翅膀吸水，飞行变慢，直到晾干。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME beats its soft, plush wings at incredible speed to stay aloft. During rainstorms, the wings absorb water, slowing its flight until it can dry off.

entry: POKENAME的晶体储存自然散发的诅咒能量。其他宝可梦一打裂巨晶，奔涌的能量便会吸走攻击者的活力。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME crystals store the cursed energy that POKENAME naturally emit. When another Pokémon cracks their giant crystal, the torrent of cursed energy saps vitality from the assailant.

entry: POKENAME蜷起身子，藏在灰黄外骨骼下，保护脆弱的粉色身体。目击者说，这动作有点像拉拉链。
author: _pixelar_
source: To protect its vulnerable pink body, POKENAME will curl up and hide under its grey and yellow exoskeleton. Eyewitnesses have compared this movement to a kind of zipping motion.

entry: POKENAME穿过呼啸暴风雪，寻找合适的训练家。它能神秘地探知训练家携带的物品，成群靠向带有旧玩具或毛绒娃娃的人。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME soar through howling snowstorms in search of the right Trainer. They can mysteriously detect what possessions a Trainer has and will flock towards those who are in possession of an old toy or plushie.

entry: POKENAME对人类着迷，收集碎屑与弃物。据说，物品丢弃前受到的照顾越多，就越能增强它的力量。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME have a fascination with humans, collecting their scraps and discarded items. It is said that POKENAME grow stronger based on the more care that was put into the object before it was thrown away.

entry: POKENAME常用布块盖住身体，似乎害怕填充物露出来，就不再被爱。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME often uses pieces of cloth to cover its body. It seems to fear that it won't be loved if its stuffing is exposed.

entry: POKENAME吸收其他宝可梦的诅咒能量，扩大自己的恶意能量云。对战中，再消耗能量向对手施咒。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME absorb cursed energy from other Pokémon to make their cloud of malevolent energy bigger. During a Pokémon battle, they expend this cursed energy to inflict hexes onto their opponents.

entry: POKENAME的众多眼睛以幽灵般的凝视，使受害者完全麻痹。嘴巴拉链随后张开，发出诡异哀嚎，以大量灵体石块轰击目标。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's many eyes can subject a victim to a ghostly glare that paralyzes them completely. Its mouth then unzips to let out an eerie wail that pelts the target with a multitude of spectral stones.

entry: 虽然已融合，体内的诅咒娃娃仍能短暂离开装甲。它回来之前，空壳便一动不动。
author: ohok3441
source: Despite being a fusion, the Banette within can leave the armor for short periods of time. The hollow shell will be inactive until it returns.

entry: POKENAME白天待在水下，夜里爬出海，静止在暗角。小宝可梦若误以为身体是安全藏身处，就会被困住、吸走生命力。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME spends the day underwater, crawling out of the sea at night and then remaining still in dark corners. If a small Pokémon mistakes its body for a safe place to hide, POKENAME will trap it within and then drain its life force.

entry: 主人对音乐的热爱，让POKENAME获得了生命。它幽幽而舒缓的歌声，还能让别的玩偶活过来，组成偶像团体。
author: hexx_vixtar
source: Its owner's love for music brought POKENAME to life. Its haunting yet soothing voice can reanimate other dolls to be used as an idol group.

entry: POKENAME似由闹鬼丝线组成。战斗时疾冲，只见模糊影子，趁敌人不备，以针状武器刺穿。没人知道面具下是什么。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME's body appears to be composed of haunted thread. In combat, it dashes rapidly, appearing only as a blur, and impales its foes upon its pin-like weapon when they least expect it. No one knows what is under its mask.

entry: 捕食性POKENAME真菌感染，正在关都原生诅咒娃娃群体中蔓延。许多人觉得悲哀，它的蘑菇却是上流社会热门食材，售价极高。
author: turron_turron
source: Infections from the predatory POKENAME fungus are a growing epidemic amongst Kanto's native Banette population. Though many consider this a tragedy, POKENAME mushrooms are a popular upper-class food item that fetches an incredibly high price.

entry: POKENAME体内不断抗争，阻止寄生物蔓延。一旦松懈，拉链就会打开，释放有毒、麻痹性的孢子，试图感染周围生灵。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: There is a constant internal battle within POKENAME to keep its parasite from spreading. Should the POKENAME falter, its zippers will open and release toxic, paralyzing spores in an attempt to infect those around it.

entry: 无数废弃布料在黑暗中腐坏，诞生了这种宝可梦。它不断寻找更多材料，保护真身，不受任何光线照射。
author: frokachu
source: A myriad of discarded materials made from fabrics and cloth festered in darkness and birthed this Pokémon. It constantly seeks more materials to shield its true form from any form of light.

entry: POKENAME爱记仇，会凶狠追猎曾从手中逃走的对象。夜间，镰刀内侧会泛起诡异粉光。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME tends to hold grudges, fiercely hunting down those who have escaped it before. The insides of its scythes glow an eerie pink during the night.

entry: POKENAME通过身上宝石吸取生命能量。拉开嘴巴，就会将力量爆炸般释放，足以夷平房屋。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME absorbs life energy through the gems on its body. If it unzips its mouth, it releases that force in an explosive burst that can level homes.

entry: POKENAME用魔杖，将诅咒能量永久束缚在体内。若有一天法术解除，所有能量都会逃走，它便会变回普通娃娃。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME uses its wand to bind its cursed energy permanently to its body. If this enchantment were to ever be undone, all its energy would escape, and it would turn into a normal doll.

entry: 有人见过POKENAME飘过废弃煤矿遗址。它按下背上别针，让壳中喷出阴森烟云，呛住敌人。
author: femaledog
source: POKENAME have been seen floating through the remnants of abandoned coal mines. They push pins in their back to expel sinister smoke clouds from their shell, choking their enemies.

entry: POKENAME保护喜欢恐怖故事、恶作剧的孩子。若看见有人烦扰受保护的孩子，就缝上自己腹部的嘴，诅咒烦人者一周无法说话。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is protective of children who indulge in scary stories and mischievous pranks. If it witnesses anyone bothering a child it is protecting, it will sew the mouth shut on its belly, which curses the nuisance with a week of silence.
