entry: POKENAME把松皮当袋子，抓进小物品，再偷偷飘走。有人相信能装走孩子，但它没有力量搬动那么重的东西。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME uses its loose skin like a bag, snatching small items in it before sneakily floating away. Some people believe that it could carry a child away in its bag, but POKENAME isn't strong enough to carry that much weight.

entry: POKENAME用厚布保护尾焰，不让熄灭。布看似柔软、鼓鼓囊囊，其实满是尖刺，触碰极痛。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: POKENAME keeps the flame on its tail protected by a thick layer of fabric to prevent it from being extinguished. This fabric looks soft and lumpy, but is actually prickly and incredibly painful when touched.

entry: 金色拉链忽然出现、拉开坚硬地面时，POKENAME一定会从开口出来。它穿行的奇异空间，被称为“拉链口袋次元”。
author: hophoppip
source: When a golden zipper suddenly appears and unzips the solid ground, POKENAME is sure to emerge from the opening. The strange space POKENAME travels through is known as the Zippered Pocket Dimension.

entry: POKENAME折磨丢玩具的人，从双手召出数百件同样的弃玩具，砸向对方。看似无害恶作剧，玩具却嵌着诅咒宝石，让人觉得太珍贵，舍不得再扔。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME torments those who throw away toys by summoning hundreds of the toy they discarded from out of its hands onto them. While seemingly a harmless prank, these toys are studded with cursed gems that make them feel too valuable to be thrown away.

entry: POKENAME的蹼足柔软，靠近时完全听不见。它尾随训练家，想交朋友，却常因突然现身，反把对方吓走。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are impossible to hear coming because of their soft webbed feet. They stalk Trainers with the hope of becoming friends but often surprise and scare away Trainers instead.

entry: POKENAME潜伏废弃商场，在玩具店间游荡，寻找擅闯者。遇上要小心，它先装友好引人靠近，再以强力火焰牙咬下。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME lurk in abandoned shopping malls, prowling between toy stores in search of trespassers. Those who come across them are advised to exercise caution, as they act friendly to draw people close, then bite down with a powerful Fire Fang.

entry: 据说，POKENAME体内不休的火焰以灵魂为燃料，拉链一裂，火便肆意燃烧。熄灭一处，另一处又会爆燃，烧灼试图灭火的对象。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: The ceaseless fires burning within POKENAME are said to be fueled by its soul, each flame burning with reckless abandon as zippers tear open. When one flame is snuffed out, another one bursts alight, scorching those who try to extinguish its flames.

entry: POKENAME是寄生宝可梦，侵占停滞水域。它用圆嘴附着大宝可梦，吸走宿主情感能量，使其懒散，对周围世界漠不关心。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are parasitic Pokémon that can be found infesting stagnant waters. They latch onto larger Pokémon with their circular mouth, draining away their host's emotional energy and leaving them lethargic and disinterested in the world around them.

entry: POKENAME嘴巴拉链张开，暗影液体涌出，积在四周。任何踏上阴影的生灵，都会被抓住、吸进贪食巨口。
author: sk372
source: When POKENAME's zipped mouth opens up, a shadowy liquid billows forth and pools around it. Anything that traipses upon the shadows will be seized and sucked into POKENAME's gluttonous maw.

entry: 它体内中空。拉链打开，水便被吸进胸口，随后就能在战斗中，借神秘力量操纵这些水。
author: houndrys.
source: It is hollow. Water is sucked into its chest when the zipper opens; it later uses that water in battle, manipulating it with its paranormal powers.

entry: POKENAME巧妙伪装成某种零钱包。无人看时，用舌头吞掉无人看管的硬币，但用途仍不清楚。
author: atlas3339098
source: POKENAME cleverly disguises itself as a purse of some sort. When no one is looking it uses its tongue to swallow unsupervised coins, but it's unclear what it does with them.

entry: 废弃房屋里，偶尔能见到POKENAME，像零钱包般拉紧拉链。谁打开，眼中冰冷的凝视就会让其怕得发抖。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME can occasionally be found in abandoned houses, zipped up like a purse. If anyone opens it, the blood-chilling gaze of POKENAME's eye will make them shiver with fear.

entry: POKENAME在设备间跳跃，积累电力，储存在背上。闪电沿背部弧形路线构成完整回路，尽量减少逸散火花。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME leap between devices to build up electricity and store it on their backs. The arcing path of the bolts along a POKENAME's back contains the electricity in a complete circuit to minimize stray sparks.

entry: POKENAME假扮普通精灵球。但训练家真想使用，就会使出自爆。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: POKENAME pretends to be an ordinary Poké Ball. However, if trainers attempt to actually use it, it Self-Destructs.

entry: 人类用这种宝可梦，将发电厂的电力送往城市。POKENAME摇动三颗头，稳定穿过身体的能量。
author: heal_fire
source: This Pokémon is used by humans to transmit electricity from power plants to cities. POKENAME swings its three heads to stabilize the energy traversing through it.

entry: 洛托姆本想附进熟睡的卡拉卡拉所戴的头骨里，却与卡拉卡拉结下了牵绊。如今，它们结伴旅行。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: Trying to merge with the skull on a sleeping Cubone's head, Rotom became attached to the Cubone. They now travel together.

entry: POKENAME用带电短棍击中谁，就能电击谁。有些还用作避雷针，吸取能量，再以能量冲击释放。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME can shock anyone it strikes with its electrically charged baton. Some POKENAME use it as a lightning rod, drawing in power then releasing it as blasts of energy.

entry: POKENAME的动作常被比作不会飞的鸟宝可梦。看似笨拙，机械腿踢出的力量，却与力壮鸡一样强。
author: .jerden
source: The way that POKENAME moves is often compared to a flightless bird Pokémon. Although it seems to move awkwardly, the kicks it makes with its robotic legs are as powerful as a Combusken.

entry: POKENAME腿里的电动马达让踢击极为有力。胸前风扇防止过热，臂炮还能发射等离子体冲击。
author: .jerden
source: The electric motors inside POKENAME's legs enable it to kick foes with great force. Kept from overheating by the fan on its chest, POKENAME can also fire blasts of plasma from the cannon on its arm.

entry: POKENAME似乎忍不住用等离子体舌头舔电子产品，常造成短路。想阻止的人，也通常会被同一条舌头电击。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME seems to be compelled to lick electronics with its plasma tongue, frequently short-circuiting them. People who try to stop it from doing this are usually shocked by the same appendage.

entry: 与常见误解相反，POKENAME确实靠天然气运作。污染太多，训练家每养一只就得交税。可惜它偏偏会被算作两只。
author: inquis1
source: Contrary to popular misconception, POKENAME does in fact run on natural gas. They produce so much pollution that their Trainers are taxed for each one they own. Unfortunately for POKENAME, it is counted twice.

entry: POKENAME粗壮的轮子能驶过任何地形，平时只走直线，推平一切挡路物。轮子无法转向，却能一侧向前、一侧倒转，原地旋身。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's rugged wheels can drive across any terrain. It usually just goes in straight lines, bulldozing anything in its way. It is unable to turn its wheels, but it can spin around by driving forward on one side and in reverse on the other.

entry: 野生POKENAME偶尔出现在游乐场或建筑外。有人爬上背，就开始前后摇晃，直到对方跌落或跳下；通常是发现它不会停，只好下去。
author: .jerden
source: Wild POKENAME can occasionally be found at funfairs or outside buildings. If someone climbs onto its back it will start rocking back and forwards, continuing until they either fall or leap off, usually after realizing POKENAME won't stop otherwise.

entry: POKENAME的履带推动旋转的角，缓慢却不停地向前。人类用它拆楼，但必须训练只盯一栋，免得拆完又朝路上的下一栋前进。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's tracks drive its rotating horn forward slowly but relentlessly. It has been used by humans to demolish buildings, but must be trained to only target a single building, rather than just continuing on to the next building in its path.

entry: POKENAME体内的蛋虽受到悉心孵育，却始终没有破壳的迹象。尽管如此，POKENAME依然很快乐。
author: patch_bros
source: Even though it's very well incubated, the egg inside of a POKENAME never seems to show signs of hatching. Despite this, POKENAME remains happy.

entry: POKENAME的嗅觉对游离离子很敏感，因此常成群涌向发电厂。到了就一群群堆在一起，想取得变压器的电能。
author: inquis1
source: POKENAME's sense of smell is attuned to the presence of free ions. This is why they are observed to gravitate in droves towards power plants. They pile up in teams once there, hoping to get their hands on the juice of a power transformer.

entry: POKENAME身体泛着电光，碰到什么都能电击。孩子似乎很好奇，不断靠近陌生事物，父母则焦急守望，攻击任何潜在威胁。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's bodies glow with electrical energy, and can shock anything they touch. The child seems to be very curious, constantly approaching unfamiliar things, while the parent anxiously watches over it, attacking anything that might be a threat.

entry: POKENAME用带电身体保护孩子。宝宝比成体对科技更好奇，经常爬出袋子，玩电子产品。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME uses its electrically charged body parts to defend its child. This infant is much more curious about technology than the adult, and frequently climbs out of the pouch to play with electronics.

entry: POKENAME常住在美发店、电视摄影棚，帮助女演员吹干头发。它不喜欢话多的人，觉得烦，就会吐墨。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME tend to live in salons and TV studios, helping with drying the hair of Actresses. POKENAME do not like people who talk too much and will spit ink at people they find annoying.

entry: POKENAME以惊人音域闻名，想到什么歌都能唱。因此既有人戏谑地狂热追捧，也被实际用于餐厅、酒吧等场所。
author: jangodiot
source: POKENAME is known for its impressive vocal range, being able to sing any song that comes to mind. This has led to both an ironic cult-like following as well as practical use in various establishments such as restaurants and bars.

entry: POKENAME流畅、现代的外观很受珍视，常被养在办公室与商场的水族箱中，充当装饰。
author: inquis1
source: POKENAME are valued for their slick and modern appearance. They are a common decorative fixture in the aquariums of offices and malls.

entry: POKENAME藏在电脑室等电子设备密集处，悄悄吸取机器电力，想加快进化。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: POKENAME hides in places full of electronic devices, such as computer labs. It subtly drains the power from the machines, trying to speed its evolution up.

entry: POKENAME休息时，能收回构成双翼的电能。拍翼释放大量粉末，形成的云团酷似电视雪花。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can retract the electric energy that comprises its wings when it needs to rest. When its wings flap and release large amounts of powder, the clouds it creates look remarkably like TV static.

entry: POKENAME的镰刀带电，斩击还会引发电击。因此是十分危险的猎手，几秒就能抓住猎物。
author: equation8573
source: A slash by POKENAME can cause an electrical shock because its scythes are imbued with electricity. This makes it a very dangerous hunter, capable of catching prey in a matter of seconds.

entry: 这只POKENAME附身麦克风，即使没连任何扬声器，也能唱出响亮、清楚、颤音连连的奇异歌曲。
author: hophoppip
source: This POKENAME has possessed a microphone. It lets out strange, warbling songs that ring out loudly and clearly, even if it's not connected to any speaker.

entry: POKENAME体内旋转的马达不断发电，可作为建筑备用电源。但必须定期导走电力，免得积电过多，化作闪电释放。
author: .jerden
source: A spinning motor inside POKENAME constantly generates electrical energy. While they can be used as backup generators for buildings, they must be regularly drained of power to prevent excess electricity from discharging as bolts of lightning.

entry: 谁想骑POKENAME，它就会大怒、疯狂挣动，想把骑手甩下。训练家间流行挑战，看谁能在背上坚持最久。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME become enraged when anyone attempts to ride them, thrashing around wildly in an attempt to throw the rider off. It is a popular challenge among Trainers to see who can last the longest on their backs.

entry: POKENAME的电路不适应海洋，只能认命住在观赏池。据说，它为摆脱弱小身体才参与融合。也有人说，能看出它对沦为观赏鱼的愤怒。
author: inquis1
source: POKENAME's circuits don't take too well to the ocean, so they are resigned to live solely in ornamental ponds. It's said they took up fusion to leave behind their weak bodies. Some say they can see fury in them for having been made a decorative fish.

entry: 醒着飞行时，双翼高速旋转，嗡鸣很响。各自偏爱特定蜂蜜、树液，会用闪电保护来源。
author: infinex21
source: Their wings spin rapidly, and buzz quite loudly, when they are awake and flying about. They each prefer certain kinds of honey and sap and will protect the sources of such things with electrical bolts.

entry: 雷暴中，POKENAME从一台街机诞生。如今，它执着地吞食现实中的树果，一心想长得更大。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: Spawned from an arcade cabinet during a lightning storm, POKENAME now obsessively consumes berries in the real world to increase in size.

entry: 传言，闪电劈中街机厅，就会形成POKENAME。它故意让栖居的游戏变得很难，想骗出更多硬币吃。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: It is rumoured that POKENAME forms when lightning strikes an arcade. It purposefully makes the game it resides in very difficult, hoping to draw out more coins for it to eat.

entry: POKENAME背部的等离子体尖刺之间，电弧跳跃，嘴里满是看似杂讯的东西。这股杂讯能分解吞下的一切，或化为伤人的射束攻击敌人。
author: .jerden
source: Electricity arcs between the spikes of plasma on POKENAME's back, and its mouth is filled with what appears to be static. This static can disintegrate anything POKENAME swallows, or be fired out at foes as damaging beams.

entry: POKENAME常打开背上的保温箱，为海滩游客送上饮品。可饮料究竟打哪儿来，谁也说不清。
author: gp423
source: POKENAME will often provide refreshments to beachgoers using the cooler on its back. Where these drinks come from, nobody quite knows.

entry: POKENAME除了变成其他宝可梦，也能重塑身体，模仿任何电器。看似很有用，却经常无法复制功能。
author: .jerden
source: In addition to transforming into other Pokémon, POKENAME can reshape its body to resemble any electrical appliance. While this seems useful, it frequently fails to replicate their function.

entry: POKENAME被养在巨大人造草坪，整日过着田园般的生活。电路里满是憧憬，梦想某天训练家前来选中自己。
author: inquis1
source: POKENAME are kept on massive astroturf fields where they spend most of their days living an idyllic existence. Their circuits dream wistfully of the day a Trainer will come and pick them out.

entry: POKENAME身体由凝聚的带电等离子体组成，轻盈、敏捷。喜欢吸食设备与机器的电能，因此有人把它们视为麻烦。
author: infinex21
source: Its body is made of condensed electric plasma, making it very light and agile. POKENAME love to feed on the electrical energy of devices and machines, so some consider it and its kind to be pests.

entry: POKENAME喜欢潜入微波炉等电器，吸收产生的热量。据报告，这导致许多普通家庭的电子产品故障。
author: npshi
source: POKENAME are known to enjoy infiltrating appliances such as microwaves to absorb the heat they generate. This reportedly has caused many electronics in everyday households to malfunction.

entry: POKENAME喜欢通过便携电脑传送，开心地穿行数字空间，有时还会擅自重排储存内容。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME loves being sent through a Box Link. It zips across digital spaces with glee, sometimes rearranging the contents of the storage without permission.

entry: POKENAME体内有以带电等离子体与化石燃料驱动的混合马达。遇袭能缩壳滚走，沿途留下废气。
author: equation8573
source: POKENAME has a hybrid motor powered by electric plasma and fossil fuel found inside its body. This allows POKENAME to retreat into its shell when attacked, and roll away, leaving exhaust gas in its wake.

entry: 壳上的眼睛只是用来蒙骗的花纹。它们附在船上，移动更快，也会试着偷偷上船，吸食电力。
author: infinex21
source: The eyes upon their shells are markings meant to fool others. They attach to boats to get around quicker, though they also try to sneak aboard to feed on electricity.

entry: 镰刀划出的微小伤口，也可能麻痹超过一天。它将镰刀浸进水里放电，削弱或击昏大群猎物。
author: infinex21
source: Even a small cut from its scythes can result in numbness that can last for over a day. It dips its scythes into water and releases electricity to weaken or knock out large batches of prey.

entry: 身体像某些宝可梦的化石，似乎主要用于威吓。能将猎物整个“吞下”，用等离子体包住，吸尽电力，再丢弃。
author: infinex21
source: Its body resembles a fossil of certain Pokémon, which seems to mostly be for the sake of intimidating others. It can "swallow" prey whole, wrapping them in its plasma and siphoning them of any and all electricity before discarding them.

entry: 这只洛托姆附在自动贩卖机里。战斗时，它会借助强大的电击，将饮料射出去。
author: jackjirachi
source: This Rotom has possessed a vending machine. When in battle, it shoots out the refreshments using powerful electric shocks.

entry: POKENAME柔软、可抱的外形，很受幼儿园小朋友欢迎。幼儿园常用腹部屏幕，播放其他地区孩子的冒险与故事，让孩子从小认识各地。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are quite popular with Preschoolers, who enjoy POKENAME's cuddly appearance. Preschools often use POKENAME's belly screen to show adventures and stories of children from other regions, so children can learn about them from a young age.

entry: POKENAME通常会干扰电气设备。粉色光芒释放强劲能量，靠近时能让飞机等交通工具故障。
author: animecreep4
source: POKENAME usually interferes with electrical equipment. Its pink glow acts as a strong energy output, causing planes and other vehicles to malfunction when it is nearby.

entry: POKENAME如游泳般浮空移动。定期蜕皮，留下透明薄膜，能保护电子设备免受静电电击。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME floats through the air, moving as if swimming. It sheds its skin regularly, producing a thin transparent film that can be used to protect electronic devices from static shocks.

entry: POKENAME体内储存电能，能缠住电池与电子设备充电。必须仔细训练，充满就停，免得过充损坏。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's body stores electrical energy, and it can coil around batteries and electronic devices to recharge them. To avoid causing damage by overcharging them, POKENAME must be carefully trained to stop when they are full.

entry: POKENAME能不落地飞往世界任何地方，靠与飞机相同的信号导航。袋中可载人、包裹，但必须绝缘，防止闪烁翅膀产生的电荷伤害。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME can fly anywhere in the world without needing to land, navigating using the same signals as airplanes. It can carry people and packages in its pouch, but they must be insulated from the electric charge its flickering wings produce.

entry: POKENAME双臂由带电等离子体组成，能电击敌人。尾端坚硬的刺也能边注入强毒，边电击。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's arms are made of electrically charged plasma, enabling it to electrocute foes. The solid stinger at the tip of its tail will also shock foes while delivering potent venom.

entry: POKENAME是顽皮的恶作剧高手，忽然出现，又转眼消失。喜欢干扰相机等设备，使拍摄工作迟迟无法推进。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are mischievous tricksters that appear and disappear in a flash. They love to disrupt devices such as cameras, which has delayed efforts to photograph them.

entry: POKENAME用头顶传感器测量湿度、温度，是养室内植物的训练家的好帮手。感知到植物需要浇水，就会哔哔响。
author: havic0970
source: POKENAME uses a sensor on its head to measure humidity and temperature, making it a helpful companion for Trainers with houseplants. It beeps when it senses a plant that needs to be watered.

entry: 电叶散出臭氧气味。虽然味道奇怪，它仍像植物般净化周围空气。
author: havic0970
source: The scent of ozone comes from its electric leaves. Despite its strange smell, it purifies the air around it like a plant.

entry: POKENAME带电触角刺激植物生长。只要阳光足够供能，新芽就会生机勃勃地冒出。
author: havic0970
source: Its electric antennae stimulate plant growth. New buds spring to life, as long as it's sunny enough to keep POKENAME powered.

entry: POKENAME藏在电子设备里遇袭，会让等离子体猛烈爆发，令设备过热。连接的任何线路也会烧坏、起火。
author: soup1900
source: If POKENAME is inside an electronic device and is attacked, it flares up in plasma, overheating the device it's in. Any wiring attached to the device it is in when these plasma flares happen will burn out and catch on fire.

entry: 它向敌人吐出凝聚的炽热等离子球，命中便爆发热量与电力。生气时，火焰和电流会从背部猛烈涌出。
author: infinex21
source: It spits balls of condensed, hot plasma at foes that explode with heat and electricity on impact. If angered, flames and electricity erupt violently from its back.

entry: 它们吸取机器的电力，过程中却也常将机器烧坏。受到挑战，就从颈后释放滚烫电流。
author: infinex21
source: They leech electricity from machines, though they also tend to cause those machines to be fried in the process. If challenged, they release a torrent of superhot electricity from the backs of their necks.

entry: 野生POKENAME偶尔待在建筑里，守护特定电器，驱赶所有靠近者。刺针猛烈电击让人不适，即使逃走，感觉仍久久不散。
author: .jerden
source: Wild POKENAME are occasionally found inside buildings, defending specific electrical appliances from anyone who approaches. The sharp shocks delivered by their stingers make people feel unwell, lingering even after they get away from POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME常栖在无线电塔、天线上，干扰信号，因此被视为麻烦。它能精准放电，让小发电机过载。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are often considered nuisances because they will perch atop radio towers and antennae and they disrupt signals when they do. They can loose precise electrical jolts that can overload small generators.

entry: POKENAME常在现代赌场工作，一有玩家获胜，就跑过去，脸上显示所得奖励。虽然机器已经显示这些信息，它仍乐此不疲。
author: theaceofhearts0306
source: Often seen employed at modern Casinos, POKENAME will scurry towards a winning player, displaying their reward on its face. Although the machines already display such metrics, POKENAME loves doing it anyway.

entry: 训练家在家需要定时提醒，常会依赖POKENAME。设定时间一到，就飞向训练家，振动、大声鸣叫，引起注意。
author: quackquackattack
source: Whenever Trainers are home and need a reminder, many rely on POKENAME to remind them after a set period of time. Once time is up, POKENAME fly to their Trainer, vibrating and releasing loud chirps to get their attention.

entry: POKENAME从角释放强力十万伏特，精准无比。它用爪子攀住洞顶，落向毫无防备的猎物，再以带电咬击使其麻痹。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME release strong Thunderbolts from their horns with great precision. They use their claws to cling to cave ceilings and drop on unsuspecting prey, then paralyze them with a shocking bite.

entry: 野生POKENAME栖在输电塔顶或电缆，吸收部分电力供能。一周内若不赶走，就会变得极具领地意识。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME perch atop electrical transmission towers, or along the cables, and absorb some of the electricity to fuel their own bodies. They become very territorial if they are not chased away within a week.

entry: POKENAME借触角的离子电荷，彼此交流天气。大量聚集时，会协调起舞，唤来雨水。
author: inquis1
source: POKENAME uses the ionic charge of its antenna to communicate with each other about the weather. When many gather in one place, they coordinate a dance to bring forth the rain.

entry: 虽然有人觉得POKENAME及其等离子体身体美妙非凡，它却不断威胁电网。能吸电就吸，似乎不知道，或根本不在乎对其他生灵的影响。
author: infinex21
source: Although some find these Pokémon and their plasma bodies to be marvelous to view, POKENAME are constant dangers to electrical grids. They feed on electricity wherever they can, seemingly unaware, or just uncaring, of the effects on others.

entry: POKENAME为寻找电能，用腹下伸出的长线接上电缆。数量够多，就会拖累当地电网，给人类社区添麻烦。
author: vic1312
source: Seeking electrical energy, POKENAME attach themselves to power lines via the long wire protruding from their underbelly. If gathered in sufficient numbers, POKENAME can be a drain on the local power grid, which can be a problem for human communities.

entry: POKENAME散出大量能量，让附近水域灭菌。研究者曾饲养它，以便轻松取得净水。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME gives off great amounts of energy that causes nearby water to become sterilised. Researchers used to keep them to be able to easily obtain purified water.

entry: POKENAME散出大量能量，让附近水域灭菌，再吸收这些水，身体就会发光。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME gives off great amounts of energy that causes nearby water to become sterilised. POKENAME then absorb this sterilised water, which makes them glow.

entry: POKENAME散出大量能量，让附近水域灭菌。没有微生物循环养分，小池塘可能因此失去一切生命。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME gives off great amounts of energy that causes nearby water to become sterilised. With no microorganisms in it to recycle nutrients, this can cause small ponds to become void of all life.

entry: POKENAME能控制电子光源。追逐敌人时，会关掉所有灯，依靠夜视。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME can control electronic light sources. When it's chasing down a foe, it will turn all the lights off and rely on its night vision.

entry: POKENAME钻进电子设备，模仿人类或宝可梦的声音，骗其他生灵交出闪亮物品，再兴奋收藏。
author: zebrarook_
source: POKENAME slips into electronic devices and mimics the voices of people or Pokémon. It uses these imitations to trick others into handing over shiny objects, which it eagerly collects.

entry: POKENAME啃电缆，吃里面的电。单只无害，大群却常让紫堇市停电。
author: smissmassentree_81799
source: POKENAME munch on cables to feed on the electricity inside. While harmless on their own, large colonies regularly cause blackouts in Mauville City.

entry: POKENAME用叶片的特殊结构，将阳光转成电力，再经两条藤蔓输送。
author: lurch327
source: POKENAME use the special structure of their leaves to generate electricity from sunlight. The collected electricity can then be delivered through their two vines.

entry: 谁打POKENAME的蓝色沙袋，它也不在意，精彩一击还会显示高分。但若想损坏后面的电子部件，就会释放每次挨打积攒的能量反击。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME is unbothered if anyone strikes its blue punching bag, and will display high scores for impressive hits. If anyone tries to damage the electronics behind it, POKENAME will counterattack by discharging energy stored up from every hit.

entry: POKENAME挨打时，周围等离子体会更亮。虽然能耐心承受，却随时可能突然放尽储能，化为强力电击。
author: .jerden
source: If POKENAME is struck, the plasma around it will glow brighter. While it can patiently endure attacks, at any moment it may suddenly discharge all of its stored energy as a powerful electric shock.

entry: 它的头与尾各有独立的意识，平时互不相通，唯有战斗时，两颗心才能真正同步。
author: staghorn
source: The consciousnesses in its head and tail are completely separate. Only in battle do its two minds properly synchronize.

entry: POKENAME在插座旁筑巢，用尾巴插入吸电。住户可能因它恶作剧，发现墙上多了个洞。
author: equation8573
source: POKENAME nests near power outlets to consume the electricity by plugging into it using its tail. Homeowners may notice a hole in their wall due to POKENAME's mischief.

entry: 它们用爪子抓住敌人、猎物，施以强电击倒。叫声像在嘻笑别人，又常对其他生灵吐舌，让这种印象更深。
author: infinex21
source: They latch onto foes and prey with their claws and deliver strong jolts to down them. Their cries tend to sound as if they are giggling or chuckling at others, further enforced by how they stick their tongues out at others so often.

entry: POKENAME的剪刃锋利如剃刀，连夹在中间的幽灵属性宝可梦也能切开。柄处带电的等离子体，让红色闪电沿刃跳跃，电击任何想触碰的对象。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's scissor blades are razor sharp, and can even cut Ghost-type Pokémon caught between them. The charged plasma at their handles causes red lightning to crackle along the blades, shocking anyone who tries to touch them.

entry: 钳子动得太快，常像有四只，其实只有两只。它使出强力子弹拳，每击都带麻痹电流。
author: infinex21
source: Its pincers can move so quick around it that it often looks as if it has four of them, but it only has two. It delivers powerful Bullet Punch attacks that deliver paralytic jolts with every blow.

entry: 身体由等离子体组成，却也常显得硬如铁。翅膀喷电，推动高速移动，再借势用钳子打出雷霆重击。
author: infinex21
source: Its body is made of plasma, yet often seems to be as hard as iron as well. It can move very fast by jetting electricity from its wings, and uses the momentum to deliver thunderous blows with its pincers.

entry: POKENAME的钢壳空心，内部充满带电等离子体。被钳子抓住的任何东西，都会受到强烈电击。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's steel shell is hollow, and filled with electrically charged plasma. Anything that it seizes with its pincers will receive a powerful electric shock.

entry: POKENAME的各块钢壳靠内部带电等离子体相连。发光翅膀拍动，产生磁场，干扰附近电子设备。
author: .jerden
source: The various pieces of POKENAME's steel shell are held together by the electrically charged plasma inside them. The beating of its glowing wings produces magnetic fields that interfere with nearby electronics.

entry: 它寄居在电动搅拌机里，保护娇弱的身体。收集树果榨成提神的果汁，能让失去战斗能力的宝可梦恢复活力。有人认为，这种果汁与伤药有关。
author: mistymagius
source: It inhabits an electric blender to protect its delicate body. It collects berries to create an energizing juice that it uses to re-energize fainted Pokémon. Some believe its juice is related to potions.

entry: POKENAME将自己液化，钻进电器，吸取能量，操控功能或动作。待得太久，会让设备过热、停机。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME liquify themselves to fit into electrical devices to siphon off energy and influence the controls or actions of the devices. A POKENAME staying within a device for too long causes the device to overheat and shut down.

entry: POKENAME让灯状身体里的炽热熔岩跳动，周围就充满大片红光，方便在暗洞看清。但熔岩必须缓慢晃动，否则玻璃碎裂，熔岩全流出来。
author: soup1900
source: When POKENAME bounces around hot lava inside its lamp-shaped body, a large ambient red light fills the surrounding area, helping it see in dark caves. However, it must bounce the magma slowly; otherwise, its glass breaks and all the lava flows out.

entry: POKENAME像烤面包的电器。内部高压等离子体会烤焦放入的食物，但一弹出，就立刻变冷。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME resembles an appliance used for toasting bread. Although the high-voltage plasma inside POKENAME scorches food placed inside it, it quickly becomes cold as soon as it pops out.

entry: POKENAME靠制冷不断造冰，但堆起来的冰主要是诱饵。攻击冰的伤害，低于攻击下方地面上的箱子。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME uses refrigeration to constantly produce ice, but the pile this creates primarily serves as a decoy. Attacks directed at POKENAME's ice will do less damage than attacks directed at the box on the ground beneath it.

entry: POKENAME常与同类在海底光缆周围安家。珊瑚枝条多彩、电光闪烁，靠颜色交流。
author: beatdoof
source: POKENAME is often seen making its home with other POKENAME surrounding parts of undersea optic cables. They communicate by the color of their sparky, colorful coral branches.

entry: 有人认为，这些宝可梦启发了某些科幻作品的武器设计。攻击精准无比，极少失手。
author: infinex21
source: Some people believe these Pokémon were the inspiration for some weapons depicted in some science-fiction media. They can release attacks with extreme precision and rarely miss.

entry: POKENAME水陆两栖，在陆地也能如海床般轻松滑行。炮状吻部能发射电能，但水下移动时，除非有意，发光等离子体不会电到附近宝可梦。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME is amphibious, gliding across the ground as easily as the seabed. POKENAME can discharge blasts of electricity from its cannon-like snout, but when travelling underwater its glowing plasma will not shock nearby Pokémon unless it wants it to.

entry: POKENAME水陆两栖，在陆地也能如海床般轻松滑行。炮状吻部能发射电能，但水下移动时，除非有意，发光等离子体不会电到附近宝可梦。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME is amphibious, gliding across the ground as easily as the seabed. POKENAME can discharge blasts of electricity from its cannon-like snout, but when travelling underwater its glowing plasma will not shock nearby Pokémon unless it wants it to.

entry: POKENAME与手机相连，缓缓缠绕设备，几乎像在玩游戏。一撞到自己，就发出轻微电脉冲，再失望似地嘶嘶叫。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Bound to cellphones, POKENAME can be found slowly wrapping around their device, almost like they're in a game. If they bump into themselves, they let out a mild pulse of electricity before hissing in what sounds like disappointment.

entry: POKENAME举起长鼻，喷出闪亮火花。虽然如蝴蝶浮在空中，仍要让孩子保持距离，免得电到。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME lifts its long trunk to spray out a shower of shimmering sparks. Although they float in the air like butterflies, children should be kept at a safe distance to prevent them from being shocked.

entry: POKENAME用长鼻吸灰，能带进家里清地，直到一尘不染才停。滚过时，会轻碰喂食者的脚踝，表达亲昵。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME sucks up dirt using its long nose, and can be brought into human homes to clean the floor, as it will not stop until the floor is spotless. It will show affection for humans that feed it by bumping into their ankles as it rolls past.

entry: POKENAME用长鼻吸灰，能带进家里清地，直到一尘不染才停。滚过时，会轻碰喂食者的脚踝，表达亲昵。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME sucks up dirt using its long nose, and can be brought into human homes to clean the floor, as it will not stop until the floor is spotless. It will show affection for humans that feed it by bumping into their ankles as it rolls past.

entry: POKENAME举起长鼻，喷出闪亮火花。虽然如蝴蝶浮在空中，仍要让孩子保持距离，免得电到。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME lifts its long trunk to spray out a shower of shimmering sparks. Although they float in the air like butterflies, children should be kept at a safe distance to prevent them from being shocked.

entry: POKENAME像未来版顿甲。滚动时，用发光铁履带碾碎一切挡路物。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME resembles a futuristic version of Donphan. When rolling along, it will crush anything that gets in its way using its glowing iron treads.

entry: POKENAME能跃进附近任何电子设备，迅速适应。天性调皮，改善设备或让它胡乱运作的机会相等，一切只为取乐。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's abilities let it leap into any electronic nearby and adapt to its surroundings quickly. Mischievous by nature, it has an equal chance of enhancing somebody's device as it does causing it to behave erratically, all in the name of amusement.

entry: POKENAME靠观察四周取得的信息为食，调整形象，吸引其他生灵。一旦有人受诱惑，就会竭尽所能，尽量长久留住注意力。
author: npshi
source: POKENAME feed off the information they obtain by surveying their surroundings, adjusting their image to be enticing to others. When POKENAME have tempted someone, they will do anything in their power to keep their attention for as long as possible.

entry: POKENAME附身旧绘图程序，常捣乱人们创作的作品，同时传出带杂讯的笑声。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: POKENAME possesses an old drawing program. It often messes with art people attempt to create, as a staticky laugh is heard as it does this.

entry: POKENAME从双手放电，增强打击。还会捡起附近电器当临时武器，每次弄坏，似乎又很失望。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME can discharge electricity from its hands to increase the power of its strikes. It will pick up nearby electrical appliances to use as improvised weapons, and seems to be disappointed whenever this breaks them.

entry: POKENAME像一台街机，里面的蛇吃水果就能长尾巴。许多孩子爱玩，想破高分，父母则试图拔掉电源，让孩子做家务。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME resembles an arcade machine that hosts a game where a snake eats fruits to grow its tail. Many children love to spend time with POKENAME hoping to beat the high score, while parents try to unplug its energy to get children to do chores.

entry: POKENAME似乎全身都能感光，即使眼状花纹被盖住，也仍像看得见般行动。周围的发光等离子体能电击敌人，头顶利刺则注入毒液。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's entire body seems to be sensitive to light, as it will still behave if it can see even if its eye-shaped markings are covered. The glowing plasma that surrounds it can shock enemies, while the sharp spike on its head can deliver venom.

entry: POKENAME用四根软管向经过领地的人喷奶，以吓人为傲。偶尔还附身冰箱，等开门时，用一阵冷奶突袭。
author: the_smirker
source: POKENAME uses its four hoses to spray milk on anyone who passes by its territory. It takes great pride in scaring them. In rare cases, it will even possess fridges, waiting to surprise anyone who opens the door with a cold shower of milk.

entry: 角状触角用于与同类交流。想放电时，就快速摩擦脸颊，让电流四处飞散。
author: infinex21
source: Its horn-like antenna serves as means for it to communicate with others of its species. To release electricity, it rubs its cheeks quickly and lets jolts fly all about.

entry: 等离子体翅膀至少闪着七种颜色，释放的光能带来如阳光般的温暖。它们吐出带电火球自卫。
author: infinex21
source: Their plasma wings shine with at least seven colors and release enough light to produce a warmth akin to sunlight. They defend themselves by spitting electrically-charged fireballs.

entry: 曾有记录称，POKENAME以时速88英里穿行，时而遁入时间，时而重返现世。
author: supersonicloki
source: There have been records of POKENAME being seen drifting in and out of time at a speed of 88 mph.

entry: POKENAME尾部储存的养分与自身电力反应，产生微弱能量信号。研究发现，喂下桃粉色花蜜，数小时后尾巴便会散出愉悦香水的舒缓香气，伴着它开心蹦跳。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME stores nutrients in its tail that react with the electricity it generates, creating a faint energy signature. Researchers found that feeding it Pink Nectar causes its tail to emit a soothing Joy Scent hours later as it bounces happily along.

entry: POKENAME夜间飞行，旋翼明亮发光。似乎爱在机场惹麻烦，会绕空管塔盘旋，干扰设备与通信。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME fly around at night, their rotors glowing brightly. They seem to enjoy causing problems at airports and will circle around air traffic control towers to disrupt their equipment and communications.

entry: 储电过多，就会变得好斗，猛烈释放电力。等放出足够多，又会恢复十分友好、温顺。
author: infinex21
source: When they store too much electricity, they become aggressive and violently release their electricity. Once they have released enough, they return to being very friendly and docile.

entry: POKENAME附身口香糖机，静止在人多的地方吃硬币。投入槽里的钱什么都吞，却似乎不愿吐出里面任何糖果。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME possesses a gumball machine, and remains motionless in populated areas to feed on coins. While it swallows any money placed into its slot, it seems to be unwilling to dispense any of the candy inside it.

entry: POKENAME飘过空中，接收无线电，再用同频广播自己的内容。通常只是录下的歌曲或广告片段，但选择似乎并非随机。
author: .jerden
source: As POKENAME float through the air, they pick up radio transmissions, then broadcast their own on the same frequencies. These are usually just snippets of songs or advertisements POKENAME has recorded, although they do not seem to be chosen at random.

entry: POKENAME飘过空中，接收无线电，再用同频广播自己的内容。通常只是录下的歌曲或广告片段，但选择似乎并非随机。
author: .jerden
source: As POKENAME float through the air, they pick up radio transmissions, then broadcast their own on the same frequencies. These are usually just snippets of songs or advertisements POKENAME has recorded, although they do not seem to be chosen at random.

entry: POKENAME夜飞时亮得地面的人都会注意。偶尔用光束将物品、其他宝可梦，甚至人举到空中，但通常会安然放下。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME fly through the sky at night, glowing bright enough to draw attention from people on the ground. They will occasionally lift objects, other Pokémon, or even people into the air with their beams, but usually put them down without harm.

entry: POKENAME夜飞时亮得地面的人都会注意。偶尔用光束将物品、其他宝可梦，甚至人举到空中，但通常会安然放下。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME fly through the sky at night, glowing bright enough to draw attention from people on the ground. They will occasionally lift objects, other Pokémon, or even people into the air with their beams, but usually put them down without harm.

entry: POKENAME形似自动贩卖机，只为引人靠近，再伸舌舔。可能电击，但通常只是发麻。补货也用这条舌头，偷拿无人看管的食物、饮料。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's body resembles a vending machine, but this only lures people close so that POKENAME can lick them with its tongue, which may shock but usually just tingles. POKENAME restocks by using the same tongue to grab unattended food and drinks.

entry: POKENAME用钻头高速钻地，寻找矿藏吃。常被养在采石场，帮助挖出大型隧道。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are able to burrow through the ground at high speeds using their drills, searching for mineral deposits to consume. These Pokémon are often kept in quarries, helping to dig out large tunnels.

entry: POKENAME在发电厂及附近演化，天生喜欢电缆噼啪嗡鸣。它爱静坐变电站下，专心听这种声音。
author: inquis1
source: Having evolved in and around power plants, POKENAME naturally love the crackling buzzing sound that power cables make. They love to sit quietly under transformer stations, listening to this exact sound.

entry: POKENAME体内充满电力与火焰，能凝成球，从双臂射出。也爱用手臂发强光，假装要攻击，捉弄其他生灵。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are filled with electricity and flames, which they will condense into balls and shoot them from their arms. They like to trick others as if they are going to attack them by emitting strong lights from their arms.

entry: POKENAME电风扇吹出的不是凉风，而是滚烫沙漠沙粒。喷力足以刮掉表面油漆。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's electrically powered fan does not blow out cool air, but hot desert sand. POKENAME can expel these particulates with enough force to strip paint off surfaces.

entry: POKENAME的电动马达带动旋翼高速转动，让它悬空、向任何方向移动，也制造强风，使人难以靠近。
author: .jerden
source: An electric motor spins POKENAME's rotor at high speed. This enables it to hover in the air and move in any direction, as well as producing powerful winds that make POKENAME difficult to approach.

entry: POKENAME通过纯等离子体叶片吸收太阳能，不断补充体内电力。动作飘忽，速度、敏捷惊人，很容易躲过捕捉。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME absorbs solar energy through its leaves of pure plasma, perpetually replenishing the power coursing through its body. Its erratic movements allow it to evade capture with remarkable speed and agility.

entry: 尾尖锋利，能刺穿多数材料，接上机器吸能。它栖在高处，俯冲偷走路人设备进食。
author: infinex21
source: The tip of its tail is sharp enough to penetrate most materials, allowing it to connect to machines and absorb their energy. It perches high to swoop down and steal devices from passersby to feed.

entry: POKENAME獠牙由电力组成，接触谁就电击谁。厚毛隔绝电与热，却似乎在马达轰鸣的工业冷冻库最舒服，还能听声音。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's tusks are made of electricity, and will shock anyone they make contact with. Its thick fur insulates it from electricity and heat, but it seems to be most comfortable inside industrial freezers with loud motors for it to listen to.

entry: POKENAME电风扇吹出的不是凉风，而是滚烫沙漠沙粒。喷力足以刮掉表面油漆。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's electrically powered fan does not blow out cool air, but hot desert sand. POKENAME can expel these particulates with enough force to strip paint off surfaces.

entry: POKENAME利爪不断噼啪带电，劈中便会电击。背上覆盖发光等离子体，蜷成球，就能电到任何接触者。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's sharp claws constantly crackle with electricity, electrocuting anyone it slashes. Its back is covered by glowing plasma, and it can curl up into a ball to shock anyone who makes contact with it.

entry: POKENAME部分身体浸在沸油里，却似乎毫不在意。双腿看似乱挥，靠近时却都能踢出强击。
author: .jerden
source: Part of POKENAME's body is immersed in boiling oil, although this doesn't seem to bother it. Although its legs seem to flail about, both of them can deliver powerful kicks to anything that gets close.

entry: POKENAME部分身体浸在油炸锅里，似乎不痛，也不妨碍蹦跳、打出强拳。还能跃空，伴着沸油雨落向敌人。
author: .jerden
source: The immersion of part of POKENAME's body inside a deep-fat fryer doesn't seem to cause it pain, or stop it from hopping around to deliver powerful punches. POKENAME can also leap into the air, dropping down on foes amidst a shower of boiling oil.

entry: POKENAME全身由等离子体组成，跳进电器，想贴近训练家。心地善良，曾被观察到用部分储电，让旧坏机器恢复运作。
author: sk372
source: With a body made entirely of plasma, POKENAME leaps into electronics to stick close to its Trainer. It has a kind heart, and has been observed using some of its electric stores to bring old non-functioning machines back to life.

entry: POKENAME的训练家遇险，就会动用全部精神力量，控制半径10英里内的所有电子设备。讽刺的是，这又危及其他训练家，附近有同类就可能连锁反应。
author: darkweavile428
source: If POKENAME's Trainer is in danger, it will use all of its psychic power to take control of every electronic device in a 10-mile radius. Ironically, doing this endangers other Trainers, which can cause a chain reaction if other POKENAME are nearby.

entry: 它们偏爱避开其他生灵，甚至放出强电，不让人留下记录。即使被驯服、受到善待，也很少愿被察觉，可能用电涌暂时弄停训练家的设备。
author: infinex21
source: They prefer to avoid others and release powerful electricity to even avoid having records of them be obtained. Even if tamed and treated well, they rarely like to be perceived and may temporarily disable their Trainers' devices with electric surges.

entry: POKENAME十分忠诚，头部与双臂上的电锯，却能轻松切开金属。许多训练家觉得，它很像某个虚构角色。
author: thefinalkalgonus
source: POKENAME is a loyal fusion. The chainsaws on its arms and head can easily cut through metal. Many Trainers think it resembles a fictional character.

entry: POKENAME亮出等离子刀，从电脑屏幕跳出，捉弄长者。但荣誉准则又迫使它事后补偿，帮助对方操作设备。
author: lordjoostmeister
source: POKENAME pranks seniors by leaping out of their computer screens, plasma blade drawn. However, its code of honor forces it to compensate its victims afterward by helping them with their devices.

entry: POKENAME的爪子与尖刺由发光等离子体组成。蜷球滚动时，旋转发电、储能，接触敌人就能释放。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's claws and spikes are made of glowing plasma. When POKENAME curls itself up into a ball to roll around, it will generate electricity as it spins, charging itself with power that it can discharge when making contact with an enemy.

entry: POKENAME基本能当作轻松移动重物的工具，也能当作对生物做同样事情的“低致命性武器”。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME essentially functions as a tool that can move heavy objects with ease or a "less lethal weapon" that can do the same with living things.

entry: POKENAME形似双人游戏机。控制非玩家角色时极好胜，拼命想击败人类玩家，但只有面对高手才破坏规则。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME takes the form of a video game console for two players. POKENAME is highly competitive when controlling non-player characters, trying its best to beat humans playing against it, but only breaks the rules when up against very skilled players.

entry: POKENAME只出现在电气死区，从未被见过在其间移动。研究者试图捕捉，设备常会故障，仿佛存在本身就能破坏电气系统。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME appears only in electrical deadzones, and is never seen moving between them. Researchers attempting to capture one often find their equipment malfunctioning, as if its presence alone corrupts electrical systems.

entry: 它控制了一台碎木机。虽然体型不大，饥饿时却会贪婪吞下整棵树。
author: hophoppip
source: It has taken control of a wood chipper. Despite not being very large, it will eagerly consume entire trees when hungry.

entry: POKENAME侵入的收音机等电器，会发出可怕的幽灵声。似乎除了吓唬附近生灵，没有别的理由。
author: .izik
source: Radios and other electronics that POKENAME infests produce terrifying ghostly noises. It appears to do this for no reason other than to startle those nearby.

entry: POKENAME与街机柜相连，寻找愿互动的人。食物摄取研究发现，任何披萨只要看见就会毁掉，但原因不明。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Bound to arcade cabinets, POKENAME seek out humans who will interact with them. A study on food consumption revealed that POKENAME will destroy any pizza it sees, but it is not clear why.

entry: POKENAME爱割下大片草滋养身体，专挑长得过高的草坪，吃碎草。粗心割草已毁过许多花园。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME loves to mow down fields of grass to nourish its body, targeting lawns with overgrown grass to eat the grass clippings. Many gardens have been ruined by POKENAME's careless mowing.

entry: 它将等离子体身体塑成碎木机般的模样，但刀刃还能磨碎小石块、矿石。性情十分友好，在许多行业备受珍视。
author: infinex21
source: It has molded its body of plasma into a form reminiscent of a wood chipper, though its blades can grind up small rocks and pieces of ore. It is very friendly and its kind are treasured in many professions.

entry: POKENAME不能吃实体物质，只能靠力量吸能维生。能从电子设备、其他宝可梦，甚至阳光吸取能量。充满后，发出绿色光芒。
author: bobosmith01
source: As it cannot consume physical matter, POKENAME relies on its powers to drain energy in order to survive. It can siphon energy from electronic devices, other Pokémon, and even sunlight. When fully charged, it emits a glowing green light.

entry: POKENAME附身电器时，神秘力量能将电线当肢体，拉长至原本不可能的距离。难觅踪迹的野生个体，最常在无人看守的花园被发现。
author: bobosmith01
source: When POKENAME possesses electronics, its mysterious powers allow it to control wires like limbs and stretch them over what would normally be impossibly long distances. An elusive wild POKENAME is most often found in unguarded gardens.

entry: 背上的发光纹样会显示体内还存有多少电力。训练家常将POKENAME当作随身电池。
author: mistymagius
source: The bright patterns on its back indicate how much electricity is stored inside of its body. Trainers often keep POKENAME as portable batteries.

entry: POKENAME常徘徊加油站，假装加油，实则吸走人们车里的燃料，因此名声很差。没人知道，吸走后拿来做什么。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has earned quite a sour reputation for hanging around gas stations and pretending to offer a refueling, so that it can instead siphon the fuel from people's cars. No one is sure what it does with the siphoned fuel.

entry: POKENAME顽皮、爱玩，常用头撞人，同时释放大量静电。两只玩耍常互相碰头，迸出巨大、但多半无害的电光。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are mischievous and playful, often headbutting others which also releases plenty of static electricity. When two POKENAME play, they will often butt heads which releases large, although mostly harmless, electric bolts.

entry: 它精力充沛、爱战斗，不管玩闹还是真打。体内电力充足，全力头锤能让大敌麻痹，或释放局部电磁脉冲。
author: infinex21
source: It is full of energy and loves to fight, be it playfully or otherwise. It holds enough electricity within itself that a full-power Headbutt can paralyze a large foe or release a localized EMP.

entry: POKENAME体内电流奔涌，向前冲得越久就越快。头部一撞击，电涌便爆发而出，形成巨大雷鸣。
author: sk372
source: Electricity surges through POKENAME's body, increasing its speed the longer it charges forward. When its head makes an impact, an electrical surge explodes outward and creates a massive thunderclap.

entry: POKENAME用手机当等离子体身体的装甲。虽然电子设备似乎一撞就坏，选中的这个型号却坚固得惊人。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME uses a mobile phone as armor for its body made of plasma. Although this electronic device might be expected to break after an impact, the particular model chosen is incredibly durable.

entry: POKENAME外形、功能都像叉车。既能为仓库上货，也能保护建筑，会举起叉臂冲向任何入侵者。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME has the shape and functionality of a forklift truck. In addition to being useful for stocking warehouses, POKENAME provides the building with security, as it will charge towards any intruders with its prongs raised.

entry: POKENAME跳入电子设备，传递灾难将至的警告。但信息往往乱码、被误解，因此常无人理会。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME leaps into electronics in order to pass along warnings of impending disasters. The messages it conveys tend to be garbled and misunderstood, however, so its warnings often go unheeded.

entry: POKENAME附身带屏幕的电器，闪现可怕画面捉弄人。讽刺的是，尖叫声又会把它吓得脱离附身。
author: sk372
source: When possessing electronics with screens, POKENAME makes the objects flash spooky imagery in order to prank others. Ironically, the sound of screams will scare it out of its possession.

entry: POKENAME曾是战争工具，如今已是受保护物种。潜水员与科学家喜爱借它探索深海，任何海洋深度都能抵达。
author: inquis1
source: Once having been tools of war, POKENAME are now a protected species. They are a favourite of divers and scientists who use them to explore the deep sea. There is no depth in any ocean that POKENAME cannot reach.

entry: POKENAME附身电器，广播改变心智的信号。受影响者会相信它是神，直到它离开机器才恢复。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME possesses electronic devices to broadcast mind-altering signals. Those affected believe it divine until it leaves the machine.

entry: POKENAME拥有发达的过目不忘能力与出色方向感，记得去过的每个地方。有时却爱故意把人引向错误地点，恶作剧。
author: milchik
source: POKENAME remembers every place it has ever visited thanks to its highly developed photographic memory and an exceptional sense of direction. It sometimes enjoys playing pranks on people by intentionally misleading them towards wrong locations.

entry: 这把等离子能量驱动的剑，能把受害者电得失去意识。它却只当在兴奋地“玩打架”，全然不知自己造成了多大伤害。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: A plasma-powered sword that is capable of zapping the lights out of its victims. It doesn't realize the harm it does by its excited "play fighting".

entry: 这把等离子能量驱动的剑，能把受害者电得失去意识。它却只当在兴奋地“玩打架”，全然不知自己造成了多大伤害。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: A plasma-powered sword that is capable of zapping the lights out of its victims. It doesn't realize the harm it does by its excited "play fighting".

entry: POKENAME是一把威力惊人的能量剑。人们相信，它来自一个遥远、遥远的地方……
author: rkmaster25367
source: As an energy sword of vast power, POKENAME is believed to hail from a land far, far away....

entry: POKENAME的等离子体塑成能量刀。能切穿钢铁，因此很受金属工匠欢迎。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME's plasma is shaped into an energy blade. It's a popular Pokémon for those who work with metal because it can be used to cut through steel.

entry: POKENAME电动马达带动锋利锯片，主要用于切树。训练家不给任务，就会夜间游荡，吵闹地伐倒仿佛随机选中的树。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's electric motor spins around a sharp sawblade. It mostly uses this to cut through trees, but if it is not given a task by a Trainer it will roam around at night, loudly felling  trees that are seemingly selected at random.

entry: POKENAME快速振翅，声音如响亮电视杂讯。飞行时，附近电视屏幕也会蒙上同样的雪花。
author: sk372
source: The rapid beat of POKENAME's wings sounds like loud TV static. Television devices in its vicinity while it is airborne have their screens grow hazy with the same kind of static.

entry: POKENAME转动齿轮发电，电弧从线圈跃向附近物品。若说服它按特定频率、时机释放，就能组成嗡鸣旋律。
author: lordjoostmeister
source: It spins its gears to generate electricity, which arcs from its coils to nearby objects. If POKENAME is convinced to use specific frequencies and timings, the arcs form a buzzing melody.

entry: 身体由强大带电等离子体组成，能与几乎任何机器、设备互动或干扰。它随时乐意阻止偷猎，因此是许多巡护员的盟友。
author: infinex21
source: Its body is made of a powerful electric plasma that allows it to interact or interfere with nearly any machine or device. It is an ally to many Rangers due to how ready and willing it is to thwart poachers' efforts.

entry: POKENAME用前所未有的电力破坏、重塑大地。闪电强得能劈裂地壳，或刺激地底深处岩浆，引发喷发。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses unprecedented levels of electricity to devastate and reshape the land. Its arcs of lightning are powerful enough to split the earth's crust, or stimulate magma deep underground to cause eruptions.

entry: 它通过强化装甲传导地震能量，将大地振动转成电力。受到撞击，系统释放电磁脉冲，能干扰电网、震裂坚岩。
author: jaminmcready
source: It channels seismic energy through its reinforced plating, converting Earth's vibrations into electrical power. Upon impact, its systems release an electromagnetic pulse that can disrupt electrical grids and fracture solid rock.

entry: POKENAME释放多余电力，常给人一种附近云层也在轰鸣放电的感觉。有些爱飞近飞机、喷气机，甚至帮助避免过坠机。
author: infinex21
source: When POKENAME release their excess electricity, it tends to appear like clouds nearby are crackling with thunder. Some of these Pokémon love to fly near airplanes and jets, and have even helped avert crashes.

entry: 这种宝可梦缠绕无线电塔筑巢，以周围电力为食，据说甚至直接吞食电磁波。似乎偏爱避免冲突，但别无选择，也不畏战斗。
author: infinex21
source: This Pokémon nests by wrapping around radio towers, feeding on ambient electricity and, supposedly, the very EM waves themselves. It seems to prefer to avoid conflict, but it will not shy away from a fight if it has no other choice.

entry: POKENAME的原子钟始终准确，至少从自身参照看来如此。如果看着变快、变慢，就是它正在加快或放慢周围时间。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's atomic clock always accurately displays the time, at least from its own point of reference. If it seems to be running faster or slower, that will be because POKENAME is speeding up or slowing down time around it.

entry: POKENAME的原子钟始终准确，至少从自身参照看来如此。如果看着变快、变慢，就是它正在加快或放慢周围时间。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's atomic clock always accurately displays the time, at least from its own point of reference. If it seems to be running faster or slower, that will be because POKENAME is speeding up or slowing down time around it.

entry: POKENAME表现得仿佛自己的外形毫不起眼，街上被注意时，总显得惊讶。人们认为，在过去某个时期，这种外形可能没那么突兀。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME behaves as if the form it has taken is completely inconspicuous, and seems to be surprised whenever people take notice of it in the street. It is believed that at some point in the past this form would have seemed less out-of-place.

entry: POKENAME充当全球定位设备，屏幕显示当前位置。按按钮查看另一区域，就会让使用者瞬间传送过去。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME acts as a global positioning device, showing its current location on its screen. Using the buttons to view another area will cause one to instantly teleport there.

entry: POKENAME为投掷充电，将巨大石标枪掷向远处。人们推测，排列成奇怪图案的石柱，就是同类竞赛留下的。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME charges its throws with electricity, then hurls enormous stone javelins over long distances. Stone columns arranged in strange patterns are theorized to be the results of competition between POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME一直爱捉弄人。传统说法是，遇上必须发笑，否则就会招雷劈家。如今则变成毁掉那个人所有电子产品。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME have always enjoyed pranking people. Tradition holds that one must always laugh at these pranks or else POKENAME will call down lightning on their home. This has modernized into POKENAME destroying all of a person's electronics.

entry: POKENAME常是恐怖网络传闻的主角。附身电脑系统、爬出电视的传言，启发了一些热门恐怖同人电影。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME are common subjects of scary online rumors. Rumors of POKENAME possessing computer systems and crawling out of televisions have inspired some popular horror fan films.

entry: POKENAME全身不断噼啪放电，干扰附近大多数电子设备。工程师通常建议，附近有群体居住的聚落，为电线增设绝缘。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME's body constantly crackles with electrical energy, disrupting most electronic devices that are used near them. Engineers typically advise using additional insulation on electrical wires in settlements near POKENAME populations.

entry: POKENAME住在节拍器里，随意改变节奏。满月之夜，会配合自己的节奏歌唱。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME inhabits a metronome, changing its rhythm at will. On nights of the full moon, it sings along to its own rhythm.

entry: POKENAME接上电源插头，吸能驱动电力本领。为了融入周围环境，演化出模仿联系绳的形态。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME attaches itself to electrical plugs, absorbing energy to fuel its electrical capabilities. It has adapted to mimic the shape of a Linking Cord in order to camouflage itself with its surroundings.

entry: POKENAME用花中藏的藤蔓作鞭子，包裹等离子体抽打，将电与毒致命地结合。
author: regicider.
source: POKENAME uses the vines concealed within its flowers as whips. They lash out with these whips, sheathed in plasma, to inflict a deadly combination of electricity and poison.

entry: POKENAME耳朵间，带电等离子体噼啪跳跃。粗鲁摸长耳兔耳朵、惹其生气的人，若也对它这样做，会迎来“触电”的后果。
author: hophoppip
source: Electrically charged plasma crackles from POKENAME's ears. Those who upset Lopunny by roughly petting its ears will face shocking consequences if they attempt the same with POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME在空中飞得快得惊人，爱戏弄捕虫训练家，有时把追逐者累得昏倒。
author: honestly_vitali
source: POKENAME zips through the air at insanely high speeds. It teases Bug Catchers, who sometimes pass out from exhaustion chasing them.

entry: 双臂本身很弱，却能直接接到小电器，自由控制，让自己更方便与世界互动。
author: varalon
source: While its arms are weak on their own, it is capable of connecting them directly to small electrical devices. It can then freely control these devices, which it uses to better interface with the world.

entry: POKENAME附身棉花糖机，就会呈现特殊形态，用棉花糖爆炸捉弄人类。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME takes a special form when it possesses a cotton candy machine. It pranks humans with explosions of cotton candy.

entry: 这些宝可梦吃布料里积累的静电。奇特饮食帮助防止住宅起火，因此许多住户欢迎野生POKENAME。
author: turron_turron
source: These Pokémon eat the static charge that builds up in fabric. Many homeowners welcome the presence of wild POKENAME, as their strange diet helps prevent house fires.

entry: 谁靠近POKENAME，它就会打印一张长串数字的纸。据说，正是那个人死亡的准确日期、时间。
author: bostroms
source: Anyone who approaches POKENAME will cause it to print out a paper with a long string of numbers. Supposedly, they represent the exact date and time the person will die.

entry: POKENAME的身体是一只有缺陷的电源分配器。据推测，若把所有插头都接上插座，就会引发惊人的大爆炸。
author: staghorn
source: POKENAME's body is made from a defective power hub. It is theorized that plugging all of its plugs into outlets would cause a tremendous explosion.

entry: 旋入普通灯座后，POKENAME便会吸走在它灯光下休息的人的生命能量。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: After screwing into ordinary sockets, POKENAME absorbs the life energy of those who rest in its light.

entry: POKENAME诡异的光芒，让人害怕会偷走灵魂。但如今已能完全靠电力运转，因此对想找阅读伙伴的人，是安全的替代选择。
author: inquis1
source: A POKENAME's eerie glow causes people to fear that it might steal their soul. However, it has developed to run fully on electricity, making it a safe alternative for those looking for a reading companion.

entry: 虽然POKENAME能悬浮，移动大多不受常规物理法则限制，却经常扭曲身体蹦跳。产生的光极强，但极少让其他生灵产生幻觉。
author: bobosmith01
source: Although POKENAME has the ability to levitate and move around uninhibited by most of normal laws of physics, it often moves around by contorting its body to hop around. It produces extreme amounts of light that rarely causes hallucinations in others.

entry: POKENAME挂在哪里，哪里就有不明来源的迪斯科音乐。几乎无法忍住不跳，许多人尽兴热舞数小时，最终倒在地上。
author: hophoppip
source: Wherever POKENAME hangs, disco music emanates from an unknown source. It's nearly impossible to resist dancing to the music, with many people found collapsed on the floor after hours of spirited grooving.

entry: POKENAME大步踏过破碎城市与战火摧残的原野，脚步响亮，气势冷峻。扫描每片废墟的模样，常被比作老练上校巡视被遗忘的战场。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME stomps loudly through crumbled cities and war-torn fields, its presence commanding and cold. The way it scans each ruin is often compared to a seasoned colonel inspecting a forgotten battlefield.

entry: POKENAME不爱收普通金属钥匙，更喜欢把塑料电子门卡挂在等离子体环上。但外观太像，有时会误偷信用卡。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME have no interest in collecting typical metal keys. Instead, they prefer taking plastic electronic access keycards to carry on their plasma rings. However, they sometimes steal credit cards by mistake due to their close similarities.

entry: POKENAME振翅，羽毛便洒出电火花。它借此烧林，捕捉逃出来的猎物。
author: bandedbodypress
source: When POKENAME flaps its wings, a shower of electrical sparks emerge from its feathers. It uses this skill to burn forests, and catch any prey that runs out.

entry: POKENAME全身笼罩涌动、明亮的等离子体。它的存在会强烈干扰、损坏电子设备。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME cloaks its body in a layer of surging, radiant plasma. Its presence is known to violently disrupt and damage electronic devices.

entry: POKENAME很容易被误认为喷气飞机，飞得也一样快。高空移动时，似乎结合雷达与自身精神感知导航。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME is easily mistaken for a jetplane, and it can fly just as fast as one. When moving high above the ground it seems to navigate using a combination of radar and its own psychic senses.

entry: POKENAME通过电磁波与同类交流。电力放大的信号能传出数英里，即使混在人类设备的电噪声中，也不丢失任何信息。
author: _pixelar_
source: POKENAME communicate with others of their species through electromagnetic waves. The signal, amplified by the Pokémon's electric powers, can travel for miles without losing any information in the ambient electrical noise of human devices.

entry: POKENAME身体大多由等离子体组成，能极速穿梭。细臂先勒住猎物，再施以致命电击。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME bodies are mostly made of plasma, which allows them to dart around at extreme speeds. They can use their slender arms to constrict prey before delivering a killer electric shock.

entry: 嘉年华入夜后，POKENAME有时会藏在摊位间的暗隙。有人靠近，就吐出一张写着模糊运势的纸。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: When night falls on carnivals, there is a chance that POKENAME can appear, hidden in the dark gaps between stalls. When approached, POKENAME spits out a sheet of paper containing a vague fortune.

entry: POKENAME看似有两具身体，却共用一个心智。它整日盯着自己，一动不动，除非有什么挡在头与所看屏幕的杂讯之间。
author: .jerden
source: While it seems to have two bodies, they share one mind.  POKENAME spends all of its time staring at itself, never moving a muscle unless something gets between its head and the static on the screen it watches.

entry: POKENAME吞食收发内容的电缆、设备，例如电视零件、无线电天线、网线。有人推测，它其实是以食物中流过的传输内容为食。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME devours cables and devices that broadcast or receive content, such as television parts, radio antennas, and ethernet cables. It has been speculated that POKENAME somehow feasts on the transmitted content that was coursing through its meal.

entry: POKENAME的等离子体壳摸着无害，孩子爱与它玩。但壳一碎，就会向四面八方射出等离子体。
author: mistymagius
source: Children love to play with POKENAME since its plasma shell is harmless to the touch. However, if the shell is broken, it will send bolts of plasma in all directions.

entry: POKENAME能投射出无害宝可梦的影像，吸引目光，再把猎物引进带电的陷阱，牢牢捕住。
author: mistershaokahn
source: To lure and capture its prey via its electrified traps, POKENAME is able to project images of harmless Pokémon that catch anyone's eye.

entry: 尾尖电涌的大小、快慢随情绪变化。电荷充足得只要爪子一碰，就能让毛发瞬间竖起。
author: infinex21
source: Their electrical surges at the tips of their tails change in volume and speed depending on their emotions. They are so electrically charged that a single touch from one claw can make one's hair instantly stand on-end.

entry: POKENAME的等离子体身体控制扬声器。歌声能轻松催人入睡，即使音量几乎震耳欲聋也一样。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's plasmic body controls a speaker. Its songs can put people to sleep with ease, even when played at a near-earsplitting volume.

entry: POKENAME从两朵等离子体玫瑰散出合成香气。人类或宝可梦想凑近闻花，都会受到厉害的静电电击。
author: honestly_vitali
source: POKENAME releases a synthetic fragrance from its two plasma roses. Both humans and Pokémon who try to sniff the flowers receive a nasty static shock.

entry: POKENAME出没街机厅与热闹商店，发出好玩的信号，引好奇孩子进来。它给访客零食，吸收自己帮助营造的欢乐气氛。
author: ilija09
source: Found near arcades and bustling shops, POKENAME emits playful signals that attract curious kids inside. It gifts treats to visitors, absorbing the cheerful atmosphere it helps create.

entry: POKENAME黏糊糊的身体也能充当导电电池，轻松存下大量电力。储能能驱动精神能力，也能捉弄毫无防备的受害者。
author: npshi
source: POKENAME have gooey bodies that can also act as a conductive battery, able to store large amounts of electricity without issue. POKENAME can use this stored energy to power their psychic abilities and also play pranks on unsuspecting victims.

entry: POKENAME偶尔劫持电台，让歌声传遍整个地区。为免所有人都睡着，电台专门开了独立频道，供它歌唱。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME occasionally hijack radio stations to broadcast their songs region-wide. To prevent potentially everyone from falling asleep, radio stations have created a separate channel for POKENAME to sing on.

entry: 它们外形似超音蝠，身体却由等离子体组成，靠无害的电脉冲引导方向。微光常帮助旅人看清黑暗洞穴。
author: infinex21
source: Although they appear physically reminiscent of Zubat, their bodies are composed of plasma and they guide themselves with harmless electrical jolts. They emit a faint glow that often helps travelers to see better within dark caves.

entry: 獠牙能轻易刺穿多数金属，吸取机器电力。吃得太多，翅膀会更亮，小电火花四散飞舞。
author: infinex21
source: Their fangs can easily puncture most metals, which allows them to easily drain electricity from machines. When they overeat, their wings glow brighter and small sparks of electricity fly freely.

entry: POKENAME伏平在地，用身体两处扁平发光区，引诱毫无防备的虫属性宝可梦。猎物踩上下半部，它一感到触碰，便猛然合上，困住对方。
author: _pixelar_
source: To hunt, POKENAME will lie flat on the ground, luring unsuspecting Bug-Type Pokémon with the glow of the two flat bioluminescent areas on its body. When its prey steps on the bottom section, POKENAME feels the touch and snaps closed, trapping them.

entry: POKENAME轮内部分不断运转，为其余身体供能。被打扰、需要搬走时，能倾斜框架，高速滚动，后面拖着悬浮电池。
author: .jerden
source: The constant running of the part of POKENAME inside its wheel powers the rest of it. If POKENAME is disturbed and needs to relocate, it can tip its frame over to roll around at high speed, trailing a levitating battery behind it.

entry: POKENAME常住街机柜，敌人靠太近就会出来。不要直接碰野生个体，因为体节间跳着电弧，倒刺上也有毒。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME often inhabit arcade cabinets, emerging whenever an opponent comes too close. It is advised not to make direct contact with wild POKENAME as they have electricity arcing through their segments and poison on their barbs.

entry: POKENAME个头虽小，却带着不寻常的骄傲。包着噼啪等离子体奔跑时，粗鲁举止和沉重身体，常造成意外破坏。
author: fertve
source: POKENAME carries itself with unusual pride for such a small Pokémon. When it sprints while wrapped in crackling plasma, its poor manners and heavy body often lead to unintended destruction.

entry: POKENAME并非单一电器，而是许多不同设备的集合，靠带电等离子体相连。在所居办公室环境中，是顶级捕食者。
author: .jerden
source: Rather than a single electronic device, POKENAME's body consists of an amalgamation of many different ones, held together by electrically-charged plasma. It is the apex predator within the office environments it inhabits.

entry: POKENAME附身屏幕，伸出看似怪颚龙的3维影像。全息巨颚的力量几乎不逊真身，还噼啪跳着静电。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME possesses screens, and can extend out what appears to be a 3D image of a Tyrantrum. The jaws of this hologram strike with almost as much force as the real thing, and crackle with static electricity.

entry: POKENAME叶片由纯等离子体组成，能随意再生。再生现象与极高温度，使工程师常将它用作喷灯。
author: theaceofhearts0306
source: POKENAME leaves are composed of pure plasma, which it can regenerate at will. Due to both this regenerative phenomenon and its extreme temperatures, POKENAME is often used as a blowtorch by engineers.

entry: POKENAME进电视或收音机前，会缓慢、有节奏地跳舞。虽然造成杂讯，有人却说，亲爱之人会短暂出现在屏幕上。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME performs a slow, rhythmic dance before entering TVs or radios. Though it causes static, some say loved ones briefly appear on screen.

entry: POKENAME由带电等离子体与恶臭液体组成，住在曾装能量饮料的弃瓶中。它不阻止别人拔塞，但里面的臭味极其可怕。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME consists of electrically charged plasma and foul smelling liquid, inhabiting a discarded bottle that once contained energy drink. It won't stop people from uncorking it, but the stench that comes from within is horrendous.

entry: POKENAME不断收集废电视，统统融进身体。许多已坏得不能用，能用的也只播广告与普遍被称为垃圾节目的真人秀。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME constantly collects discarded television sets, incorporating them all into its body. While many are too broken to function, those that do work only display advertisements and reality shows that are generally regarded as trash TV.

entry: POKENAME的电动马达能磨碎放入的一切。虽能供家庭处理垃圾，却又乱又臭，也很难清理。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's electrical motors enable it to grind up anything placed inside it. Although it can be used for garbage disposal in homes, POKENAME is messy, smelly and difficult to clean.

entry: POKENAME吸收电磁波，干扰周围无线电频率。这时会释放自身超声波，被电子设备接收到。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME disrupts radio frequencies around it by absorbing electromagnetic waves. When this occurs, it emits its own ultrasonic waves that are picked up by electronic devices.

entry: POKENAME以自己的波取代电磁波，让区域内所有设备播放想要的旋律。奇异能力使科学家必须用特殊绝缘来研究。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME replaces electromagnetic waves with its own, which causes all devices in an area to play whatever melody it wants. Scientists require special insulation to study this Pokémon because of its strange ability.

entry: 农民常用POKENAME的毒花粉驱赶虫宝可梦。储电越多，花粉效力越强。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is commonly used by farmers, its poisonous pollen being a great deterrent for Bug Pokémon. The more electricity it has stored, the more potent its pollen is.

entry: POKENAME靠屏幕上的游戏得分发电。单次行动或连招的分值越高，战斗中的能量威力就越大。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME produces power through gaining points with the game playing out on its screen. The greater the value of a single move or combo, the more devastating the energy output in battle will be.

entry: POKENAME常出现在赌场、游戏城，有时被误认为普通游戏机。虽然爱像机器般亮灯，但谁用力过头扯拉杆，就会迎来强烈电击。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME can often be found at casinos and Game Corners, where they are sometimes mistaken for ordinary games. While they enjoy lighting up like games, those who yank too hard on their lever are in for a harsh shock.

entry: 多数人会在棚屋里放一只POKENAME，养护草坪。但得时不时喂食，饿得太厉害，连棚屋都能啃穿。
author: inquis1
source: Most people have a POKENAME lying around their shed somewhere for lawn maintenance. However, it must be fed every once in a while, as POKENAME can chew through the shed if it gets sufficiently hungry.

entry: POKENAME常附身阿罗拉孩子喜爱的岩狗狗机器人玩具。项圈原本设计得无害，受它影响，却变成恶作剧用的电击危险物。
author: xyloldi
source: POKENAME frequently possesses a popular Rockruff robot toy beloved by children in Alola. Though the collar around its neck was designed to be harmless, its influence turns it into a shocking hazard for pranks.

entry: POKENAME凭强劲的车轮飞速疾驰，沿途不断从鬃毛中射出岩石。它虽对训练家极其忠诚，却也爱淘气，常拿最信任的人开玩笑。
author: xyloldi
source: POKENAME races at incredible speeds using its powerful wheels, while launching rocks from its mane as it moves. Though fiercely loyal to its Trainer, it has a mischievous streak and often pulls pranks on those it trusts most.

entry: POKENAME头上的寄生蘑菇会将阳光转化为电力。偏偏宿主本身就靠阳光获取能量，因此深受其害。
author: Trainerrobo
source: The parasitic mushroom atop POKENAME's head converts sunlight into electricity. This is unfortunate for the host, as it relies on sunlight for its energy.

entry: POKENAME附身物品后，物品会逐渐退化成纯能量。凝望时，发出的光变得刺眼，最终不得不转移到新物件。
author: .izik
source: Whenever POKENAME possesses an object, it steadily degrades into pure energy. The light it emits becomes blinding if watched, and it must eventually move on to a new object.

entry: POKENAME整天晒太阳，给内置电池充电。夜里用绿光引来虫属性宝可梦，再电击。有时人们用它，免受夜间虫扰。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME bathes in sunlight all day to charge an internal battery. At night, it uses its green glow to draw in Bug-type Pokémon, then zaps them with electricity. People sometimes use POKENAME to keep these bugs from bothering them at night.

entry: POKENAME把设备聚进身体，每多一台就更强。新科技一开发，就得采取防范，确保它不接触。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME can be found amassing devices into its body, powering up with each one. Whenever new technology is developed, precautions must be taken to ensure POKENAME does not come into contact with it.

entry: POKENAME把设备聚进身体，每多一台就更强。新科技一开发，就得采取防范，确保它不接触。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME can be found amassing devices into its body, powering up with each one. Whenever new technology is developed, precautions must be taken to ensure POKENAME does not come into contact with it.

entry: POKENAME附身棉花糖机，用糖丝制造身体。虽然微蓝、形似宝可梦，却能吃，吃掉的部分也很快补回。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME possesses a cotton candy machine, which it uses to make a body out of sugar strands. Although it has a blueish color and is shaped like a Pokémon, this cotton candy is edible and will quickly be replaced if eaten.

entry: POKENAME痴迷调配甜食，分给朋友与队友。遇上新配方，甚至不肯休息。常与加热洛托姆搭档，借烘焙改善作品。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME obsessively mixes sugary concoctions to share with its friends and team, even forgoing rest if it encounters a new recipe. It often chooses to partner with a Heat Rotom to enhance its creations through baking.

entry: 东西放上POKENAME头顶叶片，嘴部就显示重量，精确到毫克。原因不明，但测试显示，一千克以内都能准确测量。
author: _pixelar_
source: When something is placed on the leaf on POKENAME's head, the mouth will display the object's weight down to the milligram. It is unknown why the Pokémon does that, but tests have shown that the leaf can accurately measure weights up to one kilogram.

entry: POKENAME鲜艳身体的核心，融合等离子体与宇宙粒子，形成极强、近乎无穷的能量。但经常把电器充到过载、炸毁，是有风险的能源。
author: beatdoof
source: The inner core of its brightly-colored body contains both plasma and cosmic particles, fused into an incredibly potent, near-infinite energy. However, POKENAME will often overcharge electric devices and blow them up, making it a risky energy source.

entry: 许多孩子试图在限时内敲中POKENAME所有头，却没成功。三颗全中，奖品通常是闪亮石头，但孩子更爱手忙脚乱的游戏本身。
author: quackquackattack
source: Many children have tried and failed to hit all of POKENAME's heads within the time limit. The prize for hitting all three heads is usually a shiny rock, but children enjoy the frantic game more than the prize.

entry: POKENAME常游荡赌场，假扮老虎机，诱惑毫无防备的赌客。使用越多，聚宝功威力越强。
author: equation8573
source: POKENAME often roams casinos, disguising itself as a slot machine to lure in unsuspecting gamblers. The more it is used, the stronger its Pay Day attack becomes.

entry: POKENAME许诺，愿在机器上试运气，就有财富等着，却从不让人赢。它专挑特别好骗的对象，诱其投入越来越多硬币。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: Although POKENAME promises riches to those who take a chance with its machine, it never lets anyone win. It targets the especially gullible to get them to insert an increasing number of coins.

entry: POKENAME住在游戏城，怂恿训练家试老虎机运气。谁赢得太频繁，就会使出聚宝功，朝对方吐硬币。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME resides in Game Corners, goading Trainers to test their luck at the slots. If someone wins too often, POKENAME uses Pay Day to spit coins at them.

entry: POKENAME只能通过电视般“脸上”的杂讯图案交流。信息难解，这道障碍往往让这种常见宝可梦难与其他生灵建立联系。
author: mar989
source: POKENAME's only way to communicate is through the static patterns on its television-like "face". These messages are difficult to decipher, and this hurdle often prevents the common POKENAME from being able to connect with other creatures.

entry: POKENAME靠众多胡须，对数据、网络中任何变化都极敏感。许多计算机科学家既把它当有用工具，也当好伙伴。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: With its numerous whiskers, POKENAME is hypersensitive to any changes within data or networks. Many computer scientists find it both a useful tool and a good companion.

entry: 虽然POKENAME脸像等离子屏，视力似乎毫无问题。因为没有嘴，靠两条线缆尾巴，从大气吸取静电供能。
author: mar989
source: Whilst its face may resemble a plasma screen display, POKENAME appears to have no difficulty in seeing. Since it lacks a mouth, it draws static electricity out of the atmosphere with its twin cable tails in order to power itself.

entry: POKENAME像儿童游泳用的浮具。转动侧边旋钮，身下藏着的鳍肢就会启动，在水中划行。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME resembles a flotation device that children swim with. When the knob at its side is twisted, it activates hidden flippers tucked below its body to paddle through the water.

entry: POKENAME不断与其他生灵比力气，拳头足以碎岩。身体极耐打，还能算出每次挨打的准确力道。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME will constantly test their strength against others, their punches able to shatter rock. Their bodies are extremely durable, and they are able to calculate the exact amount of force behind each hit they take.

entry: POKENAME能穿进、穿出电器，常让经过的系统短路。训练家把它带在队伍中，要保护好电子产品。
author: frokachu
source: Capable of phasing in and out of electronic devices, POKENAME often short-circuits whatever systems it passes through. Trainers are advised to protect their electronics when keeping one in their party.

entry: 身体由高温等离子体组成，能如闪电般飞过空中。
author: .jerden
source: Its body is made of high-temperature plasma. It can move through the air as fast as a lightning bolt.

entry: 电力涌动太快，热得轻易就能生火。它十分调皮，常无意引起争斗，再逃跑。
author: infinex21
source: Its electricity is surging and flowing so quick that it runs hot enough to easily create flames. It is a rather mischievous Pokémon that will often start fights without intending to and then flee.

entry: 普通蚊香蝌蚪无法生活的城市里，POKENAME却很自在。它聚在洗衣店后的污巷，围住垃圾箱，寻找残留的哪怕一丁点洗涤剂来喝。
author: inquis1
source: In cities where regular Poliwag cannot live, POKENAME excel. They gather in the filthy back alleys behind laundromats where they swarm trash bins, looking for the smallest scraps of detergent to drink.

entry: 与野生近亲不同，POKENAME适应城市。聚在洗衣店后静候，一旦没电，就闯入店内，想吸够下一周所需。
author: inquis1
source: Unlike their wild cousins, POKENAME excel in urban environments. They gather behind laundromats where they lie in wait. When the time comes that they run out of power, they raid the building in hopes of siphoning enough electricity for the next week.

entry: POKENAME像一台装着摔角游戏的街机。游戏很难，却会丰厚奖励获胜者。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: POKENAME resembles an arcade machine with a wrestling game on it. Its game is very difficult, but it greatly rewards those who win.

entry: POKENAME许诺，掰手腕赢过自己就有奖励。真有人成功，会佩服得五体投地，洒下许多硬币。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: POKENAME promises rewards for anyone who can beat it in arm wrestling. When someone does succeed in doing so, it becomes very impressed, showering them with many coins.

entry: POKENAME是进化谱系的初始阶段，力量不强。身体弱小，最适合帮训练家洗精细衣物。
author: inquis1
source: As the first Pokémon of its evolutionary line POKENAME is not very powerful. Because of its weak stature POKENAME is best suited to handling its Trainers delicates in the wash.

entry: 由于体内等离子体密度高，POKENAME眼睛是深海少有的明亮光源。若被看见，就以灼光对视，直到对方移开目光。
author: beatdoof
source: POKENAME's eyes are one of the few things that shine brightly deep under the sea, due to the density of plasma within its body. If seen, it will stare into your eyes with its burning light until you look away.

entry: POKENAME狂乱、不稳定的性情，源于体内等离子体湍流，其中一半正发出强烈紫外光。回望任何生灵时，刺眼双目会快速变色。
author: beatdoof
source: The erratic, wild nature of POKENAME is caused by the turbulence within its body's plasma, half of it now harshly luminescent in UV. Its blinding eyes rapidly change colors when gazing back at any creature.

entry: 它能漂浮，却似乎更喜欢在地上滚。原地高速旋转，就能产生足够电力，释放局部电磁脉冲。
author: infinex21
source: It can float, but seems to instead love rolling around along the ground. If it spins quickly in place, it can generate enough electricity to release a localized EMP.

entry: POKENAME能为主人一周的衣物蒸汽清洁、洗涤、烘干、滚动处理，深受训练家喜爱。但袜子不见，八成就是被它吃了。
author: inquis1
source: POKENAME is beloved by Trainers for its ability to steam clean, wash, dry, and tumble all their owner's clothes for the week. However, if their socks go missing, just know this Pokémon has probably eaten them.

entry: POKENAME看似无所事事，其实忙得很。空洞目光背后，正计算世上最困难的问题。
author: inquis1
source: Despite their idle pose, POKENAME are hard at work. Behind their vacant stare, they are calculating the most difficult problems in the world.

entry: 洛托姆似乎把小磁怪也当成可附身的电器，因此野生POKENAME比多数融合体更常形成。它常潜入实验室、工厂，用磁铁干扰精密电子设备。
author: .jerden
source: Wild POKENAME form more often than most fusions, as Rotom seem to regard Magnemite as just another electrical device they can possess. POKENAME frequently sneak into laboratories and factories to disrupt sensitive electronics with their magnets.

entry: POKENAME三具身体，各自能独立操纵一对悬浮磁铁。若面前放多个磁性物品，每部分就会抓最爱的一个，再飞去藏好。
author: .jerden
source: Each of POKENAME's three bodies can move its own pair of floating magnets independently. If multiple magnetic objects are placed in front of it, each section will grab onto its favorite, then POKENAME will fly off to hide them somewhere.

entry: POKENAME吞食一桶桶放射性废料，能量充沛得发蓝光。黏液吸收大多有害辐射，但靠近张开的嘴仍很危险。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME eats barrels of radioactive waste, energizing its body so much that it glows blue. Its slime absorbs most of the harmful radiation, although it is still dangerous to approach its open mouth.

entry: POKENAME吞食一桶桶放射性废料，能量充沛得发绿光。黏液吸收大多有害辐射，但靠近张开的嘴仍很危险。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME eats barrels of radioactive waste, energizing its  body so much that it glows green. Its slime absorbs most of the harmful radiation, although it is still dangerous to approach its open mouth.

entry: POKENAME潜伏实验室、核电站附近觅食，偏爱有毒废料。因此科学家会喂核材料，而非封存地底深处。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME lurk near laboratories and nuclear power plants, seeking sustenance. They have a penchant for consuming toxic waste, leading to scientists feeding them nuclear material instead of sealing it deep underground.

entry: POKENAME桶里不断漏出放射性黏液，连靠近都极其有毒。但同位素半衰期短，离体碎块几周内就能安全触碰。
author: .jerden
source: Radioactive slime constantly leaks out of POKENAME's barrel, making it incredibly toxic to even be near. However, its isotopes have a short half-life, and separated pieces of its body will become safe to touch within weeks.

entry: 虽然看似顺理成章，三个地区已禁止将POKENAME当家电。不过，战斗中仍十分出色。
author: inquis1
source: Though it may seem intuitive, using POKENAME as a home appliance has been outlawed in three regions. Despite this, it is still excellent in battle.

entry: 训练家学校成绩不好，有时会怪到POKENAME头上。它既调皮，又是游戏机，常骗学生把时间浪费在游戏上。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are sometimes blamed for poor grades in Trainer Schools. Being both mischievous and a gaming device, they often trick students into wasting their time gaming.

entry: POKENAME壳上有两根无线电天线，水下也能收发信号。因此常用于海洋探险、水下救援。
author: equation8573
source: POKENAME has two radio antennas on its shell that receive and transmit signals even while underwater. This leads to its common use in ocean expeditions and underwater rescues.

entry: POKENAME配合活力音乐，射出集中的等离子体弹攻击。发射数量之多，常让敌人难以招架。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME attacks by shooting concentrated bolts of plasma to the tune of energetic music. The sheet number of bolts that POKENAME can fire often overwhelms its foes.

entry: POKENAME小小身体如闪电掠空，干扰沿途设备。始终伴着刺鼻臭氧味，这是它从空气中氧气制造的有毒气体。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's small body zips through the air like a lightning bolt, causing electrical disruptions in any device it passes. It is constantly accompanied by the harsh smell of ozone, a toxic gas it produces from oxygen in the air.

entry: POKENAME能进入电路，像电流穿行。通常在里面等人拨开关，再电击，或用发光身体跳出来吓一跳。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME can enter electrical circuits, moving through them like electricity. POKENAME usually waits inside until someone tries to flip a switch, then either zaps them with an electrical shock or leaps out to surprise them with its glowing body.

entry: POKENAME能自由穿过供电系统。夜里在路灯间移动，尾随人们，经过每盏都充入过量电力，使灯泡爆裂。
author: .jerden
