source: POKENAME has the ability to freely move its body through electrical power supplies. At night, POKENAME follows people around by moving between streetlights, charging every one it passes through with so much electricity that bulbs burst.

entry: POKENAME爱附身有人正在看的电视，让屏幕闪过杂讯与怪图。谁靠近调天线，就从屏中伸出黏舌触碰。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME enjoys possessing television sets that people are watching, causing static and strange images to flash across the screen. When someone approaches to adjust the antenna, POKENAME extends its slimy tongue out from the screen to touch them.

entry: POKENAME常导致睡过头，附身闹钟，不让响起。它想让目标睡得更久，好享用梦境。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are a common cause of oversleeping, inhabiting alarm clocks to prevent them from going off. They do this to keep their targets asleep for longer, feeding on their dreams.

entry: POKENAME住在电器，常试图催眠住户，让人更能容忍宝可梦偷偷住家中。许多电视台因此收到愤怒电话，一头雾水。
author: inquis1
source: Inhabiting electronic devices, POKENAME often attempts to hypnotize homeowners to be more tolerant of Pokémon secretly living in their homes. Many confused TV stations have received angry calls due to this.

entry: POKENAME缺乏精细精神控制，无法把凝胶塑成肢体，只能在树梢间笨拙扭动前进。若滑落，就用念力撑住自己。
author: lordjoostmeister
source: POKENAME lacks the fine mental control required to form its gel into limbs. Instead, it clumsily wiggles through the treetops, telekinetically supporting itself if it slips.

entry: POKENAME外表让许多人害怕，误以为内部骨头是吞食受害者留下的。其实只是天生身体结构，它相当温柔，对其他生灵无害。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's appearance causes many to be afraid of it, thinking the bones within are of a victim it has consumed. It's merely a natural part of its physiology, and it is actually quite gentle and harmless to others.

entry: POKENAME很合群，常与同类玩耍。精神力量强化物理攻击，让打击更重。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME are highly social, often found playing with other members of their species. They enhance their physical attacks with a psychic force, allowing them to hit harder.

entry: 它不断再生细胞，分离出胶状的身体组织。这些组织都带着病原体，千万不要触碰。
author: chorb33
source: It constantly regenerates its cells and splits off its jelly-like body parts. They are infected with pathogens, which is why contact must be avoided.

entry: POKENAME在胶状身体周围造精神护盾，保护柔软内部。平时不爱往来，但附近铁甲蛹受伤害，就会出手干预。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME creates a psychic shield around its gelatinous body to protect its soft innards. While it usually keeps to itself, it will intervene when nearby Metapod are harmed.

entry: POKENAME用念力加快游泳，在外海几秒便能达到超过50节。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses telekinesis to increase its swimming speed. This allows it to reach over 50 knots in the open sea within seconds.

entry: POKENAME为进化作准备，每天最多睡20小时。有人靠近，会无意识使出变硬，在柔软凝胶茧外形成精神护盾。
author: lordjoostmeister
source: POKENAME sleeps for up to 20 hours a day, preparing for evolution. If approached, it unconsciously uses Harden to form a protective psychic shield around its soft gel cocoon.

entry: POKENAME的翅膀由凝胶状物质构成，战斗时不容易受损。但这样一来，脆弱的身体也就失去了遮护。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's wings are made of a gel-like substance that makes them less likely to be damaged in combat. However, this leaves its fragile body wide open for attacks.

entry: POKENAME在海中连成大片漂浮，群落如同一个巨型生物。每个个体为专门分工，舍弃某些身体功能，确保群体生存。
author: turron_turron
source: Groups of POKENAME float through the ocean in vast, interconnected sheets. These colonies behave like one large organism, as each individual POKENAME loses bodily functions to specialize and ensure the survival of the colony.

entry: POKENAME胶状前臂镰刀，本身什么都切不开。但能沿刃缘竖起念力墙，让它轻易切过多数材料。
author: lordjoostmeister
source: POKENAME's gelatinous forearm scythes are incapable of cutting anything on their own. However, POKENAME erects walls of telekinetic force around their edges, letting them shear through most materials unhindered.

entry: POKENAME看不清正前方，容易盲目撞上石头、树木。撞后常散成一滩黏糊物，花一阵时间才重组身体。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Unable to see properly in front of them, POKENAME are prone to blindly charging into rocks and trees. On impact POKENAME tend to collapse into a pile of goop, requiring some time to re-form their bodies.

entry: 它极其聪明，却很容易生气。肆虐时，强大念力会造成大规模财产损失。
author: calelian
source: Its extremely intelligent, but very easily angered. When it rampages, it causes mass property damage with its strong telekinesis.

entry: POKENAME聪明、独立、本领高，也乐于做独立志愿者，帮助其他生灵。农事、情感支持、救溺水者，都只是一小部分。
author: bobosmith01
source: Intelligent, independent and skilled, POKENAME nonetheless takes on the role of a freelance volunteer for others' betterment. Helping with farming, giving emotional support, and rescuing those drowning are merely a fraction of what POKENAME can do.

entry: POKENAME住洞窟，沿洞壁爬行。胶状核心般的腹部是唯一弱点，因此常面壁遮住。
author: autismgaming89_51746
source: POKENAME live in caves, crawling along the cavern walls. The gelatinous, core-like abdomen of a POKENAME is its only weak spot, which it tends to cover by facing a wall.

entry: POKENAME住洞窟，沿洞壁爬行。胶状核心般的腹部是唯一弱点，因此常面壁遮住。
author: autismgaming89_51746
source: POKENAME live in caves, crawling along the cavern walls. The gelatinous, core-like abdomen of a POKENAME is its only weak spot, which it tends to cover by facing a wall.

entry: POKENAME住洞窟，沿洞壁爬行。胶状核心般的腹部是唯一弱点，因此常面壁遮住。
author: autismgaming89_51746
source: POKENAME live in caves, crawling along the cavern walls. The gelatinous, core-like abdomen of a POKENAME is its only weak spot, which it tends to cover by facing a wall.

entry: POKENAME住洞窟，沿洞壁爬行。胶状核心般的腹部是唯一弱点，因此常面壁遮住。
author: autismgaming89_51746
source: POKENAME live in caves, crawling along the cavern walls. The gelatinous, core-like abdomen of a POKENAME is its only weak spot, which it tends to cover by facing a wall.

entry: POKENAME身体大多由浓密等离子体组成，极易导电。精神力量既控制身体，也压制对手。
author: infinex21
source: A POKENAME's body is mostly made of a dense plasma that can easily conduct electrical currents. They use their psychic powers to control their own bodies and to subdue their opponents.

entry: POKENAME靠精神能量维持身体，即使睡着也一样。只要完全缠住，巨大的精神力量便能将目标汽化。
author: bee4082
source: POKENAME uses psychic energy to hold its body together, even when sleeping. It can vaporize anything it fully wraps around using its immense psychic power.

entry: 这种害羞、善良的宝可梦，从远处用精神力量警告水手危险将至。可惜，海员有时把不明声音误认为晕船引发的疯癫。
author: creaturecore
source: This shy, kindhearted Pokémon uses its psychic powers from afar to warn sailors of upcoming danger. Unfortunately, seafarers sometimes mistake the anonymous voice for seasickness-driven madness.

entry: POKENAME体表满是化学物质的液体慢慢滴落，落地后试图成形。但没有实体可依附，很快就会蒸发。
author: bigoljax
source: The chemical-filled liquid coating POKENAME's body slowly drips off them, trying to take shape once on the ground. Due to not having anything solid to form around, the liquid quickly evaporates.

entry: POKENAME周围的保护液富含化学物质。液体样本为生命从无生命物质中形成提供了支持。
author: bandedbodypress
source: The protective fluid surrounding POKENAME is filled with chemicals. Samples of this fluid have supported abiogenesis.

entry: POKENAME极聪明，用精神力量，将包裹身体的特殊液体塑成触须。神秘黏液能复活枯死植物、轻松劈开巨石，还散出舒缓香气，分散敌人注意。
author: jonclyd
source: POKENAME are highly intelligent, using psychic power to shape tendrils from a special liquid that envelops its body. This mystical slime can revive dead plants, split boulders with ease, and releases a calming fragrance to distract foes.

entry: POKENAME长长的身体由多个独立生物组成，精神相连，使身体控制极佳，是出色的体操选手。
author: dylonk25
source: POKENAME's long body is made up of several separate organisms. Their psychic connection leads to an incredibly high degree of body control, making POKENAME an excellent gymnast.

entry: 强大精神力量让POKENAME即使在最陌生的洞窟，也能迅速辨路。飞行时脱落旧的、多余黏液，探洞者常沿痕迹走，避开死路。
author: just_a_few_thousand_crows
source: Their immense psychic abilities allow POKENAME to navigate even the most unfamiliar of caverns with unmatched speed. They shed old and excess slime as they fly, so spelunkers often follow the trails they leave to avoid dead ends.

entry: POKENAME的身体近乎透明，呈凝胶状，会在深海发光，引诱宝可梦靠近。它视力不佳，靠强大的超能力感知猎物的接近。
author: katieplaysgames
source: With a nearly transparent and gelatinous body, POKENAME lures Pokémon toward itself using its light in the deep sea. Its eyesight is poor, so it relies on its immense Psychic powers to sense the approach of its prey.

entry: POKENAME的身体近乎透明，呈凝胶状，会在深海发光，引诱宝可梦靠近。它视力不佳，靠强大的超能力感知猎物的接近。
author: katieplaysgames
source: With a nearly transparent and gelatinous body, POKENAME lures Pokémon toward itself using its light in the deep sea. Its eyesight is poor, so it relies on its immense psychic powers to sense the approach of its prey.

entry: POKENAME偶尔利用胶状身体和精神能力，互相玩耍。它用精神强念将同类抛来抛去，弹跳后落地，开心咩叫。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME occasionally play games with each other, taking advantage of both their gelatinous form and psychic abilities. Using Psychic, POKENAME throw one another around, bouncing around before landing with a happy bleat.

entry: POKENAME能迅速膨大，恐吓敌人，主动挑衅比自己大得多的对手。若对方占上风，就渗出能操控的毒胶，喷满敌人，常能将其逼退。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME can rapidly expand in size to intimidate opponents and picks fights with foes much larger than itself. If its foe has the upper hand, it leaks a toxic gel that it can control and sprays it over its foe, often causing them to flee.

entry: POKENAME群居，彼此紧密相连。受威胁便围成圈，用尾巴互咬，连接心智，大幅增强精神攻击。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME live in close-knit herds. When threatened, they form a circle and bite one another with their tails, linking their minds and greatly amplifying the power of their psychic attacks.

entry: POKENAME鲁莽钻穿山体，体表液体因此滴落。科学家正尝试分析，研究它如何用心灵感应交流。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME are known to recklessly dig through mountains, causing some of the liquid coating their bodies to drip off. Scientists are attempting to analyze this liquid to find out how POKENAME telepathically communicate.

entry: POKENAME受惊会缩头、收脚，将细胞质铺成周身保护层。常一保持就是数小时，训练家必须学会别突然动作。
author: lordjoostmeister
source: If surprised, POKENAME tucks its head and feet in and spreads its cytoplasm into a protective layer around itself. Since it often remains in this state for hours, Trainers must learn to avoid sudden movements.

entry: 庞大的大脑让POKENAME对昆虫了如指掌。皮下金色的团块其实是储备的蜂蜜，供食物短缺时食用。
author: iaobug
source: POKENAME's impeccable knowledge of insects stems from its immense brain. The gold globs under its skin are honey reserves for when food is scarce.

entry: POKENAME细胞受不稳定辐射变异，发展出更多能力，却失去大部分实体结构。它睡在随身容器里，确保身体不散。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: The cells within POKENAME have been mutated by unstable radiation, developing a wider range of power, but losing a majority of their physical structure as a result. POKENAME sleep inside the containers they carry to make sure they stay together.

entry: POKENAME操纵细胞质，形成翼状结构，飞行觅食。厚胶耐受伤害，遇到威胁，也能迅速收回身体核心。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME manipulate their cytoplasm to form wing-like structures, enabling them to fly and search for food. The thick gel is resistant to harm and can be rapidly withdrawn into the core of the body if a threat is presented to them.

entry: POKENAME失去肢体，能从剩下的分出新肢。战斗中，双臂同时运用多种精神力量，压倒对手。
author: nyoomymph
source: If POKENAME loses a limb, it can split a new one off the ones remaining. In battle, its arms wield several psychic forces at once to overwhelm opponents.

entry: POKENAME操纵细胞质，形成翼状结构，飞行觅食。厚胶耐受伤害，遇到威胁，也能迅速收回身体核心。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME manipulate their cytoplasm to form wing-like structures, enabling them to fly and search for food. The thick gel is resistant to harm and can be rapidly withdrawn into the core of the body if a threat is presented to them.

entry: POKENAME将尾部手臂相连，就能互传所学的一切信息。人们相信，数百只连起来，便能模拟超级电脑网络。
author: soup1900
source: When POKENAME connect their tail arms together, they are able to transfer all information they learned between each other. It is believed that linking hundreds of these Pokémon together could simulate a supercomputer network.

entry: POKENAME将尾部手臂相连，就能互传所学的一切信息。人们相信，数百只连起来，便能模拟超级电脑网络。
author: soup1900
source: When POKENAME connect their tail arms together, they are able to transfer all information they learned between each other. It is believed that connecting hundreds of these Pokémon together could simulate a supercomputer network.

entry: POKENAME将缎带浸水，会把部分膜状凝胶稀释进水里。不仅净水，还增添特殊养分，刺激之后饮用者的大脑。
author: sk372
source: Whenever POKENAME dips its ribbon into a body of water, it dilutes some of its membrane gel into the water as well. This not only cleanses the water but also adds special nutrients that stimulate the brains of those who drink the water afterward.

entry: POKENAME用巨大精神力量，碾碎路上的障碍，连坚石也化成粉。看起来不是爬山，而是径直穿山而过。
author: oddwalls
source: POKENAME uses its tremendous psychic power to crush obstacles in its path, turning even hard stone into dust. Rather than climb mountains, POKENAME appears to walk straight through them.

entry: POKENAME凭出色智慧，指挥许多超能力宝可梦，形成统一力量。这些群体常保护弱小、脆弱的生态系统。
author: nyoomymph
source: Using its remarkable intellect, POKENAME directs many other psychic Pokémon as one force. These groups often protect weak and vulnerable ecosystems.

entry: “肩膀”其实是各有大脑的小头，进一步增强精神能力。包裹主体的液体，是特殊固态等离子体，始终带电。
author: infinex21
source: Its "shoulders" are lesser heads that have their own brains, further expanding its psychic powers. The liquid surrounding its main body is a special form of solid plasma that is always electrically charged.

entry: POKENAME味觉极敏感，操纵一条更大的胶状舌头，精细移动，将想吃的一切直接送进嘴里。
author: t3isukone
source: Since its sense of taste is extremely sensitive, POKENAME controls a larger gelatinous tongue for fine motor movement that can funnel anything it wants to eat directly to its mouth.

entry: POKENAME体表液体一碰便硬化，类似非牛顿流体，因此极难捕捉。闪电击中角时，能力会暂时增强，原因不明。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: The liquid coating this Pokémon's body hardens upon touch, similar to non-Newtonian fluids, making it incredibly hard to catch. When electricity strikes POKENAME's horn, its capabilities are temporarily enhanced. The reasoning for this is unknown.

entry: POKENAME用精神力量构成可触碰、软绵绵的形体，再以藤蔓覆盖，防止散架。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME use their psychic powers to make a tangible, squishy form. They cover themselves with vines to prevent their forms from falling apart.

entry: 有丝分裂时，POKENAME会产生大量电力。反过来，若吸收外界电力，细胞分裂也会随之加快。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME generates a lot of electricity during mitosis. If it consumes external electricity, this in turn accelerates its mitosis.

entry: 有丝分裂时，POKENAME会产生大量电力。反过来，若吸收外界电力，细胞分裂也会随之加快。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME generates a lot of electricity during mitosis. If it consumes external electricity, this in turn accelerates its mitosis.

entry: POKENAME每条悬浮肢体都能释放念力冲击。肢体独立于身体移动，包围敌人，连续轰击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME can channel telekinetic blasts from each of its floating limbs. These limbs move independently from its body to surround a foe and bombard them with blasts.

entry: POKENAME熟知周围世界，精神能量控制也极出色。它选择享受小小成功，以及身边生灵的陪伴。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME has great knowledge about the world around itself and excels at controlling its psychic energy. POKENAME chooses to enjoy the small victories and the company of those who surround it.

entry: POKENAME是最聪明的宝可梦之一，集合四颗大脑的思考力，内部身体由纯钢组成。
author: nyoomymph
source: POKENAME is one of the most intelligent Pokémon. It has the combined thought power of four brains. Its internal body is made of pure steel.

entry: POKENAME的楔石深埋胶状身体，用念力托起。维持悬浮很耗专注，因此只有危险时才移动。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME keystones are enveloped deep within their gelatinous body and lifted with telekinesis. It requires much focus to keep up this levitation, so POKENAME only move when there is danger.

entry: POKENAME敏锐察觉构成个体的生理、心理特征。数据表明，只看一眼，就能衡量自己与潜在训练家的相性。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are acutely aware of the unique traits that make an individual, both biologically and mentally. Data suggests they can measure the compatibility between themselves and a potential Trainer with a single glance.

entry: POKENAME精神力量极强。虽然黏臂能猛烈挥动，却更愿一动不动，将食物直接浮进张开的嘴。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME have incredibly psychic power. Although they can swing around their gooey arms with great force, they prefer to remain motionless and simply levitate food into their open mouth.

entry: POKENAME能与接触的任何宝可梦建立精神连接。野生个体若感知怀中宝可梦藏了食物，就走去吃光储粮，再放走对方。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME can form a psychic connection to any Pokémon they make contact with. If a wild POKENAME senses that a Pokémon it has seized in its arms has a hidden stash of food, it will walk over to that stockpile to devour it, then let the Pokémon go.

entry: POKENAME彼此握手，便能用精神交流。民间故事中，这能力对所有生灵有效，会在曾握过手的人类或宝可梦临终前，现身安慰。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: When POKENAME shake hands with one another, they gain the ability to psychically communicate. In folklore, this ability worked on all living creatures; POKENAME would appear to comfort people and Pokémon they shook hands with before their deaths.

entry: 它用惊人精神力量，操控包裹身体的特殊液体游泳。潜到超过10,000英尺深处，也会发出微光。
author: pizzarcato
source: Using its prodigious psychic powers, it controls the special liquid surrounding its body to swim. Even when diving to depths of over 10,000 feet, it emits a faint glow.

entry: POKENAME曾受奉为未来之神，赐给信徒虚假的预言幻景。深入冥想时，胶状身体颤抖，与附近信徒牵起手臂。
author: .izik
source: Once worshipped as a god of the future, POKENAME granted false prophetic visions to followers. Its gelatinous body trembles as it meditates deeply, linking arms with any worshippers nearby.

entry: POKENAME正式被记载为真实宝可梦前，几年前的卡通角色却已几乎完美呈现外形。虽然被说成巧合，有人却推测，是操控其他生灵心智的能力所致。
author: bobosmith01
source: Before being properly recorded as a real Pokémon, POKENAME's likeness was captured almost perfectly as a cartoon character some years ago. Although stated to be a coincidence, some theorize this Pokémon's power over others' minds was the cause.

entry: POKENAME能重塑身体，在细胞层面模仿其他生灵。它变化研究过的个别部位，更好理解其运作。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are capable of restructuring their bodies to imitate other creatures down to a cellular level. They morph individual parts they've studied to better understand how they function.

entry: POKENAME的触须与身体同为胶状膜，碰到什么都会留黏液。在人类和其他宝可梦身上，会吸收进皮肤，像软膏般舒缓肌肉。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's feelers are made of the same gelatinous membrane as its body, and leave a slimy residue on anything they touch. On humans and other Pokémon, this slime absorbs into the skin and soothes the muscles, akin to a salve.

entry: POKENAME鳞片坚如钢，又能碾碎山峰，被认为无可匹敌。但下侧身体呈胶状，容易遭正面攻击。传说曾用精神力量创造地区。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: With scales as durable as steel and the ability to crush mountains, it's believed POKENAME are unmatched. Despite this, their undersides are gelatinous, making them prone to frontal attacks. In legends, POKENAME used psychic powers to create regions.

entry: 虽然火力极大，POKENAME不爱用交错火焰。用得太久，胶状身体就会从尾部开始融化。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Despite wielding immense firepower, POKENAME does not enjoy using Fusion Flare. Prolonged usage of the move causes POKENAME's gel-like body to begin to melt at the tail.

entry: POKENAME爱假扮普通弃娃娃，引好奇者靠近，再拉开拉链，将胶状肢体伸向四周，以吓人为恶作剧。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME enjoys mimicking a simple discarded doll in order to lure curious onlookers closer. Once they near it, it opens up its zippers and extends its gelatinous limbs all about in order to frighten them as a malicious prank.

entry: POKENAME的治疗招式处于最先进水平，诊断能力没有宝可梦能超越。自从被发现，吉利蛋越发像宝可梦医疗的旧时代象征。每家宝可梦中心都想要它。
author: inquis1
source: POKENAME's healing moves are state-of-the-art; no Pokémon can surpass its diagnostic power. With its discovery, the Chansey has now increasingly come to represent the archaic past in Pokémon medicine. This Pokémon is the envy of every Pokémon Center.

entry: POKENAME住在沙漠，享用偷自旅人的糖果。因为很受欢迎，又有这样的习性，市面推出了多款仿照它的软糖。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME can be found in the desert, feasting upon candy they steal from travelers. The popularity of POKENAME and their nature has seen a selection of gummy candies produced, modeled after them.

entry: POKENAME看似由小人形与包裹它的棺材组成，棺材由能传导精神力量的黏液构成。人形究竟死着、活着，还是介于两者，仍不清楚。
author: dylonk25
source: POKENAME consists of what looks like a small humanoid encased in a coffin of psycho-conductive slime. It remains unknown whether said humanoid is dead, alive, or something in between.

entry: POKENAME体内漂浮的细胞器，专门用于发电。它先向猎物通入高压电，再以巨力碾碎。
author: vic1312
source: The organelles floating within the body of a POKENAME have been specialized to produce electricity. They will run large amounts of voltage through the body of their prey before crushing them with extreme force.

entry: POKENAME双肢内部，小胶团近乎催眠般起伏，在黑暗发出微光。移动顺着心情，烦躁时就更快。
author: sk372
source: Small globs undulate almost hypnotically around within POKENAME's twin limbs, casting a faint light in darkness. The substance moves in accordance to its mood, becoming more rapid in movement if POKENAME is agitated.

entry: POKENAME极好奇，收集不同化学物质，测试成分。被激怒就混合物质，引发燃烧，造成强力、缤纷的爆炸。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are highly curious, collecting different chemicals to try and test their compositions. If POKENAME are ever provoked, they will combine the chemicals to create combustion, igniting powerful and colorful blasts.

entry: 据说，胶状身体保护核心，承受多数攻击也几乎不改形状、体型。斧状獠牙由高度压缩的等离子体组成，散出微弱精神能量。
author: infinex21
source: Supposedly, the gelatinous body protects the core of this Pokémon. This gel can absorb most attacks with minimal impact to its shape or stature. Its axe-like tusks are are made of heavily compressed plasma and exude weak psychic energies.

entry: 人们相信，与这种宝可梦对视，会麻痹，甚至死去。尽管如此，POKENAME却会允许人触摸包裹面具的胶状膜。
author: loikthescreamo
source: It is believed that if you look at this Pokémon in the eyes, you will either be paralyzed, or worse, dead. That said though, POKENAME will let you feel the gelatinous membrane that encases the mask.

entry: POKENAME躯干内的本体用超能力操纵三个头。无论哪个头被斩断，都能在几秒内重新长出。
author: mistymagius
source: The main body in POKENAME's torso controls the three heads with its psychic powers. If any of its heads gets cut off, they will regrow in a matter of seconds.

entry: POKENAME无力地乱挥手臂，模仿受伤宝可梦，吸引注意。有什么靠近，就用力抓住，用黏胶层毒害目标，留待消化。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME limply flails its arm to imitate an injured Pokémon, attracting attention of other Pokémon. POKENAME forcefully grabs hold when something gets close, poisoning the target with its goo layer for later digestion.

entry: POKENAME总在奇怪装置中，莫名毫不费力地滑过地面。最初如何进入容器，里面液体有何用途，仍是谜。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are always found in odd devices that somehow effortlessly glide along the ground to move. How they first entered the tanks and what purpose the liquid inside serves are still mysteries.

entry: 古手稿记载，具有特定基因变异的POKENAME，原本还能再进化一次。可惜，化石复原把这段密码视为错误，阻断了进一步进化。
author: autismgaming89_51746
source: According to ancient manuscripts, POKENAME with certain genetic mutations could evolve yet another time. Unfortunately, fossil restoration deemed this certain code as a mistake, ceasing further evolution.

entry: POKENAME虽然没牙，咬力仍很强。借精神力量增强咬合，依然能打出猛烈一击。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: Despite their lack of teeth, POKENAME's bites are still quite strong. Using psychic power to increase their bite force, they can still deliver devastating blows.

entry: POKENAME主要吃肉，却因胶状身体难以撕开，张嘴很吃力。为弥补，就游向大海，吸收浮游动物。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Despite being primarily carnivorous, POKENAME struggle to open their mouths on account of their gelatinous bodies being hard to tear. To compensate, POKENAME swim out to sea to absorb zooplankton.

entry: POKENAME用精神力量固定猎物，再以獠牙撕咬。毒胶渗入伤口，即使暂时逃脱，也会虚弱得撑不过第二次攻击。
author: lordjoostmeister
source: Its psychic powers hold prey in place as it rips into them with its fangs. POKENAME's toxic gel seeps into the wounds it inflicts, ensuring that even if prey momentarily escape, they will be too weak to survive a second attack.

entry: 融合将植物般的DNA带进身体。它能随意长叶，每个器官还可种下，长出新肢体。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Fusion has incorporated plantlike DNA into its body. It can grow leaves from its body at will, and each of its organs can be planted to grow a new limb.

entry: POKENAME用精神能力操纵浓稠黏液身体，猛冲对手。但性情胆小，只有最后关头才如此。
author: karmaofevil
source: Using its psychic abilities, POKENAME controls its dense mucous body, launching itself at opponents. This is however a last resort, as POKENAME is quite timid.

entry: POKENAME厚厚的黏液能保护身体，强大的精神力量还能将其塑成牢不可破的超能力屏障。它虽强大，性情却温和，喜欢给人黏糊糊的大拥抱。
author: thepandasharky
source: POKENAME's thick, protective slime shields it from harm, and its powerful mind controls this ooze to form unbreakable psychic barriers. Despite its strength, it is gentle by nature and fond of giving big, slimy hugs.

entry: POKENAME靠巨大装甲状身体周围的许多大脑，控制身躯。看起来柔软，其实硬如岩石。
author: camtft
source: POKENAME control their body with a host of brains all around their giant armor-like body. Despite their soft appearance, their body is hard as a rock.

entry: POKENAME极危险，能轻松包住、消化任何猎物。但很少回应刺激，多半时间漫无目的游荡洞穴。
author: turron_turron
source: POKENAME are exceedingly dangerous Pokémon, known to envelop and digest any prey with ease. Despite this, POKENAME rarely react to stimuli and spend much of their time aimlessly wandering about caves.

entry: POKENAME身体的绿胶来自海藻，对沉船十分着迷，会扯下腐木块玩耍。
author: pizzarcato
source: The green gel composing POKENAME's body is derived from seaweed. It displays a strong fascination with shipwrecks, and will rip off chunks of rotten wood to play with.

entry: POKENAME灵巧操纵众多触手，防御、机动都很好。若被头刺扎中，精神能量灌入体内，会引发痛苦头疼。
author: sk372
source: It deftly wields its many tentacles, giving it ample defense and mobility. If pricked by the spine on POKENAME's head, the victim experiences painful headaches as a result of being infused with POKENAME's psychic energy.

entry: POKENAME伪装成装满水果的果冻，引诱猎物。宝可梦想吃水果而靠近，就抬起前腿，释放让其失去行动力的幻象光线。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME disguises itself as a fruit-filled gelatin in order to lure prey closer. When Pokémon approach to eat the fruit, POKENAME lifts its front legs to deliver a crippling Psybeam.

entry: POKENAME用精神力量，瞬间冻结周围空气里的水。平时小心不冻住自己，否则无法移动；但为免受伤害，最后关头也可能这样自保。
author: .jerden
source: Using its psychic power, POKENAME can instantly freeze water in the air around it. It is usually careful not to freeze its own body, as this prevents it from moving, but may do this as a last resort to protect itself from damage.

entry: 背上的特殊液体，控制着POKENAME的行动。它力气极大，单用一只手，就能捏碎树干。
author: pizzarcato
source: A special liquid on its back controls POKENAME. Just one of its powerful hands can crush a tree trunk.

entry: POKENAME互拍双臂恐吓敌人。但身体胶状，只会发出毫无威胁的噗叽声。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: To intimidate their opponents, POKENAME smack their arms together. However, due to their gelatinous form, POKENAME's arms just make non-threatening squishing sounds.

entry: POKENAME柔软身体极结实、有力，性情却温顺，通常独处。即使被逼入绝境，也更愿分散敌人注意，找机会溜走，而非持续交战。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's soft body is remarkably resilient and powerful, but it has a meek personality and generally keeps to itself. Even if cornered, it prefers to distract opponents and find a way to slip away from combat rather than fight continuously.

entry: POKENAME在洞穴家园弹跳，噗叽声让人找到踪迹。受惊时，从手指射出能量光束。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME can be located in their cave homes thanks to the squishing noise they make as they bounce around. If startled, they fire off beams of energy through their fingers.

entry: POKENAME能将头上的胶状角硬化，再摘下投掷。掷出的角很快融化，身体又长出新的。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can harden the gelatinous horns on its head before removing them to toss as projectiles. The thrown horns melt away shortly after, and new ones regrow on POKENAME's body.

entry: 厚厚半透明液层保护POKENAME大脑，连最猛烈撞击也不怕。精神力量操纵黏液，力道足以压碎坦克。
author: .jerden
source: A thick layer of translucent liquid protects POKENAME's brain from even the most forceful impact. Using its psychic power, it can move this goo with enough force to crush a tank.

entry: POKENAME擅长群体合作，以协调攻击、佯动迅速击败敌人。民间故事说，与训练家握手，就会精神相连，彼此完全默契。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME are known to work in groups, swiftly taking down foes through coordinated attacks and diversions. In folklore, POKENAME who shook hands with their trainers would form a psychic bond, being perfectly attuned to each other.

entry: POKENAME用精神力量喷出特殊液体，攻击上方飞行敌人。壳内液体越多越强，因此会吸取其他人造细胞卵的体液，增强自己。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME uses its psychic powers to spout its special liquid and attack enemies flying above. It grows stronger the more liquid is inside of its shell, so it siphons this fluid from other Reuniclus to increase its power.

entry: POKENAME定期闯入甜甜圈店，想吃调味奶油霜。一滴体液就能污染奶油，让烘焙师十分头疼。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME regularly break into donut shops to try and consume flavored buttercream. This poses a significant problem for the bakers, as a single drop of POKENAME's fluid can contaminate the creams.

entry: POKENAME三个部分似乎独自生长、成熟。一部分学会念力移物，其余常变懒，依赖它。
author: lordjoostmeister
source: POKENAME's three segments appear to grow and mature independently. Once one segment learns how to manipulate objects with telekinesis, the others often grow lazy and reliant on it.

entry: POKENAME的精神力量将身体塑成矮小、强壮的形态。胶状身体能调整双臂大小、长短，更好抓住、拳打对手。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's psychic power lets it manipulate its body into a short, yet powerful form. Its gelatinous form can reshape the size and length of its arms to better grab and punch opponents.

entry: POKENAME很虚荣，花许多时间把凝胶塑成肌肉模样。维持形状必须不断专注，因此尽量避开冲突。
author: lordjoostmeister
source: A vain Pokémon, POKENAME spends much of its time attempting to shape its gel to resemble muscles. It must constantly concentrate to maintain these shapes, so POKENAME avoids conflict whenever possible.

entry: POKENAME用强大精神力量造出四条超强手臂，能从胶状身体任何部位伸出，从各种出其不意的角度攻击、反击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses strong psychic powers to help it manifest four super-strong arms to battle with. It can manifest these arms from any part of its gelatinous form, allowing it to strike and counter from all manner of unorthodox angles.

entry: POKENAME酸性凝胶能迅速分解包住的任何有机物，高效吸收养分。但更喜欢用嘴吃，常把头探出凝胶，啃零食。
author: lordjoostmeister
source: POKENAME's acidic gel quickly breaks down any encapsulated organic material, efficiently absorbing nutrients. POKENAME prefers eating with its mouth, though, so it is often seen poking its head out of the gel to nibble snacks.

entry: POKENAME浮在空中，附着猎物，吸走生命力。据说不喜低温，因此冬季较不凶悍。
author: musicsheep.
source: POKENAME float through the air and attach themselves to their prey before draining their life force. It's said that POKENAME dislike cold temperatures, making them less aggressive during the winter.

entry: POKENAME在居住的山坡寻找下方猎物，再把凝胶收成完美球体，高速滚下。撞中后恢复原形，开始挥拳。
author: lordjoostmeister
source: POKENAME searches for prey below it on the mountain slopes where it lives, then retracts its gel into a perfect sphere and rolls downward at high speed. After slamming into its prey, POKENAME returns to its normal shape and begins throwing punches.

entry: 尽管身体没有固定形状，它仍能以超过每小时130英里的速度奔跑。据说，POKENAME全速奔跑时极少绊倒，但一旦摔倒翻滚，就会散成多只较小的POKENAME。
author: staghorn
source: Despite its amorphous body, it can run at speeds of over 130 miles per hour. It is said that in the rare event that a POKENAME trips and falls while at a full gallop, the resulting tumble will cause it to break apart into multiple smaller POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME单独时头脑迟钝，却能牵手，让大脑形成网络，提升智慧。
author: darkweavile428
source: While dim-witted on their own, POKENAME can link their hands together to form a network between their brains to increase their intelligence.

entry: 它能向对手喷射保护液，用念力引导液弹轨迹，准确命中最远10英里外的敌人。
author: bandedbodypress
source: It can shoot its protective fluid at opponents. It uses telekinesis to guide the path of its bullets. It can hit enemies as far as 10 miles away accurately.

entry: POKENAME收集早已死去的带壳宝可梦遗落的壳、尖刺，为胶状核心提供支架与保护。再用精神力量，把收集的刺当弹丸射出。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME gather up the discarded shells and spines of long dead shelled Pokémon, using them as structure and protection for their gelatinous core. Using their psychic powers, they propel the spines they gather up as projectile weapons.

entry: POKENAME将岩石、巨石融进身体，保护脆弱核心。也能分离岩石，用于精神攻击。
author: raydrago
source: POKENAME integrates rocks and boulders into its body to protect its weak core. It can detach these rocks from its body to use in psychic attacks.

entry: 传说POKENAME思乡心切，才让背上长出了月亮。有时会让旅人梦见月上的景象。
author: zombieshinx_
source: Legend says POKENAME's desperate desire to go home caused the growth of the moon on its back. It sometimes gives dreams of the moon to travelers.

entry: POKENAME从嘴里分泌柔软丝线，淡月光一照便闪亮。满月之夜，会与同伴在金合欢林深处的大空地，凌空起舞。
author: fiordaliso
source: The soft silk threads that POKENAME secretes from its mouth glisten when touched by the pale rays of the moon. On full moon nights, it is known to dance in midair with its companions in wide clearings deep within the acacia woods.

entry: POKENAME成群在小山岭无忧无虑地欢跳，心灵相连，不必开口也能交流。身体开始闪光时，就会展现平时没有的力量。
author: bobosmith01
source: Groups of POKENAME prance around carefree in small mountain ranges. They all have telepathic connections and can communicate wordlessly with one another. When their bodies start to glimmer, POKENAME begin to display powers they do not typically have.

entry: POKENAME更喜欢直接沐浴月光睡觉。熟睡时，头骨内能听见柔和咕鸣。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME prefers sleeping under direct moonlight. When in a deep slumber, a soft cooing can be heard from within its skull.

entry: POKENAME排出的星尘附在衣物、毛发上，吸入会引发幻觉。最常见的是明亮、闪烁的光点。
author: quackquackattack
source: The stardust expelled from POKENAME's body clings to clothing and fur and causes hallucinations when inhaled. Bright, twinkling lights are the most common experience caused by stardust inhalation.

entry: POKENAME待在天空开阔之地，月亮出来便剧烈振动。人们相信，吸收月光能加快茧内进化。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME places itself in areas with open skies, vibrating intensely when the moon is out. It is believed that absorbing moonlight hastens the evolutionary process within the cocoon.

entry: POKENAME排出的云状粉尘像星尘。许多吸入者说，会产生飞过太空的幻觉。
author: quackquackattack
source: The cloudy dust POKENAME expel from their body resembles stardust. Many who inhale these particles describe hallucinations of flying through space.

entry: 月夜里，POKENAME会将皮宝宝朝天空举起数小时。原因不明，有人认为，是为后代带来好运的仪式。
author: .izik
source: On moonlit nights, POKENAME holds its Cleffa up toward the sky for hours. No one knows why, but some believe it is a ritual to bring good fortune to its offspring.

entry: POKENAME周围环绕的石头像太阳系行星。只要取走一颗微型行星，其余都会坠地，直到失落那颗重回身边。
author: bigoljax
source: The rocks that orbit around POKENAME look like planets in the solar system. If one of these miniature planets is removed, the rest will fall to the ground until POKENAME is reunited with its lost planet.

entry: POKENAME引导保护朋友的愿望，召出盾牌。使用神秘力量时，腹部宝石会发光。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME can summon a shield by channeling its desire to protect its friends. The gem on its abdomen glows when it uses mystical powers.

entry: POKENAME夜夜研究星空，留心星座，再把见过的每一种，画在光墙造出的面板上。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME spend each night studying the stars, keeping a keen eye out for constellations. They then sketch each constellation they've seen on panels made by Light Screen.

entry: 流星雨期间，能看见POKENAME用利镰在树上雕出独特符号。占星师花了多年，解读其中含义。
author: mistymagius
source: During meteor showers, POKENAME can be seen carving unique symbols onto trees using their sharp scythes. Astrologists have spent years deciphering what these symbols mean.

entry: POKENAME的三条尾巴曾让古人争论。古籍记载，它从群星降下，尾巴讲述着太阳系的故事。
author: jojojax164
source: The three tails of POKENAME sparked controversy among people of the past. Ancient scriptures detailed that POKENAME descended from the stars, and that its tails told a story of our solar system.

entry: 沐浴足够月光、见过足够多满月后，POKENAME会飞上天空，置身群星。极少回到身为皮王时住过的水池，但新月时偶尔能见到。
author: katieplaysgames
source: After bathing in enough moonlight and witnessing enough full moons, POKENAME take to the skies and fly out to be amongst the stars. They will rarely return to the pools they lived in as Clefkarp, but can sometimes be seen during a new moon.

entry: 沐浴足够月光、见过足够多满月后，POKENAME会飞上天空，置身群星。极少回到身为皮王时住过的水池，但新月时偶尔能见到。
author: katieplaysgames
source: After bathing in enough moonlight and witnessing enough full moons, POKENAME take to the skies and fly out to be amongst the stars. They will rarely return to the pools they lived in as Clefkarp, but can sometimes be seen during a new moon.

entry: POKENAME被认为能给目击者带来好运。但见过的人太少，很难证实。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME are thought to bring good luck to those who spot them. Though due to sightings being scarce, it's hard to prove these claims.

entry: 东西一扔上POKENAME的背，就会传送到未知地方。研究者仍在调查。
author: dodoowner_
source: If you throw an item at POKENAME's back, the object teleports away to an unknown place. Researchers are still researching this phenomenon.

entry: 因为野外很少见到POKENAME飘忽的飞行轨迹，人们说它来自外太空。只在满月夜成群现身天空，向下方一切发射月亮之力。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are said to come from outer space, as their erratic flight patterns are rarely seen in the wild. They only emerge out on nights of the full moon, appearing in groups in the sky and shooting Moonblasts at anything below them.

entry: POKENAME该蜕皮时，会在夜里用小翅膀升空。旧皮刚脱落就碎散，接住月光，仿佛飞洒的星尘。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses its small wings to take to the sky at night when it is time to shed its skin. The discarded skin crumbles immediately after shedding, catching moonbeams and taking on the appearance of scattering stardust.

entry: POKENAME每周定期蜕皮。旧皮照上月光，就会发亮，像星星闪烁。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME regularly sheds its skin on a weekly basis. The discarded skin will glow and sparkle like stars when moonlight shines down upon it.

entry: POKENAME载着孩子，遨游奇幻夜空的故事，流传甚广。可真正得到证实的目击，却寥寥无几。
author: staghorn
source: Stories of POKENAME giving small children wondrous and magical rides through the night sky are common. Confirmed sightings, however, are rare.

entry: 毒液让被刺中的生灵迷乱、困倦。双臂刺针在月光下闪亮。
author: cait_sith
source: Its venom induces confusion and sleepiness in whatever it stings. The stingers on its arms glitter when exposed to moonlight.

entry: POKENAME即使满月也极少见。仅有的几次目击，其实都发生在超级月亮时。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME are incredibly rare, even during full moons. The few sightings people have caught were actually during a supermoon.

entry: 野生POKENAME虽会多种招式，白天被看见时，却总在用月亮之力与月光。但月亮一出现，立刻就开始使别的招式。
author: soup1900
source: Anytime a wild POKENAME has been spotted during the daytime, and despite being able to learn a variety of moves, they are always seen using Moonblast and Moonlight. However, once the moon becomes visible, they immediately start using other moves.

entry: POKENAME招来微小燃烧流星，攻击闯到偏僻巢穴的敌人。常被误认为普通流星，许多训练家还会朝它许愿。
author: npshi
source: POKENAME attracts tiny burning meteors to attack foes that stumble upon their isolated nests. These meteors are often mistaken for shooting stars, which many Trainers make wishes upon.

entry: POKENAME亲切、爱玩，步态如欢快蹦跳。每当嚼东西，躯干的新月标记就会泛光。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has a playful, prance-like gait that suits its affable personality. Whenever it is chewing on something, the crescent moon mark on its torso glows faintly.

entry: 这些宝可梦的后翼无法独自完全托起身体，却能辅助前翼。四翼齐用，POKENAME便能飞得比民航飞机更快。近年飞行照片很畅销。
author: secondatheniangadfly
source: These Pokémon have back wings that cannot fully support them, but they can support their front wings. When using all four wings, POKENAME can fly faster than commercial airplanes. Photos of them in flight have sold well in recent years.

entry: POKENAME夜行，喜欢在月光下一同嬉戏。听觉敏锐，人或宝可梦一靠近就会散开。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are nocturnal Pokémon that frolic together in the moonlight. They have acute hearing and will scatter if approached by Pokémon or people.

entry: POKENAME被陨石坑吸引，在坠落岩石里挖穴。满月时，能见它们绕陨石互追，在月光下一起嬉戏。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are drawn to meteor craters and will make burrows inside the fallen rocks. They can be seen on a full moon chasing one another around the meteors, cavorting together in the moonlight.

entry: POKENAME天性夜行，满月当空的夜里最活跃。有时成群聚在月光下，仰天柔唱，敬奉天体。
author: sk372
source: Nocturnal by nature, POKENAME is most active during nights where the full moon hangs overhead. Groups will sometimes gather in the moonlight and croon upward in reverence to the celestial body.

entry: POKENAME完全夜行，白天在树里休息。夜间织出复杂星座形蛛网，在月光下闪耀。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are completely nocturnal, resting inside trees during the day. At night, they spin intricate webs in the shapes of constellations, which glimmer in the moonlight.

entry: 满月时，大群POKENAME聚集，织出横跨森林、巨大而复杂的蛛网。月光下蛛丝闪亮，让森林明艳得令人屏息。
author: sk372
source: Throngs of POKENAME gather together during full moons to spin massively intricate webs across the forest. Their webbing sparkles in the moonlight, turning the forest into a bright and breathtaking sight.

entry: 若本该满月的夜里却看不见月亮，POKENAME就会焦急地不停鸣叫。有些训练家带月之石吊坠，安抚它。
author: .izik
source: If POKENAME cannot see the full moon on a night when one is present, it chirps nonstop in distress. Some Trainers carry Moon Stone pendants to calm it down.

entry: POKENAME又称“深海星河”。最大个体即使在阳光到不了的深处发光，也能从海面看见。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: POKENAME is also called the "Galaxy of the Deep". The largest ones can be seen glowing from the ocean's surface even at depths the sun cannot reach.

entry: POKENAME奇妙地亲近月之石中的星辰能量，连最小碎块也会寻找。里面的能量能强化身体。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have a strange affinity for the stellar energies contained within Moon Stones. They will seek out even the smallest fragments of the strange stones, the energies within them empowering their bodies.

entry: POKENAME聚在一起仰望夜空。传说，它们在寻找遥远星系中的其他生命。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME gather in groups to gaze at the night sky. Legends say that they are looking for other lifeforms in distant galaxies.

entry: POKENAME羊毛流过电力，就会变色，从午夜般深黑，到薰衣草紫。有人相信，花纹映出夜空的一部分。
author: _pixelar_
source: POKENAME's wool changes color when electricity flows through it, with hues ranging from dark midnight black to lavender purple. Some people believe that its wool pattern mirrors a section of the starry night sky.

entry: POKENAME在夜空追逐流星雨，月光下身影几乎难辨。古老传说说，它乘陨石来到世界，正在寻找更多同类。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME chase meteor showers across the night sky, barely visible against the light of the moon. Ancient legends surrounding POKENAME say that they came to our world on a meteor and that they are searching for more of their kind.

entry: POKENAME将月光吸进身体，增强电力。满月之夜，毛发噼啪充能，羊毛泛起微光。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME absorbs the moon's light into its body, amplifying the power of its electricity. On full moon nights, its fur crackles with energy, making its wool glow faintly.

entry: POKENAME通常飞在高云之上，许多宇航员甚至报告，在大气层外见过。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME are usually seen flying high above the clouds. Many astronauts have even reported seeing some above the atmosphere.

entry: 这种宝可梦爱在月下成群跳舞。满月时，花瓣明亮发光，据说见到就能得好运。
author: barfy_here
source: This Pokémon loves to dance under the moon in groups. When it is a full moon, their flower petals glow brightly; it is said to bring good luck to anyone who sees this.

entry: 春季，POKENAME乘热上升气流移动。身体太轻，无法脱离气流，因此很少降下。
author: karmaofevil
source: In spring, POKENAME is carried by thermal updrafts. It rarely comes down due to its light body not being able to exit an air current.

entry: POKENAME通常乘太阳风，在行星之间旅行。花粉只能在有固体表面的行星或卫星生长。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME typically rides solar winds in order to travel from planet to planet. Its pollen is only able to grow on planets or moons with solid surfaces.

entry: POKENAME完全夜行，夜里出来觅食。敏锐的听觉能察觉数英里外动静，极难寻踪，常还没弄清接近的是什么，就先逃回洞里。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are completely nocturnal, emerging at night to forage for food. Their sensitive ears can pick up sounds from miles away, making them highly elusive. They will often flee to their burrows before they even know what's coming.

entry: 一群POKENAME睡着，鼾声合成柔和、轻盈的旋律。单独听，却像风吹过高草。
author: bagumbothimble
source: When a group of POKENAME are asleep, their collective snores sound like a soft and airy tune. Individually, POKENAME snores sound like wind blowing through tall grass.

entry: 晴夜里，POKENAME在月光下有节奏地摇摆。颈边叶片若闪光，就表示成功吸收了月亮反射的残余太阳能。
author: bagumbothimble
source: On nights with clear skies POKENAME will rhythmically sway under the moonlight. If the leaves around its neck shimmer it has successfully absorbed remnants of solar power bouncing off of the moon.

entry: POKENAME白天睡，连夏夜也睡。冷夜里望着月亮，鳃轻轻颤动，甚至扑向映着月影的水，似乎总学不会月亮抓不住。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME sleeps during the day, and even during summer nights. On cold nights, it gazes at the moon, gills twitching. It even jumps into water where it sees the moon's reflection, never seeming to learn that it cannot catch it.

entry: POKENAME无论日夜都不迷路，靠星图尾巴成群在地面导航。但附近有热气球，就会飞上天，保护它们免遭袭击。
author: ghostslythe
source: Day or night, POKENAME never lose their way. Using their star-chart tail, they navigate in flocks on the ground. When hot air balloons are in the area, though, they take to the skies, protecting them from attackers.

entry: POKENAME有许多知识想分享，黎明却会忘掉这些高深见解。科学家曾深入野外研究这类夜行生灵，但它们很少在同一地方停留太久。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have lots of knowledge to share with the world but lose these powerful insights at dawn. Scientists have made expeditions into the wild to try to study these nocturnal creatures, but they rarely remain in one place for long.

entry: POKENAME捡拾坠落的月球碎片，组成背上的月形球茎，借此吸收月光，为攻击供能。
author: turcai_87271
source: POKENAME picks up fallen moon fragments to form its lunar bulb. Using this bulb, it absorbs moonlight to fuel its attacks.

entry: POKENAME鲜少现于人前。若有幸寻到，它就会让来者看见浩瀚深空的美丽幻象。
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher
source: POKENAME are rarely seen by human eyes. Those who are lucky enough to find one are shown beautiful visions of deep space.

entry: 白天，POKENAME的壳紧闭，无法打开、损坏。夜里出来捕食熟睡猎物；若被发现，就猛烈旋转，喷出足以撕穿钢铁、混凝土的金属碎片。
author: ehard
source: During the day its shell closes shut, impossible to open or damage. At night POKENAME emerges to feast on sleeping prey. If spotted it will violently spin while spraying metal shards that tear through steel and concrete.

entry: 月光增强POKENAME的飞行能力。它等待满月之夜，再高飞入山筑巢。
author: hophoppip
source: Moonlight strengthens a POKENAME's flying abilities. It waits for the night of the full moon, then flies high into the mountains to make a nest.

entry: 古老神话称，流星撞击前，POKENAME会完全静止地悬在天空。它在高层大气等待，用钢钳轻松夹碎来袭太空碎片，化成无害粉尘。
author: beatdoof
source: Ancient myths claim POKENAME hovers completely motionless in the sky just before a meteor strikes. Waiting in the upper atmosphere, it uses its steely pincers to effortlessly crush incoming space debris into harmless dust.

entry: POKENAME十分隐居，野外只有夜间森林能见到。满月夜，直接站在月光下，角被月光一触便闪亮。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is quite reclusive, and only seen in the wild in forests at night. On nights containing full moons, it stands directly in the moonlight, its horn sparkling from the touch of moonbeams.

entry: POKENAME嗅觉、听觉敏锐，能找到熟树果与溪流。深夜脚步轻巧，移动不易被发现。
author: cobalt0135
source: POKENAME's acute sense of smell and hearing allows them to detect where ripe berries and streams of water are. Their light movements in the middle of the night allow them to move without being noticed.

entry: 有人收集POKENAME壳的碎片，相信能疗伤、带来好运。碎片很稀少，因为它常住地下，回避人类与其他宝可梦。
author: wiz0z
source: Some people collect fragments from the shell of POKENAME, believing them to have healing properties or provide good luck. These are rare, as POKENAME often avoid humans and other Pokémon by living underground.

entry: 满月时，POKENAME不知为何飞得更快，轻松翱翔夜空。研究者仍未找出月光增强速度的原因。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME somehow flies faster during full moons, soaring effortlessly through the night sky. Researchers have yet to determine why moonlight enhances its speed.

entry: POKENAME成群跃过月照海洋，滑翔如违背重力。古老传说说，它们将闪亮鳞片点满天空，形成如今的星星。
author: chibitales
source: Schools of POKENAME jump and glide over moonlit oceans as if defying gravity. An old legend claims POKENAME dotted the sky with their sparkling scales, creating the stars known today.

entry: 月色明亮的夜里，POKENAME边鸣叫、边欢跳。脱落的粉色金属羽毛，在月光下很亮，是热门配饰。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME prances and chirps about during nights when the moon is bright. It sheds pink metallic feathers that glow brightly in the moonlight, making them a popular accessory.

entry: POKENAME耳朵极敏锐。成群逼近猎物时，用其他宝可梦听不见的低声吼鸣交流。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME have incredibly sensitive ears. As they close in on their prey, packs of them will communicate with each other using growls too quiet for other Pokémon to hear.

entry: 无月之夜，POKENAME在山顶点起大篝火，高声嚎叫，数英里外都听得见。引来其他同类，形成由召集者率领的群体。
author: .jerden
source: On moonless nights, POKENAME create a large bonfire on the top of a mountain, then howl loudly enough to be heard from miles away. This gathers together other POKENAME, forming a pack led by the one that brought them all together.

entry: POKENAME不断大群迁行，通常五十多只成群。月亮升起便停下休息，有些成员推倒大树，让幼小成员看见夜空。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME constantly travel in massive herds, the average size of most herds being in the fifties. The herd stops to rest once the moon rises, with some members pushing down large trees so their young can see the night sky.

entry: 病毒还没进入POKENAME所在的电脑，它隔着几个系统就能听见失真噪声。大多时间学习太空，尤其各种行星的卫星。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME can hear the glitchy sounds of viruses from several computer systems away before they even enter the computer it's in. It spends most of its time learning about space, specifically about moons of any kind or from any planet.

entry: 传言，这种宝可梦进化前，会在野外的满月之夜，与雄性对应个体相会，交换月之石。
author: violet_zero
source: It is rumored that before evolution, this Pokémon meets with its male counterpart in the wild on full moon nights to exchange Moon Stones.

entry: POKENAME踏月疾行，优雅鬃毛如夜星闪耀。人们相信，它倾听月照湖中的声音，得知哪里的水受到污染。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME dashes upon the moonlight, its elegant mane shimmering like the stars of the night sky. It is believed that it listens to voices inside of moonlit lakes who tell it where waters have been tainted and fouled.

entry: POKENAME肆虐时，反复猛砸地面，直到凹出巨坑。虽然庞大、沉重，跳跃却奇异地又高、又轻飘。
author: soup1900
source: When POKENAME goes on a rampage, it smashes the ground repeatedly until there is a giant crater indented on the surface. Despite being very large and heavy, its jumps are strangely high and floaty.

entry: 据说，最初的POKENAME在陨石坑被发现，但究竟被坑吸引，还是造出了坑，仍有争论。月夜最活跃，似乎也更强。
author: infinex21
source: Supposedly, the first POKENAME was discovered within a crater, though it remains debated if it was drawn to the crater or if it was what created the crater. POKENAME becomes most active on moonlit nights, though it also seems to become stronger.

entry: POKENAME喜欢满月时与同类聚集，常因此引发小型电风暴。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME likes to gather with others of its kind during a full moon. When they do so, they often spark a minor electrical storm.

entry: POKENAME想前往的时代若太吵，就会完全避开。殖民前时代有数百条目击记录，如今却几乎没有，支持了这种行为。
author: soup1900
source: If a time period POKENAME tries to travel to is too noisy, it will avoid it entirely. This behavior is backed up by the hundreds of records of POKENAME sightings during pre-colonization eras compared to the almost zero amount today.

entry: POKENAME尾巴吸收月光能量，越吸越轻，帮助身体轻轻浮在水面。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's tail absorbs energy from the moonlight, becoming lighter as it does. This helps POKENAME to float gently on the surface of water.

entry: 满月时，POKENAME成群聚集，为月亮跳舞。常能见它们抛接地上捡来的石头。
author: santon5512
source: On full moons, groups of POKENAME will gather and dance for the moon. They can often be seen juggling rocks that they find along the ground.

entry: POKENAME寻找圆圆的月之石，放在袋里。若发现比已有那颗更圆的，就会送给最近的人或生灵。
author: mary_the_jane
source: POKENAME searches for round moonstones to keep in its pouch. If it finds a Moon Stone rounder than the one it has, it will give it to whoever or whatever is closest.

entry: 它把吸收的月光能量储存在脸颊，腺体转成电力，随意释放。
author: foolish_weasel
source: It stores energy it absorbs from the moon in its cheeks. Glands in its cheeks convert this energy into electricity that it can unleash on command.

entry: 繁星满天的夜里，细看天空，有些舞动的绿点，正是四处飞翔的POKENAME。
author: chorb33
source: On starry nights, attentive observers can spot green, dancing dots in the sky. These are POKENAME flying around.

entry: 繁星满天的夜里，细看天空，有些舞动的绿点，正是四处飞翔的POKENAME。
author: chorb33
source: On starry nights, attentive observers can spot green, dancing dots in the sky. These are POKENAME flying around.

entry: POKENAME从掌心孔洞产生奇怪星尘，既能持续喷射，也能紧凝成球，发射微型陨石，重击对手。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME generates a strange type of stardust from the holes in its palms. It can fire this material out in a constant stream, or condense it tightly into an orb and fire miniature meteorites to pummel its opponents.

entry: POKENAME通常去陨石频繁撞击的地方，吃星体残骸。咬碎天外石块，双颚常被染黑。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME generally gravitates towards places where meteorites have regularly impacted. It snacks upon the remnants of these stellar objects, their jaws often colored black from crunching on the extraterrestrial stones.

entry: 据说，月食期间见到这种宝可梦，会得到好运。月见山山谷以外，很少有目击。
author: nuclader
source: This Pokémon is said to grant good luck to those who witness it during a lunar eclipse. Sightings of it outside the valley of Mt. Moon are rare.

entry: POKENAME是年幼、怕黑孩子的好伙伴。电力让尾巴泛起柔和粉光，夜里一见月亮升起，就习惯点亮。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME make excellent companions for young children who are scared of the night. Their tails light up with a soft pink glow thanks to their electrical power, an ability they make a habit of using when they see the moon rise at night.

entry: 獠牙成分与月球相同。毛发能保护身体，抵御极寒。
author: soup1900
source: Its tusks are made of the same composition the moon is made out of. Its fur is capable of protecting the Pokémon from extremely cold temperatures.

entry: POKENAME常打碎挡路巨石，帮助其他皮皮、皮可西，也帮它们凿出居住的洞穴。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME will often help other Clefairy and Clefable by destroying boulders that obstruct their path. They also help form the caves that those Pokémon live in.

entry: POKENAME常住在用户描绘月亮的文件里。文件若被删除，就会在其他文件间大闹。
author: victor9106
source: POKENAME often inhabits a user's files that depict the moon. If this file is deleted, it will go on a rampage through the user's files.

entry: POKENAME听力好，担任兄弟姐妹的斥候。感知人类后，便轻鸣着返回，引导同胞去更安全处，等入侵者走过。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME is a scout to its siblings due to its great hearing. When POKENAME sense the presence of people, it will return to its siblings with light chirps before helping to guide them to a safer location until the intruders pass.

entry: 这些夜行宝可梦用翅膀，让步伐仿佛失重。其他宝可梦遇险，POKENAME就会疾奔救援，甚至跑过水面，用利爪、脚爪劈向攻击者。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: These nocturnal Pokémon use their wings to add the feeling of weightlessness to their steps. If other Pokémon are in trouble, POKENAME will sprint to their aid, even across water, and use their sharp talons and claws to slash at attackers.

entry: POKENAME被称为“月之守护者”，警戒守望月之石矿藏。谁想取走，就从阴影现身，夺回被偷的宝物。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: Known as the 'Guardians of the Moon,' POKENAME vigilantly watch over deposits of Moon Stones. Should anyone attempt to remove one, they will emerge from the shadows to reclaim the stolen treasure.

entry: POKENAME靠有力双腿攀上高山，沐浴月光。月下起舞，围巾般的羽毛便如星星闪亮。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: Scaling large mountains with the help of their powerful legs, POKENAME bask in the light of the moon. By dancing in the moon's rays, their scarf-like feathers will begin to glitter and glow like the stars.

entry: POKENAME高居山中，彻夜守望，保护附近熟睡的宝可梦。有力双腿与双翼让它能跃下高崖，优雅落在需要帮助的地方。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: Living high in the mountains, POKENAME keep watch through the night, protecting any Pokémon sleeping nearby. With their powerful legs and wings, they can leap from towering cliffs and land gracefully wherever they are needed.

entry: POKENAME天性胆小，却从不逃避危险。活得越久，感到的恐惧越少，年长个体的勇气坚定不移。
author: stevethebarbarian
source: POKENAME is naturally timid, but never runs from danger. The longer it lives, the less it experiences fear at all. An elder POKENAME has unshakable courage.

entry: POKENAME有时很笨拙，戴着类似月岩材料的头盔保护自己。据说与月亮本身精神相连，常见它试着交流。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME can be quite clumsy at times, wearing helmets made from a material similar to moonrock to protect themselves. It is said that these Pokémon have a psychic connection to the moon itself, often seen attempting to communicate with it.

entry: POKENAME有突然睡着的倾向。若睡在满月下，妖精能量就会以魔法投影覆盖周围，生成许多可爱影像。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has narcoleptic tendencies and can fall asleep at a moment's notice. If it sleeps beneath the light of a full moon, its fairy energy covers the area in a magical projection, generating numerous bits of cute imagery.

entry: 训练家夜里难以入睡时，POKENAME就会围着对方优雅起舞，唱起轻柔的摇篮曲。
author: kittyluv090
source: If its Trainer is having trouble falling asleep at night, POKENAME will dance around them beautifully while singing a soothing lullaby.

entry: POKENAME白天完全静止地悬浮，研究者常称其类似睡眠。月亮开始升起，头上的新月就会亮起，唤醒身体。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME float completely still during the day, often described by researchers as a sleep-like state. When the moon begins to rise, the crescent above their heads glows brightly and wakes them up.

entry: POKENAME主体由一只痴迷月亮的皮可西操纵。它闯进天文馆，偷月球模型，逐个收入私人收藏。
author: bigoljax
source: The main body of POKENAME is piloted by a Clefable, who is utterly infatuated with the moon. It breaks into planetariums to steal models of the moon, keeping each one in a private collection.

entry: 野生POKENAME只在满月夜从粉色楔石里出来。一听见附近人声，就托起楔石，带过数英里，放到更偏远之处。
author: .jerden
source: Wild POKENAME only emerge from their pink keystone on nights when the moon is full. If they hear humans nearby, they will lift their keystone into the air, carry it for miles, then put it down in a more remote location.

entry: POKENAME楔石如裂开的满月。现身时自带引力，将附近物品拖来，导致东西倾倒、跌落边缘。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's keystone resembles a cracked full moon. When it emerges, it has its own gravitational pull, which it will use to drag nearby objects towards it, causing items to topple over or fall off ledges.

entry: POKENAME运用星辰能量，拳头如陨石撞击，能打穿一切。力量与智慧都极出色，精英训练家认为是绝佳伙伴。
author: beatdoof
source: Harnessing the energies of the stars, POKENAME's fists are as powerful as meteor strikes, able to punch a hole through anything. Ace Trainers have noted POKENAME as exceptionally great partners based on their power and their exceptional intellect.

entry: 最近发现POKENAME爬上红莲岛海滩。研究者追踪到几年前落海的陨石，那里似乎是繁殖地。
author: laughing_dan
source: POKENAME were recently discovered, dragging themselves onto the beaches of Cinnabar Island. Researchers tracked these Pokémon to a meteorite that had fallen into the ocean some years ago, which appears to act as their breeding ground.

entry: 月光照上POKENAME，脸便泛起柔光，力量增强，仿佛覆盖魔法屏障。虽然结实，却有巨大弱点：巨响会使其晕眩。
author: soup1900
source: When exposed to the moonlight, POKENAME's faces begin to glow softly and become stronger as if a magical barrier covers over them. While tough Pokémon, they have a huge weakness; they become stunned when blasted with loud sounds.

entry: POKENAME让皮宝宝爬上壳，更好看清月亮。一小块月岩始终绕着壳顶旋转。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME let Cleffa climb onto their shells so they can get a much better look at the moon. A small chunk of moon rock constantly revolves around the peak of their shells.

entry: POKENAME找到够大的巨石，带着四处走，直到入夜。夜里以月亮为参照，用另一块石慢慢雕凿。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME seek out for a boulder large enough for their needs then carry it around until night comes. At night, they slowly chisel at the boulder with a rock, using the moon as a reference.

entry: 传言，POKENAME吸进空心身体的物品，其实进了直通月亮的传送门。虽然已证伪，仍没人知道，为何只在满月吸物。
author: soup1900
source: It is rumored that items POKENAME absorbs into its hollow body are actually sucked into a portal leading directly to the moon. While this has been proven false, no one knows why it only absorbs objects during full moons.

entry: POKENAME游历宇宙，寻找愿意一起冒险的朋友。可惜，似乎不明白，为什么多数人不愿毫无装备就去太空。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME travel through the cosmos in search of friends to bring along on their adventures. Unfortunately, they don't seem to understand why most are hesitant to travel to space without proper equipment.

entry: 古宗教文献将夜夜月明归功于POKENAME。人们为敬奉这份信念，会完整表演月之舞。
author: .izik
source: Old religious writings credit POKENAME with causing the moon to shine each night. Entire lunar dances were performed in reverence of this belief.

entry: POKENAME是观星爱好者常见的伙伴。与训练家完全亲近后，尾焰里的星星会变动，映出训练家的星座。
author: distinguishedmanlygentleman
source: POKENAME is a common companion for people who enjoy stargazing. Once POKENAME has fully bonded with its trainer, the stars in the flame on its tail will shift to reflect the star sign of its trainer.

entry: POKENAME将月光存进剑鞘，睡眠时帮助恢复能量。战斗中借缎带来回飞甩，形成星辰般的绚丽景象。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME store moonlight in their scabbards to help them regain energy while they sleep. In battle, POKENAME fling themselves back and forth using their ribbons, creating a dazzling display of stars.

entry: POKENAME盾牌散出奇力，让周围一切仿佛受月球重力影响。满月时极偶尔会借此，搭起向月亮延伸的桥。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's shield emanates a strange power that causes everything around it to act as if they are under lunar gravity. On rare occasions, during full moons, it uses this force to build itself a bridge reaching towards the moon itself.

entry: POKENAME盾牌散出奇力，让周围一切仿佛受月球重力影响。满月时极偶尔会借此，搭起向月亮延伸的桥。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's shield emanates a strange power that causes everything around it to act as if they are under lunar gravity. On rare occasions, during full moons, it uses this force to build itself a bridge reaching towards the moon itself.

entry: 人们认为，POKENAME刀刃由纯月之石构成，但成因未知。随身的皮可西形盾牌，护身时会泛起舒缓光芒。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME's blade is thought to be made of pure Moon Stone, though it is unknown how it came to be. The Clefable-shaped shield it carries glows with a soothing light when shielding its body.

entry: 人们认为，POKENAME刀刃由纯月之石构成，但成因未知。随身的皮可西形盾牌，护身时会泛起舒缓光芒。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME's blade is thought to be made of pure Moon Stone, though it is unknown how it came to be. The Clefable-shaped shield it carries glows with a soothing light when shielding its body.

entry: 传说，POKENAME由坠地的大块月岩形成。常仰望月亮，仿佛想再回家。
author: bigoljax
source: Legends say that POKENAME are created from large moon rocks that fell down to earth. They're usually seen gazing up at the moon, as though they wish to visit home again.

entry: POKENAME只在夜间被看见，月夜会被吸引到海面。尾巴移动，在水里留下闪亮轨迹，如夜空流星。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are only ever seen during the night, drawn to the surface of the ocean during moonlit nights. The movements of their tails leave sparkling trails in the water reminiscent of shooting stars in the night sky.

entry: POKENAME靠幻觉力量，让长发看起来仿佛宇宙本身。似乎以月光为食，因此只在夜里活动。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's long hair appears as if it is the very cosmos itself due to their powers of illusion. They seem to feed on moonlight and, thus, are only active at night.

entry: POKENAME对人类十分戒备。两只大耳朵始终留意四周，探察潜在的威胁。
author: melodydelune
source: POKENAME are wary of humans. Their large ears are constantly monitoring the environment of possible threats.

entry: POKENAME的深海栖居处，装饰着闪亮石头，覆着与巨鳍上一样的星尘。只有满月才离开深处，跃出水面，在月光下滑翔。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's deep-sea layer is decorated by sparkling stones dusted with the stardust coating its large fins. It only comes up from the depths during the full moon, where it breaches the water and glides about beneath the moonbeams.

entry: 据说，它将月夜的天空收进了锋利的爪与指甲之中。研究者认为，这是接触月之石后产生的变化。它能轻松跃上高空，仿佛身处月球。
author: over9001
source: It's said this Pokémon captured the moonlit sky in its sharp claws and nails. Researchers believe it's the result of it coming into contact with a Moon Stone. It can easily jump into the sky as if it were on the moon.

entry: POKENAME翱翔于浩瀚太空，保护世界免受各种星际威胁。它们十分贪玩，时不时便回到人类身边。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME soars throughout the vast emptiness of space, protecting the world from a number of intergalactic threats. They are very playful Pokémon and return to humanity every so often.

entry: 有人说，POKENAME能控制所有睡在星空下的生灵之梦。力量虽大，却似乎怕人，尽可能回避。
author: t3isukone
source: Some people say that POKENAME can control the dreams of all those who go to sleep beneath a starry sky. Despite its great power, POKENAME seems to fear humans and avoids them as much as it can.

entry: POKENAME用奇异闪光雾气作独特炮弹，对夜行宝可梦最有效。人们认为，其成分可能与月球有某种关联。
author: sk372
source: A strange sparkling mist is used as POKENAME's unique type of cannon ammunition and is most effective on nocturnal Pokémon. It is believed that the material may have some kind of compositional connection to the moon.

entry: POKENAME爱飞过夜空，仰望群星。据说，每当一颗星黯去，便向无尽宇宙鸣叫，尾巴脉动着星尘火焰。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME enjoy soaring through the night sky to watch the stars above them. It is said that whenever a star in the night sky fades away, POKENAME let out a cry into the endless cosmos as their tail pulses with stardust flames.

entry: POKENAME通常极友善，连陌生者也一样。但一碰尾巴，立刻就会激怒，展开尾巴，化作堪比拆楼铁球的武器。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME are typically very friendly, even towards strangers. However, touching POKENAME's tail will immediately draw its wrath, unfurling into a weapon comparable to a wrecking ball.

entry: POKENAME被嘲笑粉色、妖精般的外表，就会好斗、易怒。但满月夜性情转为无忧无虑，在月下起舞。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME is aggressive and quick to anger when mocked for its pink, fairy-like appearance. However, on nights of the full moon, this Pokémon's attitude transforms into a happy-go-lucky one as it dances under the moonlight.

entry: POKENAME每周收集一次石头，排成完美圆圈。月夜里，在阵中优雅跳舞，随动作泛出柔光。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME gathers stones and arranges them in a perfect circle once per week. On moonlit nights, it dances gracefully within the formation, glowing softly as it moves.

entry: 臂上的花被广泛视为暗恋的象征。需要月光才能繁盛，照到日光，就开始落瓣。
author: .jerden
source: The flowers on their arms are widely regarded as a symbol of secret love. They require moonlight to thrive and will begin to shed petals if exposed to daylight.

entry: POKENAME头部如星光闪耀，似乎帮助花朵夜间引来其他宝可梦。靠近后，可能允许吸食花蜜，也可能用头身毒刺攻击。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's head sparkles with starlight, which seems to help its flowers lure in other Pokémon at night. Once they are close, POKENAME may let them feed from its flowers or may attack with the poisonous spikes on its head and body.

entry: POKENAME夜间漂浮观星。满月时，能见它们互扣缎带，形成星座般图案。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME float through the night sky to gaze at the stars. On nights of the full moon, they can be seen locking ribbons with each other in patterns resembling constellations.

entry: POKENAME仔细用彩石、宝石装饰长耳。许多神话说，一跃便能到月球，但毫无证据。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME meticulously decorates its long ears with a collection of colorful stones and gems. Many myths surrounding this Pokémon say that it could reach the moon with a single leap, though no evidence supports this claim.

entry: POKENAME释放太空般的孢子，能麻醉受影响者。副作用少，深受外科医生欢迎。受影响的人总梦见在月亮上与皮皮跳舞。
author: teatedtiten
source: The space-like spores POKENAME releases have an anesthetic effect on its recipients. Because of their low side-effects, these spores are popular among surgeons. Those that are under their influence always dream of dancing with Clefairy on the moon.

entry: POKENAME借重力场与星辰力量，躲避想研究占星能力的科学家。只留下一种会融成星尘的黑色凝胶。
author: quackquackattack
source: With gravitational fields and the power of the stars, POKENAME hide from scientists who wish to study their astrological powers. The only trace they leave behind is a black gel that melts into stardust.

entry: 两只皮可西融合成POKENAME，便天生感应天体运行。能将这股能量显现，召来微型行星、卫星自卫。
author: katieplaysgames
source: When two Clefable fuse into POKENAME, they become innately attuned to the movement of celestial bodies. They can manifest this energy and summon miniature planets and moons, using them to defend themselves.

entry: POKENAME滑过乡间聚落上空，没有高楼挡路。满月之夜，会聚在一起，凌空共舞。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME glide above rural communities where there are no tall buildings to block their path. On nights of the full moon, they join together to dance in the air.

entry: 头顶的星星，蓄满了宇宙能量。有人相信，若能摸到它而不被烫伤，就能实现一个愿望。
author: ohok3441
source: The star atop this fusion's head is filled with cosmic energy. Some believe that if you touch it without getting burnt, you'll be granted a wish.

entry: 它头上月牙状的饰物，根本拿不下来。谁若伸手想扯，往往只落得一手烫伤。
author: ohok3441
source: The moon-shaped headpiece cannot be removed from this fusion. Individuals who try to grab at it often find themselves earning a burn instead.

entry: POKENAME头上的火焰，以宇宙力量与积极的情绪为燃料。心情越好，火便烧得越亮。
author: ohok3441
source: The fire on POKENAME's head is fueled by both cosmic power and positivity. It'll burn brighter when it's happy.

entry: POKENAME爱用尾巴在泥地描图，常留下谁也解不开的形状。孩子说，它的摇篮曲会带来特别鲜明的梦。
author: mgfox_66676
source: POKENAME enjoys tracing patterns in the dirt with its tail, often leaving behind shapes no one can decipher. Children say its lullabies bring especially vivid dreams.

entry: POKENAME最初被认为是化作陨石坠地的月球碎片。体内神秘能量阵阵释放，使自己升空；封住核心的月之石，则存下多余能量。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Originally thought to have been pieces of the moon fallen to Earth as meteors, POKENAME contain a mysterious energy that they release in bursts to launch into the air. The Moon Stone that seals a POKENAME's core stores any excess energy.

entry: POKENAME极难捕捉、研究，让科学家困惑。似乎只在满月夜出现，第二天就消失。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME baffle scientists because they are notoriously difficult to capture and study. They seem to only appear on nights of the full moon, but vanish the next day.

entry: POKENAME小眼视力很差，走得慢又谨慎。满月时明显改善，看得清楚，便开心跳舞、蹦跳。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's small eyes grant it rather poor vision, making it walk around slowly and carefully. Its eyesight shows marked improvement when the full moon is out, with it dancing and hopping about happily while its vision is clear.

entry: 融合让POKENAME能借月光悬浮。虽然胆小，与朋友却很爱玩。可惜，多数不知道自己力量多大，与其他宝可梦玩得太粗暴。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: Fusion has given POKENAME the ability to levitate using the power of moonlight. Despite being timid, they are playful with friends. Unfortunately, most POKENAME are unaware of the extent of their power, playing too roughly with other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME与近亲成群，在月照湖边欢跳。人们认为，这种舞蹈吸收月亮能量，延长寿命。舞毕就会嚎叫，向四周洒下灿烂粉色余烬。
author: chibitales
source: Groups of POKENAME and their brethren prance around lakes under moonlight. It's thought they absorb the moon's energy through this dancing, prolonging their lifespan. When the dance is complete, they howl and shower the area in brilliant pink embers.

entry: POKENAME能在太空长时间呼吸，不断绕星球旅行练习。梦想有一天终于能到月亮。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME are able to breathe in space for long periods of time, constantly traveling around the planet for practice. They dream of the day they can finally reach the moon.

entry: 月亮高悬、最明亮时，据说POKENAME会为遇到的第一个人实现愿望。每个月相周期，都有大批人出门寻找，盼愿望成真。
author: quackquackattack
source: When the moon is high in the sky and shines its brightest, POKENAME are said to give wishes to the first person they come across. Many people come out in droves every lunar cycle in an attempt to locate POKENAME for their wishes.

entry: POKENAME经常避开旁人，练习武艺。有些训练家、研究者报告，满月时，攻击改用月光，而非波导。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME practice their martial skills often and out of view of others. Some Trainers and researchers report that during full moons, POKENAME manipulate moonlight for their attacks instead of aura.

entry: POKENAME懒得惊人，会在同一地方连续睡上整整几周。似乎只有满月光能唤醒，促使吃喝，再找新休息处。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are immensely lazy Pokémon, spending multiple entire weeks in a row sleeping in one place. The only thing that seems to rouse them is the light of a full moon, which pushes them to eat, drink, and search out a new resting spot.

entry: POKENAME夜里与同伴聚在星下起舞，让尾尖新月发亮。性情胆小，一察觉可疑声响，就立刻藏进树林。
author: fiordaliso
source: At night, POKENAME gathers with its companions to dance beneath the stars, making the crescent moon on the tip of its tail shine. If it senses a suspicious sound, it immediately hides in the woods because of its timid nature.

entry: 满月之夜，POKENAME成簇漂浮，排成完美球形，齐声唱歌。合声化为超凡旋律，回荡大地。
author: .izik
source: On full moon nights, clusters of POKENAME float together in a perfect spherical formation, singing in unison. Their combined voices create an otherworldly melody that echoes across the land.

entry: POKENAME藏在地下，用强大的引力漩涡吸来猎物。漩涡虽强得连汽车也能卷入，POKENAME却只捕食小型宝可梦。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME hides in the ground, using a strong gravitational vortex to pull in its prey. Despite the vortex being powerful enough to pull in a car, POKENAME only goes after smaller Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME在月光下成群，群体大小随月光强度增加。鲜艳粉色，让它深受水族馆喜爱。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME school together under the light of the moon, with the size of the school increasing proportionate to the intensity of the moonlight. They are popular with aquariums due to their vibrant pink colouring.

entry: POKENAME体内有追踪阴历的独特机关。阴历年交替时，便触发鸣响，宣告新年。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME has a unique mechanism in its body that tracks the lunar calendar. At the turn of a lunar year, its body triggers a sound that marks a new year.

entry: POKENAME爱与皮皮共舞，用低沉浑厚的嗓音，在月光下歌唱。到了新月之夜，其他妖精宝可梦，也会围着它起舞。
author: leshii
source: POKENAME loves to dance with Clefairy and sing in the moonlight with its deep, rumbling voice. Other fairy types dance around it on new-moon nights.

entry: POKENAME将尾焰集中成浓密等离子球，产生自身重力，将小物品带入轨道，甚至帮助自己浮动。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME concentrate the flame on their tails into dense balls of plasma. These balls generate their own gravity, picking up small objects in their orbit and even helping POKENAME float around.

entry: POKENAME含苞的花，会在满月夜绽放。据说，此时遇见的人，很快就会碰到灵魂伴侣。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have budding flowers that bloom on nights of the full moon. It is said that if a person comes across a POKENAME during this time, they will meet their soulmate shortly thereafter.

entry: POKENAME察觉有人低落呆滞，会埋在家旁，释放孢子。吸入后，心里暂时振奋。这样做，纯粹出于善意。
author: teatedtiten
source: When sensing someone is in a depressive stupor, POKENAME will bury themselves near their homes and release spores. When inhaled, they offer a temporary uplifting feeling in one's heart. They do this out of unadulerated kindness.

entry: POKENAME周身特殊黑液，一接触天外物质就发光。它喜欢观星，天文学家因此常当宠物饲养。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME surround themselves with a special black liquid that glows when exposed to matter from outer space. Astronomers often keep them as pets because they enjoy stargazing.

entry: 满月之夜，POKENAME会神秘地停下振翅，轻松滑翔。有人认为，月球引力能让它短暂摆脱重力。
author: .izik
source: On full moon nights, POKENAME mysteriously stops flapping its wings and glides effortlessly. Some believe the moon's pull allows it to defy gravity for a short time.

entry: 满月之夜，成群的POKENAME会四处列队行进。它们对旗帜有着奇特的痴迷，因此也常参加游行。
author: sottiwotti
source: Groups of POKENAME march around on full moon nights. Because of their weird obsession with flags, they are often used in parades.

entry: POKENAME带着几分顽皮巡视古墓，缩小身体，悄悄跟踪盗墓贼。玩腻了，就发射强力月亮之力，吓走对方。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME patrols ancient catacombs with a certain whimsy, shrinking itself down to stalk grave robbers undetected. Once bored of the grave robbers, it shoots a powerful Moonblast to scare them away.

entry: POKENAME爱吃像月亮的硬糖，例如硬糖球。使出一次咬碎，便能粉碎一颗大硬糖球。
author: musicsheep.
source: POKENAME loves moon-like hard candies such as jawbreakers. It can crush a large jawbreaker with a single Crunch.

entry: POKENAME银叶闪亮，夜里吸收月光，驱动魔力。满月时，便能浮空。
author: hophoppip
source: Its shimmering silver leaves absorb the moonlight at night, fueling POKENAME's magic. On a full moon, it gains the ability to float.

entry: POKENAME夜里优雅起舞，月下挥翼。深粉翼羽吸收月光，使它悬浮，轻得连水面也能跳。
author: hophoppip
source: It dances gracefully at night, waving its wings in the moonlight. The dark pink feathers on its wings absorb the moonlight to make POKENAME levitate, making it light enough to dance upon water.

entry: POKENAME身上紫色的“垃圾”其实是毛。虽由这样的宝可梦融合而来，气味却令人放松。
author: rageofthehomeless
source: The purple 'trash' that is seen on POKENAME is actually fur. It has a calming smell, despite what creates this fusion.

entry: POKENAME群在满月夜最活跃，不断跃出水面。有人说，它们希望有一天，能一路跳到月亮。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME schools are most active on nights with a full moon, where they can be seen constantly leaping from the water. Some say they hope to one day leap all the way to the moon itself.

entry: 极偶尔，POKENAME会从天降下，拜访失去孩子的家庭。只留片刻，便重回群星。
author: .realthree
source: Once in a blue moon, POKENAME descend from the sky to visit families that have lost a child. They only stay for a short while before returning to the stars above.

entry: POKENAME身体产生鲜艳的粉色冰，据传能追踪天体运动，遇见占星符号还会发光。迷信者靠这些冰碎片，决定人生大事。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME produces a bright pink ice from its body that is rumored to track the movement of celestial bodies and glow when exposed to astrological symbols. Superstitious people rely on these shards of ice to make major life decisions.

entry: 满月升至中天时，POKENAME周围的冰片会发光。采集很困难，挖取时需要特殊防护服，防止冻伤。
author: quackquackattack
source: The shards of ice around POKENAME's body glow under the zenith of the full moon. Obtaining a POKENAME shard is difficult, as special suits are required to prevent frostbite when mining these shards.

entry: POKENAME头部由成分类似月岩的奇怪材料构成，由粉色金属身体托住。攻击无害地滑开，让头绕支轴旋转。
author: soup1900
source: The head of POKENAME is made of a strange material similar in composition to moon rock, held by a pink metallic body. Attacks roll harmlessly off it, causing its head to spin around the axis that supports it.

entry: POKENAME从群星之外降来，藏在孩子玩具间。抱着它睡，会梦见宇宙星空与遥远行星。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME descend from beyond the stars and hide themselves among children's toys. Those who sleep while holding a POKENAME dream of cosmic starscapes and distant planets.

entry: 古民间故事说，成群POKENAME用魔力将月亮托在天空，以歌声决定潮汐。但只被当作讲给孩子的睡前故事，从未真正有人相信。
author: beetlething
source: An old folktale states that groups of POKENAME hold up the moon in the sky with their magic powers, determining the tides with the songs they sing. However, this tale is only told to children as a bedtime story and has never truly been believed.

entry: POKENAME触手遇声会振动，越响抖得越猛烈。它觉得烦，因此只在夜间到海滩，那里只剩波浪冲刷声。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's tentacles vibrate when sounds collide with them, with more violent shakes the louder the sound is. Since the trembling is annoying to POKENAME, it only chooses to come onto beaches at night, where only the washing waves make a sound.

entry: POKENAME双翼始终映着星夜，闪星常令敌人着迷。据说，画面里若出现满月，就预示必胜。
author: sk372
source: The image of a starlit sky is always visible on POKENAME's wings, often mesmerizing foes with the twinkling of the stars. If the full moon becomes visible within the images, it's said a victory for POKENAME is assured.

entry: POKENAME产生的孢子一碰空气便闪亮。据说每颗都是夜空中能看见的新星，也许因此才产得极少。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME produce spores that sparkle when they make contact with the air. It is said that each spore is a new star that can be seen in the night sky, which may explain why they produce so few spores.

entry: POKENAME身体底部闪亮的粉尘能减轻重力，帮助爬上陡山。只有明亮月夜才生效，日光下粉尘转暗、失去力量。
author: soup1900
source: The shiny dust that sparkles at the bottom of POKENAME's body helps it climb up steep mountains by lowering its gravity. This strange power only activates on bright, moonlit nights; the dust dims and becomes powerless in the sunlight.

entry: POKENAME半透明晶体身体内，呈现太阳系某一瞬间的影像。天文学家相信，身体冷如深空虚无。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Within POKENAME's translucent crystalline body contains a snapshot image of the solar system. Astronomers believe its body is as cold as the void of deep space.

entry: POKENAME夜间轻跳旅行，将成分类似月尘的颗粒洒在地上。据说会拜访大地上月能汇聚之处，把各地连成庞大、玄奥的仪式。
author: vic1312
source: Dusting the ground with particles with a similar composition to moon dust, POKENAME skip lightly in their nightly travels. They are said to visit places where the moon's energies pool on the earth, connecting the sites in a vast, esoteric ritual.

entry: 满月时，POKENAME蘑菇极嫩，生出奶酪般的味道。许多厨师等这个时候，拿来做高级餐厅的三明治。
author: .izik
source: During full moons, POKENAME's mushroom becomes extremely tender and develops a cheese-like flavor. Many chefs wait for this time to use it in sandwiches served at top restaurants.

entry: 融合似乎唤醒皮可西潜藏的力量，赋予POKENAME独特外形。背翼多为摆设，它先用耀眼外貌震慑对手，再打出凶猛一拳。
author: kam_doodle_snek
source: Fusion appears to have awakened a dormant power within Clefable, giving POKENAME its unique appearance. The wings on its back are mostly for show; POKENAME stuns opponents with its dazzling appearance before striking with a fierce punch.

entry: POKENAME聚在满月下，伴着奇异宇宙能量照明，表演美丽芭蕾。舞蹈无论为何被打断，都会伴着纷飞落叶消失。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
