source: POKENAME gather beneath full moons to perform a beautiful ballet illuminated by an odd cosmic energy. If their dance is interrupted for any reason, they will disappear in a scattering of leaves.

entry: POKENAME头上的螺旋宝石在收藏家间价格高昂。它通常喜欢躲藏，却也能从宝石射出激光，抵抗偷猎者。
author: darkweavile428
source: The spiral gem in POKENAME's head fetches a high price from collectors. Though it usually prefers to hide, POKENAME can fire lasers from this gem to defend itself from poachers.

entry: POKENAME爱收各种大小的月之石，用宇宙力量让它们绕身旋转。常分一些给皮皮，帮助进化。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME love to collect Moon Stones of all sizes, using their cosmic power to make each stone orbit around them. They often give some of their collected stones to Clefairy to help them evolve.

entry: 野生POKENAME像雇佣兵，加入寻宝者的冒险。妖精般的敏捷轻松避过陷阱，再用杖火使其失效，最后拿取应得的一份。
author: ghostslythe
source: In the wild POKENAME acts like a mercenary, joining Treasure Hunters on their adventures. Using its fairy-like agility, it easily defeats traps, then uses its wand to disable them with flames. In the end, it takes its fair share.

entry: POKENAME挥舞月之石魔杖，引导神秘雾气。动作优雅，宛如指挥家。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME channels mystical mist by waving its moonstone wand. It swishes the wand with grace, much like a conductor.

entry: POKENAME靠泡沫气泡分散宝可梦注意，四处移动。月光注入气泡，使其闪闪发亮，便能趁机悄悄溜过。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME rely on their foamy bubbles to distract Pokémon as they move through the world. They infuse moonlight into these bubbles to make them sparkle and shine, giving them the opportunity to slip past undetected.

entry: POKENAME产生大量奇怪烟雾，看似满天繁星。虽然无毒，吸多了却可能产生身处太空的幻觉。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME generates copious amounts of a strange smoke that looks like a star-filled night sky. Though not toxic, inhaling too much may cause a person to experience hallucinations of being in space.

entry: 野生POKENAME整夜游走火山边缘，凝望月亮。满足时，呼出闪亮烟雾，附在火山，如一层星雾。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Wild POKENAME spend their nights roaming the edge of volcanoes, staring at the moon. Content POKENAME exhale sparkly smoke, which clings to the volcano as a starry haze.

entry: POKENAME被光吸引，尤其月光。会成群聚在月下，迅速振翅，抖落松鳞，光中如繁星闪烁。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are attracted to light, particularly moonlight. They will gather in groups beneath the moon, rapidly flapping their wings to shake off their loose scales, which sparkle in the light like stars.

entry: POKENAME攻击能打碎小型小行星。战斗时借月光悬浮，再落下，踢出强击。皮肤特性独特，让它也能在太空生存。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME's attacks have enough power to break through small asteroids. They battle by using the power of moonlight to levitate before dropping down, hitting a powerful kick. POKENAME can survive in space due to the unique properties of their skin.

entry: 月光与星光给POKENAME充能，促使它在夜空下跳舞。但太阳能量太猛烈，日照太久，可能跳到精疲力竭。
author: milchik
source: The light from the moon and stars fills POKENAME with energy, urging it to dance under the night sky. The sun, however, emits so much intense energy that POKENAME might dance itself to exhaustion if exposed to daylight for too long.

entry: 月夜里，POKENAME飘过天空，拖出阵阵粉光。日出时，漂浮能力神秘消退，便在地面休息。
author: .izik
source: During moonlit nights, POKENAME floats across the sky, trailing bursts of pink light. At sunrise, its ability to float mysteriously fades and it rests on the ground.

entry: POKENAME的发现，在相信皮可西一族来自太空的科学界中掀起波澜。满月之夜，会散发奇异宇宙气场。
author: sk372
source: The discovery of POKENAME has made waves among the scientific community that believes in the Clefable line having origins in space. On full moon nights, it radiates a strange cosmic aura.

entry: POKENAME挖过的土里，会出现微量月之石粉。个体越老，留下的浓度明显越高。
author: .izik
source: Trace amounts of Moon Stone dust appears in soil POKENAME digs through. Older individuals leave noticeably higher concentrations behind.

entry: 民间传说，新月时若POKENAME三颗头全眨眼，目击者便能享一整年财运。
author: .izik
source: Folklore claims that if all three of POKENAME's heads wink during a new moon, the witness will enjoy a year of financial luck.

entry: 夜空只要看得见月亮，POKENAME就会凝望，暂时摆脱白天的头痛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME stare at the moon whenever it is visible in the night sky. This practice momentarily rids them of the headaches that they get during the day.

entry: POKENAME耳朵敏锐，听心跳、呼吸的变化，就能察觉情绪。人们曾训练它帮助焦虑者，结果却适得其反，常攻击自己以为的忧虑来源。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME's ears are sensitive enough to sense people's mood, listening for changes in heart rate and breathing. Attempts to train them to help sufferers of anxiety backfired as they frequently attacked the perceived cause of the sufferer's worries.

entry: POKENAME毛茸茸的身体，夜间观星也能保暖。某些满月之夜，会嚎叫、吠叫，直到黎明。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have fuzzy bodies that keep them warm when they stargaze at night. On certain nights when the full moon is out, they howl and bark until dawn.

entry: POKENAME隐居，通常回避人类。听觉异常敏锐，一听见人靠近，往往远远逃开，去更僻静之处。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are reclusive Pokémon that typically shun human contact. Their hearing is exceptionally sensitive and, if they hear a person approaching, they are prone to fleeing vast distances to get somewhere more isolated.

entry: POKENAME隐居，通常回避人类。若被迫战斗，就使出强力喷射火焰，闪着诡异苍白月光。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are reclusive Pokémon that typically shun human contact. If forced into a fight, POKENAME will use powerful Flamethrowers that shimmer with eerie pale moonlight.

entry: POKENAME隐居，通常回避人类。研究者推测，更喜欢光污染少的荒野，方便追逐坠落陨石。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are reclusive Pokémon that typically shun human contact. Researchers theorise that they prefer to live in wilderness with low levels of light pollution, allowing them to more easily chase after falling meteorites.

entry: POKENAME隐居，通常回避人类。偷猎者想捕捉取毛，据说用这种毛制衣，穿上便能得好运。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are reclusive Pokémon that typically shun human contact. Poachers attempt to catch POKENAME in order to harvest their fur, which is said to grant good fortune to those who wear clothing made of it.

entry: POKENAME腹部旋纹缓缓转动，在黑暗闪亮。常见传说说，宇宙中也能找到这图案，但天文学家未能证实。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The spiral on POKENAME's stomach gradually spins, glittering in the dark as it does so. A common legend holds that the pattern can be found in the cosmos, though astronomers have been unable to confirm the story.

entry: POKENAME披风上的星星映出未知星座，其中仿佛出现流星雨时，精神力量便达巅峰。进化时使用的月之石碎片，如今成为主要武器，随月相呈现不同形态。
author: ghostslythe
source: The stars on POKENAME's cape reflect unknown constellations, and when it appears to have a meteor shower its psychic powers crescendo. The shard of Moonstone used in evolution has become its main weapon, now appearing in the phases of the Moon.

entry: 智慧、神秘的宝可梦，能力随月相变化。越近新月，精神能力越强；越近满月，妖精属性攻击越强。
author: deadshields
source: A wise and mystical Pokémon that wields different powers depending on the phase of the moon. When closer to a new moon, its psychic abilities are stronger, and as the full moon nears, it casts stronger Fairy-Type attacks.

entry: POKENAME夜间活动，花时间敲碎巨石，寻找闪亮宝石或怪样卵石。每只睡前都会先跳一小段舞，再躺下。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME are active during the night and spend their time breaking apart large stones to find shiny jewels or odd-looking pebbles. Before they go to sleep, all POKENAME do a small dance before lying down.

entry: POKENAME物理攻击强劲，是不折不扣的大力士。可在野外，它几乎不肯动用蛮力，因为一伤害别人，自己便难过。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME's physical attack is truly great, making it a powerhouse. However, it barely uses its strength in the wild, as it feels bad when it attacks.

entry: POKENAME壳上长着小翅膀。宝可梦研究者长期争论用途，主流观点是帮助改善游泳能力。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have tiny wings sprouting from their shell. Pokémon researchers have held long debates about the purpose of these structures, the leading theory is that they help improve POKENAME's ability to swim through water.

entry: POKENAME是群星旅人，常离开世界的海洋。许多太空望远镜曾看见，成群静静飘在月球周围。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME are travelers of the stars, often leaving the world's oceans. Many space telescopes have spotted groups of POKENAME quietly floating around the moon.

entry: POKENAME常向月亮扔石头，原因不明。虽然全力以赴，却从未有石头被记录到能飞过树顶。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME frequently attempts to throw stones at the moon for an unknown reason. Despite its best efforts, no stone has ever been recorded making it past the treetops.

entry: POKENAME尽可能收集月之石，按月相雕成独特形状。这些石头常被做成吊坠、传家宝。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME loves to collect as many Moon Stones as it can find, carving them into unique shapes depending on the phase of the moon. These stones are commonly made into pendants or heirlooms.

entry: 身体分析确认，材料与月之石相同。闪亮气场能操纵重力，让自己比原本轻得多。
author: .jerden
source: Analysis of its body determined that it is made out of the same substance as a Moon Stone. Its twinkling aura enables it to manipulate gravity, making it much lighter than it would otherwise be.

entry: 身体分析确认，材料与月之石相同。闪亮气场能操纵重力，让自己比原本轻得多。
author: .jerden
source: Analysis of its body determined that it is made out of the same substance as a Moon Stone. Its twinkling aura enables it to manipulate gravity, making it much lighter than it would otherwise be.

entry: 它们在地面小跑，用小翼帮助跃得更远。火焰有神奇镇静作用，敌人即使被热量烧灼，也会平静。
author: infinex21
source: They use their small wings to help them skip rather far as they trot along the land. Their flames have a mystifying effect of calming foes even as they are burned by the heat.

entry: 满月之夜，若有好几只POKENAME聚在一起，就可能彼此黏合，发生进化。
author: chorb33
source: If several POKENAME come together on the night of a full moon, they may stick together and evolve.

entry: 每逢月圆，许多POKENAME便聚上高原或山峰，尽可能吸收月光，加快进化。
author: chorb33
source: On full-moon nights, many POKENAME gather on plateaus or mountains to absorb as much moonlight as possible in order to accelerate their evolution.

entry: POKENAME三颗头整夜轮流仰月。太阳开始升起，便全钻进地里，仿佛要透过大地继续看。
author: santon5512
source: Each of POKENAME's three heads will take turns staring up at the moon throughout the night. Once the sun begins to rise, all three heads will plunge into the ground as if continuing to watch it through the earth.

entry: 满月时，POKENAME从冰水出来，与同类在岸上跳舞。游泳姿态近乎超凡优雅，在选美比赛备受珍视。
author: fiordaliso
source: During a full moon, POKENAME emerges from the icy waters and dances on the shore with other members of its species. When swimming, it moves with an almost ethereal grace, making it highly prized in beauty competitions.

entry: 据说，POKENAME黏糊糊身体中的任何毒素，都会在满月光下中和。凑巧，它也在满月夜出行，寻找伴侣。
author: bobosmith01
source: Supposedly, any toxins caught in POKENAME's gooey body become neutralized under the light of the full moon. Incidentally, POKENAME travel to find mates during nights of the full moon as well.

entry: 据说，POKENAME黏糊糊身体中的任何毒素，都会在满月光下中和。凑巧，它也在满月夜出行，寻找伴侣。
author: bobosmith01
source: Supposedly, any toxins caught in POKENAME's gooey body become neutralized under the light of the full moon. Incidentally, POKENAME travel to find mates during nights of the full moon as well.

entry: 满月当空，POKENAME小群聚集，一同朝月亮喷水。炮射水流汇合，反射月光，构成闪亮奇景。
author: sk372
source: When the full moon is out, POKENAME gather together in small droves and shoot water towards the moon in unison. The streams from their cannons merge and reflect the moonlight, creating a sparkling spectacle.

entry: POKENAME穿过虫洞，想找其他宝可梦共舞。跳舞时唱着诡异摇篮曲，只在满月夜现身。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME travels through wormholes, trying to find other Pokémon to dance with it. While it dances, it sings an eerie lullaby. It only appears on nights with a full moon.

entry: 星尘拖在POKENAME头后，头部据说由月岩组成。它翱翔夜空，吸收月光，化作可发射的小彗星。
author: santon5512
source: Stardust trails behind POKENAME's head, which is believed to be made of moonrock.   They will soar through the night sky, absorbing moonlight which forms into small comets that they can fire off.

entry: POKENAME夜间独自浮空，寻找有睡不安稳的人居住的社区。找到后，赐予人类或宝可梦安稳睡眠，再享用梦中的正面情绪。
author: quietcognition
source: At night, solitary POKENAME float through the sky in search of communities with restless people. If one finds what it is looking for, it will grant a gentle sleep to the humans or Pokémon and then feed off of the positive emotions in their dreams.

entry: POKENAME球状身体不断长出棉毛。太厚时，就会爆发能量，强行脱毛，绒絮四散。
author: sk372
source: A cottony fur constantly grows over POKENAME's orb-shaped body. When the fur grows too thick, POKENAME explodes with energy to forcefully shed, sending fluff everywhere.

entry: POKENAME用自身棉絮包住骨棒。一击便散成小云，刺激对手、引起过敏，让战斗更难发挥。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME covers the bone it wields with some of its own cottony fluff. One strike spreads it around in a small cloudburst, causing irritation and allergic reactions that make it harder for an opponent to fight properly.

entry: 这些宝可梦释放极甜、好闻的气体，常能传遍居住的田野。POKENAME爆炸后，会留下空中漂浮的棉球。
author: pokejirkaok
source: These Pokémon emit an incredibly sweet, pleasant-smelling gas that can often be smelled across the fields they inhabit. When POKENAME explodes, it leaves behind cotton balls floating through the air.

entry: POKENAME以仁善闻名，常照顾被猛烈风暴逼离家园的宝可梦，分出绒毛，给发抖的个体取暖。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME is known for its benevolent nature, often caring for Pokémon displaced by brutal windstorms. It shares its fluff with shivering individuals.

entry: POKENAME的棉花遇直射阳光，就会以惊人速度生长。不过，它很享受因此得到的私密感。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME's cotton grows at an alarming rate if exposed to direct sunlight. However, it does enjoy the feeling of privacy it gives.

entry: 野生POKENAME常飘在水边空中，用嘴呼气调整移动。也会吐棉孢子，但吐得太久，常会缓缓下降。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME often drift in the air near water, exhaling air through their mouths to help them direct their own movements. They can also spit cotton spores, though this will often cause them to slowly descend if they do so for too long.

entry: 身体周围的棉状物质压低附近声音，让它能完全无声地模仿其他生灵。这种诡异特征，让人难以察觉就在身边。
author: .izik
source: The cotton-like substance around its body muffles nearby sounds, allowing it to mimic others in complete silence. This eerie trait makes it difficult to tell when it is nearby.

entry: POKENAME每个体节都覆着柔软绒絮，能纺成衣物。但涂着腐蚀性毒液，必须洗很多次才能清掉。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have plush fluff covering each of their body segments. The fluff can be spun into garments, but is coated in a caustic venom that needs multiple washes to be cleaned away.

entry: POKENAME脱下的毛团保留少许变身能力，被它用来恶作剧。毛团变成日常物品，一被接触，就爆成花粉。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can shed clumps of fluff that retain a bit of its transforming capability, which it uses to prank humans. The clumps take the form of everyday objects, which burst into pollen when interacted with.

entry: POKENAME飘过城镇，寻找广播、电视信号。会停在屋顶，吸收这些频率，补充能量。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME drifts above towns seeking radio and television signals. It settles atop rooftops to absorb these frequencies and replenish its energy.

entry: POKENAME每个体节都覆着柔软绒絮，能纺成衣物。但涂着腐蚀性毒液，必须洗很多次才能清掉。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have plush fluff covering each of their body segments. The fluff can be spun into garments, but is coated in a caustic venom that needs multiple washes to be cleaned away.

entry: 野生POKENAME飞高寻找繁花田野，再俯冲其中，为蓬松鬃毛添花。极罕见时，整群的行为后果，会引起小型花粉风暴。
author: npshi
source: Wild POKENAME fly up high to find lush fields full of flowers before divebombing into them to add to their fluffy mane. In very rare circumstances a herd of these POKENAME will cause small pollen storms due to the aftermath of their behavior.

entry: POKENAME用身上绿球改变气候，帮助农民。为干田召来小雨、晴暖微风，乘自己棉絮的云，优雅巡视作物。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME assist farmers by using the green orbs on their bodies to alter the climate. They summon mild rains and sunny breezes over dry fields, drifting gracefully on clouds of their own fluffy cotton to patrol the crops.

entry: POKENAME爱从门底溜进民宅，四处散棉。逃路无论为何被堵，都能直接瞬移，因此几乎抓不到来追责。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME love to slip under doors to homes and spread their cotton everywhere. If for whatever reason their escape path is blocked, they can simply teleport away, making accountability nearly impossible.

entry: POKENAME夜巡森林，确保不失火。哪怕一点火星，就会拍动棉花般柔软的翅膀，召风立即吹灭。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME patrols the forest at night to ensure no fires break out. At the slightest spark, it flaps its cotton-soft wings to summon winds that extinguish it immediately.

entry: POKENAME轻盈的棉状身体，一点微风就能浮起。白天满脑子想恶作剧，晴夜却只想在树顶安静观星。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's lightweight cotton body floats on the slightest breeze. Although during the day they are filled with a desire to pull pranks on others, on clear nights they will only want to calmly stargaze from the tops of trees.

entry: 牧羊人带着POKENAME群，在草场之间迁徙。必须每日剪毛，防止过热。
author: quackquackattack
source: Shepherds travel with groups of POKENAME to migrate between grassy pastures. POKENAME need their fleece to be sheared daily to prevent them from overheating.

entry: POKENAME羽毛备受追捧，柔软如绒絮的绒羽，能做最精美的床。触感蓬松、保温又好，训练家常寻找这种融合体，代替睡袋。
author: blake
source: The plumage of a POKENAME is highly sought after. Its downy, fluff-like feathers make the most exquisite beds. Pokémon Trainers often seek this fusion out in lieu of a sleeping bag due to its plush feel and excellent insulation.

entry: POKENAME紧密卷曲的毛发，不容易引起过敏。聚群时，额头的宝石一齐发亮；当它们乘风飘浮，整群宛如一片繁星点点的夜空。
author: gloomymort
source: POKENAME's tight curls give their fur a hypoallergenic quality. When gathered in herds, the gems on their foreheads glow brightly. As they float on the wind, the herd looks like a starry night sky.

entry: 泥会刺激POKENAME长出棉状毛发的毛囊。常见它往身上抹泥，试着加快生长。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: The follicles that grow the cotton-like hair that sprouts on POKENAME are stimulated by mud. It is common to find POKENAME rubbing mud onto itself to try to speed up its growth.

entry: POKENAME更爱沼泽，身体浸在厚泥里小睡，只让极蓬松的生长物露出表面。其他生灵在上面休息，也似乎不介意。
author: craigprime
source: POKENAME prefers to live in marshes where it can submerge its body in thick mud to nap. This leaves its incredibly fluffy growth protruding above the surface, and it does not seem to mind other creatures resting on top.

entry: POKENAME吸取猎物的生命力，储存在颈边的种子里。它会追寻临终之人，将对方的生命力送回自然。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME draws out the life force from its victims and stores it in the seeds on its neck. It pursues people near their end to return their life force to nature.

entry: 它钻入地下，用自身毛簇铺窝。棉花保温，让巢穴成为野外最舒适的藏身处之一。
author: .izik
source: It burrows underground, using tufts of its own fur to line its den. The cotton retains warmth, making its nest one of the coziest hiding spots in the wild.

entry: POKENAME的棉是热门钩织材料，细丝能纺成奢华纱线。制成衣物，即使最冷的日子也暖，如沐阳光。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME cotton is a popular material to crochet with, the fine threads able to be spun into a luxurious yarn. Clothing made from their cotton keeps the wearer warm even on the coldest days, giving the feeling of being under the light of the sun.

entry: POKENAME在荆棘巢里养育幼崽，让它们长大后，懂得从各种圈套中解开缠住的棉花。
author: pattybgoode
source: POKENAME raises its young in a nest of briars so that they can learn to untangle their cotton from any kind of snare when they are older.

entry: POKENAME穿行网络空间，棉状毛发收进沿途数千行代码。看似随机，技术员仍在研究，为何偏爱某些代码。
author: .izik
source: While traveling through cyberspace, POKENAME's cotton-like hair fills with thousands of lines of code it collects along the way. The lines appear random, and technicians are still studying why it favors some over others.

entry: POKENAME振角，让中央球体抖落花粉般的绒絮。接触会严重过敏，阻止其他生灵猎捕、追逐。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME vibrates its antlers to loosen pollen-like fluff from the orbs in its centers. The fluff causes a severe allergic reaction in those who come into contact with it, dissuading others from hunting and pursuing POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME调皮，在空中旋转，四处散棉，再咯咯笑着溜走。
author: shyguy11011
source: POKENAME is a mischievous Pokémon that spins through the air, scattering cotton everywhere before giggling and slipping away.

entry: POKENAME仰躺大田，棉毛慢慢被风扯走。与温奶混合，能制成泥土风味的奶酪，通常售价低廉。
author: bigoljax
source: As POKENAME lays on its back in large fields, the cotton that makes up its hair gets slowly pulled off by the wind. If this cotton is mixed with warm milk, it can create an earthy cheese that's usually sold for a small price.

entry: 曾有偷猎团伙想取得POKENAME珍贵棉絮，做奢华大衣。但它高居最高树顶，根本够不到，偷猎者还不断被水果弄伤，计划很快告吹。
author: redmagecole
source: Once, a poaching ring attempted to obtain POKENAME's prized cotton fluff for luxury coats. This was quickly shut down when POKENAME proved impossible to reach in the tallest trees and poachers kept getting fruit-related injuries.

entry: POKENAME好奇心极强，细心掠过开阔田野，搜寻野花。把各类花粉揉进毛里，创造全新气味。
author: turron_turron
source: As highly curious Pokémon, POKENAME meticulously glide across open fields in search of wildflowers. They rub various types of pollen onto their fur to create brand-new smells.

entry: POKENAME偷田地、农场无人看守的种子，将赃物藏在身上绒絮里。举翼时抛出，种成小田，养育幼崽。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Stealing unattended seeds from fields and farms, POKENAME hide their ill-gotten gains in the fluff along their bodies. When they raise their wings, they fling out seeds to grow small crop fields to feed their young.

entry: POKENAME从掌心向旅人群发射压紧的大棉球。受害者眼睛不适、咳嗽不止，它趁机偷走看中的食物或小饰品。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME launches large balls of condensed cotton from its palms into groups of travelers. While the unfortunate victims suffer eye irritation and coughing fits, POKENAME swipes any food or trinkets it likes from them.

entry: POKENAME使用巨大电力时，棉花会燃烧、短暂发光。随后去除烧焦纤维，慢慢长回棉花。
author: wiz0z
source: When using their immense electrical power, POKENAME burn through their cotton, causing it to glow temporarily. Afterwards, POKENAME remove the burnt fibers and slowly regrow their cotton.

entry: POKENAME覆盖轻絮、细叶，方便借风。先用爪子爬高，再松开，以滑翔而非飞行，跨过长距离。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME coats itself in light fluff and fine leaves to help it catch the wind. It uses its claws to climb up high before releasing itself, gliding rather than flying across large distances.

entry: POKENAME让数据包钻进厚棉，被困在里面，再转入另一台电脑，撕下棉花放出，使下载改由新电脑接收。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME lets data packets run into its thick cotton fluff, trapping them inside. Then, it transfers into a different computer before tearing off its cotton to free the packets, causing the new computer to receive the download instead.

entry: POKENAME奔过田野，撒播棉花种子，是业余农人的热门伙伴。它们也喜欢嚼食棉枝，正好在重新播种时帮助清理田地。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME run through fields to scatter cotton seeds, making them popular companions for amateur farmers. They enjoy snacking on cotton branches, which helps clear the field when it's time for new seeds to be planted.

entry: POKENAME极护木棉球，捕食者靠近就藏进绒毛。记录过一种战法：猛抛绒毛中沾的泥，力道足以让敌人晕眩或昏倒。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are fiercely protective of Cottonee, often hiding them in their fluff when predators are nearby. One documented way that POKENAME fights enemies is to fling mud caught in its fluff with enough force to stun or render its foe unconscious.

entry: POKENAME乘风到处漂，停在被火毁坏的森林。以未知方法净化，植物迅速重生，直到大地复绿。据说羊毛比云还软。
author: ghostslythe
source: Carried about by the wind, POKENAME stops where forests are scarred from fires. By unknown means it purifies the area, the plants rapidly regrowing until the land is green again. It is said its wool is softer than clouds.

entry: POKENAME极少自行移动，满足于静静漂浮，任微风带往各处。棉絮摸着柔软、舒服，碰过却会有奇怪寒意穿过全身。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME rarely moves on its own, content with floating silently and going wherever the breeze carries it. Its cottony fluff is soft and pleasant to touch, but those who do so feel a strange chill run through their body afterward.

entry: POKENAME从楔石出来，会向附近爆出棉球。逃跑则乘气流，附身附近宝可梦，拖慢追者。
author: quackquackattack
source: When POKENAME emerge from their keystone, they burst the nearby area with balls of cotton. To flee, POKENAME ride air currents and possess nearby Pokémon to slow down their pursuer.

entry: POKENAME棉孢子团柔软、像垫子，深受家庭喜爱。但极怕强风、雨，驯养个体甚至可能逃回精灵球。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are beloved by families due to their extremely soft and cushiony masses of cotton spores. They are very scared of strong winds and rain, to the point a tamed POKENAME may flee into its Poké Ball.

entry: 大风天，POKENAME的棉会被吹走。光着身子时，明显更活跃。
author: musicsheep.
source: On windy days, the wind can blow POKENAME's cotton off its body. In its naked state, POKENAME is noticeably more active.

entry: 得有强风，POKENAME才会脱棉。满身棉时，懒得惊人。
author: musicsheep.
source: It takes strong winds to make POKENAME shed its cotton. While in its cottony state, POKENAME is extremely lazy.

entry: POKENAME外皮虽坚韧，颈、臂周围的棉却软如云。身边常有柔风，带着甜美春天气息。
author: jadey.1557
source: Despite having a tough exterior hide, the cotton around POKENAME's neck and arms is as soft as a cloud. A gentle breeze often manifests around POKENAME, carrying with it a sweet spring scent.

entry: POKENAME乘微风漂浮，身上棉花不断落下。有时黏住植物种子，落上软土便发芽。
author: chibitales
source: The cotton on POKENAME's body falls away as it floats along gentle winds. Plant seeds will sometimes get stuck in this cotton and sprout when it lands on soft soil.

entry: POKENAME头顶嫩芽生长，棉纤维便遍布全身。玉虹市裁缝采这些绒絮，制成耐用泳衣。
author: .izik
source: As the sprout atop POKENAME grows, cotton fibers flourish across its body. In Celadon City, tailors harvest this fluff to make durable swimwear.

entry: 每当想要飞行，它就先把棉絮聚在下半身，再撑着手杖纵身一跃，乘风向西而去。
author: skymaster426
source: Whenever it wishes to fly, it gathers cotton around its lower body before using its staff to make a big leap. Then it rides the wind, going west.

entry: POKENAME身轻如风，会偷偷钻进房屋的缝隙，吸走家中小宠物的生命力。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: As agile as the wind, POKENAME sneaks into the cracks of buildings to steal the life force of small household pets.

entry: POKENAME被墓园整齐树篱吸引，帮助维护环境。园艺师若赢得信任，就能得到随意修剪植物的好搭档。
author: vic1312
source: Attracted to manicured hedges within graveyards, POKENAME will contribute to the maintenance of the grounds. Landscapers who earn their trust are rewarded with a partner who can clip any plant material the landscaper desires.

entry: POKENAME是狡猾战斗家，为取胜不怕用阴招。招牌战术是切下部分棉絮，扔进敌人眼睛遮住视线，再趁虚打击。
author: sk372
source: A devious trickster in battle, POKENAME is unafraid to use dirty tactics to win its fights. Its signature technique is cutting parts of its cottony fluff away to throw into a foe's eyes and blind them, leaving them open for opportunistic strikes.

entry: 孩子山中迷路，POKENAME就会乘风来，帮忙引向安全。善举却适得其反：大又可爱、蓬松的外貌，让孩子故意迷路，只为见它。
author: redmagecole
source: When children get lost in the mountains, POKENAME will float by on the wind to help guide them to safety. These good deeds backfired, as its big, cute, and fluffy appearance has made children get lost on purpose just to meet a POKENAME.

entry: 这只狡猾的宝可梦，会藏在棉田里伪装自己。等到时机合适，就突然跳出来袭击。
author: holzycookie
source: This sneaky Pokémon is known to disguise itself in fields of cotton. When the time is right, it jumps out and strikes.

entry: 这种宝可梦住温带，冬季长厚棉状毛，抵御寒冷。人们说，用POKENAME毛填的枕头，噩梦更少，也睡得更好。
author: _pixelar_
source: This Pokémon lives in temperate climates and builds thick, cotton-like fur in winter to withstand colder temperatures. People report fewer nightmares and improved sleep quality when lying on pillows stuffed with POKENAME's fur.

entry: 地面被POKENAME花粉触及，就能受它控制，直到花粉散去。战斗中会释放大量花粉，操纵整个战场。
author: sk372
source: Ground touched by pollen shed from POKENAME's body becomes controllable by it until the pollen dissipates. It sheds copious amounts in combat so that it can control the entirety of the battlefield.

entry: POKENAME震耳的炮能吹出飓风级狂风，既能轰走威胁、弹丸，主要却向花田发射，把数以万计的花瓣和种子吹上天。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME's deafening cannon can blow hurricane-force winds. While this can be used to launch threats and projectiles away, POKENAME primarily fire on flower fields to scatter tens of thousands of petals and seeds skyward.

entry: POKENAME的棉絮软得连自己也抵挡不住，总想躺上去睡一觉。据说，收集POKENAME的棉花，是件轻松差事。
author: xenophacilus
source: The cotton from POKENAME is so soft that even it can't resist sleeping on its own fluff. Harvesting POKENAME's cotton is said to be an easy job.

entry: POKENAME快速振翅，不断产生花粉，飞行时扬起尘絮云。它爱飞近别人，朝脸猛吹粉尘，看对方咳嗽、呛气，恶作剧。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's rapidly-flapping wings generate pollen constantly, creating clouds of dusty fluff as it flies about. It pranks others by flying up to them and blowing much of this dust into their face to see them cough and sputter.

entry: POKENAME几乎没重量，空中机动却完全自如。乘风与自行飞行轻松切换，在天上几乎抓不到。
author: deniablecredibility
source: Despite weighing practically nothing, POKENAME has perfect control over its aerial mobility. It is easily able to shift from riding the wind and flying under its own power, making it nearly impossible to catch in the sky.

entry: POKENAME潜行民居，会藏在背上的枕头后。若挡攻击后破开，就收棉重新填好，尤其爱用风妖精掉落的棉球。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME hide behind the pillow on their back when sneaking around inside human homes. If it bursts open after blocking an attack, POKENAME will restuff the cushion by gathering cotton, preferring to use balls of it dropped by Whimsicott.

entry: POKENAME随旋风漂浮，翼上的棉不断断落、吹走。棉里含曾授粉花朵的花粉，飘进城市常引发过敏。
author: chibitales
source: As POKENAME floats along whirlwinds, cotton from its wings breaks off and blows away. The cotton contains pollen from flowers POKENAME pollinated and often causes allergy outbreaks when it floats through cities.

entry: 棉状翅膀让POKENAME只有强风才升空。散出的热令人舒服，许多训练家在地上抱着它。
author: ghostslythe
source: Due to its cottony wings, POKENAME only takes to the air on great gusts of wind. Many Trainers are found cuddling them on the ground due to the pleasant heat they give off.

entry: POKENAME常见于华丽大赛。众多蓬松尾巴若打理得好，宝可梦与训练家都引以为傲。台上爱玩、欢跳，急着取悦观众。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are a common sight at Pokémon contests, their many fluffy tails being a point of pride for both the Pokémon and their Trainer when properly groomed. They are playful on stage, prancing around and eager to impress the crowd.

entry: POKENAME偶尔向强烈想报复的人现身，潜进仇家住宅，用令人烦恼、但无害的恶作剧“实现复仇愿望”，直到双方和解才停止。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME occasionally appears to people with a strong desire to get even. POKENAME grants their wish for revenge by slipping into their enemy's home to pull frustrating but harmless pranks, continuing these until the two people reconcile.

entry: POKENAME丝滑的毛被纺成时髦、雅致的衣物。它享受拔毛的感觉，也爱仔细看设计师用毛做出的服装。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME produce silky smooth fur that is spun into trendy yet urbane clothing. They enjoy the sensation of having fur plucked from their bodies and love to examine the clothing that fashion designers make with their fur.

entry: 风大的日子，POKENAME离池升空。若飞过时有人评论外貌，就会进对方家，撒满棉球，再飞走。
author: dualblades1147
source: On windy days, POKENAME leaves its pond and floats through the sky. If a person ever comments on a POKENAME's appearance while it is flying by, it will go through their house and scatter balls of cotton before flying away.

entry: POKENAME能纺出品质绝佳的棉絮。工业时代，棉纺工厂曾十分依赖它。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME spins cotton of incredible quality. Cotton factories of the industrial era were heavily reliant of POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME爱捉弄其他宝可梦，常装成一团棉花，在田野间蹦跳嬉戏。
author: holzycookie
source: POKENAME likes to play tricks on other Pokémon. It often frolics around fields pretending to be a ball of cotton.

entry: POKENAME棉絮的柔软度，取决于饮食营养是否丰富。刺上的毒，也会因此更强。
author: chibitales
source: The softness of POKENAME's cotton fluff depends on how nutritionally rich its diet is. Consequently, the poison in its thorns becomes more potent.

entry: POKENAME像风滚草滚过世界，蓬松棉里积满泥、细枝。卡在灌木，就脱掉外层棉，继续滚。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME rolls through the world like a tumbleweed, collecting dirt and twigs in their fluffy cotton. If they get stuck on a shrub, they shed the outer part of their cotton to continue rolling.

entry: POKENAME每天最多产500磅丝，用多余丝包住身体。所居森林，从上到下都覆着厚丝。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME can produce up to 500 pounds of silk a day, using its excess silk to coat its body. Forests where it lives are coated head-to-toe in its thick silk.

entry: POKENAME几乎能无限期飘在空中，一次也不必振翅。成群时曾被误认为云。
author: deniablecredibility
source: POKENAME can drift through the air without a single flap of their wings nearly indefinitely. Flocks of this Pokémon have been mistaken for clouds.

entry: POKENAME乘夜风巡视棉田，咬下植株上的棉。可惜，牙缝若卡太多棉，就会重得飞不起来。
author: soup1900
source: Riding along the night winds, POKENAME goes around cotton fields to bite off cotton from the plants. Unfortunately, if POKENAME gets too much cotton stuck in its teeth, it will become too heavy to fly.

entry: POKENAME一孵化就被饲养产棉，每天从獠牙抽取毒液，防止棉花留下污渍。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are raised to produce cotton from the moment they leave their egg. Their venom is extracted from their fangs every day to prevent stains in the cotton.

entry: POKENAME蓬松棉衣能抵御寒冷。但一湿透，就冷得直发抖。
author: hophoppip
source: Its fluffy cotton coat keeps it insulated from cold weather. However, the moment its coat gets wet, POKENAME is left chilly and shivering.

entry: 长时间晒太阳会让它们精神充沛，绒球中的酢浆草也更易开花。训练家伤心，就挥动绒球，想逗对方开心。
author: quackquackattack
source: They get energized when exposed to sunlight for long periods, which helps the oxalis in their pompoms blossom. They wave these pompoms whenever their Trainer is sad in the hopes of cheering them up.

entry: POKENAME跳舞时常被风带走，在空中散棉。棉越蓬松、越轻，身体就越健康。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are often carried off by the wind as they dance, scattering cotton through the air. The fluffier and lighter their cotton is, the healthier these Pokémon are.

entry: 人们猜测POKENAME是获得生命的堆肥堆。它乘风漂游时，会朝下撒落腐烂的植物残屑，似乎觉得这恶作剧十分有趣。
author: wormspawn
source: Presumed to be a compost heap given life, POKENAME scatters decaying plant material beneath it as it rides the wind. It seems to think this is a funny joke.

entry: 厚厚的下部棉层里，细根构成神经系统。头顶棉花不断长，必须定期拔下，常被用来给迷路宝可梦、旅人留标记。
author: infinex21
source: Beneath their thick, lower cotton are slender roots that make up their nervous systems. They must routinely pluck the ever-growing cotton upon their heads, which they often use to leave markers for lost Pokémon and travelers alike.

entry: POKENAME自由随性，风往哪吹，就去哪。棉状羽毛不断脱落，数百年来被收集制成织物。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME are free-spirited, going wherever the wind takes them. They constantly shed their cotton feathers, which have been collected to make fabrics for hundreds of years.

entry: POKENAME曾在寺庙中沉睡多年，无人发觉。毛发长得太长，终于被收服后，还得先剪个发。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME slept undiscovered in a temple for many years. Its hair grew so long that it had to have a haircut after it was finally caught.

entry: POKENAME绒毛有花香，是热门制衣、织物材料。它常参与纺织业，开心帮忙做新衣。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME's fluff has a floral scent that makes it a popular material for clothing and fabrics. They often play a role in the textile industry, happily offering their services to help make new clothes.

entry: POKENAME身后绒毛是过多填充物形成的软垫。许多幼童爱像枕头般靠着，柔软舒适。
author: sk372
source: The fluff behind POKENAME is excessive amounts of stuffing that has formed into a soft cushion behind it. Many young children enjoy resting against the plush softness like a pillow.

entry: POKENAME住在无遮蔽的山地草原，挖薄土找食物。强风吹过，就用爪子紧抓巨石，免得被吹走。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME live on exposed mountain grasslands, digging through the thin soil in search of food. When strong winds blow through, they clutch tightly to boulders with their claws to keep themselves from being blown away.

entry: 据说，史上记录最高的农业收成，发生在一个夏季：POKENAME满月下现身，强光照过大地作物。
author: frokachu
source: It is said that the greatest agricultural yield ever recorded happened during a summer a POKENAME appeared under a full moon, shining a bright light over the crops across the land.

entry: POKENAME住在无遮蔽的山地草原，挖薄土找食物。强风吹过，就紧抓巨石、抖动身体，让种子随风散开。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME live on exposed mountain grasslands, digging through the thin soil in search of food. When strong winds blow through, they clutch tightly to boulders and shake their body, releasing their seeds into the breeze.

entry: POKENAME住在无遮蔽的山地草原，挖薄土找食物。蓬松蘑菇是热门炖菜原料，表面善吸水，能吸满周围汤汁的滋味。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME live on exposed mountain grasslands, digging through the thin soil in search of food. Their fluffy mushrooms are a popular ingredient in many stews, the absorbent surface allowing it to soak in the flavour of the liquid around it.

entry: POKENAME身体由背上的马勃菌控制。一点微风就散出蓬松白孢子，强风则全吹走，让背部裸露，直到重新长回。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's body is controlled by a puffball mushroom on its back. The slightest breeze causes this fungus to scatter fluffy white spores into the air, and in strong winds they will all be blown away, leaving POKENAME's back exposed until they regrow.

entry: POKENAME受威胁，疯狂挥动手脚。看似跳舞，其实想显得更大、更凶，吓退捕食者。
author: wiz0z
source: When feeling threatened, POKENAME swing their arms and legs frantically. While this can be mistaken for dancing, POKENAME are actually attempting to frighten off any predators by appearing bigger and fiercer.

entry: POKENAME挥木杖，引导咩利羊、毛辫羊群安全远离捕食者。强大精神能力，也能随意移动叶片、植物。
author: fiordaliso
source: By waving its wooden staff, POKENAME guides groups of Mareep and Wooloo to safety, keeping them away from predators. Thanks to its powerful psychic abilities, it can move leaves and plants at will.

entry: 它们按季节迁往间歇泉，吸收喷发带来的热与富含矿物的水。喜欢当地高温，常在附近过热的泉水里休息。
author: quackquackattack
source: They migrate to geysers on a seasonal basis to soak in heat and mineral-infused water from the eruptions that occur. They enjoy the hot temperatures of the area and are known to rest in the superheated waters nearby.

entry: POKENAME翅膀几乎无重，能随风滑翔数英里。不断落下的棉絮黏住附近一切，让训练家觉得很烦。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME's wings are practically weightless, allowing them to glide with the wind for miles. Their wings constantly shed tufts of cotton, which cling to anything nearby, making them a nuisance for Trainers.

entry: POKENAME夜间游街，在屋里留棉球，制造恶作剧。诡异的歌声，能让人认出。
author: raydrago
source: POKENAME wanders the streets at night and causes mischief by leaving balls of cotton in homes. A person can identify it by its eerie singing.

entry: POKENAME将大量水存进头顶棉花，会在池里泡数小时，因为干透可能致命。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME stores large amounts of water in the cotton on its head. It submerges itself in ponds for hours, as drying out can prove fatal.

entry: 棉衣很易燃，因此它会主动点燃，威吓敌人。为此，鳞片也变得耐烧。
author: mistymagius
source: Its cotton coat is very flammable, so it will ignite its coat as an intimidation tactic. Because of this, its scales have become resistant to being burned.

entry: POKENAME额头硬币接收空气振动，精准找到猎物。虽然外表甜美，却会趁人分神抓伤。
author: karmaofevil
source: The coin on POKENAME's forehead picks up vibrations from air to precisely spot prey. Despite its sweet appearance, it's known for scratching people when they're distracted.

entry: POKENAME的棉被做成软垫，给饱受头痛的人用。棉能吸收精神力量，靠近头部便会吸走精神痛楚。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME cotton is used to make cushions for people who struggle with headaches. Their cotton has psychically absorbent properties, leeching away mental pain when close to a person's head.

entry: POKENAME的棉被做成软垫，给饱受头痛的人用。棉能吸收精神力量，靠近头部便会吸走精神痛楚。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME cotton is used to make cushions for people who struggle with headaches. Their cotton has psychically absorbent properties, leeching away mental pain when close to a person's head.

entry: 谁敢弄乱POKENAME棉状鬃毛，就会大怒，向四面八方胡乱挥拳。它需要极清洁空气才能生存，见到就表示森林十分健康。
author: fiordaliso
source: If anyone dares ruffle its cotton-like mane, POKENAME flies into a rage and begins punching wildly in every direction. Seeing one is a sign that the forest is extremely healthy, as it needs very clean air to survive.

entry: POKENAME常被用于放牧咩利羊与毛辫羊。研究显示，它不喜欢住在高度城市化的地区。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are often used to herd flocks of Mareep and Wooloo. Studies have shown that they do not like living in heavy urban areas.

entry: POKENAME成为和平文化运动的象征，在合众走红。虽然偏好和平，却能迅速制服威胁和平者。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME rose to popularity in Unova as they were used as a symbol for a peaceful cultural movement. Though it prefers to be pacifistic, POKENAME can quickly subdue anyone who threatens the peace.

entry: POKENAME在喉后特殊器官形成小棉球，再从嘴里射出。有时朝上射，再接回来，当作游戏。
author: mr.bonesii
source: POKENAME forms small balls of cotton in a special organ at the back of its throat, which it can then shoot out of its mouth. Sometimes it shoots one up and catches it again as a form of play.

entry: POKENAME能钻门底，在屋里到处散棉球，是特别烦的恶作剧高手。但会吃塑料，转成可生物降解的棉絮，因此得到容忍。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are particularly annoying pranksters because they can slide under doors to spread balls of cotton everywhere. They are tolerated because they eat plastic, converting it into biodegradable cotton fluff.

entry: POKENAME大身体由棉絮与压紧泥土组成。难以钻穿洞壁，便满足于游历温暖地区，探索各式棉纺厂。
author: redmagecole
source: POKENAME's large body is made of cotton fluff and tightly-packed dirt. Due to difficulties tunneling through cavern walls, POKENAME contents itself with traveling warm climates and exploring various cotton mills.

entry: 夜里遇见疲惫的训练家，POKENAME就会热心帮忙：先用棉絮铺好软床，再施以催眠，让人安然入睡。
author: holzycookie
source: POKENAME likes to help any weary Trainers it finds throughout the night. It makes soft beds out of cotton, and hypnotises Trainers to help them sleep.

entry: POKENAME用轻软的棉吸水，尽量装满自己搬得动的水量，再送往干田。炮口尽量喷遍土地，维持繁茂生长。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME use their light and fluffy cotton to gather water, soaking up as much as they're able to carry. They take the water to dry fields, using their cannons to spray as much of the land as possible and keep the area lush and growing.

entry: POKENAME能察觉超过30英里外的猎物宝可梦，游水、钻地追猎。猛烈咬碎，甚至能撕开金属。
author: npshi
source: POKENAME can detect prey Pokémon from over 30 miles away, being able to swim through water and drill through the ground to hunt them. POKENAME are capable of tearing through metal with their ferocious Crunch attack.

entry: POKENAME目光极锐，数英里外的闪亮物品也看得见。为收硬币不择手段，包括偷窃、恐吓，再放进透明屏障后保管。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME has incredibly sharp eyesight, and can spot shiny objects glinting from miles away. It gathers coins by any means, including theft and intimidation, and places them behind transparent barriers for safekeeping.

entry: POKENAME用默剧能力捉弄其他表演者，常假装挖洞，在台上造出绊人的坑。没人重伤，它似乎只为娱乐观众。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME uses its powers of mime to prank other performers, and often pantomimes digging a hole to create pit trips on stage. Nobody is seriously harmed by this, and it seems POKENAME only does it for the entertainment of audiences.

entry: POKENAME有点执着于让别人觉得帅，步伐刻意夸张，神气十足。谁诋毁它自认的帅气，就会愤怒、尖刻地回敬。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME seems a bit obsessed with appearing cool to others, waltzing around with an exaggerated swagger to its step. It responds to defamation of its supposed coolness with fiery vitriol.

entry: POKENAME锐眼能看见超过30英里外的猎物，无声钻向目标，从下方伏击。被抓走的宝可梦，再也没被看见。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Capable of seeing prey from over 30 miles away with its keen sight, POKENAME will silently burrow toward its prey and ambush them from below. A Pokémon snatched up by POKENAME is never seen again.

entry: POKENAME攀在大岩蛇挖出的隧道顶，等猎物靠近，再突袭，以惊人力道咬住。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME clings to the ceiling of the tunnels made by Onix, waiting for prey to wander close. It then ambushes them, biting down with incredible force.

entry: POKENAME努力保持冷淡、潇洒的态度。强大静电让尖毛竖起，更添威吓气势。
author: t3isukone
source: POKENAME tries to always keep up an aloof and cool attitude, adding to its intimidating presence with the powerful static charge that keeps its spiky fur on end.

entry: POKENAME藏沙狩猎，猎物靠近就将沙加热到极高温。每只花纹都不同，但眼前都有同样的黑横纹。
author: jodue
source: POKENAME hunts by hiding in the sand and superheating it when prey comes near. All POKENAME have individual markings, but they all share the same black stripe over the eyes.

entry: POKENAME能看清自己振翅掀起的沙暴，再用巨颚俯冲猎物。曾与入侵领地的化石翼龙战斗。
author: kokoria_
source: POKENAME can see clearly in the sandstorms it kicks up with its wings and dives at prey with its massive jaws. It was known to battle Aerodactyl that intruded on its territory.

entry: POKENAME既疯狂，又残酷。一旦追逐什么，就不顾一切，毁掉沿途所有东西，不分敌友。
author: frokachu
source: POKENAME is just as maniacal as it is cruel. When it's after something, it will stop at nothing, destroying all in its path, be it ally or foe.

entry: POKENAME相当温顺，想保存体内巨量能量。望远镜般的双眼能提前发现挑战者，未等靠近，就迅速蜿蜒离开。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME are quite docile, seeking to preserve the massive amounts of energy stored within their bodies. They use their binocular-like eyes to spot any Pokémon that would challenge them before they get near, quickly slithering out of reach.

entry: POKENAME飘过沙漠，寻找挤满暴走族的酒吧。趁无人看见，偷辆摩托车，无声无息开走。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME float around the desert, looking for packed bars filled with Bikers. When nobody is looking, POKENAME steals a motorcycle and drives off without anyone noticing.

entry: POKENAME制造绿洲，藏进沙中捕猎。据传，即使是结伴穿越沙漠的大队人马，靠近这样的绿洲也会失踪。
author: markusknight
source: POKENAME creates water oases and hides in sand to catch their prey. Rumors say that even big groups of people in the desert go missing when approaching such oases.

entry: POKENAME在沙漠挖出迷宫般隧道，地表许多洞口巧妙隐藏，便于跳出抓猎物。但隧道在沙中，一次失足，就可能全网坍塌。
author: imaginita
source: POKENAME digs a mazelike series of tunnels through the desert, with many a cleverly hidden hole on the surface to leap out of and snatch its prey. Because the tunnels are dug through sand, a single misstep can cause the entire system to collapse.

entry: POKENAME喉咙产生凝胶，帮助把沙装进嘴，再送入独立的胃状器官。吸出水分后，沙再被咳出，让它能在少有生灵涉足的地区生存。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME produces a gel in its throat that allows it to scoop up sand in its mouth that then goes to a separate stomach-like organ. Here it extracts any moisture before coughing it back up, allowing it to survive in areas few others venture.

entry: POKENAME喉咙产生凝胶，帮助把沙装进嘴，再送入独立的胃状器官。吸出水分后，沙再被咳出，让它能在少有生灵涉足的地区生存。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME produces a gel in its throat that allows it to scoop up sand in its mouth that then goes to a separate stomach-like organ. Here it extracts any moisture before coughing it back up, allowing it to survive in areas few others venture.

entry: POKENAME虽然神情凶猛，性情却很和平。偏爱在流沙坑游泳，避开捕食者。
author: santon5512
source: Despite their ferocious demeanor, POKENAME are quite peaceful Pokémon. They prefer to swim in pits of quicksand, keeping them safe from predators.

entry: POKENAME总想打架，用连番嘲讽、讥笑，怂恿经过的宝可梦攻击。每次受伤都让它开心，因为有了全力反击的借口。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is always itching for a fight, goading any passing Pokémon into striking it with numerous taunts and jeers. It revels in using any damage it receives as an excuse to hit back with all its might.

entry: 稀少的POKENAME住沙漠深处，是无情、顽固的捕食者，无论胜算都不退战。若因无法控制的理由被迫逃走，就用背翼扬起沙。
author: bobosmith01
source: The rare POKENAME lives deep in the desert. It is a ruthless and stubborn predator that never backs down from a fight, no matter the odds. If it is forced to flee for reasons out of its control, it will kick up sand with the wings on its back.

entry: 稀少的POKENAME住沙漠深处，是无情、顽固的捕食者，无论胜算都不退战。若因无法控制的理由被迫逃走，就用背翼扬起沙。
author: bobosmith01
source: The rare POKENAME lives deep in the desert. It is a ruthless and stubborn predator that never backs down from a fight, no matter the odds. If it is forced to flee for reasons out of its control, it will kick up sand with the wings on its back.

entry: 两帮POKENAME相遇，各派出飞机头最出众的代表。双方绕圈，想冻住对方发型，或弄满沙。
author: ghostslythe
source: When two gangs of POKENAME meet, each sends out a champion with the most impressive pompadour. They circle, attempting to either freeze or get sand in the foe's hairstyle.

entry: 这种宝可梦以暴躁易怒、破坏力强而出名。虽行事鲁莽，却是维系当地生态的重要一员。
author: rawthorn
source: A Pokémon known for its quick temper and destructive capabilities. Although they are rash, they are vital in protecting their surrounding ecosystems.

entry: 这种宝可梦进食时，消化不了的一切都会进入尾袋。窃贼利用这点，把赃钞、贵重珠宝扔进POKENAME嘴里，搬运更快、更方便。
author: milchik
source: As this Pokémon eats, anything that can't be digested ends up in its tail bag. Burglars use this to their advantage, throwing stolen banknotes and precious jewelry into POKENAME's mouth for quicker and easier carrying.

entry: POKENAME很受运动迷、运动员欢迎。身体极柔韧，能脱开颚关节，蜷成很小的球，训练家常拿它进行运动。
author: thesilverowls
source: POKENAME are a very popular Pokémon for sports fans and players alike. They're incredibly flexible, able to unhinge their jaw and curl up into a very small ball, which Trainers will often use to play sports with.

entry: POKENAME想装得强大、凶狠，却常被更年长、更大的宝可梦吓服，尤其顿甲。即便如此，对战仍尽力威吓敌人。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME tries to act all big and bad, but older and larger Pokémon tend to intimidate it back into submission, especially Donphan. Still, in battles, it does its best to intimidate foes.

entry: POKENAME战斗时猛冲敌人，将其撞飞。眼膜保护它免受烈日伤害。
author: mepp.
source: When in battle, POKENAME barrels into foes to send them flying. The membrane covering its eyes protects it from harsh sunlight.

entry: 这种宝可梦游荡人潮密集处，却只在人少时现身，偷偷绘画。POKENAME练习涂鸦，要让之后每个人都看见作品。
author: jangodiot
source: This Pokémon roams places with heavy foot traffic but only appears when few people are around, secretly painting. POKENAME practice their graffiti where everyone can later see their work.

entry: POKENAME虽小，性情却好斗、无畏。会与梦歌仙人掌一起狩猎，用敏感吻部察觉虚弱猎物的动作。
author: mepp.
source: Despite POKENAME's small size, it has an aggressive and fearless nature. It has been known to hunt alongside Cacturne, using its sensitive snout to sense the movement of weakened prey.

entry: POKENAME带领由黑眼鳄、混混鳄分别与黑暗鸦一族融合而成的伙伴结队觅食。身上分泌的特殊液体，能防止沙粒钻入羽毛。
author: skymaster426
source: POKENAME leads packs of Sandikrow and Krokokrow to hunt for food. It secretes a special fluid that keeps sand out of its feathers.

entry: POKENAME磁力如诱饵，引电属性宝可梦深入尘云。舒缓磁脉冲让猎物放松警惕，一靠近，就以强力咬击袭击。
author: tisgabe
source: The magnetism emitted by POKENAME acts as a lure, guiding electric types deep into the shrouds of dust clouds. When prey draws near, the comforting magnetic pulse lowering it's defenses, it strikes with a crushing bite.

entry: POKENAME整夜在沙漠游动，如在水中。角感知体热，追踪沙丘下藏的猎物。
author: .izik
source: All night, POKENAME swims through desert sands as if they were water. Its horn detects body heat, letting it track prey hidden below the dunes.

entry: POKENAME特别烦躁时，盘尾会展开、散开。眼中充满难以在电磁频谱上界定的电能。这让它能看见别的宝可梦看不见的事物，也能忽略别的宝可梦不会忽略的事物。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's coiled tail unwinds and splays if POKENAME is particularly upset. Its eyes are filled with electrical energy that cannot be easily defined on the electromagnetic spectrum, allowing it to see or overlook things other Pokémon do not.

entry: POKENAME很骄傲，不给报酬或礼物，就拒绝帮忙。矿工会用碎宝石贿赂，换它工作。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are prideful Pokémon, and refuse to help others without some sort of reward or gift. Miners are known to give broken gem pieces to bribe POKENAME into working.

entry: 即使猎物在30多英里外，POKENAME也能发现，随即俯冲而下，用强健的大颚将其咬碎。
author: darkweavile428
source: When POKENAME spots prey, even at a distance of over 30 miles, it swoops down on them and crushes them with its powerful jaws.

entry: POKENAME与矿工一起挖宝石，互有所求。矿工往铁锈色身体喷药水，它则帮忙将矿道向地下延长。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME dig gems alongside miners in a mutual interest to excavate gems. Miners spray potions onto their rust-colored bodies and in return they help miners extend mineshafts farther below the surface.

entry: POKENAME的眼睛适应力极强，能看透浑水、黑暗，远远察觉猎物，甚至看见热迹与恐惧。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME's eyes are extremely well adapted. They can see through murky water, in the dark, and detect prey from long distances. They can even see heat signatures and fear.

entry: POKENAME成帮游城，个个想做群中最酷的宝可梦。靠共情感知，寻找容易被态度打动的人，想以耍帅换食物。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME rove in gangs through cities, each striving to look like the coolest Pokémon in their group. They use their empathic sense to find people likely to be impressed by their attitude, attempting to get food in exchange for impressing the person.

entry: POKENAME亲近缺乏自信的孩子。训练家被骚扰，就发射猛烈幻象光线，吓退骚扰者。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME gravitate towards children who are in need of confidence. When their Trainers are harassed, POKENAME unleashes an intense Psybeam to scare them off.

entry: POKENAME天性随和，从不挑起冲突。帮派中，姿势最酷、墨镜最帅的就是首领。
author: jackjirachi
source: POKENAME are easygoing in nature; they never start conflicts. In gangs, the one with the coolest pose and sharpest shades is the leader.

entry: POKENAME成帮穿行沙漠城镇，太阳镜抵御沙暴。训练家别报名字，否则会被迫加入帮派。
author: ghostslythe
source: POKENAME moves in gangs between desert towns, its sunglasses providing protection against sandstorms. Trainers should not tell it their names or they will be forced to be part of the gang.

entry: POKENAME很会混入人类与其他宝可梦中，邪恶组织、各类机构都争相寻求。它几乎无法贿赂，但善良训练家有时能劝其放下可疑勾当。
author: thesilverowls
source: POKENAME excel at blending in both with humans and other Pokémon, making them highly sought after by evil teams and agencies alike. They are nearly impossible to bribe, though a kind Trainer can sometimes pull them away from doing dubious deeds.

entry: 有些高端企业会用POKENAME当保镖，也做其他工作。它带着专业的克制，尽职服从命令，无论多么粗暴。
author: sk372
source: High-level businesses have been known to use POKENAME as bodyguards among other roles. It dutifully follows the orders it has been given, no matter how brutish, with a professional stoicism.

entry: POKENAME潜沙狩猎，用精神力量探测目标。伏击时，巨爪与巨颚吞食富金属的猎物。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME submerges itself in sand to hunt, using psychic powers to detect prey. When it ambushes, it uses its massive claws and jaws to consume metal-rich targets.

entry: POKENAME四颗大脑精密计算，预判、稍稍扭曲未来时刻。训练家说，能让战斗前移几秒，攻击未出便已躲过。凝视精准得令人不安。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME have four brains that run precise calculations, letting them predict and slightly distort future moments. Trainers say they can shift battles a few seconds ahead, dodging attacks before they are made. Their stare is unsettlingly precise.

entry: 一入夜，POKENAME便游荡沙漠找猎物。击败敌人后，通过影子吞食生命力。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME wanders deserts searching for prey the moment night falls. Once it defeats a foe, it consumes their life force through their shadow.

entry: POKENAME即使以音速飞行，仍能远远发现猎物。鳞片让它在沙暴中顺畅飞行，不断游荡，直到找到目标。
author: soup1900
source: Even while flying at sonic speeds, POKENAME can still spot prey from large distances. Its scales allow it to fly smoothly inside of sandstorms, where it roams around until it spots its prey.

entry: POKENAME头上的巨口有自己的调皮心思，一有机会就拖身体去惹麻烦。不过，身体似乎也没太想阻止。
author: thegreenscorpion
source: The giant maw on POKENAME's head has a mischief-making mind of its own, often dragging the body towards trouble at every opportunity. That being said, the body doesn't seem too interested in stopping the head from wreaking havoc.

entry: POKENAME大多住洞窟，外出也能迅速适应阳光，第二对薄眼睑在地上始终闭着。撞头时，还能防止眼球弹出。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME lives mostly in caves, but if it needs to venture out it can quickly adapt to sunlight, as it has a second pair of thin eyelids that remain closed above ground. They also prevent its eyes from popping out when it headbutts.

entry: POKENAME察觉沙暴、地震等灾害将至，却主动找过去，伏击混乱中毫无防备的宝可梦。双颚咬住，再施展招牌死亡翻滚。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME can sense impending disasters like sandstorms and earthquakes. It seeks out these locations to ambush Pokémon caught unawares in the chaos, chomp them with their jaws, and twist them in a signature death roll.

entry: POKENAME是坚持不懈的优秀猎手，能发现100英里外的白海狮群。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME are persistent and excellent hunters. They're able to spot pods of Dewgong from distances of 100 miles away.

entry: POKENAME易怒，背一被踩就疯狂攻击。外表虽吓人，作为可动玩偶、海滩玩具，却很受孩子欢迎。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME are easily enraged, lashing out wildly when something steps on their backs. Despite their intimidating appearance, they are popular among children in the form of action figures and beach toys.

entry: POKENAME在沙里等猎物太久，有些宝可梦会在沙暴时寄居背上。最爱的猎物一靠太近，就被强颚夹住。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME spend so much time waiting for prey in the sands that some Pokémon take residency on their backs during sandstorms. When POKENAME's preferred prey wander too close, they clamp down on them with their strong jaws.

entry: POKENAME极速游过沙层，露头时用沙冠藏住模样。是凶狠猎手，追上穿山鼠，再用强颚撕开壳。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME can swim through sand at incredible speeds, using their crown of sand to conceal their appearance once surfaced. They are vicious hunters, chasing down Sandshrew before tearing through their shells with their powerful jaws.

entry: 据说POKENAME曾被一位传奇大盗使用。如今它在自己的沙漠领地伏击闯入者，令人闻之生畏。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: Thought to once be wielded by a legendary bandit, POKENAME terrorizes its territory of the desert by ambushing trespassers.

entry: POKENAME身体如刀刃，像老练骑士般守卫沙丘家园，宽幅斩击优雅、精准。
author: .izik
source: With a blade-like body, POKENAME guards its sand dune home like a seasoned knight. It performs sweeping slashes with elegant precision.

entry: POKENAME夜游沙漠，数只成群找猎物。旅人扎营要特别小心，一次雷电牙，便能让成年人麻痹。
author: qinshanu
source: POKENAME prowl the desert nights in prides of several individuals, searching for prey. Desert travelers must take extra care when setting up camp because a single Thunder Fang from POKENAME can paralyze a grown adult.

entry: POKENAME独占整座山，扩大眼睛的观察范围，时刻留意家园。谁侵犯，就用颚夹住，再扭身造成巨大伤害。
author: darkweavile428
source: POKENAME claims an entire mountain as its territory, and will expand the focus of its eyes to keep tabs on its home at all times. It will use its jaws to clamp down on anyone who violates its home and then twists its body to cause massive damage.

entry: POKENAME凶狠捕猎，飞行时掀起大沙暴藏身。借掩护扑向不备猎物，用强颚夹牢，无法逃脱。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are vicious predators, kicking up massive sandstorms as they fly in order to conceal themselves. From this cover, they pounce on unsuspecting prey, grabbing them with their powerful jaws so that they can't escape.

entry: POKENAME穿行沙漠，只把眼与鼻孔露在地上，不断寻新猎物。破沙而出时，触须缠住目标，强颚随即咬下。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME travels through desert sand with its eyes and nostrils above ground, constantly searching for new prey. It uses its feelers to ensnare its targets as it breaches the sand and clamps its powerful jaws down upon them.

entry: POKENAME突出的吻部本身就是强力武器，能击倒粗树，或将巨石远远抛走。也常这样展示，打动配偶。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's snout is one of its most prominent features, and a powerful weapon in its own right. With its strength, it can fell a thick tree or toss a large boulder a vast distance away. These displays are also common tactics to impress a mate.

entry: POKENAME爪子由极坚固的钨组成，既轻易斩敌，也能格开攻击。措手不及时，就从嘴喷沙，扰乱敌人。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's claws are made of an incredibly sturdy tungsten that allows it to deflect attacks as readily as it slices foes. If caught off guard, it sprays sand from its mouth to disorient the enemy.

entry: POKENAME故作强硬，命令幼小的宝可梦听自己使唤。可一旦对方的父母前来保护孩子，它就只会逃跑。
author: dusknoir64
source: POKENAME put on a tough act and command baby Pokémon to do what they say. However, it will resort to fleeing if the parents come to protect the young.

entry: POKENAME恶意把棉花抛向风，让其打中猎物的脸、遮眼。随后飘过去，假装帮忙擦掉，最后却突然咬向头。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME maliciously throws cotton at the wind so it can hit prey in the face and cover their eyes. Then, it floats over to pretend to help wipe off the cotton before suddenly biting their head at the last second.

entry: POKENAME视力完美，最暗之夜也几乎亮如午后。狩猎技巧让整个沙漠畏惧，从不丢失猎物踪迹。
author: jangodiot
source: POKENAME has developed an impeccable sense of sight, making even the darkest of nights seem almost like a bright afternoon in its eyes. POKENAME is feared across the desert for its hunting skills, never losing track of its prey.

entry: POKENAME半透明身体内，金沙如火焰旋转。夜间泛光，引来穿越沙漠的旅人。
author: .izik
source: Golden sands swirl like flames within POKENAME's translucent body. At night, it glows faintly, luring wanderers through the desert.

entry: POKENAME的长獠牙能迅速、精准地切穿钢铁，甚至曾帮助切割建造太空船所需的金属板。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's elongated tusks can cut through steel with excellent speed and precision. POKENAME has even been used to aid in cutting metal sheets meant for spacecraft construction.

entry: 据说，POKENAME顽强得不可思议。无论敌人有多强、处境多不利，只要它决定挑战，就能闯过去。
author: blazerxz
source: POKENAME is said to be extremely tenacious. No matter the enemy or odds, if it challenges something, it can overcome it.

entry: POKENAME高飞天空，锐眼寻找猎物。发现目标，就极速俯冲，用宽阔强颚一口抓住。
author: _._starry_._
source: POKENAME's sharp sight allows it to find prey while it flies high in the sky. When it finds a target, it dives at high speeds and snaps them up in its powerful, wide jaws.

entry: POKENAME用画着强大流氓鳄的纸板剪影，威吓其他宝可梦。伪装破了，就在地面伸出流氓鳄形影子，爪击、咬击敌人，震撼大地。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME tries to intimidate other Pokémon using a cardboard cut-out displaying a powerful Krookodile. If this disguise is broken, POKENAME will extend a Krookodile-shaped shadow out across the ground, shaking the earth as it claws and bites foes.

entry: POKENAME用画着强大流氓鳄的纸板剪影，威吓其他宝可梦。伪装破了，就在地面伸出流氓鳄形影子，爪击、咬击敌人，震撼大地。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME tries to intimidate other Pokémon using a cardboard cut-out displaying a powerful Krookodile. If this disguise is broken, POKENAME will extend a Krookodile-shaped shadow out across the ground, shaking the earth as it claws and bites foes.

entry: 它用高智力设计狡计，偷取想要的物品。其他POKENAME想偷自己，也会用智慧破坏对方计划。
author: doublehockeystickscomics
source: It uses its high intelligence to construct devious plans in order to steal objects it desires. It may also use its smarts to foil the plans of other POKENAME that try to steal from it.

entry: POKENAME游在沙漠绿洲附近，用巨颚咬旅人。光是存在，就常让其他生灵远离水源。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME swims near desert oases, biting at travelers with its enormous jaw. Its presence alone often keeps others far from the water.

entry: POKENAME出色的视力能在漆黑中看清猎物。天性贪吃，极爱骚扰超音蝠等猎手，抢走食物。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's powerful eyes let it see prey perfectly even in pitch-black conditions. It has a ravenous nature and is very prone to harassing and stealing the meals away from Zubat and other hunters.

entry: POKENAME用锯齿爪抓住猎物，施以猛烈咬碎。偏爱从流沙下突袭。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME grabs prey with jagged claws and delivers a devastating Crunch. It regularly prefers to attack from beneath shifting sands.

entry: 日出时，POKENAME藏进冰洞深处。有人靠近，就露爪，用鬼面赶走入侵者。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME hides deep within frozen caves at sunrise. If approached, it bares its claws and uses Scary Face to drive intruders out.

entry: POKENAME将身体各部分散在沙漠，准备伏击。猎物靠近，就借沙重组，以巨口撕碎受害者。
author: h0bojoe
source: POKENAME scatters its body parts amongst desert sand in preparation to ambush prey. When prey approaches, it reassembles itself using sand and shreds its victim apart with its maw.

entry: 骨状翅膀让POKENAME滑过沙漠夜空。耳中发出雷鸣般巨响，飞行间扰乱敌人。
author: .izik
source: Bone-like wings let POKENAME glide through desert nights. It emits thunderous booms from its ears to disorient foes mid-flight.

entry: POKENAME飞在天上，唱着低沉男中音，再俯冲，将猎物撞进沙或山土。吃完后，得花数小时梳理，清掉云状翅膀上的泥。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME soars through the skies singing in a rumbling baritone until it dive-bombs prey into the desert sands or mountainous soil. After eating its meal, POKENAME must spend hours preening to clean its cloud-like wings of dirt.

entry: POKENAME往敌人眼里吐沙，扰乱、遮住视线。快速攻击与鬃中黑曜石刺不断消耗，再用咬碎了结。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME will spit sand into the eyes of its opponents to confuse and blind them. It will wear them down using fast attacks and the obsidian spikes in its mane until it can finish them with a Crunch.

entry: 巨颚能轻易夹住、碾碎刺甲贝。打赢POKENAME的宝可梦，无一不缺了大块身体。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Its massive jaws can hold and crush a Cloyster with ease. The only Pokémon who have fought a POKENAME and won have large chunks of their bodies missing.

entry: POKENAME潜入被遗忘的城堡找宝藏，带回给训练家。擅闯被发现，就释放一阵飞水手里剑，再钻地挖隧道逃走。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME sneak into forgotten castles to search for treasure to bring back to their Trainers. If they are caught trespassing, they unleash a burst of Water Shuriken before burrowing underground and tunneling away from the scene.

entry: POKENAME凶狠守卫烈日下的沙丘领地。巨颚能夹碎车辆，一靠近就毫无警告地咬下。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME fiercely guards its sun-drenched dune territory. Its massive jaws can crush vehicles, and it bites without warning if approached.

entry: 它钻进沙漠，只露眼睛，常被误认流氓鳄。猎物认出、避开后，就跳出沙，在空中追猎。
author: bandedbodypress
source: It burrows into desert sand with its eyes peeking out, often mistaken for a Krookodile. When its prey recognizes it and avoids it, it jumps out and hunts them through the air.

entry: 几乎所有POKENAME都爱调情，似乎什么物种都想魅惑。但虽然看不出来，却始终忠于伴侣。
author: dodoowner_
source: Almost all POKENAME have flirtatious personalities, appearing to charm Pokémon of every species. However, they will always stay loyal to their mate, even if it doesn't seem that way.

entry: 合众一次发掘，发现满屋仿照POKENAME的雕像。壁画描述，它曾被奉为混沌与死亡之神。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: An excavation in Unova uncovered a room full of statues modeled after POKENAME. Murals in the room describe POKENAME being worshipped as deities of chaos and death.

entry: POKENAME藏在砂岩河岸，悠闲躺着，靠威吓气场保护。环境磨落的壳片，被人泡茶，作民间疗方。
author: ghostslythe
source: Hidden among sandstone riverbanks, POKENAME lounge about, depending on their intimidating aura for protection. Their environment chips off pieces of shell, which are steeped in tea for home remedies.

entry: POKENAME寻找生灵众多的绿洲扎根，散出臭味，吸引误以为是死流氓鳄的食腐者。狩猎成功后，可能将自己埋在地下长达一个月。
author: krogens
source: POKENAME looks for a populated oasis to plant its roots. It will then exude a foul stench, hoping to attract scavengers that mistake it for a deceased Krookodile. Once POKENAME performs a successful hunt, it may bury itself for up to a month.

entry: POKENAME行动不够灵活，狩猎时便将自己埋入沙中，再用水炮让猎物脚下喷起间歇泉。
author: iamjocheena
source: Due to their lack of agility, POKENAME hunt by burying themselves in sand and using their water cannons to create geysers under their prey.

entry: 它藏沙等人经过。受打扰就破土而出，双颚大声咬合。
author: busilisk
source: It hides under the sand, waiting for someone to pass by. If disturbed, it will burst from the ground and snap its jaws loudly.

entry: POKENAME游荡沙漠神殿，寻找同类交战，将骨头当短剑。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME roams desert temples seeking combat with others of its kind. It wields its bone like a short sword.

entry: POKENAME用实体与灵体的手，打出强力拳击。若击败怪力，就夺腰带作战利品。
author: honeslty_vitali
source: POKENAME unleashes powerful punches with both physical and spectral hands. If one defeats a Machamp, it will take its belt as a trophy.

entry: 这种宝可梦漆黑如虚空。若有人打扰所居古庙的宁静，就会暴怒，以阴影本身攻击。
author: fireblade141
source: This Pokémon's body is black as the void. If one is to disturb the peace of the ancient temples in which it resides, it will lash out in a rage, using the shadows themselves to attack.

entry: POKENAME狡猾、恶毒，现身电脑便预示灾祸。许多肢体抓取数据、文件，存进核心，似乎没有办法找回。
author: sk372
source: A devious, malicious being, POKENAME's appearance on a computer spells disaster. It uses its many limbs to grab and store data and files in its core, and there appears to be no way to recover the stolen data.

entry: POKENAME极少出现在深暗处，发光紫眼在夜中醒目，靠瞬移移动。直视双眼，就会立刻遭攻击。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME can be found rarely in very dark places. Its glowing purple eyes stand out against the night, and it teleports to get around. If one looks directly into its eyes, they will find themselves immediately under attack.

entry: POKENAME化石传统上陪葬古代国王、女王。人们相信，化石会自行复活，守卫墓穴，驱赶入侵者；但这已被证伪。
author: divinelunaria
source: POKENAME fossils were traditionally laid to rest alongside ancient kings and queens. This was done due to a belief that their fossils would spontaneously revive to defend the tomb from intruders, but this has since been proven false.

entry: POKENAME偶尔在古墓被发现，尤其被淹的墓。用镰刀猎杀入侵者，后方那一对挥得与前方同样精准。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME are occasionally found in ancient tombs, especially ones that have flooded. They will use their scythes to hunt down intruders and can swing the pair behind them just as accurately as the pair in front.

entry: 它像特定文明的古代统治者，只是身体硕大、圆滚。囤积金、宝石等贵重材料，甚至能“吃”进去，藏在体内保管。
author: infinex21
source: It resembles ancient rulers of particular civilizations, save for its massive and rotund body. It hoards gold, gems, and other precious materials and can even "eat" them to keep them safe within itself.

entry: 这些宝可梦曾是不屈服的古法老侍从，据说能看穿灵魂。主人早已离世，至今却仍守墓，抵御盗贼。
author: infinex21
source: These Pokémon were the unyielding servants of ancient pharaohs, said to have the power to peer into the souls of others. Though their ancient masters have long passed, they continue to guard their tombs from thieves to this day.

entry: 古神话称POKENAME为死亡、腐朽的悲惨显现，是游荡废弃古迹的危险物种。据说，不幸见到容貌的人，再也没被看见。
author: beatdoof
source: Said to be a wretched manifestation of death and decay in ancient myths, POKENAME is a dangerous species wandering around derelict monuments. It is said that those who happen upon its visage are never seen again.

entry: POKENAME睡眠被打扰，就会无休止地肆虐。颈部花朵，曾被视为太阳象征。
author: hortensia_xxiii
source: POKENAME will rampage ceaselessly if its slumber is disturbed. The flower around its neck was once regarded as symbolic of the sun.

entry: 据说，古文明贵族极珍视POKENAME。有些考古发现表明，女王、女皇会像活围巾般佩戴，象征财富与权威。
author: thegreenscorpion
source: It is said that POKENAME were highly valued by the aristocratic society of an ancient civilization. Some archeological discoveries suggest that queens and empresses would wear them like living scarves as a symbol of wealth and authority.

entry: POKENAME隐秘，只出现在失落文明的墓中。除了漆黑环境，都会变得好斗，攻击想探索家园的探险者、考古学家。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are secretive Pokémon that can only be found in the tombs of long lost civilisations. They grow aggressive in anything other than pitch blackness and will attack explorers and archaeologists that try to explore their homes.

entry: POKENAME迅速缠住人，试图将其变成木乃伊。但体型小，过程完成前，常能被甩掉。
author: shyguy11011
source: POKENAME quickly wraps itself around people, attempting to turn them into mummies. Due to its small size, it can often be shaken off before the process is complete.

entry: POKENAME静站在预知将被抢的建筑外。预见的抢匪一出现，就施下最终让其变成木乃伊的诅咒。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME quietly stands outside of the structures it has predicted to be robbed from. Once the robbers it foresaw appear before it, it places a curse that eventually turns them into mummies.

entry: POKENAME守护古墓，用灵体手抓住入侵者，送出去。接触过久，会产生手从地面冒出的幻觉。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME guard ancient tombs by grabbing onto intruders with an ethereal hand and escorting them out. Prolonged contact with a POKENAME causes hallucinations of hands appearing from the ground.

entry: 这些宝可梦诞生于古文明遗弃的罐子、花盆。用幽灵力量守家，常以唯一一只暗影手，把敌人拖进体内。
author: infinex21
source: These Pokémon are born from abandoned pots and planters of ancient civilizations. They guard their homes with their ghostly powers and will often try to drag their foes into their bodies using their singular, shadowy hand.

entry: 据说，POKENAME饱含古代王室智慧。与眼睛对视会使人发狂，但克服危险者，往往日后成就大事。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: It is said that POKENAME are filled with the ancient wisdom of past royalty. Looking them in the eyes can drive people insane, but those that overcome this danger often go on to do great things.

entry: POKENAME走进卡牌店，偶尔偷卡包回家。牌技出色，使人传言，随身金字塔里有个接管身体的灵魂。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME wander into card shops, occasionally stealing card packs to bring back to their homes. It's been noted that POKENAME are adept at playing these games, leading to a rumor that the pyramid they carry houses a soul that takes over their bodies.

entry: 据称是古法老转世，其实只是对埃及学感兴趣的呆呆王亚种。不过，确实中了法老诅咒。
author: kiwiarms
source: It is supposedly the reincarnation of an ancient pharaoh, but it's actually just a subspecies of Slowking interested in Egyptology. It is afflicted with a pharaoh's curse, however.

entry: POKENAME常见于古庙、古墓。许多文化视为害兽，相信正吞食墓中死者的灵魂。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are often found in ancient temples and tombs. Many cultures considered these Pokémon to be pests, believing they were feasting on the souls of those buried there.

entry: POKENAME华丽外壳由多种贵金属组成。宝可梦若受光泽吸引来攻击，就会被它扑压、吸走生命力。
author: reflecbeat
source: POKENAME's ornate shell is made of a variety of precious metals. When it is attacked by a Pokémon attracted to its shining lustre, it pounces on top of the would-be scavenger and drains its life force.

entry: POKENAME附身失落文明的金色陪葬像，驱动、操纵。雕像本为守护死者，如今却会攻击一切靠近者。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME possess the golden funerary statues of a long-gone civilisation and can animate them, bending them to their will. The statues were originally intended as guardians of the dead, but now POKENAME will attack anyone who comes near.

entry: POKENAME身体的浓黑液体，有强烈防腐液气味。石棺壳中藏着四条暗影手臂，抓住想偷盗的人。
author: hophoppip
source: The thick, dark liquid of POKENAME's body smells strongly of embalming fluids. Inside its sarcophagus shell are four shadowy arms that ensnare would-be robbers.

entry: POKENAME住废墟，故意露出部分宝藏，让探险者发现、带走。能从任何被偷走的宝物中现身，导致许多博物馆受到侵扰，陷入危险。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME lives in ruins and will leave some of its treasure exposed for an explorer to discover and carry away. It can appear from any of its stolen treasure, leading to many museums becoming dangerously infested with POKENAME.

entry: 古壁画描绘POKENAME研习各种武艺。至今仍全心遵从传统，决心像保护王室般，保护朋友与训练家。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Ancient murals depict POKENAME studying various forms of martial arts. To this day, POKENAME carry on their traditions with absolute dedication, determined to protect their friends and Trainers as if they were royalty.

entry: POKENAME守着大批遗物，阻止盗墓贼。盘身与双手能同时缠住多名对手，只有所守护者的亲属解除职责，才得安息。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME guards a hoard of relics from would-be grave robbers, as it is able to grapple multiple opponents with its coils and hands. It will only find rest if a relative of those it guards relieves it of duty.

entry: 据说，POKENAME用腹部伸出的暗影手，偷取女性与雌性宝可梦的美貌。白天以角间圆盘吸收阳光，让夜间阴影更强。
author: milchik
source: POKENAME is said to steal beauty from women and female Pokémon using the shadow hands stretching from its belly. During the day, POKENAME absorbs sunlight with the disk between its horns in order to make its shadows stronger during the night.

entry: 盗墓贼常将POKENAME误认为盛放内脏的陪葬罐。若从睡梦中唤醒，就会遭到永远无法离墓的诅咒。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Grave robbers often mistake POKENAME for canopic jars. If they wake POKENAME up from its sleep, they are cursed to never leave its tomb.

entry: POKENAME是山地暴君，自认领地内无敌。它会把山碾成粉，再依喜好与自负重塑，全不顾里面住着的生灵。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a tyrant of mountain regions that considers itself an unbeatable ruler over its domain. It will crumble a mountain to powder and reshape it to fit its own tastes and ego, regardless of other creatures living within.

entry: POKENAME悄悄接近猎物，再展开颈褶，用鬼面吓唬。对方一害怕，就盘住、勒紧。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME sneak up on prey before frightening them by flaring their hoods to use Scary Face. Once their prey has become frightened, POKENAME coils around them and squeezes.

entry: POKENAME守着大批遗物，阻止盗墓贼。盘身与双手能同时缠住多名对手，只有所守护者的亲属解除职责，才得安息。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME guards a hoard of relics from would-be grave robbers, as it is able to grapple multiple opponents with its coils and hands. It will only find rest if a relative of those it guards relieves it of duty.

entry: 野生POKENAME常率一群宝可梦，惩罚窃贼，因此常与黑暗鸦冲突。正义感与责任驱动，让它守望同伴到很晚。
author: bobosmith01
source: A wild POKENAME typically acts as the head of a group of Pokémon that punishes thieves. As a result, POKENAME and its band often come into conflict with Murkrow. Driven by a sense of justice and duty, it stays up very late to keep watch over others.

entry: POKENAME吞金、宝石，存进体内，却消化不了。似乎以暗影手抓住者的生命力为食。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME store gold and gems within themselves by swallowing them, though they have no means to digest them. They seem to feed on the life force of others grabbed by their shadowy hands.

entry: POKENAME常现身疾病肆虐之地。有些科学家认为，脸像芳香精，说明波克基斯与芳香精有亲缘关系。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME tends to appear in places where sickness is rampant. Some scientists believe that its facial resemblance to Aromatisse is evidence of Togekiss being related to it.

entry: POKENAME住墓穴、弃屋，只在深夜现身，骄傲地直坐，周围渐渐充满蒸腾烟雾。目击者说，曾感到焦虑加剧，出现发热般的谵妄。
author: beatdoof
source: Living in tombs and abandoned houses, POKENAME only surfaces at the dead of night, sitting proudly upright as the air around it thickens with vaporous smoke. Witnesses who have seen it say they experienced heightened anxiety and feverish delusions.

entry: POKENAME住墓穴、弃屋，只在深夜现身，骄傲地直坐，周围渐渐充满蒸腾烟雾。目击者说，曾感到焦虑加剧，出现发热般的谵妄。
author: beatdoof
source: Living in tombs and abandoned houses, POKENAME only surfaces at the dead of night, sitting proudly upright as the air around it thickened with vaporous smoke. Witnesses who saw it has said they experienced heightened anxiety and feverish delusions.

entry: POKENAME爱藏在旧弃网站，浏览器已无法显示。靠吃电脑芯片为生，因为里面有金。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME like to hide themselves inside of old, abandoned websites that web browsers are unable to show anymore. They eat computer chips as their food source due to the gold they contain.

entry: 古代超能力者召来POKENAME守墓，它会为研究者备丰盛餐点。若接受，就与用意纯正者结缘；盗墓贼则遭可怕诅咒。
author: ghostslythe
source: Recruited by ancient psychics to guard tombs, POKENAME offer researchers lavish meals. If accepted, those with pure intentions are bonded with. Any grave robbers suffer terrible curses.

entry: POKENAME外表虽吓人，性情却坚定、谦逊、有礼。但若不尊重地回应友好示意，就会被击倒。
author: hipsnake
source: Despite its rather daunting appearance, POKENAME is stalwart, modest and well-mannered. However, if a person fails to reciprocate its cordial gestures respectfully, POKENAME will strike them down.

entry: 这个孤独的幽灵，仍在哀悼自己的死去。据说，它曾是一位早已被世人遗忘的法老的宠物。
author: theheroict
source: A lonesome spirit that mourns its death. It is supposedly the pet of a long-forgotten pharaoh.

entry: POKENAME藏在古墓珍宝间守卫。想偷的人一靠近，便现身，用幽灵手抓住，施以惩罚。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME guards treasures within tombs by hiding amongst the valuables. When would-be thieves approach, it reveals itself and captures them in its ghostly hands to deliver their punishment.

entry: 文献记载，POKENAME统御死者，能以特殊能力判断内心纯洁或污浊。被判不洁、又将走到生命尽头的对象，会遭攻击。
author: bobosmith01
source: It has been written that POKENAME has dominion over the dead. It can deduce whether one has a pure or sullied heart with its unusual abilities. Those who are deemed impure and near the end of their lives are attacked.

entry: 它潜居古老的金字塔，将盗墓者拖入墓中，作为惩罚，让他们永世不得离开。
author: theheroict
source: A vicious creature that punishes grave robbers by dragging them into a tomb to lay for eternity. It's found inside ancient pyramids.

entry: 虽然没有科学证据，许多研究者仍认为，POKENAME腹部面具像人类最早祖先的脸。触碰它，会闪见古代景观。
author: bobosmith01
source: Although there is no scientific evidence to support it, there are numerous researchers that believe the mask on POKENAME's stomach resembles the faces of humanity's earliest ancestors. Those who touch a POKENAME see flashes of an ancient landscape.

entry: POKENAME守墓时耐心、永不放弃。发现入侵者，也要等沙漏流尽才起身，但随后无论多远，都追到底。
author: .jerden
source: When guarding tombs, POKENAME is patient but relentless. If it spots any intruders, it will wait until its hourglass empties to stand up, but will then pursue them regardless of distance.

entry: POKENAME假扮古代统治者的棺材，吓盗墓贼。太懒，常无视入侵者，直到对方想撬开身体。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME pretends to be the coffin of an ancient ruler to surprise grave robbers. It is so lazy that it often ignores intruders until they try to pry its body open.

entry: POKENAME有1,000只手，在身体周围扭动、缠绕，每只又分出无数手指。感知盗墓者进入废墟，暗影手就冲去处置。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have 1,000 hands that writhe and wrap around their body, each hand splitting into a great multiplicity of fingers. Whenever they sense a tomb raider in their ruins, the shadowy hands rush to dispose of the intruder.

entry: 据说，POKENAME是恶灵附身后活过来的石棺。它操纵的四个罐子，各装一件保存下来的人体器官。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME is said to be a sarcophagus that came to life when possessed by a wicked spirit. The four jars it manipulates each contain a preserved human organ.

entry: POKENAME伪装成镀金的弯头权杖，捕捉意图盗墓的人。它会勾住对方的脖子，吸尽生命力。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME disguises as a gold-plated crook to catch would-be grave robbers. It hooks them by the neck and drains them of their life force.

entry: POKENAME常在沙漠守护埋满宝藏的巢穴。用心灵感应向寻宝者出复杂谜题，试图赶走。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME are often spotted in the desert protecting their den full of buried treasures. They telepathically ask treasure hunters elaborate riddles in an attempt to make them leave.

entry: 古画将POKENAME描绘为国王、法老的终极卫士。它令许多幽灵宝可梦恐惧，要求绝对敬奉，吸收一切不肯低头的灵魂。
author: beatdoof
source: Ancient art depicts POKENAME as the ultimate sentinel of kings and pharaohs. It strikes terror into many Ghost Pokémon, demanding absolute worship and absorbing any spirit that refuses to bow.

entry: 古代地位最高的法老，会得到POKENAME守墓。厚金甲几乎无法穿透，对潜在盗墓贼也毫不留情。
author: sk372
