source: In ancient times, the highest-ranking of pharaohs were granted POKENAME as the guardians of their tombs. Its thick golden armor is nigh impenetrable, and it is merciless in how it treats potential grave-robbers.

entry: 古代，它能护人安全穿过沙暴，因此被奉为小神祇。若未献上适当贡品，就会在夜间沙漠消失。
author: hobiewankenobi
source: In ancient times it was worshipped as a minor deity for its ability to offer safe passage through sandstorms. Failing to offer proper tribute would lead to the person disappearing in the desert at night.

entry: POKENAME住在大湖底，只上浮制止争斗、安抚暴怒灵魂。平日虽冷静，却会凶狠攻击渔船，缠住船身，试图沉船。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME dwell at the bottom of large lakes, only rising to stop fights and soothe the enraged spirits. Despite their usual calm demeanors POKENAME are known to viciously attack fishing boats, attempting to sink these vessels by wrapping around them.

entry: POKENAME能随意将暗影手变成飞行双翼，再变回来。兴奋会喷熔金，倒方便人们拿去付它先前破坏的维修费。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME can freely transform its shadow hands into wings for flight and revert them at will. It spews molten gold when it becomes excited, conveniently allowing people to pay for the repairs of the damage it first causes.

entry: POKENAME住古金字塔，齿轮融入木乃伊的灵魂。用身体驱动陷阱、机关，守卫自己的墓。
author: nexusshenanigans
source: Found residing inside ancient pyramids, POKENAME's cogs are infused with the spirits of mummies. It uses its body to operate traps and obstacles which it defends its grave with.

entry: 残暴法老的灵魂重返旧日躯体，便形成了POKENAME。战斗时，它用暗影幻象迷惑敌人，再将其制服。
author: yoshimon
source: A cruel pharaoh's spirit possessed its old body, creating POKENAME. It utilizes shadow illusions in combat to confuse and conquer.

entry: 人们说，这些宝可梦诞生于古代灵魂，如今守着遗迹与墓地。暗影肢体吸走接触者的恶意、贪婪，帮助达到真正平静。
author: infinex21
source: People claim that these Pokémon are born from ancient spirits, who now guard ancient ruins and burial sites. Their shadowy limbs siphon malice and greed from those they touch, helping them to achieve a true sense of calm.

entry: POKENAME在深海，穿着以沉没、被时光遗忘的遗物铸成的装甲。海面上如黑色幽影现身，再把贪婪寻宝者的船拖下。
author: adam_dnh
source: Found in the depths of the ocean, POKENAME adorns itself with armor forged from sunken relics forgotten by time. On the surface, it appears as a black apparition before it drags down ships belonging to greedy treasure hunters.

entry: 据说，这种黑暗、幻影般的宝可梦，被颈中古文明遗物束缚在我们的位面。众多暗影手不断抓取，想夺去一切入侵领地者的性命。
author: infinex21
source: This dark, phantasmal Pokémon is supposedly bound to our plane by the ancient artifact of an ancient civilization around its neck. Its many shadowy hands are constantly grasping to claim the lives of any who intrude upon its domain.

entry: POKENAME假扮棺材或废墟墙饰，耐心等猎物靠近。许多故事里，鲁莽寻宝者最后看见的，是暗影手乱舞、猛扑而来的它。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME disguise themselves either as coffins or as wall pieces within ruins, waiting patiently for prey to come near. Many tales speak of foolhardy treasure hunters whose last sights were of a POKENAME lunging at them with shadowy arms flailing.

entry: POKENAME住在弃楼，避开训练家。满月夜出来沐浴月光，让皮肤逐渐成金。只有全身变金，才能进化。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME dwell in abandoned buildings, avoiding Trainers. On nights with a full moon, they emerge to bathe in the moonlight, which slowly turns their skin to gold. Only when their bodies have transformed entirely to gold can they evolve.

entry: POKENAME常静躺荒草废墟，等待有人想摘金玫瑰。危险虽众所周知，仍有人偷，因为花瓣能制成几乎无药可治的毒。
author: quantumradiation
source: POKENAME often lies motionless in overgrown ruins, waiting for someone to attempt to take one of its golden roses. Although this is a well-known hazard, some attempt to steal a flower anyway, since its petals can be made into a near-incurable poison.

entry: POKENAME飘在墓地上方，等着伏击盗墓贼。一发现就抓起飞走，去向不明，被抓者却再未被看见。
author: darkweavile428
source: POKENAME float above burial sites, waiting to ambush grave robbers. If it spots one, it grabs them and flies off. It is not known where POKENAME takes them, but they are never seen again.

entry: POKENAME制造出盗墓者心中渴求之物的幻象，引诱毫无戒心的人进入领地。一旦上钩，POKENAME便用幽灵般的肢体榨尽他们的生命力。
author: teatedtiten
source: POKENAME tempt unsuspecting tomb raiders into its domain with illusions of their desires.  Once enticed, POKENAME uses its ghostly limbs to squeeze the life force out of them.

entry: POKENAME以财富、幸福的虚假希望，引来社会最恶劣的败类。等察觉骗局，便被判永囚金牢，成了扭曲的讽刺。
author: jangodiot
source: POKENAME lure the worst of society with false hopes of fortune and happiness. Once their target is aware of the ruse, they are sentenced to an eternal prison of gold in a sick sense of irony.

entry: 它住古庙深处，用人眼看不见的丝，在地上织网。察觉探险者落网，就吞灵魂、抢财物。
author: patch01774
source: It makes its home deep in ancient temples, where it creates webs on the floor with silk that is invisible to the human eye. Once it senses explorers are stuck in its trap, it will consume their souls and steal their belongings.

entry: POKENAME守卫沙漠古墓，用锁链缠盗墓者。只有能吞下他们全部贵重物品，才会放人。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME guard desert tombs, entangling tomb raiders with chains. POKENAME will only let robbers go if they can consume all of the thieves' valuables.

entry: POKENAME藏在废工厂，找材料做伪装。发现人类，就会伸臂抱住，希望永远留下。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME hides in abandoned factories searching for materials to build its disguise. If it spots a human, it will wrap its arms around them in hopes that they stay forever.

entry: POKENAME头冠像古代统治者的画像。发现它的墓中铭文记载，曾被视为日食的化身。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's crested head resembles depictions of ancient rulers. According to inscriptions in tombs where POKENAME has been found, POKENAME was once regarded as the embodiment of the solar eclipse.

entry: POKENAME头冠像古代统治者的画像。发现它的墓中铭文记载，曾被视为彩虹的化身。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's crested head resembles depictions of ancient rulers. According to inscriptions in tombs where POKENAME has been found, POKENAME was once regarded as the embodiment of the rainbow.

entry: POKENAME在古文明密封墓中踱步，耐心守着遗忘的古物。被打扰，眼里便泛起凶恶红光，从许多尾巴召来暗影手，守卫墓穴。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME pace around within sealed tombs of ancient civilisations, patiently guarding the forgotten relics of the past. Should they be disturbed, their eyes glow a baleful red and they summon shadowy hands from their many tails to defend their crypt.

entry: POKENAME在古文化中很重要，考古学家相信，曾被敬奉为生死判官。如今仍徘徊古墓，在自己召来的余烬光中，从阴影默望。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME played an important role in ancient cultures, Archaeologists believing they were revered as the judges of life and death. They can still be found haunting ancient tombs, watching silently from the shadows lit only by their conjured embers.

entry: POKENAME半虚半实的身体，静止时能假扮藏宝瓮。打扰它，就会招来可怕记忆。
author: beatdoof
source: POKENAME's half-incorporeal body allows it to mask itself as a treasure urn when stationary. To disturb it is to invite the recollection of horrific memories.

entry: 它用暗影手抓住受害者，防止逃走，再带着飞离。不听话的孩子会被告诫，再调皮，POKENAME就来绑走。
author: fiordaliso
source: It uses its shadow hands to grab its victims and prevent them from escaping, then flies away with them. Children who misbehave are told that if they don't behave, POKENAME will come and kidnap them.

entry: 考古学家推测，POKENAME幽灵孢子里有古代王室灵魂。实际会用孢子吸取猎物灵魂，只留下干枯躯壳。
author: mistymagius
source: Archaeologists theorized that POKENAME's ghostly spores were imbued with the spirits of ancient royals. In reality, POKENAME uses its spores to absorb the souls of their prey before leaving the bodies as dried husks.

entry: POKENAME藏在金字塔地板下，等盗墓者经过便抓住。虽很难绑牢，幽灵外貌与利牙也足以把对方吓跑。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME hides under the floors of pyramids, waiting to ensnare any grave robber that comes through. While it struggles to keep its prisoners bound, its ghostly appearance and sharp teeth scare them away anyway.

entry: 据说，它是疑心极重的法老们制造的古代巡逻机关。一发现闯入者，便先发出高频尖声，再展开攻击。
author: theheroict
source: Supposedly, it's an ancient security drone created by paranoid pharaohs. It emits high pitched frequencies when it spots an intruder before attacking.

entry: 野生POKENAME潜伏沙漠废墟，用闪烁火焰引人进入，再伸暗影手抓住。
author: .jerden
source: Wild POKENAME lurk inside desert ruins. They create flickering flames to lure people in, then reach out with their shadowy arms to grab them.

entry: POKENAME能伏平在地板、墙、天花板。脸打开，露出漆黑、寒冷走廊，走完需5.5分钟。据说会从进入者身上拿走什么，但没人知道是什么。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME can lie flat on floors, walls, and ceilings. Opening up its face reveals a dark, cold hallway that takes 5.5 minutes to traverse. Some say that it takes something from those who go in, but no one knows quite what.

entry: POKENAME贪婪至极，宝藏少一枚硬币，也会不休追猎、诅咒窃贼。它很记恨这些盗墓者。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME are extremely avaricious Pokémon, if a single coin is taken from their hoard, it will relentlessly hunt for the thief, cursing them. They are known to hold grudges against these grave robbers.

entry: POKENAME为富可敌国的人家作舞者。若喂它金珠，舞姿便会美得令人出神。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME live as dancers for exceptionally rich citizens. When fed gold nuggets, their dance will become mesmerizing.

entry: 它在古墓外跳祭舞，敬奉死者。据说，盗墓者若想行窃，POKENAME就使入口坍塌，让窃贼与死者永封墓中。
author: agentyoshi
source: It performs ceremonial dances outside ancient tombs to honor the dead. It is said that if a graverobber attempts to rob the tomb, POKENAME will collapse the entrance, sealing the thief in with the dead for all eternity.

entry: POKENAME用可爱、可抱的外表欺骗。受害者一松懈，便被暗影肢体抓住、勒紧，直到力量消退。传说，诞生于被遗弃幼小宝可梦的挫败。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME deceives others with its cute and cuddly look. When its victims drop their guard, it grabs them with shadowy limbs, squeezing until their strength fades. Legends say it was born from the frustration of abandoned young Pokémon.

entry: 据说，一位水手海上迷失，灵魂困进诅咒船锚，形成POKENAME。它沉眠海底，吸食靠得太近的人类潜水员的精气。
author: tyler059
source: It is said that a sailor got lost at sea and had his soul trapped in a cursed anchor, creating a POKENAME. POKENAME lies dormant on the ocean floor, consuming the essence of human divers who stray close to it.

entry: POKENAME审判亡者的灵魂。纯净的，便引往来世；污浊的，则会化作黄沙。
author: skymaster426
source: POKENAME judge the souls of those who have died. If they are pure, then they are guided to the afterlife. If they are corrupt, the souls become sand.

entry: 古代训练家将这些宝可梦投到魔法卡上，进行显露真正实力的“乱斗”。有人说，这些斗士启发了精灵球机制，但理论未证实。
author: teatedtiten
source: In ancient times, trainers would throw these Pokémon on magical cards for a “brawl” where their true strength would be shown. Some say these brawlers inspired the Pokéball mechanism, but that theory has yet to be proven.

entry: 人们在沙漠中发现了它，相信里面寄宿着远古统治者的灵魂。它会命令某些宝可梦替自己筑起身躯。
author: houndrys.
source: Found in deserts, it is believed it contains the soul of a ruler from ancient times. It commands certain Pokémon to build its body.

entry: 这些宝可梦守卫主人的坟墓，无论离世多久。会极速穿梭，以暗影肢体打击敌人。
author: infinex21
source: These Pokémon guard the graves and tombs of their masters, no matter how long ago they may have passed. They dart around at rapid speeds and strike at foes with their shadowy limbs.

entry: 身体绷带其实是可操纵的触须，似乎刻着音符。是否就是偶尔所唱的歌，仍不清楚，因为无人获准研究。
author: infinex21
source: The wrappings around its body are feelers it can control that seem to have musical notes etched upon them. Whether these notes are the same songs they sometimes sing is unknown, for none have been allowed to study them.

entry: 许多人相信，POKENAME的号声预示不幸，甚至毁灭。它一边绕舞，一边用绷带触须击打恶人、敌人。
author: infinex21
source: Many believe the sound of a POKENAME's trumpet to be a harbinger of unfortunate times, if not outright doom. They use their bandage-like feelers to batter wicked people and their foes while dancing around them.

entry: POKENAME背着大木棺保护自己。棺盖打开，漆黑内部却只有真菌孢子。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME have a large wooden coffin on their back, which they use for protection. When the lid opens, the only thing inside the dark interior are fungal spores.

entry: POKENAME守护古迹与传说中的宝藏，用绷带触须缠住盗贼。吸取生命力，直到幽灵手状尾巴能将其拖进冥界。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME guard ancient ruins and the treasures said to lay within them, wrapping would-be thieves in their bandage-like feelers. These feelers siphon their life force until their ghostly hand-like tail can drag them down into the underworld.

entry: POKENAME讨厌身体沾泥，为保持洁净，住在沙漠绿洲附近。它操纵阴影造小虫，常用来赶捕食者。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME hates when its body is stained with dirt, residing near the oases of the desert in an effort to always be clean. It manipulates shadows to create miniature bugs, often using them to ward away predators.

entry: POKENAME背着大木棺保护自己。棺盖打开，漆黑内部却只有真菌孢子。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME have a large wooden coffin on their back, which they use for protection. When the lid opens, the only thing inside the dark interior are fungal spores.

entry: POKENAME在丛林神庙假扮雕像。感知盗墓贼，会等到极近，再跳出吓人，用精神力量推向神庙更深处。
author: ghostslythe
source: POKENAME disguises itself as a statue inside jungle temples. When it senses a grave robber, it waits until they are incredibly close, before jumping out to scare them and psychically pushing them deeper into the shrine.

entry: 多年前，考古学家在古墓中发现了POKENAME。烈日下，它看起来只是一尊泥像。可据说到了凉爽的沙漠夜晚，就会有灵魂围着它，举行早已失传的仪式。
author: kianjp2008
source: Archeologists discovered POKENAME in an ancient tomb many years ago. Under the blazing sun it appears to only be a clay sculpture, but during cool desert nights it's said that spirits can be found circled around it performing a long forgotten ritual.

entry: POKENAME住古墓深处，以暗影肢体驱赶入侵者。有些古文明画像描绘相似宝可梦，作为古代统治者的忠诚伙伴。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME reside within the depths of tombs, using their shadowy limbs to repel invaders. Some depictions of some past civilizations bear a resemblance to these Pokémon, with them as the loyal companions of some ancient rulers.

entry: POKENAME住在被考古学家扰动的古墓，贪恋、紧守旧遗物。曾钻入当地博物馆，取回文物。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are found within ancient tombs that have been disturbed by archaeologists. They are possessive Pokémon that jealously guard the relics of the past and have been known to burrow into local museums to retrieve artifacts.

entry: POKENAME住在被考古学家扰动的古墓，贪恋、紧守旧遗物。曾钻入当地博物馆，取回文物。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are found within ancient tombs that have been disturbed by archaeologists. They are possessive Pokémon that jealously guard the relics of the past and have been known to burrow into local museums to retrieve artifacts.

entry: 古时，有些地区将这些宝可梦视为神的化身。据说，POKENAME的脸会永久刻进见者记忆。
author: jangodiot
source: During ancient times, these Pokémon were seen as the embodiments of gods in some regions. POKENAME's face is said to be permanently etched into the memory of anyone who sees it.

entry: 休息时，POKENAME像失落文明的普通头带。若被拿动，就显出灵体身躯，暴怒，对触碰头饰者施下可怕诅咒。
author: katieplaysgames
source: When at rest, POKENAME appear to be simple headbands from long-gone civilisations. Should their headband be handled, they manifest their ethereal body and fly into a rage, inflicting dreadful curses on whoever touches their headpiece.

entry: POKENAME曾被训练为坐骑，供守护藏宝神庙、金字塔的人使用。战士制服盗贼后，幽灵手臂会将其缚住，直到判决。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME were trained as steeds for those who would guard temples and pyramids that held great treasures. After a warrior subdued thieves, POKENAME's ghostly arms would restrain them until judgement was passed.

entry: POKENAME极以外表为傲，暗影手不断擦壳，直到发亮。谁打扰，就会被诡笑瞪住，再被阴影拖走。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME is very proud of its appearance, its shadowy hands constantly focused on polishing its shell until it shines. If anyone tries to interrupt this process, POKENAME will glare at them with an eerie grin before the shadows drag them away.

entry: POKENAME住古堡、古庙遗迹，藏在暗道，不断巡逻领地，向任何入侵者施痛苦电击。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME are found in the ruins of ancient castles and temples and hide in dark passageways. They constantly patrol their territory, delivering painful shocks to any intruders.

entry: 它住在古墓的陪葬罐里，平时像个不动的罐子，盗墓贼闯进家，却能将其激怒。
author: bandedbodypress
source: It makes its home inside burial urns inside of ancient tombs. While it typically seems to be an inert urn, it can be spurred into rage by grave robbers intruding in its home.

entry: POKENAME身体的黏液满是防腐液臭味。小宝可梦一碰，就迅速被吸收、制成木乃伊。
author: hophoppip
source: The slime of POKENAME's body reeks of embalming fluid. Small Pokémon who touch it are quickly absorbed and mummified.

entry: POKENAME会伏击盗墓贼，让他们中毒；对规矩守礼的训练家，却会慷慨赠送宝物，有些价值数百万。
author: the_smirker
source: POKENAME ambushes and poisons grave robbers. It rewards behaving Trainers with riches. Some of these riches are worth millions.

entry: POKENAME徘徊古沉船，初看像嵌宝石的空壳。潜水员一转身，无身之手就射出，将其拖向匕首般利齿的巨口。
author: ghostslythe
source: Haunting shipwrecks of ages past, POKENAME at first appears as bejeweled empty shells. Once a diver turns their back the disembodied hands shoot forward, dragging their victim to its dagger-toothed maw.

entry: POKENAME在埋宝地附近安家，以幽灵力量与不断咬合的巨钳保护。古海盗常为追逐不义之财，与它交锋。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME makes its home close to where buried treasure is located, protecting it through ghostly powers and gnashing claws. Pirates of old clashed with it often in their search for ill-gotten gains.

entry: 传说，古代王室灵魂睡在POKENAME壳里。周围暗影触须，确保从没有人类看见内部。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Legends say that the spirits of ancient royalty slumber within POKENAME's shell. The shadowy tendrils that surround POKENAME have ensured that no humans have ever seen the insides of their shells.

entry: POKENAME将头藏在树顶，伏击鸟宝可梦。疏忽、好奇的猎物一落在爪与网间，就会被抓。风暴时低头藏叶，避开雷击。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME ambushes bird Pokémon by lurking with its head among treetops and ensnaring unobservant or curious prey when they land among its claws and webs. During storms, it ducks its head low and hides within foliage to avoid lightning strikes.

entry: 嘴里伸出的舌，由紧缠丝线组成。黏性帮助攀附表面、抓猎物。
author: .izik
source: The tongue extending from its mouth is made of tightly entwined silk. This sticky appendage helps it cling to surfaces and capture prey.

entry: POKENAME给茧覆上薄薄带电丝层，额外防御捕食者。哪怕轻碰，也会遭强电击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME coats its cocoon with a thin layer of electrically-charged thread. This gives it extra defenses against predators, who receive a powerful shock upon the faintest contact.

entry: 它钻进太阳能板，内部织网吸电。这给山脉附近的太阳能电场带来麻烦。
author: .izik
source: It drills into solar panels and weaves webbing inside to absorb electricity. This behavior has caused issues at solar farms near mountain ranges.

entry: 身体披着半透明丝，每根藤又覆着近乎无形的蛛网，既黏又意外坚韧。
author: .izik
source: Its body is cloaked in translucent silk, and each vine is coated with nearly invisible webbing. These webs are both sticky and surprisingly strong.

entry: POKENAME对幼小宝可梦有节奏地摇摆，让对方模仿、跟随。引到电网中，便跳得更兴奋，准备享用。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME bobs and sways rhythmically at baby Pokémon so that they copy its movements and follow it around. It lures them until they walk into its electric web, where its dance becomes more excited as it prepares to feast on them.

entry: 电费惊人地高，很可能是POKENAME所为。它附在住宅电表，吸取流经的电力，雷暴时织大网，盼雷击中。
author: chibitales
source: An astonishingly high energy bill is likely due to POKENAME. They attach to electric meters on homes and absorb the power coursing through them. POKENAME spin large webs during thunderstorms in hopes they will be struck by lightning.

entry: POKENAME在湖边布多张电网，平时多半泡水。猎物落网，电力分散便能被感知，提醒已有一餐。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME sets up a number of electrified webs at the edges of the lakes it inhabits. It spends much of its time submerged in water, but can sense the dispersal of electricity when something is caught in its webs, alerting it to a captured meal.

entry: POKENAME用网接上电脑，便持续吸取数据为食。一次进食，足够维持数周。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME connects to a computing device with its web, it steadily siphons data as nourishment. A single feeding can sustain it for weeks.

entry: POKENAME是灭绝镰刀盔的远亲。小臂黄毛导电，增强电属性招式。
author: antonio_9onzalez
source: POKENAME is a distant relative of the extinct Kabutops. POKENAME uses its yellow fur on its small arms to conduct electricity to power up its Electric-type moves.

entry: POKENAME瞬移进街机厅，吃电线与电，常带来大群电电虫，造成虫患。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME warp into arcades to feast on the wires and the electricity inside. They have been known to bring in hordes of Joltik with them, leading to infestations.

entry: 这些宝可梦爱用电力、阵阵火焰烤坚果和树果，再吃。背刺常散高热，威慑攻击者。
author: infinex21
source: These Pokémon love to use electricity and puffs of their flames to roast nuts and berries before eating them. The spikes along their backs often exude an intense heat that deters assailants.

entry: POKENAME准备吐火，背部尖毛就会噼啪放电。嘴里吐的蛛丝能传导火焰，数小时都不烧毁。
author: infinex21
source: The spiky fur along a POKENAME's back will crackle with electricity as it prepares to spew flames from its mouth. The webbing it can spew from its mouth is capable of channeling its flames without burning for many hours.

entry: POKENAME觅食时，用蛛丝织网袋，装采来的树果。尤其爱岳竹果，因为里面甜美。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME form nets out of webbing when foraging to help them carry the berries they pick. They are fond of Magost Berries because of the sweet flavor inside.

entry: 卡莲多镇有家店，专用它的丝制作捕虫网。网耐用、网眼细密，很受欢迎。
author: .izik
source: A shop in Luxuria Town specializes in bug nets crafted from its web. These nets are popular for their durability and fine mesh.

entry: POKENAME在高楼顶织网，捕捉飞行属性猎物。蛛网吸电，自然防雷，因此只要不挡路，人类便不干涉。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME weaves its web atop tall buildings in an effort to catch Flying-type prey. As they absorb electricity, the webs act as natural protection against lightning strikes, so humans leave it be so long as its web does not get in the way.

entry: 它挖出电缆，啃绝缘层，常引发乡间电涌。
author: .izik
source: It digs up power lines to chew on the insulation. This habit often causes electrical surges in rural areas.

entry: 塔吉西镇一位织工用它的丝制袜，因能驱散静电而出名。
author: .izik
source: A weaver in Emeragrove Town creates socks from its silk. The socks are celebrated for their unique ability to repel static electricity.

entry: POKENAME用尾球强光晃晕猎物，使其无法行动，再享用。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME stuns prey by blinding them with a bright light produced by the orb on its tail. Once the prey are successfully incapacitated, it feasts.

entry: 丝铺在花坛上，抑制杂草。小镇园丁靠它保护植物。
author: .izik
source: Its silk is laid over flowerbeds to suppress weed growth. Gardeners in small towns rely on it to protect their plants.

entry: POKENAME靠黏性的脚爬墙，偷树上水果，囤在巢里。带电丝包住食物保护，再织进废金属，增加巢穴电荷。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME use their sticky feet to scale walls, snagging fruit from trees to hoard in their dens. They protect this food by coating it in an electrified silk, weaving in scrap metal they find to increase the nest's electrical charge.

entry: POKENAME找其他物种的网，涂上自身分泌凝胶。原网主便察觉不到猎物落网的振动，让它享用。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME finds the webs of other species and covers them in a gel it secretes. This gel prevents the builder of the nest from being able to detect vibrations caused by the prey that get stuck in it, allowing POKENAME to feast.

entry: POKENAME能感知其他宝可梦动作，专在最笨拙、最不留意四周的对象旁织网。丝在阳光下发亮，深受设计师珍视。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME is able to sense other Pokémon's actions and uses that to lay webs near those most clumsy and unaware of their surroundings. The threads it creates are highly valued by fashion designers since they glow in the sunshine.

entry: POKENAME钳子张开，伸出蜘蛛状肢体，能射电网缠住、麻痹对手，再拖近。
author: sk372
source: Arachnid limbs emerge from POKENAME's pincers when they open up. These limbs can shoot electrified webbing to ensnare and paralyze opponents so POKENAME can drag them closer.

entry: POKENAME大多待在树冠，编织电网。利爪帮助攀爬，也能自卫。
author: zweizweihander
source: POKENAME spends most of its time in tree crowns, where it weaves its electric webs. Its sharp claws help it with climbing and self-defense alike.

entry: POKENAME刚孵化，妈妈就用丝和蜜，织出像小POKENAME的玩具。它走哪都带着，甜蜜香气与柔软触感，帮助胆小的自己在压力下平静。
author: milchik
source: When it hatches, its mother uses web and honey to knit a toy that resembles a baby POKENAME. It carries the toy wherever it goes. The sweet scent of honey combined with how soft the toy is helps this timid Pokémon to calm down whenever it's stressed.

entry: POKENAME在树间拉网，既捕猎，也储粮。采完树果、坚果，就织茧包住，吊上树，免得其他宝可梦够到。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME stretch their webbing between trees to trap prey, but also uses it to store food. After gathering berries and nuts, POKENAME will spin a cocoon around them, then hoist it up into a tree to prevent other Pokémon from reaching it.

entry: 这些虫属性宝可梦背着丝网巢，幼崽通常在里面不停爬动。常睡洞里，黏糊糊的身体帮助附在洞顶。
author: infinex21
source: These Bug-type Pokémon carry a hive made of silk webbing atop their backs, where their young will typically be restlessly crawling inside of. They typically sleep in caves, their slimy bodies helping them to stick to the ceiling.

entry: POKENAME用电网捕捉散落数据，包括恶意软件、病毒。不合胃口的放走，只吃剩下的。
author: chibitales
source: By using electrical webs, POKENAME catches stray bits of data, including malware and viruses. It releases data it doesn't find appetizing from the web and feasts on what remains.

entry: POKENAME用电网捕捉散落数据，包括恶意软件、病毒。不合胃口的放走，只吃剩下的。
author: chibitales
source: By using electrical webs, POKENAME catches stray bits of data, including malware and viruses. It releases data it doesn't find appetizing from the web and feasts on what remains.

entry: 它织大网等待，用头顶闪亮宝石引猎物。有时人类也落网，因此有了“POKENAME的闪光”一说，比喻好得不真实的事物。
author: hophoppip
source: It spins a large web and waits on it, luring in prey with the glittering gemstones on its head. Sometimes, humans get caught in the web, giving rise to the term "POKENAME's glimmer" as shorthand for something too good to be true.

entry: 它从尾巴甩网，缠住敌人。困住后，就用强力电击攻击。
author: .izik
source: It flings webbing from its tail to ensnare foes. Once trapped, it shocks them with a powerful jolt of electricity.

entry: POKENAME大束黏藤，是年轻同族的移动家园。它极护藤蔓，尤其里面有住客时，会用强力放电、强力鞭打驱退捕食者。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME's large bundle of sticky vines serves as a mobile home for their younger brethren. POKENAME are extremely protective of their vines, especially when occupied, unleashing powerful Discharge and Power Whip attacks to ward off predators.

entry: 发现POKENAME的科学家，也创造了“万维网”这个称呼。它同样能以每秒200,000千米，穿过光纤电缆。
author: bandedbodypress
source: The same scientist that discovered it also coined the moniker "World Wide Web." Similarly, POKENAME can travel at 200,000 km/s through fiber optic cables.

entry: 它向敌人扔黏网球，缠住、限制行动，让猎物更易遭到电击。
author: .izik
source: It hurls sticky balls of webbing at foes to ensnare them. Once immobilized, the prey is left vulnerable to its electric attacks.

entry: POKENAME移动时，羽毛积累静电。遇险会竖羽、放小火花，升温直到看起来全身着火。
author: pokefanart
source: POKENAME's feathers accumulate static electricity as it moves. When threatened, it bristles its feathers and releases small sparks, heating its body until it appears to be engulfed in flames.

entry: POKENAME只在信任的训练家面前露出虫腿。用多条上肢，为朋友织饰品，流过的无害电力让饰品发光。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME will only reveal their bug-like legs around their trusted Trainers. Using their multiple upper limbs, they weave their webbing into accessories for their friends. These accessories glow with a harmless electricity flowing through them.

entry: 野生POKENAME把下肢藏在裙状毛下，避免嘲笑与鄙视。忠诚、善良高于一切，会用电网保护每位朋友。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME conceal their lower limbs beneath their skirt-like fur to avoid ridicule and scorn. They value loyalty and kindness before all else and will use their electric webs to protect any and all of their friends.

entry: 野生POKENAME用肘间流出的电丝战斗，也以粗大下肢戳击。电丝织在一起，能造出挡下许多攻击的防御网。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME fight using electric threads that flow from their elbows and by jabbing at foes with their large, lower limbs. By weaving together their electric webbing, they can craft defensive webs that repel many attacks.

entry: 小型POKENAME迁进郊区，钻入发电厂，啃线吸能。大型个体住沙漠，将猎物拖进沙，再电到麻痹。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: Smaller instances of POKENAME have moved into suburban areas, burrowing into power plants and chewing on wires for energy. Larger POKENAME reside in deserts; they hunt by dragging their prey into the sand and shocking them into paralysis.

entry: 雷文镇一位裁缝，用它的丝制发圈，因耐用、柔软而受好评。
author: .izik
source: A tailor in Nimbasa Town crafts hair ties using its silk. The ties are praised for their durability and soft texture.

entry: POKENAME大牙高效啃倒原木，加快筑坝。织成的电丝额外支撑，让坝更稳、防御更强。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's large fangs let it chew down logs with great efficiency, hastening the speed at which it can build dams. The structures are additionally supported by electric threads it weaves, increasing their stability and defenses.

entry: POKENAME用幽灵能量，同时伸出八根带电丝。一根被碰，所有丝就一起收向目标，拖回身边。
author: sk372
source: Using ghostly energy, POKENAME can stretch out eight simultaneous threads of electrified silk from its body.  Once something touches one, all threads will converge on the target and drag it back to POKENAME.

entry: 它以结实身体，帮助飓风频发地区的电气工作。丝能固定电缆，防止停电。
author: .izik
source: It uses its sturdy body to assist with electrical work in hurricane-prone areas. Its silk helps stabilize power lines and prevent outages.

entry: POKENAME是爱玩的虫属性宝可梦，靠头顶腿状大角移动。毛带静电，多数人类或宝可梦初见都会受惊。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are playful Bug-type Pokémon who use the large leg-like horns sprouting from their heads to move around. Their fur is charged with static electricity, which often startles most people and Pokémon when they first meet.

entry: POKENAME在山中家园织网搭庇护，抵御风暴。随时随地能建，让它比多数宝可梦更能住在严酷环境。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME craft webbed shelters to weather storms in their mountain homes. Their ability to construct these shelters anywhere at any time allow them to live in more inhospitable environments than most other Pokémon.

entry: 桧垣市一位女裁缝，用混入其毒液的丝制雨衣。不但防水，还意外耐损。
author: .izik
source: A seamstress in Vertress City makes raincoats with its silk, infused with its venom. The coats are waterproof and surprisingly resistant to damage.

entry: POKENAME的电网锋利如钢，轻易切开猎物。想从网中飞过的宝可梦，常被切成碎片。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's electric webs are as sharp as steel, slicing through prey with ease. Pokémon who try to fly through the webs often end up being sliced into pieces.

entry: POKENAME用坚韧丝线装饰毛茸身体，再以静电操纵，缠住、勒死猎物。
author: bandedbodypress
source: It decorates its fuzzy body with its tough silk. POKENAME uses static electricity to manipulate its silk to restrict and strangle its prey.

entry: POKENAME转动齿轮，让体内高能晶体振动，迅速积蓄电力，再向猎物或敌人发射宽大电网。
author: fireblade141
source: Spinning its gears agitates the energy-dense crystals throughout its body, allowing POKENAME to rapidly charge up electric power. It uses this power to launch broad Electrowebs at prey or foes.

entry: POKENAME朝丝线上吐唾液，让其藏在眼前也看不见。猎物撞网，就遭它自身产生的强烈高压电击。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME spit on the strands of thread they make to hide them in plain sight. When prey run into these webs they are electrocuted by an intense voltage generated by POKENAME themselves.

entry: 它整天待在原处补充电力。入夜后便与同类成群横行，以不幸撞见的猎物为食。
author: skymaster426
source: It spends the entire day in place charging itself up with electricity. At night, it goes on a rampage with its swarm, feeding on any unlucky prey.

entry: POKENAME几乎只在废弃实验室被目击。吸尽占据的家中残电，就四处释放电网，短短几分钟覆满整片场地。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME have almost exclusively been sighted among abandoned laboratories. After sucking what electricity remains from their commandeered homes, POKENAME blast Electro Web everywhere, coating the whole property in mere minutes.

entry: POKENAME织大网并非捕猎，而为警戒领地危险入侵者。大耳存巨量电，挥一下不只是重击，也会强烈电击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME weaves large webs not to hunt, but to warn it of dangerous intruders in its domain. Its large ears store great amounts of electricity; a single swing is not only a heavy blow, but an electrifying one as well.

entry: POKENAME会附在其他生物或电器上，转眼吸干全部能量，再跳到新的宿主身上，继续如此。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME can attach itself to other living creatures or electrical devices to suck out all their energy within a very short time. It then jumps to a new host to repeat the process.

entry: POKENAME喜欢在寺庙筑巢，夜里能照明，还会捕捉其他虫宝可梦，因此很受欢迎。有人甚至相信，它们的光能驱散邪灵。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME like to nest in temples, where they are well received because they generate light at night and catch other Bug Pokémon. Some even believe that they keep evil spirits away with their radiant light.

entry: POKENAME在尾尖织电网，捕捉虫属性宝可梦。猎物落网后，先吐火烧，再吃。
author: milchik
source: It spins an electric web on the tips of its tails and uses it as a net for catching Bug-type Pokémon. Once the prey is caught, POKENAME burns it by spitting fire before eating it.

entry: POKENAME伏在浅水下，用手抓太近的猎物。谁不慎踩中背部蓝刺，就会遭强电击。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME lies beneath shallow water, using its arms to grab prey that swims too close. If anyone accidentally steps on one of the blue spines on its back, they will receive a powerful electrical shock.

entry: 它用喙吐网，困住敌人，再使出强力火花，烤熟猎物。
author: .izik
source: It spits webs onto foes using its beak, immobilizing them. It then unleashes a powerful Ember to roast its prey.

entry: POKENAME失明，靠电磁特征察觉目标。地面属性宝可梦，常让它完全察觉不到。
author: stevethebarbarian
source: POKENAME is blind and detects its targets through their electromagnetic signatures. Ground-type Pokémon are often completely undetectable to it.

entry: POKENAME颈与头之间电流畅通，连接大脑。它们如一体运作，极快织出复杂蛛网。
author: stevethebarbarian
source: Electric currents flow freely through POKENAME's necks and heads, effectively connecting its brains. They operate as one, weaving intricate webs extremely quickly.

entry: 这种宝可梦的电网，捕获猎物远超过所需。只尝试吃掉强到能逃脱、挑战自己的猎物。
author: stevethebarbarian
source: This Pokémon catches far more prey in its electric webs than it needs to eat. It only actually tries to eat those strong enough to escape and challenge it.

entry: POKENAME凶狠捕猎，善用热与电。每条尾巴都能射出易燃带电网，麻痹猎物，让大字爆炎更易命中。
author: milchik
source: POKENAME is a vicious predator that utilizes both heat and electricity to its advantage. Each of its tails can shoot highly flammable, electrically charged webs designed to paralyze the prey and make it an easy target for POKENAME's Fire Blast.

entry: 头上的腿用于织出复杂丝纹，图案的艺术美常受赞赏。
author: .izik
source: The legs on its head are used to weave silk into intricate patterns. These patterns are often admired for their artistic beauty.

entry: POKENAME从身体织出电网，能量放大网中振动，让它像电吉他一样演奏。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME spin electrically charged webs from their bodies. Vibrations sent through these webs are amplified by their energy, allowing these Pokémon to play them similarly to an electric guitar.

entry: 它的电网让发电厂齿轮平稳运转，工程师仰赖材料的高导电性与轻盈质地。
author: .izik
source: Its electric web keeps gears in power plants running smoothly. Engineers rely on its high conductivity and lightweight consistency.

entry: POKENAME只住密林，在高树筑巢，能吐毒网困猎物。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME are only found in dense jungles, building their nests high in the trees. They are capable of spitting toxic webbing to trap prey.

entry: POKENAME饥饿时，将黏糊身体表面伸成无数细丝，向四方铺出黏网。一根捕到猎物，就立即缩回，尽快吸收这一餐。
author: sk372
source: When hungry, POKENAME spreads out many minuscule threads of its gooey exterior in every direction, creating a web of slime. Any thread that catches prey immediately retracts so the meal can be absorbed as quickly as possible.

entry: 有人在无月黑夜遇见POKENAME，它主动靠近，送出随身丝包。里面有数十颗蛋，相遇不久就会孵化。
author: _pixelar_
source: People have reported meeting POKENAME in the dark of moonless nights, the Pokémon willingly approaching the person and offering the bundle it carries. Dozens of its eggs are contained in these bundles of silk, hatching not long after the meeting.

entry: 电工把它的丝加进高楼电缆，材料极强，确保长久稳定。
author: .izik
source: Electricians incorporate its silk into power lines for tall buildings. The material's incredible strength ensures long-lasting stability.

entry: POKENAME在地面设许多黏网，困住潜在猎物。落网后，多爪抓住，前颚放电，了结对方。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME sets up numerous sticky webs on the ground to trap and immobilize potential prey. Once snared, POKENAME grabs them with its multiple claws and finishes them off with electric shocks from its front mandibles.

entry: 有人推测，POKENAME启发一位伟大发明家，造出新式电力机器。常见它待在大机械旁，似乎想控制。
author: hiimhdere
source: POKENAME is theorized to have inspired a great inventor into making new, electricity powered machines. It often is spotted around large machinery, seemingly trying to control it.

entry: POKENAME埋伏着，等待猎物落入带电的丝网。它听觉敏锐，能准确抓住俯冲下去、了结猎物的时机。
author: nellnast42
source: POKENAME lies in wait for prey to stumble into its electrified webs. It is perceptive, and hears exactly when it must swoop down and finish the job.

entry: 它向敌人发射裹麻痹粉的大团蛛丝，使猎物麻痹，轻松抓住。
author: .izik
source: It fires large globs of webbing coated in Stun Spore at foes. This tactic paralyzes prey, allowing it to capture them with ease.

entry: 它把黏丝铺在水面，卷来漂浮船骸。不管碎片是什么，都吃。
author: .izik
source: It spreads its sticky silk across the water's surface to reel in floating ship debris. It will eat debris regardless of what it is.

entry: POKENAME吐巨型电网，缠住太阳珊瑚等猎物，再拖进洞，独自享用。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spits massive webs charged with electricity to ensnare prey like Corsola. Once caught, it drags them into caves to feed alone.

entry: POKENAME是狡猾猎手，采可食真菌，放在地面暗藏的电网中央作饵。进食时，背部蘑菇发亮、电光闪烁。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a crafty hunter, gathering edible fungi to use as bait, placed in the center of a hidden electrified web it has spun on the ground. The mushrooms on its back glow and spark with electricity as it feeds.

entry: POKENAME遇袭先造冰障，再吐电网麻痹对方。平时虽吃植物，却不介意捕猎小宝可梦。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: When attacked, POKENAME create a barrier of ice before spewing electrified webs to paralyze their assailants. Despite usually eating plants, POKENAME have no problem hunting for smaller Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME极护家人，用尾巴织电网，拖慢敌人，或在受保护者周围造电击屏障。
author: h0bojoe
source: POKENAME are fiercely protective of those they consider family. Using their tails, they spin electrically charged webs to slow foes or create shocking barriers around those they guard.

entry: POKENAME边舞、边唱、边纺线，丝线映出旋律的美与技艺。织成昂贵衣物、地毯，仍保持鲜艳色彩，从宝蓝到深雷云般的黑。
author: _pixelar_
source: POKENAME spin their yarn while dancing and singing a song, the thread reflecting the beauty and skill of the melody. Woven into expensive clothes or carpets, the yarn retains its vivid coloring, ranging from a royal blue to a dark thundercloud black.

entry: POKENAME的孢子像电池，携带强电荷，因此即使不在附近，蛛网也能持续带电。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's spores carry a strong electrical charge, like batteries. This allows it to keep its webs electrified even when it is not nearby.

entry: 它往灯柱吐网，爬近光源。到顶后，用吻部摩擦灯泡，吸收热量与能量。
author: .izik
source: It spits webs at lightposts to climb closer to the light source. After reaching the top, it rubs its snout against the bulb, absorbing its heat and energy.

entry: POKENAME用棒与丝不停编织，织出没有尽头的挂毯。有人说，织丝时，也在编织命运。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME is constantly knitting, using sticks and silken strands to create a tapestry without end. Some say that POKENAME weaves fate as it weaves silk.

entry: POKENAME带着带电晶体。若没有它包裹的保护网，周围一切都会被电烧毁。
author: atlas3339098
source: POKENAME carries with it a crystal charged with electricity. If not for the protective webbing the Pokémon covers it in, it would fry everything around it.

entry: POKENAME织复杂蛛网，每根丝都有持续电脉冲。它蜷身，让胡须贴网，感到猎物落网才扑去。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME spin complex webs, charging each of the strands with a constant pulse of electricity. They curl up with their whiskers resting against the web, waiting until they feel something get trapped before pouncing on it.

entry: POKENAME用多臂快速织网，黏丝绑住敌人、限制行动。对手无法移动，就无情连击。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME weave webs rapidly with their many arms, using the sticky threads to bind their opponents and limit their movement. Once their foe is immobilised, they pummel them relentlessly.

entry: 浅葱镇一位商人用它的丝制围巾，以柔软、保暖闻名。
author: .izik
source: A merchant in Daybreak Town crafts scarves from its silk. The scarves are known for their soft texture and ability to retain warmth.

entry: POKENAME轻巧、敏捷，能对付体型更大的敌人。每拳带静电，连番打击不断电击。
author: ultron_suprem3
source: Lithe and agile, POKENAME is capable of fighting foes larger than itself. Each of its punches is charged with static electricity, shocking its enemies with a flurry of blows.

entry: POKENAME将电能存进臂毛。战斗时，强钳夹住对手，再以超过15,000伏特电击。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME stores electrical energy in the fur on its arms. In combat, it will clamp onto its opponents with its powerful pincers, then shock them with over 15,000 volts of electricity.

entry: POKENAME倒刺注毒时，会让其他宝可梦刺痛。金属倒刺受力会断，确保毒液不浪费。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have barbs that cause a stinging sensation when they inject venom into another Pokémon. Their metallic barbs break when under stress to ensure that the venom is not wasted.

entry: POKENAME背部刺藤先束缚猎物，再以剃刀般镰刀切割。挣扎越厉害，倒刺就扎得越深。
author: bandedbodypress
source: The thorny tendrils on POKENAME's back restrain its prey before they are sliced by its razor-like scythes. The more its prey struggles, the deeper its barbs dig in.

entry: 变成敌人时，身上藤蔓有节奏地脉动，重新输送养分与液体，帮助变化。
author: .izik
source: When transforming into an enemy, the vines on its body pulsate rhythmically. This motion redirects nutrients and fluids to aid in its transformation.

entry: POKENAME先给触须充电，再鞭打敌人。能攀墙、附洞顶，因此战时曾被用来爬上战舰。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME battle by charging their tendrils with electricity, before whipping their foes with them. They have the ability to cling to walls and latch onto ceilings; because of this ability, they were used to climb up battleships during wartime.

entry: POKENAME虽披金属外壳，双翼却强得足以托起升空。腹下倒刺能伸长，敲打下方对手。
author: evilgammon
source: Its wings are immeasurably strong as they are able to keep POKENAME airborne despite its metal exterior. The barbs hanging from its stomach can extend to club opponents below it.

entry: 藤蔓强得能让它们悬挂洞顶。先向下方敌人、猎物射钢刺，再落下，以泰山压顶了结。
author: infinex21
source: Their vines are strong enough to let them hang from cave ceilings. They fire steel spikes at foes or prey below, and will drop onto them with a Body Slam to finish them off.

entry: POKENAME用沉重长尾压住敌人，再射金属羽毛刺穿。羽间偶尔落下的种子，摸着冰冷。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME use their large, heavy tails to pin down opponents before skewering them with their loosed, metal feathers. The seeds that sometimes fall from between their feathers are cold to the touch.

entry: 想捕捉POKENAME的冒险者，得时刻看上方，防利刺如雨落下。受伤时，它用触须吸收养分，直到当地一丝不剩。
author: soup1900
source: Adventurers trying to catch a POKENAME must always watch above to avoid getting rained on by sharp spikes from POKENAME. When injured, they use their feelers to absorb nutrients until there are none left in the area.

entry: POKENAME玩得越多，藤状尾巴就越长。紧张时反而缩短，身体同时长出极锋利的刺。
author: .izik
source: The vine-like tail extending from POKENAME's body grows longer the more it plays. It shortens when POKENAME becomes stressed, during which incredibly sharp thorns grow from its body.

entry: POKENAME尖刺能传导电能。只要扎进身体，连最结实的岩石、地面、钢属性宝可梦，也无法承受直接电击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's spines are very sharp and able to channel its electric energy. Even the sturdiest of Rock, Ground or Steel-type Pokémon wouldn't be able to endure a direct shock once its spines pierced into them.

entry: POKENAME用尾刺方便攀上各种表面。它灵巧从高处扑下，偷不备路人的帽子，再笑着跑走。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME uses the spikes on its tail to climb more easily on any surface. It swoops down from above with agility to steal the caps of unsuspecting passersby, then runs away laughing.

entry: 野生POKENAME常沿洞顶爬，像长尾怪手玩攀爬架。战斗中，金属爪扎住对手，再使出强力头锤。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME often crawl along cave ceilings like Aipom on jungle gyms. In battle, they dig their metal claws into their opponent and strike them with a strong Headbutt.

entry: 跟着POKENAME，最终总能到沼泽，早已为人所知。研究者认为，鳃能探测气压变化，理由是沼泽空气成分会刺激尖刺带毒。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: It has long been known that following a POKENAME will eventually lead you to a swamp. Researchers believe that its gills can detect changes in air pressure, as the air composition of swamps stimulates its spikes to become poisonous.

entry: POKENAME精通战斗，鲜明记住看过、参与过的每场。还将其他宝可梦战术化为己用，调整得适合带棍状末端的藤蔓。
author: oddwalls
source: As a master of combat, POKENAME vividly remembers the battles it sees or partakes in and incorporates other Pokémon's strategies into its own repertoire, adapting them to suit its clubbed vines.

entry: POKENAME附住敌人，用长触手吸养分，每根都有倒刺，勾住毛或鳞片。许多个体无意中，也帮宿主除去有毒金属，吸进自己体内。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME latches onto its foes to suck out nutrients with its long tentacles, each with a set of barbs to cling to fur or scales. Many POKENAME inadvertently help remove toxic metals from their hosts, absorbing them into their own bodies instead.

entry: POKENAME狩猎时，手臂最长能伸一英里。住在洞穴隧道，钳子能抓狭缝里，甚至洞外的猎物。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME's arms can extend up to a mile long when hunting. It lives in cave tunnels, and its pincers can grab prey in tight crevices and outside of its cave.

entry: POKENAME用壳中伸出的附肢爬洞壁，寻找铜矿。食物富铜，让构成身体的岩浆变成鲜绿。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME use their appendages issuing from their shells to climb around cave walls, seeking copper deposits. Their copper-rich diet turns the magma that their bodies consist of a vibrant green.

entry: POKENAME身体重，难以长距离飞行。捕猎时，把藤状腿像弹簧往后蓄起，再极速撞向猎物。
author: mepp.
source: Due to POKENAME's heavy body, it struggles to fly long distances. It attacks prey by coiling its vine-like legs back like a spring before slamming into them at incredible speed.

entry: POKENAME每进入新电脑，连接的线缆就长出锋利金属刺。人们相信，是为防止小拉达啃线。
author: quackquackattack
source: Whenever POKENAME enters into a new PC, it causes sharp metal thorns to sprout from the cables connected to the PC. It is believed that POKENAME produce these thorns to prevent Rattata from chewing on the cables.

entry: 植物死去，POKENAME会回到几个月前，吸尽养分，免得浪费。据说，用钢刺刻岩，痕迹会同时出现在多个时代。
author: soup1900
source: When a plant dies, POKENAME travels a few months back in the past so it can absorb all their nutrients before they go to waste. It's said that when it scratches its steel spikes into rock, the markings appear simultaneously across multiple time eras.

entry: 藤状尾巴的金属尖端，脉动着磁能。受打扰，就释放强力电击，威慑来者。
author: .izik
source: The metal tips of its tail-like vines pulsate with magnetic energy. When disturbed, it releases a powerful Thunder Shock to deter threats.

entry: 长藤末端带铁倒刺，让它迅速穿林，或挂在枝头。也用藤摘果实、坚果，先碾碎，再一口吃下。
author: infinex21
source: Using its long vines tipped with iron barbs, it can swiftly maneuver through forests or hang from branches. It will grab fruits and nuts from trees with its vines and crush them up before eating them in one bite.

entry: POKENAME成群狩猎，在地面结冰，滑行着不停追击目标。长藤帮助快速转移、避招，也能继续缠住猎物。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME hunt in groups, forming ice upon the ground to effectively skate upon as they relentlessly pursue and strike at their targets. They use their long vines to quickly maneuver and avoid attacks, or to further ensnare their prey.

entry: POKENAME像巨大行走藤团，兼有有机与金属藤。靠金属尖端在林冠高处吊行，触须垂下，捞小生灵作食。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a massive walking mass of vines, both organic and metallic. It uses metal points to hoist itself across the upper canopy of forests, tendrils reaching down to snatch up smaller creatures as meals.

entry: POKENAME虽大、重，身手却极灵巧。末端带钢刺的肢体能摆荡、附上各处，甚至飓风也吹不走。
author: bobosmith01
source: Despite POKENAME's size and weight, it is incredibly acrobatic. Its steely thorn-tipped limbs allow it to swing and attach to all sorts of places; it can even resist being blown away in a hurricane.

entry: POKENAME尾尖的花苞，平时紧紧闭合。到了春天，便绽成美丽的黄花。
author: ohok3441
source: The ends of POKENAME's tails are closed buds. In spring, they bloom into beautiful yellow flowers.

entry: POKENAME同样需要数据与硅的养分。常试图闯数据中心，先吃服务器数据，再砸机器，取半导体。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME seek out nutrients from data and silicon in equal measure. They are often seen attempting to break into data centers to feast on the data within the servers before smashing the server itself for the semiconductors.

entry: POKENAME附洞顶，伏击下方经过的宝可梦。行为虽好斗，战斗却是玩耍，还常用自己种的树果为对手疗伤。
author: nyoomymph
source: POKENAME latches onto the ceilings of caves and ambushes Pokémon that pass below. Despite this aggressive behaviour, its battles are playful, and it often heals foes with berries it grows itself.

entry: POKENAME一找到合适洞顶附住，就变色，完美融入四周。看见猎物，便连发尖刺伏击。
author: zweizweihander
source: Once POKENAME attaches itself to a suitable ceiling, it changes its colors to blend perfectly with its surroundings. Then, once it spots its prey, it ambushes it with a volley of spikes.

entry: POKENAME在深洞等迷路猎物撞上带刺的身体。一缠住，几乎逃不掉，因为只有击中外露触须，才能伤它。
author: oejoeboy33
source: Deep within caves, POKENAME lies in wait for lost prey to stumble into its spiked body. Once ensnared, escape is nearly impossible, as it can only be harmed by striking its exposed feelers.

entry: 藤上附着的金属物，像旋转陀螺。它配合陀螺动作攻击，借动量增强打击。
author: .izik
source: The metallic object attached to its vine resembles a spinning top. It coordinates its attacks with the top's movements, using the momentum to enhance its strikes.

entry: POKENAME带钢尖的灵巧长舌，挥得快到能碎石。觅食、自卫、在作为家园的黑暗洞穴中辨路，全靠这个器官。
author: brilliantdarkness
source: POKENAME can swing its steel-tipped prehensile tongue fast enough to shatter stone. It is entirely reliant on this organ to forage for food, defend itself, and navigate through the dark caverns it calls home.

entry: 它一生许多时间都在脱落不断重生、争抢身体空间的钢刺、利鳞。脱落物深受收藏家追捧，也常用于民间药方。
author: brilliantdarkness
source: It spends much of its life shedding the constantly regrowing steel thorns and sharp scales, competing for space on its body. These sheddings are highly sought after by collectors and are commonly used in folk medicine.

entry: POKENAME用狼牙棒般的尾巴重砸敌人，接着便疯狂挥砍，直到对方再也不动。
author: hummusishome
source: POKENAME uses its mace-like tail to ferociously crush foes. It follows up a blow from its tail with furious slashing until the foe stops moving.

entry: POKENAME住在深不见光的地下洞室，眼睛已退化。靠头顶金属盘探测大地振动，辨认环境。
author: brilliantdarkness
source: POKENAME inhabit subterranean chambers so deep and lightless that its eyes have been rendered vestigial. It navigates its environment by using the metallic dish atop its head to detect vibrations in the earth.

entry: POKENAME将五条带刺触须扎进洞壁，吸收养分。遇险便挥打自卫。疲惫、重伤时，出来晒太阳，睡中靠光合作用疗伤。
author: h0bojoe
source: POKENAME sinks its five spiked feelers into cave walls to absorb nutrients. When threatened, it lashes them to defend itself. If exhausted or badly injured, it emerges outside to bask in sunlight, healing through photosynthesis as it sleeps.

entry: POKENAME附在墙、洞顶，落向不备猎物，以刺触手碾碎。传说对视会有幻觉，但研究者尚未证实。
author: actliux
source: POKENAME cling to walls and ceilings, dropping onto unsuspecting prey to crush them with their spiky tentacles. Staring into their eye is said to cause hallucinations, though researchers have yet to prove this.

entry: POKENAME用沉重装甲爪固定，刺藤鞭打一切太近的东西。耐心坚定，只有猎物再也逃不掉时才出击。
author: msdawgs
source: POKENAME anchors itself with heavy armored claws while thorned vines lash at anything that wanders too close. It waits with unwavering patience, striking only when escape is no longer possible.

entry: POKENAME众多钢刺能攀树枝，方便在丛林摆荡。它用头上火焰点燃带刺小球，化为爆炸、燃烧的弹丸。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's numerous steel spines let it latch onto tree limbs to better swing through the jungles. It ignites small spiked orbs using the fire on its head, turning them into explosive, burning projectiles.

entry: POKENAME长途旅行，偶尔在人类茶馆歇脚。眼睛平时藏在帽檐下，若与其对视，几乎肯定已惹怒。
author: banquoviaquo
source: POKENAME travel on long journeys, occasionally stopping in human teahouses for rest. Their eyes are normally hidden beneath the brim; those who meet their gaze have almost certainly angered them.

entry: POKENAME三条灵巧尾巴，既能抓猎物，也能悬挂洞顶、枝头。每次物理打击都带强电，还能向远敌甩带电钢刺。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME uses its three, prehensile tails to secure its prey and to hang from cave ceilings or branches. It delivers powerful zaps with each physical strike it lands and flings electrified steel spikes at distant foes.

entry: POKENAME游荡洞窟、森林，靠爪与能抓握的尾巴离地，方便伏击。眼睛能在相当范围内看透一切，轻松追踪猎物。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME prowl within caves and forests, using their claws and prehensile tails to stay off the ground so they may better ambush their prey. Their eyes can see through anything at a decent range, which allows them to easily track prey.

entry: 后部伸出的长尾状藤蔓，能当鞭子打倒敌人。精准、有力，是可怕武器。
author: .izik
source: The long, tail-like vine protruding from its rear can be wielded like a whip to dispatch foes. Its precision and power make it a fearsome weapon.

entry: 野生POKENAME向猎物、入侵者洒下钢刺。许多长藤末端有带刺的钢制球茎，能凶狠敲打其他生灵。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME rain down steel spikes upon their prey and at those who intrude upon their territory. A POKENAME has many long vines with spiked, steel bulbs at their tips that can be used to viciously batter others.

entry: 入侵者进入领地，它就变成对方模样。趁其困惑，连发倒刺攻击，逼其逃走。
author: .izik
source: If trespassers enter its territory, it transforms into their likeness. While they are confused, it attacks with a flurry of barbed spikes, forcing them to flee.

entry: POKENAME性情好斗，穿过领地很危险。尾上钢刺锋利，足以给敌人留下深伤。
author: chibitales
source: Travelling through a POKENAME's territory is dangerous due to their aggressive nature. The steel thorns on their tail are sharp enough to leave deep gashes in their foes.

entry: 它爱玩，带着几分迷糊，会从悬挂的洞顶垂下，吓旅人。细附肢扎入富营养处，直接吸收。
author: infinex21
source: It is a bemusedly playful Pokémon that startles travelers by lowering itself from the cave ceilings it hangs from. It stabs its thin appendages into places rich in nutrients and directly absorbs them.

entry: POKENAME给背上连枷充能，冲过战场时胡乱挥舞。缠在一起，就直接切掉、长回，切下的也会甩出当攻击。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME charges energy into the flails along its back before swinging them wildly as it rushes through a battlefield. If any of the flails get tangled, POKENAME will simply slice them off and regrow them, flinging the extras as part of an attack.

entry: POKENAME摆尾远掷金属刺，用伸展手臂保持距离。头上菇帽比钢还硬，战斗时可作盾。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME swing their tails to fling metal spikes at targets from a distance and utilize their stretchy arms to keep said foes at a distance. The caps on their heads are harder than steel, and they utilize them as shields during battle.

entry: POKENAME附在阴暗洞顶生活。粗心的访客一踏入领地，它就突然落下，将人掳走。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME lives in gloomy caves, attached to the ceiling. If a careless visitor enters its territory, it suddenly drops down and abducts them.

entry: POKENAME原生于合众热闹港口，能不断提供钢丝绒、钢丝，深受摆渡人、渔民珍视。它慷慨供给，换人们容忍自己改不了的恶作剧。
author: thegreenscorpion
source: Native to the populated harbors of Unova, POKENAME are greatly valued by ferrymen and fishermen alike for their endless supply of steel wool and wire, which they generously offer in exchange for being tolerated as incorrigible pranksters.

entry: 藤状腿的尖端带磁，能附着金属表面，使它在工业环境占优。
author: .izik
source: The tips of its vine-like legs are magnetized, allowing it to attach to metallic surfaces. This adaptation gives it an advantage in industrial environments.

entry: POKENAME用带刺附肢攀爬、穿行洞顶，体型虽大，却意外灵巧。脚刺能撬出地面岩块，再扔向敌人。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME use their spiky appendages to scale and traverse cave ceilings, moving with surprising dexterity given their size. The spikes on their feet are able to dislodge chunks of rock from the ground, which they hurl at foes.

entry: POKENAME一受惊，就用藤蔓缠住敌人，再以燃烧的四肢将其烧毁。它的钢壳，过去曾被用来做炊具。
author: staghorn
source: If startled, a POKENAME will wrap its vines around its foe and torch them with its flaming limbs. Its steel shell was once used to make cookware.

entry: 它睡在丛林废墟旁，守卫古统治者的墓。藤状手臂最长伸40英尺，向入侵者打出重拳。
author: .izik
source: It sleeps near jungle ruins, defending the tombs of ancient rulers. Its vinelike arms can extend up to 40 feet, delivering devastating punches to intruders.

entry: POKENAME拿着各种户外大门钥匙，常开门释放被囚宝可梦。据说，训练家若虐待，便会前来解放。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME hold keys to all sorts of outdoor gates and often open them to let Pokémon out of captivity. It is said that if a Trainer mistreats their Pokémon, POKENAME will come to liberate them.

entry: 休息时，它把藤伸到树枝，高悬林地。受打扰，就释放火焰旋涡困敌，再逃走。
author: .izik
source: While resting, it extends its vines to nearby tree limbs, hanging high above the forest floor. If disturbed, it unleashes a Fire Spin to trap its foe before escaping.

entry: 过去王国用POKENAME，为军队建造防御工事。人们曾相信，被它的钢强化过，任何材料都坚不可摧。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: In the past, kingdoms deployed POKENAME to construct defensive structures for their armies. It was once believed that any material fortified by POKENAME's steel was indestructible.

entry: POKENAME光合作用时，大金属刺阻止别人来吃或打扰。即使能应付刺，也会被体内电流电击。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Its large metal spikes discourage anyone from eating or interfering with POKENAME while it photosynthesizes. Even those who can handle the spikes get shocked by the jolts it sends through its body.

entry: 构成POKENAME身体的死植物随时间腐烂，产生烟气，再被用于毒气攻击。
author: hophoppip
source: The dead plants that make up POKENAME's body decay over time, producing fumes that POKENAME channels into toxic gas attacks.

entry: POKENAME藏树间，静观穿越领地的对象。不喜欢谁，就在手中造硬金属球，从高处砸下。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME hides among the trees, silently observing those who traverse its territory. Those it takes a disliking to are pelted with hard metallic spheres it creates from its hands and hurls down from up high.

entry: POKENAME住土壤富铁的地方。吸铁越多，叶片越锋利、越亮。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME lives in places with iron-rich soil. The more iron a POKENAME absorbs, the sharper and shinier its leaves will be.

entry: POKENAME身上有两类蘑菇，一类紧贴背，另一类长着长柄。合用能制头痛药，但金属味很重。
author: .izik
source: Two types of mushrooms grow from POKENAME's body, one attached tightly to its back and the other on long stalks. Both can be combined in medicines for headaches, though they carry a very metallic taste.

entry: POKENAME用收集来的金属与自身尖刺，做成一只巨大的刺轮，既可远攻，也能格挡来袭的招式。
author: hexx_vixtar
source: Using the metal it gathers and its own spines, POKENAME creates a giant spiked wheel. It uses said wheel to fight from afar or block attacks.

entry: POKENAME磨牙时，身体射出钢刺，再用精神力量操控轨迹。
author: darkweavile428
source: When POKENAME grinds its teeth, it fires steel spikes from its body. POKENAME uses its psychic powers to control the spikes' trajectory.

entry: POKENAME身上的毒蘑菇极锋利、硬如铁。它用来钻石头，寻找合适的孢子散播地。
author: .izik
source: The toadstools on POKENAME's body are extremely sharp and as hard as iron. It uses them to dig into stone to find suitable places to spread its spores.

entry: POKENAME到处撒菱、布隐形岩，伤害靠近的对手。等其虚弱，再以刺藤斩击了结。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME leaves Spikes and Stealth Rock around it everywhere to damage any opponent who tries to near it. Once they're weakened, POKENAME slashes its spiked vines at the opponent to finish them off.

entry: POKENAME钢壳让它几乎不受伤害。重量使动作笨重，但背部长的触须，让最崎岖地形也能通行。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME possess a steel shell that leaves them nearly impervious to harm. The weight of the shell makes their movements cumbersome, but tendrils that sprout from their back help them to navigate even the roughest terrain.

entry: POKENAME能向上伸铁藤，夹住洞顶，拉起自己，再竖直挖掘。因此极善于救出被坍塌困住的人。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME can extend its iron vines upwards, to clamp onto cave ceilings. Upon pulling itself upwards, it can proceed to burrow vertically, making this Pokémon exceptional at rescuing people who have been trapped in cave-ins.

entry: POKENAME金属身体极重，落地时，有力双腿下方都会压出凹坑。领地意识极强，以带刺的致命翅膀攻击任何进入空域的宝可梦。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its metal body is so heavy that it dents the ground beneath its powerful legs when it lands. Extremely territorial, POKENAME attacks any Pokémon entering its airspace with its deadly spiked wings.

entry: 它挥舞的植物状钉锤，饰着铂金尖刺。念力投掷、改变方向，精准得惊人。
author: .izik
source: The plant-like maces it wields are adorned with platinum spikes. Using its telekinetic powers, it throws and redirects them with incredible accuracy.

entry: 这只宝可梦用众多带刺的触须，攀过墙面、地板与洞顶。占好位置，便会突然出击。
author: houndrys.
source: This Pokémon uses its many spiky tendrils to clamber across walls, floors, and ceilings. When it's in the right place, it strikes.

entry: POKENAME战斗时旋转，以极重身体猛撞，棒状尾巴配重。体型吓人，平时却温顺，除非被激怒。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME spin and attempt to bash foes with their extremely heavy body during battle, using their clubbed tail as a counter-balance. Despite their intimidating size, they are normally docile unless provoked.

entry: POKENAME有两对眼，头部集中精神力量，尾部追踪目标，用钢刺轰击。同时完成，就能突破任何防御。
author: oddwalls
source: It has two pairs of eyes: the eyes on its head focus its psychic power, while the eyes on its tail track targets to bombard with steel spikes. POKENAME does both at once to penetrate any foe's defenses.

entry: POKENAME以触手硬刺攀高。沉重液态金属从身体滴下，接触者都会中毒。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses the solid thorns on its tentacles to cling to high places. Heavy dollops of liquid metal fall from its body, poisoning those they come in contact with.

entry: POKENAME住地下深处含水层，用刺尾与炮附在水上洞顶。虽然能水下呼吸，身体却太密，游不动，掉进去只得爬出。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are found in aquifers deep underground, using their thorny tail and cannons to cling to the ceiling above the water. Though they can breathe underwater, their bodies are too dense to swim and they have to climb out if they fall in.

entry: POKENAME附在洞顶，向下摆荡，击打经过的宝可梦。带刺身体的撞击若没将目标击昏，就会等待周围毒气生效。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME attaches itself to the ceiling of caves, then swings down to strike Pokémon passing below. If the impact of its spiky body does not knock the target out, POKENAME will wait for the poisonous gas that surrounds it to take effect.

entry: POKENAME用金属刺附在洞顶，朝下方目标发射毒刺。移动虽然吵，悬挂时却完全无声，从不留下影子。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME uses its metal spikes to attach to cave ceilings, firing poisonous thorns down at targets passing below. Although they are loud when moving, they hang in total silence, never casting a shadow.

entry: 颈部长的刺灌木，结出甜美、营养丰富的树果。雪峰市糕点师用来制作精致果馅饼。
author: .izik
source: The thorny bush growing from its neck produces sweet and nutritious berries. Pastry chefs in Snowpoint City use these berries to craft exquisite tarts.

entry: POKENAME燃烧的气味，会吸引大片区域的虫属性宝可梦。室内饲养建议关窗，以免虫患。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME give off a scent as they burn that attracts Bug-Type Pokémon from a wide area. It's recommended that Trainers keeping a POKENAME indoors do so with the windows closed to prevent an infestation.

entry: POKENAME住暗处，藏角落，避免与其他生灵接触。唯独迷路孩子例外，会被烛光引向安全。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME resides in dark areas, hiding away in corners to avoid contact with others. The only exception is lost children, who find themselves guided to safety by the light of POKENAME's candle.

entry: POKENAME游荡旧墓地，什么都舔，从墓碑、附近的树，到脚下泥土。被蜡质舌头舔到，就会感到深深、异样的不安，连训练家也一样。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME roam around old gravesites, licking everything in the area, from gravestones to nearby trees, and even the dirt it walks on. If someone is licked by their waxy tongue, the victim will feel deeply and unnaturally unsettled, even its Trainer.

entry: POKENAME一情绪激动，便爆发成火海。据说，见证这场爆发会改变灵魂。它是濒危物种。
author: king_creepsta
source: Whenever POKENAME gets emotional, it erupts into an inferno. Witnessing the explosion is said to be soul-altering. POKENAME is an endangered species.

entry: POKENAME把灵力存进角，让尖端如幽火发光。能量越强，角越亮，常足以照亮周围水域。
author: curazy
source: POKENAME stores its spiritual energy within its horn, causing the tip to glow like a ghostly flame. The stronger its energy becomes, the brighter the horn shines, often glowing brightly enough to illuminate the surrounding water.

entry: POKENAME蜡身能塑成奇怪、吓人的形状，常用于恐怖游乐设施。它也得益，开心享用恐惧等强烈情绪。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME are often present in horror attractions as their waxy bodies can be molded in strange and frightening ways. The Pokémon benefit as well, as it happily feeds strong emotions like fear.

entry: 蜡质身体的热量、致命性堪比火山岩浆。战斗时喷出强烈紫焰，吸取被烧者的生命力。
author: h0bojoe
source: Its wax body rivals volcanic lava in heat and lethality. In battle, it blows out intense violet flames that leech the life force of anything it burns.

entry: POKENAME夜间狩猎，用钳尖微弱的火光引好奇昆虫。一靠得够近，就以黏性蜡质身体困住，留待日后悠闲享用。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME hunts at night, using low-light flames at the tips of its pincers to attract curious insects closer. Once they draw close enough, it uses its sticky wax body to ensnare them and trap them, to be consumed at its leisure later.

entry: POKENAME心情可从蜡的软硬判断。硬化代表平静，将要暴走时，体内愤怒的火焰发热，蜡也融化得更多。
author: sk372
source: A POKENAME's mood can be determined by the solidity of its wax. More hardened wax signifies calm, while a POKENAME close to rampaging has more melted wax, heated by the burning, angry fires of its body.

entry: POKENAME炽热的蜡质身体，看似正在融化。为免形体散掉，会飞过天空，冷却蜡。
author: thezekrom
source: POKENAME has a hot, waxy body that looks like it is melting. To prevent its form from coming apart, it flies through the sky to cool the wax.

entry: POKENAME好心提出渡人类、宝可梦过海，其实是陷阱。背上乘客会在大海中央被吸走生命力，从此没人能再找到。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME kindly offers to ferry people and Pokémon across the ocean, but it's a trap. Anyone caught on POKENAME's back will have their life force drained in the middle of the sea, and no one will ever be able to find them again.

entry: 这种宝可梦潜伏新近亡者安息之处。人们相信，它留在幽灵身边，安抚躁动。
author: pastelxlost
source: This Pokémon has been known to lurk around places where the recently departed rest. It is believed to linger in the area of ghosts to soothe their unrest.

entry: POKENAME每吃一个病毒，火焰就更亮、更热。太久不进食，光便渐暗。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's flames burn brighter and hotter with every virus it consumes. The glow gradually fades during long periods without feeding.

entry: POKENAME收集灵魂吃，似乎把最美味的存进螺旋壳深处，慢慢品尝。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME collects souls for consumption. Apparently, it stores the tasiest souls into the back of its spiral shell so it can slowly savor them over time.

entry: 腹中燃着不灭的火焰，POKENAME总感到饥饿。即使一连吃上好几天，还是觉得饿得慌。
author: blitzydragon
source: Because of the perpetual flame in its stomach, POKENAME are always hungry. They can eat for days on end and still feel like they're starving.

entry: POKENAME火焰的高热，让蜡质身体始终微微融化，走到哪里都滴热蜡。入夜时，栖在火山盆地。
author: sk372
source: Due to the heat of POKENAME's flames, its waxy body is always slightly melted, dripping hot wax wherever it roams. It roosts within the basins of volcanoes when night falls.

entry: 体表蜡层每几天脱落，却几乎立刻重生。脱落前一刻与过程中，头上的火焰最亮。
author: infinex21
source: Their bodies are covered in a layer of a waxy substance that they shed every few days, though it reforms almost instantly. The flames on their heads grow brightest right before, and during, the shedding process.

entry: POKENAME的幽火在生气、难过时更亮。整群被惹怒，可能不慎引发林火。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME wield ghostly flames that flare brighter when they're angry or upset. When a swarm of them are aggravated they can inadvertently start forest fires.

entry: POKENAME夜间漂浮，以尾焰光引人跟随。趁对方跟着走，吸取精神能量维生。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME floats around at night, drawing people to follow the light emanating from the flame on its tail. While they follow, POKENAME takes the opportunity to drain their mental energy for sustenance.

entry: POKENAME游荡破败旧宅，吃书页维持背上的火焰。夏季聚到地下室，避开会熔化自己的烈日。
author: quackquackattack
source: Wandering through old, decrepit manors, POKENAME eat pages from books to sustain the flames on their backs. During the summer, POKENAME congregate in the basement of these manors to avoid being melted by the hot summer sun.

entry: 独自的POKENAME无精打采地飞，始终寻找群体。同群爱在温暖、干燥处筑巢，吃得极少，同一片区域便能住很多。
author: nyoomymph
source: Lone POKENAME fly around listlessly, constantly looking for a flock. Flocks of POKENAME prefer to nest in warm, dry places. They eat very little, so one area can have many of them at once.

entry: POKENAME头上的火焰柔柔闪动，诱虫属性宝可梦入网。再注入强毒，阻止挣扎。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME's flame on their head flickers softly to lure Bug-type Pokémon into their webbing. POKENAME stop their prey from struggling by injecting them with a potent venom.

entry: POKENAME闪动背上的火焰，引猎物入网。若想挣脱，就点燃蛛网，阻止逃跑。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME flicker the flames on their back to lure prey into their webs. If their prey attempts to break out of the webbing, POKENAME light their webbing on fire to prevent escape.

entry: POKENAME的火焰羽冠，就是让蜡身活起来、又将其熔化的灵魂。灵魂越热情，身体融得越快。
author: geo_ominous
source: The flaming plume of a POKENAME is the spirits animating and melting itswax body. The more passionate the spirit is, the faster its body melts.

entry: POKENAME缠触角捕猎，吸取生命力。火焰奇异地不发热，也无法熄灭，即使完全浸水也一样。
author: kittyluv090
source: POKENAME hunts by wrapping its antennae around prey and absorbing their life-force. Its flames strangely do not give off heat and cannot be extinguished, even when submerged in water.

entry: 探索黑暗弃地时，远处若有光蹦跳，很可能是POKENAME在欢跳。它能大口吸气，让火焰猛旺，却很快就会气喘，只能维持片刻。
author: sk372
source: If one sees a light bouncing in the distance while exploring a dark abandoned locale, it is likely to be a POKENAME prancing about. It can inhale large breaths to flare up its flame, but only for a short time before it gets winded.

entry: POKENAME不断脱落蜡状外层，人类也不断收集，制作各种工艺品。不过，有时里面存着多余电力，始终得小心。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are constantly molting their wax-like coats, which are equally always being gathered and used in various crafts by humans. Sometimes, however, the shed coats are filled with their excess electricity, so caution is always maintained.

entry: POKENAME栖在哪里，身体就不断滴蜡。据说，只有蜡全部融尽，才会进化。
author: geo_ominous
source: The bodies of POKENAME constantly drip wax wherever they roost. It is said that POKENAME only evolve once all of their wax has melted away.

entry: POKENAME从嘴伸出又长又黏的蜡舌，舔其他生灵。有人说，这是留下标记，宣告有一天会来夺取生命精华。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME extends a long and sticky tongue made of wax from its mouth to lick others. Some say licking a creature is its way of marking them, leaving a message that one day it will claim their life essence.

entry: POKENAME漂浮时，热蜡滴到汽车、屋顶，许多市民都很讨厌。蜡特别难刷，常得用金属刮具清掉。
author: jaminmcready
source: Many urban residents loathe POKENAME because it drips hot wax onto cars and roofs while floating. Its wax is notoriously difficult to scrub off, often requiring the use of metal scratchers.

entry: 除了生命力，POKENAME也以烛蜡维生。墓穴、墓园中，能见它吃悼念者留下的蜡烛。
author: lydiaprower8
source: In addition to life force, POKENAME also uses candle wax to sustain itself. It can be seen in tombs and graveyards, eating candles left by grievers.

entry: POKENAME若仍有鳃，就还年轻。几年后，头上的光会烧尽，鳃转而亮起。这是生命中的特别时刻，代表告别幼年。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: If a POKENAME still has gills, it is young. After a few years, the light on its head burns away and the gills light. This is a special moment in POKENAME's life, marking the transition away from youth.

entry: POKENAME若仍有鳃，就还年轻。几年后，头上的光会烧尽，鳃转而亮起。这是生命中的特别时刻，代表步入成年。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: If a POKENAME still has gills, it is young. After a few years, the light on its head burns away and the gills light. This is a special moment in POKENAME's life, marking the transition to adulthood.

entry: 周身火焰让POKENAME身体不断融化。为抵抗，它尽量多待在水下，维持凉爽。
author: autismgaming89_51746
source: POKENAME's body is constantly melting due to the flames surrounding it. To fight this, POKENAME will try to spend most of its time underwater to keep itself cool.

entry: POKENAME白天睡觉，吸收阳光，为超能力火焰储备燃料。盯着那火看得太久，就会受它控制。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME sleep during the day to gather sunlight to fuel their psychic flames. Staring at the flame for too long will put you under its control.

entry: POKENAME火焰强度直接联系周围生灵的情绪。它努力让同伴开心，以积极能量为食，自己也能更健康。
author: sk372
source: The strength of POKENAME's flames is directly tied to the emotional state of those around it. It tries its best to keep the mood of its companions up, so it can itself be in a healthier state as it feeds off their positive energy.

entry: POKENAME飞过古墓地，啄击太靠近隐蔽巢穴的对象。有人相信，它守护新近离世者。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME flies around ancient gravesites, pecking at those who wander too close to its hidden nest. Some believe it is a guard of those who recently departed.

entry: 只要头上的火焰不熄，就拥有高深智慧。似乎吞食情感维持火焰，尤其偏爱临终者的情绪。
author: infinex21
source: It has a vast intellect so long as the flame upon its head continues to burn. It appears to feed on emotions to keep its flame going, especially the emotions of those on the verge of death.

entry: POKENAME蜡身不断燃烧，产生的孢子也能一次烧数小时，因此是极佳探险伙伴。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have waxen bodies that are constantly burning. They produce spores that can burn for hours at a time, which make them perfect exploration buddies.

entry: POKENAME住在历史悠久的城堡、宫殿，躲进难以触及的角落。夜里啃蜡烛，添入自身，免得被火焰完全熔化。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME can be found in historic castles and palaces, living within nooks and crannies that are hard to reach. They emerge at night to feed on candles, gnawing through the wax to add to their own bodies so that their flame doesn't fully melt them.

entry: 古代王室习俗，会将POKENAME的珍珠放到已故统治者身上。人们相信，温热项链能安全引导灵魂前往来世。
author: .izik
source: Ancient royal customs called for POKENAME's pearls to be placed on deceased rulers. The heated necklace was believed to guide their souls safely to the afterlife.

entry: POKENAME壳里产生蜡状物，为火焰供能。采蜡制祈祷蜡烛，或为船防水，是许多沿海城市的传统产业。
author: jacknerik
source: POKENAME generate a waxy substance inside their shell to fuel their flame. Harvesting POKENAME wax to make prayer candles or waterproof boats is a traditional industry in many coastal cities.

entry: POKENAME进攻时，将爪上的蜡硬化成利刃。每次割伤都为吸取少许生命力，边打边躲，直到目标完全耗尽。
author: sk372
source: When POKENAME goes on the attack, it hardens the wax on its claws to a sharp edge. Each cut from its talons is meant to drain a bit of the victim's life force, striking and evading until its target is completely depleted.

entry: POKENAME住在久被遗忘的宅邸，以柔火照亮走廊。仿佛遵循永恒传统，世世代代、日复一日走同样路线。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can be found in long-forgotten estates where they illuminate hallways with soft flames. They follow a set path as if guided by a timeless tradition, following the same routine every day for generations.

entry: 从POKENAME壳中收集的蜡状物，会燃紫火。行动缓慢，让它得名“爬行蜡烛”。
author: oddwalls
source: The waxy substance collected from the shells of POKENAME burns with a purple flame. Their slow pace has earned them the nickname "creeping candles."

entry: 若在林中迷路，得留心看到的光。POKENAME会让人类、宝可梦绕圈，再吸取生命力维持自己。
author: notsaying.
source: If you are lost in the woods, be careful of any lights you may see. POKENAME leads both people and Pokémon in circles and drains their life force to sustain its own.

entry: POKENAME袋里装着大量摔炮。新年第一天，会成群聚集，将袋中的全部扔出，人们认为这是在庆祝。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME carries a large number of bang snaps in its bag. On the first day of the new year, groups of this Pokémon come together and throw all of their snaps out of their bag. It is believed that this is their way of celebrating.

entry: POKENAME身体不断滴热蜡。战斗时猛烈抖动，用蜡烫伤、拖慢对手。
author: mepp.
source: Hot wax constantly drips from POKENAME's body. It violently shakes its body during battle to singe and slow down opponents with this wax.

entry: POKENAME吸收屏幕光作燃料，最偏爱电脑显示器。父母告诫孩子，夜里要关屏，免得它吃过头，烧得太热，毁掉设备。
author: darkwolfe
source: POKENAME absorb light from screens and convert it to fuel, preferring computer monitors above all else. Parents warn their children to turn off their monitors at night, lest a POKENAME overfeed, burn too hot, and destroy their device.

entry: POKENAME本能寻找师父一同训练。但要求多、反复无常，又不太控制得住身上的火，让师父不好当。
author: dylonk25
source: POKENAME instinctually seek out a master to train with. The position is unenviable, as they are known to be demanding, capricious students with little control over the fire on their bodies.

entry: POKENAME在墓园、闹鬼宅邸附近寻找佛柑果，防御其他幽灵属性宝可梦。还会对镜数小时，确认头上的火焰仍亮。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME search for Kasib Berries near graveyards or haunted manors to help protect themselves against other Ghost-type Pokémon. They spend hours in front of mirrors to check if the fire on their head is still lit.

entry: 构成身体的融蜡，温度超过1,100华氏度。每次呼气，都释放能烧灼灵魂的紫色余烬。
author: h0bojoe
source: The melting wax that comprises its body exceeds 1,100 degrees Fahrenheit. Whenever it exhales, purple embers capable of burning spirits are released.

entry: POKENAME住在闹鬼之地，会到受惊探险者身边，递蜡烛照亮黑暗。握着能让身心温暖，更容易鼓起勇气面对可怕环境。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME lives in haunted locales, coming to the side of any frightened explorer and offering them its candle as a light in the darkness. Holding the candle provides physical and emotional warmth, making it easier to brave the spooky surroundings.

entry: POKENAME诞生于废弃多年的发电厂，吸取破旧机器与引擎的能量。负责停用拆卸设施的工程师常说，黑暗的走廊与大厅深处会出现幽异的蓝光。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME form within long-abandoned power plants, drawing energy from derelict machines and engines. Engineers decommissioning these facilities often report eerie blue lights deep in the dark corridors and halls.

entry: 药剂师曾磨碎POKENAME身体底部的宝石，拿来煮药水。据说这样制出的药效极强。
author: .izik
source: The gems at the base of POKENAME's body were once ground by apothecaries and used to boil potions. Brews made this way were said to be incredibly potent.

entry: 巢旁常能找到蜡质羽毛，像小蜡烛泛光，照出道路。训练家若遇见，最好别跟随，可能被误导、吸走生命力。
author: infinex21
source: Their waxy feathers are often found near their nests, glowing faintly like small candles that can light the way. If a Trainer ever spots one, it is advised to not follow it for it may attempt to feed on your life force while misguiding them.

entry: POKENAME蜡烛般的双臂完全点燃，就迅速吸取周围一切生命能量，直到双臂融化。再靠猎捕野生烛光灵，重建自己。
author: h0bojoe
source: Whenever POKENAME's candle arms are fully lit, it begins rapidly draining the life energy of everything around it until its arms melt. It rebuilds itself by hunting wild Litwick.

entry: POKENAME从脸颊发强光，引人靠近，吸取生命能量，再转成电力，供日后战斗。
author: leotpurple_48027
source: POKENAME shines a bright light from its cheeks to lure people in to absorb their life energy. It will then convert the energy into electricity, which will aid POKENAME in future battles.

entry: POKENAME在电脑里急切等下载，立刻跳进新数据，烧作能量。火太热会融蜡，因此更喜欢冷却充分的电脑，维持完整。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME eagerly awaits inside computers for new downloads so it can instantly jump in and burn all of the new data for energy. Its burning hot flame causes its wax body to melt, so it prefers to stay in heavily-cooled computers to keep intact.

entry: 野生POKENAME藏在城市边缘树上，吸路人生命力。偷得越多，火焰与自信就越盛。
author: h0bojoe
source: Wild POKENAME often hide in trees outside city perimeters and leech off the life force of any passerby. Both its flames and its confidence grow the more life it steals.

entry: POKENAME从高枝向不备猎物甩滚烫蜡狩猎。若无效，就尽量吸取生命力，再逃走。
author: h0bojoe
source: POKENAME hunts by flinging scalding wax at unsuspecting prey from atop high tree branches. If the wax is ineffective, it will opt to leech as much life force as it can and flee.

entry: POKENAME从高枝向不备猎物甩滚烫蜡狩猎。若无效，就尽量吸取生命力，再逃走。
author: h0bojoe
source: POKENAME hunts by flinging scalding wax at unsuspecting prey from atop high tree branches. If the wax is ineffective, it will opt to leech as much life force as it can and flee.

entry: POKENAME给树木涂上吸取生命力的蜡，占据森林。树便自动替它吸走路人生命力，让自己更强、猎物更弱。
author: h0bojoe
source: It claims forests by coating the trees with its life-draining wax. The trees passively leech the life off all passersby for POKENAME, granting it extra strength and weaker prey.

entry: POKENAME头顶有一簇闪烁的紫焰，高兴、想玩时，就会亮起来。它会点出小小的火花与火焰，把快乐传给身边的伙伴。
author: thepandasharky
source: POKENAME has a flickering purple flame atop its head that lights up whenever its happy and in a playful mood. It can ignite small sparks and flames, using its fire to spread its cheerful spirit.

entry: POKENAME将沼气存进蜡质身体，潜水时保护珍贵燃料，不受水侵。气体燃着诡异蓝光，令身体发亮；浮出水面，又释放幽火。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME capture swamp gas in their waxy bodies, protecting the precious fuel from the water as they dive beneath the surface. The gas burns an eerie blue, making them glow. When they surface, POKENAME emit a ghostly flame.

entry: POKENAME将沼气存进蜡质身体，潜水时保护珍贵燃料，不受水侵。气体燃着诡异蓝光，令身体发亮；浮出水面，又释放幽火。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME capture swamp gas in their waxy bodies, protecting the precious fuel from the water as they dive beneath the surface. The gas burns an eerie blue, making them glow. When they surface, POKENAME emit a ghostly flame.

entry: POKENAME潜在沼泽、泥潭边，昏暗中烧着异世紫光。引旅人离开安全路径，陷入家园的泥沼。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME lurk along the edges of swamps and quagmires, their bodies burning an unearthly purple in the gloom. They use their lights to lure travellers off the safe paths through their homes, getting the hapless people stuck.

entry: 野生POKENAME火焰不发热，在沼泽造出诡异紫火海。吞食困惑、恐惧，火就更高、更强，因此故意恐吓路过旅人。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The flames of wild POKENAME burn without heat, creating an eerie purple inferno in the swamps. Their flames burn higher and stronger when they can feed on confusion and fear, and they aim to terrify travellers passing by.
