entry: POKENAME被赠给现代贵族作侍从。不工作时，会与其他幽灵属性宝可梦玩！
author: skleegamer
source: POKENAME are given to modern-day nobles to serve as servants. These Pokémon play with other Ghost-type Pokémon when they aren't working!

entry: POKENAME对生灵很敏感，对方能量会让自己慢慢融化，因此用磁场吓走靠近家园的对象。
author: salt
source: POKENAME is sensitive to living beings. Their energy causes it to slowly melt. For this reason, it scares others away from its home using magnetic fields.

entry: 有了第二颗大脑后，就开始追逐生命力。但火焰因此更亮，让行动慢了许多。能感知60英里外的生命力。
author: salt
source: Now that it has a second brain, it starts pursuing life force. However, this makes its flame burn much brighter, slowing it down considerably. It can detect life force from 60 miles away.

entry: POKENAME身体融化，通常黏在地上。用头顶光吸引猎物，如今也能靠精神力量控制光芒。
author: salt
source: POKENAME are generally stuck to the ground due to their melted body. They attract their prey using the light on their head, which they now control using their psyche.

entry: 许多POKENAME住古代藏宝库，以阴森火焰照明。据说，体内有死在附近的寻宝者灵魂。
author: .izik
source: Many POKENAME dwell in ancient treasure vaults, illuminating the space with haunting flames. Their bodies are said to contain the souls of treasure hunters who perished nearby.

entry: 燃烧的颚自有意识，会咬向一切，吞噬猎物的灵魂。但它的本体却出奇地友善，常朝喜欢的训练家凑过去。
author: mistymagius
source: Its fiery jaw has a mind of its own and will chomp at anything to consume its victims' souls. Despite this, the main body is oddly friendly and wanders toward Trainers it likes.

entry: 据说，吃下用POKENAME的火烹煮的食物，会鲜明地梦见史前的远古海洋。
author: staghorn
source: It is said that eating food cooked over a POKENAME's flame will cause you to have vivid dreams of ancient, prehistoric oceans.

entry: POKENAME全身由硬蜡状物构成。头上的火焰点燃，蜡会变软，便能把脸蹭树干，磨平、重塑变形部位。
author: anonymous_moose
source: POKENAME's entire body is made up of a hard, waxy substance. When the flame atop its head is lit, this softens the wax, allowing POKENAME to polish and reshape any deformations by rubbing its face against tree trunks.

entry: POKENAME能感知人何时将死。一生善良者会被安抚，作恶者则遭嘲弄。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: POKENAME can sense when people are about to die. It will soothe those who were kind throughout their life and taunt those who were wicked.

entry: POKENAME飘过墓园，滴下的蜡留下踪迹。古文化视蜡为诅咒，严格避开。
author: .izik
source: As POKENAME floats through graveyards, wax drips from its body, marking its trail. In ancient cultures, the wax was seen as a curse and was strictly avoided.

entry: POKENAME空心身体，包在脆弱蜡壳中。叫声从胸内诡异回荡。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's hollow body is encased in a brittle, wax-like shell. Its cries echo eerily from within its chest.

entry: POKENAME常在渡送灵魂与吞食灵魂间挣扎。火越亮、蜡越融，就越烦躁，有时把怒火发泄在墓碑上。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are often conflicted between ferrying spirits and devouring them. The brighter their flame and the more melted their wax, the more upset they are. Sometimes POKENAME take their anger out on gravestones.

entry: POKENAME夜间游荡，蜡与散落余烬不断掉下。余烬不引火，反而吸走周围能量，再慢慢飘回，被门状结构吸收。
author: chibitales
source: As POKENAME wanders throughout the night, wax and stray embers drop from its body. The embers do not start fires, instead draining energy from the surrounding area before slowly floating back to and being absorbed by POKENAME's gate.

entry: POKENAME用背上火焰引虫宝可梦，夺走生命力。旅人若在森林发现多个被丢弃的外骨骼，它可能就在附近。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME attracts Bug Pokémon with the flames on its back, only to steal their life force. If a traveler finds multiple discarded exoskeletons in the forest, then POKENAME may be nearby.

entry: POKENAME的蜡熔点高，能长久附着重要文件，王室曾用作火漆。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's wax was once used by royalty as sealing wax due to its high melting point, which allowed it to adhere to important documents for extended periods.

entry: POKENAME用力摇头，把蜡溅到周围生灵身上。蜡有麻木作用，不易察觉，冷却时会慢慢吸走中招者的生命力。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME  vigorously shake their head to splatter their wax onto everyone around them. The wax has a numbing property, making it hard to notice its presence, wicking away the life force of those unfortunate enough to be struck as it cools.

entry: POKENAME的蜡虽然看不出来，其实相当耐用。生气时，火焰燃烧速度翻倍，因此必须频繁补蜡。
author: darxer_
source: Despite its appearance, the wax of POKENAME is quite durable. When angry, its flames will burn twice as fast, so it must replenish the wax frequently.

entry: 沙暴中，POKENAME让紫色火翼更亮，装作指路明灯。其实是引受害者进陷阱，好吸取生命力。
author: h0bojoe
source: During sandstorms, POKENAME brightens its flaming violet wings to appear as a guiding light. In reality, it is leading its victims into a trap so it can absorb their life force.

entry: POKENAME为迷失夜色的生灵引路，但待太久，活力会被吸走。它没有恶意，似乎只想帮忙，浑然不知自身危险。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME serve as guides for those lost in the dark of night, though one must beware lingering too long lest their vitality be siphoned. These Pokémon display no malice and seem to only wish to help, blissfully unaware of the danger they can pose.

entry: 据说，POKENAME身体的火焰永不熄灭，用来引导训练家穿过黑暗。性情极亲人，但碰到体表的蜡，会严重灼伤。
author: keiracm35_
source: The flames from POKENAME's bodies are said to burn eternally, and they use them to guide their trainers through darkness. POKENAME are very affectionate, but touching the wax covering their bodies can cause severe burns.

entry: POKENAME战斗必须小心，限制强力喷火器的使用。烈火的热量会让蜡状身体融化，失去稳定。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME must be careful when fighting and limit the use of its powerful flamethrower. The heat from the fire causes its wax-like body to begin melting and lose stability.

entry: POKENAME周围的幽灵能量，其实是薄薄一层电场，摸起来刺痛。受到惊吓，大眼便如手电筒亮起。
author: darxer_
source: The ghostly energy surrounding POKENAME is actually a thin electrical field that is prickly to the touch. When alarmed, its large eyes will brighten like flashlights.

entry: POKENAME夜间潜入民居，挪东西捉弄住户，吸食受害者的生命力与挫败情绪。留下的小蜡团，能让人发现来过。
author: vic1312
source: Appearing at night, POKENAME sneak into homes and prank the residents by moving things around, leeching the life force and frustration of those they torment. One can tell when POKENAME are about thanks to the small globs of wax they leave behind.

entry: 它向迷路的人类、宝可梦提出引路。但一带到僻静处，就想整个吞下。
author: .jerden
source: It offers itself as a guide to people and Pokémon that are lost. However, as soon as it has lead them to a secluded place, it will try to swallow them whole.

entry: POKENAME火焰比未融合个体猛烈得多。幽火难以控制，迫使它吸取周围能量，维持燃烧。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME burn with a far more intense flame than their unfused counterparts. The ghostly flame is difficult for them to control and forces them to drain energy from the surrounding area to sustain it.

entry: 它头上的帽子能变形，因为蜡温暖、易塑。但维持不久，就又被火熔回下垂模样。
author: deelee2020
source: This Pokémon has been known to change the shape of its hat, as the wax is warm enough to be malleable. The shape won't stay for long though - heat from the flame will melt it back to its drooped shape.

entry: POKENAME看似融化，蜡质身体却连极热也不融。工匠开始将少量坚硬蜡块混入自己的蜡，让蜡烛燃烧时长延长至十倍。
author: jaminmcready
source: Despite its melty appearance, POKENAME's waxy body doesn't melt under extreme heat. Artisans have started to mix small fragments of its rock-hard wax with their own to extend a candle's burn time tenfold.

entry: 高级宅邸用POKENAME照亮舞厅等场所。黑暗中火焰的光，被形容为超凡、幽幽动人的美。
author: sk372
source: High-class mansions have utilized POKENAME for lighting in ballrooms and the like. The light their flames cast in the darkness has been described as ethereally and hauntingly beautiful.

entry: POKENAME开心抓着收集的钥匙，但蜡质肢体撑不久，最终滴向地面。它慌忙捡回，才安心，却又开始同样循环。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME happily clutches its gathered keys, but its waxy limbs cannot hold them for long, eventually dripping to the ground. It panics and scrambles to pick them back up to calm itself, starting the cycle anew.

entry: 许多城堡在POKENAME住进后，便迅速被弃。它常被城堡中的能量吸引，假装灵魂向导，再俯冲抓猎物。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: Many castles have quickly been abandoned after POKENAME decide to stay and live in them. They are often attracted to castles due to the amount of energy within them, often pretending to be spirit guides before swooping down capturing their prey.

entry: POKENAME隐身接近受害者，吸取生命力时，火焰越来越亮。通常只有吃完一餐，身体才看得见。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME sneaks up on its victims while invisible, its flames glowing brighter as it feeds off their life force. Its body can usually only be seen after it successfully completes a meal.

entry: POKENAME十分聪明，会借拉帝欧斯的传说，引来好奇的人类与宝可梦，再装出温顺的样子，让对方不愿离去。与此同时，幽异的紫焰却不断吸走他们的生命力。
author: arcul
source: A highly intelligent Pokémon, POKENAME uses the lore surrounding Latios to entice curious Pokémon and humans to approach. It then keeps them close by displaying a docile nature, but all the while, its eerie purple flame saps their life force.

entry: POKENAME假扮森林向导，骗猎物跟随。靠近火焰，战意会渐被烧尽，让它毫无阻拦地攻击。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME pretends to be a forest guide, tricking its prey into following it. Being near its flames slowly burns away one's will to fight, allowing POKENAME to attack unimpeded.

entry: 传说，生日吹灭POKENAME的蜡烛，就能实现愿望。这不是真的，通常只会让它难受。
author: kiwiarms
source: Legend says one can have their wish granted by blowing out POKENAME's candles on their birthday. This is untrue, and generally just causes the POKENAME distress.

entry: 体内的热量不断熔化新生的蜡，因此它始终承受着巨大的痛苦。
author: jpeggio
source: The heat from its body causes the newly formed wax to melt. Due to this, it is constantly in immense agony.

entry: POKENAME很懒，只有必要才极慢移动。身体全是蜡，烈日下会开始融化，来不及躲荫就化成蜡水。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are quite lazy, moving incredibly slowly only when needed. Due to their bodies being made entirely of wax, these Pokémon will begin to melt in harsh sunlight, turning into puddles if unable to reach shade in time.

entry: 它靠其他生灵的生命力，为火焰双翼供能狩猎。燃料耗尽，狩猎几乎不可能，常最终饿死。
author: h0bojoe
source: It hunts with flaming wings fueled by the life force of others. Should its fuel run out, hunting becomes nearly impossible, often leading to starvation.

entry: POKENAME天性爱玩，仿佛孩童，会引领葬身海中的亡魂前往来世。紫色鳞片在夜里闪闪发光。
author: yoshimon
source: POKENAME are playful, almost childlike Pokémon that help guide those who lost their lives at sea to the afterlife. Their purple scales shine at night.

entry: POKENAME在废工厂中诡异地静止悬浮，向地板滴蜡。不知为何，从不完全融尽。
author: dylonk25
source: POKENAME can be found floating eerily motionless in abandoned factories, dripping wax onto the floor. Somehow, it never completely melts away.

entry: POKENAME睡时，蜡齿轮完全硬化。醒来必须迅速加热身体，才能重新转动。
author: .izik
source: While sleeping, POKENAME's waxy gears harden completely. Upon waking, it must heat its body quickly to begin rotating once more.

entry: POKENAME诡异地像古代洗翠的索罗亚。夜里火光数英里外可见，靠近却不会得到温暖。
author: atlas3339098
source: POKENAME eerily resembles a Zorua from ancient Hisui. The fire on its body can be seen for miles at night, but won't provide any warmth if approached.

entry: POKENAME所经之处留下蜡脚印，以火误导旅人，吸取生命力。头身火焰越大、越亮，距上次进食就越近。
author: alestrius
source: POKENAME leaves waxy footprints wherever it walks. It uses its fire to lead travelers astray and feed on their life force; the larger and brighter the flames on its head and body, the more recently it has fed.

entry: POKENAME用精神力量在膜外生火。能量让观看者头痛，有效阻止追逐。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's psychic powers let it emit a flame on the outside of its membrane. The fire's energy causes headaches in those who view it, serving as an effective way of dissuading pursuers.

entry: POKENAME埋在沙面下，火焰造成沙漠热浪幻影，骗旅人以为附近有绿洲。谁中计，就会受到攻击。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME spend their days buried just under the surface of the sand, their flames creating a heat shimmer in the desert that fools travellers into thinking there is an oasis around them. They strike out at anyone that falls for their ruse.

entry: 日落时，POKENAME成群飞出洞穴，燃烧的头照亮晚空。游客远道赶来，欣赏耀眼奇景。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME swarm out of caves at sunset, their flaming heads lighting up the evening sky. Tourists gather from afar to witness the dazzling display.

entry: POKENAME蜡身柔软、易塑，却摸着不舒服。身体冰冷，正是那诡异吸取周围人类、宝可梦生命能量的能力所致。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have waxy bodies that are pliable and unpleasant to the touch. Their bodies are cold, a result of their eerie ability to siphon the life energies of Pokémon and people around them.

entry: POKENAME诡异地飘在旧弃宅，闪焰中包着融蜡核心。遇训练家，火焰便把蜡塑成对方的脸，扭曲成恐惧表情。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME floats eerily in old abandoned mansions, a melted wax core within flickering flames. Should it meet a Trainer, the flames will mold the wax into a facsimile of the human's face, twisted in an expression of fear.

entry: POKENAME住在扭曲枯林，对旅人领地意识极强。任何踏进领地的对象，都会被从高处吐来的烫蜡击中。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME inhabits gnarled and dead woods, acting highly territorial towards travelers. It spits hot globs of molten wax down on anything that traipses into its territory.

entry: POKENAME用覆蜡双脚爬古墓墙，吐出的蜡热得堪比岩浆。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME scales the walls of ancient tombs using its wax-covered feet. The wax it spits is hot enough to rival lava.

entry: POKENAME大量吞孔雀石后，蜡身硬化，陷入沉睡。火焰转暗，避免被察觉。
author: .izik
source: After consuming large amounts of malachite, POKENAME's waxy body hardens, and it enters a deep slumber. Its flames dim to avoid detection.

entry: POKENAME看似被闹鬼烛蜡重新赋活的化石遗骸。每次呼吸，鼻中闪焰便旺起，火越大，心情越好斗。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME appears to be fossilized remains reanimated by haunted candle wax. With every breath it flares up a flickering flame from its nose; the larger the flame, the more aggressive its current mood.

entry: POKENAME摆动蜡翼，缓慢、优雅地跳舞。仔细听，似乎有不明来源的轻柔里拉琴旋律，配合动作。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME waves its waxy wings in slow, elegant dances. If one listens closely, a soft lyre melody seems to accompany its movements from an unknown source.

entry: POKENAME是友好的夜行生灵，却因气味像燃烧的垃圾，很难找到家。多半只有被火焰、气味引来的小虫陪伴。
author: sk372
source: A friendly creature of the night, POKENAME has trouble finding homes due to the stench it emanates being akin to burning refuse. It mostly finds company in small insects drawn to its flames and its odor.

entry: 它用头上的火焰诱来毫无戒心的猎物，同时吸取能量。待对方虚弱得足够厉害，便整个吞下。
author: hypernovahusky
source: Using the flames on its head, it lures unsuspecting prey in whilst draining its energy. Once a victim is weak enough, it swallows them whole.

entry: 它为宝可梦引路穿过海洋，一路却都在吸走生命力。等宝可梦死去，POKENAME便吃掉遗体。
author: darkweavile428
source: It guides Pokémon though the ocean, draining their life force all the while. When the Pokémon passes away, POKENAME consumes their corpse.

entry: POKENAME灵体身躯如闷火发光，头部漏出融蜡。在林火烧过的空地，穿行焦树之间，留下长长蜡迹。
author: pattybgoode
source: POKENAME's ethereal body glows like a smoldering fire, and its head leaks melted wax. In clearings burned by a wildfire, it leaves long trails of wax as it wanders amongst the charred trees.

entry: 火焰热量让POKENAME翼上的蜡不断融化，拖重身体，因此主要蹦跳，不试着飞。
author: sk372
source: The heat from POKENAME's flames keeps the wax on its wings in a constantly melting state. This weighs it down quite a bit, so it travels primarily by hopping rather than attempting to fly.

entry: POKENAME翱翔天际，唱着和谐的旋律。歌声引来其他宝可梦，它便吸取对方的生命力。
author: deciduowl
source: POKENAME flies in the skies singing a harmonious melody. Its song draws other Pokémon in, and it absorbs the life force out of them.

entry: 虫属性宝可梦被POKENAME触角的火引来，困在沿途融蜡。它随后回来，吸取生命力。
author: potatoforged
source: Bug-type Pokémon lured by the flames on POKENAME's antennae are trapped in the trail of melted wax it leaves behind. POKENAME returns later to feed on their life force.

entry: 融合时，烛光灵的幽火点燃雷吉艾斯体内神秘能量，让POKENAME不断融化。
author: phantom640
source: Litwick's ghostly flame caused the mysterious energy coursing through Regice to ignite upon fusion, leaving POKENAME constantly melting.

entry: POKENAME花瓣由淡紫色蜡组成，融化散花香。蜡滴落时颜色加深、更紫，常被收集制花香蜡烛。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME's petals are formed of a lilac wax that gives off a floral scent as it melts. The colour of the wax deepens and becomes more purple as it drips away, with drops often being collected to make floral candles.

entry: POKENAME从一块墓碑跃到另一块，练杂技跳跃，每次落地都留蜡脚印。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME trains by performing acrobatic leaps from gravestone to gravestone, leaving behind waxy footprints with every landing.

entry: POKENAME花瓣呈凹盘状，燃烧时留住蜡。太兴奋，火便更热、花瓣融得更快，下垂盖住眼睛。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME's petals are dished to help retain wax as their flame burns. If they get too excited, their flame burns hotter and melts their petals faster, making them droop down and cover their eyes.

entry: POKENAME能吸收平时与身体不相容的东西，很难赶走。水与火都能吸，令科学家着迷，虽然不能同时吸收。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are difficult to get rid of because they can be observed absorbing things typically incompatible with their body. Their ability to absorb water and fire fascinates scientists, even if they cannot do both at the same time.

entry: 民间传说，游魂融入蜡烛最后的一点残焰，便诞生了POKENAME。它能重塑蜡质的身体，仿出各种蜡烛造型，几乎与寻常物件无异。
author: rakunk
source: According to folklore, POKENAME was formed when the last flicker of a candle was imbued with a wandering spirit. Its waxy body can reshape itself to mimic various candle designs, making it nearly indistinguishable from ordinary objects.

entry: POKENAME长的真菌带蜡状质地，保护身体免受火攻。菇顶一束蓝火稳定燃烧，生命力却被寄生者渐渐吸干。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The wax-like texture of the fungus growing from POKENAME protects them from fiery attacks. A steady blue flame burns at the top of their mushroom, their life force gradually being sapped and drained by their parasite.

entry: POKENAME将死时，会把融蜡撒遍草坪、街道、花园。蜡能当种子，长出新的同类。
author: dodoowner_
source: When they're bout to die, POKENAME will be seen melting wax all over lawns, streets, and gardens. They do this as their wax acts as seeds to grow new POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME住在黑暗洞穴深处，用火焰照亮周围。迷路探险者被光吸引，游走时就会缓缓失去能量。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME lives in the depths of dark caves, lighting its surroundings with its flames. Any lost explorers drawn to its light will be slowly drained of energy as they wander.

entry: POKENAME长的真菌带蜡状质地，保护身体免受火攻。菇顶一束蓝火稳定燃烧，生命力却被寄生者渐渐吸干。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The wax-like texture of the fungus growing from POKENAME protects them from fiery attacks. A steady blue flame burns at the top of their mushroom, their life force gradually being sapped and drained by their parasite.

entry: POKENAME长的真菌带蜡状质地，保护身体免受火攻。菇顶一束蓝火稳定燃烧，生命力却被寄生者渐渐吸干。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The wax-like texture of the fungus growing from POKENAME protects them from fiery attacks. A steady blue flame burns at the top of their mushroom, their life force gradually being sapped and drained by their parasite.

entry: POKENAME背部寄生蘑菇随一生慢慢烧尽，最终留下结实蜡团。残余能隔热、防潮，却也拖累。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The parasitic mushroom on the backs of POKENAME gradually burns out over their life, eventually leaving them with a solid waxy mass atop their back. The remnants of the mushroom protect them from both heat and moisture, but encumber them.

entry: POKENAME花数小时梳理蜡状毛，清掉杂屑，可燃的就吃。它无害地吸取其他生灵微量生命力，维持鲜亮火焰。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME spend many hours grooming their wax-like fur to remove any debris that gets caught, eating any flammable materials they find. They harmlessly siphon trace amounts of life force from others to sustain their vibrant flames.

entry: 皮肤通透性很高，因此身体有被晒干的风险。白天便分泌厚蜡，将自己包裹保护。
author: hophoppip
source: Its skin is quite permeable, so its body is at risk of drying up in the sun. To protect it during the day, it secretes a thick wax and coats itself.

entry: 蜡质外层保护皮肤，不受自身火焰的热量伤害。吸取人类生命力，就像吸水一样容易。
author: hophoppip
source: Its waxy coating protects its skin from the heat of its flames. It absorbs human life force as easily as water.

entry: POKENAME只在夜间火山区被看见，火焰散出缥缈烟雾。必须快点进食，因为离壳太久，蜡身会硬化、无法移动。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is only spotted at night near volcanic areas, casting ethereal smoke from its flames. It must feed quickly, as its waxy body will harden and become immobile if outside its shell for too long.

entry: POKENAME住在紫苑镇的宝可梦塔，常陪着神婆、祈祷师。流行传闻说，火焰旺起就是吸了灵魂，其实只是打鼾。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME can be spotted living in Lavender Town Tower, often accompanying Mediums and Channelers. A popular rumor claims that when POKENAME's flames flare, it has absorbed a soul; in actuality, the flames flare whenever POKENAME snores.

entry: POKENAME与烛光灵共生，以光为食，提供庇护。谁威胁，就吸生命力；住的烛光灵越多，效果越强。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME form a symbiotic relationship with Litwick, feeding off the light they produce while giving them shelter. They will drain the life force of anyone who threatens them, an effect that grows stronger the more Litwick they house.

entry: POKENAME像烛光灵棉花糖可可一样滚烫。头上融下的柔软糖团，被加进咖啡、热巧克力，维持热度。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are as piping hot as a Hot Litwick Cocoa drink. The soft sugary blobs that melt from their heads are added to coffees and hot chocolate to keep the drinks hot.

entry: 各地商人珍视POKENAME芳香、燃烧洁净的蜡。身体制成的一根烛，就能让房间散发甜薰衣草香，超过一周。
author: jaminmcready
source: Merchants across the region prize POKENAME for its fragrant, clean-burning wax. A single candle made from its body can keep a room smelling like sweet lavender for over a week.

entry: POKENAME用多余生命能量，制造幽灵液体，装在头顶蜡盘。发现人类，便顽皮倾盘，倒到对方头上。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME uses its excess life energy to create a ghostly liquid that is kept in the wax dish on top of its head. When it spots a human, it mischievously tips this dish over to spill the ghostly fluid over their heads.

entry: POKENAME体表融蜡不断移动。它往敌人脸上泼，遮住视线，再用火花了结。
author: .izik
source: The molten wax coating POKENAME's body shifts constantly. It splashes this wax into a foe's face to blind them before finishing them off with Ember.

entry: POKENAME用蜡做钥匙模具，打开保险箱，再将财宝存进蜡质身体。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME break into safes by making key molds out of wax. Once they are able to access the contents of a safe, they store the goodies in their waxy body.

entry: POKENAME在壁炉上方休息，热量维持蜡身柔软。火温合适，就会开心地轻声呼噜。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can be found resting above fireplaces where the hot temperature keeps their waxy body soft. When the fire is at the right temperature, they softly purr with delight.

entry: POKENAME的蜡让身体更流线、减少阻力，能高速游泳。游时将尾巴露水，造成火焰掠过水面的诡异幻象。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME wax allows them to achieve high speeds while swimming, streamlining their body and reducing drag. They keep their tail above the water while swimming, creating an eerie illusion of a flame racing across the surface.

entry: POKENAME越烦躁，火焰越亮。愤怒时化成烈火，熔软蜡身，让它迅速投入战斗。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME flames burn brighter the more agitated they are. When they are angry, their flames become a fierce blaze, melting their waxy bodies and letting them move swiftly into the fight.

entry: POKENAME穿行旧屋，寻找愿意满怀关爱对待自己的对象。小蜡爪印散在久弃房屋附近，记录着这些灵体宝可梦的日常。
author: quackquackattack
source: Scampering through vintage houses, POKENAME search for someone to shower them with affection. Their tiny, waxy pawprints can be found in the vicinity of these long-abandoned homes, cataloguing the daily activities of these ethereal Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME醒着很快消耗生命能量，因此大多时间睡，只在有什么靠得太近时醒来，吸其生命力。
author: calelian
source: When POKENAME is awake, it burns through life energy rapidly. Therefore, it spends most of its time asleep, only waking to feed on the life force of whoever comes too close.

entry: 身体虽是蜡，力量却极大。锻炼时会硬化，运作方式诡异地像肌肉组织。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Despite its body being made of wax, it is incredibly strong. The wax hardens as it trains through exercise, operating eerily similar to muscle tissue.

entry: POKENAME蜡质身体很难按住。它制服敌人后，将对方躯体物质吸收进自身，让头顶烛芯烧得更亮、更久。
author: foolish_weasel
source: This Pokémon is notoriously difficult to pin down due to the wax that makes up its body. Once POKENAME has pinned a foe into submission, it absorbs their mass into its wax body, allowing the wick on its head to burn brighter and longer.

entry: POKENAME遇险就缩蜡身入壳，在开口留火保护。成群玩耍却常黏在一起，需要帮忙分开蜡。
author: pjporwoll
source: When danger is present, POKENAME easily withdraws its waxy body into its shell, leaving the flame at the opening as a protective ward. When a group of POKENAME play, they tend to get stuck together and need help disentangling their wax.

entry: POKENAME会吸取未先赢得其信任或尊重的骑乘者的生命力。蜡状身体不断脱落，但“蜡”永不耗尽，也从不完全硬化。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME leech off the life force of all who ride upon them without first gaining their trust or respect. Their bodies are like wax that is always being shed, yet this "wax" never depletes and never fully hardens.

entry: 它在溪河边懒躺，摆动火焰，引来许多更小的宝可梦。似乎早忘了为何这样做，却仍在夜间为许多训练家照路。
author: infinex21
source: It waves its flame around while lazing near rivers and streams, attracting many other Pokémon smaller than it. Though it seems to have long forgotten why it does this, it still serves as a guiding light for many Trainers at night.

entry: POKENAME漂在危险泥沼，耳尾幽光引来不备猎物，吸走生命力。但迷路孩子会被安然引出，原因不明。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME floats in dangerous bogs with the haunting glow of its ears and tail acting as a lure for unaware prey it can leech life force from. It will lead lost children out of its swampy habitat unharmed, though it is unknown why it helps them.

entry: POKENAME旋转穿过城市街道，兴奋间不慎散火。动作飘忽，又无法完全控制紫焰，常点燃干燥建筑。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME zip through city streets spinning, accidentally scattering stray flames in their excitement. Their erratic movements frequently set dry structures ablaze, as they cannot fully control their purple flames.

entry: POKENAME越健康，头上的火焰就闪得越盛。吐息极易燃，手持燃棒在战斗中，也能充当简易喷火器。
author: sk372
source: The flame on POKENAME's head flickers more if POKENAME is in good health. Its breath is extremely flammable, so the lit stick it carries also functions as a makeshift flamethrower in combat.

entry: 火焰如跳动的心脏。一团若闪烁、将熄，另一颗头就靠近，用自身火焰维持燃烧。
author: _refuse_
source: Their flames serve as beating hearts. When one begins to flicker and risks going out, the other head leans in to keep it burning with its own flame.

entry: 它在冰水里涉行，寻找经过的船。冬季雾海中若跟随幽火，就会试图让船失事。
author: bandedbodypress
source: It wades in icy waters, searching for passing ships. If you follow its ghostly flame on a foggy winter sea, it will attempt to shipwreck you.

entry: 严寒中的旅人别用POKENAME火焰取暖。即使感觉温暖，其实正吸走生命能量。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Travelers in frigid cold should not attempt to use POKENAME's flame to warm them. Even though it may feel warm, it is sapping your life energy.

entry: POKENAME由活蜡组成，很耐高热。即使融化，冷却后又会重组，几乎无伤。
author: deniablecredibility
source: Made of living wax, POKENAME is able to tolerate significant amounts of heat. If it melts, it will just reform again when it cools, relatively unharmed.

entry: POKENAME能从壳上炮口喷射火焰或融蜡。四肢似由蜡与燃烧灵质混合，硬化成可操纵的肢体。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME can launch flame jets or molten wax from the cannons protruding from its shell. The arms and legs seem to be formed from a mixture of its wax and the flaming ectoplasm, hardening into limbs it can manipulate.

entry: POKENAME飞行时，滴蜡香味随心情变化。蜡毒性极强，不能接触裸露皮肤。
author: .izik
source: The wax dripping from POKENAME's body shifts in scent based on its mood as it flies. This wax is incredibly toxic and should not come into contact with exposed skin.

entry: POKENAME住在富矿废井，据传有失踪矿工的灵魂。用火焰吐息熔开石头，造浅坑，蜷入休息。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME makes its home in mineral-rich abandoned mines rumored to house the spirits of lost miners. Using its fiery breath, it melts rock and stone into a shallow crater where it curls up to rest.

entry: POKENAME身体坚固，能抵御、躲避多种攻击。但所附金属架限制活动范围，同时收集、重用融下的蜡。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME's sturdy body allows it to withstand and evade many kinds of attacks. However, its movement is limited by the reach of the metallic stand it inhabits, which collects and reuses wax melted from its body.

entry: POKENAME凝望别人梦境，火就更亮。它开心吃噩梦，细品恐惧。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's flame flickers brighter when it gazes into someone's dream. It gleefully devours bad dreams, savoring the fear.

entry: POKENAME虽小，食欲却旺，为进化尽量吸收养分。火焰引来其他昆虫，靠太近就点燃。
author: heal_fire
source: Despite POKENAME's size, it has a voracious appetite, trying to get as many nutrients as possible to get ready for evolution. POKENAME uses its flame to attract other insects toward itself, setting them alight when they're too close.

entry: POKENAME能把灵魂能量直接转电，吸太多就爆炸。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME can convert spirit energy directly into electricity. If it absorbs too much, it will explode.

entry: POKENAME安慰哀悼亡童的人，吃掉悲伤，帮助找回平静，继续生活。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME comforts those who are mourning a late child. It consumes their sorrows, helping them find peace in their lives and move on.

entry: POKENAME最初几年住活火山，需要热量构筑身体。大部分是玻璃，骨棒与头罩更由黑曜石玻璃组成，因此极怕钝击。
author: _pixelar_
source: POKENAME live their first few years on active volcanoes, as they need the heat to build up their bodies. They are very vulnerable to blunt force, as they are mostly made up of glass, with their club and head covering being composed of obsidian glass.

entry: POKENAME喂得越多，火越热，烟也渐浓。古时，强盗抢劫前会过量投喂，用浓烟完全遮住踪迹。
author: jaminmcready
source: The flame of a POKENAME burns hotter the more it is fed, causing its smoke to thicken overtime. Historically, bandits would overfeed this Pokémon before a heist, using its dense smoke to completely cover their tracks.

entry: POKENAME虽然能造巨量烈火，却努力收敛，以免熔掉小头。悬浮时小心保持小头平衡，常往后旋转修正。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: While a POKENAME is able to produce incredible amounts of fire, it tries to hold back to avoid melting its smaller head. It balances the smaller head carefully, often spinning backwards to correct itself while floating.

entry: 夜里感到迷失、孤独、病弱的人，可能得到POKENAME拜访。腹部火光振奋精神，许多人将幸存归功于及时到来。
author: sk372
source: Those feeling lost, alone and ill in the night may be visited by POKENAME. The light emanating from the flame in its belly rejuvenates the spirit, and many attribute their survival to its timely visit.

entry: POKENAME夜间深入水中捕猎，通常找墨海马。吐出墨汁、烟、火的有毒混合物，猎物接触几秒就轻易失去行动力。
author: sk372
source: Deep in the water at night, POKENAME goes hunting, typically seeking out Horsea. It breathes out a toxic mix of ink, smoke and fire that easily incapacitates prey within seconds of exposure.

entry: POKENAME阴森地潜在浅水，捕食小水宝可梦。诡火引出灵魂，只留虚弱、毫无生气的身体在水下。
author: curazy
source: POKENAME is a sinister fusion that lurks in shallow waters, preying on smaller water Pokémon. It uses its eerie flame to draw out their spirits, leaving them weak and lifeless beneath the surface.

entry: POKENAME火焰受胶状穹顶保护，水下也不会浇灭。催眠效果迫人类、宝可梦靠近，再吸取生命精华。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's flame is protected by a gelatinous dome that keeps it from being doused while underwater.  The flame has a hypnotic effect that can compel Pokémon and people to come near, whereupon POKENAME drains their life essence.

entry: POKENAME易握、好照料，幼童常当随身夜灯。它极其保护照顾自己的孩子。
author: beetlething
source: Young children often keep a POKENAME as a portable nightlight, as it is easy to hold and fairly low maintenance. It is extremely protective over the child that looks after it.

entry: POKENAME造光墙，照亮夜间暗街，给旅人安慰与安全。也常以墙封住危险地带。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME creates walls of light that illuminate darkened streets at night. This provides travelers with some solace as well as safety, as POKENAME often puts these walls up to block hazardous areas.

entry: POKENAME刀状双臂由易碎玻璃组成。暴怒时加热到极高温，甩出熔融碎片，烧伤敌人。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's bladelike arms are made of fragile glass. When enraged, it superheats them and flings molten shards to burn foes.

entry: 据说POKENAME会现身于刚失去亲友的悲伤者面前，既令人宽慰，又令人不安。有人相信它能引领迷途的灵魂，也有人担心它会把对方引向悲伤的深渊。
author: rakunk
source: POKENAME is said to appear to those grieving a recent loss, offering a comforting yet unsettling presence. Some believe the Pokémon guides lost souls, while others fear it leads them into the depths of their sorrow.

entry: POKENAME半透明角内，发光融蜡缥缈漂浮。都市传说说，寒夜见到光的人，很快就会死。
author: pjporwoll
source: A glowing, molten wax ethereally floats within the translucent horns of POKENAME. Urban legend says that whoever sees the lights of a POKENAME on a cold night will soon die.

entry: POKENAME玻璃状身体，背有金属壳。吞食的怨灵，让体内紫焰猛烈、明亮。
author: thezekrom
source: POKENAME has a glassy body with a metallic shell on its back. The purple flame inside rages bright with the vengeful spirits it consumes.

entry: POKENAME漆黑身体融入夜色，常被误认为水上浮灯。据说以火焰承载迷途灵魂，引向来世。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME's jet-black body blends into the darkness, causing them to often be mistaken for a lantern floating across the water at night. These Pokémon are said to guide lost spirits to the afterlife, carrying them within their flames.

entry: POKENAME开心时，尾巴发强光。鬃毛如火舞动，摸着却清凉。
author: .izik
source: When happy, POKENAME's tail glows with intense light. Its mane dances like fire but remains cool to the touch.

entry: 极偶尔，POKENAME察觉附近油灯点亮，就会顽皮吹灭，再消失。本是玩笑，突然出现、光又熄灭，却让许多人深深不安。
author: .izik
source: On rare occasions, POKENAME will sense an oil lamp being lit nearby and playfully blow it out before vanishing. While intended as a joke, many find the sudden appearance and extinguished light deeply unsettling.

entry: POKENAME曾用于送信，发光火焰让最黑夜里也找得到。成群个体至今仍栖在废弃的鸟类群栖地。
author: geo_ominous
source: POKENAME were once used to deliver letters, their glowing flames helping them to be found even in the darkest of nights. Flocks of POKENAME still reside in abandoned rookeries to this day.

entry: POKENAME体内可见的火焰，以自身生命力为燃料。强烈情绪让火猛亮，战斗时用来发动强大幽灵、火属性攻击。
author: nyoomymph
source: The flame visible inside POKENAME is powered by its life force. Strong emotions make it flare brightly. In battle, POKENAME uses this flame to create powerful Ghost and Fire attacks.

entry: POKENAME不懂休息，明亮的脸让它时刻清醒。传闻住在海底，只为护送溺亡灵魂。
author: thistleblower
source: POKENAME has no concept of rest; its bright face keeps it alert at all times. It is rumored that it only lives on the sea floor to escort drowned souls.

entry: 据说，纯洁之心的人迷失暗处，POKENAME就会现身。体内火焰照亮四周，引向远离黑暗的安全地。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is said to appear before those with pure hearts when lost in dark areas. It illuminates its surroundings with the fire in its body, guiding the person towards a safe haven from the darkness.

entry: 夜里，栖林的POKENAME常被误认为煤气路灯，让旅人迷路。受惊能以2马赫飞走，独留迷路者在黑暗。
author: geo_ominous
source: POKENAME roosting in forests are often mistaken for gas streetlamps at night, leading travelers astray. When spooked, POKENAME can fly off at Mach 2, leaving lost travelers in the dark.

entry: POKENAME住墓园，为探望亡亲的人提供柔光。据说会在新墓旁轻舞，仿佛安抚新灵魂安息。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME reside in graveyards, providing gentle light to mourners who visit their late loved ones. It is said they can be seen gently dancing near the graves of those recently passed, as if they are soothing the new spirit to rest.

entry: POKENAME微光对其他小拉达有无法抗拒的催眠吸引，常成群追随。训练家开始用它引出闹鼠患地区的害兽。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's light emits a faint illumination that other Rattata find irresistible, flocking after the hypnotic light. Trainers have begun using it to lure out pests from areas with rodent infestations.

entry: POKENAME靠近将死之人，鳃就会发光。极少离水，因此陆上见到，被当作坏兆。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME's gills glow when they are near someone that is soon to die. They rarely leave the water, so seeing one on land is taken as a bad omen.

entry: 与“有人将死就现身”的迷信相反，POKENAME无忧无虑，大多无害。它在沼泽悠闲地躺着，留心照看小宝可梦的晚间玩闹。
author: pjporwoll
source: Contrary to superstition that it appears when someone is about to die, POKENAME is carefree and mostly harmless. Found in marshlands, it lounges, keeping a watchful eye over the evening antics of younger Pokémon.

entry: 这些黑暗宝可梦常被看见聚向将自然离世的人。有些故事说，赶走它们，甚至能暂时赶走死亡。
author: infinex21
source: These dark Pokémon have oft been spotted flocking toward those who are nearing their natural ends. Some stories claim that by warding away these Pokémon, you may even be able to ward away death for a time.

entry: POKENAME在弃宅、古堡群居，吱叫着成群飘行，寻找温暖。探险训练家很吸引它，走廊中诡异的紫光，是靠近的第一征兆。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME form colonies within abandoned mansions and castles, drifting through the air in chittering groups in search of warmth. They are drawn to exploring Trainers, the eerie purple light illuminating the corridors the first sign of their approach.

entry: POKENAME近乎平面的脸里烧着神秘火焰，光从顶盖反射，照亮下方。它飘过古洞，照出失落文明的符文。
author: quackquackattack
source: Mysterious flames burn from within the nearly flat faces of POKENAME, creating a glow beneath them as light reflects off their caps. They float around ancient caves, illuminating runes of civilizations lost to time.

entry: POKENAME常被误认普通灯，完全静止以免被发现。诡火吸走周围生灵活力，受影响者常因疲倦而被抓。
author: korro0490
source: Commonly mistaken for a normal lamp, POKENAME stand perfectly still to avoid detection. Their eerie flames drain the vitality of those around them, with the fatigue induced by this effect often leading them to be caught.

entry: POKENAME以隐藏丝线挂在洞顶。梦中，内部火焰迅速脉动，投下奇怪影子。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME hangs from cave ceilings by hidden threads. As it dreams, the flame within pulses rapidly, casting strange shadows.

entry: POKENAME身体由熔融玻璃组成，爬上洞壁安全睡觉，远离地面生灵。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body is composed of molten glass. It slithers up cave walls to sleep in safety, far from creatures that dwell on the ground.

entry: POKENAME嚎过，脚掌便发亮紫光，提升速度，迅速追猎。
author: .izik
source: After howling, POKENAME's paws glow with a bright violet light. This glow boosts its speed, allowing it to swiftly chase down prey.

entry: 它体内不断燃起紫焰，发出苍白的光。POKENAME借头顶的灯罩，让光均匀地散向四周。
author: chorb33
source: It constantly creates purple flames in its body. These cause a pale light, which POKENAME can radiate evenly using the lampshade on its head.

entry: 有人进入隐蔽林间空地，POKENAME巨大金属角便升温。只有感知对方心善，才放松警惕。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's large, metallic antlers heat up when someone enters its hidden glade. It only lowers its guard if it senses kindness in their heart.

entry: POKENAME转得越快，头内火焰越大。能量导入四肢，点燃、增强攻击。
author: sk372
source: As the speed of POKENAME's rotation increases, so too does the size of the flame within its head. The flame's energy channels into its limbs, setting them ablaze and strengthening its attacks.

entry: POKENAME能从躯干同时射出四道火流，造成骇人灼伤。虽有些好斗，献上鲜奶，就能暂时安抚。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can launch four simultaneous streams of fire from its torso that can leave ghastly burns on those hit. While mildly aggressive, offering it fresh milk will placate it for a time.

entry: 凝望POKENAME火焰，会被迷住，听见奇怪咒语低语。传言盯太久，便被斗篷包围，自己也变成同类。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Those that gaze into a POKENAME's flames will find themselves transfixed as they hear whispers of odd incantations. Rumors say that those that stare for too long will find themselves surrounded by a POKENAME's cloak, becoming a POKENAME themselves.

entry: POKENAME战斗时用厚藤保护脆弱灯笼。灯不断换位，避开攻击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its thick vines to shield its delicate lanterns during battle. The lights constantly shift position to avoid incoming attacks.

entry: 它吸取亡者灵魂，为手臂里凶恶的火焰供能。发射的火球烧尽肉体与灵魂，不留一物。
author: h0bojoe
source: It absorbs the spirits of the fallen to fuel the baleful fire in its arms. The fireballs it launches from them incinerate body and soul, leaving nothing behind.

entry: 野生POKENAME好奇光源，常因此彼此跟随。自己的倒影也能分心，盯着自身火焰好几分钟。
author: sk372
source: One can often find POKENAME following each other in the wild, as their natural curiosity compels them to investigate light sources. They also can be distracted by their own reflection, staring at their own flame for minutes at a time.

entry: POKENAME精通死灵法术，能随心操纵生与死的能量。据说，与它结为朋友就能获得永生。
author: klgb76
source: POKENAME are highly skilled necromancers, capable of bending life and death energy to their will. It is said that befriending one can grant eternal life.

entry: POKENAME霓虹身体常当商店广告，挥舞提手般双臂，吸引顾客注意。
author: _refuse_
source: POKENAME's neon body is often used as an advertisement for shops. It waves its handle-like arms to attract the attention of customers.

entry: POKENAME体内燃烧着已故战士的灵魂，但身形小，战斗只能使出炽热冲撞。
author: lampent12
source: Within the body of POKENAME, the spirit of a deceased fighter burns, but its small stature limits its combat ability to heated tackles.

entry: POKENAME头中的幽灵烛火燃得炽烈，能照亮大片区域。它天生好战，会裹挟灼热的幽焰冲向敌人，将沿途战场点燃。
author: thepandasharky
source: POKENAME burns with a fierce glow, a spectral candle in its head that can illuminate a wide area. Known for its fighting instincts, it charges at foes with blazing ghostly attacks, igniting the battlefield in its wake.

entry: POKENAME如今全身心投入战斗，飞扑各目标，一踢击倒，再吸生命力疗伤。
author: lampent12
source: Now fully embracing its fighting spirit, POKENAME soars from target to target in battle, striking them down in a single kick and absorbing their life force to heal its wounds.

entry: 大雨后，POKENAME在落水管下休息，水打在圆顶头上，如雨点敲鼓。每滴空灵鸣响，组成据说能唤醒死者的旋律。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME rests below downspouts after a heavy rain, as the water bounces off its dome-shaped head like a rain drum. Each drop creates an ethereal ring, forming a melody that is rumored to awaken the dead.

entry: POKENAME游荡弃屋，脸边火焰散出诡光。偏爱独处，便静静引旅人到出口，好尽快恢复清静。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME roams abandoned homes, the flames around its face casting an eerie glow. It prefers to be alone, so travelers are quietly guided to the exit so it can more quickly return to its solitude.

entry: POKENAME进入战斗，肘间伸出覆火硬蜡刀刃。傍晚巡视步道，击退想趁夜作恶的对象。
author: sk372
source: Blades of hardened wax coated in flame extend from POKENAME's elbows when it enters combat. It patrols walkways during evenings, fighting off those who would try to commit evil in the dark of the night.

entry: POKENAME身体极脆弱，不小心一碰就会碎。除非充分准备面对危险，否则一动不动。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body is incredibly delicate; one careless touch can shatter it. It remains motionless unless fully prepared for danger.

entry: POKENAME现身临终床边，收取灵魂，为耳中紫火供能。墨黑皮肤满是分泌致命毒素的刺，作为身体防御。
author: shivaequinox
source: POKENAME appears at the bedside of the dying to harvest their spirits, fueling the purple flames from its ears. Its ink-black hide is covered in venomous barbs that secrete a lethal toxin, serving as a mechanical defense.

entry: 这种宝可梦漂浮，收集生灵的能量。强大磁力，也让POKENAME互相吸引。
author: salt
source: This Pokémon floats around, collecting energy from living beings. They are attracted to other POKENAME due to their strong magnetic powers.

entry: POKENAME火焰形体内的灵魂已挣脱禁锢，如今想聚集更多灵魂。特别憎恶灯笼等容器，会猛加热到炸开，释放里面的火。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Having broken free from containment, the souls within the flaming form of POKENAME now seek to grow their numbers. They have a distinct hatred for lanterns or similar structures, rapidly superheating them until they burst to free the flames inside.

entry: POKENAME聚向将孤独死去的人，陪伴最后时刻，因此被当作死亡之兆。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: POKENAME gather near those who will die alone, providing companionship in their final moments. This behaviour has given it a reputation as an omen of death.

entry: POKENAME身体前部演化出透明穹顶，可看见内部火焰。在暗海，靠火引猎物，吸收灵魂。
author: _pixelar_
source: POKENAME has evolved a transparent dome at the front of its body, through which its inner flame can be seen. In the darkness of the ocean, POKENAME uses this flame to lure its prey and to absorb their spirits.

entry: 旅人来不及走出森林，POKENAME就友善引路。但只是在等受害者逝去，偷走灵魂。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME acts as a friendly guide when travelers can't find their way out of a forest in time. However, POKENAME is only waiting to steal its victims' spirits when they pass on.

entry: POKENAME灵巧地跃过树顶，先在尾上烤蕉香果，再边跳边吃。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME leaps through treetops with fiery agility. It roasts Nanab Berries over its tail before eating them mid-jump.

entry: 战斗结束后，POKENAME便出现在战场，收集阵亡士兵的灵魂。战争期间，它们的光格外耀眼。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME appears at the sites of concluded battles to collect the spirits of fallen soldiers. They shine brilliantly during wartime.

entry: POKENAME微光漂过夜色，始终寻找配得上的对手。一见就打，仿佛接续从未打完的一战。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Faintly glowing as they drift through the night, POKENAME are always on the hunt for a worthy opponent. They strike on sight, as if resuming a battle that they never got to finish.

entry: POKENAME模仿最后吞下的灵魂之声，引猎物进沙漠。至今还没发现过从未夺命的无声个体。
author: h0bojoe
source: It mimics the voice of the last spirit it absorbed to lure prey into the desert. A mute POKENAME, one that has never taken a life, has yet to be discovered.

entry: 幽灵缎带能感知生灵生命渐逝。POKENAME遇见将死者，便让头上的火焰明亮，给最后时刻带来平静。
author: fiordaliso
source: It can sense when the life of a living being is fading thanks to its spectral ribbons. When POKENAME encounters dying creatures, it makes the flame on its head shine to bring peace to their final moments.

entry: POKENAME以火光引近其他生灵，再跃去，用伸展双臂缠牢，吸取生命精华供火。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME lures others towards it with the light from its flames. Once they draw close enough, it leaps towards them and wraps its extendable arms around them, keeping them restrained as it drains their life essence to feed its fire.

entry: POKENAME极速穿沼泽，头部短促闪光，想引伴侣注意。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME darts through swamps with incredible speed. Its head flashes in short bursts, hoping to catch the attention of a mate.

entry: POKENAME受惊，头部黑蜡迅速融化。逃时向后散蜡，拖慢追逐者。
author: .izik
source: When frightened, the black wax on POKENAME's head melts rapidly. It scatters the wax behind it to slow pursuers while fleeing.

entry: 它假扮路灯等人经过。传闻夜间待太久，就缓缓吸走生命力，再离开去另一处。
author: seanothan_23
source: It disguises itself as a street light waiting for someone to pass by. There are rumors that say if you stay by it for too long at night, it will slowly drain your life force before leaving for another location.

entry: 隧道里许多鬼火目击，都是POKENAME造成。越往深处，光越亮。许多隧道挖掘队给员工配一只，以备电力故障。
author: ghostslythe
source: Many ghost light sightings in tunnels are thanks to POKENAME. The deeper these Pokémon go, the brighter they burn their lights. Many tunneling crews assign employees one in case of electrical failure.

entry: 深海洞窟里，POKENAME举起小灯笼，引迷路水肺潜水员脱险。光柔和，却可靠。
author: .izik
source: In deep-sea caves, POKENAME raises its small lantern to guide lost scuba divers toward safety. Its light is soft but reliable.

entry: POKENAME收集遗忘钥匙，再附在废弃城堡的墙上。夜夜亮灯，盼归还给永不会来的主人。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME attaches itself to abandoned castle walls after collecting forgotten keys. It lights up every night, hoping to return them to owners who never come.

entry: POKENAME吸收附近任何火焰，为灯笼头里的火供能。但分不清真火与自身火焰。
author: beatdoof
source: The flame in POKENAME's lantern-like head is powered by absorbing any flames near it. However, it cannot distinguish real flames from its own.

entry: POKENAME用火焰爪击守卫作为家园的废弃旅馆，也释放阵阵浊雾，扰乱、困住毫无防备的猎物。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME defends its abandoned hotel home with fiery claw swipes. It uses bursts of Smog to disorient and trap unsuspecting prey.

entry: 几只POKENAME会排成一路，将迷路旅人引往沙漠深处，再等对方死去，吸收灵魂。
author: duskrd
source: Several POKENAME will form a trail to lead lost travellers further into the desert. They then wait for the victim to pass on to absorb their spirit.

entry: POKENAME更喜欢暗室，在阴影中静止悬浮、缓缓转动。闯入的人常受惊，因为黑暗里只看见一双发光的眼睛回望。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME prefers dark rooms, where it floats motionlessly in the shadows slowly rotating. People who stumble upon it are often frightened, as all they see are its glowing eyes staring back at them in the dark.

entry: POKENAME齿轮般的底座缓缓旋转，头部泛紫光。突然闪光，战斗中能短暂震晕敌人。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's gear-like base rotates slowly while its head glows purple. The sudden flash can briefly stun foes during battle.

entry: 傍晚，POKENAME飘过废弃城堡的庭院，灯笼微亮。据说盯光太久，余下整夜都会倒大霉。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME floats through abandoned castle courtyards in the evening, its lantern dimly glowing. Staring too long at its light is said to bring terrible luck for the rest of the night.

entry: POKENAME睡着后，内部火焰烧得更热，让包裹的黏液冒泡，泛起热光。
author: .izik
source: The flame inside POKENAME burns hotter as it sleeps, causing the goo encasing it to bubble and shimmer with heat.

entry: POKENAME挺身静止，能假扮华丽灯架。虽必须闭眼，仍能靠体热察觉潜在猎物。
author: .jerden
source: By standing tall and remaining perfectly still, POKENAME can disguise itself as an elaborate lampstand. While it has to keep its eyes closed for this to work, it can tell whenever potential prey is close by sensing their body heat.

entry: POKENAME害羞，却不会远离其他生灵。必须靠近，才能吞食恐惧，极少时候也吃生命能量。人们认为，吃够恐惧才能再进化。
author: bobosmith01
source: A shy Pokémon that nevertheless does not stray too far from others; it must be in proximity to another to feast on their fear, and, rarely, their life energy. It is thought that only when they devour enough fear that POKENAME evolves further.

entry: POKENAME悬在深林松树上，紫焰闪烁，旅人常误认鬼火。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME dangles from pine trees in deep forests, its purple flame flickering. Travelers often mistake them for ghost lights.

entry: POKENAME獠牙燃紫焰，用来在树上刻符号。发光痕迹，警告其他生灵这里是领地。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's tusks burn with violet flame, which it uses to carve symbols into trees. These glowing marks warn others of its territory.

entry: POKENAME在沙漠洞窟深处休息。睡时腹部微光，散出柔暖。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME rests deep in desert caves. While sleeping, the light in its abdomen glows faintly, giving off gentle warmth.

entry: 它会出现在夜间迷路的人面前，招手邀人同往来世。若对方不肯，POKENAME便会强行带走。
author: hummusishome
source: It appears to those who get lost at night, beckoning them to follow it to the afterlife. POKENAME will take them there by force if they decline.

entry: POKENAME咬住敌人，尾球便发深紫光。夹得越紧，光越强，亮得刺眼。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's tail orb glows deep violet while biting down on a foe. As its grip tightens, the glow intensifies to a piercing brightness.

entry: POKENAME紧裹斗篷，尽量减少照明。受逼迫才敞开，爆出吸能强光，削弱攻击者。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME clutches its cloak close to its body to minimize the amount of illumination it casts. It opens the cloak when under duress, emitting a bright flash of energy-draining light that weakens its attacker.

entry: 有人见POKENAME想跳上医院绝症患者的床。可惜跳不高，失败时咣当作响，让医生知道医院被入侵了。
author: beetlething
source: POKENAME has been described as trying to jump onto the beds of terminally ill patients in hospitals. It can't jump very high, so doctors know a POKENAME has invaded their hospital due to the clanking sound POKENAME makes when it misses a jump.

entry: POKENAME吞食空气污染物，为火焰攻击供能。但火太热，玻璃身体就会融化、变形。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME consumes airborne pollutants to fuel its fiery attacks. If the flames become too hot, however, POKENAME's glass body will start to melt, causing it to become deformed and misshapen.

entry: 融合后，灯火幽灵铁身成了POKENAME的理想外壳，能控制内部幽火而不融化。但完整力量仍未释放。
author: phantom640
source: Lampent's iron body made for the perfect casing for POKENAME upon fusion, allowing it to control the ghostly flame inside it without melting. However, its full power still remains untapped.

entry: 它用灰与沙组成身体。传说，将某人骨灰撒海，对方便会以POKENAME回到这个世界。
author: cait_sith
source: It forms its body out of ash and sand. Legend has it that if you throw someone's ashes into the sea, they will return to this realm as a POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME游荡废宅，把孢子散在墙、地板。一碰湿气，就迅速生长。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME wanders abandoned mansions, spreading its spores across the walls and floors. These spores grow rapidly upon contact with any moisture.

entry: 这种宝可梦漫游墓园，从墓中吸取超自然能量。有人说，POKENAME火炬喷出的蝴蝶状火焰，代表被引向来世的人类灵魂。
author: milchik
source: This Pokémon roams cemeteries, drawing supernatural energy from the graves. Some say that the butterfly-like spurts of flame emanating from POKENAME's torch represent human souls being guided to the afterlife.

entry: POKENAME壳上火焰随饮食变色。吃硫磺，就能变成明亮金焰。
author: .izik
source: The flame on POKENAME's shell changes color based on its diet. Consuming sulfur can turn its fire into a radiant golden hue.

entry: 身体发出的光，吸引来大群夜行昆虫。一旦靠近，生命力就会被POKENAME迅速吸走。
author: staghorn
source: Its body glows with a light that attracts large swarms of nocturnal insects. Those that approach have their vitality rapidly drained by the POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME反复撞头攻击，直到玻璃般的脸开裂，内部紫焰渗出。火不断增强，直到裂缝重新熔合。
author: drcew
source: POKENAME will headbutt opponents repeatedly to the point that its glass-like face will crack, causing the purple flames within to seep out. These flames will increase in intensity until the cracks fuse back together.

entry: POKENAME火焰迫使见者跟随。夜里若是唯一光源，效果更强，有时单只便引来整群着迷的人。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME flames produce a compulsion in those who see the flames to follow them. This effect is magnified at night when their flames are the only light around, a single POKENAME sometimes drawing entire crowds of fascinated people towards them.

entry: POKENAME想帮迷失暗洞的旅人照亮四周。但总突然从附近地下冒出，反让人受惊。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME wants to be helpful to travelers that find themselves lost among dark caverns by helping illuminate their surroundings. Its tendency to suddenly appear from beneath the ground near people tends to startle them, though.

entry: 据说，POKENAME寻找迷失的灵魂，守护在灯笼里。这传闻来自深夜目击，火焰那时最亮，诡异又美丽，令路人着迷。
author: calikov
source: It is said that POKENAME search for lost souls, guarding them within its lantern. This rumor comes from late-night sightings, when the flames emanating from POKENAME burn their brightest, captivating passers-by with their eerie yet beautiful glow.

entry: 都市传说，新娘婚礼当天见POKENAME，是坏兆。一有目击报告，有些婚礼便立即推迟。
author: mepp.
source: According to urban legends, it is considered a bad omen if a bride sees POKENAME on her wedding day. Some ceremonies are postponed immediately after a reported sighting.

entry: POKENAME游荡古宅、城堡，照亮周围，逐间翻找可偷的古董宝物。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME wander ancient mansions and chateaus and illuminate the area around them. They rummage through every room searching for antique treasures to steal.

entry: POKENAME盘踞废弃旅馆，用强光晃晕闯入者。趁对方恢复，悄悄偷走财物。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME haunts abandoned hotels, using its bright glow to stun intruders. While they recover, it silently steals their valuables.

entry: 久看POKENAME火光，会让眼睛疲劳、身体疲惫，通常引发痛苦的头疼。它主动寻找大群人，试图让尽量多的人受火光照射。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Prolonged exposure to the light from POKENAME's flame causes uncomfortable eye strain and exhaustion, usually resulting in painful headaches. They actively seek out large crowds, attempting to expose as many people as possible to their fire's light.

entry: POKENAME战斗时低头，以金属顶盖保护玻璃身体。顶盖反复被打，会越来越怒，最终弃守，全力猛攻。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME lower their head in battle, using their metallic cap to protect their glass body from harm. Repeated strikes to their cap make them progressively angrier, eventually provoking them to forgo defence and launch into all-out attacks.

entry: 从POKENAME透明腹部，能看出毫无内脏。只有紫焰，烧掉吃下的食物，似乎借此供能。
author: hophoppip
source: Through POKENAME's clear abdomen, it can be seen that it has no internal organs. A purple flame is the only thing inside its body, burning the food it eats and seemingly giving it energy.

entry: POKENAME手里拿着一对灵魂，发出阴森呻吟吓敌人。战斗时放出，分散对方注意，再近身打出决定性的连拳。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME carries a pair of spirits in its hands that emit ghastly moans to frighten its foes. In combat, it releases them to aid it by keeping an opponent distracted so it can get in close and deliver a decisive flurry of punches.

entry: POKENAME最常见于运河城市，据说护送新近亡魂出城、前往来世。外壳材质的密度极高，与玻璃般的脸和腹部尤其不同。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is most frequently seen in cities with canals, where it supposedly leads recently deceased souls out of the city and into the afterlife. The material of the shell is incredibly dense, especially in contrast to its glass face and belly.

entry: 附近若有将死者，POKENAME唯一的紫球便闪烁，再伸触手缠住，直到对方离世才放开。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's singular purple orb will start flashing if someone who is nearing death is nearby. It then wraps around them with its tentacles and doesn't let go until they pass on.

entry: 水难地点附近，常有成群POKENAME游泳。幽灵尾巴渐渐长大，都市传说说，吃的灵魂越多就越大。
author: pjporwoll
source: Groups of POKENAME are seen swimming near the sites of water disasters. The ghostly tail gets larger over time, and urban legends say it increases in size with the amount of souls POKENAME has eaten.

entry: POKENAME夜里轮换亮起的头，在最暗路径排开，为迷路旅人照明。
author: _refuse_
source: During the night, POKENAME alternate which head remains lit. They position themselves along the darkest paths, offering a guiding light to lost travelers.

entry: POKENAME每颗头都有幽灵火焰，燃烧强度不同。有时会用灯笼般的头互相碰撞，吵醒附近熟睡的居民。
author: _refuse_
source: Each of POKENAME's heads carries ghostly flames, burning at different intensities. They sometimes bump their lamp-like heads against each other, waking up nearby sleeping residents.

entry: POKENAME极少被见到移动。常附在坏路灯上，用自己的光补上照明。
author: _refuse_
source: POKENAME is rarely seen in motion. It tends to latch onto faulty lampposts, replacing their missing light with its own.

entry: POKENAME用头刺撞击经过水域的船。若成功沉船，就在水面等着，看船没入。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME uses the spike on its head to bash against boats passing through its waters. If it sinks the boat, it will wait at the water's surface, watching the ship go under.

entry: POKENAME用炮反复发射火球战斗。伽勒尔南部有个传统，会在墓园放带硬毛的杆子，因为它喜欢蹭杆清洁外壳，之后就变得温顺。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME battles by blasting repeated fireballs from its cannons. It is a tradition in South Galar to leave bristly poles around graveyards as this Pokémon enjoys cleaning its shell against them and becomes docile afterwards.

entry: 奇怪的是，它只吃烧焦的东西，常躲进烤箱，享用里面焦黑的食物残渣。
author: rockageddon
source: Curiously this Pokémon only eats things that have already been burnt to a crisp. They will hide in ovens to feast on the burnt remains of food inside.

entry: 高级餐厅、旅馆常用POKENAME当管家，照料住客宝可梦。它很易训练，也爱像人类参与日常生活。
author: camtft
source: POKENAME are commonly used by fancy restaurants and hotels as butlers for residents Pokémon. They have proven quite easy to train, and prefer to partake in daily life as people do.

entry: 它用幽火推进，以马赫级速度移动。飞进雷暴，引导闪电，为自己供能。
author: bandedbodypress
source: It moves at Mach speed by propelling itself with its ghostly flame. It flies into thunderstorms and powers itself by channeling bolts of lighting.

entry: 人们曾相信，灵魂没有路标就会迷失来世之路，因此把POKENAME形象刻进建筑。三颗头据说代表一生做过的选择。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: People used to believe that spirits would lose their way to the afterlife without a guidepost, so they carved images of POKENAME into buildings. Its three heads are said to represent the choices a spirit made during their life.

entry: 据说，头骨上的燃烧双角吸引迷失的灵魂。古画描绘它用火焰照路，引孩子前往来世。
author: dodoowner_
source: The flaming horns on its skull are said to attract lost souls. Ancient drawings depict it guiding children to the afterlife, lighting the path with flames.

entry: 被POKENAME火舌舔过，情绪会被烧尽，只留空洞。吞下的情感在腹中燃烧，散出诡光。
author: t3isukone
source: Being licked by POKENAME's fiery tongue burns up emotions, leaving its victims hollow. The emotions it consumes burn inside its belly, casting an eerie light as they are consumed.

entry: POKENAME头上的甲片，能当作冲撞的重锤。背上的紫焰既为POKENAME保暖，也让它能借高温进攻。
author: shado_.w
source: The plating on POKENAME's head is used as a ram. In addition, the purple flame on its back warms POKENAME up and allows it to attack with heat.

entry: POKENAME被痛苦灵魂吸引，吃掉负面情绪后，对方便明显好转。幽火也常为恐惧笼罩的迷路旅人指引森林道路。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are drawn to anguished souls, which will noticeably start to feel better after a POKENAME feeds upon their negative emotions. Their ghostly flames often serve as guides to lost forest travelers that feel consumed with fear.

entry: POKENAME以强光引人凝望宝石，再经宝石吞食情绪。旧民间故事说，它吃人，只为自己变成人。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME use their bright flames to lure out people and make them gaze at their gems. Through the gems, they feed on the emotions of their victims. Old folktales say POKENAME feed on humans in order to become human themselves.

entry: POKENAME的灼焰能斩断一切，连灵魂也不例外，原地只会留下躯体。
author: symile
source: A POKENAME is able to cut through anything with its searing flames. Only the body is left behind, as it even cleaves the spirit.

entry: POKENAME吸收空气里的游离电力，维持身体火焰。有些饲主当备用光源，尤其停电时。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME keeps the flames on its body lit by absorbing ambient electricity in the air. Some owners use it as an alternative light source, especially during power outages.

entry: POKENAME身体发光，据称是迷途亡魂。也据说，亡魂的懊悔、悲伤，让它暴怒。
author: infinex21
source: A POKENAME's body glows with what is claimed to be the souls of the departed who have lost their ways. Similarly, it is said that these Pokémon fly into a ferocious rage due to the many feelings of regret and grief held by these souls.

entry: 它电死猎物后，尸身的灰烬便供幽焰燃烧，残留的灵魂则被用来产生恐怖的电力。
author: soup1900
source: Its ghostly flames are fueled by the ashes of the bodies its electrocuted. It uses the remaining spirit to generate its terrifying electricity.

entry: POKENAME的毛发不断产生大量电力，形成火焰。训练家或宝可梦一碰，就会无意受到强烈电击。经过持续训练，或许能控制。
author: nyoomymph
source: POKENAME's flames are the result of the huge amounts of electricity constantly produced from its fur. Upon contact, a Trainer or Pokémon will unintentionally receive a harsh shock. With steady training, POKENAME may be able to control it.

entry: 毛发柔软、半透明，可见内部华美暗火。它依偎信任者，温暖身心，是许多人珍视的伙伴。
author: infinex21
source: Their fur is soft yet translucent, giving view to their luxurious dark flames that burn within them. They warm the body and the soul of those they trust by cuddling up with them, making them valued companions for many.

entry: POKENAME吃下大量数据，就散出复杂光纹，蓝、紫、绿、黄循环，耀眼夺目。
author: .izik
source: After devouring large volumes of data, POKENAME emits intricate light patterns. Its glow cycles through blue, purple, green, and yellow in a brilliant display.

entry: POKENAME火焰燃着被遗忘灵魂的光，许多是在远古海洋中失落已久的化石盔。
author: shreks_stepfather
source: POKENAME's flames burn with the light of forgotten souls. Many of these souls are Kabuto long-lost in the ancient seas.

entry: POKENAME火焰放出低量辐射，通常无害；烦躁时强度会增加。最严重时，几秒便能使DNA解体。
author: imaginita
source: POKENAME's flames give off low-level radiation, which is usually harmless, but if POKENAME becomes agitated, the radiation will grow in strength. At its worst, the radiation can unravel DNA in a matter of seconds.

entry: POKENAME冠部火焰含数百万魔鬼椒种子，吸入烟气会强烈灼痛。许多厨师利用独特风味，收集烟气，加入菜肴。
author: dodoowner_
source: The flames released from POKENAME's crown contain millions of ghost pepper seeds, causing intense burning if the flame's fumes are inhaled. Many chefs take advantage of this distinct flavor, capturing the smoke to incorporate into dishes.

entry: 水晶灯火灵与火暴兽融合，唤醒了古籍描绘的形态：火焰携带冥界之光的火暴兽。它性情悠闲，但触及火焰会感到极强的灼热。
author: infinex21
source: The fusion of a Chandelure and a Typhlosion has awakened a form depicted in old records that spoke of a Typhlosion whose flames carried the light of the underworld. It has a laid-back attitude even though its flames are vastly intense to the touch.

entry: POKENAME用火烧尽体内一切，连空气也不例外，尽量减轻重量，全速奔跑。撕出猎物灵魂后，必须直立摇晃，才能好好消化。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME uses its flames to burn up everything inside its body, including air, so it becomes as light as possible to run at max speed. After tearing out the spirit of its prey, it has to stand upright and sway around in order to digest it properly.

entry: POKENAME偏爱在黑暗墓室筑巢，闪动催眠火光，引猎物靠近，再用毒网缠住。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME prefers to nest inside dark crypts. It lures prey close by flickering its hypnotic lights, before ensnaring them with toxic webbing.

entry: POKENAME召来幽火，引不备猎物进入巢穴。再以表演迷住，降低警惕，趁隙扑上，用利爪施以致命一击。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME summons ghostly lights that it uses to lure unsuspecting prey into its lair. Once inside, POKENAME entrances its prey with a performance to lower their guard, so it has an opening to lunge and deal a fatal strike with its sharp claws.

entry: POKENAME漂在海上，想用幽火引船。传说会带往易失事的危险水域，趁落水者浮在水中时吸取生命力。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME floats around the ocean attempting to lure ships towards its ghostly flames. It's said to lead them to troubled waters where shipwrecks are likely, so it can drain the life force from the victims as they tread water.

entry: 古合众人相信，POKENAME用触角吸引恶灵。传说延续至今，许多渔民仍视为厄运。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: The people of ancient Unova believed that POKENAME attracted malicious spirits using their antenna. This myth has endured to the modern era, as POKENAME are still deemed bad luck by many fishers.

entry: POKENAME尾巴上的火焰强弱，直接取决于羊毛多少。蓬松个体燃着闪动烈火，刚剪过毛的却只剩噗噗作响的小余烬。
author: sk372
source: The strength of the flame on POKENAME's tail is directly tied to the amount of wool it has. A fluffy POKENAME has a burning, flickering fire, while a POKENAME that was recently sheared has a small, sputtering ember.

entry: 进化后，POKENAME内部火焰长大，拖到体外。虽然更易受攻击，却能更高效、有力地运用力量。
author: nyoomymph
source: After evolving, POKENAME's internal flame has grown, now trailing outside of its body. Though more vulnerable, this allows it to wield its power with greater efficiency and strength.

entry: POKENAME身体的固体部分密度极高、很重。但火焰浮力太大，整体几乎没有重量。
author: stevethebarbarian
source: The solid parts of POKENAME's body are actually very dense and heavy. However, its flames produce so much buoyancy that, in total, it is almost weightless.

entry: POKENAME身上六颗玻璃球，只要一颗破裂，火就瞬间熄灭。只有将附近林火的强热导入其余球内，才能重燃。
author: jaminmcready
source: If any of the six glass bulbs on its body break, POKENAME's flames will extinguish instantly. The fire is only relit by channeling the intense heat from a nearby wildfire into the remaining bulbs.

entry: POKENAME住在废弃中世纪古堡，啃金属栏杆。火焰吓走其他宝可梦，反让古堡成了探险者、历史学家相对平静的去处。
author: banzai.exe
source: POKENAME can be found in abandoned medieval castles where they gnaw on metal bars. Their fires scare off other Pokémon, making a POKENAME-infested castle a relatively peaceful destination for explorers and historians.

entry: POKENAME现身时，若不遮眼数到5，会被视为不吉。罪犯有时利用这迷信，让它名声受损。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: When a POKENAME appears, it is considered bad luck not to cover your eyes and count to 5. This superstition is sometimes exploited by criminals, resulting in POKENAME's reputation being tarnished.

entry: POKENAME透明双翼在飞行时泛着超凡光芒。每发现新墓，头上火焰便增强，仿佛连亡魂的一小部分也要夺取。
author: infinex21
source: Their transparent wings glow with an otherworldly radiance as they soar through the skies. The flames upon POKENAME' heads grow whenever they find a new grave, as if they claim even just a piece of the souls of the departed.

entry: POKENAME体型小，常被误认为摆饰。据说会给所住家庭带来不幸，原因不明。
author: pokebio
source: POKENAME is often mistaken for an ornament due to its small size, and it is said to bring misfortune to any home it inhabits, though no one knows why.

entry: POKENAME啃古物作火的燃料，被历史学家视为害兽。一进博物馆，被发现前就可能毁掉数十件无价文物。
author: banzai.exe
source: POKENAME are considered vermin by historians because they gnaw on artifacts to fuel their fires. If one gets into a museum, it can destroy dozens of priceless relics before it is discovered.

entry: POKENAME玻璃角不断喷出幽火，角一击中，便烧毁对手。若角破裂，火焰就不受控制地蔓延全身。
author: actliux
source: POKENAME's glass horn constantly extrudes a spectral flame, incinerating its opponent upon striking them with it. If the horn ever becomes cracked, POKENAME's flames spread uncontrollably across its body.

entry: POKENAME冲过敌人，身后拖着冰冻火焰，几秒便以火海围住目标。陷入其中会缓缓冻结，直到灵魂被夺走。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME rush by their foes with their freezing flames trailing behind them, creating an inferno that completely surrounds their target in a few seconds. Anyone caught in these mystical flames will be slowly frozen until their spirit is stolen away.

entry: POKENAME夜游森林，用微火引好奇者靠近。察觉自己跟着什么时，已逃不出掌控，生命力被幽火吸走。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME haunts forests at night, drawing the curious near it with the faint light of its flames. By the time the victim realizes what they're following, it's too late to escape its hold, and their life force will be drained by ethereal fire.

entry: 民间传说，这种诡异POKENAME的紫焰吞噬被烧者灵魂，却不伤身体。现实中，火焰温度确实比想象低。
author: beandrawsthings
source: An eerie Pokémon, folktales say their purple flames consume the spirits of those they burn, leaving their bodies untouched. In reality, POKENAME flames burn at a lower temperature than expected.

entry: POKENAME常被当移动光源，热紫火却会吸引野生蛾宝可梦。许多训练家觉得烦，捕虫训练家反而很欢迎。
author: beandrawsthings
source: POKENAME are often kept as mobile light sources, their hot purple flames attracting wild moth Pokémon. This can be annoying for many Trainers, though it makes them a popular companion to Bug Catchers.

entry: POKENAME枝条顶端的诡异紫焰永不熄灭，水下也一样。靠近者会有麻痹般的刺痛感，生命力渐被吸取。
author: hophoppip
source: The eerie purple flames atop its branches never cease to burn, even underwater. Those who approach it feel a paralyzing stinging sensation as POKENAME slowly drains their life-force.

entry: POKENAME带着一座最多插有9根蜡烛的烛台。据说，猜中哪支蜡烛最后烧完的人，可能会得到礼物。
author: jaycielantern
source: POKENAME carries a candelabra with up to 9 candles on it. It's said that people who guess which candle will last the longest may receive a gift.

entry: POKENAME的毒液会让咬伤周围一片灼痛。自发现POKENAME以来，医生一直在寻找有效的抗毒血清。
author: jestersqueak
source: POKENAME's venom can cause a burning sensation all over the bite area. Doctors have been looking into finding an antivenom since POKENAME's discovery.

entry: POKENAME能伸长身体数米，均匀分布灯光。几只连成链，就能迅速改变房间光色。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can stretch their body to several meters in length to evenly distribute the lights on it. Several POKENAME can form a connected chain to rapidly change the color of lights in the room.

entry: POKENAME作品虽然常很美，却不宜触碰。上面燃着永不熄灭的火焰，连水也浇不灭。
author: stevethebarbarian
source: While POKENAME's artwork is often beautiful, it isn't recommended to touch it. It eternally burns with flames that water can't extinguish.

entry: POKENAME释放灵火时，透明的上半身会泛起紫光。谁若被火击中，便会身中诅咒，注定走向死亡。
author: chorb33
source: Its transparent upper body glows purple when POKENAME emits its spirit flames. Anyone hit by them is cursed and doomed to death.

entry: 据说，POKENAME火焰能洗去亡魂全部罪孽。它连靠近谁都极挑剔，极少个体愿被驯养。
author: infinex21
source: The flames of a POKENAME supposedly cleanse the souls of the departed of all their sins. They are very selective of who they even draw near to and very few allow themselves to be tamed.

entry: 幽火每胜一场，便更大、更强，仿佛吞食败者灵魂。热得几秒就能烧穿实心钢铁。
author: infinex21
source: Its spectral flames grow in size and intensity with every victory, as if feeding upon the souls of the defeated. These flames can become so hot that they will burn a hole through solid steel in seconds.

entry: 神话将POKENAME描绘为“七之岛的守护者”。火焰最高达8,000华氏度，但只有认为威胁无法击败时，才会达到。
author: loikthescreamo
source: According to myths, POKENAME is depicted as the Protector of the Sevii Islands. The flames it produces can reach up to 8,000°F, but only if it deems the threat impossible to defeat.

entry: POKENAME烧掉灵魂时，会回到其存在的每个时刻，也在各时期烧一次，最大限度利用同一灵魂。每处都会留一缕幽火。
author: soup1900
source: When POKENAME burns up a soul, it travels back in time to every instant that soul existed, maximizing the soul's use by burning them up at those periods too. A ghostly wisp is left in the locations it burned said soul.

entry: POKENAME游墓园寻找访客，恶作剧吓人。陪伴者惊逃时，狡猾笑声响彻整夜。
author: actliux
source: POKENAME roam around graveyards searching for visitors. They will play mischievous pranks on people to scare them; their devious laugh heard throughout the night as their company flees in fear.

entry: POKENAME玻璃般羽毛常用于制作窗玻璃，尤其宗教场所。可能源自羽毛能驱恶灵的传说。
author: infinex21
source: The glass-like feathers of POKENAME are often used in the making of glass panes, especially those of religious sites. This is likely due to a legend that claims their feathers can ward off evil spirits.

entry: POKENAME诞生于火灾损毁、被弃的住宅废墟。对人类深怀怨怒，将曾经家园的毁灭，全怪到人类头上。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME form in the ruins of homes that have been abandoned due to fire damage. They harbour a deep resentment and anger at humans, blaming them all for the destruction of what had once been their homes.

entry: POKENAME在暗处跳舞，强光引旅人离开大路。恶作剧虽无恶意，跟随者却再没被看见。
author: t3isukone
source: POKENAME dances in the dark, the bright light of its flames drawing travelers away from the main path. Despite meaning no ill will with its pranks, none of those who follow its light are ever seen again.

entry: POKENAME夜猎，只用冰冷的爪子轻碰，就把猎物生命力转成幽火燃料。最终，对方会冷得发抖、倒下。
author: .jerden
source: When hunting for prey at night, POKENAME will only lightly touch it with its icy claws. This will convert its life force into fuel for POKENAME's ghostly flames, eventually causing the victim to collapse, shivering with cold.

entry: POKENAME以冰冷火焰的舞动迷住目标，再与同群伏击。吃掉猎物灵魂，只留冰冻身体。
author: yuma5054
source: POKENAME enchants its target with the dance of its icy flames, to ambush its prey with the rest of the group. POKENAME feeds on the spirit of its prey, leaving only the frozen body behind.

entry: POKENAME幽灵磁铁能把半径3英里内的游魂引来。灵魂在玻璃穹顶身体里燃烧，产生能量驱动磁铁，不断循环。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's ghostly magnets are strong enough to magnetize wandering souls in a 3-mile radius towards it. These souls are then burned inside its glass-domed body, creating energy to power its magnets and repeat this process over again.

entry: POKENAME自身磁力将空心玻璃身体内的火，聚成火球。一口气烧太多灵魂，火球就压过磁力，膨胀到充满整个玻璃身体。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's own magnetism causes the flame inside its hollow, glass body to form into the shape of a fireball. If it tries to burn many souls up at once, the fireball will overpower POKENAME's magnetism and expand throughout the entire glass body.

entry: 只有灯火炎兽吸收骇人数量的灵魂，才会形成POKENAME。燃料永不耗尽，能毫无节制地释放灾难性紫色火海。
author: h0bojoe
source: A POKENAME is only formed after a Lampmortar absorbs a sadistic amount of spirits. Its fuel never runs out, letting it unleash catastrophic violet infernos without restraint.

entry: POKENAME紫焰热得惊人。科学家始终测不出完美温度，因为每处读数都不同。
author: loikthescreamo
source: The purple flames of POKENAME are shockingly hot. Although no scientist has ever gotten a perfect temperature reading, this is because each part of POKENAME reads a different number than the last.

entry: 进一步更新让POKENAME火焰只烧受害者身体，不伤灵魂。这番奇怪变化迫使它更冒失、鲁莽地焚烧，取得足够维持生命的能量。
author: soup1900
source: Additional updates to POKENAME have caused its flames to only consume the bodies of its victims, leaving the souls untouched. This bizarre change forces it to become more rash and reckless in its burnings to obtain enough energy to survive.

entry: POKENAME像危险、凶猛的电脑病毒。用户被感染电脑吸引，困在那里，生命力慢慢被吸走。
author: solori_roznie
source: POKENAME act like dangerous and virulent computer viruses. Users will find themselves drawn to any PC infected with POKENAME, where they will be trapped as their lifeforce is slowly siphoned away.

entry: 它用钩爪、尾巴爬楼，潜入宅邸。传闻是恶灵附身木守宫，烧掉原本灵魂。
author: h0bojoe
source: It uses its hooked claws and tail to climb buildings and sneak into mansions. Rumours say it is an evil spirit possessing a Treecko whose soul it burned away.

entry: 它若认定民居在自己领地，就潜入烧掉住户灵魂，只留躯壳。随后住下筑巢，直到被迫逃走。
author: h0bojoe
source: If it deems a human house within its territory, it sneaks in and burns the spirits of the residents, leaving them as husks. It then uses the house as a nest until it is forced to flee.

entry: 它若认定民居在自己领地，就潜入烧掉住户灵魂，只留躯壳。随后住下筑巢，直到被迫逃走。
author: h0bojoe
source: If it deems a human house within its territory, it sneaks in and burns the spirits of the residents, leaving them as husks. It then uses the house as a nest until it is forced to flee.

entry: POKENAME力量、敏捷惊人，连城市也能轻松狩猎。单只便能摧毁整座乡村，只留紫色烧痕与无数失去灵魂的空洞躯体。
author: h0bojoe
source: With incredible strength and agility, it hunts with ease even in urban areas. A single POKENAME can devastate entire rural villages, leaving nothing but violet burn marks and countless hollow, spiritless bodies.

entry: 它们游荡沙漠，找迷路旅人、宝可梦，幽火夜里最亮。被利爪割伤，寒意刺骨，仿佛温暖被抽走。
author: infinex21
source: Their spectral flames glow brightest at night whilst they wander through the desert in search of lost travelers or lost Pokémon. A cut from their claws invokes a bone-chilling sensation, as if the wounded individual's warmth is being drawn away.

entry: POKENAME是披着幽焰的凶猛斗士，对战斗的热爱让它不断以灼热的幽灵攻击迎敌。POKENAME的火焰十分明亮，足以照亮整间暗室。
author: thepandasharky
source: POKENAME is a fierce fighter cloaked in spectral flames. Its intense love for battle drives it to unleash scorching ghostly attacks on its opponents. The flame of a POKENAME is bright enough to fully illuminate a dark room.

entry: POKENAME若打输，会在墙、地板、物品中跟踪敌人，直到能再战获胜。
author: zaymcawesome
source: If POKENAME ever loses to a foe, it stalks that foe in walls, floors, and objects until it can get a victorious rematch.

entry: POKENAME对抗强敌，会故意裂开腿部玻璃，放出灵魂火焰。幽火强化本已强大的踢击，每下都烧敌人灵魂。
author: _pixelar_
source: When POKENAME fights a strong foe, it purposefully cracks the glass of its legs to release its spirit flames. These ethereal flames enhance its already powerful kicks, burning the foe's spirit with every hit.

entry: POKENAME双手最脆弱，便用强力踢击保护，能把敌人烧得焦脆。不战斗时，喜欢烹饪采来的树果，供自己与家人吃。
author: _pixelar_
source: POKENAME's hands are the most vulnerable part of its body. It will defend them with powerful kicks that leave the enemy burned to a crisp. When it's not fighting, POKENAME likes to cook foraged berries for itself and its family.

entry: POKENAME用精神力量造出虚假宅邸，引迷路旅人进入，再把灵魂困进火炬火焰，免得自己孤独。
author: lasercraft32
source: Using its psychic powers, POKENAME creates fake mansions to lure in lost travelers. Once they enter, POKENAME traps their souls within torch flames so that it will never be lonely.

entry: POKENAME爱优雅，搜集其他幽灵属性与恶属性宝可梦服侍。心思难测，但有一点可确信：彻底自私。
author: t3isukone
source: POKENAME adore elegance and collect other Ghost-type and Dark-type Pokémon to serve them. These inscrutable Pokémon are hard to read, but one can trust them to be completely selfish.

entry: 这只POKENAME以礼貌、剑术闻名。谁进入它盘踞的宅邸，就会受邀友好切磋。随后却点燃出口，防止对方逃跑。
author: saucebolodu81
source: This POKENAME is known for its courtesy and swordsmanship. It challenges whoever enters the manor that it haunts to a friendly battle. It then sets the exit on fire to prevent any attempt to escape.

entry: 它如浮空雕像般徘徊空楼。无准备闯入者，会忍不住窥视发光外壳的裂缝。
author: bardanchaos
source: It lingers like a floating statue in empty buildings. Any who wander inside unprepared are compelled to peek between the cracks in its luminescent shell.

entry: POKENAME的火焰让身体浮起，目光专注猎物。据说会把灵魂存进眼球，直到与另一只同类结合。
author: salt
source: Their flames keep them afloat while they focus their vision on prey. POKENAME are said to hold souls in their eyeball until they combine with another POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME通过双臂吸收灵魂，为精神能力供能。据说火焰颜色能反映储能多少。它还能用念动力高速投掷物品。
author: salt
source: POKENAME absorbs spirits through its arms to use as energy for psychic powers. It is said that their flames change colors to reflect their energy levels. It hurls objects around at rapid speeds using its psychokinesis.

entry: POKENAME的玻璃头，用来烧掉以火抓来的灵魂。靠精神力量装成吊灯，趁猎物不备捕获，作为火焰燃料。
author: salt
source: Their glass heads are used to burn spirits that POKENAME captures with fire. They use their psychic powers to appear as chandeliers to catch their prey unaware and use them to fuel their flames.

entry: 有人说，POKENAME由葬身火海者的灵魂聚成。现身时的光会迫人靠近，再添一个集体中的灵魂。
author: sk372
source: Some say POKENAME is formed by the conglomeration of the souls of those who perished by fire. Seeing the light it casts when it manifests is said to compel a person to approach and become another soul in the collective.

entry: 据说，谁若在POKENAME的纸上写下名字，灵魂便会被夺走。
author: inksans201x
source: Those that write their names on POKENAME's papers are said to have their souls taken away.

entry: POKENAME将波导与幽火结合，战斗效果极佳。透明躯干还烧着多少火，就能看出剩余多少能量。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME combines its aura with its ghostly flames to great effect in combat. One can tell how much energy it has left by gauging the amount of fire still burning in its transparent torso.

entry: POKENAME胃里不停燃烧的火，驱动饥饿。每吞一口，火就更亮，刚吃完又立刻找食物。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: A POKENAME's hunger is fueled by the flames constantly burning in its stomach, glowing brighter with every morsel it swallows. Once it finishes a meal, it will immediately begin searching for more food.

entry: POKENAME的厚皮能抵御自身火焰。它头朝前猛撞，连最耐打的宝可梦也能烧伤；但外皮受损后，有时也会烧到自己。
author: operativevalkyrie
source: POKENAME is coated in a thick hide resistant to its fire. It charges into opponents headfirst and can burn even the most resilient Pokémon, but it sometimes burns itself when its hide is damaged.

entry: 野生POKENAME大多完全不动，只有幽火闪烁。催眠效果引其他宝可梦靠近，慢慢吸取生命力。
author: .jerden
source: Most of the time, wild POKENAME remains completely still, except for the flicker of their spectral flames. These have a hypnotic effect, luring in other Pokémon to slowly drain their life force.

entry: 野生POKENAME大多在废弃建筑内懒散地躺着。有人闯入，就缓缓靠近，沉重脚步让建筑颤抖、吱响，再突然猛扑，以幽火攻击。
author: .jerden
source: Most of the time, wild POKENAME laze around inside abandoned buildings. If anyone intrudes, POKENAME will slowly approach, its heavy footsteps making the building shudder and creak, then suddenly rush out to attack with its spectral fire.

entry: POKENAME玻璃身体充满发光能量，从头部周围与手持长鞭末端涌出闪动火焰。长鞭盘住敌人后，对方越弱，火就越亮。
author: .jerden
