source: POKENAME's glass body is filled with glowing energy, which emerges as flickering flames around its head and from the end of the whip it carries. If it wraps this long coil around a foe, its flames will burn brighter as the enemy becomes weaker.

entry: 它们敏锐感知生命将尽，似乎总忍不住前去寻找。临终前出现，虽让许多人视为凶兆，另有报告却说，也曾阻止不必要的死亡。
author: infinex21
source: They are keenly aware when the end of a life draws near and appear to be compelled to track down the source. Though their appearance near such a time has led many to see them as omens, other reports claim they have also prevented unnecessary death.

entry: 据说，POKENAME能一拳把灵魂打出身体。同类交战，败者熄火，胜者火焰明亮。
author: actliux
source: POKENAME is said to have the ability to punch souls right out of their bodies. When two of these Pokémon battle, the loser's flame is extinguished, while the victor's flame burns bright.

entry: POKENAME有从梦中显现的可怕能力。噩梦若涉及燃烧，很可能就是想吃你的灵魂。
author: natedawg210th.
source: POKENAME has the terrifying ability to manifest from dreams. If you have a nightmare where burning is involved, chances are high that POKENAME was trying to eat your soul.

entry: POKENAME像中空玻璃长管，内外壁之间装着水属性宝可梦。那是吞过的灵魂，谁走进内部，也会被加入收藏。
author: kungfucutbug
source: POKENAME looks like a long, hollow glass tube with Water-type Pokémon contained between the interior and exterior. These are the souls it has consumed; anyone who wanders inside will be added to its collection.

entry: 一个教派曾崇拜POKENAME超过一世纪，相信能让已故亲人现身。但从未观察到能力证据，信仰最终崩溃。
author: .izik
source: For over a century, a cult worshipped POKENAME believing it could reveal deceased loved ones. The faith collapsed when no evidence of this power was ever observed.

entry: POKENAME游荡森林，据传那里有受害者灵魂。人们相信，小宝可梦滥用好客，使它心生怨恨，树也因此无法栖居。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME roams through forests rumored to be haunted by the spirits of its victims. It's believed that POKENAME's tree became uninhabitable after it became bitter about smaller Pokémon that misused its hospitality.

entry: POKENAME的火焰，会为每位受害者映出独有的幻象，例如已故亲人的面容，随后再吞噬灵魂。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME's flame creates illusory images unique to each of its victims, such as the face of a deceased loved one, before it consumes their spirit.

entry: 人们认为，POKENAME专为那些逃过死劫、活得长久的国王收魂。许多故事都以与它的决斗收尾。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME is thought to be the reaper of long-lived kings who have otherwise cheated death. Duels with this Pokémon mark the end of many tales.

entry: POKENAME会指挥成群的烛小兵，吸干猎物的生命能量。随后，它把猎物的灵魂烧掉，只留下躯体。
author: darkweavile428
source: POKENAME commands groups of Litiard to drain the life energy from its prey. POKENAME then burns the prey's sprit, leaving the body behind.

entry: POKENAME护送灵魂往来世，再从它们的感激中获得力量与美。头部如尾巴般透明、柔软，战时却会变暗、变硬，像身体一样。
author: epping_forest
source: POKENAME draws its strength and beauty from the gratitude of the souls taken to the afterlife by it. Its head, transparent and squishy as its tail, gains a darker tone and a harder texture like its body when it's time to battle.

entry: POKENAME护送灵魂往来世，再从它们的感激中获得力量与美。头部如尾巴般透明、柔软，战时却会变暗、变硬，像身体一样。
author: epping_forest
source: POKENAME draws its strength and beauty from the gratitude of the souls taken to the afterlife by it. Its head, transparent and squishy as its tail, gains a darker tone and a harder texture like its body when it's time to battle.

entry: 身边火环不但极热，燃烧靠的也是灵魂能量，而非氧气。POKENAME所有火焰都有这性质，因此点的火几乎无法扑灭。
author: fireblade141
source: The fire ring circling its body is not only extremely hot, but is composed of flames that require spirit energy, rather than oxygen, to burn. Any flames POKENAME produces have this property, meaning any fire it sets is nearly impossible to put out.

entry: 据说，接触POKENAME的火焰，便能看见来世。可那些景象，不过是它制造的幻象。
author: nellnast42
source: It is said that exposure to POKENAME's flames will cause one to experience visions of the afterlife. These are just its illusions, however.

entry: POKENAME盘踞弃屋，用幻觉赶入侵者。虽然难觅踪迹，却能驯养，一旦亲近，忠诚极深。
author: jonclyd
source: POKENAME can be found haunting abandoned dwellings, using illusions to ward off intruders. Though elusive, they can be tamed—and once bonded, their loyalty runs deep.

entry: 它在战斗中吸走敌人斗志，为自己的火焰供能。战斗最激烈时，火焰失控，远处也能感到。
author: bacondlx
source: It drains the opponent's will to fight while in combat, fueling its own fire. At the height of a battle, its flames become uncontrollable and can be felt from a distance.

entry: POKENAME准备从嘴喷出烈火，身体上的球形部分就从后到前依次发光。夜飞的景象，常被许多人视为预兆。
author: infinex21
source: Each of the spherical parts of its body glow, starting from the rear to the front, when it prepares to unleash a torrent of flames from its maw. The sight of a POKENAME flying through the night sky is often considered an omen to many.

entry: 火焰里有星星般的光点，有故事说是失落已久的灵魂。POKENAME的火能热得扭曲周围空间。
author: infinex21
source: Within its flames are glimmers of light that are reminiscent of stars. Some stories claim these "stars" are long lost souls. The flames of a POKENAME can burn so hot they distort space around them.

entry: POKENAME盘踞弃屋，以幽火引好奇冒险者追逐。追得越久越困，最终陷入满是噩梦的睡眠，再被吸走生命精华。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME haunts abandoned homes, drawing in curious adventurers towards its ethereal flame. The longer they chase it, the drowsier they become, until they fall into a nightmare-filled slumber and have their life essence drained by POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME用炮烧倒敌人，以燃烧的身体给幽火供能。催眠火焰引对手站到炮前，再贴近轰击，化为灰烬。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME torches down foes with its cannon, using their burning bodies as fuel for its ghostly flames. Its hypnotic flames lure opponents to stand before its cannon, where it then blasts them point-blank, turning them into ashes.

entry: POKENAME四肢与炮，集中吞来的灵魂，以极高温燃烧。炮击彻底烧尽对手肉体与灵魂，只留灰烬。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's arms, legs, and cannon concentrate the spirits it has absorbed and burn them at superheated temperatures. Blasts from its cannon completely incinerate opponents in both body and soul, reducing them to ashes.

entry: POKENAME燃烧灵魂，幽灵能量膨胀，试图突破身体。但冰冷、透明的冰制身体，仍将火焰束缚体内。
author: soup1900
source: As POKENAME burns spirits, its ghostly energy expands and tries to break out of its body. However, thanks to its freezing, transparent ice body, its ghostly flames are kept bound inside.

entry: POKENAME全身幽火爆发，必须烧许多灵魂，才能维持稳定。先以极寒的冰冻结猎物，防止逃脱，再用幽火吞食灵魂。
author: soup1900
source: With ghostly flames bursting throughout its body, POKENAME must burn many spirits to keep its body stable. It freezes prey in ultracold ice so they cannot escape before consuming their soul in its ghostly flames.

entry: 与POKENAME久战，会因生命力不断被吸，感到极度无力。它吃够后，就退回高空。
author: mepp.
source: Those who fight POKENAME for extended periods of time find themselves feeling immense powerlessness as it continuously siphons their life force. Once it has consumed enough, it retreats back high into the air.

entry: POKENAME与训练家深厚相连后，占有欲极强，常寸步不离守望。若训练家死去，火焰便变黑，以示悲伤。
author: pokejirkaok
source: POKENAME grows fiercely possesive of its Trainer after forming a deep bond, often following them everywhere to watch over them. If its Trainer dies, its flames turn black as a sign of grief.

entry: POKENAME诞生于火灾损毁、被弃的住宅废墟。对人类深怀怨怒，将曾经家园的毁灭，全怪到人类头上。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME form in the ruins of homes that have been abandoned due to fire damage. They harbour a deep resentment and anger at humans, blaming them all for the destruction of what had once been their homes.

entry: POKENAME吸收并储存周围空气中的静电。蓄满时，便能放出强烈耀眼的光芒。
author: Trainerrobo
source: POKENAME absorbs and stores static electricity from the air around it. It is able to produce an intensely bright light when at full capacity.

entry: POKENAME通常独来独往，游荡山边森林，无视其他生灵。但满月之夜，火焰泛银光、突然高涨，它也更好斗。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME mostly keeps to itself, roaming forests near mountains and ignoring others. On nights of full moons, however, its flames take on a silvery glow and flare up, and it becomes more aggressive.

entry: POKENAME盘踞旧屋，沉进地板，等猎物靠近。一到够得着的范围，就跳起，以强劲双颚抓住。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME haunts old houses, submerging itself in the floor and waiting for prey to approach. As soon as anything gets within reach, it leaps up to seize them in its powerful jaws.

entry: POKENAME住在自己造就的荒废城镇里。医院与宝可梦中心，都有专门应对流程。
author: codewolfie
source: POKENAME resides in ghost towns it created. Hospitals and Pokémon Centers have special procedures for dealing with POKENAME.

entry: 暗洞中，POKENAME附着洞顶，幽火常是唯一照明。任何进入光里的生灵，都会被急切吸取生命能量。
author: t3isukone
source: In dark caves, the ghostly flames of POKENAME attached to the ceiling are often the only illumination. They eagerly absorb the life energy of anything that comes into their light.

entry: POKENAME每次获胜，火就更亮。斧状獠牙割伤，会烧灼皮肉，也让人感觉寒意入骨。
author: infinex21
source: A POKENAME's flames burn brighter with every victory in battle. Being cut by its axe-like tusks will both burn the flesh and feel as if it chills the bone.

entry: POKENAME高栖墓园，夜间守望。发现盗墓者或想破坏的人，就俯冲，洒紫色余烬赶走。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME perch high above graveyards, watching over them at night. Should they spot a grave robber or someone looking to vandalize the place, they will swoop down, showering them in purple embers to chase them off.

entry: 晴夜，POKENAME飞过天空，散出诡异紫光。传言，直视火焰，灵魂会被慢慢烧掉。
author: mistymagius
source: On clear nights, POKENAME soars through the sky, casting an eerie purple glow. Rumors say that if you stare directly into its flames, it will slowly burn your soul away.

entry: POKENAME毛发开始覆盖更多身体，只露眼睛下半与吊灯般的脸。对食物更不挑剔，如今火焰、灵魂都能吸取供能。
author: beatdoof
source: POKENAME's fur starts to envelop more of its body, leaving the lower half of its eyes and chandelier-like face visible. It is less discerning in its sustenance, now able to absorb both flames and spirits to fuel itself.

entry: POKENAME目光坚定，一颗头左右摇摆，另一颗头火焰更亮。几乎能听见它哼挽歌。
author: beatdoof
source: With an unflinching stare, POKENAME's one head sways from side to side, while the other's flames grow brighter. One can almost hear dirges hummed by it.

entry: POKENAME召出深红烈焰，烧灼任何挑战者。人们认为，火由灵魂能量构成，来自吸取猎物生命力。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME attacks by conjuring scarlet flames that it uses to scorch anyone who challenges it. These flames are thought to be composed of spiritual energy that it gains from draining the life force of its prey.

entry: POKENAME体内藏恶灵，化作永不熄灭的火焰。熄掉任何一处，就会引发大乱。
author: beatdoof
source: It harbors malevolent spirits inside its body, manifesting in the form of POKENAME's eternally burning flames. To extinguish any part of its fire is to unleash havoc.

entry: POKENAME住山顶间的云里。登山者报告，曾见它们照亮道路，但究竟通向陷阱还是安全，仍有争论。
author: jodue
source: POKENAME live in the clouds between mountaintops. Hikers report seeing them light the way. Whether they lead travelers into a trap or to safety is still debated.

entry: POKENAME细丝般的毛发越长，异世微光就越亮。故事说，每条尾里都有恶魂，被判永远烧下去——或者至少烧到彻底消失。
author: infinex21
source: The wispy furs of a POKENAME glow faintly with an otherworldly light the longer they grow. Stories claim that within each tail is a wicked soul that has been sentenced to being burned for eternity, or at least until it has reduced to nothingness.

entry: 据说，POKENAME身体流出的幽火，是灵魂的延伸，大小因个体而异。很受鬼屋设施欢迎，照明又营造不祥气氛。
author: chibitales
source: The ethereal flames that flow from POKENAME's body are said to be an extension of their soul, varying in size among individuals. They are popular among haunted house attractions, providing ambient lighting and an ominous atmosphere.

entry: POKENAME能重组身体，藏在阴影不被看见。似乎还能调整DNA，更好吸取周围夜间生命力，为火供能。
author: sk372
source: Being able to rearrange its body allows POKENAME to hide away unseen in the shadows. It appears to be able to attune its own DNA to better absorb the life force of those around it at night in order to fuel its flames.

entry: 据说，POKENAME实现亡者遗愿。人们推测，火焰是逐渐衰弱宝可梦的最后能量，在体内和谐融为一体。
author: crimsonklaw
source: POKENAME is said to fulfill the last wishes of the departed. The flames on its body are theorized to be the last energy of fading Pokémon, living in unified harmony within POKENAME's body.

entry: POKENAME靠吸取其他宝可梦生命力，不停活动。能量用太多，火焰会开始闪烁、变弱，动作却只更疯狂。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's constant activity is fueled by draining the life-force of other Pokémon. If it uses too much energy, its flames will begin to flicker and fade, but its movements will only become more frantic.

entry: POKENAME聚在破败房屋的电源插座旁。开心时身体电光闪烁，因而传出闹鬼之说。
author: alestrius
source: POKENAME congregate around electrical outlets in dilapidated houses. When they are happy, their bodies flash and flicker with electricity, leading to rumours of hauntings.

entry: POKENAME常伴富人。停电时，将幽火导入附近每个光源，营造不祥却温暖的环境。
author: actliux
source: POKENAME is often seen accompanying rich folk. When the power goes out, POKENAME will channel its spectral flame into every nearby light source, creating an ominous yet warming environment.

entry: POKENAME游荡歌剧院走廊，唱前一天的曲目。员工特意避开歌声，确信会给下一场演出带来厄运。
author: beetlething
source: In opera houses, POKENAME wander the halls while singing songs from the previous day's set. Opera house staff go out of their way to avoid going towards the singing, convinced that it's bad luck for the next performance.

entry: 它机动性差，便振翅催眠敌人。靠近后，烧掉受害者灵魂，再吞下空洞躯体。
author: h0bojoe
source: Because it lacks maneuverability, it vibrates its wings to hypnotize opponents. When it approaches, it burns away the victim's spirit and consumes the hollow body.

entry: POKENAME常在深海中结成小群，以光芒引来小型猎物，却也会招来捕食者。
author: jestersqueak
source: POKENAME are known for schooling in small groups in the depths of the sea. They use their glowing ability to draw in small prey, but this also attracts predators.

entry: 化学反应让POKENAME分解腐木时，迸出火焰般的光点。夜间紫色火光的景象，启发了一些鬼故事。
author: hophoppip
source: Thanks to chemical reactions, POKENAME produces flame-like sparks of light when it breaks down rotting wood. The sight of its purple fire in the night has inspired some ghost stories.

entry: POKENAME用燃烧的尾巴攻击。穿过身体虽不造成肉体伤害，构成尾巴的火焰却能烧伤灵魂。
author: .jerden
source: When attacking, POKENAME strikes foes with its fiery tail. Although it passes through without any damage to the body, the flame it is made of can still burn the spirit.

entry: POKENAME等在医院外，守候亡魂经过。有时还会吸走医院的电力，加快这个过程。
author: codewolfie
source: POKENAME waits outside of hospitals for spirits to pass. Sometimes POKENAME will sap the hospital's power to speed up the process.

entry: POKENAME的毛略黏，方便附在墙、天花板。越接近进化，火焰就越会呈现各种色调。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's fur is slightly sticky and helps it stick to walls and ceilings. As it grows closer to evolution, its flames start to shift in all sorts of different hues.

entry: POKENAME高速滚动玻璃身体，让敌人接触内部幽火。碰到后便撤退，耐心等灼痛令对方昏迷。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME can roll its glass body at high speed to expose foes to the spectral fire within. Once it has made contact, POKENAME retreats, patiently waiting for the burning pain this causes to knock the foe unconscious.

entry: POKENAME点燃猎物灵魂，在其复生前化为体内火焰。吐火时，里面能听见幽灵尖叫。
author: bandedbodypress
source: The fire in POKENAME's body is made from igniting the spirits of its prey before they can revive. When it breathes fire, ghostly shrieks can be heard within the flames.

entry: 野生POKENAME常在有人白天留下鲜花、蜡烛的墓园旁夜间跳舞。每次优雅挥翼，都会向四周散出羽毛般的火焰。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME are often seen dancing at night near graveyards whenever fresh flowers or candles have been left earlier that day. Every graceful movement of their wings sends feather-like flames around.

entry: 据说，迷失的灵魂附身坏掉的吊灯，就会诞生POKENAME。幽火燃着难闻臭味。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME is said to be born when a lost soul possesses a broken chandelier. Its ghostly flames burn with an awful stench.

entry: POKENAME被视为濒危，多数人却觉得是好事。怒气越强，火越热，至少有一例记录：特别愤怒的个体，瞬间让整座湖干涸。
author: natedawg210th.
source: POKENAME is considered endangered, but most people find this to be a blessing. Its flames get hotter with its anger, and there is at least one known case of an entire lake being dried up instantly by a particularly angry POKENAME.

entry: 它从碟状耳朵发出低频声波，能引发剧烈偏头痛。据说，它明亮的火焰能从正遭声波折磨的生灵那里获得力量。
author: hobiewankenobi
source: It emits subsonic frequencies from its dish-like ears, which can cause intense migraines. Its bright flames are said to be empowered by those who are currently the subject of its sonic torment.

entry: 强烈紫火将岩石身体烧成空心。双臂能释放可怕的火焰洪流，也能像炮弹般发射燃烧的岩石。
author: infinex21
source: Its body of rock has been hollowed by its intense, purple flames. From its arms, it can release torrents of fearsome fire and launch flaming rocks like cannonballs.

entry: POKENAME已释放全部力量，能用晶体身体集中内部幽火，发动毁灭性攻击，让身体与灵魂都彻底冰冷。
author: phantom640
source: Now with its full power unlocked, POKENAME can focus the ethereal flame inside it using its crystalline body to unleash devastating attacks that chill the body and soul to their very core.

entry: 据说，POKENAME火焰就是被冻死受害者的灵魂。摸起来极冷，因此身体从不融化。
author: bostroms
source: POKENAME's flames are said to be the souls it has drained away by freezing its victims to death.  The flames are freezing to the touch, which is how its body never melts.

entry: 研究发现，POKENAME身体的玻璃状球体，材料强于任何已知金属。内部闪烁的苍白火焰似乎能永无止境地燃烧，也看不出燃料来源。
author: anonymous_moose
source: A study has revealed that the vitreous sphere making up POKENAME's body is composed of a strange material stronger than any known metal. The pale flames that flicker within appear to burn indefinitely, with no apparent fuel source.

entry: 它会在夜里突然现身，全速冲向落单的训练家。据说，一旦被它撞中，就会被拖入冥界。
author: staghorn
source: It appears suddenly at night, charging lone Trainers at a full sprint. It is said that if it tackles you, you will be dragged into the netherworld.

entry: 野生POKENAME通常栖身于沉没的游轮残骸，会诅咒一切看见的船只。
author: dodoowner_
source: Wild POKENAME are usually found in the remains of a sunken cruise ship. It is known to put curses on any boats it spots.

entry: 深夜神秘幽灵船的传闻不断。人们相信，是POKENAME制造幻象，引不备水手葬身水中。
author: bignasty717
source: Rumors have circulated of a mysterious phantom ship sailing late at night. It's believed that POKENAME creates this illusion to lure unsuspecting sailors to their watery grave.

entry: POKENAME用高热精炼致命毒素，产生香水用的稀有原料。有些人相信，这香味能带来好运。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME refines its deadly toxin using intense heat, creating a rare ingredient used in perfumes. Some believe wearing this scent makes them lucky.

entry: POKENAME必须挥舞双臂，扩大肢体上的火焰，增加战斗伤害。但臂上的火焰越大，躯干火焰越小，速度随之下降。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME must swing its arms around to increase the size of the flames on its limbs and do more damage in combat. As the fire on its arms grows, the flame in its torso diminishes, lowering its speed in turn.

entry: POKENAME背上发光的灯，以植物生命力为燃料。夜里攀附的树虽然未受物理损伤，第二天早上却会开始落叶。
author: .jerden
source: The glowing lamps on POKENAME's back are fuelled by the life force of plants. Although the trees that it clings to at night are not physically damaged, their leaves will begin to drop the next morning.

entry: 据说，POKENAME体内住着无数灵魂，分别系于内部不同的房间。窗中闪烁着幽光，仔细聆听，还能听见隐约的低语。
author: rakunk
source: POKENAME is said to be inhabited by countless spirits living inside its body, each tied to a different room inside its structure. Its windows flicker with ghostly lights, and faint whispers can be heard if you listen closely.

entry: 许多人看POKENAME，会觉得心下沉重，仿佛两个球状部分之间的流沙，代表自己的生命。虽无根据，仍不断翻转，想确保沙永不流尽。
author: crystalgemheliotrope
source: Many who observe POKENAME have a sinking feeling, as if the sands going between its dual bulbs represent their own lives. These feelings are unsubstantiated, but many still will flip POKENAME's bulbs to attempt to make sure it never fully drains.

entry: POKENAME迅捷的动作与邪恶火焰，常预示对手的毁灭。最后一击往往是把敌人埋进岩石构成的墓，再以火焰点燃。
author: infinex21
source: The swift movements and wicked flames of a POKENAME often paint a picture of doom for its opponents. Their finishing move is oft to bury their opponent in a tomb of rocks and set them ablaze with a blast of fire.

entry: POKENAME以腐坏灵魂为食，会不断与认定如此的对象战斗，全不顾脆弱玻璃身体受损。最年长个体满是裂纹，难以想象仍未粉碎。
author: _pixelar_
source: POKENAME sustains itself by feeding on rotten souls. It will relentlessly fight anyone deemed as such regardless of the damage to its fragile glass body. The eldest POKENAME have so many cracks, it seems impossible that they haven't shattered.

entry: POKENAME只出现在生命即将走到尽头的生灵身边，因此极少见。传说歌声能安抚灵魂，让终点前得到平静。
author: oejoeboy33
source: POKENAME is rarely seen, as it appears only around those who are fading into the afterlife. It is said that its songs help ease the spirit, helping bring peace before the end.

entry: POKENAME常被新葬仪式吸引，据说是因为参加者的情绪。为尊敬逝者，它们会伴着美丽歌声与幽灵火焰，献上热情舞蹈。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are often drawn to graveyards during new burials; supposedly, they are drawn by the emotions of those attending the burials. In respect of the deceased, they perform passionate dances accompanied by beautiful songs and spectral flames.

entry: POKENAME如在空中游泳，磨动玻璃牙齿的声音让人不安。每次使用超自然力量，体内蓝火就会窜出头顶。
author: .jerden
source: As POKENAME swims through the air, it unsettles people by grinding its glass teeth together.  Whenever it uses supernatural powers, the blue flame inside its body flares out of the top of its head.

entry: 幽火在这些宝可梦玻璃般的壳里旋转，偶尔冲出身体。火不但烧肉体，也烧灵魂，直到只剩烤过的空壳，留待吞食。
author: infinex21
source: Spectral flames swirl within the glass-like shells of these Pokémon, occasionally bursting out across parts of their bodies. These flames burn not only the body, but the soul itself until all that remains is a hollow, roasted shell to be fed upon.

entry: POKENAME守护地下墓穴的死者，据说幽火能温暖身在来世的灵魂。盗墓者一惹怒，常会遭可怕命运。
author: actliux
source: POKENAME can be found in catacombs protecting the deceased. Their ghostly flames are said to give warmth to those in the afterlife. Grave robbers are often met with a terrible fate when they incur this Pokémon's wrath.

entry: 野生POKENAME住旧屋，在墙上静止装灯。谁太近，幽火就开始吸取生命力。
author: .jerden
source: Wild POKENAME live within old houses, remaining motionless on the walls to pretend to be nothing more than lamps. If anyone gets too close, their ghostly flames will begin to siphon life-force.

entry: POKENAME白天栖在树上，静止得如同黑花。夜间亮起幽火，游过森林，引其他宝可梦靠近，再发出明亮光束攻击。
author: .jerden
source: During the day, POKENAME will perch in a tree, remaining motionless like a black flower. At night, it will roam the forest with its ghostly fires lit, luring in other Pokémon with the light, then firing bright beams at them to attack.

entry: POKENAME被安息之地吸引，夜里挥杖，操控许多鬼火跳舞。天性并无恶意，但靠近其他生灵时，火就更强。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are drawn to resting sites, typically seen at night dancing about while commanding many will-o'-wisps around with their staves. They display no inherent malice, though their flames grow stronger when near others.

entry: POKENAME用火焰感知生命能量，轻易找到受害者，烧掉灵魂。臂上悬链、珠串既能迅速殴打猎物，也能像摆锤一样催眠。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME can sense life energy with its flames, making it very simple to find a victim and burn their soul. The hanging chains and beads from its arms act as both an offensive tool to quickly pummel prey and like a pendulum to hypnotize foes.

entry: POKENAME是玻璃吹制师的传统伙伴，既供热，也供灵感。脆弱玻璃翼，不断闪着内部火光。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are traditional companions of glass blowers, providing both a source of heat and a source of inspiration. Their delicate glass wings flicker constantly with the light of their inner fire.

entry: POKENAME晶体身体闪着无数恶魂在幽火中燃烧的光。闪亮帷幕也是可伸长触须，以轻柔优雅净除生者灵魂污秽。
author: infinex21
source: The crystalline body of a POKENAME shimmers with the lights of myriad evil souls burning within its ghostly flames. Its sparkling veil serves also as extendable feelers that will purge impurities from living souls with a gentle grace.

entry: POKENAME招引旅人到僻静处，再放出强光，晃得对方看不见。趁机偷走钱与珠宝，再消失得无影无踪。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME beckon travelers to a secluded location before they flash a bright light to blind the travelers. Once blinded, POKENAME pilfer any money and jewelry they may have before vanishing without a trace.

entry: 深夜，POKENAME奔过大地，诡异紫焰照亮景色，远处也能见。古神话说，它追着尚未准备好离世的灵魂。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME can be seen from great distances late at night, their eerie purple flames illuminating the landscape as they race across it. Ancient myths claim that they chase after the spirits of those not yet ready to pass on.

entry: 深夜，POKENAME奔过大地，诡异紫焰照亮景色，远处也能见。身体由脆弱玻璃组成，更愿远程用灼热喷射火焰作战。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME can be seen from great distances late at night, their eerie purple flames illuminating the landscape as they race across it. Their bodies consist of delicate glass, and they prefer to fight at range with scorching Flamethrowers.

entry: 故事说，POKENAME帮炼金术师制灵魂药水。实际曾被用于制作液态火，装瓶后用来替代灯笼。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Tales describe POKENAME assisting alchemists with the creation of soul-based potions. In actuality, POKENAME was employed in the production of liquid fire, which, when bottled, is used as an alternative to lanterns.

entry: POKENAME记得生前、死后的知识。曾在葬礼吸收一个人一生所知，特别感兴趣的墓，还会留蜡烛。
author: getsu
source: POKENAME can recall the knowledge it had in both life and afterlife. It has been spotted at funerals where it absorbs the knowledge of a person's life, and leaves a candle at graves it deems especially interesting.

entry: POKENAME很笨拙，短腿会绊倒，尾巴也会卡住。据说旧时富人用它照亮花园水池，但附近出现死亡事件后，迷信兴起，做法便停止。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is clumsy, tripping due to its stubby legs or getting its tails caught. It is said that in the past the wealthy would use this Pokémon to illuminate their garden ponds, but the practice stopped after superstitions arose from deaths near it.

entry: POKENAME奔过夜空，后轮旋转，燃着幽火。有故事说，它以火引导迷失的灵魂，但毫无证据。
author: infinex21
source: A POKENAME's hind wheels spin ablaze with ghastly flames as it runs across the night sky. Some stories would have people believe that these Pokémon guide lost spirits with their flames, but there is no proof to support such claims.

entry: POKENAME每胜一场，燃着火焰的尾巴、耳朵就会长大，更让人相信吸取周围生命能量的传言。它喜欢定期清洁玻璃外壳的训练家。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME's flaming tail and ears grow with every victory, lending credence to the rumor that it absorbs life energy from those around it. It has a fondness for Trainers who regularly clean its glass exterior.

entry: POKENAME释放阵阵火浪，逼藏身附近的生灵移动或惊叫。露面后，便用类似磁力的力量固定，使其逃不过命运。
author: soup1900
source: To search for living beings hiding nearby, POKENAME sends out waves of fire to force them to make movements or scream in fear. Once they're in the open, it generates a magnetic-like force to pin them in one place so that they can't escape their fate.

entry: POKENAME不能自然浮空，必须用以灵魂为燃料的幽火飞行。火一弱，就得靠下部大磁铁，跑着追逐猎物。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME cannot float naturally on its own; it must use its ghostly flames to fly in the air. As these flames are fueled by souls, it must physically run after prey on its large lower magnets whenever the flames begin to diminish.

entry: POKENAME无声游过墓园。据说一颗头引善良灵魂平静安息，另一颗则护送邪恶灵魂，前往永恒黑暗。
author: _refuse_
source: POKENAME silently wander around cemeteries. It is said one head guides kind souls to a peaceful rest, while the other escorts wicked souls to eternal darkness.

entry: POKENAME喜欢废弃建筑，尤其宅邸。三团火焰叠加的热量，常会点燃木家具与旧建筑。
author: _refuse_
source: POKENAME are drawn to abandoned structures, most notably mansions. The combined heat of its three flames often sets wooden furniture and old structures aflame.

entry: POKENAME可能以幽灵魔法拦渔民回港。只要分一点渔获，就能脱离法术。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME may block fisherman from returning to their harbors with its ghostly magic. To escape the spell, simply give it a share of your catch.

entry: 身体由浓稠油脂组成，为火焰供能。吸取生命力时，油会膨胀。
author: hophoppip
source: Its body is composed of thick, greasy oil that fuels its flame. When it absorbs life-force, the oil expands.

entry: POKENAME直到出击前最后一刻，才睁开真正的眼睛，骗敌人以为腹部的脸才是真脸。背上火盆里的火随战斗高涨，最终覆盖外壳与双臂。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME keeps its true eyes closed until the last moment before striking to make opponents believe that the face on its belly is the real face. The fire in the braziers on its back grows as it fights, eventually coating its shell and arms in flame.

entry: POKENAME饿了，就点燃刺尖，用催眠火光引来海中生灵。靠近后打开壳，将受害者灵魂吸进体内。
author: sk372
source: When it grows hungry, POKENAME ignites the tips of its spines, drawing undersea denizens closer with the hypnotic glow of the flames' light. Once they come close, it opens its shell, and sucks the soul of its victim within.

entry: POKENAME以头顶火盆使出强力火箭头锤，命中便吸取敌人生命力。它极以灵魂火焰为傲，夜夜擦亮外壳，扩大引诱光芒的范围，也增强战时火势。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME absorbs the life force of foes by landing a powerful Skull Bash with the brazier on its head. It takes great pride in its soul flame, polishing its shell nightly to enhance the range of its luring glow and the intensity during battle.

entry: 獠牙锋利得切钢板如切纸。它用脱落的獠牙作武器，投出去，也会如回旋镖返回。
author: infinex21
source: Its tusks are sharp enough to cut through a sheet of steel as if it were paper. It wields one of its shed tusks as a weapon; when thrown, this shed tusk will return to it like a boomerang.

entry: 据传，POKENAME因龙属性宝可梦迁徙，早已失去原生家园。因此主动猎捕双斧战龙，用自身斧刃撕开钛金属。
author: ghostslythe
source: POKENAME is rumored to have lost its natural habitat long ago due to Dragon-type migrations. As such, they actively hunt Haxorus, using their own axes to shred through titanium.

entry: POKENAME的舌尖平时柔软，绷紧特殊肌肉后，就锋利得超过金属，几乎什么都切得开。戳腋下会使它不由自主绷紧，曾因此发生数起事故。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: The tip of POKENAME's tongue remains soft until it tenses special muscles in it, which then becomes sharper than metal, and can cut through nearly anything. Poking their armpit causes them to involuntarily tense, which has led to several accidents.

entry: 与双斧战龙相似，POKENAME平时温顺，甚至开朗、爱表演。但林地遭入侵，就会狂暴。有次目击说，它把敌人按在无形墙上。
author: bobosmith01
source: Similar to Haxorus, POKENAME is typically docile and even cheerful and performative, but it will become violent if its woodland territory is intruded upon. One sighting of POKENAME described how it pinned a foe against an invisible wall.

entry: POKENAME厚甲保护身体，抵御许多物理威胁。它以沉重身体撞敌，再借惯性挥动头部斧状的角。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are covered in a thick plating that protects them from many physical threats. They swing their bulky bodies into foes and use the momentum to swing the axe-like horns upon their head.

entry: POKENAME身上的许多长刃都涂有毒液。斩击留下的伤口，会长出疼痛水泡。
author: quackquackattack
source: The many long blades across POKENAME's body are coated with venom. Whenever they slash at their foes, painful blisters sprout from the cuts they create.

entry: POKENAME虽小，却力大无穷。尾巴上的斧刃一挥，就能一击砍倒红杉树。
author: bostroms
source: Despite its small size, POKENAME possesses incredible strength.  It can swing the axe on its tail with enough force to chop down a redwood tree in one blow.

entry: POKENAME在浑水里静伏数小时，经过的训练家常误认漂木。戟状钳子，也充当第二副颚。
author: stormknight20
source: Lying still in murky waters for hours on end, passing Trainers mistake POKENAME for a drifting log. Its halberd-like pincers act as a secondary jaw.

entry: 即使黑夜，POKENAME血红双眼仍发出凶光。头上锋利的冠部或脚爪一击，便迅速击倒任何猎物。
author: mepp.
source: Even in the darkness of night, POKENAME's blood-red eyes glow fiercely. Any prey is swiftly taken down with one strike from its sharp crest or talons.

entry: POKENAME从嘴吸取猎物能量，专吃其他强大捕食者。反而有利当地较弱猎物的数量，但它是否明白，仍不清楚。
author: bobosmith01
source: Through its maw, POKENAME saps the energy of its prey: other powerful predators. This behavior ends up positively affecting the population of would-be weaker prey in the area, although it is unclear if POKENAME is aware of this.

entry: POKENAME用脸两侧锋利的冠状突起伐树，只挑倒木中最好的树枝筑巢，留下大部分植物。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME hack down trees using the sharp crests on either side of their face. They search the fallen trees for the most choice branches for their nests, leaving most of the plant in place.

entry: POKENAME旋转、疾冲着跳舞，体型虽大，速度却意外惊人。颈部刀刃用于防御，几乎碰到什么都能切开。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME dances with swift twirls and rapid darting movements, moving with surprising speed for its size. The blades around its neck are used as a defence mechanism, cutting through almost anything they come into contact with.

entry: 树才怪模仿树，POKENAME却刻意毁树。讽刺的是，通常被气候活动人士捕获，只为阻止在野外作乱。
author: jangodiot
source: Contrary to how Sudowoodo mimic trees, POKENAME go out of their way to destroy them. This Pokémon is, ironically, usually caught by climate activists to prevent them from causing terror in the wild.

entry: POKENAME住茂密海带林，用剃刀般的鳃维持领地。研究者将这片领地称作它的花园，因为打理得极整齐，还远渡大海带回异域植物。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME lives in dense kelp forests and uses its razor-sharp gills to maintain its territory. Researchers refer to this territory as POKENAME's garden, as it keeps it very tidy, and even travels across the ocean to bring back exotic plants.

entry: 双腿强壮，撑住钢壳重量。每根刀状獠牙都能轻松切开粗树，因此脱落的牙，历史上常被作武器。
author: infinex21
source: Its legs have grown strong to support the weight of its steel shell. Each of its blade-like tusks can cut through a solid tree with ease, so shed tusks of this Pokémon have oft been used as weapons throughout the past.

entry: 据说，POKENAME钳子能切开一切。遭反对，就举起巨钳威吓，有时连大自己数倍的宝可梦也会害怕。
author: altgothacked
source: POKENAME is said to be able to slice anything with its pincers. When opposed, it raises its massive pincers to threaten its foe, sometimes even intimidating Pokémon many times its size.

entry: POKENAME身体因高温不断冒泡，外面又有厚实装甲，几乎无法触碰。但行动慢，来不及躲水与冰的攻击。
author: bigoljax
source: With their bodies bubbling due to their high body heat and the dense armor around their bodies, POKENAME are practically untouchable. However, because of their low speed, they're too slow to dodge water and ice attacks.

entry: POKENAME高速跃出海，用刀刃般的鳍切过掠水的鸟。捕猎时，甚至曾干净切断帆船桅杆。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME leap out of the ocean at high speeds, using their bladed fins to slice through birds skimming the water's surface. These Pokémon have even been known to slice clean through the masts of sailboats during their hunts.

entry: 斧状獠牙留下的小切口，也会像着火般灼痛，直到愈合。它们用割痕，或火焰烧痕，标记领地。
author: infinex21
source: Even a small cut from the axe-like tusks of these Pokémon will burn as if on fire until the wound heals. They mark their territories with physical gashes or with scorch marks made with their flames.

entry: POKENAME用锋利獠牙伐树，聚起来建家。筑好巢后，会在下面冬眠半年。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME fells trees with its sharp tusks in order to gather them together and make a home for itself. Once a den is created, it hibernates underneath it for half of the year.

entry: POKENAME切分直播视频，再拼接成搞笑片段。许多创作者靠它，以精简形式保存难忘时刻。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME slice livestream videos into parts and splice together parts to create a funny clip. Many content creators rely on POKENAME's help to capture memorable moments in a condensed format.

entry: POKENAME每走一步，都伴着滚雷。每次挥动锋利獠牙，便释放闪电，给击中的一切劈出深痕。
author: sk372
source: The sound of rolling thunder accompanies every step POKENAME takes across the region. Arcs of lightning are unleashed with every swing of its sharp tusks, cleaving deep gashes into anything they hit.

entry: POKENAME长途飞行后，在海崖休息。临近船上空时，水手惊慌地试图驶离，却不知只想在猛烈风暴前，引他们回岸。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME rests within sea cliffs, letting its body relax after lengthy flights. When it looms over boats, Sailors frantically try to sail away from it, not knowing it only wants to lead them back to shore before a harsh storm hits.

entry: POKENAME喧闹、爱吹嘘，急着炫耀力量。尾巴一挥伐树，再用雷将倒木化灰，全为大显神威。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a boisterous braggart highly eager to show off its strength. It fells trees with a clean swipe of its tail before zapping the fallen trunk to ashes with lightning, all in a grandiose effort to display its power.

entry: POKENAME常在网吧，煽动过时论坛里的骂战。虽外表粗暴、性格无礼，传闻智力却高得超出智商测试能测的范围。
author: victor9106
source: POKENAME is often found in internet cafes, inciting flame wars on obsolete internet forums. Despite its brutish appearance and rude personality, it is rumored to have an intellect beyond what an IQ test can measure.

entry: 它用天生的利刃剪枝、刮去树皮，让藏在树干下的猎物无处遁形。外表虽凶，性情却温和随意。
author: staghorn
source: It uses its natural blades to clip branches and scrape bark from tree trunks, exposing prey underneath. Despite its fearsome appearance, it has a gentle and easygoing temperament.

entry: POKENAME蜷球，利刺便能重创敌人，不管皮多硬。刺被采下制箭，在黑市供偷猎者，轻松猎捕濒危宝可梦。
author: soup1900
source: When POKENAME curls into a ball, it can use its sharp spines to completely maul foes no matter how hard their skin is. Its spines are harvested and made into arrows for poachers on the black market to easily hunt endangered Pokémon down.

entry: POKENAME据传守着大批财宝，常遭盗贼追猎。天性领地意识强，用未知力量命植物挡路，再以能穿甲的角刺穿威胁者。
author: ghostslythe
source: Rumored to guard great treasure hordes, POKENAME is often hunted by thieves. Territorial by nature, it uses unknown powers to command plant life to block the threat's way before impaling them on its armor-piercing horns.

entry: POKENAME每把斧都独一无二，用其他龙属性宝可梦在决斗中掉下的鳞片制作。每把刀刃都带精神印记，只有原主能挥舞。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Each axe is unique to POKENAME. They make their axes from scales dropped by other Dragon‑type Pokémon during duels. Each blade carries a psychic signature that allows only its POKENAME to wield it.

entry: POKENAME全身都化为武器，战斗哪部分都用。手臂上的刀刃却最出色，多层钢铁也能轻易利落切开。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME fight with every part of their body, as every part of their body has effectively formed into a weapon. The blades upon their arms are their best weapons, however, and they are able to cleanly slice through multiple layers of steel with ease.

entry: POKENAME拆楼价值高，锋利獠牙轻易切开钢梁、混凝土柱。真正珍贵却是智慧，能按精确角度切割，让楼向内塌，而非往外倒。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME is highly valued for demolition. Its sharp tusks cut steel beams and concrete pillars with ease, but its real value comes from its intelligence, as it can cut at precise angles to make buildings collapse inwards rather than falling outwards.

entry: POKENAME披着金属装甲，獠牙利如剃刀。头内虽有一颗小小的大脑，大多思考却由下方体内四颗大脑组成的网络完成。
author: .jerden
source: Covered by metallic armor, POKENAME's tusks are razor-sharp. Although POKENAME has a small brain in its head, most of its thinking is done by a network of four brains in the body below.

entry: POKENAME集中徘徊灵魂的怒火，将缥缈形体凝成旋转刀刃。它用本来封印、拖慢自己的沉重铁石磨刀，希望最终挣脱束缚。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME focus the anger of lingering spirits to solidify their wispy forms into whirling blades. They practice sharpening their blades against the heavy iron stones meant to seal them and slow them down in hopes of eventually breaking free.

entry: POKENAME以感知的波导、意志衡量强弱，从不打自认比自己弱的对象。它以自身波导包裹臂上刀刃，据说伤害超出肉体感官。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME never fight those they think to be weaker than they are, which they measure by the aura and will that they sense. They wreathe the blades upon their arms in their own aura to inflict damage that is said to go beyond the physical senses.

entry: POKENAME身体两侧刀刃，连最硬装甲也能切开。除了战斗，还带来出人意料的流线型外形，让它游得惊人地快。
author: dukefrogpeasant
source: The blades at the sides of POKENAME can slice through even the hardest armor. Aside from being used in combat, they also give POKENAME a surprisingly aerodynamic shape, allowing it to swim surprisingly fast.

entry: POKENAME耐心等树上果实成熟，不等落地，便用利斧伐树。也用同样刀刃，赶走竞争者。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME will patiently wait near trees until fruit is in season. Once it is ripe, they will not wait for it to fall, but will simply fell the tree with their sharp axes, using the same blades to drive away any competition.

entry: POKENAME保护孤儿牙牙，当自家幼崽养，直到能自保。暴怒时将尾巴猛砸地面，引发可怕震动。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME protects orphaned Axew, raising them as part of its own brood until they are strong enough to fend for themselves. When it flies into a rage, it slams its tail against the ground to unleash terrible tremors.

entry: POKENAME斩过地底宝石，磨利獠牙。碎宝石被收集，用于许多地区的宗教仪式。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME sharpens its tusks by slashing through gemstones found deep underground. The fractured gems are collected and used in religious rituals across many regions.

entry: POKENAME点燃尾巴上的刀刃、挥舞，让自己更吓人。真正暴怒，还能点燃脸上刀刃般的獠牙，切割、烧灼惹怒者。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME lights up the blade on its tail and swings it around to appear more intimidating to others. When truly enraged, it can set the blade-tusks on its face alight as well to cut and burn the target of its ire.

entry: POKENAME领地意识强，用带龙之能量气场的武术连击，不停打击敌人。凶猛拳脚，能将钢铁打碎。
author: thepandasharky
source: POKENAME are territorial Pokémon. They strike their foes with relentless martial arts strikes that have an aura of draconic energy. POKENAME are able to crush steel into bits with their ferocious punches and kicks.

entry: POKENAME一见看起来强悍的对手，就想上前打一场。至今，还没遇过一斩劈不开的盾牌或铠甲。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME is eager to challenge tough-looking opponents to a brawl. It has yet to meet a shield or armor it could not break in one slash.

entry: POKENAME一见看起来强悍的对手，就想上前打一场。至今，还没遇过一斩劈不开的盾牌或铠甲。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME is eager to challenge tough-looking opponents to a brawl. It has yet to meet a shield or armor it could not break in one slash.

entry: 只要不在战斗，它就不停磨砺刀刃。过去曾有一只POKENAME仅挥动一下身体，就劈开了整座山。
author: skymaster426
source: It constantly sharpens its blades whenever not fighting. In the past, one POKENAME split an entire mountain with a single swing of its body.

entry: POKENAME只与值得一战的对手交锋，刀刃般的尾巴迅速突刺、宽幅横斩。双翼能切穿坚实岩石，也借切岩标记领地。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME will only fight with worthy opponents, using their blade-like tails to perform swift thrusting strikes and wide sweeping slashes. Their wings are sharp enough to cut through solid rock, which also serves to mark their territory.

entry: 它虽四肢行走，战斗也能后肢直立，更好用獠牙攻击，再以红色触须够最爱的食物。
author: infinex21
source: Although it walks on all limbs, it can stand on its hind limbs even during battle. It does this to better deliver attacks with its tusks and to reach its favorite foods using its red feelers.

entry: POKENAME是最好斗、领地意识最强的融合之一，占据森林，用斧状獠牙按喜好重塑。任何反对的住民，都被巨力、凶狠迅速击退。
author: sk372
source: As one of the most aggressive and territorial fusions, POKENAME takes over forests and reshapes them to its liking using its axe-like tusks. Any forest residents who oppose this act are quickly routed by its immense strength and ferocity.

entry: 有人相信，POKENAME为混乱、破坏，斩入我们的世界。触须末端刀刃，能在地面、半空划开通往毁坏的世界的门。
author: sk372
source: Some believe POKENAME cut its way into our world in order to cause chaos and destruction. The blades at the end of its tendrils are able to slice open portals to the Distortion World in the ground or midair.

entry: POKENAME战斗中獠牙命中越多，炮射激光就越准。但经常连炮的存在都忘了，只爱用獠牙。
author: .izik
source: The more successful strikes POKENAME lands with its tusks in a battle, the more accurate its cannon's laser becomes. Despite this, it frequently forgets the cannon exists, preferring to rely on its tusks.

entry: POKENAME外骨骼极耐用，覆盖大多身体。翅膀与爪子上的锋利边缘足够坚韧，能轻松切过钢梁，永不变钝。
author: thezekrom
source: POKENAME's exoskeleton is extremely durable and covers most of its body. The sharp edges on its wings and claws are sturdy enough to easily cut through steel beams and never get dull.

entry: POKENAME虽模样古老得仿佛来自史前，如今却仍活得好好的。凭借速度与尾刃，森林和猎物都能被它轻松劈开。
author: patch_bros
source: Despite its prehistoric appearance, POKENAME is still very much alive today. It uses its speed and tail to effortlessly cut through forests and prey.

entry: POKENAME每场战斗，都将几乎全身磨成致命武器。领地布满众多刀刃留下的不同痕迹。
author: infinex21
source: Every battle POKENAME has ever fought has honed nearly every part of its body into a deadly weapon. Its territory is marked with many different marks left by its myriad blades.

entry: POKENAME人形身体全是镀锌钢。胸腔有一颗铅制心脏，散出奇怪温暖。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's human-like body is made entirely of galvanized steel. Its chest cavity holds a lead heart that radiates a strange warmth.

entry: POKENAME内脏由钢制成，会把这些器官排出体外，像挥斧一样用来击退敌人。
author: _snakeywakey_
source: POKENAME has internal organs made of steel. It ejects and swings these organs like an axe to fight off enemies.

entry: POKENAME头脑简单，几乎只剩砍东西的破坏冲动。即使一天伐倒整座雨林，也无法满足它劈砍的欲望。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's mind is simple, filled with little more than a destructive impulse to cut things down. Even felling an entire rainforest within the span of a day isn't enough to satiate its need to hack and slash.

entry: POKENAME同样受人畏惧、敬奉。它们如守护者，以神秘力量和许多斧头般的尾巴保护领地，从不主动求战。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are often feared by humans as much as they are revered by humans. These guardian-like Pokémon wield a combination of mystical powers and their many axe-like tails to protect their territory, but they never seek conflict.

entry: POKENAME想留好印象，会藏起獠牙，投射出另一种无害宝可梦的幻象。一开战就占优，对手尚未准备，便已挥下强大刀刃。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME conceal their tusks when they wish to make a good impression, projecting an illusion of a different, harmless species. This gives an advantage should a fight break out, as they can swing their mighty blades before their opponent is ready.

entry: POKENAME想留好印象，会藏起獠牙，投射出另一种无害宝可梦的幻象。一开战就占优，对手尚未准备，便已挥下强大刀刃。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME conceal their tusks when they wish to make a good impression, projecting an illusion of a different, harmless species. This gives an advantage should a fight break out, as they can swing their mighty blades before their opponent is ready.

entry: POKENAME双翼一挥便能切开坚岩。成群俯冲时，连装甲最厚的敌人也能击倒。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME's wings are capable of slicing through solid rock in a single sweep. Swarms of these Pokémon are able to take down even the most heavily armored foes, diving at them from above.

entry: POKENAME伏在热沙，等不备猎物经过，再在最佳时机用强颚、致命刀刃出击。领地意识极强，连同类也会凶狠攻击。
author: bluenido.
source: POKENAME lies in the hot desert sand, waiting for unaware prey to pass by. It strikes at the perfect opportunity with its powerful jaws and deadly blades. Extremely territorial, it will fiercely attack even members of its own kind.

entry: POKENAME通常住在洞穴深处，保护着牙牙与百足蜈蚣一族融合而成的大群幼虫。若受到威胁，就会变得极为凶暴。
author: cutiepierate
source: POKENAME are usually found deep within caves, protecting large amounts of Axepede larvae.  They can be highly aggressive if threatened.

entry: POKENAME装甲极硬，难以击败，偏偏又极好斗。它会冲向任何来者，想用锋利刀状獠牙刺穿。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: Its incredibly tough armour makes it hard to take down, which is a problem as POKENAME are incredibly aggressive. They charge at anyone, attempting to spear them with its sharp blade-like tusks.

entry: 据说，POKENAME来自外星沼泽。性情极敌对，很难打倒，倒下后灵魂却还会存留片刻。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: POKENAME is said to have come from the swamps of an alien planet. It is extremely hostile and tough to take down, but its soul will persist for a moment once it falls.

entry: POKENAME极护幼崽，以强化视野警戒。猎物藏进珊瑚或沉船，就用面前刀刃切开，追进去。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is exceedingly protective of its young, using its enhanced visual field to watch for threats. When it senses prey hiding within coral or sunken ships, it will use the bladed front of its face to carve through in pursuit.

entry: 友善请求时，POKENAME可能伐木送给想当伐木工的人。但伐木工的任何工具，哪怕只碰到它所居森林中任何一棵树的树皮，就会让它陷入无情的狂暴。
author: bobosmith01
source: When kindly asked, POKENAME may cut down and give lumber to any would-be lumberjacks. However, if any of the lumberjack's tools so much as touch the bark of any tree in the woods POKENAME dwells in, POKENAME will go into a ruthless frenzy.

entry: POKENAME刀刃滴下的滑黏液能润滑，轻松切开实体物。角平时向后，却柔韧，能将刀刃转向任意角度攻击。
author: .jerden
source: The slippery slime dripping from POKENAME's blades provides lubrication, enabling them to smoothly cut through solid objects. Although its horns usually face backwards, they are flexible and can swing the blades around to strike from any angle.

entry: POKENAME背上的蘑菇受厚鳞保护，孢子却能从缝间释放。它用利刃削出薄木片，再吞下，供体内真菌消化。
author: .jerden
source: The mushroom on POKENAME's back is protected by thick scales, but can release spores through the gaps between them. POKENAME uses its sharp blades to shave thin slivers of wood off trees, swallowing them for the fungus inside it to digest.

entry: 传说，POKENAME曾率整支宝可梦军队，逼其战斗取乐。也曾被目击，将整座山斩成碎石。
author: mistymagius
source: Legends say that POKENAME once commanded entire armies of Pokémon, forcing them to fight for its amusement. It has been seen slashing entire mountains to nothing but rubble.

entry: POKENAME不易怒，会先以鳞片发出令人发抖的声音警告。但战时，刀刃般的鳞片比坦克装甲更硬，能轻易切开钢铁。
author: badwolf6066
source: Slow to anger, POKENAME will create a shiver-inducing sound with its scales as a warning. In combat however, its bladed scales are tougher than tank armor and can slice through steel with ease.

entry: POKENAME双臂虽是巨刃，动作却沉着、优雅而精确。从不伤无恶意者，但想伤它，就会迎来旋风般连斩。
author: sk372
source: Though wielding huge blades for arms, POKENAME moves with calculated grace and calm. It never hurts those who mean no ill will, but those that try to harm it will see it become a dervish of cutting swings.

entry: POKENAME光滑的装甲方便快速追猎，头冠、獠牙都长得与爪一样锋利。舌头上的鳞片很容易撕下，常被当作飞刀。
author: fr3dd1922
source: POKENAME's body armor is incredibly smooth to help them pursue their prey swiftly. The crest and tusks on POKENAME's head are grown to be as sharp as their claws. The scales on POKENAME's tongue shred off easily and are often used as throwing knives.

entry: POKENAME忠诚，保护欲极强，自中世纪起就用作守卫。每年脱一次獠牙，再制成长戟、斧等武器。
author: milchik
source: These extremely protective and loyal Pokémon were used as guards since medieval times. POKENAME shed their tusks once a year and fashion them into various weapons such as halberds and axes.

entry: POKENAME闪亮獠牙与猫般从容优雅，让失落沙漠王国曾将其尊为王权象征。如今带着沉静威严，巡视烈日炙烤的废墟，打扰者会迎来迅捷、威严的怒火。
author: silentscript89
source: Its gleaming tusks and poised, feline grace once earned POKENAME reverence as a symbol of royal might in a desert kingdom lost to time. Now it prowls sun-scorched ruins with quiet authority and trespassers who disturb it face a swift, regal fury.

entry: POKENAME飞过天空，寻找值得一战的对手。用刀状獠牙决斗，只对最强的敌人使用火焰吐息。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME fly through the sky, searching for worthy opponents. They duel using their blade-like tusks, reserving their fiery breath for only the strongest of foes.

entry: 敌人战斗时得提防POKENAME，远离剃刀般锋利的双翼。它不断冲撞对手，等对手耗尽精力，才动用火焰。
author: mepp.
source: In battle, enemies must be wary of POKENAME and stay clear of its razor-sharp wings. POKENAME's preferred strategy is to relentlessly charge at opponents, only using its fire when they expended all their energy.

entry: 大舌贝咬住尾巴时，POKENAME会痛得乱甩。尾巴挥动的力道极大，能将电线杆干净利落地劈成两半。
author: mistymagius
source: When the Shellder bites down on POKENAME's tail, it will thrash around in pain. Its swinging tail can swing with enough force to cleave a telephone pole cleanly in half.

entry: POKENAME走到哪里，都骄傲带着战斧。只要挥得得当，一击便能砍倒一棵树。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME proudly wield their battleaxe wherever they go. A proper swing can fell a tree in one swoop.

entry: POKENAME硬化的甲片过去被精炼、制成盾牌。刀刃即使使用磨损多年，仍然锋利。
author: chibitales
source: In the past, the hardened plates of POKENAME's shell were refined and made into shields. The blades remain sharp even after several years of wear.

entry: POKENAME住古墓，快速爬过尘封石棺。产生黏性青绿色丝，古人用来纺线。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME live inside ancient tombs where they scuttle across dusty sarcophaguses. They produce a sticky teal silk ancient people used to spin silk.

entry: POKENAME喜欢被打磨、抛光到顺滑，但随后很快又在泥土里打滚。有人推测，它只是爱轻柔的身体刺激。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME loves being polished and sanded to a smooth texture, but it will soon roll around in the dirt afterwards. It has been speculated that it simply loves gentle physical stimuli.

entry: POKENAME挥舞的沉重金属块，常来自倒下的泥偶巨人。也守卫泥偶巨人巡逻的地方，合作保护家园，抵御入侵者、盗贼。
author: sk372
source: The heavy piece of metal POKENAME wields is often sourced from fallen Golurk. It guards the same areas that Golurk patrol, working in tandem to keep their homes safe from intruders and thieves.

entry: POKENAME居住在合众地下，由族群共同建造的隧道里，那里常被形容为迷宫般的后勤枢纽。复杂等级制度正受研究，更像官僚机构，而非自然虫巢。
author: beatdoof
source: POKENAME lives in colony-built tunnels beneath Unova, often described as labyrinthine logistical hubs. POKENAME's colony is currently under study for its complex hierarchical systems, more akin to bureaucracies than any natural hive.

entry: POKENAME在神庙假扮大型古董。有人擅闯，就会变形，猛撞对方。
author: seanothan_23
source: POKENAME disguises itself as a large antique in temples. When people trespass in the temple, it transforms and rams into the person.

entry: POKENAME升空消除雷击，保护古老村落免受风暴。风暴后，长老献礼敬奉，确保它开心。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME protects old villages from storms, flying into the sky to neutralize lightning strikes. When that storm passes, elders offer gifts as a tribute to ensure it stays happy.

entry: POKENAME沉重身躯无声跋涉岩滩，在沙上留深印。将岸边垃圾收进头上的罐，再搬到附近村庄，轻轻放下。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME heavy frame trudges silently across rocky beaches, leaving deep prints in the sand. It gathers shoreline trash into the pot on its head, later carrying the load to nearby villages where it gently deposits the waste.

entry: 这些人造宝可梦曾是创造者的空中哨兵，能多年飞行不休。核心吸收阳光，转成能量，因此总有滚烫能量满溢。
author: infinex21
source: These artificial Pokémon served as the airborne sentries of their creators that could fly without rest for years. Their cores absorb sunlight and turn it into energy, which is why they are always overflowing with burning-hot energy.

entry: POKENAME在古墓旁河中休息，它的存在能令入侵者却步。所居河水清凉，据说能增强活力。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME rests in rivers near ancient tombs, its presence keeping intruders at bay. The cool waters it inhabits are said to enhance one's vitality.

entry: POKENAME强烈想保护遇到的每只宝可梦。有些研究者相信，创造它的本意，是确保只要它还在守护，就没有宝可梦物种灭绝。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has an intense desire to protect any Pokémon it comes across. Some researchers believe it was created in order to ensure that no Pokémon species would become extinct as long as POKENAME was around to protect them.

entry: POKENAME游过古迹，用网将碎石、古物黏在身上，组成外壳。它极护外壳，谁赠送物品添进壳中，也会受到它奋力守护。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME stalks through ancient ruins, attaching loose rubble and artifacts to their body with webbing, forming a sort of shell. They are extremely protective of this shell, but will fiercely defend anyone that gives them items to add to it.

entry: 人们认为，这种宝可梦由古人创造。它彻底探索四周，再让触角闪光，以某种密码传递发现。解码至今无果。
author: deadshields
source: A Pokémon thought to have been created by an ancient people, it thoroughly explores its surroundings then relays its findings by flashing its antenna in some form of code. Attempts to decode this language so far have been unsuccessful.

entry: POKENAME虽住温带，却需与能冷却周围的宝可梦共居。有其居住的古城里，发现过简易空调方式。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Although POKENAME live in temperate biomes, they need to live with other Pokémon that can cool down the surrounding area. In ancient times, rudimentary ways of air conditioning have been discovered in cities with POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME曾在如今已成沼泽的神庙废墟被发现。它开心迎客，展示家园残迹，宛如带团导览。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has been spotted within the ruins of temples that reside in now-swampy terrain. It happily welcomes visitors, showing them around the remains of its home as if guiding them through a tour.

entry: POKENAME背上的符文石影响植物。石头若受损，会用藤缠住，使其恢复。
author: mistymagius
source: The runestone on POKENAME's back has an influence on the plant life around it. If the stone is ever damaged, POKENAME will wrap its vines around it to allow it to heal.

entry: POKENAME巡逻古迹，保护免遭盗贼。历史学家研究它们身上的标记，了解古文明。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME patrol ancient ruins to protect them from thieves. Historians study the markings across their body to learn more about ancient civilizations.

entry: POKENAME身体是不停流动的沙，能钻过古墓暗藏的狭缝。身上卡住的古物充当固定点，跌坑后帮助爬回。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME's body is made of constantly flowing sand, allowing it to sneak under the many tight cracks hidden in ancient tombs. The artifacts stuck on its body acts as a belay, helping it get back up whenever it falls into holes.

entry: POKENAME偏爱创造性使用钻头尾巴。若任其自行活动，就会把附近石头雕成雕像，连建筑、公共财物也不例外。艺术风格像古文明。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME prefer creative uses for their drill-tipped tails. If left on their own, they will begin carving any nearby stone in statues, including buildings and public property. Their artstyle resembles that of an ancient civilization.

entry: POKENAME钻地时，顺时针转动巨大的身体。偶尔不慎破坏地铁隧道，造成严重延误。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME rotates its massive body clockwise while burrowing through the ground. It occasionally disrupts subway tunnels by mistake, causing major delays.

entry: 人们相信，POKENAME是人类为开采地底深处的矿石而造。如今用于挖矿道，但找宝石的蚊香眼，常把隧道弄得破败。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: It is believed that POKENAME were created by mankind to retrieve ores from deep underground. In the modern era, POKENAME are used to excavate for mineshafts. These tunnels are typically left dilapidated by Polieye that are in search of gems.

entry: POKENAME手部喷射器让飞行速度最高达4马赫。独处时，用抛光头饰打发时间。
author: rycronicgames
source: The jets on POKENAME's hands allow them to fly at speeds that reach up to Mach 4. When they are alone, POKENAME fills their time by polishing their hairpiece.

entry: POKENAME漏出光芒，也产生发光沙，曾被用作古庙向导。至今仍在用，大多引人参观历史洞窟。
author: bigoljax
source: Due to the light seeping out and the glowing sand it produces, POKENAME were used as guides for ancient temples. They are still in use today, mostly as guides for old historic caves.

entry: POKENAME静坐古迹，常被误认雕像。任何部分被打扰，都会变得好斗，全力守护遗迹。被捕后，却改向同伴忠诚。
author: nyoomymph
source: POKENAME is often mistaken for a statue. It sits motionless in old ruins. If any part of the ruin is disturbed, POKENAME will become aggressive, dedicated to defending the ruin with its life. A caught POKENAME will instead be loyal to its companions.

entry: POKENAME带着一只古老双耳陶罐，用与身体相同的黏土制成。装满液体，便小心搬运，人们相信古人用来在宴会上提供饮品。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME carries around an ancient amphora, made of the same clay as its body. If this jar is filled with liquid, POKENAME will carefully carry it around, and it is believed that ancient people used them to serve drinks at feasts.

entry: 据推测，POKENAME是一种失传已久的自动机关，古人用它们作警觉的卫士，守护君王。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is speculated to be a species of long-lost automaton used by ancient people as vigilant guards for the king they serve.

entry: POKENAME能几天不睡，是极佳保护者。宝可梦巡护员让它充当看守犬，保护偷猎者盯上的宝可梦所在地区。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME have the ability to stay awake for days, making them incredible protectors. Pokémon Rangers use them as guard dogs to protect areas with Pokémon targeted by poachers.

entry: POKENAME游过古墓，寻找考古学家架设的相机，吃内部数据。剩下图像严重扭曲，满是模糊与压缩伪影。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME wander ancient tombs to locate cameras set up by archeologists and consume the data within. The remaining images left behind by POKENAME are highly distorted with blurs and compression artifacts.

entry: POKENAME靠神秘能量供能，让尾巴能充当高功率喷灯。用来焊金属，造高耸钢雕像。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME's bodies are fueled by a mysterious energy, allowing their tails to function as high-powered blowtorches. They use them to weld metal together, creating towering steel statues.

entry: 据说，许多POKENAME已将体内的蛋孵育了一千年，却始终不见破壳的迹象。
author: patch
source: It is said many POKENAME have been incubating the egg in their body for a thousand years. It has never shown any signs of hatching.

entry: POKENAME苦恼时，身体开裂的部分会发出明亮黄光。传说警告，盯着这光，会让一家人遭受可怕厄运。
author: .izik
source: When distressed, the cracked portion of POKENAME's body glows a bright yellow. Legends warn that staring into this glow curses one's family with terrible luck.

entry: 它像古迹常见的雕像，尤其静止休息、充能时。一记物理打击，就能将卡车打飞。
author: infinex21
source: It resembles some statues often found within ancient ruins, especially when it goes immobile to rest and recharge. Its physical blows pack enough power to send a truck flying in a single strike.

entry: POKENAME用尾巴作武器，鞭敌时释放强闪电。电力足以灼焦地面。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its tail as a weapon, whipping it at foes to unleash powerful bolts of lightning. The electricity is strong enough to scorch the ground.

entry: 古瓮常描绘POKENAME各式杂技姿势。身躯虽很坚实，仍能高速跳跃，以迅捷的冰属性攻击打击敌人。
author: .izik
source: Ancient urns frequently depict POKENAME in various acrobatic poses. Despite its solid frame, it can leap at high speeds, striking foes with swift Ice-type attacks.

entry: 山洞岩刻显示，POKENAME曾被用作古部落的守护者，用面具上的手状獠牙掀翻怪颚龙。
author: bigoljax
source: Petroglyphs found in mountain caves show POKENAME being used as protectors for ancient tribes. They used the hand-like tusks on their masks to flip over Tyrantrum.

entry: POKENAME游过广大雪原、山脉，獠牙极适合打退威胁，或挖洞作巢。长毛的身体并非最耐用，头骨上的护甲却密度极高，保护效果很好。
author: thesilverowls
source: POKENAME roam large snowfields or mountain ranges, their tusks perfect for bashing away any threats or digging caverns for dens. While their furred body isn't the most durable, their skull plating is incredibly dense and protective.

entry: 有人推测，POKENAME是古文明制造强大守护者的失败尝试。潜在力量确实大，身体却做出不合逻辑、无法控制的动作。
author: sk372
source: Some theorize that POKENAME is a failed attempt by ancient civilizations to create a powerful guardian being. It does possess great potential strength, but its body acts in illogical and uncontrollable ways.

entry: POKENAME潜在沙漠地下，所在位置有利于守卫失落文明的古庙。入侵者太近，就跃沙而出，以极速爪击守家。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME waits underground in deserts, strategically placed to guard old temples from lost civilizations. If intruders step too close, it leaps from the sand and defends its home with blazing-fast claw swipes.

entry: POKENAME住古迹，用初步发展的精神能力控制额外附肢。它不知道力量多大，常失控，严重损坏周围。
author: sneakywalrus0
source: POKENAME live in ancient ruins. They use their burgeoning psychic abilities to control their extra appendages. They are unaware of how powerful these are and often lose control of them, usually resulting in great damage to the surrounding area.

entry: POKENAME用渐强念力控制有力肢体，保护古迹家园。破坏力太大，必须全心操控，否则周围就可能被毁。
author: sneakywalrus0
source: POKENAME uses its growing telekinetic powers to control powerful limbs in order to defend its home inside ancient ruins. Due to their destructive power, they must concentrate fully on handling them or risk devastation of the surrounding area.

entry: POKENAME以强大念力操纵强劲的石质肢体，坚守最珍视的人或地方，对威胁者极少留情。
author: sk372
source: Mighty stone limbs are manipulated by POKENAME's powerful telekinesis. Using these, it staunchly defends the locations or people it holds most dear, showing little mercy to those who would threaten them.

entry: POKENAME守护古迹家园，以强大精神能力，完全驾驭额外附肢的巨量破坏力。盗墓者、窃贼会迎来毁灭打击。
author: sneakywalrus0
source: POKENAME are guardians of ancient ruins they call home. Using their strong psychic abilities, they are able to fully harness the vast, destructive power of their extra appendages. Would-be grave robbers and thieves are met with devastating force.

entry: POKENAME臂炮靠自身精神力量供能，发射强力能量弹，保护珍视者。与所保护者的羁绊越深，炮击就能蓄入越多能量。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's arm cannon is powered by its own psychic power, firing out potent energy shots to defend those it cares for. The stronger its bond with those it protects, the more it can charge up its cannon's blasts.

entry: POKENAME臂炮靠自身精神力量供能，发射强力能量弹，保护珍视者。有些甚至能造足以夷平建筑的能量炸弹。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's arm cannon is powered by its own psychic power, firing out potent energy shots to defend those it cares for. Some POKENAME can even create an energy bomb with enough power to level a building.

entry: POKENAME体内流动着惊人的古代力量，曾用拳头猛砸地面，引发地震。
author: cyboobr
source: Incredible ancient power flows through the body of POKENAME. This Pokémon has been known to cause earthquakes by slamming the ground with its fists.

entry: POKENAME常在货运场搬运巨大罐体。力量和效率，使它在重型作业中格外宝贵。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME is frequently employed in freight yards to move massive canisters. Their strength and efficiency make them invaluable in heavy-duty operations.

entry: 铁未量产前，POKENAME将金属矿石压在砂模上，制造原始矛头。它们曾是势不可挡的守卫，为人们提供保护与自卫手段。
author: quackquackattack
source: Before the mass production of iron, POKENAME pressed metal ore against sand molds to produce rudimentary spearheads. They served as juggernauts who gave people protection and a means to defend themselves.

entry: POKENAME守墓时，从石头释放能量冲击，多用于驱赶有害生物，偶尔也无端攻击考古学家。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME releases bursts of energy from its stone while defending the tombs it inhabits. It mostly uses these to deter pests, though it occasionally attacks archaeologists without provocation.

entry: 擅闯者靠近神庙，POKENAME就召来巨大沙暴。沙暴遮住圣地，使其几乎无法找到。
author: .izik
source: When trespassers approach the temples it protects, POKENAME summons enormous sandstorms. These storms obscure the sacred grounds, making them nearly impossible to find.

entry: 这些古代的人造宝可梦，背上的花能吸收并储存巨量太阳能。常住在茂密森林旁，谁威胁自身或森林家园，就发出可怕的日光束。
author: infinex21
source: The flower upon the backs of these ancient, artificial Pokémon can absorb and store vast quantities of solar energy. They tend to live near lush forests and will unleash fearsome Solar Beams at anything that threatens them or their forest homes.

entry: 这些古代宝可梦走到哪里，都拖着看似古花瓶的东西。其实是过度生长、能产生维生能量的角，也可将能量作为光束释放。
author: infinex21
source: These ancient Pokémon are always seen dragging what appears to be an Ancient Vase along with them wherever they go. It is actually an overgrown horn that generates the energy that fuels them, though they can also release it like beams of light.

entry: POKENAME是优秀建造者，常用于城市大工程。喝大量树果汁充能，便有力抬起整卷钢材。
author: actliux
source: POKENAME are excellent builders, frequently utilized for large building projects in cities. They will drink large amounts of Berry Juice to energize themselves, giving them the strength to be able to lift entire steel coils.

entry: 歌谣称它们是来自群星之外的远古遗物。它们总在搜集奇异的古物，再用只有自己明白的方式，将知识与礼物分享给人类。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Songs are sung that claim these Pokémon are ancient relics from beyond the stars. Always gathering a collection of odd artifacts, these Pokémon share their knowledge and gifts with people in ways known only to them.

entry: 古文明曾训练POKENAME作斥候，不断寻找进军所护城市的军队。能吐大片湿沙，很适合困住大群敌人。
author: bigoljax
source: Ancient civilizations once trained POKENAME to work as scouts, constantly searching for armies marching towards the cities it protects. Its ability to spit out massive waves of wet sand made it great for trapping large groups of enemies.

entry: 有些沙漠古迹记载，POKENAME体内有难以想象的力量。这些明显虚构的故事，总以力量释放、世界毁灭告终。
author: .izik
source: Ancient desert ruins sometimes describe POKENAME as housing unimaginable power in its body. These clearly fictional tales always end with that power being released and the world destroyed.

entry: 古城的城门与城堡外，曾发现POKENAME的身影。人们推测，它们原本是专为守卫而造的智慧哨兵。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME have been found outside the gates and castles of ancient cities. They are assumed to have been designed as intelligent sentries.

entry: 古城的城门与城堡外，曾发现POKENAME的身影。人们推测，它们原本是专为守卫而造的智慧哨兵。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME have been found outside the gates and castles of ancient cities. They are assumed to have been designed as intelligent sentries.

entry: POKENAME最初发现于古代文明的遗迹，可它的剑与盾，至今仍闪着神秘能量。
author: blazerxz
source: POKENAME was first discovered the ruins of an ancient civilization. Despite this, its sword and shield still glows with a mysterious energy.

entry: 人们认为，POKENAME由古代尚武文化所创造。身上无数刀刃可拆下，作为手持武器或弹丸。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is thought to have been created by an ancient warrior culture. The myriad blades on its body can be detached to be used as handheld weapons or projectiles.

entry: POKENAME在古迹旁的水底休息，本能感知陌生人进入。便跃出水面，维护家园的神圣。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME rests at the bottom of bodies of water near old ruins. It has an intrinsic sense of when strangers walk into the ruins, leaping out of the water in order to protect the sanctity of its home.

entry: 这种宝可梦似乎不进食，旋转所需的能量来源不明。于是有人推测，若泥偶巨人体内真有永动机，POKENAME可能就是其模样。
author: fireblade141
source: This Pokémon doesn't seem to eat, meaning it is unknown where the energy it needs to spin comes from. As a result, it has been theorized that if Golurk's body really does contain a perpetual motion machine, then POKENAME might be what it looks like.

entry: POKENAME假扮探险者，骗毫无防备的入侵者走进陷阱。警惕一松，便以暗影球发动突袭。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME disguises itself as an explorer to lure unsuspecting intruders into traps. Once their guard is down, it launches a surprise Shadow Ball attack.

entry: 有传说称，它为保护一切生命而造，竭力救护其他生灵的行为，部分支持了这种说法。奇异而强大的能量流过体内，它能以多种方式运用。
author: infinex21
source: There are a few legends claiming it was made to protect all forms of life; such legends are partly supported by how vigilantly it saves and protects others. A strange yet potent energy courses through it, which it can wield in myriad ways.

entry: 据推测，数千年前，一个失落的文明造出了POKENAME，既让它们充当守护者，也作为献给神明的敬礼。
author: cristata
source: It's theorized that POKENAME were built millennia ago by a long lost civilization, both as guardian protectors and as tributes to their deity.

entry: 传说，古文明为控制空间创造POKENAME。有些版本说，启动时意外让整个文明从这世界消失。
author: sk372
source: Legends say POKENAME was created by ancient civilizations in an attempt to gain control over space. Some variations of the legend say an accident upon its activation caused the civilization to vanish entirely from this world.

entry: POKENAME用威力强大的炮守卫被遗忘的神庙，只需几秒便能充满能量。一击能将人打上数百英尺高空。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME guards forgotten temples with its powerful cannon that charges to full in a matter of seconds. A single blast can launch a human hundreds of feet into the air.

entry: 驱动POKENAME的能源，让它能飞得和喷气飞机一样快。它是凶悍护卫，几乎不犹豫就将敌人烧成焦炭。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are powered by an energy source that enables them to fly as fast as a jet. They are fierce protectors and will turn adversaries into char with little hesitation.

entry: POKENAME通常休眠，玻璃外壳转暗，全部光源关闭。但训练家可启动推进器，让它带着充沛能量猛然醒来。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME are usually dormant, their glass shells being dimmed and all light sources being turned off. However, trainers can activate their boosters, causing them to burst awake with high energy.

entry: POKENAME胸前的眼睛能发射能量束，威力足以击倒快龙。带刃手臂连最坚韧钢铁也能斩开，传闻由不讲荣誉的战士灵魂操纵。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: The eye in POKENAME's chest can unleash a beam of energy that has enough power to fell a Dragonite. They slash through even the toughest steels with their bladed arm. There is a rumor that POKENAME are piloted by the spirits of dishonorable warriors.

entry: 它在地下墓穴厅堂织复杂蛛网，捕获走得太深的来者。黏性陷阱确保墓地的神圣不受侵犯。
author: .izik
source: It weaves intricate webs in the halls of catacombs, capturing any who wander too far. The sticky traps ensure the sanctity of the tomb remains intact.

entry: 它以巨拳轻轻梳过叶片，检查健康。察觉病弱，就向土壤注入养分，让附近植物恢复活力。
author: .izik
source: It uses its massive fists to gently comb through leaves, checking their health. If it senses sickness, it injects nutrients into the soil to rejuvenate nearby plants.

entry: 这只宝可梦体内，不断泄出一阵阵炽热气流。它几乎控制不住自身的破坏力，十分危险。
author: sonicdestroyer12
source: Bursts of superheated air constantly leak from this Pokémon's body. It has dangerously little control over its own destructive power.

entry: POKENAME战斗时，巨大掌心爆发阵阵火焰，能烧毁整片田，只留焦土。
author: .izik
source: Blasts of flames erupt from POKENAME's large palms during battle. These fiery bursts can incinerate entire fields, leaving behind scorched dirt.

entry: POKENAME用巨大双脚踩平崎岖地形，在峡谷开路，过程中常帮助迷路旅人。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME stamps the ground with its massive feet to flatten rugged terrain. It creates paths through canyons, often aiding lost travelers in the process.

entry: POKENAME见于古庙遗迹，有些个体被认为已守卫数千年。亵渎圣地，便让平时温顺的它暴走，诅咒作恶者。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has been spotted in the ruins of ancient temples, with some specimens believed to have been guarding them for millennia. Desecrating these hallowed grounds results in the normally docile Pokémon going berserk, cursing the perpetrator.

entry: 据说，POKENAME守护古代地脉，能量核心在装甲下如活着的星辰般变动。醒时大地颤抖，仿佛回应被遗忘的宇宙命令。
author: ilyhef_82709
source: POKENAME is said to guard ancient ley lines, its energy core shifting like a living star beneath its armor. When it awakens, the ground trembles as if answering a forgotten cosmic command.

entry: POKENAME常守古迹、墓穴，三只成群巡逻，不知疲倦，确保没有入侵者打扰圣地。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME can often be found guarding ancient ruins and tombs. They patrol in groups of three, tirelessly ensuring no intruders disturb the sanctity of the area.

entry: POKENAME常跃下高崖，启动喷气推进器翱翔。人们认为，这是战斗训练的一部分。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME often leaps off high cliffs, activating its jet-like boosters to soar through the air. This behavior is thought to be part of its battle training.

entry: 传说，POKENAME来自古老到任何地图都找不到的文明。有人推测，所带地球仪，是想展示从前家乡在哪。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Legends claim that POKENAME come from a civilization so old that it can't be found on any map. It's theorized that the reason they possess globes is to try and show people where their homes used to be.

entry: POKENAME用剃刀般獠牙，驱退所护神庙旁的入侵者。刀刃强劲，能将皮卡车利落劈成两半。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its razor-sharp tusks to fend off intruders near temples it guards. Its blades are so strong they can cleave a pickup truck clean in two.

entry: 滑过夜空，它从背上喷火加速。目击者既觉得美丽，也受威吓。
author: .izik
source: While gliding through the night sky, it ignites fiery jets from its back to propel itself faster. This spectacle is both beautiful and intimidating to those who witness it.

entry: POKENAME是仿照神话中的昆虫雕塑而成的古代机关。胸腔结构不稳，它艰难地压制着其中潜藏的沙之力。
author: nellnast42
source: An ancient automaton sculpted after a mythical insect, POKENAME struggles to contain the power of sand concealed inside its unstable chest cavity.

entry: POKENAME潜在看似世界最早文明残迹的废墟。领地意识极强，会碾压、驱逐任何胆敢踏入家园圣地的对象。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME lurks within the ruins of what appear to be the remnants of the world's earliest known civilizations. Extremely territorial, POKENAME will crush and repel any that dare trespass on the hallowed ground of its home.

entry: 它的双颚被焊死，封住体内的古老能量。少量外泄能量的特征，与遭毁古城留下的痕迹相吻合。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Its jaws are welded shut to keep its ancient energy inside sealed. The small amount of energy that escapes is a match to the remnants of decimated ancient cities.

entry: POKENAME体内散发的力量，有极古老的时间印记。近年研究者推测，是宇宙大爆炸本身留下的能量。
author: bandedbodypress
source: The power emanating from within POKENAME's body has a very old time signature. Researchers in recent years theorize it is energy leftover from the Big Bang itself.

entry: POKENAME在沉没神庙周围不断缓游，不让任何东西进入，只有自己例外。古文献说，曾用于战争，飞入密集阵形，用自爆造出大缺口。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME lurks around sunken temples, slowly circling at all times so nothing can get in except itself. Ancient writings talk about it being used in war, flying into tight formations, and using Self-Destruct to create large weak spots.

entry: POKENAME体内细沙深受玻璃工匠珍视，常被采集，制作精细吊灯与其他精致玻璃工艺品。
author: .izik
source: The thin sand inside POKENAME's body is prized by glassmakers. It's often harvested to create intricate chandeliers and other delicate glassworks.

entry: 古港在船厂用POKENAME清除藤壶。毒液杀死有害海洋生物，却不伤木船、金属船。
author: .izik
source: Ancient harbors used POKENAME in shipyards to clear barnacles. Its poison kills marine pests but leaves wooden and metal vessels unharmed.

entry: POKENAME把自身藏在古代斗兽场，整天用碎混凝土、石块，在里面搭建擂台。像职业摔角台，有些甚至有可借力反弹的围绳。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME keeps itself hidden in ancient coliseums, spending all day using broken off concrete and stone to build arenas within. These arenas have a similar appearance to pro wrestling rings, with some even having ropes to bounce off of.

entry: POKENAME在墓内铺菌丝，是多种高端菜的珍贵原料。领地意识极强，采集很危险。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME weaves mycelium in tombs that is prized in a number of high-tier culinary dishes. It is extremely territorial, making the gathering of this mycelium a dangerous task.

entry: POKENAME操纵周围的沙，塑造自身身体，因此常见于沙漠、海滩。它会把小型濒危宝可梦庇护在自己的墙内，直到不再需要保护。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME can manipulate the surrounding sand to shape its own body, which is why it is often found in deserts or along beaches. Its protective nature drives it to shelter small, endangered Pokémon within its walls for as long as they need.

entry: 这种奇怪的宝可梦，最先发现于苔藓、真菌遍布的遗迹。POKENAME似乎不在乎建筑残迹的状况，但谁伤害家里的蘑菇，就会变得凶狠。
author: sk372
source: A strange Pokémon first discovered in ruins overrun by moss and fungi. POKENAME seems unconcerned with the conditions of the remnants of buildings, but turns aggressive if anything harms any mushrooms in its home.

entry: 古代铭板描绘POKENAME进行锦标赛式战斗，以带鳞尾巴强力挥击彼此。
author: .izik
source: Ancient tablets depict POKENAME engaging in tournament-style combat. They struck one another with powerful swings of their scaled tails.

entry: 人们认为，古代曾用POKENAME协助建筑与防御。它力量强大，又能完全水陆两栖，对沿海城市很有价值。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME is thought to have been employed in ancient times to help with construction and defense, with its high strength and fully amphibious capability making it valuable to cities close to the ocean.

entry: POKENAME背上看似带着古代之壶，其实是保护供能核心的外壳。它能缩进壳内，在常作家园的遗迹里躲藏。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME appear to carry Relic Vases atop their backs, though they are actually a shell that protects the core that gives them energy. They can withdraw inside of these shells to hide within the ruins that oft serve as their homes.

entry: POKENAME在宏大城堡的废墟中休眠，藏在墙内。一感知移动，就仿佛活过来，造出幽灵般的沙翼，飞下对抗家园入侵者。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME remain dormant in the ruins of great castles, hiding themselves in the walls. They appear to come to life when they sense movement, creating ghostly wings of sand to flutter down and confront the intruder in their home.

entry: 古籍描绘POKENAME在领地内的村落间巡行守护。任何威胁当地人类的宝可梦，都会遭到无情攻击，使它成为土地的凶悍守卫。
author: .izik
source: Ancient tomes depict POKENAME as protectors who travel between villages in their territory. They ruthlessly attack any Pokémon threatening humans in their areas, making them fierce guardians of their land.

entry: POKENAME被创造为哨兵。此状态缩进壳状外罩，保护自己，却很少能保护训练家，只为给巨大的力量充能。
author: jonclyd
source: POKENAME was created to serve as a sentinel. In this state it retreats into a shell-like casing that grants it defense, but little protection to its Trainer, as this form merely serves to recharge its immense power.

entry: POKENAME被创造为哨兵。察觉训练家遇险，就猛然冲出壳状外罩，释放巨大力量保护。威胁解除后，又回到休眠状态。
author: jonclyd
source: POKENAME was created to serve as a sentinel. When sensing danger to its Trainer, it bursts from its shell-like casing, unleashing immense power to protect them. Once the threat is neutralized, it reverts to its dormant state.

entry: POKENAME凶悍守卫所居神庙，驱赶入侵者。无人擅闯时，就找当地野生宝可梦打架，磨炼力量。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME aggressively defends the temples it inhabits from intruders. When no trespassers are around, it hones its strength by picking fights with any wild Pokémon in the area.

entry: POKENAME漫游深海，只在风暴时上浮，被遇险船只吸引。背部喷射器推动它穿过怒浪，抵达被困船只的速度，比任何救生艇都快。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME roams the ocean depths and surfaces only during storms, drawn to ships in distress. Using the jets on its back, it propels itself through crashing waves, reaching stranded vessels faster than any lifeboat.

entry: 有人认为，POKENAME是火暴猴为追求更强力量，改变自身而成。即使战至粉身碎骨，它也不肯停下。
author: staghorn
source: Some think POKENAME is a Primeape that transformed itself in order to grow stronger. It will keep fighting even if it crumbles to dust in the process.

entry: 洗翠遗迹的壁画描绘POKENAME，是当地古代氏族忠诚的坐骑。现代神奥仍可在古迹旁找到，搭载旅人往返各地。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Murals in Hisuian ruins depict POKENAME serving as loyal mounts to the ancient clans of the land. They can still be found lingering around the ancient ruins in modern Sinnoh, offering travellers rides from one part of the region to another.

entry: 洗翠遗迹的壁画描绘POKENAME，是当地古代氏族忠诚的坐骑。现代神奥仍可见它守卫遗迹，对靠得太近的来者使出强力咬住。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Murals in Hisuian ruins depict POKENAME serving as loyal mounts to the ancient clans of the land. They can still be found guarding the ruins in modern Sinnoh, lashing out with powerful Bites at those who get too close.

entry: 灼热核心驱动巨大黏土般的双翼，在天上留下熔融灰烬的轨迹。它凶悍守卫领地，驱逐任何威胁家园者。
author: msdawgs
source: Its blazing core powers massive clay-like wings, leaving trails of molten ash across the sky. It fiercely protects its territory, driving away anyone who threatens the places it calls home.

entry: POKENAME将灵力导过黏土身体，腹部旋纹也随之转动。古文明用它协助建筑，但任务早已完成，常还继续工作。
author: reaverlamont
source: Its belly spiral rotates as it channels spiritual energy through its clay body. Ancient civilizations used POKENAME for construction, but it often continued working long after its task was complete.

entry: POKENAME的黏土身体从不疲倦，古文明曾用它执行体力劳动。但必须命令停止，否则水桶会装到溢出，田也会被犁成深沟。
author: .jerden
source: Its clay body never becomes fatigued. POKENAME were used by ancient civilizations to perform manual labor, but it was essential to command them to stop, otherwise they would fill buckets to overflowing and plough fields into deep ditches.

entry: POKENAME的黏土身体容易开裂。损伤处不断喷出灵力，被能量光芒触及的对象，会恢复活力。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME's clay body is prone to developing cracks and fractures. A constant spray of spiritual energy emits from the damaged sections of their bodies, invigorating those touched by the energy's light.

entry: POKENAME能以古老力量为拳头充能，再用强化的力量切过最坚韧的金属。
author: camtft
