source: POKENAME are capable of energizing their fist with ancient power. They use their empowered strength to carve through the toughest of metals.

entry: POKENAME力气极大，常帮助建筑。多条手臂让它能轻松搬运许多重物。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME is very strong and can often be seen helping with construction. Its multiple arms allow it to carry many heavy objects with ease.

entry: POKENAME中空的中央部位如同嘴巴，可吐出腐蚀性物质或泥浆攻击，释放高压热气飞行，也能储物。多数时候，懒得清掉身上的苔藓。
author: bobosmith01
source: The hollow center that acts as POKENAME's mouth allows it to spit corrosive material or mud for offense, release pressurized hot gas to allow it to fly, or to act as storage. POKENAME doesn't bother cleaning itself of moss under most circumstances.

entry: POKENAME常休眠在古战场。附近一有战斗爆发，就会醒来，发射强大光束，只有强大的护盾才能弹开。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME remains in a dormant state, often found resting in fields where ancient battles once took place. However, when a fight is started around it, it wakes up and starts firing powerful beams, only able to be deflected by powerful shields.

entry: 古老的机关，让它能升到几米高的空中。有些考古学家因此认为，创造者曾把POKENAME当作升降台。
author: chorb33
source: An ancient mechanism allows it to fly several meters into the air. Some archaeologists believe that POKENAME was used as an elevator by its creators.

entry: POKENAME力大无穷，却毫无攻击性，对许多事都漠不关心，因此很少真正动用力量。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME has enormous strength. However, it is not aggressive in any way and is almost apathetic, so this strength is rarely used.

entry: POKENAME力大无穷，却毫无攻击性，对许多事都漠不关心，因此很少真正动用力量。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME has enormous strength. However, it is not aggressive in any way and is almost apathetic, so this strength is rarely used.

entry: 覆盖全身的巨石，为POKENAME提供了极佳防护。可多出的重量，也让每个动作都变得艰难。
author: chorb33
source: The huge boulders that cover POKENAME provide it with excellent protection. At the same time, the added weight makes every move difficult.

entry: 多数理论说，创造POKENAME的古人可能用它作坐骑。但身体中人形的那一半，也让人觉得，它们可能本身就是能自主行动的骑兵。
author: infinex21
source: Most theories about POKENAME suggest they were likely used as mounts by the ancient people who created them. Yet the humanoid-half of their body suggests they may have been autonomous cavalry, instead.

entry: POKENAME住沙漠，不停勤快地给开裂、漏沙的身体补沙。人们推测，若完全漏空，就会停止运作。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME makes its homes among the deserts, constantly and diligently refilling its cracked, leaking body with sand. It's presumed that should its body be fully emptied, it would cease functioning.

entry: 传说，POKENAME曾巡逻、保护古文明居民。它能瞬间伸出火箭般的拳头，抓住、制服闹事者。
author: mepp.
source: According to legends, POKENAME was used to patrol and protect the citizens of ancient civilizations. In a flash, it extends its rocket-like fists to grab and subdue troublemakers.

entry: 谁发现神庙，POKENAME就会催眠，抹掉位置记忆。传说，只有被催眠前写下的记录，才能揭示庙中秘密。
author: .izik
source: Should anyone discover its temple, a POKENAME hypnotizes them to erase the memory of its location. Legends say only records written before being hypnotized reveal the temple's secrets.

entry: POKENAME住在古老的海盗沉船里，保护里面的一切。有人推测，守护的是旧主人，但尚未证实。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME resides in ancient sunken pirate ships where it protects whatever is inside. It is speculated that it is protecting its former owners, though this has yet to be confirmed.

entry: POKENAME住在火山或其他炎热环境，天性胆小、温柔，避免争斗。背上卷曲的尾巴帮助身体保暖，有些家庭还当作天然暖床。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME dwells near volcanic areas or other hot environments. Timid and gentle by nature, it avoids conflict with other creatures. The curled tails on its back help keep its body heated, and some families even use it as a natural bed warmer.

entry: POKENAME夜里在茂密植被中觅食。遇到威胁，就朝对方吐出带火的吐丝，再钻地躲藏，直到感到安全。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME forages for food in heavy vegetation during the night. When threatened, it spits a fiery String Shot at the threat and burrows into the ground to hide until it feels safe.

entry: POKENAME爱用圆滚滚的身体打滚，炫耀美丽尾巴。据说，尾巴弄脏，会难过得爆炸。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME enjoy rolling around with their rotund bodies and flaunting their beautiful tails. It is said that if their tails get dirty, they get so upset that they explode.

entry: 它们用火将黏土、泥土制成头骨状头盔，手持的骨头却来自猎物。常像魔杖般挥动，让火球随动作欢跳。
author: infinex21
source: They use flames to form skull-like helmets out of clay and soil, though the bones they wield in their hands are from prey. They can commonly be seen waving this bone around like a wand, balls of fire prancing about in tune to their movements.

entry: POKENAME比许多宝可梦野性更强、戒心更重，难捕又难控制，更愿靠火把与骨头在暗处辨路。
author: curazy
source: POKENAME is more primal and wary than many other Pokémon. It's harder to catch and control and prefers to rely on a torch and bones to navigate through dark places.

entry: POKENAME的舌头能变得灼热，烫伤敌人。它极重视打理毛发，避免雨天外出，免得湿气毁掉皮毛。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME's tongue can grow scorching hot, allowing it to sear its foes. It takes great care of its fur and avoids going out in the rain to prevent humidity from ruining it.

entry: 吃到特别美味的一餐，它会从鼻子喷出微小火焰，表示开心。它极重视打理毛发，避免雨天外出，免得湿气毁掉皮毛。
author: fiordaliso
source: When it eats a particularly delicious meal, it releases tiny flames from its nose to show its joy. It takes great care of its fur and avoids going out in the rain to prevent humidity from ruining it.

entry: 它漂浮时，会从毛孔造出小鬼火。喜欢将这些浮火塑成各种形状、图案，既自娱，也娱乐其他生灵。
author: sk372
source: As it floats, it creates small will-o'-the-wisps from its pores. It enjoys manipulating these floating fires into different shapes and patterns to entertain itself and others.

entry: POKENAME产生可燃气体，颜色随树果饮食变化。遇险就喷尽当前储存的全部气体，再点燃，造成巨大爆炸。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME generates flammable gasses that take on different hues based on its berry diet. When in danger, it expels the entirety of its current gas reservoir and ignites it to cause a massive explosion.

entry: POKENAME常在咖啡店帮助咖啡师，伸长藤蔓够到高处架子，也为客人送上热饮。繁忙时段，是珍贵的搭档。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can be found at many coffee shops helping baristas. By extending their vines to reach high shelves and delivering hot drinks to patrons, they are a valuable companion during rush hours.

entry: POKENAME相当冷淡，摆动尾巴放出热风，吹走其他海中生灵。陆上则用头角甩出火球，不让别人打扰。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is quite standoffish, swinging its tail to send a rush of heated air to blow other undersea denizens away. Above the ground, it flings fireballs from the horn on its head to keep others from bothering it.

entry: POKENAME在草甸嬉戏，寻找蜂蜜。碰触的花会变暖，看上去仿佛环绕着火球，因此深受花商追捧。
author: fierysakura23
source: POKENAME can be seen frolicking about in meadows, searching for honey. The flowers it touches become warm to the touch and look as if they have fiery orbs surrounding them, making them highly sought after by florists.

entry: POKENAME快速转动背上的星形部位，就能生火，造出鬼火。它操控漂浮火球自卫，投向靠得太近的敌人。
author: sk372
source: By rapidly spinning the star on its back, POKENAME generates fire and creates will-o'-the-wisps. It controls the floating fire orbs for self defense, flinging them at foes that draw too near.

entry: POKENAME快速转动背上的星形部位，就能生火，造出鬼火。它操控漂浮火球自卫，投向靠得太近的敌人。
author: sk372
source: By rapidly spinning the star on its back, POKENAME generates fire and creates will-o'-the-wisps. It controls the floating fire orbs for self defense, flinging them at foes that draw too near.

entry: POKENAME用扇子吹出阵阵热焰攻击。一些文化喜爱它，会制作模仿其造型的服装。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME uses its fan to blow gusts of hot flames at its opponents. Certain cultures have taken a liking to POKENAME and will create outfits mimicking its style.

entry: POKENAME将灼热导入拳头，先从尾巴发射电流，有需要才改用带火的拳击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME channels searing heat into its fists. It fires electricity from its tails first, resorting to fiery punches if needed.

entry: POKENAME六条尾巴会随火焰攻击而燃起，吐息越热，点燃的就越多。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's six tails burn when it uses its fire-based attacks. The hotter its breath, the more tails ignite.

entry: POKENAME很快就会深深依恋照料者，因此好养。但也易被偷猎，拉普拉斯已濒危，使这勾当利润丰厚，又极其违法。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME quickly forms deep attachments to those that take care of it and is therefore easy to raise. However, this has made it an easy target of poaching; with the endangered status of Lapras, the act is both profitable and highly illicit.

entry: POKENAME温柔、亲人，被用作孤儿院孩子的支援宝可梦，带来欢乐。柔软、温暖的毛，也让它成为许多其他宝可梦安心的睡伴。
author: fiordaliso
source: Thanks to its gentle and affectionate nature, POKENAME is used as a support Pokémon for children in orphanages, bringing joy to their hearts. Its soft, warm fur makes it a comforting sleeping companion for many other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME温柔、亲人，被用作孤儿院孩子的支援宝可梦，带来欢乐。柔软、温暖的毛，也让它成为许多其他宝可梦安心的睡伴。
author: fiordaliso
source: Thanks to its gentle and affectionate nature, POKENAME is used as a support Pokémon for children in orphanages, bringing joy to their hearts. Its soft, warm fur makes it a comforting sleeping companion for many other Pokémon.

entry: 许多POKENAME聚在天然温泉，偏爱那里的暖水。时尚的训练家喜爱它的发型，似乎游泳也永远不会弄乱。
author: elibromax314
source: Many POKENAME can be found congregated around natural hot springs, as they prefer the warm water found there. Fashionable trainers value POKENAME for their hairstyle that never seems to get ruined while swimming.

entry: POKENAME精力充沛，闲不下来。打招呼时，兴奋地用温暖身体蹭对方，白色颈毛便竖起，释放无害静电，接触会发麻。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME is full of restless energy. When it greets others, it feverishly rubs its warm body against them, causing its white neck ruff to stand on end and release harmless bursts of static electricity that tingle upon contact.

entry: POKENAME华美的皮毛触感柔软。战斗时，巧妙发射火球，温度最高可达3,000度。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's luxurious fur is soft to the touch. In battle, it skillfully launches fireballs whose temperatures can reach up to 3,000 degrees.

entry: POKENAME主尾旁悬着额外六截短尾，能分离、四处飞动，点燃自身，在战斗中扰乱或烧伤对手。
author: sk372
source: Six extra tail nubs hover around POKENAME's main tail. These can separate and fly about, igniting themselves in order to distract or burn opponents in battle.

entry: POKENAME腹部的毛极软，许多人喜欢躺着休息。饿了便用火花烤焦树果，再吃下。
author: mepp.
source: Many people rest on POKENAME's belly as its fur is luxuriously soft. When hungry, it chars berries with an Ember before eating them.

entry: POKENAME身旁几乎总有几团召出的火球环绕，既能保暖，也能有效防御偷袭。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is rarely seen without a few conjured fireballs circling around it. These provide it with warmth as well as an effective defense against any surprise attacks.

entry: 叶片的气味让许多人联想到林中噼啪作响的篝火。POKENAME一有机会，就会晒太阳。
author: deelee2020
source: The smell of the leaf causes many to bring to mind a crackling campfire in the forest. POKENAME will sunbathe at every opportunity.

entry: POKENAME像风箱般鼓动尾巴，助背上的火焰燃烧。这很费体力，扇几分钟便会饥饿。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME pumps its tail like a set of bellows to fan the flames on its back. This activity takes lots of physical effort, so it ends up hungry after a few minutes of fanning the flames.

entry: POKENAME住在咖啡店、餐馆旁的灌木中，喜欢路人关注。花粉季打喷嚏，还会喷出余烬。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME resides in bushes near cafes and diners, as it enjoys the attention of people who walk by. It is known to sneeze embers during pollen season.

entry: POKENAME通常用尾巴挂在栖居树木的枝头。它很爱护尾巴，每天花许多小时清洁。寒冷时，从嘴里吐小火焰，蜷在余烬上取暖。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME usually uses its tail to hang from the branches of the trees it lives in. It is very protective of it and spends many hours each day keeping it clean. When cold, it blows small flames from its mouth and curls up on embers to stay warm.

entry: POKENAME住在热门公园与花园附近，喜欢路人抚摸。有时会跟人回家，再返回自己的窝。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME lives near popular parks and gardens, as it enjoys being pet by people who pass by. It is known to follow people home before returning to its den.

entry: POKENAME翱翔时，若发现柿仔果树，就轻轻咕叫。它会先用火烤树果，再吃下。
author: .izik
source: While soaring, POKENAME lets out a soft hoot when spotting Persim Berry trees. It toasts the berries with flames before eating.

entry: POKENAME的羽毛夜里泛着火光。过去传说将它当作太阳信使，因为最常在黎明附近被看见。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's feathers have a fiery glow during the night. Some legends used to believe POKENAME was a messenger of the sun, as it was most commonly seen around dawn.

entry: POKENAME能自由控火，为显得吓人，让身后在天上拖出火焰轨迹。因此有些养鸟人误认为传说中的火焰鸟。
author: bobosmith01
source: It has the ability to freely control fire. To look more intimidating, POKENAME makes a trail of fire follow behind it in the sky. As a result, some Bird Keepers confuse it for the legendary Moltres.

entry: 小小身体尚不能妥善调节火焰潜力。POKENAME受惊或情绪强烈时，可能从身上迸出小火星。
author: sk372
source: Its small body has not yet managed to properly regulate its fiery potential. Small fiery sparks may burst from POKENAME's body if startled or during moments of intense emotion.

entry: POKENAME的羊毛保温能力极强。夏季太热，甚至会咳出火焰，降低体温。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's wool is incredibly insulating. In summer, POKENAME can become so hot that it will cough up fire to lower its body temperature.

entry: 毛皮充满电，尾端光球就会亮起。继续充电，偶尔能让尾尖分叉、长出新光球，但通常只会引发高压放电。
author: .jerden
source: When its coat is fully charged with electricity, the orbs at the ends of its tails light up. Continuing to charge it occasionally results in a tail splitting at the tip to produce a new orb, but usually just causes a high-voltage discharge.

entry: POKENAME需要照明，就造一团浮空鬼火。能让它亮如天上的太阳，但只能维持短短一瞬。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME creates a floating will-o-wisp whenever it needs to illuminate its surroundings. It can make this fiery orb shine as bright as the sun in the sky, but only for a brief moment.

entry: POKENAME边舞边吸阳光，让尾巴生热。冬季也会跳舞，在寒冷中温暖自己与其他生灵。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME absorb sunlight as they dance, causing their tails to generate heat. These Pokémon will even dance during winter, keeping themselves and others warm in the cold temperatures.

entry: POKENAME会向任何抓住它尾巴的对象喷出沸水。训练家靠近时，得格外小心。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME sprays boiling water at anyone who grabs its tail. Trainers are warned to approach it with extreme care.

entry: POKENAME每只手都有三颗毛绒球，能创造并控制火焰。战斗时胡乱甩出火球，重数量，不重准头。
author: sk372
source: The trio of furry spheres on either of POKENAME's hands let it create and control fire. It flings these fireballs wildly in battle, favoring quantity over accuracy.

entry: POKENAME与其他宝可梦合作采蜜。同伴分散蜂群注意，它将灵巧、发热的手伸进蜂巢。热量产生的烟能安抚蜂群，便能取蜜与同伴分享。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME works with other Pokémon to gather honey. While its allies distract the bees, it slips its dexterous, heat-burning hands into the hive. The warmth produces smoke that calms the swarm, letting it collect honey to share with the group.

entry: POKENAME尾巴热得必须待在冰冷水域附近，免得身体干透。它能摆尾兜水，再将滚烫液体甩向敌人。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME's tails emit such intense heat that they must stay close to ice-cold water to prevent themselves from drying out. They are able to hold their tails in such a way that they can hold water and can hurl this scalding liquid at foes.

entry: 中世纪，人们认为POKENAME是女巫狡猾的使魔。带来不幸的迷信，至今仍在流传。
author: mepp.
source: In medieval times, POKENAME were thought to be the sly familiars of witches. Superstitions surrounding these Pokémon as bringers of misfortune persist to this day.

entry: 工业化前，POKENAME因球茎散发的热量，成了常见伙伴。它能调节温度，既能温暖房间，也能生火供人做饭。
author: katieplaysgames
source: In pre-industrial times, POKENAME were a common companion thanks to the heat their bulb produces. They can control the temperature they output, from enough heat to warm a room to a fire that allows a person to cook a meal.

entry: POKENAME用发烫的门牙烙印周围树木，标记领地。天气太冷时，尾巴会产生浓烟，让自己难以呼吸。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME marks its territory by branding nearby trees with its hot incisors. When the weather gets too cold, its tails produce thick clouds of smoke that give it difficulty breathing.

entry: POKENAME的六条尾巴各有意识，大多数时候却相处融洽。受到攻击时，尾巴会朝四面八方喷出灼热的火星。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's six tails all have a mind of their own, but they all get along most of the time. When attacked, the tails spew hot embers in every direction.

entry: POKENAME总在生气，朝路人吐小火焰。但火极弱，只勉强造成轻微灼烧。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME is constantly in a state of anger, spitting small flames at those who pass it by. These flames are extremely weak, however, barely able to lightly singe those hit.

entry: POKENAME逃跑或进攻前，会发出独特短吠。艺术作品常将羽毛与智慧、机敏相联。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME let out a distinctive yip before either fleeing or attacking. Their feathers are often associated with wisdom and cleverness in artistry.

entry: POKENAME体内火焰的热度恰好能让壳内树果的糖分焦糖化，制成许多人爱吃的美味焦糖酱。
author: hophoppip
source: The heat from POKENAME's internal flame is just the right temperature to caramelize the sugars from Berries it stores in its shell, creating a delicious caramel sauce that many people enjoy.

entry: 严冬，POKENAME用温暖爪子，帮人清除车道、小径的积雪。柔软无比的皮毛，受到所有注重时尚的训练家喜爱。
author: barbienina
source: During harsh winters, POKENAME assists humans by clearing snowy driveways and pathways with its warm, heated paws. Its incredibly soft fur is loved by all fashion-conscious Trainers.

entry: POKENAME射出细小水柱，速度快得能加热所经的附近区域。它把热量当作简易雷达，在下一击前追踪敌人。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME blast small jets of water fast enough to heat the immediate area they travel through. They use this heat as a makeshift radar to track their opponents before their next attack.

entry: POKENAME全年投递各种邮件，会往爪中吐余烬取暖。但得小心，别烧了该送的信。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME deliver all sorts of mail throughout the year. They breathe out embers into their paws to keep themselves warm but need to be careful not to burn the mail they are supposed to deliver.

entry: POKENAME越老，尾巴越长。据说，比起一有机会就进化，等一等再进化，会变得更强。
author: deelee2020
source: The older a POKENAME grows, the longer its tails will be. It's said that waiting to evolve will cause it to become stronger than if it evolves at its first opportunity.

entry: 原生于关都的POKENAME，毛发比大多数其他地区同类的毛更软。许多科学家穿这种毛制的实验服，声称用电脑工作更有效率。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME native to Kanto possess softer fur than those from most other regions. Many scientists wear lab coats made from this fur, claiming it helps them work more efficiently at computers.

entry: POKENAME从角中召出火球自卫。天性胆小，若允许抚摸多条尾巴，就表示真正的信任。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME defends itself by conjuring orbs of fire from within its antlers. Skittish by nature, if POKENAME allows one to pet its multiple tails, it is a sign of true trust.

entry: POKENAME以毛发为傲，不停梳理、维护。它碾碎树果，制成天然颜料，将毛染成各种颜色。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME pride themselves on their fur, constantly grooming and maintaining it. They use crushed berries to create natural paints, dyeing their fur various colors.

entry: POKENAME换毛时，条纹变得更复杂、颜色更深。尤其爱雷暴前，空气里又热又黏的湿气。
author: bobosmith01
source: As POKENAME sheds its coat of fur, the stripe patterns become more complex and darker in color. POKENAME particularly loves the hot and sticky humidity in the air just before a thunderstorm.

entry: POKENAME初被发现时，因可爱而成为热门宠物。但情绪不定，又有火与电的力量，作为宠物的名声便变差了。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's cute appearance made it a popular pet choice when it was first discovered. However, a moody disposition coupled with its powers of fire and electricity has soured its reputation in that regard.

entry: POKENAME喜欢在尾巴上蹦跳，挑战自己不摔下来。玩完后，会烧掉尾巴上的污物。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME enjoy hopping on their tail and challenging themselves to bounce without falling off. After a play session, they burn away any grime on their tail.

entry: 它点燃头上三簇绒毛，再向上发射火焰，排出多余热量。有时用来给朋友表演小烟火。
author: sk372
source: It gets rid of excess heat by igniting the trio of fluffs on its head before launching the flames upward. Sometimes it makes small pyrotechnic shows for its friends using this ability.

entry: POKENAME单爪保持平衡，把敌人困在发光屏障中。心念一动，墙壁便热得足以灼伤。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME balances on one paw and traps foes in glowing Barriers. With a thought, the walls heat up enough to cause burns.

entry: 附近的人报告，POKENAME会改变情绪与活力。原因已经确定：它的存在改变了空气里的正、负离子。
author: bobosmith01
source: Those around POKENAME report changes in mood and energy; it was determined that the cause of this abnormality was due to POKENAME's presence shifting the positive and negative ions in the air.

entry: POKENAME受惊就蜷成球，尾巴笔直竖起，向四方胡乱甩火球，直到觉得危险已经过去。
author: sk372
source: When frightened, POKENAME curls into a ball and lets its tails stand straight up. These tails fling fireballs indiscriminately in all directions until it feels the coast is clear.

entry: 它多在秋季现身，因为叶状尾尖更容易融入环境。天性和平，但谁不尊重自然，就会被POKENAME召出的鬼火惩罚。
author: fiordaliso
source: It appears mostly during the autumn months, as the leaf-shaped tip of its tail blends better with the surrounding environment. It's a peaceful creature, but if someone disrespects nature, it punishes them with the will-o'-wisps POKENAME can summon.

entry: POKENAME能穿行网络，进入旧电视与电脑显示器。它喜欢表演给附近的人看，先投出诡异鬼火吸引观众，再在屏幕上嬉戏。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are able to travel across cyberspace, inserting themselves into old television and computer monitors. They enjoy putting on performances for nearby people, projecting eerie will-o'-the-wisps to draw people in before frolicking on screen.

entry: POKENAME拔下的羽毛会自然生热，能填进为寒冷环境旅行设计的枕头里。
author: bandedbodypress
source: The feathers plucked from POKENAME naturally generate heat. They may be put in pillows designed for travel in frigid environments.

entry: POKENAME蜷成球，越强，摸着越热。最热时，甚至像一大团鬼火。
author: ichosuzu
source: POKENAME can curl itself into a ball that grows hotter to the touch as it becomes stronger. At its hottest, it even resembles a large will-o'-the-wisp.

entry: POKENAME性情温和，能用尾巴感知他人的情绪，是安慰人心的好伙伴。
author: jackjirachi
source: POKENAME are gentle-natured. They are able to sense the feelings of others by their tails, making them great comfort Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME住在神社，帮忙照料、维护圣地。受到威胁时，便借面具引导强大的火焰。
author: jackjirachi
source: POKENAME inhabit shrines, where they perform tasks to maintain their sacred ground. When threatened, they use their mask to channel powerful flames.

entry: POKENAME住在神社，帮忙照料、维护圣地。受到威胁时，便借面具引导强大的火焰。
author: jackjirachi
source: POKENAME inhabit shrines, where they perform tasks to maintain their sacred ground. When threatened, they use their mask to channel powerful flames.

entry: POKENAME心地善良，会用火焰带来舒适暖意，缓解受其照料者的疼痛与不适。
author: jackjirachi
source: POKENAME has a kindhearted demeanor. It uses its flames to create a soothing warmth, easing the pain and discomfort of those it cares for.

entry: 传说一位巫女经过神秘转变，成了POKENAME。如今继续指引别人，让他们守住纯净之心。
author: jackjirachi
source: It is rumored that a shrine maiden became POKENAME through a mystical transformation. It now guides others, ensuring that they remain pure.

entry: POKENAME的神秘旋律，连最激烈的战斗也能安抚。它偏爱宁静，谁搅扰，就会毫不犹豫，用令人噤声的烈焰收拾对方。
author: actliux
source: POKENAME sing mystical melodies that bring peace to even the harshest of battles. They highly prefer tranquil environments and will not hesitate to dispatch those who disturb their peace with a silencing blaze.

entry: 上流社会常雇POKENAME，在家里担任看护或女仆。它性情开朗，乐意帮忙，但工作时有些笨拙。
author: sk372
source: Many POKENAME are employed by high-class society to work as caretakers and maids within their homes. POKENAME is upbeat and happy to help, though it is prone to being a bit clumsy while working.

entry: POKENAME用尾巴的热量烤龙睛果，软化硬壳。遇险便往高草里散出小余烬，趁敌人分心于蔓延的火势，逃走。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME uses the heat from its tails to roast Ganlon Berries, softening their hard shells. When threatened, it will scatter small embers in the tall grass, fleeing while its attacker is distracted by the spreading fire.

entry: 工业化前，POKENAME因球茎散发的热量，成了常见伙伴。它能调节温度，既能温暖房间，也能生火供人做饭。
author: katieplaysgames
source: In pre industrial times, POKENAME were a common companion thanks to the heat their bulb produces. They can control the temperature they output, from enough heat to warm a room to a fire that allows a person to cook a meal.

entry: POKENAME会与其他宝可梦结下深厚羁绊，很快产生依恋与保护欲。感知危险，就会毫不犹豫从尾巴抛出大量火球，守护在乎的生灵。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME forms strong bonds with other Pokémon, growing attached and protective rather quickly. If it senses danger, it won't hesitate to fling multitudes of fireballs from its tail to guard those it cares for.

entry: POKENAME静卧林中假扮植物。猎物靠近，就加热触须末端，轻松烧伤、制服对方。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME lies motionless in forests, pretending to be a plant. When prey comes near, it heats the ends of its tendrils to burn and subdue them with ease.

entry: POKENAME皮毛覆着会引起炎症的毒素。防护不足便触碰，会产生痛苦的灼烧感。它们似乎不知道这特征，仍向训练家寻求关爱、呵护。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME fur is coated in an inflammatory toxin that causes a painful burning sensation if touched without proper protection. They seem unaware of this trait of their fur and seek affection and fuss from their Trainers.

entry: POKENAME察觉龙卷风正在形成，就向天空发射火焰。火焰信号警告其他生灵，危险将至。
author: .izik
source: When it senses a tornado forming, POKENAME shoots flames into the sky. The fiery signal warns others of the approaching danger.

entry: POKENAME常在无声漂过夜空时打盹。受惊醒来，就会慌张反击，朝四方吐火。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME often dozes while floating silently through the night. If startled awake, it lashes out in panic, spitting fire in all directions.

entry: POKENAME常出现在巧可果树附近，深爱树果的辛辣滋味。树一停止结果，便会点燃，再吃烧焦的残余。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are usually found near Occa Berry trees, as they adore the berries' spicy flavor. Once the tree stops producing berries, they will set the tree alight and then feed on the burnt remains.

entry: 冬季，POKENAME成群以丝滑尾巴互缠保暖。若需挪动，就用小脚摇摇摆摆一起走。
author: quackquackattack
source: To keep warm in winter, POKENAME form groups and wrap their silky tails around each other to conserve heat. If they need to move while huddled together, they waddle with their tiny feet.

entry: POKENAME的刀刃能放出受它操控的火焰。战斗经验越丰富，新尾巴也会渐渐长出来。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME's blade emits flames which it can control. New tails grow with its experience in battle.

entry: POKENAME在地面烧出大圆环，围出领地边界。尾巴长得越多，周围的圆环也越多。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME marks its territory by burning large rings into the ground which outline its perimeter. The more tails POKENAME grows, the more rings surround its territory.

entry: POKENAME出生时只有一条尾巴，长大后才不断分叉。每条尾巴都能像额外的手脚一样运用。
author: melodydelune
source: When POKENAME is born, it only has one tail, but as it ages, its tails split into more. It can use each of its tails as an additional limb.

entry: 每只POKENAME都守着自己的森林。若认为一片区域满是枯木，就会放火烧掉，让健康的新树生长。
author: bradlybro199
source: Each individual POKENAME watches over its own forest. If they deem a section of the forest to be full of dead wood, they'll set it ablaze so that new healthy trees can grow.

entry: POKENAME头顶有一门六管炮。单管射出的火球威力不大，但仔细协调所有炮管，就会成为强大又难缠的敌人。
author: sk372
source: A six-barreled cannon sits atop POKENAME's head. Though individually the fireballs shot from each are minor in power, careful and coordinated use of all the barrels lets it be quite the formidable and tricky foe.

entry: 一点湿气也会毁掉POKENAME华美耳朵的造型，因此它极讨厌沾水或在雨天外出。优雅跳跃时，灼热脚掌会在草上留下焦痕。
author: fiordaliso
source: Even the slightest humidity ruins the styling of its magnificent ears, so it hates getting wet or going out in the rain. When POKENAME hops gracefully, it leaves charred marks in the grass from its scorching paws.

entry: 有些野生POKENAME控制不好极速，撞进树里，留下烧痕。反而能给偏离小径、迷失林中的旅人指路。
author: banzai.exe
source: Some wild POKENAME have difficulty controlling their tremendous speed and leave scorch marks on trees they fly into. These marks can become helpful guideposts for wanderers lost off-trail in the woods.

entry: 它坐在身体不适者的膝上，毛发的暖意能舒缓痉挛与胃痛。但有风天外出得小心，身体太轻，可能不知不觉就被吹走。
author: fiordaliso
source: It sits on the laps of those who are unwell, and thanks to the warmth radiating from its fur, it can soothe cramps and stomach aches. It must be cautious when walking outdoors on windy days, as it's so light it might be carried away without noticing.

entry: POKENAME开始显出进化形的特征，尾巴增加，力量更强。举止沉着、高贵，即使战斗中烧掉对手也一样。
author: sk372
source: Traits of its evolution have begun to spring up in POKENAME, creating more tails and granting it more power. It has a composed and regal demeanor, even as it burns away opponents in battle.

entry: 谁想摸POKENAME柔软的黄褐色毛，它就会毫不犹豫地咬。它用鬼火驱赶不受欢迎的访客，保护黑暗洞穴家园。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME bites without hesitation anyone who tries to touch its soft tawny fur. It uses its Will-O-Wisps to keep unwelcome visitors away from the dark cave it calls home.

entry: POKENAME曾被认为是六尾的进化前形态，如今已证伪。但为何融合个体反而比普通六尾少尾巴，仍未知。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME were once thought to be a pre-evolution of Vulpix. This has since been disproven, however it is unknown why fused POKENAME have fewer tails than normal Vulpix.

entry: 虽然是两只火属性宝可梦融合，POKENAME却披着冰冷的毛皮。许多阿罗拉训练家，很熟悉这种颜色的六尾。
author: amberaxolotl223
source: Despite being a fusion between two Fire-type Pokémon, POKENAME has taken on a chilly coat. Many Alolan Trainers are familiar with Vulpix of this color.

entry: POKENAME在庙宇神龛附近过着优渥生活，创造浮空火球照路、指引访客。夜间会独自游荡庙宇周围，仿佛引领看不见的旅人。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME live life in luxury near temple shrines. By creating and controlling floating orbs of fire, they illuminate pathways and guide visitors. At night, POKENAME can be seen wandering the temple grounds alone, as if guiding unseen travelers.

entry: POKENAME遇险会举起尾巴，扇动着威吓。抖落的毛与泥土着火，噼啪爆响，如同鞭炮。
author: banzai.exe
source: When POKENAME feels threatened, they raise their tails up and fan them around to appear intimidating. This scatters loose hair and dirt, which alight in a display of pops like firecrackers.

entry: POKENAME仍在学习控制火焰，常在巨石上空挥拳练习。尾巴一被卡住，就失去专注，释放火花，很可能引发草地火灾。
author: ghostslythe
source: Still learning to control its flames, POKENAME generally shadow boxes on top of boulders. If one of its tails gets caught, it loses focus and releases an Ember that will likely start a grass fire.

entry: POKENAME能创造混合火焰与雷电的浮空球体，战斗威力强。性情好斗、有点自大，很难训练。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is able to create floating orbs that mix elements of fire and lightning together, making for a potent combination in-battle. It is feisty and a bit uppity in personality, making it difficult to train.

entry: POKENAME释放灼热火焰前，钛制头盔会热到泛出白光。许多目击者，都害怕那闪亮头盔。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's titanium helmet glows white-hot before it unleashes scorching fire. The sight of its shiny helm is feared by many.

entry: POKENAME双翼需要时间生长，因此大多时间都待在地下。挖出的隧道散发热量，能指示它经过哪里。遇险就掀起带火的流沙地狱，掩护逃走。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME's wings take time to grow, so they spend most of their time underground. Tunnels dug by POKENAME radiate heat and are a good indicator of where they have been. When threatened, they whip up fiery Sand Tombs to cover their escape.

entry: POKENAME的鳞片摸着温暖，却很容易烧焦，变成难看的褐色。六片尾巴状的鳍，让它游得很快。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's scales are warm to the touch, but they burn quite easily, causing them to turn an ugly brown. Its six tail-like fins help it swim quickly.

entry: POKENAME胆小得惊人，只能短暂看见与六尾相同的尾巴，就又消失在草丛里。因此，族群数量引来许多推测。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME are incredibly skittish. Only their tails, which are identical to that of a Vulpix, are seen briefly before disappearing into the undergrowth. This has led to much speculation about their population number.

entry: POKENAME毛一湿，全部力气就会消失，得几天才能恢复。它聪明、愿意合作，乐意为林中迷路的旅人送食物。
author: fiordaliso
source: If its fur gets wet, it loses all its strength and takes days to recover. An intelligent and cooperative Pokémon, POKENAME gladly helps lost travelers in the forest by bringing them food.

entry: POKENAME丰美的皮毛用于多种奢华产品。虽然容易烦躁、闹脾气，却也很快原谅别人。
author: bobosmith01
source: Its luscious fur is used in a variety of luxury products. Although easily annoyed and thrown into a tantrum, POKENAME is also quick to forgive others.

entry: 温暖、潮湿季节，POKENAME尤其多。情绪激动、脾气火爆时，常向上浮起。
author: deelee2020
source: POKENAME are particularly abundant during warm, humid seasons. High emotions tend to make them float upwards as their temper runs hot.

entry: POKENAME烦躁时，会热到危险的地步。奇怪的是，递上毛绒玩具就能立刻使其平静，原因不明。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME becomes dangerously hot when agitated. Strangely, presenting it with a plush toy immediately calms it, though the reason for that is unknown.

entry: 这种宝可梦的棉，比其他棉更能让穿戴者保暖，因此POKENAME深受设计师追捧。
author: deelee2020
source: Cotton from this Pokémon keeps the wearer warmer than other kinds. As such, POKENAME is highly sought after by fashion designers.

entry: POKENAME散发温柔暖意。野生个体每晚会换一个新洞穴，寻找火之石。
author: pastapockets
source: POKENAME emanates an aura of gentle warmth. In the wild, POKENAME travels to a new cave each night in search of a Fire Stone.

entry: POKENAME的刺摸起来柔软、蓬松，与外观给人的印象不同。体内保持高温，冬季很受欢迎，容易抱着取暖。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Despite their appearance, POKENAME spines are soft and fluffy to the touch. Their bodies maintain a high internal temperature, and they are popular companions in the winter months, being easy to hug and hold to help keep a person warm.

entry: 它点燃獠牙威吓。POKENAME的毛据说柔软、温暖得让人渴望拥有一只。
author: infinex21
source: It ignites its own tusks to intimidate others. Its fur is said to be so soft and warm that some long to acquire a POKENAME of their own.

entry: POKENAME假装虚弱、笨手笨脚，引来实力中等的捕食者。对方警惕一低，就用带诅咒的火焰洪流反击。
author: bobosmith01
source: It feigns weakness and ineptitude to lure in would-be predators of moderate strength. When their guard is lowered, POKENAME strikes with a torrent of accursed flames.

entry: POKENAME的外表吓人，行为却很可爱。它喜欢被揉肚子，没人关注就打喷嚏，喷出余烬。
author: musicsheep.
source: POKENAME's terrifying appearance betrays its cute behavior. POKENAME loves belly rubs and will sneeze embers if not given attention.

entry: 冬季露营者与宝可梦都珍视POKENAME，能在寒冷夜晚得到安慰。下半身虽散出寒气，却能精准运用体内热量，烤小点心与同伴分享。
author: ambrosia04
source: Cherished by winter campers and Pokémon alike, POKENAME offer comfort during freezing nights. While their lower bodies emit a frosty chill, they use precise internal warmth to roast small snacks to share with their companions.

entry: POKENAME轻若无物地滑过落雪，用冰冷毛发瞬间冻结水分，为同伴制作精美冰晶与刨冰。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME glide weightlessly through falling snow. They use their chilly fur to freeze moisture instantly, crafting ornate ice crystals and shaved ice for companions.

entry: POKENAME最多有八条尾巴，圆鼓鼓的身体承受不了更多。美容费用高，被视为身份象征，每条尾巴护理最多需要2小时。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have up to eight tails, their bulbous bodies unable to handle more than eight. They are a status symbol due to the high costs of grooming, as maintenance takes up to 2 hours per tail.

entry: POKENAME强劲的腿能让它华丽地翻腾、旋转。羽毛随动作散出发光余烬，照亮房间，也令旁观者目眩。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME's strong legs allow it to flip and spin with flair. As it moves, its feathers release glowing embers that light up the room and dazzle onlookers.

entry: POKENAME在对战场边热烈加油。火热表演振奋队友，给予克服逆境的热情。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME cheers with adulation from the sidelines of a Pokémon battle. Its fiery performance invigorates its teammates with the zeal needed to overcome adversity.

entry: POKENAME很虚荣，执着于保持羽毛干净。不肯在雨中或泥地跳舞，因为都会毁掉外貌。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME is vain and obsessed with keeping its feathers clean. It refuses to dance in the rain or mud, as both ruin its appearance.

entry: POKENAME嘴里滴下热蜂蜜，会抹在全身，让皮毛透出黏亮光泽。多数人觉得味道恶劣、难以接受，有些却赞它是习惯后才懂的滋味。
author: .jerden
source: Hot honey drips from POKENAME's mouth, which it smears all over its body to give its fur a sticky sheen. While most people find the flavor noxious and off-putting, some praise it as an acquired taste.

entry: 若无法靠敏锐听觉辨明方向，它会喷火照路。POKENAME将多条尾巴合用，作为第三只翅膀，能够迅速倒飞。
author: oddwalls
source: If it can't orient itself with its acute hearing, it sprays a burst of fire to light the way. POKENAME can fly backwards swiftly by using its many tails together as a third wing.

entry: POKENAME从嘴里吐火，在身体周围塑形，模仿更强的宝可梦。有些人以为见到火焰鸟，其实只是看到它的伪装。
author: oddwalls
source: It blows fire from its mouth and shapes the flames around its body to imitate a stronger Pokémon. Some who believe they've seen Moltres actually saw POKENAME in disguise.

entry: POKENAME嘴里滴下热蜂蜜，会抹在全身，让皮毛透出黏亮光泽。多数人觉得味道恶劣、难以接受，有些却赞它是习惯后才懂的滋味。
author: .jerden
source: Hot honey drips from POKENAME's mouth, which it smears all over its body to give its fur a sticky sheen. While most people find the flavor noxious and off-putting, some praise it as an acquired taste.

entry: 它在冬季照顾其他宝可梦，用温暖皮毛为它们保暖。摩擦双爪能产生大量热量，主要用于战斗。
author: mistymagius
source: It tends to care for other Pokémon during the winter, keeping them warm with its toasty fur. It can rub its paws together to generate high amounts of heat that it mainly uses in combat.

entry: POKENAME做杂技般的战斗动作时，臂上的尾巴会释放余烬。伴着火焰的翻身，让对手目眩。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME releases embers from the tails on its arms while performing acrobatic battle moves. Its fiery flips dazzle opponents.

entry: 温室会设法留一群POKENAME过冬，摆上一碗碗树液，鼓励它们留下。作为回报，它们在空中释放火球，为里面生长的植物保暖。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Greenhouses try to ensure they always have a population of POKENAME through the winter, giving them bowls of sap to encourage them to stay. In exchange, POKENAME release orbs of fire into the air, keeping the space warm for the plants growing inside.

entry: 对于许多容易淤青的人，POKENAME把冰冷身体贴住患处，有助恢复。也能将蓬松尾巴挡在身体前，减轻过强的寒冷感觉。
author: quackquackattack
source: For many who bruise easily, POKENAME can help make recovery easier by pressing their cold bodies against the affected area. POKENAME also have fluffy tails that can be placed in front of their body to reduce the intense cold feeling.

entry: POKENAME生气时，颈部的岩石项圈会热得冒出黑烟。它十分听话，经常被执法机构使用。
author: fiordaliso
source: When POKENAME is angry, the rocky collar around its neck become so hot that they produce a dark smoke. It is an extremely obedient Pokémon and is often employed by law enforcement.

entry: POKENAME唱歌时，数百灵魂会聚到周围聆听。传闻歌声能引哭哭面具前往来世。
author: dodoowner_
source: When POKENAME sings, hundreds of spirits gather around to listen to its song. It's rumored that its song has the ability to bring Yamask to the afterlife.

entry: POKENAME蘑菇含辛辣成分，吃后能让嘴里辣上数小时。高档餐厅将它作为冷菜之前的开胃菜，创造独特用餐体验。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME mushrooms contain a spicy compound that leaves a lingering heat in the mouth for hours after consumption. High-end restaurants include these mushrooms on their menu as an appetiser before a cold dish, creating a unique dining experience.

entry: POKENAME在六尾群中孵化，融入收养它的家族，甚至学会控火。但靠近河流时，真面目便会显露，主动捕猎水属性目标。
author: ghostslythe
source: Hatched among Vulpix herds, POKENAME blends in with its adoptive family, even learning to control fire. When near rivers, its facade drops as it actively hunts for Water-type prey.

entry: POKENAME在稀树草原很少见。它白天猎虫，酷热对它不算什么。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is rarely found in the savannah. It hunts for insects during the day; harsh heat means nothing to this Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME皮毛细软，容易打结。训练家梳毛时，会在旁边放亮灯，分散它的注意。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME has delicate fur that gets matted easily. Trainers keep a bright light nearby to distract it when brushing its fur.

entry: POKENAME在蓬松卷曲的尾巴中生热，多余热量经耳朵排出。若受到训练家许多关爱，尾巴就卷得更紧，能产生更强热量。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME generates heat in its fluffy, curled tail and vents the excess through its ears. If it receives lots of love from its Trainer, the tail becomes more tightly curled, allowing for stronger heat generation.

entry: 迷失林中的训练家说，曾沿POKENAME铺出的鬼火路径走出困境。它天性体贴，常点燃魔杖，逗刚孵化的宝可梦开心。
author: ghostslythe
source: Trainers lost in the woods have reported being led from their predicament by paths of Will-o'-Wisps laid by POKENAME. Caring by nature, they are known to light their wand to entertain newly hatched Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME含糖的身体风味独特，据说像蔓越莓混合加了香料的樱桃。它爱甜树果，吃前会用火焰烤得微焦。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's sugary body has a unique flavor to it, supposedly tasting like a mix of cranberries and spiced cherries. It loves to eat sweet berries, lightly charring them with its flames before consumption.

entry: POKENAME滋味像六尾香烤焦糖圣代，都有顺滑黄油风味与绵密奶油滋味。与圣代不同，它能自己添加配料装饰，例如美味的糖渍樱桃。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a unique taste that resembles a Burnt-Caramel Vulpix Sundae as they both have smooth buttery notes with a creamy taste. Unlike the Sundae, POKENAME can decorate themselves with various toppings, like a delicious, candied cherry.

entry: POKENAME喜欢被宠爱、戴饰品、梳理华美皮毛。感受到关爱又充满自信时，会亲昵、有力地用头撞向心爱的训练家。
author: haypile
source: POKENAME love being pampered, getting dressed up with accessories, and getting their luxurious fur brushed. A POKENAME who feels cared for and confident will grant its beloved trainer sharp, affectionate headbutts.

entry: POKENAME无论属性还是性格都很火爆。能自由控火，常让自己浑身着火、猛坠地面，结果经常反伤自身。
author: roundabout_robin
source: POKENAME are fiery in both type and personality. Their ability to freely control fire often leads to them coating themselves in fire and hurtling to the ground, which often ends in them hurting themselves.

entry: POKENAME钻穿火山岩壁，享受暖意。挖到一半受打扰，就会以猛烈火焰反击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME tunnels through volcanic walls to bask in warmth. If disturbed mid-dig, it retaliates with powerful bursts of fire.

entry: POKENAME在窝旁极害羞。有人靠得太近，就从洞里喷出余烬，赶走入侵者。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME is extremely shy near its den. When approached too closely, it fires embers from its burrow to drive intruders away.

entry: POKENAME使出火焰旋涡前，头上的硬币会烧红。这是困住猎物前，唯一的警告。
author: .izik
source: Before unleashing Fire Spin, the coin on POKENAME's head glows red-hot. This is the only warning it gives before trapping its prey.

entry: 遇见喜欢的宝可梦，POKENAME就会呼噜，表示无意伤害。但谁敢摸额头上的硬币，就会从嘴里喷火。
author: fiordaliso
source: When it encounters a Pokémon it likes, POKENAME starts purring to let it know it doesn't mean any harm. However, if anyone dares to touch the coin on its forehead, it starts blowing fire from its mouth.

entry: POKENAME曾因温暖、奢华的毛遭到猎捕，因此极警惕人类。准备使用火属性攻击时，额头珍珠会强烈发光。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is very wary of humans, as it was once hunted for its warm and luxurious fur. When it prepares to use its Fire-type attacks, the pearl on its forehead glows intensely.

entry: POKENAME每有新领悟，就兴奋地喷出一团余烬。有时随后忘了见解，反而困惑为何刚才那么兴奋。
author: quackquackattack
source: Whenever POKENAME have a new insight, they release a puff of embers to show their excitement. Sometimes they forget these insights afterwards, leaving them confused about how they got so excited.

entry: POKENAME与训练家玩你丢我捡的游戏，会同时摇动所有燃火的尾巴。快乐奔跑时，身后拖着火星。
author: .izik
source: While playing fetch with its Trainer, POKENAME wags all of its fiery tails in unison. Sparks trail behind it as it sprints joyfully.

entry: POKENAME脚掌热得能在木头上留下爪印，训练家接触时常戴手套。还需梳理丝滑、华美的皮毛，保持洁净。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have paws that can get hot enough to leave paw prints on wood, so Trainers often wear gloves when handling them. Trainers also need to brush their luxuriously silky fur to ensure they remain clean.

entry: POKENAME体表有薄薄的可燃黏液，能随时点燃、甩向对手，以迅速的烈焰溅射出击。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are coated in a thin layer of flammable mucus. They can ignite the mucus at a moment's notice, flinging it at their opponents in battle to strike their foes with a quick Flame Burst.

entry: POKENAME训练越久，身体温度就越高。结束后，会从尾巴造出几团火球，让身体降温更快。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's body heats up during training, increasing in temperature the longer the regimen goes on. Once it finishes, it creates a few balls of fire from its tail in order to decrease its temperature more quickly.

entry: POKENAME用许多前爪打击、抓住敌人。厚毛使它一用力便很快过热，因此中途会休息梳毛，仔细将头上的长毛向后理顺。
author: haypile
source: POKENAME fights by striking and grasping with its many forepaws. Its thick coat causes it to overheat quickly when it exerts itself, so it takes grooming breaks to carefully comb back its long head fur.

entry: POKENAME根部散发强烈热量。它会附住捕食者的脸，喷出溶解液自卫。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's roots radiate intense heat. It clings to predators' faces and spews Acid to defend itself.

entry: POKENAME因优雅举止，在选美比赛备受赞赏。性情极温柔，喜欢让训练家花数小时梳理鬃毛。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is highly prized in beauty contests for its elegance and grace. It has an exceptionally gentle temperament and loves spending hours having its mane brushed by its Trainer.

entry: POKENAME身体渗出黏稠、灼热的黏液，气味像焦木与辣椒，警告敌人远离。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body oozes with a sticky, hot slime. Its smell resembles burnt wood and spicy peppers, warning foes to stay away.

entry: POKENAME加热身体，造出漂浮气泡防御。破裂后，极烫的泥浆状物质喷出，灼伤与恶臭使敌人晕眩。
author: sk372
source: By heating up its body, POKENAME creates floating bubbles that it uses for defense. When popped, the bubbles spray their super-heated sludgy contents, stunning foes with burns and the putrid stench.

entry: POKENAME夜里盘踞民宅，召出六个一组的鬼火在周围起舞，开心地咯咯笑。受害者若连一点害怕也不装，就会让它很愤慨。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME haunts homes at night, summoning will-o'-the-wisps in groups of six to dance around while letting out gleeful giggles. It tends to get indignant if its victim doesn't pretend to be even remotely scared.

entry: POKENAME虚荣、爱暖，会埋进热沙滩，再要求训练家刷掉沙。若用钳子梳理自己时，不慎剪到尾毛，就会伤心得难以安抚。
author: haypile
source: POKENAME is vain and craves warmth. It buries itself in hot beaches and then demands that its trainer brush the sand out. If POKENAME accidentally clips its tail fur while grooming itself with its pincers, it becomes inconsolable.

entry: POKENAME在加热的钳子里烤树果，再吃下。经常接触盐水，让黄褐色毛发保持亮泽。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME roasts Berries inside its heated pincer before eating them. Regular exposure to saltwater helps keep its tawny fur glossy and bright.

entry: POKENAME内脏热量高、营养丰富，备受追捧。人类与宝可梦频繁捕食，使保育者担忧，努力维持野外族群。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME are highly sought after for their calorie-dense and nutritious innards. Frequent predation by humans and Pokémon has raised concerns amongst conservationists, who work hard to maintain wild populations of POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME满足于坐在洋流旁，轻松吃到藻类等细小物质。受惊时，会伴着猛烈爆发的电荷喷出内脏，使自己失去行动力，至少也能吓到威胁者。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is content to sit near ocean currents where it can easily feed on small particles of matter like algae. When surprised, it expels its internal organs with an explosive electric charge, incapacitating it and at least startling the threat.

entry: POKENAME好奇新的相遇，主动滚动探索。感到威胁或压力，就喷出内脏，黏液与生物电同时爆发，约一天才能完全恢复。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is curious about new encounters and actively rolls around to discover more. If it feels threatened or stressed, it expels its internal organs in an explosion of goo and bioelectricity, after which it takes around a day to fully recover.

entry: POKENAME数百只聚在海中洞穴入口，以心灵感应交流，构成稠密的精神网络，共享感知。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME gathers by the hundreds at sea cave entrances. They communicate telepathically, creating a dense psychic web of shared awareness.

entry: POKENAME唾液遇空气，几秒便硬化，几乎与钢铁同样坚韧。它借此造简易武器，或困住踩上唾液的猎物。
author: _pixelar_
source: POKENAME's spit, when exposed to air, will harden in a matter of seconds and be nearly as tough as steel. The Pokémon uses this to its advantage, creating makeshift weapons or trapping its prey as they step into the spit.

entry: POKENAME内脏如长藤缠绕身体，会向外伸出，抓住海藻，拉回来吃。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's innards resemble long vines that wrap around its body. They extend outward to grasp seaweed, which it pulls in to eat.

entry: POKENAME体内藏着蓄有弹力的拳头，可以从嘴里极高速射出。挨打就会反击，以沉重一拳将对手击退。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME stores a spring-loaded fist inside its body, which it can launch from its mouth at extremely high speed. When struck, it retaliates with this attack, knocking opponents back with a crushing blow.

entry: POKENAME是已知表情最丰富的宝可梦之一，幼年展露多种情绪。随着年老，表情会少得多，也更僵硬。
author: jangodiot
source: POKENAME are some of the most expressive Pokémon known to exist, showing a wide variety of emotions in their early stages of life. As POKENAME age, they become much less expressive and more rigid.

entry: POKENAME吐出部分内脏，仍与身体相连，可以当鞭子挥舞。遇空气后，奇怪反应让一侧形成锋利薄膜，也能当镰刀使用。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME dispels a portion of its innards outward, tethered to itself to be swung like a whip. A strange reaction to the air causes the innards to develop a sharp film on one side, allowing it to be wielded like a scythe.

entry: 头顶突起其实是导电器官的一部分。对粗心触碰这些器官的对象，它能释放先前吸收的雷击能量。
author: epolybius
source: The protrusions on its head are actually part of an organ that conducts electricity. It can release the energy of an absorbed lightning strike toward anyone who touches these organs carelessly.

entry: POKENAME内脏摸起来冰冷，包住的敌人最终屈服寒意，不再反抗。背部覆满黏液，很滑，骑在上面极不稳。
author: soup1900
source: Since POKENAME's internal organs are freezing to the touch, enemies it has engulfed in them will eventually succumb to the cold and stop resisting. Its back is very slippery due to the slime it's covered in, making it very precarious to ride on.

entry: POKENAME用喷出体外的内脏拼词，与人类交流。拼出“出租车”的个体会渡人过海，乘客需付食物，路越远，就要越多。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME is able to communicate in human languages by forming words using its ejected internal organs. Those that form the word "TAXI" with their organs will transport people across seas for the price of food that increases the farther the travel is.

entry: POKENAME钻进海底沙层，寻找进化石。发现一堆，就会招呼同伴，一起轮流进化。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME burrows in seabed sand to find evolution stones. If it locates a cluster, it signals allies so they can take turns evolving together.

entry: POKENAME喷出内脏，更好与周围互动。那是由二进制代码组成的粗触须，末端有白色肢体般的部位，用来抓握、戳弄。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME expels its innards to better interact with its surroundings. Said innards consist of a thick tendril of binary code ending in a white limb of sorts used for grabbing and prodding.

entry: POKENAME身体的白色部分，是喷出的内脏。接触氧气会发生反应，产生大量电力，驱退入侵者。
author: sk372
source: The white parts of POKENAME's body are its expelled innards. Exposure to oxygen causes a reaction that generates large amounts of electricity, which it uses to drive off intruders.

entry: 尖锐的毒针其实是消化道里钙化的废物。由于形成时混入胃酸，这些刺带有很强的毒性。
author: frokachu
source: Its sharp stingers are actually calcified waste that formed from its digestive tract. Due to the stomach acids that make them, the stingers are quite poisonous.

entry: POKENAME喷出尾巴形状的内脏，与人类交流，也能模仿手形。塑形需要专注，因此内脏外露时，精神力量较弱。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME communicates with humans by expelling its innards in the form of a tail that can also mimic a hand. Shaping it requires some concentration, so its psychic powers are weaker while its innards are outside its body.

entry: POKENAME内脏遇空气会产生甜香。它将内脏吐成头顶的叶子，轻轻摆动，希望引来友好的生灵。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's innards create a sweet-smelling scent when exposed to open air. It expels its inner organs in the form of a leaf on its head, wafting it about to hopefully draw friendly faces to approach it.

entry: POKENAME黄昏寻找猎物，用内脏附着对方身体，寄生吸取养分，使皮毛变得极软。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME looks for prey around dusk, using its internal organs to attach to their body. It acts as a parasite to absorb nutrients which help its fur become extremely soft.

entry: POKENAME受惊，会将敏感神经喷出体外，让自己显得更大。因为体型小，作为水族箱宠物很受欢迎。
author: beetlething
source: If it is frightened, POKENAME will eject sensitive nerves out of its body to make it appear larger than it actually is. Due to POKENAME's small size, it makes for a popular aquarium pet.

entry: POKENAME用网状内脏捕猎。但必须长时间咀嚼，让柔弱器官持续暴露在外。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's internal organs are shaped like a net, which it uses to capture prey. However, it has to spend a long time chewing its prey, which leaves its delicate organs exposed.

entry: POKENAME头部伸出的内脏，放电前会发出强光。海上数英里之外，都能看见。
author: .izik
source: The innards extending from POKENAME's head glow brightly before discharging electricity. This glow is visible from miles away across the ocean.

entry: POKENAME壳里始终装满黏性液体，防止晒伤。晴热天，会在海滩分享，让其他生灵也免受晒伤。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME always keep their shells brimming full of a sticky slime that they use to prevent getting sunburn. On hot, sunny days, they walk around beaches to share this slime so others don't get sunburns as well.

entry: 雨天，POKENAME会上岸跳舞。太阳一出现，就很快衰弱，幸好海滩游人总会帮忙送回水中。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME comes to shore on rainy days to perform its dance. It quickly weakens when the sun arrives, but luckily beachgoers always help return it to the water.

entry: POKENAME成群漂在洋流里，开心等待被带往何处。不太会自行游泳，只能用头上的鳍稍微推进。
author: mistymagius
source: Schools of POKENAME can be seen floating through ocean currents, gleefully waiting for where the current will take them. They can't really swim on their own and can only slightly propel themselves with their head fins.

entry: POKENAME轻得能乘风，快速转动内脏，在微风中调整方向。它在阳光下的湖泊休息，通过光合作用获取养分。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Light enough to be carried by the wind, POKENAME rapidly rotate their innards to help steer themselves on the breeze. They rest in sunlit lakes to gather nutrients from photosynthesis.

entry: 训练家对这种融合体意见两分：有的觉得可爱迷人，有的却反感它伸出肠管当肢体。
author: hophoppip
source: Trainers are divided in their opinions on this fusion. Some find it quite cute and charming, while others are put off by the extruding intestine it uses as a limb.

entry: POKENAME即使有保护黏液也容易干燥，因此大多留在水中，好奇地望向陆地。内脏碰到肌肤会引发严重皮疹，兴奋时，训练家与泳者都需留意。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME mostly stays in water as it dries out even with its protective mucus, but it watches the land with curiosity. Its innards cause severe rashes if they come into contact with flesh, so Trainers and swimmers need to be wary if it gets excited.

entry: POKENAME伸出内脏，从水洼喝水，尽量少动。热天会分泌有毒黏液，保持身体湿润。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME drinks from puddles using its extended innards, minimizing movement. In hot weather, it sweats a toxic mucus to keep its body moist.

entry: POKENAME方向感强，过去被用来寻找陆地，水手至今延续传统饲养。回船会得到闪亮奖赏，再用头上泡沫状器官表达见闻。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME has a strong sense of direction, so sailors keep them out of tradition for when they were used to seek land. When it returns to the boat, it receives a shiny reward and then communicates what it saw using the foamy organ on its head.

entry: POKENAME来到岸上觅食，叶片中的液体帮助身体在陆上保湿。叶子开始萎缩，就动身返回大海。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME wander ashore in search of food. Their leaves contain fluid that helps keep them moisturized while on land. When the leaves begin to shrivel, POKENAME begin their return to the sea.

entry: POKENAME住在热带海域的礁石间，沿海床缓缓移动，吃碎屑。刺中有起效很快的毒素，能引发幻觉，帮助逃离威胁。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME resides in tropical ocean reefs where it slowly meanders along the seafloor to eat detritus. Its spikes contain a fast-acting toxin that induces hallucinations so it can escape from threats.

entry: POKENAME需要水保持皮肤湿润，因此住在地下蓄水区。黏液虽已演化得更耐地底高温，挖得太深仍会干透。
author: soup1900
source: Needing water to keep its skin moist, POKENAME lives in underground reservoirs in order to survive. While its slime has evolved to better handle the high underground heat, it can still dry up if it digs too deep into the ground.

entry: POKENAME不喜争斗，避免往来，但蕉香果片能赢得好感。被迫战斗，就喷出内脏抓住敌人，拉向双颚，再重重咬下。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME avoids interactions as it does not like conflict, but it can be won over with slices of Nanab Berries. If forced to fight, it will expel its innards to grab its foe and reel them in to the jaw, which it uses to deliver a crushing bite.

entry: POKENAME行经火山与海洋相接的沙滩，享受热量与海风。谁想打扰，就会被耳中伸出的器官拳打。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME travel the beaches where volcanoes meet the sea, enjoying the combination of heat and the sea breeze. If anyone tries to disturb it, they will be punched by the organs from its ears.

entry: POKENAME性情被动，必要时宁愿避战。但若挨打，就迅速从壳里释放内脏，施以强力双倍奉还。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are passive Pokémon, preferring to avoid conflict when necessary. If they are struck, they rapidly release their innards from within their shell for a powerful Counter.

entry: 看似外壳的部分，其实是POKENAME的身体，坚韧橡胶般的外皮用于威慑捕食者。它伸出内脏移动，遇险便能随时缩回。
author: katieplaysgames
source: What appears to be a shell is actually POKENAME's body, their tough rubbery exterior intended to deter predators. They extrude their innards to move around, and can withdraw them back in at a moment's notice should danger arise.

entry: POKENAME在礁石底部滤食，远离其他水生宝可梦。若被发现，就吐出胃液，再游走。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME filter feeds at the base of reefs, keeping its distance from other aquatic Pokémon. If spotted, it will spit Gastro Acid before swimming away.

entry: 它埋在沙下，直到受扰，才爆发般喷墨、伸臂。用废罐、金属丝与塑料环建造复杂的水下巢穴，既用于伪装，也宣示领地。
author: jaminmcready
source: This Pokémon remains buried under sand until disturbed, then erupts in a burst of ink and arms. It constructs intricate underwater nests from discarded cans, wire, and plastic rings, using them as both camouflage and a statement of territory.

entry: POKENAME用内脏拾取食物，一点残余也不留给铁炮鱼，因此铁炮鱼从不搭它的便车。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME uses its internal organs to help scavenge and grab food for itself. Remoraid will never hitch on this Pokémon due to this leaving no leftovers for Remoraid.

entry: POKENAME全身覆着麻痹毒素，体内外有多个专门的器官，制造这种致命物质。
author: pkbonusducks
source: Every part of POKENAME is coated with a paralyzing toxin. Their bodies have multiple internal and external organs dedicated to creating this deadly substance.

entry: POKENAME游泳时鼓起白色囊袋，让身体浮在水上。遇险从长鼻喷出白色墨汁，能造成永久失明。
author: mistymagius
source: While swimming, POKENAME inflates the white sacs on its body to allow it to float on the water. When threatened, POKENAME sprays a white ink from its trunk that can cause permanent blindness.

entry: POKENAME尾巴上的手始终沾满液体。它们用尾部指尖留下标记，彼此传递信息。
author: jangodiot
source: The hand on its tail is constantly soaked in fluid. POKENAME use markings from their tail's fingertips to communicate messages with each other.

entry: POKENAME执着于亲吻其他生灵，很难躲开它的亲昵。它会从嘴里喷出部分身体，就连远处的东西也能亲到。
author: sk372
source: It has a fixation on kissing other creatures. Escaping POKENAME's affection is difficult, as it will expel parts of its body from its mouth in order to let it kiss things from a distance.

entry: POKENAME受惊，可能从嘴里喷出头部器官储存的部分电力。转动双臂，又能吸回电力充能。
author: epolybius
source: When startled, POKENAME may eject some of the electricity stored in the organ on its head out through its mouth. By winding up its arms, it can draw electricity back in to recharge.

entry: POKENAME摇动尾巴、咂舌，引猎物靠近。进入范围，就用尾部内脏抓住、勒紧食物。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME shake their tails and click their tongues to lure prey close. When within range, they use their internal organs from their tail to snatch and constrict their food.

entry: POKENAME以传说般的力量净化海岸、水域，清除污染。它从远处观察具破坏性的融合宝可梦，或许准备清理环境损害。
author: bobosmith01
source: With legendary power, POKENAME purifies shorelines and bodies of water, freeing them of pollutants. From a distance, it watches over destructive fused Pokémon, perhaps in preparation to clean up any harm done to the environment.

entry: POKENAME伸长尾巴抓住敌人，再从尖刺产生电力。也会抓岸边岩石，通过尾巴导电、震碎，再收集碎石当零食。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME grab foes with their extendable tails then generate electricity from their spines. They grab rocks along the shoreline and send electricity through their tails to shatter them, gathering the rubble for a snack.

entry: 有人相信，POKENAME内脏由时间本身的织物构成。虽然未证实，但每次时间旅行前喷出内脏，倒是真的。
author: sk372
source: Some believe that POKENAME's internal organs are comprised of the very fabric of time itself. While this is unconfirmed, it is true that it always expels its innards before any trip through time it travels.

entry: POKENAME不爱站着，便把自己的内脏当坐垫。不拿来垫着时，就用它捕捉宝可梦，吞食下肚。
author: dodoowner_
source: A POKENAME uses its own guts to sit on, as it doesn't like standing. If a POKENAME isn't using its guts to sit, it's using it to catch Pokémon to eat.

entry: POKENAME聪明、乐于帮忙，是很好的宠物与伙伴。但许多训练家，始终对能抓握的肠管感到恶心。
author: hophoppip
source: Intelligent and helpful, POKENAME can serve as great pets and companions, though many Trainers are unshakably grossed out by its prehensile intestines.

entry: POKENAME示好时，会吐出部分内脏，抛接自身球状器官。但得早点收回体内，否则会生病。
author: sk372
source: As a gesture of friendliness, POKENAME will expel some of its insides and juggle spherical organs it possesses. The spheres need to return inside before too long, lest it gets sick.

entry: 铁炮鱼群常被POKENAME体表黏液黏住。它只得喷出内脏，轻轻帮助铁炮鱼和自己，脱离这场黏糊困境。
author: soup1900
source: Schools of Remoraid often get stuck onto POKENAME's body due to the sticky mucous that covers it. It must then eject and use its internal organs to gently free the Remoraid and itself from this sticky situation.

entry: 头顶光球与手状尾巴直接相连。两处同时接触攻击者，就会闭合回路，释放超过30,000伏特，但自己也会疲惫。
author: epolybius
source: It has a direct connection from the bulbs at the tip of its head to its hand-like tails. By touching both of these against an attacker, it completes a circuit that unleashes over 30,000 volts. It wears itself out in the process.

entry: POKENAME友好，住热带绿植茂密的沙滩。它将内脏伸成尾巴，撑高身体，更好巡视四周。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a friendly creature that inhabits beaches with plenty of tropical greenery. It expels some of its innards like a tail to lift itself up and better survey its surroundings.

entry: POKENAME全部体热由内脏产生。虽然能喷出体外，但体温会迅速降到危险程度，因此极少这样做。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's internal organs produce all of its body heat. While it's capable of ejecting its innards, its body heat would rapidly drop to dangerous levels, so it rarely does so.

entry: POKENAME脱落的棘刺，被针灸师用来帮助人缓解压力。分泌的黏液能作局部麻醉剂，也能先擦掉，再进行较传统的针灸。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME sheds quills that are used by acupuncturists to help people relieve stress. The sticky mucus it releases can be used as a local anesthetic or can be wiped off to perform more traditional acupuncture.

entry: POKENAME踢技已很不错，却为硬仗留着秘密招式。能从嘴里喷出脚状内脏，出人意料地补上额外一踢。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is already rather adept at kicking techniques in combat, but keeps a secret move in reserve for tougher battles. It can spew its innards out from its mouth in the shape of a foot, giving it a surprising extra kick attack.

entry: POKENAME游泳时，用鳍与角保护脸部、破开岩石。需要远程战斗，就伸出内脏，释放大股水流，冲走障碍或敌人。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME use their fins and horns to protect their faces and break through rocks while they swim. If they need to fight long distances, they extend their insides and release a torrent of water out to spray away obstacles or foes.

entry: 野生POKENAME收养、保护拳海参群。谁想伤害幼小成员，就会遭到由纯精神能量形成的巨拳攻击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME adopts and protects groups of Pyukumuku in the wild. Any attempt to harm the little ones results in POKENAME unleashing a large fist of pure psychic energy at the perpetrator.

entry: POKENAME为了防御攻击，排尽所有内脏，如今只剩空壳。人们相信，踩中尖刺，会被它偷走灵魂。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is a hollow shell after having expelled all of its organs to defend from attack. It is believed that stepping on the spines of a POKENAME will cause it to steal one's soul.

entry: POKENAME将体内波导附着在内脏上。战斗时喷出，便是覆满波导的拳头，从嘴里射出，将敌人打到地平线之外。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME channels its aura within and attaches it to its innards. When it expels said innards in a fight, the results is an aura covered fist launching from its mouth to knock foes over the horizon.

entry: POKENAME花朵是外伸的内脏，放出难闻气味，引来虫属性宝可梦。进入范围，就被酸液浸透，活组织慢慢溶解。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME's flower is made of its innards, extruded out to release a noxious scent that draws in Bug-type Pokémon. Once in range, these Pokémon are soaked with an acid that slowly melts through living tissue.

entry: POKENAME极忠于训练家，甚至愿故意让自己失去战斗能力，换取训练家安全。手状附肢其实是内脏，被击中会极为疼痛。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME arde incredibly loyal to their Trainers and will even intentionally faint themselves if it means its Trainer gets to safety. Their hand-like appendages are actually their internal organs, causing POKENAME extreme pain when they are hit.

entry: POKENAME将各种物品吸入体内，必要时吐出攻击敌人。吐出物覆着黏液，能吸引灵魂、困在物品里，强迫它们附身。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME absorbs various objects into its body so that if needed, it can eject them at foes as an attack. These vomited items are covered in a mucous that attracts spirits and traps them in the item they're covered on, forcing them to possess it.

entry: 它拥有神明般的力量，足以毁灭先出手攻击自己的敌人。但若觉得来者值得相交，也会主动伸出手。
author: skymaster426
source: Godlike power allows it to unleash devastating attacks at those who strike it first. However, it offers its hand to those it deems worthy.

entry: POKENAME主要靠吐出利刃，刺穿猎物来攻击。它能贴在墙上，明明就在眼前，却让人难以察觉。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME spits out its blade as its main form of attack, piercing prey. It can stick to walls to do so hidden in plain sight.

entry: POKENAME用胃中的铁制造易碎刀刃。每天得吃大量铁，才能稳定供应锋利刀刃。它会不断追猎，直到刀刃用尽。
author: saucebolodu81
source: POKENAME can create fragile blades using the iron in their stomach. They must eat lots of iron daily if they want a steady supply of sharp blades. They relentlessly track down prey until they run out of blades.

entry: POKENAME喷出的内脏形状像闪电。透过墙壁看见敌人后，就会展开器官，从远处打击。
author: soup1900
source: The internal organs that POKENAME ejects have a lightning bolt shape to them. After spotting an enemy through a wall, it deploys its organs to strike them from a distance.

entry: POKENAME用喷出的内脏作手势，与其他生灵交流。器官接触有镇静效果，因此爱轻拍、揉肩，让其他生灵开心。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME communicates with others by expelling its innards and forming gestures akin to hand signs. Its organs possess a calming property on contact, so it likes to give pats, shoulder rubs, and the like to make others happy.

entry: POKENAME喷出内脏，像细触须般操控，既能重击来犯者，也能缠住猎物。驯养个体陪训练家走时，会至少用其中一条缠住对方。
author: infinex21
source: It can eject and control its internal organs like slender feelers, both to deal heavy blows to its aggressors and to ensnare its prey. A tamed POKENAME will wrap at least one of its organs around its Trainer while walking with them.

entry: POKENAME覆着一层永不干燥的厚黏液。它爱把身体拖上沙滩，但跟随而来的雨，最终又会将它冲回海里。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's body is covered with a thick mucus that never dries out. It has a tendency to drag its body up onto beaches, but eventually the rain that follows it will wash it back into the sea.

entry: POKENAME扭动蛇般的身体穿行天空，顽皮地挥着双臂。它能释放强大的能量冲击，也会用巨臂近身攻击。平时藏在云中，伺机吞食飞过的猎物。
author: thepandasharky
source: POKENAME wiggles through the sky with its serpentine body, flailing its arms playfully. It unleashes powerful energy blasts while using its giant arms for upclose attacks. It hides amongst clouds, preparing to devour flying prey.

entry: POKENAME外观虽吓人，性情却温顺。“翅膀”并非真正翅膀，而是攻击挑衅者的内脏。若无效，再用龙之能量轰击。
author: kam_doodle_snek
source: Despite POKENAME's intimidating appearance, it's quite docile. The "wings" are not actual wings, but internal organs that allow it to attack those who provoke it. If that doesn't work, it blasts the threat with draconic energy.

entry: POKENAME有达克莱伊模样的伪装，虽然没有散播噩梦的能力，仍能让未被吓退的对象陷入沉睡。
author: reiofsunshine1123
source: POKENAME has developed a disguise in the form of Darkrai. While not having the power to spread nightmares, it can still put those who aren't scared off by its disguise to a deep sleep.

entry: POKENAME手形炮口偶尔放出的不是储能，而是一面旗。旗子来历不明，一放出便立刻缩回。
author: .izik
source: Occasionally POKENAME's hand-like cannon releases a flag instead of stored energy. The flag's origin is unknown and it is always withdrawn back inside the moment after it is deployed.

entry: POKENAME手臂相当无力，不适合自卫。改为吐出自身内脏，形成可伸长的拳头，击退逼近的危险。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's arms are rather weak, making them ill-equipped for defending itself. Instead, it spits out its own innards in the shape of an extendable fist to knock back incoming danger.

entry: 身体产生天然刺激物，使速度提升到足以匹敌现代机械。只要通过龙睛果或其他方式强化一次防御，就会成为棘手对手。
author: quackquackattack
source: Its body produces a natural stimulant that causes it to raise its speed to levels that rival modern machinery. A single boost to its defenses through a Ganlon Berry or otherwise makes it a formidable foe.

entry: POKENAME爬上游轮，尾随把它扔下船的人。整趟旅程都用可控内脏折腾对方，半夜抓脚，或偷走对方正伸手拿的食物。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME climbs aboard cruise ships to stalk whoever threw it overboard. It torments them throughout their trip with the aid of vomiting out its controllable innards, whether grabbing their feet at night or stealing food they were reaching for.

entry: POKENAME在浑浊的海水深处散出缥缈光芒，缓缓摆动，引诱猎物。中计就会被抓进主体，作为火焰燃料。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Emitting an ethereal light through the murky depths of the sea, POKENAME slowly sway back and forth to act as a lure. Any prey that falls for this trap will be grabbed and taken into the main body, acting as fuel for their flames.

entry: POKENAME是各自拳海参群的王，占据温暖浅水，驱赶外来者。谁想丢走同群拳海参，就用内脏将对方扔出去。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME are kings of their group of Pyukumuku, claiming and protecting their territory of warm, shallow waters from outsiders. They use their internal organs to chuck anyone who tries to throw a Pyukumuku from their group.

entry: POKENAME想看东西，必须用力推出覆盖身体的器官。许多宝可梦、训练家经过，便会因此带上淤青。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: In order for POKENAME to see it must violently push out the organs that cover its body. This leads to many Pokémon and Trainers with bruises after passing a POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME三颗头都能喷出内脏攻击，却需小心分开发动。多个同时喷出，威力反而弱得多，也更耗体力。
author: sk372
source: All three of POKENAME's heads can expel their innards to attack other creatures, but they must be careful to do so individually. If multiple heads launch their insides at the same time, the resulting attack is far weaker and more exhausting.

entry: POKENAME沿海床挖出绵延隧道，寻找庇护。水下通道可延伸数英里，途中不会露出海面。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME digs extensive tunnels along the seafloor while seeking shelter. These underwater pathways can stretch for miles without surfacing.

entry: 别看POKENAME的双臂这副模样，其实十分柔软，却蕴藏惊人力量。它们既用来捕鱼，也用来战斗。
author: ayner
source: Despite appearances, the arms of POKENAME are squishy appendages that hide tremendous strength. They use them to catch marine fish Pokémon and fight.

entry: POKENAME受威胁，就用潮旋把捕食者困进漩涡，再迅速逃开，藏进远处海洞。
author: .izik
source: If threatened, POKENAME summons a Whirlpool to trap predators in a swirling vortex. It then escapes swiftly, hiding in distant sea caves.

entry: POKENAME很容易受惊，出于防卫喷出器官，驱赶认定的威胁，因而让训练家不愿饲养。它住在城市旁的浑水，也可适应盐水。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is easily startled, causing it to defensively eject its organs to ward off perceived threats, which makes it an off-putting Pokémon for Trainers to raise. It lives in murky water sources near urban areas, but can adapt to salt water.

entry: POKENAME将旧内脏裹在身上，既能保暖，也能承受高处坠落的冲击。进化时，这层包裹便会脱落。
author: neonriser
source: POKENAME wraps its old guts around its body to keep itself warm and survive long falls. It sheds them when it evolves.

entry: POKENAME吐出内脏时，也能将其点燃，给敌人额外的火焰拳击。但这对健康影响极大，会严重伤到自身。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME can torch its internal organs when it spits them out, giving foes an extra fiery punch. This however gives major repercussions on its health, greatly injuring itself.

entry: POKENAME的白色附肢直接连着胃。它用附肢裹住猎物，再一口吞下。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's white appendages are directly connected to its stomach. It uses the appendages to enwrap its prey before gulping it down.

entry: POKENAME从嘴里射出内脏，盖住人类的头。孔隙刚好能让人呼吸，表面的滑膜却会使人入睡。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME shoots its own guts from its mouth to cover a human's head. They are just porous enough to breathe through and coated in a slimy film that lulls the person to sleep.

entry: POKENAME浮在海面，随浪轻轻摆动。它靠念力改变水流，抵达喜爱的目的地。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME floats on ocean surfaces, gently bobbing with the waves. It telekinetically redirects currents to reach its preferred destinations.

entry: 它常跳上附近训练家的衣服，搭到下一座镇子，再跳下换另一位训练家。衣上留下的小网，就是搭乘费。
author: beetlething
source: It frequently hops onto the shirts of nearby Trainers, hitching a ride to the next town before it hops off and moves to the next Trainer. It leaves behind a small web on the Trainer's shirt as payment for the ride.

entry: POKENAME用器官将自己弹到训练家、宝可梦身上，吃静电。若静电不够，就用器官弹一下搭乘者，再去找其他对象。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME use their organs to launch themselves onto Trainers and Pokémon to eat their static. If there's not enough static, POKENAME flicks whoever they're riding on with their organs before finding someone else.

entry: POKENAME外壳的刺，盖住通向内脏的孔洞。器官能从孔里喷出，挥舞尖刺作武器，驱退敌人。
author: pjporwoll
source: The thorns on POKENAME's outer shell cover holes leading to its internal organs. POKENAME can expel its organs from these holes, with the thorns becoming weapons wielded by its innards to fight off foes.

entry: POKENAME不用獠牙战斗，更爱先将食物切成小块再吃。嘴里分泌蜡状液体，保持刀刃顺滑、锋利。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME doesn't use its tusks for combat, preferring to slice its food into tiny pieces before eating. It secretes a waxy fluid from its mouth to keep the blades smooth and sharp.

entry: POKENAME在战斗中被逼入绝境，就会吐出部分内脏。战后獠牙若断，会用内脏暂时代替，直到长回。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME spits up some of its innards in combat when pushed into a corner. Should its tusks break after a fight, it uses some innards to temporarily replace them until they grow back.

entry: POKENAME在水下拍翼，周围的水会升温。高速移动时，身后甚至会形成沸腾的水流。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME flaps its wings underwater, the surrounding water heats up. At high speeds, this can cause boiling currents to form behind it.

entry: POKENAME静卧海床，向上伸出内脏放电。等捕食者晕眩，便迅速逃进海带丛躲藏。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME lies motionless on the seafloor and stretches its innards upward to discharge electricity. Once predators are stunned, it flees quickly to kelp fields to hide.

entry: 海滩游客要留意野生POKENAME。它常有好斗行为，咬击还带有强烈毒性。
author: theartemis1
source: Beachgoers are warned to stay alert for wild POKENAME. It often displays aggressive behavior and fosters a highly venomous bite.

entry: 头部由一组强劲的肌肉构成，能将内脏猛力弹出。它甚至无需挪动身体，就能击落体型比自己大数倍的大嘴雀。
author: staghorn
source: Its head is a battery of powerful muscles designed to eject its inner organs with great force. It's capable of bringing down a Fearow many times its size without moving its body.

entry: POKENAME从身体侧面、底部喷出内脏，用于移动与跳舞。尽情活动这些器官，既能燃脂，也有助消化。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME ejects internal organs from the sides and bottom of its body to move around and dance. This passionate use of organs both burns fat and helps digest food.

entry: POKENAME先用手上两个器官绒球假攻，再用嘴里的器官突然补上第三击。但若给第三个器官通电，会误电身体内部的其他部位。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME pretends to attack with the two organ pom-poms on its hands before doing a surprise third attack using the organ from its mouth. It will accidentally shock the rest of its inner body if it electrifies this third organ.

entry: POKENAME的羽毛靠厚黏液附在身上，跳舞也能维持形状。但也会吸来沙与泥，使颜色逐渐黯淡。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME's feathers stick to its body using a thick, sticky mucus. While this helps keep its shape during dances, it also attracts sand and dirt that dull its colors over time.

entry: POKENAME聚到巨响附近，将声音与猎物、捡食机会联系起来。阿罗拉人发现，金属乐会使它变得爱玩，因此许多海滩播放这种音乐，缓和攻击性。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME school around loud noises, associating the sounds with prey or scavenging opportunities. Inhabitants of Alola discovered that POKENAME becomes playful in the presence of metal music, so many beaches play it to temper their aggressiveness.

entry: POKENAME喷出器官充当尾巴，迅速追逐猎物。其余时间，则一动不动地漂过海洋。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME expels its organs as a tail to speedily chase down prey. The rest of the time, POKENAME floats motionless through the ocean.

entry: POKENAME六只成群，诡异地漂过深水。游动时发出让听者不安的低吟，许多生灵因此彻底避开。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME drifts through deep waters in eerie groups of six. It emits unsettling moans as it swims, causing many to avoid its presence entirely.

entry: POKENAME将自己固定在珊瑚礁旁，除非有重大危险，否则不必挪动。弹性附肢能抓住超过100米外的猎物。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME plants itself near coral reefs, having no need to move unless it is in grave danger. It uses its stretchy appendages to grab prey from over 100 meters away.

entry: POKENAME用巨手挖开沙滩，让整片海岸浸上一层浅水。这样便能躺在沙上晒太阳，不怕干透。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME tears up beaches with its giant hands to allow shallow amounts of water to flood the whole shore. This is done so it can lounge around on the sand and catch the sun's rays without worry of ever drying up.

entry: POKENAME发现太阳珊瑚，内脏便伸成手形抓住，再注入毒液、吃掉猎物。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME spots a Corsola, its innards stretch into a hand-like shape to grab it. It then injects venom before consuming its prey.

entry: 手臂受损后，一小时内就能重新长好。尖刺中的毒性虽轻，却会引起恶心与剧烈头痛。
author: mistymagius
source: If its arms get damaged, it can regrow them within the hour. Its thorns contain a mildly toxic poison that is known to cause nausea and severe headaches.

entry: POKENAME静站沿海浅水，夜里吸收湿气。白天分泌芦荟汁般滑润的液体，维持身体水分。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME stands still in shallow coastal waters, absorbing moisture at night. By day, it secretes a slick, aloe-like fluid to keep its body hydrated.

entry: POKENAME看似天真，娱乐方式却令人毛骨悚然。常成群挤在一起，试着用锥形外壳接住落下的小火焰猴。
author: theaceofhearts0306
source: Although having an innocent appearance, POKENAME have a gruesome form of recreation. They often huddle in groups, attempting to catch falling Chimchar with their cone-shaped shells.

entry: POKENAME制造并喷出数百个内脏器官，每个都会出来，拳打周围任何生灵与物品。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME creates and ejects hundreds of internal organs from its body. Each one of these organs will come out and punch anything and anyone in this Pokémon's environment.

entry: POKENAME用一段浮木作武器，也是集中力量的媒介。由于没有手臂，便用外伸的胃挥舞浮木。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME uses a piece of driftwood as a weapon and a focus for its powers. Lacking arms, it wields the driftwood with its extruded stomach.

entry: POKENAME把蓬松内脏裹在身上，藏在急浪的泡沫里。若不慎乘浪走得太远，就会潜入深水，寻找新洋流。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME encase themselves with their fluffy innards to hide themselves in the sea foam of rushing waves. If they accidentally ride a wave too far, they dive deep underwater to try and find a new current.

entry: POKENAME能吐出强而有力的内脏团，作为平台或额外肢体，使它兼具忍者般敏捷与巨力。传说，谁欺负野生拳海参，它就会现身，给予猛烈报复。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME possesses a ninja's agility as well as great strength thanks to the mighty mass of organs it can expel as a platform or extra limb. It's said if one bullies Pyukumuku in the wild, POKENAME will appear to deliver fierce retribution.

entry: POKENAME用巨大的内脏抓住猎物，塞进壳里溶解，获取能量。山壁上的巨大掌印，是它挖掘、寻找内部小猎物时留下的。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME grabs prey using its giant internal organs and then stuffs them inside its shell to be dissolved for energy. Giant handprints can be found on mountain walls where it dug into in search of small prey hiding within.

entry: POKENAME腹部易受伤，因此埋在沙里自保。它爱吃其他海生植物的根。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's belly is very susceptible to damage, so it buries itself in the sand to keep itself safe. It likes to feed on the roots of other sea plants.

entry: 夏末，POKENAME从海里浮出，寻找南瓜田。它用浸水保持作物健康，默默忠诚守护。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME surfaces from seas in late summer to seek out pumpkin patches. It uses Soak to keep the crops healthy, guarding them with silent devotion.

entry: POKENAME用手状内脏比出粗鲁手势，激其他宝可梦打架。它毫无荣誉感，为取胜不惜使用所有阴招。
author: fancyskunk
source: POKENAME goads other Pokémon into fights by making rude gestures with its hand-like internal organs. It has no sense of honor and will resort to all manner of underhanded tactics to defeat its foes.

entry: POKENAME好斗，陌生者进入领地就常挑起争斗。开战总是同一套：先用内脏拳打对手，再在额前比出嘲弄手势。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are aggressive Pokémon, often initiating fights when a stranger enters their territory. They always begin fights the same way: punching their opponent with their organs before making a mocking gesture on their forehead.

entry: POKENAME喷出内脏，无情地劈斩、包裹对手。内脏本身也能喷火，使火焰攻击距离更远。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME mercilessly slashes and engulfs opponents by spitting out its internal organs at them. The internal organs themselves can shoot flames, giving the Pokémon extra torching distance.

entry: POKENAME常在海床下，以为找到食物，就从沙中探头。它以珊瑚与海洋植物为食。
author: flowerz78
source: This Pokémon is often found under the seafloor, and when POKENAME thinks it's found food, it pokes its head out of the sand. It feeds on coral and other types of ocean flora.

entry: POKENAME在海滩撒下珍贵宝石。人们认为，拳海参被当害兽扔回海里的沙滩，最可能收到它的礼物。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME scatters valuable gemstones across beaches. It's thought that beaches where Pyukumuku are seen as pests and chucked into the ocean are the most likely to receive POKENAME's gifts.

entry: POKENAME以手势彼此交流，较复杂的动作，常留到吸引伴侣时使用。语言学家多年来一直尝试解读。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME communicate with one another through hand gestures, often saving the more complex motions for impressing a mate. Linguists have been trying to decipher POKENAME's hand language for years now.

entry: POKENAME爪上覆着黏液，轻易就能爬上湿滑岩石。它在岩滩捕猎，抓走任何被潮水冲进潮池的宝可梦。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's paws are coated in a sticky mucus that allows it to climb slippery rocks with ease. It hunts on rocky beaches, swiping up any Pokémon that gets washed up into the tidepools.

entry: POKENAME头痛不停，便从嘴里伸出内脏，试图减轻负担。可若伸得太远，几乎立刻又会引来新一阵头痛。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Constantly suffering from headaches, POKENAME extend their innards out of their mouths to try and lighten the load. Unfortunately, if they extend their innards too far, it'll prompt a new headache near immediately.
