entry: POKENAME头上的宝石，帮助它以心灵感应扫描四周。一察觉危险，就迅速潜向海洋深处。
author: .izik
source: The gem on POKENAME's head helps it telepathically scan its environment. Upon sensing danger, it dives rapidly into the ocean's depths.

entry: POKENAME好斗爱挑衅，行动却太慢，敌人一退走就追不上。挨打时，它会靠出奇柔韧的身体反弹攻击。
author: katieplaysgames
source: A belligerent Pokémon prone to picking fights, POKENAME move too slowly to chase down opponents that disengage. When struck, they rebound blows with their surprisingly pliable bodies.

entry: 尾上的“火焰”其实是长成火焰形的粉色尖刺。用内脏裹住敌人后，器官会燃烧，烘烤困在里面的宝可梦。
author: soup1900
source: The flame on its tail is actually a pink spike that grew into a flame-like shape. After engulfing an opponent with its internal organs, the organs catch ablaze, baking the Pokémon trapped inside.

entry: POKENAME既护友，又胆小。与盟友一处受惊，会本能吐出内脏抓住朋友，再将大家一起瞬移到别处。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has a protective nature, as well as a skittish streak. When among allies, if something spooks it, it will instinctively expel its innards to grab its friends before teleporting the group somewhere else.

entry: POKENAME手中勺状物，其实是从体内吐出、用于发挥精神力量的器官。高高举起它，就能更好运用强大念力。
author: sk372
source: The spoon-like object in POKENAME's hand is actually the its psychic organ, expelled from inside its body. Holding it aloft allows it to better utilize its potent telekinetic abilities.

entry: POKENAME外壳下侧，是与体内组织类似的膜。虽不如外壳主体坚硬、结实，却能鼓起，将任何来袭攻击弹开。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: The underside of a POKENAME's shell is made of a similar membrane to the insides of its body. While it may not be as rigid or sturdy as the main part of the shell, it can be inflated to deflect any incoming attacks.

entry: POKENAME用白色肠管作饵，猎物靠得太近，就会被吸进嘴里。身体必须始终保湿，否则萎缩，因此能在沼泽生活得很好。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME lures its prey with its white intestine, which it can use as bait, and when they get too close, it sucks them into its mouth. Its body needs to stay constantly hydrated or it will wither, which is why it thrives in marshy areas.

entry: POKENAME用白色肠管作饵，猎物靠得太近，就会被吸进嘴里。身体必须始终保湿，否则萎缩，因此能在沼泽生活得很好。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME lures its prey with its white intestine, which it can use as bait, and when they get too close, it sucks them into its mouth. Its body needs to stay constantly hydrated or it will wither, which is why it thrives in marshy areas.

entry: POKENAME露出有毒内脏，像灵巧触手般爬行，探索礁石环境。大型海水水族箱常至少养一只，吃碎屑，保持环境清洁。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME explores its reef environment by exposing its toxic innards as dextrous tentacles with which to crawl. Large saltwater aquariums often house at least one since it feeds on detritus and keeps the habitat clean.

entry: POKENAME喷出内脏，形成触手团缠住食物。再迅速收回，保护器官，同时闪动伞状身体上的光球示警。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME spews its organs out of its body as a mass of tentacles to ensnare food. It quickly retracts the organs to protect them while flashing the orbs on its bell as a warning.

entry: POKENAME很难游泳，便靠手在海床爬。脸上总是愤怒的表情，并非装出来的，容易突然暴躁，用拳头破坏珊瑚礁。
author: karmaofevil
source: Its hard for POKENAME to swim, so they crawl on the sea floor using their hands. The seemingly constant anger on their face is genuine, and they're prone to destructive outbursts, destroying coral reefs with their punches.

entry: POKENAME鬃毛、尾巴与蹄上毛束，都由与胃肠一样的膜构成。疾驰之处，空气中会弥漫腐烂海藻的臭味。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's mane, tail, and fetlocks are made of the same membranes as its stomach and intestines. Wherever it gallops, the stench of rotten seaweed fills the air.

entry: 它把内脏抛进水中，等猎物咬钩。无论嘴里还是尾尖，都能将内脏放出去。
author: staghorn
source: It catches prey by casting its innards into the water and waiting for a bite. It can expel its guts both from its mouth and the tip of its tail.

entry: POKENAME尾部内脏滴出的黏液，被用于生产防晒品。虽很有用，臭味却也出了名。
author: .izik
source: Mucus dripping from the innards on POKENAME's tail is used in sunblock production. Despite its usefulness, it has a notoriously foul odor.

entry: POKENAME外伸的内脏像两颗头，各有眼睛警戒危险。靠它们监视四周，本体可以保持不动。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's extended innards resemble two heads, each with eyes that scan for danger. It uses these to monitor surroundings while remaining motionless.

entry: POKENAME反复伸缩橡胶般的内脏，殴打对手。不战斗时，会把内脏在额头上弹来弹去，自娱自乐。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME repeatedly extend and retract their rubbery insides to pummel their opponents. Outside of battle, they will entertain themselves by bouncing their innards against their foreheads.

entry: POKENAME以大舌贝为食，用浓稠白色黏液溶穿贝壳。酸性被中和后，黏液又是极好的防晒替代品。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME feed on Shellder, using their thick white mucus to dissolve right through their shells. When the acid is neutralized, the mucus can be used as a fantastic sunscreen alternative.

entry: POKENAME的体表膜，让它能吃下刺甲贝等最坚韧的猎物。它爬船壳吃海生附着物，却会连钢制集装箱船的外壳也腐蚀穿，给船带来麻烦。
author: pjporwoll
source: The film covering POKENAME allows it to devour even the toughest prey, such as Cloyster. It can cause issues for boats as it will crawl along their hulls to eat the marine growth, but the film corrodes through the hulls of even steel container ships.

entry: POKENAME能用炮口以超过每秒160英尺的速度射出内脏。器官弹性极强，因此完全不会受伤。
author: vibrationjaveline
source: POKENAME can eject its internal organs from its cannons at upwards of 160 feet per second. Its organs are so elastic that this does not hurt it whatsoever.

entry: POKENAME用能伸长的敏感舌头，既感知四周，也抓海草吃。唾液已被证实有出色的抗炎效果。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME uses its stretchy, sensitive tongue to both keep track of its surroundings and to grab sea grass to eat. Its saliva has been proven to be great at treating inflammation.

entry: 被POKENAME的手碰到，会患重病，而那其实是吐出体外的部分内脏。有些人说，是手指产生毒素，也有人说是它施下幽灵诅咒。
author: sk372
source: Those touched by POKENAME's hand, which are actually some of its innards expelled outward, will fall greatly ill. Some say this is due to poison generated by its fingers; others say it is a ghostly curse POKENAME inflicts.

entry: POKENAME甲壳虽硬，内里却极脆弱，因此尽量避战。它以强钳抓鱼，再撕成适合一口吃下的小块。
author: mistymagius
source: Despite its tough carapace, POKENAME's insides are incredibly delicate, so it tries to avoid fights as much as it can. It grabs fish with its powerful pinchers and then rips them into bite-sized pieces.

entry: POKENAME外骨骼的裂缝能喷出内脏，用作抓握附肢，抓到食物便能开始消化。肉是阿罗拉美食，取得却危险，因为会遭到粉碎力惊人的钳子反击。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME's exoskeleton has cracks where it expels its internal organs as grasping appendages, allowing it to digest food upon grabbing it. Its meat is an Alolan delicacy, but dangerous to obtain as POKENAME will fight back with its pulverizing claw.

entry: 训练家与学生日常都会带着POKENAME，只为帮忙拿、带钥匙。得到陪伴时，它生活得格外好，渐渐与主人结下亲密羁绊。
author: plkfsa32
source: Trainers and students alike bring POKENAME with them on everyday tasks, simply to hold or carry keys. This Pokémon thrives when accompanied, gradually forming a close bond with its owner.

entry: POKENAME能产生丝纤维。若转动额头的钥匙上发条，就会在数小时内，慢慢产出几磅金属丝。
author: pkbonusducks
source: While they can create silk fiber, winding up the key on POKENAME's forehead allows them to slowly produce several pounds of metal strands over the course of a few hours.

entry: POKENAME将找到的骨头塞进钥匙孔状的嘴，磨成钥匙形。任何骨头，不先这样改造，就坚决不当作武器。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME sticks bones it finds into the keyhole shape of its mouth, grinding them down into the shape of a key. It actively refuses to use any bone as a weapon without reshaping it this way first.

entry: POKENAME收集钥匙，直到每个环都挂上一把。配齐后，会开心地从脸喷烟，气味像铁锈、铜和其他金属。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME gathers up keys until it has attached one to each of its rings. When fully equipped, it lets out fumes from its face in joy. This smoke smells of rust, copper and other metals.

entry: POKENAME用钢纤维围住一把大钥匙结茧，进化或解除融合前都无法取出。有些训练家直接把它挂在腰带上，照样能使用钥匙。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME forms its cocoon of steel fibers around a single large key. It is impossible to remove this key until POKENAME either evolves or unfuses, so some Trainers simply hang POKENAME from their belt so that they can still use the key.

entry: POKENAME收集锁链绕身，保护脆弱身体。但没有手帮忙，有时会不慎把自己锁在物品上。
author: hophoppip
source: To protect its vulnerable body, POKENAME gathers chains to wrap itself in. It does so without hands, so sometimes accidentally chains itself to an object.

entry: POKENAME遇险会猛烈拍翼，发出一阵阵叮当声，扰乱敌人。更爱收小钥匙，因为大钥匙会妨碍飞行。
author: kam_doodle_snek
source: If threatened, POKENAME flaps its wings violently, creating bursts of jingles to disorient foes. It prefers collecting small keys, as larger ones make it more difficult to fly.

entry: POKENAME能造出小型隐形保险箱，几乎任何工具都破坏不了，破解也极复杂。越来越受博物馆管理员欢迎。
author: epping_forest
source: POKENAME can create a small invisible strongbox, almost unbreakable by any tool and extremely complicated to solve and breach. Its popularity among museum keepers is on the rise.

entry: POKENAME主要住城市水道，寻找新钥匙挂在口须上。它拖着钥匙搅起底泥，发现久埋的金属。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME lives primarily in urban waterways where it can find new keys to attach to its barbels. It drags its keys in the sediment to kick up silt and discover long buried metals.

entry: POKENAME吞下找到的所有钥匙，囤在体内，却吐不回来。若想取回被偷的东西，就得伸手进喉咙捞出来。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME swallows up any keys it finds and stockpiles them within. It cannot spit them back out, so to recover a stolen item, one must reach down its gullet and fish it out by hand.

entry: 人们常指责POKENAME偷钥匙，其实只是用可塑身体模仿形状。可惜细节出错，复制品都不能替代遗失的原钥匙。
author: sk372
source: People often accuse POKENAME of stealing their keys, but it only uses its malleable body to mimic their shapes. Unfortunately, it gets the finer details wrong, so none of its imitations work as substitutes for the missing keys.

entry: 许多地区禁止拥有POKENAME，或对此严加限制。因为它能绕过文件的密码、锁定，让许多人借此不付费玩游戏。
author: sk372
source: In many regions, owning POKENAME is illegal or highly regulated. This is due to its ability to bypass passwords and locks on files, letting many use it to play video games without purchasing them.

entry: POKENAME爱偷随处放着的钥匙，插进壳里，仿佛想开锁。因此流传着打开外壳便能进化的传闻。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME have a penchant for stealing keys left lying around. POKENAME put these keys in their shell as if to unlock it, sparking a popular rumor that by unlocking the shell, POKENAME could evolve.

entry: POKENAME挂在能找到的任何环状物上，等候进化。偶尔，甚至挂在钥圈儿的环上。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME hang from any ring-shaped object they can find to await evolution. Occasionally, some can be found hanging from a Klefki's ring.

entry: POKENAME相当好斗，想用满身钥匙刺扎任何靠近家园的东西。幸好钥匙不锋利，攻击比起伤人，更像惹麻烦。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is quite aggressive, aiming to stab at anything that nears its home with the many keys on its body. Fortunately these keys are not sharp, so its attempted attacks are more of a nuisance than harmful.

entry: POKENAME是恶名昭彰的捣蛋鬼，爱收钥匙，连正在使用的也会拿走。它太难寻找，钥匙可失踪多年，才有可能再现。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are infamous tricksters that love to collect keys, even ones that were in use at the time of acquisition. They tend to be so elusive that these keys will be lost for years before they might turn up again.

entry: POKENAME爱闪亮物品，尤其遗失钥匙，会涂一层奇特的膜，帮助保存。兴奋时，看似发条钥匙的器官便开始旋转。
author: bobosmith01
source: It loves collecting shiny things, especially lost keys. It coats these collected objects in an odd film to help preserve them. When POKENAME is excited, the organ that appears to be a windup key starts to spin.

entry: POKENAME织出坚如钢铁的蛛网，保护钥匙收藏。网常用于独特工具、科技的开发，但受威胁就分泌毒素，使收集非常困难。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: POKENAME will create webs as strong as steel to protect their collection of keys. These webs are often used to produce unique tools and technologies, however collecting them is difficult due to the poison POKENAME secrete when feeling threatened.

entry: POKENAME的喙像一把会变化的钥匙。它窥视过去，研究旧锁，精准模仿遗失的钥匙。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's beak resembles a changing key. It peers into the past to study old locks, mimicking lost keys with perfect accuracy.

entry: POKENAME收集钥匙，挂在金属尾巴。收得越多，能存的电也越多。任何试图偷走收藏的对象，都会遭到强烈电击。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME collects keys and hangs them from its metal tail. The more keys it gathers, the more electricity it can store. Anyone who tries to steal POKENAME's collection gets a nasty shock.

entry: POKENAME轻轻悬在仓库附近，头上钥匙随微风轻响，让其他生灵注意到它的存在。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME hovers gently near warehouses. The keys on its head jingle faintly in the breeze, alerting others to its presence.

entry: POKENAME浮在谷仓旁静等。农民开锁时，就会落下抢走钥匙，消失在云中。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME floats near barns, waiting silently. As farmers unlock doors, it drops down to snatch their keys and vanishes into the clouds.

entry: POKENAME多住城市，容易从不留意的训练家那里偷钥匙、闪亮钥匙扣。但会避开大型蓬松球状钥匙扣，研究者还不明白原因。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: Most POKENAME live in city environments where they are more easily able to steal keys and sparkly keychains from unobservant Trainers. They tend to avoid large, puffy ball-shaped keychains, and researchers are unsure why.

entry: POKENAME飞过城市，以长尾抓走散落钥匙，主人还没发现遗失，就已被带走。尾巴叮当轻响，反在逃跑时暴露位置。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME fly through cities and grab stray keys with their long tails, whisking them away before their owners even realize they're missing. Their tails jingle as they trail behind them, the whimsical noise giving away their location as they flee.

entry: POKENAME极好奇、有洞察，想了解尽可能多的秘密。一旦看上某把锁，就试着找能打开的钥匙，只为帮助发现新事物。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are extremely curious and insightful, trying to understand as many secrets as possible. Once they set their sights on a lock, they will try and find the key that can open it, simply wanting to help find new discoveries.

entry: POKENAME极忠于训练家，若对方送它钥匙留着，更是如此。钥匙中的金属离子增强精神力量，让它预判来袭攻击。
author: loverbesm
source: POKENAME is extremely loyal to its Trainer, especially if its Trainer gives it a key for them to keep. POKENAME enhances its psychic powers through the metal ions in keys which allows it to predict oncoming attacks.

entry: POKENAME潜在店后的巷子里，店主锁门就会俯冲，偷走钥匙，当作珍贵战利品。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME lurks in alleyways behind shops. When owners lock up, it swoops down to steal their keys as treasured trophies.

entry: POKENAME翻找五金店垃圾箱，吃有缺陷的钥匙。找到喜欢的一把，就会骄傲地挂在尾上。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME rummages through hardware store dumpsters, eating faulty keys. If it finds one it likes, it proudly hangs it from its tail.

entry: POKENAME爱捉弄人，把人锁在房间里或外面。随身那把钥匙，不论锁多复杂都能开。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME love to play tricks on people, locking them in or out of rooms. The key they carry works on any lock, no matter how complex.

entry: POKENAME平时平静，少因其他生灵在场而烦恼。但无论尾巴上的镜子，还是其他反光面，只要看见自己倒影，就会慌乱，原因不明。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's behavior is typically placid, rarely bothered by the presence of others. Should it spy its reflection, whether on the mirror on its tail or any reflective surface, it flies into a panic for unknown reasons.

entry: POKENAME如圆盘般旋转，飞过仓库区上空。俯冲路线飘忽，既躲捕捉，也抓闪亮物品。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spins like a disc while soaring over warehouse districts. It dives erratically to avoid capture and snag shiny objects.

entry: POKENAME虽友善，却较疏远其他宝可梦，更偏爱训练家。奇怪的是，钥匙最适合各种街机的锁。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME, while friendly, tend to be distant from other Pokémon, preferring their Trainers. Strangely, their keys tend to fit best in the locks of various arcade machines.

entry: 特殊饮食让POKENAME被废料场的零散金属吸引。它常将钥匙囤在毛发里。
author: ohok3441
source: Thanks to their strange diet, POKENAME are attracted to scrapyards for loose metal. They tend to hoard keys in their fur.

entry: POKENAME身上的钥匙，据说能开古老地下神庙。挖掘时，环绕身体的圆环旋转，松动矿藏，便于吞食。
author: santon5512
source: The keys on POKENAME's bodies are said to open ancient underground temples. The ring around their bodies spins as they dig, loosening mineral deposits for them to eat.

entry: POKENAME翅膀形如锯齿钥匙，快速突袭猎物，金属斩击留下深伤。
author: .izik
source: With wings shaped like jagged keys, POKENAME strikes prey in quick, darting bursts. Its metallic slashes leave deep cuts.

entry: POKENAME闯进市长办公室，偷走作为奖赏的巨型“城市之钥”。真要进门，却不用钥匙，只会砸穿所有挡路之门。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME are known to break into mayoral offices to steal their giant "key to the city" awards. Instead of actually using the keys to open doors, they simply smash through any door in their way instead.

entry: POKENAME痴迷收集钥匙，会用尽办法取得。它极爱护收藏，放在硬如岩石的壳中，防备黑暗鸦等窃贼。
author: mcnchsschl
source: POKENAME loves collecting keys and will go to extreme lengths to obtain them. It is so protective of its keys, it stores them in its rock-hard shell to protect them from thieves like Murkrow.

entry: POKENAME见到什么宝箱，都爱偷走。用尾上钥匙尝试打开，取得财宝；开不了，就会愤怒地丢掉整只箱子。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are prone to stealing any and all treasure chests they come across. Using the keys on their tail, they attempt to break in for the treasures inside. If they cannot open it, they throw the entire chest away in anger.

entry: POKENAME身体始终灼热得发白光。头上的钥匙热得短短几秒便能熔穿钛金属。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body glows white-hot at all times. Its head-mounted keys burn hot enough to melt through titanium in mere seconds.

entry: POKENAME爱在环上收集钥匙，偶尔熔掉并非最喜爱的，再吸收熔化的钥匙，保持供能与健康。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME enjoys collecting keys on its ring, occasionally melting any that aren't its favorite. It absorbs the melted keys, keeping its body fueled and healthy.

entry: POKENAME收集找到的所有钥匙，与身体的金属结合固定。主人要开锁，只能带着它一起，似乎令它十分开心。
author: hophoppip
source: It collects any keys it finds, sticking them to its body by binding with the metal. This forces the keys' owners to carry POKENAME around when they need to unlock something, which POKENAME seems to enjoy greatly.

entry: 卡洛斯一些鲜有记载的民间传说，会提到神秘的POKENAME。故事里，每把钥匙都能打开通向冥界不同层级的门。
author: sk372
source: A strange and enigmatic being, POKENAME appears in rarely-documented Kalosian folklore. In these tales, it is said that each of its keys opens a doorway to different levels of the underworld.

entry: 它的钥匙无法打开任何门：太长、太重，形状也别扭，作为钥匙并不实用。但用来把大舌贝从贝壳里舀出来，却再合适不过。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Its key is unable to unlock any door. It is too long, weighty, and awkwardly shaped to be a useful key. However, it is perfect for scooping Shellder out of their shells.

entry: POKENAME的钥状附肢提供极佳抓地力，能轻松沿垂直崖壁直直滚上去。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's key-like appendages grant it exceptional traction. It can roll straight up vertical cliff walls with ease.

entry: POKENAME帮助人们生成、储存其他网站与应用的密码。作为密码管家，对保护训练家的信息很重要。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME help people generate and store passwords for other websites and applications. As a password manager, POKENAME provide a vital role in securing information for their Trainer.

entry: POKENAME喜欢挑战，到处找对手战斗，尤其带着钥匙的对象。赢了便偷走钥匙，加进日益壮大的收藏。
author: shyguy11011
source: POKENAME thrives on a challenge, seeking out anyone to battle, especially those carrying keys. If victorious, it will steal the keys from its opponent and add them to its growing collection.

entry: 锁匠有时用POKENAME协助打开顽固的锁。改变身上图案与尾部钥匙，就能显示锁的类型、内部弹子配置。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are sometimes used by locksmiths to assist in opening up stubborn locks. By changing their pattern and the keys on their tail, they can show the type of lock and the pin configuration inside.

entry: 钥匙状的尾巴让POKENAME更善于控制电力。它能汇聚等离子体般的雷霆，将敌人劈开。
author: thunderjimmy
source: POKENAME has greater control over electricity because of its key-shaped tail; POKENAME can channel plasma-like thunder to cleave its enemies asunder.

entry: 传说，得到POKENAME翅膀上的钥匙，就能开启永恒快乐。除神话外没有证据，但脱落钥匙常被制成护符，高价出售。
author: quantumradiation
source: It is said that those who receive a key from POKENAME's wings will be able to unlock eternal joy. There exists no evidence for this beyond myths, but the cast-off keys of POKENAME are often fashioned into talismans and are sold at high prices.

entry: POKENAME尾上的大钥匙，各个体形状稍异，偶尔会互换。它逢锁就试，却从没打开过，因此十分苦恼。
author: quantumradiation
source: The large key on POKENAME's tail varies slightly in shape among individuals, and it may occasionally swap its key for another's. It tries its key on every lock it comes across, but it never unlocks anything, which can lead to it becoming distressed.

entry: POKENAME擅长找遗失钥匙，也很会找训练家的其他失物。许多个体能受训将物品放回原处，帮助整理。
author: quackquackattack
source: While POKENAME specialize in finding lost keys, they are also quite handy at finding anything their Trainer loses. Many can be trained to return items to where they belong to help their Trainer with organization.

entry: POKENAME跟锁匠学习开锁，最擅长通过模仿学习，因此许多锁匠会让它练习其他门锁，提升技术。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME work alongside locksmiths to learn how to open locked doors. They often learn best through mimicry, so many locksmiths have them practice on other doors to improve their skills.

entry: 尾巴带着几把钥匙，却没有一把适合腹部的钥匙孔。谁未经允许取钥匙，就会遭到电击。
author: cait_sith
source: It carries several keys on its tail, but none of them fit the keyhole on its belly. Anyone who tries to take a key without permission will be shocked.

entry: 自从第一次野外目击POKENAME，故事就低声流传。有人相信，它们是阴暗念头化成的实体。
author: ohok3441
source: From the first instance of a POKENAME being seen in the wild, stories about them have been shared through whispers. Some believe they are manifestations of dark thoughts taken form.

entry: 进化脱掉束缚的金属壳后，POKENAME成为夜间祸害。任何金属物品，都可能被强爪撕碎。
author: ohok3441
source: With their restrictive metal shells shed upon evolution, POKENAME are scourges of the night. Any metal object is at risk of being torn to shreds by their powerful claws.

entry: POKENAME尾上的钥匙虽然是实体，也能将用户锁在电脑系统之外。随后吸收全部密码、登录信息，将它们从系统彻底抹去。
author: soup1900
source: Despite the key on its tail being physical, POKENAME can use it to lock users out of computer systems. Then, it absorbs all the passwords and logins, wiping them from the system entirely.

entry: POKENAME尾上的钥匙虽然是实体，也能将用户锁在电脑系统之外。随后把全部登录信息换成自己不断变化的密码，不侵入破解，就无法访问设备。
author: soup1900
source: Despite the key on its tail being physical, POKENAME can use it to lock users out of computer systems. Afterwards, it replaces all logins with its own changing passwords, making the devices impossible to access without hacking in.

entry: 被信任者转动钥匙时，POKENAME会优雅起舞。模仿它造型的八音盒，是儿童卧室里受欢迎的装饰。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME dances gracefully when its key is turned by someone it trusts. Music boxes made in its image are popular decorations for children's bedrooms.

entry: POKENAME迷恋钥匙，收集找到的弃钥，附在身体上。谁想偷走，就会被困进笼子般的下半身。
author: sk372
source: Enamored with keys, POKENAME collects any discarded ones it finds and attaches them to its body. Trying to pilfer from it will lead to it trapping the would-be thief within its cage-like lower half.

entry: 随身巨钥看似有意识，但POKENAME占有欲狂热，不许靠近检查。只要觉得有人可能拆散它们，就会暴力挥舞钥匙。
author: sk372
source: The giant key it carries appears to be sentient, but POKENAME is fanatically possessive of it and refuses to let anyone get close enough to check. It violently swings the key around if it even thinks someone might separate them.

entry: POKENAME用钥匙碰触锁头，就能神奇地开启或封死，因此常被狱警聘用。狱警若放话要永远扔掉钥匙，那多半是有一只POKENAME在旁待命。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are staffed by prison wardens due to their mystical ability to release or seal any lock they touch with their keys. If a warden ever threatens to throw away the key, it is because they have a POKENAME on standby.

entry: POKENAME每把沉重钥匙都带强磁性。将其刺进地面扭转，就能以自身为中心引发强震，撕裂大地。
author: sk372
source: Each of POKENAME's heavy keys carries strong magnetic charges within. By piercing them into the ground and twisting, it can create powerful earthquakes centered around itself that tear the ground asunder.

entry: POKENAME能钻进细小缝隙，从而打开任何锁。解开挂锁后，还会整个吞下。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME can enter small crevices, allowing it to open any locks. Upon unlocking a padlock, POKENAME will devour it whole.

entry: POKENAME能以波导创造可用的钥匙。道德感极强，绝不用于偷窃等非法手段，只会在必要的紧急情况使用。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has the unique ability to create functioning keys out of its aura. It has a strong sense of morals, so these keys will never be used for illicit means like thievery, only for necessary emergencies.

entry: 古文化会向POKENAME献钥，相信能为家族血脉赐福。目击者说，它在天空疾驰，一路不停叮当作响。
author: .izik
source: Ancient cultures offered keys to POKENAME, believing it would bless family bloodlines with luck. Witnesses describe it galloping across the sky while producing constant jingling sounds.

entry: POKENAME将钥匙加热到极高温，再挥舞作武器。它以灼热打击袭向入侵者，凶悍守护家园。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME superheats its key before swinging it as a weapon. It fiercely defends its home by striking intruders with searing blows.

entry: POKENAME用头部突起闯进奶酪店，尽可能偷奶酪。常与拉达合伙，若没被抓住，就能一起搬空整家店。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Using the protrusion on their head, POKENAME break into fromageries to steal as much cheese as possible. They often work with Raticate, able to clear out a whole store together if not caught.

entry: POKENAME清晨游荡港口城镇，寻找钥匙吃。见到人手里有，就会喷大股水流将其打倒，抢走钥匙。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME wanders port towns during early mornings in search of keys to consume. Should it spot one in someone's hand, it unleashes torrents of water to knock them over and steal it.

entry: 不知为何，POKENAME鼻子始终指向最近的钥匙，它便顺着去收集。身体两侧如白垩，容易留下压痕，会把钥匙按入，制成模具。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Somehow POKENAME's nose is always pointing to the nearest key, which it follows in order to collect them. The sides of POKENAME's body are chalky and impressionable. It forms key-shaped molds by inserting keys it finds into its sides.

entry: POKENAME把刀刃变作钥匙，潜入屋内，再变回利刃，夺取住户的生命力。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME morphs its blade into a key to break into buildings and back into a blade to claim the life force of its dwellers.

entry: POKENAME钥形刀刃利如剃刀，能轻松切过实心铁材，刃口也不会变钝。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's key-shaped blades are razor sharp. It can easily slice through solid iron without dulling its edge.

entry: POKENAME胸甲里有密码保险箱，允许信任的训练家存放贵重物。地方政府开始采取措施，避免它们因箱中财物而遭偷猎。
author: camtft
source: The chest pieces of POKENAME contain a password-locked safe that they allow trusted Trainers to access and use to store valuables. Local governments have begun to take measures to avoid their poaching for the contents of the safe.

entry: POKENAME的钥匙能无害地插入其他生灵体内，但只对喜欢的对象这样做。据说能打开心扉，因为被触及者随后会有更强烈的情绪反应。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's keys can harmlessly insert into others, though it only does this toward those it likes. It is said that doing so unlocks a person's heart, as those touched this way become more emotional afterward.

entry: POKENAME以庞大力量创造钥匙般的构造，能在空中打开跨越空间的门。任何烦扰它的东西，都可能瞬间被强制传到遥远地方。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses its vast power to create key-like constructs that can open a doorway through space in the air. Anything that bothers it risks being forcefully teleported vast distances in an instant.

entry: 有些诊所让POKENAME帮助因怕丢重要物品而紧张的训练家。它爱吃这些噩梦，作为交换，送上愉快的梦。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Some clinics have POKENAME assist Trainers who become stressed out over the fear of misplacing important objects. POKENAME enjoy consuming these nightmares, and will give the Trainer pleasant dreams in exchange.

entry: POKENAME一生不断积累新钥匙，帮助适应战斗。将不同钥匙插入炮的背部、转动，就能切换发射的元素能量。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME amasses new keys over its lifetime that help it adapt in battle. Inserting a different key into the back of its cannon and turning swaps the elemental energy the cannon fires.

entry: POKENAME把弃钥吸进胶状身体，经钥匙传导精神力量，打开小型传送门，让自己与其他对象瞬移到新地点。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME absorbs discarded keys into its gelatinous body, channeling its psychic power through them. Doing so allows it to use the keys to open small portals that let it teleport itself and others to new locations.

entry: POKENAME被机器吸引，休息时会用末端如钥匙的触须，将自己嵌进机器中。每只的钥匙与齿形都独一无二，留下的槽痕绝不相同。
author: sk372
source: Attracted to machinery, POKENAME uses its key-ended tendrils to embed itself into the machines when at rest. Every member of the species has a unique set of keys and teeth, so no two will leave behind the same grooves.

entry: POKENAME头顶钥匙夜间发光。它站在农场附近围栏上，照亮黑暗，吓退盗贼。
author: .izik
source: The key atop POKENAME's head glows at night. It stands on fences near farms, illuminating the dark and warding off thieves.

entry: POKENAME火焰攻击前，钥匙会亮起，反映即将使用的热量。鲜有人活着见到它们全部同时发光的那一刻。
author: .izik
source: Before unleashing a fiery attack, POKENAME's keys begin to glow as a measure of the heat it will use. Few have lived to witness the moment all of them glow at once.

entry: POKENAME四把锁各存一个招式，用头上钥匙打开时，会以奇怪方式从中释放。第五个无锁钥匙孔里，则存着紧急用的瞬间移动，战败时可借此逃走。
author: thordemidgard
source: A POKENAME's four locks hold each one of its moves, which are released from inside in strange ways when it opens them using its head key. The fifth, lockless keyhole contains an emergency Teleport to escape if it is defeated in battle.

entry: 与它伪装的宝可梦不同，POKENAME毫不挑剔，什么钥匙都收集。但若把钥匙插进它的布衣，就会惹得它勃然大怒。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: Unlike the Pokémon it's disguised as, POKENAME lacks discernment and collects any and all keys. Inserting a key into into its cloth angers it greatly.

entry: POKENAME战时点燃许多翅膀，火焰变成两倍大，呈燃烧钥匙的形状。翼中的钥匙无法取下，任何尝试都会招来暴力反应。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME ignites its many wings in battle, the flames burning twice the size and taking the form of flaming keys. The keys within its wings cannot be removed, and POKENAME responds violently to any attempts to do so.

entry: 它是珍贵钥匙的完美守卫，前提是你不想再拿回来！卡洛斯一则鲜为人知的童话里，英雄曾骗一只粗暴的POKENAME，让它看守解开自身枷锁的钥匙。
author: wormspawn
source: The perfect protector for precious keys - as long as you don't want them back! An obscure Kalosian fairy tale tells of a hero who tricked a brutish POKENAME into guarding the key to its own shackles.

entry: 阴森容貌与钥匙叮当声，常把人吓跑。近期研究才发现，摇钥匙是在表示喜爱或感激。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Its haunting visage mixed with the jangling of its keys often scares people away. Recent research has revealed that it shakes its keys to show fondness or appreciation.

entry: POKENAME能从身体造出任意形状的钥匙。火箭队等强大犯罪组织争相寻求，想借钥匙进入任何建筑。
author: mrpimbus
source: POKENAME can create a key in any shape it desires out of its body. It's sought after by powerful crime organizations like Team Rocket as a way to get into any building using its keys.

entry: POKENAME锋利的钥状触角，能轻易切开土壤。它钻到地下，埋藏或取回小饰品。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's sharp, key-like antennae can cut through soil with ease. It tunnels underground to bury or retrieve hidden trinkets.

entry: POKENAME重塑钥匙般的手臂，能打开几乎任何锁。它把偷来的挂锁存进溪边小屋，当作宝物珍藏。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME can reshape its key-like arms to unlock almost any lock. It stores stolen padlocks at its creek-side lodge as treasured prizes.

entry: POKENAME准备攻击时，尾部钥匙迅速旋转。转得越快，接下来的电能冲击就越强。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's tail key spins rapidly when it's ready to strike. The faster it spins, the more powerful the coming electric blast.

entry: POKENAME唱歌时，背上的钥匙也会旋转。没有两只会唱同一首歌，旋律在仿佛中空的身体里回荡。
author: santon5512
source: The key on a POKENAME's back spins as it sings. No two POKENAME will play the same song, their melodies echoing inside their seemingly hollow bodies.

entry: POKENAME飘过城市，寻找金属小饰品吃。闭嘴啃钥匙时，双颚常锁在一起，只好找更多钥匙，重新解锁。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME float through cities in search of metal trinkets to feed on. Their jaws often get locked together when they close to gnaw on keys, causing POKENAME to seek out more keys to unlock them once more.

entry: POKENAME吃金属，在全身长出新的钥状突起。移动时，这些钥匙就不断哗啦作响。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME consumes metal to grow new key-like protrusions across its body. These keys rattle constantly as it moves.

entry: POKENAME被旧金库、遗忘的保险箱吸引，被认为是遗失秘密的守护者。锁匠开始用它工作，盼能打开被认为无法撬开的保险箱。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME is attracted to old vaults and forgotten safes, believed to be the guardian of lost secrets. Locksmiths have begun to use POKENAME in their work, hoping it will unlock safes thought to be unpickable.

entry: POKENAME天性内向，常将末端燃火的尾巴收近，从暖意中获得安慰。训练家发现，钥匙叮当声也能安抚它的紧张。
author: sk372
source: Introverted by nature, POKENAME often holds its flame-tipped tail close, seeking comfort in the warmth it provides. Trainers have found the sound of jingling keys can also help soothe its nerves.

entry: POKENAME能用脚从地里吸收铁。蹦跳时，随身钥匙叮当作响。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME can absorb iron from the ground with its feet. The keys it carries jingle when it skips about.

entry: POKENAME飘过废弃仓库，悬在身上的钥匙微微叮响，让其他生灵注意到它的存在。
author: .izik
source: As POKENAME floats through abandoned warehouses, the key dangling from its body jingles faintly, alerting others to its presence.

entry: POKENAME夜间飞行，让尾上钥匙互碰作响，用于回声定位。它在锁着的房间筑巢，因此钥匙丢失时，不妨找找它的窝。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME fly in the darkness of night, jingling the keys on their tails together to make noise for echolocation. They make their perch within locked rooms, so it is advised to look for POKENAME nests if your keys are missing.

entry: POKENAME吃金属离子，转成电力。体型小，方便摄影师随身带着，在出行时为设备充电。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME consumes metal ions and converts them into electricity. Its small size makes it a useful companion for photographers, allowing them to charge their equipment on the go.

entry: 随着年龄增长，POKENAME身上钥匙般的结构会越长越长。奇怪的是，即使身处火山高热中，它们也不会熔化。
author: .izik
source: As it ages, the key-like structures on POKENAME's body grow longer. Strangely, they remain unmelted even in volcanic heat.

entry: 飞行时，POKENAME将钥匙相互碰撞，发出刺耳声音。这些尖锐的高音，会让附近的敌人与猎物都失去方向。
author: .izik
source: While flying, POKENAME clashes its keys together to create piercing sounds. These high-pitched noises disorient nearby foes and prey alike.

entry: POKENAME帮助锁匠，为被锁在家门外的人开门。它们顽皮，爱藏开门工具，却总会赶在训练家生气前归还。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME helps locksmiths open doors for people locked out of their homes. They are mischievous Pokémon that like to hide tools for opening doors but always return them before their Trainer gets angry.

entry: 战斗中，POKENAME钥匙般的尾巴叮当作响。用力咬住敌人时，声音会更响。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's key-like tail jingles loudly during battle. The sound intensifies while it bites down hard on a foe.

entry: POKENAME在垃圾堆里搜集所有能找到的金属碎片，存进体内，再产生强酸将金属溶解，把混合物塑成临时钥匙。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME gathers any metal scraps it can find in piles of rubbish, storing them in its body. It then produces a strong acid to melt the metal down, shaping the mixture into makeshift keys.

entry: POKENAME的身体全由钥匙构成。它在城市横冲直撞时，后面便会聚起大群愤怒的失窃者。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's body is made entirely of keys. When a POKENAME runs rampant through a city, angry mobs of robbed humans form behind it.

entry: POKENAME主要吃各种金属合金，常漂在废品场里寻找最爱的点心——钥匙。
author: ayner
source: The diet of POKENAME is primarily composed of diverse metal alloys. They roam around junkyards, floating in search of keys, their favorite snack.

entry: POKENAME将钥匙状鼻子旋成钻头，凿穿船身，再耐心守候，击倒任何试图游走逃生的生灵。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spins its keylike nose like a drill to breach ship hulls. It then waits patiently, striking down any swimmers who attempt to escape.

entry: 它们爱收集遗失的钥匙，藏在翅膀里。遇上亲近的人或宝可梦，就会骄傲地展示藏品。
author: mr.person__prinplup_enjoyer
source: These Pokémon like to collect lost keys and store them in their wings. They proudly present their collection to Pokémon or humans they are close to.

entry: 钥匙丢了，说不定是野生POKENAME悄悄偷走了。为了这些宝贝，它们有时还会与乌鸦头头决斗。
author: mr.person__prinplup_enjoyer
source: If you lose one of your keys, there's a chance a wild POKENAME has stolen it without you noticing. They sometimes duel Honchkrow over these items.

entry: POKENAME啃咬废金属做成钥匙，潜入保护区或餐馆偷鱼吃。制作前会将触手探入锁孔，摸清所需的准确形状。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME gnaw at scrap metal, creating keys that help them infiltrate reserves or restaurants to steal fish for their next meal. They slip their tentacles into locks to determine the exact shapes the keys need to be.

entry: POKENAME无私勇敢，常在大都市中帮助别人。民间传说，它收集的钥匙都是受助者赠予的，寓意着“成功的钥匙”。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are very altruistic and heroic, frequently doing favors for people in metropolitan areas. Folktales suggest that the keys they gather were given to them by people they've helped in the past, claiming them to be the key to their success.

entry: POKENAME的四肢平常被锁链束缚，极度好斗、陷入狂怒时，却可能挣断枷锁。到了第二天早晨，锁链总会神秘地恢复，再次缚住它。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's limbs are normally chained, but in moments of heightened aggression it may shatter the bindings as it goes into a rage. The chain will always mysteriously repair itself and bind POKENAME again by the next morning.

entry: POKENAME极度执着于随身的钥匙，唯恐被夺走，谁靠近都会遭它猛烈攻击。有人认为，钥匙本身也有意识，但尚未证实。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has an extremely strong fixation on the key it carries and reacts violently to any who approach it for fear of it being taken. Some believe the key itself is sentient as well, though this is as of yet unconfirmed.

entry: POKENAME生活在沉没的战舰附近，尾巴上的钥匙会渐渐变形。待得越久，就越能契合舰上生锈的门锁。
author: .izik
source: Living near sunken battleships, POKENAME's tail key gradually reshapes itself. The longer it stays, the better it fits the ship's rusted doors.

entry: POKENAME收集钥匙，却很少长期留着某一把。换成新钥匙时，它会在旧钥匙上留下孢子，将携带的真菌尽可能传播到更多锁孔。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME collects keys, but rarely holds onto any for long. When it swaps them out for new ones it leaves behind spores on the keys, spreading the fungus it carries to as many keyholes as it can.

entry: 过热时，POKENAME背上挂锁般的结构会飞快旋转。它便潜入水中降温，避免受损。
author: .izik
source: The padlock-like structure on POKENAME's back spins rapidly when overheated. It submerges itself in water to cool down and avoid damage.

entry: 旅人丢了钥匙，常怪到POKENAME头上，哪怕并非它的错。它受钥匙上残留的人类情绪的甜味吸引，将其藏在棉絮般的身体里。
author: ambrosia04
source: Travelers who lose their keys often blame it on POKENAME, even when it's not POKENAME's fault. It hides them in its cottony body, drawn to the lingering sweetness of human emotions.

entry: POKENAME的钥匙能脱离环圈，像微型太阳系一样环绕它运转。身体居中，钥匙绕行，留下明亮闪烁的光迹。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's keys can detach from its ring and orbit around it like a miniature solar system. The keys leave a bright and sparkling trail as they spin around the body at the center.

entry: 传说，将POKENAME贴在爱慕你的人胸前，就能“解锁”对方隐藏的心意。但这从未被证实有效。
author: .izik
source: Legends say pressing POKENAME to your admirer's chest will "unlock" their hidden feelings. This has never been proven to work.

entry: POKENAME把随身的钥匙放在嘴里拧转，让自己冷静。即使如此，它仍很容易发怒，用那把钥匙痛打靠近的任何人。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME twists and turns the key it carries within its mouth to calm itself down. Despite this, it's still quick to turn angry and use said key to batter anybody who comes near it.

entry: POKENAME忠诚可靠，无论如何都会坚决守护训练家的钥匙与贵重物品，包括挖洞将它们埋起来。若被托付重要的钥匙，它们便会自豪地佩戴。
author: calikov
source: POKENAME are loyal and trustworthy creatures who will fiercely protect their Trainer's keys and other valuables no matter what. This includes digging holes to bury them. If given an important key, they wear it proudly.

entry: 旧时，它曾在监狱充当看门犬。现代已不再需要它做这份工作，如今却常能在小镇的汽车旅馆里看见它帮忙。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: In days of old, it would act as a guard dog in prisons. The modern age has rendered its job obsolete, but they can now be found often helping in small-town motels.

entry: POKENAME握着的巨钥，对它们有着只有自己明白的价值。任何想取走钥匙的举动，都会招来一顿暴打。过去，它们因善于守护而备受珍视，富人与王族会将金库、门扉的钥匙托付给它们。
author: chibitales
source: The giant keys POKENAME hold a value only known to them. Any attempt to remove these keys from them ends in a brutal beatdown. They were prized for their protective natures and were given keys to vaults and doors of the rich and royalty in the past.

entry: POKENAME古怪的念动力只对钥匙有效，因此训练家想训练它，总会带着一串钥匙。它的控制极其精准，只要钥匙正确，就能稳稳打开门。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME's odd telekinetic powers are limited to keys, so their Trainers keep a set of keys around when they want to train it. Its powers are so precise that it can reliably open doors with the right key.

entry: 它徒手将原料制成巨大的钥匙，此后便终生用这把钥匙做负重训练。
author: kiwiarms
source: It crafts giant keys out of raw materials using its bare hands, and then weight trains with that key for life.

entry: 它随身带着一把巨钥，作为冒险的武器。有人说，它正寻找一把同样巨大的锁，想将其征服。
author: kiwiarms
source: It carries around an enormous key, wielding it on its adventures. Some say it's searching for an equally massive lock to vanquish.

entry: 受到威胁时，POKENAME将钥匙状肢体相互摩擦，发出烦人的金属声，驱赶捕食者。若敌人仍不放弃，它就用这些肢体劈砍、重击对方。
author: sk372
source: If threatened, POKENAME will scrape its key-like appendages together to make an annoying metal noise to deter predators. If the foe persists, it uses those same limbs in battle to cut and bludgeon its opponent.

entry: 靠近POKENAME时，要留意它的反应：前鳍相拍，表示友好爱玩；尾上钥匙咔嗒碰响，则是警戒与攻击性的信号。
author: sk372
source: When approaching POKENAME, be wary of its reaction: clapping with its front flippers signifies a friendly and playful mood, but the clacking of the keys on its tail is a sign of wariness and aggression.

entry: POKENAME在垃圾场和城市小巷中寻找废钥匙，扩充收藏。觉得不值得留下的，就吃掉，积蓄进化的能量。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME searches garbage dumps and city alleys for discarded keys to add to its collection. It eats the keys it doesn't find worth keeping, building energy for evolution.

entry: POKENAME在垃圾场和城市小巷中寻找废钥匙，扩充收藏。觉得不值得留下的，就吃掉，积蓄进化的能量。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME searches garbage dumps and city alleys for discarded keys to add to its collection. It eats the keys it doesn't find worth keeping, building energy for evolution.

entry: POKENAME不满足于只收集钥匙，还会把有趣的垃圾拼成可操纵的身体部位。可身体腐蚀性太强，它必须不停寻找替代品，维持这座宝库。
author: pjporwoll
source: Not content with only keys, POKENAME collects any trash it finds interesting and builds it into body parts it can manipulate. Its body is so corrosive that POKENAME must continually search to replace this treasure trove.

entry: POKENAME背上伸出的钥匙，虽然大得打不开任何人造锁，它们却常试着插进另一只同类背上的孔。若能契合，双方就会成为一生的朋友。
author: maxissaa
source: While the keys which jut from POKENAME's back are too large to unlock any human-made locks, it is common for POKENAME to attempt to insert their keys into the hole in the back of another POKENAME. If they fit, the two will be lifelong friends.

entry: 由于各个体摄入的矿物量不同，POKENAME身体各节的颜色也因个体而异。它通常很友善，与矿工及其设备互动时都十分轻柔。
author: bobosmith01
source: Each segment of POKENAME's body will be a different color depending on the individual, due to the different amounts of minerals one POKENAME might eat over the other. It is generally friendly and gently interacts with miners and their equipment.

entry: POKENAME收集记忆，常将被催眠者珍爱的念想锁起来，使对方陷入无尽的遐想。
author: spookypookie.
source: POKENAME are collectors of memories, and regularly lock away the cherished thoughts of those they hypnotize, placing them in an endless reverie.

entry: POKENAME钥匙状的腿，让它成为出色的开锁能手。它常在严密看守的财宝堆上爬来爬去，却似乎对这些宝物毫不留恋。
author: hophoppip
source: The key-like shape of its legs makes POKENAME an excellent lockpick. Its often found scuttling over piles of securely guarded valuables, which it seems to have no attachment to.

entry: POKENAME高速振翅时，会放出由细小余烬构成的灼热花粉。它用利爪按住小虫和小鸟，再靠翅膀的热量烤熟猎物。
author: sk372
source: When flapped at high speeds, POKENAME's wings release a burning pollen made of tiny embers. It preys on small insects and birds by pinning them with its talons and cooking them with the heat from its wings.

entry: 虽然有一对翅膀，它却更喜欢留在地上奔跑，朝任何会动的东西冲撞。战斗中，它点燃头上的角，不停猛攻。它与同类成群生活在辽阔平原上。
author: fiordaliso
source: Although it has a pair of wings, it prefers to stay on the ground, running and charging at anything that moves. In battle, it ignites the horns on its head and attacks foes relentlessly. It lives in herds with others of its kind across vast plains.

entry: POKENAME飞过森林寻找树液，飞过花田寻找花粉，沿途从翅膀撒下热粉。自卫时，它们迅速振翅，点燃并撒出更多粉末。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME scatter a hot powder from their wings as they fly through forests and fields of flowers searching for sap and pollen, respectively. To defend themselves, they quickly flutter their wings to ignite and scatter even more of this powder.

entry: 进食时，POKENAME只顾着收集足够进化的能量。若受打扰，它便从翅膀喷出强烈的热浪。
author: mepp.
source: While feeding, POKENAME focuses solely on gathering enough energy to evolve. If disturbed, it releases powerful bursts of heat from its wings.

entry: POKENAME掠过水面的速度极快，连下方的水都会沸腾。它们有时无意间改变河流溪水的流向，因此目击之后，水流往往变幻难测。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: POKENAME will soar over the surface of water with such intense speeds that the water below them will begin to boil. Sightings are frequently followed by unpredictable water currents as they can accidentally alter the flow of rivers and streams.

entry: POKENAME掠过水面的速度极快，连下方的水都会沸腾。它们常快到能推动云层跟随，因此目击之后，往往会有猛烈风暴来临。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: POKENAME will soar over the surface of water with such intense speeds that the water below them will begin to boil. Sightings are frequently followed by heavy storms, as they often move fast enough to shift clouds into following behind them.

entry: POKENAME十分友善，是高空旅行者争相寻找的飞行坐骑。厚实蓬松的毛散发舒适暖意，保护骑乘者免受冰冷山风侵袭。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME is a remarkably friendly Pokémon. It is highly sought after as an aerial mount for high-altitude travel, as the comforting warmth radiating from its thick, fluffy fur protects its rider from the freezing mountain winds.

entry: POKENAME比子弹还快，猎物甚至察觉不到它正在俯冲而来。啼鸣越悦耳，就表示它越饿。
author: beatdoof
source: POKENAME can move faster than a bullet, to the point that its prey doesn't even notice it swooping in for them. The more melodious its chirps, the hungrier it is.

entry: POKENAME将自己半埋在沙里，等待扑向猎物的时机。它用尾羽铲起并加热沙子，再化作灼热的投射物，掷向目标。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME leaves itself half-buried in the sand until it comes time to spring out at prey. Using the feathers on its tail, it scoops and heats up the sand to fling as a fiery projectile at its target.

entry: POKENAME会拼命保护训练家，可也难免误会，连朋友都当成威胁，出言恐吓。
author: weirdtux
source: POKENAME will defend its Trainer ferociously, but this sometimes leads to misunderstandings where it will threaten a friend.

entry: POKENAME的翅膀锋利得能劈开峭岩与悬崖。它们住在最高的山巅，与同类自豪地一同啼鸣，声如战歌。
author: beatdoof
source: POKENAME's wings are sharp enough to slash through crags and cliffs. Living among the highest mountain peaks, it chirps proudly alongside others of its kind, sounding similar to a war anthem.

entry: POKENAME高速飞行，向敌人撒下团团余烬，再折返俯冲，穿入火云。岩石般的外表撞上余烬，使其爆炸，重创对手。
author: chibitales
source: Flying at high speeds, POKENAME showers clouds of embers over its foes and doubles back to dive through the fiery cloud. Its rocky exterior strikes the embers, causing them to explode and inflict major damage on the opponent.

entry: 为证明自己称霸天空，它会与其他鸟类宝可梦正面对撞，以勇鸟猛攻一决高下。获胜后，便用余烬炙烤对手，再以锋利尖牙将其整个吞下。
author: soup1900
source: To prove its unmatched dominance in the sky, it clashes with other bird Pokémon in head-on Brave Bird matches. Once it has won, it sizzles the opponent with embers before devouring them whole with its razor-sharp fangs.

entry: POKENAME伸展身体时，翅膀会迸出火花，点燃干燥灌木，逼出猎物。它快如闪电，转瞬便抓住猎物，带着飞走。
author: pattybgoode
source: As POKENAME stretches, sparks fly from its wings, which catch dry brush alight and flush prey. As fast as a lightning bolt, POKENAME snatches and carries its quarry away.

entry: POKENAME保护欲极强，凶猛地抵御任何可能威胁幼崽的事物。身体虽然笨重庞大，飞行速度却快得惊人。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME are incredibly protective, fiercely defending their young from any potential threat. Despite their heavy, bulky frames, they are capable of flying through the skies at surprisingly high speeds.

entry: POKENAME若足够喜欢一个人，便会送上一根羽毛。这些羽毛永远温暖，而且只有赠予之人握住时，才能感到那份舒适暖意。
author: sk372
source: If POKENAME likes a person enough, it will gift them one of its feathers. These feathers will remain warm for eternity and grant a comforting warmth to that person alone while they hold the feathers.

entry: 战斗中，POKENAME从花瓣射出孢子，附着在敌方宝可梦身上，再从羽毛喷出余烬，将孢子点燃。
author: quackquackattack
source: During a battle, POKENAME shoots spores from its petals, which cling to the opposing Pokémon. It will then ignite the spores by spraying embers from its feathers.

entry: POKENAME颈部的花散发辛辣刺鼻的香气。它用巨翼将气味吹向敌人，使对方晕头转向，再发起攻击。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME's neck flower produces a spicy aroma that irritates the nose. It uses its large wings to blow this scent towards opponents to disorient them before attacking.

entry: POKENAME在身后引发烈焰爆炸，便能像火箭一样冲上天空，靠防火羽毛抵御高热。它的翅膀与尾巴用来掌舵，而非提供升力。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME can launch itself into the air like a rocket by creating a fiery explosion behind it, relying on its fireproof feathers to protect it from the heat. It uses its wings and tail to steer rather than to provide lift.

entry: 它用翅膀上脱落的羽毛搭建暖巢，抵御寒冷与风雨。虽然尚未完全长成，这种宝可梦却无所畏惧，以坚定不移的决心迎接所有挑战。
author: fiordaliso
source: It uses the feathers that fall from its wings to build warm nests, keeping itself safe from cold and rain. Though not yet fully developed, this Pokémon fears nothing and faces every challenge with unwavering determination.

entry: POKENAME耐火，眼睛还有护目镜般的薄膜挡烟，是参与扑灭山火的巡护员的宝贵伙伴。它飞行精准，毫不畏惧地冲进险境，绕开障碍。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is fire resistant and has a goggle-like film that protects its eyes from smoke, so it is a valuable partner for any Ranger involved in fighting wildfires. It flies with precise maneuvers, fearlessly darting into danger and around obstacles.

entry: POKENAME的喙锋利带毒，宛如一根毒针。蛛丝又极易燃烧，可制成燃烧的丝弹，也能烧灼困在网中的敌人。
author: infinex21
source: A POKENAME's beak is like a stinger with how sharp and poisonous it is. Its webbing is highly combustible, being used as flaming bombs of silk or to scorch foes caught within its webs.

entry: POKENAME兴奋时，花瓣间会放出余烬，让四周落满灰。不训练、不吃东西时，它们最爱在阳光下打盹。
author: quackquackattack
source: When POKENAME are excited, they release embers from in between their petals to pepper the area with ash. When they are not training or spending time eating, they love to nap in the sun.

entry: POKENAME是高贵的天空战士，以光之剑盾作战。为了决定首领，群体成员展开激烈的空中决斗，胜者便会加冕为王。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME are noble warriors of the sky that fight with swords and shields of light. To determine their leader, members of the flock engage in intense aerial duels, with the victor being crowned as their king.

entry: 战斗中，它的羽毛会喷出灼热火焰，交战越久，火势越旺。根根羽毛炽热发亮，这番景象使它深受许多训练家喜爱。
author: infinex21
source: Scorching flames erupt from its feathers during battle, and they grow even stronger the longer a battle draws on. Each of its feathers glows with heat, the sight of which makes it popular with many Trainers.

entry: POKENAME在水下会覆上一层特殊物质，让自己也能生火。暮色渐深时，看着它们一同玩耍，从下方照亮水面，是格外动人的美景。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME cover themselves in a special coating when underwater, which allows them to produce fire. Watching them play together in the fading daylight and lighting up the water from below is an especially beautiful sight to behold.

entry: POKENAME在水下会覆上一层特殊物质，让自己也能生火。只有不停游动，溶解在水中的氧气才能穿过这层包覆。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME cover themselves in a special coating when underwater, which allows them to produce fire. Dissolved oxygen can only pass through the coating if POKENAME keeps swimming.

entry: 它拍动强健的翅膀，撒出灼热余烬，压倒猎物。吃完一顿仍不满足，总在寻找更多食物与猎物，免得火焰渐渐熄灭。
author: infinex21
source: It flaps its strong wings to scatter scorching embers to overwhelm its prey. It is never satisfied after a meal and will constantly search for more food and prey to keep its flames from petering out.

entry: POKENAME从喙中喷火，烤制猎物。烤到焦脆后，它们便用利爪撕开焦黑的残骸。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME roast their prey by breathing out flames from their beak. Once their prey is burnt to a crisp, their talons tear into the burnt remains.

entry: POKENAME以巫术操纵魔焰，从翅膀和燃烧的羽冠施展炽烈咒术。颈上的火焰结晶储存魔力，蓄满后便会释放毁灭性的烈焰。
author: msdawgs
source: POKENAME wields enchanted flames through witchcraft, casting blazing spells from its wings and burning crest. The fire crystal on its neck stores magical energy, unleashing devastating flames when fully charged.

entry: POKENAME先将热量压缩进爪中，再出手攻击。冲击威力之强，足以烧穿钢铁。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME compresses heat inside its claws before striking. The impact is powerful enough to burn straight through steel.

entry: POKENAME飞上天空，从尾巴降下雷电，击昏敌人，再猛然落在对方面前，振翅生火，试图将其烧伤。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME takes to the sky to drop lightning from its tails onto its foes to stun them. It then crashes down to the ground before them and attempts to burn them with flames generated by the flapping of its wings.

entry: POKENAME飞行于天空，寻找战斗。找到后却不会参战，而是飞过双方之间，以一道火墙将其隔开。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME flies through the skies, searching for battles. When it locates one, it will not join in but will fly between the two sides to separate them with a wall of fire.

entry: POKENAME的羽毛能冷却周围空气，让它得以在炎热气候中生存。但生气时，羽毛就会开始燃烧。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's feathers are able to cool down the air around, allowing it to survive in hot climates. However, the feathers will start to catch ablaze when POKENAME is angry.

entry: POKENAME从尾巴喷出瞬间燃起的毒液，像火箭般冲上天空。升到高处后，它们会无声滑翔，用巨爪抓取小猎物，将毒液留给格外巨大的目标。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME spray venom from their tails that instantly ignites, launching them into the air like rockets. After gaining altitude, they glide silently to snatch small prey with their massive claws, reserving their venom for exceptionally large targets.

entry: POKENAME力气充沛，用巨大的长牙掀起团团泥土，削弱敌人。暴怒时，它会从喙里喷出灼热火焰。
author: fiordaliso
source: Using its vigorous strength, POKENAME uproots clumps of earth with its massive tusks to weaken its foes. When enraged, it breathes scorching flames from its beak.

entry: POKENAME从屋顶飞过，就会干扰屋内的电脑设备。有时故障严重到整块硬盘都无法修复。
author: .izik
source: While flying over a home, POKENAME disrupts computer equipment inside. The errors it creates can sometimes be so severe that entire hard drives are left irreparable.

entry: POKENAME活动时，体内火焰不断蓄能，速度提升到跳跃宛如飞行。它绕着对手射出燃烧的叶片，等敌人烦躁或失去平衡，再冲上前去。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME's internal fire charges while it is active, increasing its speed to the point that its jumps mimic flight. It launches burning leaves at opponents while circling them, charging once the foe has become frustrated or off-balance.

entry: POKENAME脱落的绒羽能防火，人们用来制作衣物及其他用品的阻燃隔热材料。它们不易驯服，却会全力守护自己信任的人。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: The down feathers that come from POKENAME are fireproof and used by humans to make flame-resistant insulation for outfits and materials. These Pokémon are not easy to tame, but they will defend those they trust with all their might.

entry: POKENAME以锋利的爪子闻名。猎物一旦被盯上，便很少能逃脱；惊人的速度，让它能迅速高效地击倒目标。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME are famous for their sharp claws and talons. When it sets its sights on a target, rarely does its prey get away. POKENAME's incredible speed helps it take down targets swiftly and efficiently.

entry: 战斗中，它在连环踢击之间挥动沉重的翅膀，向敌人撒下灼热余烬。下方的利爪既能抓起、带走猎物，也会在每次火焰踢中深深划伤敌人。
author: infinex21
source: During battle, it swings its hefty wings between its flurries of kicking attacks, scattering scorching embers at its foe. It uses its lower talons to pick up and carry away prey and to gouge enemies with every Blaze Kick it unleashes.

entry: POKENAME用强健双腿跃上高处，以最佳视野搜寻四周。发现目标，这位猎手便从栖处跃下，用巨大的头羽精准滑翔，击倒猎物。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME uses its powerful legs to leap onto high points where it can most effectively search the area. When it spots a target, this hunter will jump from its perch and use its large head feathers to soar with precision to strike down its prey.

entry: POKENAME能感知周围生灵的情绪，胆子很小。若感到过于强烈的负面情绪，它便用小翅膀撒下余烬作掩护，瞬间移动到更安宁的地方。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can sense the emotional state of those around it, and is quite skittish. If it senses too strong a negative emotion, it showers the area with embers from its tiny wings to cover its teleporting somewhere more peaceful.

entry: POKENAME十分自负，不断挑衅敌人，惹其生气。对方中计进攻后，它就瞬间移动到空中，向下倾泻燃烧的羽毛和超能力冲击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is quite cocky, constantly taunting foes to get under their skin. Once they've fallen for the taunt and attack, it teleports into the air and showers the opponent with flaming feathers and psychic blasts.

entry: POKENAME奋力保护训练家。感到危险时，它们从翅膀唤出燃烧的羽毛，借一股强风射向敌人。
author: lasercraft32
source: POKENAME are fiercely protective of their Trainers. If they sense danger, they conjure burning feathers from their wings and send them at their foe with a powerful gust of wind.

entry: POKENAME奋力保护训练家。感到危险时，它们从翅膀唤出燃烧的羽毛，借一股强风射向敌人。
author: lasercraft32
source: POKENAME are fiercely protective of their Trainers. If they sense danger, they conjure burning feathers from their wings and send them at their foe with a powerful gust of wind.

entry: POKENAME的火焰形体显现，是卡洛斯古籍中较常见的图景。这些古老故事将它称为复仇之灵，会将背叛者烧成灰烬。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's fiery form manifesting is a somewhat common image depicted in old Kalosian texts. These ancient stories label it as a spirit of retribution that would burn to ash those who committed betrayal.

entry: 传说，有POKENAME从墓中起身，周身烈焰缭绕，灵魂系在神秘的楔石上。野生个体会焚烧周围的野生生物，烧焦森林，让林地铺满余烬与烟灰。
author: ultron_suprem3
source: Legends tell of a POKENAME that rose from the grave and was wreathed in fire, its soul tethered to a mysterious keystone. Wild POKENAME incinerate the wildlife around them, charring the forests, coating the forest floor with cinders and soot.

entry: POKENAME拼死守护住在背上的小箭雀。等小鸟离巢，POKENAME便再去寻找另一只。
author: darkweavile428
source: POKENAME will guard the Fletchling living on its back with its life. When the Fletchling leaves the nest, POKENAME will seek out a new one.

entry: POKENAME住在沙漠的地洞里。模样虽凶，它们却几乎只吃仙人掌和茄番果。身体坚韧到连沙漠蜻蜓有时也会避而不战。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME live in burrows in desert sands. Despite their ferocious looks, POKENAME almost exclusively eat cacti and Tamato Berries. POKENAME are so durable that sometimes even Flygon tend to avoid battling them.

entry: POKENAME收留许多受伤的小箭雀，照顾到它们完全康复。为了保护这些病号，它什么都愿做。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME houses many injured Fletchling until they're fully healed. It will go to great lengths to protect its patients.

entry: 它最爱的食物包括信使鸟等北极鸟类宝可梦，以及颇具讽刺意味的波加曼。POKENAME能以双翼重击，压制敌人，炽热的羽毛还会造成灼伤。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Its favorite foods include arctic bird Pokémon such as Delibird and, ironically, Piplup. POKENAME can deliver mighty blows with its wings, leaving foes subdued and burned from the heat of its feathers.

entry: POKENAME原本十分安静，扑向猎物时却会突然放声猛攻。在现代流行文化中，它通常以一部热门超级英雄动画里的反派形象为人所知，统领一支火焰怪物大军，号称邪恶皇帝。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is quiet until it lunges forth suddenly to strike at prey, attacking with a mighty cry. In modern popular culture, POKENAME is typically recognized for being the villainous emperor of a fiery monstrous horde in a popular superhero cartoon.

entry: POKENAME藏在树间等候猎物，伺机袭击。可钢甲拖慢了速度，想成功捕到并不容易。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME hides in the trees, waiting for prey so it can strike. However, it can't easily catch the prey, as the steel armor slows it down.

entry: POKENAME虽是无双的猎手，却心性高贵。它痛恨欺凌弱小，人们曾见它保护幼年宝可梦，抵御捕食者。
author: honestly_vitali
source: Despite being an unparalleled hunter, POKENAME has a noble spirit. It loathes those who prey on the weak and has been seen defending young Pokémon from predators.

entry: POKENAME的形象常见于许多古老神话。细节虽不同，多数都相信，在野外遇见它，预示着猛烈雷暴即将到来。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's visage is a common sight in many ancient mythologies. Though the details differ, most share a belief that seeing it in the wild heralded the arrival of violent thunderstorms in the near future.

entry: POKENAME振翅，使热空气环绕对手，在热流中制造幻影，迷惑敌人。它们裹着绚烂烈焰俯冲，再如熄灭的火般，消失于幻象之中。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME flap their wings to circulate hot air around their opponents, creating mirages within the heat to confuse them.  They swoop down in a glorious blaze, disappearing into their illusions like a snuffed flame.

entry: 夜里，POKENAME用温热的缎带卷住自己的蛋，抵御寒冷。暖意能加速孵化，也能安抚紧张的新生幼崽。
author: .izik
source: At night, POKENAME coils its heated ribbons around its Eggs, shielding them from the cold. This warmth accelerates hatching and soothes nervous hatchlings.

entry: POKENAME的翅膀只能短暂滑翔，因此大部分时间待在地面。它会先向敌人撒下火热粉尘，再施以破坏力惊人的地震。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME spends most of its time on the ground as its wings can only allow it to glide for a short time. It will shower foes with fiery dust before following up with a devastating Earthquake.

entry: 在地面旁观者眼中，高速狩猎的POKENAME宛如流星。离开臭氧层时，大气阻力会点燃羽毛，让它化作一线疾飞的火光。
author: ambrosia04
source: To observers on the ground, POKENAME looks like a shooting star when hunting at high velocities. Upon leaving the ozone layer, atmospheric drag  ignites its feathers, turning it into a soaring streak of flame.

entry: POKENAME是沉着的守护者，人们相信它栖于最高的悬崖，俯瞰辽阔领地。它以瞬间移动迅速来往，通过旋转的火焰虫洞消失、再现。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a stoic guardian believed to perch itself on the highest cliffs in order to survey vast amounts of territory. POKENAME travels quickly by teleporting, disappearing and reappearing through the use of swirling wormholes made of flame.

entry: POKENAME的身体完全防火，使身体鼓胀、维持升空的火焰只能从头顶冒出。抓住鸟类猎物后，它便消失，带着对方迅速前往不知名的地方。
author: soup1900
source: The flames that inflate and keep POKENAME in the air can only come out from the top of its head due to its body being completely flameproof. After grabbing its bird prey, it disappears and whisks them away to an unknown location.

entry: POKENAME模仿古文明留下的壁画，引诱好奇的探险家与历史学家。倒霉者一旦靠得太近，就会遭到致命的闪焰冲锋，灵魂随即被吸收。
author: theartemis1
source: POKENAME mimics the murals left by ancient civilizations in an attempt to lure in curious explorers and historians. Those unfortunate enough to draw too close are struck by a lethal Flare Blitz, their soul absorbed immediately after.

entry: POKENAME织出的丝网极易燃烧。猎物一落网，它们就将网点着，几秒钟便能烤熟。
author: staghorn
source: POKENAME weave webs made of extremely flammable silk. Upon catching something, they ignite the webs and cook their prey in seconds.

entry: POKENAME用强爪攀在洞顶，等猎物从下方经过。看到值得出手的目标，它便让烈焰包裹全身，朝下猛扑。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME cling to cave ceilings with their strong claws and watch for prey to pass beneath them. When a POKENAME spots worthwhile prey, it will engulf itself in fire and throw itself down upon its target.

entry: POKENAME全身积蓄着惊人的热量，飞行时化作纯粹的火焰。俯冲攻击如今威力骇人，击中时不但烧灼目标，连不幸靠近的事物也不能幸免。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's body has become supercharged with heat, becoming pure flame when in flight. Its diving attacks are now terribly devastating, burning its target and anything unfortunate enough to be near when it strikes.

entry: POKENAME的翅膀散发高热。以超音速飞行时，周围空气会燃烧，在天上留下道道火迹。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's wings radiate with an intense heat. As they fly at supersonic speeds, the air around them ignites and leaves burning trails across the sky.

entry: POKENAME加热翅膀正下方的空气，只消振翅几下，就能跃出很远。它们太重，无法真正长途飞行，却仍可滑翔远行。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME heat the air directly beneath their wings, allowing them to bound great distances with just a couple of flaps. They are too heavy to attain true long distance flight, but can still cover great distances by gliding.

entry: POKENAME用炽热的喙折下树枝，再以不可思议的精准叠放，筑起结实的溪流堤坝。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME snaps branches off trees with its burning-hot beak. It stacks them with uncanny precision to help build sturdy creek dams.

entry: POKENAME全身覆着厚羽，却无法长距离飞行。为了保护自己，它们会从羽毛的小缝隙喷出余烬。
author: hereisanimations
source: POKENAME's body is made of thick plumage, however they cannot fly long distances. In order to protect themselves they spew embers from the small gaps in their feathers.

entry: POKENAME很友善，尾巴上的火焰会流露情绪。兴奋时，它们一边两脚轮流跳动，一边从羽间迸出阵阵火花。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are friendly Pokémon whose emotions show through the flames upon their tails. When they get excited, they let loose showers of sparks from between their feathers while hopping from foot to foot.

entry: 它鲜艳的羽毛，连最负盛名的华丽大赛评委也赞不绝口。POKENAME唱着欢快的旋律，起飞时，便在自己绕着巨翼唤出、操控的火焰间优雅起舞。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its vibrant plumage is praised by the judges of the most prestigious Pokémon Contests. POKENAME sings jolly melodies, and when it takes flight, it dances gracefully among the flames it conjures and controls around its wide wings.

entry: POKENAME用女高音般的歌声，引来其他鸟类宝可梦，作为猎物。过去，它的防火绒羽曾被用作火属性宝可梦的床铺。
author: chaoticanzu
source: POKENAME uses its soprano voice to draw in other bird Pokémon to prey upon. In the past, its fireproof down was used for the beds of Fire-type Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME羽毛温暖蓬松，是人们争相寻找的伙伴。它们唱歌时，厚实如云的羽毛会泛起暖光，景象璀璨夺目。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME are highly sought after as companions because of their warm, fluffy plumage. When they sing, the thick, cloud-like plumage on their bodies emits a warm glow, creating a brilliant display.

entry: POKENAME不断从花中排出含硫烟气。由于走路时花瓣会拍动、放出余烬，它被视为引发山火的重大隐患。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME continually vents sulfuric fumes from its flower. Because its petals flap and release embers as it walks, it is considered a major wildfire hazard.

entry: POKENAME身上落下的黑沙，数秒内就能升至华氏300度。战斗时，它能控制最远100英尺外的沙，从远处攻击敌人。
author: .izik
source: The black sand that comes off POKENAME's body can heat up to 300 Fahrenheit in seconds. It controls this sand from up to 100 feet away to strike foes from a distance during battle.

entry: POKENAME一振翅，产生的热量就足以扭曲前方空气。快速振翅筑起的火墙，被形容为既富破坏力，又美丽动人。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can, with a flap of its wings, generate enough heat to distort the air in front of it. The walls of fire it can create with rapid flapping are described as being both destructive and beautiful.

entry: POKENAME的蘑菇落下孢子，覆满翅羽。向敌人猛烈振翅时，孢子会燃起，让火焰也带上毒性。
author: sk372
source: Spores from POKENAME's mushroom fall onto its wings and coat its feathers. When it flaps fiercely at foes, the spores ignite and cause the flames POKENAME produces to have poisonous capabilities.

entry: POKENAME的翅膀宽大有力，既能当武器，也能带它飞行。它掀起强风，将敌人吹飞或吹得失去平衡，趁机以火焰灼烧。
author: fireblade141
source: Due to the size and strength of POKENAME's wings, they are broad enough to use as weapons and allow it to fly. It generates powerful gales to send foes flying or put them off balance, giving POKENAME an opening to burn them with its flames.

entry: 它摸起来炽热难当，情绪激烈时体温还会升高。它靠羽毛的热量，点燃握着的枝条。
author: pix3l_655
source: It is blazing hot to the touch. Its body temperature raises with extreme emotions, and it lights the branch which it holds with the heat of its feathers.

entry: POKENAME重甲加身，在地上步履迟缓，强健的翅膀却能轻松载它升空。飞行时，它拖出浓黑烟雾，遮蔽、扰乱地面猎物的视线，再猛然俯冲。
author: ambrosia04
source: Despite being sluggish on land due to its heavily armored body, POKENAME's powerful wings easily carry it through the air. It releases a thick trail of dark smog as it flies to blind and disorient prey on the ground before suddenly diving.

entry: 无月的黑夜里，常能看见POKENAME聚集。它们动用庞大储能飞过夜空，各自依照整齐的图样爆发能量，点亮天幕，形成烈箭鹰般的轮廓。
author: chaos_emblemx
source: POKENAME are commonly seen congregating on dark, moonless nights. Using their vast energy reserves, they fly through the night sky, each bursting with energy in organized patterns, igniting the sky. The resulting formations resemble Talonflame.

entry: 战斗越久，POKENAME越兴奋躁动，情绪高涨，尾焰也随之升腾。火势达到顶点时，热火花便从羽毛间成阵喷出。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME grow increasingly excited and agitated the longer a battle draws on; as their emotions flare up, so too do their tail flames. At the pinnacle of its flame's intensity, it vents showers of hot sparks from between its feathers.

entry: POKENAME从喙喷出烈焰，将上方枝头的虫属性宝可梦打落。猎物一落地，它们就将其拖进洞里享用。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME release powerful flames from their beak to knock down Bug-type Pokémon from branches above them. Once their prey is on the ground, POKENAME drag them into a hole to eat them.

entry: POKENAME向上方树木喷出强力火焰，在虫属性宝可梦落地前就将其烤熟。猎物着地后，它们便接连啄食，吃完这顿饭。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME shoot powerful flames at the trees above them to roast Bug-type Pokémon before they even get to the ground. Once their prey reaches the ground, a flurry of pecks consumes their meal.

entry: POKENAME飞过天空，不断寻找更强的敌人挑战。它从翅膀撒下炽热余烬，同时从喙喷出道道火流，压倒猎物与敌人。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME constantly searches for stronger foes to overcome as it flies through the sky. It overwhelms prey and foes with showers of hot embers scattered from its wings in tandem with streams of fire spewed from its beak.

entry: POKENAME任风托起身体，升到足够高处，再俯冲向猎物，用根刺穿，以强效毒素令对方动弹不得。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME allows the wind to lift their bodies into the air. When high enough, they will dive towards their prey and pierce them with their roots, immobilizing them with a powerful poison.

entry: POKENAME体格虽大，却能从身体下方喷出火花，升上天空。蜕去嶙峋的外壳时，困在里面的火花一下子尽数释放，看起来仿佛爆炸。
author: soup1900
source: Despite its large physique, POKENAME can take flight by venting fiery sparks from the underside of its body. When it sheds its craggy body, it appears to explode since all the trapped sparks become free at once.

entry: POKENAME多疑，一生只会亲近一位训练家。只有信任的对象，才能在它飞行时骑上背。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME are distrustful Pokémon that will only get close to one Trainer for their whole life. Only those they trust will be able to ride on their back when they fly.

entry: 它向鸟类宝可梦吐出压缩的滚烫泡泡，轻松捕食。若不小心打中更强的目标，惹其发怒，这种宝可梦就会缩进壳里。
author: infinex21
source: It spits compressed, scalding bubbles at bird Pokémon so it may easily prey upon them. If it ever strikes a stronger target and earns its ire, this Pokémon will hide within its shell.

entry: POKENAME的防水羽毛一接触空气，便会瞬间干透。因此，几秒之内，它就能轻松跃出冰水、飞上天空，甚至点燃羽毛攻击敌人。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's water-resistant feathers dry out instantly when exposed to open air. This lets it easily leap from the icy water to take to the air and even ignite its feathers to attack foes, all within seconds of each other.

entry: POKENAME的阻燃污泥，让自己免于着火。有些消防员穿的制服，会涂上以它的黏液制成的材料。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's flame-retardant sludge protects it from catching alight. Some firefighters wear uniforms coated with a product derived from POKENAME slime.

entry: 战斗中，猛烈火焰从它身上喷出，考验对手的胆量。它靠翅膀迅速移动，同时以火球和滚烫水柱轰击目标。
author: infinex21
source: In battle, powerful flames erupt from its body to test the mettle of its opponent. Using its wings, it can move quickly while bombarding its target with fireballs and scalding water jets.

entry: POKENAME极度厌水，会攻击带着瓶装水进入领地的对象。跨海迁徙时，它们栖在船桅上。水手们认为，打扰它们会招来厄运。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME have a great disdain for water and are known for attacking those who carry bottles of water into their territory. To migrate over the ocean, POKENAME ride on the masts of ships. It is considered bad luck among sailors to disturb them.

entry: POKENAME试着模仿妙蛙种子，背上开始长出球根。若球根受到打扰，它便报复触碰者，施以带毒的灾厄诅咒。
author: redmagecole
source: In an attempt to mimic Bulbasaur, POKENAME started to grow a bulb on its back. If the bulb is disturbed, POKENAME retaliates by cursing whoever touched it with toxic afflictions.

entry: POKENAME弱小，没什么防身手段。想吃它们的飞行属性宝可梦随时可能揭穿伪装，因此它们常躲起来，免得外衣脱落。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are puny creatures that have few defenses. They are constantly under threat of being uncovered by Flying-type Pokémon that try to eat them, so they often hide to avoid their disguise from coming off.

entry: POKENAME不用爆炸的力量，免得过度损伤伪装。有人攻击时，一只强大的黑暗之手便会从它的“嘴”里挥拳而出，击退对方。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME refrains from using explosive powers as it would cause undue damage to its disguise. Instead, those that attack it get repelled by a mighty hand of darkness punching out from POKENAME's "mouth".

entry: 这种宝可梦的外壳会片片脱落，人们在野外收集，改制成狩猎球的外壳。碎片上的不规则花纹能融入草地，因此很受重视。
author: jaminmcready
source: This Pokémon's outer casing sheds in flakes that are gathered in the wild and repurposed to craft the casing of a Safari Ball. The flakes are valued for their irregular patterns that blend into grassy terrain.

entry: POKENAME制作伪装，混进需要朋友的孤独卡拉卡拉之间。手里的武器虽是假的，危险靠近时，伪装下却会涌出阴影，化作棍棒，击向敌人。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME creates a disguise that helps it mingle with lonely Cubone in need of a friend. Although the weapon is fake, when danger approaches, a shadow unleashes from beneath POKENAME's disguise and forms a club to strike at its foe.

entry: POKENAME以粗大的棍棒和阴影之爪战斗。木头脑袋只是诱饵，会当作盾牌，挡住瞄准下方眼睛的攻击。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME fights using both its thick club and a shadowy claw. Their wooden head is merely a decoy and will be used as a shield to block any attack aimed at the eyes below it.

entry: 它的大棍棒由结实的木头制成。POKENAME常游荡着寻找宝可梦聚集之处，盼找到能认作朋友的伙伴。它无私，常在战斗中出手相助。
author: fireblade141
source: Its massive club is made of sturdy wood. POKENAME often wanders in search of places that many other Pokémon frequent, searching for someone to claim as a friend. It is selfless and will often come to the aid of others in battle.

entry: POKENAME用富有弹性的腿摇摇晃晃地蹦跳，看起来随时要摔倒。其实它平衡感极佳，始终准备踢向靠得太近的敌人。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME wobbles and bounces around on its springy legs, and always seems to be about to fall over. It actually has exceptional balance, and will always be ready to kick foes that get too close.

entry: POKENAME来回摇晃，发出诡异的吱嘎声。若它突然静止，就表示马上要攻击了。
author: honestly_vitali
source: POKENAME sways back and forth, making a eerie creaking sound. If it's ever still, it's about to attack.

entry: POKENAME用影子手挂在心爱的树上，沿枝条移动。下方出现食物，它们便松手落下，吃完再用手爬回去。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME use their shadow hand to hang and move along the branches of their favorite trees. Should food appear underneath them, they will detach, eat, then use their hand to climb back up.

entry: POKENAME收集廉价香水，混入除虫喷雾，制成令人窒息的气味，抵御来犯者。它的装束隔绝性能极佳，自己不会受雾气影响。
author: slimninja55
source: POKENAME collects cheap perfumes and mixes them with Repels to create a choking aroma that protects it from attacking foes. It insulates its costume so well that it is not affected by its own mist.

entry: 为了与山中的宝可梦交朋友，它就地取材，制作各种装束。POKENAME以幽灵之力旋转头上的假钻头，凿穿岩石，开出地道。
author: fiordaliso
source: To befriend mountain Pokémon, it crafts costumes from whatever materials it finds. Using its ghostly powers, POKENAME spins the fake drill on its head to carve tunnels through rock.

entry: POKENAME徘徊在宝可梦中心周围，盼着能协助吉利蛋治疗其他宝可梦。它做成吉利蛋模样的伪装，怕真身吓着病患。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME loiters around Pokémon Centers, hoping to be able to assist Chansey in treating other Pokémon. It fashions a disguise in Chansey's likeness, fearful its true form would frighten its patients.

entry: POKENAME的主身和袋中的幼崽，都是由内部同一个阴影般的存在操纵。两种角色演得太逼真，许多人以为它们是性格各异的两只宝可梦。
author: .jerden
source: Both the main body and the infant in its pouch are puppeted by the same shadowy presence inside POKENAME. It plays both roles so convincingly that many people believe they are two separate Pokémon, each with their own personality.

entry: POKENAME的主身和袋中的幼崽，都是由内部同一个阴影般的存在操纵。两种角色演得太逼真，许多人以为它们是性格各异的两只宝可梦。
author: .jerden
source: Both the main body and the infant in its pouch are puppeted by the same shadowy presence inside POKENAME. It plays both roles so convincingly that many people believe they are two separate Pokémon, each with their own personality.

entry: POKENAME竭力让金鱼王群相信自己也是同类，用木角一点点凿岩。如果没有金鱼王在它凿出的洞里产卵，它便会慢慢游走，离开大家。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME tries its best to convince schools of Seaking that it is one of them and will chip away at rocks using its wooden horn. If none of the Seaking lay eggs in a hole POKENAME has bored, it will slowly swim away from them all.

entry: POKENAME将身体藏进被丢弃的儿童玩偶，撕开背部、掏空内部，腾出空间。它们展开阴森的翅膀移动，用鲜艳的眼状斑纹看路。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME hide their bodies inside discarded children's dolls, tearing through the backs of them and hollowing them out to make space. They spread out eerie wings to move themselves around, using the bright eye spots to see.

entry: POKENAME躲在谜拟丘模样的伪装后，用线操纵它。周围的无形屏障，让它在伪装破损前都无法被攻击。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME hides behind a Mimikyu disguise, puppeting it using strings. Invisible barriers around POKENAME make it impossible to attack until its disguise is broken.

entry: POKENAME像操纵木偶一样，摆动飞天螳螂装束的双臂。木头与布制的手臂虽不锋利，操纵它们的影爪却很利，随时能丢开伪装，发动袭击。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME moves around the arms of its Scyther costume like a puppet. Although its arms of wood and cloth are not sharp, the shadowy claws that control them are, and can drop the disguise to strike at any moment.

entry: POKENAME在田野露营，睡在帆布帐篷下。谁想往里看，它便用随身带角的头猛撞；对方若逃，它还会拎起帐篷追赶。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME camps out in fields, sleeping under canvas. If anyone tries to look inside, POKENAME will strike them with the horned head it carries with it, picking up its tent to chase after them if they flee.

entry: POKENAME个头小，看似怯弱，毒液却足以麻痹比自己大得多的敌人的嘴。它们的头像网球，因此常被其他宝可梦误捡起来。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME may seem meek because of their small size, but their venom is capable of numbing the mouths of foes much larger than themselves. Their head resembles a tennis ball, which often causes other Pokémon to pick them up on accident.

entry: POKENAME带着伪装穿行陆地与水面，假扮暴鲤龙。虽然装得并不像，可装束一旦受损，或有人指出破绽，它便会破坏性地暴走。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME carries its disguise around across land and above water, pretending to be a Gyarados. Although it is not very convincing, POKENAME will go on a destructive rampage if its costume is damaged, or if any flaw is pointed out.

entry: POKENAME能伸展、重塑伪装，变身成任何宝可梦。乍看完美，细查却总能找到藏着的接缝。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME can stretch and reshape its disguise to Transform into any Pokémon. While seemingly perfect at a glance, close inspection will always reveal hidden seams.

entry: POKENAME擅长变形，却恶意而自私。它有时会试图囚禁自己化作的那个人，想永久取而代之。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a skilled shapeshifter with a malicious and selfish streak. It has, on occasion, attempted to trap a person it has shapeshifted into so that it can permanently replace them.

entry: POKENAME十分害羞，据说个性会随进化方式改变。即使如此，它仍努力与人类和宝可梦交朋友，却从不展示伪装下的样子，怕吓到别人。
author: heal_fire
source: POKENAME has a very shy personality, but it's said that its personality changes with how it evolves. Despite this shyness, it tries to build friendships with humans and Pokémon. It never shows what's under its disguise, fearing it might scare others.

entry: 进化时，POKENAME长出鳃，配合流过伪装的水，便能在水下呼吸。游泳时它格外小心，用双臂挡住，不让任何人看见伪装底下。
author: heal_fire
source: When it evolves, POKENAME develops gills, which, combined with water flowing through its disguise, enable it to breathe underwater. It is very careful when swimming, using its arms to prevent anyone from seeing what's under its disguise.

entry: 从谜拟伊布进化后，POKENAME开始产生热量，储存在毛发内。它能将热量呼出，形成强劲的灼热气流，也能用这份暖意，与训练家依偎。
author: heal_fire
source: After evolving from a Mimivee, POKENAME starts to generate heat that is stored inside its fur. It can use this heat by breathing it out, creating a powerful stream of burning hot air. It can also use this warmth to cuddle with its Trainer.

entry: POKENAME用过时的电子零件制作装束，却出乎意料地擅长模仿声音和数码绘画。因此，电影公司会请它以数字手段增强画面效果。
author: ghostslythe
source: With a costume made from outdated electronics, POKENAME is surprisingly adept at vocal mimicry and digital art. As such, movie studios employ it to digitally enhance scenes.

entry: POKENAME拿橄榄球头盔做自己的壳。有些热情球迷喜欢给壳涂色，配成所支持球队的颜色。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME takes helmets from Gridiron football and makes them into its shell. Some enthusiastic fans enjoy painting POKENAME's shells to match their team's colors.

entry: POKENAME靠找到的旧菊石兽壳保护自己、融入群体。它们会聚在一起，同时交换外壳，每只都换进大一号的壳里。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME relies on finding old Omanyte shells for protection and social integration. Groups of POKENAME gather to swap their shells in unison, each going to a shell one size up.

entry: POKENAME的装束里，除了自己，还装着数十磅食物。它不怎么爱动，因此通常都在打盹。
author: bobosmith01
source: The inside of POKENAME's costume contains dozens of pounds worth of food as well as POKENAME itself. It doesn't like to move very much and is therefore generally found napping.

entry: POKENAME将枕头塞满伪装，力求柔软好抱。可隔热保温太好，里面热得难受，它便常从人们的保冷箱里拿冷冻甜食与冰饮。
author: slimninja55
source: POKENAME stuffs its disguise with pillows to be as huggable and soft as possible. The disguise is extremely hot due to heavy insulation, so it often takes frozen treats and chilled drinks from people's ice chests.

entry: POKENAME仰躺在游乐场附近，一动不动，想引孩子爬上来。但孩子总能看出它只是装成卡比兽，因此很少靠近。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME will lie on its back near playgrounds, remaining still to encourage children to climb on it. However, they can always tell that it's only pretending to be a Snorlax, and rarely approach.

entry: 儿童医院的毛绒玩具中，能发现POKENAME。它们喜欢给人拥抱，谁一靠近，就会兴奋地挥动双臂。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME can be spotted at children's hospitals among the plush toys. They enjoy giving out hugs and will excitedly shake their arms if someone approaches them.

entry: 旧棉花和腐烂的食物塞满POKENAME的装束，臭得很！人们从未见它离开装束，即使睡觉也不例外。
author: bobosmith01
source: Old cotton and rotten food fills POKENAME's costume, causing it to have quite a stench! POKENAME has never been spotted outside of its costume, even when it is sleeping.

entry: 橙华市或玉虹市偶尔能见POKENAME打理自己的花园。谁敢打扰，便会招来百般反击，有时被花盆砸，有时挨手掌击打。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are sometimes spotted in Petalburg or Celadon City, tending to their own garden. Any that attempt to disrupt them are met with various retaliations, from being hit with pots to being struck by their hands.

entry: 橙华市或玉虹市偶尔能见POKENAME打理自己的花园。据报告，若训练家帮忙栽培，它种出的果实会更加美味。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are sometimes spotted in Petalburg or Celadon City, tending to their own garden. Reports indicate that if their Trainer helps cultivate the plants, POKENAME's plants will have tastier fruit.

entry: POKENAME似乎难以同时移动长装束的所有部位。它会先用木棍撑起头，方便摆动尾巴，再伸出影子般的手臂，把木棍拿回来。
author: .jerden
