source: POKENAME create spectrums of light to burn and disorient foes and would-be threats. When they spread their large wings, they also scatter countless ember scales; using psychic powers, they control and direct these ember scales during battle.

entry: POKENAME结合火焰与超能力，完美重现阳光，甚至凝聚成伤人的光束。非凡的本领，让古人，将它奉为太阳之神般的存在。
author: infinex21
source: Through a combination of flame and psychic power, POKENAME can perfectly recreate sunlight and even hone said light into damaging beams. Its remarkable abilities led those of the past to revere it like a deity of the sun itself.

entry: POKENAME掌握神秘力量，能轻松与其他虫宝可梦交流，并肩作战。它随心操纵神秘的火焰，保护伙伴与训练家。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME command mystical powers that allow them to easily communicate and fight alongside other bug Pokémon. They bend mystical flames to their whim in the defense of their allies and their Trainers.

entry: POKENAME极少现身，只有巢穴必须保卫时，才离开火山最深处。交战后活下来的人说，它用优雅舞步，灵巧躲开攻击，将敌人整个焚尽。
author: beatdoof
source: Rarely seen, POKENAME only surfaces from the deepest recesses of volcanoes when its dwelling has to be defended. Those who battled it and lived tell stories of it deftly avoiding attacks with its graceful dance as it incinerated enemies whole.

entry: POKENAME观察日月星辰，能算出日月食的确切时刻。月亮每次遮住太阳，它就会在头顶，创造明亮火球，照亮周围。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME observe the movements of the sun, moon, and stars, and are able to calculate the exact timing of eclipses. Whenever the moon occludes the sun, POKENAME create a brightly glowing ball of fire above them to illuminate their surroundings.

entry: POKENAME的石头，常在火山附近发现。它大多时间休眠，喷发将近时才现形，石头亮起，仿佛期待吸饱滚烫岩浆。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's stone is often found in the vicinity of volcanoes. It spends much of its time dormant, but manifests when an eruption draws near, its stone glowing in anticipation of soaking up molten hot magma.

entry: 它跳跃、飞行时，将细鳞撒遍战场。随时都能让这些鳞片，迸成波导火焰，帮助掌控战局。
author: sk372
source: It spreads tiny scales from its wings across the battlefield as it leaps and flies about. At any given point, it can make these scattered scales erupt into flames of aura to help control the battlefield.

entry: 温暖季节里，POKENAME的体热，能增强毒性。它撒下翼上的毒鳞，保卫领地。
author: mepp.
source: During the warmer seasons, POKENAME's body heat helps intensify its venom. It defends its territory by scattering toxic scales from its wings.

entry: POKENAME成群围住幼小、虚弱的同伴，展开橙色鳍，吸收阳光供能。面对威胁，它们会咆哮，抖动鲜艳褶饰，警告对方。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME herds make a circle around their young and weak when they spread their orange fins to absorb sunlight for energy. When confronted by a threat, they bellow and shake their flashy frills in a warding display.

entry: POKENAME在寒冷气候中生活，性情温顺，常结群移动。受到威胁，它们用坚硬的脸，护住幼崽，再从褶饰撒出灼热余烬，赶走袭击者。
author: jonclyd
source: POKENAME are docile Pokémon found in colder climates, often moving in herds. When threatened, they shield their young with hardened faces, their frills scattering scorching embers to drive off attackers.

entry: POKENAME成群围住幼小、虚弱的同伴，展开橙色鳍，吸收阳光供能。面对威胁，它们会咆哮，抖动鲜艳褶饰，警告对方。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME herds make a circle around their young and weak when they spread their orange fins to absorb sunlight for energy. When confronted by a threat, they bellow and shake their flashy frills in a warding display.

entry: 野生POKENAME最常在暖日晒太阳。身体暖和后，就以极快速度与强大力量，捕猎食物。其余时间，则在地下洞穴休眠，保存能量。
author: .jerden
source: Wild POKENAME are most often seen sunbathing on warm days, and after warming up their body they will hunt for food with great speed and power. The rest of the time, they hibernate in underground caves to conserve energy.

entry: 若见POKENAME站在火山脚下，一动不动，凝望山口，就预示火山即将喷发。它究竟是有益的预警者，还是受诅咒的凶兆，人们意见不一。
author: sk372
source: Should one see POKENAME standing at the base of a volcano, unmoving and staring at the rim, it is a sign that the volcano will soon erupt. Opinions are split between whether POKENAME is a helpful warning system or a cursed harbinger.

entry: POKENAME能感知火山即将喷发，便四处飞行，撒下翼鳞，试着警告别人。可鳞片一碰皮肤就灼伤，反而被认为，害多于益。
author: sk372
source: Able to sense imminent volcanic eruptions, POKENAME flies about spreading scales from its wings in an attempt to warn others. Because the scales burn skin on contact, however, POKENAME is seen as causing more harm than good.

entry: 腹部的巨嘴中，火焰比岩浆还热。抓到的猎物，都会被拖进去，几秒内，便化成液体。
author: infinex21
source: The large mouth within its belly contains flames that burn hotter than magma. Any prey it catches will be pulled into this mouth and liquified in seconds.

entry: POKENAME试着囤积各种药草与营养植物，增强力量。谁想拿回草药，就会迎来，猛烈的火之舞。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME attempt to hoard different types of healing herbs and other nutritious plants to strengthen their power. Those who try to take back the herbs are met with an intense Fiery Dance.

entry: 这些巨大的虫属性宝可梦，即使休息，也散出温和暖意。翅膀能像流动的火焰般发亮，吓退捕食者。
author: infinex21
source: These large, Bug-type Pokémon exude a gentle warmth even when resting. Their wings can glow like flowing flames to scare away predators.

entry: 极少数时候，火山喷发后，能见到POKENAME。传说，大地与熔岩的隆隆震动，会将它唤醒。
author: bigoljax
source: On rare occasions, POKENAME are seen after volcanic eruptions. Legend says that the force of the ground and lava rumbling awakens a POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME能通过鲜艳的翅膀与大颚，传导热量，吃前片刻，就把颚中的食物烤焦。冬天不休眠，因此，它们改靠毒角，赶走捕食者。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME can channel heat through their vibrant wings and mandibles; they char food within their mandibles moments before consuming it. Because they do not hibernate in winter, they rely on their venomous horns to ward off predators instead.

entry: POKENAME的羽衣，硬得堪比最坚韧的合金。它还能操纵羽毛及周围的热量，发动攻击。
author: t.i.a.
source: The feather coat of a POKENAME is as hard as the toughest alloys. It can manipulate the feathers' and its surroundings' heat to attack.

entry: 古人将POKENAME称为，化作兵器的“太阳之怒”。它从护手撒出鳞片，点起一片火海。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: Ancient peoples referred to POKENAME as "The Rage of the Sun" in weapon form. It scatters scales from its guard to light a sea of fire.

entry: 传说中，POKENAME也叫“太阳之光”。刀刃散发的热量，能点起一片火海，耗尽附近空气中的氧气。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME is also referred to as "Sun's Ray" in legend. The heat of its blade can light a sea of fire and remove oxygen from the surrounding air.

entry: 这些虫宝可梦，产热太多，反而在夏天休眠；休眠时，温度会以指数幅度下降。感到危险，背部突起就会绷紧、发光，准备正面迎战。
author: infinex21
source: These bug Pokémon hibernate in summer due to the amount of heat they produce; when they hibernate, they become exponentially cooler. The growths on their backs tense and glow when they detect danger, as they will prepare to face it head-on.

entry: 雷电穿行于细密的毛发，双翼则放出阵阵热浪。野生POKENAME曾被视为夏日雷暴的先兆。
author: therider
source: Lightning surges through its fine fur while its wings radiate waves of heat. Wild POKENAME were thought to be harbingers of summer thunderstorms.

entry: 火山喷发后，能见POKENAME扯走烧焦的树，为新树腾出生长之地。它常让弱小宝可梦进巢保暖，直到火山灰云散去。
author: mistymagius
source: After volcanic eruptions, POKENAME can be seen tearing away burnt trees, allowing for new ones to grow. It will often let weaker Pokémon into its den, keeping them warm until the ash cloud passes.

entry: 它的甲壳，坚硬如岩石。暴怒时，喧嚣而炽烈的狂奔，可能被误认成火山喷发。
author: .jerden
source: Its carapace is as hard as rock. When enraged, its loud and fiery rampage may be mistaken for a volcanic eruption.

entry: 它用翅膀，召来裹着烈焰的沙暴。翼上散落的鳞片，落下时嗡鸣，一声叫喊，就能爆成火球。
author: infinex21
source: It uses its wings to conjure sandstorms wreathed in intense flames. The scales scattered from its wings hum as they fall and can burst into fireballs when it cries out.

entry: POKENAME忍受不了鳞片干燥。一旦变干，就会钻进草木间加热身体，吸取植物中的水分。
author: layth
source: POKENAME can't stand having their scales get dry. When they do, it heats itself up amongst vegetation to absorb its moisture.

entry: POKENAME生活在火山附近，人们能见它，游过岩浆。挥尾撒下余烬鳞片时，美丽得让斗士，失去斗志。
author: grannyjojophone
source: POKENAME lives near volcanoes, and can be seen swimming through magma. Its beauty makes fighters forget their spirits as it whips its tail around, spreading ember scales.

entry: 齿轮转得越快，身体散出的热量，就越强。战斗中，POKENAME能从水平圆环上的每根刺，喷出火焰，轻松烧灼周围一切。
author: fireblade141
source: The faster its gears spin, the more intense the heat radiating off its body gets. In battle, it is capable of blasting flames from every spike on its horizontal ring, allowing POKENAME to scorch everything around it with ease.

entry: POKENAME将幻象与控火本领结合，战斗时制造分身。分身一被攻击，就会引爆成猛烈火海。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME weaves its powers of illusion together with its mastery of flame. It creates duplicates in battle, which detonate into a blazing inferno when struck with an attack.

entry: 天气转冷，POKENAME会用温热触须，裹住训练家保暖。不过，冬季角上产生的火鳞也更多，可能成为严重的火灾隐患。
author: mistymagius
source: When the weather gets colder, POKENAME will wrap its heated feelers around its Trainer to keep its Trainer warm. However, it also produces more fiery scales from its horns in the winter which can become a major fire hazard.

entry: POKENAME散热极强，便住在寒冷气候附近，主要冬季外出。愤怒时，狂暴几乎无法阻挡，热量也会大约翻倍。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME exude such powerful heat that they live near colder climates and venture out primarily in winter. When enraged, a POKENAME will fly into a nigh-unstoppable rage that amplifies its heat approximately twofold.

entry: POKENAME的火焰，有个奇特之处，吞噬东西，远比普通火快，仿佛这些火焰的时间流逝，被加速了。
author: epping_forest
source: The flames produced by POKENAME have the quirk of consuming things much faster than normal fire. It seems as if the flow of time for those flames is accelerated.

entry: 它们背上长出如翼的巨腿，靠这些腿，在地面爬行。迅速追猎时，长长的下半身，也在后方，蜿蜒跟上。
author: infinex21
source: They crawl along the ground with the large legs that have grown from their backs like wings. Their long, lower bodies slither after them as they scurry quickly after prey.

entry: POKENAME的六翼，由锋利如刃的金属薄片制成。头顶的炮，通常发射灼热射线；若周围尽是易燃物，就改发其他能量，因为它并不免疫火焰。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's six wings are made of razor-sharp sheets of metal. The cannon above its head usually fires scorching rays of heat, although POKENAME will blast out other forms of energy if surrounded by flammable materials, as it is not immune to fire.

entry: 据说，星球上的每座火山，都有一只POKENAME沉睡。被激怒时，它会从炮中，射出加热的能量，威力胜过任何火山喷发。
author: sk372
source: It is said that a POKENAME lies dormant within every volcano across the planet. If angered, it fires heated energy blasts from its cannon more powerful than any volcanic eruption.

entry: POKENAME拥有烈日般的力量，喷出灼热火焰，战斗越久，就越猛烈。传说，它会将被贪婪吞噬者，烧成焦炭，只留下，贪欲换来的珍贵财宝。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: With the power of a burning sun, POKENAME unleash scorching flames that grow more intense as battle continues. Legends tell of POKENAME searing those consumed with greed into a burning crisp, leaving behind only the precious yield of their greed.

entry: POKENAME将利刺，藏在毛发之下。每根刺，带着不同毒素，却都极其危险，因此，野外很少有捕食者，愿意猎捕它。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME conceal sharp thorns beneath their fur. Each thorn carries a different toxin, though all of them are incredibly dangerous. As a result, very few predators choose to hunt POKENAME in the wild.

entry: 每月之初的黎明，POKENAME会在空中起舞，用臂内两条长鞭，庆祝日出。右臂的鞭浸满毒液，左臂的鞭，则裹着火焰。
author: shadeofblu
source: At the dawn of every month, POKENAME will have an airborne dance celebrating the sunrise using the two whips within its arms. The whip on the right arm is drenched in venom, while the whip in the left is engulfed in flames.

entry: POKENAME的身体，是热等离子体，寄居在火神蛾形的外壳中，与物质世界互动。它会附在灯或取暖器里，免得别人受冻。
author: h0bojoe
source: POKENAME's body is made of thermal plasma that inhabits a Volcarona-shaped shell to interact with the physical world. It will occupy lamps or heaters to keep others from freezing.

entry: POKENAME的身体，是热等离子体，寄居在火神蛾形的外壳中，与物质世界互动。它会附在灯或取暖器里，免得别人受冻。
author: h0bojoe
source: POKENAME's body is made of thermal plasma that inhabits a Volcarona-shaped shell to interact with the physical world. It will occupy lamps or heaters to keep others from freezing.

entry: 战斗中，POKENAME撒下许多发光的热余烬，威吓对手。黑色鳞片，也让它在黑暗与浓烟中，很容易藏身。
author: mepp.
source: When in battle, POKENAME scatters many glowing hot embers to intimidate its opponents. Its black scales allow it to hide well in dark and smoke-filled environments.

entry: 野生POKENAME收臂叠翼，像棺材一样，躺在墓地板上。谁打扰沉睡，它们便用火海，焚烧周围一切，随后，却得赶紧逃离自己的火焰。
author: .jerden
source: Wild POKENAME retract their arms and fold away their wings, then lie on the floor of tombs like coffins. If anyone disturbs their slumber, they will burn up everything around them with a sea of fire, but must then flee to escape their own flames.

entry: POKENAME织出耐热的网，连火山内部的温度，也能承受。它只捕食火属性宝可梦，尤其偏爱熔岩虫一族。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME spins heat-resistant webbing that can stand up to even the temperatures inside volcanoes. It strictly hunts and consumes Fire-type Pokémon, particularly the Slugma family.

entry: POKENAME本体中央，有一颗烧得像太阳般炽热的核心。它把热量，注入猛撞攻击，既压碎，也灼烧被击中的对手。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME's main body contains a central core that burns as hot as the sun. It channels this heat into its slam attacks, crushing and scorching those it strikes.

entry: POKENAME用双臂，悬在树枝或洞顶，睡觉时，则缩近固定之处。透明头部两侧的鳍，能感知附近生命力，帮助辨认猎物与威胁。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME dangles from tree branches or cave ceilings with its arms, but retracts itself close to its anchor point when sleeping. The fins alongside the transparent head detect nearby life forces and help it identify prey or threats.

entry: POKENAME面对强敌，会展开大翼，扬起一股燃烧的鳞片。大颚像斧刃，还能喷出猛烈火流。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME spreads its large wings together with a plume of flaming scales when faced with a strong foe. Its mandibles are like the blades of an axe and it can spew intense streams of flame.

entry: 体内火焰越热，身上的符文就会变换颜色。据说，它燃烧的拳头，热得堪比恒星核心。
author: staghorn
source: The runes on its body change color depending on the heat of its inner flame. Its burning punches are said to be as hot as a star's core.

entry: 两只火神蛾融合，诞生了悖论般的形态，有人曾将其描绘为，远古的火神蛾。如今，它肌肉致密，能喷出更猛烈的火焰，连岩石也能熔化。
author: infinex21
source: The fusion of two Volcarona gave rise to a paradoxical form some once depicted as being an ancient version of a Volcarona. Its body is now dense with muscles that help it to spew even more intense flames that can now melt rock.

entry: POKENAME高速飞越各地区，只有火山活跃之处，才会停留。飞行时，翼鳞撒向身后，一察觉追踪，就会将其点燃，爆出阵阵火焰。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME flies at high speeds across the regions, only stopping in areas with volcanic activity. It spreads scales from its wings behind as it flies, igniting them in explosive bursts if it senses something pursuing it.

entry: POKENAME用燃烧鳞片，烧掉老旧腐朽、对自己与生态都再无作用的坝。它筑的巢，总温暖舒适，寒季里，是理想住处。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME uses its flaming scales to burn down old and rotting dams that serve no purpose to it or the ecosystem anymore. Nests made by it always stay warm and toasty, making them great places to live during the chilly season.

entry: 它用六片翼状尾鳍，推动自己，在水下前进。战斗时，能放出如溃坝般强大的汹涌水流。
author: .jerden
source: It uses its six wing-like tail fins to propel itself underwater. In battle, it can unleash a torrent of water with the force of a dam bursting.

entry: POKENAME整天睡在，能找到的最向阳之处。受威胁，就撒下翼上余烬，点起火，再继续睡，虽然它并不免疫，自己制造的火焰。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME spends all day asleep in the sunniest spot it can find. If it is threatened, it will scatter embers from its wings to start fires, then fall back asleep, even though it is not immune to the flames it creates.

entry: POKENAME体温始终极高，一激动，翅膀便热得足以点燃，擦过的易燃物。它一天大半时间，都在逃离自己引发的火灾。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's body temperature is always incredibly high, and if it gets worked up, its wings will be hot enough to ignite flammable objects they brush against. POKENAME spends most of its time fleeing from fires it creates.

entry: 古代壁画，将这种宝可梦描绘为神，旁边文字称，POKENAME是亡者的判官，会以火塔，围住最恶劣的灵魂。实际却相当温顺，宁愿在花田打盹。
author: _pixelar_
source: Ancient murals depict this Pokémon as a deity. Accompanying texts describe POKENAME as a judge of the dead, wreathing the worst souls in towers of flame. In reality, it is quite docile, preferring to doze in flower fields.

entry: POKENAME的小翅膀，不适合飞行，让它十分懊恼。每当因飞不起来而沮丧，它就会大发脾气，喷出火焰。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: To POKENAME's frustration, its small wings are unsuitable for flight. It unleashes fiery tantrums when frustrated by its inability to fly.

entry: POKENAME生活在寒冷气候，靠背上稀有的火山植物，始终维持高温。捕猎时，它滚进雪里，等猎物踩上，再挥爪出击。
author: operativevalkyrie
source: POKENAME lives in cold climates, and can always sustain a high temperature thanks to the rare volcanic plant on its back. To catch prey, it rolls over in the snow until it is walked upon, then strikes with its claws.

entry: POKENAME不会飞，一感到危险，就用翅膀撒出孢子。接触会引发严重过敏，伤处看起来，如同重度烧伤。
author: milchik
source: POKENAME can't fly and instead uses its wings to scatter spores whenever it senses danger. These spores cause a severe allergic reaction upon contact, making the damaged area look like a high-degree burn.

entry: POKENAME颈边的护符，是古老的太阳象征。它出现在古神庙，以未知语言，朝雕像与刻纹吟诵。
author: .jerden
source: The amulet that hangs around POKENAME's neck is an ancient symbol of the sun. POKENAME can be found in ancient temples, chanting at statues and carvings in an unknown language.

entry: POKENAME生活在火山洞穴，吸取附近岩浆房的热量。大群悬挂洞顶，让本已炎热的洞穴，升温到几乎无法忍受。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME live in volcanic caverns, feeding off the heat from the nearby magma chamber. Swarms of POKENAME hang from the ceiling. heating up the hot cavern to almost unbearable temperatures.

entry: POKENAME害羞而神秘，常常只有掉落的余烬鳞片，才显出踪迹。传闻，它会用宝石眼睛，模仿日光闪烁，将迷路的冒险者，引到洞穴深处。
author: femaledog
source: POKENAME are shy and mysterious creatures, often noticed only by their dropped ember scales. They are rumored to lure lost adventurers deep into cave systems by mimicking the glint of daylight with their gemstone eyes.

entry: POKENAME极其凶暴，四处疾行时，撒下滚烫翼鳞，处处制造危险。鳞片既灼烧，又麻痹，让中招者，面对它的猛攻，极为不利。
author: sk372
source: Highly aggressive, POKENAME scatters burning-hot scales from its wings as it scurries around, creating hazards everywhere. The scales paralyze as well as burn, so those afflicted will be severely disadvantaged against POKENAME's assault.

entry: 日出时，POKENAME吼得足以惊动，附近所有野生生灵。它们从早到晚，游荡荒地，不断寻找宝石，希望连夜里，也能捕捉太阳的光。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: At sunrise, POKENAME roar loud enough to startle all other wildlife in the area. They wander the wastelands from dawn to dusk, constantly on the hunt for gems that they hope will capture the light of the sun, even at night.

entry: 据说，POKENAME一声咆哮，世界某处的火山，就会喷发。它称霸火山区域，以可怕的咬击，与双翼扇出的火风，震慑弱小宝可梦。
author: sk372
source: It is said that a POKENAME's bellowing roar causes a volcano to erupt somewhere across the world. It reigns supreme over volcanic areas, terrorizing lesser Pokémon with a terrible bite and flaming gusts of wind from its wings.

entry: 强风常将热花粉，从POKENAME的叶片间吹出。花粉若落在花上，将其点燃，它就绕着燃烧的植物，跳起圈舞。
author: sk372
source: Strong winds have a tendency to blow hot pollen out from within POKENAME's fronds. If the pollen hits a flower and causes it to ignite, POKENAME will dance in circles around the plant as it burns.

entry: 据说，POKENAME充满活力的动作，启发了古代敬奉太阳的仪式舞蹈。它们也颇为挑食，偏爱啜饮，金色花朵的蜜。
author: mepp.
source: It's said that POKENAME's energetic movements inspired ancient ceremonial dances that honored the sun. POKENAME are known to be rather picky eaters, preferring to sip on nectar from golden flowers.

entry: POKENAME白天栖在丛林树冠或火山峰顶，用翅膀吸收阳光。夜里靠回声定位捕猎，抓获时，消耗太阳能，放出刺眼闪光，轻松取得一餐。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME roosts atop jungle canopies or volcanic peaks during the day, absorbing sunlight with its wings. It echolocates prey at night, expending the solar energy in a blinding flash when it catches its prey for an easy meal.

entry: POKENAME白天栖在丛林树冠或火山峰顶，用翅膀吸收阳光。夜里靠回声定位捕猎，抓获时，消耗太阳能，放出刺眼闪光，轻松取得一餐。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME roosts atop jungle canopies or volcanic peaks during the day, absorbing sunlight with its wings. It echolocates prey at night, expending the solar energy in a blinding flash when it catches its prey for an easy meal.

entry: POKENAME的花，能喷出浓厚花粉云，让裸露皮肤，生出痛疹与灼伤。若足够专注，它还能升级攻势，喷出一大股，真正的火焰。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's flower can gush out a thick cloud of pollen that causes painful rashes and burns to exposed skin. If it concentrates hard enough, it can upgrade its assault to emitting a huge gout of actual flame as well.

entry: 它有节奏地摆锚，发出鼓声般的响动，身体也透出温暖、脉动的光。水手称POKENAME为“小太阳”，即使海况再险，待在它身边，也会勇气倍增。
author: turron_turron
source: The rhythmic swing of its anchor produces a drum-like sound as its body emits a warm, pulsing glow. Known as "Sunny" amongst sailors, those in the presence of POKENAME are inspired with courage, even on the roughest of seas.

entry: POKENAME俯身伏下，积蓄热量，直到蒸汽从体内逸出。随后，将压力化作喷涌的火海，毁坏周围区域。
author: evilgammon
source: When hunkered down, POKENAME builds up heat until steam begins escaping its body. It then vents this pressure in the form of an erupting inferno, devastating the surrounding area.

entry: POKENAME以彻底称霸沙漠而闻名，能从指尖射火，动作模仿，著名的神枪手。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME are known for their complete dominance in deserts. They can shoot fire from their fingertips, mimicking the same motions as famous gunslingers.

entry: 背上的真菌，适应炎热干旱的环境，它便依附大型宝可梦，前往更热地区。鳞片有强烈刺激性，保护它免遭捕食。
author: adam_dnh
source: As the fungus growing on its back is adapted to hot and arid environments, it clings to large Pokémon to reach hotter regions. Its scales are severe irritants, which keep it safe from predators.

entry: POKENAME在阳光下，微微发亮，用火焰头冠，威吓敌人。据说，日食时，它会现身，从暗处，用锐利的蓝眼睛，默默注视。
author: eiskitsune
source: POKENAME glows faintly under the sunlight, using its fiery crest to intimidate foes. It's said to appear during solar eclipses, silently watching from the shadows with piercing blue eyes.

entry: POKENAME巡视火山脚，视其为领地。鬃毛落下的余烬，被尾巴击中，就会燃起，射出许多火球，驱赶入侵者。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME patrols the bases of volcanoes, seeing them as its territory. It sheds embers from its mane that ignite after being hit by its tail, sending numerous fireballs out to repel intruders.

entry: POKENAME抖动身体，将余烬鳞片，与有毒孢子一起撒出，自我防御。这些是真菌孢子，长成的蘑菇，会发光，暖意如阳光。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME defend themselves by shaking their bodies to scatter their ember scales about in conjunction with noxious spores. These spores are fungal and the resulting mushrooms glow with a warmth akin to sunlight.

entry: 古时，POKENAME是灾难的征兆。出现在城市岸边，便意味着，它将使城市沉没，或保护城市，抵御传说宝可梦的怒火。
author: bandedbodypress
source: In ancient times, POKENAME was a sign of disaster. When it appeared on a city's shores, it signified that it was going to sink the city or protect it from the wrath of a legendary Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME战斗时，臂刃会变得滚烫。背部大翼，能增加跳跃高度，也能滑翔，让它从上方，用强力热风，烧灼下方一切。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME's arm blades become searing hot when it battles. The large wings upon its back increase its jump height and give it the ability to glide, allowing it to scorch everything below it with a powerful Heat Wave from above.

entry: POKENAME战斗时，臂刃会变得滚烫。背部大翼，能增加跳跃高度，也能滑翔，让它从上方，用强力热风，烧灼下方一切。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME's arm blades become searing hot when it battles. The large wings upon its back increase its jump height and give it the ability to glide, allowing it to scorch everything below it with a powerful Heat Wave from above.

entry: 传说，POKENAME是生于彻底黑暗的法师，火焰由毁坏的世界的阴影点燃。据说，这造物曾被骑拉帝纳亲手触及，将禁忌之火，与古老精神咒文交织。
author: yukifellfire
source: Legends speak of POKENAME as mages born in total darkness, its flame kindled by the shadows of the Distortion World. Said to be a creation touched by Giratina itself, it weaves forbidden fire with ancient psychic incantations.

entry: POKENAME钻过山体，寻找煤炭，为火焰供能。遇险时，先从背部喷起黑色烟尘与火焰，再迅速逃开。故事说，它曾让火山灰，遮暗世界的大气。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME dig through mountains in search of coal to fuel their flames. When endangered, they will blow up black soot and flames from their backs before scurrying away. Stories say that POKENAME caused volcanic ash to darken the world's atmosphere.

entry: POKENAME跑过原野，撒下燃烧鳞片，将沿途土地烧焦。蓝色火焰，数百年前曾与王室相联；故事里，它被尊为象征太阳之怒的传说宝可梦。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: As POKENAME race across fields, they scatter their burning scales; charring the land they run across. Their blue flames were associated with royalty centuries ago. In tales, POKENAME were revered as Legendary Pokémon who personified the sun's wrath.

entry: POKENAME能将热量汇到鳞片，让每一片都亮起来。它先以绚丽表演迷惑敌人，再将对方焚烧殆尽。
author: vaporvenator
source: POKENAME can light up each of its scales by focusing heat onto them. It performs mesmerizing displays to distract foes before incinerating them.

entry: POKENAME喜欢一边飞，一边唱，风格如同歌剧。听者说，不仅全身温暖，精神也更加振奋。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME enjoy singing as they fly, with a style similar to that of opera. Those who hear the songs report both a warm feeling throughout their body as well as feeling more energized.

entry: POKENAME热爱与其他格斗属性宝可梦交战，不断锻炼身体，提升表现。落于下风时，双拳就会爆出炽红火焰，增添争胜所需的力量。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME love to fight against other Fighting-type Pokémon and constantly train their bodies to improve their performance. Whenever they are losing a battle, their fists burst into red hot flames to give them the boost needed to secure victory.

entry: POKENAME极其稀有，通常住在深水，直到最近，还曾被认为灭绝。它从触手分泌毒素，再灼烧猎物。闪亮的宝石，也引来偷猎者追捕。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME are extremely rare, typically living deep underwater, and until recently, they were thought to be extinct. POKENAME hunt by secreting toxins from their tentacles before burning their prey. Poachers hunt POKENAME for their shiny gemstones.

entry: POKENAME在火山安家，通常靠近峰顶。最强的招式，是缩起身体，点燃全身，化作一块翻滚的火焰巨石。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME makes its home on volcanic mountains, typically near the summit. It's strongest move involves tucking inward and igniting its whole body, turning it into a rolling boulder of flames.

entry: 六翼每次拍动，都会撒出鳞片，一声鸣叫，就立刻燃烧。它只允许认定值得的对象，骑在背上，获此殊荣者，寥寥无几。
author: infinex21
source: With every flap of its six wings, it scatters scales that instantly combust when it cries out. It will only allow those it deems worthy to ride upon its back, and very few have ever been granted this privilege.

entry: POKENAME振翅撒出的温热花粉，带催眠能力，让目标陷入恍惚。施法时，螺旋花纹，也会隐隐旋转。
author: sk372
source: The warm pollen it spreads from POKENAME's flapping wings carries hypnotic capabilities that put its targets into a trance. The spiral patterns swirl faintly while it casts its spell.

entry: POKENAME视力很差，靠灵敏鼻子，寻找附近的叶片。它也能从远处，嗅出捕食者，在对方攻击前，及时藏身。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have poor eyesight, so they rely on their sensitive noses to detect leaves in the nearby vicinity. They can also smell predators from a long distance, giving POKENAME time to hide before the predator strikes.

entry: POKENAME用骨头敲击洞壁，发出声波辨路。它几乎失明，十分依赖这种方法。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME taps cave walls with its bone to release sound waves for navigation. It relies on this method heavily, as it is nearly blind.

entry: 为抵御危险，POKENAME将骨棒敲在地面，用声波定位敌人。掌握位置后，再掷出棍棒，如回力镖般，旋过空中。
author: quackquackattack
source: To defend themselves from danger, POKENAME rattle their bony club against the ground to locate their foe with sound waves. Once they have a grasp on where their foe is, they toss their club to whirl through the air like a boomerang.

entry: POKENAME过滤潮湿洞穴里，不流通的空气，将代谢废物，排成危险的蓝雾。久久不散的毒气，会引发严重过敏。
author: beatdoof
source: Filtering the stagnant air of its damp cavern home, POKENAME expels its metabolic waste as a hazardous blue mist. This lingering toxic gas is known for triggering severe allergic reactions.

entry: POKENAME吸入过多自己的毒气，身体胀大，长出两处显眼的毛茸球状结构。它不再被动取食，即使视力差，仍凭新生獠牙，主动捕猎。
author: beatdoof
source: Bloated by the excessive inhalation of its own toxic emissions, POKENAME has developed two prominent, furry spherical growths. Abandoning its passive feeding habits, it now hunts actively with emerging fangs despite its poor eyesight.

entry: POKENAME看不见，便用触角，感知周围。它从翅膀撒粉，迷住旁人的眼，免得干扰自己寻找花蜜。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME cannot see, but uses its antennae to sense its surroundings. It spreads a powder from its wings to blind others so they don't interfere with its hunt for nectar.

entry: POKENAME若因失明，找不到猎物，就会勃然大怒，冲撞附近的树木与岩石，直到找到可攻击的东西，或把自己累垮。
author: .izik
source: If POKENAME is unable to locate its prey due to its blindness, it flies into a violent rage. It charges into nearby trees and rocks until it either finds something to attack or tires itself out.

entry: 通常不建议，让POKENAME进入网络空间。它视力极差，四处乱闯，经常撞上关键数据，造成崩溃与其他问题。
author: sk372
source: Letting POKENAME venture forth into cyberspace is often advised against. Due to its extremely poor eyesight, it wonders around and often collides with critical data, causing crashes and other issues.

entry: POKENAME脸上长满毛，几乎等同失明。它避免飞行，免得撞上东西，可体型庞大，在地面沉重挪动，也没少出意外。
author: sk372
source: Because of the fur growing over its face, POKENAME is effectively blind. It avoids flying to keep itself from crashing into things, but its large size means it is not much less accident-prone while lumbering about on the ground.

entry: POKENAME完全失明，却有敏锐嗅觉弥补。毒液带着浓厚的蜂蜜香，先引来无防备的猎物，再发动攻击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME is completely blind but compensates with an acute sense of smell. Its venom carries a strong honey-like scent, luring in unsuspecting prey before it strikes.

entry: POKENAME好奇又视力差，飞遍世界时，总撞到其他生物。初次认识，它也喜欢咬对方，作为问候。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's curious nature and poor eyesight leads to it constantly crashing into other creatures while flying around the world. It tends to bite new acquaintances as a form of greeting.

entry: POKENAME视力差，必须用超能力，感知附近的他者。它天性贪玩，却常闹得过头，无意间伤到玩伴。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's poor eyesight requires it to use psychic powers in order to sense the presence of others nearby. It has a playful nature, but often gets too rambunctious and accidentally injures its playmates.

entry: POKENAME的火焰，光亮极弱，却以更高的温度弥补。人们认为，暗淡的火光，有助于它藏在，幽暗洞穴中。
author: hophoppip
source: The flames POKENAME produces give off minimal light and are hotter to compensate for this. It's thought that the dimmer flames help POKENAME to hide in the dark of caves.

entry: POKENAME常与族群走散，四处乱逛，直到撞上东西。发觉迷路，就会向附近放电，希望听见牧者，或另一只同类的声音。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME regularly get lost from their herds, wandering until they run into something. Once they realize they're lost, POKENAME will shock the area nearby in hopes of hearing their shepherd or another POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME牙齿不停生长，因此总啃硬物，磨去过长部分。这也帮助它们，摸清周围环境，弥补视力不佳。
author: santon5512
source: Due to their teeth's constant growth, POKENAME are constantly found gnawing on hard objects to grind them down. This habit also helps these Pokémon feel out their surroundings, compensating for their poor vision.

entry: POKENAME的尾巴特别敏感，能靠水流与气流，构建周围景象。只要靠近者的速度，快过缓慢步行，它就会喷出，微毒的物质。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME's tail is especially sensitive, able to use water and air currents to build up a picture of its surroundings. It spits a mildly toxic compound at anything that approaches it at anything faster than a slow walking pace.

entry: POKENAME的尾巴特别敏感，能靠水流与气流，构建周围景象。它不断分泌黏液，保持皮肤湿润；一不舒服，就会摇头，将水滴甩得到处都是。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME's tail is especially sensitive, able to use water and air currents to build up a picture of its surroundings. It constantly secretes a goo to keep its skin moist. When it gets uncomfortable, it shakes its head, spraying droplets everywhere.

entry: POKENAME感到威胁，会抖动叶片，沙沙作响，试图吓退靠近者。警告若无效，它便向前疾冲，朝惹怒自己的对象，狠狠咬下。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME rustle their leaves when they feel threatened, attempting to intimidate anything that gets close to them. If their warning fails they snap at the subject of their ire, darting forward to give a nasty bite.

entry: POKENAME看不见，便用牙齿，探索周围。咬合力强得连石头，也能咬碎，因此一路经过，总留下破坏。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME cannot see, so it explores its surroundings with its teeth. It has a powerful bite that can even break stone, so it leaves a trail of destruction in its wake.

entry: POKENAME在地下，靠震动判断，上方是否有猎物。一察觉，就用尾巴，钻穿泥土。这给游乐场带来麻烦，有时甚至导致地面下陷。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME rely on vibrations when underground to know if prey is above them. When they sense these vibrations, POKENAME use their tail to drill through the dirt. This causes problems for playgrounds, which sometimes end up sinking into the ground.

entry: POKENAME搜寻丛林地面的过熟树果，磨成黏糊。虽然失明，却能靠树果浓烈的发酵气味，诱来无防备的猎物。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME scours the jungle floor for overripe Berries, grinding them into a sticky paste. Though blind, it lures in unsuspecting prey by using the strong, fermented aroma the Berries create.

entry: POKENAME失明，靠触角感知，周围的变化。触角敏感，嗅觉又好，轻易就能找出树汁最丰富的树，尽情饱餐。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is blind, relying on its antennae to help it sense changes in its surroundings. Between the antenna's sensitivity and its sense of smell, it can easily sniff out the most sap-rich trees to gorge on.

entry: 没有眼睛，也没有肢体探索周围，POKENAME只能改用咬的。
author: im_quinn
source: With no eyes or limbs with which to learn about its surroundings, POKENAME must bite things instead.

entry: POKENAME完全失明，靠热辐射，感知周围宝可梦。遇见不散热的对象，就会变得凶暴，盲目头撞周围一切，直到平静。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME rely on thermal radiation to sense other Pokémon around them, as they are completely blind. When encountering a Pokémon that does not release heat, they become aggressive and blindly headbutt everything around them until they calm down.

entry: POKENAME需要青草、干草与树果产奶，便常把摸起来像草的东西，全吃下去。因此，有些戴着饲料袋，随时吃点，免得损坏别的物品。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME often eats everything grass-like it can feel, since it needs grass, hay, and Berries to produce milk. Because of this, some POKENAME wear feed bags to snack on and avoid damaging other items.

entry: POKENAME需要青草、干草与树果产奶，便常把摸起来像草的东西，全吃下去。因此，有些戴着饲料袋，随时吃点，免得损坏别的物品。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME often eats everything grass-like it can feel, since it needs grass, hay, and Berries to produce milk. Because of this, some POKENAME wear feed bags to snack on and avoid damaging other items.

entry: 强壮的头，把另一个当靠垫或栖处，因此两头，总在争斗。POKENAME从嘴里吹出水泡，减缓对手的动作。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its stronger head uses the other as a cushion or a perch, which is why the two are constantly in competition. POKENAME blows bubbles of water from its mouths to slow its opponents' movements.

entry: POKENAME看不见，便靠地面震动辨路。若察觉不到震动，就会蜷成球，试着保护自己。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are unable to see, so they sense for vibrations in the ground to guide themselves. If they cannot sense any vibrations, they curl up into balls to try and stay safe.

entry: POKENAME飘过荒寂洞穴，哔哔鸣叫，颤动的模样，令人不安。察觉其他宝可梦，就会凶狠地鸣叫，追过去。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME floats through desolate caves, beeping and jittering in unsettling ways. When it senses the presence of another Pokémon, it beeps aggressively while giving chase.

entry: POKENAME爱跳舞，可视力不佳，动作笨拙，舞到一半，常绊倒或撞上东西。至今，没人见过它，一次舞蹈从头到尾，毫无意外。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME loves to dance, but due to vision impairment it's rather clumsy and trips over or bumps into things mid-dance. Nobody has ever seen POKENAME commit a full dance routine without incident.

entry: POKENAME视力虽差，强大的精神感知，能弥补部分不足。它活泼又亲热，常用尖牙，在训练家肩头咬一下，表达喜爱。
author: sk372
source: Though POKENAME has poor eyesight, its strong psychic senses compensate for some of this disadvantage. Rambunctious and affectionate, it's known for giving its Trainer a sharp nip to the shoulder as a sign of affection.

entry: POKENAME视力敏锐，能迅速认出，周围哪里不对劲。感知能力突出，因此，越来越多侦探，请它们帮忙。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME have a keen sense of sight, able to quickly recognize when a part of their environment is off. This heightened sense of perception has seen them being used more by detectives.

entry: 故事说，凝视POKENAME背上的裂隙，会永久失明。它漫无目的地漂浮，避开他者，可一旦靠近，就会发出，轻轻的嘶哑低吼。
author: sk372
source: Stories say that staring into the gap in POKENAME's back will cause permanent blindness. It floats around aimlessly and avoids interacting with others, but when in close proximity, it emits a faint hissing growl.

entry: POKENAME的毛发，由针刺构成，帮助收住多余毒素。它们沿树干轻蹭，梳平毛发，却不知道，这样会伤害树木。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME's fur is composed of needles that help to contain excess poison. POKENAME smooth out their fur by nuzzling along tree trunks. Unfortunately, they aren't aware of the damage that this practice inflicts on the trees.

entry: POKENAME看不见，便用爪探索，新遇到什么，都撕扯一番，只为感受触感。它对质地记忆极佳，每种材料，只会这样破坏性地分析一次。
author: .jerden
source: Unable to see, POKENAME explores its surroundings with its claws, ripping and tearing anything new it encounters just to see what it feels like. POKENAME has an excellent memory for texture and only does this destructive analysis once per material.

entry: 来到陌生环境，POKENAME会伸出双臂移动，避免碰撞。一处只探索一次，就能记住布局，除非物件被挪走，否则，再也不会撞上。
author: .jerden
source: When in an unfamiliar environment, POKENAME will move around with its arms outstretched to avoid colliding with anything. After exploring an area once it will memorize the layout and will never collide with anything again unless an object is moved.

entry: POKENAME虽然失明，却从不碰撞。走路时，它用爪敲地，聆听回声，判断自己与任何障碍之间，确切的距离。
author: .jerden
source: Although POKENAME is blind, it never collides with anything. It taps on the ground with its claws as it walks, listening to the echoes this produces to  determine the exact distance between it and any obstacle that might hinder its movements.

entry: POKENAME叶片上的油，接触会引起难受的皮疹，不宜直接碰皮肤。它们知道这一点，生气时，就会冲向人们，好让自己不再被打扰。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The leaves of POKENAME are coated in an oil that causes an unpleasant contact rash and direct skin contact is inadvisable. They are aware of this property of their body and, when angry, will charge at people so that they can be left alone.

entry: 旅人与训练家，白天靠近POKENAME时，最好小心。虽然看不见，它们对声音与气味，仍很敏感，面对陌生存在，会毫不犹豫，射出日光束。
author: pkbonusducks
source: Travelers and Trainers are encouraged to exercise caution around POKENAME during the daytime. While they cannot see, POKENAME are still sensitive to sound and smell, and will not hesitate to fire Solar Beams at unfamiliar entities.

entry: POKENAME用大耳朵，探知周围动静。捕到猎物，就用覆毒的爪子，紧紧抓牢，确保迅速将其制服。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME relies on its large ears to detect movement in its surroundings. When it catches prey, it holds on tightly with its venom-coated claws to ensure a swift takedown.

entry: 电力尚未照亮世界以前，它们曾在黑暗中，运送信函与其他文具。借密探斗篷，避免被霜冻等影响拖慢。
author: quackquackattack
source: Before the world was illuminated with electricity, they were sent with missives and other stationery in darkness. A Covert Cloak let them avoid being slowed down by frost and other effects.

entry: POKENAME失明又好斗，靠近十分危险。被激怒时，它就不分方向，向周围洒下强力光束，希望击倒，惹怒自己的对象。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's blindness coupled with its aggression makes it a danger to go anywhere near. If it becomes angered, it rains down beams of powerful light indiscriminately around it in the hopes of taking down whatever wrought its ire.

entry: POKENAME对光敏感，便始终闭眼。不过，它清楚体内每根刺，因此，仍能精准喷射毒针。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are sensitive to light, so they keep their eyes closed at all times. They're aware of every quill on their body, so they can still spray out poisonous needles with precise aim.

entry: POKENAME看不见，便盲目攻击任何会动的东西，吸取生命力。尝过的猎物，它还能辨认出种类。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: Lacking vision, POKENAME blindly attacks anything that moves for its life force. It can sense the species of victims it's tasted.

entry: POKENAME的毛，盖住眼睛，便靠大耳朵，辨路、察觉危险。毛由毒针构成，随时能射出，再几乎瞬间长回。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME's fur grows over their eyes, so they rely on their large ears to help them navigate and detect danger. The fur is composed of poisonous needles that can be launched at a moment's notice before regrowing near instantly.

entry: POKENAME颇为吵闹，想打就与同类打一场。争执有时升级成大混战，整群同类，都加入斗殴。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME can be quite rowdy, picking fights with one another whenever they feel like it. These can turn into all-out brawls with entire hordes of POKENAME joining in on the scuffle.

entry: 眼上毛簇，让POKENAME看不清前路，飞行时，常撞上其他宝可梦。不过，凭龙爪，即使态度粗心，它也能轻松击败，任何敢挑战的生物。
author: fiordaliso
source: The tuft above its eyes makes it hard for POKENAME to see where it's going, so it often bumps into other Pokémon while flying. Thanks to its Dragon Claw, it can easily defeat any creature that dares to challenge it, despite its careless attitude.

entry: 一群POKENAME咬穿探索深海的自主潜艇，大概以为是食物，才在最近被发现。它们靠味觉，探索领地，因此许多个体，都留下互咬的伤痕。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME were recently discovered after a group bit through an autonomous submarine exploring the depths of the ocean, likely thinking it was food. They navigate their territories by taste, leading many to exhibit scarring from biting one another.

entry: 毛发盖住了虚弱的眼睛，POKENAME虽然看不见，嗅觉却极好，连别人的情绪，也能靠气味分辨。喜悦与善意的气息，最吸引它。
author: sk372
source: It cannot see due to the hair over its weak eyes, but POKENAME possesses a great sense of smell. It can even ascertain the emotions of others through its scent. It finds the scent of joy and kindness most appealing.

entry: 大多数POKENAME，都有最爱听的声音。一找到声源，就会使出时光咆哮，让那声音，持续循环。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Most POKENAME have a favorite sound that they enjoy hearing. Upon finding the source of this sound, they unleash a Roar of Time to loop the sound continuously.

entry: POKENAME炮上的头，有张定期开合的嘴，能射出强力光束，瞬间瓦解巨石。
author: .izik
source: The head on POKENAME's cannon has a mouth that periodically opens and closes. It can fire beams strong enough to disintegrate boulders instantly.

entry: POKENAME栖居的洞穴，常因尾巴，泛着深紫红光。可惜，它们什么都看不见，这光，对自己毫无帮助。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Caverns that POKENAME reside in often glow a dark magenta color thanks to their tails. This doesn't help POKENAME, since they cannot see anything.

entry: POKENAME虽然失明，却会用力甩尾，释放浓厚孢子云，藏住踪迹，轻松伏击猎物。
author: .izik
source: Despite its blindness, POKENAME shakes its tail vigorously to release thick clouds of spores. These spores obscure its presence, allowing it to ambush its prey with ease.

entry: POKENAME看不见，总是跌跌撞撞，毛簇又不断生长，照料很难。不过，绒毛十分保暖，因而备受追捧。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are hard to take care of on account of their blind stumbling and continuously growing tufts. POKENAME's fluff is highly sought after for its ability to retain heat.

entry: 这些宝可梦，喜欢取笑别人，虽然自己也有，会被嘲笑的特征。不知为何，POKENAME特别爱把粉笔，加入食谱。
author: jangodiot
source: These Pokémon enjoy teasing others, even though they also have traits that can be made fun of. POKENAME have a love for incorporating chalk into their diet for reasons unknown.

entry: 颈部与尾巴上的浓毛，又硬又粗糙。野外的POKENAME，常用尾巴撕开茂密灌木，开出道路。
author: melodydelune
source: The dense fur along its neck and tails is hardened and rough. POKENAME uses its tails in nature to tear through thick brush.

entry: 人们相信，POKENAME能开许多种锁，不过，要弄懂怎么开，得先头撞一下。可几乎每次，锁都直接坏了，也就不再需要钥匙。
author: deadshields
source: It's believed that POKENAME is able to open many types of locks, but to understand how to unlock one, they first need to headbutt it. This almost always breaks the lock, invalidating the need for a key.

entry: POKENAME视力差，走得慢而谨慎。多条尾巴，极其敏感，一觉得被碰，就会转身，用獠牙与利爪反击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME moves slowly and carefully due to its poor eyesight. Its many tails are highly sensitive, causing it to turn and lash out with its fangs and claws the moment it feels something touch them.

entry: POKENAME没有正常的双眼，一生大多时间，都在漫无目的地漂浮。据说，腹眼每五年才睁开一次，能为这只眼看见的第一个人，实现一个愿望。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME lacks a normal pair of eyes, causing it to float around aimlessly for much of its life. An eye on its stomach is said to open once every 5 years, and supposedly POKENAME will grant a wish to the first person it sees with said eye.

entry: POKENAME看不见，谁来许愿，它都答应，不问来历。这些任性的愿望，常让人事后怪罪它，可它始终困惑，为什么别人会生气。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Due to being unable to see, POKENAME grants wishes to anyone that asks, regardless of background. These wild wishes often lead people to be upset at POKENAME, who is confused as to why they are mad at it.

entry: POKENAME双眼虽盲，却依然贪玩、爱恶作剧。它住在人来人往的地方，能感知他者情绪，因此大多分得清，哪里危险，哪里安全。
author: bobosmith01
source: Despite being blind in both eyes, POKENAME is nonetheless playful and mischievous. It lives in busy areas: due to its ability to be able to sense the emotions of others, it is mostly able to tell what locations are dangerous and which are safe.

entry: POKENAME的护甲，若不打理，就会长得盖住眼睛与脸。它们因此不停互斗、撞击，打落彼此的壳片，维护护甲。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME's armor grows to cover their eyes and face if left alone. To maintain this, these Pokémon are constantly battling each other, ramming into one another to break off pieces of each other's shells.

entry: POKENAME看不见，因此，制造的幻象，都是听觉上的。听见新声音，它便仔细聆听，好在将来，准确模仿。
author: hophoppip
source: Being unable to see, POKENAME's illusions are auditory in nature. When it hears a new sound, it will listen closely so it can copy it effectively in the future.

entry: POKENAME只生活在幽暗雨林。谁碰到它，就会被它用头顶撞，同时撒出怕光的孢子。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME can only be found in dark rainforests. It will try to headbutt anything that touches it, spreading its light-sensitive spores.

entry: POKENAME常径直飞撞人的脑袋。这究竟出于恶意、失明，还是两者兼有，仍无定论。
author: dylonk25
source: POKENAME is known to fly directly into people's heads. It is an open question whether this habit stems from malice, blindness, or both.

entry: POKENAME完全失明，靠回声定位，在洞穴辨路。遇到陌生宝可梦，就用头撞一下，探查对方。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are completely blind and rely on echolocation to navigate caves. Whenever they encounter an unfamiliar Pokémon, they headbutt the new presence to investigate.

entry: POKENAME从触角，放出麻痹毒素，弥补看不见的不足。猎物无法动弹，它便靠嗅觉与声音，轻松追上，再使出咬住，给出最后一击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME compensates for its lack of sight by releasing a paralyzing toxin from its antennae. Once its prey is immobilized, it easily tracks them down using scent and sound before delivering a finishing Bite.

entry: POKENAME虽然失明，却有极佳嗅觉，能顺利辨路。靠近像食物的气味，就会开始猛咬，力量足以刺穿钢铁。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Even though they're blind, POKENAME are able to find their way around using their fantastic sense of smell. When they're close enough to something that smells like food they will start biting down with enough force to pierce steel.

entry: POKENAME以视力糟糕而出名，通常全力冲撞对手，可往往，根本撞不中目标。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME are notorious for their bad eyesight; they typically ram into their opponents at full force. However, they usually miss their targets.

entry: POKENAME紧紧裹住毛披风，抵御寒冷，却挡住本已虚弱的眼睛，因此，总跌跌撞撞，碰到东西。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME clutches its furry cloak close to its body to shield it from the cold. Doing so obscures its already weak eyes, so it stumbles around and bumps into things often as a result.

entry: POKENAME虽然看不见，体表的荚状物，却会散出甜甜的苹野果香。猎物被引到近处，它便用强大的双颚，猛然咬下。
author: .izik
source: Though unable to see, POKENAME emits a sweet Leppa Berry scent from the pods on its body: this attracts prey close enough for it to bite down with its powerful jaws.

entry: POKENAME完全失明，靠回声定位，探索世界。不过，敏锐的听觉，让它即使看不见，也很擅长躲避其他宝可梦的攻击。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Completely blind, POKENAME relies upon echolocation to find its way around the world. Despite its lack of eyesight, POKENAME is good at evading attacks from other Pokémon thanks to its sensitive hearing.

entry: POKENAME发出低沉、共鸣的叫声，探索周围。即使没有视力，震动也能让它，察觉障碍物。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME emits a deep, resonant cry to navigate its surroundings. The vibrations allow it to perceive obstacles despite having no eyesight.

entry: POKENAME被美梦的香气吸引，夜里飞快掠过天空。可视力差，常径直冲撞，散出梦香的熟睡者。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME zips through the skies at night, attracted to the scent of pleasant dreams. Its poor vision causes it to often careen directly into the sleeping person providing the aroma it chases after.

entry: POKENAME领地意识很强，入侵者靠得太近，就会尖叫。鳞片共鸣，放大叫声，让它用回声定位，探知全身周围，弥补视力不佳。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are highly territorial, screeching at intruders that get too close. Their screeches are amplified by the resonance of their scales, which allows them to use echolocation all around their bodies to compensate for their poor eyesight.

entry: POKENAME看不见，长长的手臂，帮助它在筑巢的洞穴辨路。碰到陌生东西，就会咬下，将牙齿，深深嵌进去。
author: b3llda1zora
source: POKENAME cannot see; however, their long arms help them navigate the caves they nest in. At the touch of anything unfamiliar, they will bite, digging their teeth into anything they don't recognize.

entry: POKENAME喜欢偷来柔软衣服，穿在身上。已有几名邪恶组织成员，被发现少了标志性的帽子，因为都被它拿走，自用了。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME enjoy stealing and wearing soft clothing. Several villainous organization members have been found without their signature hats due to POKENAME taking them for themselves.

entry: POKENAME的毛发，始终不停生长。因此，最好由训练家每天，为自己的伙伴梳理。
author: bobosmith01
source: The fur that grows on POKENAME's body never stops growing. As a result, it is recommended that Trainers groom their own POKENAME daily.

entry: POKENAME头毛浓厚，看不见，不过大耳朵带来的敏锐听觉，让它不至太常碰撞。若撞到其他宝可梦，就会立刻咬上去。
author: .jerden
source: Due to the thick fur on its head, POKENAME cannot see, but the keen hearing provided by its large ears prevents it from bumping into things too often. If it does collide with another Pokémon, it will immediately bite it.

entry: POKENAME看不见，便用木棒敲击，探索周围。它们在木头上敲出节奏，仿佛演奏乐器；没演完就被打断，会咬打扰者。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME cannot see, so it explores its surroundings by tapping on them with its stick. They will tap out patterns on wood as if playing a musical instrument and will bite anyone who interrupts their performance before they finish.

entry: POKENAME贪玩又顽皮，常互相打架，用尾巴抽打。可惜，坚韧耐火的鳞片，让它们很容易忘记，争吵能造成多大破坏。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are playful and mischievous, often getting into fights with each other where they slap each other with their tails. Unfortunately, their durable fireproof scales make it easy for them to forget how destructive their squabbles can be.

entry: POKENAME对人类与宝可梦，都格外亲热。可它用咬来表达喜爱，因此，朋友寥寥。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME is incredibly affectionate towards both people and Pokémon. Unfortunately, it shows affection through biting, so it has few friends.

entry: POKENAME嗅觉强，能找出气味浓烈的玉黍果。吃得充足，体色会加深，也帮助它，为进一步进化作准备。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME has a strong sense of smell, which helps it sniff out the pungent Cornn Berry. Its pigmentation deepens when eating a healthy amount of these berries, which also helps it prepare for further evolution.

entry: 它对光极其敏感，故意让毛长长，挡住自己的眼睛。哪怕最微弱的光，一照到眼，就会头痛。
author: sk372
source: It grows its hair out to blind itself purposely, due to an extreme light sensitivity. Even the faintest bit of illumination hitting its eyes will give it a headache.

entry: POKENAME视力差，总一头撞上东西，许多人反而觉得讨喜。不过，它脾气颇大，养起来，可能相当费劲。
author: sk372
source: Many have found POKENAME endearing due to its tendency to run headlong into things because of its poor eyesight. It is, however, quite temperamental, so raising one can be quite an arduous task.

entry: POKENAME视力极差，便结合精神波，与勺子产生的震动，以类似回声定位的方式，感知周围。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses a combination of psychic waves and vibrations from its spoon to sense its surroundings through a sort of echolocation. It does this because its own vision is incredibly poor.

entry: POKENAME举起巨石，抛来抛去，锻炼肌肉。可视力差，必须摸索找石头，也可能把石头，掷向自己没察觉的路人。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME trains its muscles by lifting up large boulders and tossing them around. Due to its poor eyesight, it must feel around for the boulders and risks chucking them at passersby that it lacks awareness of.

entry: 常能见到POKENAME成群，互相展示肌肉。领地里散落着，像是用于锻炼的器具。
author: whiteupgrade
source: POKENAME are often seen in packs, flexing their muscles at each other. Their territory is littered with tools that look like they were used for a workout.

entry: 巨大的狭长眼睛，让它看清周围，可POKENAME偏偏看不到正前方，必须先用触手，抓住食物，才能吃下。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Its large, slitted eyes give it a great view of its surroundings. However, POKENAME cannot see directly in front of it, so it has to use its tentacles to grab food before it can be eaten.

entry: POKENAME的头，像一颗骷髅。水手久传的克拉肯海怪故事，部分就源于它的外貌。
author: bandedbodypress
source: The head of POKENAME looks like a skull. Sailors have long told tales about krakens, fueled partially by its appearance.

entry: POKENAME一头全盲，另一头视力却近乎完美，能看出几英里远。因此，一个头不停梳理身体，另一个，负责带着它们前行。
author: quackquackattack
source: While one of POKENAME's heads is completely blind, the other has nearly perfect vision and can see for miles away. This has led to a situation where one head constantly grooms their body while the other keeps them moving through the world.

entry: POKENAME的三个头，总为分食争执。两个头都想多吃，失明的那一个，却始终主张，平等分享。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have three heads that are always in disagreement about how to share food. Two of their heads are always fighting for more food, while the blind head always wants to share the food equally.

entry: POKENAME看不见，走路或游泳时，常撞上墙与其他障碍。不过，一捕捉到猎物气味，追击就快而精准，令人胆寒。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's lack of vision means that it often walks or swims into walls and other obstacles. Once it catches a prey's scent, however, it is frighteningly swift and accurate in its pursuit.

entry: 它们已被驯养成沙地上的交通伙伴，能拉着训练家的滑橇，安全穿越辽阔沙漠。
author: cristata
source: These Pokémon have been domesticated and trained as a form of transportation in sandy areas, pulling their Trainers' sleds safely across vast deserts.

entry: 它们已被驯养成沙地上的交通伙伴，能拉着训练家的滑橇，安全穿越辽阔沙漠。
author: cristata
source: These Pokémon have been domesticated and trained as a form of transportation in sandy areas, pulling their Trainers' sleds safely across vast deserts.

entry: 毛茸茸的护符，让POKENAME始终平心静气。可谁若拿走护符，它就会发怒，不惜一切夺回来。
author: thefinalkalgonus
source: The fluffy amulet POKENAME has is used to keep it calm all the time, but, if taken away, it will get angry and do anything to get it back.

entry: POKENAME没有三首树那样的长颈，也不能像三首恶龙一样飞，却仍执着地，试着捕捉通常够不着的飞行猎物。
author: stevethebarbarian
source: POKENAME doesn't have a long neck like Hytor, nor can it fly like Hydreigon. However, it still obsessively tries to catch flying prey that's usually out of reach.

entry: POKENAME举止古怪，随时在怯懦与好斗之间切换。有人认为，它戴的头骨，各有性格，影响行动，使它违背本性。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME behaves oddly, switching between meekness and aggression at random. Some believe the skull it wears has its own personality, influencing POKENAME's actions and making it act against its nature.

entry: POKENAME更精细地控制蓝色毒气，借此获得，极其敏锐的空间感知。不论眼前狩猎是否成功，它始终格外偏爱，龙属性宝可梦。
author: beatdoof
source: Having a more refined control over its blue toxic emissions, POKENAME utilizes its gas to achieve hypersensitive spatial awareness. Regardless of its immediate hunting success, it has a distinct preference for Dragon-type Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME的几个头虽然凶猛，却都是尽责的父母，对幼崽关怀备至。它们的孩子脾气暴躁，够得着什么就扑咬什么。
author: mistymagius
source: Despite their ferocious nature, POKENAME's heads are very supportive parents and treat their offspring with the utmost care. Their offspring are temperamental and will maul anything they can reach.

entry: 暴怒时，POKENAME的两个头，会朝相反方向，发出破坏光线。因此，许多人类与宝可梦，都不愿招惹它。
author: mepp.
source: When enraged, both of POKENAME's heads unleash Hyper Beams in opposite directions. As a result, many Pokémon and people alike leave it alone.

entry: POKENAME脾气宽和，帮较暴躁的乘客，渡过大片水域。不过，两个头，常会争执，该往哪个方向游。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME are tolerant Pokémon who help transport more aggressive passengers across large bodies of water. The two heads are known to fight over the proper direction to swim to.

entry: POKENAME出现在电脑屏幕上，通常是想尽量多地，吞食、毁坏数据。可两个头经常内讧，减弱了破坏，也让它更容易应付。
author: sk372
source: When POKENAME appears on a computer screen, it's typically to eat and destroy as much data as it can. Its two heads often get into conflict with each other, however, lessening its efforts and making it easier to deal with.

entry: POKENAME喜欢与别人玩游戏，两个头，却总争论玩什么。往往等争吵结束，原本要陪它的玩伴，早已走了。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME enjoys playing games with others, but its two heads squabble over what games to play. Oftentimes, its prospective playmate has left by the time the two heads have finished fighting amongst themselves.

entry: 两个头，面对危险，反应截然不同。因此，它的火焰一抬起，很难分清，是防备着想逃，还是准备凶狠地进攻。
author: sk372
source: The two heads have contrasting personalities in response to danger. As such, it is very difficult to tell whether its flames rearing up is a sign of it becoming defensive and wanting to flee, or preparing to get aggressive and go on the attack.

entry: POKENAME的两个头，性格与目的相反。一头想帮用户，另一头却想毁坏数据，双方不停内斗，闹出许多乱子。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's personality is split between two heads with opposing motives. One wishes to help users, the other wants to destroy data. As such, they fight against each other constantly, causing havoc.

entry: POKENAME爱画画，两个头，却偏好相反的创作理念。它们为画什么，争吵不休，把作品，也撕成碎片。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME love to draw, but each head enjoys opposite concepts. This leads to both heads arguing over what to make, ripping their art into pieces.

entry: POKENAME的两个头，常想向不同方向蜿蜒前进，因此，极少真正走到哪里。
author: im_quinn
source: POKENAME's two heads often try to slither in different directions. Very rarely does it actually get anywhere.

entry: POKENAME多了一颗头，产奶量也翻了一倍。两颗头常比赛，看谁一天产的奶更多。
author: dodoowner_
source: Since it has double the heads, POKENAME produces two times more milk. The heads often compete who can produce more milk in a day.

entry: 两个失明的头，一闻见或听见有东西靠近，POKENAME的两条长颈，就会一起扑去，常把小身体弄倒。幸好身体强韧，很少因此受伤。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's long necks will both lunge towards anything that comes close, as soon as the two blind heads smell or hear it. This frequently causes POKENAME's small body to topple over, although it is so tough that this rarely harms it.

entry: POKENAME住在深挖地下的暗隧道，不需要视力。它主要用角敲岩辨路，只听声音，就能察觉石中的薄弱处。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME lives in dark tunnels that it digs deep underground, so it has no need to see. It navigates mostly by tapping against rock with its horns, sensing weak points in the stone simply from the sound it makes.

entry: 唯一能限制POKENAME狂暴破坏的，是两个头，似乎永远无法同意前进方向。它左右摇晃，往往向前，走不了多少。
author: .jerden
source: The only thing limiting the destructiveness of POKENAME's rampages is the fact that its two heads seem to be incapable of agreeing on which direction to go in. POKENAME will lurch from side to side, often making little progress forward.

entry: POKENAME虽然失明，听觉却格外敏锐。它借洞壁蹬跳，在洞穴网络中穿行，迅速掠过黑暗。
author: .izik
source: Despite its blindness, POKENAME's hearing is exceptionally sharp. It traverses cave systems by jumping off walls, allowing it to move swiftly through the darkness.

entry: POKENAME的咬击，会让被咬的数据，暂时出错。两头不和，常互相咬，连它自己的行为，也变得更加紊乱。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME possesses a bite that causes data bitten to become temporarily buggy. The two heads do not get along, often biting each other and causing POKENAME itself to behave in a more buggy manner.

entry: POKENAME看不见，出手常打偏，并不擅长战斗，主要靠身上的尖刺伤敌。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME are not great fighters, as they usually miss their target because they can't see. It relies on its spikes to hurt enemies.

entry: POKENAME皮肤干燥、受到刺激时，两头就更爱争斗。训练家只要让它身上，始终有水或泥，保持湿润，就能让它相对平静。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's two heads get more confrontational with each other as its skin dries out and becomes irritated. Trainers can keep it relatively calm by making sure it always remains hydrated with water or mud on its body.

entry: POKENAME两个头，始终不和，随时争吵、打斗。唯一能一致的，就是对训练家的喜爱与忠诚。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's two heads are constantly at odds, arguing and fighting each other at any given moment. The only thing both can agree on is their affection and devotion to their Trainer.

entry: POKENAME坚硬的壳里，只有一个大脑，分为两半，各控制一个头。平时大多合作，可不确定该怎么做时，两头就可能打起来。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME has a single large brain inside its hard shell, split into two hemispheres that each control a different head. While they mostly work together, they may fight if POKENAME is unsure of the best course of action to take.

entry: POKENAME厚厚的皮，摸起来粗糙。若逆向摩擦，锋利得连石头，都能刮碎。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's thick skin is rough to the touch. It is sharp enough to shred through stone if rubbed the wrong way.

entry: POKENAME的整个身体都受背上两颗头控制。若它受伤，两颗头就会缩回灌木丛。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: The two heads on POKENAME's back control the whole body. If POKENAME is injured the heads will retreat into the bushes.

entry: POKENAME不断迁徙，从不久留一处。虽然适应寒冷，一头却喜欢暖地，因此，它们常离开最适宜的气候，在高温里苦苦挣扎。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME are migratory Pokémon, never staying in one place for long. Although it is well-suited to cold environments, one of its heads prefers warmer climates, so they can be found far outside their optimal climate, struggling in the heat.

entry: POKENAME有两个巨大鼻子，却被观察到，只有一个大脑。它被构造成只会嗅闻，无法使用其他感官。
author: mary_the_jane
source: POKENAME has two massive noses but has been observed to only have one brain. It is unable to use any of the other senses as it has been built simply to smell.

entry: POKENAME的两个头，常争抢剑的归属，一决斗，就召来暗天与大雪。据说，唯有具备真正力量与决心的训练家，才能驯服、安抚它们。
author: chiiaseeds_
source: The two POKENAME heads often compete for ownership of their sword, summoning dark skies and heavy snow whenever they duel. It is said that only a Trainer who embodies true strength and resolution can tame them and put them at ease.

entry: POKENAME通过手臂，引导黑暗能量，发出能撕穿几乎一切的强力冲击。它极其残酷，会毫不留情，攻击无辜宝可梦。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME channels dark energy through its arms, producing powerful blasts that shred through just about anything. It is an incredibly cruel Pokémon, mercilessly attacking innocent Pokémon.

entry: 两头总对前进方向，有不同意见，常让POKENAME飞行时，撞上树木或建筑。它力量极强，只有意志坚定的训练家，才能驯服。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its two heads constantly disagree on which direction to take, often causing it to crash into trees or buildings while flying. POKENAME possesses immense strength, and only determined Trainers can tame it.

entry: 两个头难以合作，甚至用各自触须，抽打彼此。只有战斗或进食时，才会配合，唯一目标，就是解决共同的敌人。
author: infinex21
source: Their two heads struggle to cooperate and will even lash at one another with their respective feelers. Only during battle or when trying to eat will their heads work together, for the sole goal of dispatching their mutual foes.

entry: POKENAME能将背上长出的两个头，如导弹般发射。两头会竞争，看谁先撞上目标。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are able to launch the two heads sprouting from their back like missiles. Each head competes with the other to be the first to make impact with their target.

entry: POKENAME一靠近，就很容易察觉，因为两个头，总在彼此低吼、撕咬。一头脸颊带着烧痕，也十分常见。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: It's easy to tell when POKENAME are nearby as their two heads are always growling or snapping at each other. It's common to see one head with burn marks on its cheek.

entry: POKENAME的两个头，会争吵好几个小时。一头受够了，就把另一头的拉链拉上，封住对方。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME spend hours bickering amongst their heads. When one gets fed up, they will zip the other head shut.

entry: 多了两个头，让原有的脾气问题，更加严重。很少能见POKENAME的头之间，没有正凶狠地打上一场。
author: sk372
source: The addition of two more heads has further exacerbated the attitude problems it possessed. Rarely is POKENAME seen without one of its heads aggressively duking it out with another.

entry: POKENAME战斗时，两个头的獠牙常会互相勾住，难受至极。POKENAME通常不得不折断自己的獠牙，才不至于一直卡着。
author: mistymagius
source: In combat, POKENAME's two heads often get their tusks interlocked, causing them severe discomfort. POKENAME will usually have to break their own tusks to make sure they don't get stuck.

entry: POKENAME两头不和时，不会自己解决，反而狂暴地攻击旁人，宣泄烦恼。吃得越多，激光就越强，因此，它们总争抢食物。
author: soup1900
source: When the two heads of POKENAME don't get along, they solve their frustrations by attacking others in a rampage rather than solving the issue among themselves. They constantly fight over food since the more they eat, the stronger their lasers become.

entry: POKENAME曾被认为灭绝，后来，却在冰墙后发现了族群，严寒迫使两头暂时停战。如今解冻，古老的对立再起，为每一口食物，凶狠互咬。
author: eiskitsune
source: Thought extinct, a population of POKENAME was found behind a wall of ice where the cold had forced a temporary truce. Now thawed, the two heads have resumed their ancient rivalry, violently snapping at one another over every scrap of food.

entry: POKENAME闷在废弃建筑和住宅里，不时发出哀嚎。借助人偶，它们能轻易发现闯入者，迅速保护家园。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME brood in abandoned buildings and homes, periodically giving a mournful howl. Using their doll, they can spot interlopers with ease, allowing POKENAME to swiftly protect their home.

entry: 夜间飞行，POKENAME的几个头，有时争论该往哪里，令轨迹转向。突然的转弯，让身后闪亮的轨迹，画出新月般的形状。
author: sk372
source: During its nighttime flights, POKENAME's heads will sometimes argue over which direction to go, causing a shift in trajectory. These sudden turns cause the sparkling trails it leaves behind to form a shape similar to a crescent moon.

entry: POKENAME两头总是饥饿，食物不够分享，就会互咬争夺。虽然双方常留下伤痕，却也让它们更强韧，提高战斗技巧。
author: .jerden
source: Both of POKENAME's heads are constantly hungry, and if there is not enough food to share, they will fight over it by biting each other. Although this often leaves both of them with scars, it toughens them up and improves their fighting skills.

entry: POKENAME几乎失明，却用出色听觉，感知周围。尾部鳞片，锋利如刃，轻易劈开大理石，让它成为强敌。
author: .izik
source: Though nearly blind, POKENAME uses its superior hearing to sense the world around it. The scale on its tail is sharp as a blade and can cleave marble with ease, making it a formidable opponent.

entry: POKENAME的双头，只有战斗时，才能好好合作。若没有不断切磋的陪练，分散注意，它们就会凶狠互斗，常在颈部，留下伤痕。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's twin heads can only cooperate properly in combat. If not sated with constant sparring partners to keep it distracted, they will fight with each other viciously, often leaving scars along their necks.

entry: POKENAME几乎全盲，却能靠声音震动颈边的细毛，感知世界。若被逼入绝境，它就从第二个头，放出龙息。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME is almost entirely blind, but it can sense the world around it based on the tiny hairs around its neck vibrating from sounds. Should it get cornered, it will unleash a Dragon Breath from its second head.

entry: POKENAME对光极其敏感。一头有头发遮眼，略能保护，另一头却没有，因此，常受到过强刺激。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are incredibly sensitive to light. While one head has mild protection with hair covering their eyes, the other head has no such protection and often gets overstimulated.

entry: POKENAME对光极其敏感。一头天生有毛层护眼，另一头，却得把脑袋倒过来，给眼睛遮光。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are extremely sensitive to light. While one head has a natural layer of fur protecting their eyes, the other head has to flip their head upside down to shade their eyes.

entry: POKENAME智力与超能力都很强，可双头好斗，妨碍专注。两头争斗时，超能力会胡乱发出，将周围闹得一片混乱。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has great intellect and psychic powers, but the combativeness of its two heads negatively affects its concentration. As the heads fight, its psychic powers fire at random and cause chaos to its surroundings.

entry: POKENAME两个头，各控制一条手臂与一条腿。可两头不和，让战斗风格，十分混乱、失调。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's two heads each control one of its arms and legs. Because the two heads do not get along, this causes its fighting style to be very haphazard and uncoordinated.

entry: POKENAME常成双成对吊在树上。它的毒，足以致命。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME are usually found in pairs, hanging from a tree. Its toxins can be lethal.

entry: POKENAME两头分工，一头报出目标位置，另一头发射高压水柱。可一旦打偏，哪怕正在战斗，也会立刻吵起来。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its two heads divide tasks: one declares the target's position while the other fires high-pressure water jets. If POKENAME misses, the two heads start arguing even in the middle of a fight.

entry: POKENAME的两个头，都看不见周围，靠灵敏鼻子找食物，常常跟不上，同群的其他伙伴。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have two heads that are blind to the world around them. They rely on their powerful noses to locate food and often struggle to keep up with other members of their flock.

entry: POKENAME三个头，似乎永远不认同该往哪走。看得见的头，总想快走，另外两头失明，却总为该跟哪条气味，争吵不休。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have three heads that never seem to agree on where to go. The head that is able to see always wants to move quickly, while the other two heads are blind and always bicker about which scent trail they should follow.

entry: POKENAME每条颈上，都有三个头，其中两个，通常不省人事。中央的颈，负责多数身体机能，右边只感到愤怒，左边则只使用超能力。
author: stevethebarbarian
source: Each of POKENAME's necks has three heads, two of which are usually unconscious. The central neck runs most bodily functions, the right only feels rage, and the left only uses psychic powers.

entry: POKENAME以惊人的速度，穿过洞穴网络。还远没看见身影，回荡的啜泣声，就已宣告它的靠近。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME races through cave systems at tremendous speed. Its echoing sobs announce its approach long before it is seen.

entry: 这些宝可梦放出的蓝气，是特殊毒素，极易激怒龙属性宝可梦。虽然有人因此觉得危险，仍有研究者，探索气体的其他用途。
author: infinex21
source: The blue gas expelled by these Pokémon is a special toxin that is known to agitate Dragon-type Pokémon with great ease. Although this makes them be considered dangerous to some, others still research other possible uses for these gases.

entry: POKENAME有节奏地摆动副头，让人不禁一起点头。主头的声音甜美，副头的声音却阴暗邪恶，常会说出，它真正的意图。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME bobs its extra heads rhythmically, causing people to bob their heads in unison with them. While the main head has a nice and lovely voice, the extra heads have dark, sinister voices that often speak the Pokémon's true intentions.

entry: POKENAME侵入网络空间，似乎只想尽可能毁掉数据。破坏力惊人，得派出专门的多边兽融合体小队，应付它。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME invades cyberspace, with its only goal seeming to be destroying as much data as it can. Specialized teams of Porygon fusions are dispatched to deal with its impressive destructive power.

entry: POKENAME不耐烦地等待进化完成，好能毁坏周围。破坏冲动太强，即使身体几乎不能动，也要摇摆撞向附近一切，宣泄欲望。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME impatiently waits for evolution to finish so that it can lay waste to its surroundings. Its destructive tendency is so great that it will swing its nearly immobile body at anything nearby in an attempt to vent those urges.

entry: POKENAME走到哪里，就召来暗风暴与巨大龙卷，降下毁灭。形如它头部、雷鸣不休的黑云，会预告到来，让人有时间撤离，免遭大规模毁坏。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME rains destruction by summoning dark storms and large tornadoes wherever it goes. Dark, thundering clouds in the shape of POKENAME's head foretell its arrival and give time for evacuation before it creates mass oblivion.

entry: POKENAME用颈部宝石，召来猛烈龙卷与倾盆大雨，释放破坏天性。多只若聚在一处，就很可能引发，全面的气候灾难。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME unleashes its destructive nature by summoning violent tornadoes and torrential downpours using the gem on its neck. If multiple individuals gather in one place, a full-blown climate disaster is likely to ensue.

entry: 野外，POKENAME常与快龙交锋。快龙保护人类，抵御它无休止的破坏与凶暴，使双方在各地，展开恶战。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME clashes often with Dragonite in the wild. The latter protects humans from the former's endless capacity for destruction and aggression, leading to vicious battles across the lands.

entry: POKENAME爱恶作剧，会派出无人机，偷衣服等捣乱。无人机一受伤，它就会陷入，不顾一切的狂怒。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are mischievous, using their drones to pull pranks such as stealing laundry. Should the drones be injured, POKENAME flies into a mindless rage.

entry: 这只宝可梦恶意满满，脾性难测。毛皮仿佛有自己的意识，稍受惊动或兴奋，就会燃烧起来。
author: vaporvenator
source: A malicious and unpredictable Pokémon. Its fur coat seemingly has a mind of its own, igniting at the slightest disturbance or excitement.

entry: 破坏本能，驱使POKENAME毁掉线球等宝可梦织的网。它自己由前肢头部吐出的丝网，则有极强的腐蚀性。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's destructive tendencies compel it to destroy the webs created by other Pokémon like Spinarak. Its own webbing, spun by the heads on its front limbs, is highly caustic.

entry: POKENAME潜伏在森林的阴影里，布下种种陷阱，将猎物骗进蛛网。它常用尾巴迷惑对方，让自己显得比实际更小。
author: thepandasharky
source: POKENAME lurks in the shadows of forests, making various traps to trick and catch prey in its webs. It often uses its tail to make others think that it is smaller than it actually is.

entry: POKENAME被无尽怒火吞噬，想将一切化成泥。它用浊流，倾泻成加仑的水，覆盖葱郁大地，抬高地下水位，直到宛如沼泽。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME are consumed by a relentless rage to turn everything to mud. They use Muddy Water to cover lush landscapes in gallons of water, raising the water table until it resembles a marshland.

entry: POKENAME被无尽怒火吞噬，想将一切化成泥。它用浊流，倾泻成加仑的水，覆盖葱郁大地，抬高地下水位，直到宛如沼泽。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME are consumed by a relentless rage to turn everything to mud. They use Muddy Water to cover lush landscapes in gallons of water, raising the water table until it resembles a marshland.

entry: 它残酷又善操纵，常蛊惑别人效力，也能召来暗影龙，充作使魔。攻击时，将精神力量，穿过冠上水晶，送入邪恶的法杖。
author: deadshields
source: A cruel and manipulative Pokémon, it is well known for bewitching others into serving it and summoning shadowy dragons as familiars. It channels psychic power through its crown's crystal and into its corrupt staff to attack.

entry: 背部双翼，拍得足够快，能让沉重金属身体升空。它的双腿，用来推动移动，而非支撑体重。
author: .jerden
source: The wings on its back beat rapidly enough to lift its heavy metal body into the air. It uses its legs to push itself around, rather than to support its own weight.

entry: 头上的嘴太小，满足不了贪婪的食欲。它用手臂上锋利的金属颚进食，不过，上面的亮点，并不是真眼睛。
author: .jerden
source: The mouth on its head is too small for its ravenous appetite.  It eats food using sharp metal jaws on its arms, although the bright spots on them are not actually eyes.

entry: 传统上，POKENAME被视为毁灭先兆，族群总在火山喷发前抵达。研究者发现，它们只是对地壳活动敏感，有机会，就偏爱吃新鲜熔岩。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are traditionally seen as harbingers of destruction, populations arriving in an area just before a volcanic eruption. Researchers have found they are simply sensitive to tectonic activity, preferring to feed on fresh lava when possible.

entry: POKENAME收集各类骨头，用触手操纵，既显得可怕，也作为伪装。骨头虽重，它们却仍是，游泳好手。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME gather bones of all kinds, puppetting them with their tentacles to seem intimidating and to use as camouflage. Despite the weight of these bones, POKENAME are adept swimmers.

entry: POKENAME将主头藏在高草，用副头，让自己看起来没那么危险。捕食者一靠近，试图下手，它就整个昂起，抓住对方，将其撕碎。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME hides its main head beneath tall grass, using its extra heads to seem less dangerous. When a predator comes close and tries to hunt it, POKENAME rears up in full to snatch them and tear them apart.

entry: POKENAME象鼻末端的头，嗅觉极其敏锐，充当鼻子。尾部的头，则充当眼睛，吃东西时，总高高举向天空，留意危险。
author: santon5512
source: The head at the end of POKENAME's trunk has an incredible sense of smell, acting as these Pokémon's nose. The head on their tails acts as their eyes, always raised high in the sky while they eat to look out for danger.

entry: 程序员想到POKENAME出现在电脑里，就头痛。它放出两架无人机，随机破坏、删除数据，主身则怀着阴险的喜悦，欣赏混乱。
author: sk372
source: Programmers dread the thought of seeing a POKENAME appear in their computer. It sics its two drones to corrupt and delete random data, while the main body watches the chaos with sinister glee.

entry: POKENAME每个头，都有不同性格。另两个头，分别表现不同情绪，中间的头，却总是烦躁又饥饿。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Each head of a POKENAME exhibit different personalities. While the other two heads each display a different emotion, the middle head is always irritably hungry.

entry: 吃下POKENAME的蛋，人类与宝可梦，都会以暴力为乐。它会将蛋，随意赠给认定太过被动的对象，似乎很享受，随后引起的混乱。
author: .jerden
source: Eating POKENAME's egg will make both people and Pokémon take joy in violence. POKENAME freely offers it as a gift to anyone it thinks is too passive, and seems to enjoy watching the chaos that results from this.

entry: POKENAME用风暴云，引导三条黑暗之龙的能量。许多训练家，惊叹它的优雅，写诗致敬。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME use storm clouds to channel the energy of three dark dragons. In awe of their grace, many Trainers write poems in tribute to them.

entry: POKENAME不停向敌人喷火，连灰烬也烧尽，原处只剩焦石。它们毫不在乎地穿过火焰，还常故意这样做，助长野火。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME are known to relentlessly breathe fire onto foes until even the ashes burn away, leaving nothing but scorched stone where they stood. POKENAME will run through flames without a care, often doing it on purpose to cause wildfires to spread.

entry: POKENAME用三个头，吞掉够得着的一切，连脚下的地面，也不放过。进化前，从不停止进食，因此，常待在自己挖出的深坑底。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME uses all three of its heads to devour anything within reach, including the ground beneath it. It never stops eating until it evolves, and so POKENAME is usually found at the bottom of a deep pit it has dug.

entry: POKENAME悬浮的壳，似乎中空，却仍坚硬得能压碎，撞上的一切。它从双臂末端，喷出黑暗脉冲，推进身体。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's floating shell appears to be hollow, although it is still hard enough to crush anything it collides with. It propels itself around by expelling pulses of darkness from the ends of its arms.

entry: POKENAME不在乎，挡路的人类与宝可梦，臂端的头，靠近什么就咬。虽然常引来反击，却少有宝可梦，能穿过岩甲，真正伤到它。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME has no regard for people or Pokémon that get in its way, and the heads at the ends of its arms will snap at anything that gets close. While it often provokes retaliation, few Pokémon are strong enough to injure it through its rocky armor.

entry: POKENAME拍动六只黑翼，卷起沙暴，遮住太阳。它似乎偏爱暗处捕猎，三个头的红眼，都极善在微光下看清。
author: .jerden
source: By flapping its six black wings, POKENAME can whip up a sandstorm to obscure the sun. It seems to prefer to hunt in the dark, as its three heads' red eyes all have excellent vision in low-light conditions.

entry: POKENAME极其好斗，头部花纹，先以恐惧吓僵敌人，再连番猛攻。有时，人们会用它蜕下的皮，装饰恐怖主题节庆。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME are highly aggressive creatures. The patterns on their heads are used to petrify their foes with fear before releasing an onslaught of attacks. Sometimes, a POKENAME's shed skin is used as decoration during horror-inspired festivals.

entry: POKENAME脑小，常忘了最初为何生气。凭压倒性的力量，不动脑也能战斗，既投巨石，也会角朝前，盲目冲撞。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: Due to their small brains, POKENAME often forget why they are angered in the first place. Their insurmountable power allows them to battle without thinking. POKENAME battle by hurling boulders and mindlessly charging into foes horn-first.

entry: 中央头，利用两条尾巴末端的头，同时看向多个方向。两头一咬住同一个敌人，就会接成电路，发出高压电击。
author: .jerden
source: The heads on the ends of its two tails are used by the central head to look in multiple directions at the same time. When both of them bite down on the same foe, it completes an electrical circuit and delivers a high-voltage shock.

entry: POKENAME的双臂，既能射出黑暗脉冲，也能射出闪烁的红色火球。它用来远攻，或向地面发射，推动身体，飞过空中。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's arms fire out pulses of darkness as well as balls of flickering red fire. POKENAME can use these to attack foes from a distance or fire them down at the ground to propel its body through the air.

entry: POKENAME平时胆怯，一蜷成球，性格却会转变。它变得大胆好斗，四处猛撞，唯一目的，就是造成破坏。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is usually timid, but undergoes a shift in personality when it curls up into a ball. It becomes emboldened and aggressive, careening into things for the sole purpose of causing damage.

entry: POKENAME三头同时攻击所有弱点，无论对方属性，都能造成巨大伤害。双翼发出的冲击波，毁坏附近一切，再吞掉残余。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME attacks opponents for massive damage regardless of their typing by using its three heads simultaneously to strike all weak points. Its wings unleash shock waves that bring oblivion to everything nearby before it consumes all that remains.

entry: POKENAME从两个副头，发出声呐，轻松穿过漆黑洞穴。偶尔，身体会抽搐，副头完全脱落，悬浮附近，再返回本体。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME releases sonar from its two extra heads to navigate pitch-black caves with ease. Occasionally, its body convulses, and these heads detach entirely, hovering nearby before returning to the body.

entry: POKENAME性情无情，看见其他宝可梦，第一反应，就是用精神力量压碎。只有训练家，不受凶性针对，可攻击欲，仍会转向靠近者。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME possesses a ruthless personality, its first instinct upon seeing other Pokémon being to crush them with its mental powers. Only its Trainer is exempt from its aggression, and even then POKENAME redirects it towards those who get too close.

entry: POKENAME同时充满保护与破坏的冲动。情绪相冲，让它随便找个借口，就过度攻击，任何对训练家，哪怕只有一丝威胁的存在。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is filled with a simultaneous mixture of protective and destructive urges. This conflict of emotions causes it to use any excuse to excessively attack anything that poses even a remote threat to its Trainer.

entry: POKENAME用超能力，撕开周围地形，宣泄破坏欲。似乎只有训练家安全，因为在对方面前，它才会克制这些冲动。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME vents destructive urges by using its psychic powers to tear apart the terrain all around it. Only its Trainer seems to be free from danger, as it manages to reign in those urges while in their presence.

entry: 有些故事说，这些三头宝可梦，拥有来自异界的黑暗力量，连灵魂本身，也能切开。它们用臂刃，极其精准地作战，始终掌握，眼前所有敌人的动向。
author: infinex21
source: Some stories claim that these three-headed Pokémon wield a dark, otherworldly power that allows them to cut into the very souls of others. They fight with extreme precision using their arm blades, always keeping track of any foes they face.

entry: POKENAME胸前骨头般的纤毛，不停摆动，发出诡异的窸窣声。为保护内藏的心脏，它凶狠抽击靠近者，从翼上的土居忍士头，放出光鞭攻击。
author: kungfucutbug
source: The bone-like cilia on POKENAME's chest constantly oscillate with an eerie chittering sound. To protect its heart hidden inside, it violently thrashes anything that gets close to it, attacking with whips of light from the Nincada heads on its wings.

entry: POKENAME三个头，各有大脑，彼此连接，带来高超智力与协调。两头进攻，吸引敌人注意，为第三头，创造可乘之隙。
author: .jerden
