source: All three of POKENAME's heads have their own brain, and are connected together to give it great intelligence and coordination. Two of them will attack to draw a foe's attention, creating an opening for the third head to exploit.

entry: POKENAME三个头，不停咬合、咆哮，常让敌人分神，忘了它还有手臂。它便趁机，突然挥出肢体，力道堪比卡车。
author: .jerden
source: The constant snapping and roaring of POKENAME's three heads often distracts foes so much that they forget about POKENAME's arms. POKENAME will take advantage of this oversight by suddenly swinging one of its limbs with the force of a truck.

entry: POKENAME五个头，各有大脑，能独立攻击，也能交流，协调攻势。它残酷而务实，为赢，什么战术都肯用。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's five heads each have their own brain, enabling them to attack independently, although they can communicate with each other to coordinate attacks. POKENAME is brutally pragmatic and will use whatever tactic is necessary to win.

entry: POKENAME破坏欲极强，冲动难以抑制时，就会现形，裹住最近的东西，在幽灵身体内部，将其撕碎。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has overwhelming destructive urges, manifesting when those urges are too much to resist. It envelops the closest thing it can find and tears it apart within its spectral body.

entry: POKENAME一打起来，就成了毁灭的力量，击倒敌人时，胡乱释放波导，毫不在意附带破坏。有人说，手上的头，会逼它尽可能凶暴。
author: sk372
source: The moment POKENAME gets into a fight it becomes a force of destruction, blasting its aura around with no regards for collateral damage while taking down a foe. Some say the heads on its hands compel it to be as violent as possible.

entry: POKENAME用黑暗波导，攻击、惩罚那些，它们认为心怀正义的人。因此，许多电影和电视剧，都将它们设为反派。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME use their dark auras to attack and punish the people who they believe have justice in their hearts. Because of this, many movies and TV shows use these Pokémon as their villains.

entry: POKENAME生活在漆黑洞穴，用中央头两侧的突起，感知暗处猎物。发现什么，就穷追不舍，再用三张獠牙巨嘴，一同攻击。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME lives in pitch-black caves, sensing prey in the darkness using the protrusions on either side of its central head. It relentlessly pursues anything it detects, then attacks it with all three of its fanged mouths.

entry: POKENAME能高速、大力地挥动臂端利爪，看见什么，就朝什么劈去。即使没直接击中，产生的风刃，也可能从远处伤到敌人。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME can move the sharp claws at the end of its arms with great speed and force, and will swing them at anything it sees. Even when this does not physically strike foes, the blades of wind this creates may injure them at a distance.

entry: POKENAME异常好斗，战斗时，会将头当导弹发射，让对手中毒。有传闻说，它们是从另一种未来，流落至此的。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME are incredibly aggressive, launching their heads as missiles to poison their opponents in battle. There are rumors that POKENAME are stranded from an alternate future.

entry: 人们认为，POKENAME的两个副头，会怂恿它，屈从暴力、破坏的冲动。它甩出藤蔓，撕倒整片森林，仅仅为了，炫耀力量。
author: sk372
source: It's believed POKENAME's two extra heads goad it into giving in to its destructive, violent impulses. It lashes vines outward and tears down entire forests, for nothing other than as a show of power.

entry: POKENAME披着厚毛，是少数熬过冰河时代的巨型宝可梦之一。不过，猎物大量消失，让它们的数量，也逐渐减少。
author: bigoljax
source: With their thick fur, POKENAME were one of the few surviving megafauna Pokémon after the ice age. However, their populations dwindled due to mass losses of prey.

entry: POKENAME有三个头，食物充足，就能以惊人速度吞食。臂端的头，却常睡着，得中央头，将它们摇醒。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME has three heads, so when food is plentiful, it can devour it with incredible speed. The heads at the ends of its arms frequently fall asleep and must be shaken by the central head to wake them up.

entry: POKENAME有三个头，食物充足，就能以惊人速度吞食。臂端的头，却常睡着，得中央头，将它们摇醒。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME has three heads, so when food is plentiful, it can devour it with incredible speed. The heads at the ends of its arms frequently fall asleep and must be shaken by the central head to wake them up.

entry: 陪伴POKENAME的两条幽灵蛇，完全受它控制，会被派去攻击附近敌人。身体虽然虚幻，痛苦的咬击，却能吸走生命力。
author: .jerden
source: The two spectral serpents that accompany POKENAME are completely under its control, and it will send them out to attack nearby foes. While their bodies are insubstantial, their painful bites drain life force.

entry: 据报告，POKENAME暴怒时，能额外幻出最多一千个头。这些虚影，完美同步地攻击，再消失得无影无踪。
author: .izik
source: When enraged, POKENAME has been reported to manifest up to 1,000 additional heads. These apparitions strike in perfect unison before vanishing without trace.

entry: POKENAME不停长出新头，却一次只能养活两颗，只好丢掉多余的。人们推测，这些头会像种子一样，孕育新生。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: POKENAME grows new heads constantly. It can only feed two at a time, however, so it discards spare heads. It's thought the spares are used like seeds.

entry: POKENAME出了名地危险，训练家很难与之合作。意志不够坚定，可能被压倒，遭自己的伙伴附身。危险太大，至今，仍未找到解决办法。
author: archangelsookami
source: POKENAME are infamously dangerous for Trainers to work with. Those without sufficiently strong wills have been known to become overwhelmed and fall under possession by their own POKENAME. No solution has been discovered due to this danger.

entry: POKENAME尾端的头，没有自己的大脑，供主头在捕猎时，留意背后动静。
author: .jerden
source: The head on the end of POKENAME's tail does not have a brain of its own. It is used by the main head to watch its own back as it hunts for prey.

entry: POKENAME两条尾巴末端的头，不仅能看向任何方向，也能举高，从上往下观察，发现藏在掩护后面的猎物。
author: .jerden
source: In addition to looking around in any direction, the two heads on the ends of POKENAME's tails can be lifted up to give it a view from above. This can enable POKENAME to spot prey hiding behind cover.

entry: 这种宝可梦，更像传说，而非实物。POKENAME战斗时，放出阵阵火焰，先让较小的生物体攻击，再由中央头，一口定胜负。
author: lootererswillbeboated
source: This Pokémon is considered more myth than real. When POKENAME fights, it releases bursts of flame and strikes with its smaller organisms before the middle head delivers a decisive crunch.

entry: POKENAME的中央头，专注导航，飞行时，通常直望前方。若俯冲到地面附近，臂端的头，就会盲目攻击，够得着的一切。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's central head focuses on navigation and usually looks straight ahead while POKENAME flies. If it swoops down close to the ground, the heads at the end of its arms will mindlessly attack anything within reach.

entry: 中央头咬合力最强，不过，POKENAME三个头，都能用利齿与火息攻击。多数其他宝可梦，一听见三头齐吼，就会逃跑。
author: .jerden
source: While the central head has the most powerful bite, all three of POKENAME's heads can attack with their sharp teeth and fiery breath. Most other Pokémon  flee as soon as they hear the three of them roaring in unison.

entry: 它用三个头，吞掉找到的所有食物，也彻底解决任何敌人。它讨厌分享，连训练家的关注，也不例外，会用众多触须抽打别人，想全部独占。
author: infinex21
source: It uses its three heads to devour all food it can find and to thoroughly dispatch any foes. It hates to share, even the attention of its own Trainer, and lashes out at others with its many feelers to keep it all to itself.

entry: POKENAME用尾巴，攻击看见的一切，一记重击，敌人、物件，都会被毁掉。狂暴时，连身边的尼多后，想来安抚，也会遭到攻击。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME attacks everything it sees with its tail, destroying both foes and objects alike in one heavy blow. It will even attack its own Nidoqueen in these rampages if they try to calm it down.

entry: POKENAME狂暴凶猛，甲片又耐打，被视为重大威胁。丰缘有些人，因此称它们为，“难以击败的爬行动物”。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are considered major threats on account of wild rampages and durable plating. Some in Hoenn refer to them as hard-to-defeat reptiles because of this.

entry: 这些宝可梦的三个头，常争吵不休，奇怪的是，各自在一天的不同时段，更加活跃。战斗时，三头全都清醒，才显出凶悍力量。
author: infinex21
source: The three heads of these Pokémon are often seen arguing with each other because, strangely, they each seem to be more active during different times of the day. All three heads are fully alert during battle, which is when they display a fierce power.

entry: POKENAME凶性与力量惊人，许多人相信，它能将整个地区，毁坏到无法恢复。只有行动缓慢，限制了这份危险潜能。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's viciousness and strength are strong enough that many believe it could decimate an entire region beyond repair. Its hazardous potential is only hampered by its low mobility.

entry: POKENAME的程序，迫使它不断摧毁周围，直到一无所剩。手臂的龙头炮，射出的能量束，连最强韧的材料，也能直接贯穿。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's programming compels it to destroy its surroundings until nothing is left. The dragon-head cannon on its arm fires energy beams capable of piercing straight through even the strongest materials.

entry: POKENAME背上，连着一个能伸长的三首恶龙头，扫描周围，寻找毁坏目标。随后，三个龙头，会同时射出强大的能量束。
author: sk372
source: An extending Hydreigon head is attached to POKENAME's back. It scans its surroundings for targets to destroy, before all three dragon heads fire powerful energy beams simultaneously.

entry: POKENAME对不喜欢的一切，无端发起攻击。每次狂暴，头部喷出的猛烈火焰，都会造成极其严重的破坏。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME lashes out without reason at anything it doesn't like. Whenever it rampages, it wreaks extreme levels of destruction with the intense flames from its heads.

entry: POKENAME臂端的头，与中央头上的角一样，一击就能压碎钻石。厚皮吸收大部分伤害，让它不惧反击，吞掉沿途一切。
author: soup1900
source: The heads on POKENAME's arms, like the central head's horn, have the power to crush diamonds in one blow. It devours everything in its path without worry of counterattack due to its strong hide absorbing most of the damage.

entry: POKENAME派出探路气球，搜寻可供吞食的受害者。据说，天空中一见它，就预示巨大厄运，因为它凶猛，破坏力又强。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME sends out its explorer balloons to scout for victims to feed on. It is said that spotting one in the sky is a sign of great misfortune due to its ferocious and destructive nature.

entry: POKENAME耳尖上的头颚力极强，能咬碎岩石。它自视甚高，常将石头雕成供自己坐的小王座。
author: jestersqueak
source: The heads on the tips of POKENAME's ears have strong, powerful jaws that are strong enough to break rock. Due to POKENAME's ego, it normally carves stones into small thrones for itself.

entry: 众多附肢，仿佛各是一颗小头，会向路过的人类与宝可梦，张口咬去。它能从肢端，或大张的嘴里，召出火焰，焚烧敌人。
author: infinex21
source: Their many appendages snap at passing people and Pokémon alike as if they were each small heads. It can summon and release flame from the tips of its appendages, or simply from its gaping maw, to incinerate foes.

entry: 臂上的双颚，强得足以咬穿钢铁。POKENAME用这些嘴，抓住敌人，再挥下头部尖刺，以利刃般的尖端，劈斩对方。
author: .jerden
source: The jaws on their arms are strong enough to bite through steel. After seizing a foe with these mouths, POKENAME will bring down the spikes on its head to slash with their razor-sharp points.

entry: 古老传说中，POKENAME会眨眼间突然现身村庄，掀起黑暗飓风，吹走一切。若天空忽然落下许多羽毛，或许是它在上方吃掉了一群猎物。
author: soup1900
source: Legends of the past tell of POKENAME who suddenly show up in villages in the blink of an eye and create dark hurricanes to blow everything away. If an array of feathers suddenly drops out of the sky, a POKENAME may have eaten a flock of prey above.

entry: 融合后，POKENAME多出的头带上了其他龙类宝可梦的特征。这或许说明，这五种生灵都可能由同一位远古祖先进化而来。
author: sk372
source: After fusion, POKENAME's additional heads took on the attributes of other draconic Pokémon. This may suggest the five creatures all might have evolved from a common ancient ancestor.

entry: 融合让POKENAME的破坏欲与攻击性，达到近乎灾难性的程度。极难控制，也极难在对战中击败，许多地区因此禁止将它融合。
author: sk372
source: Fusion has caused POKENAME's destructive and aggressive tendencies to reach near-catastrophic levels. Extremely hard to control or defeat in battle, many regions have outlawed the act of fusing it.

entry: 宝可梦融合让POKENAME长出更多头。传说斩下一颗，就会在原处再长出2颗。力量极强，能从五颗头接连发射龙之波动光束。
author: lupa
source: Pokémon fusion has caused POKENAME to grow more heads. Legends say if one head is cut off, 2 more grow in its place. It is an incredibly powerful Pokémon, launching multiple beams of Dragon Pulse from its five heads.

entry: POKENAME的许愿之力被黑暗污染，凡是获它实现愿望的对象，都会遭到祸乱。看见的一切，都将被凝聚的黑暗轰灭。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's wish power is tainted in darkness, causing mayhem to anyone it grants a wish to. Anything it sees will be annihilated by concentrated bundles of darkness.

entry: POKENAME的头即使被砍下，也能独立活动、生存，本体则重新长出头。每颗头都会吐毒、喷火。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME's heads, if chopped off, can act and live independently while the main body regrows them. Each head can spit venom and breathe fire.

entry: 三个个体原本同出一体，不过较小的无法思考，只会服从较大个体的命令。POKENAME食欲贪婪，吃光沿路的一切，毁掉所有敢挡路的对象。
author: infinex21
source: All three were once the same individual, though the smaller individuals are unable to think and merely follow the orders of the larger ones. POKENAME are voracious Pokémon that consume all in their paths and destroy all that dare try to bar them.

entry: POKENAME的13颗头饥不择食，见什么吃什么，一天就能吞掉整片珊瑚礁。对战时悬在敌人上方，降下数十根令人痛苦的尖刺，恐怖至极。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME is known to dine on entire coral reefs in a single day thanks to its 13 heads all hungrily eating everything in sight. It's a terrifying Pokémon to face in battle since it levitates above foes to rain down dozens of painful spikes onto them.

entry: POKENAME曾肆虐古代苔原，尖锐响亮的叫声常造成永久听力损伤。已知唯一能平息暴走的，就是看见天空形成极光。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME were known to ravage through the ancient tundras, their loud, piercing calls often causing permanent hearing damage. The only thing known to calm these rampages was seeing an aurora forming in the sky.

entry: POKENAME凶猛争夺领地与食物，追求两者时毫不松懈。途中见到什么，往往都会特意冲去攻击。
author: frokachu
source: A savage contender for territory and food, POKENAME are relentless in their hunt for either, and will often go out of their way to attack anything they see in their pursuits.

entry: POKENAME一烦躁，所谓的发型就会散开，露出藏在其中的众多头。像跳催眠舞般摇晃这些头，能把猎物吓得像化了石一样僵住，再吃下去。
author: soup1900
source: When POKENAME gets annoyed, its supposed hairdo unravels, revealing the many heads concealed within. By swaying these heads around like a sort of hypnotic dance, it can frighten prey in place as if they've been turned into stone before eating them.

entry: POKENAME以优美却阴森的歌声产生暗能量，升上空中，指挥周围盘旋的小头。它在漂浮的草叉上起舞，每个动作都会指挥小头使出相应的破坏性攻击。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME uses its lovely yet sinister singing to create dark energy and rise and command small heads that swirl around it. Dancing upon a floating pitchfork, each move it makes directs the heads to perform destructive attacks in a similar way.

entry: POKENAME食量惊人，见什么都咬，连闯进偏远山居的人类也不放过。浮在空中时，会拍动六片翅膀，推动小身体前进。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME has an immense appetite and will bite anything it sees, including any humans who venture into its remote mountain home. While floating in the air, it flaps its six wings to propel its small body forward.

entry: POKENAME一见其他宝可梦，就会高声摇响尾巴，立刻冲锋。通常先出拳脚，却也常突然从某张嘴喷出能量，打敌人一个措手不及。
author: .jerden
source: Whenever POKENAME spots another Pokémon, it immediately charges while loudly rattling its tail. While it usually starts attacking using punches and kicks, it frequently surprises foes by blasting energy out of one of its mouths.

entry: POKENAME战斗不择手段，用卑鄙战术取胜，事后还会残酷折磨对手。暴怒时，会对周围一切使出龙爪，曾将大片森林夷平。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME fights dirty, using underhanded tactics to get the best of its foes and being overly cruel to them afterwards. When enraged, it uses Dragon Claw on everything around it and has been known to level sizable chunks of forest.

entry: POKENAME用法杖烧尽沿途看不顺眼的东西。有人推测，它会预见未来，筹划如何造成最大破坏。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME use their staff to incinerate anything that crosses their path that they don't like. It's theorized that they foresee the future to plot how to cause the most damage.

entry: 缠在POKENAME颈部的头，比中央头更早感知危险，因此率先攻击敌人。它不断射出黑暗气息构成的手里剑，直到敌人被轰得粉碎。
author: soup1900
source: The heads wrapped around POKENAME's neck are the first ones to attack enemies since they can sense danger before the central head can. It repeatedly blasts enemies with shurikens made of dark aura until they are destroyed to bits.

entry: 虽然看着像三只宝可梦，另外两只POKENAME其实只是手臂。手臂看不见，因此必须把真正的头露出地面，才能有效瞄准。
author: cait_sith
source: Although it appears to be three Pokémon, the other two POKENAME are just its arms. These arms are blind, so it needs to have its true head above ground to effectively aim them.

entry: POKENAME所有头的想法似乎都一样。因此总向同一方向挖洞，却也会为吃同一份食物，挡住彼此。
author: .jerden
source: All of POKENAME's heads seem to think alike. This means they always tunnel in the same direction, but it also means they get in each other's way while trying to feed on the same food.

entry: POKENAME游在海底，吃其他宝可梦落下的残渣。三颗头性格各异，一颗与另一颗意见不合，就会起冲突。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME swims at the bottom of the sea to eat falling scraps from other Pokémon. Its three heads have different personalities, which causes conflict when one head disagrees with another.

entry: POKENAME多出的两张脸被困在汤匙里。若与汤匙失去接触，脸就会从手上重新长出，试图杀死主头。
author: epping_forest
source: Its two extra faces are trapped in the spoons. If POKENAME loses touch of the spoons, the faces will regrow from the hands, trying to kill the main head.

entry: 深夜，POKENAME会与人偶杖同步举行诡异仪式，窥见可能的未来。目睹仪式的人，也常看见尚未发生之事的幻象。
author: eiskitsune
source: Late at night, POKENAME performs eerie, synchronized rituals with its marottes, gaining glimpses of possible futures. Witnesses of the ceremony often experience visions of events yet to unfold.

entry: 背上的六条附肢能随意活动，常先按住敌人，再由三颗头喷出暗火轰击。它只会朝中央头注视的方向奔跑。
author: infinex21
source: Its six back appendages can move as it wills them to, often being used to hold down foes before it blasts them with dark fire let loose by its three heads. It will only run in the direction that its central head is looking toward.

entry: POKENAME以超过每小时60英里的速度奔驰，身后留下一路破坏。各颗头不停抢食，常因自身凶性，把自己也伤得很重。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME races across the land at speeds upward of 60 mph, leaving destruction in its wake. Its heads constantly fight over food, often leading it to grievously injure itself because of its own viciousness.

entry: POKENAME发怒时虽残暴至极，平常却更喜欢轻松愉快的战斗。飞头周围的雾气味宜人，能疗养毒属性与钢属性宝可梦，对其他生灵却有毒。
author: adamzwill
source: Though capable of extreme brutality when angered, POKENAME prefers to keep fights light-hearted. The mist surrounding each of its flying heads has a pleasant scent that can be therapeutic to Poison and Steel-type Pokémon, but toxic to others.

entry: POKENAME背部神秘球体中，紫雾不断旋动变幻。临近进化，球内便充满雾气，促使它尽量远离危险，找好地方，再用毒雾填满那里。
author: chibitales
source: The mysterious orb on POKENAME's back swirls and shifts with purple mist. When close to evolution, the orb fills fully with this mist, leading POKENAME to find a spot as far away from danger as it can. It fills the chosen area with a poisonous fog.

entry: POKENAME能在空中高速飞行，加速也极快。想迅速起飞或再提速，就在身后释放爆炸，获得额外推力。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can zip through the air at high rates of speed and acceleration. To take off quickly or give itself a speed boost, it discharges an explosion behind it to grant extra force.

entry: 体内巨量能量，让POKENAME能高速飞行。起飞时，能量爆发轰出一个小坑。
author: sk372
source: The massive amount of energy within POKENAME allows it to reach high speeds while flying. It takes off with an explosive burst of energy that leaves a small crater behind.

entry: POKENAME以超常感知观察水下四周的广阔范围，轻松找到或避开其他宝可梦。有时也会朝袭击者喷墨，救助其他宝可梦。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME use their extrasensory abilities to observe a wide area around themselves underwater, allowing them to easily find or avoid other Pokémon. They sometimes will also save other Pokémon by spraying their attackers with ink.

entry: POKENAME每天在森林家园里疾驰锻炼。运动得太兴奋，常忘记家在哪里。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME speed through their forest home every day for exercise. In the excitement of their exercise, POKENAME often forget where their home is.

entry: POKENAME会在偏远地方独自起舞。释放遮蔽视线的雾，一察觉训练家看见自己，就会瞬间移动离开。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can be found in remote places dancing by themselves. They release a mist that obscures vision and are known to teleport away if they realize they have been seen by a Trainer.

entry: POKENAME是神秘的宝可梦，游到哪里，便在哪里释放奇雾。许多人相信，凝视雾气能看见过去记忆构成的幻象，不过从未证实。
author: operativevalkyrie
source: POKENAME is a mythical Pokémon that releases a strange mist wherever it swims. It is believed by many that looking into the mist causes optical illusions depicting past memories, but this has never been proven.

entry: POKENAME的毛发一变得柔顺平滑，就立刻隐形，因此永远看不到那副模样。若突然出现来源不明、无法解释的静电与触电般的刺麻，就说明它在附近。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME can never be seen with its hair soft and smoothed out since it turns invisible the moment that happens. Sudden static electricity and electrical tingles with no known source or explanation are signs that it is nearby.

entry: POKENAME不断移动，四处寻找食物。成群时十分友善，独处却胆怯。取得信任虽难，据说能带来好运。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME are constantly on the move, looking for food in various places. They are very friendly when in a group, but skittish if alone. Earning their trust, while difficult, is said to bring good luck.

entry: POKENAME身上的蓝火，平常摸着凉爽，却能随意变得炽热。拍翅时，闪烁的光似乎裹住身体，在晴朗蓝天下完全无法看见。
author: .jerden
source: The blue flames on its body normally feel cool, but can burn with heat if POKENAME wills it. As it beats its wings, the shimmering light seems to cloak its body, making it impossible to see against a clear blue sky.

entry: POKENAME以超音速掠过天空，却能不被察觉。会散射照到身体的光，让自己飞过时不露踪迹。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME dart through the sky at supersonic speeds and manage to do so without being detected. By scattering light that reaches their bodies, they can avoid being seen as they zip by.

entry: POKENAME散射周身光线，避开察觉，穿过拥挤地带也不会被看见。许多个体会趁别人不注意，只在孩子眼前现身，恶作剧捉弄他们。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME avoid detection by scattering rays of light around their body, ensuring they slip through crowded areas without being seen. Many play pranks on children by only appearing when no one else is watching.

entry: 身体太小，让POKENAME无法完全飞起来，便改用头上螺旋桨四处飘浮。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Due to their small bodies, POKENAME cannot fully fly. They instead float around using the propeller on their heads.

entry: POKENAME能以惊人速度翱翔天际。但对人类十分友善，也常步行陪在身旁。
author: mary_the_jane
source: POKENAME is able to soar incredibly fast through the sky. However, it is so friendly towards humans, it is not uncommon for it to walk beside them.

entry: POKENAME以接近音速飞过天空，尖声鸣叫，宣告现身。会俯冲介入鸟宝可梦的争斗，试图平息冲突。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME soars through the skies at almost sonic speeds, emitting a sharp cry to announce its presence. It swoops down to interject itself in fights between avian Pokémon, attempting to deescalate the conflict.

entry: POKENAME个头矮小，把比自己高的东西都当山来爬。成功后便欢呼，似乎盼望训练家为自己骄傲。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Because of their short stature, POKENAME treat objects that are taller than them as mountains to climb. If they succeed, they cheer, seemingly hopeful that their Trainer is proud of them.

entry: POKENAME只曾在城都偏远地区被人看见。据说，巫女服饰的样式，便来自它的翅膀与流苏。
author: staghorn
source: POKENAME have only ever been seen in remote parts of the Johto region. It is said that a shrine maiden's garb is based on its wings and tassels.

entry: POKENAME精通飞行，几乎一瞬就能从起飞达到极速，也能停下。盘旋巡视领地内的大片森林，俯冲阻止任何捕食林中宝可梦的行为。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has mastered flight, able to take off to max speed and stop itself almost instantly. It circles large forests it claims as territory, swooping down to stop anything from preying on the Pokémon within.

entry: POKENAME天性胆怯，借电力发出耀眼闪光，吓退威胁，掩护逃跑。但被逼入绝境时，也能释放足以烧毁小型发电厂的电力。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are skittish by nature, harnessing electricity to emit bright flashes of light to deter threats and cover their escapes. If cornered, however, they can let loose enough electricity to fry a small power plant.

entry: 大群POKENAME在空中赛跑，身后留下长长的棉孢子轨迹。喜欢和朋友表演空中特技。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME race through the sky in large groups, leaving long trails of cotton spores in their wake. They love to perform aerial stunts with their friends.

entry: 丰缘有个儿童故事，说雨云是POKENAME的向日葵以阳光为燃料，喷出的尾气。同一个故事还说，它会推摇自己的云，为下方植物浇水。
author: firstromaniandiscoerd
source: There is a Hoennian children's story that tells of how rainclouds are POKENAME's sunflower jet fumes, fueled by sunlight. According to the same story, POKENAME pushes and shakes their clouds to water plants below.

entry: POKENAME对人类语言的理解，比许多宝可梦深得多。各有最爱的树果，听见名字，就会兴奋地叫起来，满怀期待。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME understands human language on a much deeper level than many other Pokémon. They each have a favourite type of berry, and whenever they hear it they get excited and call out hopefully.

entry: POKENAME对人类语言的理解，比许多宝可梦深得多。各有最爱的宝芬，听见名字，就会兴奋地叫起来，满怀期待。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME understands human language on a much deeper level than many other Pokémon. They each have a favourite type of poffin, and whenever they hear it they get excited and call out hopefully.

entry: POKENAME用细密绒毛察觉来袭攻击，也能借绒毛折射光线，改变外观。
author: mcnchsschl
source: POKENAME uses the fine down on its body to detect incoming attacks. It can also use the down to refract light and change its appearance.

entry: POKENAME格外容易被寄托强烈情感的物件吸引，因此发生过许多偶遇。它能不可思议地找到与物件牵系情感的人，往往会将东西归还。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are remarkably drawn to objects that have strong emotions tied to them, which has led to many chance encounters. They have an uncanny ability to find whoever's emotions are tied to the objects they find and tend to return those items.

entry: POKENAME以惊人速度划过天空，沿途撒下有烟味的黏液。有些人视其为幸运之物，装瓶放在家里，作稀有却刺鼻的装饰。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME streaks across the sky at incredible speeds, scattering a smoke-scented goo wherever it travels. Some people consider this sludge lucky and store it in bottles at home as a rare, if pungent, decoration.

entry: POKENAME与小群同类旅行，为感知到悲伤的孩子送礼。羽毛能折射光线，使它隐形，因此行善时从不会被看见。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME travels with small groups of its own kind to bring gifts to children it senses are sad. It can make itself invisible thanks to its feathers, which refract light, allowing it to carry out its actions without ever being seen.

entry: POKENAME跃出水面后，空中滑翔的速度是水下的两倍。会巡视海洋，寻找需要帮助的人，抓住后送往安全处。
author: sk372
source: When POKENAME leaps from the water to the air, it glides at speeds twice what it manages underwater. It scans the oceans for people in need, grabbing them and carrying them off to safety.

entry: POKENAME的鳞片能反射光线，让自身隐形。很少被人看见，但已知住在大片海带林中，游泳时用长吻推开植物。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME's scales can reflect light in such a way that POKENAME becomes invisible. POKENAME is rarely seen, but it is known to live in areas with expansive kelp forests, using its long snout to push aside vegetation as it swims.

entry: POKENAME被当作程序，为可能在乱流中惊慌的航空飞行员提供情绪支持。隐形能力还能绕过任何防火墙，因此许多黑客都想得到它。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is used as a program to provide emotional support to airline pilots who might panic in the case of turbulence. Its ability to become invisible helps it bypass any firewall, which is why many hackers try to obtain this Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME跑到哪里，便留下细细露珠。触碰似乎能暂时增强某些宝可梦的力量。不过，即使天凉也很快蒸发，无法实际利用。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME creates a fine dew wherever it runs; it seems this dew can temporarily increase the power of some Pokémon when touched. However, the dew quickly evaporates even under cooler temperatures, leaving it impossible to practically harness.

entry: POKENAME共情能力极强，数英里外的恶意也能感知。绚丽羽毛与超能力相结合，能将小群落伪装起来，躲避潜在威胁。
author: secondunit
source: POKENAME are highly sensitive empaths and can sense ill intent from miles away. Their dazzling feathers, combined with their psychic powers, help to camouflage their small colonies from potential threats.

entry: POKENAME飞得快得惊人，却只能短暂冲刺。借此迅速往返各处，寻找愿意分享食物的友善人类。
author: sk372
source: Though POKENAME can fly at a surprisingly high speed, it can only do so in short bursts. It uses this speedy flight to travel quickly from place to place, looking for friendly people who will share their food with it.

entry: POKENAME用层层飘云裹住自己，掩饰真容。能将云展开成翻涌迷雾，消失得无影无踪。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME encase themselves within layers of drifting clouds that disguise their true appearance. They can expand the clouds out into a billowing mist so that they can disappear without a trace.

entry: POKENAME在晨空高速飞行，测试速度。正下方经过的住户，设备会发生严重数据问题，失真持续存在，直到清空硬盘。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME flies at high speeds across morning skies to test its pace. Any home it flies directly over suffers severe data issues on its devices, causing distortions that persist until a hard drive wipe is performed.

entry: POKENAME的鳞片有独特折光能力，可以隐形。在高树顶晒太阳时，便借此躲避空中天敌。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's scales have the unique ability to refract light, allowing it to become invisible. It uses this ability to protect itself from aerial predators as it basks high atop trees.

entry: 龙之能量流遍POKENAME全身，踢击凶猛，威力惊人。会在高山训练，进一步驾驭这份力量。
author: chibitales
source: Dragon energy courses through POKENAME's body, allowing it to deliver kicks with devastating ferocity. It harnesses this power further through training on tall mountains.

entry: 一个古老的龙属性训练家部落，曾以POKENAME为坐骑，飞遍丰缘。飞行途中感知危险时，会使出神秘守护，保护骑手。
author: cobalt0135
source: An ancient tribe of Dragon-type Trainers used POKENAME as mounts and flew around all of Hoenn. They will use Safeguard to protect their riders if they sense danger during their flights.

entry: 日落时，POKENAME飞来飞去，寻找伤心的孩子。阳光映着羽毛，它会让身体部分隐形，和孩子玩躲猫猫一类的游戏。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: When the sun sets, POKENAME fly around searching for sad children. By going partially invisible, POKENAME play games such as Peek-a-boo with the children, all while the sun reflects off their feathers.

entry: 这只宝可梦所到之处，总有安宁和睦的气息。它能与训练家心意相通，因而深受想结下羁绊的人喜爱。
author: jackjirachi
source: This Pokémon's presence brings a sense of peace and harmony. It is able to deeply connect with its Trainer, making it a popular Pokémon to bond with.

entry: 这只聪明的宝可梦，对他人的情绪极为敏感。照料它需要耐心，也得给它留一处安静冥想的地方。
author: final_courtesy
source: This intelligent Pokémon requires patience and a dedicated space for silent meditation, due to its hypersensitivity towards the emotions of others.

entry: POKENAME折射光线，依交流对象，让外表显得更可怕或更和善。看着更大、更吓人的时候，便是在试图自卫。但强硬表象很容易破裂，随即隐形逃走。
author: bringmeadream_
source: It refracts light to appear more or less frightening depending on who it's talking to. A larger and more intimidating POKENAME is one that is trying to defend itself. This tough facade can easily break, causing POKENAME to turn invisible and flee.

entry: POKENAME很保护认作朋友，或认为年幼、需要守护的对象。常将其一把抱入怀里，随后高速飞往远方。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is quite protective of those it considers friends or young to be safeguarded. It's not uncommon for it to scoop up those it protects into its arms before flying off vast distances at high speed.

entry: 翅膀虽小得无法飞行，POKENAME仍能凭超能力欢快地翱翔天际。它在隐秘的湖泊与潟湖附近筑巢。
author: mistymagius
source: Despite its wings being too small for flight, POKENAME joyfully soars across the sky using its psychic powers. It makes its nests near hidden lakes and lagoons.

entry: POKENAME即使在空中疾飞，双眼也能将远处看得一清二楚。飞行时，尾巴留下道道电火花。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's eyes let it see far distances in perfect clarity, even while traveling at high speeds through the air. Its tail generates a trail of electrical sparks while it flies.

entry: POKENAME飞越大地，寻找真爱。无论有多少伴侣，都会与每一位建立深厚羁绊。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME flies across the land in search of true love. It forms close bonds with its partners, no matter how many it has.

entry: POKENAME在臭氧层漂浮，移动快得惊人。最快时，有可能不到一小时便绕地球一圈。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME floats through the ozone layer, moving at incredible speeds. At its fastest, it could potentially circumnavigate the globe in less than an hour.

entry: POKENAME借黑暗掩护，完全独自旅行，人类很少看见。悄然掠过夜空时，即使专心研究它的人，也难得看见绯红剪影一闪而过。
author: ambrosia04
source: Rarely seen by humans, POKENAME travels in total isolation under the cover of darkness. Even dedicated researchers seldom catch more than a fleeting glimpse of its crimson silhouette as it streaks quietly through the night.

entry: 跨地区旅行时，POKENAME会在海上天空疾飞。金属身体的空气阻力极小，能突破音速。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME flies at incredible speeds across ocean skies when traveling between regions. Its metal body offers minimal air resistance, allowing it to exceed the speed of sound.

entry: POKENAME从大尾巴喷出蓝焰，在空中推进。翅膀坚固，能轻松破风，身后形成强劲尾流。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME propel themselves through the sky with blue flames released through their large tails. Their wings are sturdy and allow them to easily cut through the wind, creating a potent slipstream in their wake.

entry: POKENAME两颗头性格不同，红头比蓝头友善、合群得多。常见红头轻推另一颗头，鼓励交新朋友，却成效有限。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's two heads have differing personalities, the red being much more amicable and sociable than the blue. It is often seen nudging the other head, encouraging it to make new friends, with limited success.

entry: POKENAME寿命极长，聪明且善解人意，能用漫长岁月照料一片栖息地与其中居民。超能力使它擅长防御战术，是战斗中强大的守护者。
author: pjporwoll
source: Extremely long-lived, POKENAME is highly intelligent and empathetic, caring for a habitat and its inhabitants for eons. It excels at defensive tactics due to its psychic abilities, making it a strong protector in combat encounters.

entry: 丰缘传说中，POKENAME曾与传奇训练家合作，维持群岛和平。天空中划过的光迹，多半就是它们在寻找新的训练家盟友。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: In Hoenn legend, POKENAME worked with legendary Trainers to maintain peace among the islands. Streaks in the sky are most likely them, searching for new Trainers to ally with.

entry: 融合赋予拉帝欧斯与拉帝亚斯相配的新形态。两者协力飞遍各地区，保护弱小，是并肩行侠的正义双雄。
author: sk372
source: Fusion has granted Latios and Latias matching new forms. Working in tandem, they fly all across regions defending the weak and acting as dual heroes of justice.

entry: POKENAME疾掠天空，飞越各地区，寻找新经历、新朋友。全速飞行时，多条尾巴会向身后撒下无数红色光点。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME zips through the skies, flying across the regions looking for new experiences and new friends. Its multiple tails cast a myriad of red sparkles behind it when it flies at top speed.

entry: 很少有人见过POKENAME，更别说让这些温柔宝可梦实现愿望。只向心地纯洁者现身，乐于将勇敢之人的梦想化为现实。
author: quackquackattack
source: Few ever spot POKENAME, let alone have one of their wishes met by these gentle Pokémon. Only revealing themselves to those who are pure of heart, POKENAME gladly turn a brave soul's dream into reality.

entry: 体内电力积得太多时，POKENAME会变得极为胆小。被人看见，就会高速飞走，留下一路火花。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME grows extremely timid when the electricity in its body builds up too much. If spotted by a human, it flies away at high speed, leaving a trail of sparks behind.

entry: POKENAME将四肢相连，群体越大就飞得越快。速度够高时，棉花般的绒毛会少量脱落，身后留下闪亮白迹。
author: sk372
source: Linking their limbs together allows POKENAME to fly faster the larger the group. At high enough speeds, the cotton-like fluff sheds lightly and leaves a sparkling white trail behind them.

entry: POKENAME有保护壳，穿越各地区高速飞行时，能抵御风雨。有些地方的极限运动者，会穿仿照它外形设计的服装。
author: sk372
source: A protective shell covers POKENAME's body, protecting it from the elements as it flies across the regions at high speeds. In some places, extreme sportsmen wear suits designed after POKENAME's appearance.

entry: POKENAME是十分古老的物种，人们认为没有任何个体低于100岁。50年前曾濒临灭绝，如今已禁止捕捉野生个体。
author: thescribe
source: POKENAME is a very old species of Pokémon, and no single individual is thought to be less than 100 years old. Facing extinction 50 years ago, it is now forbidden to catch wild POKENAME.

entry: 光线微弱时，POKENAME能把光折射开，实际隐去身形。夜里若听见尖叫却找不到来源，很可能是隐身的它正用超声波捕猎。
author: _._starry_._
source: When there is little light, POKENAME can refract it away from its body and effectively become invisible. If you hear screeches at night but can't find the source, it's likely a cloaked POKENAME using ultrasonic waves to hunt.

entry: 据说，骑着POKENAME就像浮在云朵上。它常用蓬松的身体轻推训练家，邀请对方一起展开天空冒险。
author: rakunk
source: Riding with POKENAME is said to feel like floating on a cloud. It often nudges Trainers with its fluffy body, inviting them to join it on an adventure through the skies.

entry: POKENAME的冰能折射光线，让制成的冰雕看起来与真物一模一样。会造出自己的冰替身骗过猎人，本体则安全藏在冰墙里。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's ice refracts light in such a way that sculptures made from it appear exactly as their real counterparts. POKENAME uses this to its advantage by creating fake ice versions of itself to fool hunters while it hides away safely in an ice wall.

entry: POKENAME智力极高，能用心灵感应与人交流。靠绒羽就能轻易躲避敌人，瞬间消失，隐去身形。
author: b3llda1zora
source: POKENAME are highly intelligent Pokémon that can communicate with people telepathically. It's able to easily hide from its foes with its feathery down, vanishing instantly and becoming invisible.

entry: POKENAME大部分日子都懒洋洋地晒太阳，享受暖阳中的长睡。有时忽然精力狂盛，以超过2马赫的速度四处飞驰。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME spend most of their days lazing around in the sun, enjoying taking long naps in the warmth of the sunlight. They will sometimes become filled with a manic energy, racing around at speeds in excess of Mach 2.

entry: POKENAME爱玩，喜欢和人类或其他宝可梦追逐。快得非凡，几秒便能抓住多数玩伴。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are playful Pokémon that enjoy playing chase with people and other Pokémon. They are extraordinarily fast, capable of catching most of their play partners within seconds.

entry: 过去没人见过POKENAME落地，因此以为它从不停飞。热成像出现后才发现，其实也会降落，只是走路甚至睡觉时都隐形。
author: wiz0z
source: It was once thought that POKENAME never ceased flying as they had never been seen on the ground. The advent of thermal imaging revealed that POKENAME actually do land, becoming invisible while walking and even while asleep.

entry: POKENAME共情力强，智力高，能通过心灵感应传达某些需求。饱受焦虑困扰的训练家，常希望有一只相伴。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's empathetic nature and heightened intelligence allows it to convey certain needs through telepathy. Trainers who struggle with anxiety will often seek to have one as a companion.

entry: POKENAME飞遍丰缘，尽力伸张正义。似乎十分谦逊，英雄事迹都是在完全隐形时完成的。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME fly throughout Hoenn, serving justice where they can. It seems POKENAME are quite humble, as they accomplish their heroic acts while completely invisible.

entry: 咬住POKENAME尾巴的生灵极具攻击性，会咬紧，想让宿主也变凶。幸好它太单纯温和，连咬击产生的冲动都察觉不到。
author: sk372
source: The creature biting POKENAME's tail is highly aggressive, and bites down in order to influence the host into behaving similarly. Fortunately, POKENAME is too simple and gentle to even register the impulses the bites create.

entry: POKENAME向认作威胁的一切喷毒雾，让背部球体中的雾带着能量翻涌旋转。加上离群索居，难以好好研究。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME spits a poisonous mist at anything it deems a threat, causing the mist within the orb on its back to churn and swirl with energy. This, alongside its seclusive nature, makes it difficult to study properly.

entry: POKENAME迅速飞过树冠，寻找最新鲜的叶子吃。斗志旺盛，哪怕比自己大得多的宝可梦来争食，也不怕迎战。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME flies quickly through tree canopies in search of the freshest leaves to consume. It is a spirited fighter, unafraid to battle much larger Pokémon that might compete with it for food.

entry: POKENAME能透过厚壳感知他者情绪。愤怒的对象靠近时，就用变硬进一步加固盔甲。为了节省能量，整天都尽量保持不动。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME can sense the emotions of others through its thick shell. If someone angry approaches, it reinforces its armor even further with Harden. To conserve energy, it tries to remain as still as possible throughout the day.

entry: POKENAME能透过厚壳感知他者情绪。愤怒的对象靠近时，就立刻起飞远离。为了节省能量，白天都尽量保持不动。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME can sense the emotions of others through its thick shell. If someone angry approaches, it takes flight and distances itself immediately. To conserve energy, it attempts to stay as motionless as possible during the day.

entry: POKENAME以惊人的速度飞行，散播花粉。有传闻称，存在一只模样相近的红色宝可梦，可尚无确切目击。
author: toxicrown
source: POKENAME travels at extreme speeds to spread pollen. There are rumours of a red Pokémon that looks similar to POKENAME, but no confirmed sightings.

entry: 脸上的宝石才是POKENAME的真身。外部身体若被毁坏，只要把宝石放进洁净海水，就能再生身体。
author: bandedbodypress
source: The gem in its face is its true form. If POKENAME's outer body ever gets destroyed, the gem can regenerate its body if placed in clean ocean water.

entry: POKENAME相当冷淡，除紧急状况，很少载客。泳速惊人，会迅速把人送到目的地，好早点摆脱。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is rather aloof, rarely taking on passengers except in the case of emergencies. It can swim at incredibly fast paces, quickly getting a person to their destination so that it can be rid of them faster.

entry: POKENAME唯一记录在案的栖息地是大洋中央，因此训练家很少看见。有些记录提到，曾有训练家迷失海上，后被野生个体救起。
author: elibromax314
source: POKENAME are rarely seen by Trainers, as their only recorded habitat is in the middle of the ocean. Some accounts tell of a Trainer being lost at sea, only to be rescued by wild POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME毛发竖起时，仿佛有数百个自己同时现身，各做各的动作。有人触碰幻象，就会遭电击，幻象也在噼啪电光中消失。
author: soup1900
source: When POKENAME bristles its fur, hundreds of it seem to all appear simultaneously, doing various different actions. If someone touches an illusion, they will get zapped as the illusion disappears in a crackle of electricity.

entry: POKENAME沿网线穿行，释放能神奇提升网速的生命水滴。究竟如何起效，科学家仍摸不着头脑。
author: .izik
source: By traveling through network cables, POKENAME releases a Life Dew that mysteriously increases internet speed. Scientists remain baffled by the mechanism behind this effect.

entry: POKENAME的身体能高速破水前进，甚至跃出水面，在空中长距离滑翔。天性不合群，一见人类靠近，就逃进海底巢穴。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's body cuts cleanly through the water at high speeds, even breaching the surface to glide long distances across the air. It is antisocial by nature, fleeing into undersea dens when it spies humans approaching.

entry: POKENAME用心灵感应寻找需要帮助的人和宝可梦。常俯冲而下，帮助它认为值得援助的对象。
author: jodue
source: POKENAME uses its telepathy to locate people and Pokémon in need of help. It often swoops down to help those it deems worthy.

entry: POKENAME会隐形触发飞机雷达，恶作剧地让人以为要在半空撞上东西。碰撞发生前，便现出身形，绕到飞机前方转圈。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME are known to play pranks with airplanes, triggering their radars while invisible to make it seem like the planes may hit something midair. Before they crash, POKENAME will reveal itself before flying in circles in front of them.

entry: POKENAME背部火焰燃起时，会将接连烈焰爆炸的景象送入敌人脑中，吓唬对方。一旦闪起热浪，眼见的一切都不能当真。
author: soup1900
source: When POKENAME flares up the flames on its back, ideas of multiple fiery explosions are put into the minds of foes to frighten them. Nothing that can be seen can be trusted as reality once it flashes up a heat haze.

entry: POKENAME在空中疾飞，快得连商用喷气客机都赶不上。减速时，会留下道道水流，淋湿下方所有对象。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME flies through the sky at incredible speeds, surpassing even commercial jets. When it slows down, it leaves behind streams of water that soak anyone below.

entry: POKENAME很善于感知情绪，足以追踪敌人，从远处精准放出雷电。不过陷入绝境时，就会胡乱放电。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME can sense the emotions of others quite well, enough that they can track their foes and unleash precise lightning bolts from a distance. When cornered, however, they fire lightning bolts wildly.

entry: 它站在急流中，感受流水冲刷周身。待在水里越久，身体就越流线、越平整。
author: bandedbodypress
source: It stands in rapid streams to feel water rush around it. The longer it stays in water, the more streamlined and flush its body becomes.

entry: 看见POKENAME飞行，人们便会许愿。因为POKENAME实在太懒，只有天敌靠近，才肯飞起来，难得一见。
author: dodoowner_
source: When people see POKENAME fly around, they make a wish. They do this because POKENAME is so lazy that it only flies if there is a predator near.

entry: POKENAME在月夜疾飞，身上红环发出诡异光芒，常被误认为不明飞行物。会被情绪平和的训练家吸引，与之建立深厚羁绊。
author: vic1312
source: Zooming about on moonlit nights, POKENAME are often mistaken for unidentified flying objects due to the eerie glow of the red rings on their body. They are attracted to Trainers with serene emotions, forming strong bonds with them.

entry: POKENAME被寄托强烈情感的物件吸引，似乎尤其偏爱其中被遗弃的东西。可惜往往囤在自己身边，并不归还。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are drawn to objects that have strong emotions tied to them, although they seem to have a stronger penchant for abandoned items of such a nature. Unfortunately, they tend to hoard these items rather than return them.

entry: POKENAME携带的球并非真正的心之水滴，却蕴含自身惊人力量。似乎能使受伤的龙属性宝可梦恢复活力，也正是耀眼洁净光芒的发出之处。
author: pkbonusducks
source: While the orb they carry is not a real Soul Dew, it does contain an incredible amount of POKENAME's power. The orb seems to revitalize injured Dragon-type Pokémon, and happens to be the origin point of their blinding Luster Purge.

entry: POKENAME疾飞各地区，像游荡空中的侠客。发现宝可梦惹事，就会追上去，从嘴里喷出水柱连连击打。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME zips across the regions acting as something of a wandering airborne vigilante. If it spots Pokémon causing trouble, it flies after them while pelting them with jets of water spat from its mouth.

entry: POKENAME能感知情绪，被用作支持程序，帮助情感上遇到困难的人。搭载新一代脚本，执行功能时更能自主行动。
author: fiordaliso
source: Thanks to its ability to sense feelings, this Pokémon is used as a support program to help people with emotional problems. POKENAME is equipped with a new generation script that makes it much more autonomous in performing its functions.

entry: 传说常提及POKENAME的凶暴，能摧毁侵入领地的人与宝可梦组成的整支军队。不过也有人见它陪孩子玩，帮助幼年宝可梦回到父母身边。
author: wiz0z
source: Legends often speak of the ferocity of POKENAME, destroying entire armies of people and Pokémon that encroach on their territory. However, POKENAME have also been spotted playing with children and helping baby Pokémon return to their parents.

entry: POKENAME有心灵感应，极能体会他者心情。传闻有人极度难过时，它可能现身起舞，展示闪烁的彩羽，据说能带来快乐。
author: secondunit
source: POKENAME are highly empathetic Pokémon, owing to their telepathy. It is rumored that when someone is feeling strongly upset, they may appear and dance to show off the shimmering of their colorful feathers, which are said to bring joy.

entry: POKENAME向愿意的人伸出手，带着对方迅速飞越大地。飞在空中时，也穿越时间，让同伴看见下方景色如何随时代变迁。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME offers its hand to those who will accept, whisking them off to fly across the land quickly. While airborne, it travels through time as well, letting its companion see how the landscape below has changed through the ages.

entry: POKENAME能弹得极高，仿佛在飞。无论落下多远，都能靠软绵绵的尾巴轻轻着地。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME can bounce so high that it seems like flight. No matter how far it falls, POKENAME will land softly on its squishy tail.

entry: POKENAME接收来源不明的奇怪信号，将信息化为周围人脑中的图像，分享给大家。能操纵磁场，以极高速度飞行。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME receives strange signals from unknown origins and shares the messages these signals contain by displaying images of them in the minds of people around it. It manipulates the fields of magnetism to fly at exceptionally high speeds.

entry: POKENAME咬住猎物头部时，会将幻觉注入大脑，掩盖造成的痛楚。通常收翼以提高飞速，但也会毫不犹豫地展开剃刀般的翼缘，切开敌人。
author: soup1900
source: When POKENAME bites onto its prey's head, it injects hallucinations into their brain to mask the inflicted pain. While it typically folds back its wings to maximize flight speed, it won't hesitate to expand its razor edges to slice through foes.

entry: POKENAME侵入电脑后，网速会升得惊人。可惜浏览网页很困难，因为它会毫无预兆地随机打开网络各处的页面。
author: .izik
source: While POKENAME infests a computer, its internet speed increases to incredibly high rates. Unfortunately, navigating websites poses a challenge, as it randomly pulls up pages from across the internet without warning.

entry: POKENAME用心灵感应探查四周。察觉危险后，就凭无可比拟的敏捷与攀爬本领逃走。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME has telepathic abilities and uses them to scan its surroundings. If it senses danger, it uses its peerless agility and climbing skills to flee.

entry: POKENAME同时锻炼心智与身体，准备战斗。感受敌人的自信与情绪，预判行动，抢占先机。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME trains both its mind and body in preparation for battle. By sensing the confidence and emotions of its foe, it can anticipate their actions and gain the upper hand in combat.

entry: POKENAME贪玩随和。近来，还有以它的模样为灵感的服饰风潮。
author: jackjirachi
source: POKENAME has a playful and easygoing temperament. There have been recent clothing trends that are inspired by its appearance.

entry: POKENAME能在空中极高速飞行。飞得太快，能量便迅速消耗，不得不躲进雾中随身携带的那一滴露珠里休息。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME can travel at extremely high speeds through the sky. Should it go too fast, its energy drains rapidly, forcing it to rest within the single drop of dew it carries within its fog.

entry: POKENAME以心灵感应读取情绪，分辨敌友。面对敌人，会用角咆哮、猛咬，将其吓跑，好避免冲突。
author: bringmeadream_
source: POKENAME telepathically reads the emotions of others to distinguish friend from foe. When confronting an enemy, it uses its horns to roar and snap at them, scaring them away so it can avoid conflict.

entry: 受威胁时，POKENAME会用心灵感应，强行将令人不安的画面送入袭击者意识。趁对方分心，消失无踪。
author: bobosmith01
source: If threatened, POKENAME will telepathically force disturbing images into the aggressor's consciousness. While they are distracted, POKENAME vanishes.

entry: POKENAME视力惊人，还有感知他者存在的第六感，几乎无从逃脱。先在地上疾奔，再从后脚释放一股电力，推动自己猛烈跃向前方。
author: sk372
source: With incredible eyesight and a sixth sense for the presence of others, escaping from POKENAME is almost impossible. It runs quickly across the ground, before using a burst of electricity from its hind feet to propel it forward with mighty leaps.

entry: POKENAME天性慈悲，用心灵感应寻找遇困的对象。一经察觉，就会迅速赶去，试着提供援助。
author: infinex21
source: Compassionate by nature, these Pokémon use their telepathic capabilities to sense for any individuals in trouble. If they sense any such individuals, POKENAME will quickly dart toward them and attempt to provide aid.

entry: POKENAME极爱远游，忍不住飞快穿越大地。可特殊能力会让飞越的整座城镇突然睡上一阵，造成麻烦。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has an extreme wanderlust that compels it to fly quickly across the lands. This causes problems, as its unique abilities can cause entire towns it flies over to suddenly fall asleep for a time.

entry: POKENAME的炮通常朝前，却能反向，推动自己达到离谱的高速。敌人想袭击时，会先向空中发射爆炸弹丸，警告对方趁还没受伤，停止战斗。
author: soup1900
source: While POKENAME's cannon normally points forward, the cannon can invert to enable propulsion for ludicrous speeds. If a foe tries to attack POKENAME, it fires an explosive projectile into the air as a warning to stop fighting before they get injured.

entry: POKENAME从尾巴喷出紫色亮焰，在空中达到极速。常有人见它降下，用强大火焰净除满怀恶意的对象。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME release violet, lustrous flames from their tails to achieve extreme speeds within the air. They have often been witnessed descending to purge those filled with malice using their mighty flames.

entry: POKENAME能与植物交流，在居住的森林中飞速穿行。会试着阻止伐木人砍树，总希望以非暴力方式化解冲突。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME have the ability to communicate with plant life, zooming through the forests they inhabit at incredible speeds. These Pokémon attempt to prevent loggers from cutting down trees, always preferring to resolve conflicts nonviolently.

entry: POKENAME平常温和，盟友或守护对象受威胁时，就会动用强大攻势赶走危险。寿命漫长，曾发现同一个体用漫长岁月守护同一处地方。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is normally gentle, but if its allies or wards are threatened, it will use its immense offensive abilities to fight off the danger. Its lifespan is incredibly long, and the same entity has been found protecting a location for eons.

entry: POKENAME英勇无比，以超乎想象的高速飞遍世界。凭迅捷动作救援遇险者，再以洁净光芒重创恶徒。
author: cobalt0135
source: POKENAME are very gallant Pokémon that fly around the world beyond breakneck speeds. They use their swift movements to rescue any who are in danger and deliver devastating blows to villains with Luster Purge.

entry: POKENAME超能力强大，能把人和宝可梦看得一清二楚，预判每个动作。被击败后，可能实现一个愿望，头上一条缎带随之消失。全消失后会怎样，无人知晓。
author: pokejirkaok
source: These Pokémon possess immense psychic abilities, reading people and Pokémon like open books to predict their every move. POKENAME may grant a wish when defeated, causing one ribbon on its head to vanish. No one knows what happens once all vanish.

entry: POKENAME能高速飞行，却只能沿直线短暂冲刺。屡次迎头撞击，让头骨变得坚硬耐打。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can attain high-speed flight, but only for short bursts in a straight line. Its skull has become hardened and resilient in response to all the head-on collisions it has suffered.

entry: POKENAME的身体光滑平整，要是会飞，便能非常高效地穿过空气。它每天从高台跳下，尽力推进得更远，练习飞行。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Its smooth, flush body would allow POKENAME to fly very efficiently through the air, if it could fly. It practices every day by jumping off of ledges and boosting as far as it can.

entry: POKENAME夜间在月色星光下远游，走过许多英里。清晨会把自己种在乡间社区附近，用叶子察觉人类存在，寻找打理良好的花园。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME roam great distances at night, travelling for many miles beneath the moon and stars. They will plant themselves near rural communities in the morning, their leaves picking up on the presence of people, helping them find well-tended gardens.

entry: POKENAME白天蜷在同一处，藏身花丛草甸。夜晚长途跋涉，寻找更肥沃的土地，用共情能力找到善于栽培的园丁。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME spend the daytime hunkered down in one place, staying hidden within flower patches and meadows. At nighttime they travel vast distances in search of more fertile grounds, using their empathic powers to seek out prolific gardeners.

entry: POKENAME高速飞行时唱歌，歌声随风传远。不少人听得入迷，此后花上多年寻找，只想再听一回。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's voice carries across the wind as it sings during high-speed flights. More than a few have been entranced by hearing its voice, and spent years searching for it to hear it sing again.

entry: POKENAME夜间开花，以共情能力感知附近同类，再释放花粉。天刚亮便散开，远行许多英里，寻找新的草甸与树林安家。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME bloom at night, releasing their pollen when they can sense other POKENAME nearby with their empathic powers. They disperse at the first light of day, travelling many miles to find new meadows and new groves to make their home.

entry: 极偶尔，乘客能见到POKENAME在喷气客机旁边飞边唱。据说，振奋的旋律能给前往未知之地的旅人勇气。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: On rare occasions, passengers can spot POKENAME singing as it soars alongside jet planes. Its uplifting melodies are said to bring courage to travelers heading off to the unknown.

entry: POKENAME划过夜空，留下发光的蔚蓝孢子。虽很快就在空气中消散，有些村庄仍喜欢将其装罐，拿来做据说能带好运的饭菜。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME streaks across the night sky, it leaves behind glowing cerulean spores. While they dissipate quickly in open air, some village pastimes include jarring them for use in meals said to bring good fortune.

entry: POKENAME迅速掠过天空，留下鲜蓝光迹。热衷耸动说法的人与阴谋论者，相信其中带着外星污染物，但研究显示光迹无害。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME soars swiftly across the sky, leaving trails of vivid blue light. Sensationalists and conspiracy theorists believe these trails contain alien contaminants, but research shows the streaks are harmless.

entry: POKENAME聪明，能理解人语。性情温顺，不过需要自卫时，斩击轻易就能快过喷气飞机。
author: b3llda1zora
source: POKENAME are highly intelligent Pokémon able to understand human speech. They are docile Pokémon; however, if they need to defend themselves, their slashes can easily travel faster than a jet plane.

entry: POKENAME头顶的蓝色大结晶，会在翱翔时震动，发出共鸣声。心怀恶意的人听了，会觉得痛苦。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a large, blue crystal atop their heads that vibrates as they soar through the sky. The vibrations from the crystal produce a resonant ringing that is painful for people with ill intentions.

entry: POKENAME在地面冲刺，能突破音速，产生冲击波。会用超能力保护自己与搭载的对象，抵御剧烈加速。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are able to break the speed of sound as they sprint across the ground, creating shock waves as they sprint. They use their psychic powers to protect themselves and anyone they're carrying from the intense acceleration.

entry: POKENAME以马赫级速度飞行，跨越各地区，寻找强敌挑战。极少数败北时，可能留在当地，努力训练，争取再次获胜。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME flies at Mach speeds, traveling from region to region in search of powerful foes to challenge. On the rare occasions where it is defeated, it may linger in a given region, attempting to train itself so it can win again.

entry: POKENAME走遍世界，静静观察所遇一切，却似乎从不分享，也不依所见行动。有些寓言传说将这种生活描绘得充实、鼓舞人心，另一些却说毫无意义、荒谬可笑。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME travels all over the world to quietly observe whatever it can find, but it never seems to share or act upon anything it sees. There are several fables and legends depicting its lifestyle as rewarding and inspiring or as pointless and absurd.

entry: POKENAME的心灵感应强大，能与他者交流，表达各种情感。十分关心训练家，一感到不对劲，就立刻瞬间移动到身旁。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's powerful telepathic abilities allow it to communicate and express various emotions to others. POKENAME shows great care towards its Trainer, quickly teleporting to their side if it senses something amiss.

entry: POKENAME疾飞各地区的天空，停下来制止各地犯罪与不公。开战前，一定要先摆出夸张英勇的姿势。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME speeds across the skies of the various regions, stopping to halt crime and injustice across the lands. Before entering a battle, it always makes sure to strike a dramatic and heroic pose.

entry: POKENAME举止优雅，精通火属性招式，广受赞赏。只许训练家碰珍爱的九尾，其他谁敢尝试，都会迎来一团毒粉。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is admired for its grace and elegance, as well as its mastery of Fire-type moves. It allows only its Trainer to touch its nine tails, which it guards jealously. Anyone else who dares to try is met with a puff of poisonous powder.

entry: 科学家采集POKENAME的丝时，它有时会突然从尾巴喷出烈焰，已有许多人因此住院。
author: dodoowner_
source: Sometimes, when scientists extract silk from POKENAME, it lets out large flames from its tails. Many people have been hospitalized from this.

entry: POKENAME用圆圆的身体在地上滚动，免得弄脏尾巴。尽量保持冷静从容，免得被高估。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME roll along the ground with their round bodies to avoid making their tails dirty. They try to keep themselves calm and poised so that they do not get overestimated.

entry: POKENAME刚爆炸过，毛发便杂乱黯淡；长久蓄着能量，毛就柔顺光亮。谁想刺激它爆炸，都会遭到无尽干旱的诅咒。
author: soup1900
source: A POKENAME that recently exploded will have messy and dull fur, while one that has contained its energy for a long time will have smooth and shiny fur. Anyone who tries to stimulate it into exploding will be cursed with an endless drought.

entry: 未了怨恨深深渗入POKENAME，甚至影响基因。今后生下的后代，也会对曾伤害它的对象怀着同样恨意。
author: bobosmith01
source: Unresolved grudges seep so deeply into POKENAME that they even affect its genes; any future offspring POKENAME produces will carry the same feelings of resentment towards whomever POKENAME was wronged by.

entry: 古时，人们认为POKENAME携带的骨头蕴藏咒术，因此施巫术者会收集。惹它不快，也被认为会使挑事者遭诅咒数十年。
author: chibitales
source: In ancient times, bones carried by POKENAME were thought to contain spells or enchantments and were thus collected by those practicing witchcraft. Making a POKENAME upset was thought to curse the instigator for decades.

entry: POKENAME在富含Z纯晶碎片的地区融合，有时会变成奇怪的浅白模样。这种浅色变种，在阿罗拉群岛格外常见。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME can sometimes take on strange, pale appearances when they are fused in an area rich with Z-Crystal shards. This pale variant of POKENAME is particularly common on the Alolan islands.

entry: POKENAME把死去火属性宝可梦的头骨当钉头锤，唤出它们生前用过的火焰。这种阴森习惯，让它被视为亡者的守护灵，深受神婆喜爱。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME wield the skulls of deceased Fire-Type Pokémon as maces, channelling the fire that they once used in life. This morbid habit has led to them being viewed as a guardian spirit of the dead and makes them a popular Pokémon amongst Mediums.

entry: POKENAME在巢里收集骨头，粗大坚固的用来战斗，细骨用来梳理众多尾巴。因此有些神话说，死者灵魂会缠在它尾巴里。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME gather a collection of bones within their dens, using large, sturdy bones for combat and thinner bones to groom their many tails. This habit has led to some myths suggesting that the spirits of the dead become entwined within its tails.

entry: POKENAME在巢里收集骨头，粗大坚固的用来战斗，细骨用来梳理众多尾巴。在热带地区，毛色呈脱俗的纯白，映照着它偏爱的雪山。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME gather a collection of bones within their dens, using large, sturdy bones for combat and thinner bones to groom their many tails. In tropical regions, their fur is an unearthly white colour, reflective of the snowy mountains they prefer.

entry: POKENAME用奶油般的香草色尾巴裹住身体。天敌通常不来招惹，以免被强烈火焰烧伤。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have creamy, vanilla-colored tails that wrap around their bodies. Predators typically leave POKENAME alone to avoid getting burned by powerful flames.

entry: 它极力保护随身的卵。若想偷走，可能会遭它施下可怕诅咒。
author: hophoppip
source: It's highly protective of the egg it carries. If you attempt to steal the egg, it may inflict you with a terrible curse.

entry: POKENAME以神秘力量受人敬畏，驾驭火焰与心智同样娴熟。据说，它的火焰燃烧却没有热量，被用来引来毫无戒备的对象。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are revered for their mystical powers, commanding both fire and minds with equal skill. It is said that the fires they produce burn without any heat and are used to lure the unwary toward them.

entry: POKENAME繁琐地梳妆，显得华贵气派。会花上数小时，操心外表每处细节，连一根毛也不放过。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a grand, opulent presence because of their tedious grooming practices. They spend hours fretting over every detail of their appearance, down to the very hair.

entry: POKENAME的尾巴构成假发，每条都象征神秘力量。随节奏起舞时，能同时驾驭冰与火。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: Its tails make up faux hair, each one signifying mystic power. As it dances rhythmically, POKENAME can channel both ice and fire all at once.

entry: POKENAME是能轻松理解复杂人语的水生宝可梦。受训后，能向野生宝可梦传达人类意图，尤其擅长应对凶猛融合体，例如帮助货船免遭巨牙鲨攻击。
author: bobosmith01
source: As an aquatic Pokémon that easily understands complex human speech, trained POKENAME can communicate human intent with wild Pokémon, especially more aggressive fusions. For example, POKENAME can help stop cargo ships from being attacked by Sharpedo.

entry: POKENAME竖起毛发，就是准备朝敌人发射带微弱诅咒的毛针。古老故事说，巫师曾将这些魔法毛针制成小法杖，不过没有证据支持。
author: soup1900
source: When POKENAME bristles its fur, it's getting ready to launch bolts of weak curses onto foes. Stories dating from long ago state that wizards harnessed these magical needles of fur into tiny spell wands, although no proof has backed these tales.

entry: POKENAME接近过热时，会从尾巴与颈毛释放多余热量。妥善照料后，金色毛发柔软得惊人。
author: chibitales
source: When POKENAME is close to overheating, it releases excess heat from its tails and collar. When taken care of properly, POKENAME's golden fur is incredibly soft.

entry: POKENAME的毛极为浓密、隔热，零下天气也能保持温暖。金色尾尖燃着火星，一察觉危险，便会烧得更亮。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME possess exceptionally dense, heat-insulating fur that keeps their bodies warm even in sub-zero weather. The tips of their golden tails burn with embers that flare brighter whenever they sense danger.

entry: POKENAME性情冷淡，不喜欢谁靠得太近、待得太久。多条尾巴能从身上射出，化作追踪火焰导弹，发射不久后又会长出。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has quite the standoffish disposition, not taking kindly to those that stay too close too long. Its multiple tails can fire off from its body to act as homing, flaming missiles, growing back shortly after being fired.

entry: POKENAME有全息硬光身体，能自由往返现实与数字空间。投影块状、分辨率低，但单是渲染尾巴，就能让电脑过热。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have holographic hard-light bodies that they can freely use to transition between physical and digital space. Their projections are blocky and low resolution, but rendering the tails specifically can cause computers to overheat.

entry: POKENAME有全息硬光身体，能自由往返现实与数字空间。投影平滑、分辨率低，但单是渲染尾巴，就能让电脑过热。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have holographic hard-light bodies that they can freely use to transition between physical and digital space. Their projections are smooth and low resolution, but rendering the tails specifically can cause computers to overheat.

entry: POKENAME有全息硬光身体，能自由往返现实与数字空间。投影平滑、分辨率低，但单是渲染尾巴，就能让电脑过热。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have holographic hard-light bodies that they can freely use to transition between physical and digital space. Their projections are smooth and low resolution, but rendering the tails specifically can cause computers to overheat.

entry: POKENAME用众多尾巴护住茧，加强防御。任何打扰都不会被原谅，完全进化的那一刻就会寻仇。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME shields its cocoon with its many tails for added protection. Anything that disturbs it will not be forgiven, and POKENAME will seek vengeance the moment it fully evolves.

entry: POKENAME主要靠双翼滑翔，众多长尾来回扫荡，很容易让敌人晕头转向。
author: carameldog
source: POKENAME's wings are mostly used for gliding. With its many sweeping tails, this Pokémon easily disorients foes.

entry: POKENAME身边常围着幼年宝可梦，喜欢睡在华美蓬松的尾巴里。不睡觉时，则会寻找树果，烤着吃。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are often surrounded by baby Pokémon who enjoy sleeping within their luxuriously fluffy tails. When they are not sleeping, they are search for berries to roast and consume.

entry: 中世纪，POKENAME毛发制成的王室礼服，因金色光泽而大受王族欢迎。人们认为，碰它尾巴上的宝珠，会让冒犯者遭受延续数代的诅咒。
author: chibitales
source: Regalia made with POKENAME fur were wildly popular among royalty in medieval times due to its golden hue. It's thought touching the orbs on POKENAME's tails will inflict the offender with a curse spanning generations.

entry: POKENAME通常不愿与谁相伴，直到准备好亲近为止。据说，若允许某人触碰众多尾巴中的一条，对方便会获得它一小部分超能力。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME typically shies away from any companionship until it is ready to get close to someone. It is said that if it allows someone to touch one of its many tails, that person will be granted a fraction of its psychic powers.

entry: 对战时，POKENAME猛烈挥动叶片，将余烬撒向对手。这些叶子每年脱落，被收集来做菜，给食物添上温和辣味。
author: chibitales
source: In battle, POKENAME fans its leaf wildly to shower opponents in embers. These leaves are shed every year and are collected for culinary use, giving food a mild spicy flavor.

entry: POKENAME的毛柔软华美，是大姐姐和宝可梦培育家珍爱的宝可梦。梳毛需要专家，毛热得能熔化塑料梳，金属梳又可能与尾巴起反应，迸出火花。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have soft, luxurious fur that makes them the prized Pokémon of both Beauties and Breeders. They require specialists to groom as their fur is hot enough to melt plastic combs, whilst metal combs can react with their tails and cause sparks.

entry: POKENAME睡觉时，将精神能量集中在尾巴里。激动后，会把储存的力量化成咆哮烈焰，沿背部喷发。
author: ambrosia04
source: As it sleeps, POKENAME concentrates psychic energy within its tails. When agitated, it converts this stored power into roaring flames that erupt along its back.

entry: 宝可梦研究者曾一度将POKENAME误认成矮小的九尾变种。生态研究发现，它是独立物种，还观察到它捕猎体型数倍于自己的宝可梦。
author: katieplaysgames
source: For a time, Pokémon Researchers mistook POKENAME for a dwarf variant of Ninetales. Ecological studies have revealed them to be their own species with researchers observing them hunting Pokémon many times their size.

entry: 宝可梦研究者曾一度将POKENAME误认成矮小的九尾变种。生态研究发现，它是独立物种，还观察到它捕猎体型数倍于自己的宝可梦。
author: katieplaysgames
source: For a time, Pokémon Researchers mistook POKENAME for a dwarf variant of Ninetales. Ecological studies have revealed them to be their own species with researchers observing them hunting Pokémon many times their size.

entry: 对战时，POKENAME颈部喷出的火焰炽热无比，周围空气都热得扭曲。未经允许碰尾巴，可能遭严重烧伤，痛上多年。
author: chibitales
source: The fire spouting from POKENAME's neck burns so hot during battle, the area is covered in a heat shimmer. Touching one of its many tails without permission can lead to intense burns that remain painful for years.

entry: POKENAME避开污染、噪声严重的城市，却会迁往行人众多的地方。除了避病，也是因为喜欢与人互动。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME avoids cities with high levels of pollution and noise and will migrate to places where there is high foot traffic. This is because it enjoys interacting with people, in addition to avoiding illness.

entry: POKENAME不喜欢爪踩沥青的感觉，偏爱柔软、容易陷入的质地。城市公园既让爪子舒服，也满足与人相处的心愿。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME dislike the feel of asphalt on its paws and prefers soft textures that are easy to press into. Urban parks satisfy both its paws feeling comfy, and its desire to spend time with people.

entry: POKENAME在森林最高的树顶筑巢，不惜一切守护尾巴，不让其他生灵碰到。生气时，吐出的烈火能烧焦附近生长的一切。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME builds its nest atop the tallest trees in the forest to keep other creatures from touching the tails it guards at all costs. When angered, it can breathe flames so intense that they scorch everything growing nearby.

entry: POKENAME凝望远方时，尾巴会抽动摇摆。人们认为，它正看着九种不同未来，最后抽动的尾巴，就表示选定要前往的未来。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME tails twitch and sway whenever they stare off into the distance. They are thought to be looking into nine different futures whenever they do this, with whatever tail twitches last indicating the future they have chosen to head toward.

entry: 据说，触碰POKENAME的某条尾巴，就会看见一种可能的未来。不同尾巴呈现不同景象，未来有许多道路，因此很难据此行动。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Touching one of the tails of POKENAME is said to bring about a vision of a potential future. The vision changes depending on which tail is touched and shows many different paths the future could take, making acting on the visions difficult.

entry: POKENAME金色毛发能为体内高压电力绝缘。电流引过盘绕的尾巴，就能作为雷电释放，或产生强烈热量。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's golden fur provides insulation for the high-voltage power stored inside its body. When this current is channelled through the coils of POKENAME's tails, it can be discharged as bolts of lightning or used to generate intense heat.

entry: POKENAME为灯塔发电机供能，防止入港船只撞上岩岸。发电机故障时，就向天空喷火，继续警告海上水手。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME prevent ships coming in to port from hitting rocky coastlines by powering lighthouse generators. If these generators fail, POKENAME shoot flames into the sky to continue warning sailors at sea.

entry: 它将九尾裹在身上，直到光线足以进行光合作用。一条尾巴里藏着炽热岩石，确保太阳能给予充足能量。
author: quackquackattack
source: Its nine tails wrap around itself until there is enough light to conduct photosynthesis. It hides a Heat Rock in one of its tails to ensure the sun gives it plenty of energy.

entry: POKENAME嚼碎花朵，制成香油，涂在每条尾巴上。油能帮助定形、增加浮力，让它倚着尾巴休息，平静地顺流漂下。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME chews up flowers to produce a fragrant oil and rubs it onto each of its tails. This oil helps them keep their shape and makes them more buoyant, allowing POKENAME to rest atop them as it floats peacefully down streams.

entry: POKENAME快速转动九尾，在空中飞行。据说，若见金色身影飞过多云的天，太阳很快就会出来。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME spins its nine tails rapidly to fly through the air. It is said that if POKENAME's golden body is seen flying through a cloudy sky, the sun will soon come out.

entry: 尾毛像棉绒球一样柔软蓬松。虽然毛厚，一年最热的日子反而最有活力，会乘暖流飘起，散播种子。
author: .jerden
source: The fur on its tails is as soft and fluffy as its cotton puffs. Despite the thick fur, it is most energetic on the hottest days of the year and will float up on the warm air to scatter its seeds.

entry: POKENAME能用两条尾巴短暂飞行，但很快就累。聪明绝顶，能轻松使用人类工具，维修机器，甚至发明新机器。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can use its two tails to achieve temporary flight, though this tires it out quickly. Highly intelligent, POKENAME is able to use human tools, fixing up and even inventing new machinery with ease.

entry: POKENAME似乎颇懂机械，常协助工程师修飞机。也有记录显示，它厌恶外形像宝可梦的机器人，一见就会摧毁。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME appear to have decent knowledge of machines, often seen assisting engineers with aircraft repairs. POKENAME have also been documented as having a distaste for robots that look like Pokémon, destroying them as soon as POKENAME spot them.

entry: 成群POKENAME常把尾巴缠成一个大结，惊慌之下放出巨量热能，因此引发许多住宅火灾。
author: santon5512
source: Groups of POKENAME will often get their tails tied up into a single big knot, causing the group to panic and begin releasing massive amounts of heat. This phenomenon causes many house fires.

entry: 只要能晒到太阳，POKENAME就相对温顺。不过不喜欢花瓣被碰，据说会诅咒未经许可触碰的人。
author: sk372
source: As long as POKENAME has access to sunlight to bask in, it is relatively docile. It does not enjoy having its petals touched, however, and is said to curse those who do so without permission.

entry: POKENAME脸颊的毛永不停长，是神秘能量的通道。毛越长，能引导的力量越多。古时，为它梳毛被视为确保强大祝福的神圣举动。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: The fur on POKENAME's cheeks never stops growing and acts as a conduit for mystical energy. The longer the fur, the more power it can channel. In ancient times, grooming a POKENAME was seen as a sacred act to ensure strong blessings.

entry: POKENAME脸颊的毛永不停长，是神秘能量的通道。毛越长，能引导的力量越多。古时，为它梳毛被视为确保强大祝福的神圣举动。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: The fur on POKENAME's cheeks never stops growing and acts as a conduit for mystical energy. The longer the fur, the more power it can channel. In ancient times, grooming a POKENAME was seen as a sacred act to ensure strong blessings.

entry: POKENAME走路时，大尾巴拖在身后，留下拖痕，很容易追踪。吸收阳光、准备进化时，绯红花朵的颜色会更深。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME's large tails drag behind it as it walks, causing it to be easy to follow via the dragging marks. Its scarlet flower deepens in color as it absorbs sunlight and prepares for evolution.

entry: POKENAME太虚弱，承受不了螫刺，因此父母捕食时，只会耐心等待。平时练习从众多尾巴喷火，让森林各处树桩都留下焦痕。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME patiently waits for its parents whenever they hunt for food, as it is too frail to handle being stung. It practices shooting fire from its many tails, which leaves burn marks on tree stumps throughout the forest.

entry: POKENAME领地意识极强，会在树上烧出痕迹标记。多条尾巴帮助爬树，从蜂巢取蜜，而蜂巢几乎无力抵挡火焰。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME is incredibly territorial, and leaves burn marks on trees to mark its territory. Its many tails aid with climbing trees to gather honey from hives, which have few defenses against its fire.

entry: POKENAME的众多翅膀，让见者又惊又疑。不过，POKENAME其实会保护自己身边的生物。
author: louiseo
source: The many wings of POKENAME strike fear and confusion in the eyes of its beholders. POKENAME, however, is known to protect those that surround it.

entry: POKENAME总带着装满旧邮件的行囊。有人相信，邮件种类能预言未来：机械邮件象征牢固关系，橙色邮件预示健康，复古邮件则暗示死亡将近。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME are always seen carrying baggage filled with old mail. Some believe the type of mail they carry can predict the future; Mech Mail signals strong relationships, Orange Mail good health, and Retro Mail implies an approaching death.

entry: POKENAME优雅的形态与多片翅膀，给许多古典诗人灵感，吸引大批艺术家。接触时脾气难测，应对不当就会遭烧灼或啄击。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have been the inspiration for many classical poets, their elegant form and multiple wings drawing artists to them in droves. They can be temperamental when interacted with, poor handling resulting in being burned or pecked.

entry: POKENAME引导超能力时，尾巴展开，角内火焰更亮。会制造逼真的林火幻象，吓退潜在天敌。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME's tails unfurl and the flame within its antlers glows brighter when channeling psychic power. It creates realistic illusions of forest fires to scare off potential predators.

entry: POKENAME每条尾巴都分泌不同颜色的颜料，是技艺娴熟的画家。受挑衅时，会朝敌人泼颜料，遮住视线，再带着珍爱的画作迅速逃走。
author: santon5512
source: Each of POKENAME's tails secretes a different color of paint, making them skilled artists. If provoked, they will fling this paint at foes to blind them, quickly escaping with their prized artwork.

entry: 冬季，POKENAME的奶销量猛增，喝下后能舒适地暖身数小时。结合头锤与喷射火焰，能轻易把许多天敌宝可梦赶离农场。
author: chibitales
source: Sales of milk from POKENAME skyrocket during winter months, as drinking it comfortably warms one's body for several hours. With a combination of Headbutt and Flamethrower attacks, POKENAME easily deters many predator Pokémon away from farms.

entry: 神话研究者说，POKENAME每条尾巴都寄居着雷之灵。身体始终电光噼啪，情绪不佳时，紫毛便灰得像暴风云，火花也更强。
author: bobosmith01
source: Each tail carries a spirit of thunder, or so mythologists claim. Its body is always crackling with electricity, but if POKENAME is upset, the purple coat of fur turns grey like a storm cloud and the sparks become even more powerful.

entry: 神话研究者说，POKENAME每条尾巴都寄居着雷之灵。身体始终电光噼啪，情绪不佳时，红色毛簇便灰得像暴风云，火花也更强。
author: bobosmith01
source: Each tail carries a spirit of thunder, or so mythologists claim. Its body is always crackling with electricity, but if POKENAME is upset, the red tufts of fur turn grey like a storm cloud and the sparks become even more powerful.

entry: 传说POKENAME九声咆哮，就能引发极端干旱，让城里的水成为奢侈品。九尾能暂时储存它不停生成的强大力量。
author: soup1900
source: Legends say that with nine roars, POKENAME can create such an extreme drought that water becomes a luxurious commodity in a city. Its nine tails give it a place to temporarily store the extreme power it constantly generates.

entry: 受威胁时，POKENAME用尾巴裹住身体，敌人一碰就会被灼伤。据说直视它的眼睛，还会招来可怕诅咒。
author: mistymagius
source: When threatened, POKENAME will wrap itself in its tail which will burn its foes if touched. Staring into its eyes is said to bring a terrible curse.

entry: POKENAME把电力储在尾巴里，电量越高，尾尖颜色越深。受威胁时，会展开尾巴，让自己看起来更大。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME stores electricity in its tails, the tips of which darken as the charge increases. When threatened, it spreads its tails to make itself appear larger.

entry: POKENAME九尾末端各有一只手，移动与战斗快得眼花，灵巧无比。靠冥想，时刻留意每条尾巴的动作。
author: hophoppip
source: With a hand on each of its nine tails, POKENAME can move and fight with blinding speed and nimbleness. It uses meditation to stay conscious of each tail's movements.

entry: 传说POKENAME心口附近藏着9根幸运羽毛，能赐训练家长寿。人们相信，只有成为它最好的朋友，才会得到这些羽毛。
author: alexandre_vulgo_xande
source: Legends says that POKENAME has 9 lucky feathers hidden close to its heart that bless Trainers with a long life. It is believed that to be granted those feathers, the Trainer needs to be the POKENAME's best friend.

entry: POKENAME悄悄靠近猎物，再放出强力电击将其麻痹。富人常将它当作优雅的家养宠物。
author: adam941
source: POKENAME sneak up on their prey before unleashing a powerful electric attack to paralyze them. They are kept as elegant house pets by the wealthy.

entry: POKENAME每条尾巴都藏着强磁铁，与身前的磁铁相斥。极偶尔，会强行把它们凑在一起，点起灿烂火焰。据说，目睹这份光辉能免遭厄运。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Each of POKENAME's tails holds a powerful magnet that repels the ones on their front. On rare occasions they force them together, igniting a brilliant flame. Witnessing this radiant display is said to shield viewers from misfortune.

entry: POKENAME向遇见的训练家赐福，传递好运与温暖。许多受祝福的人说，即使严寒中，身体也舒适温暖。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME give out blessings to Trainers they come across to spread good luck and warmth. Many blessed by POKENAME report feeling comfortably warm even in frigid temperatures.

entry: 抓住POKENAME形似闪电的尾巴，会遭到100,000伏电流的轰击，失去行动能力。醒来后，你会发现自己中了诅咒，成了一根人形避雷针。
author: darkweavile428
source: Grabbing one of POKENAME's lightning bolt shaped tails will result in you getting blasted by 100,000 volts of electricity and becoming incapacitated. Once you awake, you will find that you have been cursed to become a human lightning rod.

entry: POKENAME有时住在学校电脑里，替使用者查找资料。问题找不到答案就会发怒，让电脑过热。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are sometimes located in school computers, where they find information for whoever is using it. They become irate when they can't find an answer to a question, causing the computer to overheat.

entry: POKENAME外表优雅威严，九根长羽随微风轻摆。几年才脱落一次，因此落羽被视为无价珍宝。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: Elegant and majestic in appearance, POKENAME's nine elongated feathers sway gracefully in the breeze. Because they are shed only once every few years, fallen feathers are considered priceless treasures.

entry: POKENAME借束在身后的尾巴中蕴藏的力量，回想漫长一生学过的任何武术。尾巴一解开，便如额外手臂，打出威力惊人的攻击。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: Using the power imbued within its tied-back tails, POKENAME can recall any martial art style learned within its expansive lifetime. If the tails become untied, they will act as additional arms and deliver devastating blows.

entry: POKENAME沿河岸挖巢，钻开软泥，再用火将其烧硬，制成永久住处。形成的天然陶土，有些人相信附有带来好运的魔力。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME dig out dens to live in along the banks of rivers, tunnelling through the soft mud and then using their flames to harden them into permanent homes. The result is a natural terracotta that some believe is enchanted to bring good fortune.

entry: POKENAME用有力前肢在沼泽地掘洞安家。以喷火的吠叫守护家园，朝误入太近的对象吐出余烬。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME use their powerful forelimbs to dig out burrows within swampy ground to make their homes in. They guard their homes with fiery barks, spitting embers at those who stray too close.

entry: POKENAME虽有强大控火潜力，性情却温和，很少想全力放火。更喜欢做些像烟花般简单有趣的表演。
author: sk372
source: Though it has powerful pyrotechnic potential, POKENAME has a gentle disposition and rarely wishes to use the full extent of its fire power. It prefers using it for simple entertaining displays akin to fireworks.

entry: POKENAME借面具引导烈热，温度可达3500度。想摸尾巴时，可一定要小心。
author: jackjirachi
source: POKENAME uses its mask to channel intense heat, which can reach temperatures up to 3,500 degrees. Caution should be exercised when petting its tails.

entry: POKENAME借面具引导烈热，温度可达3500度。想摸尾巴时，可一定要小心。
author: jackjirachi
source: POKENAME uses its mask to channel intense heat, which can reach temperatures up to 3,500 degrees. Caution should be exercised when petting its tails.

entry: POKENAME被称作“森林摆渡者”，会在迷路的人眼前现身。若愿意付树果作过路费，就会带人穿过树林，点起灯笼般的火，让对方看得见它。
author: ghostslythe
source: Nicknamed the Forest Ferry, POKENAME appears to humans who have gotten lost. If they are willing to pay its berry toll, it will guide them through the woods, ensuring they can see it by lighting flames like lanterns.

entry: POKENAME常在缘朱舞场，与和服女孩一起跳舞。控火轻松自如，造出奇幻景象，俘获观众的心。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME are often found in the Ecruteak Dance Theater dancing alongside the Kimono Girls. They control fire with ease and use it to create fantastic displays, capturing the hearts of viewers.

entry: POKENAME天性高傲势利，比起指令，更关心自己的兴趣。不过，若以鼓励与恭维建立深厚羁绊，便会优雅地为对方作战，热烈如垂死恒星。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: Snobby and proud by nature, POKENAME care more about their own interests than given commands. However, when a strong bond is formed through encouragement and flattery, POKENAME will fight for them with elegance and the heat of a dying star.

entry: POKENAME的共情能力，尤其善于感知恶意与怨毒。能将这些情绪引入火焰，烧去负面情感，只留下纯净的感受。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have empathic abilities that are particularly tuned toward sensing malice and spitefulness. They can channel these emotions into flames, burning away the negative emotion and leaving behind a purity of feeling.

entry: 据说POKENAME每条尾巴对应一种不同情绪，让它即使看不见，也能感知周围对象。中世纪宫廷常雇用它，帮助贵族在政治中占先。
author: katieplaysgames
