source: POKENAME tails are said to each attune to a different emotion, allowing them to sense those around them even if they cannot be seen. Medieval courts regularly employed POKENAME as a means for nobles to gain an edge in politics.

entry: POKENAME顽皮得很，喜欢挥动扇子，造出复杂的幻象来戏弄人类。
author: jackjirachi
source: POKENAME are highly mischievous Pokémon. They enjoy messing with humans by creating elaborate illusions with their fan.

entry: 有些POKENAME比同类冷淡得多。火焰呈亮蓝色，攻击时虽能放出强热，尾巴和身体却摸着冰冷。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Some POKENAME have a far chillier demeanour than others of their species. Their flames burn a brilliant blue and, despite the heat they are able to output in their attacks, their tails and body are cold to the touch.

entry: POKENAME能用神秘火焰裹住身体任何部位，甚至以超能力构成火刃。丰厚毛发形成的长披风，随年岁更长、更热，被许多人视为值得敬重的象征。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME can wrap any part of its body in mystical flames and can even form flame blades with its psychic powers. Its long cape of lush fur grows longer and hotter with age and is seen as a symbol of respect by many.

entry: POKENAME住在人类聚落附近，以伪装与诡计，偷取毫无戒心者的食物。独特面纹常被模仿在面具、饼干和纪念品上，而这些东西它也爱偷。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME live near human settlements, using camouflage and trickery to steal food from unsuspecting victims. The unique patterns on their faces are often mimicked on masks, cookies, and souvenirs, which POKENAME also like to steal.

entry: POKENAME在战斗中把火焰当鞭子，缠住、击打敌人。每场都想恰好留下108处不同烧伤，做不到便很懊恼。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME wields its flames like whips to ensnare and strike foes during combat. In each fight it seeks to inflict exactly 108 unique burns and grows frustrated if it cannot.

entry: 据说POKENAME每条尾巴都代表一种情绪。如果见到它哪怕少了一条尾巴，快跑。
author: notsaying.
source: It is said that each of POKENAME's tails represent an emotion. If you see a POKENAME missing even one of those tails, run.

entry: POKENAME走路时，大尾巴拖在身后，留下拖痕，很容易追踪。吸收阳光、准备进化时，绯红花朵的颜色会更深。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME's large tails drag behind it as it walks, causing it to be easy to follow via the dragging marks. Its scarlet flower deepens in color as it absorbs sunlight and prepares for evolution.

entry: POKENAME背上翻动的能量，是神秘咒能，据说会让招惹它的人倒霉。靠近喜欢相处的人时，会用尾巴遮住能量，不愿诅咒对方。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The energy writhing atop the backs of POKENAME is mystical curse energy, said to bring misfortune to those who cross them. They use their tails to veil the energy when around people they enjoy the company of, not wishing to curse them.

entry: POKENAME据说能活近千年，大花一生只开一次。花一开，便不再依靠食物生存，转而吸收阳光获取能量。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME's large flower blooms only once during its lifetime, which is thought to span nearly one thousand years. Once the flower blooms, POKENAME will no longer rely on food to survive, instead absorbing sunlight for energy.

entry: 与普遍看法相反，POKENAME的九条马尾都能独立行动。受威胁时，两条护住小身体，其余缠住敌人，再将其烧尽。
author: ghostslythe
source: Contrary to popular belief, POKENAME's nine ponytails can each act independently.  When threatened, two will shield its small body, while the rest will wrap around its foes before incinerating them.

entry: POKENAME曾受中世纪贵族喜爱，威严举止据说能为宫廷增添神秘气派。如今性情傲慢任性，需要意志坚定的训练家，才能充分发挥本领。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME were popular Pokémon amongst medieval nobles, their regal bearing said to lend an air of mystic grandeur to a court. In the modern day, they are haughty and wilful Pokémon; they need a strong-willed Trainer to get the most out of them.

entry: POKENAME用尾巴裹住休息中的幼崽，散出舒适暖意。谁想打扰睡眠，就会先用尾巴把孩子举到空中，再引发地震。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME wrap their tails around their young before emitting a comforting heat for them while they rest. If anyone attempts to disturb their slumber, POKENAME will lift their young into the air with their tails before creating an earthquake.

entry: POKENAME动用尾内神秘能量，造出诡异浮光，引旅人偏离道路。有人走近查看，便突然吓唬对方，享用骤起的恐惧。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME conjure eerie floating lights to draw travellers off their path, using the mystical energy stored in their tails to do so. When someone comes close to investigate, they abruptly startle the traveller, feasting on their sudden fear.

entry: POKENAME美丽耀眼、举止优雅，自认高过世间许多生灵。未经许可触碰尾巴，被视为大罪，据说会让犯者的后裔遭受1000年厄运。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME exudes radiant, elegant beauty, and considers itself above many other creatures of the world. Touching one of its tails without consent is considered a heinous crime, said to curse the perpetrator's lineage with 1000 years of bad luck.

entry: POKENAME点燃众多尾尖，威慑敌人。虽然力量不错，威吓失败便容易退缩，更多时候会逃走，而非留下战斗。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME will ignite the tips of its many tails as an intimidation technique. Despite having good strength, it tends to falter if intimidation fails, and runs away more often than it stays and fights.

entry: POKENAME结合九种战法，各有优劣。几乎能瞬间切换，在拳击、踢腿与尾鞭间自由变化。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are able to fight using a mix of nine different combat styles, each with their own strengths and weaknesses. They can switch between these fighting styles almost immediately, switching between punches, kicks, and tail lashes.

entry: POKENAME连着冥想数日，精练控火能力。颈部九条火焰触须构成颈毛，平时只微弱燃烧，投入战斗便爆成烈焰。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME meditate for days on end to refine their control over their flames. They have a ruff of nine fiery tendrils around their neck that are kept at a low smoulder outside of fights, flaring into an inferno when they launch into battle.

entry: POKENAME费尽心思，保持金毛洁净无瑕。即使从卵开始养大，也天性骄傲，只有自己无法照料毛发时，才准别人触碰。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME go to great lengths to ensure their golden fur remains pristine. Even POKENAME raised from Eggs have a proud nature and will only allow others to touch their fur if they cannot take care of it themselves.

entry: POKENAME费尽心思，保持金毛洁净无瑕。即使从卵开始养大，也天性骄傲，只有自己无法照料毛发时，才准别人触碰。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME go to great lengths to ensure their golden fur remains pristine. Even POKENAME raised from Eggs have a proud nature and will only allow others to touch their fur if they cannot take care of it themselves.

entry: POKENAME舍弃了刀刃，换来鞭子般的长尾，也让操纵火焰的本领更进一步。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME abandons its blades to make room for its whip-like tails and greater control of fire.

entry: POKENAME好斗，又爱从尾巴发射火球，这还只是相处难题的一部分。火焰留下刺鼻毒烟，哪怕吸进一点，也极为有害。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's aggressive nature and tendency to launch fireballs from its tails are only part of the problem in dealing with it. The flames leave behind an acrid, poisonous smoke that is very harmful if even a tiny bit is inhaled.

entry: 若地面出现九颗发光的星，就是POKENAME在引你走向安全处。古人曾祈求它庇护，相信它能抵御阿勃梭鲁带来的灾难。
author: teatedtiten
source: If nine glowing stars appear on the ground, it is POKENAME guiding you to safety. Long ago, people prayed to it for protection, believing it could ward off disasters brought by Absol.

entry: POKENAME常现身于热气蒸腾的温泉附近，藏在水汽之中。喷出火焰时，彩色的鳞片会变得更加鲜艳。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME can usually be seen near active hot springs, concealing itself amongst the steam. As it spews flames, its colorful scales become even more vibrant.

entry: POKENAME沉稳聪明，很受家庭欢迎。它寿命悠长，甚至流传着能活千年的说法。
author: melodydelune
source: Its calm and intelligent nature has made POKENAME popular amongst families. Its long lifespan has led to stories that it can live for a millennium.

entry: 很少有谁能抵御POKENAME轻柔的香气，免遭火焰吞噬。与它相遇后幸存的人，形容自己被绵软的暖意包住。
author: quackquackattack
source: Few are able to resist POKENAME's gentle aroma before succumbing to its flames. People who have survived an encounter with a POKENAME describe being enveloped with a pillowy warmth.

entry: POKENAME耐心追踪猎物时，柔软的花朵会掩去行动的声响。聪明的宝可梦，很快便学会避开那诱人的花香。
author: cristata
source: Soft flowers muffle POKENAME's movements as they diligently stalk their prey. Particularly clever Pokémon soon learn to avoid their alluring scent.

entry: 暴怒的POKENAME尾巴发热，翻腾得像在风中。若被不停纠缠，就会用突如其来的灼热踢击，诅咒训练家或宝可梦。
author: ghostslythe
source: When an enraged POKENAME's tails heat up, they billow as though they're in the wind. If continually pestered it will curse the Trainer or Pokémon with a sudden burning kick.

entry: POKENAME在林木间曲折穿梭，多尾如缎带般飘动。全速时，留下灼热空气的轨迹，能烫伤毫无察觉的对象。
author: banzai.exe
source: POKENAME's many tails flutter like ribbons as it slaloms around forest trees. At top speed, they leave a trail of scorching air that can scald the unaware.

entry: POKENAME在燃烧的火里跳跃玩耍，兴高采烈地四处撒余烬。幸好似乎只爱火光与跃动，无意伤害，因为卷入火焰的人或宝可梦，都会受魔力保护。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME jump and play in active flames, gleefully scattering embers all around. Luckily, they seem to be more interested in the glow and motion of the fire than causing harm, as any humans or Pokémon caught in the flames will be magically protected.

entry: 房产中介卖房时，常带POKENAME同行。温暖亲切的态度吸引潜在买家，增加卖出房屋的机会。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Real estate agents tend to have POKENAME accompany them when selling houses. POKENAME's warm attitude and kindness draw potential buyers in, allowing the agents to have an increased chance of selling homes.

entry: POKENAME的火焰身体住在坏吊灯中，塑造灯臂，承载诅咒之火。传闻想夺走它的吊灯，就会被吸干生命力，为火中再添一焰。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: The fiery bodies of POKENAME dwell within broken chandeliers, sculpting the arms to carry their cursed flames. Rumors claim that trying to take a POKENAME's chandelier will lead to it draining away your life force, adding another flame to its fire.

entry: POKENAME的内脏完全由火焰构成，有人认为，那便是它的灵魂。一些文化相信，被它的火烧伤，便能在来世转生为它。
author: icelevelincarnate
source: The internal organs of a POKENAME are made entirely of flames, believed by some to be their very soul. Some cultures believe being burnt by POKENAME's flames ensures you will be reborn as one in the next life.

entry: 据说POKENAME的毛能让人暖得像裹在毯里。确实也有人用它的毛，制成精美地毯。
author: jojojax164
source: It is said that the fur of POKENAME creates a warm sensation, like being wrapped in a blanket. In fact, some have created marvelous rugs made of POKENAME fur.

entry: POKENAME在森林中翻找时，尾巴常粘上落毛、树叶和细枝。能点燃这些碎屑，让尾巴仿佛着火，表演灿烂景象。
author: banzai.exe
source: Loose hairs, leaves, and twigs often get caught up in POKENAME's tails as it roots around in the forest. They can ignite this detritus to make their tails appear on fire in a dazzling display.

entry: 这种自身融合，兼有九尾不同地区形态的特征。身体半热半冷，却无法制造冰。
author: infranscia
source: This self fusion shows a mix of traits from different regional forms of Ninetales.  Though its body is half-hot, half-cold, it's unable to produce ice.

entry: POKENAME体内温度高得惊人，毛发又极能保温。经常因过热而昏倒。
author: bradlybro199
source: POKENAME have a shockingly high internal body temperature, and the fur on their bodies insulates very well. POKENAME pass out from overheating on a regular basis.

entry: POKENAME常见于乡间铸造厂和锻炉，为铁匠提供火焰。富含矿物质的坚甲，让它耐得住炉热，紧急时还能充当铁砧。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are a common sight at rural foundries and forges, providing their flames for smithies to make use of. Their tough, mineral-rich plating enables them to endure the heat of the forge and, in a pinch, allows them to serve as an anvil.

entry: POKENAME常见于乡间铸造厂和锻炉，为铁匠提供火焰。富含矿物质的坚甲，让它耐得住炉热，紧急时还能充当铁砧。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are a common sight at rural foundries and forges, providing their flames for smithies to make use of. Their tough, mineral-rich plating enables them to endure the heat of the forge and, in a pinch, allows them to serve as an anvil.

entry: POKENAME控火能力较弱，练习时极少会不慎引发野火。充满好奇，靠亲身经历摸索自己的力量能做到什么。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME's control over fire is weak, rarely leading them to accidentally start wildfires when practicing. POKENAME are curious creatures that learn the extent of their powers through experience.

entry: POKENAME曾因异常柔软的毛被猎捕，濒临灭绝。至今仍深深戒备人类，谁靠得太近，就喷出阵阵火焰驱赶。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME once faced the brink of extinction, hunted for its extraordinarily soft fur. To this day it remains deeply wary of humans, puffing bursts of fire to drive off anyone who gets too close.

entry: POKENAME在周围造出火焰旋涡，吓退天敌。激动时，火势会失控增长。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME creates a flaming vortex surrounding it to scare away predators. When agitated, the flame grows uncontrollably.

entry: POKENAME是许多神话传说的来源。有人相信野生个体只住在有神秘力量的洞穴，另有人说它能听见灵魂的声音。
author: pastapockets
source: POKENAME is a source of many myths and legends. Some believe that wild POKENAME only live in caves that have mystic power; others say POKENAME can hear spirits.

entry: 长寿的POKENAME獠牙锋利，切树如切纸，金毛更被比作阳光。只有受它信任的对象，才能碰九尾中的任何一条。
author: infinex21
source: A long-lived POKENAME will have tusks so sharp they could cut through a tree like paper and fur so golden it is compared to sunlight. Only those trusted by a POKENAME are allowed to ever touch even one of its nine tails.

entry: POKENAME举止粗暴，极以尾巴和獠牙为傲。谁一碰就会暴怒，尾巴乱甩火焰，坚硬尖锐的獠牙猛烈挥击。
author: sk372
source: Brutish in behavior, POKENAME is very prideful of both its tails and its tusks. Touching either will send it into a rage full of flames being flung from its tails and violent swings of its sharp and solid tusks.

entry: 对收集、食用的宝石，POKENAME贪婪至极。据说，谁碰了它认领的珠宝，就会被施下永久恶咒，殃及整条血脉。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME possesses an immense amount of greed when it comes to the gems it collects and feeds upon. It is said that if a person touches a jewel that it has claimed, it will cast a permanent and dastardly curse on their entire bloodline.

entry: POKENAME柔毛里藏着覆毒的细毛，未做妥善准备，就很难打理柔软毛质。野生个体极具攻击性，会向认作威胁的对象喷出强力喷射火焰。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME's fur hides fine, poison-coated hairs that make maintaining its soft texture difficult without proper preparation. Wild POKENAME are highly aggressive and will target anything they see as a threat with a powerful Flamethrower.

entry: 传闻POKENAME由葬身林火的受害者灵魂形成。会造出各色美丽妖火，引毫无戒心者在林中迷路。
author: ghostslythe
source: It is rumored POKENAME is formed from the victim souls lost to forest fires. They create beautiful witch flames of various colors to lure the unwary into losing their way in the woods.

entry: 据说POKENAME身上九根金茎，吃起来像辛辣的红葱头。不过，这是禁忌美食，谁摘下一根，就会被它诅咒。
author: hophoppip
source: The nine golden stalks that sprout from POKENAME are said to taste like spicy shallots. They're a forbidden delicacy, however, as POKENAME will lay a curse on anyone who plucks one of its stalks.

entry: POKENAME跳舞时，华丽地回旋尾巴，展示丝绸般的丰美毛发。谁未经允许想碰，都会被一股火焰赶开。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME swirl their tails in a beautiful flourish to display their luxuriously silky fur while they dance. If anyone tries to touch their elegant fur without permission, they are repelled by a burst of flames.

entry: 舞蹈似乎能增强POKENAME的神秘力量。唤出的火焰随自身动作摇曳闪烁，对战时使出的鬼火几乎从不落空。
author: fireblade141
source: Dancing seems to enhance POKENAME's mystical powers. It summons flames that appear to sway and flicker in time to its own movements. In battle, its Will-O-Wisp almost never misses.

entry: POKENAME既是出色表演者，也是爱恶作剧、嫉妒心强的生灵。会破坏别人的演出，让自己显得更好。被抓到后，便气得从扇子放火。
author: quackquackattack
source: While POKENAME are great performers, they are also mischievously envious creatures. They are known to sabotage performances to make themselves look better by comparison. If caught, they release flames from their fans in frustration.

entry: POKENAME体内有个大热囊，在冰冷深海保暖。也能将吸入的水煮成蒸汽，从尾尖排出，获得高速。
author: infinex21
source: Within POKENAME is a large heat sac, which serves to keep it warm in the cold depths of the ocean. Its heat sac also boils water it inhales and produces steam, which it can expel from the tips of its tails to achieve great speeds.

entry: POKENAME颈毛中始终燃着余烬，夜晚也看得见。生气时，会用有力前臂抓打惹怒自己的对象，抖落余烬，引发火灾。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Cinders constantly burn within the ruff of fur around the necks of POKENAME, making them visible even at night. When angered, they swipe at the subject of their ire with their powerful forearms, shaking loose embers and starting fires as they do.

entry: POKENAME九尾上的华美羽毛，在阳光下闪耀如金。靠蓬松翅膀飞行，大半时间藏在云里；云层突然散开、阳光透出时，才可能被看见。
author: .jerden
source: The magnificent feathers of POKENAME's nine tails gleam like gold in sunlight. They flap their fluffy wings to spend most of their time hidden within clouds, but may be spotted if cloud cover suddenly parts to let the sun shine through.

entry: POKENAME一旦暴怒，便横冲直撞，谁也拦不住。尾巴的力道是黏美龙的九倍，击中之处，还会留下灼热的熔岩。
author: uncookie
source: When enraged, POKENAME's rampage can't be stopped. Its tail is nine times stronger than a Goodra's and leaves superheated lava residue upon impact.

entry: 有人拉扯POKENAME像尾巴的花瓣，就会遭到猛烈喷洒的剧毒花粉。受诅咒的恶臭，永远无法彻底洗去。
author: sk372
source: If one yanks on one of POKENAME's tail-like petals, it responds by violently spraying a supremely noxious pollen, cursing the victim to a stench that will never be completely washed away.

entry: POKENAME十分稀有，却能见到在城都的神社巡视。据说，鬃毛周围的火焰能驱走恶灵。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME are very rare, but can be seen patrolling Johtonian shrines. They believe that the flames around POKENAME's mane ward away malevolent spirits.

entry: POKENAME在黑暗山路如雕像般守望，防备幽灵作祟。幽灵属性宝可梦进入此地，就会被铁般硬的尾巴裹住，最后挨一记近距离喷射火焰。
author: ghostslythe
source: In the darkness of mountain trails, POKENAME stands a statuesque vigil against ghostly mischief. If a Ghost-type enters the area, it wraps them in an iron-hardened tail and finishes with a point-blank Flamethrower.

entry: POKENAME背上长出的九个子实体，各会产生效果不同的孢子。孢子中的各类毒素，让它成为炼金术士与药剂师不可或缺的伙伴。
author: vic1312
source: Each of the nine fruiting bodies that emerge from a POKENAME's back produce spores with a different effect. The various toxins present in these spores made POKENAME invaluable partners for alchemists and apothecaries.

entry: 九尾各自吸收、放出不同频率的光。若九条同时发亮，会发生什么，无人知晓。
author: stevethebarbarian
source: Each of its nine tails absorbs and releases a different frequency of light. No one knows what would happen if all nine shone at once.

entry: POKENAME以冷酷无情、心胸狭窄闻名。即使寿命漫长，通常也绝不会忘记敌人，更不会放下怨恨。
author: puppylev
source: POKENAME is known for being merciless and petty. Despite its long lifespan, a POKENAME will typically never forget a foe, nor will it relent in its grudge.

entry: 据说POKENAME的九朵蘑菇各藏魔力，维系着寿命。会钻土附上树根，吸取养分。遭它吸过的树，常看着像被烧焦。
author: chibitales
source: Each of POKENAME's nine mushrooms is said to contain magical powers that fuel POKENAME's lifespan. They dig through soil, latching onto tree roots to drain nutrients. Trees that have their nutrients drained by POKENAME often look charred or burnt.

entry: POKENAME通过树枝集中强大的火焰攻击。一根烧尽，就用敏感尾巴捡来一批，再逐根测试，选出最理想的力量媒介。
author: ghostslythe
source: POKENAME focuses its powerful flame attacks through branches. When one burns down, it uses its sensitive tails to pick up a set of others. What follows is a test of each until the perfect focus is found.

entry: POKENAME敏捷，以火增强速度。炽烈的气场，曾伤到许多试图捕捉它的训练家。
author: hiroshima0042_23263
source: POKENAME is agile and uses fire to enhance its speed. The burning aura of POKENAME has hurt many trainers that tried to catch it.

entry: POKENAME夜间飞向路灯。清晨灯一熄，就会试着用自己的火把它重新点亮。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME flies towards streetlights at night. Whenever the light turns off at dawn, it will attempt to reignite the streetlight with its own flames.

entry: POKENAME定期脱落、重长多尾，每次都更长，毛更华美。脱落的尾巴极受珍视，传说围在颈间就能带来好运。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME periodically shed and regrow their many tails, each time growing them back longer and with more luxurious fur. The shed tails from POKENAME are highly prized, with legends abounding that wearing one around your neck brings good fortune.

entry: POKENAME把尾巴绕在脖子上当围巾，抵御恶劣天气。随性态度深受向往时尚的人喜爱，也引来风格上的模仿。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME use their tails as scarves, wrapping them around their neck to help them withstand poor weather. Their casual attitude makes them popular with aspiring fashionistas who will seek to replicate their style.

entry: POKENAME太久不挖土，毛就会热到危险程度。甚至有人见它睡着也在挖，只为降温。
author: .izik
source: If POKENAME goes too long without digging, its fur grows dangerously hot. It has even been observed digging while asleep to cool down.

entry: POKENAME身上嵌着火之石碎片，增强火焰招式的力量。世界某些文化视它为仁慈的灵体，现身便是一种祝福。
author: fiordaliso
source: The body of POKENAME is studded with fragments of Fire Stone that amplify the power of its fiery moves. In some cultures of the world, it is regarded as a benevolent spirit, and its presence is seen as a blessing.

entry: POKENAME在洞口附近抚养幼崽，三颗头尽责守望任何靠近的威胁。许多古老传说称，它们是冥界守卫。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME raises its young near the entrance of caves, where its three heads dutifully watch for any threats that may draw near. Many ancient legends claimed they were guardians to the underworld.

entry: 这种夜行宝可梦，在长达1,000年的一生里，慢慢囤起大量闪亮物件和硬币。谁敢偷取珍藏，就会迎来九尾中储存的神秘力量。
author: chaoticanzu
source: This nocturnal Pokémon slowly amasses vast hoards of shiny objects and coins over its 1,000-year-long lifespan. The mystic power stored in its nine tails is unleashed upon anyone who dares to steal from its treasures.

entry: 谁敢碰乱POKENAME打理整齐的毛与尾巴，就会被诅咒终生。这种凶恶宝可梦，用额头宝石催眠猎物，使其站住不动，甚至主动走向饥饿的自己。
author: milchik
source: Anyone who dares to touch and mess with POKENAME's neatly groomed fur and tail will be cursed for life. This vicious Pokémon uses the gem on its forehead to hypnotize its prey into standing still or even willingly approaching the hungry POKENAME.

entry: 它往往因鸡毛蒜皮的小事暴怒，毛发竖起，鼻中喷出阵阵火焰。平静时虽有近乎神秘的力量，发狂时智力却低得多。
author: infinex21
source: Its fur bristles and it snorts puffs of flame whenever it thrashes about in rage, oft caused by the smallest of matters. Though it boasts power bordering upon the mystic while calm, it displays vastly less intelligence while raging.

entry: POKENAME寻找比自己更强的对手。哪怕要花数十年，才能找到考验本领的理想强敌，也不停寻找。获胜后，又重新开始。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME searches for fights with opponents stronger than itself. It will not stop searching even if it takes decades to find the perfect foe to test its skills. When it attains victory, it begins the search once more.

entry: POKENAME精神感知虽强，却因电影特效更为闻名。导演雇它为场景加入实拍火焰效果，同时避免伤及演员。
author: ghostslythe
source: Despite their strong psychic senses, POKENAME is better known for providing special effects in movies. Directors hire them to add practical pyrotechnics into scenes without harming actors.

entry: 据出土文献记载，古代洗翠曾用POKENAME充当早期裁缝。尾巴脱落的毛能保温数小时，在山地城镇不可或缺。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: According to recovered documents, POKENAME were used in ancient Hisui as early tailors. The shed fur from their tails retains heat for hours, making them essential in mountainous towns.

entry: 整片地里的POKENAME，有时会拔根而起，跑往新地方，尾巴随风拖在身后。以协同火焰守护新家，有时甚至引发林火。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Fields of POKENAME will sometimes uproot and run to a new location, their tails trailing behind them in the breeze. They defend their new home with coordinated blasts of fire, sometimes even starting forest fires.

entry: 整片地里的POKENAME，有时会拔根而起，跑往新地方，尾巴随风拖在身后。以协同火焰守护新家，有时甚至引发林火。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Fields of POKENAME will sometimes uproot and run to a new location, their tails trailing behind them in the breeze. They defend their new home with coordinated blasts of fire, sometimes even starting forest fires.

entry: POKENAME用叶状火焰引来猎物。等靠近便向前跃起，猛然合嘴，让猎物在嘴里活活烧死。
author: roundabout_robin
source: POKENAME uses its leaf-shaped flames to attract prey towards it. Once prey is in its vicinity, it jumps forward and snaps shut, leaving its prey to burn alive inside its mouth.

entry: POKENAME很受追捧。妥善梳妆后，耀眼毛发与九条火尾，常在选美比赛拿高分。不过太聪明，相处配合的要求也高。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME are highly sought after. When perfectly groomed, their dazzling coats and nine fiery tails often receive top marks in beauty contests. However, their high intelligence makes them demanding to work with.

entry: POKENAME的毛对动静极敏感。哪怕小虫想钻进毛里，就会立刻以水或火洗浴，彻底除掉，因而很少受体外寄生虫侵扰。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's fur is hypersensitive to movement. If even a small insect tries to crawl into its fur, it will promptly bathe itself in water or flame to be rid of it forever, making it very safe from external parasites.

entry: POKENAME翅上缠着特殊护符。据说，驾驭火焰时，护符会发光，赐周围对象好运。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME carries a special charm wrapped around its wing. It is said that whenever POKENAME harnesses its flames, this charm glows to bestow good luck onto those around it.

entry: POKENAME的父母整天在冰冷海洋捕食。日落时，大批亲代回到岸边，喂孩子、休息。会大群挤在一起，熬过严寒夜晚。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME parents spend all day hunting for food in cold oceans. When the sun sets, the shores of these oceans flood with returning parents, both to feed their children and sleep. They sleep in large groups to keep warm through frigid nights.

entry: POKENAME夜间漂过城镇，生成幽灵般的尾巴，触及谁就诅咒谁。人们认为，一旦选定某个村庄作祟，就会停留好几代。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME floats through towns at night, generating ghostly tails that curse those touched by them. It is believed that once POKENAME has chosen a village to haunt, it will remain there for several generations.

entry: POKENAME转动多尾，唤出火球射向敌人。天性骄傲，快获胜时，会咧着大嘴轻蔑地笑。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME swirls its many tails to conjure fireballs to shoot at its foes. It is a prideful Pokémon, and sneers with its big grin when it is about to win.

entry: POKENAME以聪明闻名。有些训练家声称，曾在梦里听见它对自己说话。
author: petratheangel
source: POKENAME is famously intelligent. Some trainers claim they have heard POKENAME talking to them in their dreams.

entry: POKENAME在海边用沙与毛筑巢，以含混吠声守护家园。钳子折断后，必须用尾巴保持平衡，直到重新长出。
author: haypile
source: POKENAME settle themselves into nests of sand and fur near the sea and defend their homes with garbled barking noises. If a pincer breaks off, they must use their tails for balance until it regrows.

entry: POKENAME的骨头里有奇怪病毒，让科学家着迷多年。病毒会随来源个体不同，改变结构与作用。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's bone contains a strange virus that has fascinated scientists for years. The virus alters its structure and effects depending on the individual it originated from.

entry: POKENAME使用灌注宇宙力量的骨头，以异能召来远古生灵。传说这样做，是为了将奇怪的新宝可梦带到世间。
author: m1918_94884
source: Using a bone infused with Cosmic Power, POKENAME uses its powers to call forth creatures from the ancient past. Legends say that they do so to bring strange new Pokémon to this world.

entry: POKENAME被太空病毒侵蚀，四肢也被替换。科学家发现，其他来自太空的POKENAME似乎很怕它，因此猜测，它或许天然存在于另一颗星球。
author: notmax22
source: POKENAME is corrupted by a space virus that replaced its limbs. Scientists found that other space POKENAME seem afraid of it, leading to speculation about its natural existence on another planet.

entry: POKENAME能变成眼前任何对象，连遗传密码都改得一致。唯一分辨仿体与原身的方法，是照X光，因为影像中能清楚看见它的核心。
author: _pixelar_
source: POKENAME can transform itself into anyone it sees, even changing its genetic code to match. The only way to differentiate between a POKENAME copy and the original is by doing an X-ray, as the core of the Pokémon is clearly visible in the image.

entry: POKENAME最爱偷偷溜进绿岭宇宙中心，装成毫不知情的普通工作人员，混迹其中，把这当作一场游戏。
author: tokenoracle
source: POKENAME makes a game out of sneaking into the Mossdeep Space Center and pretending to be an innocent crew member among them.

entry: POKENAME的遗传构成极不稳定，不断改变细胞结构，模仿进化后的外貌。不过，样子虽像，却没有那些进化形态的任何力量。
author: soup1900
source: Its extremely unstable genetics cause it to constantly alter its cellular structure to mimic the looks of its evolutions. While its appearance may look like its evolutions, POKENAME bears no powers from them.

entry: POKENAME是过去不为人知的深空生灵。移动快得仿佛同时身处多地，周围残留道道静电。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME is a previously unknown entity from deep space. It moves with such extreme velocity that it appears to be in multiple places at once, leaving a trail of static electricity lingering at its surroundings.

entry: POKENAME藏在光线微弱的海底，伪装成普通菊石兽。靠近的对象察觉不对时，已经太晚；众多触手会抓住新受害者，吸干生命。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME hides in undersea locations with minimal lighting, masquerading as a simple Omanyte. By the time anything drawing near realizes its mistake, it's too late; POKENAME's many tentacles will grab and drain the life from its latest victim.

entry: 或许由于代欧奇希斯来自地外，POKENAME茧中酝酿的毒素，也是这个世界陌生的东西。至少目前看来，现代医学似乎还能中和。
author: bobosmith01
source: Likely due to Deoxys's extraterrestrial origin, the toxins brewing in POKENAME's cocoon are those that this world is unfamiliar with. At the very least, these toxins currently seem to be able to be neutralized with modern medicine.

entry: 或许由于代欧奇希斯来自地外，POKENAME茧中酝酿的毒素，也是这个世界陌生的东西。至少目前看来，现代医学似乎还能中和。
author: bobosmith01
source: Likely due to Deoxys's extraterrestrial origin, the toxins brewing in POKENAME's cocoon are those that this world is unfamiliar with. At the very least, these toxins currently seem to be able to be neutralized with modern medicine.

entry: 一对毒针用于向猎物注入外星病毒。被螫的对象，可能长出像POKENAME的特征。
author: kiwiarms
source: Its dual stingers are used for injecting an alien virus into its prey. Those it stings may develop POKENAME-like traits.

entry: 据一座被毁实验室里发现的旧文件记载，POKENAME能交换、合并、覆写他者意识。具体意味着什么还不清楚，但无论如何，拥有各式超凡的超能力。
author: bobosmith01
source: According to an old document found in a destroyed lab, POKENAME has the ability to switch, merge, and override others' consciousnesses. What exactly this entails is unclear, but POKENAME has a wide variety of otherworldly psychic powers regardless.

entry: 据一座被毁实验室里发现的旧文件记载，POKENAME能交换、合并、覆写他者意识。具体意味着什么还不清楚，但无论如何，拥有各式超凡的超能力。
author: bobosmith01
source: According to an old document found in a destroyed lab, POKENAME has the ability to switch, merge, and override others' consciousnesses. What exactly this entails is unclear, but POKENAME has a wide variety of otherworldly psychic powers regardless.

entry: 据一座被毁实验室里发现的旧文件记载，POKENAME能交换、合并、覆写他者意识。具体意味着什么还不清楚，但无论如何，拥有各式超凡的超能力。
author: bobosmith01
source: According to an old document found in a destroyed lab, POKENAME has the ability to switch, merge, and override others' consciousnesses. What exactly this entails is unclear, but POKENAME has a wide variety of otherworldly psychic powers regardless.

entry: POKENAME燃着异样的火，能对宝可梦产生奇怪影响。会模仿进化石的效果，强迫某些个体进化；也能替代基因之楔，造出野生融合体。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME burn with an unearthly flame that can produce strange effects in Pokémon. They can replicate the effects of elemental stones and force evolution in some Pokémon, and serve as a replacement for DNA splicers in others, creating wild fusions.

entry: POKENAME极能适应各种环境，飞行中可自由改变翼形，优先提升速度、机动性或耐久。吸人类及其他宝可梦的血，丰富自身DNA编码。
author: milchik
source: Highly adaptive to almost any environment, POKENAME is able to freely alter the shape of its wings mid-air to prioritize speed, maneuverability, or durability. It enriches its own DNA code by sucking blood from people and other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME尾巴的球不受重力影响，却密度极高，质量超过身体其余部分。靠惯性，能在半空吊着尾巴，仿佛短暂漂浮。
author: stevethebarbarian
source: The ball on its tail isn't affected by gravity, but is so dense that its mass is greater than that of the rest of the body. Due to inertia, POKENAME can hang from its tail in midair and appear to float for a while.

entry: POKENAME身上的双螺旋图案并非装饰。科学家研究发现，和构成它身体的实际DNA完全一致。
author: stevethebarbarian
source: The double-helix design on POKENAME's body isn't just for show; by studying it, scientists discovered that it is identical to the actual DNA that makes up its body.

entry: POKENAME以念动力甩尾，像陨石般重重砸向对手。中央核心能生成精神屏障，用来保护弱小宝可梦。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME telekinetically swings its tail, slamming it into opponents like a crushing meteor. Its central core can generate a psychic barrier, which it uses to protect weak Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME遗传密码的可塑性惊人，科学家能对它实验而不伤及本身。只要腹部紫核无损，能再生的身体就能承受严酷测试。
author: milchik
source: POKENAME possesses an impressively flexible genetic code that allows scientists to experiment on it without any harm to the Pokémon itself. Its regenerative body is able to withstand harsh tests as long as the purple core in its belly stays unharmed.

entry: POKENAME偏爱用尾巴撑起身体，导致其他四肢发育不足。会用念动力摘树果，不喜欢的则丢掉。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME favor using their tails to hold themselves up, to the point their other limbs are underdeveloped. They use their telekinetic power to pick berries, but toss away ones they do not like.

entry: POKENAME从太空坠落，深埋地下。一旦扎根，奇异的外星植物很快就会蔓延整片土地。
author: ozydamians
source: POKENAME falls from space and buries itself deep beneath the ground. If it takes root, the landscape will soon become overrun with bizarre alien flora.

entry: 传闻POKENAME来自遥远世界，智力惊人。以鞭状长尾操纵物件，甚至曾被目睹建造先进机器，用途不明。
author: kiwiarms
source: Rumored to be from a distant world, POKENAME displays startling intelligence. It uses its long whip-like tail to manipulate objects, and individuals have even been observed building advanced machinery for unknown purposes.

entry: POKENAME极柔韧，手臂能扭成看似不可能的形状。曾有一套人气银行劫案电影三部曲，让它成为一名主角的宝可梦，在抢银行时发挥不可替代的作用。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME is very flexible, as its arms can contort in seemingly impossible ways. There was a popular bank heist film trilogy where POKENAME was the Pokémon one of the main characters and played an invaluable role in helping rob the bank.

entry: POKENAME能将双尾变成各种所需工具。额前结晶球其实是大脑，能从中发出强力精神激光，直到疲惫。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME can alter the appearance of its two tails into many tools that help its needs. The crystalline orb on its forehead is actually its brain, from which it emits powerful psychic lasers until it becomes fatigued.

entry: POKENAME能改变形状，模仿各种文字字符。有些科学家试着与它们交流。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME can change their shape to mimic various text-based characters. Some scientists have made attempts to communicate with them.

entry: POKENAME的紫水晶具有极强的放射性，让身体不断变异。大多数目击记录都发生在大型陨石撞击之后。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's purple crystals are extremely radioactive, causing its body to constantly mutate. Most sightings of POKENAME are after large meteorite impacts.

entry: POKENAME用左钳碾碎猎物，右侧触须鞭打敌人。据说核心来自陨石，一旦损坏，必须更换。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME crush their prey within their left pincers and lash foes with their right tendrils. It is said that their cores come from meteorites and must be replaced if they are ever damaged.

entry: POKENAME将裹着黏稠树果汁的球，在杂物堆中滚来滚去，粘起东西。凑够物件后，再把球发射上天。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME roll balls coated in sticky Berry Juice around locations full of clutter to pick up objects. After amassing enough items, POKENAME launch the balls into the sky.

entry: 家中杂物多得受不了时，常请POKENAME来清理。用裹了树果汁的球滚过散物，聚在一起，留待之后处理。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: When household clutter becomes overwhelming, POKENAME are often brought in to clean up. By using balls coated in Berry Juice, they roll into loose objects, gathering them up to be disposed of later.

entry: POKENAME用角顶酷似头部的部分吸引猎物。等对方进入攻击范围，才现身袭击。
author: incognito1234
source: POKENAME uses the head-shaped tip of its horn to attract prey. Once within striking distance, it reveals itself and attacks.

entry: POKENAME身体没有固定形状，不稳定的遗传密码帮助适应恶劣环境。触手上燃起的火，不会烧灼组织，而会使其变异。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME have an amorphous body with unstable genetic code that helps them adapt to harsh conditions. The flames that arise from their tentacles mutate tissue, instead of burning it.

entry: POKENAME快速旋转双尾，在水中推进。能从嘴中排出水和凝聚的精神能量，驱赶天敌，或击落鸟宝可梦。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME propel themselves through water by spinning their two tails rapidly. They can expel water and condensed psychic energy from their mouths to ward off predators or to strike down bird Pokémon.

entry: 涡轮内的紫色核心吸入极光的电磁光，让POKENAME翱翔平流层。构成盔甲的细胞受击后会重新排列，迅速适应新危险。
author: fiordaliso
source: A purple core within its turbine draws in the electromagnetic light of the aurora, letting POKENAME soar through the stratosphere. The cells that compose its armor rearrange themselves when struck, rapidly adapting to new dangers.

entry: POKENAME投射代欧奇希斯的数字全息影像，让自己更有威势。虽不如真身强大，影像却能与他者实际接触，打击力依然不小。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME casts a digital hologram of Deoxys in order to appear more imposing to others. Though not as powerful as the real thing, the hologram can physically interact with others and still packs quite the punch.

entry: 极少见到POKENAME漂在太空，诱骗卫星把信号发给自己。吞食信号补充充沛的能量储备，再以高强度激光攻击来袭陨石。
author: npshi
source: POKENAME are rarely seen floating in space, tricking satellites to send their signals towards them. POKENAME consume these signals, adding to their plentiful energy reserves, which they use to fire high-intensity lasers at incoming meteorites.

entry: POKENAME虽有不必动弹就能施展的强大超能力，却通常一边使出远程精神攻击，一边劈打踢击，或许源于无畏小子的DNA。
author: bobosmith01
source: Despite being endowed with incredible psychic power that does not necessitate movement to use, POKENAME generally chops and kicks while using these powerful long-ranged psychic attacks, perhaps due to its Tyrogue DNA.

entry: POKENAME能以自身DNA改变插脚形状，适配任何插座，恢复能量。不过，插进设备后，也会让对方感染病毒。
author: hereisanimations
source: POKENAME's prongs can be altered by its own DNA to fit any outlet to restore its energy. If POKENAME plugs itself into a device, it will infect it with a virus.

entry: POKENAME跑得太快，连周围空气都燃起来。像流星般炽烈，不减速地冲撞敌人。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME can run so fast that the air around it ignites. Blazing like a meteor, it charges into foes without slowing down.

entry: 它们用背部极光，发送复杂的光信号交流。科学家至今未能破译这种高度精密的语言。
author: kiwiarms
source: They communicate using the aurorae on their back to send complex light-based messages. Scientists have yet to decode this highly sophisticated language.

entry: POKENAME将精神力量集中在尾部球体，托起自己，好奇地四处漂游。想回地面时便放开力量，如陨石般坠落，用尾巴着地缓冲。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME concentrate psychic power into the orbs on their tails to lift themselves into the air and drift around curiously. To return to the ground, they release their power and plummet like meteors, landing on their tails to cushion the fall.

entry: POKENAME胸前的脸只是诱饵，大脑其实是紫色宝珠。不过宝珠仍很容易被命中，让诱饵失去了意义。
author: kiwiarms
source: The face on its chest is just a decoy, as the POKENAME's brain is its purple orb. It's still a very easy target, rendering the decoy moot.

entry: POKENAME痴迷遗传学研究，常用大爪从熟睡的受害者身上取样。有传闻说，它正试图创造完美生物。
author: sith6834
source: POKENAME are obsessed with studying genetics and are often seen using their large claw to take samples from sleeping victims. There are some rumors it is trying to create the perfect organism.

entry: 一次宝可梦融合实验造出了它，怪异的左臂，永远提醒着曾遭遇的事。逃离时，带着装有自身一段DNA的容器，实验服则来自一名科学家。
author: infinex21
source: An experiment in Pokémon fusion gave form to this Pokémon, whose monstrous left arm is a lasting reminder of what was done to it. Its lab coat came from one of the scientists when it escaped with a canister containing a piece of its own DNA.

entry: 膨胀的身体如有弹性，能弹开大部分身体打击。双舌覆着黏物，能同时粘取多种食物。
author: infinex21
source: Its bloated body can repel most physical strikes as if it were elastic. Its dual tongues are coated in a sticky substance that allows it to gather multiple foods at once with them.

entry: POKENAME的触手刺入电子设备，抽干电力，补充自身能量。一次吸取的电量不同，形态也可能扭曲改变。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's tentacles stab into electronics to drain them of power and rejuvenate its own energy stores. Its form can distort and alter depending on how much electricity it drains at once.

entry: POKENAME把头藏在缠乱触须下，触须占身体大部分重量。借此威慑对手，否则即使有强大獠牙，也无法击败。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME conceal their heads beneath the mass of tangled tendrils that make up most of their body weight. This helps them intimidate opponents they would otherwise be unable to beat, even with their powerful tusks.

entry: POKENAME身带大量恶意软件，通常藏在自己的三角形里，躲避杀毒程序。身体可塑，能变成最适于入侵、摧毁电脑安全系统的形状。
author: soup1900
source: Since POKENAME contains lots of malware on its body, it normally hides within its triangle to mask itself from antivirus software. Its body is malleable, able to change shape to best suit infiltrating and destroying a computer's security systems.

entry: POKENAME是奇异而强大的超能力生灵，据说来自宇宙最深处。似乎能随心所欲，轻易创造黑洞、流星与其他天体现象。
author: sk372
source: A strange and powerful psychic being that supposedly originated from the deepest reaches of space. POKENAME is able to create black holes, meteors, and other celestial phenomena seemingly at whim with little effort.

entry: POKENAME自由改换形状，适应周围或任何危险。有些激进理论家说，楔石里藏着外星生灵的灵魂。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME freely manipulates its form into various shapes to suit its surroundings or adapt to any danger. Some radical theorists say it houses the souls of alien creatures within its keystone.

entry: 有人认为，它的花来自外星，另有人则说，宝可梦本身就不属于这个世界。适应力和再生力极强，只要结晶核心完好，连花都能再生。
author: infinex21
source: Some believe that its flower is of alien origin, while others argue that the Pokémon itself is not of our world. It is very adaptable and has remarkable regenerative abilities; even its flower can regenerate so long as the crystalline core is intact.

entry: 这些宝可梦拖着身体在海底前行，独眼仔细观察四周。无数触须能轻易缠住猎物与其他敌人。
author: infinex21
source: These Pokémon carefully observe their surrounding with their singular eye as they drag themselves along the seafloor. They can easily entangle prey and other enemies within their myriad tendrils.

entry: POKENAME在海底捕猎，按需要变换身体，更好地攻击或逃走。研究者中有理论认为，粗心科学家复活了受外星DNA污染的化石，才让它诞生。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME hunts on the seafloor, shifting its body to better attack or flee as needed. There are theories among researchers that it first came to be due to a careless scientist reviving a fossil contaminated with alien DNA.

entry: 身体完全由极其坚韧的外星聚合物薄片层层叠合而成。
author: staghorn
source: Its body is composed entirely of layered sheets of an extremely durable extraterrestrial polymer.

entry: 科学家称，这种宝可梦由受到激光照射的外星病毒变异而来。会耐心待着，等熟透的果实从树上落下。
author: semnotsam
source: Scientists claim Pokémon is mutated from an extraterrestrial virus exposed to a laser beam. They wait around patiently for ripened fruits to fall out of the trees.

entry: 它没有固定形状的身体，能扩张、裂开成巨大的双颚。再用超能力把猎物拉进巨口，整只吞下。
author: infinex21
source: Its amorphous body can expand and split in the form of a massive set of jaws. It will use its psychic abilities to pull prey within this massive maw and swallow them whole.

entry: 有人相信POKENAME是从另一颗行星降临、考察人类的神明。能自由重塑身体，适应任何状况，改变形体与属性，以最有利的方式对抗敌人。
author: sk372
source: Some believe POKENAME is a deity that descended from another planet to gauge humanity. It can freely reform its body to adapt to any situation, changing its body and typing in order to best combat its opponents.

entry: POKENAME瞄准完美，瞬间找出弱点，穿透最坚硬的屏障。有传闻称，月亮中嵌着一只巨大的个体。
author: partypooperrex
source: With perfect aim, POKENAME can instantly locate weak points and pierce through the hardest barriers. There have been rumors of a giant POKENAME embedded in the moon.

entry: POKENAME以透视眼追踪猎物，用超能力捕捉。在四条尾巴里凝出等离子体球，朝敌人扔去。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME use their x-ray vision to track prey and their psychic powers to capture them. They create condensed balls of plasma within their four tails and fling them at foes.

entry: 有人相信，POKENAME源自外太空，后来才降落这颗星球与海洋。偏爱深海，游动时向身后散出一缕闪耀星光的物质。
author: sk372
source: Some believe POKENAME's origins come from outer space, before it landed on this planet and its oceans. It prefers residing in the deeper depths of the sea, and casts a stream of sparkling starry material behind it as it swims.

entry: POKENAME的环，像理论中的原子粒子结构。中央核心一打开，强大精神能量便骤然爆发，造成破坏。
author: infinex21
source: A POKENAME's rings resemble the theorized structure of atomic particles. When it opens its central core, it releases powerful psychic energy in a sudden, destructive burst.

entry: POKENAME能彻底改写自己的遗传密码，模仿几乎任何东西，连分子层面的细节也能复制。
author: nellnast42
source: POKENAME is capable of completely altering its genetic code, allowing it to steal the appearance of almost anything down to the molecule.

entry: 它的身体无固定形状，能为不同状况重新配置。触须各自变出不同形态，优雅作战，压倒敌人，或保护自己与他者。
author: infinex21
source: It has an amorphous body that can configure itself for various scenarios. It fights elegantly with its tendrils, each one assuming various forms to overwhelm its foes or to defend itself and others.

entry: 外星病毒将这种宝可梦变得色彩斑斓、满身触手。攻击性极强，几乎一切动的东西都会袭击。POKENAME像操纵自身肢体一样操纵大地，压碎对手。
author: nyoomymph
source: An alien virus transformed this Pokémon into a colourful, tentacle-clad form. It is immensely aggressive and will attack almost anything that moves. POKENAME manipulates earth like a limb of its own body to crush opponents.

entry: POKENAME生活在宇宙深处，人类难以观测。至少三次观察显示，似乎住在漂浮太空的中空小行星里。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME have been difficult for humans to observe due to them living in the deeper reaches of space. At least three observations showed that they seem to live within hollow asteroids floating in space.

entry: 太阳风增强、地磁暴肆虐时，POKENAME便会苏醒。每迈出愤怒的一步，都改变周围地貌。遭遇任何抵抗，身体形态便会改变。
author: bobosmith01
source: When solar winds intensify and geomagnetic storms run rampant, POKENAME awakens, reshaping the nearby area with every rage-fueled step. If it encounters any kind of resistance, its physical form will alter.

entry: 太阳风增强、地磁暴肆虐时，POKENAME便会苏醒。每迈出愤怒的一步，都改变周围地貌。遭遇任何抵抗，身体形态便会改变。
author: bobosmith01
source: When solar winds intensify and geomagnetic storms run rampant, POKENAME awakens, reshaping the nearby area with every rage-fueled step. If it encounters any kind of resistance, its physical form will alter.

entry: POKENAME将超能力与邪恶力量结合，造出范围广大的暗黑洞，让敌人陷入噩梦。无定形身体还能模仿噩梦，把恐惧送入敌人心底。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME combine their psychic powers with their sinister powers to create expansive Dark Voids that cast foes into nightmares. Their amorphous bodies allow them to mimic nightmares and strike fear into the hearts of their enemies.

entry: POKENAME是结合生物与科技工程造出的人工宝可梦。野放试验已确定，太凶猛危险，不能放入野外。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are artificial Pokémon created through a combination of biological and technological engineering. Release trial programs have determined that they are far too aggressive and dangerous to allow into the wild.

entry: POKENAME是被认为来自深空的龙类生灵。据说，被火焰碰到，连DNA都会烧伤。
author: sk372
source: A draconic creature thought to have come from deep space. It's said that those touched by POKENAME's flame will be burned all the way to their very DNA.

entry: POKENAME周身如液体盾牌的紫色黏液，由空白DNA材料构成。覆住猎物后，能将其从分子层面分解，再吸收所得物质。
author: milchik
source: The purple ooze surrounding POKENAME's body like a liquid shield consists of blank DNA material. By covering its prey in this ooze, POKENAME is able to break its victim down on a molecular level before absorbing the resulted mass.

entry: POKENAME把真身藏在有机棺材内，以古老地下墓窟为家。用球状大脑将盗墓人引来，再突然跳出拦截，常使对方丧命。
author: the_smirker
source: POKENAME conceals its true form within an organic coffin. It considers old underground catacombs its home. It uses its orb-like brain to lure grave robbers to its location, where it will jump out and intercept them, often leading to their demise.

entry: 一种病毒不知为何接触了合众电气石洞穴的带电结晶能量，由此形成这些宝可梦。成群POKENAME会织出庞大复杂的网，麻痹落网猎物，影响大脑。
author: milchik
source: These Pokémon originate from a virus that was somehow exposed to the energy from the electric crystals of the Chargestone Cave in Unova region. Groups of POKENAME spin big, complicated webs that paralyze the trapped prey and affect their brains.

entry: 这些奇异宝可梦在太空漂浮，常位于我们星球的轨道内，众多眼睛注视飘近的一切。巨大的紫核亮起火焰，闪耀如宇宙。
author: infinex21
source: These odd Pokémon drift in space, often within the orbit of our planet, with their multiple eyes watching anything that drifts near. Their large, purple cores glow brightly with flames that sparkle like the cosmos.

entry: 传说POKENAME由缚于坠星的迷失灵魂铸成，核心如远古心脏般搏动。无声漫游被遗忘之地，以冰冷、深不可测的意志审判闯入者。
author: ilyhef_82709
source: Legends say POKENAME was forged from a lost soul bound to a fallen star, its core pulsing like an ancient heart. It wanders forgotten lands in silence, judging intruders with cold, unfathomable will.

entry: POKENAME结合超能力与强大火焰，在背上造出太阳般的球。虽然像小太阳，其实主要是帮助更好地引导力量。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME wield their psychic powers in tandem with their powerful flames to create sun-like orbs upon their backs. Although these orbs look like miniature suns, they mostly just help POKENAME better direct their powers.

entry: 这种宝可梦的尾巴几乎数不清，能变形进攻或防御。体内流动的火焰，让胸口核心微微发亮。
author: infinex21
source: The near-innumerable tails of this Pokémon can transform in order to defend or to attack. Its chest core glows faintly with the flames flowing inside its body.

entry: 自身融合让POKENAME展现所有主要形态的特征。攻击、防御、速度无可比拟，战斗中因而成为远比以往可怕的对手。
author: sk372
source: Self-fusion has caused POKENAME to exhibit aspects of all of its major forms. This gives it unparalleled offense, defense and speed to use in combat, making it infinitely more formidable an opponent.

entry: POKENAME能分成四个分身，尽展本领。三种形态分别负责进攻、防御与速度，听从第四个聪慧头脑的指挥，实力绝不可轻视。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can split itself into four copies to maximize its capabilities. With three forms adhering to offense, defense, and speed commanded by the fourth's great intellect, they are truly a force to be reckoned with.

entry: POKENAME常到大气中旅行，偶尔带回感兴趣的卫星。看到卫星消失后科学家惊慌失措，似乎觉得十分好玩。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME make frequent trips into the atmosphere, occasionally bringing back satellites they find fascinating. POKENAME appear to take great joy in seeing scientists panic after a satellite vanishes.

entry: POKENAME在陨石撞出的坑里筑巢。利用陨石坑的凸形，将精神能量放大成巨大的激光束。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME create their nests in craters where meteorites have struck. By using the convex shape of the craters, they can amplify their psychic energy into large laser rays.

entry: POKENAME尖叫时，气体粒子便会发光，形成极光般的闪烁光影。爱在夜间飞翔，享受无尽天空的自由。
author: quackquackattack
source: Particles of gas glow whenever POKENAME screech, creating shimmers of light that resemble auroras. POKENAME love to fly around at night, enjoying the freedom of the endless sky.

entry: 它始终捧着一件古代遗物，那是维系生命的关键。一旦失去，它便会死去。
author: lyrebird.rainwing
source: This Pokémon always holds an ancient relic. This relic is important for its survival, and if it ever loses it, it will die.

entry: POKENAME是半生物机器人，在空中漂游寻找猎物。训练家发现，只要指定目标，找到之前便不会停下。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: A semi-biological robot, POKENAME drift around the skies seeking out prey. Trainers have found that they can give it a target, and it will not stop until it has found them.

entry: 它悄然飞过夜空，用头上的声盘释放高频声波，在下意识层面操纵下方毫不知情的人和宝可梦。
author: vlooranthemasked
source: As it soars silently through the night sky, it uses the sound disks on its head to emit high-frequency sound waves, subliminally manipulating the oblivious people and Pokémon below.

entry: POKENAME最初被发现时，大群聚在巨坑旁，结晶核心发光，仰望夜空。研究已证实，它们能较轻松地把身体部分变成不同形状。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME were first discovered in droves near a large crater, peering up at the night sky as their crystal cores glowed. Studies have confirmed that they are able to alter parts of their bodies into different shapes with relative ease.

entry: 曾有人见POKENAME带领成群代欧黏宝，以结晶核心闪光传递信号。似乎需要定期补水，否则会越来越迟缓，开始褪色。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME have been seen leading groups of Deomy, flashing signals from their crystal cores as a means to communicate with the group. They appear to need to be hydrated regularly, or else they grow increasingly sluggish and begin to lose color.

entry: POKENAME缓慢穿过森林，靠结晶核心发出的光作为视野，寻找食物。遇见他者，便几乎一动不动地凝望，让许多人害怕。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME move slowly through forests, the light emitted from their crystal cores serving as their field of vision as they search for food. If they encounter others, they will gaze at them while barely moving, leading many to feel fearful of them.

entry: POKENAME背上的突起，不像任何已知真菌。很可能是外星DNA与冬虫夏草融合的结果，也可能是随代欧奇希斯到来的未知寄生物。
author: .jerden
source: The protrusions on POKENAME's back resemble no known species of fungus. This is most likely the result of fusing extraterrestrial DNA with the tochukaso mushroom, but it may also instead be a previously unknown parasite that arrived with Deoxys.

entry: 这种强大的天外宝可梦，引导外太空的寒冷能量。能借传送门跃迁，留下数小时不散的寒气。
author: frokachu
source: A powerful celestial Pokémon that channels the cold energy of outer space. It can warp using portals which leave a trace of chilling air for hours afterwards.

entry: POKENAME的身体大多不活跃，似乎只作为看似通往太空的传送门的容器。内部紫色寄生物，才是超能力的来源。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's body is mostly inert and seems to function only as the vessel for what appears to be a portal into space. The purple parasite within is the source of POKENAME's psychic power.

entry: 它是地外宝可梦，能吸收、释放数千英里内的光。人们认为，若全力施展，从月亮望去，我们的星球几乎会隐没在黑暗宇宙中。
author: bobosmith01
source: It is an extraterrestrial Pokémon with the power to absorb and output light within thousands of miles. It's thought that if it were to ever use its full strength, then from the moon, our planet would be nigh invisible against the darkness of space.

entry: 它是地外宝可梦，能吸收、释放数千英里内的光。人们认为，若全力施展，从月亮望去，我们的星球几乎会隐没在黑暗宇宙中。
author: bobosmith01
source: It is an extraterrestrial Pokémon with the power to absorb and output light within thousands of miles. It's thought that if it were to ever use its full strength, then from the moon, our planet would be nigh invisible against the darkness of space.

entry: 有人相信POKENAME是某种病毒，在陨石落到星球前就已感染。四肢能缩进核心的硬壳，再以更适于迎战敌人的形态出现。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is believed by some to be some type of virus that infected a meteorite before it fell to the planet. It can retreat its limbs into the hard shell of its core, reemerging in an altered form adapted to better combat its foe.

entry: 有人说，它曾在某天突然现身于一个神秘的深坑。人们仍在调查，想弄清它真正的来历。
author: busilisk
source: Some say this Pokémon appeared in a mysterious crater one day. Investigations are ongoing to determine its true origin.

entry: POKENAME相当好斗，以强健柔韧的手臂，把对手打到屈服。不过很快就会疲惫，宝石般的身体变得更亮，表示已经过热。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are rather aggressive and will beat opponents into submission with their strong, flexible arms. They quickly tire themselves out, though, and their gem-like bodies glow brighter as a sign of them overheating.

entry: 古代记载说，灾变发生时，POKENAME会从天而降。文献常说它迅捷美丽，降下时如同流星。
author: antler_zero_
source: Ancient records recount POKENAME falling from the sky during cataclysmic events. These texts tend to describe POKENAME as swift and beautiful, likening them to shooting stars during their descents.

entry: POKENAME总像沉睡不醒，头上结晶随心跳般的节奏发光。察觉威胁靠近，会先释放扭曲重力的精神波动，再瞬间移动离开。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME constantly appears in deep sleep, with the crystal on its head glowing rhythmically like a heartbeat. If it senses a threat approach, it emits psychic waves that can distort gravity before it teleports away.

entry: POKENAME智力强大，清楚知道该将身体变成什么形态，适应当前状况。有人相信，胸部宝石藏着第二个大脑，蕴含大部分超能力。
author: sk372
source: A powerful intellect lets POKENAME know exactly what form to change its body into to suit its current situation. Some believe the gem in its chest houses a second brain containing the majority of its psychic power.

entry: POKENAME有时出现在花店，随听不见的歌摇摆。渴求富铁食物，附近若有钉子，连钉子也会吃。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are sometimes found in flower shops, bobbing along to an unheard song. It craves food rich in iron and will even eat nails if they are nearby.

entry: POKENAME用藤蔓喂自己，能吞下一整桌食物。会以心灵感应，试着说服训练家给它吃的。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME use their vines to feed themselves, able to devour a table's worth of food. Using telepathy, they try to convince Trainers to feed them.

entry: 多个小头加上粗壮外露的根，让POKENAME成为劲敌。不过有个有趣弱点：喜欢用心灵感应唱歌。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: With multiple smaller heads and thick exposed roots, POKENAME is a formidable opponent. It has an interesting weakness in the fact that it loves to sing songs via telepathy.

entry: POKENAME最初在陨石坑附近或内部被发现，许多人因此推断来自外太空。四肢能变换形态，协助战斗；只要核心无损，受伤也很快再生。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME were initially found near or within craters, leading many to assume they originate from outer space. Their limbs can assume different forms to aid them during battle and will quickly regenerate damage so long as their cores are unscathed.

entry: POKENAME首次出现在水生研究实验室附近，很少与人类来往。张开壳就能制造黑洞，吸入周围物质，究竟为了进食还是别的目的，尚不清楚。
author: sk372
source: First spotted near aquatic research laboratories, POKENAME rarely interacts with humanity at large. It opens its shell to create black holes that suck in nearby matter; it is not known if this is done for sustenance or some other motivation.

entry: POKENAME潜入建筑，模仿人类助人为乐的举动。有人靠近，就抛下伪装，用可怕影像攻击猎物。遇过它的人，之后会变得极度多疑。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME sneaks into buildings to mimic the helpful actions of humans. When approached, it abandons its fraud and attacks its prey with frightening images. After encountering a POKENAME, people experience extreme paranoia.

entry: 据说，它们覆着宇宙中最硬的岩石。有理论认为，是穿越虚空、吞食行星与恒星的宇宙寄生物。
author: agtl05
source: Their body is said to be coated with the hardest rock in the universe. It is theorized that they are a cosmic parasite that travels through the void to feed on planets and stars.

entry: POKENAME是感染、控制普通大钳蟹的异界病毒。坐在岸边，毫不动摇地盯着路人。比起其他天敌，对蛇形宝可梦怕得格外厉害。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is an otherworldly virus infecting and controlling a common Krabby. It sits on shorelines, unflinchingly watching passersby. It has a disproportionate fear of serpentine Pokémon compared to other predators.

entry: POKENAME每天整整睡上23小时，梦想着背上的种子，有一天能绽放成花。
author: abhatu
source: POKENAME sleeps a full 23 hours each day. It dreams of the day when its seed will blossom into a flower.

entry: 这些宝可梦嚼食陨石碎片，用所得糊状物硬化外骨骼。若见一群POKENAME聚在某处，附近一定会有陨石落下。
author: chibitales
source: These Pokémon munch on the shards of fallen meteors, using the resulting paste to harden their exoskeleton. If you see a group of POKENAME gathering in a spot, a meteor is sure to fall nearby.

entry: POKENAME爆炸后，留下星尘般的奇异物质。粒子仍有微弱电力，直接碰到后，会刺刺麻麻好一阵。
author: sk372
source: When POKENAME explodes, it leaves behind a strange material akin to stardust. The particles still retain some faint electricity, so direct contact leaves one feeling tingly for a while after.

entry: POKENAME能操纵电力，在身体周围形成球状雷电护盾，挡开攻击。护盾启动时，球中仿佛有星星闪烁。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can manipulate its electricity to form a spherical shield of lightning around its body to deflect strikes. Stars appear to twinkle within the sphere while it's active.

entry: POKENAME现身孤儿院，为孩子送点心、礼物。收到礼物的孩子，很可能找到好家庭。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME appear before orphanages to give children treats and gifts. Those who receive a gift from POKENAME are likely to find a good home.

entry: POKENAME在茧中发育时，许多怀抱愿望的孩子会向它许愿。不过很难判断是否实现，因为它只会在茧里摇摆，不能说话。
author: quackquackattack
source: As POKENAME develop within their cocoon, many wishful children give them their desires in hopes of coming true. It is difficult to tell whether POKENAME grant these wishes as they can only wobble inside their cocoon and cannot speak.

entry: 许多人相信，碰POKENAME的钻角能得好运。未经许可伸手的人，很快就会明白，也能带来大伤害。
author: danarchosyndacalist
source: Many believe touching a POKENAME's drill horn will bring good luck. Those who touch it without permission quickly learn that it can bring great harm as well.

entry: POKENAME的身体由数十张便笺构成，可以随意写下愿望。不过便笺就像附肢，写上的愿望常被磨损，变得难以辨认。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's body is made up of dozens of notes that can be freely written on to make wishes. Since these notes are like appendages to POKENAME, the wishes written on them often get worn down and become too hard to understand.

entry: 遭偷猎者追捕时，它们许愿，想去一个谁也伤害不了自己的地方，随即在一阵光芒中消失了。
author: tomatosalad
source: Hunted by poachers, they wished to be taken somewhere where no one could harm them and disappeared in a flash of light.

entry: POKENAME跃出海浪时，会放出一阵闪亮光粉。因稀有又光彩夺目，许多人相信，看见跃起时许愿，能带来大运。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME releases a burst of shimmering glitter when it leaps from the waves. Due to its rarity and illustrious appearance, many believe that wishing upon witnessing its leap can bring great fortune.

entry: 许多心怀不轨者以为POKENAME的核心能许愿，试图偷猎。因此它在野外很少现身，会以幽光闪花发现者的双眼，趁机逃走。
author: sk372
source: Many devious sorts sought to poach POKENAME, believing its core held wish-granting powers. As a result, it rarely is seen in the wild, and blinds those who find it with spectral flashes so it may flee.

entry: 据说，流星雨之夜，POKENAME会进入人们梦中，实现一个愿望。若愿望邪恶，则会让对方珍爱的物品变得隐形。
author: mega_beedrill
source: It is said that POKENAME will appear in people's dreams on nights of star showers and grant a wish. If one's wish is corrupt, POKENAME is said to instead turn a prized possession invisible.

entry: POKENAME不在空中飞行时，就会站在沙滩球上保持平衡、跳舞。有传闻说能制造黑洞，但尚未证实。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Whenever POKENAME is not flying through the sky, they can be found balancing on top of a beach ball doing a dance. Rumors describe it being able to generate black holes, but this information has yet to be confirmed.

entry: POKENAME不在空中飞行时，就会站在沙滩球上保持平衡、跳舞。有传闻说能制造黑洞，但尚未证实。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Whenever POKENAME is not flying through the sky, they can be found balancing on top of a beach ball doing a dance. Rumors describe it being able to generate black holes, but this information has yet to be confirmed.

entry: 过去传闻，若能忍受POKENAME闪亮火焰旋涡的热度，就能实现愿望，不过要撑多久，各说各的。常住高大火山，仿佛想更靠近星星。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME's glittering Fire Spin attack was once rumored to grant a wish if one were able to withstand the heat for an amount of time that varied based on the teller. They are often found on tall volcanoes, as if wishing to live closer to the stars.

entry: 据说，只要在战斗中胜过POKENAME，就能让它实现愿望。许多人尝试，却因它的尖角，鲜有成功。
author: zweizweihander
source: POKENAME is said to grant the wishes of anyone who bests it in combat. Many try, but due to POKENAME's sharp horns, few succeed.

entry: 深夜能见POKENAME游过大海，如天上星辰闪烁。虽然温和，受威胁却很危险，会用巨大的水炮摧毁附近一切。
author: actliux
source: POKENAME can be seen swimming across the ocean late at night, twinkling like stars in the sky. Although very peaceful, it is dangerous when threatened, destroying everything nearby with immense Hydro Pumps.

entry: POKENAME极少现身，据说由史上最伟大的程序员创造。传闻会出现在陷入困境的程序员面前，实现愿望，完善手头的编程项目。
author: sk372
source: A very rarely seen Pokémon, POKENAME is said to have been created by the greatest coder in history. It supposedly appears before coders in crisis, granting their wishes and perfecting their current coding projects.

entry: 古生物学家曾认为POKENAME早已灭绝，推测是凶猛捕食者。化石复活后，却发现十分慷慨，会尽力满足朋友心愿。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are ancient Pokémon that were thought to be extinct by palaeontologists, theorised to have been fierce predators. Once resurrected from fossils, they were discovered to be generous, doing their best to fulfil the desires of their friends.

entry: 七之岛发现的古文献，记载着这样一个传说：一名水手船难后在海中溺水，求生愿望被更高的存在听见，于是重生为POKENAME。目前没有已知的野生个体。
author: bobosmith01
source: Old texts found in the Sevii Islands write about a legend where a sailor began to drown at sea after a shipwreck. His wish to live was heard by a higher power and he was reborn as POKENAME. No known wild POKENAME exist.

entry: 传说，很久以前，它为守护祈求平安的弱者，来到这个世界。待解救他们脱离暴政，POKENAME便返回群星。
author: abhatu
source: Legends say it came to this world long ago to defend the weak who wished for safety. After freeing them from tyranny, POKENAME returned to the stars.

entry: 故事说，POKENAME四处旅行，为心地纯洁的对象实现愿望。据说，最终目标是让世间每一种宝可梦，都至少有一个成员的心愿成真。
author: sk372
source: Stories say that POKENAME travels across the lands, granting wishes to those pure of heart. It's said that its ultimate goal is to grant the wish of one of every species of Pokémon that exists.

entry: POKENAME充满好奇，会隐身跟随感兴趣的对象。若认为对方善良纯洁，就读取内心，实现最深的愿望，再消失。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has a curious nature, hiding itself away while following those that pique its interest. If it judges the one it follows to be kind and pure of heart, it reads their mind and grants their deepest desire before disappearing.

entry: 据说POKENAME力量庞大，足以同时满足各地数千只宝可梦的心愿。大量运用能力时，看似会短暂解除融合，再恢复原状。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's power is supposedly vast enough that it could grant wishes to thousands of Pokémon across the land at once. When using its abilities in larger amounts, it appears to temporarily unfuse before returning to normal.

entry: POKENAME为宇宙各处的逝者哀悼。据说从它身上能望见无垠太空的景象。
author: abhatu
source: POKENAME mourns for the loss of those throughout the cosmos. It is said to exude a visage of the endless expanse of space.

entry: POKENAME飞过夜空，常被误认成流星。旅人认为，见到它就是好运的征兆。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME flies across the night sky and is often mistaken for a shooting star. Travelers consider spotting a POKENAME to be a sign of good fortune.

entry: POKENAME织出的网，常被形容柔软如丝。经常将其织成昂贵毛毯。据说，其他对象使用后，会被纤维中的剧毒毒倒。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: POKENAME produces a webbing that has often been described as soft as silk. It frequently weaves these webs into high-value blankets. It is said that if another were to use them, they would succumb to a vicious poison embedded in the fibers.

entry: POKENAME飞得比普通叉字蝠高得多，有时甚至到达太空下缘。据说，凝视腹部眼睛能实现任何愿望，但仍无依据。
author: shreks_stepfather
source: POKENAME can fly at much higher altitudes than regular Crobat and sometimes finds its way into the lower boundaries of space. It is said that looking into the eye on its stomach will grant any wish, but this claim is still unfounded.

entry: POKENAME一颗星靠正能量充能，另一颗靠负能量。据说，每实现一个仁慈慷慨的愿望，也必须实现一个出于嫉妒或怨恨的心愿。
author: .jerden
source: One of POKENAME's stars is charged by positive energy, and the other by negative energy. It is said that for every kind and generous wish it grants, POKENAME must also grant another wish motivated by envy or resentment.

entry: POKENAME在深海发光如星，却很少有人看见。夜间有人迷失海上，可能照亮安慰对方，也引导救援者前来。等遇险者安全了，便会消失。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME glows like a star in the ocean depths, but its light is rarely seen. When people are lost at sea at night, POKENAME may provide light to comfort them and lead rescuers toward them. As soon as they are safe, POKENAME will vanish.

entry: POKENAME游过夜空，周围点点光芒，让金属身体闪闪发亮。多半不理会下方聚集的人们，偶尔也会降下，实现一个愿望。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME swims through the night sky, surrounded by twinkling lights that make its metallic body glitter. It mostly ignores people who gather below, but will occasionally come down to grant a wish.

entry: 据说POKENAME每172年醒来一次，为认作值得的对象实现愿望。若认定你不配，就会用雷劈你，给自己取乐。
author: duskit___
source: POKENAME are said to wake up every 172 years; they grant wishes to anyone it deems worthy. If POKENAME deems you unworthy, it will strike you with a bolt of lightning to entertain itself.

entry: POKENAME个头小，旅行中的训练家常一不留神就错过。会试着实现宏大愿望，弥补小小身躯。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Due its small stature, POKENAME is often easily missed by traveling Trainers. It tries to make up for its small size by granting large wishes.

entry: 据说POKENAME会在祈求好运者面前现身。只与真心善意的训练家结缘，若搭档心怀怨恨，便会萎靡不振。
author: vic1312
source: It is said that POKENAME appear before those who wish for good fortune. They will only bond with Trainers who hold sincere good intentions and grow dispirited if partnered with a Trainer who fosters resentment in their heart.

entry: POKENAME预判训练家需求的本领无可比拟。往往还没说出口，就已试着满足心愿，不过并非每次都能办到。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME have an unparalleled ability to anticipate their trainer's needs. They attempt to fulfill their trainer's wishes before the trainer even voices them. Their ability to fulfill that wish is not always a given, however.

entry: POKENAME从训练家的愿望获得力量。若全心全意热切许愿，尾巴便会如星般闪耀。
author: bostroms
source: POKENAME gains power from the wishes of its Trainer.  A wish made fervently with one's whole heart will cause its tail to shine like a star.

entry: 据说POKENAME的羊毛由纯粹许愿魔力构成。以纤维织成的衣服，会按穿着者内心的渴望改变款式。
author: periperi_chicken
source: It is said that POKENAME's wool is made of pure wish magic and that any clothing spun from the fibres will change styles to fit the inner desires of the wearer.

entry: POKENAME在小拉达面前现身，替它们实现愿望。愿望大多化成奶酪或垃圾。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME will appear before Rattata to grant them wishes. These wishes mostly take the form of cheese or trash.

entry: POKENAME几乎整天休息，为进化积蓄能量。传说若瞥见它突然从天而降，最深的心愿就会实现。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME spends nearly the entire day resting to gather the energy to evolve. If someone were to catch a glimpse of it suddenly falling out of the sky, legends state that their deepest wish will come true.

entry: POKENAME有时会发光，这是热量过多时的反应。光来自吸取体热的磷光细菌。过去人们认为，见到发光的它，就能让奇迹成真。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME will sometimes start to glow. This is a response to excess heat, and the glow is caused by phosphorescent bacteria that draw heat from POKENAME's body. It used to be thought that seeing a glowing POKENAME would make miracles come true.

entry: POKENAME有时会发光，这是热量过多时的反应。光来自吸取体热的磷光细菌。它也是一家人气滑板公司的吉祥物。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME will sometimes start to glow. This is a response to excess heat, and the glow is caused by phosphorescent bacteria that draw heat from POKENAME's body. POKENAME is the mascot for a popular skateboard company.

entry: POKENAME有时会发光，这是热量过多时的反应。光来自吸取体热的磷光细菌。这时皮肤变湿，其他时候则硬得像钢。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME will sometimes start to glow. This is a response to excess heat, and the glow is caused by phosphorescent bacteria that draw heat from POKENAME's body. Their skin becomes moist; at all other times, their skin is as hard as steel.

entry: POKENAME收集愿望，帮助花苞绽放。虽不能让愿望成真，却真心希望所有心愿都有实现的一天。
author: abhatu
source: POKENAME spends its time collecting wishes to help its bud bloom. While it cannot grant them, it hopes that all wishes will comes true.

entry: POKENAME自私至极，无穷愿望只给自己实现，绝不给别人。往往浪费在更多奶酪或一个纸箱之类的小事上。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: POKENAME is incredibly selfish, refusing to grant any of its infinite wishes to anyone but itself. These wishes are often used on frivolous things, like more cheese or a cardboard box.

entry: 传说，写在POKENAME耳旁垂挂纸签上的愿望都会实现，但每一项都有意外转折。会读人心，避开残忍的对象。
author: periperi_chicken
source: Legends say that any wish written on POKENAME's tags hanging from its ears will come true, but every request will have a twist. It reads the minds of humans and will avoid those with cruel intentions.

entry: POKENAME会本能地对许愿作恶、伤害他者的对象使出破灭之愿。写好的愿望藏在壳内，免得遗失或遭修改。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME instinctively fires Doom Desire against those who wish for evil and harm upon others. It stores written wishes inside of its shell to prevent them from getting lost or altered.

entry: 传说，POKENAME外表虽略吓人，只要仍觉得它可爱，就有机会获它实现愿望。食物香味，连最深的睡眠都能唤醒它。
author: fiordaliso
source: According to legend, POKENAME has the power to grant the wishes of those who find it cute despite its slightly intimidating appearance. The smell of food is able to wake it from even the deepest sleep.

entry: 传说，POKENAME外表虽略吓人，只要仍觉得它可爱，就有机会获它实现愿望。食物香味，连最深的睡眠都能唤醒它。
author: fiordaliso
source: According to legend, POKENAME has the power to grant the wishes of those who find it cute despite its slightly intimidating appearance. The smell of food is able to wake it from even the deepest sleep.

entry: POKENAME追逐企图满足自私欲望的对象，以宇宙灾厄惩罚不义之人。重伤时，会用无法击破的钢壳裹住自己。
author: amityblamity
source: POKENAME pursue those attempting to fulfill selfish desires, unleashing cosmic doom upon the unjust. If critically injured, they wrap themselves in a shell of unbreakable steel.

entry: POKENAME轻轻飘过夜空，让下方田野笼上柔光。许多人相信，它的存在能给星下睡眠者温馨好梦。
author: eiskitsune
source: POKENAME floats gently through the night sky, blanketing fields below in a soft shimmer. Many believe its presence brings cozy dreams to those who sleep beneath the stars.

entry: POKENAME无声漂过天空，几乎不扰动周围空气。真眼微微发光，据说守望睡着的旅人，直到天明。
author: eiskitsune
source: POKENAME drifts silently across the sky, rarely stirring the air around it. Its true eye glows faintly, said to watch over sleeping travellers until dawn.

entry: 据说它带着的圆球能实现三个愿望。每年都会来到这个世界，却总藏起来，让许多人找不到。
author: drip_capybara
source: The ball that it carries is said to be able to grant three wishes. It comes to this world every year, but it goes into hiding, so many can't find it.

entry: 极偶尔，POKENAME会睁开第三只眼，凝望怀中的圆球，窥探未来。对它而言，保护这颗球比什么都重要。
author: abhatu
source: Once every blue moon, POKENAME opens its third eye and looks into the orb it carries to peer into the future. It protects the orb above all else.

entry: 盛大庆典一开始，POKENAME总会在场，与大家庆祝。实现参与者共同的愿望，散播欢欣与快乐。
author: beatdoof
source: Whenever a grand festival commences, POKENAME is always there celebrating alongside everyone, spreading cheer and joy as it grants the unified wishes of the festivalgoers.

entry: 古代文化曾相信，吃下POKENAME覆身的黏液，就能许愿。没有任何记录被证实，不过传说至今流传。
author: .izik
source: The slime covering POKENAME's body was once believed by ancient cultures to grant wishes when consumed. No documented cases of this have ever been confirmed, but the legend persists to this day.

entry: POKENAME能为自己认可的人实现愿望。藏在翼下的眼睛，能看透对方真正的本性。
author: abhatu
source: POKENAME has the power to grant wishes for those it deems worthy. The eye concealed under its wings sees someone for who they truly are.

entry: POKENAME能为找到自己的人实现愿望，可想让它安静待够久，却很困难。极易分心，见什么动就追什么，哪怕打断许愿也不管。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are capable of granting wishes to people who find them but getting them to stay still long enough to grant wishes is difficult. They are easily distracted and will chase anything that moves, even if it means interrupting a wish.

entry: POKENAME身体裹着被无数愿望硬化的结晶壳，力量庞大。传说，它睡觉时，在附近许下的愿望更容易成真。
author: moga6
source: A POKENAME's body is encased in a crystalline shell hardened by countless wishes and it possesses immense strength. Legends say wishes made near it while it sleeps are more likely to come true.

entry: 传说POKENAME漫游世界，寻找纯洁灵魂。找到愿望纯净的对象，就低头让对方写在随身纸条上，随后使其成真。
author: t3isukone
source: Legends say that POKENAME wanders the world, looking for pure-hearted souls. When it finds someone with a pure wish, it bows its head and lets them write that wish on one of the papers it carries, and that wish will then come true.

entry: 每只POKENAME颈伞上的眼纹，都有细微差别。传闻找到过一只有两只眼的，不过尚未证实。
author: kiwiarms
source: Every POKENAME has a subtly different eye design on its hood. Supposedly, one has been found with two eyes, but this hasn't been proven.

entry: 据说，POKENAME朝星夜咆哮，群星便闪烁，像在回应。每诞生一颗新星，才会实现一个愿望。
author: soup1900
source: It is said that as POKENAME roars into the starry night, the stars twinkle back as if they were responding back to it. It will only grant one single wish for each time a new star is born.

entry: POKENAME罕见现身前，核心产生的星尘沙暴会先到来。贪婪者为贵重材料寻它，因此它主动避开人类。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's rare appearances come heralded by sandstorms made of stardust, generated from its core. Due to greedy people seeking it out for the valuable material, it actively avoids human contact.

entry: 世界各地的人曾向POKENAME举行神圣仪式，希望复活逝去的挚爱。传说，彩虹色流星雨划过天空时，它终于会回应这些祈祷。
author: soup1900
source: People worldwide have performed sacred rituals to POKENAME in hopes it would grant their wish of reviving a deceased loved one. Legends say that when a meteor shower of rainbow colors streaks the sky, POKENAME will finally answer these prayers.

entry: POKENAME能让愿望成真，却不一定在正确的年代实现。最终享到好处的，可能是许愿者的祖先或后代。
author: distinguishedmanlygentleman
source: POKENAME has the ability to make wishes come true, however these wishes are not always granted in the correct time period. The wish maker's ancestors or descendants may be the ones to reap the benefits of the wish.

entry: 据说，POKENAME本该沉睡一千年，再醒来活动一周。可它睡得太舒服，如今四千年过去，竟还没醒。
author: abhatu
source: POKENAME is said to sleep for a thousand years before it awakens for a week. It got too comfortable and hasn't woken up in four thousand years.

entry: POKENAME实现的愿望常附残酷转折，更像诅咒。不过，罕见的1/1,000几率下，这份转折反而会让愿望比其他基拉祈所能实现的更有利。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's granted wishes often carry a cruel twist that causes the wish to be more like a curse instead. However, in a rare 1 in 1,000 chance, the added twist instead makes the wish more beneficial than what other Jirachi could've granted.

entry: POKENAME平静飘浮，周围散出带粉尘的白雾。人或宝可梦大量吸入，会感到平静、淡漠。
author: gileme__
source: POKENAME is found floating serenely, spreading a dusty, white fog around itself. When inhaled in high amounts, the fog causes feelings of calm and apathy in both Pokémon and humans.

entry: 传说POKENAME腹部眼睛睁开时，可能为一生善良诚实的人实现愿望。尾巴不断迸出电火花，防止谁把它从睡梦中叫醒。
author: fiordaliso
source: According to legend, when the eye on its belly opens, POKENAME may grant the wishes of people who have lived good and honest lives. Its tail emits constant electric sparks to prevent anyone from waking it from its slumber.

entry: 据说，它每隔千年，才能为人实现一次愿望。在这段漫长岁月里，许多心愿也在身边越积越多。
author: abhatu
source: It is said to grant wishes only once every thousand years. Many wishes pile up around it in the meantime.

entry: POKENAME睡觉时蜷成球，什么也穿不透。总确保身体里夹着几粒沙，好在睡时擦掉污垢，保持清洁。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: When POKENAME sleeps, it curls up into a ball that nothing can penetrate. It always ensures that a few grains of sand are caught in its body while it sleeps, and these grains scrub away any dirt to keep them clean.

entry: POKENAME用翅膀搅出强大破灭之愿，对付心愿邪恶的对象。随后高速飞往群星，成束光芒却在一周后，重创毫无戒心的敌人。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME uses its wings to churn powerful Doom Desire against those who wish for evil. It then zooms to the stars at high speeds while the bundles of light decimate the unsuspecting foe a week later.

entry: POKENAME的毛中有微小金属片，严寒时扣合成钢般坚硬的外衣。虽结实，却出奇轻盈，让它能优雅地踏过冰面。
author: reaverlamont
source: POKENAME's fur contains microscopic metal flakes that lock together in freezing temperatures, forming a coat as hard as steel. Despite its toughness, the coat remains surprisingly light, allowing POKENAME to move gracefully across ice.

entry: POKENAME爱庆祝新年，会通过邮件复制传播自己，把欢庆带遍网络空间。除了弹出烟花窗口，固执地错认现在是1999年，并不会再损坏受影响的设备。
author: kungfucutbug
source: POKENAME loves celebrating the new year and will propagate itself via email to spread this jubilee across cyberspace. Aside from firework pop-ups and the erroneous insistence that it's 1999, it does no further damage to affected devices.

entry: POKENAME睡觉时蜷成球，什么也穿不透。睡时眼中产生沙粒，醒后仍浮在空中。据说，接住沙粒的人，就能获它实现愿望。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: When POKENAME sleeps, it curls up into a ball that nothing can penetrate. POKENAME generates sandy grains from its eyes as it sleeps that float in the air after it wakes. Anyone that catches one of these grains is said to have their wishes granted.

entry: POKENAME闭上原来的双眼，专心练习第三只眼。靠第三只眼，能提前看见尚未到来的攻击。
author: abhatu
source: POKENAME has closed its two main eyes in order to master the use of its third. Through this third eye it sees attacks before they come.

entry: POKENAME初见他者便读取心智，若没通过判断，就会一闪光消失。据说，只陪在心灵最纯洁的对象身边，并因其值得而实现一个愿望。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME reads the mind and hearts of others upon first meeting them, disappearing in a flash of light if they fail its judgement. It's said it only stays alongside the purest of heart, and will grant them a wish for being worthy.

entry: 据说POKENAME能敏锐察觉所遇人和宝可梦的真实意图。认定某个对象值得信任，便会建立深厚羁绊，尽力满足真心愿望。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are said to have keen senses for the true intents of people and Pokémon they come across. When a POKENAME deems someone worthy of its trust, it will form a strong bond with them and do its best to fulfill their heartfelt desires.

entry: 传说，这种善良慷慨的宝可梦，会在流星划过后醒来，现身好心孩子面前，以力量与共情实现无私心愿。孩子醒后，却什么也不记得。
author: keiracm35_
source: Legends say this kind, generous Pokémon wakes from slumber after a shooting star passes and appears to good-hearted children, using its powers and empathy to grant their selfless wishes. The children wake remembering nothing.

entry: 它是来自群星彼端的剑术大师，为那些心怀超越自身之愿的人而战。
author: abhatu
source: A master swordsman from beyond the stars. It fights for those who desire something beyond themselves.

entry: 立志成为战士的人，为求愿望，寻找沉睡的POKENAME。它只有察觉值得一战的对手才醒来，也只为战胜自己的人实现心愿。
author: lordjoostmeister
source: Aspiring warriors search for a slumbering POKENAME in pursuit of a wish. POKENAME only awakens when it senses a worthy opponent, and only grants the wishes of those who best it in combat.

entry: POKENAME极难寻觅，引来许多传说，说它每1000年才现身一次。据说，往背部裂缝里看，就会看见早已遗忘的愿望。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME is highly elusive and inspired many tales of it only appearing once every 1000 years. It's said that those who peer into the crack on its back will be shown their long-forgotten wishes.

entry: 这些宝可梦粗糙的紫晶，遇光便闪烁，仿佛藏着无数星辰。飞过夜空时，结晶捕捉的月光会向身后投出道道光迹。
author: infinex21
source: The rough purple crystals of these Pokémon twinkle when hit by light, as if they contain countless stars. When they fly through the night sky, the moonlight caught by their crystals will be cast like streaks behind them.

entry: POKENAME精力充沛，不断收集木材，想靠自己实现心愿：筑起一道足以拦住海洋的巨坝。
author: abhatu
source: POKENAME is known to be very active, constantly collecting wood. It aims to grant its own wish for a massive dam to block up the ocean.

entry: POKENAME由许多未竟的心愿汇成，而束缚POKENAME的那块石头，来历也不属人间。
author: abhatu
source: POKENAME is a collection of many desires left unfulfilled. The rock POKENAME is bound to is of unearthly origin.

entry: POKENAME似乎被缚在多数人称为“神灯”的物件上，材质未知，无人能损坏。天性温顺，甚至十分友好，可神灯一遭任何敲击，便会迅速暴怒。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME appears to be bound to a "magic lamp", as most people have referred to it, which is made of an unknown material that none can damage. POKENAME is docile and downright friendly by nature but quickly enrages if its lamp is struck in any way.

entry: 长久以来，传说POKENAME的幽灵之眼，能看透所见生灵的意图，却始终没有方法证实。不过，已知它确实极挑剔谁能靠近。
author: infinex21
