source: POKENAME's ghostly eye has long been storied to be capable of seeing the intent of any being it looks upon, though no way to prove this has presented itself. It is, however, well known that POKENAME is very picky about who it lets draw near to it.

entry: POKENAME寻找心地纯洁的对象，热切地想替其实现愿望。会换上各种类人伪装，混入人群。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME seek out those with pure hearts, eager to grant their wishes. POKENAME have been known to don various human-like disguises to blend in with crowds of people.

entry: POKENAME在夜空疾飞，仿佛金白相间的彗星。因此人们广泛相信，对流星许愿的迷信，正源于它。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME appears as a gold and white comet when it zooms around in the night sky. For this reason, it is widely believed that the superstition of wishing upon a shooting star originated from POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME致力于实现最崇高的愿望。背后花朵的芬芳，会让人重拾信心与希望。
author: abhatu
source: POKENAME strives to help make the most noble of wishes come true. The aroma from the flower on its back inspires confidence and hope.

entry: 传闻窥进POKENAME巨颚，能看见美梦全成真的国度。可真相是，里面只有繁星遍布的空间，以及毫无生机的真空。
author: infinex21
source: It is rumored that those who peer inside of POKENAME's massive jaws will see a realm where all dreams come true. But the truth is that within its jaws is a star-clad space where all that awaits is a lifeless vacuum.

entry: 晴夜，POKENAME展开花瓣，吸收月光。察觉训练家靠近，便合拢身体，降向地面躲藏。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: On clear nights, POKENAME unfurl their petals to absorb moonlight. When they sense a Trainer nearby, they close up and lower themselves to the ground to hide.

entry: 它的脸由紫水晶构成，能承受极强的冲击。POKENAME性情沉静，喜欢让训练家的梦想成真。
author: lemmymaster
source: Its face is made of amethyst that can withstand great force. POKENAME are calm and like to make the dreams of their Trainers come true.

entry: 它是一位性情平和的巨人，在野外极难见到。据说，训练家若能堂堂正正击败POKENAME，便可获准实现一个愿望。
author: thefinalkalgonus
source: A large, peaceful giant that is rarely seen in the wild. It's said that POKENAME will grant one wish to a Trainer that defeats it in a fair fight.

entry: POKENAME会出现在命中将遭厄运的人面前。据说，在惨淡命运降临前，它会实现对方最后一个心愿。
author: abhatu
source: POKENAME appears to those with doom in their future. It is said to grant one parting wish before their grim fate arrives.

entry: POKENAME随宇宙之流飘荡，寻找新生恒星的光芒，沐浴其中。目睹这段旅程的人，都会心生敬畏。
author: abhatu
source: POKENAME flows with the cosmic currents in search of the light of a new star to bathe in. A feeling of awe washes over those who witness its journey.

entry: 唯有更深地理解存在之意的人，才能看见POKENAME的真身。它曾被称作“观察者”。
author: abhatu
source: POKENAME shows its true form to those with a greater understanding of existence. It was once dubbed The Watcher.

entry: 神话中，POKENAME是天界判官，每个愿望都必须经过它。据说，会审视世间所有心愿，决定是否值得实现。
author: slimninja55
source: POKENAME is described in mythology as a celestial judge through which every wish must pass. It is said to judge every wish in the world and decide whether it is worthy of being granted.

entry: 神话中，POKENAME是天界判官，每个愿望都必须经过它。据说，会审视世间所有心愿，决定是否值得实现。
author: slimninja55
source: POKENAME is described in mythology as a celestial judge through which every wish must pass. It is said to judge every wish in the world and decide whether it is worthy of being granted.

entry: 人们相信POKENAME能改写现实，实现任何愿望。许多人认为，每1000年才现身一次，让一位心地纯洁的人提出心愿。
author: sk372
source: It is believed that POKENAME bears the power to rewrite reality to grant any wish. Many believe it appears only once every 1000 years to grant a single purehearted human to request their desire.

entry: POKENAME背上的树，结着夜间发光的特殊杨桃。人们把愿望写在纸条上，挂上树枝，盼望成真。
author: hophoppip
source: The tree on POKENAME's back bears a special type of starfruit that glows at night. People write their wishes on strips of paper and hang them in POKENAME's tree in hopes that they'll come true.

entry: POKENAME视力不佳，靠耳朵与尾巴上的缎带分析周围。听力强，能听见人们的心愿，却只向愿望善良纯真的孩子现身。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has poor vision, and uses the ribbons on its ears and tail in order to analyze its surroundings. Its strong hearing lets it hear people's wishes, but it only appears before children with kind and innocent wishes.

entry: 数千个心愿注入一把古剑，便诞生了POKENAME。相传，持有它的人就能实现自己的愿望。
author: nellnast42
source: POKENAME is borne from the infusion of thousands of wishes into an ancient sword. Legend says that the one who wields it has their own wishes granted.

entry: 若心地纯净的人将POKENAME举起，它便会从沉眠中苏醒。只需付出一丝生命力，就能向它求一个愿望。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME will awaken from its sleep if lifted by a person with a pure heart. For a sliver of life force, it grants wishes.

entry: 若心地纯净的人将POKENAME举起，它便会从沉眠中苏醒。只需付出一丝生命力，就能向它求一个愿望。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME will awaken from its sleep if lifted by a person with a pure heart. For a sliver of life force, it grants wishes.

entry: 若心地纯净的人将POKENAME举起，它便会从沉眠中苏醒。只需付出一丝生命力，就能向它求一个愿望。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME will awaken from its sleep if lifted by a person with a pure heart. For a sliver of life force, it grants wishes.

entry: 若心地纯净的人将POKENAME举起，它便会从沉眠中苏醒。只需付出一丝生命力，就能向它求一个愿望。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME will awaken from its sleep if lifted by a person with a pure heart. For a sliver of life force, it grants wishes.

entry: POKENAME常在冲突地区出现，为需要帮助的对象提供保护。据说，世界任何地方的求救声，都能感知。
author: turron_turron
source: POKENAME regularly appear in areas of conflict and offer protection to those in need. It's said that POKENAME can sense cries for help from anywhere in the world.

entry: POKENAME会在灾后引导人们前往安全处。有人说，它眼中发出的光，能驱走一切邪恶。
author: turron_turron
source: POKENAME can be found guiding people to safety in the wake of disasters. Some say that the light emitted by POKENAME's eye will ward away all evil.

entry: POKENAME以凶猛力量闻名。据说，只要在战斗中胜过它，就能获准实现一个愿望。
author: icytos
source: POKENAME is known for its fierce power. It is said that if you best it in battle, it will grant you one wish.

entry: POKENAME每1000年出现，巡视辽阔山地领土，搜寻陨石吃。据说，谁有幸见到，最深的心愿便会实现。
author: nero_415
source: POKENAME emerges every 1000 years to patrol its vast mountain territory, scouring for fallen meteorites to feast on. It's said that anyone lucky enough to spot a POKENAME will have their deepest wish granted.

entry: POKENAME翼膜由沙粒构成，能弯折、折射光线，形成图像。会用翼膜展现一个人最深的愿望。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: The membranes for POKENAME's wings are composed of sand particles that allow POKENAME to bend and refract light to form images. POKENAME use these membranes to show a person's deepest wish.

entry: POKENAME用许愿力量，造出群星构成的翅膀飞行。不愿为其他事许愿，谁试着向它求愿，就会被密集光雨毁灭。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME use their wish powers to create wings made of the stars to fly with. Unwilling to grant wishes for anything else, they destroy others who try to wish upon them in concentrated showers of light.

entry: 据说，这些奇怪宝可梦漫游宇宙，为找到自己的对象实现一个愿望。身体像怀表，也能用来报时。
author: actliux
source: These strange Pokémon are said to travel the cosmos granting those that find it a wish. Their body is shaped like that of a pocket watch, giving the ability to tell the time.

entry: POKENAME能造出人们最深渴望的幻象，引来想据为己有的贪婪者。偷猎者利用这份需求牟利，导致POKENAME的数量显著减少。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME have the power to conjure illusions of one's greatest desires, causing greedy people to seek them out for themselves. Poachers have capitalized on this demand and their numbers have significantly dwindled as a result.

entry: POKENAME的长矛充满强毒。据说，只要足够多人许愿，被长矛刺出的伤便能立即痊愈，无需医疗处理。
author: .izik
source: The spear POKENAME carries is filled with a powerful venom. It is said that if enough people make a wish for it, a wound from the spear will heal instantly, requiring no medical attention.

entry: 据说，POKENAME游过星海时，目睹它与尾迹的对象，可能实现最珍视的心愿。
author: thermophobia
source: It is said that as POKENAME swims through the sea of stars, those who witness it and its wake may have their most cherished wish come true.

entry: POKENAME会闯入渴望强烈的人的梦，再将那些愿望扭曲，化成可怕、永难满足的噩梦。
author: abhatu
source: POKENAME appears in dreams to those with strong desires. It then twists those desires into horrible and unfulfilling nightmares.

entry: 长睡醒来后，POKENAME收集坚硬岩石，用炮射入大气。一两小时后，石头重新坠下，化作流星与流星雨。
author: pkbonusducks
source: After waking from a long rest, POKENAME collects durable rocks and launches them into the atmosphere with its cannon. The rocks fall back down an hour or two later as shooting stars and meteor showers.

entry: POKENAME锤上闪亮的蓝毒，一碰便会头晕。有人声称，经历晕眩后，再许任何愿望，都有很高机会成真。
author: .izik
source: The sparkling blue poison coating POKENAME's hammer can cause dizziness from a single touch. Some claim that after experiencing this dizziness, any wish made afterward has a high chance of coming true.

entry: POKENAME尾部涡轮靠奇异宝石供能，许多人相信来自地外。据说能许愿，但只为怀抱最正义理想的对象。
author: sk372
source: The turbine in POKENAME's tail is powered by a strange gem that many believe has extraterrestrial origins. It is said to be able to grant wishes, but only to those who carry the most righteous of ideals.

entry: 过去，村庄会寻找POKENAME，许下与农耕有关的心愿。如今更难找，因为它用甜香把寻找者引往别处。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: In the past, villages sought out POKENAME for agriculture-related wishes. Nowadays POKENAME is harder to find as it uses its sweet scent to lure away those who seek it.

entry: POKENAME野外极难见，是都市传说的主角。据说，流星之夜看见它飘过，最大的愿望就会实现。
author: sk372
source: Extremely rare to see in the wild, POKENAME is the subject of urban myth; supposedly if one sees a POKENAME float by during a night with a shooting star, their greatest wish will be granted.

entry: 据说POKENAME大多数日子都在沉睡，只有罕见的蓝月夜才醒来。此时散出强大星能，据说能吸收愿望，在下一次蓝月实现。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME is said to stay asleep for most days, only awakening during a rare moon blue night. During this period, it radiates powerful star energy that is believed to absorb wishes and grant them on the next blue moon.

entry: POKENAME头上的羊毛由特殊丝质材料构成，有人相信穿在身上能许愿。它喜欢短暂现身捉弄人，等对方想抓，就立刻消失。
author: sk372
source: The wool covering POKENAME's head is made of a special silken material that some believe grants wishes while worn. It enjoys pranking people by briefly appearing before them, then vanishing the moment they try to catch it.

entry: POKENAME身上的绒毛摸着极软。有人相信，睡在这种绒毛制成的枕头上，任何梦都能成真。
author: kittyluv090
source: The fluff on POKENAME's body is extremely soft to the touch. Some believe that sleeping on a pillow made with this fluff can make any dream come true.

entry: 据说，POKENAME藏着一股绝不可释放的古老力量。谁若窥进它的眼睛，便会永远迷失。
author: abhatu
source: It is said that POKENAME contains an ancient power never to be unleashed. Those who peer into its eye are left feeling lost for the rest of time.

entry: POKENAME会在某人临终前现身，吸收剩余生命力，再将其作为实现愿望的力量。
author: seanothan_23
source: POKENAME appears right before someone passes away to absorb that person's remaining life force. It then uses this life force as its power to grant wishes.

entry: POKENAME夜间漂过庆典，用灯笼收集人们的愿望。随后点亮灯笼，像流星般放飞天际，向下方人群示意，愿望很快便会成真。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME drift through festivals at night to collect the wishes from people using their lanterns. They then ignite the lanterns and release them across the sky like shooting stars, signaling to the people below that their wishes will soon come true.

entry: 传说，在光明正大的战斗中击败POKENAME，就能让它自愿实现胜者选定的一个愿望。会在居住洞壁刻满星形图案，磨利獠牙。
author: fiordaliso
source: According to legend, if POKENAME is honorably defeated in battle, it willingly offers to grant one wish chosen by the victor. It covers the walls of the caves it inhabits with star-shaped carvings to keep its tusks sharp.

entry: POKENAME通常出现在日落或星夜的玫瑰田。野生个体只有纯洁心灵的训练家才能驯服、捕捉，并与之结成永恒羁绊。体温能让训练家舒适、幸福。
author: keiracm35_
source: They are usually found in rose fields during sunsets and starry nights. Wild POKENAME can only be tamed and caught by pure-hearted trainers, with whom they form an eternal bond. Their body warmth brings their trainers coziness and happiness.

entry: POKENAME渴望获得认可，为讨好他者而实现愿望。邪恶组织会追猎它，正是因为它什么愿都肯答应。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are desperate to seek validation from others, and grant wishes to gain approval. Villainous organizations hunt for POKENAME because of their willingness to grant any wish.

entry: POKENAME翼上挂着的书面愿望，会随拍翅散落。只有长久留在翅膀上的才被实现，其余都遭忽略、烧掉。
author: soup1900
source: Written wishes attached to POKENAME's wings are scattered as they flap. Only the wishes that remain on the wings after a long period of time are granted; the rest are ignored and burned.

entry: POKENAME飞来飞去，散落许多附魔鳞片。收齐1,000片，就会现身，为收集者实现一个愿望。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME scatters its many enchanted scales as it flies around. When 1,000 of these scales are gathered, it will appear and grant one wish to the collector.

entry: POKENAME虽尽力满足周围心愿，却笨手笨脚，常反而咬到许愿者。不过性格太欢快，很快就会获原谅。
author: coridiant
source: Though it does its best to grant the wishes of those around it, POKENAME's clumsy nature means it often ends up biting the wishers instead. However, it has such a cheerful demeanor that it is quickly forgiven for these bites.

entry: POKENAME两颗头常为如何最好地实现愿望意见不合，因此许愿者很少真正如愿。
author: coridiant
source: The two heads of POKENAME often disagree on how to best grant a wish. Thus, it is rare for the wisher to actually get their wish granted.

entry: POKENAME收集十年愿望，再由三颗头各选一个实现。两个臂头更爱轻松愉快的心愿，主头却偏好自私或报复性的愿望。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME collects wishes for a decade before the three heads select one wish each to grant. The two brachial heads are more likely to pick lighthearted wishes, but the main head is more inclined towards selfish or vindictive wishes.

entry: POKENAME每条尾巴能实现一个愿望。不过传说，若拿来作恶，就会诅咒许愿者一千年。
author: gbjockey
source: Each of POKENAME's tails can grant one wish. However, legend has it that if these wishes are used for ill, POKENAME will curse the wisher for a thousand years.

entry: 据说POKENAME力量极强，连最离奇的愿望，都能以十倍之效成真。
author: seanothan_23
source: It is said that POKENAME's powers are so strong that even the most bizarre wishes can come true tenfold.

entry: POKENAME每次抖毛，都会撒出少许带微弱电力的星尘。粒子在黑暗中微亮，因此成为衣物等物件的热门装饰。
author: sk372
source: Whenever POKENAME shakes its fur, it spreads a small smattering of stardust laced with faint electricity. The particles glow faintly in the dark, making them a popular accessory for clothing and the like.

entry: 传说，POKENAME渴望飞翔的心太过强烈，连群星也为之感动，赐它双翼，让它终于能翱翔。
author: mistershaokahn
source: According to legend, POKENAME wished so hard to fly that the stars gave it a pair of wings that let it soar.

entry: POKENAME实现轻率许下的愿望，细品许愿者可能产生的怨恨。若有可能，它还会变成这份怨恨的实体模样，折磨许愿者。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME grants reckless wishes, savoring the resentment the wishmaker may experience. If possible, POKENAME will transform into a physical representation of that resentment to torment the wishmaker.

entry: POKENAME很受孩子追捧，许多人相信，只要带在身边足够久，它就会实现愿望。其实它没这能力，却仍很享受自己带来的快乐。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is highly sought by children, as many kids believe it will grant their wishes if they carry it with them long enough. POKENAME doesn't actually possess that power, but it enjoys the happiness it instills regardless.

entry: 现已证实，凌晨3点至下午3点之间，若雷电击中一辆载有超过3吨棉花的卡车并使其起火，3秒后在POKENAME周围3米内许愿，愿望就会实现。它爱偷玉米和小麦。
author: epping_forest
source: It's been proven that if you make a wish 3 meters near a POKENAME, 3 seconds after a lightning hits and sets on fire a truck carrying more than 3 tons of cotton, from 3 a.m to 3 p.m, that wish will come true. It loves stealing corn and wheat.

entry: 据说，无法实现愿望的人跌到最低谷时，POKENAME就会现身安慰。构成它大半身体的材料，似乎根本撕不破。
author: bobosmith01
source: It is said that POKENAME will appear and comfort those who are unable to attain their wishes when they are at their lowest point. The material that comprises much of its body is seemingly impossible to tear.

entry: 大风之夜，POKENAME像流星般被吹过天空。据说它能实现愿望，但有人说看见就够了，也有人说必须找到落下的地点。
author: .jerden
source: On windy nights, POKENAME is blown through the sky like a shooting star. It is said to make wishes come true, but while some people say that seeing it is enough, others say that it must be found where it falls.

entry: POKENAME飞遍世界，只收集训练家最真诚的愿望，尽力实现。不过，实现的愿望可能产生意料之外的后果。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME flies around the world, collecting only the most sincere wishes from Trainers. It will then grant them to the best of their abilities. The granted wishes may have unintended consequences, however.

entry: POKENAME的斗篷由奇怪的凝聚星尘制成，据说能实现愿望。但只有它自己穿着才有这力量，若强行脱下，就会化作毫无价值的沙。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's cloak is made of a strange condensed stardust said to grant wishes. This power only works while POKENAME itself is wearing the cloak, as it turns to worthless sand if forcibly removed.

entry: 有人说，将愿望写在POKENAME的一片叶子上，再任叶子随风飘走，愿望就一定能实现。
author: hophoppip
source: Some say that if you write a wish on one of POKENAME's leaves, then let it go into the wind, your wish will be certainly granted.

entry: POKENAME翼端星形的羽毛簇相当密实。战斗时，它会有力地挥翼，痛击敌人。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's star-shaped clusters of feathers on the ends of its wings are quite dense. In battle, it energetically swings its wings to pummel foes.

entry: POKENAME未必能实现愿望，却能找回过去遗失、富有纪念意义的宝物。成年人偶然与童年玩具重逢，让许多人喜极而泣。
author: quackquackattack
source: While POKENAME may not give out wishes, they manage to find precious sentimental items that have gotten lost in the past. The serendipitous reunion of adults and their childhood toys make many people tear up with joy.

entry: POKENAME在垃圾填埋场出现时，总是神情安详。它穿过垃圾，寻找被丢弃的纪念物，想归还主人。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME always have a serene expression whenever they are found at landfills. They wade through garbage to find sentimental items that were thrown away so they can return them to their owners.

entry: 流星众多的夜里，POKENAME出现得更多。据说抓到一只，就能走100年好运。
author: mepp.
source: On nights filled with shooting stars, sightings of POKENAME increase. Catching one is said to bring good luck for 100 years.

entry: POKENAME在水中、甚至空中高速喷射前进，留下一道星尘般的痕迹。人们认为，只要它愿意，就能将自己射向太空，游过银河。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME jets through the waters and even into the air at high speeds, leaving behind a trail of something resembling stardust. It's thought that if it wanted, it could fling itself into space and swim through the galaxy.

entry: 这只罕见的融合体性情温和，模样可爱，又像一艘火箭飞船，因此成了许多儿童读物的主角。
author: admiralvermin
source: This rare fusion's cute appearance and resemblance to a rocket ship have made it the subject of many children's books. It has a gentle temperament.

entry: POKENAME由未知的液态金属构成，不会发热，却能溶化接触的固体。据说它曾化作流星，坠落到这颗星球。
author: nyoomymph
source: POKENAME's body is made of an unknown liquid metal that doesn't heat but melts solids that come into contact with it. It's said that POKENAME fell to this planet as a shooting star.

entry: POKENAME很善良，愿意以实现愿望换取拥抱。力量虽不强，它仍会尽力帮每个抱住自己的许愿者达成心愿。
author: elibromax314
source: POKENAME is a kind Pokémon, offering wishes in exchange for hugs. While its wishing power isn't strong, POKENAME will still try to fulfill every wish that it is hugged for.

entry: POKENAME每条星状腿上，都刻着古老但已知语言的符号。连续念出符号组成的词12遍，就能实现拥有无限太阳珊瑚枝条的愿望。
author: soup1900
source: Each one of POKENAME's starry legs contains inscribed symbols from an old but known language. Those who chant the word formed by these symbols 12 times in a row will have their wish of unlimited Corsola branches granted to them.

entry: POKENAME每条星状腿上，都刻着古老但已知语言的符号。连续念出符号组成的词12遍，就能实现拥有无限太阳珊瑚枝条的愿望。
author: soup1900
source: Each one of POKENAME's starry legs contains inscribed symbols from an old but known language. Those who chant the word formed by these symbols 12 times in a row will have their wish of unlimited Corsola branches granted to them.

entry: POKENAME实现愿望前，会摆许多姿势，炫耀星光羽毛。若摆姿势时又有人将写好的愿望放在它身上，它便从头再来，连这个愿望也一并实现。
author: soup1900
source: Before granting a wish, POKENAME will strike many poses and show off its starry feathers. If a written wish is placed on it during one of its poses, it will restart and fulfill that wish as well.

entry: 据说POKENAME会在夜晚的沙漠里出现在心地纯洁的旅人面前。它用仿佛星尘构成的奇怪沙暴，将人传送到安全处，等对方抵达避难所，自己也随之消失。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is said to appear before pure-hearted travelers within the desert at night. It teleports them to safety via a strange sandstorm seemingly made of stardust, POKENAME itself vanishing when the traveler reaches a safe haven.

entry: POKENAME承载着稀树草原上众生的愿望，从婴儿轻轻的一口气，到老人临终的最后一息。它的出现提醒当地人，大自然既残酷又慈爱，而宝可梦也在不断适应世界。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME carry the wishes of those from the savannah, from the smallest gasp of air of a baby to an elder man's dying breath. Their appearance reminds people of the region that nature is cruel and loving, as Pokémon continue to adapt to the world.

entry: 据说POKENAME的歌让心地纯洁者充满孩子般的快乐，心怀邪恶者却只会沉睡。它几百年才醒一次，因此歌声大多只存在于传说。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's songs are said to fill pure-hearted listeners with childlike joy, while those with wicked hearts will simply be lulled into a deep slumber. It only awakens every few hundred years, so its songs are mostly known only through legends.

entry: POKENAME只在月亮最明亮、繁星点亮夜空的夜里醒来。它把月光当聚光灯，歌唱起舞，让宝可梦和人都为表演着迷。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME will only awaken on nights when the moon shines brightest and the stars are all alight in the night sky. It will sing and dance within the moonlight as though it were a spotlight, enthralling Pokémon and humans alike with its performance.

entry: POKENAME潜入梦境，帮人和宝可梦实现深藏的渴望。许多宝可梦想变强，它便帮助做梦者在睡梦中进化，实现愿望。
author: quackquackattack
source: By slipping into dreams, POKENAME help people and Pokémon alike to fulfill their deep-seated desires. Many Pokémon long to grow stronger, a wish POKENAME grants by helping the dreamer evolve in their sleep.

entry: POKENAME沉睡时，会穿行附近对象的梦境。若遇见纯洁真诚的愿望，就会将渴望化为现实。
author: ambrosia04
source: While in deep slumber, POKENAME traverses the dreams of those nearby. If it encounters a pure-hearted wish during its sleep, it manifests that desire into reality.

entry: POKENAME身上伸出的纸，写着未知语言。历史学家和语言学家推测，那是祈祷，而它正让这些愿望继续存在。
author: pkbonusducks
source: The papers protruding from POKENAME's body are written in an unknown language. Historians and linguists speculate they're prayers, and that POKENAME is keeping their wishes alive.

entry: 据说3颗流星相撞，就会诞生POKENAME。壳上的星座，能用来预测未来的流星雨。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: It is said that when three shooting stars collide, a POKENAME is created. The constellations on its shell can be used to predict future meteor showers.

entry: POKENAME实现愿望时，常偏离许愿者原意，改成对自己有利的结果。它会先占卜，决定怎样扭曲愿望最有用。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: The wishes granted by POKENAME are often altered from the original wish maker's intention to be beneficial to POKENAME. It uses its divination ability to decide what the most useful twist on each wish will be.

entry: POKENAME白天待在大气层，拉来小块陨石，制成星形岩石。夜里便将石头抛向地面，制造流星。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME spend their days in the atmosphere, pulling close small chunks of meteorite, which they make into star-shaped rocks. During the night they fling these rocks down to the ground, creating shooting stars.

entry: POKENAME白天待在大气层，拉来小块陨石，制成星形岩石。夜里便将石头抛向地面，制造流星。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME spend their days in the atmosphere, pulling close small chunks of meteorite, which they make into star-shaped rocks. During the night they fling these rocks down to the ground, creating shooting stars.

entry: POKENAME在星光灿烂的夜晚出来跳跃，练习自己的打法。欢迎别人一起训练；若练得特别好，事后还可能为切磋伙伴实现一个愿望。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME comes out on starry evenings to prance about and practice its fighting style. Others are welcome to come train with it, and if the practice goes particularly well, POKENAME may grant its sparring partner a wish afterward.

entry: POKENAME出没于太阳系深处，偶尔飞过这颗星球，在夜空留下痕迹。据说看见它会带来大好运，实现心底最深的愿望。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are found deep in the solar system, occasionally flying past the planet and leaving a trail in the night sky. Seeing one is said to bring great fortune to the observer, making their deepest desire come true.

entry: 传说，内心最深的欲望会映在POKENAME的晶体身体中。传说还说，盯得太久，只会走向毁灭。
author: bobosmith01
source: Legends say that one's deepest desires are reflected in POKENAME's crystalline body. They also state that staring at it for too long will only lead one to their doom.

entry: POKENAME能赐人无穷财富，许多贪婪者因此向它祈求。它却会送上被诅咒的宝石，让这些人一生遭遇大不幸和苦难。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME is prayed upon by many greedy people as it has the ability to grant infinite wealth to an individual. In response, they give these people cursed gems to bring great misfortune and misery to their lives.

entry: 据说持有POKENAME的一块星形金片，就能许下任何愿望。但贪欲之愿，最终会让财富如暴风雨般砸来，葬送许愿者的人生。
author: soup1900
source: It is said that having one of POKENAME's star-shaped gold pieces grants the holder the ability to ask for any wish they want granted. However, any wishes of greed will end in a storm of wealth hitting them and dooming their life.

entry: 据说，POKENAME每千年才能实现一次愿望。可愿望一旦实现，它就会忘掉自己曾有这份力量。
author: abhatu
source: POKENAME is said to grant a wish once every thousand years. However, it has no recollection of its powers after fulfilling one.

entry: POKENAME已在太空中游弋数千年，身上流淌出宇宙的碎片。第三只眼，让它能毫无阻碍地看穿任何液体。
author: abhatu
source: Having swam through space for millennia, fragments of the cosmos now flow from POKENAME. Its third eye allows it to see perfectly through any liquid.

entry: POKENAME为凡人的梦想奔走，穿行群星之间。据说，彗星不过是它划过太空，留下的灿烂身影。
author: nellnast42
source: POKENAME travels across the stars as a servant to mortals' dreams. It is said that comets are merely POKENAME blazing through space.

entry: POKENAME施展精神攻击时，腹部螺旋会旋转。古老传说称，旋转能在体内积蓄实现愿望的力量。它双腿走路困难，因此最常见于水中。
author: chibitales
source: As POKENAME channels its psychic attacks, the spiral on its stomach spins. An old legend claims that as its spiral spins, wish-granting power is built up in its body. POKENAME struggles to walk on its legs, so it is seen most often in water.

entry: POKENAME腹上的眼睛不断螺旋转动，只偶尔短暂停在周围的人或宝可梦身上。到处流传着说法，认为它总在寻找纯洁灵魂，为其实现愿望。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The eye in POKENAME's stomach constantly roves around in a spiralling motion, only briefly settling on people or Pokémon around them. Rumours abound that POKENAME are constantly searching for a pure soul to grant a wish to.

entry: POKENAME像贤者，住在常见流星雨的山巅。它审视别人的心思和内心，判断是否值得自己实现愿望。
author: sk372
source: A sage-like being residing on mountain peaks where meteor showers are commonly seen. POKENAME judges the minds and hearts of others, to see if they are worthy enough to have it grant their wishes.

entry: POKENAME用腕上飘带擒拿，将对手拉进近战范围。据说，若有战士强到能在战斗中胜过它，它就会实现对方的愿望。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's fighting style involves using the ribbons around its wrists as grappling items to reel opponents into close-quarters attack range. It is said to grant the wishes of fighters strong enough to best it in combat.

entry: POKENAME出现在放弃梦想的人面前。它虽能轻松实现任何愿望，却选择展示抱负已实现的世界，重新点燃对方失去的热情。
author: ripple.star
source: POKENAME appears to people who have given up on their dreams. Although it can grant any wish with ease, POKENAME instead chooses to rekindle the lost passion inside those it visits by showing them a world where their ambitions have been realised.

entry: 传说只要将POKENAME彻底擦拭、抛光，它就会回报一个愿望。它极其稀有，通常只在山巅岩石间伪装。
author: fiordaliso
source: According to legend, if POKENAME is rubbed and polished thoroughly, it will grant a wish in return. It is an extremely rare creature usually found only on mountain peaks, camouflaged among the rocks.

entry: POKENAME爱实现愿望，头脑却太迟钝，无法完全理解人们想要什么，因此常不小心实现了错误的愿望。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME loves to grant wishes, but it is too dim-witted to fully understand what people want. As a result, it often ends up granting the wrong wish unintentionally.

entry: POKENAME带着闪亮魔杖，能行使愿望之力。野外，它会制造大量优质大葱，平息幸运的大葱鸭群争吵。
author: orionsayshi
source: POKENAME carries with it a glimmering wand that wields the power of wishes. If found in the wild, it can be seen using its power to quell bickering among fortunate Farfetch'd populations by creating a surplus of quality leeks.

entry: POKENAME通常在流星雨期间出现，高速掠过夜空，投下美丽幻象。若此时落地，就会散发舒缓气场。
author: jojojax164
source: POKENAME are usually seen during meteor showers, where they zoom through the night at extreme speeds, casting beautiful illusions in the sky. Should a POKENAME land during one of these showers, they will radiate a soothing aura.

entry: POKENAME游过天际群星，宛如游水。每溅起一次星光，便有一个人心底最深的愿望成真。
author: nellnast42
source: POKENAME can be found swimming across the stars in the sky like water. With each splash, a human's deepest wish is granted.

entry: 据说POKENAME由人们一生留下的梦想、愿望碎片构成。人们相信，它甚至能将部分梦想化为现实，哪怕最后会有所改变。
author: heal_fire
source: It's said that POKENAME is made up of all the fragments of the dreams and wishes that were left over by people during their lives. It's believed that POKENAME could even make some of these dreams part of reality, even if they end up being altered.

entry: POKENAME睡在海底，每5000年才开壳一次。科学家虽多次尝试，却从未强行打开过。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME sleeps at the bottom of the ocean, only opening its shell once every 5,000 years. Despite many scientific attempts, POKENAME has never been forcefully opened.

entry: POKENAME挥动许愿笺，为人实现心愿。看到梦想成真的人发自内心地欢喜，就是它最快乐的事。
author: noel5229
source: POKENAME grants wishes by swinging its tanzaku. Nothing makes it happier than witnessing the pure joy of those whose dreams have come true.

entry: POKENAME用爪子搓磨叶子，将其磨成细片。细得像沙后，它才会吃掉叶片碎屑。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME rubs its claws against leaves to abrade them into tiny pieces. Once small enough to resemble sand, POKENAME consume the leafy fragments.

entry: POKENAME的群落在地道里安家。被打扰就会爆炸，有时引起连锁反应，能夷平地道上方的建筑。
author: .izik
source: Hives of POKENAME make their homes in tunnels. They explode if disturbed, sometimes setting off a chain reaction that can level buildings above their tunnels.

entry: POKENAME哭泣时，头上的几丁质颜色会加深。随后它钻进地下，借这变化平静下来，进入睡眠。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME cries, the chitin on its head darkens in color. It burrows underground afterward, using this change to calm itself into sleep.

entry: POKENAME围着下半身造便携巢，遮挡阳光，也保护睡着的自己。移动和找食物时便探出来，之后再缩回去。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME create portable nests around their lower bodies to take shelter from the sun and protect themselves while they sleep. They extend out from their nests to travel and gather food before retreating back in.

entry: POKENAME被视为最平凡的宝可梦之一，在宽阔水域漂浮，寻找海藻。谁想偷食物，它就会抓过去。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are regarded as one of the more mundane Pokémon in existence. They float in large bodies of water looking for seaweed and swipe at any Pokémon that tries to steal their food.

entry: 它在地下切断根须，腾出冬眠空间。春天快来时便弃巢，其他宝可梦能趁机接手。
author: quackquackattack
source: It slices through roots underground to create space for winter hibernation. Once spring approaches, it discards the nest, allowing opportunistic Pokémon to take over.

entry: POKENAME用硬触角探树皮弱点，找到软处就咬穿，喝树液。它代谢所吃植物中的毒素，让自己变得难吃，免遭捕食。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME use their stiff antennae to probe tree bark for weak points, biting through to feed on sap when they find a soft patch. They metabolise the toxins within the plants they feed on, using them to make themselves unpalatable to predators.

entry: POKENAME在地下多年，不断挖掘，寻找进化之石。终于找到后，就一动不动地吸收石头的辐射，完成进化。
author: darkweavile428
source: POKENAME spends many years underground, digging in search of an Evolution stone. When it finally finds one, POKENAME remains completely motionless as it absorbs the radiation from the stone and evolves.

entry: POKENAME和群里的伙伴大量吃下数据后，就会钻进地下深处休息。留下的地道能绵延数英里。
author: .izik
source: After feeding extensively on data with its swarm, POKENAME burrows deep underground to rest. The tunnels it leaves behind can stretch for miles.

entry: POKENAME一找到果实和根都合胃口的树，就会据为己有，刺向一切靠近的对象。但刺其实颇钝，因此主要靠威吓赶走闯入者。
author: sk372
source: Once POKENAME finds a tree it likes the fruit and roots of, it claims it for itself and jabs at anything that comes near it. Its stingers are actually rather dull, so it relies mostly on intimidation to sent intruders packing.

entry: POKENAME大部分时间在地下，用胡须般的触角在黑暗中辨路。视力因此逐渐减弱，一遇强光，就会造出精神护盾遮阳。
author: imaginita
source: POKENAME spends most of its time underground, finding its way through the darkness with its whisker-like antennae. This leads to its eyes growing weak, so when exposed to bright sunlight, POKENAME conjures a psychic shield to shade itself.

entry: POKENAME的毛极细，常洗沙浴，去掉在地下积存的水分。若毛湿太久，它就会焦虑。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's fur is extremely fine, and it frequently takes dust baths to rid its coat of moisture that it accumulates underground. It gets anxious if its coat stays damp for too long.

entry: POKENAME洞里覆着黏网，却不会黏住自己。若有什么落网，它就赶紧移走，保持网丝清洁，让家园一尘不染。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's burrows are covered in a sticky web that does not stick to this Pokémon. If anything gets caught in its web, it hurries to dislodge it to keep the webbing clean, ensuring its home remains pristine.

entry: 满月时，POKENAME走出地道，凝望天空。它虽几乎失明，却不知为何知道月亮在哪，受月光吸引，面朝月亮。
author: .izik
source: During the full moon, POKENAME emerges from its tunnels and stares at the sky. Though nearly blind, it somehow knows where the moon is and faces it, drawn by its light.

entry: POKENAME吃灌木根时，有时会突然停下，看见过去一周里，所有与这株灌木接触过的对象的幻象。
author: .izik
source: Sometimes, while eating the roots of bushes, POKENAME will stop abruptly. During this time, it sees visions of anyone who interacted with the bush in the last week.

entry: POKENAME吃够根须，甲壳上就会长出厚厚的绿色羊毛。这层羊毛能储电，等待进化时，它便靠这些电力维生。
author: .izik
source: After eating enough roots, a thick green wool will grow from POKENAME's carapace. This wool stores an electrical charge, which it can survive off of while it waits to evolve.

entry: POKENAME偏爱郁金香根。吃饱后，就在森林上方旋转漂浮，四处散播快乐，寻找新的探索之地。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME prefers to eat tulip roots. When full, it will spin while floating over forests, spreading joy as it drifts through the air in search of new places to explore.

entry: POKENAME厌恶阳光，因为会刺激本就不好的眼睛。夜里，它在森林漂游，寻找树木茂密的地方，准备挖新洞，好不受打扰地休息。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME despises sunlight as it irritates its already poor eyes. At night, it will float around forests looking for areas with dense trees to make a future burrow where it can rest undisturbed.

entry: 若吃光附近植物的根，POKENAME就会从别处收集种子，高高飘在空中散播，确保新植物长出来。
author: .izik
source: If POKENAME eats all the roots of nearby flora, it will gather seeds from other areas and scatter them while floating high above the ground, ensuring the growth of new plants.

entry: 捕食者进入地道，POKENAME先腼腆地使出摇尾巴，再用强力必杀门牙攻击。这样，同类能安全使用地道，家园也免遭侵入。
author: .izik
source: If a predator enters its tunnel, POKENAME will attack with a coy Tail Whip before unleashing a powerful Hyper Fang. This ensures its tunnels stay safe for others of its kind, protecting its home from intruders.

entry: POKENAME用尾端钳状部分，从树上抓取蕉香果，再回洞里吃，远离捕食者，细品甜美多汁的果肉。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses the claw-like portion of its tail to grab Nanab Berries from trees. It then withdraws into its burrow to eat the fruit, savoring its sweet, juicy flesh away from predators.

entry: POKENAME几乎失明，会快速振翅，产生声波感知周围。睡觉时躲在草木中，绿色翅膀便于融入。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are virtually blind, so they rapidly vibrate their wings to produce sonic waves that help them sense the area around them. They sleep shrouded in foliage, their green wings helping them blend in.

entry: POKENAME视力极差，在沼泽徘徊并非爱探索，而是根本看不清自己往哪走，也找不到巢。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's eyesight is extremely poor. It wanders around marshy areas not because it likes to explore, but because its eyesight is so bad it cannot see where it is going or where its den is.

entry: 夜里，POKENAME离开当前洞穴，寻找新的挖掘处。一发现枫树，就立刻下挖，尽可能多吃根须，享受丰富养分。
author: .izik
source: At night, POKENAME will leave its current burrow to look for other places to dig. Should it find a maple tree, it will immediately dig down to eat as much of the roots as it can, savoring the rich nourishment.

entry: POKENAME成群在树下挖洞，用爪子切开树根，吸收养分。被它们侵扰的树，树干上常刻着神秘符号和字母。
author: santon5512
source: Groups of POKENAME burrow beneath trees, using their claws to carve through the roots to absorb their nutrients. Trees infested by these Pokémon will often have mysterious symbols and letters carved into their trunks.

entry: 它们不断生长，因此每天蜕皮。蜕皮磨成细粉，气味和味道都像杏仁，却没有引发过敏的风险。
author: quackquackattack
source: They shed their skins daily because they are continuously growing. When ground into a fine powder, it smells and tastes like an almond, but without the risk of an allergic reaction.

entry: POKENAME用大钳在地下挖复杂地道。吃够植物后，能数年一动不动地等待，希望进化成更强的形态。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its large claws to dig underground, creating intricate tunnels. It can wait motionless for multiple years after eating enough plant life, hoping to evolve into something more powerful.

entry: 夜里，POKENAME离洞飞进球果树，撞落果实。只要一直静待地下，两颗通常就能维持一个月。
author: .izik
source: At night, POKENAME leaves its burrow to fly into Apricorn trees and knock loose the fruit. Two are usually enough for it to stay sustained for a month, as long as it remains motionless underground.

entry: POKENAME在柿仔果树下挖洞，捡落果，存进壳里。挖地时，树果继续成熟，化成美味果浆，丰缘各地餐馆会用来调饮料。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME makes a burrow under Persim Berry trees, gathering fallen berries and storing them in its shell. As it digs, the berries ripen further and turn into a delicious slurry, which is combined with drinks in restaurants across Hoenn.

entry: POKENAME用角撞开树根，喝渗出的水分。这样既能补充养分，又能继续地下生活。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its horn to break apart tree roots, drinking any moisture that seeps out. This behavior allows it to nourish itself while continuing its underground lifestyle.

entry: POKENAME用须四处探寻可吃的树根，干燥地区尤其如此。进食时，谁靠得太近，触须就会燃起，喷出极热的火焰。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME roots around with its whiskers in search of tree roots to feed on, particularly in drier climates. These feelers ignite and shoot extremely hot flames at those who get too close while it is trying to eat.

entry: POKENAME蜕下的美丽空壳由坚韧角蛋白构成，据说能保存十年。它们每月产4枚，身体会通过尾巴排出多余角蛋白。
author: quackquackattack
source: A Shed Shell from a POKENAME is said to last a decade, made of a sturdy keratin. They produce four in a month, as their bodies release excess keratin through the tail.

entry: POKENAME用一对触角，隔土感知健康的植物根。它边钻地边探前方泥土，锁定这些植物，觅食时留下一条蜿蜒长道。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME can sense healthy plant roots through soil with their twin antennae. They probe the ground in front of them to hone in on these plants whilst burrowing, leaving a long, sinuous tunnel behind them as they search for food.

entry: POKENAME群常侵扰公寓楼的电脑，是必须优先处理的麻烦。睡觉时发出几乎听不见的哔声，却已害得居民睡眠不足。
author: chibitales
source: Often infesting computers in apartment buildings, POKENAME swarms are considered a high priority nuisance. While sleeping, the swarm lets out barely audible beeps that have driven citizens to sleep deprivation.

entry: POKENAME吃水仙根后，力量会成倍增强，赤手就能打碎巨石。效果只持续几分钟，却让它在短时间内强大无比。
author: .izik
source: After eating the roots of daffodils, POKENAME's strength multiplies, allowing it to smash boulders with its bare hands. This effect lasts only a few minutes but makes it incredibly powerful in that brief period.

entry: POKENAME的触角能感知电场，即使漆黑也能辨路。靠近猎物后，它旋转双臂发电，再趁疲惫前迅速攻击。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's antennae sense electrical fields, enabling it to navigate even in total darkness. Once it gets close to prey, POKENAME spins its arms to generate electricity, then quickly strikes before it gets tired.

entry: POKENAME平时吃药草根。乳汁极苦，却能一碰就治好轻微擦伤，因此有很高的治疗价值。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spends its time eating roots of medicinal herbs. Its milk is extremely bitter but is able to heal minor abrasions on contact, making it valuable for healing purposes.

entry: POKENAME会从地下出来，大吃作物，许多农民因此视它为害虫。单只每天最多能吃20磅植物。
author: mepp.
source: Many farmers consider POKENAME a pest, as they emerge from underground to feast on their crops. A single POKENAME can consume up to 20lbs of plant matter daily.

entry: POKENAME用爪子挖地，寻找树根。视力不佳，便靠细小的须判断周围，确保能在土中精准前进。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its claws while digging to search for tree roots. It has trouble seeing, so it relies on its tiny whiskers to determine its surroundings, ensuring it can navigate through the earth with precision.

entry: POKENAME感知周围的部位在尾上，离脑太远，信息传来时已严重失真。因此，它常把无生命物体当捕食者攻击。
author: soup1900
source: Since the body part that POKENAME uses to sense its surroundings is on its tail and far from its brain, the data gets very distorted from what it originally was. Due to this, POKENAME often attacks inanimate objects, thinking they are predators.

entry: POKENAME主要在地下生活，几乎失明。它发展出感知周围热量的能力，有时会吐火，帮助自己辨路。
author: infinex21
source: Because POKENAME primarily live underground, they are nearly blind. They have developed the ability to sense heat in their surroundings, so they may spit fire to help guide themselves.

entry: POKENAME只在森林深处的夜里外出，寻找大树，抓开树皮，喝里面的水分。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME only come out during the night, deep within the forests. During their outings, POKENAME will search for large trees to scratch into and drink the moisture from.

entry: POKENAME吃池边植物的根，取得所需养分，在水生家园长大、茁壮生存。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME consumes the roots of plant life near its pond. These roots provide it with the nourishment needed to grow and thrive in its aquatic habitat.

entry: POKENAME感到附近有快乐，须就快速摆动。对方越开心，摆得越快。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME senses happiness nearby, its whiskers move rapidly. The more intense the joy the person feels, the faster they move.

entry: POKENAME平时住地下深处，也会到地表觅食。爬行时改变体色、压扁身体，躲避捕食者。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME normally live deep underground, but will travel along the surface to find food. They change the color of their bodies and flatten themselves as they crawl to hide from predators.

entry: 它在林地之下挖洞，耐心等地表震动。POKENAME靠震动强弱，判断来源的体形是否小到能当猎物。
author: craigprime
source: It burrows underneath forest floors, patiently waiting to feel vibrations up on the surface. The strength of the vibration helps POKENAME determine if the source is small enough to consider as prey.

entry: POKENAME住在墓穴，身体部分嵌在墙里。它完全失明，依靠其他感官感知世界。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are found in tombs where they remain partially embedded in the walls. They are completely blind and rely on other senses to navigate the world.

entry: POKENAME感到不敬，须就泛金光，再用制裁光砾还击，骄傲离去。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's whiskers glow gold when it senses irreverence. It retaliates with Judgment before proudly walking away.

entry: POKENAME用前钳从土里吸取养分，钳子一入土，便伸出细根。取得的能量，用来喂养头上共生的植物。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME siphon nutrients from the ground with their front claws, tiny roots extending from them once in the soil. They use the energy they gain to feed the symbiotic plant growing from their heads.

entry: POKENAME爬得快，受惊就奔上树顶，再抓坚果等物品点燃，扔向让自己逃跑的对象。
author: sk372
source: A fast climber, POKENAME scurries up to the treetops when frightened. From there, it grabs nuts and other objects to ignite and throw at whatever it was that sent it fleeing.

entry: POKENAME在松土里翻找种子、坚果吃。它贪吃又护食，进食时见什么靠近，就吐泡泡和吃剩一半的种子。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME roots around loose soil to dig up seeds and nuts on the ground to eat. It is very greedy and defensive when eating, spitting bubbles and half-eaten seeds at anything it sees coming near while it feeds.

entry: POKENAME将自己像剑入鞘般插在树根旁，吸收养分，等待进化。唯有自卫时，才会再度出鞘。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME sheaths into the ground next to the roots of a tree, absorbing its nutrients to evolve. It only unsheathes to defend itself.

entry: POKENAME用臂刃，从地下切断牛至根。它比起其他香草，更爱这种味道，常在牛至丛附近挖洞。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses the blades on its arms to cut apart oregano roots from below the surface of the ground. It prefers the flavor of this herb over all others, often making burrows near patches of the plant.

entry: POKENAME边钻地，边伸触须穿过土壤，寻找块茎，最爱土豆。因此身体散发带泥土气息的土豆香，让附近的对象安心。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME burrow through the ground while extending their feelers through the soil to locate tubers, potatoes being their favorites. Because of this, they release an earthy potato scent from their bodies that soothes those around them.

entry: POKENAME大半生待在地下。到了春天，尾上的球状菌体长得太大，地道容不下，就会脱落。热衷采集的人寻找这些珍品，可单独烹饪，也可配菜。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME spends much of its life below ground, until the spring, when the bulbs on its tail grow too large for tunnels and it loses them. Avid foragers hunt for these fungal bulbs as a rare treat, either cooked alone or as a meal topping.

entry: POKENAME在垃圾填埋场深挖洞，藏在无光处。它讨厌阳光，只有入夜才出来吃东西，寻找新的闹鬼之处。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME makes deep burrows in landfills, staying hidden from the light. It hates sunlight and only emerges after night falls to feed and scout for new areas to haunt.

entry: 据说POKENAME在树下钻洞，那棵树就能免于被野火烧毁。因此，火灾高风险地区有人请它到屋底挖洞。
author: banzai.exe
source: A tree that a POKENAME burrows under is said to be protected from burning down during wildfires. As a result, some people in fire-risk areas invite POKENAME to burrow underneath their homes.

entry: POKENAME钻到海底之下，吃水生植物的根。它尽量待在地下，躲避电灯怪等捕食者。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME burrows under the seafloor to eat the roots of aquatic plants. It stays underground as much as possible to hide from predators like Lanturn.

entry: POKENAME偷附近城镇的钥匙，藏在洞里当战利品。它偏爱铁钥匙，都会添进收藏。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME steals keys from nearby towns and keeps them in its burrow as a trophy. It prefers keys made of iron which are later added to its collection.

entry: POKENAME在地下钻上数十年，吃根和小型虫类宝可梦。准备进化时，它等到夜晚，与数百至数千同伴一同破土而出。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME spends decades burrowing underground, eating roots and smaller bug Pokémon. When it's ready to evolve, it waits until nightfall to emerge from the ground with its brethren, ranging from a few hundred to thousands of individuals.

entry: POKENAME用翅膀摩擦身体，发出极响的鸣叫。整群烦躁时，合鸣甚至大到能震碎玻璃。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME produces an incredibly loud chirping noise by rubbing its wings against its body. Should a swarm become agitated, their combined chirping can grow loud enough to shatter glass.

entry: POKENAME虽在地下出生，幼年很快就学会灵巧跃过森林家园的树木。无论实力差距多大，遇到散发邪气的对象，它都会试图伏击。
author: craigprime
source: Although born underground, young POKENAME soon learn to deftly leap between the trees of their home forest. Regardless of the difference in strength, it will attempt to ambush anyone with an evil aura.

entry: POKENAME在树根筑巢，一生大多在睡觉、进食之余挖巢。它用须状触角探食，尤其偏爱蘑菇。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME make their nests at the roots of trees, though they spend most of their lives digging out their nests in between sleeping and eating. They use their whisker-like antennae to probe for food; notably, they have a preference for mushrooms.

entry: 它是害羞的植食宝可梦，夜里最常见，只会在睡前洗澡。
author: bobosmith01
source: It is a shy herbivorous Pokémon that is most often found at night. It only bathes right before it goes to sleep.

entry: 它是害羞的植食宝可梦，夜里最常见，只会在睡前洗澡。
author: bobosmith01
source: It is a shy herbivorous Pokémon that is most often found at night. It only bathes right before it goes to sleep.

entry: POKENAME偏爱绣球花根，会用电力保卫食物。精力旺盛的性情，让它护食格外凶。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME prefers to eat hydrangea roots and will use its electrical powers to defend its food. Its energetic nature makes it fiercely protective of its meals.

entry: POKENAME的歌声，回荡在漫长地道里。听见的对象，可能睡着，或在地下通道中迷失方向。
author: .izik
source: Echoes of POKENAME's song can be heard throughout its lengthy tunnels. If one hears it, one could fall asleep or become disoriented in the underground passages.

entry: POKENAME慢慢走过地面，拨土找养分，完全不理潜在危险。甲壳太沉太坚固，天然栖息地里，没有谁强到能捕食它。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME plods along the ground, prodding at the dirt for nutrients and oblivious to potential dangers. This is due to its carapace being so heavy and sturdy that nothing in its natural habitat is strong enough to prey on it.

entry: 冬季到来，POKENAME挖洞冬眠，至少5个月后才重新见到阳光。个头虽小，双颚却强得连铁都能咬断。
author: fiordaliso
source: When winter arrives, POKENAME digs a hole and remains in hibernation for at least five months before emerging again into the sunlight. Despite its small size, its jaws are strong enough to break even iron.

entry: 它们拍翅的声音独特又响，让许多生物不得不捂耳。每隔一个夏季，就成群出巢捕猎、采集。
author: bobosmith01
source: The beating of their wings makes a very distinct and loud noise that forces many beings to cover their ears. They emerge from their nest en masse every other summer to hunt and gather.

entry: POKENAME吃罗勒根后，齿轮会开心地高速旋转。比起其他香草，它最爱这种味道，总想找来这难得的美食。
author: .izik
source: After eating basil roots, POKENAME's gears will rotate rapidly in happiness. It prefers that herb's flavor above all others, making it a rare and sought-after delicacy for the creature.

entry: POKENAME尾上的绿焰，照亮地下洞穴。周围泥土虽冷，火焰却能保暖，让它在阴冷环境存活。
author: .izik
source: The green flame on POKENAME's tail glows brightly within its underground burrow. This flame keeps it warm when surrounded by cold soil, allowing it to survive in dark and chilly environments.

entry: POKENAME每天早晨探出地道，吸收几小时阳光，再回地下睡觉，等待进化。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME peeks out of its tunnels each morning to absorb sunlight for a few hours. It then returns underground to sleep while waiting to evolve.

entry: POKENAME夜里升出地道，浮在入口外，寻找高树。白天再朝那些地方挖，吃作为主要食物的树根。
author: .izik
source: After night falls, POKENAME ascends from its tunnel and floats just outside the entrance, looking for tall trees. During the daytime, it digs towards these areas to eat the roots, its primary food source.

entry: POKENAME夜里离洞，漂过森林。它发出孩子笑声混着风铃般的怪声，令人不安，吓退闯入者。
author: .izik
source: At night, POKENAME emerges from its burrow to float through forests. It makes an unsettling noise- like a child's laughter mixed with windchimes- to scare away intruders.

entry: POKENAME用超能力移土挖掘，将泥石整齐压实，避免塌方，造出稳定、结构良好的地下家园。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its psychic powers to move dirt when digging. It neatly packs any mud or stone to ensure the tunnels do not cave in, creating stable and well-structured homes underground.

entry: POKENAME夜里离开地道，漂过草地，巡视周围，决定下一处挖哪，不停寻找新的定居处。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME emerges from its tunnels at night to float through meadows. During this time, it surveys the area to decide where to tunnel next, constantly searching for a new place to settle.

entry: POKENAME完全失明，靠触角高速震动感知周围。它对阳光极敏感，因此只在夜里外出。
author: bacondlx
source: POKENAME is entirely blind, and vibrates its antennae at high speeds to perceive its surroundings. Due to its extreme sensitivity to sunlight, it only goes out in the open during the nighttime.

entry: POKENAME吃洋甘菊根后，身体电荷会增强到平时的3倍。科学家仍在探索这奇怪反应的原因。
author: .izik
source: After eating the roots of chamomile, POKENAME's body's electrical charge strengthens to three times its normal amount. Scientists are still discovering the reason behind this peculiar reaction.

entry: 它大部分时间在洞里寻找矿床。找到大矿床，就尽量吸收养分，等待进化期间便靠这些维生。
author: bacondlx
source: Much of its time is spent searching for mineral deposits in caves. Once it finds a large one, it absorbs as many nutrients as it can. These sustain it while it waits to evolve.

entry: POKENAME的须又硬又尖，折断也会再生。新的长回前，它会把断须当小匕首用。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's whiskers are stiff and pointed. They regrow if snapped off, and POKENAME will use the dislodged whiskers like miniature daggers until new ones grow back.

entry: POKENAME与同群挖长地道，用羽毛铺巢室。即使最冷的冬天，羽毛也能让卵保持温暖。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME digs long tunnels with their flock and lines the nesting chambers with feathers. These feathers keep their eggs remarkably warm even through the coldest winters.

entry: POKENAME找到宝石后，会与同群钻进地下深处，仔细将每种宝石分放在不同地道。
author: .izik
source: After finding gems, POKENAME burrows deep underground with others of its swarm. It meticulously organizes each gem type into a different tunnel.

entry: POKENAME用黏稠、带薰衣草香的酸性黏液，帮助钻过岩地。体力最多能支撑它挖200英尺。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses an acidic, sticky lavender-scented mucus to assist in burrowing through rocky terrain. It can dig up to 200 feet before growing tired.

entry: POKENAME吃有毒植物的根，体内毒囊便会充盈。毒性增强，自卫能力也提高，让捕食者更难对付它。
author: .izik
source: As POKENAME eats the roots of poisonous plant life, the venom sacs in its body fill. This increase in toxicity boosts its ability to defend itself against predators, making it even more dangerous.

entry: POKENAME吃松树根后，头上叶子会格外油亮。叶片产生的油能治疗晕船，因此它在医疗上很有价值。
author: .izik
source: The leaves on POKENAME's head become extremely glossy after eating the roots of pine trees. The oils they produce are used for treating seasickness, making this Pokémon valuable in medicinal practices.

entry: POKENAME在树桩筑巢时，吸收根里残留的水分，树桩会变脆。随后它离去找新家，维持安全的领地，为下一次歇息作准备。
author: .izik
source: While nesting in a tree stump, POKENAME absorbs the remaining moisture in the roots. This leaves the stump brittle before it leaves to find a new home, ensuring its territory is always secure and ready for its next resting place.

entry: POKENAME找到可居住的沼泽，腿上就会长根，与当地其他植物连通。它靠根感知周围震动，弥补视力不佳。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's roots will grow out of its legs when it finds a swamp to live in. These roots connect with other plant life in the area, allowing it to sense the surrounding environment via vibrations, compensating for its poor eyesight.

entry: POKENAME翅膀边缘锋利，用来切东西，而非飞行。它们成群进食，轮流喝树液，也留心聆听危险。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have a sharp edge to their wings, using them as cutting tools rather than for flight. They swarm together while feeding, taking turns to eat plant sap whilst listening out for danger.

entry: 若穿山鼠入侵地道，POKENAME就使出劈瓦，再把昏迷的闯入者滚出洞，继续挖掘。
author: .izik
source: Should a Sandshrew invade its tunnels, POKENAME will attack with a Brick Break. It then rolls the unconscious invader out of the tunnel and continues digging.

entry: POKENAME用须寻找最适合种蘑菇的土。找到后，就挖长地道，在地面、墙壁和顶上播满孢子。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its whiskers to detect the best soil types for growing mushrooms. Once it finds a suitable spot, it digs a lengthy tunnel and spreads its spores across the floor, walls, and ceiling.

entry: POKENAME住在漆黑洞穴，几乎失明。它用触须感知周围，再埋进土中，吸收水分和养分。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME lives in completely dark caves, leading it to be almost blind. It uses its feelers to sense its surroundings and buries itself into the ground to absorb moisture and nutrients from the soil.

entry: POKENAME的毛覆着白粉，会让人呼吸困难、瘙痒不止。这种粉常用于制造某些战斗用能力强化剂。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's fur is covered in a white powder that causes breathing difficulties and uncontrollable itching. This powder is often used in the production of certain X supplements.

entry: POKENAME在地下聚成团，乍看像南瓜。冬季会挤得更紧，分享热量，在寒季保持暖和。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME lives in clusters beneath the ground, resembling pumpkins at a glance. During winter months, their clusters become tighter as they share warmth, ensuring they remain cozy in the cold season.

entry: POKENAME钻到南瓜田下吃根。它在这诡异的环境生活得很好，借地下洞穴，大吃藏在土中的营养根须。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME digs under pumpkin patches to eat the roots. It thrives in these eerie environments, using its underground burrows to feast on the nourishing roots hidden beneath.

entry: POKENAME出名地胆小，一有风吹草动就钻地逃走，因此野外极难遇见。它通常一生都在地下，挖出复杂地道。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is very hard to encounter in the wild, as it is notoriously skittish, digging away at the first sign of trouble. It usually remains underground for all of its life, digging complex tunnels through dirt.

entry: POKENAME从浪中跃出，像钻头般旋转，钻进海滩沙下。够深后，它会鸣叫一阵，再睡着。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME leaps from ocean waves and spins in a drill-like fashion to burrow beneath the beach sand. Once deep enough, it emits a chirping noise for a period before falling asleep.

entry: POKENAME用硬须翻土，寻找块茎和根。找到食物，翅膀便兴奋地大声嗡鸣，通知附近同类有饭吃。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME use their stiff whiskers to root through dirt in search for tubers and roots. Their wings buzz loudly with excitement when they find food, alerting nearby POKENAME that there's an available meal.

entry: POKENAME头痛加剧，就会加速钻地。不知为何，这番体力活动能安抚它，暂时缓解脑中剧痛。
author: .izik
source: When its headache worsens, POKENAME will dig underground at an accelerated speed. This physical exertion soothes it somehow, providing a temporary relief to its pounding mind.

entry: POKENAME鼻边的触须能感知树木健康，判断哪棵果实最美味。触须被拉扯，它就会暴怒。
author: sk372
source: The feelers bordering POKENAME's nose let it sense the health of trees to determine which are growing the tastiest fruits. It flies into a rage if its feelers are tugged on.

entry: POKENAME受威胁会紧紧蜷成球，用厚毛保护软腹。随后猛然弹出，火星在身体周围闪动，打敌人个措手不及。
author: msdawgs
source: POKENAME curls its body into a tight ball when threatened, protecting its soft underside with its thick fur. Embers flicker from its body as it suddenly springs forward, catching foes off guard.

entry: POKENAME藏在树间，用大钳抓牢枝条。被打扰后，就展翅释放强烈热浪，趁敌人没反应过来，迅速逃离。
author: msdawgs
source: POKENAME hides among trees, using its large claws to cling tightly to branches. When disturbed, it spreads its wings and releases a powerful burst of heat, quickly darting away before its foe can react.

entry: POKENAME喜欢埋进泥里，既保护自己，也防止过热。突然从泥水洼冒出、意外吓到孩子的事件，已不止一次。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME prefers to bury itself in mud for protection and to keep itself from overheating. There has been more than one case of it accidentally scaring children when it suddenly pops out from muddy puddles.

entry: POKENAME喜欢埋进泥里，既保护自己，也防止过热。突然从泥水洼冒出、意外吓到孩子的事件，已不止一次。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME prefers to bury itself in mud for protection and to keep itself from overheating. There has been more than one case of it accidentally scaring children when it suddenly pops out from muddy puddles.

entry: POKENAME大半生在地下与世隔绝，吸收渗入土地的矿物和水维生。它因此完全失明，靠超能力看见周围。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME lives most of its life underground in total seclusion, relying on absorbing minerals and water that drain into the earth as sustenance. It is entirely blind as a result, and uses psychic powers to see.

entry: POKENAME是忍术大师，独居森林，每天训练、学习。穿戴的叶子能伪装，让它更有效地伏击试图破坏家园的闯入者。
author: partypooperrex
source: POKENAME is a master of ninjutsu, living solitarily in forests as it trains and studies daily. The leaves POKENAME wear help camouflage it and make ambush strikes more efficient on intruders trying to destroy its home.

entry: POKENAME钻到发电厂下，睡在地下电线旁，偷取能量。耗电极少，可数年不被察觉，让它悄悄维生。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME burrows under power plants, sleeping near buried wires to siphon energy. The draw of power it takes is very minuscule and can go unnoticed for years, allowing it to sustain itself without detection.

entry: POKENAME用棍子翻土，寻找富含养分的土壤。挖掘也会松土，帮助住处周围的植物生长。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses its stick to dig up dirt to find good patches of soil from which to gain nutrients. Its digging efforts stir the soil enough to assist in plant growth around its home areas.

entry: POKENAME在山中挖巨大地道，寻找厚密的根丛吃。强壮身体适合挖掘，能在地下开出庞大网络觅食。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME digs massive tunnels in mountains to find thick root clusters that it can eat. Its powerful body is built for excavation, allowing it to create vast networks underground in search of food.

entry: POKENAME用强藤将树连根拔起，再用这些树木筑大坝，以泥将其黏合。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its strong vines to tear trees from the ground. It then uses these to construct large dams, binding them together with mud.

entry: POKENAME懒洋洋地随潮漂浮，每道涟漪都让它轻轻旋转。它嚼碎浮木和漂浮物，再留给鱼当藏身处。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME floats lazily with the tides, spinning gently to every ripple. It chews through driftwood and flotsam, breaking it down and then letting fish use the remnants for shelter.

entry: POKENAME在流水中筑好坝，便开始表演哑剧，仿佛大雨倾盆。几分钟内往往真会下雨，它也就能确认，水坝撑得住湍流。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Once POKENAME has constructed a dam in flowing water, it starts to mime as if it were pouring with rain. Within a few minutes, rain often comes, and POKENAME can ensure that its dam will survive fast-flowing water.

entry: POKENAME勤奋到近乎痴迷，每天最多工作18小时，筑最壮观的水坝。整群筑完后，最多等一周，就拆掉重建。
author: laughing_dan
source: POKENAME are obsessively hard workers, working up to 18 hours per day building the most spectacular of dams. Once a colony of POKENAME are done with a dam, they will wait at most one week before tearing it down and rebuilding it.

entry: POKENAME静待河边洞穴，外壳逐渐变硬。时机成熟，就以惊人速度冲出，保卫领地。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME remains motionless in its riverside burrow, its outer shell hardening over time. When the moment is right, it bursts forth with surprising speed to defend its territory.

entry: POKENAME救起落水者后，会将人裹进保温的毛，防止失温。送回家前，还会安置在自己造的巢里，确保充分休息。
author: soup1900
source: When POKENAME rescues drowning people, it keeps them snug inside its heat-retaining fur to prevent them from developing hypothermia. Before returning these people home, it makes sure they are well rested by housing them in nests it has built.

entry: POKENAME太爱筑坝，总留一部分力量，帮助其他筑坝宝可梦建造这些天然结构。它的生活虽记载详尽，却很少有人亲眼见过。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME love to create dams so much that they always reserve a fraction of their power to help other dam-making Pokémon create these natural structures. Despite their lives being well-documented, few ever see them in person.

entry: POKENAME用超能力搬动巨木，能筑出堪称传奇的水坝。河流若突然改道，有人便说，是它在恶作剧。
author: pastapockets
source: POKENAME can construct legendary dams by using its psychic abilities to move massive logs. When a river suddenly changes course, some say the POKENAME are playing tricks.

entry: POKENAME啃树，点起可控的小火，逼出藏着的虫属性宝可梦吃。凭熟练的控水本领，它能轻松灭火。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME gnaw on trees and create small controlled fires to draw out hidden Bug-type Pokémon for consumption. They easily extinguish the flames with their mastery over water.

entry: POKENAME用门牙咬开哈密果，吃里面的果肉。进食时轮流警戒，免得被捕食者突袭。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME break open Hondew Berries with their front teeth to eat the fleshy fruit on the inside. They take turns standing watch while they eat berries to avoid being surprised by predators.

entry: POKENAME厌恶海浪拍岸的声音。为此，它先用超能力推开浪，再放下巨木，筑成屏障。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME despise the sound of the waves crashing upon the shore. To combat this, POKENAME use their psychic abilities to push the waves back before placing large logs to form barriers.

entry: POKENAME凭强牙，几秒便能咬倒雪松。双颚也能轻松抬起树干，拿来筑坝。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME can chop down cedar trees in seconds with its strong teeth. It lifts these trunks easily with its jaw and uses them to build dams.

entry: POKENAME用臂上的金属锯，几秒就能放倒树。巡护员靠它清除危险或患病植物，维护大片林区安全。
author: fiordaliso
source: With the metal saws on its arms, POKENAME can topple trees in seconds. Rangers rely on it to remove dangerous or diseased plants, ensuring the safety of vast forested zones.

entry: POKENAME用角剥树皮，寻找树液。吃完后，再削倒那棵树，收集来造住处。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses its horn to peel bark off trees in search of sap. Once it's finished eating, it carves the tree down to gather and use in creating a shelter for itself.

entry: POKENAME勤快地在壳里煮液体，给其他宝可梦做吃的。最常煮树皮根须汤，为其他大尾狸补充精力、提高工作效率。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME industriously helps provide food for other Pokémon by boiling liquids inside its shell. It most commonly makes bark and root stew to energize other Bibarel and increase their work productivity.

entry: POKENAME在礁间用珊瑚和碎屑筑屋，成为小型海洋宝可梦的避难所。它能完全改变身上各条环纹的颜色，用来迷惑捕食者，而非躲藏。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME constructs coral and detritus lodges in reefs that become havens for small marine Pokémon. It can completely change the color of each band on its body, confusing predators rather than hiding from them.

entry: POKENAME骨骼轻，能从所住河流跃出20多米。它背着幼崽，向上游滑翔，寻找更清澈的水域筑坝。
author: ambrosia04
source: Thanks to their lightweight bones, POKENAME can leap more than 20 meters out of the rivers they inhabit. They carry their young on their backs while gliding upstream, searching for clearer waters to build their dams.

entry: 有POKENAME的地区，电线杆必须用金属造。木杆常被它们咬倒，因为它们想够到电线。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Areas with POKENAME populations have to construct their power poles out of metal. Wooden power poles are often chewed down by POKENAME as they try to get to the electrical wires.

entry: POKENAME一见水里漂着木头，就容易分神。它能在浮木上开心地蹦好几个小时，什么也不想。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is easily sidetracked when it comes across any piece of wood floating in the water. It can spend hours happily and mindlessly bouncing about on the wooden flotsam.

entry: POKENAME身材结实，手大臂长，篮球队很看重它的防守。但它输不起，若队伍输了，很可能沮丧地啃球场地板。
author: oddwalls
source: Basketball teams value POKENAME as a defender due to its sturdy build, large hands, and long arms. However, it tends to be a sore loser, and if its team suffers defeat, POKENAME is likely to gnaw on the court's floorboards in frustration.

entry: POKENAME用钳子挖石头、削树，沿河流溪水筑坝。再用大尾巴将这些材料与泥块压实在一起。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME use their claws to dig up rocks and chip away at trees so they can build dams along rivers and streams. They use their large tails to help pack these pieces together with clumps of mud.

entry: POKENAME啃树时，会发出尖细哔声，再将这些树干用来筑大坝。
author: .izik
source: While gnawing on trees, POKENAME lets out a high-pitched beeping noise. It uses these logs to construct large dams.

entry: POKENAME不知疲倦地用大石小石筑坝。流过的水几乎被彻底过滤，附近城镇常拿来作饮用水。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME tirelessly work to create dams made of boulders and stones. The water let through these dams is almost completely filtered, often being used by nearby towns as a source of drinking water.

entry: POKENAME面无表情地浮在河床上方，纹丝不动地观察水流，让人不安。谁靠得太近，它就喷一股水，再默默飘走。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME floats expressionlessly over riverbeds, eerily unmoving as it observes the water's flow. If anyone gets too close, it sprays them with a jet of water before silently drifting away.

entry: POKENAME与同类合作筑坝。一些用利牙伐树，另一些同步行动，用钳子举起沉重树干。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME work together with other POKENAME to construct dams. Some of them will fell trees with their sharp teeth, while others will move in unison to lift heavy logs using their claws.

entry: POKENAME身体的木材极耐用，即使砍倒的树砸在身上，也毫发无损。爪子只需轻碰，便能借超能力举起沉重树干。
author: .jerden
source: The wood POKENAME's body is made from is incredibly durable, and it will be undamaged even if a tree it cuts down falls on top of it. It will use its psychic power to lift up heavy tree trunks with only the lightest touch of its claws.

entry: POKENAME木壳里有多个脑，能完成复杂筑坝所需的计算。它主要用木头和土，若有钢筋混凝土，也会用进去。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME has multiple brains inside its wooden shell, enabling it to perform the calculations necessary for sophisticated dam construction. While it mostly works in wood and earth, it will incorporate reinforced concrete if it is available.

entry: POKENAME不知疲倦地建造精巧水坝，用嚼碎的树干加固。它领地意识极强，会用尾巴拍水，警告闯入者。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME works tirelessly to construct elaborate dams, reinforcing them with chewed-up logs. It is highly territorial and will slap the water with its tail to warn intruders.

entry: POKENAME显现在倒树的中空残骸里，将死木移到大牙狸能用来筑坝的地方，再找另一根树干栖身。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME manifests itself within the hollowed remains of fallen trees. It moves the lifeless lumber to where Bidoof can use it for their dams, before finding another tree trunk to inhabit.

entry: POKENAME用尾根产生的刺鼻化学物质标记领地。虽被认为有药效，唯一证实的用途却是香水。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME mark their territory with a pungent chemical produced at the base of their tail. While it is believed that this substance has medicinal properties, the only proven use is in perfume.

entry: 它的强颚一咬，就足以放倒一棵树。它用木土筑坝，造出池塘，再潜水捕猎，用利鳍和平尾推动身体。
author: .jerden
source: One bite from its powerful jaws is enough to fell a tree. It builds dams from wood and earth to create ponds, then dives in to hunt prey, pushing itself through the water using its sharp fins and flat tail.

entry: 成年POKENAME背上会长各种植物，扎根在毛里结住的肥土中。它们不停互相梳理，啃这些植物，防止完全长大。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have various plants that grow upon their backs as adults, rooting themselves in the fertile soil matted into their fur. They groom one another constantly, gnawing at these plants and preventing them from growing fully.

entry: POKENAME大家族合力在森林开空地，啃倒树，用落枝造住所。它们友好，天气恶劣时，愿与其他宝可梦分享。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME work together in large families to create clearings in forests, chewing down trees and using the fallen branches to make shelters for themselves. They are friendly and willing to share their shelters with other Pokémon during poor weather.

entry: POKENAME用泥、木材与自己雕好的石块，在溪流上筑坝。水坝宛如小堡垒，它则像剑入鞘一般，藏身其中。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME builds dams on river streams using mud and the wood and stone it carves. These dams resemble tiny forts, and it sheathes in them.

entry: 野生POKENAME砍倒一棵橡树，只需短短几秒，随后又扑向下一棵。伐木公司梦寐以求，环保人士却视如噩梦。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: Wild POKENAME fell oak tree after oak tree in seconds each. It's a dream for logging companies but a nightmare for environmentalists.

entry: POKENAME的毛格外柔软，水坝常用河中植物做成的彩带装饰。谁帮忙维护家园，它就与谁建立深厚感情。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's fur is unusually soft, and its dam is often decorated with colorful ribbons made from river plants. It forms strong emotional bonds with those who help maintain its home.

entry: POKENAME从高空俯察世界河流，只有审判天然水坝时才降下。判为“不合格”的坝，立刻就会被背上斧刃劈开。
author: guacamole_dog
source: POKENAME oversees the rivers of the world from far above, only descending to enact judgment on natural dams. Ones deemed "unfit" are instantly cleaved apart by the axe heads on its back.

entry: POKENAME炮管射出的树枝种类，取决于最近吃了哪种树。几乎任何木头，它都能开心啃上好几个小时。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME fires twigs from its cannon based on whatever type of tree it has most recently consumed. It will happily gnaw on just about any wood for hours.

entry: 木质外壳下，藏着POKENAME由黑暗构成的身体。它会从阴影中狩猎，将猎物囚在体内，再转移到新的出没处。
author: spartan_ct
source: POKENAME's wooden exterior conceals a body made of darkness. It has been known to hunt prey from the shadows and imprison them inside of itself before moving to a new haunt.

entry: 人们的记忆中，救灾队历来都有POKENAME协助。它用力量连根拔树，摆成天然堤防。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Disaster relief teams have regularly had POKENAME on their teams for as long as anyone can remember. Using their strength, POKENAME uproot trees so they can place them as natural levees.

entry: POKENAME的巢铺着防火羽毛，防止住所烧毁。尾巴拍水，还能让巢边的水沸腾。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's nest is lined with fireproof feathers, preventing its lodge from burning. It can boil the water near its nest by slapping the surface with its tail.

entry: POKENAME偷来露营孩子的玩具，拦溪筑坝，建造巢穴。孩子们说看到了它，大人却常只当是看见了大尾狸。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME makes its nest by damming a stream with toys it steals from camping children. Sightings by children are often dismissed as Bibarel sightings.

entry: POKENAME用水坝造出广阔内陆湖，不知满足地啃树筑家。造的坝远多于需要，废弃的旧坝则成为其他宝可梦的家。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME create vast inland lakes with their dams, insatiably gnawing through trees to build their homes. They build far more dams than they need, and the abandoned older dams form homes for other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME野生或由训练家饲养，行为差异极大。野外，它是尽责的工人，几乎每个清醒时刻，都在为族群运送木材。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's behavior differs dramatically depending on whether it is living in the wild or under the care of a Pokémon Trainer. In the wild, POKENAME is a dutiful worker that delivers lumber to its colony during almost every single waking hour.

entry: POKENAME野生或由训练家饲养，行为差异极大。驯养后，它性格傻乎乎，找到什么就啃什么。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's behavior differs dramatically depending on whether it is living in the wild or under the care of a Pokémon Trainer. When domesticated, POKENAME has a goofy personality and chews on whatever it finds.

entry: POKENAME潜水时，毛上静电噼啪作响，将电流送进河里。它借此击晕蚊香蝌蚪等猎物，再轻松捞起。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's fur crackles with static when it dives into water, sending electric currents through the river. It uses this ability to stun prey like Poliwag before scooping them up with ease.

entry: POKENAME飞行时啃断树枝，让枝条掉下，再用来为同群建造巨大巢屋。
author: .izik
source: While flying, POKENAME gnaws on tree limbs to cause them to fall. It uses these to build massive lodges for its flock.

entry: POKENAME在洞穴安家，用岩石使洞内河道改向，筑成水坝。坝里流出的水富含盐，周围很适合建洞穴度假村或水疗设施。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME make their homes in caves, using rocks to divert river caverns to create dams. The water that comes from these dams is rich in salt, making the waters around these dams ideal for creating cavernous resorts or spas.

entry: POKENAME用锋利门齿啃食硅化木。吃进去的矿物会结晶，逐渐长到身体表面。
author: apixelperfectionist
source: POKENAME uses its sharp incisors to gnaw on petrified wood. Substances in the eaten rocks crystallize and rise up to the Pokémon's body surface.

entry: POKENAME被激怒，会尽量将手中小树枝扔远。但那只是分散注意，随后它就冲向敌人，使出强力头撞。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: When provoked, POKENAME will throw the twig it carries as far as it can. However, this is only a distraction, as POKENAME will then charge at its foe and unleash a powerful headbutt.

entry: POKENAME试着恢复受污染的土地，筑坝拦污水，防止继续流向下游。当地环境修复队近来开始与它合作，清理数十年疏于照管留下的污染。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME try to reclaim polluted land, damming polluted water to stop it spreading further downstream. Local environmental remediation teams have recently started working with POKENAME to clean up decades of neglect.

entry: 船只经过POKENAME的领地十分危险。它完全无视其他生物，却仿佛忍不住追逐船等人造物，用大牙啃碎。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is considered highly dangerous to ships passing through its territory. It ignores other creatures entirely, but seems compelled to go after man-made creations like boats and gnawing them apart with its large teeth.

entry: POKENAME木甲被毁后，会找到树，在不到1分钟内掏空，做出新甲。
author: hophoppip
source: If POKENAME's wooden carapace is destroyed, it finds a tree and hollows it out in under a minute to create a new one.

entry: 流水声让它心烦，见到溪流就想筑坝拦住。因为能飞，它甚至会试着往云里塞泥和树干。
author: bandedbodypress
source: It is upset by the sound of running water, and will attempt to dam up any streams it sees. Because it can fly, it will also attempt to shove mud and logs into clouds.

entry: POKENAME食木胃口极大，常整群把森林啃出空地。背上生命力顽强的真菌会吸收食物中的木质素，用来生长。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME has a voracious appetite for wood, often resulting in large colonies creating clearings and glades in forests due to their diet. The hardy fungi on their back absorbs the lignin from the food POKENAME eats and uses it to grow.

entry: POKENAME被真菌完全控制，身体重塑为木质结构，方便真菌长出新子实体。寄生也驱使它尽可能多吃木头。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME is infested with a fungus that has completely overtaken its body, reforming it into a wood-like structure from which it can comfortably grow new fruiting bodies. This parasitism drives POKENAME to feed on as much wood as it can.

entry: POKENAME太自傲，不会盲从，只听与自己亲近、平等相待的训练家的话。野外过夜时，它会造简易住所，为自己和训练家遮风避雨。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME are too proud to follow commands blindly, only listening to Trainers who bond with them and treat them as equals. When sleeping outdoors, they build simple shelters to shield themselves and their Trainer from the elements.

entry: POKENAME锯木的效率胜过所有人类，甚至一些机器，常受雇于伐木工和木匠。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME can saw through wood more efficiently than any human and even some machines. It's often employed by woodcutters and carpenters.

entry: POKENAME用找来的材料加固水坝，层层堆石和碎屑，巩固家园。受威胁时，它用头撞闯入者，力道足以撞进水中。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME reinforces its dam with scavenged materials, layering stones and debris to fortify its home. If threatened, it headbutts intruders with enough force to knock them into the water.

entry: POKENAME从附近池塘采睡莲叶，装饰巢屋。牙齿比钻石还硬，轻松破石，是建新结构时的强大工具。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME decorates its lodge with lillipads that it gathers from nearby ponds. POKENAME's teeth are harder than diamond and can break stone with ease, serving as a formiddle tool for when it builds a new structure.

entry: POKENAME常在木头里挖来挖去，对住木屋的人而言，可能是大麻烦。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME are often found digging through pieces of wood. They can be a great pest to anyone living in a wooden house.

entry: POKENAME在污水中活得很好，边游边净化周围。它会用利牙在河岸刻心形图案。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME thrives in polluted waters, purifying its surroundings as it swims. It carves heart-shaped patterns into the riverbanks using its sharp teeth.

entry: POKENAME生气或难过，会先往身上泼水平静，免得情绪发展成头痛。它专注筑坝，好在冬天有地方冬眠。
author: quackquackattack
source: When POKENAME feel angry or upset, they splash themselves with water to calm themselves down before they spiral into a headache. They focus on building dams so that they have a place to hibernate in winter.

entry: POKENAME用强臂扯倒树木筑坝，似乎很喜欢在形成的湖里，彼此比赛游泳。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME create dams by tearing down trees with their powerful arms. They seem to enjoy racing one another in swimming contests in the resulting lakes.

entry: POKENAME用强臂扯倒树木筑坝，似乎很喜欢在形成的湖里，彼此比赛游泳。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME create dams by tearing down trees with their powerful arms. They seem to enjoy racing one another in swimming contests in the resulting lakes.

entry: POKENAME用牙雕木勺，作为精神力量的焦点。但通常只有银勺能有效聚集精神力量，因此木勺究竟是否有用，仍不清楚。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME carves a wooden spoon with its teeth to use as a focus for its psychic power. It's unknown if the spoon actually does anything, as silver spoons are normally the only effective type for psychic focusing.

entry: 它对森林及其中万物，了解得非同寻常。POKENAME力气极大，单手便能搬起十根大原木。
author: thefinalkalgonus
source: It has extraordinary knowledge of the forest and the things found in it. POKENAME has such strength that it can carry ten big tree logs in one hand.

entry: 它通常是伐木工人的帮手。POKENAME肌力惊人，能搭建水坝、道馆等大型木造建筑。
author: thefinalkalgonus
source: This fusion is usually a lumberjack's helper. Huge muscle strength allows POKENAME build large wooden structures such as dams and gyms.

entry: POKENAME的水坝涂满甜香黏树液，吸引毽子草等猎物。它藏在家中，突然使出藤鞭，攻击一切靠得太近的对象。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's dam is coated in a sticky, sweet-smelling sap that attracts prey like Hoppip. It hides inside its home, striking at anything that comes too close with a sudden Vine Whip.

entry: POKENAME跑得快，头脑却简单，容易分神。疾驰时常因有什么吸引目光而改道，转得太突然就会绊倒、翻滚。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can run at high speeds, but its mind is simple and easily distracted. It will often change course mid-sprint as something catches its eye, to the point it will stumble and topple over if it switches direction too abruptly.

entry: POKENAME想做完美短棍，就将树干在岩石上像搓衣板般磨擦，削到合适大小。成形后，还会重复这工序，做备用短棍。
author: quackquackattack
source: To shape a piece of lumber into the perfect baton, POKENAME scrape a log against rocks like a washboard until it is whittled to the right size. Once properly formed, POKENAME will perform repeat this process to produce spare batons.

entry: POKENAME把头缩进木壳，抵御攻击。铠甲若损坏到无法修复，它就用牙将附近树木雕成替代品。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME protects its head from attacks by withdrawing into its wooden shell. If this armor is damaged beyond repair, POKENAME will use its teeth to carve a nearby tree into a replacement.

entry: POKENAME主要由不自然的刺激性气体构成，连实体都能直接穿过。虽然大部分能量并非来自有机物，研究却显示，它常想着树果和木头。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is mostly composed of an unnatural irritant gas that can slide right through even solid objects. Although it does not get most of its energy from organic material, studies show it thinks about Berries and wood quite a lot.

entry: POKENAME戴头骨遮脸，想隐藏情绪，却掩不住不断散发的波导，附近谁都能感到它的悲伤。
author: craigprime
source: In an attempt to hide its emotions, POKENAME wears a skull to obscure its face. This does nothing to mask the aura it constantly emanates, and everyone nearby can feel its sorrow.

entry: POKENAME将波导注入强力踢击，一下就能粉碎钢梁。它保护比自己弱的宝可梦，只有情况危急才动用波导。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME channels its aura into powerful kicks, able to pulverize a steel beam in a single strike. It protects Pokémon weaker than itself, only using its aura in dire situations.

entry: POKENAME每天练拳，把双手锻炼得坚如钢铁。它将波导注入拳头，用情绪和梦想为拳击供能。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME trains daily with its punches, tempering its hands into steel-tough fists. It channels its aura into its punches, energizing them with its emotions and dreams.

entry: POKENAME用读取波导的能力检查食物。舌头还没舔一口，就能立即认出最美味的一餐。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its aura-reading skills on food. It can instantly identify the most delicious meal before taking a single lick with its tongue.

entry: POKENAME意志坚定到几乎不顾安危，就冲入战斗。受重伤时，角会开始发出明亮蓝光。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME have so much determination that they will charge into battle with little regard for their safety. Their horns will start to glow bright blue when they are badly injured.

entry: POKENAME察觉阴暗波导，就用藤蔓困住敌人，再高声尖叫，示意同伴逃走，自己留下独战。
author: .izik
source: Upon detecting a dark aura, POKENAME traps the foe in vines. It then screeches loudly to signal its allies to flee while it fights alone.

entry: 想抓POKENAME的训练家，靠近水边前必须压住情绪。只要感到一丝兴奋，它就立刻逃走。
author: .realthree
source: Trainers looking to catch a POKENAME must subdue their emotions before approaching the water. If this Pokémon senses any excitement, it will flee immediately.

entry: POKENAME翼上飘出能使对手麻痹的粉末。制住敌人后，它再用精准的真空波结束战斗。
author: .izik
source: Paralyzing powder drifts from POKENAME's wings. After stunning its foe, it finishes the fight with a precise Vacuum Wave.

entry: POKENAME在半空快速旋转，集中能量，积够冲势就能飞掠空中。驯养个体的宝石，会随训练家心情发不同颜色的光。
