author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME focus their energy by rapidly spinning in mid-air until they've built enough momentum to go flying through the air. The gems of domestic POKENAME glow different colors based on their Trainer's mood.

entry: 它不喜欢为运动或友好切磋而战，因此与大多训练家合不来。必须战斗时，就打了便走，迅速斩过敌人，再同样迅速撤离。
author: bobosmith01
source: It dislikes battling for sport or friendly competition, so it doesn't get along with most Trainers. When it must fight, it uses hit-and-run strategies, quickly slicing through foes and just as swiftly getting away.

entry: POKENAME很好胜，常与同类切磋，比谁最强。它将波导注入重击来磨炼力量，一击便能碎石。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are very competitive, often sparring with one another to see who's the strongest. They hone their strength by channeling their aura in powerful strikes that can shatter stone in a single blow.

entry: POKENAME看见恶意波导，角就泛红光。此时毒性翻倍，还会释放可怕的腐臭。
author: .izik
source: If POKENAME sees a malicious aura, its horn glows red. During this state, its venom doubles in potency and releases a terrible rotting stench.

entry: POKENAME大多无法活动，独自在高树上藏好，直到准备进化。白天观察其他宝可梦交战，记住招式，为将来战斗作准备。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are largely immobile and seclude themselves in high trees in order to keep themselves safe until they're ready to evolve. They spend their days observing other Pokémon fighting, memorising their moves in preparation to fight.

entry: POKENAME用波导彼此沟通，行动配合得天衣无缝。它领地意识虽强，仍会分蜂蜜给饥饿的宝可梦。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME use the power of aura to communicate with one another, allowing them to work in perfect sync. While still being quite territorial, POKENAME will actually offer some of their honey to starving Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME好奇，会仔细探查遇到者的波导与心思。若觉得某人的波导特别有趣，可能暗中跟随数日。
author: sk372
source: A curious nature leads POKENAME to deeply examine both the aura and minds of those it comes across. It may trail a person in secret for days if it finds their aura particularly intriguing.

entry: POKENAME感到善意波导，就会放出柔和花香。在温柔训练家附近，最常有这种反应。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME senses a kind aura, it releases a soft floral scent. This reaction is most common when near gentle Trainers.

entry: POKENAME贴地疾驰，速度惊人。靠近训练家并调动波导时，头部和后方排气口会喷出蓝白火焰，随着伙伴的心跳脉动。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME stay low to the ground to sprint at remarkable speeds. When they tap into their aura and are near their Trainer, vents on their head and rear burst with blue and white flames that pulse to the rhythm of their companion's heart.

entry: POKENAME始终高度警戒，能感知其他宝可梦的存在和意图。若察觉敌意，便会成群赶来，驱退威胁。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are always on high alert as they are able to sense the presence of other Pokémon and what their intentions might be. If they detect hostility, flocks of them will show up and chase the threat away.

entry: POKENAME日夜挑战更大的敌人，训练变强，不训练就采树果。每次交战前，总带一颗枝荔果，必要时增强力量。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME train day and night against larger foes to become stronger and gather berries when they are not training. Before fighting against another Pokémon, they always keep a Liechi Berry with them that boosts their strength when needed.

entry: POKENAME每天只需休息2小时，因此大半时间都在巡巢。它能感知同类情绪，谁一遇险，就会赶去帮忙。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME only needs 2 hours of rest a day, so it spends most of the day patrolling its nest. It can sense the feelings of other POKENAME and will rush over to aid them if they are ever in peril.

entry: POKENAME精力几乎无穷，能开开心心地一连玩上数日。以它的个头而言，力量出奇大，轻松就能举起超过500磅。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME have almost boundless amounts of energy and will cheerfully play with each other for days on end. It's surprisingly strong for its size, able to lift over 500 pounds with ease.

entry: POKENAME十分活跃，总想与训练家或野生宝可梦嬉闹对打。可惜壳妨碍行动，常一出手就翻倒。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are quite hyperactive, always wanting to play fight with their Trainer or any wild Pokémon. Unfortunately due to their shell, they often topple over after attempting any strike.

entry: POKENAME轻松感知波导，对别人的情绪很敏感。据说羊毛会随最常接触到的波导情绪，改变颜色。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are sensitive to the feelings of others, as they can sense their very auras with ease. The wool is said to be able to change color based on the emotions of the auras they are most often exposed to.

entry: POKENAME用波导自保，或向周围释放力量，或直接避开感知到的对象。一般纺纱者很难处理它的羊毛，因此只交给技艺娴熟的人。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME protects itself using its aura, projecting power around itself or simply avoiding those it senses. Its wool is rather tough to work with for the average spinner, so it is only entrusted to those who demonstrate proficiency in the craft.

entry: POKENAME将部分波导导入尾部或额上的球体，改变发光颜色。行为研究者推断，不同颜色反映了它当时的心情。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can channel some of its aura into its tail or forehead orb in order to change the color they emit. Behavioral researchers have deduced the different colors reflect whatever POKENAME's mood is at the time.

entry: POKENAME对别人情绪很敏感，头上的花便适应成能释放缓解焦虑的气味。它靠近心绪不堪重负的人，加以安抚，也减轻自己的负担。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME is very sensitive to others' emotions, so the flower on its head has adapted to emit a smell that dampens anxiety. It approaches overwhelmed people to calm them, easing its own burden.

entry: POKENAME翻找垃圾时，用波导察觉靠近的威胁，吱吱叫着轻松逃走。
author: .izik
source: While scavenging trash, POKENAME uses aura to detect approaching threats. It escapes easily while making a squeaking noise.

entry: POKENAME虽会被某些物种捕食，却天生没有恐惧本能。它知道自己被追踪，感到捕食者饥饿便会悲伤；悲伤引来同类，反而吓退捕食者。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME have no natural fear instinct, despite being prey for some species. It senses when it is being tracked and feels sadness when it can sense the predator's hunger. The sadness causes others of its kind to approach it, scaring off the predator.

entry: POKENAME用波导察觉恶意，就会从树枝落下爆炸，牺牲自己，保护同伴。
author: .izik
source: If POKENAME detects malicious intent with its aura reading skills, it drops from tree branches and explodes. It sacrifices itself to protect its kin.

entry: 大灾过后，POKENAME成群赶来，尽可能多救宝可梦。强角能举起大小达自身10倍的物体，让它搬开大块残骸。
author: mistymagius
source: Groups of POKENAME arrive after major disasters, saving as many Pokémon as they can. Their powerful horn can lift objects ten times its size, allowing them to move large pieces of debris.

entry: POKENAME察觉恶意波导，就大声吠叫，提醒同群，让大家有时间准备应对危险。
author: .izik
source: If POKENAME detects a malicious aura, it barks loudly to alert its pack. The warning gives others time to prepare for danger.

entry: POKENAME常被养在家里护卫。它感知周围波导，辨别意图，轻松就能找到、制伏想行窃的对象。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME is commonly kept in houses for protection. It senses the aura of those around it to discern their intentions, so it can easily find and take down any would-be thieves.

entry: POKENAME靠波导感知，在漆黑洞穴滚动，凭精准、本能的动作，灵巧避开障碍。
author: .izik
source: Using its aura sense, POKENAME rolls through pitch-black caves. It deftly avoids obstacles with precise, instinctual movement.

entry: POKENAME扫描附近波导时，鹿角泛蓝宝石色的光。若察觉猎人的意图，就用电光一闪还击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's antlers glow a sapphire blue when scanning nearby auras. If it detects a hunter's intent, it retaliates with a Quick Attack.

entry: POKENAME不断磨炼波导控制，学会新技巧：拳踢之后，还能向近处的敌人射出波导凝成的弹丸。
author: sk372
source: Constantly honing its control over aura powers has given it a new technique: POKENAME can fire short range aura projectiles at its foes following a punch or kick attack.

entry: POKENAME每天练习战斗中持续移动，用波导感知敌人位置，寻找最佳出手时机。激烈训练后，它喜欢吃文柚果恢复能量。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME trains daily at keeping in constant motion during fights, using its Aura to sense the position of the opponent and seeking the best time to strike. After an intense training session, it loves to snack on Sitrus Berries to regain its energy.

entry: POKENAME总为战斗热血沸腾，兴奋时，脸颊产生亮蓝雷电。越接近失去战斗能力，电力越强、越狂暴。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is always pumped up for battle, producing bright blue lightning from its cheeks when excited. Its electrical powers become stronger and wilder the closer it is to fainting.

entry: POKENAME刻苦训练，发展出双尾与拳头配合的独门打法。全力交战时，能见到两条尾端泛着微弱波导光。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME trains hard, developing a personal fighting style that utilizes its tails in tandem with its fists. When it fights at full force, one can see a faint aura glowing around the tips of its two tails.

entry: POKENAME靠波导感知保护弱小宝可梦。危险靠近，就用强力碎岩守护它们。
author: .izik
source: With its aura-sensing ability, POKENAME protects weaker Pokémon. If danger approaches, it defends them with a powerful Rock Smash.

entry: POKENAME用波导寻找最合适的果树。找到满意的，一顿能吃超过100磅食物。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses aura to locate the perfect fruit tree. Once satisfied, it can eat over 100 lbs of food in a single sitting.

entry: POKENAME钩爪锋利得吓人，却偏爱用钝外侧击敌。它感知对手波导，判断强弱，只挑知道能赢的战斗。
author: .realthree
source: Though POKENAME's hooked claws are wickedly sharp, it prefers to use the blunt outsides to strike foes with. Using its perception of aura, POKENAME senses the strength of its opponent so it can choose battles it knows it will win.

entry: POKENAME挖掘时，用波导察觉前方危险，再沿墙摆警示石，标记不安全的地道。
author: .izik
source: While digging, POKENAME uses its aura to sense danger ahead. It marks unsafe tunnels by placing warning stones along the wall.

entry: POKENAME将波导注入火焰踢击，每天练习复杂连招，是武术家的绝佳切磋伙伴。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME imbues its flaming kicks with aura and practices complex combinations of moves every day. It is an excellent sparring partner for martial artists.

entry: 头鳍是感觉器官，至少能察觉方圆1英里内其他对象的波导。它能后腿站立，用前肢调动自身波导，操控附近的水。
author: infinex21
source: The fin upon its head is a sensory organ that can detect the auras of others within at least a one-mile radius. It can stand on its hind legs and harness its own aura with its forelegs; by harnessing its aura, it can manipulate water near itself.

entry: POKENAME双腿跑不快，却精力无穷。追逐的捕食者早已疲惫，它仍能沿泥泞河岸继续慢跑。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME's legs can't carry it very quickly, but it has tireless energy. It can keep jogging through muddy riversides long after the predators chasing it have tired.

entry: POKENAME先藏起来，直到充分读懂别人的情绪波导。只有波导善良温柔的对象，才会被这样温顺的它主动靠近。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME hides away from others until it has properly read their emotional aura. Only those who have a kind and gentle aura will ever be approached by a meek creature like POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME热衷正义、保护人类，几乎每座城市夜里都有它游荡，像超级英雄般行侠，保护大家免遭罪犯和危险。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME are passionate about justice and protecting humans, to the extent that it is not uncommon for every city to have one roaming at night, acting the part of a superhero vigilante protecting them from criminals and danger.

entry: POKENAME能感知并理解他人的情绪。一旦察觉敌意，就会准备从角中释放可怕的毒素。
author: alumed
source: POKENAME are able to sense and understand the emotions of others. If it detects hostility, it will prepare to release a horrible toxin from its horn.

entry: POKENAME能感知别人的波导，长时间接触强烈情绪，甚至会改变体色。它天性谨慎，即使感到善意，也总先观察再行动。
author: infinex21
source: It can sense the auras of others and may even experience shifts in its bodily hues if exposed to powerful emotions for long enough. Cautious by nature, POKENAME always observes others before acting, even if it senses a kind soul.

entry: POKENAME闭眼切磋，将耳朵压贴头部，排除其他感官信息，磨炼波导感知。它便逐渐学会，连极微弱波导也能察觉、反应。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME refine their aura sensing abilities by sparring with their eyes closed and ears flattened against their head, removing all other sensory input. This lets them gradually master the ability to sense and react to even trace amounts of aura.

entry: POKENAME一根感觉角变成巨颚，和另一根角一样，能侦测波导。颚会对新波导起反应，咬向可能有威胁的对象；尽管如此，它本身很友好。
author: infinex21
source: Its giant jaws came to be when one of its sensory horns transformed; like its other horn, these jaws detect auras. Its jaws react to new auras, snapping at those it feels may be a threat; though its jaws react this way, POKENAME is friendly.

entry: POKENAME在崎岖山巅训练，将波导凝成火焰武器，热切挑战当地小拳石，测试力量。受伤时，尾巴裹满炽烈波导，攻击也更凶猛。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME trains among rugged mountain peaks, focusing its aura into fiery weapons. It eagerly challenges local Geodude to test its strength. When wounded, its tail becomes engulfed in a blazing aura as its attacks grow even fiercer.

entry: 大而灵敏的耳朵加上感知波导的能力，让人几乎不可能瞒过POKENAME。稍有危险的迹象，它就会立即攻击。
author: alumed
source: With its large, developed ears and the ability to detect the aura of others, it is nearly impossible to avoid detection by a POKENAME. It will attack at the first sign of danger.

entry: POKENAME将大部分波导注入尾焰，使火烧得更热、更亮。它把尾巴当武器，连续发射波导弹，直到火焰将尽。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME focuses much of its aura into the fire on its tail, causing it to burn hotter and brighter. While holding its tail like a weapon, firing multiple Aura Spheres until the flame is nearly spent.

entry: POKENAME靠感知波导寻找理想猎场。使用能力时，耳朵开始抽动、颤抖。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME rely on their aura sensing capabilities to find ideal locations for hunting. While using their abilities, POKENAME's ears will begin to twitch and shake.

entry: POKENAME在空中挥鳍，感知波导。若察觉低落的波导，就会哭个不停。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME senses auras by waving its fins through the air. Should it detect a depressing aura, it begins to cry uncontrollably.

entry: POKENAME被用来破冰，确保船只通行安全。若察觉训练家苦恼，它就用毛茸茸的身体紧抱对方。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are used to break ice blocks to ensure safe travels for ships. Should they notice their Trainer feeling distressed, they will embrace them tightly in their fur.

entry: 它能感知别人的波导，指向陷入苦恼的对象。它借磁力短促推进，使出的撞击往往强得足以粉碎巨石。
author: infinex21
source: It can sense the auras of others and will point toward those it senses to be in distress. By utilizing its magnetism, it can propel itself in short bursts; its Tackle attacks tend to be strong enough to shatter large rocks.

entry: POKENAME感到其他生物的波导，刀刃就泛奇特蓝光。它通常在从前发生激战的地方出没。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its blade glows with a peculiar blue luminescence when it senses the aura of other creatures. POKENAME usually haunts places where fierce battles were fought in the past.

entry: POKENAME的触须不停移动，感知附近的波导。它似乎天生会被带着低落波导的对象吸引。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's feelers move constantly to sense the auras of those nearby. It appears naturally drawn to those carrying depressing auras.

entry: POKENAME用波导感知寻找被丢弃的玩偶，察觉曾经爱它们的孩子留下的波导。
author: .izik
source: Using aura sensing, POKENAME searches for discarded plushies. It detects the lingering aura of the children who once loved them.

entry: POKENAME用黏网困住波导微弱的对象，反复电击，再拖回巢里。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME traps those with weak auras in sticky webs. It then shocks them repeatedly before dragging them back to its den.

entry: POKENAME含有不稳定、失控的超级能量。有人推测，正因为是两只利欧路融合而成，它才勉强控制得住。它们不停训练、切磋，消耗这些能量。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME contain unstable rogue mega energy, theorised to only be manageable thanks to being a fusion of two Riolu. They burn this energy off by constantly training and sparring with one another.

entry: POKENAME含有不稳定、失控的超级能量。有人推测，正因为是两只利欧路融合而成，它才勉强控制得住。它们不停训练、切磋，消耗这些能量。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME contain unstable rogue mega energy, theorised to only be manageable thanks to being a fusion of two Riolu. They burn this energy off by constantly training and sparring with one another.

entry: POKENAME时而精力无穷，时而几乎完全不动，转换似乎毫无规律。两个极端，让研究者困惑不解。
author: brilliantdarkness
source: POKENAME alternate between periods of tireless energy and periods of near-total stillness, seemingly at random. Researchers are baffled by these two extremes.

entry: POKENAME天生精力旺盛，一感到挑战者的波导，活力更增至3倍。它用磨利的爪子迅速出击。
author: .izik
source: Though naturally energetic, POKENAME's vigor triples when it detects the aura of a challenger. It strikes fast with sharpened claws.

entry: POKENAME好奇地感知周围，寻找友善的人和宝可梦的波导。若察觉谁波导暴烈，就滚过去，不断拍打，直到对方离开。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Curious by nature, POKENAME sense their surroundings to try and find the auras of friendly people and Pokémon. If a POKENAME detects someone with a violent aura, it will roll up and smack them until they go away.

entry: POKENAME感到敌意波导，就猛放电流，震住敌人，争取足够时间逃走。
author: .izik
source: If POKENAME senses a hostile aura, it releases a burst of electricity. This stuns the foe long enough for it to escape.

entry: 强大波导在POKENAME可伸缩的爪中奔涌。只要命中，敌人就会被情绪淹没。
author: .realthree
source: Powerful aura courses through POKENAME's retractable claws. If POKENAME lands a hit, its foes will find themselves overcome by emotion.

entry: 它会主动寻找强大的宝可梦，迅速将其击败。败者多半心怀恶意，因此有人视POKENAME为守护天使。
author: theemeraldflygon
source: It seeks out powerful Pokémon, and swiftly defeats them. These Pokémon are often ill-willed, so some view POKENAME as a guardian angel.

entry: POKENAME大量吃金属，补充体内储存的波导。它只用头撞战斗，撞击时释放积蓄的波导。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME consume large amounts of metal to fuel the aura stored in their body. These Pokémon fight only using headbutts, releasing their built-up aura upon impact.

entry: POKENAME的齿轮四肢，能在各种地形灵活行动。只要足够专注，就能在齿轮周围积蓄波导，增强速度和敏捷。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's gear limbs give it decent mobility across all terrains. If it focuses hard enough, it can charge up aura around the gears and enhance its speed and agility.

entry: POKENAME研究附近人类的波导，模仿他们，再造幻象，悄悄融入拥挤街道。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME studies the aura of nearby humans to copy them. It creates illusions to blend into crowded city streets unnoticed.

entry: POKENAME的波导如热焰般在尾上燃烧。战斗越激烈，光越强，显出它熊熊燃烧的战意。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME's aura burns on its tail like a hot flame. As the duel heats up, the glow intensifies, manifesting its burning desire to fight.

entry: POKENAME察觉可怕波导，就从花苞释放垃圾般恶臭，想尽快赶走来源。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME senses a terrifying aura, it releases a disgusting, garbage-like scent from its bud. This is to drive the source of the aura away as quickly as possible.

entry: POKENAME将花苞对准谁，就能读取其波导。若发现恶意，便接连释放有毒花粉。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME gains the ability to read auras when it points its buds at someone. Should it detect a malevolent aura, it releases bursts of poisonous pollen.

entry: POKENAME散发的波导能表达心情。附近的人感到它的快乐，就会招呼孩子靠近。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME emanates an aura that displays its feelings. When nearby people feel its happiness, they call their children close.

entry: POKENAME短短的小腿，出乎意料地能踢出重击。吸入孢子的对象，也会感到强烈情绪。
author: lydiaprower8
source: Surprisingly enough, POKENAME can deliver powerful kicks from its stubby little legs. Its spores make anyone who breathes them in feel intense emotion.

entry: POKENAME大部分时间寻找强敌交战，战斗越激烈，波导越亮。它主要夜间活动，用充满活力的蓝光照亮周围。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME spend most of their time looking for strong opponents to fight, their aura glowing brighter the more intense the battle. They are mainly active at night, illuminating the area with an energetic blue glow.

entry: POKENAME靠波导，能在最暗洞穴辨路。它非常善良，曾被看见带迷路的徒步者走出山地。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is able to navigate the darkest of caves using its aura. It is a very kind Pokémon as it has been seen leading lost hikers out of the mountains.

entry: 踩到POKENAME，它就会读取波导。若发现你是故意的，就会放出疼痛难忍的电击。
author: .izik
source: If you step on POKENAME, it reads your aura. If it senses you did it on purpose, it unleashes a painful electric shock.

entry: POKENAME能感知其他宝可梦的情绪波导，借此捕猎快乐的小碎钻群。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME can sense the emotional auras of other Pokémon. It uses this ability to hunt colonies of happy Carbink.

entry: POKENAME容易被动静分散注意，助威时常背错方向。它虽不擅加油，却很会追赶跑远的球。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME gets distracted by movement and often cheers facing away from the action. Though poor at cheering, it is excellent at chasing runaway balls.

entry: POKENAME手上宝石，深受收藏家珍视。它只会自愿送出，赠给自己认定的真朋友。
author: jaminmcready
source: The gems on POKENAME's hands are highly prized by collectors. It only gives them away by choice, offering one to those it sees as a true friend.

entry: 它蓬松的身体柔软却有力。感到谁悲伤，就举臂鼓励对方抱它；若发现谁惹别人难过，也可能打倒对方报复。
author: .jerden
source: Its fluffy body is soft but powerful. If it senses someone is sad, it will lift up its arms to encourage them to hug it. If it detects that someone is upsetting other people, it may knock them down in retaliation.

entry: 只要自己与其他宝可梦受到的待遇有差距，POKENAME就会不高兴。强烈正义感，让爱偏心的人很难养好它。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME becomes upset whenever there is a disparity between the treatment it receives and the treatment other Pokémon receive. This strong sense of justice makes it difficult to raise for people who pick favorites.

entry: POKENAME感知附近的情绪波导，周围帷幕随之忽明忽暗。若察觉谁心怀恶意，就会藏起来。
author: mepp.
source: The veil that surrounds POKENAME brightens and dims as it senses the emotional aura of those close to it. It hides away if it senses anyone with malice in their hearts.

entry: POKENAME善于共情，能感知握住它头上大鳞片的对象的情绪和模糊想法。操控波导，还能暂时减弱或放大别人所感受到的情绪。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME are empathetic, sensing the emotions and vague thoughts of those who hold the large scale on their heads. By manipulating aura, they can temporarily dampen or amplify what others feel.

entry: POKENAME毛皮极敏感，能察觉人的情绪变化，因此始终焦虑、惊慌。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's fur is so sensitive it is able to detect the changes in people emotions. Because of this, it is in a constant state of anxiety and panic.

entry: POKENAME强大敏捷，能释放波导，向别人表达感受。它偏爱心地纯洁的训练家。
author: torterrable
source: POKENAME is both powerful and agile, and can emit an aura to let others know how it feels. It prefers trainers who are pure of heart.

entry: POKENAME感到信任者传来积极波导，就会释放纸杯蛋糕般的甜香，表示亲近。全身的毛轻盈蓬松，像棉花糖。
author: .izik
source: When sensing a positive aura from someone it trusts, POKENAME emits a sweet, cupcake-like scent as a sign of affection. The fur covering its body is light and fluffy like cotton candy.

entry: POKENAME使出强力头撞时，会将波导集中在头部，抵御反冲。若训练不足，战斗时可能伤到自己。
author: .realthree
source: When POKENAME launches one of its powerful headbutts, it concentrates its aura in its head to protect itself from the recoil. An undisciplined POKENAME may hurt itself while battling.

entry: 心怀恶意的人在附近，POKENAME就会迅速释放波导粒子。它十分坚韧，即使从大气层坠落、外壳摔碎，也会努力回到太空。
author: soup1900
source: When people with malicious intentions are around POKENAME, aura particles begin to rapidly release from its body. It is a tough Pokémon, working hard to return to space when it falls from the atmosphere despite its outer shell being shattered.

entry: POKENAME钻地时，感知其他宝可梦的波导来辨路，绕过其他宝可梦，彻底避开地下的大型个体。它对人群好奇，会寻找特别强大训练家的波导。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME navigate by sensing the aura of other Pokémon whilst they dig, tunnelling around one another and evading larger underground Pokémon entirely. They are curious of groups of people and will seek out the auras of particularly strong Trainers.

entry: POKENAME总指向附近波导最强的人。波导格外强的人，可能会被它主动靠近，希望加入队伍。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME always point to the person with the strongest aura around them. Those with particularly strong auras may find POKENAME approaching them with the hopes of joining their team.

entry: POKENAME感到过强的波导，就会剧烈头痛。它沿河岸训练，磨炼、强化战技。
author: fiordaliso
source: When POKENAME senses an aura that is too powerful, it is struck by a severe headache. It trains along riverbanks to sharpen and strengthen its fighting techniques.

entry: POKENAME一生气，周身就燃起火焰般的波导。脾气太差，使这股波导几乎从不消失。
author: sk372
source: It flares a flame-like aura around its body whenever it gets angry. Due to its bad temperament, this aura is nearly constant on POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME若感到对手没尽全力，就会暴怒。获胜后仍不停挥抓，连敌人昏倒也不罢手。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME rages if it senses its opponent isn't fighting at full effort. It keeps swiping long after victory, even after the foe is knocked out.

entry: POKENAME极富共情能力，轻易便能读懂情绪与来意，甚至能感知20英里范围内的生命。
author: houndrys.
source: A true empath, POKENAME can easily read emotions and intentions. It can sense life within a 20 mile area.

entry: POKENAME乐意让波导强大的人骑乘。载着意志坚定、一心求成的人时，毛会变成深黑。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME enjoy serving as mounts to those who have a strong aura surrounding them. Their fur turns deep black when they carry people who are full of determination and have a powerful drive to succeed.

entry: POKENAME乐意让波导强大的人骑乘。载着深深执着于探明真相的人时，毛会变成雪白。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME enjoy serving as mounts to those who have a strong aura surrounding them. Their fur turns snowy white when they carry someone who has a deep commitment to uncovering the truth.

entry: POKENAME乐意让波导强大的人骑乘。载着战意百折不挠的人时，毛会变成金黄。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME enjoy serving as mounts to those who have a strong aura surrounding them. Their fur turns golden yellow when they carry someone with an indomitable battling spirit.

entry: POKENAME感知人和宝可梦的波导，立刻就能认出更强的对手。此时尾焰猛燃，心中也燃起无法抗拒的战意。
author: fiordaliso
source: Since POKENAME can sense the aura of humans and Pokémon, it instantly recognizes when an opponent is stronger than itself. When that happens, the flame on its tail flares up, and an irresistible urge to fight burns within.

entry: POKENAME即使在这阶段，波导潜力也很强，只是尚未完全掌握。它制造、弄破波导能量球，单纯因为觉得好看。
author: sk372
source: It has strong aura potential even at this stage, but hasn't fully grasped its usage yet. POKENAME creates and bursts orbs of aura energy simply because it thinks they look pretty.

entry: POKENAME察觉邪恶波导，身体就不受控制地冒电火花。它常飞起逃走，避免战斗。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME detects an evil aura, its body sparks uncontrollably. It often takes flight to escape without a fight.

entry: POKENAME窝在沙滩岸边，大多时候紧紧合壳。只有感知不到附近有任何波导，才会露脸。
author: craigprime
source: POKENAME nestles itself into sandy beach shores, spending most days with its shell firmly closed. It only reveals its face if it doesn't sense anyone's aura nearby.

entry: POKENAME爪状的钳子摸着虽软，却能夹碎岩石。它不知疲倦地训练，学习将波导导入双钳，造出第一颗波导弹。
author: milchik
source: Although this Pokémon's paw-like pincers are soft to the touch, they are powerful enough to crush through rocks. POKENAME trains tirelessly to learn how to channel its aura into its pincers and form its very first Aura Sphere.

entry: POKENAME出了名地懒，吃得少，动得更少。极力节省能量，反而让它很快进化。
author: mepp.
source: Notoriously lazy, POKENAME eats very little and moves even less. This intense conservation of energy helps it evolve quickly.

entry: POKENAME在树枝或阴凉处休息。捕食者看见就会犯困，因此避开。它们的蛋靠心灵感应聚集，寒月里挤着保暖；有时两组各6颗，会在同一棵树筑巢。
author: oddly.abnormal
source: POKENAME rests in tree branches or shade. Predators avoid them, growing drowsy after seeing them. Their eggs gather by telepathy, huddling for warmth in colder months; sometimes two sets of six can be found nesting in the same tree.

entry: POKENAME代谢极慢，进化也格外漫长。它藏在树木深处，等上数周至数月，才可能离壳而出。
author: sk372
source: Because its metabolism is so slow, POKENAME takes an inordinate amount of time to evolve. It hides itself deep in trees to wait out the weeks to months it may take to emerge from its shell.

entry: POKENAME懒得自己游，用卷尾缠住训练家的水下呼吸器。许多潜水者拖着一只前进，过后才发现。
author: jaminmcready
source: Too lazy to swim on its own, POKENAME will latch onto a Trainer's Scuba Gear with its curled tail. Many divers find themselves dragging one along before they even notice.

entry: POKENAME懒躺着摆姿势，展示身体，想吸引配偶。若潜在对象没兴趣、走开，它就毫无后招。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME attempts to attract mates by lounging in poses that show off its body. It does not have a backup strategy if a potential mate is uninterested and walks away.

entry: POKENAME醒着时，脸可能像懒人獭，但一睡得特别沉，就会变形，完全认不出来。它只需吃一点便能维生，因此常只是懒躺着。
author: bobosmith01
source: Although POKENAME's face may resemble Slakoth while it is awake, it deforms and becomes unrecognizable whenever it is in a particularly deep sleep. It only needs to eat a little to sustain itself, so it is often just lazing around.

entry: POKENAME据说本该给电脑用户当助手，能力却十分欠缺。它太慢太懒，无论想执行什么操作，自己动手都一定更快。
author: sk372
source: Supposedly POKENAME is meant to be an assistant for computer users, but its capability is sorely lacking. Any process it tries to do can inevitably be done faster on one's own due to how slow and lazy POKENAME is.

entry: 它喜欢整天睡觉，枕着自己精神能量做的枕头。若有什么打扰，就隐身等其消失，或瞬间移动离开，马上接着睡。
author: imaginita
source: It prefers to sleep the day away, resting on a pillow made of its own psychic energy. If anything disturbs it, it will turn invisible until the disturbance is gone, or teleport away and go straight back to sleep.

entry: POKENAME能靠尾巴平衡着睡，被视为懒惰宝可梦。野生宝可梦却很难分辨它醒着还是睡着，便不去打扰，免得交战。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are regarded as lazy Pokémon because of their ability to sleep while balanced on their tail. This trick causes wild Pokémon to have a difficult time discerning whether a POKENAME is asleep or awake, so they leave them alone to avoid a fight.

entry: POKENAME生活缓慢、无精打采，却严守作息。每天同一时间醒，找唯一一餐吃，再回去睡。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME leads an extremely slow and lethargic lifestyle, but still remains adherent to a strict schedule. It awakens at the same time every day to scrounge up its one daily meal before going back to sleep.

entry: POKENAME被认为智力很高，却很少有精力发挥。每天落到林地觅食一次，之后几乎没力气飞回树冠家园睡觉。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is thought to have high intelligence, but rarely has the energy to put it to good use. It drops to the forest floor to scavenge food once a day, then barely has the strength to fly back to its tree canopy home to sleep.

entry: 它的翅膀始终紧收，从没被看见飞行。仔细检查后发现，懒散少动，使翅膀久不用而萎缩。
author: sk372
source: Its wings are always tucked close to its body, and it has never been seen in flight. Closer inspection has revealed that thanks to its lazy, sedentary lifestyle, its wings have atrophied from lack of use.

entry: POKENAME大多在河岸附近的树上懒躺、睡觉。雨声能让它睡得更快。
author: curazy
source: POKENAME spends most of its time lounging and sleeping in trees near riverbanks. The sound of rain can make it fall asleep even faster.

entry: POKENAME只需定期晒一点太阳，就能维持活动。找到合适地方后，一生95%的时间都在睡，同时进行光合作用。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME only requires a tiny amount of regular sunlight to continue functioning, so once it finds a suitable spot, it spends ninety-five percent of its life sleeping, photosynthesizing while it does so.

entry: POKENAME会随机突然乏力，难以移动。它偏爱沼泽湿地，能吃脚下富含养分的泥。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME experience random moments of lassitude that make moving difficult. They prefer to live in marshes and swamps where they can eat the nutrient-rich mud beneath them.

entry: POKENAME会飞到一半睡着，常撞上树或大针蜂巢，撞过才醒。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME is known to doze off mid-flight. It often crashes into trees or Beedrill hives, waking up only after the impact.

entry: POKENAME想得出恶作剧，却通常懒得执行。它常准备大叫吓人，可嘴一张，尖叫就变成哈欠，随后睡着。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME dreams up pranks and tricks, but is usually too lazy to enact them. In an effort to startle others, it often prepares to scream loudly, but as soon as it opens its mouth, the scream becomes a yawn and it falls asleep.

entry: POKENAME能不动就不动。非走不可时，就拖着身体挪到别处，或搭其他宝可梦一程。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME tends to avoid moving. If it needs to, it'll drag itself to a new location or catch a ride on another Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME喜欢大半生安睡。受惊也能动得极快，只为逃到安全处，继续打盹。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME enjoys spending the majority of its life sleeping in peace. It can move remarkably fast if startled, if only to flee somewhere safe to resume napping.

entry: POKENAME最爱蜂蜜，却懒得自己采。它在蜜源附近等路人，再一路跟随，不停叫着烦人，直到对方给它弄来甜食。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME adores honey as its favorite snack, but is too lazy to gather it itself. It waits near honey sources for passersby and follows them, annoying them with its cry until they get the sweet snack for it.

entry: POKENAME虽是受欢迎的宠物，却很少想玩，总提不起劲地懒躺到饭点。能量需求不多，因此常会超重。
author: mistymagius
source: While being a popular house pet, POKENAME rarely wants to play, instead it will unenthusiastically laze around until it's time for food. Since it doesn't need much energy, POKENAME will often become overweight.

entry: POKENAME有创意和艺术头脑，却缺乏动力、精力。每天最多勉强画一两笔，完成一件作品可能要数周、甚至数月。
author: sk372
source: Though it has a creative and artistic mindset, POKENAME lacks in motivation and energy. It can only push itself to do one or two brush strokes a day, so completed art can take weeks or even months.

entry: POKENAME每天训练，却立刻就累。只练一拳或一脚，就坐下稍歇，再起身多做一下。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME train every day, but immediately become tired. After practicing a single punch or kick they sit down to take a quick break, then get back up to do one more.

entry: POKENAME懒懒地用钳状尾尖耙过草地，捡坚果和种子当零食。盯脸上花纹太久，会让人犯困。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME lazily rakes the claw-like tip of its tail through the grass, picking up nuts and seeds for it to snack on. Staring at POKENAME's facial markings for too long will induce drowsiness.

entry: POKENAME动得太少，食物大多直接转成电。它也不怎么用电，主要防其他宝可梦偷食物。
author: mistymagius
source: Due to how little POKENAME moves around, most of the food it eats gets converted directly into electricity. It doesn't use its electricity much, mainly to deter other Pokémon from stealing its food.

entry: POKENAME偶尔突然有点精神，试着跳舞，或模仿最近的对象。但能量很快耗尽，通常又倒回地上，继续犯懒。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME occasionally gets small bursts of energy that cause it to attempt to dance or mimic the nearest being. The energy surge depletes quickly and POKENAME often flops back on the ground and resumes being lazy.

entry: POKENAME几乎从没醒着，甚至靠梦游完成其他活动。连进食、战斗都在睡中进行，一整天呼呼打鼾。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is almost never seen awake, to the point that it sleepwalks to perform other functions while slumbering. Even eating and battling are done while POKENAME sleeps and snores the day away.

entry: 单只POKENAME每天都不肯太费劲，无论捕猎还是挖新地道安家。因此，许多个体会结伴互助。
author: bobosmith01
source: An individual POKENAME does not exert much effort per day, whether that be hunting or digging out more tunnels that it will call home. As a result, many POKENAME band together to help out one another.

entry: POKENAME喜欢睡在满是坚果的枝上，这样饿醒时，就不用走远。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME prefers to rest on branches full of nuts. It does this so it does not have to travel far when it wakes up hungry.

entry: POKENAME一整天大多睡着，被弄醒却能突然快速行动。若过早叫醒，它就吐火球掩护逃跑。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME sleep away most of their days, but they can move in sudden, rapid bursts if awoken. If a POKENAME is awoken early, it will spit out fireballs to cover its escape.

entry: POKENAME天生有力，却总尽量少出力，好赶快回去睡。因此，有些训练家难以在饲养时平衡训练与休息。
author: porterofgames
source: Despite its inherent strength, POKENAME will put in minimal effort so that it can go right back to sleeping. Because of this, some Trainers find it hard to strike the right balance between training and rest when attempting to raise them.

entry: POKENAME喜欢整天在树上放松、睡觉，捕食者很容易低估它自保的能力。平时虽慢，却能猛挥利爪，赶走威胁。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME prefers to spend its days relaxing in the trees and sleeping. Predators are quick to underestimate this Pokémon's ability to protect itself. Though slow normally, POKENAME can lash out with a rapid swipe of its claws to ward off threats.

entry: POKENAME一倒进泥水洼，就舒服得懒得离开。它一躺数小时，只有吃点泥、翻个身才动。
author: sk372
source: Once POKENAME has flopped into a mud puddle, it becomes too comfortable and lazy to move out of it. It lies there for hours, only moving to eat some of the mud or roll over.

entry: 研究者初次野外观察，惊讶发现POKENAME到处跳舞、精力充沛。再调查才知道，它其实像梦游般睡着跳，醒着反而懒洋洋。
author: sk372
source: When first observed in the wild, researchers were shocked to see POKENAME dancing about and full of energy. Further investigation revealed it dances while asleep in a manner akin to sleepwalking; it's quite lethargic when awake.

entry: POKENAME内向、少动、极害羞，用毛斗篷裹身，很少出巢。必须长时间温柔引导、建立深厚信任，它才肯敞开心扉，与别人互动。
author: sk372
source: Introverted, inactive and incredibly shy, POKENAME covers itself with a fur cloak and rarely comes out of its den. It takes a lot of trust and gentle coaxing over time to get it to open up and interact with others.

entry: POKENAME太懒，只有食物略超出正常够得到的范围，才伸舌去拿。即使抓到，往往连缩回舌头都懒。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's lazy nature means it will only extend its tongue towards food that is just out of normal reach. Even so, it is often too lazy to retract its tongue once it actually seizes the food.

entry: POKENAME整天懒散，常待溪边。有时任水流带到陌生地方，也毫不在意，照样过日子。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME spends its days loafing around, often near streams. It's been known to let water currents carry them away, taking them to unfamiliar places. POKENAME remains unfazed, and simply goes on with its life.

entry: 它有请假王大半力量，却完全没那脾气。几乎没有什么能激怒它，令其真正发挥力量，因此反而被视为“更弱”。
author: sk372
source: It possesses most of Slaking's power, but none of its temper. It is considered "weaker" by virtue of seemingly nothing being able to rile it enough to truly apply its strength to.

entry: POKENAME大多浮在水面睡觉，偶尔被冲上海滩，静得让人担心是否生病。不过，它最终还是会爬回水里。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME spends most of its time asleep while floating on the surface of the water. It occasionally washes up onto beaches, remaining so still that people often worry it is unwell, but it will eventually crawl back into the water.

entry: POKENAME大多浮在水面睡觉，偶尔被冲上海滩，静得让人担心是否生病。不过，它最终还是会爬回水里。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME spends most of its time asleep while floating on the surface of the water. It occasionally washes up onto beaches, remaining so still that people often worry it is unwell, but it will eventually crawl back into the water.

entry: POKENAME很少活动，若会动，也慢得惊人。这种生活很适合让懒人獭休息，它们喜欢躺在它身上的树上。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are sedentary Pokémon, moving incredibly slowly, if at all. This lifestyle makes them ideal resting spots for Slakoth, who enjoy lounging on their trees.

entry: POKENAME连尾焰都懒，微弱的火常熄灭。它可能花一天多，才攒够精力重新点燃。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's slothful nature extends even to its tail flame. The weak fire fizzles out regularly, and it may take upwards of a day for POKENAME to muster the energy to reignite it.

entry: POKENAME用利爪抓住树枝，懒懒吊着。就连从一枝荡到另一枝，都算当天大成就，值得随后长时间休息。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME lazily dangles from tree limbs, clinging to them with its sharp claws. Even swinging from one limb to the next is considered a great achievement for the day, worthy of a long rest afterward.

entry: POKENAME战斗时常休息，恢复能量和专注。它看似睡着时，若头上的火焰仍燃着，其实是在集中精神。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME rests often during battle to restore energy and focus. If the flame on its head is still alight when it's seemingly asleep, it's actually focusing.

entry: POKENAME身体虽笨重，却能不知疲倦地吊在岩石和枝上，睡着也不例外。但所吊物体大多先断，它还没醒便猛摔下来，剧烈挣扎。
author: infinex21
source: Despite their bulky bodies, POKENAME are able to hang from rocks and tree branches without tiring, even as they sleep. Because most objects they hang from will break before they awaken, they inevitably come crashing down and thrash about violently.

entry: POKENAME不自己找食物，而是用利爪到处骚扰其他宝可梦，拿走无人看管的吃食。它常招来攻击，金属身体却很难被打坏。
author: .jerden
source: Rather than gathering food for itself, POKENAME wanders around harassing other Pokémon with its sharp claws, taking any food left unattended. Although it often provokes attacks, its metallic body makes it difficult to damage.

entry: POKENAME一整天大多睡在森林家园的灌木下。它主要吃叶片含毒量高的植物，将毒素代谢、浓缩进背刺。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME spend the majority of their day sleeping within the undergrowth of their forest homes. They feed primarily on plants that have high levels of toxins in their leaves; they metabolise and concentrate them into the spines on their back.

entry: 它懒得惊人，宁可伸长触须取食，也不肯移动身体。谁看见、听见它打哈欠，就会忍不住跟着打，很快也困了。
author: infinex21
source: It is an incredibly lazy Pokémon that will sooner use its long feelers to retrieve food before moving its body. Those who witness and hear it yawn are inherently compelled to yawn and soon feel tired.

entry: POKENAME由两种不爱活动的宝可梦融合而成，懒得出奇。哪怕只动一下，都很少见。
author: hophoppip
source: A fusion between two sedentary Pokémon, POKENAME is extremely lazy. A POKENAME moving even slightly is a rare sight.

entry: POKENAME一睡太久，身上经常长苔藓。苔藓养分足，它光吃苔藓，也能维持生活。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME remain asleep for such long periods of time that moss regularly begins to grow upon them. The moss growing upon these Pokémon is rich with enough nutrients that they can sustain themselves on this moss and nothing else.

entry: POKENAME常在海面滚着滚着就睡着，除非撞到坚硬物体，否则很少醒。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME frequently falls asleep while rolling across the ocean's surface. It seldom wakes unless it collides with a solid object.

entry: POKENAME睡着时，厚毛会积聚静电。风暴中，毛随鼾声放出小火花，噼啪作响，清晰可闻。
author: .izik
source: As it sleeps, POKENAME's thick fur builds static. During storms, its fur crackles audibly with small sparks discharging as it snores.

entry: POKENAME白天懒躺，吸收太阳能，转成电能。夜里却猛然活跃，成小群捕猎；日出前吃饱，再睡掉整个早晨。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME laze about during the day, absorbing energy from the sun and converting it into electrical energy. They explode into action during the night, hunting for food in small packs. They catch a meal before the sun rises and sleep the morning away.

entry: POKENAME唱自己的摇篮曲也会睡着，唱到一半就安静入眠。悠闲随和，让它很容易照料，睡着时尤其如此。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME fall asleep to their own lullabies and end up in a quiescent rest halfway through their own song. Their laidback and easygoing personality makes them easy Pokémon to take care of, especially if they are sleeping.

entry: POKENAME在公园伪装成熟睡的人。休息时，会发出轻柔、令人安心的咕咕声。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME disguises itself as a sleeping human in public parks. While resting, it emits a soft, comforting cooing.

entry: POKENAME睡前将找到的一颗树果放进花苞。醒来再吃，帮助自己渐渐清醒。
author: .izik
source: Before sleeping, POKENAME places a berry it has found inside its bud. When it wakes, it eats the berry to help ease the waking process.

entry: POKENAME等待进化时，整天在树上打盹，用弯爪抓住或吊在枝上。被打扰后，它能抖动身体，释放毒性较轻的粉末。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: While awaiting evolution, POKENAME spend their days napping in trees, holding onto or hanging from branches using their twisted claws. If bothered, POKENAME can shiver and shake their bodies to release a mild poisonous powder.

entry: 这种宝可梦常因漫无目的地漂浮而迷路，发现它的人多半是孩子。天然栖息地有高大、阴凉的树，它会攀住，免得被吹走。
author: lydiaprower8
source: This Pokémon is often found by other people while lost somewhere due to its aimless floating, mostly by children. Its natural habitat has tall, shaded trees that it clings to in order to prevent itself from blowing away.

entry: POKENAME的毛虽密却极轻，春天能让它在草地上方轻飘。它在半空打盹，随风缓缓漂移。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's dense fur is so light that it floats gently over meadows in spring. It naps midair, drifting slowly with the wind.

entry: POKENAME白天懒散，谁的话都不听，入夜前被打扰还会发脾气。但只要送上红宝石，它就兴奋地醒来，愿意为最爱的食物配合。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME laze about during the day, refusing to listen to anyone and getting grumpy if they're disturbed before nightfall. Offering a POKENAME a ruby will cause it to excitedly wake up willing to cooperate in exchange for its favorite meal.

entry: POKENAME即使睡着也高速滚动，留下一道强力毒痕，让追逐者入睡。
author: .izik
source: Even while asleep, POKENAME rolls at high speeds. It leaves behind a potent trail of poison that puts pursuers to sleep.

entry: POKENAME懒坐花丛，吸收日光和月光。冬天一到，便挖洞，将大半身体埋进土里冬眠。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME lazily sits around in flower patches soaking up sun and moonlight. It digs a hole and submerges most of its body in the dirt to hibernate once winter rolls around.

entry: POKENAME迟缓，却善抓机会，常跟随其他肉食宝可梦，吃它们餐后留下的肉屑。灵敏鼻子和缓慢行动，让它在两餐间移动时节省能量。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are lethargic yet opportunistic. They tend to follow other carnivorous Pokémon to consume bits of meat left behind after a recent meal. Their sensitive noses and slow movement help conserve energy as they travel between meals.

entry: 朽木妖睡着时，POKENAME爬上背，将藤蔓伸进它的意识，再借这联系，在潜意识中控制附近树木。
author: .izik
source: While Trevenant sleeps, POKENAME mounts its back and extends vines into its mind. It uses this connection to subconsciously control nearby trees.

entry: POKENAME睡着时释放甘草香的花粉云，香气浓得能让附近宝可梦也打盹。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME releases clouds of licorice-scented pollen while asleep. The aroma is strong enough to lull nearby Pokémon into a nap as well.

entry: POKENAME打鼾时，耳朵会发出低频脉冲。靠得太近，可能暂时失聪。
author: .izik
source: When it snores, POKENAME emits low-frequency pulses from its ears. The blasts can cause temporary deafness if one gets too close.

entry: 许多人相信，让POKENAME睡在头上能睡得更好。不过，羽毛虽然极软，却没有科学数据支持这种说法。
author: mistymagius
source: Many people believe that letting a POKENAME rest on their heads will help them sleep better. However, while their feathers are incredibly soft, there is no scientific data to back up this claim.

entry: POKENAME太弱，举不起铠甲外壳，只好在里面歇着，白天吸热。夜里慢慢挪动，寻找更暖的地方继续休息。
author: shyguy11011
source: POKENAME are too weak to lift the shell of their armor, instead resting inside of it, soaking up the heat during the day. At night, they will slowly shuffle around in search for warmer areas to continue their rest.

entry: 进化前，POKENAME只有被碰触，或被反复惹烦，才肯动。连吃饭这种简单的事，都全靠母亲或训练家催促。
author: bobosmith01
source: Until it evolves, POKENAME only moves when another is touching it or is persistently nettling it. It relies entirely on its mother or Trainer to encourage it to do things as simple as eating.

entry: POKENAME一年大多冬眠，只为给巢里采树果才醒。若想叫醒它，就会遭利爪凶狠攻击。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME hibernate for most of the year, and it is only awake to collect berries for its den. If you try to wake it, it will viciously attack you with its sharp claws.

entry: POKENAME懒散地待在树干周围，吃真菌和霉菌。背上的蘑菇，是药用助眠剂的珍贵原料。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME lazes around tree trunks eating fungi and molds. The mushrooms growing on its back are valued as an ingredient for medicinal sleep aids.

entry: POKENAME的毛太软太舒服，让它始终昏昏欲睡。旅行训练家常拿它当临时枕头。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's fur is so soft and comfy that it is in a constant state of drowsiness. Travelling Trainers will often use POKENAME as a makeshift pillow.

entry: 这些爱睡的宝可梦会撕开枕头筑巢。野生POKENAME出没处，会卖填料辛辣的特制枕头，防止被它们盯上。
author: hophoppip
source: These sleepy Pokémon tear open pillows to use as nests. In places where wild POKENAME live, special pillows with spicy stuffing are sold to deter POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME懒坐南瓜田，把水分和养分全抢来。腹部散发的甜香，能安抚一切试图攻击它的对象。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME lazily sits in its pumpkin patch, stealing all the water and nutrients for itself. It releases a sweet scent from its belly that calms anything that tries to attack it.

entry: 潮湿天气，POKENAME睡在柔软的睡莲叶上。身体渗出金色树液，常被采来做饼干淋面。
author: .izik
source: On humid days, POKENAME naps atop its soft lily pad. A golden sap oozes from its body and is often harvested for biscuit glazes.

entry: POKENAME尾尖其实有火，只是微微闷燃，不常见。集中精神，能让火短暂旺起来，但用力过后，就会累得很。
author: sk372
source: Though not often seen, POKENAME does possess a tail flame, smoldering faintly at the tip. If it concentrates, it can make the flame flare to life for a time, but the effort leaves it quite exhausted afterward.

entry: 有人说，睡在POKENAME所住水源附近，一周内就会遇到一生挚爱。但它太稀少，这说法尚未得到科学证实。
author: .izik
source: Some say that sleeping near a water source inhabited by POKENAME will cause you to find the love of your life within a week. Due to its rarity, this has yet to be scientifically proven.

entry: POKENAME专挑最碍训练家事的地方睡觉，还会竭力无视命令。它以自己的懒惰为傲。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME only sleeps where it's least convenient for its Trainer and will try its best to ignore their commands. It prides itself on its laziness.

entry: POKENAME是一款热门助眠药的广告明星，演示吃药后睡得多快。其实它本来就很容易睡，常溜去安静地方，打个短盹。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are the star of a popular line of sleep medication, adverts featuring them showing just how quickly POKENAME fall asleep on the medicine. In truth, they need little motivation to sleep and often sneak away to quiet places for a quick catnap.

entry: POKENAME平时不太活动，作宠物算容易照料。但它懒得连毛都不梳，主人得不断照顾打结的毛，也很麻烦。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME makes for a moderately low-maintenance pet due to its generally inactive lifestyle. However, it is too lazy to even groom itself, so constant care of its matted fur on the owner's part can be a hassle.

entry: POKENAME其实很重视领地，却也懒得对闯入者做什么。最多只是气愤地哼哼，直到对方离开。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is actually quite territorial, but also too lazy to do much of anything about intruders in its territory. The most it manages is making indignant huffing noises until the interloper leaves.

entry: POKENAME鼻子极灵，数英里外就能闻到食物，却只慢悠悠走去。久而久之，还会认出哪种食物最可能等它到时，仍没被吃掉。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME has a superb nose and can smell food from miles away. It only heads towards it at a leisurely pace, and over time will learn to recognize the scent of food that is most likely to still be uneaten when it eventually arrives.

entry: POKENAME懒惰迟钝到有时飞着也睡。任何弄醒它的事都会招来凶狠反应，连终究会撞上地面也不例外。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's lethargic tendencies are so strong that it can sometimes fall asleep mid-flight. It responds quite aggressively to anything that wakes it up, including an inevitable collision with the ground.

entry: POKENAME用腹部花纹催眠对手，使其也像自己一样放松。它一整天大多躺着不动。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME uses the pattern on its stomach to hypnotize its opponent into its own relaxed state. It spends most of the day lying still.

entry: POKENAME懒得做哪怕最小的多余动作。距离再短，也只肯瞬间移动。
author: .jerden
source: It is too lazy to make the smallest unnecessary moves. No matter how short the distance, POKENAME will only travel through teleportation.

entry: POKENAME训练敷衍，只短暂散步、举小石，维持肌肉活动。虽练得不费力，实力仍比看起来强。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's training sessions are lackluster, consisting of short walks and lifting small rocks to keep its muscles active. Despite the low-effort training, it's stronger than it seems.

entry: 它一生都在寻找完美对手。找到了，马上认输。
author: dylonk25
source: It spends its life in search of the perfect opponent. Upon finding such a foe, it forfeits immediately.

entry: POKENAME总是疲倦，懒洋洋的神情很少变。肌肉至少要花10秒，才能把嘴角挪成笑容。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME has a languid expression that rarely changes because it is always tired. It takes at least 10 seconds for its muscles to move its mouth into a smile.

entry: POKENAME始终醒着，不断进食，整天啃树干枝条。附近有同类，就吃得更快，想赶在食物被抢走前多吃。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are constantly awake and eating, chewing through tree trunks and branches at every hour of the day. They eat faster when other POKENAME are nearby, trying to gorge before their food gets eaten by others.

entry: POKENAME各部分独立思考，很少同步。即使睡觉，也有一处或多处仍抽动、警戒。
author: .izik
source: Each part of POKENAME thinks independently, rarely syncing up. Even in sleep, one or more sections remain twitchy and alert.

entry: POKENAME带着过动猿的断爪，靠尖端自卫。不高兴就大发脾气，剧烈挣扎、乱挥断爪，直到倒下。
author: sk372
source: Carrying the missing claw of a Vigoroth allows POKENAME to defend itself with the limb's sharp points. When it is upset, it goes into a vicious tantrum, thrashing about and swinging the dismembered claw about wildly until it collapses.

entry: 它遇到什么都猛舔，品尝味道，也留下唾液标记。身体机能过于活跃，舌头无论伸在嘴外多久，都不会干。
author: sk372
source: It will aggressively lick anything that it comes across, tasting it and marking it with its saliva. Because of its overactive body functions, its tongue never dries out no matter how long it remains out of its mouth.

entry: POKENAME体内产物过多，双头不停咳出浓烟。吸入会使精力猛烈上涌，肾上腺素作用消退后，却极度疲惫。
author: sk372
source: Excess internal production causes POKENAME's two heads to constantly cough out thick clouds of smoke. Inhaling the smoke causes intense surges of energy that lead to heavy exhaustion when the adrenaline wears off.

entry: POKENAME用头砸碎巨石，马上又找下一块。它不停冲撞，仿佛体力永不耗尽。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME smashes boulders with its head and immediately seeks another. It charges nonstop, seemingly never running out of stamina.

entry: POKENAME头上钻头般的角不断旋转，极少数静止时也不例外。虽然沉重，它却善爬，能用刺扎进表面，让手脚有着力点。
author: .jerden
source: The drill-like horns on POKENAME's head constantly spin, even on the rare occasions when POKENAME stands still. Although it is heavy, POKENAME is a proficient climber, as it can dig in with its spikes to make its own hand and foot-holds.

entry: POKENAME极热心照顾生病或受伤的对象，但外貌加上过度活跃，往往造成的伤害多于帮助。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is incredibly eager to help tend to the sick or injured, but its appearance combined with hyperactive tendencies often causes more harm than healing.

entry: 丰缘草药师采POKENAME的藤蔓，制作廉价提神酊剂。藤蔓再生快，很容易养来采收。
author: .izik
source: Hoenn herbalists harvest POKENAME's vines to make cheap energy tinctures. The vines regrow quickly, making it easy to farm.

entry: POKENAME极其护幼，哪怕只见一丝可能的敌意，就会猛然防御。无论它怎样疯狂折腾，孩子却始终睡着。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is insanely protective of its young, flying into a defensive flurry at even the faintest hint of possible aggression. Despite the frantic motions, the child stays asleep through all its parent's antics.

entry: POKENAME容易兴奋，刺激过多就快速拍翅。常见它靠近想吃的花，兴奋过头，反把花吹跑。
author: sk372
source: Easily excitable, POKENAME flaps its wings incredibly fast when overly stimulated. It is a common sight to see it blow away flowers it wishes to consume because it got too excited when getting close.

entry: POKENAME横过身体高速旋转，就能飞行。旋转时利爪伸得更长，成为在空中回旋切割的危险物。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can fly through the air via turning horizontally and rotating at rapid speeds. While spinning, its sharp claws extend further, turning it into a whirling, slicing aerial hazard.

entry: POKENAME细长四肢让战斗伸展灵活，乱挥双臂，捶抓到对手昏倒。难得平静时，这些肢体也能给出意外舒服的拥抱。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's lanky limbs allow it a flexible reach in battle, flailing its arms around wildly to club and claw opponents into unconsciousness. In rare moments of placidity, said limbs also allow it to give surprisingly nice hugs.

entry: POKENAME精力狂野，撕树皮喝树液。若吃到一半受惊，就会发狂地连续挥爪还击。
author: .izik
source: With wild energy, POKENAME tears bark from trees to drink sap. If startled mid-meal, it retaliates in a frenzy of claw slashes.

entry: POKENAME始终精力充沛地横冲直撞，看见什么就头朝前冲。只有撞到够坚硬的东西，把自己撞昏，才会停。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is in a constant state of energized rampage, charging head-long towards anything that catches its eye. It only stops when it ends up charging into something solid enough to knock itself unconscious.

entry: POKENAME程序里的怪毛病，让它不停想移动。即使几乎悬停原地，四肢和头也会持续旋转。
author: sk372
source: A quirk in POKENAME's programming causes it to be filled with a ceaseless need to move about. Even when hovering in a mostly stationary fashion, its limbs and head will constantly rotate.

entry: POKENAME过度活跃，对靠近的东西都颇有敌意。它抓住经过的大型宝可梦，尽量长时间快速啃咬，发泄部分精力。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's hyperactivity leads it to be rather aggressive towards anything that draws near. It latches onto larger Pokémon that pass by and spends as long as possible rapidly gnawing on them to vent some of its energy.

entry: POKENAME身体虽笨重，却很活跃。给一颗零余果，就能迅速从小睡醒来，不像平时那样昏沉。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are quite active despite their bulky physique. By giving them a Chesto Berry, they can quickly awaken themselves from a nap without the grogginess that typically occurs.

entry: POKENAME从一枝跳到另一枝，从不停歇。它吃果树的花，穿行树冠时，也为树授粉。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME bounds from branch to branch, never staying still. It feeds on fruit blossoms, pollinating trees as it moves through the canopy.

entry: POKENAME庞大的超能力失控，使心智近乎疯狂。它飘过天空，尖叫哀号，不断用念力随机抓起、乱扔东西。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's vast psychic powers running rampant have driven its mind to near madness. It screeches and wails as it levitates through the skies, endlessly picking up and tossing things at random with its telekinesis.

entry: POKENAME精力和好奇心无穷，不停飞行、瞬间移动，连只感兴趣一秒的东西，也要调查。某些树果能安抚它，却只管用一小会儿。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's endless energy and curiosity lead it to fly and teleport around constantly, investigating everything that catches its interest for even a second. Certain berries can calm it down, but only for a short time.

entry: POKENAME用头上的钳状附肢挖洞藏身。它喜欢突然探出，顽皮地“挥钳”，吓路人一跳。
author: sk372
source: It uses the claw-like appendage on its head to dig holes in the dirt to hide in. POKENAME enjoys surprising passersby by popping out of its hole and "waving" its claw at them playfully.

entry: POKENAME精力无穷，极其敏捷，总跑来跑去。长臂能扎进地里，帮它急转弯。
author: sylviasnake
source: POKENAME are filled with boundless energy. They are extremely agile, always scampering about. They use their long arms to dig into the ground and make sharp turns.

entry: POKENAME昼夜都飞，只短暂停歇。拍翅虽响，动作却太快，大多猎物即使听见，也逃不掉。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME flies both during the day and during the night, only briefly stopping to rest. Its wings flap loudly, but it moves so fast that most prey that hears it coming still cannot escape.

entry: POKENAME个头虽小，却不怕任何威胁。它英勇巡逻森林，用有力的红色附肢惩罚不守规矩的宝可梦。
author: mepp.
source: Despite POKENAME's small size, it is unafraid of any threat. It valiantly patrols the forest, punishing unruly Pokémon with its powerful red appendages.

entry: POKENAME浑身是劲，成群奔过田野。同步奔跑时，还会彼此传递小股电荷。
author: .izik
source: Herds of POKENAME sprint across fields, buzzing with energy. They transfer mild charges to each other as they run in sync.

entry: POKENAME的烟雾云反映活力。最强的个体，几乎被周围风暴遮得看不见。
author: dylonk25
source: POKENAME's smog clouds reflect its vitality. The most powerful specimens can barely be seen through the storm surrounding them.

entry: POKENAME快速的心跳给身体充电，使它无法静止。从嘴里一闪强光，释放这些能量后，它才会停片刻，随即又像原来一样迅速行动。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's rapid heartbeat charges its body with electricity, keeping it from remaining still. After discharging this energy as a bright flash of light from inside its mouth, POKENAME will stop for a few moments, then resume as rapidly as before.

entry: POKENAME用爪子刮树干，消耗精力。它太活跃，出没地区的树常几乎被剥光树皮。
author: sk372
source: It scrapes its claws along tree trunks in order to burn off energy. Because it is so hyperactive, trees in areas with POKENAME presence are often all but stripped bare of their bark.

entry: 有些湖泊划出专门区域，由POKENAME训练职业游泳运动员。学生若不认可它的权威，它就用水炮将其轰出领地。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: Some lakes have designated areas where POKENAME trains professional swimmers. If a student fails to recognize POKENAME's authority, it uses Hydro Pump to blast them out of its territory.

entry: POKENAME的花粉，让附近宝可梦突然精力充沛。它身旁常围着坐不住的小群宝可梦。
author: .izik
source: The pollen from POKENAME induces bursts of energy in nearby Pokémon. It's often surrounded by small groups unable to sit still.

entry: POKENAME常乘着龙卷风、飓风的狂风移动，用强钳劈开迎面飞来的碎屑。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is often seen riding the gale-force winds of tornados and hurricanes. It uses its powerful claws to slash through incoming debris.

entry: POKENAME身体耗能大，始终饥饿、紧张不安，整夜搜食，垃圾桶也不放过。战斗时，它疯狂猛攻，毫不停歇。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is constantly hungry and on edge from the energy its body burns, spending its nights scavenging for food, even from garbage bins. In battle, it assaults foes with frantic, relentless attacks.

entry: POKENAME代谢快如闪电，花瓣不断快速长出、脱落，沿途留下一道鲜红。它依靠阳光生存，常迁往阳光更足的地区。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME leaves behind a trail of bright red petals as its lightning-fast metabolism causes its petals to grow and fall off at a rapid rate. It thrives off of sunlight and will often migrate to find sunnier areas.

entry: POKENAME用鳃将自己卡在树间；鳃能充入凝胶，鼓得硬如岩石。摆好这姿势，它花光精力想前进，虽很少成功，一天下来却累透。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME wedges itself between trees using its gills, which it can cause to become rock-hard by inflating them with a gel. When in this pose, it expends all its energy trying to move forwards, rarely succeeding but ending the day exhausted.

entry: POKENAME深潜泥水，在淤底挖地道藏身。只要时间足够，甚至能在附近水域间挖出相通的网络。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME dives deep into muddy waters and digs into the mucky bottom to create tunnels to hide itself in. It may even create tunnel networks between nearby bodies of water if given enough time.

entry: POKENAME几乎不睡，常被视为害兽，会闯入城中商铺和住家，吃光全部储粮。大城市已有驱逐计划，却收效甚微。
author: agentyoshi
source: Oft considered a pest, POKENAME almost never sleep, instead opting to break into and eat entire stocks of food supplies from urban businesses and homes. Initiatives have been started to drive them out of major cities, with little success.

entry: POKENAME尾上的头极其好斗，总找食物、找架打。温顺得多的前半身只能四处跑，满足尾巴，否则自己就会被攻击。
author: reflecbeat
source: The head on a POKENAME's tail is very aggressive and constantly looking for food and fights. Its much more docile front half has to run around, satisfying the tail's desires, lest it be attacked by itself.

entry: POKENAME以极快速度滚下山，用厚实、铁般坚硬的钳子保护自己。若想捡起，它就会发狂，试着用钳子将你撕碎。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME can be seen rolling down hills at breakneck speeds, protecting itself with its iron-thick claws. If you try and pick it up, it will go into a frenzy and try to rip you apart with its claws.

entry: POKENAME注意力极短，每天多次刺训练家，只为惹出反应。但从小树上反复滑翔，它一天玩几小时也不腻。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME has an incredibly short attention span, and it will sting its Trainer multiple times a day just to get a rise out of them. However, it can spend hours a day repeatedly gliding from small trees without getting bored.

entry: POKENAME总急着找甜树液，用钳子往树里挖。太过热切，常为找树液撕掉过多树干，弄得整树倒下。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is always eagerly searching for sweet sap to taste, digging into trees with its claws. Its overeager nature means it often tears away too much of a tree's trunk in search of sap and causes the tree to fall.

entry: POKENAME急躁地不停移动，仿佛无法安静。运动使液态身体始终不能完全凝固，即使休息，睡着也动来动去。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME move with a frenetic urgency, seemingly unable to stay still. Their constant movement keeps their liquid bodies from ever fully setting, and even when they rest, they fidget and move in their sleep.

entry: POKENAME必须一直待在最寒冷地区，才能健康。精力过剩又披厚毛，气温较暖，就容易过热而致命。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME must always stay within the coldest of regions for its health. Between its excessive energy and the heavy fur coat, warmer temperatures would cause it to easily overheat to deadly effect.

entry: POKENAME虽被硬而不动的壳裹住，仍躁动、精力充沛。它短促、杂乱地跳，通常侧身落地，卡住不动。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME is restless and full of energy despite being encased in a hard, immobile shell. It moves in brief, erratic hops, which usually cause it to land on its side and become stuck.

entry: POKENAME在平原狂奔，不停发出号角般叫声。有人认为它想创作音乐，但精力太旺，唱出无调性、不和谐的歌，听众都被赶走。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME runs wild across the plains, trumpeting constantly. It's thought that it's attempting to create music, but its overly energetic nature results in atonal, discordant songs that repel listeners.

entry: POKENAME内部程序总在超负荷运行，让它不停掠过屏幕，看着很烦。点击按住，它就疯狂挣扎，仿佛静止会疼。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's internal programming is always running on overdrive, causing it to zoom around screens constantly, becoming a visual nuisance. Clicking and holding it causes it to thrash about wildly, as if remaining still is painful to it.

entry: POKENAME坐不住，体内能量过剩，难以好好休息或长久专注。若不能持续宣泄，原本就危险的压力，可能引发严重的身体并发症。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME cannot sit still: the overwhelming energy in its body prevents it from properly resting or focusing for very long. If it cannot constantly channel its energy, its already-dangerous levels of stress can cause severe physical complications.

entry: POKENAME始终痛苦，疯狂挣扎，艰难移动。它极危险，尾钳一挥，就足以将树整齐切成两半。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is in constant pain, struggling to move as it flails frantically. It is incredibly dangerous, as a single swipe from its tail claw is enough to cut a tree clean in half.

entry: POKENAME像过度活跃的孩子，四处冲太快，常把人绊倒。它不停要玩具，却很快厌倦，又想换新的。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME behaves like a hyperactive child, rushing around so quickly that it often trips people up. It will constantly demand toys to play with, but will quickly grow bored and want to move on to new ones.

entry: POKENAME冲动地把抓到的小东西往嘴里塞，似乎全不管能否消化。若找不到塞得进的，就不停乱舔物品。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME impulsively shoves any small objects it can grab into its mouth, seemingly not caring if it can digest them or not. If it can't find something to fit in its mouth, it will constantly lick random objects.

entry: POKENAME不停捡石头、扔石头，没有目标也扔。若某块飞得特别远，它就追去捡回，堆存这些心爱的石头，等遇敌时作弹药。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME never stops picking up rocks and tossing them, even when it doesn't have a target. If a rock flies particularly far, POKENAME will chase after it to get it back, stacking up these favored rocks as ammunition for when it has a foe to fight.

entry: 黎明，POKENAME的藤蔓杂乱挥舞，抓住够得到的一切。它一直躁动，直到夜深才平静。
author: .izik
source: At dawn, POKENAME's vines flail unpredictably, grabbing anything in reach. It remains restless until calming down late into the evening.

entry: POKENAME爱随机伏击其他宝可梦，趁对方没反应过来，接连快速猛攻。虽通常夜行，它却有足够精力，5天不睡。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME loves to ambush random Pokémon, bombarding them with a flurry of quick strikes before they can react. While usually nocturnal, POKENAME has enough energy to go five days without sleep.

entry: POKENAME在网上找其他宝可梦的图，拆开图像取组件，再为自己合成身体部位，特别偏爱带爪的肢体和利牙。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME scour online images for pictures of other Pokémon, pulling the graphics apart for their components. They synthesise body parts for themselves from these destroyed graphics, showing a preference for clawed limbs and sharp teeth.

entry: POKENAME在网上找其他宝可梦的图，拆开图像取组件，再为自己合成身体部位，特别偏爱带爪的肢体和利牙。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME scour online images for pictures of other Pokémon, pulling the graphics apart for their components. They synthesise body parts for themselves from these destroyed graphics, showing a preference for clawed limbs and sharp teeth.

entry: POKENAME通常在丛林疯狂爬树、荡藤。它爱释陀果，因为身体需要大量糖，支撑旺盛精力。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are usually found in the jungle, frantically climbing trees and swinging from vines. They love Custap berries as their bodies need lots of sugar to fuel their energy needs.

entry: POKENAME整天活跃，爬树快得惊人，不停在枝间跳。只有睡着，才停止移动。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME is active all day, climbing trees with astonishing speed and leaping from branch to branch. It only stops moving when it sleeps.

entry: 它想照顾植物，却躁动得无法久留。穿过森林，留下沿途重新种下的花，以及被尾巴胡乱修剪的树。
author: .jerden
source: It tries to care for plants, but is too restless to stay in one place. As it moves through the forest, it leaves a trail of replanted flowers and trees it has haphazardly pruned with its tail.

entry: POKENAME腹中火焰，使它静不下来。常兴奋到打嗝吐火球，却也只停片刻，就又继续游荡。
author: .jerden
source: A fire in POKENAME's belly prevents it from keeping still. It will frequently become excited enough to belch out balls of fire, which only makes it pause for a moment before it resumes its wandering.

entry: POKENAME始终精力充沛，找不到敌人交战，就快速踢空气，或猛打树木，直到木头开裂。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME is constantly filled with energy. If it cannot find an opponent to fight, POKENAME will rapidly kick the air or find a tree to strike until the wood begins to splinter.

entry: POKENAME跳得太多、太高，常被误认为飞行属性。战斗时更加活跃，四处冲，任意肢体都能拿来攻击。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME leaps around so much and so high that it is often mistaken for a Flying-type Pokémon. In combat, it becomes even more hyperactive, rushing about to strike foes with any of its limbs.

entry: POKENAME爱给别人跳舞，却太活跃，舞姿散乱，让大多观众晕头转向。若没人为努力鼓掌，它就闹别扭跑走。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME enjoys dancing for others, but its hyperactive nature causes its dances to be unfocused and disorienting to most observers. It sulks and runs off if not applauded for its efforts.

entry: POKENAME精力满溢，行为狂野、不受约束。只顾用打架或游戏取乐，甚至开始忽略吃饭、卫生。
author: sk372
source: Brimming with energy, POKENAME behaves in a wild, unbridled manner. It's constantly focused on entertaining itself with fights or games, to the point it may begin neglecting things like food or hygiene.

entry: POKENAME睡眠不足，会分泌红色毒素，接触便让别人精力充沛。受害者躁动不安，无法入睡。
author: .izik
source: If sleep-deprived, POKENAME secretes a red toxin that energizes others on contact. Victims become restless, unable to sleep.

entry: POKENAME身体太活跃，几乎不能控制变色能力。色彩不断变换，仿佛迷幻图案，敌我都可能晕眩。
author: sk372
source: Because its body is so hyperactive, POKENAME has little to no control over its color change ability. Its constantly changing hues shift in an almost psychedelic pattern that can disorient friends and foes alike.

entry: POKENAME精力无穷，好斗又抽动不停。靠近石头很危险，它会现身，用爪子疯狂斩向任何靠近的活物。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's boundless energy makes it highly aggressive and twitchy. Getting anywhere near its stone is hazardous, as it will manifest and slash wildly with its claws at any living thing that gets close.

entry: POKENAME常吊在丛林树上，落下伏击毫无戒备的猎物。背上大芽产生酸液，任何接触的植物都会枯萎。
author: adsfw11
source: POKENAME is known to hang from trees in the jungle, dropping on unsuspecting prey. The large sprout on POKENAME's back produces acidic liquid that wilts any plant life it touches.

entry: POKENAME的透明毒液先让对方突然过度活跃，随后深深疲惫。战斗中被激怒，它就分泌更多。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's clear poison grants bursts of hyperactivity followed by deep fatigue. It secretes more of this toxin when provoked in battle.

entry: POKENAME的巨颚冲动、凭本能行动，附近只要有食物味就乱咬。一旦开始，本体必须费极大力气才制得住。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's massive jaws are highly impulsive and react on instinct, chomping wildly at the mere scent of food in its vicinity. It takes considerable effort on the main body's part to reign it in once it gets going.

entry: POKENAME有请假王的力量，却像过动猿般静不下来，被视为极危险。见它狂暴冲过，就连凶猛、领地意识强的宝可梦也会逃。
author: sk372
source: It is considered highly dangerous due to having Slaking's strength with Vigoroth's inability to calm down. Even vicious and territorial Pokémon flee when POKENAME is seen rabidly charging through the area.

entry: POKENAME不停追逐猎物，连海洋最深处也追去。虽然必须上浮呼吸，大鼻子却能快速吸气，充满巨大肺部。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME constantly chases after prey and will pursue it even to the deepest depths of the ocean. While it has to surface to breathe, it can quickly fill its massive lungs with air by inhaling through its large nose.

entry: 若见远处光柱快速出现、消失，很可能有POKENAME。它精力无穷、无法静止，便不停瞬间移动，发泄多余能量。
author: sk372
source: If one spots pillars of light rapidly appearing and disappearing in the distance, it's likely a sign that POKENAME is present. Full of boundless energy, it cannot stay still and teleports constantly to blow off the excess steam.

entry: POKENAME背上灌木长得快、掉得也快。它总用壳撞树，抖掉枯枝败叶。
author: santon5512
source: The bushes along POKENAME's back grow and shed rapidly. They are constantly bashing their shells against trees to shake off dead leaves and branches.

entry: POKENAME太活跃，很容易兴奋到发狂。此时会从尾焰舀火，四处扔火球，直到平静下来。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's hyperactive nature means it easily goes into an overexcited frenzy. While in this state, it scoops up fire from the flame on its tail and flings fireballs all about until it manages to calm down.

entry: POKENAME用角给巢穴入口涂毒。闯入者还没来得及逃，就会挨上地狱突刺。
author: .izik
source: In its den, POKENAME coats the entrance in poison using its horn. It attacks intruders with Throat Chop before they can flee.

entry: POKENAME一整天四处匆忙行动，最后总比出发时更靠北。迁到海边才停，因为岩石身体太沉，浮不起来。
author: .jerden
source: While POKENAME spend the day hurrying around, they always finish further north than when they started. Their migrations eventually stop when they reach the ocean, as their rocky bodies are too heavy to float.

entry: POKENAME的3只小爪，在身体周围高速旋转。利爪是金属制的，磁力推动斩击，威力强大。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's three small claws revolve around its body at high speed. Their sharp claws are made of metal, and magnetic force propels their powerful slashes.

entry: POKENAME性情狂野、精力无穷，对训练家却友好。但要小心，它喜欢全力撞上来，表示亲昵。
author: mistymagius
source: Despite its wild personality and unstoppable amounts of energy, POKENAME is quite friendly towards its Trainer. However, be cautious, as POKENAME loves to tackle them at full force to show affection.

entry: POKENAME双眼极强，始终观察周围，从没被见过眨眼。体内产电过多，奔跑时四肢也噼啪闪着雷电。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's eyes are extremely powerful, ceaselessly observing its surroundings and never being seen blinking. Lightning crackles along its limbs as it scampers about, due to excessive electrical generation in its body.

entry: POKENAME精力始终过剩，飘带不停疯狂甩动。最好保持距离，因为带尖有利爪，能划出疼痛伤口。
author: sk372
source: Always brimming with excessive energy, POKENAME's ribbons whip around frantically at all times. One should keep their distance, as these ribbons are tipped with sharp claws that can cause painful gashes.

entry: POKENAME精力过剩，飘带不停在周身乱甩。防守时，它能磨利带边，切斩一切靠得太近的对象。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's ribbons constantly thrash about around it due to its excessive energy. When on the defensive, it can sharpen the edges of the ribbons, using them to cut and slash at anything drawing too close.

entry: POKENAME不断跳舞，臂上花朵的甜辣香气四处飘散。其他宝可梦靠近，可能被毒刺扎到，有时故意，有时似乎只是意外。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME constantly dances, wafting around the sweet but spicy smell of the flowers on its arms. If any other Pokémon gets close, POKENAME may jab them with its poisonous thorns, sometimes deliberately and sometimes seemingly by accident.

entry: POKENAME奔跑时，头上飘出灯浆果香的孢子。吸入后，它自己的精力便一阵阵涌起，动作活泼、毫无规律。
author: .izik
source: Chilan Berry-scented spores drift from POKENAME's head as it runs. Breathing them in triggers bursts of energy and erratic, playful movement within its own body.

entry: POKENAME从不停动，随意乱飞，消耗无穷精力。即使难得睡片刻，身体仍震动，翅膀仍抽动。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is perpetually in motion, flying around in random haphazard patterns to burn off a limitless supply of energy. Even the few moments it spends sleeping, its body still vibrates and its wings still twitch.

entry: POKENAME织网极快，几分钟就造出复杂编织结构。动作快得积起电，导进网中，织网时便噼啪作响、电弧闪动。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME spins its webs at an incredible speed, creating complex woven structures in mere minutes. It moves so fast it builds up electricity, transferring it into the webs, which crackle and arc as it spins.

entry: POKENAME冲过森林，火焰格外旺，照亮暗处。但它常意外撞树，有时会引起小型野火。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's flame burns with surprising vigor as it dashes through the forest to light up dark spots. However, it often crashes into trees by accident, sometimes starting small wildfires.

entry: POKENAME嘴里伸出一只钳，轻松夹碎珊瑚。它极挑，觉得不配吃的碎片，都会吐掉。
author: .izik
source: A claw extends from POKENAME's mouth to crush coral with ease. It's highly selective, spitting out pieces it deems unworthy.

entry: POKENAME发现猎物，便大声咆哮，让对方逃跑。无穷精力驱使它，享受这疯狂追逐。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME lets out a bellowing roar when it spots prey, sending them fleeing. It revels in the wild chase, driven by its boundless energy.

entry: POKENAME靠波导感知，寻找精力充沛的宝可梦。找到后，就挑战接连不断的快速切磋。
author: .izik
source: Using aura senses, POKENAME searches for energetic Pokémon. Once found, it challenges them to rapid-fire sparring bouts.

entry: POKENAME醒着时精力太足，始终至少有一个部位在动。它们不断活动，包括用力以爪捶胸，肌肉也因此发达。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are so full of energy when they are awake that they are always moving at least one part of their bodies. Their constant physical actions, including their fervent beating of their paws upon their chests, keep their muscles well developed.

entry: POKENAME虽能游泳，大多时候却在陆上。它不停弹跳，仿佛一刻都静不下，连睡觉也上下晃。
author: .jerden
source: While POKENAME can swim, it spends most of its time on land. POKENAME constantly bounces around and seems to be unable to keep still for a moment, even bobbing up and down in its sleep.

entry: POKENAME头上红毛突然竖起，就是风暴将至的信号。它迅速穿过所住树枝，用长爪抓树干，采集果实。
author: fiordaliso
source: When the red tuft on its head suddenly stands on end, it is a sign that a storm is approaching. POKENAME moves swiftly among the tree branches it inhabits, using its long claws to cling to trunks while gathering fruit.

entry: POKENAME急躁冲动，常一头冲进危险。好斗的喊声略有催眠作用，研究者因此推测，若叫得更长，也许能让人睡着。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are impatient and impulsive, often running headlong into dangerous situations. Their aggressive shouts have a mildly soporific effect, leading Researchers to theorise they could send people to sleep if they made longer calls.

entry: POKENAME以强颚快速钻地。它常突然精力迸发，冲过地道，攻击一切移动的东西。
author: _lazygod_
source: POKENAME is known for using its powerful jaws to dig rapidly through the ground. It often has sudden bursts of energy, charging through tunnels and attacking anything that moves.

entry: POKENAME边走边疯狂旋转，散发混乱能量。这动作积起电，接触便会放出。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME rotates furiously as it moves, radiating chaotic energy. This motion builds electricity that discharges on contact.

entry: POKENAME为威吓，会先鼓身再呼气，挥舞手臂、大声乱叫。但大多对象看着，反而只觉得滑稽。
author: sk372
source: In order to intimidate, POKENAME inflates its body before exhaling, waving its arms about while hooting wildly. For most, this has the opposite effect and makes it look rather comical instead.

entry: POKENAME感到安全，就用小腿尽量飞奔。若觉得被谁威胁，便坐到上风处，释放毒花粉云自卫。
author: .jerden
source: If POKENAME feels safe, it will rush around as fast as its little legs can carry it. If it feels threatened by anyone, it will sit down upwind of their location, then release a cloud of toxic pollen to defend itself.

entry: POKENAME整天不停动，仿佛非跳舞不可。花香让人和宝可梦充满精力，常跟在身后，模仿动作。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME never stops moving all day and seems to be compelled to dance. The scent of its flowers fills people and Pokémon with energy, and they will often follow behind it, copying its movements.

entry: POKENAME代谢极快，胃口几乎无穷。它嚼着土前进，吃得太多，常把花园、甚至林中树木连根掀起。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has an almost endless appetite due to its body's rapid metabolism. It chews through soil, often uprooting gardens and even trees within forests with its excessive eating.

entry: POKENAME生气时，头周围的胶状物会竖成尖。有些能量饮料用这种胶作原料。
author: hophoppip
source: The jelly-like substance around POKENAME's head spikes up when it's feeling incensed. Some energy drinks use the jelly as an ingredient.

entry: POKENAME昼夜飞行，没有眼睛，便发出超声波叫声、聆听回声辨路。可它转向太突然，仍常撞上东西。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME flies around both during the day and at night. Lacking eyes, it navigates by emitting ultrasonic cries and listening for the echoes, but it frequently changes directions so abruptly that it collides with objects anyway.

entry: 它们成群围观人类与宝可梦，满脸不屑，还要捉弄一番。毛发有多长，便代表地位有多高。
author: ayner
source: In groups, they watch Pokémon and Trainer alike with disdain and pull pranks on them. The length of their hair indicates their rank in the hierarchy.

entry: POKENAME战斗时精力涌动，旋转金属身体。旋转中集中精神，释放破坏力极强的攻击。
author: .izik
source: In combat, POKENAME spins its metal body while surging with energy. While spinning, it focuses to unleash devastating attacks.

entry: 清晨，POKENAME精力充沛，用带鳍的头撞树干，留下深槽，标记领地。
author: .izik
source: During early mornings, POKENAME is brimming with energy. It slams tree trunks with its finned head, leaving deep grooves to mark its territory.

entry: POKENAME几乎不睡，必须尽可能多吃才能维持。不到30秒，就能吸干一整个西瓜的水分。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME almost never sleeps, so it has to gobble down as much food as it can find to keep going. It can drain an entire watermelon of all of its fluids in less than 30 seconds.

entry: POKENAME满心想宣泄积压的能量，偏偏冷得一直发抖，根本腾不出空来。
author: hummusishome
source: POKENAME yearns to release all of its pent up energy, but it is too busy shivering in the cold to do anything about it.

entry: POKENAME跳舞快得疯狂、节奏杂乱，产生大量火焰，常不小心点燃周围。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME dances at an insanely fast and chaotic pace. This causes it to produce a large amount of fire in the process, often inadvertently setting its surroundings ablaze.

entry: POKENAME完全失明，头上果实的眼状花纹，只为分散捕食者注意。果实极苦，咖啡因却相当于15份意式浓缩咖啡，食用极危险。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is completely blind, as the fruits on its head have eye-like markings to distract predators. While the fruits are incredibly bitter, they contain as much caffeine as fifteen shots of espresso, making them incredibly dangerous to consume.

entry: POKENAME外表可爱，力量却格外强，也爱生气。对训练家，尤其年轻训练家，它很难应付，因为情绪爆发可能伤人。
author: vic1312
source: Despite their adorable appearance, POKENAME are exceptionally powerful and angry. They are often a challenge for their Trainers, especially young ones, as their emotional outbursts can put their trainers at risk of injury.

entry: POKENAME身体不停产生大量肾上腺素，便在森林里横冲直撞。虽然很暴烈，它却不喜欢故意伤害人类。
author: mistymagius
source: Its body constantly produces large amounts of adrenaline, so it ends up rampaging all over the forest. Despite how violent it can get, POKENAME doesn't like to intentionally hurt humans.

entry: POKENAME的蘑菇富含皮质醇，不断将这种压力激素分泌进宿主体内，迫使它一直活动。它从一树冲向另一树，留下一路孢子。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME mushrooms are high in cortisol, continuously secreting the stress hormone into the body of their host. This pushes POKENAME to be constantly active, rushing from tree to tree and leaving a trail of spores behind it.

entry: POKENAME疯狂在树间跳跃，散播孢子。吸入者会过度活跃、富有攻击性，持续几小时后，终于累倒。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME leaps around frantically from tree to tree, spreading its spores. If inhaled, these spores induce hyperactivity and aggression in those affected, lasting a few hours before they collapse from exhaustion.

entry: POKENAME想静也静不下来，即使失去意识，仍不停抽动、颤抖。尚未证实，但科学家推测，它可能是心跳最快的宝可梦。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME cannot sit still if it tried, constantly twitching and shaking even while unconscious. While it has not been confirmed, Scientist theorize that POKENAME has the fastest heartbeat of any Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME从不睡，昼夜都在森林飞掠。不过，必须吃大量树果才能维持，通常专吃释陀果和沙鳞果。
author: mistymagius
