source: POKENAME never sleep and can be seen zipping around the forest all day and all night. However, they need to eat a lot of berries to keep going, usually feeding on Custap and Salac Berries specifically.

entry: POKENAME飘上高空，再以极快速度猛撞地面，反复如此，消耗过于庞大的多余精力。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME floats on high to crash down into the ground at breakneck speed, before repeating the process. It does this to burn off an exceedingly vast supply of surplus energy.

entry: POKENAME始终活跃，挖地不休，似乎从不用睡。钳子连硬岩都能轻松挖穿，深受矿工喜爱。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are constantly active, burrowing without pausing to rest and seemingly never needing to sleep. Their claws make digging through even tough rocks trivial, making them popular with miners.

entry: POKENAME有时突然精力狂暴，高速奔跑，用爪子抓倒霉的挡路者。只有送上一盘鱼类宝可梦，才能让它平静。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are sometimes abruptly seized with a mad energy, racing around at high speed and clawing at those unfortunate enough to be in their path. They can only be calmed from this state by an offering of a plate of fish Pokémon.

entry: 强健的四肢与几乎无穷的精力，让POKENAME能接连追猎12小时而不疲倦。不过，POKENAME时速最高可达60英里，狩猎通常根本不用那么久。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's strong limbs and almost limitless energy allow for it to pursue its prey for up to 12 hours without tiring. Its hunts don't last that long, however, since POKENAME can run up to 60 mph.

entry: POKENAME代谢将超能力增强到压垮心智。它恍惚摇摆地走，念力不受控制，举起、乱扔周围东西，自己却毫无察觉。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's metabolism has hypercharged its psychic powers to the point of overwhelming its mind. It waddles around in a daze, its telekinesis uncontrollably lifting and flinging things around it without it even noticing.

entry: POKENAME常自己越闹越狂，呼吸急促，觉得哪怕一丝敌意，就冲向别人。它用强肌肉和利爪，凶狠快速地抓向惹怒自己的对象。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME regularly work themselves up into a frenzy, breathing rapidly and charging at others for even the smallest perceived aggression. They rapidly swipe at the subject of their ire, brutally wielding powerful muscles and sharp claws.

entry: POKENAME闻见陌生气味，就高速追去，本该是好追踪者。但它太容易被新气味分心，常又更想追别的。
author: .jerden
source: If POKENAME smells an unfamiliar scent, it will chase after it at high speed. While this would make them excellent trackers, POKENAME are easily distracted by new odors and frequently end up more interested in pursuing something else.

entry: POKENAME体内有火，不断提供精力。没有猎物可追，就追自己的尾巴，高速绕圈。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME has fire burning inside it, filling it with energy at all times. If it doesn't have prey to pursue, it will chase its own tail, running in circles at extreme speed.

entry: POKENAME从腹部螺旋分泌强效兴奋物质，混入体表那层黏液。它精力仿佛无穷，碰到的对象也会同样躁动。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME secrete a potent stimulant from the spiral on their belly, the chemical mixing with the slimy film that coats their body. They are filled with a seemingly endless supply of energy, imparting that same restlessness in those who touch them.

entry: POKENAME体力过剩，几乎无法待在同一处。它不断瞬间移动，仿佛毫无规律，只为消耗多余精神能量。
author: sk372
source: An overabundance of stamina means it's all but impossible for POKENAME to remain in one place. It teleports around constantly, seemingly at random, just to burn off excess psychic energy.

entry: POKENAME不停摆弄勺子，磨擦太多，连金属都磨损。勺子若被拿走，就什么也无法专注。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME constantly fidgets with its spoon, rubbing it so much that the metal begins to wear down. If the spoon is taken away, it will be unable to focus on anything at all.

entry: POKENAME渴望不断获得智力刺激，拼拼图、解填字、下国际象棋，却很快厌倦，转找下个消遣。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME craves constant mental stimulation. It will assemble jigsaws, solve crossword puzzles, and play games of chess, but quickly grows bored and moves on to the next distraction.

entry: POKENAME强壮、精力充沛，喜欢搬东西。许多受雇搬家公司，往卡车搬上、搬下箱子家具，帮人入住新家。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are strong and energetic creatures that enjoy carrying things. Many are employed at moving companies to help people settle into a new home, lifting boxes and furniture to and from trucks.

entry: POKENAME很能帮忙，替新房主搬家具。一只就能同时举起床和沙发，毫不费劲。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are handy creatures that help new homeowners carry furniture. A single POKENAME can lift a bed and a sofa without breaking a sweat.

entry: POKENAME虽无四肢，精力却太旺，很难安坐。舌上覆着强效兴奋物质，能导致最多3天失眠。
author: mistymagius
source: Despite its lack of limbs, POKENAME struggles to sit still due to its boundless energy. Its tongue is coated in a potent stimulant that can cause insomnia for up to 3 days.

entry: POKENAME虽然无腿，仍不停移动。动作抖动、杂乱，战斗中很难预测下一步。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME is constantly on the move despite its lack of legs. Its motions are shaky and random, making it hard to predict its next move in battle.

entry: POKENAME高举双臂，让肢体上的眼睛看清周围。若发现有趣东西，就快速跳跃，追逐想看的目标。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME raises its arms high so the eyes on its limbs can give it a better view of its surroundings. If it spots something interesting, it makes speedy leaps and bounds to hunt down the object of intrigue.

entry: POKENAME花纹快速变化，棕白色块不断流过全身。愤怒时变得更快，不熟悉的人看去，仿佛成了米色。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's pattern rapidly shifts, brown and white patches flowing across it. When it's angry, it shifts colors even faster, appearing beige to the untrained eye.

entry: POKENAME住在河岸，整天用舌头挖沙土。偶尔虽找到食物，似乎更多只是躁动，也不会在任何洞里久留。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME lives on riverbanks, using its tongue to burrow in the sand and dirt all day. While it sometimes finds food, it seems to do this more out of restlessness, and it will not stay in any of these burrows for long.

entry: POKENAME住在河里，向一切靠近者连续发刺。没有其他宝可梦作目标，就射漂过水面的东西。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME lives in rivers and constantly fires volleys of spikes at anything that gets close. If it doesn't have another Pokémon to target, it will simply fire them off at objects floating by on the water current.

entry: POKENAME沿河岸游荡，寻找呆呆兽咬。尾巴和头的味道都喜欢，却躁动得咬不住太久，很快便松开，继续逛。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME roams around riverbanks, searching for Slowpoke to bite. While it enjoys the taste of their tails and heads, it is too restless to hold on for long and quickly lets go to wander off.

entry: POKENAME的脸太软、牙太脆，无法挖掘。它改用手臂般的壮尾，粉碎岩石。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Its face is too soft and its teeth are too fragile to be used for digging. Instead, POKENAME pulverizes stone with its hulking arm-like tail.

entry: POKENAME精力无穷，钟摆甩得太乱，催眠不了谁，因此常改用物理攻击。
author: hophoppip
source: Full of boundless energy, POKENAME swings its pendulum too wildly to put anyone to sleep. It tends to resort to physical attacks for this reason.

entry: POKENAME常在岩石海滩出现。风暴天，一群可以充当水手的临时灯塔。
author: seanothan_23
source: POKENAME are often seen around rocky beaches. Groups of POKENAME can act as a makeshift lighthouse for sailors in stormy weather.

entry: POKENAME在热门海滩滚动，外形让许多游客误当排球。倒霉的人若拿它垫球、扣球，就会被几加仑水淋个透。
author: bradlybro199
source: POKENAME roll around on popular beaches, and due to their appearance, many tourists assume them to be volleyballs. Those unfortunate enough to use it for a game will get soaked by gallons of water when they decide to bump or spike it.

entry: POKENAME身体颜色鲜艳，常被误当沙滩球。一被抛上空，就会爆炸，散出浓密盐水雾。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are often mistaken for beach balls because of their brightly colored body. POKENAME explode when tossed into the air, dispersing a dense saltwater mist around them.

entry: POKENAME在海面漂游，毒害周围的水。偶尔毒气胀得太厉害，就会升空，可能被风吹到陆地。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME drifts around on the surface of the ocean, poisoning the water around it. Occasionally, it becomes so bloated with toxic gas that it floats up into the air and may be blown onto land by the wind.

entry: POKENAME造泡泡引猎物，小型宝可梦很爱玩。泡泡却含能使目标麻痹、丧失行动能力的毒素。
author: dodoowner_
source: To attract prey, POKENAME produces bubbles that small Pokémon like to play with. These bubbles contain neutralizing toxins which will paralyze the target.

entry: POKENAME总是失去平衡，走路十分费劲。头若能小一点，本可以用四肢行走。
author: hummusishome
source: Walking is difficult for POKENAME as they are constantly off balance. They would walk on all fours if the size of their head was a bit smaller.

entry: 它喜欢与同类成群浮在浅滩，调皮地喷水。轻柔水流，也保护着更小的海洋宝可梦。
author: .izik
source: It enjoys floating in the shallows with schools of its kind, releasing playful jets of water. These gentle currents provide protection to smaller sea Pokémon.

entry: 它优雅滑过水中，绕圈制造迷人的漩涡，轻松捕捉小猎物。
author: .izik
source: It gracefully glides through the water, spinning in circles to create mesmerizing whirlpools. These whirlpools help it catch smaller prey with minimal effort.

entry: 集装箱船经过POKENAME原生栖息地，震动使同类难以沟通。许多个体只好用角刺过去，表达苦恼。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME struggle to communicate with their kin because of vibrations from container ships that sail past their native habitat. Many resort to stabbing with their horns to communicate distress.

entry: POKENAME住在水边，会爬上岸，和人及宝可梦玩。但得小心别玩太粗鲁，因为它无法像海星星那样轻松再生肢体。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME dwells near the water's edge. While it will go ashore to play with people and Pokémon, it must be careful not to be played with too roughly: it cannot easily regenerate limbs like Staryu.

entry: POKENAME用长而方正的鳍肢，在海滩附近游动，滤食小型水生宝可梦，让身体越长越壮。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME swim near beaches with their long, blocky flippers. They filter feed for small aquatic Pokémon to build up their bulky bodies.

entry: POKENAME浮在海面，用大鳍肢轻轻旋转身体。它们爱顽皮地朝经过的拉普拉斯喷水。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME float along the ocean's surface, gently spinning themselves with their large flippers. POKENAME are known for playfully blowing water at passing Lapras.

entry: POKENAME慢慢挪近池塘边，把叶片拖过水面，沾些水珠，好让身体凉下来。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME trudge close to the banks of ponds and drag their leaves across the surface. In this way, they wet them with drops to cool themselves down.

entry: POKENAME常跳进河湖消暑，身上的芽也趁机吸饱水，储存几个月都没问题。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME regularly jumps into lakes and rivers to cool off. In doing so, the buds on its body soak up water. They can hold it for months.

entry: POKENAME性情温和，喜欢交际，是训练家很受欢迎的伙伴。它还能从颈部放出清凉的水。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME has a gentle and sociable disposition, which makes it a popular partner for Pokémon Trainers. It can emit refreshing water from its neck.

entry: 它在深海游泳时发出脉冲光，引迷失的宝可梦前往安全处。渔夫也学会循光，寻找小型鱼类宝可梦群。
author: .izik
source: It produces pulses of light while swimming in the deep sea, guiding lost Pokémon toward safety. Fishermen have learned to follow its glow to find schools of smaller fish Pokémon.

entry: 发光球即使在最暗深海也能看见。许多水手误认为引路灯，却不知附近还潜伏着深海生物。
author: .izik
source: Its glowing orbs are visible even in the darkest ocean depths. Many sailors mistake it for a guiding light, unaware of the deep-sea creatures lurking nearby.

entry: POKENAME周身有气泡壳，沿海滩走时能保护自己。泡一破，就赶回海里恢复。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a protective bubble shell around their body that protects them while they roam beaches. Whenever the bubble pops, they rush back to the sea to restore their bubble.

entry: 它调皮地在海面弹跳，用橡胶般身体溅起大水花。沿海城镇的节庆期间，常能见它们一起玩。
author: .izik
source: It bounces playfully on the ocean's surface, using its rubbery body to create large splashes. Coastal towns often see them playing together during festivals.

entry: POKENAME极轻，微风就能让它升空飞走。它能通过身体吸水、头顶喷水孔排水，调节体内水量。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is so light that, with a gentle breeze, it can take off and fly through the sky. It can regulate the water levels in its body through bodily absorption and spurting through the blowhole on its head.

entry: POKENAME刚孵出时很小，随后不断长大，最终进化。它偏爱沿稳定洋流旅行。
author: bobosmith01
source: When hatched, POKENAME starts small in size, but it steadily grows until it eventually evolves. It prefers to travel in steady sea currents.

entry: POKENAME在水下不断制造水流，每秒吸入、排出数百升水。成群行动，甚至能形成小规模的全球洋流。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME creates a constant flow when underwater, drinking and expelling hundreds of litres of water a second. Pods of POKENAME can even create small global ocean currents.

entry: POKENAME在水下不断制造水流，每秒吸入、排出数百升水。其他宝可梦常被卷进去，但吐出来时都毫发无损。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME creates a constant flow when underwater, drinking and expelling hundreds of litres of water a second. Other Pokémon are often dragged into these currents but are spat out unscathed.

entry: POKENAME带着无忧的笑，在浅水中摇摆，用尾巴搅泥。看似无害，却常不小心扯松渔网，拖进深处，惹出麻烦。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME waddles through shallow waters with a carefree smile, using its tail to stir up mud. Though it looks harmless, it often causes trouble by accidentally dislodging fishing nets and dragging them to the depths.

entry: POKENAME紧密结成小群，用带刺身体互相保护。它们用低频叫声沟通，协调动作，漂过海洋觅食。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME travels in small, tight groups, using their spiked bodies to protect one another. They communicate with low frequency calls to coordinate their movements as they drift through the sea in search of food.

entry: 古代水手珍视POKENAME的壳，许多远征队专门出发捕猎，卖作美丽饰品。如今族群只在深海发现，沿海底山脉迁徙。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME shells were prized by mariners in antiquity, with many expeditions setting out with the goal to hunt them and sell their shells as beautiful ornaments. POKENAME pods are now only found deep in the ocean, migrating along underwater mountains.

entry: 它喜欢歇在珊瑚丛上，身覆碎珊瑚伪装。受惊时，就高速吐出珊瑚碎片自卫。
author: .izik
source: It enjoys resting on coral beds, covering its body in shards of broken coral for camouflage. When startled, it spits them out at high speeds as a defense.

entry: POKENAME用强触手推动身体，在水中快得惊人。大嘴能吸入大群鱼，再将鱼集中喷出，震晕附近猎物。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME uses its powerful tentacles to propel itself through the water with surprising speed. Its enormous mouth can vacuum up large schools of fish, which it then spits out in concentrated bursts to stun nearby prey.

entry: 它喜欢成大群随洋流旅行，有时搭大型海洋宝可梦的便车。水流越平稳，看起来越开心。
author: .izik
source: It enjoys riding ocean currents alongside large groups of its kind, sometimes hitching rides on larger sea Pokémon. The smoother the current, the happier it seems.

entry: POKENAME冲浪姿态优雅，深受沿海摄影者喜爱。剧烈活动后，它喜欢在潮池休息、补水。
author: jojojax164
source: POKENAME are popular subjects for coastal photographers because they appear elegant while surfing. After intense physical activity, POKENAME enjoy resting and hydrating in tide pools.

entry: POKENAME在地下湖孵化、长大一阵，再随父母前往海洋。长得越大，就越接近进化。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME are hatched and raised for some time in underground lakes before leaving with their parents to go out to the ocean. The larger they become, the closer they are to evolution.

entry: 它很爱玩，深受潜水者喜爱，常好奇靠近。在浪下滑行时，还会开心吱叫。
author: .izik
source: Its playful nature makes it a favorite among divers, often approaching them curiously. It emits joyful squeaks while gliding just beneath the waves.

entry: POKENAME虽小，却能吸入近2加仑水；只有准备上陆时才吸这么多。平时虽沿海底走，腿却也已发育得足以游泳。
author: infinex21
source: Although small, POKENAME can inhale nearly two gallons of water; they only inhale that much when they plan to walk on land. Though they typically walk along the seabed, their legs are developed enough to be used for swimming.

entry: POKENAME体内充气，与同群穿行各港口。它从浪里讨食，希望游客将吃的抛进海中。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body fills with air as it travels with its pod from port to port. It begs from the waves for tourists to toss food into the ocean.

entry: POKENAME虽笨手笨脚，却雄心不小。可一到陆地走路，又常被自己绊倒。
author: neonriser
source: POKENAME is a clumsy but ambitious creature. It often trips and falls while walking on land.

entry: POKENAME每次上浮，或与朋友嬉戏，都会从鼻孔喷水。平时虽外向爱玩，休息前后却会害羞一阵，变色藏身。
author: infinex21
source: It spouts water from its nostrils whenever it surfaces and as a playful act with friends. Although often outgoingly playful, POKENAME is shy for a period of time before and after resting, changing its hues to avoid being perceived.

entry: POKENAME常待在其他大牙狸、大尾狸筑的坝旁，晒太阳，享受同伴的劳动成果。作为回报，它用身体暂时堵住水坝漏口。
author: thescribe
source: POKENAME is found near dams made by other Bidoof and Bibarel, where it bathes in the sun and enjoys the fruits of the other Pokémon's labour. In return, POKENAME uses its body to temporarily block any leaks in the dam.

entry: POKENAME在海底休息，住进沉船留下的锚。性情友好，却常因突然现身想玩，吓坏深海潜水者。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME rests at the bottom of the sea, inhabiting anchors left behind by shipwrecks. It has a friendly disposition, but its sudden appearance while wanting to play has frightened many a deep-sea diver.

entry: POKENAME在海滩休息，却常被强烈饥饿驱使捕猎。它先远射高压水流，再靠近，用有力双臂抓住。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME rests on beaches, but is regularly driven to hunt by its ravenous hunger. It attacks prey from a distance by firing high-pressure jets of water, then closes in to grab it with its powerful arms.

entry: POKENAME整天在岸边滚动，把鼓胀身体当巨垫，撞上岩石又弹开。个头太大，笨拙的玩闹常无意间弄得浪花猛拍、惊动当地野生生物。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME spends its days rolling around the shore, using its inflated body as a giant cushion to bounce off rocks. Its massive size often causes unintended chaos, sending waves crashing and startling local wildlife with its clumsy antics.

entry: POKENAME越开心，喷水孔射水越强。极度喜悦时，它会咬住结实的树，固定自己，抵住喷水的巨大压力。
author: jaminmcready
source: The intensity of the water ejected from POKENAME's blowhole increases alongside its level of happiness. POKENAME bites onto a sturdy tree when feeling extreme joy to anchor itself against the immense pressure of the resulting blast.

entry: 洪水时，POKENAME用壳载小型宝可梦。可它太爱滚，有时忘了乘客，边走边转，将大家甩上天。
author: .izik
source: During floods, POKENAME carries small Pokémon on its shell. Because it loves to roll, it sometimes forgets they are there and flings them through the air as it spins during travel.

entry: POKENAME常潜到超过800英尺深的地方觅食。深处滤食，能吃到的漂浮有机物，远比近水面多。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME regularly dives beyond 800 feet in search of food. By filter-feeding in the deep, it consumes much larger quantities of drifting organic matter than it can near the surface.

entry: 船只放锚，常会引来POKENAME。它盯着锚好几个小时，研究动作。
author: .izik
source: When ships lower their anchors, it tends to attract POKENAME. It stares at the anchor for hours, studying its movements.

entry: 野生POKENAME吃珍珠，靠磁场穿过海底，猎食带珍珠的珍珠贝。上陆时，还会捕猎跳跳猪。
author: cobalt0135
source: Wild POKENAME eat pearls and use the magnetic field to traverse the seabed to hunt for Clampearl that hold them. They also hunt Spoink whenever POKENAME are on land.

entry: 野生POKENAME用磁场确定茫茫海洋中的迁徙方向。它们常成群旅行，用磁波彼此沟通。
author: cobalt0135
source: Wild POKENAME use the magnetic field to determine where to migrate across the vast ocean. They often travel in groups and will use their magnetic waves to communicate with each other.

entry: POKENAME体型虽大，却只取食小鱼群的生命力。它也爱与海滩游客互相泼水，比个高下。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: Despite its size, POKENAME only harvests the life force of schools of small fish. It enjoys splash-offs with beach goers.

entry: POKENAME会拍打小鱼群，夺取生命力，却也喜欢与游客泼水嬉戏，被当作沙滩球拍来拍去。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: Though it smacks the life force out of small schools of fish, POKENAME also enjoys splashing water at beach-goers and being hit like a beach ball.

entry: POKENAME将空气中的水分存进利刃，释放时引来突发风暴，淋湿附近一切。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME stores moisture from the air in its blades. When released, it creates a sudden storm that drenches everything nearby.

entry: POKENAME体内空气、海水比例均衡，轻松就能滚过海面。全速前进时，它会向经过的对象释放安抚气场。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body fills with a balanced mixture of air and seawater that allows it to roll across the ocean's surface with ease. While at top speed it releases a calming aura to those it passes by.

entry: 海啸过后，常能见到POKENAME在被淹海岸徘徊。研究者争论原因，最主流的推测是，它们被造成巨浪的强流带上岸。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are typically found stalking along the flooded shoreline in the aftermath of tsunamis. Pokémon Researchers actively debate why they do this, the leading theory is that they are brought ashore by the powerful currents creating the tidal wave.

entry: 带泡沫的水不停流过POKENAME身体，洗去尘土污垢。圆身体轻又有弹性，能高高跃起。
author: sk372
source: Sudsy water pours constantly across POKENAME's body, keeping it clean of dirt and grime. Its round body is light and bouncy, giving it the capacity to make great leaps into the air.

entry: POKENAME爱用能伸缩的双臂玩闹打架。喝下很多水，尾巴就胀成沙滩球大，也一样能弹。
author: foolish_weasel
source: It likes to play fight with its stretchy arms. When POKENAME drinks a lot of water, its tail inflates to the size of a beach ball, being just as bouncy as one.

entry: POKENAME拿着的盖子，由类似青金石的宝石制成。若盖子碎了，便拿找得到的材料替换。
author: dodoowner_
source: The lid that POKENAME holds is made out of a gemstone similar to lapis lazuli. If the lid happens to break, POKENAME will replace it with whatever material it can find.

entry: POKENAME大多在海底休息，用带刺附肢攀岩固定。它常黏船偷鱼，已成渔夫眼里的著名害兽。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME spend most of their time resting on the ocean floor by using their spiny appendages to latch onto rocks for stability. POKENAME have become a notorious pest to fishermen, often attaching to boats and stealing catches.

entry: POKENAME靠布气球浮在浪上，紧随吼吼鲸和吼鲸王群。同伴虽不明白它为何不会潜水，却很爱把它当沙滩球抛着玩。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME floats above the ocean's waves with a cloth balloon, remaining close to pods of Wailmer and Wailord. While its compatriots are confused by its inability to dive, they enjoy tossing POKENAME around like a beach ball.

entry: POKENAME在海底淤泥里造水下地道。捕食者若进来，它就大声鸣叫，同时射高压水流。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME creates underwater tunnels within the silt of the seafloor. Should a predator enter, it chirps loudly while unleashing high pressurized water jets at them.

entry: POKENAME已适应高盐饮食，极其懒散，躺在海滩，吃海水和冲上岸的植物。
author: brilliantdarkness
source: POKENAME are adapted to tolerate high salinity in their diet. Extremely lethargic, they lie along beaches, feeding on seawater and vegetation washed ashore.

entry: POKENAME从不停止移动，因此总饥饿。陆海都觅食，但通常不离岸太远。
author: .jerden
source: Because POKENAME never stops moving, it is constantly hungry. It hunts for food both on land and at sea, but usually stays close to the shore.

entry: POKENAME充气，轻松滚过海面。完全胀起，体形会变得极大，偶尔甚至高如游轮。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME fills its body with air to roll across the ocean's surface with ease. At full inflation, it can grow gigantic in size, on rare occasions reaching the height of a cruise ship.

entry: POKENAME在浪间跳进跳出，给体内充电。它时不时莫名地高高弹起，有时能达到100英尺。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME bounces in and out of the waves to charge electricity within its body. It will randomly launch incredibly high for unknown reasons, sometimes reaching 100 feet into the air.

entry: POKENAME喉咙巨大，能从嘴里射强大雷电。它张大嘴，向前导电，同时吸水，滤出微小养分。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME have huge gullets and can launch massive lightning bolts from their mouths. They will channel electricity in front of them with a mouth open wide, swallowing water and filtering out microscopic nutrients.

entry: POKENAME热心救助落水的人和宝可梦，让对方把身体当活救生筏。可救起后，却不太想把乘客送回岸。
author: staghorn
source: A POKENAME will eagerly rescue drowning humans and Pokémon, allowing them to use its body as a living life raft. Once they are saved, however, it has little interest in bringing its passengers back to shore.

entry: POKENAME住在海带林，滤食时融入周围叶片。花苞当鳍，游得出奇灵活。捕食者靠近，就放毒，迅速逃走。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME dwells within kelp forests, blending in with the surrounding leaves as it filter feeds. Its buds function as fins, allowing it to swim with surprising agility. If a predator approaches, it releases a poisonous toxin and quickly escapes.

entry: 它一天能吸收超过1吨堆肥。肚子快撑破时，就打嗝喷出大量孢子。
author: foolish_weasel
source: It can absorb over a ton of compost in a day. When its stomach is near to bursting it belches out a massive spray of spores.

entry: POKENAME翻找沉船，寻找遗失珠宝。只要找到宝石，就毫不犹豫吃下，也不看看有没有谁旁观。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME searches through sunken ships for lost jewelry. Should it find any gems, it consumes them without hesitation or checking for onlookers.

entry: POKENAME鼻孔众多，从海里上浮呼吸时，会朝四面八方喷水。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME has numerous nostrils, and spouts water in all directions when it emerges from the sea to take a breath.

entry: POKENAME结成小群狩猎，独处时十分胆小。一旦失散，就会漫游海洋，直到找到新的群体。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME hunt in small groups. It is very cowardly on its own and roams the ocean until it finds a new group if it loses its old one.

entry: POKENAME用鼻孔吸进空气，储在体内。看见猎物，便将空气喷出去，为自己加速。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME collects air through its nostrils, which it stores in its body. When it sees prey, it expels it for additional acceleration.

entry: POKENAME住在废弃灯塔，日落后沿海岸飞行，途中定期发出笛声般的响亮鸣声。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME lives in abandoned lighthouses, leaving once the sun sets to fly along the coast. It periodically releases loud flute-like bursts as it goes.

entry: POKENAME能在空中和水中移动，但身躯沉重，飞不了太久。双翼猛拍在一起，就能产生音爆，赶走捕食者。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are able to move through both air and water, though their heavy stature prevents them from flying for very long. By slamming their wings together, they create sonic booms to drive away predators.

entry: POKENAME受威胁或过度兴奋，会从喷水孔放出稀释的毒水。它常黏在船底，用强水流轰走靠近的危险宝可梦。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME will release diluted, poisonous water from its blowhole when threatened or when it gets too excited. It often latches onto the bottoms of boats and uses its powerful jets to blast away any dangerous Pokémon that approach.

entry: POKENAME只需很少水便能生存，却会胀大，将多余水存进体内。头上每年开一次花，个体越小，花往往越美、越香。
author: darkweavile428
source: POKENAME need very little water to survive, but will swell larger to hold any excess water within their bodies. Once a year, a flower will bloom atop its head. Smaller POKENAME tend to have the prettiest and most fragrant flowers.

entry: 这种能漂浮的宝可梦毫无距离感，看见船上派对，就会兴奋地闯进去。
author: .realthree
source: This buoyant Pokémon has no concept of personal space and excitedly crashes any boat party it sees.

entry: 它浮在珊瑚礁附近，鲜蓝鳞片在阳光下闪耀。被打扰，就释放强劲精神波，吓退威胁。
author: .izik
source: Its vibrant blue scales shine brilliantly under the sun as it floats near coral reefs. If disturbed, it unleashes powerful psychic waves to scare away threats.

entry: POKENAME在晴朗海滩决斗，但烈日下只要一方开始干燥，就立刻停下。因此，许多战斗不到一小时便结束。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME duel on sunny beaches, but will immediately stop if either begins to dry out under the harsh rays. Due to this, many fights don't last over an hour.

entry: POKENAME沿池边跳，寻找芭瓢虫等猎物，再跃上空，用强力弹跳在空中解决对方。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME hops along pond edges searching for prey like Ledyba. It launches into the air and dispatches them midflight with a powerful Bounce.

entry: POKENAME常在灯塔周围出现，确保守塔者出行安全。水手故事说，它曾用泡泡将沉下的船托回水面。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME can often be spotted around lighthouses, ensuring the safe travels of its keepers. Sailors' stories tell of POKENAME that used its bubbles to lift a sinking ship back to the surface.

entry: POKENAME最常见于大湖、海洋附近的农场，能自然调节水位，农民很喜欢。它能靠生物发光，在黑暗中看清周围。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME is most commonly seen on farms near large lakes and oceans. Farmers enjoy its presence because it naturally regulates water levels. Its bioluminescence allows it to see clearly in the dark.

entry: POKENAME最常见于大湖、海洋附近的农场，能自然调节水位，农民很喜欢。它能靠生物发光，在黑暗中看清周围。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME is most commonly seen on farms near large lakes and oceans. Farmers enjoy its presence because it naturally regulates water levels. Its bioluminescence allows it to see clearly in the dark.

entry: 两只POKENAME一起玩，心形鳍会划出优美水纹。许多人相信，见它们一同跃起，就象征爱情永恒。
author: .izik
source: When two POKENAME play together, their heart-shaped fins create elegant water patterns. Many believe seeing them leap together is a sign of everlasting love.

entry: POKENAME在珊瑚礁里挖洞，窝着避险。它伸出3颗头，朝水流滤食，也逐渐滤去污染物。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME make their burrows within coral reefs, nestling within them for safety. They extend their trio of heads into water currents to filter feed, gradually cleaning water of pollutants as they do.

entry: 海上石油钻井平台的噪音污染，常让POKENAME头痛。声音强到受不了时，它就痛苦地用鳍肢按住头。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME experience many headaches because of the noise pollution caused by offshore oil rigs. Whenever the noise becomes too intense for them to handle, they press their flippers against their head in pain.

entry: 它调皮地与游泳快的对象竞速，用水流推动前进。训练家相信，陪它游泳能增强耐力。
author: .izik
source: It playfully races against fast swimmers, using jets of water to propel itself forward. Trainers believe swimming alongside it enhances endurance.

entry: POKENAME爱玩，也爱在沙滩上放松。它最喜欢的消遣，却是找其他野生宝可梦打一架。
author: usaginezumi
source: POKENAME is a fun-loving Pokémon that enjoys relaxing on the beach. Its favorite means of relaxation is trying to fight other wild Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME好奇，常碰撞经过湿地家园的船。它爱朝船里的人喷水，顽皮地玩耍。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are curious creatures that often bump into boats that go through their wetland home. They enjoy playfully spraying water at those inside the boats.

entry: 码头借POKENAME的力量，将船拉进港口。它却急躁，稍有耽搁，常生气喷水。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Docks use POKENAME's strength to help pull ships into harbors. They are quite impatient, often spouting water in anger should a delay occur.

entry: POKENAME产生有毒脂肪，很早就被用来做蜡烛。燃烧足够久，蜡烛会释放辛香。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME produces a toxic fat that has long been used to make candles. When burned for extended periods, these candles release a spicy aroma.

entry: POKENAME常漂在浅水，触手按难懂的规律抽动。研究者无法确定用途，但它的存在似乎会奇怪地扰乱当地海洋生态。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME is often seen drifting in shallow waters, with its tentacles twitching in unexplained patterns. Researchers have been unable to determine its purpose, but its presence seems to cause strange disruptions in local marine ecosystems.

entry: POKENAME用小鳍撑住笨重身躯，摇摆上岸，挪过城市街道。它虽无害，却常堵路、偷偷逛市场找食物，惹出小乱子。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME often waddles onto land by using its small fins to support its bulk as it shuffles through city streets. While harmless, it often causes minor chaos by blocking roads and sneaking into markets in search of food.

entry: POKENAME生活在严寒环境，气温从不高于水的冰点。脂肪占体重超过三分之一，厚脂肪层让它穿行冰水也保暖。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME live in frigid conditions where the temperatures never rise above the freezing point of water. Their thick blubber keeps them warm as they traverse the icy water, as the fat makes up more than a third of their body weight.

entry: POKENAME一离水，皮肤就干得快。它便用水泡裹住身体，其中混有作用较弱的化学物质，帮助皮肤保湿。
author: ruben2309295
source: A POKENAME's skin is known to dry out quickly when not underwater. Because of this, POKENAME encase themselves in bubbles of water mixed with low-potency chemicals to help keep their skin moisturised.

entry: POKENAME感到威胁，就让尾巴上的星形部分发出亮光。它能产出精细华贵的丝，用来制作优雅晚礼服。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME makes the star on its tail shine brightly whenever it feels threatened. It can produce a delicate, luxurious silk used to craft elegant evening gowns.

entry: POKENAME伪装虽差，却很少遭大型宝可梦袭击。研究发现，蛹带静电，一碰就会被电得疼。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Despite the poor camouflage of POKENAME, they are rarely attacked by larger Pokémon. When researching why this was, it was discovered that their chrysalis carries a static charge that causes painful shocks when touched.

entry: POKENAME周身盘绕的卷须，结构类似电线，轻松承载高电压。刚孵化时还不会控电，缆线般卷须的黄端，会乱放雷电。
author: deadshields
source: The tendrils coiled around POKENAME have a similar structure to electrical wire, letting them easily carry high voltages. Newly hatched POKENAME cannot control their electricity, resulting in wild bursts of lightning from their cables' yellow ends.

entry: POKENAME每片翼鳞都略带电荷。受威胁时，它会让电脉冲流过双翼，骤然亮起，晃得袭击者看不见。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have wing scales that each carry a slight electrical charge. When they feel threatened, POKENAME can send an electrical pulse through their wings that causes them to abruptly light up, blinding their assailants.

entry: POKENAME能压得薄如纸，让电流流过身体。它常藏在小路或门口，电击毫无戒备、踩上去的训练家。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME is able to flatten itself paper-thin and course electricity through its body. It often hides on trails or in doorways and shocks unsuspecting Trainers who step on it.

entry: POKENAME始终留意周围，感到危险，便一闪消失。若附近有伙伴，它会让尾巴的光仍看得见，提醒危险。
author: imaginita
source: POKENAME always keeps an eye on its surroundings and will disappear with a flash if it senses danger. If allies are nearby, it will allow the light from its tail to remain visible to alert them to the danger.

entry: POKENAME吸收阳光发电，充满时，黄叶会明亮发光。露营者常养它，作为太阳能电池。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME generates electricity by absorbing sunlight, its yellow leaves glowing brightly when fully charged. Campers often keep POKENAME as they act as solar-powered batteries.

entry: POKENAME摩擦毛皮，积聚静电。全身毛发连成网络，将能量导向背上的同一点。
author: danonzer
source: POKENAME can rub its fur together to build up static electricity. The individual strands of hair on its body form a network that channels this energy into a single point on its back.

entry: POKENAME让身上带电部位明亮闪动，与同类交际。彼此洒火花，被认为是深厚友谊的表示。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME flares up the electric patches of its body as a way of socializing with others of its kind. Showering sparks on each other is considered a gesture of deep friendship between POKENAME.

entry: 它们在雨刚停后最活跃，因为虫类宝可梦会跑出巢。野生POKENAME好斗，经过适当训练却很友好。
author: bobosmith01
source: They are most active just after rainy days, when bug Pokémon scurry out of their dens. While wild POKENAME have an aggressive disposition, properly trained POKENAME are quite friendly.

entry: POKENAME的身体够轻，光靠尾巴就能举离地面。它借此显得更高，也能看过高草。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME's body is just light enough for its tail to lift it into the air. It uses this to appear taller and to see above tall grass.

entry: POKENAME将电导入脚爪，常栖在高树上，再落下电击毫无戒备的训练家。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME channels electricity through the talons on its feet. It often perches high in trees and drops down to shock unsuspecting Trainers.

entry: POKENAME足够专注，就能用电点亮背斑。成群聚集时，它们会顽皮比较闪光的图案和颜色。
author: sk372
source: If it concentrates hard enough, POKENAME can use its electricity to make the spots on its back light up. Groups of them playfully compare flashing patterns and colors when gathering together.

entry: POKENAME的网略带电荷，暗中会发光。光在夜里引虫入网，让它抓到许多潜在美餐。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's webbing contains a faint electrical charge that causes it to glow in the dark. This light attracts insects into the webbing at night, allowing it to capture plenty of potential meals.

entry: POKENAME不停揉脸颊，缓解储电的酸痛。难以保住电荷时，尾巴上的星形部分便会漏出火花。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME constantly rubs its cheeks to ease the ache of stored electricity. Sparks leak from the star on its tail when it struggles to hold the charge.

entry: 它自保方式少，靠父母、兄弟姐妹，免遭秃鹫般的捕食者猎食。其中一种自卫方式，是猛吸空气，再一口全吐出，飞离此处。
author: quackquackattack
source: It relies on its parents and siblings to avoid being picked off by buzzard-like predators, as it has few methods of self-defense. One such method requires inhaling lots of air before exhaling all at once to fly away.

entry: POKENAME将电导入羽尖，蓄电时明亮发光。它让头上光滑羽毛间跃动雷电，想吸引配偶。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME channels its electricity into the tips of its feathers, which glow intensely when charging up. It arcs lightning between the glossy feathers on its head as a display meant to attract a partner.

entry: 幼年POKENAME迷路，就会明亮发光，好让母亲找到。大城市里很常见，光能照进窗，打扰居民睡觉。
author: periperi_chicken
source: Young POKENAME glow brightly when they are lost so that their mothers can find them. In big cities, this is quite common, and the lights can shine into windows and disturb sleeping citizens.

entry: POKENAME喜怒无常，容易被周围分心。训练家常拿食物“收买”，确保训练专心。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME has a capricious personality and are easily distracted by its surroundings. Trainers tend to bribe it with food to ensure that it focuses during training.

entry: POKENAME涂满泥，调节体温，也抵御强烈紫外线。危险靠近，毛就噼啪作响；太近时，甚至可能把泥炸离身体。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME covers itself in mud to help regulate its temperature and protect it from high UV rays. All its fur begins to crackle when danger is nearby, and may cause the mud to explode off its body if the danger gets too close.

entry: POKENAME感知设备电力过载，就用电线般的藤蔓接入源头，抽走电力。存下的电，再给能量不足的设备用。
author: npshi
source: POKENAME can sense when devices are overloading with electricity, using their wire-like vines to connect to the source and drain the target of its power. POKENAME uses this stored electricity to power devices that are low on energy.

entry: POKENAME头上的羽毛噼啪放电。火花亮度，反映健康和心情。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME crackles with energy from the feather on its head. The brightness of the sparks reveals its health and mood.

entry: POKENAME穿行森林时，会3至4只结伴，保障安全。夜里若落单，就猛然发电闪光，让自己更显眼，与朋友重聚。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME travel in groups of three to four for safety when moving about in the woods. If one of them becomes separated from the others at night, they light up with a flare of electricity to make themselves more visible and reunite with their friends.

entry: POKENAME精力过旺，不停奔跑，见什么都想嬉闹对打。跑动时，全身小电火花噼啪跳动。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME is very hyperactive, always running around and attempting to play-fight anything it sees. As it runs, small sparks of electricity jolt and crackle all over its body.

entry: POKENAME体内热量和储电，让身体摸着总温暖。它很友善、爱抱抱，但摸它，会使人的毛发竖起。
author: sk372
source: Due to its internal heat and electrical stores, POKENAME's body is always warm to the touch. It is quite amicable and loves to cuddle, though petting it will cause one's hair to stand on end.

entry: POKENAME紧缠敌人，同时摇尾。越收越紧，电荷不断积聚，随后一口气猛放电流。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME coils tightly around its foe while rattling its tail. As it tightens, it builds a charge, then releases a burst of electricity all at once.

entry: POKENAME能从鼻子打喷嚏，喷出雷电。闪光可能让人或宝可梦短暂失明，除此之外却无害。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can sneeze out bolts of electricity from its snout. These flashes of electricity can momentarily blind people or other Pokémon but are otherwise harmless.

entry: 肌肉活动给鹿角充电，直到噼啪作响。黑暗中，红鼻子能明亮发光，照亮前方地面。
author: .jerden
source: The movements of its muscles charge its antlers with electricity until they audibly crackle. In the dark, its red nose can glow brightly to illuminate the ground in front of it.

entry: POKENAME用尾尖经日光充能的颜料，在紫外灯下画画。谁嘲笑作品，就会被它电击。
author: luludracon
source: It creates paintings under UV lights with the solar charged paint from the tip of its tail. POKENAME shocks those who mock its art.

entry: POKENAME精力惊人，能连续近3天不休。毛里存大量静电，出招时会让对手遭强烈电击。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is incredibly energetic and can go for almost 3 days straight without rest. Its fur stores large amounts of static electricity, causing its strikes to give its opponent a powerful shock.

entry: POKENAME乘星形尾巴掠过天空，留下亮光痕迹。飞后必须给尾巴充电，靠吸收星光补充。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME zips across the sky on its star-shaped tail, leaving bright streaks of light behind it. It must recharge its tail after flight, generating more electricity by absorbing starlight.

entry: POKENAME跳舞时，将电存进头上绒球。打断舞步，常会招来电击报复。
author: .izik
source: While dancing, POKENAME stores electricity in the pom-pom on its head. Interrupting its routine often results in a shocking retaliation.

entry: POKENAME找来遗失的蛋，存进毛袋保温。它摩擦毛茸茸的双腿，产生少量电，用来点亮尾巴，逗幼崽开心或驱赶捕食者。
author: laughing_dan
source: POKENAME find lost eggs and store them in their fur pouch to keep them warm. POKENAME can generate small amounts of electricity by rubbing its furry legs together, which they use to light up their tails to entertain babies or fend off predators.

entry: POKENAME钻地时，尾巴会蓄电。电工研究尾尖，它能放出精准电击，强到制服更大敌人。
author: .izik
source: While tunneling, POKENAME builds electricity in its tail. Electricians study its tail tip, which can deliver precise shocks strong enough to disable larger foes.

entry: POKENAME常见于遭过不止一次雷击的树旁，或木电杆附近。感到危险，毛就噼啪竖起，再放强光，试图逃走。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are often found near trees that have been struck with lightning more than once or near wooden power poles. Their fur crackles and stands on end if they sense danger; they use their electricity to emit a bright flash and then attempt to flee.

entry: POKENAME从尾上黄叶猛放强电。白天若晒太阳不足，电力就会大幅减弱。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME fires strong bursts of electricity from the yellow leaf on its tail. The power of this electricity diminishes considerably if it does not get enough sunlight during the day.

entry: POKENAME星形尾巴的羽毛，生病就变白。即使掉落，仍留少许电荷。
author: .izik
source: The feathers making up POKENAME's star-shaped tail turn white when it falls ill. Even after falling out, they retain a slight electrical charge.

entry: POKENAME容易兴奋，一开心蹦跳，身体就开始产电、放热，有时尾巴和毛状羽毛也会发光。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME has a very excitable personality. When this Pokémon hops with excitement, its body will begin to generate electricity, radiate heat, and in some cases, its tail and fur-like feathers will begin to glow.

entry: 拨乱POKENAME的羽毛，会让周身积起静电。双脚却笨，它常摔倒后电到自己。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: Ruffling POKENAME feathers causes static electricity to build around their bodies. However, due to their clumsy feet, POKENAME have a bad habit of shocking themselves after falling.

entry: POKENAME成群跑过田野，靠肌肉发电。战斗虽强，若敌人已难独自应付，羽毛就会眩目发光。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME run in packs through fields in order to generate electricity using their muscles. While strong fighters in combat, the feathers on POKENAME will dazzle and glow when an opponent becomes too much for one to handle alone.

entry: POKENAME最爱先跳泥水洼，把自己弄脏，再短促放电，泥四散飞开，自己也全干，玩得开心。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's favorite method of recreation is first jumping into a muddy puddle to coat itself in grime. It then makes a short burst of electricity that scatters the mud around its surroundings and leaves it completely dry.

entry: POKENAME很爱玩，常成小群在沼泽摇摆行走。它们一拍手，便会产生少量无害的电火花。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a playful creature often seen waddling around in small groups in marshy areas. When it claps its hands, it creates small bursts of harmless electric sparks.

entry: POKENAME很快就与认定的朋友建立精神联系。面对强烈情绪，会将精神能量化为潜藏的静电荷。
author: turron_turron
source: POKENAME is quick to form psychic connections with those it considers friends. When in the presence of intense emotions, it converts its psychic energies into a latent, static charge.

entry: 整体疗法的治疗师看重POKENAME所产物质带的正电荷，用作主要原料，制作多种护肤霜和保健产品。
author: vic1312
source: Holistic healers prize the material produced by POKENAME for its positive charge. They produce diverse lines of skin creams and other wellness products with the material as a prime ingredient.

entry: POKENAME跳舞时会发电。格外兴奋或开心时，动作更快，身上会飞出细小的无害火花。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME generates electricity as it dances. When particularly excited or happy, its movements become quicker, and small, harmless sparks fly off its body.

entry: POKENAME的伪装完美，能让自己隐形。可毛里的电让它闪闪发光，反而暴露位置。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Its perfect camouflage allows POKENAME to go invisible. However, the electricity in its fur makes it sparkle, giving away its position.

entry: POKENAME用大门牙啃倒树，随后用电力和星形尾巴，在树干烙下印记。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME nibbles down trees using its big buck teeth. After they fall, it brands them using electricity and its star-shaped tail.

entry: POKENAME的楔石始终略微带电，握着会手麻。身体的发电方式，让石头和本体都在黑暗中微微发光。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's keystone always generates a faint electricity, making one's hand tingle while holding it. Both the stone and POKENAME itself glow faintly in the dark due to the way their body generates electric energy.

entry: POKENAME头上的花纹，让它看起来比实际友好多了。温顺宝可梦受骗靠近，终究会被电到屈服，再被吃掉。
author: sk372
source: The markings on POKENAME's head make it look far more friendly than it actually is. This facade lures in gentle Pokémon that will inevitably be shocked into submission and then consumed.

entry: POKENAME的尾巴看着不像，其实坚硬、由钢制成。兴奋时常意外打碎附近东西，出了名地惹麻烦。
author: retrodox
source: Despite its look, POKENAME's tail is stiff and made of steel. Its tail is notorious for accidentally breaking nearby objects when POKENAME gets excited.

entry: 天色阴沉、风暴将至，POKENAME便成群出藏身处，在雷雨中玩。它们通过毛皮吸电，充满后尾巴明亮发光。
author: mistymagius
source: When the sky gets dark and stormy, groups of POKENAME come out of hiding and play in the thunderstorm. They absorb electricity through their fur, their tails glowing brightly when fully charged.

entry: POKENAME眼睛浑浊，几乎看不见。感到附近有谁，就会阴森尖叫，向周围放火花。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's eyes are clouded over, giving it little sense of vision. It sheds sparks around its body with an eerie shriek when it senses the presence of others nearby.

entry: 训练家抚摸POKENAME，头上芽就会放小火花，表示亲昵。芽导电性极强，能引导体内产生的电。
author: jaminmcready
source: When POKENAME is petted by a Trainer, the sprout on its head releases small sparks as a sign of affection. This sprout is highly conductive and is able to channel electricity generated from within its body.

entry: POKENAME喝水时，壳会变硬，同时发电。头上叶子充当导体，吸收雷击。
author: lydiaprower8
source: When POKENAME drinks water, its shell hardens, generating electricity as it does so. The leaf on its head acts as a conductor and absorbs lightning strikes.

entry: POKENAME能攀上陡崖，沿途留下一道火花。遇到麻烦，火焰会更加明亮。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME can scale sheer cliffs, leaving a trail of sparks behind it. Its flame glows more intensely when in trouble.

entry: POKENAME的刺含有使人疼痛、麻痹的毒。被扎时一阵锐痛，仿佛遭了电击。它易怒，讨厌谁就冲过去，不适合新手作第一只宝可梦。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME spines contain a painful paralytic poison; the sensation of being stung is described as similar to receiving a sharp shock. They are irritable and will charge at anyone they dislike, making them difficult first-time Pokémon for new Trainers.

entry: POKENAME尾巴能产生不少火焰和电能，但仍在练习控制。一次若任一种用太多，就会筋疲力尽。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's tail can generate a good amount of both fire and electrical energy. POKENAME is still practicing controlling these elements, exhausting itself if it uses too much of either at one time.

entry: POKENAME紧握双拳，控制头部漏出的电流。若这些电击落空，就接上一记重上勾拳，力道足以放倒悬铃木。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME clenches its fists tightly to control the electricity leaking from its head. Should it miss with these lashes, it follows up with an uppercut forceful enough to topple a sycamore tree.

entry: POKENAME游泳时在体内发电，上岸后才用来攻击。感到紧张、危险，就放出火花，跑到安全处。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME generates electricity inside while it swims, using it in attacks once it's out of the water. When it feels tension and danger, it lets off sparks and runs off to safety.

entry: POKENAME用电攻击或与同伴沟通时，喙会像灯泡般发光。小小一下电流，就能传达复杂计划。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's beak glows like a light bulb when it uses electricity to attack or communicate with its allies. A single small jolt can convey complex plans.

entry: POKENAME的刺含有使人疼痛、麻痹的毒。被扎时一阵锐痛，仿佛遭了电击。它易怒，讨厌谁就冲过去，不适合新手作第一只宝可梦。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME spines contain a painful paralytic poison; the sensation of being stung is described as similar to receiving a sharp shock. They are irritable and will charge at anyone they dislike, making them difficult first-time Pokémon for new Trainers.

entry: POKENAME身上的星发出柔光，能安抚周围烦躁的宝可梦。训练家遇险，它便给毛皮充电，面对再可怕的敌人也不退。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its stars emit a gentle glow that has the power to calm agitated Pokémon around it. When its Trainer is in danger, POKENAME charges its fur with electricity and doesn't back down even in the face of terrifying enemies.

entry: POKENAME身上的星发出特定频率的光，降低好斗宝可梦体内的皮质醇。受威胁时，它启动高压电场，同时增强攻防。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its stars emit a specific light frequency that lowers cortisol in aggressive Pokémon. When threatened, POKENAME triggers a high-voltage field that improves both defense and offensive capabilities.

entry: POKENAME好奇，什么只要略有趣，就想跳着追去。格外兴奋时，它用体内电力加速，每迈一步，腿后都留下一道雷光。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's curious nature compels it to hop after anything it finds remotely intriguing. When particularly excited, it uses internal electricity to increase its speed, leaving trails of lightning behind its legs with each stride.

entry: POKENAME尾巴的星状部分，战斗时会烧得通红。电攻击越强，温度就越高。
author: .izik
source: The star-like parts of POKENAME's tails glow red-hot during battle. The stronger its electric attacks, the hotter they burn.

entry: POKENAME给洞壁矿石充入大量电，最多能保持3天。一碰就像触发地雷，电击的力道足以掀翻卡车。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME charges ore found in its tunnel walls with high amounts of electricity that can last up to three days. Touching one acts as a landmine, shocking the victim with enough force to knock over a truck.

entry: POKENAME精力极旺，昼夜都嬉闹奔跑。毛里储存大量电，能导入强力物理攻击。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is an incredibly energetic Pokémon, playfully running around all day and night. It stores large amounts of electricity in its fur and is able to channel it into powerful physical attacks.

entry: POKENAME身体噼啪放电，短暂迸发精力，变得格外活跃。能量一过，就又恢复懒散。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME's body crackles with electricity, giving it short bursts of energy that make it extremely hyperactive. Once this energy wears off, it returns to its lazy state.

entry: POKENAME始终发光，却无声、难寻踪迹。传言它能看透人的灵魂，知道每个藏着的秘密。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME glow constantly, but are silent and elusive. It is rumoured that POKENAME can look deep into a person's soul and see every secret they keep.

entry: POKENAME的脸可爱得不得了，训练家总忍不住原谅恶作剧。它爱啃电视电线，寻找里面浓郁美味的能量。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME have a positively precious face, and their trainers cannot help but forgive them when they get up to mischief. They have a tendency to gnaw on television cables, seeking the rich, flavorful energy within.

entry: POKENAME的甲能传导体内储电，让头撞带上电。毛在光下闪耀，前冲时能分散敌人注意、使其看不见。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME's armor conducts the electricity stored within their bodies, allowing them to deliver electrically charged headbutts. Their fur sparkles in the light, distracting and blinding opponents as they charge forward.

entry: POKENAME很不适合当宠物。大额头虽显可爱，许多主人却忘了它的咬力也大。无数家具遭了可怕的“乱咬发作”，连加固的钢材也挡不住。
author: speciessaladmallory
source: POKENAME makes for a horrible pet. While it may seem cute with its gigantic forehead, many pet owners forget about its equally big bite. Countless pieces of furniture fall victim to its dreaded "biting fit" that even reinforced steel fails to stop.

entry: POKENAME捕猎时用幻象模仿人类。脚印留下的小火花，是它曾来过的唯一线索。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME mimics humans using illusions while it hunts. Tiny sparks left in its footsteps are the only clue it was ever there.

entry: POKENAME尾上的星不断闪光，强弱取决于心情。它摩擦牙齿，产生小火花，点小火，在巢中睡觉时保暖。
author: fiordaliso
source: The star on its tail emits flickering lights that vary in intensity depending on its mood. By rubbing its teeth together, POKENAME can generate small sparks, which it uses to ignite tiny fires to stay warm while it sleeps in its den.

entry: POKENAME住在大片野花田，靠敏锐听觉警戒。若草地受威胁，花苞就展开，尾巴噼啪放电，警告闯入者远离。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME live among vast fields of wildflowers, keeping watch with their keen hearing. If anything threatens the meadow, their buds bloom open as their tails crackle with electricity to warn intruders to stay away.

entry: POKENAME夜里漫无目的地发光漂游，为路过的对象照明。有时，偷溜出家的孩子会抓住它当灯笼，但这些孩子并非都能回家。
author: darkweavile428
source: POKENAME glow as they float aimlessly through the night, providing light to anyone they pass by. Sometimes, children who sneak out of the house at night will hold onto a POKENAME to use as a lantern, though these children don't always return home.

entry: POKENAME感到危险，黄斑就发光，身体抖动，从头顶散出麻痹孢子。双腿靠收缩肌肉发电。
author: lydiaprower8
source: When POKENAME senses danger, its yellow spots glow as it shakes its body, scattering paralyzing spores from the top of its head. Its legs generate electricity by contracting its muscles.

entry: POKENAME由致密黏稠的凝胶构成，带着强劲电荷。训练家最好避免长时间接触，因为它一烦躁，就容易放出强烈电击。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME  are formed of a dense and sticky gel that carries a potent electrical charge. Trainers are advised to avoid handling them for too long as POKENAME tend to release powerful shocks if they become too agitated.

entry: POKENAME飞行时，从尾部放电，击晕猎物，再与同类一拥而上。
author: .izik
source: As it flies, POKENAME releases shocks from its tails to stun prey. It then swarms the target with others of its kind.

entry: POKENAME用獠牙在树上留下深痕，痕迹里仍有残余雷电噼啪作响。此时，它身上的毛也会发光。
author: beatdoof
source: POKENAME leaves deep tusk marks in trees that crackle with residual lightning. During this activity, the Pokémon's fur glows.

entry: POKENAME眼睛的光，比任何天然钻石都亮、都眩目。它借此使敌人短暂失明，趁机逃走。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME's eyes shine and dazzle more than any naturally-occurring diamond. It uses them to momentarily blind its foe and escape.

entry: POKENAME眼睛的光，比任何天然钻石更明亮、更眩目。它借此使敌人短暂失明，趁机逃走。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME's eyes shine and dazzle brighter than any naturally-occurring diamond. It uses them to momentarily blind its foe and escape.

entry: 遇见一群肉食者，它先扎最近的捕食者一下，再甩尾飞奔。无论是否在丛林被追，POKENAME都不停疾走，寻找食物或安全处。
author: quackquackattack
source: Whenever it is in the presence of a pack of carnivores, it jabs the nearest predator before flicking its tail to dash away. Whether being chased through the jungle or not, POKENAME continuously zips around in search of food or safety.

entry: POKENAME通常5只一群，挤在一起，用火花彼此取暖。它光吃冰雪，也能生存。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME usually move in a group of five, huddling and warming each other up with their sparks. They can survive by only eating snow and ice.

entry: POKENAME的绒球里满是静电。跳舞时火花四散，不知为何，落在谁身上，就让谁战意振奋。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's poms are filled with large amounts of static. While it dances, sparks fly in all directions, somehow invigorating those they land on for battle.

entry: 雷雨中，POKENAME离洞吸收空气潜藏的电。靠这些电荷，能维持数周。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME leaves its cave during thunderstorms to absorb latent electricity from the air. It can subsist on this charge for weeks.

entry: POKENAME成群在雷雨中旅行，将电存进双翼。但有时会被大冰雹打得从云中坠下。
author: mistymagius
source: Flocks of POKENAME travel in thunderstorms, storing electricity in their wings. However, they sometimes get knocked out of the clouds by large hailstones.

entry: POKENAME极亲昵，也极独立。若不见踪影，训练家常能发现，它正跟着最近的风暴走。
author: geo_ominous
source: POKENAME are highly affectionate, but also highly independent Pokémon. Trainers whose POKENAME go missing can often find them following the nearest storm.

entry: POKENAME移动时，棉絮般身体积起静电。哪怕轻轻一抱，电击也可能强到留下轻微灼伤。
author: .izik
source: Static builds within POKENAME's cottony body as it moves. Even a gentle hug can result in jolts powerful enough to leave mild burns.

entry: POKENAME是很亲人、忠诚的宠物，却会让有些主人疲惫。它玩耍时精力旺盛，体内产生的电也必须定期消耗，避免意外放电。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a very loving and loyal pet, though it can be exhausting for some owners. It has a lot of energy for playing, and its body generates electricity that needs to be burned off regularly to avoid accidental discharges.

entry: 所有POKENAME都具有某种联觉，能够看见声音。因此，它们对声音与音乐有着更深的理解。
author: voxary
source: All POKENAME have a form of synesthesia that makes them able to see sounds. Because of that, they have a greater understanding of sound and music.

entry: POKENAME用能光合作用的毛吸阳光发电。受威胁时，释放宜人香气，使敌人看不见，趁机跑走。
author: sakuraneko
source: POKENAME uses its photosynthetic fur to take in sunlight to generate electricity. When threatened, a POKENAME will release a pleasant aroma that can blind its foes so that it may run away.

entry: POKENAME长而硬的毛易传导静电。有些个体积得太多，甚至会彼此黏住。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME's long, stiff fur easily conducts static electricity. Some POKENAME even end up sticking to one another if enough static is built up.

entry: POKENAME体内发电，存进沉重外壳。充得太满，就从背孔排出多余能量，化作明亮的黄色雷电。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME generate electricity inside their bodies and store it within their heavy shells. When overcharged, they vent this excess energy from the openings in their backs as brilliant yellow lightning bolts.

entry: POKENAME将电力压缩到极高压力，使其过热，化为纯粹的等离子体。从壳释放的电流灼热无比，闪着鲜亮蓝光。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME can compress electricity to such extreme pressures that it is superheated into raw plasma. The resulting electrical discharges released from their shells burn at incredibly high temperatures, glowing a vivid blue.

entry: POKENAME用头顶睡莲叶吸收风暴中的雷电，存起能量，电击靠得太近的捕食者。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses the lily pad on its head to absorb lightning during storms. It stores the energy to shock predators that get too close.

entry: POKENAME用头顶睡莲叶融入草木，喜欢悄悄接近人，突然在脸前晃动耀眼的尾巴，再趁对方看不见，开心地溜走。
author: imaginita
source: POKENAME uses the lily pad on its head to blend in with surrounding greenery.  It likes to sneak up on people and suddenly wave its dazzling tail in their face, blinding them while POKENAME runs away with mischievous glee.

entry: POKENAME生成星形晶体，再像手里剑般掷向敌人。掉落的晶体，有时被拿来做首饰。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME generates star-shaped crystals, then launches them at enemies like throwing stars. Fallen POKENAME crystals are sometimes used in jewelry.

entry: POKENAME的大耳朵极擅察觉捕食者，很适合它害羞的性情。它偏爱睡在水面，因为耳朵能听得最远。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's large ears are incredibly adept at detecting predators, which suits its shy nature well. It prefers to sleep at the water's surface where its ears can listen across the greatest distance.

entry: POKENAME靠静电，将硬币和瓶盖黏在毛上。它珍爱所有亮晶晶的东西，攒成小宝藏。
author: .izik
source: Static electricity allows POKENAME to stick coins and bottle caps to its fur. It treasures anything shiny and builds small hoards.

entry: 训练家指令太复杂，POKENAME就会剧烈偏头痛。心情好时，星形尾巴泛淡淡黄光。
author: fiordaliso
source: If its Trainer gives it commands that are too complex, POKENAME is wracked by severe migraines. When it is in a good mood, its star-shaped tail emits a faint yellowish glow.

entry: POKENAME玩捡球时，开心得不得了。疾奔时毛间火花跳跃，留下一道静电痕迹。
author: .izik
source: When playing fetch, POKENAME becomes overjoyed. Sparks leap from its fur as it dashes, leaving a trail of static behind.

entry: POKENAME耳朵大，听觉极敏锐。威胁靠近，就开始从口中喷电。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: POKENAME's large ears gives it very sensitive hearing. If any threats approach, POKENAME begins spewing electricity from its mouth.

entry: POKENAME坐在海岸附近，雷雨一近，耳朵就竖起。它靠尾巴闪光沟通，却常忘记这些信号的意思。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME sits near the coastline, its ears perking up when a thunderstorm is nearby. It communicates with blinking lights from its tail, even though it will often forget what these signals mean.

entry: POKENAME能让毛皮发出足以使敌人短暂失明的强光，趁机攻击、逃跑，或将四肢和头缩进壳里自保。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME can make its fur shine bright enough to temporarily blind foes. This creates an opportunity for it to attack, flee, or withdraw its limbs and head within its shell for protection.

entry: POKENAME能点亮炮管射出的水。夜里借此表演，让明亮的水流在空中舞动，令人赞叹。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME can light up the water it fires from its cannons. At night, it can use this to create impressive displays, making streams of brightly illuminated water dance in the air.

entry: POKENAME体内磁性矿物，让它能操控微弱电流，如同身体的延伸。沟通时，它按不同间隔，用尾巴砸地。
author: bobosmith01
source: Magnetic minerals in POKENAME's body allow it to harness weak electrical currents as if they were an extension of its body. To communicate, POKENAME slams its tail into the ground in distinct intervals.

entry: 它生气时，背上黄种子就会发光，放出吓人的火花。它对利木果胃口无穷，因此在结果的植物旁筑巢。
author: fiordaliso
source: When it gets angry, the yellow bulb on its back glows, emitting frightening sparks. It has an insatiable appetite for Aspear Berries, which is why it makes its den near plants that bear those fruits.

entry: POKENAME将尾巴接触电杆吸电。吸得太多，就会猛烈爆炸。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME touches its tail to electric poles to absorb power. If it takes in too much, it will explode violently.

entry: POKENAME常看似一个歪斜的个体，其实由6个独立部分组成。它们像单一个体行动，更好地合力用电防御。
author: sk372
source: Although it often appears to be a single lopsided individual, POKENAME is a clutch of six separate pieces. They move as one singular unit to better combine their electricity powers for defense.

entry: POKENAME哭时，电力会猛增。泪水洒遍战场，让电能传得比平时更远。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's electrical power surges when it cries. Tears scatter across the battlefield, allowing its electricity to reach much farther than usual.

entry: 雷雨靠近，POKENAME便出巢，空气电势渐高，火花在翼上跳跃。它们有时被发电厂吸引，错把发电机当雷云。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME emerge from their nests as thunderstorms approach, sparks dancing across their wings as electrical potential builds in the air. They are sometimes drawn to power plants, mistaking the generators for incoming thunder clouds.

entry: 野生POKENAME是强大的群猎者，夏天每天却大约只活动1小时，其他时候通常休息、进食。风暴中，身体会泛蓝光。
author: bobosmith01
source: In the wild, POKENAME are powerful pack hunters that are typically only physically active for approximately one hour a day during the summer season and are usually resting or eating during all other periods. During storms, their bodies glow blue.

entry: POKENAME凶悍，觉得自己理应受优待。它偏爱洁净湖泊，或装满过滤冰川水的私人泳池，愿意轻易被抓，好受人宠爱。
author: princessmilandria
source: POKENAME is fierce and entitled. It prefers to swim in pristine lakes or private pools filled with filtered glacier water. POKENAME allows itself to be easily caught so it can be pampered.

entry: POKENAME在变电站旁伪装成电气设备。没人看着时，就轻轻嗡鸣，吃储存的电。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME disguises itself as electrical equipment near power substations. When unobserved, it feeds on stored electricity with a faint hum.

entry: 据说POKENAME靠近偏爱的进化之石，尾上星星就泛微光。若感到威胁，它会在黑鬃周围放出噼啪电流，吓唬对方。
author: fiordaliso
source: It is said that when POKENAME is exposed near an Evolution Stone it favors, the star on its tail emits a faint glow. If it feels threatened, it wraps its dark mane in crackling, frightening electrical discharges.

entry: POKENAME尖毛里始终流着电。受惊时放出的电，甚至超过避雷针能承受的量。
author: .izik
source: The pointy fur on POKENAME's body is always coursing with electricity. When frightened, it discharges more power than a lightning rod can handle.

entry: 古老传说说，心善的人迷失丛林，POKENAME就会用星形尾巴的光引向安全。它虽戒备人类，却爱与群里同伴相处。
author: fiordaliso
source: An ancient legend tells that if a kind-hearted person gets lost in the jungle, POKENAME will guide them to safety with the light from its star-shaped tail. Although it is very wary of humans, it loves spending time with the others in its pack.

entry: POKENAME头上叶子像多用途天气感应器，能察觉温度、湿度，也能储电，战斗时释放数千伏。
author: foolish_weasel
source: The leaf on POKENAME's head acts as an all-purpose weather sensor, detecting temperature and humidity. The leaf also stores an electrical charge that can discharge thousands of volts during battle.

entry: POKENAME喜欢成群在雷暴中社交，懒洋洋地待着，仿佛别人晴天晒太阳。多个个体让叶子相碰，就能产生大量电。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Groups of POKENAME love to socialize in electrical storms, lazing about in the same way others sun bathe on a sunny day. When multiple POKENAME touch their leaves together, they can generate a great deal of electricity.

entry: POKENAME叶上飘出辛香，使人振奋，有时也变得好斗。它天性爱交往，会用细微电脉冲点亮胸前叶片，与同类沟通。
author: foolish_weasel
source: A spicy scent wafts from POKENAME's leaf, which invigorates and causes aggression at times. Social by nature, POKENAME will communicate with other POKENAME by lighting up the leaves on its chest with subtle electrical impulses.

entry: POKENAME让黄羽发光，想赢得同群赞赏、受到更认真对待。哪怕对手更大更强，它也勇敢用利喙交战。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME makes the yellow feathers on its body shine to impress the other members of its flock and be taken more seriously. It fights bravely even against larger and stronger Pokémon, using its sharp beak.

entry: 雷雨时，POKENAME从树枝敬畏地看闪电。若将有强大雷击，就会兴奋地啼叫。
author: .izik
source: During thunderstorms, POKENAME watches the lightning in awe from tree branches. If a large strike is coming, it hoots in excitement.

entry: POKENAME在发电厂啃电线。受惊后，放出的电足以把自己击昏。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME gnaws on wires in power plants. When startled, it discharges enough electricity to knock itself out.

entry: POKENAME尾上星星间歇闪光，威吓挡路者。它成大群栖居，侵占潮湿巷道或下水道。
author: fiordaliso
source: The star on its tail flashes intermittently to intimidate anyone who gets in its way. POKENAME lives in large colonies, infesting damp alleys or sewers.

entry: POKENAME用长尾猛放电，准头极佳，能将树上蕉香果击落。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its long tail to launch bursts of electricity, knocking Nanab Berries from trees with expert aim.

entry: POKENAME在湖面上方沿Z形路线飞行，寻找猎物。发现鲤鱼王，就会放电。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME flies in Z-shaped patterns over lakes looking for prey. If it spots a Magikarp, it unleashes an electrical shock.

entry: POKENAME整天看人说话，模仿听来的词。若觉得学得不好，就会沮丧地从尾巴放火花。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spends its days watching people talk, imitating words it hears. If it feels it hasn't done a good job, it will release sparks from its tail in frustration.

entry: POKENAME控制别人脑内电脉冲，进行心灵沟通。据说操控相同脉冲，还能缓解与记忆有关的疾病。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME communicates telepathically by controlling the electrical impulses in the brains of others. It is said to be able to ease memory-related illnesses by manipulating these same impulses.

entry: 同伴遇险，POKENAME立刻挺身而出，全身每个毛孔都冒火花。它常占据下水道整片区域，赶走原本住着的其他宝可梦。
author: fiordaliso
source: If one of its companions is in danger, POKENAME immediately steps in, sparking electricity from every pore of its body. It tends to take over entire sections of the sewers, driving out any other Pokémon living there.

entry: POKENAME用叶片收集的太阳能，在体内发电。花苞储着大部分电荷，粗心碰到花瓣，就可能挨上疼痛电击。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME use solar energy collected by their leaves to create an electrical charge within their body. Their bulb carries the bulk of this charge, and touching the petals can deliver a painful shock to the unwary.

entry: POKENAME从门牙放电，足以让小池塘通电，击昏角金鱼等猎物。强攻前，身体会泛黄光。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME discharges enough electricity from its front teeth to electrify a small pond, using this ability to knock out prey like Goldeen. It will glow yellow before a powerful attack.

entry: POKENAME将电导入爪子，借夜色掩护，俯冲攻击猎物。爪力很强，足以夹碎树干。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME channels electricity into its claws to attack, divebombing prey under the cover of night. Its claws are strong enough to crush tree trunks.

entry: POKENAME细心清毛，让电顺利流过身体。出色视力能辨出密灌木中的动静；靠近后，先使冰冻之风减慢猎物，再用带电利爪攻击。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME will clean its fur meticulously to help channel electricity through its body. Its exceptional eyesight can pick out movement in dense brush. Once close, it will let loose an Icy Wind to slow its prey before striking with charged claws.

entry: POKENAME飞过雷云吸电，积得太多便泛黄光。此时，性情会格外暴躁。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME flies through storm clouds to absorb electricity, glowing yellow if it gathers too much. During this period it will be extremely irritable.

entry: POKENAME从尾巴放亮火花，吓退捕食者。它把小型宝可梦护在绝缘、下垂的软耳后，免得被火花伤到。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME fires bright sparks from its tail to scare away predators. It shields smaller Pokémon behind its insulated, floppy ears to protect them from the sparks.

entry: POKENAME格外有灵感时，尾端星星便明亮发光。身体只能产浅蓝液体，因此它会用林中树果，给作品添色。
author: fiordaliso
source: When POKENAME is feeling especially inspired, the star at the tip of its tail begins to give off a bright glow. It uses berries found in the forest to add color to its artwork, since its body only produces a bluish liquid.

entry: POKENAME将尾巴放在电器上偷电。充得太多，就会在各处飞跑，无法减速。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME places its tail on electric appliances to steal power. If overcharged, it moves rapidly from one point to another, unable to slow down.

entry: POKENAME每用电属性攻击，花纹上的眼睛就闪光。鬃毛也因静电蓬起，让它更吓人。
author: deelee2020
source: The eyes on POKENAME's pattern flash every time they use an Electric attack. Their mane puffs up with the static as well, making POKENAME look even more fearsome.

entry: POKENAME的奶能改善饮用者视力，常被用来治疗白内障。它滚动攻击时，火花四处飞散。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME's milk improves the vision of whoever drinks it and is often used to clear up cataracts. As this Pokémon attacks by rolling out, sparks fly everywhere.

entry: POKENAME紧挤成群，加强自保。尾巴相触，便能分享、合并电力，产生极高电压。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME gather in closely-huddled groups for better self-preservation. By keeping their tails in contact, they can share and combine their electricity into massive amounts of voltage.

entry: 雷雨中，能听见POKENAME念诵怪叫。那不是已知语言，许多人猜它在念某种诅咒。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME can be heard chanting an odd cry during thunderstorms. It is not a known language, and many assume it is chanting a curse of some kind.

entry: POKENAME飞行时羽上静电噼啪，召雷劈向巢边所有对象。体内高压电流奔涌，连睡着也冒火花。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's feathers crackle with static as it flies, calling down lightning to strike anyone near its nest. It sparks even while asleep due to the high voltage coursing through its body.

entry: POKENAME将大部分电导入尾端的黄色器官。战斗时，它主要先放出强光，再用带电的尾巴挥击敌人。
author: infinex21
source: The yellow organ at the tip of its tail is where it channels most of its electricity. POKENAME fights primarily by emitting bright flashes and then swinging its electrically charged tail into its foes.

entry: 雷雨中，POKENAME尾上星形黄叶快速闪光。此时它极护这片叶，哪怕训练家碰，也会攻击。
author: .izik
source: The star-shaped yellow leaf on POKENAME's tail blinks rapidly during thunderstorms. It grows highly protective of this leaf during such times, even lashing out at its own Trainer if touched.

entry: POKENAME凭电力和强壮大腿，敏捷出众。爪尖冒电，弱小宝可梦哪怕只擦伤一点，也会昏倒。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME's electricity and sturdy thighs give it outstanding agility. Electricity sparks from the tips of its claws, causing weak Pokémon to faint from the slightest scratch.

entry: POKENAME冲向敌人，放出足以击昏的电，再小心靠近倒地者，迅速抢走物品、树果。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME dart towards opponents, discharging enough electricity to cause their enemy to faint. They cautiously approach the felled foe, quickly snatching items or berries away from the fallen Pokémon.

entry: 它滚动时，自然在爪里储电。全力蓄电的一斩，连最强的宝可梦也能击昏。
author: h0bojoe
source: It passively stores electricity in its claws while it rolls around. A fully charged slash can cause even the mightiest Pokémon to faint.

entry: 它滚动时，自然在爪里储电。全力蓄电的一斩，连最强的宝可梦也能击昏。
author: h0bojoe
source: It passively stores electricity in its claws while it rolls around. A fully charged slash can cause even the mightiest Pokémon to faint.

entry: POKENAME快速转动双臂发电，储存在腿内的特殊组织中。尾巴开始噼啪作响，就说明电已充满。这些储备让它能长时间奔跑，不必休息。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: By rapidly rotating its arms, POKENAME produces electrical energy that is stored in specialized tissues within its legs. When its tail begins to crackle, this indicates a full charge. These reserves allow it to run for extended periods without rest.

entry: POKENAME病时，向四方射带电高压水流，排出体内积电，加快恢复。
author: .izik
source: When sick, POKENAME shoots highly pressurized jets of electrified water in all directions. It does this to discharge built up power from its body and recover faster.

entry: POKENAME身体发育后，越发难控制体内涌动的电流。通常涂一层泥，就能抑制能量，防止意外伤害。
author: sk372
source: As POKENAME's body develops, it has a more difficult time controlling the surge of electricity within. Coating its body with a covering of mud is usually enough to dampen its energy and keep it from causing accidental harm.

entry: POKENAME生活在小群中，用电脉冲交流。游过泥浆时，它会发电。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME live in small groups, communicating with each other through electrical pulses. It generates electricity as it swims through mud.

entry: POKENAME极善共情，感到附近悲伤，也会情绪低落。心情格外低落时，电力大幅减弱。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME has incredible empathy for those around it and grows depressed when it senses sadness nearby. Its electric power weakens considerably during periods of strong depression.

entry: POKENAME内敛、少表情，却极关心朋友安全。据说能从所持的枪中召来各种灵魂，发动攻击。
author: actliux
source: Although reserved and emotionless, POKENAME has great care for the safety it's friends. It is said it summons various spirits from the gun it wields to unleash attacks.

entry: POKENAME用长舌从发电厂吸电为食。它们排成长链，舌尾相连，就能将电送进城市。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME feeds by using its long tongue to siphon electricity from power plants. A long line of POKENAME can connect power to cities by connecting their tongues to their tails.

entry: 它被磁性材料吸引，爱把朝北鼻像毛线球一样拍着玩。利爪上涌动着强劲的电流。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Drawn to magnetic materials, it loves to bat at Nosepass like it was a ball of yarn. Its sharp claws pulse with potent electricity.

entry: 它们群居，用波导沟通捕猎。配合默契的群体，能造出雷电噼啪的波导风暴，寻找、击倒范围内任何活物。
author: imaginita
source: They live in packs, communicating via aura to hunt.  A well-coordinated pack can create an aura storm crackling with lightning that can seek out and strike down any living creature within its range.

entry: POKENAME从巨颚黄牙放电，制服咬住的猎物；也能让这些牙闪强光，震住捕食者。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME release electricity through the yellow fangs of their large jaws. They electrify prey caught within their jaws to subdue them and release dazzling, bright flashes from these fangs to stun predators.

entry: POKENAME较软的头，常被误当成更抢手、更硬的盾甲龙头部。两者在野草中都会探头，但POKENAME的头上有刺，可以据此分辨。
author: retrodox
source: POKENAME's softer head is often mistaken for Shieldon's more sought-after, harder head. While in wild grass, both have their heads poking out, but you can differentiate them by the spike on POKENAME's.

entry: POKENAME穿高草尾随猎物，却因高举尾巴，很容易被发现。目标一逃，它就生气砸尾，在地上留下星形印。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME stalks prey through tall grass, yet it is easily spotted because it raises its tail high while hunting. POKENAME smashes its tail into the ground in anger if its target escapes, leaving a star-shaped mark.

entry: POKENAME群体亲密，用体温和蹭近时交换的微弱电流沟通。要警告危险或重大事件，多个个体就合起尾焰，做明亮信标。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME live in close-knit groups and communicate through body heat and weak electrical currents exchanged while nuzzling. To alert others to danger or important events, multiple POKENAME combine their tail flames into a brilliant signal beacon.

entry: POKENAME用体内电能强化四肢，加快攻击。速度最快时，拳踢还会裹上火焰。
author: sk372
source: Using the electric energy within its body, POKENAME can supercharge its limbs and increase the speed of its strikes. At max speed, its punches and kicks become engulfed in flames as well.

entry: POKENAME遇见真正想打的对手，头上火焰就明亮燃起。战斗中，毛上静电噼啪，持续让身体充满能量，直到结束。
author: fiordaliso
source: When POKENAME faces an opponent it truly wishes to battle, the flame atop its head flares brightly. During combat, its fur crackles with static sparks, keeping its body charged with energy until the fight is over.

entry: POKENAME生活在小而隔绝的群体中，靠鳍发出的特定电脉冲，辨认同群成员。
author: drcew
source: POKENAME live in small, isolated groups. They are able to identify members of the same group through specific electrical pulses they send through their fins.

entry: POKENAME向侵入领地的宝可梦愤怒放电、咬去。保安常用它帮忙巡逻，麻痹电击和衰弱毒素能拖慢闯入者，便于逮捕。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME spark and snap angrily at Pokémon that encroach on their territory. They are commonly used by security guards to help with patrols, their paralytic shocks and debilitating poisons helping to slow intruders for arrest.

entry: POKENAME对训练家的占有欲极强，谁未经它许可靠近，它都会烦躁。彩带导电性能很好，能增强需要接触的电属性攻击。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is extremely possessive of its Trainer, to the point that it gets irritated whenever someone approaches without its permission. Its colorful ribbons act as effective conductors, boosting the power of its contact-based electric attacks.

entry: POKENAME防御平平，靠隐蔽战术捕猎。它无声飘向猎物，用爪子放电将其击昏，便能轻松带走，不必与猎物纠缠或交战。
author: sk372
source: Because of its middling defenses, POKENAME hunts with sneaky tactics. It floats silently down to prey before zapping them unconscious with its paws, making it easy to carry them away without a fuss or fight.

entry: POKENAME的黄铜环噼啪带电，漂过空中时叮当作响。雷雨期间，它格外有精神。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's brass rings crackle with electrical energy, jingling as it floats through the air. It is extremely energized during thunderstorms.

entry: POKENAME往土里挖地道。不知为何，挖掘的兴奋会产生电，越享受，电就越多。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME digs into the dirt to create tunnels. Its excitement for digging somehow generates electricity, which builds as it enjoys its task.

entry: POKENAME从河边巢屋，用敏锐本能感知威胁。夜里释放强雷，赶走捕食者。
author: .izik
source: From its riverside lodge, POKENAME senses threats with sharp instincts. At night, it releases powerful lightning strikes to keep predators away.

entry: POKENAME将波导导入四肢，产生雷电涌流，加强打击。身体仍在发育，因此只能少用，否则会耗尽所有体力。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME channels its aura into its limbs to create lightning surges that give its strikes more impact. Its body is still developing, so it can only use this technique sparingly lest it completely exhaust itself.

entry: POKENAME将前腿搭在别人身上，从爪子释放波导，传达情绪。它会用前爪扑向最好的朋友，表达友谊带来的快乐。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME rest their forelegs on others, as they communicate their emotions with an aura that radiates from their paws. POKENAME will tackle their best friends with their front paws to show them how happy their friendship makes them.

entry: POKENAME在高处休息，接触充足空气，借空气摩擦在毛间积起静电。醒来活动时，利爪和强电击，让它成为凶猛猎手。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME rest at high elevations where they are exposed to plenty of air so that the air friction builds a static charge across their fur. Their sharp claws and potent electrical jolts make them fierce predators when they are awake and active.

entry: POKENAME走动时，身体散发强电脉冲。附近的对讲设备受干扰，会发出难听的尖啸。
author: .izik
source: A strong electrical pulse emanates from POKENAME's body as it walks. Nearby intercoms pick up interference from this, letting out a terrible screeching noise.

entry: POKENAME烦躁时，金色毛皮会发光。此时接触，人或宝可梦都会被电得很迷糊。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: The golden fur of POKENAME glows whenever it is agitated. Contact with it while it's glowing will leave the person or Pokémon feeling quite disoriented from the shock.

entry: POKENAME借钢甲传导电击，甲胄由可可多拉蜕下的壳制成。若看见特别大或铠甲特别厚实的可可多拉，POKENAME便会结群猎杀，夺取它的壳。
author: staghorn
source: POKENAME channel electric shocks through their steel armor, which is made from discarded Aron shells. If a particularly large or well-armored Aron is sighted, POKENAME will form packs to hunt it for its shell.

entry: POKENAME漂过发电厂，用尾巴检查设备。发现问题，就高声尖叫，提醒工人。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME floats through power plants, checking equipment with its tail. If it detects an issue, it lets out a loud screech to alert the workers.

entry: POKENAME尾焰闪着火花，大小反映储存的电力。它会将电导入爪中，或短促喷吐雷电。
author: sk372
source: The size of the sparking flame on POKENAME's tail indicates how much electric power it has in reserve. It channels this electricity into its claws, or for short bursts of lightning breath.

entry: 猛烈雷雨中，POKENAME身体噼啪放电，还会释放浓烈风信子香的花粉，药剂师用来制药膏。
author: .izik
source: During severe thunderstorms, POKENAME's body crackles with electricity. It releases an intensely hyacinth-scented pollen during this time that apothecaries use in balms.

entry: POKENAME用带电凝胶包住自己，保护娇小脆弱的身体。它靠操电能力自卫，不必肢体搏斗。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME surround themselves in an electrically charged gel, protecting their small and vulnerable bodies. They defend themselves with their electrokinetic powers, enabling them to fight without physical altercation.

entry: POKENAME外层的胶状膜，像电池一样储存多余电。漂浮时，表面始终有火花跳动。
author: .izik
source: The gelatinous membrane encasing POKENAME's body stores excess electricity like a battery. Sparks constantly dance across its surface as it floats.

entry: POKENAME完全失明，靠周围宝可梦的电场，在空中辨路。双尾不断产生电荷，电击一切靠得太近的对象。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are completely blind and navigate through the air using the electrical fields of the Pokémon around them. Their twin tails generate a constant electrical charge that they use to zap at anything that gets too close to them.

entry: POKENAME聚集时，让獠牙相碰，分享电力。它们用尾部有节奏的脉冲，彼此沟通。
author: beatdoof
source: When POKENAME gather, they join their tusks to share electricity. They communicate with others using rhythmic pulses from their tails.

entry: 夜里，POKENAME成群接触尾巴，清点同伴。哪怕少一只，也会找到早晨。
author: .izik
source: At night, flocks of POKENAME touch tails to take count of their kin. Should even one be missing, they will search until morning.

entry: POKENAME成小群捕猎，让猎物落单、包围。猎完先喂幼崽，剩余的自己吃。
author: bluenido.
source: POKENAME hunt in small packs to isolate and surround their prey. Once the hunt is over, they feed their young before eating the rest themselves.

entry: POKENAME从尾巴射出雷电，击晕敌人，再吸血。它偏爱只在夜里捕猎。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME releases bolts of electricity from its tail to stun foes, then sucks their blood afterward. It prefers to only hunt at night.

entry: POKENAME趴在洞底等猎物。若被踩，就放出足够电力，让袭击者的皮肤带电。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME lays on cave floors waiting for prey. If stepped on, it unleashes enough electricity to charge the skin of its attacker.

entry: POKENAME的眼睛能放大视野，让东西看起来更清楚、更近。爪子既用来攻击，也挖宝石吃。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME's eyes help it to magnify its vision, ensuring a clearer, closer view of things. Its claws are used both to attack and to dig up gems for it to eat.

entry: POKENAME咳出的黏痰，对其他电属性宝可梦尤其危险。它使对方不断冒火花，数小时内就能耗尽力量。
author: .izik
