source: The sticky phlegm POKENAME coughs up is particularly dangerous to other Electric-type Pokémon. It causes their bodies to spew constant sparks and can drain them within hours.

entry: POKENAME视力锐利，最猛烈的暴风雪也看得清。家里养一只，被视为富足的象征。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME's sharp vision helps it see in even the toughest of blizzards. Having one at home is a sign of prosperity.

entry: POKENAME吃电子废物，吸收其中潜藏的电能。它主要翻垃圾箱觅食，连小碎片都能维持数周。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME consumes e-waste to absorb latent electrical energy. Sifting through dumpsters is its primary way to find food, as even small scraps can sustain it for weeks.

entry: POKENAME耳中发出的尖叫，会让附近电器出故障。生病时，它会不由自主地这样叫。
author: .izik
source: The high-pitched squeals emanating from POKENAME's ears can cause nearby electrical devices to malfunction. It releases these involuntarily when sick.

entry: POKENAME成群聚在电线上，互相摩擦翅膀，产生强烈的静电放电。发电厂常得赶走它们，防止静电损坏线路。
author: geo_ominous
source: POKENAME gather together on power lines and rub their wings against each other, creating powerful static shocks. Power plants often need to shoo flocks of POKENAME to prevent them from damaging the lines with their static.

entry: 臂上黄纹泛着电光，会在树上烙下爪印，标记领地。捕猎时，它四肢着地，提高速度。
author: mistymagius
source: The yellow stripes on its arms glow with electricity and will scorch pawmarks into trees to mark its territory. While hunting, it will run on all fours to increase its speed.

entry: POKENAME在树间以杂技动作跳跃，体内电能脉动。不知为何，穿过翅膀的气流，会给身体充电。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME performs acrobatic movements while jumping from tree to tree, pulsing with electrical energy. The air moving through its wings somehow charges its body.

entry: POKENAME颈边小晶体，收集周围静电。充满后，它更有精神，也会一小股一小股地放电。
author: gamblebreaker
source: The small crystals around its neck collect static electricity from the surrounding area. When the crystals are charged, POKENAME becomes more energetic and will release the electricity in small bursts.

entry: POKENAME用毛吸收阳光，给体内充电，再从嘴里释放能量。充满后，毛会竖起。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME absorbs sunlight into its fur to charge electricity within its body, unleashing the energy from its maw. Its fur will stand on end when fully charged.

entry: POKENAME附近宝石越多，发电越快，黄玉似乎最能加速。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME generates electricity faster the more gems are nearby. Topaz in particular seems to accelerate the charge the most.

entry: POKENAME厌恶恶霸，常保护弱小无助的对象。它把电当撬棍使，噼啪作响，吓退威胁。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME have a hatred of bullies and are often seen protecting the small and helpless. It wields electricity like a crowbar and crackles it to scare off threats.

entry: POKENAME带的树枝，通常取自遭雷劈的树，因此能短时间操控雷云。
author: .izik
source: The twig POKENAME carries is usually taken from a tree struck by lightning. This grants it the ability to manipulate storm clouds for short periods.

entry: POKENAME聚在雷雨下，高举魔杖，冒着受伤风险，盼被雷击。若命中，黄色斑纹便会明亮发光，电属性攻击也增强。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME gather under thunderstorms, raising their wands in hopes they will be struck by lightning despite the risk of injury. If struck, their yellow markings glow brightly and their Electric-type attacks are heightened.

entry: POKENAME极灵巧，轻松攀上高楼。它们成小群生活，借带蹼双脚分享电力，还能模仿雷雨。
author: torterrable
source: POKENAME is extremely nimble and can scale tall buildings with ease. They live in small groups and will share electricity through their webbed feet, which can mimic thunderstorms.

entry: POKENAME将尾巴接到插座上，收集电力。充满后，会释放蔓莓果般的香味。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME touches its tail to outlets to gather electricity. When fully charged, it releases a scent similar to Razz Berries.

entry: POKENAME将尾巴放进水里，放电就很开心。这能很好地使水电离，因此化学家常借助它。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME find great joy in putting their tail in water and sending out a shock. Since this is a great way to ionize water, they are often utilized by chemists.

entry: 传言POKENAME能预测落雷位置。一大群聚来，人们通常便留在室内。
author: archserpent
source: It's rumored that POKENAME can predict where lightning will strike. Whenever these Pokémon gather in numbers, people tend to stay indoors.

entry: POKENAME若被钓客拉起，就会朝对方猛放火花。通常能震住钓客足够久，让它游走。
author: .izik
source: If reeled in by an angler, POKENAME releases high bursts of sparks at them. This usually stuns the angler long enough for it to swim away.

entry: POKENAME根端有特殊器官，将吸收的阳光转成电。扎根时，能隐约见器官在地下发光，储能待用。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's roots end in special organs that convert absorbed sunlight into electricity. While rooted to the ground, one can faintly see the organs glowing underground as it stores the energy for later.

entry: 进入野外的POKENAME是可怕猎手，带电的蹼爪让它游得极快，轻松捕猎水生生物。
author: bigblue
source: POKENAME that find their way into the wild are formidable predators, using their electrical, webbed claws to swim at incredible speeds and hunt aquatic prey with ease.

entry: POKENAME的鬃毛混着火与电，火花、余烬盘旋，闪得像满天星。雷电还会流过蹄子。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME's mane is a mix of fire and electricity, swirling with glittering sparks and embers that glitter like a starry night sky. Lightning courses through its hooves.

entry: POKENAME越长大，毛越深、越长，牺牲泳速，换取保护。变强后，它更愿猎食陆上生物，免得电到自己。
author: bigblue
source: As POKENAME ages, its fur darkens and grows longer, trading off swimming speed for protection. As it grows stronger, it prefers hunting prey on land to avoid electrocuting itself.

entry: POKENAME浮在建筑上方，尾巴飘动。头上毛簇，其实由数万亿根细金属丝构成。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's tail flutters as it floats above buildings. The fur tuft on its head is made of trillions of tiny metal wires.

entry: POKENAME的炮能射带电水流，威力足以在金属板打出星形凹痕。它也能用爪放电，或以头上硬毛簇撞击、电击敌人。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME can fire electrically charged water from its cannons with enough force to leave star-shaped dents in metal plates. It can also shock foes with its claws or by headbutting them with the tuft of hardened hair on its head.

entry: POKENAME吃饱梦后，电能在体内奔涌，噼啪作响。有时吃到美梦，还会开心地从耳朵放电。
author: .izik
source: After feasting on dreams, POKENAME's body surges with electric energy. It crackles with power, sometimes even gleefully discharging shocks from its ears after eating pleasant dreams.

entry: POKENAME将身体埋入海底，只让双爪露出水面。它先用爪上的强光晃花猎物的眼睛，再将其拖进沙下。
author: floopussoupus
source: POKENAME bury themselves in the ocean floor with their claws poking above the water. They blind their prey with bright flashes from their claws before dragging them below the sand.

entry: POKENAME在背上种子里藏着麦克风，放大歌声，效果像扬声器。谁听见旋律，终究都会睡着，因此它常被用来治疗失眠。
author: fiordaliso
source: Inside the bulb on its back, POKENAME hides a microphone that amplifies its songs and sounds like a speaker. Anyone who listens to its melodies inevitably falls asleep, which is why POKENAME is often used to treat insomnia.

entry: POKENAME受威胁就唱歌。捕食者被美妙音乐分心，它便朝对方排出恶臭。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: When POKENAME is threatened, it begins to sing. While predators are distracted by the beautiful music, it expels a foul odour at them.

entry: POKENAME的歌传得很远，常能一次让整座村镇睡着。
author: smashbear
source: The singing of a POKENAME can reach far and wide, often putting entire villages or towns to sleep at once.

entry: 每天清晨，都能见到POKENAME练习歌唱。唱得太差或不够卖力的成员，可能被赶出群体。
author: busilisk
source: Every morning, POKENAME can be found practicing their singing. Weak or unenthusiastic singers risk being kicked out of the group.

entry: POKENAME朝着手中的麦克风，唱缓慢、哀婉的歌。听着睡着的对象，会梦见与家人的幸福时光。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME sings slow, plaintive songs into the microphone it carries. Those that fall asleep to the song dream of happy times with family.

entry: POKENAME释放精神活性烟气，使对方像醉了一样。释放时发出的声音，也颇令人着迷。
author: epping_forest
source: POKENAME releases psychoactive fumes that cause a state similar to drunkenness. The sound it produces when releasing them is also pretty mesmerizing to hear.

entry: 未融合的铁甲蛹听见POKENAME唱歌，可能陷入深睡。不知为何，醒来后，无论睡了多久，铁甲蛹都会立刻进化。
author: bradlybro199
source: If POKENAME's song is heard by an unfused Metapod it can be thrust into a deep rest. For an unknown reason, upon waking, no matter how short their rest, the Metapod will immediately evolve.

entry: POKENAME精确排气，推动身体移动。淡粉气体无味，浓度高时会使人困倦。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME propel themselves around through precise gas emissions. The light pink gas ejected from their bodies is odorless and induces drowsiness in high concentrations.

entry: POKENAME常在术后病房演出，让病人住得开心。歌声悦耳，即使疼得厉害，也能帮人入睡。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME often performs in post-operative recovery wards to brighten the stay of patients there. When it sings, its melodious voice helps people fall asleep even while in considerable pain.

entry: POKENAME野外发现熟睡宝可梦，会轻放进育儿袋，再哼柔和曲调，确保安稳休息。
author: .izik
source: If POKENAME finds a sleeping Pokémon in the wild, it gently places them in its pouch. It then hums a soft melody to ensure they rest peacefully.

entry: POKENAME的泡泡破裂，会发出轻轻的乐音。它一次吹出大小、节奏不同的泡泡，演奏水下音乐。
author: sk372
source: Bubbles blown by POKENAME release a faint musical tone when they pop. It creates several at a time in different sizes and tempos in order to create underwater music.

entry: POKENAME沿河游泳时会唱歌，歌声十分舒缓，岸边谁听见都会犯困。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME sings as it swims through rivers. The sound is so relaxing that anyone on the riverbanks will feel drowsy.

entry: POKENAME爱在空中振翅，用清澈嗓音歌唱。甜美摇篮曲，能安抚训练家和宝可梦。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME enjoy fluttering through the air and singing with their crystal-clear voice. Their sweet lullabies soothe both Trainers and Pokémon alike.

entry: POKENAME高速掠过夜空，常被误当流星。据说出现在城镇上方，当地人当夜就一定睡得好。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME zoom through the night sky at incredible speeds, often being mistaken for shooting stars. It is said that when one appears above a town, its residents are sure to sleep well that night.

entry: POKENAME不肯安静，逮到机会就大声唱，每段歌声都伴着生动手势。
author: .jerden
source: Refusing to be silent, POKENAME sing loudly at every opportunity. They accompany all of their vocals with expressive hand gestures.

entry: POKENAME有剃刀般利爪，是凶猛战士。战斗时唱歌，鼓舞同伴士气，打垮敌人斗志。
author: zweizweihander
source: POKENAME, with its razor-sharp claws, is a fierce fighter. In a battle, it sings songs that boost the morale of allies and crush that of its foes.

entry: POKENAME一唱，人们便聚来，鼓励它继续表演。听众常说，它的嗓音仿佛不属于人世。
author: gileme__
source: When POKENAME sings, crowds of people gather around, motivating it to continue performing. Listeners often describe POKENAME's voice as otherworldly.

entry: POKENAME在水中航行，为背上乘客唱舒缓的曲。许多训练家会带恋人同行，欣赏浪漫夕阳。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME sings a relaxing melody to those on its back as it sails through the water. Many Trainers will take their significant other along with them, enjoying a romantic view of the sunset.

entry: POKENAME皮肤黏稠，却能操控得看似柔软细腻。它爱被抚摸，主动靠近训练家和宝可梦。若对方显敌意，就唱甜美曲调安抚。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME has very slimy, gooey skin, but is able to manipulate it to appear soft and delicate. It loves to be petted and approaches Trainers and Pokémon. Should anything it approaches become aggressive, it sings a sweet melody to pacify them.

entry: POKENAME很爱交往，会随船同行，常为船员唱摇篮曲，帮助入睡。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are very social creatures, following alongside boats as they sail. They often sing the crew lullabies to help them fall asleep.

entry: POKENAME出现在屏幕后不久，就会开始播放一首数字化歌曲。歌声会让它所在的机器进入睡眠模式。
author: sk372
source: A short time after POKENAME appears on a screen, a digitized song will begin playing. The song causes whatever machine POKENAME is inhabiting to go into Sleep Mode.

entry: 周五夜晚，能见到POKENAME唱说唱歌曲，吸引潜在伴侣。若失败，它就僵在原地，仿佛挨了一记突如其来的重拳。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: On Friday nights, POKENAME can be found singing rap songs to entice a potential partner. If they are unsuccessful, POKENAME freezes in place, as if they were sucker-punched.

entry: POKENAME阴森而悦耳的叫声在深海回响，诱得生物越靠越近，直到触手无情出击。它的化石曾被发现嵌在古海底泥岩中，四周满是猎物残骸。
author: eiskitsune
source: POKENAME's haunting, melodic cry echoes through the deep, luring creatures ever closer until its tentacles strike without mercy. Fossils of POKENAME have been discovered embedded in ancient seafloor mudstone, surrounded by the remains of its prey.

entry: POKENAME仍唱史前时代就有的古老旋律。哪怕其他宝可梦听着已不会睡，它也觉得不必创新、改变摇篮曲。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME sings the same ancient melodies that were present in prehistoric times. It sees no need to innovate or change the lullabies it sings, even when Pokémon no longer fall asleep listening to it.

entry: 高海拔探险的徒步者常遇见POKENAME。这种蛇形宝可梦好奇、不怕人，饿时会主动找人，唱到对方睡着，再偷背包食物。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Hikers often run into POKENAME during high-altitude expeditions, the snake-like Pokémon being highly curious and unafraid of humans. When hungry, POKENAME will actively seek out people and sing them to sleep, stealing food from their backpacks.

entry: POKENAME在观众前大声唱，展示唱功。若看见谁不欢呼，就用念力逼对方欢呼。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME sings loudly before crowds to display its vocal prowess. Should it notice anyone not cheering, it forces them to do so with telekinesis.

entry: POKENAME用温柔歌声，安抚苦恼的宝可梦入睡。对每个特定物种，似乎都备有恰到好处、量身定制的不同歌曲。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses its gentle singing voice to help soothe troubled Pokémon to sleep. It has a different song seemingly tailor-made to work perfectly on any specific Pokémon species.

entry: POKENAME唱到哪，花就开到哪，飞行属性宝可梦也聚来。被激怒后，它使出尖锐的魅惑之声，召来飞行大军，摧毁袭击者。
author: ghostslythe
source: Wherever POKENAME sings, flowers bloom and Flying-type Pokémon gather. If angered, it uses a shrill Disarming Voice, calling forth the army of flyers to destroy its aggressor.

entry: POKENAME在水塘附近捕猎，摇篮曲听起来更像柔和低吼，而非真正歌声，让猎物入睡。肺活量很大，能连续唱歌或藏在水下数小时，不用换气。
author: milchik
source: POKENAME hunts near watering holes and uses its lullabies, which sound more like soft soothing growls than actual singing, to put its prey asleep. Its lung capacity allows it to sing or hide underwater for hours without the need to breathe.

entry: POKENAME偏爱用强颚咬住敌人脸，再发刺耳尖叫。它暴烈、明显好斗，几乎总需严格训练。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's preferred method of attack involves latching onto its opponent's face with its powerful jaws and letting out an ear-piercing shriek. It exhibits violent and overtly confrontational behavior, so rigorous training is almost always required.

entry: POKENAME常停在树枝上，监看下方动静。大眼睛始终警醒地盯着，常把孩子们吓一跳。
author: adam941
source: POKENAME are known to perch themselves on tree branches and survey the area below. They often scare children due to their large and watchful eyes.

entry: 野生POKENAME成群生活，温和友善。歌声的催眠效果太强，有时连自己也会唱睡着。
author: roundabout_robin
source: Groups of wild POKENAME are known to be gentle and friendly. Their song is so potent that they are known to put themselves to sleep.

entry: POKENAME警觉，会在洞前守望时唱歌。若彼此筑巢太近，就可能把自己催眠。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are vigilant creatures and sing songs while they keep watch in front of their dens. If they build dens too close to each other, they put themselves at risk of falling asleep.

entry: 成群的POKENAME整夜歌唱，欢快地随着旋律摇摆，让听见的人渐渐入睡。
author: mistymagius
source: Flocks of POKENAME sing all throughout the night, slowly lulling anyone who hears them to sleep. They cheerfully sway to the melody as they sing.

entry: POKENAME嗓音平淡，像说话多于唱歌。听者无聊到睡着，有些宝可梦每晚同一时间来听，确保安睡。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME sings with a prosaic voice that sounds closer to speech than music. People who listen to its song fall asleep out of boredom. Some Pokémon come to listen to its song at the same time every night to ensure they fall asleep.

entry: POKENAME每到日落，便啾啾唱摇篮曲，帮其他宝可梦入睡。睡着后，它从树枝俯冲，捕走没进洞的虫类宝可梦。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME chirps out a lullaby every sunset that helps other Pokémon fall asleep. Once they are asleep, POKENAME swoops down from tree branches to pick off bug Pokémon that are not in their burrows.

entry: POKENAME手臂肌肉弱，靠音乐才华脱险。可爱的咿呀声，让许多训练家忍不住养它。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have weak muscles in their arms, so they rely on their musical talent to escape danger. Their adorable babbling beguiles many Trainers into keeping them.

entry: 参加宝可梦华丽大赛时，训练家有时会给它们粉红头巾，祈求好运。它们会炫耀壳，突出圆滚滚的体形，头巾也让它们看起来更圆、更可爱。
author: quackquackattack
source: As they enter Pokémon contests, Trainers may give them a Pink Scarf for good luck. They flaunt their shells to emphasize their rotund form, and the scarf helps give them a rounder, cuter look.

entry: POKENAME啄树的中空部位，判断哪处混响最好。找到合适树洞，就跳进去唱短歌，享受回声。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME pecks at trees with hollow points to determine which will grant it the best reverb. Once it finds a suitable hole to hop into, it sings short songs and enjoys the echo it gains.

entry: 野生POKENAME在黎明、黄昏，会用单调音高歌唱。那其实是一种冥想。
author: cobalt0135
source: Wild POKENAME can be seen singing in monotone during the twilight hours of dawn and dusk. Their singing is actually a form of meditation.

entry: POKENAME身体轻，一跃便能越过普通房屋。它在湖边筑巢，靠出色听觉追踪水下猎物。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME's lightweight body allows them to clear the average house in a single jump. These Pokémon nest along lakes, using their excellent hearing to track prey beneath the water.

entry: POKENAME似乎像古代描绘中的胖丁。它深吸气、胀大身体，发出刺耳尖叫，扰乱周围；尖叫前，还会用长毛强拉敌人靠近。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME seems to resemble an ancient depiction of Jigglypuff. By inhaling deeply and expanding its body, it belts out an ear-splitting scream that disorients those around it. It uses its long hair to force foes to be closer before it screams.

entry: 叶子有好几种颜色，能让它随风漂游。它一路快乐歌唱，让听者放松心情。
author: frokachu
source: Its leaves can come in a few different colors. It uses them to float around in the wind. It sings happily as it drifts, relaxing those who hear it.

entry: POKENAME唱舒缓旋律催眠猎物，再用尖牙啃咬。若猎物比自己大，就让身体胀大，好装更多食物。
author: darkweavile428
source: POKENAME sings a soothing melody to put its prey to sleep, then begins to chew on them with its fangs. If the prey is bigger than it, POKENAME will inflate its body so it can hold more food.

entry: POKENAME等进化时不耗太多能量，会聚在日月光都能照清叶片的地方。最后关头才与同伴合唱，催眠捕食者，再逃到安全处。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME doesn't use much energy while waiting to evolve, gathering in places where both moonlight and sunlight can shine clearly on its leaves. It will sing with others as a last resort, putting predators to sleep before fleeing to safety.

entry: POKENAME飞行时，翅膀会随转向和移动方式发出不同音调。它们聚在一起，飞出复杂队形，合奏奇趣旋律。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME's wings buzz in different tones depending on how they steer or travel during flight. Groups of POKENAME gather together to fly in complex routines to perform whimsical melodies together.

entry: 遇见POKENAME，常被目光迷住，无法移开视线。它轻轻唱，抚平烦恼。听众情绪涌上，往往流泪，它便温柔收集，喝下眼泪。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Those who meet POKENAME often become entranced by its gaze, unable to look away. While they're mesmerised, it softly sings, easing their worries. Overwhelmed by emotion, listeners often burst into tears that POKENAME gently collects and drinks.

entry: 遇见POKENAME，常被目光迷住，无法移开视线。它轻轻唱，抚平烦恼。听众情绪涌上，往往流泪，它便温柔收集，喝下眼泪。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Those who meet POKENAME often become entranced by its gaze, unable to look away. While they're mesmerised, it softly sings, easing their worries. Overwhelmed by emotion, listeners often burst into tears that POKENAME gently collects and drinks.

entry: 训练家生病，POKENAME就唱温柔摇篮曲，帮助入睡、恢复。宝可梦中心员工珍视这安抚本领，常见它陪着护士。
author: fiordaliso
source: When its Trainer falls ill, POKENAME sings gentle lullabies to help them fall asleep and recover. Its soothing abilities are cherished by Pokémon Center staff, and it is often found accompanying the nurses.

entry: 这种宝可梦用催眠幻象，让威胁它的对象入睡，因此也是失眠者的绝佳帮手。
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher
source: This Pokémon uses hypnotic illusions to lull threats to sleep. Using this ability, it's a perfect aid for those who suffer from insomnia.

entry: 古代遗迹的墙上，刻着POKENAME的图案。图案连成摇篮曲的音符，只消看上一眼，就令人昏昏欲睡。
author: serversizeme
source: Carvings of POKENAME can be seen on the walls of ancient ruins. They form the notes to a lullaby that can make you sleepy just by looking at it.

entry: POKENAME在附近，收音机就发出奇怪频率，让大多生物困得厉害。它的身体也出奇柔韧。
author: bobosmith01
source: When POKENAME is around, radios begin to emit an odd frequency that causes most beings in the vicinity to feel incredibly drowsy. Its body is surprisingly pliant.

entry: POKENAME受威胁就鼓起身体，承受攻击，也让对手入睡。若成功，很快便会还击。
author: cascadeguy
source: When threatened, POKENAME puffs up its body to endure the attack and lull the opponent to sleep. If it's successful, it goes for a counterattack soon after.

entry: POKENAME催眠敌人，再用强钳紧抓。它偏爱从上方出手，摇篮曲起效后，便无声落下。
author: .izik
source: After putting a foe to sleep, POKENAME uses its strong claws to grab them tightly. It prefers to strike from above, dropping in silently after its lullaby takes effect.

entry: POKENAME难相处，又自命不凡。酸性唾液能杀死潜藏在口腔和喉咙里的细菌，它有时也朝敌人吐唾液自卫。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is known for its prickly and self-important personality. Its saliva is acidic, killing bacteria that lurk in its mouth and throat. It may spit at a foe to defend itself.

entry: POKENAME无论吃什么颜色的树果，果汁总是淡粉色，被视为极有效的助眠品。
author: sk372
source: No matter the color of the berries POKENAME consumes, the resulting berry juice always comes out a light shade of pink. POKENAME's juice is regarded as a highly effective sleep aid.

entry: POKENAME靠可爱外表脱困。不装可怜时，就会四处惹事，撕家具，弄得乱七八糟。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME rely on their cute appearance to get themselves out of trouble. When they are not looking pitiful, they can be found causing havoc, tearing up furniture and making a mess.

entry: POKENAME吃蜂蜜后，声音会严重跑调。但它仍热情十足地继续唱。
author: .izik
source: After eating honey, POKENAME's voice becomes wildly off-key. Despite this, it continues to sing with great enthusiasm.

entry: POKENAME在地道口唱歌，催眠里面的居民，再用长喙探入，叼走毫无戒备的猎物。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME sings at the entrance of tunnels to lull the inhabitants inside to sleep. It then uses its long beak to reach in and pluck out unsuspecting prey.

entry: POKENAME吸气，能胀到原来2倍大，吓退捕食者。呼气时缓缓吐出，化作出奇舒缓、传得极远的歌声。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME can puff their bodies up to twice their size, sucking in air to scare off predators. When they exhale, they do so slowly, making surprisingly soothing songs that can carry across vast distances.

entry: 嘴形能放大它发出的所有声音。强劲或舒缓的声波，能从远处击倒对手。
author: hophoppip
source: Its mouth is shaped to amplify any sounds it emits. It can take down opponents from afar with blasts of forceful or soothing sound.

entry: POKENAME爱给人惊喜礼物，却不愿被看见。它在窗外唱到人睡着，再闯入放礼物。可惜来得毫无规律，常给居家工作者添麻烦。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME enjoy giving surprise gifts to people, but dislike being observed doing so. They sing outside windows to put people to sleep, then break into homes to leave gifts. Unfortunately, they arrive at random times, causing issues for home workers.

entry: 音乐家训练POKENAME表演短歌。它却常练到一半饿，合作起来不容易。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are trained by musicians to perform short songs. They can be difficult to work with because they frequently get hungry during practice.

entry: POKENAME连上音乐串流服务，从身体播音乐。选的常是既有歌曲的混音或戏仿版。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME play music from their bodies by connecting to music streaming services. Many of the songs they choose to play are remixes or parodies of existing songs.

entry: 野生POKENAME投出周围地形的全息影像，躲避捕食者和训练家。谁识破伪装，它便凭好歌喉安抚，让对方沉睡。
author: npshi
source: Wild POKENAME produce holographic images of the nearby terrain to hide from predators and Trainers alike. POKENAME will use their excellent singing ability to pacify anyone who sees through this disguise, putting them into a deep slumber.

entry: POKENAME亮蓝的角色泽鲜艳，深受关都原住民工匠珍视。它是保护物种，天然分布区内的原住民社群，能直接为保护工作提供意见。
author: vic1312
source: Their bright blue horns are highly prized by indigenous Kantonian craftspeople for their naturally vibrant color. POKENAME are a protected species, and indigenous communities in their natural range have a direct input into their conservation.

entry: POKENAME在墙上画音符，轻松就能谱新旋律。奏出时尤其能安抚孩子，帮他们夜里入睡。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME will draw music notes across walls, effortlessly able to write new melodies. When played, these melodies have been described as calming, especially for children, helping them fall asleep at night.

entry: POKENAME的奶催眠作用极强。奇怪的是，不喝，只碰一下，也会突然犯困。
author: .izik
source: The milk POKENAME produces has potent sleep-inducing properties. Strangely, even touching the milk without drinking it can cause sudden drowsiness.

entry: POKENAME以最时髦、保养最好的卷毛为傲，常心不在焉地望着湖面，修剪卷毛。此时虽暴露给捕食者，蛮力却足以保护自己。
author: leandermalurt
source: POKENAME take great pride in having the most stylish and well-maintained curls. They are often seen absentmindedly staring into a lake while trimming them. Though exposed to predators while doing this, their brute strength keeps them safe.

entry: 据说POKENAME用魔杖造镜子。它模仿其他宝可梦，却有时装作发不出任何声。
author: pattybgoode
source: They say POKENAME makes mirrors with a magic wand. It mimics other Pokémon, but sometimes pretends it can't make any sound.

entry: POKENAME平静地飘在空中，喜欢唱歌，邀别人加入快乐合唱。它想贴地，好让观众听清，却常唱得忘我，飘远。
author: sylviasnake
source: POKENAME are found floating peacefully through the sky. They love to sing, inviting others to join in a joyful chorus. POKENAME try to stay low to the ground so their audience can hear, but tend to get caught up in their singing and drift off.

entry: POKENAME常4至5只一组，配合歌舞。呼气太冷，演完时，观众和舞台都已冻住。
author: _blissey
source: POKENAME are known to perform coordinated song-and-dance routines in groups of four or five. Their breath is so cold that they leave audiences and the stage frozen by the end of their shows.

entry: POKENAME在树根间打洞，借根系加固地下的家。夜里，它们常来到洞口，以歌声彼此交流。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME makes its burrows amongst tree roots, using the extra structure of the roots to reinforce its underground home. At night, they often come to the mouth of their burrows and sing out to one another to communicate.

entry: POKENAME只吃某些稀有花种的花粉，保持尽可能柔美的嗓音。歌声和花香，都能让最躁动的宝可梦入睡。
author: fiordaliso
source: To keep its voice as delicate as possible, POKENAME feeds exclusively on the pollen of certain rare flower varieties. Both its song and its floral fragrance hold the power to lull even the most restless Pokémon to sleep.

entry: POKENAME歌唱，周围就飘雪。节日里，它会挨家挨户唱喜庆的歌。
author: santon5512
source: Snow falls around POKENAME as they sing. During holidays, they will go door to door to sing festive songs.

entry: POKENAME与同类训练，用蓬松的爪子练拳，在树枝间竞速。觉得能独当一面，就前往山里，寻找月之石进化。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME trains with others of its kind, boxing with its puffy claws and racing across tree branches. When it feels prepared to strike out on its own, it travels into the mountains in search of a Moon Stone to evolve.

entry: POKENAME爱用各种哔哔、嘟嘟声，重现听过的乐曲。它还会钻进不同媒介里，继续唱个不停。
author: skymaster426
source: POKENAME adores repeating music it hears with a variety of boops and beeps. It likes to insert itself into different mediums to continue singing.

entry: POKENAME鸣叫如七夕青鸟的歌般动听，很爱给观众演出。若被打扰或截断表演，就气得身体胀大，朝肇事者吐火球。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME's chirps are as lovely to listen to as an Altaria's song. This Pokémon loves to perform in front of an audience. If its performance is disturbed or cut off, POKENAME will puff up with anger and spit fireballs at the culprit.

entry: POKENAME准备演出，羽毛身体就被火焰裹住，只剩发亮轮廓。火一散，舞台服装便现身，手里还拿着麦克风。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: When POKENAME gets ready for a performance, its feathery body becomes engulfed in flames, only leaving behind a glowing silhouette of their body. When the flames clear, POKENAME's stage outfit is revealed with a microphone in its hand.

entry: POKENAME以表演为傲，给训练家开音乐会。其他宝可梦像对待流行歌星一样，自然聚来参加演出。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME pride themselves in performing, putting on concerts for their Trainers. Other Pokémon seem to treat them as pop stars, naturally gathering for their performances.

entry: POKENAME歌声优美，吸引所有听众，令人恍惚入迷。它敏感于情绪，按观众调整歌曲，让每次演出都不同。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have beautiful singing voices that capture the attention of everyone listening, putting them into a trance. They use their emotional sensitivity to tailor their songs for their audience, making every performance unique.

entry: POKENAME歌声优美，吸引所有听众，令人恍惚入迷。它敏感于情绪，按观众调整歌曲，让每次演出都不同。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have beautiful singing voices that capture the attention of everyone listening, putting them into a trance. They use their emotional sensitivity to tailor their songs for their audience, making every performance unique.

entry: POKENAME歌声优美，吸引所有听众，令人恍惚入迷。它敏感于情绪，按观众调整歌曲，让每次演出都不同。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have beautiful singing voices that capture the attention of everyone listening, putting them into a trance. They use their emotional sensitivity to tailor their songs for their audience, making every performance unique.

entry: POKENAME因优美嗓音广受赞誉。最常见它在舞台开小音乐会，或在托儿所工作，为孩子唱最舒缓的摇篮曲。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is lauded for its beautiful singing voice. It is most commonly seen either on the stage performing small concerts, or working in nurseries providing the most soothing of lullabies to children.

entry: 山中的POKENAME群落用和声与远处同类联系。每个群落都有独特的合唱，经验丰富的登山者迷路时，可据此辨认方向。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Colonies of POKENAME communicate with others across their mountain homes by singing in harmony. Each colony has a unique chorus, and experienced hikers can use these songs to navigate when lost.

entry: POKENAME用巨臂爬上峭壁，找更好的高处唱歌。声音回荡下方山谷，让成群宝可梦安然入睡。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses its massive arms to help it climb up cliff faces, finding better vantage points to sing from. Its voice echoes across the valleys below, sending throngs of Pokémon into a peaceful slumber.

entry: POKENAME每次现身，都会有缓慢、不祥的旋律，仿佛从远处传来。没人听过全曲，因为总会被催眠睡着。
author: sk372
source: Whenever POKENAME manifests itself, a slow and baleful melody can be heard as if playing somewhere in the distance. Nobody has ever heard the full song since they inevitably fall asleep due to its soporific effects.

entry: POKENAME有橡胶般身体，天性爱玩，常为结交强大得多的宝可梦而陷入危险。即使交上朋友，也常因爱咬，让对方不愿久留。
author: katieplaysgames
source: With a rubbery body and naturally playful attitude, POKENAME often puts itself into dangerous situations trying to befriend much more powerful Pokémon. Even those it does get close to don't often stick around as it's prone to biting.

entry: POKENAME用响亮歌声，赶走洞穴里的竞争者，数英里外都听得见。但歌难听、没有调性，许多其他宝可梦也避开它。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME wards away rivals from its caves with loud songs that can be heard for several miles. Their songs are unpleasant and atonal, meaning many other Pokémon also keep away from them.

entry: POKENAME的和声令人迷醉。大意的训练家醒来时，可能已身在荒野，背包里的树果也被翻走了。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The harmonies produced when POKENAME sing have a mesmerizing quality. Unwary Trainers may find themselves waking up in the wilderness with their backpacks raided for berries.

entry: 与许多胖丁融合体不同，POKENAME希望观众在音乐会睡着。唱完还有谁醒着，它就会愤怒、暴力相待。
author: sk372
source: Unlike many other Jigglypuff fusions, POKENAME wants others to fall asleep during its concert performance. It gets angry and violent towards anyone still awake when it finishes singing.

entry: POKENAME察觉灾难，就唱警告歌。它们常成大群聚集，齐声歌唱。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: When it senses disasters, POKENAME sings warning songs. Large groups of POKENAME often gather, singing in unison.

entry: POKENAME是许多人最可怕的噩梦。行为虽与胖丁相似，歌声却会让目标陷入睡眠瘫痪，醒着也动弹不得。
author: kermeros
source: POKENAME is many people's worst nightmare. It behaves similarly to a Jigglypuff, but it instead puts its targets into sleep paralysis with its song.

entry: POKENAME温柔的鸣叫，数英里外也听得见。所有听见的对象，都会感到平静、放松。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's gentle cry can be heard from miles away. Anyone who hears its cry feels a sense of serenity and relaxation.

entry: POKENAME以低沉共鸣的节奏唱歌，悄悄改变感知。听众常相信它是神，直到歌声结束。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME sings in low, resonant cadences that subtly alter perception. Listeners often believe it divine until the song comes to an end.

entry: POKENAME小枝顶端的耳朵极敏感，最好别碰。挤压或拉扯，会让它苦恼地发出刺耳尖叫。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's ears on top of its twig are extremely sensitive and should not be bothered. Squeezing or tugging them will result in it making an ear-splitting high pitched shriek of distress.

entry: POKENAME唱柔和旋律，催眠大型宝可梦，再挪过去。若尚未偷偷通过，对方就醒来，它便用毒角攻击。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME sing soft melodies to lull larger Pokémon into slumber before shuffling past. If the Pokémon wakes up before POKENAME can sneak past, then they attack with their venomous horn.

entry: POKENAME振动刀刃，哼出优美的摇篮曲。等对手沉沉睡去，它便痛下杀手。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME vibrates its blade which hums a beautiful lullaby. When its opponent falls asleep, it finishes the job.

entry: POKENAME的尖毒角，能打倒独角犀牛。但比起正面冲撞，它更愿唱歌，催眠大型宝可梦。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a sharp, venomous horn that is capable of taking down a Rhyhorn. They prefer to lull larger Pokémon to sleep instead of tackling them head-on.

entry: POKENAME唱歌舒缓，又能用飘带安慰哭闹的幼童，因此很受托育工作者欢迎。
author: melodydelune
source: POKENAME is popular amongst daycare workers due to its soothing singing voice and ability to calm fussy toddlers with its ribbons.

entry: POKENAME挑战同类赛歌，唱得最准的，就赢得争议领地的主导权。强尾一击，还能引发猛烈地震。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME challenges other POKENAME to singing contests, and whichever sings truest wins dominance over the disputed territory. A single blow from its sturdy tail can trigger a violent earthquake.

entry: 满月夜，POKENAME直接对月歌唱。据说5只以上聚集，合声会使所有听者涌起深深悲伤。
author: .izik
source: On full moon nights, POKENAME sings directly to the moon. When five or more gather, their combined voices are said to evoke deep sorrow in anyone who hears them.

entry: POKENAME的歌能从细胞层面冻住听者。它收集受害者，拖进洞，再用冰冷嗓音唱小夜曲。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Its song freezes anyone who hears it at a cellular level. POKENAME will collect its victims, drag them into its cave, and serenade them with its frigid voice.

entry: 这些宝可梦常住城市，爱引人注意、展示自己，欢欢喜喜地唱歌跳舞，也紧盯最新的流行潮流。
author: cristata
source: Commonly found in cities, these Pokémon love attention and showing off, singing and dancing happily. They pay close attention to the latest trends.

entry: 这些宝可梦常住城市，爱引人注意、展示自己，欢欢喜喜地唱歌跳舞，也紧盯最新的流行潮流。
author: cristata
source: Commonly found in cities, these Pokémon love attention and showing off, singing and dancing happily. They pay close attention to the latest trends.

entry: POKENAME演奏的音乐催眠力很强。但和胖丁一样，若观众撑不到唱完就睡着，它便暴怒。
author: alestrius
source: The music played by POKENAME has strong soporific qualities. Much like Jigglypuff, POKENAME becomes enraged when its audience cannot stay awake until the end of its song.

entry: 夜里，它先凝望天空，再放声歌唱，一直唱到天明。事后，却全不记得自己做过什么。
author: skymaster426
source: At night, it stares into the sky before beginning to sing. It will do this until morning, and will not remember doing so afterwards.

entry: 这种宝可梦的上部像驾驶员，操纵身体；铠甲般的身体则保护它。两者配合，一拳便能击碎许多坚硬物体，用巨力粉碎敌人。
author: infranscia
source: The top part of this Pokémon acts like a pilot for the body.  The armor-like body protects the pilot in return.  Together, they can crush many solid objects with a single punch.  They use their incredible strength to crush foes.

entry: POKENAME爱给别人唱歌，听众觉得歌声阴森，却又令人放松。但确实发现过人和宝可梦听得太久、因此死亡的案例。
author: dahappycute
source: This Pokémon enjoys singing to others, and listeners of POKENAME's songs find them eerily soothing. However, cases have been found of Pokémon and humans alike dying after listening to their songs for too long.

entry: POKENAME用小翅膀在树间飞，唱温柔的曲。只在啃食刚萌发的嫩叶时，才会停下。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME flutters from tree to tree with its small wings, singing a gentle tune. It pauses only to nibble on freshly budding leaves.

entry: POKENAME在高树梢低吟悲伤歌曲，寻找同类陪伴。可惜，歌反将其他POKENAME催眠，让大家不再活动。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME sing sorrowful songs in search of companionship from others of their species, crooning from high in the treetops. Unfortunately their songs send other POKENAME to sleep, lulling them into inactivity.

entry: POKENAME齿轮旋转，就能模仿听过的任何歌曲。音乐家借这能力，准备音乐会和演出。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: When POKENAME's gears spin, it can replicate any song it's heard. Musicians utilize POKENAME's ability to help them prepare for concerts and performances.

entry: POKENAME能向中空的尾巴充气，跃上高处。嗓音有独特的旋律感，唱歌时，能使听者安然入睡，它就趁机偷走受害者的食物。
author: elfail0
source: POKENAME can inflate its hollow tail with gas, which allows it to leap to great heights. Its voice has a distinct melodic quality that lulls listeners to peaceful sleep when it sings. It will use this chance to steal food from its victims.

entry: POKENAME爱表演，寻找大群宝可梦献唱。歌声的催眠效果甚至比未融合的胖丁更强，几乎没有宝可梦意志够强，能醒着听完整场。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME love to perform and seek out large gatherings of other Pokémon to sing to. The effects of their voice are even more soporific than those of unfused Jigglypuff. Very few Pokémon have the willpower to stay awake through the whole performance.

entry: 融合后的POKENAME，酷似灵异杂志里据称已有10亿年历史的胖丁。为什么会这样，仍不清楚。
author: kungfucutbug
source: Fused POKENAME bear a striking resemblance to an alleged 1-billion-year-old Jigglypuff found in a paranormal magazine. It's currently unknown why this happens.

entry: POKENAME在火山高原上唱歌，歌声传遍灼热的大地。下方熔岩的光，让表演有近乎催眠的魅力。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME sings atop volcanic plateaus, its voice carrying over the fiery landscape. The glow of lava below gives its performances an almost hypnotic allure.

entry: POKENAME很胆小，常藏在其他宝可梦或训练家身后。独处时，会唱短短的幽灵般曲调，飘过夜色。
author: amberaxolotl223
source: POKENAME are very timid Pokémon, often hiding behind other Pokémon or their Trainers. When alone, POKENAME will sing short, ghostly tunes that drift throughout the night.

entry: POKENAME常以歌声作声呐，探知障碍物，有时也会唱歌催眠天敌。
author: phrotonz
source: POKENAME often sings as a form of sonar to detect obstacles. They may also sing to put predators asleep.

entry: POKENAME用各种啾鸣和歌曲沟通。但令人与宝可梦都头疼的是，它的歌以让谁都犯困而出名。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME communicate with one another through various chirps and songs. To the chagrin of people and Pokémon alike, however, their songs are infamous for making anyone drowsy.

entry: 这种宝可梦用体内火囊的热，胀大胸部，连物理打击都能弹开。它也能排热改变轨迹，灼烧潜在威胁。
author: infinex21
source: This Pokémon can use the heat of its internal flame sac to inflate its chest to the point that physical blows bounce off. It can expel this heat to alter its trajectory and to burn any would-be threats.

entry: POKENAME声音共鸣强，靠回声定位。它唱的摇篮曲回荡洞穴，让其他宝可梦睡着。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a resonant voice that they rely on for echolocation. These lullabies they sing echo through caves and put other Pokémon to sleep.

entry: POKENAME在宝石丰富的洞中安家，喜欢唱阴森却舒缓的旋律，靠自己产生的回声茁壮生存。
author: hamperius
source: POKENAME make their home inside caves where plenty of gemstones can be found. It likes to sing an eerie yet soothing melody and thrives on the echoes it creates.

entry: POKENAME在开阔空地高速竞跑，比谁最快。研究者想观察，确定它们是否是真正融合体，却总被催眠，很难完成研究。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME race around open clearings at high speed, trying to see who can go the fastest. Pokémon Researchers observing these races to determine if they are a true fusion struggle to complete their research, as POKENAME often put them to sleep.

entry: 融合让POKENAME既爱玩，又带凶猛脾性。接球游戏，能让它乐个不停。
author: hortensia_xxiii
source: POKENAME's fusion has matched its playfulness with a ferocious streak. Games of catch amuse it endlessly.

entry: POKENAME在草地摇摆游荡，除吸收阳光外，似乎什么也不干。日光存够，便能从独眼发射太阳能光束。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME waddles through grasslands, doing nothing in particular besides absorbing sunlight. If it stores up enough sunlight, it can fire beams of solar energy from its single eye.

entry: POKENAME以悦耳吟唱受到喜爱。它只吃红色食物，维持粉色毛皮。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME are popular for their melodic chants. Their pink fur color is maintained via a diet of only red foods.

entry: 有时能见这种宝可梦在各处摇摆游荡，仿佛永无止境。途中还会从独眼发射小型太阳能光束，同样不知为何。
author: infranscia
source: This Pokémon can sometimes be found waddling around different places, seemingly endlessly.  As it does, it can also be seen firing miniature beams of solar energy from its singular eye, also for no apparent reason.

entry: POKENAME身体软、翅膀蓬松，陪睡很舒服，因此被容许住进其他宝可梦的巢。它也会唱摇篮曲，让睡眠更加愉快。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are tolerated in nests of other Pokémon because their soft bodies and fluffy wings make them comfy to sleep with. They also sing lullabies that make for a pleasant sleeping experience.

entry: POKENAME皮肤弹性极强，能胀到原来的2倍多。它用储存的空气，对远方同类唱歌，约德尔歌声数英里外都听得见。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME can puff up to more than twice their starting body size thanks to having an extremely elastic skin. They use this stored air to sing to one another across vast distances, their yodels being audible from miles away.

entry: POKENAME柔软、适合拥抱，谁按下肚子上的按钮，它就唱歌。许多个体在育儿设施协助照护人员，让孩子们入睡。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are soft, cuddly creatures that sing whenever someone presses the button on their stomach. Many aid caregivers at childcare facilities with putting children to sleep.

entry: POKENAME热爱战斗，却也以爱表现出名。每次上场前，一定先唱“登场曲”，为自己鼓劲。
author: mbo1064.
source: This Pokémon loves to battle. However, it is notorious for its showmanship. POKENAME will always sing a "walk-up" song to hype itself up before entering a battle.

entry: POKENAME孢子有催眠作用，吸入便会沉睡。制药业饲养大量个体，用孢子为失眠者制助眠药。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME spores have a soporific effect, sending anyone who breathes them into a deep sleep. Pharmaceutical industries keep large populations of them so that they can use the spores to produce sleeping medication for sufferers of insomnia.

entry: 寒冷冬夜，能听见POKENAME成群唱甜美、安抚的曲。每群有独特摇篮曲，却也乐意和别群一起唱。
author: mistymagius
source: During cold, winter nights, Herds of POKENAME can be heard singing a sweet and calming tune. Each POKENAME herd has their own unique lullaby but will happily sing along with other herds.

entry: POKENAME的美妙歌声，能让所有听见的对象安然入眠。录下的旋律，作为助眠品卖往世界各地。
author: chibitales
source: The beautiful songs POKENAME sings are able to put any who hear them into a restful sleep. Melodies recorded from them are sold all over the world as sleep aids.

entry: 有些POKENAME发现，用月之石处理感染处，能减缓寄生蘑菇生长。它们背着月之石碎片，试着阻止蘑菇继续蔓延。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Some POKENAME have discovered that the parasitic mushroom growth that plagues them can be slowed by using Moon Stones on infected areas. They carry Moon Stone shards atop their back in an effort to prevent the mushrooms from continuing to grow.

entry: POKENAME夜里藏在小巷，身体里传出悦耳、舒缓的歌声。若被靠近，就放出漆黑孢子云，几秒便让猎物睡着。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME hides in alleys at night, letting out melodic, calming singing from its body. If approached, it releases a cloud of jet black spores that put the prey to sleep within seconds.

entry: 许多偶像艺人喜欢与POKENAME合作，因为它的歌声确保艺人演出前安睡。有些会带着最喜欢的POKENAME的照片，困难时看看，希望鲜艳色彩带来信心。
author: beetlething
source: Many idols enjoy working with POKENAME, as its singing ensures the idols get good sleep before a performance. Some idols carry photos of their favorite POKENAME to look at during rough times, hoping the vibrant colors will bring them confidence.

entry: 它的颜色和毛茸茸外表，深受年轻女孩喜爱。它偏爱暗光处，唱温柔小曲，让自己和别人都安心。
author: sk372
source: Its color and fuzzy appearance make it quite popular with young girls. It prefers lingering in areas with low light, singing soft little songs that put itself and others at ease.

entry: 每天早晨，POKENAME成群歌唱，回声传遍池塘家园。听众将这声音视为好天气的征兆。
author: mepp.
source: Every morning, groups of POKENAME gather to sing, their songs echoing across the pond habitat. Those who listen consider the sound a sign of good weather.

entry: POKENAME受月光吸引，夜里成群升空，追随月亮轨迹。聚集时彼此唱歌，和声飘过黑暗，催眠所有听者。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are drawn to the light of the moon, swarms of them taking to the skies at night to follow its path through the sky. They sing to one another as they gather, their harmony drifting through the dark and lulling those who hear it to sleep.

entry: POKENAME头上圆盘衬着金属片，移动就叮当响。受威胁时，它快速抖动，想用大声响吓退捕食者。
author: hophoppip
source: The disk on POKENAME's head is lined with metal plates that make a jingling sound when it moves. It shakes rapidly when threatened in hopes to scare off predators with loud jingling.

entry: POKENAME轻轻飘过夜空，开心歌唱。大多听者撑不到摇篮曲唱完，便会睡着。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME floats gently through the night sky, singing with joy. Most who hear its lullaby can't stay awake long enough to hear it finish.

entry: POKENAME漂过天空，岩壳里回荡着闷闷的歌。若察觉谁没在听，就会气得爆炸。
author: .izik
source: A muffled song echoes from within POKENAME's rocky shell as it drifts through the sky. If it senses someone isn't listening, it will explode in a fit of rage.

entry: POKENAME受月光吸引，夜里成群升空，追随月亮轨迹。聚集时彼此唱歌，和声飘过黑暗，催眠所有听者。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are drawn to the light of the moon, swarms of them taking to the skies at night to follow its path through the sky. They sing to one another as they gather, their harmony drifting through the dark and lulling those who hear it to sleep.

entry: POKENAME与同类一起挖地，开心唱歌。曲调舒缓，足以让附近钻地的宝可梦睡着。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME sings cheerfully while digging alongside others of its kind. The melody is soothing enough to lull nearby tunneling Pokémon into sleep.

entry: POKENAME为情侣唱美妙情歌。有人说，听见便能巩固感情。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME serenades couples with a beautiful song. Some say that hearing the song will bolster your relationships.

entry: 有谁靠近，POKENAME的3颗头就默契齐唱。旋律令猎物着迷，引向隐藏陷坑。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's three heads sing in perfect unison when someone approaches. The melody entrances prey, luring them toward hidden pitfalls.

entry: POKENAME彼此和声，摇篮曲形成优美的三声部旋律。观众散去后，它们就不满，钻地离开，找更懂欣赏的听众。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME harmonise with one another when they sing, their lullabies forming a beautiful three-part melody. When their audience falls apart, they grow disgruntled and dig away in search of a more appreciative audience.

entry: POKENAME彼此和声，摇篮曲形成优美的三声部旋律。观众散去后，它们就不满，钻地离开，找更懂欣赏的听众。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME harmonise with one another when they sing, their lullabies forming a beautiful three-part melody. When their audience falls apart, they grow disgruntled and dig away in search of a more appreciative audience.

entry: POKENAME爱玩又好动，一闹起来就靠柔韧身体在屋里弹跳好几分钟，停都不停。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME is very playful and hyperactive. Once it gets going, it bounces around the room for minutes without stopping thanks to its flexible body.

entry: 它的喵叫声有极强的催眠效果，因此格外受到睡眠不好的人欢迎。
author: chorb33
source: Its meowing has an incredibly soporific effect, which is why it is particularly popular with people with sleep problems.

entry: POKENAME爱唱，却常忘记歌会催眠其他宝可梦。发现观众睡着，就转去找下一群。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME love to sing but often forget their songs put other Pokémon to sleep. Once POKENAME realize their audience is asleep, they move on to another crowd.

entry: 野生POKENAME只有蛮力打不赢时，才最后使出催眠。宝可梦常因可爱脸和颜色，低估它。
author: mrpimbus
source: A wild POKENAME only puts opponents to sleep as a last resort if it can not win with raw strength. Pokémon often underestimate it due to its cute face and coloration.

entry: POKENAME爱唱，常找观众表演。若觉得被忽视、歌曲不受欣赏，就会暴怒，攻击看见的所有对象。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME love to sing, often seeking out audiences to perform for. If they feel ignored or that their songs aren't being appreciated, they will be thrown into a fit of rage, attacking anyone they see.

entry: POKENAME蹭岩石清毛，留下簇簇毛团。不梳理时，就练习悦耳的嚎唱。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME keep their fur tidy by rubbing their fur against rocks, which leaves tufts of fur behind. They practice their musical howling when they are not grooming themselves.

entry: 训练家有心事时，POKENAME就唱歌缓解焦虑。它粉色的毛皮极软极暖，其他宝可梦夜里常把毛皮当软垫睡觉。
author: fiordaliso
source: If its Trainer is worried about something, it sings to ease their anxiety. Its pink fur is extremely soft and warm, so much so that other Pokémon often use POKENAME's coat as a cushion to sleep on at night.

entry: 据说这种宝可梦的鬃毛有神秘力量。传言它快得能一闪跃过世界；也许，那其实是另一种能力。关于它，拍过许多电影。
author: infranscia
source: This Pokémon's mane is said to hold mysterious powers.  It's rumored to be so fast, it can jump across the world in a flash; or perhaps that's a separate power.  Many a movie has been made about this Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME有男高音般的唱功，能让歌声传遍山谷家园。宽翼带它飞到高处，让旋律向下飘落。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME has the vocal power of a tenor and can carry its songs across the entire valley it calls home. Its broad wings allow it to reach high vantage points from which it lets its melodies descend.

entry: POKENAME表演前，往肚里吸满空气。许多观众被腹纹、温柔歌声迷住，大多最终睡着。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME inhale lots of air into their stomachs before a performance. Many audience members are mesmerized by the pattern on their bellies and the gentle song that POKENAME sing, which causes most to fall asleep.

entry: 面对比自己强的对手，它吞更多空气，让肌肉显得更大。但常胀过头，给自己带来剧痛。
author: mistymagius
source: When faced with an opponent stronger than itself, it will swallow extra air to make its muscles look bigger. However, it tends to overinflate itself, causing it immense pain.

entry: POKENAME吹出悦耳口哨，据说能帮助植物生长。它常在雏菊花田中央轻唱，周围花朵随之摇曳。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME whistles a delightful tune said to help plants grow. It can often be found in the middle of daisy fields, singing softly as flowers sway around it.

entry: POKENAME亲人又爱撒娇，抱着也舒服，是很受欢迎的宠物。安心时，它会自顾自轻轻哼唱。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME is extremely affectionate and cuddly, which makes it a popular pet. When it feels comfortable, it hums gently to itself.

entry: POKENAME用中空身体放大歌声。雨季，体内灌满雨水，能发出的声音种类也改变。
author: .7soul
source: POKENAME uses its hollow body as a means of amplifying the sound of its songs. During the rainy season, it is filled with rainwater, altering the types of sounds it can produce.

entry: POKENAME对歌喉有自信，若觉得谁嘲笑或无视自己，就毫不犹豫挥强拳痛打。它的声音能鼓舞听众，让大家跃跃欲试，想展示力量。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is confident in its singing and will not hesitate to use its powerful fists to wallop anything it thinks is mocking or ignoring it. Its vocalizations invigorate listeners, pumping them up for physical feats of strength.

entry: POKENAME游荡家园，毛里结住泥土石块，外表粗糙凹凸。滚下坡时，团块掉落，被小比鸟等筑巢宝可梦收集。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME's fur clumps up with dirt and stones as it wanders about its habitat, leading to a rough, bumpy appearance. When it rolls downhill, the clumps become dislodged and are collected by nesting Pokémon, like Geotto.

entry: POKENAME不照顾毛，毛团结得密实，妨碍移动，却也有助防护。它比看着轻，能沿山脉蹦跳，亲眼一看便知。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME's lack of care for its coat has turned the clumps of fur into dense tufts that impede its movement but aid in protection. It is lighter than its appearance indicates, which can be witnessed as it bounces along mountain ranges.

entry: 这种罕见POKENAME变体精力过旺，很少认真。它想尽办法给别人快乐，歌声连最痛苦的老人，也能逗出笑容。
author: periperi_chicken
source: This rare variation of POKENAME is hyperactive and rarely takes anything seriously. It will do anything it can to bring joy to others, and its singing can bring a smile to even the most miserable old man.

entry: POKENAME爱追火车，边跑边唱摇篮曲。司机意外睡着，已因此出过事故。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME love chasing trains. As they run, they sing lullabies, which have caused accidents when the train driver accidentally falls asleep.

entry: POKENAME一进入同类群体，就很难离开。一个哈欠便能接连引出嘈杂哈欠声，把整群催眠。
author: quackquackattack
source: Once POKENAME enters a colony of its kind, it is rarely able to leave. This is because a single yawn can cascade into a cacophony that puts the entire colony to sleep.

entry: POKENAME一边唱着催眠曲，一边有节奏地拖动尾巴。坚硬外壳，则保护着柔韧的身体。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME accompanies its soporific singing with a rhythmic dragging of its tail. It protects its flexible body with a hard shell.

entry: POKENAME浮在发电厂附近，软身体噼啪放电。歌唱时，小火花从嘴里漏出，落到地上。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's soft body crackles with electricity while it floats near power plants. When it sings, tiny sparks escape its mouth and fall to the ground.

entry: POKENAME朝随身麦克风唱柔和摇篮曲，使周围宝可梦沉睡。平时虽快活，若其他宝可梦想用麦克风，它就会敌视。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME sing soft lullabies into the microphone they carry with them, causing other Pokémon around them to fall into a deep sleep. Despite their general jovial mood, they become hostile if another Pokémon tries to use their microphone.

entry: POKENAME爱用麦克风唱，哪怕歌太响，根本当不了摇篮曲。它能连唱数小时，只有麦克风需要充电才停。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME love to sing with their microphone, even if their songs are too loud to function as lullabies. They can sing for hours at a time and only stop once their microphone needs a charge.

entry: POKENAME歌唱优美，与另一颗头和声完美。可惜两头都孩子气，常打架，因此难得唱出这样的歌。
author: t3isukone
source: POKENAME sings beautifully, harmonizing perfectly with its other head. However, these songs are rare, as both heads tend to have childish personalities and regularly fight with each other.

entry: POKENAME跃上浮冰唱歌，声音传遍北极地区。同类受吸引，赶来便加入，独唱几乎总变成大合唱。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME leaps atop ice floes to sing, its voice carrying across the arctic regions. Other POKENAME are drawn to the song and join in once they arrive, so solo performances almost always turn into group choirs.

entry: POKENAME粉色外层虽是固体，却软软的，身体体积大多仍是各种气体。它有时从口中排出一种气体，让对方困倦、头昏。
author: bobosmith01
source: Although its outer pink layer is solid (albeit squishy), most of what constitutes POKENAME's volume consists purely of various gases. POKENAME may expel one type of gas from its mouth that causes drowsiness and lightheadedness.

entry: POKENAME粉色外层虽是固体，却软软的，身体体积大多仍是各种气体。它有时从口中排出一种气体，让对方困倦、头昏。
author: bobosmith01
source: Although its outer pink layer is solid (albeit squishy), most of what constitutes POKENAME's volume consists purely of various gases. POKENAME may expel one type of gas from its mouth that causes drowsiness and lightheadedness.

entry: POKENAME常飘在行人旁，露出恳求表情。收到礼物，就开心唱完再飘走。有些孩子还把送礼当游戏，礼物越送越精巧。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME often float by people as they walk, looking at them with a pleading face. If given a gift, it will sing happily before floating away. Some children have even made a game of giving POKENAME increasingly elaborate gifts.

entry: POKENAME在洞穴家园四处挖大地道，改善音乐的声学效果。歌声回荡每间洞室，催眠其他所有生物，让它自由游荡。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME digs large tunnels all through its cavernous homes to make for better acoustics for its music. Its song echoes through every chamber of the cave, putting every other creature to sleep so it may roam freely.

entry: POKENAME能用摇篮曲操纵梦境。科学家训练许多个体，帮助人进入清醒梦，开展研究。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are able to manipulate dreams with their lullabies. Many POKENAME are trained by scientists to help people enter into lucid dreams for research studies.

entry: POKENAME夜里在镇上游荡，寻找难以安睡的人。它隔窗唱催眠摇篮曲，几秒就能让对方入睡。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME wander around towns at night looking for restless individuals. Through their windows, they will sing them a hypnotic lullaby able to put them to sleep within seconds.

entry: POKENAME体内存有毒孢子，能从身上孔洞释放。集中喷出，甚至能击昏愤怒的猴怪。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME store toxic spores within their body and release them through the holes in their body. These concentrated bursts of spores can knock out an angry Mankey.

entry: POKENAME吃工厂附近的灌木叶，也能吃黏在叶上的灰色烟尘。它的胃消化力极强，能化解烟灰毒性，将其转成养分。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME eats leaves from bushes near factories and are capable of consuming the ash-colored soot that ends up clinging to leaves. Their powerful stomachs neutralize the poisonous soot to convert it into nutrients.

entry: POKENAME披着钨制外壳，轻松滚过崎岖地貌。途中被打扰，就使出强力电球。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body is covered in a tungsten shell, allowing it to roll across rough landscapes with ease. If interrupted while traveling, it unleashes a powerful Electro Ball.

entry: POKENAME曾被士兵训练，穿越战场后爆炸。爆炸力道，能使附近地区震动。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME were once trained by soldiers to explode after crossing a battlefield. The force of the explosion can create tremors in the nearby area.

entry: 它穿着母亲蜕下的旧甲，那是如今唯一能用来追念母亲的遗物。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: It wears the shed armor of its mother as a hand-me-down, the last thing it has to remember her by.

entry: POKENAME的壳硬如厚钢板。它用黏丝吊在洞顶，这种丝精炼后，强度堪比金属。接近进化时，身体太重，丝便吊不住。
author: infinex21
source: Their shells are as hard as a slab of solid steel. POKENAME hang from cave ceilings using sticky threads with the strength of metal when refined. Their bodies grow too heavy to hang by these threads as they near their evolution.

entry: POKENAME冲撞崎岖峭壁侧面，露出铁矿。找到好矿源，就不停撞那一处，在地形上开出洞。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME rams itself into the side of rugged cliffs to expose iron ore. If this Pokémon finds a good source of iron, it will continue to bash into that area, creating a hole in the terrain.

entry: POKENAME的蛋覆着坚韧金属壳，既防捕食者，也是战斗中的好武器。若想分给别人吃，它会自己敲开外层，露出营养丰富的内里。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's eggs are actually coated in a tough metallic shell to deter predators and make effective weapons in battle. If it wishes to share one for consumption, it breaks the outer layer itself, revealing the nutritious contents within.

entry: POKENAME鳍部的钢极其柔韧、易塑形。它们成群用金属身体反射阳光，晃得捕食者看不见。
author: alestrius
source: The steel that makes up an POKENAME's fins is extremely flexible and malleable. Schools of POKENAME blind predators by reflecting sunlight off of their metallic bodies.

entry: POKENAME快速旋转金属身体，能产生猛烈漩涡。它寻找海底沙下埋着的金属物吃。
author: fiordaliso
source: When POKENAME spins its metallic body rapidly, it can generate violent whirlpools. It searches for metallic objects buried beneath the seafloor sand to feed on them.

entry: POKENAME用超能力寻找海底金属碎片。有时在近水面，固定于货船上，啃穿金属船体，造成很大危险。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME uses its psychic abilities to locate scraps of metal on the seafloor. Occasionally it can be found near the surface anchored on cargo boats, posing a great risk as it eats through the metal hull.

entry: 它的牙几秒就能撕碎一切，常被办公室用来处理废物、文件。外表虽可怕，POKENAME却极听话、平静。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its teeth can shred anything in seconds, which is why it's often used in offices to dispose of waste or documents. Despite its menacing appearance, POKENAME is an extremely obedient and calm Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME周身金属壳，保护它免遭大型捕食者。锋利钢蹄踢向其他宝可梦，能留下深伤。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a metallic shell around their body that protects them from large predators. Their sharp hooves are made of steel, which can cause deep cuts when they kick other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME用来游泳的肌肉较弱，金属壳又沉，大半时间只能待在湖底。费上极大力气，一次也只能游约10英尺，随后便要休息。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's weak swimming muscles combined with its heavy metal shell leaves it spending most of its time at the bottom of lakes. With considerable effort, it can swim about ten feet at a time before needing rest.

entry: POKENAME嗅觉敏锐，能找到微量原矿，深受矿工喜爱。角分泌腐蚀毒液，将金属碎屑溶成浆，方便吞食。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME have an acute sense of smell capable of locating trace amounts of raw ores, so they are favored by miners. They secrete a corrosive toxin from their horns that can melt metal flakes into a slurry for them to consume.

entry: POKENAME的铁壳在准备进化时，保护内脏。进化便蜕去外层金属，留下空壳，很容易被误认成真的POKENAME。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME's iron shell keeps its innards safe while it prepares its body for evolution. It will shed its outer layer of metal upon evolving, leaving behind a hollow husk that is easily mistaken for an actual POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME将爪子埋进沙，滤食小生物。它很少移动，金属壳坚固沉重，几乎没有捕食者能举起或咬穿。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME buries its claws into the sand and filter-feeds on small organisms. It rarely moves, and its sturdy and heavy metal shell means that few predators have the strength to pick it up or bite into it.

entry: POKENAME通常在深矿井发现，父母在那里筑巢产卵。这种小型龙属性宝可梦蜕下的皮，作材料价值连城。
author: lejon51
source: POKENAME can typically be found deep in mineshafts where its parents make nests for their eggs. The shed skin of this small Dragon-type Pokémon is worth a fortune as a material.

entry: 它的钢制毒刺能整齐刺穿树木。双翼硬如铁，却轻得能快如螺旋桨般活动。
author: infinex21
source: Its venomous stingers are made of steel and can cleanly puncture trees. Its wings are as hard as iron, yet are so light that they can move as quick as propellers.

entry: 它友好，会用头碰亲近者，表示喜爱。但力气太大，对方可能被撞飞到房间另一端。
author: bostroms
source: It is friendly and will headbutt those it cares about as a sign of affection.  However, its powers are so great that this may send the recipient flying across the room.

entry: POKENAME全身覆着厚钢板铠甲，会晒太阳，让铠甲变暖。头上叶片既储存能量，也滤掉可能使铠甲生锈的化学物质。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME's body is covered in an armor of thick steel plates, which it warms beneath the sun. The leaf on its head stores energy and filters out chemicals that could rust its armor.

entry: POKENAME身体坚如钢，用粗壮双腿将矿石、矿物块踩成粉吃。花瓣散发金属味，越接近进化，气味越锐利。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME have steel-hard bodies and use their stout, strong legs to crush up pieces of ore and mineral chunks into a dust to consume. Their petals exude a metallic odor that grows sharper as they near their evolution.

entry: POKENAME用背上的火焰加热金属，方便吃下。愤怒时，铠甲热得能造成灼伤。
author: lbbacca
source: POKENAME uses the flames on its back to heat metal, making it easier to consume. When angry, its armor becomes hot enough to leave burns.

entry: POKENAME用更炽热的火焰，将大量矿石熔炼成金属，再尽情享用。准备战斗时，它会侧身站立，头朝敌人，随时用头部或尾部的火焰灼烧对方。
author: lbbacca
source: With a hotter flame, POKENAME smelts large quantities of ore into metal before feasting upon it. When ready for battle, it stands to the side with its head facing the enemy, ready to burn them with its flames from head or tail.

entry: POKENAME的重甲使它无法浮起，因此大多伏在水底，等待毫无防备的宝可梦从上方游过。它一次能在水下，待上最长二十四小时。
author: gamblingdie
source: POKENAME's heavy armor prevents it from floating, so it spends most of its time lying in wait on the water's floor for an unsuspecting Pokémon to swim above. It can remain submerged for up to 24 hours.

entry: POKENAME过着少动的生活，常在岸边长时间歇息。睡觉若被打扰，就会勃然大怒，攻击视野内的一切。它已不再常常待在水里。
author: gamblingdie
source: POKENAME leads a sedentary lifestyle, resting along the shoreline for long periods. If disturbed while sleeping, it flies into a rage and attacks anything in sight. It no longer spends much time in the water.

entry: POKENAME喜欢在高处栖息，成群寻找视野辽阔的地方。它们身体沉重，一群停栖，就可能压坏较脆弱的设施；许多电线，都曾被它们压塌。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME love to roost in high places, gathering together to find areas with views across large distances. They are heavy enough that a roosting flock poses a risk to more fragile structures; many powerlines have collapsed under their weight.

entry: POKENAME用六条腿，敲打坚硬如铁、却中空的腹部，彼此交流。腿与身体相接处，会分泌芳香的液体，帮助保持清洁。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME communicate by drumming their iron-hard, albeit hollow, bellies with their six legs. They secrete an aromatic fluid from where their legs join their bodies, which helps to keep themselves clean.

entry: POKENAME覆着金属外骨骼，几乎能抵御一切危险。它们会吃掉找到的任何裸露金属，供身体生长，在建筑工地，是不受欢迎的祸患。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are coated with a metallic exoskeleton that protects them from almost all danger. They consume any exposed metal they can find to fuel their growth, making them an unwanted pest at construction sites.

entry: POKENAME的外骨骼中，遍布生长着的金属甲片，为它们抵御捕食者。甲片分为一节节，比起整块坚实的护甲，行动更加自由。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have metallic plating growing throughout their exoskeletons, providing vital protection against their predators. These metallic plates are segmented, allowing greater freedom of movement than more solid plating would provide.

entry: POKENAME虽然覆着沉重的金属护甲，却很有弹性。它喜欢被抱起、抛来抛去，不过稍不小心，就可能伤到人，或损坏财物。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is quite bouncy despite being covered with heavy metal shielding. It enjoys being picked up and thrown around, though doing so could cause damage to people or property if not careful.

entry: POKENAME小小的身体，披着过于沉重的金属外层，连走路都很困难。它用双手敲打钢铁腹部，发出回荡的铿锵声，吓退捕食者。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's metal coating is so heavy on its small frame that it has difficulty walking. It drums its hands against its steel belly to create an echoing clang to scare off predators.

entry: POKENAME用金属喙啄击采矿设备，偶尔吃下小块碎片。之后，它有时会看见最近使用者生活中的片段。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME pecks at mining equipment with its metal beak, occasionally consuming small pieces. Afterward, it sometimes experiences visions from the most recent user's life.

entry: POKENAME像活着的避雷针，保护重要建筑，免遭风暴侵害。接触它时要小心，因为金属甲片，非常容易导电。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME acts as a living lightning rod to protect vital buildings from the dangers of storms. Be careful about contact with this Pokémon, as its metal plates are very conductive.

entry: 身体由极轻又坚韧的钢构成。POKENAME的尾巴能定期分泌油脂，让它得以在水面游泳。
author: chorb33
source: Its body is made of very light but resistant steel. POKENAME can regularly secrete oil from its tail, allowing it to swim on the surface of the water.

entry: 身体由极轻又坚韧的钢构成。POKENAME的尾巴能定期分泌油脂，让它得以在水面游泳。
author: chorb33
source: Its body is made of very light but resistant steel. POKENAME can regularly secrete oil from its tail, allowing it to swim on the surface of the water.

entry: POKENAME不会游泳，只好沿湖底走着觅食。沉重的身体能帮它像掷链球般高速甩动尾巴。
author: pokepower
source: POKENAME can't swim, instead walking along lake beds for food. Its heavy body helps it spin its tail at high speed like a hammer thrower.

entry: 它身体结实，铠甲又轻，尾巴里还有油，因此能浮起来，再从孔洞中喷水，推动身体。
author: chorb33
source: Its body is robust, able to float due to the light weight of its armor and the oil in its tail. It can expel water through the holes to move around.

entry: 它身体结实，铠甲又轻，尾巴里还有油，因此能浮起来，再从孔洞中喷水，推动身体。
author: chorb33
source: Its body is robust, able to float due to the light weight of its armor and the oil in its tail. It can expel water through the holes to move around.

entry: POKENAME常光顾交通繁忙的城市，在路边一站就是很久。这会引发不少混乱，甚至造成事故。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME frequently cities with high traffic and often stand on the side of roads for long periods of time. This causes quite a lot of confusion, and can lead to accidents.

entry: 生长在富含铁的土壤中，让POKENAME长出锋利闪亮的叶片，既轻巧，又危险。
author: hophoppip
source: Growing in iron-rich soils gives POKENAME sharp, shiny leaves that are as lightweight as they are dangerous.

entry: POKENAME会迅速占据任何适合栖身的洞穴。娇小的身体让它们无论角落还是缝隙，都能住下。
author: incognito1234
source: POKENAME quickly take over any cave they can live in. Their small bodies allow them to live in all kinds of nooks and crannies.

entry: POKENAME手掌般的尾巴，比铁还硬。它用尾巴猛砸崖壁，敲落大理石块，再以强力的金属爪磨碎，迫不及待地吃下。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's hand-like tail is harder than iron. It smashes it into cliff walls to knock loose chunks of marble, which it eagerly consumes after grinding it up with a powerful Metal Claw.

entry: POKENAME与电击波搭档捕猎，让自己覆上一层保护胶。它装作受伤，引诱较大的宝可梦靠近。对方一攻击，伙伴便将电流传过胶层，一击将敌人麻痹。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME hunts in tandem with Electiper, allowing itself to be coated in a protective gel. It plays injured to lure larger Pokémon close. The moment one strikes, its partner sends electricity through the gel, stunning the foe in one blow.

entry: POKENAME以轻盈如无物的身姿，跃过山间陡崖。带棱的铁角，如音叉般接收心灵感应信号；头部和背部的宝石，则投射出精神力场，让它在强风中站稳。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME leap across mountain precipices with weightless poise. Their ridged iron horns act as tuning forks for telepathic signals, while gems on their heads and backs project psychic fields to steady their balance in high winds.

entry: 沐浴月光后，POKENAME的毛发会变得坚硬如钢。夜里，它更加精力充沛，因此特别受值夜班的保安喜爱。
author: ghostslythe
source: Bathed in lunar radiation, POKENAME's fur hardens until it is tough as steel. It becomes more energetic at night, making it especially popular with security guards working night shifts.

entry: POKENAME曾被训练，从身体的孔洞释放孢子，使士兵平静。这种做法，如今在许多地方已遭禁止，它们便常被安置在庇护所，平静生活。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME were once trained to release spores through the holes in their body to pacify soldiers. The practice is now banned in many places, so they often find themselves in sanctuaries where they live peacefully.

entry: POKENAME发出像金属刮擦般的叫声，吓走人们。除了偶尔吃一点金属，它还从恐惧中获得养分。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME scares people off with a cry that sounds like metal being scraped. In addition to the odd bit of metal, POKENAME gets its nourishment from fear.

entry: POKENAME发出像金属刮擦般的叫声，吓走人们。除了偶尔吃一点金属，它还从恐惧中获得养分。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME scares people off with a cry that sounds like metal being scraped. In addition to the odd bit of metal, POKENAME gets its nourishment from fear.

entry: POKENAME常钻进金属里，随后长久休眠，因此经常被误认成螺丝。
author: incognito1234
source: POKENAME are often mistaken for screws due to their tendency to drill inside of metals and then stay dormant for long periods of time.

entry: POKENAME用泛银光的爪子，砸碎洞壁，敲落硬石头，再将这些石头收集起来，装饰地下的巢穴。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its silvered claws to smash cave walls and knock loose Hard Stones. It collects these rocks to decorate its underground den.

entry: 它手上的钢板，与金属头骨一样坚固，能有效抵挡攻击。这也让POKENAME的拳头威力十足，轻易就能打裂巨石。
author: sk372
source: The steel plates on its hands are as sturdy as the metal of its skull, letting it effectively guard itself from attacks. It also gives POKENAME punches potent enough to easily crack boulders.

entry: 极少数POKENAME的拳头孔洞中，似乎能看见眼睛。不知为何，这些个体战斗时，远比其他个体更加凶猛好斗。
author: sk372
source: Rarely, certain POKENAME can be observed with what appear to be eyes visible from the holes in their fists. These specimens fight with a much more aggressive ferocity than others, for some reason.

entry: 寒冷的冬夜，POKENAME在密林中潜行，跟踪猎物。据说，猎物最后看见的，就是那双锐利的蓝眼睛。
author: partypooperrex
source: During cold winter nights, POKENAME hunt their prey by stalking them in dense forests. Its said the last thing their prey sees is their piercing blue eyes.

entry: POKENAME的金属头骨上，有着对应某种月相的花纹。头顶月亮的形状，与脸上花纹一致时，它们的战斗力就会增强。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME have markings on their metallic skulls in the shape of certain phases of the moon. When the moon overhead matches the shape on their face, they exhibit greater combat strength.

entry: POKENAME栖居在沉船上长出的珊瑚礁中，捕猎金属宝可梦。猎物捕不到时，它便会啃穿船体，因此在港口，被视为祸患。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME lives in reefs that have grown on shipwrecks, where it hunts metallic Pokémon. It is considered a pest at ports since it will eat through the hull of boats when it is failing to catch prey.

entry: 成群的POKENAME用金属头骨互相顶撞，确立地位，也让护甲更加坚韧。通常，金属上凹痕与刮痕最多的那只，就是首领。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME packs headbutt each other with their metal skulls to establish hierarchy and toughen their armor. Typically, the one sporting the most dents and scrapes on their metal is the leader.

entry: POKENAME在深洞里伸出蓝色舌头，嗅寻蓝色碎片。找到以后，就不停用头撞墙，直到碎片脱落。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME flicks out its blue tongue in deep caves to smell for Blue Shards. Upon finding some, it rams its head into the wall until the shards break loose.

entry: 野外的POKENAME，就像幼小可可多拉与小小象的兄长。它动作敏捷，披着坚固的铁甲，能轻松应对那些会给小家伙们带来麻烦的宝可梦。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME acts as a sort of big sibling to young Aron or Phanpy in the wild. Quick on its feet and with a sturdy iron coating, it can easily take on Pokémon that would otherwise trouble the others.

entry: POKENAME出没在富含铁的崖边，慢慢摇晃身体，用钢铁的喙啄击岩石。它似乎寿命极长，因此并不在意要挖多久，才能够到想要的金属。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME is found by iron-rich cliffsides, slowly teetering back and forth to peck at the stone with its steely beak. Since it seems to have an incredibly long lifespan, it doesn't care how long it takes to dig its way to the metal it seeks.

entry: POKENAME吃各种金属，满足日常所需的养分。人们认为，它最终进化成什么模样，或许取决于饮食的配比。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME consumes a variety of metals to meet its daily nutritional needs. It is thought that what POKENAME evolves into may depend on the balance of its diet.

entry: POKENAME是能自我复制的人造宝可梦。它们知道，相较于较大的宝可梦，自己的身体较脆弱，因此会十分仔细地组装彼此。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are artificial Pokémon that are capable of self-replication. They assemble one another with great care, aware of the relative fragility of their bodies compared to larger Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME每次蜕下的金属皮，都会被用来加固火车与飞机的骨架。它铁锈色的唾液，腐蚀性极强，使它的咬击极易致命。
author: fiordaliso
source: The metal skin POKENAME sheds each time it molts is used to reinforce the frames of trains and airplanes. Its rust-colored saliva is extremely corrosive, making its bites extremely lethal.

entry: POKENAME产的奶富含铁，常用于制作维生素补充剂。春季，它的产奶量，会比平时更多。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME produces milk rich in iron, often used in vitamin supplements. It generates more milk than usual during the spring months.

entry: 即使遭人轻视，POKENAME仍骄傲地昂首挺立。进化成波士可拉斯后，对没伤害过自己的生物，它会手下留情。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME stands tall with pride, even when looked down upon. When it evolves into Aggitar, it spares those who haven't wronged it.

entry: 它必须均衡摄入泥土与金属。POKENAME若吃太多金属，护甲就会重得让它无法移动；泥土吃得太多，护甲又会不足以覆盖要害。
author: bandedbodypress
source: It has to have a balanced diet of dirt and metal. A POKENAME with too much metal in its diet will not be able to move under the weight of its armor, while too much dirt means its armor doesn't cover its vitals.

entry: POKENAME通常成群行动，进退如一。它们从一块废金属转向另一块，转眼便吃个精光。
author: incognito1234
source: POKENAME typically gather in packs, moving as one. They go from scrap metal to scrap metal, quickly devouring them.

entry: 眼中分泌的液体酸性极强，能溶解金属，让它更容易吃下。
author: incognito1234
source: The fluid it secretes from its eyes is highly acidic. This helps to dissolve metals for easier consumption.

entry: POKENAME主要吃富含铁与矿物质的东西，岩石最为常见。废金属算是零食，宝石则是值得慢慢品尝的珍馐。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's diet consists primarily of things rich in iron and minerals. Rock and stone are most typical. Metal scrap is considered a treat, and gemstones are a delicacy to be savored.

entry: POKENAME用金属脑袋猛撞地面，惊动地鼠一类的猎物。等它们钻出地面，再使出强力的重踏，将其解决。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME slams its metal head into the ground to startle prey like Diglett. When they surface, it finishes them off with a powerful Bulldoze.

entry: POKENAME与植物的联系，在钢铁等金属附近的草木间，似乎最为强烈。因此，大多数野外目击，都发生在植物丛生的废弃建筑中。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's connection with plants seems most potent with foliage near the presence of steel and other metals. As such, most wild sightings of POKENAME have been in abandoned buildings experiencing overgrowth.

entry: POKENAME会被矿藏丰富的区域吸引，用悬浮的四肢挖开泥土，寻找矿物含量最丰富的岩石充饥。偶尔，头与躯干会暂时互换位置，原因不明。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is attracted towards areas with high mineral deposits, using its floating limbs to dig through soil to find the richest stone to consume. Occasionally, its head and torso will swap positions for a time, for unknown reasons.

entry: POKENAME的手指与脚趾上，都有小小的钩爪，能轻松攀上岩面。尾巴能够感知磁场，帮助它在栖居的深邃洞穴中辨路。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME has small, hooked claws on its fingers and toes, allowing it to easily scale rocky surfaces. It is able to detect magnetic fields with its tail, which it uses to navigate the deep cave systems it lives in.

entry: POKENAME虽然大半身体由金属构成，部分地方仍长着叶片般的附属物。被迫交战时，它会将这些东西摘下，当作锋利而沉重的投射武器。
author: sk372
source: Though most of POKENAME's body is metallic, it still grows leaf-like accessories on parts of its body. It can pluck these and use them as sharp and heavy projectiles when forced into combat.

entry: POKENAME捕食钢属性宝可梦，尤其喜爱可可多拉。它们让火焰裹住全身，猛冲猎物，将其制服。找不到猎物时，就熔化矿石来吃。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME prey on Steel-type Pokémon, particularly on Aron. They clad themselves in fire and forcefully charge at their prey to subdue them. They will melt down ore and consume that if they cannot find prey.

entry: POKENAME双脚不协调，容易绊倒，脸上的金属面罩能减轻摔伤。攻击时，它用头猛撞敌人，将对手撞得晕头转向。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: The metal mask on POKENAME's face softens the damage it takes when tripping over its uncoordinated feet. To attack, POKENAME headbutts foes to bash and disorient their enemies.

entry: 只要像激光般专注，POKENAME就能在周围行进，不会被自己绊倒。它们的铁头十分坚硬，撞上什么，都能造成伤害。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: With laser-like focus, POKENAME can maneuver their environment without tripping over themselves. These Pokémon have strong iron heads that deal damage to anything it collides with.

entry: POKENAME大多出现在特定的岛屿上。人们相信，很久以前，POKENAME，或一群可可多拉与水跃鱼，曾结伴迁移，后来被侵蚀大地的巨洪，与大陆隔开。它们孵化后，并不天生就会游泳。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME are most often found on specific islands; it's believed that long ago, POKENAME, or some Aron and Mudkip, traveled together before massive eroding floods cut them off from the mainland. They are unable to naturally swim after hatching.

entry: POKENAME极善挖掘，轻松钻过泥土，吃下找到的所有铁。山中的矿工，常会在岩壁里发现一只POKENAME，吃饱铁矿后，正在呼呼大睡。
author: imaginita
source: POKENAME are superb diggers.  They easily burrow through the dirt, eating any iron they can find.  It's not uncommon for mountain miners to find an POKENAME asleep in a wall, having gorged itself on iron ore.

entry: POKENAME敲打头骨的金属部分，结合超能力与回声定位，感知周围。它对附近的情绪尤其敏感，能更好地察觉怀有恶意的对象，及时藏身。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME taps the metal part of its cranium, sensing its surroundings with a mix of psychic powers and echolocation. It is especially sensitive to the emotions of those nearby, letting it better sense those who mean it harm so it can hide.

entry: 它用角感知钢铁的品质，挑选要吃的钢材。POKENAME进化时，会蜕去铠甲般的皮，人们将其收集、熔化，制成耐用的合金。
author: oddwalls
source: It chooses steel to consume by using its horns to sense the steel's quality. When POKENAME evolves, it sheds its armored skin, which is collected and melted down to make durable alloys.

entry: POKENAME虽小巧精致，身体却极能承受伤害。它会高声歌唱，有时独唱，有时与其他宝可梦合唱。
author: neonriser
source: POKENAME is very durable, despite its tiny, delicate appearance. They either sing alone or with other Pokémon with a high-pitched voice.

entry: POKENAME身上的金属外层，覆着一层薄薄的透明毒素。接触后，若不尽快洗掉，便可能引起剧烈抽搐。
author: .izik
source: The metal coating POKENAME's body is covered in a thin layer of clear poison. Contact with this toxin can cause violent seizures if not washed off quickly.

entry: POKENAME用长舌舔尝洞壁，分析其中的成分。凡是舔过的岩石，它都能模仿质地与颜色，毫无破绽地融入其中。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME tastes cave walls with its long tongue to analyze their composition. It can mimic the texture and color of any stone it licks, blending in seamlessly.

entry: 寄居石中的灵魂，每当显形，便会在投射出的身形上，凝成一顶金属头盔。坚硬的头盔，让POKENAME防御稳固，头锤也威力十足。
author: sk372
source: The spirits inhabiting the stone form a metal helmet over their projection whenever they materialize. This hardened helmet gives POKENAME a sturdy defense and a very potent Headbutt attack.

entry: POKENAME从身体孔洞释放花粉，使敌人入睡。金属身体让它们不受毒的影响，因此能随意产生花粉，想放多少就放多少。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME release pollen through the holes in their body to put foes to sleep. Their metallic bodies make them impervious to the effects of poison, so they can freely produce as much pollen as they want.

entry: POKENAME将花粉储存在花苞里，从身体孔洞，一小阵一小阵地释放。遇上危险的宝可梦，它们就伸出金属藤蔓，保护自己。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME store pollen in their bulbs, which is released in small bursts through the holes in their body. They release metallic vines from their body to defend themselves against dangerous Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME曾是军中的特殊部队，会从身体孔洞，向空中释放有害的花粉。大片花粉云，会使士兵陷入昏昏欲睡的迷糊状态。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME were once part of the army as a specialized unit that released noxious pollen into the air through the holes in their body. The large cloud of pollen would force soldiers into a sleepy stupor.

entry: 不饿时，POKENAME会将金属藏在较大的颚里，留待日后食用。
author: incognito1234
source: When POKENAME is not hungry, it will store metals in its larger jaws for later consumption.

entry: 外骨骼极其坚硬，几乎不惧直接伤害。为了保持强韧，它总在寻找更多金属。
author: incognito1234
source: Its extremely hard exoskeleton leaves it nearly impervious to direct damage. In order to keep it strong, it constantly searches for more metal.

entry: 飓风来临之前，POKENAME的金属外壳，会泛起明亮的蓝光。这时，它会跑过村庄，希望有人注意警告，将消息传开。
author: .izik
source: Before a hurricane, POKENAME's metal shell glows with a bright blue hue. During this time, it runs through villages hoping someone will notice the warning and spread the word.

entry: POKENAME看似金属的外壳之下，还有一层岩土构成的壳。两层都属于外壳，分别与脊柱的不同部位融合，缺了任何一层，它都无法正常活动。
author: bobosmith01
source: Beneath what appears to be POKENAME's metallic shell is another shell made of rock and soil; both are layers of the shell, and each are fused to different parts of POKENAME's spine, so it cannot function without both.

entry: 尽管栖居在幽暗的深洞，POKENAME仍竭尽全力，让背上的树苗活下来。树苗只靠金属元素提供养分，因此枝条坚硬如铁钉。
author: mistymagius
source: Despite living in deep dark caves, POKENAME tries its absolute hardest to keep the sapling on its back alive. Due to only growing on metallic elements for nutrients, the branches are as tough as iron nails.

entry: POKENAME背上无机质的茎，实际上是复杂的天线阵列。它用这些天线，与极远处的其他POKENAME交流。
author: slimee_amogus
source: The inorganic stems on POKENAME's back are actually complex antenna arrays. It uses these arrays to communicate with other POKENAME across vast distances.

entry: 虽然远不如土台龟巨大，POKENAME背上仍有一小片洞穴，可供可可多拉等小型宝可梦歇息。它能负担惊人的重量，连极其致密的物件，也举得起来。
author: bobosmith01
