source: Although it is not nearly as huge as Torterra, POKENAME has a small cavernous system on its back which smaller Pokémon such as Aron may rest in. POKENAME is able to carry a tremendous amount of weight, so it can lift even extremely dense objects.

entry: POKENAME戴着面具，就觉得自己力量十足，因此常惹麻烦。若不知怎的弄丢面具，不安便会化作怒火，疯狂抓挠附近的任何人。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME often get into trouble because they feel empowered by the mask they wear. If they somehow manage to lose their mask, their insecurity turns into wrath as they violently scratch at anyone nearby.

entry: POKENAME巨大的金属耳朵，连一百多英尺外最细微的声响，也能听见。一察觉捕食者，就会迅速退回洞穴。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's large metallic ears can detect even the faintest noise from over 100 feet away. If it senses a predator, it quickly retreats to its burrow.

entry: POKENAME生活在冰冷的深山，吃铁矿与鱼类宝可梦。大多数都会留一颗光滑的卵石，送给亲近的对象。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME lives deep in icy mountains, feeding off iron ore and fish Pokémon. Most of them have a smooth pebble to give to someone close.

entry: POKENAME生活在冰冷的深山，吃铁矿与鱼类宝可梦。大多数都会留一颗光滑的卵石，送给亲近的对象。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME lives deep in icy mountains, feeding off iron ore and fish Pokémon. Most of them have a smooth pebble to give to someone close.

entry: POKENAME生活在冰冷的深山，吃铁矿与鱼类宝可梦。大多数都会留一颗光滑的卵石，送给亲近的对象。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME lives deep in icy mountains, feeding off iron ore and fish Pokémon. Most of them have a smooth pebble to give to someone close.

entry: POKENAME全身覆着金属层，下面紧接着一层岩石。红色的角带有磁场，能永久损坏靠得太近的电子设备。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's entire body is covered in a metallic layer, with a rocky layer directly underneath. Its red horn has a magnetic field, which can cause permanent damage to electronic devices that come too close.

entry: POKENAME钻入凸起的岩石，寻找月之石碎片。吃下这些碎片，似乎能增强它的活力与防御能力。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME drills into rocky outcrops in search of Moon Stone shards. Eating these shards seems to strengthen its vitality and defensive capabilities.

entry: POKENAME用刀刃般的四肢，在石中刻出复杂的迷宫。准备战斗时，它会用脚跟保持平衡，跳起激烈的剑舞。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME carves intricate labyrinths in stone using its bladed limbs. It performs an intense Swords Dance while balancing on its heels to prepare for battle.

entry: POKENAME用缎带般的触须，在栖居的暗洞中搜寻铁矿。脱落的缎带，既柔韧又结实，因此在建筑行业，十分受欢迎。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME uses its ribbon feelers to search for iron ore found in the dark caves where it resides. Its shed ribbons are used and greatly appreciated in the construction industry due to how flexible yet strong they are.

entry: POKENAME能嗅出矿物与矿石，有些还能将触须当作探测棒，寻找淡水。它们挖掘矿石与矿物充饥，效率极高。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME have a sense of smell for minerals and ores, and some can use their feelers like dowsing rods to find fresh water. They are efficient at mining for minerals and ores to feed on.

entry: POKENAME的皮肤含有大量铁合金，泛着金属光泽，很难划破。彼此展开残酷的争斗时，它们就靠这份强韧，保护自己。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have skin that is laced with high levels of iron alloys, giving them a metallic sheen and making it difficult to break their skin. They rely on this increased resilience to keep them safe when they get into brutal battles with one another.

entry: POKENAME的身体坚韧，足以承受栖息环境中巨大的静水压力。它四处游海，寻找沉船，以金属残骸为食。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's tough body is strong enough to withstand the immense hydrostatic pressure of its environment. It spends its time roaming the seas in search of shipwrecks, feeding on metallic wreckage.

entry: POKENAME一向安静。凡被它吐息吹到的东西，都会变成室温。
author: neonriser
source: POKENAME is known to be very quiet. Everything it breathes on becomes room temperature.

entry: POKENAME吞食金属，融入钢铁身体，让它保持崭新。随后沐浴月光，泛起神秘的光泽。
author: incognito1234
source: POKENAME consumes metals to incorporate into its steel body to keep it fresh. It then bathes in moonlight, producing a mysterious sheen.

entry: 常能看见POKENAME穿着服装，大多像电子游戏中的角色。科学家推测，这是为了区分群体中的个体，因为它们一聚，最多可达一百五十五只。
author: _pixelar_
source: POKENAME are often seen wearing costumes, with most of the outfits resembling video game characters. Scientists hypothesize that they do so to differentiate between individuals of their herd, as these gatherings can be up to 155 members large.

entry: POKENAME奇异的外表，虽然让许多人害怕，它其实十分胆怯，宁愿躲开人类。月光照在金属身体上，仿佛使它变得缥缈虚幻。
author: mepp.
source: Though many fear POKENAME's strange appearance, it is actually quite timid and prefers to hide away from humans. Its metal body appears almost ethereal when exposed to moonlight.

entry: 不同个体的POKENAME，背上的圆球，可能由钢铁、羊毛，或两者共同构成。不亲手触摸，很难分辨。
author: oddwalls
source: Depending on the individual, the bulbs on POKENAME's back could be made of steel, wool, or a combination of both. It is difficult to distinguish between them without touching them.

entry: 金属身体虽然坚固，沉重的分量，却让POKENAME几乎无法移动。它会吐出同样包着金属壳的内脏，强行拖着自己，慢慢挪动。
author: sk372
source: Its metallic body is sturdy, but the heavy weight leaves POKENAME with little ability to move. For locomotion, it ejects its innards, which are also coated in a metal shell, in order to forcibly drag itself around slowly.

entry: POKENAME的装束，真的由可可多拉进化时，蜕下的钢铁制成。它这么做，是希望有一天，自己也能进化成可多拉。
author: redmagecole
source: POKENAME's costume is made out of actual steel that Aron sheds when it evolves. POKENAME does this in the hopes that one day, it will evolve into a Lairon as well.

entry: 身体沉重而坚实，让它无法光靠自身的力量，跳出太远。它挖掘并吞食松软的泥土，获取养分，让外壳保持坚韧。
author: sk372
source: Its heavy, sturdy body means that it cannot jump very far on its own power. It digs through and consumes soft soil for nutrients that keep its shell strong and resilient.

entry: POKENAME能用装着弹簧的尾巴，向下重击，震动大地。为压紧弹簧，它会用后腿站起，再仰面躺下，借助自己的体重蓄力。
author: darkwolfe
source: POKENAME are capable of delivering a ground shaking downwards blow with their spring loaded tail. To load the spring POKENAME use their bodyweight by standing on their hind legs before laying down on their backs.

entry: POKENAME一生大多待在深山，找到什么铁，就吃什么铁。岩石中因此留下空隙，有时会形成新的洞穴。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME spends most of its life deep within mountains, eating all the iron it can find. This creates gaps in the stone that can lead to new caves.

entry: 空气穿过POKENAME头顶的孔洞，使它们的口哨与歌声，像管乐器一样。表演结束后，它们会大口喝水，再从喷气孔中，喷出壮观的水柱。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME whistle and sing in tones that resemble wind instruments because of the air moving through the holes on the top of their heads. Once they finish a performance, they take in a big gulp of water and create a grand spout from their blowholes.

entry: POKENAME看似可爱，却被许多人视为祸患。含铁的东西，它们什么都吃，带静电的毛发蹭上电子设备，还会使其过载。尽管如此，它们天性十分温柔。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME may look cute, but many consider them a pest. They will eat anything containing iron, and overload electronics when they rub their staticky coat against them. Despite this, they are very sweet by nature.

entry: POKENAME尾尖的蓝色金属星，噼啪跳着静电。它用这条尾巴，追踪地下电线，以及矿物丰富的矿脉。
author: .izik
source: The blue metal star-shaped tip of POKENAME's tail crackles with static. It uses this tail to track underground power lines and mineral-rich veins.

entry: POKENAME身体的孔洞中，轻轻回荡着忧郁的歌声。老年人若听得太久，可能头晕，甚至昏倒。
author: .izik
source: A melancholic song echoes softly from the holes on POKENAME's body. The sound can cause dizziness and fainting in the elderly if heard for too long.

entry: 融合之后，POKENAME面部的甲片，宽度与厚度都变为原来的两倍。它只生活在地下深洞，那里压力之大，绝大多数生灵都无法承受。
author: mistymagius
source: Upon fusion, POKENAME's face plating has become twice as wide and twice as thick. It can only be found in deep underground caverns where the pressure is too strong for most other lifeforms.

entry: POKENAME爬过洞穴，寻找金属矿藏。随着不断吃下矿石，原本圆润的金属甲片，会逐渐长出更多锯齿般的棱角。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME crawl through caves in search of deposits of metal ore. The rounded metal plates on their body slowly grow more jagged as they continue to consume metal ore.

entry: POKENAME挖坑藏身，等候烈雀、阿柏蛇一类的猎物。目标一经过，它便跃出，咬合铁颚，将对方拖入地下。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME digs pits and hides inside, waiting for prey like Spearow or Ekans. When one passes by, it leaps out, snapping its iron jaws and dragging the target underground.

entry: POKENAME贴在金属表面，用黏液慢慢溶解，再吃下去。飞行时，风穿过翼上的孔洞，产生低沉的嗡鸣，令人头痛。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME clings to metal surfaces, slowly dissolving them with its mucus to consume them. As it flies, wind passes through the holes in its wings, creating a low humming noise that is known to cause headaches.

entry: POKENAME渴望有一天，能披上坚不可摧的金属鳞片。为增强耐久，它在火山中烘烤自己，还会将身体撞向崖壁，反复锤炼。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME aspires to one day have a skin of indestructible metal scales. To improve its durability, POKENAME bakes itself in volcanoes and rams its body into cliff walls to temper itself.

entry: POKENAME常在建筑工地帮忙。金属零件要报废时，它十分乐意，用齿轮般的牙齿磨碎，再吃下去。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME is often used in construction. When metal parts are to be scrapped, an POKENAME is happy to eat them by grinding them between its gear teeth.

entry: POKENAME能操纵镜面护甲中的倒影，呈现虚假的景象，迷惑对手。蓝色的毛发，在夜里会明亮发光。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME can manipulate its reflections from its mirror-like armor to show false imagery, confusing its adversaries. Its blue fur glows brightly during the night.

entry: POKENAME以多种金属为食，尾火的颜色，也取决于饮食。它住在火山洞穴，借高温与压力，强化金属护甲。
author: mistymagius
source: The color of the flame on POKENAME's tail depends on in diet, feeding on many different types of metal. It lives in volcanic caves, the high temperature and pressure reinforcing its metal armor.

entry: POKENAME使用火花等火属性招式时，身上的金属外层，会变得滚烫。体力耗尽，就吃下煤炭，为火焰补充燃料。
author: .izik
source: The metal coating POKENAME's body becomes extremely hot when using Fire-type moves like Ember. When exhausted, it consumes coal to refuel its flame.

entry: 雨后，POKENAME银色的花苞，会散发怡人的苔藓香气。睡觉时，里面还会渗出水银般的树汁。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's silver bud gives off a pleasant mossy scent after rain. A mercury-like sap leaks from it while it sleeps.

entry: POKENAME需要睡觉时，脚底会长出细根，扎入洞壁。这样一来，即使休息，它也能继续吸收必需的养分。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME needs to sleep, tiny roots grow from its feet and ingrain themselves into cave walls. This allows it to absorb vital nutrients even while resting.

entry: 野生POKENAME常出现在矿藏丰富的矿井，身体钻进岩中，只露出头顶。只要矿工偶尔扔给它们一块矿石，它们就会保持温顺。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME are often found within ore-rich mines, with all but the tops of their heads burrowed within the rock. They remain docile so long as miners toss them the occasional chunk of ore.

entry: 身体沉重，让它很难飞行，因此它会用翅膀内侧的铁刺，攀附墙壁。这些铁刺，也让它拍击敌人、自卫时，更具威力。
author: sk372
source: Its heavy weight makes flying difficult, so it climbs and sticks to walls using the iron spikes on the inside of its wings. They also help make for effective slaps against enemies in self-defense.

entry: POKENAME的长牙锋利如刃，也因此常遭猎杀。那些牙，会被用来制作刀具等锐器。
author: sottiwotti
source: The tusks of POKENAME are razor sharp, which is why they are often hunted. Their tusks are used to make knives and other sharp objects.

entry: 胸前的圆形其实是一只眼睛。人们推测，很久以前，它是替主人监视四周的机器人。
author: incognito1234
source: The circle on its chest is actually an eye. It is thought that this Pokémon was supposed to act as a surveillance robot for its master long ago.

entry: POKENAME的钢铁翅膀十分沉重，使它无法起飞。它便钻在浅浅的地下，啃食植物的根。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME has heavy wings made of steel that prevent it from taking flight. Instead, it burrows just below the ground and eats plant roots.

entry: POKENAME能挡开顽皮孩子扔来的石头。因为金属翅膀，会将石头弹开，使它不受伤害。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can deflect rocks thrown at it by rowdy kids. This is because its metallic wings cause the rocks to bounce off harmlessly.

entry: 护甲沉重，POKENAME很少飞行，改用翼爪攀爬崎岖的岩壁。猎物从下方经过时，它便落下，用头锤猛击目标。
author: pjporwoll
source: Due to the weight of its armor, POKENAME rarely flies, instead using the wing-claws to climb craggy rock walls. When prey passes below, it drops from its perch to bludgeon the target with a Headbutt.

entry: POKENAME极少离开洞穴，只有寻找作为食物的金属时才会外出。
author: incognito1234
source: POKENAME rarely leave their caves. Any instance that they do is purely for scavenging for the metal they feed on.

entry: 矿物、矿石和金属吃得越多，它们的金属身体，就长得越发达。强壮的双颚，轻易就能咬穿坚岩，甚至咬穿一些敌人。
author: infinex21
source: Their metal bodies develop the more minerals, ores, and metals they eat. Their strong jaws can easily chew through solid rock and through some foes.

entry: 这些小小的宝可梦，通常藏在洞穴的墙壁、顶壁和地板中。一觉得被发现，就会迅速逃走。虽然身体由金属构成，跳跃能力却相当好。
author: infinex21
source: These tiny Pokémon typically hide within the walls, ceilings, and floors of caves. If they see they feel they have been spotted, they will dash away quickly and have proven to have good jumping abilities despite their metal bodies.

entry: POKENAME吃垃圾箱里的铝罐，强化自己的身体。吃得足够多后，连拆楼铁球，也能轻松承受。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME consumes aluminum cans from dumpsters to strengthen its body. After eating enough, it can easily withstand a wrecking ball.

entry: 野生POKENAME栖居在深深的水下洞穴，遇到任何生物，不论大小，都会凶猛地攻击。
author: theartemis1
source: Wild POKENAME dwell in deep underwater caverns, savagely attacking any creature it encounters no matter the size.

entry: 野生POKENAME栖居在深深的水下洞穴，遇到任何生物，不论大小，都会凶猛地攻击。
author: theartemis1
source: Wild POKENAME dwell in deep underwater caverns, savagely attacking any creature it encounters no matter the size.

entry: POKENAME常被误认成夜里飘浮的可怕头骨，眼睛泛着锐利的蓝光，其实它们的头只是金属。没人陪它们玩，就会不高兴。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME are often mistaken for terrifying skulls with piercing blue eyes floating through the night, but their heads are only made of metal. They get upset when they aren't played with.

entry: POKENAME背上坚固的壳，保护着柔软而敏感的身体。壳一旦出现裂缝，它就会分泌特殊的酸，分解矿物，重新修补护甲。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: The sturdy shells atop POKENAME protect their squishy and sensitive bodies. If their shells ever develop cracks, POKENAME will produce a specialized acid to break down minerals for them to build their armor back up.

entry: POKENAME能把柔软的身体，完全缩进铁壳中自保。分泌的黏液，除了自己的护甲，什么都能慢慢溶解，因此它只需偶尔探出身，吸食自己的黏液，就能进食。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME can retract its soft body entirely into its iron shell for protection. The mucus it secretes slowly dissolves everything except its own armor, so to feed, POKENAME only needs to occasionally re-emerge to slurp up its own slime.

entry: POKENAME的身体，由细小的金属碎片组成。小型宝可梦若在它的洞中睡着，它就会缠住对方，吸取生命力。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body is composed of tiny metal shards. It wraps itself around small Pokémon that fall asleep in its cave, absorbing their life force.

entry: 背上结实的蘑菇，富含从岩石饮食中吸收的矿物质。POKENAME的蘑菇，可以磨成粉，当作维生素补充剂出售。
author: oddwalls
source: The hardy mushrooms on its back are rich with minerals absorbed from its rocky diet. POKENAME mushrooms can be ground and sold as vitamin supplements.

entry: POKENAME十分友善，却因住在洞里，难得遇见人类，只好假装石头都是自己的朋友。
author: incognito1234
source: POKENAME are very friendly, but they rarely see people due to living in caves. This has caused them to resort to pretending rocks are their friends.

entry: POKENAME十分友善，却因住在洞里，难得遇见人类，只好假装石头都是自己的朋友。
author: incognito1234
source: POKENAME are very friendly, but they rarely see people due to living in caves. This has caused them to resort to pretending rocks are their friends.

entry: POKENAME的身体出奇坚韧。音乐家发现，若将它头部与毛发上的纹样当作乐谱演奏，就会奏出一支熟悉的曲子。
author: imaginaryneon
source: POKENAME has a surprisingly resilient body. Musicians have found that interpreting the pattern on its hair and head as sheet music produces a familiar tune.

entry: 背上结实的蘑菇，富含从岩石饮食中吸收的矿物质。POKENAME的蘑菇，可以磨成粉，当作维生素补充剂出售。
author: oddwalls
source: The hardy mushrooms on its back are rich with minerals absorbed from its rocky diet. POKENAME mushrooms can be ground and sold as vitamin supplements.

entry: POKENAME的外层，是一种类似钢铁的金属，吃下宝石，就会变得更强韧。蓝宝石似乎比其他任何宝石，都更能使外壳坚硬。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's outer layer is made of a steel-like metal that strengthens as it consumes gems. Sapphires seem to make its shell harder than any other gemstone.

entry: POKENAME披着整套金属铠甲，头盔顶上竖着钢刺。它寻找优质铁矿，锻造自己的面具，再吞下余料，强化披着铁甲的身体。
author: potato_tub
source: POKENAME wears a full suit of metal armor, its helmet crowned with steel spikes. It seeks out high-quality iron ore to forge its mask, and devours the leftovers to strengthen its iron-plated body.

entry: POKENAME的身体看似蓬松，实际覆着紫色的金属丝，结实如钢筋。这些金属纤维，能极好地抵御攻击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body appears fluffy but is covered in metallic purple strands as strong as rebar. These metal fibers provide exceptional protection against attacks.

entry: POKENAME身周的铁甲，已增厚为坚实的甲壳。它毫不犹豫地用沉重的身体，撞向威胁；由精炼矿石锻成的铁面具，隐隐发光。
author: potato_tub
source: The iron armor around POKENAME's body has thickened into a solid carapace. It hurls its heavy body into threats without hesitation, its iron mask glowing faintly from the refined ore it's forged from.

entry: POKENAME用铁做成耐用的面具，练习头部撞击时，保护自己。最终，即使不靠面具，它们的头撞，也能将金属撞平。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME fashion durable masks out of iron to protect themselves as they practice their headbutts. Eventually their headbutts will become strong enough to flatten metal even without the help of their masks.

entry: POKENAME在水洼众多、潮湿的洞穴中筑巢。莲叶顶部的钢刺十分锋利，能防范脚掌柔软的宝可梦，以及毫无防备的人类。
author: chibitales
source: Moist cave environments where puddles are plentiful are where POKENAME nest. The sharp, steel spike atop their pad serves as protection against soft-footed Pokémon and unaware humans.

entry: POKENAME吃金属矿石，让金属身体发育，尤其偏爱铜。因此，它们的火焰会越来越蓝，也能据此大致推断年龄。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME feed on metal ores to develop their metallic bodies, though they favor copper most of all. Their flames progressively grow more blue as a result, which also serves to show their likely age.

entry: POKENAME展现过高超的剑术。在旁观者眼中，它们挥剑穿梭战场，如同翩翩起舞。
author: camtft
source: POKENAME have displayed advanced levels of swordsmanship. To onlookers it appears as if they dance through the battlefield with their sword.

entry: POKENAME常在深水中游泳，身体变得异常坚硬。许多报告指出，它的身体，甚至能硬得像铁一样。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body grows incredibly hard from swimming at great depths. Many reports suggest its body can become as hard as iron.

entry: POKENAME偷偷潜入人家，盗走金饰来吃。这种饮食，能强化它脸上面具般的金色甲片。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME sneaks into homes to steal gold jewelry, which it consumes. This diet strengthens the golden mask-like plating on its face.

entry: 这种宝可梦虽然长着金属毛发，覆有面具般的铁甲，却能靠柔软的脚掌，悄无声息地移动。它被亮闪闪的东西吸引，不过，只有金属制品，才想收藏。
author: infinex21
source: Despite its metallic fur and iron, mask-like plating, this Pokémon is able to move silently due to its soft paws. It is drawn to shiny objects, though it only cares to collect them if they are metallic.

entry: POKENAME银色的胡须，能极其精确地感知温度变化。察觉风暴逼近时，它就会把伙伴聚到洞穴里避难。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's silver whiskers can detect temperature changes with remarkable precision. If it senses a storm approaching, it gathers its allies in a cave for shelter.

entry: POKENAME长大时，覆盖身体的钢甲，会越绷越紧。头部承受的压力，引起剧烈偏头痛，只有进化以后，才能缓解。
author: .jerden
source: As POKENAME grows, the steel armor covering its body becomes tighter and tighter. The pressure on POKENAME's head causes intense migraines, which are only resolved when it evolves.

entry: POKENAME光滑的钢铁护甲，能将游泳时的阻力降到最低。在它们栖居的湖里，人们常误以为，那是一艘机器人潜艇。
author: .jerden
source: The smooth steel armor that covers POKENAME's body minimizes drag as it swims through the water. In lakes where they live, people often mistake them for robot submarines.

entry: POKENAME用强壮的肌肉，破开坚硬的岩石，寻找原生金属来吃。毛发由细小的金属碎片组成，锋利得能刺穿厚衣服。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME uses its powerful muscles to break through hard stone, looking for raw metals to eat. Its fur is made of tiny metal shards sharp enough to pierce through thick clothing.

entry: POKENAME战斗时，像球一样滚动圆圆的金属身体。哪怕只有一次攻击落空，它也会陷入狂怒，不分对象地乱打。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME fights by rolling its round, metallic body like a ball across the ground. If it misses even a single strike, it flies into a blind rage and attacks indiscriminately.

entry: 虽然护甲能抵御大多数攻击，POKENAME只要察觉一丝危险，就会瞬间移动逃走。消失时，还能听见轻微的金属声。
author: sk372
source: Despite having an armor coating that can resist most attacks, POKENAME teleports away at the first sign of danger. When it warps away, a faint metallic sound can be heard.

entry: POKENAME只踢一脚，就能拦停行驶中的火车。覆盖身体的合金，像皮肤一样生长，受损后便会脱落。
author: .izik
source: A single kick from an POKENAME can halt a moving train. The alloy that covers its body grows like skin and falls off if it gets damaged.

entry: POKENAME吃矿物，并用火焰熔化金属和矿石，饮入体内。虽然被认为弱小，它们的身体却很坚韧。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME feed on minerals and drink up metals and ores that they melt using their flames. Their bodies are tough even though they are considered weak.

entry: POKENAME身上的钢板，会让触碰者挨上疼痛的电击。疲倦时，它会停在交通信号灯上休息，给自己充电。
author: .izik
source: The steel plating covering POKENAME's body delivers a painful shock to anyone who touches it. When tired, it rests on traffic lights to recharge.

entry: POKENAME守护巢穴，谁靠得太近，就一头撞过去。即使因此冲出悬崖，它也面不改色。
author: pokepower
source: POKENAME defends its nest, ramming into anything that gets too close. It remains unfazed even if it flies off a cliff in the process.

entry: POKENAME将音叉敲在自己身上，发出强大的声波，用来驱赶捕食者。
author: _snakeywakey_
source: POKENAME clangs its tuning fork against itself to create large soundwaves. It uses this technique to ward off predators.

entry: POKENAME的喙，覆着类似黄金的金属。它啄击洞壁，敲落光之黏土，再兴高采烈地吞下。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's beaks are coated with a gold-like metal. It pecks cave walls to dislodge Light Clay, which it then devours with delight.

entry: 费力时，它会轻轻喘气，疲倦的小舌头，若隐若现。头部的金属壳，让喘息回荡成低沉的粗重声音，往往无意间，吓到较小的宝可梦。
author: sk372
source: It pants lightly when exerted, a small tongue barely visible as a sign of tiredness. The metal shell around its head makes the sound echo and come out as a baritone heaving noise that tends to inadvertently scare smaller Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME由能腐蚀任何含铁金属的黏液构成。就连释放的气体，也足以让小金属物件生锈、碎裂。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME is made of a slime that can corrode any ferrous metal. Even the fumes it emits are enough to make small metal objects rust and crumble.

entry: POKENAME能轻松承受顽皮雷弹爆炸的冲击。这些行走的庞然大物，光凭巨大的体型，就极难击倒。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can easily endure the force of an Electrode explosion. These walking behemoths are difficult to take down because of their sheer size.

entry: 周身的气体腐蚀性极强，碰到任何金属都会侵蚀，甚至曾造成一些建筑倒塌。
author: incognito1234
source: The gas surrounding its body is highly corrosive, eroding any metal it touches. It has been responsible for the collapse of some buildings.

entry: POKENAME能改变身体的密度，让自己像钢铁一样坚固，或像氦气一样轻盈。它会撞击钢结构，穿过撞出的裂缝，从内部侵蚀金属。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are able to change the density of their bodies between being as sturdy as steel or as light as helium. They collide with steel structures and phase into any cracks they create to eat away at the metal from inside.

entry: POKENAME是恶意的宝可梦，附在废金属上，让废料活动起来，在成形之处作祟。它们喜欢拆散车辆与金属设施，将碎片融入自身。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are malevolent Pokémon that possess discarded scrap metal, animating and using these scraps to haunt the sites they form at. They love to pull apart vehicles and metal structures, incorporating the shreds into their own bodies.

entry: POKENAME是恶意的宝可梦，附在废金属上，让废料活动起来，在成形之处作祟。它们喜欢拆散车辆与金属设施，将碎片融入自身。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are malevolent Pokémon that possess discarded scrap metal, animating and using these scraps to haunt the sites they form at. They love to pull apart vehicles and metal structures, incorporating the shreds into their own bodies.

entry: POKENAME通常住在废品场，以各种金属为食。不过，钻掘与进食的声音十分扰人。
author: incognito1234
source: POKENAME are typically found in scrapyards, feasting on the various metals. However, the sound of their burrowing and eating is disruptive.

entry: 常能看见POKENAME陪在水管工身旁，因为金属钳，很适合拧紧管道。野外，它在海底筑巢，借水压，强化钢铁甲片。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is often seen alongside plumbers, since its metal pincers are extremely useful for tightening pipes. In the wild, it makes its den on the seabed, letting the pressure of the water strengthen its steel plating.

entry: POKENAME被派到冶金工厂，用爪子切割钢材。机器一旦过热，它便吹出水泡介入，防止意外发生。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is deployed in metallurgical factories to cut steel with its claws. If any machinery overheats, it intervenes by blowing bubbles of water to prevent any kind of accident.

entry: POKENAME的头骨，由致密的层层铁质构成。它用骨头敲击洞壁，打落矿石吃下，让头骨更加坚硬。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's skull is formed from dense layers of iron. It strikes ore from cave walls with its bone, consuming it to further harden its skull.

entry: POKENAME挥动钉头锤，速度与力量都十分惊人。据说，只需一击，就连太古盔甲坚固的防御，也能受到损伤。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: POKENAME wields its morningstar with incredible speed and power. One blow is said to be strong enough to damage even the sturdy defenses of an Armaldo.

entry: 它前后摇摆身体，积足动量，再向前猛冲。POKENAME会用头撞击坚岩或金属物，让外壳钨质的头部，保持锋利。
author: infinex21
source: It moves by rocking itself back and forth until it builds enough momentum to lunge forward. A POKENAME will keep the tungsten head of its shell honed by headbutting solid rock or something else made of metal.

entry: POKENAME厌恶雨水。突然下起太阳雨时，它会惊慌地闯进最近的遮蔽处，无论洞穴还是建筑。若不能立刻找到入口，就会直接撞穿墙壁。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME despises the rain. In the event of a sudden sun shower, POKENAME will panic and barge into the nearest structure for cover, be that a cave or a building. It will plow through walls if it can't immediately find an entrance.

entry: POKENAME厌恶雨水。突然下起太阳雨时，它会惊慌地闯进最近的遮蔽处，无论洞穴还是建筑。若不能立刻找到入口，它甚至会直接撞穿墙壁。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME despises the rain. In the event of a sudden sun shower, POKENAME will panic and barge into the nearest structure for cover, be that a cave or a building. It will even plow through walls if it can't immediately find an entrance.

entry: 两只野生POKENAME一旦相遇，几乎免不了打一场。这样的争斗，曾引发山石崩落。
author: notsaying.
source: The meeting of two POKENAME in the wild almost inevitably results in a fight. These fights are known to cause rock slides.

entry: POKENAME用强壮的角，在河床的巨石上凿洞。两只相遇时，也会用这根角，为争夺领地，凶狠地互相撞击。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: POKENAME uses its strong horn to punch holes in boulders along riverbeds. When two POKENAME meet, they use the same horn to fight viciously for territory, battering one another.

entry: POKENAME覆着金属甲片，能挡开利爪的攻击。头部甲片，伸得比退化的角更远，因此有些人，会将它们的角，修成华美的形状。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are covered with metallic plates that deflect attacks from claws and talons. The metallic plate on their head extends further than their vestigial horns, so some people shave their horns into ornate shapes.

entry: POKENAME产生并喷出的腐蚀毒素，能熔解部分金属和大多数原矿。多数锻造厂会滤去毒素，使用液化的金属；不过，也有人发现了精炼毒浆的方法。
author: infinex21
source: The corrosive toxin that POKENAME produce and spew can melt down some metals and most raw ores. Although most forges filter out the toxins to use the liquefied metals, some have discovered ways to refine the toxic slurry.

entry: POKENAME会拼命保护自己认定的朋友。身材虽小，铠甲却让它重得出乎意料。
author: duskrd
source: POKENAME will fiercely protect anyone it considers a friend. Despite its small stature, it is deceptively heavy due to its armour.

entry: POKENAME生活在深海，用尖端覆钢的触手，刺穿外壳与护甲，再吞食猎物内部。它很少升到一定深度以上，科学家一度以为，它已经灭绝。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME live in the depths of the ocean, POKENAME use their steel-tipped tentacles to pierce through shells and armor before devouring their prey's insides. Rarely seen above certain depths, scientists once thought this Pokémon had gone extinct.

entry: 它使出强力的金属音，从几英里外，就能威吓其他生物。POKENAME全身覆着钢刺，总自豪地运用它们，不惜一切争取胜利。
author: fiordaliso
source: It uses powerful Metal Sound attacks to intimidate others from miles away. Its body is covered in steel spikes, which POKENAME uses proudly to win at any cost.

entry: POKENAME头上的盔甲，由一种类似铅的合金锻成。尾部的珠体一泛蓝光，猛烈的雷暴，很快就会接踵而至。
author: .izik
source: The helm atop POKENAME's head is forged from a lead-like alloy. When the orbs on its tail glow blue, a massive thunderstorm soon follows.

entry: POKENAME通常藏在卡车下，观察路过的人。一旦被发现，它就能钻进发动机，藏在里面。
author: hiroshima0042_23263
source: POKENAME typically hides under trucks and watches people passing by. When someone spots POKENAME under a truck it can enter the engine and hide in there.

entry: 它用钢铁脑袋发动头撞，保护自己和幼崽。为了领地，即使面对同类，也绝不退缩。想让敌人平静时，它会从花瓣放出带金属气息、却令人舒缓的香味。
author: infinex21
source: It defends itself and its young with headbutts delivered via its steel head. It will not back down from fighting one of its own kind over territory. To placate enemies, it can release a soothing, albeit metallic, scent from its petals.

entry: POKENAME靠火焰推进，冲撞巨石时，隆隆声常传得很远。随着经验积累，它会锤炼护甲，使其更加耐用。
author: lbbacca
source: The rumble of a POKENAME can often be heard from afar as it charges into boulders by propelling itself with its flames. With experience, it tempers its armor to make it more durable.

entry: POKENAME披着利于减少风阻的护甲，高速撞向巨石，或争夺领地的对手。冲锋时，火焰炽热得足以烧灼钢铁。
author: lbbacca
source: With aerodynamic armor, POKENAME launches itself at high speed into boulders, or at rivals when it fights for territory. When it charges, its flames burn hot enough to scorch steel.

entry: POKENAME吃金属与矿石，让钢铁身体保持强壮。有些个体，大半生都用矿块磨牙。它们还会将身体拖过硬物，磨去铁锈。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME feed on metal and ore to keep their steel bodies strong; some POKENAME teethe on chunks of ore for most of their lives. They drag themselves against hard materials to keep their bodies free of rust.

entry: 湖泊、池塘或河流附近的洞穴，常回响着两只POKENAME争夺领地的撞击声。威猛的双颚，各长两排铁牙，轻易就能撕碎精炼金属。
author: infinex21
source: Caves near lakes, ponds, or rivers often ring with the sounds of two POKENAME clashing over territory. Their imposing jaws are each lined with two rows of iron fangs that can shred pieces of refined metal with ease.

entry: 野生POKENAME对同类极其好斗，一看见对方，就免不了打一场。它们在半空碰撞，试图用沉重的铁头，将对手撞落。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME are highly combative towards one other in the wild, and one spotting another inevitably leads to a fight. They clash in midair as each attempts to knock the other out of the sky with heavy iron headbutts.

entry: POKENAME外表强悍，却喜欢训练家为自己梳理。不过，鬃毛由钢丝绒组成，纤维粗糙，还带静电，使梳理过程颇有危险。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: While tough in appearance, POKENAME love to be groomed by their Trainer. However, the steel wool that makes up this Pokémon's mane makes maintaining this process hazardous due to the rough fibers and static electricity.

entry: 夜里，它会登上能找到的最高处，望着月亮直到天明。若遇见另一只POKENAME，双方就会互相顶撞，直到较弱的一方被赶走。
author: staghorn
source: At night, it seeks out the highest point it can find and watches the moon until dawn. If it encounters another POKENAME during this process, the two will butt heads until the weaker one is driven away.

entry: 它的领地意识极强，会击退靠近家园的人类与宝可梦。战斗时全力以赴，身体的任何部位，都能当作钝器，猛砸敌人。
author: bobosmith01
source: It is incredibly territorial and will fight off both people and Pokémon that approach what it has deemed its home. When it battles, it exudes effort and is willing to use any part of its body as a bludgeoning tool.

entry: POKENAME分节的身体，挖得越深，就越致密。它在山地中钻行，沿途吃下原矿。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's segmented body grows denser the deeper it digs. It consumes raw ore as it tunnels through mountainous terrain.

entry: POKENAME主要捕食地鼠，它们一探出头，就整只吸入口中。随后，它再翻开泥土，寻找被地鼠带到更靠近地表的富铁矿脉。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME primarily preys on Diglett, slurping them up whole when they pop their head out of the ground. They then turn through the soil, seeking iron-rich veins that the Diglett has brought closer to the surface.

entry: POKENAME流畅的金属身体，摩擦阻力很小，能顺畅滑过水面，速度足够时，甚至能起飞。它们偏爱以淡水河作跑道，因为海水的盐分，会刺激钢铁皮肤。
author: anonymous_moose
source: POKENAME's sleek metal body provides little friction, allowing it to glide smoothly across the water's surface and even take flight with enough speed. They prefer freshwater rivers for runways, as the ocean's salinity irritates their steel skin.

entry: 披甲的身体能挡住绝大多数打击，只有极猛烈的攻击才奏效。因此，野生POKENAME会用相对脆弱的鹿角互抵，解决领地争端，直到一方认输或角折断。这场角力可能持续数小时。
author: alumed
source: As their armored bodies can resist all but the fiercest blows, wild POKENAME will settle territorial disputes by locking their relatively fragile antlers in a struggle until one yields or its antlers break. This process can take several hours.

entry: POKENAME休息时，铁质身体便会变硬。它在睡眠中，从一处铜矿藏，跳到另一处，慢慢积蓄进化的力量。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's iron body hardens as it rests. It hops between copper deposits while sleeping, slowly building strength for evolution.

entry: 它遍布全身的孔洞，能喷射沙子与铁屑。战斗中若无法以力量压倒对手，就会试着弄得对方看不见。
author: bandedbodypress
source: The holes covering its body can blast out sand and iron fillings. During any fight where it can't overpower its foe, it seeks to blind them.

entry: POKENAME攀爬冰冷的山崖，寻找登山者留下的金属岩钉。吃下这些岩钉，能强化护甲，让爪子更加锋利。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME climbs icy mountain cliffs in search of metal pitons left by climbers. Eating these strengthens its armor and sharpens its claws.

entry: POKENAME与其他宝可梦相处时，非常骄傲，会用覆钢的身体和火焰吐息，证明自己更胜一筹。不过，与训练家独处时，虽然身躯沉重，它却很爱依偎撒娇。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME is very prideful when it comes to interacting with other Pokémon. It uses its steel-coated body and fiery breath to prove that it is better than its opponent. When alone with its Trainer, POKENAME loves to snuggle despite its heavy body.

entry: POKENAME巨大的尾巴，能轻易挖起大块泥土。金属外壳十分蓄热，它便将泥浆或泥土抛到身上，让自己凉快。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's large tail easily lets it dig out large chunks of dirt and mud from the ground. It tosses the mud or soil onto its body to keep itself cool, as its metallic shell greatly retains heat.

entry: POKENAME若察觉周围的情绪过于激烈，就会使出变硬，让自己平静，获得安全感。它非常无害，金属外壳，主要用于抵挡他者的攻击。
author: fiordaliso
source: If POKENAME senses emotions around it growing too turbulent, it uses Harden to calm itself and feel safer. It is an extremely harmless Pokémon that uses its metal shell mainly to defend itself from others.

entry: POKENAME领地意识极强，会用念动力，将彼此抛来抛去，争夺地盘。预见未来的能力，能帮助它们判断对手的下一招。
author: oddwalls
source: Fiercely territorial, POKENAME duel for territory by throwing each other about with their psychokinetic powers. Their ability to see the future helps them predict their opponent's moves.

entry: POKENAME披着致密的钴甲片，靠超能力悬浮。即使采矿，也很少碰到地面。
author: .izik
source: Covered in dense cobalt plating, POKENAME hovers using psychic force. It rarely touches the ground, even while mining.

entry: POKENAME只有铁质头骨，无法化作无形。它像挥动重锤般，将沉重的头骨甩向敌人，力量大得轻易就能打裂水泥。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's iron skull is the only portion of its body that cannot become incorporeal. It swings this heavy skull at foes like a mace with enough force to crack cement with ease.

entry: POKENAME的身体，包在中空的铝合金外壳中。跳跃时，它兜住迎面急风，便能在山崖之间，短暂滑翔。
author: .izik
source: A hollow aluminum alloy encases POKENAME's body. It captures rushing air while leaping, allowing for brief glides between cliffs.

entry: POKENAME用覆着铁甲的第二颗头，轻轻咬同类玩耍。有时咬得太用力，无意间，就会留下凹痕。
author: .izik
source: With its iron-plated second head, POKENAME playfully nibbles at its kin. At times it bites too hard, unintentionally leaving dents.

entry: POKENAME会冲向受灾地区，用钢铁身体推搡人类与宝可梦，强行将他们赶离。这样的帮助方式太过粗暴，使它名声不佳。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: POKENAME will rush to areas experiencing disasters and physically force people and Pokémon out of the area, shoving them with its steel body. This aggressive method of helping gives it a poor reputation.

entry: POKENAME常为领地与同类交战。庞大的金属身体相撞，产生的震荡，能在海面掀起汹涌的波涛。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME regularly get into fights with each other over territory. The clashing of their huge metal bodies causes reverberations that can create tumultuous waves upon the ocean's surface.

entry: POKENAME的钢铁壳板可以移开，露出里面松软的泥土和植物。它拼命保护这处，只有极亲密的朋友，才能看见，并照料其中的植物。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's steel shell plating is removable, revealing soft soil and plant-life within. It guards this spot fiercely and will only allow extremely close friends to see it and tend to the plants it grows.

entry: POKENAME寻找草木青翠的地方安家，尽情吃周围的植物。它们十分保护自己的住处，若有另一只POKENAME到来，双方就免不了冲突，为这片地方而战。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME find verdant areas to live in and feast on the plant life around them. They are protective of their chosen place, so if another POKENAME comes into the area, the two will inevitably come into conflict and fight for the spot.

entry: POKENAME的金属尖刺，末端中空，装着有毒的液态金属化合物，主要成分是汞。它们好勇斗狠，缺乏经验的训练家，最好避开其领地。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The metal spines of POKENAME have hollow tips that contain a toxic liquid metal compound, primarily composed of mercury. They are belligerent Pokémon and inexperienced Trainers are advised to avoid their territories.

entry: POKENAME用锋利的金属爪，撕开矿脉，轻易击碎岩石。一处矿藏，就够它吃上几个月，不必移动。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME tears into ore veins with sharp metal claws, breaking stone with ease. It can feed on the same deposit for months without moving.

entry: POKENAME喜欢追赶铁轨上疾驰的火车。烦躁时，尾巴上的蓝色星星，就会闪烁，迸出骇人的电火花。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME enjoys chasing the trains that speed along the tracks. When it becomes irritated, the blue star on its tail begins to flash and emit menacing electric sparks.

entry: POKENAME的缎带，与坚固的身体由同样材料构成。它挥动缎带保卫领地，还会用缎带敲击自己，发出响亮的金属闷响，警告他者远离。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's ribbons are made of the same material as its own sturdy body. It whips them around to defend its territory, warning others to stay away by striking itself to make a loud metallic thud.

entry: 战斗或烦躁时，它的触须会变硬，也就成了锋利的武器。它能切下矿石和宝石，这些也是它的食物；许多采石场，都至少有一只POKENAME。
author: infinex21
source: Its feelers become rigid during battle or when it feels agitated, which turns them into sharp weapons as well. It can cut out, or off, pieces of ore and gemstones, which are also what it eats; many quarries are privy to having at least one POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME在山洞里安家，深挖岩石，寻找金属矿石充饥。它们严守住处，防备饥饿的竞争者，谁来打扰，就用强壮的尾巴扫过去。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME make their homes within mountain caves, digging deep into the rock in search of metal ores to consume. They jealously guard their home from hungry rivals, swiping at anyone who disturbs them with their powerful tail.

entry: POKENAME为争夺沉船墓场，不断互相争斗。金属脑袋相撞的铿锵声，回荡深海，会干扰依靠水下回声定位辨路的宝可梦。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME fight constantly with one another for control of shipwreck graveyards. The deep sea echoes with the clangs of their metallic heads smashing together. The noise can disrupt Pokémon who use underwater echolocation to navigate.

entry: POKENAME能变成喷气机般的形态，以更高速度飞行。传闻里面住着友善的小生灵，可从没人看见它打开身体，露出内部。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is able to take a jet-like form in order to travel through the air at higher speeds. Its rumored that friendly little beings live inside it, but it has never been observed opening up and revealing its insides.

entry: POKENAME相遇时，会用锁链，刮擦同伴棺材般的身体。刮痕常像人脸。民间迷信认为，这些是被锁在POKENAME体内者的记忆。
author: wiz0z
source: When POKENAME meet, they scratch their chains over the coffin-like bodies of their companions. These scratches often resemble human faces. Common superstition proposes that they are the memories of those locked within POKENAME's body.

entry: 人们曾见过这些坚韧的宝可梦，共同生活、合作，守护特定山脉，驱赶擅闯者。观察表明，它们用复杂的碰拳与头撞组合，彼此交流。
author: sk372
source: These durable Pokémon have been seen living and working together to guard select mountain ranges from trespassers. Observation indicates they communicate through a complex combination of fist-bumps and headbutts.

entry: 它们的尾巴像钉头锤或链枷，战斗时用来猛砸对手。每条尾巴都能独立行动，接连击碎岩石和其他障碍物。
author: quackquackattack
source: Their tails resemble a morningstar or flail, which they use to slam into opponents in battle. Each tail is able to act independently to smash rocks or other obstacles in quick succession.

entry: POKENAME是顶级捕食者，以拉达等大型鼠类宝可梦为食。拉达的牙齿，无法刺穿它们的金属翅膀，因此几乎无力抵挡这种鸟类宝可梦。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are an apex predator that eat large rodent Pokémon such as Raticate. Their metallic wings cannot be pierced by a Raticate's teeth, so the rodent Pokémon have little to no defenses against this avian Pokémon.

entry: 它的六只翅膀，反射阳光，看起来仿佛燃着火。翅膀常会脱落，熔落在地面上。
author: lydiaprower8
source: Its six wings reflect sunlight to give itself a fiery look. Those wings often shed and melt onto the ground.

entry: POKENAME的两个头，都由致密的铁构成。在洞穴睡觉时，两头会无意间交替打鼾，声音沿隧道，回荡到深处。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's two heads are made of dense iron. While sleeping in its cave, the two heads unintentionally alternate snoring, the sound echoing deep through the tunnels.

entry: POKENAME的双臂，必须消耗大量能量，才能托起沉重的金属身体，高速飞行。飞行结束，一落地，它便大吃能找到的任何食物，恢复能量。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's arms use up a lot of energy in order to lift up its heavy metal body and let it take flight at high speeds. Once it lands from a flight, it gorges itself on anything edible it can find to regain its energy.

entry: POKENAME天生领地意识强。厚实的护甲，让它们能承受大量打击，充沛得仿佛不会疲倦的精力，又让它们不断巡视，因此是极佳的守卫。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME are territorial by nature. POKENAME make for excellent guards because their well-armored bodies can withstand a great deal of punishment and they are brimming with tireless energy that compels them to constantly patrol around an area.

entry: 每到秋天，POKENAME会在港口城镇附近，翻滚着互相碰撞，让身体更加坚硬。许多人特地赶来，只为观看这一幕。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME roll into one another near port towns each autumn to strengthen the hardness of their bodies. Many travel to these destinations just to watch.

entry: POKENAME坚硬的外骨骼，紧紧贴着身体。它们食量惊人，需要大量铁，才能让外骨骼继续扩张。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have tough exoskeletons that cling tightly to their bodies. They are ravenous creatures that need lots of iron to expand their exoskeletons.

entry: 常能看见POKENAME潜进废品场。它爱吃金属，会用强壮的双颚，从旧机器上撕下大块零件当零食，吃到相当于一扇车门的重量，才觉得满足。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a common sight infiltrating junkyards. With a taste for metal, it uses its powerful jaws to tear off chunks of old machinery for a snack, eating the equivalent weight of a car door before it feels satisfied.

entry: 环绕POKENAME、帮助它进化的外壳，被认为坚不可破。如此耐用的材料，本适合制作上好的金属制品，可至今，没人能刮下或敲落，哪怕最微小的一片。
author: sk372
source: The shell around POKENAME, created to aid its evolution, is thought to be impervious. Its durability would make for fine metalwork, but none so far have been able to shave or chip off even the tiniest piece of the material.

entry: POKENAME栖居在自己挖出的地下隧道网。金属外壳极其坚硬，饮食中的矿物，还会进一步强化它。外表虽然威猛，平时却相当温顺友善。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME dwells in underground tunnel networks that it digs. Its metallic shell is extremely hard, strengthened further by the minerals in its diet. Despite its imposing appearance, it is normally quite docile and friendly.

entry: 它们用金属爪和巨颚，保卫领地。对矿石与贵金属的嗅觉十分敏锐，因此常成为矿工的伙伴。
author: infinex21
source: They defend their territories with their metallic claws and their large jaws. They have a keen sense of smell for ores and precious metals, making them common allies to miners.

entry: POKENAME发出声呐脉冲，在暗洞中定位铜矿脉。找到以后，就啃食金属，强化披甲的身体。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME emits sonar pulses to locate copper veins in dark caves. Once found, it gnaws on the metal to bolster its armored body.

entry: POKENAME的獠牙，覆着厚厚的钢铁，为挖掘而强化。它钻穿岩石，寻找稀有矿物。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's tusks are coated in thick steel, reinforced for digging. It tunnels through rock in search of rare minerals.

entry: POKENAME铁头和身体上的孔洞，使它飞行时更加灵活。倒挂睡觉时，它会伪装成一根特别闪亮的钟乳石。
author: pjporwoll
source: The holes in the iron head and body of POKENAME allow it to maneuver better when flying. When sleeping upside down, POKENAME is disguised as an especially shiny stalactite.

entry: POKENAME吃的祖母绿越多，金属护甲就越强韧。缺少宝石，就会变得迟缓而虚弱。
author: .izik
source: The more emeralds POKENAME eats, the stronger its metal armor becomes. When deprived of gems, it grows sluggish and weak.

entry: 它们用强力的头撞，以及覆铁的咬击，保卫领地。通常栖居在矿物丰富，或藏着大量原矿的洞穴附近。
author: infinex21
source: They defend their territory with strong headbutts and their iron-clad bites. They typically live near caves that are rich in minerals and, or, raw ores.

entry: POKENAME会互撞铁头，争夺领地，直到其中一只终于倒下。双颚力量强大，连大块岩石与金属，也能吃下。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME will bash their iron heads together to compete for territory, until one finally collapses. Their jaws are strong enough to allow them to eat large chunks of rock and metal.

entry: POKENAME是小型宝可梦，常出现在钢铁厂与矿井附近，大吃金属、矿石的碎屑和余料。它们经常撞上别人，坚硬如铁的脑袋，能保护自己不受伤。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are small Pokémon often found near steel mills and mines, where they feast upon the shavings and scraps of metals and ores. Their iron-hard heads protect them from harming themselves when they run into others, which happens often.

entry: POKENAME是领地意识强的独行猎手，比起矿物和岩石，更爱吃金属。多只交锋时，金属身体撞击的声音，能从极深的海底传出。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are territorial and solitary hunters that prefer to feed on metal over the minerals and rocks. When multiple POKENAME clash, the sounds of their metal bodies ramming against each other can reach from some of the deepest ocean depths.

entry: POKENAME生活在山区，靠富含矿物质的泥土与水维生。粗硬的羽毛，可以收集起来，制成钢丝绒清洁垫。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME lives in mountainous regions, subsisting on mineral-rich soil and water. Its coarse feathers can be collected and turned into steel wool pads.

entry: POKENAME一找到可挖掘的矿脉，便会严守领地。它依靠铁甲保护，试着推开闯入的宝可梦，不过动作实在太慢，轻易就能被绕过去。
author: .jerden
source: Once it has found a vein of ore to mine, POKENAME is very territorial. It will rely on its iron armor for protection and try to push away any Pokémon that intrude, although it moves so slowly that it is easy to just move around it.

entry: POKENAME的身体，会渗出一层液态金属，移动时，在地上积成一滩滩。睡觉时，它蜷成光滑发亮的圆球，静悄悄的。
author: .izik
source: A coating of liquid metal seeps from POKENAME's body, pooling in puddles as it moves. It sleeps curled into a glossy, silent orb.

entry: POKENAME十分好胜，会通过切磋，证明自己的力量。败下阵后，它们就会闷闷不乐地回到洞穴，修补铁甲。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are very competitive and will engage in sparring matches to prove their strength. After they lose a fight, they will sulk back to their cave to repair their iron armor.

entry: POKENAME尾巴上的蓝色金属鳞片，哪怕只缺了一小角，也会脱落。吃金属后，鳞片长得更快，使它能迅速修补，保持防御能力。
author: .izik
source: The blue metal scale on POKENAME's tail falls off if it gets even slightly chipped. It will regrow faster if it eats metal, allowing it to rapidly repair and maintain its defensive strength.

entry: POKENAME在夜间活动，深入洞穴，寻找裸露的铁矿。它们靠矿藏闪烁的光，判断矿石能否食用，因此也会吃下其他贵重金属。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are nocturnal creatures that search for exposed iron deposits deep within caves. They rely on glints of light from these deposits to determine if the ore is edible, leading them to consume other valuable metals as well.

entry: POKENAME的钢铁甲壳，如武士铠甲般层层叠起，磨得闪亮，还缀着锯齿般的尖刺。它以坚定的自律迎敌，低下光亮的头盔，势不可挡地冲锋。
author: potato_tub
source: POKENAME's steel carapace is layered like samurai armor, polished to a shine and adorned with jagged spikes. It meets foes with unwavering discipline, lowering its gleaming helm before charging with unstoppable force.

entry: 这种宝可梦背着宽大的钢板盾牌，上面排列着高耸、锋利如刃的尖刺。战斗时，POKENAME低下闪着决意的铁面具，向前猛冲，保护信任的对象。
author: potato_tub
source: This Pokémon bears a broad shield of plated steel on its back, lined with towering, razor-sharp spikes. In battle, POKENAME lowers its iron mask, shining with resolve, then barrels forward to protect those it trusts.

entry: POKENAME的铝头盔，越擦就越亮。它痴迷地用丝滑的尾巴，不停打磨表面。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's aluminum helmet gleams brighter the more it's polished. It uses its silken tail to buff the surface obsessively.

entry: POKENAME全身覆着钢板，当作抵御敌人的护甲。愤怒时，尾火的热量会传遍金属，让身体灼红发亮。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME's body is covered in steel plates that serve as armor against enemy Pokémon. When angered, the flame on its tail spreads its heat through the metal, making it glow red-hot.

entry: POKENAME以矿物与金属矿石维生，钢铁身体越长越坚固。就连毛发，也更像细细的金属针。头顶有硬币般的结构，每天都会擦亮。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME have steel bodies that have grown sturdier as they subsist on minerals and metal ores. Even their furs are more akin to thin, metallic needles. Upon their heads is a coin-like feature, which they polish daily.

entry: 它的钢铁胡须，如雷达般，连周围最细微的震动也能探知。遇上同类，双方会用头锤和铁尾交锋，声音能传出几英里。
author: infinex21
source: Its steel whiskers serve as radars for even the smallest of vibrations around them. When it meets another of its kind, the two of them will clash with Headbutt and Iron Tail attacks, the sounds of which that can ring out for miles.

entry: POKENAME用随身携带的金属镐，开采铁矿。战斗时，镐能当武器，也能罩在喙上，增加保护。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME mine for iron ore using the metal pick they carry. They can use it as a weapon in combat or place it over their beak for extra protection.

entry: POKENAME玩耍时，头顶的银色头盔，会灼红发亮。训练家常扔给它耐火的玩具，让它玩得开心。
author: .izik
source: The silver helm on POKENAME's head glows red-hot when it plays. Trainers often toss it fire-resistant toys to keep it entertained.

entry: POKENAME用双手压碎铁矿，再将粉末吃下。这个过程，能进一步强化本已致密的护甲。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME crushes iron ore between its hands before eating the powder. This process helps reinforce its already dense armor.

entry: POKENAME在废弃矿井中，轻松挖取铁矿。吃下矿石，能强化并增厚头部的钢板。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME scoops iron ore with ease in abandoned mines. It consumes the ore to reinforce and thicken the steel plating on its head.

entry: POKENAME的火焰，从头部与背部金属甲片的缝隙间窜出。它们用仍在发育的腿和蹄子，踩碎岩石与矿石，再吃下去。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's flames lick out from between the cracks of the metallic plates lining their heads and backs. They use their developing legs and hooves to crush rocks and ores before eating them.

entry: 它们头部与背部的钢板，极其耐火，不过摸起来总是滚烫。炽热的蹄子接触过许多矿石，因此也长出了金属甲片。
author: infinex21
source: The steel plates lining their heads and backs are incredibly flame-resistant, though constantly hot to the touch. Their hot hooves have developed metallic plating due to the many ores they have come into contact with.

entry: 它们用金属棒弹射小石头，速度惊人。POKENAME之间即使友好切磋，看着也像拼命。
author: pokepower
source: They can use their metal sticks to flick small stones at an alarming speed. Even friendly spars between POKENAME look like fights for their lives.

entry: POKENAME披上废弃的金属板，保护原本气态、脆弱的身体。它们用操纵铁的力量，控制甲片，需要时，便能蜷成防御的圆球。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME cover themselves with discarded plates of sheet metal, protecting their otherwise gaseous and vulnerable bodies. The plates they use are manipulated using ferrokinetic powers, letting them curl into defensive balls if needed.

entry: POKENAME领地意识极强，在地下遇见其他宝可梦，就会用铁头攻击。若仍赶不走对方，它便转向反方向，挖洞离开。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME is incredibly territorial, attacking any other Pokémon it encounters underground with strikes from its iron head. If this does not drive it off, POKENAME will tunnel in the opposite direction.

entry: 它岩石般的身体，只有部分覆着金属甲片。在野外，它们必须吃下与自身体重相当的铁矿，才能进化。
author: .jerden
source: Its rocky body is only partially covered with metal plating. In the wild, they cannot evolve until they have eaten their body weight in iron ore.

entry: POKENAME慢慢靠近领地里熟睡的宝可梦，偷偷吞食它们的梦。定期吃梦，似乎能让身上的金属，保持闪亮与坚固。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME slowly approaches sleeping Pokémon in its area and secretly feasts on their dreams while they slumber. It seems that regular dream consumption helps keep the metal on its body shiny and sturdy.

entry: 许多人因POKENAME体型小，低估它的力量，其实它能用巨颚，使出强力的咬击。它甚至曾咬裂壶壶的外壳。
author: mepp.
source: Though many underestimate POKENAME's strength given its small size, it can deliver a powerful bite with its large jaws. Its bite has been known to even crack the shells of Shuckle.

entry: POKENAME喷出大量沙子藏住身体。它的密度却比沙子还低，因此能浮在沙丘上。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's body spews large amounts of sand to keep itself concealed. However, it can keep itself afloat on the dunes due to being less dense than the sand.

entry: POKENAME沿陡峭的沙丘滚下，借冲势，将自己埋入沙中。一感觉有宝可梦从上方经过，它们便会自爆。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME rolls down steep sand dunes, using the momentum to bury themselves into the sand. When they feel Pokémon wander above them, they Self-Destruct.

entry: POKENAME埋伏在沙下，直到感觉有东西踩上自己。随后，它猛然钻出，咬住擅闯者，再使出大爆炸。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME lie in wait under the sand until they feel something step on them. POKENAME then pop out of the sand, bite on the interloper, and use Explosion.

entry: POKENAME在开阔的沙漠游荡，锁链尾巴叮当作响。一发现猎物，它们会先吠叫，再尽全力猛扑过去。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME roam the open desert, their chain tail clinking as they do so. When they spot prey, they will bark before lunging as hard as possible.

entry: POKENAME四处搜寻残食，用强壮的颚，啃食狩猎留下的骨头。它总会留下一根骨头当棍棒，赶走其他食腐者。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME scavenges around, eating bones leftover from hunts using its powerful jaws. It always saves one of the bones to use as a club to fight off other scavengers.

entry: POKENAME有一颗假头，用来欺骗对手。挥拳攻击后，还会紧接着使出强力咬击。
author: camtft
source: POKENAME have a fake head that's used to fool opponents. Their punches are followed up with strong bites.

entry: POKENAME一看见像是美味的东西，就会向前冲，巨颚不断磨咬，满心期待饱餐。不过，双腿短小，即使全速前进，也相当慢。
author: sk372
source: When it spots something tasty-looking, POKENAME charges forward, gnashing its large jaws in anticipation of a meal. Because of its stubby legs, however, its top speed is rather slow.

entry: POKENAME携带的蛋，有着模仿自身巨颚的开口。它在里面藏好甜点，赠出营养丰富的蛋时，还能给对方一份美味的额外惊喜。
author: sk372
source: The eggs POKENAME carries are designed with an opening that mimics its own large jaws. It stores sweet treats within so that those it gifts the nutritious eggs to get a tasty snack as an extra special surprise.

entry: 年幼的POKENAME什么都咬，以此锻炼强大的双颚。虽然十分惹人烦，人类应对它的胡闹时，仍须小心，因为POKENAME母亲的颚，更加危险。
author: hophoppip
source: A baby POKENAME trains its powerful jaw by biting anything and everything. Though it can be quite a nuisance, humans must be cautious when dealing with its antics, as a mother POKENAME's jaws are much more dangerous.

entry: 野生POKENAME在沙漠或古代遗迹中钻穴。它们用宝石般的小舌，吸引各种猎物，走进等候已久的巨嘴，再猛地咬合。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME burrow within desert sands or within ancient ruins. They use their gem-like uvula to lure all manner of prey into their awaiting maws before clamping shut around them.

entry: POKENAME让周围地面快速震动，不靠热量，也能几乎瞬间，将沙子变成玻璃。野生个体用来制造屏障，家养个体，则是各地玻璃工匠不可或缺的帮手。
author: deadshields
source: Through rapid vibration of the surrounding land, POKENAME is able to near-instantly turn sand into glass without the use of heat. Wild POKENAME use this ability to create barriers, while domestic ones are indispensable to glassmakers everywhere.

entry: POKENAME一生大多待在地下，偏爱土壤松软的地方。一感到上方有猎物经过，就会用毒刺攻击。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME spends most of its life underground, preferring areas with soft soil. When it senses prey walking above, it attacks with its poisonous stinger.

entry: POKENAME在沙下钻行，游动速度堪比受过训练的跑者。猎物一到上方，它们便猛然破沙而出，将其整个吞下。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME dig under the sand, swimming through it at speeds rivaling trained runners. When prey is above them, POKENAME erupt from underneath to swallow them whole.

entry: POKENAME在网络空间游荡，不断咬合双颚，渴望吃掉遇见的所有数据。人们开发了许多程序，阻止它闯入用户珍贵的数据存储空间。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is driven to consume any data it comes across, roaming across cyberspace and constantly gnashing its jaws. Many programs have been made to block POKENAME from getting into a user's precious data stores.

entry: POKENAME飞过冰冷的群山，搜寻猎物，用巨颚在雪中凿出锥形陷阱。不过，亮橙色的身体，在白雪中十分显眼，多数猎物，还没等陷阱做好，就早已逃走。
author: h0bojoe
source: POKENAME soars over icy mountains in search of prey, using its massive jaws to carve conical traps in the snow. However, its bright orange body stands out in the white landscape, causing most prey to flee long before the trap is set.

entry: POKENAME在沙漠疾行，藏身裂隙，避开开阔的沙地。被迫撤退时，它能蜕下皮，作最后的掩护，分散注意，不过之后，会有一段时间相当虚弱。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME scurries across the desert, taking shelter in crevasses and staying away from the open sands. If forced to retreat, it can shed its skin as a last-ditch distraction, though this leaves it quite weakened for a time afterward.

entry: POKENAME侧向蜿蜒身体，将自己埋入沙中，只露出尾尖，看起来像条小虫。它借此吸引毫无防备的小型鸟类宝可梦，再发动伏击。
author: ultrazombie929
source: POKENAME move their bodies in a sidewinding motion to bury themselves in the sand. They leave the tip of their tail exposed, resembling a worm to lure in small, unsuspecting bird Pokémon to ambush.

entry: POKENAME藏在岩缝，等候路过的猎物。出击时，它会毫不留情地将强力毒素，注入受害者体内。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME hides in rocky crevasses, waiting for any prey that passes by. When it strikes, it mercilessly injects a powerful poison into its victim.

entry: POKENAME从巨石上咬下大块，留下的洞，能供小型宝可梦避难。风暴来临，平日的猎物与捕食者，也会暂时放下恩怨，并肩坐在洞里。
author: beetlething
source: POKENAME take large bites out of boulders, leaving behind holes that smaller Pokémon use as shelter. When there is a storm, Pokémon who are normally prey and predator will put their differences aside and sit side-by-side in these holes.

entry: 夜里，POKENAME睡在仙人掌围绕之中，躲避捕食者。不过，它醒来时，常忘了睡在哪里，往往一动，就扎伤自己。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME protect themselves from predators at night by falling asleep surrounded by cacti. However, POKENAME tend to forget where they slept when they awake, often poking themselves when they wake up.

entry: POKENAME藏进枝叶，只露出一朵花，以甜香引来虫宝可梦。等对方替花授完粉，便一口将其吞下。
author: mistymagius
source: Hiding amongst the foliage until only its flower is visible, POKENAME uses a sweet scent to lure in bug Pokémon to pollinate the flower before devouring them in a single bite.

entry: 它的身体，完美适应沙漠生活，即使顶着烈日，飞上几个小时，也毫不受影响。POKENAME俯冲猎物时，会用强大的巨颚，猛烈咬击，将其了结。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its body has adapted perfectly to life in the desert; it can fly for hours under the scorching sun without being affected in the slightest. When POKENAME swoops down on its prey, it finishes it off with the powerful bites of its mighty jaws.

entry: 这些宝可梦较小的半身上，有一处小脸般的花纹，使猎物误以为安全。它们用较大半身的巨嘴，抓住猎物，再以腐蚀液，将其溶解。
author: infinex21
source: The small face-like pattern upon the lesser half of these Pokémon is used to lull their prey into a false sense of security. They capture prey within the large maws of their body's larger half and dissolve them within using a corrosive fluid.

entry: POKENAME腹部的大嘴状花纹，能吓退远比自己强大的敌人。它们常钻入沙下，用腹部的毒刺，让猎物无法动弹。
author: infinex21
source: The large, mouth-like marking along a POKENAME's abdomen is used to scare away foes much stronger than they are. They often burrow under desert sands and use their abdomen's stinger to immobilize their prey.

entry: 翅膀振动极快，力量强大，使它连在沙暴中，也能灵巧飞行。POKENAME看见什么在动，就会拼命追赶，无法抗拒用大嘴咬住对方的本能。
author: fiordaliso
source: It flies skillfully even through sandstorms thanks to the strength of its extremely rapid wings. POKENAME desperately chases anything it sees moving, unable to resist the primal instinct to bite it with its large mouth.

entry: POKENAME常一动不动，凝望远方，其实远比看起来警觉。谁想偷偷靠近，它都会迅速转身，猛扑过去，狠狠咬上一口。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME tends to stand motionless and stare off into the distance, but is far more attentive than it appears. Anything that attempts to sneak up on it will find it quickly turning and lunging to give them a nasty bite.

entry: POKENAME将自己埋入沙中，只留一绺卷毛露在外面。好奇的生物一碰，它便猛然跃出，用舌头卷住倒霉的家伙，拖进巨颚。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME buries itself in the sand, leaving only its curl of hair sticking out. Should a curious creature touch it, it immediately leaps from the sand to grab the hapless being with its tongue and pull it into its wide jaws.

entry: 这种平静的生物，生活在沙漠。头上仙人掌状的裂片，能储存水分，让它几个月不喝水，也能度过。
author: hophoppip
source: This calm creature resides in deserts. The cactus lobes on its head store moisture, allowing it to go months without drinking water.

entry: POKENAME在垃圾桶里，筑起碗状的巢，等待猎物掉进来。清洁工会配备合适的护手用品，保护手指，免遭它锋利的双颚咬伤。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME makes its bowl-like nest inside trash cans, waiting for prey to fall in. Garbage collectors are given proper hand protection to keep their fingers safe from POKENAME's sharp jaws.

entry: POKENAME将尾巴藏在沙中或地下，用看似纤弱的外表，欺骗猎物。对方一靠近，它们便迅速甩出尾巴上的巨嘴，发动攻击。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME use their frail-seeming appearances to deceive their prey while keeping their tails hidden in the sand or the ground. When their prey draws near, they swiftly lash at them with the maws upon their tails.

entry: POKENAME藏在沙下，将植物般的舌头探出地面，引诱猎物。只要有东西落进双颚之间，它便短暂升起，猛地咬住，再拖着猎物，一起沉回沙中。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Hiding beneath the desert sand, POKENAME extend their plant-like tongues out of the ground to lure in prey. If something lands within their jaws, POKENAME will rise just long enough to clamp down before sinking back down with their prey in tow.

entry: POKENAME凭宽阔的视野，在干旱之地搜寻富含矿物的岩石。途中若起沙暴，就躲进崖边凹处，将耐沙的翅膀围住身体，当作护盾。
author: aster_oid1701
source: POKENAME scour arid places using their wide range of vision for rocks filled with minerals. If a sandstorm arises whilst searching, they settle down in the nooks of cliffsides and curl their sand-resistant wings around their bodies as a shield.

entry: POKENAME常藏在高大的草木或浑浊的泥水中，难以看见。捕捉它需要极大的耐心，因为稍有声响，它就会逃走。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME often hides out of sight in the cover of tall foliage or muddy water. Catching one requires a great deal of patience, as they flee at the slightest sound.

entry: POKENAME常藏在高大的草木或浑浊的泥水中，难以看见。它们会制作类似捕兽夹的装置，困住猎物，再一口，让对方噤声。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME often hides out of sight in the cover of tall foliage or muddy water. They create contraptions similar to bear traps that they use to trap their prey and are able to silence them with one bite.

entry: POKENAME白天待在俯瞰绿洲的悬崖上，任风沙吹过，静心冥想。捕食者若从后方靠近，它就取下王冠，抛出去，咬住敌人。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME spend their days on cliffs overlooking oases, meditating as sand blows by them. When predators approach from behind, POKENAME take off their crowns and throw them to bite their foes.

entry: POKENAME将自己埋在绿洲周围的沙中，一边休息，一边轻舔池水。旅途中渴了，它们就用沙质藤蔓，从仙人掌中吸取水分。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME bury themselves in the sand surrounding oases, gently lapping the water as they rest. When they become thirsty on travels, they use their sand-vines to suck moisture out of cacti.

entry: POKENAME背上的多肉植物，提供了全部能量，因此只需极少的食物和水。它的唾液，能帮助缓解晒伤。
author: bandedbodypress
source: The succulent on POKENAME's back gives it all its energy. It requires very little food or water. Its saliva can help with sunburns.

entry: POKENAME在开阔的沙漠上滑翔，借周围热空气的浮力升空。毒液只用来让猎物失去行动力，战斗时，它更爱使用利爪与巨颚。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME glides above the open desert, the heated air around it granting it lift. It only uses its venom to incapacitate its prey, preferring to use its sharp claws and jaws in combat.

entry: POKENAME非常好斗，为了够到惹怒自己的对象，甚至会试着咬穿大树。不过，视力很差，夜里常会径直撞上东西。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is very aggressive and will try to chomp through large trees to get to whatever angered it. However, its poor eyesight can cause it to fly directly into things during the night.

entry: POKENAME用沙子塑成熔岩虫形的诱饵，吸引平时捕食熔岩虫的宝可梦。成功引来以后，它们便向前猛扑，用强大的双颚，紧紧咬住猎物。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME create a lure shaped like Slugma out of sand, using it to lure in Pokémon that would normally prey on Slugma. They lunge forward when they successfully lure in a Pokémon, snapping their powerful jaws closed around their prey.

entry: POKENAME在雪原游荡，用强壮的双颚，咬开连最厚的冰，继续前行。它总是饥肠辘辘，什么食物，都能把它引过来。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME roams the snowy plains, chewing through even the thickest ice with its strong jaws to make its way. Always extremely hungry, it can be lured closer using any kind of food.

entry: 偏远的冻原上，北极迷宫曾神秘地一夜出现，其实是饥饿的POKENAME用巨颚啃穿冰层，留下的通道。它看不清，所以只沿直线，一路咬过去。
author: alindrome
source: Arctic labyrinths have been known to mysteriously appear overnight in remote tundras: these are actually the carved paths of hungry POKENAME, using its huge jaws to chomp through ice. It cannot see well, so it munches only in straight lines.

entry: POKENAME能像游水一样，游过沙子，再跃出，将猎物整个吞下。偶尔，它们会误吞刺球仙人掌，难受上几天。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are able to swim through sand as if it were water, leaping out to swallow their prey whole. Occasionally, these Pokémon will mistakenly swallow Cacnea, leaving them ill for a couple of days.

entry: POKENAME喜欢吃仙人掌，用长长的象鼻，慢慢啃食。厚甲不仅抵御危险，也让它吃仙人掌时，不会被刺伤。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME likes to feed on cacti, using its long trunk to slowly chomp away at it. Its thick carapace not only protects itself from danger but also allows it to munch on cacti without getting pricked.

entry: POKENAME滚过沙漠，留下的痕迹，像越野车的轮胎印。它主要白天活动，夜里则在沙下挖出的巢穴休息。
author: fiordaliso
source: When POKENAME rolls across the desert, it leaves behind tracks resembling the tire of an off-road vehicle. It is mainly active during the day, resting at night in its den dug beneath the sand.

entry: POKENAME滚过沙漠，留下的痕迹，像越野车的轮胎印。它主要白天活动，夜里则在沙下挖出的巢穴休息。
author: fiordaliso
source: When POKENAME rolls across the desert, it leaves behind tracks resembling the tire of an off-road vehicle. It is mainly active during the day, resting at night in its den dug beneath the sand.

entry: POKENAME从象鼻喷出沙柱，扰乱对手，再以威力惊人的冲锋，践踏敌人。双颚强大到连铁也能咬穿，丝毫不疼。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME blasts jets of sand from its trunk to disorient opponents before trampling them with devastating charges. Its jaws are so strong that it can bite through iron without feeling any pain.

entry: POKENAME沉入沙漠，完美模仿沙子的质感。猎物一从上方经过，它便钻出，用双颚咬住，拖入沙下。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME submerges itself in desert sand and perfectly mimics its texture. Should prey pass above, it emerges and drags them beneath the surface in its jaws.

entry: POKENAME向沙地吐出火舌，将其烧灼，阻止好斗的宝可梦靠近领地。吃树果时，它会用巨颚，将果实整个吞下。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME breathes tongues of fire onto the sand to scorch it, keeping aggressive Pokémon away from its territory. When it eats Berries, it swallows them whole within its enormous jaws.

entry: POKENAME在山中群居，挖出广阔的隧道与洞穴网络。强大的大颚，撕开坚石，就像撕开棉花糖一样轻松。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME live in colonies in the mountains, digging out vast networks of tunnels and caverns. Their powerful mandibles allow them to rip through hard stone as if it were cotton candy.

entry: 它们将大半身体埋进沙漠，只把头留在外面，观察并引诱猎物。对方一靠近，它们就钻出，用腹部的巨嘴，将其吞没。
author: infinex21
source: They will burrow most of their bodies with desert sands, their heads resting above to watch for, and lure in, prey. When prey draws near, they will emerge and engulf them within the large maw upon their bellies.

entry: POKENAME用树果作饵，试着诱捕其他宝可梦。不过，陷阱往往藏得太差，很难让什么东西，靠近到能下口的距离。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME attempts to trap other Pokémon using berries as lures. However, its traps are usually poorly hidden, so it has a difficult time luring anything close enough for it to deliver a bite.

entry: POKENAME在两张嘴里储存坚果，留作捕猎或战斗之用。它能奋力掷出坚果，也能一口气全扔出去，掩护逃跑。找不到坚果，就用石头代替。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME will store nuts within its two maws to use while hunting prey or in battle. It can throw these nuts with great force or will throw all of them at once to cover its escape. If it cannot find nuts, it will use rocks instead.

entry: POKENAME散出甜得发腻的气味，吸引虫子靠近，再用双颚夹住，尽情吞食。家养个体常被给予不变之石，免得在家中进食时进化。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME exudes a sickeningly sweet scent that attracts bugs close enough for the jaws to trap them and devour the meal. Domestic POKENAME tend to be given Everstones so that they do not evolve while feeding inside their homes.

entry: POKENAME在沙漠游荡，找到什么能吃的，就吃什么。它的胃能消化腐败食物，若在荒野发现遗弃的尸骸，便是极佳的食腐者。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME wanders the desert, eating anything and everything edible it can find. Since its stomach can handle rotten food, it makes for an excellent scavenger if it happens to find any abandoned carcasses in the wasteland.

entry: 野生POKENAME将自己埋入沙中，突袭无意间闯入领地的猎物。它们善于操纵磁力，能用沙子，迅速制造陷坑。
author: npshi
source: Wild POKENAME bury themselves in sand to surprise prey that unknowingly enter their territories. POKENAME can quickly create pit traps with sand using their efficient control over magnetism.

entry: POKENAME用爪子夹住对手，咬合力惊人。爪中还能射出大量热沙，灼伤并迷住对方的眼睛，使其无力躲开，接下来的擒拿。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's claws clamp down on opponents with a most impressive bite force. It can shoot out large amounts of heated sand from said claws to burn and blind others, rendering them helpless to avoid its next grapple.

entry: POKENAME虽然咬合力惊人，皮肤也坚韧，却异常胆怯。一有危险的迹象，它们就会钻入地下。
author: mepp.
source: Despite POKENAME having impressive bite strength and a tough hide, they are incredibly timid. They are known to burrow underground at the first sign of danger.

entry: POKENAME的巨颚力量惊人，空中速度也快，是不容小觑的对手。觅食时，它一边飞，一边疯狂咬合牙齿，岩石、草木，甚至倒霉的猎物，落进嘴里就吃。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's massively powerful jaws and aerial speed make it a force to be reckoned with. To feed, it flies around gnashing its teeth wildly, chomping down any rocks, foliage or unfortunate prey caught in its maw.

entry: POKENAME以整片冰原为食，用两根巨大的獠牙当铲，将沿途冰地送进巨嘴。摄取足够食物后，它便休眠，进化时，部分身体会变成纤巧的翅膀。
author: alindrome
source: POKENAME carves up entire ice plains to feed, using its two great tusks as scoops to funnel the landscape into its open maw. When it absorbs enough food, it will hibernate, parts of its body metamorphosing into delicate wings during evolution.

entry: POKENAME脸朝下伏在沙中，等猎物或水靠近，才翻过身来。它们感官敏锐，分得清该大口咬下食物，还是轻轻含咬训练家的手指。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME lie face-down in the sand, awaiting prey or water to be near before flipping over. They have heightened senses, allowing them to know whether to chomp down on food or gently nibble on their Trainer's fingers.

entry: POKENAME脸朝下伏在沙中，等猎物或水靠近，才翻过身来。翻身时，它会让沙子快速震动，使地形困住对手，展开战斗。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME lie face-down in the sand, awaiting prey or water to be near before flipping over. When it flips, it rapidly vibrates the sand, making the terrain trap their opponents for battle.

entry: POKENAME只吃仙人掌，背上的刺，因此呈现绿色。战斗时，尖刺十分有效：它先蜷成球，撞向对手，再狠狠咬下，造成重创。
author: evilgammon
source: The spines on POKENAME's back are green due to their diet of exclusively cactus plants. These spines are used to great effect in battle, with POKENAME curling into a ball and ramming its opponent, before delivering a devastating chomp.

entry: POKENAME太过怯弱、纤细，不敢主动寻找猎物。它便等小型飞虫宝可梦经过，张开嘴，用微弱的念动力，将它们拖进双颚。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is much too meek and frail to actively seek out and hunt food. Instead it waits for small flying insect Pokémon to cross its path, opening its mouth and using weak telekinesis to drag them into its jaws.

entry: POKENAME藏在仙人掌旁，伪装得与植物几乎一模一样。猎物一走近，它便突然使出突袭。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME hide by cacti, camouflaging to look near identical to the plants. When prey walk near, POKENAME strikes with a sudden Sucker Punch.

entry: POKENAME靠念动力，朝一个方向冲锋，沿途什么都咬。不过，它无法转向，因此常常撞上墙，或错过本来的目标。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME telekinetically charges in a direction, chomping down on anything in its path as it does so. It can't change directions, however, so often collides with a wall or misses its intended target.

entry: 小小的流沙地狱，将POKENAME束缚在楔石上。虽然行动受限，什么东西若靠得太近、太快，它仍会愤怒地磨牙，向其投掷沙子。
author: pkbonusducks
source: A small Sand Tomb binds POKENAME to their keystone. Though restricted, POKENAME will angrily gnash and throw sand at anything that gets too close too fast.

entry: 古时初次发现POKENAME，人们将它们视为奇特而好斗的沙漠部族。直到今天，这些群居、领地意识强、极其聪明的宝可梦，仍像一支沙漠部族。
author: dylonk25
source: When POKENAME were first discovered in ancient times, they were thought of as a peculiar and belligerent desert tribespeople. Social, territorial, and highly intelligent, they occupy essentially the same role today.

entry: POKENAME吃大岩石，强大的巨嘴，一下就能将其碾碎。不过，宝石有时会卡在嘴里，若无法弄出，它就会饿肚子。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME eats large rocks, instantly crushing them to pieces with its powerful maw. However, it will sometimes get gemstones stuck in its mouth, causing it to starve unless it can get them free.

entry: POKENAME钻入沙中，只露出背上丛生的多肉植物。植物有毒，几分钟内，就能引起麻痹与剧痛；中毒者，也就成了它们轻易到手的猎物。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME burrow themselves within sand, save for their formations of succulents on their backs. Their succulents are poisonous, causing paralysis and extreme pain in minutes; victims of their poison become nothing more than simple prey for them.

entry: 为了捕猎，它将身体埋在沙坑底部，露出后部的双颚。这样，身体能在沙中钻行，后颚则能抓住掉进陷阱的猎物。
author: hophoppip
source: To catch prey, it buries its body at the bottom of a sandy pit, keeping its rear jaws exposed. This allows it to tunnel through the sand with its body while its rear jaws snatch up prey that fall into its trap.

entry: POKENAME埋在沙漠里，一个月会吃下与自身体重相当的沙子。双颚张开的幅度，远比乍看大得多，一口，就能吞下大块沙漠地面。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME buries itself in the desert, eating its weight in sand over the course of a month. It can open its jaws far wider than a first glance would suggest, consuming huge chunks of the desert ground in a single bite.

entry: POKENAME的幼崽，藏在它背上的沙里，伏击小型猎物。它自己则偏爱用强大的双颚，攻击更大的猎物。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's babies hide in the sand on its back to ambush small prey. POKENAME itself prefers to attack larger prey with its powerful jaws.

entry: POKENAME常待在崎岖石山旁的树木附近，山和树都爬，锻炼攀登本领。它用巨颚，咬下大块树皮或岩石，获得养分。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME typically hangs around trees that border near craggy, rocky mountains. It scales both to keep its climbing skills strong, and gains nutrients by biting off huge chunks of bark or stone with its powerful jaws.

entry: 它用大耳朵，聆听任何危险的征兆，稍有声响，就全速奔逃。若被逼入绝境、无法逃跑，它便用强大的双颚，咬紧袭击者。
author: houseoffallingflowers
source: It uses its large ears to listen for any sign of danger, launching into a full sprint at the slightest sound. If cornered and unable to run, it will clamp down on its attacker with its powerful jaws instead.

entry: POKENAME喜欢用尖尖的手臂，在沙漠家园的沙地上画图形。有时，它会画出食物，再对着这顿想象中的美餐，大咬一口。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME enjoys using its pointed arms to draw shapes in the sands of its desert home. Sometimes it will draw a picture of food, and then take a big bite of the imaginary meal.

entry: 这种宝可梦像大颚蚁一样，在自己挖出的沙坑底，等候猎物。转动齿轮，能让附近沙子形成强大的内吸漩涡，凡是不会飞的，都会被卷进等候的巨嘴。
author: fireblade141
source: Like Trapinch, this Pokémon waits for prey at the bottom of sand pits it digs. Rotating its gears allows it to create a very strong inward-pulling vortex out of nearby sand, guaranteeing that anything that can't fly is pulled into its waiting maw.

entry: POKENAME用飘带般的触须，放出安抚心神的气息，引来猎物，再以大颚咬住，使其失去行动能力。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME emits a soothing aura from its ribbonlike feelers to lure in its prey. It then uses its big jaw to bite into its prey, neutralizing them.

entry: POKENAME制造的漩涡，极其致命，几乎无法脱身。猎物一被吸过中心，就会被它整个吞下。
author: bobosmith01
source: The whirlpools POKENAME creates are extremely deadly and are nearly impossible to get out of. Prey sucked through the center are swallowed whole by POKENAME.

entry: 沙漠地区，发现过几座供奉POKENAME的神庙。里面记载，亵渎它的人，会受到惩罚，被吸入沙坑，放逐到另一个时代。
author: sk372
source: A few temples dedicated to POKENAME have been discovered in desert areas. Tales written within say that those who blasphemed it would be punished, sucked into sand pits that banished them to another time.

entry: POKENAME大范围操纵周围的沙子，移动沙丘，制造巨大的陷坑，困住许多其他宝可梦。它不直接伤害它们，设陷阱似乎出于本能，也可能只是为了取乐。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME controls sand on a vast scale around itself, moving sand dunes and creating colossal pits that trap many other Pokémon. It doesn't directly harm these Pokémon and seems to trap them out of instinct, or possibly for amusement.

entry: POKENAME大范围操纵周围的沙子，移动沙丘，制造巨大的陷坑，困住许多其他宝可梦。它不直接伤害它们，设陷阱似乎出于本能，也可能只是为了取乐。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME controls sand on a vast scale around itself, moving sand dunes and creating colossal pits that trap many other Pokémon. It doesn't directly harm these Pokémon and seems to trap them out of instinct, or possibly for amusement.

entry: POKENAME只出现在沙漠与台地状的地区。它产生的沙子，会被用来治疗失眠。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME can only be found in desert and mesa-like areas. The sand it generates is used to cure insomnia.

entry: POKENAME能从背部与手臂的炮中，发射大颚蚁，咬住远处的敌人。它与身边的一群大颚蚁，会合作制服猎物。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME can fire Trapinch from the cannons on its back and arms, enabling them to bite distant foes. POKENAME and its pack of Trapinch will work together to bring down prey.

entry: POKENAME完全看不见，因此演化出了感知地面微弱震动的能力，借此判断周围环境。不过，这只对移动的东西有效，所以它仍经常撞上障碍物。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is completely blind, so it has adapted to detect slight vibrations in the earth to determine its surroundings. However, this only works on moving objects, so POKENAME is often running into things.

entry: POKENAME一饿，就会烦躁得让电火花，在深色鬃毛间噼啪跳动。它与族群一起，布下可怕的埋伏，袭击冒险进入沙丘的旅人。
author: fiordaliso
source: When POKENAME is hungry, it becomes so agitated that electric sparks crackle through its dark mane. Together with its pack, POKENAME sets terrible ambushes for travelers who venture into the desert dunes.

entry: POKENAME用强大的双颚，钻穿岩石，为自己凿出小洞安家。挖掘时，坚韧的甲壳，能保护它免受落石碎屑伤害。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME uses its strong jaws to tunnel through rock, making itself a small cave to nest in. Its tough carapace is able to protect it from falling debris while it digs.

entry: 大颚蚁之间融合，会形成POKENAME，在沙漠制造巨大的流沙陷阱。它们的咬击，能刺穿甚至咬断钢铁，对沙漠旅行构成极大危险。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Fusions between Trapinch result in POKENAME, which are Pokémon that create gigantic sand traps in the desert. They have a bite that can penetrate or break steel, making them a major hazard for desert travel.

entry: POKENAME的双颚大得能同时载着好几只未融合的大颚蚁，在沙漠中很常见。人们认为，这是本能，能保障同伴的生存。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME's jaws are large enough to carry several unfused Trapinch at once, which is a common sight in deserts. It's thought they do this out of instinct, ensuring the survivability of their fellows.

entry: POKENAME偏爱留在流沙陷阱里，用新长出的翅膀，震动周围沙子，引来更强的猎物。不过，若眼下的猎场逐渐枯竭，它如今也会另寻更理想的地方。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME prefers to stay in its sand trap, now using its newly grown wings to lure in stronger prey by vibrating the surrounding sand. However, it will now search for more optimal hunting areas if its current spot is drying up.

entry: POKENAME在地下群居，用强壮的双颚，啃穿厚厚的岩石。不过，它们几乎全盲，坚固的头骨，能让它们撞上东西时，不至受伤。
author: mistymagius
source: Colonies of POKENAME live underground, chewing the thick stone with their powerful jaws. However, they are almost completely blind, so their durable skulls prevent injuries when they eventually run into something.

entry: 它经常在食物里，添些小石块与泥土。矿物储存在尾巴中，可以从尾尖的尘暴里射出，用于自卫。
author: sk372
source: It regularly adds small bits of stone and dirt to its meals when it eats. The minerals get stored within its tail, and can be shot from the dust storm at its tip as a means of self-defense.

entry: POKENAME的双颚，相比身体其他部分，宽得过头，因此常试着吞下胃装不下的猎物。为免猎获被食腐者抢走，它会带着猎物，一同埋进沙里。
author: lucioleuh
source: POKENAME's jaws are so wide compared to the rest of its body that it often tries to swallow prey too big for its stomach. To avoid getting its game stolen by scavengers, it will bury itself with it in the sand.

entry: 凝视POKENAME奇异宝石的人，会被其中某种事物迷住，忍不住一步步靠近，也离它强大的双颚，越来越近。
author: sk372
source: Those that gaze into POKENAME's strange jewel find themselves compelled to step closer, entranced by something within that draws them nearer, and closer to its powerful jaws.

entry: POKENAME藏在沙中，假装成大颚蚁，吓退其他宝可梦。咬合力虽然远不及大颚蚁，却仍足以压碎小石头。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME hides in the sand, pretending to be a Trapinch to scare away other Pokémon. While its bite force is nowhere near as strong as Trapinch, it is still strong enough to crush small stones.

entry: POKENAME吃得越多，体型就越大，尤其是吃活猎物时。人们认为，猎物的灵魂，能提供大量尚未发现的养分。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME grows bigger the more it eats, but especially so when it eats living prey. It is thought that the prey's soul gives POKENAME tons of nutrients that are yet to be discovered.

entry: POKENAME以沙漠里的热沙为食，独特的胃，能从中吸收养分。这一过程，也会积蓄热量，使它偶尔打嗝，喷出火焰。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME's diet consists of hot desert sand, with a unique stomach that can absorb nutrients from it. It builds up heat as a byproduct of this process, occasionally belching flames.

entry: POKENAME的几丁质外壳虽然薄，却极善群体捕猎。凭数量优势与强大的双颚，它们能对付远比自己巨大的猎物。狩猎间歇，便退到高草的阴影下，躲避正午烈日。
author: mr._casket
source: Despite their thin chitinous shells, POKENAME are great pack hunters. Their numerical advantage and powerful jaws allow them to tackle prey far larger than themselves. Between hunts, they retreat into the shade of tall grass to escape the midday sun.

entry: 它的触角，能接收各种频率，连人耳无法察觉的，也不例外。受威胁时，它会震动触角，发出让大多数其他宝可梦痛苦的尖声。
author: mistymagius
source: Its antennae can pick up all types of frequencies, even ones undetectable by the human ear. When threatened, it will vibrate its antennae to create a high-pitched sound that is painful to most other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME大多藏在洞里或沙下，等待沙暴，再成群出猎。饿极时，它们可能用起风、顺风，试着制造沙暴；最强的个体，甚至能用暴风。
author: lucioleuh
source: POKENAME spends most of its time hidden in caves or under sand, waiting for a sandstorm to go out and hunt in a flock. When starving, it may try to cause one by using moves like Gust, Tailwind, or, for the strongest, Hurricane.

entry: POKENAME几乎整个身体，都是巨大而强有力的双颚。咬紧猎物的力量，足以使周围地面，发生轻微震动。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's body is almost entirely comprised of its enormous, powerful jaws. The force with which it clamps down on prey is enough to cast small tremors in the surrounding area.

entry: 它用颚状的触手将猎物撕碎，尤其爱追捕大舌贝等硬壳宝可梦，因为享受设法咬碎外壳的挑战。
author: mistymagius
source: It uses its jaw-like tentacles to rip its prey to shreds. It goes after hard-shelled Pokémon, such as Shellder, since it enjoys the challenge of trying to crush their shells.
