entry: 强大的双颚，是POKENAME在擂台上的最大优势。凭咬合力，它能轻松压制、擒拿对手，甚至将对方抛来抛去。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's powerful jaws are its greatest asset in the ring. With the power of its bite it can pin, grapple, and even throw around opponents with ease.

entry: POKENAME吞下大量沙子，储存在体内。需要自卫时，它会从尖刺下的孔洞，喷出汹涌沙流，将体表的刺，推进射出。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME swallows large amounts of sand to store within its body. When it needs to defend itself, it propels the spines on its body via releasing torrents of sand from the pores beneath them.

entry: POKENAME每次张口进食，双颚都会向空中，释放许多真菌孢子。惊人的食欲，让它不断吃，也不断在干旱的家园，播散孢子。
author: sk372
source: Whenever POKENAME opens its mouth to feed, its jaws release a number of fungal spores into the air. Its ravenous appetite means it is constantly eating and spreading the spores around its arid home.

entry: POKENAME背上的沙，掩护它埋伏，突袭猎物。身上的仙人掌，虽然能提供一些养分，却要靠它吃下的食物，汲取水分。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's sandy back conceals it as it lies in wait to ambush prey. While the cacti on its body provide it with some nutrients, they rely on water drawn from whatever POKENAME eats.

entry: 成群的POKENAME挖掘巨大隧道，在偏僻的沙漠，构成广阔网络。若有一只与群体走散，就会用尾巴拍地，发出同伴能通过震动察觉的闷响。
author: evilgammon
source: Groups of POKENAME dig huge tunnels, creating vast networks in isolated deserts. If one is separated from the group, it slams its tail on the ground, creating thumps the others can sense through tremors.

entry: POKENAME疾行的速度，足以在沙中灵活移动。若非触角在行进时露出沙面，根本不会被察觉。它们钻出，扑向弱小猎物，一遇反抗，却会迅速逃走。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME scurry quickly enough that they can move well in sand. If not for their antennae protruding from the sand as they move, they would go entirely unnoticed. They surface to pounce upon weak prey but will quickly flee if met with resistance.

entry: POKENAME头上的仙人掌，提供沙漠生活所需的重要养分与水分。作为回报，它会用巨爪修剪，悉心照料仙人掌。
author: casinosluck
source: The cactus on POKENAME's head supplies important nutrients and hydration for living in the desert. In turn, it will take care of the cactus, pruning it with its large claws.

entry: POKENAME背上的仙人掌，提供全部所需养分，因此不必捕猎。它用利爪和双颚，向下挖到水源，也保护植物，免遭其他宝可梦啃食。
author: .jerden
source: The cactus on POKENAME's back provides it with all the nutrition it needs, so it has no need to hunt. It uses its sharp claws and jaws to dig until it reaches water and to protect the plant from any other Pokémon that try to feed on it.

entry: POKENAME在海底喷出一柱柱泡泡，装作热泉喷口。由于真正的喷口，生长着维系生命的细菌，它便借此，骗来其他宝可梦。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME disguises itself as a hydrothermal vent by spewing out columns of bubbles on the seafloor. As these vents host vital bacteria, POKENAME tricks other Pokémon into approaching it.

entry: 它们在绿洲附近设猎场，捕捉口渴或疲倦的宝可梦。POKENAME从藏处跃出，猛咬一口；若没得手，便像海市蜃楼般，消失在沙云中，耐心等待下次机会。
author: icelevelincarnate
source: They make their hunting grounds near oases, preying on thirsty or tired Pokémon. POKENAME then leap out of hiding and strike with a bite, but if this fails, they'll vanish in a cloud of sand like a mirage and patiently wait to try again.

entry: POKENAME白天埋在沙丘里，等待其他宝可梦经过，发动伏击。夜里，它用大翅膀抖开沙子，飞过黑暗，为清晨寻找新的藏身处。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME bury themselves within sand dunes during the day and wait for other Pokémon to pass by so they can ambush them. At night, they shake themselves free with their large wings, flying through the dark to find a new hiding spot for the morning.

entry: POKENAME潜伏在沙丘下，只有沙云般的手臂留在地面。蟹钳般的爪子合拢，像是果实，诱来毫无防备的猎物，再将其抓住，拖入沙下。
author: silentscript89
source: POKENAME lurks beneath desert dunes, with only its sandcloud arms remaining above ground. Its crab-like claws resemble fruit when closed, luring unsuspecting prey that wander too close before they are seized and dragged beneath the sand.

entry: POKENAME不停吃沙、岩石与泥土，收集的矿物，滋养头上生长的果实。它乐于分享，不过果实又干又酸，得吃惯了，才懂欣赏。
author: sk372
source: The minerals POKENAME gathers from constantly eating sand, rocks and dirt nourishes the fruit growing on its head. It is happy to share the fruit it grows, but it is an acquired taste due to its dry and sour flavor.

entry: POKENAME白天埋在沙丘里，等待其他宝可梦经过，发动伏击。夜里，它用大翅膀抖开沙子，飞过黑暗，为清晨寻找新的藏身处。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME bury themselves within sand dunes during the day and wait for other Pokémon to pass by so they can ambush them. At night, they shake themselves free with their large wings, flying through the dark to find a new hiding spot for the morning.

entry: 沙漠中若遇见玻璃碎片，务必小心：那是POKENAME钻地时，炽热尾巴留下的痕迹，说明附近有流沙陷阱。
author: craigprime
source: Be wary if you stumble upon shards of glass in the desert; it's a telltale sign of a sand trap nearby, created by the blazing tail of a POKENAME as it burrowed into the ground.

entry: 三个头配合双颚，迅速挖出隧道。颚的力量极大，让POKENAME连其他穴居者无法钻穿的坚实石壁，也能挖开。
author: sk372
source: The three heads work in tandem to quickly dig out tunnels with their jaws. Because these jaws are so powerful, POKENAME can dig through solid stone walls other cave-diggers cannot.

entry: POKENAME越过沙丘，在沙漠潜行觅食，用胡须感知沙中细微的震动。猎物一靠近，它们便大嘴朝前，猛扑过去，使出凶狠的咬住。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME stalk through deserts in search of prey, prowling across sand dunes and feeling minute vibrations in the sand through their whiskers. When they sense prey approaching, they pounce mouth-first, delivering a nasty Bite.

entry: POKENAME吃沙子，分散对头痛的注意。若进食时，突然发作格外剧烈的偏头痛，就会向四周喷出沙子。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME eats sand in order to help take its mind off the pain in its head. If a particularly painful migraine occurs while it eats, it winds up spewing sand all around it.

entry: POKENAME越生气，就越用力磨牙，发出碾磨般的低吼。狂怒时，它一口下去，轻易就能咬碎厚重的石头。
author: sk372
source: The angrier POKENAME gets, the more it gnashes its teeth together and makes a grinding, growling noise. When raging, it bites with enough force to shatter thick stone with ease.

entry: POKENAME的牙齿，强得能咬穿钢铁。够得着什么，它们就抓什么，只要塞得进嘴，就会咬下去。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME teeth are strong enough to bite through steel. They grab onto anything they can within reach, biting on whatever fits into their mouth.

entry: POKENAME生活在泥泞的池水里，藏进岸边柔软的淤泥，躲避捕食者。它们很容易受惊，什么东西一走近，就会狠狠咬住。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME live in muddy pond waters, hiding away from predators in the soft silt near the banks of the pond. They are easily startled, biting hard into anything that steps near them.

entry: POKENAME生活在泥泞的池水里，藏进岸边柔软的淤泥，躲避捕食者。它们很容易受惊，什么东西一走近，就会狠狠咬住。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME live in muddy pond waters, hiding away from predators in the soft silt near the banks of the pond. They are easily startled, biting hard into anything that steps near them.

entry: POKENAME整天在绿洲家园周围，挖掘陷坑。可它们总忘记挖在哪里，常常自己掉进去，整个晚上，都忙着往外爬。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME spend all day digging pitfalls around the oases they call home. They are prone to forgetting where they've dug them, often causing POKENAME to fall into one and spend their evening climbing back out.

entry: POKENAME的颚，力量惊人，一口就能将砖块碾成粉末。建筑工人害怕它出现，确实有其道理。
author: jaminmcready
source: A POKENAME's jaw is so powerful, it can turn Bricks to dust with a single crunch. Construction workers fear its presence for good reason.

entry: POKENAME藏在管道与洞中，一动不动，等待毫无防备的猎物。虽然扎根原地，茎却能伸得出奇地远，发出强力咬击。一察觉危险，它就本能地缩回藏处。
author: dimentio240512
source: POKENAME lurks inside pipes and holes waiting motionless for unsuspecting prey. Although rooted in place, it can stretch its stem surprisingly far to deliver powerful bites. It instinctively retreats into its hiding place whenever it senses danger.

entry: POKENAME够得着什么，就啃什么，不论食物，还是大岩石。它在栖身绿洲附近的沙地，设下陷阱，捕捉其他宝可梦。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME gnaws on anything within reach, whether that's food or even large rocks. It sets traps for other Pokémon in the sands near the oases where it shelters.

entry: 它住在管道和盆里，什么东西靠得太近，就张口咬去。园丁会十分小心地使用POKENAME，保护花园，抵御各种威胁。
author: bandedbodypress
source: It lives in pipes and pots, snapping at whatever gets too close. Gardeners use POKENAME very carefully to protect their garden from any threats.

entry: POKENAME捕猎时，会将藤蔓绕住树，向后拉紧。一放松，藤蔓便猛地弹回，将它甩向空中，扑向目标。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME hunts by wrapping its vine around a tree and pulling back. When it relaxes, its vine will snap, and POKENAME will be flung through the air at its target.

entry: POKENAME有时会捡起遗失的太阳镜戴上，保护眼睛，免受沙漠强光刺激。不过，圆圆的脸上，眼镜总戴不端正。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME sometimes picks up and wears lost sunglasses to protect its eyes from the bright desert sun. The glasses don't sit right on the fusion's round face.

entry: 两颗头都贪婪地吃沙漠里的沙子，还会争抢食物。POKENAME战斗时，也不协调，两头总朝着完全相反的方向，咬过去。
author: evilgammon
source: Both heads ravenously eat their diet of desert sand, fighting over their meals. POKENAME is also uncoordinated in battle, with both heads biting in completely opposite directions.

entry: 它始终保持同一个表情，让人很难一眼判断心情。不过，POKENAME开心时，会用沙子塑出尾巴的形状，欢快地拍掌。
author: sk372
source: It retains the same expression on its face, making it difficult to ascertain its mood at a glance, but when happy, POKENAME will form the shape of a tail with sand and clap with joy.

entry: POKENAME偏爱栖居在红沙的沙漠，与周围环境，融为一体。猎物往往，就这样径直掉进它嘴里。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's preferred habitat is deserts with red sand. There, it blends in perfectly with its surroundings, and prey falls right into its mouth.

entry: POKENAME有各种颜色，对应不同沙漠的沙色。它们与环境毫无破绽地融为一体，使猎物轻易就掉入陷阱。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME come in a variety of colors that match the sands of various deserts. They blend in seamlessly with their environment, making it easy for prey to fall into their trap.

entry: POKENAME用强壮的双颚，吃掉死去的珊瑚，为新珊瑚腾出空间。它们钻进沙里睡觉，需要捕猎鱼类宝可梦时，也会用同样的洞，作为伏击点。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME use their strong jaws to eat dead coral, clearing space for new coral to grow. They burrow into the sand to sleep, using the same burrows as ambush points to hunt fish Pokémon when needed.

entry: 它的巨嘴能张得很大，一次吃下大量泥土。建筑公司开始请POKENAME帮忙挖掘，改造地块，以供开发。
author: sk372
source: Its maw can open up wide to allow it to consume large quantities of dirt at a time. Construction companies have taken to using POKENAME to help dig and reshape plots of land for development.

entry: POKENAME虽然体型庞大，在沙漠中钻行的速度，却快得惊人。它伏在沙下，随后深深吸气，制造流沙陷阱，将毫无防备的猎物吸入。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can burrow through the desert sands at a surprisingly quick pace in spite of its size. It lies in wait beneath the surface before inhaling deeply, creating sand traps that suck in unsuspecting prey.

entry: POKENAME全身覆上黏液，能滚上电杆，再爬到电线上。借附近的电流，它能长时间悬在线上，轻松击落鸟类宝可梦，作为猎物。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME covers itself in a sticky fluid that allows it to roll up poles and onto power lines. Thanks to the nearby electrical current, it can stay suspended on the line for long periods of time and easily strike down its prey: bird Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME的几个头，用头顶叶片传递的一连串独特震动，互相交流。若争着说话，震动就会更剧烈。热带沙漠中，常能见到它们。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME's heads communicate with one another through a unique series of vibrations sent through the leaves on their head. If the heads try to talk over each other, the vibrations become more intense. They are a common sight in tropical deserts.

entry: POKENAME冲锋时难以转向，便快速振翅，发出令人头痛的声波，使目标晕眩。只要帮它挠挠甲片之间，就很容易赢得信任。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME vibrates its wings rapidly to generate headache inducing sonic waves to stun its target since it has a hard time changing direction while charging. It is easy to gain POKENAME's trust by scratching it between its plate armor.

entry: 战斗中，它的双臂高速震动，足以击碎岩石。幼小的POKENAME吸取受害者体液时，有时忘了停止震动，弄得一片恶心狼藉。
author: h0bojoe
source: In battle, it vibrates arms at frequencies strong enough to break stone. Young POKENAME sometimes forget to stop vibrating while draining its victim's fluids, leading to disgusting messes.

entry: POKENAME在地下钻行，如同在水中游泳，不断蜕落细微的鳞片。这些鳞片，有极佳的声学特性，是制作乐器的珍贵材料。
author: quietcognition
source: A POKENAME burrows through the ground like it is swimming through water, constantly shedding microscopic scales. The scales have remarkable acoustic properties and are a prized material for making instruments.

entry: 沙漠众多的地区，常请POKENAME协助搜救队。它能在沙暴中看清道路、迅速行进，也能承受热浪；找到迷途者后，还会驱散恶劣天气。
author: pkbonusducks
source: In desert-rich areas, POKENAME are often employed to aid search and rescue teams. They're able to quickly navigate while seeing clearly through sandstorms and withstanding heatwaves, repelling the terrible weather after locating lost individuals.

entry: POKENAME快速振翅，产生独特的频率，吸引虫属性宝可梦。常能看见一只POKENAME飞行，后面跟着大群迷恋这声音的虫属性宝可梦。
author: sk372
source: The beat of POKENAME's wings flapping rapidly creates a unique frequency that attracts Bug-type Pokémon. It is fairly common to see a flying POKENAME followed by throngs of Bug-type Pokémon enamored by its noises.

entry: 野生POKENAME把蛋埋在极深的地下，可能数年以后，才会孵化。它们的同族，能够各自独立生存。
author: bobosmith01
source: In the wild, POKENAME bury their Eggs extremely far underground. The Eggs can hatch years later; POKENAME's brethren survive independently.

entry: POKENAME睡觉时，翅膀会生长，白天却逐渐缩小。因此，越懒惰的个体，翅膀反而越大，却越不擅长飞行。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME's wings grow as they sleep but gradually shrink during the day. This means that lazier POKENAME have larger wings, though they are less adept at flight.

entry: POKENAME睡觉时，会轻轻摩擦翅膀，释放超声波。这能刺激皮肤孔洞，产生促进翅膀生长的黏液，不过，黏液对其他宝可梦有毒。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: As POKENAME sleeps, it gently rubs it wings together, loosing ultrasonic waves. This stimulates pores on its skin to produce a sticky substance that encourages the wings to grow. This substance is toxic to other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME高速振翅，羽毛嗡嗡作响。它滑过热带草原，扫视高草中的动静，再俯冲而下。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's feathers buzz as its wings flap at high speed. It glides over savannahs, scanning the tall grass for movement before diving.

entry: POKENAME生性害羞，藏在新雪里，避免与其他生灵冲突。受威胁时，它会疯狂拍动背上的翅膀，产生强烈震动，可能引发危险的雪崩。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is a shy creature that hides in fresh snow to avoid conflicts with other beings. When threatened, it flaps the wings on its back frantically, creating powerful vibrations that can trigger dangerous avalanches.

entry: 它将所有翅膀，完全同步地拍动，产生冰冷的粉末，能冻结前方一切。蓬松的毛发，连眼睛都盖住了，POKENAME便靠触角探知震动，在雪地辨路。
author: fiordaliso
source: By flapping all its wings in perfect unison, it generates a frosty powder capable of freezing anything in its way. Since its fluffy coat covers even its eyes, POKENAME navigates snowy environments using the vibrations it detects through its antennae.

entry: POKENAME从沙漠跃出，捕食飞虫。鳍会释放超声波，吸引大颚蚁，它便将它们带在身旁，一起进食。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME leaps from desert sands and feeds on flying insects it catches. Its fins emit ultrasonic waves that attract Trapinch that it carries along to share its feeding time with.

entry: 与许多阿柏蛇的融合体不同，POKENAME震动尾巴，表示开心，而非恐惧或敌意。不过，训练家仍须留心；过于兴奋时，尾巴产生的声波震动，甚至会损坏窗户。
author: sk372
source: Unlike many Ekans fusions, POKENAME vibrates its tail to signify joy rather than fear or aggression. Trainers should take caution, however; an overjoyed POKENAME may shake its tail enough to cause damage to windows via the sonic vibrations.

entry: 白茫茫的暴风雪中，有时能听见POKENAME在头顶侦察时，发出的超声嗡鸣。它们演化出了雪镜般的保护膜，挡住浓毛，避免遮眼，因此视野再差，也能敏锐看清。
author: alindrome
source: In whiteout blizzards, you can sometimes hear ultrasonic buzzing from POKENAME scouting overhead. They have evolved perfect acuity in low-visibility conditions using protective ski goggle-like membranes that keep the thick fur out of their eyes.

entry: POKENAME振翅的震动，能制造沙暴。手臂上的刀刃，也能快速震动，增强切割能力。
author: cait_sith
source: The vibrations from POKENAME's wingbeats can create sandstorms. The blades on its arms can vibrate rapidly as well, increasing their cutting ability.

entry: 战斗中，POKENAME震动鳞片，扬起周围的沙子，让小小的沙暴，掩护自己。趁对手分神，它灵巧地在空中穿梭，迅速劈斩。
author: mistymagius
source: In combat, POKENAME vibrates its scales to stir up the surrounding sand, cloaking it in a small sandstorm. It nimbly darts through the air, quickly slashing its opponents while they are distracted.

entry: POKENAME能够完美融入沙漠的沙子。只有确定不会暴露藏处，它才会释放超声波。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME has the ability to perfectly blend into the desert sands. It only releases ultrasonic waves when its cover is certain not to be blown.

entry: POKENAME背上的仙人掌，会结出带刺、却富含养分的果实。它将果实整个吃下，战斗时，再将带倒钩的种子吐出，当作投射武器。
author: kungfucutbug
source: The cactus on POKENAME's back produces prickly but nutrient-rich fruit. POKENAME will eat these fruits whole, then spit out the barbed seeds as projectiles in battle.

entry: POKENAME大多时间，都藏在沙漠的沙里。只需极少食物，就能维生数周，因此很少回到地面。若被发现，它们就会快速振翅，扬沙，遮住旁人的视线。
author: _pixelar_
source: POKENAME live most of their time hiding in the sand of a desert. They rarely return to the surface, as they can live on minimal food for weeks at a time. If spotted, they will rapidly flap their wings to kick up sand to obscure others' vision.

entry: POKENAME察觉灾难将至，就赶往最近的人类聚居处，摩擦双翼，发出嗡鸣。危机类型不同，声音的高低与节奏，也各不相同。
author: sk372
source: After sensing an incoming disaster, POKENAME rushes to the nearest civilization and rubs its wings together to create a humming noise. It has different pitches and patterns of noises depending on the type of crisis approaching.

entry: POKENAME对震动极其敏感，任何宝可梦碰到背部，连同背上的树，都能察觉。若对方造成损伤，它便会胡乱甩动身体，将其抖落。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME is highly sensitive to vibrations. It can feel any Pokémon that touches its back, including its tree, and will flail around to knock off any Pokémon that cause damage.

entry: POKENAME用全身的黑毛，储存静电，释放强大的电击。在栖居的沙漠中，常能从沙子熔成玻璃的地方，发现它经过的痕迹。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME uses the black fur covering its body to store static energy and unleash powerful electric attacks. In the deserts where it dwells, traces of its passage can often be found in the spots where sand has been fused into glass.

entry: POKENAME摩擦翅膀，发出悦耳的声音。它们也能制造使人晕头转向的声波，平息或吓退潜在的威胁。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME create pleasing sounds by rubbing their wings together. They can create disorienting sonic waves to quell or deter potential threats, as well.

entry: POKENAME高速振翅，以强烈震动，轰击附近的宝可梦。若背部装入合适的卡带，它还能用这些冲击波发电，或点燃附近的物件。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME can flap its wings at high speed to blast nearby Pokémon with powerful vibrations. If the right Drive is installed into its back, POKENAME can use these shockwaves to generate electricity or set nearby objects on fire.

entry: POKENAME振翅极快，能卷起小小的沙龙卷，攻击并扰乱敌人。不过，它们更出名的，是求偶表演：移动沙子，在巢周围，绘出巨大复杂的图案，吸引伴侣。
author: _pixelar_
source: POKENAME can flap their wings fast enough to kick up small sand tornadoes to attack and disorient foes. Yet this species is more well known for their mating displays, moving sand to draw giant intricate patterns around their nests to impress mates.

entry: POKENAME在沙漠安家，埋在沙下。它们钻到仙人掌底下，用酸性黏液，慢慢掏空内部，再住进去。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME make their homes in deserts, buried beneath the sand. Burrowing beneath cacti, these Pokémon use their acidic mucus to slowly hollow them out, using them as homes.

entry: 比预期更早长出翅膀，使大颚蚁更加灵活，食欲也更旺盛。它飞在空中，疯狂咬合双颚，吞食飞虫。
author: sk372
source: Forming wings earlier than expected has given Trapinch more mobility, and a stronger appetite. It flies through the air, chomping wildly as it consumes flying insects.

entry: POKENAME的翅膀，会呈现当地主要地质的特征，带着美丽的水晶光泽。宝可梦巡护员必须保持警惕，保护族群，免遭偷猎。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have wings that take on aspects of the dominant local geology. They have a beautiful crystal sheen. Pokémon Rangers have to remain vigilant to ensure their populations are not poached.

entry: POKENAME虽有能正常活动的翅膀，却还不会飞。它仍常常练习，翅膀扑动，嗡嗡作响，身体却头朝下，坠向地面。
author: sk372
source: Despite having functional wings, POKENAME is not yet able to fly. It still practices often, its wings flapping and buzzing loudly as it plummets head-first to the ground below.

entry: POKENAME必须不断让沙子，围绕尾巴旋转，才能生存。空气中的任何水分，都会让沙子变重，因此它偏爱干旱气候，那里沙子轻盈，又充足。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME needs to constantly keep sand swirling around its tail to survive. Any moisture in the air makes sand heavy, so it prefers arid climates where sand is light and abundant.

entry: POKENAME挖掘时，会拍动翅膀，将沙子扬向空中。猎物被迷住眼睛后，它就从下方，用能碾碎猎物的双颚，发动袭击。
author: .izik
source: While digging, POKENAME flaps its wings to throw sand into the air. Once prey is blinded, it strikes with crushing jaws from below.

entry: POKENAME被古代遗址吸引，在石墓的柱子里筑巢。它飞掠遗迹，用定身法，拦截闯入者。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME nests in stone tomb pillars, drawn to ancient sites. It streaks through the ruins to intercept intruders with Disable.

entry: POKENAME飞行时，双翼快速运动，消耗大量能量，因此常得从更大的生灵身上，吸食静电。刚吃饱、充足了电，它便能以惊人的速度起飞。
author: sk372
source: The rapid movement of POKENAME's wings for flying takes a lot of energy, so it needs to feed on static electricity from larger beings often. It takes off at startling speeds once it has topped itself off from a recent meal.

entry: 古代医者，曾用POKENAME穿越险恶地形，运送膏药。许多积尘的卷轴，都提到它在失传疗法中的作用。
author: .izik
source: Ancient healers once used POKENAME to deliver poultices across harsh terrain. Many dusty scrolls reference its role in forgotten remedies.

entry: 即将攻击前，POKENAME的翅膀，会震动成一片火红的模糊残影。释放的一阵阵热量，强得能轻易熔化砂岩。
author: .izik
source: Just before attacking, POKENAME's wings vibrate in a fiery blur. It releases bursts of heat strong enough to melt sandstone with ease.

entry: POKENAME快速振翅，产生超声波，使猎物晕眩、迷乱。如此制服以后，它便能轻松俯冲而下，吸饱鲜血。
author: sk372
source: Ultrasonic waves generated from POKENAME's quick flapping stun and disorient prey. Once they've been subdued this way, they're easy pickings for POKENAME to swoop down and drink its fill of blood.

entry: POKENAME用敏感的触角，早早察觉天气将变的微妙征兆。暴雨来临之前，常能看见它们成群聚集。
author: mepp.
source: Using its sensitive antenna, POKENAME can sense subtle changes in the weather long before they occur. Groups of the Pokémon can be seen gathering right before rainstorms.

entry: 只有翅膀与脊柱不是由无定形黏液构成。它以特定频率振翅，就能调整身体密度，变得比钢铁更硬。
author: staghorn
source: Its wings and spinal column are the only parts of its body that aren't composed of amorphous slime. By vibrating its wings at specific frequencies, it can adjust the density of its body to become harder than steel.

entry: POKENAME的翅膀，实际是坚韧的叶片，摸起来像砂纸。眼睛覆着厚膜，让它即使身处猛烈沙暴，也能看清。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's wings are actually tough leaves that feel like sandpaper. Its eyes are covered in a thick film that allows it to see clearly even in harsh sandstorms.

entry: 沙漠里若形成龙卷风，很可能是POKENAME正在原地旋转，玩得开心。卷入的训练家，会被抛向最近的绿洲。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: When tornadoes form in the desert, it's likely POKENAME having fun spinning in place. Trainers sucked in find themselves flung towards the nearest oasis.

entry: 吸收足够阳光后，POKENAME头上的花苞，便会打开。随后，它振翅发出嗡鸣，吸引虫子靠近，为花朵授粉。
author: sk372
source: After soaking up enough sunlight, the bud on POKENAME's head opens. Once it does, it vibrates its wings to create a hum that draws insects near to pollinate the flower.

entry: POKENAME白天埋在沙下，躲避沙漠烈日。日落时，整群一同现身，起飞觅食，振翅的嗡鸣，充满夜空。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME shelter from the desert sun by burying themselves under the sands during the day. Entire swarms emerge at once at sunset, the buzzing of their wings filling the night air as they take off in search of food.

entry: POKENAME同时拍动四翼，产生大量摩擦，使周围空气升温。再加上家乡沙漠的热沙，它甚至不必靠近，也能灼伤敌人。
author: .realthree
source: When POKENAME beats its four wings together, it generates a lot of friction to heat the air around it. This, when coupled with the heated sands of its desert home, can burn POKENAME's foes without it even approaching them.

entry: POKENAME用翅膀般的附属物，弄塌身后的隧道，阻拦捕食者。即使身在地下，触角也能感知空气中的震动，让它安全浮上地面，寻找食物。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME's wing-like appendages collapse tunnels behind it to deter predators. Its antennae sense vibrations even in the air when underground, allowing it to surface safely and forage for food.

entry: POKENAME用利爪抓挠时，会产生音乐般的震动，使敌人晕眩。主人还另有收获，能享受它格外亲昵的呼噜声。
author: palmer5628
source: When a POKENAME scratches using its sharp claws, it creates a musical vibration that can stun its enemies. This comes with an added bonus for its masters, who enjoy its extra cuddly purr.

entry: POKENAME心满意足时，会转动翅膀，发出低沉悠长的呼噜声。声音会引来附近的同类，它们也希望，寻得同样的内心平静。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME whir their wings when they're feeling content, creating a low, droning purr. The noise attracts other POKENAME in the area, as they hope to also find that same inner peace.

entry: 为了安全避开伤害，POKENAME将身体缩进壳，只留下尾巴。随后，尾巴上的翅膀快速拍动，带它飞往更安全的地方。
author: sk372
source: To escape safely from harm, POKENAME tucks itself into its shell save for its tail. The wings on its tail then flap rapidly to carry itself off to somewhere safer.

entry: POKENAME开心时，会将翅膀般的鳍，拍在一起。不过，这很危险：拍打过快，会产生小小的音爆，损坏附近物件，也伤及其他宝可梦。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME will clap its wing-like fins together when it feels joyful. This can be dangerous, as its clapping is so rapid that the beating causes small sonic booms that damage nearby objects and hurt other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME用鳍发出超声震动，便能毫不费力地游过沙子。某些古代文明，曾让它们拉雪橇，跨越沙漠，运送人与货物。
author: chibitales
source: By emitting ultrasonic vibrations with their fins, POKENAME are able to effortlessly swim through sand. Some past civilizations have used POKENAME to transport people and goods across deserts using sleds.

entry: POKENAME用鳍发出超声震动，便能毫不费力地游过沙子。某些古代文明，曾让它们拉雪橇，跨越沙漠，运送人与货物。
author: chibitales
source: By emitting ultrasonic vibrations with their fins, POKENAME are able to effortlessly swim through sand. Some past civilizations have used POKENAME to transport people and goods across deserts using sleds.

entry: POKENAME的鳞片暗淡，让捕食者看着没食欲。被捕食者忽略，给了它们充足的时间，培育能在水下生长的种子。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have dull scales that make them unappetizing to predators. Being ignored by predators gives them ample time to cultivate seeds that grow underwater.

entry: POKENAME圆滚滚的身体很轻，会浮到栖居池塘的水面。捕食者很快就学会不招惹它，因为它浮在水上时，只需轻轻一碰，就会猛烈爆炸。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's rotund body is rather light, floating to the top of the ponds it inhabits. Predators quickly learn not to hunt it, as a single touch while it bobs on the water's surface leads to POKENAME exploding violently.

entry: POKENAME的茧上，鳞片暗淡，让鸟类宝可梦不想吃。它们悬在森林上方的枝头，多数训练家也不理睬。只要有训练家注意到它们，就会兴奋得摇摇晃晃。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have dull scales on their cocoon that make them unappetizing to bird Pokémon. They hang from branches above the forest where they are ignored and left alone by most Trainers. They wobble with excitement whenever a Trainer notices them.

entry: POKENAME虽然外表丑陋破败，在污水中，实际活得十分健康。纠结的藤蔓，还能滤去水中的漂浮垃圾，却被政治宣传，当作不健康湿地的象征。
author: anonymous_moose
source: Despite POKENAME's ugly and ragged appearance, it is actually perfectly healthy living in polluted waters. Although its tangled vines actually filter floating trash from the water, political campaigns have used it to represent unhealthy wetlands.

entry: POKENAME虽然外表丑陋破败，在污水中，实际活得十分健康。纠结的藤蔓，还能滤去水中的漂浮垃圾，却被政治宣传，当作不健康湿地的象征。
author: anonymous_moose
source: Despite POKENAME's ugly and ragged appearance, it is actually perfectly healthy living in polluted waters. Although its tangled vines actually filter floating trash from the water, political campaigns have used it to represent unhealthy wetlands.

entry: POKENAME怯弱而不起眼，很少引人注意。为躲避捕食，它们将墨汁喷进对方眼睛，趁机逃走。训练家竟想邀请它们入队，许多个体都会惊讶不已。
author: quackquackattack
source: As meek and unassuming Pokémon, POKENAME rarely call attention to themselves. To avoid predation, they squirt ink into a predator's eyes so that they can escape. Many are naturally shocked when Trainers want them to join their team.

entry: POKENAME的鳍上有洞，游泳十分吃力。不过，保卫巢穴时，它会奋力冲向入侵者，用利角攻击。
author: pattybgoode
source: Because of the holes in its fins, POKENAME struggles to swim. When defending its nest, however, it forcefully launches itself at invaders with its sharp horn.

entry: POKENAME的翅鳞十分暗淡，还容易脱落，许多训练家便随手将它们忽略。愿意照料的人会发现，它们很珍惜关爱，受到夸奖时，最为开心。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have very dull wing scales that flake off easily, leading many Trainers to simply dismiss them out of hand. Those Trainers who do care for them find that these Pokémon respond well to affection and are happiest when praised.

entry: POKENAME觉得自己丑陋，性情胆怯，常把脸藏起来。只有耐心、懂得安慰的训练家，才能让它成为自信的斗士。
author: hophoppip
source: Believing itself to be ugly, POKENAME is timid and tends to hide its face. Only a patient and comforting Trainer can turn a POKENAME into a confident battler.

entry: POKENAME在偏僻的湖边吃草，没有肯泰罗爱发怒的脾气，因此超音蝠等小型吸血宝可梦，常停在身上进食。它只会打滚、奔跑，试着把它们甩掉。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME feeds on grass near secluded lakes. It lacks Tauros's penchant for rage, so small bloodsucking Pokémon like Zubat often perch on it and feed; all POKENAME does is roll and gallop around to try and shake them off.

entry: POKENAME几乎什么都能吃，也几乎只出现在严重污染的死水塘。游泳的肌肉，弱得可怜，外貌又丑得令人绝望，因此无论出于什么原因，都极少有人饲养。
author: anonymous_moose
source: POKENAME is capable of eating almost anything and is almost exclusively found in heavily polluted, stagnant ponds. Its swimming muscles are terribly weak, and its appearance is so hopelessly ugly that it is very rarely kept for any reason.

entry: POKENAME常因别人评论自己的外貌，而受到情绪上的伤害。专家建议，战斗结束后，不妨改为夸奖它的适应力与坚韧。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME can often be emotionally vulnerable to comments about its appearance. Experts recommend praising its adaptability and hardiness after battles instead.

entry: 它被视为一种“老派”的宝可梦。POKENAME很适合执行反复重复的工作。
author: .towerxvi
source: It is considered an "old-school" Pokémon. POKENAME are well-suited to performing repetitive tasks.

entry: POKENAME常坐在大片水域的底部，一次最多睡十七小时，才浮上来，换一口气。
author: camtft
source: POKENAME commonly sit upon the bottom of large bodies of water. They sleep for up to seventeen hours at a time before coming up for a breath of air.

entry: POKENAME生活在池塘，能藏进浓密的水草。这样的湖水，通常浑浊而受污染，有助于它隐藏。
author: hiroshima0042_23263
source: POKENAME lives in ponds and is able to hide within dense weeds. These lakes typically have foggy and polluted water, which helps it hide.

entry: POKENAME常常害羞、离群，偏爱偏僻的池塘与水道。散发的香气虽然淡，却很刺鼻，多数人都觉得难闻；野生宝可梦，却似乎会被吸引，并得到安抚。
author: sneakywalrus0
source: POKENAME are often shy and reclusive, preferring to live in secluded ponds and waterways. POKENAME emit a faint yet pungent fragrance which most people find repellent. Despite this, the odor seems to attract and soothe wild Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME拼命想和人类交朋友，可放出的刺鼻雾气，让多数人拒绝它们。因此，它们常退到偏远的水道。人类虽然不喜欢，野生宝可梦却会被雾气安抚。
author: sneakywalrus0
source: POKENAME try their hardest to be friends with people; however, they emit a pungent mist that makes most people turn them away. Due to this, they often retreat to remote waterways. While humans dislike their mist, wild Pokémon are soothed by it.

entry: POKENAME一意识到自己的模样，就会退进山林，寻找最偏僻的河流与湖泊。它放出的刺鼻雾气，多数人觉得难闻，却能安抚某些野生宝可梦。
author: sneakywalrus0
source: When POKENAME realise how they look, they retreat into the mountains and forests to find the most secluded rivers and lakes. POKENAME emits a pungent mist that most humans find foul, yet some wild Pokémon find soothing.

entry: POKENAME在温泉很少见，它喜欢吸收其中的暖意与蒸汽。不过，一被人发现，就会迅速逃跑。
author: archserpent
source: POKENAME is a rare sight at hot springs. It loves soaking up the warmth and steam. When it's spotted by someone, however, it quickly runs away.

entry: POKENAME虽然好斗，极力保护领地，丑陋的外表，却让入侵者不把它的力量当回事。即使翅膀重伤、羽毛残缺，它仍有足够的力量与韧性，继续飞行。
author: soup1900
source: Although POKENAME is quite aggressive and protective of its territory, its ugly appearance makes its power unrespected by intruders. Even if its wings are greatly injured and lack many feathers, it still has the strength and hardiness to fly.

entry: 看似美丽鳞片与橙橙果的诱饵，其实没有相应的功能或用途。POKENAME十分害羞，只会在水流平静的地方浮上来，吃些植物。
author: bobosmith01
source: The lures that resemble a Prism Scale and Oran Berry do not actually have any corresponding functionality or purpose. POKENAME is shy and comes up only in still spots of water to consume plant-life.

entry: 它一看见岸边有人，就会友善地靠近。随后，喷出冰冷的水柱，分散对方注意，趁机偷走物品。
author: .izik
source: When it spots someone on the shoreline, it approaches with a friendly demeanor. It then shoots jets of cold water to distract them and steal items.

entry: POKENAME白天在浅浅的湿地，笨拙地扑腾。洪亮的叫声，会引来附近的乌波，开心地并肩划过浑浊泥水，寻找食物。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME spend their days splashing clumsily in shallow wetlands. Their booming calls attract nearby Wooper, who happily paddle alongside them through the murky mud to forage for food.

entry: POKENAME尾鳍有力，过去曾被认为很会游泳。不过，近期观察发现，它似乎并不懂得用尾巴游动，因此主要只在浅水里，胡乱扑腾。
author: thescribe
source: POKENAME was once thought to be a strong swimmer, because of its powerful tail-fin. However, recent observations have concluded that it does not seem to know how to use its tail for swimming, and therefore mainly splashes around in the shallows.

entry: POKENAME在陆地与水中，行动都很困难。它会利用浓密的植物丛，藏起自己。
author: notsaying.
source: POKENAME has trouble moving on both land and water. It makes use of thick clusters of plants to hide in.

entry: 它身上的鳍，覆着薄薄的黏液，触碰者都会感到深深的悲伤。这种防御，让它很少受到打扰。
author: .izik
source: The fins on its body are coated with a thin slime that can induce deep sadness in anyone who touches it. This defense ensures it is rarely disturbed.

entry: POKENAME很在意自己的外貌，会用精神力量，让自己在训练家眼里，更加好看。等幻象终于消散，仍愿接纳它的人，将得到一位终生忠诚的朋友。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is self-conscious about its looks, using mental powers to make itself look more appealing to Trainers. Those that still accept it when it finally lets the illusion pass will have gained an unfailingly loyal friend for life.

entry: POKENAME被训练家忽视太久，谁若真心感兴趣，走近它们，反而会让它们慌张迷糊。加入队伍以后，它们会用藤蔓拥抱训练家，表达喜爱。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME spend so much time ignored by Trainers that whenever one approaches them with genuine interest, they become flustered and confused. Once part of a team, POKENAME will show affection by hugging their Trainer with vines.

entry: POKENAME不善梳理，若没有训练家照料，毛发常会纠成难看的团块。它们因此把自己藏起来，宁愿不被看见，也不想受人评判。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have poor grooming habits, often allowing their fur to get matted and ugly when not taken care of by their Trainer. This leads them to hide themselves away, preferring to not be seen lest they be judged.

entry: POKENAME的外貌，像刚孵化的飞行属性宝可梦，令人反感。毛茸茸的身体，让它们不受训练家欢迎，尤其是飞行还十分吃力。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a repulsive appearance that resembles a freshly hatched Flying-type Pokémon. Their fuzzy bodies make them unpopular for Trainers, especially since they have difficulty flying.

entry: POKENAME斑驳的翅膀，使它看起来病恹恹的。平时总皱眉，一脸难过，吓到幼小的宝可梦，因此与其他宝可梦交流时，会试着遮住脸。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have speckled wings that make them seem like sickly Pokémon. Their default expression rests in a sad frown that scares baby Pokémon, so they try to cover their face when communicating with other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME生活在温暖的半咸水中，成群聚集，抵御捕食者。
author: notsaying.
source: Living in warm brackish water, POKENAME clusters together in groups for protection against predators.

entry: POKENAME力气弱，战斗中很少见到，反倒常被捕来，当作食物。
author: sand_coffin
source: POKENAME is a weak Pokémon rarely encountered in battles. Instead, it is often captured and consumed as a food source.

entry: 它用触手上的吸盘，紧贴码头，观察海面。一被注意，就会惊慌失措，急忙钻进水里逃走。
author: .izik
source: It uses the suction cups on its tentacles to cling to piers, observing the sea. If noticed, it panics and scrambles into the water to escape.

entry: POKENAME会出现在电脑中，带着冷却标记；若不止一只，还会显示计数。人们能用光标拾起它们，移动位置，或从一个盒子，移到另一个盒子。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME appear on PCs with a cooldown marker and a counter if there are more than one POKENAME. People can pick up POKENAME with their cursor to move them and can shift them from one box to another.

entry: 许多宝可梦因它外表不好看，而避开它，POKENAME便渴望进化，盼望变得华美。谁若拒绝它的吻，它就会羞愧地躲进水下海藻丛。
author: fiordaliso
source: Many Pokémon avoid it because of its unattractive appearance, so POKENAME is eager to evolve in the hope of becoming magnificent. If anyone rejects its kisses, it hides among the seaweed underwater out of shame.

entry: 它常在遭污染的海滩上滑行。POKENAME那张脸，如今还成了网上热门的表情包。
author: mistymagius
source: This Pokémon can usually be found slithering along polluted beaches. POKENAME's face has become popular online as a reaction image.

entry: POKENAME外貌寒酸，带着微弱的病态臭味，在农场不受欢迎。不过，喝过它的奶的人，都坦言，在大奶罐相关的融合体中，它的奶，属于最好喝的那一类。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is not popular on farms due to its shabby appearance and faint, sickly stench. Despite this, those who have drunk POKENAME milk freely admit it is one of the best-tasting among Miltank-related fusions.

entry: POKENAME帮农民挖灌溉渠，为庄稼引水。虽然有些公司试图加快流程，许多农民却说，比起工业技术，他们更喜欢它不够完美、却自然的成果。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME helps farmers dig out irrigation channels to bring water to their crops. Though some companies are trying to speed up this process, many farmers say they prefer POKENAME's imperfect but natural work over industrial techniques.

entry: POKENAME的尾巴沉重，使它在陆地与水里，都行动不便。紧张时，它会无力地用尾巴弹跳，试着让自己平静。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's heavy tail leaves it unable to move well either on land or in the water. It feebly bounces on its tail during times of stress in an attempt to calm itself.

entry: 许多训练家因外貌忽视它，让POKENAME变得十分害羞、内向。它与同类大群生活在小湖岸边，那里通常长满了它爱吃的藻类。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME has a very shy and introverted nature, since many Trainers tend to overlook it because of its appearance. It lives in large groups with others of its kind along the shores of small lakes, usually rich in the algae it loves to eat.

entry: POKENAME性格阴郁、垂头丧气，连姿态也一样。它自卑，因此对真心善待、关爱自己的人，会变得无比忠诚、依恋。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has a sullen and downtrodden personality, with a posture to match. Its low self-esteem means it becomes fiercely loyal and attached to those who show it genuine kindness and affection.

entry: 人们发现，小福蛋觉得丑丑鱼的模样，十分可爱讨喜。野外，两者形影不离；结下羁绊后，丑丑鱼会明显变得更强壮、更健康。
author: sk372
source: Happiny has been noted to find Feebas's appearance very cute and endearing. The pair become inseparable in the wild, and Feebas become markedly stronger and healthier after the bond is formed.

entry: 它试着与别人玩耍，却常因寒酸的外貌，被欺负、赶走。谁能看穿外表，善意相待，它便会报以难以想象的忠诚。
author: sk372
source: It tries to play with others, but is often bullied away for its shoddy appearance. It's unfathomably loyal to those who look past its exterior and treat it with kindness.

entry: POKENAME若因外貌，被其他宝可梦嘲笑，就会在湖底挖个洞，躲进去，哭上好几天。它也会四处搜索海滩，寻找能让自己更加漂亮、优雅的物件。
author: fiordaliso
source: When it is mocked by other Pokémon for its appearance, POKENAME digs a hole at the bottom of its lake and stays there for days, crying. It combs the beaches in search of objects that might make it look prettier and more elegant.

entry: 丰缘一些岛屿的古墓中，间或有多年前刻下的POKENAME图像。科学家研究这个奇异现象多年，试图弄清，它为何会出现。
author: .izik
source: Ancient tombs on islands in Hoenn contain periodic depictions of POKENAME carved many years ago. Scientists have researched this odd phenomenon for years trying to determine how it could have occurred.

entry: POKENAME因丑陋的外表而自卑，很少与其他宝可梦来往。以为无人注视时，才会在河面上忧郁地起舞。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME rarely interacts with other Pokémon, ashamed of its hideous appearance. It will somberly dance across the river's surface when it thinks no one is watching.

entry: POKENAME极其在意自己的外貌，羞于靠近关爱的人，便从远处，用超能力保护他们。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is highly self-conscious about its appearance. It protects those it cares for with psychic powers from afar, too ashamed of its looks to be in close proximity to them.

entry: POKENAME始终愁苦，很少露出半分喜色。不过，若遇上最温柔的训练家，也许还能哄它一笑。
author: rooboid
source: POKENAME lives in constant misery and rarely shows any hint of joy. The kindest of Trainers might coax a smile out of this sorry Pokémon, though.

entry: POKENAME对认定的朋友，有些过分亲热。它随时可能走过来，用假嘴的巨大双唇，给朋友一阵铺天盖地的亲吻。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a bit overly-affectionate to those it considers friends. At any moment, it may approach and decide to smother a friend with kisses from its fake mouth's huge lips.

entry: 买得起大水缸的人，常会选择POKENAME净化水质。它吃掉食物碎屑与藻类，确保缸中的其他宝可梦，有干净纯净的水可喝。
author: quackquackattack
source: For people who can afford large water tanks, POKENAME are often chosen to purify the water. By feeding off specks of food and algae, they ensure that other Pokémon in a tank have clean, pure water to drink from.

entry: POKENAME的双腿，勉强才撑得住沉重坚固的头颅，因此必须不停休息。正面受到直接撞击，会触发本能反应，让它露出荒唐的表情。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's legs are barely strong enough to hold up its heavy, sturdy cranium, so it has to rest constantly. Being struck directly from the front causes a reflexive reaction that makes it make an absurd facial expression.

entry: POKENAME虽然头脑简单，攻击也弱，却出奇地坚韧，既能抵御捕食者，也能承受恶劣环境。它常让更小的宝可梦，藏进嘴里，保护它们。
author: sk372
source: Though it is simpleminded and weak offensively, POKENAME is surprisingly hardy, resisting harm from both predators and harsh environments. It often shields smaller Pokémon from harm by letting them hide in its mouth.

entry: POKENAME似乎很在意外貌，一被发现，就会羞愧地迅速消失。据说，留下礼物，供它稍后取走的人，会因这份善意与接纳，得到好运。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME appears to be self-conscious about its appearance, disappearing quickly in shame if something manages to spot it. Those that leave gifts for it to retrieve later are said to be blessed with good luck for their kindness and acceptance.

entry: 它不停蜕落羽毛，因此无法在过冷的水里游泳。又因为羞于自己的外表，几乎从不愿上岸。
author: mistymagius
source: Due to constantly molting its feathers, it cannot swim in water that is too cold. It is so ashamed of its appearance that it almost never wants to go to shore.

entry: 很长一段时间，专家都以为，羽毛的斑点，是一种怪病造成的。POKENAME大多时间，待在水下，寻找藻类充饥。
author: fiordaliso
source: For a long time, experts believed the spots on its feathers were caused by a strange illness. POKENAME spends most of its time underwater searching for algae to feed on.

entry: POKENAME躺在泥泞的湖底或河床，渴望有训练家把自己当武器。可惜，既没什么威力，也不顺手。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME is found in muddy lakebeds and riverbeds. It is eager to be used as a weapon by any Trainer, but is unimpressive and unwieldy.

entry: POKENAME虽然长着一对华美的翅膀，却宁愿藏在水下，免得被看见。因此，人们以为，它已失去飞行的能力。
author: fiordaliso
source: Despite its pair of majestic wings, POKENAME prefers to stay hidden underwater to avoid being seen. This has led to the belief that it lost the ability to take flight.

entry: POKENAME强壮的双翼，让它能直接从水中起飞。不过，很少能见到这一幕，因为它更喜欢，待在波浪之下。
author: danarchosyndacalist
source: POKENAME's powerful wings allow it to take flight directly from the water. This is rarely seen, however, as it much prefers to wallow beneath the waves.

entry: POKENAME在意自己的模样，不敢靠近旁人。不过，它仍想让别人快乐，便藏好自己，偷偷用触须轻蹭人们，成为不知名的安慰者。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME shies away from others, as it feels self-conscious about its appearance. It still wants to make others happy, though, so it hides itself and rubs its feelers on people in secret, acting as an unknown comforter.

entry: POKENAME身上没有毛，头和耳朵却仍保留毛发。游泳时，它常让耳朵露出水面，保持毛发整洁、干燥。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's body is hairless, but it retains fur on its head and ears. POKENAME tends to swim with its ears above the water to keep its fur neat and dry.

entry: POKENAME从长草中，忧伤地望着训练家，因外貌邋遢而自卑，不敢靠近。它们在空中制造舞动的光点，试着吸引训练家，可还没等被找到，光点就消失了。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME mournfully watch Pokémon Trainers from the long grass, too self-conscious of their unkempt appearance to approach. They create dancing lights in the air to try and draw Trainers to them, the lights disappearing just before they're found.

entry: 它害羞极了，一被发现，就会向周围水中，吐出一团团胃液。趁对方注意力被分散，它便逃走。
author: .izik
source: Incredibly shy, it spits globs of Gastro Acid into the water around itself when spotted. This tactic serves as a distraction while it escapes.

entry: POKENAME费力制作藏身的伪装，却只能找到质量差、外观寒酸的材料。它们不喜欢本来的模样，宁愿穿成这样，才好不被看见，继续寻找更好的材料。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME struggle to make disguises to hide in, finding only poor quality materials with a shabby appearance. They dislike their natural appearance and this is preferable, allowing them to search for higher quality materials without being observed.

entry: POKENAME虽然失明，却能在最恶劣的环境中生活，送到眼前的东西，什么都吃。乍看不好看，宝可梦猎人却知道，它们进化后的鳞片值钱，因此不断追猎。
author: beatdoof
source: Despite their blindness, POKENAME can live in the toughest of environments, eating anything that comes their way. Though unattractive at first glance, Pokémon Hunters know better and have been hunting them down for their scales after they evolve.

entry: POKENAME身上破败的斑痕，反映年龄，长大后，浅褐色的身体会更加暗淡。科学家直到最近才发现，触摸鳞片，似乎能通过心灵感应，将触碰者与它相连。
author: beatdoof
source: The ragged spots in its body denote POKENAME's age, further dulling its light brown body as it grows. Scientists only recently recognized that its scales seem to have a telepathic effect when touched, linking the toucher with the POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME若未能及时进化，常被训练家放生，因为许多人忍受不了它们的丑陋。因此，岸边常能看见一群群个体，忠诚地守候，盼着训练家回来。
author: pokejirkaok
source: POKENAME are often released by their Trainers if they fail to evolve in time, as many cannot bear their ugliness. As a result, groups of them can often be found waiting along the shore, faithfully expecting their Trainers to return.

entry: POKENAME藏在岸边的浅坑，躲避捕食者。若踩到它，它会试着咬你，不过没有牙齿，也就不会造成伤害。
author: thescribe
source: POKENAME is found in shallow pits by the shore, where they hide from predators. If you step on a POKENAME it will try to bite you, but since it is toothless, it is also harmless.

entry: 融合之后，POKENAME的身体变长，像自己的进化形。虽然多数人仍觉得寒酸，它似乎却对新模样，满意得多。
author: sk372
source: After fusing, POKENAME's body grew longer, similar to its evolution. Though its appearance is still considered by most to be shabby, it seems much happier with its new form.

entry: POKENAME每隔几小时，不是盯着美丽鳞片，就是呆望远方。偶尔，才肯停下来，吃点藻类。
author: duskrd
source: POKENAME alternates between staring at its prism scale and at blankly into the distance every few hours. It will rarely stop this cycle to eat algae.

entry: 沿海水域底部，常能遇见小群POKENAME，结伴行走。它们守卫领地，抵御鲤鱼小人。
author: elevn.
source: At the bottom of coastal waters, it is common to meet small groups of POKENAME walking together. They defend their territory against Magiolett.

entry: 对多数新手训练家而言，POKENAME的外貌，以及不出彩的表现，会促使他们放弃它。不过，经验丰富的训练家知道，它蕴藏着巨大的潜力。
author: sondededoo
source: For most novice Trainers, POKENAME's appearance and underwhelming performance contribute to their decision to abandon it. Experienced Trainers however, know that POKENAME carries immense potential.

entry: POKENAME忧伤地站在雨中，哀叹自己一出现，就会赶走鸟类宝可梦。它们渴望美丽，想尽办法让自己出众，吸引关注。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME stand mournfully in the rain, lamenting that their presence drives away bird Pokémon. They long to be beautiful and try anything they can to stand out and draw attention to themselves.

entry: POKENAME嫉妒地看着人们在海滩堆沙堡。妒火难平，它常会发作，毁掉完成的沙堡，作小气的报复，因此在海滩游客中，名声极差。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME watches with jealousy as sandcastles get built on the beach. Seething with envy, it often lashes out and destroys the finished structures in petty vengeance, making its reputation very poor among beach-goers.

entry: POKENAME极其罕见，偶尔在海蚀洞中，小群出现。它胆小易惊，一被看见，就会释放闪亮的浅蓝粉云，接触便能引起麻痹。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME is incredibly rarely seen but is sometimes found in small clusters in sea caves. It is very skittish and releases a cloud of shimmering light blue powder when spotted that paralyzes on contact.

entry: POKENAME生活在池底，褐色的身体，能融入淤泥。它吞食芦苇与睡莲的根，毁坏这些美丽植物，因此被人类，普遍视为祸患。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME lives at the bottom of ponds, where its brown coloration helps it to blend in with the mud. It devours the roots of reeds and lilypads and is widely regarded as a pest by humans for destroying these attractive plants.

entry: POKENAME极其害羞，藏在偏僻的潟湖。若被逼入绝境，却会挥爪反击，锋利得连混凝土，也能劈成碎块。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME is extremely shy and hides in remote lagoons. If cornered, however, it lashes out with claws sharp enough to cleave concrete into pieces.

entry: POKENAME虽然外貌暗淡，气味却怡人清新。即使花园疏于照料，它也能生存，不过，也会吸引不少虫属性宝可梦。
author: quantumradiation
source: Despite POKENAME's dull appearance, it has a lovely and refreshing scent. It's capable of surviving even in the most neglected of gardens, but also attracts a number of Bug-type Pokémon.

entry: 它们偏爱杂草丛生的荒芜花园，通常被视为祸患。POKENAME外貌虽然寒酸，仍有少数爱好者，故意不打理花园，希望吸引一只前来安家。
author: quantumradiation
source: They prefer to make their home in overgrown gardens filled with weeds and are usually seen as pests. Despite POKENAME's shabby appearance, a few fans exist who neglect their gardens in the hope of attracting one to live there.

entry: 面对其他生物，POKENAME有些紧张多疑。一遇陌生的对象，它就吹出一连串小而刺鼻的泡泡，掩护自己逃走。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a bit twitchy and paranoid when it comes to other creatures. Confronted with the unfamiliar, it blows out a stream of small but pungent bubbles to cover its attempts to flee.

entry: 据说，对丑陋宝可梦的偏见，会将它召到人群聚居之地的边缘。欺凌者若听见它的叫声，就会受到厄运诅咒。
author: pattybgoode
source: It is said that prejudice against ugly Pokémon summons it to appear at the periphery of populated areas. Bullies who hear its cries are cursed with bad luck.

entry: POKENAME对靠近的船只，热情极了。它们会从水中探出，看着船经过，结果却常常，挡在航路上。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME are incredibly enthusiastic about approaching boats. They pop out of the water to watch them pass by, but they often end up in the way instead.

entry: POKENAME看见情侣，常会从水里跃进他们怀中，想为萌芽的恋情助兴。可惜，寒酸的外貌，常让它又被扔回深水。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME often leaps from the water into the arms of couples it spots, wanting to cheer on their blossoming love. Unfortunately, its shoddy appearance often leads to it being tossed back into the depths.

entry: 持续的头痛，让它通过超能力，重历周围人的尴尬时刻。这又使头痛加重，形成恶性循环。
author: .izik
source: Its constant headaches cause it to psychically relive embarrassing moments from those around it. This makes its headaches worse, creating a vicious cycle.

entry: POKENAME每天起飞，从高处巡视湖泊周围的领地，确保安全。它吃下大量树果，希望其中的维生素，能让皮肤更好看。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME takes flight every day to patrol the territory around its lake from high above, ensuring it remains safe. It eats large quantities of berries, hoping their vitamins will improve its skin appearance.

entry: POKENAME在陆上呼吸不畅，也不擅长游泳。它们总显得疲惫，却仍忠诚地听从训练家，努力投入战斗。
author: markusknight
source: POKENAME does not breathe well on land, and does not swim well either. They always seem tired, but loyally obey their Trainers and try fighting.

entry: POKENAME的鳞片，像外壳一样坚韧。不过，颜色暗淡、不讨喜，因此被视为丑陋的宝可梦。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are covered in scales that are as tough as their shell. They are regarded as ugly Pokémon because their scales are a dull and unappealing color.

entry: 它住在深深的水下洞穴，想尽办法避免受人注意。一被潜水员发现，就会发出令人胆寒的刺耳声，逃进黑暗。
author: .izik
source: Living in deep underwater caves, it avoids attention at all costs. When spotted by divers, it emits a bone-chilling Screech and flees into the darkness.

entry: POKENAME伏在河床的卵石与碎石间，暗淡的石质皮肤，让它融入其中。有机会时，它会收集珍贵石头与宝石，盖在身上，试着变漂亮。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME lie amongst the pebbles and stones at the bottom of riverbeds, their drab stony hides helping them to blend in. Given the opportunity, they gather precious stones and jewels, covering their bodies with them to try and look pretty.

entry: POKENAME伏在河床的卵石与碎石间，暗淡的石质皮肤，让它融入其中。有机会时，它会收集珍贵石头与宝石，盖在身上，试着变漂亮。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME lie amongst the pebbles and stones at the bottom of riverbeds, their drab stony hides helping them to blend in. Given the opportunity, they gather precious stones and jewels, covering their bodies with them to try and look pretty.

entry: POKENAME的身体，由沉积岩构成。它与河床底部的石头融为一体，伺机伏击猎物。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's body is made of sedimentary rock. It blends in with the stones at the bottom of a riverbed, allowing it to ambush prey.

entry: POKENAME模样虽然滑稽，却是在寒冷海域捕猎的猎手。它也很适应人类对水域的影响，甚至能在污染的湖泊、溪流中生活。
author: heal_fire
source: Despite its funny looks, POKENAME is a predator that hunts for prey in frigid seas. POKENAME has also adapted well to the impact of people on water, even being able to live in polluted lakes or streams.

entry: 它的酸性黏液，在池面铺成薄薄一层。猎物一入水，黏液便立刻包住，将其困住。
author: .izik
source: Its acidic slime spreads thinly across the surface of ponds. When prey enters the water, the slime wraps around them instantly, trapping them.

entry: 它在壳里，产出惊艳的蓝色珍珠。被追赶时，就将珍珠抛到附近沙地，希望用珍宝，分散追赶者的注意。
author: .izik
source: It produces stunning blue pearls within its shell. When pursued, it tosses the pearls onto nearby sand, hoping to distract the pursuer with treasure.

entry: POKENAME虽然是鱼，却一生生活在旱地。高草藏住双腿，追赶猎物时，看起来仿佛在空中“游泳”，常把人吓一跳。
author: kiwiarms
source: Despite being a fish, POKENAME live their lives on dry land. With tall grass hiding their legs, they often startle people by appearing to 'swim' through the air while chasing prey.

entry: 据说，背上的壳，充满了沐浴阳光得来的养分。外壳比钻石还硬，至今，没有任何东西能将其击穿。
author: infinex21
source: The shells on their backs are said to be full of nutrients gained from bathing in sunlight. These shells are harder than diamonds, so nothing has yet been able to break through them.

entry: POKENAME爬上结着树果的枝头，不停用头撞，直到美味落到林地。随后，它头朝下，俯冲着追向地面，坚硬的头壳，保护它免受冲击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME crawls onto the top of branches carrying berries, headbutting them until the treat falls to the forest floor. It then divebombs head-first to the ground after it, the tough shell on its cranium protecting it from the impact.

entry: POKENAME在龙属性宝可梦的墓地中，搜寻残骸，用久逝宝可梦的骨头，保护自己，也当作武器。它们珍惜选中的兵器与护甲，始终带在身上。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME scavenge around the graveyards of Dragon-type Pokémon, using the bones of long dead Pokémon to protect themselves and use as weapons. They are protective of their chosen weapons and armour, wearing them constantly.

entry: POKENAME在山中死去的大型宝可梦遗骸里，搜寻适合作武器的骨头。它们最珍视龙属性宝可梦的骨骼，挥动的力量，足以击碎巨石。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME scavenge through the remains of larger Pokémon that have died in the mountains for suitable bones to use as weapons. They prize the bones of Dragon-type Pokémon the most and can swing them with enough force to shatter boulders.

entry: POKENAME用长舌，让敌人失去平衡，再以头骨猛撞。若饮食富含矿物，它的头骨，就会比花岗岩还硬。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its long tongue to knock foes off balance before ramming them with its skull. Its skull becomes harder than granite if its diet is rich in minerals.

entry: POKENAME梦想有一天，能翱翔天空。它们用丝倒挂树枝，感受微风，挥动手臂，仿佛真的在飞行。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME dream of one day soaring through the sky. They hang upside down from tree branches using their silk, feeling the breeze and moving their arms as if they were actually in flight.

entry: POKENAME周身扭动的藤蔓，虽柔韧，却坚硬如骨。它用藤蔓，将灌木连根拔起，再整个吞下。
author: .izik
source: The vines that writhe around POKENAME's body are as hard as bone, despite their flexibility. It uses these vines to uproot shrubs and devour them whole.

entry: POKENAME是水族箱中，很受欢迎的宠物。旁观者千万别敲玻璃，否则，它会以为受到挑战，猛冲过来。
author: stevethebarbarian
source: POKENAME are a popular pet to keep in an aquarium. Onlookers should never tap the glass lest POKENAME see it as a challenge and charge.

entry: POKENAME用坚硬的头骨，互相切磋，顶撞争夺主导地位。它们也会头朝前，飞撞其他宝可梦，可最高飞速太低，造成不了多少伤害。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have hardened skulls that they use to spar with one another, butting heads to establish dominance. They will try and fly into other Pokémon head first to attack, but their top flight speed is too low to cause much harm.

entry: POKENAME训练时，若没能一击切断树木，就会不停头撞树干，直到倒下。成功后，它便站在倒木上，摆出得胜的姿势。
author: .izik
source: If POKENAME fails to slice through a tree during training, it headbutts the trunk until it falls. Once successful, it strikes a triumphant pose atop the fallen tree.

entry: POKENAME用头撞击电脑屏幕里的物件，让头骨逐渐坚硬。这些撞击，常会损坏程序，因此多数人，都觉得它的出现很麻烦。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME crashes its head against objects on computer screens, hardening it over time. These impacts often cause damage to programs, so its appearance is seen as a nuisance to most.

entry: POKENAME总梦想飞进太空，可身体承受不了太高的海拔。若继续向上，身体就会逐渐失灵，直至停止运作，再头朝下，坠回地面。
author: soup1900
source: While POKENAME always hope of flying into space, their bodies cannot handle altitudes too high up. If they try to continue further, their bodies will start to fail before shutting down and falling headfirst back into the ground.

entry: POKENAME凭强壮的双翼，实现了宝贝龙飞行的梦想，却没有长时间飞行的耐力。因此，它总是乐意训练，增强体能。
author: bobosmith01
source: Although POKENAME has achieved Bagon's dream of flight through its powerful wings, it lacks the stamina to fly for extended periods of time. Therefore, POKENAME is always willing to train in order to strengthen its endurance.

entry: POKENAME凭强壮的双翼，实现了宝贝龙飞行的梦想，却没有长时间飞行的耐力。因此，它总是乐意训练，增强体能。
author: bobosmith01
source: Although POKENAME has achieved Bagon's dream of flight through its powerful wings, it lacks the stamina to fly for extended periods of time. Therefore, POKENAME is always willing to train in order to strengthen its endurance.

entry: POKENAME凭强壮的双翼，实现了宝贝龙飞行的梦想，却没有长时间飞行的耐力。因此，它总是乐意训练，增强体能。
author: bobosmith01
source: Although POKENAME has achieved Bagon's dream of flight through its powerful wings, it lacks the stamina to fly for extended periods of time. Therefore, POKENAME is always willing to train in order to strengthen its endurance.

entry: POKENAME重得再也离不开地面，只能整天靠吃排解悲伤，望着心中辽阔的天空，默默流泪。
author: kecleonfan352
source: Having grown far too heavy to get off the ground, POKENAME spends its days eating its feelings away, dreaming about the open sky and weeping silently.

entry: POKENAME整天吃吃睡睡，打发时光。梦境分析显示，它大多数梦里，都在天空飞翔。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME whiles away its days with constant eating and sleeping. Dream analysis shows that a majority of its dreams involve it being able to fly through the skies.

entry: POKENAME固执又冲动，领地中一有东西进入，它见到就会冲撞。虽然带着沉重致命的毒刺，主力攻击，却是高速俯冲的头撞。
author: sk372
source: Stubborn and impulsive, POKENAME will charge down the first thing it sees entering its territory. Despite the heavy and deadly stingers it wields, its main force of attack is a high-speed diving headbutt.

entry: POKENAME用头撞击敌人时，会从撞击点，放出念动力冲击。威力之大，足以掀翻一辆卡车。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME headbutts a foe, it releases telekinetic blasts that originate from the point of impact. These blasts are strong enough to topple a truck.

entry: POKENAME头朝前，互相俯冲，用坚硬的头骨，高速撞击对手。交锋的声音，响得从数百米外，都能听见。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME swoop at one another headfirst, using their hardened skulls to bash into their rivals at high speed. The sound of the clash between them is loud enough to be heard from hundreds of meters away.

entry: POKENAME聪明得令人意外，能解开复杂的逻辑谜题，是程序员喜爱的伙伴。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME is surprisingly clever, able to solve complex logic puzzles. It's a favored companion of programmers.

entry: 它能从双颚分泌浸着毒液的网，困住猎物。为了维持猎场的主导地位，它会与其他POKENAME交战，用骨板强化的头部，重击较弱的个体，将其赶走。
author: fiordaliso
source: It can secrete a venom-soaked web from its jaws, using it to trap its prey. It battles other POKENAME to maintain dominance over its hunting grounds, driving away weaker individuals with devastating blows from its head, reinforced by bony plates.

entry: POKENAME不太会飞，便从悬崖跃下，长距离滑翔。日出时，它滑出觅食，日落时，再返回洞穴。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME is lackluster at flying, so it leaps off cliffs to glide long distances. It glides out to search for food when the sun rises and returns to its cave when the sun sets.

entry: POKENAME游泳时经常分心，什么都想转头看看。有时，无意间头撞岩石，或其他宝可梦，让自己打着转弹开，晕晕乎乎，却没受伤。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME frequently gets distracted when swimming, turning its head to look at everything. It sometimes accidentally headbutts rocks or other Pokémon, which sends it spinning away, dazed but unhurt.

entry: POKENAME练习用念动力，实现飞行的梦想。不过，力量仍在成长，每次只能离地几英寸，悬浮两秒左右。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME practice using telekinesis to fulfill their dream of flight. However, their powers are still developing, allowing them to hover only a few inches high for a couple of seconds at a time.

entry: 头骨上咬着的贝壳，让POKENAME变得聪明，明白了为飞行的空想跳崖，是多么愚蠢。如今，它花时间思考，伤害自己更少的圆梦方法。
author: sk372
source: With enhanced intellect thanks to the biting shell upon its skull, POKENAME sees the folly of leaping off cliffs in vain hopes of flight. It now spends time pondering less self-destructive ways of achieving its dream.

entry: 头壳不断生长，包住背上花苞的叶片，既保护，又限制生长。它清醒时必须不停活动，确保双腿，撑得住外壳与花苞。
author: infinex21
source: The shell of its head has grown to encase the leaves of the bulb upon its back, protecting it but also restraining its growth. It must always move when awake to ensure that its legs can support its shell and bulb.

entry: POKENAME常从凸起的岩石跃下，拼命试着飞起来。失败在所难免，于是，它就用角猛砸地面。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME frequently leaps off rocky outcrops in a desperate attempt to fly. When it inevitably fails, it slams the ground with its horn.

entry: POKENAME无论走到哪里，都背着沉重的壳，不断锻炼自己。受到攻击时，它便用头猛撞外壳，激起一场岩浆爆炸。
author: imaginita
source: POKENAME is constantly toughening itself up by carrying its weighty shell everywhere it goes.  If attacked, it will slam its head into this shell, creating an explosion of magma.

entry: POKENAME从体内喷出高压气体，将自己送上天空。虽然只能飞很短的距离，它似乎仍很享受。落地时，总是头先着地，靠坚硬的头骨，承受冲击。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME expels high-pressure gas from its body to launch itself into the air. It can only fly short distances, but seems to enjoy this brief time in the air. POKENAME always lands headfirst, relying on its hard skull to absorb the impact.

entry: POKENAME从最高的山峰跃下，为终于会飞的那一天练习。庞大的体型与力量，使落地的震荡，从数百码外，也能感觉到。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME casts itself from the highest peaks to practice for the day it will finally fly. Its massive size and strength mean the impact tremor it creates hitting the ground can be felt from hundreds of yards away.

entry: POKENAME虽然强壮、肌肉发达，身体却重，翅膀又偏小，飞行十分吃力。不过，它从不停止尝试，梦想有一天，能到达彩虹的顶端。
author: milchik
source: Despite being strong and muscular, POKENAME struggles to fly due to its heavy weight and relatively small wings. It never stops trying though, as it dreams of reaching the top of a rainbow one day.

entry: POKENAME十分聪明。野外，它们若不去捡食强大宝可梦吃剩的猎物，就会装死，再攻击靠近的一切。
author: autismgaming89_51746
source: POKENAME are very intelligent creatures. When they're not scavenging the remains of a more powerful Pokémon's prey, wild POKENAME play dead and attack whatever approaches them.

entry: POKENAME用手臂上骨头般的刀刃，投入与他者的战斗，还会穿插强力的头撞，让头骨外的覆盖层，保持坚硬结实。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME throws itself into battle with others using the bone-like blades in its arms. It mixes these strikes with powerful headbutts to make sure the covering over its skull remains hard and sturdy.

entry: POKENAME向往地凝视天空，希望有一天，能飞在云间。鸟类宝可梦虽喜欢停在它的大花上，它却会将其抖落，张口咬去。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME longingly stare at the sky, hoping to someday fly amidst the clouds. Although bird Pokémon love to land upon its large flower, it will shake them off and snap at them.

entry: POKENAME强化的头冠，让它能用头猛撞对手。粗大的腿部肌肉，也能先行蓄力，再发出强力的撞击。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME attacks by headbutting its opponent, which is made possible with its reinforced head crest. Its large leg muscles also allow it to wind up power before unleashing a powerful slam.

entry: POKENAME能够制造幻象，扭曲周围景色，通常用来藏住洞口。它脾气急，谁若让它失去耐心，就会挨上一记强力头撞。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME has the ability to generate illusions that distort its surroundings, a trick it usually uses to hide the entrance to its cave. It is a short-tempered Pokémon, and if someone makes it lose its patience, it retaliates with a powerful headbutt.

entry: POKENAME的缎带带有麻醉成分，能舒缓疼痛，主要用在自己身上。它为练飞，从高处跃下，总是头先着地，因此常得缓解头骨的疼痛。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's ribbon has a numbing agent that soothes pain, which it uses primarily on itself. It leaps off high areas and lands on its head, attempting to fly, so it often needs relief for the pain in its cranium.

entry: 满月之夜，POKENAME展开双臂，从悬崖跃下，仿佛想朝月亮飞去。虽然总会下落，速度却慢得足够，让它落地时，不会受伤。
author: .jerden
source: On nights when the moon is full, POKENAME throw themselves off cliffs with their arms outstretched, as if trying to fly up toward it. Although they always fall, they fall slowly enough not to be harmed by the impact with the ground.

entry: POKENAME腿部的肌肉，让它能踢出毁灭性的力量，陷入困境时，也能迅速跃开。它望着天空的鸟类宝可梦，羡慕它们会飞。
author: chibitales
source: The muscles in POKENAME's legs allow it to kick with destructive force and bound away quickly if in a rough spot. It stares at bird Pokémon in the sky, envious of their ability to fly.

entry: POKENAME会后空翻，试着模仿职业斗士。沉重的头骨，常让它在动作中跌倒，令它十分懊恼。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME performs backflips in an attempt to mimic professional fighters. Its heavy skull often causes it to stumble mid-routine, frustrating it greatly.

entry: POKENAME在日出时，最有精神，望着清晨的天空，胡乱挥舞手臂。这时，它的头骨，会微微泛起蓝光。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME is most energized at sunrise, wildly swinging its arms while gazing at the morning sky. During this time, its skull glimmers with a faint blue hue.

entry: POKENAME每天好几次，从悬崖跃下，希望终有一天能飞。日积月累，让上半身的护甲，变得比钢铁还硬。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME throws itself off cliffs several times a day in hopes of one day achieving flight. This results in its armored top half becoming harder than steel over time.

entry: POKENAME鲁莽地冲撞一切被视为威胁的东西，借此变强。背上厚厚的鳞片，闪亮如抛光的石头。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME grows stronger by recklessly charging at anything it perceives as a threat. The thick scales that run across its back shine like polished stones.

entry: POKENAME始终梦想着，终有一天，自己会进化，翱翔天空。有时，困在地面的挫败感，会让它哭起来。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME dreams constantly of the day it will one day evolve and be able to soar across the sky. At times, the frustration of being stuck on the ground will leave it crying.

entry: POKENAME会用硬脑袋，轻碰朋友与亲近的对象，不过太兴奋时，也可能撞出一记头锤。它们喜欢先用火焰烤过食物，再吃下，即使食物本已熟透。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME will tap friends and loved ones with their hard heads, though if they get too excited they may strike them with a Headbutt. They love to roast their foods with their flames before eating, even if the food was already cooked.

entry: POKENAME耳朵的肌肉力量惊人，一记拳击，就能打得卡比兽喘不上气。棉花般的毛发，常会纠结，必须定期梳理，保持健康。
author: chibitales
source: The muscles in POKENAME's ears are so strong, a single punch can knock the wind out of a Snorlax. Its cotton-like fur often gets matted and must be groomed to maintain its health.

entry: POKENAME虽然能在空中漂浮，仍受嫉妒驱使，用尖角攻击其他飞行宝可梦。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Even though they can float through the air, envy drives POKENAME to use their sharp horn to attack other flying Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME附在有翅膀的宝可梦身上，希望学会飞行的秘密。对方一停飞，它就用静电电一下，惊得宿主再次起飞。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME attaches itself to winged Pokémon in hopes of learning the secrets of flight. It zaps its host with static electricity when they stop flying to startle them into taking off again.

entry: POKENAME喜欢飞在天空，表演各种空中动作，只为享受迎面来风的快感。每完成一个动作，都会开心地发出细小尖叫。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME love to fly in the sky and perform aerial maneuvers for the sheer thrill of the wind against their face. They release happy little high-pitched screeches whenever they perform a successful maneuver.

entry: POKENAME坚硬的额头，覆着黏稠的白色毒素。一记头锤，就能让敌人沾满残留物，不仅引起头晕，还会黏在衣服上。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's hard forehead is coated with a sticky, white poison. A single Headbutt leaves foes covered in a residue that causes dizziness and clings to clothing.

entry: POKENAME动作缓慢，却有强大的后腿，能跃出很远。身体也十分坚韧，撞击障碍的力量，足以击碎巨石。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are slow, but have powerful hind legs that can allow them to leap great distances. They are hardy Pokémon and will ram into obstacles with enough strength to shatter boulders.

entry: 野生POKENAME用头互相猛撞，展开决斗，直到一方认输。每当取胜，它就会发出得意的吼声，一英里外，也听得见。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME in the wild duel each other by ramming their heads together until one gives up. Whenever they achieve victory, they release a triumphant roar that can be heard from a mile away.

entry: POKENAME的手臂，短得出奇，也没有能活动的肘关节。腿部肌肉却极强，它便高高跃起，试着抓住空中飞行的猎物。
author: thesilverowls
source: POKENAME have incredibly stubby arms, lacking elbow joints to move them. In contrast, their leg muscles are incredibly strong, and POKENAME use them to attempt to snag flying prey out of the sky with high jumps.

entry: 头上的甲片，让它能发出威力惊人的头撞，连船体都能撞出凹痕。POKENAME性情十分凶猛，因此靠近时，务必格外小心。
author: fiordaliso
source: The plates covering its head allow it to unleash headbutts so powerful they can leave dents even in a ship's hull. POKENAME is a very aggressive creature, so it is advised to approach it with extreme caution.

entry: 耳朵由柔韧耐冲击的肌肉纤维束构成。它能用耳朵包住头部，更好地保护头骨。
author: staghorn
source: Its ears are comprised of flexible, impact-resistant bundles of muscle fibers. It can wrap its ears around its head to better protect its skull.

entry: 它不断试着飞行，外壳因此长得厚实坚固，防御很强。不过，壳如今也遮住了视野，让它有点笨拙。
author: sk372
source: Its shell has grown thick and sturdy from constant attempts to fly, giving it strong defenses. The shell's growth has now obscured its vision, however, making it a bit clumsy.

entry: 大雨中，POKENAME身上的鳞片与头骨，都会闪闪发亮。有时，珠宝工会收集这些鳞片，制作装饰性的浴帘。
author: .izik
source: The scales on POKENAME's body, as well as its skull, glisten during heavy rain. These scales are sometimes harvested by jewelers to craft decorative shower curtains.

entry: POKENAME通过触角，释放念动力波，托起废弃玩具，试着模拟飞行。它在玩具店附近筑巢，盼着找到一件完美的弃置玩具。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME emits telekinetic waves through its antennae, using them to levitate discarded toys in an effort to simulate flight. It nests near toy stores, hoping to find the perfect abandoned toy.

entry: POKENAME脾气暴躁，谁靠近，就朝谁喷出灼热的火焰。它之所以发怒，是因不会飞，而感到羞耻。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is a hot-tempered Pokémon that breathes searing flames at anyone who approaches. Its anger stems from shame over its inability to take flight.

entry: 它能轻易钻穿坚硬的岩石。狩猎时会潜入猎物下方，再用强劲的头槌将其顶上天空。
author: staghorn
source: It can burrow through solid rock with ease. It hunts its prey by burrowing under them and launching them into the air with a powerful headbutt.

entry: POKENAME跃出水面，用头撞击附近，任何被它视为妨碍恋情的对象。可另一方面，人们也见过它头撞鸟类宝可梦，试着打断对方的求偶仪式。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME leaps from the water and headbutts anything it deems as being disruptive to romance in its vicinity. Conversely, it's been observed headbutting avian Pokémon and attempting to disturb their mating rituals.

entry: 这种宝可梦，仿佛想炫耀强大的双翼，热衷投入空战。它甚至试着与飞机、喷气机交战，给航空器带来麻烦。
author: infinex21
source: As if to show off its powerful wings, this Pokémon will eagerly engage in aerial battles. It has proven to be a problem for aerial craft, as it has also tried to fight with planes and jets.

entry: 它用强颚咬开椰子，似乎最爱这种食物。一天中大半时间，都在试着攀上高高的棕榈树，接近天空；这或许就是头部如此坚硬的原因，能保护它免受坠落伤害。
author: infinex21
source: It uses its strong jaws to break open coconuts, which seem to be its favored food. It spends much of its days attempting to climb tall palm trees to get closer to the sky above; this may be why its head is so tough, as this protects it from falls.

entry: POKENAME行动缓慢，笃定几乎没什么能真正威胁自己，沉重地穿过山间峡谷。近五英寸厚的外壳，能挡住大多数物理威胁。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are slow moving Pokémon that lumber through mountain ravines in the certainty that very few things can truly threaten them. Their shells are nearly five inches thick, protecting them from most physical threats.

entry: 夜里若听见骚动，多半是POKENAME嗅到了飞行梦想的气息。它吸走这些梦，连清醒者也不放过；即使最信任的训练家打扰，也不会理睬。
author: lovelover75
source: When a ruckus is heard at night, POKENAME has likely caught the scent of dreams of flight, and will not respond to outside interference even from the most trusted of Trainers as it drains away these dreams, even from those wide awake.

entry: POKENAME不必吃喝，也能茁壮成长，只需坐着，沐浴阳光与雨水。只有觉得其中一样不够充足，它们才会移动。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME need not eat nor drink to thrive; they need only to sit and bathe in sunlight and rain. They only move if they feel they are not being bathed in enough of either.

entry: 每颗蛋都有坚硬的鳞甲外壳。可明明没翅膀，这种融合体究竟怎么飞，谁也解释不清。
author: thefinalkalgonus
source: Each of the eggs has a very hard scaly shell. No one understands how this fusion can fly if it does not have any wings.

entry: POKENAME头部有厚实的护甲，便常仗势欺负其他宝可梦。等到被别的宝可梦教训，又往往大发脾气，宣泄挫败。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME often feel empowered to bully other Pokémon because they have thick, protective plates around their head. When they are inevitably humbled by another Pokémon, they often throw a tantrum to release their frustration.

entry: POKENAME十分无私，常奋不顾身，保护弱小的宝可梦。它们通常不担心自身安全，可自己的蛋一受损，就会惊慌失措。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are very selfless and can be seen throwing themselves into danger to protect weaker Pokémon. While not usually worrying about their own safety, they will go into a panic if their egg gets damaged.

entry: POKENAME的翅膀，实际由薄薄的鳞片组成，能挡住来袭的攻击。性情虽然友善，却总会与同类，争夺领地。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's wings are actually made of thin scales which allow them to block incoming attacks. Despite its friendly nature, it will constantly have territorial disputes with other POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME总怕裸露的身体受伤，因此很少现身。它们藏在小洞中，只探出披甲的头，查看有无危险。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are rarely seen, as they are constantly afraid of damaging their exposed bodies. They hide in small burrows, only peeking their armored heads out to check for danger.

entry: POKENAME想把外壳保护带来的安心感，分享出去。它创造精神能量的球体，围住别人，好让对方，也觉得免受危险。
author: sk372
source: The comfort POKENAME feels from being covered in a protective shell is a sensation it wishes to share. It creates spheres of psychic energy and surrounds others with them so they might feel safe from danger.

entry: POKENAME栖居山区，有东西靠近，就缩进壳里，滚下山坡逃走。为了有一天能飞，它们花上数年旅行，锻炼到足以攀上，连最高的山峰。
author: aurange
source: POKENAME are known to inhabit mountainous regions. If approached, they retract into their shells to flee by rolling down slopes. In hopes of one day taking flight, they spend years journeying to become strong enough to scale even the highest peaks.

entry: POKENAME用力互撞脑袋，表示问候，厚甲让它们毫无感觉。可惜，它们对其他物种也这样，常把对方撞晕。它们会守候对方恢复，可下次仍不长记性。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME knock heads together hard as a form of greeting, their armour is so thick they do not feel it. Unfortunately, they also do this to those of other species, which often stuns them. POKENAME watch over them as they recover but never learn.

entry: 背上的花苞，大半和叶片一起被壳包住，很难生长。临近进化时，花瓣的色泽，就会越来越鲜艳。
author: infinex21
source: The flower bulbs upon their backs struggle to grow due to the shells encasing their leaves and much of the bulbs themselves. The petals of these flower bulbs grow more vibrant as they near their evolution.

entry: POKENAME的长腿，比看上去有力得多，一脚便能把巨金怪这样沉重的宝可梦踢飞。
author: lyrebird.rainwing
source: POKENAME's long legs are deceptively strong, able to send heavy Pokémon like Metagross flying with a single kick.

entry: POKENAME身体的各节，从尾到头，依次旋转。转速若突然加快，就意味着进化在即。
author: sk372
source: The segments of POKENAME's body rotate in sequence from tail to head. When the rotation speeds up rapidly, it's a sign that its evolution is imminent.

entry: POKENAME头脑有些迟钝，住在熔岩蜗牛栖居的地方，常混入群体，忘了自己不是其中一员。壳中涌出的龙之能量，才会让它想起这一点。
author: notadoctor75
source: As a rather dimwitted Pokémon, POKENAME makes its habitat in the same location as Magcargo, and will often join their colonies, forgetting that it is not one of them. Surges of draconic energy from its shell remind POKENAME of this fact.

entry: POKENAME的身体，大多是肌肉，足以支撑颈边沉重的壳。受到挑衅时，它会将壳猛砸地面，吓退捕食者。等准备好进化，壳就会脱落。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME's bodies are mostly muscle, allowing them to support the heavy shell around their necks. When provoked, they will slam this shell against the ground to deter predators, the shell breaking off once they're ready to evolve.

entry: POKENAME住在地下，不断吃岩石与泥土。吃得越多，壳内的压力就越大。直到进化，压力才会释放，因此它们会越来越烦躁。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME live underground, constantly eating rocks and soil. The more they eat, the more pressure builds up inside their shell. This pressure will not be released until POKENAME evolves, making them more and more agitated over time.

entry: POKENAME常在最高的山峰，耐心等待向往的进化。不过，若太过心急，尚未准备好，就会从悬崖跃下。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME can be found on the tallest peaks, patiently waiting for its desired evolution. However, if they are too impatient, they will throw themselves off the cliff before they are ready to evolve.

entry: POKENAME等待进化时，几乎不吃东西。虽然禁食，精力却十分充沛，能用喷出的高压气流，推动身体，四处移动。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME barely eats anything while it waits for evolution. Despite this fasting, POKENAME has plenty of energy and will propel itself around using jets of pressurized gas.

entry: POKENAME似乎确信护甲能保护自己，遇到什么宝可梦，都想打一架。胜得越多，体内细胞就分裂得越快，最终蜕壳进化。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME seems to be confident that its armor will protect it and will try to fight against any Pokémon it encounters. The more battles it wins, the faster the cells inside its body divide, until it eventually sheds its shell to evolve.

entry: POKENAME似乎确信护甲能保护自己，遇到什么宝可梦，都想打一架。胜得越多，体内细胞就分裂得越快，最终蜕壳进化。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME seems to be confident that its armor will protect it and will try to fight against any Pokémon it encounters. The more battles it wins, the faster the cells inside its body divide, until it eventually sheds its shell to evolve.

entry: POKENAME大多时候，歇在彩虹脚下，为进化保存能量。据说，只要带着它蜕下的壳片，就能获得好运。
author: badtothebow
source: POKENAME spends most of its time resting at the foot of rainbows, conserving energy for its evolution. The shell it sheds is said to bestow luck unto those who carry its fragments.

entry: POKENAME蜷成球，睡在冰洞深处。褶边般的甲片，能抵御伏击；沉睡时，周围气温，还会下降十度。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME sleeps curled in a ball deep within icy caves. Its frilled plating wards off ambushes, and the surrounding air drops by ten degrees as it slumbers.

entry: POKENAME的钢甲，抵挡攻击，让它们有充分时间，逃离危险。蜷成球以后，几乎无从下手，既能承受酷热，也能抵挡碾压之力。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME's steel armor helps protect them from attack, giving them ample time to escape from danger. By curling up into a ball, they are practically untouchable, able to withstand both intense heat and crushing force.

entry: POKENAME几乎完全不动，靠念动力悬浮，移动位置。它用精神能量，为训练家与亲近的对象，投射出保护外壳。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME stays almost entirely motionless, moving around through telekinetic levitation. It uses psychic energy to project protective shells around its Trainer and those dear to it.

entry: POKENAME坚韧的鳞片，并非自然长出，因此常能看见它，收集其他龙宝可梦的鳞片。行动不便，通常靠强壮的手臂与爪子，攀爬崖壁。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's tough scales do not grow naturally, so it can be seen collecting other Dragon Pokémon's scales. It has trouble getting around, usually scaling cliff faces with its strong arms and claws.

entry: POKENAME行动不便，裹在壳中的形态，也缺乏有效防御。为弥补，它能在周围凝成幽灵般的团块，吓退潜在危险。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME lacks mobility and effective ways to defend its shelled form. To compensate, it has the ability to form a spectral mass around itself to frighten potential dangers away.

entry: POKENAME挖掘广阔的洞穴网络，坚韧的鳞片，保护它免遭落石碎屑伤害。多数攻击，都不放在眼里，不过，谁打扰挖掘，它就会赶走谁。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME can be found digging out large cave systems, with its tough scales shielding it from falling debris. While not fazed by most attacks, it will chase away anyone that disturbs its digging.

entry: POKENAME大半身体披着壳，保护更强，速度与灵活性，却有所下降。尽管如此，它仍是高效的猎手，偶尔甚至能捕食三首恶龙这类凶猛的生物。
author: sk372
source: The shell coating much of POKENAME's body gives it additional protection, but hampers its speed and maneuverability somewhat. Despite this, it is an efficient hunter, able to prey even on vicious creatures such as Hydreigon on occasion.

entry: 它只需阳光便能维生，行动却极其缓慢，为进化保留部分养分。身体中央大半由硬壳保护，双腿也能缩进壳里。
author: infinex21
source: It needs only sunlight to sustain itself, but it moves very slow to conserve some of its nutrients for its evolution. Most of its central body is protected by a hard shell that it can withdraw its legs into.

entry: POKENAME的外壳几乎无法穿透，可重量与体积庞大，游泳极其缓慢。它在海底滤食，等待蜕壳的那一天，好能更自由地游动。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's exterior shell is almost impenetrable, but the heavy weight and huge size means it swims at an incredibly slow pace. It filter-feeds at the ocean bottom, awaiting the day it sheds its shell and can swim more freely.

entry: 厚厚的铁壳，保护POKENAME的头，免遭塌方与伏击。它不断搜寻铁矿，吃下去，强化护甲。
author: .izik
source: A thick iron shell shields POKENAME's head from cave-ins and ambushes. It constantly searches for iron ore, which it consumes to reinforce its armor.

entry: POKENAME提前长出了翅膀，可沉重的带壳身体仍在，行动不够灵活。不过，只要能飞上一点，它就欣喜若狂，一有机会，便开心地滑翔。
author: sk372
source: Wings have developed early for POKENAME, but its heavy shelled body remaining means it's not as agile as it could be. It is still overjoyed to have attained some measure of flight, and glides about happily whenever it can.

entry: POKENAME的身体几乎完全改变，只剩翅膀尚未发育。它焦躁不安，迫不及待地等待完整进化，终于能够飞翔。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's body has almost fully changed, with only the wings left to develop. It is anxious and restless, impatiently waiting for when it evolves fully and can finally achieve flight.

entry: POKENAME用触须，从洞穴家园的墙上采集苔藓。夜里，它将苔藓盖在身上，避免冲突，等待进化。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its feelers to gather moss from the walls of its cavern home. At night it covers itself in this moss to avoid confrontation while it waits to evolve.

entry: POKENAME的中心比空气还轻，周围的壳却很重，因此只能低速、低空飞行。尽管如此，只要能以任何方式飞起来，它似乎就开心极了。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's heavy shell around a lighter-than-air center means it can only fly at slow speeds and low altitudes. Despite this, it seems overjoyed at being capable of any type of flight at all.

entry: POKENAME的手与耳朵，覆着沉重甲片，很难迅速移动。它便用甲片拍开威胁，再往更安全的地方挪去。
author: chibitales
