source: The heavy plating on its hands and ears makes it hard for POKENAME to move quickly. Instead, it uses these plates to bat away threats and moves to a safer location.

entry: 古老记录提到，POKENAME曾协助山地救援。厚甲让它能毫发无伤地穿过雪崩，将幸存者带到安全处。
author: .izik
source: Ancient records tell of POKENAME aiding in mountain rescues. Its heavy plating allowed it to march through avalanches unscathed, carrying survivors to safety.

entry: POKENAME仗着防护衬层，有时会鲁莽得过头，常用头撞远比自己强的宝可梦。无聊时，两个头还会互撞取乐。
author: mistymagius
source: Due to their protective padding, POKENAME can be incredibly reckless, often headbutting Pokémon far stronger than themselves. When they are bored, the two heads will start headbutting each other for fun.

entry: POKENAME大半身体，覆着坚硬的骨质鳞片。壳内细胞不断分裂，为进化作准备，让它的三个头，总是饥肠辘辘。
author: .jerden
source: Most of POKENAME's body is covered in hard, bony scales. Within this shell cells are constantly dividing to prepare it for evolution, making POKENAME's three heads constantly hungry.

entry: POKENAME大半身体，覆着坚硬的骨质鳞片。壳内细胞不断分裂，为进化作准备，让它的三个头，总是饥肠辘辘。
author: .jerden
source: Most of POKENAME's body is covered in hard, bony scales. Within this shell cells are constantly dividing to prepare it for evolution, making POKENAME's three heads constantly hungry.

entry: POKENAME结成关系紧密的群体，爬过洞穴，寻找银矿。一群只需一周，就能吃掉五十多吨。
author: .izik
source: In tight-knit packs, POKENAME scuttles through caverns in search of silver ore. A single group can consume over 50 tons in just one week.

entry: POKENAME进化之前，几乎从不移动。构成外甲的甲片，摸起来，竟出奇地温暖。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME rarely ever moves until it has evolved. The plates that composed the outer armor for POKENAME are oddly warm to touch.

entry: POKENAME的壳十分沉重，会拖累它攀附的飞行宝可梦。吸收的静电越多，体内细胞变化越快，也就越接近进化。
author: soup1900
source: The heaviness of POKENAME's shell causes it to weigh down aerial Pokémon it clings onto. The more static electricity it absorbs, the faster the cells within its body change, and the closer it gets to evolution.

entry: POKENAME的鳞片很耐打，生长却不够快，无法真正帮助战斗。它通常藏在偏僻洞穴，等鳞片长够，才会出来。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's scales are quite resistant to damage, but it doesn't grow them quickly enough to really aid it in battle. It usually hides away in isolated caves, only coming out once it has grown enough scales.

entry: POKENAME滑过隧道，从金属身体发出声呐脉冲。即使一片漆黑，它也能探明整个洞穴系统的布局。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME glides through tunnels, emitting sonar pulses from its metallic body. It can map an entire cave system in pitch-black darkness.

entry: POKENAME的壳坚韧又富有弹性，能在各种地形上滚动。它们常从高高的山丘滚下加速，一旦滚起来，几乎就停不住。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's shell is tough but elastic, allowing it to roll on any terrain it chooses. They tend to roll down large hills to build speed; once they start rolling, they are almost impossible to stop.

entry: POKENAME背上厚甲，能抵御更大的宝可梦。受到威胁时，它会蜷成球，护住较柔软的腹部。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME has a heavily armoured back that protects it from larger Pokémon. When threatened, it curls into a ball to shield its softer underbelly from harm.

entry: POKENAME坚韧的甲壳与粗糙的鳞片，保护它免受捕食者伤害。它无畏地冲过开阔水域，趁猎物尚未察觉，就将其捕获。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's tough carapace and rough scales protect it from predators. It darts fearlessly across open waters, picking off prey before they can react to its presence.

entry: 它大多待在壳里，却喜欢头撞路过的训练家。平时不怎么动，通常靠在壳中翻滚，挪动位置。
author: mistymagius
source: While it mostly stays in its shell, it has a tendency to headbutt passing Trainers. It doesn't move very much, usually getting around by rolling around in its shell.

entry: POKENAME的蘑菇，有厚厚的几丁质层，保护柔软身体。它们能完全缩进菌盖里，躲到危险过去。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME mushrooms have thick, chitinous layers that protect their soft body from harm. They can pull themselves totally inside the bell of their mushroom, hiding away until the danger's passed.

entry: POKENAME虽然常与同类切磋，却更以防御动作自豪。鳞片既坚韧，又灵活，不易被扭得变形。
author: mistymagius
source: While POKENAME often gets into sparring matches with one another, they pride themselves on their defensive maneuvers. Their scales are both tough and flexible, preventing them from being bent out of shape.

entry: POKENAME虽然行动不快，等待进化时，仍会撞向岩石与树木，进一步锻炼身体。厚甲让多数攻击，都直接弹开。
author: .jerden
source: Although POKENAME cannot move quickly, they will throw themselves against rocks and trees to harden their bodies further while waiting to evolve. Their thick armor makes most attacks simply bounce off.

entry: 战斗中，POKENAME将松弛的皮肤举过头顶，绷硬成金属般的盾牌。它信赖自己的护甲，头朝前，冲向敌人。
author: .izik
source: In battle, POKENAME hoists its loose skin over its head and stiffens it into a metal-like shield. POKENAME charges headfirst into foes, confident in its armor.

entry: 覆身的肌肉甲片，让它能激烈战斗，不必担心受伤。野外，这种POKENAME，常在丰缘岩石嶙峋的山顶筑巢。
author: fiordaliso
source: The muscular plates covering its body allow it to fight fiercely without worrying about getting hurt. In the wild, this variant of POKENAME tends to nest on the rocky peaks of Hoenn.

entry: 野外，这种形态的POKENAME，常在关都的岩石洞穴安家。与另一只龙属性宝可梦激战时，尾部火焰，就会膨胀得十分巨大。
author: fiordaliso
source: In the wild, this form of POKENAME tends to make its home in the rocky caves located in Kanto. When it fights fiercely against another Dragon-type Pokémon, the flame on its tail swells to great proportions.

entry: POKENAME全身覆着一圈防护肌肉，能吸收任何打击的冲击。它威风地翱翔天空，向同类挑战，比比谁能飞得最高。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME's body is covered in a protective band of muscle that absorbs the impact of any blow. It soars through the sky with majesty, challenging others of its species to see who can reach the highest altitude.

entry: 从未有人见过POKENAME离开外壳，头部的真实构造，对研究者仍是谜。数英寸厚的外壳，长有水晶加固，形成异常坚韧的防御。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have never been observed outside of their shells, the true structure of their head remaining unknown to researchers. Their shells are several inches thick and are reinforced with crystalline growths, forming an incredibly tough defence.

entry: 它需要吸收大量太阳能，维持铁质身体运作，因此尽可能长时间晒太阳。背上的齿轮转动时，会释放金属粉尘，吸入后便会中毒。
author: fiordaliso
source: It needs to absorb a considerable amount of solar energy to keep its iron body functioning, so it spends as much time as possible basking in sunlight. When the gear on its back spins, it releases a metallic dust that is toxic to those who inhale it.

entry: POKENAME通常生活在废品场，大吃废料，不过有些群体会侵入设施。它们吞食金属，咬断电线，大肆破坏，是极大的麻烦。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: While POKENAME normally live in junkyards and feast on scrap, some groups invade facilities. They are a major nuisance, causing havoc by devouring metal and chewing through cords.

entry: POKENAME能高速旋转，产生庞大的电力，最终甚至引发爆炸。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME can revolve so fast and generate so much electricity that they eventually explode.

entry: POKENAME吃废品场与垃圾填埋场中的旧电子设备时，长长的金属舌头，会噼啪闪出零星火花。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's long, metallic tongue crackles with stray sparks as it eats discarded electronics found in junkyards and landfills.

entry: POKENAME通常藏在废品场，借金属茧的形状，装成一枚普通的废齿轮。多数人都不会理会，让它能安静地完成进化。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME generally hides away in junkyards, where the shape of its metal cocoon lets it masquerade as a simple scrapped gear and be ignored by most until its evolution can complete.

entry: POKENAME在领地里发现东西，就让齿轮高速转动，为奔跑冲撞蓄力。一旦撞上，冲击会让齿轮暂时短路，使它愣在原地。
author: sk372
source: When POKENAME spots something in its territory, its gears churn at high speeds to power up a running charge. Once it hits something, the impact temporarily shorts out its gears, leaving it stunned.

entry: 金属皮肤坚硬得，即使建筑倒塌砸在身上，也不会留下凹痕。不过，POKENAME极怕热，内部机关会因受热膨胀而卡死，冷却前，完全无法移动。
author: .jerden
source: Its metallic hide is hard enough to not be dented even if a building falls on it. However, POKENAME is very vulnerable to heat, as it can cause its internal mechanisms to expand and lock up, completely immobilizing it until it cools down.

entry: POKENAME由少数基础零件组成，最显眼的，是背上的上弦钥匙。年轻工程师学习时，常被安排维护它们，按需替换磨损的部件。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME consist of a few basic parts, most notably the turnkey on their back. Young engineers are often tasked with maintaining POKENAME as part of their studies, replacing worn components as necessary.

entry: POKENAME生活在废品场、垃圾填埋场和废弃建筑中。用金属筑巢时，它们似乎会本能地将巢，建成花朵的形状。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: POKENAME live in junkyards, landfills, and abandoned buildings. When constructing their nests out of metal, they seem to instinctively build them in the shape of flowers.

entry: POKENAME喜欢转动齿轮状的头，模仿机器。它乐在其中，可许多人却觉得，诡异又不舒服。
author: h0bojoe
source: POKENAME adores mimicking machinery by turning its gear-shaped head. Although it delights in this, many people find it creepy or off-putting.

entry: 可惜，POKENAME的钢铁身体很容易生锈。若非繁殖速度快，它们恐怕早已灭绝。
author: dylonk25
source: Unfortunately, POKENAME's steel bodies are quite susceptible to rust. They would likely be extinct if not for their fast rate of reproduction.

entry: POKENAME体内旋转的齿轮，产生变身所需的能量。想变的形态越大，就要转得越久，才能完成变化。
author: sk372
source: The gear spinning inside POKENAME's body generates the energy needed to fuel a transformation. The bigger the form it wants to change into, the longer it has to churn before it can transform.

entry: POKENAME常出没于垃圾填埋场附近，翻找成堆的废弃电子设备。进食时，齿轮会呼呼作响，飞速旋转。
author: .izik
source: Often found near landfills, POKENAME digs through heaps of discarded electronics. Its gears whirr and spin furiously while it feeds.

entry: POKENAME是颇受欢迎的幼童礼物。转动侧面的曲柄，就会播放音乐；乐曲达到高潮时，它会从盒中弹出，再用数码歌声，唱出自己的版本。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a fairly popular gift for young children. Turning the crank on its side plays a tune, and POKENAME pops out of the box at the climax of the song, before singing its own digitized rendition.

entry: 有人认为，POKENAME的身体设计有缺陷，因为胸前齿轮，偶尔会卡住，使它无法使用超能力。它能自行强转齿轮，重新启动，不过似乎十分痛苦。
author: sk372
source: Some think that POKENAME's body has a defective design, as the gears in its chest occasionally jam and leave it unable to use psychic powers. It can forcibly turn and start its gear on its own, but doing so seems to be a painful effort.

entry: POKENAME转动齿轮，产生并微调精神能量，用来复制任何招式。它似乎十分依恋这几枚齿轮，不肯接受替代品。
author: imaginita
source: POKENAME spins its gears to generate and fine-tune its psychic energy, using them to replicate any move. It seems very attached to these particular gears and will not accept substitutions.

entry: POKENAME必须从背部，排出暗色火焰，散去多余热量。火也会产生呛鼻的黑烟，有人担忧，它可能造成环境污染。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME needs to rid itself of excess heat by venting dark flames from its back. The fire creates acrid black smoke as well, and some have raised environmental concerns about the potential pollution it could cause.

entry: POKENAME使出最强招式前，会加大体内燃烧，做好准备，使火焰从尾部喷涌而出。声音被形容为，缩小版的汽车引擎声。
author: sk372
source: Before using its strongest moves, POKENAME readies itself by revving its internal combustion, making flames erupt from its tail. The sound has been likened to a miniature version of a car's engine.

entry: POKENAME嘴里有独特的机关，像捕鼠夹一样。舌头一受压，嘴就会猛然合拢，夹住食物或肢体。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a unique mechanism in their mouths that functions like a mousetrap. When pressure is applied to the tongue, they snap their mouths closed to ensnare food or limbs.

entry: 据说，POKENAME曾是帝牙卢卡的部下。如今，它主要作为老年人的伙伴宝可梦出现。
author: taka_re
source: It is said that POKENAME was once a subordinate of Dialga. Nowadays POKENAME is mainly seen as a partner Pokémon for the elderly.

entry: 给背上的钥匙上弦，能增强POKENAME战斗中的电力，不过必须小心；拧得太多，就会过载，无法控制地向四周放电。
author: sk372
source: The key on its back can be wound to increase POKENAME's electric powers in battle, but caution is needed; winding it too much will cause it to overload and uncontrollably send jolts of lightning all around it.

entry: 它们会用气球漂浮，避开沙土与砂砾的伤害。在有毒物泄漏、正在恢复的工厂里，它们既能工作，也能充当备用发电机。
author: quackquackattack
source: They are known to float using an Air Balloon, helping them avoid damage from sand, dirt, and grit. They work in factory facilities that are recovering from toxic spills, as they double as backup generators.

entry: POKENAME转动颈边的齿轮，产生电力。它们在工厂里，给制造汽车零件的大型机器供能。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME generate electricity by rotating the gear around their neck. They work in factories where they power large machinery that produces car parts.

entry: POKENAME常在自助洗衣店帮忙，折叠衣服。洗衣机全被占用时，它会让训练家，改用自己能消毒的嘴，代替洗衣机。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME commonly helps out in laundromats, where it helps fold clothes. When all the washing machines are occupied, it will allow Trainers to use its sanitizing mouth as a replacement.

entry: 人们常买来POKENAME，陪伴向尾喵。它们喜欢一起玩，轮流追逐彼此。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME are often bought as companions for Skitty. They love playing together and will take turns chasing each other.

entry: POKENAME栖居在废弃工厂，从一根管道，荡到另一根。察觉附近有捕食者，就会将钹状的双手，撞在一起，警告同伴。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME inhabits abandoned factories, swinging from pipe to pipe. When it detects a predator nearby, it bangs its cymbal-like hands together to alert others.

entry: POKENAME走路时，会来回倾斜头部。头里的机关，与脚部直接相连，因此必须这样摆动，才能向前移动。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME tilts its head back and forth as it walks. The motion is necessary for forward momentum, as mechanisms in its head connect directly to those in its feet.

entry: POKENAME身体有个奇特之处，一看见水，就会渴得厉害。它反复低头入水，再仰起喝下，直到把水喝光。
author: sk372
source: A quirk in POKENAME's body causes it to become incredibly thirsty the moment it spots water. It will repeatedly dip its head into water and pull back to drink, until all the liquid is drank.

entry: 这种POKENAME能靠吃树果，补充能量，即使长时间阴雨，也能保持活跃。背上的齿轮开始逆时针转动，就表示它已准备战斗。
author: fiordaliso
source: This variant of POKENAME can replenish energy through the Berries it feeds on, allowing it to remain active even during prolonged rainy periods. When the gear on its back begins spinning counterclockwise, it signals that POKENAME is ready for battle.

entry: POKENAME由发条驱动，接受的阳光多少，决定齿轮的转速。正午阳光下，身体足够温暖，齿轮能以最高效率运转，让它们快速移动。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are Pokémon powered by clockwork, the speed at which their gears turn varying depending on how much sunlight they receive. Under the midday sun they are warm enough that their gears can run at peak efficiency, letting them move at speed.

entry: POKENAME努力理解人类，希望用现代技术，升级自己的系统。可惜，一动起来，老旧机械的呼呼声，就常把多数训练家吓跑。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME seek to understand humans in pursuit of upgrading their systems with modern technology. Unfortunately, the outdated mechanical whirring that starts up whenever they move often ends up scaring most Trainers away.

entry: 它用特殊的胶，将自己黏在金属表面。有些训练家，会让POKENAME守着自行车，防止被偷。
author: oddwalls
source: Using a specialized glue, it adheres itself to metal surfaces. Some Trainers use POKENAME to prevent their bicycles from being stolen.

entry: POKENAME夜里滑过建筑工地，啃穿推土机。消化金属，能强化自己用于碾磨的齿轮。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME glides through construction sites at night, chewing through bulldozers. It digests metal to reinforce its own grinding gears.

entry: POKENAME虽有钢铁外骨骼，却比赫拉克罗斯更轻。它们会用锯齿状肢体弄坏捕虫陷阱，再吃掉诱饵，在捕虫训练家间恶名昭彰。
author: vibrationjaveline
source: Despite POKENAME's steel exoskeletons, they are lighter than a Heracross. They are notorious among Bug Catchers for breaking traps set for Bug-types with their jagged limbs and eating the bait.

entry: 它的手能伸出多种工具，分别应付不同任务。POKENAME烦躁时，头部通风口会涌出浓烟，情绪越激烈，烟就越浓。
author: jaminmcready
source: Its hand extends with multiple tools, each designed for a different task it faces. When POKENAME is agitated, thick smoke pours from the vents on its head, growing heavier with the intensity of its emotions.

entry: POKENAME下半身的金属，虽未熔融，温度却足够让它像液体般流动。不知为何，头部不停转动的齿轮，能驱使它前行，而它似乎永远无法停下。
author: .jerden
source: Although it is not molten, the metal of POKENAME's lower body is warm enough to flow like liquid. Somehow, the constantly turning gears in POKENAME's head drive it forward, and it seems unable to ever stop moving.

entry: POKENAME不停吃煤炭或泥土，再在体内燃烧，驱动自己，时速最高可达35英里。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME constantly eats coal or soil, which it burns in its body to power itself. It can reach speeds of up to 35 mph.

entry: POKENAME身体沉重，动作僵硬，几乎不可能飞行。刀刃般的翅膀，却能当作投射武器发射，用后，再返回身上。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's heavy body and stiff movements make flying nearly impossible for it. It's blade-like wings can be fired off as projectiles that will return to POKENAME's body after use.

entry: POKENAME高速翻滚，冲过荒地。释放一阵阵电力时，齿轮上，便有火花飞溅。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME charges across wastelands while rolling at high speed. Sparks fly from its gear as it discharges bursts of electricity.

entry: POKENAME试着轻巧地跳过森林，可多数旁观者，却形容它的动作怪异诡谲。夜里，金属鹿角似乎还会发出，奇怪的无线电波。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME tries to prance daintily through the forest, but most onlookers describe its movements as strange and uncanny. Odd radio waves seem to emanate from its metallic antlers at night.

entry: POKENAME有个独特本领，能画出完美的圆。虽然对战斗没用，却很受某些设计师与工程师重视。
author: bostroms
source: POKENAME has the unique ability to draw perfect circles.  This isn't useful in battle, but it is valued by certain designers and engineers.

entry: POKENAME有个独特本领，能画出完美的圆。虽然对战斗没用，却很受某些设计师与工程师重视。
author: bostroms
source: POKENAME has the unique ability to draw perfect circles.  This isn't useful in battle, but it is valued by certain designers and engineers.

entry: POKENAME在废弃纺织厂安家，啃食被遗忘的机器。进食充能时，体内电能涌动，发出嗡鸣。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME makes its home in abandoned textile factories, gnawing on forgotten machines. Its body hums with electric energy as it feeds and powers up.

entry: POKENAME虽然难以寻觅，仍因一种奇妙功能，受到追寻。因进水而停摆的机器，只需在它身边待上一小会儿，就能重新运作。
author: sk372
source: Though highly elusive, POKENAME has been sought out due to a curious functionality it has exhibited. Machines that have stopped functioning due to water damage will begin working again after a short amount of exposure to POKENAME's presence.

entry: 维持POKENAME生命的，是体内齿轮的转动，而非心跳。它用头上的金属尖刺钻土，再用背部旋转的齿轮，磨碎金属矿石，吃下细粉。
author: .jerden
source: Instead of a heartbeat, POKENAME is kept alive by the turning of its internal gears. It uses the sharp metal spike on its head to burrow through the soil,  grinding up metallic ores with the spinning gear on its back, then consuming the fine powder.

entry: 强大的力量，将POKENAME的两副身体连在一起，即使它喷出高压气体、高速冲撞，也不会分开。仔细聆听内部的滴答声，会发现两者的齿轮，完全同步。
author: .jerden
source: A powerful force holds together POKENAME's two bodies, even as it vents high-pressure gas to slam into foes at high speed. Listening carefully to the ticking sounds coming from within indicates that gears inside both of them are perfectly in synch.

entry: 它能暂时让四肢脱离，远距离攻击，不过不久就必须返回，以免耗尽能量。若四肢全失，它便释放强烈的磁波，扰乱旁人，直到找回身体部件。
author: sk372
source: It can temporarily detach its limbs to attack from afar, though they must return shortly  before they run out of power. If deprived of all its limbs, it radiates intense magnetic waves to disorient others until it can retrieve its body parts.

entry: POKENAME藏在玩具店，与陈列商品融为一体。毫不知情的训练家，将它带回家后，它便开始啃食，家中的电子设备。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME hides itself in toy stores, blending in among the products on display. When an unsuspecting Trainer brings the Pokémon home, POKENAME begins snacking on the household's electronics.

entry: 战斗中，POKENAME身上的齿轮，会加快转动，产生高热。据说，许多著名发明家，亲眼见过它的壮丽模样后，都曾灵感迸发。
author: mepp.
source: In battle, the gears on POKENAME's body rotate faster to generate intense heat. It's said that many famous inventors were blessed with a surge of inspiration after witnessing its magnificence.

entry: POKENAME与玩具工匠合作，制造有趣的机关，吸引孩子的注意。难得没工作时，它们就抛接齿轮，打发时间。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME work alongside toymakers to produce fun contraptions to capture the attention of children. On the rare occasion that there is no work, they juggle gears to pass the time.

entry: POKENAME手臂上，虽有多种工具延伸部件，进化后，却特别偏爱电锯臂。训练家常得反复教导，哪些东西能锯，哪些不能。
author: beatdoof
source: While POKENAME has a variety of tool extensions on its arms, evolution has made it strongly favor using its chainsaw arm. Trainers often have to repeatedly teach POKENAME what it can and can't rip up.

entry: 一个个齿轮旋转生能，再经头顶天线，将能量转化为磁波。
author: chorb33
source: The individual gears rotate and generate energy, which is converted into magnetic waves via the antenna on the head.

entry: 外面的大齿轮，只起带刺护甲的作用，POKENAME金属身体的动作，其实由内部机关驱动。鼻上的角是钻头，能高速旋转，钻穿岩石。
author: .jerden
source: While the large cogs on its exterior only function as spiky armor, the movements of POKENAME's metallic body are powered by internal mechanisms. The horn on its nose is a drill, and can be spun at high speed to bore through rock.

entry: 研究者偶尔会将蜷起的POKENAME，误认成某种沾沙的机械古物。只要试着拾起，它就会钻入深深的地下。
author: deelee2020
source: Researchers have occasionally mistaken a curled-up POKENAME for some sort of sandy, mechanical artifact. Trying to pick it up will result in it burrowing deep into the ground.

entry: POKENAME在工厂和建筑工地，与人合作，体型小巧，能伸进狭窄处。它很享受工作带来的触感，常得训练家提醒，才肯休息。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME works alongside people in factories and construction sites, where its small size allows it to reach into tight spaces. It enjoys the tactile sensation work provides, needing reminders from its Trainer to rest.

entry: POKENAME身上的金属，能吸收阳光，化作能量。许多种西兰花的农民，会请它守护、耕作农田。
author: .izik
source: The metal on POKENAME's body can absorb sunlight to use as energy. Many broccoli farmers employ it to defend and work their farmlands.

entry: 它不停活动双腿，产生维生的能量，连睡觉也不例外。只要能量充足，体内火焰就强盛；坚硬的身体若冷却，便意味着健康不佳。
author: infinex21
source: It generates the energy it needs to live by always moving its legs, even while asleep. Its internal flames remain strong as long as it has energy; if its hard body ever cools, it is a sign that it is in poor health.

entry: POKENAME跑过山地，产生生存所需的能量。休息时，齿轮状的头会慢慢转动。一感到储能降低，它就醒来，再次奔跑。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME runs through mountainous terrain to generate the energy it needs to live. When POKENAME rests, its gear head slowly spins. This Pokémon wakes up when it feels its reserves are growing low and begins running again.

entry: POKENAME的齿轮头，规律转动，维持能量。它喜欢泡泥洼，却得小心，免得泥垢堵住齿轮，使转速下降，身体出问题。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's gear-shaped head rotates regularly to keep its energy up. It enjoys taking dips in mud puddles, but must be careful lest the mud gunk up its gear, slowing its rotation and causing physical issues.

entry: POKENAME在水力发电厂附近筑巢，夜里附在厂上，吸取电力。到了白天，它却有一种奇特本领，能提高电厂的产能。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME makes its nest near hydroelectric power plants, latching onto them to siphon power at night. During the day, it has an odd ability to increase the plant's productivity.

entry: POKENAME齿轮的转速，取决于周围的情绪。正面情绪，让齿轮顺畅运转，负面情绪，则会使其迟滞，也让它显得病恹恹。
author: sk372
source: The rate at which POKENAME's gear turns depends on the emotions around it. Positive emotions let it turn smoothly, while negative emotions cause it to lag, which in turn causes POKENAME to act sickly.

entry: POKENAME巨大的耳齿轮，对周围十分敏感，赋予它极佳的听觉与感知力。受惊时，齿轮飞快转动，增强灵活性，让它更容易逃离危险。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's large ear-gears are finely tuned to its surroundings, giving it excellent hearing and senses. When startled, the gears churn quickly and enhance its mobility so it can better flee from danger.

entry: POKENAME的金属身体，覆着油层，能随环境变色。它藏在废弃工厂中，伪装得毫无破绽。
author: .izik
source: An oily coating allows POKENAME's metal body to shift color with its surroundings. It hides in derelict factories, perfectly camouflaged.

entry: POKENAME用超能力，操纵重型机器，凭高超的计算，完成精确动作。它帮助使用腐蚀酸液的研究者，发现并制造新的化学物质。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME operates heavy machinery by using its psychic power, its advanced calculations allowing it to produce precise movements. It helps researchers working with corrosive acids to discover and produce new chemicals.

entry: 工厂维修时，POKENAME会用微弱的精神波，影响工人。看着机器顺畅运转，它会获得深深的满足。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses subtle psychic waves to influence factory workers during repairs. It finds deep satisfaction in watching machinery run smoothly.

entry: 喂它原木，它就会吐出木板，再用这些板材制作简单的手工艺品。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: When fed logs, it dispenses planks of wood which it then uses to construct simple crafts.

entry: POKENAME有保护本能，尤其照顾年幼、弱小的钢属性宝可梦。背部大齿轮高速转动，能让它吐出热蒸汽，遮蔽四周，方便自己与受保护的小家伙逃走。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has protective instincts, primarily for young and small Steel-type Pokémon. The large gear on its back can churn at high speeds to let POKENAME breathe a hot steam that obscures the area, facilitating escape for it and its charges.

entry: POKENAME的身体相当僵硬，便用头顶的巨爪，完成更精细的动作。它们常在废品场，帮忙拆解汽车，搬运沉重废料。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME's bodies are quite rigid, using the massive claws on their heads for more fine-tuned movements. They are often used in scrapyards, helping to dismantle cars and move heavy scrap.

entry: POKENAME能感知未来技术故障的位置与原因，对工程师而言，是十分有用的帮手。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: POKENAME can sense the sites and causes of future technical failures. This makes it a very useful tool for engineers.

entry: POKENAME在废弃的技术设备仓库作祟，住进残留的齿轮与电线之间，还会取其中一件，当作自己的脸。
author: lesbian_garlicbread
source: POKENAME haunts abandoned technical warehouses. It makes itself home in the leftover gears and wires, taking one for its own face.

entry: 将POKENAME头上的钥匙，转动几圈，就能补充能量，提高速度与力量。不过，转得太多，它就会失控，甚至彻底瘫倒。
author: sk372
source: Turning the key on POKENAME's head a few times boosts its energy, hastening its speed and increasing its strength. Turning too much will cause it to act haywire or even collapse completely, however.

entry: POKENAME的火焰，燃着奇异的银色。谁若试着阻止齿轮旋转，它就会勃然大怒。
author: deelee2020
source: POKENAME's fire burns an odd silvery color. It will become furious if one attempts to stop the gears from spinning.

entry: POKENAME巨大的耳齿轮，对周围十分敏感，赋予它极佳的听觉与感知力。受惊时，齿轮飞快转动，增强力量，让它更能应对危险。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's large ear-gears are finely tuned to its surroundings, giving it excellent hearing and senses. When startled, the gears churn quickly and enhance its strength, improving its ability to combat danger.

entry: 比起蹒跚走路，POKENAME更爱沿雪面滑行，因为滑动能带动齿轮，提供维生的能量。遇上平坦雪地，它们就用双脚，蹬着冰面前进。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME prefer tobogganing to waddling as the sliding action helps turn the gears and provide them the energy needed to survive. If they are on flat, snowy land, POKENAME will use their feet to propel themselves across the icy surface.

entry: 钥匙不转，POKENAME就静止不动。妥善上弦后，它便稳步向前，从大鼻子喷出蒸汽，发出尖细的哨声。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME remains stationary until its key is turned. Once properly wound up, it marches forward at a steady pace, puffing out steam from its large nose with a high-pitched whistle.

entry: POKENAME的齿轮，能让剑刃不断振动，切入受害者体内。夺来的生命力，则为它持续供能。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME's gears cause its blade to vibrate, cutting into the body of its victims. It is continuously powered by the life force it harvests.

entry: POKENAME以防御姿态开始战斗，承受攻击，通过旋转的齿轮盾牌蓄能。充满以后，就进入攻击状态，拔出刀刃，齿轮上的光，也变成红色。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME starts combat in a defensive stance, absorbing blows and gathering energy through its rotating gear-shield. Once fully charged, it enters attack mode, unsheathing its blade as the light on its gear turns red.

entry: POKENAME体内众多齿轮，配合运作，提供能量与行动能力。同时全力转动时，它就能移动得极快，不过也会变得，异常凶暴。
author: sk372
source: The many gears comprising POKENAME's internals work in conjunction to provide it energy and mobility. Churning at max power simultaneously, POKENAME can move incredibly fast, but becomes incredibly aggressive as well.

entry: POKENAME头上的齿轮若被停住，它便僵在原地，无法攻击。齿轮重新启动后，又会以猛烈的速度，继续行动。
author: deelee2020
source: If the gear on POKENAME's head is halted, it becomes frozen in place, unable to attack. Once the gear restarts, it continues with furious speed.

entry: POKENAME全身众多转动的齿轮，为攻防提供庞大的能量储备。不过，战术极其简单，只顾四处猛砸，几乎不考虑策略。
author: sk372
source: Many gears turning across POKENAME's body give it vast reservoirs of energy for offense and defense. Its tactics in battle are incredibly basic though, smashing about with little strategic thought involved.

entry: POKENAME靠强化的轮子，缓缓前进。一见其他宝可梦闯入家园，就会高速冲过去，飞快转动双臂，再用尾巴猛砸敌人。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME trundle forward on reinforced wheels, racing forward at high speed when they spy another Pokémon encroaching on their home territory. They fight by whirling their arms at high speed and slamming their tails into their foes.

entry: POKENAME是完全由钢铁构成的庞大生灵，巨大的齿轮，坚不可摧，使四肢不停运动。传说，只要它愿意，力量足以逆转世界的转动。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is a colossal being made entirely of steel, with massive indestructible gears that keep its limbs in constant motion. Legends say it has enough power to reverse the world's rotation if it ever wished to.

entry: 这种宝可梦起初被认为，很适合流水线作业，如今却调整功能，适应战斗。炮会根据敌人的构成改变，并获取外部数据，预测、反制对手的招式。
author: jaminmcready
source: Originally thought to be ideal for assembly-line labor, this Pokémon has adapted its functions to suit combat situations. Its cannon modulates based on enemy composition, feeding on external data to predict and counter its opponent's moves.

entry: 人们发现，用背部齿轮连接机器后，这些宝可梦能充当极其有用的高输出电容器。储能上限虽然不明，却能长时间持续输出，高达十万兆瓦时的能量。
author: the_cardinals
source: These Pokémon were found to be extremely useful as high-output capacitors when linked to machinery through the gear on their backs. While it is unknown how much energy they can store, they are able to output at 100,000 MWh for extended durations.

entry: 它的灯泡，发出自然的蓝光，亮度随情绪变化。平静时，光芒轻轻闪烁；兴奋或恐惧时，则会炽亮地照遍四周。
author: jaminmcready
source: Its bulb emits a natural blue glow that shifts in intensity with its emotions. When calm, the light flickers gently, but during moments of excitement or fear, it blazes brightly, illuminating its surroundings.

entry: POKENAME核心里的蓝色灯泡，像火焰，却不发热。夜里，它停在起重机顶，灯泡发亮，身旁散出细小火花。
author: .izik
source: The blue lightbulb in POKENAME's core resembles a flame but emits no heat. At night, it perches atop cranes, letting loose tiny sparks as its bulb glows.

entry: POKENAME将废弃的电子仓库，划为领地。受到打扰，它便发出刺耳的金属叫声，释放阵阵静电。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME claims abandoned electronics warehouses as its territory. If disturbed, it emits a piercing metallic cry and discharges static bursts.

entry: POKENAME头上的齿轮，看起来只是装饰，体内却总有齿轮转动的声音。谁若善待它，无论人类还是宝可梦，它就会跟在身旁，试着永不分离。
author: .jerden
source: Although the cog on its head seems to just be decorative, gears can always be heard turning inside POKENAME. If any person or Pokémon shows POKENAME kindness, it will start following them around, trying to never be separated from them.

entry: POKENAME在木子果树下钻行时，颈部齿轮，会飞快旋转。它释放道道电击，将树果震落。
author: .izik
source: As it burrows beneath Lum Berry trees, POKENAME's neck gear spins rapidly. It knocks Berries loose by releasing bolts of electricity.

entry: POKENAME筑的坝，由废金属和木头混合而成。尽管如此，似乎从不生锈。
author: deelee2020
source: The dams POKENAME builds are made of a mix of metal scraps and wood. Despite this, they never seem to rust.

entry: POKENAME快速敲打金属，积蓄能量，在城市里十分惹人烦。因此，有人会在镇外放置金属假人，让它们改去练拳。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME build up energy by rapidly hitting metal. This makes them a nuisance in cities, so some choose to place metal dummies by the outskirts of town for POKENAME to punch instead.

entry: POKENAME用钢梁练拳，留下大大的凹痕。它常出没建筑工地，看得见的金属，无一幸免。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME trains by striking steel beams, leaving large dents behind. It frequents construction sites, where no visible metal goes unharmed.

entry: POKENAME喜欢在孩子们身旁玩耍，兴奋奔跑时，尾巴闪着静电火花。可电荷常会电到靠得太近的孩子，还没交上朋友，就把他们赶跑了。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME loves playing around children. Its tail sparks with static energy as it runs excitedly, but the charge often shocks kids who get too close, driving them away before it can make friends.

entry: 为吓退捕食者，POKENAME会发出令人胆寒的尖啸。叫声强烈到，目击者称，自己曾暂时失去听力。
author: dodoowner_
source: To deter predators, POKENAME emits a petrifying screech. This cry is so intense that witnesses report temporarily losing their hearing.

entry: 这种宝可梦，似乎不习惯第三枚齿轮，偶尔不同步，就会让三枚齿轮一起卡住、磨响。不过，完全同步时，POKENAME的力量，会明显增强。
author: fireblade141
source: This Pokémon seems unaccustomed to having a third gear, so it sometimes falls out of sync, resulting in all three gears locking and grinding. However, when the gears are perfectly in sync, POKENAME's power is noticeably boosted.

entry: POKENAME越是斗志高昂，齿轮就转得越快。与其他齿轮啮合，很有危险，只要不完全吻合，就可能磨卡停转。
author: deelee2020
source: POKENAME's gears spin faster the more fired-up it is. Interlocking with other gears is dangerous, as it can grind to a halt if they don't fit perfectly.

entry: POKENAME的滴答声，常用于现场音乐会和表演，提供响亮、稳定的节拍，供乐队成员掌握时机。训练时，它也常被给予节拍器，提高节奏的稳定性。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME's ticking noise is often utilized during live concerts and shows, creating a loud, consistent beat that band members can base their timing on. When training, this Pokémon is often given a Metronome to increase its rhythmic consistency.

entry: POKENAME开心时，会放出带润滑油气味的黄色粉云。附近的机器，一接触粉末，就会以正常的两倍速度运转。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME releases clouds of yellow grease-scented powder when happy. Machines nearby operate at twice their normal speed when exposed to this powder.

entry: POKENAME花朵形的齿轮，带着电能嗡鸣。它用储存的电力，保护同族，抵御盔甲鸟等空中捕食者。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's flower-shaped gears hum with electricity. It uses stored power to defend its kin from aerial predators like Skarmory.

entry: POKENAME浮在野生生物的栖息地上方，为科学家扫描生物特征信息。金属外壳，能在恶劣天气中，稳定动作，方便扫描。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME floats above wild habitats to scan biometric information for scientists. Its metallic shell stabilizes its movement in tough weather conditions, which makes scanning easier.

entry: POKENAME身上覆着金属层，抵御想啃食柔软内部的虫属性宝可梦。它也能快速转动齿轮，甩掉企图钻入的刺尾虫。
author: smissmassentree_81799
source: POKENAME have a layer of metal coating over their body to protect against Bug-types looking to feast on its soft interior. It can also rapidly rotate the gears on its body to shake off any Wurmple that may be trying to break inside.

entry: 每只POKENAME，最终都会形成不同的食谱。有些只吃有机物，有些只吃矿物；极少数，则只靠磁能维生。
author: bobosmith01
source: Each POKENAME will eventually develop a different diet from one another: some will only eat organic foods, while others will just consume minerals. Rarely, there are POKENAME that only rely on magnetic energy in order to live.

entry: 这种宝可梦的绒毛，像钢丝绒，而且永不生锈，因此常被用来清洁医疗设备。
author: deelee2020
source: The fluff on this Pokémon's body resembles steel wool. It's used frequently to clean medical equipment as it never rusts.

entry: POKENAME是机械人造宝可梦，在搜救任务中，探索险恶环境。体型虽小，力气却足以将旅人，从沙漠深处，带到安全地点。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are mechanical, artificial Pokémon that are used to search hostile environments during search and rescue missions. Despite their small size, they are strong enough to carry travellers to safety from the depths of the desert.

entry: POKENAME常躲在废弃工厂，主要以遗留的机械为食。老旧厂房里往往满是它们的身影。
author: daemonkill22
source: POKENAME often shelters within abandoned factories, where the remaining machinery acts as its primary food source. Old industrial plants swarm with this Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME发出可怕的暗影球，保卫古墓。每次攻击前，尾部齿轮，都会因幽灵能量而震动。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME defends ancient tombs by unleashing horrifying Shadow Balls. Its tail gear vibrates with ghostly energy before each attack.

entry: POKENAME吸收电力时，齿轮会高速旋转。电力可以保留数月，具体取决于充电的强度。
author: .izik
source: While absorbing electricity, POKENAME's gears spin at high speed. It can retain power for months depending on the intensity of the charge.

entry: POKENAME没有牙齿，便用嘴两侧的旋转齿轮，碾碎坚果与树果，再吞下。它也爱吃废金属，会闯进废品场，寻找薄薄的瓦楞铁皮充饥。
author: .jerden
source: Lacking teeth, POKENAME uses the spinning gears on either side of its mouth to crush nuts and berries before it swallows them. It also has a hunger for scrap metal, and will raid junkyards searching for thin sheets of corrugated iron to consume.

entry: 即使睡觉，POKENAME头两侧的齿轮，也会缓缓转动。只要给它时间，加速到全速，这些齿轮，一碰就能击碎坚岩。
author: .jerden
source: Even when it sleeps, the gears on either side of POKENAME's head continue turning slowly. If given time to spin them up to full speed, these cogs can shatter solid rock upon contact.

entry: POKENAME在废弃的机械设备里筑巢。若一群住进同一台机器，有时能让机器呼呼地重新运作，持续一小会儿。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME makes its nests in abandoned mechanical equipment. When a flock inhabits a machine, it sometimes whirrs back to life for short periods.

entry: POKENAME周身的金属，总是滚烫。传闻，高级烤炉会使用它的部件，维持稳定热量。
author: .izik
source: The metal surrounding POKENAME's body is constantly hot. High-end grills are rumored to use parts from it for consistent heat.

entry: POKENAME锡质身体上的细孔，会渗出浓稠的绿色毒液。接触后，会产生严重刺激。
author: .izik
source: Tiny holes across POKENAME's tin body leak a thick, green poison. Contact with the fluid causes severe irritation.

entry: 彼此咬合的身体让它能像山地自行车般，在林间飞驰。许多林间土路，都是由它开辟的。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: This Pokémon's interlocking body allows it to speed through the forest like a mountain bike. It is the source of many natural dirt trails.

entry: 它动作僵硬缓慢，却坚决而执着。一旦决定咬住某个目标，无论花多少时间、走多远，都会追到底，直到双颚咬紧对方。
author: sk372
source: Its movement is stiff and slow, but it is determined and persistent.  If it chooses to bite at something, it will pursue them no matter the time or distance it takes, until its jaws clamp around its chosen target.

entry: POKENAME身上厚厚的钢壳，摸起来冰冷刺骨。雨一碰到寒冷的躯体，就会瞬间冻结。
author: .izik
source: The thick steel shell covering POKENAME is freezing to the touch. Rain freezes instantly upon contact with its frigid frame.

entry: POKENAME能自主行动，设计用途就是不断收集垃圾，装满后到最近的垃圾箱倒空，再重复这一过程。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME is an autonomous Pokémon that was designed to fill itself with garbage, empty itself in the nearest dumpster, and repeat the process.

entry: POKENAME全身覆着金属鳞片，跃出水面时，会闪出火花。它最高能跃到水面上方十英尺，咬住长翅鸥一类的猎物。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body is covered in metal scales that spark when it leaps from the water. It can leap up to 10 feet above the surface to bite prey such as Wingull.

entry: 齿轮就像发条马达，POKENAME转得越久，随后朝前疾冲的速度便越快。
author: chorb33
source: Its gears work like a wind-up motor. The longer POKENAME rotates it, the faster it can whizz off in one direction.

entry: 据说，POKENAME诞生自工业时代童工的灵魂。它在废弃工厂游荡，谁想动手重建，它就会将谁赶走。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are said to be born from the spirits of working children during the industrial era. It wanders around abandoned factories and will chase out anyone who tries to rebuild it.

entry: POKENAME大群生活在石油丰富的地方，用油润滑关节。它们的叫声，常被比作敲击打字机键的声音。
author: snookerron
source: Huge colonies of POKENAME can be found in areas that are rich in oil, which they use to lubricate their joints. Their cries are often likened to the striking of typewriter keys.

entry: 它靠翅膀旋转产生的磁力悬浮。成群的POKENAME休息时会将翅膀连在一起，一旦天敌靠近，只需一只开始旋转，整群就能一同升空。
author: staghorn
source: It hovers using the magnetism generated by its spinning wings. Flocking POKENAME link wings when at rest; if a predator approaches, it only takes a single POKENAME spinning up for the entire flock to take flight.

entry: POKENAME遇见转动的齿轮，就想与之啮合，汲取机械能。可很少有尺寸合适的，不是啮不上，就是把对方的机关，彻底卡死。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME will try to mesh with any turning gears it finds to harvest mechanical energy from them. It rarely finds any that can fit, and either cannot mesh with them or completely jams their mechanism.

entry: POKENAME齿轮间伸出的铲子，会定期发出低音信号，使附近机器轻微失灵。它很难关掉信号，尤其在睡觉时。
author: .izik
source: The shovel protruding from POKENAME's gears regularly emits a low-tone signal that causes nearby machines to malfunction slightly. It has difficulty turning this signal off, especially while it sleeps.

entry: POKENAME通常生活在废弃生锈的机器附近。背上的蘑菇，看似普通，实际由金属构成，只有钢属性宝可梦，才能安全食用。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is typically found living near abandoned, rusted machinery. The mushrooms on its back appear normal but are actually made of metal, and can only be safely consumed by Steel-type Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME在零度以下的环境，生活得很好，却极怕升温。金属身体，迅速传导热量；内部机关若过热，就会膨胀卡死。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME thrives in sub-zero temperatures but is incredibly vulnerable to increases in temperature. POKENAME's metallic body rapidly conducts heat, and its internal mechanisms will expand and lock up if they get too hot.

entry: 训练家可从相互咬合的齿轮转速，判断POKENAME的心情。它能量近乎无穷，有些训练家甚至跟不上POKENAME爱玩的劲头。
author: schwaus
source: Trainers with a POKENAME can determine its mood by how fast it's interlocking gears are turning. It contains a near infinite energy, some Trainers aren't able to keep up with POKENAME's playful nature.

entry: POKENAME唱歌时，身旁悬浮的小齿轮，就会绕圈运动，定期敲击它的金属身体，或附近物件。规律的铃响，似乎帮助它掌握节拍。
author: .jerden
source: As POKENAME sings, the small gear floating in the air next to it will begin to move in circles, regularly striking against either POKENAME's metallic body or a nearby object. This regular ringing seems to help POKENAME keep to time.

entry: POKENAME跳舞时，身旁悬浮的小齿轮，会不停绕着它转。谁试着打断表演，它就伸手抓住齿轮，像弹丸般，掷向对方。
author: .jerden
source: The small gear that floats in the air next to POKENAME will constantly circle around it as it dances. If anyone tries to interrupt POKENAME's performance, it will reach out to grab this gear and toss it at them like a projectile.

entry: POKENAME缓慢而稳定地爬过地面，经过什么金属碎片，就啃什么。在工坊里，它是清理锋利废金属的好伙伴。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME skitters across the ground at a slow but steady pace, chomping on any pieces of metal it passes over. It's a useful companion for cleaning up sharp metal scraps in workshops.

entry: POKENAME移动时，背上的钥匙会旋转，帮助驱动关节。壳上通风口，释放蒸汽，又为钥匙持续转动，提供动力。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: The keys on the backs of POKENAME rotate to help power their joints as they move. POKENAME release steam from the vents in their shells to help power the constant turning of their keys.

entry: POKENAME的金属色棉花糖，虽然看似蓬松，味道却糟透了。幸存者形容，那滋味像电池酸液与机油。
author: .izik
source: Though it appears fluffy, POKENAME's metallic-colored candy floss tastes awful. Survivors describe the flavor being similar to battery acid and oil.

entry: POKENAME腿边像裤子的橡胶状皮肤，能防止训练或战斗中，意外电到伙伴，保护同伴。
author: .izik
source: The pants-like rubbery skin around POKENAME's legs protects its allies by preventing accidental electric shocks while it trains or battles.

entry: POKENAME常钻进工厂机器，将莲叶嵌在其中，旋转发电。野外，它们则互相配合旋转，产生能量。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME are often found inside factory machines, fitting their pad in between in order to spin and generate energy. In the wild, POKENAME generate energy by spinning with one another.

entry: POKENAME随时都在飞快旋转，似乎为了维持能量与悬浮。一旦停下，眼睛便迅速黯淡，人们推测，极短时间内，它就会死去。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME rotates itself rapidly at all times, seemingly as a way to keep itself energized and aloft. If it stops, its eye dims quickly and it would presumably perish in an incredibly short amount of time.

entry: POKENAME齿轮的每个齿上，都有可压印在金属薄片上的特殊纹样。情侣常将一种纹样，压在硬币上，表达爱意；这股风潮，来自一部电视剧的场景。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a special pattern on each tooth on its gears that can be pressed onto sheets of metal. Couples often press one of these patterns onto a coin to show their love for each other, a trend popularized by a scene from a television show.

entry: POKENAME常到建筑工地找食物。它喜欢吃各种手表，吃的时候，尾部的齿轮，就会转得飞快。
author: agostostino
source: POKENAME will often go into construction sites to find something to eat. It loves to eat all kinds of watches, with the gears on its tails spinning quickly as it eats some.

entry: POKENAME是十分不幸的宝可梦。齿轮必须转动，才能产生维生的能量，可每转一圈，都会扭曲头颅，带来剧烈头痛。
author: sk372
source: A very unfortunate Pokémon: POKENAME's gears must turn in order to generate the energy needed to live, but every turn of the gears distorts its cranium and causes excruciating headaches.

entry: 朝一个方向，转动POKENAME尾巴的齿轮，能暂时缓和坏脾气；朝另一个方向，则会增强攻击性。饲养它的训练家，最好尽快记住，该往哪边转。
author: sk372
source: Turning the gear on POKENAME's tail one direction will temporarily assuage its bad temperament, while turning the other will boost its aggression. Trainers are advised to quickly memorize which way to turn when raising POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME在原木里安家，找不到，就用电锯般的尾巴，锯倒一棵树。这样做时，金属皮肤，能保护它免遭任何鸟类宝可梦的啄击。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME makes its home in logs. If none are available, it can use its tail like a chainsaw to chop a tree down. Its metal skin protects it from Pecks from any bird Pokémon when it does this.

entry: POKENAME将双拳伸入急流，产生能量。由于全部能量，都来自水力发电，它不需要进食。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME will put its two fists in rushing water to generate energy. Because all of its energy is hydroelectric, it does not need to eat.

entry: 出拳时，它腕边的齿轮，会高速旋转。具体原因尚不清楚，生物学家认为，最可能是为了保护POKENAME，抵御反击。
author: bandedbodypress
source: The gears around its wrists spin at high speed when punching. The exact reason is not known, but biologists' best guess is that it protects POKENAME from counterattacks.

entry: POKENAME能从几米外，控制脱离身体的手脚。研究者已确定，这是通过操纵磁场实现的，也观察到它们，轻松控制其他金属。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are able to control their disembodied hands and feet from several meters away. Researchers have determined they do so through manipulation of magnetic fields and have observed POKENAME controlling other metals with ease.

entry: POKENAME准备从嘴中喷水时，壳上的齿轮，就会转得更快。虽然大多生活在水中，它的钢铁，却从不生锈。
author: fiordaliso
source: When POKENAME prepares to spray water from its mouth, the gears on its shell begin rotating faster. Even though it lives mostly in aquatic environments, its steel never rusts.

entry: POKENAME很受马戏团欢迎。吞火艺人与杂技演员骑在它身上，借失控的火焰表演惊险特技。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME is popular in circus performances, where fire eaters or acrobats ride on it and perform dangerous stunts featuring its uncontrolled fire.

entry: 身体由一套齿轮系统构成，能推动它在水中高速前进。光滑的表面像金属般反光，让POKENAME游泳时在水下闪闪发亮。
author: rakunk
source: Its body is composed of a system of gears, aiding in propelling it through water with surprising speed. Its polished surface reflects light like metal, which allows POKENAME to glimmer underneath the water while swimming.

entry: POKENAME背上的巨大齿轮，显然本应通过转动，带来高超的智力。不过，齿轮转得太慢，它几乎得不到什么好处。
author: sk372
source: The huge gear in POKENAME's back is apparently supposed to provide it with great intellect as it churns. However, it turns so slowly that POKENAME rarely sees any benefit.

entry: 研究人员已经证实，POKENAME不断让一个无形磁场，绕自身轴线旋转，借此保护自己。
author: chorb33
source: Researchers were able to prove that POKENAME constantly rotates an invisible magnetic field around its own axis, which it uses to protect itself.

entry: POKENAME用下方的齿轮，激发自身产生的磁场。即使一片漆黑，也能准确辨认方向。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME uses the gear on its underside to stimulate its self-generated magnetic field, with which it can orient itself even in absolute darkness.

entry: POKENAME能将几颗头嵌在一起，飞快旋转。这本是护身的办法，有些人却借此发电。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME can interlock its heads and then make them rotate rapidly. This protective mechanism is exploited by some to generate energy.

entry: 身体由坚韧轻盈的钢构成，三颗头各有明确分工，让POKENAME做事格外高效。
author: chorb33
source: Its body is made of sturdy but lightweight steel. Each of its three heads have different, defined tasks, which makes POKENAME an effective fusion.

entry: 身体由坚韧轻盈的钢构成，三颗头各有明确分工，让POKENAME做事格外高效。
author: chorb33
source: Its body is made of sturdy but lightweight steel. Each of its three heads have different, defined tasks, which makes POKENAME an effective fusion.

entry: 身体由坚韧轻盈的钢构成，三颗头各有明确分工，让POKENAME做事格外高效。
author: chorb33
source: Its body is made of sturdy but lightweight steel. Each of its three heads have different, defined tasks, which makes POKENAME an effective fusion.

entry: 它身上的齿轮，一顿一顿地转动，仿佛十分吃力。POKENAME的触碰，能让大多数金属慢慢生锈，随后，就当作零食吃掉。
author: deelee2020
source: The gear on its body spins jerkily as though struggling to move. POKENAME's touch slowly rusts most metals, which it then consumes as a snack.

entry: 有人试着从黏稠污泥中，取出齿轮，却发现这有损POKENAME的健康。没有污泥，齿轮便转不动；分离太久，它就可能死去。
author: sk372
source: Some have tried to remove the gears from within the gooey sludge, but learned this is detrimental to POKENAME's health; without the sludge, the gears are unable to turn, and it could perish if separated too long.

entry: POKENAME是一对漂浮的幽灵齿轮，常在废弃工厂作祟。据说，它们是坏掉机器的灵魂，被留在旧日的家中，徘徊不去。
author: sk372
source: A pair of floating spectral gears that tend to haunt abandoned factories, it's said that POKENAME are the spirits of broken-down machines left to linger around their former homes.

entry: POKENAME吃的梦越美味，齿轮就转得越快。不过，它们究竟如何吃梦，仍不得而知。
author: deelee2020
source: The tastier the dream POKENAME eats, the faster its gears spin. The method of how they consume dreams is unknown.

entry: POKENAME韧性极强，连污染最严重的水域，也能生存。由于没有天敌，数量多得能堵塞下水管，在某些地区，被视为灾患。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME are incredibly resilient and can survive in even the most heavily contaminated water. Since they have no natural predators, they are considered a plague in some regions because their sheer numbers can clog sewer pipes.

entry: POKENAME在地面横向滚动，偶尔故意让背上的大齿轮，撞向地面。齿轮蓄满能量后，它便会在一连串火花中爆炸。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME roll laterally along the ground, occasionally purposefully striking the large gear on their back against the ground. Once the gear charges up enough energy, the POKENAME will explode in a series of sparks.

entry: 小齿轮转动，为POKENAME有力的奔跑冲撞提供动力。若眼看要撞墙，最大的齿轮，就会反转，强迫身体刹停。
author: sk372
source: The smaller gears turn to fuel POKENAME's powerful running charges. If it looks to be charging into a wall, the largest gear spins in reverse to force the body to hit the brakes and stop.

entry: POKENAME背上的大齿轮，驱动鼻部钻头般的角。齿轮也能猛砸后方来敌，不过，它往往注意不到，正前方以外的任何东西。
author: .jerden
source: The large gear on POKENAME's back drives the spinning of the drill-like horn on its nose. It can also be slammed against foes that approach POKENAME from behind, although POKENAME tends to not notice anything that isn't right in front of it.

entry: POKENAME身上旋转的齿轮，不断产生电力，供它调用。达到最大容量时，后部的齿轮，就会放出短距离闪电，排去多余能量。
author: sk372
source: The spinning gears of POKENAME's body constantly generate electrical force for it to tap into. At max capacity, the gear at its rear will cast off short-range bolts of lightning to expel excess energy.

entry: POKENAME将长身体紧紧盘起，储存内部齿轮产生的机械能。敌人一靠近，便可猛甩长角的头、披甲的尾巴，突然释放这股力量。
author: .jerden
source: By tightly coiling its long body, POKENAME can store up mechanical energy from its internal gears. This power can suddenly be released if any foe approaches, through powerful swings of POKENAME's horned head and armored tail.

entry: 研究显示，POKENAME不断变化的DNA，与背上齿轮的位置有关。例如，头顶上方的齿轮齿呈红色时，取出的DNA样本，会与某些火属性宝可梦极为相似。
author: bobosmith01
source: Research shows that its perpetually shifting DNA has a correlation with the position of the gear upon its back. For example, a DNA sample will closely resemble some Fire-types' when it is drawn while the gear tooth above POKENAME's head is red.

entry: POKENAME的后半身，装着一大卷体内产生的金属丝状线。它们用灵巧精准的脚尖，将线编成各种形状、陷阱与工具。
author: infinex21
source: The rear halves of POKENAME contain a large spool of a metallic silk-like thread produced within their bodies. The precise tips of their legs are used to weave this thread into various shapes, traps, and tools.

entry: POKENAME转动翼上的齿轮，维持悬浮。它几乎无声地飞过陌生领地，侦察可能适合筑巢，或捕猎的新地方。
author: reflecbeat
source: POKENAME spins the gears on its wings to hover. It flies almost silently above unfamiliar territory, scouting out potential new nesting sites or hunting grounds.

entry: 体内齿轮转动时，尾部珠体里，便能看见噼啪闪烁的电光，显示当前能量水平。即使POKENAME睡觉，齿轮也从不会完全停下。
author: sk372
source: As the gears of its body turn, crackling electricity can be seen within the orb on its tail, an indicator of its current energy level. The gears never stop turning completely, even when POKENAME sleeps.

entry: POKENAME体内电力减少，齿轮就会变慢。夜里，它会陷入深睡，恢复电量。
author: .izik
source: The cogs on POKENAME slow as its internal electricity depletes. At night, it enters a deep sleep to restore its charge.

entry: POKENAME飞得极不规律，经常撞上周围的东西。幸好，即使最精细的部件，也十分耐用。
author: staghorn
source: POKENAME fly extremely erratically and constantly crash into their surroundings. Fortunately, even their most delicate components are very durable.

entry: POKENAME悬浮在工厂与发电厂附近，缓缓旋转，吸收阳光，为电属性攻击提供能量。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME hovers near factories and power plants, gently spinning as it absorbs sunlight to fuel its Electric-type attacks.

entry: POKENAME的齿轮，由轻巧的铝制成，让它能毫不费力地，飘过工厂与废品场。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's cogwheels are made of lightweight aluminum, allowing it to drift effortlessly through factories and scrapyards.

entry: POKENAME常到废品场，吃生锈的废金属。受到挑衅时，它会把不稳定的电子设备，掷向对手，往往一撞，就会爆炸。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME frequents junkyards, feeding on rusting, discarded metal. When it feels provoked, it throws unstable electronics at its opponent, which often explode on impact.

entry: POKENAME常到废品场，吃生锈的废金属。受到挑衅时，它会把不稳定的电子设备，掷向对手，往往一撞，就会爆炸。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME frequents junkyards, feeding on rusting, discarded metal. When it feels provoked, it throws unstable electronics at its opponent, which often explode on impact.

entry: 科学家推测，POKENAME体内的能量，足以靠自身力量飞入轨道。可它宁愿浮在宁静的湖边，凝望水中的倒影。
author: sk372
source: Scientists theorize POKENAME has enough power in its body to take itself to orbit under its own power. It instead prefers to hover around quiet lake areas and stare at its reflection in the water.

entry: 它的钢铁身体，随着尾部齿轮转动，一顿一顿地移动。飞行时，会发出金属尖啸，使附近的人晕头转向。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its steel body moves in jerky motions, following the rotation of the gears on its tail. When it flies, it emits metallic screeches that disorient anyone nearby.

entry: POKENAME转动齿轮，发出嗡鸣，改变转速，就能调整音高。城市公园，既有筑巢的树，又有能一起合奏的科技设备，因此很吸引它。
author: oddwalls
source: When it rotates its gears, it causes a humming sound that it can pitch by varying its rotation speed. City parks attract POKENAME because they provide trees to nest in and technology to harmonize with.

entry: POKENAME的翅膀被巨型齿轮取代，像甲壳般护住背部。增加的体重让它更容易借力，掀翻比自己大得多的宝可梦。
author: vibrationjaveline
source: POKENAME has replaced its wings with a gigantic gear, which it uses as a shell to protect its back. Its increased weight allows it to get enough leverage to fling Pokémon much larger than it.

entry: POKENAME背上的齿轮，平时虽慢，一旦加速到全速，就能驱动身体，飞快前进。沿地面高速滑动的摩擦，会在身后留下一道熔融金属。
author: .jerden
source: Although it usually turns slowly, once it spins up to full speed, the gear on POKENAME's back can drive its body forward very quickly. The friction produced by rapidly sliding along the ground will leave a trail of molten metal behind POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME用赖以运转的油液，在地面上滑行。可人类改用可再生能源后，它们的数量也日益减少。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME uses the oil it runs on to slide along the ground. However, because of the shift to renewable energy, their numbers have dwindled.

entry: 头上的齿轮，让POKENAME喷射水流时，极其精准。快速微调瞄准方向，就能准确击中，几千米外的目标。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME has superb precision when shooting bursts of water because of the gears on its head. By rapidly making small adjustments to its aim, POKENAME can accurately land strikes from several kilometers away.

entry: POKENAME用身上的履带，穿过崎岖地形。开火前，头部两侧的齿轮，会微调瞄准方向，发出极其精准的攻击。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME moves through tough terrain with the treads on its body. The gears on either side of its head make minute adjustments to its aim before firing with superb precision.

entry: 体内的炉膛，不断产生新的火焰，送往正处于攻击状态的那个头。危急时，POKENAME能让两个头一起喷火，却可能耗尽全部储备。
author: sk372
source: Its internal furnace is always creating new flames, fueled towards whichever head is actively in attack mode. In times of desperation POKENAME can burn with both heads, but it risks depleting its reserves completely should it do so.

entry: POKENAME在电脑内部工作，保持时间稳定，与其他设备同步。训练家想将文件日期回溯时，它便快速旋转身体，让旧日期重新可用。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME work inside computers to ensure that the time remains consistent and synchronized with other devices. Whenever their Trainer wants to backdate a document, POKENAME rapidly spin their body to give access to the old date.

entry: POKENAME前部的齿轮转动，会微妙地扰动前方电波，让范围内的对象晕头转向。一旦目标被弄晕，它就能轻松盘身，将其压碎。
author: sk372
source: The rotation of its frontal gears subtly stimulates the airwaves in front of POKENAME, causing disorientation in those within range. Once stunned by this display, POKENAME can coil around and crush its targets with ease.

entry: POKENAME前往工业城市，修复因严重进水或锈蚀而损坏的机器。头部齿轮转得越快，水系攻击的威力，就会以指数级增强。
author: h0bojoe
source: POKENAME visits industrial cities to fix machines damaged by excessive water damage or rust. Its water attacks exponentially increase in power the faster the gears on its head turn.

entry: POKENAME能让两个大齿轮啮合，使身体高速旋转，再将其中一个射出，攻击敌人。坚硬的金属外壳，让它连高速撞击，也不会受伤。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME can interlock its two large cogs to spin its body at high speed, then fire one of them off to strike foes. Since it is encased in a hard metal shell, even high-speed impacts will not harm it.

entry: POKENAME越愤怒，齿轮就转得越快。它既能用旋转齿轮碾磨敌人，也能与齿轮形的手臂啮合，加速到高速后，发射出去，打击对手。
author: .jerden
source: The angrier POKENAME gets, the faster its gears spin. As well as grinding these spinning gears against foes, POKENAME can interlock them with its cog-shaped arms, accelerate them to high speed, then fire them off to strike foes.

entry: POKENAME越愤怒，齿轮就转得越快。它既能用旋转齿轮碾磨敌人，也能与齿轮形的手臂啮合，加速到高速后，发射出去，打击对手。
author: .jerden
source: The angrier POKENAME gets, the faster its gears spin. As well as grinding these spinning gears against foes, POKENAME can interlock them with its cog-shaped arms, accelerate them to high speed, then fire them off to strike foes.

entry: POKENAME转动胸前齿轮，提升能量与心情。久不充能，就会闷闷不乐。头上的齿轮，随身体那枚一起转，却似乎没什么作用。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME will turn the gear on its chest in order to boost its energy and mood, becoming dour if it hasn't charged itself in a while. The gears on its head turn along with the one on its body, but appear to serve no function.

entry: POKENAME喜欢用电锯臂，威吓想捕捉自己的训练家，不过并不像人们想的那么爱捣乱。它开始发现，雕刻树木，原来也很有趣。
author: beatdoof
source: POKENAME likes to use its chainsaw arm as a way to intimidate would-be Trainers attempting to catch it, though it is not as mischievous with it as one might assume. It has begun to learn how fun carving up trees can be.

entry: 坚硬的玻璃，保护着内部马达。POKENAME借马达不断产生能量，再将其转化为磁波。
author: chorb33
source: The motor on the inside is protected by hard glass. POKENAME constantly generates energy via this motor, which it can convert into magnetic waves.

entry: POKENAME用传送带般的舌头，卷起金属碎料。它慢慢消化，从每一片中，吸收微量能量。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its conveyor-belt-like tongue to scoop up metallic scraps. It digests the metal slowly, absorbing trace energy from each piece.

entry: 大齿轮保护着POKENAME。它能让胸前齿轮的齿高速旋转，碾磨碰到的一切，借此磨下小块岩石，再从掌心发射。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME is armored by large cogs. It can spin the teeth of the gear around its chest at high speed to grind anything it makes contact with. It uses this to break off small pieces of rock that it can fire from its palms.

entry: 金属身体内部，燃着一团火，让它持续活跃。齿轮开始加速，浓厚的暗烟，就会环绕身边，防止POKENAME过热。
author: fiordaliso
source: A flame burns within its metal body, keeping it constantly active. When its gears begin to spin faster, it becomes surrounded by thick, dark smoke to prevent POKENAME from overheating.

entry: 金属身体内部，燃着一团火，维持连续运作。齿轮加速时，浓密的黑烟，会将身体包住，避免POKENAME过热。
author: fiordaliso
source: A flame burns within its metal body, sustaining its continuous operation. As its gears accelerate, dense black smoke envelops it to keep POKENAME from overheating.

entry: POKENAME始终匀速旋转，偶尔趁没人看见，变换姿势。它优雅的模样，启发了好几款音乐盒的造型设计。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME perpetually spins at a steady speed, sometimes changing poses when nobody is looking. Several music boxes have been made featuring designs inspired by POKENAME's graceful appearance.

entry: POKENAME觉得自己陷在不断昏厥、苏醒的循环里，永无尽头。它会把附近的齿轮雷朵，当作训练家般保护。
author: tokenoracle
source: POKENAME considers itself trapped in a never-ending spiral of faints and revives. It chooses to protect any nearby Klalade as if they were a Trainer.

entry: POKENAME将每个动作，都算得精确到毫秒，让攻击几乎无法躲开。许多城市，将它部署为维持秩序的最后手段。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME calculates every movement down to the millisecond, making its strikes virtually impossible to dodge. Many cities have deployed it as a last resort peacekeeper.

entry: POKENAME携带齿轮状的巨镜，战斗时，当作武器挥舞。镜子似乎有一种神秘能力，能改变它的属性。
author: smissmassentree_81799
source: POKENAME carry around huge mirrors that are shaped like a cog, which they wield as weapons in battle. The mirrors seem to have the mysterious ability to change a POKENAME's type.

entry: POKENAME受磁力吸引，前往未来会发生技术故障的地方。警告若被无视，它就会撕扯电线与金属，咬穿线缆。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: POKENAME is magnetically drawn to the sites of future tech failures. If its warnings are ignored, it will tear up wires and metal, chewing through cords.

entry: POKENAME在有机器的地方，通常很有帮助，能穿进机器，从内部维持运作。不过，若有坏心眼的人在场，它就会故意弄坏机器。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME is normally a helpful presence in places with machines, as it can phase through them to keep them running from the inside. However, if mean-spirited people are around, it will purposefully break machines.

entry: 它喜欢待在人类文明附近。腹部周围齿轮般的附属物，藏着许多秘密。
author: hortensia_xxiii
source: It prefers to remain near human civilization. The gear-like appendage around its abdomen contains many secrets.

entry: POKENAME使用火焰攻击时，身上的齿轮，会猛烈旋转。身体升温，关节间，也会火花飞溅。
author: .izik
source: When using fire-based attacks, the cogs on POKENAME's body spin furiously. Sparks fly from its joints as it heats up.

entry: POKENAME既是振动利刃，也是战斗电锯，能高效取走受害者体内的铁与生命力。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME functions both as a vibrating blade and combat chainsaw. It effectively harvests iron and life force from its victims.

entry: POKENAME动作僵硬机械，像上了发条的玩具。它用左臂匕首般的刀刃，打击敌人。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME moves with stiff, mechanical motions, resembling a wind-up toy. It strikes enemies with the dagger-like blade on its left arm.

entry: POKENAME主要齿轮转动，产生的电力极强，每转一下，都能看见。全速旋转时，雷电就会在全身周围，形成屏障。
author: sk372
source: The rotation of POKENAME's main gears generates so much electricity that it can be visibly seen with each turn. Spinning the gears at max speed creates a barrier of lightning around its whole body.

entry: 历史上，POKENAME曾用于战争。耐用的身体与能越过各种地形的履带，让它们穿越险地；天生的领地本能，又使它们成为士兵的得力伙伴。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have historically been used during warfare, their durable bodies and ability to traverse any terrain with their tracks helping them cross difficult terrain. Their naturally territorial instincts make them effective companions for soldiers.

entry: 古老传说称，世界其实是POKENAME制造的巨大齿轮系统，齿轮啮合不良，就会引起地震。人们也见过它制造小齿轮，围着自身的大齿轮旋转。
author: soup1900
source: Ancient legends have stated that the world is actually a giant gear system made by POKENAME and that earthquakes are caused when the gears don't mesh properly. POKENAME has been shown creating minigears to spin around its own large gears.

entry: POKENAME的齿轮转动，让体内不断产生酸液。炮会高速喷出河流般的酸液，一只爪子也会渗漏，能在敌人身上，划出灼痛的伤口。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's gears churn to keep it constantly producing an acidic liquid within itself. Its cannon fires rivers of the acid at high velocity, while a single claw leaks it, able to create painfully burning gashes in opponents.

entry: POKENAME的齿轮，平时转得慢，以节省能量。一进入战斗模式，就会加速，让身上的速射加特林机枪，发出数百枚能量弹。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's gears usually turn slowly to save energy. Once combat mode is engaged, the gears spin faster, enabling it to use a rapid-fire gatling gun on its body to fire hundreds of energy bullets.

entry: POKENAME齿轮上的微量残留物，能让它黏住表面，垂直、倒挂也没问题。若看见它留下的轨迹，要留意，残留物带着微弱静电。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's gears carry a faint residue that allow it to cling to surfaces, even when vertical or inverted. Be cautious if you find tracks left by POKENAME; the residue it leaves behind is mildly charged with static electricity.

entry: POKENAME在电杆顶筑巢，让电流穿过身体。它明亮发光，吸引摩鲁蛾一类的猎物靠近。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME nests atop electrical poles, channeling currents through its body. It lights up brightly to lure prey like Venomoth closer.

entry: POKENAME旋转时，会消耗维持火焰的生命能量，逐渐衰弱。小齿轮熔化消失后，大齿轮必须另找伙伴连接，否则，就会死去。
author: pjporwoll
source: As POKENAME spins, it consumes the life energy powering its flames and gradually dwindles. When the smaller gear melts away, the big gear must find another partner with which to connect or it will die.

entry: POKENAME头内的蓝色灯泡发光，仿佛一团冷焰。醒来时，它会让灯泡放出，刺眼的闪光。
author: .izik
source: A blue bulb glows within POKENAME's head, resembling a cool flame. Upon waking, it releases a blinding flash from the bulb.

entry: POKENAME爱收集工具，接在自己身上，因此深受各类维修工喜爱。不过，什么都收，积得太多，要它拿出特定工具时，往往自己也搞糊涂。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a popular companion for various handymen due to its tendency to collect tools and link them to itself. It collects so many items indiscriminately that it often gets confused when asked to provide a specific tool, however.

entry: POKENAME体内的齿轮，不断转动，带动一只眼周围的齿轮。转得慢，表示放松；转得快，则是生气，通常因为，被人类忽视或躲避。
author: .jerden
source: Gears constantly turn inside POKENAME, rotating the cog around one of its eyes. If it spins slowly, POKENAME is relaxed, but if it spins quickly POKENAME is angry. This is usually due to it being ignored or avoided by humans.

entry: POKENAME身后众多齿轮翼旋转，产生热量。转得足够快，就能让火焰彻底包住身体，是它偏爱的战斗技巧之一。
author: sk372
source: Heat is generated by the rotation of POKENAME's many gear-wings behind it. Increasing the gears' speed enough can allow POKENAME to completely engulf itself in flames, and is one of its favored combat techniques.

entry: 野生POKENAME大半生，除了沿直线游泳，几乎不做别的。它们常张着嘴，碰巧撞上食物，就顺势吃下。
author: camtft
source: Wild POKENAME don't do much else than swim in a straight line for most of their lives. They luck into food by running into it by chance, often with its mouth agape.

entry: 齿轮以不寻常的方式，啮合在一起。因此，POKENAME偶尔会转到一半卡住，停止运作，直到自己或别人排除故障。
author: sk372
source: The gears have meshed together in an unorthodox fashion. As a result, POKENAME may occasionally get its gears stuck mid-turn, halting functionality until it or another fixes the issue.

entry: POKENAME连最猛烈的毒素，也能轻松吸收、使其失效，是清理污染区域的宝贵帮手。因此，玉虹大学一直在研究它。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is able to absorb and deactivate even the most potent toxins with ease, making it valuable in cleaning up contaminated areas. As a result, studies into POKENAME have been ongoing at Celadon University.

entry: 由于长期吞食老工厂的机械，POKENAME长出了更大的金属身体。成群飞行时会与同伴碰撞，发出齿轮相磨的声音。
author: daemonkill22
source: Due to its diet of old factory machinery, POKENAME has developed a larger metallic body. Its body collides with others when flying in a swarm, creating the sound of grinding gears.

entry: POKENAME能让尾部与头部的齿轮啮合，带动嘴里的齿轮高速旋转。速度足够后，它就用来在附近岩石，刻下深痕，标记领地。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME can interlock the gears on its tail and head to spin the gears in its mouth at high speed. Once they are moving fast enough, it will use them to carve deep gashes into nearby rocks as a way to mark its territory.

entry: 后脑的齿轮，驱动POKENAME头部两侧的齿轮，高速旋转。它将这些齿轮，与对手的啮合，双方朝相反方向奋力转动，直到一方被迫反转。
author: .jerden
source: Driven by the gear at the back of its head, the cogs on either side of POKENAME's head can be spun at high speed. POKENAME will interlock these with the gears of rivals, then strain in opposite directions until one is forced into reverse.

entry: POKENAME圆圆的鼻子，温度能高过商用烤箱。即使最强韧的宝可梦，只碰一下，也会严重烧伤。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's round nose heats up beyond commercial oven temperatures. A single touch can leave severe burns on even the toughest Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME奇妙地酷似一款流行的小型汽车，便借此伪装，藏在拥挤的停车场。感到威胁时，它会突然挂挡，以危险的速度疾驰而去。
author: anonymous_moose
source: POKENAME curiously bears a strong resemblance to a popular model of compact car and uses this as camouflage to hide in crowded parking lots. If it feels threatened, it will suddenly shift into gear and drive away at dangerous speeds.

entry: POKENAME实际能力，只算一般，却自负地认为，自己是机械造物的巅峰。谁暗示并非如此，它就恼羞成怒，高速吐出齿轮，向质疑者赌气反抗。
author: sk372
source: Though its actual capabilities are only moderate, POKENAME vainly considers itself the pinnacle of machinery. Should someone imply otherwise, it angrily spits high-velocity gears at the detractor in petty defiance.

entry: 它忍不住收集，发现的任何废金属与机器。有时积得太多，连自己都几乎无法移动。
author: cait_sith
source: It has an urge to collect any scrap metal or machinery it finds. Sometimes it collects so much that it is barely able to move.

entry: 一发现猎物或闯入者，双眼便亮起慑人的红光。水下基地，常用POKENAME负责警戒。
author: chorb33
source: If it sees prey or intruders, its eyes glow a menacing red. POKENAME is often used in underwater bases for security purposes.

entry: 一发现猎物或闯入者，双眼便亮起慑人的红光。水下基地，常用POKENAME负责警戒。
author: chorb33
source: If it sees prey or intruders, its eyes glow a menacing red. POKENAME is often used in underwater bases for security purposes.

entry: 一发现猎物或闯入者，双眼便亮起慑人的红光。水下基地，常用POKENAME负责警戒。
author: chorb33
source: If it sees prey or intruders, its eyes glow a menacing red. POKENAME is often used in underwater bases for security purposes.

entry: 野外，偶尔能见POKENAME与齿轮儿或齿轮组啮合，由对方的齿轮，带动自身运转。它似乎会因此恢复活力，没有其他齿轮，能配合得如此合适。
author: .jerden
source: Wild POKENAME are occasionally found meshed with a Klink or Klang, with their own gears being turned by those of the other Pokémon. POKENAME seems to be energized by this interaction, and no other gears fit them as well.

entry: 即使睡着，体内也能听见诡异的机械声。它会在磁场强烈的区域，来回巡视。
author: mistymagius
source: Even while asleep, eerie mechanical noise can be heard from inside its body. It will patrol around areas with strong magnetic fields.

entry: POKENAME身旁悬浮的齿轮，与歌声同步转动。训练家观察到，战斗中若命令它加快齿轮，歌声就会变成两倍，甚至三倍速度。
author: .jerden
source: The gears floating in the air next to POKENAME turn at the same pace as its songs. Trainers have observed that if they command POKENAME to shift its gears up to a higher speed in combat, it will sing at double or even triple speed.

entry: POKENAME身旁的悬浮齿轮，跟随播放音乐的节奏转动，似乎决定它的舞速。曲子若足够快，它的动作，就会超过任何人类舞者。
author: .jerden
source: The turning of the gears floating in the air next to POKENAME matches the tempo of whatever music is playing and seems to set the speed at which it dances. If a song is fast-paced enough, POKENAME will move faster than any human dancer could.

entry: POKENAME走路时，头会慢慢旋转。它能感知附近机械的故障，一有不妥，身体就会发烫。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's head rotates slowly as it walks. It senses nearby mechanical failure, growing hot to the touch when something is wrong.

entry: POKENAME由机械齿轮驱动，放进嘴的任何东西，都会磨成细粉，进行分析。即使微量化学物，也能检出，适用于工业分析与试毒。
author: .jerden
source: Driven by mechanical gears, POKENAME grinds anything that is placed inside its mouth into a fine powder for analysis. It can detect even trace amounts of chemicals, making it useful for both industrial analysis and poison tasting.

entry: POKENAME全部火焰力量，都来自尾火，火焰被笼罩保护，免于熄灭。每次起飞，背部齿轮都会快速旋转，将它推进天空。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME source all of their fiery powers from the flame at their tail, which is caged to protect it from being extinguished. The gears on their back rapidly spin whenever they take flight to propel them into the sky.

entry: POKENAME彼此将齿轮锁在一起，越转越快，较量到一方跟不上。齿轮的磨损程度，也能看出它的年龄。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME will compete between themselves by locking their gears together, and rotating faster and faster until the other cannot keep up. You can tell the age of a POKENAME by how scuffed their gears are.

entry: POKENAME用超能力，能极其精准地操纵物体。集中念动力时，离体的齿轮，会在半空转动。研究者推测，齿轮的位置，与空间维度有关。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME is capable of incredibly precise manipulation of objects with its psychic powers. Its disembodied gears turn mid-air as it focuses its telekinetic energies. Researchers speculate that its gear positions relate to dimensions in space.

entry: POKENAME将齿轮转动的噪音，投进附近对象的脑海，使其心生不安恐惧。人们认为，这样做，是为了赶走争夺食物的竞争者。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME project the noise of turning gears into the minds of those nearby, imbuing a disquieting sense of dread in those they afflict with the noise. The behaviour is believed to be intended to drive away competition for their food.

entry: POKENAME飞快转动体内齿轮，从嘴中喷水。产生的水量，与齿轮转速，成正比。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME rapidly spin the gears in their body to squirt water from their mouths. The amount of water produced is proportional to the speed at which the gears spin.

entry: POKENAME疾驰时，喷出滚烫蒸汽，点燃身后的大地。蒸汽声与踏地的回响，听来宛如火车头。
author: chorb33
source: When POKENAME gallops, it emits boiling steam that ignites the landscape behind it. This and the echoing of its steps sound like a locomotive.

entry: POKENAME用活塞驱动的四肢，向前冲锋，脊柱边的通风口，嘶嘶喷着蒸汽。角高速旋转，精准切开障碍，仿佛受无形的计算指引。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME charges forward on piston-driven limbs, with steam hissing from vents along its spine. Its horn spins at a high velocity, slicing perfectly through obstacles as if guided by unseen calculations.

entry: POKENAME尾部的齿轮，主要用于调节平衡，尤其在水下。齿轮一受损，它就无法正常游泳。
author: sk372
source: The gears on POKENAME's tail are primarily responsible for regulating its balance, especially underwater. If they become damaged, it can no longer swim properly.

entry: POKENAME以防护电场环绕自身。四处行进时，这种防御手段，会让附近机器失控。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: POKENAME surrounds itself with a protective electric field. As it travels around, this defence measure causes nearby machines to go haywire.

entry: 这种构造奇特的机械宝可梦，偶尔会先分离，再重排三个单元的位置。人们认为，不同排列，能帮助POKENAME专注战斗、计算等特定功能。
author: sk372
source: The oddly-arranged machine Pokémon occasionally separates itself before rearranging the three units' positions. It's thought that the differing arrangements help POKENAME focus on specific functions like battling or computing.

entry: POKENAME的头，不停顺时针旋转。腿上的弹簧，让它能跃到超过十米的空中。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME's head rotates continuously in a clockwise direction. The springs on its legs enable it to jump over ten meters into the air.

entry: POKENAME是狡猾爱恶作剧的幽灵，会将幽灵齿轮送入机器，使其故障。既难驱除，又难赶走，因此工厂等建筑，都视它为祸患。
author: sk372
source: A devious prankster of a spirit, POKENAME sends out ghostly gears into machinery to cause them to malfunction. Factories and other such buildings consider it a menace due to this and how difficult it is to properly exorcise and eject it.

entry: POKENAME常伪装成老人，在幽暗树林中徘徊。谁若靠得太近，它就吐出黏丝抓住，留给巢中的同伴，作为食物。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME frequently disguises itself as an elderly person wandering darkened woods. If someone gets too close, it spits a sticky silk thread to capture them, leaving them for others in its nest to feed on.

entry: 融合研究者普遍知道，POKENAME的幻象一旦受到某种干扰，就会立刻爆炸。有理论认为，幻象受扰，会产生小冲击波，进而引发爆炸。
author: secondatheniangadfly
source: It is commonly known among fusion scientists that if POKENAME's illusions are disrupted in some way, it will instantly explode. A theory states that this is because a small shockwave is generated by the disturbance of POKENAME's illusions.

entry: POKENAME施展幻象，装成其他宝可梦，结交朋友。它很难主动露出真身，因此愿意这样做，就代表最深的信任。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME casts illusions to disguise itself as other Pokémon to make friends. It has a hard time willingly revealing its true form, so doing so is a sign of ultimate trust.

entry: POKENAME通常吃蜂蜜与花朵，很少需要为食物争斗。因此，它们改变外貌，避免与强者无谓交战，只有为了分得附近的食物，才会动手。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME typically eat honey and flowers, so they rarely need to fight other Pokémon for food. As such, they change their appearance to avoid needless fights with stronger Pokémon, only fighting to claim their share of any nearby food.

entry: POKENAME变成与对手一模一样的模样，骗过对方，再趁机翻扑、溅水。有时，它也会变成无声的婴儿。
author: the_fireplace
source: POKENAME changes so it looks just like its foe, tricks it, then uses that opportunity to flop and splash. It sometimes takes the form of a silent baby.

entry: POKENAME在森林深处，假装成哭泣的婴儿，吸引毫无防备的路人。谁一靠近，它便注入毒液，消失在阴影中。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME pretends to be a crying infant deep in the forest to attract unsuspecting passersby. The moment someone gets too close, it injects them with venom and disappears into the shadows.

entry: 这次融合减弱了POKENAME爱捉弄人的一面，却未影响变身能力。如今它近乎孩童般天真爱玩，将变身也当作游戏。
author: elfail0
source: This fusion has significantly dampened the mischievous streak of POKENAME without impacting its ability to transform. As a result, it has an almost childlike innocence and playfulness, treating its ability to transform like a game.

entry: POKENAME进化前，几乎无法移动，便改变模样，躲过强大宝可梦的察觉，为自己争取进化的时间。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME can hardly move before evolving, so they change their appearance to avoid being detected by stronger Pokémon. This gives them time to evolve.

entry: POKENAME用幻象能力，装成其他海中宝可梦，常混在哈克龙群里。它既用能力保护朋友，也同样热衷，对朋友恶作剧。
author: sk372
source: Using its illusion abilities, POKENAME masquerades as other undersea Pokémon. It typically mingles with Dragonair groups, using its abilities to protect and prank its friends in equal measure.

entry: POKENAME会奋力保护自己与朋友。不过，遇到更大、更强的宝可梦，它们就会伪装，保证自身安全。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME will defend themselves and their friends fiercely. However, when they encounter larger and stronger Pokémon, they disguise themselves to keep themselves safe.

entry: 野生POKENAME用幻象，扮成人类孩子，进入训练家学校。它们虽然沉默，却似乎十分勤奋，尽可能记下，关于宝可梦对战的知识。
author: .jerden
source: After using illusion to disguise themselves as human children, wild POKENAME will attend schools for Pokémon Trainers. Although silent, they seem to be diligent students, memorizing as much as they can about Pokémon battling.

entry: POKENAME扮成人类孩子，观看宝可梦对战，尤其喜欢道馆挑战。有时，模样与失踪儿童，像得诡异，被人认出，它们就会逃走。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME disguise themselves as human children to watch Pokémon battles, especially challenges in Gyms. Sometimes they are recognized for their uncanny resemblance to children that have gone missing, which is when POKENAME will flee.

entry: 这种融合体，行踪极难捉摸，确认过的目击极少。不想被看见时，它会顽皮地制造幻象，让人追错方向。
author: bostroms
source: It is a highly elusive fusion with very few confirmed sightings.  If it does not wish to be seen, it will playfully create illusions to throw people off its trail.

entry: POKENAME头顶的毛簇，会飘出罗勒般的怡人气味。许多人觉得，香气莫名令人安心，不过也可能是，诱捕无防备者的诡计。
author: .izik
source: A pleasant basil-like scent wafts from the tuft of fur on POKENAME's head. Many find this aroma oddly calming, though it may be a trick to lure unsuspecting victims.

entry: POKENAME独自生活，守卫作为家园的洞穴。它化作更巨大、更可怕的宝可梦，吓走入侵者；幻象若不奏效，就使出毁灭性的火属性招式。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is a solitary creature guarding the cave it calls home. It takes on the form of larger, more fearsome Pokémon to scare off intruders; if that illusion fails, it unleashes devastating Fire-type moves.

entry: POKENAME变成毛茸茸的宝可梦，引诱训练家抚摸，再偷走财物逃跑。看见危险宝可梦时，它也会变成对方的模样，让伙伴知道，自己看见了什么。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME transforms into fluffy Pokémon to entice Trainers to pet it, only to steal their belongings and run. When POKENAME spots a dangerous Pokémon, it transforms into that Pokémon to show its allies what it sees.

entry: 白天，它大多休息，用幻象把自己伪装成树枝。到了夜里，深色羽毛与无声的双翼让它几乎无迹可寻，唯有阴森的叫声会泄露行踪。
author: elfail0
source: During the day, this Pokémon spends most of its time resting while wreathed in an illusion that disguises it as a tree branch. During the night, its dark plumage and silent wings make it nearly undetectable outside of its haunting cry.

entry: POKENAME采集花粉时，用幻象模仿其他虫属性宝可梦，混入群体。若被发现，它就挥动发蓝光的拳头，击中时，还会闪出强光。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses illusions to mimic other bug types and blend into their swarms when harvesting pollen. If noticed, it punches at them with its glowing blue fists that flash on impact.

entry: POKENAME冒充其他飞行属性宝可梦的幼鸟，抢走原本给孩子的食物。吃饱，等父母飞走以后，它们就会溜走，免遭责骂。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME disguise themselves as the chicks of other Flying-type Pokémon to steal meals from their children. Once they have eaten and the parents fly away, POKENAME flee before they are reprimanded.

entry: POKENAME天性胆怯，藏在灌丛，改变模样，避免冲突。特别害怕时，头顶的毛簇，还会释放电击。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME are naturally timid, hiding in bushes and changing their appearance to avoid confrontations. When they are particularly scared, they release electric shocks from the tufts of fur on their heads.

entry: POKENAME天性胆怯，藏在灌丛，改变模样，避免冲突。特别害怕时，头顶的毛簇，还会释放电击。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME are naturally timid, hiding in bushes and changing their appearance to avoid confrontations. When they are particularly scared, they release electric shocks from the tufts of fur on their heads.

entry: POKENAME能连续好几个小时，唱出美丽的旋律。不过，它们往往害羞得不敢唱，甚至改变模样，连脸都不愿露出。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME can sing beautiful melodies for hours at a time. However, they are often too timid to do so, changing their appearances to avoid even showing their faces.

entry: POKENAME一次能在空中，翱翔数小时，飞行时变换模样，避免被察觉。羽毛既美丽又稀有，在收藏者眼中，价值极高。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME can soar through the skies for hours at a time, changing their appearance while flying to stay undetected. Their feathers are as beautiful as they are rare, fetching a high price for collectors.

entry: POKENAME乘微风漂游，常在半空就睡着。传说，它们成群飞过时，会无意间将噩梦散播到天空中。
author: rakunk
source: POKENAME drift through the air on gentle winds, often falling asleep mid-flight. Legends say that bad dreams are unintentionally spread through the skies by groups of this Pokémon when they fly by.

entry: POKENAME施展幻象的能力，取决于头顶茎秆，收集了多少阳光。它白天休息、进行光合作用，好在傍晚，用幻象捉弄别人。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's ability to cast illusions depends on how much sunlight the stalk on its head has gathered. It rests and photosynthesizes during the day so that it can prank others with its illusions during the evening.

entry: POKENAME不断移动，飞快穿梭，战斗时极难追踪。迅疾的动作，还会留下短暂残影，进一步扰乱对手。
author: evilgammon
