source: POKENAME is constantly moving, with its darting movements making it incredibly hard to track in battles. This rapid movement causes brief afterimages, further disorienting its opponent.

entry: POKENAME不喜欢冲突，若有恶意靠近，就会化作溺亡亲属的模样。谁抓住它，都会沾满黏胶，趁对方分神，它便逃走。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME dislike conflict and take on the appearance of a drowned family member if approached with malice. Anything that grabs them becomes covered in a sticky goo, creating enough distraction for escape.

entry: POKENAME伏在沼泽湿地里，张着嘴，守在猎物家门外。它用幻象，诱使对方相信，里面有食物。
author: gwello
source: Within swamps and marshland, POKENAME will lay, mouth agape, outside the homes of their prey. They use their ability of illusion to trick the Pokémon into believing there is food inside.

entry: 亮闪闪的东西，总能吸引POKENAME的目光。它们变换模样，偷走贵重小物，逃脱追究；即使伪装失败，飞逃的速度，也很快。
author: entomoxie
source: Anything that shines or sparkles catches any POKENAME's eye. They can change their appearance to get away with stealing any valuable trinkets, though they are also speedy in their flight when their disguises fail.

entry: POKENAME性情安静，几乎不动，伪装成自己赖以取食的树的一部分。一棵树上能住着数百只，路过的人却毫不知情。
author: elfail0
source: A very passive Pokémon, POKENAME moves little and pretends to be a part of the tree that it feeds off of. Hundreds of them can live in a colony on a single tree without anyone passing by ever knowing they are even there.

entry: POKENAME结群旅行，防备更大的宝可梦，任何一只受威胁，就会共同迎战。它们还会扮成烈雀，到公园讨面包屑。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME travel in flocks to protect themselves from bigger Pokémon and attack as a team when one is threatened. They are known to disguise themselves as Spearow to obtain breadcrumbs at parks.

entry: POKENAME寻找鸟巢，偷取其中的食物。需要时，它能变换模样混入，不过更喜欢，从无人看守的巢中偷蛋。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME seek out nests for food, stealing food from them. They can change their appearance to blend in when needed, though they prefer eggs from unguarded nests.

entry: POKENAME是诡计多端的家伙，常化作别人，恶作剧。不过，对深深信任的对象，它们也能忠诚而认真。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME are tricksters, frequently pulling pranks by taking on the appearance of others. However, they can be loyal and serious to those whom they trust dearly.

entry: POKENAME是诡计多端的家伙，常化作别人，恶作剧。不过，对深深信任的对象，它们也能忠诚而认真。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME are tricksters, frequently pulling pranks by taking on the appearance of others. However, they can be loyal and serious to those whom they trust dearly.

entry: POKENAME制造自身的幻影捉弄人，最爱假装突然冲到车前，造成交通事故。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME creates illusions of itself to mess with people. Its favorite prank is to pretend to run out in front of vehicles and cause road accidents.

entry: POKENAME的幻象能力，仍在发展，便用电力练习。它将闪电塑成别人的形象，留在空中，仔细研究，好让自己模仿得更像。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is still developing its illusion abilities, and practices using its electricity. It creates copies of others in the air using shaped lightning, studying the facsimiles so it can better mimic them itself.

entry: POKENAME制造复杂迷人的幻象，让猎物彻底着迷。对方一动不动，专注幻象时，它便盘身，将猎物压碎。
author: t3isukone
source: POKENAME creates complex and enchanting illusions, rendering its prey utterly entranced. With them still and focused on its illusion, POKENAME then crushes the prey in its coils.

entry: POKENAME喜欢扮成其他训练家心爱的皮卡丘，抢走皮卡丘该得的爱抚。许多争执因此而起，最后常以一记愤怒的电击收场。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME love to disguise themselves as the beloved Pikachu of other Trainers. Many fights have started when POKENAME steal pets from a Trainer's Pikachu, often ending with a bitter shock.

entry: POKENAME变身时，会发出震耳的尖啸。听见者常会暂时晕眩；趁敌人无暇顾及，它便寻找逃离危险的办法。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: When POKENAME transforms, it emits an ear-splitting screech. Those who hear it are often temporarily stunned, and whilst its foes are preoccupied, POKENAME finds a way to escape danger.

entry: POKENAME表演用的杂耍球和其他道具，全是幻象。它试着不让观众察觉，却常因失误，暴露它们并非实体。
author: .jerden
source: The juggling balls and other props POKENAME uses to perform are all entirely illusionary. While it tries to prevent audiences from noticing this, it will often make mistakes that reveal they are not solid.

entry: POKENAME通常害羞，会伪装自己，避免与别人冲突。无论走到哪里，都带着一颗蛋形卵石，给自己安慰。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME are typically shy and disguise themselves to avoid confrontations with others. They carry an egg-shaped pebble wherever they go to comfort them.

entry: POKENAME用幻象，变成眼前对手的放大版，将其吓离家园。它们也常变成无尾的宝可梦，诱使敌人从后方攻击。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME use their powers of illusion to transform into a larger version of the foe they're facing to scare them away from their home. They often change forms to become tailless Pokémon to trick enemies into trying to strike from behind.

entry: POKENAME施展幻象前，手臂的红叶，会短暂闪光。睡觉时，它变成树木或灌丛，在森林中躲过察觉。
author: .izik
source: The red leaves on POKENAME's arms shimmer briefly before it creates illusions. It transforms into trees or bushes while sleeping to avoid detection in the forest.

entry: POKENAME能变成别人，藏起自己。加上柔软的毛发与羽毛，以及身边的暖意，这些本领，让它们很受孩子欢迎。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME can transform into others to hide themselves. Due to their abilities, their soft fur and feathers, and their ambient warmth, these Pokémon are popular with children.

entry: POKENAME用幻象伪装，战斗时，绕着掩护躲闪，变换外貌，扰乱对手。它能不完整地模仿多数宝可梦的叫声，便发出不搭的声音，迷惑敌人。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME disguises itself with illusions, switching up the projected appearance by ducking around cover while in battle to throw off opponents. It can make imperfect imitations of most Pokémon cries, so it will make incorrect sounds to confuse foes.

entry: POKENAME用幻象，扮成池中央挥手的小女孩，引诱猎物靠近。对方一来，就先使出超音波，再拖入水中，饱餐一顿。
author: .izik
source: Using illusions, POKENAME mimics a small girl waving at the center of a pond to lure prey close. Once they draw near, it uses Supersonic before dragging them into the water to feast.

entry: POKENAME胆怯又贪玩，大多时间，藏在泥里。不过，一注意到朋友靠近，它就会从泥中跃出，给对方一个惊喜。
author: imaginita
source: POKENAME is a timid yet playful Pokémon. It spends much of its time hidden in mud, but if it notices friends approaching, it will leap out of the mud to surprise them.

entry: POKENAME在野外，给自己施加幻象，躲开旁人。只有绝对确信，交往的人完全可信，它才肯撤下幻象。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME casts illusions on itself to hide away from others in the wild. It won't lower this illusion until it is absolutely sure the person it is interacting with is completely trustworthy.

entry: POKENAME既会变色伪装，又能制造幻象，极善躲避危险。不过，它忍不住恶作剧，总从看不见的地方，伸出长舌，抽打旅人。
author: sk372
source: With both camouflage and illusion capabilities, POKENAME is excellent at hiding away from danger. It can't resist pranking travelers by whacking them with its lengthy tongue from somewhere unseen.

entry: POKENAME扮成普通石头，夜里蹦跳着，来到人群聚居处。一感到附近人多，就裂开石头外表，现出身形，吓大家一跳。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME disguises itself as a simple stone, hopping around at night to populated areas. When it senses a large amount of people nearby, it will crack the stone facade and manifest to startle those nearby.

entry: POKENAME扮成普通石头，夜里蹦跳着，来到人群聚居处。一感到附近人多，就裂开石头外表，现出身形，吓大家一跳。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME disguises itself as a simple stone, hopping around at night to populated areas. When it senses a large amount of people nearby, it will crack the stone facade and manifest to startle those nearby.

entry: POKENAME用幻象，藏住第二副双颚，以免吓到朋友。为了保护自己或关爱者，它们却会毫不犹豫，露出这些巨颚。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME conceal their second sets of jaws using their illusion-based powers so they do not frighten their friends. To defend themselves or others they care about, they will not hesitate to unveil these jaws.

entry: POKENAME出没于海底，借幻象能力，伪装在天然的植物群中。
author: slimninja55
source: POKENAME are found along the ocean floor and use their illusory abilities to disguise themselves among the natural flora.

entry: POKENAME有时会得到来源不明的灾难预兆。为了警告人类，它会用幻象扮作人类孩子靠近，展示自己预见的危险。
author: elfail0
source: POKENAME sometimes receives premonitions of disasters from an unknown source. In order to warn humans, it will use illusions to disguise itself as a human child to approach them and show them the nature of the danger it has foreseen.

entry: 夜里偏离小路的人，可能遇见一个戴狐狸面具的孩子，那其实是POKENAME的伪装。它或许会将迷路者带回路上，也可能引入密林，让人从此不知所终。
author: elfail0
source: If a person wanders off the path at night, they may encounter a child in a fox mask. This is actually a POKENAME in disguise. They will either attempt to lead the lost person back to the path or deeper into the woods, never to be seen again.

entry: 过去，曾有整个文明，集体崇拜POKENAME。人们并不知道，它常会扮成人类，也加入庆典。
author: .izik
source: Entire cultures once worshipped POKENAME en masse. Unbeknownst to them, it often joined the festivities disguised as a human.

entry: POKENAME用幻象，模仿人类外貌，再从嫩芽放出气味，复制人的体味。它借此混入，偷取食物。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME mimics the appearance of humans through illusion and replicates their scent by releasing aroma from its sprout. It uses this to blend in while stealing food from them.

entry: POKENAME之间的较量，可能持续数小时，双方制造的幻象，越来越复杂。胜者因为欣喜，尾火会烧得更亮。
author: catsquatch_geography
source: Challenges between POKENAME may last for several hours, during which each challenger creates illusions of increasing complexity. The winner's tail flame burns brighter from the joy of victory.

entry: POKENAME虽然能用幻象，完美模仿某人的外貌，身体却始终灼热，周围空气，也被暖意烘得微微波动。
author: .izik
source: Despite being able to perfectly mimic someone's appearance through illusion, POKENAME retains an intense heat on its body. The air around it ripples slightly from the warmth.

entry: POKENAME体内产生致幻液体，再化作泡泡吐出。力量与速度，足以损坏岩石和树木，不过，它通常仍靠诱发幻觉，解决对手。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME produces a hallucinogenic fluid within its body, which it spits out as bubbles. POKENAME can spit out bubbles with enough force and speed to damage rocks and trees, though it typically relies on induced hallucinations to dispatch foes.

entry: POKENAME为躲避冲突，常伪装成普通物品。只有脆弱的猎物落单时，才会出手伏击。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME disguises itself as ordinary objects to avoid conflict. It only ambushes vulnerable prey when they are alone.

entry: POKENAME变换模样，接近毫无防备的宝可梦，免遭威胁。直到利爪深深切入，它们才会露出真面目。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME can change their appearance to approach unsuspecting Pokémon without themselves being threatened. Only after their sharp claws cut deep do they show their true colors.

entry: 这种宝可梦能制造幻象，轻易避开陌生人。不过，这项能力常被用来恶作剧，即使其他POKENAME，总能一眼看穿。
author: secondatheniangadfly
source: This Pokémon can create illusions that allow it to easily avoid strangers. However, this ability is often used for mischief, even though other POKENAME can always see through it.

entry: POKENAME模仿其他宝可梦，数周也不被发现。期间，它始终维持平和的气息；哪怕短暂中断，也会立刻逃走。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME can go weeks undetected while mimicking other Pokémon. It maintains a calming aura throughout this time, fleeing the moment it lapses even briefly.

entry: 它能用触须，制造大型宝可梦或巨大物件的幻象，保护自己或别人。无论人类还是宝可梦，它都会用力量，阻止或平息争斗。
author: infinex21
source: Using its feelers, it can create an illusion of large Pokémon or large objects to protect itself or others. It will use its powers to prevent or stop fights between others, be they humans or Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME用多层幻象藏身，先装成索罗亚，再装成人类孩子。即使外貌完美，它的举止与行为，也总与真身有明显差异，令人不安。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME cloaks itself in multiple illusions, first disguising itself as Zorua, then as a human child. Even if the disguise looks perfect, POKENAME's mannerisms and behavior will always be noticeably and unsettlingly off from the real thing.

entry: POKENAME能自由操纵火焰，也能用幻象，改变火的颜色。它们喜欢为旅人，献上五彩缤纷的灯光表演。
author: quinnyquiver57
source: POKENAME can freely control fire, and their illusions can be used to change the colour of the flame. POKENAME love to put on colourful light shows for travelers.

entry: POKENAME若遇到受困的探洞者，就用幻象，精确变成对方的模样。它直盯着对方，等待其逝去，再进食。
author: .izik
source: Should POKENAME encounter a trapped spelunker, it uses illusions to mirror their appearance exactly. It stares directly at them while waiting for them to pass so it can feed.

entry: 它对其他宝可梦开些无害的玩笑，想借此交朋友。它却怕人，通常只会披着幻象的伪装靠近。
author: bobosmith01
source: It plays harmless pranks on other Pokémon in an attempt to become friends with them. It shies away from humans, often only approaching under an illusory disguise.

entry: 它对其他宝可梦开些无害的玩笑，想借此交朋友。它却怕人，通常只会披着幻象的伪装靠近。
author: bobosmith01
source: It plays harmless pranks on other Pokémon in an attempt to become friends with them. It shies away from humans, often only approaching under an illusory disguise.

entry: 它对其他宝可梦开些无害的玩笑，想借此交朋友。它却怕人，通常只会披着幻象的伪装靠近。
author: bobosmith01
source: It plays harmless pranks on other Pokémon in an attempt to become friends with them. It shies away from humans, often only approaching under an illusory disguise.

entry: POKENAME的手臂与爪子强壮，却很少喜欢用力量争斗。休息时，它变换模样，避免冲突，每天只活动两小时左右。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME have strong arms and claws, though they rarely like to use their strength for fighting. They can change their appearance while resting to avoid fights, and they are only active for around 2 hours each day.

entry: POKENAME常变成孩子，混进游乐场，开心地与其他小朋友玩耍。不过，一发现欺凌者，它就会用一记精准的电击，惩罚对方。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME often transforms into a child to blend in at playgrounds, happily playing alongside other kids. However, if it spots a bully, it will punish them with a well-placed electric shock.

entry: POKENAME用能力，装成无助的宝可梦，欺骗猎物。恢复本来模样后，它就让深色毛发带电，全力战斗。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME deceives prey by taking the form of a helpless Pokémon thanks to its powers. When it returns to its original features, it fights with all its strength, electrifying its dark fur.

entry: POKENAME的幻象，会让观看者陷入催眠般的恍惚，很快睡着。这常让爱恶作剧、想成为焦点的它，十分不满。
author: t3isukone
source: The illusions created by POKENAME lull those who view them into a hypnotic trance, quickly falling asleep. This often upsets the mischievous POKENAME, who prefer to be the center of attention.

entry: POKENAME渴望钢铁的滋味，尤其爱吃铁轨与桥梁所用的致密合金。可爱的外表和胆怯的性情，让它们很受欢迎，直到大块金属，开始不翼而飞。
author: brilliantdarkness
source: POKENAME crave the taste of steel, favoring the dense alloys used in train tracks and bridges. Their cute appearance and timid nature make them quite popular until chunks of metal start vanishing.

entry: POKENAME用幻象，改变外貌，让花苞看起来，像周围的花朵。美餐一靠近，花苞便会打开，露出利刃般的爪子，抓住猎物。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: By altering its appearance with illusions, POKENAME makes its bud resemble the surrounding flowers. When a potential meal comes within reach, the bud parts to expose razor-sharp claws that capture the prey.

entry: POKENAME的花，绽放出夺目的绯红与海蓝色。危险稍露征兆，它就把花瓣变得暗淡，避免受到注意。
author: brilliantdarkness
source: The flowers of a POKENAME bloom into striking hues of crimson and aquamarine. At the first sign of danger, it transforms its petals into duller tones to avoid attention.

entry: POKENAME常装成安静的孩子，将儿童引离安全的地方。绳线般的手臂，无法改变，容易露馅，因此它会将双臂，藏到背后。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME will often disguise themselves as quiet children to lure children away from safety. They will tuck their string arms behind their backs, as these parts do not change and can lead to them getting caught.

entry: POKENAME产生的黑色孢子，吸入后会引起幻觉。只有觉得威胁靠巢太近，它才会释放。
author: mepp.
source: The black spores POKENAME produces can cause hallucinations when inhaled. It only releases them when a perceived threat comes too close to its den.

entry: POKENAME夜里旅行，让风带着轻盈的身体前行。为进一步保护自己，它施展幻象，看起来只是微风卷起的叶片或尘埃。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME travels at night, using the wind to carry its light body around. To further protect itself, it casts illusions to make it appear as nothing more than leaves or dust caught in the breeze.

entry: POKENAME躲在洞穴最暗的角落，不愿被看见。遭到围堵时，就变成来犯者的模样，吓对方一跳，再飞走。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME hides in the darkest corners of caves to avoid being seen. When cornered, it transforms into the appearance of its provoker to startle them, then flies away.

entry: POKENAME能改变镜中的倒影，常用来欺骗路人。不知为何，它似乎很讨厌，看见自己的倒影。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is able to change the reflections in its mirror and will often try to trick passersby with it. For some unknown reason, POKENAME seems to hate looking at its own reflection.

entry: 为了保护自己，它伪装成其他鸟类宝可梦。一旦受到逼问或对峙，就会露出真身，变得凶暴。
author: lydiaprower8
source: To protect itself, it disguises itself as other bird Pokémon. When confronted, it shows its true form and becomes aggressive.

entry: POKENAME在宝石矿里，用幻象冒充矿工，搜寻无人看管的宝石。偷到一颗，就会退到矿井角落，吃掉。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME impersonates miners in gem mines using illusions to search for unattended gems. When it steals one, it retreats to a corner of the mine to eat it.

entry: POKENAME喷出的橙色毒液，有致幻作用。因此，即使不太擅长幻象的个体，也能显得更加逼真。
author: .izik
source: The orange venom POKENAME sprays carry a hallucinogenic quality. This allows even those with poor illusion skills to appear more convincing.

entry: POKENAME能高速翻滚，却很难转向。无法在平坦地形上四处移动时，它们就会改变模样，免得被认出。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME can roll around at high speeds, though they struggle to turn around when doing so. They can change their appearance to avoid being identified whenever they can't move around on smooth terrain.

entry: POKENAME会扮成迷路的旅人，躲避危险，却无意间，将想来救援的人，带进暴风雪。
author: ghostslythe
source: Known to disguise itself as a lost traveler to avoid danger, POKENAME unintentionally leads would-be rescuers into blizzards.

entry: POKENAME将身体埋起，只留头顶一点毛露出。它能让毛簇看起来像叶片，在森林中彻底藏好，一边埋伏，一边探知附近动静。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME can bury their bodies, only letting some fur on their head poke out. They can make these tufts of fur look like leaves to stay completely hidden in forests, still detecting nearby motion while lying in wait.

entry: POKENAME变换模样，避免与强大宝可梦争斗。脚爪上的大绒球，储着许多静电，轻轻一戳，就能电到毫无防备的目标。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME change their appearance to avoid fights with stronger Pokémon. The large pom-poms on their paws store much static electricity and can shock unsuspecting targets with a single jab.

entry: POKENAME的叫声，与尖叫的孩子一模一样。它会找到野餐或露营的人，大声哭喊，等他们离开，好偷走食物。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME has a call that sounds exactly like a screaming child. It will find people going on picnics or camping and cry out, waiting for them to leave so that it can steal their food.

entry: POKENAME在幽暗的森林游荡，用各种伪装保护自己，最常见的，就是沉默的孩子。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME wanders around dark forests, taking on all sorts of disguises to protect itself; the most common one being a silent child.

entry: POKENAME在幽暗的森林游荡，用各种伪装保护自己，最常见的，就是沉默的孩子。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME wanders around dark forests, taking on all sorts of disguises to protect itself; the most common one being a silent child.

entry: POKENAME能精确控制，耳朵发出的声音。观察一个人，就能模仿嗓音，再用幻象复制外貌，不过，它的嘴唇，从来不动。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME has acute control over the sounds its ears can produce. By studying a human, it can mimic their voice and copy their appearance through illusion, though its lips never move.

entry: 谁把手伸进POKENAME嘴里，哪怕只是一瞬，它的身体，也能制造出对方的幻象。不过，声音无法模仿，让幻象，安静得令人不安。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body can create an illusion of anyone who sticks their hand into its mouth, even briefly. It cannot mimic their voice, leaving the illusions eerily silent.

entry: POKENAME很合群，喜欢置身其他宝可梦的大群体。为扩大族群，它们会伪装，潜入培育屋与牧场，偷来蛋，孵出新朋友。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME are very sociable and enjoy being amongst large groups of other Pokémon. In order to grow their packs, POKENAME disguise themselves and sneak into daycares and ranches to steal eggs to hatch new friends.

entry: POKENAME模仿受害者亲爱之人的嗓音，用催眠般的歌声，将其引入夜色。若最近失去亲近的人，最好不要夜间出行。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME lures its victims into the night with its hypnotic singing, mimicking the voices of the victim's loved ones. It is recommended to not to travel at night if you have recently lost someone close to you.

entry: POKENAME吃树根，通常用幻象装成真菌，避免不必要的注意。若不奏效，它们就轮番化作见过的宝可梦，试着威吓对方。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME feed on tree roots, and usually avoid unwanted attention by using illusion to disguise themselves as fungi. If this doesn't work, POKENAME will cycle through illusions of other Pokémon they have seen in an attempt to be intimidating.

entry: POKENAME是恶意的小捣蛋，用幻象，融入周围环境。它在附近藏好尖刺，等旅人踩上、弄伤自己，再放声嘲笑。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a malicious little prankster, using illusions to make itself blend in with its surroundings. It places hidden quills around the area nearby, waiting to laugh when travelers hurt themselves stepping upon them.

entry: POKENAME只需轻挥手中细枝，就能施展幻象，模仿二十英尺内的任何人。幻象的动作，也能与本尊完全一致。
author: .izik
source: With a simple wave of the twig it carries, POKENAME can cast an illusion on itself to mimic anyone within 20 feet. This illusion can move exactly like its subject.

entry: POKENAME能将幻象，固定在注入精神力量的发光棒上。它们把棒散在巢穴周围，形成幻象与诡计的迷宫，抵御大多数危险。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME conjure illusions which they can anchor to glowing sticks that they imbue with psychic power. They scatter these sticks around the places they nest, creating a maze of illusions and trickery that keeps them safe from most danger.

entry: POKENAME敏捷又会变身，总躲开研究者，因此很难研究。科学家发现，少数会扮成忍者小子，只有没带精灵球，才会露出破绽。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are hard Pokémon to research because they use their agility and transforming ability to evade researchers. Scientists have found that a few disguise themselves as Ninja Boys, only able to be spotted by their lack of Poké Balls.

entry: POKENAME常藏在阴暗的树顶或洞穴，等待猎物靠近。若找不到合适藏处，它们也能改变外貌，避免被发现。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME tend to hide in dark treetops and caves, waiting for prey to approach. They can change their appearance to avoid detection whenever they can't comfortably hide.

entry: POKENAME扮成友好的宝可梦，引诱别人爬上背。目标坐稳，它就恢复真身，游到湖中央，索要多汁的树果，才肯保证对方安全。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME disguise themself as a friendly Pokémon to lure others onto their back. Once their target is secured on their back, they revert back to their true form and swim out to the middle of lakes, demanding juicy berries in exchange for safety.

entry: POKENAME先观察海滩的情侣，再扮成其中一人，假装溺水。对方靠近救援时，它便将受害者，拖到波浪之下。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME studies couples at the beach before pretending to be a drowning member of the pair. When they draw close to help, it drags the victim beneath the waves.

entry: POKENAME很受新富人群欢迎，能让家中任何表面，看起来变成金、银、大理石、玉石或上等瓷器。不过，变化全是幻象，藏住的，其实仍是普通住宅。
author: riley_muir_qu33n_in_yellow
source: Popular among the nouveau riche, POKENAME are able to turn any surface in the home into gold, silver, marble, jade, and fine china. These changes, however, are only illusions hiding otherwise plain homes.

entry: 它靠诡计与乞求，讨来各种零食，即使吃饱、照料充分，也不例外。毛发十分蓬松。
author: bobosmith01
source: It uses trickery and begging in order to obtain all manner of treats, even after it is full or perfectly well-fed. It has very fluffy fur.

entry: 它靠诡计与乞求，讨来各种零食，即使吃饱、照料充分，也不例外。毛发十分蓬松。
author: bobosmith01
source: It uses trickery and begging in order to obtain all manner of treats, even after it is full or perfectly well-fed. It has very fluffy fur.

entry: 它镜面般的腹部，能根据提问，显现图像。不知道答案，就故意显示错误的东西；有时，甚至只是为了取乐，也会答错。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Its mirror-like belly can conjure images in response to questions. If it doesn't know the answer, it deliberately displays something incorrect. Sometimes, it gives wrong answers simply for its own amusement.

entry: POKENAME用幻象，改变腹部面孔的表情，逗年幼的宝可梦开心。还会配上哑剧表演，常常重现，当天早些时候发生的事。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME use their illusory powers to alter the face on their stomach into different expressions for the entertainment of young Pokémon. They mime performances to go along with their show, often recounting events that happened earlier in the day.

entry: POKENAME独居在幽暗的深洞，用幻象，让自己在入侵者眼中，显得更加可怕。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME lives a solitary life in deep, dark caves. It uses illusions to make itself appear more terrifying to intruders.

entry: POKENAME柔软可塑的身体，能轻易变形，投射幻象。有些实验显示，连脱离身体的黏液，也能改变形状。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's malleable body can easily shift in shape to project an illusion. Some experiments have shown that the slime from POKENAME can change shape even while unattached.

entry: POKENAME背上的仙人掌，含有易燃毒液。POKENAME既能从尖刺放毒自保，也能点燃毒液进攻。
author: raza
source: The cactus on POKENAME's back contains a flammable toxin. POKENAME can release the toxin from the spikes for defense or ignite it for attacks.

entry: POKENAME的种子能分泌溶解金属的强烈腐蚀性酸液。这种酸液，也是尾焰燃烧的燃料。
author: benevolent
source: The bulb of a POKENAME is capable of producing a corrosive acid that can dissolve metal. This acid is the fuel for the flame on its tail.

entry: POKENAME吐出的丝，能抵御火焰。许多厨师烹饪时，都会穿上这种丝做的围裙。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME produce a flame-resistant silk. Many chefs wear aprons made from this material when cooking.

entry: POKENAME休息时若被打扰，就会放出猛烈的火焰。越感到孤独，火便烧得越炽热。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME unleashes intense flames when disturbed during rest. The lonelier it feels, the hotter its fire burns.

entry: POKENAME把燃烧的骨头当火把，照亮洞中道路，免得害怕黑暗。戴着的头骨若受损，它就会哭上一整天。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME uses its flaming bone as a torch to light its way through caves and avoid fear of the dark. If the skull it wears is damaged, it cries all day.

entry: 它常保护一群幼小的卡拉卡拉，教它们生存的本领。POKENAME战斗时，会点燃骨棒，让打击更加有力。
author: fiordaliso
source: It often takes groups of young Cubone under its protection to teach them the art of survival. When POKENAME battles, it sets the bone club it wields ablaze to make its strikes even more powerful.

entry: 强壮的双腿燃着火，随便踢一下都能造成重伤。每走一步，地上都会留下焦痕。
author: krune
source: Any kick from this Pokémon, with its powerful flaming legs, will cause some serious damage. Its footsteps leave seared marks on the ground.

entry: POKENAME摩擦拳套，就能将其点燃，让摆拳与上勾拳，变成炽热的威胁。它天性大胆，即使被异常状态，或远比自己强大的对手逼入困境，也会奋战不休。
author: fiordaliso
source: By rubbing its gloves together, POKENAME can set them ablaze, turning its hooks and uppercuts into blazing threats. Bold by nature, it fights on relentlessly even when cornered by status conditions or opponents far more powerful than itself.

entry: POKENAME能点燃舌面上的唾液，灼烧舔到的一切。为让尾火明亮燃烧，它只吃极辣的食物。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME can ignite the saliva coating its tongue to scorch anything it licks. To keep the flame on its tail burning bright, it feeds exclusively on extremely spicy foods.

entry: POKENAME体内的气体极易燃烧。受到威胁时，它就用尾焰将其点燃，引发烈焰爆炸。气体也有腐蚀性，吸入会损伤肺部。
author: mistymagius
source: The gas inside of POKENAME's body is highly flammable, and when threatened it will ignite the gas with its tail to cause a fiery explosion. The gas is also caustic, causing lung damage if inhaled.

entry: POKENAME吐出一团团燃烧的丝，抵御捕食者。不过，有时会无意间，燎伤附近植物。
author: mepp.
source: To defend itself from predators, POKENAME spits lobs of flaming silk. This has been known to inadvertently singe nearby plants.

entry: 古时候，人们将POKENAME当作活灯笼。历史上许多火灾，据说都与遭受虐待的POKENAME有关。
author: staghorn
source: In ancient times, humans used POKENAME as living lanterns. Many historical fires are thought to be caused by mistreated POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME从壳后喷出火焰，就能高速奔跑。寒冷天气里，温差会让护甲变脆，因此，它只能栖居在温暖的地方。
author: oreee0230
source: By shooting flames from behind its shell, POKENAME can run at high speed. In cold weather, POKENAME's armour becomes fragile due to the temperature difference, so its habitat is limited to warm places.

entry: 为适应严酷的雨林气候，POKENAME开始披上当地植物。研究者不确定，这是为了防御，还是吸引伴侣。
author: nottgames7
source: In order to adapt to the harsh rainforest climate, POKENAME began wearing the local flora. Researchers are not sure whether this is for the purpose of defense, or for attracting partners.

entry: POKENAME尾部的火焰，即使在水下，也烧得明亮。捕食者靠近时，它们会挥动火焰，希望将对方吓退。
author: santon5512
source: The flames on POKENAME's tails burn brightly even underwater. When predators are nearby, they will wave this flame around, hoping to scare them off.

entry: POKENAME鼓胀的腹部，充满可燃气体。气体受热，从后部喷出时，水中的氧气，就足以使其燃烧。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME's swollen belly is full of flammable gas. When it heats up and jets from behind, the oxygen in the water is enough to make it ignite.

entry: 角尖的火焰，即使在水下，也持续燃烧。它先用火光，引来小型宝可梦，再喷出极其灼热的水流，使其晕眩。
author: prideful_snek
source: The flame at the tip of its horn remains burning even underwater. It lures smaller Pokémon with the light from the flame before stunning them with a stream of superheated water.

entry: POKENAME十分迷恋，尾鳍发出的火焰。因此，常能看见它们一只接一只，排成直线前进，各自欣赏，前一只的尾巴。
author: radiance8990
source: POKENAME is quite enamored with the fire emanating from its tail fins. As such, groups of POKENAME are often seen traveling in single-file lines, with each POKENAME admiring the tail of the one ahead of it.

entry: POKENAME炽热的身体，散发大量热量，吸引冷血宝可梦。许多太害羞，不敢拥抱它；少数鼓起勇气的，却发现，双方都很享受。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME release so much body heat from their hot bodies that they draw the attention of cold-blooded Pokémon. Many cold-blooded Pokémon are too shy to hug POKENAME, but the few that do find that they both enjoy the experience.

entry: POKENAME的翅膀不能飞，却仍能帮助提速。遇到难切开的东西，它会先试着用火熔化。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME's wings cannot be used for flying, but they can still help with boosting speed. When encountering objects that are hard to cut, POKENAME will try to melt them with fire first.

entry: 夜幕降临，POKENAME在常见的猎场潜行。它用尾巴燃烧的光，指引弱小宝可梦，到安全的地方。
author: amityblamity
source: When night falls, POKENAME stalks common hunting grounds. It guides weaker Pokémon to safety with the burning light of its tail.

entry: 燃烧的角，是它生命精华的源泉。天气潮湿或下雨时，POKENAME就钻入地下，保护角，不被浇熄。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Its fiery horns are the source of its life essence. When it is damp or raining, POKENAME will burrow into the ground to protect its horns from being doused.

entry: POKENAME的耐心，比牙签还短。再加上强壮的体格，至今没有斗牛士能赢过它。
author: patch_bros
source: POKENAME's temper is about as short as a toothpick. Because of this, in addition to its physique, no matador has ever bested it.

entry: POKENAME奋力腾跃在火山崖壁上方，维持火焰，又不至在温泉里，将自己煮熟。觉得即将进化的个体，会朝火山中央跃去。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME uses powerful leaps to soar above volcanic cliffs to keep its flames going without cooking itself in the hot springs. POKENAME that believes it is about to evolve will leap toward the center of a volcano.

entry: POKENAME性情温和，只有抵御捕食者、自保时，才会战斗。它拍动火翼，四处觅食，撒下细灰，让土壤变得格外肥沃。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is a gentle creature that fights only to defend itself from predators. As it beats its fiery wings while searching for food, it scatters fine ash that makes the soil remarkably fertile.

entry: POKENAME各有鲜明的个性与喜好。吃到最喜欢的树果或叶片，身体末端的火焰，就会泛出明艳的紫红色。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME have distinct personalities and preferences. If a POKENAME eats its favorite kind of Berry or leaf, the flame at the end of its body will glow in a brilliant fuchsia color.

entry: POKENAME通常在熔岩表面，爬行、玩耍。一下雨或降温，它就游入熔岩，变得像暴鲤龙一样凶猛。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME usually crawls and plays on the surface of the lava. Once it rains or the temperature drops, POKENAME will swim in the lava and become as aggressive as a Gyarados.

entry: POKENAME帮助怕冷的宝可梦幼崽，度过冬季。那些足够强壮、却仍需借它的火焰，温暖幼崽的宝可梦，则在附近守望。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME helps Pokémon babies who are afraid of the cold get through the winter. Those Pokémon that are strong enough but still need POKENAME's flames to warm the babies will keep watch nearby.

entry: 尾巴的火焰，反映它的情绪。POKENAME颈边的鬃毛温暖，害怕或生气时，却会像硬毛一样竖起。
author: infinex21
source: The flame on its tail reflects its emotions. The mane of fur around a POKENAME's neck is warm but will stand up like bristles when it is scared or angry.

entry: POKENAME喜欢寻找火山海滩的水洼与潮池，在其中练习、玩耍。研究者多半是追查它留下的玻璃爪印，才发现它们。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: POKENAME enjoy locating puddles and tidepools along volcanic beaches. They often use these to practice as well as play. Most have been found by researchers investigating glass pawprints left behind by this Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME常出现在火山活动区域下方的海滩，与海浪玩耍。它加热身体，蒸发可能浇灭尾火的水，保护自己。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: POKENAME are often found around beaches at the base of volcanic activity. They play with the surf, keeping themselves safe by heating their bodies to evaporate any loose water that may douse their tail flame.

entry: POKENAME不断在体内储存电能，为颈边的火焰领圈提供燃料。它脾气急、易冲动，有时不等训练家下令，就先行动。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME continuously stores electrical energy in its body to fuel the fiery collar around its neck. Hot-tempered and impulsive, it may sometimes act without waiting for its Trainer's command.

entry: POKENAME不断在体内储存电能，为颈边的火焰领圈提供燃料。它脾气急、易冲动，有时不等训练家下令，就先行动。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME continuously stores electrical energy in its body to fuel the fiery collar around its neck. Hot-tempered and impulsive, it may sometimes act without waiting for its Trainer's command.

entry: 这种POKENAME比近亲更活跃，体温也更高，加快代谢，使它更强。为维持能量消耗，它日夜捕猎、烧烤，再大口吃下。
author: oreee0230
source: This POKENAME is more active than other close relatives, and its higher body temperature speeds up its metabolism, making it stronger. To maintain its energy expenditure, it hunts, grills, and eats day and night.

entry: POKENAME的尾火，随心情明灭。欣喜若狂时，火焰噼啪燃得明亮，还会偶尔迸出，数字1和0。
author: sk372
source: The flame on POKENAME's tail flares up or dims in accordance to its mood. When overjoyed, it crackles and burns brightly casting off occasional 1s and 0s while it burns.

entry: 外壳始终燃着火，提供额外防御。稍有下雨迹象，POKENAME就缩进壳，滚走，立刻寻找避雨处。
author: sk372
source: Its shell stays constant aflame as extra defense. At the first sign of rain, POKENAME tucks into its shell and rolls away to find immediate shelter.

entry: POKENAME各有鲜明的个性与喜好。吃到最喜欢的树果或叶片，身体末端的火焰，就会泛出明艳的紫红色。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME have distinct personalities and preferences. If a POKENAME eats its favorite kind of Berry or leaf, the flame at the end of its body will glow in a brilliant fuchsia color.

entry: POKENAME虽然缓慢，厚壳却能抵御捕食者。即使身在水下，尾火也持续燃烧。
author: _._starry_._
source: Although it is slow, POKENAME's thick shell protects it from predators. The fire in its tail burns even when it is underwater.

entry: POKENAME若遭虐待，火焰头冠会越烧越弱，直到熄灭。因为稀有，宝可梦巡护员常会留意、保护它，免受偷猎者与其他罪犯伤害。
author: fiordaliso
source: If mistreated, POKENAME's crest of fire burns down until it goes out. Given its rarity, it is often observed by Pokémon Rangers, and kept safe from poachers and other criminals.

entry: POKENAME每次蜕皮，尾火都会吞噬蜕下的皮，烧得更明亮。火焰增强时，它的体型与力量，也会增长。
author: linhasxoc
source: Every time POKENAME molts, the flame on its tail consumes the shed skin and burns brighter. As the flame strengthens, its size and power grow.

entry: POKENAME每次蜕皮，尾火都会吞噬蜕下的皮，烧得更明亮。火焰增强时，它的体型与力量，也会增长。
author: linhasxoc
source: Every time POKENAME molts, the flame on its tail consumes the shed skin and burns brighter. As the flame strengthens, its size and power grow.

entry: 测量POKENAME尾火的长度，就能判断年龄。每次蜕鳞，火焰都会增长；蜕下的鳞片，则能磨成粉，用于传统医药。
author: quackquackattack
source: The age of a POKENAME can be determined by measuring the length of the flame on their tail. The flame grows each time they shed their scales, which can be ground into a powder that is used in traditional medicine.

entry: POKENAME只在晴朗时外出，尾火敏感，让它害怕任何雨意。它心地温和，除非觉得身处危险，否则，尾火不会烧伤别人。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME only ventures out when skies are clear, afraid of any hint of rain due to the sensitivity of its tail-flame. It has a gentle soul, and the fire on its tail will not burn another unless it feels it is in danger.

entry: POKENAME的叶片从叶尖一直烧到根部时，就说明它要进化了。脖子上的花苞，会散发出干花香料般的怡人香气。
author: volvonovic
source: When a POKENAME's leaf burns down to its root, it is ready to evolve. The bulbs on its neck emit a pleasant aroma reminiscent of potpourri.

entry: 背部火焰的强弱，反映心情；POKENAME生气时，就会冒出浓黑的烟。它极怕雷暴，甚至只要下雨，就拒绝战斗，也不听训练家的话。
author: fiordaliso
source: The intensity of the flames covering its back reflects its mood; when POKENAME becomes angry, they emit thick black smoke. It is extremely afraid of thunderstorms, to the point that it refuses to fight or obey its Trainer when it is raining.

entry: POKENAME精力充沛，背部冒火，喜欢追逐其他宝可梦。送到眼前的东西，它们也都爱咬，想训练克制这股冲动，十分困难。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are energetic creatures that sprout flames from their back and love to chase other Pokémon. They also love to bite down on anything they are presented with, and training them to suppress this urge can be difficult.

entry: POKENAME总想咬住眼前的一切，因此很难训练。不过，咬到其他宝可梦或训练家以后，它们常会懊悔。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can be difficult to train because of their urge to bite down on anything in front of them. They often feel remorseful after biting another Pokémon or their Trainer.

entry: POKENAME能从嘴中喷出火星，烤好树果，再吃下。给它树果去烤，能暂时压住，见什么都想咬的冲动。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can produce embers from their mouth to roast berries before they eat them. Their urge to bite whatever is in front of them can momentarily be suppressed by giving them berries to roast.

entry: 羽毛覆着薄薄一层灰。受惊时，它就会猛烈扑腾，扬起一团烟雾。
author: ozydamians
source: Its feathers are coated in a thin layer of ash. It flaps around wildly when frightened, kicking up a cloud of smoke.

entry: 冬天来临，POKENAME会用蓬松尾巴，裹住自己保暖。为防火焰熄灭，它一天大多时间，都在吃橡实与树果，积蓄能量。
author: fiordaliso
source: When winter comes, POKENAME wraps its fluffy tail around itself to keep warm. To prevent its flame from going out, it spends most of the day eating acorns and berries to store up energy.

entry: POKENAME点燃整条尾巴，辅助飞行，也威吓猎物。尽管如此，人们曾观察到，夜间捕猎时，它们会减弱角与尾巴，两处的火焰。
author: silverscloudy
source: POKENAME ignite their entire tail to aid their flight and intimidate their prey. Despite this behaviour, they have been observed to weaken both the flames of their horns and tail when hunting at night.

entry: POKENAME的网，很快就能烧起来。宝可梦一被困住，它便点燃蛛网，顺势将猎物烤熟。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME's webbing burns quickly, so when a Pokémon gets trapped in it, POKENAME sets the web alight and cooks its prey in the process.

entry: POKENAME的羽毛，始终在阴燃，夏天常无意间引发森林火灾。宝可梦巡护员会密切留意鸟群的栖处，必要时，才能及时通知居民撤离。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have feathers that are constantly smouldering. They inadvertently start forest fires in the summer, so Pokémon Rangers pay close attention to where flocks roost to make sure they can warn residents if they need to evacuate.

entry: POKENAME用尾羽将温暖的火星扇向巢中的蛋。若有天敌来偷蛋，POKENAME就会扬起烟幕，挥爪胡乱抓挠。
author: ozydamians
source: With its tail feathers, POKENAME fans warm embers over the eggs in its nest. When a predator tries to steal its eggs, POKENAME whips up a smokescreen and slashes haphazardly with its talons.

entry: 尾尖火焰若熄灭，POKENAME就会陷入深度休眠。它能把火焰转移到脸颊，妥善保护。
author: bandedbodypress
source: If the flame at the end of its tail ever goes out, POKENAME falls into a deep hibernation. It can transfer its flame into its cheeks for safeguarding.

entry: POKENAME生病时，打喷嚏会喷出火星。每次排出的空气太多，都会让眼睛泪汪汪。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME sneeze out embers when they are sick. Each time they sneeze, so much air is expelled from their body that it causes their eyes to water.

entry: 它散发的热量能让人类与宝可梦都感到暖意融融，心中宽慰，因此常成为治疗师的伙伴。
author: staghorn
source: The heat it produces also creates a "warm and fuzzy" feeling in humans and Pokémon. For this reason, they're a common partner for therapists.

entry: POKENAME常突然停步，凝望远方。学者认为，它看见了过去时刻的片段；影像结束后，就会打喷嚏，喷出小团火焰。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME often stops walking and stares into the distance. Scholars believe it sees glimpses of past moments in time, and when its vision ends, it sneezes small bursts of flame.

entry: POKENAME每次活动，都产生静电，积在羊毛里。尾火反映生命力，让农民与牧场工人，轻易就能判断，哪只身体不适。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME wool is rife with static electricity generated with each move they make. Their life forces are indicated by their tail flames, so it is easy for farmers and ranch hands to tell if one of their POKENAME is ill.

entry: POKENAME摩擦体毛，积蓄热量。毛发温暖时，容易加工，冷却以后，则会成为不易变形的弹性材料。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME accumulates heat by rubbing its body hair. This hair is easy to process when warm and becomes a hard-to-deform elastic material once cooled.

entry: POKENAME曾被误认成发胖的火焰鸟。飞行时身后拖着浓浓黑烟，军队因此会借POKENAME远距离传递暗号。
author: ozydamians
source: POKENAME was once mistaken to be a chubby Moltres. Dark clouds of smoke trail behind it as it flies, so the military employs POKENAME to send coded messages across long distances.

entry: POKENAME耐火的毛发，遇高温便会放热。小心取下燃烧的毛，是精细而古老的技艺，这些毛，也能卖到极高的价格。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME's fire-resistant fur releases heat when exposed to high temperatures. Carefully removing the blazing fur is a precise and ancient skill, and these furs sell for a very high price.

entry: 天气越晴，POKENAME的火焰，就烧得越明亮。下雨时，它们会躲避，因为火一熄灭，生命也就结束。
author: santon5512
source: The sunnier it is, the brighter POKENAME flames burn. When it rains, they will take shelter, as their lives will end if their fire is extinguished.

entry: POKENAME点燃小片草地，制造烟雾，再乘着烟云，将自己送上天空。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME set small patches of grass on fire to produce smoke. They ride on these clouds of smoke to propel themselves into the sky.

entry: POKENAME小群挤在一起，产生一股股烟。烟积得足够多后，它们就乘着上升的烟，飞入天空。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME huddle into small groups to produce plumes of smoke. Once enough smoke has been made, they ride the rising smoke into the sky.

entry: POKENAME夏季最活跃，炎热的气温与烈日，让它们兴奋。这时，它们喜欢尽情玩耍，尤其爱与别人玩捉人游戏。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are most active during summer, as the hot temperatures and scorching hot sun make them excited. They enjoy playing during these periods of excitement and especially love to play tag with others.

entry: POKENAME在城镇疾行，尾巴闪着火花，照亮深夜的路。它们啃穿油箱，喝掉里面的燃料。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME scurry around towns with their tails sparking to help them see during the dead of night. They gnaw holes into gas tanks to drink the fuel inside.

entry: POKENAME怕雨浇灭头上的小火苗，只在阳光明媚时外出。夏季热量，加快生长，缩短进化所需的时间。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME fears that rain might extinguish the small flame on its head, so it only ventures out when the sun is shining. During summer, the heat accelerates its growth, shortening the time it needs to evolve.

entry: POKENAME追随太阳转头，是出于喜爱，并非出于需要。阴天时，它们会聚在一起，由一只用火光假扮太阳，其余照常，跟着转头。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME turns its head following the sun out of admiration rather than necessity. On cloudy days, they gather together, one using the light of their flames to pretend they are the sun, the rest turning their heads as they normally would.

entry: POKENAME尾部分泌油状物，维持火焰。它们出生时，尾巴并未燃烧，由父母中的一方点燃。难过时，会找同伴，合起火焰，似乎借此得到安慰。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME secretes an oily substance from its tail that keeps its flame burning. They are not born with it aflame, so one of their parents ignites it. When upset, they seek out others to combine flames, a gesture that seems to soothe and comfort them.

entry: POKENAME需要大量水，才能保持活跃，火焰却会烤干附近的小水源。因此，它只出现在大河，或海洋附近的陆地。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME needs a large amount of water to stay active, but its flames will dry up nearby small water sources. POKENAME only appears on land near large rivers or the ocean.

entry: 与喜欢的人相处，它的尾火，就会噼啪作响，透着欢快。它拥有强大的超能力，能提前预见对手的招式。
author: fiordaliso
source: When it is in the company of people it likes, the flame on its tail crackles with cheerful pops. It possesses strong psychic abilities that allow it to foresee its opponents' moves in advance.

entry: 它的火焰仍在成长，便在夜里收集月光，恢复能量。害怕训练家抚摸时被烫伤，POKENAME常显得害羞、疏远。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its flames are still maturing, so it spends the nights gathering moonlight to restore its energy. Out of fear that its Trainer might get burned when petting it, POKENAME often keeps a shy and distant demeanor.

entry: 它的火焰仍在成长，便在夜里收集月光，恢复能量。害怕训练家抚摸时被烫伤，POKENAME常显得害羞、疏远。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its flames are still maturing, so it spends the nights gathering moonlight to restore its energy. Out of fear that its Trainer might get burned when petting it, POKENAME often keeps a shy and distant demeanor.

entry: 它的火焰仍在成长，便在夜里收集月光，恢复能量。害怕训练家抚摸时被烫伤，POKENAME常显得害羞、疏远。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its flames are still maturing, so it spends the nights gathering moonlight to restore its energy. Out of fear that its Trainer might get burned when petting it, POKENAME often keeps a shy and distant demeanor.

entry: POKENAME在夜里潜行，偷走无防备旅人的帽子。被逼入绝境，它就喷火，分散追赶者注意，再趁机逃跑。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME sneaks through the night, stealing hats from unsuspecting travelers. If cornered, it spits fire to distract its pursuers before making its escape.

entry: POKENAME的智力，取决于脑部温度。一失去火焰的热量，智力就会降到，呆呆兽的水平。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME's intelligence depends on the temperature of its brain. Once it loses its flaming heat, its intelligence diminishes to the level of a Slowpoke.

entry: POKENAME背上的种子，含有维持火焰所需的燃料，由光合作用产生。火焰若熄灭，它就必须在阳光下休息、睡觉，否则，便可能死去。
author: daimposter_60614
source: The bulb on POKENAME's back contains the fuel it needs to keep the fire going. This Pokémon produces this fuel through photosynthesis. If POKENAME's flame goes out, it will need to rest in the sun and sleep or risk perishing.

entry: POKENAME背上花苞形的火焰，是生命力的外在表现。它不仅能吃普通食物，也能吸收热能，维持生命。
author: oreee0230
source: The bud-shaped flame on POKENAME's back is an external manifestation of its vitality. POKENAME can not only eat regular food, but also sustain itself by absorbing heat energy.

entry: POKENAME的花苞外层，由木炭构成，需要时，会分泌油，产生强烈的火焰。为补上耗油所需的养分，它的食量很大。
author: oreee0230
source: The outer layer of POKENAME's bud is made of charcoal, and it secretes oil to create a strong flame when needed. POKENAME has a large appetite to supply nutrients for oil consumption.

entry: 背上的花苞，宛如染着火色的花朵。散出的香气却满含毒素，能灼伤眼睛。
author: soup1900
source: The flower bud on its back resembles a flame-tinged blossom. The bud releases a fragrant smell full of toxins that will burn your eyes.

entry: POKENAME有啃木炭的习惯。啃咬坚硬的块状物，能让牙齿强壮，吃下的木炭，则让尾火与体内火焰，都保持健康、旺盛。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has a habit of gnawing on charcoal. Chewing on the hard stone helps keep its teeth strong, and consuming the charcoal itself keeps its fire, both on its tail and within its body, healthy and stoked.

entry: POKENAME用全身水晶储存的太阳能，滋养火焰。能量蓄得足够，即使雨天，也能明亮燃烧。
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher
source: POKENAME feeds its flames with the solar energy stored within the crystals along its body. Once it charges enough energy, it can keep burning brightly even on rainy days.

entry: POKENAME尾巴上的头，能用超能力，集中火焰。不过，这个头常常迟钝，使火光忽明忽暗，毫无规律。
author: oreee0230
source: The head on POKENAME's tail can concentrate flames through psychic powers. Since this head is often sluggish, the flames flicker erratically.

entry: POKENAME常挂在树上，落向毫无防备的猎物。可尾火往往不是烧到目标，就是点着树叶。
author: whiteupgrade
source: POKENAME often hangs from trees to fall on unsuspecting prey. Due to the flame on POKENAME's tail, it tends to either burn its target or the leaves on the tree.

entry: POKENAME为火焰持续补充新鲜空气，维持稳定体温。许多露营者会带上它，让寒冷的户外夜晚，也温暖舒适。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME maintain a stable internal temperature by getting a constant supply of fresh air for their flames. Many campers bring POKENAME along to keep themselves warm and comfortable during cold nights outside.

entry: POKENAME滑过黎明天空，搜寻走路草一类的猎物。先用火星灼烧，再俯冲而下，完成捕猎。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME glides through the dawn sky in search of prey like Oddish. It scorches them with embers before swooping down to finish the hunt.

entry: POKENAME虽然性情温和，却被许多宝可梦视为危险。尾火迅速消耗地下有限的氧气，迫使其他宝可梦，来到地面呼吸。
author: oreee0230
source: Although it has a gentle nature, POKENAME is considered dangerous by many Pokémon. The flame on its tail rapidly consumes the limited oxygen that exists underground, forcing other Pokémon to go to the surface to breathe.

entry: POKENAME若遇见比自己的巢，更漂亮的鸟巢，就会因嫉妒，朝它喷出火星。好胜的天性，常让它与其他宝可梦结怨。
author: .izik
source: If POKENAME comes across a nest more impressive than its own, it spits embers at it out of sheer jealousy. Its competitive nature often leads to feuds with other Pokémon.

entry: 细雨通常不威胁POKENAME，可倾盆大雨，会迫使它躲起来，保护敏感的火焰。即使外部火焰被浇灭，外壳也能暂时保护，直到重新点燃。
author: chibitales
source: Gentle rain normally poses no threat to POKENAME, but intense downpours force these Pokémon into hiding to protect their sensitive flames. Even if their external flames are doused, their shell offers some protection until they can be reignited.

entry: POKENAME对其他飞行属性宝可梦，格外敌视，甚至干扰对方捕猎、筑巢。尾羽燃起明亮的火，便代表它，健康极佳。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is particularly hostile toward other Flying-type Pokémon, even hindering them during hunts or while building their nests. When the feathers on its tail are ablaze with bright flames, it means it is in excellent health.

entry: POKENAME常特意烧掉其他宝可梦的巢，尤其是更整洁的。只有雨能浇灭它的脾气，因为它怕尾火熄灭，只得留在原地。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME often go out of their way to burn down other Pokémon's nests, especially if they appear tidier. The only thing that dampens their temper is the rain, which causes them to stay put to avoid extinguishing their tail flame.

entry: POKENAME靠敏锐嗅觉与火焰，寻找小植物，烘干后再吃。它偏爱干植物，因为即使雨雪天气，也能帮助维持旺盛火焰。
author: infinex21
source: Using its keen sense of smell and its flames, POKENAME forages for small plants and dries them out before consuming them. It prefers dried plants, as they help keep its flames strong despite rain and snow.

entry: POKENAME用火焰加热，向猎物射出极烫的水。需要时，也能朝水面上的东西，喷出一阵阵火焰。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME shoots superheated water at prey, relying on its flames to raise the heat. When needed, POKENAME can fire spurts of flames at anything above the water.

entry: POKENAME用灵活触手，在水下与陆地移动，靠刺激性分泌物自保。这些物质，水下形成墨汁，陆地受火加热，则化成黑烟。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME uses flexible tentacles to move underwater and on land, and protects itself with irritating secretions. These substances form ink underwater and turn into black smoke when heated by fire on land.

entry: POKENAME的脚爪炽热，能烧穿虫属性宝可梦的茧。翅膀触到什么，就烧穿什么，若点着树叶，还可能引发野火。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have fiery hot talons that can sear through cocoons of Bug-type Pokémon. Their wings burn through whatever they touch, which can result in wildfires if they light tree leaves on fire.

entry: POKENAME紧紧盘成螺旋，护住自己的火焰。鳞片摩擦生热，能烧伤被它缠住的对象。
author: baverbrugge
source: POKENAME protects its flame by curling into a tight spiral. Its scales produce heat through friction, burning anything it manages to constrict.

entry: POKENAME滚到哪里，就留下焦黑的轨迹。滚烫的身体，会点燃身后的干草与泥土。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME leaves behind scorched trails wherever it rolls. Its superheated body ignites dry grass and dirt in its wake.

entry: POKENAME活泼却笨拙，滚下山坡时，常点着附近灌丛，是许多野火的源头。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are energetic yet maladroit creatures that set fire to nearby bushes whenever they roll down hills. They are the source of many wildfires.

entry: POKENAME开心地漫游电脑系统，好奇人们在做什么。谁若点击得太近，它就会受惊，让显示器过热，造成断电。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME wanders happily between computer systems, curious about what people are doing. Should anyone click too close, it becomes startled and overheats the monitor, causing a power failure.

entry: POKENAME用尾火创作艺术，在树木上，烧出复杂的图案。不过，这些艺术尝试，往往引发森林火灾。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME use their flames on their tails to create art, scorching trees to create intricate designs out of burn marks. Their artistic endeavors often lead to forest fires, however.

entry: POKENAME与其他宝可梦，或训练家切磋得越多，尾火就越明亮。心智尚未成熟，让它不肯承认失败。
author: beatdoof
source: The flame on POKENAME's tail burns brighter the more it spars with other Pokémon or its Trainer. It doesn't acknowledge defeat due to its lack of maturity.

entry: POKENAME用颈部皮褶上的花纹，吓走领地中的其他宝可梦。喷火能力尚在成长，因此，它主要靠恐吓，守住地盘。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME scares away other Pokémon from its territory with the pattern on its hood. It relies on this fear to protect its territory because its fire-breathing abilities are still developing.

entry: POKENAME产的奶，泼在伤处，能舒缓烧伤。虽然天性带火，它却以帮助受伤宝可梦恢复，而为人所知。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME produces milk that can soothe burns when splashed onto an injury. Despite its fiery nature, it is known to help wounded Pokémon recover.

entry: POKENAME在一英里外，就能听见肚子咕咕叫。厨艺虽然才起步，每一餐却都满怀心意。
author: leshii
source: POKENAME can hear a rumbling stomach from a mile away. It's only just learning to cook, but every meal is made with love.

entry: POKENAME虽然稀有，却常在未经人类改造的天然温泉旁筑巢。人们发现，它会对冰产生不适反应，总觉得非将其融化不可。
author: npshi
source: While POKENAME are rare, they frequently make their dens next to natural hot springs that are unaltered by human hands. POKENAME have been observed having an adverse reaction to ice, feeling the need to melt it.

entry: POKENAME扬起沙子，吸走植物与小池中的水分，使空气干燥。尾巴对湿气极其敏感，因此走到哪里，它就在哪里制造沙暴。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME desiccates moisture from the air by kicking up sand to wick water from plants and small ponds. Its tail is extremely sensitive to humidity, so it creates sandstorms wherever it goes.

entry: POKENAME的壳，摸起来滚烫，会吸收空气中的水分。湿气过多，会使身体迅速冷却，若浸入水中，甚至可能让茧壳开裂。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have shells that are hot to the touch that absorb moisture in the air. Excess moisture rapidly cools down their body, which can cause their cocoon to crack if submerged in water.

entry: POKENAME尽力温柔待人，可暴躁的脾气，常让它可怕地大发雷霆。其他宝可梦害怕它们，许多个体，最终只能独来独往。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME do their best to be gentle, but their raging temper often leads to scary tantrums. Many end up as loners because other Pokémon are scared of them.

entry: POKENAME来回甩尾，产生火花，长成眩目火焰。风暴中，它通过尾巴引雷，维持火焰，也防止树木受损。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME flick their tails back and forth to generate sparks that can grow into dazzling flames. During storms, they draw in lightning bolts through their tails to keep their flames burning and prevent damage to trees.

entry: POKENAME身后的火焰是生命核心。它能用火焰治愈自己或其他活物。
author: oreee0230
source: The flame behind POKENAME is the core of its life. It can use the flame to heal itself or other living beings.

entry: POKENAME部分由煤和其他富含有机质的岩石构成，因此易燃。它能长时间燃烧而不受损，却会危及周围植物。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are partially composed of coal and other organic rich rocks meaning that they are flammable. They can sustain this flame for extended periods of time without ill effect, but are hazardous to surrounding plants.

entry: POKENAME部分由煤和其他富含有机质的岩石构成，因此易燃。有时烧得太热，耗尽燃料后突然中暑倒下，必须送宝可梦中心。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are partially composed of coal and other organic rich rocks meaning that they are flammable. POKENAME that burn too hot will sometimes abruptly collapse due to heat stroke after using all their fuel, necessitating a trip to a Pokémon Centre.

entry: 年幼的POKENAME通常爱吵爱闹，玩起来没轻没重，一不留神，帽子就会点着周围的东西。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME are usually rowdy when they're younger. They often play without care, and when that happens, their hat can set things on fire.

entry: POKENAME收集蛋形石，练习将来照顾真正的蛋。为给珍爱的石头保暖，它会定期将它们举到头上的火焰附近。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME collects egg-shaped stones as practice for one day taking care of the real thing. To keep its precious cargo warm, it periodically lifts and holds them close to the flame on its head.

entry: POKENAME火焰的强弱，反映精力和情绪。若察觉快熄灭，就放尽所有储电，用绚烂火花猛然重燃尾焰。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: The intensity of a POKENAME's flame is a sign of its energy level and emotions. If a POKENAME notices that its flame is about to burn out, it will discharge any and all electricity it has stored to re-ignite its tail in a brilliant burst of sparks.

entry: 它用尾焰烤熟食物再吃。尾焰随情绪变化，惹怒它便可能烤焦食物，反而更生气。
author: infinex21
source: It uses its own tail flame to roast food before eating it. Its tail flame reacts to its emotions, so angering it can cause it to burn food which will make it even more angry.

entry: 头上的触角能精准察觉极细微的温度变化，让它感知接近的捕食者的体温。它住在海岸峭壁。
author: bobosmith01
source: It can precisely detect even minute changes in temperature thanks to the antennae atop its head, which allows it to detect an approaching predator's body heat. It lives on seashore cliffs.

entry: POKENAME用灼热的舌头烧灼别的宝可梦的伤口，帮忙治疗。它害怕尾焰熄灭，因此下雨就不愿离巢。
author: fiordaliso
source: It helps other Pokémon by cauterizing their wounds with its hot tongue. Since POKENAME is terrified that the flame on its tail might go out, it avoids leaving its den when it rains.

entry: POKENAME不停钻地，找煤吃。身体像熔炉燃煤，让双手孔洞能喷出火焰。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are constantly boring through the earth in search of coal to consume. Their bodies work like furnaces to burn this coal, letting them spew flames from the holes in their hands.

entry: POKENAME双臂是大炮。用炮喷火，是调节体温的重要方式，而肩上火焰能显示体温。
author: roundabout_robin
source: POKENAME has large cannons for arms. Shooting fire out of these cannons is an important part of regulating their body temperature, which is indicated by its shoulder flames.

entry: POKENAME受惊会蜷成球，不小心点燃周围。训练时要选择混凝土等不易燃表面。
author: linhasxoc
source: If startled, POKENAME will curl into a ball, unintentionally igniting its surroundings. Its important to train it on non-flammable surfaces such as concrete.

entry: POKENAME摸着很暖，爱在落叶堆玩。可体温很快就让叶片干枯，甚至着火。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's body is quite warm to the touch. It loves to play in piles of fallen leaves, but its body temperature quickly causes said leaves to shrivel up or even catch fire.

entry: POKENAME进到储存数据更多的电脑，尾焰就烧得更亮。那表示它很兴奋，接着便开始吃附近文件。
author: .izik
source: The flame on POKENAME's tail burns brighter when it is inside a computer with more data stored. This signals its excitement before it begins feeding on nearby files.

entry: POKENAME用尾尖代码，把数据烧录进光盘，再下载、分析，学习新信息。若不喜欢学到的内容，就喷火烧毁光盘和原设备。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME learns new information by using the code on the tip of its tail to burn data into discs that it can download and analyze from. If what it learns is not of its liking, it spouts flames to burn down both the disc and the device it was from.

entry: POKENAME用树枝遮雨，防止尾焰熄灭。任何表面都能爬，无论多光滑、多陡。
author: fiordaliso
source: It uses tree branches to shelter itself from the rain and prevent the flame on its tail from going out. POKENAME can climb any surface, no matter how smooth or steep.

entry: 看尾巴烧短了多少，就能判断POKENAME的年龄。尾巴足够长，能一直烧到下一次进化。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: How old a POKENAME is can be determined by how far its tail has burned down. Its tail is long enough for it to last up to its next evolution.

entry: POKENAME爱亲近人，在喜欢的人旁开心啾叫。若没受关注，或训练家把注意给了别的宝可梦，它就跳着发脾气，尾巴上的火焰因愤怒越烧越旺。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME love being around people and chirp happily when near people they enjoy. If they aren't given attention or see another Pokémon getting the spotlight from their Trainer, POKENAME's fiery tail grows with anger as they hop around in a tantrum.

entry: POKENAME对巢的布置极挑剔，被改动就烦躁，尾羽上的火也增强。它一边修家，一边恼火地啾叫。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: Having a very particular way it likes its nest, the fire on POKENAME's tail feathers will grow from annoyance if the nest is altered. It will chirp in frustration as it fixes its home.

entry: POKENAME饿极，尾焰就变弱，因此总在巢里存好食物。利爪既能驱退其他宝可梦，也能扩充储藏室。
author: fiordaliso
source: When it gets too hungry, the flame on its tail begins to fade, so POKENAME always makes sure to keep food stored in its den. Its sharp claws are not only useful for keeping other Pokémon away but also for expanding the size of its pantry.

entry: POKENAME总在动，跳来跳去练腿。它们聚在一起，热火朝天地锻炼、互相支持；练得越苦，尾焰越亮。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME are always on the move, hopping around to strengthen their legs. These Pokémon will gather in groups and work out, supporting each other with heated workouts; the harder the workout, the brighter their tail flames.

entry: POKENAME的武术招式总伴着火光。羁绊够深，训练家便能从战斗所用火焰，判断它的心情。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME's martial moves will always be paired with a fiery flare. With a close enough bond, POKENAME's Trainer can tell what mood their Pokémon is in based on the flames it uses during combat.

entry: POKENAME身上和头上的火，随情绪改变亮度、强弱。它爱与经验较少的宝可梦一起，教导、训练它们磨炼战技。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: The fire covering POKENAME's body and head changes in brightness and intensity based on how it's feeling. POKENAME enjoys working with less experienced Pokémon, teaching and training them to hone their fighting skills.

entry: POKENAME周身的火焰宛如天然罗盘，让它感知附近物体与地点的方位。据说，见到训练家时，火光会更明亮。
author: rakunk
source: POKENAME is covered in flames that act as a natural compass, allowing it to sense the direction of nearby objects or locations. It is said to shine brighter at the sight of its Trainer.

entry: POKENAME能从热量中汲取大量能量，却又怕身体干掉，便爱在温泉边的泥里玩耍，保持湿润。
author: shocktopus1717
source: POKENAME gets lots of energy from heat, but must be careful not to dry out. To deal with this, it plays in the mud near hot springs.

entry: POKENAME难以控制自己的情绪，愤怒时尤其如此。训练家若也对它生气，双方会越闹越凶，直到训练家先平静。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a difficult time managing their own emotions, especially when they are angry. If their Trainer is also angry with them, this creates a feedback loop of escalation until their Trainer calms down.

entry: 训练家生气，POKENAME就浑身起火，想模仿对方的感受。学会管理情绪，对保障彼此安全至关重要。
author: quackquackattack
source: If their Trainer is angry, POKENAME burst into flames in an attempt to mimic how their Trainer feels. Learning how to manage one's emotions is vital to keeping both the Trainer and POKENAME safe.

entry: POKENAME靠训练家的精神状态，让火焰活动。训练家热切兴奋，它便从这情绪获取力量，火也格外旺。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME rely on the energy of their Trainer to keep their flames moving. If their Trainer is full of eager excitement, their flames grow extra strong as they feed off the excitement.

entry: POKENAME胸前或尾上的火，只要还有一处燃着，就能快乐、健康。若两处都熄灭，就会重病、极其沮丧。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME will remain happy and healthy as long as one of the flames on its chest or tail is still burning. Managing to extinguish both will lead to it becoming extremely sick and despondent.

entry: 只要头上的火没受影响，POKENAME就不会受伤。开阔处下雨，它会倒着飞，用身体遮住火焰。
author: oreee0230
source: As long as the flame on its head isn't affected, POKENAME won't get hurt. When it rains in open areas, POKENAME flies upside down in the air, using its body to shield itself from the rain.

entry: 雌性POKENAME嗅觉胜过雄性，会带群体找食物，常被饭菜香味引到人类聚落。
author: .fedoraman
source: Female POKENAME have a stronger sense of smell than males. They lead packs toward food, often ending up in human settlements, drawn by aromatic meals.

entry: POKENAME随周围岩石、熔岩改变肤色，融入火山地貌。它借伪装伏击猎物，再猛喷火焰。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME blends in with the volcanic terrain, shifting its skin color to match nearby rocks and lava. This camouflage allows it to ambush prey before unleashing fiery bursts.

entry: POKENAME用火控制自身磁性，再用磁力控制体内可燃气体。平时靠磁力移动，只有猎食钢属性宝可梦，才会升温吐火。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME uses fire to control its own magnetism and uses magnetic force to control the flammable gases in its body. Normally, it moves using magnetic force and only heats up to breathe fire when hunting Steel-type Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME的火很怕湿度变化。楔石一湿，控火能力就减弱，直到干燥才恢复。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME's flames are vulnerable to changes in humidity. If its keystone gets wet, its ability to wield fire is dampened until it is dry.

entry: POKENAME像烧焦的小火龙骨架，会主动纵火，据说还吸收受害者灵魂。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME looks like the charred skeleton of a Charmander. It actively causes fires and is said to absorb the souls of victims.

entry: 背上的花苞，宛如染着火色的花朵。散出的香气却满含毒素，能灼伤眼睛。
author: soup1900
source: The flower bud on its back resembles a flame-tinged blossom. The bud releases a fragrant smell full of toxins that will burn your eyes.

entry: POKENAME背上的仙人掌能注入催化氧化反应的毒素。毒量虽多，通常只用来自卫，因为可能使猎物自燃。
author: oreee0230
source: The cactus on POKENAME's back can inject toxins that catalyze oxidation. Although the toxin is abundant, it is generally only used for defense because it may cause prey to spontaneously combust.

entry: 尾尖的火焰，为背上的花提供了光源。可光照太多，叶片反而已经泛黄。
author: soup1900
source: The flame that's on the tip of its tail gives it its own source of light for its flower. Its leaves have yellowed due to too much exposure to light.

entry: 野生POKENAME虽然温顺，也不建议随意触碰。受惊时，倒刺突出，尾焰猛燃。
author: .fedoraman
source: Despite their docile nature, it is not recommended to handle wild POKENAME. When frightened, their barbs protrude and the flame on their tail roars.

entry: POKENAME常把树果和肉烤过再吃。若火焰颜色古怪，多半与它吃了什么有关。
author: mossybanana
source: POKENAME will often roast Berries and meat before eating them. If their flames are an odd color, it is most likely due to their diet.

entry: POKENAME造出火焰触手，烤猎物，再送到嘴边。焦到不能吃的，就吐回去，滋养周围土地。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME manifests flaming tentacles to roast prey and bring them to its mouth. Whatever is too charred to consume is spit back out to fertilize the area around it.

entry: POKENAME生气，脸上钢盾就滋滋作响。头顶一聚云，它便赶快找掩蔽，怕雨熄灭尾焰。
author: fiordaliso
source: When POKENAME grows angry, the steel shield on its face sizzles. If clouds gather overhead, it quickly seeks shelter, fearing that rain might extinguish the flame on its tail.

entry: POKENAME仅在圈养环境中存在，对玩具和圈舍物品占有欲很强。心爱的东西被拿走，尾焰就会猛烈燃起。
author: .fedoraman
source: Only existing in captivity, POKENAME are very possessive of their toys and other items in their enclosure. When their favorite items are taken away, the flame on their tail roars.

entry: POKENAME察觉飓风将至，就在城镇广场乱喷火。可它的火焰警告，常到风暴来了才被重视。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spits flames wildly in town squares when it senses an incoming hurricane. Its fiery warnings often go unheeded until the storm arrives.

entry: 这种宝可梦个头虽大，幼年生命却脆弱。它无腿，必须住水里，尾焰一熄却又会死。这或许是大自然对极危险进化形态的制衡。
author: ecstaticwoop64556455
source: Despite its large size, this Pokémon lives a fragile young life. Without legs it has to live in the water, but if the flame on its tail extinguishes, it will die. This may be nature's countermeasure to its incredibly dangerous evolutions.

entry: 古籍尊POKENAME为夏日炎热的先兆。若觉得不受欣赏，附近气温就会骤升，有时热得能煮沸水。
author: .izik
source: Ancient texts revere POKENAME as a herald of summer's heat. When it feels unadmired, temperatures nearby rise sharply, sometimes hot enough to boil water.

entry: POKENAME的尾焰反映健康。长腿让它迅速脱险，常逃回父母身旁求保护。
author: chibitales
source: The flame on POKENAME's tail can be used as an indicator for their health. Their long legs allow them to quickly escape danger, often fleeing to their parents for protection.

entry: POKENAME头上小枝若有翻涌火焰，便是最健康的状态。它啃叶片、树枝，为火添燃料，保持旺盛。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is at its healthiest as long as the twig on its head is alight with a roiling flame. It munches on leaves and branches to help fuel the fire and keep it burning brightly.

entry: 即使灌木上起火，它的叶片也不会烧伤。雨里会变弱，因此风暴时躲到树下。
author: cait_sith
source: Its leaves are never burnt despite the flames on its bushes. It grows weaker in the rain, so it shelters under trees during storms.

entry: POKENAME从地下吸热维生。需要热量的宝可梦聚到背上，在燃烧的树旁取暖。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME absorbs heat from the ground to survive. Pokémon that need heat gather on its back and warm themselves around the fire tree.

entry: POKENAME从地下吸热维生。需要热量的宝可梦聚到背上，在燃烧的树桩旁取暖。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME absorbs heat from the ground to survive. Pokémon that need heat gather on its back and warm themselves around fire stumps.

entry: POKENAME白天常小群旅行。但篝火的声音和气味能唤醒它们，将它们引来你的营地。
author: .fedoraman
source: POKENAME often travel in small packs during the day, but the sound and smell of campfires can wake them up and attract them to your campsite.

entry: POKENAME甩燃烧的尾巴击敌。看似好斗，其实只是喜欢打架取乐。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME swings its flaming tail to hit foes. Although it seems aggressive, POKENAME simply enjoys fighting for fun.

entry: POKENAME借尾焰调节体温。潜水时，会用气泡包住火焰，免得熄灭。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME uses the flame on its tail to regulate its body temperature. During dives, it envelops it in an air bubble to prevent it from going out.

entry: 不论外界多冷，它都能把绒羽加热到140度以上。滑过雪地时，身后便留下一道冒着蒸汽的痕迹。
author: chorb33
source: It can heat its down to over 140 degrees, regardless of outside temperatures. As it glides over the snow, it leaves a steaming trail in its wake.

entry: POKENAME在严寒家园寻找受冻者，帮忙保暖。它让大家抱住身体，再摩擦鳍肢的锋利边缘，产生火花，点起小火。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME finds those suffering from the cold in its frigid home and helps warm them up. It lets others cling to its body, while it creates a small fire from sparks made by rubbing the sharp edges of its flippers against each other.

entry: 这把附有幽灵的镐，击中金属或血肉，便能将其瞬间烧至赤热。它游荡矿中，只有采掘时遭到打扰，才会发动攻击。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: On impact, this haunted pick instantly turns metal or flesh red hot. It wanders mines and only attacks if disturbed while mining.

entry: POKENAME住在活火山坡，吃养分丰富熔岩地带的新生嫩芽。领地受威胁，就结伙，朝威胁吐炽热火星。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME make their home on the slopes of active volcanoes, feeding on the shoots of plants that sprout in the nutrient-rich lava fields. When they feel their territory is being threatened, they will band together and spit fiery embers at the threat.

entry: 烈日下，POKENAME最有精神，也最好斗。夜里气温下降，脾气也随之冷却。
author: .fedoraman
source: Under the hot sun, POKENAME are the most energetic, but also the most aggressive. At night when the temperatures lower, so too does POKENAME's temper.

entry: 这个顽皮伙伴，走到哪里都留下焦痕。POKENAME既宝贝自己的尾焰，也会拼命保护同伴。
author: supersonicloki
source: A playful companion that leaves burn marks wherever it goes. POKENAME is very protective of its companions and the flame on its tail.

entry: POKENAME钻过领地中的山体，沿途留下一道火。火烧去枯死植物，让新生命从灰烬生长。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME leaves a trail of fire in its wake as it tunnels through the mountains in its territory. The blaze it leaves behind clears away dead plants so that new life can grow from the ashes.

entry: 高温会让POKENAME鳞片更鲜艳。野生个体因泡熔岩，体温很可能极高，因此最好保持距离。
author: oreee0230
source: High temperatures can make POKENAME's scales more vibrant. The body temperature of wild POKENAME is likely to be very high due to bathing in lava, so one should keep a distance from it.

entry: 心情越好，这只宝可梦摸起来就越温暖。它常想扑进信任的训练家怀里，亲昵一会儿。
author: melodydelune
source: The happier this Pokémon is, the warmer its body feels to the touch. It often seeks to cuddle with a trusted Trainer.

entry: POKENAME仅在圈养环境中存在，常突然发脾气，直到把自己累坏。已发现，将圈舍维持在室温以下，能让脾气温和些。
author: .fedoraman
source: Only existing in captivity, POKENAME is prone to sudden temper tantrums that last until it tires itself out. Keeping its enclosure below room temperature has been found to cool its temperament.

entry: POKENAME能随意召来阳光，照向地面。它用高温阻止云形成，也能用烟像云般遮日。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME sunlight affects those on the ground and can be summoned at will. It can use high temperatures to prevent clouds from forming, or use smoke to block the sun like clouds.

entry: POKENAME炮里射出的火，似乎能随意志变形。一落在固体表面，就像活着般独自移动，随机飘向各处。
author: .izik
source: The flames fired from POKENAME's cannon appear to take shape based on its will. Once on a solid surface they move independently, as if alive, drifting in random directions.

entry: 月光直照，POKENAME的尾焰会变强。满月夜，群体汇聚所有尾焰，造出一团巨大篝火。有一瞬，太空里也能看见火光。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: The fire on a POKENAME's tail grows stronger in direct moonlight. Groups of POKENAME gather together on nights of a full moon to create one large bonfire between all of their flames. For a moment, the light of these flames can be seen from space.

entry: POKENAME常不小心用尾巴点燃手里花束，战斗时尤其如此。有时借此占优势，更多时候却慌到把火扑灭才停。
author: quantumradiation
source: POKENAME is known to accidentally light the bouquets in its hand on fire with its tail, especially during battles. Sometimes, it will use this to its advantage in a fight, but it mostly results in it panicking until it can put the fire out.

entry: POKENAME看似头上有火，其实只是把燃烧的尾巴搁在头顶。它靠身下火焰加热自己，一次能飞数月。
author: oreee0230
source: Although POKENAME's flames appear on its head, it is actually just placing its flaming tail on top of its head. POKENAME flies for several months at a time by heating itself from the flames underneath its body.

entry: 它走到哪里，哪里便落满极易燃烧的毛发。饲养这只宝可梦的训练家，必须先上消防安全课。
author: capwolfbane
source: It sheds incredibly flammable fur on just about any surface. Trainers of this Pokémon are required to take a fire safety course.

entry: POKENAME能像现代电器，烤饼干和其他甜点。但心情不好，就乱调温度。尊重相待，烤出的点心便看着可口。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can bake cookies and other confectioneries like any other modern appliance, but will make wild adjustments to the temperature if they feel upset. Treating them with respect ensures that your baked goods come out looking delicious.

entry: POKENAME难将雷电与火分开。产电虽多，高温却会熔电线，难以在电力行业工作。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME has difficulty separating its lightning and fire. Although it generates a large amount of power, the high temperatures melt the wires, making it difficult for POKENAME to work in the electricity industry.

entry: POKENAME在闪烁火焰间轻盈起舞，夜里成群滑过天空，仿佛流星雨。尾焰甚至在太空真空中，也能明亮燃烧。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Dancing delicately while framed by flickering flames, POKENAME glide across the sky at night in groups resembling meteor showers. The fires on their tails can burn brightly even in the vacuum of space.

entry: POKENAME外形可爱，棉絮般的蓬松鬃毛即使脱落也能保温。因此，人们用它的毛制作夹棉衣物和毯子，始终暖和舒适。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME's fluffy cotton mane retains its warmth even when detached from its cute body. For this reason, its fur is used to make padded clothing and blankets that stay cozy at all times.

entry: POKENAME与同类训练，磨炼照亮夜间街道所需的自制力。现阶段，许多个体还无法坚持超过4小时。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME train alongside their kin to learn the discipline necessary to keep streets bright at night. In their current state, many lack the stamina to last more than four hours.

entry: POKENAME明亮燃烧的火越多，就越健康。前方两条尾巴状肢体很敏感，一被拉扯，它就生气，所有火里都吐火花。
author: sk372
source: The more of POKENAME's flames that are burning brightly, the healthier it is. The two tail-like limbs in the front are sensitive; POKENAME will angrily spit sparks from all its fires if they are tugged.

entry: POKENAME使起獠牙总热情过头，若训练不当，会砍倒太多树或损坏金属梁。它想讨好尊敬的对象，因此赢得它信任的训练家，教导起来并不难。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is overenthusiastic when using its tusks, resulting in it cutting down too many trees or damaging metal beams if improperly trained. It seeks to please those it respects, so it is easy to teach for Trainers that can gain its trust.

entry: POKENAME任一尾巴的火熄灭，都会疼，因此避开水多的地方。它花太久细心梳理每条尾巴，几乎没空陪其他宝可梦玩。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME experiences pain whenever any of its tails are put out, so it avoids places where there is a lot of water. It spends a long time carefully grooming each of its tails that it rarely has time to play with other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME背上的火，吓得敌人不敢碰。持续忍受自身烈火高温，皮肤也常很干。
author: soup1900
source: The flames on POKENAME's back deter foes from trying to touch this Pokémon. Its skin is often very dry due to the intense heat it always endures from its own flames.

entry: 它让随身打火机的火猛燃，阻止别人偷钥匙。人们常留它在旁，帮忙点篝火等。
author: sk372
source: It flares up the flame from the lighter it carries in order to dissuade others from pilfering its keys. People often keep it around to help them light campfires and the like.

entry: 被收服的POKENAME常携带训练家的私人物品。野生个体热衷收红珠、蓝珠，希望找到珍贵宝石。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME that have been captured usually carry their Trainer's personal belongings. Wild POKENAME are keen on collecting red and blue beads, hoping to find precious gems.

entry: POKENAME巧妙伪装成小火龙。最大破绽是，尾上长燃的火来自一根点着的树枝，必须定期更换。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME cleverly disguises itself as a Charmander. The disguise's biggest flaw is that the continuously burning flame on its tail comes from a lit stick, which must be replaced regularly.

entry: POKENAME看不见，常想咬自己的尾焰。新手训练家虽担心，专家却视为幼年发育的正常行为。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME cannot see, so it often tries to bite the flame on its tail. Though this habit may alarm new Trainers, experts consider this a normal behavior in a young POKENAME's development.

entry: POKENAME尾巴温度高，始终微微发光。兴奋时，整条尾巴都覆满火焰。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME's tail always emits a faint light due to high temperatures. When it gets excited, its entire tail is covered in flames.

entry: POKENAME实现愿望，头上火焰就变弱，必须沉睡才能恢复。睡着时，火会呈现漂亮的蓝绿色。
author: dodoowner_
source: When POKENAME grants a wish, the flames on its head get weaker. To restore the fire, it must enter a deep slumber. While sleeping, the flames will burn a beautiful aquamarine.

entry: POKENAME钻地时，爪子热得发白。猛烈挖掘，常让地道布满烧焦泥土。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's claws heat up to a white-hot temperature as it burrows into the ground. Its tunnels are often lined with charred soil from its intense digging.

entry: POKENAME学会点燃波导，放出火焰，很爱炫耀新本领。
author: solori_roznie
source: POKENAME has learned to ignite its aura, allowing it to emit fire. It delights in showing off its newfound abilities.

entry: POKENAME生性懒惰，常常活不到完全长成。即使雨水正浇灭尾焰，它们也只是气鼓鼓地继续睡。
author: scapz
source: POKENAME often never make it to full maturity due to their slothful nature. They slumber indignantly even as the rain extinguishes their tails.

entry: POKENAME极活跃，也极易分心。连训练吐火星都难，因为注意力总转去不相干的事。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are incredibly active Pokémon but lose focus just as easily. Even training them to produce embers is difficult as their attention veers off to something unrelated.

entry: POKENAME易怒，却也容易无聊。许多训练家在它生气时藏起来，便能避开它的怒火。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are quick to anger but get bored just as easily. Hiding from POKENAME whenever they are upset allows many Trainers to escape their fiery wrath.

entry: POKENAME在温水中欢快嬉戏，总尽量让尾巴露在水面上。潜水时则用泡泡裹住尾巴，等里面的空气用尽后再浮回水面。
author: markusknight
source: Cheerfully playing around in warm waters, POKENAME always tries to keep its tail above water. When diving, they surround it in a water bubble and come back after air in the bubble runs out.

entry: 在关都，人们常让孩子通过照顾POKENAME，学习饲养宝可梦的基础。不过，为安全起见，最好让它离地毯远点。
author: supersonicloki
source: In Kanto, POKENAME is mostly used to teach young children the ropes of Pokémon care. Keep it away from carpets for your own safety.

entry: 它们常成群嬉戏，诙谐又爱闹，总喜欢捉弄路过的旅人。
author: supersonicloki
source: Often found playing in packs, these humorous creatures have been known to prank travelers passing by.

entry: 极少数POKENAME融合后，只剩一条燃烧的尾。研究测试表明，体内火焰比其他个体更强，却无法用火覆盖同样大的范围。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Rarely, POKENAME fusions result in the Pokémon having just a single burning tail. Tests by Pokémon researchers have determined that they have a more intense inner flame than other POKENAME, but cannot cover as large an area with their fire.

entry: POKENAME众多尾尖各燃一簇火。每条尾巴可独立挥动，在暗处造出复杂、诡异的灯光表演，有人认为这可能是鬼火传说的起源。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The many tails of POKENAME each burn with a single flame at their tip. POKENAME can wave these tails independently of one another, creating complex and eerie light shows in the dark that some think could be the origin of legends around will'o'wisps.

entry: POKENAME众多尾尖各燃一簇火。每条尾巴可独立挥动，在暗处造出复杂、诡异的灯光表演，有人认为这可能是鬼火传说的起源。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The many tails of POKENAME each burn with a single flame at their tip. POKENAME can wave these tails independently of one another, creating complex and eerie light shows in the dark that some think could be the origin of legends around will'o'wisps.

entry: POKENAME身体先变得极热，随后胀大浮起。能升到超过100英尺高，沿途留下淡淡火星痕迹。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body becomes extremely hot before it inflates and floats. It can reach heights of over 100 feet, leaving behind a faint trail of embers.

entry: 铁匠曾收集POKENAME身上金属，锻成金属锭。散热能力优异，使这些锭备受珍视。
author: .izik
source: The metal on POKENAME's body was once harvested by blacksmiths to forge ingots. These ingots were prized for their superior heat dispersion properties.

entry: POKENAME住在活火山顶，慢慢挪向冷却中的熔岩。它用爪子夹碎、撕开火山岩，直到碎得能吃。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME live atop active volcanoes where they shuffle towards cooling lava. They crush and rip into volcanic rocks with their claws until they are edible shards.

entry: 两只POKENAME融合后，原本隐性的龙类等位基因，便会转为显性。它性情凶悍，尾焰也极难扑灭。
author: atomicdiamond
source: Recessive, dragon-like alleles become dominant when two POKENAME are fused. It tends to have a fierce nature, and its tail is difficult to extinguish.

entry: POKENAME从尾部收集暖空气，鼓起身体，升上空中。使用喷射火焰等招式吐火时，便排出余热、冷却，飘回地面。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME inflate their bodies by gathering warm air from their tails before launching up into the air. When they breathe fire in moves such as Flamethrower, they expel excess heat and cool, drifting back towards the ground.

entry: POKENAME花苞里藏着赖以生存的小火，由易燃树液供能。花苞始终略开，让燃烧所需空气进入。
author: lucioleuh
source: Its bud hides a small flame that POKENAME needs to live. The flame is fueled by flammable sap and the bud remains slightly open to let in the air it needs to burn.

entry: POKENAME不断产生易燃树液，维持火焰，却能控制强弱。受训后，甚至能改变烟的颜色、毒性、气味和数量。
author: lucioleuh
source: POKENAME always produces a flammable sap to keep its flames ignited, but it can control the intensity. A trained POKENAME can even alter the smoke its flames produce, changing the color, toxicity, smell, and quantity.

entry: 它的耳朵只在战斗时卷起，用来迅速施展火焰攻击。寒夜，有些个体不蜷进暖和毛皮中，有些却仍习惯这么做。
author: torterraguy26
