source: Its ears only curl up when it battles, using them to deliver swift fire attacks in battle. On cold nights, some don't curl into their warm fur and some still do out of habit.

entry: POKENAME靠头上火焰调节体温。若没有额外养分，无法长时间维持火焰，就很容易生病。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME regulates its body temperature through the flame on its head. If there is no extra nutrition to maintain its flame for extended periods of time, POKENAME is likely to fall ill.

entry: POKENAME由易燃凝胶构成，一离开本体便瞬间点燃。反应性太高，几乎无法研究。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are made of a flammable gel that instantly ignites when separated from the main body. This high reactivity makes studying POKENAME nearly impossible.

entry: POKENAME像燃烧棉球般被风吹动。自身虽防火，撞上易燃物却会点着，常引发野火。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME are blown around by the wind like burning cotton balls. Although their own body is fireproof, they set fire to any flammable objects they collide with, frequently starting wildfires.

entry: POKENAME能加热柔韧身体内的气体。遇威胁，一口便能喷出数十升、超过摄氏200度的气体，灼烧敌人。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME can heat gas within its flexible body. When faced with a threat, it can blow out dozens of liters of gas at over 200°C in one breath to burn its enemies.

entry: 它双翼虽强，却难久留空中，常在阵阵火焰里翻落。休息便攀住岩顶，留下完美的圆形焦痕。
author: jaminmcready
source: Though its wings are strong, it struggles to stay aloft for long, often tumbling in bursts of flame. It clings to rocky ceilings to rest, leaving scorch marks in perfect circles.

entry: POKENAME常难以进食，因为尾上燃烧面具，把找来的食物大多烧成灰。真吃到，火便格外旺，呈现缤纷亮色。
author: crumple_2
source: POKENAME often struggles to eat, as the flaming mask on its tail turns much of the food it scavenges into ash instead. If it does eat, the flame burns intensely and displays a medley of bright colors.

entry: POKENAME藏在大型宝可梦身上，靠体热和皮屑维生。它偏爱火属性，因为其他宝可梦往往会注意到它的火。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME lurk atop larger Pokémon, surviving on their body heat and skin flakes. It prefers Fire-type Pokémon because other Pokémon tend to notice its fire.

entry: POKENAME藏在大型宝可梦身上，靠体热和皮屑维生。它偏爱火属性，因为其他宝可梦往往会注意到它的火。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME lurk atop larger Pokémon, surviving on their body heat and skin flakes. It prefers Fire-type Pokémon because other Pokémon tend to notice its fire.

entry: POKENAME的獠牙燃着火，会随情绪变大或变小。无论心情怎样，若没有均衡摄入树果和矿石，火焰就会熄灭。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME's fiery tusks change in size depending on its emotions. Regardless of how it is feeling, if it does not receive a balanced diet of berries and ore, the flames will extinguish.

entry: POKENAME的獠牙燃着火，会随情绪变大或变小。无论心情怎样，若没有均衡摄入树果和矿石，火焰就会熄灭。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME's fiery tusks change in size depending on its emotions. Regardless of how it is feeling, if it does not receive a balanced diet of berries and ore, the flames will extinguish.

entry: POKENAME披甲的头冠延伸至背部，让它战斗时过度自信。獠牙开始在火焰下硬化，若饮食失调，可能进化时还没长足。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is overconfident in its abilities in battle because its armored crest has extended down its back. The tusks are beginning to harden under the flames, so if its diet is disrupted, the tusks may insufficiently grow before evolution.

entry: POKENAME体内燃着特殊火焰，为身体供能。只要留在体内、不受干扰，能烧数百年。
author: wiz0z
source: A unique type of flame burns within POKENAME that fuels their bodies. If left undisturbed inside them, the flames can burn for hundreds of years.

entry: POKENAME尾巴摸着极暖，兴奋、受惊便更热。它按一连串规律，与同类相碰尾巴沟通。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's tail is extremely warm to the touch, and heats up if excited or frightened. It communicates with others of its kind by tapping tails together in a series of patterns.

entry: POKENAME用火球击落其他鸟类宝可梦，有时为捕食，有时只为赶出领地。兴奋时尾火散小火花，烦躁时却四处吐小火球。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME shoot down other bird Pokémon with fireballs to prey upon them or to simply remove them from their territories. Their tail flames scatter small sparks when they are excited but spit small fireballs about when agitated.

entry: POKENAME极擅猎食虫属性宝可梦，从大嘴流出燃烧唾液，灼烧猎物。它有助控制野生绿毛虫、独角虫的数量。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are incredible Bug-type hunters that sear their prey with flaming drool from their gaping maw. They help keep wild populations of Caterpie and Weedle under control.

entry: POKENAME穿行干旱地区的石缝。身体极轻，靠火猎食几乎与自己同大的猎物。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME moves through the cracks in rocks in dry areas. It is very light, and relies on fire to hunt prey that is almost the same size as it.

entry: POKENAME遇东西从后靠近，就挥两条燃烧的尾巴驱赶；从前靠近，便用毒咬。它会迅速转身，绝不让自己被从侧面接近。
author: .jerden
source: If anything approaches POKENAME from behind, it fends them off by waving its two burning tails. If anything approach from in front, it attacks with its poisonous bite. POKENAME will quickly turn so that they are never approached from the side.

entry: POKENAME尾巴上的火焰突然旺起来，就说明它即将冲锋。滚向敌人时，它把尾巴伸向侧面，避免熄灭自己的火。
author: .jerden
source: When POKENAME's flaming tail flares up, this indicates that it is about to charge. While rolling towards an enemy, POKENAME holds its tail out to the side to avoid extinguishing its own flame.

entry: POKENAME尾火小，就很放松，不太会攻击。若合成一大簇火，便是在准备头朝前冲，用角送上滚烫毒液。
author: .jerden
source: If the flames on its tails are small, POKENAME is relaxed and unlikely to attack. If it brings them together to form a single larger flame, it is getting ready to charge headfirst to deliver scorching venom with its horns.

entry: POKENAME能短促地从口中喷出强劲火焰。某个热门节目与周边产品系列，以它为主要吉祥物。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can fire short but powerful bursts of flame from its mouth. A popular franchise of shows and merchandise uses POKENAME as its main mascot.

entry: POKENAME鼻腔大，嗅觉敏锐，远处气味也闻得到。它用火伏击小型飞行属性宝可梦，趁猎物飞走前，先烧焦羽毛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a keen sense of smell due to the large nasal cavities in their skulls, allowing them to pick up scents from long distances. They hunt small Flying-type Pokémon by ambushing them with fire, roasting their feathers before they fly away.

entry: 研究者发现，POKENAME在冰川家园中会四只或更多挤成一团移动。目前认为，这是为了挡住突来的阵风与暴风雪，保护尾焰，集体保暖。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Pokémon researchers have observed POKENAME moving across their glacial homes in huddled groups of four or more. The current theory is that they do so to protect their flames from abrupt gusts of wind or blizzards, letting them stay warm as a group.

entry: POKENAME是温柔灵魂，暗中起舞，令人着迷。从双臂流出的火焰随舞摇曳，拖出催眠般的火星痕迹，轻轻安抚野生宝可梦和迷路徒步者。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME are gentle spirits that perform mesmerizing dances in the dark. As they sway, the fire flowing from their arms creates hypnotic trails of embers, which they use to gently soothe wild Pokémon and lost hikers.

entry: POKENAME用鲜艳叶色，警告捕食者自己有毒。释放毒孢子，会让它打喷嚏、喷火星，反过来又放出更多孢子。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME relies on its brightly colored leaves to signal to predators that it is poisonous. It releases toxic spores that make it sneeze out embers, which in turn causes it to release more spores.

entry: POKENAME亮橙叶片将光转成热，便能使用火焰攻击。它摇摆行走时，叶片沿途落下有毒火星。
author: theaceofhearts0306
source: POKENAME's bright orange leaves convert light into heat energy, allowing it to wield fiery attacks. As POKENAME waddles, it leaves a trail of toxic embers shed from its leaves.

entry: POKENAME很顽皮，常在垃圾堆纵火，吃火产生的有毒烟气。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are quite mischievous, often starting fires in trash dumps. They do so to feed off the toxic fumes these flames produce.

entry: POKENAME每张嘴，都漏出点点火。它常顽皮地轻咬训练家，似乎不知道可能造成灼伤。
author: sk372
source: Bits of fire eek out from POKENAME's mouth whenever it opens its jaws. It often playfully nips at its Trainer, seemingly unaware of the potential for the act to leave burns behind.

entry: 森林大火扫过，POKENAME便沿焦黑林地漂游，吸热为食，熄灭残余小火和火星。多亏它，灾后地区能更快恢复生长。
author: vic1312
source: In the scorched wake of forest fires, POKENAME will drift along the razed forest floor, snuffing out remaining small fires and embers by feeding on the heat. Places where disastrous fires have swept through regrow much faster thanks to their efforts.

entry: 长期干旱时，POKENAME族群兴旺。它吸收腐烂植物的灵力，补充养分。
author: dodoowner_
source: During long droughts, the POKENAME population thrives. It gains nutrients by absorbing the spiritual energy of decomposing vegetation.

entry: POKENAME采树果，淋上易燃蜂蜜。它挥动燃烧的叶片，在树果上方烘烤，做成美味一餐。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME gather berries before drizzling them with flammable honey. They then wave their flaming leaves over the berries to roast them for a delectable meal.

entry: POKENAME把火加热的空气困在云里，像热气球般飞。它讨厌弄湿，因为雨里便无法飞行。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME traps fire-heated air in its clouds to fly like a hot air balloon. It dislikes getting wet because it makes it unable to fly in the rain.

entry: POKENAME身体尚在发育，难以产生高温火焰，但抱着仍温暖舒服。数百年前文献便记载，用它的黏液作暖身膏、药膏基底。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME's developing body can't easily produce high-temperature flames, but they are still pleasantly warm to hold. Documents dating back centuries cite POKENAME's goo as a base for body-warming creams and medicinal ointments.

entry: POKENAME覆着阻燃物，保护自己免遭尾焰伤害。但它一湿就会疼，许多家长因此很难清洗它。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are coated with a flame retardant that protects their body from their flaming tail. Unfortunately for many parents, cleaning POKENAME can be quite difficult because they cannot get wet without getting hurt.

entry: POKENAME轻松跃下峭壁，空中旋转、吐火，展示给旁人看，宣示优势。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME leaps effortlessly from cliffsides, spinning mid-air while spitting flames. These fiery displays are meant to impress others and assert dominance.

entry: POKENAME吃风滚草、树枝和其他易燃物，为体内火焰添燃料。寒冷沙漠夜里，它会向外放热。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME fuels the fire burning inside its body by eating tumbleweeds, sticks, and other flammable materials. It radiates heat during cold desert nights.

entry: POKENAME积极收集木头，维持体温，也制造木炭。它能操控炭粉捕猎。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME actively collects wood to maintain its body temperature and produce charcoal. It can manipulate charcoal powder to hunt.

entry: POKENAME的火其实能净化空气，烧掉大多臭气。若火熄灭，没及时重燃，散发的臭气反而会猛然燃起。
author: oreee0230
source: The flames of POKENAME actually purify the air, because most of the foul-smelling gases are burned up. If the flame goes out and is not relit in time, the odor emitted by POKENAME will erupt into flames instead.

entry: 附在POKENAME背上的蘑菇，寄生特性受到散出的火焰抑制。它将孢子与火焰攻击结合，作为获取养分的强力手段。
author: pixlhoopa
source: The mushrooms that latch onto POKENAME's back have their parasitic properties under control due to the flames that emit from them. It uses its spores in combination with fiery attacks as a powerful method of obtaining nutrients.

entry: 野生POKENAME很难遇见，但一见到，总在彼此打闹。受训饲养后，却很友好，对主人极忠诚。
author: itsthenewisaiah
source: Wild POKENAME are hard to come across, but when seen in the wild, they are always roughhousing with one another. As Trainer-kept Pokémon, POKENAME are quite friendly and fiercely loyal to their owners.

entry: POKENAME天生叛逆，不开心就恶作剧，特别爱点着训练家的衣服。但训练家疼得厉害，它便会停。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are naturally rebellious creatures that pull pranks on their Trainer whenever they are upset. They are particularly fond of setting fire to their Trainer's clothes, but they stop when their Trainer is in serious pain.

entry: POKENAME唱歌时手里造小火，为歌作视觉伴奏。无害火焰飘向观众，演出时可自由把玩。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME creates small flames in its hands while it sings, as a visual accompaniment to its songs. The harmless flames float over to its audience to be freely played with during the performance.

entry: POKENAME住在最严酷的环境，减少竞争。共生真菌帮助消化，火焰则驱退竞争物种。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME lives in the harshest environments to reduce competition. The fungi that coexist with POKENAME help improve its digestion, while its flames repel competing species.

entry: POKENAME皮肤光滑，容易滑过窄缝。它借高温帮助消化吃下的垃圾。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME's skin is smooth, which helps it slip through narrow gaps. POKENAME uses high temperatures to help digest the garbage it eats.

entry: POKENAME情绪强烈，尾焰便更亮。新生个体常开心过头，意外烧到身上的刺。
author: st4rdustyugure
source: The flame on POKENAME's tail burns brighter if they feel strong emotions. Newborn POKENAME often accidentally burn their quills when they get too happy.

entry: POKENAME用尾焰引猎物。有时看见自己的尾巴，便绕圈追，直到晕得动不了。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME use the flame on their tail to draw in prey. Sometimes, POKENAME will spot their own tails and chase them in circles until they become too dizzy to move.

entry: POKENAME即使尾焰熄灭，也要等壳内火焰同样熄灭才会死。它能把尾巴伸过壳口，重新引燃任一处熄灭的火。
author: soup1900
source: Even if the flame on its tail goes out, POKENAME won't die until the flame inside its shell also goes out. It can also stick its tail through an opening of its shell to reignite either flame that went out.

entry: POKENAME翼鳞含耐热毒素。散到敌人身上，高温先烧伤皮肤，让毒素更容易进入身体。
author: oreee0230
source: The scales on POKENAME's wings contain heat-resistant toxins. When the scales are scattered over an enemy, the high temperature first burns the skin, allowing the toxin to enter the body more easily.

entry: POKENAME穿耐火裤，能承受身上烈焰。它太天真，狡猾对手容易趁机扯裤子，将它制住。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME wear flame resistant pants that can endure the fiery flames on their body. Their naivety is easy to exploit by a cunning opponent, who may snag them by the pants to pin them down.

entry: POKENAME身体轻盈、中空，能喷火迅速移动、转向。它将空中尘埃转成可燃气体，作为食物。
author: oreee0230
source: Benefiting from its lightweight hollow body, POKENAME can shoot flames to move and turn quickly. It can convert airborne dust into combustible gas and feed on it.

entry: POKENAME火力大增，连背上都开始冒火。它更爱战，因为交战很能宣泄多余火焰。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's flame powers have grown massively, to the point the fire has begun to surface on its back as well. It has become more battle-hungry, as it serves as a good way to vent out the excessive flames it produces.

entry: 如今火焰已变得炽热无比，尾巴上的火无论泼多少水也无法熄灭。
author: soup1900
source: Its flames have now become ultra hot. No amount of water can put out the flame on its tail.

entry: 它的外表变得更加暗沉，口中也冒出火焰。卡洛斯的专家认为，它与超级喷火龙X有相似之处。
author: soup1900
source: It has taken on a darker appearance, and flames come out of its mouth. Kalos experts claim it has similarities with Mega Charizard X.

entry: POKENAME小家庭住在火山坡。躲藏时，亮橙鳞片可变成火山土的灰色，避开空中捕食者。
author: _pixelar_
source: POKENAME live in small families on the slopes of volcanos. To hide, they can change their bright orange scales to the ashy gray of the volcano soil, camouflaging themselves against predators in the sky.

entry: 它性情相当平和，除非迫不得已，不会凶狠地进攻。面对强敌时，反而会有点害怕。
author: soup1900
source: It is a pretty calm Pokémon and won't viciously attack unless absolutely necessary. It becomes slightly afraid when facing tough opponents.

entry: POKENAME静待越久，周围土地越热。为防野火，它不停迁往更凉土壤。
author: .izik
source: The ground around POKENAME heats up the longer it stays still. To prevent wildfires, it constantly relocates to cooler soil.

entry: POKENAME遇见情侣分手，就会情绪低落，小火焰也会缩小。训练家得留意表露的情绪，多与别人分享关爱，让它开心。
author: soup1900
source: If POKENAME encounters a couple who breaks up, it gets depressed, and its tiny flame shrinks in size. Trainers must be wary about the emotions they show and make sure they share plenty of love with others to keep this Pokémon happy.

entry: POKENAME挖地，周围土壤就升温。它小心远离树根，避免引起野火。
author: .izik
source: The soil around POKENAME heats up as it digs. To avoid causing wildfires, it carefully keeps distance from tree roots.

entry: 精灵球工匠很爱POKENAME，因为利爪轻松开球果，火能加快制球。野生个体靠球果维生。
author: kasai_kitsune
source: Beloved by Poké Ball makers, POKENAME can easily open Apricorns with its claws, and use its fire to accelerate the Poké Ball creation process. When in the wild, they live off of Apricorns.

entry: POKENAME面相虽温和，却是耐心猎手，能藏数小时，再用利爪突袭。病弱时，尾焰会摇曳、黯淡。
author: fiordaliso
source: Despite its gentle-looking face, POKENAME is a patient hunter, able to remain hidden for hours before striking with sharp claws. When sick or weak, the flame on its tail flickers and fades.

entry: POKENAME既需要、又怕水，处境矛盾。尾巴会吸走身体其他部位水分，若脱水严重，便会头痛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME is in the paradoxical position of needing and fearing water. Its tail wicks moisture from the rest of its body, which causes headaches if dehydration is severe.

entry: POKENAME怕水，因为担心尾焰熄灭，却因此脱水到头痛。痛得严重时，甚至只能尖叫。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are terrified of water because they fear extinguishing their tail flame, yet become so dehydrated that they develop headaches. The pain can grow so severe that they can only scream.

entry: POKENAME尾焰虽能在水下燃烧，本能却仍不愿弄湿，因此游得远比实际能达到的速度慢。
author: quackquackattack
source: Despite having a flame that can remain lit underwater, POKENAME have an instinctual desire to keep the flame from getting wet. This leads them to swim much slower than they are capable of.

entry: POKENAME厌水到近乎不讲理。有人喝口水，或带水靠近，它就暴怒攻击。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a vehement hatred of water that borders on irrational. Whenever a person takes a sip of water or comes near them with it, they become enraged and lash out.

entry: POKENAME可能毫无预兆地暴怒，猛打所有靠近者，连训练家也不例外。平静后，燃烧毛皮只剩闷火，它则虚弱不堪地休息。
author: chibitales
source: Without warning, POKENAME can erupt into a violent fit, thrashing at anything that comes near, including its Trainer. When calmed down, its flaming fur dies down to a smolder, leaving POKENAME extremely weakened while it rests.

entry: POKENAME忠诚，训练家叫做什么都愿意。但这也让它容易被忽视，有些训练家雨天或大风时，竟忘了带进屋。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are loyal Pokémon that will do anything its Trainer asks it to. This also makes them subject to neglect, as some Trainers forget to bring them inside when it is rainy or windy.

entry: POKENAME成群奔过大地，沿途留下一道火。旱季，巡护员会试着引开群体，远离灌木茂密区，减少野火风险。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME packs leave trails of fire in their wake as they sprint across the landscape. During dry seasons, Pokémon Rangers attempt to direct the packs away from areas with heavy underbrush in an attempt to reduce the risk of wildfires.

entry: POKENAME摇摆走到水洼、池塘和湖边，找树果吃。它爱先喷火星，烤焦树果再享用。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME waddles near puddles, ponds, and lakes to find berries to eat. It loves to spew embers to char the berries before eating them.

entry: POKENAME准备战斗、鼓起劲，双拳就会燃起火。它把交战当游戏，觉得伤对手过重，就立刻熄掉手上的火焰。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's fists will ignite when it pumps itself up for battle. It treats fights as a game, instantly dispelling the fire from its hands if it thinks it has hurt its opponent too much.

entry: POKENAME机灵，靠瞬间移动避开湿地。每逢下雨，就传进洞穴，防止尾焰熄灭。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are witty creatures that rely on their teleportation skills to avoid wet places. Whenever it rains, POKENAME teleport inside caves to avoid their flaming tail from being extinguished.

entry: 已有许多报告说，训练家的POKENAME跑得太远，迷了路。它们天性爱冒险，意志坚定。
author: secondatheniangadfly
source: There have been many reports of Trainers whose POKENAME ventured too far and became lost. They are known for their adventurous natures and steely determination.

entry: POKENAME不停追求更强力量，渴望得令人不安。它击倒遇到的一切阻挡，脸上始终挂着空洞的笑。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME possesses an unnerving desire to endlessly seek greater power. It strikes down any and all opposition it comes across, all with an unceasing blank smile upon its face.

entry: POKENAME虽小，火拳却能把树打出洞。唯一限制是体力不足，几拳便累。
author: quackquackattack
source: Even though POKENAME have small bodies, their fiery punches can blast holes into trees. The only thing holding them back is their lack of stamina, as it only takes a few punches before POKENAME get tired.

entry: POKENAME下半身沉重，常被敏捷对手压制。为弥补，它用尾巴点燃双脚，踢出灼热攻击。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are bottom-heavy and often end up overwhelmed by agile opponents. To compensate, POKENAME use their tail to ignite their feet, granting them searing kicks.

entry: POKENAME很少战斗，通常只为防捕食者。受威胁时，它点燃自己的触手，烧灼敌人，也从口中吐黏稠毒酸。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME rarely fights, usually only to defend itself from predators. When it feels threatened, it sets its own tentacles ablaze to scorch its foes and spits a slimy poisonous acid from its mouth.

entry: 许多POKENAME与铁匠一起造锤，反复加热钢材，制成锤头。它用拳打锤头一侧，将钢打平塑形。
author: quackquackattack
source: Many POKENAME forge hammers alongside blacksmiths, as they heat and reheat steel to form the hammerhead. Their fists strike one side of the hammerhead to flatten the steel into shape.

entry: 许多POKENAME在工厂组装园艺剪，加热刀刃，再浇油，随后合起两刃，制成珍贵的园艺工具。
author: quackquackattack
source: Many POKENAME assemble garden shears inside factories, heating blades before dousing them in oil. They then join the two blades together, creating a valuable tool for gardening.

entry: POKENAME是铁匠的好帮手，控火能把钢塑成所需形状。大拳头也能代锤打钢。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME is a valuable asset for blacksmiths, as its control over fire allows it to mold steel into whatever shape is needed. Its large fists can also strike steel in lieu of a hammer.

entry: POKENAME随同群小跑过草地，偶尔打喷嚏喷火星，随即踩灭，防止野火。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME trots in fields of grass alongside pack members. It sneezes out embers on occasion, which it stamps out to prevent wildfires.

entry: POKENAME随同群慢跑，保障安全。面对威胁，它会用燃烧的蹄踢击。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME canters alongside its pack to stay safe. When confronted with a threat, it launches a kick with its flaming hooves.

entry: POKENAME不能像大多水属性宝可梦那样久待水里；要维持水下尾焰，必须主动供氧。它还能吹出含可燃气体的泡泡，破裂便爆炸。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME cannot stay in water like most Water-type Pokémon; it needs to actively supply oxygen to its tail to maintain the flame underwater. POKENAME can blow bubbles containing flammable gas, which explode when they burst.

entry: POKENAME缩进壳里睡觉，靠尾焰取暖。若去打扰熟睡的POKENAME，它就会从壳上的孔洞喷火。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME will tuck themselves into their shell, using the flame from their tail to stay warm as they sleep. Attempting to disturb a sleeping POKENAME will cause them to release fire from the holes in their shell.

entry: POKENAME在熔岩池旁活得很好，将高热吸进体内。越热，电击招式越强，也越不稳定。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME thrives near lava pools, absorbing intense heat into its body. The hotter it becomes, the stronger and more erratic its Thundershock attack grows.

entry: 内部器官分析显示，POKENAME各部分分开，也能独立运作。不过，人们认为它与小火龙一系和小磁怪的融合体不同，合在一起比各自分开更强。
author: bobosmith01
source: Analysis of internal organs reveals each of POKENAME's parts could function independently if they were separated. However, they are considered different from Charmite, and are stronger together than apart.

entry: POKENAME挥动火焰短棍，想显得可怕。靠近水就慌，因为怕火熄灭。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME waves its fiery baton to appear menacing. It loses its composure when around water because it is scared of the fire being put out.

entry: POKENAME常吃浮冰，冷却滚烫身体。否则，便可能过热、行动迟缓。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME frequently eats floating ice chunks to cool its intensely hot body. Without this, it risks overheating and becoming sluggish.

entry: POKENAME由不易燃的污泥构成，从垃圾箱收集燃料，维持活命的火，再用不可燃物增大体形。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME's body is made of non-flammable sludge. It collects fuel from garbage bins to maintain the flames needed for survival, while using non-combustible materials to increase its size.

entry: POKENAME吃太多可燃物，火会热到熔化身体。温度恢复前，只能慢慢移动。
author: oreee0230
source: When POKENAME consumes too many combustible materials, its flames become hot enough to melt its body. Until the temperature returns to normal, POKENAME can only move slowly.

entry: POKENAME能从壳上的炮管喷火，射出的小火球，会飞出10英尺才炸开。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME expels flames from the cannons on its shell. It can shoot small fireballs that travel for a distance of 10 feet before they explode.

entry: POKENAME的炮管会喷出蒸汽，可烫伤人的威力不强，顶多只会刺痛一阵。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME shoots steam from its cannons. However, the steam doesn't burn much, and at most it'll sting for a while.

entry: POKENAME捕猎时给舌头涂油、点燃。因为用火猎食，它几乎只吃熟食。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME spreads oil on its tongue and ignites it when hunting. Because it hunts with fire, POKENAME almost exclusively eats cooked food.

entry: POKENAME受威胁，就向袭击者猛喷火。若合壳太久，壳会热到煮沸周围的水。
author: mistymagius
source: When threatened, POKENAME fires large bursts of flames at its attacker. If it keeps its shell closed for too long, the shell will become hot enough to boil the surrounding water.

entry: POKENAME外貌诡异，吓坏遇到的对象。但有登山者说，能见度低时，它曾帮忙引离危险路径。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's eerie appearance frightens those who come across it. However, there have been accounts from mountaineers claiming that POKENAME helped guide them away from dangerous paths when visibility was low.

entry: POKENAME用燃烧的手碰肩，捉弄纠缠的对象，暖到对方大汗淋漓。只需威胁要喷水，它就吓得逃走。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME pranks those it haunts by touching their shoulders with its burning hands, warming the victim to the point of profusely sweating. Just the threat of being sprayed with water is enough to send it fleeing in terror.

entry: POKENAME天性友好，常接近洞里歇脚的旅人，提供大身体，保暖、保护。它还愿借尾焰做饭，只要分一点给它。
author: sk372
source: Friendly by nature, POKENAME often approaches travelers resting inside caves and offers them its large body for both warmth and protection. It even offers its tail-flame to use for cooking food, as long as it gets a small share.

entry: POKENAME吐出催眠火焰，旋成多种图案。有人声称盯着看能见异象，但缺乏确凿证据。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME breathes out hypnotic flames that swirl in various patterns. People claim to have visions while staring at its flames, though concrete evidence for this is lacking.

entry: POKENAME诱来渴望龙之力量的小火龙，偷走它们的梦。受影响者，会变得过于平静。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME lures Charmanders who desire the power of dragons and steals their dreams. The affected Charmanders become overly calm in personality.

entry: POKENAME诱来渴望自我突破的小火龙，偷走它们的梦。受影响者，会变得过于顽皮。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME lures Charmanders who desire self-breakthrough and steals their dreams. The affected Charmanders' personalities become overly impish.

entry: POKENAME将背上种子胀到气球大，便能长时间漂浮，随风远行。烦躁时释放毒孢子，赶走别人。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME can inflate the seed on its back until it grows as large as a balloon, allowing it to float for long periods and travel great distances on wind currents. When agitated, it releases poisonous spores to keep others away.

entry: 进化所用的月之石，让POKENAME实力大增。它以惊人速度，保卫训练家。
author: smashbear
source: The Moon Stone used for evolution gave POKENAME a significant boost in power. It defends its Trainer with incredible speed.

entry: POKENAME唱歌时，别人若睡着，它就暴怒。沮丧中可能自爆，强烈爆炸轰击周围一切。
author: .izik
source: If others fall asleep while it is singing, POKENAME grows furious. In its frustration, it may self-destruct, blasting everything around it with a powerful explosion.

entry: POKENAME朝骨棒唱歌，放大音量。听它轻柔、低声的摇篮曲，许多宝可梦会梦见家人。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME sing into their boney club to amplify their voice. Many Pokémon dream of their families after a soft, hushed lullaby from POKENAME.

entry: 谁在POKENAME唱歌时睡着，它便高速扔出棍棒。顽皮又突然的动作，把目标叫醒。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME will fling a club at someone who falls asleep during its song, doing so with high speed. This sudden action is a playful yet surprising way to wake its target up.

entry: POKENAME吸入大量空气，以低频吼叫，同时让舌头起伏。这奇怪行为的用途，引来许多猜测。
author: empty_set
source: POKENAME undulates its tongue by sucking in large amounts of air and bellowing at a subsonic frequency. The purpose of this peculiar behavior is a topic of much speculation.

entry: POKENAME的气体像温和镇静剂，使吸入者困倦、不再回应外界。医院用来合成手术所需的强效麻醉药。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME's gas functions as a mild sedative, causing those who breathe it to become drowsy and unresponsive. Hospitals make use of POKENAME's gas to synthesise powerful anaesthetics for surgeries.

entry: 深夜，POKENAME会发出呻吟，仿佛一位正受痛苦折磨的老妇人。若有人上前相助，就会被它吃掉，化为进化的能量。
author: .izik
source: Late at night, a POKENAME groans as if it is an elderly woman in pain. Should a person assist, it will consume them, storing energy for evolution.

entry: POKENAME气体镇静作用极强，几股就能击昏人和大型宝可梦。这常让想交朋友的它十分沮丧。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's gas is a strong sedative, even knocking out humans and large Pokémon with only a few puffs. This tends to frustrate POKENAME, who seek to make friends.

entry: POKENAME边唱歌，边旋转鼻子上的钻头，动作形成奇特节奏。歌声配合钻头，既能娱乐，也能在战斗中威吓。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spins the drill on its nose while singing, creating an oddly rhythmic pattern as it moves. This combination of song and drill serves to both entertain and intimidate in battle.

entry: POKENAME照顾幼小宝可梦，害怕时就唱歌哄睡。柔软蓬松的身体，安慰着求暖的对象。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME takes care of young Pokémon, singing them to sleep when they are scared. Its soft, fluffy body provides comfort to those seeking warmth.

entry: POKENAME把弱小、无力自保的宝可梦护在袋里，哪怕不是自己的孩子。为了驱退野生宝可梦，它憋住气、胀大身体，显得大得多。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME shelters small, defenseless Pokémon in its pouch, even if they aren't its own offspring. To ward off wild Pokémon, it puffs itself up by holding its breath, making itself look much larger.

entry: 它的身体柔软如橡胶，能毫发无损游过激流。撞到任何障碍，也只是弹开。
author: .jerden
source: Its body is soft and rubbery. It can swim through rough waters without being harmed, as it will simply bounce off any obstacle it collides with.

entry: 它虽有带鳞的鳍，身体却覆着防水毛。头上的角由同样的物质紧密聚成尖锐形状。
author: .jerden
source: While it has scaled fins, its body is covered with waterproof fur. The horn on its head is made of the same substance, tightly packed into a sharp point.

entry: POKENAME精力无穷、天性好奇。虽说最爱苹果，却只肯吃自认为完美的果实。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME are known for their boundless energy and curious nature. Though apples are considered their favorite food, they only choose to consume fruit they deem as perfect.

entry: 华美的外貌，让它常被请去唱歌、跳舞，可至今竟没留下表演评价。失眠的人，倒很喜欢它。
author: houndrys.
source: Due to its luxurious look, it's often employed as a singer and dancer, but no reviews exist of its performance. It's popular among insomniacs.

entry: 被POKENAME电击的训练家说，自己差点触电身亡时，听见过音乐。那声音常被比作电吉他。
author: empty_set
source: Trainers who were shocked by POKENAME's electricity report hearing music while they were nearly electrocuted.  The sound has often been compared to an electric guitar.

entry: POKENAME肺活量大，一口便能吐大量火。有时还能边喷边唱，在前方倾泻出音乐与烈焰交织的火海。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's lung capacity lets it breathe out vast quantities of fire in a single breath. At times it even manages to sing as it does so, creating an inferno of music cascading in front of it.

entry: POKENAME热爱金属乐，用尽嗓子尖叫，疯狂甩头。它们成群，甚至会在森林中央开整场音乐会。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME have a love for metal music, thrashing their heads around while screaming at the top of their lungs. Groups of POKENAME will even create entire concerts out in the middle of the forest.

entry: POKENAME因美貌和好歌喉，常被养在私人池塘。歌还会吸引其他鲤鱼王融合体，因此也是研究者的好伙伴。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME are often kept in private ponds both for their beauty and lovely singing voice. These songs are known to attract other Magikarp fusions, making them useful companions for researchers as well.

entry: 新手艺术家和工匠很喜欢POKENAME。它先让人把柔软身体塑形，再真正变成物件，让创作者检查捏得准不准。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a popular companion for budding artists and artisans, letting others mold its malleable body into a shape before it transforms into the object proper, allowing the artist to see how accurate their molding was.

entry: POKENAME喜欢抱别人，也爱被抚摸。毛皮太柔美，哪怕轻碰一下，也能让人沉迷好几个小时。
author: biodrum
source: POKENAME loves to cuddle others and get pets. Its fur is so luscious that a single touch can completely captivate one's attention for hours.

entry: POKENAME主要侵入电子游戏，用自己的歌替换配乐。但歌太好听，几乎没人抱怨。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: POKENAME primarily infests video games, replacing their soundtracks with its own singing. However, its songs are so pleasant that few complain.

entry: POKENAME唱歌时，声音在壳里回响，放大音量，引其他宝可梦靠近。足够近，触手便抓住，整只吞下。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME's voice echoes through their shells as they sing, increasing its volume and luring other Pokémon towards them. Once they get close enough, their tentacles will snatch them up before swallowing them whole.

entry: POKENAME全身软毛如丝。有些训练家发现，躺它肚上听温柔鼾声，睡得最好。
author: .jerden
source: Its body is covered by soft and silky fur. Some Trainers find that they sleep best lying on POKENAME's belly, soothed by its gentle snoring.

entry: POKENAME身体很软、轻、柔韧，把战斗当游戏。它很喜欢被攻击抛来弹去，仿佛无论挨什么都不疼。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's body is very soft, light and pliant. It sees combat as a game, and delights in being thrown and bounced around by attacks, seemingly feeling no pain no matter what it gets hit with.

entry: POKENAME柔软的身体和华贵的毛皮深受喜爱。著名明星出席瞩目活动，曾把它披在脖子上，因此饲养它也被视作某种身份象征。
author: sk372
source: Beloved for its soft body and luxurious fur, POKENAME has been seen draped around the necks of famous stars at high-profile events. Due to this, owning a POKENAME is seen as something of a status symbol.

entry: POKENAME大眼睛视力强，夜晚黑暗中也看得清。它守着离巢幼鸟，学飞摔落，就用柔软的身体接住。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's large eyes give it strong eyesight, even in the darkness of night. It watches over young birds leaving the nest, catching them against its soft body should they fall while learning to fly.

entry: POKENAME用触角上的麦克风，在深海唱美丽旋律。歌声诱人，让听者越潜越深。
author: santon5512
source: Using the microphones attached to its antenna, POKENAME will sing a beautiful melody deep beneath the ocean. This song has an alluring effect on those who hear it, drawing them deeper and deeper underwater.

entry: 据说POKENAME长耳能听到其他维度的声音。耳朵开始按节奏抽动，它就朝天鸣叫，仿佛在回应什么。
author: cobalt0135
source: The long ears of POKENAME are said to pick up sounds from other dimensions. When their ears begin to twitch rhythmically, they let out a call, facing the sky as if they are responding to something.

entry: POKENAME的羊毛据说柔如云，身体又能胀成完美枕头。训练家忍不住靠着休息，渐渐睡去。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME wool is said to be as soft as a cloud, while its body is able to expand into the perfect pillow. Because of this, Trainers can't help but rest alongside it and drift asleep.

entry: 许多偷猎者为粉白丝滑羽毛，猎杀POKENAME。但这些猛禽绝不会不战而被擒。
author: ratractac
source: Many poachers try to hunt POKENAME for its pink-white and silky feathers, but these birds of prey do not let themselves be captured without a fight.

entry: POKENAME能胀到原来2倍大，够到旁树的树果。若碰到大针蜂毒刺而中毒，给一颗桃桃果就能解毒。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can expand to twice their size to reach berries in trees nearby. By giving them a Pecha Berry, they can cure the poison they get whenever they bump into Beedrill stinger.

entry: POKENAME藏在家中墙内，整夜唱。许多人觉得烦，也有人说有助入睡。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME hides within the walls of homes, singing throughout the night. While many people find this singing to be a nuisance, some say it helps them fall asleep.

entry: POKENAME大多时间吸收日月光，能量充足后，就唱甜美摇篮曲，催眠周围宝可梦。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME spend much of their time absorbing sunlight and moonlight. Once they are full of energy, they sing sweet lullabies that put Pokémon around them to sleep.

entry: POKENAME刚进化时还没长毛，皮肤随后分泌薄膜状物质，刺激生长。一天，毛就长至约10厘米的完整长度。研究者正探索其促进人类生发的潜力。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Right after evolution, POKENAME is bald. It excretes a film from its skin that stimulates hair growth, growing to its full length of about 10cm in a single day. Researchers are studying them for the potential in human hair growth.

entry: 表演中若有人想走，POKENAME就用精神能量压住。它不许观众在唱完前离开。
author: .izik
source: Should someone attempt to walk away mid-performance, POKENAME will pin them down with psychic energy. It refuses to let an audience leave until the song is finished.

entry: POKENAME藏在家中墙内，整夜唱。许多人觉得烦，也有人说有助入睡。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME hides within the walls of homes, singing throughout the night. While many people find this singing to be a nuisance, some say it helps them fall asleep.

entry: POKENAME吃奶酪后，极其幸福，连唱数小时。舒缓嗓音回荡，曲调传遍周围，让附近宝可梦平静。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME sings for hours on end in pure bliss after eating cheese. Its soothing voice echoes in the air, filling the area with a calming melody that can have a peaceful effect on nearby Pokémon.

entry: 关都的一些商店照着POKENAME的模样制作甜点，想与名气响亮的飞云冰淇淋竞争，效果却不怎么好。
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher
source: Some stores in Kanto have made confections based on POKENAME to try to compete with the vaunted Casteliacone, to little success.

entry: 它爱唱，不停长的门牙却常让音调跑偏、失谐。毛皮被视为极尽奢华，它也为此骄傲。
author: kinsgs
source: It loves to sing, but its ever-growing front teeth often make its notes sound off-key and dissonant. Its fur is considered the height of luxury, and it is extremely proud of it.

entry: 它爱唱，不停长的门牙却常让音调跑偏、失谐。毛皮被视为极尽奢华，它也为此骄傲。
author: kinsgs
source: It loves to sing, but its ever-growing front teeth often make its notes sound off-key and dissonant. Its fur is considered the height of luxury, and it is extremely proud of it.

entry: 它爱唱，不停长的门牙却常让音调跑偏、失谐。毛皮被视为极尽奢华，它也为此骄傲。
author: kinsgs
source: It loves to sing, but its ever-growing front teeth often make its notes sound off-key and dissonant. Its fur is considered the height of luxury, and it is extremely proud of it.

entry: POKENAME吸气，最多能胀到原来5倍，几乎像气球。大刺从身体突出，保护它慢慢飘离危险。
author: santon5512
source: By sucking in air, POKENAME can expand up to five times their original size, becoming almost like a balloon. Large spikes jut out from their bodies, protecting them as they slowly float away from danger.

entry: POKENAME身体柔软却结实，能挨很多打，毫不退缩。它钳住敌人不放，任其挣扎、还击，直到累得打不动。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's body is soft yet firm, able to withstand a large amount of punishment without flinching. It grabs foes with its pincers and holds on tightly, letting them struggle and strike until they're too exhausted to continue fighting.

entry: POKENAME爱在大群观众前边唱边表演。舞台花样之一，是用利爪戳破装闪粉的泡泡。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME take great joy in singing in front of large audiences while performing tricks. One of the tricks they can perform while on stage revolves around popping glitter filled bubbles with their sharp claws.

entry: POKENAME体内不断产超热气体，太热便冒泡、膨胀。经过训练能慢慢释放热气，在寒冷地区很受欢迎。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME bubble and puff up when they get too hot, as their internal anatomy constantly produces superhot gas. They can be trained to release this hot air slowly and are popular companions in colder regions.

entry: POKENAME的碧玺深绿，收藏家珍视，还常进一步抛光，增强光泽。宝石一生都长，因此必须持续喂富含二氧化硅的食物。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME's tourmaline gems are prized for their deep green colour, with many collectors seeking to polish them further to enhance their lustre. The gem grows throughout their life, requiring POKENAME to be fed a steady diet of silica-rich foods.

entry: POKENAME飞过草地唱歌，想鼓舞吃草的宝可梦。可舒缓嗓音，终究总使对方意外睡着。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME sings while soaring over meadows, hoping to invigorate grazing Pokémon with its melody. However, its soothing voice inevitably lulls them into an unintended slumber.

entry: POKENAME个头小、毛极软，是受欢迎的宠物。最好备跑轮，以及能挖掘的花园。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME is a popular housepet for its small size and extremely soft fur. A running wheel and a garden to dig in are recommended for this Pokémon.

entry: 这种宝可梦常仅因毛就被追捧。毛软得不可思议，常被用来制作高档枕头和被子。
author: lydiaprower8
source: This Pokémon is often sought after for its fur alone, which is unbelievably soft and often used for luxury pillows and duvets.

entry: POKENAME用舒缓声波，引小型水生宝可梦群穿过海洋。有时升到水面，通过鳃吸氧。
author: violet_zero
source: POKENAME guides schools of small aquatic Pokémon through the sea with soothing soundwaves. It occasionally rises to the water's surface to take in oxygen through its gills.

entry: POKENAME用鼻子吸入花粉、烟，净化空气。肚子随之胀大，直到将空气排到外面。许多哮喘患者会养它在旁，帮助呼吸。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can remove pollen and smoke from the air by sucking them in through their trunk, causing their stomachs to expand until they can release the air outside. Many people with asthma have a POKENAME handy to help them breathe better.

entry: POKENAME用鼻子吹欢快乐曲，最愤怒的宝可梦也能安抚。可惜，过程常连同伴也催眠。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME trumpets a cheerful tune from its trunk that can soothe even the most furious Pokémon. Unfortunately, it often puts its own allies to sleep in the process.

entry: 野生POKENAME投射二维图像，能操控显示各种画面。它也配上歌声，独自开演唱会，或迷惑附近捕食者。
author: npshi
source: Wild POKENAME emit 2D images that they can manipulate to show a variety of different visuals. POKENAME can accompany these images with singing to put on one-man concerts or even confuse nearby predators.

entry: POKENAME因角和毛价值高，野外几乎遭猎到灭绝。巡护员与保育者已大体恢复族群，人道养殖也大体取代非法偷猎。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME were nearly hunted to extinction in the wild due to the value of their antlers and fur. Pokémon Rangers and conservationists have largely restored wild populations. Humane POKENAME farming has largely supplanted illegal poaching.

entry: POKENAME以艺术、音乐才华为傲，边画边开心唱，有时还装尾巴是麦克风。
author: violet_zero
source: POKENAME prides itself on its artistic and musical talents. It sings happily as it draws, sometimes pretending its own tail is a microphone.

entry: POKENAME毛皮极软、柔韧，深受王室喜爱。若没好好照顾，它便生气、胀大，用尖耳像陀螺般攻击。
author: shyguy11011
source: POKENAME's fur is beloved among royalty for being very soft and supple. If not properly attended to, POKENAME will become angry, inflating its body and striking with its pointed ears like a top.

entry: POKENAME用凝视赶走天敌。若不眨眼、不退缩的表情还不够，就突然尖叫一声，刺得对方耳朵生疼。
author: pokepower
source: POKENAME drive off predators by staring. If its unblinking, unflinching expression isn't enough, a sudden ear-piercing screech does the job.

entry: POKENAME在野外轻跃，却因害羞，会避开大群对象。它能让身体略微膨胀，使华贵鬃毛变大，散出彩色火花和雷电。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME prances about the wild, though it flees from large groups due to its shy nature. It can inflate its body slightly, the act of which causes its luxurious mane to grow and emit colorful sparks and bolts of lightning.

entry: POKENAME大手有力，按摩堪称世界一流。它不收费，因为客人放松后的一声叹息，就是足够回报。
author: kiwiarms
source: Its huge, strong hands allow POKENAME to give some of the best massages in the world. It does so for free, as a relaxed customer's sigh of relief is reward enough.

entry: POKENAME爱唱，让交好的宝可梦开心。歌声获赞，它一开心，体内储存的电力就会让身体像灯泡般明亮。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME loves to perform songs to delight the Pokémon it has befriended. When it receives praise for its singing, it becomes so happy that the electricity stored in its body makes it shine like a lightbulb.

entry: POKENAME能发信号，关闭周围电器。调整信号强弱，也能让其他钢属性宝可梦入睡。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are capable of producing signals that turn off electronics around them. By modifying the strength of the signal, they can cause other Steel-type Pokémon to fall asleep too.

entry: POKENAME可伸长的舌头覆着微小钩，帮忙清理华美毛皮。被舔可能刮掉皮肤。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Its stretchy tongue is covered in microscopic hooks that help it clean its luscious fur. Getting licked by POKENAME can scrape skin off.

entry: 这种强壮宝可梦硬如花岗岩，却渴望亲昵接触。它裹满枕头、柔软布料，想让自己更适合拥抱。
author: sontyp
source: This strong Pokémon's body is hard as granite. Missing physical affection, it covers itself in pillows and soft fabrics to appear more huggable.

entry: POKENAME快速飞过大地，出现在纷争之处，唱悦耳乐曲。听众负面情绪渐去，转而想睡一场美梦。
author: sk372
source: Flying quickly across the lands, POKENAME appears above places of strife, singing a pleasant tune. Those who hear its song find their negative feelings slipping away, replaced with an urge to sleep and have pleasant dreams.

entry: POKENAME只喝最纯净的水，否则华贵的粉色毛皮可能受损。据说谁帮忙，它就送一朵香气绝妙的花，表示感谢。
author: fiordaliso
source: It can only drink the purest water; otherwise, its luxurious pink coat might get ruined. It is said that if someone helps POKENAME, it will thank them by giving them one of its wonderfully fragrant flowers.

entry: POKENAME用敏感毛簇察觉上升气流，借披风般的翼滑翔。弱小宝可梦遇险，它便俯冲救助，用蓬松爪子攻击施暴者。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME uses its sensitive tuft of hair to sense updrafts to aid in gliding with its cape-like wing. If it sees a weak Pokémon in danger, it dives to the rescue and attacks the aggressor with its puffy claws.

entry: POKENAME被视为最难伺候的宝可梦之一，华贵毛每天得梳4小时。宠爱它的训练家，会得到保护欲过强的伙伴：它蓬起花粉般柔软的毛，守护主人。
author: ghostslythe
source: Often considered one of the most demanding Pokémon, POKENAME's luxurious fur must be brushed four hours a day. Those Trainers who pamper them are rewarded with an overprotective companion that protects them by puffing up their pollen-soft hair.

entry: POKENAME爱唱，没观众时很自信。旁人在场、要它唱，它反而怕失败，流着泪逃回巢。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME loves to sing and does so in confidence when there are no observers. When others are in its presence and ask it to sing, POKENAME becomes scared of failing and tears up before running away back to its nest.

entry: POKENAME大半天都在犁田，为下轮作物腾地方。犁地时唱歌，让自己保持稳定节奏。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME spends most of the day plowing fields to make room for the next round of crops. It can be heard singing songs to help itself keep a steady rhythm when plowing fields.

entry: POKENAME眼睛受透明水膜保护，战斗不用眨眼。毛虽摸着软，有力的双腿却能踢出破坏力极强的攻击。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME's eyes are protected by a transparent watery lining, allowing it to fight without blinking. While its fur feels soft to the touch, its powerful legs can deliver devastating kicks.

entry: POKENAME以细腻毛皮为傲，很挑谁能摸身体。谁擅自碰，就毫不犹豫重踢，将人击飞。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: Proud of their fine fur, POKENAME are very selective of the people who can feel their bodies. If someone touches a POKENAME without permission, these Pokémon will retaliate with a powerful kick without hesitation to knock the individual away.

entry: 它看不穿额上华贵长毛，却靠超能力感知周围。若觉得对方友好，就会请求揉乱头毛。
author: pattybgoode
source: Although it can't see past the luxurious locks of fur atop its head, it uses its psychic power to remain aware of its surroundings. If it senses that a person is friendly, it will request that the fur on its head be tousled.

entry: POKENAME在战场边唱边跳复杂舞。它优雅按自己的节奏舞动，形成近乎迷人的气场，能迷惑敌人，也能逗对方开心。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME performs intricate dances while singing on the battlefield. It moves gracefully to its own rhythm, creating an almost mesmerizing aura that can confuse or entertain its foes.

entry: POKENAME用摇篮曲般温柔的嗓音平息怒气，再为训练家披上强力的精神帷幕。察觉危险，胸前的玫瑰就开出深红花朵，将妖精和超能力的力量凝成优雅一击。
author: cerealjamalt
source: POKENAME soothes raging hearts with a voice as soft as a lullaby, then wraps its Trainer in a powerful psychic veil. The rose on its chest blooms crimson when it senses danger, channeling Fairy and Psychic power into one elegant strike.

entry: 它臂上的毛簇摸着柔软，却坚韧如钢。战斗时用念力，将毛塑成临时、剃刀般锋利的刃。
author: cait_sith
source: The tufts of fur on its arms are soft to the touch yet as durable as steel. When in battle, it uses telekinesis to form this fur into makeshift razor-sharp blades.

entry: POKENAME小家庭合力啃倒树，筑家庭水坝。身体像橡胶，若树意外砸上来，也能保护它们。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME work together in small family groups to gnaw down trees with which to make family dams. They have rubbery bodies that help to protect them from harm should one of the falling trees accidentally fall on top of them.

entry: POKENAME将波导集中在特定部位，使其变大。胳膊或腿胀大，便让拳踢威力适度增强。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can focus its aura within specific parts of its body in order to increase their size. This lets it swell up its arms or legs in order to give its punches and kicks a moderate boost in power.

entry: 后面的头爱唱歌，唱得却连主头也受不了。歌声长年不断，让主头随着年龄增长，听力越来越差。
author: mistymagius
source: The back head loves to sing, even though its singing is so bad not even the main head can stand it. Due to the constant singing, the main head's hearing gets worse as it gets older.

entry: POKENAME整天懒躺，随意吃灌木、树上的果。被叫去打架，却强得可怕，胀起胸大吼，数英里外也听得见。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME spend their days lazing around and casually eating fruit from bushes and trees. When roused to fight they are terrifyingly strong, inflating their chest and bellowing loud enough to be heard from miles away.

entry: POKENAME寿命通常约100年。毛一生越长越厚、越软，帮助适应各种气候，因此能从毛皮浓密程度估年龄。
author: puppylev
source: POKENAME's lives are known to typically span about a century. In that time, their fur continuously grows thicker and softer, which helps them adapt to various climates. As such, their ages can be estimated by the density of their coats.

entry: POKENAME初看阴森，其实很友好，会带迷路孩子离开森林家园。谁敢威胁它或孩子，就会迎来刺耳哀号。
author: kam_doodle_snek
source: Although spooky at first, POKENAME is a very friendly Pokémon! It leads lost children out of the forests it calls home. Those who dare threaten it or the children it guides will be met with an ear-splitting wail.

entry: POKENAME有音乐天分，尤其擅长弹钢琴。与身体分离的双手在琴键上完美舞动，只需几分钟，就能记住乐谱。
author: sk372
source: The musically-inclined POKENAME is especially adept at playing the piano. Its disembodied hands dance across the keyboard flawlessly, and it memorizes sheet music in only a few minutes.

entry: POKENAME开朗、孩子气，常有些天真，可对珍爱的东西，却守得格外凶——尤其是最爱的零食。
author: cristata
source: Despite being jovial, childish, and often naive, POKENAME are also fiercely protective of that which they hold dear, primarily, their favorite snacks.

entry: POKENAME开朗、孩子气，常有些天真，可对珍爱的东西，却守得格外凶——尤其是最爱的零食。
author: cristata
source: Despite being jovial, childish, and often naive, POKENAME are also fiercely protective of that which they hold dear, primarily, their favorite snacks.

entry: POKENAME通常居于高山，在连绵峰顶维持大片领地。它们以响亮回荡的歌声，向胖王和敌对的POKENAME传递讯息。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME typically dwell high in the mountains, maintaining large territories across the peaks of their homes. They signal to Wigglyking and rival POKENAME with loud, echoing songs.

entry: POKENAME只用飘带上柔软的毛轻轻拂过，便能安抚人类与宝可梦。它还能把刀刃鼓得奇大无比。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME can calm people and Pokémon just by brushing them with their ribbon's soft fur. It can also inflate their blade to a ridiculous size.

entry: POKENAME的盾，由一团蓬松、弹性极高的毛构成。大多攻击直接就弹开。
author: regulavish
source: POKENAME's shield is made out of a cluster of poofy, highly elastic hair. Most attacks bounce right off.

entry: POKENAME把盾像唱片般转动，制造音乐，既娱乐也战斗。曲风虽多，它最爱电子舞曲。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME can spin their shields like a record disc, creating music for both fun and to fight enemies. While they can play various genres, they prefer Electronic Dance Music.

entry: POKENAME战斗时也极爱表现，几乎每次出招的前后，都要摆夸张姿势，发出响亮战吼。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has a massive flair for showmanship regarding battles. Almost every strike it makes is preceded by and followed up with dramatic poses and loud battle cries.

entry: 出众的歌声能令听众着迷，为它聚来大批死心塌地的歌迷，愿意替它做任何事。可演出一旦被打断，它发起火来，连脾气最坏的歌坛天后都比不上。
author: elfail0
source: Its incredible singing voice has the power to enthrall listeners, which allows it to amass giant crowds of loyal fans that will do anything for it. Its rage when a performance is disrupted can put even the most disgruntled diva to shame.

entry: 毛发丰厚蓬松，手感好得让人忍不住想摸。抱着POKENAME，也被用来帮助失眠的人入睡。
author: melodydelune
source: Its rich, fluffy fur feels so good to touch that people find it difficult not to touch it. Cuddling POKENAME is used to help insomnia patients.

entry: POKENAME通常平和，唱摇篮曲催眠其他宝可梦。但一生气，就挥爪、用毒角攻击，因此训练家尽量避免在它周围起冲突。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are generally peaceful Pokémon that sing lullabies to put other Pokémon to sleep. When they get angry, they lash out with their sharp claws and venomous horn, so Trainers try to avoid conflict around POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME深吸一口气，鼓起身体，就能轻轻浮上天空。放气时则看心情，发出舒缓的声音，或极具破坏力的尖啸。
author: sontyp
source: By inhaling deeply, POKENAME can inflate itself enough to gently float through the air. When it deflates, it creates soothing sounds or devastating screeches, depending on its mood.

entry: 有些父母愁孩子夜里不肯睡，就送他们一只POKENAME。在它身上玩游戏，几乎任何失眠者都能在开玩后30分钟内入睡。
author: alestrius
source: Frustrated parents whose children won't go to bed at night are sometimes known to gift them a POKENAME. The games played on a POKENAME can put almost any insomniac to sleep within 30 minutes of starting.

entry: POKENAME柔软的浅橙粉色毛皮，加上温柔嗓音，让人喜欢养在身边。它先给训练家唱摇篮曲，再自己蜷起睡着。
author: quackquackattack
source: People enjoy having a POKENAME around because of their soft, melon-colored fur and gentle voice. POKENAME sing lullabies to their Trainers before curling up and falling asleep as well.

entry: 它飞得快，拖着灼热火星，高唱美妙旋律，因而被称为“歌唱彗星”。吸气胀大身体，再排气，就能调整轨迹。
author: infinex21
source: It is known to many as the "Singing Comet" due to how fast it can fly, trailed by searing embers and bellowing beautiful melodies. It can expand much of its body by inhaling and then release the inhaled air to adjust its trajectory.

entry: POKENAME好奇、爱交往，变换形态，适应不同环境。每到新地方，都先让附近训练家安心，表明自己没有敌意。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME is highly curious and social, shifting its form to try to adapt to different environments. Whenever it travels somewhere new, it makes sure to reassure any nearby Trainers that it comes in peace.

entry: POKENAME过度活跃，跳来跳去，胀得会从墙上弹开。战斗中疯狂移动，满场弹跳挥爪，让敌人跟不上。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME hyperactively jumps around, inflating so much it bounces off walls. It uses manic movement in battle, bouncing around the field swiping with its claws while its opponent struggles to keep up.

entry: POKENAME肺大、身体可胀，能连唱几分钟，却常被自己的歌催眠。毛柔软得像羊绒。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME can sing for several minutes due to their large lungs and inflatable body. Oftentimes, they end up putting themselves to sleep with their own song. Their fur is as soft as cashmere.

entry: 它毛发华美，歌声舒缓而催眠。讨喜的外貌引来大批观众，既满足被关注的渴望，又有更多食物可偷。
author: elfail0
source: This Pokémon possesses luxurious fur and a soothingly hypnotic voice. Its appealing appearance allows it to lure in large audiences, which gives it the attention it craves and more food to steal.

entry: POKENAME肺大、身体可胀，能连唱几分钟，却常被自己的歌催眠。毛柔软得像羊绒。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME can sing for several minutes due to their large lungs and inflatable body. Oftentimes, they end up putting themselves to sleep with their own song. Their fur is as soft as cashmere.

entry: 遇见好斗宝可梦，POKENAME就吸气，像气球般胀大，显得更吓人。疲惫、饥饿时，尾焰会变弱。
author: fiordaliso
source: If it encounters an aggressive Pokémon, POKENAME inflates itself like a balloon by inhaling air, making itself appear larger and more threatening. The flame on its tail weakens when it grows tired or hungry.

entry: POKENAME的毛柔软舒服，制成衣服很抢手。它好奇什么，就用手杖快速敲打，进行调查。
author: ruben2309295
source: POKENAME are known for the soft and comforting texture of their fur. Clothing made from the fur of a POKENAME is highly sought after. If a POKENAME is curious about an object, they will investigate it by rapidly hitting it with their cane.

entry: 这种宝可梦光是存在，就足以安抚、逗乐任何对象。它异想天开，常浮在淡彩云间，或让孩子在极能膨胀的身体上弹跳。
author: violet_zero
source: The very presence of this Pokémon is enough to soothe and delight any individual. It is a whimsical Pokémon, often times floating amid pastel clouds or letting children bounce on its incredibly inflatable body.

entry: 融合后的POKENAME能把原本潜藏的力量化成彩云，安抚对手，使其神思恍惚。它出奇耐打，最强壮的宝可梦全力一击，也能承受。
author: violet_zero
source: Fused POKENAME are able to wield their previously latent power in the form of colorful clouds, which can pacify and daze opponents. It is surprisingly durable and can withstand a full-force blow from even the most physically strong Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME吸气，让胸部像气球般鼓起，既吓退捕食者，也让自己在训练家面前显得强大，希望被收服。
author: santon5512
source: By inhaling air, POKENAME can puff up their chests like balloons. They do this both to scare off predators and to make themselves look stronger to Trainers, hoping to be caught.

entry: POKENAME羽毛柔软得绝妙，象征奢华财富。火囊平时很热，刚蜕的羽毛暖到能融雪。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME feathers are considered a symbol of luxury and wealth due to how sublimely soft they are. Freshly shed feathers are so warm that they can melt snow due to how hot the flame sacs of these Pokémon typically get.

entry: POKENAME嘴大、身体有弹性，能先胀大，再发出极响、歌唱般的叫声。人们认为，它的音量可能与爆音怪一样，达到危险的极高分贝。
author: sk372
source: With its large mouth and elastic body, POKENAME can puff up before releasing extremely loud song-like cries. It's believed it may rival Exploud in reaching dangerously extreme decibel levels.

entry: POKENAME主要吃宝石，吃石头让毛更亮。它偏爱进化之石，吃月之石后，毛便明亮泛粉光。
author: hamperius
source: POKENAME's primary food source is gemstones, and consumption of stones increases the sheen of its fur. It favours eating evolution stones, and when it eats a Moon Stone, its fur will glow bright pink.

entry: POKENAME让身体保持膨胀，以便牢牢贴住滚过的表面。但吸气过多、胀得太大，摩擦力反而降低，很难滚动。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME keep themselves inflated to ensure they have a good grip on whatever surface they roll on. Whenever they inhale too much air, they become overinflated and have a difficult time rolling with the low friction.

entry: POKENAME软毛保暖。见其他宝可梦发抖，可能用毛皮裹住，提供庇护；毛皮褶子宽松，小型宝可梦也装得下。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's soft fur coat keeps it warm in cold conditions. If it sees another Pokémon shivering, POKENAME may provide shelter by wrapping its coat around it, as its folds are loose enough for a smaller Pokémon to also fit within.

entry: POKENAME身体冷，却柔软，触感常被比作冰淇淋。其实很像橡胶，能像球般弹。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's body is cold but soft, with a texture that is often compared to ice cream. It is actually quite rubbery, enabling it to bounce around like a ball.

entry: POKENAME飞过雪地，找人唱摇篮曲。边唱边吐寒气，让观众无法离开。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME flutter through snowy landscapes searching for people to sing their lullaby to. As they sing, they release a frosty breath to keep a captive audience.

entry: 舞姿道馆的对战中，常能看见POKENAME。它们花样繁多，又很爱炫耀。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME are often found in Gym battles at the Ballonlea gym. They know numerous tricks and like to show off.

entry: POKENAME看似柔软蓬松，却很不该摸。身体大多是玻璃纤维隔热材料，触碰会留下许多割伤。
author: hophoppip
source: Though POKENAME looks soft and fluffy, petting it is a horrible idea. Its body is largely made of fiberglass insulation, and will leave anyone who touches it with a plethora of cuts.

entry: POKENAME飞行时唱歌、听回声辨路。每只音高不同，能分出自己的声音，成群时便形成和声。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME sing to help themselves navigate, listening for echoes off their environment as they fly. Each POKENAME sings at a different pitch so that they can differentiate their own noises, with flocks of POKENAME creating a harmony.

entry: POKENAME身体极有弹性，爱胀大、彼此碰着弹。它是有些登山男意想不到的伙伴，若滑下山坡，迅速膨胀便可能救命。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have very elastic bodies and enjoy puffing up and bouncing off of one another. They are an unlikely companion for some Hikers, as their ability to rapidly inflate can be a lifesaver if a Hiker slips and falls down a mountainside.

entry: POKENAME用音乐、光传达情绪和思想。有证据显示，每种光色对应不同情绪，但这理论从未证实。
author: giggity._.
source: POKENAME uses music and light to communicate emotions & thought. There is evidence that each color of light conveys a different emotion, but the theory has never been proven.

entry: POKENAME用音乐、光传达情绪和思想。有证据显示，每种光色对应不同情绪，但这理论从未证实。
author: giggity._.
source: POKENAME uses music and light to communicate emotions & thought. There is evidence that each color of light conveys a different emotion, but the theory has never been proven.

entry: POKENAME由特殊弹性布料构成，身体能胀大。许多能长成沙发大，正适合训练家临时歇脚。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are made out of a special stretchy fabric that allows them to expand their bodies. Many can expand to the size of a sofa, making them the perfect size for Trainers to take an impromptu rest.

entry: 谁听POKENAME唱歌睡着，它就摆战斗姿势，耐心等对方醒，再送重拳。它在战斗中这样用，既顽皮，也有策略。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME enters a fighting stance when someone falls asleep to its song, waiting patiently for them to wake up before delivering a powerful punch. It uses this tactic as a playful but strategic move during battles.

entry: 其他宝可梦踩上格栅，POKENAME就从脚印推断身份，随后让对方猛然坠落，葬送性命。
author: bostroms
source: If another Pokémon steps onto its grate, POKENAME will deduce their identity based on their footprint.  It will then send them plummeting to their doom.

entry: 其他宝可梦踩上格栅，POKENAME就从脚印推断身份，随后让对方猛然坠落，葬送性命。
author: bostroms
source: If another Pokémon steps onto its grate, POKENAME will deduce their identity based on their footprint.  It will then send them plummeting to their doom.

entry: POKENAME胸腔大，每次吸气便扩张。呼出时，漫天雪花让碰到的一切都冷下来。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a large chest cavity that expands whenever they take a breath in. When they exhale, they release a flurry of snow that chills whatever it touches.

entry: 有人说，POKENAME身体中那种奇怪的石质材料来自太空。它夜里穿行天空，即使离去很久，数英里外仍能听到轻歌。
author: sk372
source: Some say the strange rocky material comprising some of POKENAME's body came from space. It travels across the skies at night, its soft singing heard for miles even after it has long since left the area.

entry: POKENAME常因华贵毛皮被偷走，训练家便开始剃掉腹毛，降低吸引力。也常给它买衣服，帮助保暖。
author: beetlething
source: POKENAME are frequently stolen for their luxurious fur, so Trainers have begun to shave POKENAME's stomachs to make them less desirable. Trainers will frequently buy POKENAME clothing to help them stay warm.

entry: POKENAME的毛柔软极了，摸一摸就能让人开心。若发现谁情绪低落，它便不断亲昵地蹭过去，直到对方好受些。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's fur is extremely soft and can make anyone feel happy just by touching it. If it finds someone feeling down, it has a tendency to nuzzle them until they feel better.

entry: POKENAME鳞片虽软，却不宜抚摸，接触会严重刺激皮肤。拍翅的旋律奇妙舒缓，人们录下来助眠。
author: mistymagius
source: Despite how soft POKENAME's scales are, it is recommended not to pet them as they cause severe skin irritation on contact. Its wingbeats create an oddly soothing melody that has been recorded to help people fall asleep.

entry: POKENAME雪酪般的顶部，散发甜甜开心果香。若没引来猎物，就深沉地高声歌唱，立刻催眠对方。
author: .izik
source: The sorbet-like top of POKENAME emits a sweet pistachio scent. If that fails to lure prey, it unleashes a deep bellowing song that puts them to sleep instantly.

entry: POKENAME耳朵精于察觉地下震动，提醒捕食者靠近。但钻进厚泥，听觉便大幅变钝。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's ears are finely tuned to vibrations beneath the ground, alerting it to approaching predators. Digging through thick mud dulls its hearing considerably.

entry: POKENAME唱歌时，用橡胶般身体缠住敌人。等对方睡着，再慢慢拉进地下。
author: .izik
source: While singing, POKENAME's rubbery body coils around foes. As they fall asleep, it slowly pulls them beneath the ground.

entry: POKENAME有时参加宝可梦华丽大赛，训练家会把3颗头的毛染成互补色。表现不好，它就闹别扭躲地下，直到信心恢复。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are sometimes entered into Pokémon contests, their Trainers opting to dye the hair of their three heads in complementary colours. If their performance goes poorly, they sulk underground, hiding until they feel more confident in themselves.

entry: 它的喵叫声各有特色。每只POKENAME的音调、音高与长短，都不尽相同，有时差别还大得惊人。
author: chorb33
source: Its meowing sounds are unique. This is because each POKENAME has its own pitch, height and tone length, which can vary greatly in some cases.

entry: POKENAME能把身体各部位鼓到平常的许多倍。马戏团很欢迎它，孩子们尤其喜欢。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME can puff up each of its body parts to many times their normal size. It is a popular circus attraction and especially popular with children.

entry: POKENAME的须，能感知风中同类歌曲的微弱震动。夜里专注望天等待，再用自己响亮的嗷叫曲调回应。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME whiskers can pick up the faint vibrations of other POKENAME songs on the wind. They look skyward intently at night as they wait for these songs, replying with a loud yowling tune of their own.

entry: POKENAME往肚里吸气，好唱很久。但憋气后，有时忘了放出，缺少新鲜空气，反而头痛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME suck in air into their stomach so that they can sing for long periods of time. When they inhale and hold their breath, sometimes they forget to release the air and give themselves headaches from the lack of fresh air.

entry: POKENAME稍有不顺，就真会气得鼓起来，吸气让蓬松身体膨胀。终于发作，一声震耳尖叫，便吐尽憋住的气。
author: lordjoostmeister
source: Even slight inconveniences cause POKENAME to literally swell with rage, inhaling and expanding its fluffy body. When it finally loses its temper, POKENAME releases all of the breath it was holding in a single deafening shriek.

entry: POKENAME读心，知道对方最爱哪首歌，再试着模仿。这能与敌人共鸣，让对方更亲近，或因此分心。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its mind-reading abilities to sense someone's favorite song, then tries to mimic it. This ability allows it to resonate with its opponents, making them feel more connected or distracted.

entry: 它拿两只麦克风，按心情选其中一只，唱不同类型的歌。战斗时则同时对两只唱，用刺耳反馈产生强劲声波。
author: sk372
source: Wielding two microphones, it sings a different kind of song into either depending on its mood. In battle, it sings into both to cause powerful sound waves from the harsh feedback.

entry: POKENAME为华丽大赛刻苦训练，严守卫生，维护华贵毛皮。优雅、杂技般的武术，也独具一格。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME train relentlessly for Pokémon contests and follow strict hygiene to maintain their luxurious fur. Their elegant, acrobatic martial arts are in a class all their own.

entry: POKENAME能膨胀，想显得多壮大都行。没被外表吓到的对象会发现，这并不增强它原本中等的力量。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's inflatable body gives it the ability to appear as large and muscular as it wants. Those not intimidated by the display will find it does nothing to enhance its actual middling level of physical strength.

entry: POKENAME体内有特殊气囊，能储气，在水下数日不换气。上浮时，摇篮曲催眠别人，自己便能安静恢复。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can spend several days underwater without surfacing for air because they have a special sack that stores air within their bodies. When they surface, their lullaby puts others to sleep so they can recover in peace.

entry: POKENAME细毛易沾泥，常用手臂荡树枝，避免触地。它唱着歌，紧紧抱住敌人压制，最终让对方失去意识。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME's fine fur easily picks up dirt, so it often swings from tree branches with its arms to avoid the ground. It tackles foes with crushing hugs while singing, leading the opponent to inevitable unconsciousness.

entry: POKENAME软毛珍贵，每季大量脱落，毛团容易拔下。它去哪都滚，因此换毛季，栖地到处挂着散落毛簇。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is covered in a highly coveted, soft fur that it sheds heavily quarterly, when clumps of fur become easily pluckable. Since it rolls everywhere, its habitat is covered in stray tufts of fur caught on the landscape during these seasons.

entry: POKENAME大多滚动，毛结满泥垢，像铠甲，能抵挡大多直接攻击。剪掉后必须由别人守护，因为身体不习惯没保护。
author: pjporwoll
source: Since it rolls most places, POKENAME's fur has become matted with dirt and grime to the point of being like armor, shrugging off most direct attacks. It must be guarded by others if the fur is shorn since its body is not used to being unprotected.

entry: POKENAME懒懒浮在海岸边。它外表可爱，训练家常找来参加宝可梦华丽大赛。
author: violet_zero
source: POKENAME lazily floats along the beach shores. Because of their adorable looks, they are often sought out by Trainers for their cuteness to participate in Pokémon Contests.

entry: POKENAME一口气能唱数小时。壳内大多中空，留空间储气。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can sing for hours at a time with a single breath. The majority of their shell is hollow to give them space to store air.

entry: POKENAME的3颗头默契齐唱，悲伤摇篮曲和谐得阴森。听见的对象，很快便沉入无梦深眠。
author: .izik
source: All three of POKENAME's heads sing a melancholic lullaby, harmonizing in eerie unison. Those who hear it are quickly lulled into a deep, dreamless sleep.

entry: POKENAME肥胖身体和华贵保暖毛，曾让它遭大量猎杀。如今住在冰冻地区，大多对象不敢随意探索。
author: bobosmith01
source: Its fatty body and luxurious heat-preserving fur caused many POKENAME to once be hunted in large numbers. It lives in freezing areas that most do not dare to freely explore nowadays.

entry: POKENAME周围冒着泡泡、闪闪发光的雾，其实吸入有毒。但毛仍像胖可丁般华贵，因此有人冒险采毛。
author: bobosmith01
source: The bubbly and sparkly mist that surrounds POKENAME's body is actually toxic to inhale. However, its fur is still luxurious, just like Wigglytuff, so some attempt to harvest it despite the danger.

entry: POKENAME身体每一节都软如枕头，常见幼童和宝可梦把头枕在它尾巴上歇着。
author: bradlybro199
source: Each section of POKENAME's body is as soft as a pillow, and due to this, small children and Pokémon are often seen resting their heads on POKENAME's tails.

entry: POKENAME用巨钳夹唱歌时睡着的对象。毛簇一脏，就立即吹水泡，清洁自己。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME pinches anyone who falls asleep during its singing performances with its giant claw. If its tufts of fur get dirty, it immediately produces water bubbles to clean itself.

entry: 地下音乐人常带着POKENAME演出，因为它们的音响，响得超过任何法定音量上限，最高可达180分贝。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME is often used by underground DJs, as their loud boomboxes go beyond any legal decibel limit. They can generate volumes of up to 180 dB.

entry: 地下音乐人常带着POKENAME演出，因为它们的音响，响得超过任何法定音量上限，最高可达180分贝。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME is often used by underground DJs, as their loud boomboxes go beyond any legal decibel limit. They can generate volumes of up to 180 dB.

entry: POKENAME遇敌，通常用毒花粉攻击，或快速滚动逃跑。但最后关头，也能猛烈爆开，喷散花粉。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME usually reacts to foes with either a toxic pollen attack or a rapid rolling escape, but as a last resort, it can explode in a violent burst of pollen.

entry: 夏季，POKENAME骨头般的身体长出花，释放花粉，安抚附近生物。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME sprouts flowers from its bonelike body during summer. The pollen they release has a calming effect on nearby creatures.

entry: POKENAME很小，身体有70%由植物状附肢构成，靠光合作用获取能量。为躲避捕食者，会藏进小裂缝，或死去大型宝可梦的头骨。
author: _pixelar_
source: POKENAME are very small Pokémon, with 70% of their bodies made up of plant-like appendages that they use to photosynthesize and gain energy. As protection from predators, they hide inside small crevices or inside skulls from deceased, larger Pokémon.

entry: 春夏，POKENAME花苞张开，吸更多阳光，也格外有精神。所持植物茎，据说与大葱鸭所用的有相同来历。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME open their bulbs during spring and summer to absorb even more sunlight; thus, they are vastly more energetic during these times as well. The plant stalks they wield are said to be of the same origin as those wielded by Farfetch'd.

entry: 熬过漫长冬季，POKENAME舒展长腿，花苞随之打开。移动时散出花粉，引发剧烈喷嚏、流鼻涕。
author: shyguy11011
source: After winter, POKENAME's bud opens as it stretches its long legs after enduring the long winter. As it moves, it spreads pollen that induces harsh sneezing and runny noses.

entry: 准备蜕变时，POKENAME会闭合花苞，硬化外壳。临近破壳，又会重新张开花苞，吸收能量，完成最后的蜕变。
author: holgast
source: As POKENAME prepare for metamorphosis, they close their buds and harden their shells. Just before they emerge, they open their buds again to absorb energy for the last push.

entry: POKENAME停在海面，让花苞更好吸收照进水面的阳光。花苞每次张开，就放出一个浓稠的墨汁泡泡。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME sticks to the ocean's surface to better let its bud absorb sunlight cascading down onto the water. Whenever its bud opens up, it releases a single thick bubble of ink.

entry: POKENAME单靠光合作用就能活，但进化需要花蜜的能量。它通常不主动攻击，也不排斥人类，却会用毒花粉云，凶狠保护幼崽。
author: lucioleuh
source: POKENAME can survive on photosynthesis alone, but to evolve they need the energy from the nectar of flowers. They usually are passive and do not mind humans, but will aggressively protect their young using clouds of poisonous pollen.

entry: 温暖春日，POKENAME浮在水面，吸收尽可能多的阳光。中央花苞随之打开，露出核心的美丽宝石。
author: sk372
source: On warm spring days, POKENAME will float on the water's surface to absorb as much sunlight as possible into its body. As it does so, the bud in its center opens up to reveal a beautiful jewel in its core.

entry: 天冷时，POKENAME会蜷起来。阳光暖暖照耀，便现身，开心摇摆跳舞。
author: hophoppip
source: It curls up when the weather is cold. When the sun is shining warmly, POKENAME emerges and performs a happy swaying dance.

entry: POKENAME的繁殖地是沼泽，但能消化植物和肉、破开外壳，也能光合作用，因此许多环境都能活。限制领地的，只有温度或竞争。
author: lucioleuh
source: POKENAME's breeding habitats are swamps, but they can live in many environments since they digest plants and meat, break shells, and photosynthesize. The only limiting factors for their territories are temperature or competition.

entry: 它抖毛，花粉便散进空气，能让任何花结果，供自己吃。
author: bandedbodypress
source: When it shakes off its fur, it sends pollen into the air. This pollen can make any flower turn into fruit for it to eat.

entry: POKENAME刚进化，就找平静处伪装，等下一次进化。对进化后的鸟类、虫类宝可梦没什么办法，但能喷刺激花粉，赶走小威胁。
author: lucioleuh
source: As soon as they evolve, POKENAME will seek a calm place where it can camouflage itself until ready to evolve. It can't do much against evolved bird and insect Pokémon, but it can ward off small threats with puffs of irritant pollen.

entry: 春天，POKENAME结束冬眠，盘曲身体上的草叶便能吸收生长所需的太阳能。它弱小温顺，总避冲突，哪怕自己安全受威胁。
author: fiordaliso
source: In the spring, POKENAME emerges from hibernation so that its grassy coils can absorb the solar energy it needs to thrive and grow. It is weak and gentle, which is why it always avoids conflict, even when its own safety is at risk.

entry: 人们普遍相信，POKENAME身上的宝石能控天气，确保阳光够用。环境太冷，叶会变褐，表明不健康。
author: fiordaliso
source: According to popular belief, the gems on POKENAME's body help it control the weather so that it always has enough sunlight to absorb. Living in environments that are too cold causes its leaves to turn brown, a sign that it is unwell.

entry: POKENAME卷住尾巴，留住里面的强效花粉。战斗中一释放，就让附近草属性宝可梦陷入疯狂。
author: bandedbodypress
source: It keeps its tail coiled to contain the powerful pollen within. When POKENAME releases this pollen in battle, it drives nearby Grass types to madness.

entry: 只要太阳露脸，POKENAME就精力充沛。它无忧无虑地飞过花田，兴奋等待尾端花苞开放的那天。
author: pkbonusducks
source: As long as the sun is out, POKENAME will be full of energy. They spend their carefree lives flying through flower fields, excitedly waiting for the day the bud on their tail blooms.

entry: POKENAME在湿地附近生活得很好，吸收周围豆瓣菜的养分。夜里轻轻啼叫，散花粉，帮助附近植物强健。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME thrives near wetlands, where it absorbs nutrients from the watercress growing around it. At night, it hoots softly while spreading its pollen to strengthen nearby plant life.

entry: POKENAME外表很有欺骗性，与普遍看法相反，它其实是小型虫属性宝可梦的天敌。但个头小，自己也常被鸟类宝可梦捕食。
author: lucioleuh
source: POKENAME's appearance is deceptive, as contrary to common belief, it is the natural predator of small Bug-types. Due to its small size, POKENAME is also prey, mainly for bird Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME花心的特殊器官发光，让花朵也亮起来。昆虫成群被光引来，烦得它放电。
author: sk372
source: Special organs in the center of POKENAME's flowers produce light, leading to glowing flower blossoms. Insects are drawn in droves to the light, which leads to an annoyed POKENAME zapping them.

entry: POKENAME晒太阳，耳朵便产生更多电。身体容量有限，晒得过多，就不由自主放火花。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's ears generate more electricity as it soaks in sunlight. Its body can only contain so much, so gathering too much sun causes it to involuntarily release sparks.

entry: 晴天，POKENAME独自或与其他宝可梦绕圈跳舞。温暖夏夜，它不介意待外面；冬季却要进洞避寒。
author: .jerden
source: On sunny days, POKENAME can be seen dancing in circles, either alone or with other Pokémon. They don't mind being outside during warm summer nights, but in winter they will shelter from the cold inside caves.

entry: POKENAME只有喜悦满溢，花苞才张开，甜香也让别人快乐。春天常见它们成群，在花田开心蹦跳。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's bud will only open when its overcome with joy, releasing a sweet scent that also makes others happy. During the springtime, groups of POKENAME can be seen happily bouncing around flower fields.

entry: POKENAME花苞下的茎出奇结实，耐用程度像竹子。它们成簇生长，托起在叶间筑巢的其他宝可梦。
author: .izik
source: The stem beneath POKENAME's bud is surprisingly strong, resembling the durability of bamboo. This Pokémon grows in clusters, supporting other Pokémon that build nests within its leaves.

entry: 日出，POKENAME醒来，一晒就是数小时。冬季，能见成群向太阳方向迁徙。
author: mepp.
source: At sunrise, POKENAME awakens to bask in the sun's glow for hours on end. In the winter months, flocks of the Pokémon can be seen migrating in the direction of the sun.

entry: POKENAME晴天懒躺田野，吸收阳光。枝叶满刺，很难修剪。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME lounges in fields on sunny days to absorb sunlight. It's difficult to trim its foliage, which is laden with thorns.

entry: POKENAME是春日花园的祸害，偷走刚种下的嫩芽，编在毛里。嫩芽清新的草香能护它免遭捕食，但草食者偶尔仍会来啃。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME are a scourge on spring gardens, stealing newly planted buds to weave into their fur. The fresh, grassy bud smell protects POKENAME from predators, though herbivores occasionally nibble on them.

entry: POKENAME种子像小小腰果，营养丰富、能量充足。野生宝可梦常来寻找，但坚硬外壳难以敲开。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's seeds resemble tiny cashews, packed with energy-rich nutrients. Wild Pokémon often seek them out, but its tough outer shell makes them difficult to crack open.

entry: 若见POKENAME在瀑布嬉水，是生态健康的有力信号，因为它对环境变化极敏感。保育者会根据目击情况，评估再野化与生态修复的成效。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: The presence of POKENAME splashing in waterfalls is a strong sign of a healthy ecosystem, as they are highly sensitive to environmental changes. Conservationists use their sightings to gauge the success of rewilding and restoration efforts.

entry: 若见POKENAME在瀑布嬉水，是生态健康的有力信号，因为它对环境变化极敏感。保育者会根据目击情况，评估再野化与生态修复的成效。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: The presence of POKENAME splashing in waterfalls is a strong sign of a healthy ecosystem, as they are highly sensitive to environmental changes. Conservationists use their sightings to gauge the success of rewilding and restoration efforts.

entry: 若见POKENAME在瀑布嬉水，是生态健康的有力信号，因为它对环境变化极敏感。保育者会根据目击情况，评估再野化与生态修复的成效。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: The presence of POKENAME splashing in waterfalls is a strong sign of a healthy ecosystem, as they are highly sensitive to environmental changes. Conservationists use their sightings to gauge the success of rewilding and restoration efforts.

entry: 头冠其实是两条始终紧夹的藤蔓。花粉里的毒，使吸入者更聪明，却得付出身体畸形的代价。
author: bandedbodypress
source: The crown on its head is actually two vines that stay clamped shut. The poison in its pollen makes those who breathe it smarter, at the cost of physical deformity.

entry: 宝可梦研究者起初以为POKENAME是神奥原生的妙蛙草地区形态。详细分析花粉和花蜜里的酶后，才发现它是独立物种。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Pokémon researchers initially believed POKENAME to be a regional variant of Ivysaur native to Sinnoh. A detailed analysis of their pollen and the enzymes in their flower's nectar revealed them to be their own distinct species.

entry: POKENAME成群出现，传达奇怪讯息。每次破解，最后都发现只是园艺建议。
author: lucioleuh
source: POKENAME have been spotted in groups, giving strange messages. Each time one of these messages have been deciphered, they turned out to be gardening tips.

entry: POKENAME白天举尾，进行光合作用；夜里埋尾进土，吸收养分。除此之外，很少活动。
author: sk372
source: During the day, POKENAME lifts its tail up to photosynthesize sunlight, and during the night it buries the tail into the dirt to absorb nutrients. It rarely moves to do anything else.

entry: POKENAME用双翼在树间滑翔，看见地面猎物便俯冲。夏季最活跃，冬季则冬眠。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME uses its wings to glide from tree to tree, diving down to attack whenever it spots prey on the ground. It is most active in summer and hibernates in winter.

entry: POKENAME看着巨大、走得慢，却相当灵活。柔软身体能大幅弯曲，卷须可抓住高处、带起其余身体。野外攀树时，有时不小心将树连根拔起。
author: lucioleuh
source: POKENAME are agile despite their imposing size and slow movements. Their soft bodies can bend a lot, and their tendrils can grasp high spots and lift the rest of the body. In the wild, they may uproot trees by accident while climbing on them.

entry: POKENAME只要每天晒够晨光，就很乖。没晒到，便阴沉烦躁，朝所有靠近者恼火地叫。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME behaves well as long as it receives a good dose of morning sunlight each day. If denied its daily sunbeams, it turns surly and squawks grumpily at anything that comes near.

entry: POKENAME与三蜜蜂共生。它保护田野，赶走闯入者；作为回报，三蜜蜂分一些蜂蜜。
author: victor9106
source: POKENAME has a symbiotic relationship with Combee. POKENAME protects the fields from intruders, and in return, Combee shares some of its honey.

entry: POKENAME藏沟洞，用花苞引其他含羞苞，再跳出攻击。它们擅长伪装，也借此结伴旅行，不被发现。
author: fxncy_poland
source: By hiding in ditches and holes, POKENAME use their bud to attract other Budew, only to then jump out and attack them. They are known to be good at camouflage, so POKENAME use this to travel together unnoticed.

entry: 天气较暖的月份，POKENAME会合起花苞，减少活动。等较冷月份回来，花就开放，奔跑时散出雪花般花粉。
author: sk372
source: In the warmer months, POKENAME closes its bud and becomes less active. Once the cooler months return, the flower blooms and spreads a snow-like pollen as it scurries around.

entry: POKENAME伏低草地，尾巴举过草尖晒太阳。尾端花苞里有松散种子，它快速摇尾，警告快踩到自己的对象。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME lie low in meadows, keeping their tails raised above the top of the grass to receive sunlight. The bud at the tip of their tail has loose seeds within, and they shake it rapidly to warn those close to stepping on them.

entry: POKENAME花瓣散发清凉桉树香，安抚附近对象。它随风优雅摇摆，向空中释放令人平静的孢子。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's petals exude a cooling eucalyptus aroma that soothes those nearby. It sways gracefully in the wind, releasing calming spores into the air.

entry: POKENAME长出藤蔓，连起双角，接通体内电路，让全身笼罩电流。战斗时再长出嫩芽，扩大电流能及的范围。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME create vines to connect their horns together, completing the circuit in their bodies and encasing themselves in electricity. They grow sprouts from their bodies to extend the range of their electricity during battle.

entry: POKENAME叶片略有烟味，像燃烧木炭。受威胁时，花瓣喷火星，吓退袭击者。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's leaves release a faint smoky scent, resembling burning charcoal. When threatened, it emits embers from its petals to deter attackers.

entry: POKENAME光靠日光、泥土也能维生，但产奶需要吃草。奶很甜，略像花蜜，可一天最多一杯，因此不常被作牲畜饲养。
author: lucioleuh
