source: POKENAME can subsist on sunlight and dirt alone; however, they need to graze to produce milk. Their milk is very sweet and somewhat reminiscent of nectar, but since they produce at most a glass of it per day, they aren't widespread as livestock.

entry: 电流穿过POKENAME耳朵，会产生甜香。平时轻淡宜人，雷雨时却可能在不通风处越积越浓，难以忍受。
author: lucioleuh
source: When an electrical current passes through POKENAME's ears, a sweet aroma is produced. Although usually discreet and pleasant, it may become unbearable during thunderstorms as the smell builds up in unventilated areas.

entry: POKENAME比外表看起来结实得多，爱坐在崖缝里，安全地慢慢长大。
author: ayutac
source: POKENAME is very sturdy besides its appearance. It likes to sit in cracks of cliffs, where it can slowly grow in safety.

entry: POKENAME把奇迹种子安全藏在腹袋，每天小心用阳光滋养。它天性温柔，总尽可能避战。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME keeps a Miracle Seed tucked safely in the pouch on its belly, carefully nourishing it each day with sunlight. A gentle soul by nature, it avoids fighting whenever possible.

entry: POKENAME把橙橙果安全藏在腹袋，每天小心用阳光滋养。它天性温柔，总尽可能避战。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME keeps an Oran Berry tucked safely in the pouch on its belly, carefully nourishing it each day with sunlight. A gentle soul by nature, it avoids fighting whenever possible.

entry: POKENAME吸够阳光，便散发舒缓香气。若有谁想碰，它会用轻柔电流，试着赶走。
author: fiordaliso
source: When it absorbs enough sunlight, it releases a fragrant aroma with soothing properties. If someone tries to touch it, POKENAME attempts to ward them off with gentle electric discharges.

entry: 秋季，POKENAME合起花苞，缩进金属壳，电击所有触碰者。只有春天，才探出、打开。
author: .jerden
source: In autumn, POKENAME will close its bud and retract it inside its metal shell, using electricity to shock anyone who touches it. It will only emerge and open up in spring.

entry: POKENAME用尾巴吊枝，绿色身躯藏进叶间。冬季躲在常绿树里，用翅膀紧紧裹住自己保暖。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME hangs from branches by its tail, using its green coloration to disguise itself among the leaves. In winter, it will shelter in evergreen trees and tightly wrap its wings around itself for warmth.

entry: POKENAME平静悠闲，在林间空地活得很好。蓬松尾巴常沾花粉和孢子，因此连很远的花草，也能借它繁殖。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is a calm and relaxed Pokémon that thrives in the clearings of a forest. Its fluffy tail often collects pollen and spores, allowing it to fertilize even faraway flowers and other flora.

entry: POKENAME快乐或兴奋时，头上花苞常开，尾巴上的却很少。多数人说后者一生只开一次，开花条件仍不清楚。
author: sk372
source: Although the bud on POKENAME's head blooms regularly when joyful or excited, it is much rarer for the one on its tail to do so. Most say it only does so once in POKENAME's lifetime, and the criteria for it to happen are still unknown.

entry: POKENAME张开花苞，会散许多易燃孢子，被逼急就可能点燃。吸收阳光就够了，不需进食；喝水时停河边，把喙浸进水里。
author: infinex21
source: When POKENAME open their buds, they scatter many flammable spores, which they may ignite if they feel cornered. They do not need to eat, as they absorb sunlight. To drink water, they perch beside a river and dip their beaks into the water.

entry: POKENAME只有水分充足，花苞才开，泡进够深的水或泥就行。红色鳍散发泥土香，蓝色鳍则带有水的气味。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME only open their buds when they are exposed to plenty of moisture; lying in deep enough water or mud fits the requirements. They emit earthy scents from their red fins, and from their blue fins, they emit the scent of water.

entry: POKENAME爱在雨天玩水洼。春天将近，颊上花苞便开放，花粉飘进空气。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME enjoy playing in puddles on rainy days. The buds on their cheeks begin to bloom when spring is near, releasing pollen into the air.

entry: POKENAME大多在沼泽，通常没入水中。春天从头上散花粉，帮助周围植物生长。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME spend most of their time in swamps, usually submerged underwater. During the spring, they release pollen from their heads, helping the plant life around them grow.

entry: 冬季，POKENAME成群挤在一起。遇险先散花粉，再瞬间移动到安全处。
author: mepp.
source: Groups of POKENAME are seen huddling together when winter comes. When faced with danger, POKENAME scatter pollen before teleporting away to safety.

entry: POKENAME收集别人积极的情绪，刺激生长。周围若满是负面情绪，它可能生病。
author: cobalt0135
source: POKENAME gathers the positive emotions of others to stimulate its growth. If surrounded by emotional negativity, it may become sick.

entry: POKENAME温柔可亲，清晨最活跃。晒太阳后，头上花苞张开，花便向周围释放阵阵舒缓的精神能量。
author: sk372
source: A gentle and sweet Pokémon most active in the early morning hours. When the bud on POKENAME's head opens after sunlight exposure, the flower releases pulses of soothing psychic energy all around it.

entry: POKENAME茎里渗出乳白、有毒的汁液，质地像乳草汁。草食者想吃，嘴便会发麻。
author: .izik
source: The sap seeping from POKENAME's stem has a milky, toxic consistency similar to milkweed. Herbivores that attempt to eat it experience numbness in their mouths.

entry: POKENAME会潜入住家，藏在花盆里。它改变体色，伪装成花草，沐浴阳光。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME will infiltrate homes, hiding themselves in flower pots. By changing their colors, they will disguise themselves as plants or flowers, basking in the sun.

entry: 它喜欢潮湿土壤，常花数小时啃开花树木的树皮，毛也沾上花粉。有些林间道路两侧，留着它们未完工的水坝和正在发芽的脚印。
author: jaminmcready
source: It prefers damp soil and spends hours gnawing bark from flowering trees, staining its fur with pollen. Some forest paths are lined with their half-finished dams and sprouting footprints.

entry: 头上花束有108朵不同的花。香气能安抚任何狂暴宝可梦，久闻还可能让性情永久温和。
author: bandedbodypress
source: The bouquet on its head has 108 different flowers. The aroma can calm any rampaging Pokémon, and long-term exposure can make them mellow out permanently.

entry: POKENAME成群抱在肥土里，抵御寒潮。若其他宝可梦想吃它，就弹出地面、用颚咬住，从袭击者吸取养分。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME cuddle as a group in rich soil to protect each other from a cold snap. If another Pokémon tries to feed on it, POKENAME springs from the ground and latches on with its jaw, absorbing nutrients from the attacker.

entry: POKENAME成群抱在肥土里，抵御寒潮。若其他宝可梦想吃它，就弹出地面、用颚咬住，从袭击者吸取养分。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME cuddle as a group in rich soil to protect each other from a cold snap. If another Pokémon tries to feed on it, POKENAME springs from the ground and latches on with its jaw, absorbing nutrients from the attacker.

entry: POKENAME大花苞里藏着强大得可怕的颚，内里颜色鲜艳。张开时看似花朵，轻松引来猎物，随即整只吞下。
author: infinex21
source: The large buds of POKENAME conceal frighteningly powerful jaws with vividly colored insides. The bright colors of their jaws allow them to appear as flowers when opened, easily luring in prey that is quickly swallowed whole.

entry: POKENAME对温度和光极敏感，只在温暖而黑暗的夜晚现身。空洞眼窝连最坚强的人也能吓哭。
author: soup1900
source: Extremely sensitive to temperature and light, POKENAME only shows up on warm, dark nights. Its empty eye sockets frighten even the toughest of people and make them cry.

entry: POKENAME随和温柔，喜欢在洁净河流、溪水旁悠闲晒太阳。连高度污染的空气也能吸收，光合作用后释放成吨新鲜氧气。
author: bobosmith01
source: Easygoing and gentle, POKENAME prefers a relaxed life basking in the sun by clean rivers and streams. It is able to take even highly polluted air and photosynthesize to release tons of fresh oxygen.

entry: POKENAME偏爱潮湿丛林，不停散发薰香般气味。它虽爱湿环境，却讨厌雨，毛毛雨也要躲。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME has a preferred habitat of humid jungles. It constantly emits a scent similar to incense. Despite liking damp environments, it dislikes the rain and will take shelter even when it drizzles.

entry: 它天生见植物就想浇水，甚至不理训练家，跑去浇花。建立牢不可破的羁绊后，头上花苞便开始绽放。
author: bobosmith01
source: It has an innate urge to water whatever plant it sees. It will even ignore its Trainer to run off to water flowers. When it forms an unbreakable bond, the bud at the top of its head starts to bloom.

entry: POKENAME性情温和而坚定，植物状鳍尖的味道也一样：特色鲜明，却不过分浓烈。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME has a mild but stalwart personality. This extends to the taste of the tips of its plant-like flippers: distinct, but not overpowering.

entry: POKENAME受威胁，从草般毛里释放花粉，使敌人产生幻觉、迷失方向，足够让自己逃走。
author: mepp.
source: When threatened, POKENAME releases pollen from its grassy fur. This pollen causes foes to hallucinate, disorienting them long enough for POKENAME to escape.

entry: 早晨，POKENAME沐浴明亮阳光。吸够后，头上花苞就绽成鲜艳花朵，散发令人愉悦的能量，改善附近对象的心情。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME basks in bright sunlight in the mornings. When it absorbs enough of the sun's rays, the buds on its head bloom into brightly-colored flowers that radiate a pleasant energy, improving the moods of those nearby.

entry: 春夏，这些宝可梦的两个大花苞开放，释放彩色、令人平静的花粉，人与宝可梦常使用。冬天合起花苞，更好抵挡严寒。
author: infinex21
source: During spring and summer, the two large buds of these Pokémon open and release colorful, soothing pollen used by many Pokémon and humans. During winter, they seal their buds to better endure the intense cold.

entry: POKENAME的体形，使它需要大量纯净的水和清洁空气，才能茁壮生存。物种已稀少，城市化仍不断威胁家园，科学家十分忧心。
author: mepp.
source: Due to POKENAME's size, they need vast amounts of pure water and clean air to thrive. The species are already rare, leaving many scientists fearful as urbanization continues to threaten their habitats.

entry: POKENAME很少被看见，虽追寻阳光，却常去难抵达的树顶、崖侧。若其他宝可梦一起玩，可能被引出来加入。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME are rarely seen, as while they seek out sunlight, they usually do this in inaccessible locations at the tops of trees or on the sides of cliffs. If other Pokémon are playing together, they may be lured out of hiding to join them.

entry: POKENAME很受爱植物的人欢迎。它靠阳光、清水为食，略带甜香，还能指出日照最好的地方。不过不太爱玩，主要以向训练家微笑表达亲昵。
author: lucioleuh
source: POKENAME is a popular pet choice among plant lovers. It feeds on sunlight and fresh water, has a discreet sweet smell, and shows the spots with the best sunlight. However, it isn't very playful and mainly shows affection by smiling at its Trainer.

entry: POKENAME用两条藤蔓吊在树枝下，发光身体照亮周围。维持光亮需要大量能量，因此摸着很热。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME hang underneath tree branches using their twin vines, illuminating the area with their glowing bodies. Their bodies are hot to the touch due to the amount of energy needed to keep them glowing.

entry: POKENAME极其害羞，总躲进阴暗的灌木或花田下。它需要阳光才能好好成长，若能勇敢些，本可长得更快。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME is extremely shy and hides in shady undergrowth or under flower fields. If it were braver, it could develop more quickly, as it needs sunlight to thrive.

entry: POKENAME深钻花园，在根间睡，让人们提供生长所需的水和养分。养分足够后，它就钻出地面进化，头上的花苞也随之绽放。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME burrow deep beneath gardens to sleep among roots, letting people provide all the water and nutrients they need to grow. Once a POKENAME is properly nourished, the bud on its head will bloom as it tunnels up out of the ground to evolve.

entry: POKENAME对情绪变化极敏感。待在悲伤者身边，会哭好几小时，因此喜欢有快乐人群的地方，如主题公园花槽或儿童公园。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME is highly sensitive to changes in emotions. Being around sad people will make it cry for hours, so it tends to stay in places with happy people, such as theme park planters or children's parks.

entry: POKENAME睡觉时，头上花苞半开，释放细雾般浓密的催眠花粉。醒来，花苞完全打开，改放香气，不再放催眠花粉。
author: infinex21
source: When POKENAME are asleep, the buds upon their heads remain partly open and release soporific pollen as thick as a fine mist. When they awaken, their buds open the rest of the way and release an aromatic scent rather than soporific pollen.

entry: 夏日，POKENAME慢慢游荡，晒暖太阳。夜间、冬季却加快行动，保持温暖。
author: .jerden
source: On summer days, POKENAME will wander around slowly, basking in the warm sunlight. At night and in winter, POKENAME will move more rapidly to keep itself warm.

entry: POKENAME得到充足水分和阳光，体形便不断长大，直到进化。
author: theartemis1
source: When exposed to an abundance of water and sunlight, POKENAME will continuously grow in size until evolution.

entry: 阳光为POKENAME发电供能。它大半天打盹、吸光，必要时却能以惊人高速冲入战斗。
author: hophoppip
source: Sunlight fuels POKENAME's electricity generation. It spends most of the day napping and absorbing light, but it can charge into battle with blinding speed if necessary.

entry: POKENAME住在湖边，水越干净，前钳传电越多。春天将近，它用钳子刺激新植物生长。
author: notadoctor75
source: POKENAME make their habitat near lakes; those that live near cleaner water are able to channel more electricity through their front claws. Whenever spring draws near, it will use its claws to stimulate the growth of new plants.

entry: 花苞张开，就散发强烈金属味，驱退大多捕食者。冬季，它合起花苞躲在地下，以矿物和能找到的水维生。
author: infinex21
source: When its bud is open, it exudes a powerful, metallic odor that deters most would-be predators. During winter, it keeps its bud shut and takes shelter underground, feeding on minerals and whatever water it can find.

entry: POKENAME大多埋在温暖软沙里睡，吸沙漠热量供能。脸边叶片像虎钳，谁想碰，就猛然合拢。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME spends most of its time sleeping, buried in soft, warm sand, drawing energy from the desert heat. The leaves surrounding its face act like a vice, snapping shut if anyone tries to touch it.

entry: POKENAME用背上尖锐的吸管附在树干上，吸取养分。树皮有机质为体内小锅炉供能。科学家仍争论，它不停转动有何生理用途。
author: dylonk25
source: POKENAME can be found leeching off tree trunks via a sharp siphon on its back, with the organic matter of the bark fueling small boilers within POKENAME. Scientists still debate the biological purpose of POKENAME's ceaseless turning.

entry: POKENAME的舒缓香气，吸引各种生物。若引来威胁，就释放令人迷失方向的花粉，分散捕食者注意。
author: dodoowner_
source: The soothing aroma that emanates from POKENAME attracts all types of creatures. If the scent happens to attract a threat, POKENAME releases disorienting pollen, which distracts predators.

entry: POKENAME虽然友好，穿行森林家园却必须小心。燃烧的尾巴只要蹭到树，就可能引发森林大火。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: Although POKENAME is a very friendly fusion, it must be careful navigating amongst the forests it lives in. One brush of its flaming tail against a tree could cause a forest fire.

entry: POKENAME比未融合的含羞苞长得快得多。融合的特殊作用，使它随年龄长额外花苞。吸收大量土中养分，也让它带泥土香。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME grow and develop far faster than unfused Budew, a quirk of the fusion process causing them to grow extra flower buds as they age. They have an earthy scent to them from all the nutrients they absorb from the soil.

entry: POKENAME比未融合的含羞苞长得快得多。融合的特殊作用，使它随年龄长额外花苞。吸收大量土中养分，也让它带泥土香。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME grow and develop far faster than unfused Budew, a quirk of the fusion process causing them to grow extra flower buds as they age. They have an earthy scent to them from all the nutrients they absorb from the soil.

entry: POKENAME比未融合的含羞苞长得快得多。融合的特殊作用，使它随年龄长额外花苞。吸收大量土中养分，也让它带泥土香。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME grow and develop far faster than unfused Budew, a quirk of the fusion process causing them to grow extra flower buds as they age. They have an earthy scent to them from all the nutrients they absorb from the soil.

entry: POKENAME对环境极敏感，花苞很少全开。哪怕老练园艺师，想成功养到开花，也是细致、苛刻的任务。
author: brilliantdarkness
source: Incredibly sensitive to environmental conditions, the buds on POKENAME rarely fully flower. Successfully coaxing one to bloom is a delicate and demanding task, even for seasoned horticulturists.

entry: 它身后大荚一爆开，花粉便散开，帮助植物生长。但花粉对人有毒，吸入可能刺激喉咙。
author: periperi_chicken
source: When the big pod behind it pops, pollen spreads around. This helps plants grow, but it is poisonous to humans and can irritate the throat if inhaled.

entry: 它吸收附近土壤中的金属与矿物，融入皮肤和尖刺。冬天越近，身体越沉、行动越慢，最终重得无法移动，便进入休眠。
author: staghorn
source: It absorbs metals and minerals from nearby soil, incorporating them into its skin and spines. It becomes heavier and slower as winter approaches, eventually going dormant once it becomes too heavy to move.

entry: 冬季，POKENAME合起花苞，初春再开。兴奋时自身热量能增至2倍，却不会影响花苞。
author: lydiaprower8
source: In winter, POKENAME closes its bud, and reopens it at the beginning of spring. The bud is unaffected by POKENAME's own body heat, which can double when excited.

entry: 冬季，POKENAME合起花苞，初春再开。花苞不受本体热量影响，哪怕兴奋时体热增至2倍。
author: lydiaprower8
source: In winter, POKENAME closes its bud and reopens it at the beginning of spring. The bud is unaffected by POKENAME's own body heat, which can double when excited.

entry: POKENAME在洞里发现黄玉簇，就放一团绿粉守护。粉末效力极强，闻一下就能使人入睡。
author: .izik
source: Should POKENAME locate a cluster of topaz in a cave, it releases a puff of green powder to defend it. This powder is extremely potent, as a single whiff can cause someone to fall asleep.

entry: POKENAME叶上覆着霜般细粉，略有冷杉香。它在严寒环境活得很好，冰冷汁液能防止冻结。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's leaves are coated in a fine, frost-like dust that smells faintly of fir trees. It thrives in cold environments, where its icy sap protects it from freezing.

entry: POKENAME光合作用供能，因此爱晴天。它练踢、练舞，想有朝一日为同伴助威。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME gains energy through photosynthesis, so it loves sunny days. It practices kicks and dances so it can one day cheer on its allies.

entry: 孩子若在花田死去，有机会变成POKENAME。它们珍爱晴天，整天浮在花间。
author: periperi_chicken
source: If a child dies in a flowery field, they have a chance to become a POKENAME. They cherish sunny days and spend their days floating through flowers.

entry: 愉悦香水的防腐成分，只能从POKENAME唾液提取。在愉悦香水中有效，混进兴奋香水或心动香水，却没有明显效果。
author: jaminmcready
source: The preservative chemical used in Joy Scent can only be extracted from the saliva of a POKENAME. While effective in Joy Scent, it has no noticeable effect when combined with Excite Scent or Vivid Scent.

entry: POKENAME释放宜人的油桃香，安抚敌人。若失败，花苞便发低音，也能帮助对方平静。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME calms foes by releasing a delightful nectarine scent. Should this fail, it emits a low tone from its buds that also helps to soothe the target.

entry: 愉悦香水的防腐成分，只能从POKENAME唾液提取。在愉悦香水中有效，混进兴奋香水或心动香水，却没有明显效果。
author: jaminmcready
source: The preservative chemical used in Joy Scent can only be extracted from the saliva of a POKENAME. While effective in Joy Scent, it has no noticeable effect when combined with Excite Scent or Vivid Scent.

entry: POKENAME由无数种子构成。水太多，就长微小花苞，释放樱子果香。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body is composed of countless seeds. When exposed to too much water, tiny buds sprout from it, releasing a Cheri Berry scent.

entry: POKENAME很稀有，夜里照顾在森林熟睡的对象。露营者常说，此前根本不知道它存在，却在梦里见到了它。
author: lucioleuh
source: POKENAME is a very rare Pokémon that can be spotted at night, caring for those sleeping in forests. Campers regularly report seeing a POKENAME in a dream despite not knowing it existed before.

entry: POKENAME寄生植物根，吸取树液，供花苞生长。族群庞大，会影响当地植物，因此环境机构会监测它们。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME parasitise plant roots, drinking their sap to fuel the growth of their flower buds. Large populations of POKENAME can cause issues for local plant populations and their presence is monitored by environmental agencies.

entry: POKENAME用前肢上的硬叶，在松软土壤里挖洞安家。它偏爱开阔田野，让花苞一整天晒太阳。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses the hard leaves on its front limbs to dig into soft soil, creating holes for itself to reside in. It favors open fields, letting its bud bask in the sunlight for all hours of the day.

entry: POKENAME找洞内仍有阳光的地方，进行光合作用。吸阳光时，头上的花苞张开，露出眩目宝石。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME finds spots within caverns that still have access to sunlight to photosynthesize. When it gathers sunbeams, the bud on its head opens up to reveal a dazzling gemstone within.

entry: 野生POKENAME像家长，会用棍子指挥幼小宝可梦跟随。受威胁便展开花苞，释放会引起炎症的粉末。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME act as parental figures in the wild, using their stick to command baby Pokémon to follow them. If threatened, they will open their bud, releasing a powder that causes inflammation.

entry: POKENAME喜欢用头撞和自己对上眼的对象。接触头部，就喷花粉，令人剧烈打喷嚏、咳嗽。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME likes to headbutt anything it makes eye contact with. Upon contact with POKENAME's head, pollen will burst out, inducing harsh sneezing and coughing.

entry: POKENAME皮肤分泌极易燃的油，主要在尾尖，维持常燃火焰。战斗时，能从头上花苞将油喷向敌人。
author: lucioleuh
source: The skin of POKENAME excretes a highly flammable oil, mainly at the tip of the tail, where a flame is kept lit at all times. During battle, it can shoot said oil to its foes from the bud on its head.

entry: 春天，POKENAME在近海面游泳，吸收阳光。皮肤也因此带上可可香。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME swims near the sea's surface during spring to absorb sunlight. This causes its skin to take on a cocoa-like scent.

entry: 夏季，POKENAME悠闲晒太阳，用草叶般的毛吸光，整天待一处也行。它怕冷，天气凉便找掩蔽，常想钻进人家。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME lounge in the sunlight during the summer, able to spend entire days in one place as they absorb sunlight through their leafy fur. They are sensitive to cold and seek shelter as the weather cools, often trying to get into people's houses.

entry: POKENAME双臂抱住头上花苞，挠痒很困难。花苞又没开，因此头痛时也没什么办法。
author: quackquackattack
source: The arms of POKENAME are wrapped around the bulb on their head, which makes scratching itches difficult. Since the bulb on their head has yet to bloom, they have few remedies for the headaches they experience.

entry: POKENAME不停寻找阳光草地。季节转冷、冬日将近，群体就跑过大地，迁往暖处。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME constantly seek out sunny meadows to bask in. When the seasons turn cold and winter starts drawing in, packs of them race across the landscape to head to warmer climates.

entry: POKENAME早晨晒足阳光，身心振奋。头脑发挥到极致时，携带的植物和头上的花朵会同时开放。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME soaks up plenty of morning sunlight, which energizes its mind and body. The plant it carries and the flower on its head both bloom simultaneously when its mind is operating at max ability.

entry: POKENAME像紧合的玫瑰，藏在灌木装普通花。触手蜿蜒着从花瓣间伸出，取食附近的虫属性宝可梦、腐烂植物等养分来源。
author: vic1312
source: Resembling a tight rose, POKENAME hide themselves in bushes, disguised as a mundane flower. Their tentacles snake out from within their petals to snack on nearby sources of nutrients, such as Bug-type Pokémon and rotting plant matter.

entry: 它们潜在芦苇水下，尾巴却竖在一束束香茅旁，采集者有时因此意外割断尾巴。
author: quackquackattack
source: When they are submerged below the surface in the reeds, their tails stick up against bundles of lemongrass. This occasionally leads gatherers to sever their tail without meaning to do so.

entry: POKENAME天性胆小，稍有风吹草动就逃。若被困，便升空，疯狂飞离危险。
author: .izik
source: Naturally timid, POKENAME flees at the slightest notice. If trapped, it launches into the air, flying frantically to escape danger.

entry: 阳光明亮，POKENAME便打开、抬高尾巴，吸收日光。作为活体植物，它耐寒得出乎意料。
author: hophoppip
source: When the sun is bright, POKENAME opens and raises its tail to absorb the sunlight. It's surprisingly cold-tolerant for a living plant.

entry: POKENAME长着代替鳍的宽大叶片，用来吸收阳光。完全满足时，头上的花苞便会开放。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME has broad leaves in place of fins to help it soak up the sun's light. When it feels completely content, the bud on its head opens up.

entry: POKENAME喷一团催眠花粉，让敌人入迷。有时自己也吸进去，反而打起喷嚏。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME entrances its foes with a puff of sleep-inducing pollen. It sometimes inhales the pollen and makes itself sneeze.

entry: POKENAME用熏香安抚其他宝可梦。待对方平静，就打开花苞，把愉快的情绪吸进去。
author: ayner
source: POKENAME uses the aroma of their incense to calm other Pokémon. Once this is done, they open their bud and absorb their positive emotions with it.

entry: POKENAME受威胁，会摇动手上的花苞，喷出阵阵使人发痒的花粉。它偏爱阳光充足、水质洁净的地方。
author: mepp.
source: When POKENAME feels threatened, it shakes the buds on its hand to release puffs of itchy pollen. It prefers to live in areas with plenty of sun and clean water.

entry: POKENAME核心周围簇着各种花束，从红玫瑰到紫色锦葵都有。花束天生散甜香，因此它会避开虫群繁多的林区。
author: quackquackattack
source: Various bouquets of flowers, from red roses to violet mallow, are collected together around the central core of a POKENAME. It avoids bug-infested areas of the forest, as they produce a naturally sweet scent.

entry: POKENAME用手上花香，引宝可梦靠近自己、远离珍爱的花园，再从花里伸出骨质刺鞭，缠住闯入者，甩到远处。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses sweet scents from the flowers on its hands to lure Pokémon closer to it, away from its precious gardens. Then it extends bony, thorny whips from the flowers to wrap around the intruders and fling them away.

entry: POKENAME战败，就得赠非惯用手的一片花瓣，表示敬意。只有能透过花瓣看见手，才会被视作长者。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: If bested in battle, POKENAME must gift a petal from their non-dominant hand as a sign of respect. They are only considered elders once their hand is visible through the petals.

entry: POKENAME不停散发浓烈、宜人花香。芳疗师认为有许多健康益处，包括帮助放松、安睡。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME constantly exudes a strong, but pleasant smelling floral aroma. Aromatherapists cite its numerous health benefits, including promoting relaxing and restful sleep.

entry: POKENAME触手软如卷心菜，掰断时却像黄瓜一样脆。再生很快，是稳定食物来源，也是出乎意料美味的零食。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME's tentacles are as flimsy as cabbage but snap like cucumbers. They regrow quickly, making it both a reliable food source and a surprisingly tasty snack.

entry: POKENAME轻飘过花田，翼上散出闪光粉末，保护花朵免遭害虫。园丁因此珍视它这天然帮手。
author: fiordaliso
source: As POKENAME drifts gently over flower fields, it scatters a shimmering powder from its wings. This dust protects blossoms from pests, making the Pokémon highly valued by gardeners as a natural helper.

entry: POKENAME性格鲜活、花瓣多彩，导演常选来主演，让观众惊叹。唯一毛病是虚荣，认为会显得无趣的工作，它就不做。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are often chosen to cast in lead roles by theater directors to amaze audiences with their vibrant personality and colorful petals. Their only vice is their vanity, as they refuse to do work that they believe make them look boring.

entry: POKENAME用花香，将毫无戒备的猎物引近藏身灌木。等对方松懈，就用带刺的角猛烈攻击，结束捕猎。
author: fiordaliso
source: Thanks to the scent emitted by its flowers, POKENAME lures unsuspecting prey close to the bushes where it hides. When they let their guard down, it strikes them with a powerful blow from its spiked horns, ending the hunt.

entry: 它从翅膀撒出花粉，干扰敌人。受到善良训练家照料的POKENAME，双翼色彩更鲜艳，香气也更芬芳。
author: kittyluv090
source: It distracts enemies by scattering pollen from its wings. The wings of POKENAME who are raised by kind Trainers are more vibrant and aromatic.

entry: POKENAME的玫瑰花藏有毒刺，许多新手园丁因此被送进急诊室。
author: atlas3339098
source: POKENAME's rose hides a toxic spike. Many novice gardeners are sent to the emergency room by this Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME在养分充足的泉水里度过许多日子后，身体和花朵都长得很大。它借庞大体形吓退凶暴宝可梦，但会避开战斗。
author: mary_the_jane
source: POKENAME has spent many days in rich springwater to grow its massive body and flowers. It uses its hulking size to scare off violent Pokémon, but it avoids battling.

entry: POKENAME终生只忠于一位训练家，用花、香气鼓励对方，提供情绪支持。据说接近进化，花瓣会变色。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: POKENAME are strictly loyal to a single Trainer throughout their lifetime, using their flowers and fragrances to cheer up and provide emotional support. It is said that their petals change color when close to evolution.

entry: POKENAME边飞边掉花瓣，留下一路鲜艳色彩。花瓣数月留香，因此在芳香疗法中很受欢迎。
author: oddwalls
source: POKENAME sheds its petals as it flies, leaving a trail of brilliant color. The petals are popular in aromatherapy because they retain their scent for months.

entry: POKENAME背上烈火旋成玫瑰花瓣般图案。晒很多太阳，火就更亮；每次喝水，火焰还会产生蒸汽。
author: .jerden
source: The roaring flames on POKENAME's back constantly swirl in a pattern like rose petals. They glow brighter if POKENAME spends lots of time in the sun and produce steam whenever it drinks water.

entry: POKENAME裹着粗厚的藤蔓，便于伪装，躲避天敌。虽然满是尖刺，刺却不锋利，可以放心触摸。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's body is wrapped in thick vines that help it camouflage from predators. Despite being covered in thorns, they are not very sharp and are safe to touch.

entry: POKENAME的白玫瑰象征爱与高洁，常受精英训练家饲养。它们竭力保护弱小的宝可梦，尤其是异性。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's white roses are symbols of love and nobility and are commonly owned by elite Trainers. They go out of their way to defend weaker Pokémon, especially ones of the opposite gender.

entry: 它身后的花，含有气味强烈的花粉，吸引许多虫类宝可梦。受惊时，花一下全开，撒出无数棉孢子，自己便快步跑走。
author: infinex21
source: The flower upon this Pokémon's rear contains a strong-smelling pollen that attracts many bug Pokémon. When startled, its flower will fully pop open and scatter countless Cotton Spores before it skitters away.

entry: 满月夜，POKENAME把花完全打开。甜香引来同类，大家便跳上一整夜。
author: lampent12
source: On nights of the full moon, POKENAME will open their flowers in full. The sweet aroma they release draws in other POKENAME and they dance the night away.

entry: 春天，POKENAME灌木般的枝叶会开出美丽玫瑰。修剪、养护它，需要十分用心。
author: hophoppip
source: In the spring, beautiful roses bloom from POKENAME's shrubby foliage. Trimming and maintaining a POKENAME requires much attention.

entry: POKENAME柔软花瓣两年才枯，有些枕头公司拿来作极软填料。花瓣的气味清爽而鲜明。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME's soft petals take two years to wilt, so some pillow companies use them as an extra-soft stuffing. The petals have a zesty, vibrant smell.

entry: POKENAME用身上3朵花，在湖岸散播花粉，帮助花生长。它还会从这些花里伸出带刺藤蔓，捕食鱼类宝可梦。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses the three flowers of its body to spread pollen around lakefronts to help flower growth. It uses thorny vines extended from the same flowers to catch fish Pokémon to eat.

entry: POKENAME装花丛避战，野外很有效，人类附近却反而吃亏，因为花太美，常被摘走。
author: stevethebarbarian
source: POKENAME disguises itself as a flower bush to avoid fights. In the wild, that works fine, but when humans are around it backfires; the flowers are so beautiful that they're often picked.

entry: POKENAME飞行时，空气便充满新开鲜花的美妙香气。它略戒备人类，常躲在树篱或开花灌木间，免得被看见。
author: fiordaliso
source: When POKENAME is flying, it fills the air with the wonderful scent of freshly bloomed flowers. It is a bit wary of humans, which is why it usually hides among hedges or flowering bushes to avoid being seen.

entry: POKENAME悠闲随气流滑翔，飘散芳香。雨天便降回地面休息。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME spread a fragrant scent as they leisurely glide on air currents. On rainy days, they drift back to the ground to rest.

entry: POKENAME住花园旁，把泥土里的花偷走，带回洞里种下，用心照料。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME reside near gardens, stealing flowers straight from the dirt and taking them to their burrows. They will plant these flowers there, taking great care of them.

entry: POKENAME开心，花就散强香。善心的人有时养它，想让家里始终好闻。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: When POKENAME is happy, their flowers emit a strong scent. Kind-hearted people sometimes take to looking after them to keep their house smelling pleasant.

entry: 清晨，POKENAME尾上的花散浓甜香。有人相信，一生闻够次数，便会唤醒心中超能力。
author: sk372
source: In the early morning, the flowers on POKENAME's tail emit a strong sweet scent. Some believe that inhaling this aroma enough times in life will awaken psychic powers in one's mind.

entry: POKENAME似乎只在无月夜现身，因此流传它与巫术有牵连。尾上玫瑰的柔光，可能被认成月光，似乎还会催眠别人。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: POKENAME's involvement in witchcraft is a widespread rumor, as it only seems to appear on moonless nights. The soft glow of its rose tail can be confused for moonlight and seems to hypnotize others.

entry: POKENAME以尾上美丽却脆弱的玫瑰闻名。唯有吸收月光，花朵才能保持鲜艳色彩。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME are known for the beautiful but fragile roses on their tails. These blossoms can only maintain their vibrant colors by absorbing the light of the moon.

entry: POKENAME背上花朵的花瓣繁复，香气复杂，取决于花色。开粉红花的个体，散出甜得发腻的香气，吸引嗜甜宝可梦。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME grow elaborately petaled flowers on their backs that give off a complex fragrance dependent on their flower's colouration. Pink flowered POKENAME produce a sickly sweet smell that draw Pokémon with a sweet tooth.

entry: POKENAME完全吃素，主食是花。它常夜里闯花店吃花束，花商因此视它为害兽。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are entirely vegetarian, their diets consisting mostly of flowers. They are considered to be pests by florists, often breaking into flower shops during the night to consume bouquets.

entry: 它的玫瑰略有金属味。受威胁便快速旋转，掀起使人迷失方向的花瓣旋风。
author: cait_sith
source: Its roses have a slightly metallic scent. If threatened, it spins rapidly to create a disorienting whirlwind of petals.

entry: POKENAME的毒爪藏在玫瑰花苞之下。常能见到它们从枝头跃下，用毒刺伏击猎物。
author: mistymagius
source: Underneath the rose buds hide POKENAME's poisonous claws. They can frequently be seen jumping from tree branches, ambushing prey by stabbing them with their toxic thorns.

entry: 这种傲气宝可梦，心里却渴望得到一位用心照顾它的训练家的疼爱。谁喂它美味树果，它就回赠花瓣。
author: ozydamians
source: This snooty Pokémon secretly seeks out the affection of a devoted Trainer. It gifts flower petals to those who feed it delicious berries.

entry: POKENAME壳上长出红宝石、蓝宝石，吸引许多欣赏者。壳有时作花瓶，所含矿物渗入水，帮助插在里面的花生长。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME shells grow studded with rubies and sapphires, drawing many admirers. Their shells are sometimes used as vases, the mineral content of their shells leaching into the water and promoting plant growth for the flowers placed inside them.

entry: 体表的叶片坚韧无比，战斗时能当作铠甲。雄性POKENAME常相互争斗，求取羽毛最美的雌性的青睐。
author: mistymagius
source: The leaves on its body are extremely tough and act as protective armor in battle. Male POKENAME frequently engage in combat to woo the females with the prettiest plumage.

entry: POKENAME见于多雪地区，会自然照料作物和树果，帮助新植株在入冬前开花。它在湿泥打滚降温。
author: bobosmith01
source: Found in places that can get lots of snow, POKENAME naturally takes care of crops and Berries to help new ones bloom before the winter season. It rolls in wet mud to stay cool.

entry: 叶状的双翼锋利如钢，轻易就能斩开树木。但POKENAME十分友善，允许其他宝可梦为脚上的花授粉。
author: mistymagius
source: Its leaf-like wings are as sharp as steel, able to slice through trees with ease. Despite this, POKENAME is very friendly and allows other Pokémon to pollinate the flowers on its feet.

entry: 它练习优雅地突进、旋转，想提升闪避和伏击能力，盼着进化的那天。
author: bobosmith01
source: This Pokémon practices graceful darts and twirls, all in an effort to improve its abilities to dodge and ambush. It longs for the day it evolves.

entry: 它练习优雅地突进、旋转，想提升闪避和伏击能力，盼着进化的那天。
author: bobosmith01
source: This Pokémon practices graceful darts and twirls, all in an effort to improve its abilities to dodge and ambush. It longs for the day it evolves.

entry: POKENAME平时冷静，敌人太靠近巢，便尖锐嘶叫。尾上鲜艳花瓣，被用作传统药物。
author: mepp.
source: Though normally calm, POKENAME sharply hisses at foes that draw too close to its nest. The vibrant petals that bloom on its tail are used in traditional medicines.

entry: POKENAME用身上不同花朵施法。组合精巧花束，便能编织繁复却美丽的诅咒。
author: princessmadelyn
source: POKENAME casts spells with different types of flowers that grow from its body. By creating elaborate bouquets, it can weave elaborate, yet beautiful curses.

entry: POKENAME用电泵吸泉水，再飘着洒给花。自己的花也能补水，金属身体却慢慢生锈。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME will suck up spring water using a pump powered by electricity, then float around to sprinkle it on flowers. While this also keeps the flowers on its own body hydrated, it slowly rusts the metallic parts of its body.

entry: POKENAME鲜艳花纹随心情变色，红代表好斗，蓝代表孤独。春天，情绪起伏更频繁。
author: teatedtiten
source: POKENAME's vibrant patterns can shift hues depending on their mood: reds indicate aggressiveness and blues indicate loneliness. These mood swings are more frequent in the spring.

entry: POKENAME爱恶作剧，吓人取乐。它将臂炮对准训练家，佯装蓄力，结果射出的却是花束。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME is a prankster, finding humor by scaring humans. It aims its arm cannon at Trainers as if charging it up, only to fire a bouquet of flowers instead.

entry: POKENAME滚动，便散一层致敏孢子。钻过的土，日后会长茂盛草木。
author: bobosmith01
source: As it rolls around, it spreads a layer of allergy-inducing spores. The dirt where POKENAME burrows will grow lush flora over time.

entry: POKENAME有点傲，谁太靠近，就用尾上重花猛拍。勉强算安慰的是，挨打后，身上会留几小时宜人花香。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a bit haughty and will harshly smack any that come too close with the heavy flowers on its tail. As a consolation, being struck will leave the victim smelling pleasantly floral for a few hours.

entry: POKENAME用尾巴吊花架，藏在攀援玫瑰间。狩猎越成功，花就开得越鲜艳。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME uses its tail to hang from trellises, camouflaging its body among climbing roses. The more successful it is as a hunter, the brighter its flowers bloom.

entry: POKENAME睡在橡树枝，从花里释放半透明的橙色粉末。谁靠得太近，都会疲惫至极。
author: .izik
source: While sleeping on oak branches, POKENAME releases a translucent orange powder from its flowers. This causes extreme exhaustion in anyone who draws too close.

entry: POKENAME寻找僻静的丛林清泉，很喜欢喝清澈泉水。一旦认领，便正气凛然地奋力守护，好维持美丽花朵。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME seek out isolated jungle springs and delight in drinking the crystal clear water. Once they have claimed a spring, POKENAME will defend it with a righteous fervor to maintain their beautiful blooms.

entry: 它是春季很受欢迎的宝可梦。POKENAME在花田中欢快起舞，散发的香气让训练家不由自主地开心起来。
author: mistymagius
source: A popular Pokémon during the spring season. POKENAME playfully dance around flower fields, emitting a scent that makes Trainers uncontrollably happy.

entry: POKENAME身上的毛发其实是层叠的棘刺，能刺痛打扰者。它虽随和，却会毫不犹豫用强壮双腿、尖利脚爪接连踢敌。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: The hairs on POKENAME's body are actually layers of thorns that hurt anyone who bothers this Pokémon. While easygoing in nature, POKENAME will not hesitate to strike an opponent with several kicks from its sturdy legs and sharp talons.

entry: POKENAME是花田保护者，优雅巡视领域，照看每朵花的生长。若花受威胁，愤怒的一脚，就能踢飞对方。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: Known as protectors of flower fields, POKENAME gracefully wander through their area, monitoring the growth of each flower. If something is threatening the flowers, one kick from an angry POKENAME will send that threat flying.

entry: POKENAME的玫瑰香因个体而异，受饮食、环境影响。身体和尾巴浸水后，香气总会混上新雨气息。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME roses emit scents that differ between individuals; diet and environment influence these scents. When they submerge their bodies and tails in water, the scents from their roses consistently are mixed with the odor of fresh rain.

entry: POKENAME头上的花需要特殊照料，才能保持健康。若不经常往脸上抹泥，花很快就会枯萎。
author: sk372
source: The flowers on POKENAME's head require a unique type of care to stay healthy. If POKENAME does not regularly apply mud to its face, the flowers will begin to wilt in short order.

entry: POKENAME周围有积极情绪，头上的花便散出宜人香气。若满是负面情绪，花中就伸出带刺长鞭，抽向情绪来源。
author: sk372
source: The flowers on POKENAME's head emit a pleasant aroma when in the presence of positive emotions. If negative emotions surround it, the flowers extend out thorny whips to lash at the source of these terrible feelings.

entry: POKENAME以头上花朵的多种香气受到喜爱，香味随自身情绪而变。
author: cobalt0135
source: POKENAME are beloved for the variety of scents produced by the flowers on their head. The scent changes with their emotions.

entry: POKENAME被积极情绪包围，手上花朵就会美丽绽放。它整天在阳光草地放松。
author: mepp.
source: The flowers on POKENAME's hands bloom beautifully when it is surrounded by positive emotions. It spends its day relaxing in sunny meadows.

entry: POKENAME善良，能感知别人情绪。谁悲伤，就温柔送美丽花朵，改善心情。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME is known for its benevolent nature and ability to sense the emotions of others. To those experiencing sadness, it kindly offers beautiful flowers to improve their mood.

entry: 它从两朵花散出芳香花粉，使附近植物逐渐变色，但变化不会永久持续。身体能随意变色，自己的花却永不变色。
author: infinex21
source: From its two flowers, it scatters an aromatic pollen that can cause the colors of nearby vegetation to gradually change; the color change is never permanent. It can change its bodily colors at will, though its flowers never change color.

entry: POKENAME花中伸出有黏性的长鞭，固定被它偷偷接近的猎物。舌头上的棘刺释放毒素，确保落网目标逃不出成为一餐的命运。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's flowers extend out sticky whips to help immobilize prey it sneaks up on. Its tongue is covered with thorns that release a toxin that ensures its target won't escape becoming its meal once ensnared.

entry: POKENAME大半时间都在梳理自己，啃掉毛里长出的尖刺。若觉得玫瑰不够美，就采其他花装饰自己。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME spends most of the time grooming itself, chewing off the sharp thorns that grow in its fur. If it thinks its roses aren't pretty enough, it will collect other flowers to decorate itself with.

entry: POKENAME深受舞台魔术师喜爱，能从任意物件中突然钻出，让观众惊叹。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME are favored by stage magicians. It can pop out through any object and audience members are amazed.

entry: POKENAME背上花朵的花瓣繁复，香气复杂，取决于花色。开蓝花的个体散淡淡土香，仿佛雨后湿土气息。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME grow elaborately petaled flowers on their backs that give off a complex fragrance dependent on their flower's colouration. Blue flowered POKENAME produce a subtle earthy smell that is reminiscent of petrichor.

entry: POKENAME背上花朵的花瓣繁复，香气复杂，取决于花色。极少情况下，会长出多朵，香气像一整束花。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME grow elaborately petaled flowers on their backs that give off a complex fragrance dependent on their flower's colouration. Rarely, POKENAME sprout multiple of these flowers, their scent that of an entire bouquet.

entry: POKENAME以大玫瑰为傲，备受草属性爱好者俱乐部追捧。花粉被用于高档玫瑰香水。
author: opossiblymage
source: A POKENAME is very proud of its large roses. It is coveted in Grass-type fan clubs. Its pollen is used in high-end, rose-scented perfumes.

entry: POKENAME头上玫瑰美丽，鲜艳花瓣下，却藏着含有毒汁的刺。每朵花的毒液都不一样。
author: _._starry_._
source: The roses on POKENAME's head are beautiful, but underneath the vibrant petals are hidden thorns filled with poison-laced sap. The venom on each flower is unique and different from the other.

entry: POKENAME玫瑰产蜜，通常让传粉者安心吸食。饿时，会从陷阱大嘴分泌效果更强的蜜，咬住好奇宝可梦，吃饱才停。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME produces nectar from its roses and usually allows pollinators to safely sip from the flowers. When it is hungry, POKENAME will produce more potent nectar from the trap mouth, which snaps up inquisitive Pokémon until full.

entry: POKENAME挥动6朵美丽花朵，诱来虫属性宝可梦作猎物。它喝干净泉水，让花散出诱人香气。
author: pizzarcato
source: POKENAME lure in their prey of Bug-type Pokémon by waving their six beautiful flowers. They drink clean springwater to give these flowers their enticing aroma.

entry: POKENAME用花形双手慢慢走，靠泉水和阳光滋养。若被误当容易到手的猎物，它就用头上尖刺猛攻，力道令人吃惊。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME slowly walks around using its flower-shaped hands, nourished by springwater and sunlight. If any Pokémon mistake it for easy prey, POKENAME will surprise them with the force with which it jabs using the thorns on its head.

entry: POKENAME身上玫瑰，要精心照料才能茁壮。只有吃最优质的土壤、喝最新鲜的水，植物才不枯萎褪色。
author: sk372
source: The roses on POKENAME's body require a high degree of care to thrive properly. Only consuming the highest quality soil and freshest water will keep the plants from wilting and losing color.

entry: 对饲养开花宝可梦的人而言，POKENAME也算高难挑战。背上开花灌木极娇贵，需要精心照料，才会开花并保持鲜艳花色。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is considered a high-level challenge for owners of floral Pokémon. The flower bushes on its back are very finicky and require a high level of care to bloom and retain their vibrant coloration.

entry: POKENAME背上树有蜂蜜香，引虫属性宝可梦来。可一尝树液，苦得它们大失所望。
author: .izik
source: The tree growing from POKENAME's back smells of honey. This attracts Bug-type Pokémon, only for them to be disappointed when they taste its very bitter sap.

entry: POKENAME能攀陡崖，那里长着藤花。它向过路游客提议，用一朵花换些东西。严冬睡在喜爱植物的茎周围，以体热防止植物死去。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: Able to climb sheer cliffs where vine flowers grow, POKENAME offers to trade a flower for something with tourists passing through. POKENAME's body heat helps prevent its favorite plants from dying during harsh winters by sleeping around the stem.

entry: 遇险，臂上的花展开花瓣，尾焰强烈燃烧，让自己显得更吓人。原本宜人的香味，也变得浓烈、发酸。
author: bobosmith01
source: When in danger, the flowers on its arms spread their petals and the flame on its tail radiates intensely all in order to make it seem more threatening. In addition, its normally pleasant scent turns sour and strong.

entry: POKENAME花蜜用于制作香气大胆、带挑衅感的香水。使用者可能更难亲近、更固执，观点被质疑，也更不愿退让。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME nectar is used in the production of perfumes with a bold, challenging scent to them. The scent of the perfumes can cause those wearing it to become more standoffish and stubborn, and less likely to give ground when challenged on their ideas.

entry: POKENAME全身的刺能伤人，也能治愈，取决于被刺者内心有多纯洁。因此得了“温柔之刺宝可梦”的绰号。
author: deniablecredibility
source: The thorns that cover POKENAME have the remarkable ability to both harm and heal depending on how pure-hearted the one being pricked is. This has earned it the nickname "The Tender Thorn Pokémon".

entry: POKENAME以舒缓香气闻名，身体却对污染极敏感。有些研究者认为，野外数量可能受威胁。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME are renowned for the relaxing fragrances they exude. Their bodies are extremely sensitive to pollution, so some researchers believe their numbers in the wild are at risk.

entry: POKENAME住山坡天然泉水旁。人们为美花甜香寻找它，但一被它发现，就会迁往更偏远处。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME live near natural springs on the sides of mountains. People seek it out for its beautiful flowers and sweet fragrance, but if POKENAME notices them, it will relocate itself to somewhere even more remote.

entry: POKENAME臂端花束散诱人香气，让想攻击的敌人放松。对方虚弱后，便掷出剃刀般锋利的花瓣。
author: santon5512
source: The bouquets at the ends of POKENAME's arms emit an alluring scent, lulling any opponent who tries to attack them. Once debilitated, they will fling razor-sharp petals at them.

entry: POKENAME从头、尾释放舒缓香气，制伏敌人，再用满是棘刺的拳头攻击。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME releases soothing scents from its head and tail to subdue enemies. It then attacks with its thorn covered fists.

entry: POKENAME是园丁好友，既滋养周围植物，也驱赶害虫。满月夜散特殊花粉，加速附近植物生长。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are great friends of gardeners because they both nourish plants around them and ward off pests. During nights of the full moon, they spread a special pollen that accelerates the growth of plants around them.

entry: POKENAME头顶双色花，因内部火焰闪动而发光。它常徘徊花园，吸走路人的生命力。
author: chibitales
source: The bicolored flower atop POKENAME's head glows due to a flame flickering inside. It loiters in flower gardens, leeching the life force of passersby.

entry: 泥偶巨人据说是古代守护者，而POKENAME温柔得多。它虽平和，作为大型魔像，一拳却强得很。
author: bottomusmaximus3
source: As Golurk were rumored to have been ancient protectors, POKENAME are much more gentle. Though peaceful, these large golems pack a powerful punch.

entry: 组成尾巴的玫瑰散发着诱人的香味。可得当心！一旦靠得太近，POKENAME就能从花里喷出猛烈的火焰！
author: chorb33
source: The roses that form its tail emit a tantalizing scent. But watch out! If anyone gets too close to them, POKENAME can emit devastating flames from the flowers!

entry: POKENAME外表美、气味舒缓，令人想靠近。但人或宝可梦太近，臂上的头就会咬，用口腔顶端暗藏的毒刺扎入受害者。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME's beautiful appearance and soothing scent make it tempting to approach. If a person or Pokémon gets too close, the heads on its arms will bite, piercing the victim with venom-laced thorns hidden on the roof of their mouths.

entry: 尾巴上的花很耐热，能将太阳能转化为烈火，保护自己。接触POKENAME虽然有危险，仍有许多训练家喜爱它。
author: chorb33
source: The flowers that form its tail are heat-resistant. In these, it converts solar energy into hot fire to protect itself. Although POKENAME is not harmless to handle, it is very popular with many Trainers.

entry: POKENAME将花状身体部位蹭洞壁，让刺藤长满地道。刺似乎不影响同类，对其他路过者却相当危险。
author: .izik
source: By rubbing the flower-like portions of its body against its tunnel walls, POKENAME causes thorny vines to grow throughout. While these thorns do not seem to bother its kin, they prove quite dangerous to anyone else passing through.

entry: 这种慵懒的宝可梦常在大片森林里闲躺，慢慢啃花。POKENAME颈边的花散发舒缓的香气，仿佛玫瑰与松木混在一起。
author: mistymagius
source: These lazy Pokémon can be seen lounging around large forests, slowly gnawing on flowers. The flower on POKENAME's neck releases a relaxing scent that smells like a mixture of roses and pinewood.

entry: POKENAME花朵的美妙香气，能使附近对象平静、满足，因此被制成香水。首次约会的人，常会使用这种香气。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME's flowers give off a wonderful fragrance that can make those around it calm and content. Because of this, it is turned into a perfume. The scent is often worn by those about to go on their first date.

entry: 谁碰到POKENAME撒出的花粉，它就能感知谁的情绪，即使远在几英里之外，也一样。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME can detect the emotions of anything that touches the pollen it scatters, even from miles away.

entry: POKENAME身上的花需要充足水分，它便滚过热带海洋，保持湿润。
author: .izik
source: The flowers growing on POKENAME's body require considerable hydration. It rolls across tropical seas to keep them sufficiently wet.

entry: POKENAME喝新鲜泉水，会长鲜艳美丽的花。据说踩过的地方，比没踩过的更肥沃。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME grow vibrant, lovely blooms when they drink fresh springwater. The places they step are said to be more fertile than the places they don't.

entry: 尾巴上的花很耐热，能将太阳能转化为烈火，保护自己。接触POKENAME虽然有危险，仍有许多训练家喜爱它。
author: chorb33
source: The flowers that form its tail are heat-resistant. In these, it converts solar energy into hot fire to protect itself. Although POKENAME is not harmless to handle, it is very popular with many Trainers.

entry: POKENAME不直接饮水，而通过花吸水，因此雨天常见。水吸得越多，花朵的金属气味就越强，尤其刚吃过营养丰富的矿物时。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME absorb water through their flowers rather than drink water, and they are often seen during rain. Their flowers exude metallic odors that strengthen with water absorption, especially when they have recently fed on rich minerals.

entry: POKENAME旋转，便释放玫瑰香。香气虽宜人，却表示它准备攻击一切靠得太近的生物。
author: .izik
source: As POKENAME spins, it releases a rose-like scent. While pleasant, this aroma signals that it is ready to strike any creature that gets too close.

entry: POKENAME常沿途留火，新手很难照料。它用火烧去枯死树果树，让新树长得更强健。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: POKENAME are often considered difficult for first time Trainers, as they often leave a trail of flames behind them. They utilize their flames to burn down dead berry trees to grow back stronger trees.

entry: POKENAME鲜艳玫瑰吸引传粉者，后者也可能回报保护。这种共生很有用，因为它个头小、容易受伤害。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's vibrant roses are attractive to pollinators, which may protect POKENAME in return. This symbiosis is very helpful, as POKENAME's small size makes it vulnerable.

entry: POKENAME随季节，从花中释放醉人浓香，冬季最淡。摇花散出的有害花粉，谁碰上都会过敏，却不会致命。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME exude intoxicatingly powerful scents from their flowers depending on the seasons; in winter, their scents are at their weakest. When they shake their flowers, they scatter noxious pollen that induces non-lethal allergic reactions in anyone.

entry: POKENAME混在公园池边的花里。喝够水，便升空，将麻痹花粉撒向能找到的孩子，再拖上天空。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME blends in with other flowers around park ponds. When it has drunk enough water, it will rise up to the skies and spread its paralysing pollen over any child it can find before dragging them off to the skies.

entry: POKENAME开心时，耳上的花苞会散发怡人的香味，常被用于香水。可毛发里藏着利刺，抱起来并不舒服。
author: mistymagius
source: When POKENAME is happy, the buds on its ears release a pleasant scent often used in perfumes. Its fur coat hides sharp thorns that make it unpleasant to hug.

entry: 很久以前，POKENAME游过小镇，边跳舞边播种。镇民留一些种子，作护身符、首饰。
author: big_clanker
source: Far in the past, POKENAME would travel through small towns spreading seeds and dancing. The townsfolk would keep some of the seeds as good luck charms and jewelry.

entry: 它们成群附在树木与灌丛上，缓缓转动，产生能量。受威胁时，便将能量集中到玫瑰花苞中，射出强劲的激光。
author: mistymagius
source: Groups of these Pokémon can be seen attached to trees and bushes, slowly spinning to produce energy. When threatened, they concentrate this energy in their rose buds to unleash a powerful laser.

entry: POKENAME乘微风漂游，沿途洒落彩色的花瓣。人们常将其收集起来，相信攒得够多，就能获得永恒的爱情。
author: mistymagius
source: As POKENAME drifts along the breeze, it drops colorful flower petals. People often collect these petals, believing that gathering enough brings eternal love.

entry: POKENAME猎食其他草属性宝可梦，吸取它们维生的汁液，恢复鲜艳花瓣的生机。它以甜香引猎物，再用强超声波扰乱对方。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME hunts down other Grass-type Pokémon to drain their vital sap and revitalize the petals of its colorful flowers. It lures prey in with the sweet scent its body gives off, then disorients them with powerful ultrasonic waves.

entry: POKENAME视力差，用獠牙翻土，找新鲜土和根滋养自己。吃饱后，花散好闻、安抚的香气。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has poor vision, and uses its tusks to root around the ground for fresh soil and roots to nourish itself. A well-fed POKENAME emits a pleasant and calming aroma from its flowers.

entry: POKENAME背上花朵，其实是大簇羽毛。春季气味极强，靠近太久，会头晕。
author: .izik
source: The flowers growing from POKENAME's back are actually large tufts of feathers. Their scent is incredibly strong during springtime, causing dizziness in those who linger too close.

entry: POKENAME飞行时，双翼会散播效力很强的花粉，帮助花朵生长。容易过敏的人，最好远离POKENAME大量聚集的地方。
author: mistymagius
source: As POKENAME flies, its wings spread a strong pollen that helps flowers grow. People with allergies should stay away from areas where large groups of POKENAME can be found.

entry: 花园若疏于照料，可能就会被POKENAME占据。它的“眼睛”伪装成花朵，引诱猎物靠近。
author: staghorn
source: If you don't take good care of your garden, it may become infested with POKENAME. Its "eyes" mimic flowers in order to lure in potential prey.

entry: 花店常用POKENAME帮忙。但它若不喜欢插花搭配，就会吃掉整束花。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME is commonly used by florists. If it doesn't like an arrangement, it will eat the entire bouquet.

entry: POKENAME始终静止不动，以免损伤身上娇嫩的花。角上带着剧毒，触碰就可能致命。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is always stationary to avoid damaging the delicate flowers on its body. Its horns are laced with a strong poison that can be deadly when touched.

entry: POKENAME极护背上花。谁想骑，就会被刺扎。
author: bandedbodypress
source: It is highly defensive of the flower on its back. If anyone attempts to ride it, POKENAME will prick them with thorns.

entry: POKENAME冲过密林，从尾上盛开的花苞散花粉。它借沿途花粉，诱使虫属性宝可梦进入丛林深处的埋伏。
author: eiskitsune
source: POKENAME charges through dense vegetation, scattering pollen from the blooming buds on its tail. It uses this trail of pollen to lure Bug-type Pokémon into ambushes deep within the jungle.

entry: 晴天，常能看见成群的POKENAME一边睡觉，一边吸收太阳的能量。POKENAME越健康，花香就越甜美。
author: mistymagius
source: Groups of POKENAME can be seen sleeping on sunny days to draw energy from the sun. The healthier POKENAME is, the sweeter the scent from its flowers becomes.

entry: POKENAME跳复杂草裙舞，身上散玫瑰花瓣。岛上村落曾在春季庆典请来它们，盼带来好运。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME scatters rose petals from its body as it performs a complex hula-style dance. Island villages have employed them during springtime festivals to bring good fortune.

entry: POKENAME用美丽舞蹈、舒缓香气，邀别人共舞。它常飘过开花草地，想创造极致的舞蹈体验。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: POKENAME uses its beautiful dancing and calming fragrances to encourage others to dance with it. It is usually found drifting through flowering meadows, trying to create the ultimate dance experience.

entry: POKENAME定期在垃圾堆散特殊种子，促进植物生长。来过不久，许多填埋场就会长满花。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME regularly scatters special seeds throughout dumps to encourage plant growth. Many landfills become overgrown with flowers in a short period after one pays a visit.

entry: POKENAME通常爱和平，独自在草木丰富的水域生活。但谁在它面前乱碰植物，就会遭玫瑰鳍伸出的刺藤凶狠攻击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is generally pacifistic, keeping to itself in water areas with lots of flora nearby. Messing with plants in its presence will cause it to viciously attack with thorn-covered vines from its rose fins, however.

entry: POKENAME在林深处呜咽，引成人靠近。太近，就从花里喷剧毒花粉，先击昏，再吸走生命力。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME whimpers deep in forests to draw adults close. When they venture too near, it bursts a highly toxic pollen from its flowers to knock them out before draining their life force.

entry: 据说，迷失的灵魂会在心怀恶意的毒蔷薇体内扎根，最终长成POKENAME。它们惊吓迷路的林中人，为自然遭受的破坏寻求报复。
author: altius
source: It is said that lost spirits take root within malevolent Roselia until they grow into POKENAME. These creatures scare people lost in the woods, seeking revenge for the destruction of nature.

entry: 情侣约会会选购POKENAME，代替小小花束，毕竟宝可梦能在身边留得更久。有人说，园丁能从它的健康状况，看出两人感情好不好。
author: quackquackattack
source: Lovers will opt to buy a POKENAME instead of a Small Bouquet for dates, as a Pokémon lasts much longer. Some people say that gardeners can tell how well a relationship is based on how healthy their POKENAME is.

entry: 微风天，POKENAME头上的花会奏悦耳口哨乐。觉得没人听，就提高到刺耳音量，强迫注意。
author: .izik
source: The flowers on POKENAME's head produce pleasant whistling music on breezy days. If it feels like people are not listening, it amplifies the sound to a piercing level to force their attention.

entry: POKENAME翅膀太弱，几乎无法飞行。受威胁时便会拼命振翅，撒出花中带刺激性的花粉。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's weak wings make it almost impossible for it to fly. When threatened, it will frantically flap its wings, spreading the irritating pollen from its flowers.

entry: POKENAME遇见任何花，都会饥渴地吸食香甜花蜜，补充能量。不断采蜜，让花粉大量积在身上，奇怪地拖慢身体运动机能。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME hungrily absorbs the sweet, succulent nectar from any flower it comes across for energy. This constant raiding of flowers causes lots of pollen to collect on its body, which has a strange effect of slowing down its motor functions.

entry: 每年春天，POKENAME头上铲子长出美丽紫玫瑰。它有药用性质，药剂师常磨碎，制成外敷药泥。
author: .izik
source: A beautiful violet rose grows from the shovel on POKENAME's head each spring. This rose carries medicinal qualities and is regularly ground into a poultice by apothecaries.

entry: POKENAME的花有许多鲜艳颜色。它常结群旅行，路人因此能看见丰富花色。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME's flowers can come in many different, vibrant colors. They often travel in groups, allowing passersby to notice the variety.

entry: POKENAME尾上花随时辰变色。日落至午夜，蓝色花变红、红色花变蓝；日出至正午，颜色再恢复如初。
author: bobosmith01
source: The flowers on POKENAME's tail shift in color depending on the time of day. From sunset 'til midnight, the blue flower turns red and vice versa; from sunrise 'til noon, the colors return to their original shades.

entry: POKENAME身上真菌的子实体，带有花香。煎炒后能为菜肴添独特风味，深受厨师喜爱。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The fruiting bodies of the fungus growing from POKENAME have a floral fragrance. They give a unique flavour to meals when sauteed and are popular amongst many chefs.

entry: POKENAME把极热花瓣散在森林领地。一触地便燃烧，几乎瞬间就烧尽。灰烬能为附近草木提供关键养分。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME scatters extremely hot petals around its forest territory. These petals burst into flame the moment they touch the ground; they burn out almost instantly. Their ashes are known for providing vital nutrients to nearby flora.

entry: 初春，POKENAME从幼树轻取新枝，用精神能量维持生机。它用选中的魔杖占卜清水源，畅饮，也让花朵补水。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME will gently remove a new growth branch from a sapling in the early spring, utilizing their psychic energy to sustain the young twig. They use their chosen wand to divine sources of fresh water, drinking deeply and hydrating their blooms.

entry: POKENAME在草地里培育隐秘玫瑰园，用喉咙运新鲜泉水，保持土湿。花丛持续开放，它只采最优质玫瑰，制作围巾。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME cultivate hidden rose gardens within meadows, transporting fresh springwater within their throats to keep the soil they tend moist. They keep their bushes in consistent bloom, harvesting only the highest quality roses for their scarves.

entry: POKENAME背上灌木的叶软，令人想靠近。青绵鸟、波波会歇在上面，事后常送球果致谢。
author: .izik
source: The bush growing from POKENAME's back has soft, inviting leaves. Swablu and Pidgey rest in it, often gifting Apricorns in gratitude afterward.

entry: POKENAME身上多彩的玫瑰状突起，其实是坚硬岩石。它蓄力准备以强大日光束自卫时，突起就会明亮发光。
author: mepp.
source: The colorful rose-like protrusions on POKENAME's body are actually solid rock. They glow brightly right as POKENAME charges powerful Solar Beams to defend itself.

entry: POKENAME求偶时，长出大藤缠住竞争者。藤上带刺，还会排出浓稠毒液。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME grows large vines from its body to ensnare competitors during courtship rituals. These vines are lined with thorny portions and expel a thick venom.

entry: POKENAME住健康土壤，花最美。挖地时，花合拢成苞，暂当铲子，帮助钻土。
author: pizzarcato
source: POKENAME living in healthy soil display the most beautiful flowers. While digging, their blossoms close, and they use the buds as makeshift shovels to help with their burrowing.

entry: 高档植物园常养POKENAME，它巡花坛，找偷吃珍贵植物的宝可梦。发现植物被吃，就用带刺的爪子攻击肇事者。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are often kept within high-end botanic gardens, prowling through flowerbeds in search of Pokémon trying to feed on the expensive plants. If they find a plant being eaten, they swipe at the offending Pokémon with their thorny paws.

entry: 高档植物园常养POKENAME，在门口亲昵地蹭脸迎宾。它留下气味标记，颈边一圈花朵，让客人身上留宜人花香。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are often kept within high-end botanic gardens, greeting guests at the entrance with an affectionate cheek rub. Their scent lingers on those they mark, their ruff of flowers imparting a pleasant floral fragrance.

entry: POKENAME手上花不断掉花瓣。头痛时，就把脸埋进花中，让自己平静。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME constantly release petals from the flowers on their hands. Whenever they experience a headache, they put their face into their flowers to calm themselves down.

entry: POKENAME奔跑，沿途散落花瓣。婚礼策划者开始在庆典请它，让新人跟着，沿花路走向婚礼圣坛。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME leave a scattered trail of petals behind them as they run. Wedding planners have begun to make use of them during celebrations, encouraging the betrothed to follow POKENAME's lead as it creates a floral trail to the altar.

entry: POKENAME头上的刺越大，毒性就越强。花园中常能见到成群的POKENAME，以小型虫属性宝可梦为食。
author: mistymagius
source: The larger the thorns on POKENAME's head, the more powerful its poison it produces. Groups of POKENAME can be seen in flower gardens, feeding on small bug Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME姿态美丽，常在花田中欢快奔跃。奇怪的是，身上的火焰烧不伤其他植物。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is a thing of beauty and can be seen playfully galloping around flower fields. The flames on its body curiously cannot burn other plant life.

entry: POKENAME常住清澈、缓流的河边。它定期将尾上花浸水，让花恢复、保持最旺盛活力。
author: ocxin
source: POKENAME is often found next to clear yet slow-moving rivers. They regularly dip the blossoms on their tail into the water to refresh them and ensure their maximum vitality.

entry: POKENAME的花是强力磁铁，刺能放电。它以磁力吸附楼外的金属管，再用刺穿孔取水。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's flowers are both powerful magnets and its thorn can deliver an electrical shock. It will magnetically attach itself to metal pipes on the outside of buildings, then pierce it with its thorn to extract water.

entry: POKENAME极害羞，两颗头都藏在脸周围的玫瑰花瓣里。它能产迷人香气，用来蒸馏高档香水。
author: fiordaliso
source: Because it is extremely shy, POKENAME keeps both of its heads hidden within the beautiful rose petals that surround its faces. It can produce an irresistible fragrance used to distill high-end perfumes.

entry: POKENAME睡时，把花束尾巴卷过头，装花丛。被骗、想穿过去的宝可梦，会被花上毒刺扎得动弹不得。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME curls its bouquet tail over its head when it sleeps, making it appear like a flower bush. Pokémon who fall for this facade and try to run through POKENAME become frozen in place from the poisonous thorns the flowers had.

entry: POKENAME炮管里的花含强毒，射出后立刻再生。训练家接触它，最好穿戴防护装备。
author: ambrosia04
source: The flowers within a POKENAME's cannons contain a potent toxin and immediately regrow after getting launched out. Trainers are recommended to wear protective gear when handling this Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME在森林下钻地，覆满花朵的身体节段将泥土翻成肥沃苗床。村民说，它走过的路径上，似乎总会长出茂盛花园。
author: jaminmcready
source: As POKENAME tunnels beneath forests, its flower-covered segments churn the soil into fertile beds. Villagers say lush gardens always seem to sprout over the paths it's traveled.

entry: POKENAME用长鼻喷出催眠花粉，等对方睡着，再从手上的玫瑰伸出藤蔓，把对方压住，吞食梦境。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME blows a sleep-inducing pollen from its trunk-like nose at others. Once they slumber, it holds them down with vines from its rose hands and consumes their dreams.

entry: POKENAME自然掉落的花瓣，数百年来都被用作助眠品。一杯花瓣茶，便能让饮用者连续睡足8小时。
author: lydiaprower8
source: Petals that naturally fall off POKENAME have been used as a sleep aid for centuries. A cup of tea made with these petals makes the consumer sleep for a whole 8 hours straight.

entry: POKENAME自然掉落的花瓣，数百年来都被用作助眠品。一杯花瓣茶，便能让饮用者连续睡足8小时。
author: lydiaprower8
source: Petals that naturally fall off POKENAME have been used as a sleep aid for centuries. A cup of tea made with these petals makes the consumer sleep for a whole eight hours straight.

entry: POKENAME滚来滚去，寻找潮湿环境。若在水池里看见，训练家要小心别踩进去，免得触电。
author: .jerden
source: It rolls its body around, seeking damp environments. If POKENAME is spotted in a pool of water, Trainers should be careful not to step in, as they may receive an electric shock.

entry: POKENAME吃电越多，就越不稳定。每次爆开，声音都像可怕的哀号。
author: .jerden
source: The more electricity POKENAME feeds on, the more volatile it becomes. Whenever it bursts, the explosion sounds like a terrible wailing.

entry: POKENAME常与电工一起，帮他们够到高处的电线。孩子们常把它误当气球，这时它会帮孩子找到父母。
author: agostostino
source: POKENAME is often seen with electricians, as it helps them reach electrical wires in high places. POKENAME is often mistaken for a balloon by kids. When they are, POKENAME will help them find their parents.

entry: POKENAME在云间飘，轻轻哭，想引起孩子注意，再试着将他们带走。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME drifts through clouds while crying softly. The sound is meant to draw the attention of children, whom it then attempts to carry away.

entry: POKENAME满怀成为世界冠军的斗志，并将这份决心，都用来当最棒的气球商。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: POKENAME has a spirit that yearns to be a world champion. It has taken this determination and put it towards being the best balloon seller there is.

entry: POKENAME从橡胶般皮肤放出的恶心气体，有时会发出滑稽声。传言，它体内气体由恶毒之人的灵魂组成。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Sometimes the nauseating gases it emits from its rubbery skin make a humorous sound. Rumours suggest that POKENAME's internal gases are made up of the souls of toxic people.

entry: POKENAME排出的气体，被认为是人类灵魂的精华。传说它四处漂游，寻找灵魂，维持漂浮。
author: foolish_weasel
source: The gas POKENAME emits is thought to be the spiritual essence of people. Legends say that POKENAME drifts around in search of souls to keep it afloat.

entry: POKENAME的壳密度比空气还低，却坚硬无比。准备离蛹而出时，就会猛烈爆开，留下令人震惊的残局。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME's shell is incredibly hard despite it being less dense than air. When this Pokémon is ready to hatch from its pod, it will violently burst apart, leaving a shocking aftermath.

entry: POKENAME随浓海雾出现，身体标记透雾发光，曾被倒霉船只误当灯塔。尽管当地有传说，这行为并不被认为是有意为之。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME appear alongside dense sea fog. The mark on their body glows through the fog and has been mistaken for a lighthouse by some unfortunate ships. Despite local folktales, this behavior is not believed to be intentional.

entry: POKENAME游过空中，试图带走小孩。但力气可怜、身体又轻，根本办不到；连新生儿抓住它的胡须，也能轻易把它甩来甩去。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME swims through the air attempting to carry away small children. However, its pitiful strength and light body make it impossible; even a newborn could throw it around with ease after gripping its whiskers.

entry: 野生POKENAME从不在一处久留。据说每只体内都有多个灵魂，为了决定该进化成什么，彼此争吵不休。
author: .jerden
source: Wild POKENAME never remain in one place for long. It is said that their bodies each contain multiple spirits, and that these spirits squabble amongst themselves to decide what POKENAME should evolve into.

entry: POKENAME揉捏身下的云，激发能量，让云向地面放雷。揉得越黑，随后的雷暴就越猛烈。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME kneads the cloud beneath it to stimulate energy and cause it to cast lightning bolts at the ground beneath it. The darker the cloud turns as it kneads, the more violent the lightning storm that follows.

entry: POKENAME常被误当垃圾，见人或宝可梦想捡起自己，就喷出短促气流逃走。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME is frequently mistaken for trash and flees from people and Pokémon who want to pick it up. It releases quick bursts of air to make its escape.

entry: POKENAME像飘飘球一样，爱把孩子带走。可它是带孩子去儿童免餐费的餐厅，骗来免费的饭，喂饱自己。
author: llamawiz34
source: Just like Drifloon, POKENAME likes to take children away. It carries them to kids-eat-free restaurants to trick them into giving it free food.

entry: 尾端的囊可以充气，胀到身体的好几倍。即使事态严重，它还是爱用这个囊四处弹跳。
author: bostroms
source: The sac on the end of its tail is inflatable and can expand to several times the size of its body.  Even in serious situations, it loves using its sac to bounce everywhere.

entry: POKENAME懒懒浮在河流上方，寻找绿毛虫等猎物。一发现，就用细线般的肢体缠住，拖回巢。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME floats lazily above rivers, scanning for prey like Caterpie. Once it spots one, it wraps its thread-like limbs around it and drags it away to its nest.

entry: POKENAME趁其他宝可梦睡着，溜进巢里，蜷在蛋旁。温暖、橡胶般的身体，能让蛋发育得更快。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME sneaks into the nests of other Pokémon, curling up next to their eggs while they sleep. Its warm, rubbery body helps the eggs mature faster.

entry: 据说POKENAME会出现在悲伤的孩子面前，顽皮地用细线般的尾巴缠住他们。这份友善，让为儿童表演的小丑和其他艺人很喜欢它。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME is said to appear to sad children, playfully wrapping itself on them with its string-like tail. This friendly attitude makes it a popular Pokémon for clowns and other entertainers who perform for children.

entry: POKENAME追逐雷云，吸收雷电，逐渐消去风暴。它安定人心的存在，令坏天气缓和，也让周围的大家精神振奋。
author: ilija09
source: POKENAME is known to chase storm clouds, absorbing their lightning to slowly siphon away the storm. Its calming presence turns harsh weather into gentle skies, lifting the spirits of those nearby.

entry: POKENAME漂过小溪，排出浓雾，融入雾中。感到危险，就猛喷水流，推远威胁。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME expels a thick mist as it drifts over brooks, blending into the fog. If it senses danger, it releases powerful jets of water to push threats away.

entry: POKENAME飘到高处，收集小块云朵带回地面。它会抖动这些小云团，让降水落在别人头上，顽皮地捉弄对方。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME float high up enough to gather small pieces of clouds to take back down with them. It playfully pranks others by shaking these little cloud fluffs to cause precipitation to fall on their heads.

entry: 单只POKENAME太弱，举不起比硬币大的东西，没什么作用；成群却很危险。气球般外表会引走孩子，将他们诱到危险高处。
author: periperi_chicken
source: A single POKENAME can't do much on its own since it is too weak to lift anything bigger than a coin, but as a group they are very dangerous. POKENAME draw children away with their balloon-like appearance, luring them to dangerous heights.

entry: 附近有生命逝去，POKENAME的头就会胀大，吸收能量。这似乎使它十分难过，悲伤哀号着跃上高空，数日不落。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Whenever a life is lost near POKENAME, its head expands, absorbing the energy. This seems to greatly upset it, and it emits a sorrowful wail, jumping up high into the air, and does not come down for days.

entry: 附近有生命逝去，POKENAME的飘飘球部分就会胀大，吸收能量，乌波部分却缩小。它似乎十分难过，悲伤哀号着跃上高空，数日不落。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Whenever a life is lost near POKENAME, the Drifloon expands, absorbing the energy, and the Wooper shrinks. This seems to greatly upset it, and it emits a sorrowful wail, jumping up high into the air, and does not come down for days.

entry: 夜里，POKENAME想让人抓住其中一条尾巴，跟随自己。可身体太轻，连孩子也能轻易拉着它走。
author: .jerden
source: At night, POKENAME tries to get people to follow it by having them take hold of one of its tails. However, its body is so light that a child can easily pull it around.

entry: 像飘飘球一样，诱骗、绑走孩子是POKENAME的本性。但它只能离地飘几英尺，几乎所有孩子都逃得掉。
author: nakamagic
source: Like Drifloon, it's in POKENAME's nature to lure and abduct children. However, given it can only float a few feet off the ground, almost all children escape its grasp.

entry: POKENAME背上云朵的蓬松程度，取决于白天吸收了多少日光。它用细线般的藤蔓举起小孩，一起玩，唱歌给他们听。
author: sk372
source: The fluffiness of the clouds on POKENAME's back is dependent on how much sunlight it has absorbed during the day. It uses string-like vines to lift up small children to play with and sing to them.

entry: POKENAME在废墟间漂游，等倒霉又好奇的旅人接触。据说，拉动身上垂下的线，就会失去条理清晰地说话的能力。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME drifts around ruined areas, waiting for hapless and curious travelers to interact with it. Pulling the string it dangles from its body is said to rob a person of the ability to speak coherently.

entry: POKENAME一出现在居民区附近，大人就会赶紧将孩子带进屋，因为它身上的绳索十分危险。轻轻一拉就能引发巨大爆炸，因此POKENAME常住在废弃城镇及其周边。
author: faeflame
source: If a POKENAME appears near a community, children are quickly ushered inside due to its dangerous cords. A single tug on these cords can cause a massive explosion, and as a result, POKENAME often reside in and around ghost towns.

entry: POKENAME夜里浮在孩子窗前，做鬼脸吓人。它仔细听，寻找最轻的哭声，再试着偷走那个孩子。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME floats near the windows of children at night, making scary faces to startle them. It listens carefully, searching for the softest cry before attempting to steal the child away.

entry: 建筑公司开始用POKENAME修人行道和道路。给壳装满熔渣后，倒出一部分填进缝隙，便能封补。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Construction companies have begun to use POKENAME to repair sidewalks and roads. By filling their shells with molten slag, they can partially dump the contents of their shells into gaps to seal over.

entry: POKENAME天生气球般的身体，配合惊人力量，能用细线把海中垃圾拉出，再丢回陆地。也有水手见过，它借墨汁在空中移动。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: Using their natural balloon bodies with their impressive strength, POKENAME have been seen pulling garbage from the oceans with strings and dropping it back on land. Sailors have witnessed POKENAME using ink to move through the air.

entry: POKENAME探索时碰撞物体，便在体内积起静电。尾部静电一跳出，常使缺乏防护的电子设备短路。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME stores static electricity in its body as it bumps into objects while exploring. This often causes short-circuits with unprotected electronics as static jumps from its tail.

entry: POKENAME身体脆弱，需要刺耳果帮助抵御恶属性宝可梦。不找树果时，它便把孩子引进森林，试图绑走。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are fragile creatures that need the help of Colbur Berries to defend themselves against Dark-type Pokémon. When they are not searching for berries, they lure children into forests to kidnap them.

entry: 它蛇行时吱吱作响，声音惹人警觉，限制了伏击能力。据说现身时，会盘成数字2的形状。
author: tqz7
source: This Pokémon's ambushing power is limited by the alarming noise of its squeaky slither. It is said to appear coiled in the shape of the number two.

entry: POKENAME身体的乳房状部位，装着比空气轻的气体。一挤便放气，身体慢慢瘪下，飘到地面。
author: oddwalls
source: The udder-like portion of POKENAME's body is filled with a gas that is lighter than air. If this area is squeezed, the gas is released, and POKENAME slowly deflates and floats to the ground.

entry: POKENAME背上长出气球般的物体，帮它浮过峭壁。这些气球能隔绝自身放电，最多同时长4个，按路程远近调整数量。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME sprouts balloon-like objects from its back to float over cliffs. These balloons are insulated from its electric discharges, and it can generate up to four at a time, adjusting their number based on how far it needs to travel.

entry: POKENAME两条充气的尾巴能减轻重量，帮助灵活移动。但也有缺点：一阵强风，就可能把它吹走。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's two gas-filled tails serve to lighten its weight, aiding its agility. There is a downside to this trait, however — a strong wind may blow POKENAME away.

entry: POKENAME飞行时，若察觉下方打架，就俯冲，用触须缠住一方，带到远处。它相信，无论为何争执，把双方分开就能解决。
author: sk372
source: If POKENAME senses a fight beneath it as it flies, it swoops down and uses its feelers to ensnare and carry one of the combatants far away, believing that separating them will solve whatever problem caused the strife.

entry: POKENAME投出气球影像，装作礼物，引孩子靠近。可影像常出视觉故障，孩子只要足够留心，通常就不会上当。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME produces the image of a balloon as a gift offering to lure children closer to it. The image is often prone to visual glitches, so the lure usually fails as long as the child is attentive enough.

entry: POKENAME被逼到绝境，身体就充满鼠尾草香的气体，能短暂飞起逃走。
author: .izik
source: When cornered, POKENAME's body inflates with a sage-scented gas. This allows it short periods of flight to escape.

entry: 它靠体内火焰和天生轻盈的身体，在空中漂游，有风天却会找掩蔽。身体能膨胀不少，有时被小孩误认成气球。
author: infinex21
source: It utilizes its own internal flames and its inherently light body to drift through the air, though it takes shelter on windy days. Its body can expand a decent bit, to the point that it sometimes has been mistaken for a balloon by small children.

entry: POKENAME似乎与飞行物有仇，尤其是气球。只要看见，就忍不住想用爪子戳破。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME seems to have a vendetta against flying objects, balloons in particular. If it spots one, it cannot resist the impulse to pop it with its claws.

entry: POKENAME在有幼童训练的道场附近游荡。孩子在户外练习时，它可能靠近，用细线缠住四肢，纠正姿势。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME hang around dojos where young children train. When the children are practicing outside, wandering POKENAME may approach a child and wrap their strings around the kid's limbs, proceeding to correct the child's form.

entry: POKENAME双腿强，身体轻，最高能跳60英尺。借自生火焰，还能留空更久，但此时连微风，也可能把它吹来吹去。
author: notadoctor75
source: POKENAME's powerful legs combined with its light body allow it to leap up to 60 feet in the air. It can use the flames it produces to stay aloft for longer, but it is then in danger of being blown about by even gentle winds.

entry: POKENAME嘴里不断滴水，飞在天上也一样。水臭得厉害，气味很难从衣服上洗掉。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's mouth constantly dribbles water even as it floats through the sky. This water has an incredibly foul smell that is difficult to remove from clothing.

entry: POKENAME飘在沼泽湿地等泥泞处上方。若有宝可梦或人陷进泥里，它会试着抓住、向上浮，帮忙救出。
author: drcew
source: POKENAME will drift above muddy places like marshes or swamps. If there is a Pokémon or person stuck in mud, POKENAME will try to help by grabbing them and floating upward.

entry: POKENAME的灵质被用于民间退烧方。据说它对绝症病人很敏感。它会主动寻找医院，帮助患者。
author: ghostslythe
source: Ectoplasm from POKENAME is used in home remedies to decrease fever. Rumored to be sensitive toward the terminally ill, it actively seeks out hospitals to help the patients.

entry: POKENAME身体中空，里面只有氦气。它在世界各地漂浮，直到死亡，随后身体才慢慢分解。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME are hollow bodies, only filled with helium. They will float around the world until death, when they will slowly decompose.

entry: POKENAME感到危险，中空身体就充满毒气。它够轻，能借气体漂浮到很远的地方，尽可能避免冲突。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's hollow body fills with toxic gas when it senses danger. It is light enough to use this gas to float over vast distances, avoiding conflict whenever possible.

entry: POKENAME用尾巴吊在高枝，向下伸舌，吸引好奇猎物。谁拉舌头，就被卷上树冠，再也回不来。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME dangles from its tail off high branches, extending its tongue down to draw in curious prey. Anything that tugs on its tongue gets reeled up into the tree canopy, never to return.

entry: POKENAME在废弃图书馆、博物馆游荡，用超能力整理房间，保持清洁。打扫干净就放松睡着，不再担心从前主人责骂。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME wanders abandoned libraries and museums, tidying rooms and keeping them clean with its psychic power. It relaxes and falls asleep when an area is clean, as it no longer fears scolding from its former masters.

entry: POKENAME云朵般的嘴，质地像橡胶。巨口一咬住猎物，就会拖进附近群山享用。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's cloud-like mouth is rubbery in texture. Should it latch onto prey with its maw, it drags them into nearby mountains to feast.

entry: 身体慢慢石化，变得越来越沉。想飞起来，就得耗去极大的能量。
author: chorb33
source: Its body slowly petrifies, making it progressively heavier and only able to fly by expending a great deal of energy.

entry: POKENAME夜间在森林游荡，用头上小触角感知微风。找到适合筑巢的树后，会缓缓浮上去，但只有无风时才这样做。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME wanders through forests at night, using the small antennae on its head to detect gentle breezes. When POKENAME finds a suitable tree to nest in, it floats slowly upward, but only if there is no wind.

entry: POKENAME飘过茂密森林上空，宝可梦会搭在背上。有些将背部气球状结构误认成树果，还会试着吃掉。
author: drcew
source: Pokémon will ride on POKENAME's back as it drifts above heavily forested areas. Some Pokémon will try to eat the balloon-like structures on POKENAME's back, mistaking them for berries.

entry: POKENAME漫不经心地高飘城市上空。背上青草放出樱桃与藻根果香，吸引附近飘飘球，唆使它们搜集年幼宝可梦与人类作为猎物。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME drifts carelessly high above cities. It releases a cherry and Kelpsy Berry scent from the grass on its back that attracts nearby Drifloon and convinces them to gather young Pokémon and humans as prey.

entry: POKENAME身体如橡胶，毒气会从耳朵渗出。向不同方向释放小股毒气，就能控制空中移动。
author: .izik
source: Poisonous gas seeps from POKENAME's rubbery body through its ears. It controls its movement midair by releasing small bursts of this gas in different directions.

entry: POKENAME投物精准，几百英尺外也能准确命中。高飞时，体内充满热气，把物件如雨般扔向下方敌人。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME is remarkably accurate when hurling objects, capable of pinpoint precision from hundreds of feet away. It fills its body with hot gas while flying high above, raining items down on foes below.

entry: 战斗中，POKENAME猛吸一口气，升向天空。高度足够后，再放出空气，迅速落下踢击，将敌人击昏。
author: .izik
source: During combat, POKENAME inhales sharply to rise into the sky. Once high enough, it releases the air and descends with a swift kick to knock out its foe.

entry: 无月夜，能见POKENAME吹泡泡。泡泡破裂的声音像极了尖叫，让人不安。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME can be seen blowing bubbles on moonless nights. When these bubbles pop, the sound they make is unnervingly close to a scream.

entry: POKENAME必须克服充气脑袋的浮力，才能潜水。到达一定深度，脑袋便开始缩小，压力越大就越小。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME has to fight its buoyant, air-filled head in order to dive. Once it reaches a certain depth, POKENAME's head starts to shrink, getting smaller with more pressure.

entry: POKENAME的模样深受孩子珍爱，便利用这点绑走他们。被抓住时，会像真剑一样反击。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME's form makes it a treasure for children, which it takes advantage of to kidnap them. It fights back like a real sword when caught.

entry: POKENAME的模样深受孩子珍爱，便利用这点绑走他们。被抓住时，会像真剑一样反击。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME's form makes it a treasure for children, which it takes advantage of to kidnap them. It fights back like a real sword when caught.

entry: POKENAME看着有弹性又钝，挥动时却能产生压缩空气波，锋利不输任何刀刃。孩子若抓住某个剑柄，可能造成可怕伤害。
author: .realthree
source: Although POKENAME seems bouncy and blunt, it generates waves of compressed air when swung that are as sharp as any blade. Horrific damage can occur if a child should seize this Pokémon by one of the hilts.
