entry: POKENAME轻得一阵强风就能吹起来。会用触须抓牢任何够得到的东西，尤其喜欢握住训练家的手。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are known for being so light that a strong breeze will lift them into the air. They use their feelers to anchor themselves on whatever they can, though they favor holding onto the hands of their Trainers.

entry: POKENAME中空身体内燃着火，托住它漫无目的地飘荡。据说，亡者与死去宝可梦的灵魂，是火焰的燃料。
author: pattybgoode
source: Inside POKENAME's hollow body is a burning flame that keeps it afloat as it drifts about aimlessly. It is said that the spirits of dead people and Pokémon fuel the flame.

entry: POKENAME橡胶身体排出的热，足以熔化银。古时，工匠会借它制作精巧首饰。
author: .izik
source: The heat POKENAME expels from its rubbery body is hot enough to melt silver. In ancient times, artisans used it to help craft delicate jewelry.

entry: 它们住在废弃射箭场，弹性皮肤连弩箭都射不穿。会挑衅人们来射，因为觉得这种感觉很舒服。
author: quackquackattack
source: They are known to live in abandoned archery ranges, and their elastic skin cannot be penetrated by an arrow from a crossbow. They taunt people to shoot them, as they find the sensation pleasant.

entry: 曾有一只野生POKENAME不知从何处突然出现，抓走孩子，一小时后又送回。据孩子说，它展示了云中宫殿，却从未有人找到这样的栖息地。
author: bobosmith01
source: There was once a case where a wild POKENAME suddenly came out of nowhere and snatched up a child, only to return them an hour later. According to the child, POKENAME showed them their palace in the clouds. No such habitat for POKENAME has been found.

entry: POKENAME喜欢逛主题乐园与马戏团，寻找兴奋的孩子，送上气球。尾巴上的气球被取走后，很快又会长出，因此始终不缺。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME love to roam around theme parks and circuses, searching out excited children to offer them a balloon. The balloons their tails rapidly regrow when taken, allowing them to always have a ready supply.

entry: POKENAME试图引孩子靠近，孩子们以为抓住它就能实现愿望。它一见父母就逃，暗示或有更阴险的动机。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME attempts to lure children closer to it, who feel that grabbing hold of it will make their wishes come true. It flees as soon as it sees the child's parents, which implies more sinister motives.

entry: POKENAME对情绪极敏锐，通常专找悲伤的孩子捕猎，因为最容易骗走。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME have a keen sense for emotions. It typically hunts for sad children, as they are the easiest to lure away.

entry: POKENAME整天睡在最高的树枝上。有时抓不牢，就会浮向天空，被强风吹到新森林，再被孩子发现、带着四处走。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME spend their days sleeping in the highest branches of trees. They sometimes lose their grip and end up floating skyward, where strong winds blow them to new forests, where they get found and taken around by children.

entry: POKENAME体内的气体可替代氦气。充入这种气的气球，可能自行变成随风球。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Gasses inside of POKENAME are used as a replacement for helium. Balloons filled with this gas may spontaneously transform into Drifblim.

entry: POKENAME不断鼓胀、收缩身体，产生静电，存入薄薄的橡胶状皮肤。谁一碰它，便会释放令人刺痛的静电。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME will inflate and deflate to generate static electricity, which becomes stored within its thin rubbery skin. Upon being touched, it will emit a sharp static shock.

entry: POKENAME装成走失的小猫，引孩子抚摸。一旦碰触，皮下蓄积的强静电便会麻痹孩子，再将受害者拖往不知何处。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME will pretend to be a lost kitten in order to lull children into petting it. Once a child does, a sharp static shock stored within its skin will paralyze them and it will drag its victim away into the unknown.

entry: POKENAME寻找同伴，通过细绳般的尾巴分享电力，结果却常缠成滑稽的一团，怎么也解不开。鬃毛被认为由灵魂精华构成。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME find other POKENAME to share electricity between their stringy tails, though this ends up with a comical clump of POKENAME unable to untangle themselves from each other. Its mane is thought to be made up of spiritual essence.

entry: POKENAME身体轻，除了刚吃过东西，总能浮在空中。它们吃矿石与岩块，消化需要时间，却也因此不容易突然被风吹走。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are light and capable of floating in the air at all times except when they have recently eaten. They eat minerals and rocks, which takes time for them to digest and helps keep them from being suddenly blown away.

entry: POKENAME垂下线状双臂，引小型宝可梦抓住，再拉入口齿之间。不建议年幼训练家饲养，手若被牙卡住，可能留下永久损伤。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME dangle their string arms to lure small Pokémon. When prey grabs on, they pull it into their teeth. Young Trainers are discouraged from owning one, as getting a hand caught in the teeth can cause permanent hand injuries.

entry: POKENAME变出的幻象总带着乳胶般的质感，因此很容易识破。游行中的宝可梦气球，有时就是POKENAME的伪装。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME's illusions are easily spotted due to the latex-like texture they maintain when changing. Pokémon balloons in parades are sometimes POKENAME in disguise.

entry: POKENAME漂过沼泽，从花苞中放出有害气体，隔一阵又会降落，到附近水源饮水。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME releases a noxious gas from its bud as it floats through marshy areas. It periodically drops to ground level to drink from nearby water sources.

entry: 无论年岁多大，POKENAME都爱陪人类孩子与幼小宝可梦玩。气球般的四肢互相摩擦，既散出甜美花香，又产生静电，用来吓朋友一跳。
author: infinex21
source: No matter their age, POKENAME enjoy playing with human children and young Pokémon. By rubbing their balloon-like limbs together, they release sweet, floral scents and produce static electricity, the latter of which they use to surprise friends.

entry: POKENAME鲜少现身，可一旦出现，家家都会锁门。它们成群降下，以鲜亮色彩与尖细叫声催眠近处的孩子。跟着POKENAME走的孩子，从不回来。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME rarely appear, but when they do, families lock their doors. They fly down in droves, their bright, shiny colours and high-pitched squeaks hypnotising all children in close range. Any children who follow POKENAME never return.

entry: POKENAME的耳朵变得如幽灵般缥缈，原本猛烈的打击也柔和了许多。如今，它改用云絮般的耳朵，送出少量令人刺痛的能量。
author: glacierwing
source: POKENAME's ears have turned ghostly, and the once-brutal strikes it delivers have softened considerably. Instead, it uses the cloud-like wisps to deliver subtle doses of stinging energy.

entry: POKENAME气体构成的身体装满黄色粉末，帮助悬浮。它高飘空中，寻找淡水，维系同类生存。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's gaseous body is filled with a yellow powder that helps it stay aloft. It floats high above the ground, searching for fresh water sources to sustain its kind.

entry: POKENAME成大群飞过夜空。若遭攻击，整个群体就包围来犯者，将其带走，从此不知所终。
author: staghorn
source: POKENAME fly through the night sky in huge flocks. If attacked, the flock will surround the assailant and carry them off, never to be seen again.

entry: 它吊在洞顶，垂下如离洞绳般的细线。旅人若不慎抓住，POKENAME就会拉上去，吸尽生命力。
author: bacondlx
source: It hangs from the ceilings in caves, letting a string down that looks like an Escape Rope. If a traveler grabs one of its strings by accident, POKENAME will pull them up and drain their vitality.

entry: POKENAME能用眼睛反射月光，汇成光束，寻找海上失踪者，很受海岸警卫队欢迎。可有时还得提醒它，找到人之后，别忘了带回岸边。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are popular among Coast Guards due to their ability to reflect moonlight off their eyes into beams of light, helping them find people lost at sea. Unfortunately, they sometimes need to be reminded to actually bring the people back to shore.

entry: POKENAME体内的高压蒸气带有酸性，一碰便会灼伤。狩猎时，它借此蚀穿门口。
author: .izik
source: The high-pressure vapor within POKENAME's body is acidic to the touch. It uses this to burn through doorways when hunting.

entry: POKENAME能做宝可梦气球与冰雕，是冬季庆典受欢迎的帮手。可气球一吹大，往往就冻住，因此它们通常先忙冰雕。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME make for popular attendants at winter festivals due to their ability to craft both balloon Pokémon and ice sculptures. Unfortunately, their balloons often freeze once inflated, leading to them focusing on the ice sculptures first.

entry: POKENAME橡胶般的身体装满细小种子。滑过草野时随意撒下，一夜便能让整片草甸冒出新芽。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's rubbery body is packed with tiny seeds. As it glides through grassy fields, it scatters them freely, causing entire meadows to sprout overnight.

entry: POKENAME在夜空起舞，云朵便被吸引而来。观看太久的人会陷入恍惚，任它带上天空，消失得无影无踪。
author: .izik
source: As it dances in the night sky, clouds are drawn toward POKENAME. Those who watch too long fall into a trance, allowing it to lift them into the air and vanish without a trace.

entry: POKENAME好奇、友善，通常也没什么危险。可它真正从何而来，却流传着许多骇人的都市传说。
author: staghorn
source: POKENAME are curious, friendly, and often harmless. Despite this, there are many grisly urban legends surrounding its true origins.

entry: POKENAME由云构成，体型虽大，也能随意飘游天空。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's body is made of clouds, allowing it to float through the sky at will despite its large size.

entry: POKENAME舒服地睡在水面，闻到猎物便立刻精神起来。它能飞，因此无论水上水下，威胁都不小。
author: .izik
source: While sleeping comfortably on the water's surface, POKENAME springs to life the moment it smells prey. It can pose just as much of a threat above the water as below, thanks to its ability to fly.

entry: POKENAME嘴里没牙，却是凶猛的猎手。它从高处扑下，将猎物装进中空的大嘴，带往不知何处。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is an aggressive hunter despite having no teeth in its mouth. It swoops down from on high to capture prey into its hollow mouth and carry them off to parts unknown.

entry: POKENAME乐于抓起孩子，从高处丢下。似乎并无恶意，只是太想找更多朋友，陪自己在天上玩。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME take great joy in capturing children and dropping them from great heights. They don't seem to do this out of malice; rather, the Pokémon is longing for more friends to play with it in the sky.

entry: 随风漂行时，它显得慢吞吞。可只要鼓起头部与翅膀，就能升上天空，快得转眼消失。
author: chorb33
source: It appears sluggish when it lets itself be carried by the wind. However, by inflating its head and wings, it can rise into the air and disappear surprisingly quickly.

entry: POKENAME用力出拳，威力颇强。不过，平时的力气不及穿着熊，拥抱便不再致命。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME can pack quite a punch with effort, but its passive strength is not as great as that of a Bewear, making its hugs no longer lethal.

entry: POKENAME体内始终冲突不休。它同时吸取生物与非生物的能量：前者让它浮起，后者让它下沉，因此这一族群没有固定的体重。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME is plagued by a constant internal battle. It absorbs energy from both biotic and abiotic sources, with biotic energy making it float and abiotic energy making it sink. This means there is no consistent weight for the species.

entry: POKENAME群体规模庞大，一旦占住某地，就几乎赶不走。借背上的球体短距离飘行，它们能轻松将食物带回群落。
author: faeflame
source: POKENAME live in colonies of vast sizes, and once they have claimed an area it is nearly impossible to get them to leave. Using the orbs on their back they float short distances bringing food back to the colony with ease.

entry: POKENAME看似挂在云上，随风漂游。分析发现，那团云其实是疏松菌丝网，捕捉空气水分，形成云朵般的结构。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME appear to drift on the breeze attached to a cloud. Analysis of the cloud reveals that it's formed of a loose web of mycelium that captures ambient moisture in the air, creating a cloud-like structure.

entry: POKENAME身体看似橡胶，近看却更像叶片。它浮过森林，沿途吃树叶，还特意不重复啃同一棵树。
author: .izik
source: While POKENAME's body looks to be made of rubber, it is more similar to leaves when observed up close. It eats leaves from trees as it floats through forests, purposefuly never chewing on the same tree twice.

entry: POKENAME游荡墓园，决意守护长眠于此的人。通常三到五只结群，轮番警戒，防备流氓与捣乱者。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME roam around graveyards and cemeteries, committed to protecting the people who rest there. They can be found in groups of three to five, as they take turns keeping vigil against hooligans or troublemakers.

entry: 空气与体内共生真菌不断交换气体，让POKENAME背上的气球鼓起。真菌处理水分时释放氢气，还促使POKENAME饮云，维持自身生存。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME puff up the balloon on their back through a passive gas exchange between the air and an internal, symbiotic fungus. The fungus releases hydrogen gas as it processes water and encourages POKENAME to drink clouds to sustain it.

entry: POKENAME身体苍白，没有色素，背上鲜亮的充气蘑菇却格外醒目。研究者推测，这会引天敌攻击蘑菇，顺势喷出团团孢子。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME's bodies are pale and devoid of pigment, a marked contrast to the brightly coloured, gas-filled mushroom growing on their back. Researchers speculate that this draws predators to attack the mushroom, releasing puffs of spores as they do.

entry: POKENAME通过一种变异的光合作用产气，借此漂浮。由于产气需要阳光，日出时，常能见到POKENAME瘪着身体伏在地上。
author: drcew
source: POKENAME is able to float due to gas produced by a modified version of photosynthesis. Since sunlight is needed to produce this gas, POKENAME is often found deflated on the ground by sunrise.

entry: POKENAME漂在温泉与间歇泉上方，收集蒸汽热能，再从头顶排出热气，调节高度。奇趣的模样，让它长久以来深受马戏团演员喜爱。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME drift over hot springs and geysers, gathering steam and heat energy to control their altitude by venting hot air from the top of their body. Circus performers have long enjoyed the company of POKENAME for their whimsical appearance.

entry: POKENAME腰下的皮肤像橡胶长裤，雷暴中会用来藏住自己。它能安全浮在离地处，避开猛烈雷击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME has rubbery, pants-like skin from the waist down, which it uses to hide itself during lightning storms. It can float safely above the ground, shielded from the electrifying bolts.

entry: 与飘飘球一样，POKENAME很吸引孩子，可它其实讨厌靠近别人，因此常被看见逃离孩子。
author: nakamagic
source: Like Drifloon, children are drawn to POKENAME. However, POKENAME actively dislikes being near others and thus is often seen fleeing from children.

entry: POKENAME不快时，橡胶身体就会装满热水。过去有人拿这水泡茶，相信能挽回情侣间淡去的情意。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's rubbery body fills with hot water when it is upset. This water was once used in teas as a presumed remedy for couples facing lost affection.

entry: POKENAME住在云里，整天吃水汽、开通道。有时三个头从云边探出，找寻附近还有哪片云可以前往。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME live within clouds, spending their days creating tunnels through them as they consume water vapour. They can sometimes be seen popping out of the edges of clouds, their three heads looking for other nearby clouds to travel to.

entry: POKENAME以地底深处的气穴为食，能找到氦气就优先选它。它们得定期露面排放废气，同时发出尖细的吱叫。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME feed on gas pockets that can be found deep underground, preferring to seek out helium pockets where they can. They periodically have to surface to release waste gas, making high-pitched squeaks as they do.

entry: POKENAME浮过城市街道，用长线般的四肢偷旅人的钱包。赃物用来铺巢，仿佛在囤积战利品。
author: .izik
source: While floating through city streets, POKENAME uses its long, thread-like limbs to steal wallets from travelers. It lines its nest with these stolen items, seemingly hoarding them as trophies.

entry: POKENAME爱紧蹭训练家，借亲密接触示好。可这样总积起静电，常把自己黏到衣服上，只好喵喵求救。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME love to rub up close against their trainers, showing affection through close physical contact. They generate a persistent static charge when doing so, often resulting in them getting stuck to their trainer's clothing and meowing for help.

entry: POKENAME渗出的湿热气体，比熔炉还烫，能让巢穴在最冷的环境中也保持暖和。
author: .izik
source: The humid gas that seeps from POKENAME's body is hotter than a furnace. It uses this intense heat to keep its den warm, even in the coldest environments.

entry: POKENAME身体充气，能浮在池面，再用绳状尾巴抓取藏在水下的东西。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's gas-filled body allows it to float on the surface of ponds. It uses its string-like tail to grab at objects hidden beneath the water's surface.

entry: POKENAME勤奋锻炼，增强身体。可体重始终太轻，强敌、甚至一阵大风，都能轻易将它推着走。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME trains vigorously to strengthen its body. Unfortunately, its body is always lightweight, making it all too easy to be pushed around by strong foes or even strong gusts of wind.

entry: 确定无人注视时，POKENAME才给肌肉充气，装得比橡胶身体应有的模样更强壮。它还常让异性宝可梦，甚至训练家替自己充气，满足虚荣。
author: nightshadow_og
source: When they're certain nobody's looking, POKENAME takes the time to inflate their muscles to seem stronger than their rubbery bodies would imply. They often allow Pokémon and even Trainers of the opposite gender to inflate them to boost their egos.

entry: POKENAME浮过繁茂田野，沿途撒种。长得飞快的杂草，只需数周就能侵占整片生态环境。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME floats above lush fields, scattering seeds as it drifts. The fast-growing weeds it produces can overrun entire ecosystems within weeks.

entry: POKENAME身体白色的部分，与飘飘球一样，其实是云。孩子爱拿它的壳当枕头睡，压得POKENAME动不了，让它十分懊恼。
author: nakamagic
source: Like Drifloon, the white part of POKENAME's body is actually a cloud. Children like to nap on POKENAME's shell as a pillow, which frustrates POKENAME as it is pinned down by the child.

entry: 它用细线缠住疏忽的登山者脚踝，想绊倒对方，或拖下山。可自己太轻，对成年人根本不奏效。
author: bandedbodypress
source: It wraps its strings around unobservant hiker's ankles, attempting to trip them or pull them down mountains. It's much too light to do this to adults.

entry: POKENAME用三个气球脑袋轻松离地，在空中滑翔。
author: camtft
source: Using their three balloon heads, POKENAME are able to lift off the ground and glide through the air with ease.

entry: POKENAME安静漂过夜空，发光的节段宛如浮灯。庆典上，人们常将它放飞，让柔光汇成动人的景象。
author: ilija09
source: POKENAME drifts peacefully through the night sky, its glowing segments resembling floating lanterns. It is often released during festivals, where its gentle light creates breathtaking displays.

entry: POKENAME天真爱玩，却因把孩子拖进居住的森林陪玩而恶名远扬。有人相信，它诞生于迷途孩子的灵魂，至今仍把自己当作其中一个孩子。
author: fiordaliso
source: Though naive and playful, POKENAME has a notorious reputation for dragging children to play with it in the forests where it lives. It is believed that POKENAME was actually born from the spirits of lost children and still identifies with one of them.

entry: POKENAME软毛里满是毒孢子。春日庆典上，商家常把它当可爱礼物卖给孩子，但有些倡议团体正为POKENAME的福祉发声，反对这种做法。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME's fluffy fur is filled with poisonous spores. Though it's often marketed as a cute Pokémon to give to children during springtime celebrations, several advocacy groups are speaking out against this practice for POKENAME's well-being.

entry: POKENAME吐出的丝带着淡淡胡萝卜香，吸引草食宝可梦。它以软丝铺好洞穴，造出温暖芳香的巢。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spins silk with a faint carrot-like scent, attracting herbivorous Pokémon. It lines its burrow with the soft strands, creating a warm and fragrant nest.

entry: POKENAME用骨棒从农田挖胡萝卜。被发现便装哭，等对方放松警惕，再趁机逃走。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its bone to dig up carrots from farmland. When spotted, it pretends to cry before fleeing once guards are lowered.

entry: 即使外壳逐渐硬化，POKENAME强劲的腿仍能跃出很远。它常跳上树枝，躲避天敌。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's powerful legs allow it to hop great distances, even while its outer shell hardens. It often leaps into tree branches to avoid predators.

entry: POKENAME嗜甜如命，漂在树果丛间，尽挑最甜的果子大吃。若被吓到，便本能地喷出甜腻得令人窒息的烟，裹住四周。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME floats around berry patches gorging on the sweetest fruits it can find due to its extreme sweet tooth. If something spooks it, it billows out a stiflingly sweet cloud of smoke all around it on reflex.

entry: POKENAME善良体贴，太理解别人的心情，甚至过了头。训练家常得帮它学会坚定表达自己的意愿。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are kind and empathic creatures that are understanding of others, to a fault. Trainers often need to step in to help them act assertively.

entry: POKENAME善良体贴，太理解别人的心情，甚至过了头。训练家常得帮它学会坚定表达自己的意愿。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME kind and empathic creatures that are understanding of others, to a fault. Trainers often need to step in to help them act assertively.

entry: POKENAME柔韧多彩的毛发，可制成各种奢侈品。它每天要睡好几次，睡不够就会暴躁不安。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's supple and colorful fur is used in a variety of luxury products. It sleeps several times a day; failure to do so results in it becoming grumpy and restless.

entry: POKENAME准备迎战，耳朵就会展开，显出不断高涨的敌意。双耳力量惊人，能抛起自身三倍重的东西。
author: theartemis1
source: POKENAME's ears unfurl as it prepares for battle, a telling sign of its rising aggression. These ears are incredibly powerful, capable of tossing three times its body weight.

entry: POKENAME蓬松的尾巴里暗藏毒刺，只有受威胁才用。它常低声呜咽，让敌人误以为安全。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's fluffy tail contains a hidden venomous barb, which it uses only when threatened. It whimpers frequently, lulling foes into a false sense of security.

entry: POKENAME体内存有不稳定的能量，既可通过强劲的耳击释放，也能以进化之石增强。
author: _snakeywakey_
source: POKENAME has unstable energy stored in its body. This energy can be released through its powerful ear attacks, or enhanced with an evolution stone.

entry: POKENAME删除程序后，就将图标改成胡萝卜。设备若久无人看管，渐渐就会像一片数码胡萝卜田。
author: .izik
source: After deleting a program, POKENAME replaces its icon with a carrot image. Devices left unattended often resemble digital carrot patches over time.

entry: POKENAME被激怒便用双耳猛击。危急时，则缩进坚固的壳中自保。
author: _snakeywakey_
source: POKENAME attacks with powerful ear strikes when provoked. In dire circumstances, it hides in its sturdy shell to protect itself.

entry: POKENAME大量吃胡萝卜，强化发育中的壳。壳越坚硬，面对天敌也越有自信。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME eats large amounts of carrots to strengthen its developing shell. The tougher its shell becomes, the more confidently it faces predators.

entry: 只要喂养得当，POKENAME就会与训练家建立牢不可破的羁绊。任何威胁伙伴的对象，都会被伸长的耳朵压倒痛打。
author: lampent12
source: If properly fed, POKENAME will form an unbreakable bond with its Trainer. Any danger posed to its partner will be flattened and pummeled by its extendable ears.

entry: POKENAME十分胆怯，一见陌生人就逃。它住在最寒冷偏远的山脉，用自己脱落的毛铺巢。
author: alestrius
source: POKENAME is a timid Pokémon that will immediately flee at the sight of strangers. It lives in the coldest and most remote mountain ranges and uses its own shed fur as lining in its nest.

entry: POKENAME爱在湍急瀑布旁掘洞，每天在那里蜕皮。闯入者一进洞，它便蜷起身体，再弹射出去，将对方撞昏。
author: torterraguy26
source: POKENAME prefers to burrow near swift waterfalls, shedding there every day. If an intruder comes into its burrow, it coils its body before springing forward to knock the intruder unconscious.

entry: POKENAME喜欢在大地上蹦跃。有科学家推测，它一跳就能越过整座山。
author: pastapockets
source: POKENAME loves to bound across the landscape. Some scientists theorize that it could leap over a mountain in a single jump.

entry: POKENAME察觉人类遇险，耳朵便会抽动。它能跃得极高，不过通常更愿意飞。
author: pastapockets
source: POKENAME's ears twitch when it senses a human in distress. It could leap incredibly high, though it usually chooses to fly.

entry: POKENAME喜欢拥抱亲吻，却很容易兴奋过度。一旦受刺激太多，就爱抓到什么啃什么。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME enjoy hugs and kisses but easily get excited. When they are overstimulated, they have a tendency to gnaw on whatever is available.

entry: POKENAME在花椰菜田旁筑巢，藏在浅色菜茎中。农人常在黎明看见它安静地歇在菜间。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME builds its nest near cauliflower fields, hiding within the pale stalks. Farmers often find it peacefully resting among the plants at dawn.

entry: POKENAME又可爱又蓬松，常被训练家低估。它们听觉敏锐，卷耳的攻击也强，守护着卷卷耳与尾立的洞穴。
author: t3isukone
source: The cute and fluffy appearance of POKENAME leads many Trainers to underestimate it. They use their sharp hearing and the powerful strikes of their rolled-up ears to act as a guardian to burrows of Buneary and Sentret.

entry: POKENAME胆子极小，独处便会紧张。寒天里，它们挤在一起，将软毛凑拢，保暖得更好。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME is incredibly timid and will become stressed if it is alone. During cold weather, it huddles with other POKENAME for warmth, putting their fluff together for extra insulation.

entry: POKENAME听力虽敏锐，却极易受惊。一声巨响，就会失去飞行控制，撞上洞壁。
author: mepp.
source: Despite having keen hearing, POKENAME startles easily. Loud noises cause it to lose control of its flight and crash into cave walls.

entry: 浓密的毛带着胡萝卜炖菜般的气味。静电存进毛里，需要时便能施展猛烈电击。
author: .izik
source: The thick fur growing off its body smells like a carrot-based stew. It stores static electricity in this fur, which helps it deliver powerful shocks when needed.

entry: 寒地的POKENAME长出厚毛，还把头缩进去保暖。热地的则毛薄，既遮阳，又能通风纳凉。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME in cold habitats grow thick wool and tuck their heads inside for warmth. Those from hot climates have thinner wool instead, providing shade while allowing cool air to circulate.

entry: POKENAME的长耳能向前伸击。尾巴帮它站稳，免得被打翻。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME has long ears that extend forward to strike opponents. Its tail stabilizes its footing, ensuring it does not get knocked over.

entry: POKENAME以双耳戳击敌人，力道足以碎石。可爱的模样也能让对手心神不宁，因此它总细心梳理，保持可爱。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME jabs at its opponents with its ears, which have enough strength to break rocks. It also unnerves opponents with its cuteness, and grooms itself to ensure it always appears cute.

entry: POKENAME钻进地下找胡萝卜吃。园丁因此视它们为祸害，不断驱赶。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME will burrow underground in search of carrots to eat. Gardeners consider them to be pests for this reason, being forced out constantly.

entry: 遇险时，它伸耳弹上树梢，再以尾巴荡枝逃走。极少数需要战斗的时候，耳击也比任何一只手都强。
author: bacondlx
source: It escapes danger by extending its ears to launch into treetops, then swinging away on branches with its tail. In the rare event that it needs to fight, its ears pack a stronger punch than any of its hands.

entry: POKENAME住在寒地，厚毛让它保持温暖。太冷时就蜷起身体，用耳朵裹住自己，耳朵却会抖个不停。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME live in cold environments, their thick fur keeping them warm. If it gets too cold, they curl up and wrap their ears around themselves, which twitch uncontrollably.

entry: POKENAME住在寒地，厚毛让它保持温暖。太冷时就蜷起身体，用耳朵裹住自己，耳朵却会抖个不停。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME live in cold environments, their thick fur keeping them warm. If it gets too cold, they curl up and wrap their ears around themselves, which twitch uncontrollably.

entry: POKENAME一察觉危险，就竖起耳朵。觅食时，会搜遍广大的区域。
author: the_fireplace
source: When POKENAME senses danger, it perks up its ears. It searches wide areas for food.

entry: 据说POKENAME会造出可爱长耳宝可梦的幻象，让人发疯。可一离开影响范围，幻象就消失得毫无痕迹。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are said to drive people insane by producing hallucinations of cute, long-eared Pokémon. Once a person is out of range, the hallucinations fade away without a trace.

entry: POKENAME看着像满身软毛，身体其实由岩石构成。背着的壳，则像节庆用的彩蛋。
author: beandrawsthings
source: Though it appears quite fluffy in texture, POKENAME's body is made of rock. The shell it carries resembles a festive holiday egg.

entry: POKENAME双翼内侧覆着温暖柔软的毛。它把幼崽藏在翼中，替孩子保暖。
author: sk372
source: The inner area of POKENAME's wings is covered with very soft and warm fur. It keeps its young tucked away within its wings to keep them warm.

entry: POKENAME耳朵敏锐，附近数据一有改动，就能察觉。人们常在电脑里养它，提醒文件是否出了异常。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's sensitive ears can easily sense when data near it is being altered. Many have it on their computer to help alert them when something amiss is happening within their files.

entry: POKENAME靠唯一的大耳朵旋转，平衡近乎完美。但耳朵主要用于平衡，POKENAME的听力反而较差。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME demonstrates almost perfect balance spinning on its singular large ear. Because the appendage is used mostly for balance, POKENAME has relatively poor hearing.

entry: POKENAME模样太讨喜，常被送给小女孩作伙伴。战斗一落下风，就大哭，让对手内疚。
author: fiordaliso
source: Because of its adorably cute appearance, POKENAME is often gifted to young girls as a companion Pokémon. If it starts losing a battle, it bursts into tears to make its opponent feel guilty.

entry: POKENAME胆怯极了，稍觉有东西接近，就飞快逃过大地。旅途中，只有来到最洁净、无人碰过的水域饮水，才肯停下。
author: sk372
source: Extremely timid, POKENAME will flee across the land at high speeds at the mere hint of something approaching. It only stops during its travels to drink from the most pristine and untouched bodies of water.

entry: POKENAME打架时会甩出重尾。尾巴沉得出乎意料，一两击就能敲昏小型宝可梦。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME lobs its heavy tail at opponents when it is in a fight. Its tail is deceptively heavy and can knock out small Pokémon with a hit or two.

entry: POKENAME最爱宝芬。先卖萌让训练家放松戒备，再用耳朵抓走宝芬盒，笨拙地跳着逃跑。
author: lampent12
source: POKENAME's favorite food are Poffins. After getting a Trainer to drop their guard with their cute act, they grab the Poffin case with their ears and awkwardly hop away.

entry: POKENAME用软绒四肢擦除病毒。可绒毛本身的代码，反而常让病毒运作得更高效。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME rubs its fluffy limbs on viruses in order to clean and remove them. Unfortunately, this frequently makes the viruses more efficient due to the code that its fluff is composed of.

entry: POKENAME虽小巧可爱，耳击却威力惊人。全力施展，轻易就能击碎岩石。
author: mepp.
source: Though POKENAME appears small and cute, its ears pack a devastating punch. At full power, they can shatter rocks with ease.

entry: POKENAME很容易寂寞，要始终有陪伴才能安心。哪怕只过一小时没牵着谁的手，就会焦躁。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME gets lonely easily and needs constant companionship to feel at ease. It will get very antsy if it goes even an hour without at least holding someone's hand.

entry: 寄居在胡萝卜形的石头里，让胆小易惊的POKENAME十分困扰。饥饿的小动物常来靠近，迫使它显形自卫，再赶紧逃去别处。
author: sk372
source: Inhabiting a carrot-shaped stone causes problems for the meek and jumpy POKENAME. Hungry critters approach it often, forcing it to manifest and defend itself before quickly fleeing elsewhere.

entry: POKENAME卷起大嘴，再猛然弹开，将自己送上天空。在孩子身旁，它们总努力闭紧嘴，免得吓到对方。
author: santon5512
source: By coiling their large mouths and rapidly uncoiling them, POKENAME can launch themselves into the air. When around children, these Pokémon always make an effort to keep their jaws shut so as not to scare them.

entry: 古书声称，POKENAME毛发织成的衣物，能赐人重塑现实的力量。反复实验早已否定这传说，可民间仍在流传。
author: .izik
source: Ancient tomes claim garments woven from POKENAME's fur could give someone the power to reshape reality itself. Repeated experiments have disproven these legends, though the myths persist in folklore.

entry: 厚实的绒毛与坚固的甲壳，让POKENAME防御力出众。它们偏爱鼠曲草类植物与香蒲。
author: frokachu
source: With a combination of thick wool and a sturdy shell, POKENAME have powerful defenses They prefer eating cottonweeds and cattail plants.

entry: POKENAME身上植物的叶片极软，却不容易摸到。除非受信任的训练家，其他人一碰，POKENAME就会蹦着扭开。
author: hophoppip
source: The foliage of POKENAME's plants is extremely soft to touch, but its difficult to do so, as POKENAME will jump and squirm away when touched by anyone other than a trusted Trainer.

entry: POKENAME不爱暴力，又胆小，鲜少拔刃。受到威胁，通常只会迅速用剑鞘敲一下，再全速逃跑。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is nonviolent and rather timid, so seeing it unsheathe its blade is a rare sight. If threatened, it instead defaults to hitting something with its scabbard quickly before fleeing at top speed.

entry: POKENAME剃下身上绒毛，盖住钢刃。有人认为，吸水的软毛能防止刀刃生锈。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME cover their steel blades with tufts of fur they shave from their bodies. It has been suggested that this absorbent fur keeps their blades from rusting.

entry: POKENAME用敏锐听觉作战，有些在全黑中也能应敌。POKENAME身体与脚上的利刃，颜色虽与毛相同，却是锋利的金属。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME use their keen sense of hearing in combat, and some can use it to fight in total darkness. Despite being the same color as its fur, the blades on POKENAME's body and feet are made of sharp metal.

entry: POKENAME春季换毛，走到哪里，都留着棉球。它虽可爱，电击威力却远近闻名，低估它往往会吃亏。
author: fiordaliso
source: When POKENAME sheds its fur in spring, it leaves cotton balls everywhere it goes. Despite its cute appearance, it is a Pokémon renowned for the power of its electric attacks, and underestimating it is often a mistake.

entry: POKENAME越安心，柔软触角就越舒展。被好好照顾的POKENAME走路一步一跳，触角随腾空而飘舞，这景象深受人们喜爱。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME unfurl their soft feelers the less nervous or scared they feel. A well-cared-for POKENAME bounces with every step, its feelers fluttering around as it moves through the air; this is a sight beloved by many.

entry: POKENAME极难相处，心有不满就朝周围发泄，把环境夷成荒土。身上的胡萝卜形图案，科学家也不明其意。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is extremely difficult to get along with. It will release any frustrations it harbors on the nearby environment, leveling them back to a barren, earthen state. Scientists are unsure of the reason behind the carrot-shaped designs on its body.

entry: POKENAME靠耳击推动岛屿，横越海洋。古老神话称，月亮的坑洞，正是POKENAME在地上展开双耳、将自己弹得太高所造成。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME is able to move islands across seas by pushing them with the impact of its ears. Ancient myths have stated that the craters on the moon were caused by POKENAME bounding itself too high into the sky when unfurling its ears on the ground.

entry: POKENAME身上看似蓬松的部分，装满极细的铜丝。铜丝锐利无比，千万别随意碰触。
author: .izik
source: The fluffy-looking portions of POKENAME's body are filled with thin copper wires. These wires are incredibly sharp, making contact with these areas strongly discouraged.

entry: POKENAME的毛会随月相改变粗细，满月时最软。人们常在此时将它赠给所爱之人，表达善意。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME's fur changes coarseness depending on the phase of the moon. Their fur is at its softest during a full moon, during which time they are commonly gifted to loved ones as a sign of goodwill.

entry: POKENAME极不听话，也很难亲近别人。它爱吃甜的，却绝不肯分食。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is extremely disobedient and has a hard time warming up to others. It prefers to eat sweet things; sharing food, however, is not an option.

entry: 想让暴怒的POKENAME平静，唯一的办法就是抚摸它。若尚未哄好便停手，POKENAME就会张臂紧抱，让训练家窒息，送上一个“永恒的拥抱”。
author: teatedtiten
source: The only way to calm an enraged POKENAME is to pet it. If a Trainer stops petting it before it calms down, POKENAME will wrap its arms around them and suffocate them as an everlasting hug.

entry: POKENAME耳上的绒毛很黏，一沾衣服就难清掉。耳尖能生出小火驱敌，但维持不了多久。
author: sk372
source: The fluff on POKENAME's ears is sticky and difficult to clean off once stuck to clothing. It can generate small flames at the tips of its ears to ward off attackers, but only for a short time.

entry: 眼睛被蓬松毛发遮住，因此它靠冲撞、咬触，以及伸开长耳，探知周围。
author: lydiaprower8
source: Its eyes are covered by its fluffy fur. Therefore, it tackles, bites, and uncoils its long ears to feel for its surroundings.

entry: 眼睛被蓬松毛发遮住，因此它靠冲撞、咬触，以及伸开长耳，探知周围。
author: lydiaprower8
source: Its eyes are covered by its fluffy fur. Therefore, it tackles, bites, and uncoils its long ears to feel for its surroundings.

entry: 眼睛被蓬松毛发遮住，因此它靠冲撞、咬触，以及伸开长耳，探知周围。
author: lydiaprower8
source: Its eyes are covered by its fluffy fur. Therefore, it tackles, bites, and uncoils its long ears to feel for its surroundings.

entry: 两个头是要好的朋友，相处极佳，总想分享食物照顾彼此。可看不清份量是否分半，常让它吃得过多。
author: lydiaprower8
source: The two heads are great friends and get along tremendously. They try to help each other by sharing their food, but since they can't see if the portion is halved, this Pokémon often overeats.

entry: 两个头是要好的朋友，相处极佳，总想分享食物照顾彼此。可看不清份量是否分半，常让它吃得过多。
author: lydiaprower8
source: The two heads are great friends and get along tremendously. They try to help each other by sharing their food, but since they can't see if the portion is halved, this Pokémon often overeats.

entry: 它常好心办坏事，因为两只手其实是头，不受控制，动不动就咬。
author: lydiaprower8
source: This Pokémon often causes havoc even when they have good intentions. This is because the two heads it has for hands are uncontrollable and often bite.

entry: POKENAME用圆瞳凝视训练家，哄对方给零食。若不先给吃的，就不让摸毛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME beguile Trainers into giving them treats by staring at them with their Baby-Doll Eyes. They stop Trainers from petting their fur if they refuse to give them a treat first.

entry: 传说，谁在半空接住跳跃的POKENAME，就能实现愿望。但若心愿邪恶自私，POKENAME便会挥耳揍人，再逃进最近的森林。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: According to legend, anyone who catches POKENAME mid-jump will have their wishes granted. But if the person's wish is wicked and selfish, POKENAME will punch them with its ears and flee into the nearest forest.

entry: POKENAME懒得出奇，每天睡20小时，只为吃饭才醒。睡时双耳卷起，却可能突然弹开，力道足以打穿树干。
author: chibitales
source: Incredibly slothful, POKENAME sleeps for 20 hours a day and only wakes to eat. Its ears coil as it sleeps and can spring out suddenly with enough power to punch a hole through a tree trunk.

entry: POKENAME收集可可多拉进化后丢下的甲片，穿戴起来，保护柔软脆弱的身体免遭捕食。
author: _snakeywakey_
source: POKENAME collects discarded armor pieces from evolved Aron. It wears this armor to protect its soft, vulnerable body from predators.

entry: POKENAME伸长耳朵，击碎陡峭山路的大石。厚毛能抵挡猛烈暴风雪，让它继续修行。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME extends its ears to shatter large boulders along steep mountain paths. Its thick fur protects it during harsh blizzards so it can continue training.

entry: POKENAME獠牙太小，战斗派不上大用，便拿来拨松毛团，如人使用梳子与刷子。
author: bradlybro199
source: The tusks of a POKENAME are much too small to be used effectively in battle. Instead, it uses them to loosen tufts of fur, much like a person would use a brush or comb.

entry: 它用长獠牙修剪、梳理卷曲的软毛，也会定期磨牙，吃富含维生素的蔬菜，保养獠牙。
author: cait_sith
source: It uses its long tusks to trim and comb its curly, fluffy fur. It also maintains the tusks themselves through regular sharpening and vitamin-rich veggies.

entry: POKENAME的激素分泌，转眼就可能剧变，行为与成长速度都难预料。不过，几乎每只POKENAME都爱吃烤好的树果。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's hormone production levels can vary dramatically from moment to moment, so its behavior and rate of growth are unpredictable. Almost every POKENAME, however, loves a good roasted Berry.

entry: POKENAME不仅能以惊人的速度逃离捕食者，每团棉絮般的毛簇也都能猛然出拳，快得让人眼花。它们的毛能做成最柔软的枕头。
author: wormspawn
source: In addition to the striking speed at which POKENAME can flee from predators, each of its cotton-like tufts can lash out with a dizzying punch. Their fur makes the softest pillows.

entry: POKENAME天生好斗、难相处，又一根筋，稍不如意就暴走。一点不快便迁怒训练家，等真正懂得珍惜对方，便会进化。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is naturally aggressive, disagreeable, and single-minded, and rampages if it doesn't get exactly what it wants. If it feels even remotely upset, it will take its anger out on its Trainer; when it properly appreciates them, it evolves.

entry: POKENAME软毛上覆着神经毒素，可能使人四肢麻痹。阿罗拉多次发生不知情游客试图抚摸的事件后，野生POKENAME聚集的海滩便限制公众进入。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME's soft fur is coated with a neurotoxin that may cause paralysis in one's limbs. Due to several incidents where clueless tourists in Alola tried to pet it, beaches where wild POKENAME gather have been restricted to the public.

entry: POKENAME背上长出并种下蘑菇，外形触感都毛茸茸。成年宝可梦嫌它难吃，幼小宝可梦却很爱拿POKENAME的蘑菇当点心。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME grows and plants mushrooms from its back that have a distinctly fuzzy look and texture to them. Though adult Pokémon find the taste repulsive, young Pokémon adore snacking on POKENAME's shrooms.

entry: POKENAME装成温暖的人类房屋，将其他宝可梦困在体内。人类孩子偶尔也误当玩具屋，被困进去。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME trap other Pokémon inside their bodies by pretending to be a cozy human home. Human children occasionally get trapped inside, believing POKENAME to be a dollhouse.

entry: POKENAME贪玩又忠诚，是出色的伙伴。软毛其实由极细的岩石晶体纺成纤维。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME makes for an excellent companion; it has a playful nature and is extremely loyal. Its soft fur is actually made of very thin rock crystals that are spun out into fibres.

entry: 据说POKENAME拥有世上最可爱动听的嗓音。可惜生性害羞，总无法好好唱出来。
author: hexx_vixtar
source: POKENAME is said to have the cutest and most beautiful voice in the world. Unfortunately, its shy nature prevents it from properly singing.

entry: POKENAME背上堆着蓬松的绒球。它对震动极敏感，POKENAME全身仿佛都是耳朵，几乎无法悄悄靠近。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's back is covered with a pile of fluffy puffballs. It is so sensitive to vibrations that POKENAME's entire body functions like an ear, making it almost impossible to sneak up on.

entry: POKENAME住在有林木的河湖岸边。平时少动，一察觉危险，却能敏捷得出奇地弹身逃走。
author: opossiblymage
source: POKENAME resides by forested lakeshores or riversides. It is fairly sedentary but springs away with surprising agility when it senses danger.

entry: POKENAME初看无害，孢子却一碰就使肌肉无力。人抱过POKENAME便晕乎乎，不是开心过头，而是中了孢子的招。
author: quackquackattack
source: While POKENAME may not seem threatening at first, but their deleterious spores cause muscle weakness on contact. The swooning that occurs after a person hugs a POKENAME is caused by the spores and not because of excitement.

entry: 夏天，POKENAME开心撒出多余绒毛，庆祝天气转暖。农人收起顺溪漂下的毛，织成冬用的手套围巾。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: During the summer, POKENAME gleefully scatter their spare fluff to celebrate the warmer weather. Farmers collect the fluff that drifts down streams to weave into gloves and scarves for winter.

entry: 鼻孔喷烟时，卷起或展开耳朵，就能改变声音高低。POKENAME满足时，会借此向别人“唱歌”。
author: sk372
source: Curling and uncurling its ears lets it create a different pitch of sound when it expels smoke from its nostrils. POKENAME will "sing" to others using this ability when it feels content.

entry: POKENAME柔软的身体，甜滑得如卷卷耳坚果冰沙。它不只甜，还爱在咖啡店帮忙，因为可以和新奇的宝可梦一起摆姿势。
author: quackquackattack
source: The soft bodies of POKENAME are as sweet and smooth as a Nutty Buneary Frappé. Not only are POKENAME sweet but also enjoy working in cafes because they get to pose with new and interesting Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME不停挖地下通道，让整个群体往来更快。谁靠近洞穴，就会被坚实耳朵重击赶走。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME constantly digs underground tunnels to speed up the movement of every member of its colony. If anyone approaches its burrows, it drives them away with powerful blows from its sturdy ears.

entry: POKENAME若不定期吃胡萝卜，就会剧烈头痛。吃不到最爱的食物时，常能见到它揉着太阳穴。
author: .izik
source: If POKENAME does not eat carrots regularly, it develops intense headaches. It is often seen rubbing its temples when deprived of its favorite food.

entry: POKENAME耳朵敏锐，连别人的想法都听得见。它卷耳、展耳，调准想听的思绪，始终留意攻击的冲动，警戒危险。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME's ears are sensitive enough to hear the thoughts of others. They curl and uncurl their ears to tune in on specific thoughts, remaining constantly aware of danger by listening out for aggressive impulses.

entry: POKENAME的种子喷出小团孢子，吸入很危险。可孢子长出的蘑菇，却对当地生态相当有益。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's bulb puffs out small clouds of spores that are quite dangerous to breathe in. However, the mushrooms that spawn from these spores are actually quite beneficial to the local ecosystem.

entry: POKENAME骷髅般的蘑菇，摸着柔软如海绵。阿罗拉的许多厨师，都珍视这份食材，用来熬制浓汤。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's skull-like mushroom is soft and spongy to the touch. In Alola, many chefs prize it as an ingredient for hearty stews.

entry: POKENAME吃林地腐叶，发酵成臭气，托起身体，再从气孔一阵阵排气，推动前进。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME feeds on rotting leaves from the forest floor. It ferments these into a foul-smelling gas that lifts it into the air and moves itself around by releasing puffs of its gas from pores.

entry: POKENAME藏在小片菌丛间，耐心等进化。头上的蘑菇为POKENAME提供不可少的养分与热量。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME hides amongst small mushroom colonies, patiently waiting for evolution. The mushroom on its head provides essential nutrients and warmth for POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME将孢子混进伤害植物的毒气，令长出的真菌在腐烂草木上繁盛。有人借POKENAME清除田中杂草，翌年再种作物或花。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME releases spores within a gas that is toxic to plants, enabling the fungus they grow into to flourish on the rotting vegetation. Some people use POKENAME to clear fields of weeds, replanting crops or flowers the next year.

entry: POKENAME住在浓密海带林，吃海底枯海带。遇上天敌，就从嘴里喷出孢子，迷住对方眼睛，趁隙逃走。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME live in dense kelp forests, consuming dead kelp off the seafloor. These Pokémon shoot puffs of spores from their mouths at predators, blinding them long enough to escape.

entry: POKENAME通常待在河湖较深处，主要吃泥与苔藓。额上蘑菇越大，就说明POKENAME吃得越好。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME usually keeps to the lower depths of ponds and lakes, feeding primarily on mud and moss. Larger mushrooms on its forehead indicate a well-fed POKENAME.

entry: 它主要吃落地腐烂的水果与树果。可POKENAME仍会抽空用触角为花田授粉，确保家园美丽。
author: ludacriswell
source: This Pokémon largely feeds on fallen, decomposing berries and fruit. Still, POKENAME takes time to pollinate flower fields with its antennae to ensure that it has a beautiful environment to inhabit.

entry: POKENAME脸朝下扎进土里，花数小时慢慢嚼食软土。若被踩到，就放出有害孢子云自卫。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME plants itself face-down in the dirt, spending hours slowly chewing on the soft soil it lays upon. Stepping on it causes it to release a cloud of noxious spores in self-defense.

entry: POKENAME大半生将身体藏在灌丛，装成蘑蘑菇。受惊时，便以暗藏的毒刺突击，再喷毒孢子压倒来敌。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME spends most of its life hiding its body in brush and pretending to be a Shroomish. When frightened, it strikes with its hidden stinger and sprays toxic spores to overwhelm the threat.

entry: POKENAME像方块蘑菇，走到哪儿就撒下方形孢子。孢子若碰上电脑，就会植入占空间的软件，直到电脑里塞满蘑菇图片。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME look like a blocky mushroom and produce cube-shaped spores wherever they go. If these spores reach a PC, they infect the machine with bloatware until the PC is full of pictures of mushrooms.

entry: POKENAME虽慢且弱，受威胁仍能放出毒孢子云。尾尖的蘑菇，似乎可以吃。
author: craigprime
source: Although slow and weak, POKENAME can release a cloud of poisonous spores when threatened. The mushroom at the tip of its tail is apparently edible.

entry: POKENAME吊在树梢，准备进化。少数偏爱倒挂，脸上表情因此变得截然不同，十分滑稽。
author: craigprime
source: Suspended in treetops and preparing for evolution, a small number of POKENAME prefer to hang upside-down. This creates a drastic yet humorous change in the expression on their face.

entry: 它睡在树下，看着就像巨大的蘑菇。POKENAME放出毒孢子，确保附近没有东西打扰睡眠。
author: bacondlx
source: This Pokémon appears to be a colossal mushroom while sleeping at the base of trees. POKENAME releases toxic spores to ensure nothing nearby disturbs its rest.

entry: POKENAME模样友好，成群时却出了名地凶。一靠近巢穴，转眼就会被孢子与POKENAME层层包围。
author: craigprime
source: Although friendly in appearance, a swarm of POKENAME is notoriously aggressive. Targets will quickly find themselves surrounded in both spores and POKENAME if they approach their nest.

entry: POKENAME毫无重量地飘过密林树冠，撒下发光的超能力孢子，让附近宝可梦一同坠入鲜明梦境。在那里，POKENAME随心顽皮地扭曲现实。
author: msdawgs
source: POKENAME float weightlessly through dense jungle canopies, spreading glowing psychic spores. These particles plunge nearby Pokémon into a shared, vivid dreamscape where POKENAME playfully bend reality at will.

entry: POKENAME在树根下筑巢，只有不见太阳才出门。来敌若伸进巢穴，它就拼命振翅，将毒孢子撒进空中。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME makes its nests under tree roots and will only leave when the sun isn't out. If an attacker tries to reach the nest, it will frantically flap its wings, releasing poisonous spores into the air.

entry: 柔软的球状部位上，长着猕猴桃般细细的绒毛。即使林中最暗处，它竖起细毛，也能判断时间。
author: quackquackattack
source: It has tiny, fuzzy, kiwi-like hairs atop its bulb, which is soft to the touch. Even in the darkest parts of a forest, it is able to determine the time by standing its tiny hairs.

entry: POKENAME将孢子撒遍河流与沼泽，因此，它栖息的地方，附近很少有其他宝可梦生活。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME scatters spores all over rivers and swamps. As a result, not many Pokémon live near its habitat.

entry: POKENAME发电不靠阳光，而是吃叶子，让身上的真菌将食物转为电能。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME doesn't need sunlight to produce its electricity. Instead, it nibbles on leaves and lets the fungus that grows on its body convert its food into electrical energy.

entry: POKENAME受惊时，会从头部喷出催眠孢子。用量过多虽危险，人们仍常借POKENAME的孢子，好好睡上一晚。
author: mistymagius
source: When frightened, POKENAME will puff out a cloud of sleep-inducing spores from its head. While dangerous in high doses, people will often use POKENAME's spores to help them get a good night's sleep.

entry: POKENAME捡来其他宝可梦丢弃的蛋壳，遮护软身。长大后，还吃富钙的壳，补充矿物，帮助成长。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME use the discarded shells of other Pokémon eggs as a way to shield their soft bodies. They use the calcium-rich shells as a source of minerals as they grow older, helping to fuel their growth.

entry: 周围充满欢乐，POKENAME便释放黄色孢子，强迫别人微笑。效果缓缓消退，留下奇异的平静。
author: .izik
source: When surrounded by joy, POKENAME emits yellow spores that forces others to smile. The effect fades slowly, leaving behind an odd sense of calm.

entry: 蘑蘑菇与波克比的融合体耗尽蛋壳能量后，必须吸取其他生命的能量。不过，积累足够的美好经历，就能进化为POKENAME，只靠正面情绪生活，因此POKENAME很爱交际。
author: bobosmith01
source: Once Shroompi drains all the energy from its eggshell, it has to get energy from other living things. However, with enough positive experiences, it evolves into POKENAME, and lives purely off positive emotions. Therefore, POKENAME is quite social.

entry: 夜一来，POKENAME便外出找小蘑菇，储进巢里。它吃的菇没有毒，因此采菇人常来寻找POKENAME的巢。
author: mistymagius
source: Once night falls, POKENAME will go out hunting for small mushrooms to store in its nests. Since the mushrooms it eats are non-toxic, foragers often search for a POKENAME nest.

entry: POKENAME住在阴暗森林，夜里嚼食腐木，体内的化学反应，便让尾巴发亮。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME resides in shady forests. At night, it munches on rotting wood, causing a chemical reaction in its body that makes its tail glow.

entry: POKENAME把软糖视作同胞，无法忍受它们被吃。有时POKENAME结成大群，闯店“解放”糖果。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME view gummy candy as brethren and despise the thought of them being eaten. POKENAME sometimes form into large packs, breaking into stores to liberate the candy.

entry: POKENAME住在湿林，撒下帮助植物生长的孢子。快乐的蛙鸣回荡树间，常预示春天到来。
author: curazy
source: POKENAME lives in damp forests, spreading spores that encourage plant growth. Its cheerful croak echoes through the trees, often signaling the arrival of spring.

entry: POKENAME在一年结霜9个月的地区地下冬眠。霜化后便掘土而出，吃掉湿润泥土。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME hibernate underground in areas where the ground is frosted for 9 months of the year. When the frost thaws, they dig up through the soil, consuming the moist dirt.

entry: POKENAME住在森林，享用湿润的腐殖土。丰富养分，让背上的地星菌长得硕大、健康。
author: cristata
source: POKENAME feast on the damp, composted soil in their forest homes. These vital nutrients keep the Earthstar fungi on their backs healthy and large.

entry: POKENAME悬挂在树枝上，吸取树木的部分养分。吃饱以后，它们便落到地面，释放全部孢子，可能危及路过的训练家。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME hang from tree branches, leeching off of some of the tree's nutrients. Once they are full, they will fall to the ground and release all of their spores, which can be a hazard to passing Trainers.

entry: POKENAME的毒素多存于尾内的囊，再送进各根尖刺，放出团团毒孢子。释放时，尾囊也会缩小。
author: sk372
source: Most of POKENAME's toxins are stored in a sac within its tail. It delivers the toxin to its spines so it can create clouds of toxic spores from its many spikes, its tail sac shrinking as it does so.

entry: 它在林地摇摆着走，吃有机残屑。生气时撒出的真菌孢子，会长成石珊瑚般的蘑菇。
author: hophoppip
source: It waddles across the forest floor, consuming detritus. The fungal spores it releases when agitated grow into mushrooms resembling stony coral.

entry: POKENAME靠滚动前进，沿途散播孢子。一天就能沿超过10英里的路程撒下孢子。
author: melodydelune
source: Rolling around to travel, POKENAME will spread its spores as it goes. In a single day it can plant over 10 miles of spores.

entry: POKENAME甩头发炫耀时，总不慎撒下真菌孢子。嘴唇一贴树皮，还能判断树是否健康。
author: fiordaliso
source: Every time POKENAME shakes its hair to show it off, it inadvertently scatters fungal spores around its location. By pressing its lips against the bark of trees, it can tell whether they are healthy or not.

entry: 春夏看见POKENAME飞过头顶，被视为好运。每次振翅都撒下肥土的孢子，促进草木生长。
author: mega_beedrill
source: It is considered good luck to see a POKENAME fly overhead in the spring and summer. With each wing flap it spreads fertilizing spores, bolstering plant growth.

entry: POKENAME爱把圆蘑菇存进囊袋。平时开朗，谁若拿走蘑菇，就会大发脾气，从头上喷毒孢子。吸入会剧痛难忍。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME likes to collect round mushrooms around in its pouch. While usually a cheerful Pokémon, it will throw a tantrum by releasing toxic spores from its head if anyone takes its mushroom away. The spores cause a great deal of pain if inhaled.

entry: POKENAME吃尽丢弃的剩饭残渣，几乎什么都不拒绝。缓步走动时，孢子便在四周飘扬。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME feasts on the discarded remains of leftover food: there is almost nothing POKENAME will refuse to eat. Whenever it lumbers about, spores flutter around its surroundings.

entry: 野生POKENAME通常避开人眼，住在未被探索的森林。它像其他宝可梦的知心好友，总在暗处给予帮助。
author: bobosmith01
source: Wild POKENAME generally keep themselves hidden away from human eyes and live within unexplored forests. It appears to act as a confidant to other Pokémon and assists them out of sight.

entry: POKENAME体内满是麻痹孢子，能喷向来敌。头或尾若被压得太重，也会撒出，因此训练家抚摸POKENAME时得轻柔。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME are full of paralyzing spores they can expel at threats. Too much pressure on their heads or tails also trigger the spores to spread, so Trainers are advised to be gentle when petting POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME与梦歌仙人掌互利合作：后者嚼沙再吐出，让POKENAME能吃；作为回报，POKENAME白天寻找猎物，留给梦歌仙人掌夜里追踪。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME and Cacturne have developed a protocooperative relationship; Cacturne can chew up and spit out sand in a form in which POKENAME can consume. In return, POKENAME finds prey during the day for Cacturne to stalk at night.

entry: POKENAME挥动头上长叶，向敌人撒出深绿孢子。吸入后，可能妄想、发烧。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME swings the long leaf on its head to release clouds of dark green spores at its foe. If inhaled, these spores can cause delusions and fevers.

entry: POKENAME能安全吃土，最爱肥沃、湿润、腐熟的土壤。也吃干木，既取养分，又给体内火焰添燃料。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME can safely consume soil, favoring rich, damp, and composted soil the most. They also eat dry pieces of wood, which both provides them with nutrients and fuels their internal flames.

entry: POKENAME吃菌类所得的养分，多用来强化双脚，应对危险。遇险可猛跃逃走，也能以同样强劲的踢击自卫。
author: sk372
source: Most of the nutrients POKENAME gains from eating fungi go towards powering its feet in case it runs into danger. When confronted by said danger, it can either escape with powerful leaps or defend itself with equally strong kicks.

entry: POKENAME踢敌时，会将一阵蓝孢子放进空中，反使自己狂乱，踢得毫无章法。
author: .izik
source: When kicking a foe, POKENAME releases a burst of blue spores into the air. This drives itself into a frenzy, causing its kicks to become erratic.

entry: 密林中，POKENAME砸碎树根，挖取下方肥土。还会用脚踩碎落叶堆，方便消化食用。
author: soup1900
source: In thick forests, POKENAME smashes roots to access the nutrient-filled soil below. It crushes up leaf piles with its feet to make them digestible enough for it to eat.

entry: POKENAME往泥堆里填满黄色孢子云。谁一踩上，孢子就会喷满身，引起剧烈咳嗽。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME fills muddy mounds with thick clouds of yellow spores. When stepped on, they burst onto the individual, causing heavy coughing fits.

entry: POKENAME一察觉危险，先把身体埋到只露头，装成普通蘑菇。若来者还逼近，就带着刺激性的孢子云瞬移逃走。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's first instinct when it senses danger is to bury itself up to its head in the soil, acting as a normal mushroom. If something approaches too close, it teleports away in a cloud of agitating spores.

entry: POKENAME在林间蹦跳起舞，双脚敲出小土坑。几天后，坑里便会长出大真菌。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's tapping feet as it prances and dances in the forest dig small divots in the soil. These holes it creates will begin growing large fungi within a few days.

entry: POKENAME让空气充满削弱行动的孢子，保护他人免受威胁。危急时，也允许伙伴藏在裙摆般的身体下。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME protects others from threats by flooding the air with debilitating spores. It allows allies to shield themselves beneath its dress-like body in these tense moments.

entry: POKENAME用舌头在林地拱探，找土中蘑菇。它实在太爱蘑菇，偶尔甚至追猎野生派拉斯。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME roots around with its tongue along the forest floor, in search of mushrooms growing in the soil. Its love of mushrooms has driven it to seek out and hunt Paras in the wild on occasion.

entry: 暴雨后，大群POKENAME现身森林，吃腐熟土壤，腹部的嘴让进食更容易。POKENAME还从头部放毒孢子，趁吃饭时把其他宝可梦赶出林子。
author: darkweavile428
source: After a rainstorm, droves of POKENAME will appear in forests to feast on composted soil, a task made easier by the mouth on their stomachs. POKENAME will release poison spores from their heads to keep other Pokémon out of the forest while they feast.

entry: 河岸若零星布着孢子，往往说明附近住着POKENAME。筑家时被打扰，它们就打喷嚏撒孢子自卫。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: River shores dotted with spores often indicate that POKENAME live nearby. If they are disturbed while making homes, they sneeze out spores to keep themselves safe.

entry: 身上的蘑菇长得飞快。一旦长得太长，就会进化成斗笠花，蘑菇也随之截断。
author: dodoowner_
source: Its mushroom grows at a rapid rate. Once the mushroom grows too long, it evolves into Bresaur and the mushroom gets cut.

entry: POKENAME的大嘴如天然堆肥器，收进落叶与腐果，因此很受园丁喜爱。不过，受惊后撒出的毒孢子，也相当麻烦。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME scoop fallen leaves and decaying fruit into their large mouths, which act as natural composters. These Pokémon are favored by gardeners for this reason, though the toxic spores they release when scared can prove to be troublesome.

entry: POKENAME十分护食，会冲上去头槌一切闯入觅食地的对象。常吃真菌与覆盖料，让它撞击时从菌盖喷出的气体臭得很。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is rather protective of feeding grounds, charging down and headbutting anything that intrudes on it. A large diet of fungi, mulch and the like makes the gas it releases from its cap on impact quite smelly.

entry: POKENAME钻进肥土，给头上的蘑菇补足养分。POKENAME一受惊，就从蘑菇放出黄孢子，让来者剧烈咳嗽。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME burrows into fertile soil so the mushroom growing on its head has enough nutrients. POKENAME releases yellow spores from this mushroom whenever it is startled, causing intruders to suffer from intense coughing fits.

entry: POKENAME壳上的菌丝软弹，却满是危险的绿色孢子。稍一受压，就喷出孢子云，可能引起链球菌性咽炎。
author: .izik
source: The mycelium growing on POKENAME's shell is extremely squishy but filled with hazardous green spores. Even slight pressure on the mycelium releases a cloud capable of causing strep throat.

entry: 以奇特的果实为食，让POKENAME身体有了橡胶特性。它珍藏的蘑菇帽，是进化形态——斗笠菇与烈焰猴的融合体传下的。
author: slimninja55
source: POKENAME's body has rubbery features due to a diet of odd fruit. POKENAME has a cherished mushroom cap passed down by a Brenape, POKENAME's evolved form.

entry: POKENAME伸缩压紧四肢，加快血管中的血液流动，成倍提升身体机能。过程令体温急升，多余热量便化作蒸汽。
author: slimninja55
source: POKENAME has developed a technique of stretching and compressing its limbs to accelerate the flow of its blood vessels, multiplying its physical performance. The process causes its temperature to rise rapidly, producing steam from the excess heat.

entry: POKENAME沿古老林径缓步走，寻找肥沃的腐叶。似乎没什么能让它动摇。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME plods along ancient forest trails, searching for nutrient-rich leaf litter. Nothing seems to faze it.

entry: 它淘气地藏在蘑菇丛间，等待敌人靠近，再用锐利的金属肢体伏击。受威胁时，POKENAME会放出使敌人混乱或入睡的孢子，趁机逃走。
author: thepandasharky
source: This mischievous Pokémon hides among mushrooms, waiting to ambush foes with its sharp, metallic limbs. When threatened, POKENAME releases spores that cause confusion or puts opponents to sleep, giving it a chance to escape.

entry: POKENAME周身不断生出飘带般的孢子流，促进领地菌类生长，也能自卫。受到攻击，便能迷住或刺激来犯者的感官。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME constantly generates ribbon-like streams of spores from its body. It uses these to help fungal growth in its home territory, as well as acting as a method of self-defense, blinding or agitating an attacker's senses when struck.

entry: POKENAME住在臭氧层，从高空撒孢子，从不落地。浓度够高时，孢子会凝成彩云，毒害或麻痹穿云的宝可梦。
author: milchik
source: POKENAME lives in the ozone layer, spreading its spores from high up and never landing on the ground. If the concentration of released spores is high enough, they can form colorful clouds that poison or paralyze Pokémon flying through them.

entry: POKENAME吐出从地面采来、半消化的叶子，让带咸味的菌丝遍布洞穴。资源短缺的季节，这便是群体的食物。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spreads a salty-smelling mycelium throughout its cave by spitting out half-digested leaves gathered from the surface. This serves as food for its swarm during seasons when resources are scarce.

entry: POKENAME从头上喷孢子。吸入会有多种反应，例如大笑不止、恐惧，或暴怒。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME spouts spores from its head. If inhaled, it can cause many different effects, such as uncontrollable laughter, feelings of dread, and intense rage.

entry: POKENAME看着虽小，作战却强劲，只凭双腿就能重击，同时散播孢子。它以波导与别人交流。
author: lydiaprower8
source: Though small in appearance, POKENAME is mighty in battle, able to deliver blows using only its legs, spreading spores in the process. It uses its aura to communicate with others.

entry: POKENAME最喜欢一口吞下一整丛灌木，再用一整天慢慢咀嚼。兴高采烈时，它会从头顶的喷口，短促地喷出一股花粉和种子。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's preferred eating method is to consume an entire bush in one bite, chewing on it over the course of the whole day. When elated, it spews a short spout of pollen and seeds from a spout atop its head.

entry: POKENAME不快时，就撒下带电的孢子云。一碰物体便啪地爆开，吓退天敌。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME releases clouds of spores when they are upset. These spores are charged with electricity and pop whenever they make contact with other objects, scaring away predators.

entry: POKENAME常蜷在落叶里。遇险便射出麻痹孢子，转身逃跑。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME can be found curled up in fallen leaves. When it faces danger, it shoots paralyzing spores and runs off.

entry: POKENAME喜欢聚在电力设施旁，吸取充沛电能。它们在变压器附近聚集撒孢子，常不慎引起短路，造成聚落停电。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME like gathering near electrical infrastructure for the high amounts of electrical energy. They trigger blackouts in communities by gathering and spreading their spores near transformers, often inadvertently triggering electrical shorts.

entry: POKENAME住在湿洞与森林，吃湿土及丰富矿物。POKENAME抖身撒孢子，会长出坚如铁的蘑菇，煮过却很软嫩。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME nest within humid caves and forests, feeding on the damp soil and rich minerals they find. When POKENAME shake their bodies, they scatter fungal spores that cause iron-hard mushrooms to grow; when cooked, these mushrooms become very tender.

entry: POKENAME太盼着进化，只好用头撞硬树干，发泄日渐增长的焦躁。每次撞击都会撒下孢子，让苔藓长得更健康。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is so eager to finally evolve that it has to vent its growing restlessness by ramming its head against sturdy tree trunks. Every time it crashes into them, it releases fungal spores that help the moss grow healthier.

entry: POKENAME每跳一次，头上就冒一小团孢子。药师常养POKENAME，因为孢子有多种药效。
author: mistymagius
source: Every time POKENAME hops, it releases a small puff of spores from its head. Apothecaries often keep a POKENAME around, as its spores have various medicinal properties.

entry: POKENAME天性胆小，多数时候独处。它在温暖潮湿处筑巢，吃湿润腐熟的土与苔藓，双臂球菌相碰，就撒出浓浓的花粉。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are inherently timid and keep to themselves most of the time. They nest within damp, warm areas and feed on damp, composted soil and moss. By clashing the spherical fungi upon their arms together, they scatter thick pollen around themselves.

entry: POKENAME以藤蔓般的长臂缠住孩子，再朝对方放出晶亮的蓝孢子。强烈的疲惫让受害者沉睡，任它带走。
author: .izik
source: After wrapping its long vine-like arms around a child, POKENAME releases a cloud of shimmering blue spores onto them. This induces intense exhaustion, causing the victim to fall into a deep sleep as they are taken away.

entry: POKENAME总是三个叠在一起行动，时刻小心不分开。只要分开，三个都会虚弱、迷糊。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME walks as a collective trio, being careful to remain stacked together at all times. The three will get very weak and discombobulated if something causes them to separate.

entry: 顶端那个究竟在笑，还是只是倒放着，研究者一直争论不休。
author: elite01.
source: There is a large debate amongst researchers on whether or not the top is smiling or simply upside down.

entry: POKENAME住在湿洞，喝洞壁渗下的水。尾巴像吸盘，轻易就能贴住湿滑表面。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME live in damp caves, drinking the water seeping from the cave walls. Their tail acts like a suction cup, allowing them to stick to slippery surfaces with little effort.

entry: POKENAME生活在湿林地，吐丝包住猎物，带回巢中。它在巢旁种小蘑菇园，再让毒孢子覆住身体，保护自己。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME live on the damp forest floor, wrapping up its prey in its silk and then taking them back to its den. It cultivates little mushroom gardens around its den, covering itself in their toxic spores for protection.

entry: POKENAME成群迁徙，双翼撒出多彩孢子云。云在日下闪亮，吸入却可能有害。
author: .izik
source: Flocks of POKENAME scatter multicolored spore clouds from their wings while migrating. These clouds sparkle in the sunlight, but can be hazardous to breathe in.

entry: POKENAME身上的绿茎属于稀有真菌，吃下可能高烧、起疱。可据说，它们的孢子又能给多数菜肴添上美妙的辣味。
author: mistymagius
source: The green stems on POKENAME's body belong to a rare species of fungus that, when consumed, can cause severe fevers and blistering. However, their spores are said to add a nice, spicy flavor to most dishes.

entry: POKENAME受惊就张开头边褶饰，射出孢子。孢子会带来灼烧般的痛感。
author: northkira
source: When startled, POKENAME expands the frills around its head, shooting off spores. These spores give a sensation of burning.

entry: POKENAME吃足水晶，就喷出一团晶体孢子。孢子长成水晶蘑菇，为其他吃宝石的宝可梦提供养分。
author: periperi_chicken
source: When POKENAME eat enough crystals, they will send out a puff of crystalline spores. These spores will grow into crystal mushrooms, which provide nutrients to other gem eating Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME的孢子剧毒，若不尽快处理，可能昏倒。不过，研究者正测试这些孢子，能否用作其他孢子攻击的解药。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's spores are incredibly toxic and can cause fainting if not treated quickly. However, researchers have been testing if its spores could be used as an antidote for other spore attacks.

entry: POKENAME背上长着大蘑菇，吸取本体的养分。一经碰触，有害孢子便散入空中。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a large mushroom on their back that leeches nutrients from their body. Contact with it causes noxious spores to spread through the air.

entry: POKENAME身体光滑，像橡胶，连羽毛也像胶球般会弹。舞动时，全身仿如果冻，按难以预测的节奏抖动。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME's body feels smooth and rubbery, even its feathers bounce like rubber balls. When it dances, its whole body jiggles in an unpredictable rhythm, similar to jelly.

entry: POKENAME进食前，先朝垃圾喷一阵绿色腐蚀孢子，将垃圾化成液体，更容易消化。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME sprays a corrosive burst of green spores on trash before eating. This liquefies the garbage to make it more easily digested.

entry: POKENAME由致密的有机物与蘑菇构成，不断寻找腐物吸收，转成能量。住处不同，身上长的蘑菇也不同。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME's body is made of dense organic material and mushrooms. They continually seek out sources of rotting material to absorb, converting the mass into energy. Different varieties of mushrooms grow on their body depending on where they live.

entry: POKENAME住在穿过丛林的长河，在水中撒毒孢子。谁喝下，就会病上一周。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME spreads toxic spores in the water it resides in. Anyone who drinks it becomes sick for a week. It can be found in long rivers through jungles.

entry: 正确处理POKENAME头上的叶子，就能制成治愈百病的药。可只要错一步，药液就毒得连树木杂草都会枯萎。
author: darkweavile428
source: If prepared correctly, the leaves on POKENAME's head become a medicine that can cure any illness. However, a single mistake in the process will leave you with a concoction so toxic it makes trees and weeds wilt.

entry: POKENAME双耳轰出声波时，身体也同时喷出大团孢子云。吸入这些孢子，可能麻痹。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME releases sound bursts from its ears, a large cloud of spores erupts from its body simultaneously. These spores can cause paralysis if inhaled.

entry: POKENAME看似枝叶，睡觉便藏在灌丛求安全。蘑蘑菇也常聚在它下方，保暖又避险。
author: sk372
source: With an appearance similar to foliage, POKENAME hides among the shrubs for safety when it needs to sleep. Shroomish will often gather underneath it as well for warmth and safety.

entry: POKENAME本体是长得很快的霉菌，住在海滩与游艇码头旁。若找不到船锚生长，就黏到小船底部。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's true body is comprised of a fast-growing mold. It lives near beaches and marinas. If it can't find an anchor to grow off of, it will latch to the underside of small boats.

entry: 有人踏进海滩，POKENAME就放出深红孢子云。吸入太久，会剧烈抽搐。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body puffs out clouds of crimson spores whenever someone enters its beach. Breathing these in for too long can cause violent convulsions.

entry: 菌落太重，POKENAME几乎挪不动。背上蘑菇满是毒孢子，稍一碰触就会裂开。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME can barely move around due to the sheer weight of its fungal colony. The mushrooms on its back are filled with toxic spores and will burst open at the slightest touch.

entry: POKENAME挖林地湿土吃。POKENAME背上的蘑菇占满了本该长内脏的地方，连脑的位置也不例外，它却仍和其他草属性宝可梦一样正常活动。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME digs up damp soil from the forest floor to eat. The mushroom on POKENAME's back fills the space where its internal organs should be, including its brain, but it seems to function just as well as any other Grass-type Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME爱吃枯叶，常受雇清理花园与富人的庄园。晒太阳时若被打扰，就从头上小真菌喷出麻痹粉。
author: fiordaliso
source: Because of its habit of feeding on dead leaves, POKENAME is often employed to keep gardens or the estates of wealthy landowners clean. If disturbed while basking in sunlight, it sprays a paralyzing powder from the little fungus on its head.

entry: POKENAME白天游走南瓜田，找到病南瓜，就在附近撒孢子，帮助植株恢复。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME wanders pumpkin patches during the day. When it finds a sick pumpkin, it scatters spores nearby to help the plant recover.

entry: POKENAME长在码头里，躲避比自己强大的海中宝可梦。为免被水手赶走，它吃掉停泊船只湿木上的霉烂，帮忙清理船壳。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME grows within the docks to avoid being hunted by sea Pokémon that are bigger and stronger than it. To avoid being chased away by sailors, it cleans the hulls of moored ships by feeding on the rotten mold that has settled on the wet wood.

entry: POKENAME从林中跑进城市，搜寻食物与闪亮小物，带回巢里。它很难讨好，烦得过头，连训练家也会被喷上一脸刺激性粉末。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME ventures from its forest home to cities to scrounge for food and shiny trinkets, which it then takes back to its den. It is known to be hard to please and will even puff irritating powder at its Trainer if it gets overly annoyed.

entry: POKENAME全身覆着麻痹粉，不让别人碰。野外，它藏在灌丛，等准时机伏击猎物。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME's body is coated in paralyzing dust that prevents others from touching it. In the wild, it lurks among bushes to ambush prey at just the right moment.

entry: 研究者见过它在城堡护城河筑巢，静水让它活得很好。POKENAME挥动木杖，便能在数米内撒下麻痹孢子。
author: fiordaliso
source: Researchers have observed its habit of building nests in the moats of castles, where stagnant water allows it to thrive. By waving its wooden scepter, POKENAME can scatter paralyzing spores within a radius of a few meters.

entry: POKENAME每拳都喷出刺激性孢子，削弱敌人。孢子又黏又难洗，许多野生宝可梦宁愿躲开POKENAME，也不想沾上。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME puff out irritating spores with every strike of their fists, debilitating those they're battling. Their spores are sticky and difficult to clean off, with many wild Pokémon preferring to avoid POKENAME rather than deal with the spores.

entry: POKENAME喜欢在洞穴或密林深处的湿土里打盹。在它附近睡着，会做奇幻的梦。
author: danarchist
source: POKENAME prefer to doze in the damp soil found in caves and deep woods. Those who fall asleep near one experience fantastical dreams.

entry: POKENAME常去酒馆，给熟客调酒。它往饮料加一点温和的毒，添上只有老顾客才受得住的辛烈滋味。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME regularly visits taverns, acting as a bartender for frequent customers. It adds trace amounts of mild poisons into its beverages, adding a sharp flavor only experienced patrons can handle.

entry: POKENAME沿河旅行撒孢子，促进苔藓与蘑菇生长。也爱趁别的宝可梦休息，朝它喷水泡恶作剧。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME spreads its spores by traveling along rivers, thereby accelerating the growth of moss and mushrooms. It enjoys playing pranks on other Pokémon by shooting water bubbles at them while they are resting.

entry: POKENAME身体大半是孢子，用触手缚住敌人，再撒毒孢子，使其中毒。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME's body is mostly made up of spores. It ensnares its enemy with its tentacles and then scatters toxic spores to poison them.

entry: POKENAME以长触手捉住猎物，再从头上撒毒粉。许多钓客不慎钓起POKENAME，也会被喷满一脸。
author: darkweavile428
source: POKENAME ensnares its prey with its long tentacles, then releases toxic powder from its head. Many anglers have also gotten a face full of POKENAME's powder after accidently fishing one up.

entry: POKENAME身体大半是孢子，用触手缚住敌人，再撒毒孢子，使其中毒。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME's body is mostly made up of spores. It ensnares its enemy with its tentacles and then scatters toxic spores to poison them.

entry: POKENAME身体大半是孢子，用触手缚住敌人，再撒毒孢子，使其中毒。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME's body is mostly made up of spores. It ensnares its enemy with its tentacles and then scatters toxic spores to poison them.

entry: POKENAME大半天埋在土里。若被打扰，就用藏着的触手撑到最高，吓走来者。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME buries itself in soil throughout most of the day. If bothered, it raises itself up to full height with its hidden tentacles to scare off the intruder.

entry: POKENAME以仿佛用不尽的甲烷推进，传说能快过音速。虽未直接证实，可那屁响般的音爆，实在找不出多少别的嫌疑者。
author: wilmervr
source: Propelled by a seemingly endless supply of methane, POKENAME is rumoured to be capable of reaching supersonic speeds. While such claims have not been directly verified, the flatulent sonic booms leave few other suspects.

entry: 管理员把POKENAME训练成公园与植物园的垃圾清理助手。它睡过的地方，会冒出一小片吃污垢的蘑菇。
author: ozydamians
source: Custodians train POKENAME as trash-collecting assistants for natural parks and botanical gardens. Where it sleeps, small patches of grime-consuming mushrooms sprout.

entry: POKENAME胆小温顺，藏在浅浅的土穴，谁靠近就喷毒孢子。它们结成小群，藏在浅池溪流周围。
author: picses_the_fish
source: POKENAME is a shy and meek Pokémon, hiding in shallow holes it digs in the ground and spewing toxic spores at anything that comes close. They gather in small groups hiding around shallow ponds and streams.

entry: POKENAME伪装成无害的林中花苞，纹丝不动。等宝可梦毫无戒心地走近，就突然爆出有害花粉与阴森窃笑，再悄无声息地跑开。
author: silentscript89
source: POKENAME disguises itself as a harmless forest bud, lying perfectly still until an unsuspecting Pokémon wanders close enough, when it suddenly bursts into a cloud of noxious pollen and sinister snickering before scampering away silently.

entry: POKENAME的蘑菇，可不像引梦貘人的摆锤。让人昏昏欲睡的，其实是蘑菇摇动时撒出的孢子。
author: gp423
source: POKENAME's mushroom does not function in the same manner as Hypno's pendulum. Instead, the spores it emits when swung induce sleepiness.

entry: POKENAME长满真菌的钳子，磨出的粉末已用于护发产品数十年。许多加有这种粉末的洗发水，能滋润受损发丝，恢复活力。
author: .izik
source: The powder created from POKENAME's fungus-covered claws has been used in hair care products for decades. Many shampoos made with it moisturize and revitalize damaged hair.

entry: POKENAME臂上球状部位积满孢子，摇动像沙锤。它用球部砸天敌，迫使对方吸入，引起恶心、困倦等不同反应，随后便迅速钻进沙里。
author: chibitales
source: Spores build in POKENAME's arm bulbs and sound like maracas when shaken. They bash predators with these bulbs, forcing the foe to inhale the spores, which then cause a variety of effects from nausea to drowsiness before quickly burrowing into sand.

entry: 心怀怨恨之人的屋外，常有POKENAME聚集。它们放电烧坏灯泡、使整栋楼短路，只让住户的负面情绪愈发浓重。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME gather near the homes of people experiencing resentment for others. Their electrical discharges frequently blow bulbs and short circuits throughout the building, which will only increase the negative emotions felt by the home's resident.

entry: POKENAME报复心极强，六只小偶组成身体，谁伤了任何一只，都得面对它们的怒火。可若人类爱护任何玩偶，它们又会围过来，抱住那人的脚。
author: heal_fire
source: POKENAME is a very vengeful Pokémon; anyone who damages one of the six little puppets composing this Pokémon will face their wrath. If a human shows love to a doll of any kind, they'll gather around them and hug their feet.

entry: POKENAME将诡异的幽灵之力注入骨棒。抛出去，骨棒竟会自行追向目标，准得离奇。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME imbues the bone it carries with eerie ghostly energy. Once thrown, the bone somehow attempts to home in on its target with uncanny precision.

entry: POKENAME缥缈的身体下，可以看见心脏。心情不同，心脏的颜色与大小也会改变。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME's heart is visible underneath its ethereal body. It can change color and size depending on POKENAME's mood.

entry: POKENAME爱恶意捉弄人，例如用无形屏障困住对方。若是信任的人，它或许会送一把隐形钥匙，解除屏障。
author: pattybgoode
source: POKENAME is known for playing spiteful pranks, such as trapping people in invisible barriers. It might give a person it trusts an invisible key that dispels the barriers.

entry: POKENAME随幽冥的风漂浮，身体轻颤。靠近别的宝可梦，就能飞快甩动尾节，施以痛苦的螫刺。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME flutter as they float, caught in ethereal winds. They can whip their tail segments around quickly when they get close to another Pokémon, delivering a painful sting.

entry: POKENAME在荒屋四周寻找孩子。它渴望陪伴，便在高草中跳跃，盼着引人注意。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME roam around abandoned homes looking for children. They long for companionship and will jump in tall grass in the hopes of getting attention.

entry: POKENAME住在深海富矿的洞窟。火山岛附近的海洋死区，曾记录到体型更大的POKENAME。
author: amberaxolotl223
source: POKENAME can be found in deep, mineral-rich ocean caverns. Larger POKENAME have been documented in dead zones around volcanic islands.

entry: POKENAME善良却害羞，察觉谁有负面情绪，便悄悄跟随，藏着身形吸走这些感受。既改善对方心情，也维持自身生存。
author: sk372
source: Kindhearted yet shy, POKENAME follows after those it senses negative emotions from. It drains these feelings from them while staying hidden, both to help their mood as well as to sustain itself.

entry: 夜色掩护下，POKENAME竖耳寻找争吵的宝可梦，悄悄吃掉纷争背后的恶劣情绪，在局面失控前平息。
author: pkbonusducks
source: Under the cover of night, POKENAME keep their ears open, sleuthing for arguing Pokémon. They will silently consume the foul emotions behind these fights, defusing situations before they get out of hand.

entry: POKENAME周围的浮球，是它制造的奇异幽灵种子。它将种子埋进几乎不见光的土里，便会长出独特的苍白花朵。
author: sk372
source: The orbs that float around POKENAME are a strange type of spectral seed it creates. It plants the seeds in soil largely bereft of light, where it will grow into a uniquely pale type of flower.

entry: POKENAME爱开玩笑吓人，孩子也喜欢在化装会上扮成它。因与来世相通，人们还常见它安慰弥留之人。
author: sottiwotti
source: POKENAME loves to playfully scare people and Pokémon. Children like to dress up as POKENAME at costume parties. Because of their connection to the afterlife, they are often seen comforting people on their deathbed.

entry: POKENAME能持续守望20小时，才需要休息，因此很受巡街警员欢迎。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can remain at vigil for up to 20 hours before it needs rest. Because of this, it is a popular choice among police officers who patrol city streets.

entry: POKENAME是巡街警员喜爱的宠物，动作敏捷，能追上窃贼。夜里也能保持清醒，帮助警员发现可疑动静。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME is a popular pet of police officers who patrol city streets for crime, as its nimble speed helps it chase down burglars. Its ability to remain awake at night gives officers an edge in spotting suspicious activity.

entry: POKENAME只在阴天乘冷风出现。它跳上人头，暂时遮住视线，看着受害者跌跌撞撞，咯咯直笑。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME only appears when it is overcast, riding on the cold winds. It will hop on people's heads to temporarily blind them, cackling as it watches its victims stumble around.

entry: POKENAME通过角吸取负面情绪，鳃便随之长大。它虽诞生于恶意，却意外好相处。常撞上东西，研究者认为，情绪涌动时，会有短暂黑暗遮住视野。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: The gills on POKENAME grow as it absorbs negative emotions through its horn. Though born from malice, it's surprisingly affable. It often bumps into things; researchers believe that brief flashes of darkness cloud its vision when emotions surge.

entry: POKENAME察觉近处的嫉妒，喙便泛红。它静静在上空盘旋，直到情绪散去，或决定进食。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's beak glows red when it detects jealousy nearby. It circles above quietly until the emotion fades or it decides to feed.

entry: POKENAME以深仇制造恐怖幻象，吓唬人类。恐惧被吸进颈边光球，成为它的食物。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME crafts horrifying illusions based on deep grudges to scare humans. It feeds on fear drawn into the glowing orbs around its neck.

entry: POKENAME吸收负面情绪，凝成不断渗出的黑液。味道很苦，奇怪的是，竟有人喜欢。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME absorbs negative emotions and condenses them into a dark, oozing liquid. The substance tastes bitter, but oddly, some people enjoy the flavor.

entry: 夜里，它偷偷拿走受害者的珍贵物品，激起对旁人的怨恨，再吃负面情绪。POKENAME能化为无形，穿过任何墙。
author: fiordaliso
source: At night it secretly steals precious belongings from its victims so it can fuel their resentment toward others and feed on their negative emotions. POKENAME can render its body intangible to slip through any wall.

entry: 火山喷发后，POKENAME在熔岩毁掉的屋舍间爬行，吃失去家园者的怨恨与伤痛，壳里满得尽是负面感情。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME can be found in the aftermath of a volcanic eruption, crawling through the ruins of homes destroyed in the lava flows. They feed off the resentment and loss of those who have lost their homes, their shell bursting with the negative feelings.

entry: POKENAME始终陪伴训练家，同甘共苦。若训练家情绪低落，它便想尽办法逗对方微笑。
author: inksans201x
source: POKENAME stick with their Trainers through thick and thin. If their Trainers are feeling blue, they do what they can to make them grin.

entry: POKENAME性情内向，只喜欢交一两个朋友。陪朋友玩时，会从象鼻吹出幽雾，变成各种形状。
author: sk372
source: Introverted by nature, POKENAME prefers having very small friend groups of one or two other creatures. To play with these friends, it creates shapes using a ghostly fog it blows from its trunk.

entry: POKENAME碰见熟睡者，便将积压的敌意发泄在对方身上。它飘到耳边，用象鼻发出尖利号鸣，等受害者惊醒，自己早消失了。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME takes out its pent-up aggression on sleepers it happens to come across. It floats up just beside their ear before releasing a screeching trumpeting noise from its trunk, vanishing as the victim jolts awake in terror.

entry: 它追求刺激，爱用各种恶作剧，激起别人的强烈反应。头角则像一根避雷针。
author: bobosmith01
source: It is a thrill-seeking Pokémon that likes to provoke extreme reactions from others with all kinds of pranks. Its horn acts like a lightning rod.

entry: POKENAME的真脸藏在紫布下。夜里，它用罩布上的脸惊吓人类与宝可梦，吃对方散发的恐惧。
author: kam_doodle_snek
source: POKENAME's actual face is concealed under the purple sheet. It enjoys scaring Pokémon and people at night using the face on its hood, feeding off the fear and terror that emanates from them.

entry: POKENAME像个怨毒的小灵，似乎随意挑选憎恨的目标。一旦选中，就穿越时间，在受害者人生的不同阶段纠缠折磨。
author: sk372
source: Like a spiteful little spirit, POKENAME chooses a target of its ire seemingly at random. Once a victim is picked, it travels through time to torment and haunt them at various different stages of their life.

entry: POKENAME爱藏在家中各处柜子里。若无缘无故生气，或许是POKENAME正在吃掉你的正面情绪。
author: lampent12
source: POKENAME loves hiding in cabinets throughout the house. If you find yourself mad for no reason, POKENAME may be feeding on your positive emotions.

entry: 为让人类孩子更愿靠近，POKENAME制作小手偶，套在手形尾巴上。用表演逗孩子开心，就是它最快乐的时刻。
author: sk372
