source: In order to make itself more approachable to human children, POKENAME fashions little puppets to go over its hand-like tails. It is happiest when it is entertaining the young ones with its shows.

entry: POKENAME容易寂寞，便给尾巴套上自制玩偶，假装有人作伴。若有机会，也很爱演偶戏，逗幼童开心。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME feels lonesome easily, fashioning puppets to put on its tails to simulate company. It loves being able to entertain young children with puppet shows when given the opportunity.

entry: 夜里，POKENAME附身衣物，折磨想睡的受害者。人们往往变得疑神疑鬼，以为每道影子，都是POKENAME的伪装。
author: mistymagius
source: During the night, POKENAME will possess pieces of clothing and torment its victims while they try to sleep. Its victims are often left in a state of paranoia, thinking every cast shadow is a disguised POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME夜游道路，模仿、嘲笑遇见的敌人。可通常只有自己觉得有趣，演到一半，就被对方揍了。
author: notsaying.
source: Wandering the roads at night, POKENAME will mimic and mock any foes it comes across. It is typically the only one who finds this amusing, as the foe will usually attack POKENAME in the middle of its show.

entry: POKENAME飘过墓地，脑袋转向四面八方，发出阴森呻吟。已确认那只是移动的声响，并非有意吓人。
author: .izik
source: While floating through graveyards, POKENAME's head rotates in all directions as it emits an eerie groaning noise. This has been determined to simply be the sound it makes while moving, rather than an intentional effort to frighten others.

entry: 它夜游丛林，寻找负面情绪。找到显露这些感受的对象，大嘴就伸展张开，吸取能量。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: This Pokémon floats through the jungles at night in search of negative emotions. When it finds something exhibiting these, its mouth stretches open as it absorbs that energy.

entry: POKENAME察觉谁在嫉妒，便先喷水，试着改变心情。若不奏效，就长久待在近处，慢慢吸干那份能量。
author: .izik
source: If it senses envy in someone, POKENAME blasts them with water to shift their mood. If this fails, it slowly drains that energy through prolonged exposure.

entry: 许多寓言将POKENAME写作爱捉弄人的精灵。它能融入黑暗，在眼前消失。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME is featured in many fables as a trickster spirit. It is capable of melting into the darkness, disappearing right before one's eyes.

entry: 人们认为POKENAME爱好和平，只有被挑衅才攻击。它用幽灵之力制造虚幻的骨头，迎击敌人。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME are believed to be pacifist Pokémon, only attacking when provoked. They use ghostly energy to create spectral bones and attack their foes.

entry: POKENAME仗着速度与力量，欺负弱小宝可梦，狠狠打败后，还要嘲弄，吃下挫败与无助的情绪。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses its speed and strength to pick fights with weaker Pokémon and beat them soundly. It taunts them after its victory so that it can feed on the negative emotions of frustration and helplessness.

entry: POKENAME感到有人嫉妒，骷髅般的脸就亮起来。它会找出那人，一路跟随，吃对方放出的负面能量。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's skull-like face glows brightly when it senses a jealous person. It will seek them out and follow them, feeding off the negative energy they emit.

entry: POKENAME的奇异斗篷，碰到什么就吸其力气。它用浮手将猎物压在布上，吸走能量。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME wears a strange cloak that saps strength from anything it touches. It uses floating hands to press prey against the fabric and drain their energy away.

entry: 被怨影龟控制的草苗龟进化时，布质的外皮可能撑破。若能保持完整，就能顺利进化为POKENAME。
author: hellaluyeah
source: When a Turtwig evolves while being controlled by a Shupwig, the fabric skin threatens to tear. If it stays intact, the evolution to POKENAME is complete.

entry: POKENAME以针对某个人的复仇之情为食。吃饱之后，便找到那个人，真正付诸报复。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME feeds on feelings of vengeance against specific people. When it is full, it finds and acts out that revenge on that person.

entry: POKENAME靠负面情绪为食，夜里溜进家，用飘带轻拂睡梦中的人，吸走不快。受害者醒来，反而莫名平静舒畅。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME feeds on negative emotions. It slips into homes at night to brush its ribbons against sleeping people and drain their negativity. Victims wake up feeling oddly calm and refreshed.

entry: POKENAME无声飘过垃圾场，寻找被丢弃的玩偶，把破玩具当珍贵战利品，藏进秘密巢穴。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME levitates silently over landfills, searching for discarded dolls. It hoards these broken toys as prized trophies in its hidden den.

entry: POKENAME夜飞找人恶作剧。得手后，就大吃恶作剧激起的负面情绪。
author: sleepyman0731
source: POKENAME flies at night searching for people to prank. After a successful caper, it will feast on the negative emotions created by its trick.

entry: POKENAME藏在闹鬼大宅，以诡异紫光照亮走廊。谁盯着火焰太久，灵魂就会被偷走。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME hides in haunted mansions, lighting up the hallways with an eerie purple glow. Anyone who stares at its flame for too long will have their soul stolen.

entry: POKENAME徘徊墓地，以新亡的灵魂为火焰供能。夜里会捉弄来访者，想把他们赶走。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME hangs around graveyards, using the recently deceased souls to fuel its flame. During the night, it can be seen playing tricks on any visitors in an effort to get them to leave.

entry: POKENAME出生时，只有一条闪动的小尾巴。幼时吃负面情绪，每目睹一次暴怒，尾巴就分岔。尾巴越多，力量与恶意也越强。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: When born, POKENAME has only one small, flickering tail. It spends its early days feeding on negative emotions, and each time it witnesses an outburst of anger, its tail splits. With every new tail, its power and malice grow.

entry: POKENAME爱坐在浅海底，用傀儡吓附近的游泳者。有人推测，POKENAME灵魂困在傀儡里，拿走傀儡，POKENAME便会死。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME loves to sit on the shallow seafloor and uses its puppet to scare nearby swimmers. It is theorized that POKENAME's soul is stuck in the puppet and that removing it will end POKENAME's life.

entry: POKENAME轻得能随微风飘舞，在半空蹦跃、悬浮。它对进入领地的人十分感兴趣，专找害怕自己的，巨尾在身后鼓动。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are light enough to flutter in the breeze, prancing in the air and floating in place. They show a great amount of interest in people who enter their domain, seeking out those who are afraid of them, their great tail billowing behind them.

entry: 据说，有时夜深，孩子许下特别强烈的心愿，愿望便可能寄入身旁的玩偶，诞生POKENAME。
author: wrenchworx
source: It is said that sometimes in the midst of the night, if a child makes a particularly strong wish, the wish may come to inhabit a doll nearby, and a POKENAME is born.

entry: POKENAME在善妒之人的屋下掘洞，趁他们睡觉，隔着地板吸取负面情绪。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME burrows beneath the homes of envious people. While they sleep, it feeds off their negative emotions through the floorboards.

entry: POKENAME能察觉周围的负面波导，跟随源头，吸走不快。它在影中飞掠，不让人看见。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME is able to sense negative auras of those around it, following and absorbing the negativity from sources. It darts through shadows to remain unseen.

entry: 时常争吵的屋子，花箱里可能长出POKENAME。怒气够浓，POKENAME头上的花苞就会打开。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME have been known to sprout from the planter boxes of houses where arguments are common. The bud on a POKENAME's head opens when it's exposed to lots of anger.

entry: POKENAME由细线松松缝起，受压便容易散开。看见POKENAME内部布料的人会做噩梦，灵异迷便借它诅咒敌人。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are held together by loose stitches of thin thread and easily pull apart under pressure. Seeing the internal fabrics of POKENAME causes the observer to suffer nightmares, and they are used by Hex Maniacs to curse their foes.

entry: POKENAME爱穿墙惊吓其他宝可梦，尤其喜欢呆呆兽与可达鸭。它们太健忘，让POKENAME能日复一日反复吓唬。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME enjoy spooking other Pokémon, phasing through walls as they go in for a scare. Their favorite Pokémon to frighten are Slowpoke and Psyduck, as they are quite forgetful, allowing POKENAME to scare them repeatedly day after day.

entry: POKENAME用意念移动游乐场的玩具，激起孩子嫉妒，再吸取争吵累积的情绪能量。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its mind to move toys in playgrounds, stirring jealousy among children. It absorbs the emotional energy that that builds in their arguments.

entry: POKENAME似乎拥有别的生命少有的视力，天生能隔着实物，看见其他生物的生命力。它通常在寒冷的沙漠之夜，猎取熟睡的生命。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME seem to possess a form of vision that many other living beings don't possess. They can naturally see the life force of other beings even through solid objects. They typically hunt sleeping beings in the cold desert night.

entry: POKENAME披着旧布缝的衣，里面藏着表情各异的面具。戴上一张，就立刻睡着，因此旁边必须有人替佩戴者摘下。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME wears a coat stitched from old fabric, and tucked inside it are masks each bearing a different expression. Wearing one puts the user to sleep instantly, so someone else must be nearby to take it off.

entry: POKENAME躲在角落盯着亮物，确认无人注视，才窜去拿走。耐心与隐秘身手，让盗贼喜欢这伙伴，也让它成了许多疑惧故事的主角。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME lurks in corners watching shiny objects until scampering over to seize its prize once it knows nobody is looking. This patience and stealth has made it popular among thieves as a partner, but also has made it the subject of paranoid stories.

entry: POKENAME靠近生活艰难的人，放出舒缓的催眠粉。等人睡着，便吸掉负面感受，帮助对方好受些。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME approach people who are going through a difficult time in their lives and release a soothing Sleep Powder. Once the person is asleep, they absorb negative feelings to help them feel better.

entry: 满怀复仇心的人若踏进森林，POKENAME便唤醒林木进攻。树木弯曲扭动，抽打来者，保卫领地。
author: .izik
source: If a vengeful person steps into its woods, POKENAME calls on the forest to strike. Trees bend, twist, and lash out to protect its domain.

entry: POKENAME头顶球状部位能感知心怀恶意的人。它被动吸收负面与怨毒的情绪，帮人放下往事。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have bulbs atop their head that are sensitive to people with malice in their hearts. They passively absorb feelings of negativity and spite to help people move on from the past.

entry: POKENAME用声波感知人类情绪，夜里无声飞行，靠大耳寻找悲伤、嫉妒等负面感受，吞食充饥。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME use sound waves to detect human feelings. They fly silently through the night, guided by their large ears to seek out and consume negative emotions like sorrow and envy.

entry: 它以安宁灵魂聚成的云托住自己。POKENAME虽常被误解，待在身边却很舒心。传说，若有超过十只从头顶飘过，就会带来好运。
author: lootererswillbeboated
source: It cushions itself in a cloud of calm souls. Despite what one would think about POKENAME, it is actually very soothing to be around. Legends say if more than ten float overhead, you will have good fortune.

entry: POKENAME吞食周围的负面情绪时，褶边便轻轻飘动。饱餐之后，漂游的身后会拖着一抹幽暗极光。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME feeds on the negative emotions of those around it, signified by the fluttering of its frills. After it has feasted, a dark aurora trails behind it slightly as it floats around.

entry: POKENAME的悲歌，让听者回想痛苦的往事。可等听完，却仿佛卸下了重担。
author: lampent12
source: The song of POKENAME is a sad tune that makes listeners recall painful memories of the past. Afterwards, however, it feels as if their burdens have been lifted.

entry: POKENAME有时被当宠物卖，号称水晶能带来正面能量。其实，它并不制造快乐，只是吃掉不快。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME are sometimes sold as pets, purported as sources of positive energy via their crystals. In reality, they don't induce positive feelings, but they do consume negative ones.

entry: 登山者报告山林里出现神秘蓝光，通常是见到了POKENAME的火。看见的人回来后，往往比先前更愤怒、更嫉妒。
author: leandermalurt
source: When hikers report mysterious blue lights in mountainous forests, they have usually seen the fire of a POKENAME. Those who witness it often return feeling angrier and more envious than before.

entry: 有人走进南瓜田，POKENAME便飘近，默默吃掉对方生命力。过程中，头角会泛出微光。
author: .izik
source: When someone steps into its pumpkin patch, POKENAME drifts near and silently feeds on their life force. Its horn glows faintly during the process.

entry: 这些嗜甜的宝可梦，近来越来越常讨糖，不再自己找野果。POKENAME吃不到足够甜食，就恶作剧，吃掉人们被惹出的烦躁。
author: milchik
source: Lately, these sweet-toothed Pokémon have increasingly been spotted begging for candies instead of searching for wild berries on their own. If POKENAME don't receive enough sweets, they feed on people's irritation by playing tricks on them.

entry: POKENAME喜欢突然钻出地面吓人。可只找孩子下手，因为大人似乎不觉得它吓人。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME loves to scare people, popping out of the ground when they're not expecting it. However, it only goes after children since adults don't seem to find it scary.

entry: POKENAME靠近善妒之人，就会剧烈头痛。痛感很快向外扩散，使附近的人头晕。
author: .izik
source: When near jealous people, POKENAME develops severe headaches. The pain soon radiates outward, causing dizziness in anyone nearby.

entry: 古老迷信称POKENAME生于孩子闹脾气的强烈情绪。它自己也十分任性，一点小事不顺心，就愤怒尖叫。
author: sk372
source: Old superstitions say that POKENAME was born from the strong emotions of childish tantrums. It has a very petulant personality, screeching angrily at every minor thing that troubles it.

entry: POKENAME会感受到最近的人或生物的情绪。只有对方宝可梦主动寻战，它们才肯交手。
author: bradlybro199
source: POKENAME experience the emotion of the person or creature nearest to them. They will only fight a Pokémon who is seeking out a battle.

entry: POKENAME徘徊宝可梦墓园，巡守曾被深爱的伙伴的墓碑。它常在悲痛格外强的人面前显形，亲昵蹭近，带来片刻温暖。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME linger around the Pokémon grave sites, patrolling the headstones of particularly well-loved companions. They tend to manifest in front of those with particularly strong feelings of grief, nuzzling close and offering an ephemeral warmth.

entry: POKENAME在黑夜的湖边浮沉，露出诡异的脸。虽然许多人曾被水中的它吓到，它们却无害。
author: fireflower20002
source: POKENAME bobs on the edge of lakes to show their eerie faces on dark nights. Even though many people have been spooked seeing them in the water, they are harmless.

entry: POKENAME始终修炼体力与幽灵本领。只凭灵力举起重物，是它最自豪的时刻。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is always training, both its physical strength and its ghostly powers. It's most proud of itself when it's able to lift up heavy objects using its spiritual strength alone.

entry: POKENAME吃怒火与轻蔑等负面情绪，维持硕大的肌肉。如今偶尔被错当成角色扮演者，因为布罩般的身体太好仿制。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME keep their muscles large by feeding on the negative emotions of rage and contempt. In the present, they are occasionally confused with cosplayers, as their sheet bodies are easy to replicate.

entry: 秋日庆典的都市夜里，常有POKENAME捣乱。它们偷走孩子好几罐糖，再吃被激起的悲恼与挫败。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: In urban areas on fall festive nights, POKENAME can be spotted wreaking havoc. They have been known to steal multiple containers of candy from children, feeding on the anguish and frustration these acts inflict.

entry: POKENAME用棒子施小诅咒，通常使人笨拙或恶心。它最喜欢诅咒的，是其他鸟宝可梦。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses its stick to cast minor hexes on others, usually to invoke clumsiness or nausea. Its preferred victims to cast a curse upon are other avian Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME看似凶恶，其实只是寂寞求伴的灵魂。它以为外表太吓人，少有人愿友好相待，便常催眠别人。
author: sk372
source: It looks malevolent, but POKENAME is actually a lonely spirit in search of companionship. It often resorts to hypnotizing people, assuming few would be friendly to it because of its appearance.

entry: 若POKENAME看见谁欺负毛绒玩具，就一路跟回家。当晚，对方便会被残酷而无尽的噩梦折磨。
author: .izik
source: If POKENAME sees someone mistreat a stuffed toy, it will follow them home. That night, it inflicts them with brutal, relentless nightmares.

entry: POKENAME夜里沿岸拾荒，狩猎时容不得别人闯入。对孩子尤其记仇，边追边咔哒响螯，发出幽灵般的嘶声。
author: sk372
source: A scavenger that roams coastlines at night, POKENAME does not take kindly to intruders while it hunts. It is particularly vindictive towards children, chasing after them while clicking its claws and making a ghostly hissing sound.

entry: 它长久晒太阳，增强超能力。羊水会产生毒素，由POKENAME释放，使对手入睡或麻痹。
author: fiordaliso
source: It enhances the power of its psychic abilities by resting for long periods in the sunlight. Its amniotic fluid produces toxins that POKENAME releases to put its opponents to sleep or paralyze them.

entry: POKENAME将叶子溶进羊水，迅速分解纤维素与叶绿素，转成养分。液体又将养分运遍全身，吃几片叶，就能得到大量能量。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME dissolves leaves in its amniotic fluid, rapidly breaking down the cellulose and chlorophyll from the leaves into nutrients. This fluid quickly transfers nutrients around the body, allowing it to gain lots of energy from a few leaves.

entry: POKENAME大群住在发电厂附近，细胞产生充沛能量，与群体分享。可发电太多，身体便会在强光中炸裂。
author: mistymagius
source: Large colonies of POKENAME live near power plants, their cells generating high amounts of energy to share with the colony. However, if they generate too much power, their bodies will rupture with a large flash of light.

entry: 它的身体构造类似气泡藻，一种巨型单细胞藻。头部会定期脱落，再重新长出。
author: hophoppip
source: Its body composition is similar to that of bubble algae, a giant single-celled alga. Its heads regularly fall off and grow back.

entry: POKENAME凝胶立方体般的身体里，留着卡拉卡拉头骨与几根骨头，似乎别有情感意义。偶尔伸出持骨的肢体，战斗时当作武器。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME keeps a Cubone skull and a few bones within its gelatinous cube of a body, seemingly for some kind of sentimental reasoning. It occasionally extends limbs carrying the bones to use them as weapons in battle.

entry: POKENAME的头安全裹在凝胶液体中。它会奋力保护卡拉卡拉与单卵细胞球，挥骨迎敌，或释放超能力冲击。
author: kam_doodle_snek
source: POKENAME's head is safely encased in a gelatinous liquid. It will fiercely protect Cubone and Solosis, whacking its bone at threats or using bursts of psychic energy.

entry: POKENAME不断分泌黏稠团块，软得像枕头。可要小心，这些团块会传播各种疾病。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME consistently secretes viscous masses that act like pillows. However, caution is advised as the mass spreads various diseases.

entry: POKENAME不断分泌黏稠团块，软得像枕头。可要小心，这些团块会传播各种疾病。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME consistently secretes viscous masses that act like pillows. However, caution is advised as the mass spreads various diseases.

entry: POKENAME周围的细胞团，再生得快得惊人。即使待在放射性污染地区，也能安然生存。
author: chorb33
source: The cell mass surrounding POKENAME regenerates incredibly quickly. It can even survive in areas contaminated by radioactivity without any problems.

entry: POKENAME囊袋里的“蛋”，其实是单卵细胞球与小福蛋融合体的幼体。研究者仍不知它如何诞生，却认为很可能类似无性分裂。
author: craigprime
source: The "egg" POKENAME carries in its pouch is actually a baby Solopiny. Researchers are still unsure how the newborn is formed, but agree that it is likely comparable to asexual division.

entry: POKENAME周身半透明触须里，满是能光合作用的藻。浸在凝胶中，它们便不会干枯。POKENAME虽哪里都能生存，只有阳光充足才长得好。
author: .jerden
source: The translucent tendrils surrounding POKENAME's body are full of photosynthetic algae, protected from drying out by their immersion in this gel. While POKENAME can survive in any environment, it will only thrive if given plenty of sunlight.

entry: POKENAME上下弹跳，身上触须便如果冻般晃动。看得太久，会头晕、站不稳，也因此保护POKENAME免遭捕食。
author: .jerden
source: The tendrils that cover POKENAME's body wobble like jelly as it bounces up and down. This motion seems to confuse anyone who stares at it too long, making them dizzy and unsteady on their feet, protecting POKENAME from predators.

entry: POKENAME周身的凝胶泡，让它离开水也能适应各种环境。它能射出胶泡自卫，却必须回水中歇息，重新生成凝胶。
author: infinex21
source: The gelatinous bubble that surrounds a POKENAME allows it to survive outside of water in any environment. Though it can shoot bubbles of this gel to defend itself, it must rest within water to regenerate the gel.

entry: POKENAME本体极小，分泌厚胶，再以超能力操纵，塑成巨翼，飞过天空。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have a very small body from which they exude a thick gel that they can manipulate with their psychic powers. They form this gel into great wings, allowing them to fly through the air.

entry: POKENAME的核心满是干细胞，每个都能分化，担任不同职责。科学家正竞相寻找重现POKENAME快速细胞再生的方法。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a core full of stem cells, each capable of specializing into one of many roles. Scientists are scrambling to find ways to replicate POKENAME's rapid cellular regeneration.

entry: POKENAME在有丝分裂时发电，不断迸出火花。有些家庭，便让它帮忙提供可再生电力。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME sparks continuously as it generates electricity during mitosis. It is therefore used in some households to generate renewable electricity.

entry: POKENAME头尾各有毒刺，安全藏在凝胶层内。只有表面受压，才会带来危险。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have a toxic stinger on both their head and their tail. The stingers are safely concealed within their gel coating and are only dangerous if pressure is applied to their surface.

entry: 它们以凝胶泡保护柔弱的身体。本体与泡泡，对不同的进化之石各有反应。
author: infinex21
source: They use their gelatinous bubbles to protect their meeker bodies. They and their bubbles react to various evolution stones in different ways.

entry: POKENAME温顺，凝胶身体软弹。它们造出的黏液团能合成胶块，垫在蹦床下，还能跳得更高。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are docile creatures with a bouncy, gelatinous body. They create blobs of slime that can be combined to produce slime blocks, which can be put under trampolines to increase bounce height.

entry: POKENAME液体身体紧裹在超能力造出的螺旋壳里，护住海底生活。狩猎时猛射体液滴，液滴随后会慢慢滚回，重新合入身体。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's liquid body is tightly packed inside a spiral shell of psychic force. This protects it on the ocean floor, where POKENAME hunts by firing off droplets from its body with great force, which will slowly roll back to rejoin its body.

entry: POKENAME硬壳里的本体动不了，只能用意念行动、攻击。它以超能力操纵周围的水，将浮游生物拉进嘴。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's body is immobile within its hard shell, so it moves and attacks using its mental abilities. It will manipulate the water around it using psychic power, pulling plankton into its mouth.

entry: POKENAME靠厚胶护身，可只挡得住体型相近的宝可梦。遇上大个子，便躲进树里，却又被一路黏液暴露行踪。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME rely on their thick gel coating to keep their bodies safe. The gel is only strong enough to resist attacks from Pokémon of a similar size, they hide themselves away in trees against larger Pokémon, though a trail of slime gives them away.

entry: POKENAME用超能力造出黏稠屏障，保护脆弱本体。屏障一被触碰，POKENAME便本能反应，立刻瞬移逃离。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME generates a viscous barrier using its psychic power to protect its fragile body. The shield triggers an instinctive reaction in POKENAME when touched, making it teleport away as soon as it senses contact.

entry: POKENAME背上的特殊液泡很厚实，能抵御天气与部分攻击。战斗时，体内火势渐旺，液体常像沸腾般冒泡。
author: infinex21
source: The bubble of special fluid atop a POKENAME's back is rather dense, offering protection against the elements and some attacks. In battle, this liquid will often bubble as if boiling due to the growing flames within its body.

entry: POKENAME飞过云间，身后拖着绿胶。民间传说，翼上落下的一滴胶，就能带来七日霉运。
author: .izik
source: Green gel trails behind POKENAME as it soars through the clouds. Folklore says a drop from its wings brings misfortune for seven days.

entry: 特殊液体包裹全身，让它们迁往何种环境，都能安然生活。据说，不断变化的分泌气味，能传达心情。
author: dandelionbaphy
source: Sturdy in any environment they migrate to, thanks to the special liquid they're enveloped in. It is said that alternating scents they secrete convey their feelings.

entry: POKENAME双拳裹着能适应变化的特殊液体，出拳时很少受到反冲。它们大群生活，保护空气清净、能望见星辰的土地。
author: vic1312
source: Because their fists are enveloped in a special, adaptable liquid, POKENAME receive little recoil from punching attacks. They protect land with clean air and visible stars, living in great numbers.

entry: 它将猎物困在黏胶球里，几乎无法脱身。雨季，又会将这种胶涂在网上，抵御风雨。
author: mistymagius
source: It traps its prey in a ball of sticky gel that is almost impossible to escape from. During the rainy season, it will coat its web in this gel to keep it resistant to the wind and rain.

entry: 下雨时，POKENAME以超能力气场围住身体，免得凝胶淋湿。它滑翔时，晶亮的屏障泛着微光。
author: .izik
source: During rainfall, POKENAME surrounds itself with a psychic aura to keep its gelatinous body dry. Its shimmering barrier glows faintly as it glides.

entry: POKENAME苍白的皮肤分泌保护胶，覆满身体。胶的味道与触感都不好，让天敌不愿攻击。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME has a body covered in a protective gel, secreted from its pale skin. The gel dissuades predators from attacking it as it has an unpleasant taste and texture.

entry: 深海生活让POKENAME的皮肤失去了所有色素。头上的光会伪装成发光水母，引诱猎物靠近。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Living in the deep sea, POKENAME have lost all pigmentation in their skin. The lights on their heads lure prey by fooling them into thinking they are bioluminescent jellyfish.

entry: POKENAME周身橡胶般的液体，碰到任何表面都会猛烈弹开。为避免如此，POKENAME通常用超能力悬在空中。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's body is covered in a rubbery fluid that will cause it to forcefully bounce off of any surface it hits. To prevent this, POKENAME levitates above the ground using its psychic powers.

entry: POKENAME在凝胶与下方地面产生相同电流，让身体升空，再用尾巴引导电荷转向。周围多余的凝胶，也能缓冲落地。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME lift themselves into the air by generating matching currents of electricity throughout their gel and the ground beneath them, directing the charges with their tails to steer. The excess gel around their bodies helps cushion their landings.

entry: POKENAME对绿毛虫的食欲无穷，便住在绿毛虫繁多之处。构成身体的羊水富有养分，许多天不吃，也能维持生存。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME has an insatiable appetite for Caterpie, which is why it nests in areas where they are plentiful. The amniotic fluid that makes up its body is rich in nutrients, sustaining it even through many days without food.

entry: POKENAME头周的液体满是叶绿素，帮助光合作用。多余的太阳能，还会转成超能力。
author: bee4082
source: The liquid around POKENAME's head is full of chlorophyll, and aids in photosynthesis. Excess energy from the sun is converted into psychic power.

entry: POKENAME转动头上的花，便能发动念力，将花粉提起，漂在草甸上空进食。
author: .izik
source: By rotating the flower on its head, POKENAME can activate its telekinesis. It uses this to lift pollen from flowers and eat while floating above meadows.

entry: POKENAME笨拙得很，小脚走路常费劲。好在周身凝胶，跌倒时总能缓冲。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME is very clumsy, often having trouble walking with its tiny feet. Luckily, the gelatinous substance around its body cushions it whenever it falls.

entry: POKENAME每筹划下一次诡计，周身凝胶就会被发出的超能力激得冒泡。计划若失利，它便溜进黑暗，立刻筹划新的。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Whenever POKENAME think about their next schemes, the gel around their body will bubble with the psychic energy they're projecting. If their plans ever fall short, they will slip away in the darkness and immediately get to work on the next one.

entry: POKENAME悬在不渗透的凝胶中，隔绝外界。它们从泡内心灵交流，因为一旦暴露在外界，就会痛苦不已。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are suspended in an impermeable gel that protects them from the outside world. They communicate telepathically from inside the bubble, as exposure to the external world causes them great pain.

entry: 有些POKENAME天生视力惊人，靠它穿行洞穴、找食物。遇见训练家，便一直盯着，直到对方离开。
author: sondededoo
source: Some POKENAME are born with incredible ocular vision and rely on it to navigate cave systems and find food. When encountering a Trainer, they will stare at them until they leave.

entry: POKENAME的液膜几乎和岩浆一样热。它用超能力移动身体，也防止身体在冷处凝固。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's liquid membrane is nearly as hot as magma. It uses its psychic power to move its body around and keep it from solidifying when in cooler temperatures.

entry: 不知为何，POKENAME拿实验玻璃器皿当壳，保护软身。有人推测，未洗烧瓶、烧杯中的残余药剂，正是它们的食物。
author: hophoppip
source: For some reason, POKENAME use laboratory glassware as shells to protect their soft bodies. It's theorized that the leftover chemicals in unwashed flasks and beakers are a food source for them.

entry: POKENAME最爱吃独角虫，便在其洞旁筑巢。核心周围的凝胶，能抵御天气与温度变化。
author: fiordaliso
source: Weedle is the favorite prey of POKENAME, which is why it nests near their burrows. The gelatinous liquid surrounding its core protects it from the elements and temperature fluctuations.

entry: POKENAME周身的凝胶，让珊瑚获得理想的生长条件，适应多数环境。胶也被当作好用的护理品，卖给养太阳珊瑚的训练家。
author: mistymagius
source: The gel surrounding POKENAME's body provides the perfect conditions for its coral to grow, allowing it to survive in most environments. The gel is sold as a useful care product for Trainers raising their own Corsola.

entry: 身体大半由浓稠黏液组成，能轻易挤进窄处藏身休息。也会朝敌人喷出同样的液体，将其固定。
author: infinex21
source: Most of their bodies are made of a sticky, thick liquid that makes it easy for them to fit into tight spaces to hide and rest. They will spew this same liquid onto their foes to hold them in place.

entry: POKENAME借心灵感应，知道朋友最想要什么，再寻找相似的东西，送作真心的礼物。
author: .izik
source: Using telepathy, POKENAME senses what its friends desire most. It then seeks out similar objects and delivers them as heartfelt gifts.

entry: POKENAME最爱吃独角虫，便在其洞旁筑巢。核心周围的凝胶，能抵御天气与温度变化。
author: fiordaliso
source: Weedle is the favorite prey of POKENAME, which is why it nests near their burrows. The gelatinous liquid surrounding its core protects it from the elements and temperature fluctuations.

entry: 放出强大龙属性招式前，它会分开周身保护液，免得妨碍攻击。又因须不断用超能力固定液体，往往要睡很久。
author: fiordaliso
source: Right before unleashing a powerful Dragon-type attack, it parts the protective liquid around its body to fire without interference. Because it must constantly use its psychic powers to hold the liquid in place, it often needs long hours of sleep.

entry: 放出强大龙属性招式前，它会分开周身保护液，免得妨碍攻击。又因须不断用超能力固定液体，往往要睡很久。
author: fiordaliso
source: Right before unleashing a powerful Dragon-type attack, it parts the protective liquid around its body to fire without interference. Because it must constantly use its psychic powers to hold the liquid in place, it often needs long hours of sleep.

entry: POKENAME从象鼻喷出保护黏液，涂满身体。其他宝可梦通常不喜欢，乌波却似乎爱在留下的黏液洼里玩。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME coats its body in a protective mucus that it shoots from its trunk. While its mucus typically repels other Pokémon, Wooper appears to enjoy playing in the puddles left behind.

entry: 周身特殊液体，让它几乎适应任何环境，也强化本已强劲的象鼻。它念力惊人，常借此摘取高树上的水果。
author: infinex21
source: The layer of special fluid along its body allows it to endure nearly any environment while reinforcing its already-powerful trunk. It displays a surprising telekinetic ability, which it often utilizes to acquire fruits from tall trees.

entry: POKENAME能塑形凝胶，适应各种环境，也借凝胶变形，学习其他动物如何在不同地方生存与活动。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME can shape its gel to allow it to thrive very well in any environment. It also uses this gel shapeshifting to learn how other animals survive and move in places.

entry: POKENAME常闯实验室玩化学药剂，是个麻烦。它们用尾巴蘸药剂画画，偶尔会酿成破坏。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are considered nuisances to labs, as they break inside to play around with chemicals. POKENAME dip their tails in chemicals to draw with them, occasionally leading to destructive results.

entry: POKENAME周身的绿色胶液，抛光效果出奇好。许多酒馆餐馆养POKENAME，让玻璃杯保持洁净明亮。
author: mepp.
source: The green gel-like fluid covering POKENAME's body is surprisingly effective as a polish. Many taverns and restaurants keep POKENAME around to keep their glasses clean and shiny.

entry: POKENAME虽有强大超能力，性情却胆小。一遇危险，便靠柔软身体挤进窄缝，转眼不见。
author: chorb33
source: Despite its strong psychic powers, POKENAME is cowardly and disappears into narrow cracks through which it can squeeze thanks to its flexible body.

entry: POKENAME慢慢蜕掉保护胶层，清除裹在里面的碎屑。胶虽剧毒，却已用于某些洗衣产品。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME will slowly shed the layer of gel protecting its body to get rid of any debris caught inside. While being highly toxic, POKENAME's gel has seen use in certain laundry products.

entry: 野生POKENAME确实罕见，可只要找到一只，就一定还有更多。除了脾气凶、护卫心强，人们对POKENAME知之甚少。
author: seffffffffffffff
source: A wild POKENAME is a rare sight indeed, though where one finds one POKENAME, they will certainly find more. Not much is known about POKENAME aside from its fierce temper and protective nature.

entry: 野生POKENAME常结群，以超能力穿过密林与暗洞。果冻般的薄膜，却会黏在沿途障碍上。
author: seffffffffffffff
source: Wild POKENAME often travel in packs, using their psychic prowess to migrate through dense forests and dark caves. Their jelly-like membrane gets stuck on obstacles in their path.

entry: POKENAME很友善，爱用念力玩蛋形物件。真身周围的绿色物质，弹性极佳。
author: craigprime
source: POKENAME are quite friendly and like to use their telekinetic powers to play with egg-shaped objects. The green material surrounding its true body is extremely bouncy.

entry: POKENAME用电力操纵胶层，让全身始终带正电。想把胶甩向敌人时，就突然反转电荷。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME use their electrical powers to manipulate their gel coating, generating a constant positive charge throughout their body. When they want to fling their gel at their foes, they abruptly invert their charge.

entry: 不停再生的细胞团，护着POKENAME真正的身体。个头虽大，却很柔软，钻进小洞就能消失无踪。
author: chorb33
source: Constantly regenerating cell mass protects the actual body of POKENAME. Despite its size, it is very flexible and can disappear through narrow holes.

entry: POKENAME用电力操纵胶层，让全身始终带正电。想把胶甩向敌人时，就突然反转电荷。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME use their electrical powers to manipulate their gel coating, generating a constant positive charge throughout their body. When they want to fling their gel at their foes, they abruptly invert their charge.

entry: POKENAME以超能力移开周围枝叶，确保总能直晒太阳。光合作用保持膜稳定，缺光太久，身体便开始失稳、松散。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses its psychic powers to manipulate the foliage around it to ensure it always has direct exposure to sunlight. Photosynthesis keeps its membrane stable; too long without sunlight and its body will begin to lose stability and cohesion.

entry: POKENAME能冷却核心外的胶液，将贸然碰触者冻住。它以心灵感应与同伴交流，提醒威胁。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME can cool the gelatinous liquid coating its core to freeze anyone incautious enough to touch it. It communicates telepathically with its companions to warn them of threats.

entry: POKENAME用心灵感应，把刺耳哔声直接送进猎物脑中，边追边响，直到对方露出破绽，再用幻象光线收尾。
author: .izik
source: Using telepathy, POKENAME projects a loud beeping noise directly into its prey's mind. It continues this while in pursuit until the foe falters, then finishes them with Psybeam.

entry: POKENAME无法维持身体形状，只好待在玻璃罐里，用超能力搬动。研究者很喜欢与POKENAME合作，因为它友善又可爱。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: Unable to keep its body together, POKENAME is contained within a glass jar that can be moved using its psychic powers. Researchers enjoy working with POKENAME due to its friendly attitude and adorable appearance.

entry: 吃腻了被胶液染味的食物，POKENAME偶尔会在头边的胶里开一张“嘴”，直接咬食。可空气会让眼睛干，因此只有格外好吃的点心，才值得如此。
author: lordjoostmeister
source: Bored of food flavored by the gel of its body, POKENAME sometimes opens a "mouth" in the gel around its head so that it can nibble on its meal directly. Exposure to air dries out its eyes, so POKENAME only does this for especially tasty treats.

entry: POKENAME最喜欢湿润洞窟，与信赖的宝可梦一起歇息。安宁被打破，POKENAME便鲁莽反击，抛出一碰就爆成毒云的孢子。
author: gileme__
source: POKENAME is most comfortable in damp grottos, where it rests alongside trusted Pokémon. If its peace is disturbed, POKENAME lashes out, recklessly throwing spores that burst into toxic clouds.

entry: POKENAME超能力极强，能感知对手下一招。极少数仍被打中的时候，周身特殊液体也能缓冲。
author: mcnchsschl
source: Thanks to its immense psychic abilities, POKENAME can sense the next move of its opponent. In the rare event that the attack connects, the special liquid surrounding its body cushions the blow.

entry: POKENAME体表液体让它适应一切环境。它们结伴穿越险地，一同磨炼、变强。
author: nyoomymph
source: The liquid covering POKENAME's body allows it to adapt to and survive in any environment. Groups of POKENAME will travel through dangerous places in order to test themselves and get stronger together.

entry: POKENAME从容器裂缝中现身，每次都会留下泛着微弱超能力波动的黏液。直接碰触，会轻微头痛。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME emerges from the cracks in its container. Every time it manifests itself, it leaves behind a slimy residue that pulses with a faint psychic energy. Direct contact with the goop causes mild headaches.

entry: 脑外裹着厚胶，能硬化进攻，也能防守，还保护POKENAME免受脑震荡。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Its brain is covered by a thick gelatinous slime. It can harden the slime to attack or defend, and the goo protects POKENAME from concussions.

entry: POKENAME的脸乍看柔软，却因质地致密，有着钢铁般的强度。可身体其他地方，仍十分娇弱。
author: forbiddenbread
source: While it may look soft, POKENAME's face retains the strength of steel due to its density. However, the remainder of its body is still very fragile.

entry: POKENAME凝胶一受击，就暂时凝固。它们转身迎敌，再调整胶形，接下物理打击，如持盾般防护。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME gel hardens when struck, momentarily becoming solid. They use their gel as a shield against physical blows, turning to face threats and reshaping their gel so that it catches incoming blows.

entry: POKENAME结合超能力与幽灵之力，投出恐怖影像。其实它很胆小，这只是在害怕时，试图吓退让POKENAME受惊的对象。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses a combo of psychic and ghostly powers to project fearful imagery. It is actually quite timid, so these actions are done as a fear response, attempting to scare away something that has managed to frighten POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME漂过各地，发出超能力波，诱使意志薄弱的人膜拜。若用得过多，会暂时无法悬浮。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME floats through regions emitting psychic waves that sway weak-minded humans into worship. Overuse of this power temporarily prevents it from floating.

entry: POKENAME背上的植物，结构简单得很，宛如放大后的微生物。
author: hophoppip
source: The plants on POKENAME's back are exceedingly simple in structure, built like giant versions of micro-organisms.

entry: POKENAME由毒胶构成，经皮肤吸收会使人恶心。它们以超能力塑形，全凭意志操纵凝胶。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME's bodies are made of a toxic gel that can cause nausea when absorbed through the skin. They shape their bodies with their psychic powers, manipulating the gel entirely through their willpower.

entry: POKENAME头上的飘带放出超能力波，引发短暂幻觉，改变受害者看见的颜色。对方一迷乱，它便能从困境逃脱。
author: .izik
source: The psychic waves POKENAME releases from the ribbon on its head cause brief hallucinations, altering the colors victims perceive. This disorientation buys it time to flee if cornered.

entry: POKENAME体内只有少数彼此分离的核，悬在毒胶中，各自控制不同部位，让POKENAME能随意变形重组。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME bodies consist of a small number of disparate nuclei suspended in a toxic gel. The nuclei each control a different part of the body, allowing POKENAME to reshape and reform at will.

entry: POKENAME从近旁者的痛苦中，吸取超能力能量，转作大炮动力，爆发式射出。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME absorbs psychic energy from the distress of those nearby. This is converted into power for its cannon and can be shot in massive bursts.

entry: 超能力虽强，却用不好凝胶身体。它蹒跚地四处走，碰到什么，就沾上绿色黏液。
author: mistymagius
source: Despite its psychic prowess, it struggles to work its gelatinous body properly. It shambles from place to place, getting its green slime on everything it touches.

entry: POKENAME大小变化极大。科学家与训练家合作，测试POKENAME用变小能缩到多小。有人相信，若能缩至微观尺度，或许有助于医疗。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's size can vary dramatically. There are scientists who cooperate with Trainers to see just how small POKENAME can Minimize to; some believe that if POKENAME were able to shrink to a microscopic level, they could assist in the medical field.

entry: POKENAME周身凝胶，其实是消化液，能将吸收的食物直接溶入胃中。可它常不慎吃下危险物件，因此容易生病。
author: mistymagius
source: The gel that surrounds POKENAME is actually its digestive fluid, allowing it to dissolve any food it absorbs directly into its stomach. However, it gets sick a lot as it often ingests hazardous objects by accident.

entry: POKENAME以火之石作凝胶身体的核心，抽出元素之力，造出附有超能力的强焰。奸恶猎人觊觎火之石，相信它有神秘力量。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME use a Fire Stone as the nucleus for their gel-like body, drawing out its elemental power to produce powerful, psychically charged flames. Their Fire Stones are coveted by unscrupulous hunters due to presumed mystical powers.

entry: 隧道开始坍塌，POKENAME就以超能力撑住顶壁，常为救整巢同伴而牺牲。
author: .izik
source: When tunnels begin to collapse, POKENAME will hold the ceiling aloft with psychic force. It often sacrifices itself to save its hive.

entry: 身体靠凝聚的超能力维持，而非肌肉。读懂附近生物的意图，就能抢在危险发生前反应。
author: vracken
source: Its body is sustained by concentrated psychic energy rather than muscle. By reading the intentions of nearby creatures, it can react before danger unfolds.

entry: 其他生物偶尔会游进，或被吸进POKENAME的凝胶膜。POKENAME却少有察觉，开心地游跳，载着这些意外乘客同行。
author: sk372
source: On occasion, other creatures swim into or otherwise get sucked into POKENAME's gelatinous membrane. POKENAME rarely notices, and happily swims and hops around with its new unintentional passengers along for the ride.

entry: 羊水太稠，每次想转动凝胶齿轮，POKENAME都得动用超能力。保护胶还能硬如金属，抵御敌袭。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its amniotic fluid is so thick that POKENAME must use its psychic powers every time it wants to turn the gelatinous gears. It can make the protective gelatin as hard as metal to defend itself from enemy attacks.

entry: POKENAME用羊水裹住尾焰，隔绝湿气。液体又将养分送到尾部，确保火焰明亮。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME wraps the flame on its tail with an amniotic fluid that shields the flame from moisture. This fluid also nourishes the flame by moving nutrients to the tail, ensuring the flame burns bright.

entry: POKENAME的凝胶外层既护核心，也加快太阳能转换。头上的花苞偶尔打开，露出色泽鲜艳、由黏液做成的花。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's gelatinous external layer protects its core from harm as well as amplifying the rate at which it converts sunlight into energy. The bud on its head occasionally blooms to reveal a vibrantly colored flower made of goo.

entry: POKENAME夜里在窗外若隐若现，对人类天性十分好奇。据说请POKENAME入屋，翌日便会好运、晴空。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Barely visible outside windows at night, POKENAME are curious about human nature. It is said that allowing a POKENAME to enter your house will bring good fortune and clear skies for the following day.

entry: POKENAME吃的东西不同，保护层便会变色。它本身失明，靠超能力辨路；触觉也差，通常不爱亲热。
author: bobosmith01
source: Its protective layer changes colors depending on what POKENAME feeds on. It uses its psychic abilities to navigate, and is otherwise blind. It has a poor sense of touch, and typically does not like affection.

entry: POKENAME身体见日光就容易干，因此只夜出觅食，吸干其他宝可梦的体液，保持自身湿润。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's body dries out quickly in the sun, so it only comes out to feed at night. It drains other Pokémon of their fluids to keep its body nice and moist.

entry: POKENAME只能活在悬浮其中的奇液里，放上陆地或普通水中就会病弱。它用超能力，与容器外的世界互动。
author: sk372
source: The strange liquid it floats in is all POKENAME can survive in, as it becomes sickly if placed on land or in normal water. It uses psychic abilities to interact with the world outside its container.

entry: POKENAME气泡身体难以攻击，也难捕捉。又极其凶暴，利爪带强力麻痹毒，因此不太受训练家欢迎。
author: sottiwotti
source: POKENAME's bubble body makes it difficult to attack or catch. It is highly aggressive, and its claws unleash a very strong paralysing poison. All of this makes POKENAME not a very popular choice for Trainers.

entry: POKENAME身体的胶摸着始终冰凉，可舒缓烫伤，用太多却可能使人昏倒。
author: hophoppip
source: The goo that makes up POKENAME's body is always chilly to the touch. It can be used to soothe burns, but using too much may cause one to pass out.

entry: POKENAME喜湿。各个体的叶色，随碰过并吸取能量的东西而变。例如，吸取水电坝旁泥土能量的，叶子便较黄。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME prefers damp areas. The color of each individual POKENAME's leaves varies depending on what it's touched and absorbed the energy of. For instance, those that absorb energy from the mud near electrical dams have more yellowish leaves.

entry: POKENAME把吃下的垃圾转成毒胶。合众许多餐馆将废物锁进严密垃圾箱，不想让POKENAME吃，它却直接用超能力毁掉锁。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME's body converts the trash it eats into poisonous slime. Though many restaurants in Unova try to dispose of their waste in secure dumpsters to prevent POKENAME from eating it, POKENAME simply uses its psychic powers to destroy the lock.

entry: 神婆用POKENAME头上的黄叶泡茶，相信茶汤能让人与灵魂短暂交流。
author: .izik
source: Mediums use the yellow leaves on POKENAME's head to brew tea. The infusion is believed to allow brief communication with spirits.

entry: 山洪骤起，POKENAME便放出强大超能力脉冲，操纵树木，引开水流。小型宝可梦将它奉为森林守护者。
author: .izik
source: During flash floods, POKENAME unleashes powerful psychic pulses to control trees and redirect the waters. It's revered as a forest guardian by smaller Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME喜湿。各个体的叶色，随碰过并吸取能量的东西而变。例如，吸取水电坝旁泥土能量的，叶子便较黄。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME prefers damp areas. The color of each individual POKENAME's leaves varies depending on what it's touched and absorbed the energy of. For instance, those that absorb energy from the mud near electrical dams have more yellowish leaves.

entry: 吸入POKENAME蓝花粉的超能力者，声称看见鲜明的未来。奇特的心灵影响，研究者仍在争论。
author: .izik
source: Psychics who inhale POKENAME's blue pollen report intense visions of the future. Researchers continue to debate its strange effects on the mind.

entry: 孩子难过时，温柔的POKENAME群会飘到孤儿院旁，凌空翻转盘旋，以一阵阵带来欢乐的超能力，振奋孩子的心。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME forms gentle flocks that hover near orphanages when children feel sad. They perform aerial loops and spins to lift spirits with bursts of psychic joy.

entry: POKENAME小巧黏软，生性贪玩，能随意伸展变形。它会借流动的身体，对毫无防备的敌人发动出其不意的小型超能力攻击。
author: thepandasharky
source: POKENAME is a small, gooey Pokémon. Its playful nature allows it to stretch and reshape, using its fluid form to launch surprising small psychic attacks on unsuspecting foes.

entry: POKENAME保护层受损后长得很快，形状却不一定相同。胶泡涂上皮肤，能舒缓灼伤与刺激，因此有人养在家里。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME's protective layers regenerate quickly when damaged, but do not always grow back identically. Its gooey bubble soothes burns and irritated skin when applied, leading to some people caring for one in their home.

entry: POKENAME保护层受损后长得很快，形状却不一定相同。胶泡涂上皮肤，能舒缓灼伤与刺激，因此有人养在家里。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME's protective layers regenerate quickly when damaged, but do not always grow back identically. Its gooey bubble soothes burns and irritated skin when applied, leading to some people caring for one in their home.

entry: POKENAME爪子由胶构成，很难爬树，便改住废弃的洞穴。
author: bigoljax
source: Due to their claws being made of gel, POKENAME struggle to climb up trees. They instead take shelter in abandoned burrows.

entry: POKENAME用含超能力的厚胶裹住自己，在背上塑出隆起，护住脆弱的核，免遭伤害。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME surround themselves with a thick layer of psychically charged gel. They form the gel into a hump over their back to protect their vulnerable nucleus, keeping themselves safe from harm.

entry: 它与其他POKENAME在洞中漂游，尽力躲避威胁。体表宝石是结晶的黏液，当地人会将其熔化，制成药膏。
author: krune
source: It floats around caves with other POKENAME, trying their best to hide from threats. The gems on its body are crystalized slime, which are melted and used by locals as a medicinal cream.

entry: POKENAME凝胶适合制作护发品，尤其助长头发的产品。但胶剧毒，使用前必须大量加水稀释。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME gel is great for making hair care products, especially products for hair growth. However, the gel is incredibly toxic, so it has to be heavily watered down before use.

entry: POKENAME吹出的泡泡，与体表是同样的胶质。泡泡若在附近破掉，就可能使人轻微头痛、迷乱。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME blows bubbles made up of the same gel-like substance coating its body. These bubbles can cause mild headaches and disorientation in those that they pop near.

entry: POKENAME射出的泡泡，一受击就分裂成小泡。分开后很难应付，正适合迎战冲动的宝可梦。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME shoot bubbles that divide into smaller bubbles when struck. These bubbles are difficult to counter once they split, making them a perfect choice to fight against impulsive Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME藏进南瓜与葫芦，凝胶身体慢慢将其分解充饥。等瓜烂尽，再缓缓飘走，寻找新的住处。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME hides inside of pumpkins and gourds, its gelatinous body slowly breaking them down for food. Once the gourd has decayed, it will slowly float around looking for a new one.

entry: POKENAME由微微发光的凝胶构成。有人说，直视它的眼睛，就会中诅咒。
author: willuna
source: POKENAME's body is composed of a gelatinous substance that emits a faint glow. Some say looking into its eyes will curse you.

entry: POKENAME不怕热，也不受湿气影响，只有接触唾液才会腐坏。科学家与糖果师都在研究，想重现它凝胶身体里的物质。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME is unaffected by heat or moisture and only decays when exposed to saliva. It is being studied by both scientists and confectioners as they scramble to figure out how to replicate the contents of its gelatinous body.

entry: POKENAME的特殊凝胶受压时会改变黏度，让它撞上硬物，也不破坏周身液体的表面张力。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are made out of a unique gel that changes viscosity when exposed to stress. This allows them to ram into solid objects without breaking the surface tension of the fluid around them.

entry: 体表特殊液体能挡住雨与强风，不让体温下降。全力发动超能力时，POKENAME却会热得冒出一缕轻烟。
author: fiordaliso
source: The special liquid covering its body protects it from rain and strong winds, preventing its body temperature from dropping. When it exerts itself to the fullest to use its psychic powers, POKENAME gets so hot that it emits a wisp of light smoke.

entry: POKENAME平静漂游，尽量不碰别人。因为凝胶外层一受刺激，里面的本体就会头痛欲裂。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME floats around placidly, trying to avoid contact with others. This is because anything stimulating its gelatinous exterior gives the core body a splitting headache.

entry: POKENAME用超能力，让各部位紧靠核心。它又极易烦躁，稍一失去耐性，便攻击靠得太近的对象。
author: fiordaliso
source: With its psychic powers, POKENAME is able to keep the other parts of its body close to its core. Since it is easily irritated, it takes only a moment for it to lose patience and attack anyone who gets too close.

entry: POKENAME用超能力，让各部位紧靠核心。它又极易烦躁，稍一失去耐性，便攻击靠得太近的对象。
author: fiordaliso
source: With its psychic powers, POKENAME is able to keep the other parts of its body close to its core. Since it is easily irritated, it takes only a moment for it to lose patience and attack anyone who gets too close.

entry: 追猎所需的高速，得靠POKENAME极度专注，才能稳住胶身。常能见到幼年POKENAME边跑，边以念力搬着脱落的胶块。
author: quietcognition
source: In order to maintain the high speeds it needs to catch its prey, POKENAME must concentrate hard to keep its gelatinous body stable. It is common to see young POKENAME running while using their telekinesis to carry detached bits of gel.

entry: POKENAME的毛不断产生浓稠的导念力凝胶。医护人员常用胶代替热水袋，借热量舒缓肌肉紧张，减轻疼痛。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME fur constantly produces a thick, psychically conductive gel. Their gel is commonly used by medical professionals in place of hot water bottles, the heat of the gel easing muscle stress and leeching away pain.

entry: POKENAME成群顺着河流轻松漂行。捕食者靠近时，就发出超能力振动，潜入水下。
author: holgast
source: POKENAME travel in groups, floating along effortlessly using river currents. Should a predator approach, they produce psychic vibrations to dip under the surface of the water.

entry: POKENAME潜在钓点附近的岸边，用念力制造假的咬钩拉扯，弄得钓客烦躁又困惑。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME lurks by the shoreline near fishing spots. It uses telekinesis to create false tugs, leaving anglers irritated and confused.

entry: 身体太脆弱，胶屏障便隔开一切外来接触。食物先在胶中溶解，再从皮肤吸收，补充养分。
author: mistymagius
source: Since its body is so frail, its gel barrier protects it from any outside contact. It gets its nutrients by dissolving food in the gel then absorbing it through its skin.

entry: POKENAME裹着带超能力的厚胶，让液体分散物理攻击的力道。操控精细得很，还能借胶飘过天空。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME encase themselves in a thick layer of psychically charged gel, using the liquid to disperse the force of physical attacks. Their control over the gel is fine enough that they are able to float through the air using it.

entry: POKENAME静止地生活，沉思周围世界。需要移动，就攀住路过的宝可梦。周身膜一泛起波纹，就说明进化近了。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME live in perfect stillness, reflecting on the world around them. Should they need to move, they latch onto a passing Pokémon. When the membrane surrounding them begins to ripple, it means that evolution is imminent.

entry: POKENAME胶身能扭曲重塑，闪避攻击，再挥强拳还击。中央的红核若被拿走，身体就会失去形状。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's gel-like body allows it to deform and reshape itself to avoid attacks and strike back with its powerful fists. The red core in its center will cause it to lose shape if removed.

entry: POKENAME胶身像朵花，偶尔站在空田中央。它把脚埋进土里，免得干枯，再试着抓住靠近的虫属性宝可梦。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's gelatinous body resembles a flower and can occasionally be seen standing in the middle of empty fields. It buries its feet in the ground to stop itself drying out, and tries to catch any Bug-type Pokémon that approach.

entry: POKENAME天生胆怯，却又好奇不尽，会浮在友善训练家身后，用强大的超能力感官，研究周围一切。
author: aggrotek
source: Although timid by nature, POKENAME is endlessly curious. It floats after friendly Trainers, studying everything around it with its powerful psychic senses.

entry: POKENAME对病菌极敏感，便分泌厚胶，几乎瞬间杀灭病菌。医生常养POKENAME，拿它的胶作消毒剂。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's body is very sensitive to germs, so it produces a thick gel that kills them almost instantly. Doctors will often have a POKENAME on hand to use its gel as a disinfectant.

entry: 严格来说，POKENAME不靠注毒，而是本身有毒；黏触手须进入身体孔口，才会生效。小猎物被麻醉吞食，大生物则只会恶心。
author: dylonk25
source: POKENAME is technically not venomous, but poisonous; its slimy tentacles must enter an orifice to take effect. Though smaller prey is sedated and consumed, larger creatures merely become nauseated.

entry: POKENAME对人通常不致命，却不受海滩游客欢迎。中毒的感觉，被形容为灌下一大瓶止咳糖浆，再服下大剂量致幻药。
author: dylonk25
source: POKENAME, though mostly nonlethal to humans, is an unwelcome sight on the beach. Being poisoned by one has been described as similar to downing a large bottle of cough syrup followed up with a heroic dose of hallucinogens.

entry: 身体质地看似石头，摸着却柔软可塑。它很敏感，戳得太多，就会凶狠出拳回应。
author: sk372
source: Though its body appears similar in texture to stone, it's actually soft and malleable to the touch. It's quite sensitive, so prodding it too much will incite it to respond with aggressive punching.

entry: POKENAME外层软胶，包着结晶的壳。每碰别的物质，胶就干缩成粉，令POKENAME十分痛苦。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a soft outer layer of gel that encases a crystallized shell. Whenever they make contact with another substance, the gel shrivels up into a powder, causing POKENAME much pain.

entry: POKENAME覆着防水油，免得身体被雨溶化。工匠也拿POKENAME的油，给陶罐涂防水层。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's body is coated in a waterproof oil that prevents its body from dissolving in the rain. Artisans use POKENAME's oil as a waterproof coating for their pots.

entry: POKENAME胶层耐用，又能以超能力操纵，与环境互动。胶再生很快，浅红市的糕点师便设陷阱采集多余凝胶，裹在甜点上，添一份酸味。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is durable due to its gel coating, which it controls with psychic powers to interact with its environment. The gel regrows quickly, so Fuschia City pastry chefs leave traps to harvest excess gel to coat desserts with a acidic flavor.

entry: 一种流行却古怪的护理，是让POKENAME夹住头发，慢慢往后滑。留下的亮膜，能使头发柔软、光亮、香上数日。
author: jaminmcready
source: A popular but strange treatment involves letting a POKENAME clamp onto someone's hair and slowly slide back. It leaves behind a glossy coating that makes hair soft, shiny, and sweet-smelling for days.

entry: POKENAME把构成身体的软胶护在巨壳中，遇险就缩回。也能从炮口高压射胶，再以超能力召回。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME keep the soft gel that forms their body safe within their great shells, retreating within it if they ever feel endangered. They can fire the gel at high pressure out of their cannons, recalling it with their psychic powers.

entry: 柔软的凝胶身体让POKENAME容易遭到捕食。它们用黏性身体搜集贝壳，借此保护自己。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The soft and gelatinous bodies of POKENAME leave them vulnerable to predators. They scavenge sea shells using their sticky bodies, keeping themselves safe from danger.

entry: POKENAME全身不断漏出绿气，始终被雾包围，既隐藏踪迹，也遮挡日光。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME constantly leak a green gas from their bodies, which envelops them at all times. This haze helps to both hide their presence and protect themselves from the sun.

entry: 核心周围的特殊液体，让POKENAME在暗洞中也不惧冷。它用超能力捉弄、逗弄人类与宝可梦。
author: fiordaliso
source: The special liquid surrounding its core allows POKENAME to live in dark caves without suffering from the cold. It uses its psychic powers to play tricks on and tease both Pokémon and humans alike.

entry: POKENAME的身体如同凝胶，防御力差得可怜，便藏在树洞里求得安全。它用超能力从树上摘下叶子与树果，送回家中，饱餐一顿。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's gelatinous body gives it pitiful defenses, so it hides away inside tree holes for safety. It uses psychic powers to pluck leaves and berries from the tree and bring them back to its home to feast on.

entry: 黏液主动吸收林地松针与种子，再在果冻般的物质中消化，获取养分。
author: .izik
source: Its slime actively absorbs pine needles and seeds from the forest floor. These are digested within the jelly-like substance to nourish it.

entry: POKENAME表面的胶质，是它不断进行有丝分裂时排出的多余细胞，里面还感染着病原体。
author: chorb33
source: The jelly that coats POKENAME are surplus cells that it secretes during its constant mitosis. These are infected with pathogens.

entry: 它造出无形物件，让人绊倒，再坐在屋顶，看着对方倒霉，乐于恶作剧。
author: .izik
source: It creates invisible objects to cause people to trip and fall. Watching from rooftops, it gleefully observes their misfortune with mischievous delight.

entry: 它先以超能力固定猎物，再用利刃切割，确保出手精准。
author: .izik
source: It uses its psychic powers to immobilize prey before slicing them with razor-sharp blades. This method ensures it strikes with precision.

entry: POKENAME吸收活跃聊天室的数据，从参与者身上抽取情绪能量。吃饱后放出的超能力脉冲，能让附近设备失效。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME absorbs data from active chat rooms, siphoning emotional energy from participants. When full, it releases psychic pulses capable of disabling nearby devices.

entry: POKENAME能随意冻实、融化凝胶身体。冻住时，敌人攻击无法穿透，可自己也动不了。
author: bostroms
source: POKENAME has a gelatinous body that it can completely freeze and thaw at will.  While it is frozen, enemy attacks will not penetrate it, but it cannot move.

entry: 维系POKENAME的厚胶，集中了成长所需的养分、化学物质与能量。碰上新东西，POKENAME先想的，总是让胶碰一碰，会发生什么。
author: pkbonusducks
source: The dense gel keeping POKENAME together is composed of all the nutrients, chemicals, and energy it needs to grow. When introduced to something new, POKENAME's first thought is to see what happens when its gel touches it.

entry: POKENAME长身的两端各有一颗脑。有人见过幼体，竟试着同时往两个方向跑。
author: dylonk25
source: POKENAME have two brains, located on either side of a long body. Young individuals have been spotted trying to run in two directions at once.

entry: 古代神奥，人们曾用它体表的胶治疗精神疲劳。这奇特传统，如今早已淡去。
author: .izik
source: The jelly coating its body was once used in ancient Sinnoh as a medicine for mental fatigue. This peculiar tradition has long since faded.

entry: POKENAME以胶身吐丝结网。猎物一被困，胶网便塌拢包住，开始溶化POKENAME的下一餐。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME spins webs out of the gel that comprises its body. When prey get trapped in this gelatinous web, the web collapses around the prey to begin dissolving POKENAME's next meal.

entry: POKENAME力量增长，身体也更能鼓胀，膜也更能硬化。胀到最大时，膜像橡胶，几乎能弹开所有寻常打击。
author: sk372
source: As POKENAME's strength grows, its ability to inflate its body and solidify its membrane grows as well. At full inflation, the membrane gains a rubbery texture that bounces almost any basic attack away.

entry: 第二颗脑以超能力预见飞行中将遇的障碍，提前避开，因此它极擅空中辨路。
author: .izik
source: Its second brain uses psychic powers to detect and avoid future obstructions during flight. This foresight makes it a master of aerial navigation.

entry: POKENAME若分心太多，部分身体就开始飘走。它大多脑力都用于维持完整，实在丢了找不回的部分，也能再生。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: If POKENAME focuses on too many things, parts of it begin to drift away. It uses most of its brain power to remain whole, and if a part is irrecoverably lost, it can regenerate it.

entry: 它懒洋洋浮在流沙，享受缓缓下沉。等彻底埋没，便睡上数日，再轻易游回表面。
author: .izik
source: It floats lazily in quicksand, enjoying the slow descent. Once fully submerged, it sleeps for days before effortlessly swimming back to the surface.

entry: 它把心爱的物件吸进黏液，当作身体的延伸。携带的月之石，能集中更强的超能力攻击。
author: .izik
source: It absorbs objects it loves into its slime, using them as an extension of its body. The Moon Stone it carries acts as a focus for its more powerful psychic attacks.

entry: 果冻般的外层散出怡人松香，松针吃得越多，香味越浓。虽然黏，闻着却奇妙地让人安心。
author: .izik
source: Its jelly-like covering emits a pleasant pine scent that intensifies as it consumes more pine needles. This aroma makes it oddly soothing despite its sticky nature.

entry: POKENAME始终离地悬浮，却以为自己真能靠小翅膀飞。常从高处纵身而下，幸好有凝胶身体缓冲。
author: mistymagius
source: Despite constantly levitating off the ground, POKENAME thinks it can actually fly with its small wings. It can be seen throwing itself off of high places, only to be cushioned by its gelatinous body.

entry: POKENAME的膜形酷似布鲁皇，便用来吓唬小宝可梦。可对方哪怕只稍露敌意，它就立刻服软。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses its membrane's similar shape to Granbull as a means to intimidate smaller Pokémon. It is easily cowed into submission by making even minor aggressive responses to its intimidation, however.

entry: POKENAME体表胶能引发幻视，制成抗生素软膏时，药用价值却很高。若涂皮肤太多，使用者可能因超能力反馈而头痛，因此用量要适中。
author: .izik
source: The gelatin-like goo covering POKENAME's body can cause visions, but is highly medicinal when used in the production of antibiotic ointments. Excessive application to the skin can cause headaches from psychic feedback, so moderation is important.

entry: 它们以超能力吸来石块与硬坚果，存在桶状嘴里，日后用水柱射向敌人。胶质触手极黏，抓敌很容易。
author: infinex21
source: Using their psychic powers, they pull in and store rocks and hard nuts within their barrel-like mouths to later shoot at foes using jets of water. Their gelatinous tentacles are incredibly sticky, which allows them to easily hold onto their foes.

entry: POKENAME害怕时，胶身就散出令人恶心的气味，阻止捕食者靠近。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME emits a nausea-inducing scent from its gelatinous body when its scared. This defensive mechanism discourages predators from approaching.

entry: POKENAME尾边滴下的绿胶，常被收集起来，为机械散热。它也能以超能力操纵附近者的想法，影响创造力。
author: .izik
source: The green slime dripping from POKENAME's tail is frequently harvested as a heat sink for machinery. It can also use its psychic abilities to manipulate the thoughts of those nearby, influencing their creativity.

entry: POKENAME胶身很耐物理伤害，能连续数小时猛烈训练，不太损伤。久而久之，也会调整体形，适应专精的格斗方式。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's gelatinous body can resist a lot of physical damage, so it can train roughly and vigorously for hours without much wear and tear. Over time it will adjust its body's shape to better fit its specialized type of fighting.

entry: POKENAME的尾巴是凝胶，抓住谁，就很难挣脱。黏毒胶在接触后仍会久久附着，得洗掉，免得误食。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have tails that are made out of gel that makes struggling out of their grip incredibly difficult. The sticky, poisonous gel clings to their prey long after the initial encounter and should be washed off to avoid accidental ingestion.

entry: 地面一震，液体身体就泛起波纹，令POKENAME晕乱。因此，POKENAME通常避开地震活跃区。
author: oddwalls
source: Tremors in the ground disorient POKENAME by causing its fluid body to ripple. POKENAME tends to avoid seismically active areas as a result.

entry: POKENAME周身凝胶平常很结实，却能改变稠度，让身体柔软可塑。因此，POKENAME能挤过山中住处的狭缝。
author: oddwalls
source: Usually, the gel surrounding POKENAME is firm, but it can alter the gel's consistency to make its body malleable. This allows POKENAME to slip through tight crevices in its mountainous habitat.

entry: POKENAME体外胶液导电，碰触很危险。充满电时，能把足以令心跳停止的电力，从身上传给碰它的对象。
author: quackquackattack
source: The liquid gel around the bodies of POKENAME act as a conductor for electricity and makes contact with them dangerous. When fully charged, they can transfer a heart-stopping amount of energy to flow from their bodies to whoever touched them.

entry: 它把使自己进化的雷之石，包在特殊液体里。借这块石头，便能释放10000伏的电击。
author: duskrd
source: It keeps the Thunder Stone that evolved it enveloped in a special liquid. It can use the Thunder Stone to unleash electrical shocks of 10,000 volts.

entry: 据说，80%的不明飞行物目击报告，都来自POKENAME的夜游。小触角发出的电波强得出奇，能干扰大片区域的电子设备。
author: sk372
source: It is believed POKENAME's nighttime roaming makes up 80 percent of claims of UFO sightings. Its small antenna emits deceptively powerful radio waves that interfere with electronics in a wide vicinity.

entry: 体表糖浆般的物质，似乎自有意识，像藤蔓般独立活动。这有感知的黏液，还会本能回应光与热。
author: .izik
source: The syrup-like substance covering its body seems to have a mind of its own, moving independently like vines. This sentient slime reacts instictively to heat and light.

entry: POKENAME用超能力穿行网络，在电脑间寻找大文件程序，尤其偏爱艺术类。有时光吸收一张图像文件的数据，就花上数日。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME use their psychic abilities to travel through cyberspace, moving through computers in search of programs with a high file size. They have a preference for artistic programs, sometimes spending days absorbing data from individual image files.

entry: POKENAME用超能力穿行网络，在电脑间寻找大文件程序，尤其偏爱艺术类。有时光吸收一张图像文件的数据，就花上数日。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME use their psychic abilities to travel through cyberspace, moving through computers in search of programs with a high file size. They have a preference for artistic programs, sometimes spending days absorbing data from individual image files.

entry: POKENAME每次需要举起外面的罐子，都备感压力，事后疲惫。研究者指出，居住条件让它更容易疲倦、低落。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME experiences stress whenever it needs to levitate its exterior jar, leaving it weary afterwards. Researchers note that it is more likely to be tired or depressed due to its living conditions.

entry: POKENAME熟悉别人的心情，黏稠身体会贴住喜欢作伴的人。身体温软，抱起来虽湿，却很安慰。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are attuned to the feelings of others, and their viscous bodies cling to people they enjoy spending time with. Their bodies are warm and soft and give damp yet comforting hugs.

entry: POKENAME用两颗脑，精细得出奇地施展渐长的超能力。独处时，POKENAME大多时间都用来增长智力，磨炼本领。
author: nyoomymph
source: Using its two brains, POKENAME wields its developing psychic powers with impressive finesse. A lone POKENAME will dedicate most of its time to furthering its intelligence and honing its psychic abilities.

entry: POKENAME常被养在罐子等玻璃器皿里，方便展示器官。许多训练家料不到它会胀缩，容器便常被膨胀的POKENAME撑破。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are often kept in jars and other glassware to better display their organs. Many Trainers fail to anticipate how the bodies of POKENAME grow and shrink, so POKENAME often break these glass containers when expanding.

entry: 它们藏在植物间，用酸袭击路过的草、毒属性宝可梦充饥。身体按指数增长，只有长势放缓，才说明快进化了。
author: bobosmith01
source: They live among plants and attack wandering Grass and Poison-type Pokémon with acid to hunt. They grow at an exponential rate; only when they slow down are they close to evolution.

entry: POKENAME体内浮着多颗核，支撑毒胶附着。每当动用超能力、以有害能量相互攻击时，这些核便会亮起。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have multiple nuclei floating within their body, providing scaffolding for their toxic gel to adhere to. These nuclei glow when they use their psychic powers, attacking one another with blasts of noxious energy.

entry: POKENAME伸出触角，如天线般传送超能力波，悄悄阻止其他宝可梦靠近巢穴。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's feelers extend and act as antennae to transmit psychic waves. These waves subtly deter other Pokémon from approaching its nest.

entry: POKENAME靠超能力浮行。少数尝试走路的记录中，四肢因没有肌肉，根本撑不住身体。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME use their psychic powers to float. The few times one has been seen attempting to walk, their limbs couldn't hold them up thanks to the lack of musculature.

entry: POKENAME身体光滑敏感，战斗丢失大块，也能重新长出。训练家最好带乳液或水，免得POKENAME的膜干掉。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME have smooth, sensitive bodies that can regrow major pieces if lost in battle. Trainers are advised to carry around lotion or water to make sure their POKENAME's membrane doesn't dry out.

entry: POKENAME每次用超能力，角就随能量一闪一闪。它超能力强劲，战斗能发能量弹，念力也能随意搬动数吨物料。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME horns light up with a pulse of energy whenever they use their psychic powers. They are potent psychics, flinging energy blasts in battle and able to telekinetically move several tonnes of material at will.

entry: POKENAME气泡般的外层，其实是保护别人。核心剧毒，靠近就会受伤，因此它十分孤僻，为旁人的安全，主动远离。
author: sk372
source: The bubble-like exterior of POKENAME is meant to protect others from itself, as its core body is incredibly toxic, causing harm just by being near it. It's very reclusive as a result, staying away from others for their sake.

entry: POKENAME能把持着的金属物当连枷甩，可甩太猛也有代价：物件会脱离本体，使融合的宝可梦分开。
author: turcai_87271
source: The metallic object that POKENAME holds can be swung around like a flail. This can come at a cost, however, as if the object is swung too hard, it will separate from the main body, and cause the fused Pokémon to split.

entry: 头上滴落的透明蜡状液体，热得惊人，落到哪里，都留下焦痕。
author: .izik
source: The transparent, wax-like fluid dripping from its head is intensely hot. This burning liquid leaves scorch marks wherever it falls.

entry: POKENAME在保护膜内发电，电击靠得太近的对象。遇险先亮光威吓，再释放麻痹的电流。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME generates electric fields within its protective membrane, shocking anything that gets too close. When threatened, it glows brightly to intimidate foes before delivering a paralyzing jolt.

entry: 周身黏液始终沸腾，散出高热。任何对象靠得太近，一碰便可能严重烫伤。
author: .izik
source: The slime on its body boils constantly, radiating intense heat. Contact with it can cause severe burns to anything that gets too close.

entry: 身体覆着稠黏液，黑暗中微微发光，分散猎物的注意，让它悄然接近攻击。
author: .izik
source: Its body is covered in a viscous slime that glows faintly in the dark. This glow distracts prey as it closes in silently for the attack.

entry: POKENAME把蔬菜存进守着的黏球里腌渍，最爱秋葵与欧防风，发酵成酸点心，开战前享用。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME stores vegetables inside the gooey orb it guards to pickle them. It prefers okra and parsnips, which it ferments into a sour snack before battle.

entry: POKENAME从焦油坑升起，将力量分给两颗脑：一颗来自超能力强者，另一颗来自古代曾经无敌的生物。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: Rising from tar pits, POKENAME divide its power between its two brains. One of a powerful psychic mind, and the other of a once invincible dweller of the ancient world.

entry: POKENAME有两颗脑，能极其高效地操纵自己造出的冰云，破坏力也随之增加。
author: coridiant
source: Having two brains, POKENAME controls the ice clouds it forms with great efficiency. Its destructive power is similarly increased.

entry: 它吸取周围者的记忆，化作复杂的舞蹈。每场表演，都映着收集来的情绪。
author: .izik
source: It absorbs the memories of those around it, transforming them into intricate dances. Each performance reflects the emotions it collects.

entry: 它穿上枯树桩，保护核心。可黏液让木头烂得更快，平均每两周，POKENAME就得换副铠甲。
author: bandedbodypress
source: It wears dead tree stumps to protect its core. Its slime causes its stump to decay faster, so the average POKENAME goes through its armor every two weeks.

entry: 它用根系与附近POKENAME连接心智与超能力。仅一片POKENAME之林，就能移走大岛。
author: bandedbodypress
source: It uses its roots to link minds and psychic powers with other POKENAME in its vicinity. A forest of POKENAME alone could move a large island.

entry: POKENAME穿戴木甲，保护软身。甲虽结实，攻击若能穿透，或打中甲片间隙，POKENAME仍会受到重创。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME protects its soft body by wearing pieces of wooden armor. Although this armor is durable, any attacks that can pass through it or target the gaps in between will deal massive damage to POKENAME.

entry: 黏软的身体由细胞质基质构成，里面藏着分成两半的脑。晒太阳太久就会干，两边必须合作，寻找阴凉。
author: pattybgoode
source: Its slimy body is made of cytosol that contains a divided brain. Because it will dry out if it stays too long in the sun, the two halves must work together to find shade.

entry: POKENAME黏软的身体外覆着一层薄而滑的膜，能缓冲攻击。它以超能力操纵黏液进攻，优雅地滑过地面，迷惑对手。
author: thepandasharky
source: POKENAME's gooey body is protected by a thin, slick membrane that cushions it from attacks. It uses its psychic powers to attack with its slime, confusing opponents as it slides gracefully across the ground.

entry: 体表果冻状物质，闻着、摸着都像蜂蜜。黏黏的性质，既能引来朋友，也能引来敌人。
author: .izik
source: The gelatin-like substance covering its body smells and feels like honey. Its sticky nature attracts both friends and foes alike.

entry: 凝胶外衣在暗中发出幽光，迷住猎物。攻击前，它先嚎叫，精准地将目标定住。
author: .izik
source: Its gelatinous covering emits an eerie glow in the dark, mesmerizing its prey. Before attacking, it howls, pinning its target with precision.

entry: POKENAME把核心护在钟形胶泡里。更耐用的部位从胶底伸出，以急爬的动作带着身体前进。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME protect their core nucleus within a bell-shaped bubble of gel. More durable parts of their body protrude from the bottom of their gel, moving them along with scuttling motions.

entry: 翼上飘落的闪粉，留着超能力余波，会使人迷乱头痛，也能扰乱敌人。
author: .izik
source: The glitter falling from its wings contains remnants of psychic power, causing confusion and headaches. This shimmering dust can disorient foes.

entry: POKENAME产生柔软黏稠的果冻，吃下便化成营养丰富的胶浆。它会多产出自身两倍重的果冻，多数脱成大球，供其他宝可梦吃。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME produce a soft, viscous jelly that melts into a slurry of nutritious goo when eaten. Its body produces an excess volume of twice its body weight in jelly, most of which it sheds in large bulbous blobs that other Pokémon eat.

entry: POKENAME体胶散发沼泽味，在湿地久久不散。它用超能力摘苹果，飘到嘴边。
author: .izik
source: The gelatin coating POKENAME's body releases a swampy odor that lingers in humid areas. It uses its psychic powers to pluck apples from trees, floating them toward its mouth.

entry: POKENAME凝胶天生能消音，让它行动近乎无声。音响工程师借它在墙上涂胶，确保录音室有效隔音。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME gel has natural sound-dampening qualities, allowing them to move almost silently. Sound engineers employ them to help ensure studios are effectively sound-proofed, letting POKENAME apply a layer of gel across the walls.

entry: 它撞上路人，让钱包里的硬币掉落，再用胶掌吸住，转身逃跑。
author: .izik
source: It bumps into people, scattering coins from their purses onto the ground. It then absorbs the coins into its gelatinous paws and flees.

entry: POKENAME凝胶常用于暖包，帮人过冬。胶会回应持有者的需要，只有握着它的人开始冷，才变得温暖。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME gel is a common ingredient in heat packs, helping people stay warm during the winter. Their gel is reactive to a person's needs, only becoming warm to the touch when the person holding it starts feeling cold.

entry: 第二颗脑比主脑聪明得多，数毫秒就解开复杂方程。双脑合力，让它成为出色的战略家。
author: .izik
source: The second brain is significantly more intelligent than the main one, solving complex equations in mere milliseconds. This dual intelligence makes it an incredible strategist.

entry: POKENAME神秘又令人畏惧，影响心神的毒极强，虽不伤身体，多数受害者仍会被惊昏。侥幸逃掉的，也从此难复从前。
author: dylonk25
source: Mysterious and highly feared, POKENAME's psychoactive poison is incredibly potent. Though it does no physical damage, most victims pass out from shock. Those who do escape are never quite the same afterwards.

entry: POKENAME身上覆着水样凝胶，能轻松破开水流，快速游动。感到威胁时，它们会将凝胶收回壳里，保护自己免受伤害。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME coat their bodies in a watery gel that allows them to swim at speed, the gel letting them cut through water easily. When they feel threatened their gel can be withdrawn into their shell, keeping themselves safe from harm.

entry: POKENAME身体透明，让科学家弄清水箭龟如何从体内喷水。它还常来课堂展示水炮。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have helped scientists understand how water shoots from the body of Blastoise thanks to their clear bodies. Many classrooms have a visit from POKENAME to show off how they fire their water cannons.

entry: 体表液体一碰，就能引发强烈妄想，让人仿佛在幻觉中活过整整一个月，事后迷乱不已。
author: .izik
source: The fluid coating its body can induce intense delusions if touched, causing people to hallucinate an entire month of their life. This effect leaves them disoriented and confused.

entry: 它徘徊游乐场，以催眠让孩子交出零食。淘气的天性，让它又狡猾又麻烦。
author: .izik
source: It lingers near playgrounds, using hypnosis to convince children to hand over their snacks. Its mischievous nature makes it both cunning and troublesome.

entry: POKENAME背上种子放出的孢子，闻起来像刚洗好的衣物。厂商将孢子加入香体棒，让人也有同样清新洁净的气味。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME release spores from the bulb on their back that smell like fresh laundry. Manufacturers take these spores and incorporate them into deodorant sticks to give people the same fresh, clean smell.

entry: POKENAME住处有许多火属性天敌，便吃巧可果防身。棉絮般的毛太易燃，因此这份防备尤其重要。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME live in a habitat that has a lot of Fire-type predators around them, so they eat Occa Berries to help defend themselves against the predators. This is especially necessary because their cotton-like fur catches fire easily.

entry: POKENAME身体并非实钢，而是棉花与铅，能慢慢随风飘。POKENAME很爱在雨云里漂游，可停电的整座城镇，恐怕不这么想。
author: lovelover75
source: As opposed to solid steel, POKENAME's body is composed of cotton and lead, allowing it to drift through the air at a slow rate. POKENAME loves drifting about within the rainclouds, although entire towns suffering from power outages say otherwise.

entry: POKENAME随风轻摆，宛如催眠的舞蹈，带着淡淡惆怅，任风吹向何方。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME sways back and forth with the wind, creating a hypnotic dance. It wistfully goes wherever the wind blows.

entry: POKENAME用刀臂修掉多余棉絮，免得自己太轻。身上软毛越多，就越轻，越容易被风带走。
author: sk372
source: The more cottony fluff on POKENAME's body, the lighter and more easily windswept it is. It uses its bladed arms to trim off excess cotton in order to keep itself from becoming too light.

entry: POKENAME覆着天鹅绒般的软棉，无忧无虑地随风漂游，若数起星星，还可能睡着。
author: pastapockets
source: POKENAME is covered in a soft, velvety cotton. It floats on the breeze, carefree, and may fall asleep if it starts counting stars.

entry: POKENAME背上的棉易燃，天干气热时更甚。训练家最好夏天把POKENAME养在屋里，免得意外起火。
author: quackquackattack
source: The cotton on the backs of POKENAME is flammable, especially when the air is dry and conditions are hot. Trainers are advised to keep POKENAME indoors during the summer to avoid accidental fires.

entry: POKENAME一暴怒，颈棉就燃起烈焰，直烧到只剩煤灰。几小时后，棉领便自行长回，比先前更软。
author: fiordaliso
source: When POKENAME flies into a rage, the cotton around its neck bursts into fierce flames, burning until nothing but soot remains. The cotton collar grows back on its own within hours, softer than before.

entry: 成百只POKENAME随暖风飞行，冬天迁去更暖的地方，也会拿多余的棉花筑巢。
author: mistymagius
source: Flocks of POKENAME can be seen by the hundreds flying along warm breezes, migrating to warmer areas during the winter months. They will use some of their extra cotton to help build their nests.

entry: POKENAME从树上跃下，用长棉尾滑翔落地，缓冲冲击。柔软毛发里，总有淡淡草药香。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME skillfully uses its long cotton tail to glide to the ground after leaping from trees, cushioning any impact or fall. Its soft fur always carries a delicate herbal scent.

entry: 它喝晶亮的晨露，在林间有阳光的地方蹦跳。有些POKENAME好奇，走离家园，训练家捕到的野生POKENAME，多半便来自它们。
author: bobosmith01
source: It sips sparkling morning dew and hops around in sunny spots in groves in the woods. Some POKENAME are curious and wander away from home: these are the source of most wild POKENAME that Trainers catch.

entry: POKENAME毛发极不沾水，哪怕刚游完，身体也轻得足以随风漂行。
author: bee4082
source: The fur of a POKENAME is incredibly impervious to water, letting the Pokémon remain light enough to float on the winds even right after a swim.

entry: POKENAME藏在地窖角落，装成灰团或散毛，等机会偷食物。蓬松身体让它带着残羹，也能借风逃走。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME hide in cellar corners, pretending to be clumps of dust or stray fluff. They lie in wait for opportunities to steal food, their fluffy bodies helping them to escape on the wind with their scraps.

entry: 雄性POKENAME通常不长毛，鳃较长，因为负责在地面找安全地方，供雌性夜里歇息。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Typically, male POKENAME do not grow fur on their bodies and have longer gills. This is because they are tasked with finding safe places on the ground for the females to rest at night.

entry: 雌性POKENAME通常满身毛，鳃较短，因为白天会浮在空中警戒，雄性则留在下方地面。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Typically, female POKENAME are covered in fur and have shorter gills. This is because they spend the day floating in the air, looking out for danger, while the males stay on the ground below.

entry: POKENAME一激动，花朵便喷出棉絮孢子。孢子容易结团，吸入十分危险。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's flower spews cotton-like spores when it is agitated. The spores are dangerous to breathe due to their tendency to clump together.

entry: POKENAME用超能力调整落棉的方向，将它们精准撒在战场，拖慢对手。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses psychic power to redirect falling cotton fluffs. It drops them across the battlefield to slow down opponents with precise placement.

entry: 它从炮管中射出棉花，想吓走天敌。可毕竟只是棉花，这招常不管用，照样挨打。
author: soup1900
source: It shoots cotton out of its cannons to scare predators away. This defense is often ineffective since it's just cotton, and it gets attacked anyways.

entry: 从POKENAME身上摘下的棉花，即使过了好几年，摸上去仍然温暖。不过，POKENAME并不喜欢被当作枕头，谁躺上来，它就会让体温骤然升高。
author: notadoctor75
source: Any cotton that is picked from POKENAME's body will remain warm to the touch, even for years after being removed. POKENAME itself, however, does not like being used as a pillow, and will drastically increase its temperature if laid on.

entry: POKENAME整天神游天外，很容易分心。训练家想让POKENAME在战斗中专注，可不容易。
author: hophoppip
source: Spacey and easily distracted, POKENAME always has its head in the clouds. It can be difficult for a POKENAME's Trainer to get their Pokémon to focus in battle.

entry: POKENAME六七只成群，漂过城镇。挤得太近，下方电脑便开始出故障。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME drift in groups of six to seven over towns. When they cluster too closely together, computers below them begin to malfunction.

entry: POKENAME的棉唇，亲起来柔软无比。它是受珍视的安慰伙伴，尤其能让新生宝可梦与人类幼儿安心。
author: foolish_weasel
source: The sensation of being smooched by POKENAME is incredibly soft, due to its cotton lips. It is valued as a comforting companion, especially for newborn Pokémon and humans alike.

entry: POKENAME在树上睡觉，会让树皮长出大团棉。可这特殊棉絮出奇脆，很难用来缝纫。
author: .izik
source: While sleeping in a tree, POKENAME causes large tufts of cotton to grow from the bark. This special cotton is surprisingly brittle and difficult to use for sewing.

entry: POKENAME轻得惊人，想留在原地，就得将脚扎进土里，用利爪抓牢地面。准备出发时，它便把脚拔出来，任风带着身体前行。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME is incredibly light; if it wishes to remain in place, it must dig its feet into the ground and grip the earth with its talons. Once it is ready to move on, POKENAME will unearth its feet and allow the wind to carry its body along.

entry: POKENAME体表覆着浮力极强的厚棉，因此很难在湖面下潜得长久。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body is coated in a thick layer of highly buoyant cotton. Because of this, it struggles to dive below a lake's surface for any significant length of time.
