entry: POKENAME颊棉一鼓起，不知为何就能轻松离地，浮过草甸，朝下方植物喷洒轻柔的水流。
author: .izik
source: When the cotton on POKENAME's cheeks puffs out, it somehow gains the ability to lift off the ground with ease. It drifts above meadows, spitting gentle streams of water onto the plants below.

entry: POKENAME头上的棉絮，一察觉附近危险就会振动。受威胁时瞬移逃走，原地只留一小团软毛。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's cotton-like covering on its head vibrates when it senses danger in the area. It teleports away when threatened, leaving behind a small cloud of fluff in its place.

entry: POKENAME以多变的色彩闻名，压力与温度的不同组合，都会让它变色。长舌能远远饮水，免得靠得太近，棉毛一湿就变沉。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are renowned for the variety of colors they can change to when exposed to combinations of pressure and temperature. They use their long tongues to drink water and avoid getting close to it, for their cotton grows too heavy when wet.

entry: POKENAME身体轻缈，由棉状物构成。通常无风时才显形，因为大风会吹走部分棉絮，使它衰弱。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has a wispy body made of a cotton-like substance. It usually manifests on windless days, as strong gusts may blow parts of its cotton away and weaken it.

entry: 无风的日子，常见POKENAME从种子形石头里出现，在日下起舞。风一起就少肯出来，因为棉絮身体太易被吹走。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can often be seen emerging from its seed-shaped stone to dance beneath the sunlight on windless days. It rarely comes out when the wind picks up, as its cottony body is easily blown away by the gusts.

entry: POKENAME背上的大团棉又轻又蓬松，是野生宝可梦舒服的睡处。挪动前，它们会梳理棉毛，确保不把睡客也一起带走。
author: quackquackattack
source: The mass of cotton on POKENAME's back is light and fluffy, making them a cozy spot for wild Pokémon to fall asleep on. Before they move from one location to another, they comb their cotton fluff to ensure sleeping Pokémon are not carried with them.

entry: POKENAME用大嘴般的附肢存食，也装得比实际更凶。可大嘴吸水极强，沾湿很快就重，因此总小心避开液体。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME use their maw-like appendages to store food and to make themselves look fiercer than they truly are. Their maws are incredibly absorbent and quickly grow heavy when wet, so they take care to keep them away from any liquids.

entry: 它用棉絮，让喜欢的人待得舒适。战斗时，也能给一部分棉注毒，掷向敌人。
author: bacondlx
source: It uses its cotton to keep people it likes comfortable. When it engages in combat it can imbue some of its cotton with venom before throwing it at foes.

entry: POKENAME体型虽大，极轻的风也能托起。它们飘过内陆田野，以软毛收集花粉种子，再撒向海岸礁群，给海中宝可梦提供宝贵养分。
author: vic1312
source: Despite their size, POKENAME can float on the gentlest of winds. They drift over inland fields, gathering pollen and seeds in their fluff, scattering them over coastal reefs to feed sea-going Pokémon valuable nutrients.

entry: 人们曾相信，只要收集足够多POKENAME棉中落下的种子，就能实现一个愿望。细致研究，却已彻底否定这些说法。
author: .izik
source: Seeds shed from POKENAME's cotton were once believed to grant a single wish if gathered in great numbers. Careful study later proved these claims entirely false.

entry: 蒲公英般的种子团从POKENAME头上飘走，在地上扎根。未来季节再来时，POKENAME能凭长出的花香，记起曾到过哪里。
author: catsquatch_geography
source: Dandelion-like seed heads float off the POKENAME's head and plant themselves in the ground. When POKENAME returns in future seasons, it can remember where it has been by the scent of the flowers that have grown from those seeds.

entry: POKENAME树皮里长出的蓬松棉絮，让它能远距离漂行。连睡着也能漂，一连数小时不落地。
author: .izik
source: The voluminous cotton growing from POKENAME's bark allows it to float over long distances. It can even do this while sleeping, staying airborne for hours at a time.

entry: POKENAME的背结实舒适，能将受伤的人与宝可梦送往治疗处，途中尽量保持平稳，减轻痛苦。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME's back is sturdy and comfortable, meaning it can be used to transfer injured Pokémon and people to where they can be healed, all while keeping them stable and in as little pain as possible.

entry: POKENAME背上的巨型棉株，割后长得很快。制衣厂正考虑拿POKENAME供应原料。
author: hophoppip
source: The giant cotton plants on POKENAME's back regrow quickly when cut. Clothing manufacturers are considering using POKENAME as a source of material.

entry: 它平时温顺，整天编织耐热的布。受威胁时，会喷出枕头般的棉团，燃成亮火球，吓退天敌。
author: catsquatch_geography
source: Normally docile, it spends its days weaving heat-resistant cloth. When threatened, it ejects pillows of cotton that ignite into bright balls of flame to scare off predators.

entry: POKENAME高居枝头，避开大多纷争。被迫自卫，就从尾巴放出一阵棉絮，碰到皮肤会有灼痛。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME stays up high in tree branches, avoiding most avenues of conflict. If forced to defend itself, it lets loose a burst of cotton from its tail that causes a burning sensation on contact with skin.

entry: 力量、速度虽强，身体却太轻，常一拳就把自己反弹飞。等POKENAME双脚练出超常的抓地力，能借地面作支撑，才有本领打伤别人。
author: epping_forest
source: Despite its sheer power and speed, it's so light that the strength of its own punches usually sends it flying. POKENAME becomes able to hurt others as it develops the superhuman grip strength of its feet, to use the floor as a counterforce.

entry: POKENAME幼时覆着棉絮羽毛，抵挡寒风冷水。POKENAME准备进化，就会同时换掉所有羽毛，这期间无法游泳捕鱼。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME is covered in cottony down feathers that protect it from the cold winds and waters during its adolescence. When POKENAME is ready to evolve, it will begin to molt all of its feathers at the same time, during which it cannot swim or fish.

entry: POKENAME身上棉状的物质，质地其实更近钢丝绒。它在栖地的拍岸浪中磨利翼刃，再用棉絮抹去杂质。
author: notadoctor75
source: The cotton-like growths on POKENAME are actually closer in consistency to steel wool. It sharpens the blades on its wings in the crashing tides where it lives, then uses the cotton to smooth out any impurities.

entry: POKENAME优雅浮过冰面，小心不让棉絮沾水。它喜欢独处，偶尔也会贴着同类。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME gracefully floats along the ice, making sure its cottony bits steer clear of water. While it prefers solitude, it sometimes sticks to others of their kind.

entry: POKENAME先把棉花射向对手眼睛，再发动攻击。身轻固然灵巧，却也容易被人推开。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME shoots cotton into its opponent's eyes before attacking. Its light weight makes it nimble yet easy to push around.

entry: POKENAME用练习棍般的武器，将来犯者推远。若看来要输，就朝敌人射出棉絮，趁机逃跑。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME uses its pugil stick-like weapon to push away would be attackers. If the battle seems lost, it shoots its cotton at its foe to escape.

entry: POKENAME用棉筑墙，猎物看不透，自己却有透视眼。一等机会到，就跃穿软而轻的屏障，趁猎物未及反应，突然袭击。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME uses its cotton to create walls that its prey cannot see through, though it can see through them thanks to its x-ray vision. Once the moment strikes, it leaps through the soft and airy barrier, ambushing the prey before they can react.

entry: POKENAME虹彩的棉，沾湿仍保留大半蓬松，适合制防泼水衣物。尾巴柔软如绒，抱一抱，就能洗去心中不快。
author: milchik
source: POKENAME's iridescent cotton saves most of its fluffiness even when wet, making it excellent for water-resistant clothes. Its tail is so soft and downy that hugging it can wash negative emotions from one's heart.

entry: 每年秋天，POKENAME触角会长棉，再自然脱落。它便在寒冬来前，拿这些棉筑成舒服的巢。
author: .izik
source: Tufts of cotton grow from POKENAME's feelers each autumn before being naturally shed. It uses these to build itself a comfortable nest before the winter's cold arrives.

entry: 据说POKENAME的棉身，是所有宝可梦里最软最好抱的。可它胆小极了，只肯让最信赖的训练家抱；别的对象则先挨耳击，再看它惊慌跳走。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's cotton-like body is said to be the softest and most cuddly of all Pokémon. However, it is extremely timid; only the most trusted of Trainers get to hug it, while anything else will be smacked with its ears before it leaps away in fear.

entry: POKENAME小而轻，谨慎极了，不熟悉的东西刚一出现，就想逃。它跃入空中，让最弱的微风也带走自己，盼着去更安全的地方。
author: sk372
source: Tiny and lightweight, the extremely-cautious POKENAME will try to escape from anything unfamiliar the second it notices it. It leaps into the air, and lets even the faintest breeze carry its small body off somewhere hopefully safer.

entry: 风大的日子，POKENAME便藏好，免得火焰被强风吹灭。火一弱，就用自己的棉絮添燃料。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME hides away during windy days, as its flame is at risk of being blown out by a strong gust. When the flame grows weak, it fuels it with pieces of its own cotton.

entry: POKENAME每天翼上脱棉，可用于衣物与毛毯，因此受人饲养。战斗时撒棉点火，灼烧敌人。生态学家正帮助POKENAME恢复减少的族群数量。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME are raised for the cotton their wings shed daily, which is used in clothing and blankets. They spread cotton in battle, igniting it to burn foes. Ecologists are helping POKENAME recover their dwindling population.

entry: POKENAME一家高速奔过大地，长长的叶状尾巴拖在身后。它们一边增强头顶阳光，一边用尾巴将光化作充沛能量，供自己奔跑。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Families of POKENAME race across the landscape at high speed, their long leaf-like tails trailing behind them. They are able to intensify the sunlight above them whilst using their tails to turn the same light into an abundance of energy to run with.

entry: POKENAME睡在厚厚的棉球里，抵御攻击。只有身旁传来真心的愿望，它才会露面。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME sleeps within a thick ball of cotton, protecting it from attacks. It will only emerge if a heartfelt wish is spoken near it.

entry: POKENAME的棉枕很受欢迎，传说能生出正面能量。虽未证实，软质地至少确实让人好眠，醒来精神舒畅。
author: periperi_chicken
source: Pillows stuffed with POKENAME cotton are popular as it is rumoured to manifest positive energy. Though these claims are unproven, the soft texture is known to at least provide a restful sleep and leave users feeling refreshed.

entry: POKENAME体表棉一干，就脆得很，因此一生大半时候，都愿沉在海里。
author: .izik
source: When the cotton covering POKENAME's body dries out, it becomes incredibly brittle. Because of this, it prefers to remain submerged in the ocean for most of its life.

entry: POKENAME棉毛虽厚，身体却轻得出奇。毛既强导电，又极吸水，沾湿反而难放出自身电力，因此雨天会躲起来。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME have remarkably light bodies despite their thick, cotton-like fur. Their fur is a powerful electrical conductor and very absorbant of fluids. When their fur is wet they struggle to release their own electricity, so they hide during rain.

entry: POKENAME聚成一团巨大的静电球。一察觉危险，POKENAME蓬松的毛就闪得耀眼。
author: lydiaprower8
source: A group of POKENAME gather to form a massive ball of static electricity. Its fluffy fur dazzles when POKENAME senses danger.

entry: POKENAME乘雷暴漂行，主动进入雷电的路径，吸取雷击能量。最终落在风暴背风处，便用积攒的能量成长或进化。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME ride in thunderstorms, floating into the paths of lightning bolts to absorb energy from the strikes. When they finally settle in the lee of the storm, they use the energy they've gathered to grow or evolve.

entry: POKENAME讨厌沾湿，总带着一片叶子遮雨。身体保持干燥，它便能扯下棉球，用尾焰点燃，再投向敌人。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME hate being wet, and always carry a leaf with them to shelter from the rain. If they keep their body dry, they can pull off balls of cotton, set them on fire using their flaming tail, then toss them at foes as projectiles.

entry: 风大的季节，它蜷起身体，任风带往远方。沿途撒下花粉，暖地尤其多。
author: foolish_weasel
source: During windy seasons it will curl up and let the wind carry it to far away lands. As it floats with the wind it will release pollen, especially if it is in warm climates.

entry: POKENAME悠悠飘过向日葵田，用小触须从花上摘种子。微风轻松托着，数日也不必落地。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME drifts lazily over sunflower fields, using its tiny tendrils to pluck seeds from the blossoms. It can go days without landing, carried effortlessly by the breeze.

entry: POKENAME的棉，比未融合的木棉球更蓬松、更轻，也就更易被风托走。身体软弹，又爱拥抱，让年轻训练家十分喜爱。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have far fluffier and lighter cotton than unfused Cottonee. This makes them far lighter and easier for the breeze to pick up. They are a popular Pokémon for younger Trainers as they are squishy and enjoy being hugged.

entry: POKENAME的棉很易脱落，黏在敌人嘴上，足够争取逃走的时间。它在田野晒太阳蓄能，夜里钻进地下。
author: chibitales
source: The cotton on POKENAME's body comes off easily, sticking to the mouth of opponents long enough for it to escape. It lounges in fields to absorb energy from the sun and burrows into the ground at night.

entry: POKENAME飘在电线旁，尽可能靠近，却不直接碰触。空气静电让棉绒微微噼啪作响，充满能量。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME hovers near powerlines, positioning itself as close as possible without making direct contact. The static charge in the air causes its cotton-like fluff to crackle softly with energy.

entry: POKENAME几乎没有重量，像棉团随风漂，节省精力。一发现猎物，就猛振双翼，快得惊人地向前冲。
author: deniablecredibility
source: POKENAME is almost weightless and is able to conserve energy by drifting on the breeze like a puff of cotton. When it spies its prey, it snaps its wings and darts forward with incredible speed.

entry: POKENAME能轻易切换随风漂游与高速飞行，空中灵活性无可比拟。可强风里，仍可能辨不稳方向。
author: deniablecredibility
source: POKENAME is able to effortlessly alternate between drifting on the breeze and flying with incredible speed. This gives it unmatched aerial mobility, though it may struggle to maintain its bearing in strong winds.

entry: POKENAME的觅食洞穴记录很全，究竟在哪筑巢，却始终是谜。受惊就喷棉转移注意，逃去何处，研究者仍想不明白。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME's feeding caves are well documented, but the nesting grounds they come from are a mystery. When startled, they expel cotton from their bodies as a distraction, leaving researchers still wondering where they go.

entry: POKENAME触角一感知震动，便静止、落地、收起小脚，装成小灌木。为了不被强风吹走，POKENAME也会将脚扎进硬地。
author: infinex21
source: When POKENAME sense vibrations via their feelers, they go still, drop to the ground, and tuck in their small feet to disguise themselves as small shrubs. To keep from being blown away by strong winds, POKENAME dig their feet into a hard surface.

entry: 它鼓出棉，扯下投掷，保护自己或旁人。许多人相信，POKENAME总去安慰痛苦的人，是因为自己也脆弱，不愿别人再尝它受过的苦。
author: infinex21
source: It puffs out, tears off, and throws its cotton to protect itself or others. Many believe POKENAME is drawn to those in pain and offers them comfort because it, too, is frail and wishes not for others to suffer like it has.

entry: 它们浓绿的体色，来自檫树叶的食谱。据说，这些叶子能神奇地治疗许多现代疾病。此外，这食谱也让POKENAME对捕食者有毒。
author: quackquackattack
source: Their heavy green pigmentation comes from their diet of sassafras leaves, which are said to provide miraculous cures to many modern diseases. Additionally, this diet makes POKENAME poisonous to other predators.

entry: POKENAME在森林与浅海都能好好生活。头上耳朵般的结构，其实用来闻气味。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME thrives in both forests and the shallows of the sea. The ear-like structures on its head are for smelling.

entry: POKENAME棉绒轻盈，遇足够的风，整个身体就会被卷上天空。它们主动找多风处，漂在空中，原地转圈，伸展叶片晒太阳。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME fluff is light enough that they can be swept up into the air with a strong enough gust of wind. They seek out windy places so that they can float through the air, twirling in place and stretching their leaves out to catch the sun.

entry: 它蹦来跳去，仿佛轻如羽毛。因此，一记重击往往让对手措手不及。
author: staghorn
source: It bounces about as if it were as light as a feather. Because of this, many of its opponents are caught off-guard by its heavy blows.

entry: POKENAME近岸漂游，将海沫收进蓬松棉里，吸取水分。即使海岸风干，也能保持湿润。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME collects seafoam within its fluffy cotton, absorbing moisture as it floats near the shore. This helps it stay hydrated even in dry coastal winds.

entry: POKENAME颇轻，展开叶爪就能飘行。还会扔出绒棉，分散来敌注意。棉质好又稀少，十分珍贵。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME are rather lightweight, able to drift in the air when spreading their leaf claws out. They can throw puffy cotton to distract attackers. This cotton is prized for its quality and rarity.

entry: POKENAME攀住海岩，刮藤壶吃。一受惊，就立刻松手，任风带到安全处。
author: .izik
source: Clinging to ocean rocks, POKENAME scrapes off barnacles to feed on. If startled, it instantly releases its grip and lets the wind carry it away to safety.

entry: POKENAME外壳很软，脱落的碎块常被拿来代替粉笔。受攻击时，便从体内喷粉，趁机逃走。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME's outer shell is very soft and shedded chunks of it are often used as a chalk substitute. When attacked, it shoots dust from its body and escapes.

entry: POKENAME静不住，飞快蹦跳找食物，遇险就撒出绒毛云。定期脱下的毛，经加工可代替棉制品，价格低廉。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is fidgety, hopping around quickly to scrounge food and shedding clouds of fluff in self-defense. Its regularly-shed fur can be processed and used as a cheap alternative to cotton products.

entry: POKENAME身披的棉里，有数千根细到肉眼难辨的刺。受威胁便四周喷棉，筑成几乎无法穿过的穹罩，碰到就痒，宛如玻璃纤维。
author: dodoowner_
source: There are thousands of microscopic thorns present in the cotton POKENAME wears. When threatened, it expels cotton all around it, creating a near-impenetrable dome. Touching it causes an itching sensation, similar to fiberglass.

entry: POKENAME的壳软而脆，淋雨却会变坚固，也更沉。受攻击，便射刺逃走。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME's shell is soft but fragile, and gets sturdier but heavier in the rain. When attacked, it shoots its spikes and runs off.

entry: POKENAME唤出的棉团，是世上最舒服的材料之一。可拿来做枕头，评价就两极，因为睡着的人常瞥见未来的片段。
author: notadoctor75
source: The tufts that POKENAME summons are some of the most comfortable materials that can be found in the world. People have mixed opinions on using it for pillows, though, because those who fall asleep on them often see glimpses of the future.

entry: POKENAME住在火山岛，吃煤灰。灰烬还能加快体表棉絮生长。
author: .izik
source: Living on volcanic islands, POKENAME feeds on soot. The ash accelerates the growth of the cotton covering its body.

entry: POKENAME站在瓜田，挥动双臂，棉絮从身上飘落。纤维滋养土壤，让植物长得健康。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME stands in gourd patches, waving its arms as cotton drifts from its body. The fibers nourish the soil, encouraging healthy plant growth.

entry: POKENAME棉绒很软，却难晾干，常滋生霉菌。有些训练家还让小植物长在POKENAME毛里，添点装饰。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME's cotton fluff is soft, but often becomes infested with mold and mildew because it is hard to dry. Some Trainers allow small plants to grow in POKENAME's fluff to add a bit of flair.

entry: POKENAME的棉很吸水，连干旱也能舒服地湿润着。平时常在池塘与湖泊划游，阵雨时则会上岸。
author: imaginita
source: POKENAME's cotton soaks up water with ease, keeping them pleasantly damp even during a drought. They can generally be found paddling around ponds and lakes, but will come on land during rain showers.

entry: POKENAME常望着水域，满怀向往。可一沾湿，棉絮就会压重身体。训练家替它梳棉时得轻柔，因为十分敏感。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME can be found staring longingly at bodies of water. If it gets wet, the cotton of a POKENAME will weigh it down. Trainers who care for one must be gentle when brushing its cotton, as it's quite sensitive.

entry: POKENAME周身的棉，满是装着氦气的泡泡，让它能浮到海面上方最高10英尺。
author: .izik
source: The cotton surrounding POKENAME's body is filled with bubbles containing helium. This allows it to float up to 10 feet above the ocean's surface.

entry: 这位兴奋的小厨师，以温和火焰和身上长的香草，将做出的菜肴调味得恰到好处。虽更爱蔬菜料理，POKENAME多数餐点都能做得出色。
author: evilgammon
source: This excitable little chef is able to perfectly season any dish it has cooked with its gentle flames and naturally grown herbs. While preferring to prepare vegetable dishes, POKENAME will prepare most meals to a high standard.

entry: 风特别大时，POKENAME会被卷出水面，抛到半空。它们试着用叶子转回去，却很少成功。
author: clownatosis
source: On extremely windy days, POKENAME can be seen getting lifted out of the water and tossed through the air. They try to use their leaves to steer back, however, it rarely works.

entry: POKENAME的每个头都先顾自己安全，会扯走别的头的棉花据为己用。若太贪心，堆得过多的棉花反会挡住视线。
author: mistymagius
source: Each of POKENAME's heads prioritize their own safety, so they will pull off each other's cotton to use for themselves. If one head gets too greedy, the cotton will start to impair its vision.

entry: POKENAME用坚韧的草壳，保护蓬松软身。实际比笨重外形看着轻，能在水面浮荡，不会下沉。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME protect their fluffy, soft bodies with a tough grassy shell. They are lighter than their bulky appearance would suggest and can bob along the water's surface without sinking.

entry: POKENAME蓬松得无可比拟，纤细的绒絮摸着软极了。可虽有实感，一扯下一簇，就会散成烟。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are the epitome of fluffy, as their delicate wisps feel plush to the touch. Despite feeling physical, pulling a tuft of wisps causes them to disintegrate into smoke.

entry: POKENAME埋进沙里，只露鼻孔，几乎看不见。闻到猎物靠近，就以爆炸将自己轰出沙中，冲向即将到嘴的食物。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME buries itself in the sand save for its nostrils, almost completely hidden from view. When it smells prey coming near, it uses an explosion to propel itself out of the sand and careen towards its prospective meal.

entry: 这些沙漠宝可梦演化出了将头藏进遗骸的本领，下半身则埋在沙中。猎物靠近时，它们便抓起一根骨头当作棍棒，猛击对方，直到其屈服。
author: infinex21
source: These desert Pokémon have evolved to be able to hide their own heads within remains, with their lower bodies submerged in the sands. When prey draws near, they grab hold of a bone and use it like a club to pummel them into submission.

entry: POKENAME喷沙云，掩护接近猎物，也能在躲藏时扰敌。它生性爱捣乱，盗贼便与它结伴，趁沙迷眼，偷走财物。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME spews clouds of sand to mask its approach on prey and to distract foes while it hides. Because of its mischievous streak, thieves partner with it to take advantage of the blinding sand sprays while absconding with valuables.

entry: POKENAME太热时，背上的石片就掀起，放出体内热量，让它还能顶着太阳继续捕猎。
author: .izik
source: When overheated, stone flaps along POKENAME's back lift up to release internal heat. This keeps it cool enough to keep hunting in the sun.

entry: POKENAME能在软沙中游动，用角破开阻路的坚硬表面。野生个体会在夏天把热量储存在体内，用来在秋冬保暖。
author: npshi
source: POKENAME can swim through soft sand, using their horn to break any hard surface that impedes their travels. Wild POKENAME store heat within their bodies during the summer, which they use to keep warm through the autumn and winter seasons.

entry: POKENAME不太聪明，常把石头当猎物，扑咬过去，冒着受伤风险。它咬击明明极危险，却仍常被低估。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is not very intelligent, often mistaking rocks for prey and lunging at them, risking injury. Many underestimate it, despite its extremely dangerous bite.

entry: POKENAME住在海底沙中的大凹坑。它好奇，常探头观察四周，可除非有吃的，否则很快就缩回家。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME makes its home in large divots in the undersea sand. A curious sort, it often pokes its head out to observe its surroundings, but is quick to retreat back home unless food is involved.

entry: POKENAME是游泳者的灾星，与湖底泥沙融为一体。它纹丝不动，只要有东西挡住阳光，便猛冲水面，咬力足以折弯钢铁。
author: ghostslythe
source: The bane of Swimmers, POKENAME blends perfectly with the mud and silt at the bottom of lakes. It lies motionless until anything blocks the sunlight, causing it to explode to the surface and bite with enough force to bend steel.

entry: POKENAME藏在可疑网站的弹窗广告下。光标一近，就猛合双颚，像想咬住指针。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME hides beneath pop-up ads on shady websites. When a cursor draws near, it snaps its jaws as if trying to bite the pointer.

entry: POKENAME白天钻进沙里睡觉，夜间在地面狩猎。皮肤太紧时，就在地下蜕皮。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME burrows into desert sand during the day to sleep and hunts above ground during the night. It will molt underground once its skin becomes too tight.

entry: POKENAME埋进沙里，看不出与普通黑眼鳄有别。可它能隐身，也能飞，捕猎与避敌的本领都更好。
author: imaginita
source: When submerged in sand, POKENAME is indistinguishable from a common Sandile.  Unlike common Sandile, however, it can turn invisible or fly into the air, making it better at hunting prey and evading predators.

entry: POKENAME把眼睛与鼻子露出沙面，窥看四周。它常用背火引猎物靠近，再出击。
author: bonquilis
source: POKENAME keeps its eyes and nose above the desert sand to peer at its surroundings. It often uses the fire on its back to entice potential prey to move closer before striking.

entry: POKENAME模样虽可爱，却能将大意的训练家咬成重伤。它们行动迅速，仿佛在沙里游泳，只露出鼻孔与背刺。
author: markusknight
source: POKENAME, in spite of its cuteness, can deliver devastating bites to careless Trainers. They move very quickly, seemingly swimming in sand, with only their nostrils and backspikes visible.

entry: POKENAME潜在水下，咬住猎物。抓牢后，就翻滚扭身，重创对方的腿，也断掉逃生的机会。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME hunt by biting their prey while submerged underwater. Once they have a good grip, they roll and twist their body to severely damage the prey's leg and any chance of escape.

entry: POKENAME淘气极了，特别爱偷像流星或星星的东西。被当场抓住就哭，通常凭可爱的模样，便能蒙混过关。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is extremely mischievous, and especially likes to steal anything that reminds it of meteors or stars. When caught in the act of mischief, it cries and usually gets away with it due to its cuteness.

entry: POKENAME有时游在沙里，藏住皮革般、颜色鲜亮的蛋壳。试着站直时，偶尔也会仰面卡住。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME sometimes swims in sand, concealing its leathery, brightly coloured eggshell. It might occasionally get stuck on its back trying to stand upright.

entry: POKENAME白天埋进沙漠纳凉。羊毛里的沙粒，则靠一次集中放电，全抖出去。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME buries itself in desert sands to cool off during the day. It expels sand particles in its wool by discharging electricity in said wool in one large burst.

entry: POKENAME用垃圾桶测试颚力。盖子一咬开，洒出什么残羹，便毫不犹豫吞下。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME tests its jaw strength on garbage cans. Once the lid is cracked open, it devours whatever scraps spill out without hesitation.

entry: 野生POKENAME大多温和，不喜动武，因此能被其他宝可梦群落接纳，一起清理残屑。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME are mostly passive in the wild. Their aversion to violence causes them to be accepted into other Pokémon's colonies, where they work with them to clear away any detritus.

entry: POKENAME柔软弹润，轻易就能滑入沙中躲险。钻出来时，沙粒黏在身上，还能在正午烈日下帮助降温。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's soft and squishy form lets it easily slither into the sand to hide from danger. The sand grains stick to its body when it emerges, helping to keep it cool beneath the scorching midday sun.

entry: 这些扁平的宝可梦会沿沙漠表面滑行。有些象形文字似乎记录了人们见到它们的情景。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: These flat Pokémon can be found sliding along the surface of the desert sand. Some hieroglyphs seem to depict their sightings.

entry: POKENAME白天大多在沙漠的沙层下休息，保持凉爽。它们钻出沙子，便伸展翅膀，在空中滑翔。食物主要是肉食宝可梦吃饱后留下的残余。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME spend most of the day resting beneath the desert sand to remain cool. They emerge from the sand to stretch their wings and glide through the sky. Their main source of food comes from leftovers after carnivorous Pokémon eat their fill.

entry: POKENAME成群围在热门野餐地，在树梢观察游客。看见哪顿饭没人顾着，就一拥而下，尽量抢食，弄得野餐者叫苦。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME flocks gather around popular picnic sites, watching park-goers from the tops of trees. When they spy a meal that is not being paid enough attention, they will swarm in, stealing as much food as they can to the dismay of the picnickers.

entry: POKENAME长长的吻部嗅觉灵敏，轻易就能找到出汁最多的树，再用爪剥开树皮，找下方的甜汁。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's extended snout gives it a strong sense of smell. It can easily sniff out trees producing the most sap for it to find, peeling away the bark with its claws to find the nectar beneath.

entry: POKENAME住在久已熄灭的死火山熔岩洞里，伏在入口，贴住玄武岩壁，突袭大意的探洞者。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME make their homes in the lava tubes of long-extinct volcanoes. They lie in wait near the entrance to these tunnels, pressing themselves against the basalt walls and ambushing unwary cavers.

entry: POKENAME飞过沙漠，可能半途一头扎进沙里，迅速掘地，追捕穿山鼠等猎物。
author: .izik
source: While flying across desert skies, POKENAME may dive into the sand mid-flight. It quickly burrows after prey like Sandshrew.

entry: POKENAME白天晒着温暖的沙漠太阳睡觉。夜里出猎小虫，靠强大的鼻子，从沙下嗅出目标。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME sleep during the day, basking in the warm desert sun. Once night falls, they go out hunting for small insects, using their powerful noses to sniff them out from under the sand.

entry: POKENAME疾奔沙漠，用窄嘴将猎物拉出洞穴。洞若深过嘴够得到的范围，就懊恼地打个喷嚏，喷出火星。
author: quackquackattack
source: Scampering through the desert, POKENAME pulls its prey out of burrows with its narrow maw. When the burrow is deeper than its snout, it sneezes out embers in frustration.

entry: 昏暗处，它会钻进背包或袋子避寒。训练家想拿离洞绳，有时拿出的却是POKENAME。
author: quackquackattack
source: It slithers into backpacks or bags during dimly lit conditions to gain shelter from the cold. Trainers who attempt to use an Escape Rope may find a POKENAME instead.

entry: 寒夜，耳朵会卷成圈，身体也深埋沙中。若有好奇的宝可梦靠近，便啪地合颚，赶对方离开。
author: bobosmith01
source: During cold nights, its ears roll up in a circular fashion, and it buries itself deep into the sand. It may snap its jaws together to drive off approaching curious Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME先从颚间放出寒风，再亲上一口，让敌人迷乱，持续好几个小时。
author: .izik
source: A chilling breeze escapes POKENAME's jaws before it delivers a kiss that leaves foes disoriented. The confusion can last for several hours.

entry: 野外长大的POKENAME很难训练，通常从未学过克制破坏冲动。只要够好奇，见到什么都想咬、戳、电。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME are difficult to train if they grew up in the wild, as they typically were never taught to control their destructive urges. They will bite, poke, and shock almost anything they come across without hesitation if they are curious enough.

entry: POKENAME把嘴伸进洞里，拖出小型啮齿宝可梦。挣扎常使猎物精疲力尽，方便它在后颈补上致命一咬。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME stick their snouts into burrows to pull small rodent Pokémon out. This struggle often leaves their prey exhausted and allows them to secure a lethal bite on the nape of their neck.

entry: POKENAME栖居严酷沙漠，鳞片热到能点燃细枝。可沙漠寒夜里，热迹反而暴露踪影，难以伪装。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME lives in harsh deserts, its scales radiating enough heat to set twigs alight. It struggles to keep itself camouflaged during the cold, desert night since its heat signature gives it away.

entry: POKENAME在栖居的沙丘下翻滚，动作几乎无法察觉。掘地时，以颚咬碎硬岩，找出里面藏着的虫猎物。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's movements become unnoticeable when it rolls beneath the surface of the sand dunes where it resides. When digging underground, it shatters hard rocks with its jaw to reveal any bug prey hiding within.

entry: POKENAME野性大胆，虽罕见，沼泽与沙漠都有踪迹。无论水中、沙里或树梢，都灵巧得惊人。
author: bobosmith01
source: Wild and bold, POKENAME may be found in marshes or deserts, albeit rarely. Whether in water, sand, or treetops, it shows incredible agility.

entry: POKENAME能滚动，便迅速赶到猎物倒下的地方，趁尸体新鲜吞食。它漫游时总埋在沙下，皮肤因此变得十分粗糙。
author: soup1900
source: Since POKENAME has the ability to roll, it can get to locations where prey has collapsed quickly and eat the body while it's still fresh. Its hide has become very coarse due to it always being submerged in the sand when roaming.

entry: POKENAME通常害羞，宁愿逃，也不愿与人类或宝可梦来往。POKENAME被逼入绝境，就大声叫喊，朝任何靠近者合颚咬去。
author: itsthenewisaiah
source: POKENAME are usually quite shy and would rather run away than interact with other people or Pokémon. When cornered, POKENAME shouts loudly and snaps its jaws at anything that gets too close.

entry: POKENAME与巢中伙伴同住地洞，合作搜集食物。它们常轻咬年长成员的耳朵，讨食吃。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME live in burrows underground with their nest mates to cooperate and gather food together. They often nibble on the ears of older members of the nest to beg for food.

entry: 沙漠诸国从前奉POKENAME为流沙之神，照其形象制玻璃偶像，祈求财富与好运。
author: .izik
source: Desert nations once worshipped POKENAME as a god of shifting sands. Glass effigies were crafted in its image to bring wealth and fortune.

entry: POKENAME眼上的膜能挡热，也能防尘。它以爪攀树找坚果，再用颚咬开。
author: santon5512
source: The membrane on POKENAME's eyes helps protect them from both the heat and dust. They use their claws to scale trees in search of nuts, using their jaws to crack them open.

entry: POKENAME藏在沙中，只露眼睛与耳朵，静候目标。一等靠近，就跃出施以毒咬。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME hides in the sands with only its eyes and ears peeking above the ground, waiting for targets. Once they draw close, it leaps out and delivers a poisonous bite.

entry: POKENAME的眼睛不怕沙尘，挖地时无所顾忌。它借此绕行对手，再从下方突然冒出，以强颚攻击。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME's eyes are well protected from dust and dirt, allowing them to dig through the ground without worry. They do so to maneuver around opponents, popping up beneath them with their powerful jaws.

entry: 它伏在浅浅的沙下，挥刃划向路人的腿。受害者若逃走，POKENAME便凶猛地追上去。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: It lies just below the surface of the desert to slice at the legs of passersby. When victims get away, POKENAME aggressively pursues them.

entry: POKENAME四肢的铸铁刀刃，在沙漠阳光下迅速发烫。它借这些灼热武器，劈开强韧的猎物。
author: .izik
source: The cast iron blades on POKENAME's limbs heat up rapidly under the desert sun. It uses these superheated weapons to slash through tough prey.

entry: POKENAME成群穿越广大沙漠，睡时埋在沙面下。夜里，触须探出沙面摇动，让人觉得像沙漠地上的海带丛。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME travels in congregations across vast deserts, resting beneath the surface while sleeping. At night they peek their feelers above the sand and wiggle them, leading many to say the congregation resembles a kelp bed on the desert floor.

entry: POKENAME伏在沙丘下，只露眼睛与炮。目力极好，能从数百米外，朝接近的宝可梦射出能量束。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME lurk beneath desert dunes, keeping only their eyes and cannons exposed. They have excellent eyesight and blast approaching Pokémon with beams of energy from hundreds of meters away.

entry: POKENAME沿河岸挖掘，找丢弃的树枝筑坝。找不到，不到一分钟，也能伐倒一棵树。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME digs along riversides searching for discarded sticks to build dams. If none are found, it can fell a tree in under a minute.

entry: POKENAME一睡就是数周，爱待在偏僻安静的舒服地方。被吵醒便闷闷地懒挥一下，谁吵它就打谁，可攻击很易闪开。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME sleep for weeks on end, content to remain comfortable in out-of-the-way places where they won't be disturbed. They are grumpy when roused and will lazily lash out at whoever woke them, though their attacks are easy to avoid.

entry: POKENAME凶狠追逐闯进领地的对象，谁靠得太近，就以利牙尖爪攻击。凶暴的性情，让恶徒训练家十分喜爱。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME aggressively chase after interlopers in their territory, using their sharp teeth and claws to attack anyone that gets too close. Their aggression makes them popular with villainous Trainers.

entry: POKENAME藏在沙下，只露嘴猎食。颚关节能松开，将嘴平摊，等小得能吞下的猎物站到上方，就猛合大嘴。
author: evilgammon
source: Burying itself in the desert sands, POKENAME hunts by hiding underground with only its mouth exposed. Able to unhinge its jaw and lay it flat, it waits for prey small enough to swallow and snaps its mouth shut when it's underneath them.

entry: 这种POKENAME是专为宠物培育的。与主人感情深了，还会亲昵地轻咬一口。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: This form of POKENAME was specifically bred as a pet. It will nibble its owner affectionately if they share a close bond.

entry: 黎明，POKENAME振翼，在沙上刻出图案，再在每幅图的下方盖上鼻印，作个记号。
author: .izik
source: At dawn, POKENAME vibrates its wings to etch patterns into desert sand. It marks each piece by stamping its snout at the base.

entry: POKENAME侧身滚过沙漠，圆身越滚，势头越大，皮肤也随每次转动变硬。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME rolls sideways through desert sands as it travels, its rotund body picking up momentum. Its skin grows harder with each rotation.

entry: 白天，POKENAME埋沙避日。夜里，花苞散出木子果香，引猎物靠近。
author: .izik
source: By day, POKENAME buries itself in the desert sand to avoid the sun. At night, its bud emits a Lum Berry scent to lure prey.

entry: POKENAME用背刺破沙，穿越沙漠比未融合的黑眼鳄更流畅、更迅速。但快起来也更显眼，容易被看见。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME use their back spines to break through the sand, making their movements through the desert more fluid and rapid than unfused Sandile. The increased speed is counterbalanced by their increased visibility, making them easier to spot.

entry: POKENAME结成小团伙，守在沙漠边，寻找刚离开的宝可梦与训练家。疲惫旅人看着好欺负，便会遭它们围攻。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME linger at the edges of deserts in small gangs as they look for Pokémon and Trainers leaving the sands. They will try to gang up on these tired travellers, seeing them as easy pickings.

entry: 古代采矿文献记载，POKENAME用强颚碎矿，得到的报酬是水果与干蔬菜。
author: .izik
source: Ancient mining texts record POKENAME crushing ore with its powerful jaws. It was paid in fruit and dried vegetables for its service.

entry: POKENAME傻乎乎的笑脸与扁平体形，近来在网上走红。每逢周五，爱好者都到沙漠寻它拍照，可板状身体很易被风沙掩埋藏住。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME has enjoyed recent popularity on the internet for its gormless smile and remarkably flat shape. Every Friday, enthusiasts search deserts hoping to take its picture, but its tabular form allows it to be buried and hidden by the blowing sands.

entry: 许多沙漠发现过POKENAME的木乃伊，未受湿气与岁月侵蚀，令科学家相信，它们自史前以来几乎没变。最爱的点心，是小型啮齿宝可梦。
author: quackquackattack
source: Scientists believe that POKENAME have changed very little from prehistoric times, as their mummies have been found in many deserts, untouched by moisture and time. Their favorite snacks are small rodent Pokémon.

entry: 沙漠寒夜里，POKENAME猛烈发抖保暖。鳞片摩擦，迸出微弱火星，在黑暗中发亮。
author: .izik
source: During icy desert nights, POKENAME shivers violently to stay warm. The friction from its scales creates faint sparks that glow in the dark.

entry: POKENAME收集沙漠里被风吹来或埋住的垃圾。袋状皮肤锁住热量，帮助熬过严寒的沙漠夜。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME gathers windblown or buried trash in the desert. Its bag-like skin traps heat to help it survive frigid desert nights.

entry: POKENAME藏在沙下，只露利刺，驱退天敌。若被踩中，就送对方一记痛咬。
author: mistymagius
source: To deter predators, POKENAME hides under the sand with its sharp thorns sticking out. If it is stepped on, it will leave the victim with a painful bite.

entry: POKENAME靠满身尖刺，察觉沙中细微震动。它掘地时速可达30英里，在地下追猎。
author: .izik
source: Using its thorn-covered body, POKENAME detects subtle vibrations in the sand. It can burrow at 30 mph to chase prey underground.

entry: POKENAME有犬形身体，能以超过每小时30英里的速度游过沙中。用鬃毛锐石攻击后，又会消失在沙里。
author: m1918_94884
source: With its canine body, POKENAME can glide through the sand at over 30 mph. It uses the sharp rocks in its mane to attack, then disappears into the sand.

entry: 翼上散出黑暗颗粒，如一层面纱，遮住POKENAME夜猎沙漠的身形。
author: the_fireplace
source: Dark particles are released from its wings like a veil. This helps conceal POKENAME while it hunts in the desert at night.

entry: POKENAME聚在流星将进入大气的区域，等着吃烧起来的碎片。科学家借此预测流星路径。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME will congregate around areas where meteors will enter the atmosphere, looking to eat any bits that burn up. Scientists use this behavior to predict the paths of meteors.

entry: POKENAME对光极其敏感，因此直到日落都埋在地下。眼上的薄膜，也能在挖掘时挡住碎屑。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is very sensitive to light, so it keeps itself buried underground until the sun sets, its eyes are protected by a thin film that keeps debris out of its eyes while digging.

entry: POKENAME用鬼面威吓旅人，索取硬币，再拖回沙漠巢穴，像宝藏般囤起。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses Scary Face to intimidate travelers into giving it coins. These are dragged back to its desert den and hoarded like treasure.

entry: POKENAME最喜欢叼走训练家的某件东西，再玩起拔河。它的颚力很强，往往要拉扯好一阵，它才肯放弃抢来的物件。
author: sk372
source: One of POKENAME's favorite habits is to snatch something of its Trainer's and play tug-of-war with it. Due to its strong jaw strength, these sessions can last for a while before it'll give up the stolen object.

entry: POKENAME埋进沙丘侧面，留出气穴，让尾焰持续燃烧。一感到脚步接近的震动，就跃出沙，飞去追猎。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME bury themselves in the side of sand dunes, creating pockets of air to keep their tail-flames burning. If they feel the vibrations of footsteps approaching, they will leap out of the sand and fly in pursuit of prey.

entry: POKENAME住在沙漠绿洲，顶着烈日快乐玩水。水池一开始干，就埋入泥中，藏在地下，等下次降雨。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME live around desert oases, splashing around happily under the fierce desert sun. They bury themselves in the mud when their pool starts to dry up, hiding underground until the next rainfall.

entry: POKENAME全身埋沙，只让尾巴悬着假果，吸引来者。饥饿的倒霉生物一上钩，它就升起，猛合双颚，咬住愚蠢的猎物。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME buries itself in the sand save for its tail, which dangles a false fruit to lure others close. Once a hapless hungry creature takes the bait, it rises up and clamps its jaws shut around its foolish quarry.

entry: POKENAME夜游沙漠，白天平躺沙面吸收阳光，为电力核心充能。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME floats through the desert at night. During the day, it lies flat on the sand to absorb sunlight and recharge its electrical core.

entry: 身体成分类似多种明胶，因此无味无臭的果冻，对它们营养丰富。平时却主要吃旧骨，消化要花更多时间与能量。
author: quackquackattack
source: Their bodies have a similar composition to various gelatins, so flavorless, odorless jellies are highly nutritious to them. They typically subsist on old bones, which take longer and more energy to digest.

entry: POKENAME厌恶阳光，不惜一切躲避日晒。它靠带毒的藤蔓，从腐烂的植物残体中吸取养分。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME hate sunlight and will stay out of the sun at all costs. It gets its nutrients from rotting plant-matter using its poisonous vines.

entry: POKENAME发出超声波，在洞中认路，再以爆发的电力袭击猎物。猛烈的放电，甚至能让供电中断，自己也跟着昏过去。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME emits ultrasonic waves to navigate caves and blasts to shock prey. It can emit a blast strong enough to knock out power as well as itself.

entry: POKENAME的音波冲击能震碎玻璃，使听者暂时失聪，对新手训练家尤其危险。迎战时，可得小心。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME emit sonic blasts powerful enough to shatter glass and cause temporary deafness. They are a particular danger for inexperienced Pokémon Trainers, and caution is advised while battling them.

entry: POKENAME的音波冲击能震碎玻璃，使听者暂时失聪。它们用翼拍地，推动身体接近敌人，再近距离放出音爆。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME emit sonic blasts powerful enough to shatter glass and cause temporary deafness. They flap their wings against the ground to push their way toward their opponents, getting close to deliver their sonic bursts.

entry: POKENAME的音波冲击能震碎玻璃，使听者暂时失聪。它们用翼拍地，推动身体接近敌人，再近距离放出音爆。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME emit sonic blasts powerful enough to shatter glass and cause temporary deafness. They flap their wings against the ground to push their way toward their opponents, getting close to deliver their sonic bursts.

entry: POKENAME在洞里滚动发电，用翼转向避开障碍。若突然停下，就很可能爆炸。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME roll around caves to generate electricity, and their wings help them swerve around obstacles. If they experience a sudden stop, they are likely to explode.

entry: POKENAME成群在洞中，挖出彼此邻近的巢穴。它们虽看似无助，可只要见到一只，附近一定还藏着超过十二只。
author: t3isukone
source: Groups of POKENAME nest in burrows close together in caves. While they seem helpless, if you see one, then you can be sure that more than a dozen more are nearby.

entry: POKENAME戴着被自己吸干鲜血的猎物的头骨。因为看不见，狩猎时只能朝声音传来的方向俯冲。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME wears the skulls of the prey it has sucked all the blood from. Since it is blind, it just dives in the direction of prey it hears.

entry: 失明让其他感官格外敏锐。它在夜间潜行，发现罪犯就会施以残酷而猛烈的打击。
author: mistymagius
source: Because of its blindness, all of its other senses are enhanced. It stalks during the night, attacking any criminal it finds with brutal amounts of force.

entry: POKENAME凭敏锐的听觉与快速反应，轻松躲开敌人的招式。它更愿堂堂正正交手，不用带毒的咬击。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME uses its keen sense of hearing and quick reflexes to allow it to effortlessly dodge its opponents' blows. It prefers to fight fair and not use its venomous bite.

entry: POKENAME虽然失明，却靠长舌与敏锐的耳朵，准确感知周围。
author: chorb33
source: With the help of its long tongue and sensitive ears, the otherwise blind POKENAME can accurately scan its surroundings.

entry: 失明让其他感官格外敏锐。它在夜间潜行，发现罪犯就会施以残酷而猛烈的打击。
author: mistymagius
source: Because of its blindness, all of its other senses are enhanced. It stalks during the night, attacking any criminal it finds with brutal amounts of force.

entry: POKENAME是被弃置的军事实验产物，靠回声定位寻找目标，一触碰就引爆。它们可被当作消耗品，破坏力又强，因此受邪恶组织青睐。
author: kianjp2008
source: An abandoned military experiment, POKENAME uses echolocation to seek out targets and detonate upon contact. Due to their expendable and destructive nature they are popular among evil organizations.

entry: 它们用回声定位猎物，从树上跃下，吸饮路过者的血。POKENAME身体轻，因此不易被察觉。
author: bobosmith01
source: They detect prey through echolocation and jump from trees to suck the blood out of the passerby. POKENAME's light weight allows them to escape notice.

entry: POKENAME咬住一切靠近的对象，以利齿吸取好奇路人的能量，尽量多存一些，想加快进化。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME bite at anything that comes close, using their sharp teeth to try and leech the energy from curious passers-by. They store as much of this energy as they can to try to hasten the evolution process.

entry: POKENAME排出满是传染颗粒的烈毒气体，让其他宝可梦重病。新遇的疾病会在族群中传播，成员因此对多种疾病格外耐受。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME expel virulent gas that is full of infectious particles and make other Pokémon incredibly sick. Their colonies share new diseases that they encounter, making members of their colony incredibly resilient to many types of illness.

entry: POKENAME用嘴里营养丰富的蛋作饵，引来狃拉等偷蛋宝可梦。对方一伸进来，POKENAME就咬下，给准窃贼注入麻痹毒液。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME hunts by using the nutritious eggs in their mouth to lure in egg-stealing Pokémon like Sneasel. When a Pokémon reaches in, POKENAME bites down and injects the would-be thief with a paralyzing venom.

entry: POKENAME先用藤蔓束住猎物，再吸干体液。白天睡觉时，常能看见它们挂在树上。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME wraps its prey with its bundle of vines before draining them of their fluids. They can be seen hanging from trees while they sleep during the day.

entry: POKENAME用利牙咬住靠近者，想吸走好奇路人的能量。觉得受威胁，就紧裹双翼，靠坚韧皮肤护身。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME bite at anything that comes close, using their sharp teeth to try and leech the energy from curious passers-by. When they feel endangered, they wrap their wings tightly around themselves and rely on their tough skin to protect them.

entry: POKENAME夜游花园，啃食尚未开放的花朵。性情温和，园主一驱赶，就会听话离开，不再打扰。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME flutters around flower gardens at night, nibbling away at those yet to bloom. It has a gentle disposition, obediently leaving gardens alone if shooed away by their owners.

entry: 尖啸听起来，像嘲弄的笑。POKENAME结队行进，即使阳光下，也无惧狩猎。
author: hortensia_xxiii
source: The noises of its screeching sound like mocking laughter. POKENAME move in packs, hunting beneath sunlight without fear.

entry: POKENAME虽看不见，众多双翼感到的震动，仍能告诉它别的宝可梦在哪。双镰极锐，刃上毒素会让被割者中毒。
author: fiordaliso
source: Even though it is blind, POKENAME can sense where other Pokémon are thanks to the vibrations picked up by its many wings. It wields a pair of extremely sharp scythes, whose edges are coated with a toxin capable of poisoning anyone they cut.

entry: POKENAME失明，得靠其他宝可梦帮忙打理装扮。它们以亲吻答谢帮手，分泌物会让被吻者更喜欢POKENAME。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are blind and unable to maintain their appearance without the help of other Pokémon. They reward those who help them maintain their dress with kisses, which release a secretion that creates fond feelings for POKENAME.

entry: 由于没有视力，耳朵逐渐变成大颚般的器官，用来夹捕猎物。
author: melodydelune
source: Its ears have adapted, due to its lack of eyesight, to act as a set of mandibles to capture prey.

entry: POKENAME完全失明，总撞上东西。角中烈毒，会使中者攻击性暴涨，并短暂失明。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is completely blind, so it is constantly running into things. Its horns contain a potent toxin that causes hyper aggression and momentary blindness.

entry: 地下河湖中，POKENAME数量极多。它们对光极敏感，多藏在暗缝或岩石之间。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are incredibly abundant in underground lakes and rivers. They are incredibly sensitive to light, so they will mostly hide in dark crevasses or between rocks.

entry: POKENAME附在受害者身上，慢慢吸尽鲜血。它们生命力顽强，主要住在阴暗潮湿之处。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME sucks on its victims and gradually drains their blood. They are hardy and live mainly in dark and damp places.

entry: POKENAME深居冰冷、无光的水底，靠回声辨路。维生所需的血实在太多，多数野生群体，因此很快衰退。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME live deep underwater where heat is low and light is nonexistent, so they rely on echolocation to navigate their surroundings. They must consume large amounts of blood to survive; so much, in fact, that most wild populations swiftly fade.

entry: POKENAME深居冰冷、无光的水底，靠回声辨路。维生所需的血实在太多，多数野生群体，因此很快衰退。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME live deep underwater where heat is low and light is nonexistent, so they rely on echolocation to navigate their surroundings. They must consume large amounts of blood to survive; so much, in fact, that most wild populations swiftly fade.

entry: 有人说，超音蝠有1,400个亚种，POKENAME全能模仿。多变的斑纹，也映出野外族群的丰富多样。不过，它们模仿不了绿色。
author: quackquackattack
source: Some say there are 1,400 different subspecies of Zubat, and all of them can be copied by a POKENAME. Each of the many different markings they can have represent the sheer diversity of the wild population. However, they cannot copy the color green.

entry: 暮色近时，POKENAME在海蚀洞里忽高忽低地飞。若撞上洞顶岩壁，厚壳也轻松接住冲击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME flies erratically through seacaves as night approaches. Should it collide with a ceiling or wall, its thick shell absorbs the impact with ease.

entry: POKENAME曾被认为灭绝，直到最近才在地底深处重被发现。它们完全失明，靠敏锐听力穿过黑暗，翼不用于飞行，而是作鳍游水。
author: ghostslythe
source: Thought extinct, POKENAME were only rediscovered recently deep underground. Completely blind, they use their acute hearing to navigate the darkness. Their wings are not used for flight, instead acting as flippers for swimming.

entry: 矿工传说，地底深处有庞大的POKENAME巢群。它用钻头般的爪掘开岩石，造出巢穴。
author: pastapockets
source: Miners tell tales of massive POKENAME hives deep underground. Using its drill-like claws, it burrows into rock to make its nest.

entry: POKENAME以短叫回声定位狩猎。它能完美模仿别的宝可梦，让猎物弄不清，究竟被哪一族追着。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME emits a short cry in order to use echolocation to hunt. It can perfectly mimic the cries of other Pokémon, confusing prey as they have no idea which species they are truly being pursued by.

entry: POKENAME将头叶如螺旋桨般旋转，短暂悬停。飞过时散出牛至般的好闻气味，久久不散。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spins the leaf on its head like a propeller, allowing it to hover in place momentarily. As it flies, it emits a pleasant oregano-like scent that lingers in the air.

entry: 它转动头叶，散播颈边嫩枝的香气。闻着奇妙地舒缓，嫩枝本身却很苦。
author: infinex21
source: It spins the leaf upon its head to spread the aroma of the tree shoots around its neck. This aroma is oddly soothing, though the tree shoots themselves are very bitter.

entry: POKENAME失明，只好咬一切够得着的东西，弄清是什么。皮肤又易干，因此住在水道沿岸，方便游泳。
author: fiordaliso
source: Since POKENAME is blind, it bites anything within reach to understand what it is dealing with. As its skin is prone to drying out quickly, it makes its home along waterways where it can swim.

entry: POKENAME一天中最活跃的时段，随季节改变。可性子很胆小，无论什么季节，一听巨响通常就逃。
author: bobosmith01
source: The time of day POKENAME is most active depends on the season. It is very flighty, however, and will typically flee upon hearing any loud noise, regardless of what time of year it is.

entry: POKENAME虽没看得见的牙，仍会咬人玩，惹恼挑中的对象，再飞去窄处藏好，收翼挤进去。
author: sk372
source: Though it has no visible teeth, POKENAME still bites others as a form of mischievous play. After annoying its chosen victim, it flies off to hide in narrow spaces, tucking its wings to help it squeeze in.

entry: 它用时钟般的滴答声发出回声，辨别方向。虽然眼睛很大，其实完全看不见。
author: admiralvermin
source: It navigates using echolocation by making clock-like ticking noises. This is because despite its large eyes, it is completely blind.

entry: POKENAME只在夜里出没，靠敏锐的听觉追踪猎物。獠牙与利爪都带着致命毒素，能让猎物失去行动能力。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME only comes out at night, tracking its prey with its keen sense of hearing. Its fangs and talons contain a deadly poison that it uses to incapacitate its prey.

entry: POKENAME看不见，便以多腿握住布满洞穴的细丝狩猎。猎物一碰线，它就收回，迅速用网裹紧。
author: sk372
source: Being blind, POKENAME hunts through several thin strings of webbing lined across caverns and held by its many legs. The moment it feels prey brush against a thread, it reels them in and quickly webs them up completely.

entry: POKENAME完全失明，越长大、能量需求越高，就越难养活自己。因此，活得最久的POKENAME，都是训练家饲养的。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is entirely blind, so it has a difficult time sustaining itself as it matures, as it will require more and more energy as it grows. Therefore, the longest living POKENAME are those owned by Trainers.

entry: 发光球体放出低低的嗡鸣，似乎用于回声定位。球内产生、储存的电力，也能从獠牙放出。
author: infinex21
source: Its glowing bulbs emit a low humming noise which seems to serve as a means of echolocation. Its fangs can deliver electric jolts that are generated by, and stored within, its bulbs.

entry: POKENAME每次咬猎物都会迸出火花。喂柿仔果后，便能抵御超音蝠的奇异之光，争食时也能保持清醒。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME produce sparks of electricity whenever they bite their prey. By giving them a Persim Berry, they gain the ability to resist a Zubat's Confuse Ray, which keeps them level-headed whenever they fight over food.

entry: POKENAME尖叫定位，也会激起附近宝可梦的亲子本能，让许多POKENAME的天敌不忍下手。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME lets out a shrill cry for echolocation. This cry also has the added effect of drawing out the parental instincts of nearby Pokémon, warding off many of POKENAME's natural predators.

entry: 它盲目地摇摆前行，找东西咬，看似在狩猎。可POKENAME牙里的物质会使被咬者微微欣快，它只是想把快乐分给别人。
author: sk372
source: It waddles around blindly in search of something to bite. It seems like hunting behavior, but POKENAME's fangs contain a substance that induces mild euphoria in those bitten; it wishes to share this joy with others.

entry: POKENAME的喙有奇异的超能力感应，猎物尚未到来，最早10分钟前就能察觉。夜里最活跃，借此伏击不知情的目标。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's beak possesses an unusual psychic sensitivity, allowing it to detect prey up to 10 minutes before they arrive. It is most active at night, using this ability to ambush unsuspecting targets.

entry: POKENAME用刺耳哀伤的歌声回声定位。野外POKENAME结群狩猎，合唱着致命的无伴奏歌。
author: pastapockets
source: POKENAME sings a harsh, mournful song that allows it to echolocate. In the wild, POKENAME hunt in groups, singing a deadly a cappella.

entry: POKENAME在海滩闲躺，吸收月光取能。若试着进行光合作用，花就很快枯萎。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME lounges on the beach, absorbing moonlight to gain energy. If it attempts photosynthesis, its flowers will quickly wilt.

entry: 它能利用回声定位，找到几英里外的水果。休息时，POKENAME会紧紧攀住自己信任的训练家的肩膀。
author: melodydelune
source: Using its echolocation, it can find fruit within miles of its location. When resting, POKENAME will cling to the shoulder of its trusted Trainer.

entry: POKENAME吃下赖以为食的果实中的种子，积攒毒素。只有自己或训练家受到威胁、别无选择时，才会动用这些毒。
author: melodydelune
source: POKENAME builds up its poison reserve by eating the seeds of the fruit it survives on. They are only known to use this poison as a last resort against potential threats to it or its Trainer.

entry: 头上蝙蝠花伸出的长雄蕊，如胡须般，帮助POKENAME摸索黑暗。过大的颚，让脑没剩下多少空间。
author: .realthree
source: The long stamens protruding from the bat flower on POKENAME's head act as whiskers to help it feel its way through the dark. Its oversized jaw leaves little room for its brain.

entry: POKENAME抖落球体上的花粉，弥补看不见的不便。它能感知花粉落在活物身上，便追上去攀住，吸取一点血。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME shakes the pollen from its orbs loose in order to make up for its lack of sight. It can sense when its pollen has landed on a living being, chasing after them in order to latch onto them and drink some of their blood.

entry: 荒废的城市里可能住着数千只POKENAME，以能找到的一切腐烂物为食。利齿连金属线也能咬断。
author: mistymagius
source: Deserted cities can be home to thousands of POKENAME, feeding off any rotten matter they can find. Their sharp teeth are able to chew through metal wire.

entry: POKENAME全盲，靠回声定位与热量辨路。睡觉时，会用藤蔓缠住钟乳石。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME is completely blind and relies on echolocation and heat to maneuver through its environment. Whenever it goes to sleep, it wraps around a stalactite with vines.

entry: POKENAME是没有眼睛的猎手，靠振翅感受从洞壁弹回的气流，辨认方向。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: An eyeless hunter, POKENAME flaps its wings and feels the air bouncing off cave walls in order to navigate.

entry: 夜行的POKENAME天生失明，靠回声感知周围。研究却发现，它与月亮相连，附近被月光照到的对象，都能准确察觉。
author: bobosmith01
source: Although the nocturnal POKENAME is naturally blind and relies on echolocation to see the area around them, studies have shown it has a connection with the moon, and can perfectly sense anyone nearby if moonlight is touching them.

entry: 夜行的POKENAME天生失明，靠回声感知周围。研究却发现，它与月亮相连，附近被月光照到的对象，都能准确察觉。
author: bobosmith01
source: Although the nocturnal POKENAME is naturally blind and relies on echolocation to see the area around them, studies have shown it has a connection with the moon, and can perfectly sense anyone nearby if moonlight is touching them.

entry: 夜行的POKENAME天生失明，靠回声感知周围。研究却发现，它与月亮相连，附近被月光照到的对象，都能准确察觉。
author: bobosmith01
source: Although the nocturnal POKENAME is naturally blind and relies on echolocation to see the area around them, studies have shown it has a connection with the moon, and can perfectly sense anyone nearby if moonlight is touching them.

entry: 弥留之际的人，身旁会聚来大群POKENAME。待那人逝去，它们便会将遗体一点点吃尽，什么也不留下。
author: mistymagius
source: Large flocks of POKENAME appear around people near their end. Once they perish, the flock will feed on their lifeless body until nothing remains.

entry: 它们用回声辨路，大耳朵也能追踪其他声音。主食是毒植物与蘑菇，似乎会影响身上紫斑的鲜艳程度。
author: infinex21
source: They use echolocation to navigate, though they can also track other sounds thanks to their large ears. They primarily feed on poisonous plants and mushrooms, which seem to affect the vibrancy of their purple spots.

entry: POKENAME颚力极强，能将钢梁碾碎。它们常栖息在下水道、暗巷等疫病滋生的地方。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME has extremely strong jaws, capable of pulverizing a steel beam. They are commonly found in disease-ridden areas like sewers and alleyways.

entry: POKENAME虽全盲，回声仍能让它感知。周身宝石与鸣叫回声共振，帮助更精准地追猎。
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher
source: Though POKENAME is completely blind, it can use echolocation to see. The gems along it resonate with the echoing cries to aid in tracking prey more precisely.

entry: POKENAME是洞里常见的祸害，超能力让它在全黑也找到食物。扁平的身躯与利牙，一旦黏住，就很难清除。
author: footlongdingledong
source: POKENAME are a common pest found in caves. Their psychic powers allow them to detect food even in perfect darkness, and their flat bodies and sharp fangs make them difficult to remove once they've latched on.

entry: POKENAME住在洞中，朝猎物所在的方向乱挥身体狩猎。它会躲开其他捕食者，除非对方先击中它的尾巴。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME lives in caves and hunts by blindly flailing its body in the direction of prey. It avoids other predators unless they strike its tail first.

entry: POKENAME吊在大树上，伪装成松果。浓密毛发中藏着数百根毒针，一经碰触便会折落。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME hangs from large trees, disguising itself as a pinecone. Its thick fur contains hundreds of poisonous needles that break off on physical contact.

entry: 它用爪吊在深洞的洞顶休眠，让体内产生的毒液慢慢汇入尾针。许多洞穴探险者身上，都留着被POKENAME突袭的伤疤。
author: kianjp2008
source: It hangs dormant by its claws on the ceilings of deep caves, slowly letting the venom produced in its body gather in its stinger. Many spelunkers bear the scars left by sudden POKENAME attacks.

entry: POKENAME爱吃街边的剩饭残渣，被城市居民视为祸害。遭到POKENAME咬伤，可能出现类似食物中毒的症状。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are considered pests in urban areas due to their habit of eating leftover food scraps along the streets. Being bitten by a POKENAME can cause symptoms similar to food poisoning.

entry: POKENAME借双翼的回响感知四周，夜间穿过密林。它们爱蜂蜜花蜜，常将整片蜂巢吞食。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME use the reverberations of their wings to sense their surroundings, flying through dense forests at night.  These Pokémon love to eat honey and nectar, often consuming entire honeycombs.

entry: POKENAME爪上带有剧毒，能让猎物动弹不得。它夜间狩猎，从高处滑翔而下，伏击目标。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's claws are laced with a strong poison that incapacitates its victims. It hunts at night, gliding from high places to ambush its prey.

entry: POKENAME总在寻找能弄到手的果子，尤其偏爱有毒的果实。它会将毒素存入牙中，咬击时释放。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are always on the hunt for any fruits it can get its paws on. It actually prefers poisonous fruits as they will store the toxins in its teeth for a venomous bite.

entry: POKENAME不需要眼睛，因此嘴巴最终长大到覆盖了整个身体。它一顿就能吞下300颗以上的树果。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME 's mouth eventually covered it's whole body, as it didn't need eyes. It can gobble up over 300 Berries in one sitting.

entry: POKENAME黏在洞顶，以回声追踪，等小生物走过下方，再落到猎物身上，用滚烫的身体将其闷住。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME sticks itself to cave ceilings and waits for something small to wander beneath it, tracking movements via echolocation. It then drops down to land on and smother its prey with its boiling-hot body.

entry: POKENAME爬过洞壁，熔融身体的高热将岩面磨平。平滑的石壁，让它借回声更精准地找到领地中的外物。
author: anonymous_moose
source: As POKENAME crawls over cave walls, it polishes them smooth with the heat of its molten body. The smooth rock surfaces allow it to more precisely locate foreign objects in its territory through echolocation.

entry: POKENAME常被认为吓人危险，其实很爱交际。POKENAME喜结大群栖息，连其他鸟宝可梦也能交成朋友。
author: pastapockets
source: Although POKENAME is often seen as scary or dangerous, it's highly social. POKENAME often prefer to roost in large groups, even making friends with other species of bird Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME的退化小翼，太小，飞不起来。群中长者会轻咬双翼示好，再喂水果树果，让它们长得圆滚饱满。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have small, vestigial wings that are too small to allow them to fly. Instead, older members of the colony bite these wings to signal affection, feeding them fruits and berries to keep their bodies rotund and plump.

entry: 厚圆的身体比看着轻，飞得又快又轻松。可一点阳光都会让它生病，因此住在最深、最暗的洞穴。
author: sk372
source: Its thick round body is lighter than it looks, so it can fly quickly with no troubles. Even small amounts of sunlight will make it ill, so it lives in the deepest and darkest cavern locations.

entry: 这些笨头笨脑的宝可梦，分不清同伴与敌人，总打个不停。被它们毒牙咬过，灼痛会久久不散。
author: mistymagius
source: These dim-witted Pokémon are constantly attacking each other, unable to tell each other from their enemies. Their toxic bite leaves a long-lasting burning sensation.

entry: POKENAME与族群交流的尖细哀鸣，会令人头痛、想逃。听从这份警告，或许能避开带毒的咬击与火属性招式。
author: haypile
source: The eerie high-pitched whines of POKENAME communicating with their colonies causes headaches and an urge to flee. Heeding this cry may protect a person from their toxin-laden bites and Fire-type moves.

entry: POKENAME常被认为吓人危险，其实很爱交际。POKENAME喜结大群栖息，连其他鸟宝可梦也能交成朋友。
author: pastapockets
source: Although POKENAME is often seen as scary or dangerous, it's highly social. POKENAME often prefer to roost in large groups, even making friends with other species of bird Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME不停摆动沉重的象鼻，触探周围。翅膀虽弱，却一直怀着飞翔的梦想。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is constantly swinging its hefty trunk around to sense its surroundings. Despite its weak wings, it has always dreamed of flight.

entry: POKENAME进食时，会吸收附近声波。直到吃完，手机与其他音频设备，都莫名停止工作。
author: quackquackattack
source: Whenever POKENAME are eating, they absorb sound waves from the nearby area. Phones and other audio devices mysteriously stop working until they are finished eating.

entry: POKENAME看不见，便拼命提高招式的准头，反而常忽略威力与防御的锻炼。
author: bagumbothimble
source: Unable to see, POKENAME work tirelessly to improve the accuracy of its attacks. As a result it often neglects to work on the strength of its attacks and its defensive capabilities.

entry: POKENAME听得见最细小的动作，反应快得惊人，借此迅速打昏猎物，再吸饮鲜血。
author: mega_beedrill
source: POKENAME can hear the slightest movement and react with astonishing speed. They use this ability to knock their prey out quickly and drink their blood.

entry: POKENAME易被突来的震动吓到，察觉大个子宝可梦，也可能逃走。它蜷在窄孔或石下，藏好身形，随时准备袭击路过的宝可梦。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME are easily startled by sudden vibrations and may flee if they detect the presence of a heavy Pokémon. They remain hidden in narrow holes or underneath rocks, coiled and ready to strike passing Pokémon at a moment's notice.

entry: POKENAME成群住在火山洞穴，吊在洞顶睡觉。熟睡时，火星从嘴里滴下，落在不幸走过下方的人身上。
author: santon5512
source: Swarms of POKENAME live in volcanic caves, hanging from the ceiling as they sleep. When asleep, embers drip from their mouths, raining onto anyone unfortunate enough to walk below.

entry: POKENAME吃富钙的食物，甚至吸血补钙。为免如此，训练家经过它们栖居的洞穴，最好带富钙食物或哞哞鲜奶。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME consume foods high in calcium, even drinking blood to get some. To prevent this, Trainers are advised to bring calcium-rich food or MooMoo Milk when traveling in caves where POKENAME live.

entry: POKENAME的蛋能治夜盲，可惜对POKENAME自己，却没有同样效果。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME's egg can be used to treat night blindness. Unfortunately, the egg doesn't have the same effect on POKENAME itself.

entry: POKENAME虽盲，脚下地面的震动，却让它在洞中辨路自如。双翼能短飞，用来到达藏食的岩隙。
author: fiordaliso
source: Although POKENAME is blind, it navigates its cave lair perfectly by sensing vibrations in the ground beneath its feet. It has a pair of wings that allow short flights, which it uses to reach crevices where it hides its food.

entry: POKENAME以回声狩猎，叫声强到能制造巨浪海啸，搅乱海中生命，方便POKENAME从上层海水抓取。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME hunts via echolocation. Its echoing cry is powerful enough to create waves and tsunamis, disrupting sea life and making it easier for POKENAME to pluck them from the upper sea level.

entry: POKENAME看不见，只能以电磁感官描出周围的景象。它只在暴风雨之夜现身，试图引雷击中自己。
author: mistymagius
source: Due to its lack of eyesight, POKENAME uses its electromagnetic senses to get a picture of its surroundings. It can only be seen on stormy nights, trying to get struck by lightning.

entry: POKENAME以感知别人的情绪，弥补失明，尤其受负面情绪吸引。吸血既能维生，也能增强幽灵本领。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME makes up for its lack of sight by sensing the emotions of others, drawn particularly towards negative ones. It drains blood both to sustain itself and power up its ghostly abilities.

entry: POKENAME是肢体喜剧高手，可惜常找不到观众，因为它忘了用回声确认，附近究竟有没有人看。
author: mega_beedrill
source: POKENAME is a master of slapstick comedy. Unfortunately, it usually fails to get an audience on its own, as it forgets to use its echolocation to see if anyone is nearby to watch.

entry: POKENAME走到哪，都带着一块石头，练习护蛋。漆黑中，它们以尖叫回声辨路，免得撞上洞壁。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME practice raising eggs by carrying a stone with them wherever they go. To avoid bumping into cavern walls, they rely on loud screeches to echolocate in pitch-black darkness.

entry: POKENAME没有通常的感觉器官，靠超声波辨路。头上看似耳朵的，其实是天线，用来操纵磁场与电力。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME emit ultrasonic waves to find their way, due to their lack of conventional sensory organs. What may appear to be ears on their heads are actually antennae that they use to control their magnetic fields and electrical energies.

entry: POKENAME只栖息在洞穴，用灵敏的听觉感知四周。它们成群住进洞壁狭小的裂隙里。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME can only be found in caves, using its sensitive hearing to detect its surroundings. Groups of POKENAME make their dens in small crevices in the cave walls.

entry: POKENAME尖叫震耳欲聋，声调疯狂起伏。最响时，能造成永久听力损伤，甚至震碎玻璃。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME release deafening screams, their pitch fluctuating wildly. At their loudest, these screams can cause permanent hearing loss and even shatter glass.

entry: POKENAME通过三只羽毛般的耳朵散去体热。据说，被POKENAME咬中，就像全身的血都烧起来了。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME vents its internal heat through its three feather-like ears. Getting bitten by POKENAME is said to feel like your blood in on fire.

entry: POKENAME藏在洞壁凹处，避免被看见。没有眼与翼，POKENAME便一边跳跃，一边轻叫尖啸，以回声找路，躲开坑洞障碍。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME hides within indents in cave walls to remain unseen. Due to its lack of eyes and wings, POKENAME uses small chirps and screeches to echolocate where it needs to go and to avoid holes and obstacles as it hops around.

entry: POKENAME很喜欢穿山鼠，有时会把洞顶找到的石头送给它。可翅膀不够强，石头常掉下摔碎。
author: rumia_archer
source: POKENAME is very fond of Sandshrew and sometimes delivers rocks it finds on the roofs of caves to it. However, its wings are not very strong, so the rocks often fall and break.

entry: POKENAME掘进洞顶，等听到猎物从下方经过。一有动静，就展开翼无声滑下，发动攻击。
author: rosesilver
source: POKENAME burrows into the ceiling of caves and waits until it hears prey moving below. Once alerted, it glides down using its wings to strike without a sound.

entry: POKENAME飞时蜷成球，露出锐利紫刺，不让别人靠近。它虽不特别凶，见到认作猎物的生物，仍会毫不犹豫咬下。
author: fiordaliso
source: While flying, POKENAME curls into a ball, exposing its sharp violet spikes to keep others at bay. Though not especially ferocious, it won't hesitate to bite creatures it perceives as prey.

entry: POKENAME刺耳的尖啸，回荡整片洞穴，让它在全黑也能辨路。它靠强腿活动，危险一近，就用爪攀住洞壁。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME's piercing screeches emit an echo that carries through entire cave systems, allowing them to navigate in total darkness. They rely on their powerful legs for movement and use their claws to cling to cave walls when danger approaches.

entry: POKENAME受邪恶组织胁迫犯罪，还被当奴仆役使。训练家若尊重、爱护POKENAME，很可能得到一生的朋友。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are pressured by evil organizations to commit crimes and are forced to work in servitude. Trainers who treat a POKENAME with respect and love are likely to develop a lifelong friend.

entry: POKENAME失明，须以回声扫描四周。家养POKENAME还有独特的叫声，若与训练家走散，便更容易找回对方。
author: sk372
source: Being blind, POKENAME must scan its surroundings via echolocation. Domesticated POKENAME also have a unique type of cry to use that allows them to better locate their Trainer when separated from them.

entry: 夏夜，数百只POKENAME会出来寻偶。此时毒性达到平常的十倍，为保护幼崽做好准备。
author: mistymagius
source: During summer nights, hundreds of POKENAME appear to find a mate. During this period, its poison becomes ten times more potent in preparation to protect its young.

entry: 它用声波与舌头找路，也能模仿别的宝可梦叫声，不过得先相处够久，听过学会才行。
author: infinex21
source: It uses sonic waves and its tongue to navigate. It can mimic the cries of other Pokémon, though only after being around them long enough to hear and learn their cries.

entry: POKENAME深睡洞中，尽量避开接触。有东西太近，POKENAME就张嘴放出无害的幽灵蝙蝠，将来者吓走。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME slumber in the depths of caves, as far from contact as possible. If something gets too near, POKENAME opens their mouth to unleash harmless spectral bats to scare the intruder away.

entry: 它穿过森林靠藤蔓，穿过洞穴靠回声。花苞是否健康，影响紫斑的鲜亮程度，也影响毒牙的毒力。
author: infinex21
source: It uses its vines and echolocation to navigate through forests and caves, respectively. The health of its bulb affects the vibrancy of its purple spots and the potency of the venom it delivers through its fangs.

entry: 许多POKENAME靠同族帮忙辨路，通常守在巢边，免得迷失。它们也能协助防敌，可一转错方向，偶尔就误伤手足。
author: quackquackattack
source: Many POKENAME rely on the help of their kin to navigate and often remain close to their dens to avoid getting lost. While they are capable of helping defend against predators, they may accidentally attack their siblings when they turn the wrong way.

entry: POKENAME全盲，用嘴里细细的喋叫回声定位。颚虽能咬断树枝，它却更爱吃树果。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is completely blind, so it will use echolocation by making small chattering noises from its mouth. Despite its jaws being powerful enough to snap tree branches in half, it prefers to just eat berries.

entry: POKENAME张嘴吸虫，进食时合拢花瓣。性情温和，也好养，但一受刺激仍会咬人，主人得留意。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME consumes bugs, inhaling them into its mouth and closing its petals while it eats. While fairly docile and easy to raise, owners should still be careful as it will bite if agitated.

entry: POKENAME用坚硬如宝石的头骨猛击敌人，先使其迷乱，再凶狠咬下，将目标制服。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME bludgeons foes with its hard, gem-like skull to disorient them. Once they are reeling, it follows up with a vicious bite to incapacitate its target.

entry: POKENAME最早的线索，是深灰市附近发现、估计已有数千年的化石。圆嘴能牢牢黏住空中猎物，几乎掰不开。
author: .izik
source: The earliest reports of POKENAME date back to fossils found near Pewter City, estimated to be thousands of years old. Its round mouth was used to latch onto airborne prey with a nearly unbreakable grip.

entry: POKENAME凭沉重身体，将毒刺砸进敌人。两只POKENAME角力时，厚鳞又能阻住彼此的毒。
author: pastapockets
source: POKENAME slams its venomous spikes into foes with its incredible heft. When two POKENAME wrestle, their thick scales prevent them from poisoning each other.

entry: POKENAME在深海游动，用水下回声定位。体形庞大，叫声也惊人，能扰乱声呐，甚至伤到游得太近的生物。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses a type of underwater echolocation as it swims around the deep sea. Its sheer size means these impressive cries can disrupt sonar and even cause damage to creatures that swim too close.

entry: 繁殖季，POKENAME最多可同时拥有十二个伴侣。POKENAME的力量是雌性的两倍，轻易就能推动小岩块。
author: mistymagius
source: During mating season, POKENAME can have up to twelve mates at once. POKENAME are twice as strong as the females, able to push small boulders with ease.

entry: POKENAME栖息的洞穴通常死寂无声，稍有响动便会惊动整个群体。但到了夏末，各地的POKENAME汇集而来，发出嘈杂的吱叫与尖啸，寻找伴侣。
author: jacobtmm
source: POKENAME caves are usually dead silent; the slightest noise will alert the swarm within. However, in late summer, POKENAME gather from all over the region, unleashing a cacophony of chittering screeches in the hopes of finding mates.

entry: 进化后，它已无法吊住居住洞穴的顶壁，便栖在易碎岩石上，仔细倾听黑暗中猎物的动静。
author: snookerron
source: Upon evolution, it can no longer suspend itself from the roof of the caves in which it dwells. Instead, it perches atop breakable rocks, listening carefully for the sound of its prey in the darkness.

entry: POKENAME成群巡逻栖息的洞穴，一有入侵者就不顾一切地撞过去。它们通常守着富含稀有矿物的洞窟。
author: mistymagius
source: Groups of POKENAME patrol the caves where they live, throwing themselves at intruders with reckless abandon. They usually guard caves with large amounts of rare minerals.

entry: POKENAME不喝血也能生存，喝了却能增力提速。只要当晚还没喝血，哪怕地上捡的树枝，也能轻易将它赶走。
author: .fedoraman
source: While not required for POKENAME to persist, consuming blood increases its strength and speed. As long as a POKENAME has not drunk that night, they are easy to fend off with weapons as humble as a stick from the ground.

entry: POKENAME没有眼睛，完全依靠敏锐的听觉辨别方向。有时，它会用小翅膀拨动周围的石子，仔细聆听回声，掌握四周的情况。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have no eyes and are totally reliant on their acute hearing for navigation. They will sometimes use their little wings to knock small pebbles around, listening out for the echoes to get a good sense of their surroundings.

entry: POKENAME的爪由有毒金属构成，进入血液就可能致命。它们常彼此切磋，比比谁的铠甲更坚固。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's claws are made of a toxic metal that can be fatal if it enters your bloodstream. They can often be seen sparring with each other, testing whose armor is strongest.

entry: POKENAME虽没眼，其他感官在狩猎时却绰绰有余。它从两条尾巴放雷，远远击倒猎物，再扑去吸血。
author: sk372
source: Though POKENAME lacks eyes, its other senses more than make up for it when it comes to the hunt. It strikes prey down from a distance with lightning from its two tails before pouncing on them to drink their blood.

entry: POKENAME天生失明，靠回声定位与飘带感受周围。若遇上不认识的东西，就会试着轻咬一下。
author: melodydelune
source: Being born blind, POKENAME uses echolocation and its ribbons to feel its surroundings. When around something it doesn't recognize, it will nibble it.

entry: 这只宝可梦双目失明，却有着不可思议的本领，能感知周围生物的情绪。
author: supersonicloki
source: This Pokémon is blind as a bat. However, it has an incredible ability to sense the emotions of beings around it.

entry: POKENAME以轰鸣般的怒吼威吓、狩猎。回声弥补失明，精准找出猎物；对方往往已被雷鸣巨声吓僵，来不及逃。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME lets out a bellowing roar for intimidation and hunting. The echolocation makes up for its lack of eyes and allows it to pinpoint prey, which are often too frozen in terror by its thunderous cry to properly flee.

entry: POKENAME常见于月见山，在黑暗中生活得很好。它们结群收集月之石，用来装饰巢穴。
author: mistymagius
source: Commonly found in Mt. Moon, POKENAME thrive in the darkness. Groups of POKENAME collect Moon Stones to decorate their dens.

entry: POKENAME双腿硕大、肌肉发达，重得让它飞不起来。它改为跃上最高十英尺的空中，捕猎虫宝可梦。
author: dylonk25
source: The weight of POKENAME's large, muscular legs has rendered it flightless. Instead, it leaps up to ten feet in the air to hunt for bug Pokémon.

entry: 周身的等离子体稠密有毒，既能防护，也是利器。它们攀住敌人，刺入獠牙，吸血维生。
author: infinex21
source: The plasma enveloping their bodies is dense and poisonous, offering protection and a potent weapon. They attach themselves to foes, sink their fangs into them, and drain their blood to sustain themselves.

entry: 月亮渐圆的夜里，POKENAME饥饿得难以满足。它会无声尾随卷卷耳等猎物数小时，才终于出击。
author: .izik
source: During nights of a waxing moon, POKENAME experiences an insatiable hunger. It silently stalks prey like Buneary for hours before finally striking.

entry: POKENAME不断发出尖锐的鸣响，驱退捕食者。若聚成大群，几乎转眼就能让听者的听力永久受损。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME constantly emits a high-pitched ringing noise that deters predators. Large groups of POKENAME will cause permanent hearing loss almost instantly.

entry: POKENAME以尖锐高鸣，在暗洞辨路。常结群旅行，用一片嘈杂叫声吓退天敌。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME release high-pitched screeches to navigate caves in the dark. They often travel in groups to scare predators with the cacophony of noise.

entry: 失明的POKENAME，在洞中发出超声波尖叫，靠回声定位狩猎。年岁渐长，尾巴越多，动作也越灵活。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: The blind POKENAME uses ultrasonic screams and echolocation to hunt in caves. As it gets older, it grows more tails and in turn becomes more agile.

entry: POKENAME猎捕穴居超音蝠。趁它们睡着，以热风烧伤，阻止逃跑，再扎入獠牙吸血。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME hunts after Zubat inhabiting cave systems. It attacks while they sleep, burning them with hot gusts of wind to inhibit their escape before sinking its fangs into them and drinking blood.

entry: POKENAME两个头都全盲，只能靠回声辨路。可双方频率互相干扰，须轮番尖叫，免得回响混乱。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME's heads are completely blind, forcing them to rely upon echolocation to navigate. The two heads emit competing frequencies, forcing them to alternate shrieks to navigate lest they have confusing echoes return to them.

entry: POKENAME以每小时1000英里的速度，穿行高层大气。近来有理论认为，它是在躲太阳。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME travels at 1000 miles per hour in the upper atmosphere. Recent theories suggest it's hiding from the sun.

entry: 月夜，POKENAME飞过芜菁田觅食，突然俯冲掘地，用牙啃咬土下的菜根。
author: .izik
source: On moonlit nights, POKENAME soars over turnip fields in search of food. It will suddenly dive and burrow into the ground, using its fangs to gnaw on the vegetables beneath.

entry: POKENAME用强劲的牙齿咬碎石块、掘开土层，挖出自己的洞穴，喜欢在地下水源附近安家。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME make their own caves, using their strong teeth to crush stone and dig through the soil. They prefer making their homes near underground water sources.

entry: POKENAME视力不佳，便以特殊力量，察觉别人的动作与情绪。只要一只受惊，就会通知附近所有POKENAME。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME cannot see very well, so it uses its powers to detect the movement and emotions of others. If just one is frightened, it will alert all other POKENAME in the area.

entry: POKENAME每天最多睡20小时，将全部精力留到夜里尝试飞行。爪上带着细菌，一旦划破皮肤就可能造成危险。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME sleeps for up to 20 hours a day, putting all its energy into trying to fly during the night. Its claws are coated in bacteria that can be dangerous if they pierce the skin.

entry: 强日光很易烧伤POKENAME皮肤，因此只在夜里外出。白天藏在暗洞，却睡得不多，反四处急跑，烦扰其他宝可梦。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's skin is easily burned by bright sunlight, so it only goes outside at night. During the day, it hides within dark caves, but it spends little time sleeping and instead rushes around bothering other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME狩猎时迸出小电火花，借闪光感知四周，因此格外善于穿行暗洞与暴风雨之夜。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME emits tiny sparks of electricity while hunting, using the flashes to sense its surroundings. This makes it particularly effective at navigating through dark caves and stormy nights.

entry: 身体偏重，靠自己飞不了多久。叫声又带金属回响，被认为反而妨碍自身回声定位。
author: sk372
source: Its body is rather heavy, so it can only fly under its own power for short amounts of time. Its cry has a metallic reverb to it, which is thought to adversely affect its own echolocation capability.

entry: POKENAME尖厉的金属鸣声，宛如石头刮铁，借着回响，穿过深邃曲折的洞道。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME emits harsh metallic cries that echo like stone scraping iron. It uses these reverberations to navigate deep and twisting cave tunnels.

entry: POKENAME牙太钝，咬不穿多数鳞片与皮肤，常只好捕幼年宝可梦，或吃人类扔下的食物。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME's dull fangs struggle to puncture most scales and skin. They often resort to preying on baby Pokémon or discarded human food.

entry: 野生POKENAME潜居无光深洞，长出外壳，准备进化。POKENAME发现近处威胁，就大声尖叫，警告邻居，也把注意力引向自己。
author: npshi
source: Wild POKENAME lurk deep in unlit caves, developing their outer shells in preparation for evolution. POKENAME will screech loudly when they discover a nearby threat, warning neighbouring Pokémon while drawing attention to themselves.

entry: 由于另一半身体没有翅膀，POKENAME通常留在地面。旋转时会发出独特的咔哒声，有人推测那是古老的信号。
author: mistymagius
source: Due to the second body's lack of wings, POKENAME usually keeps to the ground. It creates a unique clicking noise as it spins, theorized to be an ancient signal.

entry: POKENAME胆小又看不见，躲在黑暗洞穴，用回声定位感知周围。它会变成天敌的模样，吓退、欺骗对方，可即使变了，仍然失明。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: A shy, blind Pokémon, POKENAME hides in dark caves and uses echolocation. It scares and tricks predators by transforming into them, but remains blind.

entry: 斑点鲜亮的POKENAME，毒性极强。它能整只捕住敌人，轻易注毒，再将对方抛开。它其实草食，偏爱毒植物与毒蘑菇。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME with bright spots are incredibly venomous. They can capture foes whole and easily inject them with venom before tossing them away. They are herbivores that favor poisonous plants and poisonous mushrooms.

entry: POKENAME在炎热暗处形成群落，以超声鸣叫辨路。尾端毒云显示生命力，云越厚，就越健康。
author: princessmilandria
source: POKENAME forms colonies in hot and dark places using ultrasonic cries to help navigate. The poison cloud on the end of their tail indicates their life force. The thicker the cloud the healthier they are.

entry: POKENAME用长而下垂的腿，在半空缠住敌人。抓稳便飞回洞中，被带走的对象，鲜少再有踪迹。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its long, dangling legs to grapple foes mid-air. Once secured, it flies them back to its cave, where they are seldom seen again.

entry: 碰到POKENAME蓬松的毛，会起疼痛的疹。新研究指出，它其实知道，因此那副友善活泼的模样，反显得颇有恶意。
author: dylonk25
