source: Contact with POKENAME's puffy fur causes a painful rash. Recent research suggests that it is aware of this fact, recontextualizing its friendly, frisky nature as rather malicious.

entry: POKENAME虽然不会飞，却总边振翅边蹦跳，散播毒孢子。吸入这些孢子可能致命。
author: mistymagius
source: Despite not being able to fly, POKENAME is constantly jumping around while flapping its wings. This spreads its poisonous spores, which can be deadly if inhaled.

entry: POKENAME身体中空，把猎物抓进嘴，并非通常意义的吞食，而是用幽灵之力吸些生命力，再从身体底部丢出。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's body is hollow, so when it catches prey in its mouth, it does not consume them in the traditional sense. Instead, it siphons some vitality via ghostly powers before discarding them out of the bottom of its body.

entry: POKENAME以超能力轻松浮行，维持飞行几乎不费力。它还会操纵猎物的心智，让对方忘记曾被自己取食。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME floats effortlessly using its psychic powers, needing little effort to stay airborne. It manipulates the minds of its prey, making them forget that it ever fed on them.

entry: 沙漠入夜，POKENAME便探头，以回声寻找猎物。它短促飞行，跃沙抓住新的一餐，再拖回地下。
author: sk372
source: Once night falls in the desert, POKENAME pokes its head out to find prey via echolocation. It flies in short bursts, leaping out from the sand to snatch its latest meal and drag them down underground.

entry: 有人推测，这种宝可梦无需伴侣便能生超音蝠蛋，是关都多数洞穴超音蝠泛滥的唯一原因。不过，这理论多来自正面挨过超音波、昏倒后醒来的训练家。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: This Pokémon is theorized to be the sole cause of Zubat overpopulation in most caves of Kanto, being able to produce Zubat eggs without a mate. However, these theories usually came from post-blacked out Trainers after a Supersonic to the face.

entry: POKENAME先以牙攀住猎物，再释放猛烈电流，让受害者动弹不得。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME latches onto prey with its fangs before releasing a surge of electricity. This shock leaves the victim unable to move.

entry: 鲜亮的獠牙分泌剧痛之毒，唯一解药，也得由同种毒制成。它们以超声波感知四周，再展翼尖叫，扰乱敌人。
author: infinex21
source: Their vibrant tusks secrete an agonizing venom whose only cure is derived from the selfsame venom. Using ultrasonic waves, they can keep track of their surroundings. They will spread their wings and screech loudly to disorient foes.

entry: 古书警告旅人，夜里别独行，书中写着POKENAME如何潜行村庄，吸饮不知情者的血。
author: .izik
source: Ancient tomes warn travelers not to walk alone at night. They speak of POKENAME stalking villages to drink the blood of the unsuspecting.

entry: POKENAME轻快的鸣声，常在栖居的暗洞回荡。因为失明，它靠这些声波发现物体，绕开前行。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Pleasant chirps from POKENAME often echo throughout the dark caves that it calls home. Since it is blind, it uses the soundwaves from its chirping to detect objects and navigate around them.

entry: 紫色触须会分泌一层毒膜，若不洗掉，可能引起严重皮疹。进化前，它会用翅膀包住身体，吊在结实的树枝下。
author: mistymagius
source: Its purple feelers produce a toxic film that can cause severe rashes if not washed off. Before evolution, it wraps itself in its wings and hangs beneath a strong tree branch.

entry: 两只超音蝠融合，有时会显出更成熟形态的特征，长出初步的眼睛，甚至脚。可它们难以处理新感官的信息，偶尔飞着就撞了。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Fusions of two Zubat can result in this fusion expressing traits of a more evolved form, developing rudimentary eyes, and even feet. They struggle to process these new sensory developments and can sometimes crash mid-flight.

entry: 两只未融合的超音蝠合体，有时会长眼。若眼睛占了耳朵的位置，就会失去回声定位，变得难以辨路。
author: katieplaysgames
source: This fusion will sometimes develop eyes when they form from two unfused Zubat. When these eyes take the place of their ears, they can struggle to navigate due to the loss of their echolocative abilities.

entry: POKENAME在超音蝠家族中虽属罕见，却在大型洞穴系统里颇常见。它总想将猎物一口吞下，哪怕对方大得根本咽不下去。
author: mistymagius
source: Despite being a rarity amongst the Zubat family, POKENAME is still quite common in larger cave systems. It will try to swallow its prey whole, even if they are too large to swallow.

entry: 它伏在暗洞地面，等不设防的猎物直接走进嘴里，再咬住放电，制服对方。
author: kiwiarms
source: It lies in wait on the floors of dark caves, waiting for unsuspecting prey to walk right into its mouth. Then, it bites down and shocks them into submission.

entry: 它们喜欢捉弄路过的训练家，不是用长矛戳人，就是让人染上恶疾。若在住家附近看见POKENAME，不出一周，全家都会生病。
author: mistymagius
source: These mischievous Pokémon love to play tricks on passing Trainers, either prodding them with its spear or giving them nasty illnesses. If POKENAME is seen near your house, the entire household will fall ill within a week.

entry: 成群的POKENAME在洞壁爬行，巡守巢穴。它们不断吸取猎物的体液，直到自己胀到原来的两倍大。
author: mistymagius
source: Swarms of POKENAME can be seen crawling on cave walls, patrolling their nests. They drain the fluids out of their prey until they swell to twice their size.

entry: 只在漆黑洞穴狩猎，眼睛便发育得很差。它靠打嗝辨路，凭气味的回响，感知四周。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Its only hunting grounds are pitch-black caverns, so its eyes are very underdeveloped. It navigates by belching, and using the smell reverberations to see its surroundings.

entry: 多数穴居宝可梦会给POKENAME留下食物，免它主动捕猎。因为回声定位的隆隆怒吼，会震动洞壁，可能造成塌方。
author: sk372
source: Most cave-dwelling Pokémon will leave offerings of food for POKENAME to keep it from actively hunting. This is because the rumbling roars it uses for echolocation shake the cave walls and risk causing cave-ins.

entry: POKENAME锥形身体利于破风，空中飞得极快。可主要住洞里，又看不见，鲁莽乱撞常让它受伤。
author: chinigan
source: POKENAME zoom through the air, as their cone-shaped bodies are highly aerodynamic. However, due to living primarily in caves and being blind, they often injure themselves by crashing recklessly.

entry: POKENAME飞过洞穴，发出令人不安的尖啸。进食时，还想把猎物四肢冻在原地。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME flies through caves making an unsettling screeching noise. It attempts to freeze its prey's limbs in place while it feeds.

entry: POKENAME拼命往喉咙里塞垃圾，直到皮肤开始撑裂。它们成群在垃圾箱与垃圾桶中筑巢。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME shoves as much rubbish into its gullet as it can until its skin starts to tear. Groups of POKENAME make their nest in dumpsters and garbage cans.

entry: POKENAME飞得慢，却无声。它借隐秘飞行悄悄接近，以幽灵尾巴攀住猎物，咬下吸血。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME flies slowly, but silently. Using this stealthy flight, it sneaks up on potential prey, latching onto them with its ghostly tail and biting down to drink their blood.

entry: POKENAME口中渗出的液体，化学性质类似牛排煎熟后渗出的肌红蛋白汁液。科学家正研究它是否有医疗价值。
author: holgast
source: The fluid oozing from POKENAME's mouths is chemically similar to myoglobin, the liquid which leaches out of a cooked steak. Scientists are studying whether it may have medical use.

entry: POKENAME的咬击带毒，单独一口并不危险。可同一个巢穴住着数百万只POKENAME，接着很可能还有至少十二只来咬。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME have a toxic bite, which isn't dangerous by itself. However, millions of POKENAME live in the same nest, making it likely that you'll be bitten by at least a dozen more.

entry: POKENAME很久没阳光，也能生活，慢慢移动来省力。终于直接晒到太阳，就会兴奋，四处狂奔。
author: pastapockets
source: POKENAME can go long periods of time without sunlight, moving slowly to conserve energy. When it finally feels direct sunlight, it becomes excited and runs around frantically.

entry: POKENAME热情接近洞里的小孩子，盼着一起玩。可惜外表常把孩子吓跑。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME eagerly approaches small children in caves, hoping to play with them. Unfortunately, its appearance often scares them away.

entry: POKENAME藏在搁浅船只里，利用独特的轮廓融入残骸。只有伪装被识破，才会施以毒咬。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME hides inside beached ships, using its unique silhouette to hide amongst the wreckage. It will only use its venomous bite when its disguise fails.

entry: POKENAME只在夜里现身，无声地从一栋楼跃向另一栋楼，身手惊人。斗篷不易撕裂，能保护POKENAME免遭爪击与撕咬。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME only come out at night, impressively leaping from building to building without making a sound. Its cape is resistant to tearing, which defends POKENAME from claw and biting attacks.

entry: POKENAME靠坚硬的刺攀住洞壁。刺还能注入毒液，若被扎中不止一次，就可能昏倒。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's tough thorns allow it to cling to cave walls. The thorns also inject poison which can cause fainting if stung more than once.

entry: 被POKENAME咬伤，会感染它的寄生蘑菇。接下来的一年里，蘑菇会慢慢吸尽感染者的生命力。
author: mistymagius
source: Being bitten by a POKENAME causes the body to be infected by its parasitic mushrooms. The mushrooms will slowly drain the life force from anyone infected over the span of a year.

entry: 它能与训练家结成深厚羁绊，却也爱咬。靠朝周围吠叫探知环境，常把住处洞穴闹得很吵。
author: the_fireplace
source: This Pokémon can bond very strongly with its Trainer, but it also has a habit of biting. It checks its surroundings by barking at them, causing quite a ruckus in caves it inhabits.

entry: POKENAME虽然失明，却能精准嗅出周围一切。凭敏捷动作捉住猎物，再用坚硬无比的爪猛烈击倒。
author: fiordaliso
source: Even though it is blind, POKENAME can perfectly perceive the scent of anything around it. When it catches prey with its agile movements, it finishes it off with fierce strikes from its incredibly hard claws.

entry: POKENAME歌中的声波，是高效的猎法。回声精准找出位置，美妙旋律又让猎物分心、昏沉。
author: sk372
source: The sonic waves of POKENAME's songs are highly effective as a hunting tactic. It uses echolocation to pinpoint prey's location, while the prey itself is distracted and lulled by the song's pleasant melody.

entry: POKENAME住暗洞，咔哒响爪，靠回声找食物。幼崽被护在洞穴般的背里，免遭危险。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME live in dark caves, clicking their claws to echolocate and help them find food. They keep their young in their cave-like backs, protecting them from danger.

entry: POKENAME吃过其他宝可梦，体表植物纤维便迅速生长。纤维渐厚时，它就倒挂睡觉。
author: .izik
source: The plant fibers covering POKENAME's body grow rapidly after feeding on another Pokémon. It hangs upside-down to sleep while they thicken.

entry: POKENAME住洞穴，深色身体融进岩壁，靠悦耳的尖啸辨路，不需眼睛。
author: puppylev
source: POKENAME lives in caves, where its dark colours help it camouflage against the rocky cavern walls. It emits melodic screeches to find its way around without eyes.

entry: POKENAME全盲地跑着，享受风拂过皮肤。头顶双翼不够强，托不起身体，但POKENAME心情好，翼也会开心扑动。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME run around completely blind, enjoying the feel of the wind across their skin. The wings atop their heads are not strong enough to provide them with lift, but they flap happily whenever POKENAME are in a good mood.

entry: 受威胁时，POKENAME会发出尖锐的叫声，听得太久可能损伤听力。由于看不见，它也靠叫声进行回声定位。
author: mistymagius
source: When threatened, POKENAME will emit a high-pitched screech that can cause hearing damage if exposed for too long. It uses its cry for echolocation due to its lack of eyesight.

entry: POKENAME振翼，将超声尖啸聚向前方，汇成锥状，借回声辨路。一感知别的宝可梦，就猛冲过去，全身撞击。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME flap their wings to help focus their hypersonic shrieks, channelling them forward in a cone. They rely on the echoes of these shrieks to navigate, rushing forward to perform full body tackles if they sense another Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME生活在草原气候区一些不起眼的阴凉处，例如树木的缝隙，甚至地下洞穴。它们夜间四处奔走，身体天生产生的热量，使它们不畏寒冷。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME are found in odd shady places in steppe climates, such as in the crevices of trees or even in underground burrows. They run about during the night and are not deterred by the cold due to the natural warmth their bodies generate.

entry: POKENAME发出高频尖啸，身上紫色的部分便亮起。听这怪声太久，可能迷乱。
author: .izik
source: The purple portions of POKENAME's body glow brightly when it emits high-pitched screeches. These eerie cries can cause disorientation in those who hear them for too long.

entry: 浑浊的眼睛只能感光，因此夜间繁忙的城市里常有成群POKENAME。它们听力极佳，稍听到危险的声响就会逃走。
author: mistymagius
source: Its cloudy eyes are only able to detect light, so swarms of POKENAME can be seen in busy cities during the night. They have excellent hearing, allowing them to flee at the slightest sound of danger.

entry: POKENAME收翼收耳，闭上嘴，装成棉花糖诱猎。嗜甜的对象一近，就遭POKENAME利牙袭击。
author: fireflower20002
source: To bait its prey, POKENAME will tuck its wings and ears and close its mouth to look like cotton candy. When a sweet-toothed victim gets close, POKENAME will strike them with its sharp fangs.

entry: POKENAME能分辨一切气味，靠嗅觉找路。它能从任何洞穴闻出出口，很受探洞者欢迎。
author: roundabout_robin
source: POKENAME relies on its sense of smell to get around, as it can distinguish any scent. It's popular among spelunkers for its ability to sniff its way out of any cave.

entry: POKENAME用强颚碾碎未熟的果子食用。果子越甜，腰间皮肤就越像橡胶，进食时多一层保护。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its strong jaw to crush unripened fruit and eat it. The sweeter the fruit, the more rubbery the skin around its waist becomes, providing it with extra protection as it feeds.

entry: 它吐出微毒的麻醉物，吸取少量鲜血时，猎物便感觉不到疼。夜里在外徘徊，白天回洞睡觉。
author: bobosmith01
source: It spits out a mildly toxic numbing substance that causes any prey to not feel pain while it siphons a little bit of their blood. It prowls around outside at night but sleeps inside caverns during the day.

entry: POKENAME常被自身睡莲叶压住，伏在地面。它不爱飞，食物一近，才振翼托起身体，猛扑过去。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME can usually be found lying on the ground, weighed down by their own lilypads. POKENAME prefer not to fly, instead using their wings to propel themselves up into a pounce when near food.

entry: POKENAME以紫翼翱翔洞中，靠回声掌握周围墙壁。一撞东西，就气得从嘴喷出火星，发泄不满。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME soar through caves with their violet wings and rely on echolocation to keep track of the walls around them. They become incredibly irate whenever they bump into something and release embers from their mouths to vent their frustration.

entry: POKENAME冒出泥土，咬住站在上方的一切。平时多半只是吓人又烦的祸害，可若大群聚集，能让整条洞道都过不去。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME pop out of the soil and bite anything standing above them. While they're normally little more than a shocking nuisance, large hordes of POKENAME can make a cave's tunnels completely impassable.

entry: POKENAME主要吸饮其他生物的血。唾液里的物质会先麻痹咬处，再让被咬者短暂变得多情。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's main source of sustenance is the blood of other creatures. Its saliva contains a concoction that first causes numbness when bitten, before leaving the bitten creature feeling amorous for a short time afterward.

entry: POKENAME掘地时放出阵阵声呐，扰乱猎物，再猛扑向前，迅速以抓制服。
author: .izik
source: While tunneling, POKENAME fires bursts of sonar to disorient prey. It then lunges forward and subdues them swiftly with Scratch.

entry: POKENAME从洞顶孔洞尖啸，先将猎物震晕，片刻后才落下突袭。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME releases piercing screeches from holes in cave ceilings. The sound stuns prey moments before it drops down to attack.

entry: 这些修长的宝可梦是高明的猎手，靠回声定位轻松追踪目标。毒咬能在数小时内，让猎物失去行动能力。
author: mistymagius
source: These slender Pokémon are expert predators, using echolocation to track prey down with ease. Its toxic bite incapacitates its victims within a matter of hours.

entry: POKENAME通常生活在受污染的水边。体表覆着滑溜的毒膜，便于从天敌手下脱身。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME can usually be found near polluted waters. It covers its body in a slippery, poisonous film that allows it to escape from predators.

entry: POKENAME深夜放声尖叫，吸引伴侣。叫声经常干扰导航设备，因此船只都主动避开它们大量聚集的水域。
author: griddle
source: POKENAME will attract mates late at night by screeching at the top of its lungs. Ships will actively avoid waters teeming with POKENAME, as this screeching regularly disrupts navigational equipment.

entry: POKENAME带着骇人的狂怒伏击猎物，用利牙撕碎小型宝可梦。若猎物侥幸逃脱，它便会爆发野兽般的怒火。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME ambushes its prey with unsettling fury, ripping small Pokémon apart with its sharp fangs. It flies into a primal rage if its prey somehow escapes.

entry: POKENAME对声音极其敏感，任何巨响都会让它接连暴走数小时。汗液中含有危险的化学物质，似乎只会增强它自身的力量。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are very sensitive to sound; any loud sound will cause it to rampage for hours on end. It sweats out a dangerous chemical that only seems to enhance its own strength.

entry: POKENAME嗅觉惊人，仅凭气味便能轻松追踪猎物。它们将吃不完的猎物囤在小型洞穴群中。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME have an amazing sense of smell and can track its prey effortlessly with its scent alone. Packs of POKENAME hoard their uneaten prey in small cave systems.

entry: 它看不见，靠灵敏的鼻子找路。融合后的身体，能抵抗长时间日晒造成的灼伤。
author: lydiaprower8
source: Being unable to see, this Pokémon uses its strong sense of smell to navigate. As a fusion, its body can resist being burned by prolonged exposure to the sun.

entry: POKENAME全盲，靠强化的嗅觉与听觉探索世界。它们灵巧，战斗专长闪避，很难被抓牢。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are completely blind, relying on their enhanced sense of smell and hearing to navigate around the world. They are agile Pokémon, battling with an evasive fighting style that makes them difficult to pin down.

entry: 它虽盲，完美的嗅觉却能精准找到人类与宝可梦。致命的利牙，既可施毒，也可烧伤，让POKENAME绝不可低估。
author: fiordaliso
source: Despite being blind, its flawless sense of smell allows it to pinpoint the location of both humans and Pokémon with precision. Its lethal fangs can poison or burn its enemies, making POKENAME a foe that should never be underestimated.

entry: POKENAME听觉惊人，能在漆黑洞中捕猎。睡时，POKENAME以两条强尾，吊在巨大的钟乳石上。
author: pastapockets
source: POKENAME's incredible hearing allows it to hunt in pitch-black caverns. Using its two powerful tails, POKENAME sleeps hanging from massive stalactites.

entry: POKENAME在浑浊的河湖中结成大群。只需约二十只POKENAME，就能吸干一名训练家全身的体液。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME live in large schools and can be found in murky rivers and lakes. It only takes about twenty POKENAME to drain a Trainer of all of their bodily fluids.

entry: POKENAME群夜飞寻找树果。虽没眼睛，日光一出现，POKENAME却会立即瞬移回洞，因为敏感皮肤会被晒伤。
author: wiz0z
source: During the night, colonies of POKENAME fly through the night in search of berries to eat. Though they lack eyes, POKENAME immediately teleport back to their caves in the presence of sunlight, which burns their sensitive skin.

entry: POKENAME结合敏锐听觉与心灵感应，能察觉数百英里外的人类与宝可梦。警觉性极高，几乎无法让POKENAME措手不及。
author: wiz0z
source: The combination of POKENAME's keen hearing and telepathic powers allows them to detect people and Pokémon from hundreds of miles away. Their hyper-awareness make POKENAME very difficult to catch by surprise.

entry: POKENAME不停锻炼肌肉，直到强得足以飞翔。锻炼越多，汗液的毒性就越强。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are constantly training their muscles until they become strong enough to fly. The more this Pokémon exercises, the more toxic its sweat becomes.

entry: POKENAME虽已不善飞行，却依然一心增强力量。双翼如今成了毒刺，作为巨大蛮力之外的辅助手段。
author: mistymagius
source: Despite losing its ability to fly well, POKENAME is still just as dedicated to increasing its strength. Its wings now act as toxic spines that are just secondary to its massive strength.

entry: POKENAME缠在丛林藤蔓上，完美隐蔽，静候猎物。对方一近，就会被深深扎入獠牙。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME wraps itself around jungle vines, blending in perfectly as it waits for unsuspecting prey. The moment they get close, it sinks its fangs deep into them.

entry: POKENAME常吊在洞中植物上，吸收养分，张着嘴捕虫；也会突然俯冲，一口口吞食小虫。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME often hangs onto cave plants, absorbing their nutrients and catching bugs with its open mouth. It also swoops down to eat bugs in mouthfuls.

entry: 洞中水域常有POKENAME，对人的攻击性，却远低于许多训练家的想象。鳍膜覆毒，接触会刺激皮肤，留下发光的疹。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is a common sight in water sources found in caverns, but is much less aggressive towards humans than many Trainers believe. The webbing of its fins are covered in a toxic film that leaves an irritating, glowing rash.

entry: POKENAME深游海中，光几乎照不到。红色身体吸走残余的光，身形近乎隐没，靠长长的翼状鳍游动。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME live deep in the ocean, swimming at a depth where very little light reaches. Their red colouration absorbs what little light there is, making them nearly invisible. They swim by using their long wing-like fins.

entry: POKENAME住深海与洞中湖，不需视觉，改用球状器官感知动作。它以触手毒素麻痹猎物，再慢慢吸血。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is found in the deep ocean and lakes found inside caverns since it has no need for eyesight, instead sensing movement with its bulbous organs. It paralyzes prey with toxins in its tentacles and slowly drains the blood.

entry: 它们飞过漆黑洞穴，凭坚固身体横冲直撞，撞碎障碍。被它撞一下，可比挨一口咬更伤。
author: staghorn
source: They fly through pitch-black caves, plowing through obstacles with their durable bodies. Being struck by one is more injurious than being bitten.

entry: POKENAME身体太重，又没有腿，常得从陡崖纵身跃下，才能起飞。
author: stevethebarbarian
source: With their great weight and lack of legs, POKENAME often need to throw themselves off of steep ledges to take flight.

entry: POKENAME有个怪习惯：攀在高高的崖壁上，再落到毫无防备的受害者身上。岩石般的颚力道惊人，连小汽车也能咬碎。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME have a weird habit of clinging to high cliff walls, then dropping themselves onto unsuspecting victims. Its rocky jaws have enough power to crush a small car.

entry: POKENAME双翼极费力，才勉强托起沉重石身。靠回声找猎物，再挣扎飞到上方，落下，以体重压倒目标。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's wings can only barely hold its heavy stone body aloft with great effort. Using echolocation to find prey, it struggles to flutter above them before dropping down to crush the target beneath its weight.

entry: 它发出低沉音调，感知周围。这声音令人不安，也被恐怖电影用来烘托惊悚气氛。
author: .izik
source: It makes a low tone to view its surroundings. This tone is unsettling and has been used in horror movies to cause unease.

entry: POKENAME以宽平的双翼划水。它们全盲，靠壳防伤，一感到东西撞来，便缩进去。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME row themselves through the water with their broad, flat wings. They are totally blind and rely on their shell to protect them from harm, withdrawing into it if they feel something impact against them.

entry: POKENAME露牙、展翼鳍，装得很可怕。巨大蓬尾，谁一碰，无论宝可梦还是训练家，都会刺痛。
author: pastapockets
source: POKENAME bares its fangs and stretches its wingfins to make itself look terrifying. Its large, fluffy tail causes a painful sting to any Pokémon or Trainer that touches it.

entry: POKENAME不能飞，也看不见，靠回声与超能力波辨路。尾上的壳一咬，就有能量涌起，让它对周围世界获得新的见解。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are unable to fly or see, so they rely on their echolocation and psychic waves to navigate. Whenever the shell on their tail bites down, they experience a surge of energy that gives them new insights about the world around them.

entry: POKENAME的毒液带电，若不处理，可能造成麻痹。夜里，常能见到它们成群啃咬电线。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's venom is charged with electricity which can cause paralysis if untreated. Flocks of these Pokémon can be seen gnawing on powerlines during the night.

entry: POKENAME吞食的电力越多，几个头之间的磁力就越强。三个头都贪吃极了，总为猎物争执。
author: mistymagius
source: The more electricity POKENAME consumes, the stronger the magnetic pull between the heads becomes. All three heads are extremely greedy and are constantly fighting over prey.

entry: POKENAME无法行走，飞行时会把珍贵的大葱叼在嘴里。它的毒液会渗入大葱，让大葱变成战斗中实用的武器。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME cannot walk, so it holds its precious leek in its mouth while it flies. Its venom ends up poisoning the leek, making it a useful weapon in battle.

entry: POKENAME的两个头必须合作，才能穿过洞穴。一个发出高频细鸣，让声音撞壁回响；另一个倾听，带身体走向食物。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have two heads that must work together to navigate caves. One head produces high pitch squeals that bounce off cave walls, while the other head listens and leads them in the direction of food.

entry: POKENAME在冷水狩猎，用咔哒声找到猎物，再释放强大音波，将其震晕。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME hunt in cold waters, making clicking noises to locate their prey. Once found, they release a powerful sonic wave to stun their prey.

entry: POKENAME找到什么都吃，哪怕无法一口吞下。翅膀虽小，仍能轻松在离地约十英尺处飞行。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME consumes anything it can find, even if it can't swallow its food whole. Despite how small its wings are, it is able to comfortably fly about ten feet off the ground.

entry: 适应漆黑地下湖的POKENAME完全失明。它张口放超声，凭回音精准找目标，再以同样精准的水柱轰击。
author: .jerden
source: Adapted for life in pitch-black underground lakes, POKENAME is completely blind. It opens its mouth to emit ultrasonic waves, using the echoes it hears to pinpoint targets and fire blasts of water with pinpoint accuracy.

entry: POKENAME吸取人类与宝可梦的能量，周身幽气就越发浓烈。多见于废矿场，遇到恼怒敌人，还能穿隧道墙逃走。
author: pjporwoll
source: The ghostly gas surrounding POKENAME grows in intensity as it absorbs energy from people and Pokémon. It is most often found near abandoned mining sites, where it can phase through the tunnel walls to escape an angered enemy.

entry: POKENAME没视觉，靠超感能力感知生命力与负面情绪猎食。它沿洞顶爬到猎物上方，再落到面前尖叫，以恐惧为食。
author: pjporwoll
source: Lacking vision, POKENAME relies on its extrasensory ability to detect life force and negative emotions to hunt its prey. It creeps along ceilings until above its quarry, then drops in front of them with a high-pitched screech, feeding on the fear.

entry: POKENAME蹲在废楼或洞穴角落，闭嘴引来不设防的猎物。目标一近，POKENAME就跃起，张开巨口使出刺耳声，令敌人迷乱惊恐。
author: pjporwoll
source: While sitting in corners of abandoned buildings and caves, POKENAME keep their mouths closed to lure in unsuspecting prey. When a target approaches, POKENAME leaps up and opens its giant maw with a Screech to disorient and terrify the foe.

entry: POKENAME在地下深处挖隧道，靠回声定位穿过漆黑的通道。獠牙坚硬无比，连厚钢板也能刺穿。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME tunnel deep underground, using echolocation to navigate its pitch-black tunnels. Its rock-hard fangs are tough enough to pierce through thick steel.

entry: POKENAME能看见附近物体的温度，借此发现人类与宝可梦。躲避天敌时，会藏进泥里或海底草木间。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME has the ability to see the temperature of objects in its general vicinity, which allows it to detect humans and other Pokémon. It avoids predators by hiding in mud or undersea growth.

entry: POKENAME眼外的强韧薄膜，让它水下等各种环境都能看清。野生POKENAME用大角碎岩，开辟水下洞穴筑巢，保护幼崽。
author: npshi
source: POKENAME have a strong membrane surrounding their eyes that let them see in any environment, even under water. Wild POKENAME protect their young by destroying rocks to create underwater caves with their large horns and forming their nests there.

entry: POKENAME身体易变形，轻松进出下水道。觅食时若有东西撞见，就变成更大、更吓人的宝可梦，将对方赶走。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses its malleable body to slip in and out of sewers easily. If something comes upon it while scrounging for food, it transforms into a larger, more intimidating Pokémon to scare them off.

entry: POKENAME吃下微芯片，游沙能力便大增，最快甚至堪比民航客机。
author: .izik
source: After consuming microchips, POKENAME's ability to swim through sand increases dramatically. At peak speed, it can rival a commercial jet.

entry: 壳像混混鳄，天生能吓退捕食者。可壳上尾形突起又打乱平衡，让它常跌倒。沙漠强烈的沙暴，往往再把它翻正。
author: duskit___
source: Its shell resembles a Krokorok, acting as a natural deterrent to predators. However, the tail-shaped protrusion on its shell throws off its balance, causing it to fall over frequently. Harsh desert sandstorms often flip it upright again.

entry: POKENAME以超能力推动身体，快得令人眼花地穿过沙漠。旅途中，常被误认成远处的沙暴。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses psychic power to propel itself through desert sands at blinding speeds. Because of this, many mistake it for a distant sandstorm as it travels from one location to another.

entry: 强健的下肢肌肉与长尾，让它们能轻易扑向猎物。利齿之下，骨头也会轻松碎裂。
author: markusknight
source: They can leap on their prey with ease, using massive muscles of the lower body and a long tail. Bones are crushed with ease beneath their sharp teeth.

entry: 小鳃让它在任何环境都能辨方向，连全黑也行。可皮肤很快就干，因此常在河里清洗，每次离水前，都涂满泥。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its small gills allow it to orient itself in any environment, even in complete darkness. Since its skin is prone to drying out immediately, it often washes itself in rivers and covers its body with mud every time it prepares to step out of the water.

entry: POKENAME坚壳内存沙，倒出来攻击。若遭痛打，POKENAME常很快漏光所有沙，只好试着逃走，再去搜集。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME stores sand within its sturdy shell, which it pours out to use for attacks. However, battering POKENAME often causes it to lose all of its sand quickly, causing it to attempt to run away to gather more.

entry: POKENAME用烈焰吐息塑造沙漠巨石，制成壳。身体长大装不下，就找更大的石，丢掉旧壳。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME shapes boulders found in the desert using its fiery breath to craft its shell. When it outgrows one, it finds a larger boulder and discards the old one.

entry: POKENAME滑进别的宝可梦洞穴，寻找食物。动作得快，巢主一回来，就可能受伤。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME slither into burrows of other Pokémon to hunt for their meals. They have to act quickly before the nest occupants return or risk getting hurt.

entry: POKENAME以发冠自傲，谁弄乱精梳的飞机头，就攻击谁。可长耳常把自己绊倒，立刻大发脾气，强硬高傲的样子全没了。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME's vain pride of its hair crest leads it to lash out at anything that messes up its well-groomed pompadour. Its tough and haughty demeanor is easily broken as its long ears often cause it to trip and throw a tantrum.

entry: POKENAME爪中嵌的寒冰，帮助身体散热。POKENAME更爱偷别的宝可梦的饭，不愿自己狩猎。
author: .realthree
source: The chilly ice embedded in POKENAME's claws helps direct heat away from its body. POKENAME is known for stealing meals from other Pokémon rather than hunting for itself.

entry: 它白天在沙漠上空滑翔，借上升热气流悬空，夜里埋进沙下。爪含极危险的毒，数秒就能令敌人动弹不得。
author: .izik
source: It glides along desert sands during the day, using thermals to stay aloft, and burrows under the sand at night. Its claws hold a particularly deadly toxin that can incapacitate foes in seconds.

entry: POKENAME旋动长爪，在地下钻隧道。它会帮矿工挖宝石，换取食物与陪伴。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME drills tunnels into the earth by twisting its long claws. It is known to assist miners with excavating gems in exchange for food and company.

entry: 它察觉猛烈沙暴将至，就钻进大沙丘。旅人常把这视为不祥警告，赶紧找地方躲。
author: .izik
source: It burrows into large sand dunes if it senses a bad sandstorm. Many travelers see this as an ominous warning and quickly seek shelter.

entry: POKENAME眼膜能感知周围热量，十分善于暗战。身体灵巧，从墙壁洞顶弹跃，再送上一记猛烈踢击。
author: santon5512
source: The membrane of POKENAME's eyes lets them sense the heat of their surroundings, making them excellent fighters in the dark. Using their agile bodies, they bounce off the walls and ceilings before delivering a devastating kick.

entry: POKENAME眼上的薄膜，让它在黑暗里也能看清，格外适合夜战。身上的火焰漆黑一片，免得暴露位置。
author: santon5512
source: The membranes on POKENAME's eyes let them see well in the dark, making them especially suited for fighting at night. The flames on their bodies are jet black so as not to give away their location.

entry: POKENAME夜里从沙漠的沙层下现身，靠感知体温，在黑暗中追踪其他宝可梦。它先划伤猎物的脚踝，将其绊倒，再用布裹住对方的头，吸取生命力。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME emerges from beneath the sand to hunt in the desert at night, sensing other Pokémon in the dark by detecting their body heat. After slashing at ankles to trip its prey up, POKENAME wraps its cloth around the head to drain life force.

entry: POKENAME的刀刃像用鲨鱼牙齿制成的剑。它们会伏击猎物，肆意劈砍，因为掉落的牙齿很快就能重新长出来。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: With blades that resemble shark tooth swords, POKENAME ambush and hack at prey with abandon, as they quickly grow lost teeth back.

entry: 人们认为，POKENAME曾是古代宫殿王座厅守卫的宝可梦。直到今天，它似乎仍在执行首领的命令。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME is thought to have belonged to the guards of an ancient palace's throne room. It seems to follow its leader's orders to this day.

entry: 古人相信，POKENAME来自死者之国，寻找污秽灵魂吞食。一些沙漠神殿遗迹，还留着它的雕像壁画。
author: milchik
source: Ancient people believed that POKENAME come from the land of the dead in search for tainted souls to devour. This Pokémon's statues and wall drawings can be found in the ruins of some desert temples.

entry: 自古以来，人们对它既惧怕又仰慕。POKENAME兼具混混鳄的咬劲与伦琴猫的速度，栖息在炎热地区的河边，位居食物链顶端。
author: milchik
source: Since ancient times, this Pokémon has been feared and admired in equal measure. Combining the bite force of Krokorok and speed of Luxray, POKENAME lives near rivers in hot regions where it dominates the food chain.

entry: POKENAME厌恶日光，更愿夜猎，滑翔穿越广大沙漠，白天才回绿洲休息。
author: .izik
source: Detesting sunlight, POKENAME prefers to hunt under the cover of night. It glides over large deserts to hunt before resting at oases during the day.

entry: 眼膜能察觉别人的热量，让它暗中也轻易追猎。它钻地、穿沙，再用飘带般的附肢缚住目标，咬下去。
author: infinex21
source: The membrane covering its eyes allows it to detect the heat of others; it can easily stalk prey, even in darkness. It burrows through the ground or through sand and then ensnares its prey with its ribbon-like appendages before biting down.

entry: POKENAME精于狩猎，夜里靠夜视独自出门，伴侣则陪幼崽睡觉。它用强尾击倒猎物，总会带新鲜一餐回家。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME are expert hunters that utilize their night vision to hunt alone at night while their partner sleeps with the children. Using their powerful tail to strike prey, this predator will always return home with a fresh meal for their family.

entry: 它花数年磨炼伏击技艺，先完美藏进沙里，再出手。最强的个体，能打倒比自己大许多倍的敌人。
author: .izik
source: It spends years perfecting its ambush techniques, blending seamlessly into the sand before striking. The strongest among them are known to take down foes many times their size.

entry: POKENAME用体内火焰，将光透过眼膜射出。黑暗中发现的猎物，常被光束惊住、晃花眼睛。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can use the flame in its body to channel light through the membranes of its eyes. This beam of light is effective at surprising and blinding prey it has spotted within the darkness.

entry: 它在沙漠绿洲旁安家，谁太近就咬。拼命守住领地，不许别人耗干宝贵的水。
author: .izik
source: It makes its home near desert oases and bites at anyone who gets too close. It fiercely defends its territory, ensuring no one drains its precious water supply.

entry: POKENAME疯跑在领地边界巡逻，寻找闯入者。通常只要用巨响与可怕动作，将对手吓走，就满足了。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME patrol their territory with frenetic movements, racing along the border in search of intruders to scare off. They are usually content to simply intimidate their rivals away with loud noises and frightening gestures.

entry: POKENAME真头上方还有假头，让自己更大，吓退天敌。找到什么眼镜，都往假头上戴，继续强化伪装。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME has a false head on top of its real one to make it look bigger and deter predators. It will equip its false head with any form of glasses it finds to further the illusion.

entry: POKENAME是残酷的恶霸，靠敏锐嗅觉找到罕见绿洲，再赶走其他宝可梦。它爱欺负弱小，可强敌一来，就变得胆怯。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are cruel bullies, using their acute sense of smell to find rare desert oases and then forcing other Pokémon away from them. They delight in wielding their strength against smaller Pokémon, but are cowards when confronted by stronger foes.

entry: POKENAME的暗环在弦月前后长得最大。它猎食时藏进环里，剩下的食物埋沙，留待以后。
author: the_fireplace
source: POKENAME's dark rings grow the largest around the quarter moon. It hides in them while hunting for prey, and buries leftovers in the desert for later.

entry: POKENAME潜在面包店与餐馆后，啪地合颚，吓工作人员交食物。可同一家店，一周内绝不抢第二次。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME lurks behind bakeries and restaurants, snapping its jaws at workers to scare them into offering food. It refuses to rob the same business more than once in a week.

entry: 它待在高层大气，张大嘴，接住落进去的星尘与碎屑。可POKENAME没有胃，吃什么，最终都吐出来。
author: bandedbodypress
source: It sits in the upper atmosphere with its mouth wide open, catching any stardust or debris that falls inside. However, POKENAME has no stomach, and spits up whatever it eats.

entry: POKENAME几乎时时都在找伴侣，连青春期没到就开始了。它炫耀骑士风度，也炫耀迷人的墨镜。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME is almost always trying to find a mate, even before it reaches adolescence. It shows off its chivalrous personality and charismatic shades.

entry: POKENAME眼上的深色薄膜，能帮助感知热量。夜里飞过沙漠时，它们便凭此寻找猎物，哪怕对方试着埋进沙里躲藏，也能找到。
author: .jerden
source: The dark membrane over POKENAME's eyes enables them to sense heat. When flying over the desert at night POKENAME will use this to locate prey, even if it has tried to hide by burying itself in the sand.

entry: POKENAME目力强、身体细而灵活，几乎所有来招都能看见并闪开，因此十分自大。可防御差得可怜，一旦中招，就立刻老实。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's strong eyesight and flexible, spindly body allow it to see and dodge almost any attack that comes its way, giving it a cocky personality. Its defenses are pitiful however, so if an attack manages to get through, it is quickly humbled.

entry: POKENAME在沙漠赛跑，训练速度。太阳晒得受不了，就挖洞，将自己埋住。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME race against each other across the desert sands to train their speed. They dig holes to bury themselves into when the beating sun's rays becomes too much to bear.

entry: POKENAME背着金色球状祭器，放出古老孢子。孢子能吸去皮肤水分，因此这器物曾用于为人防腐。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME wears a golden ceremonial bulb on its back that releases ancient spores. The bulb was once part of a process for embalming people, as the spores wick moisture from skin.

entry: 某些古代文明曾为卡拉卡拉制作金面具，代替头骨佩戴。面具赋予奇异的力量，让它们变成POKENAME。
author: staghorn
source: Some ancient cultures crafted golden masks for Cubone to wear instead of skulls. These masks granted them strange powers, turning them into POKENAME.

entry: 这个幽灵徘徊于自己的墓地，哀悼着逝去的生命。脸上的葬面具，是仅存的身份印记。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: This spirit wanders its burial site, mourning its passing. Its burial mask is all that remains of its identity.

entry: POKENAME游荡古墓，寻找陪伴，翻寻失落文明遗弃的古物。宝可梦研究者推测，POKENAME曾是那些古老社会不可缺少的一部分。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME wander through ancient tombs in search of companionship, pawing over abandoned and discarded relics of lost civilisations. Pokémon researchers theorise that POKENAME were once an integral part of these ancient societies.

entry: 孤独驱使POKENAME聚在失落文明的地下墓窟。它们搜集久远遗物，想重建曾经熟悉的社会。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Driven by a sense of isolation, POKENAME band together in the ruined catacombs of lost civilisations. They gather up relics of a time long past and attempt to reconstruct the societies they once knew.

entry: POKENAME以镀金双翼折光，投出红眼发亮的巨脸，吓退天敌。双翼虽像金属，它却能自如轻拍，毫不费力。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME refract light off of their gilded wings to project the image of a large face with glowing red eyes to scare off predators. While their wings appear to be metallic, POKENAME are able to flutter freely without struggle.

entry: 据说POKENAME仍记得古代水手，夜游海湾，月下泛着幽光。它收集瓶盖、护符与碎玻璃，相信都是散失的祭品。
author: jaminmcready
source: Said to remember ancient sailors, POKENAME wanders bays at night, glowing eerily in the moonlight. It collects bottle caps, charms, and shattered glass, believing them to be lost offerings.

entry: POKENAME白天出现在墓园，模仿亡者的声音，慢唱哀歌。刚失去亲友的人，总被引来，只想再听一次所爱之人的声音。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME appear during the day near cemeteries and graveyards. They sing slow songs of mourning in voices that mimic the dead. These performances draw in the recently bereaved, eager to hear the voice of their loved ones once more.

entry: 金面具与鲜红鬃毛，让它们在某些地方受人崇敬。它们以可怕的力量，守护同伴与领地。
author: infinex21
source: These Pokémon are often revered in some areas due to their golden masks and bright red manes. They guard others and their own territories with fearsome strength.

entry: POKENAME以强嗅觉找腐叶吃。秋天，POKENAME尤其多见。
author: drcew
source: POKENAME uses its strong sense of smell to locate decaying foliage to eat. POKENAME are seen in abundance during the autumn months.

entry: POKENAME戴着怪物面具，威吓敌人。虽无明确证据，有人推测，面具里另有一份独立于哭哭面具与暴鲤龙的意识，操纵融合后的身体。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME wears the mask of a monstrous creature in order to intimidate foes. Although there is no clear-cut evidence, it has been speculated that the mask contains a separate consciousness from Yamask and Gyarados that controls their fused body.

entry: 据说，未曾实现自身潜能的伊布，灵魂会化作POKENAME。它夜夜漫游不休，寻找本可以训练自己的人类。
author: beatdoof
source: It is said that the spirit of an Eevee that has never fulfilled its potential became POKENAME. It wanders endlessly at night, searching for humans who could have trained it.

entry: POKENAME化石的金属成分，赋予古铜金色，古代社会曾拿它做仪式。可想敲下POKENAME壳片的人，往往发现自己中了诅咒。
author: quackquackattack
source: Ancient societies once harnessed POKENAME fossils in rituals because of their metallic composition that gives them their bronze-gold color. Many who have tried to break off a piece from POKENAME shells find themselves cursed.

entry: 人们认为，看似身体的部分，只是困在壳中的幽魂伸出的灵体。有人说，壳会露出真眼，怒瞪前世犯下大恶的对象。
author: sk372
source: It is believed that what looks to be its body is merely a spiritual extension of a haunted soul trapped in the shell. Some say the shell uncovers this Pokémon's true eyes to glare at those that have committed terrible deeds in a past life.

entry: POKENAME贴着枯死腐烂的树，纹丝不动。POKENAME身上的面具，似乎随时日慢慢改变。
author: drcew
source: POKENAME remains immobile as it clings to dead or decaying trees. The mask on POKENAME seems to change slightly over time.

entry: POKENAME很害羞，把真脸藏在面具后。谁想看面具下面，POKENAME就用大肚子将对方顶走。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are quite shy, hiding their true face behind their mask. If anyone tries to see under the mask, POKENAME bumps them away with their large belly.

entry: 几乎每场惨烈大火升起的烟里，都可能看见POKENAME。人们相信，它由葬身烈焰者的灵魂构成。
author: danarchosyndacalist
source: POKENAME can be found in the smoke rising from just about any great, disastrous fire. It is believed to be made of the spirits of those who perished in the flames.

entry: POKENAME住在废弃聚落，成群时会举行奇怪仪式。每只都回自己的坟前，蜕下透明的皮。
author: torterraguy26
source: POKENAME are found in abandoned settlements and participate in strange rituals when in a group. Each one goes to its own gravesite to shed its transparent skin.

entry: POKENAME靠改变腹部脸孔的表情交流。巢穴一受威胁，里面所有POKENAME的脸，都会露出怒容。
author: drcew
source: POKENAME communicate by changing the expression of the face on their abdomen. When a POKENAME's nest is being threatened, the faces on all of the POKENAME in the nest become angry.

entry: POKENAME有多种奇异力量。有人猜测，无论来自哪里，任何物种的亡者，它都能交流。至少一幅古画，似乎描出了POKENAME的模样。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME displays a variety of unusual powers. Some have hypothesized it can commune with the dead of any living species, regardless of origin. There is at least one old painting that appears to depict the likeness of POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME有多种奇异力量。有人猜测，无论来自哪里，任何物种的亡者，它都能交流。至少一幅古画，似乎描出了POKENAME的模样。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME displays a variety of unusual powers. Some have hypothesized it can commune with the dead of any living species, regardless of origin. There is at least one old painting that appears to depict the likeness of POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME头边垂下的面具，散出浓烈腐臭，驱退天敌。战斗中，POKENAME也拿臭味当武器，令对手恶心。
author: drcew
source: The mask hanging from POKENAME's head gives off a pungent, rotten smell. POKENAME uses this smell to deter potential predators. In battle, POKENAME will weaponize this odor to cause nausea in its opponents.

entry: 融合将哭哭面具的面具，接到它脸上，封住潜藏的力量。颈边长出的花苞，带着早已被忘却的芳香。
author: hortensia_xxiii
source: Fusion has grafted the mask of a Yamask to its face, sealing away its latent powers. The buds sprouting from its neck smell of long-forgotten aromatics.

entry: POKENAME花朵的香，会引起悲伤。POKENAME自己也不免疫，几乎时刻泪流不止。
author: drcew
source: The fragrance emitted from POKENAME's flower evokes feelings of sadness. POKENAME is not immune to this odor and is in a near-perpetual state of tears.

entry: POKENAME始终带着面具，性情闷闷。咬着面具让它安心，可嚼得太久，又会疼，自己的身体还会出现奇怪牙痕。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME carries a mask around at all times, and has a sullen personality. Biting on the mask gives it emotional comfort, but gnawing on it too long will cause it pain, and create strange bite marks to appear on its own body.

entry: POKENAME胸前的面具，永远望着巢穴。若面具闭着眼，就说明POKENAME没有巢。
author: drcew
source: The mask on POKENAME's chest is always looking towards its nest. If the eyes on the mask are closed, then POKENAME does not have a nest.

entry: POKENAME似乎有预感死亡的第六感，常出现在将死之人的身旁，因此被当作死亡的预兆。
author: drcew
source: POKENAME seems to have a sixth sense for when someone is about to die, often appearing near those moments away from death. This had led POKENAME to become an omen of death.

entry: POKENAME飘在空中，寻找能勾起深藏记忆的面孔。谁的模样让它想起坏经历，就会被它冲上去，用金球痛打。
author: lordjoostmeister
source: POKENAME drifts through the air, searching for faces that trigger its deeply-buried memories. If someone's appearance reminds it of a bad experience, it will rush up to them and batter them with its golden orbs.

entry: POKENAME出没于废弃已久的墓穴，是遥远年代迷失的灵魂，依附着生前时代的遗物。被考古学家惊动，便本能逃离光，躲进暗隙。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are found in long-abandoned tombs. They are the lost spirits of ages long past that cling to relics of their time. When disturbed by archaeologists they instinctively scuttle away from the light, hiding in shadowy recesses.

entry: POKENAME出没于废弃已久的墓穴，是遥远年代迷失的灵魂，依附着生前时代的遗物。被考古学家惊动，便本能逃离光，躲进暗隙。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are found in long-abandoned tombs. They are the lost spirits of ages long past that cling to relics of their time. When disturbed by archaeologists they instinctively scuttle away from the light, hiding in shadowy recesses.

entry: POKENAME附身逝去文明的财宝，出没古墓与地下墓窟。它们害羞，爱待阴影，可住处太亮，又会发起脾气。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME possess the treasures of civilisations long passed and can be found in ancient tombs and catacombs. They are shy and will stick to shadowed areas, but they will lash out if their home gets too bright.

entry: POKENAME能否控制初生的力量，取决于心情。它常突然悲伤，独自哭泣时，稳定性大减，电流混乱地向外奔涌。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's emotional state affects how well it can control its budding powers. It is prone to spells of sorrow, where it loses much of its stability, electricity surging outward chaotically as it cries by itself.

entry: POKENAME带着形状完美的护符，一感到威胁，就躲在后面。也有人发现，它们会被自己的护符卡住。
author: camtft
source: POKENAME carry a perfectly shaped amulet that they hide behind when they feel threatened. Some have noted them getting stuck to their amulet.

entry: POKENAME戴着面具，藏起生前的身份。驯服后，它们便是强悍的信使，能跨越长途，将信送达。
author: elionagashi
source: POKENAME wear masks to hide who they were in life. Once tamed, they are fierce messengers, able to traverse long distances to deliver a letter.

entry: 人去世过的地方，常有POKENAME。POKENAME的眼睛，总在追随不存在的东西。
author: drcew
source: POKENAME is often found in places where people have died. POKENAME's eyes are always following something that isn't there.

entry: 据说POKENAME看得见游魂。它用面具藏住这本领，似乎害怕游魂知道以后，会对自己做什么。
author: drcew
source: POKENAME is said to have the ability to see roaming spirits. It's believed that POKENAME uses its mask to hide its ability in fear of what the roaming spirits would do if they knew.

entry: POKENAME亮毛由金色纤维构成，制成的衣物售价高昂。盗贼若想剪别人POKENAME的毛，就会中诅咒。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's shiny coat is made of golden fibers. Clothes made from these fibers sell for high prices. Thieves who attempt to shear someone else's POKENAME become cursed.

entry: POKENAME羽毛华美有光泽，常被用作墓前祭品。可许多人不敢随身带太久，因为传说会引来灵魂。
author: drcew
source: Feathers from POKENAME are common grave offerings due to their gorgeous and glossy look. However, many people avoid carrying these feathers with them for too long, as they are said to attract spirits.

entry: POKENAME暗中发电更明显。能量生成时，尾巴拿着的面具会亮，有人坚称，偶尔还见它变了表情。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's electricity generation is more pronounced in the dark. As it produces the energy, the mask held in its tail glows, and some swear they see its expression change on occasion.

entry: POKENAME被幽冥之水吸引，夜里会举行神秘仪式。据说，目睹者将遭遇不幸。
author: sand_coffin
source: POKENAME is drawn to spectral waters, performing mysterious rituals at night. Those who witness these rituals are said to encounter misfortune.

entry: POKENAME谨慎极了，进屋前，常先把尾上面具伸进去，自己才跟着进。
author: drcew
source: POKENAME are extremely cautious. They often hold the mask they carry on their tails into a room before entering themselves.

entry: POKENAME振翼快极了，可无论POKENAME振得多快，灵魂还是无法离开身体。
author: drcew
source: POKENAME is able to flap its wings extremely fast, though no matter how fast POKENAME flaps its wings, it is still unable to separate its spirit from its body.

entry: POKENAME怕自己的尾巴，一看便内疚不堪。研究详查它的脑活动，结论是它看见了极度逼真、却只有自己能见的幻象。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME is afraid of its own tail, as looking at it causes it to be racked with guilt. POKENAME's brain activity has been studied in detail, leading to the conclusion that it sees hyperrealistic visions only visible to itself.

entry: POKENAME怕自己的尾巴，一看便内疚不堪。似乎只有浮在冷水里，才能平静。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME is afraid of its own tail, as looking at it causes it to be racked with guilt. It seems to only find calm when floating in cold water.

entry: POKENAME常在餐馆停车场，吃客人留下的残羹，因此也常受雇于各种食店，负责清洁周围。
author: sondededoo
source: POKENAME can often be spotted at restaurant parking lots, where they feed by devouring scraps of food left behind by customers. For this reason, they are often employed by various eateries to keep their locations clean.

entry: POKENAME易惊又黏人，很像不肯离开父母的小孩。POKENAME每遇见其他幽灵属性宝可梦，尾边红带般的器官就越长。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is incredibly skittish yet clingy, much akin to a small child refusing to leave its parents' side. As POKENAME meets other Ghost-types, the red ribbon-like organ around its tail grows longer and longer.

entry: POKENAME吸取附近宝可梦的生命力，滋养背上的花苞。许多训练家都说，碰过POKENAME便头晕、疲倦。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME siphon the vitality of nearby Pokémon to nourish the bulb on their back. Many Trainers describe feeling dizzy and tired after making contact with POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME嫉妒受害者仍能活在人世，夜里在他们卧室外哀哭尖叫，以恐惧为食。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: Jealous of the lives of its victims, POKENAME wails and screams outside their bedrooms at night to feed on their fear.

entry: 据说POKENAME前世是人。生前记忆一浮现，强烈情绪就让它跌下树，爆炸，连记忆也重新清空。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is said to have been a human in a previous life. Supposedly, when the memories of its past life begin to surface, the overwhelming emotions cause it to fall from trees and explode, resetting its memory.

entry: 据说POKENAME把历代前世的灵魂，装在金属钳里。钳张开时仔细听，或许能听见灵魂低语。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is said to carry the souls of its past lives within its metal claws. Supposedly, if one listens closely while the claws are open, they may hear the spirits whisper to them.

entry: POKENAME只有吃从其他宝可梦巢里偷来的蛋，才会抬起面具。它吃得飞快，转眼便消失无踪。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME only lifts its mask when feeding on stolen eggs from other Pokémon nests. It consumes them quickly and vanishes without a trace.

entry: 没人见过POKENAME真脸。心情或表情一变，面具就掉下摔碎，里面再露一张，映着当下表情。
author: musicsheep.
source: No one has seen POKENAME's real face. Any time its mood or expression changes, its mask falls off and shatters, revealing another mask underneath that reflects its current expression.

entry: POKENAME由数百年前打造的金色祭祀面具化成。看见者的恐惧，会具现成它的身体。冬季最活跃，夜里四处潜行。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME form from ceremonial gold masks that were crafted centuries ago. They manifest the fears of those that see them to form their body. They are most active during the winter, stalking through the night.

entry: 幽灵般的身体被自身过高的体温熔化。有人认为，这就是岩浆之灵的模样。
author: soup1900
source: Its ghostly body melted from the sheer heat of its body temperature. Some people believe this to be the form of the spirit of magma.

entry: POKENAME以爪中面具，引猎物进入湿地沼泽。长颈与细长喙，让它轻易捉住陷泥的目标。
author: drcew
source: POKENAME uses the mask it carries in its talon to lure its prey into marshes or swamps. Its long neck and elongated beak make it easy to catch prey trapped in mud.

entry: POKENAME遇见熟睡的人，就将面具放到对方脸上，借此操控。穿越其栖地时，人们被建议每天至少吃一份佛柑果，以作防护。
author: pjporwoll
source: If POKENAME finds a sleeping person, it will place the mask it carries on their face, which allows it to control that person. People are recommended to eat at least a serving of Kasib Berries each day when traveling in its habitat as protection.

entry: 民间说，夜遇POKENAME，只能看面具。若直视它的眼，就会看见自己死亡的那一刻。
author: sk372
source: Folklore says that should one come across a POKENAME at night, gaze only into the mask, for gazing into its eye will show one the moment of their death.

entry: POKENAME颈膜内侧的花纹像人脸，会变成观看者年老后的模样。它在遗迹筑巢，偏爱沙漠或热带。
author: pjporwoll
source: The markings on the interior of POKENAME's hood resemble a face and shift to appear as an aged version of the human viewing it. It makes its nest in ruins, preferring desert or tropical climates.

entry: POKENAME将电存进背上戴的面具。受惊时，POKENAME从面具嘴里放电，响声宛如尖叫。
author: drcew
source: POKENAME stores electricity in the mask it wears on its back. When frightened, POKENAME will discharge the electricity through the mouth of the mask. The noise the discharged electricity makes is akin to screams.

entry: 据说POKENAME在墓园搜寻迷失的灵魂。传说，POKENAME携带的面具，会映出正引向来世的灵魂的脸。
author: drcew
source: POKENAME is said to roam graveyards for lost spirits. Legend says the mask that POKENAME carries shows the face of the spirit they are guiding to the next life.

entry: 人们常见POKENAME与两个面具说话，因此推测面具各有意识。天生温顺的POKENAME，似乎还听它们的命令。
author: kiwiarms
source: POKENAME are often seen conversing with their two masks, which lead to the theory that the masks contain distinct consciousnesses. The naturally meek POKENAME seems to take orders from them.

entry: 耳朵一贴上POKENAME面具般的奖章，就会听见诡异人声低语。听太久，常会剧烈头痛。
author: .izik
source: When one presses an ear to POKENAME's mask-like medal, eerie voice-like murmurs can be heard. Listening too long often results in piercing headaches.

entry: POKENAME拿在胸前的面具，会随POKENAME心情稍变形。POKENAME一放手，便恢复原状，除了原本的POKENAME，谁也改不了新形状。
author: bobosmith01
source: The mask that POKENAME carries and holds above its chest can slightly alter shape depending on POKENAME's mood. It returns to its original state if POKENAME drops it, and it cannot be changed into a new shape by anyone but the original POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME戴叶片面具，从墓中出现。它模仿卡拉卡拉、哭哭面具等戴面具的宝可梦，盼能少些孤独。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME emerges from tombs with masks made of leaves. It mimics other mask-wearing Pokémon like Cubone and Yamask, hoping to be less lonely.

entry: POKENAME守护洞穴与遗迹的宝物，护财心很强，因此常被银行雇作保安。
author: actliux
source: POKENAME defend treasure found within caves and ruins. They are highly protective of valuables, making them a frequent hire for banks as a security measure.

entry: POKENAME热心护卫，常守着深洞中的宝藏。据说，POKENAME财宝一被偷，就会追贼不休，直到最后一口气。
author: actliux
source: POKENAME is a zealous protector and can be found protecting treasure deep within caves. It is said that when POKENAME's treasure is stolen, it will endlessly pursue the thief until its last breath.

entry: POKENAME面具里电存得太多，性情就变得阴郁。为免如此，POKENAME偶尔从面具嘴里放电，路人常把响声听成尖叫。
author: drcew
source: If POKENAME stores too much electricity in its mask, its behavior will turn gloomy. To avoid this, POKENAME will occasionally discharge electricity from the mouth of the mask. Those who happen to hear the discharge often confuse it for screams.

entry: POKENAME吞藏古墓中的金币，吃附在钱上的残余灵力。谁敢碰它的金面具，就会听见一声令人胆寒的尖叫。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME swallow and store gold coins within ancient tombs, feeding on the lingering spiritual energies that cling to them. They release a bone-chilling screech if anyone dares to touch their golden masks.

entry: POKENAME蜷成球，防御攻击，却露着尾上面具，吓走来犯者。
author: drcew
source: POKENAME will curl up into a ball to defend against attacks while leaving the mask on its tail exposed to scare away its attacker.

entry: 它夜夜默默哭泣，其实是在吸收月光能量，称作“月合作用”。幽灵般的叶身质地独特，很适合做各种菜的蔬菜底料，因此帕底亚人常来捕猎。
author: beatdoof
source: It always weeps silently at night, but it's actually gathering lunar energy, a process called selinisynthesis. Paldeans often hunt it down because of the unique texture of its ghostly, leafy body, making it a perfect vegetable base for any dish.

entry: POKENAME用身上的面具，在有权限访问设备的用户面前，伪造设备上的自身踪迹。它紧盯面具，便能取回从电脑吸取、偷来的数据。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME uses the mask on its body to falsify its presence on devices to those users who have access. It stares intently at its mask to retrieve data it has absorbed and stolen from computers.

entry: 时日渐长，POKENAME的面具有了自己的意识。如今由面具发号施令，灵魂反成了容器。
author: kiwiarms
source: Over time, POKENAME's mask gained a mind of its own. Now it's in charge, and the spirit is just its vessel.

entry: POKENAME带着首位受害者脸孔的面具，对方通常是夜里走得太深入丛林的冒险者。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: POKENAME carries a mask of the face of its first victim. This victim is usually an adventurer who wandered too far into the jungle at night.

entry: POKENAME心地温暖，寻找曾相识的训练家。可惜始终未能找到，回忆起往事，就会落下一滴幽魂的泪。
author: mcnchsschl
source: A Pokémon with a warm heart, POKENAME searches for a Trainer that it once knew. Unfortunately, it never found them, and it sheds a single ghostly tear as it remembers its past.

entry: POKENAME迅速掘过沙漠，用守住抵挡混混鳄等天敌。即使遇上落石，面具也毫发无伤。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME digs rapidly through desert sands, using Protect to ward off predators like Krokorok. Its mask remains unscathed even in rockslides.

entry: 它将超能力集中到金面具，吸走其他宝可梦与人类的正面情绪。周围的希望与欢乐消退时，面具便开始笑。
author: pattybgoode
source: Focusing its psychic power into its golden mask, it drains the positive emotions of other Pokémon and people. As those around it lose hope and joy, the mask begins to laugh.

entry: 每片闪鳞都存着一个记忆。除此以外，POKENAME再无办法回忆一生，只好仔细管理收藏。每想记住新经历，就必须选一件旧事，永远忘去。
author: lordjoostmeister
source: Each gleaming scale holds a single memory. With no other way to recall its life, POKENAME carefully curates its collection. For each new experience it wants to remember, POKENAME must choose an old one to forget forever.

entry: POKENAME从面具眼里流泪自保。泪含剧毒，POKENAME越痛苦不安，毒性就越强。
author: drcew
source: POKENAME releases tears from the eyes of its mask as a form of protection. These tears are highly toxic and their potency increases with POKENAME's level of distress.

entry: 久无人迹的古遗迹要当心，也许会撞见难觅的POKENAME。只看一眼不眨的红眼，就会恐惧满心。它在古址搜寻面具，啃古物、弄塌地基，再用黏土搭家。
author: oddly.abnormal
source: Beware long-abandoned ruins, for you may stumble upon the elusive POKENAME. One look into its unblinking crimson eyes fills victims with dread. It scavenges ancient sites for masks, chewing relics and collapsing foundations, making homes out of clay.

entry: POKENAME装作地上被丢弃的面具，除非信赖者在旁，极少活动。它能投出幽异的幻听，如一群人齐声尖叫。
author: .izik
source: Disguised as a discarded mask on the ground, POKENAME rarely moves unless near someone it trusts. It can project ghostly auditory illusions that sound like a chorus of screaming voices.

entry: 近来才发现POKENAME守着古墓。它能随意操纵身上的裹布，据推测，靠周围矿物或潜藏的能量生存。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME has recently been discovered guarding ancient tombs. It can control the wrappings on its body at will, and it is theorized to survive by feeding on minerals or latent energy in the area.

entry: 它领地意识极强，传说曾守卫某个古文明的神殿。面具偶尔变表情，却只趁你没看时。
author: joeofthealps
source: A fiercely territorial Pokémon, legends say it once guarded the temples of an ancient civilization. Sometimes, the expression on its mask changes, but only when you look away.

entry: 人们认为POKENAME由古代战士，以及战斗中护卫他们的伙伴宝可梦的灵魂化成。传说双方羁绊太深，连死亡也无法斩断。
author: joeofthealps
source: POKENAME is thought to be the spirits of warriors from ancient times and their partner Pokémon, who defended them in battle. Legend says that the bonds between these two are so strong that not even death could break them.

entry: 据说POKENAME是昔日灾难死者的灵魂。常见它们游荡村庄遗迹，发出悲鸣。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: POKENAME are said to be the spirits of those who died in past disasters. They can be seen roaming around village ruins, letting out mournful cries.

entry: POKENAME无声浮游海洋，受负面情绪吸引。水手歌谣说，沉船旁会出现POKENAME，庞大有浮力的身体，却无意间成了海上避难处。
author: lordjoostmeister
source: POKENAME floats silently through the ocean, drawn to sources of negative emotion. Sailors' shanties tell of POKENAME appearing near sinking ships, its buoyant massive body inadvertently providing refuge from the sea.

entry: 许多人相信，绕POKENAME旋转的面具，是它引往来世的迷魂。若拿来戴上，就会被附身。
author: origamiskies
source: It is widely believed that the masks orbiting POKENAME are lost souls it guides to the afterlife. Taking and wearing one of its masks is known to result in possession.

entry: 据说POKENAME是古代某人深爱的宝可梦的灵魂。它寻找旧日训练家，却永远找不到。
author: archserpent
source: POKENAME is said to be the spirit of a beloved Pokémon who belonged to someone from ancient times. It searches for its former Trainer, never to find them.

entry: POKENAME用面具的磁力，吸来曾为人类的灵魂，再放进臂上的“迷你鼻”，完全掌控、指挥。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME uses its mask to magnetize the souls of former humans to it. It then puts these souls into 'mini-noses' on its arms to have complete control and command over them.

entry: 据说，武士的灵魂附在自己的葬面具与生前佩剑上，至今仍为战败，深感绝望。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: It's said the spirit of a warrior possesses its funeral mask and sword it wielded while it was alive. It still despairs that it lost the war.

entry: 据说，武士的亡魂仍带着生前的剑，悲悼自己为之奋战的王国，早已不复存在。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: It's said the spirit of a warrior carries the sword that it wielded in life. It mourns that the kingdom it fought for no longer exists.

entry: 这把仪式用剑，被幽灵附身，徘徊地下墓穴，寻找更多祭品，尤其喜欢盯上盗墓者。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: A ceremonial blade haunted by a spirit. It wanders catacombs in search of more victims to sacrifice, especially grave robbers.

entry: 有人说，碰到POKENAME金面具，就会终生受咒。背上鬼手的数量，据说就是被它诅咒过的人数。
author: archserpent
source: Some say that should anyone touch POKENAME's golden mask, they will be cursed forever. The ghostly hands emerging from its back are thought to be the amount of people it has cursed.

entry: POKENAME长久吃金块，黄毛便微微泛光。它守古代君王的墓，对闯入者，毫不留情追杀。
author: mepp.
source: Due to a steady diet of gold nuggets, POKENAME's yellow fur faintly glimmers. It guards the tombs of ancient rulers, and mercilessly hunts down any trespassers.

entry: 没人敢看POKENAME铠甲里面，就连它自己的训练家，也不敢。
author: tomatosalad
source: Nobody dares look within POKENAME's armor. Not even its own Trainers.

entry: 据说，尾上的面具来自过去的训练家，也像他们的模样。它们飞过沙漠天空，翼间便响起忧伤的曲调。
author: infinex21
source: The masks upon their tails are said to have come from, and resemble, their past Trainers. Their wings emit a melancholic tune as they fly through desert skies.

entry: POKENAME厌恶自己的脸，用手中的面具盖住。POKENAME觉得谁美，面具就会变成那人的脸。
author: drcew
source: POKENAME is disgusted by its face and will cover it with the mask it holds. The mask POKENAME uses will change to match the face of whoever POKENAME finds beautiful.

entry: 化作POKENAME的灵魂，始终追求一个古老而险恶的目标。它们会装善良，骗别人帮忙。
author: rakanadyo
source: The spirits that became POKENAME work toward an ancient, sinister goal. They will feign kindness to trick others into assisting them.

entry: 据说POKENAME用遇见过的人与宝可梦脸形的面具伪装。也有传言，POKENAME会偷走不设防者的脸。
author: drcew
source: POKENAME is said to disguise itself using masks that resemble the faces of Pokémon and people it has come across. It is rumored that POKENAME steals the faces of unsuspecting people and Pokémon.

entry: 它们常在墓园安慰悲伤的家人。只有独处，才留一点时间，为自己哀伤。
author: dolly_cholli
source: These Pokémon can be spotted around graveyards comforting grieving families. They only take their own time to grieve when they're alone.

entry: POKENAME行为难测，翱翔天际，走到哪，就带来混乱。尾端面具存着破坏时积起的诅咒能量。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are erratic creatures that soar through the sky bringing chaos wherever they go. The mask at the end of their tails stores cursed energy they accumulate from causing destruction.

entry: POKENAME常在满月之夜现身墓前。POKENAME想陪悲伤者玩，让对方高兴些。
author: drcew
source: POKENAME often appears at graves on full moon nights. POKENAME tries to cheer the grieving up by playing with them.

entry: POKENAME住的沙漠遗迹，寒冷得反常，哭声也回荡得格外清晰。谁辜负它信任，就会被POKENAME以招牌的踉跄步态，追出遗迹。
author: .realthree
source: The desert ruins that POKENAME lives in are unnaturally chilly, and the sound of its weeping echoes exceptionally well. Those that betray its trust are chased out of the ruins, pursued by POKENAME running with its signature lurching gait.

entry: POKENAME翅膀只是装饰，蹦跳却轻盈，仿佛真能借翼活动。有人见过POKENAME月夜在墓前留下金色祭品。
author: drcew
source: While POKENAME's wings are just for show, it is still able to skip around lightly as if it could use them. POKENAME has been seen leaving golden offerings at graves on moonlit nights.

entry: 永不熄灭的火焰慢慢熔化灵魂的蜡面具，生前记忆也随之模糊，直至彻底遗忘。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: As an eternal flame melts the wax mask of this spirit, its memory of its life becomes fuzzier until it forgets it completely.

entry: POKENAME把面具藏在六尾之下。据说谁偷看，面具便会睁眼，诅咒观看者。
author: drcew
source: POKENAME hides the mask it carries under its six tails. It's said that if one were to look at this mask, the eyes on the mask would open and curse whoever viewed it.

entry: POKENAME等不设防的哭哭面具经过，偷走面具。它收集这些面具，盼着找到自己为人时的脸。
author: hereisanimations
source: POKENAME waits for unsuspecting Yamask to pass by, stealing their mask. It collects these masks with the hope of finding its human face.

entry: POKENAME伸开六臂，便能让四周陷入黑暗，可影子中心，金身仍亮。它们通常深藏古墓，周围满是财宝。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME can stretch out their six arms to shroud their surroundings in darkness, but their golden body will still gleam brightly in the center of the shadow. They are usually found deep inside ancient tombs, surrounded by treasure.

entry: POKENAME每条尾都带着不同诅咒，一碰便传给来者。它夜里寻找能解咒的人，却在无意间，散播了更多苦难。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Each of the tails of POKENAME are imbued with a different curse that is transferred to anyone who makes contact with them. They stalk through the night in search of anyone who can take the curse off of them, inadvertently spreading misery as they do.

entry: 据说，好几只哭哭面具的灵魂合在一起，成了POKENAME。它再也弄不清自己是谁，那些带着的面具，只能徒增痛苦。
author: ethewriter
source: It's said the souls of multiple Yamask combined, creating POKENAME. Its identity is compromised, so the masks it carries only cause them anguish.

entry: POKENAME筑好水坝，就用携带的面具装点。面具安好后，POKENAME获得对水坝的灵力控制，能以意念操纵构成水坝的木材。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses the mask it carries to adorn a dam once it has completed construction. After attaching to mask, POKENAME gains a type of spiritual control over the dam, able to mentally manipulate the lumber making up the structure.

entry: POKENAME虽慵懒，熟睡的身体仍渗出灵力，引起周围怪事。金面具以亡者的声音低语，回响早已被遗忘的梦。
author: silentscript89
source: Despite its lethargy, POKENAME's spiritual energy seeps from its slumbering body, causing bizarre phenomena around it. Its golden mask whispers with the voices of the departed, echoing dreams long lost to oblivion.

entry: 饱含冤魂悲鸣的金面具，融合在POKENAME额上。不断的哀号让它睡不着，传出面具内囚着的痛苦，始终陷在狂怒。
author: silentscript89
source: The golden mask, which has accumulated the anguished cries of the unjustly departed, has fused to POKENAME's forehead. Their constant wailing prevents it from sleeping, leaving it in perpetual rage as it channels the torment trapped within the mask.

entry: POKENAME悲伤的脸，看似无助，其实很会自卫。尾上面具释放强电，放电时的表情，还会转成惊讶。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's sorrowful expression makes it seem helpless, but it is quite adept at defending itself. It lets loose intense voltage from the mask on its tail, its expression changing to one of surprise as it dispenses electricity.

entry: POKENAME每条尾都带着不同诅咒，一碰便传给来者。它夜里寻找能解咒的人，却在无意间，散播了更多苦难。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Each of the tails of POKENAME are imbued with a different curse that is transferred to anyone who makes contact with them. They stalk through the night in search of anyone who can take the curse off of them, inadvertently spreading misery as they do.

entry: POKENAME每条尾都带着不同诅咒，一碰便传给来者。它夜里寻找能解咒的人，却在无意间，散播了更多苦难。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Each of the tails of POKENAME are imbued with a different curse that is transferred to anyone who makes contact with them. They stalk through the night in search of anyone who can take the curse off of them, inadvertently spreading misery as they do.

entry: 据说POKENAME的歌，使听者悲伤。葬礼上，常能见到它唱歌。
author: drcew
source: POKENAME's song is said to cause feelings of sadness in those who hear it. It can often be found singing at funerals.

entry: 古代人会照着逝去亲人的面容，为POKENAME制作面具。面具属于谁，这只宝可梦便会守护谁的墓。
author: melodydelune
source: Ancient civilizations would craft masks of departed loved ones for POKENAME. This Pokémon will guard the burial site of the person their mask matches.

entry: POKENAME脸上的面具，与金甲壳一同长大。它守墓时，眼色据说能显示亡者的罪孽，红色就表示最深重。
author: beatdoof
source: The mask covering POKENAME's face has grown alongside its golden armor shell. As a grave guardian, the Pokémon's eye color is said to determine the sin of the deceased it guards, with red indicating the most sinful of all.

entry: POKENAME用宽颚铲起佛柑果吃。被打扰，就突然放出黑夜魔影，掩护逃走。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME hunts for Kasib Berries, scooping them up with its wide jaws. If disturbed, it unleashes a sudden Night Shade to cover its escape.

entry: POKENAME幽翼快振，飞过古墓。金面具还能发出阴森虫鸣，回荡遗迹。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's ghostly wings beat rapidly as it flies through ancient tombs. From its golden mask, it can emit a haunting Bug Buzz that echoes through the ruins.

entry: 身体没有固定形态，让POKENAME能接上各种古老机关，也因此很受盗墓者欢迎。
author: chorb33
source: Thanks to its amorphous shape, POKENAME can connect with all kinds of ancient mechanisms. For this reason, it is very popular with grave robbers.

entry: POKENAME淘气极了，常造幻象，惊吓走近巢穴的人。传说，碰到POKENAME面具，自己也会变成一只。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME are incredibly mischievous Pokémon, often creating illusions to scare people wandering near their dens. Legends say that those who touch a POKENAME's mask turn into one themselves.

entry: POKENAME披上伪装前，会先想躲在面具后。可变成的形体，通常比戴着的面具大，几乎藏不住。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: Before donning a disguise, POKENAME attempt to hide behind their masks. This rarely works however as the form they take is typically larger than masks they wear.

entry: POKENAME用尾尖火焰扭塑面具，表达当下心情。可常因表现不准，令POKENAME懊恼不已。
author: drcew
source: POKENAME uses the flame on the tip of its tail to warp the mask it's holding to reflect its current mood. POKENAME often gets frustrated when it is unable to accurately depict its emotions.

entry: 最早的POKENAME，是在古墓的一个瓶里发现的。许多人相信，POKENAME是强大古灵的转世。
author: hophoppip
source: The first POKENAME was found within a bottle inside an ancient tomb. Many believe POKENAME to be the reincarnations of powerful ancient spirits.

entry: POKENAME头上裂开的面具，在日出前一小时便开始微亮，让它有时间赶在光到来前，退进阴影。
author: .izik
source: The split mask on POKENAME's head begins to glow faintly an hour before sunrise. This gives it time to retreat into shadows before the light reaches it.

entry: POKENAME夜行，无月的晚上，常浮在草野上。受惊时，头上面具先露出恐惧表情，再放出黑棉云，掩护逃走。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a nocturnal creature, seen floating above grassy fields on moonless evenings. The mask on its head takes on a fearful expression when startled, just before it releases a cloud of black cotton to obscure its escape.

entry: POKENAME震动面具，造出高频声，在暗洞辨路。传言说，POKENAME面具后藏着眼睛。
author: drcew
source: POKENAME vibrates its mask to create high-frequency sounds to navigate through dark caves. POKENAME is rumored to have eyes hidden behind its mask.

entry: POKENAME是狡猾的沙漠住民，先藏身，只让敌人看见尾巴。尾端面具催眠看见者，令其不动，POKENAME便偷东西，或痛打到服。
author: sk372
source: A crafty desert dweller, POKENAME hides away and lets its tail be the first thing a foe sees. The mask at the end hypnotizes those who view it, rendering them motionless so POKENAME can pilfer them or beat them into submission.

entry: POKENAME的面具，原本像它生前的脸。可每看一次，POKENAME便更怨恨，面具也因此越发扭曲。
author: drcew
source: The mask POKENAME carries used to resemble its face in life. Every time POKENAME looks at its mask, POKENAME grows to resent the mask more, causing the mask to distort even further.

entry: POKENAME是一群幽灵，靠吸收闹鬼之物与凶地的灵力为生。入夜后，常能看见它们聚集在墓地。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME are spirits that absorb the spiritual energy of haunted objects and areas. They can be found swarming burial sites at night.

entry: POKENAME追捕盗墓者，将其赶走，让亡灵不受打扰。双翼极快，让它在领地各处之间，迅速飞行。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME hunts down grave robbers to drive them away and allow the souls of the dead to rest undisturbed. It can fly very quickly from one point to another in its territory thanks to the speed of its wings.

entry: 为这只幽灵铸造金身的古代文明相信，POKENAME象征着太阳周而复始的“死亡与重生”。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: According to beliefs of the ancient civilization who created the golden body for this spirit, POKENAME symbolizes the 'Death and Rebirth Cycle' of the sun.

entry: POKENAME追猎时闭紧嘴，让两半面具合拢。POKENAME准备出击，面具才会分开。
author: drcew
source: When stalking prey POKENAME will keep its mouth closed, joining the two halves of its mask. These halves will separate once POKENAME is about to attack.

entry: 金色王冠在阳光下闪耀，诱着毫无戒心的人深入沼泽。面具上，则戴着那些迷失者的脸。
author: zagreus8
source: Its golden crown glitters in the sun, luring unsuspecting people deeper into swamps. It wears the faces of those lost on its mask.

entry: 它们以艺术天赋与友善面孔，引人走近。目标够近，就猛扑上去，只想尽量多收些亮晶晶的物件。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Combining their penchant for art and their friendly visage, they lure people close to them. When their target gets close enough, they pounce, eager to amass as many sparkly objects as possible.

entry: POKENAME常欺负小型幽灵属性宝可梦，命令它们办事，例如拿来闪亮饰品。POKENAME多住古殿，还用尾上面具，引来盗墓者。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME often bully smaller Ghost-type Pokémon into doing their bidding, such as bringing them shiny accessories. POKENAME often live in ancient temples, using the masks on their tails to lure in grave robbers.

entry: POKENAME用斗篷与面具，遮护怕冷的身体和脸。据说，强行摘面具，就会中咒，连死后都被纠缠。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses a cloak and mask to shield its sensitive body and face from the cold. Trying to forcibly remove the mask is said to result in a curse that will haunt you even in the afterlife.

entry: POKENAME摘掉面具，嘴里就放出黑雾，吸入者会心生恐惧。
author: drcew
source: When POKENAME removes its mask, it emits a black mist from its mouth that instills a sense of dread in those who breathe it in.

entry: POKENAME头上像脸的结构，不是变形的叶片，而是种子。POKENAME找到适合栽种的地方，种子便开始流泪。
author: drcew
source: The face-like structure on POKENAME's head is not a modified leaf but actually a seed. This seed will begin to weep when POKENAME finds a suitable place to plant it.

entry: POKENAME找到伴侣，就在头饰绑条红线，表示已有对象。训练家或宝可梦若想偷走红线，便会被诅咒，霉运缠身。
author: dodoowner_
source: When POKENAME finds a partner, it wraps a Destiny Knot around its headwear, symbolizing that it's in a relationship. If any Trainer or Pokémon attempts to steal the knot, they are cursed with bad luck.

entry: 记忆碎片从面具渗出，久久停留，让经过POKENAME走过之处的人，也感到其中情绪。多数记忆苦涩，少数却暖心得甜。
author: lordjoostmeister
source: Fragments of memory seep out of its masks, lingering and inducing emotion in those who cross POKENAME's trail. Though most of the memories are bitter, a scant few are heartwarmingly sweet.

entry: POKENAME身体各节，一碰便唤起不同的幽魂记忆。有些记忆，还出现被认为如今已灭绝的宝可梦。
author: lordjoostmeister
source: When touched, each segment of POKENAME's body evokes a different ghostly memory. Some memories involve Pokémon that are thought to be extinct in today's era.

entry: POKENAME夜里释放黑花粉。自己的眼也常被刺激，因此POKENAME戴上面具，保护双眼。
author: drcew
source: During the night POKENAME release black pollen. POKENAME's eyes are often irritated by its own pollen, so it wears a mask to protect its eyes.

entry: 传说，它是被逼走跳板落海的男子之魂，永远绑在重得举不起的金锚上。
author: kiwiarms
source: Legend says it's the soul of a man forced to walk the plank. It is bound forever to its golden anchor, which is too heavy for it to lift.

entry: 它们曾在酷热的沙漠烈日下丧命，如今戴着仙人掌形的面具，纪念自己的死亡。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: These spirits passed under the sweltering desert sun. They wear cactus-shaped masks in memoriam of their passing.

entry: 据说POKENAME体内有多个灵魂。背上每株金蘑菇的大小，都由最能掌控身体的灵魂决定。
author: drcew
source: POKENAME's body is said to have multiple spirits within it. The size of each gold mushroom on its back is dictated by whichever spirit has the most control.

entry: 它忠诚深厚，却不太爱交际。主人离世后，POKENAME脸上的面具便一天天、慢慢改变，最终变成故主的脸。
author: bobosmith01
source: It is a deeply loyal Pokémon that does not like to socialize very much. If its owner passes away, the mask upon POKENAME's face will change day by day, little by little, until it finally resembles their old master's face.

entry: POKENAME顶着雨雪，守着曾侍奉者的墓碑。据说POKENAME忠心不改，会击败恶灵，吸收力量，再逼它们一同守墓。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME endures rain and snow to guard the gravestones of those it once served. It is said that POKENAME's unwavering loyalty drives it to defeat evil spirits, absorbing their power and forcing them to defend the graves alongside it.

entry: 月光之夜，有人说听见过POKENAME幽异的旋律。据说，听见它歌声的人注定会死。
author: inksans201x
source: On moonlit nights, some people claim to hear the haunting melody of POKENAME. It's said that those who hear its song are fated to die.

entry: 它独自在墓地跳舞，若发现被看见，就逃，或攻击。人们认为，那是敬奉亡者、早已失传的古舞。
author: bobosmith01
source: It dances alone in burial sites and will flee or attack if it realizes it is being watched. It is thought to perform old and forgotten ritualistic dances that honor the dead.

entry: 实验让科学家确认，POKENAME额上面具坚硬，足以挡开好坏星的攻击。它们还常囤些物件啃咬，保持牙利。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: Through experimentation, scientists now know that the mask on POKENAME's forehead is tough enough to deflect blows from Mareanie. They often hoard items to chew on, keeping their teeth sharp.

entry: POKENAME体内某个灵魂完全占住主导，背上蘑菇就会长大，覆住大半身体，彰显其支配。
author: drcew
source: When one of the spirits contained in POKENAME's body gains full control, the mushroom on its back grows to cover most of its body to reflect the spirit's dominance.

entry: 传说POKENAME仍忠于主人，热切守护旧物。击打面具，会响起震耳的鸣声，据说连死者也能唤醒。
author: quackquackattack
source: Legends claim that POKENAME retain loyalty to their masters and zealously protect old belongings. Striking their mask releases a deafening ring that is said to awaken the dead.

entry: POKENAME头上面具般的鳞，盯太久就会深感恐惧。有人说，鳞片的“嘴”会弯成骇人的笑，带来诅咒。
author: .izik
source: The mask-like scale on POKENAME's head causes intense dread in anyone who stares at it for prolonged periods. Some claim its scale's 'mouth' will curve into a horrible smile and bring about curses.

entry: 据说POKENAME能看透眼前者的灵魂。POKENAME常被所见之事，惹得流泪。
author: drcew
source: POKENAME is said to be able to peer into the souls of those it sees. POKENAME is often brought to tears by what it sees.

entry: POKENAME受挑衅便振翼，撒出金面具里的记忆。记忆不同，敌人便可能被恐惧、悲痛或羞耻压倒。
author: lordjoostmeister
source: If provoked, POKENAME beats its wings to scatter the memories contained in its golden masks. Depending on the memory, foes may feel overpowering fear, grief, or shame.

entry: 吃少量POKENAME头上的金糖浆，就能短暂看见灵界。
author: hophoppip
source: Ingesting a small amount of the golden syrup from POKENAME's head allows one to see into the spirit world for a brief time.

entry: POKENAME歇在湖泊与池塘，人们却常误认背上面具是溺水者，打扰它。据说，这面具像它栖地水中溺亡的人。
author: drcew
source: POKENAME rests in lakes and ponds but is often disturbed by people who mistake the mask on its back for a drowning person. It is rumored that this mask resembles those who have drowned in the waters where POKENAME resides.

entry: POKENAME战斗时发热，让面具变得可塑，最后总像最近交手过的敌人。
author: drcew
source: POKENAME's body heats up when it battles, causing its mask to become malleable. This leads to its mask resembling the last opponent it has faced.

entry: 偶尔能见POKENAME与随身面具说话。POKENAME一被发现，就迅速掘地逃走。
author: drcew
source: POKENAME is sometimes seen conversing with the mask it carries around. If POKENAME is caught conversing with its mask, it will quickly burrow away.

entry: 据说POKENAME原本只有一个灵魂，因太孤独，才分成三个。POKENAME的面具，分别代表原灵魂的不同面向。
author: drcew
source: It's said that POKENAME was originally one spirit but split itself into three due to its loneliness. The masks on POKENAME are said to represent different aspects of the original spirit.

entry: POKENAME喜欢收集亮硬币。有人见过POKENAME将收来的钱，放在墓前。
author: drcew
source: POKENAME likes to collect shiny coins. POKENAME has been seen leaving the coins it collects at graves.

entry: POKENAME把尾巴拿着的面具，当作另一双眼。只有POKENAME待在安心的对象身边，面具的眼睛才会闭上。
author: drcew
source: POKENAME uses the mask it carries with its tail as a second pair of eyes. The eyes on the mask will only close if POKENAME is around someone it is comfortable with.

entry: POKENAME藏在湿地、沼泽的浑水中。看见旅人经过，它便用额上硬币的金光，吸引对方靠近，再跃出来，试图将其淹死。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME lurk in marshes and swamps, hiding themselves within the murky waters. When they see a traveller pass by, they use the golden glint of the coin on their forehead to draw them close, then leap out to attempt to drown them.

entry: POKENAME徘徊古墓，守着消逝文明的遗物。住处被扰，便会狂怒，用金拳痛击胆敢闯入者。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME linger in ancient tombs, watching over relics from long dead civilisations. They fly into a frenzy when their home is disturbed, striking at whoever dared enter with golden fists.

entry: POKENAME忠心极深，据说训练家死后，仍会守墓。不少墓园看守人，因此被误当盗墓者，遭POKENAME袭击。
author: drcew
source: POKENAME is extremely loyal and is said to guard the graves of their trainers after they pass. This has led to a number of graveyard attendants being attacked by POKENAME because they were mistaken for grave robbers.

entry: POKENAME以尾尖火焰，引出强敌。POKENAME认可的对手，会被它改变腹部脸孔，留作纪念。
author: drcew
source: POKENAME uses the flame on the tip of its tail to lure out strong opponents. POKENAME changes the face on its belly to memorialize an opponent it has deemed worthy.

entry: POKENAME用尾巴拿着的面具当桨，让自己游得更快。面具上的眼睛睁开或闭上时，腹部螺旋的方向，也会随之改变。
author: drcew
source: POKENAME uses the mask it carries with its tail as a paddle to swim faster in the water. The spirals on its stomach will change direction based on whether the eyes on the mask are open or closed.

entry: POKENAME不愿别人看见脸，便瞬移到暗处，用面具装成刚死去的人类或宝可梦。
author: drcew
source: POKENAME does not like its face being seen, so it will teleport to a dark place and use its mask to disguise itself as a human or Pokémon that has recently died.

entry: POKENAME读懂来者的心，再用面具装成对方珍爱的人。POKENAME是否别有恶意，仍无人知道。
author: drcew
source: POKENAME uses its psychic abilities to read the minds of those who approach it and uses its mask to disguise itself as someone dear to that person. It is unknown if POKENAME does this maliciously.

entry: POKENAME以两张浮动面具，向悲伤的人投出新亡亲友的影像。当地不少闹鬼目击，实际都出自POKENAME。
author: drcew
