source: POKENAME shows grieving people projections of the recently deceased using its two floating masks. POKENAME is responsible for a number of ghost sightings throughout the region.

entry: 据说POKENAME是历史上某些最伟大斗士的灵魂，依附奇异的面具古物。敲响面具，便能召来POKENAME，再赴战斗的荣光。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME are said to be the spirits of some of the greatest fighters in history, lingering within a strange mask artifact. Striking the mask to make it ring summons POKENAME, ready to return to the glory of battle once more.

entry: POKENAME常在荒地扎根。携带的金头用来存水，面具则清理障碍，方便POKENAME把根种下。
author: drcew
source: POKENAME often takes root in barren places. The gold head POKENAME carries is used to store water, while the mask is used to clear obstructions to make planting its roots easier.

entry: POKENAME十分健忘，漫游时仿佛对四周浑然不觉。可背壳的眼一发现要事，就会亮红光，让POKENAME突然专注。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are rather forgetful, wandering around as if completely unaware of their surroundings. However, if the eyes on the back of their shells spot something important, they will glow bright red as the POKENAME suddenly focuses.

entry: POKENAME嘴里的面具，挡住吞下的东西，不让逃跑。面具像的，正是POKENAME最后吞下的那张脸。
author: drcew
source: The mask in POKENAME's mouth keeps whatever it swallows from escaping. The mask resembles the face of the last thing POKENAME has swallowed.

entry: POKENAME藏在海底，只露头上两个面具。POKENAME察觉猎物，就从面具向周围喷毒，麻痹目标。
author: drcew
source: POKENAME hides itself on the sea floor, only leaving the two masks on its head exposed. When POKENAME senses potential prey, it will spew poison from its masks into the surrounding area to paralyze its target.

entry: 有时能见POKENAME夜奔墓园。POKENAME身侧的面具，像父母其中一位。
author: drcew
source: POKENAME is sometimes seen at night galloping through graveyards. The mask on POKENAME's side resembles one of its parents.

entry: 有人见POKENAME夜里飞奔墓园。POKENAME似乎在找某件东西，或某个人。
author: drcew
source: POKENAME has been spotted dashing through graveyards at night. POKENAME seems to be looking for something or someone.

entry: POKENAME睡觉，壳内便传出幽灵哀号。谁想找出怪声源头，壳眼就亮红光，哀号也化作尖叫。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Ghostly wails echo out from inside POKENAME's shell while POKENAME sleeps. Any attempts to find the source of the odd sounds will cause the eyes on the shell to glow bright red as the wails turn to shrieks.

entry: POKENAME看似一个自带磁场的古老电池盒，由囚禁其中的灵魂供能。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME appears to be an ancient form of a battery case with its own magnetic field, powered by a spirit trapped within.

entry: 它们住在古遗迹，吃踩在无定形身体上的来者的情绪。少许就够维生，但谁想拿金面具，就会被尽可能吸取。
author: infinex21
source: Found within ancient ruins, these Pokémon feed on the emotions of those who step upon their amorphous form. They need little to sustain themselves, but if one tries to take their golden mask, they will siphon all they can.

entry: POKENAME胃口惊人，水果到宝可元，什么都吃。POKENAME吃得多，身体就长大，有些甚至像卡比兽一般。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME have voracious appetites, eating anything from fruit to Poké Dollars. When POKENAME consume vast amounts of food, they grow, with some becoming as large as Snorlax.

entry: POKENAME背炮能独立转动，锁住任何方向的目标。POKENAME常眺望远处，却又诡异地专注于炮口锁定的一切。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: The cannons on a POKENAME's back move independently to lock onto a target from any direction. While POKENAME often spend their time looking out into the distance, they're eerily focused on whatever their cannons lock onto.

entry: POKENAME的身体仿似古代面具，暗藏的双眼却会突然睁开。据说，看见的人会遭可怕的诅咒。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body mimics an ancient mask, but its hidden eyes can suddenly open. Those who see them are said to suffer a terrible Curse.

entry: 这条庞大的长蛇，由数百个溺亡者的灵魂构成。野生POKENAME漫游大洋，寻找更多受害者，壮大身体。
author: lyman
source: A long massive serpent made of hundreds of drowned souls, wild POKENAME travel the vast ocean in search of more victims to add to its mass.

entry: 这条庞大的长蛇，由数百个溺亡者的灵魂构成。野生POKENAME漫游大洋，寻找更多受害者，壮大身体。
author: oxitape.
source: A long massive serpent made of hundreds of drowned souls, wild POKENAME travel the vast ocean in search of more victims to add to its mass.

entry: POKENAME是不得安息的灵魂，会让猎物入睡，再潜入其心中，重温做梦的感觉。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: A restless spirit, POKENAME puts to sleep and enters the mind of its victims to remember what it was like to dream.

entry: POKENAME摆锤的脸，会像观看者认识的亡者。POKENAME随后吃掉双方共度的记忆，直到对方彻底忘掉死者。
author: drcew
source: The face on POKENAME's pendulums will resemble a deceased person the viewer knew. POKENAME will then feed on the memories the viewer shared with the deceased until the deceased is completely forgotten by the viewer.

entry: POKENAME头骨由紧密层叠的丝构成。若受损，就飞快吐更多丝，补上裂口。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's skull is composed of tightly layered silk. If damaged, it rapidly spins more silk to patch the breach.

entry: POKENAME的壳满是导电小刺。训练家或宝可梦若好奇靠近，就会被一记电击吓走。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME's shell is covered in small spines that conduct electricity. Any Trainers or Pokémon curious enough to get close are scared off with a Thunder Shock.

entry: POKENAME身体微小，会用变小巧妙闪招。每缩一次，还释放一阵电流。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are tiny creatures that can skillfully dodge attacks by using the move Minimize. Each time they shrink, they release a burst of electricity.

entry: POKENAME与电电虫互利共生。POKENAME给它们保护与静电，而单只电电虫较低的电荷，又能放大POKENAME潜在的放电量。
author: secondunit
source: POKENAME have a mutualistic relationship with Joltik. POKENAME provide protection and a source of static for the Joltik, while the Joltik's relatively low individual charge amplifies POKENAME's potential electrical output.

entry: 缠绕的藤丛遮护POKENAME身体。它在藤上涂黏性导电丝网，既能捉食，也方便释放电属性攻击。
author: chibitales
source: The bundle of tangling vines conceals POKENAME's body as protection. It coats these vines in a sticky, conductive webbing, allowing it to catch prey with them and discharge Electric-type attacks easily.

entry: POKENAME没有强毒，改用尾针电击来犯者。可刺一次，电力就得花时间恢复。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME lacks strong poison, instead using the stinger on its tail to deliver a potent jolt to any would-be attackers. It takes some time to recover its electric power after a single sting, however.

entry: POKENAME成群受惊，就雷光一闪地逃走，常留下少量雷击石。宝石收藏家与珠宝匠便故意吓它们，收集贵重的玻璃。
author: vic1312
source: When frightened, packs of POKENAME will take off with a crack of lightning, often leaving small deposits of fulgurite in their wake. Gem collectors and jewelry makers will scare groups of POKENAME on purpose to collect the valuable glass.

entry: POKENAME小得很，潜入电脑也难看见。好在吃的数据极少，算是无害。
author: sk372
source: Extremely tiny, it's difficult to see POKENAME when it invades a person's computer. Fortunately, the amount of data it consumes is minimal, so it is rather harmless.

entry: 大洪水后常见它们，攀住湿电线，吸吮导电的铜。却不是为了养分，单纯就爱舌头挨电的感觉。
author: teatedtiten
source: Commonly sighted after harsh floods, these Pokémon will latch onto wet wires and suck on the conductive copper. They do not gain any nutrition from doing this; it is done because they enjoy getting their tongue shocked.

entry: POKENAME两柄镰尖一碰，便生出火花与小股电流。狩猎遇见更大宝可梦，就想借此威吓。
author: sk372
source: Tapping the tips of POKENAME's scythes together creates sparks and small bursts of electricity. It uses this ability to try and intimidate larger Pokémon that come across it while it hunts.

entry: POKENAME常在断路器或发电机内筑巢，吃电维生。能量又化作特殊蜂蜜，提神效果出色，常被加入能量饮料。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME commonly build their hives within breakers or generators, feeding off the electricity. They use this energy to produce a special honey, which is commonly added to energy drinks due to its energizing properties.

entry: POKENAME啃电线，吃里面流动的电。若惹出故障或小停电，就开心地咯咯笑。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME nibble on wires to consume the electricity that courses through them. If they cause a malfunction or a small blackout, they giggle in delight.

entry: 这些毛茸茸的宝可梦柔软温暖，训练家与孩子常抱着睡。可也会生出微弱静电，隔天醒来，头发便乱得很滑稽。
author: infinex21
source: These fuzzy Pokémon are so soft and warm that many Trainers and their children will cuddle with them when they sleep. Amusingly, they also produce a gentle amount of static electricity that results in very chaotic bedhead the next morning.

entry: 它们胆小，能蜷成噼啪带电的球，再用火焰推进。通常借此逃敌，可也有许多，直接像火球撞向对手。
author: infinex21
source: These timid Pokémon can curl up into a ball crackling with electricity and propelling themselves with flames. Although they typically do so in order to flee from their foes, there are plenty who will ram their foes like fireballs.

entry: POKENAME全身尖棱状的毛，始终噼啪带着静电，又温暖得很，许多收藏家十分珍视。
author: infinex21
source: The jagged fur covering a POKENAME's entire body is constantly crackling with static electricity. This fur is also incredibly warm and treasured by a good number of collectors.

entry: POKENAME小巧黏人，攀住别人轻咬，用牙吸静电充饥。可也实在享受拥抱，想掰开四条手臂，常得费些劲。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a very clingy little Pokémon. It grabs onto others in order to nip them and siphon static electricity with its fangs for sustenance, but it immensely enjoys the hugs as well, so prying all four of its arms off can require effort.

entry: POKENAME从脚放静电，震晕小虫与其他生物吞食。鸣声中，还带着鲜明的电流杂音。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME releases static electricity from its feet to jolt and stun small insects and other creatures to eat. Its chirps have a distinctly static-like tone to them.

entry: POKENAME编出特殊丝网，携带采来的众多树果。可茸丹果太苦，它们不愿捡。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME create a special webbing that helps them carry the many Berries they forage. They avoid picking up Rabuta Berries because of their bitterness.

entry: POKENAME警觉，又爱讨亲热，经常飞窜，一次静坐很少超过二十秒。训练家建议多备电池，因为POKENAME爱啃无人照看的电器。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME are highly attentive and affection-seeking. They often dart around, rarely sitting still for longer than twenty seconds at a time. Trainers suggest keeping lots of spare batteries, as POKENAME like to gnaw on unattended electronics.

entry: POKENAME咬住别的生物吸电。若吃得太多，便每隔整整五分钟，准点以小电爆释放多余能量。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME absorbs electricity from other beings via bites. If it overindulges, it releases the stored excess energy in small electric bursts every five minutes on the dot.

entry: 现代POKENAME攀上飞机，帮助自己跨地区迁徙。城市一旦泛滥，便会请岩石属性宝可梦专家来驱赶。
author: pjporwoll
source: In modern times, POKENAME latch onto airplanes to aid their migration across regions. If an urban area becomes infested with them, Rock-type Pokémon specialists are called in to help drive them off.

entry: POKENAME为好玩而飞进雷云，享受雷击。它在落雷处附近筑巢，吸取能量。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME flies into thunderclouds for fun, basking in lightning. It nests near spots where bolts have struck to absorb their energy.

entry: POKENAME栖在住家旁的电线杆上，据说能窥见附近住民的过去，可无人知道怎么做到。
author: .izik
source: Roosting atop electrical poles near homes, POKENAME is said to glimpse the pasts of those who live nearby, though no one knows how.

entry: POKENAME没有自行发电的器官，毛却能产生足够静电，施展微弱电击。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME does not have an organ to produce its own electricity, but its coat produces sufficient static for weak electric attacks.

entry: 它爱吃别的宝可梦剩下的淡味或酸食，因此很好养，尤其喜欢用餐时剩下的袋装蔬菜。
author: quackquackattack
source: It is easy to raise because it enjoys eating bland or sour food that other Pokémon leave behind. A Salad Mix left behind during meals is what it enjoys the most.

entry: POKENAME靠环境静电漂浮，偏爱往电势高处。飞行也会生静电，结果飞着飞着，就互相黏成团。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME float using ambient static charge, preferring to travel to areas with high electrical potential. They generate static as they fly and will end up clumping together as they fly.

entry: POKENAME吃电流，自然聚往雷暴频繁之地。现代却成了祸害，咬电线吸电，偶尔甚至造成停电。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME feed on electrical currents and naturally gravitate to regions with a high frequency of thunderstorms. They have become a pest in modern times as they will bite into and feed on power lines, sometimes even causing blackouts.

entry: 它是城市里不常见的祸害宝可梦，在住家附近结带电的网，通常倒无害。一被发现，就逃去别处找安全处，直到筋疲力尽。
author: bobosmith01
source: An uncommon pest Pokémon in urban areas that build typically harmless but electrically-charged webs near homes. If discovered, it will flee elsewhere for safety until it is exhausted.

entry: POKENAME以长尾收集柑橘皮碎，揉上毛发，驱退天敌。清冽柠檬香久久不散，掩住它天生携带的电荷。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME collects bits of citrus peels with its long tail, rubbing them on its fur to deter predators. The zesty lemon scent lingers, masking its natural electrical charge.

entry: POKENAME用带电丝裹住花瓣，虫宝可梦一碰便麻痹。它爬上找得到的最高结构，尽量吸收阳光。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME wraps its petals in its electrically charged silk, paralyzing any Bug Pokémon on contact. It climbs up the tallest structure it can find so it can absorb the most possible sunlight.

entry: POKENAME电击敌人前，先往对方身上浇满泥，尽可能增强导电性。等待反击时，也常在水洼玩耍。
author: .izik
source: Before shocking its foe, POKENAME drenches them in mud to maximize conductivity. It often plays in puddles while waiting to counter an attack.

entry: POKENAME是城市里不常见的祸害，在住家附近结带电的网，通常倒无害。一被发现，就逃去别处找安全处，直到筋疲力尽。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is an uncommon pest in urban areas, building typically harmless but electrically-charged webs near homes. If discovered, it will flee elsewhere for safety until it is exhausted.

entry: POKENAME把电力存进种子，放出自卫。晒太阳能产生更多电，常能见POKENAME歇在阳光下。
author: actliux
source: POKENAME stores jolts of electricity in its bulb that it unleashes to defend itself. They produce more electricity when exposed to sunlight, which POKENAME is often seen resting under.

entry: 雷暴里，POKENAME将雷电引入花苞，滋养自己。可常存得太多，身体承受不了，便剧烈放电，烧焦四周。
author: actliux
source: POKENAME can be seen during thunderstorms drawing thunderbolts into their bulb to nourish themselves. Oftentimes, they store too much electricity for them to handle, causing violent discharges that scorch their surroundings.

entry: POKENAME啃穿楼内电线吸电。办公室职员常怪灯光闪烁是线路坏了，没发现它的存在。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME gnaws through buildings' wiring to drain power. Office workers often blame flickering lights on faulty circuits, unaware of its presence.

entry: POKENAME爱恶作剧，电力不强，会像甩触手般挥动软毛打人，电得对方麻刺不适，好一会儿才散。它便咯咯笑着，浮走了。
author: sk372
source: A prankster with mild electric abilities, POKENAME will swing its fuzzy hair like tendrils and smack others, discharging enough voltage to give them lingering tingling discomfort. It then giggles at their mild inconvenience and floats away.

entry: 它吃静电，却怕大猎物痛击报复，便改黏孩子，吸他们的电，反倒惹恼了父母。
author: sk372
source: It feeds on static electricity, but is fearful of painful repercussions from larger prey. Because of this, it clings to children to take theirs, ironically earning the ire of their parents.

entry: POKENAME毛上有黏性物质，能牢牢贴住其他宝可梦，再张臂抓紧，仿佛拥抱。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME have a sticky substance on their fur that enables them to firmly attach to other Pokémon. They will hold on tightly with their arms as if hugging the other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME先在胸口铺网，再黏抱猎物。目标越挣扎想逃，越会给POKENAME毛上充静电，日后便能放出。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME places webbing on its own chest, then grabs prey in a sticky hug. By struggling to escape its grip, POKENAME's target will charge its fur with static electricity it can discharge later.

entry: 这些小小的宝可梦，常用黏滑的身体，依附在其他宝可梦身上，借此出行。背上驮着一团丝网，里面装满了压碎的坚果，留作旅途中的食物。
author: infinex21
source: These tiny Pokémon often use their slimy bodies to cling to other Pokémon in order to get around. They carry a ball of silk webbing atop their backs, which is filled with crushed up nuts to feed on during their journeys.

entry: POKENAME体内恰好能存一个字节的信息。族群会从软盘，一字节一字节地搬走数据，直到盘里什么也不剩。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can store exactly one byte of information in their body. Colonies of POKENAME take data from a floppy disk and remove it byte by byte until nothing remains on the disk.

entry: POKENAME以用电量低的设备能源为食，曾成群钻进计算器，惹出算错。究竟是故意捣乱，还是取食的失误，仍不得而知。
author: darkwolfe
source: Known to feed on energy from low-usage devices, colonies of POKENAME have been found infesting calculators. This can result in incorrect calculations, whether this is mischief on the part of POKENAME or an error caused by their feeding is unknown.

entry: POKENAME鹿角间的黏网，捉住许多小虫。POKENAME自己不吃，而是送给其他宝可梦，换取吸它们静电的许可。
author: sk372
source: The sticky webbing between POKENAME's antlers is used to catch a bevy of small insects. POKENAME itself doesn't eat them but offers them to other Pokémon in exchange for being able to suck static electricity from them.

entry: POKENAME成群觅食，彼此磨蹭充电。一有东西碰它，就排尽积电，麻痹对方，再逃跑。
author: darxer_
source: POKENAME graze in packs, rubbing against each other to charge electricity. If something touches it, it will expel all the stored electricity to paralyze its target and run away.

entry: POKENAME受电流吸引，常盘在发电机与输电塔底部。工程师得考虑它们的存在，不让电线外露，免得被咬。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are drawn to electrical currents and can be found coiling around the base of generators and electrical pylons. Engineers are advised to account for their presence, making sure no wires are exposed to prevent POKENAME from biting them.

entry: POKENAME产奶极少，却深受美食家追捧。喝过的人都说，奶酸甜、质地丝滑。
author: beetlething
source: POKENAME produce an incredibly small amount of milk that is highly sought after by gourmets. Those who have tasted the milk of POKENAME describe it as having a tangy sweetness with a silky texture.

entry: POKENAME攀住妙蛙花等大型草属性宝可梦，求取保护。宿主不介意，因为POKENAME也会照料它们身上长的植物。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME attaches itself to large Grass-type Pokémon like Venusaur for protection. These hosts don't mind, as POKENAME tends to the plants growing on their bodies in return.

entry: POKENAME攀着目标念咒，既能释放可怕诅咒，也能驱除厄运。咒文效果通过静电，传给目标。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME chants incantations that can unleash a terrible curse or ward off misfortune while clinging to its target. The effect of the incantation is passed to its target through static electricity.

entry: POKENAME懒懒织网，躺着等睡醒前有食物落网。等不到，就弃网重来。人们只好往网里留食，免它不断另结新网，把周围弄乱。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME lazily spins webs to rest in and hope that food gets caught before it wakes, abandoning the web if this tactic fails. People leave spare food in its webs to keep it from causing a mess by creating too many additional ones.

entry: POKENAME悄悄接近，轻咬别人，吸点静电维生。咬着不怎么痛，可能量被抽走后，有些对象会微微发冷，一个小时左右才散。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME sneaks up on others to nip them and siphon a bit of static electricity for sustenance. The bite is relatively painless, though the energy drain can leave some suffering from slight chills for an hour or so.

entry: 科学家常把POKENAME当祸害，有些老师却故意带去校园展会，放进电力作品，复查电池是否没电、线路是否坏了。发现问题，就会啪地大响一声。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: While often considered a pest by scientists, some teachers intentionally bring POKENAME to school fairs. They are released into electrical projects to double-check any dead batteries or faulty wiring, making a loud popping sound upon finding one.

entry: POKENAME边舞边从手吐出丝线，优雅织网。爱艺术的训练家，很喜欢比较各自POKENAME织出的花纹。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME spins silky threads from its hands as it dances, forming webs in elegant motion. Artistically-inclined Trainers enjoy comparing the web patterns made by their POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME附在小种子上，以静电吸来绒絮与毛，借这临时平台，乘风漂起。若一直不被打扰，电荷会积到危险的程度。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME attach themselves to small seeds and use static electricity to attract fluff and fur to the seeds, catching the breeze and floating on their makeshift platforms. If left undisturbed, the charge builds up to a dangerous degree.

entry: POKENAME附在小种子上，以静电吸来绒絮与毛，借这临时平台，乘风漂起。若一直不被打扰，电荷会积到危险的程度。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME attach themselves to small seeds and use static electricity to attract fluff and fur to the seeds, catching the breeze and floating on their makeshift platforms. If left undisturbed, the charge builds up to a dangerous degree.

entry: POKENAME把电存进水晶，用于战斗。电量耗尽，就躲回晶体歇息，重新充电。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME stores electricity within its crystal to use in combat. When the charge is exhausted, it rests inside the crystal to recharge.

entry: POKENAME背花不断发电，触摸有害。战斗时，它们将花中的电力塑成强雷击。
author: actliux
source: The flower on POKENAME's back constantly generates electricity, making it harmful to touch. During battle, they can be seen shaping the electricity from this flower into powerful thunderbolts.

entry: POKENAME温顺，头上有腿形的角，覆着蓄静电的毛。它们常用四条小肢，将电丝织成好玩的形状。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are docile Pokémon with a leg-like horn atop their heads, which is clad in fur that is charged with static electricity. They often weave their electric threads into playful shapes using their four small limbs.

entry: POKENAME发出精准电脉冲，干扰神经信号。接触太久，受害者的感知会被改变，逐渐认它为神。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME emits precise electrical pulses that interfere with neural signals. Prolonged exposure can manipulate victims into thinking it is a deity through altered perception.

entry: 电电虫住在POKENAME背上的网里，吃黏住的猎物。它们不停活动，又为POKENAME产生能量。
author: hophoppip
source: Joltik live on the web on POKENAME's back, consuming prey that gets stuck in the silk. The constant movement of the Joltik generates energy for POKENAME.

entry: 它用角袭击小型猎物，以特殊毒液夺取能量，储存在体内，再化作电力自卫。
author: skymaster426
source: It attacks small prey with its horn, sapping their energy with a special poison it secretes. It then stores the energy in its body to convert into electricity for defense.

entry: POKENAME刺伤受害者后，便吸收其体内的生物电，增强攻击。大型电宝可梦，能给它最多的能量。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME consumes the bioelectricity of victims it stabs to power up its attacks. It gains the most energy from large, Electric-type Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME刺伤受害者后，便吸收其体内的生物电，增强攻击。大型电宝可梦，能给它最多的能量。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME consumes the bioelectricity of victims it stabs to power up its attacks. It gains the most energy from large, Electric-type Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME的毛看着软，抚摸却会被细刺扎得难受。刺毛没有毒，有毒的是角。
author: cait_sith
source: Although its hairs seem soft, petting a POKENAME will result in irritating microscopic stings. The stinging hairs are not venomous, but POKENAME's horn is.

entry: POKENAME不能自己发电，主要靠毛下毒刺威慑来敌。找到电线、变压器等电源，就把角扎进去充电。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME cannot generate its own electricity and mostly relies on the poisonous spines beneath its fur to discourage attacks. If it finds a source of electricity such as a power line or transformer, it will plunge its horn in to charge itself up.

entry: 它在河湖织大而坚韧的网，用嘴叼作渔网，再以静电把自己固定水底。
author: bandedbodypress
source: It spins large, durable webs in rivers and lakes, holding them in its mouth as a fishing net. It anchors itself to the bottom of lakes and rivers using static electricity.

entry: POKENAME用飘带般的器官精准电击，能找到对手最弱的部位下手，本领离奇。
author: infinex21
source: Using their ribbon-like organs, POKENAME deliver precise electric shocks. They display an uncanny capability to deliver electric shocks where their opponents are weakest.

entry: POKENAME个头小，却守着跨越好几英里的大领地。它以尖细怒吼挑战来者，挥小臂，想吓走对方。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Despite their small size, POKENAME maintain a large territory that can be multiple miles in size. They challenge intruders with high-pitched roars, swinging at them with their tiny arms to scare them away.

entry: 别因POKENAME个小就低估它。跳跃灵活，炮口射出的雷电，也足以击昏结实的岩石属性宝可梦。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME should not be underestimated because of its small size. It is highly agile with its jumping ability, and the bolts of lightning fired from its cannon are potent enough to knock even sturdy Rock-type Pokémon unconscious.

entry: POKENAME能自己发电，不必再吸别的宝可梦的静电。常能见POKENAME被电电虫围住，喂它们所需的电。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: With their ability to generate their own electricity, POKENAME do not have to rely on absorbing static off of other Pokémon. POKENAME can be found surrounded by Joltik, feeding them the electricity they need.

entry: POKENAME柔软蓬松的毛发储着能量，微微作响。在地面蹦跳时，静电不断积攒，让毛间噼啪迸出电火花。
author: rakunk
source: POKENAME is covered in soft fluffy fur that hums with stored energy. As it jumps across the ground, static builds up, causing its fur to crackle and spark.

entry: POKENAME会附在人类或其他宝可梦身上，慢慢吸取生命能量。一旦黏住猎物，就很难再剥下POKENAME。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME attaches itself to other Pokémon or humans to slowly drain their life energy. It is difficult to detach POKENAME from the prey once attached.

entry: POKENAME藏在玻璃身体里保护自己，也把它当作发电机供能。因此能像手臂般操纵丝线，甚至拿来当腿走路。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME protects itself behind a glass body, which it also uses as a dynamo to produce electricity. Thanks to this, it can control its threads like arms and even use them as legs to move around.

entry: POKENAME常聚发电厂，吃剩余废电。也不介意顺手偷走工人留下、还吃得了的垃圾。
author: milchik
source: POKENAME often gather around power plants to consume the leftover electric waste. They don't seem to mind stealing edible garbage left by the plant workers either.

entry: POKENAME住水下，在体内织网。捕猎时从口中吐出，一兜住东西，就立刻收回。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME lives underwater, spinning webbing inside its body. To capture prey, it can spit this webbing out of its mouth, then pull it back in as soon as it traps something.

entry: 软尾互相摩擦，就能产生惊人的静电。POKENAME天天清洁，因为带电的毛，总会吸来细粒与小物。
author: milchik
source: This Pokémon generates an impressive amount of static electricity by rubbing its fluffy tails against one another. POKENAME cleans itself every day, since its charged fur attracts small particles and objects all the time.

entry: POKENAME守在树根，吸收土中养分，等待进化。谁一打扰，它就快振双翼，激起四周一阵电火花。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME stays near tree roots, gathering nutrients from the soil while waiting for evolution. Should anything disturb it, it flaps its wings rapidly, creating showers of electric sparks around it.

entry: POKENAME在柳树下打盹，偶尔释放电击，阻止好奇的宝可梦靠近。
author: .izik
source: While napping beneath willow trees, POKENAME occasionally releases jolts of electricity. This deters curious Pokémon from approaching.

entry: POKENAME聚在电线电器旁，吃里面的电流。它们破坏设备，又难驱除，谁来打扰，就唱歌催眠。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME cluster together around electrical wires and appliances, feeding off the currents running through them. Their presence is destructive, but removing them can prove difficult, as they will sing people to sleep should they try to disturb them.

entry: POKENAME得到进化所需的电荷与矿物，就开始漫长休眠。有人甚至见它吃掉汽车电池，自己顶替其位置，直到进化才被发现。
author: mirkinator
source: POKENAME undergoes a lengthy hibernation process after obtaining the electric charge and minerals required for evolution. Some have even been found to eat and take the place of car batteries, going unnoticed until evolution.

entry: 发电器官发育不足，电力只够让POKENAME彼此用静电黏住。大风暴后，常有多只POKENAME聚成团，堵住水道。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Its underdeveloped electricity-producing organ is only capable of making POKENAME attach to each other with static electricity. After strong storms, multiple POKENAME can be found in clusters, damming waterways.

entry: POKENAME攀在发电厂，不断裹丝，网又重又黏，谁也挪不动，便能把产生的电力，一点不剩地吸走。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME continuously wraps itself in silk while clinging onto a power plant. This lets it absorb every last bit of electricity generated, as the weight and stickiness of the webs make it impossible for it to be moved.

entry: POKENAME纺出金属丝，连着身体时，噼啪满是能量。一断开，电荷就很快散了。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spins metallic silk that crackles with energy while still attached to its body. Once severed, the charge fades quickly.

entry: POKENAME以幻象装成林中走失的幼童。人一近，先电麻，再用网裹起，留待以后吃。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses illusions to pose as a lost toddler in the woods. When a person draws close, it paralyzes them with an electric shock before wrapping them in webs to consume later.

entry: POKENAME常在虫类繁多的地方结网。蛛网导电性极佳，它能沿丝线放电，灼烧猎物。
author: skymaster426
source: POKENAME can be found spinning webs in areas populated by bugs. Its webs are very conductive, so it can send a shock through the string to burn prey.

entry: POKENAME吸入空气，体形能胀到四倍，主要用来吓退天敌。可小丑界也有它独特的岗位：替气球吹气。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are capable of inhaling air to quadruple their size. They mainly utilize this talent to scare away predators, though they have a unique niche among clowns where they blow air into balloons.

entry: POKENAME将特殊的肢体折成花苞状。猎物靠近，POKENAME便伸肢抓住，再用毒制服。
author: alumed
source: POKENAME fold their specialized limbs into a form that resembles the bud of a flower. When their prey approach, POKENAME will use these limbs to grasp the target and subdue them with their poison.

entry: 雷暴中常见POKENAME，以带电的毛引来雷击。别抓它的手臂，否则毫无预警就会挨电。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME can be found during thunderstorms, using its charged hairs to draw in lightning strikes. Do not try to grab its arms or it will shock you without warning.

entry: POKENAME蹭人类与其他宝可梦，产生静电。若不喜欢的对象抓住细线，它便一次放光，狠狠电对方。
author: bacondlx
source: POKENAME rubs against people and other Pokémon to generate static electricity. If someone it dislikes tries to grab its strings, it expels all the static at once to give them a large shock.

entry: POKENAME吸别人的静电维生，再把部分多余电力存入耳尖，让攻击添上电劲。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME drains static electricity from others for sustenance. It stores some of the excess in the tips of its ears, giving its strikes an extra bit of electrical strength.

entry: POKENAME在电线杆周围撒孢子。孢子与静电混在一起，让飞行宝可梦很不安全。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME scatters spores around telephone poles. The mix of spores and static makes the area unsafe for flying Pokémon.

entry: 雷暴中，POKENAME高飘天际，穿过云层，绒身噼啪迸着静电。
author: .izik
source: During thunderstorms, POKENAME floats high into the sky. Its fuzzy body crackles with static as it soars through the clouds.

entry: POKENAME凶猛飞向目标，想吸血饱餐。可吃饱所需极少，除了咬时微痛，人们便觉得它无害。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME aggressively flies at targets, aiming to feast on blood. The amount of blood it consumes to be full is so minuscule, people regard it as harmless aside from the slight pinch of its bite.

entry: POKENAME悠悠浮过遗迹，织出奇特纹样的网。网极黏，连碎屑也能牢牢挂住数月。
author: .izik
source: Floating gently through ruins, POKENAME spins webs in strange patterns. The webbing is extremely sticky and is able to hold debris for months.

entry: 吸收了电气石洞穴一块水晶的能量后，POKENAME长得庞大无比，却仍带着那块水晶，走到哪里也不放下。
author: nellnast42
source: After absorbing energy from a crystal from Chargestone Cave, POKENAME has grown to enormous sizes. It still carries around this crystal, though.

entry: 这种POKENAME小得极端，很难好好研究。人们认为它吃微生物，身形虽小，却仍能让某些设备短路。
author: chibitales
source: This variant of POKENAME is extremely miniscule, making it difficult to study properly. It is thought to subsist on microscopic organisms. Despite its size, it is able to cause short-circuits in some devices.

entry: POKENAME比普通电电虫还小，发电量却近乎两倍。它等在草尖，有东西走过，就攀上，吸取积蓄的静电。
author: chibitales
source: Although smaller than normal Joltik, POKENAME's electrical output is near-doubled. It waits on the tips of grass blades for something to walk by, attaching to it and absorbing any built-up static electricity.

entry: 电电虫以自身电力，增强共生POKENAME的能量。POKENAME则在永不停息的旅途中，寻找可吸收的能源。
author: pjporwoll
source: The Joltik enhances the symbiotic POKENAME's energy with its electricity. The POKENAME seeks out energy sources to absorb on its never-ending journey.

entry: POKENAME群居，通常守着满是数百颗大水晶的洞穴。最强的POKENAME，就是胸前红宝石最大的那些。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME live in groups, usually guarding their caves filled with hundreds of large crystals. The most powerful POKENAME are the ones with the largest red gem on their chest.

entry: POKENAME以黏丝困住刺球仙人掌等猎物，再喷火，常留下焦网与烧黑的空壳。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME traps prey such as Cacnea in sticky silk before blasting them with fire. It often leaves behind scorched webs and charred husks.

entry: POKENAME常黏住电器，吸尽能源，被视为麻烦，城市尤其如此。人们便设置发电机，作专门的喂食区。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is often found latched onto and draining electrical devices of their energy. It is considered a nuisance, especially in urban areas, so generators have been set up to act as feeding zones.

entry: POKENAME给猎物注毒，再用带电的电网困住。它偏爱从上方快速突击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME injects venom into prey, then traps them with a charged Electro Web. It prefers to strike quickly and from above.

entry: POKENAME高速旋转，让壳上积起静电，再突然嗡地爆响，放出。
author: .izik
source: While spinning at high speed, POKENAME builds static across its shell. It releases the charge with a sudden, buzzing pop.

entry: POKENAME以爪抓住别人，注入麻痹毒，吸取静电。可毒不强，吸得又极少，因此POKENAME远没看着那么致命。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME grabs onto others with its claws, immobilizing them with paralytic venom and draining static electricity from them. Its poison is mild, and the amount it drains is still minuscule, so POKENAME is far less lethal than it appears.

entry: POKENAME胆小，藏在土里，盼叶片的微弱电荷能让人别来烦。若还是被拔出土，眼里便哭出小火花。
author: sk372
source: Timid by nature, POKENAME hides underground and hopes the weak electric charge in its leaves will dissuade others from bothering it. If plucked from the dirt regardless, it cries tiny sparks from its eyes.

entry: POKENAME漫浮墓园，闪着细碎静电，深夜照亮墓碑。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME drifts aimlessly through graveyards, sparking with flickers of static. Its eerie flashes light up tombstones late at night.

entry: 据说POKENAME会为迷路孩子照路，引他们穿过森林。有人说，它只想确保别人不再遭自己曾经的命运。
author: cassimari
source: POKENAME is said to be a helpful light, guiding lost children through the forest. Some say it does this to ensure no one else suffers the same fate it once did.

entry: POKENAME在雪松筑巢，风暴中吸取近处落雷。有些人相信，它以此守护森林。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME builds nests in cedar trees and absorbs nearby lightning during storms. Some believe it protects the forest this way.

entry: POKENAME头上的花苞，每早存进阳光。它休息时，内部能量就渐渐化作电荷。
author: .izik
source: The flower bulbs on POKENAME's head store sunlight each morning. As it rests, the energy inside slowly builds into electrical charge.

entry: 它用翅膀摩擦毛茸茸的身体，积攒静电，再以耳朵引导电流，释放强劲的电磁波。
author: staghorn
source: It builds up static electricity by brushing its wings against its furry body. It can unleash its built-up charge in a powerful Thunder Wave by directing the electrical discharge with its ears.

entry: POKENAME飞穿风暴云，双翼噼啪带电。棉絮绒羽，能将雷电存上数小时。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's wings crackle with static as it flies through storm clouds. Its cottony down can store lightning for hours.

entry: 传说，最早的POKENAME来自一只攀上皮卡丘的电电虫。皮卡丘放雷赶它，却把它轰向毫无戒心的雷吉艾斯。至今，它们似乎仍怕皮卡丘。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Legends claim that the first known POKENAME formed when a Joltik had attached itself to a Pikachu. The Pikachu used a thunderbolt to dislodge it, which caused it to hurtle into an unsuspecting Regice. To this day they seem to be wary of Pikachu.

entry: POKENAME体内软棉互相摩擦，产生静电，存进毛里，等战斗取用。
author: .izik
source: The soft cotton in POKENAME's body rubs together, creating static. It stores the charge in its fur until needed in battle.

entry: 小型宝可梦在POKENAME体内织网，借此栖身。它众多眼睛始终留意四周，仔细照看住客。
author: darxer_
source: Smaller Pokémon weave webs within POKENAME and use it as shelter. Its multitude of eyes are always aware of its surroundings, and watch over its inhabitants closely.

entry: POKENAME兴奋时，毛间会生出静电。它爱玩，很讨主人喜欢，但抚摸时得小心，免得冷不防挨一下电击。
author: h0bojoe
source: POKENAME generates static electricity in its fur when excited. Its playful nature makes it a beloved pet, but owners must be careful when petting it or they may get an unexpected shock.

entry: 训练得当的POKENAME，是训练家最忠实的伙伴之一。不听话的却常无视指令，偷插座和家用电器里的电来取乐。
author: h0bojoe
source: Well-trained POKENAME are among the most loyal companions a Trainer can have. However, disobedient ones often ignore orders and steal electricity from outlets or household devices for their own amusement.

entry: POKENAME背上的网像捕梦网。它停在敞开的卧室窗沿上，似乎在捕捉空中闪亮的微粒，清晨全吃下后便飘走。
author: .jerden
source: The web on POKENAME's back resembles a dreamcatcher. POKENAME perches on the ledge of open bedroom windows and seems to catch shiny particles from the air. It will eat them all in the morning, then float away.

entry: POKENAME会依偎睡不安稳的人，只要不受打扰，就能让对方一觉睡到天亮。被它抱住的人仍整夜翻来覆去，为它充上静电。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME seeks restless sleepers to cuddle up to, preventing them from waking until morning as long as they are undisturbed. The people they cling to still toss and turn all night, charging POKENAME with static electricity.

entry: POKENAME用电击打昏猎物后，便站到猎物身上，留下一团团孢子。这样能在同类赶来进食前，让猎物保持新鲜。
author: .izik
source: Once POKENAME stuns prey with a jolt of electricity, it stands over them and leaves behind clouds of spores on the body. This helps preserve the prey before its kin arrive to feed.

entry: POKENAME成群聚在风力发电机旁，吸食周围的电荷。一被发现，就四散而逃。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME swarms gather near wind turbines, feeding off the ambient charge. When spotted, they scatter in every direction.

entry: POKENAME设下带电的丝网陷阱，防止猎物逃脱，将其耗到足以吞食。丝网鲜亮的蓝色，很受时装公司青睐。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: To ensure prey doesn't escape, POKENAME set up traps of electrified webbing to wear them down enough for consumption. This webbing is highly sought out by fashion companies for its bright blue hue.

entry: POKENAME用毛吸收阳光，将其转成电。凡是游荡到身边的，都会挨电击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME absorbs sunlight through its fur, converting it into electricity. It shocks anything that wanders too close.

entry: POKENAME幼时结成小群，共享电源。长大后渐渐独立，偶尔甚至会为守住电力充沛的领地，赶走自己的家人。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME live together in small groups when they are young, sharing electricity sources amongst one another. As they grow older, they grow more independent. Rarely, they may even fight off their own family to protect their electric-laden territory.

entry: 常能看到POKENAME依附在火神蛾等大型火属性宝可梦身上，靠它们的热量获取能量。它很难自行生火，生存有赖于这种关系。
author: theartemis1
source: POKENAME is often seen clinging to larger Fire-type Pokémon like Volcarona, drawing on their heat for energy. It relies on this relationship for survival, as it is unable to easily generate fire on its own.

entry: 常能看到POKENAME依附在火神蛾等大型火属性宝可梦身上，靠它们的热量获取能量。它很难自行生火，生存有赖于这种关系。
author: theartemis1
source: POKENAME is often seen clinging to larger Fire-type Pokémon like Volcarona, drawing on their heat for energy. It relies on this relationship for survival, as it is unable to easily generate fire on its own.

entry: POKENAME的毛散发着金南果腐烂的臭味。受威胁时，会从体内释放强劲电流。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's fur reeks of rotting Pumpkin Berries. When threatened, it unleashes a powerful electric blast from its body.

entry: 夜里，POKENAME在城市公园的路灯旁盘旋，偷偷吸电，令灯光莫名闪烁。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME hovers near light poles in city parks at night. It siphons off electricity, leaving the lamps to flicker mysteriously.

entry: POKENAME吐的丝带有微弱电荷。到了秋天，毛间便会散发浓浓的金南果气味。
author: .izik
source: The silk spun from POKENAME's body carries a light electric charge. Its fur smells strongly of Pumpkin Berries in autumn.

entry: 静电吸得越多，POKENAME蓬松的身体就带电越多，尝起来也越酸。它不停轻咬其他生物吸电，让绒毛的电击和滋味吓退天敌。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's fluffy body becomes more electrified and more sour in taste the more static electricity it absorbs. It constantly nibbles on others to drain them, so that the shock and flavor of its fuzz will repel predators.

entry: POKENAME会使出带电的强力头锤，赶走一切靠近巢穴的生物。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME delivers powerful headbutts charged with electricity. It uses them to drive off anything that nears its den.

entry: POKENAME的毛始终带着静电，根根竖立。毛对气流十分敏感，很难趁它不备偷袭。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME fur carries a constant static charge, making their fur stand on end at all times. Their fur is very sensitive to air movements, making them difficult to catch off-guard.

entry: POKENAME啃食电缆，常在高大的输电塔上进食。聚得太多会引发停电，它们往往因此大发雷霆，开始破坏脚下的电塔。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME feed on electrical cables and can often be seen feeding atop large pylons. Large populations of POKENAME can cause blackouts, often leading them to fly into a rage and start destroying the pylon they're feeding on.

entry: 放电前，POKENAME会将细根扎进地面，既能稳稳接地，也能增强攻击。
author: .izik
source: Before unleashing electricity, POKENAME digs its tiny roots into the ground. This helps it stay grounded and boosts its attack.

entry: 夜里，POKENAME静静飘过城市街道，从交通灯和配电箱吸电，补充能量。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME floats quietly through city streets at night. It draws electricity from traffic lights and power boxes to stay energized.

entry: 雷雨中，POKENAME会举起木棍指向天空。有人说，它在引雷储存，以备日后使用。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME raises its stick toward the sky during lightning storms. Some say it draws in thunderbolts to store for later use.

entry: POKENAME结的网黏稠无比。丝上裹着一层胶状薄膜，帮助导电，更容易把猎物电得动弹不得。
author: sk372
source: The webs that POKENAME creates are incredibly sticky and rather viscous. The layer of goop-like film around the threads helps conduct electricity, letting it more easily shock prey into submission.

entry: POKENAME闯进民宅，窃取住户身上的养分。它吃的是静电，除了偶尔有细微杂音、头发竖起，倒不会伤害住户。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME haunts households in order to steal its nourishment from the victims within. It feasts on static electricity, so it's harmless to the residents aside from faint static noises and one's hair standing on end at times.

entry: POKENAME让大批目标睡着，方便吸食他们身上的静电。被吸食的人常说，梦里出现了蜘蛛、闪电，或两者交织的景象。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME puts large swaths of targets to sleep so it can more easily take static electricity from their bodies to feast on. The victims being fed on often report dreaming of spiders, lightning, or some combination thereof.

entry: POKENAME将带电的丝编成发光、迸着电火花的摆锤。既能催眠敌人，也能将不易进入恍惚状态的对手电得麻痹。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME weaves strands of electrified silk into a glowing, sparking pendulum. This pendulum is useful for both lulling foes into hypnosis and delivering paralyzing shocks to those who don't fall into trances easily.

entry: POKENAME一边硬扛攻击，一边投出吸取对手活力的种子迎战。它还可吸出病人体内的有毒金属，吸收并化解毒物，有独特的药用价值。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME fights foes by throwing seeds that leech vitality from its opponents and enduring attacks. POKENAME has a unique medicinal use where it sucks out toxic metals from sick people, absorbing and neutralizing the toxic materials.

entry: POKENAME用尖刺钉住洞壁，吸收矿物。受到攻击便会自爆，将尖刺炸向四面八方。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME use their spikes to stick to cave walls, absorbing minerals. When attacked, they self-destruct, sending spikes flying in all directions.

entry: 休息时，六个蛋状部位中的一个会长出藤蔓，与其余部位相连，在各段之间输送养分。
author: .izik
source: When it rests, vines grow from one of its six egg-like portions, connecting to the others. These vines transfer nutrients between the segments.

entry: POKENAME从头部放出恶臭驱赶天敌。若遭攻击，便将头砸向对方，尖刺连最坚硬的护甲也能刺穿。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME release a foul scent from their heads to ward off predators. If attacked, they will drop their heads onto the attacker, their spikes able to pierce even the toughest armor.

entry: 两只POKENAME相遇，谁也拦不住它们打架。甲壳极耐钝击，因此一打往往就是好几个星期。
author: gdottb
source: When two POKENAME meet, it is impossible to stop the two from engaging in combat. Their shells are highly resistant to blunt force, meaning their brawls often last weeks at a time.

entry: POKENAME的金属外骨骼，能挡住几乎所有身体攻击。它藏在洞里积攒进化所需的能量。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's metallic exoskeleton protects it from nearly any physical attack. It hides away in caves as it gathers energy to evolve.

entry: 遇险便蜷起身体，伸出周身的刺。雷雨时，鼻上的刺会伸长，吸收雷击的电力。
author: .izik
source: When in danger, it curls up and extends the thorns around its body. During lightning storms, the thorn on its nose extends to absorb electricity from lightning strikes.

entry: 谁若靠近它的幼崽，它便从尾部甩出成千上万根细针。这些针刺得人痛苦不堪，驱赶效果很好。
author: .izik
source: If anyone approaches its young, it flings thousands of tiny needles from its tail. These projectiles create a painful and effective deterrent.

entry: 它用利刃刮下洞壁的苔藓充饥，靠这简单的食物，在严酷的地下环境中生存。
author: .izik
source: It uses its sharp blades to cut moss off cave walls to eat. This simple diet sustains it in harsh underground environments.

entry: 树汁吃得越多，POKENAME的金属壳就越坚固。它用锋利的钳子切开树木，取出汁液。
author: .izik
source: The more sap it consumes, the stronger POKENAME's metallic shell becomes. It uses sharp pincers to cut into trees and extract the liquid.

entry: POKENAME钻进厨余粉碎机，吸收找到的各种残渣。若两周不摄取液体，身体就会开始变硬。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME slips into garbage disposals, absorbing any debris it finds. If it goes two weeks without liquids, its body begins to harden.

entry: POKENAME必须让皮肤保持适当湿润，身体才能正常活动。皮肤过干除了可能损害健康，还可能让尖刺不受控制地突然射出，伤到旁人。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME needs to keep its skin properly moisturized to function properly. Aside from possible health problems, its skin drying out too much could cause its spines to suddenly and involuntarily launch out and hurt someone.

entry: 它无法自由活动，靠钢壳上的毒刺护身。若被其他宝可梦惹急了，POKENAME就会将尖刺如弹雨般射向四周。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its steel shell is lined with venomous spines, it relies on for protection, since it cannot move freely. If a Pokémon provokes it enough, POKENAME launches those spines outward in all directions like a volley of projectiles.

entry: POKENAME是凶猛的捕食者，强劲的双颚连最硬的岩石也能咬碎。一发现猎物，便发射满身的绿刺，从上空毫不留情地将其击倒。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is a ferocious predator that can crush even the hardest rock in its powerful jaws. When it spots prey, it launches the green spikes covering its body to mercilessly strike it down from above.

entry: POKENAME趴在养分丰富的地方，用坚韧的倒刺吸收养分。防身时会使出泰山压顶，刺穿并压扁敌人。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME lay belly-down in nutrient-rich areas, absorbing said nutrients through their tough barbs. To defend themselves, they will use Body Slam attacks that skewer and crush their foes.

entry: POKENAME得不停玩耍，才能让超能力保持稳定。太久没玩，压力积得过大，便会爆燃，威力足以夷平一个街区。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME constantly needs to play to keep its psychic energy in check. If it goes too long without playing and grows too stressed, it will combust with enough force to level a city block.

entry: 它的双眼能各自转动，轻松扫视四周。靠着金属脚，能整整旋转360度。
author: .izik
source: Its eyes can move independently, scanning its surroundings with ease. It can rotate a full 360 degrees on its metallic foot.

entry: 它把尾巴当重槌挥舞，打击力惊人。只需一下，就能轻易击倒一棵雪松。
author: .izik
source: It swings its tail like a maul, delivering devastating blows. With a single hit, it can topple a cedar tree effortlessly.

entry: POKENAME在林中藏身时若被发现，便会抡起带刺的金属头猛砸。雨天会把头埋进地下，以免生锈。
author: .izik
source: When spotted while hiding in the forest, POKENAME swings its spiked metallic head like a maul to attack. It hides the head underground during rain to avoid rusting.

entry: POKENAME总爱一动不动，却能把手上的刺球当手里剑扔出防身。扔出的球，几小时就能再长出来。
author: sk372
source: Though it prefers to remain motionless at all times, POKENAME can defend itself by throwing the spiked orbs on its hands akin to shuriken. The thrown orbs grow back in a few hours.

entry: 它挥动尾尖的刺球守卫领地。雨天，POKENAME会藏进树木深处，防止金属身体生锈。
author: fiordaliso
source: It defends its territory by swinging the spiked ball at the tip of its tail. To prevent its metallic body from rusting, POKENAME remains hidden deep within its tree during rainy days.

entry: 头上的刺能延伸成藤蔓，刺入树枝，将它拉上去。它常依偎枝间，安然熟睡。
author: .izik
source: The thorns on its head extend into vines that pierce tree limbs, allowing it to reel itself up. It often sleeps peacefully nestled in the branches.

entry: 加速飞行时，它像护目镜的双眼会泛起金光。直线飞行能轻松超过每小时100英里。
author: .izik
source: Its goggle-like eyes glow gold as it accelerates in flight. In a straight line, it can reach speeds over 100 mph with ease.

entry: POKENAME攀在崖脚洞口的岩石上，吃涨潮冲来的海藻。刺里有轻微的镇静成分，有些训练家会养它助眠。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME cling onto rocks at the mouth of caves in the foot of cliffs, eating seaweed that washes up at high tide. Their spikes contain a mild sedative, so some Trainers keep them to help them sleep.

entry: 它会从空中俯冲袭击一切靠近巢穴的生物。头部像头盔的部位十分坚硬，足以撞碎巨石。
author: .izik
source: While flying, it divebombs anyone who approaches its nest. The helmet-like portion of its head is strong enough to smash boulders.

entry: POKENAME戴着满是锐刺的尖冠。刺扎进头骨，引起的疼痛反而增强了它的超能力。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME has a sharp crown that is covered with sharp thorns. These thorns dig into its skull, and the resulting pain enhances its psychic power.

entry: POKENAME带刺的金属倒钩，一旦扎进其他宝可梦就会折断。脱离身体后，倒钩便会释放毒液，令对方发烧、瘙痒。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have prickly metallic barbs that break off whenever they get lodged into another Pokémon. Once separated from their body, these barbs release venom that causes fevers and itchiness.

entry: POKENAME金属身体里镶着的宝石，放出诡异的力量，使它能浮起来。它潜伏在废弃工厂，吸收残余能量维生。
author: .izik
source: The gems embedded in POKENAME's metallic body emit a strange, eerie power that lets it float. It lurks in abandoned factories, absorbing residual energy to sustain itself.

entry: POKENAME住在古代文明遗留、长满苔藓的遗迹里，吃古老壁画上的苔藓。有人推测，它们曾采集这些特殊苔藓，供女巫熬制药剂。
author: reese1017600
source: POKENAME lives in moss-covered ruins of ancient civilizations, eating the growth that covers old wall paintings. They were theorized to have collected this special moss for witches to use in their brews.

entry: POKENAME会从空中撒下数十根刺防身。若劳累过度，就退回巢中，休息很久。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME scatters dozens of thorns onto the ground from the skies to defend itself.  If it overworks itself, it will retreat to its nest and rest for a long period of time.

entry: POKENAME采到树果，就用刺攀住洞顶或高处岩沿，开始酿果汁。多余的果汁可能滴落，洒在下方经过的旅人身上。
author: sk372
source: Once POKENAME has collected a berry, it uses spines to cling to a cave ceiling or high ledge to begin creating juice. Excess juice from the process may drip down on travelers passing beneath it.

entry: 角的绿色部位覆着微小倒刺。它会用巨力将倒刺甩出，扎得猎物疼痛不堪。
author: .izik
source: The green portion of its horn is covered in microscopic barbs. These barbs stick painfully into prey after it throws them with immense force.

entry: POKENAME是路边的害兽，能用黏滑的腹足直接吸收食物中必需的矿物。人造沥青的矿物含量更高，吃沥青的个体，甲壳也更坚硬。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME are pests living along roadways that absorb minerals essential to their diets directly through their slimy foot. POKENAME who consume asphalt have stronger shells due to the higher concentrations of minerals in the human-made material.

entry: POKENAME的腹面与角全覆满苔藓。这种苔藓与它共生，替它防锈，作为回报，POKENAME将苔藓及其孢子带到新的栖地。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME's underside and horns are completely covered in moss. This particular species of moss has a symbiotic relationship with POKENAME, providing protection against rust in exchange for POKENAME taking the moss and its spores to new habitats.

entry: POKENAME尾内的种子会沙沙作响，赶走不怕尖刺的天敌。健康的个体在尾节装满种子后，会让那段尾节脱落；里面的种子可拿来制成草本香水。
author: pjporwoll
source: The seeds within POKENAME's tail create a rattling sound to ward off predators not deterred by its spikes. A healthy POKENAME sheds tail sections when they become too full of seeds, allowing the seeds to be used in herbal scented perfumes.

entry: POKENAME会蜷成刺球防身，也会这样跟同类玩耍。每当它扬鼻鸣叫，满身的刺便扭动震颤。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME curls into a spiked ball both as a form of self-defense and to play amongst its own kind. The spines on its body wiggle and vibrate whenever it trumpets.

entry: 手臂与躯干上的金环，帮助它集中力量。借此增幅，一拳便能打穿实心钢板。
author: .izik
source: The gold bands around its arms and torso help it focus its strength. With this enhancement, it can punch through solid steel.

entry: POKENAME在喉囊里储存荆棘种子，遇上猎物或威胁，便发射种子将其打昏。它主要捕猎可可多拉这类兽形的岩石属性宝可梦，也肯将就吃小拳石这类更像矿石的。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME stores briar seeds in an internal sac in its throat, from which it can fire them to stun a target, whether prey or threat. It primarily hunts animalistic Rock-types like Aron, but will settle for more ore-based ones like Geodude.

entry: POKENAME约一半体重都在尾巴上，因此尾巴成了强力武器。危急时也能断尾，换来远超平时的移动速度。
author: mirkinator
source: Approximately half of POKENAME's weight is in its tail. This lets POKENAME use its tail a powerful weapon. In a pinch POKENAME's tail can also be dropped allowing POKENAME to move significantly faster than normal.

entry: 铁一般坚硬的倒刺能挡住大多数攻击，有时也被它拿来挂食物。它在养分丰富的地方休息，睡着也能慢慢吸收一些养分。
author: infinex21
source: Its iron-hard barbs protect it from most attacks, though it sometimes stores food on them. It rests in nutrient-rich areas and passively absorbs some of those nutrients as it sleeps.

entry: POKENAME领地意识很强，用满是尖刺的身躯与锋利尾巴保卫家园。
author: lemmymaster
source: POKENAME are quite territorial. They use their spiky bodies and sharp tails to defend their home.

entry: POKENAME受惊时，金属身体会骤然放出高热，碰它很危险。它曾在慌乱中点燃枯草。
author: .izik
source: If startled, POKENAME's metallic body suddenly emits intense heat, making it dangerous to touch. It has been known to set dry grass ablaze in moments of panic.

entry: POKENAME用爪刨开岩石，将找到的矿物吸进体内。受威胁时，先向袭击者射出背上的石刺，再迅速逃走。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME use their claws to dig through stone, absorbing the minerals that they find into their bodies. When threatened, they fire the rocky spikes on their backs at attackers before quickly fleeing.

entry: POKENAME能在沼泽水底找到，纹丝不动地吸收湿泥里的养分。有趣的是，即使到了寒冷季节，它也很少离开住处。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME can be found at the bottom of swampy waters, staying completely stagnant as they absorb nutrients from damp dirt. Interestingly, POKENAME rarely leave their homes even during colder seasons.

entry: POKENAME能察觉附近人和宝可梦的情绪，借此保全自己。面对心怀敌意的对手，若无处可藏，就紧紧蜷起身体，用刺防御。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME can sense the emotions of people and Pokémon near them. They use this power to keep themselves safe. If they are caught with nowhere to hide against someone with hostile intent, they will curl up tightly and use their spikes defensively.

source: POKENAME can sense the emotions of people and Pokémon near them. They use this power to keep themselves safe. If they are caught with nowhere to hide against someone with hostile intent, they will curl up tightly and use their spikes defensively.

entry: 对战时，POKENAME用感知情绪的能力锁定对手的位置，像舞者般单脚旋转，让金属皮肤护身，同时用刺割伤敌人。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME use their empathic powers to pinpoint the locations of their opponents during Pokémon battles. They fight by spinning in a pirouette, relying on their metallic skin to protect them from harm whilst their spines cut into their foes.

entry: 对战时，POKENAME用感知情绪的能力锁定对手的位置，像舞者般单脚旋转，让金属皮肤护身，同时用刺割伤敌人。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME use their empathic powers to pinpoint the locations of their opponents during Pokémon battles. They fight by spinning in a pirouette, relying on their metallic skin to protect them from harm whilst their spines cut into their foes.

entry: POKENAME自信钢皮与感知情绪的能力能保自己无伤，便飘入对战中。察觉敌意袭来，就撑开铠甲般的裙摆，用带刺的金属挡下攻击。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME drift into Pokémon battles in the certainty that their steel skin and empathic powers will enable them to avoid harm. When they sense a hostile attack, they flare up their armoured skirt, using the thorny metal to block.

entry: POKENAME自信钢皮与感知情绪的能力能保自己无伤，便飘入对战中。察觉敌意袭来，就撑开铠甲般的裙摆，用带刺的金属挡下攻击。

entry: POKENAME自信钢皮与感知情绪的能力能保自己无伤，便飘入对战中。察觉敌意袭来，就撑开铠甲般的裙摆，用带刺的金属挡下攻击。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME drift into Pokémon battles in the certainty that their steel skin and empathic powers will enable them to avoid harm. When they sense a hostile attack, they flare up their armoured skirt, using the thorny metal to block.

entry: 它的身体中空，由纯银构成，表面刻满微小纹路，似乎在诉说前世的故事。
author: .izik
source: Its body is hollow and made of pure silver, covered in microscopic carvings. These markings appear to tell the story of its past life.

entry: POKENAME生活在严酷环境中，常见于干旱沙漠。群体紧密，领地意识很强；富含铁质的刺皮让它能驱赶对手，不太担心遭到反击。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME live in harsh environments, typically found in arid deserts. They live in tight-knit groups and are highly territorial, their spiky and iron-rich hides letting them fend off rivals without much fear of reprisal.

entry: 覆在身上的锡状物质，会随情绪变色。心情平静放松时，能更好地模拟冷色。
author: .izik
source: The tin-like material covering its body changes color to reflect its mood. It can mimic cool colors more effectively when calm and relaxed.

entry: 这种宝可梦住在洞穴深处，不动也不吃。每隔一个月，POKENAME才外出寻找食物和水。
author: cyboobr
source: This Pokémon lives deep in caves, not moving or eating. Every other month, POKENAME will venture out to find food and water.

entry: POKENAME极硬的壳里，封着的幽灵能量其实是幽火。壳若破裂，附近一带便会被几乎无法扑灭的幽火吞没。
author: elibromax314
source: The ghostly energy kept within is actually a ghostly fire that is contained by POKENAME's extremely hard shell. If ever broken, the surrounding area will be bathed in a spectral fire that is nearly impossible to put out.

entry: POKENAME集中波导，便能造出顶端带刺的长杖作战。坚硬的外壳加上娴熟的杖法，让它很擅长防守作战。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can, by focusing its aura, create a spike-tipped staff to use as a weapon in combat. With its tough exterior and its skill with the staff, it is an expert at fighting defensively.

entry: POKENAME用满是荆棘的鞭子制服敌人，堵住所有退路。受威胁时，还能从尾部连射铁刺。
author: theartemis1
source: POKENAME subdues its enemies using its thorn-covered whip, halting all means of escape. When threatened, it is able to release a barrage of iron spikes from its tail.

entry: 这种宝可梦的食谱很奇特，吃地下植物与过渡金属。它啃穿洞壁，用下颚腹面细网般的鳞片，滤掉不能吃的石土。
author: brilliantdarkness
source: This Pokémon has a strange diet of underground vegetation and transition metals. It chews through cavern walls, using the fine mesh-like scales on the underside of its jaw to strain out inedible stone and soil.

entry: 它在宽敞的地下洞穴筑巢，爱吃水晶和宝石。粗糙金属外皮的色泽，会随饮食习惯变化。
author: brilliantdarkness
source: It nests in spacious lairs underground and has developed a taste for crystals and gemstones. The color and luster of its rough, metallic coat are known to change depending on its dietary habits.

entry: 背刺渗出绿色毒液，让攻击格外危险。它出击前先翻个跟斗，用尖刺刮伤敌人。
author: .izik
source: The spikes on its back ooze a green toxin, making its attacks particularly dangerous. It somersaults before striking to rake its spines across its foe.

entry: POKENAME大部分时间都在睡觉，鼾声远远就能听见。察觉有东西过于靠近引起的震动，身体便本能地向四面八方射出粗刺。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME spends much of its time sleeping, and its loud snoring can be heard from large distances. If it senses the vibration of something moving too close to it, its body instinctively fires off thick spines in every direction.

entry: POKENAME既会重击受害者，也能发射尖刺。它最擅长对付披甲的敌人，吸收对方身上的金属。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME fires off spikes in addition to bludgeoning its victims. It excels against armored opponents and absorbs their metal.

entry: 额头的刺像钻头一样转动，连最硬的材料也能刺穿。战斗中，钻透板岩对它轻而易举。
author: .izik
source: The spike on its forehead rotates like a drill, piercing through even the hardest materials. It can effortlessly bore through slate during combat.

entry: 它们会被宝可梦蛋吸引，常在旁逗留或筑巢，守到蛋孵化。孵化后，POKENAME也可能长期保护这只幼崽。
author: banquoviaquo
source: They're drawn to Pokémon eggs, and will frequently linger or nest nearby to guard them until they've hatched. Even afterwards, a POKENAME may act as a long-term protector to the newborn.

entry: 它们会被宝可梦蛋吸引，常在旁逗留或筑巢，守到蛋孵化。孵化后，POKENAME也可能长期保护这只幼崽。
author: banquoviaquo
source: They're drawn to Pokémon eggs, and will frequently linger or nest nearby to guard them until they've hatched. Even afterwards, a POKENAME may act as a long-term protector to the newborn.

entry: POKENAME打起架来凶狠又阴险，却常不肯危及父母或幼崽。因此，尽管不易亲近，野生袋兽似乎仍很珍惜它们的陪伴。
author: banquoviaquo
source: A POKENAME fights viciously and underhandedly, but often refuses to endanger parents or children. For that reason, wild Kangaskhan seem to value their company, despite their prickliness.

entry: POKENAME用槌状尾巴使出带电的重击，迅速打倒敌人。它能看穿大多数物体，敌人与猎物几乎都逃不过它。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME deliver devastating, electrically-charged strikes with their mace-like tails to swiftly dispatch their foes. They are capable of seeing through most objects, so their foes and prey rarely ever manage to escape them.

entry: POKENAME将爪扎进洞壁，吸收岩中的矿物，其他养分则靠捕猎获取。凭着透视眼，它通常在夜间狩猎，更容易趁猎物不备下手。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME dig their claws into cave walls to absorb minerals within the rock and rely on hunting to acquire other nutrients. Due to their X-ray vision, they typically hunt at night to better catch prey unaware.

entry: POKENAME一生大半都在水下，金属身体却不会生锈，还能游得很快。周身的利刺能吓退敌人，集中精神也能将刺射向四周。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME's metallic body lets it swim swiftly without rusting, even though it spends most of its life underwater. Its body is lined with sharp spikes that act as a deterrent, and with focus, it can fire them in every direction.

entry: 训练家想摸POKENAME时，它能收起钢身上的绿刺，免得把人扎伤。它习惯把尾巴插进地里，吸收维持强壮所需的矿物。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME can retract the green spikes covering its steel body when its Trainer wants to pet it, so they don't get hurt. It has the habit of planting its tail into the ground to absorb the minerals it needs to stay strong.

entry: POKENAME满身凶险的倒刺，击中目标便会钩住，深深划开身体。皮与刺富含金属化合物，得吃富铁岩石，维持这一身铠甲。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are covered in vicious barbs that catch and cut deep into the bodies of whatever they strike. The spines and skin of POKENAME are rich in metallic compounds; they feed on iron-rich rocks to help maintain their armoured body.

entry: POKENAME满身凶险的倒刺，击中目标便会钩住，深深划开身体。皮与刺富含金属化合物，得吃富铁岩石，维持这一身铠甲。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are covered in vicious barbs that catch and cut deep into the bodies of whatever they strike. The spines and skin of POKENAME are rich in metallic compounds; they feed on iron-rich rocks to help maintain their armoured body.

entry: POKENAME附在洞壁，吸收岩里的矿物。满月之夜，它会爬下来，来到洞口凝望皎洁月光。
author: pattybgoode
source: POKENAME attaches to cave walls to absorb minerals in the rock. On nights with a full moon, it detaches itself and crawls to an opening to gaze at the bright moonlight.

entry: POKENAME的头发其实是根，总想把它扎进地里。因此，它醒来发现头埋在地下时，总会很苦恼。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME's hair is made of roots that try to plant it in the ground. Because of this, POKENAME is distressed when it wakes up to find its head buried in the ground.

entry: 外甲由轻薄却坚韧的金属构成。虽然怕热，却能有效抵御身体攻击。
author: .izik
source: Its outer carapace is made of a thin but durable metal. While vulnerable to heat, it provides effective protection against physical attacks.

entry: POKENAME藏在带刺的金属铠甲中。有些民间传说认为，甲壳下面，是一个怀恨的亡魂。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME is encased in thorny metal armor that covers its interior. Some folk tales suspect a vengeful spirit lies beneath the armor.

entry: 外甲是辉石合金，尖刺则主要是橄榄石。这些矿物在星球表面也有，但在月球的玄武岩平原上更常见。
author: pattybgoode
source: Its outer plating is a pyroxene alloy and its spines are mostly olivine. While these minerals are present on the planet's surface, they are more common on the basaltic plains of the moon.

entry: 头上绿色的部分虽像火焰，其实是一根长藤的末梢。对手靠得太近，它便伸藤抽打。
author: .izik
source: Though it resembles a flame, the green portion on its head is the tip of a long vine. This vine extends to slap at opponents who get too close.

entry: POKENAME得先将钢身加热至华氏450度，才能使用火属性攻击。来不及热身时，它可能干脆抡起刺尾，直接砸向对手。
author: bradlybro199
source: Before a POKENAME can use Fire-type attacks, it has to heat its steel body to 450 degrees Fahrenheit. When not given enough time to warm up, a POKENAME may resort to simply bashing its spiked tail directly into its opponent.

entry: 它的身体会莫名生成汞，受惊时便将汞吐出。这种金属防御既有效，又令人费解。
author: .izik
source: Its body mysteriously generates mercury, which it spits out when frightened. This metallic defense is as perplexing as it is effective.

entry: 为保护钥匙，POKENAME会以带刺的身体冲撞来犯的窃贼。最爱的钥匙往往来自废弃花园小屋。
author: ayner
source: POKENAME protect their keys from robbers by charging them with their thorny bodies. Their favorite keys often come from abandoned garden shacks.

entry: 胡须般的突起，其实是一对尖得能钻入坚石的口器。它攀在洞壁，钻进岩石，吸取内部矿物为食。
author: sk372
source: The whisker-like protrusions are actually a pair of proboscis pointed enough to dig into solid stone. It clings to cave walls, digs into the rock and siphons minerals from within for its nutrition.

entry: 它用强劲的手臂将矿石从洞壁敲落。吃下的矿石，能让外壳变得更坚固。
author: .izik
source: It uses its powerful arms to knock ore loose from cavern walls. The ore it consumes helps fortify and strengthen its outer shell.

entry: POKENAME主要靠尖刺放电，所以常用身体撞向敌人，或甩尾攻击。爪子也能从地里吸收养分与矿物。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME primarily discharge electricity from their spikes, so they typically fight by throwing themselves at their foes and by swinging their tails. They can absorb nutrients and minerals from the ground via their claws.

entry: POKENAME周围裹着神秘凝胶，任何东西一靠近，就会硬化成玉刺。想要拥抱时，它会先以心灵感应告诉训练家，免得凝胶意外硬化。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are surrounded by a mysterious gel that hardens into jade spikes whenever anything comes close. Whenever they want a hug, they will telepathically communicate with their Trainer to ensure that the gel does not accidentally harden.

entry: 它优雅地飘在林间空地上方，一察觉天敌便猛然坠下，冲击力足以震裂路面。
author: .izik
source: It floats gracefully above glades but drops with immense force if it senses a predator. The impact is strong enough to crack pavement.

entry: 走投无路时，它会咬住敌人，用双颚注入汞。中毒后若不治疗，可能致命。
author: .izik
source: As a last resort, it latches onto an enemy and injects mercury with its jaws. This toxic act can be fatal if left untreated.

entry: POKENAME捕猎时，会用刺尾紧紧缠住猎物。它领地意识颇强，与同类也处不来。
author: kittyluv090
source: POKENAME hunts by wrapping its spiky tail tightly around its prey. It can be quite territorial and does not get along with others of the same species.

entry: POKENAME用刺附在宿主宝可梦身上，缓缓吸走能量与养分，转成生存所需的电。训练家替伙伴梳理时，最好检查有没有它。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME attach to host Pokémon using their thorns. POKENAME slowly drain energy and nutrients from their host, converting it into the electricity they need to survive. Trainers are advised to check for POKENAME when grooming their companions.

entry: 休息时，POKENAME会在全身长出獠牙般的尖刺，抵御天敌。这些刺坚固无比，让它能在险恶环境中生存。
author: .izik
source: While resting, POKENAME grows tusk-like spikes all over its body to protect itself from predators. These spikes are incredibly sturdy, allowing it to survive in hostile environments.

entry: 带倒刺的铁壳，让这种宝可梦能免受大多数威胁。仗着这层保护，POKENAME有时会试探训练家的底线。
author: cyboobr
source: This Pokémon's barbed iron shell protects it from most threats. POKENAME has been known to test the limits of its Trainers because of this.

entry: 白天，POKENAME用金属双颚夹住洞里的钟乳石。夜晚便松口飞走，在黑暗中无声捕猎。
author: .izik
source: By day, POKENAME clamps onto cave stalactites with its metal jaws. At night, it releases and flies off to silently hunt in the dark.

entry: POKENAME会蜷成球，滚下山坡躲避天敌。脆弱的倒刺边滚边断，留下渗着毒液的锐利断口。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME curls into a ball and rolls down hills to escape predators. Their brittle barbs snap off as they roll, leaving a sharp edge that oozes with venom.

entry: POKENAME用长长的毒角猛击敌人，直到对方无力倒地。庞大的钢身奔跑时，会发出可怕的金属声，吓跑附近所有宝可梦。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME lashes out at its enemies with its long, poisonous horns until they collapse to the ground, powerless. Running with its massive steel body, it creates terrifying metallic noises that cause all Pokémon in the area to flee.

entry: POKENAME用长长的毒角猛击敌人，直到对方无力倒地。庞大的钢身奔跑时，会发出可怕的金属声，吓跑附近所有宝可梦。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME lashes out at its enemies with its long, poisonous horns until they collapse to the ground, powerless. Running with its massive steel body, it creates terrifying metallic noises that cause all Pokémon in the area to flee.

entry: 猎物一旦落入POKENAME的利齿间，金属双颚便绝不松开。满身刀刃般的锐刺，让连比它大得多的宝可梦也不敢捕猎它。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME's metallic jaws never release their prey once it's trapped between its sharp teeth. No one dares to hunt POKENAME, not even much larger Pokémon, because its body is too spiky and razor-sharp.

entry: POKENAME附在海中栖地的洞壁，静静吸取矿物。长而有力的爪、惊人的力气，甚至偶尔生出的锈，都让人怎么也拔不下来。
author: ocxin
source: POKENAME attach themselves to the cave walls of their marine habitats and quietly leech minerals. Their long, powerful claws, surprising strength, and even occasional rust make removing them a futile effort.

entry: POKENAME不爱与其他宝可梦贴得太近，便让全身长满倒刺。若侧耳细听，还能听见面具里传来轻轻的哼唱。
author: hexx_vixtar
source: POKENAME covers itself with barbs as it hates being too close to other Pokémon. If you listen closely, you can hear soft humming coming from its mask.

entry: POKENAME在洞里挖掘富铁的结核为食，将金属融进共生蘑菇。蘑菇表面带着金属质感，嵌有甲壳质的刺，保护着宿主。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME dig through caves for iron-rich nodules to feed on, incorporating the metal into their symbiotic mushroom. The mushroom has a metallic surface studded with chitinous thorns to help protect its host.

entry: 满刺的健壮身体给了它充足保护，它却依旧胆小易惊。逃跑时会留下细尖刺，阻止猎手继续追赶。
author: sk372
source: Its spiky and robust body gives it adequate defenses, yet it still possesses a jumpy temperament. It leaves small pointed spikes behind as it flees, discouraging a hunter's continued pursuit.

entry: 在黑暗中寻觅猎物时，它的双眼闪闪发亮。捕到猎物，先用刺扎穿再进食。
author: .izik
source: Its eyes blink brightly when searching for prey in the dark. It uses its thorns to pierce its catch before feeding.

entry: 对战时，POKENAME坚固的壳会在手臂上形成钢盾般的防护。条件合适时，甚至能挡住一列货运火车。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's sturdy shell mimics steel shields on its arms during combat. Under the right conditions, it is strong enough to stop a freight train.

entry: POKENAME钻入地下，想靠尖刺，让周围土地萌发生机。可它离开后留下的土，却往往粗硬不平。
author: xephyr
source: POKENAME burrows into the ground in hopes of germinating the surrounding area with its spikes. Often, the soil it leaves behind is coarse and tough.

entry: POKENAME住在水势极其汹涌、时常遭风暴侵袭的水域，轻些的东西都会被卷走。靠着沉重铁身与利刺，它们能紧聚成团，免遭冲走。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME live in highly turbulent waters where storms regularly blow through, sweeping up anything light enough. With their heavy iron bodies and sharp spikes, they can cluster together to keep from being washed away.

entry: 身上的倒刺让它挖掘毫不费力，材料再硬也一样。各个身体从挖开的岩石吸收矿物，再将养分彼此分配。
author: foolish_weasel
source: The barbs on its body makes digging effortless, regardless of the hardness of the material. Each body absorbs minerals from the rocks they dig through, and the bodies communally distribute the nutrients amongst themselves.

entry: 它吃废弃矿井里搜来的银矿石。吃得饱的POKENAME，会泛起耀眼的金属光泽。
author: .izik
source: It consumes silver ore scavenged from abandoned mines. A well-fed POKENAME gleams with a brilliant, metallic sheen.

entry: POKENAME将刺插进洞壁，吸收岩中的矿物。吸收过量，便可能引发剧烈头痛。
author: elite01.
source: POKENAME stick their spikes into cave walls and absorb the minerals they find in the rock. If they absorb too many minerals it can cause painful headaches.

entry: POKENAME住在湍急河流，靠沉重的金属身体稳住身形，抵住水流。它用刺刮河床上的卵石，吃其中的矿物。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME live in turbulent rivers, relying on their heavy metal body to keep them weighed down against the current. They use their spikes to scrape pebbles in the riverbed, feeding on the minerals within them.

entry: 它游过溪流，水流拂过，尖刺随之摆动。战斗时，会用坚硬的头猛撞敌人。
author: .izik
source: It swims through streams, its thorns wiggling as water washes over them. In battle, it uses its sturdy head to slam into foes with force.

entry: 它用带刺的拳头熟练攀山。仿照POKENAME双手制成的指虎，常见于犯罪团伙。
author: h0bojoe
source: It expertly scales mountains using its spiked fists. Knuckledusters inspired by POKENAME's hands are commonly found among criminal groups.

entry: 它常忘记自己有条刺尾。尾巴抬得太久会累，放下时又不小心被刺扎到自己。
author: oddwalls
source: It often forgets it has a spiny tail. If it lifts its tail for too long, it then grows tired and drops it, accidentally poking itself with the spines.

entry: 它总担心尾巴会夺走身体的控制权，尽管尾巴根本没有自己的意识。这份忧虑，连战斗时也会令它分心。
author: oddwalls
source: It constantly worries that its tail is taking over its body, though the tail has no mind of its own. This worry will even distract it in the midst of battle.

entry: 头部前方的刺既像喙，也起嘴的作用。它用这些刺夹取并吃下食物，动作精准得出奇。
author: .izik
source: The thorns on the front of its heads mimic beaks and function like mouths. It uses them to grasp and consume food with surprising precision.

entry: POKENAME动作太慢，难以避开危险，全靠带刺的甲壳护身。不得不战时，就用炮管向敌人发射金属刺。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME rely on their thorny shell to protect themselves from harm, being too slow moving to properly evade danger. If forced into a fight, they use their cannons to launch metallic thorns at their foes.

entry: POKENAME悬浮在洞里，用周身锐利的金属刺刮取岩石中的矿物。除了硬壳，放出的绿色毒气也能保护它。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME levitates inside caves, using the sharp metal thorns that surround it to extract minerals from rocks. In addition to its hard shell, POKENAME is protected by the toxic green gas it releases.

entry: POKENAME满身毒刺，能射向敌人。有时能看到它嵌在金属物体中，慢慢将铁吸进体内。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME bristles with toxic thorns, which it can fire off at foes. It can occasionally be found embedded within metal objects, slowly absorbing iron into its own body.

entry: 据说许多中世纪武器都以POKENAME为灵感，最有名的就是晨星锤。和人手挥舞的武器一样，它用棒槌般的尾巴击退遇上的一切敌人。
author: derhauptmann2k17
source: POKENAME are said to be the inspiration for countless medieval weapons, most famously the morningstar. Just like its hand-wielded counterparts, POKENAME use their club-like tails to fend off any and all foes they might encounter.

entry: POKENAME动作太慢，难以避开危险，全靠带刺的甲壳护身。不得不战时，就用炮管向敌人发射金属刺。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME rely on their thorny shell to protect themselves from harm, being too slow moving to properly evade danger. If forced into a fight, they use their cannons to launch metallic thorns at their foes.

entry: POKENAME背上的种子吸收阳光，帮助它生长。同窝的幼崽常用爪和獠牙嬉闹打斗。
author: lydiaprower8
source: The seed on POKENAME's back helps it grow by absorbing the sunlight. A litter of POKENAME often playfight with their paws and tusks.

entry: 多数POKENAME一生都住在孵化的那棵树里，除非被迫，否则绝不离开。它用獠牙在住处刻记号，让同类知道这里已有主人。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: Most POKENAME live in the tree they were hatched in for life, never leaving unless forced. POKENAME mark the trees they live in with their tusks, so others know it is occupied.

entry: POKENAME挥舞强劲的骨质獠牙，抵御其他宝可梦。磨尖的牙端划过敌人，会留下深深的伤口。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME wield a mighty bone tusk that they rely on to defend themselves against other Pokémon. The sharpened end of their tusk slashes through their foes leaving behind deep cuts.

entry: POKENAME用獠牙般的舌头刺穿球果，舔食里面的汁液。尝到酸味，便会厌恶地乱甩舌头。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its tusk-like tongue to pierce Apricorns and lick the juice inside. If it tastes something sour, it flails its tongue wildly in disgust.

entry: POKENAME用强壮手臂摇树，将绿毛虫等猎物震下来，再用獠牙击打落地的目标，随后吃掉。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME shakes trees with its strong arms to knock down prey like Caterpie. It strikes fallen targets with its tusks before consuming them.

entry: POKENAME虽能在陆上走动，却十分吃力。双腿勉强撑得起身体，獠牙接触空气会变脆，还常被自己的长须绊倒。
author: sk372
source: Though POKENAME is able to traipse upon land, it is incredibly inefficient when it does so. Its legs are barely strong enough to hoist up its body, its tusks become brittle when exposed to air, and it often trips on its own lengthy whiskers.

entry: POKENAME勇敢又时刻追求进步，是新手训练家的好伙伴。它不停用獠牙磨石，让牙变得更锋利坚韧。
author: fiordaliso
source: Because of its courage and constant drive for self-improvement, POKENAME is an outstanding partner for a beginning Trainer. It constantly rubs its tusks against rocks to make them sharper and more resilient.

entry: POKENAME寻找莓榴果，抵御其他龙属性宝可梦。它有种奇怪的仪式，会把蜕下的鳞片碾碎，因此很难收集到它的鳞片。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME search for Haban Berries to protect themselves against other Dragon-type Pokémon. They have a strange ritual of crushing their scales after shedding them, which makes harvesting them difficult.

entry: 有贤者称，在龙的神祠祈祷后，曾从眼角瞥见POKENAME。尽管目击极其罕见，许多人仍视它为这些地方的守护者。
author: .izik
source: There are reports of Sages catching glimpses of POKENAME out of the corner of their eyes after praying at draconic shrines. Many regard it as a guardian of these places, even though sightings are exceedingly rare.

entry: 獠牙与剃刀般的尖齿，让它咬劲极强。偏又喜欢咬着玩，害许多训练家受过伤。
author: melodydelune
source: Its combination of tusks and razor-sharp teeth gives this Pokémon an intense bite force. It plays by nibbling, causing many injuries to Trainers.

entry: POKENAME的橄榄色羽毛，能融入周围树木。猎物一冲向洞穴，它便用小獠牙挖洞口。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have olive-colored feathers that blend into trees around them. Whenever their prey rushes towards a burrow, POKENAME dig at the entrances with their small tusks.

entry: POKENAME用坚硬獠牙与拳头碾碎树果。它怕冷，冬季来临前，常能看到它成群南迁。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME use their hardened tusks and fists to crush berries. As they are sensitive to the cold, groups of the Pokémon can be seen traveling south before the winter season.

entry: 温暖的月份，POKENAME埋在河边泥下，减缓代谢。寒冬时反而活跃，清开积雪与落叶，标示领地。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: During warm months, POKENAME buries itself under the mud by rivers and slows its metabolism. It is active during the cold, winter months, and marks its territory by clearing away any snow or fallen leaves.

entry: POKENAME头顶的圆隆部位，会随时间长大，智力也一同增长。它极力保护那里，人们认为一旦崩缺或磨损，智力就会下降。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's cranial dome grows over time, as does its intelligence. It's very protective of the dome, and it's believed that were it to be chipped or ground down, its intelligence would diminish as a result.

entry: POKENAME用獠牙在泥土与石头上刻符号，与同类沟通。每种记号的含义，仍在研究解读中。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses its tusks to carve symbols into dirt and stone to communicate with others of its kind. Research is still ongoing to decipher the meanings behind each marking.

entry: POKENAME靠钢壳与利牙防身。獠牙若断了，就紧闭甲壳，等牙重新长出来。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME defend themselves with their steel shells and their sharp tusks. When their tusks break, they will tightly shut their shells and wait for them to regrow.

entry: POKENAME的獠牙几乎每周都脱落，新牙很快就会长出。它喜欢在脱落前涂上蜂蜜，等牙掉了，就能方便地拿来当零嘴。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's tusks fall off on an almost weekly basis, with new ones growing shortly. It likes to smear honey on them before they fall, so it can easily snack on it once it does.

entry: POKENAME把獠牙当刀切食物，切片时也能将食物加热到恰好的温度。牙若折断，它会用身体将其熔化，再用熔融的材料长出新牙。
author: soup1900
source: When POKENAME uses its tusks like knives to cut through food, the slices also cook the food to the perfect temperature. If its tusks break off, it melts them with its body to use the molten materials to grow new ones.

entry: POKENAME在露出的岩石上磨牙，随时准备战斗。小小身体力气却很大，能搬巨石、推倒树木。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME sharpen their tusks on rocky outcroppings, keeping them ready to fight with. They are powerful for their size, capable of moving boulders and knocking over trees.

entry: POKENAME嘴里伸出小而尖的獠牙。牙太小，不适合战斗，便被它用来翻找块茎等地下食物。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have small but sharp tusks that jut from their mouth. Too small to use effectively for combat, POKENAME use their tusks to root around for tubers and other underground meals.

entry: POKENAME曾被尊为最强大的使者。据说，只要见过它，此后就再也不会输掉任何战斗。
author: m1918_94884
source: POKENAME were once revered as the mightiest of messengers. It is said that anyone who sees an POKENAME will never lose a battle again.

entry: POKENAME用下巴上的獠牙挖地道，虽然这常让下颚酸痛。爪子格外锋利，跟它扭打十分危险。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: POKENAME uses the tusks on its chin to help it carve out tunnels, although this often leaves it with a sore jaw. Its claws are extra sharp, making it quite dangerous to tussle with.

entry: POKENAME没有獠牙，却有格外强壮的喙，而且受损越多，就越坚硬。爪子既用于战斗，也用于在树干留记号。
author: lydiaprower8
source: In lieu of tusks, POKENAME has a really strong beak that gets harder the more damaged it gets. It also uses its claws in combat and to mark tree trunks.

entry: 这种宝可梦很少远离巢穴，会与兄弟姐妹用角互撞，比试力气。POKENAME身上没什么防护，喷出的火球却能让对手严重烧伤。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: This Pokémon is rarely far from its nest, playing with its siblings by knocking their horns together in a test of strength. While POKENAME have little to physically protect themselves, their fireballs can leave opponents badly burned.

entry: 离开巢穴后，POKENAME的手足与对手会彼此发起挑战，用各种比赛较量本领，包括快速踢击、喷火球和碾树果。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: Outside of their home nests, sibling and rival POKENAME will challenge each other to tests of strength with different contests. These challenges can include speed kicking, fireball spitting, and berry crushing.

entry: POKENAME的爪与獠牙由同种物质构成。踢击力道之大，足以将树干踢成两截。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME's claws are made of the same material as its tusks. Its kicks are strong enough to break a tree trunk in half.

entry: POKENAME战斗中若折断獠牙，便融入附近枝叶躲藏，等待新牙长出。它会吃树苗，加快这一过程。
author: .izik
source: If POKENAME's tusk breaks off in battle, it blends into nearby foliage while it regrows. It consumes saplings to speed up the process.

entry: POKENAME能察觉树木生病，用颚上强劲的獠牙砍掉不健康的树。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: POKENAME can detect when trees are sickly. They use their strong tusks on their jaw to cut down any unhealthy ones.

entry: POKENAME体形虽庞大，却宁愿待在最深的海底，很少被人看见。绿鳞泛起不祥光芒诱来猎物，钢一般坚硬的牙便能立刻将其咬穿。
author: be77yboop
source: Despite their enormous size, POKENAME are rarely seen, instead preferring to remain in the deepest parts of the ocean. Their green scales glow ominously to attract prey, which they can bite through promptly with their tough-as-steel teeth.

entry: 它用头上的大角在树上刻记号，标出凶猛天敌出没的地带、食物格外丰盛的地方等。角若折断，一周就能重新长出。
author: sk372
source: It uses the large horn on its head to carve markings into trees, denoting things such as areas with dangerous predators or particularly lush food stores. Should the horn snap off, a new one grows back in a week.

entry: POKENAME将短而强壮的獠牙，与钢刃般的双翼配合，压制敌人。牙若崩缺，便向敌人眼里喷水，尽快逃走。
author: .izik
