source: POKENAME wields its short, strong tusks in tandem with its steel-edged wings to overwhelm foes in combat. Should it chip a tusk, it sprays water at the foe's eyes and flees as quickly as possible.

entry: POKENAME会在树上刻下独有的记号，标示领地。刀刃虽会崩口，重新长好后，却更加强韧。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME marks its territory by etching its unique signature in trees. Its blade chips but grows back stronger.

entry: POKENAME的獠牙覆着恶臭毒液，一击就能打碎混凝土。它在夜间训练，好更好地保护巢穴。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's tusks are coated in a foul-smelling poison and can break concrete with a single strike. It trains at night to better protect its den.

entry: POKENAME的獠牙脆弱，折断后要很久才能长回。它用缎带保护牙，不用时常会裹起来。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's tusks are brittle and take quite some time to grow back if broken. It uses its ribbons to shield them from harm, often keeping them wrapped up when not in use.

entry: POKENAME喷出的内脏，接触空气便会变得锋利。既能当劈砍武器，也能砍断低垂树枝，让水果和树果掉下来。
author: sk372
source: When ejected, POKENAME's innards sharpen in response to exposure to the air. It uses them as a hacking weapon in battle, but also to chop at low-hanging tree branches to make fruits and berries fall.

entry: 它们用獠牙在树上划出深痕，标记领地。也有人见过POKENAME在石头上磨利尾巴的某些部位。
author: elite01.
source: They mark their territory by leaving gashes in trees with their tusks. POKENAME have also been spotted sharpening parts of their tails on rocks.

entry: 被惹恼时，它会从护头石盔的孔里喷气，用前爪刨地。POKENAME极力守护家园，谁也不许靠近，连同类都不例外。
author: fiordaliso
source: When irritated, it snorts air through the holes in the stone helmet protecting its head and scrapes the ground with its front paws. POKENAME is extremely protective of its home and won't allow anyone to approach, not even others of its own species.

entry: POKENAME用獠牙咬开坚果硬壳，进食前，还会用尾火烤一烤。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME use their tusks to crack open the hard shells of nuts. They toast their food with the flame on their tail before they eat it.

entry: POKENAME温顺又爱玩，常在其他宝可梦周围蹦跳取乐。可惜锋利的头冠，有时会不慎伤到它们。
author: enzo200
source: POKENAME are very playful and docile; they often jump around other Pokémon for fun. Unfortunately, its sharp crest can accidentally hurt other Pokémon.

entry: 小獠牙能轻易捕捉震动与声波。它靠回声定位辨路，追踪敌人。
author: infinex21
source: Its small tusks pick up vibrations and sonic waves with ease. It performs echolocation to find its way and to keep track of any of its foes.

entry: POKENAME身上的铁刺常会折断，几小时就能长回。古代文明曾将这些刺熔成合金，打造耐用的盾牌。
author: .izik
source: The iron spikes on POKENAME's body often break off but regrow within hours. Ancient civilizations once melted these spikes into alloys for crafting durable shields.

entry: 两只牙牙融合，让POKENAME的龙类特征更加突出，獠牙与背刺都更显眼。它擅长用这些部位吓住更大的宝可梦，避开冲突。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The fusion of two Axew causes an exaggeration of draconic characteristics in POKENAME, resulting in more pronounced tusks and more exaggerated spines. They use these features to intimidate larger Pokémon and are adept at avoiding confrontation.

entry: POKENAME从獠牙放出细而黏的丝网，困住敌人。等对方动弹不得，再吐出腐蚀性毒液，使其失去行动能力。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME dispenses a thin, sticky webbing from its tusks to trap foes. Once restrained, it spits a corrosive poison to incapacitate them.

entry: POKENAME用流畅优美的翼舞分散对手注意，让对方放松戒备，再以刀刃般的翼尖突袭。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME distracts its opponents with the flowing and graceful movements of its wings. The distraction leads to its foes being less wary of sudden strikes from its bladed wingtips.

entry: 和谐的歌声尤其受龙属性宝可梦喜爱，它们无论片刻前多么暴怒，在它面前都会温顺下来。它爱吃甜甜蜜，既美味，又能防止喉咙痛。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its harmonious song is especially beloved by Dragon-type Pokémon, who become docile in its presence no matter how enraged they were moments before. It is fond of Honey, which is both delicious and helps prevent sore throats.

entry: POKENAME用利牙劈开树皮，贪婪吸食树汁，也会从身上的大蘑菇释放孢子，划定林中领地。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME uses its sharp tusks to split open tree bark so it can greedily feed on the sap within. It secretes spores from the large mushroom on its body to mark out its territory in the forest.

entry: POKENAME敲击鳞片，与同类沟通。鳞片若脱落，八小时内就会长出新的。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME strikes its scales to communicate with others of its kind. If a scale breaks off, a new one grows within eight hours.

entry: 看见陌生光源，POKENAME就会兴奋起来，兴奋中不慎从獠牙放出一团团褐色麻痹粉。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME becomes excited when it sees unfamiliar light sources. In its excitement, it accidentally releases clouds of brown Stun Spore from its tusks.

entry: POKENAME用火焰吐息标示领地。树木会被烧焦，巨石则被熔化。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME marks its territory using its fiery breath. Trees will be left charred, and boulders will be melted.

entry: POKENAME獠牙里装着深粉色的可食用馅料。人们常将它当果酱，用牙牙獠牙制成的刀抹在吐司上，尤其会在纪念日奢侈地享用。
author: teatedtiten
source: The filling in POKENAME's tusks house a deep pink, edible filling. It is usually spread on toast as a jam with Axew tusk knives as a luxury, especially for anniversaries.

entry: POKENAME个子小，领地意识却强。深夜里，会在领地内大肆摧残各种东西，让旁人以为此地潜伏着庞大强悍的宝可梦。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is a small but territorial Pokémon. In the dead of night, it will brutalize many things throughout its territory to give the impression to others that a large and powerful Pokémon lurks in the area.

entry: 学会飞行后，POKENAME会舍弃地上的旧巢，在高高的山腰另筑新巢。
author: .jerden
source: After learning how to fly, POKENAME abandons its old nest that was on the ground. It makes a new one high up on the side of a mountain.

entry: POKENAME的喙进食时常会折断，过些时候才会长回。这期间，另一个头会吃够两份食物，维持双方所需。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's beaks frequently break off during feeding and regrow over time. When this happens, the other head eats enough food to sustain both of them until the beak returns.

entry: 这种宝可梦的后鳍与嘴里都长着獠牙。它用尾部獠牙凿下冰块，再甩尾将冰块掷向敌人。
author: lydiaprower8
source: This Pokémon has tusks on its hind fins as well as in its mouth. It uses its tail tusks to carve out chunks of ice, then uses its tail to fling these chunks at enemies.

entry: POKENAME不停用钳子捶打岸边的岩石。钳子常会断掉，新长出的强度却是原来的两倍。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME will repeatedly punch rocks along the shore with their claws. These claws will often break off, growing back twice as strong.

entry: POKENAME把特殊的獠牙当剑，一上场对战便猛烈挥舞。战斗之外，会花时间打磨、擦亮这根沉重的牙。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME wield a special tusk like a sword and swing this weapon wildly whenever they face off in a Pokémon battle. They spend time outside of battles sharpening and polishing this hefty tusk.

entry: 天生的獠牙，是POKENAME最大的骄傲，断了却永不再生。若折断，它便陷入几乎无法制止的狂暴，不顾一切攻击附近的生物，连毫无胜算的敌人也不放过。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's natural tusks are a supreme source of pride for it. They never regrow if they break off; if they do, POKENAME goes into a nigh-unstoppable rampage and recklessly attacks almost anything nearby, even foes that it has no chance of defeating.

entry: 它将獠牙撞向石笋，喜爱那回荡的声响。据说声音能传进洞穴深处，惊动其他宝可梦。
author: .izik
source: It slams its tusks against stalagmites, delighting in the resonating echoes. The sound is said to carry deep into caves, startling other Pokémon.

entry: 船长们告诫人们提防POKENAME，这恶兽脾气极其暴烈。獠牙能轻易劈开船体，许多水手因此溺亡。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Sea captains warn of POKENAME as it is an atrocious beast with a violent temper. Its tusks can easily cleave through ship hulls, and many sailors have drowned because of them.

entry: POKENAME的獠牙若折断，几天就能长回。走投无路时，也可能自行拔下，用来战斗或当应急零嘴。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's tusks will regrow over a few days if snapped off. In times of desperation, POKENAME may remove them itself, either for fighting or as an emergency snack.

entry: POKENAME的獠牙一生都在生长，覆着坚韧的保护层，护住敏感表面。临近进化，保护层变得半透明，牙也泛起柔光，据说映出了体内积蓄的巨大力量。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME's tusks grow throughout its life, coated in a tough layer to protect their sensitive surface. When nearing evolution, this coating becomes translucent and the tusks begin to glow softly, said to reflect the immense power building within.

entry: POKENAME通过獠牙集中超能力。越开心，牙就越长越强壮，念力也越强。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME focuses its psychic abilities through its tusks. The happier it becomes, the longer and stronger its tusks grow, and the more powerful its telekinesis gets.

entry: POKENAME用利牙割断海草，等海草浮向水面便吃起来。大部分还没吃到就漂走了，它似乎也不在意。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME uses its sharp tusks to slice through seagrass. As the seagrass floats to the surface, POKENAME feasts upon it. It doesn't seem to mind that most of its food floats away before it eats it.

entry: 它用獠牙配合高速旋转，能切开大多数障碍。牙即使折断，一天内也能长回；还可把钢壳当破拆球用。
author: infinex21
source: It can cut through most obstacles using its tusks in tandem with its Rapid Spin attacks. Even if its tusks break, they will regrow within a day's time and can still use its steel shell like a wrecking ball.

entry: POKENAME用利爪爬上树，平日多在林冠间滑翔。坚硬的獠牙，则用来威吓敌人。
author: nyandogegaming
source: Using its clawed hands to climb trees, POKENAME are usually found gliding around the canopies in forests. Its hard tusks are used to deter foes.

entry: 它用爪与獠牙连番劈砍敌人，待对方虚弱，再以强劲的毒针使其动弹不得。
author: .izik
source: It slashes at foes with its claws and tusks in a flurry of strikes. Once weakened, it delivers a potent Poison Sting to immobilize them.

entry: 刀刃般的翅膀划过洞壁，留下深深刻痕，向闯入领地者发出明确警告。
author: .izik
source: Its blade-like wings slash into cave walls, leaving deep carvings. These markings serve as a clear warning to trespassers in its territory.

entry: POKENAME击碎坚石，磨砺獠牙。若找到宝石或贵金属，就会带给自己最信任的对象。
author: m1918_94884
source: POKENAME breaks open strong rocks to sharpen its tusks. If it finds any gemstones or precious metals, it will bring them to whoever it trusts most.

entry: POKENAME在冰冻苔原上与同类切磋，先以獠牙重击，最后用锋利冰爪连番猛攻，结束战斗。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spars with its kind across frozen tundras. It begins with heavy tusk strikes, ending battles with a flurry of sharp, icy claws.

entry: POKENAME的长牙从头部而非颚部长出，这种适应让它不易误张嘴，吸进环境中的冷空气，能牢牢保住宝贵的体热。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME's adaptation to have its long tusks grow from its head instead of its jaw helps prevent it from accidentally opening its mouth to the cold air of its environment, keeping vital body heat safely inside.

entry: POKENAME用四肢一同发力，将硬头向前顶撞，力道足以粉碎巨石。用这强力冲击撞倒敌人，再以尖锐如喙的嘴撕咬。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's hard head can be propelled forward by all four of its limbs, striking hard enough to shatter boulders. After using this powerful impact to knock down foes, POKENAME will bite using its sharp beak-like mouth.

entry: 头冠、獠牙与背甲由极其坚硬耐用的金属构成。沿洞壁留下的划痕，就能看出POKENAME曾走过哪里。
author: holgast
source: Its crest, tusks and back plates are composed of an extremely durable and hard metal. One can see where a POKENAME has been by the scratches it leaves along cave walls.

entry: POKENAME强劲的獠牙，其实是向内长的大鳞片，能劈开密林。厚皮也能抵御大多数伤害。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's powerful tusks are actually large ingrown scales, which it uses to cleave through dense forests. Its thick hide is resistant to most forms of damage.

entry: POKENAME的獠牙锋利得足以切断钢铁，身体则覆着厚厚的深色铁层。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's tusks are sharp enough to cut through steel. Its body is covered in a thick dark-colored iron.

entry: POKENAME用触角抓住坚果和水果，再以獠牙敲壳、切果。这样既能磨牙，也能让自己与伙伴们吃饱。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME use their tusks to break open nuts and cut open fruits they grab and hold with their feelers. This keeps their tusks honed and provides them, and their friends and allies, with plenty of sustenance.

entry: 花瓣锋利无比，能轻易切断粗树枝。战斗时，POKENAME会将磨利的花朵掷出，作为致命武器。
author: mistymagius
source: Its petals are incredibly sharp, and they can slice straight through thick tree branches with relative ease. In combat, POKENAME can throw its sharpened flowers as a deadly projectile.

entry: POKENAME挥动斧子般的触角攻击对手。在狭窄通道里若用力过猛，触角可能卡进物体，露出破绽。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME swings its axe-like feelers towards opponents. If the Pokémon swings too hard in a narrow passage, its feelers may get stuck in an object, leaving POKENAME susceptible to attacks.

entry: 人们曾发现一群POKENAME守卫着合众古代地下墓穴。它们把探险者误当成盗墓贼，抵抗数周才被安抚。
author: .izik
source: A group of POKENAME were discovered guarding an ancient Unovan catacomb. Mistaking explorers for grave robbers, they resisted for weeks before being calmed.

entry: POKENAME的两颗头彼此厌恶，总打个不停。若能把它们教得齐心协力，便足以证明训练家精于培育龙宝可梦。
author: staghorn
source: POKENAME's two heads hate each other and fight constantly. Owning a POKENAME whose heads cooperate is a mark of a skilled Dragon-type Trainer.

entry: POKENAME每天锻炼身心，磨砺獠牙，也磨炼感知宝可梦与人类波导的本领。
author: t3isukone
source: POKENAME spends its days training its mind and body, honing both the sharpness of its tusks and its ability to sense the auras of Pokémon and humans.

entry: 神秘的红色能量从金属身体的裂隙透出。POKENAME的獠牙能磨得比任何剑都锋利，是致命的武器。
author: santon5512
source: A mysterious red energy shines through the cracks in their metal bodies. POKENAME's tusks can be sharpened to be sharper than any sword, making them deadly weapons.

entry: POKENAME用有力的尾巴缠住人表达亲昵，小心不让利牙靠得太近。对敌时，用这对利刃劈砍，同时用柔韧的角击打。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME expresses affection by wrapping its muscular tail around people, careful to avoid bringing its sharp tusks too close. It uses these blades to slash at foes, while simultaneously striking with its flexible horns.

entry: 它敏捷地借家具或地势起跳，在空中做出复杂动作。战法结合空手道与相扑，凌厉而高效。
author: .izik
source: It leaps nimbly off furniture or terrain, performing elaborate aerial maneuvers. Its combat style combines karate and sumo with ruthless efficiency.

entry: POKENAME的獠牙极其锋利，断了却不会再生。取而代之的是异常坚固的真菌，渐渐硬化，仿成原本獠牙的样子。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's tusks are extremely sharp but will not regrow if broken off. Instead, they are replaced by extremely sturdy fungi that harden over time to emulate the original tusks.

entry: POKENAME靠强壮的上身砸碎巨石。若砸不开，就会使出骇人的龙爪。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its strong upper body strength to smash boulders. When this fails, it will use a horrendous Dragon Claw.

entry: 从前，人们把POKENAME的獠牙磨粉，放进它蜕下的鳞皮里熬煮，得到的糊剂用来缓解牙痛，在古时是出奇管用的药方。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's tusks were once ground up into a powder and boiled within its scaly shed skin. The resulting paste was used to relieve toothaches, making it a surprisingly helpful remedy in ancient times.

entry: POKENAME凶猛守卫山间领地。夜里，用明亮的尾火发出警告，阻止入侵者靠近。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME fiercely defend their territories in the mountains. At night, they use the bright flame of their tails as a warning to discourage intruders.

entry: POKENAME凶猛不屈，因此被某些文化融入传统。战时，人们会陈列这种宝可梦的石像。
author: rakunk
source: POKENAME is known for a fierce and unyielding nature, earning it a place in the traditions of some cultures. Stone statues of this Pokémon are displayed during times of war.

entry: POKENAME越愤怒，尾火就越亮。平时只烧得通红，和强敌苦战时，却能烧成白热。
author: .jerden
source: The flame on its tail becomes brighter the angrier POKENAME gets. It is normally only red-hot, but can burn white-hot if POKENAME is struggling against a strong rival.

entry: POKENAME性情凶悍，用獠牙与角战斗。争地盘、较量本领，甚至取乐，都能成为打架的理由，因此满身伤疤的个体很常见。
author: pix3l_655
source: POKENAME are vicious, using their tusks and horns to fight. The reasons they fight vary, from territory battles to contests to entertainment. For this reason, it is common to see POKENAME with many scars.

entry: POKENAME借电磁飘浮，乘沙漠强风移动。有人推测，许多野生个体其实是很久以前造出的人造物。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME travel on strong desert winds with the help of Magnet Rise. Some theorize that many wild POKENAME are man-made, and were created long ago.

entry: 人们认为，POKENAME是失落地下文明中走失的孩子。研究者远远跟随，盼它能带领他们找到它的故乡。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME is thought to be a lost child of a lost underground civilization. Researchers follow it from afar in hopes it will lead them to its home.

entry: POKENAME裹着坚韧的绿松石色茧，栖身古墓深处。制衣的人曾深入洞穴，采集它的优质丝。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are surrounded by a tough turquoise cocoon and are found deep within ancient tombs. People who make clothing have gone spelunking to obtain their high-quality silk.

entry: 它的角有种独特能力，能感知同类。靠近古代遗迹时，能力会增强，这现象至今让科学家费解。
author: .izik
source: Its horn has the unique ability to sense others of its kind. This power grows stronger near ancient ruins, a phenomenon that puzzles scientists to this day.

entry: 据说古人用黏土和团团锹形虫造出了POKENAME，体内流动着至今未明的能源。它挖洞睡觉，即使埋在土下，也仍发光、滴答作响。
author: beatdoof
source: POKENAME is said to have been created by ancient people from clay and clumps of stag beetles, with a currently unidentified energy source flowing through its body. Digging burrows to sleep, it still glows and ticks even beneath the earth.

entry: 许多考古学家带着POKENAME协助探索遗迹、编目发现。有时，从未被观察到的古代文明资料，也会莫名出现在它的目录里。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is paired with many archaeologists to help explore and catalog findings within ancient ruins. On occasion, data about ancient civilizations that was never observed finds its way into POKENAME's catalogues.

entry: 古时，POKENAME被奉为圣殿的守护者，站在刻有复杂谜题的石板旁，只为考验旅人而醒来。唯有最聪慧的人，才能解谜获准入内。
author: rakunk
source: POKENAME were revered as guardians of sacred temples in ancient times. They would stand near tablets inscribed with intricate riddles, awakening only to challenge travelers. Only the most intelligent could solve their puzzles and gain entry.

entry: 靠近古代器物，头上的珍珠便会灿烂发光。考古学家对此很困惑，仍不明白珍珠与这些遗物有何关联。
author: .izik
source: The pearl on its head glows brilliantly when near ancient artifacts. Archaeologists are puzzled by this phenomenon, as the connection between the pearl and these relics remains unknown.

entry: POKENAME是古老陶器构成的神秘生命，靠超能力结合在一起。尾上的表盘不停滴答作响，用途却无人知晓。
author: imaginita
source: POKENAME is a mysterious being made of ancient clay pottery and held together by psychic energy. The dial on its tail is constantly ticking, but for what purpose is unknown.

entry: 材料虽极其致密，它仍保有天然雀出色的跳跃本领。POKENAME能长久纹丝不动，看起来只是一尊普通石像，直到危险来临才会行动。
author: elfail0
source: It still retains the great hopping capabilities of a Natu, despite being made of incredibly dense materials. POKENAME can stay incredibly still for long periods of time, appearing as nothing more than a simple stone idol until danger approaches.

entry: POKENAME靠来源不明的能源运转。大尾巴充当导管，窃取小型电子设备的电力，再将损坏的东西藏进高高的树枝间。
author: thelastmaleneko
source: POKENAME runs off an energy source of unknown origin. It uses its large tail as a conduit to steal power from small electronics, then stashes the broken items in tree branches high off the ground.

entry: POKENAME大量聚集在海边洞穴产卵，洞壁上绘有奇怪图案。有人推测，新生幼崽能读懂符号，就此启程横越海洋，到远方定居。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME gather in large numbers to lay their eggs in coastal caves with strange depictions on the walls. It is theorized that newborn POKENAME can interpret these symbols and head off on a voyage across the oceans, settling far away.

entry: POKENAME攀在墓壁上站岗，留意探险者。它毫不松懈地守卫，向过于靠近的人喷出灼热沙粒。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME clings to tomb walls keeping sentry and watching for explorers. It guards these areas relentlessly, spitting hot sand at anyone who draws too close.

entry: POKENAME栖在古神殿遗迹顶端，用藤蔓筑巢。巢常能在被遗忘的祭坛附近找到。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME perches atop ancient temple ruins, crafting its nests from vines. These nests are often found near forgotten altars.

entry: 有人见到POKENAME在古文明遗迹间蜿蜒爬行，用尾端的手缓慢而有条理地修复部分残迹。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has been spotted slithering about the ruins left behind by ancient civilizations. Using the hand at the end of its tail, it slowly and methodically attempts to rebuild some of what's been left behind.

entry: 它们把巨石啃成平板，再一块块刻下神秘纹路。人们认为这些独特记号源自古代，含义却仍未知。
author: .izik
source: They chew boulders into flat tablet shapes, carving mysterious etchings on each. These unique markings are thought to be ancient, but their meaning remains unknown.

entry: 古老壁画画着POKENAME清理矿井塌方的景象。它凿穿岩石，换来成捆的根与林间草药。
author: .izik
source: Old murals depict POKENAME clearing cave-ins in mining shafts. It carved through stone and was rewarded with bundles of roots and forest herbs.

entry: POKENAME细心用黏土塑出大手，再注入神秘能量，让手动起来。它用这些手，保护自己与信任的对象免遭野生宝可梦袭击。
author: sirg44
source: POKENAME carefully sculpt large hands out of clay before animating them with a mysterious energy. They use these hands to defend themselves and those they trust from wild Pokémon.

entry: 古籍记载，POKENAME曾在城镇之间空运包裹。服务快捷却昂贵，只有富贵阶层用得起。
author: .izik
source: Ancient texts describe POKENAME delivering parcels by air between towns. The service was fast but expensive, used only by the wealthy elite.

entry: 缚在POKENAME身上的花瓶，约有500年历史。有些喜好奢华或品味古怪的富人，会用它看家。
author: mepp.
source: The vases that are bound to POKENAME were created around 500 years ago. Wealthy people with lavish or very eccentric tastes have been known to use POKENAME as security guards for their homes.

entry: 发怒时，胸前的石板泛起红光，警告敌人远离。寒冷气候会让粗皮更坚韧，使它成为出色的守卫。
author: .izik
source: The tablet on its chest glows red with anger, warning enemies to stay away. Its rough skin becomes tougher in colder climates, making it an exceptional guardian.

entry: 许多个体守着沙漠墓穴，大嘴上的螺纹在致命一咬前泛白光。诡异的存在感，能吓退入侵者。
author: .izik
source: Many are found guarding desert tombs, the spirals on their larger mouths glowing white before delivering a deadly bite. Their eerie presence wards off intruders.

entry: 人们在它头顶橙色玻璃罩上，发现了微小刻痕，似乎是失落文明的文字，含义与来历却仍是谜。
author: .izik
source: Microscopic etchings have been discovered on the orange glass dome of its head. These markings appear to be writings from a long-lost civilization, but their meaning and origin remain a mystery.

entry: 用硬头弹开攻击时，胸前螺纹会短暂发光。这些纹路似乎会对冲击起反应，用途却仍未知。
author: .izik
source: When deflecting attacks with its hardened head, the spiral on its chest glows briefly. The markings seem to react to impacts, though their purpose remains unknown.

entry: 许多人认为，这些宝可梦是某个知之甚少的古文明造来陪伴大家的。它们会安抚训练家与弱者，拼上性命保护他们。
author: infinex21
source: Many people believe these Pokémon were created by an ancient, yet vastly unknown, civilization to serve as companions for all. They will comfort and protect their Trainers and the weak with their lives.

entry: 很久以前，POKENAME是古竞技场上的角斗士。虽看不见，却能用头盔上鬃毛般的结构感知敌人动作，在战斗中占优。
author: .izik
source: Long ago, POKENAME were gladiators in ancient coliseums. Though blind, it can sense enemy movements through the mane-like structure on its helmet, giving it an edge in battle.

entry: 有人见到POKENAME在古代遗迹里，除了注视来往访客，几乎什么也不做。有人认为，它是古文明失败的造物，造出时储存的能量不足以正常驱动身体。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has been seen in ancient ruins, doing little other than watching visitors that pass through. Some believe it is a failed construct from an ancient civilization, created with energy stores that cannot properly move its own body around.

entry: POKENAME常见于古神殿，被注视时很少动，常在一处坐得太久，被误认成雕像。人们常留下礼物，据说不敬它家园的人会被诅咒。
author: sneakywalrus0
source: POKENAME are commonly found at ancient temples. They rarely move when observed and often sit in one place so long that they are mistaken for carved statues. People often leave gifts, as it is said that they curse those who disrespect their homes.

entry: 栖息遗迹中的考古资料显示，POKENAME自诞生之初便与孩子结伴，充当守护者。如今常见它们搜寻各处壁龛与隐蔽角落，寻找失散的伙伴。
author: thelastmaleneko
source: Archeological data gathered from ruins that were home to POKENAME suggest they were bonded to a child from birth, serving as a guardian and protector. They are often seen searching various alcoves and hidden spots, trying to find their lost partners.

entry: 栖息遗迹中的考古资料显示，POKENAME自诞生之初便与孩子结伴，充当守护者。如今常见它们搜寻各处壁龛与隐蔽角落，寻找失散的伙伴。
author: thelastmaleneko
source: Archeological data gathered from ruins that were home to POKENAME suggest they were bonded to a child from birth, serving as a guardian and protector. They are often seen searching various alcoves and hidden spots, trying to find their lost partners.

entry: POKENAME睡觉时，喜欢完全埋进土、沙或黏土里。不知为何，野生个体无论何种情形都绝不互相攻击，生死关头也不例外。
author: bobosmith01
source: When POKENAME sleeps, it likes to be completely submerged in earth, sand, or clay. For some reason, wild POKENAME will never attack one another under any circumstance, even if it is a matter of life or death.

entry: 古代沙漠壁画上，成群POKENAME拔起田中庄稼，带上天空。有学者认为，传说指的是古老农耕仪式，也有人害怕那是毁灭的征兆。
author: .izik
source: There are ancient desert murals depicting swarms of POKENAME ripping up fields of crops and carrying them into the sky. Some scholars believe this legend refers to an old farming ritual, while others fear it was a sign of destruction.

entry: POKENAME发达的双臂能挥出毁灭性的拳击，位置却长得不合适，常在打斗时把自己绊倒。随着长大，体重分布改变，这个问题才渐渐缓解。
author: thelastmaleneko
source: While POKENAME are capable of delivering devastating punches with their highly developed arms, the unfortunate placement of these appendages often trips them up mid-fight. As they age, their weight distribution changes to help counteract this issue.

entry: 这种融合体酷似许多遗迹中的雕像，相似得令人发毛。一旦接到命令，就会不眠不休地执行，永不疲倦，还能借幻术隐秘行事。
author: elfail0
source: This fusion is eerily close in appearance to carved idols found in a number of ruins. When given an order, it will carry it out relentlessly, never resting or tiring. Its power over illusions allows it to do this work very discreetly.

entry: POKENAME在古代遗迹里，结队缓缓修复旧建筑，试图使其重现昔日光辉。它们相互轻声哼唱，和成哀歌，悼念失落的城池。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME can be found within ancient ruins, slowly working in teams to try and restore the old buildings to their former glory. They make gentle humming noises to one another, harmonising and creating a mournful song for their lost cities.

entry: 据说它手持的石板，会让附近的人感到不安。它无声飘过墓穴，目的不明，只留下诡异的气息。
author: .izik
source: The tablet it holds is said to make those nearby feel uneasy. It floats silently through tombs with an unknown purpose, leaving an eerie presence behind.

entry: 它钻进沙漠墓穴旁的沙丘，伪装得天衣无缝。探险者一靠近，便跃出将人拖入沙下。
author: .izik
source: It burrows into dunes near desert tombs, camouflaging itself perfectly. When explorers approach, it leaps out to drag them beneath the sands.

entry: 常能看到POKENAME沿着固定路线，在栖身洞穴里飞行，像在巡逻。翼上与胸前的符号会闪光，击昏并扰乱袭击者。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can be observed flying set paths within the caverns it calls home, as if on patrol. It can stun and confuse attackers by flashing lights from the symbols on its wings and chest.

entry: 它携带的石板，曾被占卜师用来窥见未来。凝神注视，会发出二十种独特色彩，但POKENAME会穿墙，避开不配窥视的人。
author: .izik
source: The tablet it carries was once used by fortune tellers to glimpse the future. It glows in twenty unique colors when deeply stared at, but POKENAME will phase through walls to avoid unworthy gazes.

entry: POKENAME从脚底喷出能量，瞬间加速。可身体太重，POKENAME在半空无法转向，常以惊人的冲击力撞上东西。
author: thelastmaleneko
source: POKENAME are able to channel energy from the soles of their feet into explosive bursts of speed. However, due to their weight, POKENAME lack the ability to change direction mid-flight, often causing them to slam into things with very alarming force.

entry: POKENAME的群落藏在古墓墙里，在黑暗中繁衍。墙面若有温热的地方，就可能发现这些隐秘群落。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME colonies are found in the walls of ancient tombs, thriving in the darkness. These hidden colonies can be detected through the presence of warm spots on the walls.

entry: POKENAME常在古遗迹里伪装成小罐。据传，嘴里的符文能让它发出超声波。
author: seanothan_23
source: POKENAME is often found in ancient ruins disguised as a small pot. It is rumored that the rune in its mouth allows it to emit supersonic waves.

entry: POKENAME凶猛守卫着嵌在古墓墙里的宝石。它警觉的天性，让它在寻宝人的故事里，成了备受推崇的护卫。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME fiercely guards gems embedded in the walls of ancient tombs. Its vigilant nature has made it a prized protector in stories of treasure hunters.

entry: 淋雨过久，陶土身体可能变脆、开裂。POKENAME不停锻炼，让双颚保持强劲的咬合力。
author: fiordaliso
source: If it remains in the rain for too long, its terracotta body risks weakening and cracking. POKENAME trains constantly to keep the grip of its jaws powerful.

entry: 庞大身体若在战斗中损坏，便退回洞穴，用黏土或泥土修补。POKENAME领地意识很强，谁敢闯入，都会被有力双颚碾碎。
author: fiordaliso
source: If parts of its massive body are damaged in battle, it retreats to its cavern to rebuild them using clay or soil. POKENAME is a territorial creature that crushes any intruder bold enough to encroach upon its domain between its powerful jaws.

entry: POKENAME是开裂的古老细颈瓶，漏出的沙会加速腐朽。凡被沙碰到的，都会化为尘土；它一路游荡，沙漠遗迹也随之崩塌，助沙漠无休止地收回土地。
author: silentscript89
source: POKENAME is a cracked, ancient flask whose leaking sand accelerates decay. Anything its sand touches crumbles to dust, and desert ruins slowly fall away as the vessel wanders, thus helping the desert reclaim the land in its relentless passage.

entry: POKENAME住在黑暗的地下墓穴，靠回声定位穿梭迷宫般的廊道。身手敏捷，即使一片漆黑，也能灵巧飞行。
author: .izik
source: Making their home in dark catacombs, POKENAME uses echolocation to navigate the labyrinthine halls. Their agility makes them excellent fliers, even in total darkness.

entry: POKENAME在林木环绕的神殿顶端筑巢。双翼由古老的棉絮状材料构成，轻如空气，独特的来历令研究者费解。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME nests atop forested temples, its wings as light as air and made of an ancient cotton-like material. The origin of its unique wings baffles researchers.

entry: 准备攻击时，脸颊上的螺纹会泛黄光。移动时分泌的黏液极其滑溜，很难追上它。
author: .izik
source: The spirals on its cheeks glow yellow when it prepares to attack. The mucus it secretes while moving is extremely slippery, making it hard to follow.

entry: POKENAME不安时，腹部螺纹便明亮发光。此时，头刺似乎也变得更尖，作为防御手段。
author: .izik
source: The spiral on its belly glows brightly when POKENAME is in distress. During these times, the spines on its head appear to grow sharper, serving as a defense mechanism.

entry: 古代遗物若被冲上岸，POKENAME便会本能地忠诚守护，不惜为这些珍宝献出性命。
author: .izik
source: Should ancient relics wash ashore, POKENAME will instinctively guard them with unmatched loyalty. It will defend these treasures with its life.

entry: 人们认为，古代园丁曾用POKENAME监测真菌的健康。它能极其准确地察觉蘑菇生病或濒死。
author: .izik
source: Ancient gardeners are believed to have used POKENAME to monitor the health of fungi. They can detect when a mushroom is sick or dying with startling accuracy.

entry: POKENAME在古遗迹里翻找陶片与砖石碎块，融进身体，用它们造出花盆运载植物，遮风避雨，帮助植物生长。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME can be found sifting through ancient ruins in search of fragments of pottery and masonry to incorporate into their bodies. They use these fragments to construct a pot to carry plants, sheltering them from the elements and helping them grow.

entry: 古代铁匠曾用它的头锤锻造盾牌。据说一击之力，连最坚硬的金属也能打弯。
author: .izik
source: Ancient blacksmiths once used its Headbutt to shape shields. The force of its strike was said to be strong enough to bend even the toughest metals.

entry: POKENAME用头顶的核战斗，从中喷出古老能量。有时，核会在撞击中折断，石质身躯便停止活动。
author: nexusshenanigans
source: POKENAME fights using the core on its head, which expels blasts of ancient energy. Sometimes, the core breaks off on impact, deactivating the stone creature.

entry: POKENAME出没在古文明遗迹附近。傍晚，核会发光指路，也能向远方传递信号。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME is found near the ruins of ancient civilizations. During evening hours, its core glows to act as a guiding light and can be used to send signals across long distances.

entry: POKENAME中央的大能量核里，伸出一个小小的头。头尖与尾尖能发射同样由这奇异能量形成的尖刺。
author: sk372
source: A small head unit pokes out from a large energy core in POKENAME's center. Quills formed from this same strange energy can be fired from the points on its head and tail.

entry: 古籍记载，POKENAME曾结队协同守卫村庄，一同扑向入侵者，用围攻将其赶走。
author: .izik
source: Ancient tomes tell of POKENAME guarding villages in coordinated packs. They pounced on invaders with Beat Up to drive them out together.

entry: POKENAME常在沉船旁漂游，仿佛仍守着失落已久的宝藏。潜水者抓着它锯齿状的骨架，让它带着自己迅速游过珊瑚与残骸。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME is often found drifting near sunken ships, as if still guarding some long-lost treasure. Divers cling to its jagged frame as it glides through the water, guiding them swiftly past coral and wreckage.

entry: 人们认为，许多古文明曾将POKENAME奉为神明，为它创作宗教图像。它与泥偶速狗合作困住恶灵，能用胡须传出幽灵信号，安抚它们。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Many ancient civilisations are believed to have treated POKENAME as deities, with religious iconography being dedicated to them. They work together with Golenine to trap evil spirits, able to send ghostly signals from their whiskers to pacify them.

entry: POKENAME曾被饲养在古王国的王城，象征地位。它与泥偶老大合作困住恶灵，快速绕圈奔跑，将恶灵困在原地。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME were kept in royal cities in ancient kingdoms, serving as status symbols. They work together with Golesian to trap evil spirits, rapidly running in circles to trap them and keep them in place.

entry: POKENAME很少出现在古神殿与神祠之外，担当着守护者。体内火焰燃烧时，坚硬的黏土身体能暂时泛起釉陶光泽。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME are rarely found outside ancient temples and shrines, acting as a guardian protector. When its inner fire burns, its hardened clay body can temporarily take on the sheen of glazed pottery.

entry: 尾巴既擅长挖掘，也擅长游泳。它们热心帮助人类，启发古代文明发明了铲子与船桨。
author: markusknight
source: Their tails are equally good at digging and swimming. They eagerly helped people and inspired the creation of shovels and oars in ancient civilizations.

entry: 人们先在古代壁画上发现了POKENAME的形象，很久之后才见到活体。腹部催眠般的纹样也曾被画作装饰。
author: markusknight
source: POKENAME was first discovered on ancient wall paintings, with the living species being discovered much later. The hypnotic pattern on their abdomen has been depicted as ornaments.

entry: POKENAME精力充沛，能长久游泳，关节间放出亮光。休息时，便会停机，沉眠于河床与湖底。
author: markusknight
source: POKENAME is full of energy. They swim for prolonged periods of time, shining bright from its joints. When the time comes to rest, they shut down and hibernate on the river and lake beds.

entry: POKENAME用巨力抬起、重置古神殿的石柱，常在修复被遗忘已久的废墟。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its immense strength to lift and reposition stone columns in ancient temples. They are often found restoring long-forgotten ruins.

entry: POKENAME的四肢，大半由古怪且略具刺激性的半流体构成。它能以不自然、无定形的方式快速弯曲四肢，出奇擅长完全避开攻击。
author: bobosmith01
source: An odd and mildly irritating semi-fluid comprises most of POKENAME's limbs. It is surprisingly adept at completely avoiding attacks by swiftly bending its limbs in unnatural and amorphous ways.

entry: POKENAME生活在某些古代遗址。它的形状与墙上的孔洞相合，因此可能是开启特定机关的钥匙。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME lives in certain ancient sites. Due to its shape and matching holes on the walls, it could have been used as a key for specific mechanisms.

entry: POKENAME稳稳滚过古迹长廊。若碰撞受损，就会搜集新材料，修补自己。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME rolls steadily through the corridors of ancient ruins. If it suffers damage due to collisions, it can collect new material for repairs.

entry: 它挥作武器的长杆，刻着古老纹路。研究者困惑了几十年，仍不知它从哪里取得这些独特遗物。
author: .izik
source: The pole it wields as a weapon bears ancient carvings. Researchers have puzzled for decades over where it obtains these unique relics.

entry: 它滑过破败遗迹，用身体的铜色黏液填补裂缝。凝固后能坚固数百年，科学家正尝试合成这种材料。
author: hophoppip
source: It glides over crumbling ruins, filling in cracks with the coppery slime of its body. Once hardened, this material remains durable for hundreds of years, so scientists are attempting to synthesize it.

entry: 钻穿坚石时，石板上的螺纹会明亮发光。有些古代矿工曾雇用POKENAME，开凿复杂的矿道。
author: .izik
source: The spiral on its tablet glows brightly while it digs through solid rock. Some ancient miners employed POKENAME to create intricate mine shafts.

entry: POKENAME住在古沉船里，保护船只不受潜水者侵扰。据说它会守护沉船宝藏，但并非总是如此。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME lives inside ancient sunken ships where it protects the ship from divers. It is said that POKENAME protect sunken treasure, but this is not always the case.

entry: POKENAME保护古沉船，驱赶掠夺者。巨钳能夹穿气瓶等装备，因此潜水者都会避开它的住处。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME protects ancient shipwrecks from looters. Its massive claw can pinch through air tanks and other equipment, so divers stay away from places where it lives.

entry: 这些喜欢群居的宝可梦，用悦耳鸣声和触角动作互传信号。伪装酷似花纹相近的某种毒属性宝可梦，还会跟它们同行，躲避天敌。
author: quackquackattack
source: These social Pokémon send signals to one another with beautiful chirps and antennae movements. Their camouflage resembles a Poison-type species with similar markings and will travel alongside them for protection against predators.

entry: 身上藤蔓长着羽毛，甩动便能获得升力。这种奇特动作，让它能短暂飞行。
author: .izik
source: The vines covering its body are feathered, allowing it to flick them for lift. This peculiar motion gives it the ability to fly for short bursts.

entry: POKENAME藏在瀑布上游的起始处，等圈圈熊来捕捉鱼形宝可梦。靠得够近，就跃出使出灼热的角钻。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME hide where waterfalls begin, waiting for Ursaring to hunt for fish Pokémon. When they get close enough, POKENAME leap out to deliver a scorching Horn Drill.

entry: POKENAME通常在日出时外出，采食一天所需的清晨花蜜。农人说，清晨有它飞过窗边，是好运的兆头。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME typically comes out during the sunrise to feed on early-morning nectar for the day. Farm folk say that having one flutter by the window in the morning is a sign of good luck.

entry: POKENAME的伪装让其他宝可梦误以为它有毒，得以在林间自在活动。它们交流哪里能找到最好吃的树果，结小群出行，以免迷失方向。
author: quackquackattack
source: Their camouflage enables these POKENAME freedom in the forest, as other Pokémon assume they are poisonous. They communicate about where to find the best berries to consume, and travel in small groups to maintain a sense of direction.

entry: 变成对手模样前，身体会先变得滚烫。若受打扰，变身后可能仍留着原本的喙。
author: .izik
source: Its body grows intensely hot before transforming and reshaping into its opponent. If disturbed, its original beak may persist after the transformation.

entry: POKENAME没有进化后那样的火力，面对威胁，只能给个微小电击，就飞快溜走。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME lack the firepower of their future evolutions. They can only give threats minuscule electrical shocks before skittering away.

entry: POKENAME的外壳模仿小箭雀，避免遭其他鸟宝可梦攻击。临近进化时，身体摸起来会暖暖的。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's outer shell mimics a Fletchling to dissuade other bird Pokémon from attacking it. Its body will become warm to the touch when it is ready for evolution.

entry: POKENAME自史前就已存在，沿海岸低飞。天性快乐，喜欢在沙滩上快步跑，脚步声意外地悦耳有调。
author: beatdoof
source: Having existed since the prehistoric ages, POKENAME live along the shores, flying low. Joyful by nature, they enjoy skittering across the beach with surprisingly tuneful steps.

entry: POKENAME用生动有表现力的舞蹈沟通。对方的回应够积极，刚结交的双方便一同狩猎，巩固新结的友谊。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME communicate with each other via vibrant and expressive dances. If the response to a dance is positive enough, the pair of newly-formed friends will go hunt together to solidify their new alliance.

entry: 太阳刚升起，POKENAME便聚成大群合唱。嗓音较弱，啁啾与哨鸣到太阳完全升起时，就已结束。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME sing together in large flocks just as the sun begins to rise. Their voices are rather weak, so the chirping and whistling is concluded by the time the sun has fully risen.

entry: POKENAME与其他鸟宝可梦玩耍时，羽毛在万千色彩间变幻。玩够了，就瞬间移动到云间睡觉。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's feathers oscillate between a myriad of colors while it plays with other bird Pokémon. Once it has had enough fun, it teleports away to sleep among the clouds.

entry: POKENAME用羽毛控制阵风。不过风大的日子，自己有时也会被吹倒。
author: elite01.
source: POKENAME uses its feather to control gusts of winds. It will sometimes get blown over on windy days.

entry: POKENAME身体很轻，背上的火翼能带它升空。飞行时，拍翼的热浪使它如海市蜃楼般闪烁。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's body is light enough that the fiery wings on their back can lift them into the air. When POKENAME fly through the air, the heat haze of their flapping wings makes them shimmer like a mirage.

entry: POKENAME成小群飞行，用阵风将余烬吹散到田野。它们在空中画出火焰图案，向同伴示警或指路。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME flies in small flocks, using gusts of wind to spread embers across fields. It communicates with others through fiery patterns in the sky, signaling warnings or directions.

entry: POKENAME的鸣叫有节奏，还会随时辰调整。夜里，翼上的火微微发光，仿佛黑暗中的远处灯笼。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME chirps in rhythmic patterns, adjusting its calls based on the time of day. At night, the flames on its wings glow faintly, resembling distant lanterns in the dark.

entry: 它引导翼边气流，增加出拳速度。这份气流助力，让它在空中成为难缠的攻击手。
author: .izik
source: By channeling air currents around its wings, it increases the speed of its punches. This aerodynamic boost makes it a formidable attacker while flying.

entry: 它用黏网补好晾晒衣服上的破洞。虽是一片好意，衣服却常被黏在一起。
author: .izik
source: It patches holes in clothes left to dry with its sticky webbing. Despite its good intentions, the garments often end up stuck together.

entry: POKENAME没有飞行所需的翼羽，便蹦蹦跳跳游历四方。不找食物时，常能听见它咿呀唱歌。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME lack the wing feathers they need to fly so they bounce throughout the world instead. When they are not looking for food, they can be heard babbling songs.

entry: POKENAME对人与宝可梦都很友善，以2马赫翱翔天际，展示优雅的羽毛。
author: asyoko
source: POKENAME is very friendly towards humans and Pokémon. It soars through the skies at Mach 2 speed, displaying it's elegant feathers.

entry: POKENAME用尾巴与鸣叫沟通，每只都有独特的声音。羽毛摸起来温暖又蓬松。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME use their tails and chirps to communicate, each one having distinctive noises. Their feathers are really warm and fluffy to the touch.

entry: 城市里的POKENAME越来越多，合众尤其如此。它们友善，又爱与兄弟姐妹唱可爱的歌，成了很受欢迎的宠物。
author: sk372
source: Urban areas are seeing an uptick in POKENAME populations, particularly in Unova. Friendly and prone to singing cute songs amongst its siblings, POKENAME has become a popular pet.

entry: POKENAME是少数不迁离寒冷地区过冬的鸟宝可梦之一。它全年准备越冬，筑起铺满苔藓、毛与羽毛的暖巢，外面还分泌一层凝胶防水。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME are one of the few bird Pokémon that don't migrate from frigid regions over winter. They prepare for the winter all year, building a warm nest full of moss, fur and feathers. They secrete a gel over the outside of it to keep it waterproof.

entry: POKENAME是少数不迁离寒冷地区过冬的鸟宝可梦之一。它全年准备越冬，筑起铺满苔藓、毛与羽毛的暖巢。有时，巢内还能看到一小团火。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME are one of the few bird Pokémon that don't migrate from frigid regions over winter. They prepare for the winter all year, building a warm nest full of moss, fur and feathers. Sometimes, a small fire can be found inside.

entry: POKENAME白天觅食，靠帽子般的头冠遮挡强烈阳光。夜里聚群，沙哑响亮的叫声会吵得人好几个小时睡不着，被当成扰人的家伙。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's hat-shaped crest helps protect them from bright sunlight as they forage in the day. Flocks gather at night, keeping people awake for hours with their loud, raspy cries to the point of being considered a nuisance.

entry: POKENAME平时平静亲人，向其他宝可梦欢快鸣叫。战斗时，却会后腿站立、露出獠牙，凶狠尖叫，恐吓敌人。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME are normally calm and affectionate, chirping cheerfully at other Pokémon. In battle, they rear up on their hind legs, bare their fangs, and aggressively shriek to intimidate foes.

entry: 它翅膀太小，无法长久飞行，羽毛还常被贪吃来的蜂蜜黏住。为抵御采集或酿造那些蜂蜜的虫属性宝可梦，它会喷出团团高热。
author: infinex21
source: Not only are their wings too small to fly for long, but their feathers are also often stuck together with honey. They expel puffs of intense heat to defend themselves from the Bug-type Pokémon who had collected or made the honey they gorge upon.

entry: 这只小宝可梦虽有翅膀，却更爱在地上走。它很容易与其他小宝可梦交朋友，还愿分享食物。
author: holzycookie
source: Despite having wings, this little Pokémon likes to walk around on the ground. It easily befriends other small Pokémon, sharing its food with them.

entry: POKENAME停在阳光下，让金属双翼受热。温度升得够高，就能飞撞敌人，将其烧伤。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME perches in the sunlight so its metallic wings will heat up. Once it has raised their temperature enough, it can burn its foes by flying into them.

entry: POKENAME游得越快，体温越高。全速前进时，能隐约看到周围的水冒泡沸腾。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's body heat increases the faster it swims. One can faintly see the water around it bubbling and boiling whenever it moves at its top speed.

entry: 它将尾部的黄色黏液抹在其他宝可梦巢上。虽无害，这习惯却常惹恼领地意识强的宝可梦。
author: .izik
source: It rubs yellow ooze from its tail on the nests of other Pokémon. Although harmless, this habit often angers territorial Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME飞快转动双臂，造出小阵风让自己升空。着陆时常稳不住，双臂一阵乱挥，迸出火花。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME rapidly spin their arms in order to create small gusts of wind and lift themselves off the ground. They often struggle to balance themselves when they land, wildly flailing their arms and releasing sparks.

entry: 它靠有弹性的尾巴弹起，积攒势头再起飞，得以优雅升空。
author: .izik
source: It bounces off its springy tail to gain momentum before taking flight. This technique allows it to soar gracefully into the air.

entry: POKENAME飘过天空时，会用控火能力表演绚丽光景。至少，它是这么打算的；可往往不小心惹出小火灾，还得自己踩灭。
author: bobosmith01
source: As POKENAME levitates through the skies, it creates dazzling displays of light with its pyrokinesis. At least, it tries to: POKENAME typically and accidentally causes small fires that it needs to stamp out.

entry: POKENAME飘过天空时，会用控火能力表演绚丽光景。至少，它是这么打算的；可往往不小心惹出小火灾，还得自己踩灭。
author: bobosmith01
source: As POKENAME levitates through the skies, it creates dazzling displays of light with its pyrokinesis. At least, it tries to: POKENAME typically and accidentally causes small fires that it needs to stamp out.

entry: POKENAME沿海岸栖居，捕食易下手的水生宝可梦。每逢雷暴，便寻找烛木果，抵御危险的雷击。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME make their homes along coastlines to pick off vulnerable aquatic Pokémon. Whenever there is a thunderstorm, they search for Wacan Berries to insulate themselves from the dangerous lightning.

entry: POKENAME用悦耳鸣声，以及翅膀挥出的各种图案沟通。个子小，飞翔或滑行都维持不久，因此总先爬上树枝，再从高处起飞。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME communicate with each other via beautiful chirps and by waving their wings around in various patterns. They are small, so they can only fly or glide for so long; because of this, they always climb atop tree branches and take off from them.

entry: 它精力充沛，爱四处奔跑，摔多少次都会再站起来。喜欢停在心爱训练家的肩上或手臂上，婉转唱歌。
author: infinex21
source: It is a bundle of energy that loves to run around. It will get back up no matter how often it trips. It loves to perch upon the shoulder or arm of its beloved Trainer and chirp singsongy tunes.

entry: POKENAME战斗时十分凶猛，用利爪与脚爪攻敌。战况越激烈，身体便越热，火焰攻击也越强。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME are aggressive fighters in combat, using their sharp claws and talons to attack foes. When battles get heated, POKENAME's bodies heat up, and their fiery attacks become stronger.

entry: POKENAME与同群伙伴盘旋列阵飞行，身后拖着蒸汽轨迹。不同地区的群体，飞行图案差别极大。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME flies with others from their flock in spiraling formations, leaving trails of steam behind. Flocks from different regions display vastly different flight patterns.

entry: 它先像飞行般扑动小手臂，再啄向对手。这一击往往没多少力道，却显出了决心。
author: .izik
source: It flaps its small arms as if flying before pecking at its opponent. The attack often lacks strength but shows its determination.

entry: POKENAME会唱收音机里听来的歌，舞姿优雅有风采。它一心想成为最出色的，训练时坚持不懈，却常因用力过度伤到自己。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME chirps out songs it hears on the radio and gracefully dances with elegance and style. Its desire to become the very best is exemplified by its perseverance during training, as it is prone to hurting itself from overexertion.

entry: POKENAME天性和善，却容易受惊。突遭惊吓时，能迅速变色融入周围，只有腰间的锯齿花纹无法掩藏。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are amiable by nature, though they are quick to be startled. When taken by surprise, they can quickly shift their colors to blend in, save for the zigzag patterns wrapped around their midsections.

entry: POKENAME用鸣声与脑信号构成的系统沟通。专家至今尚未解读出这套复杂语言。
author: _snakeywakey_
source: POKENAME communicate with one another via a system of chirps and brain signals. Experts have yet to decipher this intricate language.

entry: 它飞到峡谷顶端，把树撞倒进下方河流。人们认为，这是为巢穴改变水流方向。
author: .izik
source: It flies to the tops of canyons to knock down trees into the rivers below. This behavior is thought to help redirect water flow for its nests.

entry: POKENAME后脑还长着一对翅膀，主翼损伤也能帮它飞行。那对翼里虽有第二张喙，它却只用主喙吃东西，毕竟后脑很难清洗。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME has an extra set of wings on the back of its head that can help it fly if its main wings are damaged. Even though there is a second beak in those wings, it only eats with its main beak because it is difficult to clean behind its head.

entry: 光合作用被打断，POKENAME就会毫不留情地啄人，直到对方离开。光合作用会让体温上升，啄击也常造成烧伤。
author: darkweavile428
source: If POKENAME is interrupted while photosynthesizing, it will mercilessly peck the offender until they leave. Since POKENAME's body temperature increases during photosynthesis, these pecks often cause burns.

entry: POKENAME背上灌丛长出的叶子，质地像羽毛。它会蓬起叶片，吓退过于靠近巢穴的生物。
author: .izik
source: The leaves growing from the bushes on POKENAME's back are similar in consistency to feathers. It puffs these leaves out to intimidate those who draw too close to its nest.

entry: 歌声被打断，它就会全身燃烧，暴怒尖鸣，不停啄那打扰者。骤然放出的热量太强，尾羽得花几天才能重新长出。
author: catsquatch_geography
source: When its song is interrupted, its whole body ignites and enters a chirping rage, relentlessly pecking at whatever disturbed it. The flash of heat this produces is so powerful that it takes several days for its tail feathers to regrow.

entry: POKENAME常把角误当成喙，结果没吃到食物，只把食物戳穿。常能看到它角上插着树果，到处游荡。
author: techlaw
source: POKENAME often mistake their horn for its beak, leading them to impale food rather than eat it. It's not uncommon to spot one wandering with a berry stuck on its horn.

entry: POKENAME站在临水岩石边，再纵身跳起，争取几秒腾空时间。这额外的几秒，能帮助它扎进水里，游得更快。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: Standing on a stone's edge above the water, POKENAME will jump from a rock to gain some air time. These additional few seconds help these Pokémon dive into the water and increase their swim speed.

entry: POKENAME用滚烫的尾羽替同伴烘干。羽毛相当脆，游得太快，有时会脱落。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME dries its allies using its incredibly hot tail feathers. These feathers are quite brittle and occasionally fall out when it swims too fast.

entry: POKENAME的触角由成千上万根小羽毛组成。它将触角逆时针飞旋，推动自己穿梭天空。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's feelers are composed of thousands of tiny feathers. It rotates them counterclockwise at great speed to propel itself through the sky.

entry: 常能看到POKENAME用长耳般的翅膀在空中滑翔，也常在草原觅食。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME is seen gliding in the air through the use of its long ear-like wings. It is commonly seen foraging in grasslands.

entry: POKENAME的翅膀不适合长途飞行，宁愿挖地到达目的地。飞得太频繁，会大量掉羽毛。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME prefers to dig to its destination as its wings are poorly suited for long-term flight. Should it fly too frequently, its feathers will fall off in large quantities.

entry: POKENAME醒着时，用悦耳鸣声互相呼唤，确认没离鸟群太远。春天聚集交配，结成伴侣的双方会分享食物，轮流睡觉。
author: infinex21
source: When POKENAME are awake, they cry out to one another using beautiful chirps to make sure they have not gone too far from their flocks. In spring, they gather to mate; a pair of POKENAME mates will share their food together and alternate sleep cycles.

entry: 俯冲啄敌前，耳朵会噼啪放电。火花让它在夜里很显眼，伏击时也一样。
author: .izik
source: Its ears crackle with electricity before it dives to peck at its foe. The sparks make it easy to spot at night, even when ambushing.

entry: POKENAME用尾巴当避雷针，收集攻击所需的能量。虽还没长出翅膀，仍想方设法腾空，试着滑翔。
author: c0u51nv1nn7
source: POKENAME is known for using its tail as a lightning rod to gather energy for its attacks. Despite not yet having grown out wings, POKENAME will still find ways to get into the air to try and glide.

entry: POKENAME开朗又亲人，能飞就欣喜若狂，常只为高兴而扑翼飞翔。许多个体不愿进化，害怕失去飞行的能力。
author: bobosmith01
source: Upbeat and affectionate, POKENAME is positively ecstatic to be able to fly and will joyfully flap around for the sake of it. Many POKENAME don't want to evolve, as they fear they may lose the ability to fly.

entry: POKENAME能用鸣叫模仿其他宝可梦，骗得筑巢的亲鸟送来本该喂给幼鸟的食物。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are able to mimic the sounds of other Pokémon with their chirping, fooling nesting Pokémon into bringing them food that would otherwise have gone to the parents' young.

entry: POKENAME用翅膀与燃火的尾巴摆出各种姿势，互相沟通。兴奋时，身体升温，尾火也狂乱跳动。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME communicate with one another by striking various poses using their wings and flame-lit tails. When they get excited, their bodies heat up and their tail flames dance wildly.

entry: POKENAME花苞里长出的羽毛，有甘草香，能安抚同类。香气浓，许多人拿来做香料干花。
author: .izik
source: The feather growing from POKENAME's bud releases a licorice scent that calms others of its kind. Many use it for potpourri due to its strong aroma.

entry: POKENAME讨厌陌生人闯领地，攻击前会尖声叫。只有孩子能进它的家；孩子一靠近，它便暖起周围，让环境舒适亲切。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME detests strangers in its territory, letting out a high-pitched squeal before attacking. It only allows children to enter its home. As soon as they come near, POKENAME will warm the surrounding area until it feels cosy and inviting.

entry: POKENAME受惊时，会一跃冲上天空。锐利视力让它能远远发现危险。
author: fredfeyh
source: When startled, POKENAME launches itself skyward in a single leap. Its sharp eyesight allows it to spot dangers from great distances.

entry: POKENAME将喙探出薄膜，吹出小泡沟通。泡泡破裂时，会发出细小的、如同它鸣叫的声音。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME communicates by poking its beak through its membrane and blowing small bubbles. The bubbles create tiny versions of POKENAME's cry when they pop.

entry: POKENAME飞行时振翼极快，看起来像身体两侧各有两组静止的翅膀。虽然拍得快，飞行速度却并不出众。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's wings beat so rapidly in flight that it appears to have two sets of still wings on either side of its body. Despite the speed of its wingbeats, it is not a particularly fast flyer.

entry: 野生POKENAME刚孵化时较为虚弱。虽看不出多大攻防本领，却容易突然爆发出破坏力惊人的火焰能量。
author: chaos_emblemx
source: Wild POKENAME are hatched relatively frail. Despite lacking obvious offensive or defensive power, they are prone to random and devastating bursts of flaming energy.

entry: POKENAME爱睡在吸收它热量的大块光滑岩石上。其他宝可梦常来取暖，可它一醒来，就会把它们啄走。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME love to sleep on large smooth rocks that absorb their heat. Other Pokémon often join to enjoy some of the warmth, but as soon as POKENAME wakes, it pecks them away.

entry: POKENAME从嘴里吐出灼热毒液。这种绿胶，片刻就能令皮肤起泡。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spits searing hot toxin from its mouth. This green goo can cause the skin to blister within moments.

entry: 休息时，POKENAME会附身密林里的空心树桩。树桩表面随之发热，有时甚至热到燃烧。
author: .izik
source: To rest, POKENAME possesses hollow stumps in dense woods. The stump's surface grows hot, sometimes hot enough to ignite.

entry: 春天的早晨，它不停叫，直到看见有人醒来。它为自己的努力得意洋洋，自觉帮了忙，就飞走了。
author: .izik
source: On spring mornings, it chirps nonstop until it sees someone wake up. Feeling proud of its effort, it flies away thinking it has been helpful.

entry: 它在托儿所旁假扮毛绒玩具，轻易混入其中。点心时间一到，就推倒幼儿抢走零食，再飞走。
author: .izik
source: It pretends to be a stuffed toy near daycares, blending in with ease. During snack time, it pushes over toddlers to steal their treats before flying off.

entry: POKENAME沙状身体伸出的羽毛，微微发光，吸引绿毛虫等猎物。等对方靠近，便使出啄。
author: .izik
source: The feather protruding from POKENAME's sand-like body glows slightly to attract prey such as Caterpie. Once they draw close, it strikes with Peck.

entry: POKENAME身上寄生着纤细的猴头菌属真菌。真菌形似羽毛，被它用来滑翔，逃离危险。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have fine, fibrous Hericium mushrooms parasitising their bodies. These mushrooms take a feathery appearance and are used by POKENAME to glide away from danger.

entry: 幼年POKENAME常结小群，从矮岩沿往下跳，锻炼双翼。它们合群又易训练，很适合成为新手训练家的第一只宝可梦。
author: chibitales
source: Juvenile POKENAME often form small groups and strengthen their wings by jumping from small ledges. Because they are very social and easy to train, POKENAME make great starter Pokémon for new Trainers.

entry: POKENAME的蛋深埋在火山周围的地下。数月的地底压力与高热，让它们身上形成水晶。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME eggs are buried deep in the ground surrounding volcanoes. The many months of deep pressure and heat form crystals on their bodies.

entry: POKENAME用树枝围住身体，结成移动的巢。既能保护后代，也能随身提供引火物，用于火焰攻击。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME surrounds its body with sticks to form a mobile nest. Besides protecting its offspring, the nest also serves as a portable source of kindling for its fire-based attacks.

entry: POKENAME用叶盘当滑翔伞，在树间滑行。看见训练家带着食物，就常跟着不停叫，直到被喂食。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME's pad acts like a paraglider, allowing them to glide between trees. They often follow Trainers with visible food and chirp incessantly until fed.

entry: 它甩尾时，尾尖羽毛会撒出余烬；也会一边摇尾、一边发出各种鸣叫，与同类沟通。兴奋或烦躁时，爪子变得滚烫。
author: infinex21
source: When it swings its tail, it scatters embers from the feathers upon the tail's tip; it communicates with others of its kind by waving its tail while emitting myriad chirps. Its claws burn hot when it gets excited or agitated.

entry: POKENAME啄食地下的根维生。它突如其来的叫声，曾惊醒林中许多宝可梦。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME peck at underground roots to nourish themselves. The unexpected cry of a POKENAME has awakened many Pokémon in the forest.

entry: POKENAME与同类欢快地跃出波浪，急速振翼，长时间留在空中。遗落的羽毛若在干地放得太久，就会溶解。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME hops happily from the waves with others of its kind, fluttering its wings rapidly to stay airborne for extended periods. The feathers it leaves behind dissolve if left on dry land for too long.

entry: POKENAME只能短暂飞行，头痛的痛楚总逼它落地。若揉头缓解偏头痛，头顶又会飞出灼热火花。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can only fly in short bursts, as its headaches require it to land due to the pain. If it rubs its head to soothe the migraine, hot sparks fly off of its cranium.

entry: 它们贴近湖泊与池塘低飞，用尾巴划过水面，向上方树枝的虫宝可梦泼水，想把它们打下来当饭吃。
author: quackquackattack
source: They fly low to the surface of lakes and ponds to drag their tails across the surface. They splash water onto bug Pokémon in branches above them in the hopes of knocking them down to secure a meal.

entry: 它们用有力手臂挖开、敲碎岩石，露出底下的根，再一头扎进地里，啄开撕碎树根进食。
author: quackquackattack
source: They dig up and break rocks with their muscular arms to expose roots underneath. Afterwards, they dive headfirst into the ground to peck and rip apart the roots for consumption.

entry: 光滑甲壳与强劲双翼，让它能快速游泳。它能用喙压缩泡泡，再像子弹般吐出。
author: infinex21
source: It can swim at great speeds thanks to how smooth its shell is and how strong its wings are. Using its beak, it can compress bubbles and spit them out like bullets.

entry: POKENAME只要奋力拍翼，就能稍稍离地飞行。飞着时常想夹住下方猎物，却因此失去平衡，摔回地面。
author: sk372
source: If POKENAME flaps hard enough, it can lift its body off the ground a small distance and achieve flight. It often tries to snap at prey beneath it while flying, but this destroys its balance and sends it crashing to the ground.

entry: POKENAME的羽翼泛着燃烧余烬的光，夜里也能看见它飞行。长久干旱时，寻花途中可能无意引发森林大火。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The feathery wings of POKENAME glow with burning embers making their flight visible at night. They can inadvertently cause forest fires while searching for flowers during prolonged dry periods.

entry: POKENAME在火山间歇泉附近筑巢。吸足热量后，羽毛泛白，闪出危险的强光。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME nests near volcanic geysers. When it absorbs enough heat, its feathers glow white and shimmer with dangerous intensity.

entry: 它能将双翼藏在壳下，直到看见岸边丰盛的猎物。有人说，POKENAME的叫声与振翼声，令人想起某个古帝国的颂歌。
author: beatdoof
source: It can tuck its wings beneath its shell until it sees a veritable smorgasbord of prey along the shores. POKENAME's cries and wing flapping are said to be reminiscent of an ancient empire's anthem.

entry: 部分POKENAME随着体格成长，需要更多食物，难免与群中伙伴产生冲突。獠牙什么都能咬穿，注入火焰后尤其厉害。
author: beatdoof
source: Some POKENAME require more food as they grow to accommodate their growing physique, inevitably creating conflict between others of their flock. Their fangs are capable of gnashing through anything, especially when infused with flames.

entry: POKENAME的羽毛格外温暖。雪山里遇上迷路旅人，会送一根羽毛保暖；对方一到安全地方，便立刻收回。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's feathers are extremely warm. It will give a lost traveler in snowy mountains a feather to keep them warm, retrieving it the moment they reach safety.

entry: POKENAME用火翼对付捕猎的虫属性宝可梦，尤其适合抵御大针蜂。它常闯蜂巢偷蜜，惹得大针蜂前来攻击。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME use their fiery wings against the Bug-type Pokémon they hunt. POKENAME find them to be particularly useful as a defense against Beedrill, which are often provoked into attacking by POKENAME raiding their hives for honey.

entry: POKENAME一边用火翼赶开大群大针蜂，一边闯入蜂巢偷蜜。采来的蜜，还会分给火箭雀。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME use their fiery wings to fend off swarms of Beedrill while raiding their hives for honey. POKENAME will share the honey they gather with Fletchinder.

entry: 捕猎时，POKENAME会发出咳嗽般的声音，喷出一小团火。这让人们有了祝病人康复的俗语：“飞走吧，POKENAME。”
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: When hunting, POKENAME makes a coughing-like sound that produces a small burst of flames. This behavior inspired a common saying wishing good health to the ill: "Fly away, POKENAME".

entry: 谁若靠近巢地，它们就喷出灼热的酸。被酸沾到，得接受合适且有针对性的治疗，才能彻底康复。
author: bobosmith01
source: If one encroaches near their nesting grounds, they spit a burning acid. If the acid touches someone, they will require proper and specific treatment in order to fully recover from the affliction.

entry: 筑巢时，它会找辣椒，将辣椒汁挤在巢底，享受羽毛上传来的辛辣感。
author: .izik
source: When building its nest, it searches for hot pepper plants. It squirts pepper juice on the base, enjoying the spicy sensation on its feathers.

entry: POKENAME讨厌羽毛湿漉漉的感觉，暴雨中绝不起飞。捕猎时，会加热喙与爪，让攻击更加致命。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME never takes flight during rainstorms, as it hates the feeling of wet feathers. When hunting, it heats both its beak and its claws to make its attacks even more lethal.

entry: 它嗡嗡掠过溪面，身后留下热的轨迹。放出的热空气，让人用温度计就能轻易追踪它。
author: .izik
source: It buzzes across creek surfaces, leaving trails of heat in its wake. Tracking it becomes easy with a thermometer due to the hot air it generates.

entry: POKENAME喷火的速度远快于飞行，于是悬停水面上方，向下抛火球。附近不幸的生物，转眼就被烧熟。它不吃烫食，还得等食物冷却。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME can spit fire much faster than it can fly, so it hovers above bodies of water and hurls balls of fire at them. Anything unlucky enough to be in the vicinity is flash-fried. POKENAME refuses to eat hot food, so it allows the food to cool.

entry: POKENAME喷火的速度远快于飞行，于是悬停水面上方，向下抛火球。附近不幸的生物，转眼就被烧熟。它们可能破坏生态。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME can spit fire much faster than it can fly, so it hovers above bodies of water and hurls balls of fire at them. Anything unlucky enough to be in the vicinity is flash-fried. They can have negative effects on ecosystems.

entry: POKENAME翅膀太小，飞不起来，却很会游泳。它张嘴游过沼泽水域，沿路的虫子全落入口中。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's wings are too small for flight, but it's a good swimmer. It glides through swampy water with its mouth open, catching all the bugs in its path.

entry: POKENAME背上的蛋用来引诱猎物。POKENAME通过蛋分泌麻痹毒素，等猎物动弹不得，再用燃烧的藤蔓烤熟。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: The egg on the back of POKENAME is used as a lure for its prey. POKENAME secretes a paralysing poison through the egg, and while its prey is immobilised, it will cook them with its fiery vines.

entry: POKENAME无声飞过夜空时，牙会烧得通红，远看格外诡异，令扎营的旅人视它为凶兆。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's teeth grow red hot as it flies silently through the night sky. This creates an incredibly eerie sight from afar, causing travelers to regard it as an ill omen while making camp.

entry: 闹脾气时，它停上高树，用火焰烧焦附近灌丛。这种发火，常只是为了泄愤。
author: .izik
source: When throwing a tantrum, it perches on tall trees and scorches nearby bushes with flames. This fiery outburst is often done out of spite.

entry: POKENAME捕猎虫属性宝可梦，一路追到巢里，放火将猎物赶出，再捕来吃。尤其偏爱大针蜂，连它们酿的蜜也喜欢。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME hunt Bug-type Pokémon and track them to their nests. They expel flames to drive their prey out from their nests to capture and feed on them. They are especially partial to Beedrill and the honey they make.

entry: 它把鼻子伸进间歇泉，吸取强烈热量，帮助鼻子在寒冷季节保持温暖。
author: .izik
source: It sticks its nose into geysers to soak up the intense heat. This habit helps warm its nose during colder seasons.

entry: POKENAME用羽毛堵住运转机器的通风口，让机器过热，好睡在上面。城市生活让它懒惰不堪，连巢也不想筑。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME blocks the ventilation openings of machines it finds in circulation with its feathers, causing them to overheat so it can sleep on top of them. Living in an urban environment has made it very lazy; it never feels like building a nest.

entry: 感到威胁，POKENAME便蓬起颈膜边的羽毛。若觉得吓不住对方，就蜿蜒上前，凶狠啄向让它害怕的生物。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME fluff out the feathers lining their hood when they feel like they're being threatened. They slither forward and peck viciously at whatever they're afraid of if they feel like their display isn't working.

entry: 吃下的美食越多，火焰便越亮。饱饱的肚子，能大幅增强火焰攻击的威力。
author: .izik
source: The more delicious food it consumes, the brighter its flames become. A full belly significantly boosts the power of its fire attacks.

entry: POKENAME虽爱寒冷气候，体热却足以融化巢边积雪。环境反差鲜明，让它在野外的住处很好辨认。
author: sk372
source: Though it prefers frigid climates, the warmth from POKENAME's body is enough to melt snow around its den. A POKENAME habitat is easy to spot in the wild due to this stark environmental contrast.

entry: POKENAME是臭名昭著的偷蛋贼。全速能跑到每小时50英里，还会借势跃起，短暂滑翔。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: POKENAME is a notorious egg thief. When it runs at its top speed of 50 mph, it jumps into the air and glides for short periods of time.

entry: 短粗的腿，让POKENAME宁愿待在空中，不愿落地。战斗时，靠体内火焰守卫领地、驱赶入侵者。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME tend to remain in the air rather than on the ground due to their stubby legs. When in combat, POKENAME fight using their internal fire to protect their territory and ward off intruders.

entry: POKENAME用发达双腿强力踢击，也用来将自己弹上天空。翅膀已发育得足以滑翔数小时，才需休息。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME use their developed legs to deliver strong kicks and to launch themselves into the air. Their wings are developed enough to let them glide for hours before needing to rest.

entry: POKENAME加热嘴里的水，射出能击碎巨石的蒸汽弹。羽毛般的鳍，帮助调节体温。
author: lampent12
source: By heating the water in their mouth, POKENAME can fire steam bullets that shatter boulders. The feathery fins help manage their body temperature.

entry: 它先喷火威吓、驱赶旁人，再趁混乱变色藏身，悄悄溜走。用喙敲开坚果与硬水果，都是它最爱的食物。
author: infinex21
source: It spits fire to intimidate and deter others and changes colors in the midst of the resulting chaos to hide and sneak away. It uses its beak to crack open nuts and to break into hard fruits, both of which are its favorite kinds of foods.

entry: POKENAME精细控制余烬，烧灼原木筑巢。领地意识很强，谁敢靠近它的坝，就向谁喷火星。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME builds its nests by carefully burning logs with controlled embers. It is highly territorial and will spit sparks at any intruders that approach its dam.

entry: POKENAME统治着半径一英里的领地，赶走任何可能与它争食的宝可梦。研究者发现，它还真会“头脑发热”：羽毛温度与自大程度成正比。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME reigns over a territory a mile in radius, fending off any other Pokémon that might compete for food. Researchers have noticed that it is literally hot-headed with the temperature of its feathers being proportional to its ego.

entry: 许多人珍爱日出日落时，野生POKENAME成群滑过天空的景象。羽毛即使脱落，也仍温暖，握在手里能让人平静。
author: infinex21
source: The sight of herds of wild POKENAME gliding through the air at sunrise and sunset is treasured by many. Their feathers remain warm even after being shed and have a calming effect on those who hold them.

entry: 这种形态的POKENAME翱翔于卡洛斯天空。它用宽阔温暖的双翼，拥抱、安抚害怕或过度焦虑的宝可梦。
author: fiordaliso
source: This variant of POKENAME is known to soar through the skies of the Kalos region. It uses its broad, warm wings to embrace and calm frightened or overly anxious Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME飞过后，周身羽毛仍能长久保温。寒夜里，常替较小的宝可梦遮护。
author: fredfeyh
source: The feathers around POKENAME's body retain warmth long after flight. It often shelters smaller Pokémon during cold nights.

entry: POKENAME快得能在空中留下余烬轨迹。一见猎物，便燃火俯冲出击，再化作模糊火影飞走。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME moves so fast that it leaves behind trails of cinders in the air. If it spots prey, it strikes with a fiery dive before jetting away in a blur of flames.

entry: 体内充满易燃液体，移动时晃来晃去。它先将液体吐向敌人，再用火焰攻击点燃。
author: .izik
source: Its body is filled with a flammable liquid that jiggles as it moves. It spits this liquid at foes before igniting it with fiery attacks.

entry: POKENAME从胸核发射激光，点燃高草。藏在草里的宝可梦想逃离火海时，它便以快得看不清的速度扑上去。
author: darkweavile428
source: POKENAME fires lasers from the core on its chest at tall grass to light it on fire. When the Pokémon that were hiding in the tall grass attempt to flee from the blaze, POKENAME pounces on them with blinding speed.

entry: POKENAME察觉周围的斗志，便会增强火焰回应。它与同伴切磋时，会发射小火球，考验对方耐力。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME senses the fighting spirit of those around it and responds by increasing the intensity of its flames. It spars with others by launching small fireballs to test their endurance.

entry: POKENAME对自己的玫瑰极其讲究，用喙与双翼细心照料，维持完美状态。花若被撕坏，便会暴怒，不惜一切复仇。
author: darxer_
source: POKENAME is very particular about its roses, using its beak and wings meticulously to keep them in perfect condition. If the roses are ever ripped, it will become enraged and stop at nothing for revenge.

entry: POKENAME高速俯冲后，落地处会留下淡淡焦痕。研究者用这些痕迹追踪它的行踪。
author: fredfeyh
source: POKENAME leaves faint scorch marks wherever it lands after a high-speed dive. These marks are used by researchers to track its movements.

entry: POKENAME周围的胶质极易燃，能让它点燃全身攻击。取少量涂在柴上，也能让营火更快燃起。
author: hophoppip
source: The jelly surrounding POKENAME is highly flammable, allowing it to ignite its whole body as an attack. Small amounts of the jelly can be harvested and spread on firewood to help a campfire ignite faster.

entry: POKENAME快如飞箭，最快的虫宝可梦也能捉到。冬天常挤在烟囱里互相取暖，让许多靠壁炉御寒的人家烦恼不已。
author: chibitales
source: Swift as an arrow, POKENAME can catch even the fastest bug Pokémon. They often roost in chimneys when winter strikes to keep each other warm, causing a nuisance to many homes that rely on lit fireplaces to keep warm.

entry: 扑向猎物前，POKENAME会兴奋得宝石眼闪出明亮火橙光。可惜藏不住喜悦，往往暴露藏身处，让猎物先逃了。
author: periperi_chicken
source: Just before POKENAME pounces on its prey, its gemstone eyes will glint a bright, fiery orange in sheer excitement. Unfortunately, their inability to hide their joy often leads to their prey noticing their hiding spots and fleeing.

entry: POKENAME的头太重，飞行间得频频停下休息双翼。红皮肤不停放热，贸然触碰的人常会被烫伤。
author: fiordaliso
source: Since its massive head is too heavy, POKENAME has to take frequent breaks to rest its wings after flying. Its red skin constantly emits heat, which is why anyone who touches it without caution often ends up getting burned.

entry: POKENAME的双翼柔如棉花，却散出强热。它停在树顶晒太阳，让火焰始终保持最强。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's wings are soft like cotton, but they radiate intense heat. It perches atop treetops, basking in the sun to keep its flames at peak strength.

entry: POKENAME维持高体温，想赶走身上的寄生真菌。干掉的菌很容易着火，可垂死蘑菇的孢子，又会落回它身上。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME maintain a high body temperature in an effort to stave off the parasitic fungus that infests their bodies. The dried out fungus is prone to catching fire, but the spores from the dying mushroom fall back onto the body of POKENAME.

entry: 双翼更有力，也更自信，POKENAME比进化前更独立。它从喙里吐出团团熔岩，攻击敌人。
author: chibitales
source: With stronger wings and more confidence, POKENAME has become more independent than its previous evolution. It spits globs of molten rock from its beak to attack foes.

entry: 鼻口部虽像喙，却覆着软毛。它兴奋地摇尾，再使出强劲的火花。
author: .izik
source: While its snout resembles a beak, it is covered in soft fur. It wags its tail excitedly before unleashing powerful Ember attacks.

entry: POKENAME维持高体温，想赶走身上的寄生真菌。干掉的菌很容易着火，可垂死蘑菇的孢子，又会落回它身上。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME maintain a high body temperature in an effort to stave off the parasitic fungus that infests their bodies. The dried out fungus is prone to catching fire, but the spores from the dying mushroom fall back onto the body of POKENAME.

entry: 战斗时，体内的火焰囊会越烧越热；最近才发现，只要情绪激动，就会如此。它用坚爪踢击，也向对手喷余烬。
author: infinex21
source: Its internal flame sac grows increasingly hotter during battle, though this has been recently discovered to be the case whenever it is agitated. It fights with kicking attacks that utilize its tough claws and by spitting embers at its opponent.

entry: POKENAME用喙向猎物射出余烬，再将猎物拖入地下。翅膀会在火势失控前将火扑灭。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME shoot embers at prey through their beaks before dragging them underground. Their wings put out these fires before they get out of control.

entry: 它连续快速翻跟斗，让敌人难以防备。旋转中仍能精准喷火，击中对手。
author: .izik
source: It performs somersaults in rapid succession, keeping foes off guard. While spinning, it blows flames at opponents with impressive precision.

entry: POKENAME成对在领地上空飞翔，发现猎物，就朝猎物窝里喷余烬。彼此极其忠诚可靠，再危急也不离弃，还常与岩狗狗结成对手。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME soar over their territories in pairs. If they find any prey, they shoot embers into their den. POKENAME are extremely trustworthy and loyal, staying with each other in even the most dire times. They often form rivalries with Rockruff.

entry: POKENAME飞翔时，用脚爪抓着树枝训练。有力的双腿能使出灼热踢击，连地面都会烧焦。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME trains by carrying branches in its talons as it soars through the sky. Its powerful legs allow it to strike with kicks hot enough to scorch the ground.

entry: 双翼与腿都还在发育，让POKENAME有些自卑，表现得咄咄逼人。它鼻喷蒸汽，向看见的任何对象吐火，试图挑起争斗。
author: sk372
source: With both its wings and legs still developing, POKENAME exhibits a bit of a complex, displaying aggressive behavior. It snorts out steam and spits flame at anybody it sees, attempting to pick fights.

entry: 它们翅膀虽小，却能轻松长时间翱翔。成群的POKENAME会全速飞向水面，用自己的甲壳打水漂，作为游戏。
author: infinex21
source: Though their wings are small, they can soar through the air with ease for long periods of time. Flocks of POKENAME will fly as fast as they can toward water and then skip across the surface using their own shells as a means of playing.

entry: 它拍尾击水，恐吓敌人。若被激怒，就吐出猛烈火焰，逼退袭击者。
author: .izik
source: It slaps its tail against the water's surface to intimidate foes. Once provoked, it exhales intense flames to keep attackers at bay.

entry: 这些虫宝可梦的红角滚烫，还能放出液体，用骨棒敲出的火花点燃。它们戴着猎物的头骨，方便随时将骨棒往上一敲，擦出火星。
author: infinex21
source: The red horns of these bug Pokémon are very hot and can even expel a fluid that they ignite with sparks made by smacking their bone club around. They wear the skulls of their prey to then hit their club against to always be able to create sparks.

entry: 它挥舞自己蜕下的一根角，仍能分泌易燃液体，像火柴般一擦就能点燃。它点燃蜕下的角，如标枪般投出，击倒远敌或空中猎物。
author: infinex21
source: It wields one of its shed horns, which can still secrete a flammable liquid and can be ignited by striking it like a match. It will set this shed horn ablaze and throw it like a javelin to strike down distant foes or aerial prey.

entry: POKENAME攀在火山坡上等待进化。古文明相信，火山喷发时，它会从岩浆中重生，进化成火神蛹。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME clings to the sides of volcanoes as it awaits evolution. Ancient civilizations believed that once the volcano erupted, POKENAME would be reborn from the magma, evolving into Volcapod.

entry: POKENAME鲜红的鳍十分醒目，很受富裕训练家欢迎。摸起来温暖，鳍上还能冒出小火焰。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have bright crimson fins that give them a distinct look that makes them popular among rich Trainers. They are warm to the touch and can produce small flames from their fins.

entry: POKENAME对外表十分挑剔，最恨毛被弄乱。毛一碰就会让人起灼痛的疹子，仿佛在惩罚破坏它仪容的人。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME is finicky about its appearance, and hates it when its fur is messed up. As if to punish those who ruin its look, its hairs leave a burning rash when touched.

entry: POKENAME尾部滴落粉色毒液，极其易燃，仅晒到太阳就可能起火。
author: .izik
source: A pink venom drips from POKENAME's tail. Highly combustible, it can ignite from mere sunlight exposure.

entry: POKENAME平时柔软温热，像暖果冻。变身时，先用火焰将自己结茧包住，再炸开火焰，显出变化后的模样。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's normal form is soft and heated, described as being like warm gelatin. When transforming, it cocoons itself in flames before the fire bursts and reveals its morphed state.

entry: POKENAME在火山脚下结成小群，攻击性极强。飞快振翼，将特殊花粉撒在针状双臂上，再点燃，刺出火焰攻击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME gathers in small swarms around the base of volcanoes. Highly aggressive, its rapid wingbeat spreads special pollen onto its stinger arms that it can ignite to attack others with flaming stabs.

entry: POKENAME从角喷出的火虽极热，却始终用超能力小心控制。有人认为，这种控火能力或许能让它在太阳表面生存，但还未经验证。
author: imaginita
source: Though the fire that POKENAME shoots from its horns is extremely hot, POKENAME always exerts careful psychic control over it. This control over fire may allow POKENAME to survive on the surface of the sun, but this theory has not been tested.

entry: POKENAME羽毛温暖柔软，又爱依偎较大的生物，因此成了很受欢迎的宠物。向别人鸣叫歌唱时，会冒出小小火焰。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has become popular as a pet due to its soft and warm plumage and a tendency to cozy up to other, larger beings. It creates tiny flames when it chirps and sings to others.

entry: 夜里，POKENAME在柳树上守望，等待溪边猎物。无声起飞时，翼后拖着余烬。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME watches from willow trees at night, waiting for prey near streams. Embers trail from its wings when it silently takes flight.

entry: POKENAME吐出柔软黏丝，强度恰好够基本垂钓。人们常用它的丝，加固破旧钓竿的钓线。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME produces a soft, sticky thread that is just durable enough for basic angling needs. Its silk is commonly used to reinforce the line of an Old Rod.

entry: 清晨，POKENAME的羽毛散出高热。只一根脱落绒羽，就足够煮沸一锅水。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's feathers radiate intense heat in the morning. A single loose down feather is hot enough to boil a pot of water.

entry: 火山将要喷发，POKENAME往往最早察觉，结群逃离烈火。科学家研究它们的飞行路线，协助疏散火山附近的居民。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are some of the first to detect when a volcano is about to erupt and form groups to escape the fiery wrath. Scientists study their flight patterns to help evacuate people near volcanoes.

entry: 成群POKENAME游荡在森林火灾的余烬里，不断吃灰与烟尘，毛也染成灰白。
author: santon5512
source: Packs of POKENAME can be found wandering through the remains of forest fires. These Pokémon constantly consume ash and soot, turning their fur an ashy white.

entry: POKENAME滑过湖面，翼上的热量煮沸水面。它在空中掠取西洋菜，当零嘴吃。
author: .izik
source: As POKENAME glides over lakes, the heat from its wings boils the water's surface. It snatches watercress midair to snack on.

entry: POKENAME厚毛能抵御冬寒。夏天迁到火山蜕毛，人们收集来制成绳索，不会把皮肤勒擦伤。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME is covered in a thick fur that keeps it warm in winter months. In summers, it migrates to volcanoes and sheds its fur, which can be collected to make ropes that don't cause rope burns.

entry: POKENAME从尖角放火，写成文字与人沟通。庆典上，人们曾请它在天空写出巨大的火焰字句。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME create letters out of fire from their prongs in order to communicate to others. POKENAME have been employed at festivals, making massive flaming messages in the sky.

entry: POKENAME睡着从松树上掉下，就会燃烧爆炸。这样的意外曾引发大规模森林火灾。
author: .izik
source: If POKENAME falls from its pine tree while asleep, it erupts into flames and explodes. These accidents have been known to start massive forest fires.

entry: 很久以前，人们以为POKENAME头顶的面具是太阳神的脸。低沉嚎声的音调，会随太阳位置变化，更让人深信此说。
author: soup1900
source: Long ago, people believed that the mask atop POKENAME's head was the face of a sun god. This idea was reinforced by the fact that POKENAME's deep howls change pitch along with the position of the sun.

entry: POKENAME趁夜在沙漠潜行，嚎叫着向天空喷火，将超音波幼虫等飞行猎物打下来。
author: .izik
source: Under cover of night, POKENAME prowls the desert. It howls and fires jets of flame into the sky to bring down flying prey like Vibrava.

entry: 这些虫宝可梦蜷起来，肌肉绷得极紧，能承受甚至弹开一些身体打击。它们偏爱干热，常见于沙漠，不喝水，改喝水果与仙人掌的汁。
author: infinex21
source: When these bug Pokémon curl up, their muscles become so tense that they can withstand and even repel some physical blows. They prefer arid heat, so they are often found within deserts. They drink juice from fruits and cacti rather than consume water.

entry: 蜷起来时，肌肉会极度鼓起绷紧，即使蜷着，也能从红角喷火。它耐得住强热，甚至会全身披火，冲向敌人。
author: infinex21
source: When it curls up, its muscles bulk out and tense up to a remarkable degree. Even while curled up, it can shoot out flames from its red horns. It can withstand intense heat, so it may even clad itself in flames as it charges at an enemy.

entry: POKENAME住在古火山脚下的森林，被视为火山看守者，会吓退太靠近山的人。有些人收集它的角，用作仪式服饰。
author: wiz0z
source: Found in the forests at the base of old volcanoes, POKENAME are considered the wardens of the volcanoes, scaring off those that wander too close to the mountains. Some people collect POKENAME horns and use them in ceremonial clothing.

entry: POKENAME总在训练，磨炼控火本领。在火山地带练习，能让成长中的身体保持高温，更好地控制火焰。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is always training to hone its power of flame manipulation. Practicing in volcanic areas allows its growing body to remain at a high temperature, giving it better control of its fire.

entry: POKENAME虽小，却为华丽鬃毛骄傲。粗心训练家若想摸头，就会尝到那出奇强大的超能力。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME may be small, but it is proud of its magnificent mane. Should a careless Trainer try to pet its head, they'll get a taste of its surprisingly powerful psychic abilities.

entry: POKENAME抓住电线，给身体过度充电，热得危险。暴怒时，放出的热量甚至能熔化钛。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME grips power lines to overcharge its body, growing dangerously hot. When enraged, it can emit heat intense enough to melt titanium.

entry: POKENAME用喙状嘴喝熔岩，爱住在活火山，让身体始终滚烫。它讨厌冷，一觉察到丝毫寒意，就浸进熔岩。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME drinks lava through its beak-like mouth and prefers to dwell in active volcanoes, where it can stay superheated at all times. It hates being cold, submerging itself in lava when it feels even the smallest chill.

entry: POKENAME通过蓬大的尾巴吸收阳光、转化能量，再将所得能量化成火焰。每次喷火，背上的蓝球都会发光。
author: infinex21
