source: POKENAME absorbs sunlight through its large, bushy tail and metabolizes it; the resulting energy from this process can be turned into flames. The blue orbs along POKENAME's back glow whenever it spits out fire.

entry: POKENAME挖地时，背上热量烧灼地道顶端，熔结岩石，使地下巢穴更牢固。
author: .izik
source: The heat from POKENAME's back scorches tunnel ceilings as it digs. This molten touch fuses stone, reinforcing its underground lairs.

entry: 受威胁时，POKENAME会蜷成球翻滚，周身烈焰翻腾。火山地带若有焦黑痕迹，可能就是对手间交战留下的。
author: sk372
source: When threatened, POKENAME curls into a ball and rolls, its body covered in roiling flames. Scorched trails can be seen in volcanic areas where rival POKENAME have fought.

entry: POKENAME住在火山岩浆房最深处，每隔几天才从住处冒出，用角喷出道道火流，烧掉体内多余的火焰。
author: beatdoof
source: POKENAME lives in the deepest pits of the magma chamber in a volcano. Every few days, it surfaces out of its dwelling, spewing streams of fire from its horns to burn off its excess internal flames.

entry: POKENAME能召出燃遍全身的烈焰，既是自卫，也展示自己的成熟。不过更多时候，是在神秘优美的仪式舞蹈中用火，祈求家园繁荣。
author: beatdoof
source: POKENAME can conjure immolating flames burning on its entire body to defend itself and to show how it has matured. Though more often these flames are conjured as part of its mystical, graceful, ritualized dancing, for the prosperity of its dwelling.

entry: POKENAME体内的火，即使在最黑的夜里也炽烈不熄，能化出无数火焰幻景，包括蜃景、小太阳般的火球，以及遥远往昔的景象。
author: beatdoof
source: The flame burning within POKENAME's body burns hot and true even in the darkest of nights, where they are then used to create innumerable fire conjurations, including mirages, fireballs resembling miniature suns, and visions of a long-gone past.

entry: POKENAME住在火山附近的森林，爬树后从上方扑下捕猎。虽能用角喷火自卫，却常把树也点着，只得逃走。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME live in forests near volcanos, hunting prey by climbing into trees and dropping down from above. While they can defend themselves from attack by launching fire from their horns, this frequently sets trees on fire, forcing POKENAME to flee.

entry: POKENAME痒了就蹭木头与树皮。这可能很危险，绒毛里的易燃鳞粉有时会松脱，让它蹭着的木头烧起来。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME rubs its body against wood and bark when it gets itchy. This is a potentially dangerous act, as sometimes flammable scales can be loosened from its fuzz and cause the wood it rubs against to catch fire.

entry: 据说星球上每座火山，都有一块POKENAME的楔石。寒冷时休眠，周围越热，就越活跃。
author: sk372
source: It is said that there is a POKENAME keystone for every volcano that dots the planet. It lies dormant in colder temperatures, becoming more active the hotter its surroundings are.

entry: POKENAME的花瓣吸足阳光，就会燃烧。这不会伤到它，却曾引发危险的森林火灾。
author: badtothebow
source: POKENAME's petals burst into flame whenever they absorb a large amount of sunlight. This process does not harm it, but it has been the cause of dangerous forest fires in the past.

entry: POKENAME看着像海中植物，其实是靠拟态引诱猎物的虫宝可梦。碰一下，便会严重灼伤。
author: hellaluyeah
source: While POKENAME looks like a marine plant, it is actually a Bug-type Pokémon drawing in prey with mimicry. It causes serious burns on contact.

entry: 野生POKENAME常把身体紧紧蜷起，几乎只露出白毛。放出的温暖，常吸引许多较小的虫属性宝可梦。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME will often curl upon their bodies enough that mostly just their white fur is visible. Due to the warmth they emit, many smaller Bug-type Pokémon are often drawn to them.

entry: POKENAME在枝间荡来荡去，把香蕉烤焦再吃，林中领地留下道道烟灰。
author: .izik
source: Swinging from branch to branch, POKENAME chars bananas before eating them. It leaves a trail of soot in its woodland territory.

entry: 这些小而数量众多的虫宝可梦，主要住在火山地底，尤其喜欢硫磺丰富的地方。常年吃硫磺，似乎让红刺与角都带上了毒。
author: infinex21
source: These small and numerous bug Pokémon primarily live underground in volcanic regions, especially where sulfur is plentiful. They consume sulfur on a regular basis, which seems to have imbued their red spikes and horns with toxic properties.

entry: 当地人也把POKENAME称作“太阳之滴”。它能从刀刃喷出火焰，温度高达华氏5500度。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME is also referred to as "Sun Drop" by locals. It expels flames from its blade up to 5,500 degrees F.

entry: 角能刺穿玄武岩却不崩缺，似乎还嫌不够，每次刺击还会注入可怕毒液。POKENAME的毒接触后几分钟内便会灼伤活体组织，解毒血清也很难研制。
author: infinex21
source: As if it were not enough that its horn can pierce basalt without chipping, each strike from it delivers a horrible venom as well. POKENAME venom effectively burns living tissue within minutes of contact; antivenoms have proven difficult to develop.

entry: POKENAME臂端烧红的利刃，热得足以熔石。凭这火力，能轻易切开坚岩，是可怕的战士。
author: .izik
source: The red-hot blades on the end of POKENAME's arms are hot enough to melt stone. This fiery power makes it a fearsome fighter, capable of cutting through solid rock with ease.

entry: 古代王室珍视POKENAME的丝，称之为“龙丝”，织成昂贵的王室布料。古代象形文字中，曾画着它陪伴君王的身影。
author: cobalt0135
source: The silk of POKENAME was prized by ancient royalty as "dragon silk" which was used to make expensive royal fabric. These Pokémon have been depicted beside kings in ancient hieroglyphs.

entry: 红色器官能传导热量，强到足以点燃白毛。为抵御威胁，它会点燃团团毛发，再掷出去。
author: infinex21
source: Its red organs channel heat through them; it can channel enough heat to ignite pieces of its white fur. To fend off threats, it will ignite clumps of its fur and throw them.

entry: POKENAME用长角喷火，压制目标，也把树上的食物打下来。每月都会蜕下几簇温暖白毛，许多人握着便觉得安心。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME shoot flames from their long horns to overwhelm their targets and to knock down food from trees. Every month, POKENAME shed tufts of their warm, white fur that many find comforting to hold.

entry: 角与刺每次放火，都会烧得通红，也只有这些部位能喷火。角刺上的毒鳞粉，能让碰到的血肉遭到化学灼伤。
author: infinex21
source: Its horn and spikes glow red-hot whenever it releases flames, which it can only release from these same parts. Its horns and spikes carry upon them toxic scales that chemically burn the flesh of anything that touches them.

entry: POKENAME对火十分着迷，尽管自己极其怕火。通常在火山附近，从看似安全的距离观赏熔岩流。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME has a fascination with fire, despite being incredibly vulnerable to it. It is usually found near volcanoes, and will watch lava flows from what appears to be a safe distance.

entry: POKENAME是一只庞大的幼虫，梦想有朝一日，进化成威风的巨龙。身上的尖刺，则由永不融化的冰构成。
author: voxposs
source: A humongous larva, POKENAME dreams about evolving into a mighty dragon someday. Its spikes are made of ice that never melts.

entry: POKENAME栖在火山岩壁里，蜡状身体无论温度多高，都不会融化。睡着时，头上的蓝火轻轻摇曳。
author: .izik
source: Found in volcano walls, POKENAME's waxy body never melts-no matter how high the temperature rises. The blue flame on its head flickers as it sleeps.

entry: POKENAME攀在废弃沙漠墓穴的顶端栖居。旅人从下方经过，体内的光就会大亮。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME resides in abandoned desert tombs, clinging to ceilings. The light within its body glows brightly when travelers pass below.

entry: POKENAME在废弃宅邸里收集钥匙，吃饭时摇得叮当响。响得越大，越是吃得开心，身体也越热。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME collects keys in abandoned mansions and jingles them while eating. The louder the jingling, the more it enjoys its meal and the hotter it gets.

entry: POKENAME极其罕见，住在火山内的岩浆深处。古时，人们将宝石投入火山，希望它现身实现心愿。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME are very rare creatures that live deep within the magma inside volcanoes. In ancient times, people would throw precious gems into the volcano in the hopes that POKENAME would come forth and grant their wishes.

entry: POKENAME隔热绒毛下，是一座天然熔炉，什么气候都能暖洋洋、舒舒服服。发怒会把体温升到850度，再从甲胄小孔排出余热。
author: pkbonusducks
source: Below POKENAME's insulated fuzz is a natural furnace, keeping them warm and content in any climate. Angered POKENAME will superheat themselves up to 850 degrees, venting the excess heat from the small holes in their armor.

entry: 进化前，POKENAME用纤维物质把自己裹成茧。此时虽不动，却烫得惊人；进化完成，茧便在烈火中爆开。
author: bobosmith01
source: Before evolving, POKENAME wraps itself in a fibrous material that acts as a cocoon. Despite being still and inactive in this state, they are overwhelmingly hot to the touch. The cocoon erupts in a fiery explosion when POKENAME finishes evolution.

entry: POKENAME高速掠过沙漠。落地时，放出的热量能把脚下沙子变成玻璃。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME darts over desert sands at high speed. When it lands, the heat it emits can turn the sand beneath it into glass.

entry: POKENAME的身体由耐热金属构成，能释放强劲火焰攻击而不受伤。它蹭柔软物体，清洁身体、擦亮金属。
author: .izik
source: Its body is composed of heat-resistant metal, allowing POKENAME to unleash powerful flame attacks without harm. It rubs against soft objects to keep itself clean and its metal polished.

entry: POKENAME发动火焰攻击时，齿轮般的身体顺时针旋转。战斗结束后，睡梦中会发出有节奏的咔嗒声。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's gear-like body spins clockwise while unleashing fire attacks. After battle, it emits rhythmic clicking sounds while it sleeps.

entry: POKENAME的辛辣叶片，深受厨界喜爱，常被放进粥里。阳光镇有家知名餐馆，就以它入菜，做成招牌餐点。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's spicy leaves are prized in culinary circles and often used in porridge. A dish featuring it is the signature meal of a famed Sunnytown restaurant.

entry: POKENAME身上落下的孢子，会造成轻度烧伤。采集得当，却是制作灼伤药的关键材料。
author: .izik
source: The spores shed from POKENAME's body can cause mild burns. When properly harvested, these spores are a key ingredient in crafting Burn Heals.

entry: POKENAME住在哪片森林，哪里就有危险。五根角会放出超高热的毒孢子，威胁一切有机生命。
author: chaoticanzu
source: POKENAME are a danger to any forest they reside in. Its five horns release super-heated toxic spores dangerous to all organic life.

entry: POKENAME夜飞林间，靠覆毛的双翼保温。即使最冷的冬天，也照常活动。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's furred wings keep it insulated during nighttime forest flights. It remains active even in the coldest winters.

entry: POKENAME捧着奇怪器物，在古墓周围的沙漠漂浮。白天能高举器物，汇聚太阳能量，增强战斗中的火力。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME floats around the deserts surrounding ancient tombs, clutching strange artifacts. During the day, it can hold the artifact aloft to channel the sun's energy and enhance its flame powers in battle.

entry: POKENAME偏爱富含磁性矿石的洞穴，将矿石熔化后吃下。同类若靠近它下一餐的食物，就会被喷火驱赶。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME prefers caves dense with magnetic ore, which it consumes by melting it down. It will spit fire at rival POKENAME who approach its next meal.

entry: 人们在离休眠火山不远的遗迹里，发现了POKENAME。它靠近活火山会躁动，研究者推测，古文明或许用它作预警。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has been discovered within ruins within short distances of dormant volcanoes. Researchers theorize that old civilizations may have used them as warning signs, as it grows restless near active volcanoes.

entry: 夜里，POKENAME爬上树，触角被热量映得发亮。任何东西靠得太近，都会被它喷酸。
author: .izik
source: At night, POKENAME climbs trees with its antennae glowing brightly with heat. It spits acid at anything that gets too close.

entry: POKENAME任性又戒心重，总觉得旁人因体形和姿态看不起它。脾气一上来，不只朝周围发火，还会扔火球。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is petulant and defensive, thinking others look down on it due to its size and posture. It's prone to throwing tantrums, as well as fireballs, at anything nearby when its temper flares.

entry: POKENAME想睡觉，就附身老树桩。时间一久，木头越来越热，最后烧起来。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME wants to sleep, it possesses old tree stumps. Over time, the wood heats and eventually bursts into flames.

entry: 战斗时，它站到有利位置，让强光晃花对手的眼，更难击中自己。胜利后，POKENAME摆出夸张姿势，从角里喷火。
author: milchik
source: When fighting, it uses the sun to its advantage by positioning itself so the bright sunlight blinds the opponents and makes it harder for them to land a hit. Once the battle is won, POKENAME strikes a dramatic pose and spouts fire from its horns.

entry: POKENAME通过头上的红刺散发体热，也能将烫刺射向敌人，造成剧烈的疼痛。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME radiates its internal body heat through the red thorns on its head. It can fire its hot thorns at its opponents, causing excruciating pain.

entry: POKENAME背上的蘑菇，辣得危险。只吃一口，也能让人的味觉永久受损。
author: .izik
source: The mushrooms on POKENAME's back are dangerously spicy. Even a single bite can irreparably damage a person's sense of taste.

entry: 受威胁时，POKENAME抖身甩落大量细毛。细毛一脱落便迅速起火，迸出灼热火花和响亮爆声，吓退天敌。
author: sk372
source: When threatened, POKENAME shakes its body to shed many of the tiny hairs covering its body. These follicles quickly ignite after detaching, causing a shower of hot sparks and loud pops that scare off predators.

entry: POKENAME在火山隧道筑巢，铺上熔岩。若太冷，动作就会慢得几乎挪不动。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME builds its nest in volcanic tunnels, lining it with molten rocks. If it becomes too cold, its movements slow to a crawl.

entry: POKENAME的触角散出甜甜的南瓜香。飘过河面时，会从腹部放出闪烁蓝光，诱引猎物。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's antennae emit a sweet pumpkin scent. As it floats above rivers, it releases flickering blue lights from its belly to lure prey.

entry: POKENAME的皮肤摸起来烫手。趴在池塘睡觉时若做噩梦，周围的水便开始沸腾。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's skin is hot to the touch. When it has nightmares while sleeping face-down in ponds, the surrounding water begins to boil.

entry: POKENAME对偷来收藏的硬币占有欲极强。为防别人拿回赃物，会用火把硬币烧得滚烫，除它以外谁也碰不了。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is extremely possessive of any coins it purloins for its collection. To keep others from taking back what it stole, it will super-heat them with its flames so that nobody else can handle the heated metal but it.

entry: 野生POKENAME常见于温泉一带，泡着滚热的泉水。防身时，从嘴里吹出红泡，破裂便化成燃烧的余烬。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is typically seen at or around hot springs areas in the wild, soaking in the piping hot waters. To defend itself, it blows red-colored bubbles from its mouth that burst into burning embers.

entry: 它用沉重的炮管射出水流，将敌人推得远远的。这也是POKENAME保护柔软肚皮的唯一办法。
author: voxposs
source: This larva uses heavy cannons to shoot water streams and push enemies far away. That's the only way POKENAME can protect their soft belly.

entry: POKENAME极其贪食，与群体栖居密林。为填满无底洞般的肚子，会咬树吸汁；背上的种子储存能量，增强毒属性招式。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is an extremely voracious creature that inhabits dense forests with its group. To satisfy its insatiable appetite, it bites the trees to consume their sap. The seed on its back stores the energy that fuels the power of its Poison-type moves.

entry: POKENAME胃口太大，容易不慎捕猎过量。因此，科学家会密切监测已知有它栖居的洞穴。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: Due to their massive appetites, POKENAME are prone to accidentally overhunting. Due to this, scientists carefully monitor any caves where POKENAME are known to live.

entry: POKENAME用长舌缠住洞中的岩台，在石块之间荡来荡去，再凭声波，寻找黑暗中的下一个落点。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME uses its tongue to wrap around ledges in caves and swing from stone to stone. It uses sound waves to locate its next target in the darkness.

entry: POKENAME极耐疾病，会吸收其他宝可梦的病症，增强毒烟威力。它们群居，辟出共用场所，接触多种病症来使自己获得免疫。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are incredibly resilient to disease and absorb illnesses from other Pokémon to increase the potency of their noxious fumes. POKENAME live in colonies where they create a shared space to inoculate themselves against a plethora of illnesses.

entry: 身躯太庞大，POKENAME飞得并不好，却仍会跳下悬崖，盼着展翅翱翔，最后只能一路摔到崖底。
author: capwolfbane
source: Given its bulk, it cannot fly well. Despite this, POKENAME jump off cliffs hoping to soar, only to tumble to the bottom.

entry: 发现地鼠这类掘地猎物，POKENAME就用角钻进地里，沿地下隧道紧追不舍。
author: .izik
source: When it spots burrowing prey like Diglett, POKENAME drills into the ground using its horn. It pursues its target relentlessly through underground tunnels.

entry: POKENAME解开藤蔓缠住敌人，拉到身前使出剧毒牙。动作精准，几乎不给逃脱机会。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME untangles its vines to snare foes, reeling them in for a venomous Poison Fang attack. Its precision leaves little chance for escape.

entry: 圣特安努号上流行的“红莲珍味”，以POKENAME的尾巴为重要食材。略加焖煮，再配上刺耳果做的酱汁上桌。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME tails are a key ingredient in the 'Savory Cinnabar', a dish popular aboard the S.S. Anne. Lightly braised, they are served in a Colbur Berry-based sauce.

entry: 它整只捕住鲤鱼王、丑丑鱼这类常见猎物，吸干血维生。石头般坚硬的角带着危险毒液，刺中暴鲤龙，几天后也能让它倒下。
author: infinex21
source: It captures prey, which is typically Magikarp or Feebas, whole and siphons them of their blood to sustain itself. Its rock-hard horn contains a dangerous venom that could fell a Gyarados days after being stabbed.

entry: POKENAME以超能力放大尖叫，令人和宝可梦都极其难受、疼痛。它还会吸食跃出水面的吼鲸王的血。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME amplifies its screeches with psychic energy, causing immense discomfort and pain in Pokémon and people alike. It is known to feed on the blood of breaching Wailord.

entry: POKENAME是发电厂附近的害兽，会从电线上吸电，直到吃饱。许多停电，都是它们成群大吃造成的。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME is a pest found near power plants, sapping electricity from the wires until they've had their fill. Many blackouts are caused by groups of this Pokémon feasting away.

entry: 头上的翅膀也能当钳子。嘴无法闭合，杂物很容易掉进去；它常站在树下，用钳状翅膀摇落水果和树果，让食物直落嘴里。
author: infinex21
source: Its head wings also function as pincers. It cannot close its mouth, so debris can easily fall within. It can often be found under trees, using its pincer-like wings to shake loose fruits and berries to fall into its mouth.

entry: POKENAME攻击性极强，谁看它的眼神不对，就朝谁尖叫。若惊扰一群，没等它们动手，你的耳膜就已被震破。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are hyper-aggressive, loudly screeching at anything that looks at it funny. If you disturb a school of POKENAME, your eardrums will burst before they even have the chance to attack you.

entry: POKENAME从远处射出毛间毒刺，猎取比自己大的目标。等猎物虚弱，再用大獠牙咬住，补上痛苦电击，将其打倒。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME takes down prey larger than itself by firing poisoned quills from its fur from a distance. Once weakened, it latches onto its target with its massive fangs and delivers a painful electric jolt to finish them off.

entry: POKENAME很像极古老、过时画法中的大嘴蝠。长舌能缠住小生物，拖到近处，再扎进獠牙，吸些血。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME resembles an extremely old, outdated depiction of a Golbat. Its long tongue can ensnare smaller creatures, dragging them close so it can sink its fangs into them and drain some blood.

entry: POKENAME从不闭嘴，能塞进嘴的东西全吃。也因此，翅膀失去了作用。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME never closes its mouth and consumes anything that fits inside. Its wings are nonfunctional as a consequence.

entry: 暴风雨将至，POKENAME嘴里悬浮的水晶球，便泛出鲜亮紫光。水手视之为风浪来临的凶兆。
author: .izik
source: The floating crystal orb in POKENAME's mouth glows a vivid violet when a storm is imminent. Sailors see it as an omen of turbulent seas.

entry: POKENAME在公园陪孩子玩，可一被大人发现，就用嘴叼住孩子，瞬间移动到远处。亲历者说，它只是想连续玩好几个小时，片刻不停。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME plays with children at parks, but the moment an adult spots it, it will latch onto a child with its mouth and teleport far away. Those who have experienced this report that it simply wanted to play for hours without rest.

entry: POKENAME吃虫，却不太会主动捕猎。颈间珠子散出极招虫的香气，引得虫子飞近或飞进嘴里，便被整只吞下。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is an insectivore, but lacks a strong hunting instinct. Instead, the beads around its neck emit a scent highly attractive to insects, leading bugs to fly close to or into its mouth so it can swallow them whole.

entry: POKENAME虽无天生的夜视能力，却能轻松穿梭洞穴等黑暗环境。脚爪注入的毒液使猎物麻木，方便吸血。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME can navigate dark environs, such as caves, with incredible ease despite a lack of organic night vision. They deliver a numbing venom through their talons, which makes it easier for them to drain prey of their blood.

entry: POKENAME从口中放出浓厚黑雾，遮蔽四周，用来迷惑天敌与猎物。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME releases a dense Haze from its mouth to obscure its surroundings. It uses this tactic to confuse both predators and prey alike.

entry: POKENAME在黑暗洞穴的石笋间结网，用黏黏的陷阱，捕捉穿过隧道、毫无防备的猎物。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME weaves its web between stalagmites in dark caverns. It uses this sticky trap to catch prey unaware as they traverse the tunnels.

entry: POKENAME在密林繁衍，捕食波波、独角虫等小宝可梦。只消一记超音波，就能扰乱猎物，再发起攻击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME thrives in dense forests, preying on smaller Pokémon like Pidgey and Weedle. It uses a single Supersonic to disorient its prey before striking.

entry: 睡觉与寻找新猎物时，它都倒挂在高处。强劲的脚爪能刺穿厚皮、注入剧毒，再将猎物拖回巢穴。
author: infinex21
source: It hangs upside down from tall perches when it sleeps and when it searches for fresh prey. Its talons are strong enough to penetrate thick hides and deliver a potent venom as it drags its prey back to its nest.

entry: POKENAME像振翼般拍鳍，跃出水后确实也能在空中滑翔片刻。发光球体帮助它在深水辨路，大张的嘴则捕住许多小猎物。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME flap their fins almost as if they were wings, though they are able to glide in the air for a time when they leap out of water. Their glowing bulbs allow them to navigate deep water and their gaping mouths catch many small prey.

entry: POKENAME的眼睛敏感，遇上强光就闭眼，将头缩进蛋壳。革质双翼也能减轻刺眼的光。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have sensitive eyes, so whenever they encounter bright lights, they close their eyes and tuck their head into their eggshell. Their leathery wings also help mitigate the glare of bright lights.

entry: 锋利坚硬的喙里，排着小小尖牙，用来吸食猎物的血。羽色鲜艳程度，能看出年龄及毒液强弱。
author: infinex21
source: Their sharp and tough beaks are lined with small, sharp fangs that they use to drain the blood of their prey. The vibrancy of their feathers is an indicator of how old they are and of how potent their venom has become.

entry: POKENAME常在地下深处的洞中水潭附近出没。外表虽让人想抱，领地意识却很强，会毫不犹豫咬住没防备的训练家或宝可梦。
author: gay_lumi_society
source: POKENAME are often found near cave pools deep underground. Despite their huggable appearance, POKENAME are quite territorial and won't hesitate to bite any unsuspecting Trainers or Pokémon.

entry: 一见猎物，POKENAME的胡须就兴奋抖动。若咬不倒训练家，就从包里抢件道具，飞上天空逃走。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's whiskers twitch excitedly at the sight of prey. If unable to defeat a Trainer with its bite, it will snatch an item from their bag and escape into the sky.

entry: POKENAME是夜间猎手，最常出没在迷宫般的洞穴附近。虽凶悍，性格却忠诚。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is a nocturnal predator that is most often found near labyrinthian caverns. Although aggressive, it has a loyal personality.

entry: POKENAME捕猎时，尽量多吞食有形物质。毛间裹满从毛孔渗出的浓稠黏毒，也影响了飞行能力。
author: bobosmith01
source: When POKENAME hunts, it makes sure to consume as much physical matter as it can handle. It coats its fur with sticky and dense toxins that leak from its pores, which affects its ability to fly.

entry: POKENAME捕猎时，尽量多吞食有形物质。毛间裹满从毛孔渗出的浓稠黏毒，也影响了飞行能力。
author: bobosmith01
source: When POKENAME hunts, it makes sure to consume as much physical matter as it can handle. It coats its fur with sticky and dense toxins that leak from its pores, which affects its ability to fly.

entry: POKENAME连发空气利刃前，冠上的红宝石会强烈发光。它能轻易击碎坚石。
author: .izik
source: The red gem on POKENAME's crown glows intensely before it unleashes a barrage of Air Cutter attacks. It can break apart solid stone with ease.

entry: 它捕猎能被大嘴一口整个抓住的小生物，吸食其血。牙能注入麻痹毒液，花苞撒出的花粉，对多数生物也有毒。
author: infinex21
source: It hunts smaller prey that it can easily grab whole with its gaping maw so as to drain their blood. Its fangs deliver a numbing venom and the pollen loosed from its bulb is poisonous to most.

entry: POKENAME的牙很小，便用幻象掩盖自己的存在，让猎物误以为安全，方便靠近。等猎物识破伪装，就已经太迟。
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher
source: POKENAME's teeth are very small, so they use illusions to mask their presence and lull their prey into a false sense of security to get up close. By the time the prey sees through the facade, it is too late.

entry: POKENAME诡异的嚎声，像病弱孩子的声音。趁目标不备下手，用獠牙吸走生命。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME emits eerie howls that resemble the sounds of sick children. It strikes when its target is off guard, draining life with its fangs.

entry: 入侵者靠近巢穴，POKENAME便发出强劲的刺耳声，扰乱得大多数威胁都不敢再近。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME emits a powerful Screech when an intruder approaches its nest. The sound is disorienting enough to deter most threats.

entry: 吸食猎物时若被打扰，POKENAME会先泛出深褐光，再爆炸，确保自己逃离潜在威胁。
author: .izik
source: If disturbed while draining its prey, POKENAME glows a deep brown before exploding. This tactic ensures its escape from potential threats.

entry: POKENAME身上每一处尖端，一碰都能注入剧毒。夜里最活跃，振翼靠近、咬住猎物，全程不发出声音。
author: bobosmith01
source: Each and every sharp point on POKENAME's body can inject a potent poison if touched. It is most active at night. It can flap its wings and latch onto prey without making a sound.

entry: POKENAME轻松滑过夜空，穿进穿出云层。古人曾认为，它闪亮的身体预示着歉收。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME glides effortlessly through the night sky, diving in and out of clouds. Ancient cultures once believed its gleaming body signified an impending poor harvest.

entry: POKENAME栖在洞口，在岩石裂隙里筑巢。谁靠得太近，就一拥而上，用利牙撕咬，吸走活力。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME roost in the mouths of caves, making their nests within crags and crevices in the rock. They swarm anyone who gets too close, biting at them with sharp fangs and draining their vitality.

entry: POKENAME把角浸在池塘里清洗。刚洗净的角，空战时使起来更顺手。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME cleans its horn by soaking it in ponds. A freshly cleaned horn can be wielded more efficiently during aerial combat.

entry: POKENAME在新月之夜最活跃，飞行无声。獠牙太钝，咬不进猎物的身体，只好留些红色树果咬着，装出凶狠吓人的样子。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Most active on nights with a new moon, POKENAME fly without making a sound. Their fangs are too dull to properly bite into prey, so they instead keep around red berries to bite into, trying to play tough and appear intimidating.

entry: POKENAME的喙里藏着两对毒牙，夜猎时给捉到的猎物注毒。它受不了强光，住在黑暗洞穴深处。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME's beak hides two pairs of venomous fangs used to poison prey caught during its nightly hunts. It lives deep within dark caverns, as it cannot tolerate bright light.

entry: POKENAME紧收双翼，钻进雪堆，只探出小鼻子，嗅闻空气，寻找食物线索。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME burrows into snow mounds with its wings folded tightly. It pokes its small nose out, sniffing the air for potential food sources.

entry: POKENAME先迅速顺时针旋转，再俯冲扑向铁甲蛹等猎物。刀锋般的双翼，连最硬的壳都能切开。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spins in swift, clockwise movements before diving onto prey like Metapod. Its razor-sharp wings slice through even the hardest shells.

entry: POKENAME的喙里藏着两对毒牙，夜猎时给捉到的猎物注毒。它受不了强光，住在黑暗洞穴深处。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME's beak hides two pairs of venomous fangs used to poison prey caught during its nightly hunts. It lives deep within dark caverns, as it cannot tolerate bright light.

entry: 古时，皮匠珍视POKENAME的翼，用来制成耐用的盾牌蒙皮。
author: .izik
source: In ancient times, POKENAME's wings were prized by leatherworkers. They were used to craft durable leather for shields.

entry: POKENAME迅速滚向烈雀、穿山鼠等小猎物时，会张开巨嘴。速度太快，几乎无从躲避。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME opens its massive mouth when rolling rapidly toward smaller prey like Spearow and Sandshrew. Its speed makes it nearly impossible to evade.

entry: POKENAME天生擅长擒拿，热爱参加格斗比赛，却常因爱咬人而被取消资格。
author: kiwiarms
source: POKENAME are natural born grapplers, and love to participate in fighting tournaments. Their tendency to bite often leads to them being disqualified.

entry: POKENAME嘴里潮湿，是理想的孵蛋环境。它会凶猛保护这片宝贵空间，驱赶入侵者。
author: .izik
source: The inside of POKENAME's mouth is humid, creating an ideal environment for incubating eggs. It fiercely defends this precious space from intruders.

entry: 石质身体让POKENAME很难维持飞行。筋疲力尽时，就撞向崖壁嵌进去，安全休息。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME struggles to stay airborne with its stone-like body. When exhausted, it crashes into cliff faces to embed itself and rest safely.

entry: POKENAME头骨上的球里，装满了毒液。飞行时投下，削弱猎物，使其无力逃避，任它俯冲吞食。
author: sk372
source: The orbs on POKENAME's skull are filled to the brim with a toxic liquid. It drops them while in flight to debilitate prey and leave them helpless to avoid it swooping down to devour them.

entry: 不知为何，POKENAME常潜伏在墓地与相关纪念场所附近。它似乎能从吸过血的对象那里取得部分记忆，同类也不例外。
author: bobosmith01
source: For unclear reasons, POKENAME tend to lurk near graveyards and related memorials. It appears that they are able to obtain some of the memories of anyone they suck blood from, including their own brethren.

entry: POKENAME在变电站筑巢，咬进电线吸电，常引发局部停电。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME nests in power substations, where it bites into wires to absorb electricity. Its presence often causes localized blackouts.

entry: 它们协力捕倒猎物，再吸食鲜血。每只POKENAME都要吸干100个受害者，才肯心满意足。
author: darkweavile428
source: They work together to bring down prey and feed on their blood. Each POKENAME is not satisfied until it has completely drained 100 victims.

entry: POKENAME借电流与自身磁场高速飞行。凡落进大嘴的猎物，都会被吸走体内电能，连脑中的电也不放过。
author: infinex21
source: Using electrical currents and their own magnetic fields, POKENAME fly around ad high speeds. They feed on any prey caught within their gaping maws by siphoning any electrical energy within them, even those of the brain.

entry: POKENAME不在水边筑巢，会连飞几天寻找干旱地貌。即使沙漠环境严酷，耐力依旧惊人。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME avoids nesting near water and flies for days in search of arid landscapes. Its stamina is remarkable, even in harsh desert conditions.

entry: POKENAME从山顶台地附近的住处滑翔而出，向过近的其他捕食者大声尖叫。叫声最远十英里外都听得见。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME glides from its home near a mountain's plateau, screeching loudly at other predators who get too close. Its cries can be heard from up to ten miles away.

entry: POKENAME会毫无预兆地从树顶扑下，袭击毫无防备的猎物，不停吸血，再另找一棵树爬上筑巢。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Without warning, POKENAME will suddenly dive from atop a tree onto unsuspecting prey. It will relentlessly drain their prey of blood before finding a tree to climb up to and nest.

entry: POKENAME一兴奋，就会飞快扑动小翅膀，发出尖锐叫声。若热情过了头，张开的大嘴还会开始喷火。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME rapidly flap their tiny wings whenever they're excited, making a high-pitched cry as they do. If they become too enthusiastic about whatever has them worked up, they start to spit fire from their gaping mouth.

entry: POKENAME闭着嘴，显得比实际小得多，也没那么吓人。它耐心等猎物靠近，再整个吞下。面对天敌，则发射火球，打开逃生路。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: By keeping its mouth closed, POKENAME appears far smaller and less threatening than it truly is. It waits patiently for prey to draw near before swallowing it whole. When confronted by predators, it launches fireballs to create an escape route.

entry: POKENAME缠着钟乳石睡觉，用满身刺吓退敌人。锋利的刺，让潜在威胁不敢靠近。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME coils itself around stalactites to sleep, using its spiny body as a deterrent. The sharp quills keep potential threats at bay.

entry: POKENAME用手爪与脚爪攀洞壁，找舒适角落藏身等猎物。一见目标，就用手臂滑翔而下，以尖叫与毒咬伏击。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME scales cave walls using its claws and talons, finding a comfortable nook to hide in while waiting for prey. When it spots a target, POKENAME uses its arms to glide down and ambush the foe with a loud screech and toxic bite.

entry: POKENAME藏在洞穴天然屏障后。敌人太近，就跳出来叉开腿，展开翼状双臂，伸出毒舌威吓。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME hides behind the naturally formed barriers of its cave home. When a foe gets too close, POKENAME will jump out, widen its stance, extend out its winged arms, and stick its toxic tongue out to intimidate the opponent.

entry: POKENAME坐在洞穴高处的岩沿上，观察经过领地的旅人。挥手振翼，超音蝠便会惊起，飞向旅人攻击，它自己很少参战。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: Sitting on high cave ledges, POKENAME observe travelers passing through its territory. With a wave of its hand and a flap of its wings, Zubat will stir and fly towards the traveler and attack. It's rare for POKENAME to enter combat themselves.

entry: POKENAME虽然弱小，尖叫却能令人毛骨悚然，连最强的敌人也会被吓退。它常住在有水的洞穴里。
author: canada
source: Although it is weak, POKENAME can produce a bloodcurdling scream that scares away the toughest of foes. It is often found in aquatic caves.

entry: POKENAME的手臂太弱，不能真正当翅膀，眼睛也发育不全，耳朵又小又不能动。得细心看顾，否则爱咬人的习惯，会让它惹上应付不了的危险。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME's arms are too weak to act as true wings, its eyes are underdeveloped, and its ears are small and immobile. This Pokémon must be watched carefully, or its habit of biting will get it into danger it cannot handle.

entry: POKENAME在月下旋舞，优雅又安详。很长一段时间，尽管已有研究证实，许多人仍不信它会像大嘴蝠一样吸血。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME dance and twirl so gracefully and peacefully under the moonlight that, for a long time, there were many who did not believe the research confirming POKENAME was a bloodsucker like Golbat.

entry: POKENAME夜间活动，白天挂在浓密丛林的树上。进食时会吸走猎物的颜色，所到之处，留下灰白的躯壳。
author: dolly_cholli
source: POKENAME are nocturnal, hanging in dense jungle trees during the day. They drain the color from their prey when feeding, leaving grayscale husks behind wherever they go.

entry: POKENAME双颚强劲，一口就能咬倒雪松。它用木材，在河边筑起复杂的巢穴。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's powerful jaws allow it to chop down a cedar tree with a single bite. It uses the wood to build elaborate dens near rivers.

entry: POKENAME住在洞穴深处，享受安静。被任何人或物打扰，便会现身，发出高达108分贝的尖叫。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME live deep in caves, enjoying the peace and quiet they provide. When someone or something disturbs POKENAME, they manifest with a loud screech reaching 108 decibels.

entry: POKENAME翅膀太小，无法飞行，还常磨擦背上长出的叶子。受攻击时，背花会生出藤蔓，缠住袭击者。
author: quackquackattack
source: The wings of a POKENAME are too small to fly with and often chafe against the leaves sprouting on their back. Whenever they are attacked, vines sprout from the flower on their back to grapple the assailant.

entry: POKENAME倒挂睡觉，响亮尖锐的鼾声回荡洞中。直到天黑，才飞出去寻找水果吃。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME sleeps while hanging upside down. Its loud, high-pitched snoring echoes throughout the cave until nightfall, when it flies out to search for fruit to eat.

entry: 野生POKENAME整夜觅食，因此白天昏昏欲睡。主要用牙吸果汁，但捉到草属性宝可梦也会吃。
author: .jerden
source: Wild POKENAME hunt for food all night, and so are drowsy during the day. They mostly use their fangs to drain juice from fruit, but will also feed on any Grass-type Pokémon they can catch.

entry: POKENAME永远张着的大嘴，一口能吞下大量猎物。翼状鳍让它游得出奇快，更容易捕食整群鱼。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's eternally-gaping maw allows it to swallow large amounts of prey in a single gulp. Its wing-like fins make it a surprisingly fast swimmer, making it easier to prey on entire schools of fish.

entry: 有些POKENAME形态没有翼状鳍，獠牙也较小，速度与攻击性都降低。这些大嘴个体满足于四处漂浮，什么游进嘴，就吞什么。
author: sk372
source: Some POKENAME variants lack wing-like fins and have smaller fangs, resulting in reduced speed and aggression. These wide-mouthed specimens content themselves with floating around and swallowing whatever swims into their maw.

entry: POKENAME躺下捕猎时，嘴里会伸出酷似崖壁地形的奇异构造。等够多小生物毫无戒心地聚来停栖，便猛然合嘴，一次吞光。
author: sk372
source: As a method of hunting, a strange facsimile of cliffside terrain extends from POKENAME's mouth as it lies down. Once enough small unsuspecting creatures have gathered and perched, it chomps down and swallows them all at once.

entry: POKENAME常聚在被水淹没的洞穴。新演化出的眼睛，赋予它强劲夜视能力，能在水上水下捕猎。
author: snookerron
source: POKENAME will often congregate around flooded caverns. Their newly evolved eyes imbue them with powerful night vision, which they use to hunt above and below the waters.

entry: POKENAME用磁性鼻子，探测夜行旅人身上的金属物。锁定目标，就等待对方松懈的最佳时机下手。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its magnetic nose to detect metal objects on nighttime travelers. Once it identifies a target, it waits for the perfect moment to strike when they're off guard.

entry: POKENAME带着战术家的眼光，灵活穿梭战场，用刃翼击倒对手。愿放任它吸取受害者活力的训练家，爱用它作打手与潜入者。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME nimbly races around the battlefield with a tactician's eye, dispatching opponents with its bladed wings. It is popular as an enforcer and infiltrator for Trainers willing to allow it to indulge in draining victims of their vitality.

entry: POKENAME用发达的声带模仿其他宝可梦的叫声，再以幻象遮身，诱来猎物。等毫无防备的目标近到看见幻象消散，已经太迟。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME use their expanded vocal chords to mimic the cries of other Pokémon, cloaking themselves in an illusion and crying out to lure in prey. By the time the unsuspecting prey get close enough to see the illusion fade, it is too late.

entry: 它每次进食，最多能喝下10盎司鲜血。咬下之前，飘带能帮忙，把猎物牢牢缠住。
author: melodydelune
source: It drinks up to 10 ounces of blood during any feeding. Its ribbons makes it easier to hold its prey before it bites.

entry: POKENAME的大嘴通向一座无尽的漆黑洞穴。据说探索岩山隧道却不带灯的人，可能误入其中，再也出不来。
author: kobold_hijinks
source: POKENAME's gaping mouth opens into an endless pitch black cave. It's said those exploring Rock Tunnel without a light may stumble inside, never to escape.

entry: POKENAME口腔极大，双翼也巨大无比，能掀起强风自卫。超音蝠会躲进它嘴里，避开想收服自己的训练家。
author: over9001
source: POKENAME has an incredibly large oral cavity and a huge pair of wings which it can use to generate strong winds to protect itself. Zubat seek shelter in its mouth to hide from Trainers that try to capture them.

entry: POKENAME张开巨嘴，将毽子草、木棉球等猎物吸进来。它常无声漂浮，才突然袭击没防备的目标。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME opens its enormous mouth to vacuum in prey like Hoppip and Cottonee. It often drifts silently before striking unsuspecting targets.

entry: POKENAME既可算寄生者，也可算伏击猎手。跃向目标后，会试着用腿锁住对方，喝它的血。
author: dylonk25
source: POKENAME can be described as both a parasite and an ambush predator. After it leaps toward its victim, POKENAME attempts to hold it in a leg lock and drink its blood.

entry: 它飞过夜空，用有力双腿俯冲重击。猎物往往还没看见袭击，就已被击昏。
author: .izik
source: It soars through the night sky, using its powerful legs to deliver crushing dive-bombs. Prey rarely sees the attack coming before it is knocked unconscious.

entry: POKENAME身体柔软如绒，能掩藏动作，很难察觉。它爱在训练家视野边缘现身，又飞出视线取乐。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are difficult to detect because their soft, plush bodies give them the ability to mask their movements. They enjoy teasing Trainers by appearing in the corner of their view before flying out of sight.

entry: 它能将浓稠有毒的等离子体，化成束或刃射向敌人。牙里还有麻痹毒液，方便吸食猎物的血。
author: infinex21
source: It can fling bolts and blades of its dense, poisonous plasma at foes. Its fangs contain a paralytic venom that makes it easier to drain their prey of their blood.

entry: POKENAME夜行又敏捷，常被酒店雇来做深夜客房服务。靠双翼，能无声又迅速地穿过走廊。
author: .izik
source: Being nocturnal and agile, POKENAME is often employed by hotels for late-night room service. Its wings allow it to navigate hallways silently and swiftly.

entry: POKENAME看起来只是普通棺材，直到意图行窃的人经过。一察觉入侵者靠近，便张开足以整个人吞下的大嘴。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME appears as a regular coffin until a would-be thief walks by it. Once it senses the approach of an intruder, it opens its mouth wide enough to engulf them whole.

entry: POKENAME攀在洞顶耐心等候，从上方扑向猎物，再用腹部的嘴将其吞下。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME clings to the ceiling of caves, patiently waiting for prey. It pounces on its prey from above, devouring them with the mouth on its belly.

entry: 为捕捉特别大或强壮的猎物，POKENAME会在四肢间结网。猎物一近，就突然落下，用坚韧黏丝网住对方。
author: hophoppip
source: To capture particularly large or powerful prey, POKENAME spins a web between its limbs. When the prey approaches, it suddenly drops and ensnares them in a net of strong and sticky silk.

entry: POKENAME发出超声波，既用来回声定位，也抵御天敌。常聚在旧洞穴、废弃庄园等容易长蘑菇的地方。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME releases supersonic waves that serve as echolocation and protection from predators. Swarms of POKENAME gather in places where mushrooms are likely to grow, such as old caves or abandoned manors.

entry: 在古代市集，POKENAME曾是防盗的哨卫。一有麻烦，就发出震耳的刺耳声，通知守卫。
author: .izik
source: In ancient merchant grounds, POKENAME was used as a sentinel against theft. If trouble arose, it released a deafening Screech to alert guards.

entry: POKENAME将嘴张得极大，一次甩出大量内脏。内脏有毒刺，能从相当远的地方，向猎物注毒。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME opens its mouth extremely wide to fling out a large amount of its innards all at once. Said innards contain poison points that allow it to inject venom into prey from quite a distance.

entry: POKENAME给超音蝠提供栖处，让它们捕猎间隙安全休息。独特身体让它自己不便捕猎，超音蝠便分些捕到的猎物，作为回报。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME acts as a perch for Zubat to safely rest upon between hunts. Since its unique body makes hunting for itself difficult, the Zubat share some of the prey they grab with it in exchange for its service.

entry: POKENAME嘴的两侧各有大脑，常为要吃什么争斗。双方打架时夹进嘴里的东西，反而成了大部分养分的来源。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: The two sides of a POKENAME's mouth each have their own brain, which often leads to them fighting over what they want to eat. Most of their nourishment comes from anything caught between the two sides while they are fighting each other.

entry: 探险队曾在废弃城堡里发现POKENAME。发现它的人，却怕得不敢谈论。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Expeditions into abandoned castles have revealed POKENAME. The explorers who found it are too afraid to speak of it.

entry: POKENAME大部分时间躺在树下，偶尔也不起身，只伸出长舌抓几片叶，丢进张开的嘴。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME spends most of its time lying on the ground beneath a tree. Without getting up, it will occasionally stretch out its long tongue to grab a few leaves, then drop them into its open mouth.

entry: POKENAME大部分时间躺在树下，偶尔也不起身，只伸出长舌抓几片叶，丢进张开的嘴。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME spends most of its time lying on the ground beneath a tree. Without getting up, it will occasionally stretch out its long tongue to grab a few leaves, then drop them into its open mouth.

entry: 奇怪的是，POKENAME白天会冥想。夜里却活跃无比，小宝可梦、水果，能吃的全吞下。
author: bobosmith01
source: Oddly enough, POKENAME meditates during the day. At night, however, it is extremely active, devouring whatever it can, from small Pokémon to fruit.

entry: POKENAME的大嘴，让它能一口咬下大块食物。岩石身体却让天敌很难对它如法炮制。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have large mouths that allow them to bite big chunks of food. Their rocky bodies make it hard for their predators to do the same.

entry: POKENAME难以持续飞行，便借山间上升热气流，滑翔往返台地之间，节省体力。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME struggles with sustained flight. Instead, it glides between plateaus, using mountain thermals to conserve its strength.

entry: POKENAME的厚皮，能让它在极热中也保持清凉。若遇上足以伤它的强敌，就毫不犹豫飞走。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's thick hide keeps it cool even in extreme heat. If it encounters a foe strong enough to harm it, it retreats without hesitation by flying away.

entry: POKENAME动作缓慢，靠双翼载着移动。身体沉重，落在哪里，哪里就压出凹痕。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are slow creatures that rely on their wings to carry them around. Their body is so heavy that they cause indents wherever they land.

entry: POKENAME用超能力在洞中漂浮，以念力冲击制服敌人。主要在夜间活动，白天很少出洞。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME will use its psychic powers to float in caves and use telekinetic blasts to subdue foes. It is primarily active at nighttime and seldom leaves caves during the day.

entry: POKENAME冲进小猎物群，发射身上的毒刺捕猎。没中的惊慌逃走，它则享用被毒倒的猎物。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME hunts by diving into crowds of smaller prey and firing poisonous spikes from its body. It then feasts on those struck down by its toxins while the rest flees in fear.

entry: POKENAME的嘴相对身体大得惊人，一口能吃下自身体重数倍的食物。消化时动不了，只得攀着洞顶，等消化完才能再飞。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Thanks to their proportionately gigantic mouths, POKENAME can consume food many times their weight in a single gulp. They are immobile whilst they digest these meals, having to cling to the ceiling and wait before being able to fly again.

entry: POKENAME从洞壁垂下镶满宝石的舌头，引来黑暗鸦等猎物。靠得够近，就用可怕的黑夜魔影精准出击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME dangles its gem-covered tongue from cave walls to lure prey like Murkrow. Once close enough, it strikes with precision using a terrifying Night Shade.

entry: POKENAME爬行在漆黑洞穴的地面与墙壁，嘴始终大张。什么食物一进嘴，便迅速闭上，吞完又立刻张开。
author: bradlybro199
source: POKENAME crawl around the floors and walls of pitch-black caves. Their mouths remain wide open at all times until food of any kind enters, at which point they quickly snap shut just long enough to devour it.

entry: POKENAME先高速滚动，再奋力振翅，将自己弹向空中。它们从上方张大嘴捉住毫无防备的猎物，咬紧牙，再一路滚走。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME roll at incredible speeds before flapping their wings hard enough to launch themselves into the air. They open their mouths as wide as they can to capture unsuspecting prey from above, sinking their teeth into them and rolling away.

entry: 独特的牙，几乎什么猎物的皮都能咬破。舌头舔食流出的血，也散布着满是病毒与细菌的唾液。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Its unique teeth are capable of breaking the hide of almost any prey. Its tongue laps up the blood it spills while spreading its saliva filled with viruses and bacteria.

entry: POKENAME先用冰冷吐息冻住猎物，再近身。目标无法动弹，便以足以咬凹钢铁的力道下口。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME freezes prey with its frigid breath before closing in. Once its target is immobilized, it bites with enough strength to dent steel.

entry: POKENAME将大冰牙扎进受害者体内，将其冻住，再运回巢穴。住在严寒洞穴深处，那里有时近乎绝对零度。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME freezes its victims by sinking its massive ice fangs into them, then carries them back to its den. It lives deep within frigid caverns, where temperatures sometimes approach absolute zero.

entry: POKENAME头上的叶子，有淡淡龙蒿香。帷幕市的厨师，会用这芳香叶片制作招牌菜。
author: .izik
source: The leaves on POKENAME's head emit a faint scent of tarragon. Chefs in Veilstone City use these aromatic leaves to prepare their signature dishes.

entry: POKENAME舞姿繁复，双翼优雅地来回挥动，常先迷住猎物、使其分心，再从空中展开捕猎。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME performs an intricate dance, gracefully waving its wings back and forth. This mesmerizing display often distracts prey before it begins its aerial hunt.

entry: POKENAME攻击前，会跳一段优雅的交谊舞，最后用威力惊人的毒液冲击，为表演收尾。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME performs a graceful ballroom-style dance before striking its foes. It finishes the performance with a devastating Venoshock attack.

entry: POKENAME张嘴以惊人速度游泳，沿路什么都吞下。利牙中的毒足以麻痹吼鲸王，对人类更是致命。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME swim at astonishing speeds with their mouth agape, swallowing anything in their path. Their sharp fangs hold enough venom to paralyze a Wailord, making POKENAME bites deadly to humans.

entry: POKENAME躲在柳树里，发出怪笑，分散毫无戒心者的注意。诡异笑声，给同伴创造了绝佳出手机会。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME hides within willow trees, cackling to distract unsuspecting targets. Its eerie laughter provides the perfect opening for an ally to strike.

entry: POKENAME牙上滴下的腐蚀性酸，能瞬间溶解植物。它借此清除领地里的灌丛。
author: .izik
source: The caustic acid that drips from POKENAME's fangs can dissolve plant matter instantly. It uses this to clear out undergrowth in its territory.

entry: POKENAME缓慢优雅地振翼滑翔。一见猎物，就用蓬松双翼急速加速，露出獠牙俯冲攻击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME glides with slow, graceful wingbeats until it spots prey. Once it does, it accelerates rapidly with its fluffy wings and divebombs with fangs ready to strike.

entry: 许多邪恶组织因POKENAME吸血，便选它作战。不过，多数个体最后都太过友好，没法对旁人造成多大威胁。
author: .realthree
source: Many villainous organizations select POKENAME for use in battles because these Pokémon feed on blood. However, most POKENAME end up being too friendly to pose much of a danger to others.

entry: 大张的颚，是数十只超音蝠的移动栖所。吓人的外表，是为了赶走可能的入侵者。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Its gaping jaw serves as a portable roost for dozens of Zubat. Its alarming appearance is to ward off any would-be intruders.

entry: POKENAME的牙锋利如剃刀，连钨都能刺穿。这份惊人力量，让它成为领地里可怕的猎手。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's fangs are razor-sharp, capable of piercing even tungsten. This incredible strength makes it a fearsome predator in its territory.

entry: POKENAME无声滑过夜空，随后落在救生艇上，将其压沉。海难幸存者，常被它有力抓住，拖入深处。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME silently glides through the night sky before dropping onto lifeboats to sink them. Survivors of shipwrecks are often pulled into the depths by its powerful grip.

entry: POKENAME在海底等太阳珊瑚等小猎物，前来探查洞穴般的大嘴。一进嘴，就会被它咬住。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME waits on the seafloor for smaller prey like Corsola to investigate its cave-like maw. Once inside, it will bite down on the prey.

entry: 许多穿行月见山的训练家，都觉得这些宝可梦很烦。POKENAME双颚虽弱，牙却大得足以狠狠刮伤太靠近洞穴的旅人的脚踝。
author: chinigan
source: Many Trainers venturing through Mt. Moon will find these Pokémon a nuisance. POKENAME have weak jaws, but their teeth are massive enough to leave nasty scrapes on the ankles of travelers that walk too close to their burrows.

entry: POKENAME的嘴能张到一口吞下大尾立。吃饱后，尾鳞便泛起迷人的紫光。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME can open its mouth wide enough to swallow a Furret whole. When it is full, its tail scale glows with a mesmerizing violet shimmer.

entry: POKENAME所到之处，吸血鬼的传说往往随之而来。训练家若惹它不快，第二天可能会觉得自己格外虚弱。
author: puppylev
source: Where a POKENAME goes, myths of vampires are usually soon to follow. If its trainer upsets it, they might find themselves feelings particularly drained the next day.

entry: POKENAME从嘴里放出超声波，再用火焰轰向敌人，烤熟了才吃。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME lets loose supersonic waves from its mouth, then blasts the foe with flames to cook them before eating them.

entry: POKENAME夜飞火山地带，用刺耳尖叫让卡蒂狗等猎物失去行动力，再俯冲使出猛烈的惊吓，完成攻击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME flies over volcanic regions at night, releasing piercing screeches to disable prey like Growlithe. It then dives in to finish the assault with an aggressive Astonish attack.

entry: 什么想碰POKENAME的棉花糖身体，都会立刻被咬。成功尝过的人说，是酸酸的蓝树莓味。
author: fireflower20002
source: Anything that tries to touch POKENAME's cotton candy body will immediately get bitten by it. Those who have been able to get a taste say that the cotton candy has a sour blue-raspberry flavor.

entry: POKENAME尖叫着，吓退闯进地道住处的生物。若对方不走，就会冲上去，使出凶狠的头锤。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME lets out sharp screeches to scare others from its tunnel home. If they persist, it charges with a savage Headbutt.

entry: POKENAME用双翼快速游过湖泊，双颚捕住小拉达等猎物，拖进深处吃。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its wings to swim quickly through lakes. It catches prey like Rattata in its jaws, dragging them into the depths to feed.

entry: POKENAME成群袭击时，尖叫声回荡洞穴。吃完，便钻进洞顶，在离地高处安全休息。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's piercing screeches echo through caves during a swarm attack. After feeding, it digs into the ceiling to rest safely above the ground.

entry: POKENAME裹着松土，混入路面，毫无预兆地咬住旅人的脚，将人拖入地下。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME coats itself in loose dirt to blend in with paths. It bites travelers' feet and drags them underground without warning.

entry: 它常住洞穴深处。对老练矿工来说，发现POKENAME，就意味着附近很可能有矿。
author: supersonicloki
source: It is often found deep in caves. Finding a POKENAME is a sign of nearby ore deposits to veteran miners.

entry: 若有人在池边钓鱼，POKENAME便俯冲抢走钓竿，趁对方分心，再拿走钓获。
author: .izik
source: If it spots someone fishing near its pond, POKENAME will swoop down and steal their fishing pole. It uses the distraction to take their catch.

entry: POKENAME躲在瀑布巢穴附近，用超音波伏击入侵者。隐秘战术，让住处免受打扰。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME hides near its waterfall den and uses Supersonic to ambush intruders. Its stealthy tactics ensure its home remains undisturbed.

entry: POKENAME很亲人，会跳到训练家身边，用湿答答的舌头舔个没完。太过热情，常害训练家赴约迟到。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are very affectionate, bounding up to their trainers and giving long, slobbery licks. Their enthusiasm leaves them prone to making their trainers late for appointments.

entry: 融合得来大嘴蝠的大嘴，让POKENAME一次能喷出远多于融合前的火焰。喷出大股火流时，还能看到尾火缩小。
author: sk372
source: Gaining Golbat's wide mouth allows POKENAME to blow out much more flame from its mouth at once than it could before fusion. As it breathes out huge gouts of flame, one can notice the fire on its tail shrink.

entry: POKENAME潜进浑浊池塘，只露出耳朵，耐心等猎物游荡到近处，再发起攻击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME submerges itself in murky ponds, leaving only its ears exposed. It waits patiently for prey to wander close before attacking.

entry: 热天里，POKENAME潜进湖中降温。大口吸水有时会造出漩涡，将猎物拖到够得着的地方。
author: .izik
source: During hot days, POKENAME submerges itself in lakes to cool off. Its deep inhalations of water can sometimes create whirlpools that drag prey into its reach.

entry: POKENAME将四肢大张，形成翼面，一次能滑翔数百米。独特的翼形，曾给改进人用翼装的工程师带来灵感。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME spread their arms and legs wide to create an aerofoil, allowing them to glide hundreds of meters at a time. Their unique wing shape has served as inspiration for engineers looking to improve on wingsuit designs for people.

entry: 它喜欢用关节技制住对手。待猎物虚弱下来，再吸干鲜血，作最后一击。
author: chazzwozzer32
source: This Pokémon likes to put its opponents in submission holds. When its prey is weakened, it will finish it off by draining its blood.

entry: 壳虽只护住身体一小部分，却能减轻阻力，让POKENAME靠大翼在水中或空中前进。既能强力喷毒，也能用利牙撕咬。
author: .jerden
source: Its shell only protects a small part of its body, but it helps to minimize resistance as POKENAME propels itself through water or air with its large wings. It can attack by spitting venom with great force, or by biting with its sharp fangs.

entry: POKENAME摇摇摆摆地走着，徒劳拍打叶片，想要飞起来。平衡虽差，速度却出奇地快，常趁猎物不备，突然咬下。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME awkwardly waddle about while flapping their leaves in futile attempts to fly. Despite their lack of traditional balance, they still possess a surprising level of speed, managing to sink their teeth into prey when they least expect it.

entry: POKENAME从空中巡游风暴海域，寻找猎物，常在同群伙伴协助下，用触手从甲板卷走水手。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME patrols stormy oceans from the sky in search of prey. Its tentacles seize sailors from ship decks, often with assistance from the rest of its swarm.

entry: POKENAME住在海蚀洞里，躲进暗角，等待猎物游过，再将其拖回洞中，吸上好几个小时的血。
author: jokerswild
source: POKENAME live in sea caves, hiding in dark corners and waiting for prey to swim by. It drags its prey into its cave and sucks its blood for hours.

entry: POKENAME用大嘴扫过河岸，吞下养分丰富的泥土，补足长途飞行的能量。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME sweeps its large mouth across riverbanks to ingest nutrient-rich mud. This sustains its energy for long flights.

entry: POKENAME飞过时，从崖壁扯下灌木，在半空吃掉。它尤其爱吃高处的植物。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME tears shrubs from cliff walls while flying and devours them mid-air. It prefers high-altitude vegetation for its meals.

entry: POKENAME石头般坚硬的身体，内部完全中空，双翼轻松就能带它夜飞峡谷。受威胁时，会用石身猛撞，碾压对手。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's rock-hard body is completely hollow inside, allowing its wings to easily fly it through canyons at night. It will slam its stone body into a foe if threatened, using its sturdy form to crush opponents.

entry: POKENAME尾巴散出桃桃果汁般的甜香。它将尾巴垂进大颚蚁洞里，希望轻松钓到一餐。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's tail emits a sweet aroma, reminiscent of Pecha Berry juice. It dangles its tail into Trapinch burrows, hoping to snag an easy meal.

entry: POKENAME在水下也像飞行般振翼，甚至能跃出海面，在水上长距离滑翔。靠灵活身手，伏击水生宝可梦，用牙吸血。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME flaps its wings as if flying to move underwater, and can even leap out of the ocean to glide long distances above the surface. It uses its maneuverability to ambush other aquatic Pokémon and drain their blood with its fangs.

entry: POKENAME只有中间的头长舌头，三个头却都能尝到滋味。它馋着洞里沉积的盐分，常花好几个小时舔东西。
author: .izik
source: Only the center head of POKENAME possesses a tongue, yet all three heads can taste through it. It will spend hours licking objects in a cave, craving salt deposits.

entry: 看见水中的大钳蟹等猎物，POKENAME便从上方扎进去。大嘴合得快得惊人，牢牢抓住猎物。
author: .izik
source: When it spots prey like Krabby in the water, POKENAME dives in from above. Its large mouth snaps shut with incredible speed to secure its catch.

entry: POKENAME的大嘴，一次能吞好几只好坏星。它先用耀眼的奇异之光击昏猎物，再吞下。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's massive mouth can consume multiple Mareanie at once. It employs a dazzling Confuse Ray to stun its prey before devouring them.

entry: POKENAME由黏稠、甜香的液体构成，树果吃得越多，甜味就越浓。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body is composed of a viscous, sweet-smelling fluid. Its sweetness intensifies the more Berries it consumes.

entry: 沉壳让POKENAME在陆上比水下慢，但仍能跃出水面，用牙咬住靠近岸边的猎物。血喝得越多，蓬松尾巴的颜色就越深。
author: .jerden
source: Its heavy shell makes it slower on land than underwater, but POKENAME can still leap above the surface to sink its fangs into prey that approaches the water's edge. The more blood it drinks, the deeper the color of its fluffy tail becomes.

entry: POKENAME从嘴里喷出的水，力道足以击昏猎物。利牙能刺破其他宝可梦的硬壳，让它痛饮血液。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME fires water out of its mouth with enough force to stun prey. POKENAME's fangs are sharp enough to puncture the hard shells of other Pokémon, allowing POKENAME to gorge itself on their blood.

entry: POKENAME在洞穴或夜间，袭击没防备的人和宝可梦。只吸到对方头昏、踉跄离开的程度，就觉得好笑极了。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME attacks unaware people and Pokémon in caves or at night. It only drains them of enough blood so the victim stumbles off disoriented, which POKENAME finds hilarious.

entry: POKENAME的翼利如刀，身体像钻头般旋转，最硬的岩层也能开出隧道。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's wings are as sharp as blades. By spinning its body like a drill, it can clear tunnels through even the hardest rock formations.

entry: POKENAME将嘴罩在熟睡者头上，用超能力吃掉梦。诡异的进食方式，催生了许多令人不安的传说。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME positions its mouth over the head of a sleeping victim to psychically consume their dreams. Its eerie feeding behavior has inspired many unsettling legends.

entry: POKENAME牙里的毒较弱，便用强大咬合力弥补。大嘴轻松一咬，就能将坚石咬碎。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's poison in its fangs is rather weak, so it compensates with a powerful bite force. Its large mouth can chomp down and shatter solid stone without breaking a sweat.

entry: POKENAME的触角极其敏感，轻轻一碰就会放出微弱电击。它藏在河床底下，只有吃附近植物时才出来。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's antennae are very sensitive and will generate a small electric shock with the slightest touch. It hides at the bottom of the riverbed and will only come out to feed on the nearby plants.

entry: POKENAME将身体胀得越鼓，远离它的警告就越强。哪怕轻触，也可能引发巨大的电力爆炸。
author: sk372
source: The more bulbous a POKENAME has inflated itself, the more it serves as a warning to stay away. Even a faint touch could cause it to burst in a massive explosion of electricity.

entry: 碰到POKENAME的黄斑，就会挨一下电击。舌上也有黄斑，因此每次吃东西，都在电自己。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Touching POKENAME's yellow spots delivers a jolt of electricity. Because it has these spots on its tongue, it is constantly shocking itself whenever it eats.

entry: POKENAME很受爱恶作剧的人欢迎。一踩，就发出响亮屁声，气味也配合得逼真。
author: musicsheep.
source: Popular amongst pranksters, stepping on POKENAME causes a loud, flatulent sound. On top of this, the smell adds to the authenticity.

entry: POKENAME很受爱恶作剧的人欢迎。一踩，就发出响亮屁声，气味也配合得逼真。
author: musicsheep.
source: Popular amongst pranksters, stepping on POKENAME causes a loud, flatulent sound. On top of this, the smell adds to the authenticity.

entry: 它埋在安静沙滩的沙下，吸取暖意。被打扰便迅速放电，再旋转着埋得更深，免被发现。
author: .izik
source: It lies buried in the sand on quiet beaches, soaking up warmth. If disturbed, it releases a quick shock and buries itself deeper by spinning to avoid detection.

entry: POKENAME的利刃带电，一碰就疼。强健双腿与流线身体，让它能轻松跑过泥泞河床。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's blades are charged with electricity, painfully shocking anything on contact. Its strong legs and sleek body allow it to run across the muddy riverbed with ease.

entry: POKENAME合钳时，噼啪放电，借这份电力，能压倒比自己大得多的对手。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME crackles with electricity as it snaps its pincers. With this charge, it can overpower much larger opponents in battle.

entry: 它故意跳上陆地捕猎，假装离水后无助。等有生物试图碰它，便用电击倒，再拖着新猎物，蹦回海里。
author: sk372
source: It purposefully throws itself onto land in order to hunt. Pretending to be helpless out of the water, it waits until something attempts to touch it before jolting them with electricity, then flopping back to sea with its new prey in tow.

entry: POKENAME沿河床蠕动，用带电的角刺近身的宝可梦。旱季会深掘地下，寻找小型含水层。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME wriggles along the riverbed, jabbing any Pokémon who gets close with its electrified horn. During the dry season, POKENAME digs deep underground to find small aquifers.

entry: POKENAME只住在四周泥泞的水域，将头埋在岸边表层泥里。猎物一踩头，就会被它用压倒性的力量拖进水里。
author: infinex21
source: Found only near bodies of water surrounded by mud, POKENAME will bury their head in the surface mud near the edges. The moment any prey steps upon their head, they use their overwhelming strength to drag them into the water.

entry: POKENAME的浓毛能吸收多余电力、导入地下，适合当宠物。平日悠然自得，却不信任陌生人，可能骗对方摸头，再用鬃毛状捕夹夹住手电击。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME's dense fur absorbs and grounds any excess electricity, making it a suitable pet. Despite its content nature, it distrusts strangers and may trick them into petting its head before clamping its mane-trap on their hand and shocking them.

entry: POKENAME半埋在岸边湿沙，身体敏锐感受其他生物靠近。什么离得太近，就猛地跃起贴上对方脸，施以痛苦电击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME buries itself partially in the wet sands on the shoreline, its body tuned to listen for another creature's approach. If anything draws too close, it suddenly leaps from the sand and latches onto their face to deliver a painful jolt.

entry: POKENAME是古代最顽强耐活的物种之一，也是善于钻空子的食腐者。它等大猎手捉到猎物，再用电击昏猎手，抢走一餐。
author: sk372
source: One of the hardiest and most tenacious species of the ancient world, POKENAME was a highly opportunistic scavenger. It would wait until bigger hunters caught their prey before stunning them with electricity and swiping their meal.

entry: POKENAME带着火焰飞行，出奇地优雅。着陆却狼狈得多，一头撞地，滑出好几英尺才停，趴着等下次想飞才起身。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's flames make it look oddly graceful when flying through the air. It lands with far less grace, crashing and sliding across the ground several feet before stopping and lying prone until it feels like taking off again.

entry: POKENAME喜欢埋在海边泥里。谁想把它挖出来，就会被超能力甩走。若还吓不退，它便干脆瞬间移动离开。
author: imaginita
source: POKENAME likes to bury itself in the mud of the seashore. If anybody tries to dig it up, it will use psychic powers to fling them away. If that's still not enough of a deterrent, POKENAME will just teleport itself away.

entry: 脸的位置尴尬，令它飞行时难以察觉周围，频频碰撞。它宁愿用薄弱双翼在地上爬，那模样被形容为“可怜得可爱”。
author: bukie
source: In flight, its awkwardly positioned face leads to many collisions, owing to its lack of awareness. It prefers to crawl along the ground with its flimsy wings; the sight of this act was described as "endearingly pathetic".

entry: 夜里，POKENAME将自己的羊毛铺在群体四周。天敌一踩，就会遭强力电击，陷入麻痹。
author: .izik
source: At night, POKENAME lines its herd's perimeter with its own wool. Any predator that steps on it suffers a strong paralyzing shock.

entry: POKENAME静卧水洼吸水。若被踩，就猛烈喷水反击，足以将人向后轰飞。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME lies still in puddles to absorb water. If stepped on, it retaliates by blasting water so forcefully it can launch a person backward.

entry: 受惊时，POKENAME飞旋头上的鳍，扬起海底沙云。碰到鳍，会挨猛烈电击。
author: mistymagius
source: When frightened, POKENAME will rapidly spin the fins on its head, kicking up a cloud of sand from the seafloor. Touching these fins will cause a nasty electric shock.

entry: POKENAME住在小湖，将湖底涂满导电凝胶。什么来到水底，都会挨强烈电击，小生物更会被击昏。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME live in small lakes which they coat the bottom of with a conductive gel. Anything that comes to the bottom is given a nasty shock which knocks out smaller creatures.

entry: POKENAME住在小湖，将湖底涂满导电凝胶，再把自己埋在下面。什么来到水底，都会挨强烈电击，小生物更会被击昏。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME live in small lakes which they coat the bottom of with a conductive gel, then bury themselves under. Anything that comes to the bottom is given a nasty shock which knocks out smaller creatures.

entry: 养POKENAME最难的事之一，就是想让它干净。它讨厌身上没泥，一觉得太干净，就立刻寻找最近的泥坑跳进去。
author: sk372
source: One of the hardest parts of owning a POKENAME is attempting to keep it clean. It detests not having mud on its body and will immediately seek out the nearest mud puddle to jump into when it feels too clean.

entry: POKENAME狡猾地趁猎物外出，埋伏进它的巢或地洞。主人一近，便突然扑出，用冰冷一击打倒。即使被发现，坚韧皮肤也能保它安全。
author: bobosmith01
source: To hunt, POKENAME cunningly buries itself in its prey's den or burrow once they leave. When the occupant comes close, it suddenly lunges out and takes them down with one chilling strike. Even if discovered, it will remain safe due to its sturdy skin.

entry: POKENAME厚毛如钢，肩上的毛每月脱落。它用蜕毛做成天然捕兽夹，布在领地各处。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME's thick fur is like steel, the fur along their shoulders shed monthly. They use this shed fur to create natural bear traps, which they lay around their territories.

entry: POKENAME藏在岩质海底的碎石与卵石间，伪装成普通石头。藏得连同类也能骗过，有时整片岩层其实全是它们。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME hide amongst broken stones and pebbles along rocky sea floors, disguising themselves as just another stone. They are good enough at hiding that they even fool other POKENAME, with entire rock formations sometimes being formed of them.

entry: POKENAME在离水仅几英寸处滑翔，身后火花如雾般拖曳。它几乎无声地掠过海面。
author: .izik
source: While gliding just inches above water, POKENAME sheds sparks that trail behind it like mist. It travels almost silently across the ocean surface.

entry: POKENAME穿行泥里，将毒散在地上。入侵者一进领地，就向散布的毒素传出微弱电脉冲，迅速削弱敌人防御。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME slither through mud to scatter poison along the ground. If an intruder enters their territory, they will release slight electric pulses through the scattered toxins to rapidly wear down their foe's defenses.

entry: POKENAME住在深海，完美伪装成海床的一部分。身体起伏蓄电时，上方海面便会形成猛烈雷暴。
author: coridiant
source: POKENAME lives deep under the ocean, disguising itself perfectly on the seabed. When it undulates to build electricity, fierce lightning storms are generated on the surface above.

entry: POKENAME贴地平躺或贴住墙，常被误当成画，而不是真宝可梦。研究者在遗迹里找它，可人一不看着，它就飞走。
author: .jerden
source: When POKENAME lies flat on the floor or against a wall, it is easily mistaken for a painted image rather than a real Pokémon. Researchers are searching for POKENAME in ruins, but it tends to fly away as soon as humans are no longer looking at it.

entry: 可伸长的舌头覆着放电器官，能麻痹猎物。舌头有自己的意识，能伸到一整座足球场那么长。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Its extendable tongue is covered in shock-emitting organs that paralyze prey. This tongue has a mind of its own and can extend to the length of a football field.

entry: POKENAME鲜亮的叶状部位，通过光合作用产生防身电力。动用电力后，身体会散出腐臭刺鼻的气味。
author: sk372
source: Photosynthesizing sunlight allows the bright, leafy parts of POKENAME's body to generate electricity to defend itself with. After using its electric powers, its body emits a putrid, acrid stench into the air.

entry: POKENAME通过皮肤吸收阳光，进行光合作用，再将能量储为电力，受威胁时释放。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses photosynthesis to absorb sunlight through its skin. It stores the energy as electricity, which it releases when threatened.

entry: POKENAME松垮地站在泥地中央，直到有东西靠近，才突然挺身摆出战斗架势，挥臂从肘部向闯入者发射闪电。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME stands with a limp posture in the middle of muddy areas until something draws near. Then it suddenly springs into a rigid battle stance, swinging its arms and sending bolts of lightning from its elbows at the trespasser.

entry: POKENAME将身体半埋地里，露在外面，爪子却藏得更深。想绕行的生物，常踩上藏爪的地方，挨一下痛苦电击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME partially buries itself into the ground, letting itself remain visible while hiding its claws further underground. Those who try to go around it often step onto where its claws are hidden and receive a painful jolt.

entry: POKENAME在泥泞海岸用沙藏身，等猎物走进嘴里。在沙滩行走，最好小心提防它。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME conceal themselves with sand on muddy seashores, waiting for their prey to walk into their jaws. It is highly recommended people watch out for POKENAME when walking on beaches.

entry: POKENAME体形虽极大，却很擅长伏击。巨躯藏在河湖的泥下，小宝可梦太靠近，就被它扑出，用体重碾压。
author: william_t2144.
source: Despite its incredible size, POKENAME is an extremely effective ambush predator, hiding its massive body underneath the mud of lakes and rivers, pouncing on smaller Pokémon that get too close, crushing them under its weight.

entry: 它躺在泥里，只露出脸，像只大号泥巴鱼，直到爬出追逐更机警的猎物，才显露真身。脸坚硬得连陨石撞击也伤不了。
author: bandedbodypress
source: It lies in mud with just its face out, looking like a larger Stunfisk until it emerges and pursues smarter prey. Its face is so durable that a meteor strike cannot harm it.

entry: POKENAME把身体压平、变形，尽量不惹眼，等猎物踩上来。随后迸出麻痹电力，电光冲得高，数米外都能看见。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME flattens itself out and reshapes its body to be as unassuming as possible, waiting for prey to step upon it. Once they do, it releases a burst of paralyzing electrical energy tall enough to be seen several meters away.

entry: POKENAME全身像一块棱镜，角度合适便能折射光。打喷嚏时，会喷出彩虹般的色彩。
author: atlas3339098
source: POKENAME's entire body is a prism capable of refracting light when angled correctly. When it sneezes, it shoots and sprays out colors like a rainbow.

entry: 这些宝可梦藏在大湖岸边的泥里。人们警告小孩别碰湖岸泥，免得吓得魂飞魄散。
author: secondatheniangadfly
source: These Pokémon conceal themselves in the mud on the shores of large lakes. Small children are warned to stay away from lakeshore mud, lest they experience the fright of their lives.

entry: 这种宝可梦住在低顶洞穴，将扁头贴在洞顶，感受猎物震动。POKENAME不善飞行，便在山间滑翔，寻找新洞穴狩猎。
author: milchik
source: This Pokémon lives in caves with low ceilings, against which it presses its flat head to detect its prey's vibrations. POKENAME isn't a good flyer and instead glides from mountain to mountain in search of new caves to hunt in.

entry: POKENAME触角末梢带着静电，与同类一碰触角，就能把冗长的交流浓缩成几秒。
author: .izik
source: The tips of POKENAME's feelers are charged with static. It touches feelers with others of its kind to condense out long, drawn-out communications into just a few seconds.

entry: POKENAME藏在浅层地下，等人或宝可梦踩上，才释放巨大能量。要安全找出藏身处，唯一办法就是用磁铁探测金属甲。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME buries its body underground but close to the surface, then waits until a person or Pokémon steps on it to discharge a huge amount of energy. The only safe way to locate a hidden POKENAME is to use magnets to detect its metal armor.

entry: POKENAME有时会陷入存在的迷惘。严重时，就四肢摊开、仰面躺下，低低嘀咕一声：“唉……”
author: xenophacilus
source: POKENAME is prone to periods of existential crisis. When this problem worsens, it lies down flat on its back and a faint sound mutters out: "Man".

entry: POKENAME体内大半是泥，动起来总难免漏些出来。它慢慢爬过海底，时刻害怕碰到尖东西。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's body is mostly filled with mud, meaning it struggles to move without spilling some of its mud. It slowly crawls across the seafloor, constantly terrified of coming in contact with something sharp.

entry: POKENAME在树根与杂物间假扮旧地毯。什么一碰，发光纤维便瞬间缠紧，吸走生命能量，令其动弹不得。
author: ilija09
source: POKENAME disguises itself as an old carpet among roots and debris. Its glowing fibers tighten instantly around anything that touches it, draining their life energy and leaving them immobilized.

entry: POKENAME坐在海底，吃沙中矿物。什么靠得太近，就用刺夹紧，施以麻痹电击。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME sits on the seafloor, feeding on the minerals in the sand. If anything gets too close to it, it will clamp down on them with its spines and deliver a paralyzing electric shock.

entry: POKENAME在陆上摇摇晃晃地走，模样可笑，实际却异常凶悍。尤其到了水中，动作更灵活敏捷。
author: sk372
source: When walking on land, POKENAME moves with a wobbling and swaying gait that makes it look rather ridiculous. It is deceptively aggressive however, particularly in the water where it is far more mobile and agile.

entry: POKENAME感知波导，辨别人心。若察觉邪恶，便放出强电，施以审判。
author: .izik
source: By sensing their aura, POKENAME can detect a person's intent. If it senses evil, it discharges intense electricity as a form of judgment.

entry: POKENAME在泥洼打滚，让身体裹泥保湿。受威胁就抖落带电泥团，溅到谁，谁便会被电。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME rolls around in mud puddles to keep its body coated and moist. If it feels threatened, it shakes its body to shed clumps of mud charged with its own electricity, jolting those the mud splatters against.

entry: 它通过活动身体发电，因此十分活跃。等电力释放完，又会变得懒洋洋，直到重新充足。
author: staghorn
source: It generates electricity by moving its body and is quite active as a result. Once it unleashes its charge, it is lethargic until it recharges.

entry: 视力差让它胆小易惊。感到附近有东西，就向周围放电自卫，击昏闯入者，好趁机逃走。
author: sk372
source: Its poor vision leaves it with a skittish demeanor. If it senses something nearby, it will surge electricity around itself in defense to stun the interloper and allow it to flee.

entry: 头冠里有大量电感受器，让它在泥中游动也能发现猎物。可若迎头撞到东西，常把自己电着。
author: mistymagius
source: Its crest contains large amounts of electroreceptors, allowing it to detect its prey while swimming through the mud. However, it often ends up shocking itself if it bumps headfirst into something.

entry: POKENAME旋转着穿过泥沙，寻找一起进化的伙伴。它会触发赶海寻宝者的金属探测器，于是常电击对方自卫。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME spins through muddy sand in search of a partner to join it for evolution. It shocks many beachcombing treasure hunters in self-defense when it sets off their metal detectors.

entry: POKENAME在河底挖洞，用鳍状耳朵游泳。捕猎时，把耳朵缠住目标，一直电到对方麻痹。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME makes its burrows underneath rivers, using its fin-like ears to swim. To catch its prey, it will wrap its ears around them and shock them until they become paralyzed.

entry: POKENAME飘过沼泽，发光的黄色凝胶随电流脉动。夜里，光按节奏闪烁，宛如沼中信标。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME floats through marshes, its glowing yellow gel pulsing with electricity. At night, its light flashes in patterns like a swamp beacon.

entry: 有人认为，POKENAME的凶悍来自前世残留的怒气。它像一副脱离身体的双颚，朝旁人咬合，咬住便施以痛苦电击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's aggression is believed by some to be from possessing residual anger from a previous life. It gnashes its body at others like a set of disembodied jaws that deliver a painful shock once it bites onto something.

entry: 被POKENAME夹住的猎物，会遭到闪电般强劲的电击。幸好，疑似有猎物上钩后，这种宝可梦的反应很迟缓。
author: jangodiot
source: When prey is clamped down by POKENAME, it receives electric jolts as powerful as lightning. Fortunately, this Pokémon is very slow to react after making a potential catch.

entry: POKENAME扁得几乎难用肉眼看见。科学家发现，它甚至比纸和人的发丝还薄。
author: _snakeywakey_
source: POKENAME is so flat that it is barely visible to the human eye. Scientists have found that it is thinner than paper and human hair.

entry: POKENAME的叶片覆着麻痹毒素，能让触碰的小宝可梦僵住。叶片却能泡成提神茶，是某些运动员的日常饮料。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME leaves are coated in a paralyzing toxin that stuns smaller Pokémon that touch them. These leaves can be brewed into an energizing tea that is a common beverage for certain athletes.

entry: POKENAME沿河漂流，借流水在羽间发电。什么想从上方袭击，都会遭到强力电击。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME floats along the river, generating electricity in its feathers from the running water. Anything that tries to attack it from above will be met with a powerful electric shock.

entry: 在满是细菌的泥里待上几小时，POKENAME便会从多臂的究极奈克洛兹玛形态，变成现在的样子。蓄电发射闪电时，皮瓣里的细菌会被清除。
author: soup1900
source: When POKENAME sits in bacteria-filled mud for hours, its body shapeshifts from its Ultra Necrozma form with many arms to this current form. When it charges and fires bolts of electricity, the bacteria within its skin flaps are purged.

entry: POKENAME捕猎时，用触手放电，常先击昏数只太阳珊瑚，再拖回水下巢穴。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME emits jolts of electricity through its tentacles while hunting. It often stuns several Corsola before dragging them into its underwater den.

entry: POKENAME的菌盖微微发光，在阴暗沼泽栖地里诱来猎物。吃下蘑菇会令脑部活动剧增，出现过度活跃、幻觉与欣快感。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME's mushroom caps give off weak light that attracts prey in their dreary swamp homes. Consuming the mushrooms causes an intense increase in brain activity resulting in hyperactivity, hallucinations and euphoria.

entry: 可怕的POKENAME用玩偶，将小宝可梦引进大张的嘴里，一边偷走活力，一边微笑。
author: the_fireplace
source: The terrifying POKENAME lures smaller Pokémon into its open mouth with a doll. It smiles while stealing their vitality.

entry: POKENAME常在沼泽芦苇间嬉戏。大眼有出众的八色视觉，八类视锥感光细胞，让它看世界的色彩格外鲜活绚丽。
author: beatdoof
source: POKENAME are often found in marshes, frolicking around the reeds. Their large eyes are notable for their octochromacy, having eight cone photoreceptors that allow it to see the world's colors more vibrantly and vividly.

entry: POKENAME由泥状物质构成，在海边摇摆行走时不断剥落。人们发现，留下的一滩滩物质含糖很高，吃起来像坚果巧克力。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME's body is made of a mud-like structure that sloughs off as it waddles through its seaside habitat. Humans have realized that the leftover puddles of POKENAME have a high sugar content and taste like nutty chocolate.

entry: 它意外地擅长做松饼。分泌来诱猎物的甜糖浆，也能浇在自己做的松饼上，十分美味。
author: hophoppip
source: It has an unusual knack for making pancakes. The sweet syrup it secretes to lure in prey is also a tasty topping for the flapjacks it prepares.

entry: POKENAME摇摆行走，腰间松皮便积起静电。轻轻蹭过，也能让人头发竖起。
author: .izik
source: Static builds in the loose skin around POKENAME's waist as it waddles. Even brushing against it can cause hair to stand on end.

entry: 用一群泥巴鼠布成“雷区”，看似好计策，直到吃饭时，它们还得彼此争抢。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: The strategy of a "minefield" of Stunletts seems smart, until they are left having to fight over the meal.

entry: POKENAME情绪多变又冷淡，游荡在人类聚落，偏爱蜷在最碍事的地方。谁想强行挪走，就会挨它愤怒的电击。
author: sk372
source: Very moody and standoffish in disposition, POKENAME loiters about among human civilizations, curling up in the most inconvenient of places. Any who try to move it forcibly will receive an angry shock.

entry: 体内电力刺激脑部，让POKENAME天生焦虑。它躺在河床底，吃沙里的矿物。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is naturally anxious due to the electricity in its body stimulating its brain. It lays at the bottom of the riverbed, feeding on the minerals in the sand.

entry: POKENAME藏在泥里，只露出尾巴，电击一切碰到的生物。皮肤开始干燥，吸收电力便会更困难。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME hides in the mud with only its tail sticking out, shocking anything that touches it. When its skin starts drying out, it becomes harder for it to absorb electricity.

entry: POKENAME腹部的螺纹催眠般旋转，让猎物入睡，再用发光的黄手反复电击。
author: .izik
source: The spiral on POKENAME's belly rotates hypnotically to put prey to sleep. It then electrocutes them repeatedly with its glowing yellow hands.

entry: POKENAME热爱战斗，打着打着就咧嘴大笑。皮肤极其坚韧，即使别的宝可梦会觉得危险的地带，也能见到它。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME loves to battle: it breaks out into wide grins in the midst of combat. Its skin is extremely hardy, so it can be found even in areas that would be deemed hazardous to other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME爬上山道旁的高处，向下方经过的远足者扔石头。谁想清走它，就会被头上明亮的冠电击。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME climb up to high places near mountain trails, and then throw rocks down at hikers passing below. If anyone tries to remove them, they will deliver electrical shocks using the bright crest on their head.

entry: POKENAME在河底相连，共享大量电力。任何东西碰上，都会像撞到电围栏一样，遭到强力电击。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME link together at the bottom of the river, sharing immense amounts of electricity between them. Anything that comes into contact with them will be met with a powerful shock similar to an electric fence.

entry: 它们住在管理不善的观光海滩附近，消化贝壳与垃圾来成长。气味刺鼻，像牙膏，因为能清理沙滩，倒也被人容忍。
author: quackquackattack
source: They digest shells and litter to grow and reside near poorly maintained tourist beaches. They have a pungent smell that resembles toothpaste and are tolerated as they clean beaches.

entry: POKENAME能处理海滩上的一切，但只吃有机物。无机物则熔化、收集成白牙膏般的糊。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can process anything found on a beach, though it only eats organic matter. Inorganic matter is melted and gathered into a paste that resembles white toothpaste.

entry: POKENAME埋进厚泥，从水面几乎看不见。壳与河床融为一体，直到换个更好的藏处，才会暴露。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Burying themselves in thick mud, POKENAME are nearly invisible from the water's surface. Their shells blend in with the riverbed, granting camouflage that only breaks when they decide to move to a better hiding spot.

entry: POKENAME半浸在岸边泥地，等潮水送来食物。猎物太近，就用钳子抓住，施以痛苦电击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME half-submerges itself in muddy areas among the coastline, waiting for the tide to bring in potential food. If prey steps too close, it snatches it in its pincers and delivers a painful electric shock.

entry: POKENAME生来背上便有水晶，毒咬很有名。水晶随年龄增长，快要进化时，会泛起微光。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME is born with the crystal on its back and is known for its venomous bite. Its crystal grows as it ages and glows faintly when it's ready to evolve.

entry: 贪食的胃口，催它吃掉能找到的所有宝石。若附近宝石很多，POKENAME便气味强烈，训练家据此就能分辨。
author: thehobomice
source: Its voracious appetite compels it to devour as many gems as it can find. Trainers can tell if there are a lot of gems nearby due to POKENAME having a strong odor.

entry: 它翻滚着移动，也借此磨平粗糙的结晶半身。常在带电晶体旁吸电维生，发怒时，会“爆发”出炫目强光。
author: infinex21
source: It rolls to move but also to smooth out its rough, crystalline half. It lingers near galvanic crystals to leech electricity from them, which is what it sustains itself with. When angered, it "explodes" with blinding light.

entry: 野生POKENAME在矿工与采石工间恶名昭彰。它啃穿岩石找宝石吃，常睡在自己挖的隧道里，矿工一镐敲中，便遭猛烈电击。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME are infamous among miners and quarry workers. These Pokémon eat their way through rock to find and eat precious stones, often falling asleep within their tunnels. Many times miners have struck them and been met with a devastating shock.

entry: POKENAME是拳击高手，用水晶眼分析对手动作。人们认为，它感到时间流逝得比其他宝可梦慢，因此能更快反应与移动。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME is a master boxer, analyzing the moves of its rivals with its crystalline eyes. It's thought that it perceives the passage of time more slowly than other Pokémon, allowing it to react and move more quickly than its foes.

entry: POKENAME是拳击高手，用水晶眼分析对手动作。人们认为，它感到时间流逝得比其他宝可梦慢，因此能更快反应与移动。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME is a master boxer, analyzing the moves of its rivals with its crystalline eyes. It's thought that it perceives the passage of time more slowly than other Pokémon, allowing it to react and move more quickly than its foes.

entry: 壳与吃过的宝石一样硬。POKENAME常埋在洞里，在壳内让柔软的内脏为进化做准备。
author: thehobomice
source: Its shell is as hard as the gems it had consumed. POKENAME are often found buried inside caves, preparing their soft innards for evolution inside the shell.

entry: POKENAME常吃蓝宝石及类似颜色的宝石，造出的雾也因此染色。受威胁时，首先就会喷毒雾防身。
author: mepp.
source: The mist POKENAME creates gets its hue from its steady diet of sapphires and similar colored gemstones. When threatened, it expels this toxic mist as its first defense.

entry: POKENAME喜欢宝石，会试着砸开洞壁，希望能找到一些。双眼对光极其敏感，因此它们很少离开黑暗的洞穴。
author: mistymagius
