source: POKENAME love gemstones, as they will try to smash through the cave walls in the hopes of finding some. Their eyes are incredibly sensitive to light, so they very rarely leave the darkness of their cave.

entry: 角是POKENAME全身最坚硬的部位。它的身体，由吃下的宝石构成。
author: petratheangel
source: POKENAME's horn is by far the hardest part of its body. POKENAME is made up of the gemstones that it eats.

entry: POKENAME从海底收集闪亮宝石，装饰身体。水下舞蹈特意衬出宝石，吸引潜在伴侣。
author: petratheangel
source: POKENAME collects shining gemstones from the seafloor and decorates its body with them. POKENAME performs underwater dances that accentuate its gems to impress potential partners.

entry: POKENAME战斗中失去肢体，便吃宝石加快再生。平时要几天或几周的过程，能缩到几小时。
author: quackquackattack
source: Whenever POKENAME loses one of its appendages during a battle, it eats gems to accelerate the regrowth process. What typically takes days or weeks is shortened to a matter of hours.

entry: POKENAME把宝石与珍贵石块抛向空中，表演杂耍，让受害者放松戒备，再突然使出凶狠的暗影爪，几乎不给逃脱机会。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME performs juggling acts, tossing gems and precious stones into the air to lull its victims into a false sense of security. It launches surprise attacks with its ferocious Shadow Claw, leaving its opponents with little chance of escape.

entry: POKENAME有节奏地扭身，仿佛起舞，借此分散训练家注意，顺手偷走珠宝。
author: thehobomice
source: A POKENAME sashays rhythmically as if it were dancing, its does this to distract Trainers while it swipes their jewelry.

entry: POKENAME常吃宝石，将矿物代谢成角与尾巴外的保护晶层。若崩缺或开裂，就自己剥掉，重新长一层。
author: metcassette
source: Due to their gem-rich diet, POKENAME metabolize minerals in order to form a protective crystal coating around their horns and tails. If one gets chipped or cracked, the POKENAME will remove it manually and begin growing a replacement.

entry: POKENAME爱吃宝石，身体却无法好好消化，只得改吃沙与海水里的盐。
author: petratheangel
source: POKENAME loves to eat precious gems. However its body cannot properly digest them so instead it eats sand and salt from sea water.

entry: 它用利角在洞里挖出分岔地道，寻找赖以为食的宝石。POKENAME用大红鼻子嗅闻，分辨喜欢与讨厌的种类。
author: thehobomice
source: It digs branching holes in caves using its sharp horn in search of the gems they feed on. POKENAME distinguishes its favorite kinds of gems from those it dislikes by sniffing with its big red nose.

entry: POKENAME爱用变身能力，在身上变出漂亮宝石。若给一面镜子，能花好几个小时变换、重排，直到图案分毫不差。
author: petratheangel
source: POKENAME loves to use its transformation abilities to create beautiful gemstones on its body. If given a mirror, it will spend hours changing and rearranging its gemstones into the exact right pattern.

entry: POKENAME只见于深水洞穴，常吃矿工永远够不到的宝石。这样的饮食让它一照光就闪亮，与水中完全隐形的模样截然相反。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: POKENAME are only found in deep underwater caverns often feasting on the gems that miners are never able to reach. Their diet tends to lead to them sparkling when exposed to light, a direct contrast to how they completely vanish under the water.

entry: POKENAME待在宝石洞穴，常与勾魂眼起冲突。身体两侧的宝石放出强光束，抵御这些饥饿、以宝石为食的宝可梦。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME hangs out in gem-filled caverns, often running into trouble with Sableye. The gems on its sides radiate powerful beams of light to defend itself from the hungry jewel-eating Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME在网站搜寻宝石图片，见到就把文件吃掉。若被发现，便迅速消失，逃回网络空间。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: POKENAME looks through websites for images of gemstones, eating the files of any it finds. If spotted, it quickly vanishes back into cyberspace.

entry: POKENAME的壳常由斑彩石构成，这种宝石可在化石形成过程中产生。壳虽是宝石，勾魂眼却似乎没兴趣吃。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME shells are often made out of ammolite, a gem that can be found during the process of fossilization. Despite having a shell made out of precious gems, Sableye do not seem interested in eating them.

entry: POKENAME的壳由闪亮宝石构成。科学家发现，它会发出小闪光，借明亮甲壳反射大量光，彼此寻觅。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME shells are made of shiny gems. Scientists have observed that they produce small flashes of light to find each other, as the bright, shiny shells reflect lots of light.

entry: 常年吃宝石，让POKENAME周身长满水晶，甲壳都快装不下。化石里的稀有斑彩石，让珠宝商常来收集。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME's steady diet of gemstones has caused crystals to form along their bodies to the point where their shells struggle to contain them all. POKENAME fossils are often collected by jewelers for their rare deposits of ammolite.

entry: POKENAME热切吞食矿物与宝石，填满巨大胃口。最爱吃磷灰石，英文名恰与“胃口”谐音，倒很应景。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME devours minerals and gemstones with fervor to sate its enormous appetite. Its favorite gemstone to eat is apatite, which also makes for a pleasant pun.

entry: POKENAME用找到的闪亮宝石，装饰冰雪家园。若太久没找到新珠宝，可能冻住遇上的倒霉生物，拿来作新装饰。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME decorates its glacial home with shiny gems it comes across. If it goes too long without finding new jewels, it may freeze other unfortunate creatures it finds and use them as new decorations.

entry: POKENAME在山中巢穴深处，囤积各色珠宝，为防被偷几乎不出门。尤其爱吃各种小碎钻融合体。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME hoards a rainbow of jewels deep in its mountainous lair, hardly ever leaving to ensure no one tries to steal from it. It's known to have a particular taste for various Carbink fusions.

entry: 这种宝可梦在满是宝石的洞里筑巢，领地意识极强，用臂上的钻石钻头不停攻击。POKENAME的钻头以锋利、晶体结构完美而备受推崇。
author: banjosaurus.
source: This species is extremely territorial over the gem-filled caves it builds its hives in, attacking relentlessly with the diamond drills it has on its arms. POKENAME drills are highly regarded for their sharpness and immaculate crystal structure.

entry: 人类只有带着石头或宝石，它才肯现身。若信任某人，还可能献出随身不离的那颗宝石。
author: bostroms
source: It will only show itself in front of humans if they are carrying rocks or gemstones with them.  If it trusts someone, it may offer up the jewel it carries around with it everywhere.

entry: POKENAME的叶子已退化。每只个体一生中，总有一天，那片干枯、嵌满宝石的叶子会终于脱落。
author: dylonk25
source: POKENAME's leaf is vestigial; at some point in every POKENAME's life, the withered, gem encrusted thing will finally fall off.

entry: POKENAME冠上与尾上的宝石，都是从地上捡的，颈间宝石却由沉淀过程长成。
author: dylonk25
source: While the gems on POKENAME's crown and tail are collected from the ground, the ones on its neck are grown through a precipitation process.

entry: 考古证据表明，许多史前穴居人视POKENAME为圣物。如今它已高度濒危，受到大力保护。
author: dylonk25
source: Archaeological evidence indicates that POKENAME was sacred to many prehistoric cave-dwelling humans. Today, it is highly endangered and fervently protected.

entry: POKENAME在洞里寻找亮宝石吃，吃下的宝石，会慢慢从背上长出。受威胁时，就射出背部宝石分散敌人注意，再逃向安全处。
author: pokejirkaok
source: POKENAME searches caves for shiny gems to eat. The gems it consumes slowly grow from its back. When threatened, it launches the gems from its back to distract attackers before fleeing to safety.

entry: POKENAME头与尾的水晶形似火焰，有时还闪烁发光，看起来更像真火。
author: hophoppip
source: The crystals on POKENAME's head and tail bear a resemblance to flames. They sometimes glow with a flickering light, furthering the illusion.

entry: POKENAME迷恋宝石的闪亮，大量挖掘囤积。它用利牙咬出独特齿痕，标记这些都是自己的。
author: sk372
source: Obsessed with the shininess of gems, POKENAME digs up and hoards them in great amounts. It uses its sharp teeth to bite the jewels and create indentations unique to its jawline, marking them as its own.

entry: POKENAME在河岸崖壁挖的巢穴，总塞满一生收集的宝石。谁敢碰哪怕一颗，它便张合强颚，发起攻击。
author: fiordaliso
source: The dens POKENAME digs into riverbank cliffs are always filled with precious gems it has gathered throughout its life. If anyone dares to touch even a single jewel, POKENAME launches an attack, snapping its powerful jaws.

entry: POKENAME一见珠宝，就忍不住用小喙叼走。兴奋时有时会误吞，稍后又吐出来，用珍宝装点巢穴。
author: fiordaliso
source: When POKENAME spots a jewel, it can't resist snatching it with its tiny beak. In its excitement, it sometimes swallows precious gems, later spitting them out to decorate its nest with treasures.

entry: POKENAME将大量大宝石囤进洞穴。离开收藏超过一天，便会变得十分烦躁。
author: petratheangel
source: POKENAME collects enormous hoards of large gemstones that it keeps in underwear caves. Being away from its collection for more than a day will make POKENAME very irritable.

entry: POKENAME好奇，可能跟在旅行中的训练家身后。一被逮个正着，就强光一闪，晃花附近所有人的眼，转身逃走。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are curious Pokémon that may trail behind Trainers as they travel. When they are caught, they obscure the vision of everyone nearby with a bright flash before running away.

entry: 它藏在阴影，双眼微闪。哪怕只是好奇，凝视双眼也会入睡。等POKENAME偷完身上的亮东西，就消失无踪。
author: bobosmith01
source: It hides in shadows, its eyes glimmering. Those who stare into them out of even simple curiosity fall asleep. Once POKENAME steals anything shiny on their person, they disappear without a trace.

entry: 夜里，POKENAME悄悄闯进博物馆与珠宝店，偷最爱的食物——切磨过的宝石，留下黏液作记号。
author: .jerden
source: At night, POKENAME stealthily break into museums and jewelers to steal their favorite food - cut gemstones. They leave behind a sticky fluid as their calling card.

entry: POKENAME的丝被织成衣服，卖给富人，还在世界各地拍卖。多个邪恶组织曾偷偷试做捕捉宝可梦的网，却无一成功。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME silk is spun into clothing for rich patrons and sold at auctions around the world. Various villainous organizations have made surreptitious attempts at making a net that ensnare Pokémon, but none of the attempts have worked.

entry: POKENAME制成的衣服价格高昂，优质丝既方便活动，又耐撕扯。野外会先用丝包住虫宝可梦，装进小丝袋，再吃猎物。
author: quackquackattack
source: Large sums of money are spent on clothing produced by POKENAME because the high-quality silk allows for both freedom of movement and resistance to tearing. In the wild, they wrap bug Pokémon in small pockets of silk before consuming their prey.

entry: POKENAME爱找贵重亮物，送给亲近的对象。双翼除宝石翼膜外，大多半透明；它借宝石翼膜折射光，扰乱对手。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME enjoys finding valuable, shiny objects to give to those with whom it feels a close bond. Its wings are mostly translucent except for the gemstone webbing, through which it refracts light to disorient opponents.

entry: 这种宝可梦潜伏在洞口，用利爪抢走训练家的宝石。
author: thehobomice
source: This Pokémon is seen lurking around cave entrances, snatching gems from trainers using its sharp claws.

entry: POKENAME啃水晶时，体内电力活跃，尾巴与耳尖闪烁发光。这时碰它，就会遭强烈电击。
author: sk372
source: When POKENAME gnaws on crystals, its tail and the tips of its ears flicker and light up with active internal electricity. Anything that touches them while it's chewing will receive a nasty shock.

entry: POKENAME还没长牙，只能从石头表面吸取养分。月之石尤其滋补，见到就会开心地叫起来。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME has not developed teeth yet and so must suck nutrients from the exterior of stones it finds. Moonstones are especially nutritious for POKENAME, so they cry happily when they spot one.

entry: 幼年POKENAME身体坚硬如宝石，行动缓慢。用尽力气不停唱歌，身体便渐渐变成深紫色。
author: thehobomice
source: Young POKENAME have hard, gemlike bodies that make them move slowly. When they sing continuously with all their might, their bodies steadily turn into a deep purple color.

entry: 偷走附近训练家的首饰后，野生POKENAME会跑上矮树，用珠宝筑巢。
author: thehobomice
source: After stealing jewelry from nearby trainers wild POKENAME will run up short trees, and use the jewelry to form their nest.

entry: 取得几颗宝石原石后，POKENAME就能借它们占卜未来，常用这能力找到更多原石。
author: thehobomice
source: After procuring several raw gems POKENAME can use them to scry future events. They often use this power to secure more raw gems.

entry: 休息中的POKENAME，活像一堆宝藏。谁想靠近拿走，就会遭它头锤攻击。
author: hophoppip
source: A resting POKENAME looks just like a pile of treasure. Those who approach it in hopes to acquire the loot will be targeted by its headbutts.

entry: POKENAME贪恋宝石出了名，在崖边巢穴里，连同蛋一起囤着。锐利视力，能看见近三英里外的宝石！
author: rakunk
source: POKENAME is known for its intense greed of gems, hoarding them alongside their eggs in cliffside nests. Their sharp eyesight allows for POKENAME to spot gemstones from nearly three miles away!

entry: POKENAME吃宝石原石，让身上长出的宝石保持闪耀。光泽也代表力量，宝石暗淡的个体，发电就较少。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME consumes raw gems to keep the ones growing on its body sparkling. The shine of its jewels is also a mark of its strength; a POKENAME with faded, dull gems generates less electricity.

entry: POKENAME常在古城堡遗迹或墓穴筑巢，吃被遗忘的宝藏，让考古学家十分头疼。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME are often found nesting in the ruins of ancient castles or tombs, feeding on forgotten treasure. This behaviour has made them considerable pests for archeologists.

entry: 它们住在古神殿附近的森林与丛林，是寻宝者的噩梦。POKENAME最爱跟踪探险者，偷吃他们珍贵的发现。
author: milchik
source: They populate the forests and jungles near ancient temples. These mischievous Pokémon are a living nightmare for treasure hunters; one of POKENAME's favorite activities is to stalk the explorers in order to steal and eat their precious finds.

entry: 矿工被告诫远离POKENAME。它挖掘时，用湿尾有节奏地拍击，测试岩石是否脆弱，声音回荡隧道；常引发塌方，自己却总能毫发无伤溜走，只留下诡异声响。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Miners are warned to avoid POKENAME, whose rhythmic wet tail slaps echo through tunnels as it digs to test for weak rock. Its actions often trigger cave-ins, though it always manages to slip away unharmed, leaving only its eerie sound behind.

entry: POKENAME的眼习惯了黑暗洞穴，十分讨厌阳光。只有夜里才出来，用月光为身体宝石充能，使它们在黑暗里泛起柔光。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME hate sunlight as their eyes have grown accustomed to dark caves. They only emerge at night to recharge their body gems in the moonlight, causing them to glow softly in the dark.

entry: POKENAME能带的宝石有限，常不慎掉下从人家里偷来的珠宝。因此，野外见到它，既被当成福气，也被视作祸事。
author: petratheangel
source: POKENAME can only carry so many gemstones and will accidentally drop ones that it stole from people's homes. Because of this, seeing a POKENAME in the wild is considered both a blessing and a curse.

entry: POKENAME的闪耀，是地位象征。再激烈的战斗也小心移动，免得擦伤或碰缺璀璨的水晶大舌贝。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's sparkliness is a status symbol. Even in a rough battle, it moves carefully to avoid scratching or chipping its dazzling crystal Shellder.

entry: POKENAME背上水晶的颜色，全看各自吃什么。它的咬击带毒。
author: mepp.
source: The color of the crystal that grows on POKENAME's back is entirely dependent on an individual's diet. It has a venomous bite.

entry: 为撑起越长越大的宝石，它在洞里挖洞，将自己栽进去。背部宝石反光太强，因此大部分时间都避开直射阳光。
author: thehobomice
source: To support its growing gems, it digs holes in caves to plant themselves into. They will spend most of their time avoiding direct sunlight due to the highly reflective gem on their back.

entry: 为磨短利牙，它啃咬宝石与贵金属。矿工会用POKENAME协助开凿隧道。
author: thehobomice
source: To keep its sharp fangs ground down, it gnaws on gems and precious metals. Miners use POKENAME to help excavate their tunnels.

entry: POKENAME带着的宝石里，住着某种灵体。它不太留心周围，宝石便常提醒它危险将至。
author: mistymagius
source: The jewel that POKENAME carries around has some sort of spirit living inside of it. Since POKENAME isn't that aware of its surroundings, the jewel will often alert POKENAME of incoming threats.

entry: POKENAME固定在黑暗洞穴，将闪亮宝石嵌进钢壳，诱引探险者。目标一近，便猛合甲壳，闪动宝石眼，让敌人在黑暗中眩晕。
author: msdawgs
source: POKENAME anchors itself inside dark caves, embedding glittering gems into its steel shell to lure explorers. When a target steps near, it snaps its armor shut while flashing its jewel-like eyes to daze enemies in the darkness.

entry: POKENAME用尾巴挖掘，寻找最爱的宝石。找到大片矿藏，就在旁筑巢，慢慢享用。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME uses its tail to dig in search of its favorite food of gemstones. When it finds a large deposit of them, POKENAME makes a nest so it can slowly feast on the stones.

entry: POKENAME从宝石洞穴敲下碎块，装进甲胄。可惜又爱把甲上的水晶当零嘴，常得另找新材料。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME break off chunks of jeweled caverns to build into their armor, Unfortunately, their tendency to eat crystals from their armor as a snack results in them frequently needing to find new material.

entry: POKENAME住在洞边崖壁，方便滑进矿井吃宝石。翼膜里的石英，能晃花天敌的眼。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME live on cliffs by caves, allowing it to glide into mines to eat gems. They use the quartz in their membrane to blind potential predators.

entry: 铠甲比已知的任何金属都坚韧，让人怀疑，它根本来自另一个世界。挖掘宝石时，动作又几乎如机械一般。
author: pepperthepirate
source: Its armor is tougher than any known metal, making some believe it came from another world entirely. It digs for gems in an almost mechanical fashion.

entry: 若洞穴四壁都回荡着高亢哀鸣，就是POKENAME正在捕猎的征兆。
author: thehobomice
source: If its high, keening cry can be heard echoing all around a cavern's walls, it is a sign that POKENAME is on the hunt.

entry: POKENAME积蓄水之力量，身上宝石便变成深蔚蓝色。喷出的水，强得足以打翻卡车。
author: .izik
source: The gems on POKENAME's body turn a deep cerulean when it charges its water-based abilities. Its spurts are powerful enough to knock over a truck.

entry: POKENAME藏在洞里，在镶满宝石的壳中将树果发酵成果汁。果汁帮助消化宝石，其中一小部分，也是很好的抛光液。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME hides in caves while fermenting berries into juice inside its bedazzled shell. While it uses the juice to aid in digesting gemstones, a small portion of the juice is actually an excellent polishing solution.

entry: POKENAME自视为栖身洞穴的守护者，主要靠臂上的水晶进攻，既能直接使出强力身体招式，也能发射能量束。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME considers itself the guardian of the caverns it inhabits. The crystals upon its arms are its primary form of offense, either by brute-force physical moves or by shooting energy beams from them.

entry: POKENAME将闪亮的爪浸进溪水，引鱼浮到水面。猎物一近，便迅速从水里捞出。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME dips its shiny claws into streams to lure fish to the surface. Once its prey is near, it swiftly plucks them right out of the water.

entry: POKENAME利用可爱外表，偷训练家的宝石与首饰。人们最好收好随身物、避开它，免得丢失重要东西。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME exploits its adorable appearance to steal gems and jewelry from Trainers. People are advised to secure their belongings and avoid POKENAME to ensure nothing important gets stolen.

entry: POKENAME从地下深处采宝石，装饰躯干上的环。两只相遇，便立刻比较收藏，看谁的珍宝更多。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME collects gems from deep underground to adorn the ring in its torso. If two POKENAME meet, they immediately compare gem collections to see who has the greater amount of precious jewels.

entry: POKENAME住在地下深处，火山活动旺盛的含水层附近。滤出饮水里的矿物，渐渐长成嵌满贵重水晶的大石壳。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are found deep underground, making their home around volcanically active aquifers. They filter out the minerals from the water they drink, gradually growing a large rocky shell that's studded with valuable crystals.

entry: POKENAME放出的超高热蒸汽，富含矿物，冷却处便长出水晶。它能控制蒸汽释放，在背上稳稳培育巨大的红宝石。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The superheated steam POKENAME release is rich in minerals, causing crystals to form wherever it cools. They are able to control the release of their steam, allowing them to steadily grow gigantic rubies upon their back.

entry: POKENAME住在地下深处，火山活动旺盛的含水层附近，寻找最热的地方，吸收富矿物的水，让壳上长出新水晶。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are found deep underground, making their home around volcanically active aquifers. They seek out the hottest part of the aquifer, absorbing the mineral-rich water so they can stud their shells with new crystal growth.

entry: POKENAME放出的超高热蒸汽，富含矿物，冷却处便长出水晶。超级富豪视它为地位象征，能按主人需要，制造珍贵宝石。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The superheated steam POKENAME release is rich in minerals, causing crystals to form wherever it cools. They are considered to be a status symbol amongst the super-rich, creating precious gems on demand for their owners.

entry: POKENAME由地下深处吃来的金属与水晶构成，偏爱较软的金属。吃过黄金的个体，最受人追捧。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME's bodies are composed of the metals and crystals they feed on deep underground. They have a preference for softer metals, with the most sought after POKENAME being ones that have fed on gold.

entry: 野生POKENAME用假头引诱猎物。对方一近，便用利爪迅速出击。
author: thehobomice
source: Wild POKENAME lure in prey with their false head, then quickly strike with their sharp claws when the prey gets close.

entry: POKENAME视力差，靠极灵敏的鼻子，在黑暗洞穴里辨路。食谱包含植物与矿物。
author: mepp.
source: It has poor eyesight, so POKENAME relies on its highly developed nose to navigate the darkness of caves. Its diet consists of both plant matter and minerals.

entry: POKENAME在高山洞穴筑巢，深挖宝石为食，宝石的颜色也影响羽色。羽毛比赋予其颜色的宝石更耐久，很适合制作艺术品与首饰。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME nests in high mountain caves, digging deep to find gemstones to eat, the color of which impact the shades of its feathers. Its feathers are more durable than the gems they take their color from, making them valuable in artwork and jewelry.

entry: POKENAME夜里啃咬探洞时收集的宝石，保持牙齿锋利。谁靠得太近，就会将身上宝石烧得通红，烫伤倒霉的对方。
author: fiordaliso
source: To keep its teeth sharp, POKENAME spends its nights gnawing on precious stones that it collects during its expeditions into caves. If anyone gets too close, it makes the gems on its body glow red-hot to burn the unfortunate victims.

entry: 吃下几颗宝石，POKENAME便盘成螺旋休息。它能吃下体重两倍的宝石。
author: thehobomice
source: After eating several gems, POKENAME will curl itself up in a spiral so it can rest. POKENAME can consume twice its weight in gems.

entry: POKENAME精准的水流喷射，能切开任何天然材料。用它切磨的宝石做首饰，价值不菲，有些收藏者却囤了数十件。
author: _pixelar_
source: POKENAME's high precision Aqua Jets are powerful enough to cut through any natural material. Jewelry adorned with POKENAME-cut gemstones is worth a small fortune, though some collectors hoard dozens of pieces.

entry: POKENAME爱收集珠宝，将栖身电脑里外都装饰一遍。时间一久，堆积的宝石开始扰乱设备内部结构，反倒有害。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME likes to collect jewels and decorate computers it inhabits with them, both inside and out. This becomes detrimental after a time as the accumulated gems begin messing with the device's infrastructure.

entry: POKENAME双角间的大红宝石，被普遍认为可作治疗睡眠呼吸暂停的药材，因此常遭盗猎。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: The large ruby POKENAME have between their antlers are commonly believed to be an ingredient used to cure sleep apnea. As such, POKENAME are often victims of poaching.

entry: POKENAME用尾部产生的闪亮液体，装饰领地。人们以为循着记号就快到安全处，结果反而迷得更深。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME decorates its territory with a shimmering fluid produced from its tail. People follow these markings believing safety is close by, only to get more lost.

entry: 野生POKENAME爱跑来跑去，可洞里黑，常会跌倒。它也爱凝视抛光宝石中自己的倒影。
author: thehobomice
source: Wild POKENAME love to actively run about, but due to living in dark caves, they often fall over. POKENAME love to stare at their reflection in polished gems.

entry: 野生POKENAME喜欢吓唬闯领地的生物，觉得十分好玩。缠紧的力道，足以压扁整辆矿车。
author: thehobomice
source: Wild POKENAME finds humor in terrifying anything that enters its territory. POKENAME can flatten an entire minecart with its constricting force.

entry: 看见人伤心，POKENAME会吸走负面情绪，化成钻石，日后再送给深深珍视的对象。
author: petratheangel
source: When POKENAME sees someone sad, it will siphon out the negative emotions and transform them into a diamond. POKENAME will later gift the diamond to someone it deeply cares about.

entry: POKENAME整天用小爪挖掘，寻找宝石或矿脉。谁离挖掘处太近，便毫不犹豫地凶狠撕咬。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME spends the whole day digging with its tiny claws in search of gems or mineral veins. If anyone approaches too close to its dig site, it will bite fiercely without a second thought.

entry: 这浑身珠宝的宝可梦，会攻击一切靠近洞穴的生物。POKENAME毁灭性的怒火，足以让整座洞穴坍塌。
author: yuma5054
source: This jewel-covered Pokémon attacks anyone who approaches its cave. A POKENAME's destructive rage can collapse entire caverns.

entry: 双翼掀起的阵风，几乎瞬间就能侵蚀岩石。它借此揭出宝石，拿来吃。
author: calelian
source: The gusts from its wings are powerful enough to erode rock nearly instantly. It uses this ability to uncover gems to eat.

entry: 吃宝石能让POKENAME尾上的水晶产生更多电。若主要吃某色宝石，放出的闪电也会染上那种颜色。
author: sk372
source: Feasting on gems helps the crystals on POKENAME's tail generate more electricity. If its diet consists strongly of a specific color jewel, the lightning it generates will take on that coloration.

entry: POKENAME招来成群小鸟宝可梦，指挥它们向没防备的人偷珠宝饰物。每天都在亮物堆里打滚，陶醉于不义之财。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME enlists flocks of smaller avian Pokémon, commanding them to steal jeweled trinkets from unsuspecting humans. Every day, it rolls around in a pile of the shiny baubles, basking in its ill-gotten gains.

entry: POKENAME一见宝石等亮物就兴奋，忍不住收进腹袋。陪着信任的训练家时，偶尔会送些较贵重的藏品。
author: mepp.
source: Shiny objects like gems excite POKENAME and it cannot help collecting them in its pouch. When with a trusted Trainer, POKENAME will occasionally gift them some of the more valuable items.

entry: 若储电太多，它能生成天然的雷之石。这本领让POKENAME备受追捧。
author: thehobomice
source: If it stores too much electricity, it can produce a naturally occurring Thunder Stone. Because of this ability, POKENAME is highly sought after.

entry: 爱吃珠宝的淘气宝可梦。准备恶作剧时，总忍不住露出尖牙咧嘴笑，提前暴露企图。
author: bobosmith01
source: A mischievous Pokémon with a taste for jewels. When it is about to play a prank, it uncontrollably grins with sharp teeth, prematurely revealing its intent.

entry: POKENAME的利爪，部分由宝石构成，价值很高，让它成了盗猎者的重要目标。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME's sharp claws are partially made of gems. These gems are high in value, causing POKENAME to be a main target of poachers.

entry: POKENAME有种特殊磁力，能把宝石从地下深处拉出。摘掉触角上的珠宝，就会失去这本领。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME possesses a special type of magnetism that allows it to pull out gems from deep within the ground. Removing the jewel on its antenna robs it of this ability.

entry: POKENAME吃下的宝石，装点着长舌。对手们彼此展示舌头，镶宝石最多的，赢得领地与伴侣。
author: hophoppip
source: The gems in POKENAME's diet adorn its lengthy tongue. Rival POKENAME will show off their tongues to one another, with the most bejeweled tongue earning territory and mates.

entry: POKENAME寻找宝石，带回洞穴深处的宝藏堆。它极力保护财物，谁敢伸手，就挥动长藤般的手臂攻击。
author: actliux
source: POKENAME search for gems to take back to their hoard deep inside caves. They are extremely defensive of their possessions and will swing their long, vine-like arms to attack anyone who dares to try to take from them.

entry: 饮食让它皮肤坚韧、颜色暗沉，更容易融入洞穴环境。
author: thehobomice
source: Its hide is tough and dark as a result of its diet, making it better suited to blend into its cavern environment.

entry: POKENAME翱翔夜空，掠过旁人身边便偷走财物，快得对方来不及反应。它在暗洞筑巢，用偷来的珠宝装点自己。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME soars through the night sky, stealing the valuables of those it passes by before they have time to react. It nests in dark caves, bejeweling itself with the jewelry it has stolen.

entry: 它一边钻穿洞壁，一边吃宝石，让POKENAME身上长出水晶叶，净化洞里不流通的空气。
author: jinjetica
source: It eats gemstones while burrowing through cavern walls. This allows POKENAME to grow crystal leaves on its body and purify stagnant cavern air.

entry: POKENAME夜里现身，找到什么黄金宝石都偷，囤在通常长满大水晶的暗洞里。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME appears during the night to steal any gold and gemstones it can find. It hoards its wealth in dark caves, usually lined with large crystals.

entry: POKENAME眼上覆盖的水晶，让它在最强暴风雪中也看得清。训练家被告诫别吓到它，红宝石獠牙轻易就能劈开巨石。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: The crystal covering the POKENAME's eyes allows it to see clearly through even the harshest blizzards. Trainers are warned to be careful not to startle POKENAME, as their ruby tusks can cut through boulders with ease.

entry: POKENAME身上宝石越亮，表示吞过的数据越多。它靠这些数据维生，如同哺乳动物消耗储存的脂肪。
author: .izik
source: The brighter the gems on POKENAME's body glow, the more data it has consumed. It feeds off this data much like a mammal subsists on stored fat.

entry: POKENAME从出生起，就一直寻找水晶。找到最大的一块，便在那里筑巢，再也不动。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: From the moment they're born, POKENAME spend their time finding a crystal. Once it has found the largest one, it will nest there and never move.

entry: POKENAME的体形已超过随身带着的水晶。爪子本可轻易挖地道，可抱着最爱的水晶，就挖得吃力。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: POKENAME carries around a crystal that it has now outgrown. Its claws allow it to dig tunnels with ease, but struggles to do this while holding its favourite crystal.

entry: POKENAME像植物般吸取水晶能量，凭心念挪动水晶。背上也长出水晶，完美防范从背后偷袭的敌人。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: POKENAME can manipulate crystals, absorbing their energy like a plant to move them with just its mind. It even grows crystals out of its back, acting as a perfect line of defence for anything that may try to sneak up on it.

entry: 它吐出压缩火球，用爪挖宝石原石为食。激动时，红水晶亮起火光。
author: infinex21
source: It spits out compressed fireballs and uses its claws to dig for raw gems, which is what it eats. Its red crystal glows with fire when it is riled up.

entry: 适应了火山洞穴，POKENAME的双眼亮如余烬。当地人常警告探洞者，别跟随闪烁的光，它常会将旅人引入歧途。
author: mepp.
source: Having adapted to volcanic caverns, POKENAME's eyes glow like embers. In these regions, many have warned spelunkers not to follow any flickering lights due to POKENAME often leading travelers astray.

entry: POKENAME的爪由致密紫水晶构成，精准切开含宝石的岩壁，趁旁人还没察觉，就吞下碎块。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's claws are made of dense amethyst. It slices gem-laden walls with precision, devouring the fragments before others can notice.

entry: POKENAME一感到洞穴深处埋着宝石，就不停踢墙，直到岩壁崩落，露出珍宝。大吃一顿，总还会留一颗作挖掘纪念。
author: sk372
source: Once POKENAME senses gems buried deep within a cavern, it sets about kicking the walls until they crumble and reveal their prizes. It feasts copiously on the jewels, but always saves one as a souvenir of the excavation.

entry: 水晶化的拳脚，让POKENAME一击就能碎石。它住在满是水晶的洞穴深处，击打周围巨大坚固的宝石，磨炼招式。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's crystallized feet and fists give it incredibly strong strikes in battle, enough to shatter stone with a single blow. It lives deep within crystal-filled caverns, practicing its techniques by striking the huge and sturdy gems around it.

entry: POKENAME栖息在不见天日的深洞，双眼却极其敏锐。全身晶体发出微光，让它能在居住的地下水池里觅食。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Living in deep caves far from any sunlight, POKENAME has nevertheless developed extremely sensitive eyes. The crystal growths across its body produce a dim light that allows it to find food in the underground pools it lives in.

entry: POKENAME没有挖宝石所需的利爪，便潜伏在珠宝店与矿场附近，盼着捡到落下的宝石。等待时，也吃普通石头充饥。
author: imaginita
source: POKENAME lack the sharp claws needed to dig up gemstones for themselves, so they will lurk around jewelers' shops and gem mines, hoping to snatch up fallen gemstones. While waiting, they can snack on mundane rocks.

entry: 泥石流影响采矿，人们就带来POKENAME，寻找冲走的矿石。训练家得有把握管住它，否则该找回的矿石，可能反被它吃了。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: When mudslides affect mining operations, POKENAME are brought in to find ore swept away. Trainers must be confident when handling POKENAME, as they might just eat the ore they are meant to recover.

entry: POKENAME随身带着一颗巨大的宝石，当作盾牌，挡开攻击。若有攻击损伤了心爱的宝石，它便会勃然大怒，试图徒手将敌人捏碎。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME carries with it a giant gem that works as a shield to deflect blows. If an attack manages to blemish its precious jewel, it flies into a rage and attempts to crush its foe with its bare hands.

entry: POKENAME用超能力搬运大水晶，无意中也不停锻炼念力。它时不时啃一口，水晶便渐渐变小。
author: infinex21
source: It lugs around a massive crystal by wielding the crystal with its psychic power; this inadvertently hones its psychic powers ever further. The crystal grows smaller over time as POKENAME nibbles away at it.

entry: POKENAME的三颗水晶，用来集中超能力，扩展对周围的感知。它虽吃水晶与宝石，却绝不吃这三颗随身之物。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's three crystals serve as foci for its psychic powers, through which it can expand its perception of its surroundings. Though it feeds on crystals and gems, it will never eat the three crystals it is always seen with.

entry: 外表诡异、目光令人不安，这种宝可梦却始终端正凛然，绝不屑于耍小伎俩，只以力量保护亲近的对象。
author: jaminmcready
source: Despite its eerie appearance and unsettling gaze, this Pokémon holds itself with unwavering dignity. It will never stoop to petty tricks, instead using its power to protect those it bonds with.

entry: POKENAME的本体，其实是头顶宝石操纵的空壳。据说随身带的大宝石里，装着看过它背部空洞者的灵魂。
author: malamaru
source: The main body of POKENAME is actually a husk puppeteered by the gem above its head. It is said that the larger gem that it carries around contains the souls of those who have seen the orifice in its back.

entry: POKENAME的本体，其实是头顶一圈宝石操纵的空壳。据说它乘坐的大宝石里，装着看过它背部空洞者的灵魂。
author: malamaru
source: The main body of POKENAME is actually a husk puppeteered by a halo of gems above its head. It is said that the larger gem ridden by POKENAME contains the souls of those who have seen the orifice in its back.

entry: POKENAME挖出宝石矿藏，就滚来滚去，将水晶融进软肉。人和宝可梦都会猎它，因此大部分时间藏在地下道网里。
author: dylonk25
source: After POKENAME digs up a gem deposit, it rolls around, assimilating the crystal into its soft flesh. Hunted by Pokémon and humans alike, POKENAME spends most of its time hiding in tunnel networks.

entry: POKENAME挖洞时，舌头搜寻并卷走找到的珠宝。宝石吃得越多，天生肤色就越随饮食变化。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's tongue searches out and snatches up any jewels it finds while digging through cavern areas. The more gems it eats, the more its natural skin tone changes to match its diet.

entry: POKENAME用楔石上宝石般的外层，欺骗毫无防备的宝可梦。只要靠得太近，POKENAME就会从宝石里跳出来吓对方。
author: crazynaturekitty
source: POKENAME uses the gem-like coating over its keystone as a way to trick unsuspecting Pokémon. If a Pokémon gets too close, POKENAME will pop out of the gem to frighten it.

entry: POKENAME啃水晶时，牙会折断再生。遗落的宝石般的牙，深受收藏者追捧。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME have teeth that break off and regrow while gnawing on crystals. The discarded gem-like teeth are highly sought after by collectors.

entry: POKENAME培育从身体伸出的水晶，大部分时间都在打磨抛光。出门寻宝石时，又当作镐，凿开洞壁。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME cultivate crystals that jut out from their body and spend most of their time sharpening and polishing these crystals. When they go out to hunt for gems, these crystals function like picks to chip away at cave walls.

entry: 矿工常被要求，一见POKENAME就攻击。可它有毒刺又凶猛，任务很危险，工会往往反对这类规定。
author: dylonk25
source: Miners are often instructed to attack POKENAME on sight. With POKENAME's poison spines and vicious nature, the task is quite unsafe, and such policies tend to be resisted by unions.

entry: POKENAME在大嘴里装满宝藏，诱来没防备的猎物。吞下些宝藏也不在意，还能让宝石牙保持亮泽。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME fills its maw with treasure to lure in unsuspecting prey. It does not mind if it eats some of the treasure as that helps keep its gemstone teeth lustrous.

entry: 信赖的勾魂眼化作镰刀，伴POKENAME四处寻找腐化的灵魂。据说，击败幽灵属性宝可梦后，它们会更强，仿佛镰刀以死亡本身为动力。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: With their trusted Sableye having taken the form of their scythe, POKENAME wander in search of corrupted souls. It is said they grow stronger after defeating Ghost-Types, as if their scythe is powered by death itself.

entry: 贪婪的POKENAME藏在洞穴深处，埋身财宝堆。人类或宝可梦只要靠得太近，宝物便会被它夺走。
author: pizzarcato
source: The covetous POKENAME lurks in the depths of caves, buried in a pile of riches. It collects the treasures of people and Pokémon who come too close.

entry: POKENAME吃宝石与珍贵矿石，身体吸收后，让外骨骼更强壮华美。坚爪能挖出洞穴，藏身避开直射阳光。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME feeds on gems and precious stones, which its body then absorbs, strengthening and embellishing its exoskeleton. Its sturdy claws allow it to dig caves where it can take shelter to escape direct sunlight.

entry: POKENAME头顶宝石几乎无法破坏，轻易就能撞碎巨石。传说凝视其中，会看见自己的灵魂回望。
author: mistymagius
source: The gemstone on POKENAME's head is almost unbreakable, allowing it to smash through large boulders with ease. Legends say that if you stare into POKENAME's gem, you'll see your own soul staring back.

entry: POKENAME脸上的宝石状甲片，由特殊分泌物结晶而成。必须蜕下，POKENAME才能继续生长，掉落的甲片深受收藏家追捧。
author: alumed
source: The gem-like plate on the face of POKENAME is formed by the crystalization of specialized secretions and must be shed to allow POKENAME to grow. Shed plates are highly sought-after by collectors.

entry: POKENAME外表虽凶，内心却温柔无私。POKENAME会用坚硬无比的宝石甲片堵住隧道，保护小型宝可梦免遭捕食。
author: alumed
source: Despite their fearsome appearance, POKENAME are selfless, gentle creatures. POKENAME will block tunnel entrances using their incredibly hard gem-like plate to protect smaller Pokémon from predators.

entry: POKENAME游历世界，寻找最美味的宝石当零嘴。强劲肌肉，让它走到哪都带着大红宝石；想偷走，简直痴心妄想。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME travels the world, seeking the tastiest gems to snack on. Using powerful muscles, POKENAME carries a massive ruby wherever it goes. To try to steal this gemstone would be a fool's errand.

entry: 有人推测，POKENAME不会因衰老而死亡。未有人类踏足的洞里，曾发现全身被宝石覆盖的个体。
author: dylonk25
source: It has been hypothesized that POKENAME is biologically immortal. In caves untouched by humans, specimens have been found with gems covering the entire body.

entry: POKENAME夜里到来，将偷走的灵魂封进大宝石。宝石若损坏，被困灵魂便会缓缓漏出。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME arrives during the night, sealing the souls it steals in its large gemstone. If its gem is ever damaged, the captured souls will slowly leak out.

entry: POKENAME假扮贵重布料，吃无人看管的黄金与宝石。吃够了，便会变形，身上多出一颗新宝石。
author: northkira
source: POKENAME disguises itself as valuable fabric to eat unattended gold and gemstones. Once it has eaten enough, POKENAME transforms and gains a new gemstone on its body.

entry: 古文明受POKENAME诡异气场影响，以为它来自神明，献上宝石供奉，转眼就被它吃掉。
author: .izik
source: Ancient civilizations were manipulated by POKENAME's eerie aura into thinking it was divine in origin. They offered gemstones in worship, which it promptly consumed.

entry: POKENAME健康时，头上宝石鲜亮闪耀，生病则暗淡。强劲双颚，足以让大多数小型食岩宝可梦不敢攻击。
author: pjporwoll
source: The gem growing on POKENAME's head becomes vibrant and shiny when it is healthy, but grows dull when it is sick. Its strong jaws are enough to dissuade most smaller rock-eating Pokémon from attacking it.

entry: POKENAME壳上长着簇簇鲜亮水晶，饮食健康，品质就更好。它会站在瀑布下冲净宝石，盼着吸引伴侣。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME grows clusters of vibrant crystals along its shell, which improve in quality if it has a healthy diet. It will bask under waterfalls to clean the gems of dirt in hopes of attracting a mate.

entry: POKENAME有时会长出夜开植物和仿月光的水晶，为夜行的小宝可梦造出安身处。它寻求与大嘴娃等妖精属性宝可梦共生，保护水晶不被勾魂眼吃掉。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME sometimes grows night-blooming plants and crystals that mimic moonlight, creating a haven for small, nocturnal Pokémon. It seeks out symbiotic relationships with Fairy-type Pokémon like Mawile to protect its crystals from Sableye.

entry: POKENAME壳上长满宝石，常被成群勾魂眼捕食。它寻求与大嘴娃等妖精属性宝可梦共生，保护自己。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME grows vast amounts of gemstones on its shell, making it a frequent target for predation by packs of Sableye. It seeks out symbiotic relationships with Fairy-type Pokémon like Mawile to protect it from Sableye.

entry: POKENAME壳上长满宝石，常被成群勾魂眼捕食。它寻求与大嘴娃等妖精属性宝可梦共生，保护自己。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME grows vast amounts of gemstones on its shell, making it a frequent target for predation by packs of Sableye. It seeks out symbiotic relationships with Fairy-type Pokémon like Mawile to protect it from Sableye.

entry: POKENAME壳上长满宝石，常被成群勾魂眼捕食。它寻求与大嘴娃等妖精属性宝可梦共生，保护自己。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME grows vast amounts of gemstones on its shell, making it a frequent target for predation by packs of Sableye. It seeks out symbiotic relationships with Fairy-type Pokémon like Mawile to protect it from Sableye.

entry: POKENAME壳上长满宝石，常被成群勾魂眼捕食。它寻求与大嘴娃等妖精属性宝可梦共生，保护自己。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME grows vast amounts of gemstones on its shell, making it a frequent target for predation by packs of Sableye. It seeks out symbiotic relationships with Fairy-type Pokémon like Mawile to protect it from Sableye.

entry: POKENAME是烦人的珠宝贼，常偷走矿工辛苦挖出的宝石。矿工想追，一阵火光就让他们停下脚步。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are pesky jewel thieves that often steal from miners who have worked hard to unearth the gems. When miners attempt to pursue POKENAME, a flash of fire stops the miners in their tracks.

entry: POKENAME的肌肉，能让身上宝石朝任何方向自由移动。大耳朵连洞里最细微的声音都听得见。
author: thehobomice
source: The POKENAME has developed muscles that freely move its gems in any direction on its body. Their large ears enable them to hear even the slightest sound in their cavern.

entry: POKENAME尽可能挖掘、偷取亮宝石，全吃掉，只有红色除外。红宝石它宁愿点燃，看着烧，原因至今未知。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME digs up and pilfers as many shiny gems as it can. It eats all but the red-colored ones, which it prefers to set on fire and watch burn instead. The reason for this is as yet unknown.

entry: 民间传说，不安抚POKENAME，它便用钻石长杖烧村。脚下乘的硬币，据说就是过去村民为求平安献的贡品。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Folklore tells of POKENAME setting villages on fire with its diamond staff if not appeased. The story says coins it rides on consists of past tributes by villages to be spared.

entry: POKENAME将宝石囤成小堆，谁碰就跟谁打。最亮最光滑的一颗，会留给亲近的对象。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME hoards gems in a little pile and fights others who touch them. It keeps the shiniest and smoothest gem to give to someone close.

entry: POKENAME将宝石囤成小堆，谁碰就跟谁打。最亮最光滑的一颗，会留给亲近的对象。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME hoards gems in a little pile and fights others who touch them. It keeps the shiniest and smoothest gem to give to someone close.

entry: POKENAME用高压水流，将托帕石从洞壁打落，藏在洞中各处水洼，留着以后吃。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses high-pressure water to knock topaz loose from cave walls. It stores its findings in puddles around the cave to eat later.

entry: POKENAME用鳍端利刃，从洞壁切出珠宝。多数直接吃掉，最美的则带回巢，细细雕成各种形状，装点家园。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME carves jewels out of cavern walls using the sharp bladed ends of its fins. It eats most of them, but the most beautiful gems are taken to its den and meticulously carved into decorative shapes to adorn its home with.

entry: POKENAME曾因纯金鼻子，以及轻易找出贵重矿物的奇异本领遭猎捕。近年数量才恢复，仍被视为须保护的物种。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME were once hunted due to their noses of solid gold and their uncanny ability to easily locate precious minerals. Only in recent years have their numbers been restored, so they are still considered a species to be protected.

entry: POKENAME疯狂挖掘地下隧道，寻找可吸收的宝石，也会袭击矿工，抢走他们采得的宝物。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME feverishly mines underground tunnels in search for gemstones to absorb. It also assaults miners for the gems they've found.

entry: POKENAME袭击寻宝者，想吃掉他们的宝石。不过，它自身也足够坚硬，能钻地掘土，自己找食物。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME assaults treasure hunters in order to consume their gemstones. It is also hard enough to drill and dig for food itself.

entry: POKENAME袭击寻宝者，想吃掉他们的宝石。不过，它自身也足够坚硬，能钻地掘土，自己找食物。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME assaults treasure hunters in order to consume their gemstones. It is also hard enough to drill and dig for food itself.

entry: 角由最坚硬的钻石构成。察觉敌意，背上所有宝石便一齐竖起，像根根尖刺。
author: thehobomice
source: Its horn is made from the hardest of diamonds. If it senses a hostile presence, all the gems on its back bristle up at once, imitating quills.

entry: 传说，有头巨兽游荡在最幽暗的洞穴，遇见它的人从此不知所终。有人相信，它会将猎物的灵魂变成宝石，再吞下。
author: ravendragons
source: Legends speak of a beast who wanders the darkest caverns, and those who encounter it are never seen again. Some believe that it turns the souls of its prey into gemstones and eats them.

entry: POKENAME常守在古墓，喜爱囤积古代君王的陪葬财宝。它会以浓重的沙暴掩住墓穴，不让人发现所在。
author: mistymagius
source: Usually found guarding ancient tombs, POKENAME loves hoarding the buried loot once held by ancient kings. It will conceal the tomb in a thick sandstorm to hide its location.

entry: POKENAME常藏在深洞，囤积宝物，再用这堆财宝作诱饵，把猎物引回巢。
author: scapz
source: POKENAME is often found in deep caves, hoarding its treasure. It uses its hoard to lure prey into its lair.

entry: POKENAME的翼由锋利水晶构成，全速飞行能切开岩石与钻石。它在山中巢穴囤宝石，堆起来躺着休息。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's wings are made of a sharp crystal material, able to cut through stone and diamond when flying at full speed. It hoards gems it finds in its mountain den, creating a pile for it to rest upon.

entry: POKENAME将最大的宝石制成特殊的环，装在最先进的无人机上，用来搜寻大批宝藏。
author: phantom640
source: POKENAME fashions a special ring with its biggest gem and mounts it onto its most advanced drone, which it uses to locate massive amounts of treasure.

entry: POKENAME为满身宝石骄傲，格外细心地用缎带状肢体，擦亮宝石蝴蝶结。它会嬉闹分散人们注意，再伸缎带偷首饰吃。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is prideful of the gemstones decorating its skin, taking special care to polish its gemstone bows using its ribbon-like appenages. It will frolic to distract people while extending the ribbons to pickpocket jewelry to eat.

entry: POKENAME的盾，由历经漫长年代才形成的巨大红宝石雕成。中央的小空间，据说藏着它囤积的宝物。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: The shield POKENAME wields is carved out of a gargantuan ruby that took eons to form. The pocket of space in the center is rumored to hold its hoard of treasure.

entry: POKENAME用背炮发射闪亮硬币。虽会回收再用，仍总想收集更多弹药；训练家丢下钱财，就能分散它注意，再趁机逃走。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME fires glittering coins from the cannon on its back. While it will reuse them, it always tries to collect more ammunition, and Trainers can distract it by dropping currency and then fleeing.

entry: POKENAME背炮发出的能量，足以熔化宝石，让它舔食熔液补充养分。得让它远离首饰，否则损失可能十分昂贵。
author: .jerden
source: The energy fired from the cannon on POKENAME's back is powerful enough to melt gemstones, enabling POKENAME to nourish itself by lapping up the liquid this creates. To avoid very expensive damage, POKENAME must be kept away from jewellery.

entry: POKENAME背炮发射纯钻石尖刺，硬又锋利，连钢铁与岩石甲胄也能刺穿，是黑暗地下洞穴里的危险猎手。
author: .jerden
source: The cannon on POKENAME's back fires spikes made of solid diamond. Since this substance is hard and sharp enough to piece even armor made of steel and rock, this makes POKENAME a dangerous hunter within the dark underground caves it lives in.

entry: POKENAME不停寻找切磨完美的宝石，添在尾上，却又加热身体，将它们熔成不规则形状。原因仍未完全弄清。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME endlessly search for perfectly-cut gems to add to their tails. However, they will then melt these gems by heating up their body, reforming them into irregular shapes. It is not yet fully known why they do this.

entry: POKENAME着迷于闪亮宝石，尤其是进化石内部。野生个体若想进化，就得克制口腹之欲。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME are entranced by sparkly gemstones, particularly the insides of evolution stones. Wild POKENAME must temper their appetites if they ever hope to evolve.

entry: POKENAME身上伸出尖锐锯齿状宝石，一不留心，便会危及过于靠近的生物。
author: thehobomice
source: With sharp jagged gems protruding from its body, POKENAME can be a danger to anything that gets too close if POKENAME is not careful.

entry: POKENAME只短暂离开洞中地洞，采些宝石吃。有时也会拿些珠宝装饰耳朵。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME only comes out of its burrow within caverns long enough to gather up some gems to eat. It has occasionally been seen using some of the jewels to decorate its ears.

entry: POKENAME是点子很多的捣蛋鬼，爱对旁人恶作剧。它被负面能量吸引，尤其喜欢捉弄心怀怒气的人。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are creative tricksters that love to play pranks on others. They particularly like to pull pranks on people with anger in their hearts, as they are drawn to the negative energy.

entry: POKENAME像金属探测器，却能同时找出埋藏的宝石与贵金属。人类寻宝者试着利用它，它却很少肯分享发现。
author: .jerden
source: While it resembles a metal detector, POKENAME has the ability to locate buried gemstones as well as precious metals. While human treasure hunters have tried to make use of POKENAME, it is rarely willing to share anything it finds.

entry: POKENAME寻找让它想起月亮的晶洞石，再敲开外壳，饱餐里面美丽的部分。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME searches for geodes that remind it of the moon. It then cracks the stone open to gorge itself on the beautiful insides.

entry: POKENAME双颚强劲，能轻易咬穿岩石。虽爱收集宝石，却更爱捕食活物，藏在洞里最暗处，突然扑出，发动猛烈伏击。
author: t3isukone
source: POKENAME's powerful jaws can chew through stone easily. Despite loving to collect gems, it prefers to prey on the living, hiding in the darkest part of caves before springing out to launch a devastating ambush.

entry: POKENAME假扮宝箱，攻击想打开的探险者。喂金块，就能让它平静。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME disguise themselves as treasure chests, attacking explorers who try to open them. They can be appeased by feeding them golden nuggets.

entry: POKENAME的网结成一周后，便会硬化结晶。闪亮彩丝在洞壁与洞顶织出复杂花纹，迷住许多探险者。
author: sk372
source: Webs spun by POKENAME harden and crystallize a week after being formed. Many explorers are captivated by these sparkling, colorful threads woven in intricate patterns clinging to cavern walls and ceilings.

entry: POKENAME用最爱的亮宝石装饰网，在昏暗洞里反光诱猎物。讽刺的是，它自己却常被别的同类的网缠住。
author: thesilverowls
source: POKENAME decorate their webs with shiny gemstones that they love. These gems serve to attract prey by casting glints of light in dim caves. Ironically, they are frequently tangled in other POKENAME's webs.

entry: POKENAME在地下群居，头上宝石发出诡异红光，照亮黑暗。宝石若折落，就会遭群体遗弃。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME live in underground colonies, the gems on their heads illuminating the darkness with an eerie, red light. If the gem were to ever break off, the POKENAME will be abandoned by the rest of the colony.

entry: 看似用头上宝石照亮暗洞，实际却投出幻象，在关键而致命的地方，与真洞穴截然不同。
author: staghorn
source: It appears to illuminate dark caves via the gem on its head. In reality, it projects an illusion that differs from the real cave in important and deadly ways.

entry: 獠牙上粘满切过的宝石与水晶碎块。它挖穿洞穴与地层，寻找更多宝石吃。
author: infinex21
source: Its tusks are caked in the pieces of gems and crystals that it has cut through with them. It digs through caves and the ground itself in search of more precious stones to feed upon.

entry: POKENAME在中空身体里囤黄金与宝石。有时会吃储藏的宝石，黄金却绝不碰。
author: kam_doodle_snek
source: POKENAME hoards gold and gemstones within its hollow body. It will occasionally feed on the gems it stores, but will leave the gold untouched.

entry: POKENAME寻找让它想起月亮的晶洞石，再敲开外壳，饱餐里面美丽的部分。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME searches for geodes that remind it of the moon. It then cracks the stone open to gorge itself on the beautiful insides.

entry: 宝石太大，吞不进体内，POKENAME就背在身上。若受威胁，便吐出钱币与宝石迎击。
author: neonriser
source: If a gemstone is too big to store inside its body, POKENAME carries it on its back instead. It spits out coins and gems to whatever threatens it.

entry: POKENAME住在大洞穴，主要猎取小碎钻身上的宝石。强劲脚爪，能将大宝石从岩面撬下来吃；据说还能搬动大石，寻找食物。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: Living in large caverns, POKENAME primarily hunt Carbink for their gemstones. They use their strong talons to pry large gemstones off surfaces to eat them. It is said they are strong enough to move large stones in order to locate meals.

entry: POKENAME翱翔山上，宝石映光闪烁。见到它，往往表示附近有贵重宝石矿藏。
author: w3ird0_r4tz
source: POKENAME can be found soaring over mountains, its gems glinting in the light. POKENAME sightings often indicate a nearby deposit of precious stones.

entry: POKENAME只找最好的宝石装饰尾巴。长寿的个体，毛会如紫水晶般闪耀。
author: thehobomice
source: POKENAME will seek out only the best gems to decorate its tails with. A long-lived POKENAME will have fur that shines like amethyst.

entry: POKENAME常试图挖地道通向珠宝店，偷宝石与财物。似乎最爱红宝石和蓝宝石。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME regularly attempts to dig tunnels into jewelry stores to steal gems and valuables. It appears to prefer rubies and sapphires above all other gems.

entry: 吃宝石能促进POKENAME成长中的波导能力。吃下彩色宝石后，会暂时被同色波导包围。
author: sk372
source: The consumption of gems helps stimulate POKENAME's growing aura powers. After eating a colored gemstone, it becomes temporarily covered with an aura matching the jewel's coloration.

entry: POKENAME热爱亮物，在地下巢穴收集宝石与水晶，却懒得保护宝藏，常被其他宝可梦偷走收藏。
author: brilliantdarkness
source: POKENAME adore shiny things, collecting gems and crystals in underground lairs. However, they are too lazy to defend their hoard, and are frequently robbed by other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME将宝石与小饰物藏在脸颊，保护珍宝不被对手夺走。它在海底搜寻遗落物，常把人类垃圾误当贵重品。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME stores gems and trinkets in its cheeks to protect its treasures from rivals. It scours the seafloor for discarded objects, often mistaking human trash for valuables.

entry: 吃下紫水晶，POKENAME会失控放电整整一天。同类往往趁此围来，吸走散逸电力，免得浪费。
author: .izik
source: After consuming amethyst, POKENAME's body sparks uncontrollably for a full day. Others of its kind tend to huddle around it during this period to absorb the loose electricity rather than let it go to waste.

entry: POKENAME躲在废弃矿道，找到多少宝石就啃多少。据说夺走它任何一颗宝石，都会招来无尽厄运。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME hides in abandoned mineshafts, nibbling on as many gemstones as it can find. Trying to take any of its gems is said to bring endless misfortune.

entry: POKENAME的岩甲嵌着许多宝石，闪闪发亮。看见别的宝可梦敲碎岩石，就会生气，有机会便冲过去。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have rocky plates that sparkle with the many gems embedded within them. They get angry when they see another Pokémon break rocks and will charge at them given the opportunity.

entry: POKENAME的身体几乎全由水晶构成。为了躲避觊觎水晶的人类猎杀，POKENAME开始迁入水下洞穴的深处。
author: jestersqueak
source: POKENAME's body is almost entirely made up of crystal. POKENAME have started to live deep in underwater caves to avoid being hunted for its crystals by humans.

entry: POKENAME用各种金属与最珍贵的宝石，打造闪亮的无人机，帮助寻找更多宝石，也能协助战斗。
author: phantom640
source: POKENAME fashions its most precious gems into glittering drones using various metals. These drones then help it find more gems, or aid it in battle.

entry: POKENAME喜欢给无人机试配不同的宝石组合。最受宠的那一台，往往会被升级得远胜其他。
author: phantom640
source: POKENAME loves to experiment with different gem combinations with its drones. The one it likes the most is often upgraded far beyond the others.

entry: POKENAME悄悄跟矿工进洞。一见地上有大宝石，就趴上去装成石堆，好稍后不受打扰地吃。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME will sneak into caves alongside miners. If it spots a large gem on the ground, it will lie on it and disguise itself as a pile of rocks, so it can eat it later without interruption.

entry: 尾尖燃烧的火焰，能反映它最近吃过哪种宝石。如果摄入的珠宝不够充足，尾巴上的火焰，就会变得暗淡而微弱。
author: thehobomice
source: The flame that burns at the tip of its tail is an indication of which gems it has recently eaten. If it does not eat enough jewels, the fire on its tail will grow dim and weak.

entry: POKENAME常囤积进化石，也是皮可西与九尾等宝可梦在野外极其罕见的原因之一。看上什么财物就会争夺，同类的也不例外。
author: giggity._.
source: POKENAME often hoards evolution stones, which is one reason Pokémon such as Clefable and Ninetales are extremely rare in the wild. This Pokémon will start a fight over any possession it covets, even those belonging to other POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME的身体，是吃下的宝石乱聚成的一团。它能露出头顶宝石，让其他食宝石者分心，顾不上看守食物。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's body is a chaotic cluster of gems it's consumed. It can reveal the gem on top of its head to distract other gemstone-eaters into leaving their food unguarded.

entry: 双臂由水晶玫瑰构成，这种宝可梦在栖身暗洞里格外醒目。贪心敢摘的人，会尝到花中藏着的剧毒。
author: brilliantdarkness
source: With arms formed of crystalline roses, this Pokémon cuts a striking figure in the dark caves it inhabits. Within its flowers lies a potent venom for anyone greedy enough to dare pluck them.

entry: 很久以前，人们在POKENAME的洞口供奉宝石，盼能讨好它，让它放过自己的家人。有些聚落至今仍这样做。
author: periperi_chicken
source: Long ago, humans gave gemstone offerings to the mouth of a cave inhabited by POKENAME. They hoped that buying its favour would convince it to leave their families alone. Some communities still do this.

entry: POKENAME用霉菌与苔藓，盖住巢里囤的宝物，避开好奇目光。最爱的一颗却总随身带着，放出使人发痒的孢子，驱赶旁人保护它。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME covers the precious treasures it hoards in its lair with mold and moss to hide them from curious eyes. POKENAME always carries the gem it loves most with it and defends it from others by releasing urticating spores.

entry: POKENAME无声飘过空中，寻找它认为劳累过度的人。若目光相接，双眼便开始转动，轻柔催人入眠。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME floats silently through the air, seeking out those it deems to be overworked. If they meet its gaze, its eyes begin to spin in place and gently lull the person to sleep.

entry: 它用利爪在洞里挖出分岔孔道，寻找食物——宝石原石。也爱跟踪小碎钻，只有双眼在转角处闪亮。
author: elite01.
source: It digs branching holes in caves using its sharp claws in search of food--raw gems. It also likes to stalk Carbinks, with just its eyes glinting around corners.

entry: POKENAME的翼膜，带着食用宝石的光泽；色彩越丰富，在群中的地位越高。满月下成群飞行，虹彩双翼能将周围照得如白昼。
author: pjporwoll
source: The membranes of POKENAME's wings take on the luster of its gemstone diet, with more multicolored wings elevating its status within its colony. When a swarm of POKENAME fly on a full moon, their iridescent wings can brighten the area like day.

entry: 据说，古时有只贪心的勾魂眼想偷哭哭面具的面具，结果受到惩罚，变成了POKENAME。
author: eminemace
source: It's said that long ago, a greedy Sableye tried to steal the mask of a Yamask. This incident caused it to be turned into POKENAME as a punishment.

entry: POKENAME是珠宝店的害兽，啃得宝石在镶座里歪斜松动，最终脱落丢失。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are considered pests for jewelry stores. They nibble on gems, causing the stones to buckle in their settings. This leads to lost gemstones.

entry: POKENAME只住在最晶亮、财宝与宝石最多的洞穴。它在其中伪装身形，等待毫无防备的寻宝者。
author: pokebio
source: POKENAME is only found in the shiniest caves with the most treasures and gemstones. In those caves, it camouflages itself to wait for unsuspecting treasure hunters.

entry: 即使遇上崩断獠牙的宝石，它也不停啃，直到牙断或石碎。新牙裹着宝石般的晶层，与吃过的许多宝石相似。
author: infinex21
source: Even if they come across a gem their tusks break against, they will still gnaw on them endlessly until either their teeth break or the gem breaks. Their tusks regrow clad in gem-like crystals that match many of the gems they eat.

entry: POKENAME只吃珍贵矿石与水晶。在地里挖掘时，用獠牙从遇上的大晶簇切下碎块。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME feed entirely on precious stones and crystals. They use their tusks to carve pieces from larger formations that they come upon whilst digging through the ground.

entry: POKENAME吃宝石补充能量，宝石越大、切磨越精整，力量越足。坚爪能挖穿实心岩石，让人推测它是古文明的采矿造物。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME consumes gemstones to power up, with larger and more cleanly cut gems supplying more power. It is theorized to be a mining unit from an ancient civilization due to its powerful claws that it uses to dig through solid rock.

entry: POKENAME吃宝石补充能量，宝石越大、切磨越精整，力量越足。坚爪能挖穿实心岩石，让人推测它是古文明的采矿造物。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME consumes gemstones to power up, with larger and more cleanly cut gems supplying more power. It is theorized to be a mining unit from an ancient civilization due to its powerful claws that it uses to dig through solid rock.

entry: POKENAME用强喙将海蓝宝石从洞壁撬出，再敲碎，开心吃下。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its strong beak to pry aquamarine from cave walls. Once freed, it shatters the gem before eating it with glee.

entry: POKENAME四处搜寻贵重物件，藏在嘴里。可若吞得太多，就会接连数周飞不起来。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME hunts for all sorts of valuable items to store in its mouth. If it consumes too much however, it will become grounded for weeks on end.

entry: POKENAME的皮肤，会带上所吃宝石的色泽与质地。它藏在漆黑洞穴，伏击满身宝石的其他宝可梦，连同类也吃。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME's skin takes on the shade and texture of the gemstones it eats. It hides in pitch-black caves to ambush other gem-encrusted Pokémon, even others of its own kind, which it feeds upon.

entry: 流传甚广的一种说法认为，这种融合体，是很久以前统治丰缘的邪恶君王，转世而来。
author: 8xviktor
source: A popular theory has been floating around that suggests this fusion is the reincarnation of an evil king that ruled Hoenn long ago.

entry: POKENAME是小蜈蚣的主要天敌。双方都想吃珍贵矿物，也常争夺领地。锐利强壮的脚，能让它迅速钻穿硬岩。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are the primary predators of Carpede and also often fight with them for territory due to both species' desire to feed on precious minerals. Their feet are sharp and strong, allowing them to quickly burrow through hard rock.

entry: POKENAME用坚硬锐利的颚，主动寻觅宝石吃。据说吃得越多，成长就越快、越强壮。
author: korro0490
source: With its tough and sharp jaw, POKENAME actively seeks gemstones for it to consume. It is said that the more gemstones this Pokémon eats, the stronger and faster its growth becomes.

entry: POKENAME饥饿无比，凡塞得进嘴的宝石都吃。巨大双颚，让它能较轻松地挖穿洞穴。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME is extremely ravenous, feasting on any gemstones they can get in their mouths. Their gargantuan jaws enable them to burrow through caves with relative ease.

entry: POKENAME极力占着栖身洞穴里的珍贵矿物，可能因为它就吃这些。下口前，会先向坚石与宝石喷出冰冷气息。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME is very possessive of the precious minerals lining the cave it resides in, potentially because it feeds on such minerals. It breathes a freezing air upon solid rock and solid gems before attempting to bite into them.

entry: POKENAME夜间活动，水晶能吸收月光。储下的能量，会让靠得太近的人生病，到了白天，症状又神奇地消退。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME is active at night, and its crystals are capable of absorbing moonlight. The stored energy makes those who get too close fall ill. Come daytime, their symptoms miraculously fade.

entry: POKENAME的舞蹈，会随最近吃的宝石种类略有变化。吃了托帕石，就能像芭蕾舞者般旋转数小时，不需休息。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's dance changes subtly based on the type of gem it most recently consumed. If it eats a topaz, it can spin like a ballerina for hours without resting.

entry: POKENAME将找到的宝石埋进垃圾场深处，藏在垃圾间，却常忘记埋在哪里。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME hides gems it finds deep within landfills, concealed among the garbage. It frequently forgets where it buries them.

entry: 这种宝可梦住在宝石丰富的地下深河。POKENAME结群游动，跃出水面，用强颚咬碎宝石，方便群体一起吃。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: This Pokémon lives in deep underground rivers where gemstones are plentiful. Swimming in packs, POKENAME will jump out of the water and clamp its powerful jaws down onto the gems to break them into pieces that it and the pack can consume.

entry: POKENAME常埋在沙里，用嘴中宝藏诱来猎物。可牙与眼常反光，坏了计划。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME often bury themselves in sand, using the treasure in their mouth to lure prey close. However, light often reflects off their teeth and eyes, ruining their plans.

entry: 带珠宝的旅人，常遭POKENAME偷窃。它着迷于宝石的颜色与反光，偷来装饰栖身树桩。
author: sk372
source: Travelers carrying jewelry often become victims of POKENAME's thievery. It pilfers the shiny gems from them to decorate the stump it inhabits, entranced by their color and reflective nature.

entry: POKENAME守护地下环境，常给挖得太深的矿场找麻烦。据说从它的洞里拿走哪怕一颗宝石，也会被诅咒。
author: deniablecredibility
source: POKENAME is a guardian of subterranean environments, often causing trouble for mining operations that dig too deep. It is said to curse anyone who removes even a single gemstone from its caverns.

entry: POKENAME耳内的晶层，与它发出的频率共振，产生尖锐高音，严重损害过于靠近者的听力。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's ears are lined with a crystalline coating that resonates with the frequencies it produces, causing a high-pitched tone that causes severe hearing damage in anyone who gets too close.

entry: POKENAME独来独往，藏在险恶洞穴。耳朵发出响亮诡异的声音，使受害者陷入强烈恐惧。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are solitary POKENAME, hiding away in treacherous caverns. It emits a loud, eerie frequency from its ears that induces an overwhelming sense of fear in its victims.

entry: POKENAME在洞里寻找美丽宝石，装饰蓬松羽毛，盼着吸引伴侣。宝石收得越多，持续飞行越困难，只得更精于防守作战。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME searches caverns for beautiful gemstones to decorate its puffy plumage in hopes to attract a mate. The more gems it collects, the less capable POKENAME is at sustained flight, forcing it to become more adept at defensive combat.

entry: 有人推测，勾魂眼会收集珍贵宝石，搭建一个魔像。等它们外出找更多宝石，魔像便负责守住财宝。
author: tokenoracle
source: Theory suggests Sableye will gather precious gemstones to construct a golem.  It's tasked with protecting the hoard when they go and gather more gems.

entry: 有些POKENAME正用手臂切开岩壁挖掘。红宝石若丢了，就会暴怒，不顾一切地凿岩，直到另找到一颗。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Some POKENAME can be found excavating, using their arm to cut through rock walls. If their ruby goes missing, POKENAME enter a rage and will recklessly carve into rocks until they can procure another ruby.

entry: 据说来自究极发电厂的POKENAME，痴迷于收集一切找到的闪亮宝石。想在哪囤就在哪囤，谁也不敢反对。
author: beatdoof
source: Said to have originated from Ultra Plant, POKENAME obsessively collects whatever shiny, precious stones it can discover. It hoards wherever it wants, and none dare to resist it.

entry: 想偷POKENAME的宝石很不明智，它对闯洞者绝不留情。若真拿到了，据说整个血脉都会被厄运诅咒。
author: mistymagius
source: It is unwise to try and steal POKENAME's jewel, as it will show no mercy to anyone that enters its cave. If you do end up with the jewel, it is said that your entire bloodline will be cursed with misfortune.

entry: POKENAME找到海底沉宝，便在旁休息。谁想掠夺宝藏，就使出惊吓。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME locates sunken treasure on the ocean floor and rests beside it. Should anyone attempt to loot its hoard, it strikes with Astonish.

entry: POKENAME用水晶，把地质学家引入洞中，再将他们困进地下洞窟。大多数人，终生都没能逃出。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME lure geologists into caves with crystals. It then captures the humans and traps them in a underground cavern from which most never escape.

entry: POKENAME常与进化前的勾魂星合作，引诱、捕捉地质学家。POKENAME盯紧这些人，谁想逃跑，便受到惩罚。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME often lures and captures geologists with its pre-evolution, Sableanie. POKENAME keeps track of the humans, punishing those who try to escape.

entry: POKENAME由细碎宝石构成。找到新宝石，就在嘴里碾碎，添进身体。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body is composed of tiny crushed gemstones. It crushes any new gems it finds in its mouth to add to its form.

entry: POKENAME吃的真菌越多，背上的水晶就越大越鲜亮。训练家正试着喂各种蘑菇，看能长出多少种宝石。
author: sk372
source: The more fungi POKENAME consumes, the larger and more vibrant the crystals growing on its back become. Trainers are experimenting with different mushrooms in its diet to see how many different kinds of gems it can grow.

entry: POKENAME夜游苔原，无声盯着旅人，让人惧怕。满身红宝石若急速闪烁，就表示准备掀起遮尽光线的浓重暴风雪。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME roam the tundra at night, and are feared for the way they silently watch travelers. If the red gemstones that cover their body flash rapidly, this is a sign that they are preparing to create a blizzard so thick it blocks out all light.

entry: POKENAME爱玩丢宝石捡回来的游戏，有时却啃着吃掉，成了极昂贵的磨牙玩具。
author: mellowmuse
source: POKENAME loves to play fetch with gems. Occasionally, it will chew and eat them, making for a very expensive chew toy.

entry: POKENAME狡猾又善于潜行，喜欢闪闪发亮的东西，发现了就会偷走。它们住在洞穴里，将赃物藏好；谁想拿走哪怕一丁点，也会遭到攻击。
author: keiracm35_
source: POKENAME are cunning, sneaky Pokémon that love shiny things and steal any that they find. They live in caves where they hide their loot and will attack anyone who tries to take even the slightest part of it.

entry: POKENAME身上嵌着各种矿物，微微闪光。最爱吃硬宝石，强劲双颚轻松就能咬碎。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's body is studded with a variety of minerals that sparkle faintly. Its powerful jaws easily crush hardened gemstones, its favorite food.

entry: POKENAME在废弃城堡搜寻遗落珍宝吃。一察觉人近，就藏到盘碟下，很少被人看到移动。
author: bradlybro199
source: POKENAME scavenge abandoned castles for forgotten treasures to feed on, although they are rarely seen moving since they hide underneath dishware if they know people are near.

entry: POKENAME由人类已知最珍贵的宝石构成，据说美得令人一见就移不开目光。它受贵重宝石吸引，尤其喜欢阿罗拉的。
author: beatdoof
source: POKENAME's body is made of gemstones that are considered to be the most precious known to mankind, and the sight of it is said to be so alluring that those who see it can't look away. It's drawn to precious gems, especially those from Alola.

entry: 勾魂眼蜕下外皮，POKENAME就会偷走，用控土能力塑成坚固载具，保护柔软内部。
author: hushpuppygirl
source: When a Sableye sheds its outer skin, POKENAME steals it. It uses geokinesis to form the skin into a tough vehicle, protecting its soft insides from harm.

entry: POKENAME只吃蘑菇，却特别挑颜色，仿佛颜色本身就影响滋味。奇怪的是，吃下的蘑菇，确会影响水晶的生长与颜色。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME consume mushrooms as their sole food, though they are particular about the color of these mushrooms as if color alone affects the taste. Oddly, the mushrooms consumed affect the growth and colors of the crystals upon them.

entry: POKENAME周身覆着紫苔，宝石吃得越多，颜色越鲜亮。在所有宝石里，它特别偏爱托帕石。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body is covered in a purple moss that grows more vibrant the more gems it consumes. It shows a strong preference for topaz above all others.

entry: 矿业公司逐渐用POKENAME取代镐与炸药，使用越来越多。它一记肩撞，足以将黑曜石粉碎。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are being used more and more by mining companies as they pivot away from picks and dynamite. A shoulder-tackle from POKENAME is strong enough to pulverize obsidian.

entry: POKENAME常用树枝将普通石头变成宝石。据说这样变出的宝石，比钻石更硬。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME often use their twigs to turn normal rocks into gemstones. Gems produced this way are said to be harder than diamonds.

entry: POKENAME辗转各洞寻找宝石原石，既用于维生，也添到魔杖上。牙与眼在暗中闪亮，令探洞者看了不安。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME travel to different caves, searching for raw gems both for sustenance and to add to their magical wand. They are an eerie sight for cave explorers, their teeth and eyes flashing in the dark.

entry: POKENAME在洞里跳动，颈上的硬币便会掉下。人们普遍相信，捡到一枚就能带来好运。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: The coins on the neck of a POKENAME fall off as it hops around caves. It's a common belief that acquiring one of these coins brings good luck.

entry: 矿工得与POKENAME争蓝宝石，它几分钟就能吃掉许多条矿脉。若找到磨损的蓝宝石，会在周围结冰，拿来投射。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Miners have to compete with POKENAME for sapphires, as they can quickly feast on a multitude of sapphire veins in minutes. Should they find a scuffed sapphire, they will freeze water around it to use as a projectile.

entry: POKENAME刚被发现，就因眼睛酷似美丽宝石遭盗猎。虽很快被证实并非宝石，猎杀却已让原本稀少的物种，变得极度濒危。
author: sk372
source: When first discovered, POKENAME was poached due to its eyes resembling fantastic gems. Though this was quickly realized to be false, enough poaching had been done to cause the already-rare species to become critically endangered.

entry: POKENAME收集宝石，藏进葫芦形身体。废弃矿道里常能听到哀鸣，是它正在寻宝石。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME collects gems and stores it within its gourd-shaped body. Its wails can be heard inside abandoned mineshafts, where it searches for gems.

entry: POKENAME将宝石、黄金与一切亮物，塞进松垂的蜕皮。囤得太多就会撑破，只得舍下珍宝，等再蜕一层皮。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME stuffs gems, gold, and anything shiny into its sagging, shed skin. When its hoard becomes too big, the contents will tear through, forcing the POKENAME to abandon its treasures until it can shed another layer of skin.

entry: POKENAME珍爱日积月累收来的水晶。谁想拿走，它便暴怒，不报复成功绝不停。
author: chaotic_aspergers
source: POKENAME adores its crystals, having collected them over time. If someone tries to take its crystals, it will fly into a rage, only stopping when it gets revenge.

entry: POKENAME的头罩坚硬如钻石，深入洞穴寻宝石，不怕落石与来自上方的攻击。
author: atlas3339098
source: POKENAME's head covering is as hard as diamonds. It delves into caves searching for precious stones, unafraid of falling rocks and attacks from above.

entry: POKENAME常跳怪舞，阻止人们靠近洞里矿道。里面全是它囤着大吃的水晶。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME often dance erratically to deter people from approaching mineshafts in caves. These mineshafts are full of crystals that POKENAME hoard and devour.

entry: POKENAME住在地下深处，高热与压力让体内形成水晶。只有一年中最黑的那晚，才会来到地面。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME lives deep beneath the surface, the high heat and pressure causing crystals to form within its body. It will only come up to the surface on the darkest night of the year.

entry: POKENAME泛着脉动的淡紫光，滑过地下洞网。一见晶簇，就撞上去，吞吃碎块。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME glides through cave systems, pulsing with a faint purple glow. When it spots a gem cluster, it crashes into it and devours the shattered pieces.

entry: 它寻觅最爱的宝石时，能轻松啃穿岩石。但POKENAME更愿偷矿工藏的宝石，被当成讨厌的家伙。
author: mepp.
source: It chews through rock effortlessly while seeking out gemstones, its favorite food. However, POKENAME much prefers to steal from miners' gem caches, and are considered nuisances.

entry: 古代丰缘，贵族常在选美前喂POKENAME红宝石与蓝宝石。拥有最美个体的优胜者，会获最高荣誉。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: In ancient Hoenn, nobles often fed rubies and sapphires to their POKENAME before beauty competitions. The winner with the prettiest POKENAME received the highest honors.

entry: POKENAME的求偶展示华丽繁复。花数十小时找最亮的物品，装饰巢穴，盼吸引伴侣。有些大型布置，甚至被宣传成潜水景点。
author: _pixelar_
source: POKENAME's mating displays are very colorful and elaborate. It spends tens of hours searching for the shiniest things it can find and decorates its nest with them, hoping to attract a mate. Some larger displays are advertised as tourist diving spots.

entry: POKENAME天生爱囤东西，什么财物都想弄到手。感到有东西可偷，身上宝石便发光，照亮周围，方便找出藏起的小饰物。
author: kungfucutbug
source: A natural-born hoarder, POKENAME will get its claws onto any valuables it can find. When it senses something to steal, the gems lining its body glow and light up the surrounding area to make finding hidden trinkets easier.

entry: POKENAME天生爱囤东西，什么财物都想弄到手。感到有东西可偷，身上宝石便发光，照亮周围，方便找出藏起的小饰物。
author: kungfucutbug
source: A natural-born hoarder, POKENAME will get its claws onto any valuables it can find. When it senses something to steal, the gems lining its body glow and light up the surrounding area to make finding hidden trinkets easier.

entry: POKENAME爱拿亮东西，黏在毛上。还会掉下粘家具的闪粉，养作宠物十分麻烦。
author: nugamallow
source: POKENAME loves to take shiny stuff and stick it to its fur. It also sheds some glittering dust that sticks to furniture, making it very annoying to keep as a pet.

entry: POKENAME靠丰富宝石饮食强健身体。吃饭被打断，就会用利爪猛击。
author: petratheangel
source: POKENAME toughens its body on a rich diet of gemstones. If its meal is interrupted it will lash out with sharp claws.

entry: 双拳覆着一层钻石，出拳威力惊人。它渴求珍贵的宝石，为了寻找它们，甚至会摧毁整座山。
author: mistymagius
source: Its fists are coated in a layer of diamonds, which makes its punches absolutely devastating. It desires precious gemstones and will destroy entire mountains in search of them.

entry: POKENAME摇身时，可能掉下宝石。摸起来温暖，常用在高级餐盘等餐具上。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: When POKENAME shake their bodies, there's a chance one of its gems will fall off. These gems are warm to the touch and are often used in high-end plates and other dishes.

entry: POKENAME痴迷敛财，见多少囤多少。哪怕只丢了一枚钱币，也会横冲直撞，直到那枚硬币物归原主。
author: rakanadyo
source: POKENAME obsessively hoards as much wealth as it can find. If even a single coin is stolen, it will rampage across the land until it is returned.

entry: 阳光照上POKENAME腹部螺旋宝石，会折射美丽光彩。可惜它不爱阳光，能避就避。
author: petratheangel
source: The spiral shaped gemstone on POKENAME's belly creates beautiful refractions when sunlight shines on it. Unfortunately POKENAME dislikes sunlight and will avoid it when possible.

entry: POKENAME自认是栖身地下洞穴的统治者。领地意识极强，哪怕最小的宝石，也能为之打架。
author: gronkissimo
source: POKENAME believes itself to be the ruler of the underground caves it lives in. It's incredibly territorial, and even gets into fights over the smallest of gems.

entry: POKENAME大部分时间，都呆望找到的宝石。研究内部的分形图案，能让它更深地理解超能力。
author: petratheangel
source: POKENAME spends most of its time staring blankly at gems it finds. It gains deeper understanding of its psychic powers by studying the fractal patterns within the gems.

entry: POKENAME向迷路旅人提供不靠谱的指点，让人绕上好几个小时。送颗小宝石或亮汤匙，就很容易安抚它。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME offers dubious advice to lost travellers to keep them wandering for hours. It is easily placated with the gift of small gems or a shiny spoon.

entry: 多次有人见到POKENAME用投石索，击倒更大的敌人。成群个体之间，也常友好比试。
author: mepp.
source: There have been many accounts of POKENAME using their slings to take down larger foes. Groups of POKENAME will often engage in friendly competition with one another.

entry: POKENAME将根扎进能找到的最大宝石。只要够大，里面的养分就能供它活几个月。
author: petratheangel
source: POKENAME ingrain their roots in the biggest gemstone they can find. POKENAME can live off the nutrients of a big enough gem for months.

entry: POKENAME先用发光双眼催眠猎物，再出击。受威胁时，缩进据说与吃过的宝石一样硬的壳里。
author: zaffery88
source: POKENAME mesmerizes prey with its hypnotic, glowing eyes before striking. When threatened, it withdraws into its shell, which is said to be as hard as the precious stones it consumes.

entry: POKENAME用大宝石诱来猎物，到最后一刻才移开，再将猎物整个吞下。
author: petratheangel
source: POKENAME lures in prey with its massive gemstone. It pulls away the gem at the last moment and swallows its prey whole.

entry: POKENAME在海底洞穴找宝石吃，最爱红宝石，营养也最丰富。
author: petratheangel
source: POKENAME search undersea caves for gemstones to eat. Rubies are its favorite and most nutritious food.

entry: 贪求更多宝石，让POKENAME做出卑劣行为。它会攻击游泳者、潜水者，甚至小船，只为找到稀有宝石。
author: petratheangel
source: POKENAME's greedy desire for more gemstones has led it to despicable behavior. POKENAME will attack swimmers, divers and even small boats in hopes of finding rare gems.

entry: POKENAME身上长出的水晶，用途多样，既装饰、防护，也能挖掘。崩缺后，就吃掉，让水晶再生。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME grows crystals from its body for a variety of uses including decoration, protection, and digging tools. When the crystals become chipped, it eats them to regenerate.

entry: POKENAME寻找宝石吃，积攒进化能量。随饮食不同，极少数个体会渐渐泛起金色光泽。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME hunts gemstones to eat and build energy for evolution. Depending on its diet, in rare cases it can start to build a golden sheen.

entry: POKENAME寻找宝石吃，积攒进化能量。随饮食不同，极少数个体会渐渐泛起金色光泽。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME hunts gemstones to eat and build energy for evolution. Depending on its diet, in rare cases it can start to build a golden sheen.

entry: POKENAME深掘地下，寻找最美的宝石吞食。吃得越多，外皮越华丽，直到满身水晶，迎来进化。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME burrows deep into the earth searching for the most beautiful gemstones to devour. The more it eats, the more extravagant its hide becomes until it becomes encrusted in crystals and evolves.

entry: POKENAME深掘地下，寻找最美的宝石吞食。吃得越多，外皮越华丽，直到满身水晶，迎来进化。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME burrows deep into the earth searching for the most beautiful gemstones to devour. The more it eats, the more extravagant its hide becomes until it becomes encrusted in crystals and evolves.

entry: POKENAME深掘地下，寻找最美的宝石吞食。吃得越多，外皮越华丽，直到满身水晶，迎来进化。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME burrows deep into the earth searching for the most beautiful gemstones to devour. The more it eats, the more extravagant its hide becomes until it becomes encrusted in crystals and evolves.

entry: POKENAME甲壳的颜色与材质，全看饮食。外皮宝石越美，越需提防其他勾魂眼类宝可梦。
author: pjporwoll
source: The diet of POKENAME determines the color and material of its carapace. The more beautiful the gemstones comprising its hide, the more POKENAME will need to defend itself from other Sableye species.

entry: POKENAME甲壳的颜色与材质，全看饮食。外皮宝石越美，越需提防其他勾魂眼类宝可梦。
author: pjporwoll
source: The diet of POKENAME determines the color and material of its carapace. The more beautiful the gemstones comprising its hide, the more POKENAME will need to defend itself from other Sableye species.

entry: POKENAME甲壳的颜色与材质，全看饮食。外皮宝石越美，越需提防其他勾魂眼类宝可梦。
author: pjporwoll
source: The diet of POKENAME determines the color and material of its carapace. The more beautiful the gemstones comprising its hide, the more POKENAME will need to defend itself from other Sableye species.

entry: POKENAME的宝石外壳被走私者视若珍宝，却从无人能在上面留下一道划痕。那也是POKENAME唯一会奋力守护的东西。
author: epping_forest
source: POKENAME's gemstone shell is highly valued by traffickers, but nobody was able to even scratch it. It's the only thing POKENAME will fiercely fight for.

entry: POKENAME甲壳的颜色与材质，全看饮食。外皮宝石越美，越需提防其他勾魂眼类宝可梦。
author: pjporwoll
source: The diet of POKENAME determines the color and material of its carapace. The more beautiful the gemstones comprising its hide, the more POKENAME will need to defend itself from other Sableye species.

entry: POKENAME沿洞底爬行，寻找宝石吃。动作慢、耗能少，一颗小宝石能消化几个月，期间一直饱足。
author: alestrius
source: POKENAME crawls along cave floors in search of gems to eat. It moves so slowly and uses so little energy that one small gem can take months to digest, keeping it satiated the entire time.

entry: 宝石不带磁性，因此POKENAME有时很难吸来其他同类，一起进化。
author: diriector_doc
source: As gemstones are non-magnetic, sometimes POKENAME struggles to attract other POKENAME with which it can evolve.

entry: POKENAME住在最黑的洞穴，让地下宝石磁化，再吸出来。寻找贵重矿石的矿工，会利用它的磁力。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME dwell in the darkest of caves, where they pull out gems from within in the ground by magnetizing them. Miners who seek out precious ores utilize POKENAME's magnetic ability.

entry: 每只POKENAME都有特别喜爱的宝石，时刻带在身边。有研究者发现，群内阶序会依据宝石的大小与形状形成。
author: petratheangel
source: All POKENAME have a particular favorite gem that they keep on them at all times. Some researchers have noticed social hierarchies forming based on the size and shape of these gems.

entry: POKENAME仅有的头上，伸出一只奇异发光眼，能透墙看见宝石与威胁。也能引导超能力，让它浮起，够到洞穴高处的食物。
author: thordemidgard
source: An odd glowing eye branches from POKENAME's singular head that it uses to see gems and threats through walls. The eye can also channel Psychic power, allowing POKENAME to levitate and reach food high in the caverns.

entry: POKENAME见到亮宝石便贪婪吞下，似乎并非为了养分，只是吃下的宝石会浮到体表装饰，让它享受自己的美丽。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME greedily consumes any shiny gemstones it comes across. It doesn't appear to need them for nourishment, but merely because it enjoys feeling beautiful as the consumed gems float to its surface and decorate its exterior.

entry: POKENAME在水下洞穴制造珍珠。受威胁时，能用舌头将珍珠发射出去。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME can be found in underwater caves, making pearls. If threatened, they can launch their pearl using their tongue.

entry: POKENAME笼罩在宝石粉末形成的闪亮云雾里。据说，只需一眼，就能控制贪婪之人的心智。
author: staghorn
source: The bodies of POKENAME are shrouded in glittering clouds made of pulverized gemstones. It is said that they can dominate the minds of greedy people with a single look.

entry: POKENAME的舌头嵌满宝石，对滋味极敏感。它在黑暗中生活得很好，用胸前红宝石诱捕没防备的猎物。
author: jojojax164
source: POKENAME has a gem-encrusted tongue that is very sensitive to taste. It thrives in darkness, the ruby on the POKENAME's chest acting as a lure to catch unsuspecting prey.

entry: 这种融合体很聪明，先把岩石宝可梦催眠，再将其吃掉。颈部的毛，竟由纯粹坚硬的钻石构成。
author: thefinalkalgonus
source: This is an intelligent fusion that uses hypnosis to put Rock-type Pokémon to sleep, then eats them. Its neck fur is made of pure, hard diamond.

entry: POKENAME常在宝库里，吃亮石头与矿物维生。它囤积财宝，谁想拿走，就朝谁猛夹。
