author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME are often seen in treasure rooms, feeding on shiny rocks and minerals to sustain themselves. They hoard treasure and snap at anyone who tries to take it.

entry: POKENAME常在宝库里，吃亮石头与矿物维生。它囤积财宝，谁想拿走，就朝谁猛夹。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME are often seen in treasure rooms, feeding on shiny rocks and minerals to sustain themselves. They hoard treasure and snap at anyone who tries to take it.

entry: POKENAME贪得无厌出了名，为增添收藏，无所不用其极。甚至潜进游轮，偷硬币与钱包。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME are well-known for their intense greed, doing anything in their power to add to their collection. POKENAME have even snuck onto cruise ships to steal coins and wallets.

entry: POKENAME通常出现在海洋最深处，能点亮水晶，轻松穿过黑暗海床。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME are usually found at the very bottom of oceans. They can light up their crystals to easily travel along the dark sea floor.

entry: POKENAME表皮覆着麻痹毒，天敌很快就会学会远离。身体深色斑点的排列，每只都独一无二。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's epidermis is coated in a paralytic poison; predators quickly learn to stay away from it as a result. The arrangement of darker spots on its body is unique to the individual POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME用触角敏锐感知四周。任何东西一碰触角，便会向周围爆发电力。
author: infinex21
source: Using their feelers, POKENAME remain keenly aware of all else around them. If anything touches their feelers, they explosively release electrical energy all about.

entry: POKENAME各部分虽能独自移动，却更爱跟着同窝首领，整体行动。休息时，其余五只围住第六只，保护它。
author: sk372
source: Though they can move individually, the separate pieces of POKENAME prefer to move as a singular unit, following behind the leader of the clutch. When resting, the other five surround the sixth to protect it from harm.

entry: POKENAME在林中遇上赫拉克罗斯，就与它切磋磨炼拳技。头上触角，能感知其他宝可梦的存在。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME hones its boxing technique by sparring with any Heracross it encounters in the forest. It can sense the presence of other Pokémon through the antennae on its head.

entry: POKENAME的胃强健，最毒的蘑菇也吃得下。消化后，爪与刺里的毒液更强。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's strong stomach lets it consume even the most poisonous of mushrooms. The digestion helps give the venom in its claws and stingers even more potency.

entry: POKENAME脾气好斗，稍受招惹，就顶角冲向任何对象。角带轻毒，能削弱被刺者的肌肉。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has a feisty personality and will charge horn-first at anything with little provocation. The horn contains a mild venom that weakens the muscles of anything that gets stung.

entry: POKENAME极力保护蛋，用强毒驱赶袭击者。毒虽强，却也能作通用解毒剂。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is incredibly protective of its egg, using its powerful venom to fend off attackers. While incredibly potent, its venom can be used as a universal anti-venom.

entry: POKENAME野外独居，在小片花丛觅食。若被逼迫，便从双翼撒出极强的麻痹毒。
author: sk372
source: A solitary Pokémon, POKENAME keeps to itself in the wild and eats from small flower patches. If confronted, it spreads a very potent paralyzing poison from its wings.

entry: POKENAME战斗时动作敏捷，保持守势。镰刀尖端有毒，便等待最佳时机出击，让敌人痛尝毒液。
author: sk372
source: In battle, POKENAME moves with agility and stays on the defensive. Its scythes are tipped with venom, so it waits for the perfect moment to strike and deliver a painful dose to its foe.

entry: POKENAME毒性虽轻，钳状毒刺却夹得很紧。抓住猎物后不停注毒，直到彻底麻痹，方便吃下。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's venom is mild, but its pincer-like stingers have a powerful grip. It grabs prey and holds them tight, constantly injecting venom until they're totally paralyzed and an easy meal.

entry: POKENAME头上的大触角，能感知近处的振动。再毒的植物，它也照吃不误。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME has a large antenna on its head with which it can locate vibrations in its immediate vicinity. It can eat even the most poisonous plants.

entry: POKENAME头上双触角也能当毒刺，特意去刺附近任何对象。只有缺乏四肢，才限制了凶猛的攻击性。
author: quackquackattack
source: The twin antennae on POKENAME's head double as stingers. Its fierce aggression is only limited by its lack of limbs, as it goes out of its way to sting anyone nearby.

entry: POKENAME从空中攻击一切认为能吃的生物，再以锯颚与毒液完成捕猎。无论如何，都别将它引向市区。
author: torterraguy26
source: POKENAME attacks anything it thinks it can eat from the sky before using its saw-like jaws and poison to finish its prey. Avoid leading it to urban areas at all costs.

entry: POKENAME常向自认能用毒牙打倒的敌人挑战。每夜毒牙与鳞片一同脱落，新牙长出，毒性就更强。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME frequently challenge foes they believe they can take down with their venomous fangs. Their fangs are shed along with their scales every night. Their venom becomes more potent when their fangs grow back.

entry: 它们用水晶球的光诱猎物，再扑上去，用毒牙制服。盘起身体，像弹簧般弹出，打对方一个措手不及。
author: infinex21
source: They use the glow of their crystal orbs to lure prey and pounce to neutralize them with their venomous fangs. They coil upon themselves and launch themselves like springs to catch others off guard.

entry: 头上触角能感到空气最细微的变化，敏锐察觉天气将变。飞行时，会从双翼撒下毒鳞粉。
author: infinex21
source: The feelers upon their heads can sense the slightest changes in the air, so they are keenly aware of when the weather is about to change. They scatter poisonous scales from their wings as they fly.

entry: 白天，POKENAME睡在毒草上，吸收毒性。到了夜晚，再借这些毒，展开凶猛狩猎。
author: chorb33
source: During the day, POKENAME sleeps on poisonous plants to absorb their toxicity. It uses this at night to go on a fierce hunt.

entry: POKENAME是隐秘的小家伙，飘在视线之外，再扑向猎物毒咬，随后瞬间移动离开，等毒完全生效，才完成捕猎。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a sneaky little creature, floating just out of sight before pouncing on prey to deliver a poisonous bite. It then teleports away to wait for its venom to take full effect before finishing its hunt.

entry: POKENAME大群生活，吃小种子与树果。喙里有毒，单次啄刺虽不致命，遭整群围攻却极其危险。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME live in large flocks, feeding on small seeds and berries. They carry poison in their beaks, and while one sting isn't lethal, it can be incredibly dangerous if you are swarmed by a flock of them.

entry: 这些小虫宝可梦常遭踩踏，因此脾气暴躁。它们用有毒大颚连咬敌人，毒却只会让对方发痒。
author: infinex21
source: These small Bug Pokémon are so often trampled that they have developed irritable temperaments as a result. They will rapidly bite enemies with their poisonous mandibles, though the poison is only capable of inciting an itch.

entry: POKENAME覆着柔软蓬松的纤维，看似无害。碰到毛，却会强烈麻木好几个小时。
author: .izik
source: Covered in soft, fluffy fibers, POKENAME appears harmless. Touching its wool causes intense numbness that lasts for hours.

entry: POKENAME用头尾的感受器发现猎物。尾部还裹着有浮力的油，方便在水上捕猎。捉住后便咬下，注毒麻痹，让猎物无望逃生。
author: grannyjojophone
source: POKENAME uses sensors on its head and tail to discover prey. The tail is also covered in a buoyant oil to help catch prey on water. When it catches the located prey, it will inject venom through its bite to paralyze the now hopeless prey.

entry: POKENAME是捕猎高手，听觉出众、触角敏锐，能察觉水里溺水的猎物。若有同类在水中挣扎，其他个体会吹气泡相助。
author: grannyjojophone
source: POKENAME is an expert hunter, able to sense drowning prey in water with both great hearing and highly tuned feelers. If another POKENAME is struggling in the water, others will help by blowing air bubbles.

entry: POKENAME很会趁机取食，等其他宝可梦捕到猎物，就高速俯冲，毒倒并麻痹猎手，抢吃现成的一餐。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is highly opportunistic when it comes to procuring food: it waits until it spies another Pokémon capture prey, before swooping in at high speeds to poison and paralyze the predator so it can eat the hunted meal instead.

entry: 任何东西碰到触角，POKENAME都会暴怒，四处奔跑，向所有动的东西射水枪，直到自己昏倒。有些地区将它关进竞技场，赌能撑多久。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: When anything touches its antennae, POKENAME goes into a rage, running around and shooting Water Gun at anything that moves until it faints. In some regions, people trap POKENAME in arenas and bet on how long it will last before it faints.

entry: POKENAME尾端与羽端有毒刺，用来毒倒人类与黑暗鸦，使其无力反抗，再偷走贵重物。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has toxic points on the end of its tail and feathers. It uses them to poison humans and Murkrow in order to render them helpless and steal precious items from them.

entry: POKENAME靠敏捷与本能避开天敌，天性狡猾，会给较小的POKENAME下毒，跟到毒发死亡后再吃。
author: notmax22
source: POKENAME rely on agility and instinct to avoid predators. Cunning by nature, they poison small POKENAME and follow them until their demise before feeding.

entry: POKENAME用毒牙咬一切靠得太近的生物，保护背花。释放的麻痹孢子很强，连附近飞行属性宝可梦都能放倒在地。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME defends the flower on its back by sinking its venomous fangs into anyone who ventures too close. It is capable of releasing paralysis-inducing spores potent enough to ground even the Flying-type Pokémon in the surrounding area.

entry: POKENAME视力差，靠触角感知周围。受惊便缩进卷起的甲壳，等危险过去。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have poor eyesight, relying on their antennae to sense the world around them. When startled, they withdraw their bodies into their curled-up carapace, waiting out the danger.

entry: POKENAME睡在雪堆，与地形融为一体。一被碰到，就渗出汗般的毒液，接触便能麻痹。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME slumbers in snowdrifts, blending in with the terrain. If touched, it releases a sweat-like venom that can paralyze on contact.

entry: POKENAME身上连着巨大的毒囊，受到威胁便会释放烈毒。被逼入绝境时，还会紧抓尾巴，摆出威吓的姿势，赶走来敌。
author: rakunk
source: POKENAME has a large poison sac attached to its body, which it uses to deliver potent venom when threatened. When feeling cornered, it grips its tail tightly, using it as an intimidation tactic to ward off potential threats.

entry: 与电脑上的POKENAME互动要小心。惹急了，毒咬会损坏咬中的程序，甚至可能令电脑无法运作。
author: sk372
source: One should be careful interacting with a POKENAME on their computer. When agitated, it has a venomous bite that will degrade whatever program it nips, and could potentially render the computer inoperable.

entry: 它从尾部毒刺产毒，再将毒团甩到鹿角。受威胁时，尾巴与角都能抛射毒团。
author: sk372
source: It produces poison from the stingers on its tail, creating globs it flicks onto its antlers. It flings blobs of poison from both its tail and antlers when it feels threatened.

entry: POKENAME全身覆着厚厚的甲壳质外骨骼，分节结构让尾巴方便活动。头部鼓起，带有花纹，吓退更大的宝可梦。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have a thick chitinous exoskeleton covering their body with separate segments to allow their tail to move easily. Their head is bulbous and patterned to dissuade larger Pokémon from attacking them.

entry: POKENAME住在山里，坚韧甲壳挡住落石。性情极凶，为食物会与其他宝可梦争斗。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME lives in the mountains, its tough carapace protecting it from falling rocks. It is very aggressive and will try to fight other Pokémon over food.

entry: POKENAME将毒储在颊囊。带电的一咬，据说如同被闪电击中。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: POKENAME stores venom in the sacs on its cheeks. Its shocking bite is described as feeling like being struck by lightning.

entry: POKENAME能将尾巴向前甩，用麻痹尖刺打击对手。够不到爱吃的树果，就踩着尾巴，跳过去取。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME can swing its tail forward to strike opponents with its paralyzing spikes. When it can't reach the berries it loves to eat, it uses its tail as a step and then jumps on them.

entry: POKENAME的尾巴同时制造、储存毒液与电。它常刺人注毒，就连闪电击中，也会在目标身上留下令人衰弱的毒。
author: sk372
source: Both poison and electricity are stored and generated in POKENAME's tail. Stabbing others to poison them is common, but even being hit by its lightning bolts will leave a debilitating toxin marring the target's body.

entry: 头上触角感受空气震动，腿也敏锐察觉地面震动。蜷成球，外皮绷紧，能弹开大多数身体攻击。
author: infinex21
source: The feelers on its head allow it to sense vibrations in the air, as do its legs keenly sense vibrations through the ground. When it curls up in a ball, its hide becomes so tense that it can repel most physical attacks.

entry: POKENAME用触角接收无线电信号，获取猎物位置。遇上一大群，就古怪扭动，让行动难以预测，同时用毒牙不断撕咬。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME uses its antennae to pick up radio signals to gather information on the locations of prey. If it encounters a huge hoard, it erratically wiggles around to make its movements unpredictable while dishing out toxic bites with its fangs.

entry: POKENAME靠头尾触角感受空气震动，警觉潜在天敌。手脚的小钩，让它能爬上高树，在树上与树中筑巢。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME rely on the feelers on their heads and tails to sense vibrations in the air, which alert them to potential predators. They nest upon and within tall trees, which they can scale thanks to the small hooks on their hands and feet.

entry: POKENAME从臂上叶片喷出强腐蚀树汁。酸性极强，短暂一碰，也能在巨石留下深槽。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME sprays a highly corrosive sap from the leaves on its arms. This acid is strong enough to leave deep grooves in boulders on even brief contact.

entry: 它靠尾部触角感知周围，触角常抽动，或像节拍器般左右摇摆。一感到陌生存在，便迅速向那边吐出微弱火球。
author: infinex21
source: The feeler on its tail is how it senses its surroundings; this feeler often twitches or rocks side to side like a metronome. It quickly reacts to an unknown presence by spitting weak fireballs at the source.

entry: POKENAME挑衅敌人，激得对方靠近，再用毒牙与毒爪出击。可计划也会适得其反，让它遭到毫无准备的反击。
author: porterofgames
source: POKENAME provokes its foes, taunting them to approach so that it can strike them with venomous fangs and claws. This plan can backfire, however, leaving them vulnerable to a counterattack they weren't prepared for.

entry: POKENAME靠头尾触角察觉周围动静，免遭天敌伏击。敏锐感知也帮助它锁定敌人，先发制人，以利爪猛挥。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: Using the feelers on POKENAME's head and tail, it can sense movement around it and prevent predators from ambushing it. This heightened sense also gives POKENAME an advantage on locating foes and striking first with a powerful swipe of its claws.

entry: POKENAME嘴里放出的粉色液体，毒性极强。皮肤哪怕只沾一滴，也能令受害者失去味觉数周。
author: .izik
source: The pink water POKENAME releases from its mouth is highly poisonous. Even a single drop on the skin can cause the victim to lose their sense of taste for weeks.

entry: POKENAME害羞，不算太凶，却会迅速报复吓它的对象。用超能力将额刺的毒液射出，毒倒对方，再跑走。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is shy and not overly aggressive, but is quick to retaliate towards anything that spooks it. It uses psychically-launched venom from the spines on its forehead to poison anything that scares it before running off.

entry: POKENAME的触角极敏感，能察觉空气震动，边飞边探查周围。翼上落下的毒粉，会给下方生物造成轻微伤害。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME's antennae are extremely sensitive to vibrations in the air, so it can scan an area as it flies. A poisonous powder drops from its wings, causing minor harmful effects to those below it.

entry: POKENAME能抵御恶劣环境，在世界各地生活。沙漠中的POKENAME吃仙人掌，沼泽中的则靠啃蕨类与荨麻维生。
author: rooboid
source: POKENAME's resilience to the elements allows it to thrive in many corners of the world. Desert POKENAME enjoy a diet of cacti, while marshland POKENAME nibble away at ferns and nettles to survive.

entry: POKENAME用背花甜香诱来其他虫属性宝可梦。触角察觉靠近，就扑去毒咬，再一路跟随，直到猎物毒发倒下。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME uses the sweet scent of the flower on its back to lure in other Bug-type Pokémon. After sensing their approach with its antennae, POKENAME will attack with its venomous bite, then follow its prey until they succumb to the poison.

entry: POKENAME吃果树叶，倒刺会渗出绿毒。只有受惊或被逼入绝境，才启动这层防御。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME grazes on fruit tree leaves, leaking green toxin from its barbs. It only activates this defense when startled or cornered.

entry: POKENAME藏在丛林地面，等着用毒咬伏击猎物。触角探空气动静，双翼感地面震动，谁也没法悄悄靠近。
author: oejoeboy33
source: POKENAME hides along the jungle floors, waiting to ambush its prey with a poisonous bite. Its antennas detect movement in the air, while its wings feel vibrations on the ground, making it impossible to sneak up on.

entry: POKENAME攻击性极强，常用头撞树，震落想吃的叶子。吃下落叶，甲壳也更强壮。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME is extremely aggressive, frequently headbutting trees to dislodge leaves that it finds desirable. POKENAME consumes the fallen greenery to strengthen its shell.

entry: POKENAME主要吃毒树果与毒植物，因此毒性强。旅人常用它找出、吃掉危险植物，免得自己采食时中毒。
author: sk372
source: The potent poison POKENAME possesses is due to its diet consisting mostly of poisonous berries and plants. Travelers often use it to suss out and consume dangerous plants to avoid getting poisoned while gathering food.

entry: POKENAME紧张时，会分泌汗般的强效致幻物。这种分泌物，常在各地被非法高价贩卖。
author: big_clanker
source: POKENAME secretes a very strong hallucinogenic when nervous, not too dissimilar to sweat. The perspirant is often sold illegally across the region at a high value.

entry: POKENAME性格孤傲难近，什么一靠近，就会猛攻。它吹出一串毒泡，毒性出奇强，用来赶走旁人。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's prickly, independent personality causes it to lash out at anything that approaches it. It blows a series of bubbles filled with a surprisingly potent poison as a way of warding off others.

entry: POKENAME用毒刃戳弄、折磨林中宝可梦，专挑比自己弱的。一旦盯上人，就不停骚扰，直到对方精疲力竭。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME uses its venomous blade to prod and torment other Pokémon in the forest, targeting those weaker than itself. Once it sets its sights on a human, it harasses them relentlessly until their strength is fully spent.

entry: 秋天，POKENAME囤枯叶吃。会为叶堆与同类打架，遭挑战便从刺背喷毒。
author: .izik
source: In fall, POKENAME hoards dry leaves to eat. It will fight kin over leaf piles, spraying poison from its spiked back when challenged.

entry: POKENAME用拥抱，将伪装外衣不断渗出的毒，抹到其他宝可梦身上。等毒起效，就吃掉猎物。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME smear the poison that constantly seeps from their disguise onto other Pokémon via hugs. After the poison does its job, POKENAME will eat their prey.

entry: POKENAME往洞壁吐毒黏液，对同类却无效。触碰会令人头晕，长出巨大水泡。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spits globs of poisonous mucus on its cave walls that do not affect others of its kind. Touching this mucus can cause dizziness and massive blisters.

entry: POKENAME按感到的波导决定态度。波导弱，就用毒针欺负；波导强，就迅速逃走，避开打不赢的仗。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's attitude towards others depends on the aura it senses from them. Weak auras result in it bullying them with its Poison Sting, while strong auras cause it to flee quickly to avoid a losing battle.

entry: POKENAME触角极善感知情绪。扭一扭，就能察觉恐惧的波动，准确知道哪边不该去。
author: periperi_chicken
source: The feelers on POKENAME are fine-tuned to sense emotions. When it wiggles them it can sense waves of fear, which tells it exactly which direction it shouldn't go in.

entry: POKENAME体内流动的毒液带电。它吐出这墨汁般的物质，让敌人同时受电击、中毒，再逃走。
author: .izik
source: The toxin coursing through POKENAME's body carries an electrical charge. It spits this inky substance to shock and poison foes before fleeing.

entry: POKENAME从额头与后方伸出的触角放出闪电，再用巨大毒爪，攻击失去行动力的猎物。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME blast lightning from the feelers extending from their forehead and rear. They then attack their incapacitated prey with their huge, venomous claws.

entry: POKENAME深吸气，胀到两倍大，发出响亮鸣声，隔着森林互相沟通。偏爱日落时叫，让人在栖地附近很难露营。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME make loud chirps to communicate with one another across a forest, inhaling deeply and inflating to twice their size to make these noises. Their tendency to chirp at sunset makes it difficult to camp in regions where they make their home.

entry: POKENAME披着比铁更硬的甲壳质铠甲，矿物吃得越多，甲越硬。头上触角，能感知并回应地面或空气的震动。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are clad in an armor-like chitin harder than iron, which grows even harder the more minerals they consume. The feelers on their heads sense and react to vibrations, be they in the ground or in the air.

entry: POKENAME住在杂草丛生的池塘，绿鳞与破碎状鳍，让它藏进叶间。鳞中毒素，使天敌也难以下咽。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME lives in weed-infested ponds, camouflaged among the leaves due to its green scales and ragged fins. The toxins in its scales make it unpalatable to potential predators.

entry: POKENAME极其好斗，争领地时，会用头撞其他宝可梦。可头若重伤，毒便会积在甲下，痛苦不堪。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is very aggressive, and it can be seen headbutting other Pokémon in territorial disputes. However, if its head is badly injured, its poison will start to pool under its carapace, causing it immense pain.

entry: POKENAME用多只爪抓住敌人，再咬住注入带来灼痛的毒液。头上触角随心情动，好奇时抽动，烦躁时绷紧。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME use their many claws to hold onto foes and inject them with a burning venom via a bite. The feelers upon their heads move in ways correlative to their feelings; their feelers twitch when curious or tense up when agitated, for example.

entry: POKENAME埋在扁桃树下，等坚果落地，吸收其中的苦杏仁苷，用于分泌毒液。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME buries itself beneath almond trees, waiting for nuts to fall. It absorbs amygdalin from them to fuel its toxic secretions.

entry: POKENAME的花心藏着毒刺，花瓣间层层夹着刺激性花粉。身上甲壳质比树皮硬，临近进化，还会更坚韧。
author: infinex21
source: A POKENAME's flowers conceal venomous stingers at their centers and layers of irritant pollen within their petals. The chitin lining their bodies is harder than tree bark, but it grows even tougher as they near evolution.

entry: POKENAME住在沼泽深处，撞树震落树果。孢子酸性极强，碰到什么，便开始缓缓腐蚀穿透。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME lives in the deep marsh, headbutting nearby trees to knock down berries. Its spores are highly acidic and will slowly start to melt through anything it comes into contact with.

entry: POKENAME的膜由毒性物质构成，平时摸却出奇安全。惹急了，就用尖角将毒直接注入，造成暂时神经损伤。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's membrane is made of a toxic material that is surprisingly safe to touch normally. However, if it is agitated, it will attack with its pointed horns and inject the poison directly, causing temporary nerve damage.

entry: POKENAME飞行时，能以惊人准头喷出团团神经毒液。洞穴里，群体借此压制虚弱的猎物。
author: .izik
source: While airborne, POKENAME spits globs of neurotoxin with alarming precision. In caves, swarms use this to overwhelm weakened prey.

entry: POKENAME像撒网般投出丝网，捕捉微小生物。即使猎物逃脱，网上的毒也会渐渐耗尽体力，让它追上。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME hunts tiny creatures by lobbing webbing at them as if casting a net. Even if captured prey escapes, the webbing is coated with poison that will exhaust them in time and allow POKENAME to catch up.

entry: 野生POKENAME用毒牙啃树标记领地，留下的腐蚀毒，连树皮与木材都能蚀穿。
author: johnneh_
source: Wild POKENAME mark their territory by gnashing trees with their venomous tusks, leaving behind a corrosive poison that eats through bark and wood alike.

entry: POKENAME攻击性极强，几乎把一切都当威胁。它从触角喷出沸热酸液，令受害者痛不欲生。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is incredibly aggressive and will perceive basically anything as a threat. It sprays boiling-hot acid from its antennae to attack, which leaves its victims in agonizing pain.

entry: 吃下萤石，POKENAME的毒性便增强至两倍。此时毒液变成亮黄色，还会在暗中发光。
author: .izik
source: After consuming fluorite, POKENAME's venom becomes twice as potent. During this period the venom turns a bright yellow and glows in the dark.

entry: 这是长着两颗头的百足蜈蚣。由于大多个体活不长，极其难得一见。
author: mr.person__prinplup_enjoyer
source: A two-headed form of Venipede. They are exceptionally rare to find, as most don't live for very long.

entry: 融合让POKENAME多出体节，毒性也增强。外骨骼还长出更多刺，一碰就危险。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The fusion process causes POKENAME to develop additional body segments as well as increasing the potency of their venom. Their exoskeleton also becomes covered in extra spines, making them dangerous to touch.

entry: 融合让POKENAME多出体节，毒性也增强。外骨骼还长出更多刺，一碰就危险。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The fusion process causes POKENAME to develop additional body segments as well as increasing the potency of their venom. Their exoskeleton also becomes covered in extra spines, making them dangerous to touch.

entry: POKENAME像处在进化阶段之间，仍保留灵活行动力，却牺牲了部分毒性与甲壳强度。遇险便快跑，避开冲突，直到能再进化。
author: sk372
source: Something of a step between evolution stages, POKENAME retains mobility but loses some venom potency and the sturdiness of its shell. It skitters away from trouble, avoiding conflict until it can evolve further.

entry: POKENAME用惊人力气与毒角，残忍杀死附近一切生物。似乎只有百足蜈蚣一族的其他成员能例外。
author: torterraguy26
source: POKENAME brutally kills anything in its vicinity with its remarkable strength and venomous horns. The only exception seems to be other members of the Venipede family.

entry: 常能看到POKENAME欺负被它击退的鸟宝可梦。它也爱被梳理，常要求训练家擦亮甲壳。
author: m0ther0fdem0ns
source: POKENAME can often be seen bullying bird Pokémon that it fights off. POKENAME also loves being groomed, usually demanding that its trainer keep its carapace shiny.

entry: POKENAME敲碰长触角，与同类沟通。它在植物旁挖洞，吸取养分。触角分泌毒液，想拔走它很危险。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME communicate among themselves by clicking together their long feelers. They feed on the nutrients of plants by burrowing near them. Their antennae secrete a venom, making it dangerous to try and remove them.

entry: 音乐一停，POKENAME就深深哀伤，在舞厅里是大麻烦。泪中带强毒，附近人只闻一丝，几秒内就会倒下。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME becomes deeply sorrowful when music ends which is a major problem in clubs. Its tears carry a powerful toxin, and even a faint whiff can cause people nearby to collapse in seconds.

entry: POKENAME吃危险废弃物，补满毒液储备，常先吐毒削弱猎物，再使出清除之烟。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's poison reserves fill when it consumes discarded hazardous waste. This venom is frequently spat at prey to weaken them before it strikes with Clear Smog.

entry: POKENAME用头上触角嗅闻水中气味，锁定受伤的水生宝可梦。靠得够近，锯齿一阵猛咬，就到手一餐。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME detects scents in the water with the feelers on its head, allowing it to hone in on injured aquatic Pokémon. Once POKENAME is close enough to its prey, a flurry of gnashing serrated teeth quickly secures its next meal.

entry: POKENAME捕猎时咬完就跑，注毒后迅速逃开，暗中跟踪，等毒发，再收拾虚弱的猎物。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's hunting technique involves hit-and-run tactics. It bites to inject venom before quickly fleeing, stalking and waiting for the poison to run its course before picking off its weakened prey.

entry: POKENAME附身树桩，桩上便莫名长出毒葛。原因仍令研究者不解。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME possesses a stump, poison ivy mysteriously sprouts from it. The mechanism behind this remains unknown to researchers.

entry: POKENAME头上的果实毒性极强，多数想吃的生物，不到一天就会毒发死亡。甜腻气味，却引得某些虫宝可梦想尝。
author: mistymagius
source: The fruits on POKENAME's head are incredibly poisonous, and most that try to eat them will succumb to them in less than a day. The fruit smells sickly sweet, which lures certain Bug Pokémon to try and eat them.

entry: POKENAME的眼睛不适合白昼视物，便靠灵敏听觉辨路。尖锐鸣声，即使浓密灌丛也能传得很远。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have eyes that are poorly adapted for seeing in daylight, so they rely on their keen hearing to navigate. They make high-pitched chirping noises that carry well through dense undergrowth.

entry: POKENAME的眼睛不适合白昼视物，便靠灵敏听觉辨路。尖锐鸣声，即使浓密灌丛也能传得很远。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have eyes that are poorly adapted for seeing in daylight, so they rely on their keen hearing to navigate. They make high-pitched chirping noises that carry well through dense undergrowth.

entry: POKENAME体内不断产生、积累毒性杂质，令它极其难受。它从身体放出高浓度腐蚀毒束，排走多余物质。
author: sk372
source: Toxic impurities are constantly produced and build up within POKENAME's body, causing it extreme discomfort. It releases the excess by unleashing beams of highly concentrated and caustic poison from its body.

entry: POKENAME常被用作市内交通工具。虽很可靠，行驶时却会放出团团毒烟。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is often used as a mode of transportation in urban areas. While quite reliable, it produces clouds of toxic smog as it drives.

entry: POKENAME骄傲地展示鲜亮鳞片，警告潜在对手。鳞中强毒，不到一分钟便能令人衰弱。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME proudly shows off its vibrant scales, which act as a warning to would-be opponents. Its scales are laced in a powerful toxin that can debilitate its opponent in less than a minute.

entry: POKENAME爪尖会调出一种特殊毒物，抓伤生物通常致病。可若在树上划出伤口，抓痕里便开始长真菌。
author: sk372
source: A unique type of poison concoction is produced from the tips of POKENAME's claws. Normally causing illness in those it scratches, if its claws scrape a gash into a tree, fungi begin growing in the scratch marks.

entry: POKENAME凶猛守卫地下洞网深处的菌丛。爪里的强毒，会引发痉挛。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME guards its fungal patches deep in cave systems with fierce intensity. Its claws hold a powerful venom that cause seizures.

entry: 野生POKENAME是两面派捣蛋鬼。被大生物发现，先假装惊恐逃走，再绕回来，趁对方松懈，跃起连番毒咬。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME acts as a two-faced trickster in the wild. If spotted by a larger creature, it pretends to flee in terror, then doubles back in order to leap at its foe when their guard is down and apply rapid venomous bites.

entry: POKENAME住在浓密雨林，藏于湿叶间。从上方扑向猎物，毒爪扎进头，直到对方虚弱得站不住。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME lives in dense rainforests, hiding amongst damp foliage. It will leap at prey from above, sinking its venomous claws into their heads until they are too weak to stand.

entry: POKENAME不算好斗，毛发却会分泌剧毒。它也有些微弱的超能力。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME is not particularly aggressive, but its fur produces a highly poisonous secretion. It also has weak psychic powers.

entry: POKENAME讨厌触碰，一被碰就迅速用毒刺扎对方，再逃走。只在夜间活动，靠腹部暗光看清四周。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME hates being touched, as it will quickly prick its foe with its poisonous thorns before fleeing. It is exclusively nocturnal, using the dim lights from its belly to see in the dark.

entry: POKENAME极其凶悍，成群围攻一切进入领地者。头上毒刺有强神经毒，剂量足够就能造成麻痹。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are incredibly aggressive and will swarm anyone that enters their territory. The venomous barbs on their heads contain a powerful neurotoxin that can cause paralysis with a large enough dose.

entry: 这些宝可梦戒心极强，什么被视为威胁，就攻击什么。头上叶盘有成千上万根细刺，毒性足以麻痹大王燕等鸟宝可梦。
author: chibitales
source: These Pokémon are extremely defensive, lashing out at anything that they perceive as a threat. The pad on their head has thousands of small spines that deliver a venom potent enough to paralyze bird Pokémon like Swellow.

entry: POKENAME被视为矢车森林的祸患。吃完河藓，还会破坏藓生长的岩石，令河岸侵蚀加剧。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are considered a blight in Pinwheel Forest. After consuming river moss, they destroy the rocks it grew on, causing an increase in bank erosion.

entry: POKENAME埋在地下，只露出触角。触角被踩，就会注入毒液。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: POKENAME buries itself underground, leaving only its antennae sticking out. When stepped on, these antennae deliver venom.

entry: POKENAME向树枝上的猎物，吐黏稠蓝毒，将其打落。小猎物一接触，就可能麻痹。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spits a viscous blue poison at prey in branches to knock them down. For smaller prey, this venom can cause paralysis on contact.

entry: POKENAME的触角能察觉很大范围内的硬币。一有发现，就兴奋地四处疾跑，急着抢先捡走。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME's antennae can detect the presence of coins in a large radius. When it detects something, it will dart around excitedly, eager to scoop the coins up before anyone else.

entry: POKENAME呼噜时，毒素聚到尾尖。受威胁就猛甩尾巴，如同挥动毒链枷。
author: .izik
source: As POKENAME purrs, toxins gather at the tip of its tail. When threatened, it lashes out, swinging the tail like a poisoned flail.

entry: 头内的产毒腺，若造出太多毒却不排出，就会引发剧烈头痛。它被迫逮住能咬的东西，咬下注毒，缓解自己的疼痛。
author: sk372
source: The poison-creating glands residing in its head give it massive headaches if too much is produced without release. It is forced to bite and inject anything it can with poison to relieve its own pain.

entry: 这奇特的物种会产生轻毒，接触后，短暂起些无害的疹子，并有片刻灼痛。
author: rykona
source: This unusual species produces a mild toxin that causes temporary, harmless rashes and a brief, fiery irritation on contact.

entry: 分叉尾尖分泌强毒，也极其易燃。爪里分泌较弱的一种，可爪子本身已足够强，弱毒很少派得上用场。
author: infinex21
source: The twin tips of its tail secrete a potent venom that is also highly flammable. Its claws secrete a weaker variant of this venom, though their claws are strong enough that this weaker venom rarely serves a purpose.

entry: POKENAME尾上的绿火散发毒烟，实际却不算热。主要靠毒咬捕猎，若没能毒倒敌人，便迅速飞走。
author: .jerden
source: The green flame on POKENAME's tail produces toxic fumes, but doesn't actually burn that hot. POKENAME mostly relies on its venomous bite to take down prey and will quickly fly away if it fails to poison a foe.

entry: POKENAME全身覆着毒膜，碰触会刺激皮肤。若腹部花纹所在的位置被攻击刺破，就会分泌更猛烈的毒。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is covered in a toxic film which is irritating to the touch. If the pattern on its belly is punctured by an attack, it will secrete a more potent poison.

entry: 背壳格外致密，身体似乎也因此强健、肌肉发达。头上与壳上的触角，能察觉附近动静。
author: infinex21
source: The shell on its back is remarkably dense, which is seemingly why its body is so fit and muscular. The feelers on its head, and upon its shell, allow it to sense nearby movement.

entry: POKENAME的脚不停漏毒，积成一滩滩。饲养很棘手，毒液会毁坏地板与花园。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: POKENAME's feet constantly leak a poisonous substance in the form of a puddle. Caring for them is very tricky, as they can ruin both flooring and any gardens with this poison.

entry: POKENAME攻击性极强，向一切视作威胁的对象喷出轻度腐蚀性酸。适当蒸馏，却能用来做极酸的糖。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are incredibly aggressive and will spew a mildly corrosive acid onto anything it deems a threat. When properly distilled, this chemical can be used to make extremely sour candy.

entry: POKENAME埋进地里，用眉毛般的触角感受上方震动。察觉附近宝可梦，就连连挥拳，指节上的刺注入强毒。
author: secondegg
source: POKENAME buries itself in the ground, using its eyebrow-like antennae to detect vibrations above it. When it senses a Pokémon nearby, it punches them repeatedly, the stingers on its knuckles injecting a potent venom.

entry: POKENAME身体顶端有根柔韧尖刺，扎得很痛。两侧硬刺能感应磁场，用来辨路。
author: oddwalls
source: On top of its body, POKENAME has a flexible spike that delivers a painful sting. It navigates using the hard spines on each side, which sense magnetic fields.

entry: 它亮起绿色光纹，与其他POKENAME沟通，也会闪光扰乱对手，再施以电击。
author: oddwalls
source: It creates patterns of glowing green lights to communicate with other POKENAME. It also flashes the lights to disorient opponents before delivering an electric shock.

entry: POKENAME用尖喙刺穿厚树干，吃里面的小虫。可喙上覆着大量毒液，小宝可梦若被啄中，很危险。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME uses its pointed beak to pierce through thick tree trunks, feeding on the small insects inside. However, its beak is coated in large amounts of poison and can be dangerous if a small Pokémon is pecked by it.

entry: 这种宝可梦敲响双钳，靠回声定位与高触角，更好地感知周围。它用钳子，在溪河附近挖洞。
author: infinex21
source: By clacking its claws together, this Pokémon gets a better sense of its surroundings through echolocation and its tall feelers. It uses its claws to dig a burrow near streams and rivers.

entry: POKENAME身上交错着淡紫与栗红花纹，向天敌表明自己有毒。喜欢滚下山坡，翻滚的刺激令它肾上腺素激增。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a mixture of thistle and maroon markings on their bodies, which marks them as poisonous to potential predators. They enjoy rolling down hills because the physical sensation of rolling gives them an adrenaline rush.

entry: 除非被攻击或发现猎物，否则通常不动。移动会产生静电，储起后可放出十万伏特，静卧时电力却会散去。
author: infinex21
source: It is usually motionless unless attacked or unless it spots prey. When it moves, it generates static electricity which it can store and later loose as Thunderbolts; this electricity dissipates as it lies still.

entry: 密密的卷须在POKENAME周围结成螺旋壳，保护发育中的身体。藤蔓相当坚实，什么靠得太近，就会抽打过去。
author: sk372
source: Densely-packed tendrils form a swirled shell around POKENAME's body to protect it while it develops. These vines are quite solid, and can lash out and wallop anything that gets too close for comfort.

entry: 相对脆弱的双翼飞累了，它便倒着落地，滚轮般前进。翼缘比纤细的内部坚韧得多，经得住崎岖地面。
author: something_smith
source: Once it gets tired of flying on its relatively fragile wings, it simply lands upside down and wheels along. The edges of its wings are much tougher than the spindly inside, allowing it to withstand rough terrain.

entry: POKENAME能凭空变出隐形物体，只有腹部的眼睛看得见。POKENAME很喜欢圆形的东西，尤其着迷于旋转的动作。
author: kianjp2008
source: POKENAME are able to conjure invisible objects out of thin air that only the eye on their stomach can see. POKENAME are very fond of circular objects; they are especially interested in spinning motions.

entry: POKENAME甲壳沉重，动作不灵活，攻防却都很强。头与臂上的利刃尖端带毒，连双翼也尖得能伤人。
author: sk372
source: Though its weighty carapace gives it low agility, POKENAME has potent defenses and offenses. The blades on its arms and head are sharp and venom-tipped, and even its wings are pointed enough to cause damage.

entry: POKENAME头上的壳能打开，露出排排利齿。双角抓住猎物，拉进壳里吞食。
author: evilgammon
source: The shell on POKENAME's head can open up, revealing rows of razor-sharp teeth. Its horns grip prey, pulling it into the shell to be devoured.

entry: POKENAME滚下山坡躲天敌，再爬回原处吃叶。淡紫身体太显眼，一见天敌附近出没，便藏进灌丛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME roll down hills to avoid predators before crawling back to the same spot to eat leaves. Their mauve bodies make them easy to spot, so they hide in bushes whenever they see a predator nearby.

entry: 休息时也像车轮般蜷紧，毒刺蓄势待发。似乎只有蜕旧皮与鳞时，才肯展开身体。
author: infinex21
source: Even when resting, it is curled upon itself like a wheel with its venomous spikes primed. It seems to only uncurl when it sheds its old skin and scales.

entry: 蜷起能挡住大多数攻击，再滚向敌人强力反击。它积蓄大量进化能量，进化前夜，水晶球最亮。
author: infinex21
source: By curling upon itself, it can repel most attacks and deliver forceful counterattacks by rolling into enemies. It stores vast energy for its evolution, and its crystal orbs glow brightest on the eve of its evolution.

entry: 双翼看着小，却能飞得高、飞得久。它蜷成巨大刺轮，砸向敌人。
author: infinex21
source: Despite how small their wings seem, they can fly high and for long times. They crash down onto foes by curling upon themselves like a giant, spiked wheel.

entry: 化学反应在腹中产生剧毒，POKENAME用来狩猎或自卫。对人类而言，这毒足以致命。
author: chorb33
source: Highly toxic substances are formed in its abdomen through chemical processes. POKENAME uses this poison, lethal to humans, for hunting or defense.

entry: 它爱蜷成轮，滚下山坡或山脉，却不太顾及旁人。也会蜷身，用毒刺防御。
author: infinex21
source: It loves to curl up like a wheel and roll down mountains or hills, albeit with minimal regard for others. It will also curl up to defend itself with its venomous spikes.

entry: POKENAME背上喷火加速，滚过栖地，留下圈圈焦黑灌木。驾车者视它为速度象征，将其形象装在汽车引擎盖上。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME rolls through its habitat with burst of fire from its back to accelerate, leaving charred circles of undergrowth in its wake. Motorists have taken to it as a symbol of speed that they mount on the hood of their cars.

entry: 化学反应在腹中产生剧毒，POKENAME用来狩猎或自卫。对人类而言，这毒足以致命。
author: chorb33
source: Highly toxic substances are formed in its abdomen through chemical processes. POKENAME uses this poison, lethal to humans, for hunting or defense.

entry: POKENAME在极高处互扣脚爪，再一同坠地，测试壳的强度。这是野生个体受伤最常见的原因。
author: drcew
source: POKENAME will lock talons at extreme heights before plummeting back to the ground to test the strength of their shells. This practice is the most common reason for injury in wild POKENAME.

entry: 鼓胀腹部存着大量松散丝网，意外坚韧。POKENAME能蜷起大身体，借周身许多小钩，在墙壁与洞顶翻滚。
author: infinex21
source: Their bulbous abdomens are surprisingly sturdy due to the amount of loose silk webbing they store within themselves. POKENAME can curl upon their large bodies and roll along walls and ceilings due to many small hooks lining their bodies.

entry: POKENAME的爪尖，抓破皮肉就能注入强毒。它在空中缩成球，旋转弹开攻击，再躲远避险。
author: sk372
source: The tips of POKENAME's talons deliver a potent poison when they manage to scratch flesh. It tucks into a ball while airborne and spins to deflect attacks before seeking shelter away from danger.

entry: POKENAME通常一动不动地浮水，用感官探寻猎物，免得惊动。迷彩花纹让它难以察觉，能袭击毫无戒心的猎物。
author: grannyjojophone
source: POKENAME usually floats on water without moving, using its senses to try and find prey without spooking them. The camouflage pattern makes POKENAME hard to see, allowing it to lash out at unsuspecting prey.

entry: POKENAME常坐在泥泞河岸，吸着尾巴发呆。离水时全身覆着剧毒薄膜，这动作能增强它对其他毒素的抗性。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME can oftentimes be found sitting on a muddy riverbank while sucking on its tail, staring off at nothing. This action helps it build resistances to other poisons since, when out of water, its body is covered in a highly toxic film.

entry: POKENAME以恶作剧出名。它会躲在阴影中纠缠受害者，等待最佳的出手时机。项链上旋转的珠子拥有强大的催眠能力，能让受害者沉睡长达2周。
author: kianjp2008
source: Known for its mischievous pranks, POKENAME haunts victims from the shadows before it finds the perfect opportunity to strike. The spinning beads on its necklace have powerful hypnotic powers, able to put victims to sleep for up to 2 weeks.

entry: POKENAME从爪里分泌红毒，令人呕吐、发烧。一旦抓住，就不松开，直到液体完全流尽。
author: .izik
source: From its claws, POKENAME secretes a red toxin that induces vomiting and fever. Once latched on, it won't release until the fluid is fully drained.

entry: 平时慢慢爬，直到缩进壳，才能沿地面翻滚，迅速逃离天敌。
author: bostroms
source: It usually crawls around at a slow pace, until it ducks into its shell.  Then it is able to roll across the ground to quickly escape from predators.

entry: POKENAME双翼覆着能蚀穿岩石的毒。它捕食可可多拉，用强翼切开周围障碍，抓住猎物。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's wings are coated in a corrosive poison that can eat through stone. It preys on Aron, using its powerful wings to slice through the environment and catch its prey.

entry: POKENAME从唇间分泌强毒，用连番亲吻削弱敌人，再以角刺击。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME secretes a potent toxin through its lips. It weakens foes by peppering them with kisses before jabbing them with its horns.

entry: POKENAME胃口很大，总为猎物互相打架，用尖角找准对方厚甲的缝隙刺进去。
author: mistymagius
source: Due to their large appetites, POKENAME are constantly fighting with each other over prey. They will exploit the gaps in each other's thick carapace by jabbing their sharp horns into them.

entry: 看似形状笨拙的身体，其实是能缩进去护身的壳。缩起后，就能高速旋转移动，撞击敌人。
author: infinex21
source: What appears to be an awkwardly-shaped body is a shell that it can withdraw inside of to protect itself. While withdrawn, it can spin at high speeds to move about and to ram into foes.

entry: 动作间隙，POKENAME众多肢体会绕圈摆动。它从联网设备收集能量。
author: bobosmith01
source: Between distinct actions, POKENAME's many limbs trail around in a circular pattern. It collects energy from network-connected devices.

entry: POKENAME宁愿守候猎物，也不想追猎，便攀在树干侧面埋伏。潜在猎物靠近，它们就用笨重的身体压下，迅速以叶刃劈砍。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME prefer to wait for prey rather than hunt prey down; they lie in wait by clinging to the sides of trees. When potential prey draws near, they drop onto them with their bulky bodies and quickly slash at them with Leaf Blade attacks.

entry: POKENAME平时不动，进攻时却会蜷成球撞向敌人，接触的瞬间喷火，烧得地面焦黑，余火闷燃。
author: kriznick
source: While usually motionless, POKENAME form a ball to crash into opponents, spewing fire on impact. The resulting blaze leaves the ground scorched and smoldering.

entry: 它蜷成球，沿铺好的道路滚动，把车轮当对手，用长爪攻击。许多保险公司会承保POKENAME造成的损失。
author: bandedbodypress
source: It rolls into a ball and travels along paved roads. It perceives the tires of cars on the roads as rivals, and attacks at them with its long claws. Many insurance companies provide POKENAME protection.

entry: 它以一阵带毒踢击猛攻。野生POKENAME不打到自己或对手昏倒，绝不罢休；战得越久，越精神。
author: bobosmith01
source: It attacks with a flurry of poison-laced kicks. Wild POKENAME will not stop fighting until either it or its opponent faints; the longer the battle draws on, the more spirited POKENAME gets.

entry: POKENAME以不规则翻滚起舞，将毒液溅到地面。舞步划出了有毒、严加守卫的领地边界。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME dances in erratic tumbles, splashing venom across the ground. Its movements mark the edges of a toxic, defended territory.

entry: POKENAME的环状壳，有时害它绊倒，滚下坡。往返水坝时，能把空气存在壳里，增加浮力。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME sometimes trips and rolls down hills due to its ring-like shell. It can trap air in its shell for extra buoyancy when traveling to and from its dam.

entry: 构成POKENAME大部分身体的旋涡能量，会造出无形护盾保护眼睛。除非极危险，很少离开石头，省下能量，好更快完成进化。
author: sk372
source: The swirling energy comprising most of POKENAME creates an invisible shield that protects its eye. It rarely emerges from its stone unless in great danger, as it conserves energy so that its evolution will be completed faster.

entry: POKENAME用速度伏击小猎物。后触角排出积蓄的多余能量，免得追猎时过热。
author: oejoeboy33
source: POKENAME uses its speed to ambush smaller prey. The rear antennas release excess energy built up so POKENAME doesn't overheat while chasing its target.

entry: POKENAME常在湖岸歇息，与环境浑然一体，被误认成石头。口渴时才滚到水边，吓旁观者一跳。
author: kriznick
source: Often mistaken for stones, POKENAME rest by lakeshores, blending seamlessly with their surroundings. When thirsty, they roll to the water's edge, startling onlookers.

entry: POKENAME大部分时间在睡觉、攒能量。两个鼻子一闻到危险靠近，就收腿入体，滚向安全处。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME spends much of its time sleeping and saving energy. If its two noses catch a whiff of approaching danger, it tucks its legs into its body and rolls away to safety.

entry: POKENAME宁愿留在鞘里，尽量避战。迫不得已，就回旋挥刃，弹开攻击，也扰乱敌人。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME prefers to keep itself sheathed and avoid combat where possible. If forced, it strikes with swirling, circular swings of its blade that deflect attacks and disorient foes.

entry: POKENAME的嘴由多节构成，张开后，大得远超体型给人的预期。它的咬击带毒，能用来驱退敌人。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME mouths are formed of multiple segments, enabling them to open their mouths far wider than might be expected for a Pokémon their size. They have a venomous bite that they use to deter their foes.

entry: POKENAME有坚硬金属壳保护，内部机关从背炮发射尖刺，赋予毒性，或注入身体所装卡带提供的各种能量。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME is protected by a hard metal shell. Internal mechanisms fire out spikes from the cannon on its back, imbuing them with poison or with various forms of energy supplied by Drives that slot inside POKENAME's body.

entry: POKENAME蜷着等待进化，靠硬甲护身。受威胁便蜷得更紧，化作轮形，尾上燃起火焰与毒孢子，冲撞敌人。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME remain in curled positions while waiting for evolution, relying on their hard-plated shell for protection. If threatened, they coil further into a wheel shape and, while their tail blazes with fire and poisonous spores, ram into the foe.

entry: POKENAME大多一动不动。被命令行动，通常先摘下头，像打保龄球般滚向目标。若没中，身体就得游荡数小时找头。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME remain motionless most of the time. When commanded to act, they will usually begin combat by removing and bowling their head at their target. If the head misses the target, the body will wander for hours searching for it.

entry: POKENAME不怎么移动，想让护身的壳不至散架。壳若掉落，它就寻找绿毛虫的巢，用幼虫的黏丝，将壳重新粘牢。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME doesn't move much, as it wants to keep its protective shell from falling apart. If it does fall off, it will hunt for a Caterpie nest to use the larvae's sticky silk to stick its shell back together.

entry: POKENAME汗里有毒，碰到会刺激皮肤。它爱独处，滚去偏远地带，找安全地方睡觉，远离打扰。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME sweats a poison that irritates the skin of anyone who touches it. Preferring solitude, it will roll to remote areas to find a safe place to sleep, away from any disturbances.

entry: POKENAME其实是两只宝可梦，由不明力量连在一起。遇到威胁时，双方相互旋转摩擦，蓄足劲后放出储存的庞大能量攻击。
author: kianjp2008
source: POKENAME is actually two Pokémon held together by an unknown source. When threatened they will both begin spinning against each other to build up enough friction to release massive stored up energy attacks.

entry: POKENAME的花有桃桃果香，掩住危险。轻轻一碰，发烧的毒便会透皮侵入。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's blossoms emit a scent like Pecha Berries, masking their danger. A single touch can spread a fever-inducing poison through the skin.

entry: POKENAME的腿短短的，移动相当缓慢。需要加速时，它能侧过身来翻滚，不过这种移动方式，很难维持超过几秒。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's stubby legs make its movement quite slow. When it needs to go faster, it can turn sideways and roll, but this type of movement is difficult to maintain for more than a few seconds.

entry: POKENAME液体外层的圆纹，能随意移动。自卫时，核敲击圆纹，便迸出强劲的超能力脉冲。
author: sk372
source: The circular markings on the liquid exterior of POKENAME can be shifted around at will. For self-defense, the core strikes these circles, which send out pulses of potent psychic energy on impact.

entry: POKENAME快速旋转着，飘过森林上空，身后拖着毒。姿态优美，对下方生物却危险。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spins rapidly as it drifts through forest skies, trailing poison behind it. Its motion is graceful but hazardous to those below.

entry: POKENAME用轮状身体，穿过洞壁的小裂隙。它在全黑中捕猎，用毒角刺穿猎物。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME used its wheel-like body to traverse small crevasses in the cave walls. It hunts in pure darkness, impaling its prey on its venomous horns.

entry: 轮子般的脚让它时速最高可达六十英里。但多数时候，它只悠悠前进，节省体力。
author: staghorn
source: It can use its wheel-like feet to reach speeds of up to sixty miles per hour. Most of the time, however, it moves at a leisurely pace in order to conserve energy.

entry: 两只车轮球融合，让它更加稳当，速度也更快。可换来这些好处，也牺牲了几分灵活。
author: soup1900
source: It's a Whirlipede that fused with itself, giving it more stability and speed. However, it sacrificed some of its maneuverability for these boosts.

entry: 野生POKENAME会假扮寻找对战的暴走族。骑手只是伪装，诱近猎物后，就由车轮出击，将毒注入目标。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME can be spotted in the wild, blending in as other Bikers looking for a Pokémon battle. The rider is a facade and serves to lure prey close enough so that the wheels can strike, injecting poison into their target.

entry: 中央的大个子，是群体首领，四周的小个子负责载着它移动，模样就像一辆车。
author: soup1900
source: The big one in the middle is the leader of the pack. The small ones around it carry it around. They move around similarly to a car.

entry: POKENAME身上按奇异圆纹，长出红羽。磨成毒粉后，只有它能安全吃下。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME grows red feathers in strange circular patterns across its body. These can be ground into a poisonous powder that only POKENAME can safely ingest.

entry: POKENAME安静地待在林间，与环境相融。若受惊扰，就会猛冲过去，用黑暗能量诅咒入侵者。
author: kriznick
source: POKENAME remain still and serene in their groves, blending into the environment. If disturbed, they rush forward to curse intruders with dark energy.

entry: POKENAME大耳朵里的耳垢，毒得美容师必须戴手套。虽危险，仍得常清理，免得积聚。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's large ears produce an earwax so toxic that groomers must use gloves. Though dangerous, it must be cleaned often to prevent buildup.

entry: POKENAME常在重污染地带，从体内喷出团团毒雾。不过它吃有毒物质，有些人并不觉得讨厌。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is usually found in highly polluted areas, spewing clouds of smog from inside its body. However, since it feeds on toxic materials, some people don't consider it a nuisance.

entry: POKENAME柔如棉花的身体，蜷成轮滚过林地。毛里渗出恶毒，触碰便视线模糊。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME rolls its cotton-soft body across forest floors in a wheel-like form. A noxious poison seeps from its fur, causing blurred vision on contact.

entry: 眼睛长在手臂上，令它战斗时几乎看不见。只得胡乱挥动，希望用毒爪击中对手。
author: mistymagius
source: Due to its eyes being on its arms, it is basically blind during combat. To remedy this, it will blindly flail around in hopes of hitting its opponents with its poisonous claws.

entry: POKENAME头顶的眼能独立活动，别看模样，却有360度视野。若有东西想偷近，便引导它喷出孢子防御。
author: sk372
source: The eye atop POKENAME's head operates independently of the rest and possesses 360 degree vision despite its appearance. It helps POKENAME direct bursts of spores in defense should something attempt to sneak up on it.

entry: POKENAME最常见于热带雨林，能蜷成球移动。对付威胁有两招：蜷着碾过去，或平静地滚走。
author: bobosmith01
source: Most commonly found in tropical rainforests, POKENAME can curl into a ball to navigate around its environment. It deals with threats in two ways: plowing over them while curled up, or simply calmly rolling away.

entry: 坚韧身体，让它几乎什么地面都能滚。月光照上滚动的身体，便泛起金光，扰乱天敌。
author: bobosmith01
source: Its tough body allows it to roll across nearly any kind of surface. When the moon hits its body as it rolls around, it begins to glow a golden hue that disorients predators.

entry: 连崎岖不平的路，POKENAME也能滚过去。因此，在举办宝可梦拉力赛的地方，格外受欢迎。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME can even roll over uneven terrain. There are places where Pokémon rally races are held, where POKENAME is particularly popular.

entry: POKENAME无声滚过田地，守卫南瓜园。扭曲的藤蔓手臂，会向入侵者使出毒液冲击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME guards pumpkin patches by rolling silently through the fields. It strikes intruders with Venoshock from its twisting vine arms.

entry: POKENAME向池塘放毒，赶走外来者。毒不伤同类，伙伴之间能安心共游。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME releases a toxic substance into its pond to ward off outsiders. The poison harms none of its kin, allowing peaceful swims among allies.

entry: 尾巴蜷得越紧，尾火就越旺。它们用火焰或腐蚀毒，把猎物化成易于进食的糊。
author: infinex21
source: Their tail flames grow stronger the more they curl their tails up. Using flames or a corrosive toxin, they reduce their prey into a slurry that they can more easily consume.

entry: 谁靠近闪亮的宝藏堆，POKENAME就高速滚撞过去。带毒的毛，扎得灼痛。
author: .izik
source: If anyone nears its stash of glittering treasures, POKENAME rolls into them at speed. Its fur, laced with toxins, delivers a burning sting.

entry: POKENAME外层虽像硬壳，却得时刻护住腹中眼睛这处弱点。临近进化，身顶螺纹便开始旋动。
author: sk372
source: Though its shell-like exterior is sturdy, POKENAME must constantly shield its weak spot: the eye in its tummy. The spiral patterns on the top of its body begin to swirl when it nears evolution.

entry: 状态最好的POKENAME会追逐摩托车，向群体展示优势。常在体育赛事期间比赛，人们押注摩托或宝可梦哪方赢。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME in peak physical condition chases after motorcycles to show its dominance over its packmates. These races often occur during sporting events, where people bet on the motorcycle or the Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME围绕中心自由旋转、翻滚，很少停。组成它的三具身体也各自转动，整体看着催眠。
author: oddwalls
source: POKENAME rotates and tumbles freely about its center, rarely stopping. Because each of its three component bodies also spins freely, the overall effect is hypnotic.

entry: POKENAME催眠时，身上的圆纹发光。遇险便蜷成球，向四周放出超能力波，击退袭击者。
author: sk372
source: The circles on POKENAME's body glow when it uses its hypnotic powers. When in danger, it curls into a sphere and sends psychic waves all around it to repel aggressors.

entry: POKENAME用超能力让旅人产生幻觉，引入巢穴，再以强劲毒液冲击制服。
author: .izik
source: Using psychic powers, POKENAME lures travelers into its nest by causing delusions. Once inside, it subdues them with a potent Venoshock.

entry: POKENAME的角坚硬锋利，足以刺穿实心岩石，转起来却更危险。旋转搅动内部产毒器官，滴出致命毒液，几秒就能令受害者动弹不得。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's horn is sturdy and sharp enough to punch through solid stone, but becomes even more dangerous when rotating. Rotation stirs a poison-secreting organ within, making it drip with a deadly toxin that incapacitates a victim in seconds.

entry: POKENAME双翼覆着厚重强毒粉，降落野花丛，将其他虫属性宝可梦毒倒，独享花草。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's wings are covered in a thick and highly toxic powder. It descends on wild flower gardens, poisoning any other Bug-types so that it alone may feast on the flora.

entry: POKENAME常见于污染水域附近。既爱在污水里游，也吸收污染，留下清水。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME can be found near bodies of polluted water. Not only do they enjoy swimming in pollution, but they also absorb it, leaving clean water behind.

entry: 多边兽虽只被编入基本动作，POKENAME进入电子设备，却会令其他程序异常运作。战斗中，刺耳声也能使电子设备故障。
author: bobosmith01
source: Despite Porygon only being programmed with basic actions, POKENAME causes other programs to exhibit unintended behavior when inside of an electronic device. In battle, POKENAME can let out a Screech that can cause electronic devices to malfunction.

entry: POKENAME有两根栗红毒角，刺向想啄茧的鸟宝可梦。毒刺引发炎症，让天敌的脸肿胀鼓起。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have two maroon horns that sting flying bird Pokémon that try to peck at their cocoon. The venom from a POKENAME's stinger causes inflammation, which causes the faces of predators to puff up with swelling.

entry: 饱餐毒葛与毒蘑菇后，POKENAME静卧密林。有毒吐息会令人头晕、恶心。
author: .izik
source: After gorging on poison ivy and toxic mushrooms, POKENAME lies still in dense forests. Its toxic breath causes dizziness and nausea.

entry: POKENAME虽小，却极其好斗，用许多小爪扎住敌人，注毒击倒。每次蜕皮，鲜亮颜色就更分明。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are highly aggressive despite their small stature, digging many small claws into foes and injecting venom to fell them. Their vibrant colors grow more defined with every shedding cycle.

entry: 头角相当尖，藏着最强的毒。分叉尾尖之间的球，总泛着不祥紫光。
author: infinex21
source: The horn upon its head is rather sharp and contains its most potent venom. The orb between the pronged tips of its tail is always glowing with a sinister purple light.

entry: 它以惊人速度飞巡领地，入侵者无论大小，都凶狠驱逐。大多数敌人，会被分叉的毒尾尖刺穿。
author: infinex21
source: It flies around its territory at staggering speeds, brutally fighting off any intruders no matter their size. It skewers most foes upon the venomous, pronged tips of its tail.

entry: POKENAME体内的毒素，能从全身孔隙释放。哪怕只碰一下，也会中毒，痛苦难忍。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME produces toxins in its body, which it can release through pores all over its body. Just touching it leads to painful poisoning.

entry: POKENAME毒强又好斗，是爱较量的独行者，单只就能独占多达五英里的森林。虽危险，训练得当也能温柔友善。
author: nyoomymph
source: POKENAME is known to be highly toxic and highly aggressive. It is a competitive loner; a single individual can lay claim to up to five miles of forest. Despite the danger it poses, a trained POKENAME can be very sweet and kind.

entry: 看似在睡觉，可一察觉敌人，POKENAME就立刻行动。双角既撕伤对手，也集中超能力冲击。
author: imaginita
source: It may appear to be sleeping, but the moment it detects a foe, POKENAME will spring into action. It uses its horns both to tear into opponents and to concentrate psychic blasts.

entry: 这六肢猎手用体重压住猎物，颈边火领喷出耀眼赤红热浪。随后一击剧毒，令受害者的神经仿佛由内而外焚烧。
author: shivaequinox
source: This six-limbed hunter pins prey beneath its weight while the fiery ruff around its neck erupts in brilliant crimson heat. It delivers a strike so toxic that the victim's nerves feel as though they are being incinerated from the inside out.

entry: POKENAME速度快，适应大多数地形，常被训练成坐骑。性格也随和，尤其给沙鳞果、挠挠触角，很快就能与训练家亲近。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is often trained as a mount due to its high speed and adaptability to most terrain. It also has a very agreeable temperament, bonding quickly with its Trainer, especially if offered Salac Berries and antennae scratches.

entry: 头上的大角，坚固得能与独剑鞘交锋而不受损。吐出的紫丝网浸满麻痹毒，能迅速困住猎物与敌人。
author: infinex21
source: The large horn upon their heads is strong enough to clash with a Honedge without suffering damage. The purple silk webbing they can spin and weave is soaked thoroughly with a paralytic toxin that quickly immobilizes their prey and foes.

entry: POKENAME俯冲下去，用毒牙捕猎。阳光伤眼，因此拒绝白天飞行。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME divebombs prey with venomous fangs. It refuses to fly during the day as the sun hurts its eyes.

entry: POKENAME极其好斗，谁敢闯领地，便毫不犹豫俯冲。脚爪上的麻痹物质，让猎物无力逃走。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is extremely aggressive, diving without hesitation at anyone who dares enter its territory. Its talons are coated in a paralyzing substance that leaves prey unable to escape.

entry: POKENAME凶悍，借迷彩在水中狩猎。猎物一近，就用环状利齿猛咬，注入致命毒液。
author: grannyjojophone
source: POKENAME is highly aggressive, using its camouflage patterns to hunt in water. When prey wanders close, POKENAME lashes out with its ring of teeth, injecting the prey with deadly venom.

entry: POKENAME肢体上的绒球，装满微小毒种子。飞行时撒出，使猎物失去行动力。
author: .izik
source: The puffballs on POKENAME's limbs are filled with tiny poisonous seeds. It scatters them mid-flight to incapacitate prey.

entry: 它的角里有强神经毒，却也极脆。同类常打架，还会折下自己的角，作近战武器。
author: mistymagius
source: While its horns are filled with a powerful neurotoxin, they are also incredibly brittle. Fights often break between themselves, and they will break off their own horns to use as a melee weapon.

entry: 它贴在墙上，监看闯入者。一有动静，便飞扑而下，咬住对方，注入致命毒液。
author: skymaster426
source: It sticks to walls to keep an eye out for intruders. Whenever any enters, it flies down and bites any parts of their bodies, injecting a fatal poison.

entry: POKENAME夜里跳过森林，寻找毒蘑菇。受威胁时，角便爆开，喷出毒液。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME hops through forests at night hunting for toadstools. If threatened, its horns explode in a spray of poison.

entry: POKENAME尖端与双颚分泌的毒，能液化岩石，严重破坏金属。它吃地下深处的钻石、煤与其他固体。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's points and jaws secrete a poison strong enough to liquefy stone and cause serious damage to metal. It consumes diamonds, coal and other solid materials deep beneath the earth.

entry: POKENAME爬树采桃桃果，酿出的汁危险有毒。但烹煮得当，会变成美味糖浆。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME climbs trees to gather Pecha Berries. The juice it brews is dangerously poisonous, but when cooked properly, it becomes a delicious syrup.

entry: POKENAME利角渗出酸性毒，蚀穿树皮，方便吸食树汁。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's sharp horn leaks an acidic toxin that eats through bark. It uses this to access and consume tree sap.

entry: 按下POKENAME躯干的圆纹，就会漏出最猛烈的毒。战前涂满爪子，轻轻一划，就让敌人极度虚弱。
author: sk372
source: Pressing the circle on POKENAME's torso causes it to leak out the most virulent batch of its toxin. It coats its claws with this poison before battle, ensuring a single scratch will leave its foe extremely weakened.

entry: 据说一只蜈蚣王误滚进岩浆，身体部分熔化，却莫名幸存，才有了POKENAME。它情绪不快，周围气氛也跟着变坏。
author: weirdmageddonprepper_93813
source: It is said the POKENAME came into being when a Scolipede mistakenly rolled into molten magma, partially melting, yet somehow surviving. POKENAME has an unhappy disposition that ruins the mood of those around it.

entry: POKENAME用尖口器刺穿树皮，吸食树汁。被打扰便昂起身，拍动巨翼，吓唬打扰者。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have a sharp proboscis that they use to pierce through tree bark and feed on tree sap. When disturbed, they rear up and flap their gigantic wings to intimidate whatever interrupted them.

entry: POKENAME在袋口摆上散发甜香的零食，引诱小生物入袋。对方一靠近，它就合上装满毒物的袋子，将其困住，等待毒素生效。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME lures small creatures into its bag by putting sweet-scented treats at the entrance. Once they draw near, it closes the bag, which is filled with poisons, and traps them while the toxins take effect.

entry: POKENAME攻击时分泌的毒，被用于生产微芯片。毒能将数据分解成更易处理的形式，增加储存容量。
author: chibitales
source: The poison secreted by POKENAME's attacks is used in the production of microchips. The poison breaks down data into a more manageable form, allowing for increased storage capacity.

entry: POKENAME以惊人速度奔跃，有力腿肌让每一步都猛冲向前。借速度积起势头，再蜷成球，冲撞对手。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME prances at an astonishing speed, its powerful leg muscles sending it surging forward with every stride it makes. With this speed, it builds momentum, which is used when it curls into a ball and rams its opponents.

entry: 许多小腿，让它如蛇般迅速爬过几乎任何表面。它常从猎物上方垂下，用人脸花纹的大颈膜，吓得对方僵住，再扑过去。
author: infinex21
source: It has many small legs that allow it to crawl along nearly any surface at rapid speeds like a slithering serpent. It will often hang down from above prey and use their large frills with a face-like pattern to scare them stiff before lunging at them.

entry: POKENAME是蜈蚣王群中受信赖的雌性首领，负责照料新产下的百足蜈蚣蛋，视如己出。特别护蛋的个体，甚至用身体挡住危险。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are trusted matriarchs within Scolipede colonies, left in charge of freshly laid Venipede eggs. They care for the colony eggs as though their own, with some particularly protective POKENAME using their own bodies to shield them from harm.

entry: POKENAME坚硬的外骨骼，抵御恶劣天气与天敌。身体各处尖端还能注入强毒，进一步吓退想吃它的生物。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's hard exoskeleton keeps its body well-protected from the elements and predators. The various points of its body can deliver a potent toxin to additionally deter those that would try to make a meal of it.

entry: POKENAME腿虽短粗，动作却极快。一缠住猎物，就用双角不停攻击。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: Despite its short and stubby legs, POKENAME move extremely fast. Once they wrap themselves around their prey, they relentlessly attack with their two horns.

entry: POKENAME蜷成球撞果树，贪婪吃掉落果，常能吃下体重两倍的量。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME curls into a ball to ram into fruit trees. It greedily devours any fallen fruit, often eating twice its weight.

entry: POKENAME什么都吃，小猎物整个吞，较大的则用毒牙麻痹制服。电刺还能同时电击多个敌人。
author: oddwalls
source: POKENAME feeds indiscriminately, swallowing its prey whole or delivering a paralyzing toxin with its fangs to subdue larger quarry. Its electric spines can shock multiple foes at once.

entry: POKENAME灵活得惊人，几分钟就能从山脚爬到高峰。手中石块发射时，会裹上猛烈毒液，威胁更大。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is surprisingly mobile, able to scale up a tall mountainside from base to peak in mere minutes. The rocks it launches from its hands get coated with a terribly potent poison as they're fired, making them doubly dangerous.

entry: POKENAME脾气极差，谁敢进领地，就追谁。手臂能伸过50英尺，远远用毒爪劈砍对手，自己却安全。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is incredibly temperamental, pursuing anyone that dares enter its territory. It is able to stretch its arms over 50 feet, allowing it to slash its opponents with its poisonous claws from a safe distance.

entry: POKENAME蜷成球，既保护自己，也打出最致命的攻击。旋转撞敌时，毒角能刺得最深。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME roll up into balls to protect themselves, yet also to deliver their deadliest attacks. While rolled up, they can best deliver deep strikes with their venomous horns by spinning into their foes.

entry: 不知为何，POKENAME对其他多边兽融合体格外凶悍。臂上小刺先钩住，再毒咬，毒性强得近乎酸蚀。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is highly aggressive towards other Porygon fusions for unknown reasons. It latches onto them with small barbs on its arms before delivering a venomous bite so potent it is almost acidic.

entry: POKENAME用毒爪精准劈砍，打倒目标。没被劈倒的，再由沉重尾巴猛击。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME fell their targets with precise slashes using their toxic claws. Anything that does not succumb to their slashes is beaten down with strikes from their heavy tails.

entry: POKENAME是极其高明的猎手，藏在泥里等待猎物。哪只宝可梦走得太近，它便从藏身处跃出，按住猎物，注入致命毒液。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME are extremely proficient hunters, waiting in the mud for their prey. Once a Pokémon wanders too close, POKENAME will jump out of its hiding place, pinning down its prey and injecting it with a deadly venom.

entry: 前臂的彩刺，带着强神经毒，高剂量下近乎能消除记忆。身体虽笨重，强大超能力却让它动作灵便。
author: infinex21
source: The colorful spikes on its forearms carry and deliver a potent neurotoxin that borders on being an amnestic in high doses. Despite its bulky body, it can move rather well thanks to its noteworthy psychic power.

entry: POKENAME聪明又凶悍，通过角注入毒液，便能用心灵感应影响猎物行动。
author: sanguinenebula
source: POKENAME are highly intelligent and aggressive predators. Their poison, injected through their horns, allows them to telepathically influence the actions of their prey.

entry: POKENAME极爱独处，只许少数信任的对象作伴。烦扰者先被超能力定住，尖刺轻轻一碰，便中了毒。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME greatly prefers to be left alone, only allowing the company of a select few it trusts. Nuisances are held in place by psychic powers before being poisoned by just a touch from its spines.

entry: POKENAME照顾被遗弃或孤苦无依的虫属性与毒属性宝可梦。独特身体，让它在战场上展现惊人敏捷。
author: t3isukone
source: POKENAME takes care of Bug and Poison Pokémon who have been abandoned or are alone in the world. Its unique body allows it to perform incredible feats of agility on the battlefield.

entry: POKENAME每次现身，身体都散出大量毒雾。天性凶悍，若自然散出的雾够不到目标，就喷出更集中的雾，送往远处。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's body emanates large amounts of toxic mist whenever it manifests. Aggressive by nature, if the passive fog it generates can't reach a target, it breathes out a concentrated mist that travels much farther.

entry: POKENAME身上长的黄叶，是强效药方的材料。可惜性情凶猛，几乎不可能安全采到。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: The yellow leaves that grow on a POKENAME are used in a powerful remedy. Unfortunately, due to its aggressiveness, safely acquiring the leaves is near-impossible.

entry: POKENAME是极凶悍、领地意识极强的虫属性宝可梦，以惊人速度冲向对手。尾巴边分泌强毒、边猛烈甩动，力道足以击裂树木。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are highly aggressive and territorial Bug-type Pokémon that charge down their opponents with startling speed. They secrete a potent poison from their tails as they swing them around with enough force to crack a tree.

entry: POKENAME领地意识极强，会斩伤、毒害一切闯入者。即使敌人逃出领地，也会追击不休，直到将其杀死。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME is fiercely territorial, slicing and poisoning any and all invaders. Even those who flee its territory are continuously pursued until slain.

entry: 利刃每一寸都覆着致命毒，能消灭整窝宝可梦，每只要么一击倒下，要么不久后毒发。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Every inch of its blades is covered in a deadly poison. It will take out entire dens of Pokémon, each one falling in a single blow or shortly after.

entry: 紫甲如铠，既能保护，又不妨碍迅捷动作。POKENAME在双角之间蓄电，向对手释放强大闪电。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its purple carapace protects it like armor without limiting its swift movements. POKENAME charges electricity between its two horns before unleashing powerful lightning bolts at opponents.

entry: 肢体与尾巴尖端分泌强毒。这虫属性宝可梦一振翼，便响起诡异曲调，撒下毒鳞粉。
author: infinex21
source: The sharp tips of its limbs and tail secrete a potent toxin. The wings of this Bug-type Pokémon emit an eerie tune as they scatter poisonous scales whenever flapped.

entry: 满身刺、颜色暗沉，飞速掠天的模样，让多数人恐惧。其实POKENAME只是享受自由飞行的畅快。
author: imaginita
source: With its spikes and dark coloration, most people are terrified to see this ominous Pokémon speeding through the sky.  In truth, however, POKENAME is simply enjoying the exhilarating freedom of flight.

entry: POKENAME花里产出的香蜜，毒性极强。毫无戒心的猎物喝下，会渐渐失去行动能力。
author: mepp.
source: The fragrant nectar POKENAME produces in its flowers is highly toxic. Unsuspecting prey that drinks from them slowly lose the ability to move.

entry: 初看，POKENAME头上像有两大束头发。其实是额外的肢体，长刺，战斗中又灵活无比。
author: dylonk25
source: At first glance, POKENAME appears to have two large strands of hair on its head. These are actually extra limbs, spiked and highly maneuverable in combat.

entry: 战斗时，POKENAME全身长出小毒蘑菇。成功闪开攻击，便会撒出毒花粉。
author: .izik
source: During combat, tiny toadstools grow all over POKENAME's body. It spreads poisonous pollen when it successfully dodges an attack.

entry: 月光明亮的夜里，POKENAME会渗毒汗，再甩向天敌，将其赶走。
author: .izik
source: During nights with prominent moonlight, POKENAME's body leaks a poisonous sweat. It flings this sweat at predators to drive them away.

entry: POKENAME曾被用来拉战车，参与带打斗的竞速。毒刺与旋转肢体，让它成为这古代竞技的绝佳伙伴。近来有人尝试复兴比赛。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME were once used as draught Pokémon, pulling chariots in combative races. Their venomous stingers and rotating limbs made them perfect partners for the ancient sport. There have been recent attempts to revive this old competition.

entry: POKENAME满身倒刺，扎得灼热疼痛。研究者正尝试改用它的毒，制作快速治疗失温的药。
author: femaledog
source: The barbs covering POKENAME deliver a painfully hot sting. Research is underway to adapt its poison for a fast-acting cure for hypothermia.

entry: 深夜，POKENAME滚过地道寻猎物，突使毒尾，迅速压制受害者。
author: .izik
source: Late at night, POKENAME rolls through its tunnels seeking prey. It strikes with a sudden Poison Tail to quickly overwhelm the victim.

entry: 谁公开嘲笑歌艺，POKENAME就会吐毒报复。触角位置能看出心情；往后拉，就表示准备攻击。
author: fiordaliso
source: If someone openly insults its singing abilities, POKENAME gets revenge by spitting venom at them. The position of its antennae indicates its mood: when they are pulled back, it is preparing to strike.

entry: POKENAME用体内分泌的毒作颜料，在城墙画奇怪符号。若被抓到，就胀起身体显得更大，威吓想赶它的人。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME stains city walls with strange symbols, using the venom secreted from its body as paint. If caught in the act, it inflates itself to appear larger and intimidate anyone trying to chase it away.

entry: 被踩时，POKENAME迅速用双角刺入，注射致命毒。若不管用，就用角夹住对方，反复翻动身体，将其摔向地面。
author: soup1900
source: Whenever it is stepped on, POKENAME will quickly react and stab the victim with its two horns, which inject a lethal poison. If ineffective, it will instead clasp them with its horns and slam them into the ground by flopping repeatedly.

entry: POKENAME总带着蜕皮，既作护盾，也当钝器。若丢了，就藏起来，等能再蜕出一层。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME constantly carries around its shed skin to use as both a protective shield and a blunt weapon. If POKENAME ever loses it, it hides away until it can create a new shed skin.

entry: POKENAME似乎正处于达到最终进化形态的关口。这个过渡形态不够灵活，毒性与攻击性却达顶峰，靠近极危险。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME appears to be on the crux of achieving its final evolutionary stage. In this transitive form, it lacks full mobility, but its toxin and aggression levels are at their peak, making it very dangerous to approach.

entry: 融合后，POKENAME身体伸长，多出许多腿。宝可梦研究者与古生物学家合作，判定它恢复了数百万年前的体形。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME lengthen and grow many extra legs following the fusion process. In collaboration with palaeontologists, Pokémon Researchers have concluded that POKENAME revert to a body form from millions of years in the past.

entry: POKENAME睡着时，角上会长出小毒叶。它爱在潮湿腐烂的树桩休息。
author: .izik
source: As POKENAME sleeps, tiny poisonous leaves sprout from its horns. It prefers to rest on damp, rotting tree stumps.

entry: 这双足虫宝可梦先用超能力迷惑对手，再用大爪劈砍。常摆威吓姿势，赶走袭击者，也节省力气。
author: infinex21
source: This bipedal bug Pokémon uses its psychic abilities to entrance its opponents before slashing at them with its large claws. It often assumes an intimidating stance to deter aggressors and conserve its own strength.

entry: POKENAME栖居森林，身上刺目的颜色，便是对闯入者的警告。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME resides in forests. Its harsh colors are a warning to trespassers.

entry: POKENAME的蘑菇几乎一直颤抖，身体同时漏出微小毒孢子，接触会引发抽搐。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's mushroom is almost always quivering. During this time, small toxic spores leak from its body that can cause convulsions on contact.

entry: POKENAME最恨触碰，谁想摸，就猛烈挣扎。个子虽小，却跑得比多数职业运动员快。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME hates being touch and will thrash around violently if anyone tries to pet it. Despite its small size, it can run faster than most professional athletes.

entry: POKENAME藏在南瓜田，等落单农夫。等只剩对方一人，就用毒液陷阱浇透，再藏起，看对方挣扎。
author: .izik
source: Hiding in pumpkin patches, POKENAME waits for lonely farmers. When alone, it soaks them with Venom Drench and hides while they struggle.

entry: 它夜里飞过森林，双眼如雷达般搜寻。POKENAME一发现猎物，就从远处射出麻痹的毒。
author: chorb33
source: It flies through forests at night, its eyes acting like a radar. If POKENAME spots prey, it shoots it over long distances with a paralyzing poison.

entry: 这些极凶悍的宝可梦，用爪与火开路，追逐敌人或猎物。疲惫时尾火渐弱，恢复期间，便靠灼痛毒液防身。
author: infinex21
source: These highly aggressive Pokémon will use their claws and their flames to create a path in pursuit of their foe or their prey. Their tail flames peter out as they tire, so they will rely on their burning venom to defend themselves as they recover.

entry: POKENAME只为战斗而活，时刻为下一仗训练。老个体的爪刻满无数旧战伤痕，因此很容易分辨老幼。
author: moose1._.
source: POKENAME live only to battle, always training for their next fight. This makes it easy to tell young and old POKENAME apart, as the latter's claws will be marked by the scars of their countless past battles.

entry: 古老经文称POKENAME为虫中之神，相信它能用威猛的长嚎，号令蝗群。
author: gurguro
source: Ancient scripture declares POKENAME to be a god amongst insects, commanding locusts with its mighty howl.

entry: POKENAME飞过时，用燃烧的尾巴点着树木与高草。火将猎物赶到空地，再俯冲用毒角攻击，还得小心别被自己的火烧伤。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME uses its burning tails to set trees and tall grass on fire as it flies past. Once the flames drive prey out into the open, POKENAME swoops in to attack with its poisonous horns, taking care not to burn itself in the fires it creates.

entry: 尾尖分泌易燃毒液，能甩出有毒火球攻敌。四条强腿加上有力身体，让它能与怪力势均力敌地搏斗。
author: infinex21
source: The tips of its tail secrete a flammable venom, which it uses to fling toxic fireballs at foes. With its four strong legs and muscular body, it can grapple with a Machamp on equal footing.

entry: POKENAME藏在阴影里等猎物。一入范围，就用藤蔓上的爪状突起钩住，注入甜香毒液。
author: imaginita
source: POKENAME hides in the shadows, waiting for prey to approach.  Once one gets in range, it uses the claw-like protrusion on its vine to snag the prey and inject a sweet-smelling venom.

entry: POKENAME身上的火，将强毒散进空气。野生群体会绕猎物成圈奔跑，窒息烟雾很快便能制服对方。
author: bandedbodypress
source: The flames on POKENAME release powerful toxins into the air. Wild POKENAME swarms will gallop circles around their prey, while their choking smoke makes quick work of them.

entry: POKENAME很凶，常主动与其他鸟宝可梦打架。它的大葱洗净后，酸味很浓，常与面条十分相配。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are very aggressive, often starting fights with other bird Pokémon. Once properly cleaned, its leek has a strong sour flavor that often pairs well with noodles.

entry: POKENAME每个头都有不同毒液。三个头同时攻击，确保至少一种能奏效。
author: linhasxoc
source: Each of POKENAME's heads uses a different type of venom. It attacks its prey with all three heads, ensuring that at least one will be effective.

entry: POKENAME以恐惧为食，造出催眠摆锤，让中招者以为自己被毒虫围攻，再享用幻象带来的惊恐。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME feasts on fear. It creates hypnotic pendulums that causes those afflicted to hallucinate being swarmed by poisonous insects, letting it feed on the terror created from this illusion.

entry: POKENAME用强腿沿海岸与崖壁急追猎物。钳中酸能熔穿金属，进食之处，都留下腐蚀灼痕。
author: eiskitsune
source: POKENAME scuttles with relentless speed, using its powerful legs to chase down prey along shorelines and cliffs. Its claws secrete an acid potent enough to melt through metal, leaving scorched trails wherever it feeds.

entry: 大钳内分泌腐蚀毒，常用来将植物、树果化成方便迅速吞食的糊。巨钳挥动，力道足以击碎一棵树。
author: infinex21
source: A corrosive toxin is secreted from within its largest claw, which it oft uses to melt down plants and berries into a quickly-consumed slurry. It can swing this oversized claw with enough force to shatter a tree.

entry: POKENAME用小而利的爪爬树，再用强颚吃叶。重躯若跌下枝头，坚皮也让它很少受伤。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME uses its small but sharp claws to climb trees, then devours leaves with its powerful jaws. If its heavy body falls off a branch, its skin is so tough that it rarely takes any damage.

entry: POKENAME吃其他猎手剩下的残食，骨头留着啃。平时胆小，戴上头骨，却有了反抗敌人的勇气。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME eats scraps left from other hunters' meals, keeping the bones to chew on. Ordinarily timid, wearing a skull over its head instills it enough bravery to fight back against its foes.

entry: POKENAME的软身体，有实心岩壳保护。大多一动不动，受威胁便张开强颚，咬靠得太近的生物。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's soft body is protected by a shell of solid rock. While it mostly remains motionless, if anything threatens POKENAME, it will open up its powerful jaws to bite anything that gets too close.

entry: POKENAME常绕其他宝可梦飞，似乎享受被追。薄岩片组成的翼，坚硬又有锐边，常不小心撞伤旁人。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME often flies in circles around other Pokémon, and seems to enjoy being chased. Its wings are made of thin pieces of rock and are hard with sharp edges, so POKENAME often carelessly injures other Pokémon by colliding with them.

entry: POKENAME振翼，撒出细石粉，吸入会咳嗽。它吃花，却不吸蜜，而是将所有花瓣吞下。
author: .jerden
source: When POKENAME flaps its wings, it scatters a fine rocky dust that causes coughing when inhaled. It feeds on flowers, but will swallow all the petals rather than drink the nectar inside.

entry: POKENAME用强颚咬碎水下拦路的大残骸，也用来捕猎。腿虽小，却强得能从湖底弹出水面，抓住鸟宝可梦。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME use their strong jaws to bite apart any large underwater debris in their way and to catch prey. Although their legs are small, they are strong enough to launch themselves from the bottom of a lake into the air to grab bird Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME娇纵黏人，要求训练家全心陪伴，寸步不离。给骨头啃，倒能暂时转移注意。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is spoiled and clingy, demanding that its Trainer lavish it with all their attention and never leave its side. It can be distracted for a time by offering it bones to chew on.

entry: POKENAME用咬来确立权威。羊毛储存的静电，传入双颚，增强雷电牙。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME bites other Pokémon to enforce its authority. Its wool stores a static charge that is channeled to its jaw to power its Thunder Fang attacks.

entry: 孵化后，POKENAME最多能不吃东西赶路一个月，生长比其他宝宝暴龙融合体迟缓许多。它亲人，可训练家进化时得小心，之后会十分危险。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: After hatching, POKENAME travel for up to a month without eating, greatly stunting their growth compared to other Tyrunt fusions. They are very friendly to people, though Trainers must be careful when evolving them, as they become very dangerous.

entry: 外形像伊布，凶猛常被忽略，令POKENAME十分烦躁。受挫时，可能仰望月亮，寻求指引。
author: theaceofhearts0306
source: Due to their Eevee-like figure, POKENAME can be incredibly irritable, as their ferocity is often overlooked. When in states of frustration, POKENAME may look to the moon for guidance.

entry: 古老岩层里的POKENAME化石，排出毫无意义的词句。许多古生物学家认定，它们生前只是自然聚集，并非想传信息。
author: .izik
source: Fossils of POKENAME have been found spelling out nonsensical phrases in stones from long ago. Many paleontologists have determined that they simply grouped together naturally rather than attempting to convey any message during their lifecycles.

entry: POKENAME娇纵自私，得不到想要的东西，就破坏性地闹脾气。尾巴像年幼手足，一觉得被忽略，也会胡闹。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME is spoiled and selfish, throwing destructive tantrums when it doesn't get what it wants. POKENAME's tail behaves like a younger sibling, acting out when it feels like it isn't getting enough attention.

entry: POKENAME群体靠战斗选首领。性格傲慢又输不起，有些群体争首领的时间，比捕猎还多。
author: sk372
source: The leader of a POKENAME pack is decided by combat. Because it is arrogant and a sore loser, some packs spend more time fighting over leadership than hunting.

entry: POKENAME头上三张嘴，按心情开口叫。心情越差，张嘴喊的就越多。性格任性，几乎从不安静。
author: sk372
source: The three different mouths on POKENAME's head open and cry in accordance to its mood; more mouths will open and shout as its mood worsens. Because it has a bratty personality, it's almost never silent.

entry: 它虽然嘴巴很大，却只能吐出小小的火焰，喜欢将大块食物含在嘴里，慢慢烤熟。烦躁时，它会展开尾羽，对着空气咬合，威吓旁人。
author: infinex21
source: Though it has a large mouth, it can only breathe out small flames; it loves to hold large foods in its mouth and roast them with these flames. It fans out its tail feathers when agitated and bites at the air to intimidate others.

entry: POKENAME生活在1亿年前。人们推测，安抚心绪的花，是它抵御更危险天敌的手段。
author: notsaying.
source: Living 100 million years ago, POKENAME's calming flower is theorized to be a defense mechanism against more threatening predators.

entry: POKENAME发怒，就容易忘记壳有多宽，撞坏周围建筑。有时装饰背石，能让它冷静下来。
author: elevn.
