source: When a POKENAME gets angry, it tends to forget the width of its shell and damages the structures around it. Decorating the rock on its back can sometimes calm it down.

entry: 它将储下的热传到颚上，咬出灼热力道。产热需要时间，这期间极其脆弱。
author: evilgammon
source: Transferring its stored heat into its jaw, it bites down with searing force. It takes a while to generate this heat, making it very vulnerable during the process.

entry: POKENAME的刃看着弱，实为强劲牙齿，轻易就能碾穿实心金属板。虽能浮起，却更爱单脚跺地，每走一步，就胡乱刺出弯刃。
author: soup1900
source: While POKENAME's blade looks weak, this powerful tooth can easily crush and puncture through solid metal sheets. While it can float, it prefers to stomp with its singular foot and thrust its curved blade wildly with each step.

entry: POKENAME用古老、部分石化的刃，带着原始怒气挥砍。可刃极钝，击中也只能留下浅浅抓痕。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME uses its old, partly fossilised blades in battle, slicing with a primal fury. The blades are extremely dull, only managing to lightly scratch those they hit.

entry: 它爱咬硬物磨牙。年龄增长，颚越来越强，旧时磨牙的东西，终究都会被咬碎。再强的龙属性宝可梦，它也爱挑战。
author: infinex21
source: It loves to teethe on hard objects, though its jaws become stronger with age, and so it will inevitably break whatever it once teethed on. It loves to test itself against Dragon-type Pokémon, no matter how much stronger they may be.

entry: 据说POKENAME是古代宝可梦遗骸，被附身而成。常在化石挖掘处吓退考古学家。
author: actliux
source: POKENAME is said to be the possessed remains of an ancient Pokémon. It can frequently be seen at fossil dig sites scaring off archaeologists.

entry: POKENAME用特殊颜色的蜡与火，装出更凶悍的样貌，吓退天敌。甚至能张“嘴”喷火，让伪装更加逼真。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses specially-colored wax and its flame to put on a more fearsome appearance to scare away predators. It can even open its "mouth" to breathe fire and further sell the facade.

entry: 人们曾推测，POKENAME在古时是某种收魂者，用古宝可梦的灵魂作燃料发动火攻。如今看来，天然石油与煤也是很好的替代燃料。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME was theorized to be a sort of reaper in ancient times, using the souls of ancient Pokémon to fuel its fire attacks. However, natural oil and coal now seem to serve as great alternative fuel sources.

entry: 它向闯入者吼叫时，内脏会涌出来，进一步吓唬对方。可事后想收回去，又很吃力。
author: sk372
source: When it roars at trespassers, its innards spill out in a threat display done to further frighten the target. It has a difficult time retracting its innards back afterward, however.

entry: 它任性自私，认定想要的东西本就属于自己。为了拿到，连金属表面也能用上颚撕开。
author: sk372
source: It is petulant and selfish, believing anything it wants rightfully belongs to it. It can tear open even metal surfaces with its upper jaw in order to get to something it desires.

entry: POKENAME披着宝宝暴龙伪装，想用双颚撕咬，欺负其他POKENAME。可伪装材料太软，咬击完全无效，也伤不了谁。
author: sk372
source: Using a Tyrunt disguise, POKENAME attempts to bully other POKENAME by biting them with its jaws. Due to the soft material comprising the disguise, these bites are entirely ineffective and harmless.

entry: POKENAME没有眼睛，主要靠嘴感知环境，什么都咬。可双颚太强，破坏也因此无休无止。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Lacking eyes, POKENAME primarily uses its mouth to feel around its environment by biting everything. Its jaws are so powerful, however, that the rampant destruction it causes is endless.

entry: 科学家用挖掘中找到的一片化石鳞，复活了POKENAME。嘴如钢夹，前面有什么，就不假思索咬下。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME was revitalized by scientists using one of its fossilized scales recovered during excavation. Its mouth works like a steel trap, biting down on anything in front of it without a second thought.

entry: 组成POKENAME身体的两枚齿轮，靠电磁力相连，彼此却极其厌恶。不停争夺齿轮控制权，想证明自己强过死对头。
author: evilgammon
source: Both of the gears that make up POKENAME's body are held together by electromagnetism. They are extremely resentful of each other, constantly competing to control the gear and prove their might over their bitter rival.

entry: POKENAME部分石化的结构，能极好地抵御大多数攻击。旋转能射出石块，甚至将副齿轮如锯片般发射。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME's partially fossilised structure makes it extremely durable against most attacks. It can fire off chunks of rock as it spins and even launch its secondary gear like a sawblade.

entry: POKENAME爱跺步装凶，却胆小得可笑。水边尤其如此，只要可能弄湿，连零食与抚摸都不肯接受。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME enjoys stomping around acting like an intimidating presence, but it is comically cowardly. This is especially true when it is near water, as POKENAME will refuse treats or petting if there is a chance it gets wet.

entry: POKENAME咬各种食物时，躯干周围的绒毛常沾满碎屑。耳朵也能碾碎东西，力气虽不及颚，却一样危险。
author: pixlhoopa
source: The fluff that surrounds POKENAME's torso often catches many crumbs from when it bites down on various foods. Its ears can be used to crush items with a force weaker than its jaw, yet just as dangerous.

entry: POKENAME用强颚咬住猎物，再喷出灼热火焰，热得足以熔穿铁。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME bites down on prey with powerful jaws, then blasts searing flames. Its fire burns hot enough to melt through iron.

entry: 它比普通的宝宝暴龙更加成熟，外貌也更接近1亿年前的样子。
author: mr.person__prinplup_enjoyer
source: It is more mature than a normal Tyrunt. It also looks more similar to how it looked 100 million years ago.

entry: POKENAME体形巨大、力量强，举止却仍任性粗鲁。非要人宠，若被忽略，就闹破坏。
author: sk372
source: Despite POKENAME's great size and strength, it still behaves in a bratty and uncouth matter. It insists on being pampered, and goes into quite the destructive tantrum if ignored.

entry: 强得不可思议的双颚、利齿与凶性，让普通钓法都留不住它，难以钓起。有志收服的训练家，若在水中见到POKENAME，最好联系有关部门。
author: radiance8990
source: Equipped with unbelievably strong jaws, sharp teeth, and a vicious temperament, no conventional fishing method can hold them long enough to catch them. Aspiring Trainers are advised to contact authorities if a POKENAME is seen in the water.

entry: POKENAME讨厌触碰，谁靠近就想攻击。刺其实是尖石，一碰皮肤，就会断在里面。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME hates being touched and will try to attack anyone that gets near it. Its spines are actually sharp stones that will break off in the skin on contact.

entry: POKENAME爱在沙里装成普通化石，等人查看，再昂身怒吼，吓跑对方，因此在考古学家间名声不佳。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME likes to camouflage itself as a simple fossil lying amongst the sand, before rearing up and roaring to spook away those who investigate it. It has a poor reputation among archeologists because of this.

entry: POKENAME特别爱啃骨头，或许是基因里刻下的古老本能。给什么硬零嘴，都一直啃到碎；提前拿走，对自己的健康可没好处。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME has a strong affinity for chewing on bones, likely due to ancient instincts ingrained in its genes. It will keep chewing on any provided hard treat until it shatters; removing the treat beforehand is an unhealthy idea.

entry: POKENAME化石常与大得多的宝可梦化石一同出土。古生物学家推测，它寄生在大宝可梦身上，用强颚咬穿厚皮，吸取能量。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME fossils are often found alongside those of much larger Pokémon. Palaeontologists theorise that they would parasitise larger Pokémon, using their powerful jaws to bite through thick skin and drain their energy.

entry: POKENAME会粗声喷鼻，从毛孔放蒸汽威吓。野外对手比谁一次喷的烟最多，来确立优势。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME will gruffly snort and emit steam from its pores as a threat display. Rivals in the wild will compete to see who can blow the most smoke at once to establish dominance.

entry: POKENAME睡着完全不动，满是坑洼的岩身，常被当成坠落的太空岩石。被打扰便瞬间醒来，扑咬碰它的任何东西。
author: eiskitsune
source: When asleep, POKENAME remains completely still, its rocky, cratered body often mistaken for fallen space rock. If disturbed, it awakens instantly, lunging out to bite anything that touches it.

entry: 尾巴捕到东西，它便将猎物丢到面前，得意吼叫。吼完却把狩猎忘得一干二净，任猎物逃回水里。
author: sk372
source: When its tail catches something, it drops the prey in front of it and roars at it in triumph. After roaring, it forgets about the hunt completely, allowing the prey to escape back into the water.

entry: POKENAME两部分甲胄，形似头骨碎片，带着微弱磁性。中央身体指挥另外两部分，用尖刺将对手夹住攻击。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: The two parts of POKENAME's armor are built to resemble parts of a skull and contain subtle magnetic charges. The central body helps direct the other two as they work to trap and attack opponents between their spikes.

entry: POKENAME的两个头不停争夺主导，飞着也会互咬、低吼。虽不和，捕猎时却本能地合作。
author: eiskitsune
source: POKENAME's two heads are locked in a constant struggle for dominance, often biting and growling at each other mid-flight. Despite their rivalry, they work together instinctively when hunting prey.

entry: POKENAME拼命保护背上的蛋，谁近就跟谁打。若真打破蛋，它便凶狠扑向你。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME protects the egg on its back with its life, fighting anyone who gets near. If you manage to break the egg, POKENAME will violently lunge at you.

entry: POKENAME虽小，吼声却强大，咆哮的音爆足以将卡比兽掀上空中。
author: sk372
source: Despite its small stature, POKENAME packs a powerful roar. The sonic boom created from its bellowing cry has enough force to send a Snorlax airborne.

entry: 野外见到POKENAME，最好别招惹。它不合群、易暴怒，爆炸般的怒吼，足以彻底摧毁一栋楼。
author: sk372
source: If one spots a POKENAME in the wild, it is highly advised to leave it alone. Antisocial and volatile in nature, its angry and explosive roar packs enough power to obliterate a building completely.

entry: 这些小宝可梦戴着大化石头骨的上半部，常因此失去平衡。头骨也够大，能当家，让它们蜷进去安全休息。
author: infinex21
source: These small Pokémon don the upper halves of a large fossil's skull, even though it often throws them off-balance. These skulls are actually large enough to also serve as a home for them to curl up into and remain safe as they rest.

entry: POKENAME力量强大，斗志不屈，绝不肯放弃战斗。野外对手之间的拳赛，能不间断地打上数天，才决出胜负。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's strength and fighting spirit is indomitable. It absolutely refuses to give up a fight, and boxing matches between rivals in the wild can go on for days without end before a victor is decided.

entry: POKENAME跑起来，伪装会滑稽地晃来晃去。如今作为体育赛事的逗趣吉祥物，越来越受欢迎。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME wears a disguise that flops about comically whenever it runs around. It is becoming quite popular in modern times as an entertaining mascot at sporting events.

entry: POKENAME用伪装模仿怪颚龙，以强吼吓人。等对方吓够了，又从伪装跳出来，嘲笑那惊恐模样。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses a disguise to mimic a Tyrantrum and scare others with mighty roars. Once the victim is properly terrified, it pops out of its disguise and laughs at their frightened state.

entry: POKENAME能将牙加热到极高温，咬出灼伤。大尾也能精准射出燃烧石块，将飞行对手击落。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME can heat its fangs to extremely high temperatures, allowing for scalding bite attacks. It can also shoot out flaming chunks of rock from its large tail with extreme accuracy, knocking flying opponents out of the air.

entry: POKENAME三条尾巴各能碎石，强颚让猎物无从逃脱。太容易暴走，多数人主张一见就收服，免得自然遭不可逆破坏。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's three tails can each shatter boulders, and their jaws are strong enough to keep any prey from escaping. Due to how prone they are to rampaging, most consider them catch on sight to prevent irreversible damage to nature.

entry: POKENAME一认定某树属于自己，别的小虫哪怕想啃一片叶，也会被凶猛赶走。小小的领地怒吼，让小虫宝可梦胆寒。
author: sk372
source: Once a POKENAME has claimed a tree as its own, it viciously fends off any other small insects trying to nibble even a single leaf. Its tiny territorial roar strikes fear into the heart of small bug Pokémon.

entry: 野生POKENAME飞翔山脉上空，常与同类厮斗，见什么动就攻击。凶猛战斗，甚至迫使航班改变飞行计划。
author: quackquackattack
source: Wild POKENAME is known to soar above mountain ranges, and regularly fights others of its kind. Its ferocious fighting causes changes to flight plans, as the Pokémon indiscriminately attacks anything that moves.

entry: POKENAME是凶猛猎手，游在猎物栖居的冰水里。背上坚壳，能安全载着幼崽，从一岸渡到另一岸。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is a fierce predator that swims in icy waters where its prey lives. The sturdy shell on its back is used to carry its young safely from one shore to another.

entry: POKENAME是庞大史前生物，被视为空中的顶级猎手之一。能滑翔极远，从山顶住处下来捕猎，每次俯冲，都重创整群宝可梦。
author: sk372
source: A massive prehistoric being, POKENAME was considered one of the apex aerial hunters. Able to glide massive distances, it would descend from its home atop the mountains to hunt, devastating entire herds of Pokémon with each swoop.

entry: POKENAME贪食，一次吞下大量食物，直到肚子胀满。想抢它的饭，被视为鲁莽愚蠢到了极点。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a greedy glutton, gorging on massive amounts of food at once until it is bloated and full. Trying to steal a meal from it is considered the height of foolish recklessness.

entry: POKENAME精于飞行，在崖壁与岩沿巡视，寻找猎物。锁定目标，便跃下俯冲，用强颚夹住猎物身体。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: Mastering the art of flight, POKENAME uses cliffs and ledges to scan its environment for prey. Once it has found a target, POKENAME will leap from its perch and divebomb its prey, clamping down on their body with its powerful jaws.

entry: POKENAME不够灵活，却以力量弥补，强颚轻易碾碎大多数岩石。不过性情温和，只有受威胁才攻击。
author: fireblade141
source: What POKENAME lacks in agility, it makes up for in strength, as its powerful jaws can easily crush most rocks. However, it has a gentle demeanor and will only attack if threatened.

entry: POKENAME自认强大统治者，想征服遇上的一切宝可梦。能改变吼声音调，激起听者本能的臣服欲。
author: sk372
source: Thinking itself a powerful ruler, POKENAME attempts to subjugate any other Pokémon it comes across. It is able to change the tone of its roars to trigger an instinctive instinct to submit in whatever Pokémon it bellows at.

entry: POKENAME使出火属性攻击后，用尾刃刮掉牙上烟灰，也磨利刀刃。战斗越久，刃越热，最终烧红着劈敌。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME sharpen their tail blades by scraping soot from their teeth after using Fire-type attacks. The blade gradually heats up as they battle, allowing them to slice at foes with red-hot ferocity.

entry: 脚大得不成比例，让POKENAME飞不好，宁愿地上走。小喙满是利齿，轻易撕开虫属性宝可梦的外骨骼。
author: kam_doodle_snek
source: POKENAME prefers to travel on the ground, as it cannot fly well due to its disproportionately large feet. Its small beak is filled with sharp teeth that easily shred through the exoskeleton of Bug-type Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME先用有力身体缠敌，再以巨颚猛咬。它爱钻软土、蜷在地下，安静休息几个小时。
author: msdawgs
source: POKENAME coils its powerful body around foes before striking with its massive jaws. It enjoys burrowing through soft earth and curling up underground, where it can rest undisturbed for hours.

entry: POKENAME极易过热，只能在冷环境生存。它以巨力堆起小丘，投下长影，好尽量久地待在阴凉里。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME can only survive in cold conditions, as it is very prone to overheating. It uses its great strength to construct small hills that cast a long shadow so that it can stay in the shade for as long as possible.

entry: POKENAME模样威严，想暴君般统治沼王等宝可梦。可脑子简单，实际也不过在泥家园里跺来跺去，不停吼叫。
author: sk372
source: With its imposing appearance, POKENAME aims to rule as a tyrant over Quagsire and others of its ilk. Because of its simple mind, in practice this just amounts to stomping around in their muddy home and roaring a lot.

entry: 强颚肌能夹紧猎物，造成重伤。牙太强，只得用金属等硬物磨短，在人口密集的城市成了祸患。
author: chibitales
source: Their strong jaw muscles allow them to clamp onto prey, inflicting major damage. Due to the strength of their teeth, these Pokémon are forced to file them down on hard materials like metal, which makes them nuisances in populated cities.

entry: POKENAME吃岩石，以及大部分组成地层的物质。常在地下深处，慢慢边啃边走，造出长隧道。
author: camtft
source: POKENAME feed upon rocks and most of what makes up the ground. They are commonly far below the surface, slowly munching their way through, creating long tunnels.

entry: POKENAME独自狩猎，敢追逐体型是自身五倍的猎物。骨质大颚强劲，足以把猎物肢体撕开。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are solitary hunters and will go after prey five times larger than itself. Their bony jaws are strong enough to rip its prey limb from limb.

entry: 有人认为，太空陨石撞上古宝可梦并融合，才成了POKENAME。分析岩石科学价值很高，可它谁也不许碰壳。
author: sk372
source: Some believe that POKENAME is the result of a meteor from space impacting and merging with an ancient Pokémon. Analyzing the rock would have great scientific value, but POKENAME allows no one to touch its shell.

entry: 古代的POKENAME是凶悍、令人畏惧的猎手。电流遍及骨架，连牙也带电，猎物伤处常留有特有焦痕。
author: leandermalurt
source: In ancient days, POKENAME were fierce and feared predators. An electric current runs through their skeletons, even reaching their teeth. Prey hunted by them often bear signature scorch marks left at the site of the attack.

entry: POKENAME独来独往，独自奔过大地，寻找高处，发出雷鸣般噼啪怒吼。发怒时，背与颚上的白毛变得如乌云般黑，雷电攻击也增强。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is solitary, racing alone across the land to find a high location where it unleashes crackling roars like thunder. When angered, the white tufts on its back and jaw turn dark like storm clouds and its lightning attacks are enhanced.

entry: 据说最早的POKENAME，在极遥远的古时，从星球熔融地核中孵出。每次隆隆吼叫，都喷出能将一切烧成灰的火焰与岩浆。
author: sk372
source: It is said the first POKENAME hatched from within the planet's molten core eons ago. With every rumbling roar, it launches a gout of flame and magma capable of burning anything away to ash.

entry: POKENAME游历世界，净化看见的所有脏水。谁污染水，就用巨大强颚攻击。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: POKENAME travels the world purifying any dirty water it sees. If it sees anyone polluting water, it will attack with its gargantuan, powerful jaws.

entry: POKENAME是可怕的顶级猎手，在山腹挖洞。强劲石尾一砸地，就会引发毁灭性山崩。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is a terrifying apex predator that burrows caves in the heart of mountains. When it slams its powerful stone tail against the ground, it causes devastating landslides.

entry: POKENAME是可怕的顶级猎手，在山腹挖洞。强劲石尾一砸地，就会引发毁灭性山崩。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is a terrifying apex predator that burrows caves in the heart of mountains. When it slams its powerful stone tail against the ground, it causes devastating landslides.

entry: POKENAME张扬又霸道，甩动尾巴，欺负一切比自己小的对象。谁若想反抗，它就用带电的尾巴猛拍地面，发出震耳的雷鸣，威吓对方。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a bombastic bully of a Pokémon, swinging its tail about to push around anything smaller than it. It intimidates those who try to fight back by smacking its tail on the ground while electrified, making a mighty thunderclap.

entry: 研究发现，颊色不同的POKENAME储电能力较低，似乎也比平常更凶，弥补这弱点。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME with alternative cheek colors have been noted to have lesser electrical capacity. Its behavior seems to be more aggressive than normal to compensate for this weakness.

entry: POKENAME曾是古代世界最致命的刺客。无敌双颚能刺穿一切材料，吸干任何猎物的血。
author: h0bojoe
source: POKENAME was the deadliest assassin in the ancient world. Its invincible jaws can pierce any material, allowing it to drain the blood of any prey it hunts.

entry: POKENAME是极快又敏捷的猎手，能跳起攀住猎物，将其打倒。小宝可梦往往远离它的丛林领地。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: POKENAME is an incredibly fast and agile predator, able to jump and cling to its prey to take it down. Smaller Pokémon tend to stay away from its territory in the jungle.

entry: POKENAME的巨爪，挖泥与凿石一样轻松，以惊人速度开地道。等猎物察觉它正钻过来，已经太迟。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's massive claws let it dig through dirt and solid stone with equal ease, tunneling through the ground at breakneck speeds. By the time prey notices it tunneling its way towards them, it's already too late.

entry: POKENAME曾因高超的武艺备受尊崇。它的利爪像镰刀盔的双镰一样锋利，出拳则像战槌龙的冲锋一样有力。
author: nellnast42
source: POKENAME was once revered for its martial prowess. Its claws are sharp as a Kabutops's scythe, and its blows as powerful as a Rampardos's charge.

entry: POKENAME极护训练家，来者须在战斗中证明资格，才许靠近。训练家常得费力管住这习惯，亲友才能正常来往。
author: sk372
source: Fiercely protective of its Trainer, POKENAME won't allow any to approach them unless they have proven worthy in combat. It is often a chore for a POKENAME Trainer to curb this tendency so friends and family can interact with them normally.

entry: POKENAME收起双腿，就能短暂浮在空中，却很快又砸回地面。它通常会正好砸在猎物身上，将其压住，再抬起身体，用强健的双颚咬下。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME can briefly float in the air by tucking in its legs, but will quickly crash back down to the ground. POKENAME usually does this right on top of prey, pinning it to the ground, then lifting itself up again to bite with its powerful jaws.

entry: POKENAME从古宝可梦骨骸中现身，极善恐吓。雷鸣般怒吼，连最勇敢的宝可梦都要迟疑。
author: sk372
source: Emerging from within the skeletal remains of ancient Pokémon, POKENAME is a master at intimidating others. It manifests itself with a thundering roar that can give even the bravest Pokémon pause.

entry: 它们是背负整个生态系统的庞然巨兽。为了满足巨大的养分需求，常把丰饶的森林，糟蹋得一片狼藉。
author: bobsterbot
source: Titanic beasts with ecosystems on their backs. To satiate their heavy need, they often ravage forests for the abundance of nutrients within them.

entry: POKENAME头部前方坚固无比，几乎无法击穿。史前时，便能承受体形大得多的宝可梦的攻击。
author: dukefrogpeasant
source: The front of a POKENAME's head is incredibly sturdy and nearly impossible to break through. This allowed them to withstand hits from Pokémon that were far bigger than them in size during prehistoric times.

entry: 研究者曾把POKENAME化石碎片误认作头盖龙未知的进化，尤其因那圆顶头骨。可带刺的颈领，最终证实它是完全不同的物种。
author: quackquackattack
source: Researchers once misidentified POKENAME fossil fragments as a previously unknown evolution of Cranidos, especially because of their dome skull. However, POKENAME's spiky ruff allowed researchers to confirm they are an entirely separate species.

entry: 人们认为，POKENAME的攻击性在古代无可匹敌。研究化石与地理后，有人相信，整座山都曾被它暴怒冲锋撞成碎片。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's aggression is thought to have been unparalleled in the ancient world. Research into fossils and geography has led some to believe entire mountains were smashed to bits by its raging charges.

entry: POKENAME强颚几乎什么都能吃，优先吃最近的东西。因此，其他宝可梦总设法避开它伸出的手臂。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's powerful jaws enable it to devour almost anything. It will prioritize eating whatever is closest, so other Pokémon make sure to keep away from its outstretched arms.

entry: POKENAME视其他宝可梦为臣民，认为都需更强的顶级存在保护。与它相对的王者靠近时，这份保护本能便尤为必要。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME considers all other Pokémon as its subjects, needing to be protected by a stronger apex being. Its protective instinct is well-needed when its kingly counterpart is near.

entry: POKENAME是数百万年前的古代猎手，一口能吞数百磅食物。
author: nyoomymph
source: POKENAME is an ancient predator dating back millions of years. It can consume hundreds of pounds of food in one swallow.

entry: 洞穴壁画显示，已知最古老的文明，或许曾将POKENAME奉为毁灭神。画上它只一声巨吼，便使世界各地遭灾。
author: sk372
source: Cave drawings suggest that the oldest known civilizations may have worshiped POKENAME as a destructive deity. The drawings depict it causing cataclysms across the world with a single bellowing roar.

entry: 背上的苔藓与树木，酷似数百万年前灭绝的植物。基因检测却表明，只是现生植物的变异品种。
author: staghorn
source: The moss and trees on its back resemble plants that went extinct millions of years ago. Genetic testing has revealed these plants to merely be mutated variants of present-day flora.

entry: 动作虽僵硬，爪子却强得能轻易撕开树木。鼻孔喷气，听起来像低吼。
author: sk372
source: Though its movements are stiff, its claws are strong enough to tear apart trees with ease. When it expels air through its nose, it sounds like a low roar.

entry: 它用强爪掘进硬土，藏入地下，伪装成石造物。猎物一来，便突然破土而出，将其吞食。
author: chorb33
source: It digs itself into hard soil with its strong claws and masquerades as a stone structure in order to shoot out of the ground to eat its prey.

entry: 古老部族的骑士，曾挥舞POKENAME，进行壮观战斗。据传，如今仍有这传统。
author: kiwiarms
source: Knights from an ancient tribe would wield POKENAME in spectacular battles. Rumors say this practice continues into the modern day.

entry: 锯齿状的刃，一旦劈进猎物，就极难拔走POKENAME。扎住后，便等猎物昏倒，再完成捕猎。
author: kiwiarms
source: Its serrated edge means that it's extremely hard to remove a POKENAME from its prey once it slashes them. Once in place, it waits for its meal to pass out then finishes the job.

entry: 一则著名中世纪故事中，背信骑士挥舞着POKENAME。野生个体则夜里无声漂过丛林，捕猎大目标。
author: mepp.
source: A famous medieval story featured POKENAME being wielded by a treacherous knight. In the wild, the Pokémon drifts silently through jungles at night as they hunt for large prey.

entry: POKENAME领地意识强，自认高过遇上的一切宝可梦，不臣服就动武。雷鸣般怒吼一出，巨大石身便噼啪迸出电火花。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is a territorial creature that considers itself superior to every Pokémon it encounters, resorting to force if they refuse to submit to its will. Its massive stone body crackles with electric sparks the moment it lets out a thunderous roar.

entry: 皮肤是钻石鳞，外覆厚厚的超硬岩层。最老的个体尤其明显，数百年的暴力厮斗磨损岩层，周身露出闪光。
author: epping_forest
source: Its skin is made of diamond scales covered by a thick layer of ultra-hardened rock. This is most visible in the oldest specimens, due to erosion caused by hundreds of years of violence and aggression, revealing glistening flashes all over its body.

entry: POKENAME沿火山山脉划出大弧飞行，吐息能熔石。曾以蛮力暴政地表，如今将同样恐惧带上天空。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME flies in sweeping arcs across volcanic ranges, its breath capable of melting stone. Once a tyrant that ruled the surface with brute strength, it now brings the same fear to the skies above.

entry: POKENAME在野外，试图强登任何群体的顶端。除了凶性与巨力，触角一碰，也能让对方畏惧臣服。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME attempts to force itself to the top of any hierarchy in the wild. Aside from its aggressive demeanor and great strength, its feelers will cause those touched to be instilled with a sense of fear and submission towards it.

entry: POKENAME是残暴的暴君，意图让一切臣服于力量与统治。只有女王般的另一方在场，才管得住它。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a brutal tyrant of a Pokémon intent on subjugating all others beneath its power and rule. The only way to keep it in check is with the presence of a queenly counterpart.

entry: POKENAME在栖居山地，常对其他宝可梦发号施令。不肯服从的，便会与它争斗。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME are known to boss around other Pokémon in the mountainous regions they live in. They commonly get into disputes with other Pokémon that defy their rule.

entry: 有人见POKENAME在废品场潜行，暴怒时碾碎残骸。因身高，可能被误认作坏掉失控的电动角色人偶。
author: femaledog
source: POKENAME have been spotted prowling junk yards, crushing debris in fits of anger. Because of their height, they can be mistaken for broken animatronic characters gone haywire.

entry: POKENAME能召来太空陨石攻敌。幸而陨石大半在大气中烧尽，才没再引发物种大灭绝。
author: musicsheep.
source: POKENAME can call forth meteors from space to attack its opponents. The meteors mostly burn up in the atmosphere, preventing another mass extinction event.

entry: 原本被认为灭绝的POKENAME，近来在烘烘沙漠被发现。研究者得知，它藏在沙里捕猎，等目标靠近，电击后拖入沙下。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: Originally thought extinct, a POKENAME was recently discovered in the Asado desert. Researchers have learnt they hunt by waiting in the sand, when prey wanders close, POKENAME shock them before dragging them into the sand.

entry: 巨大的力量与凶性，让POKENAME被视为古代星球最顶尖的猎手之一。对手争地盘，常毁掉大片土地。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME was considered one of the highest apex predators of the planet in ancient times due to its titanic strength and vicious temperament. Battles between rivals for territory would leave large swaths of land completely destroyed.

entry: 没经允许碰POKENAME任何一条尾巴，在它看来都是不可饶恕的冒犯。它会横跨整个地区，追个不停，只为碾碎玷污者。
author: sk372
source: Touching one of POKENAME's tails without permission is an unforgivable offense in its eyes. It will chase a perpetrator unceasingly across entire regions just to crush them for defiling it.

entry: POKENAME的战斗技巧虽尚未成熟，小看它却会犯下大错。石头般的双颚，足以让粗心大意、放松警惕的家伙吃苦头。
author: fiordaliso
source: Although its fighting techniques are not yet fully developed, it would be a mistake to underestimate POKENAME. Its stone jaws are capable of causing trouble for anyone who is careless enough to let their guard down.

entry: POKENAME趴着假装骨骸，等倒霉猎物靠近，便突然行动。骨头坚如钢，即使打散，很快也能重组。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME lies prone, pretending to be mere skeletal remains until hapless prey wanders near and it springs into action. Its bones are as solid as steel, and even if it were knocked apart, it would reform itself shortly.

entry: 这种巨大、鲨鱼般的宝可梦，早已被认为灭绝。不过，一些记者相信，POKENAME仍活在深海沟底。
author: nellnast42
source: A massive shark-like Pokémon long thought to be extinct. However, some journalists believe POKENAME still reside deep in ocean trenches.

entry: POKENAME身体是石化木，白毛团是棉絮般的种子，会引发恐怖幻觉。它跟踪中招者，吸食恐惧，等迷路旅人放弃，再吃身体。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME's body is petrified wood and the white tufts are made up of cotton-like seeds which cause frightening hallucinations. It stalks those afflicted while feeding on their fear, finally eating the body once the lost traveler gives up.

entry: POKENAME用穿地声波，探测最爱的食物小碎钻。发现后，挖出藏身个体，再用强颚咬开壳。
author: turron_turron
source: POKENAME use ground-penetrating sound waves to detect their favorite food, Carbink. When they find one, POKENAME will excavate the hidden Carbink and crack through the shell using their powerful jaws.

entry: POKENAME能拆解身体，强行覆住其他宝可梦，从各方向碾压。它不停狂暴捕猎，只为随时都有想吃的所有肉。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME can disassemble its body and forcefully cover it over other Pokémon to crush them in every direction. It continuously hunts prey in savage rampages to have all the meat it could ever want to eat at all times.

entry: POKENAME讨厌洗澡，尽量避开流水。非打磨不可，也都自己来，还小心别磨钝石身的尖端。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME dislike bathing and avoids moving water whenever possible. When they must polish themselves, they do so all on their own; they take care not to sand down any sharp parts of their rocky body.

entry: POKENAME罕见，难以研究自然行为。研究显示可能结群捕猎，可事后不分食，而是彼此打架，决定谁能吃。
author: bobosmith01
source: Due to their rarity, researching the natural behavior of POKENAME has proved difficult. Studies have suggested they are pack hunters. However, instead of sharing the prey afterwards, they each fight one another to see which gets to eat.

entry: POKENAME罕见，难以研究自然行为。研究显示可能结群捕猎，可事后不分食，而是彼此打架，决定谁能吃。
author: bobosmith01
source: Due to their rarity, researching the natural behavior of POKENAME has proved difficult. Studies have suggested they are pack hunters. However, instead of sharing the prey afterwards, they each fight one another to see which gets to eat.

entry: 许多人称POKENAME为摇滚之王。强劲歌声配上狂放舞蹈，表演到高潮，便砸碎吉他与周围地形，展现无匹力量。
author: soup1900
source: Called the kings of rock by many, POKENAME combine their powerful singing with their wild, thrashing dancing. At the climax of their performances, they smash their guitars and the surrounding terrain to display their unmatched power and strength.

entry: POKENAME的甲片能承受重创，反而寻找强到能伤它的对手。冠状头冠终生生长，标示族中优势。
author: pjporwoll
source: The armored plates of POKENAME can withstand immense damage, so it seeks opponents strong enough to hurt it. The crown-like crest on its head grows its entire life and indicates superiority within the species.

entry: POKENAME住在火山山脊，凶猛守卫领地。入侵者一现，便怒不可遏，张口喷出热焰。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME lives in volcanic ridges, fiercely defending its domain. When an intruder appears, it spews hot flames from its mouth in a fit of rage.

entry: POKENAME吉他的强力和弦，雄浑轰鸣，近一英里外都能听见。超能力将声音送出，不插音箱，也能弹出电吉他的音色。
author: hophoppip
source: The power chords from POKENAME's guitar are roaringly sonorous, ringing out for nearly a mile. It uses psychic powers to project the sound, and as such, its guitar sounds electric without needing to be plugged into speakers.

entry: POKENAME住在老间歇泉，用利爪挖掘下方岩面，吃过去喷泉活动留下的二氧化硅覆层，强健甲壳。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are known to reside in old geysers, their sharp claws excavating the rocky surfaces beneath them. They consume the old silica coating left behind by old geyser activity, which strengthens their shell.

entry: POKENAME凶猛保护土地及其中宝可梦，残忍撕咬闯入者。可腿短粗，常跌倒，还很难起身。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is a fierce protector of its land and the Pokémon in it, brutally mauling any trespassers. However, due to its short and stubby legs, it often ends up falling over and struggles to get back up.

entry: POKENAME自古就是恶名昭彰的不良分子，欺压整群宝可梦服从。两只交战，角上鳞片四散，胜者会捡败者的鳞，添上披风。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Infamous delinquents since ancient times, POKENAME bully entire herds of Pokémon into following their commands. When two POKENAME clash, they scatter scales from their horns, with the winner adding the loser's scales to their cape.

entry: POKENAME拉起宽松的皮肤，跺响地面，宣示自己的地位。展示过后，谁仍不肯给予应有的尊重，它就会试图用双颚将其撕碎。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME pulls up its loose skin and stomps the ground as a gesture of dominance. It will attempt to use its jaws to tear apart anything that doesn't show it the proper respect after this display.

entry: 古时天空满是灰，帮助POKENAME筑壳，数量远比现在多。它以惊人速度坠落，留下宽逾50英尺的熔融坑。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME was a lot more common in ancient times, as all the ash in the skies helped to build up its shell. It falls from the sky at tremendous speeds, leaving molten craters over 50 feet wide.

entry: POKENAME领地意识极强，谁进入空域，就从天上击落谁。吃小陨石，在陨石被大气烧尽前，能咬多少口就咬多少。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is incredibly territorial, knocking any Pokémon that enters its airspace out of the sky. It feeds on small meteors, getting as many bites in as it can before the meteor burns up in the atmosphere.

entry: POKENAME穿过满是化石琥珀的洞穴。自己没力气挖土，便沿地鼠留下的道前行，囤积大量琥珀。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME travel through caves lush with fossilized amber, they follow the paths Diglett have left behind, since they don't have enough strength to move the earth by themselves. POKENAME build vast hoards of this amber.

entry: POKENAME被1亿年前撞击世界的陨石记忆困扰，回声永不消退。压力令它失控，放出压倒性的超能力波。
author: ._term.
source: POKENAME is haunted by the echoing memory of the meteor that struck the world 100 million years ago. The stress triggered from this everlasting echo results in the emission of uncontrolled, overwhelming psychic waves.

entry: 古时，POKENAME的超能力无可匹敌，便像国王般行事，念力能压碎整辆车。科学家认为，古人以它们携带的琥珀工具为原型，造出汤匙。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: In ancient times, POKENAME's psychic powers were unparalleled, leading them to behave like kings. POKENAME could crush entire cars with their psychic abilities. Scientists believe that ancient people based spoons on the amber tools they carried.

entry: POKENAME扯倒整棵树，只为从树干取一段，制成坚棒。用棒威吓、欺凌弱者，让它们臣服于巨力。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME tears down entire trees just to fashion a part of the trunk into a sturdy club to wield. The club serves as a way to intimidate and bully lesser creatures into submitting to its immense power.

entry: POKENAME咬敌人时，牙常容易脱落。发生后，几分钟就能长回。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's regularly teeth fall out easily when they bite into a foe. Should this occur, more regrow within minutes.

entry: 流氓利用POKENAME的巨力与强颚，骚扰其他训练家，控制某些道路。因能一次碾碎多辆自行车，自行车道不鼓励使用它。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Due to their immense strength and powerful jaws, Hooligans use POKENAME as a way to harass other Trainers and maintain control of certain Routes. Because they can crush multiple bicycles at once, they are discouraged from being used on Cycling Road.

entry: POKENAME虽是这般体形，咬力却足以压皱金属。闯领地者，都会遭它张合双颚威吓。
author: cait_sith
source: Despite its size, POKENAME can bite with enough force to crumple metal. It snaps its jaws threateningly at any intruders in its territory.

entry: 研究认为，POKENAME交配与每年蜕石壳的时节相合。化石记录显示，蜕下的石被拿来筑巢，保护脆弱幼崽。
author: sk372
source: According to research, POKENAME's mating habits coincided with its yearly shedding of its stone shell. Fossil records indicate the shed stones were used to nest the vulnerable young.

entry: POKENAME最高速度普通，腿力却比外表强得多。先重踢昏大得多的敌人，再怒吼放出火浪，将其烧熟。
author: sk372
source: Its top speed is mediocre, but POKENAME's legs are deceptively strong. It stuns much larger foes with powerful kicks, then fries them with a bellowing roar that releases a wave of flame.

entry: POKENAME虽懒，领导力却强，仁慈统治栖身海洋。战斗时用超能力将自己头朝前砸向对手，事后便会头痛。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: Despite their laziness, POKENAME have great leadership skills, benevolently ruling over the oceans they reside in. In battle POKENAME throw themselves headfirst at their opponents using psychic power; this leaves them with headaches after fighting.

entry: 它常被误认成掉进焦油坑的怪颚龙。猎物存进焦油状的身体后，会花上一周慢慢消化。
author: celio_0230
source: This Pokémon is commonly mistaken for a Tyrantrum that fell into a tar pit. It stores prey within its tar-like body, digesting them over the course of a week.

entry: POKENAME的水炮只能单发，无法形成连续水流，威力却极其凶猛。一发水流，就能径直贯穿整片山壁。
author: sk372
source: Though POKENAME's water cannon can only fire in single shots rather than a constant stream, these blasts of water are viciously powerful. A single shot of water from it can pierce straight through an entire mountainside.

entry: POKENAME进化出明确阶序：一个头主导，另一个不情愿地默默服从。这份不安稳的平衡，却能让它完美配合，打出毁灭性攻击。
author: eiskitsune
source: POKENAME has evolved with a clear hierarchy - one head now leads while the other follows in grudging silence. This uneasy balance allows it to unleash devastating attacks with perfect coordination.

entry: POKENAME把腰带当离洞绳逃出洞穴，也用来攀绳下崖，尽管滚下去明明更轻松。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME uses the band around its waist like an Escape Rope to flee caves. It also rappels down cliffs with it, even though it could easily roll down instead.

entry: POKENAME从骨头发射寒冷雪团，减缓或冻住敌人。有些冰激凌商贩靠它保冻，省了冷柜。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME fires chilling bursts of snow from its bone to slow or freeze foes. Some ice cream merchants rely on it to keep their stock frozen without a freezer.

entry: 拳套坚如岩石，摸着冰冷。寒冷地带，常能看到野生POKENAME成群切磋。
author: ichosuzu
source: Its boxing gloves are as hard as rocks and feel cold to the touch. Groups of wild POKENAME can be seen sparring with each other in cold areas.

entry: POKENAME的唾液冷得一碰就冻住皮肤。同一处多舔几次，连大生物也能冻得动不了。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's saliva is cold enough to freeze skin on contact. If it licks the same spot multiple times, even large creatures can be immobilized.

entry: 这些漂浮宝可梦展示胸前雪花标志，在同类间宣示优势。POKENAME活得越久，雪花结构越复杂。
author: infinex21
source: These floating Pokémon brandish the snowflake symbol upon their chests as a show of dominance amongst their kind. The longer-lived a POKENAME is, the more complex the structure of this snowflake will be.

entry: POKENAME不停发抖，暖处也一样。戴帽子止不住抖，却能让它开心许多。
author: bagumbothimble
source: POKENAME shivers constantly, even in warm environments. Wearing a hat will not stop the shivering, but POKENAME will be significantly happier if it does.

entry: POKENAME藤蔓寒冷，摸着冰凉。低温使它极脆，轻碰就断，却不会令它疼。
author: theartemis1
source: POKENAME's vines are chilling to the touch. This frigidity renders them extremely brittle, snapping off at even the lightest touch - though this doesn't cause it any pain.

entry: 据说POKENAME核里的脸才是真身，其余都只是壳。只有后面的星能旋转，鼓起气流，将核中脸吐出的冷气吹散。
author: infinex21
source: Supposedly, the face within a core of a POKENAME is the true form of this Pokémon and everything else is just a shell. Only the rear star can spin, which creates a force of air that spreads the cold air breathed out from the face within the core.

entry: POKENAME不停寒颤，通常双臂抱身。防御时，能以哑剧动作在面前筑起实心冰墙。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's body is wracked with perpetual chills, so it usually keeps its arms wrapped around itself. For defense, it can use miming to set up walls of solid ice in front of it.

entry: POKENAME常喜欢上迷路旅人，让对方在巢里住到风雪停。可留得太久，它又舍不得放人走。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME tends to take a liking to lost travelers, often letting them stay in its den until the snow passes. However, if the traveler stays too long, POKENAME will have a tough time letting them go.

entry: POKENAME穿过严寒北海，背上小屋般的壳，替乘客遮风避寒。自己有厚脂肪与肌肉，不需藏进去。
author: infinex21
source: The hut-like shell upon a POKENAME's back will provide shelter for its passengers as it traverses the frigid northern seas. It has no need to hide within itself because its body consists of thick fat and muscle.

entry: POKENAME是住在北方森林的小巧可爱食腐者。基因序列异常混乱，似乎全靠自身低温压制。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are the small, adorable scavengers that dwell within boreal forests. These Pokémon have unusually chaotic genetic sequences that seem to be tempered purely by the cold of their own bodies.

entry: POKENAME尾巴虽全由冰雪构成，却如活火般闪动变形。颈毛与兜帽头顶的毛，平静时冰凉，烦躁却发热，甚至泛橙光。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's tail flickers and shifts like an active flame, even though it is made entirely of ice and snow. The fur around its neck and atop its hooded head are cool when it is calm but will become hot, and even glow orange, when agitated.

entry: POKENAME每年大部分时间都在休眠，只有冬季才会醒来。它愿将毛毯分给更小的宝可梦，替它们挡住寒冷。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME hibernate throughout most of the year, only awakening during the winter months. It will share its furry blanket with other smaller Pokémon to keep them out of the cold.

entry: POKENAME格外善良，常巡山寻找暴风雪中迷路者。一发现，就领回温暖洞穴，保护他们免遭零下严寒。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME is exceptionally kindhearted, frequently patrolling the mountainside in search of those lost in blizzards. If it spots anyone, it guides them back to its warm cave, keeping them safe from the sub-zero temperatures.

entry: 据说成群POKENAME现身，猛烈暴风雪很快就来。它们用超能力操纵、塑造冰来攻击。
author: actliux
source: It is said that when groups of POKENAME appear, harsh blizzards are soon to follow. They use their psychic energy to manipulate and shape ice to attack.

entry: POKENAME寻找失意的人与宝可梦，隐去身形，在对方头上撒雪，想逗他们开心。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME look for downtrodden people and Pokémon. They make themselves invisible and sprinkle snow over the individual's head, hoping to cheer them up.

entry: POKENAME虽住在寒冷气候，却完全不适应。编织社团联手为它做衣服，让它在严酷环境里过得好些。
author: sneakywalrus0
source: Despite living in cold climates, POKENAME are wholly unsuited to living in such conditions. However, knitting clubs have banded together to make clothing for POKENAME to wear so that they might have a better time in such harsh environments.

entry: POKENAME不适应寒冷，却仍住在冷地。当地编织社团知道它挨冻，会收留照顾，通常让它裹着手织暖物离开。
author: sneakywalrus0
source: POKENAME reside in the cold climates, despite not being suited for such an environment. Local knitting clubs will take them in, as they know that they struggle in the cold. They usually leave bundled in warm, hand-knitted accessories.

entry: POKENAME背火消耗了大部分体热，很难调节体温。常能看到它烧木头与叶子，给自己取暖。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME struggles to regulate its body temperature, as the flame on its back uses most of its body heat. It can often be seen burning wood and leaves to keep itself warm.

entry: POKENAME厚毛抵御冰水，却几乎遮得它看不见。它凭锐敏嗅觉捕猎，白海狮与金鱼王等都是猎物。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's hefty coat keeps it warm in frigid waters, but leaves it almost completely blind. Hunting via a sharp sense of smell, it takes down Pokémon such as Dewgong and Seaking as its prey.

entry: POKENAME织出隔热丝衣，抵御极地寒冷。用角破冰，把丝垂进水里钓鱼，再用网包好，留待日后吃。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME weaves a coat of insulating webbing to protect its body from the arctic chill. It carves through frozen water using its horn and lowers strands of webbing into the water to catch fish, which it webs up for later consumption.

entry: POKENAME大群生活，大雪暴里挤作一团取暖。晴朗冬夜，能看到它们仰望星空。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME live in large groups, huddling together during large snowstorms to keep themselves warm. On clear winter nights, they can be seen gazing up at the stars.

entry: 蛋壳般的披风，连最严寒的低温也能保暖。暴风雪中，常见POKENAME开心跳舞。
author: sk372
source: The eggshell-like cloak around its body keeps it warm even among the most frigid of temperatures. It's not uncommon to see POKENAME happily dancing about in the middle of snowstorms.

entry: POKENAME收集细枝，编成遮雪的小帽。察觉风暴将近时，它们就将帽子放在崖脚，当作巢穴，在里面休息。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME gather twigs to craft small hats that shelter them from the snow. If they sense a storm approaching, they will set down their hats at the base of cliffs to act as nests for them to rest in.

entry: POKENAME难觅踪迹，住在冰洞深处避太阳。不知为何，白天在外就不动，双眼追着太阳，让天敌有机可乘。
author: _pixelar_
source: POKENAME are very elusive Pokémon, living deep in icy caves to hide from the sun. For unknown reasons, when outside during the day, POKENAME cease to move and will track the sun's movement with their eyes, leaving them vulnerable to predators.

entry: POKENAME身上如衣服的纤维植物，帮助御寒。据说成群聚舞，不久就会下雪。
author: mepp.
source: The fibrous plants on POKENAME's body, which appear as clothing, help shield it from the cold. It's said that when groups of POKENAME gather to dance, snowfall will soon come.

entry: POKENAME通常将双臂藏在围巾下保暖。围巾却是活的，能像肢体般活动，不怕冷。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME usually keeps its arms tucked under its scarf for warmth. The scarf, which is alive and able to move like a limb, is not hindered by the cold.

entry: POKENAME用冰冻的鳃，在身上覆薄雪，探索新地方时护身。遇上同类，也爱一起跳进沿途泥洼。
author: fiordaliso
source: With its frozen gills, POKENAME can cover its body with a thin layer of snow that protects it while exploring new places. When it meets others of its species, it enjoys jumping in mud puddles it encounters.

entry: POKENAME钻入冰川冻住，直到冰川到海里才解冻。借此活上数千年，还分泌凝胶，让皮肤保持年轻。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME burrow into glaciers, becoming frozen and only thawing when the glaciers reach the sea. This allows them to live for thousands of years, with them secreting a gel that keeps their skin rejuvenated.

entry: POKENAME钻入冰川冻住，直到冰川到海里才解冻。科学家认为，它数百万年未变，繁殖太慢，赶不上演化压力。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME burrow into glaciers, becoming frozen and only thawing when the glaciers reach the sea. Scientists believe that POKENAME haven't changed for millions of years, as they reproduce too slowly to adapt to evolutionary pressures.

entry: POKENAME用超能力时，兜帽上垂下的两个球体，会泛起淡淡的紫粉色光芒。无论身处什么环境，黑毛的触感都出奇地凉。
author: infinex21
source: The pair of orbs that dangle from the hood of a POKENAME glow with a faintly purple-pink color when they use their psychic powers. Their black fur is surprisingly cool to the touch, no matter the environment they may be within.

entry: POKENAME飞掠冰洞，放出阵阵雪驱赶旁人。性情害羞，很少露面，常只见寒冷中一抹模糊身影。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME darts through icy caverns, releasing bursts of snow to deter others. It is shy and rarely seen except as a blur in the cold.

entry: POKENAME面对旁人有点害羞，会模仿墙上的文字沟通。
author: lemmymaster
source: POKENAME are slightly shy around others. They communicate by mimicking texts found on walls.

entry: POKENAME既有艺术天分，也擅运动。爱滑冰、雕冰像，只要周围不太热，也愿尝试新活动。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are both artistic and athletic. They enjoy skating on the ice, carving ice into statuettes, and they even try out new activities, so long as it is not too hot around them.

entry: POKENAME半流体的身体，对周围降温很敏感。太冷就整个缩进头上披风，等环境好转。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's semi-liquid body is quite sensitive to cooling temperatures around it. If it gets too cold, it retracts its whole body into the cloak it wears on its head until the conditions improve.

entry: POKENAME在冰冻地带快步跑，嗅寻冰块带回巢。尚不清楚，它按什么标准挑值得拿的冰。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME skitters around frozen areas, sniffing out chunks of ice to bring back to its den. It's not yet known what criteria it uses for judging which pieces of ice are worth retrieving.

entry: POKENAME住在高山，厚毛让它在最猛烈暴风雪里也暖和。古人曾用它的毛做冬衣。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME lives in the high mountains, its thick fur keeping it warm during the harshest of blizzards. Ancient people used to use POKENAME's fur to make winter clothing.

entry: POKENAME会在客机、游轮等场所端送餐饮。冰冷双手，能为饮料及袋里的冰点降温。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are known to serve food and drinks in a variety of settings, such as an airliner or cruise ship. Their cold hands cool drinks and frosty treats from their sack.

entry: POKENAME闲来就编织，常做围巾与毯子。给白银山获救训练家使用的毯子，也是它织的。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME knit whenever not preoccupied, often creating scarves and blankets. Blankets used to help Trainers rescued from Mt. Silver are made by POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME用轻柔亲吻沟通，碰到前还会抖一下。暴风雪与旅途中，它的触碰能安抚伙伴。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME communicates with gentle kisses, shivering just before contact. Its touch calms allies during snowstorms and travels.

entry: POKENAME为冬季储电，靠额外热量防止冻住。看见同类开始结冰，便分电将它暖回来。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME stores its electricity for the winter as it needs the additional heat to prevent it from freezing. If it spots another POKENAME starting to freeze, it will share its electricity to warm them back up.

entry: 睡前，POKENAME轻吻冰山，熔出小空洞，蜷在里面睡到天亮。
author: .izik
source: Before sleeping, POKENAME gently kisses icebergs, melting small hollows inside. It curls up in the cavern and sleeps until dawn.

entry: POKENAME住在冰峰，披风极善保温，帮助熬过严冬。只肯与伴侣或幼崽分享、交换披风。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's cloak retains heat excellently, helping keep it warm during the frigid winters it endures on the icy peaks it calls home. POKENAME only ever shares or swaps its cloak with its mate or young.

entry: 这个融合体，把找到的有用东西都装进披风。有时会与走投无路的训练家，做不公平的交易。
author: evilscarypurple
source: This fusion packs anything useful it finds into its cloak. It has been known to make unfair trades with desperate Trainers.

entry: POKENAME滚出尽可能大的雪球，再用头顶上天，比能飞多远取乐。胡闹常不慎砸中没防备的旅人。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME entertains itself by rolling up the biggest snowball it can create, before seeing how far it can headbutt it into the air. Unsuspecting travelers have been regularly pelted by accident by POKENAME's hijinks.

entry: POKENAME读取周围情绪，能预知尚未出现的危险。常领着受困宝可梦穿过暴风雪。
author: fredfeyh
source: By reading the feelings of those around it, POKENAME can predict danger before it appears. It is often seen leading stranded Pokémon through snowy storms.

entry: POKENAME在大雪中蹦跳起舞，用超能力扬起踢飞的雪，粉雪环身，增添美感。群舞罕见，却尤其绚丽。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME dances and prances about in heavy snow, using its psychic powers to lift the snow it kicks up and create a powder of snow around it for aesthetics. Group performances are rare, but especially dazzling to behold.

entry: POKENAME暖毛藏着毒刺，受威胁便竖起。约六只结成小群，吃睡都协调行动，免得谁落单无人保护。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME's warm fur hides venomous barbs they flex when threatened. They live in small groups of about six POKENAME, coordinating activities such as eating and sleeping so that no one is left unprotected.

entry: POKENAME替北方针叶林的伐木工，砍取珍贵常绿木料。冬天会带柴进村，帮人们御寒。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME chops down logs of valuable evergreen wood for lumberjacks in taiga forests. During the winter it is known to approach villages with firewood to keep people warm.

entry: 低温时，POKENAME留在石里，靠石头温暖幽灵身体。只有升温到一定程度，才小心从安全处探出。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME remains within its stone when the temperature drops low, the rock providing its spectral body warmth. Only when the temperature rises above a certain degree will it cautiously poke out from its place of safety.

entry: POKENAME只与品性高尚者结缘。善意的波导驱走厄运，为选中保护的对象带来鸿运。
author: _adaryx_
source: POKENAME only bonds with virtuous souls. Its benevolent aura repels misfortune, bringing great fortune to those it chooses to protect.

entry: 北方城市曾将POKENAME奉为雪神。受惊便放出冰冻冲击，瞬间将受害者封进冰里。
author: .izik
source: Northern cities once worshipped POKENAME as a god of snow. When startled, it releases a freezing blast capable of encasing victims in ice instantly.

entry: POKENAME创造的酷寒环境，很适合其他冰宝可梦。壳中甚至住着整座雪童子村落，受它保护。
author: thropp
source: The frigid environment POKENAME creates is ideal for its fellow Ice Pokémon. Its shell houses a village of Snorunt, protecting them from harm.

entry: POKENAME开心地发抖，滑过冰湖。借阵阵冰冻之风，做出优雅复杂的旋转。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME skates across frozen lakes while shivering with joy. It uses bursts of Icy Wind to perform graceful and complex spins.

entry: 独剑鞘天生不合群，POKENAME却群体紧密。月下成群闪耀的景象，是寒冷冬夜的经典象征。
author: .fedoraman
source: Honedge are not naturally social Pokémon, but POKENAME live in tight-knit swarms. The sparkle of a POKENAME swarm in the moonlight is a classic symbol for a cold, winter night.

entry: POKENAME结群，用废金属筑小屋御寒。出门绝不忘披风，否则就有在外冻住的危险。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME live together in packs, constructing small huts out of scrap metal to protect themselves from the cold. They will never leave their huts without their cloak, or they will risk freezing outside.

entry: POKENAME深受巡查、保护寒山地带的宝可梦巡护员喜爱。野生个体会冒最猛烈的暴风雪，寻找迷路训练家，用触角领到安全处。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are the favored companions of Pokémon Rangers that survey and protect cold mountain areas. This is because wild POKENAME will brave the harshest blizzards to find lost Trainers and guide them to safety with their feelers.

entry: POKENAME常蹲在大雪堆里，尽量不显眼。若被发现，就用耳朵抓雪，向观察者丢雪球，再逃走。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is often found crouching in large snowbanks, attempting to keep a small profile. If spotted, it grabs clumps of snow with its ears and lobs snowballs at its observer before fleeing.

entry: POKENAME的毒种子，最适合在其他植物受苦的环境生长。春天，它把种子藏在外衣里，直到能进洞躲藏。
author: darkweavile428
source: POKENAME's poisonous seeds grow best in environments where other plant life would suffer. During the spring, it keeps the seeds in its coat until it can take shelter in a cave.

entry: POKENAME虽发抖，摸着却出奇温暖。它偷吸附近热源，连人和宝可梦也不放过。
author: chibitales
source: Despite its shivering, POKENAME is surprisingly warm. It leeches heat from nearby sources, including people and Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME是寒地常见的伙伴，再冰冷，体热也足以暖一间小屋。共用空间往往有好几只，为各家取暖。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are a common companion in colder regions, their bodies generating enough heat to warm a small room even in the iciest of conditions. Communal spaces tend to have multiple POKENAME to help keep families warm.

entry: POKENAME硬壳既防攻击，也吸收周围寒意。受击能释放能量，将袭击者冻实，好趁机逃走。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's hard shell protects its body from attacks and absorbs the ambient cold around it. It can release this energy when struck in order to freeze its attackers solid and allow it to escape.

entry: 尾根的冰晶显示POKENAME的健康状态。蓝色越深，说明体内温度调节得越好。
author: melodydelune
source: The icy crystal formed at the base of POKENAME's tail indicates its current health. The deeper blue in color it is, the better its internal temperature is being regulated.

entry: POKENAME几乎总在生病，不停喷嚏、发抖。每次喷嚏，都从花苞喷出小团霜，久而久之，花苞裹上厚冰。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is almost always sick, constantly sneezing and shivering. It sprays small clouds of frost from its bud every time it sneezes, which ends up coating the bud in a thick layer of ice over time.

entry: POKENAME很受冬日村落欢迎，柔软棉絮很适合做暖冬衣。常大群挤在一起，互相挡寒。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are a welcome sight in winter villages, as their soft cotton is wonderful for making warm winter clothing. They can be seen in large clusters, protecting each other from the cold.

entry: POKENAME用肚皮滑冰追猎物，可若有伙伴帮它到达冰下水域，会更善捕猎。常蜷在冰钓小屋，啃自己的那份鱼，或裹着蜕皮打盹。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME slides across ice on its belly to chase prey but is a more skilled hunter when an ally helps it reach water under ice. It is often found curled up in an ice fisher's shack, gnawing on its part of the catch or snoozing in its shed skin.

entry: POKENAME成群在地下洞网最深、最冷处筑巢。同类间极合群，却通常不爱外来者。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME nest together in flocks in the deepest and chilliest parts of cavernous systems. They are incredibly social among one another, but they generally do not like outsiders.

entry: POKENAME适应并遍布各种气候。寒冬夜里，给自己裹静电；温暖夏日，则给自己覆霜。
author: camtft
source: POKENAME have adapted and spread through all climates. In the cold winter nights, they cover themselves with static electricity. In the warm summer days, they cover themselves with frost.

entry: POKENAME成群在地下洞网最深、最冷处筑巢。同类间极合群，却通常不爱外来者。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME nest together in flocks in the deepest and chilliest parts of cavernous systems. They are incredibly social among one another, but they generally do not like outsiders.

entry: POKENAME飞行时，翼上空气水分冻成雪，纷纷落下，栖居洞穴内便会骤然飘雪。
author: .izik
source: As POKENAME flies, its wings shed falling snow formed from frozen air moisture. This creates sudden flurries inside the caves it inhabits.

entry: POKENAME住在极冷环境，甲壳构造能留住体热。壳虽冰凉，身体却隔热良好，远低冰点也能生活。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME live in very cold environments and have carapaces that are built to retain body heat. Though their shells are cool to the touch, their bodies are kept well-insulated and they can live at temperatures far below freezing.

entry: POKENAME覆着薄而松的甲壳质层，用来留住热量。松垂外层显得诡异，有研究者怀疑，许多都市传说都源于它。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are covered in a thin, loose layer of chitin that is built to retain heat. This loose layer gives them an eerie appearance, and some researchers suspect POKENAME is the source of many urban myths.

entry: POKENAME常闯进民居，寻找替换披风。奇怪的是，不去更合理的地方，反倒常选电影院。
author: secondatheniangadfly
source: POKENAME often wanders into human dwellings looking for a replacement cloak. Strangely, it often chooses movie theaters instead of somewhere more reasonable.

entry: POKENAME是一群雪童子，征用冰鬼护空心遗骸护身。合力用冰，能掀起强暴风雪自卫。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a colony of Snorunt that commandeered the hollowed remains of a Glalie for added protection. Using their ice powers in conjunction lets them create potent blizzards to defend themselves.

entry: POKENAME以幽灵般的优雅舞过山脊。若被打扰，瞬间就在原地冻住入侵者。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME dances across mountain ridges with ghostlike grace. If disturbed, it will instantly freeze intruders where they stand.

entry: POKENAME顶上的脸是假的，真脸藏在雪里。层层雪下，竟意外暖和。
author: hophoppip
source: The face at the top of POKENAME is a false one — the real face is hiding in the snow. It's surprisingly warm under all the snow.

entry: POKENAME适应冰冻平原，胆小，五只以上结群。根状腿从雪里吸水与矿物，彼此碰腿，无声沟通，免被天敌发现。
author: ambrosia04
source: Adapted to freezing plains, skittish POKENAME live in groups of five or more. They draw water and minerals from snow through their root-like legs, touching them together to communicate silently and avoid detection by predators.

entry: POKENAME发出高频声，与附近冰锥共鸣，出奇令人舒心。可听得太久，又会止不住发抖。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME produces a high-pitched frequency that resonates with any nearby icicles, creating an oddly soothing sound. However, if you are exposed to POKENAME's frequency for too long, you will experience uncontrollable shivering.

entry: POKENAME用披风调节体温。自身放出的寒意太强，连披风摸着也冰冷。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: The cloak of POKENAME is used to regulate its internal temperature. Due to the intense cold POKENAME emits, even its cloak is icily cold to the touch.

entry: POKENAME披风柔软蓬松，它却不爱被摸。摸过头，就乱挥反手，力道能把人打飞。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's cloak is soft and fluffy to touch, though POKENAME itself doesn't much enjoy being pet. Touching it too much will result in a flailing backhand that can send a person flying.

entry: POKENAME不停吐冷雾，黑刺也结满冰。它恨暖天，躲进冰洞，直到太阳消失。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME constantly exhales a cold mist that ends up freezing over its black thorns. It hates warm weather and will hide in icy caves until the sun disappears.

entry: 猛烈暴风雪中，POKENAME成群挤紧，分享体热。此时一周多不吃不喝，也能撑住。
author: mistymagius
source: During harsh blizzards, herds of POKENAME huddle together to share their body heat. During this period, they can go for over a week without food or water.

entry: POKENAME住在高山，结小群巡过冰川，寻找迷路训练家。找到后，就领到最近的避难处，回归安全。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Living high up in the mountains, POKENAME search across glaciers in small packs to find lost Trainers. When they find someone who has gotten lost, they will herd them back to safety at the nearest shelter.

entry: POKENAME小群漫游冰川，锐爪牢牢抓住险滑地面。有时，人们组队用它拉雪橇，在严酷环境中远行。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME roam across frozen glaciers in small packs, their sharp claws giving excellent purchase on the treacherous terrain. Teams of POKENAME are sometimes used to pull sleds and allow people to travel great distances in harsh conditions.

entry: 大雪过后，POKENAME常只剩头顶的锥形蘑菇露在外面。它挖出雪下的落叶吃，供养这朵蘑菇。
author: .jerden
source: After heavy snowfall, the conical mushroom on POKENAME's head is often the only part of its body that remains visible. It feeds the mushroom by digging up and eating fallen leaves from beneath the snow.

entry: POKENAME身体暗色部位怕恶劣天气，常将双翼紧收护住。受威胁才彻底展开，向四周放出灼热光波。
author: sk372
source: The dark parts of POKENAME's body are sensitive to the elements, so it often keeps its wings tucked close for protection. If it feels threatened, it fully unfurls them to deliver searing light waves all around it.

entry: 大雪过后，POKENAME常只剩头顶的锥形蘑菇露在外面。它挖出雪下的落叶吃，供养这朵蘑菇。
author: .jerden
source: After heavy snowfall, the conical mushroom on POKENAME's head is often the only part of its body that remains visible. It feeds the mushroom by digging up and eating fallen leaves from beneath the snow.

entry: 这些宝可梦潜行雪下，找下个丢雪球的目标。POKENAME爱玩又友善，尤其受孩子喜爱。
author: milchik
source: These Pokémon sneak around under the snow in search of their next target to shoot snowballs at. POKENAME are especially adored by children for their playful nature and friendly attitude.

entry: 冬天，POKENAME攀在树上。在北方被当作害兽，会将数百棵常绿树的皮剥掉。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME can be found clinging to trees in winter. They're considered pests in northern regions, where they strip the bark off of evergreen trees in the hundreds.

entry: POKENAME皮肤极暖，能熬最冷低温。战技娴熟，冰鬼护等对手也应付得来。还能察觉雪崩，登山者常寻它作伴。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME's incredibly warm skin allows it to survive the coldest temperatures, they are skilled fighters being able to take on the likes of Glalie. Mountaineers will often seek a partnership with POKENAME due to their ability to detect avalanches.

entry: 它钻到雪下，躲开天敌视线。外衣让它在最冷天气，也能保持温暖。
author: hophoppip
source: To stay out of sight of predators, it burrows under the snow. Its coat helps it stay warm even in the coldest weather.

entry: POKENAME吃的宝石越多，身上长的宝石就越冷。冷得足以让盛夏的周围，也仿佛冬天。
author: .izik
source: The gems that grow from POKENAME's body grow colder as it consumes more gems. They can reach temperatures cold enough to make the surrounding area feel like winter even in the middle of summer.

entry: 这三胞胎穿雪掘进，速度惊人。各自的头罩，保护着不停撞地、开凿隧道的头。
author: bacondlx
source: These triplets burrow through snow at an impressive speed. The covers each head wears help protect them as they continuously headbutt the ground to make their tunnels.

entry: POKENAME躲在冰冻河湖附近，只有冰薄到一定程度，才出外捕猎。厚皮不积水，身体就不会结冰晶。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME takes refuge near frozen rivers and lakes, only going out to hunt once the ice is thin enough. Its thick skin prevents moisture buildup, stopping ice crystals from forming on its body.

entry: POKENAME攀登精准，连最好的攀岩装备也比不过。有人见它爬上连老练远足者都避开的崖壁。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME's climbing skill is so precise that it puts even the best Climbing Gear to shame. It's been spotted scaling cliffs that seasoned hikers avoid entirely.

entry: 至少5只POKENAME，常沿冰湖雪岸摇摆走。嬉戏时，缩进壳，彼此碰撞。
author: infinex21
source: Groups of at least 5 POKENAME often waddle along the snowy shores of frozen lakes. They will often play amongst themselves by withdrawing in their shells and bumping against one another.

entry: POKENAME半埋雪里藏身，看着只是遗失的帽子与手套。谁没戒心想拿，就向谁喷强酸。
author: anonymous_moose
source: POKENAME partially buries itself in snow to hide, appearing to be nothing more than a lost hat and mittens. It sprays a strong acid at any unwary creature who attempts to take its garments.

entry: POKENAME的蓝火，不信任的人觉得冰冷，信任的人却觉得暖得舒服。厚毛易让它过热，奔跑时鼻喷蒸汽散热。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's blue flames are frigid cold to those it does not trust, but comfortably warm to those it does trust. It breathes steam out of its nostrils as it runs so it avoids overheating due to the thick coat covering its body.

entry: 它们小跑过雪地，周身柔软新雪扬起落下，常像纱帘遮身。披着的毛，对信任的训练家摸起来格外暖。
author: infinex21
source: Plumes of fresh, soft snow rise and fall from across this Pokémon's body, often casting a veil around themselves as they trot across fields of snow. The coat of fur draped across their bodies is remarkably warm to the touch for their trusted Trainer.

entry: POKENAME裹着的暖毯，其实是背上大量绒皮，本就是身体一部分。每春蜕去厚毛，免得气温上升后过热。
author: milchik
source: The warm blanket POKENAME covers itself with is actually a part of its body, made of the copious amounts of fuzzy skin on its back. This Pokémon sheds its thick fur every spring to prevent overheating as the average temperature rises.

entry: 厚毛毯只覆住POKENAME部分身体与尾巴，大块皮肤仍露着。它却似乎不在乎冷，最恶劣冬天也出门。
author: .jerden
source: A thick blanket of fur only covers part of POKENAME's body and tail, leaving a lot of its skin exposed. Despite this, it seems to be indifferent towards the cold and will go out even in the harshest winter weather.

entry: 金属身体还软，它便用静电吸来其他宝可梦的蜕毛，做外衣御寒。有时能在象牙猪等大宝可梦厚毛上，找到黏住的它。
author: novembermagnus
source: The metal composing this Pokémon's body is still soft, so it uses static electricity to gather the shed fur of other Pokémon into a coat for warmth. It is sometimes found stuck to the thick coats of larger Pokémon, like Mamoswine.

entry: POKENAME爬上冰山休息，轻轻颤抖。抖动毛间，雪花聚起又落下。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME hauls itself onto icebergs, where it trembles gently as it rests. Snow flurries gather and fall from its shaking fur.

entry: POKENAME的壳质地如丝绒，常因此遭猎捕。它会以冰息冻住猎物，再拖回巢。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is often hunted for its shell, which has a unique velvet-like texture. It will freeze its prey with icy breath before dragging them back to its nest.

entry: POKENAME从地下升起、露齿，让许多生物吓得四散。可这只是天生模样，丝毫不凶。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME rising up from beneath the ground and baring its teeth has sent many a creature scurrying away in terror. This is just its natural appearance, however; it's not aggressive in the least.

entry: POKENAME藏在山口，吃旅人的梦。进食时剧烈发抖，却既不冷，也不怕。
author: .izik
source: While hidden in mountain passes, POKENAME consumes the dreams of travelers. It shivers violently as it feeds, though unaffected by cold or fear.

entry: POKENAME栖息在寒冷的海岸与冰冷水域，以海藻、苔藓和能找到的各种树果为食。它们通常五到七只结成一群，由体型最大的一只担任首领。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME inhabit cold shores and freezing waters, with seaweed, moss, and whatever berries they can find serving as their diet. They tend to live in groups of at least five or up to seven, with the largest serving as the group's leader.

entry: POKENAME背着似乎永不融化的冰片。四肢短粗、沉重又僵硬，它们便造出长长的滑溜冰路，靠滑行四处移动。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME carry shards of ice on their backs that never seem to melt. They are also known for creating long, slippery paths made out of ice that they rely on to slide through the world, as their stocky limbs are heavy and stiff.

entry: POKENAME滚动不顾旁人，栖地常立警示牌。撞上任何东西，都会放电，同时释放连电都能冻实的寒冷能量。
author: infinex21
source: Habitats of POKENAME are commonly denoted with warning signs, as these Pokémon roll around with no regard for others. If they collide with anything at all, they discharge electricity and release a frigid energy that can even freeze electricity solid.

entry: 它们以贪食、脾气爆烈闻名。中央的角向猎物使出强力十万伏特，再冻实、大吃，有时整只吞下。
author: infinex21
source: These Pokémon are known for two things: their voracious appetites and their explosive tempers. They fire powerful Thunder Bolts from their central horns at prey, then freeze them solid and gobble them up, sometimes whole.

entry: POKENAME的唾液一碰表面，就会冻结。因此，什么被舔都有危险，同伴也不例外。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's saliva freezes surfaces on contact. This trait makes it a danger to anything it licks, including allies.

entry: 这些水栖宝可梦偏爱冷气候，却能放出只降水温、不结冰的寒气。POKENAME用强角，打碎水中冰块、岩石等大障碍。
author: infinex21
source: These water-dwelling Pokémon typically prefer colder climates, but the chilling gas they can release is capable of chilling water without freezing it. POKENAME use their powerful horns to break apart large debris in the water, such as ice and rocks.

entry: POKENAME的脸封在永不融的冰面具里，表情诡异凝固。它在暴风雪唱幽曲，将旅人引进严寒，再彻底冻住。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's face is encased in an icy mask that never melts, giving it an eerie, frozen expression. It sings haunting melodies in snowstorms, luring travelers into the cold before freezing them solid.

entry: 它爱赶上猛烈冰雹，边跳舞边吃落冰。风暴一停，就无聊得闯进汽车旅馆，摆弄制冰机。
author: epping_forest
source: It loves to catch violent hailstorms and eat the falling ice while dancing. After the storm is over, they feel very bored so they break into motels to mess with the ice machines.

entry: POKENAME是严寒北海中，领地意识极强的住民。冰冷怒吼，顷刻冻住整船，留作冰封警示，告诫闯领地的后果。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a highly territorial denizen of the frigid northern seas. With its bellowing icy roar, it can freeze an entire ship solid in moments, leaving a frozen reminder of the consequences of trespassing in its domain.

entry: POKENAME周身水晶能放出炫目光束，让少数追它的训练家与天敌，极难捉到。
author: nexusshenanigans
source: POKENAME can radiate blinding beams of light from the crystals surrounding its body, making it very elusive to the few Trainers and predators who pursue it.

entry: POKENAME体内的火囊，不断生火保暖。外面蓝毛却放出刺骨寒意，防止体热熔化冰身。
author: infinex21
source: Internally, a POKENAME has a flame pouch that is always producing fire and warming its insides. Externally, its blue fur exudes a bone-chilling cold that prevents its own internal heat from melting its icy body.

entry: POKENAME对猎物毫不留情，先封进实冰，再重重咬碎。厚鳞让它在严寒中也生活得好。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME shows no mercy to its prey, preferring to encase them in solid ice before delivering a crushing bite. Its thick scales allow it to thrive in frigid environments.

entry: POKENAME胸脸才是真脸，头只是冰息排口，几秒就能冻住敌人。它住在冷到人类无法独自生存的山巅。
author: nyoomymph
source: The face on POKENAME's chest is its true face; the head is merely a vent for the icy breath it can spew, which can freeze an opponent in seconds. POKENAME lives on the peaks of mountains so cold that humans cannot survive alone.

entry: POKENAME适于严寒，冰柱般的毒刺一碰就能冻住猎物。冷空气能保持尖刺锋利，又不致融化，因此它格外喜欢寒冷。
author: rakunk
source: POKENAME thrives in frigid climates, its icicle-like stingers capable of freezing prey on contact. It prefers the cold, as the freezing air keeps its stingers sharp and prevents them from melting.

entry: POKENAME极端孤僻，所占冰山，连另一只生物也不容居住。瞬间移动到入侵者面前，用眼中冰束冻住，再扔下山。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is extremely isolationist, not tolerating a single other creature living on the icy mountain it claims. It teleports before intruders, freezing them solid with ice beams from its eyes before tossing their frozen form off its mountain.

entry: POKENAME酷爱冰球，戴上面具，让球杆悬浮。每逢球员神奇进球，就有人认为是它赐福。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME love hockey, so much so that they adorn themselves with masks and levitate hockey sticks around. Whenever a player miraculously scores a shot, some believe it is due to POKENAME's blessing.

entry: POKENAME能随意从背喷蓝火，从胸口的嘴喷冰块。拿手招数，是先冻实敌人，再用烈火熔化。
author: sk372
source: At will, POKENAME can burst forth with blue flames from its back and ice chunks from its mouth in its chest. Its signature technique involves freezing a foe solid before melting them with its intense flames.

entry: POKENAME吊在冰洞顶端，静候猎物。翅膀与脸上包着锐利的冰，连坚硬岩石也能劈开。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME hang from the roof of frozen caves waiting for prey. Their wings and faces are encased in ice so sharp it can cleave through hard stone.

entry: POKENAME触角在水下发出闪光，诱来好奇猎物。一入范围，就爆发寒能，骤冻四周，将猎物冻实吃下。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's antennae create shimmering light beneath the water that lures curious prey closer. Once within range, POKENAME flash-freezes its surroundings with a chilling burst of energy, freezing prey solid for it to consume.

entry: POKENAME裹着的冰，会映出朦胧往昔。许多人相信，满月时凝视冰壳，就能看见遥远过去。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body is encased in ice that reflects faint visions of the past. Many believe gazing into its frozen shell during a full moon allows one to witness events from long ago.

entry: POKENAME四处走，将喙深插地面，标记领地。戳过的孔，片刻后就长出大冰笋。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME marks territory as it traipses around by poking its beak deep into the ground. The spots it pokes holes into will grow large stalagmites of ice shortly thereafter.

entry: POKENAME住在山里，很少出洞。偶尔下山，小群共舞；据说会带来猛烈暴风雪，强得能夷平城镇。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME reside in the mountains, rarely leaving their caves. On rare occasions, they will descend, dancing together in small groups. It is said that these dances will bring violent blizzards, strong enough to level towns.

entry: POKENAME很友善，可摸它几乎瞬间冻伤，训练家得小心。幸好，分泌的凝胶抹在裸手，就能不受冷地碰它。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME are very friendly, though Trainers have to be careful around them as petting them causes frostbite almost instantly. Luckily, POKENAME produce a gel that, when applied to bare hands, allows one to touch them without getting cold.

entry: POKENAME深色毛发的身体，覆着致密坚硬的实冰外壳。它将超能力与迅速降温的雾结合，将敌人冻成坚冰，保护训练家。
author: infinex21
source: The dark-furred body of a POKENAME is covered in a dense, hard shell made of solid ice. It combines its psychic powers with its ability to produce a fast-cooling mist to protect its Trainer by freezing their foes solid.

entry: POKENAME偷远足者的围巾筑巢，温暖的巢，藏在雪山。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME builds its nest from scarves stolen from hikers. These cozy nests are hidden in snowy mountains.

entry: POKENAME背上冰晶，为全部冰雪能力供能。很少走人造路，总冻出横穿道路的捷径，十分滑，害许多人跌倒。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have ice crystals on their back that power all of their frosty abilities. POKENAME rarely follow manmade paths, as they freeze trails that cut through existing roads. These paths are quite slippery and have caused many falls.

entry: POKENAME滑过湖上，吐冷气冻住湖面，造出稳当落脚处，方便渡水。
author: .izik
source: As POKENAME glides above lakes, it breathes cold air to freeze the surface. This helps it traverse water by providing stable landing areas.

entry: POKENAME如双手的两张嘴，吐气冷得能迅速冻住熔融金属。它先冻矿石原料与水果，再在嘴里瞬间碾碎。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's dual mouths that serve like its hands can exude air so cold it will swiftly chill and freeze molten metal. It will use this ability to freeze raw ores and fruits before instantly crushing them within these mouths.

entry: POKENAME常与冰球选手训练，磨炼敏捷。头羽帮助它在高速动作中保持平衡。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME frequently trains with hockey players to hone its agility. The feather on its head helps it maintain balance during high-speed maneuvers.

entry: POKENAME是滑冰高手，速度与灵巧无可匹敌，会参加竞技运动，证明自己是冰上冠军。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are masters of gliding on ice, their physical speed and dexterity are unrivaled. They will compete in athletic sports to prove themselves champion of the ice.

entry: POKENAME的角冰冷无比，却出奇甜。密阿雷市有家冰激凌店，用它调制独特奶昔。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's horns are incredibly cold and surprisingly sweet. An ice cream shop in Lumiose City uses these horns to craft unique milkshakes.

entry: 冰洞顶端聚成礁群的POKENAME，看起来就像成簇冰柱。可得小心：一碰到珊瑚渗出的卤水，就会被冻结，当作猎物。这里没有好坏星，让POKENAME得以繁盛。
author: wormspawn
source: Reefs of POKENAME on the roofs of icy caves resemble clusters of icicles. Be warned: anything that touches the brine secreted from their coral will be frozen and taken as prey. The lack of Mareanie in this habitat has allowed POKENAME to thrive.

entry: POKENAME不知疲倦地在苔原采食，将收获藏进尾巴，却很少分享。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME tirelessly gathers food across the tundra. It stores its findings in its tail but rarely does it share with others.

entry: POKENAME虽有冰属性，却很爱在开阔农田吃草。栖地附近竞速的选手，常因它游荡上赛道而恼火。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Despite being partially Ice-type, POKENAME find great pleasure grazing on open farmland. Racers who race near homes of POKENAME often become annoyed when they wander onto the track.

entry: POKENAME因擅长宝可梦冰球而被培育。速度与敏捷，让它成为完美中锋。
author: bitterchemicalhaze
source: POKENAME are bred for their proficiency as Pokémon ice hockey players. Their speed and agility make them perfect centers.

entry: POKENAME深受冰球迷喜爱，攻击范围大，又能强力放电，击昏想打球的选手，争取进球机会。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are popular players for fans of hockey. Their superb reach combined with powerful zaps can stun players who try to hit the puck, giving them the opportunity to score a goal.

entry: POKENAME能完全控制身边环境。每进一处，就大幅降温，让周围都明白这一点。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have complete control over their immediate environment. They ensure that everyone around them knows it by chilling the air significantly when they enter an area.

entry: POKENAME三只眼，连浓重暴风雪也能看透，还能分别看到三段不同光谱。野生宝可梦与某些设备的无线电辐射，都是食物。
author: novembermagnus
source: The three eyes of a POKENAME can see even in heavy blizzards, as well as in three different spectrums of light. It preys on both wild Pokémon and the radio emissions from certain devices.

entry: POKENAME唾液冷得连周围空气都能冻结，结出的实冰块，裹住长舌。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME's saliva is so cold that it can even freeze the air around POKENAME. When this happens, it creates solid ice cubes that encase its long tongue.

entry: 连发冰锥前，POKENAME会用硬手猛砸地面。这番威吓过后，便是破坏力惊人的岩石爆击。
author: .izik
source: Before unleashing a barrage of icicles, POKENAME slams its hardened hands on the ground. This intimidating display precedes a devastating Rock Blast attack.

entry: POKENAME从扇动双翼与大嘴放出冻风。翼上冲击波裹着寒风，命中便能冻结大片区域。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME release freezing winds from their fluttering wings and from their large mouths. They can launch shockwaves from their wings that carry these frigid winds, which can freeze a sizeable area upon impact.

entry: 一些训练家会为冰球比赛专门培育POKENAME，“石英冰冻光束”队便是如此。它能灵巧运用球杆般的附肢，掌控冰球。
author: sambazoni
source: Some Trainers breed POKENAME for hockey, such as those in the Indigo Ice Beams. It uses its dexterous hockey-stick appendages to control the puck.

entry: 它冻结空气中的水分，扬起晶莹的细雪，再披上冰甲。有些训练家专门培育体形更流畅的POKENAME，用来打冰球。
author: sambazoni
source: It can freeze moisture in the air to make a diamond-dust flurry and clad itself in icy armor. Some Trainers breed sleeker POKENAME for hockey.

entry: 它冻结空气中的水分，扬起晶莹的细雪，再披上冰甲。有些训练家专门培育体形更流畅的POKENAME，用来打冰球。
author: sambazoni
source: It can freeze moisture in the air to make a diamond-dust flurry and clad itself in icy armor. Some Trainers breed sleeker POKENAME for hockey.

entry: 许多冰球迷都知道，POKENAME凭出众的速度与敏捷身手，成为深受欢迎的球员。它们贴近地面低飞，稳稳控住冰球，再挥尾射门得分。
author: quackquackattack
source: Many fans of hockey know that POKENAME are popular players of the sport because of their superior speed and agility. POKENAME fly low to the ground to maintain control of the puck before swinging their tail to score a goal.

entry: 厚毛既挡冬霜，也能伪装躲猎手。冬春交替，为适应湿度与温度变化，最多会蜕掉相当于半个体重的毛。
author: quackquackattack
source: Their thick fur provides both resistance to the winter frost and camouflage against hunters. They lose up to half their body weight in fur between the transition from winter to spring to adapt to the adjustments in humidity and temperature.

entry: POKENAME冻结空气水分作甲，仍迅捷优雅，冰上尤其如此。两只相遇，就立刻冻住周围地面，临时来场冰球赛。
author: _blissey
source: Despite wearing armor made by freezing the moisture in the air around it, POKENAME is quick and graceful, doubly so on ice. When two meet, they instantly freeze the ground in the surrounding area and start an impromptu hockey match.

entry: POKENAME在雪堆嬉跳，埋起来吓人，最爱惊吓靠得太近的生物。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME hops playfully in snowdrifts, burying itself to surprise others. It delights in startling anyone who gets too close.

entry: POKENAME覆着触之冰冷的铠甲，一碰就能把人冻住。全身锋利的冰刺，却又很容易折断。
author: patch_bros
source: POKENAME is covered with cool-to-the-touch armor that instantly freezes all who touch it. The razor-sharp icicles all along its body are very brittle.

entry: POKENAME凶悍孤僻，在冰封的山中家园里，用冰冷身体造出大冰锥，猛砸入侵者。极少有训练家，耐心坚定到能融化它的冷心。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is aggressively isolationist, pelting intruders in its frozen mountain home with large icicles it creates from its chilled body. Very few Trainers have had the patience and determination to thaw its cold heart.

entry: POKENAME从刃臂放冷气，冻结水分，造出剃刀般利的冰刃。常先冻地，让自己更灵活，攻击也更有冲势。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME can exude frigid air from their blade-like arms to freeze moisture around them and form razor-sharp blades of ice. They will oft freeze the ground around them to make their movements more agile and add more momentum to their strikes.

entry: POKENAME伪装在覆冰巨石边，潜近猎物，一舔就冻实。看过的登山者常说，这一幕冷到骨子里。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME camouflages itself against ice-covered boulders as it sneaks up on prey, freezing them solid with a lick of its tongue. Mountaineers who've seen POKENAME hunt often say the sight is chilling to the bone.

entry: POKENAME在冰洞生活得好，藏在雪里，只露温暖笑脸，再扑出压住猎物，吃得一片狼藉。有时会聚集，用可怕的金属语言吟唱。
author: lootererswillbeboated
source: POKENAME thrive in freezing caves. It camouflages in snow, only showing a warm smiling face. It then pounces out, pins down its prey and messily eats them. Sometimes they gather together and chant in a scary metallic language.

entry: 有人相信，冻死者的灵魂聚在一起，形成POKENAME。据说被冰冷吐息击中，就会冻实，灵魂被强行并入它。
author: sk372
source: Some believe POKENAME formed from the souls of those who succumbed to the frigid cold, gathering as one. Supposedly if one is attacked by its ice-cold breath, they will be frozen solid and have their soul forcibly joined with POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME背着巨大的黑色冰块，即使酷热也不会融化。双腿粗重，难以迅速移动，因此需要时，它们会冻出一条路，滑行前进。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME carry a large chunk of black ice on their backs that does not melt, even in scorching hot conditions. POKENAME have large, bulky legs that struggle to move quickly, so they freeze a path and slide whenever the situation calls for it.

entry: POKENAME通常住在冰川，啃食冰层。这是它们唯一的食物来源；找不到冰，就把能找到的最近水源冻住，再吃掉自己造的冰。
author: dukefrogpeasant
source: POKENAME are usually found in glaciers, where they eat away at the glacial ice. This is their only source of food. If they cannot find any ice, they will freeze the nearest available water and eat the ice they create.

entry: 许多训练家以为POKENAME由硬岩构成，实则甲胄是最坚硬的冰与石混成。自卫时，先冻敌，再猛撞。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: Contrary to the beliefs of many Trainers, POKENAME's bodies are not made up of hard rock. Instead, their armor is plated with a mixture of the toughest ice and stone. To protect themselves, POKENAME freeze their foes before slamming into them.

entry: POKENAME发怒，角便喷出冷雾，冻住身边的一切。
author: .izik
