source: When enraged, POKENAME's horn emits a cold mist. The mist freezes everything in its immediate vicinity.

entry: POKENAME通常住在严寒北方，角能轻易刺穿最厚冰山与最坚固船体，也能从冰甲缝隙喷水、喷雪。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME typically lives in the frigid north. Its horn can easily pierce through the thickest icebergs or the sturdiest ship hulls. It can also shoot water and snow through the gaps in its icy plating.

entry: POKENAME一占领地，就冰息一吐，瞬间冻住周围。热带或火山气候，也被极地寒力转成冻苔原。
author: sk372
source: When POKENAME claims territory, it instantly freezes over its surroundings with a chilling icy breath. Even the most tropical or volcanic climates will be instantly turned to frozen tundras by its arctic power.

entry: POKENAME常约五只结队，合力接连使出冰砾与音速拳，逼敌人退却或投降。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME are often found in troops of about five members. They work together to blast foes with Ice Shard and Mach Punch attacks in rapid succession to force a retreat or surrender.

entry: POKENAME优雅滑过冰湖，旋转身姿，以精湛滑冰技艺闻名。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME glides across frozen lakes with elegance, twirling gracefully. It is known for its remarkable ice-skating skills.

entry: 古石板记着POKENAME协助骑士作战。它奋勇战斗，冻结敌人，保护同伴。
author: .izik
source: Ancient tablets describe POKENAME aiding knights in battle. It fought valiantly, freezing enemies and protecting its allies.

entry: POKENAME的身体本身就是盾。它冻结空气中的水分制成剑，与天敌及猎物决斗。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME's body is the shield. It freezes the moisture in the air to form a sword which it uses to duel predators and prey.

entry: POKENAME常将头与爪裹上厚冰。身体比铁硬，还能冷得一碰就有冻伤危险。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME often cover their own heads and claws in thick layers of solid ice. Their bodies are harder than iron and can become so cold that one will risk frostbite by touching them.

entry: POKENAME会占整条山脉，常因此争夺领地。捕猎时引发雪崩，再冲去刺穿猎物。据说吐息能冻住整湖。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME will claim entire mountain ranges as their own, which typically leads to fights over territory. POKENAME hunt by causing avalanches and ramming into their prey, impaling them. It is said that POKENAME's breath can freeze an entire lake.

entry: POKENAME轻松飞越冰封山脉的陡峭地势，融入暴风雪躲藏。受激便猛甩尾，利得能从崖壁削下冰。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME soars with ease through the steeps of frozen mountain ranges, blending into blizzards to avoid detection. When provoked, it lashes out with its tail that's sharp enough to carve ice from cliff walls.

entry: 为实现飞翔的梦想，POKENAME将背上的水分冻成翅膀。飞行时，嘴里还会喷出冰。
author: darkweavile428
source: In order to realize its dream of flying, POKENAME froze the moisture on its back into the shape of wings. It spouts ice from its mouth as it flies.

entry: 幻象破灭、真身暴露，POKENAME就会暴怒。身体上出现的发光脸，瞬间令周围变冷。
author: .jerden
source: If its illusion is broken and its true form is revealed, POKENAME will be filled with rage. The glowing face that appears on its body will instantly chill the air around it.

entry: POKENAME冻结水分，造出冰武器，再以幻象扮作人类战士。模样太吓人，少有谁敢攻击。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME will freeze moisture in the air to create weapons out of ice, then use illusion to disguise itself as a human warrior. These displays are so intimidating that few dare to attack.

entry: POKENAME用角刺敌，便注入毒液，从内到外冻住对方。其他猎手极怕这一招。
author: .izik
source: If POKENAME pierces a foe with its horn, it injects a venom that freezes them from the inside out. This attack is highly feared by other predators.

entry: POKENAME住在偏远冰川深处。古壁画将它描为引发可怕雪崩的自然之力。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME lives deep inside remote glaciers. Ancient murals depict it as a force of nature that is responsible for terrible avalanches.

entry: 传说POKENAME夜里漫游，留下冰雾轨迹，使附近睡者做噩梦。所有自称梦见它的人，醒来都冷得刺骨。
author: fiordaliso
source: According to legend, POKENAME wanders through the night leaving behind trails of icy vapor that bring terrible nightmares to those who sleep nearby. Everyone who has claimed to see it appear in their dreams has awoken chilled to the bone.

entry: POKENAME鳞上层层覆冰，甲胄几乎攻不破，最强烈焰也能抵挡。它先将猎物冻在原地，再吞食。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME covers its scales in many layers of ice, forming a near-impenetrable armor that can endure even the most intense flames. It freezes prey in their tracks before devouring them.

entry: 尖刺由冻树汁构成，熔化兑水，能成为杀菌药液。它们拿刺与原住民聚落换盐石，分解取养分。
author: quackquackattack
source: Their spines are made of frozen sap and produce an antiseptic serum when melted and mixed with water. They offer these spines to indigenous communities in exchange for salt rocks, which they break down for nutrients.

entry: POKENAME能瞬间冻结体内气体，化成沉重冰锥，从高处猛坠。人们认为，它会带走受困北方的探险者灵魂。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME has the ability to instantly freeze its gaseous interior, causing it to instantly form into a heavy icicle that comes crashing down from high above. It is believed that POKENAME carries off the souls of explorers stranded in the north.

entry: 虽然表面上看不出来，POKENAME其实很喜欢给“石英冰冻光束”队当显示屏。每天收到的夸奖，更让它乐在其中。
author: lemmymaster
source: Despite not showing it, POKENAME quite likes its job as the Ice Beams' monitor. It loves the praise it receives on the daily.

entry: 虽然表面上看不出来，POKENAME其实很喜欢给“石英冰冻光束”队当显示屏。每天收到的夸奖，更让它乐在其中。
author: lemmymaster
source: Despite not showing it, POKENAME quite likes its job as the Ice Beams' monitor. It loves the praise it receives on the daily.

entry: POKENAME咬敌时，喷出阵阵寒气，几秒就能将对手冻实。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME bites a foe, it releases bursts of frigid air. This icy attack can freeze enemies solid in seconds.

entry: POKENAME常当冰球守门员，众多肢体能挡各方向射门。外表带刺，却喜欢球迷拥抱。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME play as goalies for hockey games because their many appendages can block shots from multiple angles. Despite their prickly appearance, POKENAME enjoy hugs from fans.

entry: POKENAME攀在冰洞顶，发光照路，引导迷途旅人。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME clings to the roofs of frozen caves, illuminating the way. Its glowing body serves as a guide for lost travelers.

entry: POKENAME冰牙碰到什么水分，就冻什么。近身很危险，连训练家也能瞬间冻住。
author: teatedtiten
source: POKENAME's icy tusks will freeze any moisture that it touches. This makes being in close contact with them dangerous as it can freeze its Trainer instantaneously.

entry: POKENAME曾被认为是靠不融冰核驱动的古代造物。身体散出寒气，每一步，都瞬间令地面覆霜。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME was once thought to be an ancient construct powered by a core of Never-Melt Ice. Its body radiates freezing air, instantly frosting the ground with every step it takes.

entry: POKENAME收集小饰物与冰锥状挂饰，暴风雪里摇得诡异作响。谁想偷，就会遭冰冷凝视，冻在原地。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME collects trinkets and icicle-shaped charms, rattling them ominously during blizzards. Anyone who tries to steal its collection is met with an intense, icy glare that can freeze them in place.

entry: POKENAME与其他宝可梦玩类似冰球的游戏，磨炼捕猎本领。先将平地覆冰，再用棍打石，将它滑向对手那边。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME hones its hunting skills by playing a hockey-like game with other Pokémon. It covers a flat surface with ice, then uses a stick to strike a rock and slide it towards the opponent's side.

entry: 这些异常宝可梦，能从刺翼放出寒气或酷热。严寒与极热气候都有发现，有时还作当地顶级猎手。
author: infinex21
source: These abnormal Pokémon are capable of releasing freezing air or sweltering heat from their spike-like wings. They have been spotted in blistering hot climates and frigid cold climates, often seen acting as the local apex predator in some cases.

entry: POKENAME啃穿实冰，将大嘴探进冰水，等鱼宝可梦游近或察看发光嘴巴。它是热门冰钓伙伴，也启发了钓具发明。
author: pjporwoll
source: To hunt, POKENAME gnaws through solid ice, sticks its open maw into freezing water, and waits for unaware fish Pokémon to swim too close or inspect its glowing mouth. It is a popular ice fishing companion and inspiration for fishing inventions.

entry: POKENAME的眼膜防止雪盲，方便穿过极地捕猎。分泌的酸，帮助分解冻住的猎物进食。
author: mepp.
source: The membrane over POKENAME's eyes prevents snow blindness when it hunts across the arctic landscape. The acid it produces helps break down frozen prey for consumption.

entry: POKENAME一察觉生命迹象，就会引发寒冰爆炸，冻结附近的一切。它不断追逐目标，直到整片区域全都冰封。
author: mistershaokahn
source: When POKENAME detects signs of life, it triggers an icy explosion that freezes everything nearby. It relentlessly pursues its target until the area is completely frozen.

entry: POKENAME先裹薄冰，再飞夜空，让天敌难抓住。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME coats its body in a thin layer of ice before flying through the night sky. This makes it harder to grab for predators.

entry: POKENAME闭眼时，与普通冰壶石毫无分别。有人用它在奥运会作弊，闹出争议。
author: kiwiarms
source: A POKENAME with its eyes closed is indistinguishable from a normal curling rock. Controversy began when one was used to cheat at the Olympics.

entry: POKENAME的爪子裹着多层坚冰，更加坚固，能轻松切开岩石，寻找矿物吃。腹内产生的寒冷气体，维持着身上的冰层。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's claws are clad in many layers of solid ice to further reinforce them, allowing them to easily cut through solid rock in search of minerals to eat. It maintains the ice on its body with a freezing gas it produces within its gut.

entry: POKENAME遇强敌，便从大嘴放冻气，周围常笼罩冷雾。住在富矿物的洞里，长年寒雾弥漫，阻止闯入者。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME exudes a freezing gas from its maw when confronted by a strong foe, typically veiling its surroundings in a cold mist. Its den within a mineral-rich cave is constantly filled with a chilling mist to keep out intruders.

entry: 锐刺帮助它轻松穿过冰地。下雪会让壳变厚，便滚遍山地，脱掉多余冰层。
author: mistymagius
source: The sharp spikes on its body allow it to easily traverse icy terrain. Its shell grows thicker when it snows, so it will roll around the mountain to shed the extra layers.

entry: POKENAME不许任何人穿过冰封家园。发现谁，先用冰吼冻实，再粗暴踢出去。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME refuses to allow anyone to travel across the frozen realm it calls home. Any that are found by it are frozen solid by its icy roar before being violently kicked out.

entry: POKENAME在冰洞外啃冰锥磨牙，享受嘴里的冰冷感。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME sharpens its teeth by chewing on icicles outside of frozen caverns. It enjoys the icy cold sensation on its mouth.

entry: 它的外貌与超级冰鬼护极为相似。断裂的下颌，让它不断从口中喷出暴风雪。
author: soup1900
source: Its appearance is extremely similar to that of Mega Glalie. Its broken jaw causes it to spew endless blizzards from its mouth.

entry: POKENAME的羽毛适合极地气候。舞动掀起冰风，将看入迷的对手冻住。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's feathers make it well suited to live in arctic climates. As it dances, it whips up icy winds to freeze captivated opponents.

entry: POKENAME假扮人类堆的大号雪人。猎物靠近，就拉进冰冷、满是毒烟的体内。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME disguise themselves as larger versions of the snowmen often made by humans. When prey draws near, they will pull them into their frigid bodies that are filled with toxic fumes.

entry: POKENAME刚被发现，曾被误认为雄性雪妖女。近来才知，它附身于熬不过严冬、冻死树木的残骸。
author: katieplaysgames
source: When they were first discovered, POKENAME were thought to be a male variant of Froslass. More recently they have been discovered to be Pokémon that possess the frozen remains of trees that have perished over harsh winters.

entry: POKENAME振翼掀起强暴风雪，既防身，也用来占领地。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME flaps its wings to create powerful blizzards. This serves as both a defense mechanism and a way to claim territory.

entry: POKENAME全身与双翼覆着厚雪，足以缓冲物理打击。它在积雪的树上筑巢，借雪色隐藏身形。
author: mistymagius
source: A layer of thick snow coats POKENAME's body and wings which is thick enough to dampen physical hits. It creates its nest in snowy trees to camouflage itself amongst the snow.

entry: POKENAME曾是“石英冰冻光束”队的吉祥物，可它缺乏鲜明个性，最终被冰人偶取代。
author: t.i.a.
source: The former mascot of the Indigo Ice Beams. POKENAME's lack of attitude made it obsolete when Glamime replaced it.

entry: POKENAME先冻食物，再慢慢消化，高效吸取养分。背上的结晶构造，其实是耐零下低温的特殊真菌。
author: oddwalls
source: POKENAME freezes its food before consumption, digesting it slowly to extract nutrients efficiently. The crystalline formations on its back are a specialized fungus that can withstand subzero temperatures.

entry: POKENAME叫声如卡车喇叭，用来宣示领地。夜里听到，会格外不安。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME emits a cry like a truck horn to announce its territory. Hearing this sound at night can be incredibly unsettling.

entry: POKENAME颈刺在战斗中伸长、变尖，既能进攻，也能防守。
author: .izik
source: The spikes on POKENAME's neck extend and sharpen in battle. This adaptation provides both offensive and defensive capabilities.

entry: 它在冰雪北地捕猎，借自己召来的暴风雪掩护。遭成群POKENAME袭击后，最后听到的，是它们咯咯的笑。
author: bobosmith01
source: It hunts in the frigid, snow-covered north under the guise of a blizzard it has summoned. The last thing you hear after being attacked by a pack of POKENAME is their chortling laughter.

entry: 背上冻蘑菇若脱落，几天就长出新的。有些地方把冰蘑菇当冷冻零嘴，卖给口味独特的人。
author: sk372
source: Should the frozen mushrooms on its back fall off, new ones will form in a few days' time. In some regions, these icy shrooms are sold as a frozen treat for those with unique tastes.

entry: 为了保护背上的蘑菇，POKENAME将空气中的水分冻结，在周围结成冰甲。真菌在其中休眠，不受损伤；待天气暖到足以融冰，才会散播孢子。
author: .jerden
source: To protect the mushroom on its back, POKENAME freezes moisture in the air into armor around it. The fungus remains dormant but unharmed until the weather is warm enough to melt the ice, which is when it scatters its spores.

entry: POKENAME锐利蓝眼，一瞥就能冻水。再用爪破冰，让对手落水。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME's piercing blue eyes are able to freeze water with just a glance. They then use their claws to break the ice, causing opponents to take a plunge.

entry: POKENAME从嘴与壳孔吐出冰冷雾气，将家园笼罩在冻雾中，阻止旅人闯领地。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME expels ice-cold mist from its mouth and the pores on its shell. It blankets its home in a freezing fog to deter travelers from invading its territory.

entry: POKENAME爱冻池塘与小湖，把倒霉泳者关进冰牢。谁能逃出，它就送利木果。
author: bagumbothimble
source: POKENAME delights in freezing the waters of ponds and small lakes, trapping any unlucky swimmers in an icy prison. POKENAME will offer a gift of Aspear berries to anyone who escapes the ice.

entry: POKENAME飞得越快，身体越冷。撞地时，会爆发足以冻结四周的寒气。
author: .izik
source: The faster POKENAME flies, the colder its body becomes. Upon impact with the ground, it releases a blast of cold strong enough to freeze the surroundings.

entry: POKENAME飞过刚发生雪崩的地方，发出如飞机坠落的诡异声，为雪景添上不安。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME flies over areas that recently experienced avalanches. It makes an eerie noise while it flies, like that of a crashing plane, adding an unsettling presence to the snowy landscape.

entry: 队友常把它头上的饰物，误认成冰球。若比赛里突然多了个球，多半就是从POKENAME身上来的。
author: apixelperfectionist
source: Its teammates often mistake the charm on its head for a hockey puck. If there's ever multiple pucks in a game, it's likely one came from a POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME喜欢与其他宝可梦打冰球，却常常拿不稳球杆。鳍肢无法牢牢抓住球杆，于是频频发生球杆砸到自己头上的意外。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME love to play hockey with other Pokémon but often have a hard time handling a hockey stick. Their flippers are unable to firmly grasp the stick, leading to many accidents where the stick slams into their heads.

entry: POKENAME冲过雪原，用火焰牙刺穿猎物。冰冷身体能吸收周围雪，暂时增强，让战斗撑得更久。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME charge through snowy tundras to pierce through prey with a Fire Fang. Their frosty bodies allow them to absorb snow around them, giving them a momentary boost to help them last longer in a fight.

entry: POKENAME体内炽热，摸着却冰冷，因此团团蒸汽诡异地翻涌。冲过苔原时，常吓到看见的训练家。
author: opossiblymage
source: POKENAME has a fiery inner temperature, yet it is freezing cold to the touch. Because of this, steam eerily rolls off of it in clouds, startling Trainers that see it charging past in the tundra.

entry: POKENAME全心投入团队，能花数小时规划战术与阵容。POKENAME外表虽冷，对伙伴却十分支持。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is extremely dedicated to its group, planning strategies and roster composition for hours on end. Despite its cold exterior, POKENAME is very supportive of its companions.

entry: POKENAME出拳途中，能从臂上射出冰锥，组合攻击威力惊人。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME can release icicles from its arms mid-punch. This combination makes its attacks devastatingly effective.

entry: POKENAME壳由纯冰构成，碎屑撞上也不刮伤。脱落后仍冰凉，是度假者极好的天然冷藏物。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's shell is made of pure ice that doesn't get scratched when hit by debris. This shell always stays cool even when shed off, making it a great natural cooler for vacationers to use.

entry: 缩进壳里时，它看起来像一颗足球。千万别不小心踢到POKENAME。
author: soup1900
source: When withdrawn into its shell, it has a similar look to that of a soccer ball. It is imperative to not accidentally kick POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME的蓝色火焰极冷，若未先与它交好，就想骑上去，便会被冻得结结实实。它们在雪原奔驰时，躯干上的通风口，会喷出热蒸汽。
author: infinex21
source: The blue flames of a POKENAME are so cold that anyone who tries to ride them without befriending them first will be frozen solid. The vent-like ports along their torsos exude hot steam as they gallop across snowfields.

entry: POKENAME用冰面具护脸。尾上的大舌贝凶悍，咬它催着战斗，可敌人再近，它也常浑然不觉。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME protects its face with a mask made of ice. The Shellder on its tail is aggressive, biting down to encourage POKENAME to attack, but POKENAME often remains oblivious even while enemies are close.

entry: POKENAME用冰面具护脸。尾上的大舌贝凶悍，咬它催着战斗，可敌人再近，它也常浑然不觉。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME protects its face with a mask made of ice. The Shellder on its tail is aggressive, biting down to encourage POKENAME to attack, but POKENAME often remains oblivious even while enemies are close.

entry: 暴雨时，POKENAME在高处等雷击。等待中，用冰息冻雨滴，再以无线电波解冻，练习控温。
author: darkweavile428
source: During a rainstorm, POKENAME will wait in high up places for lighting to strike. While it waits, POKENAME will freeze the raindrops using its icy breath, then unfreeze them using radio waves to practice its temperature altering powers.

entry: 许多POKENAME擅长控杆，便加入冰球队。流线双翼与冰凉冰鞋，让它能快速滑冰射门。
author: quackquackattack
source: Many POKENAME join hockey teams because of their adeptness at controlling their hockey stick. POKENAME's aerodynamic wings and frosty ice skates allow them to swiftly traverse across the ice to score points.

entry: 冰球选手常与POKENAME训练，因为它冰上速度快，反应敏捷，是出色的守门员。
author: .izik
source: Hockey players often train with POKENAME due to its speed on ice. Its quick reflexes make it an excellent goalie.

entry: POKENAME身上的冰沙，遇暖空气反而变硬。夏天，常因热得难以移动。
author: .izik
source: The frosty slush on POKENAME's body hardens in warm air. During summer, it often struggles to move due to the heat.

entry: POKENAME被称为寒海守护者，水中甲壳像冰山。船太近，炮便发射，瞬间冻住空气水分及一切碰到光束的东西。
author: oejoeboy33
source: Described as a guardian of the frigid seas, a POKENAME's shell seems like an iceberg in the water. If ships get too close, the cannons fire and instantly freeze moisture in the atmosphere along with anything that makes contact with its beam.

entry: POKENAME住在冰湖旁的沙里，向入侵者发冰刺，保卫领地。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME resides in the sand beside frozen lakes. It defends its territory by firing icy barbs at intruders.

entry: 身体气体能瞬间冻水，甚至冻住空气水分。谁直视第三眼，常被吓得僵在原地。
author: infinex21
source: The gases of its body can instantly freeze water and may even freeze moisture in the air. Those who look directly into its third eye will oft be frozen in place with fear.

entry: POKENAME藏在陡崖阴影，吓唬旅人。恶作剧常想让没防备的远足者失去平衡。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME hides in the shadows of sheer cliffsides to startle travelers. Its pranks often aim to knock unsuspecting hikers off balance.

entry: 它操纵团团冰能，冷得能灼伤几英尺内的一切。离POKENAME太远，就凝成致密冰块，因此很受冰雕训练家欢迎。
author: darxer_
source: It conducts powerful globs of icy energy so cold it will burn anything that gets within a few feet. The globs harden into dense ice when too far from POKENAME, which makes it popular for Trainers interested in ice sculpting.

entry: POKENAME先以超能力哄敌人沉睡，等对方不动，再从鼻口射冰锥，将其打倒。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses psychic powers to lull opponents into a deep sleep. Once immobilized, it fires icicles from its snout to finish them off.

entry: POKENAME在寒山捕猎，用丝带困住没戒心的猎物，再塞进背上种子，留待日后。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME hunts in the cold mountains, using its silky laces to trap unsuspecting prey. Once caught, the prey is stuffed into the bulb on its back, where it is stored for later.

entry: 受威胁时，POKENAME展开头顶蝴蝶状部位，模仿进化后的样子，恐吓天敌。
author: ambrosia04
source: When threatened, POKENAME spreads the butterfly-like appendage atop its head, imitating its evolution to intimidate predators.

entry: POKENAME在深洞休息，很像装饰冰雕。远足者进洞避难，常径直走过，没发觉这些安静如雕像的宝可梦正在注视。
author: ambrosia04
source: While resting inside deep caves, POKENAME look remarkably like decorative ice sculptures. Hikers seeking refuge in the caves often walk right past them without realizing that these quiet, statue-like Pokémon are actually watching them.

entry: 研究者认为，它们莫名能靠日月的微弱宇宙辐射维生。随后急旋，从周身紫孔放出冰冷空气，造出强暴风雪。
author: infinex21
source: Researchers believe these Pokémon are somehow able to live off the weak cosmic radiation of our sun and our moon. They then spin quickly as they release freezing cold air from the purple ports along their bodies, creating powerful Blizzards.

entry: POKENAME双翼主要是一层反光冰。据说看见翼中自己倒影的人，会被彻底冻住，再运回巢。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's wings are primarily composed of a very reflective sheen of ice. It is said that those who see their reflection in its wings will be frozen solid before being carried off to POKENAME's den.

entry: 雪林远足者得留意脚下，POKENAME常蜷在覆冰树根旁。头尾的实冰毒刺，用来注入麻痹毒液自卫。
author: ambrosia04
source: Trainers hiking through snowy woodlands must watch their step, as POKENAME often curls around icy tree roots. It defends itself using stingers made of solid ice located on its head and tail, which inject paralyzing venom into foes.

entry: POKENAME塑造冰雕，战斗时操纵，想攻就攻、想守就守。领地意识强，光对上眼就容易惹怒。
author: actliux
source: POKENAME shapes ice sculptures and manipulates them in battle to attack or defend for whatever purpose it needs. It is very territorial, and is easily angered merely by making eye contact.

entry: POKENAME常现身雾气浓重的寒地。它所居的水域里，能找到好几具冻住的潜水者遗体。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are usually sighted in colder regions with large amounts of fog. The frozen bodies of several divers can be found in POKENAME's waters.

entry: POKENAME在岸边等，用迷人歌声邀路人搭乘。谁接受，就冻成冰像，装饰背壳。
author: bacondlx
source: POKENAME waits at shores, offering rides to passersby and luring them in with its enchanting song. It freezes those who accept to adorn its shell with icy statues.

entry: POKENAME性格活泼凶悍，常将烦扰者彻底冻住。临近进化，造出的冰似乎会呈现不同颜色。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's spunky and aggressive personality means it is common for it to freeze nuisances solid. The ice it generates apparently takes on different colors as POKENAME nears evolution.

entry: POKENAME是冰湖里罕见的住民，常在深冰下生活。冒出时，多因察觉危险，会追寻源头，将其彻底冻住。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are the rarely-seen denizens of frozen lakes, as they often live deep under the ice. When they emerge, it is often because they sense danger nearby and will hunt it down and freeze the source of it solid.

entry: POKENAME冷雾寒得灼人，常穿过厚重暴风雪，寻找迷路训练家。若被善待，就依偎在旁，用厚暖毛为对方取暖。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's body can exude a chilling mist that is so cold that it burns. It often wanders through thick blizzards in search of lost Trainers and, if treated with kindness, will curl up with them and warm them with its thick, warm fur.

entry: POKENAME一动不动，挂在雪枝下，酷似大冰锥。看着无助，壳内却双臂交叉，随时反击，向威胁注入麻痹毒。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME hang motionless beneath snow-covered branches, closely resembling large icicles. Though seemingly helpless, they keep their arms crossed inside their shells, ready to strike threats, injecting a numbing venom into them.

entry: POKENAME住在山巅，不停绕山飞。常现身受伤或迷路的登山者面前，背着他们安全下山。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME live at the peaks of mountains, circling them constantly. They will often appear before injured or lost climbers, helping them safely descend by carrying them on their backs.

entry: POKENAME懒懒乘极地风，飞过苔原。性情较平静，脱落鳞粉却极毒，意外接触，会先头晕，再昏迷。
author: ghostslythe
source: POKENAME lazily uses arctic winds to fly across the tundra. While relatively calm in nature, any scales it sheds are highly toxic. Accidental exposure leads to dizziness followed by unconsciousness.

entry: POKENAME冻住受害者，趁冰封时洗脑。解冻后，对方便余生只想着陪伴、同它玩。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME freezes over victims and brainwashes them while they are frozen. Once it thaws them out, they can only think of keeping it company and playing with it for the rest of their days.

entry: POKENAME格外有节庆气息，似乎只在冬天出现，新年到来便消失。常捉弄人和宝可梦，飞着咯咯笑。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME is a particularly festive Pokémon that seems to only appear during winter and disappears by the time of a new year. It often loves to play small pranks on humans and Pokémon alike, audibly giggling as it flies about.

entry: POKENAME罕见，民间说是雪山守护者。探险者虽难见其身，只要发现隐蔽庇护处开满纯净高山花，便知它就在附近。
author: sneakywalrus0
source: POKENAME sightings are rare, and folklore says that they are guardians of snow-capped mountains. Despite being hard to find, explorers know when they are near, finding their sheltered sanctuaries covered in pristine alpine flowers.

entry: POKENAME成群飞过严寒洞穴，口吐冰气，先冻敌人，群体再一同扑下。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME flies with its swarm through frigid caverns. It expels icy air from its mouth to freeze foes before the group descends together.

entry: POKENAME用多翼藏住大半脸与身体。有人以为只是害羞，也有人传说，只瞥见脸，就会连灵魂一起冻住。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses its multiple wings to hide most of its face and body from view. Some think it is simply shy, while others spread folk tales that a single glimpse of POKENAME's face will freeze a person down to their soul.

entry: POKENAME虽性情残酷，仍因闪耀美貌受人追捧。它住在冰洞，夜空滑翔时，周身如钻石般的冰尘闪烁。
author: bobosmith01
source: A cruel Pokémon that is nonetheless coveted for its sparkling beauty, POKENAME shimmers with diamond dust as it glides through the night sky. It lives in icy caverns.

entry: 大冰雹后，POKENAME聚集捡冰粒，做小星饰。永不融化，常被当奢侈品出售。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME will gather after large hailstorms to collect the fallen hail to create little star-shaped ornaments. These ornaments never melt and are commonly sold as luxury items.

entry: POKENAME周围空气，电光与冰晶噼啪作响。它能让电流穿过冷空气。
author: musicsheep.
source: The air surrounding POKENAME crackles with electricity and ice crystals. It can conduct electricity through cold air.

entry: POKENAME飞过留下冰雾，快速振翼，就能造暴风雪，将敌人彻底冻住。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME leave trails of icy mist as they fly. By rapidly flapping their wings, they can create blizzards that freeze foes solid.

entry: POKENAME天性极谨慎，喜欢雪林深处废弃小屋，因为暖和。附近没房子，普通洞穴也能将就。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME are extremely cautious by nature. While they prefer to nest inside abandoned cottages deep within snowy forests, a simple cave will suffice if no buildings are nearby. POKENAME favor these cottages because of their warmth.

entry: 许多故事说，POKENAME会诅咒不忠男人，醒来浑身刺痛，如同徒手碰乌波。唯有浸进冰水，才能解除。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: There are many stories of POKENAME cursing unfaithful men that wake up with a stinging sensation like that of touching a Wooper with bare hands, all over their body. The only cure is to submerge themselves in icy cold water.

entry: POKENAME静候洞里，等猎物进来，却很容易被新宝可梦分心。马上丢下捕猎去玩，有时冰冷拥抱，还不慎冻住玩伴。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME wait quietly in caves for prey to wander in. However, they are easily distracted by new Pokémon, immediately abandoning the hunt to play and sometimes accidentally freezing their playmates with a chilly hug.

entry: POKENAME戴冰冠、拖长纱，在雪原散布幻象。它轻松滑行，用超能力将猎物冻在原地。
author: the_lunarian
source: With its icy crown and flowing veil, POKENAME casts illusions across the snow-covered plains. It glides effortlessly, freezing prey in place using its psychic powers.

entry: POKENAME背上的水晶，由永不融的冰川冰构成，吸收山间冻气长大。战斗时，会向敌人打出极冷的雾拳。
author: ambrosia04
source: The crystal on POKENAME's back is made of unmelting glacial ice that grows larger by absorbing freezing mountain air. When in battle, it will unleash an extremely cold mist punch upon its enemies.

entry: POKENAME的牙全是冰，为免融化，只能短暂离开雪山。
author: goober145
source: POKENAME's teeth are made entirely of ice, so it can only leave its snowy mountains for short periods of time to keep them from melting.

entry: POKENAME情绪感知出奇敏锐，能制造酷热天气，让猎物绝望，也会安慰别人，借机利用；有时倒也是真心安慰。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME shows surprising emotional intelligence. It can create blistering weather to instill hopelessness in prey, or comfort others to exploit them. At times, it comforts others genuinely as well.

entry: 这危险宝可梦藏在苔原与冰封水域的冰下，谁不幸闯到住处，就吃谁。有时，POKENAME光靠凝视造出蜃景，戏弄食物。
author: beatdoof
source: A dangerous Pokémon hiding beneath the ice of tundras and frozen bodies of water, it will eat any unfortunate souls coming across its dwelling. Sometimes, POKENAME will play with its food by creating mirages from its gaze alone.

entry: POKENAME通常在北方森林，周身零下寒意。人类体热让它见到人就兴奋。它们也曾救下雪崩中的训练家，用子弹拳击雪、挡住岩石。
author: ghostslythe
source: Generally found in boreal forests, POKENAME's body is wreathed in sub-zero temperatures. They become excited when spotting humans due to their heat. Many have saved Trainers from avalanches, Bullet Punching the snow and shielding them from rocks.

entry: POKENAME与名冰雕师并肩凿冰，创作宏伟艺术。和训练家接连工作数天甚至数周，几乎不休息，怕拖久了作品会融化。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME chisel ice alongside prestigious ice sculptors to carve grand displays of art. They work alongside their Trainers for several days or even weeks with little rest, as the passage of time risks melting their work.

entry: 战斗中，POKENAME在爪上结冰，化成刀、棍等形状痛打对手。暴怒时，血流增加，皮肤泛红。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME create chunks of ice on their claws during battle, ranging in shapes from a blade to a club to batter opponents. When enraged, their skin turns a reddish hue due to increased blood flow.

entry: POKENAME壳里充满冻气，温度低到跻身有记录的最低温。其他宝可梦太近，便释放，将其彻底冻住。
author: secondegg
source: POKENAME's shell is full of freezing gases, at some of the coldest temperatures ever recorded. When other Pokémon get too close, it releases these gases, freezing them solid.

entry: POKENAME爬过温带海藻林，用孤单可怜的外表，引来天敌。对方靠近，就从隐蔽喷口射冰封住，再拖回巢。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME crawls through temperate kelp forests, luring in predators with its solitude and forlorn appearance. When the predator gets close, POKENAME encases it with ice from a concealed jet, before dragging the prey to its lair.

entry: POKENAME藏在雪中，等着攻击猎物。毒会让身体僵住，像被完全冻结。
author: raydrago
source: POKENAME hides itself in the snow, waiting to strike its prey. POKENAME‘s poison causes the body to lock up as if frozen solid.

entry: POKENAME厚毛抵御最严寒环境。受激便从象鼻喷冰雾，彻底冻住对手。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME's thick fur lets them brave even the coldest environments. When provoked, they will fire icy mist from their trunks, freezing opponents solid.

entry: POKENAME用尾液作画，再以冰息冻住。也会冻其他宝可梦，让它们乖乖不动，方便写生。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME paints using liquid from its tail, freezing it solid using its icy breath. It has been known to freeze other Pokémon using the same ability, so that they remain still while it sketches them.

entry: 冰地传说，POKENAME曾是心灵空洞的人，被诅咒徘徊山间。它蜷起装脆弱，再迅速出击，以长颈缠紧猎物。
author: mepp.
source: Legends in icy regions claim that POKENAME were once hollow-hearted individuals cursed to wander the mountains. Each curls up to appear frail before swiftly striking and constricting prey with its long neck.

entry: POKENAME出现在暴风雪里，乘冰风若隐若现。光看一眼，就会寒意刺骨，心生大祸将至的恐惧。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME appear within snowstorms, barely visible as they ride along the icy winds. Merely gazing at them causes one to experience a sharp chill and an imminent sense of dread.

entry: POKENAME缎带轻碰，就能冻住整片水域与其中一切。它视冻水为纯净与美的极致，谁想解冻作品，就会惹它不快。
author: sk372
source: A single touch of POKENAME's ribbon is enough to completely freeze over a body of water and anything within. POKENAME views frozen water as the pinnacle of purity and beauty, and reacts poorly to any who try to thaw out its works of art.

entry: POKENAME借彩羽，在空中造出绚丽极光捕猎。看客被色彩迷住，没察觉它潜近，便被彻底冻住。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can generate amazingly prismatic aurora displays in the air thanks to its colorful plumage. These displays are how it hunts; onlookers are so distracted by the colors, they don't see POKENAME sneaking up close to freeze them solid.

entry: POKENAME有好几辈子的雕塑经验，技法历来师徒相传。它教授复杂技巧，雕成华美作品。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have had lifetimes of experience creating grand sculptures, and their techniques are traditionally passed down from teacher to student. They educate students on complex techniques to carve out gorgeous works of art.

entry: 雪山村落更常传出不明飞行物目击，原因是POKENAME飞上天空，吃大气电流。有记录曾飞到超过6万英尺。
author: novembermagnus
source: Reports of U.F.O. sightings are more common in snowy mountain villages. This phenomenon is attributed to POKENAME taking flight to feed on electric currents in the atmosphere. POKENAME has been recorded reaching altitudes of over 60,000 feet.

entry: 心跳越快，能放出的电力便越多；心跳越慢，吐出的冰息便越寒冷。
author: darkweavile428
source: The higher its heart rate, the more electrical energy it's able to output. The lower its heart rate, the colder its icy breath is.

entry: 再肆虐的暴风雪，POKENAME也能完美优雅地漂浮。它曾引导迷路探险者安全下山。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME float with perfect grace even amidst raging blizzards. They have been known to guide lost explorers safely down mountainsides.

entry: POKENAME能轻松滑过最狂暴的风暴，在肆虐暴风雪中很占优势。它完全没骨头，身体大半中空。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME can glide through the most disruptive of storms with ease, which helps it immensely in rampaging blizzards. It entirely lacks bones, and much of its body is hollow.

entry: POKENAME在雪林家园快得仿佛无处不在。据传是保护过度的守卫，会冻住想离开的住民，确保永远安全留在看护下。
author: _blissey
source: POKENAME's speed gives others the illusion that it is everywhere at once within its snowy forest home. Rumored to be an overprotective guardian, it freezes other inhabitants who attempt to leave, making sure they are forever safe under its watch.

entry: POKENAME裹着极光般的青焰，轻松滑过雪地。刀刃和服袖使出快速武技，踢腿时，闪亮冰霜四散。
author: ambrosia04
source: Shrouded in cyan flames that resemble an aurora, POKENAME glide effortlessly over snowy terrain. They perform rapid martial maneuvers with their bladed kimono sleeves, scattering glittering frost with their kicks.

entry: POKENAME住在雪地。角一感到有人，就迅速藏起来。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME are found living in snowy regions. When their horn senses the presence of someone, they quickly hide away.

entry: POKENAME一感到危险，就会唤起强烈的暴风雪。POKENAME十分珍视朋友与训练家。
author: jona_hehe
source: When POKENAME senses danger, it will summon a powerful blizzard. POKENAME cares deeply for its friends and Trainer.

entry: 深冬，POKENAME在暴风雪里现身起舞。碰过的表面全成冰，若与训练家亲近，便为其屋画上永久冰霜艺术。
author: ghostslythe
source: In the dead of winter, POKENAME appear dancing in blizzards. Every surface they touch turns to ice, and if they bond with a Trainer, they mark the human's house in permanent frosty art.

entry: POKENAME内敛、不合群，几乎不流露情绪。冰雪暴与扭曲世界的黑洞背后，其实是想被训练家疼爱，却怕得不敢说的宝可梦。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are subtle asocial creatures that rarely show any emotion. Behind the frosty blizzards and world-warping black holes is a Pokémon that craves affection from its Trainer but is too scared to ask.

entry: POKENAME冰冷的心，与正义感相冲突。遇上落难女子，总迅速相助，却很少在意男性安危。
author: musicsheep.
source: POKENAME's cold heart is conflicted with justice. It is quick to help a woman in trouble, but seldom cares for the wellbeing of men.

entry: POKENAME住在冬日山巅，吐息低至华氏零下108度，瞬间冻住敌人。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME lives on the peaks of wintry mountains. It freezes foes in an instant with its icy breath reaching -108 degrees Fahrenheit.

entry: POKENAME独居在寒冷山区的深处，它缎带般的藤蔓，只需轻轻一碰，就能让人寒冷彻骨。它借此夺取体温，使背上的冰川保持冰冷而坚实。
author: sk372
source: Solitary creatures that make their homes deep within frigid mountain areas, just a touch from POKENAME's ribbon-like vines will chill a person to the bone. It steals body heat this way in order to keep the glacier on its back frigid and robust.

entry: 旅行若遇POKENAME靠近，得给足尊重。若觉受辱，就冻住冒犯者双腿，让人躲不开痛苦头锤。
author: sk372
source: Should a POKENAME approach you during your travels, be sure to give it proper respect. If it feels offended, it will freeze the offender's legs, leaving them unable to avoid a very painful headbutt.

entry: 雪封村落曾敬POKENAME为神圣保护者。据说觉得不被感激，就毫无预兆冻住冒犯者。
author: .izik
source: Snowbound villages once revered POKENAME as a divine protector. If it felt unappreciated, it was said to freeze offenders solid without warning.

entry: POKENAME留下的割伤，会让寒意深入身体，永不消退。融合技术出现前，人们曾以为它只是都市传说。
author: .fedoraman
source: A cut from a POKENAME leaves a chill deep in your core that never fades. They were thought to be urban legends until the advent of fusion technology.

entry: POKENAME双眼看透迷路旅人的灵魂。若认为值得救，便引下山；否则一路跟踪，直到对方死亡。
author: mary_the_jane
source: POKENAME uses its eyes to see through lost travelers' souls. If it deems them worthy of grace it will guide them down the mountain. Otherwise it will stalk the traveler until they meet their demise.

entry: POKENAME猛烈振翼，发出歌声般的响动，卷起极冷旋风，将卷入的一切冻结。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: POKENAME flaps its wings furiously, creating a sound similar to singing. This kicks up a whirl of extremely cold air that freezes anything caught within it.

entry: 传说有只雪白蛇形宝可梦，曾平息寒冷北方的部族战争。华美晶鳞如冰闪耀，身白如雪，据传沉睡在冰湖底。
author: wolfbrine
source: A legend tells of a white, serpentine Pokémon that once soothed a war between tribes in the cold north. It is said to be as white as snow with gorgeous crystal scales that gleam like ice. It is rumored to rest at the bottom of a frozen lake.

entry: 它们耐心跟着困在骤雪里的远足者，等其筋疲力尽。食物稀少，POKENAME也会假装人类呼救，将猎物引进山。
author: turron_turron
source: They patiently follow hikers caught out in snow squalls, waiting for exhaustion to set in. When food is scarce, POKENAME will lure prey into the mountains by feigning human distress.

entry: POKENAME向寒冷旅人递缎带，触感舒适温暖。倒霉的人们，直到太迟才明白，缎带正将自己彻底冻住。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME offers its ribbons to cold travelers, the touch of which provides feelings of comfort and warmth. The unfortunate souls don't realize POKENAME's ribbons are freezing them solid until it is far too late.

entry: POKENAME为守护世界，用冰息冻结来袭流星体，震碎成尘。信众感念它抵御宇宙威胁，向它献上无数祈祷。
author: fiordaliso
source: To protect the world, POKENAME freezes incoming meteoroids with its icy breath, shattering them to dust. This guardian receives numerous prayers from believers who honor its defense against cosmic threats.

entry: 民间故事说，POKENAME或将旅人掳去冰王国，或提供庇护、引导回家。传说地点附近的居民说，两者皆真，全看旅人心性。
author: wiz0z
source: Folk stories say that POKENAME either steal away travelers to a kingdom made of ice or provide them shelter and guidance home. Locals near these supposed locations suggest that both are true depending on the heart of the traveler.

entry: POKENAME爱在雪村附近逗留，尽力引远足者走出冰雪。独特外形，也启发许多时装设计师。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME love to hang around snowy villages, trying their best to guide hikers out of the snow. Their unique appearance has inspired many fashion designers.

entry: POKENAME光是存在，就让栖身山地雷暴与暴风雪交加。只有最顽强的训练家，才能跋涉其中，找到巢穴。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's presence alone causes the mountains it dwells in to be wracked with a combination of thunderstorms and blizzards. Only the hardiest of Trainers are able to trek through these conditions and find POKENAME's den.

entry: 博物学家遍寻山岭，盼找到POKENAME。它在山间空地的家园，长着别处没有的高山植物。可寻觅者一被发现，它就会掀起致命暴风雪，迫其退走。
author: sneakywalrus0
source: Naturalists scour mountains hoping to find POKENAME, whose homes in mountain clearings contain alpine flora found nowhere else. However, this is hazardous as POKENAME can create deadly blizzards if these hunters are caught, forcing them to retreat.

entry: POKENAME披霜舞过暴风雪，诱引旅人。谁摸精致耳朵，就被优雅一踢，彻底冻住。中空体内，只有刺骨严寒。
author: cerealjamalt
source: POKENAME cloaks itself in frost while it dances through blizzards to lure travelers. Those who touch its delicate ears are frozen solid by a graceful kick. Its hollow body holds only bitter cold.

entry: POKENAME不停产生冷气，降低周围温度，因此常被养在家，当空调。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME's bodies constantly produce cold air, lowering the temperature around them. They are often kept in homes as air conditioners for this reason.

entry: 废宅被雪覆盖，POKENAME便成新主人。传说留在领地太久，就会加入灵界。它连靠近另一只同类都不肯。
author: bobosmith01
source: When abandoned mansions are blanketed in snow, POKENAME becomes the mansion's new owner. Legends say those who stay in POKENAME's domain for too long join the spirit world. A POKENAME will refuse to even be in proximity to another POKENAME.

entry: 獠牙由零度以下的坚冰构成，强韧如钢。POKENAME通常住在既危险，又寒冷的冰窟。
author: soup1900
source: Its tusks are made of subzero ice that is as strong as steel. POKENAME usually resides in icy caves where it is both treacherous and cold.

entry: POKENAME脸戴面具，顶着冰角，一身纯白毛。无声踏过风雪，厚爪毛分散雪上的重量，双臂抱着迷路孩子。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME possess masked faces capped with icy horns and coats of pure white fur. They tread silently through blizzards, using the thick fur on their paws to distribute their weight across snowdrifts while their arms to carry lost children.

entry: POKENAME不断造冷气，身体却装不下。有时只得停下，打开伪装，让气放出去。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME constantly generate cold air, which their body cannot contain. This prompts POKENAME to occasionally stop and open up their disguise to let the air out.

entry: POKENAME亲人又活泼，爱蹦过雪原，与训练家玩。颈上的厚红围巾放出柔暖，免得精力旺盛的身体受寒。
author: ambrosia04
source: Extremely affectionate and spirited, POKENAME love bounding through snowfields to play with their Trainers. The thick red scarves around their necks radiate gentle warmth, preventing their energetic bodies from growing chilly.

entry: POKENAME活力四射，在山坡嬉闹。奔跑时，冰尾接住落下粉雪，留下旋转闪亮的雪帘。欢快跳跃的模样，让旁观者也很开心。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME frolic energetically across mountain slopes. Their icy tails trap fallen powder as they run, leaving behind swirling curtains of glittering snow that delight anyone watching their playful leaps.

entry: POKENAME感知所有靠近者的波导。若不喜欢，就吐冷气，将那人暂时变成冰像。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME senses the auras of everyone that comes near it. If it dislikes a person's aura, it breathes out a chilling vapor that turns the person into a frozen statue temporarily.

entry: POKENAME高速振动冰翼，能发出引发大雪崩的超声波。常在高耸雪峰筑巢，避开人类文明。
author: fiordaliso
source: If POKENAME vibrates its ice wings very rapidly, it can create ultrasonic waves capable of triggering massive avalanches. It tends to nest atop high, snow-capped peaks, shunning human civilization.

entry: POKENAME过于谨慎，造暴风雪、躲雪堆，避开人与宝可梦。毛上覆冰、减慢呼吸，能在强风里纹丝不动。
author: ambidexhex
source: POKENAME whips up blizzards and hides in snowbanks to conceal itself from people and Pokémon due to its overly cautious nature. It can hold perfectly still in strong winds by coating its fur in ice and slowing its breathing.

entry: POKENAME夜里用尾光，将迷路登山者引回巢。看似暖火，实则放出零下寒意，一碰就严重冻伤。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME lures lost climbers to its lair at night using the glow of its tail. Though it looks like a warm fire, the flame releases sub-zero temperatures, causing severe frostbite upon contact.

entry: 它掳走雪山迷路者，抓起升入大气，直到对方死于寒冷或稀薄空气，POKENAME才肯松手。
author: bandedbodypress
source: It spirits away those who get lost on snow capped mountains. It picks its victims up and rises into the atmosphere, where they perish from the cold or thin atmosphere. Only then POKENAME lets go.

entry: POKENAME游荡高海拔雪原，用冰颚碾碎冻石。气候变暖，熔化偏远山间栖地，让它面临局部灭绝。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME roam high-altitude snowfields, crushing frozen stone with their icy jaws. As warmer climates melt their secluded mountain habitats, they have become threatened with local extinction.

entry: 它哭泣，闪亮水珠从眼里浮起。不是伤心，是有人发现隐蔽山巢，令它喜极而泣。
author: .izik
source: When it cries, shimmering water drops levitate from its eyes. It cries not from sadness but from joy when someone discovers its hidden mountain den.

entry: POKENAME用嬉闹手势与怪笑戏弄旅人。跟随者却困进冰冷心理游戏，被残酷、久久不散的折磨渐渐击垮。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME toys with travelers through playful gestures and eerie laughter, but those who follow are trapped in freezing mind games, slowly broken by its cruel, lingering torment.

entry: POKENAME只适合冰冻山谷，尤其怕突发热浪，便深埋雪里保冷。有时却被其他觅食宝可梦打扰。
author: ambrosia04
source: Thriving only in freezing mountain valleys, POKENAME are particularly vulnerable to sudden heatwaves. They bury themselves deep in the snow to keep cold, but they are sometimes disturbed by other foraging Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME始终无比宁静，激战也不例外。舞动时，冻结周围水分，造出美丽冰景。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME always holds an air of perfect serenity, even during intense battles. It is capable of freezing the moisture around it as it dances to create beautiful icy displays.

entry: 偶尔能在冰峰顶，见这神秘的龙掀暴风雪与旋风。雪特大的夜里，POKENAME曾被误认作新月。
author: leofric1814
source: This mystical drake can occasionally be found at the summit of icy peaks whipping up blizzards and twisters. On particularly snowy nights, POKENAME has been mistaken for a crescent moon.

entry: POKENAME跳过北方针叶林，撒出冷得一碰就覆霜的孢子。平时用来保植物越冬，可人若威胁家园，就会把对方冻在原地。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME hop through taigas while scattering spores cold enough to encase whatever they touch with frost. While they normally focus this power on preserving plants through winter, if a human threatens their homes, they will freeze them in place.

entry: POKENAME由冻海藻与沉没残骸构成，带着船舵和覆霜锁链，无声巡游冰川水域，缠住、赶走闯领地者。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME have bodies composed of frozen kelp and sunken debris. Bearing ship wheels and frost-covered chains, they silently patrol glacial waters to ensnare and drive away any intruders who enter their territory.

entry: 酷暑里，小宝可梦想躲POKENAME身下乘凉，通常此后再不见踪影。据传是它进食的方式，多数研究者却怕得不敢确认。
author: huh.7
source: During the blazing heat of the summer, small Pokémon attempt to hide under POKENAME to cool off. They are usually never seen again. It's rumored that this is how POKENAME feeds, but most researchers are too scared to confirm this.

entry: POKENAME身体材料像玻璃纤维。若吃下，胃里就会一直发痒。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME's body is made out of a material comparable to fiberglass. If you eat the substance, you will have an itching sensation in your stomach indefinitely.

entry: 暴风雪里，POKENAME假扮洞穴，让小宝可梦以为能安全休息。一进去，猎物就被拖进雪下，封冰留待日后吃。
author: oejoeboy33
source: POKENAME mimics a cave for small Pokémon during snow storms, offering a safe place to rest. Once inside, its prey is dragged underneath the snow, encased into ice for later consumption.

entry: 它不爱访客，急切看着登山者下山。若留了装备，就淘气地踢下去，跟着他们走。
author: .izik
source: Disliking visitors, it eagerly watches mountain climbers descend its peak. If any equipment is left behind, it mischievously kicks it down after them.

entry: 颈边缎带状结构，是身体一部分，用来调节核心温度。体温若超过华氏0度，便再以缎带降温。
author: .izik
source: The ribbon-like structure around its neck is part of its body, helping regulate its core temperature. If it rises above 0°F, the ribbon cools it further.

entry: POKENAME通常被训练守卫雪峰附近的神殿。顺从天性与控冰本领，让它格外受追捧。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is a creature usually trained to guard temples built near snowy peaks. Its obedient nature and skill in controlling ice make it a particularly sought-after Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME通常被训练守卫雪峰附近的神殿。顺从天性与控冰本领，让它格外受追捧。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is a creature usually trained to guard temples built near snowy peaks. Its obedient nature and skill in controlling ice make it a particularly sought-after Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME喷出寒息，将猎物冻在原地捕获。过去，冰封北地的猎人身旁常有POKENAME相伴。
author: pendragonic
source: POKENAME hunt their prey by freezing them in place with their breath. In the past, hunters in the frozen north would often be accompanied by POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME性情反复难测，用怪笑与寒冷把戏嘲弄对手，再以重爪上的剃刀般冰爪，凶狠击倒。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME possess unpredictable, erratic temperaments. They taunt opponents with mocking cackles and chilly tricks, then viciously strike them down using the razor-sharp ice claws on their heavy paws.

entry: POKENAME弹三味线，曲调幽美得摄人。每拨一音，空气水分便结晶，闪亮霜花随乐节舞动。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME play hauntingly beautiful melodies on their shamisen. Each note plucked from the instrument crystallizes moisture in the air, creating sparkling flurries of frost that dance in rhythm with their music.

entry: POKENAME唱出特定旋律频率，操纵天气，用金色指挥棒驾驭风与雷电。外表欢快，脾气却意外严厉，常训斥不听话的同伴。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME manipulate the weather by singing specific melodic frequencies, steering wind and lightning with golden batons. Despite their cheerful appearance, they possess surprisingly fierce tempers and will sternly reprimand unruly peers.

entry: 夜里，POKENAME无声漂过雪暴，凝望片片落雪。发现训练家迷路，便轻轻送回家，让其在暖床安心休息。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME silently drifts through snowstorms at night, pondering the snowflakes as they fall. If it spots a Trainer lost in the snow, it will gently carry them back home, ensuring they can rest easy in a nice warm bed.

entry: POKENAME放出的寒气，令身体与斧头总裹着霜。力量太强，挥斧掀起的冻风，连前方四英尺外的地面也能冷透。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME exudes such frigid air that its body and its axe are always clad in frost. It is so strong that swinging its axe can churn up a frigid gale strong enough to chill the ground over four feet ahead of itself.

entry: POKENAME住在雪山洞穴，守着冰封领地。谁闯洞，就会遭到冰杖召来的猛烈暴风雪。
author: fairywood16
source: POKENAME dwells in caves among snowy mountains, where it watches over its frozen territory. Any intruders to POKENAME's cave will be met with an intense blizzard conjured from its icy staff.

entry: POKENAME造暴风雪藏身，发射冰手里剑打倒敌人，再带回巢作装饰。
author: darkweavile428
source: POKENAME creates blizzards for it to conceal itself within. It launches throwing stars made of ice to defeat its foes, then takes its victims back to its den to become decorations.

entry: POKENAME用背上水晶，吸走空气暖意。夏天被租给人们，给家里降温。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME sap warmth from the air using the crystals on their back. They are rented out to people during the summer to help keep homes cool.

entry: 它只为捕猎离开寒冷山巅，将猎物冻住，再拖回巢。常与伽勒尔地区某种宝可梦混淆。
author: sk372
source: It only departs from its home in cold mountain peaks to hunt and freeze prey, dragging them back to its den. It's often confused with a Pokémon from the Galar region.

entry: POKENAME与烘焙师、甜点师合作，比谁都先吃到美味。吃满足了，再朝剩余点心吐出带胡椒薄荷香的寒气。
author: quackquackattack
source: By working alongside bakers and confectioners, POKENAME gets access to delicious treats before anyone else. After eating until it is satisfied, it will release a frosty breath of peppermint over the remaining treats.

entry: POKENAME在星空下，飘过冰崖。看到觉得美的人或宝可梦，就冻在原地，好欣赏几个小时。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME floats above icy cliffs beneath the stars. If it sees a person or Pokémon it finds beautiful, it freezes them in place to admire them for hours.

entry: POKENAME飞过山巅，泛着微光。冰身冷得轻碰就能瞬间冻结血肉或岩石。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME glows faintly as it flies along mountain peaks. Its icy body is so cold that a single touch can freeze flesh or stone instantly.

entry: POKENAME迅速袭向猎物，吐出冰息，鼓动尾巴上零度以下、火焰般的雾气，瞬间将目标吞没。猎物冻得结实后，它便悄悄拖回巢穴，再用爪子敲碎。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME swiftly attacks its prey, blowing its icy breath to fan the sub-zero flame-like mist on its tail, instantly engulfing its target. Once the victim is frozen solid, it quietly drags them back to its lair to then shatter them with its claws.

entry: POKENAME是极罕见的雪妖女变异，雪披风下长出结晶冰。其他雪妖女待它如公主，视为群中强大凝聚者。被水晶冻住，就永不解冻。
author: operativevalkyrie
source: POKENAME is an extremely rare mutation of Froslass, growing crystal ice underneath its Snow Cloak. It is treated like a princess by other Froslass, and is recognised as a strong unifier within the group. Those frozen by its crystals will never thaw.

entry: 它爱在冰崖瀑布后安家，流水声给它无尽宁静。
author: .izik
source: It prefers to make its home behind waterfalls on icy cliffsides. The sound of rushing water provides it with endless serenity.

entry: POKENAME外衣融入冰雪，方便伏击没防备的宝可梦。选美比赛珍视它的美貌与耐力，可它很难捉。
author: wolfbrine
source: POKENAME's coat helps it blend among snow and ice, letting it ambush unwary Pokémon. POKENAME is highly valued for its beauty and stamina in Pokémon Beauty Contests, but it is difficult to catch.

entry: POKENAME是完全中空的冰壳，轻得惊人。它将丝带塑成翼，冰冷山风从下方吹过，就能浮起。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME is incredibly light, as it is a completely hollow husk of ice. It floats when icy mountain winds get under the silk laces that it shapes into wings.

entry: POKENAME帮助工人，将物资运过重雪暴地区。巨力与耐力，让它零下也能拖重装备，不知疲倦。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME helps workers move supplies through areas afflicted by heavy blizzards. Its great strength and endurance allows it to drag heavy equipment in subzero temperatures without tiring.

entry: POKENAME吹出泡泡，迷惑并引来猎物，泡泡一碰冷空气，便会冻结。等目标分心，它再用背上冰层里储存的水，喷出冰冷的水流攻击。
author: ambrosia04
source: To fascinate and lure its prey, POKENAME blows bubbles that freeze the moment they hit the cold air. Once the target is distracted, it blasts them with a freezing stream of water, using the water it stores inside the ice on its back.

entry: POKENAME敏捷耀眼，疾奔冰封苔原。鬃与尾上的冷蓝火，将周围水分瞬间冻成闪亮飞雪。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME sprint across frozen tundras with dazzling agility. As they gallop, the cold blue flames billowing from their manes and tails instantly freeze ambient moisture into sparkling snow flurries.

entry: POKENAME长耳尖覆霜，能听广阔雪原的细声。小跑时抬着头，留意冰层开裂与气温骤降。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME possess long, frost-tipped ears capable of hearing faint sounds across vast snowfields. They hold their heads high as they trot, listening closely for cracking ice and sudden temperature drops.

entry: 大雪里，POKENAME成群现身，吃草直到雪停。雾鬃始终低于冰点，可信任的训练家摸着，却莫名温暖。
author: chibitales
source: During heavy snowfall, herds of POKENAME appear and graze until the snow stops. Their misty manes are consistently below freezing temperatures, but feel oddly warm when touched by a Trainer they trust.

entry: POKENAME摇曳尾上的丝，使猎物陷入恍惚，再喷出冰冷的水流，将目标封在冰里，方便拖回巢穴。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME sways the silks on its tail to lull its prey into a trance. It then shoots a freezing water stream to encase its target in ice so it can drag it back to its lair.

entry: POKENAME优雅地滑游冰冷水域，也常仔细梳理背上的飘带。
author: xephyr
source: It glides through icy waters gracefully. POKENAME grooms the ribbon on its back often.

entry: POKENAME被视为苔原上最危险的宝可梦之一。它经常喷出水柱，让水柱在原地冻结，封锁区域，阻挡威胁。
author: pendragonic
source: POKENAME is considered one of the most dangerous Pokémon of the tundra. It will often fire jets of water that freeze in place to block off areas and ward off threats.

entry: POKENAME手上放出的霜，一碰就冻结。它藏在雪里，抓训练家的脚，碰到谁就冻谁。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME releases a chilling frost from its hands that freezes anything it touches. It hides in the snow to swipe at the feet of Trainers and freezes those it touches.

entry: POKENAME藏在暴风雪，仅摆锤亮光穿透雪幕。迷路旅人被金光催眠，梦想暖意跟随，直到生命力被吸干、倒下。
author: slowforest
source: POKENAME hides within blizzards, with only the shine of its pendulum piercing the snow. Entranced by its golden glow, lost travelers follow it, dreaming of warmth, until they collapse, their life force drained away.

entry: POKENAME全身覆着会蜇人的叶片，抵御捕食者。它常在阳光下睡觉，吸收热量与能量，存进背上的种子，为进化作准备。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME's body is covered with stinging leaves that serve as a defense mechanism against predators. It often falls asleep under the sun to absorb its warmth and energy, storing it within its bulb as it prepares for evolution.

entry: POKENAME每节都甜，最甜的是头，散出蕉香果般的香气。
author: .izik
source: Each segment of an POKENAME is extremely sweet in flavor. The sweetest portion is the head, which emits an aroma that mimics Nanab Berries.

entry: 初见POKENAME，研究者以为只是畸形走路草。凑近才大吃一惊，它爆出漫天花粉自卫。
author: sk372
source: When first discovered, the researcher who spotted POKENAME thought it was simply a malformed Oddish. When approaching, they received a rude awakening as POKENAME exploded in a pollen-filled display of self-defense.

entry: POKENAME体内电膜极不稳定，月光下长得惊人快。可照得太久，就会猛烈爆炸。
author: theaceofhearts0306
source: Due to the highly volatile electric membrane within its body, POKENAME grows at an incredible rate when exposed to moonlight. If exposed for too long, however, POKENAME will violently explode.

entry: 颜色虽较深，它留下的小块芽，滋味却像茄子。据说阳光足，会长出特别大的芽，因此训练家将它养在花园亮处。
author: quackquackattack
source: Despite being a darker shade, it leaves behind nuggets of buds that taste like an eggplant. It is said that a particularly large bud is made when it gets lots of sunlight, so Trainers keep it in bright parts of a garden.

entry: POKENAME用干葫芦做头盔，找导师教它战斗，保护幼年宝可梦。顺从随和，很适合新训练家。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME fashions a helmet from a dried gourd and seeks out a mentor to teach it to fight in defense of baby Pokémon. It is an excellent partner for new Trainers due to its obedient and agreeable attitude.

entry: 有月光的夜里，POKENAME翻找花园，寻找块头大的根茎蔬菜。若找到中意的块茎，它就换作新的棍棒，把原来的那根重新种进土里。
author: anonymous_moose
source: On nights when the moon is shining, POKENAME can be found digging through gardens in search of large root vegetables. If they find a tuber they prefer, they will swap it out, replanting their existing club in the soil.

entry: POKENAME头盔常因战损而换，却仍偏爱换上新的植物材料。棒上装饰着叶子，能撒各种粉，妨碍对手。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME's helmet must be replaced often due to battle damage, but it still prefers to swap to a new piece of vegetation. It decorates its club with leaves that emit different powders to hamper its opponents.

entry: POKENAME用头上叶片吸月光能量，晚间战斗最出色。它将叶片向后捋，挑衅对手。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME gathers energy from moonlight via the fronds on its head, so it is most effective in battle during the evening. It brushes the fronds back as a taunt to provoke opponents.

entry: POKENAME的气体促进植物一夜生长，很受植物学家欢迎。数量太多，也曾不慎令城市植物过度滋长。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME produces a gas that promotes overnight plant growth, making it popular with botanists. Large populations of this Pokémon have caused accidental overgrowth in urban areas.

entry: POKENAME皮韧、脾气差，对冷天气极敏感。晒暖之前，动作明显迟缓。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME has a very tough hide and temperamental nature. It is very sensitive to cold weather, becoming notably sluggish until the sun warms it up.

entry: POKENAME每天产出大颗蛋状种子，养分丰富，在关都被当作美食。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME produces large egg-like seeds daily. These seeds are packed full of nutrients and are considered a delicacy in the Kanto region.

entry: POKENAME每天产出大颗蛋状种子，存进腹袋。虽苦得厉害，却被当作高档超级食品销售。
author: mepp.
source: Every day, POKENAME produces large egg-like seeds and stores them in its pouch. Though incredibly bitter, they are marketed as a premium superfood.

entry: POKENAME白天休息，借满身叶子，伪装成灌木。夜里活跃，吸月光作能量，帮助生长。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME rest during the day, hiding as shrubs and bushes thanks to the many leaves upon their bodies. They become active at night, harnessing moonlight as energy that helps them to grow.

entry: POKENAME用小脚吸水，借头上的藤蔓吸收阳光。藤蔓若受损，它们便分泌红色树液，作为黏合剂，帮助伤处愈合。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME soak up water through their tiny feet and absorb sunlight through the vines on their head. When one of the vines is damaged, they produce a red sap that acts as a binding agent to help them heal.

entry: POKENAME袋里装满走路草，给它们躲天敌。谁想吃其中一只，它便尖叫，再攻击饥饿的宝可梦。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME has a pouch full of Oddish that serves as a safe place to hide from predators. Whenever anyone tries to eat one of its Oddish, it lets out a scream before striking the hungry Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME一半养分靠直射月光，只见于清水池。头叶边缘锋利，是强力防身工具。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is only found in clean ponds as it relies on direct moonlight for half of its sustenance. The edges of the leaf on its head are sharp, making for a formidable defensive tool.

entry: POKENAME白天钻池底泥，夜里融入暗水觅食。许多厨师养着，方便从尾上剪取新鲜配料，给菜添土香与苦味。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME burrows in the muddy bottom of ponds during the day and feeds at night, when it blends into the dark water. Many chefs keep POKENAME as a pet so they can harvest fresh cuttings off the tail, which add an earthy, bitter flavor to a dish.

entry: POKENAME常躺在岸边，进行光合作用。别的宝可梦若把它当成能吃的植物，它便赶紧爬回水里。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME often lies on the shore and photosynthesizes. If another Pokémon misinterprets it as an edible plant, it quickly crawls back into the water.

entry: POKENAME常躺在岸边，进行光合作用。别的宝可梦若把它当成能吃的植物，它便赶紧爬回水里。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME often lies on the shore and photosynthesizes. If another Pokémon misinterprets it as an edible plant, it quickly crawls back into the water.

entry: POKENAME常躺在岸边，进行光合作用。别的宝可梦若把它当成能吃的植物，它便赶紧爬回水里。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME often lies on the shore and photosynthesizes. If another Pokémon misinterprets it as an edible plant, it quickly crawls back into the water.

entry: POKENAME高速自转，既能产生超能力，也能用飞叶风暴，将来犯者赶跑。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME can rotate rapidly on its own axis to generate psychic powers or to send attackers fleeing with Leaf Storm.

entry: POKENAME总精力满满，漫无目的地飞行、奔跑，常只为感受力量，就挥镰乱砍。可比任何生物，都难找舒服睡姿。
author: epping_forest
source: POKENAME are always full of energy, flying and running senselessly, often slashing things with its scythes just to feel powerful. However, they struggle to find a good sleeping position more than any living creature.

entry: POKENAME靠叶状头发吸收阳光取能。吸太多，就跳节奏舞，消耗多余能量。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME gain energy by having sunlight hit their leafy hair. Whenever they absorb lots of sunlight, they get rid of the excess energy by doing a rhythmic dance.

entry: POKENAME白天埋在地下，夜里出土沐月。身上叶片作为香草，入许多菜，以独特辛辣味闻名。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME remain buried underground during the day, emerging at night to bathe in the moonlight. The leaves that grow on their bodies are used as herbs in many different recipes, renowned for their uniquely spicy flavor.

entry: POKENAME用荆棘般的钳夹住、缠斗其他宝可梦。攻击范围有限，飞行属性天敌很容易耗尽它的体力，直到无法反抗。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME pinch and grapple other Pokémon with their thorn-like pincers. Their limited reach makes them easy targets for Flying-type predators, who can tire them out until they can no longer resist.

entry: POKENAME多生活在浅水与河岸。虽住在水里，肌肉却软弱无力，很容易就被水流冲走。
author: deflador
source: POKENAME is mostly found in shallow water and riverbanks. While it does live in the water, its muscles are so weak that it can easily be washed away.

entry: POKENAME夜里探索，白天前找地方扭身藏入。华蓝市有道菜，将肉片与它的绿叶拌合，浇桃桃果酱汁，中和毒性。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME explores at night before finding a hiding spot to wiggle into for the day. A Cerulean City dish is made by mixing the sliced meat with the leafy greens growing on POKENAME, topped by a Pecha Berry dressing to neutralize its poison.

entry: POKENAME脾气虽差，却多在河湖底睡觉。叶片泡的茶，是极好的解压饮品。
author: mistymagius
source: Despite having a bad temperament, POKENAME can be mostly found sleeping at the bottom of lakes and rivers. Its leaves can be made into a tea that is a great stress reliever.

entry: POKENAME既能变成宝可梦，也能变成植物。可身上总飘出甜香，轻易就露了馅。
author: sand_coffin
source: POKENAME can transform into both Pokémon and plants. It constantly emits a sweet aroma that reveals its disguise.

entry: POKENAME适应性极强的DNA，令全球科学家广泛研究。训练家让它高兴，叶片便散出宜人的香草气息。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its adaptable DNA makes POKENAME the subject of extensive research by scientists around the world. When its Trainer makes it happy, its leaves release a delightful vanilla fragrance.

entry: POKENAME侵入笔记本电脑，打开窗口的边缘便开数字花。随昼夜周期，白天开，夜里闭。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME infests a laptop, digital flowers bloom along the edges of open windows. These blossoms open during the day cycle and close when night falls.

entry: 一片卷叶就是POKENAME的壳，需要时，它便缩进去。叶壳除了护身，也会吸收阳光、积存热量，在夜里为它保暖。
author: sk372
source: A curled-up leaf acts as a shell for POKENAME to retreat into should the need arise. As well as protection, it can also provide POKENAME warmth overnight after growing hot from absorbing the sun's rays.

entry: POKENAME夜里探索，白天前找地方扭身藏入。华蓝市有道菜，将肉片与它的绿叶拌合，浇桃桃果酱汁，中和毒性。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME explores at night before finding a hiding spot to wiggle into for the day. A Cerulean City dish is made by mixing the sliced meat with the leafy greens growing on POKENAME, topped by a Pecha Berry dressing to neutralize its poison.

entry: POKENAME头叶越深色，就越近进化。它也从叶子放恶臭，驱赶天敌。
author: sk372
source: The color of the leaves on POKENAME's head indicate its closeness to evolution, darkening as it draws nearer. To deter predators, it emits a foul stench from these leaves.

entry: POKENAME主要吃腐物，住在海底。动作慢、背长叶，伪装极佳；叶丛也保护躲进来的小鱼宝可梦。
author: afilthycasual
source: POKENAME are primarily scavengers that live on the ocean floor. Their slow movements and leafy backs give them fantastic camouflage while also granting protection for small fish Pokémon that hide amidst their vegetation.

entry: POKENAME振翼，声如整座森林的树木沙沙响。领地意识极强，靠近巢穴，简直自找灾难。
author: deelee2020
source: POKENAME's wings make a peculiar sound, like the rustling trees of an entire forest. They are highly territorial - approaching their nest is a recipe for disaster.

entry: POKENAME夜行，夜里四处远游。白天隐形睡觉，保护自己，超能力则在月光下增强。
author: imaginita
source: POKENAME is nocturnal and travels far and wide at night. During the day, it turns invisible in order to sleep safely. Its psychic powers grow under the moon's light.

entry: POKENAME放出的黏花粉，作用如杀虫剂，因此农人饲养它，保护树果丛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME release a sticky pollen that acts like an insecticide, which is why farmers raise them to protect berry bushes.

entry: 它用头顶大而利的叶片，修剪尾叶，免得失去平衡。叶在月下生长，因此每天清晨都得修剪。
author: infinex21
source: It trims its tail leaves with the large, sharp leaf atop its head to ensure its balance is not thrown into disarray. Since its leaves grow with moonlight, it must trim them every morning.

entry: POKENAME颈部突起与叶尾，产生能中和胃酸的特殊树汁。靠它帮忙，烧心的人可服树汁片，缓解不适。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME produce a special sap from the growths on their neck and their leafy tail that can function as an antacid. Thanks to the help of POKENAME, people who suffer from heartburn can take a sap tablet to feel better.

entry: POKENAME喜欢明亮日光，常晒得舒服睡着。若被叫醒，就会闹脾气。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME enjoy sunbathing in bright sunlight and often feel so comfortable that they fall asleep in the bright sun. They can get grouchy when awakened from their slumber.

entry: POKENAME背叶长得比背火快。灰烬养分丰富，四处游荡时随身散落。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME has leaves on its back that grow faster than the fire on its back. Its ashes are full of nutrients that it sheds when it roams around.

entry: POKENAME在河湖旁浓密植被间筑巢，主要夜间活动。为叶冠骄傲，谁敢损坏，就凶狠痛咬报复。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME makes its den among thick vegetation near ponds and lakes, and is mostly active at night. It takes great pride in its leafy crest and becomes ferocious if anyone dares to damage it, retaliating with painful bites.

entry: POKENAME在树篱筑巢，每次振翼，都撒小种子。园丁珍惜它到访，落过的地方，植物似乎都长得旺。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME nests in hedges and spreads tiny seeds with each beat of its wings. Gardeners prize its visits, as plants seem to thrive where it has landed.

entry: 头叶放出的天然油，让毛柔软闪亮。POKENAME与群体住在树上，从枝间收橡实与榛子吃。
author: fiordaliso
source: The leaves on its head release natural oils that keep its fur soft and shiny. POKENAME feeds on acorns and hazelnuts collected from tree branches where it lives with its colony.

entry: 这种POKENAME住在密林树根下，湿气滋养叶片。主要用月光进行光合作用取食。
author: fiordaliso
source: This variant of POKENAME lives in dense forests and nests beneath tree roots, where humidity helps its leaves thrive. It mainly feeds through photosynthesis using moonlight.

entry: POKENAME在灌丛静候，几乎不动，留意动静。锐利目光，能定住小生物片刻，够它爆发孢子，将其击昏。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME waits silently in thickets, barely moving as it watches for motion. Its piercing gaze holds smaller creatures still just long enough for it to release a burst of spores to knock them out.

entry: POKENAME清晨飞过花园，身后拖着闪亮粉尘。只有太阳刚升时，才在花瓣旁休息。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME flutters through gardens in the early morning, leaving trails of sparkling dust behind it. It only rests near flower petals when the sun begins to rise.

entry: 它将身体半埋土中，只露出叶片晒太阳，因此常被误认成杂草。
author: sottiwotti
source: This Pokémon partially digs itself into the dirt, only exposing its leaves to let them bathe in the sunlight. Because of this, they often get mistaken for weeds.

entry: POKENAME常见于月见山隧道，沿岩面快爬，寻找月之石。找到一块，就急振叶翼庆祝。
author: theaceofhearts0306
source: Typically seen in the tunnels of Mt. Moon, POKENAME like to scuttle along rocky surfaces in search of Moon Stones. Once they find one, POKENAME will rapidly flutter their leafy wings in celebration.

entry: POKENAME滑过广谷，撒出轻种子，在空中盘旋。种子常在肥沃山土里迅速发芽。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME glides across wide valleys, shedding lightweight seeds that spiral through the air. The seeds it releases often sprout quickly in the rich mountain soil.

entry: POKENAME常在珊瑚礁嬉戏，成群铁炮鱼从它的叶鳍取食。奇怪的是，它似乎毫不在意，继续陶醉于快乐。
author: theaceofhearts0306
source: POKENAME are most commonly seen frolicking in coral reefs, with schools of Remoraid feeding from their leafy fins. Oddly, they seem to remain unbothered, continuing to bask in their state of joy.

entry: 它白天在日光处睡，夜里游荡。若踩杂草挨了静电，可能就是POKENAME睡梦中放电。
author: pattybgoode
source: It sleeps in sunny places during the day and roams at night. If trodden weeds deliver a static shock, it's likely POKENAME releasing electricity in its sleep.

entry: POKENAME爱将唯一的叶浸进旁人的饮料，似乎借此尝味。饮料也明显更甜，喝过的人说，精神焕发。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME likes to dip its singular leaf into the beverages of those around it. It seems to be sampling the taste this way, but the act also gives the drink a noticeably sweeter taste; those who consume it after report feeling rejuvenated.

entry: POKENAME虽能看未来，影像却模糊、短暂。即便有限，它的叶子仍是超能力者与灵媒争抢的货品。
author: quackquackattack
source: While POKENAME are capable of seeing into the future, the visions they have are blurry and only last for short periods of time. Despite this limitation, POKENAME leaves are a hot commodity for psychics and mediums.

entry: 农人将大群POKENAME养在牧场，田地像移动的灌丛。定期采叶、干燥卖茶，泡出的茶带来奇特酥麻感。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Large herds of POKENAME are kept in pastures by farmers, the fields they call home looking like a moving shrubbery. Farmers periodically harvest their leaves to be dried out and sold for tea, the leaves creating an unusual tingly sensation.

entry: POKENAME飞行技艺惊人，在林冠间完美隐身。必须住在极湿栖地，保持水分，否则就无法维持飞行。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME flies with incredible skill through the woodland canopies, where it can blend in perfectly. It needs to live in very humid habitats to keep its body properly hydrated, otherwise it cannot stay airborne.

entry: POKENAME身上薄薄的毛发，能留住水分和泥土，使植物在其中生长。它们定期释放电击，刺激植物生长；若植物开始萎蔫，也能帮助它们恢复生机。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are coated in a thin layer of fur that traps moisture and dirt, allowing plants to grow within it. They stimulate this plant growth with periodic electrical shocks, helping to revitalise the plants if they ever begin to wilt.

entry: POKENAME关怀又护弱。揉尾部红宝石，会造电屏障，对飞行属性宝可梦格外有效，常借此保护走路草。
author: theaceofhearts0306
source: POKENAME is known to be a protective and caring Pokémon. When rubbing the ruby on its tail, POKENAME creates an electric barrier that is extremely effective against Flying-type Pokémon. It is often seen doing this to protect Oddish from harm.

entry: POKENAME大多时间都在空中滑翔，只有需要汲取泥中的水分与矿物，才会落地。它们在高高的云层上方，沐浴阳光，获得大部分能量。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME spend most of their time gliding through the air and only come down to the ground for water and minerals from the mud. Most of their energy comes from sunlight that they get from being high above the clouds.

entry: POKENAME快速扇头上叶翼升空。一接上气流，叶子弯曲迎风，便被带走。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME flap the leafy wings on their head rapidly to elevate themselves into the air. Once they catch an air current, their leaves bend and catch the breeze to be whisked away.

entry: POKENAME不停乘气流翱翔，很少落到地上。偶尔落地时，能见它半身浸在泥里，吸收矿物。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are rarely seen on the ground, as they are constantly soaring through the sky on wind currents. On the rare occasion that they are on the ground, they can be seen half submerged in mud absorbing minerals.

entry: POKENAME乘微风穿林，用头捕捉花粉与阳光。几乎始终在空中，好尽量多晒太阳。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME ride through forests on a gentle breeze, capturing pollen and sunlight on their heads. They are almost always airborne so that they capture as much sunlight as possible.

entry: POKENAME啃植物根取养分，在园丁间恶名昭彰。钻土藏身等候，叶片吸日光，为夜间活动供能。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are infamous among gardeners due to their tendency to eat away at plant roots for nutrients. They burrow into soil to hide their bodies and lie in wait, their leaves absorbing sunlight to power their nighttime escapades.

entry: POKENAME大部分时间，在测试靠尾巴能平衡多久。通常专心保持完全不动，常显得一脸空白。
author: theaceofhearts0306
source: POKENAME spends most of its time testing how long it can balance on its tail. Typically, It will focus heavily on remaining completely still, often appearing to have a blank expression.

entry: POKENAME把所有时间都用来晒太阳、蓄能。状态最佳，叶子就有浓甘草香。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME spends all its time basking in sunlight to build up energy. When at peak condition, its leaves emit a strong scent of liquorice.

entry: POKENAME日光、月光都能转作能量维生。叶里榨的油，常被快餐店拿来炸食物。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME can convert both sunlight and moonlight into energy to thrive. The oil extracted from its leaves is used in many fast-food restaurants to fry food.

entry: POKENAME的鳃和头叶一样，能吸月光。冬天埋在泥下，任表面冻结，体温降近零；春天冒出，便大得多、强得多。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME's gills can also absorb moonlight, like the leaves on its head. In winter, it stays buried under mud, allowing it to freeze over, and dropping its body temperature to near-zero. It then emerges in spring much bigger and stronger.

entry: POKENAME黄昏在屋顶跳，躲在叶后，淘气探看。陪它玩的孩子，常全身沾满花粉。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME bounces along rooftops at dusk, hiding behind leaves and peeking out playfully. Children who play with one often become covered in pollen from head to toe.

entry: POKENAME叶子放出的物质，会刺痛近身者的眼。它将臭种子暴露在亮月下，让其长大。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its leaves release a substance that stings the eyes of anyone who gets too close to POKENAME. It makes its foul-smelling bulb grow by exposing it to the bright moonlight.

entry: POKENAME把日光能量存进脸颊，兴奋就释放。细火花有时穿过叶片噼啪响，令周围空气带电。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME stores energy from sunlight in its cheeks and releases it when excited. Tiny sparks sometimes crackle through its leaves, charging the air around it.

entry: POKENAME是关都草原的夜行猎手与食腐者，偏爱烈雀、小拉达。叶须滋味介于薄荷与胡椒之间，常给小点心或披萨作配料。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is a nocturnal hunter and scavenger of Kanto grasslands, preferring Spearow and Rattata. The leaf whiskers have a flavor that sits neatly between minty and peppery, making it a common topping for small snack plates or pizzas.

entry: POKENAME每当被其他宝可梦击中，就会释放毒花粉，黏在袭击者身上。花粉持续抽取对方的水分与养分，直到它找到反击的机会。
author: quackquackattack
source: Whenever POKENAME are struck by another Pokémon they release a toxic pollen that clings to their assailant. The pollen saps moisture and nutrients away from their assailant until they find an opportunity to launch a counterattack.

entry: POKENAME循刺鼻气味前去查看，沿路留下毒花粉云。找到来源，再以强超能力攻击，宣示领地主导。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME follow pungent scents in the air to investigate them while leaving behind a cloud of poisonous pollen. Once they find the source, they attack with powerful psychic energy to assert their dominance over their territory.

entry: 这些宝可梦大多爱关注，尤其喜欢被喂小坚果与熟树果。但头叶被摸得太重，就会咬冒犯者，训练家也不例外。
author: infinex21
source: Most of these Pokémon love attention, especially being fed small nuts and ripe berries. However, if the leaves on their head are touched too roughly, they will bite the perpetrator, even if it is their Trainer.

entry: POKENAME撒在巢里的叶子，富含天然抗氧化物，很受草药医学珍视。夜巡领地，靠月光辨路。
author: fiordaliso
source: The leaves POKENAME scatters in its nest are rich in natural antioxidants and highly valued in herbal medicine. It patrols its territory at night, orienting itself by the light of the moon.

entry: POKENAME休息时，总会交叉双臂，露出獠牙，借此吓退旁人。醒来活动后，它们会寻找坚硬的果实与树皮啃咬，让双颚保持强壮。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME sit with their arms crossed and their fangs bared whenever they rest as a means to deter others. When they are awake and active, POKENAME find tough fruits and tree bark to gnaw on to keep their jaws strong.

entry: POKENAME细心照料角叶，向同类炫耀。叶越长，对同类吸引力越强。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME take great care of the leaves on their horn to show off to other POKENAME. The longer the leaves on their horn, the more attractive they are to members of their species.

entry: POKENAME平静时，叶子有独特忍冬花香。睡觉埋进洞土，找安静平和的休息处。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's leaves let loose a distinct honeysuckle scent when it is calm. It buries itself in cave dirt when sleeping, creating a quiet and peaceful resting place.

entry: POKENAME壳里满是沃土，让植物健康生长。休息半埋，只露覆叶的壳。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME shells are packed with rich soil that supports healthy plant growth. They partially bury themselves when resting, leaving only their leafy shell above ground.

entry: POKENAME习惯清早来到田里，给自己挖个洞，待上一整天，因此被农民视为害兽。它们将长脖子探出洞外，沐浴阳光，直到夜里才离开。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are considered a pest by farmers due to their habit of arriving in a field in the early morning and digging out a hole for themselves for the day. They poke their long neck out of their hole, soaking in the sun, before leaving at night.

entry: POKENAME钻地避天敌，只露叶冠。叶被扰动，就用满是墨汁的章鱼桶炮反击；环境不同，体色也不同。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME dig into the ground to hide from predators, leaving only their crown of leaves exposed. If their leaves are disturbed, they retaliate with Octazooka attacks filled with ink. POKENAME in different environments exhibit different colors.

entry: POKENAME钻地避天敌，只露叶冠。叶被扰动，就用满是墨汁的章鱼桶炮反击；环境不同，体色也不同。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME dig into the ground to hide from predators, leaving only their crown of leaves exposed. If their leaves are disturbed, they retaliate with Octazooka attacks filled with ink. POKENAME in different environments exhibit different colors.

entry: POKENAME从叶翼撒种，长成刺鼻花，标示领地。谁毁哪怕一粒种子，就会被锐爪攻击。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME mark their territory by dropping seeds from their leafy wings that grow into pungent flowers. They attack anyone who damages one of their seeds by swiping with their sharp talons.

entry: POKENAME嚎叫时，头上叶子散出大麦气味，表示攻击即将开始。
author: .izik
source: While howling, POKENAME releases the scent of barley from its leafy head. This odor signals that an attack is imminent.

entry: POKENAME习惯清早来到田里，给自己挖个洞，待上一整天，因此被农民视为害兽。它们将长脖子探出洞外，沐浴阳光，直到夜里才离开。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are considered a pest by farmers due to their habit of arriving in a field in the early morning and digging out a hole for themselves for the day. They poke their long neck out of their hole, soaking in the sun, before leaving at night.

entry: POKENAME藏在高草，融入景色。猎物够近，就扑出，用毒牙咬住。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME hide themselves in tall grass to blend in with the surrounding landscape. Once prey comes close enough, POKENAME pounce and bite down with their venomous fangs.

entry: POKENAME甩象鼻，末端叶片就散淡雅花香。有些在热带度假村工作，为客人扇来甜香风。
author: sk372
source: When POKENAME waves its trunk around, the leaves at the end emit a faint and pleasant flowery aroma. Some can be found working tropical resorts, fanning guests with sweet-scented air.

entry: 它用坚韧的长牙翻找植被，再用象鼻抓住自身松脱的叶子吃，回收养分，让身体不受拖累，好随时蜷起，滚过敌人。
author: haypile
source: Its tough tusks are used to rummage through vegetation. It grabs its own loose leaves with its trunk and eats them, recycling nutrients while keeping its form unburdened so it can curl up at a moment's notice to roll over foes.

entry: POKENAME在训练家的背包里，假扮招式学习器，好被带着远行。它们终究会被训练家发现；那时，便会爬出背包，再找个安全地方躲起来。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME camouflage themselves within a Trainer's bag as a Technical Machine so that they can be carried for long distances. When they are inevitably spotted by the Trainer, they scuttle out of the bag to find a safe place to hide.

entry: 它们最爱捉迷藏，找张高草图片，嵌入其中，等训练家发现。天然伪装，让藏身处极难辨。
author: quackquackattack
source: One of their favorite games is hide and seek, where they find an image of tall grass and embed themselves in the image until their Trainer spots them. Their natural camouflage makes them difficult to spot when hidden.

entry: POKENAME跳进有高草的照片，藏在影像中。训练家若不陪玩，就一直留着，直到听到呼唤。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME hop into photos where there is tall grass to hide within the image. If their Trainer does not indulge in their games, they stay in these photos until their Trainer calls out to them.

entry: 夜行POKENAME用纹理，白天假扮高草或覆苔石，躲天敌。受扰就发出响亮静电尖叫，吓到许多没防备的园丁与园艺工。
author: darkwolfe
source: The nocturnal POKENAME uses conversion to disguise itself as tall grass or moss-covered stones to avoid predators during the day. If disturbed, POKENAME emits a loud static screech, frightening many unsuspecting gardeners and landscapers.

entry: POKENAME主要夜间游荡，沐浴月光。白天变成花，藏起来睡觉，躲敌对宝可梦。
author: blaizegamer
