source: POKENAME primarily wanders around at night time, soaking in the moonlight. During the daytime, they change their body to resemble a flower and hide from enemy Pokémon when they are sleeping.

entry: POKENAME把自己藏进高草图片，躲训练家，却又盼被找到。一被发现，就兴奋地叫几声。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME bury themselves in images of tall grass to hide from their Trainer, hoping to be found. Whenever their Trainer finds them, they let out a few small chirps of excitement.

entry: POKENAME叶尾摇动，沙沙巨响。害怕时摇尾，给敌人充足逃跑时间，才肯咬。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have leafy tails that produce a loud rustling sound when shaken. They shake their tails when they are scared and give their foe ample time to escape before they bite.

entry: POKENAME白天埋身，夜里才出。虽住茂盛环境，却对花粉极敏感，春天不停打出火星喷嚏。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME bury themselves during the day, only emerging at night. Despite living in lush environments, they are highly sensitive to pollen, constantly sneezing embers during spring.

entry: POKENAME抱起蛋，就用头上的叶子蹭，染上气味，也把蛋变绿。它与蛋一同晒上好几个小时，互相保暖。
author: quackquackattack
source: Whenever POKENAME pick up an egg, they impart their scent onto it by rubbing it against their leafy head, turning it green in the process. POKENAME and the egg spend long hours basking in sunlight to keep each other warm.

entry: 从电杆吸电时，POKENAME头叶散出宜人比巴果香。吸取电力，却飘着舒心香气，气氛古怪而平和。
author: .izik
source: While absorbing electricity from an electric pole, the leaves on POKENAME's head will emit a pleasant Qualot Berry scent. This calming fragrance contrasts with the energy it is drawing, creating a peculiar but peaceful atmosphere.

entry: 这些怪脸宝可梦，夜里展叶翼吸月光，帮助长大。能吐种子与弱毒自卫。
author: infinex21
source: These odd-faced Pokémon spread their leafy wings at night to absorb the moonlight that helps them grow. They can spit seeds and weak poisons to defend themselves.

entry: POKENAME把奇迹种子装在腹袋，以为是蛋。细心照料，盼它某天发芽。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME carries a Miracle Seed in its pouch, thinking that it is an egg. It will take care of the seed in the hopes of it sprouting someday.

entry: 它夜里漫无目的游荡，寻找电器偷电。POKENAME摇摇晃晃，不假思索地走上数英里。
author: pattybgoode
source: It wanders aimlessly at night, seeking electric equipment from which it can siphon power. POKENAME migrate in toddling, thoughtless movements for miles.

entry: POKENAME有类似磁力的独特能力，能操纵周围植物。通常用来挪叶与树枝，让住处植物晒到最合适的光。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME possesses a unique ability similar to magnetism that lets it manipulate plant-life around it. This is typically used to shift leaves and branches around so that the plants in its home area receive optimal sunlight.

entry: POKENAME叶子长得极快，令植物学家着迷。据说最强剪刀也剪不断；它在茂盛植被中生活得好，轻易融入灌丛。
author: jaminmcready
source: Botanists are fascinated by this Pokémon's incredibly fast growing leaves, which are said to be impossible to cut even with the strongest of Shears. POKENAME thrives in dense vegetation where it easily blends into the underbrush.

entry: POKENAME从明月取能量。群体只在深夜飞行，因此很难瞥见。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME gathers its energy from radiant moonbeams. Flocks of POKENAME only fly during the late hours of the night and thus it is quite rare to catch a glimpse of them.

entry: POKENAME甲片下藏着软土。有时背土会按吃下的植物，长出相应植被，花从甲缝冒出。
author: sk372
source: Beneath the plates of POKENAME's hide lies soft soil. On occasion, the soil on its back will grow plants based on what foliage POKENAME has consumed, the flowers sprouting out from between the plates.

entry: POKENAME白天攀住高高的树枝，尽量用翅膀吸收阳光。到了夜里，它才活跃起来，从翅膀散出花粉，拖慢试图逃离的猎物。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME spends the day clinging to the upper branches of trees, absorbing what sunlight it can through its wings. It becomes active at night, spreading a pollen from its wings that slows down prey that tries to flee from it.

entry: POKENAME暴露日光，就会疯狂抖动、抽搐，控制不了身体。这时常将遇上的植物连根拔起，自己种的也不例外。
author: soup1900
source: When POKENAME are caught out in the daylight, they start crazily shaking around and twitch a lot as they're unable to control their bodies. While in this state, they commonly unroot any plant they come across, including ones they had planted before.

entry: POKENAME头叶像谜芝果般辣，令天敌不敢下口。身体天生温暖，寒季也能生存，不怕冻伤。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: The leaf on POKENAME's head tastes just as spicy as an Enigma berry, discouraging predators from attacking it. POKENAME's body is naturally warm, allowing it to survive during the cold season without risking frostbite.

entry: POKENAME大多半埋沃土，吸取进化所需养分。身上叶片味辣，若被打扰，就向敌人喷余烬。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME spends most of its time half-buried in fertile soil and absorbing the nutrients it needs to evolve. The leaves on its body taste spicy. If something disturbs it, POKENAME will spit embers at the foe.

entry: POKENAME皮肤披着厚甲，遍布隆脊沟纹。实验证实，这令皮肤出奇吸水，吸来并分送全身，帮助叶片生长。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME skin is heavily plated with ridged grooves running throughout. Experiments with POKENAME have shown that this makes their skin surprisingly absorbent, able to suck up and distribute moisture across their bodies to help their leaves grow.

entry: POKENAME用爪子挖出睡处，白天藏在里面休息。夜里，它钻出来练习各种战斗方式，同时散播羽毛间的种子。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME uses its claws to dig out a place for it to sleep in during the day. At night, this Pokémon uncovers itself and practices different fighting styles, spreading the seeds sitting in its feathers as it does so.

entry: POKENAME在月光下奔跑，沿途撒下羽毛间生长的种子。天一亮，它们便找地方埋进土里休息，只露出叶片般的羽毛。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: Running around in the moonlight, POKENAME spread the seeds that grow between their feathers as they travel. Once morning breaks, these Pokémon will find a place to rest buried under the soil, with only their leafy feathers exposed.

entry: POKENAME竟能滤泥中养分吸收，因此有时含泥，过些时候再吐出。双脚稳稳踏住地面，叶尾还能举起岩石。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME can oddly filter nutrients out of mud, which they absorb to nourish themselves, so they will sometimes scoop mud in their mouths and eventually spit it out. Their leafy tails can lift rocks when they fully plant their feet into the ground.

entry: 野生POKENAME常在花园游走，尤其傍晚。它甩出腰部利叶，追踪想伤害珍贵花朵的生物。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can be found traipsing through flower gardens in the wild, particularly during the evening. It shakes off sharp leaves from its hips that home in on those who would try to harm the precious flowers.

entry: POKENAME飘在植物凋零的地方，叶与翼散出花香，可闻过的都说，香味很“空洞”。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME floats around in areas of waning plant life. It emits a floral scent from its leaves and wings, but all who have caught the aroma describe it as smelling "hollow".

entry: POKENAME白天用叶片吸日光。敏感胡须能察觉空气湿气，带它找到饮水处。
author: quackquackattack
source: During the day, POKENAME soak in the sun's rays with the leaves on their body. Their sensitive whiskers can detect moisture in the air, bringing them to places where they can drink water.

entry: POKENAME除头叶外，大半身体都能可靠伪装。常躲灌丛旁，让头叶也有机会融入。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are able to reliably camouflage most of their body except for the leaves on their head. They often hide near bushes where the leaves on their head have a chance of blending in.

entry: POKENAME由108种独特植物花粉构成。战斗时操纵花粉，令人咳得停不下，甚至永久损害敌人肺部。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body consists of 108 unique types of plant pollen. It wields this pollen during combat to cause coughing fits that can permanently damage the lungs of its foes.

entry: POKENAME白天钻到树下，吃粗植物根，却总露着后身晒太阳。夜里回共同巢穴，与同类休息。
author: quackquackattack
source: During the day, POKENAME burrow beneath trees to eat thick plant roots but always leave their rears above ground to absorb sunlight. At night, POKENAME return to a communal den to rest alongside their kin.

entry: 背上的杂草一直无人修整，已经长得硕大无比。沐浴月光时，它的力量还会更强。
author: soup1900
source: The weeds on its back have been left untouched, allowing them to grow large in size. It is more powerful when in the moonlight.

entry: POKENAME大部分养分来自太阳，外出便替同类采树果。满载归来，同类会帮忙清洁身体，表示敬意。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME get most of their nutrition from the sun, so whenever they go out into the wild, they gather berries for their kin. When they return home with lots of berries, their kin help clean their bodies as a sign of respect.

entry: 它是人类的天敌。人一被困进植物般的大嘴，巨口便会猛然合下。
author: theheroict
source: This Pokémon is a natural predator for humans. The large plant-mouth it has will bite down when a human is trapped inside.

entry: POKENAME伸出海藻般的叶状触手，缠住水生宝可梦。牢牢制住，再放强酸分解猎物。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME extend their leafy, kelp-like tentacles to wrap around aquatic Pokémon. Once properly restrained, POKENAME release powerful acids to break down their prey.

entry: POKENAME头顶金属板一被敲，花瓣便放花粉。接触过的花朵，更能抵御严酷环境。
author: sk372
source: Pollen is released from POKENAME's petals whenever the metal plate on its head is struck. Flowers touched by the pollen have been noted to grow more resilient to harsh conditions.

entry: 风暴将来，POKENAME反会捕猎平日的天敌，先以白粉麻痹，再将其丢给将至的暴风雨。
author: .izik
source: When a storm approaches, POKENAME hunts its usual predators instead. It paralyzes them with white powder before abandoning them to the coming tempest.

entry: 白天，POKENAME穿入地下，躲开日晒，只让叶片留在地面。受惊时会从面具孔洞射出坚果，击中就能使对方麻痹。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME phase into the ground during the day to hide their bodies from the sun, leaving only their leaves above the surface. If they're startled, they will shoot nuts from the holes in their masks that can paralyze anyone they hit.

entry: POKENAME所到之处，藤蔓与苔藓生长。常去古代宝可梦遗迹，用植被装饰墙壁。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME cause vines and moss to grow wherever they travel. They often frequent the ruins of ancient Pokémon to adorn the walls with vegetation.

entry: POKENAME向天敌喷毒孢子，保护手足。叶子也沾满孢子，便常在池湖洗澡。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME protects its siblings by spraying toxic spores at predators. Its leaves end up coated with these spores, so it can be found bathing in ponds or lakes.

entry: POKENAME有智慧，靠藤荡过丛林，用石木制作工具与武器。也展现过使用人造工具的能力。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are sapient Pokémon that swing through jungles and forests upon vines, wielding tools or weapons fashioned from stone and wood. They have displayed a capacity to use human-made tools as well.

entry: POKENAME在灌丛安家，紧张时放出的气味，会让训练家与宝可梦生病。有训练家说，遇到受惊个体后，得了感冒。
author: fxncy_poland
source: POKENAME build their homes in shrubberies, and can secrete odours when nervous that cause other trainers and Pokémon to be sick. Trainers report having a cold when encountering a startled POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME只在白天成群现身，吸取日光，夜间再用来进行光合作用，让绿意更浓。最鲜绿的，被视为最健康。
author: fxncy_poland
source: POKENAME is only seen during the day, in groups. They absorb the sunlight from the daylight hours and use it to photosynthesise during the night, maximising their green hue. POKENAME with the brightest shade of green are seen as the healthiest.

entry: 白天，POKENAME像木桩一样扎在土里。唯有月光洒下，这根手杖才会自行拔地而起，悬浮在半空。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME stakes in the ground during the daytime. The staff only uproots itself and hovers above the ground under the moonlight.

entry: POKENAME叶片般的耳朵，能听见远处的低语，让人难以悄悄靠近。为了警觉地守护巢穴，它夜里只睡两三个小时。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME has leafy ears that can pick up whispers from a long distance, making it difficult to sneak up on. It only sleeps two to three hours at night because it wants to vigilantly protect its nest.

entry: POKENAME完美藏在森林植被中，等猎物松懈，便跃起扑击。雷电牙致命，能麻痹任何敢挑战的对手。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME remains perfectly camouflaged in the forest's vegetation, and when its prey lowers its guard, it pounces with a leap. Its Thunder Fang is deadly and allows it to paralyze anyone bold enough to challenge it.

entry: POKENAME完美藏在森林植被中，等猎物松懈，便跃起扑击。雷电牙致命，能麻痹任何敢挑战的对手。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME remains perfectly camouflaged in the forest's vegetation, and when its prey lowers its guard, it pounces with a leap. Its Thunder Fang is deadly and allows it to paralyze anyone bold enough to challenge it.

entry: POKENAME会造出整座幻象森林，使旅人迷路。白天，幻象往往变得透明；若你觉得总在绕圈，就安顿下来，等天亮。
author: deelee2020
source: POKENAME have been known to create entire illusory forests and cause travelers to become lost. Their illusions tend to become see-through during daylight hours - so if you feel like you're wandering in circles, settle in and wait for dawn.

entry: 月光一唤醒POKENAME，它就把叶片编成临时的腿，趁夜行走，沿途播种。
author: apixelperfectionist
source: Once awakened by moonlight, POKENAME weaves its leaves into makeshift legs so it can sow seeds as it walks about at night.

entry: 月光一唤醒POKENAME，它就把叶片编成临时的腿，趁夜行走，沿途播种。
author: apixelperfectionist
source: Once awakened by moonlight, POKENAME weaves its leaves into makeshift legs so it can sow seeds as it walks about at night.

entry: POKENAME像海藻漂海，藏在藻丛伏击。叶尾放出安抚孢子，让敌人在水下沉睡。
author: segmoph
source: POKENAME drifts through the ocean like seaweed, camouflaging itself among kelp beds to ambush prey. Its leafy tail releases soothing spores that lull enemies into a deep underwater sleep.

entry: 眼前其实是POKENAME的空壳，真身藏下方。只能看见头上伸出的一片叶，和隐约探出的身体。
author: kam_doodle_snek
source: What you see is actually the husk of POKENAME; its real body is hidden underneath. You can only see the single leaf protruding from its head, and a glimpse of its body peeking through.

entry: 野生POKENAME大多扎根，像植物般长。只有无月夜才起身撒种。黑种子一吞，就会做鲜明噩梦，梦里总有一朵巨花。
author: .jerden
source: Wild POKENAME remain rooted in the ground most of the time, growing like a plant. They only rise up to scatter their seeds on moonless nights. Each black seed will produce a vivid nightmare if swallowed, always featuring a flower of immense size.

entry: POKENAME爱潜伏月下林荫，亮红眼观察周围。一发现威胁林中住民的对象，就用恐惧塞满对方头脑，直到逃走。
author: theaceofhearts0306
source: POKENAME enjoys lurking in the shadows of moonlit forests, using its bright red eyes to observe the scene around it. If it spots a potential threat to the residents of the forest, POKENAME will fill the foe's mind with terror until it flees.

entry: 准备育后时，POKENAME四处替伴侣找沃土。用尾探地、使出扎根，判断土质；地鼠住处养分丰富，格外受青睐。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: When preparing for offspring, POKENAME roam in search of fertile soil for their partner. They probe the ground with their tails and use Ingrain to judge its quality. Areas inhabited by Diglett are highly prized for their nutrient-rich earth.

entry: POKENAME举止夸张，受部分训练家欢迎。臂上叶菜煮熟可吃，生吃却有毒。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's dramatic mannerisms have made it popular with some Trainers. The leafy vegetables that grow on its arms are edible when cooked, but toxic if eaten raw.

entry: POKENAME周身叶片由纯草属性能量构成。苦战后，需要光合作用恢复体力。
author: cait_sith
source: The leaves around POKENAME's body are made of pure Grass-type energy. After a tough battle, POKENAME needs to photosynthesize to regain its strength.

entry: POKENAME周围的等离子体叶，能如风扇急旋，将毒花粉吹向敌人。
author: hophoppip
source: The plasma leaves surrounding POKENAME can spin rapidly like a fan, blowing toxic pollen in an enemy's direction.

entry: POKENAME不停长出微甜绿叶菜，很受欢迎，常作沙拉底料。只要有清水与月光，采得再勤，一周内也能长回。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME continually grows a semi-sweet leafy green plant which is a popular salad base. As long as it has access to clean water and moonlight, the leaves will grow back within a week, regardless of how often they are harvested.

entry: POKENAME是森林里强大的夜猎手，能完美伪装。宽颚分泌草药汁，可缓解烧伤与擦伤疼痛。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is a formidable nocturnal hunter that dwells in forests where it can blend in perfectly. From its wide jaws it secretes an herbal sap that can be used to soothe the pain caused by burns and abrasions.

entry: POKENAME长肢末端的球状部分，像走路草的头。休息便将身体与球体扎进地里，只露带叶的头部晒太阳。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have long appendages with bulbs that resemble Oddish heads. Whenever they rest, they plunge their body and bulbs into the ground, so their leafy heads stick out while they absorb sunlight.

entry: POKENAME用树枝与蜡筑巢，藏入香草香料，睡觉时吸收。许多偏爱牛至；完全成熟后，会被制成昂贵美食，供卡洛斯权贵享用。
author: skyrvr
source: POKENAME builds nests out of twigs and wax, hiding away herbs and spices to absorb while it sleeps. Many POKENAME show a preference for oregano and, upon reaching full maturity, are prepared as an expensive delicacy for Kalos elites.

entry: POKENAME有时住进废弃温室。火燃着宜人花香，附近生物闻得越多，越疲惫困倦。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has been known to take up residence in old abandoned greenhouses. Its flames burn with a pleasant floral scent that makes others nearby feel tired and sleepy the more they breathe in.

entry: POKENAME游荡在热带丛林中，久被遗忘的建筑周围，尽力修护。可本领常限于培育、照料植物。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME roam around the perimeters of long forgotten buildings in tropical jungles. They tend to and maintain the buildings as best as they are able, though their skill is often limited to cultivating and caring for the plant life.

entry: POKENAME身上的叶子在月光下生长，能随心操纵植物与火焰。
author: darkweavile428
source: The leaves on POKENAME's body grow in the moonlight. It has the power to control both plant life and fire at will.

entry: POKENAME身体沉重，难以离地，只好在林地上爬行。它一天最多要吃500磅叶子，若仍不饱，连体型较大的虫宝可梦也会吃。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME crawls on the forest floor since it struggles to get its hefty body off the ground. It has to eat up to 500 pounds of leaves a day and will even eat larger bug Pokémon if it's still hungry.

entry: POKENAME虽看得见，却近视，望不到两米外。它慢慢游历世界，多晒日光，探索明亮的地方。
author: quackquackattack
source: Even though POKENAME can see, their myopic vision prevents them from seeing more than a couple meters away. They take their time to amble around the world, taking in lots of sunlight and exploring well-lit places.

entry: POKENAME白天睡在极浅的地洞，尾叶在地面上摊开，休息时也能光合。夜里，它们出洞游荡，寻找食物与新的睡处。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME spend the day sleeping in a very shallow burrow, fanning their tail leaves out above the surface so they can photosynthesise as they rest. At night, they emerge and wander in search of food and a new resting burrow.

entry: 无月夜，POKENAME偶尔现身精心照料的花园。据说会为尽心爱护珍贵植物的园丁，实现一愿。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME will rarely appear during moonless nights, materializing within gardens that have been kept immaculate. Supposedly it grants the tender of the garden a wish for their dutiful care of precious plant life.

entry: POKENAME在根下挖浅巢，白天躲藏。脚固定位置，上身假扮落叶，免被发现。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME digs shallow nests beneath roots, where it hides during the day. Its feet anchor it in place while its upper body mimics fallen leaves to avoid being found.

entry: POKENAME懒洋洋地躺在散落的种子间，拣起种子，递给路人。它盼着别人帮忙播种、传播，因为自己实在太懒。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME lounges among scattered seeds, picking at them and handing them to any passersby. It does this in the hope that others will help plant the seeds and help them spread, as it is too lazy to do so itself.

entry: POKENAME夜间活动，深夜能见它们高速奔跑，头叶随风飘动。白天，它们将自己埋到脖子，在地里睡觉，被动吸收养分。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are nocturnal and have been seen racing around at high speed in the depths of the night, their head leaves trailing in the breeze. They spend the day buried up to their neck, sleeping in the ground to passively absorb nutrients.

entry: 卡洛斯爆发偷树果风波，POKENAME常与警员搭档，追查失窃树果。察觉附近有果，便让毛亮得耀眼，提醒警员。
author: theaceofhearts0306
source: Due to a berry-stealing crisis in Kalos, POKENAME are often partnered with Police Officers to track down stolen berries. When they sense berries are nearby, POKENAME will alert their Police Officer by making their fur dazzle brightly.

entry: POKENAME边唱边放安抚孢子，让周围一切沉睡。叶片也随旋律轻颤。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME releases soothing spores as it sings, lulling anything nearby into a deep slumber. Its leaves tremble slightly in rhythm with its melody.

entry: POKENAME有只亮红眼，扫描土壤养分浓度。月下能力增强，连其他宝可梦的养分浓度也能探测。
author: theaceofhearts0306
source: POKENAME features a bright red eye used to scan the nutrient concentration of soil. Under moonlight, its eye's abilities are enhanced, allowing it to detect the nutrient concentration of other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME头锤攻击其他宝可梦，身体便散出孢子云。连连撞头，就能令空气充满孢子。
author: quackquackattack
source: Whenever POKENAME attacks another Pokémon with a headbutt, a cloud of spores gets released from their body. They can saturate the air with spores if they headbutt rapidly.

entry: 它蜕壳后，厨师们便会四处收集这些壳，将其碾碎，磨成浓稠的糊。把糊浇在热带风味的甜点上，就能添上一抹淡甜的火龙果滋味。
author: quackquackattack
source: After it sheds its shell, chefs will wander to collect the shells to grind and pulverize into a thick paste. This thick paste is poured onto tropical desserts to serve a mildly sweet taste of dragon fruit.

entry: POKENAME有节奏地旋转，叶齿轮磨出催眠的嗡嗡声。不停运动，帮助孢子散往各方。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME rotates rhythmically, the grinding of its leafy gears creating a hypnotic droning sound. Its constant motion helps circulate spores in all directions.

entry: POKENAME在制药厂稳定产花粉，用来做补充剂。花粉一沾水就易坏，便在干燥无菌室生产，保持稳定。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME produce a consistent amount of pollen in pharmaceutical factories to produce supplements. Their pollen will spoil quickly if exposed to water, so POKENAME produce pollen in a dry, sterilized chamber to keep the pollen stable.

entry: POKENAME怕人，变成其他植物藏身。可又爱捣蛋；若林中有灌木似乎跟着你，多半就是它。
author: deelee2020
source: Timid around humans, POKENAME changes into other plants to hide. However, they like playing tricks - so if a bush seems to be following you through the forest, it's likely an POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME与同类争抢最佳日照。阳光供能，让尾火旺盛。
author: higuchi
source: POKENAME competes with its kin for the best sunshine. The sunlight gives it energy to keep its tail burning strong.

entry: POKENAME从鼓胀身体伸出藤，清除拦路杂物。秋天尤其重要，落叶堆太高，就会遮住太阳。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME sprout vines from their bulbous body to clear debris in their path. This is especially important during fall, where piles of leaves can obscure sunlight if the pile is tall enough.

entry: POKENAME在公园高空散出舒缓香气，让孩子平静。等靠近，可能降下，静静将他们带走。
author: .izik
source: High above parks, POKENAME releases a soothing scent that calms children. Once close, it may descend to quietly carry them away.

entry: POKENAME极胆小，受惊就从叶里放毒。毒不危险，可沾皮肤，会痒得厉害。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is a very timid Pokémon, and when frightened, will release a toxin from its leaves. The toxin isn't dangerous, but it will cause severe itching if it gets on the skin.

entry: POKENAME深夜吃湿土。满月下胃口无底，常轻易吃掉整片花床。
author: theaceofhearts0306
source: POKENAME can be found feasting on damp soil late at night. When exposed to a full moon, their appetite becomes insatiable, often consuming entire garden beds with ease.

entry: POKENAME寻找心怀恶意的人交友。据说叶茶会招来诅咒能量，却仍未经证实。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME seek out people with malice in their hearts to become their friend. It is said that the leaves of POKENAME produce a tea that attracts cursed energy, though this has yet to be proven.

entry: POKENAME飘过草甸，散出椰木果般的香气，诱来附近宝可梦，营造平和、适合休息的气氛。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME floats through meadows, releasing a scent akin to Pamtre Berries. This fragrance lures nearby Pokémon and creates a calm atmosphere, perfect for rest.

entry: POKENAME产特殊花粉，将周身液体染得鲜红。花粉令附近宝可梦昏昏欲睡，营造平静休息的气氛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME produce a special pollen that dyes the fluid around their body a bright red. This pollen lulls nearby Pokémon into a drowsy state, creating a calm atmosphere for rest.

entry: POKENAME裹着富含叶绿素的厚凝胶，颜色鲜绿。叶绿素颗粒悬在其中，直晒阳光，便闪闪发亮。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are surrounded by a thick gel that is full of chlorophyll, turning the gel into a bright green color. These particles of chlorophyll are suspended in the gel, giving them a glittery appearance when exposed to direct sunlight.

entry: POKENAME像蒲公英种子，轻轻随风漂。叶片的浓咖啡香，留在清晨空气里。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME floats gently on the breeze, drifting like a dandelion seed. Its leaves emit a rich, coffee-like aroma that lingers in the morning air.

entry: POKENAME住在最潮湿的沼泽，白天全身浸在泥中，只露头顶和叶片般的尾巴。夜里月亮照耀，叶片能以月光为食，它们便欢快地出来游荡。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME live in the dampest marshes, with all but the tops of their heads and their leafy tails submerged in mud during the day. At night, when the moon is shining and their leaves can feed on the moonlight, they arise and wander about with glee.

entry: 这种宝可梦夜行，靠吸植物与草属性宝可梦的汁液维生。视力差，受攻便四处散危险孢子。
author: bobosmith01
source: A nocturnal Pokémon that survives by absorbing the fluids of plants and Grass-types. It has poor vision and relies on scattering dangerous spores everywhere when attacked.

entry: POKENAME附在蔬果，扎进小牙吸养分。偏爱快坏的食材，有些餐馆用它监测食物新鲜度。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME clings to fruits and veggies, draining them of nutrients after sinking its tiny fangs into them. Because it tends to favor produce about to go bad, some restaurants use it to monitor freshness of their wares.

entry: POKENAME钻进地下，只露带叶的头晒太阳。哪只宝可梦想拔起沉重身躯，就会被它射刺防御。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME burrow themselves underground while keeping their leafy heads exposed to absorb sunlight. Whenever a Pokémon tries to uproot their heavy bodies, they shoot thorns to defend themselves.

entry: POKENAME整夜飞遍地区，天亮便钻地下。谁想拔出，就迅速升体温，烫伤冒犯者。
author: darkweavile428
source: POKENAME spends all night flying around the region and goes underground when daylight comes. If someone tries to pull it out of the ground, POKENAME will rapidly increase its body temperature to burn the offender.

entry: 它夜行，靠吸植物与草属性宝可梦的汁液维生。视力差，受攻便四处散危险孢子。
author: bobosmith01
source: It is a nocturnal Pokémon that survives by absorbing the fluids of plants and Grass-types. It has poor vision and relies on scattering dangerous spores everywhere when attacked.

entry: POKENAME飞行时，叶冠散出樱子果香，再以惊人速度，挥翼攻击。
author: .izik
source: As it flies, POKENAME releases a scent like Cheri Berries from its leafy crown. It then strikes with wings at surprising speed.

entry: POKENAME住在浅沼底，伪装普通灌丛。猎物一碰叶，就会被电昏。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME lives on the bed of shallow swamps, disguised as simple shrubbery. When prey touches POKENAME's leaves, they are shocked unconscious.

entry: POKENAME主要代谢月光，白天慢、夜里快。叶含致命毒，却也能入多种药方。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME move rather slowly during the day, yet move quickly at night because they mainly metabolize moonlight. Their leaves contain deadly toxins yet serve well in many medicinal remedies.

entry: 它如车轮滚动，却常掉下大量叶子。只要两夜就能长回，每次新生，叶中毒性似乎更强。
author: infinex21
source: It moves around like a wheel, though this often causes it to shed its many leaves. It takes but two nights for its leaves to regrow, and the toxins within them seem to grow more potent with each regrowth.

entry: 这些宝可梦平和温顺，白天将长身埋沃土，只露角与叶休息。叶中造的毒，再从角流成强毒液。
author: infinex21
source: These peaceful and docile Pokémon rest during the day by burrowing their long bodies in rich soil, leaving only their horns and leaves to protrude. Their toxins produced in their leaves leak out as a potent venom from their horns.

entry: 这种宝可梦只吃萝卜，因此POKENAME会合力种田。自己装萝卜埋土，若别的宝可梦想吃其中一只，全群便跃起攻击。
author: _pixelar_
source: This Pokémon can only eat radishes, leading to POKENAME planting fields together. They mimic radishes and bury themselves in the soil to hide; when another Pokémon tries to eat one, the group jumps out to attack.

entry: POKENAME吸收月光成长，用这份能量起舞，却可能让四周的草枯死。
author: roundabout_robin
source: POKENAME grow by absorbing moonlight. This energy fuels its dance, which can cause grass around it to die.

entry: POKENAME往体内塞入大量叶子。叶片腐烂后，身体就会渗出恶臭的液体，碰触便会中毒。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME stuffs large amounts of leaves inside of its body. As the leaves begin to decay, its body leaks an incredibly foul liquid that is toxic to the touch.

entry: POKENAME高站沼泽，偏爱新雨，叶片展开，尽量多吸水，在潮湿中茁壮生长。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME stands tall in marshy areas, preferring fresh rain. It leaves its leaves open to absorb as much water as it can, thriving in the moist environment.

entry: POKENAME照到满月就觉醒，对本领信心爆棚。因此，有研究者称见它挑战怪力般的强敌，几乎毫无畏惧。
author: theaceofhearts0306
source: When POKENAME are exposed to a full moon, they become awakened, adopting extreme confidence in their abilities. As such, researchers claim to have seen POKENAME challenging Pokémon as strong as Machamp with little to no fear.

entry: POKENAME埋土睡觉，呼出淡淡灰色毒粉，吓退威胁。古代药方曾把粉用在药膏里。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME buries itself in soil to sleep, exhaling faint puffs of grey Poison Powder to ward off threats. This powder has been used in salves in ancient remedies.

entry: POKENAME结群飞过田野。留下的莲蒲果香，能让闻者精力与精神振奋。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME flies through fields with flocks of other POKENAME. The Chople Berry scent it leaves behind invigorates anyone who smells it, boosting their energy and spirit.

entry: POKENAME以森林守护者自豪，大石拳吓退许多敌人。常守在走路草群旁，警惕天敌。
author: theaceofhearts0306
source: POKENAME prides itself on being a guardian of the forest, as its large rock fists intimidate many foes. POKENAME can typically be found near groups of Oddish, watching closely for predators.

entry: POKENAME雨天蓄水，能胀到原来两倍重，留待以后用。潮湿气候里，训练家得给它排水，胀得过头会痛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME is known to swell to twice its body mass when it rains, storing rainwater for future use. Trainers living in humid climates need to drain swollen POKENAME, as excessive swelling causes it pain.

entry: POKENAME背总痒，便一直拱着。巧的是，拱背更方便看月亮，恰是它最爱的活动之一。
author: theaceofhearts0306
source: As a result of their constantly itchy backs, these POKENAME have adopted a constantly arched posture. Coincidentally, their arched backs allow them to better gaze at the moon, one of their favorite activities.

entry: POKENAME白天埋在地里，啃食植物的根，获取生长所需的养分。它只在夜里返回地面，四处寻找健康的树木取食。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME buries itself in the ground during the day to gnaw at plant roots, providing it with the nutrients it needs to grow. It only resurfaces at night, when it will wander in search of a healthy tree to feed on.

entry: POKENAME模样虽然不讨喜，性情却很温顺。白天躲避天敌，夜里再靠月光进行光合作用。
author: ethewriter
source: Despite their off-putting appearance, POKENAME are docile. They hide from predators in the day and photosynthesize using the moon at night.

entry: POKENAME白天埋身，只露叶片。植物般的身体干燥磨粉，药用广，盗猎者会等它夜里出土，再来搜寻。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME buries itself during the day, leaving only its leaves above the ground. Pokémon poachers will search for it after it resurfaces at night, as POKENAME's plant-like body has a wide range of medical applications when dried into a powder.

entry: POKENAME只在自认没被发现时才动，否则尽量借暗色藏身。常侵入温室与花园，享受其他植物受到的照料。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME moves only when it believes it has not been detected, otherwise using its dark coloration to try and avoid notice. It is often found infesting greenhouses and gardens, where it benefits from the care other plants are receiving.

entry: POKENAME散出压倒敌人嗅觉的气味，保护柔软脆弱的身体。原产温带湿地，常在月下冥想、伸展。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME protects its vulnerable, soft body by emitting an odor that overpowers the olfactory senses of enemies. Native to temperate wetlands, it can often be found meditating and stretching under the moonlight.

entry: POKENAME大多坐着不动。脚轮能载它走，却太笨拙，走不远。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME spends most of its time sitting still. It can move using the wheels on its feet, but it's too clumsy to get very far.

entry: POKENAME埋进地里，粗根吸土中养分。人们常办比赛，看谁养的最大。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME bury themselves in the ground, using their thick roots to gather nutrients from the soil. There are many competitions held to see who can grow the biggest POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME叶子药用多，草药师常饲养。不过叶有轻毒，处理得小心。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are often owned by herbalists, as their leaves have many different medicinal properties. However the leaves are mildly toxic, so they should be handled with care.

entry: POKENAME白天潜伏暗洞，夜里外出。肘与膝能发射利叶。
author: hiroshima0042_23263
source: POKENAME lurks in dark caves during the day and comes out at night. POKENAME can release sharp leaves from its elbows and knees.

entry: POKENAME蒸汽有宜人花香，因此很受家庭欢迎。饮食影响香气，饲主常交流心得，按季节调香。
author: sk372
source: The steam POKENAME emits contains a floral scent many find appealing, making it a popular house pet. As its scent is affected by diet, many owners swap advice on how to change the fragrance for the seasons.

entry: POKENAME虽吃许多毒花，叶子却无毒。常入沙拉，温和苦味与鲜番茄相配。
author: mistymagius
source: Despite feeding on many types of poisonous flowers, POKENAME's leaves are actually non-toxic. They are often used in salads; their mild and bitter flavors tend to pair well with fresh tomatoes.

entry: POKENAME白天躲卷心菜田伪装。夜里鼾声响亮，散出烂南瓜恶臭。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME hides in cabbage fields to blend in during the day. At night, it snores loudly, releasing a foul rotten pumpkin stench.

entry: POKENAME绵丝般的身体，由细藤构成，有茸丹果香。甜香诱来旁人，表示这里安全平和，适合休息。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's floss body is comprised of thin vines that let loose a Rabuta Berry scent. This sweet aroma attracts others, signaling a safe and peaceful place to rest.

entry: POKENAME领地意识极强，头锤敌人时，放出绿花粉云。花粉会令对方疲惫，难以站稳。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME is fiercely territorial, letting loose clouds of green pollen whenever it headbutts a foe. The pollen can cause exhaustion, making it difficult for its enemies to stay on their feet.

entry: POKENAME虽一脸空白，领地意识却强。埋土等入侵者，跃起头锤，力道强得反将敌人打进地里。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Despite their vacant expressions, POKENAME are fiercely territorial. They burrow themselves into the ground to wait for intruders before leaping up and delivering headbutts strong enough to bury their foes instead.

entry: POKENAME恶臭，常青森林其他宝可梦都避它。研究者认为，核心似乎因大气氧浓度高而腐烂，才有气味。
author: theaceofhearts0306
source: POKENAME is commonly avoided by the other Pokémon in Viridian Forest since it has a foul odor. Researchers attribute this to its core seemingly rotting away from high oxygen concentration in the atmosphere.

entry: POKENAME尾尖火焰，晒久太阳便更亮。绿色来自身体产生的叶绿素与其他矿物。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have flames at the end of their tails that glow brighter after spending lots of time in the sun. The green color comes from the chlorophyll and other minerals that their body produces.

entry: POKENAME在地下深处吃松树根。休息时，叶子探出土，放出清新松香。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME feeds on pine tree roots deep underground. When resting, it pushes its leaves above the soil, releasing a fresh pine scent.

entry: POKENAME地道里，飘着宜人萄葡果香。入侵者先被安抚，随后它便吐出腐蚀酸。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's tunnels are filled with a pleasant Grepa Berry aroma. The scent relaxes intruders before it spits corrosive acid.

entry: POKENAME游荡收叶，挑选标准无人知道。偶尔甚至出硬币，向旁人换叶。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can be seen collecting leaves as it roams, though none are sure what criteria it uses to judge the ones it collects. Occasionally it will even offer coins to others in exchange for leaves.

entry: POKENAME头叶有枝荔果香，宜人却久久不散，引发剧烈偏头痛。旁人难集中精神，让它更容易躲避威胁。
author: .izik
source: The leaf on POKENAME's head releases a Liechi Berry scent that is pleasant but lingering, causing large migraines. This odd fragrance makes it hard for others to focus, giving POKENAME an advantage when hiding from potential threats.

entry: POKENAME受惊就凶狠反应，用脚扬起土与孢子。它从不平静，总在来回绕圈。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME reacts aggressively when startled, kicking up dirt and spores with its feet. It is never calm and constantly paces in circles.

entry: 一闻燃烧树叶，POKENAME就暴怒，挥拳打附近一切。满月夜进行光合作用，增强臂肌与力量。
author: fiordaliso
source: If it smells burning leaves, POKENAME flies into a rage and starts punching anything nearby. It performs photosynthesis during full-moon nights to strengthen its arm muscles and become stronger.

entry: POKENAME跑起来，背叶会变热。疾奔过后，留下淡淡熟凰梨果香。
author: .izik
source: The leaves on POKENAME's back grow hot while it runs. As it sprints, it leaves behind a faint scent like ripened Pinap Berries.

entry: 叶里榨的油极辣，许多地方菜用来调味。POKENAME整夜不睡，以惊人速度掠过树林。
author: fiordaliso
source: The oil extracted from its leaves is intensely spicy and used in many regional recipes to flavor delicious dishes. POKENAME stays awake through the night, darting through the woods at incredible speeds.

entry: 它们的环境里没有天敌，不需强劲攻势。训练家若想培养战斗攻击力，可用小瓶涟漪薰香，帮它提起精神。
author: quackquackattack
source: They have no natural predators in their environment, and as such they do not have a need to pack a punch. To help develop their offensive abilities in battle, Trainers may use small vials of Wave Incense to help perk them up.

entry: POKENAME在池塘捕猎，头叶散出棱瓜果香。用溶解液制服波波等猎物，确保捉住，留待以后吃。
author: .izik
source: The leaves on POKENAME's head release a Coba Berry scent while it hunts in ponds. It will use Acid to incapacitate prey like Pidgey, ensuring a successful capture for later consumption.

entry: POKENAME躺在高草，放出干扰心智的毒气，以敏捷动作应付攻击，再凭空消失。
author: dragon6420
source: POKENAME lies in the tall grass, emitting a poisonous gas that causes psychological impairment. It weathers attacks with agile movements before vanishing into thin air.

entry: POKENAME小小身体力大无穷，晒太阳促进肌肉生长。双臂拔起走路草，能甩到地平线外。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME possess incredible strength despite their small size, basking in the sun to increase muscle growth. They use their arms to yank Oddish out of the ground, hurling them past the horizon.

entry: POKENAME头叶随风摇，散出浓洋葱味。园丁常误认它是普通杂草。
author: .izik
source: The leaves on POKENAME's head release a sharp onion scent as it sways in the wind. Gardeners often mistake it for a common weed.

entry: POKENAME半浸沼泥，从富矿物的泥里吸养分，让头叶长大。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can be found in marshes or swamps half submerged in the mud. It siphons nutrients from the mineral rich mud to grow leaves from its head.

entry: POKENAME叶片产薄油，似乎能阻止虫宝可梦想吃它。近来发现，油也很适合治虫蜇伤。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's leaves produce a thin layer of oil that seems to prevent Bug Pokémon from trying to eat it. It has recently been discovered that the oil is also great at treating insect stings.

entry: POKENAME在海底假扮海藻，触手钻入底泥，挖出食物。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME hides on the sea floor disguised as seaweed. It digs its tentacles into the sea floor to dredge up food.

entry: 它是夜行海洋宝可梦，全身流着麻痹毒。游进藤状触手之间的宝可梦，都会动弹不得。
author: bobosmith01
source: It is a nocturnal marine Pokémon whose entire body courses with a paralytic poison. Pokémon that swim between its vine-like tentacles become unable to move.

entry: POKENAME常远游，停下就把自己栽土里休息。吃草宝可梦有时误认叶片为草，一口啃来，就被它怒喷毒粉报复。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Prone to wandering across long distances, POKENAME will stop to rest by planting itself. Sometimes grazing Pokémon will mistake its leaves for grass and begin to eat it, causing POKENAME to angrily spray poisonous powders in retaliation.

entry: POKENAME钻地，只露灌木般的鬃与尾。若宝可梦想啃叶，就将叶子烧得只剩一片。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME burrows underground, leaving only its bush-like mane and tail visible. If a Pokémon tries to nibble at its leaves, it will burn all but one of them off.

entry: POKENAME久久静坐，让背苔生长。苔流出的液体，连炎夏也能让身体保湿。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME sits still for incredibly long periods to allow the moss on its back to grow. This moss leaks a fluid that keeps its body moist even on hot summer days.

entry: POKENAME壳上长着沼泽常见的芦苇与草，常埋在泥里伪装，躲天敌。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME has shells that grow reeds and grasses that appear in marshes. It can be found buried in the mud, where it camouflages itself to hide from predators.

entry: 手中那根“棍子”，其实是好几片长草叶团成的。谁敢割掉它的草，就会遭到反击。
author: soup1900
source: The stick it carries is actually multiple blades of tall grass wadded together. It fights against anyone who tries to mow down its grass.

entry: POKENAME吸收大量阳光后，精力便会猛然涌起，于是四处狂奔，消耗一部分多余的能量。冬天日照较少，它们便减少活动，保存体力。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME experience a jolt of energy whenever they absorb lots of sunlight and run around wildly to burn off some of the excess energy. During winter when there is little sunlight, they conserve their energy by limiting their movement.

entry: POKENAME沿海岸找地方，安静晒太阳。找到合适处，就睡着，让叶片吸日光。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME travel along coastlines to find a viable spot to sunbathe undisturbed. Once they find a suitable location, they fall asleep and absorb sunlight through their leaves.

entry: POKENAME完全不能接受睡干处，成长需要大量水与阳光。因此沿海岸休息，睡着也能取养分。
author: quackquackattack
source: The idea of sleeping somewhere dry is completely anathema to POKENAME, as they require lots of water and sunlight to develop. They rest alongside coastlines to get those nutrients while sleeping.

entry: POKENAME身上覆的泥状黏液，养分意外丰富。头叶抽动，转向阳光。
author: .izik
source: The mud-like slime that coats POKENAME's body and is surprisingly rich in nutrients. Its head-leaves twitch and turn toward sunlight.

entry: POKENAME厚泥身体养分高，附近植物轻易就长旺。滴下的液体，还能给田地作肥。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's thick muddy body is high in nutrients, allowing plants to grow with remarkable ease nearby. The fluid dripping from its body can be used as fertilizer for fields.

entry: POKENAME是水族箱里常见的宝可梦，叶片能过滤水中的杂质，外壳则保护自己免受打扰。它们通过开合外壳，将水抽送过叶片。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are a common Pokémon to be included in aquariums, their leaves filtering out impurities in the water whilst their shell keeps them from being disturbed. They pump water past their leaves by opening and closing their shells.

entry: 它胆怯地藏在栗子般坚固的壳里，只有独处才肯露面。活动太少又不通风，让POKENAME经常迟钝无力。
author: mistymagius
source: This timid Pokémon hides in its tough, chestnut-like shell, only revealing itself when it is alone. Because of this, POKENAME is often sluggish due to limited activity and poor air circulation.

entry: POKENAME夜里无目的地飘，所到处留花粉云。目击者常误认它是游魂。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME drifts aimlessly at night, leaving clouds of pollen wherever it goes. Sightings of POKENAME are often mistaken for wandering spirits.

entry: POKENAME蹭锐石，修整圆头与身上叶片。身体磨光滑，战斗时也更快。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME maintains its rotund head and the leaves on its body by rubbing against sharp rocks. This smooths out its body, making it faster in battle.

entry: 洞壁开始呼吸、露出POKENAME覆苔身体，曾让矿工惊逃。它爬去更静的地方休息，旧卧处的蘑菇，此后一直长个不停。
author: jaminmcready
source: Miners once fled in terror when a cavern wall began to breathe, revealing POKENAME's moss-covered body. It slithered off to a quieter resting place, leaving mushrooms growing endlessly where it once slept.

entry: POKENAME头叶有榴石果香，能哄猎物入睡，方便吃梦。
author: .izik
source: The leaves atop POKENAME's head smell like Pomeg Berries. This aroma can lull prey to sleep, allowing it to feast on their dreams.

entry: POKENAME挥祖传吊坠，受害者就深深恍惚，被它引去盛大的部落集会。
author: theaceofhearts0306
source: As POKENAME waves its ancestral pendant, its victims fall into a deep trance, allowing POKENAME to lead them to its large tribal gatherings.

entry: POKENAME常在花园打盹，尤其月夜。吸足月光，大钳便有紫丁香花香。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME spends much of its time napping in flower gardens, particularly during moonlit nights. When it absorbs a large amount of moonlight, its larger claw emits a floral scent akin to lilac.

entry: POKENAME翅膀足以带它离地，却更爱配合快步，用来威吓。
author: pixlhoopa
source: The wings of POKENAME are functional enough to lift it off the ground, but it prefers to use them as a form of intimidation alongside its quick footwork.

entry: POKENAME热爱舞蹈，尤其在亮日光下。阳光助燃火焰，舞成可爱又美丽的景象。
author: roundabout_robin
source: POKENAME is a very eager dancer. It loves to dance in bright sunlight, which fuels its flames and creates adorably beautiful displays.

entry: POKENAME外表虽讨喜，体内火与电却危险地翻腾，混合欲爆。发怒便爆发能量，偏偏又极容易惹怒。
author: infinex21
source: Despite an appearance found charming by many, POKENAME are dangerous due to the explosive mix of fire and electricity broiling within them. They explosively release their energies when angered, which is all too easy to accomplish.

entry: POKENAME常见于纪念先祖的节庆。传说曾被视为以音乐指引亡灵的向导。
author: roninthedev
source: POKENAME are commonly seen during festivals honoring people's ancestors, Legends say that POKENAME were seen as a musical spirit guide for the dead.

entry: POKENAME战斗中摇摆，令人难料。下招可能是优雅振翼虚晃，也可能是直冲而来的火拳。
author: sk372
source: In combat, POKENAME's swaying motions make for an unpredictable opponent. A foe is never certain if POKENAME's next move will be an elegant feinting sway of its wings, or a fist of flame careening towards them.

entry: POKENAME大部分时间教幼崽协调、专注，练好招牌战舞。孩子虽还在学，动作已能造小火龙卷。
author: sk372
source: Much of POKENAME's time is spent teaching its young the coordination and focus needed to perfect their trademark combat dance. Though the child is still learning, it is capable of creating tiny fire tornadoes with its moves.

entry: POKENAME拍鳍，按特定动作游，刺激身体从内发热，便能吐出灼热泡泡与滚烫墨汁，抵御大生物。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME flaps its fins and swims in specific motions to stimulate its body and heat it up from the inside. This lets it spit out burning-hot bubbles and scalding ink to defend itself from larger creatures.

entry: POKENAME春天众多，在花田上空排成绚丽红浪。复杂优雅的空中舞，表示花粉产量格外高。
author: metcassette
source: Abundant in springtime, POKENAME arrange in dazzling waves of red above fields of flowers. Their intricate and graceful mid-air dances are a sign that pollen production is exceptionally high.

entry: POKENAME是弗拉门戈高手，有机会就爱表演。每次拍手，都会迸火星。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are masters of the flamenco and enjoy putting on shows when they can. Whenever they clap their hands, fire sparks.

entry: POKENAME臂上大羽锋利，能轻易切开花岗岩。战斗边舞边切过空气，动作致命精准。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's large, sharp feathers on its arm are able to cut through granite with ease. It moves with lethal precision, slicing through the air as it dances in combat.

entry: POKENAME边舞边向周身喷火。复杂跳跃与姿势，每个精编动作，都点燃战场。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME shoots flames around its body while it dances. It does elaborate leaps and poses, igniting the battlefield with each carefully choreographed move.

entry: POKENAME双钳随舞开合，节奏鲜明。动作利落精准，谁低估这优雅，都会遇上难缠对手。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's pincers open and close in rhythm as it dances. Its movements are sharp and precise, making it a challenging opponent for anyone who underestimates its grace.

entry: POKENAME越专心跳跃，火焰越大越强。天敌想趁跳起捕捉，就被鳍上的巨大火焰巴掌扇开。
author: soup1900
source: The more intent POKENAME is at leaping about, the bigger and stronger its flames become. It dishes out huge fiery slaps from its fins at predators who try to catch it mid-jump.

entry: POKENAME用头刺支地，旋转起舞。小身躯竟优雅无比，转出复杂舞步，尖刺既帮它保持平衡，也能作武器。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spins on the stinger on its head while it dances. Its tiny body moves with surprising grace as it performs intricate twirls, the stinger serving as both a balance and a weapon.

entry: POKENAME爱水下跳舞，双翼难料地摆动，诱近猎物，再迅速冲锋打倒。
author: thezekrom
source: POKENAME loves to dance underwater. The unpredictable movement of its wings is meant to lure in prey until they are close enough to be taken out by a swift charge attack.

entry: POKENAME大胆火热的舞，融合许多舞者的技巧，复制后记在身体里。虽不原创，精湛本领却能比肩人类舞者。
author: quackquackattack
source: The bold, fiery dance of POKENAME combines elements from many dancers, each technique copied and memorized in its body. Even though POKENAME's dances lack originality, its superb skill rivals human dancers.

entry: POKENAME热情起舞，火星四溅，表演独特。住在海滩，常不慎留下繁复玻璃脚印，令见者着迷。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: POKENAME are passionate dancers who create sparks as they dance, putting on unique shows. They live on beaches and will often accidentally leave behind intricate patterns of glass pawprints that fascinate those who come across them.

entry: POKENAME吐丝，在战场挪身。边战边古怪旋舞，让敌人难料下一步。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spits silk to move itself around the battlefield. It spins in an odd dance while fighting, making it difficult for opponents to predict its next move.

entry: POKENAME美丽又致命，战斗随只有自己听见的节拍起舞，危险而优雅地穿梭。若在舞蹈上胜过它，就能赢得效忠。
author: nyoomymph
source: POKENAME is a striking combination of beauty and deadliness. It dances as it fights, moving to a rhythm only it hears, weaving through the battlefield with dangerous gracefulness. If you can beat POKENAME in dance, you will win its allegiance.

entry: POKENAME身躯大又圆，舞步却出奇优雅。肚子始终温暖，靠着打盹十分舒服。
author: sk372
source: Despite its large rotund body, POKENAME's dance routines contain a surprising level of elegance to them. Its perpetually-warm belly is considered a quite pleasant place to nap against.

entry: POKENAME惊人舞姿，启发古今许多艺术与音乐杰作。音乐家和艺术家结成大旅行团，寻找这火鸟。
author: a_grain_of_rice
source: POKENAME's breathtaking dance has inspired many ancient and modern masterpieces in art and music. Musicians and artists form large travel groups to find this fiery bird.

entry: POKENAME偏爱红花，提取色素，染出鲜亮羽色。人看飞行轨迹混乱，其实每一步都精算、准确。
author: metcassette
source: POKENAME have a strong preference for red flowers, the pigments of which are extracted and used for vibrant plumage coloration. Their flight patterns, though erratic to the human eye, are carefully measured and precise.

entry: POKENAME停在帕底亚最高的楼顶，听下方音乐，按曲子编舞。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME perch atop the highest buildings in Paldea, listening to the music down below. They choreograph their movements based on the songs they hear.

entry: POKENAME跳跃踢后腿、展开羽毛，威吓对手。威胁仍靠近，就点燃羽毛，随绚丽舞蹈撒出。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME leap about while kicking their hind legs and flaring out their feathers to intimidate opponents. If the threat approaches anyway, they ignite their feathers and scatter them in vibrant dances.

entry: POKENAME不用手指拨弦，改以小电流弹尤克里里，演奏南方文化的音乐。
author: dodoowner_
source: Instead of strumming with its fingers, POKENAME uses small jolts of electricity to play the ukulele. The music it plays comes from southern cultures.

entry: POKENAME在阿罗拉祭礼上，催眠般的肚皮鼓很有名，也能缓解头痛与炎症。
author: big_clanker
source: This fiery Pokémon is known for its hypnotic belly drumming during spiritual ceremonies in the Alola region. POKENAME's belly drumming is also known to soothe headaches and inflammation.

entry: POKENAME在池面快舞，始终不沉水。夜间优雅移动，脚下能见微微发光的余烬。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME performs a rapid dance atop the surfaces of ponds, never sinking beneath the water. At night, faint embers can be seen glowing beneath its steps as it moves with grace.

entry: POKENAME跺动双脚，拍打翅膀般的双臂，积蓄火焰。这是求偶舞中至关重要的一环，可它们常聚在垃圾桶旁，动静实在很吵。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME stamps its feet and flaps its winged arms to build up fire. This is a crucial part of the POKENAME courtship dance, but it is very loud, as they tend to group up around trash cans.

entry: POKENAME嘴里玫瑰看似无害，实能瞬间燃烧，烫伤触碰者。水里这招不灵，便跳热舞，实际将自己钻进泥里藏起。
author: soup1900
source: While the rose in POKENAME's mouth looks harmless, it can instantly light ablaze to burn anyone that touches it. As this tactic fails in water, POKENAME instead performs a passionate dance that in actuality digs itself into the mud to hide away.

entry: POKENAME背上的花苞吸收阳光，提升内部温度。野外遇到捕食者，或陷入激战时，它便挥动翅膀，扬出热孢子。
author: pixlhoopa
source: The bulb on its back takes in sunlight to increase its internal temperature. When confronted by predators in the wild, or during a fierce battle, POKENAME releases the heated spores by whipping them around with its wings.

entry: POKENAME爱前后甩头、乱舞双臂，尤其遇上响亮刺耳音乐。奇怪的是，再怎么摇滚忘我，尾巴却诡异地纹丝不动。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME loves to dance by rocking its head back and forth and flailing its arms all around, especially when loud and harsh music is being played. Oddly, no matter how much POKENAME jams and rocks out, its tail remains eerily still.

entry: POKENAME热情舞动头部，跺脚蓄火。尾巴却不爱激烈动作，便啄身体，闹到它放慢。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME's head dances passionately, stamping its feet to build up its flame. The tail doesn't like the aggressive movement and will peck at the body, bugging it until it slows down.

entry: POKENAME在深洞起舞，坚石双翼绕身旋转。节奏在岩道共鸣，每下重拍，都引发小震动。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's stone-hard wings spin around its body as it dances deep in caves. The rhythmic movements resonate through the rocky tunnels, causing small tremors with each powerful beat.

entry: POKENAME边舞边对空咬，使出鬼面，恐吓观众。表演可爱又吓人，恰到好处地兼具魅力与威胁。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME bites at the air as it dances, making a Scary Face to intimidate all who watch. Its performance is both endearing and threatening, creating a perfect mix of charm and menace.

entry: POKENAME把双钳当响板，随舞优雅打节拍。跳舞引导火焰，再以强劲打击释放。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME use their claws as castanets as they dance, clicking them in an elegant rhythm. These Pokémon channel flames as they dance, unleashing them in powerful strikes.

entry: POKENAME成对行动，一个跳舞分散注意，另一个偷宝可梦蛋等食物。欺骗行径加上擅战本领，启发了许多虚构作品中的坏蛋形象。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME travel in pairs, with one dancing to distract a target while the other steals food, such as Pokémon eggs. Because of this deceptive behavior and their ability to fight adeptly, POKENAME has inspired many scoundrels in fiction.

entry: POKENAME由极微小羽毛构成，跳舞看着如液体。羽光闪动，动作带来绚丽景象。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body is composed of extremely tiny feathers that resemble liquid as it dances. The feathers glisten and shimmer, creating a visual spectacle during its movements.

entry: 过去，人们用短弓或长枪猎POKENAME，收羽织布。岛上禁用这些武器后，成了它们安居繁衍的庇护所。
author: quackquackattack
source: People used to hunt POKENAME with a shortbow or lance, as their feathers were once collected for textiles. These weapons were banned on islands, creating a sanctuary for them to grow and prosper.

entry: POKENAME边旋舞边嚎，火焰猛烈得能熔钢，展现力量与热情。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME howls while spinning during its dance. The flames it produces are so intense that they're hot enough to melt steel, showcasing its strength and passion.

entry: POKENAME炫脚步、高速旋转，踢起绚丽余烬。若转得太忘我，炫酷火舞就变成猛烈火龙卷。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME kicks up dazzling embers as it shows off its fancy footwork and high-speed spins. If it spins too passionately, it turns from a cool show of fire into an intense flaming tornado.

entry: POKENAME炫耀华丽的步法、飞快旋转时，会踢起绚丽的火星。观众必须站在远处，以防它转得太快，竟变成猛烈的火焰龙卷风。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME kicks up dazzling embers as it shows off its fancy footwork and high-speed spins. Spectators of these shows must watch from far away in the event it spins too fast and becomes an intense tornado of fire instead.

entry: POKENAME热情，大部分时间都在完善舞蹈。尾巴拍地，发出掌声般的响动，帮助保持节奏。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are passionate creatures that spend most of their time perfecting their dance. Their tail thuds against the ground to produce a clapping sound that they rely on to keep rhythm.

entry: POKENAME无论水下或空中，都扭身优雅移动。振翼一下，附近水域就能喷起滚烫液柱，如间歇泉。
author: sk372
source: Whether beneath the water or in the air, POKENAME's movements are twisting and elegant. With a single flap of its wings, it can create a rising geyser of scalding liquid to erupt from any body of water near it.

entry: POKENAME舞动时，尾羽噼啪放电。若被忽略，就从尾放闪电，让人注意它。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's feathers on its tail crackle with electricity as it dances. If ignored, it will unleash lightning bolts from its tail to ensure its presence is known.

entry: 发怒时，它乱甩头、拍尾击地。这动作助长火力，造出能灼伤敌人的烈焰。
author: hophoppip
source: When angry, it thrashes its head and smacks its tail on the ground. The motion of thrashing fuels its fiery abilities, helping it generate flames to sear its foes.

entry: POKENAME越舞越凶，尾部放电吸引注意，常点燃周围。可火海之中，它仍继续跳。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME becomes more aggressive as it dances and will draw attention to itself by discharging lightning from its tail. This often sets its surroundings on fire, but POKENAME will dance on amidst the flames.

entry: POKENAME用妩媚的舞步与天生的美貌，引其他宝可梦听命。它先骗敌人共舞，再用双翼将其烧尽。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME uses their seductive dance moves and natural beauty to coax other Pokémon into doing its bidding. It tricks its enemies into dancing with it before incinerating them with its wings.

entry: POKENAME按舞姿，为周围带来热风或冷风。展翼跳，便热；收翼跳，则冷。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's dances can provide the surrounding area with hot or cold wind, depending on its actions. Dancing with its wings spread provides heat, while dancing with them closed generates cold.

entry: POKENAME跳舞顺时针转，身体散出大量数字信号。电脑一接触，常从互联网上随机装入各处程序。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spins clockwise while dancing, dispersing a large amount of digital signals from its body. Computers exposed to this often have programs installed on them at random from places across the internet.

entry: POKENAME勤练舞，把笨拙失步，也努力变成新舞招。翅膀虽短，舞中动作却精细复杂。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME diligently practices its dancing, attempting to turn each clumsy misstep into a new dance move. While dancing, it moves its wings intricately despite their short length.

entry: POKENAME用狂热快步跳舞生火，再把蜕羽织成优雅扇子，舞时拿着。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME generates its flames by performing rapid dances with frenzied footwork. It weaves its own shed feathers into an elegant fan to hold while dancing.

entry: POKENAME的下半身，密密地覆着许多小羽毛。开心时，或与信任的人类、宝可梦相处时，它会小心翼翼地起舞。不过，羽毛摩擦产生的火星，很容易点燃附近的引火物。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's lower body is clad in many small feathers densely packed together. It performs a careful dance when it is happy, and with people or Pokémon it trusts, but the friction of its feathers can easily spark fires if near kindling.

entry: POKENAME碰拍双翼能生火，跳舞时常如此。战斗或开心，都会跳。
author: infinex21
source: By beating its wings together, POKENAME can create flames; it frequently beats its wings together as it dances. POKENAME dances during battle and when it is happy.

entry: 迷人的舞姿来自刻苦练习。最好别打扰它们训练，惹恼了，可会被踩脚趾。
author: quote.lass
source: Their mesmerizing dances are the result of intense practice. It's best not to interrupt their training; they've been know to stomp toes when annoyed.

entry: POKENAME舞中多羽摩擦生火，再用念力控火，既作战，也为表演添彩。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME create flames through the friction of their many feathers as they dance. They wield telekinetic powers to control and command these flames either for battle or to enhance their performances.

entry: POKENAME常照料受伤的鸟类。遇险时，便在自己与病号周围，卷起小小的火焰旋涡。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME often are found tending to injured birds. It will create a small Fire Spin around itself and its patients when in danger.

entry: POKENAME美丽的羽毛散出大量热量，因此住在寒冷地区。它十分难以讨好，对任何不喜欢的求偶者，都会喷出猛烈火焰。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME lives in colder climates as its beautiful feathers give off large amounts of heat.  It is a difficult Pokémon to please as it will spew harsh flames at any potential mate it doesn't like.

entry: POKENAME舞中偶尔随机变成一种原色。似乎不由自主，焦虑时更常发生。
author: .izik
source: While dancing, POKENAME occasionally shifts its body to a random primary color. This appears to be involuntary and occurs more frequently when POKENAME is anxious.

entry: POKENAME现身便摇身打拍，随自己的调子舞动。动作在体内生热，向近身者甩火，也不乱一拍。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME sways its body rhythmically when it manifests, dancing to its own tune. The movements generate heat within its body, letting it toss fire about at anything that gets too close without missing a beat.

entry: POKENAME奔跑时，会挥动翅膀向身后抛出火焰，留下一路火迹。它借此迅速绕着目标奔走，直到火墙彻底封死逃路。
author: sk372
source: When POKENAME runs, it moves its wings in such a way as to cast flames behind it, leaving trails of fire in its wake. Using this, it surrounds a target with quick movements until the fire walls leave them with no chance of escape.

entry: POKENAME初看吓人，也确实危险。失去双翼的怒火，让它向一切飞近者，施以烈焰与致命毒雾，残酷打落。
author: pixlhoopa
source: POKENAME appears intimidating at first, and for good reason. Instilled with rage for the loss of its wings, any Pokémon that fly near it are subject to a brutal combination of flames and lethal fog to strike it down.

entry: POKENAME假嘴还兼作舞伴，陪它练习。双方高速旋舞，周围便起小火龙卷。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's false mouth serves an additional purpose as a dance partner for it to practice its moves with. When the two pirouette at high speeds, it creates a small flaming tornado around them.

entry: 对POKENAME而言，舞就是一切，不可或缺。不肯常陪跳的训练家，它连服从的念头都不会有。
author: sk372
source: For POKENAME, its dance is everything, a facet of life that cannot be lived without. It won't even entertain the thought of obeying a Trainer unwilling to dance with it regularly.

entry: POKENAME战斗之外，走得很慢。野生花舞鸟一有机会，就聚来，在背上舞台表演。
author: ferdirenz
source: POKENAME is a very slow walker outside of battle. Wild Oricorio seem to flock to perform on the stage on its back whenever they can.

entry: POKENAME羽上覆甜香毒，战舞越久，毒性越强。节奏动作，增强毒舞威力。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's feathers are coated in a sweet-smelling poison that gets more potent as it dances during battle. The rhythmic motions enhance the potency of its toxic dance.

entry: POKENAME挥向敌人时，长布与双翼燃起烈焰。人们认为，那是寄宿剑中灵魂的热情。
author: soup1900
source: As POKENAME swings itself at enemies, a blazing flame is created from its long cloth and wings. These flames are believed to be the burning passions of the soul that inhabits this sword.

entry: POKENAME双剑如二重奏，配合打出烈焰重击与火刃。热情攻势，像帕底亚传统舞的动作与节拍。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's two swords attack opponents as a duet, performing blazing strikes and fiery slices at enemies. Its passionate attack patterns are similar to the moves and rhythms of traditional dances from the Paldea region.

entry: POKENAME惯将每场战斗当舞蹈。控火之下，精妙攻击，令对手目瞪口呆。
author: korro0490
source: POKENAME customarily treats each battle as a dance. With its control over flames, POKENAME's exquisite attacks leave its opponents astounded.

entry: 它振翅的声音像女子歌唱，舞步却毫无优雅，配不上动听的歌声。它为自己糟糕的舞技羞愧，常躲着旁人。
author: hobiewankenobi
source: The flapping of its wings sounds like a woman singing, but it fails to have any grace in its dance moves to live up to the gorgeous sound. It often hides from others because it is ashamed of its terrible dance skills.

entry: 盒身顶上的花舞鸟，其实只是极逼真的复制品。只有用身侧摇柄上足发条，才会如活物般起舞。
author: infinex21
source: What appears to be an Oricorio atop its box-like body is actually just a very accurate replica. This replica can dance as if it were alive, but only when the crank on the side of its body has been fully wound up.

entry: POKENAME舞中夸张甩毛，确保吸引附近所有人。带人群一路穿镇歌舞，总想再拉人加入。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME dance with dramatic flourishes of their fur to make sure they can capture the attetion of everyone nearby. They lead crowds in song and dance through towns, always looking for more to join their performacnes.

entry: POKENAME擅战，借缎带与敏捷，打倒比自己大得多的敌人。据说火热动作，启发许多古典舞。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME is known for its battle prowess, using its ribbons and agility to take down foes much larger than itself. It is believed its fiery movements have inspired many classical dances.

entry: POKENAME战中在同伴旁跳轻快桑巴，振奋大家。灼热触角划过空中，周围泛起涟漪般的波动。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME performs a lighthearted samba near its allies to excite them during fights. Its hot feelers wave through the air, creating a rippling effect around it.

entry: POKENAME每年一次，在深山优雅舞动。有幸看见的人说，火焰点亮心中的暖意，几个月都不散。
author: jaminmcready
source: Deep within the mountains, POKENAME performs a graceful dance once each year. Those fortunate enough to witness it claim its flames kindle a warmth in their hearts that lingers for months.

entry: POKENAME每年一次，在深山优雅舞动。有幸看见的人说，火焰点亮心中的暖意，几个月都不散。
author: jaminmcready
source: Deep within the mountains, POKENAME performs a graceful dance once each year. Those fortunate enough to witness it claim its flames kindle a warmth in their hearts that lingers for months.

entry: 它到来，静广场便化作花开舞台。舞得太热情，花从石缝冒出，全镇聚看，入迷得直到谢幕都移不开目光。
author: jaminmcready
source: Its arrival transforms quiet plazas into blooming stages, where it dances with such passion that flowers burst from the cracks in the stone. Entire towns gather to watch, spellbound, unable to look away until the final bow.

entry: POKENAME飘在节庆人群上方，随乐拍鼓胀、收缩。虽爱玩，挡视线的游行气球却惹它生气，常用利喙戳爆。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME drifts above festival crowds, inflating and deflating with the beat of the music. Though playful, it grows aggressive toward parade balloons that block its view, often popping them with its sharp beak.

entry: POKENAME曾是王族亲用护卫。快转阳伞，能将火甩成环，护住自己与训练家。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME were used personally by royalty as bodyguards. By spinning their parasols rapidly, they can fling fire into a protective ring around themself and their Trainer.

entry: POKENAME边舞边将多尾画圈。每次甩尾，空气就泛波纹，看着如流动火焰漩涡。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME waves its multiple tails in circular patterns while dancing. Each flick of its tails sends ripples through the air, making it look like a fiery whirlpool in motion.

entry: 训练家指令不好，POKENAME便喷出燃烧内脏抽打。黏液易燃，谁把它拎起扔下海，双手也能被点燃。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME eject burning internal organs from their bodies to smack Trainers who give them a bad order. Their sticky mucus is flammable; this allows them to ignite the hands of anyone who lifts and chucks them into the ocean.

entry: POKENAME环上的小挂饰一摇响，附近就泛暖意。平时平和，真惹怒了，就点燃挂饰掷人。
author: sk372
source: Jingling the small charms on POKENAME's ring casts out a pleasant warmth in the immediate vicinity. Though generally peaceful, POKENAME will ignite the charms and fling them at others if angered enough.

entry: POKENAME私下露出暗影缎带般的肢体，共舞。制作褶边服装，在废弃花舞鸟求偶地比拼，舞得猛烈，火星令其他宝可梦不敢近。
author: orionsayshi
source: POKENAME unveil shadowy ribbon-like limbs to dance together in private. They craft frilled costumes and compete with each other in abandoned Oricorio courtship grounds, moving so intensely that fiery sparks keep other Pokémon from approaching.

entry: POKENAME每片翼纹都独一无二。展翼既为防身，也用于求偶仪式。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: The pattern on each wing of POKENAME is entirely unique. This Pokémon will unfurl its wings both as a defense mechanism and as part of its courting ritual.

entry: POKENAME轻快地蹦跳时，许多尾巴在空中摇曳，轻盈而优雅。谁想触碰，只消尾巴轻轻一甩，掀起的火浪便会将其轰飞。
author: sk372
source: As POKENAME prances around, its many tails swish through the air in a light and elegantly flowing manner. Those who attempt to touch its tails will be blown away by a wave of fire it creates with a single swishing motion.

entry: 水坝造好，POKENAME在坝前跳舞庆祝。有时太过热情，翼中冒火，反将坝烧毁。
author: sk372
source: After the completion of a dam, POKENAME celebrates by dancing in front of the completed structure. On occasion, its dance is too overzealous and causes flames to emit from its wings, burning the dam down.

entry: 节庆上，POKENAME用细绳般手臂举起小孩，帮他们越过人群看。可音乐太响，就会狂转，惊动乘客与旁观者。
author: jaminmcready
source: At festivals, POKENAME helps smaller children see over crowds by lifting them with its string-like arms. If the music gets too loud, though, it starts twirling wildly, startling its passengers and nearby onlookers.

entry: 舞被打断，POKENAME就慢舞向冒犯者，用翼裹紧，面具压上对方脸，迅速加热惩罚。
author: .izik
source: If interrupted while dancing, POKENAME slowly dances toward the offender and wraps its wings around them. It then presses its mask against their face and heats it rapidly as punishment.

entry: POKENAME领地意识极强。人们欣赏的美丽舞蹈飞行，其实是在威吓，想赶走闯入者。
author: t3isukone
source: POKENAME is fiercely territorial. While many humans admire this Pokémon's beautiful dance-like flights, they are a threat display attempting to scare off trespassers.

entry: 日落后，POKENAME成群出洞，热情共舞。舞越热烈，双翼火焰就越多。
author: mistymagius
source: Once the sun sets, flocks of POKENAME will emerge from their caves and start performing a passionate dance with one another. The more passionate the dancing, the more flames their wings give off.

entry: POKENAME在枝上跳舞、吐毒性化学物。动作反复难料，危险毒物，让表演更刺激。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spits a poisonous chemical as it dances on tree branches. Its movements are erratic, and the dangerous chemical only adds to the excitement of its performance.

entry: 暴风雪里，POKENAME优雅舞动，升高气温，平息冰风。据说捡到红羽，就有好运。
author: fiordaliso
source: During snowstorms, POKENAME performs elegant dances that raise the surrounding temperature, calming the freezing gales. It is said that collecting one of its red feathers brings good fortune.

entry: 只要POKENAME在，附近就一定能见到其他形态的同类。吸月光生出的热，让叶状羽毛鲜亮发光。
author: pixlhoopa
source: When POKENAME is around, it is a guarantee that other POKENAME of various forms are to be found nearby. The heat produced from taking in moonlight causes its leaf-like feathers to glow vividly.

entry: POKENAME被视为宝可梦世界最佳独舞者之一。常以热情舞蹈为舞节开场，主节目还没开始，就让观众赞叹不已。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME is considered one of the finest solo performers in the Pokémon world. It often opens dance festivals with passionate routines that leave the audience breathless before the main event even begins.

entry: POKENAME是双人同步舞的典范，完美一致的动作令人赞叹。想结伴共舞的人们，常将它视为和谐与竞技风采的象征。
author: jaminmcready
source: A living emblem of synchronized dance duos, POKENAME dazzles with a perfect unity of motion. Aspiring partners in the dancing world often look to it as a symbol of harmony and competitive flair.

entry: POKENAME的绒球一摩擦，轻易点燃干灌丛。巡林者曾记录它在深林练舞，常循焦痕找到。
author: jaminmcready
source: The friction of POKENAME's pom poms can ignite dry brush with ease. Forest patrols have documented it practicing deep in the woods, often tracing it by the scorched trails it leaves behind.

entry: POKENAME是霹雳舞强者，带着十足街头活力，翻腾、定格。贴地旋转，烟雾升起，踩准节拍烧焦地面。
author: jaminmcready
source: A breakdancing powerhouse, POKENAME flips and freezes with raw street energy. Smoke raises as it spins across the ground scorching the floor in perfect rhythm.

entry: POKENAME用臂扇，将灼热余烬吹向敌人。冷了又裹住脸取暖，既能作战，也能保暖。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME uses the fans on its arms to blow fiery embers at opponents. When cold, it wraps them around its face for warmth, making them both weapons and comfort.

entry: POKENAME是一只破袋，装满产粉绒羽与羽毛。红花粉影响下，舞步狂热。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's body is a torn bag full of powder down and feathers. The influence of red pollen inspires POKENAME's frantic dance moves.

entry: 游泳若在水里看到蒸汽，多半就是POKENAME。振翼生的火遇水，常将它笼罩在蒸汽里。
author: astral_1447
source: If you are swimming and you see steam in the water, it is probably an POKENAME. They are often engulfed by steam when the fire produced by flapping their wings meets water.

entry: 它起舞时，会掀起一道道火浪。若没有六只脚，这套舞步，根本学不来。
author: .flipside3
source: It creates waves of fire when it dances. Its style of dancing is impossible to replicate without six feet.

entry: POKENAME边舞边撒蓝花粉，令近敌入睡。跳得越快，撒得越快，是强敌。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME releases a blue pollen to put foes nearby to sleep while it dances. The faster it dances, the faster the pollen gets released, making it a formidable opponent in battle.

entry: POKENAME唾液含微量朱红色花蜜，滋味辛辣刺口，嘴里会久久留着温热刺痛。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME's saliva contains traces of Red Nectar. It has a sharp, spicy taste that causes a warm sting to linger in the mouth.

entry: POKENAME跳舞时，柔软双腿交替弹跳。可爱嬉闹，让人难认真看待，可舞中敏捷却无可匹敌。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME bounces from one soft leg to another while dancing. Its playful and adorable movements make it difficult to take seriously, yet its agility is unmatched during its dance.

entry: POKENAME跳舞时，摩擦羽毛下藏着的石头，擦出火星，点燃翅膀上的绒羽。闪烁的火光配上迅疾的动作，成了一场美丽的舞蹈表演。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME scrape together rocks hidden beneath their feathers to create sparks while they dance, catching downy fluff from their wings on fire. These flickering lights mixed with their rapid movements create a beautiful display of dance.

entry: POKENAME深夜跺脚，短促断续，是在呼唤对手。它求的不是表演，而是竞争，激敌人加入节奏战。
author: wiz0z
source: The staccato sound of POKENAME's stamping feet in the middle of the night is a call for an opponent. Rather than performing, POKENAME seeks competition, goading enemies to join them in a rhythmic battle.

entry: POKENAME背上的羽状鳞，随舞上下扇动。每个优雅舞步都精准，增添战力。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's feather-like scales on its back flap up and down as it dances. Its movements are precise, adding to its battle prowess with every graceful step.

entry: POKENAME月下欢舞，一被发现却拔腿跑。优雅短暂却美丽，逃入暗影，很快消失。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME dances happily in the moonlight but will bolt if someone spots it. Its graceful movements are brief but beautiful, fading quickly into the shadows as it flees.

entry: POKENAME花瓣如美丽礼服，衬得舞步更优雅。脾气火暴，谁敢毁表演，就会大发雷霆。
author: fiordaliso
source: The petals of POKENAME resemble a beautiful gown that enhances the grace of its dance steps. It has a fiery temperament and flies into a rage if another Pokémon dares to ruin its performance.

entry: POKENAME周身宝石闪着艳红，跳舞时散光，将美丽花纹映上墙。据说看见它舞蹈的训练家，会得好运。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The gems on POKENAME's body glitter in a brilliant red hue, the light scattering through them and casting beautiful patterns onto the walls as it dances. The dancing of POKENAME is thought to bring good fortune to Trainers who see it.

entry: POKENAME身上红宝石放出强热。古人靠它们熬过严冬。
author: mistymagius
source: The rubies on POKENAME's body radiate intense heat. Ancient peoples relied on them for warmth during harsh winters.

entry: POKENAME身上的小红宝石能产生高热。周围碎片硬得惊人，既能射出数米，也能挡敌人的攻击。
author: chorb33
source: The small rubies on POKENAME's body can generate intense heat. It can shoot the amazingly hard splinters that surround it over several meters, or use them to protect itself from enemy attacks.

entry: POKENAME跳舞时羽毛摩擦，迸出阵阵小余烬。眼睛能见红外光，夜里轻易就能发现天敌。
author: mistymagius
source: When POKENAME dances around, its feathers rub together to create a flurry of small embers. Its eyes are able to see infared light, allowing it to easily detect predators during the night.

entry: POKENAME在舞池甩大尾，掀尘云衬托动作。虽绚丽，附近舞者却常中途咳嗽，挥手扇走尘埃。
author: jaminmcready
source: On dance floors, POKENAME whips up clouds of dust with its large tail to accent its moves. While the effect is dazzling, it often leaves nearby dancers coughing and waving the air clear mid-performance.

entry: POKENAME娴熟优雅地舞，火焰绕身。跳得够快，脚也裹火，留下焦黑脚印。
author: chibitales
source: Fire swirls around POKENAME as it dances with practiced grace. Its feet are coated in fire when it dances fast enough, leaving scorched pawprints in its wake.

entry: POKENAME长长的两栖腿能水上舞，吸引大群人围看。许多人为噱头来，却为热情感人的舞留下。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can dance on water with their long amphibious legs, drawing many crowds to see them dance. While many people come to see this gimmick, many stay for their passionate and emotional dancing.

entry: POKENAME舞中从壳里按节奏喷烟。烟柱为优雅动作添朦胧气息，造出神秘火景。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME releases smoke from its shell in rhythm as it dances. The plumes of smoke add a hazy aura to its graceful movements, creating a mystical and fiery spectacle.

entry: POKENAME每年会在夜里聚会一次，随彼此的歌声欢舞。据说，聚会地点介于生死之间，谁打断舞蹈，就会被卷往亡者的世界。
author: milchik
source: POKENAME gather together at night once a year to dance joyfully to each other's songs. Their gathering spot is said to be a place between life and death, and that whoever interrupts these Pokémon's dancing gets swept away to the afterlife.

entry: POKENAME舞中每次挥翼，都优雅控火。可若中途头痛，可能失控，甩出扫荡的火浪。
author: sk372
source: As it dances, POKENAME controls flames elegantly with every swing of its wings. Should a headache strike mid-dance, however, it may lose control and wind up launching a sweeping wave of fire.

entry: POKENAME细腻起舞，每一步都点火。随节拍旋转、跳跃，火景令人入迷。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME does a delicate dance, causing flames to ignite with each step. The fiery display can be mesmerizing, as it swirls and leaps in rhythm.

entry: 技艺极高的POKENAME，能造火焰分身伴舞。特别的是，这两个分身的性格与舞步，都和本体不同。
author: sk372
source: Extremely skilled POKENAME can create copies of itself made of flame to serve as backup dancers to its performance. Notably, the two simulacra exhibit differing personalities and dance moves compared to their creator.

entry: 戴着的“一边的耳环”能接收声音震动，帮它随动作同步。火焰充满热情活力，终场前需要助力，便烧得更旺。
author: quackquackattack
source: The Lone Earring attached to its ear picks up sound vibrations that help it move in synchronicity to certain moves. Its fire flickers with passion and vitality and grows in intensity whenever it needs a boost before the finale.

entry: POKENAME随听不见的节奏摇摆，只有沙锤随舞作响。每摇一下，就向四周放超能力波，悄悄鼓励听者共舞。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME move and sway to an unheard rhythm, the rattle of their maraca the only noise they make as they dance. Each shake of their instrument sends out psychic waves to those around them, subtly encouraging listeners to join in the dancing.

entry: POKENAME既被尊为创造者，也被敬畏为毁灭者。起舞时卷起的火焰，却不会伤到同伴。
author: fenragon
source: POKENAME is venerated as both a creator and destroyer. The flames it whips up while dancing do not burn its allies.

entry: POKENAME虽笨拙，却热爱跳舞，花瓣随舞飘小火星。唾液有玫瑰甜香，常用于空气清新剂。
author: mistymagius
source: Despite their clumsiness, POKENAME have a passion for dancing, their petals giving off small ember when they do so. Their saliva gives off the sweet scent of roses and is often used in air fresheners.

entry: POKENAME爱跳舞，却总比音乐慢两三拍。谁笑话错拍，就会生气喷余烬，直到再次被音乐分心。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME loves dancing, but is usually two or three beats behind any audible music. If anyone mocks its off-beat dance moves, it becomes angry and sprays fiery embers until it becomes distracted by the music again.

entry: POKENAME各个头，永远随只有自己听见的拍子点动。有时会为某项活动该用什么节奏，吵起来。
author: metcassette
source: Each head is perpetually bobbing to a tempo only the POKENAME can hear. Sometimes, this results in bickering over what rhythm is best suited for a given activity.

entry: POKENAME各个头跳舞节拍不同，喜欢的曲风却总一致。不同个体之间，音乐偏好才不同。
author: .izik
source: Each of POKENAME's heads sways to a different tempo while dancing. Despite this, they always seem to enjoy the same type of music, which differs from one individual to the next.

entry: POKENAME优雅浮游水中，身后留下朱红色花蜜。火焰大又鲜亮，就表示健康。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME gracefully floats through the water, leaving a trail of Red Nectar behind it. If its flame is large and vibrant, it's a sign of healthiness.

entry: POKENAME行动虽有限，舞却热烈美丽。跳着敲钳，如用响板。
author: santon5512
source: Despite their limited mobility, POKENAME dances are fierce and beautiful. They will click their claws as they dance, using them like castanets.

entry: POKENAME以旋转、翻腾、蹦跳的动作起舞，每转一圈，就多积蓄些电能。一套舞跳完，它便向四周猛烈释放积存的能量。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME dances around with twirling, flipping and hopping motions, each rotation giving it more electrical energy to work with.  Once it finishes a dance sequence, it releases the pent-up energy in a huge burst around it.

entry: POKENAME的六颗蛋，几乎总叠成金字塔。既望得远，也能威吓，有时纯粹为好玩。
author: hophoppip
source: The six eggs of POKENAME are almost always found stacked into a pyramid. They form this structure to see further, intimidate enemies, and sometimes purely for fun.

entry: 切磋时，POKENAME摩擦脚与拳套，积起电，再以电拳出击。快如闪电的步法，连高水平职业拳手也争相学。
author: shyguy11011
source: When sparring, POKENAME rubs its feet and gloves together, building up electricity. It will then strike with electrical punches while also moving with lightning-fast footwork that even high-level professional boxers try to imitate.

entry: POKENAME由数十小绒球构成，彼此摩擦，造静电护身。需要时，能更快振动，多蓄电，放出噼啪闪电。
author: sk372
source: Dozens of little pom-poms make up POKENAME's body, rubbing against each other to generate protective static electricity. It can vibrate itself faster to generate larger amounts and send out crackling bolts of lightning if needed.

entry: 幼年POKENAME爱加入训练家的游戏，妈妈就替孩子加油。母亲起初只做绒球，帮幼崽打气，后来许多却爱上这门艺术。
author: chaotic_aspergers
source: Young POKENAME tend to join Trainers in their games, leading their mothers to cheer them on. While the mothers originally only crafted pom poms to cheer on their young, many gained a joy for the art.

entry: POKENAME心地善良，观战时会同样热情地替双方加油。战斗结束，它就飞过去，撒下带静电的花粉，舒缓双方疲惫的肌肉。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's kind personality leads it to cheer for both sides of a battle equally when it spectates. After watching a battle unfold, it flies over and spreads a static pollen that helps soothe the combatants' tired muscles.

entry: POKENAME旋转长杖，为伙伴加油，放出令人振奋的超能力波。活泼能量提振群体心情，更自信积极。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spins its staff while cheering on its allies, releasing a psychic wave that cheers up anyone around it. The playful psychic energy lifts the mood of the group, making them feel more confident and positive.

entry: POKENAME使剑舞时，将绒球挥成三角图形。有节奏的鸣声，增强攻击力度。
author: .izik
source: When using its Swords Dance, POKENAME waves its pom-poms in triangle patterns. Its rhythmic chirps enhance the intensity of its attacks.

entry: POKENAME有节奏地摇身跳舞，鼓励伙伴。动作迷人，看客常也忍不住跟着跳、跟着加油。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME dances and sways rhythmically to cheer on its allies. Its movements are mesmerizing, and those who view them often end up dancing and cheering along.

entry: POKENAME追赶猎物时，会在空中挥舞绒球，发出可怕的尖叫。它主要生活在阴暗的森林，黄色的发光绒球照破黑暗，让它迅速追上目标。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME waves its pom-poms in the air while chasing down prey, making a terrifying scream. It primarily inhabits dark forests, its glowing yellow poms illuminating the darkness as it moves swiftly in pursuit of its target.

entry: 它用蓬松绒球摩擦身体，产生静电防身，电击触碰者。即使被抓时身体没电，头角也总能放电。
author: sk372
source: For defense, it rubs its body with the fluffy pom-poms to generate static electricity and shock those that touch it. If it should be caught without an electrified body, it can still always deliver a shock from the horn on its head.

entry: POKENAME成群互唱、互相加油，巩固关系。蓬松绒羽易积静电，方便电退天敌，再逃走。
author: chibitales
source: Pods of POKENAME sing and cheer to each other to solidify social bonds. Their fluffy down easily collects static, which in turn allows POKENAME to shock potential predators and escape.
