entry: POKENAME把身体塑成训练家的样子，给队友加油。电力四射的表演，振奋精神，助队友争胜。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME molds its body into a copy of its Trainer to cheer on its teammates. Its electrifying performance revitalizes the spirit of its teammates to help push them to victory.

entry: POKENAME赢后兴奋跳舞，软耳上下弹，给自己打气。喜悦有感染力，庆祝时，也让旁人开心。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME performs an excited dance after winning a battle, cheering itself on with its floppy ears bouncing up and down. Its joyful energy is contagious, spreading happiness to those around it as it celebrates its victory.

entry: POKENAME游泳强又灵巧，玩圆物抛来抛去，用动能发电。积极活泼的性格，很受训练家欢迎。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: POKENAME are strong and nimble swimmers who play with round objects, tossing them about and generating electric charges through kinetic energy. They are very popular with Trainers due to their positive and spirited disposition.

entry: POKENAME几乎总在挥着丝网绒球跳舞。若有人不喜欢这舞，它可能就让对方中毒，或挨一记电。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: POKENAME is almost always dancing with its webbed pom-poms. If someone dislikes its dancing, it may poison or electrify them.

entry: POKENAME若喜欢一位训练家，不管目标多不可能，都会鼓励。为实现目标，还逼其他宝可梦帮忙，不肯就狠电。
author: thesilverowls
source: If an POKENAME takes a liking to a Trainer, they will encourage them to do whatever they set their mind to, regardless of how impossible an act it is. But to make it possible, they force other Pokémon to assist or deliver a nasty shock.

entry: 千万小心，别惹怒POKENAME。带刺的绒球能打出致命重拳，也能远远投出，随后炸开，撒下闪电与尖刺弹丸。
author: sk372
source: One should be very careful not to anger POKENAME. Its spiked pom-poms make for deadly punches, but can also be lobbed from afar, where they will burst apart in a shower of lightning and spiked projectiles.

entry: POKENAME爱偷看橄榄球赛，主要是看啦啦队。动作全会照抄，也能轻易模仿喊声。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME love to secretly watch football games, mostly to see how cheerleaders perform. They copy each movement, able to easily mimic vocal patterns.

entry: POKENAME头上绒球带强电，巢中培育的鲜黄花，还能增强电力；这种巢称作求偶亭。挥球时，常不慎电到训练家。
author: vic1312
source: The pom-pom on their head carries a potent electric charge, which is strengthened by the bright yellow flowers POKENAME cultivate in their nests, called bowers. POKENAME will inadvertently shock their trainers while waving this pom-pom about.

entry: POKENAME受静电吸引，常在晾洗衣物附近筑巢。家养个体在屋里，常因静电，蓬松羽毛黏着一只袜子。
author: sk372
source: Attracted to sources of static electricity, POKENAME often winds up nesting around human laundry. Domesticated POKENAME are often seen around the house with an errant sock stuck to their fluffy plumage due to static cling.

entry: POKENAME挥绒球跳舞，讨伴侣欢心。训练家很容易教它，听令就跳。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME performs a pom-pom-waving dance to impress its partner. A Trainer can easily teach it to do this dance on command.

entry: POKENAME靠绒球发电，给伙伴添力量。彼此组小啦啦队，有时正电拍拍与负电拍拍也加入。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME generates electricity through its pom-poms, which they use to power up their allies. They make up little cheering squads with each other, sometimes including Plusle and Minun as well.

entry: POKENAME坐路边，用歌替旅人加油。振奋旋律给听者快乐与精力，漫长旅程也能提士气。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME sits on the sides of routes, cheering on travelers with its songs. Its invigorating melodies bring a sense of joy and energy to everyone who hears it, boosting morale on long journeys.

entry: POKENAME鲜亮羽色，来自里面储电。疲惫光暗，暴怒却大放光。
author: thordemidgard
source: The bright colors of POKENAME's feathers are caused by the electricity stored within them. Their glow becomes dim when POKENAME is exhausted, and they shine brightly when it is furious.

entry: POKENAME常被形容如孩子般好奇，对世界满是惊奇。它也格外贴心，总把训练家拉来，给大大的温暖拥抱。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME are often described as childlike and curious, always having a large sense of wonder. They're also massive sweethearts, always pulling their trainers in for big warm hugs.

entry: POKENAME闯派对与酒吧，炫舞让人惊叹。随乐挥绒球，散场便溜出去，找下一场混入。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME barge into parties and bars to amaze people with their dancing skills. They wave their pom-poms to the music, and when a party ends, they sneak out to find another party to infiltrate.

entry: POKENAME头发很适合储存树果。冬天，靠此前采来的果实维生。
author: dodoowner_
source: The hair on POKENAME's head is practical for storing berries. During the wintertime, this Pokémon relies on the berries it has harvested to survive.

entry: POKENAME害怕就抓住大尾绒，揉着安慰自己。不仅平静，也加快发电，必要时能射火花自卫。
author: sk372
source: When frightened, POKENAME grabs hold of its own large tail-fluff and rubs it for comfort. This not only serves to calm it, but the rubbing accelerates its own electric output, letting it shoot defensive sparks if necessary.

entry: POKENAME天性极易兴奋，跳舞时会挥动尾巴，积蓄静电。为了支持朋友和队友，它们会将尾巴高举过头，让炫目的火花四处绽放。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Extremely exciteable by nature, POKENAME wave their tails around to build up static while they dance. To show their support for their friends and teammates, they will hold their tails above their heads with a dazzling display of sparks.

entry: POKENAME上陆，总以覆羽薄膜给身体充电，电击想碰的生物。回水前，活泼拍泥，将电荷导入地。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME always uses its feathered membranes to electrify its body on land to shock anyone that tries to touch it. It energetically splashes in the mud to ground its electrical charges before returning to the water.

entry: 它站在深深的池塘里，懒洋洋地挥动绒球，收集水草和小型宝可梦充饥。若有更活跃的捕食者试图伏击，绒球也能释放电击。
author: hophoppip
source: It lazily waves its pom-poms around while standing in deep ponds, gathering water plants and small Pokémon to eat. Its pom-poms can also release an electric shock if a more active predator attempts to ambush it.

entry: 人们常鼓励POKENAME住进健身房与体育场，加油能让人更自信。报酬则是剩下的烤燕麦片、米饼与水果。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME are often encouraged to live in gyms and sports arenas, as their cheering makes people more confident in themselves. As a reward, POKENAME are given leftover granola, rice cakes, and fruit.

entry: 梦妖吃恐惧，POKENAME却靠决心取养分。为了维生，一有机会就给人和宝可梦加油。
author: hophoppip
source: While Misdreavus feeds on fear, POKENAME is instead nourished by determination. To sustain itself, it cheers on humans and Pokémon whenever it can.

entry: POKENAME爱跳舞，可后面的头比主要的头更讲究技巧。只要主要的头跳错步，后面的头就会闹意见。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME loves to dance, but the back head is a lot more particular about its technique than the main one. It will often kick up a fuss when the main head messes up its footwork.

entry: 它太迟缓，不能亲自冲入战场，便呼喊鼓励奋战的伙伴。战后，用采来的水果、花蜜做甜饮，犒劳疲惫同伴。
author: hophoppip
source: It moves too sluggishly to charge into battle itself, so it calls out to its fighting allies to encourage them. After the battle, it produces sweet drinks for its tired allies using fruit and nectar it's gathered.

entry: 野生POKENAME是凶猛猎手，扑倒猎物，用手上的绒球电击。可收服后却是好队友，开心给全队加油。
author: pattybgoode
source: In the wild, POKENAME is a fierce hunter, pouncing on prey and using the pom-poms on its hands to electrocute a pinned victim. Despite its ferocity, a captured POKENAME makes a great teammate, cheering on its team happily.

entry: POKENAME每日苦练，别人一加油，身体还真充上电。舞技似乎通过亲子共练，代代传承。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME practices hard every day and becomes literally charged with electricity when others cheer for it. It appears to pass dances along from parent to child by practicing together.

entry: POKENAME每日苦练，别人一加油，身体还真充上电。舞技似乎通过亲子共练，代代传承。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME practices hard every day and becomes literally charged with electricity when others cheer for it. It appears to pass dances along from parent to child by practicing together.

entry: POKENAME鱼群动作同步，排直线游泳。有些训练家，便给鱼群起名“POKENAME游行”。
author: hophoppip
source: Schools of POKENAME swim in a straight formation with synchronized movements. The appearance of these motions has led some Trainers to nickname these schools "POKENAME parades".

entry: 受威胁时，POKENAME甩尾吓天敌。可动作显得开心多过可怕，常会失败。
author: hophoppip
source: When threatened, POKENAME shakes its tail to scare off predators. This often fails, as the gesture looks more cheerful than frightening.

entry: 这只开朗的厚皮宝可梦，最爱逗大家开心。POKENAME虽然温顺，真遇上敌人，也毫不犹豫地挥起绒球，给对方狠狠一记电击。
author: thropp
source: This cheerful pachyderm loves to make others smile. Although docile, POKENAME is not afraid to use its pom-pom to give its enemies a nasty shock.

entry: POKENAME只要旋转，碰上任何表面都会放闪电。人们造出发电机，同时利用离心力与电流，尽量提高效率。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME creates electric bolts on contact with any surface as long as it is spinning. Electrical generators have been created to harvest both its centrifugal force and electric bolts for maximum power efficiency.

entry: POKENAME兴奋举起高颈膜，给队友加油。却常挡住对战与体育赛事观众的视线，招来抱怨。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are excitable creatures that cheer on their teammates by lifting their hood high. They often get complaints of blocking the view for other people watching Pokémon battles or sporting events.

entry: POKENAME边舞边以绒球蹭脸颊储电。充满仍不肯停，脸旁噼啪迸火花。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME stores electricity in its cheeks by rubbing its pom-poms against them as it dances. It will continue to do this even after it is fully charged, causing sparks to crackle near its face.

entry: POKENAME爱拿柔软的尾巴玩，顽皮地用头顶它，迸出小电火花。春天，常能见到它们成群起舞。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME love to play with their soft tail, playfully headbutting it and producing small sparks. Groups of these Pokémon can be seen dancing together during the springtime.

entry: POKENAME边舞边用绒球，将树上蕉香果敲下。节奏鲜明，采果得心应手，轻松摘收也不乱一拍。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME dances while picking Nanab Berries from trees, using its pom-poms to knock the fruit loose. Its rhythmic movements make it a master of gathering, and it never misses a beat, effortlessly collecting berries in the process.

entry: 它用花蜜与花瓣制颜料，装饰大树果，再抛接杂耍，逗朋友开心。演完，果子就分给伙伴当零嘴。
author: hophoppip
source: It decorates large Berries with pigments made from nectar and flower petals, then juggles the Berries to entertain its friends. Once the performance is done, it shares the Berries with its buddies as a snack.

entry: POKENAME热情舞动，每次演完，都用绒球摩擦随身石头。人们推测，是在练习成熟后照料、刺激真正的蛋。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME enthusiastically dances, rubbing its pom-poms against the stone it carries after every performance. It's presumed that this act is practice for nurturing and stimulating real eggs once it matures.

entry: POKENAME用自己的舞提神，越跳越快、越热情。表演到最高潮，放出巨大闪电，才平静走去休息。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME energizes itself with its own dancing and will dance faster and with greater enthusiasm over time. When its performance finally reaches its crescendo, it will discharge a massive bolt of lightning, then calmly walk away to rest.

entry: POKENAME能侵入网游，在里面跳舞给玩家加油。可舞蹈引发严重故障，有时连游戏都崩溃。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME can infiltrate online video games, dancing within them to cheer on the player. Unfortunately, this dance causes severe bugs in the game, sometimes making it crash entirely.

entry: POKENAME用振奋歌声与炫目舞步鼓励伙伴。额上羽毛像体操彩带，编进舞蹈。
author: porterofgames
source: POKENAME cheers on its allies with uplifting songs and dazzling dance moves. It uses the feathers on its forehead like gymnastic ribbons, incorporating them into its dance choreography.

entry: POKENAME能察觉人类情绪，平时害羞。可训练家难过，或觉得自己做不到，就跳舞加油。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME is able to sense the emotions of humans. It's typically quite shy, but if its Trainer is feeling incapable or sad, it will dance to cheer them on.

entry: POKENAME舞中放出令人振奋的超能力波，羽毛摩擦又能造大量电。因此，不少医疗机构会利用它。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME emit elative psychic waves as they dance and generate considerable electricity when their feathers rub together. Both of these factors have led quite a few medical facilities to utilize these Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME开心跳舞支持朋友，却极输不起。朋友没赢，就跺步乱放闪电，闹脾气。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME loves to happily cheer on its friends' battles with its dances, but is a very sore loser. If a cheered friend doesn't win the fight, POKENAME stomps around and throws lightning in a tantrum.

entry: 宝可梦全能竞技赛的裁判发现，POKENAME会借助欢呼声，通过心灵感应指挥训练家，引发了一场丑闻。如今，它们已被禁止进入竞技巨蛋。
author: quote.lass
source: A scandal occurred when Pokéathlon judges learned POKENAME were directing their Trainers telepathically via cheers. They're now banned from the dome.

entry: 它能用长利爪放电。常在输电塔旁挖洞，享受靠近电力。
author: mrpimbus
source: It can discharge electricity using its long, sharp claws. They often burrow into the ground near transmission towers, enjoying being close to electricity.

entry: POKENAME温顺，很受孩子欢迎。耳尾软毛，储着积起的静电。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME is known for its docile personality, making it popular with children. The soft tufts of fur on its ears and tail store built-up static electricity.

entry: 它连捕猎也不停跳舞。小宝可梦看舞分心，就被快如闪电的伸缩长舌卷住。
author: hophoppip
source: It's constantly dancing, even while hunting prey. The dance serves as a distraction, as while smaller Pokémon are busy watching it dance, it snatches them up with its lightning-fast extendable tongue.

entry: POKENAME现身后，就蹦跳点动，如随乐起舞。动作搅起体内电力，能边舞边射电弧防身。
author: sk372
source: After manifesting, POKENAME bounces and bobs about as if dancing to music. These motions stir up electricity within its body, letting it shoot arcs of lightning in self-defense while continuing to dance.

entry: POKENAME战中有节奏地舞，以快乐能量点亮伙伴波导、提振士气。谁将欢快误作软弱，便被快速精准打击，攻个措手不及。
author: bluenido.
source: POKENAME dances rhythmically in battle, using its cheerful energy to brighten its allies' aura and boost their morale. Foes who mistake its upbeat demeanor for weakness are swiftly caught off guard by rapid, precise strikes.

entry: POKENAME战中有节奏地舞，以快乐能量点亮伙伴波导、提振士气。谁将欢快误作软弱，便被快速精准打击，攻个措手不及。
author: bluenido.
source: POKENAME dances rhythmically in battle, using its cheerful energy to brighten its allies' aura and boost their morale. Foes who mistake its upbeat demeanor for weakness are swiftly caught off guard by rapid, precise strikes.

entry: 被POKENAME假嘴捉住，会随甩颚翻来翻去。动作激起电能，受害者先被电，最后才被吐出。
author: sk372
source: Those caught in POKENAME's false mouth are thrashed about as it swings the jaw around. This stimulates electric energy within it, causing the victim to be electrocuted before eventually being spat out.

entry: POKENAME绒球看着蓬松，其实是海绵状材料，能吸水，为身体补水。
author: jojojax164
source: The pompoms found on an POKENAME look fluffy and are made of a spongy material. This allows it to soak water up, which hydrates the POKENAME.

entry: 它爱跑步锻炼。头绒看似软，实则厚得能在头锤敌人时，吸收冲击。
author: hophoppip
source: It loves to run for exercise. The fluff on its head may look soft, but it's thick enough to absorb the shock when this Pokémon headbutts foes.

entry: POKENAME察觉攻击，就原地挪步，让绒毛产电充身。攻击命中，盾般头骨便放出强大麻痹电击。
author: sk372
source: When POKENAME spots an attack incoming, it shuffles in place to charge its body with electricity from its fluffy bits. Once the attack strikes, its shield-like cranium lets loose a powerful and paralyzing electric burst.

entry: POKENAME半夜出现在人们家中，穿过墙壁追赶，通常让人心生恐惧。其实，它只是想和被追的人玩个痛快。
author: hophoppip
source: It appears in people's houses in the middle of the night, phasing through walls to chase them down. It's usually seen as frightening, but POKENAME actually aims to have a fun time with the humans it chases.

entry: POKENAME开朗热情，绕旁人蹦跳唱歌，造出漂浮绒球跟着伙伴。绒球撒火花，让大家精神饱满，下场战斗更出色。
author: sk372
source: Chipper and exuberant, POKENAME prances around others singing and creating floating pom-poms that follow its allies. These fuzzy orbs shower them with sparks that energize them and enhance their performance in subsequent battles.

entry: POKENAME能从头顶绒球般的嫩芽，传导电击。雷暴中，它吸收落雷，让能量流遍全身，令攻击再添一股威力。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME can channel electrical attacks through the pom-pom-like sprout growing out of its head. During thunderstorms, it absorbs lightning strikes, channeling the energy through its body and adding a surge of power to its attacks.

entry: POKENAME背上黄花的花粉极易致敏，因此春天带它出门很不受欢迎。
author: ferdirenz
source: The pollen from the yellow flowers on POKENAME's back is highly allergenic, making it an unpopular Pokémon to bring out during spring.

entry: 它摩擦蓬松头绒产电，为头绒骄傲，一脏，就立刻用水洗净。
author: hophoppip
source: It generates electrical charges through the friction of its fluffy head tuft. It's quite proud of this tuft, and will quickly rinse it off in water the moment it gets dirty.

entry: POKENAME的动作，既点燃队友的斗志，也震撼对手的心。摇起绒球，电力便一点点积蓄起来。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME electrifies its teammates' spirits and opponents' hearts with its moves. It shakes its pom-pom to build up its electric charge.

entry: POKENAME劈中敌人，便释放静电麻痹。双刃蹭羽也会放同样静电，火花既令粉丝惊叹，又吓退敌人。
author: soup1900
source: When POKENAME slices and hits an enemy, static electricity is released, paralyzing the foe. This same static electricity is released when it rubs its two blades against its feathers, creating sparks that simultaneously awe fans while scaring enemies.

entry: POKENAME战中多守势，承受打击、积能。充满后才拔刃，电光噼啪缠绕，转守为攻。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME retains a defensive stance for most of its fights, absorbing blows and building up energy. Once it's fully charged, it unsheathes its blade, wrapped in crackling electricity, and goes on the offensive.

entry: POKENAME帮沙漠迷路者回家。终于到目的地，就跳特别的舞庆祝。
author: ferdirenz
source: POKENAME helps lost travelers in the desert find their way home. When they finally reach their destination, POKENAME celebrates by performing a special dance.

entry: 锦标赛开场若有POKENAME，就先扇大翼，掀起阵阵彩纸，再为伙伴加油。
author: quackquackattack
source: Whenever present for the start of a tournament, POKENAME launch waves of confetti into the air by flapping their massive wings before cheering on allies.

entry: POKENAME加油时急摇头，绒球散出柠檬与绣球花香，舒缓附近心情。香气浓得几天不散。
author: .izik
source: While cheering on its allies, POKENAME shakes its head rapidly and releases a delightful lemon-hydrangea scent from its poms that soothes anyone nearby. The scent is potent enough to linger for days.

entry: POKENAME察觉焦虑，就跳欢快舞，让对方平静。因此常养在精神病院，缓解患者惊恐发作。
author: santon5512
source: When POKENAME sense that someone is feeling anxious, they will perform a cheerful dance to help calm them down. They are often kept in psychiatric hospitals for this reason, helping to ease panic attacks in patients.

entry: POKENAME云状体节，吸收大气里的电。充满后，云团从身体脱落，变成雷云。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME absorbs ambient electricity in the atmosphere within the cloudy segments of its body. Once full of electric energy, the puffs fall from its body and become thunderclouds.

entry: POKENAME优雅舞动迷人，撒下带电带毒的黄花瓣。敌人看入迷，来不及反应便已眩晕，美丽既炫目，也危险。
author: silentscript89
source: POKENAME mesmerizes onlookers with graceful dances, scattering yellow flower petals that crackle with electricity and poison. Enemies caught in its performance are stunned before they can even react, making its beauty as dangerous as it is dazzling.

entry: 它爱给战中的宝可梦加油。热情协调的舞蹈电力四射，为目标充能。
author: bobosmith01
source: It loves to cheer on a Pokémon who is in the middle of a battle. Its enthusiasm and coordinated dancing are positively electrifying and charge targets with energy.

entry: 它爱给战中的宝可梦加油。热情协调的舞蹈电力四射，为目标充能。
author: bobosmith01
source: It loves to cheer on a Pokémon who is in the middle of a battle. Its enthusiasm and coordinated dancing are positively electrifying and charge targets with energy.

entry: POKENAME绒羽藏着身体产生的毒孢子。双手先在绒里蹭满孢子与静电，再挥拳攻敌。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME's downy feathers hold poisonous spores produced by its body. It rubs its hands in this down to cover them in spores and static electricity before punching opponents.

entry: POKENAME怨气很重，受不了别人舞得比自己好，一旦真有，就会勃然大怒。它会给华丽大赛的其他选手轻微电击，扰乱表演。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is a very resentful Pokémon. It can't stand the thought of anyone dancing better than it, and it flies into a rage when that happens. It disrupts other Pokémon Contest competitors' performances by giving them small electric shocks.

entry: 这个融合体既当粉丝，也当风扇。边舞边支持训练家与全队，边送来凉风。
author: hophoppip
source: This fusion is its Trainer's fan in both senses of the word. It cheers on its Trainer and their team with dances while keeping them cool with a cool breeze.

entry: POKENAME飘在稻田上加油，活力动作似乎促进附近植物生长，仿佛快乐存在本身，就为庄稼带来意外生机。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME does cheering motions while floating over rice fields. Its energetic gestures seem to boost the growth of nearby plants, as though its cheerful presence accelerates their development, bringing unexpected vitality to the crops.

entry: POKENAME躲在神殿与墓穴的宝藏中，防备盗贼。人一到，就摇暗影肢体，造闪电逼闯入者退走。
author: sk372
source: While hiding among the treasures hidden within temples and tombs, POKENAME watches out for thieves. It shakes its shadowy limbs when they arrive, generating lightning bolts meant to force the intruders to retreat.

entry: POKENAME曾是王族专用宫廷舞者。为逗宾客，常在表演关键处，从手指射电。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME were used personally by royalty as court dancers. To entertain guests, POKENAME would shoot electricity from their fingers at key moments in their performances.

entry: POKENAME摇晃身体，让绒球相互摩擦，迸出火花，为伙伴助威。动作会暂留磁性，因此舞蹈时，金属物品会被吸向它。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME jiggles its body to rub its pom-poms together and create showers of sparks as displays of support to its allies. The act leaves a residual magnetic charge for a time, so metal objects are pulled towards it during these dances.

entry: POKENAME贴近啪滋啪滋风格花舞鸟，模仿快乐舞蹈。动作不稳，跟不上节奏，却仍精力无穷地练。
author: mimisha_m.lkpowder
source: POKENAME stays close to other Pom-Pom Style Oricorio, mimicking their cheerful dances. With its flimsy movements, it cannot maintain the same rhythm as the Pokémon it imitates, but it tries with relentless energy.

entry: POKENAME抖羽摩擦，周围亮起火花雨。因为视力差，多些光，才好判断环境。
author: sk372
source: Shaking and rubbing its feathers together lets POKENAME create bright showers of sparks around it. It does this because it has poor eyesight, so the extra illumination helps it gauge its surroundings.

entry: 主要的头热情给伙伴加油，没发觉吼声多可怕。臂上的头只跟着重复，随POKENAME动作，放出有活力的电流。
author: icelevelincarnate
source: The main head enthusiastically cheers on its allies, not realizing how terrifying its roars are. The heads on its arms simply repeat after the main head, giving off energetic bursts of electricity in time with POKENAME's movements.

entry: POKENAME表演如光与节奏的炫目风暴，舞台总容不下。有人相信，它接收深空信号来编舞。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME's performances are a dazzling storm of light and rhythm, the stage always too small for its expansive displays. Some believe it taps into deep space signals to choreograph its routines.

entry: POKENAME追随波导中带善意的对象，做什么都加油。热情无尽，不停支持启发它的伙伴，忠诚陪伴、鼓励。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME follows those with a good aura, cheering them on in everything they do. Its enthusiasm knows no bounds, and it provides constant support to those who inspire it, becoming a loyal companion and motivator.

entry: POKENAME模仿人类，在体育赛事加油。虽不说人话，丰富动作与热情却夺目，走到哪都掀兴奋浪潮。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME imitates humans to cheer them on during sporting events. While it doesn't speak any human language, its expressive movements and enthusiasm stand out, drawing attention and causing a wave of excitement wherever it goes.

entry: 研究发现，野生POKENAME常受伤，主要因羽毛不及其他形态发达，在群中落后。
author: pixlhoopa
source: Research has shown that POKENAME is often found injured in the wild, mainly because its feathers are not as developed as other forms. This causes it to fall behind in groups.

entry: POKENAME神气走上舞池，仿佛已赢。每动撒闪粉，以长久排练的旋转与夸张鞠躬，索要赞叹。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME struts onto the floor like it already won. It tosses glitter into the air with every move and demands admiration with long rehearsed spins and theatrical bows.

entry: POKENAME像迪斯科聚光灯，照亮舞池。踩节奏，神气旋转，摆姿势惊艳观众，也震住挑战者。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME lights up the floor like a disco spotlight. It spins with rhythm and sass, throwing poses that leave crowds stunned and challengers shook.

entry: 野外见到POKENAME，多半正给别的宝可梦加油。它精力旺盛又乐观。
author: thisisnotaplaceholder
source: If you see an POKENAME in the wild, chances are it is cheering for another Pokémon. It is very energetic and upbeat.

entry: POKENAME夜舞时，黄绿羽毛发亮，警告想吃它的天敌，会有什么危险。
author: malxire
source: This POKENAME's yellow and green feathers light up during its nightly dances to warn possible predators of the danger that comes of trying to eat it.

entry: 找到特别好的垃圾食源，POKENAME便欢呼舞动、挥绒球。偶尔不慎发动电力，反把马上要吃的东西电熟。
author: sk372
source: When finding a particularly good source of garbage to eat, POKENAME cheers and dances, shaking its pom-poms about. This occasionally triggers its electric abilities and accidentally fries the meal it was preparing to consume.

entry: POKENAME产粉绒羽收集黄花粉，就变成这形态。开心欢呼起舞，也将绒羽撒开。
author: hophoppip
source: Collecting yellow pollen in its powder down makes POKENAME take this form. It scatters down as it cheers and dances spiritedly.

entry: 这种宝可梦摇身如跳舞，融入多风森林。花朵碰撞，便放种子，闪出电弧。
author: hiimhdere
source: This Pokémon camouflages into windy forests with a swaying motion that looks like a dance. When its flowers collide, they release seeds and spark with arcs of electricity.

entry: POKENAME加油时，散出香罗果香，振奋附近同伴。甜香提神，战斗中添一股活力。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME releases a Maranga Berry scent while cheering on its allies, invigorating all nearby. This sweet fragrance lifts the spirits of its companions, empowering them with a burst of energy during battle.

entry: POKENAME唾液含微量金黄色花蜜，酸涩如柑橘，舌上留下轻微酥麻。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME's saliva contains traces of Yellow Nectar. It has a tart, citrusy taste that leaves a slight tingle on the tongue.

entry: POKENAME乐于为别人的成功喝彩，热情地挥臂、跳舞。可它们每次晃动双臂，都会无意中甩出黏液，常溅得附近生灵满身都是。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME take joy in cheering for the success of others, waving their arms and dancing with great enthusiasm. They have a tendency to splatter those nearby with mucus as they do so, inadvertently flinging their slime every time they shake their arms.

entry: POKENAME只挖鲜黄花吃，吸其能量。见破坏就忍不住欢呼，再从大绒羽发电束，凑热闹一起破坏。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME exclusively claws up vibrant yellow flowers to devour and absorb their energy from. When it sees destruction, it can't help but cheer and join in on the fun by sending out beams of electricity from its large, puffy feathers.

entry: POKENAME臂端是柔软填絮。性情温和、肢体如绒玩具，很适合陪睡，常被送给睡不好的孩子。
author: jaminmcready
source: The ends of POKENAME's arms are puffs of soft stuffing. Children with sleep issues are often given one, as its gentle nature and plush limbs make for a perfect sleeping companion.

entry: POKENAME几乎总欢快有活力，特别兴奋，毛就迸火花。小群生活，借静电黏在一起。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are almost always cheery and energetic, their fur giving off sparks when they get especially excited. They live in small clusters, sticking themselves together with static electricity.

entry: POKENAME热烈支持伙伴。伙伴战得越艰难，它越激动，情绪的热度，也助长火力。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME cheers for its allies with fervor. The rougher the battle its allies face, the more fired up it gets, and this emotional heat fuels its fiery abilities.

entry: POKENAME做特技、挥绒球，让选手振奋。强腿高高跃起，再潇洒落地，显出急切鼓舞大家的热情。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME energize players by performing stunts and shaking their pom-poms. With their powerful legs, they display their eagerness to inspire by jumping high into the air before landing with a flourish.

entry: POKENAME壳里伸出的绒球，战斗时左右摇，散出焦木味。动作不由自主，为姿态添古怪，也让存在感更强。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's pom-pom coming out of its shell wiggles back and forth, releasing the smell of burnt wood while it fights. This behavior occurs unconsciously, adding an odd element to its movements and making its presence even more intense.

entry: POKENAME与同类从树枝跃进湖里，看每次入水的水花多精彩，便大声加油。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME leaps from tree branches into lakes with others of its kind. It cheers loudly based on how impressive each dive looks during the splash.

entry: POKENAME用尾火，在喝彩人群前热情跳火舞。极其友善，遇上谁，都愿开心共舞。
author: ambrosia04
source: Using the flame on its tail, POKENAME performs energetic fire dances in front of cheering crowds. It is incredibly friendly and will happily dance alongside any Pokémon it meets.

entry: POKENAME不停蜕蓬松绒羽，堆在身体周围。能极快上下点动，摩擦造静电，增强电攻击。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME is constantly shedding clumps of fluffy down, which pile around its body. It can bob up and down at incredible speeds, creating a static charge through friction to power up its electrical attacks.

entry: POKENAME爱替训练家与队友加油。可打一场下来，可能忘记支持谁，干脆谁赢就给谁加油。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME love to cheer for their Trainer and teammates. Over the course of a Pokémon battle, they can forget who they are cheering for and simply cheer whoever is winning.

entry: POKENAME欣快到极点，战斗中给所有参战者加油，连挥重拳打敌人也不例外。混乱难料的动作，启发阿罗拉一种不停移动的武术。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is in an ascended state of euphoria and spends battles cheering on all combatants, even as it swings haymakers at opponents. Its erratic and confusing movements has inspired a martial arts form of constant motion in Alola.

entry: POKENAME常小群对战。许多宝可梦懂玩耍，可它严格守规，且爱观战多过参战，是少数理解体育的物种。
author: dylonk25
source: POKENAME are often found battling in small groups. Though many Pokémon species understand the notion of play, stringently followed rules and a tendency to spectate rather than participate make POKENAME one of the few to understand sport.

entry: 它想用绒球拼出“艳压全场”的英文口号，可惜偏偏有阅读障碍。
author: apixelperfectionist
source: Its pompoms are meant to spell "SLAY". Unfortunately, it is dyslexic.

entry: POKENAME绒球其实是独特花种，莫名能储大量电。雷暴一近，花便噼啪迸火花。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's pom-poms are actually a unique species of flower, that is somehow able to hold a large electrical charge. The flowers will start to spark and crackle when a thunderstorm is nearby.

entry: 多只这个融合体相遇，必会将自己叠成金字塔。用意未知。
author: hophoppip
source: If multiple individuals of this fusion meet, they will invariably stack themselves into a pyramid. The purpose of this behavior is unknown.

entry: 尾绒球控制主体，其他绒球举高挥动，便发超能力攻击。POKENAME借此在缓慢舒心的舞中，将念力集中成强招。
author: .izik
source: The pom-pom on its tail controls the main body, and it unleashes psychic attacks by waving its other pom-poms high. This unique ability allows POKENAME to focus its psychic energy into powerful moves with a slow, calming dance.

entry: POKENAME爱在场边支持队友，兴奋就将指挥棒抛空。热情喜悦格外鼓舞，许多训练家把成功归功于喝彩。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME love to cheer on their teammates from the sidelines, tossing their baton into the air to show their excitement. Their enthusiasm and glee make their performances particularly motivating, as many Trainers attribute success to their cheers.

entry: POKENAME的两颗头，有节奏地一齐点动，为伙伴加油鼓劲。一颗头故作潇洒镇定，另一颗却毫不掩饰兴奋。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: The two heads of POKENAME rhythmically nod in unison to support their companions and cheer them on. While one head tries to act cool and calm, the other head makes no effort to hide its excitement.

entry: POKENAME用电增强尾肌，方便陆上移动。只靠尾鳍，也能灵巧翻滚、跳跃，甚至翻跟斗。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME use electricity to enhance the muscles in their tails, allowing them to maneuver while on land. They are dexterous enough to roll, jump, and even flip using only the flippers on their tails.

entry: POKENAME群体合作紧密，通常三只以上同行。夜里叠金字塔，保暖又安全。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME demonstrate strong cooperation within their pods, rarely seen in less than a trio. At night, they gather into pyramid-shaped piles for warmth and safety.

entry: 人们观察到，POKENAME会牵着彼此的鳍，一起有节奏地游动。它们摩擦鳍上的绒毛，帮助彼此蓄电，借此在寒冷的海洋里保暖。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME have been observed swimming together with linked fins, moving in rhythmic patterns. By rubbing the fluff on their fins together, they help each other build an electric charge. This charge helps keep them warm in the cold ocean.

entry: POKENAME装备彩纸炮与绒球，在场边电力四射地表演，替伙伴加油。打完就喷水冲场，迅速洗净彩纸。
author: quackquackattack
source: Equipped with confetti cannons and a set of pom-poms, POKENAME cheer on allies from the sidelines with an electrifying performance. Once a fight ends, POKENAME hose down the field to swiftly clean up their confetti.

entry: 它住在暖海，水流中挥臂，看似热情跳舞，其实在捞浮游生物吃。
author: hophoppip
source: It resides in warm oceans, waving its arms around in the flowing water. This behavior looks like a spirited dance, but it's actually a way to gather plankton to eat.

entry: POKENAME背花散舒缓香气，令人恍惚。成群共舞，几乎完美同步。
author: mistymagius
source: The flower on POKENAME's back emits a relaxing scent that puts people into a trance-like state. Groups of POKENAME can be seen dancing together in almost perfect sync.

entry: 它用身上的毛，拂去自己的忧愁，再把负面能量传给来犯的天敌，让对方不敢轻易下手。
author: alliveir
source: It uses the hairs on its body to brush its worries away. It expels the negative energy by passing it onto hostile predators, making them think twice.

entry: POKENAME用长喙饮下最爱的桃粉色花蜜，也用它防止自己滚得失去控制。它们左右摇摆身体，让心神平静、专注。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME use their long beaks both to drink pink nectar, which is what they favor most, and to stop themselves from rolling out of control. They sway themselves from side to side to help calm and focus their minds.

entry: 它产天然甜酶，极适合做大马拉萨达。烘焙师想采，就陪跳，直到酶聚成汁液，黏在羽上。
author: quackquackattack
source: It produces a naturally sweet enzyme that is perfect for making a Big Malasada. To get some of that enzyme, bakers dance with it until the enzyme forms a sap that sticks to its feathers.

entry: POKENAME虽乱成一团，舞中留下的油却珍贵。涂发易梳，又有光泽，因此大事前，让它绕头一圈成了传统。
author: jaminmcready
source: Despite its tangled look, POKENAME is prized for the oils it leaves behind as it dances. These oils make hair easier to comb and leave it glossy, so it's tradition to let one circle your head before big events.

entry: POKENAME羽状手臂比看着更锋利，轻易切开大理石。舞步优雅又危险，所经之处，留下细小切痕。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's feather-like arms are deceptively sharp, able to slice through marble without much effort. Its dance moves are as dangerous as they are elegant, leaving a trail of tiny cuts wherever it goes.

entry: POKENAME舞中，头钳按拍敲合，发出微弱超能力脉冲。附近小生物被削弱，等它跳完，就好捕捉了。
author: sk372
source: As POKENAME dances, it clicks the pincers on its head together in tune with its rhythm. These clicks emit a faint psychic pulse that weaken small creatures in the vicinity, making them easy pickings once POKENAME finishes the dance.

entry: POKENAME圆鼻抽动，在花间舞，作为求偶仪式。轻柔摇身，用动作吸引伴侣。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's round nose twitches as it dances between flowers. It performs this as a mating ritual, using its movements to attract potential mates with the delicate swaying of its body.

entry: POKENAME舞姿优雅，超能力又能帮做音效，很受剧院欢迎。尾羽微动，便如水流过石头般作响。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME are popular in theaters for their graceful moves and psychic abilities that help in creating sound effects. By subtly moving their tail feathers, they produce a sound of water trickling over stones.

entry: POKENAME缓慢跳跃旋舞，向地面吐丝，绘成美丽图案。动作慢而用心，每一跳，都织出复杂纹路。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spits silk on the ground in beautiful patterns as it does a slow hopping and spinning dance. Its movements are slow and deliberate, creating intricate webbed patterns with each hop.

entry: POKENAME能控制环境的细微变化，影响周围生灵的心情与专注。头流畅地一转，气压便改变；尾巴轻轻一甩，风就换了方向。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME can control minute aspects of its environment that affect the mood and concentration of those around it. With just a flowing twist of its head, the atmospheric pressure alters; with a gentle flick of its tail, the wind shifts direction.

entry: POKENAME能控制环境的细微变化，影响周围生灵的心情与专注。头流畅地一转，气压便改变；尾巴轻轻一甩，风就换了方向。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME can control minute aspects of its environment that affect the mood and concentration of those around it. With just a flowing twist of its head, the atmospheric pressure alters; with a gentle flick of its tail, the wind shifts direction.

entry: POKENAME是较平和的大针蜂融合体，却仍极护巢。太近，便急振翼，放超能力波，扰乱、驱赶闯入者。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is one of the more peaceable Beedrill fusions, but still highly protective of its nest. Should something come too close, the rapid flapping of its wings will send psychic waves that disorient and deter the interlopers.

entry: POKENAME是经基因工程造出的人造宝可梦，超能力潜能惊人，能读取周围动作，一念就复制。性情平和，爱借此与旁人共舞。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are artificial Pokémon that are genetically engineered to have amazing psychic potential, able to read the movements of those around them and copy them with a thought. They are peaceful, and love to use this power to dance with others.

entry: POKENAME在空中波浪般摇摆，流过身体的风，刺激已有的巨大超能力。只要继续空中舞，能力就持续增强。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME sways around in the air in a wavy pattern. The air catching on its body this way stimulates its already vast psychic abilities, enhancing them as long as it keeps up its aerial dances.

entry: 野生POKENAME成群练舒缓舞，准备公开表演。它追求完美，公众面前哪段跳错，就会紧张。
author: doctorjazznumber6215
source: Groups of wild POKENAME practice their soothing dances together so they can perform in public. POKENAME are perfectionists, so they will get nervous if they mess up a part of a dance routine in public.

entry: POKENAME边唱边舞、前后起伏，心满意足，曲调便快乐；心情低落，便悲伤。音乐与舞反映着心绪。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME undulates back and forth while singing and dancing. Its songs are happy in tone when it is content and sad when it is feeling down, reflecting its emotional state through music and dance.

entry: POKENAME开心跳舞，木槿类花朵的甜香随之散开，让周围都快乐。
author: hophoppip
source: As POKENAME performs its delightful dances, the sweet smell of hibiscus flowers spreads, bringing joy to all around it.

entry: POKENAME尾部有超能力，能平息湍河。有人说，见过它站在柔缓流水上跳舞。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME's tail is imbued with psychic energy that can calm turbulent rivers. Some people claim they've seen POKENAME dance while standing on top of gentle, flowing water.

entry: POKENAME见宝可梦溺水，就用裹着舒缓念力的气泡救起，让其平静。常被请到热门河湖泳区，当救生员。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: If POKENAME sees a drowning Pokémon, it rescues them with an air bubble coated with relaxing psychic energy to help them calm down. They're often employed as lifeguards at popular swimming areas in rivers and lakes.

entry: POKENAME爱随听不见的音乐，在风里轻摆。这动作启发了广受欢迎的婴儿床挂饰系列：迷你POKENAME随浪涛声晃动。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME enjoys swaying back and forth in the wind to the tune of some unheard music. This rocking motion has led to a popular line of baby mobiles where miniature POKENAME rock to the sound of crashing waves.

entry: POKENAME舞蹈舒缓、香气安定，有时被当疗愈宝可梦。最爱温暖晴天。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME is sometimes used as a therapy Pokémon for its relaxing dances and calming aroma. It likes sunny, warm weather the best.

entry: POKENAME靠尾撑身，在高树冠寻花蜜。对手被美丽动作分心，就用超能力攻击。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME supports itself with its tail as it searches for nectar high in the treetops. After an opponent is distracted by its beautiful movements, it strikes with psychic energy.

entry: POKENAME在热带海滩旁，晒日光，跳柔缓舞。阳光供能，让它能整夜不停。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME perform soft, mellow dances near tropical beaches as they soak in the sun's rays. Sunlight gives them the energy to dance all night long.

entry: POKENAME常见于温泉休养地，参与者被鼓励深度冥想。摇摆舞让人恍惚，身上凝胶燃后吸入，也能扩展感官。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME are common in spa retreats where participants are encouraged to fall into deep meditation. POKENAME's swaying dance helps people fall into a trance, and the gel that covers it can be burned and inhaled to expand the senses.

entry: POKENAME焦虑，累了就爬进车避险，在仪表盘睡。人一开门，就慌张跳舞分散注意，再逃走。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME are anxious Pokémon. When tired, it climbs into cars for safety and falls asleep on the dashboard. When a person opens the door, POKENAME panics, dancing to distract them before making its getaway.

entry: POKENAME平静起舞，随微风摇胯。太放松，尾巴就大叫，催身体再活跃。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME's dances calmly, swaying its hip to the breeze. If it becomes too relaxed, POKENAME's tail will squawk to encourage the body to become lively again.

entry: 见访客，POKENAME便在枝上跳舞。谁哪怕片刻不看，就怒而爆炸，想用骤发能量，保护自己与领地。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME dances on tree branches when it sees visitors. If anyone stops watching it dance for even a short moment, it will get angry and explode, trying to use its sudden burst of energy to protect itself and its territory.

entry: POKENAME常在烈雀群作调解者，空中起舞，放舒缓超能力，平息争斗，维持和睦。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME often serves as a mediator within Spearow flocks. It releases a calming psychic energy through an aerial dance to quell fights and maintain harmony.

entry: POKENAME给人和宝可梦跳舞，空气带来清冷平静。观众一放松、不再视它为威胁，就卷走能拿的食物逃跑。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME dances for humans and Pokémon alike, filling the air with a chilly calm. As soon as its audience disregards it as a threat, it scoops up any food it can grab and runs off.

entry: POKENAME每支舞，似乎都对应一种天气，仿佛能预报明日。其他超能力，仍不明了。
author: bobosmith01
source: Each dance POKENAME performs seems to correspond with a type of weather; it appears it can forecast the next day's weather. What other psychic abilities POKENAME has are not well understood.

entry: POKENAME每支舞，似乎都对应一种天气，仿佛能预报明日。其他超能力，仍不明了。
author: bobosmith01
source: Each dance POKENAME performs seems to correspond with a type of weather; it appears it can forecast the next day's weather. What other psychic abilities POKENAME has are not well understood.

entry: POKENAME常参与巡回演出，小群共舞，逗孩子开心。演后走进人群，感激地收下花生等零嘴。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are often involved in travelling performances, dancing together in small herds to the delight of onlooking children. After performances, they wander amongst the crowd, gratefully accepting gifts of peanuts and other snacks.

entry: POKENAME能连跳数小时不休息，期间发出一串哔声，像音乐极了。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME can dance for hours without rest. During this time it lets out a series of beeps that sound remarkably like music.

entry: POKENAME尾液含残余超能力，用它作画，看画的人便感到平静安宁。
author: sk372
source: The fluid on POKENAME's tail carries some of its residual psychic energy within. Paintings made with it instill a sense of calmness and serenity in those who view them.

entry: POKENAME性情柔和，随轻曲摇身。尾巴即使缠住其他宝可梦，看着也总像在跳舞。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are mellow dancers that sway their body to a gentle tune. Even when they wrap their tail around another Pokémon, they always seem to be dancing.

entry: POKENAME动作优雅，迷人无比。近来人们流行模仿它跳舞，年轻情侣尤其喜欢。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's graceful movements are incredibly charming. There was a recent dance trend involving people emulating POKENAME, especially for young couples.

entry: POKENAME飞行时，身后能留下绚丽的彩虹光迹。看见美景者会心生宁静，即使它飞走，这份感受仍会停留很久。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can create a vibrant rainbow trail behind it as it flies. Those who view the colorful sight find a feeling of tranquility come over them, which lingers for quite a while after POKENAME has flown away.

entry: 优雅摇摆，似乎让POKENAME专注，也为脸颊充电。遭攻击，仍无比宁静地电击敌人。
author: .jerden
source: Graceful swaying seems to focus POKENAME's mind, as well as charge its cheeks with electricity. If attacked, it will shock its foes with complete serenity.

entry: 体内电荷渐满，POKENAME便优雅舞动，让自己平静。专注又充满能量，既能放强大超能力，也能发闪电。
author: .jerden
source: As electrical charge builds up inside it, POKENAME calms itself by dancing gracefully. With its mind focused but also energized, POKENAME can unleash powerful psychic energy as well as bolts of lightning.

entry: POKENAME在枝上跳舞，看着林中迷路旅人。常跟在旁边，笑他们来回绕圈。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME dances atop tree branches while watching lost travelers in its forest. It often moves alongside them, mocking them as they wander in circles.

entry: POKENAME天性情绪敏感，靠轻摆保持放松，也借此调体温。心一不静，火囊造火就大增。
author: infinex21
source: Emotionally reactive by nature, POKENAME keep themselves relaxed by gently swaying. By keeping themselves relaxed, they also regulate their own body heat; their flame sacs become far more productive when they are not relaxed.

entry: POKENAME的手羽与裙羽随舞轻轻飘动。外表虽柔和，却时刻备战，把武术架势编进舞蹈。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME's hand and skirt feathers sway gently in the wind as it dances. Despite its gentle appearance, this Pokémon is always ready for combat, incorporating martial arts stances in its choreography.

entry: POKENAME的动作难分舞蹈与格斗。表演中曾制服闹事者，完美舞步却毫不中断。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: The movements of POKENAME blur the line between dance and combat. During performances, POKENAME has been known to neutralize troublemakers while maintaining its flawless routine.

entry: POKENAME虽小，单只也能用轻柔摇摆的舞蹈安抚一群人。可它极其害羞，多数宁愿逃走，也不肯出面平息。
author: infinex21
source: Although small, even a single POKENAME exhibits enough psychic influence to calm a moderately sized crowd with its gentle, swaying dancing. They are incredibly shy Pokémon, however, and most would sooner flee than quell others.

entry: 阿罗拉常能看到POKENAME迎接游客。它还能借超能力，让旅人对接下来的行程，更加兴奋。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME are often seen greeting tourists in Alola. It can use psychic powers to make travelers more excited for their trip.

entry: 激烈的舞蹈，能改变天气。它们只用动作交流，可谁都能看懂其中的意思。
author: quote.lass
source: Their intense dances can change the weather. They communicate exclusively through movement, but no one struggles to understand them.

entry: POKENAME摇摆跳舞，激发超能力。长舌催眠般扭动，令看见的生物忍不住加入共舞。
author: sk372
source: The swaying movements of POKENAME's dance stimulate its psychic powers. It extends its tongue and wriggles it in a hypnotic way that compels those who view it to join it in its dancing.

entry: POKENAME跳草裙舞常出错。多数观众出于同情鼓掌，另一些却是被鞠躬时露出的后脑双颚吓得鼓掌。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME often make mistakes during their hula performances. While most people clap out of sympathy for this Pokémon, others are intimidated into clapping by the set of jaws on the back of their head that are revealed when they bow.

entry: POKENAME随附近音乐摆羽，偏爱慢歌。许多个体扎在沙滩，盼游客共舞。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME rhythmically sway their feathers to whatever music is nearby but prefer slow songs. Many remain planted in the sand at beaches, hoping for tourists to join them in a dance.

entry: POKENAME腹下羽毛扫走水下藻与杂物，再将收获吃掉，因此深受水族饲养者喜爱。
author: dukefrogpeasant
source: The feathers under POKENAME sweep away algae and other debris underwater, and POKENAME eats what it gathers. This has made them a rather beloved and wanted species by aquarists.

entry: POKENAME所到之处都有清新海风与鸡蛋花香，因此纪念品店很爱用它招揽顾客。
author: ferdirenz
source: POKENAME spreads the scent of the fresh ocean air and plumeria flowers wherever it goes. Because of that, its very popular in souvenir shops as a way to attract customers.

entry: POKENAME舞蹈激发超能力，让力量更充分显现。完全沉浸舞中，周围便浮起如火焰般的淡淡超能力气场。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's dances stimulate its psychic abilities and let them manifest further. When fully immersed in its own movements, a faint psychic aura with the appearance of burning fire forms around it.

entry: POKENAME在水面以美丽旋转起舞，秋天尤其常见。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME performs beautiful spinning movements while dancing across water surfaces. These displays are more prevalent during the autumn season.

entry: POKENAME平静亲切的模样令人想握剑柄。一握住，它就以超能力强迫对方轻舞，边跳边吸走生命能量。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's calm and inviting behavior causes people to want to grab its hilt. Once they have done so, POKENAME uses its psychic energy to force them to a gentle dance while it drains them of their life energy.

entry: POKENAME跳交谊舞时触角发光，能稍稍离地漂浮，鼓舞附近看见的人。
author: .izik
source: While performing a ballroom-style dance, POKENAME's feelers begin to glow. This allows it to levitate slightly off the ground, inspiring anyone nearby who witnesses it.

entry: POKENAME站在阿罗拉遗迹边，缓缓随风起舞。平和气场，让许多小宝可梦停在身上休息。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME stand along the edges of Alolan ruins, slowly dancing with the wind. They seem to project an aura of calmness, causing many small Pokémon to perch and rest atop POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME的花每晚脱落，每晨重开。阿罗拉用落瓣制作芳香肥皂与香水。
author: ferdirenz
source: POKENAME's flowers fall off every evening, and bloom again every morning. The shed petals are used in Alola to make fragrant soaps and perfumes.

entry: POKENAME曾是王族专用骑士，将超能力注入剑里，挥剑时爆发释放。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME were used personally by royalty as knights. POKENAME could channel psychic energy into their swords, releasing it as a burst when they swung their swords.

entry: POKENAME身体轻，被扔出就像石子在水上轻弹。事后用超能力造巨大的潮水之手，吞没扔它的人，也将自己带回岸。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's light body lets it gently bounce over water like a skipping stone when thrown. Afterwards, it uses its psychic energy to create a giant tidal hand that engulfs the person that chucked it away while bringing it back to shore.

entry: POKENAME让饰物随风飘，给自己产生超能力。若有人忘了重要事情，也能用部分力量帮忙唤回记忆。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME lets its accessories billow in the breeze to generate psychic energy for itself. It can use some of this psychic power to help unlock a person's memories, should they be forgetting something important.

entry: POKENAME优雅摇摆的用意未知。有研究者推测，它聪明得足以掩藏真正来历。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: The purpose behind POKENAME's elegant swaying is unknown. Some researchers theorize that POKENAME is intelligent enough to hide its true origins.

entry: POKENAME跳太久，身体开始无意放出小电磁脉冲，令附近电子设备失灵。
author: .izik
source: When dancing for too long, POKENAME begins releasing small electromagnetic pulses from its body. This is unintentional and will disable any electronics in the immediate area.

entry: POKENAME花苞撒淡粉花粉。它想模仿旁人的舞，小肢体却让它做得吃力。
author: hophoppip
source: The pollen from POKENAME's buds is a soft shade of pink. It tries to emulate others' dances, but struggles due to its tiny limbs.

entry: POKENAME在草甸舞动，花瓣缓缓旋转。看客常被催眠，替它从附近取水。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME slowly spins its petals while dancing in meadows. Onlookers can frequently become hypnotized into fetching it water from nearby sources.

entry: 它们轻摇身体，配合微弱超能力脉冲，周围便有舒缓气场。医院用来帮助压力极大或焦虑的患者。
author: chibitales
source: The gentle swaying of their bodies alongside minor psychic pulses generates a relaxing aura around them. Hospitals employ these Pokémon to help patients experiencing extreme stress or anxiety.

entry: POKENAME舞中扬起大片黄粉，能灼伤皮肤。毒孢子危险，靠近须小心，让表演既迷人又险恶。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME lets loose large puffs of yellow powder while dancing which can cause chemical burns on the skin. Its toxic spores are dangerous and should not be approached without caution, making its performance both mesmerizing and hazardous.

entry: POKENAME稳稳摇摆，将超能力集进摩根石双眼，感知人与宝可梦的情绪。据说与它共舞，能帮人找到快乐与热爱。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Swaying steadily to focus their psychic energy into their morganite eyes, POKENAME have the ability to sense the emotions of people and Pokémon. It is believed that dancing along with an POKENAME can help people discover their joys and passions.

entry: POKENAME节奏流畅，中世纪很受欢迎，是优雅、耐心胜过人类的芭蕾教师。才艺进步快如百日菊生长，微风中格外美丽。
author: quackquackattack
source: Their smooth rhythm made POKENAME a favored ballet teacher in medieval times, their grace and patience surpassing human instructors. Much like a zinnia, they cultivate their talents quickly and are beautiful in a light breeze.

entry: POKENAME摇胯、投来会意眼神，悠闲态度与精准时机兼具。训练家说，它边给你加油，边评判你的穿搭。
author: jaminmcready
source: With a swing of its hip and a knowing glance, POKENAME blends chilled-out attitude with sharp timing. Trainers say it cheers you on while judging your outfit at the same time.

entry: POKENAME每次缓慢而用心地摇摆，都引花瓣绕身画完美圆圈。从日出舞到黄昏，不受打扰，也如微风般安静。
author: jaminmcready
source: With each slow, deliberate sway, POKENAME guides petals to drift in perfect circles around its body. It dances from sunrise to dusk, unmoved by distractions and it is as silent as the breeze.

entry: POKENAME舞中不断掉垃圾，转眼周围就杂物满地。
author: .izik
source: While dancing, trash falls from within POKENAME's body onto the ground. This causes the area around it to become littered with debris within moments.

entry: POKENAME下身堆着绒絮与产粉绒羽，点缀粉花粉。舞姿柔缓，在所有形态里，造成的脏乱最少。
author: hophoppip
source: The pile of fluff and powder down that is POKENAME's lower body is speckled with pink pollen. Its dances are mellow, so it makes the least mess of all POKENAME forms.

entry: 这种宝可梦摇身如跳舞，融入多风森林。这个形态的POKENAME，喜欢向恋人们撒大量玫瑰色花瓣。
author: hiimhdere
source: This Pokémon camouflages into windy forests with a swaying motion that looks like a dance. This version of POKENAME enjoys showering lovers with many rose-colored petals.

entry: POKENAME跳舞时，将一生听过的声响编成音乐。它能完美模仿，再轻松混合。
author: .izik
source: While dancing, POKENAME releases music composed of noises it has heard throughout its life. It can perfectly mimic these sounds and blend them together effortlessly.

entry: POKENAME有时沉浸思绪，不听指令。舞中无意四散黏唾液，因此野生宝可梦常离表演远远的。
author: fiordaliso
source: Sometimes POKENAME ignores its Trainer's commands, lost in its own thoughts. Its dances unintentionally spread sticky saliva all around it, which is why wild Pokémon tend to keep their distance when it is performing.

entry: POKENAME唾液含微量桃粉色花蜜，甜得像树果，舌上留一层柔软糖衣。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME's saliva contains traces of Pink Nectar. It has a sweet, berry-like taste that leaves a soft sugary coating on the tongue.

entry: 不知POKENAME的热带模样，是为吸引更多人类猎物，还是为了更容易随风摇摆。
author: mary_the_jane
source: It is unknown whether POKENAME uses its tropical-like form to attract more human prey or to simply sway in the wind easier.

entry: POKENAME向丛林藤蔓撒孢子，取得控制。跳舞时藤也同节奏摇，陪它跳柔缓华尔兹。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME disperses spores on jungle vines to gain control over them. While it dances, the vines sway in the same rhythm, moving in gentle waltzes alongside it.

entry: POKENAME水晶被风轻拂就受刺激，发光并放微弱超能力脉冲，扰乱附近生物。
author: sk372
source: The crystals on POKENAME's body respond to the feeling of wind brushing across them. The stimulation causes them to glow and emit faint psychic pulses that disorient those near it.

entry: POKENAME舞中营造宁静舒缓的气场，很受按摩院与高级度假村欢迎。
author: mistymagius
source: When POKENAME dances, it creates an aura of serenity and relaxation. POKENAME are a popular Pokémon at massage clinics and luxury resorts.

entry: POKENAME常在夕阳下的崖边，随自己的节奏舞动。人们推测，平和气氛让它能预见未来。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME can be found on cliffs, dancing to their own rhythm as the sun sets.  It is assumed that this peaceful atmosphere allows POKENAME to foresee into the future.

entry: POKENAME跳来自偏远岛屿的传统舞，热情舞姿鼓舞许多人了解背后传承。按习俗，用大蹼掌拍胸。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME perform a traditional dance originating from remote islands where their spirited dance inspires many people to learn about their heritage. They slap their chests with large, webbed palms as is customary with this type of dance.

entry: 动作与风完美相合，只有微风吹过才摇摆。舞中散出神秘不安气场，连平时强硬的对手，也会害怕而顺从。
author: dodoowner_
source: Its movements are in perfect harmony with the wind, swaying only when a breeze passes. As it dances, a mysterious and unsettling aura is released throughout the air, leaving usually tough opponents frightened and docile.

entry: POKENAME壳中放出的超能力，吸入能清肺、让人放松。喷向天敌则能化解攻击性，方便逃走。
author: soup1900
source: The psychic energy POKENAME emits from its shell will clear a person's lungs and make them feel relaxed when inhaled. By spouting this energy against predators, it can turn them nonaggressive, allowing for an easy escape.

entry: 产卵季，POKENAME用迷人泳姿打动天敌，让它们放过蛋。对空中敌人劝说无效，便改用超能力猛轰。
author: soup1900
source: During spawning season, POKENAME use their attractive swimming to melt the hearts of predators and dissuade them from eating their eggs. Since this method of persuasion is ineffective on aerial foes, they instead pelt them with psychic energy.

entry: POKENAME连舞数小时，盼人群丢来亮东西。若什么都没有，就想偷附近财物，淘气天性也成了表演主角。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME dances for hours in hopes of someone throwing it a shiny object from a crowd. If it gets none, it will attempt to steal from anyone nearby, its mischievous nature taking center stage during its dance.

entry: POKENAME看着呆萌无辜，摇摆舞却使看客头痛。这也是不得已，它唯有暂时将偏头痛传给别人，才能缓解自己。
author: sk372
source: Though it has an innocently dopey look to it, POKENAME uses its wavy dance to inflict painful headaches on those that see it. This is a necessary evil, as the only way to diffuse its own migraine pains is to pass them onto others for a time.

entry: POKENAME舞动，使对手放松得近乎催眠。游泳比走路强，便偏爱水中舞。
author: lydiaprower8
source: When POKENAME dances, it relaxes its opponent in an almost hypnotic trance. It prefers to dance in water, as it can swim better than it can walk.

entry: POKENAME坐岸边，慢慢随海浪拍岸的节拍舞动。若被打扰，就停舞，悲伤叹息，再瞬间移动离开。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME sit along shorelines, slowly dancing along to the rhythm of the waves crashing onto the beach. If someone disturbs them, POKENAME stop dancing, sigh sadly, then teleport away.

entry: POKENAME被视为长久爱情的象征。据说，两只POKENAME若舞得天衣无缝，它们的训练家便能相爱一生。
author: rakunk
source: POKENAME is cherished as a symbol of enduring love. It is said that if two POKENAME dance in perfect harmony, it signifies a lifelong romance between their Trainers.

entry: POKENAME常忘记正跳舞，躺下想自己刚在做什么。慢动作与健忘，让它无意中成了表演者，简单动作却也有魅力。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME frequently forgets that it is dancing and lays on the ground trying to remember what it was doing. Its slow movements and forgetfulness make it an unintentional performer, but its charm lies in the simplicity of its motions.

entry: POKENAME摇摆缓慢有节奏，令人入迷。一见海浪，就忍不住想跳舞。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME's rhythmic swaying is slow and hypnotizing. It feels compelled to dance whenever it sees the ocean's waves.

entry: POKENAME每天晨光下摇摆，帮助保健康，也为双炮发射超能力束供能。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME sways rhythmically beneath the morning sun, a daily ritual that helps it stay healthy. It also powers its ability to fire beams of psychic energy from its twin cannons.

entry: 起舞时，它会放出催眠波，减轻疼痛、安抚情绪，因此常与医生结伴。
author: thefinalkalgonus
source: While dancing, it produces hypnotic waves that reduce pain and induce calm, which is why they are a frequent companion of doctors.

entry: 渔船越来越常带POKENAME，横爬的舞似乎能招鱼。大船会载数十只四处舞动，引大鱼群来捕。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME are becoming seen more often on fishing vessels, as their scuttling dance seems to carry an allure that draws fish in. Larger ships will carry dozens of POKENAME scuttling about to bring in huge schools to catch.

entry: POKENAME一入舒缓舞蹈的节奏，谁也拦不住。什么来打扰，就一钳举起，扔到旁边，节拍丝毫不乱。
author: sk372
source: Once POKENAME gets into the rhythm of its relaxing dance, nothing will stop it from completing its swaying movements. If something comes to disturb it, it picks it up with its claw and tosses it aside without missing a beat.

entry: 墓地若有薰衣草香，POKENAME多半就在附近。它用持续到天亮的优雅舞蹈排解孤独。
author: fiordaliso
source: If a lavender scent is noticed in cemeteries, an POKENAME is likely nearby. It copes with loneliness by performing elegant dances that last until dawn.

entry: 它翻滚发电，代谢特殊紫色花蜜，帮助调节电力。极易发怒，怒时怪叫；据说叫声会带来可怕诅咒。
author: infinex21
source: It generates electricity while it rolls around, while its metabolization of special, purple nectar helps to regulate this electricity. It is easy to anger and will emit eerie screeches when angry; these screeches are said to inflict horrible curses.

entry: POKENAME吐的丝，供清爽村匠人制作定做的芭蕾舞鞋。
author: .izik
source: The silk that an POKENAME dispenses is used by crafters in Rifure Village. The string is used to create custom-made ballet slippers.

entry: 夜幕下，POKENAME藤蔓随舞蜿蜒，划出流畅长纹。淡月中按拍摇摆，催眠般令人入迷。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's vines writhe and move in fluid, long patterns while it dances under the cover of night. The dance is hypnotic, adding a mesmerizing effect as the vines sway rhythmically in the dim moonlight.

entry: POKENAME采集紫色花蜜酿蜜时，会撒下剧毒粉尘。吸入后幸存的人，常说自己曾见到灵魂，甚至与之交谈。
author: darkweavile428
source: POKENAME scatters highly toxic dust as it gathers purple nectar to make honey. Survivors of inhaling this dust often claim they saw or spoke with spirits.

entry: POKENAME深夜独自起舞，有人声称，它舞动时，远处能听见隐约的里拉琴声。传说，看得太久便会着迷，次日在墓碑旁醒来，茫然不知身在何处。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME dances alone late at night, and some claim to hear the faint music of a lyre in the distance as it moves. Legend says that watching it for too long causes one to become entranced, and they awaken the next day near a gravestone, disoriented.

entry: POKENAME邀疲惫远足者进山洞，条件是共舞。若对方不怕舞中召来的灵体，就换得安全下山的引导。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME invites tired hikers into its mountain cave on the condition that they share a dance. If the hiker doesn't become frightened by the spirits that POKENAME summons with its dance, they will receive safe passage down the mountain in return.

entry: POKENAME在月下几乎无声地舞，只双钳按拍敲响。专注动作精准，气氛安静却诡异。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME clicks its pincers together in a rhythmic pattern, performing a largely silent dance beneath the moonlight. Its precise movements create a quiet yet eerie atmosphere as it moves with great focus.

entry: 原始时代，人们相信被POKENAME刺中，能暂时与灵界沟通。现代科学认定，只是毒液带来的幻觉。
author: sk372
source: In primitive times, it was believed POKENAME's sting allowed one to communicate with the spirit world for a time. Modern science concludes this was actually hallucinogenic effects brought by POKENAME's poison.

entry: 生前爱背人渡海。有些人说，如今POKENAME载灵魂穿行亡者世界，风里偶尔还能听到它的歌。
author: ehard
source: It loved to ferry people on its back across the sea during its life. Some say POKENAME now carries spirits across the afterlife, its song sometimes being heard in the wind.

entry: 据传POKENAME沿海岸找迷途灵魂，引过平静水面，安抚到它们获得安宁。共舞还能增强幽灵属性招式。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: POKENAME are rumored to wander shorelines to find wayward souls and guide them across tranquil waters, soothing them and allowing them to find peace. It is said they will dance with these spirits to increase the power of their Ghost-type moves.

entry: POKENAME会在林火中协助训练家，穿火动作精准如优雅舞者。据说它吸收周围火热，为迷途灵魂引路。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: POKENAME can be seen assisting Trainers during forest fires. They navigate the flames with sharp precision that is often compared to that of elegant dancers. They are said to guide lost souls by absorbing the heat of flames around them.

entry: POKENAME住在陵墓屋顶，旋转起舞，鸣着忧伤的歌，为安息之地更添诡异。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME makes its home in mausoleum roofs and spins in circles as it dances. While doing so, it chirps a somber song, adding to the eerie atmosphere of the resting place.

entry: 雄性POKENAME的羽毛比雌性更大、更鲜艳。它们一同起舞，要与远古世界再度相连。
author: mistymagius
source: Male POKENAME have larger and more vibrant feathers than the females. They dance together to reunite themselves with the ancient world.

entry: 冰冷的心接纳兰紫色花蜜后，它从喙到羽尖，都满怀对所有人的爱，让悲伤与苦痛也有了尊严。每走一步，都显出对生命的热爱；这份爱生于痛苦，却永不消逝。
author: quackquackattack
source: When the cold heart it has embraces Purple Nectar, its grief and suffering is dignified through the love it has for everyone, from its beak to the tips of its feathers. Its undying love for life born from pain is marked with each step forward.

entry: POKENAME优雅滑过雾天，幽灵双翼拖着闪亮光迹。目睹飞行的旅人，想起那空灵舞姿，心中宁静久久不散。
author: silentscript89
source: POKENAME glides through misty skies with graceful movements. Its spectral wings leave trails of shimmering light behind, and travelers who witness its flight recall an ethereal dance that leaves behind a lingering sense of serenity.

entry: POKENAME傍晚绕巢，做细腻舞蹈动作。嗡鸣有节奏，近乎成歌，传达与环境、蜂巢的联系。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME performs delicate dance-like movements around its hive during the evenings. The buzzing sound produced pulsates in rhythmic patterns, almost like a song, signaling its connection with the surroundings and the hive.

entry: 它挥扇优雅空灵，召唤超自然力量。神秘学者称，扇法是在施展召魂的神秘咒式。
author: imaginita
source: It waves its fans in a graceful, ethereal manner to call upon paranormal powers. Occultists claim that the way it waves its fans invokes mystic formulae for summoning spirits.

entry: POKENAME夜晚跳忧伤的舞，散出奇秘果香。哀愁香气与舞相合，营造平静沉思的氛围。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME dances a somber routine while releasing the scent of Micle Berries during the late evening. The melancholic fragrance mixes with its movements, adding to the serene, reflective atmosphere.

entry: 有人见POKENAME参加守灵，缓慢舞动，再蹭最悲痛的人。被碰过的，都坚称听到逝者最后说了一次话。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME have been observed attending wakes, moving at a slow rhythm before rubbing themselves against the most mournful. Those who were touched swear they heard the voice of the departed speaking to them one last time.

entry: POKENAME以优雅舞蹈激发身体与力量，每个动作都以小火花雨收尾。饲主坚称，曾在其中看见逝去亲人的影像。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses an elegant dance to stimulate its body and powers, and ends each movement with small showers of sparks. POKENAME owners swear they've seen the image of departed loved ones within these displays.

entry: 流星多的夜里，POKENAME在墓地空灵诡异地绕圈舞，清晨便消失。可悼念者经过舞过的地方，总会不安。
author: pattybgoode
source: On nights with many shooting stars, POKENAME appear in graveyards to dance in circles with eerie, ethereal steps. They are gone by morning, but an uneasy feeling settles in whenever mourners pass by the area where POKENAME danced.

entry: POKENAME无忧无虑，随自己节拍跳跃摇摆。舞常不慎从来世召来某个灵魂，通常也帮它战斗。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME dances about without a care, hopping and swaying to its own rhythm. Its dances often inadvertently summon a random spirit from the afterlife to its side, usually aiding it in battle.

entry: POKENAME夜里优雅浮在墓地上，旋转盘舞。动作与微风同步，仿佛本就属于墓地的自然景色。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME performs spinning and swirling movements as it floats gracefully above graveyards at night. Its dance, synchronized with the breeze, seems to blend in with the natural surroundings of the graveyard- almost as if it belongs there.

entry: POKENAME不高兴就诅咒对方。幸好咒太弱，没什么大损害，顶多丢袜子、撞痛脚趾。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME will curse anything that upsets it. Thankfully, POKENAME's curses are too weak to do much damage and only lead to mild inconveniences, such as lost socks or stubbed toes.

entry: POKENAME安静优雅，深夜溜进屋找食物。每次吃前，都缓缓跳一段哀舞。
author: santon5512
source: Quiet and graceful, POKENAME will slip into homes in the dead of night in search of food. Each time before eating, they will perform a slow, somber dance.

entry: POKENAME每周脱一次旧外壳，蜕下的材料滋味极苦。
author: .realthree
source: Every week, POKENAME's old casing falls off. This cast-off material has a very bitter taste.

entry: 傍晚，POKENAME召唤灵体到陆地上，为自己采集食物。它会给每个灵体覆上一层有毒薄膜，使其能吓退想抢走食物的贼。
author: soup1900
source: When the day becomes evening, POKENAME summons spirits to go on land and gather food for it. It covers each spirit in a toxic film-like substance so that the spirits can deter thieves from stealing their collected food.

entry: POKENAME爱日下优雅舞，通常平静避战。可战中能预见敌人动作，以协调空灵的姿态闪避。
author: keiracm35_
source: POKENAME love dancing in sunlight, moving gracefully and elegantly. They're usually calm and avoid conflict, but in battle their psychic powers let them foresee an opponent's moves and dodge with coordinated, ethereal motions.

entry: POKENAME在最黑的夜里，无声飞过墓地。据说会在心怀负面情绪而死者的坟上摇摆起舞。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME flies quietly through graveyards on the darkest of nights. It is said to sway and dance over the graves of those who died with negative emotions in their hearts.

entry: POKENAME在空中优雅摇摆滑行，双臂如风流转。未知图腾与幽灵属性宝可梦尤其着迷，会围聚，偶尔也共舞。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME sway and glide through the air in a graceful dance, their arms flowing like the wind. Unown and Ghost-type Pokémon seem particularly drawn to these dances, gathering around and even joining in at times.

entry: POKENAME按古怪路线奔跑，摆颈跺脚，如指挥异界合唱。尾上的头轻摇，感知周围，免得身体小跑时撞上实物。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME gallops in odd patterns, waving its neck and stomping its feet as if directing an otherworldly chorus. The head on POKENAME's tail sways gently while the body trots along, sensing the surroundings to avoid colliding with anything solid.

entry: POKENAME在墓地旁挖洞，日落后在墓碑边跳舞。动作神秘，用意不明，却像在悼念逝者。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME digs burrows near graveyards and emerges after sundown to dance beside the gravestones. Its movements are mysterious, and though its reasons are unknown, it seems to pay tribute to the departed.

entry: 一只POKENAME死去，许多成年同类会聚来，跳上好几小时的特别舞，才离开遗体。不知它何时教幼崽这舞。
author: bobosmith01
source: When an POKENAME passes away, many other adult POKENAME gather and perform a special dance that lasts for hours before departing from the body. It is not known when POKENAME teaches its young this dance.

entry: 一只POKENAME死去，许多成年同类会聚来，跳上好几小时的特别舞，才离开遗体。不知它何时教幼崽这舞。
author: bobosmith01
source: When an POKENAME passes away, many other adult POKENAME gather and perform a special dance that lasts for hours before departing from the body. It is not known when POKENAME teaches its young this dance.

entry: POKENAME振翼造舒缓小烟云，再用优雅复杂的翼形，引导平静下来的人，共跳恢复活力、净化身心的舞。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME create small clouds of soothing smoke when they flap their wings. They flap and twist their wings in elegant and intricate patterns to direct those calmed by their smoke in a rejuvenating and cleansing dance.

entry: 整群POKENAME夜聚墓地，边哀嚎边跳复杂的舞。共同仪式，向夜里传递令人发寒的美丽讯息。
author: .izik
source: An entire pack of POKENAME gathers in graveyards at night, letting out mournful howls while performing an intricate dance. This ritual, performed together, sends a hauntingly beautiful message into the night.

entry: POKENAME寻找音乐起舞。虽没四肢，却跳得极优雅。
author: ayutac
source: POKENAME will seek out music and dance to it. Despite having no limbs, this Pokémon can dance very gracefully.

entry: POKENAME以尾扇遮嘴，让阴森低语仿佛从四面传来。猎物充分迷乱，就无声靠近，撤扇享用一餐。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Hiding their mouths with the fans on their tails, POKENAME throw their voice to resemble haunting wihspers from all directions. Once their prey is properly disoriented, POKENAME silently approach, withdrawing their fans to enjoy their meals.

entry: 调查员主要用POKENAME协查涉及死者的案件。人们普遍相信，它能与亡魂交流，才总能轻易找到犯人。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME are primarily used by investigators to help with cases involving the dead. There is a common belief that they are able to speak with the souls of the deceased, which is how they are able to find the perpetrators so easily.

entry: POKENAME威仪优雅，蹄按节拍击地。摇鹿角能造幻象分身，合演完美同步的群舞。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME dances with graceful majesty, rhythmically striking the ground with its hooves. By shaking its antlers, it can create illusory copies of itself, performing a perfectly synchronized group choreography.

entry: 观察发现，POKENAME手势暗示擅长战法。扇竖着，多偏防守；手臂横展，则偏进攻。
author: sk372
source: Observation has determined the positions of POKENAME's hands hint at its preferred fighting style. Vertically-kept fans signifies defensive leaning, while horizontal limbs mean an offensive style.

entry: POKENAME舞艺精湛，需要时按节奏振翼，让风中响起安静旋律。
author: ayutac
source: POKENAME is a masterful dancer. If needed, it can flap its wings rhythmically to create a quiet melody on the wind.

entry: POKENAME奔跑时，飘带优雅流动，形成舒缓的气场。不得安息的亡魂，也能因此平静下来。
author: glacierwing
source: POKENAME's ribbons flow gracefully as it runs, forming a soothing aura. Restless spirits of the dead are calmed by it.

entry: POKENAME一跳舞，附近地区就起台风。传说死于这些台风的人，会被诅咒不停跳舞，供它取乐。
author: dodoowner_
source: When POKENAME dances, a typhoon will form in a nearby region. Folklore states that those who die from these typhoons are cursed to dance indefinitely for POKENAME's entertainment.

entry: POKENAME见葬礼，会在旁跳舞，想敬逝者。可无言又笨拙的动作，往往安慰不了，反令人更难受。
author: .izik
source: If POKENAME sees a funeral, it will dance nearby in an attempt to honor the deceased. Unfortunately, its wordless, awkward movements tend to make those around it feel more uncomfortable than comforted.

entry: POKENAME优雅舞动，周围便噼啪生出蓝色球状闪电。诡异电光如舞伴，随动作相伴。
author: .jerden
source: As POKENAME dances elegantly, blue ball lightning will begin to crackle in the air around it. This eerie electricity will follow POKENAME's movements like a dance partner.

entry: POKENAME舞姿优雅又有活力。据说不安灵魂跟着跳，跳累便能安息，因此常获邀到闹鬼宅邸表演。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME dances gracefully but energetically. It is said that restless spirits dance alongside them, but will become able to rest once exhausted by the dance, so it is often invited to perform inside haunted houses.

entry: 野生POKENAME在沙漠跳舞，通常是想联络死于栖地严酷气候的灵魂。
author: jesmarzan
source: When a wild POKENAME is found dancing in a desert, it is usually trying to contact spirits of those who have died in the harsh climates of its home.

entry: POKENAME舞蹈似想与来世灵魂沟通。可动作几乎总出故障，几乎从没找对真正想找的灵体。
author: sk372
source: The dances POKENAME does seem to be an attempt to communicate with spirits in the afterlife. Because it rarely dances without glitching, the dances almost never commune with the spirit it's actually seeking out.

entry: POKENAME的舞能卸下敌人戒心、安抚情绪，哄进似睡的恍惚。对方一松懈，就受诅咒，被吸食负面情绪，直到醒来。
author: sakuraneko
source: POKENAME's disarming dance can calm its opponents' emotions and lull them into a sleep-like daze. Once their guard is down, it curses them and feeds on their negative emotions until they wake.

entry: POKENAME天生擅长优雅起舞，令剧团争相邀请。为不负期待，它彻夜训练，有时却因此在白天睡着。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is highly sought after by theater companies due to its natural elegance in the art of dance. To meet expectations, it trains throughout the night, which sometimes causes it to fall asleep during the day.

entry: POKENAME的舞，是优雅与沉着的典范。看客屡屡坚称，近乎催眠的动作中，听见逝去亲人温柔的话。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's dances are the epitome of grace and composure. Viewers repeatedly say they swear they hear kind words from deceased loved ones while watching POKENAME's almost hypnotic movements.

entry: POKENAME自尊心强，训练又有素。它们组成的表演团，早已成为城都各地节庆、茶馆与精致花园的常客。
author: quote.lass
source: Proud and disciplined, performing troupes of POKENAME have become mainstays in festivals, tea houses, and elaborate gardens across Johto.

entry: 野生POKENAME用扇状手掀起致命风与沙暴，再跳仪式舞，召来遇难者灵魂吃掉。
author: jesmarzan
source: A wild POKENAME uses its fan-like hands to whip up deathly winds and sandstorms. After this, it performs a ritual dance to summon and feast on the souls of those who perished.

entry: POKENAME起舞，会扭曲周围生物的感知。受害者眼前，便满是万花筒般的色彩，常因此陷入疯狂。
author: fenragon
source: When POKENAME dances, it warps the perception of those around it. Its victims see a kaleidoscope of colors, which often causes bouts of madness.

entry: 传说POKENAME由舞者灵魂构成，可此说已被科学家推翻。他们如今认为，动作背后的真相，远比传说复杂。
author: .izik
source: Legends say POKENAME's body is made up of the souls of dancers. However, this theory has been debunked by scientists, who now believe the truth behind its movements is far more complicated than myth suggests.

entry: POKENAME能让波导与灵界相通，汲取阵亡战士灵魂的力量。冷静优雅地穿行闪避，再用波导反击，吸走敌人力气。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has the ability to attune its aura to the spirit world, gathering strength from the souls of fallen warriors. It weaves and dodges attacks with stoic grace, countering with aura strikes that sap the strength of its opponents.

entry: POKENAME在丛林最深处秘密练优雅舞。谁敢打断，就以头顶石质扇状突起，凶狠撞向闯入者。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME secretly practices its elegant dance in the deepest part of the jungle. If anyone dares to interrupt POKENAME's dance, it will ferociously headbutt the intruder with the rocky, fan-shaped protrusion on its cranium.

entry: 阿罗拉流传，POKENAME舞得越夸张，驱逐的灵体就越邪恶。真相却是，它在跳舞吸引尼多王。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: There exists a popular Alolan rumor that the more exaggerated POKENAME's dance is, the more evil the spirit they are banishing. The truth is that POKENAME dance to attract Nidoking.

entry: POKENAME看着再亲切也不可轻信。善意模样与优雅外表诱近受害者，再慢慢吸走灵魂。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are not to be trusted no matter how kind they appear to be. They will lure in their victims with their kind demeanor and elegant appearance before slowly draining away its victim's soul.

entry: POKENAME在墓碑上缓缓跳哀舞，敬逝者。动作似与亡魂交流，令周围平静。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME moves in slow, mournful dances on gravestones, honoring those who have passed. Its movements seem to bring a sense of calm to the surrounding area, as if communicating with the spirits of the deceased.

entry: POKENAME随着舞步，来回摇动头上的嫩芽。寂静的夜里，有人声称能听到微弱的竖琴乐声，来源却始终成谜。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME sways the sprout on its head back and forth in time with its dance. In the quiet of the night, some claim to hear the faint sound of a harp playing music, its source always a mystery.

entry: POKENAME背上的树木属于紫藤属，可科学家始终没找到与任何已知物种完全相合的基因。
author: ferdirenz
source: The trees on POKENAME's back are members of the wisteria genus, but no scientist has found an exact genetic match to any known species.

entry: POKENAME并非完全不动，只是慢得惊人。长期延时摄影显示，平均一个舞蹈动作，就要十年。
author: kiwiarms
source: Though they may seem completely immobile, the truth is that POKENAME just move incredibly slowly. Long-term timelapse photography has revealed that it takes the average POKENAME ten years to perform a single dance move.

entry: POKENAME一生只吸取一个活物的生命力。得到足够能量，就能召更多来世灵魂，改吸魂能，不再取活物。
author: soup1900
source: A POKENAME will only ever drain one living being of its life force. This is because once it has gained enough energy, it can summon more spirits from the afterlife, draining their soul's energies instead of beings that are still currently alive.

entry: POKENAME挥钢铁武器如指挥棒，指挥花舞鸟舞者，常把过去败仗编成胜利的舞剧。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME directs Oricorio dancers with its steel weapon, which it waves like a baton. It tends to choreograph dances that rewrite its past battle losses into victories.

entry: 无月夜，POKENAME在山中家园旋转、绕圈飞，仿佛空中舞。有人认为，正与逝去古龙的灵魂沟通。
author: sk372
source: During moonless nights, POKENAME swoops about its mountain home in twirling, looping patterns akin to an aerial dance. Some believe it is communicating with the spirits of fallen ancient dragons when it does so.

entry: POKENAME在墓穴旁缓慢而有条理地舞，悼念新逝者。缎带夜里泛舒缓蓝光，容易看见。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME performs a slow, methodical dance near crypts to mourn those who have recently passed. It can be spotted at night as its ribbon glows a calming blue.

entry: POKENAME的舞蹈猛烈而富于破坏性。手臂与尾巴挥甩，掀起劲风，让尘土绕着身体旋上天空。
author: glacierwing
source: POKENAME's dancing is violent and destructive. With lashes of its tail and arms, it creates a whipping wind, dust spiraling around it into the air.

entry: 人们相信，POKENAME优雅的舞能揭露隐秘真相。一则传说中，它先向王国揭穿恶王罪行，再用火将其烧死。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: It's believed that POKENAME's elegant dance brings hidden truths into the light. One legend describes a wicked king who was incinerated by POKENAME's fire after it revealed his evil deeds to the kingdom.

entry: POKENAME满月夜格外活跃，星下聚舞。月光一照，奇异蓝光便包住身体。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME are notably more active during nights of the full moon, gathering to dance under the stars. When exposed to moonlight, a strange blue glow envelops them.

entry: 夜里，POKENAME在月光下与亡灵共舞。据说，看过舞蹈的人到了清晨，便只能随风移动或起舞。
author: crazynaturekitty
source: During the night, POKENAME dances with spirits of the dead under the moonlight. It's said that come morning, those who viewed its dance find themselves only able to move or dance with the wind.

entry: 秋天，最后的花渐渐凋零时，能听见这种宝可梦悲伤的叫声。春日花朵重开，POKENAME便成群共舞，庆祝新的循环开始。
author: milchik
source: This Pokémon's sad cries can be heard during the fall season when the last flowers are slowly withering. As the spring comes and flowers begin to bloom again, flocks of POKENAME gather together to dance, celebrating the start of a new cycle.

entry: POKENAME附身乐器，奏出诡异旋律，各形态曲调独特。无论怎么变，总有异界般的气息，令人着迷或不安。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME possesses musical instruments, causing them to play unsettling melodies unique to each form it inhabits. The music varies, but it always evokes a strange, otherworldly vibe that captivates or disturbs anyone who hears it.

entry: POKENAME以宁静舞蹈闻名，却很少满月下跳。若共舞数量够多，美丽流星雨就会笼罩夜空。
author: quantumradiation
source: POKENAME are well-known for their serene dance, but they only rarely perform it under the full moon. If enough of them dance together, a beautiful meteor shower will envelop the night sky.

entry: POKENAME站陵墓顶起舞，火焰般羽毛按节奏脉动。动作与光营造的气氛，仿佛令所有看客都悲伤。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME stands atop mausoleum roofs, its flame-like feathers pulsing in rhythmic patterns as it dances. The movement and light it produces create an atmosphere that seems to evoke sadness in all who witness it.

entry: 金属与玻璃身体大多不动，可闪烁火焰与轻摇帘布，看着像在空中跳舞。POKENAME若被激怒，瞬间就能点燃一切。
author: sontyp
source: Its metal and glass body is largely immobile, but the flickering flames and gently moving curtain fabric invoke the illusion of it dancing in the air. If provoked, an POKENAME can set anything aflame in an instant.

entry: POKENAME曾是王族专用宫廷乐师，也被用于发现、诅咒刺客，趁威胁未成就消灭。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME were used personally by royalty as court musicians. Royals would use POKENAME to detect and curse assassins, eliminating them before they became a problem.

entry: POKENAME热爱音乐，会逼乐手一直播到天明。谁若拒绝，或撑不下去，就会遭它的幽火诅咒。
author: staghorn
source: POKENAME loves music and will force musicians to continue playing until dawn. Musicians that refuse or fail are cursed by its eerie flames.

entry: POKENAME战得凶猛，动作却也空灵优雅。有故事说，人们曾在双翼卷起的火焰里看见亡灵影像。
author: sk372
source: Despite the ferocity with which POKENAME can fight, there is an ethereal grace to its movements as well. There are tales that say some have seen the images of deceased spirits within the flames its wings whip up.

entry: 夜晚的节庆中，常能看见POKENAME在月光下起舞，引导幽幽的火焰环绕身边。据说，亲眼观赏这场神秘舞蹈，能让寿命稍稍延长。
author: actliux
