source: POKENAME can be found at festivals at night, channeling a ghostly fire that surrounds it while it dances in the moonlight. It is said that bearing witness to this mystical dance extends one's lifespan just a little longer.

entry: POKENAME舞姿优雅，性情胆小，常在令它想起父母的长春花丛附近。据说收服它的训练家，会与它结永恒羁绊。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are elegant but timid dancers and are found near periwinkle patches, which remind them of their parents. It is said that a Trainer that catches an POKENAME develops an everlasting bond with them.

entry: POKENAME平时懒洋洋、动作慢，据说一生只舞一次。舞却深刻动人，连亡魂也来见证。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Usually lethargic and sluggish, it is said that POKENAME dances once in its lifetime. When it does this, the dance is so profound that even the spirits of the dead come to witness the spectacle.

entry: POKENAME容易兴奋，还在学习耐心与优雅。虽有不足，却很快学会节奏，也爱把尾巴编进舞。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are excitable creatures that are still developing a sense of patience and grace. Despite these drawbacks, they pick up on rhythm quickly and enjoy incorporating their tail into dances.

entry: POKENAME优雅摇耳扇，召来异界能量。梦幻舞步迷住敌人，再将积能化为致命诅咒释放。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME summons energy from another world by elegantly swaying the fans on its ears. It entrances opponents with its dreamy dance steps, then unleashes its gathered energy in the form of a deadly curse.

entry: POKENAME跳缓慢哀舞，释放超能力波，逼附近生物加入。即使不懂舞步，也会被卷进共同哀悼、追忆。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME releases psychic waves while performing a slow, somber dance. These waves compel others nearby to join in, even if they don't know the choreography, drawing them into the moment of collective grief and remembrance.

entry: POKENAME虽失明，却能平静穿过任何环境。人们认为，它或用灵力感知四周，振翼便扫出平静的能量波。
author: chibitales
source: Despite being blind, POKENAME are able to calmly fly and navigate through any environment. It is believed that they may be able to sense their surroundings using spiritual energy, sweeping waves of calm energy with the flap of a wing.

entry: POKENAME的舞似能召来亡灵，却不与它们并肩战斗，而是扎进獠牙，吸走残余生命力。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's dance seem to summon spirits from the afterlife but instead of fighting alongside them, POKENAME will sink its fangs into them and drain their remaining life force.

entry: POKENAME每夜多次滚过墓地，巡查盗墓者。发现后，先古怪摇舞，再放浓味强毒，制住闯入者。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME rolls through cemeteries multiple times each night, patrolling for graverobbers. Upon spotting one, it performs an odd, swaying dance before releasing a potent, strongly-scented poison that incapacitates the intruder.

entry: 有人说，POKENAME靠轻盈轻盈风格花舞鸟的舞维生，因此以强劲的喙，保护花舞鸟巢。
author: spookypookie.
source: Some say POKENAME require the dancing of Sensu style Oricorio to remain alive. As a result, they protect Oricorio nests from danger using their crushing beak.

entry: 据传POKENAME进化后，成为花舞鸟的强大编舞者，用编好的舞，召唤灭绝宝可梦的灵魂。
author: spookypookie.
source: After evolving from its previous form, it is rumored that POKENAME becomes a powerful choreographer of Oricorio dance routines. It uses these dance routines to summon the spirits of extinct Pokémon.

entry: 它在暴风雪中现身，用亡者的迷人幻影引诱受害者。POKENAME出没的地方，失踪案格外多。
author: rawthorn
source: It appears during blizzards, using alluring visions of the dead to attract their victims. Regions POKENAME inhabit have high cases of missing persons.

entry: 舞艺优雅无匹，它们的舞曾只献给古王族。演完，人们不用玫瑰，而丢成束鸢尾致谢。
author: quackquackattack
source: Their dance was once reserved for ancient royalty, as their elegance through the art of dance was unmatched. Rather than roses, people throw bundles of iris flowers to show appreciation after a performance.

entry: POKENAME毒舌又时髦，带狡黠微笑，流畅完成舞步。像谁都没开口，就已知道八卦，沿路留下冷嘲与闪粉。
author: jaminmcready
source: Snide and stylish, POKENAME glides through routines with a sly smirk. It dances like it knows the gossip before anyone speaks and leaves behind a trail of sarcasm and glitter.

entry: POKENAME顶莫霍克式羽冠，节奏如雷，以摇滚气势震撼舞台。脚打鼓，神气如传奇，谁有胆就来抢风头。
author: jaminmcready
source: With a mohawk of feathers and rhythm like thunder, POKENAME shreds the stage in full rock and roll glory. It drums with its feet, struts like a legend, and dares anyone to try and upstage it.

entry: POKENAME顶莫霍克式羽冠，节奏如雷，以摇滚气势震撼舞台。脚打鼓，神气如传奇，谁有胆就来抢风头。
author: jaminmcready
source: With a mohawk of feathers and rhythm like thunder, POKENAME shreds the stage in full rock and roll glory. It drums with its feet, struts like a legend, and dares anyone to try and upstage it.

entry: 新月下，POKENAME聚集共舞，步步随无声节奏，目光悠远，仿佛看见难以想象之物。古传说认为，是在引迷魂回家。
author: _pixelar_
source: POKENAME gather under a new moon and perform a dance. Step by step the group follows a silent rhythm, their gaze far away as if they see something inconceivable. Ancient folklore describes that this dance is supposed to lead lost souls back home.

entry: 有人见POKENAME在墓地吃粗心人留下的垃圾，再于附近墓碑边跳舞，仿佛为亵渎向亡魂道歉。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has been spotted in graveyards, consuming litter that thoughtless people have left behind. It dances near the gravestones that were close to the trash, as if to apologize to their spirits for the desecration.

entry: POKENAME产粉绒羽的身体，混着紫花粉。舞中踢起粉云，据说能从中看见异界灵魂。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's body of powder down is laced with purple pollen. Its dances kick up a cloud of powder in the air, through which POKENAME is said to see spirits from the beyond.

entry: 坐在POKENAME的枝条下，训练家便能与亡者交流。紫色花朵常被当作魔法物品贩卖，据说能让人再见已故亲友。
author: mistymagius
source: Sitting underneath POKENAME's branches allows Trainers to communicate with the dead. Its purple flowers are often sold as magical items to allow people to see their lost loved ones.

entry: POKENAME结合天生舞艺与超声波，先扰乱目标，再攻击。
author: mary_the_jane
source: Using both its innate talent to dance and ultrasonic waves, POKENAME is known to rely on confusing its target before attacking.

entry: POKENAME唾液含微量兰紫色花蜜，酸香像李子，舌上会干涩发紧。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME's saliva contains traces of Purple Nectar. It has a tangy, plum-like taste that leaves a dry, puckering sensation on the tongue.

entry: POKENAME只有夜里才醒，在月下悲舞。舞中会有诡异现象，某些无生命物，开始活过来。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME only come awake at night, somberly dancing underneath the moonlight. As it dances, an eerie phenomenon occurs as certain inanimate objects start coming to life.

entry: POKENAME在沙身里筑复杂内部结构，连战斗也不破坏。它收集废扇，装饰身体。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME constructs an elaborate interior in its sandy body, and this interior stays intact even as it battles. It collects discarded fans to decorate its body.

entry: 有时能在穿过森林与田野的小径，见POKENAME跳舞。有人认为，此时见到它，今年余下日子都有好运。
author: beetlething
source: POKENAME are sometimes seen dancing on paths that cross between forests and fields. Some believe that seeing an POKENAME during this dance brings good fortune for the rest of the year.

entry: POKENAME毛有薰衣草与迷迭香的甜香，能做香水与古龙水，巫女也用于灵性仪式。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's fur carries the sweet scent of lavender and rosemary. While its fur can be used in the production of perfumes and cologne, shrine maidens also use it in spiritual rituals.

entry: POKENAME舞步缓慢，却很有章法。细微的动作引动幽灵能量球，绕着身体盘旋；投向敌人时，这些灵球便会燃起火焰。
author: chibitales
source: The dance of an POKENAME is slow, yet methodical. Its subtle movements coerce orbs of ghostly energy to swirl around it as it dances. The spirit orbs then ignite with fire as they are hurled to attack its foes.

entry: 许多POKENAME表演出色，常给和服女孩伴舞。有些更亲自接受和服女孩训练，掌握成功表演所需的技艺。
author: beetlething
source: Many POKENAME are incredible performers, often acting as backup dancers during a Kimono Girl's performance. Some POKENAME train as Kimono Girls themselves, able to learn the skills that any Kimono Girl needs to be successful.

entry: POKENAME表演保持从容沉着，免压力损舞之美。据说会将灵魂困在周身气泡里。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME remain poised and composed while performing so that their stress does not distract from the beauty of their dance. It is said that POKENAME trap spirits in the bubbles that form around them.

entry: 不知为何，POKENAME聚在新近发生悲剧的地方，唱忧伤挽歌。绒衣可吃，也舒缓情绪，能帮助人缓和失去亲人的悲痛。
author: pjporwoll
source: For unknown reasons, POKENAME congregate where recent tragedies have occurred and sing a mournful dirge. Their fluffy coat is edible and emotionally soothing, so the fluff can be eaten to help ease the grieving process after a loved one is lost.

entry: POKENAME夜里在池面跳哀舞。水面宁静，动作节奏沉重，让池上诡异又平和。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME performs a mournful dance on the surface of its pond during the night. The stillness of the water and the somber rhythm of its movements create an eerie, peaceful mood over the water.

entry: POKENAME有独特而复杂的求偶舞。每年换羽时，它们都无法飞行；有趣的是，偏偏就在这个时期，它们会以舞蹈追求同类。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME have distinct and complex mating dances. They shed their feathers every year: during this time, they cannot fly. Interestingly, it is during this period of molting that POKENAME try to woo other of their kind with their dancing.

entry: POKENAME尾火带幽焰，许多饲主称，曾在火中见逝去亲人，鼓励自己更强。虽含喷火龙DNA，性情却很宁静。
author: chibitales
source: The flame of POKENAME's tail flickers with ghostly fire. Many Trainers who own them claim to have seen images of passed loved ones within the fire, urging them to grow stronger. Despite the Charizard DNA within them, POKENAME are quite serene.

entry: POKENAME是宝可梦盛装舞步的明星。细腻旋转与慢跑，让鬃中紫藤如火起舞。扬身时，怪叫如女子歌唱。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME are stars in the sport of Pokémon dressage. Their delicate twirls and cantering make the wisteria of their mane dance as if it were fire. When they rear, they let out a haunting cry that sounds similar to a woman singing.

entry: POKENAME常困倦望着墓地水塘。迷信说舞会预告看客如何死，实际却只展示某件不会致死的事。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is often found sleepily staring into ponds in graveyards. Superstition says that POKENAME's dancing forewarns the viewer on how they will die, but it actually shows the viewer the a specific instance that will not lead to their death.

entry: POKENAME花数周造完美舞杖，有时还与同类争材料。人们相信，舞能驱负能量，让空气宁静。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME spends weeks crafting the perfect wand for its dances, sometimes fighting with other POKENAME for materials. Its dancing is believed to ward off negative energy, instead filling the air with a sense of serenity.

entry: 夏日烈阳下，POKENAME扇尾扇降温。很少发火，周围再发生什么，似乎也不烦恼。
author: quackquackattack
source: In the hot summer sun, POKENAME flap the fan on their tails to cool down. They rarely lose their temper and never seem to be bothered by events around them.

entry: POKENAME在墓地漂浮，诡歌让它长期被视为凶兆。可旋律与点动的舞，能安抚不安灵魂，如今在紫苑镇是珍贵伙伴。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME are seen floating around graveyards and were long considered an ill omen due to their eerie song. Their haunting melody and bobbing dance calms restless spirits, so they have become valuable companions in Lavender Town.

entry: POKENAME在墓地漂浮，诡歌让它长期被视为凶兆。可旋律与点动的舞，能安抚不安灵魂，如今在紫苑镇是珍贵伙伴。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME are seen floating around graveyards and were long considered an ill omen due to their eerie song. Their haunting melody and bobbing dance calms restless spirits, so they have become valuable companions in Lavender Town.

entry: POKENAME有两组扇子，表演时挥动。多为主舞伴舞，扇子齐齐扇动。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have two sets of fans that they wave around during performances. They most commonly perform as backup dancers to a main dancer, fluttering their fans in unison.

entry: 这种毒种子宝可梦，靠垃圾腐烂后形成的土壤进食、生长。为了四处寻找更多食物，它长出了能用四足行走的身体。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: This poisonous bulb Pokémon feeds and grows on soil created by decomposed trash. It has grown a quadrupedal body to move around and obtain more food.

entry: POKENAME主要聚在垃圾场偏僻角落，能塞多少垃圾就吃多少。触角恶臭，是吃下垃圾压缩、凝聚成的气体。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: POKENAME primarily clusters in remote patches of landfills, often consuming as much garbage as it can hold. The foul stench released by its antenna is compressed and condensed gas from consumed trash.

entry: POKENAME滚到哪，垃圾留到哪，一进楼，便是清洁员噩梦。人们得叫专门环卫人员，确保它不爆炸。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME leaves trash wherever it rolls, making it a nightmare for janitors whenever they enter a building. Special sanitation workers are called to ensure that it does not explode.

entry: POKENAME腐臭带硫味，其他宝可梦都避开。住在垃圾场，吃厨余与塑料。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a rancid and sulfurous stench that causes other Pokémon to avoid them. They live in landfills where they consume food scraps and plastic.

entry: POKENAME手中武器，是紧压成团的塑料。袋身开口渗出的毒液，看着像落泪。
author: dodoowner_
source: The weapon POKENAME holds is a densely compacted mass of plastic. Poisonous liquid seeps out of the openings in its bag, resembling falling tears.

entry: POKENAME用垃圾覆脏身，尤其常穿破垃圾袋。还拔路牌当武器，是恶名昭彰的麻烦制造者。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME clad their filthy bodies with pieces of trash. Specifically, they will typically wear tattered trash bags. They are infamous nuisances, as they will uproot signs to wield as weapons.

entry: 它向周围排臭烟，偶尔在身下留下垃圾堆。这些垃圾，常被破破袋与其他毒属性宝可梦吃掉。
author: sk372
source: It expels stinky smoke around it as well as occasional piles of refuse beneath it. These spots of garbage are often eaten by Trubbish and other Poison-type Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME藏在城市，假扮垃圾桶。丢什么垃圾都吃，用来给进化供能。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are found hiding in cities, disguising themselves as trash bins. They will consume any trash that is thrown into them, using it to fuel their evolution.

entry: POKENAME住在远海，聚于满是一次性塑料与废物的洋流涡旋。藏在残骸间，保护自己。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME live in the open ocean and can be found within ocean gyres filled with disposable plastics and waste. They camouflage themselves amongst the detritus, keeping themselves safe from harm.

entry: POKENAME藏在深海垃圾带，融入一次性塑料与废物。谁想清理、恢复环境，它就攻击，不愿家园被变回干净模样。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME hide in garbage patches in the deep ocean, camouflaging themselves in the single-use plastics and waste. They attack anyone that tries to clean up their hiding places, reluctant to see their home restored and made environmentally sound.

entry: POKENAME用纸翼飞遍世界。翼若破或湿，就无法飞，直到另找到纸片。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME flutter through the world with their paper wings. If the wings become damaged or wet, they are rendered unable to fly until they find another piece of paper.

entry: POKENAME一找到合适地方，就收起四肢装垃圾桶，吵吵地吃人们丢进嘴里的废物。
author: .jerden
source: Once it finds a good location for itself, POKENAME will retract its arms and legs and pretend to be a trash can. It will noisily feed on waste that people drop into its mouth.

entry: 卡洛斯等地很重视受训POKENAME，能安全处理各种生物质。因此，使用这类可再生能源的发电厂，尤其用得上。
author: bobosmith01
source: Trained POKENAME are highly valued in regions such as Kalos for their ability to safely handle all kinds of biomass and therefore are especially useful in power plants that produce that kind of renewable-based energy.

entry: POKENAME常在最讨厌融合体排行榜上位居第二。许多相处过的训练家都说：“已经够臭了，居然还能更笨。”
author: gooeygamer69
source: POKENAME regularly ranks as the second-most disliked Pokémon fusion. Many Trainers that have spent tie with this Pokémon describe it as "somehow even more dim than it is stinky".

entry: POKENAME薄塑料翼由旧包装纸制成。翼损，就急找新包装，收够后分泌特殊黏合剂，溶开染料，将包装黏好。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have thin plastic wings that are made out of old wrappers. If their wings become damaged, they scramble to find wrappers. Once they have enough wrappers, they secrete a special binding agent that dissolves dyes and binds wrappers together.

entry: POKENAME在垃圾堆翻动，吃软碎屑与弃食。饮食与住处让角沾满腐物，被刺者会严重感染。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME rustles around piles of garbage, eating soft detritus and discarded foods. Its diet and habitat leave its horn coated with putrid residue that causes nasty infections in those pricked.

entry: POKENAME恶臭永不变，变身也带着。因那难闻气味，多数宝可梦都绕道。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME always has an immutable stench that carries over whenever it transforms. Most other Pokémon steer clear and avoid it because of that repulsive smell.

entry: POKENAME常翻垃圾桶，找食物与有趣小饰物。若被抓到，就试着送出部分发现，表示求和。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME often digs through garbage cans looking for both food and interesting trinkets. If caught rummaging, it attempts to give away some of its findings as a peace offering.

entry: 据说，POKENAME是在大洋中央，发现大片漂浮垃圾后进化的。它开始将垃圾融入身体，自己乐在其中，训练家却嫌恶不已。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: POKENAME is said to have evolved after they discovered a large patch of garbage floating in the middle of the ocean. It has begun taking in the trash as part of its body, much to the delight of itself and the disgust of its Trainer.

entry: POKENAME探索数字垃圾，吃垃圾邮件与废数据，莫名将无用信息转为体力。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME explores digital trash, feeding on spam emails and discarded data. It somehow turns this useless information into physical strength.

entry: POKENAME一孵化，就找最近的垃圾桶吃。或远行数百公里，却总带着最初的桶，人们凭桶很容易找到孵化处。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: As soon as they hatch, POKENAME seek out the nearest bin and consume its contents. They may travel hundreds of kilometres from where they hatch, but their origin is easily locatable due to the original waste bin they always carry with them.

entry: POKENAME不聪明，只吃剩渣与尸体，因此很容易出健康问题，还可能传病给近处生物。
author: kittyluv090
source: POKENAME is not very intelligent, only feeding on leftover scraps and carcasses. As a result, it is very prone to medical issues and may even bring illness to those in close proximity to it.

entry: POKENAME难寻踪迹，偶尔被见在垃圾场游荡。用超能力翻废物，挑中喜欢的垃圾，再带着瞬间移动离去。
author: sk372
source: An elusive Pokémon, POKENAME has been spotted on rare occasions milling about garbage dumps. It uses psychic powers to dig through the detritus and find junk it finds appealing, before teleporting away with its chosen trash in tow.

entry: 它翻垃圾桶找零嘴，是城市的小麻烦。把它最爱的旧汽水罐留桶外，就能免它翻得更乱。
author: sk372
source: It upturns garbage cans to look for things to snack on, making it a minor nuisance to urban areas. One can avoid a bigger mess by leaving old soda cans, its favorite treat, outside of the garbage can.

entry: POKENAME飞过污染城市上空，从蝙蝠翼撒下宝石般的毒泥。黑夜里用高频超声波锁定垃圾堆，轻易找到腐烂弃物吃。
author: msdawgs
source: POKENAME flutters through polluted city skies, scattering toxic, gem-like sludge from its bat-like wings. It targets trash heaps in the dark, emitting high-frequency ultrasonic waves to easily locate and consume rotten, discarded waste.

entry: POKENAME由电子残骸与日常废物构成。必须常吃橡胶绝缘，否则可能电到自己。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME is composed of electronic debris and everyday waste. It must consume rubber regularly to insulate itself, or it risks shocking its own body.

entry: POKENAME担心臭味吓走其他宝可梦，常觉得孤单疏离。训练家若受得了，就会发现它爱玩又爱恶作剧。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME often feel alienated because they are worried that their smell would scare away other Pokémon. Trainers that can put up with their stench will find that they are playful creatures that enjoy pranks.

entry: POKENAME内脏的细胞构成，与垃圾桶的普通废物相似，充满极臭气体，让它能浮起。吐气既防身，也能落地。
author: bobosmith01
source: Its innards, which have similar cellular composition to the average waste inside of a trash can, are filled with incredibly malodorous gas which allows POKENAME to float. It exhales this gas both in defense and to land on the ground.

entry: POKENAME内脏的细胞构成，与垃圾桶的普通废物相似，充满极臭气体，让它能浮起。吐气既防身，也能落地。
author: bobosmith01
source: Its innards, which have similar cellular composition to the average waste inside of a trash can, are filled with incredibly malodorous gas which allows POKENAME to float. It exhales this gas both in defense and to land on the ground.

entry: POKENAME能发现承载深厚情感的弃物，如毛绒玩具、情书。吸收残留快乐，再传给旁人。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME detects items thrown away with deep emotional value, like stuffed toys or love letters. It absorbs the lingering happiness and radiates it to others.

entry: 垃圾黏在身上，结成护壳。壳太重，垃圾就会掉落，在POKENAME身后留下踪迹。
author: justacatastrophe
source: Garbage clings to its body, forming a shell-like protective layer. When the shell becomes too heavy, pieces of trash will fall off and leave a trail behind POKENAME.

entry: 垃圾黏在身上，结成护壳。壳太重，垃圾就会掉落，在POKENAME身后留下踪迹。
author: justacatastrophe
source: Garbage clings to its body, forming a shell-like protective layer. When the shell becomes too heavy, pieces of trash will fall off and leave a trail behind POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME吃垃圾，羊毛般的废物外衣越长越多，电力也更强。得常梳洗，免它成了边臭边迸火花的巨大行走垃圾堆。
author: sk372
source: As POKENAME feasts on garbage, its wool-like coat of trash grows, strengthening its electric capabilities. It should be regularly groomed and cleaned lest it become a massive walking pile of smelly, sparking refuse.

entry: POKENAME爱吃柔软填絮，也爱在里面筑巢，常见于家具店后方垃圾桶。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME enjoy eating and nesting in soft stuffing, so it is often found in the trash cans behind furniture stores.

entry: POKENAME尾巴不停漏出糊状垃圾。其余身体虽收得住，尾巴却极不卫生，得彻底罩好。
author: musicsheep.
source: POKENAME leaks mushy garbage from its tail constantly. While the rest of its body is contained, its tail is a major hygiene violation and should be covered up completely.

entry: POKENAME满身霉垃圾，搜寻食物与聚苯乙烯泡沫，让身体长大。嘴边碎玻璃如獠牙，撕开大废物。
author: .izik
source: Covered in moldy refuse, POKENAME scavenges food and styrofoam to grow larger. The jagged glass on its mouth acts like a fang to tear apart bigger waste.

entry: POKENAME裹在硬塑料里，受着保护，哪里都能开花。破破袋、臭臭泥等常恶臭，可走进它的花园，往往会闻到淡淡向日葵香。
author: lovelover75
source: Safely cocooned within hard plastics, POKENAME can bloom in any location. Despite the noxious smells known with Trubbish and other Pokémon of such types like Muk, running into a garden of POKENAME is often followed with the soft scent of sunflowers.

entry: 乌波原本栖居的清洁水道，近年污染加重，更多破破袋侵入，因此POKENAME数量激增。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: The population of POKENAME has exploded in recent years, as the previously clean waterways that Wooper inhabits have been facing increased pollution, leading to more Trubbish encroaching on their habitat.

entry: POKENAME用垃圾装饰自己，宣示优势。极少数时候，身上竟戴着真正失落的贵重品。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME adorns itself with garbage as a show of dominance. On rare occasions, POKENAME has been found wearing actual valuables that had gotten lost.

entry: POKENAME会产毒气，许多人劝阻孩子陪它玩。藤上的胶，还能蚀穿羊毛与棉，一个拥抱，就让训练家衣服破洞。
author: quackquackattack
source: Many people discourage children from playing with POKENAME because of the poisonous gases they produce. Their vines are also covered with a gel that eats through wool and cotton, as a single embrace can put holes in a Trainer's clothes.

entry: POKENAME在城市街道搜寻废物与塑料吃。垃圾越多，身体越长；玻璃碎片作牙，咬开太硬、难以整吞的东西。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME prowl city streets in search of discarded litter and plastic waste to consume. Their bodies gradually build up the more garbage they eat; they use shards of glass like teeth to allow them to bite through anything too tough to swallow whole.

entry: 人们嫌POKENAME脏，又怕它传播疾病，常将它排斥在外。其实，它以垃圾为食，帮助巷道保持洁净，对大都市很有益处。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is often shunned because people consider it filthy and fear it might spread disease. In reality, its presence is very beneficial to metropolitan areas, since it feeds on trash and therefore helps keep the alleys clean.

entry: POKENAME由工厂附近漂浮的水上垃圾带形成，身体是废物与污泥。刺是脆塑料，自然侵蚀，将其磨尖。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME is formed from an aquatic garbage patch that floats near factories, made of waste and sludge. Its spines are made of brittle plastic, which are sharpened because of the natural erosion of the material.

entry: POKENAME夜里游荡城市，收集沿途垃圾。若见有人乱扔，就会动怒，上前攻击。
author: incognito1234
source: POKENAME can typically be found wandering cities at night, collecting trash they find. If one sees a person littering, they become hostile and attack.

entry: POKENAME爬过街道搜垃圾吃，将废物融入身体，吃不下的塞进薄塑料壳，留待以后。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME crawl through city streets, hunting for garbage and litter to consume. They incorporate the discarded waste into their bodies, packing anything they can't eat into their thin plastic shell as food for later.

entry: POKENAME爬过街道搜垃圾吃，将废物融入身体，吃不下的塞进薄塑料壳，留待以后。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME crawl through city streets, hunting for garbage and litter to consume. They incorporate the discarded waste into their bodies, packing anything they can't eat into their thin plastic shell as food for later.

entry: POKENAME栖在城市垃圾场内外，吃废物添身体。薄塑料翼轻得能飞，却慢慢降解，沿航路撒下微塑料。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME roost in and around city dumps, consuming waste to add to their bodies. Their wings are composed of thin sheets of plastic that are light enough to help them fly but gradually degrade, littering microplastics along their flight paths.

entry: POKENAME在垃圾场大吃，再睡进废物。谁误认垃圾想清走，受惊的它就尖叫挪走，吓人一大跳。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME gorges itself on trash found in landfills before falling asleep among the refuse. Those that mistake it for more garbage and try to clean it will be given quite the shock as the startled POKENAME squeals and shuffles off.

entry: POKENAME把垃圾、杂物装满袋子，送给路人作礼物。好意被拒，它就恼火，常试着用袋子殴打拒收者。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME fills bags full of garbage and junk to hand out as gifts to passersby. It gets frustrated when its kindness is refused, oftentimes leading to it attempting to beat the refusing party with said bags.

entry: POKENAME每叫一声，活动的身体就掉些垃圾。循踪常能找到家，是闷烧的垃圾堆。
author: .izik
source: Every time POKENAME lets out a bark, bits of trash fall from its shifting body. Its trail often leads back to the smoldering heaps of garbage it calls home.

entry: POKENAME易受惊，收集物资想让人远离。它拔停车标志，扰乱交通，在大都市是祸患。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are easily frightened, so they gather supplies in hopes of keeping humans away. They are considered a nuisance in metropolitan areas due to how they uproot stop signs, leading to confusion in traffic.

entry: 海底垃圾污染严重处，就能发现POKENAME。谁想清理垃圾领地，就会被喷出恶臭的液化垃圾流。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can be found wherever there's a high amount of dumped garbage polluting the seafloor. It spits a noxious stream of liquefied garbage at those who would try to clean up its trash domain.

entry: POKENAME吃长期闲置数据，人们便养在电脑回收站，帮助管理文件。可到了电脑其他地方，就可能大闹系统。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME feeds on data that has sat unused for long periods of time, so people will place it in the Recycle Bins of their computers to help manage their data. A POKENAME in any other part of a computer can wreak havoc on the system.

entry: 许多初学涂鸦者受POKENAME作品启发。主题包括不受欢迎宝可梦的价值，以及对所有宝可梦一视同仁的爱。
author: quackquackattack
source: Many budding graffiti artists feel inspired by POKENAME because of the art that they produce. Themes of art produced by POKENAME include the value of unpopular Pokémon and universal love for all Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME在垃圾场翻找废电子品，从旧电池与坏设备吸收残电。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME rummages through landfills in search of discarded electronics. It absorbs residual electricity from old batteries and broken devices.

entry: POKENAME在垃圾场找各种电池吃，吸电荷，吃下的毒性材料，则用于多种毒属性攻击。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME roams garbage dumps looking for batteries of all kinds. It will feed on the batteries it finds, absorbing the charge and using the toxic materials it eats in its various Poison-type attacks.

entry: POKENAME常见于垃圾驳船与污染沙滩。人们定期做志愿清理，防这害兽造成更多破坏。
author: musicsheep.
source: POKENAME is a common sight around landfill barges and polluted beaches. Volunteer work is regularly done to prevent this pest from causing further harm.

entry: POKENAME看似戴着金属垃圾桶盖，其实是身体形成的伪装。许多传闻说，它是满溢废物中诞生的灵体。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME appear to wear metal trash can lids, but this is simply camouflage their bodies developed. Many rumors claim they are spirits born from overflowing waste.

entry: POKENAME吃数字文件，主要被用于清除回收电子设备的信息。可程序有疏漏，常误将不该执行的数据当代码，行为因此不稳定。
author: anonymous_moose
source: POKENAME is primarily employed to wipe information from recycled electronics, as it feeds on digital files. Due to an oversight in its programming, however, POKENAME often executes unintended data as code, leading to unstable behaviours.

entry: POKENAME以废物为食，是垃圾填埋场的常见住民，甚至能用废液代替水。喷火也是健康的标志；若喷出黑烟，它多半是病了。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are common landfill occupants because they feed on waste; they can even feed on liquid waste in lieu of water. They can spit fire, which also serves as a sign of their health; if POKENAME spits out any black smoke, it is likely ill.

entry: POKENAME受旁人情绪吸引，常在城镇附近被发现。可性情胆小，就藏进既作住处、又供食物的垃圾堆。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are drawn to the emotions of others, so they are often discovered near towns and cities. They are timid, so they tend to hide amidst that which they also eat from: piles of waste and rubbish.

entry: POKENAME超能力敏锐，清楚知道别人嫌它臭，因此怯懦羞愧。谁能忍受它在旁，很快就会被依恋。
author: dylonk25
source: POKENAME's psychic powers make it acutely aware of others' distaste for its stench. The result is a meek, shameful Pokémon, quick to form an attachment to anyone who can tolerate its presence.

entry: POKENAME伸缩舌与全身一样，由垃圾构成。得定期吃垃圾维持，否则可能失去长长伸舌的能力。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's extendable tongue is made up of garbage, much like the rest of its body. It needs to regularly consume trash to maintain itself, or it may lose the ability to extend its tongue great distances.

entry: POKENAME健康，直接取决于所依附那件垃圾周围的废物量。堆得越多，越强壮，可臭味也越浓。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's health is directly tied to how much garbage surrounds the specific piece of trash it is tied to. Its strength improves the more trash is accumulated, but so does its pungent odor.

entry: POKENAME吃大量垃圾，造出污泥，从背上喷出。毒性极强，碰到的任何植物都会死。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME consume massive amounts of trash, which they use to produce a sludge that they spray from their backs. This sludge is highly toxic, killing any and all plant life that it touches.

entry: POKENAME装成一小堆满溢的垃圾袋与废物，避免注意。最大的袋子其实是嘴，能迅速吃穿真垃圾堆，填饱肚子。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME disguise themselves as a small pile of trash bags and overflowing waste to avoid attention. The largest bags are actually mouths, which they use to quickly eat through piles of actual waste to sate themselves.

entry: POKENAME住污染水里，假扮挂在石上的垃圾。滤食有害塑料与污染物，清洁珊瑚礁，让其他宝可梦住得舒服。
author: kduffradio
source: POKENAME resides in polluted waters, disguising itself as trash caught on rocks. It filter-feeds on harmful plastics and pollutants, helping clean reefs so other Pokémon can live comfortably.

entry: POKENAME往袋状头里塞废金属，耐得住大多数身体攻击。可它格外小心，避免袋子破裂，否则几乎再无保护。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME fills its bag head with scrap metal, making it durable against most physical attacks. However, POKENAME is careful to avoid the bag splitting, as it would leave it with little to no protection.

entry: POKENAME似能发现附近垃圾，天生爱清理废物与垃圾场，见什么就吞什么，被认为对环境很有益。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: POKENAME have been deemed very helpful for the environment, able to seemingly detect the location of nearby garbage. They have a natural instinct to clean litter and landfills up, devouring any trash they see.

entry: 这些宝可梦大口吞食人类的垃圾和其他废物，身体的分量随之不断增加。由于全身散发着可怕的恶臭，它们根本不必担心捕食者。
author: infinex21
source: These Pokémon gorge themselves upon human trash and other waste, which adds more and more mass to their bodies. They have no need to fear predators due to the horrendous stench their bodies emit.

entry: POKENAME吃大量垃圾，偶尔被城市社区用于废物处理。受威胁时，从背部开口排垃圾，让自己看着更大。
author: staghorn
source: Since POKENAME consume large quantities of garbage, they are occasionally used for trash disposal in urban communities. When threatened, they expel garbage from the openings in their backs to make themselves look larger.

entry: POKENAME爱大垃圾箱，长途旅行后，常在里面安然休息。附近人发现，它偶尔散出废气般的味。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME love dumpsters, and can be found resting peacefully in them after a long day of traveling. Those nearby note that POKENAME sometimes emit an odor reminiscent of exhaust fumes.

entry: POKENAME爱囤积，收来大量杂物，分处藏好。它对收藏既贪婪又多疑，宁可烧成灰，也不愿分享，更不愿被夺走。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has a hoarder mentality, collecting large amounts of junk and storing it away in stashes. It's quite greedy and paranoid about its collections, preferring to burn them to ash rather than share them or have them taken away.

entry: POKENAME爱在废物里玩、吃。可每日需求少，实际消耗很低。奇怪的是，环境饮食虽脏，产生的水却毫无污染。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME love to play within and consume waste, though their consumption rate is rather low due to how little they need to eat per day. Oddly, they produce water that is entirely clean of any pollutants despite their environs and diets.

entry: POKENAME占小废品场或垃圾场，独居废物间。有人闯入，就从身上踢甩恶臭垃圾团，赶走对方。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME takes over small junkyards or dumps to live an isolated life among the garbage. If intruded upon, it kicks and flings nasty lumps of garbage from its body to repel the intruder.

entry: POKENAME嗅觉敏锐，轻易找到变质货品，还能安全吃大多数腐物，似乎也很爱吃。因此有些商家视它不可或缺。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME have keen senses of smell that allow them to easily locate spoiled goods. Because POKENAME can also safely eat most spoiled goods and seem to love doing so, they are considered vital by some businesses.

entry: 据说，POKENAME被垃圾之灵附身。因为遭人丢弃，如今满心怨恨，想向人类复仇。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME is said to be possessed by the spirit of garbage, vengeful towards humans for having been thrown away.

entry: POKENAME吃废物，无机垃圾也吃。饱后放毒气，迅速使旁人放松平静，有时甚至到危险程度。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME feed on waste, even non-organic waste. When they have eaten their fill, they exude a toxic gas; this gas quickly relaxes and calms others, sometimes to a dangerous degree.

entry: 神话中，POKENAME是海洋创造者。人类污染海洋多年，如今它的模样，也映出自己造物的境况。
author: spry_1676
source: POKENAME has appeared in mythology as the creator of the sea. After years of humans polluting the oceans, it has come to reflect the state of its creation.

entry: 无月夜，POKENAME偶尔翻垃圾找食物。有人出门查看，它就嗝出恶臭烟；吸入者便陷入发热昏睡。
author: .jerden
source: On moonless nights, POKENAME can occasionally found rummaging through trash, devouring whatever food it can find. If anyone comes out to investigate, it will belch out foul-smelling smoke, which forces anyone who inhales it into a feverish sleep.

entry: 每只POKENAME都钟爱某类垃圾，缺了便空虚。谁能供最合心意的，它就住那家外，无论带来好坏。
author: icelevelincarnate
source: Each POKENAME is attracted to a particular type of trash and feels empty without it. They will make their home outside the residence of whoever provides them with their ideal trash, for better or for worse.

entry: POKENAME十分在意自己的外貌，以及由垃圾构成的身份。得花不少心思温柔地哄，它才愿意放下戒备，享受与旁人亲近。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is very self-conscious due to its appearance and nature as a being made of garbage. It takes quite a bit of gentle coaxing to convince it to warm up and let itself enjoy being near others.

entry: POKENAME开盖漂浮，盼人投垃圾。通常早已满溢，却只慢慢分解里面的废物，而不倒空。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME floats around with its lid open, trying to get people to drop trash inside. It is usually already filled to overflowing, as it slowly breaks down the garbage rather than emptying it out.

entry: POKENAME像生锈桶，潜伏城市垃圾场附近。醒着时，体内总有昏暗火苗闪动。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME resembles a rusted barrel and lurks near urban dumps. A dim flame flickers inside its body whenever it is awake.

entry: POKENAME总带着烧塑料的味道，住在大城市，靠餐馆后面的垃圾箱觅食。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME always smell like burning plastic. They live in large cities, and feed off dumpsters behind restaurants.

entry: POKENAME走到哪，都有烧塑料味。翻垃圾箱找塑料袋与包装，熔进身体。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME smell of burnt plastic wherever they go. They rummage through dumpsters to find plastic bags and wrappers to melt into their bodies.

entry: POKENAME靠小垃圾桶护身，可桶一受击就瘪。它清地上垃圾想讨好人，可恶臭通常又将人赶走。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME are protected by a small trashcan, but it buckles after a single blow. POKENAME try to endear themselves to humans by clearing up trash from the ground, but their foul smell usually drives people away.

entry: POKENAME夜里从附近垃圾箱收废物，存进地道。冬眠期间定期醒来，便吃这些储备。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME gathers trash from nearby dumpsters at night to store inside its tunnel. It consumes this refuse when it periodically wakes from hibernation during the winter months.

entry: POKENAME是环保人士的噩梦，会用压实的垃圾筑坝，污染河流。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: An environmentalist's nightmare, POKENAME creates dams made of packed garbage which poison rivers.

entry: POKENAME用沾满口香糖的黏爪，捉住毫无防备的猎物，常躲在暗巷与垃圾箱里。
author: rakunk
source: POKENAME uses its sticky, gum-covered claws to grab unsuspecting prey. It is known to hide in dark alleyways and dumpsters.

entry: POKENAME受污染物吸引，大城市港口附近常见。吃废物渐渐长大；研究发现，部分增长，来自消化产生的毒气。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are drawn to pollutants, so many are often found near the ports of large cities. They feed on waste and gradually grow larger; it was discovered that part of their growth is due to noxious gases produced by digestion.

entry: POKENAME吃垃圾，在体内转成电。这块体内电池通常随时维持着至少100万伏特。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME consumes trash and converts it into electricity within its body. This internal battery tends to hold at least 1,000,000 volts at any given time.

entry: POKENAME穿行垃圾场，放出阵阵静电，搜寻美味垃圾。偏爱闻着微带辛辣的。
author: .izik
source: As POKENAME navigates landfills, it releases bursts of static to scan for flavorful trash. It prefers garbage with a slight spice to its scent.

entry: POKENAME有唱歌天分，却因臭味进不了场馆，只能在小巷开唱。少数听众，主要都是小拉达。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a talent for singing but are not allowed into venues because of their stench. They resort to singing in alleyways where they have small audiences which mainly consist of Rattata.

entry: POKENAME用巷里捡来的废物包住金属骨架。谁靠近，就放电防身。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME cloaks its metallic frame in refuse gathered from alleyways. It emits jolts of electricity to defend itself if approached.

entry: POKENAME被用于城市垃圾处理，以火焚废物。可气味难闻，有时仍被人避开。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is employed to help with city waste disposal, incinerating garbage with its flames. It is sometimes avoided because of its unpleasant odor.

entry: POKENAME源于自然地带的污染。花苞一开，臭味就令花草枯萎。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME comes from pollution in natural areas. When its bud opens, flowers and plants wilt from the stench.

entry: POKENAME的身体由腐烂的植物构成，便裹上塑料袋，帮助身体维持完整。它仍希望有人能看见自己的潜力，因此脸上总带着微笑。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME's body is made up of decomposing plant life, so it wraps itself in a plastic bag to aid in holding itself together. Having hope that a person will still see potential in its abilities, it keeps a smile on its face.

entry: POKENAME双手是玫瑰形垃圾。光是在场，就足以令真花枯萎。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME has rubbish in the shape of roses for its hands. Its presence is enough to make actual flowers wilt.

entry: 自然地带遭工业污染，POKENAME便如杂草大量冒出。它们剧毒，又会抵抗清除危害的行动，若不谨慎迁移，会威胁清理人员。
author: brilliantdarkness
source: Industrial pollution in natural areas causes scores of POKENAME to sprout like weeds. Highly toxic, they resist hazard removal efforts and pose a threat to clean-up workers unless relocated carefully.

entry: 它带着恶臭，漂在市区。教育节目常把它当作“可爱”的城市污染象征。
author: staghorn
source: It floats around urban areas, accompanied by a foul odor. Educational shows often use them as a "cute" representation of urban pollution.

entry: POKENAME在工业弃物场挖尖金属片，作临时牙。咬到太硬的东西，牙常就掉了。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME digs through industrial dumping grounds for sharp metal shards to use as makeshift teeth. These often fall out after it bites into something too tough.

entry: POKENAME垃圾翼常散落，无法飞行。它翻吃垃圾桶里的东西，加快双翼再生。
author: sk372
source: The rubbish forming POKENAME's wings regularly loses cohesion and falls off, leaving it grounded. It rifles through and eats the contents of garbage cans to help hasten their regeneration.

entry: POKENAME从溪流与支流附近捡塑料，喂群里最小的幼崽。一群只需几小时，就能吃掉满箱垃圾。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME gathers bits of plastic from near streams and tributaries to feed to the youngest members of its flock. A single flock can devour a dumpster full of trash in hours.

entry: 许多人讨厌看见POKENAME，可它能将无机物转成有机肥，减少最终填埋的垃圾，对废物管理很重要。
author: quackquackattack
source: While many people loathe seeing POKENAME, they play a vital role in waste management. By converting inorganic material into organic fertilizer, they help minimize the amount of trash that ends up in a landfill.

entry: POKENAME初看可怜，速度却惊人。橡胶般的身体有足够摩擦力，泥面也能滚，雨天反占优势。
author: quackquackattack
source: While POKENAME may seem pathetic at first glance, their surprising speed makes them stand out. Their rubbery bodies give them the friction needed to roll atop of muddy surfaces, giving them an advantage in the rain.

entry: 埋在填埋场下的颚之化石，能被复原成POKENAME。它生前最爱吃的，是臭泥一种早已灭绝的近亲。
author: mrpeach774
source: When a Jaw Fossil is found buried beneath a landfill, it can be resurrected into a POKENAME. Its favorite food was a now extinct cousin of Grimer.

entry: POKENAME的大颚，连最难处理的垃圾也能轻易撕开。吃过最爱的食物，还会放出数百万年不曾出现的毒气。
author: mrpeach774
source: A POKENAME's jaws easily tear through the toughest garbage. After eating its favorite meal, it releases toxic gases not seen for millions of years.

entry: POKENAME用恶臭吐息诱来臭泥，再放冷气彻底冻住，方便吃。每挨一击，袋甲便掉垃圾，直到只剩软身体。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME lures in Grimer with its foul breath before releasing a cold gas that freezes them solid, making them easy meals for it to eat. Each hit it takes spills trash from its bag-like armor until only its soft inner body remains.

entry: POKENAME夜里摇摆走过街道，找弃物吃。塑料身体常在头旁破开，大块垃圾冒出来，像花般随风摇。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME waddle through city streets at night in search of discarded waste to consume. Their plastic bodies often rupture around their head, allowing larger chunks of waste to blossom out of them and wave in the wind.

entry: 它跳欢快舞，想鼓励伙伴。可挥臂时垃圾满天飞，通常反而烦到同伴。
author: hophoppip
source: It performs cheerful dances to motivate its allies. Unfortunately, it usually ends up bothering its allies, as bits of trash fly everywhere when it waves its arms.

entry: POKENAME形成于垃圾满溢、卫生差的城市，主动把散落废物收到体内。有时身体破裂，只得往垃圾桶排掉废物。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME form in cities with an overflow of garbage and poor street hygiene. These Pokémon actively work to try and gather up discarded litter into themselves, sometimes rupturing and needing to deposit their waste into trash cans.

entry: POKENAME形成于垃圾满溢、卫生差的城市，主动把散落废物收到体内，塞到几乎撑破。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME form in cities with an overflow of garbage and poor street hygiene. These Pokémon actively work to try and gather up discarded litter into themselves, filling themselves to bursting point.

entry: POKENAME肿胀的身体，不停填入垃圾与废物，笨重走过城市失修街道。数量一多，主动翻抢垃圾桶与大箱时，便可能危险。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have swollen, bloated bodies that they constantly fill with discarded trash and waste. They lumber through neglected streets in cities, and large populations can prove dangerous when they start actively trying to raid bins and dumpsters.

entry: POKENAME常出没于深水，也很容易被污染的水域吸引。它主要以废物为食，因此身披垃圾碎片，鳞片也有毒。性情凶暴到会为觅食而攻击船只。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are found often in deep waters, though they are easily drawn to polluted waters as well. They primarily feed on waste, resulting in them being clad in pieces of waste and having toxic scales. They are violent enough to attack ships for food.

entry: POKENAME住在重污染海域，狼吞虎咽地吃海洋垃圾，因此清理海中废物的效率很高。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME lives in ocean waters with high pollution rates. It gorges itself ravenously on trash in the ocean, making it rather efficient as a way to help clean up the garbage polluting the seas.

entry: POKENAME无论多老，都像孩子般爱在垃圾里嬉戏。最爱的垃圾堆被清走，就大哭，有些训练家因此很难养。
author: infinex21
source: No matter their age, POKENAME display childlike demeanors, such as by frolicking within trash. They cry loudly if their favorite piles of trash are cleaned up, making them difficult to raise for some Trainers.

entry: POKENAME夜里摇摆走过街道，找弃物吃。塑料身体常在头旁破开，大块垃圾冒出来，像花般随风摇。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME waddle through city streets at night in search of discarded waste to consume. Their plastic bodies often rupture around their head, allowing larger chunks of waste to blossom out of them and wave in the wind.

entry: POKENAME身后总拖着受污染的垃圾渗滤液，臭液留下一层黏残渣。大多只住下水道或垃圾场，别处很难容忍。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME constantly trail a contaminated leachate behind them, the foul-smelling liquid leaving behind a sticky residue. Most are only found in sewers and landfills, as they are seldom tolerated elsewhere.

entry: 因为总吃腐败的剩菜，身上长出一种生物学家尚未辨明的新花，摸起来滑溜溜的。
author: chorb33
source: As it constantly eats rotten leftovers, its body has grown a new type of bloom that has not yet been determined by biologists. It is very slippery.

entry: POKENAME从沉船捡散落垃圾与船只废物，组成实体。慢慢走过海底，吞住猎物，吸走能量。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME collects loose trash from sunken boats and discarded ship waste to form its physical body. It slowly moves across the seafloor in search of prey to engulf and drain their energy.

entry: POKENAME分泌黏液黏住碎屑与废物，在城市海岸的污水中伪装。垃圾腐败，也使黏液满是毒。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME secrete a sticky mucus that they use to gather detritus and waste to camouflage themselves, hiding amongst the polluted waters of city coastlines. Their mucus is laden with toxins from the decay of the garbage.

entry: POKENAME操纵体内垃圾，分成多个分身。即使拆开，每块也能协同使出武术攻击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME manipulates the trash in its body to split into multiple copies of itself. Even divided, each piece can perform synchronized martial arts attacks.

entry: POKENAME以粗垃圾肢体猛打敌人。它吃、囤垃圾与弃置锐物，也能将收来的东西，远射成尖弹。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME clubs at opponents with its thick trashy limbs. It consumes and hoards garbage and discarded sharp objects, so it can use the gathered garbage to fire pointy projectiles at foes from afar.

entry: POKENAME身上的沙一晒太阳，就放出恶臭。夏天，这气味几乎无法忍受。
author: .izik
source: The sand covering POKENAME's body releases a terrible stench when exposed to sunlight. During the summer months, this smell becomes nearly unbearable.

entry: 因为总吃腐败的剩菜，身上长出一种生物学家尚未辨明的新花，摸起来滑溜溜的。
author: chorb33
source: As it constantly eats rotten leftovers, its body has grown a new type of bloom that has not yet been determined by biologists. It is very slippery.

entry: POKENAME钻垃圾袋与堆肥找厨余。没有消化系统，只靠背上彩蘑菇分解食物，供应养分。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME burrows into trash bags and compost heaps to gather food waste. It lacks a digestive system and relies on the colorful mushrooms on its back to break down food and provide POKENAME with nutrients.

entry: POKENAME背上的大蘑菇，产酶消化任何有机材料，塑料也行。每钻进一处垃圾场，都会留下孢子。
author: .jerden
source: The large mushroom on POKENAME's back produces enzymes that can digest any organic material, including plastic. POKENAME leaves its spores in every garbage dump it dives into.

entry: POKENAME在温室堆肥中迅速挖掘，找美味叶片。吃完，便将堆肥撒给附近植物，表示感谢。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME digs rapidly through compost piles in greenhouses for flavorful leaves. After eating, it scatters the compost across nearby plants as thanks.

entry: 它胆小，在城里垃圾桶搜食。头上硬刺，轻易就能掀翻重桶。
author: busilisk
source: A timid Pokémon, it scavenges from trash bins in urban areas. The sturdy quills on its head allow it to topple heavy bins with ease.

entry: POKENAME在垃圾场，与其他食腐宝可梦互撞着玩，咯咯笑不停。垃圾身体玩得压实，外皮破了也不会漏。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME wanders garbage dumps, playing with other scavenging Pokémon by crashing into each other which lead to giggling fits. If its outer coating tears, the trash body is so compacted from its play that it will not leak out.

entry: POKENAME每日最多吃100磅垃圾，积极帮助环境。许多城市开始用它，清除街上弃物。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME actively helps the environment by consuming up to 100 lbs of garbage a day. Many cities have started using POKENAME to help keep their streets clean of discarded trash.

entry: POKENAME爱在垃圾箱玩，可也会陪志愿者，用树枝戳起路上散落垃圾。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME can be found playing in dumpsters. Despite their proclivity to play in garbage, they can be found alongside volunteers using their twig to spear loose trash found on the street.

entry: POKENAME一操纵垃圾，杖尖便发光。废物压成球，加热到高温，再如炮弹般射向敌人。
author: .izik
source: The end of POKENAME's wand glows when it begins manipulating trash. It compacts the garbage into balls and heats them to high temperatures before firing them like a cannon at foes.

entry: POKENAME塑料皮几乎装不下垃圾团身体，溢出的废物，就当武器。垃圾弹射太多，身体又会瘪下、萎缩，直到再吃垃圾。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME can barely contain its garbage blob body within its plastic skin, leading to an overflow of waste that it uses as a weapon. If it fires too many projectiles of trash, its body will sag and shrivel until it consumes more rubbish.

entry: 最好别碰POKENAME。它吃下垃圾中的甜食，身体变得黏糊，还带着难以洗掉的甜腻臭味，常让人恶心、食欲不振，持续好几天。
author: actliux
source: Touching a POKENAME is unwise, as the sugary foods they eat from garbage make them sticky and create a sweet malodor that becomes hard to wash off, often inducing sickness and appetite loss that can last for days.

entry: POKENAME收散落垃圾，装进松皮，藏在巢里当宝，偶尔也吃作零嘴。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME collects loose trash and stores it within its loose skin. It keeps this refuse in its den as a treasure, occasionally consuming it as a snack.

entry: 它浮在污水上，或歇在罐、碗等圆洞上。有些POKENAME吃完一罐豆子罐头，小小身体正好能盖住空罐。
author: quackquackattack
source: It is found floating atop sewage or resting atop circular holes such as cans or bowls. Some POKENAME are small enough to cover a Tin of Beans after eating the contents inside.

entry: POKENAME整夜往头上带着的袋子塞垃圾，保持脏臭。若有人试着洗净它，它就会大哭，立刻另找污物打滚。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME spends the night stuffing the bags it carries on its head with garbage to stay dirty and smelly. If someone tries to wash it clean, it bursts into tears and immediately searches for new filth to roll in.

entry: POKENAME通常住垃圾场，过去被当害兽。如今，吃垃圾却几乎不留副产物，即使满身细菌，也受环保人士喜爱。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME are generally found in landfills. While they were once regarded as pests, the fact they are able to consume garbage and leave little byproduct behind has made them well-liked among conservationists, even with their bacteria-laden bodies.

entry: POKENAME跟游轮，盼船上丢垃圾。胃酸强，几乎什么废物都轻易消化。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME follows cruise ships in hopes of trash being discarded from the vessel. The acid in its stomach allows it to easily digest almost any refuse.

entry: POKENAME通常住垃圾场，过去被当害兽。如今，吃垃圾却几乎不留副产物，即使满身细菌，也受环保人士喜爱。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME are generally found in landfills. While they were once regarded as pests, the fact they are able to consume garbage and leave little byproduct behind has made them well-liked among conservationists, even with their bacteria-laden bodies.

entry: POKENAME捡垃圾里遗落的硬币，囤到袋子快爆。有的袋破了，币又掉下，结果总反复囤同一笔零钱。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME pilfers coins lost among garbage and refuse, hoarding it until its bags are full to bursting. Some bags rip and leave behind its coins, causing it to continuously hoard the same bits of change.

entry: POKENAME爱玩垃圾场的坏玩具，如褪色毛线球、坏激光笔。吃下大量垃圾，咳个毛球，又继续玩。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME enjoy playing with an assortment of broken toys that end up in landfills, such as a discolored ball of yarn or a broken laser pointer. After eating lots of garbage, they cough up a hairball before resuming their play.

entry: POKENAME有时卡进连通河湖的管道。人们通常请水管工先疏出，再送到安全地方。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can find itself lodged in pipes that connect to lakes and rivers. Plumbers are typically called in to help dislodge POKENAME from pipes before transferring it to a safer location.

entry: POKENAME睡着也在垃圾箱间瞬间移动，莫名从弃物吸能。进食被扰，就放强念力冲击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME teleports between dumpsters while sleeping, somehow absorbing energy from the discarded trash. If disturbed while feeding, it unleashes a powerful telekinetic blast.

entry: POKENAME随人走环卫路线，轻松举满桶。若满溢，便吸走剩下的粥状污泥，减轻重量。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME works sanitation routes alongside humans, hoisting full bins with ease. When the bin overflows, it slurps up any leftover gruel-like sludge to lighten the load.

entry: POKENAME常帮清道夫与环卫工，获赠垃圾吃。在野外，会为找食物与臭泥打架。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME are known to help street cleaners and sanitation workers, often being rewarded with trash to eat. In the wild, they fight Grimer while looking for food.

entry: POKENAME虽一身垃圾臭，许多孩子仍被它尽心保街道清洁的行动鼓舞。近来一批有它登场的电影，希望让大家认识到清洁工也是光荣职业。
author: quackquackattack
source: Even though POKENAME reek of garbage, many children are inspired by their dedication to helping keep streets clean. There has been a recent wave of films where POKENAME are featured to help normalize street cleaners as an honorable occupation.

entry: POKENAME涉过垃圾场泥污，找塑料吃维生。为抵御其他食腐者，向竞争者喷污水。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME survive living in landfills by wading through the muck to find plastic to eat. To defend themselves from fellow scavengers, they spray dirty water at their competition.

entry: POKENAME常卡在排水管中，是世界各地水管工的噩梦。他们不仅得排出堵住的积水，还可能要面对POKENAME强有力的刺击。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are a nightmare for plumbers throughout the world because they often get stuck in drainage pipes. Not only do plumbers have to drain clogged water but they may also have to face against POKENAME's powerful stings.

entry: POKENAME收建筑废料构筑身体，哪里有碎砖与混凝土都拿。工地管理不善，就可能大群迁入，扰乱进度。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME collect construction waste to build out their bodies, taking broken bricks and concrete wherever they can. Poor management of a building site can result in large populations of POKENAME moving in and disrupting progress.

entry: POKENAME翻垃圾场找塑料吃。硬壳保护，哪怕高处落下也不受伤。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME rummage through landfills to find plastic to consume. Their tough shells allow them to fall from great heights without hurting themselves.

entry: POKENAME总挥舞满垃圾的塑料袋，整日收厨余塞进武器，增加分量。不过光是臭味，就能赶跑天敌。
author: anonymous_moose
source: POKENAME is always seen brandishing a plastic bag brimming with garbage. It spends its days gathering food scraps to add bulk to its weapon, though would-be predators are deterred by the stench alone.

entry: POKENAME将空牙膏管、用过的伤药瓶等垃圾，拖进浓污泥。味道刺鼻，即使有益，也被人赶走。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME drag trash into their thick sludge, from empty toothpaste tubes to used Potion bottles. They have a pungent smell and are chased away despite being helpful.

entry: POKENAME吃大量塑料，炮里便产出浓污泥。熔化后，能转成可再生材料，可少有人肯收那恶臭泥。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME produce a thick sludge from their cannons that is created after they eat lots of plastic. This sludge can be melted down and converted into renewable materials, but few people want to harvest the putrid sludge.

entry: POKENAME住在垃圾常见的城区与住宅区，饱餐废物。也可能伸舌，从不留心的路人那里卷食物。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME feasts on trash, placing itself in urban and residential areas where such things are common. It may use its tongue to slurp up food from passersby that aren't paying enough attention.

entry: POKENAME恶臭能留衣上好几天。人们试过许多蜡烛与薰香，始终没能让味道好忍些。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME produce a horrible stench that lingers on clothing for days. Many attempts at making their odor more tolerable through candles and incense have yielded no solution.

entry: 它在沙滩快爬，边走边掉垃圾。每天需吃3磅垃圾，身体才不缩水。
author: bandedbodypress
source: It scurries around beaches, dropping trash when it walks. It needs to eat 3 pounds of trash a day to not shrink.

entry: POKENAME住在重污染水域，身体由工业废物与微塑料构成。它想清洁家园，吞吃周围漂浮的污染物。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME live in highly polluted waters, their bodies forming from industrial waste and microplastics. They have a drive to try and clean up their homes, consuming the pollutants that float in the water around them.

entry: POKENAME住在重污染水域，身体由工业废物与微塑料构成。它想清洁家园，吞吃周围漂浮的污染物。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME live in highly polluted waters, their bodies forming from industrial waste and microplastics. They have a drive to try and clean up their homes, consuming the pollutants that float in the water around them.

entry: POKENAME逗留加油站与燃料库，大吃垃圾、舔漏油、吸废气与油汽。处理污染后，排出清土、净水与空气，让住处一尘不染。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME linger around gas stations and fuel depots; guzzling up litter, licking spilled fuel, and inhaling exhaust and fuel fumes. They process the contaminants and output clean soil, water, and air, leaving the places they inhabit spotless.

entry: POKENAME轻飘的身体，一饿就极臭。讽刺的是，喂最臭的垃圾，反而最能填饱肚子，暂时去臭。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's wispy form emits an extremely pungent odor when it is hungry. Ironically, feeding it exceedingly smelly garbage is the best way to sate its appetite and eliminate its stench for a while.

entry: 这种宝可梦散发浓烈的“奇怪的果实”气味。多数生物受不了，却有某些野生宝可梦莫名被吸引。
author: jaminmcready
source: This Pokémon emits an overpowering scent of Strange Fruit. While most find the stench unbearable, certain wild Pokémon are strangely drawn to it.

entry: POKENAME恶臭，令多数宝可梦厌恶。少数能忍的小拉达与拉达，会喂垃圾，换一处磨牙的地方。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME release a foul stench that is repulsive to most Pokémon. Rattata and Raticate are among the few that tolerate the smell, feeding POKENAME trash in exchange for a place to sharpen their teeth.

entry: 野生POKENAME常翻垃圾与废物，吃金属屑、腐烂厨余。尤其爱大钢筋，既作工具武器，也能啃上好几天。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME are commonly found sifting through trash and other waste, feeding on scrap metal and rotten food scraps. They favor large pieces of rebar as weapons and tools, but also as something to gnaw on for days.

entry: POKENAME常住填埋场与垃圾堆，右手捡垃圾吃，左臂放毒气防身。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are common inhabitants of landfills and garbage dumps, picking up trash with their right hands to then eat. They release poisonous gas from their left arms to defend themselves.

entry: POKENAME在垃圾桶里安家，以人类丢弃的垃圾为食。它脾气很坏，每次从桶里冒出来，通常都是为了赶走旁人。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME makes its home in a garbage can, subsisting on the trash thrown away by humans. When it pops out of its can, it is typically to drive others away, as it has a very grouchy personality.

entry: POKENAME会收养任何被遗弃的幼年宝可梦，视如己出。它吃垃圾，被残酷训练家丢进垃圾堆的幼崽，最可能获救。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME will take in any young abandoned Pokémon and raise it as its own. Pokémon left in the trash by cruel Trainers are most likely to be rescued, as POKENAME feeds on garbage.

entry: POKENAME不停寻找海洋废物，用塑料片与微塑料固定身体。身体在海水中逐渐降解，对其他宝可梦有毒害。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME use scraps of plastics and microplastics floating in the ocean to hold their bodies together, constantly seeking out oceanic waste to do so. Their bodies gradually degrade in sea water, making their presence toxic to other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME的身体长得像污水里漂浮的各类人造垃圾。人们相信，这是为躲鸟宝可梦，可身体似乎毒得根本无法吃。
author: infinex21
source: The bodies of POKENAME have developed to resemble various pieces of human trash floating in polluted waters. Though this is believed to have been to protect themselves from bird Pokémon, their bodies seem far too toxic to be consumable.

entry: POKENAME常翻垃圾箱，找纸造翼与筑巢。找到合适纸张，就喷可生物降解胶，黏到背上。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME often go dumpster diving to find paper for their wings and nests. Once they find a suitable sheet, they squirt a biodegradable glue onto the paper and stick it onto their back.

entry: POKENAME最常见于污水污染的水域，吃沉底垃圾。住处虽浑浊，却连最微弱的光也能察觉。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME is most often found in water polluted by sewage, feeding on trash that sinks the bottom. Although the water they live in is murky, they are sensitive to the faintest sources of light.

entry: POKENAME最常见于污水污染的水域，吃沉底垃圾。它让小漂浮碎屑亮起鲜光，照明浑浊深处。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME is most often found in water polluted by sewage, feeding on trash that sinks the bottom. They illuminate the murky depths by making small pieces of floating debris glow with bright color.

entry: POKENAME在城市小巷安家，开心吃居民垃圾。数量多的城市称，垃圾清运费用大幅降低。
author: fancyskunk
source: POKENAME have made their homes in urban alleyways, happily feeding on city residents' garbage. Cities with large populations of POKENAME have reported drastically reduced costs for trash removal.

entry: POKENAME收集其他表演者丢的道具，融进身体。日后随时取出，无声却准确地重现曾使用该道具的表演。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME collects props discarded by other performers, incorporating them into its body. It can pull any of these out later to silently but accurately recreate a previous performance involving that object.

entry: POKENAME的角和牙，已变得如金属粉碎机，能将大块废物绞碎进食。虽有人有些害怕，它们却常被用于垃圾填埋场，拆解大件垃圾。
author: infinex21
source: The horns and fangs of a POKENAME have become like metal grinders that can churn large waste into little pieces for it to eat. Although some humans fear them a bit, they are often utilized in landfills to break apart larger pieces of trash.

entry: 它总能夺得最讨厌融合体的称号。POKENAME经常发怒，一生气就滑行在居住的城市里，朝倒霉路人喷洒垃圾。
author: gooeygamer69
source: This Pokémon always wins the title of most-disliked fusion. When angry, which is quite often, POKENAME glides through the city in which it lives while spraying trash at unlucky pedestrians.

entry: POKENAME收世界海洋垃圾，存进背上袋。悲歌据说连最粗心的人，也会在污染它的家前再想一想。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME collects trash from the world's oceans and stores everything collected in sacks on its back. Its mournful song is said to make even the most careless people think twice about polluting its home.

entry: POKENAME将小垃圾岛全部吸进身体，开始渗毒黏液。曾为清污本领自豪，如今却常与旁人隔绝。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: POKENAME has fully absorbed small islands of garbage into its body, which has caused it to begin oozing a toxic slime. This Pokémon, once proud of its ability to clean pollution, now often finds itself isolated from others.

entry: POKENAME战斗时，真能闻着像一堆热垃圾。气味虽差，呆萌魅力却让许多人难拒绝，即使依偎时，软垃圾外衣蹭得人满身。
author: icelevelincarnate
source: During battles, POKENAME can end up literally smelling like hot garbage. In spite of their unpleasant smell, many can't resist POKENAME's dopey charm, even when they cuddle up and rub their soft coat of trash all over someone.

entry: POKENAME压得太密，排出的垃圾快得看不清。它把亮物弯成护符或奖杯形射出，想和陌生人交朋友。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are so condensed that any trash they expel shoots out with blinding speed. They shoot out shiny objects bent into the shape of amulets or trophies in an effort to become friends with strangers.

entry: POKENAME出没于受辐照的填埋场附近，身体层层覆着未用过的聚合物。壳如加压废物舱，将合成碎屑转成生物燃料，防止自己崩解。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME is found near irradiated landfills, its body layered with unused polymers. Its shell acts as a pressurized waste chamber, converting synthetic debris into biofuel, preventing its own body from breaking down.

entry: 这些空中猎手偏爱垃圾场等有毒地带，俯冲以尖颚叼猎物。似乎吃过某些宝可梦化石，身体围残骸长成。
author: infinex21
source: These airborne predators favor landfills and other poisonous areas, diving down to snatch prey within their pointed jaws. They appear to have eaten the fossilized remains of certain Pokémon and their bodies developed around the remains.

entry: POKENAME常见于大都市小巷，全身就是胃，丢上去的食物，直接便被吸收。
author: bacondlx
source: POKENAME can be found in the alleys of sprawling cities. Its entire body acts as its stomach, so any food tossed away on it is simply absorbed.

entry: POKENAME将垃圾收进污泥身体，飞入雷暴挨雷。垃圾熔结，条件合适还能形成雷之石，再像冰雹洒下。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME collects trash in its muck-covered body and soars into thunderstorms to be struck by lightning. This fuses the trash together, which under the right circumstances forms Thunder Stones, and rains the fused trash down like hail.

entry: POKENAME贴海低飞，尾巴黏浮垃圾，拖出估计最长100米的废物带。随后连同收藏，一起瞬间移动离开。
author: oddwalls
source: POKENAME flies low over the sea and attaches floating garbage to its tail, creating a trail of litter that can grow up to an estimated 100 meters. It then teleports away, along with its collection of trash.

entry: POKENAME体内有极易燃气体，敲齿就能点着。还可做成小炸弹，掷向敌人。
author: infinex21
source: The body of a POKENAME contains a highly combustible gas that can be ignited by clacking its teeth. They can form small bombs from this gas and hurl them at enemies.

entry: POKENAME在废品场找零件添身体。遇电子设备，通常也能通电，为自己所用。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME scavenges junkyards to find parts to add to its body. If it finds any electronics, it can usually power them on to serve its own purposes.

entry: POKENAME袭击河湖旁城市的垃圾桶，每走一步都漏垃圾液，翻抢完便留下明显痕迹。
author: musicsheep.
source: POKENAME raids garbage cans in cities located near rivers and ponds. POKENAME leaks trashy liquid from its body with every step, leaving heaps of evidence after a trash raid.

entry: POKENAME爱蹦跳，液态垃圾溅满四周。全身都是软烂废物，带它去公共场所，很不受欢迎。
author: musicsheep.
source: POKENAME loves to jump around, splashing liquid garbage all over the place. Its entire body is mushy, rotten trash and it is frowned upon to bring one to public spaces.

entry: POKENAME头侧的鳃，能察觉1公里外腐败生物质放的甲烷。腐臭刺激过强，鳃便漏毒液。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: The gills on the side of POKENAME's head detect methane emitted from rotting biological matter over 1km away. If overstimulated by excess putrescence, their gills leak a poisonous liquid.

entry: POKENAME用两条长肢清扫垃圾，抵御竞争者。背上的袋子里有一朵收拢的花，只有吃下足够垃圾、获得充足养分，才会开放。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME uses its two long limbs to sweep up trash and to fend off competitors. There is a flower folded up inside the bag on its back, but it will not bloom until POKENAME nourishes itself with enough garbage.

entry: POKENAME受街道卫生差的城市吸引，在弃袋与垃圾堆筑巢，地上有什么就吃。垃圾箱旁的齿痕，是它在场的明证。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are drawn to cities that have poor street sanitation, nesting amongst discarded trash bags and piles of waste. They feed on anything they can find on the floor; gnaw marks around dumpsters are a sure sign of their presence.

entry: POKENAME从容器取垃圾，在地面画符号，被认为想沟通。可至今没人读懂垃圾形状的意义。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME plucks garbage from containers and uses it to draw symbols upon the ground. It's believed this habit is an attempt at communication, but none have yet discovered meaning in the trash's shapes.

entry: POKENAME格外害怕时，会用超能力举起周围垃圾，掷向敌人。垃圾尾似有独立意识，咬一切从背后靠近者。
author: fiordaliso
source: When POKENAME feels particularly frightened, it uses its psychic powers to lift the surrounding garbage and hurl it at its enemies. The trash that forms its tail seems to have a mind of its own and bites anything that approaches POKENAME from behind.

entry: POKENAME通常住在供自己取食的填埋场下。身体酷似所吃垃圾，尤其是最爱的废钢筋。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME typically live under the landfills that they also eat from. Their bodies resemble the trash they devour, especially the discarded bars of rebar that they especially favor.

entry: POKENAME腿如坚针，轻易串起各类杂物，最终被上身吸收。双钳能“嗝”出毒气，先使敌人眩晕，再挥拳痛打。
author: infinex21
source: A POKENAME's legs are like sturdy needles that can rather easily skewer myriad junk and debris which eventually gets absorbed into their upper bodies. They can "belch" toxic gas from their pincers to daze foes before pummeling them with punches.

entry: POKENAME以强臂将自身废物压成紧球，扔向对手。野生个体常仿佛在垃圾山里游泳。
author: infinex21
source: This Pokémon uses its strong arms to compact its own refuse into tight balls that they throw at their opponents. Wild POKENAME can often be found effectively swimming through mounds of trash and refuse.

entry: POKENAME常在校外与垃圾场吃废物，没完全吃下的，便成为身体一部分。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME can be found outside schools and in garbage dumps, consuming trash. Whatever they don't fully eat becomes part of their body.

entry: POKENAME广用于电影拍摄，演员与剧组产生的废物都交给它，飞运指定废物点，帮助野外拍戏不损环境。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME have become widely used during the filming of movies. Any waste that the cast and crew produce is given to POKENAME, who fly it to designated waste points. This has helped shoots in wild locations without harming the environment.

entry: 有人在含渔业废物的海洋垃圾带附近，发现野生POKENAME。闪亮鱼饵，能诱水生猎物。
author: hophoppip
source: Wild POKENAME have been spotted near ocean garbage patches containing fishing waste. The fusion's shiny fishing lure attracts aquatic prey.

entry: 反复滚动冲锋，会磨损POKENAME身上的轮胎，动作渐渐不稳。胎终会破，眼前最急的事便是换新的。
author: evilgammon
source: Repeated rolling charges wear down the tire along POKENAME's body over time, resulting in movement becoming unsteady. When the tire inevitably tears, its new immediate mission is to find a replacement.

entry: POKENAME强迫光标将文件拖进回收站，用户还需要也不管。若不看守，最终会拖走所有非必需文件。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME force cursors to drag files into the trash, even if the user still needs the file. If left unsupervised, they eventually drag all non-vital files into the trash.

entry: POKENAME主要吃垃圾，住在填埋场。鹿角圆球能遮住垃圾臭，磨粉还能缓解消化不良。
author: bobogagabobo
source: POKENAME lives in landfills since it primarily consumes trash. The orbs on their antlers help mask the scent of the garbage and, when ground into a powder, help with indigestion.

entry: 这小巷宝可梦用涂鸦标领地。饮食差，色素腺很快干涸，因此也学会用废喷漆罐。
author: hophoppip
source: This alley-dwelling Pokémon marks its territory with graffiti. Its poor diet causes its pigment glands to run dry quickly, so it learns to use discarded spray paint cans as well.

entry: POKENAME的奶酪完全不能吃，满是寄生虫，还长致命霉菌，散发垃圾臭。
author: musicsheep.
source: POKENAME cheese is completely inedible. It reeks of garbage, as deadly mold grows on the cheese, and it is filled with parasites.

entry: 野生POKENAME被受污染的湖泊、池塘吸引，吞吃漂浮的废物，似乎想将水清理干净。可身体毒性太强，它们往往又给水添上另一种污染。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME are drawn to polluted lakes and ponds, seemingly trying to clean them by feasting upon the waste floating in them. Unfortunately, their own bodies are so toxic they often add a different form of pollution to the water.

entry: POKENAME游荡荒地时，臭风绕身打旋，卷起尘土和小块垃圾。烦躁时，这些碎物会被猛地抛出，力道足以伤敌。
author: .jerden
source: As POKENAME roams through wastelands, a foul smelling wind swirls around it, picking up dust and small pieces of trash. When it is agitated, these are propelled through the air with enough force to injure foes.

entry: POKENAME脸两侧有臭腺，翻垃圾找各种食物，旧电子设备也吃。
author: bobosmith01
source: Smelly odor-releasing glands are on the sides of POKENAME's face. It roots through trash to search for all kinds of things to consume, including old electronics.

entry: 水中看似一团漂垃圾，可能其实是POKENAME。靠近得小心，它也许会向周围喷毒气。
author: musicsheep.
source: What may seem like a clump of trash floating in the water may actually be a POKENAME. Take caution when approaching, as it might spew toxic gases into the surrounding area.

entry: POKENAME释放的毒气，浓烈而可怕，肉眼可见一片诡异的紫色。光是气味，就能轻易制服多数对手；而猛烈的毒性，也可能很快结束它们的痛苦。
author: infinex21
source: The toxic gas released by a POKENAME is so thick and horrid that it is visibly an eerie purple color. They can easily subdue most opponents through the smell of this gas alone, but it is also so toxic that it may quickly end their torment.

entry: 它看人收垃圾，便模仿动作。人刚装满一袋，就跑来，想把垃圾融进身体。
author: .jerden
source: It imitates the motions humans make while watching them collect trash. Every time they finish filling a bag, it will run up to try to incorporate the garbage into its body.

entry: POKENAME用大磁铁，将汽车与废物搬回家，囤起来吃。许多废品场养着它，帮助搬重物。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME use their large magnets to carry cars and other scrap back to their homes, hoarding them for food. Many junkyards keep these Pokémon to help them move heavy materials.

entry: POKENAME舌头材质如纸巾，收集各种垃圾废物，再消化取能量。
author: bradlybro199
source: POKENAME have tongues that are made of a material similar to a paper towel. They use this appendage to gather up all kinds of garbage and waste that they then digest for energy.

entry: 游戏设计者常请POKENAME建议，怎样制作好精灵图。画师不满意，只需删掉作品，就能喂给它。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Video game designers often employ POKENAME to give advice on how to make proper sprites. Should an artist hate their sprite, they can feed it to POKENAME by deleting their work.

entry: POKENAME常住电脑回收站，吃掉里面所有已删文件，让它们再也无法恢复。偏爱损坏文件，在多边兽融合体里很少见。
author: _pixelar_
source: It is common to find a POKENAME living in the waste bin of a computer. It will consume all deleted files it finds in the bin, making it impossible to recover them. The Pokémon prefers corrupted files, which is uncommon for Porygon fusions.

entry: POKENAME外表虽差，却是自然最强的保护者之一，能吃垃圾、喝污水，主要目标便是保护丛林免遭污染。
author: saucebolodu81
source: Despite their appearance, POKENAME are one of nature's greatest protectors, as they can eat trash and drink polluted water. Their main goal is to protect the jungle from being polluted.

entry: POKENAME到填埋场寻找废布，给自己做衣服。在它看来，土豆袋这样朴素的装扮，才最好看。
author: blitzydragon
source: POKENAME searches landfills for discarded cloth to dress itself in. It believes it looks best in simple things like potato sacks.

entry: 它朝自己喷各种颜色的污泥，来作伪装。最厉害的POKENAME，人的眼看不出，鼻子却轻易能闻见。
author: bandedbodypress
source: It camouflages itself by spraying different colored sludge on itself. The most skilled POKENAME cannot be detected by the human eye, but can be very easily identified by the human nose.

entry: POKENAME敌意强、力量又大，十分难驯。训练家若没做好准备，就可能被垃圾堆与毒泥淹没。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME is a hard-to-tame fusion thanks to its hostility and power. Unprepared Trainers find themselves buried under trash hoards and toxic sludge.

entry: 有人打趣说，这种融合体，不过是一个垃圾袋，封住了108股臭味。发怒时，还会散出有毒蒸气。
author: ohok3441
source: It has been joked that this fusion is 108 bad smells bound within a trash bag. It wafts toxic vapor in the air when angry.

entry: POKENAME与普通垃圾的联系，远不止物理层面。不用眼、耳、鼻，也能追到最适合添进身体的废物。
author: stevethebarbarian
source: POKENAME's connection to normal trash is more than physical. Without using sight, sound, or smell, it can track down pieces of garbage which are perfect to add to its body.

entry: POKENAME模样怪诞，吓到训练家与宝可梦。性情虽温和，许多个体却为迎合社会压力，故意装得更丑恶。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a grotesque appearance that scares Trainers and Pokémon alike. Despite their gentle inclinations, many play up their ugly appearance to conform to social pressure.

entry: 它们适应了人类大都市，吃小废物。POKENAME头角长成大垃圾箱的形状，方便保管以后吃的食物。
author: infinex21
source: These Pokémon have adapted to living within large, human cities where they feed off small refuse. The horn atop a POKENAME's head has taken the form of a dumpster to better secure food for it to eat later.

entry: POKENAME能在极咸、又受工业污染的水里生活得很好。它吃藻、霉与大垃圾，环境如此，几乎没对手争食。
author: anonymous_moose
source: POKENAME has the ability to thrive in water with very high salinity, as well as contamination from industrial pollutants. In these conditions, it faces little competition for food, as it consumes algae and mold, as well as larger pieces of trash.

entry: 吃过许多磁性碎片，让POKENAME周围总有无数废物盘旋，可最宝贝的收藏，却是一颗圆球。恶臭连多数毒属性宝可梦都能赶走。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are orbited by myriad junk due to all of the magnetic debris they have consumed, but their most prized possession is their globe. The stench of their bodies is enough to drive away even most Poison-type Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME躺下，就和垃圾山毫无分别。毒属性宝可梦可在背上安家，但若吃已并入身体的垃圾，就会被抖落。
author: .jerden
source: When POKENAME lies down to rest, it becomes indistinguishable from a mound of trash. Poison-type Pokémon may make their home on its back, but it will shake them off if they try to eat garbage that has become part of its body.

entry: POKENAME用能找到的最亮物品作武器。最爱武器若丢，便会极度愤怒。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME uses the shiniest objects it can find as weapons. It will be severely angered if it loses its weapon of choice.

entry: POKENAME守护垃圾场，也保护以垃圾为食的宝可梦。它允许人类献上垃圾，充实领地，却绝不容忍清理或在这里翻捡。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME acts as a guardian of trash dumps, and a protector of the trash-eating Pokémon. It will allow humans to make offerings of trash for its domain, but attempts to clean or scrounge from the area will not be tolerated.

entry: 它将杂垃圾做武器与甲胄战斗。装备看似粗陋，使用却熟练精准，比外表有效得多。
author: sk372
source: It battles using assorted bits of trash fashioned into weapons and armor. Despite the shoddy appearance of its weaponry, it wields them with skill and precision in battle, making them far more effective than they seem.

entry: POKENAME占整座废铁堆，凶猛赶走竞争者。翻找新金属，啃到化成铁锈。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME lay claim to entire scrapheaps, aggressively driving off competition. They dig through piles of scrap in search of fresh metal, which they chew until it breaks down into rust.

entry: POKENAME住在重度污染的湖泊，靠吃废物、垃圾清理水域。可越吸收污染，优雅的身体越带上杂物的特征，让人们反而厌弃这位栖地救星。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME inhabits heavily polluted lakes, cleaning them by feeding on the refuse and garbage. As it consumes the pollution, its graceful body takes on additional aspects of the detritus, in turn causing people to be repulsed by the habitat savior.

entry: POKENAME飞过各地时，构成身体的垃圾会滴落、掉下。它得时常停在垃圾场大吃，补回流失的体重。
author: sk372
source: Some of the garbage comprising POKENAME's body drips and falls off of it as it soars across the region. It needs to regularly stop and feast on trash dumps in order to regain some of its lost mass.

entry: POKENAME性情十分平和，可浑身恶臭，又不断冒气，谁也不敢靠近。在它们身旁必须一直戴着手套，因为哪怕轻轻碰一下，毒素也会渗进皮肤。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME are very peaceful creatures, yet no person ever dares to go near them due to how foul-smelling and gassy they are. Gloves must be worn at all times when around POKENAME since even a slight touch causes toxins to seep through the skin.

entry: POKENAME领地里的每块废物，都算王国一部分。它不停收弃物，认定每件本就属于自己的收藏。
author: ilija09
source: Every scrap within its territory is considered part of POKENAME's kingdom. It relentlessly collects discarded objects, convinced that every piece rightfully belongs to its hoard.

entry: POKENAME所到处生暖风，加快腐败，身边总有热垃圾的臭味。
author: .jerden
source: Wherever POKENAME goes, it creates warm air that accelerates decomposition. It is constantly accompanied by the stench of hot garbage.

entry: POKENAME所到处生暖风，加快腐败，身边总有热垃圾的臭味。
author: .jerden
source: Wherever POKENAME goes, it creates warm air that accelerates decomposition. It is constantly accompanied by the stench of hot garbage.

entry: POKENAME能开传送门，召来毁坏的世界的碎屑轰敌。那些明明看得出是垃圾，却与此世任何东西都不同。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME can open portals to bombard opponents with debris from the Distortion World. Although clearly recognisable as trash, it is unlike anything from this world.

entry: POKENAME住在填埋场，受扰就从右臂喷毒气，击昏人们。昏睡中会梦见吃臭垃圾，噩梦仿佛正是它的日常。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME lives in landfills, and if disturbed will release puffs of toxic gas from its right arm to knock people out. While they sleep, they will dream of eating foul garbage, a nightmare that seems to represent POKENAME's everyday experience.

entry: POKENAME吃垃圾，分解成毒泥，用背炮发射。什么靠太近，就用钢牙与外露钢筋爪攻击。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME devours garbage, breaking it down into a poisonous sludge that it fires out of the cannon on its back. If anything gets close, POKENAME will attack with its steel teeth and claws made of exposed rebar.

entry: POKENAME以机械效率巡逻废铁堆，垃圾桶炮发射高度压缩的腐蚀毒废物块。浓雾里仍能追目标，远射高速垃圾弹。
author: msdawgs
source: POKENAME patrols scrap heaps with mechanical efficiency, utilizing its trash-can cannon to launch highly compressed blocks of corrosive toxic waste. It tracks its targets through dense smog, firing off high-velocity garbage bombs from long range.

entry: POKENAME的白烟，来自体内燃烧的废物。燃烧时，火焰会清除污染物，因此产生的烟，竟颇为宜人。有些人会请它们帮忙清理垃圾。
author: infinex21
source: The white smoke of a POKENAME comes from burning refuse within its body. Its flames remove pollutants in the process, and the resulting smoke is surprisingly pleasant. Some humans use them to help clean up garbage.

entry: POKENAME吃垃圾里的旧食物，保留霉孢子，留待防身。尾上垃圾桶，阻止最毒的孢子不断散进空气。
author: bacondlx
source: POKENAME eats old food from the trash, saving any mold spores it finds to be released later as a defense mechanism. The trash can covering its tail prevents the worst of its toxic spores from constantly spreading into the air around it.

entry: POKENAME常游荡城市，沿路吸微塑料。净水厂常用它协助处理饮用水。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are often found roaming cities, absorbing microplastics into their bodies wherever they go. They are commonly used at water purification plants, where they help treat drinking water.

entry: POKENAME在城镇周围巡游，用长吸嘴吸走垃圾。它们从不需要清空体内，因为所有垃圾都会分解成恶臭的毒气，从头部排出。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME patrol around human towns and cities, hoovering up trash with their long nozzle. They never need to be emptied, as they break it all down into a foul-smelling toxic gas that they vent out of their head.

entry: POKENAME由随机杂垃圾紧密压成独特身体。亚音速飞行，随意掉下大残骸，落在下方一切之上。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME's body is made up of random assortments of rubbish, densely packed to give it its unique shape. It flies at subsonic speeds, randomly dropping large chunks of debris on whatever happens to be below.

entry: POKENAME不停吃垃圾，为燃烧多尾供能。饮食若维持不住，可能被火烧得一干二净。
author: bagumbothimble
source: Constantly absorbing garbage to fuel its fiery tails, POKENAME are at risk of being fully consumed by the fire if it lacks a sustainable diet.

entry: 齿轮般的内脏旋转，让毒气从排口涌出。主要吃金属，最爱却是橡胶轮胎。
author: cait_sith
source: The rotation of its gear-like innards causes noxious gas to spew out of its vents. Although it mainly eats metal, its favorite food is rubber tires.

entry: POKENAME从尾部喷出剧毒气体，若不处理，就会聚成浓厚的毒云。这种气体还极易燃烧，小小一点余烬，便足以让毒云变成猛烈的火海。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME sprays a highly toxic gas out of its tail that forms a dense cloud of poison if not dealt with. This gas is also highly flammable, a simple ember capable of turning the cloud into an intense inferno.

entry: POKENAME住脏地方，啃电池吸电，增强自身电力。
author: hophoppip
