source: POKENAME dwells in filthy places. It chews on batteries to drain their charge and power up its own electricity.

entry: POKENAME吃化学废物，住填埋场等污秽地带。会撒毒菱护身。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME lives in landfills and other filthy areas as it sustains itself on chemical waste. It scatters Toxic Spikes around to protect itself.

entry: POKENAME藏填埋场，先毒气削弱猎物再攻击。常猎鼠类宝可梦与热带龙的融合体，科学家还记录过它与寻找垃圾的自爆瓦斯相遇。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME hide in landfills, using poisonous gas to weaken their prey before attacking. They often hunt for Ratpius, and scientists have recorded encounters between POKENAME and Magnezing that are in search of trash.

entry: POKENAME在城市垃圾场等废物密集处形成，尽量将垃圾收进身体。污染特别严重，便可能长成庞然大物。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME form within city dumps and other similar areas with high densities of waste and refuse. They gather as much waste into their bodies as they can, and particularly bad instances of pollution can result in gargantuan POKENAME.

entry: 它追着垃圾运输船撞，直到船沉。若不阻止，单是一只POKENAME，就能让整座港口无法居住。
author: staghorn
source: It hunts down garbage-carrying boats and rams them until they sink. Even a single POKENAME can render a harbor uninhabitable if left unchecked.

entry: POKENAME吃废物长大，肢端与嘴的臭味也增强。却像孩子般爱游戏、恶作剧，让许多人头疼。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME body grows as it eats waste, as does the pungent odor emanating from the ends of its limbs and from its mouth. It displays a childlike love for games and tricks, to the chagrin of many people.

entry: POKENAME出没于大城市下水道，用力量防植物与根堵排水管。
author: empathnaga
source: POKENAME can be found in the sewer systems under large cities. They use their powers to keep plants and roots from clogging drainage pipes.

entry: POKENAME身体产生的浓渗滤液，夏季排出间隔更长。它用来裹身，防止干燥。
author: .izik
source: The thick leachate POKENAME's body produces comes out at greater intervals during the summer months. It uses this to coat itself and prevent drying out.

entry: POKENAME垃圾身体压得如石坚硬。捡山中旅人的弃物，进一步加固废物甲胄。
author: sk372
source: The garbage comprising POKENAME's body is so tightly compacted as to be as solid as stone. It picks up discarded litter from mountain travelers, using the trash to further strengthen its armor of refuse.

entry: POKENAME偷来垃圾桶盖，保护身体内部。后来黏得太牢，索性站在桶盖边缘，把它当轮子滚。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME has stolen a dustbin lid to protect its insides. It is now so firmly stuck to it that it can stand on the edge and use it as a wheel.

entry: POKENAME外表气味虽差，却是很有本事的垃圾处理专家。它带一群较小的破破仙人掌，合收领地废物，再饱餐一顿，庆祝一天的工作成果。
author: _pixelar_
source: Despite their appearance and odor, POKENAME are very competent waste management experts. They gather a group of smaller Trubnea around and together they gather litter in their territory. They celebrate a good day's work by feasting on the litter.

entry: POKENAME在小巷、垃圾堆附近，用尾收废物，补身体。材质虽脏，毛却依然柔软，摸着安心。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: POKENAME hang around alleyways and garbage piles, gathering rubbish with their tails to replenish their bodies. Despite the components, their fur still feels very soft and comforting.

entry: POKENAME的音乐不合所有人口味，充满杂乱尖叫与金属撞击。常出现在拥挤音乐会和地下夜店。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's style of music isn't for everyone, composed of erratic screaming and clanging metal. It tends to appear at crowded concerts and underground nightclubs.

entry: POKENAME体内蘑菇能分解垃圾，却似乎逼它找特定养分。常花几小时翻垃圾，挖出尤其刺鼻的废物。
author: .jerden
source: The mushrooms growing inside POKENAME's body can break down garbage, but seem to compel it to seek out highly specific nutrients. POKENAME will spend hours digging in trash heaps to unearth particularly pungent waste.

entry: POKENAME用金属罐片装饰身体。一摇，罐碰罐，声音强大得令人入迷。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME decorates its body with pieces of metal cans. When it shakes, its cans clank together, producing a powerful and mesmerizing sound.

entry: POKENAME背上重垃圾，被菌丝网络慢慢消化，化成满孢子的浓胶。只有要再往背堆加垃圾，才肯动。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's back carries a heavy load of garbage, which is slowly digested by a network of fungal mycelium, forming a thick slime filled with spores. POKENAME will only move to absorb more garbage into the heap on its back.

entry: POKENAME周围苍蝇有时聚成怪形。它读这些形状，占卜未来。
author: hophoppip
source: The flies that congregate around POKENAME form strange shapes at times. POKENAME reads these shapes to divine the future.

entry: POKENAME舞越多，汗越多。臭汗，连一英里外的鼻孔也能灼伤。
author: gronkissimo
source: The more a POKENAME dances, the more it sweats. Its sweat smells foul, and can burn nostrils up to a mile away.

entry: POKENAME多住垃圾场，靠弃食维生。人们试过家养，可大多数都受不了恶臭。
author: bostroms
source: POKENAME mostly live in garbage dumps and survive on food that has been thrown away.  People have tried domesticating them, but most cannot stand the awful smell.

entry: POKENAME厌恶乱扔垃圾，或丢弃完好物品的人。它们收集找到的每一件垃圾，用来壮大拳头，决心向丢弃者报仇。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME despise people who litter or throw away perfectly good items. They gather any piece of trash they find and use it to build up their fists, determined to get vengeance on the one that discarded the item.

entry: POKENAME长途飞行，找垃圾山占领。体内焚垃圾生火，尾喷火流，驱逐竞争者。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME will fly long distances in search of trash heaps to claim. It drives off any competitors with blasts of fire from its tail, generated by the burning garbage inside its body.

entry: POKENAME在胃里发酵垃圾，产易燃气。右臂释放时点燃，既攻敌，也能飞行加速。
author: .jerden
source: Inside its stomach, POKENAME ferments trash to produce flammable gasses. It can ignite these as it releases them from its right arm, using this as a weapon to attack, or as additional propulsion when flying.

entry: 它在海里游，找漂垃圾。鼻口吸管喷污水，赶走上方袭来的天敌。
author: .jerden
source: It swims in the ocean, hunting for floating trash. The straw in its snout sprays jets of filthy water to drive off any predators that attack from above.

entry: POKENAME无目的地漂海，找到垃圾就添身体。污染重的城市，常投放到水道，清走废物，恢复洁净安全。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME float aimlessly in oceans, adding any trash they find to their body. Cities suffering from large amounts of pollution often deploy POKENAME in their local waterways to clean the trash, leaving them clean and safe to use.

entry: 野生POKENAME在垃圾与杂物中打滚，只要没有掉落，这些东西最终都会被吸入体内。每年，它们都必须蜕去一部分垃圾般的身体，免得长得太大，无法移动。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME roll around in trash and other debris, which is all eventually absorbed into their bodies if they do not fall off. Once a year, they must shed some of their garbage-like bodies so that they do not grow so large that they cannot move.

entry: POKENAME吃垃圾供能，因此在填埋场长得好。全速奔上垃圾山，也毫不吃力。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME grazes on trash to fuel its body. It thrives in landfills for this reason and has no issue galloping up the garbage heaps at full speed.

entry: POKENAME始终有焚垃圾的臭味。风一吹，能传好几英里。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME reeks of burning garbage at all times. When the wind blows, the smell can spread for miles.

entry: 它由垃圾构成，最常出没在有毒物质被丢弃的地方。
author: hophoppip
source: Its body is comprised of garbage. This fusion is most often found in places where toxic substances were discarded.

entry: POKENAME住拥挤城市，尤其爱垃圾遍地的地带。将废物堆在集中处，有时用超能力，悄悄劝旁人来帮忙。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are found in crowded cities, especially those plagued by littering. They pile trash in central areas and sometimes use psychic abilities to subtly encourage others to help.

entry: 它爱捡巢边海滩垃圾。有些POKENAME被迁至海洋垃圾带，能长到40英尺高。
author: bandedbodypress
source: It loves picking up trash off the beaches near its nest. They have been relocated to trash patches in the ocean, where POKENAME can grow up to 40 feet tall.

entry: POKENAME唾液有能中和、分解塑料的毒。把海岸垃圾拖回洞，改作甲胄或诱饵。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME's saliva contains toxins that can neutralize and disintegrate plastics. It drags heaps of coastal garbage into burrows to repurpose them into armor or bait.

entry: POKENAME游到海滩，吃尽冲来的垃圾。背炮则高压泵出污水。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME swims to beaches to devour any trash that washes up. The cannons on its back pump out contaminated water at high pressure.

entry: POKENAME成群在河口三角洲岸上晒太阳，等着围扑呆呆兽等没戒心的猎物。栖地若变恶劣，背上泡泡能让它短暂上陆。
author: pjporwoll
source: Packs of POKENAME sun themselves on the shores of river deltas, waiting to swarm unaware prey like Slowpoke. The bubble on its back allows it to travel on land for a short amount of time if its habitat becomes inhospitable.

entry: POKENAME单只弱，便大群生活捕猎。小牙能撕开强度不高的金属与实心木材，还会袭物资商队取食，显出这本领。
author: infinex21
source: Because they are individually weak, POKENAME live and hunt in large swarms. Their small fangs are strong enough for them to tear through weak metal and solid wood; they demonstrate this by targeting supply caravans for their food.

entry: POKENAME常在沙滩与入海河旁，却容易被水流带走。脾气爆烈，受刺激就弹向源头，凶狠撕咬。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are commonly spotted along beaches and aside ocean-leading rivers, though they are easily carried away by the currents. They have explosive tempers and will launch themselves at the source of their agitation and then viciously bite it.

entry: 野生POKENAME壳坚如铁板，将自己射向猎物与闯领地船只。虽如导弹般使用，常受小伤，却也越长越强。
author: infinex21
source: With shells as hard as iron slabs, wild POKENAME launch themselves at prey and at ships trespassing through their territory. Though they sustain many minor injuries by using themselves like missiles, they continuously grow stronger as well.

entry: POKENAME在体内储水，从大孔喷出，推动自己穿空，追赶逃上陆地的猎物。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME stores water within its body, which it can shoot out from its many large pores. It uses this to propel itself through the air to chase after prey that escapes onto land.

entry: POKENAME在咸水里与许多伙伴共游，防大宝可梦袭击。毒咬危险，人们看见一只，通常就离水。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME swims with many companions in saltwater to prevent larger Pokémon from attacking them. People usually leave the water when they spot even just one, as its bite is poisonous.

entry: POKENAME以无底胃口和凶暴脾气恶名远扬。闯领地者，都会遭不顾一切的猛攻，常连自己家也毁了，只得搬走。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are infamously known for their insatiable appetites and ferocious tempers. They lash out at anything that enters their territory with such reckless abandon that they often destroy their own home and force themselves to have to relocate.

entry: POKENAME临蜕皮，胃口大增，几秒就吞一餐，爆出能量，抖落多余外皮。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's appetite increases dramatically when it is time for it to shed its skin. It devours a meal in seconds to give itself the burst of energy needed to shake off the excess layer.

entry: 它爱用超能力泡泡装海水消遣。若宝可梦不慎弄破，POKENAME便暴怒扑咬。
author: fiordaliso
source: It enjoys trapping seawater inside its psychic bubbles to pass the time. If a Pokémon accidentally pops them, POKENAME flies into a rage and pounces on its victim with ferocity.

entry: POKENAME聚得越多，越爱咬。群体够大，就疯狂啃咬，几分钟能撕开一栋高楼。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's propensity for biting things increases the more of them are together. A sufficiently sized group will go into a gnashing frenzy, capable of tearing a high-rise building apart in minutes.

entry: POKENAME至少二十只结群，在海上环礁筑巢。很少攻击人，宁可留体力捕猎。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME tends to nest on sea atolls alongside its group of at least twenty individuals. It rarely attacks humans, preferring to save its energy for hunting prey.

entry: POKENAME结成小群，合力击倒大型猎物，可目标一倒下，团结也就荡然无存。个个贪食，只顾尽可能多吃，开饭时便成了一场混战。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME operate in small packs to take down larger prey, but once the target is felled, all group cohesion is lost. Ravenous greed compels them to try and eat as much as they can for themselves, turning mealtime into a free-for-all.

entry: POKENAME能把电转为养分，一饿便咬任何够得到的电器。通常与不少伙伴，住在大水域附近。
author: fiordaliso
source: When hungry, it bites into any electronic device it can reach, as POKENAME converts electricity into nourishment for its body. It usually lives near large bodies of water alongside a sizeable group of companions.

entry: POKENAME成长中，战力还在发育。鳞壳保护身体，轻碰也痛得厉害，曾在丛林深处的流水旁被发现。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's strength in battle is still developing as it physically matures, but it is protected by a scaly outer shell that hurts tremendously just to touch. It has been spotted deep in the jungle by flowing rivers.

entry: POKENAME成长中，战力还在发育。鳞壳保护身体，轻碰也痛得厉害，曾在丛林深处的流水旁被发现。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's strength in battle is still developing as it physically matures, but it is protected by a scaly outer shell that hurts tremendously just to touch. It has been spotted deep in the jungle by flowing rivers.

entry: 它淘气地啃咬停泊船只的锚链，让船挣脱束缚、漂向大海，以此取乐。POKENAME泳技高超，尾巴的形状让它能游得飞快。
author: fiordaliso
source: It mischievously gnaws at the anchor chains of docked ships to free the boats and have fun sending them out to sea. POKENAME is an expert swimmer, capable of moving at great speed thanks to the shape of its tail.

entry: POKENAME战中淘气，以尾嘴转移注意，从意外角度攻敌。智力高，需要大量活动刺激，不适合想省心的训练家。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME are very mischievous in combat, utilizing the maw on their tail to misdirect attention and attack opponents from unexpected angles. They require a lot of stimulation due to their intelligence, making them poor Pokémon for casual Trainers.

entry: POKENAME常游在热带河流的表面，背上植物散出甜香，诱来鸟类和虫类宝可梦，供自己捕食。潜水时，植物会合紧双颚，因为吸水太多，会让动作迟缓。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is often found swimming at the surface of tropical rivers, the plant on its back exuding a sweet scent to attract bird and bug Pokémon for a meal. When it dives, the plant clamps its jaws shut as overconsumption of water makes it sluggish.

entry: POKENAME小嘴迅速啃树、岩等材料，却几乎从不咬活物。咬痕呈怪符号，意义未知，也许本就没有。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's small mouth rapidly gnaws into trees, rocks and other materials, rarely if ever biting at organic creatures. The gashes it leaves behind in what it eats take the form of strange symbols of unknown meaning, if any.

entry: 它强壮却不聪明，常咬断钓线鱼饵，自己毫无察觉。迷信水手远看，以为POKENAME是美人鱼，游近看脸，才失望。
author: milchik
source: This strong but not very clever Pokémon often rips the lures off fishing lines without even noticing. From afar, superstitious sailors often mistake POKENAME for a mermaid, until they swim closer and, to their disappointment, see its face.

entry: POKENAME无聊就与同群伙伴袭港内停船。极其顽强，猛烈海风暴也能飞过。
author: fiordaliso
source: When bored, POKENAME assaults ships moored in harbors alongside the rest of its flock. It is an extremely tenacious Pokémon, able to fly even through violent sea storms.

entry: POKENAME双钳迅速开合，又利又强，几秒能撕裂目标。野外对手更凶残，互撕对方肉块，争夺优势。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's pincers clamp down at a rapid pace, their sharpness and strength allowing them to tear a target apart in seconds. Rivalries in the wild are particularly vicious as two POKENAME try to rend chunks off their rival to establish dominance.

entry: POKENAME将钩爪钉进船体，攀上船。一群配合，最完好的船也能弄沉。
author: wormspawn
source: POKENAME scales ships by punching its hooked claws into the hulls. A swarm working in concert can sink even the most shipshape vessel.

entry: 这些利齿宝可梦常成群，发热的身体令周围大幅升温。看似凶狠，可单独对敌就会逃走。
author: beandrawsthings
source: A sharp-toothed Pokémon usually found in swarms, their hot bodies significantly raise the temperature in an area. Though they appear vicious, they will flee when confronted one-on-one.

entry: 它与族群沿海岸疾驰，凭猎犬般敏锐的嗅觉，追猎一切会动的东西。双颚强如液压机，一旦咬住，就绝不松口。
author: fiordaliso
source: It races along the coastline with its pack, hunting anything that moves by relying on its powerful hound-like sense of smell. Once it clamps down with jaws as strong as a hydraulic press, it refuses to let go.

entry: POKENAME嚎一声，整帮就赶来，片刻围住猎物。咬击致命，到海边遇上它，极其危险。
author: fiordaliso
source: With a single howl, POKENAME can summon its entire gang, surrounding prey within moments. Its bite is lethal, and encountering this Pokémon while visiting the seaside is considered extremely dangerous.

entry: 盘身满是锐鳞，能挡更大天敌。捕猎时，POKENAME通过毒牙，向受害者注入强毒。
author: fiordaliso
source: The scales covering its coils are sharp, helping to keep predators larger than itself at bay. When hunting, POKENAME injects a very powerful toxin into its victims through its fangs.

entry: POKENAME用利牙，从所在电脑实实在在撕出病毒。一群只需一天，便能清掉感染整栋办公楼的电脑病毒。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME use their sharp fangs to physically tear out viruses from the computers they're inside of. A swarm of them can clear out a computer virus that has infected an entire office building in one day.

entry: 蛇形身体，连最窄水下洞都钻得进。人若在浪里见POKENAME，就怕毒咬，赶紧逃出水。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its serpentine body can squeeze its way into even the narrowest underwater caves. If people spot POKENAME in the waves, they flee from the water, fearing its poisonous bite.

entry: 沙漠旅人常称POKENAME为“沙中祸害”。性情凶悍，几乎能游过沙子，袭旅人抢物资，再吃掉。
author: infinex21
source: Commonly referred to as the "Vermin of the Sands" by desert travelers, POKENAME are aggressive Pokémon that effectively swim through the sands. They typically attack travelers in an effort to steal, and consume, their supplies.

entry: POKENAME游过网络论坛，找词语咬。每只都被不同字母、字符组合吸引，胃口欲求显得极随机。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME swims through online forums in search of words to bite. Each individual is attracted to different letters and character combinations, making its appetite and desires appear extremely random.

entry: POKENAME橡胶般的透明尾能储水，方便陆上探索捕猎。水快耗尽，尾就萎缩，只得赶到有水处恢复。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME store water within their rubbery, transparent tails so they can explore and hunt on land. When they run low on stored water, their tails shrivel, and they quickly flee to any water to recuperate.

entry: POKENAME至少五只结群生活、捕猎，臂上锐鳍快速出击。尾能储水，因此也常在岸边狩猎。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME live and hunt in packs of at least five individuals, delivering quick attacks with the sharp fins on their arms. Because they can store water within their tails, they often hunt near shores as well.

entry: POKENAME用强健的双腿蹬向周围岩石，推动自己在水中前行。它们以鳍控制方向，成群围攻同一个目标，将其击倒。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME use their powerful legs to kick off surrounding rocks to propel themselves through the water. Using their fins to control their direction, groups of these Pokémon will attack a single target to take it down.

entry: 最大POKENAME群在咸水，可淡水也发现过小得多的群体。动作快、毫不留情，围住猎物凶狠连咬。
author: infinex21
source: Although the largest schools of POKENAME are found within saltwater, some much smaller schools have been discovered in freshwater. They are quick and merciless predators who will swarm and assail prey with many vicious bites.

entry: POKENAME住在较大、较深的沼泽，游在厚泥里。一感到有生物陷泥，便饥饿发狂，冲去攻击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME inhabits larger and deeper swamps, swimming around deep in the muck. Once it senses another creature stuck in the muck, it goes into a hungry frenzy and attacks.

entry: 猎物靠近池塘，POKENAME便兴奋振鳍。够近就扑出，双颚夹住，拖进水里。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's fins vibrate with excitement when prey draws close to its pond. It lunges out when they get near enough, clamping on with its jaws and dragging them into the water.

entry: POKENAME用超能力感知周围，专挑性情最怯懦的对象下口。因为它自己也意志薄弱，不敢招惹任何可能反抗的家伙。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses its psychic senses to locate those around it with the meekest demeanor to bite. It seeks them out specifically because it is itself too weak-willed to go after anything that might fight back.

entry: POKENAME很容易吃得疯狂，长舌抓到什么能吃的，都用强颚啃。此时体色，也随正在啃的东西变化。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME easily goes into a feeding frenzy, grabbing anything edible with its tongue and gnashing it with its strong jaws. During this frenzy, its color changes to match whatever it is currently chomping down on.

entry: POKENAME是淡水鱼宝可梦，能在水里完美伪装。只等猎物够近，才突进咬住。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are freshwater fish Pokémon that can perfectly camouflage themselves within the water. They only move when potential prey draws near enough, lunging toward them and attempting to bite down on them.

entry: 什么靠近，POKENAME就从石里现身，凶狠咬牙切齿。它们总被驱使着，慢慢找同类结群，方便捕猎。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME viciously responds to anything coming near it by emerging from its stone and gnashing its teeth. POKENAME are compelled to slowly seek out others of their kind to form schools to more easily take down prey.

entry: POKENAME背上碗状花能储水，在陆上射出削弱对方的水流。水下则游到大猎物下方，用植物造漩涡，困住没防备的目标。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME can store water in the bowl-shaped flower on its back, which it uses to fire debilitating water blasts on land. In the water, it will swim below large prey and use the plant to create a whirlpool, entrapping the unprepared catch.

entry: POKENAME在洞中水道，用漂来物测试咬力。牙若断，几天便长回。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME tests its bite strength on objects floating through cave waterways. Should a tooth break off, a new one grows back within a matter of days.

entry: POKENAME通常结群，强爪与坚颚撕开拦路一切。若与群体分离，就迅速逃离比自己大的敌人。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME typically hunt in packs, using their tough claws and strong jaws to shred through anything that gets in their way. When separated, POKENAME quickly scurry away from any foes larger than themselves.

entry: 沙滩战中，POKENAME强尾能向敌人掀巨浪，卷去盐水与沙。锯齿锐牙，留下的咬伤很难愈合。
author: fiordaliso
source: With its powerful tail POKENAME can hurl huge waves of salt water and sand at its foes during beach battles. Its sharp, serrated teeth make its bites hard to heal.

entry: POKENAME总在飓风来临前现身，因此许多水手，至今仍相信它是带来厄运的生灵。它通常在大洋深处的偏僻环礁安家，避免接触人类。
author: fiordaliso
source: Many sailors still believe that POKENAME is an ill-omened creature, since it appears just before a hurricane strikes. It tends to make its home on isolated atolls in the middle of the ocean to avoid contact with humans.

entry: 皮肤能察觉极微弱的振动，让POKENAME在漆黑海底，也能发现数千米深处的猎物。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME senses even the faintest vibrations through its skin. This enables it to detect prey many thousands of meters deep in the pitch-black ocean.

entry: POKENAME虽未全进化，脾气却火暴，外来者太近就咬。毒刺与锯齿角，能击退更大、更强的入侵者。
author: fiordaliso
source: Though not yet fully evolved, POKENAME shows a fiery disposition, snapping at outsiders who approach too closely. Its frame is armored with poisonous spikes and jagged horns that let it repel intruders larger and stronger than itself.

entry: POKENAME虽小，泳速可达每小时10英里。结群从多方向精密配合，冲击目标。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: Despite their small size, POKENAME can reach swimming speeds of 10 miles per hour. They hunt as a group, rushing targets from multiple directions in carefully coordinated attacks.

entry: POKENAME用大颚碎冰测咬力。在极地，就不停游海，找最大的冰块咬。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME crushes ice in its large jaws to test its bite strength. In polar environments, it constantly swims through the seas searching for the largest ice to bite.

entry: POKENAME鳍肢腹面有一组尖牙状突起。通过拍击同类、留下伤痕，展示优势，确立群中地位高低。
author: sk372
source: The underside of POKENAME's flippers have a set of sharp fang-like protrusions. Slapping and scarring others is an act of dominance over another POKENAME, an attempt to establish a pecking order among the group.

entry: POKENAME会连续几周追逐敢穿海上领地的水手。幽灵般的罩幕定住敌人，令人无从抵御锯齿利刃。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME pursues sailors who dare navigate through its ocean territory for weeks on end. It uses its spectral shroud to hold enemies in place, leaving them defenseless against the strikes of its sharp, serrated blade.

entry: 谁敢近领地，它就顶着毒角冲过去。对闯入者无情，对同类却亲切，任幼崽玩口中吹的泡泡。
author: fiordaliso
source: It attacks anyone who dares approach its territory, charging forward with its horn coated in venom. Though ruthless toward intruders, it shows great affection to its own kind, letting the young ones play with the bubbles it blows from its mouth.

entry: POKENAME是强悍的捕食者，会与族群一同沿岸捕猎。它用强大的双颚发出致命一击，往往轻松就能解决猎物。体型最大的一只，被公认为首领。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is a formidable predator that hunts along the shores in the company of its pack. It uses its powerful jaws to deliver lethal blows, often finishing off its prey with ease. The largest specimen is recognized as the leader of the group.

entry: POKENAME是利牙多拉鱼群罕见的领袖，常守着挖出的水下洞。爪牙硬得能撕金属，保护住处与利牙多拉群。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are the rarely-seen leaders of Caron schools that tend to stay and guard the underwater caves that they dig out. Their claws and fangs are often tough enough to tear through metal, which they use to defend their homes and schools of Caron.

entry: POKENAME耐心藏水下裂隙，等猎物游近。若见更强的宝可梦，就迅速缩回洞。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME patiently hides in underwater crevices as it waits for prey to swim close. When it sees a stronger Pokémon, it quickly retreats into these holes.

entry: POKENAME游过咸淡水，放出舒缓气场，安抚附近生物，趁机近身咬猎物。
author: .izik
source: While swimming through brackish waters, POKENAME releases an aura that soothes those nearby. It uses this opportunity to swim close to prey before taking a bite.

entry: POKENAME领地意识极强，靠蛮力赶走过于接近海岸巢穴的船只。巨尾猛砸地面时，震动足以引发猛烈地震。
author: fiordaliso
source: Highly territorial, POKENAME uses its sheer brute strength to drive away ships that venture too close to its coastal den. When it slams its massive tail against the ground, it can shake the earth with enough force to trigger violent quakes.

entry: POKENAME的鳞片极其粗糙，碰上坚硬的岩石也能将其刮损，撞上船只则会损伤船体。它们通常捕猎成大群的小型宝可梦，每餐都会整只吞下许多。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME have incredibly rough scales that are capable of grating solid rock and damaging ship hulls if they collide against either. They typically hunt down large schools of small Pokémon, swallowing many of them whole per meal.

entry: POKENAME的双颚能咬穿船身，强健的双腿，无论在陆地还是水下，都能让它高速弹出。越久没接触水，它的力量就越衰弱。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME have jaws powerful enough to tear a hole in a ship's hull and use their strong legs on land or underwater to launch themselves at high speeds. Their strength fades the longer they go without water exposure.

entry: POKENAME的毛短而硬，形成流线形的身体，让它能快速游动。它呈鱼雷般的姿态穿水而行时，后方的九片鳍能帮助保持稳定。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME fur is short and stiff, creating a streamlined shape that allows them to swim rapidly through the water. Their nine fins at the back of their body keep them stable as they assume a torpedo shape to swim through the water.

entry: POKENAME精力充沛，能整夜不停游。哪只闻到恐惧，就叫同类，一拥而上围攻。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME are full of energy, and can swim for an entire night without stopping. When one POKENAME smells fear, it will find others to gang up on its victim in a swarm.

entry: 它们的信息素，能让附近生物困倦。POKENAME起初看着懒，等敌人或猎物中招，才凶猛出击。
author: infinex21
source: The pheromones exuded by these Pokémon effectively induce drowsiness within others near them. Though POKENAME initially appear to laze around, they will viciously lash out when their prey or foes succumb to their pheromones.

entry: POKENAME能张大颚，吞下比自己还大的猎物。不过，它只挑那些无法从体内伤害自己的目标。
author: staghorn
source: POKENAME can stretch its jaws and consume prey larger than its body. It only targets prey that is incapable of damaging it from within.

entry: POKENAME陆上相当慢，水里却快得惊人，石牙连咬坚石也承受得住。最多10只结群，能迅速制服更大的宝可梦。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are considerably slow on land but stunningly quick in water, with rock-solid fangs that can withstand biting solid rock. POKENAME hunt in schools of up to 10 capable of taking down other Pokémon larger than themselves rather swiftly.

entry: POKENAME不停啃岩崖硬边，增强颚力。在暖海岸筑巢，群体相当大。
author: fiordaliso
source: To strengthen its jaws, POKENAME constantly chews on the hard edges of rocky cliffs. It lives in fairly large groups and builds its den along the coasts of warm seas.

entry: POKENAME不停啃岩崖硬边，增强颚力。在暖海岸筑巢，群体相当大。
author: fiordaliso
source: To strengthen its jaws, POKENAME constantly chews on the hard edges of rocky cliffs. It lives in fairly large groups and builds its den along the coasts of warm seas.

entry: POKENAME双颚随齿轮转动，按拍咬合。若闻到受伤猎物，齿轮全速疯转，嘴也急咬，准备撕开下一餐。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's jaws gnash in time with the rotation of its gears. Should it sniff wounded prey, the gears go into overdrive and its mouths chomp at an extremely rapid pace, ready to tear its prospective meal apart.

entry: POKENAME游时让花浮在水面，用植物双颚捕住蚊香蛙皇等没戒心的猎物。植物与本体各有胃，必须共享食物，才能同步生长。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME swims with its flower on the surface of the water to catch unsuspecting prey like Politoed in the jaws of the plant. The plant and body have different stomachs, so they have to share food to grow in synchronicity.

entry: POKENAME游时让花浮在水面，用植物双颚捕住蚊香蛙皇等没戒心的猎物。植物与本体各有胃，必须共享食物，才能同步生长。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME swims with its flower on the surface of the water to catch unsuspecting prey like Politoed in the jaws of the plant. The plant and body have different stomachs, so they have to share food to grow in synchronicity.

entry: POKENAME大半生在海水里，体内火焰却令鳞温暖。暴怒时，鼻孔喷出小团蒸汽。
author: fiordaliso
source: Though POKENAME spends most of its life in seawater, its scales remain warm from the fire burning within. When enraged, it snorts small clouds of steam from its nostrils.

entry: POKENAME若把细绳缠上船桅，就必须立即移走。若任由它留下，其他POKENAME便会聚来，很快将整艘船撕得粉碎。
author: periperi_chicken
source: If a POKENAME wraps its string around the mast of a boat, it needs to be removed immediately. If allowed to stay, it will be joined by other POKENAME that will quickly tear the boat to shreds.

entry: POKENAME磨獠牙有群体反射，一只开始蹭树或岩，其余全本能照做，让每只的牙都完好锋利。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME groups reflexively sharpen their tusks as a whole; when one begins grinding against a rock or tree, they all instinctively do the same so every member has pristine and sharp tusks.

entry: POKENAME常在船体刻深痕，标示领地。水手自然不太喜欢。
author: stevethebarbarian
source: POKENAME often mark their territory by carving gashes into the hulls of ships. Naturally, sailors don't like them very much.

entry: POKENAME惯在浅水伏击，用利矛时，兴奋得令人不安。许多见过事后惨状的人，都谴责这混乱战法。
author: jaminmcready
source: Known for ambushing prey in shallow water, POKENAME uses its sharp spear with unsettling glee. Its chaotic fighting style is seen as reprehensible by many who encounter the aftermath.

entry: 这只POKENAME拥有整群鱼的力量与凶性，会率领小鱼群，贪婪地四处肆虐。
author: serversizeme
source: This POKENAME has the strength and aggression of a whole school. It will lead swarms of smaller fry on a voracious rampage.

entry: POKENAME用强颚放出巨响，在深湖下辨路。声波强得足以毁巨石。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME releases powerful bursts of noise from its strong jaws to navigate beneath deep lakes. These bursts are strong enough to destroy boulders.

entry: POKENAME以惊人速度滑向猎物，双颚咬住，猛烈摇晃。软身体却轻易吸收反击。
author: lordjoostmeister
source: Sliding toward prey with surprising speed, POKENAME latches onto them with its jaws and shakes them fiercely. Its soft body absorbs retaliatory blows with ease.

entry: POKENAME真起了兴致，便能成为水上船只的祸患。不过，它们往往提不起劲去攻击船只，也不被视为危险的宝可梦，更常被当作闹腾的宠物饲养。
author: dualblades1147
source: In the right mindset, POKENAME can be a scourge on ships on the water. However, they often lack enough motivation to attack the ships and are more commonly kept as rowdy pets, as they are not regarded as dangerous Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME是常见水下宝可梦，常懒卧河岸附近，也常成为蘑菇孢子的宿主。休息被打断，就凶狠咬向最近活物。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are a common species of underwater Pokémon that often laze about near along the shores of rivers, often becoming the hosts of mushroom spores. If disturbed from their rest, they will viciously bite at the nearest living thing.

entry: POKENAME成群移动，沉重脚步，数英里外都听得见。彩色颈褶先迷惑猎物，再全群一起攻。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: POKENAME move in herds, their heavy footsteps being heard from miles away. Their colourful frills are used to confuse prey before moving in to attack all together.

entry: POKENAME是水边凶猛的猎手，双颚迅如闪电，攻击极其猛烈。水面只露出头冠，游客游泳时得格外留意。
author: rakunk
source: POKENAME is a fierce predator found near bodies of water, known for its lightning-fast jaws and ferocious attacks. Only its crest is visible above the water surface, so tourists are advised to watch for it while swimming.

entry: 它住深海，沿海底滑行，找残食。装凶吓天敌，真被当面对上，却逃进窄缝。
author: bluenido.
source: Found dwelling at the depths of the ocean, it glides along the seafloor scouring for scraps. It feigns fierce aggressiveness to intimidate predators but flees into tight crevices if directly confronted.

entry: POKENAME能察觉岩石与宝石的裂缝、弱处。一发现附近石块受损，便急扑过去，强颚几秒吃尽。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is able to sense when stones and gems develop cracks and weaknesses. Once it detects a damaged rock in its vicinity, it quickly descends on it and devours it in seconds with its tough jaws.

entry: POKENAME一浸淡水，身上树皮便长得极厚，有时坚得如玉。
author: .izik
source: When submerged in freshwater, the bark on POKENAME's body grows incredibly thick. At times this bark can become as tough as jade.

entry: POKENAME落单时，会试着唤出同类或利牙鱼的幻象，给自己壮胆狩猎。水面闪着火光，是它们栖居的确凿迹象，船只最好避开这些区域。
author: notadoctor75
source: If POKENAME finds itself alone, it tries to channel the illusion of other POKENAME or Carvanha to give it the courage to hunt. Ships are advised to avoid any areas where they see flames flickering on the surface, a sure sign of their habitat.

entry: POKENAME常跃向停船，急着撕碎。速度快、咬力可怕，却很容易被船笛吓跑。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME often leap out at parked boats, eager to tear them to pieces. Despite their high speed and fearsome bite, they are easily spooked by a boat's horn.

entry: POKENAME躺浅水，耐心等下一餐。帆船一过上方，就被奇准鱼叉拖来，最后只剩漂浮残骸。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME lies in shallow water, patiently waiting for its next meal. Sailboats that pass overhead are reeled in with its remarkably accurate harpoon, leaving only drifting debris of the ship that once was.

entry: 过去，海盗用POKENAME偷宝藏。研究证实，它挥舞的铁炮鱼，并未遭它伤害。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: In the past, POKENAME were used by pirates to steal treasure. Studies confirm that the Remoraid they wield are not harmed by POKENAME.

entry: 它被音乐与舞蹈吸引，会召来一群POKENAME，闯进找到的任何聚会。接着，它们粗野打闹、打架、胡乱起舞，彻底毁掉派对。
author: notadoctor75
source: It is attracted to the sound of music and dancing, and will gather a pack of other POKENAME to go and invade any party it finds. They then engage in roughhousing, fights, and chaotic dancing, effectively ruining the party.

entry: 它咬力极强，最硬的石也能咬碎。暴怒时，鼻孔喷出小团蒸汽。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its bite is incredibly powerful, capable of shattering even the toughest stones. When enraged, it snorts small clouds of steam from its nostrils.

entry: POKENAME其实比外表胆小得多，便与同类巡岸水找食。伙伴遇险，会从颚里吐蓝焰，驱赶敌人。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME patrols coastal waters in search of food alongside others of its kind, as it's far more timid than it appears. When an ally is in danger, it spits bluish flames from its jaws to drive enemies away.

entry: 人们发现POKENAME很容易被巧克力打动。如今船上常多带几箱，丢下船，安抚鱼群，免其变凶。
author: sk372
source: It's been discovered that POKENAME are highly receptive to chocolate. Ships now often carry surplus containers to toss overboard and placate schools of POKENAME to keep them from becoming aggressive.

entry: POKENAME伏在地下，能感知上方泥土中的震动。它从下方打开地洞，让猎物跌入，随后三个头便一同疯狂啃食。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME lies in wait beneath the ground, able to sense the vibrations in the dirt above it. It attacks prey from underneath, opening a hole in the ground for the target to fall in before all three go into a gnashing feeding frenzy.

entry: POKENAME是敏捷水猎手，高速穿过丰缘海洋。胡须能感受其他宝可梦留下的水涡，远远追踪猎物。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are swift aquatic predators, able to swim at high speed through Hoenn's oceans. Their whiskers are sensitive and can pick up the eddies in the water left by other Pokémon, allowing them to track prey across great distances.

entry: POKENAME外表巨大可怕，实际极害羞，常飞在海上荒岛岸边。只有守领地才攻击，与同类作伴，才添信心。
author: fiordaliso
source: Despite its fearsome and massive appearance, POKENAME is a very shy Pokémon that usually soars over the coasts of deserted islands in the sea. It attacks only to defend its territory and gains confidence when in the company of others of its kind.

entry: POKENAME睡着仿佛浮在水里。若被吵醒，就咬住反击，或瞬间移动换地方。极少也会移上船抢食物。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are often seemingly floating in water as they sleep. If a POKENAME is disturbed from its slumber, it will either lash out with a Bite or use Teleport to change its location. POKENAME have rarely warped aboard ships and raided them for food.

entry: 它扎在海底，够得到什么就啃什么。叶状鳍能帮逃天敌，只是游得不快。
author: mistymagius
source: It plants itself on the seafloor, munching on anything it can get its mouth on. Its leaf-like fins allow it to swim away from predators, even though it cannot swim very fast.

entry: POKENAME外表凶猛，离群后却很少袭宝可梦或船。守领地时，尾尖会放蓝焰，给自己壮胆。
author: fiordaliso
source: Despite its fierce and intimidating appearance, POKENAME rarely attacks other Pokémon or ships when separated from its flock. When defending its territory, it releases a bluish flame from its tail tip to boost its courage.

entry: 猎物还未见到POKENAME，就被臭气熏走。POKENAME只好改在水底觅食，结果却变得更臭。
author: markusknight
source: POKENAME's stench drives away its prey before they can even see them. This caused POKENAME to become bottom feeders in the bodies of water, which in turn makes them stink even more.

entry: POKENAME出没在海滩与港口，会从其他宝可梦或人类那里，偷走刚捕到的鱼。它在陆地上行动较慢，入水后却能靠藤蔓辅助推进，游得更快。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is found along beaches and ports where it will steal freshly caught fish from other Pokémon or humans. It is rather slow on land, but speeds up in the water by using its vines to aid in propulsion.

entry: POKENAME好斗，想让谁都听它使唤。锋利的牙齿，连大型树果的厚皮，也能轻松切开。
author: t.i.a.
source: POKENAME is highly aggressive and will try to bully anyone into doing its bidding. Its sharp teeth can cut through the thick skin of large Berries.

entry: POKENAME是水电大坝的常见害兽，会咬住任何通电的东西，吸走能量。想安全移走它很难，因为稍受刺激，就可能惹它暴怒。
author: infinex21
source: It is a common pest at hydroelectric dams, as it will bite into anything flowing with electricity and leech that energy for itself. It is difficult to safely remove a POKENAME, as the slightest stimulus could cause it to fly into an explosive rage.

entry: POKENAME睡觉用尾缠船链。被打扰，就以足以碎花岗岩的强颚下口。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME wraps its tail around ship chains while sleeping. If disturbed, it bites with jaws strong enough to crush granite.

entry: POKENAME用烟幕将水变暗，再出击。浑浊莫名不影响视线，连钨般的防护，也能轻松咬穿。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses Smokescreen to darken the waters before striking. The murk somehow doesn't hinder its own sight as it effortlessly bites through defenses as strong as tungsten.

entry: POKENAME优雅游热带海，发现猎物，一口就能撕穿铁。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME swims gracefully through tropical seas. When prey is spotted, it bites with enough force to rip through iron.

entry: POKENAME倚水下表面休息，什么游过，就触动狩猎本能。锁定后急旋而去，各肢锋利无比，能划出致命深伤。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME rests against underwater surfaces until something swims past it, triggering its hunting instinct. It locks onto prey and rotates rapidly towards them, each limb viciously sharp and capable of making deep, deadly cuts.

entry: POKENAME在海底找猎物，用哑剧动作筑无形墙困住，逼目标为了逃走，反而游向自己。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME prowls the ocean floor, searching for prey. It will use mime to trap its target using invisible walls, forcing it to swim towards POKENAME to escape.

entry: POKENAME贪食得连珊瑚都吃，利齿一口碾碎。尾上毒刺，则用来削弱敌人。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is so ravenous that it can even devour coral, crushing it beneath its fearsome teeth. The venomous sting on its tail is used to weaken its enemies.

entry: POKENAME数量渐少，领地意识格外强，护巢时凶猛沉船、攻击一切。大胆船长，也会训练它护航。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is extremely territorial, especially with its dwindling population, and viciously sinks ships and attacks anything while protecting its nesting grounds. Daring captains train POKENAME to protect their ships on voyages.

entry: POKENAME数量渐少，领地意识格外强，护巢时凶猛沉船、攻击一切。大胆船长，也会训练它护航。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is extremely territorial, especially with its dwindling population, and viciously sinks ships and attacks anything while protecting its nesting grounds. Daring captains train POKENAME to protect their ships on voyages.

entry: POKENAME常让磨牙彩皮鱼、铁炮鱼等小宝可梦住壳里。数量减少后，对人类越发凶暴。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME often let smaller Pokémon, such as Bruxish and Remoraid, live in their shells. Due to their dwindling numbers, POKENAME have become increasingly violent towards humans.

entry: POKENAME水中疾冲，重撞一切闯领地者。潜艇有时误以为，这袭击是鱼雷命中。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME zooms through the waters at breakneck speeds, tackling hard into anything that ventures its territory. On occasion, submarines have mistook POKENAME attacks for being hit by torpedoes.

entry: POKENAME捕猎刺甲贝，强颚能撕壳。战中先吞水，再如间歇泉强喷。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME's jaws are strong enough to rip through the shells of the Cloyster they hunt. In battle, POKENAME swallows water before shooting it back out with the force of a geyser.

entry: POKENAME住洞穴水域，游泳不算最快，跃上陆地，却爬得惊人快。咬住倒霉生物，再拖回水下。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a hunter inhabiting bodies of water within caverns. It isn't the fastest when swimming, but leaps onto land and scuttles with surprising speed, biting hapless creatures and dragging them underwater.

entry: POKENAME在海崖高处筑巢，巡视猎物。与同类合作，连吼鲸王也能猎倒。水里、空中都快得能比肩人造交通工具。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME nests high on coastal cliffs where it can survey its habitat for prey, even taking down the likes of Wailord if it works with others of its kind. POKENAME flies and swims at speeds rivaling human-made transportation in those environments.

entry: POKENAME飞天与潜海一样快，力量强、性情凶，被视为两处的顶级猎手。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME cuts through the air and the ocean depths with the same incredible speed. With its extreme strength and aggression, it is considered an apex predator of both biomes.

entry: 确认野生POKENAME现身，就算紧急事件，性情与领地意识实在太凶。附近城镇会收到留室内警告，直到专业训练家成功处理。
author: sk372
source: A confirmed sighting of a wild POKENAME is considered an emergency, due to its extremely violent and territorial nature. Nearby towns are issued stay-inside warnings until professional Trainers can come and successfully deal with POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME游在游轮与渡船下，等船远离岸，便开始咬穿船体，毁坏够了，再游走。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME swim under cruise ships and ferries, waiting until the boats are far out into the water. They then start to bite holes into the hull, swimming away once they've done enough damage.

entry: POKENAME游热带水，多在珊瑚礁巡领地找食。细毛一遇空气便炽热燃烧，水下也大量放热，游出蒸汽轨迹。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME swims in tropical waters and is most often found around coral reefs, patrolling their territory in search of food. Their fine fur burns hot on contact with air and produces a lot of heat even underwater, producing a steam trail as they swim.

entry: POKENAME领地意识极强，常为猎物相互争斗。POKENAME专捕大型鱼宝可梦，用利喙与尖爪凶狠袭击。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are incredibly territorial and will constantly fight with each other over their prey. POKENAME prey on larger fish Pokémon, brutally attacking them with their sharp beak and talons.

entry: POKENAME发电球，将鸟宝可梦打入海，再猛咬拖水下，慢慢吃。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME fires Electro Ball to knock avian Pokémon into the sea. It then bites down hard and drags them underwater so it can feast.

entry: POKENAME是深海沟中的捕猎霸主，用光突袭猎物，再几口吞食。海面附近极少见它；若发现，通常正迷失方向，满心戒备。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is a dominant predator of deep ocean trenches, using its light to surprise prey before devouring them in only a few bites. It is rare to see POKENAME near the ocean surface, but when one is found it is usually disoriented and defensive.

entry: POKENAME无声移动，常吓着遇到的生物，自己也因此难过。它想分享快乐，却没察觉别人其实更想独处。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is silent in its movement, so it often startles those it happens upon, disheartening it. It seeks to share happiness with others, and ends up being oblivious to when those it interacts with would rather be alone.

entry: POKENAME溜进船舱，吃尽找到的食物。剃刀利齿，连铁锚也轻易啃穿。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME sneaks into the holds of ships to devour every scrap of food it can find. Its razor-sharp teeth are so strong that it could gnaw through iron anchors without the slightest difficulty.

entry: POKENAME看见会动的东西就想咬，因此用活饵钓鱼，很容易将它钓上。挂在线上时，它会猛烈挣扎；一旦收上岸，却又变得十分温顺。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME will try and bite anything that moves, making it very easy to catch when fishing with live bait. When on the end of the line it will thrash about violently, but once it has been reeled in it becomes very docile.

entry: POKENAME懒，张嘴游盼吃个现成的，或晒太阳，盼食腐者好奇凑近。凶相很适合守家，实际却爱陪孩子玩。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is lazy, swimming with its mouth open in hopes of catching an unaware meal or basking in the sun hoping scavengers get too curious. Its vicious appearance makes it an excellent guardian pet as it actually loves playing with children.

entry: POKENAME懒，张嘴游盼吃个现成的，或晒太阳，盼食腐者好奇凑近。凶相很适合守家，实际却爱陪孩子玩。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is lazy, swimming with its mouth open in hopes of catching an unaware meal or basking in the sun hoping scavengers get too curious. Its vicious appearance makes it an excellent guardian pet as it actually loves playing with children.

entry: POKENAME用藤甩出花苞上的刀锋花瓣，互争领地。伤疤越多，越受同类尊敬。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME fight for territory by using their vines to fling the razor-sharp petals of their flower bulbs at each other. The more scars a POKENAME bears, the more respect it commands from others.

entry: POKENAME游动，锚链拖过海底。链条留着余量时，便能喷水推进，捉附近东西。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Its anchor and chain drag across the seafloor as POKENAME swims. If its chain has slack, it can jet water to catch something nearby.

entry: POKENAME虽很能捕猎，近50年数量却大减。肉若做错，毒性极强，却被美食家与求刺激者，当稀有珍味。
author: _pixelar_
source: Despite being very prolific hunters, the population of POKENAME has decreased severely over the last 50 years. The meat of POKENAME is viewed as a rare delicacy by gourmets and thrill hunters alike, as the meat is very poisonous when prepared wrong.

entry: POKENAME用鳍状翼迅速推进。鲨鱼形钳子，能施加每平方英寸700磅力的压力。
author: adam_dnh
source: POKENAME uses its fin-like wings to swiftly propel itself forward. It can exert pressure of up to 700 PSI with its shark-shaped claws.

entry: 猎物游得更快，POKENAME便开背上助推器追。许多报告说，见它追猎时，在船上打出深洞。
author: bigoljax
source: Whenever their prey seem to outswim them, POKENAME use the boosters on their back to catch up. Many reports say that POKENAME have been seen punching deep holes into boats during a chase.

entry: POKENAME水速与空速一样快，研究者确定，原因就在头冠。
author: atlas3339098
source: POKENAME is just as fast in the water as it is in the air. Researchers have determined this is because of the crest on its head.

entry: POKENAME藏在其他太阳珊瑚融合体中，骤喷水弹出，咬住没防备的猎物。虽捕食，却也满足于潜水者喂零嘴，甚至在码头向游客乞食。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME lies hidden in plain sight among other Corsola fusions, before releasing a burst of water to jet out and snap up unwary prey. Despite its predatory nature, it is content to be fed treats by divers and even begs at docks for tourists.

entry: POKENAME极聪明，潜行礁间，偷袭大猎物。独立、多疑，可一旦信任训练家，就会凶猛保护。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is highly intelligent and sneaks around reefs to catch larger prey unaware. It is independent and distrustful of others, and it will become aggressively protective of its Trainer once it trusts them.

entry: POKENAME在开阔海域生活得很好，能跃出水面，捕捉鸟类宝可梦。它跃过船只时，外貌常吓得人退缩；不过，只有搭便车的利牙鱼掉上甲板，才会真的带来危险。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME thrives in the open ocean where it can burst out of the water to snag bird Pokémon as a meal. When it leaps over boats, people recoil in fear of its appearance, but it is only a danger if the Carvanha hitching a ride falls off onto the deck.

entry: POKENAME以不可思议的极速飞行，掠过树就能用利肢劈成两半。还会造巨牙鲨形爆炸弹，射敌人与猎物。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME jets through the air at impossibly fast speeds, and can cleave trees in two with its sharp limbs as it flies past. It produces Sharpedo-shaped explosive projectiles to launch at opponents and prey.

entry: 同类受伤、危险逼近，POKENAME就从颚里喷滚烫蒸汽，逼退袭击者。虽以致命咬力闻名，真正强处却是陆水两用的无匹敏捷。
author: fiordaliso
source: If danger looms near its wounded kin, POKENAME emits a plume of scalding steam from its jaws, forcing attackers to retreat. Though known for its lethal bite, its true strength lies in its unmatched agility on land and underwater.

entry: 同类受伤、危险逼近，POKENAME就从颚里喷滚烫蒸汽，逼退袭击者。虽以致命咬力闻名，真正强处却是陆水两用的无匹敏捷。
author: fiordaliso
source: If danger looms near its wounded kin, POKENAME emits a plume of scalding steam from its jaws, forcing attackers to retreat. Though known for its lethal bite, its true strength lies in its unmatched agility on land and underwater.

entry: POKENAME发怒时，体温剧增，连捕猎途中游过的水都能被加热。它们与同类比赛咬船锚，看看谁的颚力最强。
author: fiordaliso
source: When angered, POKENAME's body temperature rises so much that it can heat the very waters it swims through while hunting. It competes with others of its kind by biting the anchors of ships to determine who has the strongest jaws.

entry: POKENAME暴怒，体热猛升，周围水开始微沸。同类常咬穿船锚比试，争谁颚最凶。
author: fiordaliso
source: When enraged, POKENAME's internal heat surges until the waters around it begin to simmer. Members of this species often clash by biting through ship anchors, testing which one possesses the fiercest jaws.

entry: POKENAME借海军蓝伪装，急游海中找猎物。颚能张开罩住比自己大的宝可梦，交胃酸消化。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME zip through the sea with navy camouflage and search for prey to consume. Their jaw stretches over Pokémon larger than themselves to be digested by their stomach acids.

entry: POKENAME在海藻林中潜游，观察其他居民的弱点，再加以欺凌，抢走食物。这样便能省下充沛的能量，用来驱赶侵入领地的竞争者。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME stealthily swims through kelp forests to observe other inhabitants for weaknesses, which it exploits by bullying them to steal food. This practice allows it to preserve its vast energy to drive competitors from its territory.

entry: POKENAME艺术灵感，来自巨牙鲨袭击电影。野生个体的巢里，曾发现大批巨牙鲨电影纪念品。
author: hophoppip
source: The inspiration for POKENAME's art comes from movies about Sharpedo attacks. Wild POKENAME have been found with stockpiles of Sharpedo movie memorabilia adorning their dens.

entry: POKENAME如闪电般迅猛，穿陆游海。所到处风暴相随，恰好成为捕猎背景。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME courses through both the land and sea with the speed and ferocity of a lightning bolt. Stormy weather follows it wherever it roams, lending the perfect backdrop for it to hunt in.

entry: POKENAME自然脱落的牙，被收集制成商店出售的锐利之牙。它领地意识极强，谁闯海洞住处，就惯常攻击。
author: fiordaliso
source: The teeth it sheds naturally are collected and used to craft the Razor Fangs sold in Pokémarts. POKENAME is fiercely territorial and makes a habit of attacking anyone who intrudes upon the sea caves where it makes its den.

entry: POKENAME用强电感受器，探测周围生物。远处也能分辨脑内电脉冲的细微差别，判断情绪。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME uses the powerful electroreceptors in its body to detect the organisms around it. From a distance, it can even decipher the nuances of electric impulses in another's brain to determine their emotional state.

entry: 这凶猛猎手以快得看不清的速度，连番攻得对手晕头。水边或海滩见POKENAME，附近通常就会呼吁疏散。
author: evilgammon
source: This vicious predator uses its blinding speed to launch dizzying assaults on its opponent. When POKENAME is sighted near a body of water or beach there are usually calls to evacuate the nearby area.

entry: POKENAME体形虽大，游动却全无声息。曾见它跃水，用獠牙钩住猎物，一起拉回水下。
author: bigoljax
source: Despite its large size, POKENAME is completely silent while swimming. It has been seen launching itself out the water to hook its tusks into prey, bringing them back down with it.

entry: POKENAME极力保护水下植物，讨厌的访客太近就凶猛迎战。再多疤、再多伤，也不停攻。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is fiercely protective of underwater plant-life. If an unwelcome guest ventures too close to its territory it fights fiercely to defend it, never stopping its assault no matter how scarred and injured it gets.

entry: POKENAME好斗，进入它栖居的雨林河很危险。可背上种子是珍贵美食，逐财者仍冒险前往。
author: imaginita
source: It is dangerous to venture into the rainforest rivers where the combative POKENAME makes its home.  Fortune-seekers make the attempt nevertheless, as the seeds on its back are a valuable delicacy.

entry: POKENAME能跑到每小时75英里，用锚与脚爪攻击。过去鳍被采作食材，因此常遭猎捕。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME can run up to 75mph, and uses its anchor and its talons to attack. Its fins used to be harvested for foodstuffs, so POKENAME was often a victim of hunting.

entry: POKENAME背上泡泡，能给溺水者供氧，却只肯帮助尊重小鱼宝可梦的人。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: The bubbles on the backs of POKENAME can provide oxygen to people who are drowning. It will only give to those who respect smaller fish Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME战中极凶，会不停抓踢撕咬，直到自己或敌人满身伤口。它以留下的战疤多少，判断战斗好坏。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is an incredibly vicious opponent to face in battle. It won't stop clawing, kicking, or biting at a foe until they or it are covered in wounds; a POKENAME judges the quality of a fight by the number of battle scars left behind.

entry: POKENAME虽然体型庞大，却能在浓稠的泥浆中，像在水里一样轻松游动。沼泽湿地中，常能见到它们的头鳍，正围住目标，准备扑击。
author: infinex21
source: Despite their size, POKENAME can swim through thick mud as easily as they can swim in water. Their head fins are a common sight within marshes and swamps as they encircle their targets and prepare to pounce.

entry: POKENAME一生与野外对手凶斗，留许多疤。伤疤痛，就涂泥，暂时舒缓。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME gains multiple scars over its lifetime due to vicious fights with rivals in the wild. When the scars ache, it applies mud on the wounds to temporarily soothe the pain.

entry: POKENAME造沙洲搁浅船只，方便袭击刚受困的乘客。皮肤易干，有些训练家离水后替它涂泥，保持凉爽。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME creates sandbanks to beach boats, allowing it to easily attack the freshly stranded passengers. Its skin dries out quickly, and some Trainers put mud on it to keep it cool if out of water.

entry: POKENAME很想咬游过的生灵，咬力却很弱。它低吼着想逞威风，可对方哪怕只轻轻回击，也会吓得它哭着游走。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has a strong urge to bite those who swim past it, though its bite is rather weak. It tries to growl and be intimidating, but even a light retaliatory tap will send it swimming away, crying in terror.

entry: POKENAME取代沉船船首像，唱轻扬旋律，引水属性宝可梦。靠近后，以水之波动扰乱，再凶狠咬下。
author: ghostslythe
source: Found replacing the figurehead on sunken ships, POKENAME sings a lilting melody, attracting Water-types. When they close in, it confuses its prey with a Water Pulse before finishing them with a vicious bite.

entry: POKENAME狩猎本能极强，性格却甜美如孩子。在新捕猎物旁开心唱歌，许多人看了反而不安。
author: sk372
source: Despite it having great hunting instincts, POKENAME's personality is sweet and almost childish. The sight of it happily singing next to freshly-caught prey has been described as disconcerting to many.

entry: POKENAME是人类已知最凶猛忠诚的战士之一，保护训练家，常如同保自己的命。
author: taka_re
source: POKENAME are some of the fiercest and most loyal fighters known to man. They often defend their Trainers as though their lives depend on it.

entry: POKENAME常在海上骚扰船只，可最终并不会伤人。据说，过去曾有海盗跟随POKENAME航行。
author: blazerxz
source: POKENAME is usually seen in the ocean, harassing ships but ultimately not harming anyone. It's said pirates followed POKENAME in the past.

entry: 这些凶猛宝可梦劫镇夺宝。POKENAME虽粗暴，却讲公平，不攻击无力自卫者。
author: actliux
source: These vicious Pokémon plunder towns for treasure. Although very brutish in nature, POKENAME believe in fair fights and do not attack those who cannot defend themselves.

entry: POKENAME是凶悍海底猎手，长舌抓快泳者，拖入大嘴啃咬。进食发狂常咬自己，舌上因此满疤。
author: sk372
source: An aggressive undersea hunter, POKENAME grabs onto speedy swimmers with its tongue, gnashing its teeth as they are pulled into its maw. Its tongue is covered with scars from biting itself during these feeding frenzies.

entry: POKENAME体内有108种略有差异的水。各具独特性质，科学家曾加以研究。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body contains 108 slightly different kinds of water. Scientists have studied these due to the unique properties each one holds.

entry: POKENAME水下快得离谱，如战斗机。手上镰刀，锋利得能切钛。
author: actliux
source: POKENAME swims at ludicrous speeds like a fighter jet underwater. The scythes on its hands are sharp enough to cut through titanium.

entry: POKENAME悠闲巡视所占的珊瑚礁，赶走其他海洋顶级猎手，用海葵触手抓没戒心的猎物。平时慢，只有地位受威胁，才爆能突袭。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME leisurely patrols the reef it controls, chasing off other ocean apex predators and snagging unaware prey with its anemone tentacles. It moves slowly unless there is a threat to its dominance, launching a surprise attack in a burst of energy.

entry: POKENAME猎渔人的传闻，导致它遭过度捕猎。近年，故事被视为虚构，数量正慢慢恢复。
author: mepp.
source: Tales of POKENAME preying on fishermen lead to the over-hunting of the Pokémon. In recent years, these stories have been dismissed as fiction, and their numbers are slowly recovering.

entry: POKENAME以惊人速度甩颈、张嘴猛咬猎物。牙利得能刺穿钢板。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME strikes prey by whipping its neck forward with incredible speed and snapping with its maw. Its teeth are sharp enough to pierce steel plating.

entry: POKENAME巡热带礁与海藻林，靠出众的水中敏捷追快猎物。新发现的化石显示，它与过去作顶级猎手时，几乎没变。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME prowls tropical reefs and kelp forests, using its enhanced aquatic agility to pursue fast prey. Recent fossil discoveries reveal that this Pokémon remains largely unchanged from how it appeared in the past as an apex predator.

entry: POKENAME弯头鳍能预知猛烈海风暴，便用来计划袭击闯领地的船，轻易将其弄沉。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME, thanks to the curved fin atop its head, can predict the arrival of violent sea storms. POKENAME uses this knowledge to plan assaults on ships that stray into its territory, sinking them with ease.

entry: POKENAME能制造吸力，将方圆一公里内的一切吸入。只需短短几周，就能灭尽数公里海域中的生命。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME can create suction that sucks in everything within a kilometer. It can wipe out life within several kilometers of sea in just a few weeks.

entry: POKENAME能制造吸力，将方圆一公里内的一切吸入。只需短短几周，就能灭尽数公里海域中的生命。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME can create suction that sucks in everything within a kilometer. It can wipe out life within several kilometers of sea in just a few weeks.

entry: 野生POKENAME太爱挑战海滩附近的宝可梦，总满身战疤。战斗咬敌时，许多牙易断，可每次长回都更坚韧。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME are so quick to challenge other Pokémon near the beaches they live upon that their bodies are always covered in many scars. Their many fangs break rather easily during battle as they bite their foes but they always grow back tougher.

entry: POKENAME身体致密沉重，水中远不如陆上灵活。极凶又贪食，一天最多猎食八次。
author: sk372
source: Due to POKENAME's dense and heavy body, it is far less mobile in the water than on land. It is highly aggressive and ravenous, hunting and eating prey up to eight times a day.

entry: POKENAME住海底，小水生宝可梦栖在背部碎屑里，替它清壳。许多水族馆因此在大展池养它，丰富其他宝可梦的生活。
author: jadey.1557
source: POKENAME live on the bottom of seabeds. Small aquatic Pokémon will inhabit the debris upon its back and keep its shell clean for it. Because of this, many aquariums will keep a POKENAME in their large exhibits as enrichment for other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME尾端是一团水，能硬化成刀锋。野外对手以此凶斗，周身留下数不清的切伤。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's tail ends in a bit of water that can be hardened to razor sharpness. Rivals in the wild fight viciously with these blades, gaining innumerable cuts over their body in the process.

entry: POKENAME只要先加足速，就能沿水面冲浪。猎物快得追不上时，这招很有用。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME are able to surf along the water just by getting a good head start. This helps them during hunts if their prey gets too fast for them to catch.

entry: POKENAME骄傲至极，胁迫小宝可梦加入海盗帮，抢更大宝可梦的树果储备。与杰尼龟尤其敌对。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is exceedingly proud and attempts to strongarm other small Pokémon into joining its pirate gang and raiding berry stashes of much larger Pokémon. It has an intense rivalry with Squirtles.

entry: POKENAME有时夜跟渔船，惯偷工具装备，藏在水下巢穴作战利品。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME can sometimes be seen stalking fishing vessels at night. It regularly steals tools and equipment from these vessels to keep as trophies in its underwater den.

entry: POKENAME以大锚砸穿闯领地的船。若能将船引撞冰山，就开心极了。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME use their large anchor to break through the hulls of ships that enter their territory. If they can lead a boat into an iceberg, they become filled with joy.

entry: POKENAME感官广泛，红外、回声定位、电感受与磁感受都有。水族馆对看它的游客严格限制，免刺激过度。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME has a wide range of senses, including infrared, echolocation, electroreception, and magnetoreception. Pokémon aquariums have to place heavy restrictions on visitors when viewing POKENAME tanks to avoid overstimulating them.

entry: 它极好斗，见到强者就想战，同类尤其如此。POKENAME刃上的每道缺口与疤，都骄傲戴着，代表一次凶战。
author: sk372
source: It has an extremely aggressive streak and seeks to battle any powerful opponent it can find, especially others of its kind. POKENAME wears every chip and scar on its blade with pride, as each signifies a vicious fight.

entry: POKENAME视沉船为领地，谁闯家就凶猛出击。对破破舵轮，尤其暴烈。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME considers sunken ships its territory, and strikes viciously at any who would trespass on its home. It's known to be especially aggressive and violent towards Dhelmise.

entry: 这巨型水下猛兽，双颚轻易撕船，智力却又狡猾得惊人。POKENAME披着毁过的船骸，彰显可怕的狡智。
author: infinex21
source: A colossal underwater behemoth with jaws that easily shred ships' hulls and surprisingly cunning intellects. POKENAME are clad in the remains of ships they've torn apart as proof of their terrifying cunning.

entry: 近来，人们发现凶悍野生POKENAME住在沉船。敢探索的寻宝者，未必能活着回来。
author: cobalt0135
source: Ferocious wild POKENAME have recently been discovered using sunken ships as homes. Any daring treasure hunter that attempts to explore these vessels may not make it back alive.

entry: POKENAME凶猛残暴，因此号称“海洋暴君”。身上的两片金色鳍锋利得足以切开钢铁，还能让它跃出水面后，继续在空中飞行。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME is known as “The Tyrant of the Seas” due to its aggressiveness and brutality. The two golden fins on its body are sharp enough to slice through steel and allow it to maintain flight after it launches itself out of the water.

entry: POKENAME水中朝上，旋转中央齿轮，造大漩涡，卷来撕碎猎物，也撕碎不幸经过的船。
author: fireblade141
source: By facing upwards and rotating its center gear while underwater, POKENAME is able to create large whirlpools that pull in and shred prey, as well as any boats unfortunate enough to cross its path.

entry: POKENAME极爱独居，拒绝多数陪伴。受扰便狂甩缎带，锐边足以划深伤。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME greatly prefers a solitary existence, eschewing most types of companionship. If agitated, it whips its many ribbons around wildly, the edges of which are sharp enough to leave deep gashes.

entry: 对没防备的深潜者与小水生宝可梦，满口利牙常是最后所见。它们体纹在深处发光，只有捕猎才变暗。
author: infinex21
source: Its many teeth are often the last sight for unaware deep sea divers and small aquatic Pokémon alike. The markings along the bodies of these Pokémon glow within the depths and only dim when they are hunting.

entry: POKENAME这水下巨兽，只住最深最暗海沟。为领地与猎物，和其他水下宝可梦战过无数，身体也满疤。
author: infinex21
source: This underwater leviathan of a Pokémon lives within only the deepest, darkest undersea trenches. POKENAME's body is covered in countless scars from its many battles with other underwater Pokémon over over territory and prey alike.

entry: POKENAME又称“七海的死神”。水里一有目击，最好留陆上；剃刀利爪，最重甲的船也能轻松弄沉。
author: sottiwotti
source: POKENAME is also called "the Grim Reaper of The Seven Seas". Whenever POKENAME is spotted in a body of water, it is recommended to stay on land. Their razor-sharp claws can effortlessly sink even the most armored ship.

entry: POKENAME的金属身体会自然下沉，因此它大多待在海底，用背上的发射器，向上方游过的猎物发射鱼雷。击中目标后，它便从水中跃起，用钢牙将其咬住。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's metal body naturally sinks, so it spends most of its time on the seabed, firing  torpedoes from the launcher on its back at prey swimming above. After hitting a target, POKENAME leaps up through the water to seize it with its steel teeth.

entry: POKENAME像古海盗，配强炮。水下不能开炮，便主要猎水面上方的目标；可利牙与钢钩，近战也一样危险。
author: .jerden
source: Resembling a pirate of old, POKENAME is armed with a powerful cannon. POKENAME mostly hunts for prey above the surface, as it cannot fire its cannon underwater, although its sharp teeth and steel hook make it just as dangerous up close.

entry: 这种宝可梦在北极水域生活、捕猎，也能在陆地待上一段时间。身上的冰层既能保护它，也形成致命尖角，让它能迅速刺穿猎物。
author: infinex21
source: This Pokémon lives and hunts in arctic waters, though it is capable of staying on land for periods of time. The ice along its body protects it while also giving it a deadly horn that allows it to quickly impale any of its prey.

entry: POKENAME是敏捷沿岸猎手，爆发跃水，以快如闪电的踢击与利尾劈斩压制敌人。锁定目标，头上星形部位便强烈发光。
author: cerealjamalt
source: POKENAME is an agile hunter that patrols coasts. It launches from the water with explosive force, using lightning-fast kicks and a slashing tail to overwhelm foes. The star upon its head glows fiercely when it locks onto a target.

entry: POKENAME伸颈范围有限，只约半英尺，却能迅速伏击、猛咬目标。水中快、陆上灵巧，是难缠对手。
author: infinex21
source: Although the range is limited, POKENAME can stretch their necks around half a foot and ambush targets with swift, biting attacks. They can move swiftly in water and are agile on land, which makes them tricky foes to overcome.

entry: 这些可怕外形的宝可梦，游荡深海，鸣如歌曲，勾起忧伤。却没有突袭记录，似乎渴望接触，只换来恐惧。
author: infinex21
source: These horrific-looking Pokémon wander around in the depths of oceans, letting out song-like cries that invoke melancholy. Despite how they look, sudden attacks have not been reported; rather, they seem to long for contact but are met with fear.

entry: POKENAME借月光引路，熟练地游遍海洋，寻找猎物。电灯怪能用发出的光，骗它以为是月光，将它引离本要捕食的目标。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME expertly navigates the ocean in search of prey to devour, using moonlight to guide its way. Lanturn are able to use their lights to fool POKENAME into thinking it's seeing moonlight, leading it away from its would-be prey.

entry: POKENAME陆上还算心善，水中却极其凶猛。牙与坚獠牙并用，几乎什么都切得开。
author: darkweavile428
source: POKENAME are fairly kindhearted on land, but turn incredibly vicious when in water. By using both its fangs and sturdy tusks, POKENAME can cut through almost anything.

entry: POKENAME借月光引路，熟练地游遍海洋，寻找猎物。电灯怪能用发出的光，骗它以为是月光，将它引离本要捕食的目标。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME expertly navigates the ocean in search of prey to devour, using moonlight to guide its way. Lanturn are able to use their lights to fool POKENAME into thinking it's seeing moonlight, leading it away from its would-be prey.

entry: POKENAME外表适应成巨牙鲨，连海底泳姿也模仿。实际却基本无害，只吃小海草。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME has adapted its appearance to look like a Sharpedo, even mimicking the way it swims across the seafloor. However, it is basically harmless, only feeding on small sea plants.

entry: POKENAME是可怕猎手，飞在罪犯游荡的法外之地。酒馆常张贴高额生擒悬赏，却没人成功。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME is a feared predator that soars above lawless areas where roving bands of criminals gather. Though taverns often post bounty posters with a big reward if one is captured alive, nobody has succeeded in this quest.

entry: 曾见一只POKENAME吞掉整群鲤鱼王。它常与龙宝可梦打架，交锋时掀起风暴。
author: kam_doodle_snek
source: A single POKENAME has been observed to devour an entire school of Magikarp. They get into frequent fights with dragon Pokémon, whipping up storms as they clash.

entry: POKENAME泳速快，又耐深潜，许多海洋探索机构都喜爱。多鳍帮助它，最猛风浪里也能灵活转向。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are a favourite Pokémon amongst many ocean exploration organisations thanks to their speed in the water and their ability to tolerate swimming at great depths. Their many fins help them manoeuvre in even the stormiest of seas.

entry: 这无情海兽，是最快最强的海洋猎手之一。速度力量虽惊人，脆弱身体却易受伤。POKENAME曾轻易压碎潜艇，从此恶名远扬。
author: onyxsylvian
source: This ruthless undersea Pokémon is among the fastest and strongest predators in the sea. Despite its incredible speed and power, its fragile body leaves it vulnerable to attacks. POKENAME gained notoriety after crushing a submarine with ease.

entry: POKENAME在海面下高速旋转，如长枪刺入海底，挖出巨大隧道，供同类居住。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spins at high speeds beneath the ocean's surface, piercing into the seafloor like a lance. This creates massive tunnels for others of its kind to inhabit.

entry: 它定期浮上海面吸气，储进体内。身躯虽粗壮，只需喷出储气，便能迅速转向。
author: chorb33
source: It regularly fills up with air by swimming to the surface. Despite its chunky physique, it can quickly change direction by expelling the stored air.

entry: POKENAME组成家族群，由雄性巨牙猫首领带领，游荡欺负弱者。谁背叛首领，就会遭无情攻击，直到重新服从。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME live in family groups led by a head male Sharpray. They will roam, bullying any vulnerable Pokémon they see. If they ever betray the boss Sharpray, they will be attacked mercilessly until they fall in line.

entry: POKENAME歌声传过辽阔水面，让远处猎物无力沉睡。凭快泳，轻松就能抓住睡着目标。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's song carries great distances across the water, sending distant prey into a helpless slumber. With its quick swimming speed, it can snatch up its sleeping target with ease.

entry: POKENAME颚力比看着更强，能撕金属船体与深海岩。牙断很快长回，还会更强，最终比大多数金属还坚韧。
author: infinex21
source: The jaws of POKENAME are unassumingly strong enough to tear through metal ship hulls and deep sea rocks. Their teeth quickly regrow if they break, and they grow back stronger thus resulting in them being tougher than most metals.

entry: 哪怕小血滴，也会令POKENAME疯狂进食。一尝猎物滋味，就不停吃到只剩骨头。
author: musicsheep.
source: Even a small drop of blood with send POKENAME into a feeding frenzy. Once it gets a taste of its prey, it will keep eating away until nothing is left but bone.

entry: POKENAME的齿轮边缘极其锋利。它将体内较小的齿轮射向远处猎物，割伤对方，便更容易循着伤口的血腥味追踪。
author: sk372
source: The edges of POKENAME's gears are extremely sharp. It fires the smaller gear from its body at distant prey, cutting them and allowing it to track them easier by following the scent of blood from the wound.

entry: 这种宝可梦玫瑰里的刺，是强力飞镖。藏在高草，毫无预警地偷射其他宝可梦。
author: lydiaprower8
source: This Pokémon's thorns in their roses are powerful darts. It hides in tall grass and sneakily fires the darts into other Pokémon without warning.

entry: 大多数飞机的航线，都会绕开POKENAME的领地。无法绕行时，便会带上一队飞行宝可梦护航。成群的POKENAME，只需几秒，就能将铁撕开。
author: periperi_chicken
source: Most planes are routed to fly around POKENAME territories, but when that isn't possible, they will bring a team of flying Pokémon to defend them. A swarm of POKENAME can rip through iron in a matter of seconds.

entry: POKENAME周身始终有泡泡，让它能游过天空与陆地。水中食物争得太激烈，便转猎空中。
author: camtft
source: POKENAME creates a constant bubble around itself that it uses to swim through the air and land. This allows it to hunt in the skies when competition for food in the water gets too competitive.

entry: 这种宝可梦高速游到目标下方，以背鳍割伤对方，背鳍比斧还利、还硬。
author: stevethebarbarian
source: This Pokémon attacks by swimming at high speeds under its target and slashing them with its dorsal fin, which is sharper and tougher than an axe.

entry: POKENAME能跃上船甲板。浑身锐边太多，船几乎总会沉。
author: stevethebarbarian
source: POKENAME can leap out of the water and land on the deck of a ship. It's covered in so many sharp edges that the ship will almost always be sunk.

entry: POKENAME大群降林，鸣声与羽毛密如云。轮流如鱼雷冲出群，捕猎较弱的鸟宝可梦。
author: .izik
source: Flocks of POKENAME descend upon forests in large clouds of chirping and feathers. They take turns torpedoing out of the flock at weaker bird Pokémon to hunt.

entry: POKENAME伏在海底，以突然的电击伏击猎物。求偶季若有两只相遇，便会互咬鳍，向彼此表达好感。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME lay at the bottom of the ocean floor where they ambush prey with a jolt of electricity. If two POKENAME meet during the courtship season, they exchange bites on each other's fins to signal interest in one another.

entry: POKENAME曾是海上的恐怖存在。很久以前，它们高速撞向木船侧面，凿穿船身，将船击沉，再潜入残骸，收集留下的财宝。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME were once terrors of the sea. Long ago, they would careen at high speeds into the sides of wooden ships, gouging holes through the hull to sink them. They would then dive into the wreckage and collect any treasure left behind.

entry: POKENAME潜在废弃船骸下，将锚状尾藏进碎屑。猎物查看，便以恐怖速度从黑暗扑出。
author: msdawgs
source: POKENAME lurks beneath abandoned shipwrecks, disguising its anchor-like tail among the debris. When prey investigates, POKENAME erupts from the darkness with terrifying speed.

entry: POKENAME以暴烈闻名，颚能咬开刺甲贝壳。有一只常袭海滩，人们甚至不得不追捕。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME are known for their violent nature, with jaws strong enough to crack through Cloyster shells. One particular POKENAME had to be hunted down due to regularly attacking beaches.

entry: 黄昏，POKENAME鱼群饥饿大吃，毁尽整片礁。狩猎时，同伴受伤，也毫不犹豫弃下。
author: .izik
source: At dusk, schools of POKENAME feed ravenously, wiping out entire reefs. They abandon injured allies without hesitation while on a hunt.

entry: POKENAME通常在大群水属性宝可梦附近。多片利鳍割渔网，多数渔人都恨它。
author: swangfrog04
source: POKENAME is usually found near large groups of Water-type Pokémon. Most fishermen hate it because its multiple sharp fins cut through their nets.

entry: 刀刃般的鳍，切石如切奶油。甚至曾有人见过，单只个体就把暴鲤龙、吼鲸王这样的巨兽，切成碎片。
author: mr.person__prinplup_enjoyer
source: Its blade-like fins can cut stone like butter. Some have been seen cutting the likes of Gyarados and Wailord to pieces by themselves.

entry: POKENAME捕猎，从耳放出阵阵巨响，击昏附近鱼宝可梦，随后强力咬碎。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME releases bursts of noise from its ears to stun nearby fish Pokémon while hunting. Once disabled, it strikes with a powerful Crunch.

entry: POKENAME飞过海面，若发现大鱼群，便放出强劲声波，瞬间击倒大半。为抢夺猎物，也会与其他POKENAME激烈交战。
author: mistymagius
source: If it sees a large school of fish while it's flying over the ocean, POKENAME will fire a powerful sound wave that instantly takes out most of the school. It will fiercely fight other POKENAME over their prey.

entry: POKENAME哼刺耳低音潜猎，再俯冲扑下。群体疯狂进食，能搅风成龙卷或水龙卷。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME hums a grating bass melody as it stalks prey before dive-bombing them. If a school of POKENAME engage in a feeding frenzy, it can stir the winds into a tornado or waterspout.

entry: 这只宝可梦柔软亲人，据说毛绒绒的脑袋里，什么念头也没有。可谁需要慰藉、关爱与保护，它都愿意陪伴。
author: rooboid
source: This soft and cuddly Pokémon is said to have no thoughts inside its plush head. It provides comfort, love and protection to those who need it.

entry: POKENAME高速游咸淡水，锚状身体大幅画圈，击中猎物，瞬间就昏倒。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME travels through brackish waters at high speeds. It swings its anchor-like body in large circles, knocking out any prey it strikes in an instant.

entry: POKENAME头冠模仿巨牙鲨，吓退磨牙彩皮鱼等天敌。它活动假嘴肌肉、伸出舌头，装成死鲨，诱食腐的水生宝可梦当饭。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME utilizes mimicry where its crown looks like a Sharpedo, warding off predators like Bruxish. To attract scavenging aquatic Pokémon for a meal, it flexes muscles in the fake mouth to extend a tongue and seem like a dead Sharpedo.

entry: POKENAME模仿巨牙鲨，吓退磨牙彩皮鱼等超能力属性猎手，安心啃礁。外层有毒，铁炮鱼等想啄食的，迅速毒死，反成它一餐。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME's mimicry of Sharpedo deters Psychic-type predators, like Bruxish, allowing it to devour a reef in peace. Its outer layer is poisonous, so creatures like Remoraid that try to nibble on it quickly die and become a meal for POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME一旦盯住目标，就绝不放走。特制的鱼叉枪能钩牢猎物，谁试图逃跑，它便将其重新拖回。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME refuses to let a target escape once it has set its sights on them. It uses a specialized harpoon gun to ensure it can latch onto its quarry and reel them back in if they try to flee.

entry: 这些宝可梦身上蘑菇积多，脑功能下降，被河冲进海。莫名地，战斗受伤，疤上还会长菇。
author: infinex21
source: These Pokémon began to display lower brain function as mushrooms accumulated upon their bodies, causing them to be swept away by rivers and carried into oceans. Somehow, when they become injured in battle, mushrooms will grow from the scars.

entry: 它们栖息在参差海岸外最寒冷的海中。如今主要以船只为猎物，掀起巨浪或漩涡，将船拖沉海底。
author: doxtordaemon
source: Found in the coldest of seas just off the shores of jagged coasts. They have learned to prey mostly on ships these days, creating giant tidal waves or whirlpools to sink them to the depths of the sea.

entry: 商船听见威胁性的水手歌，就掉头，那是POKENAME潜伏的信号。不听的倒霉船，会被优雅剑法与威严步伐劫掠。
author: soup1900
source: Trade ships turn around on waters where threatening sea shanties are being sung, as that's a sign of POKENAME lurking nearby. The unfortunate ships that don't heed the call are raided by POKENAME with elegant swordplay and commanding steps.

entry: POKENAME高速狩猎，以超能力定住目标，逼近后使出残酷咬碎，连骨都碾碎。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME hunts at high speed, locking prey in place with psychic power. It closes in with a brutal, bone-crushing Crunch.

entry: POKENAME磨利齿，激发超能力，远远定住猎物，再以惊人速度赶来，让对方无从逃脱。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME grinds its sharp teeth together to activate its psychic powers. It immobilizes prey from a distance, and speeds towards it at remarkable speed, ensuring its target has no chance of escaping it.

entry: POKENAME十分霸道，会把其他捕食性宝可梦赶出领地。两只POKENAME一旦靠近，就会爆发激烈争斗，破坏部分珊瑚礁，有时甚至使那里不再适合自己居住。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME act as a bully, pushing any other predatory Pokémon from their territory. When two POKENAME get near each other, the violence that ensues can damage parts of the reef, sometimes making it unsuitable for them to continue residing there.

entry: POKENAME主钳如巨牙鲨，战中用来分散注意、威吓与虚晃。若战败，就回巢冥想复仇计划。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME's primary claws resemble Sharpedo, which it uses to distract, intimidate, and fake out opponents in combat. It if is bested in a fight, it will return to its den to meditate on a revenge plan.

entry: POKENAME狡猾残酷，把舌头装成漂流水雷吓船。原以为在驱离领地，后来才发现，竟是将船赶向巨牙鲨出没的水域。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Cunning and cruel, POKENAME pretend their tongues are loose water mines to scare boats away. Originally thought to be scaring boats away from their territory, it has been discovered that they actually herd ships into Sharpedo infested waters.

entry: 它爱雨，尤其能在外面泡泥时。有些训练家给潮湿岩石，让它多享雨中快乐。
author: quackquackattack
source: It loves the rain, especially when it is able to spend time outside to soak in the mud. Some Trainers give it a Damp Rock to ensure it spends more time happy in the rain.

entry: 别因POKENAME小，就以为性情可爱。它凶狠、狡诈，领地意识极强，会偷袭经过栖居河道的每艘船，逼船上宝可梦给它当船员。
author: imaginita
source: Don't mistake its diminutive size for a cute temperament — POKENAME is vicious, sly, and extremely territorial.  It will sneak attack any boat that comes down the river it calls home, and force the Pokémon aboard to join its crew.

entry: POKENAME唯一比舞刀弄剑更爱的，是一段精彩吉格舞。六角手风琴或绞弦琴一奏活泼曲子，立刻就跳。
author: imaginita
source: There is only one thing POKENAME likes more than swashbuckling: a good jig. A lively tune on a concertina or hurdy-gurdy will immediately set POKENAME dancing.

entry: POKENAME莫名能感到新近订婚的人，穷追不舍，只为咬一口。为什么挑这些人，无人知道。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME somehow senses those who have been recently engaged and chases them relentlessly so that it can bite them. No one knows why its attacks are targeted in this fashion.

entry: POKENAME短而粗糙的毛，帮助减轻水中摩擦。泳速快又凶猛，很受海上不法者欢迎。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are covered in short, rough hairs that help them cut through the water with minimal friction. Their speed and aggression in the water make them popular amongst lawbreakers at sea.

entry: POKENAME狡猾敏捷，流线身体方便追猎，也方便抢食后逃走。袭大船尝独特食物，有时分给巨牙鲨，换更快脱身。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is a cunning and swift predator, using its hydrodynamic shape to chase prey and escape with stolen meals. It raids large ships to taste unique foods, sometimes sharing its prize with Sharpedo to have an even quicker getaway.

entry: POKENAME狡猾敏捷，流线身体方便追猎，也方便抢食后逃走。袭大船尝独特食物，有时分给巨牙鲨，换更快脱身。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is a cunning and swift predator, using its hydrodynamic shape to chase prey and escape with stolen meals. It raids large ships to taste unique foods, sometimes sharing its prize with Sharpedo to have an even quicker getaway.

entry: 它嗅觉敏锐，能追踪五十英里外的猎物。毛发从前往后抚摸，柔软蓬松；换作其他方向，却会觉得粗糙扎手。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Its acute sense of smell lets it track prey from 50 miles away. Its fur is soft and fluffy if you pet it front to back, but petting it any other way is coarse and rough.

entry: 这只双足飞龙般的宝可梦经常战斗，身上留下独特伤痕。POKENAME由水构成的双翼与尾巴滚烫无比。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: This wyvern-like Pokémon is often in fights, resulting in unique scarring. POKENAME's water-based wings and tail are scaldingly hot.

entry: POKENAME用超能力拢漂浮物，造小船自己驾驶。常召其他宝可梦当船员，冷酷高效地统领。
author: sk372
source: Using psychic power, POKENAME pulls together flotsam and creates its own small ship to commandeer. It often amasses a crew of other Pokémon, leading them with ruthless efficiency.

entry: POKENAME每日游逾50英里，维持体能。水速惊人，能很快赶到遇险泳者身边，常受训当救生员。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME stays in shape by swimming over 50 miles a day. They are often trained as lifeguards since their incredible speed in the water lets them quickly reach struggling swimmers.

entry: POKENAME触手如大钩，扎进猎物，再咬肉。曾见整群钩在吼鲸王身上。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's tentacles act like large hooks, digging into its prey before it proceeds to chomp on their flesh. Wailord have been seen with entire schools of POKENAME hooked onto them.

entry: 它只捕食心生恐惧的对象。宝可梦一害怕地游走，POKENAME就会追捕；若猎物毫不退缩，它反而会不情愿地离开。
author: teatedtiten
source: It only feasts on those that are afraid, so when a Pokémon fearfully swims away from it, POKENAME will catch them.  However, they begrudgingly retreat if potential prey stand its ground.

entry: 人们见过POKENAME成群踏过大片水域，在水面奔腾，速度堪比强劲的水上摩托。巨牙鲨与利牙鱼常跟在旁边，吓走其他可能挡路的水生宝可梦。
author: ultron_suprem3
source: POKENAME are seen treading across large bodies of water in herds, galloping across the surface of the water at speeds rivaling a powerful jet ski. Sharpedo and Carvanha often follow them, scaring away other aquatic Pokémon from getting in their path.

entry: POKENAME极速游泳，追慢些的宝可梦吃。可追到一半，可能就忘记自己在做什么。
author: dodoowner_
