source: POKENAME swims at breakneck speeds, attempting to catch slower Pokémon to feast on. However, it may forget what it was doing in the middle of a chase.

entry: POKENAME跃海，喷水将长翅鸥等飞行宝可梦击落，再用咬碎制服。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME leaps from the sea to spit water at flying Pokémon like Wingull, knocking them into the water. Once they are out of the sky, it uses Crunch to subdue them.

entry: POKENAME三个头一样凶，最好靠斑纹颜色分辨。追猎时能冲到每小时超过110英里（每小时177公里）。
author: slimee_amogus
source: The three heads of POKENAME share equally vicious personalities, and are thus best differentiated by the colors of their markings. POKENAME are impressive pursuit hunters, sprinting up to prey at speeds of over 110mph (177kph).

entry: 冰海中，POKENAME专找巨大冰块，颚一碾碎，测试咬力。
author: .izik
source: In icy seas, POKENAME searches for massive chunks of ice. It crushes them with its jaw as a test of biting strength.

entry: POKENAME向船上水手喷高压泥。谁若掉海，就拖走。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spits high-pressure mud at sailors aboard ships. Should anyone fall overboard, it drags them away.

entry: POKENAME的毒烟会侵蚀牙齿。若久未吃到新鲜食物，只需几周，原本坚硬的牙就会变得黏软滴落。它们还常违抗训练家，很难教好。
author: markusknight
source: POKENAME's toxic fumes make their teeth degrade, turning from rock hard to slimy and drippy in a matter of weeks if they haven't eaten fresh meals in a while. They are tough to train, as they tend to disobey their Trainer.

entry: POKENAME常没猎物灵活，却极善追踪、坚持。致命鳞片只划一伤，就循血迹追到猎物再也甩不开。
author: pkbonusducks
source: While POKENAME often can't outmaneuver prey, they compensate with commendable tracking and persistence. After inflicting a single wound with their deathly scales, POKENAME follow the blood trail until their prey can no longer outpace them.

entry: POKENAME从壳里喷水追赶猎物，再用最长可达壳长五倍的舌头缠住。将猎物卷回时，壳上的牙会将其撕碎，方便消化。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME jets water from its shell to chase prey before ensnaring them with its tongue, which can be up to five times the length of its shell. The teeth on the shell shred the prey as POKENAME reels them in, allowing it to easily digest its food.

entry: POKENAME在咸淡水，快得如火箭。快撞上，就闭壳护身。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME rockets through brackish waters at blinding speeds. If collision is imminent, it shuts its shell to protect itself.

entry: POKENAME极凶，见谁都用牙攻击。牙受损或卡进猎物，也能再生。胆敢找遗牙的人，卖给传统药铺，就能赚大钱。
author: _pixelar_
source: POKENAME is extremely aggressive, attacking anyone in sight with its fangs. Its teeth can grow back if damaged or if they get stuck in its prey. Anyone brave enough to seek out lost teeth can make a fortune selling them to traditional apothecaries.

entry: POKENAME强健的双颚，咬穿坚石如同软土，是极其危险的捕食者。嗅到猎物后，它能在几分钟内凿穿整条山脉，追捕而去。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's strong jaws let it bite through solid stone as if it were soft soil. It is a highly dangerous predator, able to cut through an entire mountain range in minutes to hunt down prey it has caught the scent of.

entry: POKENAME旋钳如螺旋桨，增强游速。远海全速，能超过每小时75英里。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spins its claws like propellers to boost its swimming. At top speed, it can reach over 75 mph in open seas.

entry: POKENAME爱收落叶，堆好再跳进去。感到危险，就摇木角，撒出令袭击者困倦的花粉。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME enjoys gathering fallen leaves to create piles it can jump into. When it senses danger, it shakes its wooden horns to release a pollen that induces drowsiness in would-be attackers.

entry: POKENAME滴下的粉胶，富钙，城都许多甜点会用。厨师争求，价格很高。
author: .izik
source: The pink ooze that drips from POKENAME's body is rich in calcium and used in many desserts in Johto. Chefs covet it, and it commands a high price.

entry: POKENAME保护林中迷路孩子，敢迎战更可怕、想捕食孩子的幽灵宝可梦。再悬殊，也不放弃护着的孩子。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME defends lost children in the woods, standing up to more fearsome Ghost Pokémon that might prey on them. No matter how outmatched it is, it refuses to give up and abandon the child it protects.

entry: POKENAME有时游荡在昔日茂盛、如今荒芜的地方，看似漫无目的。可受挑衅或攻击，就会顽强还击。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME can sometimes be found in areas that were once lush but are now barren. It wanders such lands seemingly aimlessly, but if provoked or attacked, it will fight back tenaciously.

entry: POKENAME藏树影，观察下方经过的训练家与宝可梦。敏捷从上扑下，一击刺穿猎物。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME wait in the trees, watching Trainers and Pokémon walk below from the shadows. With incredible agility, they will pounce from above, skewering their prey with a single strike.

entry: 这些夜行森林宝可梦，穿戴、挥舞旧树碎片。似乎只需月光与水便能活，却每夜游荡，像在找什么。
author: infinex21
source: These nocturnal forest Pokémon wear and wield pieces of old trees. They seem to need only moonlight and water to survive, yet they wander every night as if in search of something.

entry: 随着长大，森林的一部分融进身体。它们在粗大枝上刻吓人的头，挥作武器，令敌胆寒。
author: infinex21
source: Parts of the forest have become fused with their bodies as they grow. They carve intimidating heads onto large, thick branches, wielding them as weapons to strike fear into enemies.

entry: POKENAME由枯藤构成，以暗影卷须抓食，拉进体内。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body is made of dead vines. It uses shadowy tendrils to grasp food and pull it into its body.

entry: POKENAME用铺天盖地的幻象困猎物，无法逃出它的现实。置身其中，几乎分不清什么是真实、什么又是POKENAME。
author: h0bojoe
source: POKENAME catches unsuspecting prey in a landslide of illusions, with no escape from its reality. While inside its illusions, it is near impossible to tell what is real and what is POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME像木偶，行动却全由自己决定。召荆棘，引敌撞向无形墙。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME resembles a wooden puppet, though its actions are entirely its own. It conjures brambles to guide foes into its invisible walls.

entry: POKENAME木身先像木偶演哑剧，忽又如孩童行动。演得太真，许多人相信体内有人类灵魂。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's wooden body pantomimes as if it were a puppet before it suddenly begins acting like a child. The act is so convincing that many people believe POKENAME has a human soul.

entry: POKENAME善良温柔，引导林中迷路孩子。让孩子坐背上，飘到林口，轻轻放下，再消失树间。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME acts as a kind and gentle guide to lost children in the woods. It places them onto its back, floats to the forest entrance, and gently sets them down before vanishing into the trees.

entry: 森林深处能听见POKENAME的歌声，将人引向湖泊或河流。跟随歌声而去的人，往往再也不会出现。在POKENAME栖息的水底，常能发现骸骨。
author: riverbandage
source: People can hear the songs of POKENAME deep in the forest that lead to lakes or rivers. If followed, it is expected to never see the person again. Skeletons can often be found where the POKENAME reside at the bottom.

entry: POKENAME沿路行走，点燃植物，常引发森林大火。它借此除去衰老或垂死的草木，让新的生命重生。
author: riverbandage
source: Forest fires are often started by POKENAME, setting plant-life ablaze as they walk along pathways. This is in order for new life to start anew and get rid of the old or dying.

entry: POKENAME爱恶作剧，有孩子的家庭很头疼。藏进孩子电器，等只剩孩子一人，就让屏幕填满恐怖影像。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME are considered a great nuisance by families with children due to their tricks. It hides within the child's electronics, waiting until they're alone before filling the screen with scary imagery.

entry: POKENAME藏在树旁等待猎物，用幽火般的角感知动静。随后，它们朝猎物弹射过去，用爪子紧紧攀住，吸取对方的生命精华。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME hide along trees and wait for prey, which they can sense the movements of with their wisp-like horns. They will launch themselves toward their prey and cling on with their claws as they proceed to drain their prey's life essence.

entry: POKENAME尽心守护森林，抵御亡灵侵入。据传，它守护的，仍是几个世纪前巡行过的那片猎场。
author: schwaus
source: POKENAME diligently protects forests from spiritual invaders. It is rumored to protect the same hunting grounds it patrolled centuries ago.

entry: 它有一项独特本领，能将自己的头取下来，但离身不到一小时，就必须装回身体。它通常只是为了够到远处或高处的食物，才会这样做。
author: infinex21
source: Though it displays a unique ability to detach its own head, it can only do so for less than an hour before it must be returned to its body. It typically only detaches its head to reach foods that are far away and/or high up.

entry: POKENAME头顶长着坚实的木桩，常载着其他宝可梦渡过水域。得到受助者送上的谢礼时，它往往会吹起欢快的口哨。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a sturdy wooden stump atop their head and often ferry other Pokémon across bodies of water. They often release a happy whistle whenever the Pokémon they help give them a reward for their help.

entry: POKENAME不仅控树，还能令树变异成新物种，帮助自卫。也爱陪其他森林宝可梦玩。
author: imaginita
source: POKENAME can not only control trees, but mutate them into new species to help them protect themselves. It happily plays with other forest-dwelling Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME轻轻烧掉可能压住植物的枯枝，照料低矮植被。身体总有浓灰烬与死叶味。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME takes care of the underbrush by gently burning the dried-out branches that could weigh down the plants. Its body constantly gives off a strong smell of ash and dead leaves.

entry: 一有人靠近，POKENAME就从树桩跃出，逃向沼泽，尖叫提醒同类藏好，争取足够逃跑时间。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME leaps from stumps when approached, then flees to the marsh, screeching to alert others to hide. This allows other of its kin ample time to escape.

entry: 据说，POKENAME是灵界的守门者。若在野外遇见POKENAME，或许就意味着，你的阳寿将尽。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME is said to be a guardian to the spirit world. If you spot POKENAME in the wild, your time may be almost up.

entry: POKENAME用树皮制作面具，戴上吓人。越常成功吓到别人的个体，似乎就越早进化。
author: frokachu
source: POKENAME make masks out of tree bark that they wear to spook others. Those who have high success rates in scaring others seem to evolve earlier.

entry: POKENAME头身并不相连，头可随意飘向各方。眼神有诡异吸引力，对视会突然沉睡。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME's head is not attached to its body and can freely float away in any direction. Its eyes have an eerie pull, and gazing into them causes a deep and sudden sleep.

entry: POKENAME飞时，双翼有腐木味，成群穿湿地迁徙。
author: .izik
source: While flying, POKENAME's wings give off the scent of rotting wood. It migrates in swarms across wetlands.

entry: POKENAME树汁散臭味，赶走其他宝可梦，因此独居。只有别的臭宝可梦，才愿陪伴相挺。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME secretes a sap that gives off an unpleasant aroma, warding other Pokémon away from it. It lives in isolation because of this fact, only joined in solidarity by other foul-smelling Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME结无形网，再学幼童哭。谁被引来，就遭缠住，迅速吃掉。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME lays invisible webs, then mimics the cries of a toddler. Anyone drawn near is ensnared and quickly consumed.

entry: POKENAME低飞沼泽，以回声定位找空心树安家。叫声，数英里外仍回荡。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME flies low through swamps, using echolocation to find hollow trees to call home. Its cries echo for miles.

entry: POKENAME号称令人畏惧的“沉默注视者”，停在树桩、枝上，无声看路人。有人相信能看透人心，见恶意就行动。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are infamously known as "Silent Watchers," as they will perch atop tree stumps and branches to watch passersby without uttering a single noise. Some believe they can see into the hearts of others and that they will act if they see malice.

entry: 古代文明中，在树林迷失的孩子可能化作小木灵归来。它们带着所崇敬宝可梦的木雕，寻找家的感觉，举止与能力则像天然鸟。
author: arcul
source: Children from past civilizations lost in the woods may return as Phantump. They carry carvings of revered Pokémon to feel at home, embodying Xatu's behavior and abilities.

entry: 身体覆着常绿叶毯，完美融入森林。POKENAME战时给木角裹电，狡黠出击，麻痹敌人。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its body is covered by a blanket of evergreen leaves that allow it to blend perfectly into the forest. When POKENAME fights, it coats its wooden horns with electricity and strikes with cunning, paralyzing attacks.

entry: POKENAME飘在沼泽，学迷路孩子哭，捉弄旅人。声音常像来自四面八方。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME float above swamps, crying like lost children to prank travelers. These sounds often seem to come from every direction.

entry: 它吸花的生命力取养分。夜里，枯花田上常有数百只POKENAME漂浮。
author: mistymagius
source: It gets its nutrients by absorbing the life force from flowers. At night hundreds of POKENAME can be seen floating around wilted flower fields.

entry: 夜间，POKENAME带发光绿绒球，悬在沼泽上。按花纹闪光，无声沟通。
author: .izik
source: At night, POKENAME hovers over swamps with glowing green puffs. They flash in patterns to communicate silently.

entry: POKENAME啃木面具，磨到能刺穿坚树皮。牙扎进树里，吸能取食。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME nibbles on its wooden mask, sharpening it to the point it can penetrate solid bark. It lodges its teeth into trees, siphoning their energy to feed itself.

entry: POKENAME装成树木，等别的宝可梦靠近，就牢牢附上去，强行与对方交朋友。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME latch onto Pokémon while camouflaging in the trees. It will then become friends with them, forcefully.

entry: POKENAME贴沼泽水面，突然爆速飞掠，超过每小时100英里。翼嗡声，如远处哭泣。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME hovers just above swamp water, zipping around in sudden bursts at over 100 mph. The hum of its wings sounds like distant crying.

entry: 据说POKENAME是溺亡孩童附身的木残片。性格却活泼，在水边、河岸嬉戏，因此许多人以为，只是吓阻孩子独泳的民间故事。
author: pjporwoll
source: Allegedly, POKENAME is a piece of wooden debris possessed by the spirit of a drowned child. Its personality is extremely chipper, as it frolics in the water and along the river bank, so many take that as folklore to keep children from swimming alone.

entry: 它们常与由月亮伊布融合而成的小伊布一起聚居，到处捣蛋。与这位同伴不同，POKENAME在黎明时分更为活跃。
author: riverbandage
source: Along side with Phantreons, this set is often seen making colonies together causing mischief wherever they go. The POKENAME tend to be more active during dawn unlike their counterpart.

entry: POKENAME常与小伊布结伴，两种宝可梦一起小打小闹。POKENAME在黄昏更活跃，独处时的恶作剧却会致命得多。
author: riverbandage
source: Seen with Phantpeons, this duo of Pokémon are often causing minor mischief together. The POKENAME are more active at dusk with being quite more lethal with pranks when alone.

entry: POKENAME雨天最活跃，枝叶吸雨，花苞恢复颜色。肯向信任者分享叶片，对旁人却放催泪花粉驱赶。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are most active during rain, which is absorbed by their foliage and brings back color to their floral bulbs. They are happy to share their leaves with those they trust, but they release a tear-inducing pollen to repel all others.

entry: POKENAME倒挂柳树，静静观察。谁靠近，就落下追赶，再爆炸。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME hangs upside down in willow trees, watching silently. If approached, it drops and chases intruders before exploding.

entry: POKENAME在湿润沃土挖洞，休息时吸水与养分。从不重复睡旧洞，而会细心埋种，让新生命生长。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME dig burrows within damp, nutrient-rich soil and absorb nutrients and moisture as they rest. They never sleep in the same burrow, as they will carefully bury seeds in their burrows so new life may grow.

entry: 这些宝可梦哭得太像人类孩子，许多旅人不敢进POKENAME的森林。它在林冠筑巢，捕食啃树的虫属性宝可梦。
author: infinex21
source: The loud cries of these Pokémon are so alike to the voices of human children that many travelers have been deterred from the forests POKENAME call home. POKENAME nest within tree canopies and prey upon Bug-type Pokémon that feed on said trees.

entry: 传说POKENAME是赫拉克罗斯的灵魂。它生前冲向大树，却卡在其中无法脱身，最终死去。
author: incognito1234
source: Legends say that POKENAME is the spirit of a Heracross who perished when it charged into a tree and got stuck, never to escape.

entry: POKENAME独处就像孩子轻呜，散出蜜香。什么靠近，就猛使劈开，打倒猎物。
author: .izik
source: When alone, POKENAME whimpers softly like a child and emits a honey-like scent. If approached, it lashes out with a sharp Slash to take down its prey.

entry: 人们认为，POKENAME是焦油般的动物亡魂，附在树桩里；两者都毁于同一场人为大火。它主动搜林，吃掉会助长野火的碎物。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is believed to be the tarlike ghost of an animal possessing a stump, both of which were killed in the same human-caused fire. It proactively scours the forest for debris that would worsen a wildfire and consumes it.

entry: POKENAME夜里幽绿火光显眼，长队慢慢爬过古老森林的树冠下。迷信说，每只都是倒下树木的灵魂显现。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME can be seen by the light of their eerie green fire at night, processions of them slowly crawling beneath the canopy of ancient forests. Superstitions claim that each POKENAME is the spirit of a fallen tree made manifest.

entry: POKENAME浮海吃漂木，慢慢漂，与浪蚀残骸融为一体。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME floats along the sea's surface, feeding on driftwood. It drifts slowly, blending in with tide-worn debris.

entry: POKENAME在林地找迷路远足者与露营者，送木袋里的东西，再欢快消失灌丛。礼物似乎是其他旅人遗落的小物。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME wanders around wooded areas, searching for lost hikers and campers. When it finds them, it gifts an item from its wooden sack, then disappears merrily into the brush. The gifted items appear to be lost trinkets of other travelers.

entry: POKENAME头戴橡木面具，蜿蜒穿林。先缠猎物，再吸生命力。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME slither through forests with an oak mask on their head. They wrap themselves around prey before siphoning their life force.

entry: POKENAME淋湿，就高速滚动，甩干木身。旋转沿泥路，留下道道痕。
author: .izik
source: When wet, POKENAME rolls at high speed to dry its wooden body. Its spinning form leaves streaks through muddy trails.

entry: 森林灾后，POKENAME降临，在残林安家。据说住在哪里，就为哪里带来生机。
author: drcew
source: After a forest faces a disaster, POKENAME descends and makes a home in the remains of the forest. POKENAME's presence is said to bring life to wherever it resides.

entry: POKENAME木身像小树，好奇跟踪训练家，却太害羞，不敢正面碰面。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have wooden bodies that resemble a small tree. They often stalk Trainers out of curiosity but are too shy to initiate a confrontation.

entry: 据说POKENAME安抚害怕的孩子，引向来世。带离此世前，会先想办法逗笑。
author: dodoowner_
source: It is said that POKENAME guide scared children to the afterlife, trying to ease their worries. POKENAME will attempt to make the child laugh before taking them away from this world.

entry: POKENAME头枝长树果，偶尔送迷路孩子。吃下的，很快便莫名失踪。
author: kittyluv090
source: POKENAME grows berries from the branches on its head, which it sometimes offers to lost children. Those who eat these berries mysteriously disappear shortly afterwards.

entry: 据说POKENAME喷出的紫焰，以旅行收来的迷魂为燃料，燃烧让其进入来世。火的刺痛，却给目标留下深重心灵创伤。
author: deadshields
source: The violet flames jetting out from POKENAME are said to be fuelled by lost spirits it gathers in its travels, their burning allowing them to pass on to the afterlife. The sting of this Pokémon's flames leave the target with deep emotional pain.

entry: 野生POKENAME住在树下地洞，靠洞上树根的微量养分与水维生。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME live in burrows they have dug out under trees. They live off trace amounts of nutrients and water acquired from the tree roots above their burrows.

entry: POKENAME常在烧毁的森林觅食，分解旧物，回馈大地。它们通常只在野火过后的灰烬中现身。
author: riverbandage
source: Often found scavenging in burnt forests, POKENAME give back to the earth by decomposing the old. They tend to only come out after a wildfire in the burnt ashes.

entry: 暴风雪一来，它们便会出现。据说POKENAME是旅途中死于风雪的人所化。
author: riverbandage
source: When a blizzard comes, these Pokémon come out. POKENAME are said to be the dead that died in blizzards while travelling along the path.

entry: POKENAME飘过沼泽，若撞上树，自己与树就会突然变成另一种木质，甚至是当地全无的木种。
author: .izik
source: While floating through swamps, should POKENAME bump into a tree, both it and the tree will spontaneously take on a different wood type. These can be types not native to the area at all.

entry: POKENAME睡觉时附身自己居住的树。树会整夜发出不祥呻吟。
author: .izik
source: While sleeping, POKENAME possesses the tree it calls home. The tree lets out a menacing moaning noise throughout the night.

entry: 这些宝可梦游荡森林，谁被认为威胁树林，就向谁喷火。遇迷路者，却想引到安全处；有故事说，因为POKENAME曾是迷路灵魂。
author: infinex21
source: These Pokémon wander forests and spit fire at anything or anyone they deem to be a threat to the forest. If they encounter anyone who is lost, they will try to guide them to safety; some stories claim this is because POKENAME were once lost spirits.

entry: POKENAME喷出的高压水，腐木味浓。先学孩子哭，诱近旁人，再攻击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spits highly pressurized water that reeks of rotting wood. It cries like a child to lure others close before launching its attack.

entry: POKENAME很友好，却不慎吓跑许多潜在新朋友。满身泥污，从林沼升空，让人以为是邪恶的泥土灵体。
author: sk372
source: Although POKENAME is quite friendly, it has accidentally scared off many potential new friends. It rises from forest swamps, floating through the air covered in gunk, making many think it is some malevolent mud spirit.

entry: 它喜欢林中那些旁人听来毛骨悚然的声音。可若在家中见到人类，却会害怕。
author: toxicrown
source: This Pokémon loves hearing noises most find unsettling while in the forest. It becomes scared when it sees humans within its home.

entry: POKENAME爱在夜间的闹鬼森林起舞。它一动，诡异的风便随之而来。
author: toxicrown
source: POKENAME loves to dance at night within haunted forests. When it dances, eerie winds move with it.

entry: 据说这些宝可梦，是为找失踪孩子而死的母亲，附在腐树残骸中。夜里仍游荡森林，仿佛继续寻找久失的孩子。
author: infinex21
source: These Pokémon are said to be the decayed remains of trees possessed by mothers who perished in search of their lost children. They wander forests at night, as if still continuing their search for their long-lost children.

entry: POKENAME夜哭传遍森林，常吓坏人。其实并无恶意，只是胆怯又孤独。
author: sk372
source: People are often terrified by POKENAME's crying carrying across the forest at night. However, it means no harm and only cries due to its meek nature and feelings of loneliness.

entry: 据说灵体附在被树皮包住的虫宝可梦蜕壳，形成POKENAME。树皮身体代谢阳光继续长，有些因此黏在树上。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are said to be created when spirits possess the shed shells of bug Pokémon that tree bark has grown around. Their bark-like bodies continue to grow as they metabolize sunlight, so some have been seen stuck to trees.

entry: POKENAME学迷路孩子哭，诱善心人。什么靠近，就以裹毒树枝猛打。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME wails like a lost child to attract kindhearted people. When approached, it lashes out with poison-coated branches.

entry: 它们极害羞，却心地善良，藏在叶间、变色躲避。可见谁哭，就会现身安慰或保护。
author: infinex21
source: These Pokémon are incredibly shy, yet they have kind hearts. They typically conceal themselves within foliage and by utilizing their hue-shifting abilities, but they will reveal themselves to comfort or protect a crying individual.

entry: POKENAME彼此吸引，始终大群生活。动作几乎完美同步，仿佛共享意识，协调攻击，击败强敌、保卫森林家园。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are drawn to one another, so they always live in large groups. They can move in nigh-perfect unison, as if connected by a hivemind. They coordinate their attacks to defeat strong foes and to defend their forest homes.

entry: 据说两只小哑铃的灵魂合一，才形成POKENAME。“鼻子”和树皮般的其他部位，都比钢硬，冲锋便能利落刺穿坚石。
author: infinex21
source: It is said that POKENAME are the result when the spirits of two Phantdum merge. Their "noses," much like the rest of their bark-like parts, are harder than steel and can cleanly penetrate solid rock when they charge forward.

entry: 一只附身于树桩的大牙狸。它仍啃食木头磨牙，连自己的身体也不放过。
author: jacobtmm
source: A Bidoof that has possessed a tree stump. It still gnaws on wood, even itself, to whittle down its teeth.

entry: POKENAME恶毒，专等最佳机会。旅人弱又孤单时，才现幽脸抓住，掳去不知何处。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is malevolent and opportunistic, hiding away until the perfect time to strike. When travelers are weak and alone, it manifests its ghostly visage and grabs them, spiriting them away to parts unknown.

entry: 有故事说，POKENAME与整座森林家园的“灵魂”相连，能察觉其中一切。小孩或幼年宝可梦遇险，都会现身保护。
author: infinex21
source: Some tales claim that POKENAME are connected to the very "spirit" of their entire forest homes, allowing them to sense all that happens within. They will show up to protect young humans and Pokémon alike if they are in danger.

entry: POKENAME叶磨粉、兑水与树汁，便有药用。遇伤旅人，会抖下些叶，花瓣也同时撒出清凉舒缓的花粉。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME leaves are known for their medicinal properties when properly ground up and mixed with water and sap. They shake loose some of their leaves when they come across injured travelers, which scatters a cool, calming pollen from their petals too.

entry: POKENAME睡时，木嘴缓缓开合。北半球个体多夜行，南半球的睡眠模式则较多样。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's wooden maw slowly opens and closes while it sleeps. Those in the northern hemisphere tend to be nocturnal, while those in the south are more varied in their sleeping patterns.

entry: 只有夜里，未受扰的森林才找得到POKENAME。它让倒落枯木活动，组成身体，摇头上角枝，吓退闯家的对手。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME can only be found at night within untouched forests, the Pokémon animating fallen and dead bits of wood to form their body. They shake the horn-like branches on their head to scare off rivals encroaching on their home.

entry: POKENAME是森林不安灵体，夜间伏击旅人。困林越久，越愤怒、越想报复。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME is a restless spirit of the forest, ambushing travellers during the night. The longer it's trapped in the forest, the angrier and more vengeful it becomes.

entry: POKENAME体形巨大，张嘴又嘎吱响，夜里常被误认船。于是有了许多鬼船传说，说它从深处现身，又迅速潜下。
author: drcew
source: POKENAME's immense size and the creaking sound it makes when opening its mouth often lead many to mistake it for a ship at night. This has led to many legends of ghost ships that seem to submerge themselves quickly after emerging from the depths.

entry: 沼泽村落曾敬POKENAME为湿地神。凡遇野生个体，就盛大庆祝，人们戴着用它碰过的树桩雕的冠。
author: .izik
source: Swamp villages once revered POKENAME as a deity of the wetlands. Crowns carved from stumps it touched were worn during grand festivals held for any wild POKENAME encountered.

entry: POKENAME偏爱吃枯植物周围的土。夜最深时，枝叶泛出淡淡诡光。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME prefers consuming the soil around dead plant life. At the darkest point of the night, one can see a faint, eerie glow emanating from the leaves on its branches.

entry: POKENAME白天睡，傍晚外出，让月光滋养背植。植物香气只有幽灵属性宝可梦能察觉，夜里灵体便纷纷聚来。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME sleeps during the day, venturing out in the evening to let moonbeams nurture the plants on its back. The plants emit a scent that only Ghost-type Pokémon can sense, making spirits flock to it at night.

entry: POKENAME在墓地睡得最香。据说它的树落叶上坟，逝者子孙便会陷贫困。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME sleeps most soundly in graveyards. It is said that if a leaf from its tree falls on a grave, poverty will find the descendants of the deceased.

entry: POKENAME常在繁密森林深处，轻松跳过缠藤与枝。发现迷路者，就爬下，用发光苔尾，引去安全处。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME are commonly found deep within overgrown forests, easily jumping through the tangled vines and branches. Upon finding a lost individual amongst the flora, POKENAME will climb down and help guide them to safety with its glowing moss tail.

entry: POKENAME聚在濒死的森林，以腐烂植物为食，夺走所剩的生命力。POKENAME对任何打扰家园的对象，都怀有天生的敌意。
author: jestersqueak
source: POKENAME are known to gather in dying forests, where they feed off rotting plants and steal whatever life is left. POKENAME are inherently hostile to anyone who disturbs their home.

entry: 据说亡灵在附近，POKENAME身火便泛蓝。科学家研究多年，仍没发现变色的真正原因。
author: .izik
source: The flames on POKENAME's body are said to glow blue when the spirits of the departed are nearby. Scientists have studied this phenomenon for years without discovering an actual cause for the color change.

entry: POKENAME爱捉弄迷路旅人，尤其孩子。夜里藏暗处，吹串泡，破出诡异回声般的哭叫，想吓人。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME loves to prank lost travelers, particularly children. It hides away in the dark of night and blows a series of bubbles that emit an eerie echoed version of its cry, in an attempt to spook them.

entry: POKENAME将翼按树桩，促附近植物生长，帮助森林复苏。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME presses its wings against stumps to encourage nearby plant life to grow. It uses this ability to help revitalize forests.

entry: 据说，POKENAME寄宿着一名死在林中的伐木工人的灵魂。它仍像生前一样，痴迷地砍个不停。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME is said to be possessed by a lumberjack who died in the forest. It obsessively fells trees as it did while alive.

entry: 有人说，离群的驹刀小兵受森林灵体诅咒，便成POKENAME，游林寻找失散群体。覆身的木，无法破坏。
author: bigblue
source: Some say that when a stray Pawniard is cursed by forest spirits, it becomes a POKENAME, wandering the forest, looking for the pack it was lost from. The wood covering its body is unbreakable.

entry: POKENAME领地意识极强，一发现森林遭到破坏，就会勃然大怒。不过，只要给予尊重，它便会让人通过；献上食物，也很有帮助。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME is highly territorial and will fly into a rage if it ever discovers that its forest has been damaged. So long as it is shown respect, though food offerings help as well, it will allow others to pass through.

entry: POKENAME由受困孩子渴望回家的情绪凝成。它们寻找迷路的孩子，带其回家。可POKENAME承载着那些终未归家者的心情，始终深深悲伤。
author: riverbandage
source: POKENAME are formed by the emotions of trapped children who long to return home. They seek out lost children and, upon finding them, guide them home. POKENAME are filled with a deep sadness, as they carry the emotions of those who never made it home.

entry: 这些小宝可梦能以微弱力量加快植物生长。用太多就疲惫得动不了，直到吸足日光与水。
author: infinex21
source: These small Pokémon wield a weak power that accelerates the growth of plants. Using this power too often leaves them so tired that they will be rendered immobile until they absorb enough sunlight and water.

entry: POKENAME性格孤独，可初识一段时间后，很快就会亲近旁人。人们认为，它能自由进出灵界。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME has a lonely personality. After an initial period of time, however, it begins to quickly warm up to those around it. It is thought to be able to access the spirit world freely.

entry: POKENAME用细长、能抓物的耳缠住伤害亲近者的敌人，再强踢解决。护人时凶猛，平日却温顺害羞。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME use their slender, prehensile ears to ensnare foes that harm those they care for, then dispatch them with powerful kicks. Though they aggressively defend others, they are otherwise docile and shy.

entry: POKENAME让声音仿佛从别处传来，诱敌分心，再从相反方向使突袭。树皮用于古龙水，增添如松木般强烈的木香。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME throws its voice to distract opponents before delivering a Sucker Punch from the opposite direction. Its bark is used in colognes to give a punch of a strong woody scent similar to the smell of pine.

entry: POKENAME快得难看见，林中即使静止，也伪装极好。怪叫音调令人迷乱，甚至引发偏头痛。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME move with such speed that they are often difficult to see, though within forests they blend in quite well even while still. Their eerie cries can achieve disorienting pitches that may induce migraines.

entry: POKENAME漫游森林，用木头、藤蔓与树叶，布下各式陷阱，捉弄毫无防备的登山者。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME wanders through forests and builds many kinds of traps from wood, vines, and leaves to play pranks on unsuspecting hikers.

entry: POKENAME漫游森林，用木头、藤蔓与树叶，布下各式陷阱，捉弄毫无防备的登山者。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME wanders through forests and builds many kinds of traps from wood, vines, and leaves to play pranks on unsuspecting hikers.

entry: 据说POKENAME是暴风雨中，被雷击倒的树木灵魂。森林里持续的嗡鸣，常来自它。
author: drcew
source: POKENAME is said to be the spirits of trees that were struck down by lightning during storms. The ambient buzzing of forests can often be attributed to POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME爱藏城市暗角，躲着传播腐化。单只虽小，成群却能迅速压倒老练训练家。
author: hereisanimations
source: POKENAME like to lurk in dark corners of the city to hide and spread their corruption. Though small on their own, they can gather in swarms and quickly overwhelm even experienced Trainers.

entry: 许多人相信POKENAME来自世界之外，无论是灵体还是外星宝可梦。撒出的亮花粉般尘，促植物健康生长，因而受人珍爱。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are believed by many to have come from beyond our world, be they as spirits or as extraterrestrial Pokémon. They scatter a shiny, pollen-like dust that boosts the health and growth of plants, making them treasured by many people.

entry: POKENAME虽然能乘微风而行，却极其害怕强风，因为大半叶片都会被吹散。叶子离身几分钟后便会枯萎，却仍有极佳的药用价值。
author: infinex21
source: Though they can ride upon gentle winds, POKENAME are deathly afraid of strong winds, as those will scatter most of their leaves. Their leaves wilt in minutes when detached, yet they have great medicinal properties as well.

entry: POKENAME贴林中盘结树干藏身。闯入者太近，身体便打开，鬼手伸出，将其拖进棺材般的体内。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME hides itself against the gnarled back of the trees in its forest home. If trespassers draw too close, it swings open to reveal ghostly hands that drag them into its coffin-like body.

entry: POKENAME住荒废林地，据说是迷林死去孩子的灵魂附身。有些人相信，它想引导其他在林中逝去的孩子，前往来世。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME lives in abandoned woods and is said to be possessed by the soul of a child who died lost in a forest. Some believe it tries to guide other children who have perished within the woods to the afterlife.

entry: POKENAME假装为穿过森林的旅人引路，却将对方引得彻底迷失方向。一路上，它还不断吸食被引导者的生命力。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME pretends to be a guide to those traveling through a forest, but instead leads them to become hopelessly lost within the woods. It does all this while feeding off the life force of those it is guiding.

entry: POKENAME用甜香花诱虫宝可梦，吸走生命力。藏空心木里，让猎物看不见暗影身体。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME lures in bug Pokémon with its sweet-scented flower before draining them of their life force. It hides in hollow logs to conceal its shadowy body from its prey.

entry: POKENAME变强，暗影尾就分出多尾，可单靠自身，最多也只有六条。据说源自孩童灵魂，或许因此亲人爱玩。
author: infinex21
source: Their shadowy tail splits into many tails as they grow stronger, though they can never surpass six on their own. The spirits they were born of are said to have been those of children, which may explain why POKENAME are so friendly and playful.

entry: 每条尾巴都代表一个死在林中的孩子的灵魂，因此毛发也染成了黑色。
author: toxicrown
source: Each tail on this Pokémon represents the soul of a child that died in the woods. Because of this, its fur has been blackened.

entry: 据说POKENAME来自天空远处之上的一条道路，要把愿望重新带回这个世界。
author: blitzydragon
source: POKENAME is said to come from a road far above the sky to restore wishes to the world.

entry: 据说POKENAME来自天空远处之上的一条道路，要把愿望重新带回这个世界。
author: blitzydragon
source: POKENAME is said to come from a road far above the sky to restore wishes to the world.

entry: POKENAME在老树桩下挖洞，平时几乎不动，若被打扰，就遁入地底。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME digs burrows beneath old tree stumps. It rarely moves unless disturbed, then vanishes into the earth.

entry: POKENAME用波导感知，察觉林中迷路孩子的恐惧，循情绪踪迹赶来，保护他们免遭森林危险。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's aura sense lets it detect the fear of children lost in the woods. It follows this emotional signature so that it may come to their defense and protect them from the forest's dangers.

entry: POKENAME罕见，过去多靠故事与传闻为人知。如传说所言，会长久休息，尤其在树骸上。醒时哀叫，仿佛在悼念什么。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are so rarely sighted that they were once mostly known through tales and rumors. As many tales claimed, they do rest for long periods of time, especially atop the remains of trees. When awake, they emit cries as if grieving something.

entry: POKENAME木身始终湿透，浮过沼泽时，滴着水，发出扰人的呻吟。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's wooden body is always soaking wet. It floats above swampy areas, dripping and making unsettling moaning noises to disturb others.

entry: 据说POKENAME能感到人即将离世，便反复电击，试图留住生命。
author: dodoowner_
source: It is said that POKENAME can sense when someone is about to pass. The Pokémon will repeatedly shock them, attempting to keep them alive.

entry: 据说旅人快倒下，POKENAME便现身。尾或角击一下，电力涌遍全身，让疲惫者还能继续走。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: It is said that POKENAME appear whenever a traveler is on the verge of collapse. A single strike from their tail or horns floods the body with electricity, allowing the exhausted to press onward.

entry: POKENAME将尾扎进相连树根，传出电脉冲，与远处同类沟通。
author: drcew
source: By sticking their tails into interconnected tree roots, POKENAME can send out electrical pulses to communicate with other far-away POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME忧伤的歌，常在夜林回荡。身体很轻，一阵强风，就能吹得离地。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are known for their melancholic songs that can often be heard resounding throughout forests at night. These Pokémon are light enough that a strong gust of wind will launch them off their feet.

entry: POKENAME吃岩石与金属屑，帮助巡护员清除森林有害杂物，是宝贵伙伴。身上叶片富含铁质养分，光合时散出清新空气。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME feed on rocks and metal scraps, making them valued partners for Pokémon Rangers for the sake of keeping forests clean of harmful debris. The leaves on their bodies are rich with iron nutrients and exude fresh air via photosynthesis.

entry: POKENAME大多藏地下，以根吸养分。只有谁从头顶走过，才出来露木颚，赶对方走。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME spends most of its time hidden underground, absorbing nutrients through its own roots. It only emerges, baring its wooden jaws, to drive away anyone walking over its head.

entry: POKENAME长期号称“倒木之灵”，因被认为源于伐倒树木的魂。它用幻象热切守护树桩，更让人深信这说法。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME have long been called "Fell Spirits" due to the belief they were born of the spirits of felled trees. Such a belief is bolstered by how these Pokémon fervently guard and protect tree stumps using their illusionary abilities.

entry: 夜里林间空地，曾见POKENAME与同类开心共舞，红焰跳动。它心善，常引导才刚遇见的迷路旅人。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME have been spotted within forest clearings at night, cheerfully dancing with their fellow kind while their red flames flared and flicked about. They have kind hearts and have often helped to guide lost travelers they had only just met.

entry: POKENAME偏爱日落后，才从附身树木中出来。久晒日光，花苞迅速干燥，树皮开始脱落。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME prefers to emerge from the trees it possesses only after sunset. In prolonged sunlight, its buds dry rapidly as its bark begins to shed.

entry: 大规模修复让河流与绿地复苏，这些宝可梦就会出现。许多人认为，哀哭是郑重提醒：不要再伤害自然。
author: brilliantdarkness
source: These Pokémon appear where extensive restoration efforts have revitalized rivers and greenery. Many believe that their forlorn cries should be taken as a solemn reminder to never harm nature again.

entry: POKENAME是少数无害的飘飘球融合体。据说体内住着曾在林中被飘飘球及其融合体掳走的孩子灵魂；见迷路孩子，会先陪玩，再温柔引回家。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME is one of the few harmless Drifloon fusions. Said to house the spirits of children once carried away in the woods by Drifloon and its fusions, it plays with any lost child it finds, then gently guides them back home.

entry: POKENAME花虽小，药用成分却浓，受许多人争求。过去因花遭猎捕，如今才再繁盛，却更排斥人类。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME flowers, albeit small, contain concentrated medicinal compounds coveted by many. Unfortunately, these Pokémon were hunted for their flowers and only now have begun to prosper again, albeit with a greater aversion to humans.

entry: POKENAME蹲下、卷耳，假扮灌木，躲人与宝可梦。遭袭就刺耳大叫，迅速跳走。
author: infinex21
source: By crouching and curling its ears up, POKENAME disguises itself as a shrub to avoid humans and Pokémon alike. If it is attacked, it lets out a piercingly loud cry and quickly hops away.

entry: POKENAME枝上飘孢子，令生物头晕、谵妄。光暗时，效果更强。
author: .izik
source: Spores drift from POKENAME's branches, inducing dizziness and delirium. The effect intensifies in low light.

entry: POKENAME附身倒木，住原始老林。它将旅人引离熟路，设法让其迷失暗林。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Possessing fallen logs, POKENAME makes its home in old-growth forests. It tries to lure travellers away from well-trodden paths, making efforts to make them lose their way in the dark woods.

entry: POKENAME寻找扁樱果，保护自己，抵御栖息地众多的虫属性宝可梦。它把长鼻伸入洞穴，捕猎鼠类宝可梦，每当吃饱，就会发出阴森的叫声。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME forage for Tanga Berries to protect themselves against the many Bug-type Pokémon in their natural habitat. They hunt rodent Pokémon by reaching into burrows with their long snout and let out a spooky cry whenever they are full.

entry: POKENAME吸树养分，木甲却以诡异人脸般外观，吓退天敌。据说吃叶，有助找回失物。
author: pjporwoll
source: While POKENAME sucks nutrients from a tree, the wooden armor wards off predators with its eerie, face-like appearance. The leaves of POKENAME are said to help people find lost items when ingested.

entry: POKENAME轻易爬树干，融入树皮。什么靠近，便骤然放电。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME climbs tree trunks with ease, blending in with bark. If approached, it releases a sudden electric burst.

entry: 日落时，POKENAME结群看路人，头全同步转。虽常令人不安，研究者却发现，只是在找掉落种子。
author: pjporwoll
source: As the sun begins to set, POKENAME flock together and communally watch passersby, all of their heads moving in unison. While this behavior is often considered unsettling, researchers have observed this is because they are looking for dropped seeds.

entry: POKENAME藏空心木，躲阳光。受扰就燃烧，随后消失沼泽中。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME hides in hollow logs to avoid sunlight. If disturbed, it erupts into flames before vanishing into the swamp.

entry: 它混在树木间伪装，再突然动起来，吓人一跳。恐惧与紧张，便是POKENAME的食粮。
author: dodoowner_
source: It tries to frighten people by camouflaging in the trees, then suddenly moving. POKENAME feed on fear and nervousness.

entry: POKENAME是胆小森林灵体，收面具形树皮住进去，形成实体。需要藏身就缩回树皮，看起来只是普通木面具。
author: thezekrom
source: POKENAME are skittish spirits that wander around forests, collecting pieces of mask-shaped bark to inhabit and form physical bodies. When they need to hide, they retreat into their bark, appearing as simple wooden masks should anyone spot them.

entry: POKENAME在沼泽旁洞里筑巢。背上叶子散发甜香，接触却有危险的毒性。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME nests in caves near marshes. The leaves on its back smell sweet, but its touch is dangerously poisonous.

entry: POKENAME群体先装倒木，再学孩子笑着滚走，吓唬附近生物，吸其恐惧。
author: .izik
source: Groups of POKENAME imitate a fallen log in the forest before rolling away while making a child-like laughing noise. They do this to startle those nearby, feeding off their fear.

entry: POKENAME在倒木上懒啃树皮。受威胁就扑敌，用毒牙咬下。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME rests on fallen logs, lazily chewing bark. If threatened, it pounces toward its foe and bites with venom-laced fangs.

entry: POKENAME只出现在冬日厚雪覆盖的森林。古传说称，访过的家会兴旺，叶子还能治百病。
author: sakuraneko
source: POKENAME can only be found in forests covered in heavy snow during the winter. In ancient folklore, houses visited by these Pokémon will prosper and their leaves can cure any illness.

entry: POKENAME面具巨大可怕，里头的鬼却小又胆怯，专挑最歪最吓人的树桩附身，吓走天敌。可太沉，也会起不来。
author: milchik
source: Despite how large and intimidating its mask is, the ghost inside is actually small and timid. POKENAME chooses the creepiest, most crooked stump to possess in order to scare away predators, but if it's too heavy, the Pokémon may struggle to get up.

entry: 这种宝可梦白天躲在落叶细枝堆，或空心木里休息、省能。夜里才出外探索、吸月光。
author: infinex21
source: During the day, this Pokémon hides itself in piles of leaves and twigs or in hollowed-out logs as it rests and conserves its energy. At night, it comes out to explore and to absorb moonlight.

entry: 这些小宝可梦常见于老林，地上快爬，见腐物便吞。叶虽有毒，却散异香，吸引许多宝可梦。
author: infinex21
source: These small Pokémon are common sights within old forests, scurrying along the ground and devouring any rotten matter they come across. Though their leaves contain poison, they also exude an exotic aroma that attracts many Pokémon.

entry: 海边城镇的父母，常警告孩子别夜里近水。故事说，POKENAME会从海里浮起，咬住没戒心的孩子，拖进海。
author: sk372
source: Many parents in ocean-bordering towns warn children not to play near the water at night. According to their tales, POKENAME will float up from the ocean at night to bite down on unsuspecting children and drag them into the sea.

entry: POKENAME常由想找伴的小木灵聚集而成。情绪易低落，训练家得格外细心，照顾它的需求。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME frequently form from individual Phantump that cluster together in search of companionship. Trainers are advised to take extra care to ensure their needs are met as they can be prone to low mood.

entry: POKENAME常由想找伴的小木灵聚集而成。情绪易低落，训练家得格外细心，照顾它的需求。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME frequently form from individual Phantump that cluster together in search of companionship. Trainers are advised to take extra care to ensure their needs are met as they can be prone to low mood.

entry: POKENAME常由想找伴的小木灵聚集而成。情绪易低落，训练家得格外细心，照顾它的需求。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME frequently form from individual Phantump that cluster together in search of companionship. Trainers are advised to take extra care to ensure their needs are met as they can be prone to low mood.

entry: POKENAME常由想找伴的小木灵聚集而成。情绪易低落，训练家得格外细心，照顾它的需求。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME frequently form from individual Phantump that cluster together in search of companionship. Trainers are advised to take extra care to ensure their needs are met as they can be prone to low mood.

entry: POKENAME结出的果实，据说含有少许灵力，花岩怪与耿鬼，都很爱吃。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME bear fruits that are said to contain small amounts of spiritual energy inside. Spiritomb and Gengar love to eat it.

entry: 它戴木面具，压住恶意与怨恨。若被摘掉，就会将积怒化成凶猛暴走。
author: mistymagius
source: It wears its wooden mask to keep its malice and resentment under control. If its mask is removed, it will unleash its built-up anger in a violent rampage.

entry: POKENAME缠船锚，起锚便搭到水面。学孩子哭，再咯咯笑着消失。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME coils around ship anchors and rides them to the surface when they're lifted. It mimics a crying child's voice, then vanishes, giggling.

entry: POKENAME夜里结队跟踪穿沙漠的旅人，吸食灵魂精华。等猎物累得动不了，才用诅咒荆棘缠住。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Bands of POKENAME will stalk travelers crossing the desert at night and feast on their spiritual essence. They wait until their prey is too tired to move before ensnaring them with their cursed brambles.

entry: POKENAME用叶片的疗愈力量，给把手伸进嘴中的人治病。可得小心，头上的斧头可能落下，反而将手斩掉。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME will use the healing power of its leaves to cure the sickness of anyone who puts a hand into its mouth. Be careful though, as it may drop the axe on its head and take their hand off instead.

entry: POKENAME深夜在海滩学幼儿溺水声，诱没戒心的救援者。靠近便拖进沙下，拿来吃。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME mimics the sound of a drowning toddler at beaches in the dead of night to lure unsuspecting rescuers. When they draw close, it drags them beneath the sand to feed.

entry: 有人失去宠物，有时就会获POKENAME来访。虽无证据是那宠物的灵魂，许多人仍收养、宠爱。它友善爱玩，也淘气、想被关注。
author: pjporwoll
source: When someone loses a pet, sometimes they are visited by a POKENAME. While there is no evidence that it is the spirit of the pet, many adopt the POKENAME and pamper it. It is a friendly and playful Pokémon, but is mischievous and attention-seeking.

entry: POKENAME尽量不动，装普通树桩。谁想坐着歇，就会慢慢被吸走灵魂。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME tries to stay as still as possible to camouflage itself as a regular stump. Anyone who attempts to rest on its stump will have their souls slowly drained away.

entry: POKENAME睡在柳枝上，鼾声如咯咯笑。夜里旅人听到，常很不安。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME naps in willow branches, emitting giggle-like snores. These sounds unsettle travelers who hear them at night.

entry: POKENAME像死木，会被搬或滚进洞，供其他宝可梦庇护。学孩子声音想交友，却只让人迷失洞穴深处。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME resemble dead logs that are carried or rolled into caves for other Pokémon to use as shelter. They imitate the voice of a child to try to make friends, but all this does is leave people lost deep in caves.

entry: 据说POKENAME是林中迷失孩子的灵魂，常聚在空地玩耍。它们用木头制作乐器与面具，组成小乐队，还邀请人们加入。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Said to be spirits of children lost in the woods, POKENAME often gather together to play in forest clearings. They fashion instruments and masks out of wood, creating a little band and inviting people to join in.

entry: POKENAME极关心孩子，常引导林中迷路者。任务一完，就消失回森林。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME greatly cares about the well-being of children and often guides those who get lost in the woods. Once its job is done, it disappears back into the forest.

entry: POKENAME收集枝条生起小火，引导迷失的灵魂穿过森林。火一熄，POKENAME便如风中落叶般消失。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME gather branches for kindling, creating small fires to guide lost souls through the forest. When the fires go out, POKENAME disappear like leaves on the wind.

entry: POKENAME能窥未来，借此提前拦住潜在威胁，不让其进入栖居的森林。
author: drcew
source: POKENAME has the ability to peer into the future. It uses this ability to preventively block potential threats from entering the forest where it resides.

entry: POKENAME攀在树侧，守望进入森林的人。发现迷路者，就会隐在暗处清出道路，免得对方遭受与自己相同的命运。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Clinging to the sides of trees, a POKENAME will keep watch over those that enter its forest. If it spots someone that's lost, it will clear the path from the shadows, saving them from sharing its fate.

entry: 据说POKENAME的粉色光束，会让受害者产生幻觉，将它看成人类孩子。民间告诫，绝不能让它进家门。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME fires pink beams said to cause victims to hallucinate it as a human child. Folklore warns: never let it into your home.

entry: POKENAME藏枯树，休眠到天黑。发现附近新植物生长，便飞下吸生命力，补养分。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME hides in dead trees, lying dormant until nightfall. When it finds new flora growing nearby, it flies down and drains it of life-force for nutrients.

entry: POKENAME夜里飘游森林，邀请迷路的孩子吃身上的甜糖。据说，接受者会遭到诅咒，去世后变成POKENAME。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME floats around forests at night, offering lost children the chance to partake in some of the sweet candy from its body. Those who accept are believed to be cursed, and will become POKENAME when they pass on.

entry: POKENAME浮在幽深暗林的池塘。来历无人知，有人相信，源于死在森林里的灵魂。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME floats on ponds in deep dark forests. No-one knows where they came from, but it is believed that they come from spirits that died in the forest.

entry: 据传，这些宝可梦诞生自森林火灾遗下的灵魂，如今附在烧焦的树木残骸上。它们十分温顺害羞，开心时，火焰却会明显增大，还忍不住跳上几步。
author: infinex21
source: It is rumored that these Pokémon were born of the spirits left behind by forest fires, now possessing the burnt remains of trees. They are incredibly docile and shy, though when happy their flames noticeably grow and they cannot help but dance a bit.

entry: 据说红焰是异界能量显现，或许因此不会烧着森林家园。POKENAME守家却凶猛，爪、角、火全用。
author: infinex21
source: Its red flames are said to be otherworldly energies made manifest, which may explain how they do not set their forest homes aflame. A POKENAME will fight viciously to defend their homes, using their claws, horns, and flames alike.

entry: POKENAME静止太久不游泳，身体会长大树枝。枝叶有蜂蜜水果香，吃起来却苦极。
author: .izik
source: Large branches grow from POKENAME's body if it remains still for too long without swimming. The leaves that grow from these branches smell of honey and fruit but are extremely bitter to taste.

entry: POKENAME附倒木，汲残存活力，形成烟状身体。无声漂深林，找猎物滋养所附木头，胡须连一丝生命气息也能追到。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME possess fallen logs, drawing on the lingering vitality within them to form smoke-like bodies. They drift silently through deep forests in search of prey to sustain their log, their whiskers tracing even the faintest whiff of life force.

entry: POKENAME原是一尊多年前雕成、长满草木的忠犬卡蒂狗像。如今一个迷失孩子的亡魂住进了里面。
author: captainzscourge
source: POKENAME was once an overgrown statue of a loyal Growlithe, carved many years ago. It is now the home of a lost child's soul.

entry: POKENAME会裹上幽灵火焰威吓旁人，却至多只能维持一小时，就会筋疲力尽。它常见于林火发生地附近，几乎将一切都视为潜在威胁。
author: infinex21
source: Although a POKENAME will enshroud itself in spectral flames to intimidate others, it's only able to do so for at best an hour before it exhausts itself. It is usually seen near sites of forest fires and perceives nearly anything as a possible threat.

entry: POKENAME在战斗或被逼急时，凶得如野火。连休息都火旺，因此离开昔日森林家园，在附近洞穴独居。
author: infinex21
source: In battle or when cornered, POKENAME display a ferocity that is often compared to wildfires. Their flames burn so strong, even as they rest, that they have isolated themselves within caves near the forests they once called home.

entry: POKENAME群落常见于遭到大量砍伐的地区，徘徊在留下的树桩旁。它们极力保护家园，用双拳捶打肚子，试图吓走人们。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME colonies are often found in areas that experience heavy logging, and can be seen lingering around cut tree stumps. They are protective of their home, banging their fists against their belly to try and scare people away.

entry: POKENAME极害羞，远观进林者。极少见它替尊重森林的人留下树果，再迅速瞬间移动离去。
author: drcew
source: POKENAME is extremely shy and will watch those who enter the forest from a distance. POKENAME has rarely been seen leaving berries for those who are respectful of the forest before quickly teleporting away.

entry: POKENAME抬东西时，声音像孩子哭。明明满足也如此，令旁人困惑。
author: .izik
source: When lifting objects, POKENAME makes sounds like a crying child. It does this even when content, confusing those nearby.

entry: 当地传说，POKENAME是不安战士，游林寻找目标。外表虽吓人，实际温顺好奇，常凑向进林训练家。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Local legends describe POKENAME as restless warriors, wandering forests in search of purpose. Despite their intimidating presence, POKENAME are docile and inquisitive, often curiously wandering towards Trainers that enter the forest.

entry: 它喷快速硬化的乳胶，缠住虫属性猎物，迅速解决。也会用乳胶，帮助封合大植物与树的伤口。
author: infinex21
source: It spits out a fast-hardening latex to ensnare and quickly finish off the Bug-type Pokémon it preys on. It will also use this latex to help seal the wounds on larger plants and trees.

entry: POKENAME战时头冒火光，有人因此猜头部中空。它却善战聪明，充分利用环境；不打仗，就轻轻照料附近植物。
author: infinex21
source: Because its head glows with fiery light during battle, some have theorized its head is hollow. Despite this, it is a clever fighter who makes use of its environments to the fullest. When not battling, POKENAME will gently tend to plants nearby.

entry: 小灵体选大漂木附身，诞生了这宝可梦。它照料腹苔，修出讨喜图案。身体意外硬，还能缩进木内，进一步增强防御。
author: infinex21
source: A Pokémon born of a small spirit's choice to inhabit a large piece of driftwood. It tends to the moss on its belly and makes enjoyable patterns of it. Its body is surprisingly tough, and it can withdraw inside to further enhance its defenses.

entry: POKENAME住森林池湖，身体轻，浮着让玻璃般绿球露水面。只需阳光就能活，可传说太近，仍会被拖入水下。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME live within forest lakes and ponds, their light bodies allowing them to float with their glassy, green orbs above the surface. They only need sunlight to survive, but some tales claim they will drag others underwater if they get too close.

entry: POKENAME让玻璃般通透的球体发出迷人光芒，将生灵引到栖居的湖边，再拖下水，吸食生命力。它也能从头上的孔发出孩子般的哭声，诱人靠近。
author: infinex21
source: It emits alluring lights from its glassy orbs to draw others closer to the edge of its lake habitat, then drags them down to feed on their life force. POKENAME can also emit child-like cries from the hole on its head to lure humans closer.

entry: 它在遭砍伐的林地游荡，见到伐木工就出拳。高山步道旁也常能见到它，伪装成树桩。
author: markusknight
source: Wandering around cut-down forests, it punches any lumberjacks it sees. It's also often seen around high mountain trails, disguising as tree stumps.

entry: POKENAME爱捉弄登山者。它将幽灵般的身体扎入地下，震动大地，让树木倒向不幸惹怒它的人。
author: markusknight
source: POKENAME likes to prank hikers. It plunges its ghastly body into the ground, causing the earth to tremble and trees to fall down on those unfortunate enough to anger it.

entry: 它游荡在极古老的森林，寻找巨大的倒木树干，作为新住处。它守护这些古林，会诅咒入侵者，或全速冲过去攻击。
author: markusknight
source: It is said to wander around very old forests, seeking new trunks from enormous fallen trees to live in. It guards these ancient forests, bringing curses or rushing at full speed at anyone that trespasses.

entry: 或许因为生来体弱，POKENAME只肯让孩子骑在背上。不过，仍须先赢得信任，免得黑焰伤及骑乘者。
author: infinex21
source: Perhaps due to their inherent weakness from the moment they are born, POKENAME will only ever let children ride upon their backs. Their trust must still be earned first, lest their black flames harm their rider.

entry: POKENAME体形大又强，多半却只背孩子，对有爱的家庭则会破例。黑火绝不伤信任者，也帮掩行踪。
author: infinex21
source: Despite their size and strength, POKENAME mostly only let children ride upon their backs. They are known to make exceptions for loving families, however. Their black flames will never hurt those they trust, and they help to conceal their movements.

entry: POKENAME睡觉像孩子哭。若被惊醒，就以念力冲击反击。
author: .izik
source: While it sleeps, POKENAME makes the sound of a crying child. If startled awake, it retaliates with a telekinetic blast.

entry: 叶尾是年龄标志，能赢得同类尊敬；得到多少尊敬，要看尾巴长短与厚薄。它们靠日光、苔藓与水维生，常见于溪池旁。
author: infinex21
source: Their leafy tails are a sign of age and garner respect among their kind; how much respect is gained depends on the length and thickness. They subsist on sunlight, moss, and water, so they are frequently spotted near ponds and streams.

entry: 野生植物被过采，宝可梦挨饿，POKENAME就常出现。找上肇事者，哪怕大如卡比兽，也挥葱蒜类蔬菜痛打。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME commonly appears where Pokémon are starving due to wild plants having been overharvested. It hunts down the perpetrator, even if it is as large as Snorlax, and bludgeons them with its allium vegetable.

entry: 哪一处是它的头，人们争论许久，深入研究才知，壳脸只是障眼法。甲壳成分是木，硬度却如铁。
author: infinex21
source: Debate persisted for quite some time over which was the head of this Pokémon, though further study revealed the face on the shell is a diversion meant to trick others. Its shell has the composition of wood, yet the durability of iron.

entry: POKENAME气体身体怕被吹走，就躲树洞，也常当巢。因常吓着旅人而恶名在外，却似乎并非出于恶意。
author: infinex21
source: To prevent their gaseous bodies from being blown away, POKENAME seek refuge within tree hollows, which often also become their nests. They are infamous for startling and frightening travelers, yet they do not seem to do so out of malice.

entry: POKENAME是恶毒森林灵体，穿梭家林树间，时隐时现。最爱缠扰迷路孩子，折磨到哭。
author: sk372
source: A malevolent forest spirit, POKENAME phases in and out between the trees of its home forest. It especially loves to haunt and torment lost children and hear their cries.

entry: POKENAME双手能异常操纵附近植物，仿佛无绳提木偶。用来诱人和宝可梦入林，此后极少再被看见。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME display an abnormal capacity to influence the plant life around them with their hands, as if they were puppeteering without any strings. They use this ability to lure humans and Pokémon into their forests, who are rarely ever seen again.

entry: POKENAME常在林地，用笛状鼻演奏。孩子听乐，就会恍惚起舞。
author: drcew
source: POKENAME is often found playing music from its flute-like nose in forested areas. Children who hear POKENAME's music will begin to dance in a trance-like state.

entry: POKENAME装成灌木，静静等待猎物。有东西经过，就一把捉住，让其消失。
author: prof.whitebeam
source: POKENAME quietly hides disguised as a bush as it waits for prey. When something passes by, it catches it and makes it disappear.

entry: POKENAME分开观察林中人类活动。若见破坏家园，就通知更强的朽木妖融合体。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME split up to observe the activities of humans in their forest. If POKENAME sees them despoiling their home, they alert stronger Trevenant fusions.

entry: 红眼从不眨，始终追随林中闯入者，遮挡后也躲不过。挥舞作棒的树枝时，还能控制附近植物。
author: infinex21
source: Its red eye never blinks and always follows an intruder within its forest territory, even if they are behind cover. As they wave their branches wielded as clubs, they display the ability to exert control over other plants near them.

entry: 叶披风与头枝，都随年龄生长。两样都最长者，是群体首领。它们展现智慧，会为自己与旁人，以木做强力武器。
author: infinex21
source: Their cloaks of leaves and the branches upon their heads all grow with age. The one with the longest of both is the leader of its pack. They display a level of intellect by forming powerful weapons out of wood for themselves and for others.

entry: 野生POKENAME有强烈的亲子本能，常照料幼小的小木灵，直到它们足够强，能够独立生存。
author: phantom640
source: Due to this fusion's parental instincts, wild POKENAME often care for young Phantump until they're strong enough to survive on their own.

entry: POKENAME贴水面慢游，常被当漂木。角尖放亮红光，令敌分心、迷乱又不安。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME swim so slowly near the surface that they are often mistaken for driftwood. The tips of their horns glow bright red to distract, disorient, and unnerve their foes.

entry: 野生POKENAME在海藻地筑巢，只要草状鳍扎稳，就能控藻，缠猎物或威胁。据说直视红光，生命力就会被吸走。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME nest within fields of seaweed, which they can control to ensnare any prey or threats so long as their grassy fins are dug in. It is said that looking directly into their glowing red lights will sap one's very life force.

entry: POKENAME潜林，在树间造屏障，爱捉弄旅人，编成复杂迷宫，让人困在里面。
author: jangodiot
source: POKENAME lurk in forests, creating barriers between trees. POKENAME like to mess with people travelling through the woods, creating elaborate mazes in the forest for them to get stuck in.

entry: POKENAME不信任任何其他生灵，见谁进入森林领地，就会冲撞。强健双腿暴走时，能将硬土踩松，让新生命更容易扎根。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are untrusting of all others and will charge at anyone they see within their forest domains. Their legs pack enough power that they soften hard ground when they rampage, allowing new life to more easily take root.

entry: POKENAME模仿伊布或幼童的哭声，将人引入密林。它虽只想找玩伴，却有时会不慎诅咒想一起玩的人。
author: riverbandage
source: POKENAME lures people deep into its woods by mimicking the cries of an eevee or small child. Though it only seeks a playmate, it sometimes mistakenly curses those it tries to play with.

entry: POKENAME会淹死一切靠近居住水域的人，连其他宝可梦也不放过。唯独派拉斯与派拉斯特例外。
author: riverbandage
source: POKENAME will drown anyone that comes near the body of water that it resides in. It has even been known to even drown other Pokémon that come to close. The only exception is Paras and Parasect.

entry: POKENAME十分敏感，也极具攻击性。它能透过树皮般的毛发，迸出短促的10000伏电流，像射出尖刺一样，发电攻击。
author: riverbandage
source: POKENAME tend to be highly aggressive and sensitive. Through the bark-made fur, it can produce a 10,000-volt charge in small bursts that can be ejected as like quills from the fur to attack.

entry: 普通火伊布能将体温升至华氏1,650度，POKENAME却承受不了。POKENAME常因发怒，不慎让体温过高，反把自己点燃。
author: riverbandage
source: While typical Flareon can heat their body up to 1,650 degrees Fahrenheit, POKENAME are unable to handle that temperature. POKENAME tend to catch themselves on fire in their own anger by unintentionally rising their body temperature too high.

entry: POKENAME住进系统，便间歇在屏幕闪恐怖影像，吓跑用户，好不受扰地吃。
author: .izik
source: While inhabiting a system, POKENAME flashes disturbing images across the screen at intervals. This frightens users away so it can feed undisturbed.

entry: 它以坚岩磨镰，修剪过密植被，残枝便吃。也分叶给病宝可梦，叶里有药用成分与丰富养分。
author: infinex21
source: It sharpens its scythes against dense rocks and uses them to trim the forest overgrowth, the scraps of which it feeds on. It shares its leaves with ill Pokémon, for they contain medicinal compounds and plentiful nutrients.

entry: POKENAME假扮树木，观察威胁森林家园的动静，择机出手。它们从脚底伸出根，吸收水分与养分，也可能借根连接、控制附近的植物。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME pose as trees so they may watch for any threats to their forest homes and strike as they see fit. They extend roots from their feet to absorb nutrients and water. They may use their roots to connect to and control nearby plants as well.

entry: 同一片林附近，可有多只POKENAME，却各自独居，甚至争地盘。巢覆树脂般唾液形成的琥珀，或许说明它们很古老。
author: infinex21
source: Although multiple POKENAME may be found near the same forests, they live independently of each other and may even clash over territory. Their dens are covered in amber that formed from their resin-like saliva, indicating they may be ancient.

entry: 枝上苹果大小、滋味各异，“完美苹果”最稀罕，也最抢手。只许朋友触碰，贼一伸手，就会遭全部力量打击。
author: infinex21
source: The apples that grow upon its branches vary in size and taste, with "Perfect Apples" being the rarest to grow and the most sought after. It will only let its friends even touch these apples and will bring down its full might on would-be thieves.

entry: POKENAME不停蜕树皮，约一天长全。皮里有小树苗，扎根后长成细扭树，吸附近植物生命，供自己生长。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME constantly sheds its bark, with it fully regrowing in around a day. This bark contains small saplings, with them taking root and growing into thin, twisted trees that drain the life of other plants around to fuel their own growth.

entry: POKENAME假扮龙形树，观察进林者。认定有害，就以角上幽灵力量，强行驱逐。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME pretends to be nothing more than a dragon-shaped tree while observing those who wander into its forest. Those it deems a detriment are forcibly expelled by the ghostly powers emitted from its horn.

entry: POKENAME察觉洪水，便用念力拔大量树挡水。见宝可梦溺水，则瞬间移动到安全处。
author: .izik
source: If POKENAME notices flooding, it will uproot large amounts of trees with its telekinesis to block off waterflows. Any Pokémon it notices drowning are teleported to safety using its powers.

entry: POKENAME枝上的叶片有辛辣味，泡成茶后，能让饮者精神振奋。
author: hophoppip
source: The leaves that grow from POKENAME's branches have a spicy flavor and can be brewed into a tea that makes the drinker feel energized.

entry: POKENAME木身完美融入树枝，耐心等猎物松懈再出击。它极怕火，不惜一切避开。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME blends perfectly with tree branches thanks to its wooden body, waiting patiently for its prey to lower their guard before striking. It's extremely afraid of fire and avoids it at all costs.

entry: POKENAME保护认领的森林，凶猛赶走不受欢迎的访客。外表虽冷，却常许其他宝可梦停在头上。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME protects the forest it claims as its domain and will violently chase away any unwanted visitors. Despite its cold exterior, it will often let other Pokémon perch on its head.

entry: 若见枝条结成网，最好别靠近。那完全受POKENAME控制，先缠猎物，再吸生命力。
author: mistymagius
source: If you see a cluster of tree branches in a web-like shape, it is best not to approach. Fully under POKENAME's control, the branches will ensnare its prey before draining their life force.

entry: POKENAME在森林里飞行，寻找没有守护者的树，与其结下羁绊。它会与信任的树艺师，或其他宝可梦密切合作，照料这棵树；待到满意，再去寻找新的树木守护。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME flies about the forest in search of a tree that is unprotected and bonds with it. It will work closely with an arborist or other Pokémon that it trusts to tend to the tree, leaving in search of a new tree to protect once satisfied.

entry: POKENAME预见恶意闯入者，就命森林树木攻击，直到敌人逃走或昏倒。
author: .izik
source: If POKENAME foresees an intruder with ill intent, it commands the forest trees to attack. The onslaught continues until the foe flees or falls unconscious.

entry: POKENAME飞得快，掠过就震落树叶。极护家园，见伐木工就攻击。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME soar through the air fast enough to shake leaves from trees as they fly by. They are highly protective of their home and are known to attack lumberjacks on sight.

entry: POKENAME头颈的枝叶十分浓密，每片叶子都蕴藏强电荷。它用尾巴的光吸引夜行的闯入者，待对方靠近，再施以使其麻痹的电击。
author: sk372
source: The thick foliage on POKENAME's head and neck contains a strong electrical charge within each leaf. It lures trespassers traveling at night with the glow of its tail, bringing them closer so it can deliver a paralyzing jolt.

entry: POKENAME飘行于沼泽上方，停在树上时，像一颗长着苔藓的果实。天敌靠近，它就唤动森林，让树枝以诡异而精准的动作发起攻击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME drifts above marshes, perching in trees like mossy fruit. If a predator nears, it stirs the forest, commanding branches to strike with eerie precision.

entry: POKENAME爱躲树间，从上跃下吓旅人。冬天一到，便成群随风漂去暖地。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME loves to scare passing travelers, hiding amongst the trees before jumping at them from above. When winter comes, groups of POKENAME drift along the wind to find warmer areas.

entry: POKENAME的牙齿不停生长，必须啃咬木头磨短。兄弟姐妹之间会试着互相啃咬，因而发生争斗。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME must chew on wood to file down their constantly growing teeth. POKENAME siblings try to chew on each other, causing conflict.

entry: 它常半浸泥里，接入树根网络，吸出附近树的毒素，再从头顶以树汁排出。某些宝可梦能消化，会停头上舔食。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: It is often found half submerged in mud, tapping into the root network. It is able to draw out toxins from nearby trees and expel them from the top of its head as sap. Some Pokémon can digest it and can be found perching on its head licking it.

entry: 黄昏，POKENAME贴地飞过密林，猎捕迷路者。枝条受命扭曲，盘根缠住受害者。
author: .izik
source: At dusk, POKENAME swoops low through dense woods, hunting the lost. Branches twist at its command, snaring victims in gnarled roots.

entry: 秋天，POKENAME常在南瓜田里。它爱陪孩子玩，可那阴森的目光，往往又把孩子吓得逃走。
author: thropp
source: In autumn, POKENAME can be found in pumpkin patches. It loves to play with children, but they often run away, terrified of POKENAME's haunting gaze.

entry: POKENAME将树拗成恐怖形，缠扰落单旅人，吃收在亮红珠里的恐惧。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME bends trees into frightful shapes to haunt lone travelers. It feeds on the fear collected in its glowing red beads.

entry: POKENAME有超常感应，知道何时被注视。除非遭袭，否则只动眼睛；受攻就猛然报复，号称“伐木工的克星”。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME has a preternatural sense when something is watching it and will not move anything but its eyes while watched unless it is attacked. When attacked, it lashes out in retaliation, giving it the nickname of "the lumberjack's bane".

entry: POKENAME有超常感应，知道何时被注视。除非遭袭，否则只动眼睛；受攻就猛然报复，号称“伐木工的克星”。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME has a preternatural sense when something is watching it and will not move anything but its eyes while watched unless it is attacked. When attacked, it lashes out in retaliation, giving it the nickname of "the lumberjack's bane".

entry: POKENAME的头不睡觉，休息时会陷入深沉的恍惚。一个头出神时，另一个仍保持警惕，留意威胁。不过，那条像小木灵的尾巴胆子更小，稍有突响就会惊动前面的头。
author: kungfucutbug
source: Rather than sleeping, POKENAME's heads go into a deep trance when inactive. While one is entranced, the other remains alert to look out for threats. The Phantump-like tail, however, is more cowardly, rousing the front at any sudden noise.

entry: 每只POKENAME都认领一棵树，附在枝上，直到受扰，再如火箭落下，以阴森幽灵力量，无情袭击闯入者。
author: sk372
source: Every POKENAME claims a tree as its own, remaining attached to a limb until something disturbs it. It rockets down from the tree in response, mercilessly assaulting the interloper with ghastly ghost powers.

entry: 没人知道POKENAME硬木壳里是什么。人或宝可梦想探看，就猛地夹闭，锯齿边缘的力道，足以切断铁棍。
author: .jerden
source: It is unknown what is inside POKENAME's hard wooden shell. POKENAME will clamp shut if any person or Pokémon tries to investigate its interior, moving with enough force that its serrated edge can slice through an iron rod.

entry: POKENAME的唾液像树脂，既用来标记领地，也用来照料伤口。它们攀附树干，再滑翔向猎物，以钳子和毒刺将其击倒。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's saliva is like tree resin, which they use to mark their territories and to tend to their own wounds. They cling to the sides of trees and glide toward their prey, which they fell using their pincers and venomous stingers.

entry: 与朽木妖融合，激发了圈圈熊罕见进化形态的特征。这个融合体住泥炭沼泽，现身攻击闯入者。
author: hophoppip
source: Fusing with Trevenant has drawn out traits from Ursaring's rare evolved form. The fusion dwells in peat bogs, emerging to attack intruders.

entry: POKENAME附身倒木，为枯木注入新生命。传说壳里寄着森林灵体，穿过原始老林，身后便一路长出新植物。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME possess fallen logs, infusing the dead wood with new life. Legends persist of their shells playing host to spirits of the forest, claiming their passage through old growth forests leaves a trail of fresh plant growth in their wake.

entry: POKENAME附身于倒下的树干，为枯木注入新生。它们寻找森林中腐朽的树，将其拆下，融入自己的外壳，同时腾出空地，让新的植物生长。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME possess fallen logs, infusing the dead wood with new life. They seek out decaying trees within the forest and tear them down, incorporating the wood into their shell and leaving space for new growth to take the tree's place.

entry: 这个形态的POKENAME，体形酷似帕底亚某种传说中的宝可梦。研究却证实，只是巧合。
author: hophoppip
source: This form of POKENAME has a body shape very similar to that of a Legendary Paldean Pokémon. Studies have shown that this is a coincidence.

entry: POKENAME住原始老林，栖在死树或垂死树里。干木身伪装极好，往往直到亮红眼盯住靠近者，才知有一群。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME live within old growth forests, roosting in dead or dying trees. Their dry woody bodies camouflage well against their homes, and the first sign of a flock of POKENAME is usually when their bright red eyes fixate on the person approaching.

entry: POKENAME叶含的色素，与珊瑚枝上粉藻相同。秋天，叶会变灰。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's leaves contain the same pigment as the pink algae that live on coral branches. The leaves turn gray in the autumn season.

entry: POKENAME夜里无声滑过林冠，小幽灵属性宝可梦有时搭叶翼便车，人们便认为见它是凶兆。
author: pizzarcato
source: POKENAME glides silently over the forest canopy at night, with small Ghost-type Pokémon sometimes hitching a ride on its leafy wings. This has led to the belief that seeing POKENAME is a bad omen.

entry: POKENAME住原始老林，栖在死树或垂死树里。干木身伪装极好，往往直到亮红眼盯住靠近者，才知有一群。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME live within old growth forests, roosting in dead or dying trees. Their dry woody bodies camouflage well against their homes, and the first sign of a flock of POKENAME is usually when their bright red eyes fixate on the person approaching.

entry: POKENAME用象鼻上的小树，抹去零散的积水与水洼，将水吸入体内过滤。它们性情贪玩，也喜欢别人修剪小树，免得长得过盛。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME use their small trees on their trunks to mop up loose water and puddles, which is absorbed and filtered within them. They are playful Pokémon who love letting others trim their trees, which helps keep them from overgrowing.

entry: POKENAME醒着时，身体保持粗糙树皮的质感，让颚力较弱的天敌不敢靠近。睡着后，粗糙表面却会变得光滑，更容易受到伤害。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME's body maintains a rough bark texture while awake, deterring predators with weak jaws. When it sleeps however, this rough texture smooths out, leaving POKENAME vulnerable.

entry: 少数传说称它是最古老森林的守护神，更少的说法，认为是森林灵魂的化身。能诡异操纵附近草木，赶走旁人。
author: infinex21
source: Some few legends refer to this Pokémon as a guardian deity of the eldest forests, with even fewer citing that it is the manifestation of a forest's spirit. It has an uncanny power over nearby plants and trees, using them to ward off others.

entry: 头如骷髅，由石化木构成，配合胸前发光印记，令人不安畏惧。缠紧目标，不到一小时便吸干生命精华。
author: infinex21
source: Its skull-like head is made of petrified wood, which serves well to unnerve and intimidate others in tandem with the glowing mark on its chest. It tightly wraps around its targets and drains them of their life essence within less than an hour.

entry: POKENAME树汁有多种极有益养分，熬糖浆更滋养。可若非主动赠出，便变苦难喝；想偷，是自找灾难。
author: thesilverowls
source: POKENAME's sap is full of several incredibly healthy nutrients, which is only amplified when made into a syrup. However, it turns bitter and unpleasant unless it was actively given out by the POKENAME. Stealing the sap is a recipe for disaster.

entry: 传说POKENAME以吼声，随意命令所有火山何时喷、喷多猛。它故意用重藤绑腿，免得四处狂奔，撞穿树木。
author: soup1900
source: In legends, POKENAME controls all volcanoes with its roars, commanding when and how violently they erupt at will. It purposely ties its legs down with heavy vines to prevent itself from racing all over and blitzing through trees.

entry: POKENAME发出犬吠般的吼声，命令树木追赶破坏森林的家伙。老树需要清除、让新生命生长时，它便精准喷火，只烧去那一棵。
author: soup1900
source: With a barking roar, POKENAME will command trees to chase after those who ruin forests. When a tree becomes old and needs to be rid of so new nature can grow, it blasts intense fire in a precise manner so only that tree burns away.

entry: POKENAME追进林者，怪叫、做威吓动作。可旅人一给食物，立刻平静，不再纠缠。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME chases after those who enter its forest, making spooky noises and threatening gestures. If a traveler offers it food, however, it is instantly placated and will leave them alone.

entry: POKENAME身上的开花寄生物，充当大脑，以卷须操木身。歌声众声和鸣，传遍森林。
author: hophoppip
source: The flowering parasites present on this Pokémon act as the brain, manipulating its tree body with tendrils. POKENAME sings in a chorus of harmonized voices that can be heard throughout the forest.

entry: POKENAME满月夜蜕木鳞。据说目睹者会被一路跟出森林，自身面临极大危险。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME sheds its wooden scales on the night of a full moon. Those who witness this are said to be followed out of the forest by POKENAME, at great peril to themselves.

entry: POKENAME轻声嗡鸣，穿行暗林，寻找迷路旅人。它操纵周围树木，将失去方向的人引向森林更深处。据说，它的红眼若在黑暗中闪过，便是不祥之兆。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME buzzes quietly through dark forests, seeking lost travelers. POKENAME manipulates the surrounding trees to guide the disoriented wanderers deeper into the woods. It is said that the flash of its red eyes in the dark is a dark omen.

entry: POKENAME常为迷失森林的宝可梦指路。不过，若对方由人类饲养，却鲜少能再与训练家重聚。
author: riverbandage
source: POKENAME often guide stray Pokémon that have lost their way in the forest. However, if these Pokémon belong to humans, they are rarely reunited with their Trainers.

entry: POKENAME能降低体温，让自身树皮裂成碎片，拿来投射攻击。若没有用掉，碎片便会脱落，再被它吃回去，重新补入身体。
author: riverbandage
source: POKENAME have the ability to lower their body temperature, which allows them to splinter their own bark and use it as a projectile. If not used, the splinters will break off and be consumed by the Pokémon in order to add them back to their body.

entry: 它用尾巴挂在树枝上，连休息时也一样。善用滑翔膜，哪怕最弱的微风也能搭乘，狩猎时便能迅速穿行森林。
author: infinex21
source: It hangs from tree branches using its tail, even when it rests. It is skilled at using its gliding membrane to ride on even the weakest breezes and can swiftly navigate through the forest as it hunts.

entry: POKENAME睡着，头枝吸电脑信号。被唤醒，就从同样枝条放电攻击。
author: .izik
source: The branches on POKENAME's head absorb computer signals while it sleeps. If awoken, it unleashes electric attacks through those same branches.

entry: POKENAME会在森林里最大的一棵树上筑巢，进入恍惚状态，与林中所有树木沟通，留意潜在的威胁。它守护自己的森林，即使最强大的敌人，也无法使它动摇。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME will find the largest tree in a forest and make its nest there. There it enters a trance to commune with all the trees in the forest, where it watches for threats. POKENAME will protect its forest, unfazed by even the strongest of foes.

entry: POKENAME极凶，碾碎闯领地的一切，炫耀压倒性力量。罕见有人观察到，它搜集巨大亮宝石，囤在巢里。
author: sk372
source: Extremely aggressive, POKENAME crushes anything that enters its territory as a show of overwhelming power. Rarely, it has been observed searching for and gathering up huge shiny gems to hoard in its den.

entry: POKENAME天生与植物相通，以古老森林为家。多年来过度伐木，令它主动躲避人类，因此野外很少能遇见。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME has an innate connection to plant life and makes its home in old-growth forests. Due to excessive logging over the years, POKENAME actively avoids people, making it rare to encounter in the wild.

entry: POKENAME穿林起舞时，会唤起不祥的风，吹动身上叶片与它一同舞蹈。
author: toxicrown
source: As it dances through the forest, POKENAME causes ominous winds to flow. These winds help the leaves on its body to dance with it.

entry: 这只宝可梦能凭手杖掌控森林。它借此远远守护孩子，帮助他们避开残酷的命运。
author: toxicrown
source: This Pokémon's staff allows it control over the forest. It uses this to help children from a distance, so that they don't meet a cruel fate.

entry: 许多人称POKENAME为“森林守护者”。它保护无力自保的生物，把林中的小宝可梦，当成自己的孩子。
author: toxicrown
source: Known to many as the Forest Guardian, POKENAME protects those who can't protect themselves. It treats young forest Pokémon like its children.

entry: POKENAME将大半身体埋进地里，只露出覆叶的背部，便能控制附近树木。如此扎根，也能从土壤与周围植物吸取水分、养分。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME can exert control over nearby trees by burying most of their bodies in the ground, save for their leafy backs. By ingraining themselves like this, they can also acquire nutrients and water from the ground and flora around them.

entry: POKENAME蜷在森林里，看起来不过是一丛浓密灌木。它白天大多在睡觉，可一察觉森林里有垃圾，就会立刻出击，从背上射出利叶，攻击糟蹋森林的家伙。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME curls up in forests and resembles nothing more than a thick bush. It sleeps most of the day, but if it senses litter in its forest, it immediately goes on the attack and fires sharp leaves from its back at the defiler.

entry: POKENAME极恶毒，住最深最暗森林。绝不容忍访客，认为都得立刻残酷处置。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a highly malevolent Pokémon inhabiting the deepest and darkest forests. POKENAME has zero tolerance for visitors, seeing them as something to be dealt with immediately and viciously.

entry: POKENAME在树干上磨爪，保持锋利。据说，它身上的树皮磨成粉，有疗愈作用，可它极力抗拒任何采皮的企图。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME scratches its talons against tree trunks in order to keep them sharp. The bark of its body is said to possess healing properties when powdered, but POKENAME is very resistant to attempts to acquire its bark.

entry: 秋天，POKENAME常在南瓜田里。它爱陪孩子玩，可那阴森的目光，往往又把孩子吓得逃走。
author: thropp
source: In autumn, POKENAME can be found in pumpkin patches. It loves to play with children, but they often run away, terrified of POKENAME's haunting gaze.

entry: POKENAME背葫芦已完全成熟，滋味也足。临近寿终，也许谁来求都肯给；可强拿者，会遭诅咒甚至更惨。
author: bobosmith01
source: The gourd on POKENAME's back has reached full maturity and flavor. POKENAME may provide it to whoever asks near the end of its own lifespan, but those who try to take it by force will be cursed or worse.

entry: POKENAME以利爪吸走敌人的生命力，遇到危险则埋入地下躲避。
author: jona_hehe
source: POKENAME uses its claws to absorb the life force of its opponent. It buries itself to hide from danger.

entry: 森林遭到毁坏后，人们开始看见野生POKENAME四处潜行。只要被认定有害于领地，便会遭它无情攻击。
author: endersalasa
source: As forests are demolished, people notice wild POKENAME prowling around. They relentlessly attack anyone it deems harmful to its territory.

entry: POKENAME嘴从不合拢。研究者怀疑，图腾般的面容是否真脸。
author: duplicitous_dirk
source: POKENAME's jaw never closes. Researchers are skeptical whether this Pokémon's totemic visage is its real face.

entry: POKENAME通常住暗密森林，外表虽可怕，性情却平静。喂最爱水果，甚至能家养。
author: naivetotoro
source: POKENAME usually live in dark, dense forests. Despite their intimidating appearance, they are calm and can even be domesticated if fed their favorite fruits.

entry: 有人称POKENAME为森林之王。常在枝上种树果，吃来增强巨力，也常照料懒人獭及其融合体。
author: hiimhdere
source: Known as the king of the forest by some, POKENAME often spends its time growing berries from its branches and eating them to bolster its immense strength. It is often seen caring for Slakoth and its fusions.

entry: 它看守并庇护赖以为家的森林，格外爱护走失的孩子，无论人类还是宝可梦。
author: staghorn
source: It acts as a warden and guardian spirit for the forest it calls home. It's particularly protective of lost children, regardless of if they are human or Pokémon.

entry: 它是高尚的守护者，与林中住民和睦。POKENAME平时内敛，保护森林免遭大灾时，却会凶猛展示力量。
author: bacondlx
source: A noble defender that lives in harmony with other forest-dwellers. Despite its usual reserved nature, POKENAME puts on a fierce display of its strength when warding forests from great disasters.

entry: POKENAME蜕的树皮，曾被认为有神赐祝福。缓缓燃几天，是沼泽各国珍贵的燃料。
author: .izik
source: Bark shed from POKENAME was thought to be divinely blessed. It burns slowly for days, making it a prized fuel source among swamp nations.

entry: 有寓言说，POKENAME能控制整片森林，保护自己与林中伙伴。虽还未确定，已知却会用大量根藤，攻击任何威胁。
author: infinex21
