source: There are a few fables that say POKENAME has the power to control an entire forest to defend itself or the other Pokémon within. While this is yet unsure, what is known is that POKENAME attacks any threat with many roots and vines.

entry: POKENAME看着吓人，实际心善，夜里游林，引迷路者出去。据说身上的墓碑，刻着没救下者的名字。
author: rumia_archer
source: Despite its scary appearance, POKENAME are actually quite kind. They wander forests at night to lead lost people out. The gravestone on their bodies is said to bear the names of those they failed to save.

entry: 谁亵渎受护森林，POKENAME就无情战斗。若被逼绝境，会让双臂燃起幽火，哪怕危及生命。
author: lampent12
source: If anyone defiles the forest they protect, POKENAME will fight them without mercy. If pushed to the brink, POKENAME will ignite their arms in spirit fire, at risk of their own life.

entry: POKENAME是森林的行刑者，专找伤害森林的人，用那有生命的木刃，毫不留情地处决。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME is the forest's executioner. It seeks out people who harm the forest and shows no mercy towards them with its living wood blade.

entry: POKENAME对付闯林者，很少动用覆皮刃。盾先以根状卷须抓住，再用树干大的爪碾碎。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME rarely uses the bark-covered blade when dealing with intruders to its forest. Its shield grabs them with its root-like tendrils, before POKENAME crushes them with its tree-trunk-sized claw.

entry: 人们认为，伐木工砍古树，便会形成POKENAME。被附身的树桩拿斧复仇，还将有关袭击者的记忆，传给附近树。
author: mindrivet
source: POKENAME is thought to be created when a lumberjack cuts down an ancient tree. The now-possessed stump takes an axe and seeks vengeance... sharing the memory of its attacker to nearby trees.

entry: 这种生物十分可爱，只要待在它伸手够不着的地方，就几乎没有危险。任何森林，只要苔藓足够丰富，能供它充饥，就能成为它的家。
author: fireblade141
source: This adorable creature poses little threat to anyone who stays out of arm's reach. It lives in any forest that possesses an abundant enough moss supply for it to use as its food source.

entry: 覆身木材已将它彻底同化。POKENAME敬仰树木，如驹刀小兵敬仰劈斩司令，拼命保护。
author: bigblue
source: The wood covering its body has subsumed its being. POKENAME looks up to trees the way Pawniard look up to Bisharp, protecting them with its life.

entry: POKENAME将维护森林视作荣耀，毫不留情攻击不敬者。身上木材，强得能撕金属。
author: bigblue
source: POKENAME fight with a strong sense of honor for the forest, attacking those who disrespect it without mercy. The wood growing on its body is strong enough to rend metal.

entry: POKENAME在深林装死树桩，用根爪扑猎物。宣示森林领地时，阴森怒吼回荡。
author: korro0490
source: POKENAME disguises itself as a dead stump within deep forests. It pounces its intended prey using its root-like claws. Its haunting roar echoes as POKENAME marks a forest as its territory.

entry: 它的叶片与外皮，总与家乡森林里某一棵树相同。那棵树一受威胁，它便现身，将来犯者赶走。
author: staghorn
source: Its leaves and hide always match that of a tree somewhere within its home forest. If that tree is threatened, it will appear to drive the threat away.

entry: POKENAME跟踪林中猎物，以幻象重现迷路者已经走过的树，吃其情绪动荡。树皮磨成香水，能让使用者闻着像身边人。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME stalks prey through its forest, using illusions to make it look like trees the lost victim already passed and feeding on their emotional turmoil. Its bark is ground down for perfumes which make the wearer smell similar to those around them.

entry: POKENAME跟踪林中猎物，以幻象重现迷路者已经走过的树，吃其情绪动荡。树皮磨成香水，能让使用者闻着像身边人。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME stalks prey through its forest, using illusions to make it look like trees the lost victim already passed and feeding on their emotional turmoil. Its bark is ground down for perfumes which make the wearer smell similar to those around them.

entry: POKENAME虽有仙子伊布DNA，却常独居暗林，躲避人类接触，野外研究极难。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME, despite their Sylveon DNA, are often loners living within dark forests. Attempts to study them in the wild prove difficult because they shy away from human contact.

entry: POKENAME栖居在高空，巡视自己选定的森林领地。谁若伤害领地，它便从天而降，从口中射出带诅咒的能量束，轰击肇事者。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME resides high up in the sky, patrolling over its chosen forest domain. Causing harm to its territory will make it descend from above and blast the perpetrator with a cursed energy beam fired from its mouth.

entry: 据说POKENAME体内有历史中，无数被砍树木的精华。传说误入住处，会被强行变成树。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is said to house the essence of countless trees that have been chopped down across history. Legends say that if one stumbles upon its home, they will be forcibly transformed into a tree.

entry: POKENAME暗中守护森林，跟随糟蹋领地的生灵，直到对方睡着。它再用活树的恐怖噩梦，侵扰其梦境，惩罚破坏家园的行为。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME watches over forests in secret, following those who desecrate its land until they fall asleep. As they slumber, it infests their dreams with horrific nightmares of living trees as punishment for their crimes against its home.

entry: POKENAME收集倒木与枝条，将枯木融进身体。它们似乎能从中汲取力量，收集的材料越多，射出的能量冲击也越强。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME gather fallen logs and branches, incorporating the dead wood into their bodies. They appear to draw power from the wood they gather, firing blasts of energy that grow in strength based on the amount of material they've collected.

entry: POKENAME住在森林，在安全距离外，观察登山者。若有人意图伤害林木，它就抓住对方，变成一棵树。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME lives in forests and watches hikers from a safe distance. If someone tries to harm the forest, it catches them and turns them into a tree.

entry: 一群POKENAME能织宽到盖全林的网。坚韧粗丝织成地毯出售，号称几乎什么宝可梦攻击都挡得住。
author: _pixelar_
source: A clutter of POKENAME can build a web wide enough to engulf the entire forest they inhabit. The rough, resilient thread used in their nests is woven into carpets and sold with a promise to withstand nearly every Pokémon attack.

entry: 林火夺去人或宝可梦性命，POKENAME就神秘地大群出现，哀悼到森林再生、足养生命，才消失无踪。
author: icelevelincarnate
source: When a forest fire claims the lives of people or Pokémon, POKENAME mysteriously appear in large groups to mourn. They remain until the forest grows back and can sustain life again, then vanish without a trace.

entry: POKENAME潜在咸淡水，根状手臂探水下。碰到的树，都成为意志一部分。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME, lurking in brackish waters, extends rootlike arms beneath the surface. Any tree it touches becomes part of its will.

entry: POKENAME做皮卡丘等宝可梦的木剪影，吓退天敌。若吓不跑，便抡起剪影打。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME create wooden cutouts of Pokémon such as Pikachu in order to ward away predators. If they aren't scared off, POKENAME will whack the predator with the cutout instead.

entry: POKENAME在各地森林之间飞行、巡视，性情不算特别凶暴。不过，谁伤害树木，就会被它掳走，送到遥远的地方。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME roams across the lands, flying from forest to forest to observe them. Though not overly aggressive, it will spirit away those causing harm to the trees, transporting them far away.

entry: 据说，它每条尾巴中，都有一个永远迷失在森林或丛林中的悲伤灵魂。哪怕只将一条尾巴扎进地里，也能操纵附近植物，驱退潜在威胁。
author: infinex21
source: Within each of its tails is said to be a mournful spirit of those who were forever lost within forests and jungles. By digging in even one of its tails into the ground, it can exert control over nearby plants and use them to repel would-be threats.

entry: POKENAME在森林下打地道，与根系融合，唤醒树木。整片林丛在无声控制下，悄悄移动。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME tunnels beneath forests, fusing with root systems to awaken trees. Entire groves move subtly under its silent control.

entry: POKENAME看似守林灵体，挥爪却慢又没劲。吓退讨厌访客的极限，也不过有点诡异的哀叫。
author: sk372
source: Ostensibly a guardian spirit of the forest, POKENAME's swipes are slow and unenthusiastic. The most it can muster to deter unwelcome visitors is a somewhat creepy wailing cry.

entry: POKENAME枝角靠近老树，就泛微光。只需一瞥，便能让树干活动，成为抽动的森林哨兵。
author: .izik
source: The branch-like horn atop POKENAME glows faintly near old trees. With a glance, it can animate trunks into twitching sentinels of the forest.

entry: POKENAME木身覆着藻般黏液。将这能光合的胶抹上树，就可通过心灵感应，远程控制。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's wooden body is covered by a layer of slime similar to algae. By placing blobs of this photosynthetic goo on trees, POKENAME can telepathically control them from a distance.

entry: POKENAME成群待暗林，诡异盯路人。通常附健康树，吸养分，直到树开始枯。
author: mistymagius
source: Groups of POKENAME hang out in dark forests, creepily staring at those who walk by. They will usually attach themselves to healthy trees and feed off their nutrients until the tree starts to wither.

entry: POKENAME群落住大树，咬颚、尖叫，抵御任何威胁。能察觉所在林丛的叶片变化，三只组队查看异常。
author: pjporwoll
source: Colonies of POKENAME inhabit large trees and defend them against any threat by biting with their jaws or scaring with their shrill chittering. They sense shifts in the leaves of the grove their tree is in and investigate suspicious changes in trios.

entry: POKENAME在树间织导电丝，与自身连成活体电路。猎物一近，电击便沿树皮、树枝传去。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spins conductive silk between trees to form a living circuit with itself. Once prey is near, it channels shocks through bark and branch alike.

entry: POKENAME用獠牙，在住处的树皮上刻下标记，标示自己的领地。闯入者若无视警告，继续深入森林，它便会变得凶猛好斗。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses its tusks to carve markings into the bark of trees in its home. These markings are indicators of its territory, and POKENAME will turn aggressive if these markers are ignored and trespassers delve further into the forest.

entry: 凡威胁POKENAME栖居树木的生物，都会被它纠缠不休。它的嚎叫像狂风刮过树枝。消化食物时无法飞行，就蜷起身体，假装灌木。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME relentlessly harasses threats to the tree it has made its home. Its howling cry sounds like an intense wind blowing through tree branches. When digesting a meal, it is unable to fly, so it curls up and pretends to be a bush.

entry: POKENAME像风滚草，滚过森林，嘎吱怪响。所到处，留一路腐败植物。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME rolls around the forest like a tumbleweed, making an eerie creaking noise as it rolls. It leaves a trail of decaying plants wherever it goes.

entry: POKENAME常袭击、扰乱伐木作业，被人当作森林的守护灵。其实，它们单纯讨厌重型机械的声音。
author: alumed
source: POKENAME are often thought to be guardian spirits of the forest, as they frequently attack and disrupt logging operations. In truth, they simply hate the sound of heavy machinery.

entry: POKENAME吼，周围树便颤摇，仿佛回应。虽曾被误解，其实是温和、不爱斗的巨人，以爪尾耕地，让新生命扎根。
author: infinex21
source: When a POKENAME roars, the trees around it quiver and sway as if responding to its call. Despite initial assumptions, POKENAME are gentle giants that prefer not to fight. They use their claw-like tails to till the ground so new life may take root.

entry: POKENAME旋转得足够快，就能翻动土壤，将自己部分埋起。埋在土里时，它们会伸根操纵附近植物，也能向四周释放寒气，阻碍靠近的敌人。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME can spin fast enough to churn the ground, allowing them to partially bury themselves. While buried, they can extend roots to control nearby plants. They can release freezing air all around them to impede any foes nearby.

entry: POKENAME体内特殊树脂，遇冷几分钟就硬得如琥珀。猎物封进琥珀，吸残余生命力，耗尽便丢弃。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME produce a special form of resin within them that can harden like amber within minutes of exposure to cold air. They preserve their prey in amber and feed on their lingering life force; when no life remains, POKENAME discard them.

entry: POKENAME自认是小型植物的守护者，夜间巡视森林与花园，向可能闯入的生物甩出叶片。叶子虽小，边缘却锐利得能造成严重割伤。
author: sk372
source: Considering itself a defender of small plant-life, POKENAME patrols forests and gardens at night, flinging leaves at potential trespassers. Though small, these leaves possess sharp enough edges to leave nasty cuts.

entry: 它一跳舞，叶片就在空中扬起伴舞。秋季，缤纷舞姿引来许多野餐者。
author: bandedbodypress
source: When it dances, leaves lift from the air and dance alongside it. During the fall, its colorful dances attract many picnickers.

entry: POKENAME狡猾隐秘，一动不动地假扮普通树，直到狩猎时刻。等无戒备的猎物背过身，根部便将它飞快弹射出去，一口咬住下一餐。
author: sk372
source: Very sneaky and sly, POKENAME remains immobile and pretends to be a normal tree until it is time to hunt. It waits for unsuspecting prey to turn their back, before its roots launch it at blindingly-fast speeds to chomp down on its next meal.

entry: POKENAME夜间用灵力控制树木，操纵枝条与根部，主要用来吓唬那些无人照看、闯入它森林家园的孩子。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses its spiritual power to take control of trees at night, manipulating their branches and roots. It uses this primarily to frighten children that wander unattended into its forest home.

entry: POKENAME叶耳传出低沉雷鸣般脉冲，以超常力量震动林冠，扰乱猎物。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME releases deep, thunderous pulses through its leaflike ears. These vibrations rattle canopies and disorient prey with unnatural force.

entry: POKENAME飞过林梢，侦察威胁。谁伤害森林，便会被它无情追击，直到彻底消灭。
author: skymaster426
source: POKENAME flies over the skies of forests to scout for threats. Whoever harms its forest will be attacked mercilessly until they are eradicated.

entry: POKENAME藏密树顶，俯冲将猎物拖回林冠巢。叶格外柔软，是很好的枕头填絮。
author: hiimhdere
source: POKENAME camouflages into dense treetops, before swooping down and dragging prey into nests they make in the canopy. This Pokémon's leaves are extraordinarily soft, and make for effective pillow stuffing.

entry: 心中有愧的人，碰到POKENAME滴下的树液，便会黏在它身上，无法脱身。只有坦承自己的过错，才能获释。
author: staghorn
source: If a human with a guilty conscience touches the sap dripping from a POKENAME, they will stick to its body and become trapped. The only way for them to be released from its clutches is by confessing their guilt.

entry: POKENAME跺脚，波动穿地，唤醒近处树。树回应召唤，以整片森林之力压敌，战后再扶正所有倒树。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME stamps its foot to send a ripple through the ground which wakes any trees nearby. The trees respond to POKENAME's call, bringing the power of an entire forest down on their foe. After battle, POKENAME rights any fallen tree.

entry: 七只眼总按花纹眨，有人认为是在与往昔灵魂沟通。住在死林，众根扎地，也能控枯植物，赶走威胁。
author: infinex21
source: Its seven eyes are always blinking in patterns, which some believe allows it to communicate with bygone spirits. Its den is within a dead forest, yet by ingraining its many roots, it can control the dead plants to drive off threats.

entry: 特别诡异的夜里，POKENAME会进镇，想偷居民灵魂。平时却多留暗林与墓地。
author: mistymagius
source: On especially eerie nights, POKENAME will wander into towns, trying to steal the souls of the townsfolk. However, it usually sticks to dark forests and graveyards.

entry: POKENAME以根网络，跨广阔沙漠，与其他仙人掌相通，刺球仙人掌、梦歌仙人掌也在内。尽量将水存躯干，分享给沙漠伙伴。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME communes with other cacti, including Cacnea and Cacturne, across vast stretches of desert via a root system. It tries to store water in its torso to share with other Pokémon that live in the desert.

entry: POKENAME用红孢子，令闯林者产生幻觉。若近处突然喷出孢子，轻轻拉它的蘑菇，就能吓退。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME use their red spores to induce hallucinations in trespassers of their forest. If POKENAME is a burst of spores nearby, one just simply needs to gently tug on their mushroom to scare them off.

entry: POKENAME假扮舒适的小屋，供迷路的旅人和宝可梦休息。可住客一想离开，它就会封死所有门窗，将客人整个吞下。
author: patch01774
source: POKENAME disguises itself as a cozy cabin for lost travelers and Pokémon to rest in. Once those who enter try to leave, however, it will seal all of its doorways and windows shut and consume its guests whole.

entry: 据说它是狗的灵魂，与最爱的木棍之魂结合。如今独自玩无尽的捡抛游戏。
author: kiwiarms
source: Supposedly, it is the spirit of a dog combined with the spirit of its favorite stick. Now it plays an endless game of fetch by itself.

entry: POKENAME孢子驱赶大多数爬行类宝可梦，因此傲骨燕、大王燕的家族，常把叶丛当安全庇护。
author: theaceofhearts0306
source: Most reptilian Pokémon are repelled by the spores POKENAME excretes. Due to this repulsion, families of Taillow and Swellow often take up its foliage as a safe haven.

entry: POKENAME被天敌发现，就跑进灌丛，疯狂翻动，以更强进化形态的幻象，试着吓退对方。
author: hiimhdere
source: If POKENAME is spotted by a predator, it will run into the bushes. Once in the bushes, it will thrash around wildly, attempting to scare the predator off with the illusion of its more powerful evolved forms.

entry: POKENAME常将年幼同族驮在肩上，叶子提供舒适休息处。受威胁，摇叶、敲木甲，发警告。
author: hiimhdere
source: POKENAME will often carry younger Tremo-o on its shoulder, where leaves provide a comfortable place to rest. When threatened, it will shake its leaves and clack its wooden armor as a warning.

entry: POKENAME拼尽一切保护族群，确保家人安全。受激便连连尖叫、作响，除最无畏的敌人，都被吓退。
author: hiimhdere
source: Fiercely protective of its pride, POKENAME will stop at nothing to ensure the safety of its family. If provoked, it will let loose a series of screeches and rattling, scaring off all but the most dauntless of foes.

entry: POKENAME的伪装本领近乎无可匹敌。不借助幻象，就能融入森林景色，少有宝可梦能与之相比。谁扰乱森林，就会遭到它不休不止的跟踪。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME's camouflage is near-unmatched, allowing it to blend into the forest scenery like few other Pokémon can without illusions. If someone disturbs the forest, they will find themselves stalked by POKENAME relentlessly.

entry: 民间故事中，POKENAME是神圣森林的神秘守护者。对破坏者无情，卷起火与荆棘的旋风，迅速惩罚。
author: mepp.
source: In folklore, POKENAME are the mystical guardians of sacred forests. They are merciless against those who would ravage these forests, swiftly punishing them with a whirlwind of fire and thorns.

entry: POKENAME用黏性泡泡将树叶连成防护披风，因此会在树木的枝叶间筑巢。它们吐出大量泡泡，扑灭火焰、防止森林火灾，随后再追捕纵火者。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME clad themselves in protective cloaks of leaves held together with sticky bubbles; as such, they nest within tree foliage. They spit out many bubbles to put out flames and prevent forest fires, then hunt down those responsible.

entry: 它的叶片披风由绿色黏性气泡固定，停在树枝上时很容易融入环境。它向伐木工人掷出叶片，准头惊人，速度也快得足以划出疼痛的伤口。
author: infinex21
source: Its cloak of leaves is held together with green, adhesive bubbles, which helps it to blend in while perched atop tree branches. It throws leaves at lumberjacks with remarkable accuracy and at such speeds that they will leave painful cuts.

entry: 它颈边环绕的附属物，是一条长根，能连上附近植物的根，进而控制植物。它在暗处监视林中生灵，谁若对森林稍有伤害，就以精准的飞水手里剑攻击。
author: infinex21
source: The appendage around its neck is a long root that allows it to connect with and control nearby plants through their roots. From the shadows, it monitors those in its forest and attacks them with precise Water Shuriken if they harm the forest at all.

entry: 情绪激动如战斗时，它们身体局部烧红，周围散浓黑雾。雾中灰烬本就是好肥料，栖地因此格外茂盛。
author: infinex21
source: When agitated, such as in battle, parts of their bodies become red hot, and they exude a thick, black haze around them. This haze is laced with ash that works well as a fertilizer on its own, so their habitats are considerably lush.

entry: POKENAME步态笨拙，有人说更像踉跄蹒跚。战斗操植物与根；据报壳中红光会跟着动作移动，还会眨动。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME move awkwardly, though some would call it shambling more than walking, and fight by manipulating nearby plants and their roots. Reportedly, people have seen the red lights in POKENAME's shells following their movements and blinking.

entry: POKENAME恨一切进领地的生物，不捉到绝不放弃。看哪些树根正慢慢吞噬躯体，就能辨其领地。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME hates anything entering its territory and will relentlessly pursue them until it catches them. You can determine which trees are its territory by the bodies slowly being consumed by their roots.

entry: POKENAME常将无辜的人引入自己的森林，看着对方逐渐迷失在黑暗林中。它还常挪动树木的位置，让受害者几乎不可能逃出去。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME will often lure innocent people into its forests, watching as they slowly get lost in the dark woods. It will often shift the position of the trees, making it almost impossible for its victims to escape.

entry: POKENAME夜间躲在树木与灌丛中，用硕大的红眼观察周围。发现它们的人，往往会被吓得逃走。
author: actliux
source: POKENAME hide within trees and bushes during the nighttime. They use their large red eyes to observe their surroundings from the shrubbery, and those who notice them tend to flee out of sheer fear.

entry: POKENAME以完美搭配的香草香料，做最棒酸种面包，也尤其擅烤圣诞树干蛋糕。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME uses a perfect mixture of herbs and spices to create the best sourdough loaves. It is also especially great at baking yule logs.

entry: POKENAME戴上举在脸前的大饼干面具，就能控附近全部枝叶。熟悉林中每种气味，陌生威胁一入境，立刻就知。
author: soup1900
source: When POKENAME puts on the large cookie mask that it holds over its face, it gains control of all nearby foliage. Knowing every smell in its forest, it always knows the moment when an unfamiliar threat enters its territory.

entry: POKENAME笨拙，常翻到壳上，起不来。只好控周围根，盼先翻正，接着准又会重来一遍。
author: hiimhdere
source: Clumsy and bumbling, POKENAME often gets stuck on its shell. To remedy this, POKENAME can control the roots around it, hopefully righting itself before, undoubtedly, repeating this process again.

entry: POKENAME住林中小池，慢慢污染水，杀死附近一切生命，让水有毒不能喝。
author: evilgammon
source: Making its home in small forest ponds, POKENAME slowly corrupts the water it inhabits. This process kills all nearby life and renders the water toxic to drink.

entry: 白天，POKENAME以根大量汲沼水。夜里散入林中，操树无声巡逻。
author: .izik
source: By day, POKENAME drink deeply from swamps through their roots. At night, they spread through the woods, manipulating trees to patrol in silence.

entry: 夜里，POKENAME无声浮过沼泽树间，轻轻挪开附近枝条，让滑行通路畅通。
author: .izik
source: At night, POKENAME floats silently between swamp trees. It subtly shifts nearby branches with its powers to keep its path clear as it glides.

entry: POKENAME核心的奇异能量，让木壳碎片绕身浮动。被迫战斗时，既当弹丸，也当甲胄。
author: sk372
source: Bits of a wooden shell circle around POKENAME, levitated by a strange energy from its core. It manipulates these pieces both as projectiles and as armor when forced into battle.

entry: POKENAME保护森林，抵御伤林者。它的火焰，永远不会熄灭。
author: mr.person__prinplup_enjoyer
source: POKENAME protects forests from those who harm them. Its flame never goes out.

entry: 传说这宝可梦住古林深处，有些故事更说在正中央。众根扎地，控制附近植物，保卫自己与家园。
author: infinex21
source: A storied Pokémon said to reside deep within ancient forests, with some stories claiming it resides at the very center. It will dig its mass of roots into the ground and then exert control over nearby plants to defend itself and its home.

entry: POKENAME枝条长成利爪，靠刮巨石保持锋利。不磨爪时，游荡闹鬼森林，盼遇合适训练家，跟对方回家。
author: quackquackattack
source: The branches of a POKENAME grow into long claws that they scrape against boulders to keep sharp. When they are not sharpening their claws, they wander haunted forests hoping to find the right Trainer to go home with.

entry: POKENAME将根伸入地下，连上附近的树木，感受它们的所感。它借树木探知其他宝可梦的动静，凡是靠得太近的东西，都会扑过去。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME stretches its roots through the ground, tapping into nearby trees to feel what they feel. It uses this ability to sense the movement of other Pokémon through the trees, pouncing on anything that gets too close.

entry: POKENAME要吓退旁人，就拆下木身的头，用超能力漂着绕圈。接回后，却常头痛。
author: sk372
source: Should it need to frighten others away, POKENAME lifts off the head of its wooden body and levitates it around using psychic powers. It tends to get a headache once the head is reattached afterward.

entry: 许多砍毁森林的人，临终前最后看见的，就是POKENAME。它几乎不必移动，就能让自然听从意志。
author: captainzscourge
source: POKENAME is often the last sight of those who are causing a forest to shrink in size. It is able to bend nature to its will, despite barely moving.

entry: 民间传说里，它是守护自然的传奇存在。人类与宝可梦，都常在它脚下，留下敬献的供品。
author: captainzscourge
source: This Pokémon is the legendary guardian of nature, according to folklore. There is often tribute left at its feet, from people and Pokémon alike.

entry: 古籍描绘POKENAME为凶险森林神。取用森林却不偿还者，会遭烈火焚村。
author: chibitales
source: Depictions of POKENAME appear in ancient texts describing it as a menacing deity of the forest. Those who took from the forest without recompense were met with awful fires burning their villages.

entry: 许多POKENAME似与伐木公司达成妥协，只能砍它许可的树。违约者，会被一拳打向最近的树。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Many POKENAME seem to have come to a compromise with logging companies. At the discretion of POKENAME, only certain trees are cut down. Those who break this deal get punched into the nearest tree.

entry: POKENAME的双臂巨大，足以轻松托着自己移动，因此很少真用双脚站立。它缓缓穿行黑暗森林，随时准备击倒破坏林地安宁的生灵。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's arms are huge enough to carry it around easily, so it's rarely seen actually standing on its own feet. It lumbers throughout dark forests, ready to strike down those who would disturb the woodland's peace.

entry: 它们游林，避开林间小屋。据说会猎捕深入过头的训练家，吞食他们与宝可梦的灵魂。
author: naivetotoro
source: These Pokémon roam the forests while keeping their distance from woodland cabins. It is said that they prey on trainers who venture too deep into the woods, feeding on their souls and those of their Pokémon.

entry: 野生POKENAME常攀森林附近的树与山，可被小石子击中，也会落下。身硬如石，光坠落就能造成重创。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME notoriously cling to the sides of trees and mountains that are near forests, though they will fall if struck by anything, even a small pebble. Their bodies are as hard as stone, so even by falling they can cause considerable damage.

entry: POKENAME被敬为火热、却又讽刺地冷酷的森林守卫。像无声影子，跟踪不敬闯入者，受激便灼烧。
author: chaos_emblemx
source: POKENAME is revered as the fiery and, ironically, cold-hearted guardian of the forest. It stalks disrespectful trespassers like a silent shadow and scorches them when provoked.

entry: POKENAME发怪嘶，奔过林中旅人。迷信说，会用空灵力量把不受欢迎的客人定在背上，载往来世。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME gallops past forest travelers with an eerie whinny. Superstitions say that it will force unwelcome guests onto its back, held there by ethereal forces, and carry them off into the afterlife.

entry: POKENAME藏在独特、濒危树木的树冠中，对危及家园的生灵伺机出手。胸口的洞里藏着种子，若感到经过者关爱自然，它就会送上一颗。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME hides in the canopies of unique and endangered trees, waiting to attack any that would harm its home. It carries seeds in the hole of its chest, and will give one to any passerby who it senses cares about nature.

entry: POKENAME白天多睡水道底，能控海藻与芦苇，引鱼避开沼王的大嘴。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME will sleep most of the day at the bottom of water ways. It can exert control over seaweed and reeds to help guide fish from swimming into the mouths of Quagsire.

entry: POKENAME在寒冷夜晚醒来，游荡于栖居的黑暗森林。据说，若有人直视它的巨眼，反会将POKENAME吓得恐惧发狂，攻击附近的一切。
author: actliux
source: POKENAME awakens during cold nights to wander the dark forests it inhabits. Looking into its massive eye is said to frighten POKENAME and send it into a terrified frenzy, attacking anything nearby.

entry: POKENAME允许森林里任何宝可梦，在自己的巨嘴中安家。不过，对威胁森林的家伙，这张嘴却意味着覆灭：灵魂会被夺走，化作森林的肥料。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME allows any Pokémon that lives in the forest to make its home inside of its gigantic mouth. To any forest threat, this mouth instead becomes their downfall and their soul is taken. The soul is then used as fertilizer for its forest.

entry: POKENAME背上的种子能放出格外浓烈的恶臭，驱赶敌对宝可梦。它通常住在空地，大半生都在吸收阳光，从中获取生存所需的能量。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME can release a particularly strong and foul odor from the bulb on its back, which drives away enemy Pokémon. It usually inhabits clearings and spends most of its life absorbing sunlight, from which it draws the energy it needs to survive.

entry: POKENAME爆炸，会从体内放出大量花粉。腐臭留数周，还削弱附近植物。
author: sk372
source: When POKENAME explodes, it releases a large burst of pollen from within its body. The putrid stench left behind can linger for weeks, and weakens plant life in the vicinity.

entry: POKENAME体内树汁，可熬成糖状物。价格便宜，是帕底亚烘焙店常用的甜味剂。
author: .izik
source: The sap inside POKENAME can be boiled into a sugar-like substance. This sweetener is a staple in Paldea's bakeries due to its affordability.

entry: POKENAME脚动越多，臭气越浓。用力时流出的汗，也和常从嘴滴下的蜜状花蜜一样。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME generates more and more of its pungent aroma the more it uses its feet. As it exerts itself, it sweats the same honey-like nectar often seen drooling from its mouth.

entry: POKENAME吃枯植物，混成肥料，从过滤孔排出。常吃太多，来不及喷够气体，混合物就先变毒涎漏出。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME consumes dead plant matter, which mixes into a fertilizing concoction and is released by its filtering vents. It often eats so much that it cannot spray enough of the gas before it begins leaking the mixture as a toxic drool.

entry: POKENAME身上石瓣放橙粉，令多数生物恐惧。谁不怕，就顶角冲去。
author: .izik
source: Stone flaps on POKENAME's body emit clouds of orange powder that inspire fear in most creatures. If anything resists the fear, it charges with its horn raised.

entry: POKENAME触手由微小细丝构成，碰哪都黏。细丝是类胡萝卜素，让它呈独特橙色。
author: quackquackattack
source: The tentacles of POKENAME are made of tiny filaments that stick to any surface they touch. The filaments are made of carotenoids that give POKENAME their distinct orange color.

entry: POKENAME嘴滴臭花蜜，袋里走路草吃来补养分。尾巴当棒，抵御天敌。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME drool foul-smelling nectar from their mouths, which the Oddish in their pouches will consume for nutrients. They use their tails as clubs to keep predators at bay.

entry: POKENAME翼撒浓紫催眠粉，制住猎物。睡下后，受害者噩梦连连，发起高烧。
author: .izik
source: From its wings, POKENAME releases a dense cloud of purple Sleep Powder to incapacitate prey. Once asleep, victims are plagued with awful dreams and an intense fever.

entry: 它不经意分泌的毒蜜，会污染附近的水。虽然鲜少主动攻击，许多宝可梦，却仍因此遭殃。
author: chorb33
source: It contaminates the water around it with a passively secreted, poisonous honey. Although it rarely attacks, many different Pokémon fall victim to it.

entry: 它砍大片最臭的花吃，因此蜂蜜虽甜美，却也臭得厉害。
author: sk372
source: It cuts down large swaths of the most pungent flowers to eat. These flowers are what give its honey such a foul stench in addition to the enjoyably sweet taste.

entry: POKENAME口气太臭，近处生物常昏倒。自己似乎没发觉，还想亲醒他们。
author: bobosmith01
source: Those close to POKENAME often fall unconscious due to its horrible-smelling breath. POKENAME itself, however, appears to be unaware and will try to kiss those that have fainted to wake them up.

entry: POKENAME喝树汁后，身上荚散清新松香。受威胁，却能喷毒云赶敌。
author: .izik
source: After drinking sap from trees, the pods on its body release a refreshing pine scent. However, if threatened, POKENAME can expel a noxious cloud to drive enemies away.

entry: POKENAME唾液加快分解食物，好继续多吃，为蛹期蓄能。叶干后，有湿森林般的舒心香，常用作香料干花。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME's drool helps break down its food more quickly, allowing it to continue eating more to build energy for its pupal stage. Its leaves give off a calming scent like a damp forest when dried, making them popular for potpourri.

entry: POKENAME蜕皮像臭臭花的恶臭花瓣。外表如此，性情却极凶悍。
author: raydrago
source: POKENAME's shedding skin resembles the petals of a Gloom's foul-smelling flower. Despite its looks, this Pokémon has an extremely aggressive nature.

entry: POKENAME背花产大量催眠孢子，总让自己打瞌睡。数百年来，这孢子既用来做解眠药，也做解毒药。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is constantly dozing off because the flower on its back produces large amounts of sleep-inducing spores. These spores have been used for centuries in both Awakenings and Antidotes.

entry: POKENAME在日光下，快乐地扭来扭去，似乎还会分泌黏稠甜汁，引来各种虫宝可梦。
author: xephyr
source: POKENAME wiggles and jiggles happily in the sun. It seems to secrete a thick, sweet ooze that attracts all manner of Bug-type Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME在保护壳中发育时，用口涎吸引传粉者，补充养分。若天敌试图袭击，就从花里喷出毒粉，但这也会推迟它出壳的时机。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME attracts pollinators with its drool, providing it with supplemental nutrients while it gestates in its protective shell. If a predator attempts to attack, it sprays noxious powder from its flower, but that slows how soon it can emerge.

entry: POKENAME花瓣分泌浓蜜状毒，诱猎物。没戒心的宝可梦近身，就用毒刺出击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's petals secrete a thick, honey-like toxin that attracts prey. When an unsuspecting Pokémon draws near, it strikes with its venomous stingers.

entry: POKENAME集中超能力，头花便放刺鼻难闻的气味。通常住深林，驱逐太近住处的人。
author: fiordaliso
source: When POKENAME concentrates its psychic powers, the flower on its head gives off a sharp, unpleasant odor. It tends to live deep within forests, driving away any human who ventures too close to its home.

entry: 据说POKENAME头上粉花粉，一碰就带快乐。因罕见，尚未充分测试，无法判断真有效果，还是安慰剂。
author: .izik
source: The pink pollen POKENAME produces from its head is said to bring happiness to anyone it touches. Due to its rarity, extensive testing has not been done to determine whether this is a genuine effect or a placebo.

entry: 自己的蜜状唾液太醉人，连它都常头脑不清。挥大叶挡威胁，却常蹒跚，最终跌倒。
author: infinex21
source: Its own honey-like saliva is so intoxicating that even this Pokémon is often cognitively impaired. It will wave around its large leaf to keep threats at bay, but often stumbles about and eventually falls over.

entry: POKENAME滴蜜，香浓醉人，滋味却随饮食、因个体而异。颈边卷叶里的树芽，分泌稠度与蜂蜜相同的树汁。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME drool honey that is intoxicatingly aromatic, though the flavor differs between each individual depending on their diet. The tree shoots within the curled leaves around their necks secrete sap with consistencies that match their honey.

entry: POKENAME许多英里外，也闻得到同类花蜜，连夜跋涉找彼此。轮流低头，饮同伴花里的蜜。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME can smell the nectar of other POKENAME from many miles away, trekking through the night to find one another. They bow their heads in turn, drinking from their companion's flower.

entry: 它滴下的蜂蜜营养丰富，足以促进大多数已知植物与草属性宝可梦生长。身上每一处球状部位都极香，常被用来烹饪。
author: infinex21
source: It drools honey that is nutritious enough to boost the growth of most known plants and the growth of most known Grass-type Pokémon. Each of its bulbs are extremely fragrant and are often used in cooking.

entry: POKENAME口中分泌黏液，香而易燃。甩出再点火，保护自己。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME secrete an viscous fluid from their mouths that is equally aromatic and flammable. They will fling this fluid and set it aflame to protect themselves.

entry: POKENAME吃玫瑰花瓣，保持羽毛柔软。鲜亮羽色，表示营养良好。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME eats the petals off roses to maintain the softness of its feathers. Its vibrant plumage is a sign of a well-nourished diet.

entry: POKENAME见中意的花，就不停流涎，常因此疯狂觅食。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME spots desirable flowers, it begins to drool uncontrollably. This behavior often leads it to a frenzy of foraging.

entry: POKENAME口里渗润滑树汁，可涂木当清漆。导电性极强，配灯具与灯泡，就能让木雕成为美丽灯景。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME ooze a smooth sap from their mouths that is applied onto wood as a varnish. With a few lights and bulbs, the highly conductive sap can turn a wooden sculpture into a beautiful display.

entry: 将POKENAME的树液涂在木雕上，既能保护作品免受水损，又能导电。艺术展览便靠它照明，免得电线妨碍展陈的美感。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME sap is applied to wooden sculptures to create pieces of art that protects artwork from water damage and conducts electricity. Art exhibitions rely on this sap to illuminate spaces without wires interfering with the aesthetic of the displays.

entry: POKENAME还造不出真正花粉或孢子，不能靠这些让植物繁殖。可造带不同毒素的尘粒，用来护身。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME cannot yet create true pollen or spores and thus cannot cause flora to reproduce through those methods. However, it can create dusty particles that are laced with different toxins, allowing it to defend itself.

entry: 流行传闻说，吃POKENAME头上的树汁，也能一窥未来，却没提汁苦得惊人。
author: quackquackattack
source: A popular rumor claims that eating the sap from POKENAME heads allows people to share the glimpses of the future. These rumors fail to mention that their sap is incredibly bitter.

entry: 据说饮POKENAME糖浆般黏涎，能短暂看未来。可涎极苦，还令肚痛，多数人因此不喝。
author: quackquackattack
source: Drinking the syrupy drool of POKENAME is said to help people see short glimpses into the future. The drool itself is extremely bitter and causes stomach aches, so most people avoid drinking the drool.

entry: POKENAME缓缓摇动两朵花，模仿风吹花动的样子。移动时，它们留下一路花粉，这些粉尘会刺激不幸待在附近者的眼睛。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME slowly wave their two flowers to mimic the motion of being moved by the wind. They leave a trail of pollen as they move, the dusty substance causing irritation to the eyes of those unfortunate enough to be nearby.

entry: POKENAME全身涂树汁，润滑得滑溜，快扇叶翼飞行时，尤其重要。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME coat their bodies with the sap they produce, as the sap lubricates their bodies and make themselves slippery. This is especially important for POKENAME as they flap their leafy wings rapidly to fly.

entry: POKENAME靠滑润的树汁，润滑小小的叶翼。叶片不断微调，让身体保持在空中。树汁也因十分滑润，被装瓶当作自行车润滑油出售。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME rely on a slippery sap to lubricate their small leafy wings, as the leaves constantly make small adjustments to keep their bodies airborne. The sap is also bottled and sold as bicycle oil because of how slippery it is.

entry: POKENAME身上的三大绒团装满树液，绒团上的小孔舒缩，让它保持浮空。树液维持身体湿润，绒团一干，它便飞不起来。
author: quackquackattack
source: The three large puffs on POKENAME's body are full of sap, as each puff has tiny holes that expand and contract to keep POKENAME airborne. The sap ensures that their bodies stay moisturized, as POKENAME cannot fly when their puffs dry up.

entry: POKENAME把嘴里的臭口水涂在住宅墙内，招来更多住客安家。闻到恶臭，就很容易分辨哪家正遭POKENAME侵扰。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME smears the smelly drool from its mouth within the walls of homes to signal others to come make their homes there. Because the stench is so foul, it's easy to identify a home in the midst of a POKENAME infestation.

entry: POKENAME尾放阵阵甜香，令闻者极度愉悦，常诱宝可梦近身，更易受攻。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME releases puffs of a sweet aroma from its tail that cause a state of euphoria. This scent often lures Pokémon closer, leaving them vulnerable.

entry: POKENAME常一起在湿地玩水，搅起下方腐植物中的氧与养分，滋养环境。虽生态重要，常接触腐物，也让自己恶臭。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Often found splashing in wetlands together, POKENAME help enrich their environment by stirring up oxygen and nutrients from the rotting plant matter below. Though vital to the ecosystem, their constant exposure to decay gives them an awful smell.

entry: POKENAME常想交朋友，似乎不知浓蜜状唾液有多腐臭。却有行家以其浓香为享受，已有用它做的香水。
author: infinex21
source: It seems to be unaware of how rancid its viscous, honey-like saliva is, as POKENAME frequently tries to make friends with others. There are some connoisseurs that find the scent decadent, and some perfumes have been made with it.

entry: POKENAME在晴日草地休息，晒光充能。背上花苞慢慢舒展，能量噼啪作响。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME rests in sunny patches of grass to charge up on sunlight. The budding flower on its back crackles with energy as it slowly uncurls.

entry: 它用藏起的大牙，轻易啃碎腐木。过程中，释放难忍臭味，赶走天敌。
author: .izik
source: It gnaws on rotting logs using a large, hidden fang, breaking them apart with ease. During this process, it releases an unbearable stench that repels predators.

entry: POKENAME颈边球状物散腐臭，能随意脱下，标领地边界。
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher
source: The bulbs around POKENAME's neck emit a rancid smell. They can detach them at will, marking the boundaries of its territory.

entry: 据说POKENAME很坚韧，能忍许多痛才需休息。科学家认为，浓口涎是受伤后不留痕的原因之一。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are said to be sturdy creatures that can endure a lot of pain before needing to rest. Scientists claim that the thick sap that they drool is a part of how their body manages to remain unblemished after getting hurt.

entry: POKENAME向敌吐涎，天生麻痹成分使其动弹不得，确保危险相遇时的安全。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spits its drool at foes, using its innate paralytic properties to immobilize them. This ability ensures its safety in dangerous encounters.

entry: POKENAME吃绣球花瓣，摄取独特养分，叶色也因此更鲜亮。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME consumes hydrangea petals for their unique nutrients. This diet enhances the brightness of its leaves.

entry: POKENAME大片花瓣坚如钢，保护里面脆弱的孢子。什么靠近，就急转身体，混撒毒花粉与金属屑。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's larger petals are as tough as steel, protecting the delicate spores inside. If approached, it rapidly rotates its body, scattering a mix of toxic pollen and metal shavings.

entry: POKENAME花蜜香浓，人与宝可梦都会注意。有些大姐姐便不用香水，改为时刻带着它。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The nectar from POKENAME flowers has a strong floral scent that draws attention to them from people and Pokémon alike. In lieu of using perfumes, some Beauties choose to keep POKENAME with them at all times.

entry: POKENAME花蜜香浓，人与宝可梦都会注意。有些大姐姐便不用香水，改为时刻带着它。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The nectar from POKENAME flowers has a strong floral scent that draws attention to them from people and Pokémon alike. In lieu of using perfumes, some Beauties choose to keep POKENAME with them at all times.

entry: POKENAME嗅觉强，被自己的花臭惹得烦躁。每次喷嚏，黏臭口涎都会洒满面前。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's strong sense of smell means it gets agitated by the stench of its own flower. When it sneezes, it sprays its sticky, stinky drool all over the areas in front of it.

entry: 它在火山环境生长旺盛。靠近得小心，头上花形熔岩团，会放有害气体。
author: hophoppip
source: It thrives in volcanic environments. Be cautious when approaching it, as the flower-shaped globs of lava on its head give off noxious gases.

entry: POKENAME口漏的蜜香甜浓烈，还会长久维持极高温。充分冷却后，丰缘各地厨师会用于甜点。
author: .izik
source: The honey leaking from POKENAME's mouth smells intensely sweet but retains an incredibly high temperature for long periods. When sufficiently cooled, it is used in desserts throughout Hoenn by culinarians.

entry: POKENAME在落叶层里拱找食物，只有花朵露在外面。花蜜潮霉的气味，会引来大群虫属性宝可梦，跟在身后。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Only the flower of POKENAME is visible as it roots around through leaf litter for food. They are often trailed by swarms of Bug-Type Pokémon, the swarms drawn to POKENAME by the musty scent of their nectar.

entry: 它们产特殊有害液，随季节，闻着或像蜜、或像树汁。既是绝佳诱饵，又极黏，战中用途也广。
author: infinex21
source: They produce a special, noxious liquid that smells like honey or sap depending on the season. This liquid is perfect bait for prey and is also very sticky, making it versatile in battle as well.

entry: POKENAME无声地蜿蜒前行，把尾上的花举过高草，试图引来猎物。可还没来得及吞下，猎物就几乎总被臭味熏得飞走了。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME raises the flower on its tail over tall grass while silently slithering around to attempt to attract prey. However, they almost always fly away due to the foul smell before POKENAME can swallow them up.

entry: POKENAME从象鼻喷花中吸来的臭花粉云。常用这招防身，让鼻子出现独特色泽变化。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can expel a stinky cloud of pollen siphoned from its flower out of its trunk. The constant usage of this technique for self-defense has led to the unique discoloration of said trunk.

entry: POKENAME用象鼻喝水，滋养花苞。健康时，开花便有舒缓芳香。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME drinks water through its trunk to nourish its bulbs. Healthy bulbs emit a soothing fragrance when in bloom.

entry: POKENAME尾巴产生的黏液对其他生物有毒，它自己却觉得美味极了。若舔食太久，行为就会变得反常，难以预料。
author: sontyp
source: POKENAME's tail produces a sticky liquid that's toxic to others but seems incredibly delicious to itself. When they suck on the liquid too long, they get erratic and unpredictable.

entry: POKENAME口滴树汁辛辣刺激，靠气味赶天敌与敌人。
author: .izik
source: The sap that drips from POKENAME's mouth is intensely spicy and irritating. It uses this scent to ward off predators and foes alike.

entry: POKENAME嘴里总滴熔融般滚热的蜜。冷却、干燥后，硬成甜水晶糖，常在嘉年华卖。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME constantly drool molten-hot honey from their mouths. When cooled and dried, this honey hardens into a sweet crystal candy, often being sold at carnivals.

entry: POKENAME的口水一滴到身体，便会与鬃毛散出的热量反应，化为有害气体。不过，液态的口水十分珍贵，能让濒死的花恢复生机。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: As soon as the drool from POKENAME's mouth drips onto its body, it reacts with the heat emanating from its mane and becomes a noxious gas. The drool in its liquid form is very valuable, however, as it can bring dying flowers back to life.

entry: POKENAME口中分泌的蜂蜜香甜诱人，厨师一度争相索取，直到发现其中有剧毒。它用蜂蜜引来虫属性宝可梦，等对方试着吃蜜，便带着它们飞走。
author: infinex21
source: The sweet-smelling honey that secretes from the mouths of POKENAME was once sought after by chefs, until they realized it was highly toxic. They use their honey to attract Bug-type Pokémon and fly off with them after they try to consume it.

entry: POKENAME尾香辛辣，闻者会阵阵暴怒。这不稳定的香气，常扰乱附近宝可梦。
author: .izik
source: An aroma from POKENAME's tails smells spicy and incites intense bouts of anger in those who inhale it. This volatile scent often disrupts nearby Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME体小，只需日光与水，狭窄公寓也好养，很受学生欢迎。可香气有时会在该读书时，把训练家哄睡。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are easy Pokémon to keep within cramped apartments thanks to their small size and need for only sunlight and water. They are popular with students, though their scent can lull their Trainer to sleep when they should be studying.

entry: POKENAME忍不住模仿住处路过者的动作。舞蹈般的模仿费力，让本就浓的臭味，明显更重。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is compelled to mimic the movements of others it spots traveling by its home. The exertion of its dance-like mimicry causes its already pungent odor to get markedly worse.

entry: POKENAME叶尾尖锋利，轻易切过枝叶，用来准备饭菜。
author: .izik
source: The sharp tip of POKENAME's leaf-like tail slices through foliage with ease. It uses this skill to prepare its meals.

entry: POKENAME甲缝分泌蜜，滋味随饮食。尾尖球状部位养分足，因此备受觊觎。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME secrete honey from between their plates, the flavor of it being influenced by what they consume. The bulbs upon the tips of their tails are full of nutrients and, thus, are coveted by many.

entry: POKENAME嘴滴树汁，稠度像导热膏。可真拿来这样用，电脑系统就会严重故障。
author: .izik
source: The sap that drips from POKENAME's mouth is similar in consistency to thermal paste. If used as such, it can cause massive glitches in computer systems.

entry: POKENAME爬树找最好枝条睡。口涎在树下积成洼，为某些宝可梦提供苦养分。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME climb trees to find the best branches to nap on. The drool from their mouths collects in puddles at the base of the tree, which provides bitter nourishment to some Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME栖居的田地，常在看见之前，就先闻到臭味。嘴里滴下的热花蜜，气味像腐败的甜食，黏稠又烫，足以灼伤裸露的皮肤。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: Fields inhabited by POKENAME can often be smelled before they are seen. The heated nectar dripping from its mouth gives off a noxious odor resembling rotting sweets. This sticky substance is hot enough to leave burns on exposed skin.

entry: POKENAME身上花朵的厚实花瓣十分坚韧，能让它们借此滚动。它们夜里出来，从一个睡处滚到另一个，寻找肥沃土壤，作为白天的落脚处。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The thick petals of the flower growing on the bodies of POKENAME are tough enough that they can use them to roll on. They will emerge at night and roll from one sleeping spot to another, searching for fertile soil to settle for the day.

entry: POKENAME尾苞放黄粉，标领地。阵阵粉云，风大也看得见。
author: .izik
source: The bud on POKENAME's tail emits yellow powder to mark its territory. These puffs are visible even on windy days.

entry: POKENAME挥爪劈击，恶臭花蜜就沿攻击方向甩。气味好比一只常待烘焙店的破破袋。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: When POKENAME slash with their claws, the noxious nectar they produce gets flung in the direction of the attack. The smell of these Pokémon can be compared to a Trubbish that hangs around a bakery.

entry: POKENAME住沼泽，大蘑菇下筑巢。幼崽只喂真菌，因为栖地里多得很。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME reside in marshes, creating nests under large mushrooms. They will feed their young solely on fungi, as it is bountiful in the habitat they live in.

entry: POKENAME花与滴落花蜜，都刺鼻恶臭。它巧妙操纵训练家感官，使其从不察觉，也不被臭味困扰。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's flower and the nectar dripping from its body carry a noxious and pungent aroma. It carefully and subtly manipulates its Trainer's senses so they never sense and become bothered by its stench.

entry: POKENAME会流出有毒树液，黏在毛发和鳞片上，哪怕水洗、摩擦，也极难清除。许多宝可梦想用舌头舔掉，反而生了病。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME drool a poisonous sap that clings to fur and scales. This sap is incredibly difficult to remove, even with water or friction. Many Pokémon have gotten ill trying to remove this sap with their tongues.

entry: POKENAME的伪装十分出色，能与环境融为一体，但头上球状的植物部分，却始终不会变色。它们便用树叶将其盖住，使伪装更加逼真。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are capable of blending into their environment with their superb camouflage, but the plant bulbs on their head will always remain the same color. They cover the bulbs on their head with leaves to help make their camouflage more convincing.

entry: POKENAME气身极臭，多数宝可梦都绕行。除了臭味却无害，存在还会加快附近植物生长。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's gaseous form is incredibly smelly and causes most Pokémon to give it a wide berth. Aside from the stench, it is harmless, and its presence actually bolsters the growth rate of nearby plant life.

entry: POKENAME不停往身前滴黏汁，溅满身体，散甜腻香，吸来其他草属性宝可梦，源源不断提供潜在猎物。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME constantly drool a sticky sap down their front, splatters of it covering their body and giving off a sickly sweet scent. The sap attracts other Grass-Type Pokémon, providing POKENAME a steady stream of possible prey.

entry: POKENAME滴营养树汁，用来做抗衰老霜。毒花粉也被采来制手术麻醉剂，让肌肉麻木。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME drool a nutritious sap that is made into anti-aging creams. The toxic pollen they produce is also taken and made into anesthetics that numb muscles during surgery.

entry: POKENAME散发糖浆般的香气，使猎物误以为安全。对方一飘得太近，伪装成花朵的双颚便猛然合拢，无情一口，将其整个吞下。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME releases a syrupy fragrance from its body to entice prey into a false sense of safety. The moment they drift too near, the jaws disguised as blossoms snap shut, engulfing them whole in a merciless bite.

entry: POKENAME在潮湿的土岸或黑泥岸扎根，较为中空的上身里，会产生有害的蜂蜜状液体。自卫时，它们甩动上身，将液体洒向四周。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME root themselves along damp shores of dirt or shores of dark mud. They produce a noxious honey-like liquid within their rather hollow upper bodies. To defend themselves, they will flail their upper bodies and send this liquid flying about.

entry: POKENAME头锤时，头上坚硬成熟的花瓣，会更硬。若硬过头，花瓣就再长不动。
author: bandedbodypress
source: When POKENAME headbutts, its hard, ripened petals on its head get harder. If they get too hard, they will be unable to grow.

entry: POKENAME爱将旁人拉进拥抱，献上口中流出的蜂蜜状花蜜。也许出于好意，可花朵刺鼻的香气，会在被抱者身上停留很久。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME loves to pull others into a hug and offer the honey-like nectar it drools out. The offer may be well-intentioned, but the pungent aroma of POKENAME's flower will linger on the person hugged for quite some time after.

entry: 草药师收POKENAME树汁般的涎，做香薰蜡烛。据说有助与亡者交流，因此这些蜡烛很难找到。
author: quackquackattack
source: The sappy drool of POKENAME is collected by herbalists to produce scented candles. It is said that candles made of POKENAME sap help people communicate with the dead, which is why finding them can be quite difficult.

entry: 叶片产甜润露珠，它似乎总忍不住吃，变得懒洋洋、温顺。训练安全、听话，就是反应稍慢。不过不建议训练家食用露珠。
author: blake
source: It produces a sweet, succulent dew from its leaf, which it can't seem to help but eat. This makes the Pokémon lethargic and docile. It is safe to train and obedient, though a little slow to react. However, Trainers are advised not to consume the dew.

entry: 它不动，嘴里滴蜜诱猎物。即使吃了逃走，蜜中磁性成分，仍让它能用自身磁力，把猎物吸回嘴边。
author: sk372
source: It drools honey from its mouth to lure in prey while it remains sedentary. Even if something eats and escapes, the magnetic content of its honey allows it to use its own magnetism to draw them back to its mouth.

entry: 这根手杖能喷出黏稠、有毒的蜜，让对手晕头转向。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: This staff can expel a sticky, noxious honey that can disorientate opponents.

entry: POKENAME用缎带，将蜜状口涎抹给喜欢的对象。味浓却很甜，还有舒缓作用，能迅速减压。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses its ribbons to smear the honey-like drool it makes on those it likes. The drool is rather pungent but quite sweet and contains a calming property that helps alleviate stress quickly.

entry: 谁惹怒POKENAME，就迎来黏花蜜巨浪。光腐臭，就足以让人昏倒。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME responds to those who anger it with a tidal wave of sticky nectar. The rancid smell alone is enough to make anyone pass out.

entry: POKENAME口里特殊树汁，常被木匠做成漆。满月下，树汁漆会泛柔和荧光。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME produce a special sap from their mouths that many woodworkers turn into lacquer. Under the light of the full moon, the lacquer made with this sap fluoresces with a soft glow.

entry: POKENAME身上的三朵花，都能放出剧毒、有害的烟气。它也可能先用毒雾裹住自己，藏在其中，再挥动带刺藤蔓袭击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can dispense incredibly toxic and noxious fumes from all three of the flowers on its body. It may cover itself with a toxic fog before lashing out with thorn-covered vines while it remains hidden within.

entry: POKENAME极谨慎，常躲人。倒对路人有利，谁都知道它口气极差。
author: poppyisconfused
source: An incredibly cautious Pokémon that often tends to shy away from people. However, this works in passersby's favour; it is common knowledge that POKENAME possesses bad breath.

entry: POKENAME每步散孢子云，泥土气味刺鼻。受威胁，便挥蘑菇手臂，混撒毒孢子与催眠孢子。
author: .izik
source: Each step POKENAME takes releases a cloud of spores with a pungent, earthy aroma. If it feels threatened, it swings its mushroom-covered arms, scattering a mix of poisonous and sleep-inducing spores.

entry: 满月下，人们将POKENAME的树液当作特殊漆，涂在装饰木雕上，使作品发光。每月的艺术展展示树液的强光，为恢复森林筹款。
author: quackquackattack
source: Under the light of the full moon, POKENAME sap is applied to decorative wooden sculptures as a special lacquer to make the works of art glow. Monthly art exhibitions showcase the powerful glow of POKENAME sap to raise money for reforestation.

entry: POKENAME头上和尾巴的花，会散出香气浓郁的花粉。冷天闻着宜人，热天却会放出太多，浓烈得灼痛吸入者的耳鼻。
author: .jerden
source: The flowers on POKENAME's head and tail release pollen with a strong fragrance. While pleasant on cold days, on hot days POKENAME releases so much pollen that this becomes overwhelming, burning the ears and nose of anyone who inhales it.

entry: POKENAME的花，散发着略微呛鼻的气味，像火焰初起时的几缕轻烟。多瓣的尾巴，将气味扇遍栖居的森林，让它们在浓密的林下，也能找到彼此。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME flowers produce a slightly acrid scent, reminiscent of the first wisps of smoke from a fire. Their many-petalled tails waft this scent through the forests they live in, allowing them to find one another through the dense undergrowth.

entry: POKENAME只肯为极少数能欣赏臭味的幸运儿中的一人，实现心愿。实现时，还会不停流臭蜜，洒得到处都是。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME only grants wishes to one of the very few lucky people who can enjoy its foul-smelling fragrance. It excessively drools its repugnant-scented honey from its mouth and splatters it everywhere when it fulfills a wish.

entry: 它们主要吃复活草，喜欢苦味。苦会刺激某个脑区，帮助保持活力。
author: quackquackattack
source: Their diet consists mostly of the Revival Herb, which they enjoy for its bitter flavor. The bitterness activates a certain part of their brain that helps keep them active.

entry: POKENAME浓树汁常卡齿轮，转不动。想养得健康，训练家需隔几天清齿轮，防汁堆积。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME produce a thick sap that often gums up their gears, preventing them from rotating. Trainers who want to keep POKENAME healthy need to clean their gears every few days to prevent sap buildup.

entry: 研究显示，POKENAME花的浓烈气味，能缓头痛。可面临危险，会明显更浓、更刺激。
author: mepp.
source: Studies have shown that the pungent odor produced by POKENAME's flower can alleviate headaches. When faced with danger, the scent becomes noticeably stronger and irritating.

entry: POKENAME伪装得与毒蔷薇近乎一样，试图引它们靠近，传播具有感染性的孢子。
author: camtft
source: POKENAME disguises itself to look nearly identical to Roselia in an attempt to lure them closer and spread its infectious spores.

entry: POKENAME往栖居墓地滴洋甘菊香的酸性树汁，既标领地，也诱绿毛虫等虫属性猎物。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME drips chamomile-scented acidic sap across the graveyards it inhabits. The aroma marks its territory and lures Bug-type prey like Caterpie.

entry: 覆身胶状黏液，像无数花香混合。这独特香气，在香水业很受追捧。
author: .izik
source: The gelatinous slime coating its body smells like a mix of countless flowers. This unique scent is highly sought after in the perfume industry.

entry: POKENAME身上多个花苞，各有独特香气。香水商采花粉，调出浓烈芬芳。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have several flower buds across their body, each with their own unique scent. Perfume manufacturers harvest pollen from these flower buds to produce pungent aromas.

entry: POKENAME在土中穿行，只把花露在地面，不断散发甜腻的香气，吸引其他宝可梦。等对方靠得够近，它便跃出土层，扑咬过去。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME tunnel through the soil, keeping only their flower above the surface. They constantly emit a sickly sweet scent that draws other Pokémon to them, launching out of the soil to bite at them once they're close enough.

entry: POKENAME气味虽刺鼻，身体却很小，大型生物几乎闻不到臭味。它用臭口涎标出喜爱的觅食地点，告诉同类这里有很好的食物来源。
author: sk372
source: Although pungent, POKENAME's small size makes its stench almost imperceptible to larger creatures. It marks its favored feeding spots with its smelly drool, letting other POKENAME know of a good source of sustenance.

entry: POKENAME头花苞有浓金属气味。从地里拔出，刺便产浓树汁，没有防护就拿，会感刺痛。
author: quackquackattack
source: The flower buds on the heads of POKENAME have a strong metallic scent. When pulled out from the ground, their thorns produce a thick sap that produces a stinging sensation if held without protection.

entry: POKENAME总产黏树汁，裹在身上。踩它特别危险，树汁会让它黏住踩踏者。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME constantly produce a sticky sap that clings to their bodies. This makes stepping on POKENAME particularly dangerous, as the sap causes them to cling to whoever stepped on them.

entry: 它藏在浓密毒葛丛，等没戒心的猎物。受扰就吐酸毒，瞬间溶植物。
author: .izik
source: It hides within dense poison ivy patches, waiting for unsuspecting prey. When disturbed, it spits acidic toxins that can dissolve plant matter instantly.

entry: POKENAME埋头土里睡，嘴中树汁渗地，滋养土壤，促进植物生长。
author: .izik
source: As POKENAME sleeps with its head buried in the soil, sap from its mouth seeps into the ground. This sap enriches the soil, fostering plant growth.

entry: POKENAME优雅跳桑巴，每步都放彩粉团。绚丽景象迷住看客，也扰乱敌人。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME performs an elegant samba, releasing colorful puffs of powder with every step. The vibrant display mesmerizes onlookers and confuses foes.

entry: POKENAME以芭蕾般动作，撒出美丽花粉图案。战中优雅表演，常让敌人分心。
author: .izik
source: While performing ballet-like movements, POKENAME spreads its pollen in stunning patterns. The grace of its display often distracts enemies in battle.

entry: POKENAME是一堆活有机废物与园艺工具。维护健康花园很有用，可臭得不受欢迎。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME is a living pile of organic waste and gardening tools. It is very helpful for maintaining a healthy garden, but its terrible smell makes it unpopular.

entry: 口涎不断滴，浓臭能赶走多数海底猎手。船只开始至少带一只POKENAME跟航，减少受袭。
author: sk372
source: The pungent scent of the drool that constantly leaks from its mouth repels most undersea predators. Ships have taken to having at least one POKENAME follow them to reduce the chances of being attacked while sailing.

entry: POKENAME木身上的树果极毒。只吃一颗，也能麻痹好几年。
author: .izik
source: The berries on POKENAME's wooden body are extremely poisonous. Consuming even one can cause paralysis lasting years.

entry: 臭臭花自融合，身子夹在两朵花之间。POKENAME涎蜜格外甜，诱猎物；可花臭也格外浓，猎物还没近身，就先熏昏。
author: infranscia
source: This self fusion of Gloom ended up with its body sandwiched between two flowers.  While POKENAME's drool-like nectar is extra sweet, luring prey, the flowers' foul smell is extra pungent, knocking out said prey before it gets close enough to eat.

entry: 谁未经许可碰POKENAME花瓣，周围就放毒孢子云。它分泌的涎，被合成处理，用来增强洗洁精去油力。
author: fiordaliso
source: If someone touches POKENAME's petals without permission, it releases a cloud of poisonous spores around itself. The drool it secretes is synthesized and used to boost the grease-cutting power of dish soap.

entry: POKENAME干地也长得旺，毒臭驱天敌，深根吸地下水，最严酷沙漠也能生存。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME thrives in dry environments, using its noxious scent to repel predators. Its roots extend deep underground to absorb moisture, allowing it to survive even in the harshest deserts.

entry: POKENAME月下按节拍摇，放催眠雾，引没戒心的猎物。够近，就以刺须猛攻。
author: .izik
source: Under the moonlight, POKENAME sways rhythmically, releasing a hypnotic mist that lures in unsuspecting prey. Once close enough, it strikes with thorn-covered tendrils.

entry: POKENAME在满垃圾的海滩，散垃圾臭，诱臭泥等猎物，轻易吸收。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME emits a garbage-like stench on trash-covered beaches. The scent lures prey like Grimer, which it absorbs with ease.

entry: POKENAME双花恶臭，敌友全被赶走。口涎滴到哪里，就促地里真菌生长。
author: sk372
source: The foul stench from POKENAME's twin flowers drives off friends and foes alike. The drool dripping from its mouth encourages fungal growth in the ground it drips on.

entry: POKENAME鳞吸日光，增强毒性分泌物。先摇花瓣尾吓敌，再喷腐臭麻痹雾。
author: .izik
source: The scales on POKENAME's body absorb the sunlight, strengthening its toxic secretions. It rattles its petal-covered tail to intimidate foes before spraying them with a putrid, paralyzing mist.

entry: POKENAME大部分时间睡，流着诱人的蜜。受惊就急退，本能放臭，立即赶走一切潜在威胁，附近多数其他生命也会避开几天。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME sleeps the majority of the time, drooling an enticing honey. When startled, it hastily retreats and instinctually spews a noxious odor, which immediately drives away any possible threat but also most other life nearby for multiple days.

entry: POKENAME张开甲缝，放多种恶臭粉，妨碍对手。香料化学家捡外骨骼碎片，试着蒸馏其中粉末，制美妙独特香水。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME opens gaps in its exoskeleton plates to expel various foul-smelling powders to hinder its opponents. Shards of its exoskeleton are scavenged by fragrance chemists seeking to distill the powders into gorgeous and unique perfumes.

entry: POKENAME靠脚轮滚动，仍很笨拙，常摇晃跌倒。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME gets around by rolling on the wheels on its feet. It's still quite clumsy and is prone to wobbling and falling over.

entry: POKENAME种子吃越多，嘴中花蜜闻着越甜。可对人极毒，不能食用，会严重中毒。
author: .izik
source: The more seeds POKENAME eats, the sweeter the nectar flowing from its mouth smells. The nectar is extremely toxic to humans and should not be eaten, as it can cause severe poisoning.

entry: POKENAME背上的多朵蘑菇，渗出甜腻液体，驱使它们寻找同类。找到后，它们便互相梳理，身上也因此沾满新孢子。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The multiple mushrooms growing from the backs of POKENAME ooze a sickly sweet liquid that cause POKENAME to seek out others of their own species. When they find each other, they groom their partner, becoming coated in fresh spores as they do.

entry: POKENAME的口水恶臭难当，足以让一般生物闻得反胃。它用长舌把臭唾液涂满敌人，让对方在战斗中更难应付自己。
author: sk372
source: The noxious smell of POKENAME's drool is enough to make the average creature sick to its stomach. Using its long tongue, it coats foes with the stinky saliva to make dealing with it in combat much more difficult.

entry: POKENAME嘴流的蜜，远比花能产的多。喜欢阴暗多云，厚云遮日，尤其活跃。
author: curazy
source: POKENAME drools far more honey from its mouth than its flower can produce. It enjoys dark, cloudy weather and becomes especially lively when heavy clouds block out the sunlight.

entry: POKENAME摇摆走过夜里，躯干因漏液，泛诡光。液体虽好吃，却剧毒，务必避开。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME waddles through the night, its torso glowing eerily from the liquid it leaks. Though the fluid tastes pleasant, it is actually highly toxic and should be avoided at all costs.

entry: POKENAME口滴厚黏液，甜花香浓烈无比。煮沸蒸馏后，可成美味糖浆，搭许多烘焙食品。
author: fancyskunk
source: The thick, viscous fluid that drips from POKENAME's mouth has an overpoweringly sweet, floral scent. This fluid can be boiled and distilled into a delicious syrup that pairs well with many baked goods.

entry: POKENAME头总漏毒花粉，赶闯入者。若警告被无视，就会从最远20英尺外，吐腐蚀酸。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's head constantly leaks toxic pollen to ward off intruders. If left unheeded, it spits corrosive acid from up to 20 feet away.

entry: POKENAME浮水，以化学信号，招传粉者到球状植物部位。可替它传粉的宝可梦，最终都会严重中毒。
author: fxncy_poland
source: POKENAME float on top of water and attract pollinators to its bulb through chemical signals. However, Pokémon who pollinate POKENAME eventually suffer extreme poisoning.

entry: POKENAME遇险就放浓气，受伤更浓。据说气味极辛辣，刺激眼睛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME produce a pungent scent whenever they are in danger that grows stronger if they are injured. This scent is said to be incredibly spicy and irritates the eyes.

entry: POKENAME挖地遇特别大岩，就喷绿腐蚀酸。岩通常很快溶掉，路便通了。
author: .izik
source: If POKENAME encounters an unusually large boulder while digging, it spits corrosive green acid. The usually stone dissolves quickly, clearing its path.

entry: POKENAME睡在地道壁里，散舒缓木子果香。猎物近身，就放黄粉，令其麻痹。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME sleeps within tunnel walls, releasing a soothing Lum Berry scent. When prey draws near, it emits yellow powder that causes paralysis.

entry: POKENAME尾叶神秘指向贵重物。寻宝者虽知性情难料，仍常求指引。
author: .izik
source: The leaf on POKENAME's tail mysteriously points toward valuable objects. Treasure hunters often seek its guidance despite its unpredictable nature.

entry: POKENAME夜行，梦般恍惚地游林，受稀花吸引，蜷在周围一整夜。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are nocturnal Pokémon, roaming the forest at night in a dream-like haze. They are drawn toward rare flowers and will spend the night curled around them.

entry: POKENAME常调整头叶，缓解自己长期的头痛。动作带来有节奏的沙沙声。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME frequently adjusts the leaves on its head to ease its chronic headaches. The movement creates a rhythmic rustling sound.

entry: POKENAME游泳时，海面下一英里，也闻得到蜜状口涎。渔人虽恨那味，却很适合诱虫属性宝可梦。
author: teatedtiten
source: As POKENAME swims, its honey-like drool can be smelled from a mile below sea level. Though fishermen hate the smell, the drool works as an excellent Bug-Type attractant.

entry: POKENAME先给松果涂涎，软化外壳再吃。这行为在密林最常见。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME drools on pinecones before eating them, softening the outer shell. This behavior is most often seen in dense forests.

entry: POKENAME每拳都放催眠花粉云。敌人很少能清醒太久。
author: .izik
source: Each punch from POKENAME releases clouds of pollen that can induce sleep. Its opponents rarely stay conscious for long.

entry: POKENAME仿佛从未醒过，白天睡着反倒活动更多。收来的口涎，入许多菜，添咸甜味。
author: ghostslythe
source: Although POKENAME never seems to be awake, it moves more in its sleep during the day. Many dishes are flavored with its harvested drool, adding a salty-sweet taste.

entry: POKENAME视力虽差，却能借汤匙心灵感应，察觉周围，战中因此极准。
author: .izik
source: Despite its poor eyesight, POKENAME uses telepathy through its spoon to perceive its surroundings. This unique ability makes it highly accurate in battle.

entry: POKENAME用超能力，将麻痹粉云转向敌人，使其麻痹，无力防御。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its psychic powers to redirect clouds of Stun Spore at enemies. This tactic leaves foes paralyzed and defenseless.

entry: POKENAME口液收集加工后，可食用。营养高，促进肌肉生长，运动员很重视。
author: mepp.
source: The fluid that drips from POKENAME's mouth can be collected and processed for consumption. Athletes value it for its high nutritional benefits that aid in muscle growth.

entry: 往往还未看见POKENAME，就先闻到了臭味。皮肤分泌的恶臭毒液会吸引虫属性宝可梦，成为它的主要食物。
author: rakunk
source: You're likely to smell POKENAME before you see it, as it secretes a foul-smelling, poisonous liquid through its skin. This odor attracts Bug-type Pokémon, which it uses as its main source of food.

entry: POKENAME钟形头放浓树汁，引鱼宝可梦。触手扎海底，免被水流冲走。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME releases a thick sap from its bell-shaped head that lures fish Pokémon towards it. It digs its tentacles into the sea floor to avoid getting swept away by water currents.

entry: 臭花蜜是为了提醒旁人，POKENAME就在这，别踩。它便能整天沐着自己的蜜，无人打扰地躺着，也很满足。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Its foul smelling nectar is meant to signal its presence so that it does not get stepped on. This allows POKENAME to lay on the ground around all day unbothered, drenched in its own honey, which it is content to do.

entry: POKENAME鬃虽像火，实为无数小花。奔跑时如火摇曳，令人入迷，仿佛真焰。
author: .izik
source: Though resembling flames, POKENAME's mane is made of countless tiny flowers. They sway like fire, creating a mesmerizing illusion as it runs.

entry: POKENAME睡时放橙粉，让附近生物极度倦怠。若变黑，表示已酸化，一碰便灼伤。
author: .izik
source: The orange pollen POKENAME releases while sleeping causes extreme lethargy in those nearby. Should the pollen turn black, it has become acidic and can burn on contact.

entry: POKENAME浮湖晒太阳，球状部位吸日光。阳光最强时，几个小时都不动。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME floats on lake surfaces, basking as its bulbs absorb sunlight. It remains motionless for hours during peak daylight.

entry: POKENAME把花当长棍，敏捷挡击。用得够多，花便能硬到如铁。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME wields its flower like a quarterstaff, parrying blows with great agility. The flower can harden to the strength of iron with enough use.

entry: POKENAME两头轮流闻食，可花瓣自己的味，常让它们混乱。受惊就剧抖身体，放厚毒花粉云。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's two heads take turns sniffing out food, but the smell of its own petals often confuses them. If startled, it shakes its body violently, releasing a thick cloud of toxic pollen.

entry: POKENAME的恶臭能穿墙，数日不散。它身体很大一部分是液体废物，纯化后变成口中流出的蜂蜜，甜美异常，因此仍有农人饲养。
author: t3isukone
source: The stench of a POKENAME penetrates through walls and lingers for days. Some farmers cultivate them, however, as the honey they drool, a purified form of the liquid waste that makes up much of a POKENAME's body, is exquisitely sweet and delicious.

entry: POKENAME钻过松软土层，沿途摄取大量养分。吃下的土帮助它们长出花瓣，散发泥土香，备受香氛厂商青睐。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME tunnel through loose soil and dirt, consuming vast amounts of nutrients as they do. The soil they consume allows them to grow petals that give off an earthy smell that is prized by fragrance companies.

entry: 它背上的球状部位装满种子，花开时种子会爆裂，发出震耳的尖啸。它极少离开暗洞，因此背上的植物只靠少量日光维生。
author: ozydamians
source: Its bulb is full of seeds that pop with a deafening screech when the flower blooms. It rarely leaves dark caves, so the plant on its back survives on minimal sunlight.

entry: POKENAME以特殊频率探测地下最深100英尺处的化石残骸，拿来当铠甲。古生物学家常到POKENAME密集的地方寻找化石。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME uses special frequencies to find fossilized remains up to 100 feet underground which it then uses as armor. Paleontologists usually search in areas where lots of POKENAME can be found.

entry: POKENAME叫声甜美讨喜，在动物园是主要看点，会受训整齐合唱。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a dulcet cry that is endearing to many people. They are a major attraction at zoos where they are trained to sing in unison.

entry: POKENAME叫声欢腾悦耳，在水族馆是重要节目，会一同唱短小曲。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have an ebullient cry that is pleasant to listen to. They are a featured attraction at aquariums where they sing short jingles in unison.

entry: POKENAME藏在电脑屏幕的文件与图标后，被发现就惊叫。尖声极高，可能震裂藏身屏幕。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME tries to hide behind files and icons on computer screens, letting out a surprised shriek when discovered. Said shriek is shrill and high enough in pitch to potentially crack the screen it hides behind.

entry: POKENAME几乎从不离开洞穴，睡觉时常缠在钟乳石上。突然的巨响一传来，POKENAME就会惊慌飞走。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are almost never seen outside of their caves, usually seen wrapped around stalactites as they sleep. Any sudden loud noise and POKENAME will fly away in a panic.

entry: POKENAME用催眠超声波，谨慎将周围个体纳入控制。潜意识讯息在目标心中反复回荡，强化对它的忠诚。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME uses hypnotic ultrasonic waves to carefully draw those around them under their thrall. Subliminal messages echo repeatedly in the target's mind, enforcing loyalty to POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME偶尔栖在游乐鬼屋，喜欢吓经过的训练家，咯咯笑后突然消失。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME occasionally roost in haunted house attractions. They enjoy scaring Trainers that walk through, giggling before disappearing abruptly.

entry: POKENAME友善合群，可鸣声太响，是城市的难题。小群互叫，也能盖尽其他声，甚至令近处玻璃受损。
author: sk372
source: Highly friendly and sociable, POKENAME is a problem for urban areas due to the volume of its chirps. Even a small flock communicating with each other could blot out all other noises or even cause damage to nearby glass.

entry: 它在洞顶结网，白天大多在那里睡觉。蛛网结构会干扰超音蝠的回声定位，让它们直接飞进掌中。
author: mistymagius
source: It builds its webs on the ceiling of caves where it sleeps for most of the day. The web's structure messes with Zubat's echolocation, causing them to fly directly into its grasp.

entry: POKENAME在屋顶间跳跃，找孩子恶作剧，吓人取乐。灵活的尾巴还会顺手偷走路人的东西。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME leaps between rooftops, looking for children to playfully scare them for their amusement. It nicks random items from passersby with its flexible tail.

entry: POKENAME用超声推进水中，严重干扰声呐。因此遭许多地区海军追猎，海中变得很罕见。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME projects itself through the water by generating ultrasonic sounds. This wreaks havoc with sonar, so POKENAME is hunted by many region's navies, leading to it becoming very rare in oceans.

entry: 预知加回声定位，令POKENAME不可能被偷袭。饲主说，它从不在脚边碍事。
author: .fedoraman
source: Its combined precognition and echolocation make it incapable of being caught off-guard. Owners remark on how their POKENAME never get underfoot.

entry: 这种夜行宝可梦，只吃水果。双耳与背上球状部位，都能放强大声波，与数英里外同类沟通。
author: bobosmith01
source: A nocturnal Pokémon that dines exclusively on fruit. Both its ears and the bulb on its back can send out such powerful soundwaves that it may communicate with others of its kind for miles.

entry: 即使在最嘈杂的夜晚，巢穴附近仍能隐约听见POKENAME高亢的哀号。民间传说，若听见后忽觉背脊发凉，你便成了它接下来要害的人。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's loud high-pitched wails can be faintly heard even on the loudest of nights from near its den. Folktales say that if you feel shivers down your spine after hearing its cry, you're one of its next victims.

entry: POKENAME耐心潜伏在装满蛋的巢穴附近，用声波探知亲代何时离开，再悄悄溜进去，只挑最大、汁水最足的蛋饱餐。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME patiently stalks Egg-filled nests while using its sound waves to detect when the parents leave the area. It then sneaks in and takes only the biggest and juiciest Eggs to feast on.

entry: 以POKENAME的体型而言，鳞片却坚韧得能挡住落下的钟乳石。它静伏洞底等待进化，几乎不需食物或水。
author: mistymagius
source: Despite its size, POKENAME's scales are tough enough to resist falling stalactites. It waits silently on the cave floor, barely ever needing food or water while it waits for evolution.

entry: 进入POKENAME栖息的洞穴得小心。谁若打扰它们，可能挨上猛烈的电击。
author: sottiwotti
source: Be careful when entering caves where POKENAME reside, as they might voilently shock people who disturb them.

entry: POKENAME酷爱水果，够得着什么树果就抓什么。可贪食让身体太重，离不开地面，翅膀也就几乎没用。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME absolutely adores fruit and will eagerly grab any berries it can get its claws on. Their wings are basically useless as, due to their gluttony, they are too heavy to get off the ground.

entry: POKENAME飞行时，把听到的各种声响，混成活泼旋律。体侧大扬声器汇聚电能，轰鸣出放大回声与强劲和弦。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME fly through the sky while remixing different sounds they observe into lively melodies. The large speakers on their sides blare out with concentrated electricity, creating amplified echoes and powerful chords.

entry: 它从臂端放出伴随高音的灼热冲击。这种攻击会升高体温，大耳却能缓解过热风险。
author: cait_sith
source: It unleashes high-pitched and extremely hot blasts from the ends of its arms. Attacking like this raises its internal temperature, but its large ears mitigate the risk of overheating.

entry: POKENAME蓬松双翼藏着器官，发超声波，在黑暗精测距离。遇上纷争，就躲洞穴深处。
author: pattybgoode
source: POKENAME releases ultrasonic waves from organs hidden in its fluffy wings that allow it to precisely gauge distances in the dark. In times of strife, it hides away deep in caves.

entry: POKENAME在峭壁打洞栖息，用非凡的听觉，在漆黑洞中寻找同类，也能找到崖壁高处的巢。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are cliff-dwelling burrowing Pokémon. They use their exceptional hearing to find one another in their pitch-black burrows and to locate nests high up in the cliffsides.

entry: POKENAME以阵阵次声波，寻找陡峭岩面的道路，靠回声辨可靠落手点。攀岩者常与它训练，学更好技术。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME use infrasonic bursts of noise to find their way across sheer rock faces, using echolocation to identify reliable handholds. Climbers frequently train alongside POKENAME, using their guidance to develop better climbing technique.

entry: POKENAME超声叫能扰电子设备。图鉴一出故障，多半就是它在附近扫描环境。
author: _refuse_
source: POKENAME can disrupt electronics with its ultrasonic cries. When a Pokédex starts glitching out, it's most likely a sign POKENAME is nearby scanning the surrounding area.

entry: 天敌靠近悬铃木家园，POKENAME就定时尖叫，声响会令人混乱、恶心。
author: .izik
source: Should a predator draw too close to its sycamore tree home, POKENAME screeches at regular intervals. These sounds can cause confusion and nausea.

entry: POKENAME住庞大洞网深处，一生不见日光也不稀奇。群体却用粪便制灯，再吐火球点亮。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME live deep in extensive cave networks. It is not unusual for them to never see the daylight, though POKENAME colonies create their own lanterns from guano, and light them by spitting a ball of fire at them.

entry: POKENAME虽然会飞，空中动作却很笨拙，平日更爱待在地下。尖刺对次声波敏感，让它们能借高亢的叫声，在地下找到彼此。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Though capable of flight, POKENAME are clumsy in the air and prefer to spend most of their time underground. Their spines are sensitive to infrasonic waves, allowing them to locate one another with high-pitched shrieks while underground.

entry: POKENAME住深洞，更靠听觉而非视力。脚爪叩石地，声音经回声定位，清楚辨明环境，穿过黑暗。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME inhabit deep caverns where they must rely on their hearing more than their sight. Using the sound of its talons on the stone ground, POKENAME can clearly identify its surroundings through echolocation and maneuver through the darkness.

entry: POKENAME双翼与身体大小失衡，飞不久。要吃树果，就踢长着最爱果子的树。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Due to the disproportionate size between its wings and body, POKENAME are not capable of long flights. In order to get the berries they eat, they kick the trees their favorite berries grow on.

entry: POKENAME藏泥洼，只露头上肢体。器官发超声脉冲，击落飞过的虫，方便吃。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME hides itself beneath mud puddles with only the appendage on its head poking out. The organ can emit an ultrasonic pulse that downs insects flying by, making them easy pickings for POKENAME to eat.

entry: POKENAME住在沼泽池塘旁的洞窟，在泥里也能站得平稳。它用声呐找出洞外的熟果，再摇动树木，让果实掉落。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME lives in caves near marshy ponds and is able to have even footing on the mud. It uses sonar to pick out ripe fruit outside the cave and shakes trees to get fruit to fall.

entry: POKENAME感到附近危险，就急振头肢，脉冲超声向外击昏近身者，争取逃跑时间。
author: sk372
source: If POKENAME senses danger nearby, it vibrates the appendages on its head rapidly. The movement causes ultrasonic waves to pulse outward that knock out those close to it, giving it time to escape.

entry: POKENAME大耳与胡须，对声响及地面震动极敏感。捕猎先以超声震晕，再用剧毒角刺入。
author: milchik
source: This Pokémon's large ears and whiskers are very sensitive to sounds and vibrations in the ground. When hunting, POKENAME stuns its prey with ultrasonic waves before stabbing it with its highly venomous horn.

entry: POKENAME发高频声波攻击时，身体闪过万千颜色，常令敌人迷乱，足以取得上风。
author: .izik
source: While emitting high-frequency soundwaves to attack, POKENAME flashes in a myriad of colors. This tends to confuse foes enough to give it the upper hand.

entry: POKENAME攀附洞顶，发出电磁波，探测周围岩石的金属元素，却几乎不曾离开那个位置。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME attach themselves to the roofs of caves while emitting electromagnetic waves trying to detect metallic elements in the rocks around them. However, they barely ever move from this position.

entry: POKENAME近视，靠回声定位穿行洞穴。它找到松动的石块就咬，搜寻其中富含的矿物充饥。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is short-sighted and will instead use echolocation to traverse the cave system in which it lives. It tends to chomp on any loose rocks it can find, looking for rich minerals to feed on.

entry: POKENAME在地下挖洞，以回声寻找小宝石吞食。若宝石太大，双颚咬不碎，就带回藏处妥善收好。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME tunnels underground, using echolocation to look for small jewels for it to eat. If it finds a gemstone that is too big for its jaws to crush, it will bring it back to its hoard for safekeeping.

entry: POKENAME与同类比拼尖叫，锻炼耐力，直到能承受嗡蝠一族与尼多后融合体的叫声。它巡视家庭巢穴周边，用战吼向其他成员示警。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME builds endurance by engaging in shrieking matches with its kin until it can withstand a scream from a Noiqueen. It patrols the area around its family's den, alerting the others with battle screeches.

entry: POKENAME白天大多藏在洞里，夜间才现身。遇险时，后面的头会发出震耳尖啸，听得太久，甚至会震破耳膜。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME hides in caves for most of the day, only revealing itself at night. When in danger, its back head releases a deafening screech loud enough to burst eardrums if exposed for too long.

entry: 据推测，POKENAME已生存数十万年。大耳朵能察觉10英里之外的天敌，翅膀却最多只能撑着飞一分钟。
author: mistymagius
source: Theorized to have lived for hundreds of thousands of years, POKENAME uses its large ears to detect predators over 10 miles away. Its wings are only able to keep it aloft for a minute at most.

entry: POKENAME扁平的脸很适合反射声波，方便回声定位。它们性情温顺，只有防御也不管用时，才会出手攻击。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's flat face is excellent at reflecting sound waves which makes echolocation easy for it. They are quite docile Pokémon, only ever attacking if its defensive prowess fails.

entry: POKENAME体型虽大，仍能飞上树吃果实。不过，它通常宁愿留在地上，从耳朵发出阵阵尖锐的高音，震得熟果不断颤动，直到掉落。
author: .jerden
source: Despite its large size, POKENAME is capable of flying up into trees to feed on fruit. However, it usually prefers to remain on the ground and fires blasts of high-pitched sound from its ears to make ripe fruit vibrate until it falls.

entry: POKENAME离开安全的巢穴，开始建立自己的家庭。它邀年幼的嗡蝠一族与尼多王融合体，一同挑战更大的敌人，借此结为伴侣。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME leaves the safety of its nest to begin building its own family. It challenges young Noiking to team up with it against a larger foe, bonding the pair together.

entry: POKENAME察觉灾害，就大声尖叫。每被无视一次，警告就再响些。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: When POKENAME senses disasters, it lets out a loud screech. Each time its warnings are ignored, it progressively grows louder and louder.

entry: 求偶时，POKENAME将郁金香与雏菊覆翼，再吹响亮哨鸣，招其他个体前来。可花让飞行困难许多。
author: .izik
source: During courtship rituals, POKENAME covers its wings with tulips and daisies before letting out a loud whistle-like cry. This draws others to its location, though the flowers make flight considerably difficult.

entry: POKENAME通常住在黑暗洞窟，背上的植物已适应微弱阳光，也能茂盛生长。它还能载着其他宝可梦移动，甚至飞往洞窟的另一层。
author: lydiaprower8
