source: POKENAME usually spends its time in dark caves, so the plants on its back have adapted to thrive in little sunlight. It can carry Pokémon around, even being able to fly to another level of the cave.

entry: POKENAME随年龄变大，仿效山体，让数百宝可梦住洞里。受激时，超声波会引发局部地震。
author: leandermalurt
source: As POKENAME grow older, they grow in size, mimicking mountains and letting hundreds of Pokémon rest inside their caves. When provoked, their supersonic soundwaves create local earthquakes.

entry: POKENAME深夜出洞，爬树找食。洞内，则用火照路。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME emerges from caves late at night to climb trees for food. While in caves, it lights the way with its flame.

entry: POKENAME爬上崖，便开心跃顶滑向低处，再重新攀登。受威胁，先以刺耳声扰乱对方，再使火焰轮猛坠敌身。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: After scaling a cliffside, POKENAME eagerly leaps from the summit and glides to lower elevations, only to begin the climb again. When threatened, it emits a disorienting and ear-piercing Screech before crashing down on its foe with a Flame Wheel.

entry: POKENAME的耳朵还在适应巨响，因此成年的嗡蝠一族与尼多王融合体会将它安全护在巢内。它发出小小的吱叫，锻炼回声定位本领。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME's ears are still developing resilience to loud noises, so a fully grown Noiking keeps it safely contained in its den. It makes tiny squeaks to help it strengthen its echolocation skills.

entry: POKENAME高声尖鸣，造超声波，扰乱近处生物。爱恶作剧，也曾如此捉弄旅人，偷走物品。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME creates ultrasonic waves with a high-pitched shriek, disorienting those nearby. A bit of a prankster, it has been known to do this to travelers in order to steal items from them.

entry: POKENAME嘴里每发喇叭般响声，头焰热度便猛升。声音之大，数英里外都听得见。
author: .izik
source: Each burst of trumpet-like sound from POKENAME's mouth causes the flames on its head to surge with heat. These sounds are loud enough to be heard from miles away.

entry: POKENAME觉得有危险时，会吹出一些泡泡。破裂时，泡泡会释放一小股超声波，能使附近生灵晕头转向。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME blows a number of bubbles when it feels like it is in danger. Upon popping, the bubbles release a small burst of ultrasonic waves that can be highly disorienting to anything nearby at the time.

entry: 双翼尚未发育完全，它得常在地上恢复体力。找灌丛中的食物或住处时，遍身毒刺抵御威胁。
author: fiordaliso
source: Since its wings are not yet fully developed, it must spend considerable time on the ground to restore its strength. Its body is covered in venomous spines that ward off threats as it rummages through bushes for food or shelter.

entry: 飞行时，它用裹着毒液的角，赶走试图挡路的野生宝可梦。它偏爱在树果树筑巢，因为枝头安全，又能给幼崽稳定供果。
author: fiordaliso
source: While flying, it uses its poison-coated horn to ward off other wild Pokémon that try to get in its way. Berry trees are its favored nesting spots, chosen because their branches provide both safety and a steady supply of fruit for its young.

entry: POKENAME致幻叫声，调高得只有其他宝可梦听得到。讽刺的是，最好的防训练家手段，却会招来超音蝠。
author: ghostslythe
source: POKENAME's hallucinogenic cries are pitched so high only other Pokémon can hear them.  Ironically, their best defense against Trainers attracts Zubat.

entry: POKENAME战斗又快又隐秘，仿佛瞬移，出现在敌人背后。态度冷淡，却不把侮辱或败仗往心里去。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME utilizes both its speed and its stealth in battle, appearing behind opponents as if it had teleported. It has a cold attitude, but it doesn't take insults or losses personally.

entry: POKENAME敏锐双耳，能听出人因情绪而起的细微身体变化。饲主半开玩笑说，它能“听见悲伤”。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's sensitive ears can pick up minute fluctuations in a person's body functions relative to emotions. This has lead to the half-joke among owners that it can hear sadness.

entry: POKENAME能用声呐判断果实是否熟到可以吃，因此常被用来帮助农民。触角还能感知超声波，让它们在漆黑的洞窟里也不会迷路。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME use their sonars to determine which fruits are ripe enough to be consumed, which is why many of them are used to help farmers. They can sense ultrasonic waves with their feelers, so they never get lost in pitch-black caves.

entry: POKENAME离开安全的巢穴，寻找安稳的地方建立家庭。遇到同龄的嗡蝠一族与尼多后融合体，便与对方合作，结为伴侣。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME leaves the safety of its nest in search of a safe place to begin its own family. When it finds a Noiqueen of an equivalent age, it combines forces to become a bonded pair.

entry: POKENAME双翼如扬声器放声，配合完美模仿，捕捉、反射人的声音，令其说话结巴，宛如语音干扰器。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can release sound waves through its wings like speakers. Combined with its perfect mimicry, it can act like a speech jammer by capturing and reflecting a person's voice, causing them to fumble their words.

entry: 飞行时，双翼扬起尾上细灰，留下痕迹。灰可安全吃，有辛辣味。
author: oddwalls
source: As it flies, its wings stir up the fine ash that coats its tail, leaving a trail behind it. The ash is safe to eat and has a spicy flavor.

entry: POKENAME最初是很久以前，一位裁缝的作品。后来遭人弃置，里面的幽灵，便想要复仇。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME was originally made by a tailor long ago. It was eventually abandoned, and the spirit inside wants revenge.

entry: 浓密的毛发能感知最细微的震动，让POKENAME闭眼也能清楚掌握周围。它只栖息在最幽暗的洞穴群。
author: mistymagius
source: Its thick fur can sense even the slightest of vibrations which allow POKENAME to clearly see its surrounding even with its eyes closed. It only resides in the darkest of cave systems.

entry: POKENAME听觉敏锐，还能隐约感知他者的波导，因此极善追踪。一旦锁定敌人，就会锲而不舍地追赶，直到在战斗中将其击败。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's strong hearing as well as its ability to faintly sense another's aura gives it excellent tracking abilities. Once it has targeted a foe, it will relentlessly pursue them until it bests them in battle.

entry: POKENAME总是昏昏欲睡，每天倒挂树枝最多22小时。只有原来的树不再结果，才会飞往新树。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are in a constant state of drowsiness, hanging upside down on tree branches for up to 22 hours a day. They are only seen flying to a new tree when their old tree stops producing berries.

entry: POKENAME常溜音乐会，啃乐器与扩音器电缆。吸能足了，小翼就能飞完当天剩余时间。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME tends to sneak into concerts to gnaw on the electrical cables of instruments and amplifiers. Once it has absorbed enough energy, it can flutter around on its tiny wings for the rest of the day.

entry: POKENAME常溜音乐会，啃乐器与扩音器电缆。吸能足了，小翼就能飞完当天剩余时间。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME tends to sneak into concerts to gnaw on the electrical cables of instruments and amplifiers. Once it has absorbed enough energy, it can flutter around on its tiny wings for the rest of the day.

entry: POKENAME睡山洞，尾互扣。敏感听力，能远察数英里外雷暴，留足时间出洞，从临近风暴采电。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME roost in mountain caves, sleeping with their tails interlocked. Their highly sensitive hearing allows them to detect thunderstorms from miles away, giving them time to leave the cave and harvest electrical energy from the approaching storm.

entry: 这些穴居宝可梦胆子很小，稍有危险就会溜走。它们啃食富含金属的岩石，维持金属毛发的光洁与坚韧。
author: mistymagius
source: These cave-dwelling Pokémon are quite timid and will scuttle away at any sign of danger. They will nibble on metal-rich rocks to keep their metallic fur nice and strong.

entry: POKENAME伏在浅沙下，等候猎物。感知沙中的细微震动，就能判断目标何时进入攻击范围。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME sit just underneath the sand, waiting for prey to come by. By detecting small vibrations in the sand, it can tell when its prey will be in striking range.

entry: 长期生活在漆黑洞穴，让POKENAME视力不佳，听觉却极其精准。任何声响都可能令它逃跑，或迎面冲来，狠狠撞上一记头槌。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME have poor eyesight but very precise hearing due to living in pitch-black caves. Any sort of sound will either cause it to flee or charge head on with a powerful headbutt.

entry: 万圣节之夜，POKENAME会出来寻找幼童，引诱他们。受到威胁时，会发出似乎只让成人痛苦的高频噪声。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME can be seen on Halloween nights, looking for young children to lure in. When threatened it will produce a high-frequency noise that only seems to be painful to adults.

entry: POKENAME身体几乎轻如空气，能轻松随风漂游。身上的灰棉絮常被用作隔音材料。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's body is almost as light as air, allowing it to float effortlessly along the breeze. The grey cotton on its body is commonly used as a sound-dampening material.

entry: 不同于其他沙漠穴居者，POKENAME靠巨耳听猎物，穿越广阔领地。偏爱安静，否则很易焦躁。
author: wrenchworx
source: POKENAME, unlike other burrowing desert dwellers, relies on its oversized ears to traverse the wide expanses of its domain by listening for prey. They prefer quiet areas, otherwise they easily become stressed.

entry: POKENAME不断随电能振动，声响在20英尺外也能听见。它能用双翼将声音集中，轰出震耳欲聋的声波。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is constantly vibrating with electrical energy, creating a sound loud enough to be heard from 20 feet away. It can concentrate this sound into deafening blasts by using its wings.

entry: 中空的獠牙能吸取所吃树果的汁液。它对声音极其敏感，太吵便会变得凶暴。
author: mistymagius
source: Its tusks are hollow and are able to draw the fluids out of the berries it eats. It is very sensitive to sounds and will turn aggressive if things get too loud.

entry: POKENAME中空的胸腔能发出强劲声波，足以震碎石墙。传闻，许多早期声学器具都是受POKENAME启发而造。
author: mistymagius
source: The hollow cavity in POKENAME's chest can produce sound waves powerful enough to pulverize a stone wall. There are rumors that POKENAME was the inspiration for many early acoustic devices.

entry: 悦耳鸣声，多是它发超声波，寻找熟果。找到后便啄食，连种子也吃。
author: lydiaprower8
source: Its melodious cries are usually them sending ultrasonic waves to detect ripe fruit. After finding one, it proceeds to peck at it, seeds and all.

entry: 悦耳鸣声，多是它发超声波，寻找熟果。找到后便啄食，连种子也吃。
author: lydiaprower8
source: Their melodious cries are usually their way of sending ultrasonic waves to detect ripe fruit. After finding one, it proceeds to peck at it, consuming seeds and all.

entry: POKENAME五个耳朵，能精确定位任何声音。感到远处威胁，就用同样的耳，发强大精准声波，击退袭击者。
author: pattybgoode
source: POKENAME's five ears can precisely locate the source of any sound. If it senses a threat from far away, it uses the same ears to conduct devastating, precise sound waves to repel would-be attackers.

entry: POKENAME用精准的回声定位，只挑最美的宝石装饰自己。古代城塞前，还能见到守卫般的POKENAME雕像。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME searches for only the most beautiful gemstones to adorn itself with using its highly accurate echolocation. Statues of POKENAME can be seen guarding ancient citadels.

entry: POKENAME对洞穴噪声极敏感。若听见不安声响，就慌张朝四面喷棕色黏毒。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME is highly sensitive to noises in its cavern habitat. If it hears something distressing, it panics and sprays tacky brown poison in all directions.

entry: POKENAME收翼滚过洞网，声音巨大，宣示在场，也警告前路威胁。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME tucks in its wings while rolling through cave systems. It makes a loud noise while rolling, announcing its presence and warning any potential threats in its path.

entry: POKENAME住在冰洞，用黑色毛发保暖。它们成群与悬垂的冰柱共鸣，奏出独特的小曲。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME live in frozen caves, using their black fur to keep themselves warm in the cold. Groups of these Pokémon can be seen resonating frequencies with hanging icicles to create a unique little tune.

entry: POKENAME舞动，双翼传出如短笛的美声。似乎借此与同类沟通。
author: .izik
source: While dancing, a beautiful piccolo-like sound can be heard emanating from POKENAME's wings. It appears to use this to communicate with others of its kind.

entry: POKENAME发高频声波，与鱼群同伴配合。整段对话，几声短波就能传完。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME fires high-frequency soundwaves to coordinate with others of its school. Entire conversations can be exchanged between them with just a few short bursts of sound.

entry: POKENAME耳能听数英里外的猎物，再循声慎选目标。水下洞里，可见成群。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME's ears allow it to hear its prey from miles away, and based on those sounds, it carefully selects a target. Packs can be seen in underwater caves.

entry: POKENAME极速游过猎物身旁，放强超声扰乱平衡，最终使其昏沉到轻易就能捕食。
author: sk372
source: While swimming past prey at blinding speeds, POKENAME emits powerful ultrasonic waves. These waves disrupt a Pokémon's equilibrium, eventually dazing them enough for POKENAME to easily prey on them.

entry: 据说POKENAME能夺走一切生物的发声能力，让整座城镇陷入死寂。传闻只要被POKENAME听见，就会立刻失声。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is said to be able to extract the sound-making capabilities of any living thing, leaving entire towns dead silent. The tales say if POKENAME can hear you, you will be silenced immediately.

entry: POKENAME极亲人，常停在穿洞旅人头上歇。新朋友若遭凶物靠近，就以削弱对方的超声波迎击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is extremely friendly towards humans, often landing and resting on the heads of those traveling through its caves. If anything aggressive comes close to its new friend, it assaults the foe with debilitating ultrasonic waves.

entry: POKENAME每次使用声音能力，黏软的身体就会振动。它黏在洞顶等猎物，再放出音波冲击，将其暂时震晕。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's slimy body vibrates anytime it uses its sonic abilities. It sticks itself to the top of caves waiting for prey, then blasts them with a sonic shockwave, stunning its prey temporarily.

entry: POKENAME住洞口附近，飞不远便能猎食。强翼直接将虫属性宝可梦拍落空中。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME lives close to cave entrances so that it doesn't have far to fly to reach its prey. It swats Bug-type Pokémon out of the air with its muscular wings.

entry: POKENAME的双翼足以轻松将它带离地面，只是撑不了太久。强壮的手臂则能单手提起一名成人。
author: mistymagius
source: Despite their size, POKENAME's wings can easily get off the ground, just not for long periods of time. Its powerful arms allow it to carry an adult human with just one hand.

entry: 传说，只要POKENAME在附近，就能听见被它埋葬的受害者尖叫。身体由独特的紫色沙粒构成，在富人间十分珍贵。
author: mistymagius
source: Legends say that the screams of the victims it has buried can be heard anytime a POKENAME is around. Its body is made of a unique purple sand that is highly treasured amongst the wealthy.

entry: POKENAME通常住在湿洞，靠其中的真菌生存。POKENAME虽看不见，背上耳朵状的蘑菇却能让它随时察觉四周。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are usually found in damp caves, thriving on the fungi that grow there. Despite being blind, POKENAME are constantly aware of its surroundings due to the ear-like mushrooms on its back.

entry: POKENAME听觉、嗅觉都好，较安静听话的个体，是老人及残障人士的理想伙伴。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME has really good senses of hearing and smell, so the calmer and better-behaved ones are ideal Pokémon for the aged and disabled.

entry: POKENAME住洞底，吃上方栖居宝可梦落下的碎物。全黑也能回声定位，防身却主要靠爪。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME lives on the floor of caves, feeding on detritus dropped by Pokémon roosting above it. It can navigate in total darkness using echolocation, but mostly relies on its claws for defense.

entry: POKENAME从耳中放出强烈的声波冲击。蓄能时，背上的鳞片急速振动，进一步增强声音的强度。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME fires powerful sound blasts from its ears. As it charges up, the scales on its back vibrate rapidly, amplifying the sound's intensity.

entry: POKENAME发巨响攻击，身上宝石就大放光。叫声震动给宝石充能，增强声波攻势。
author: .izik
source: When it emits loud sounds to attack, the gems on POKENAME's body glow brightly. The vibrations from its cries energize the gems, amplifying the power of its sonic assaults.

entry: POKENAME想飞，壳上便长翼，能带它远行。在山顶之间飞，沿途吞植物。
author: .izik
source: The wings that sprout from POKENAME's shell when it wants to fly can carry it great distances. It flies between mountaintops, devouring plant life along the way.

entry: POKENAME夜飞，毛泛余烬光，许多人视为美景。若一夜见两次，还有人认为是好运。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME flies across the night sky, its fur glows with embers. Many find it a beautiful sight, with some considering it good luck if seen twice in one night.

entry: POKENAME只需挥一下魔杖，附近的一切声音便会回响，音量随之放大。它常用这招扰乱对手，却也往往惹得附近的伙伴心烦。
author: .izik
source: With a single wave of its wand, POKENAME causes all sounds in its immediate area to echo and amplify in volume. It often does this to unsettle its opponent, though this tends to irritate nearby allies as well.

entry: 它吸洞壁水分，大耳能听一英里外天敌，再放强声波，轰退对方。
author: hophoppip
source: It absorbs moisture from the walls of caves. Its large ears can hear predators from a mile away and project forceful sound waves to blast them away.

entry: POKENAME听觉太好，难寻安静休息，只得退到洞网深处。即使未必寂静，也想从岩石吱呀声中，找到安宁。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME have exceptional hearing and often struggle to find quiet and rest. This leads to POKENAME retreating deep into cave systems, seeking, if not quiet, but peace within the sounds of the creaking stone around them.

entry: POKENAME能像雷达般凭声音追踪物体，是很受欢迎的旅伴。但野生POKENAME若成群无人约束，就会闹出不小的骚动。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are popular travelling companions for their radar-like ability to track objects through sound. However, swarms of wild POKENAME can cause quite the ruckus if left unchecked.

entry: POKENAME如哨兵，站守南瓜田。见闯入者，就放震耳巨响护作物，让谁也不敢偷收成。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME stands like a sentinel within pumpkin patches. If it spots an intruder, it unleashes a deafening noise to protect its crop, ensuring no one dares to steal its bounty.

entry: POKENAME夜间活动，头上的巨耳能听见数英里外的声音。它爱潜到水下，向鱼钩发出声呐波，骗钓鱼的人以为有宝可梦咬钩。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME is a nocturnal Pokémon and can hear for miles with the massive ear on its head. POKENAME likes to trick fishermen by diving underwater and using sonar on their fishing hooks to make them think a Pokémon has taken the bait.

entry: POKENAME头顶耳吸收各种声音。听足之后，便能集中尖叫，响得足以震破耳膜。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: The ear atop POKENAME takes in all manner of sounds. After hearing enough, it can let out a concentrated screech loud enough to burst eardrums.

entry: POKENAME身上红宝石与黝帘石共生的晶石，敲击时会发出响亮清脆的声音，可用来制作独特的乐器。
author: hophoppip
source: The anyolite crystals on POKENAME's body make a loud and clear sound when struck. They can be used to craft unique instruments.

entry: POKENAME与同群伙伴，在海上飞成心形。风暴时，轮流发声模仿雷鸣。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME flies in heart-shaped formations with others of its school over the sea. During storms, they take turns producing noises that imitate thunder.

entry: 蜜月酒店种果树，盼POKENAME到访吃果。它的耳朵，能听数英里外的谈话。
author: lydiaprower8
source: Honeymoon hotels grow fruit trees in hopes that POKENAME will come to visit and feast. Its ears can pick up conversations from miles away.

entry: POKENAME极力守护林间找到的亮饰物。谁敢碰一枚硬币，就从耳放猛烈声波，驱赶对方。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME jealously guards any shiny trinket it finds on its outings through the woods. If anyone dares touch even a single one of its coins, POKENAME drives them off with violent sound waves from its ears.

entry: POKENAME大群懒躺洞口，互相尖叫。入夜全起飞，大群狩猎，超声波会干扰附近无线电通信。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME lounge about at the entrances of caves in huge numbers, shrieking at one another. When night falls, they all take flight, hunting in huge swarms; their ultrasonic waves can disrupt radio communication devices in the area nearby.

entry: POKENAME的耳朵对响声极其敏感，连远处最细微的声音也听得见。随着城市不断扩张，它们退入荒野，试图避开城市里令人头痛的噪音。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME ears are extremely sensitive to loud noises, enabling them to hear the faintest sound from great distances away. Growing urbanisation has caused them to retreat into the wilds, trying to avoid the headache inducing noise of the city.

entry: 别看这副模样，POKENAME最爱水果！谁给它好吃的，它便忠心相待，还能带迷路的矿工与探险者，走出暗洞。
author: captainzscourge
source: Despite its appearance, POKENAME loves fruit! It's loyal to anyone who gives it a treat, and can help lost miners and explorers out of dark caves.

entry: 它们靠超声波，在暗洞中飞快穿行，常被探险者误认为传说中的异兽。
author: captainzscourge
source: These Pokémon move swiftly through dark caverns with its ultrasonic capabilities. They're often mistaken for legendary creatures by explorers.

entry: POKENAME靠近训练家，腹纹会聚拢声波，让听力不佳者听得更清。多数背包都装得下，水下也能发挥作用。
author: quackquackattack
source: When POKENAME are close to their Trainer, the pattern on their stomach focuses soundwaves so that Trainers who are hard of hearing can hear better. They are small enough to fit in most backpacks and can even function underwater.

entry: POKENAME完全失明，靠发精神波感知世界。耳对精神波频率极敏感，自己发的波与旁人思维活动，都能感知。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are completely blind and rely on sending out waves of psychic energy to sense the world around them. Their ears are highly tuned to psionic frequencies, letting them sense not just their own waves, but also the mental activity of others.

entry: 这些闹腾的宝可梦会从楼上跃下，尝试飞行。耳朵朝地面放出强劲声波，借此托住身体。
author: mistymagius
source: These rambunctious Pokémon can be seen leaping off buildings in an attempt to fly. They will use their ears to blast high-pressure sound waves into the ground to keep themselves aloft.

entry: POKENAME扎根增强感官。耳与根都能感受空气或地面震动，警觉潜在危险靠近。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME roots itself to the ground to enhance its senses. Its ears and roots both sense the vibrations in the air or ground to alert it of the approach of potential dangers.

entry: POKENAME身体弱，先以耳中超声波弄晕敌人，再逃。还能吐微弱火，辅助捕猎，也惊吓天敌。
author: infinex21
source: Because their bodies are physically weak, POKENAME emit ultrasonic waves from their ears to daze foes before fleeing. They can breathe weak flames that help hunt prey and startle predators.

entry: POKENAME歌唱得不怎么样，却总对着麦克风唱个不停，声音放大到超过140分贝，连附近的窗玻璃都震碎了。
author: mistymagius
source: Even though its singing is not that great, POKENAME will constantly sing into its microphone, amplifying its voice to over 140 decibels which ends up shattering any windows within its vicinity.

entry: POKENAME的两个头，都能放出超声波，使旁人晕头转向，借此捕猎、自卫。不过，一不小心，两头也会互相干扰，惹出许多麻烦。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's two heads can release ultrasonic waves to disorient others as a method of hunting and self-defense. If it is not careful, each head could also disorient the other, causing a multitude of issues.

entry: POKENAME出生时太重，飞不起来，因此用回声寻找轻质岩石，重建身体。不过，这也会让它变得更脆弱。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME uses echolocation to search for lightweight rocks to rebuild its body with because at birth their body is too heavy to fly. However, this does mean it becomes more fragile in the process.

entry: 扬声器般的耳朵奏出甜美的曲子，仿佛儿时的摇篮曲，让猎物沉睡，再吞食其梦。受POKENAME侵扰后，常会出现短暂失眠。
author: mistymagius
source: Its speaker-like ears play a sweet melody similar to childhood lullabies that lulls its victims into a deep sleep, then feeds on their dreams. Victims of POKENAME often experience short-lasting insomnia.

entry: POKENAME在昏暗处虽令人畏惧，自己却怕极了强光。哪怕只瞥见一丝阳光，它也会惊慌失措，用角钻出地洞或洞窟，躲藏起来。
author: sk372
source: While fearsome in dim lighting, POKENAME is deathly afraid of bright lights. Even a glimpse of sunlight will send it into a panic, boring holes with its horn to dig a hole or cave for it to hide away in.

entry: POKENAME以歌舞诱没戒心的敌人，等猎物进到栖身的黑暗深处，再以强声波迅速制服。
author: violet_zero
source: POKENAME lures unsuspecting foes with its song and dance. When it has drawn its prey into the dark recesses where it dwells, it swiftly subdues them with powerful soundwaves.

entry: 它通常靠回声定位，在深海底潜猎。也曾飞出海面，攻击大宝可梦与人类船只。
author: starpun.
source: This Pokémon is typically found stalking the depths of the seafloor for prey using its echolocation. However, it has been seen flying out of the sea in order to attack large Pokémon or human ships.

entry: POKENAME壳能奏超过120分贝的热闹音乐，让附近水面起小浪，常在海滩音乐会作水上音响。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME shell produces energetic music at over 120 decibels, causing small waves in the surrounding water. They are commonly used as aquatic sound systems at beachside concerts.

entry: POKENAME振翼恰如雷鸣。飞时，数公里外都听得见。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME's wingbeats sound exactly like thunderclaps. When it flies, it can be heard from several kilometers away.

entry: 据说POKENAME为吓天敌，演化出酷似某种究极异兽的外形。
author: slimmagma
source: It is said POKENAME evolved to look like a specific Ultra Beast in an attempt at intimidating predators.

entry: POKENAME夜寻强大宝可梦，与之作战，吸收部分遗传物质增强自己。被打败者，成了它的仆人。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME stalks the night in search of powerful Pokémon. It battles them and absorbs some of their genetic material to increase its own strength. Those defeated by POKENAME become its servants.

entry: POKENAME回声定位不如音波龙，却以超能力一次扫描四周弥补。也用这力量，成筐摘下树上熟果。
author: imaginita
source: Though it's not as good at echolocation as Noivern, POKENAME makes up for this by using psychic energy to scan all its surroundings at once. It also uses this power to pluck whole bushels of ripe fruit off of trees.

entry: POKENAME以热电与压电效应，在背上产生大量电能，却无法操纵。极速掠过天空，常被误认流星。
author: statedhercules98
source: POKENAME generates enormous amounts of electricity along its back using thermoelectric and piezoelectric effects; unfortunately, it cannot manipulate this electricity. When it streaks across the sky at incredible speeds, many mistake it for a meteor.

entry: POKENAME飞行优雅、踪迹难寻，成为许多地方传说的主角。却极爱玩，空中旋转时，会高声啁啾。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME's graceful flight and elusive nature have caused it to be the subject of many local legends. It is incredibly playful and lets out high-pitched chirps as it spins in the air.

entry: POKENAME发高音探环境，攻击像车轮旋转，用锐翼劈敌，再以声音扰乱。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME can emit high-pitched noises to determine its surroundings. It spins like a wagon wheel when attacking, slashing at foes with sharp wings and using its sound-based attacks to disorient them.

entry: POKENAME藏湖里，搅起沉积物遮身。什么太近，就出击，想把猎物拖入、困在湖底淤泥。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME hides in lakes and churns up sediment to conceal itself. If something gets too close, POKENAME will strike, attempting to drag its prey and trap it in the silt lying at the bottom.

entry: POKENAME张大嘴飞夜空，尽量多捕虫，偏爱池旁。掉水也能轻松游回岸。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME soars through the night sky with its mouth wide open, catching as many bugs as possible. It prefers to fly near ponds and can easily swim to shore if it falls in the water.

entry: POKENAME聪明、夜行，轻易夜出捕猎，赶在饲主醒前回来。对生态的影响，引发争议。
author: .fedoraman
source: POKENAME are intelligent nocturnal hunters. They easily slip out at night to hunt and return before their owners wake. Their ecological impact has caused some controversy.

entry: POKENAME连最坚硬的物质也能钻穿，同时用敏锐的耳朵，探知猎物的震动，连飞行的猎物也不例外。一察觉目标，它便破土而出，咬住食物，飞到不受打扰的地方享用。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME tunnels through even the hardest substances while using its sensitive ears to detect vibrations from prey, even flying ones. Upon sensing a target, it bursts from the ground, clamps its jaws on its food, and flies away to eat undisturbed.

entry: POKENAME高速冲刺时，从耳中发出巨响，震晕猎物。阵阵声浪扰乱目标，让它得以近身，准确出击。
author: .izik
source: While dashing at high speeds, POKENAME unleashes loud noises from its ears to stun prey. These sonic bursts disorient its targets, allowing it to close in and strike with precision.

entry: POKENAME用声波震落树上的柿仔果，再收进壳里。据说，它酿出的果汁能短时改善听力，为饮者带来独特的好处。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses sound waves to knock Persim Berries from trees before gathering them in its shell. The juice it makes is said to promote better hearing for short periods, offering a unique benefit for those who consume it.

entry: POKENAME听觉敏锐，连树皮下蜜与树液流动的细响，也能察觉。它能据此找到最新鲜的来源，再用头上的角挖取。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's hearing is strong enough that it can sense the faint drip of honey and sap moving beneath tree bark. This lets it seek out the freshest sources for it to dig up using the horn on its head.

entry: POKENAME先举翼，再猛拍，轰然震耳。腹部薄膜与一切来袭声波共振、反射，将强度放大至十倍。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME raise their wings before bringing them down in a deafening roar. The membranes on their stomachs resonate with and repel all sound waves that hit them, amplifying them tenfold.

entry: 电气摇滚团常带POKENAME，只要咬住吉他接线，就能扩放音乐。线材销量上升，有些乐器店主便繁育它，送给大量购线者。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are often used by Rockers, being able to magnify their music as long as they bite on the guitar lead. Due to the rise in buying these leads, some music store owners breed POKENAME to give away to those who mass purchase.

entry: POKENAME受真菌气味吸引，夜里无声掠林。普通菌菇稀少时，曾见它猎蘑蘑菇与哎呀球菇。
author: sk372
source: Attracted to the scent of fungi, POKENAME swoops through the forests at night, making nary a sound. It has been known to hunt Shroomish and Foongus at times when normal fungi are scarce.

entry: POKENAME的金属翅膀发出巨响，足以震碎大理石。双翼产生的声波冲击力，既能扰乱敌人，也能穿透坚实物质。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's metallic wings create loud blasts of noise that can shatter marble. The sonic force generated by its wings is enough to disorient foes and break through solid materials.

entry: POKENAME夜游尖叫。人出来查看，就送蛋；吃下的人放松过头，常陷沉睡。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME wanders around at night, making loud screeching sounds. Whenever people come out to investigate, it offers them its egg. Eating this egg relaxes people so much that they often fall into a deep sleep.

entry: POKENAME夜里从树顶或崖顶出击，起飞力道强，离地就响起雷鸣般爆声。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME hunts at night, striking from the tops of trees or clifftops. It takes off into flight hard enough to create a thunderclap when it goes airborne.

entry: POKENAME体内的空腔既能感知一英里内的声音，也能放大自身怒吼。它用吼声赶走不值得一战的对手，吸引能让自己大展身手的强敌。
author: pjporwoll
source: The hollows in POKENAME's body serve a dual purpose of helping it sense sounds within a mile of it and to amplify its own roars. It uses these roars to scare away unworthy opponents and attract foes that will challenge its combat capabilities.

entry: POKENAME靠电感受与回声定位，穿深洞。夜里出来，吃遇上的虫宝可梦。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME navigates deep caves by use of electrosensory perception and echolocation. It emerges at night, snacking on any Bug Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME住全黑地底深处，耳极敏，数英里外岩石移动的细响也听到，借此在地下洞穴辨路。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME lives deep underground in pitch-black conditions. It has extremely sensitive ears and can hear the faintest noise of rocks shifting from miles away, helping it navigate the underground caverns.

entry: POKENAME转动钻头般的角，发出刺耳声波。尖啸先扰乱猎物，随后它便以威力惊人的猛撞冲上前去。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME emits piercing sound waves by spinning its drill-like horn. The shriek disorients prey before it charges in with a devastating Take Down.

entry: POKENAME夜行，日里住地下，夜出猎食。在夜空中，视力完美。
author: karmaofevil
source: POKENAME leads a nocturnal lifestyle, residing underground in the day and hunting at night. It possesses perfect vision in the night sky.

entry: POKENAME翼太小，完全飞不了，便用来扇散吐出的冷气，将对手彻底冻住。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Its wings are much too small for POKENAME to be able to fly. Instead, these wings blow the freezing air it breathes out, which can freeze opponents solid.

entry: POKENAME耳如强大扬声器，连最弱信号也收得到。发出的信号，则能干扰附近一切通信频道。
author: _refuse_
source: Its ears function as powerful speakers that are capable of catching even the faintest of signals. The signal POKENAME emits have been known to jam all nearby communication channels.

entry: 尖刺撞上物体会发出巨响。它狩猎时在半空高速翻滚，四处射刺，再凭回声判断猎物的位置。
author: celio_0230
source: This Pokémon's spikes are capable of emitting a loud noise on impact. While hunting, it will rapidly roll in midair, launching spikes everywhere to echolocate their prey's location.

entry: POKENAME飞起来不如其他飞行宝可梦优雅，主要在夜间捕猎。听觉敏锐又擅长挖掘，必要时能追着猎物钻入洞穴，深入地下。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Not as graceful in the air as other flying Pokémon, POKENAME mostly hunts at night. It uses its sharp hearing to track prey down and is adept at digging, enabling it to chase prey Pokémon into burrows and underground if needed.

entry: POKENAME脚上的声波装置，能在踢击时将敌人震飞，也能帮它跳得更高。
author: yoshimon
source: POKENAME use sonic emitters on their feet to send foes flying when they kick at them. They also use these emitters to amplify their jumps.

entry: 光下，POKENAME害羞内敛，躲社交。暗里却自信，以流畅优雅舞姿，迷住观众。
author: sk372
source: In the light, POKENAME is shy and reserved, hiding away from social contact. In the dark, it grows in confidence and captivates audiences with the smooth and graceful movements of its dances.

entry: 野生POKENAME极擅空战，顽强不屈，得以称霸天空。武士道般的自律，让许多与它们接触的生灵，都心生尊敬。
author: cobalt0135
source: Wild POKENAME are highly adept in aerial combat and their sheer tenacity has let them dominate the skies. Their bushido-like discipline has earned them the respect of many who have come in contact with them.

entry: 它放出响亮的音乐，诱来幽灵宝可梦，吞作食物。据说，POKENAME音乐的频率，只有亡魂听得见。
author: yoshimon
source: It plays loud music to attract Ghost Pokémon to consume. The music POKENAME produces is said to be at frequencies only spirits can hear.

entry: POKENAME能将超声波凝聚成声刃，让被击中者感到刺耳的剧痛。它反复用翼与鳞片的锋锐末端，痛击敌人，使对方再也不敢争夺资源。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME can focus its ultrasonic waves into blades of sound that cause ear-piercing pain to anyone struck by them. It repeatedly bashes foes with the sharp ends of its wings and scales so that they never try to challenge it for resources again.

entry: POKENAME在黑暗战斗，回声定位最能帮看清。音速飞行时，也有感知能力，避开摩天楼；极速激起超声波，令人耳痛欲裂。
author: soup1900
source: In battles, POKENAME's echolocation is best for seeing while in the dark, but when flying at sonic speeds, it has sensing capabilities to prevent crashing into skyscrapers. Its blistering speed creates supersonic waves that cause ear-shattering pain.

entry: POKENAME两根颚状角，能使出粉碎厚钢板的爆音波。可更爱唱宁静歌，只有受威胁，才放声波冲击。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's dual, jaw-like horns can emit powerful Boombursts capable of pulverizing thick steel plates. However, it prefers to sing tranquil songs and will only emit sonic shockwaves when threatened.

entry: POKENAME平时凶叫，赶所有近身者。携熟果的人，却获兴奋吱声欢迎，声轻些，调仍极高。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME will usually screech aggressively to drive away anyone that gets close. People who approach carrying ripe fruit are instead welcomed in by POKENAME's excited squeaking, which is quieter but still very high-pitched.

entry: POKENAME用随身手提音响，高声放音乐。谁想叫停，就遭强臂与双翼猛攻。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME blasts out music at high volume from the boombox it carries. If anyone tries to make it stop, POKENAME will lash out with its powerful arms and wings.

entry: POKENAME双翼比对应雄性更发达，便在夜里替家人猎采。高处喷毒后，再俯冲扑向失去行动力的目标。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME spends the night hunting and gathering for its family as its wings are more developed than its male counterpart's wings. It attacks targets by firing venom from above, then dive-bombing the incapacitated creature.

entry: POKENAME低哼改变感知，让听者相信它有神性。发怒，声音就强得连山也能震碎。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME emits a low hum that alters perception, convincing listeners of its divinity. When enraged, the sound intensifies enough to shatter mountains.

entry: POKENAME跟随巢中成年的嗡蝠一族与尼多后融合体，学习捕猎、辨认可安全采摘的树果。它也会搜寻大型猎物，用哨声向对方报信。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME joins the adult Noiqueen of its nest to learn about how to hunt and what berries are safe to harvest. It also assists by scouting around for larger prey and signalling the Noiqueen with whistles.

entry: POKENAME灵巧操纵弯刀形身体，攻击敌人意想不到的地方。若找不到破绽，就发出强烈声波，让大多数宝可梦痛得发抖。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME deftly controls its scimitar-shaped body to strike where its foe is not expecting. If it cannot find an opening, it emits a powerful frequency that makes most Pokémon quiver in pain.

entry: 偶尔能见到POKENAME率领一大群驹刀小兵。它们向POKENAME学会了发出超声波、亮刃跃入空中，比普通驹刀小兵更加危险。
author: beatdoof
source: On rare occasions, POKENAME can be seen leading a large pack of Pawniard. They are more dangerous than regular Pawniard because they learned from POKENAME how to emit ultrasonic waves and leap through the sky with their blades ready.

entry: POKENAME敏捷惊人，在高山独居捕猎。耳越尖，听力越好。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME have incredible agility and thrive far up in the mountains, living solitary lives as hunters. The more pointed their ears, the better they can hear.

entry: POKENAME敏捷惊人，在高山独居捕猎。一声鸣叫，召来强风暴，迫其他宝可梦逃走。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME have incredible agility and thrive far up in the mountains, living solitary lives as hunters. With a cry, they call down powerful storms that cause other Pokémon to flee.

entry: POKENAME住在海洋最漆黑的深处。先用回声定位找到猎物，再唱海妖般的歌将其引来，以声波出击。
author: jordanx27
source: POKENAME live in the darkest depths of the sea. It uses echolocation to detect its prey, lures it in with a siren song, then strike with sonic waves.

entry: POKENAME夜间活动，白天倒挂在洞顶睡觉，夜里翱翔天空，深暗的体色让它极难被看见。从高空俯冲时，它们能突破音障。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME are nocturnal, sleeping by hanging from cave ceilings during the day and soaring through the skies at night, when their dark coloration makes them extremely difficult to see. They can break the sound barrier by diving from high altitudes.

entry: POKENAME的训练家应当随身携带合适的护耳用品。它发出的金属尖叫，音量最高可达140分贝。
author: cait_sith
source: A POKENAME's trainer should always carry proper hearing protection. Its metallic screeching can reach volumes of up to 140 dB.

entry: 无月夜，POKENAME撤幻象，借黑暗藏身。有人说，训练家暗中若觉寒毛竖起，便是被它们跟上。
author: ghostslythe
source: On moonless nights, POKENAME drop their illusions, instead using the darkness as camouflage.  Some say if Trainers feel their hair prickling in the dark, they are being stalked by these Pokémon.

entry: 夜色掩护下，POKENAME潜近猎物时几乎隐去身形。即使在浓密灌木中，也能准确扑中目标；碰上活蹦乱跳的猎物，就用响亮的刺耳声震晕它们。发怒时，红色眼纹会发光。
author: chibitales
source: Under the cover of darkness, POKENAME become nearly invisible when stalking prey. They accurately leap onto prey even in the middle of dense brush, using a loud Screech to stun livelier targets. Their red eye markings glow when enraged.

entry: POKENAME的触须如同麦克风，能放大尖叫声，再由扬声器般的尾巴传出。即使相隔数英里，也能清楚听见。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's feelers act as microphones, allowing it to amplify its screeching voice and transmit it through its speaker-like tail. This can be heard reliably from miles away.

entry: 有些训练家觉得，POKENAME充满活力、欢快的歌声实在惹人喜爱。也有人觉得这高亢又嘹亮的声音听得身体都疼。
author: .jerden
source: Some Trainers think that POKENAME's energetic, upbeat singing is incredibly endearing. Others find the high-volume, high-pitched sound to be physically painful.

entry: POKENAME用强壮的尾巴拢住幼崽、清理巢穴，照料一家。它并不会真正飞行，而是助跑跃起，再用耳朵与臂翼控制下降，滑翔前进。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME acts as a caretaker by using its muscular tail to corral its young and to clear any debris from its den. Rather than true flight, it glides by taking a running leap and controlling its descent with its ears and arm-wings.

entry: POKENAME只在无月之夜离开臭氧层，下到地面捕猎。借着漆黑夜色，它发出撼动大地的尖啸，将猎物吓住、震晕。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME only descends from the ozone to hunt on moonless nights. Under the cover of pure darkness, it frightens and stuns prey with a ground-shaking sonic screech.

entry: POKENAME从颚间发出超声尖啸，击碎进入平流层的流星。无月之夜会变得更好斗，从高空降下，寻找值得一战的对手。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME destroys meteors that reach the stratosphere using ultrasonic screams unleashed from its jaws. On moonless nights, it grows more aggressive, descending from the sky in search of worthy challengers.

entry: POKENAME在战斗中从炮口放出强烈声波。稍不留神，这些声波就可能让人失聪。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME discharges large soundwaves from its cannon during combat. These soundwaves can deafen a human if it is not careful.

entry: POKENAME会浮在训练家周围，操纵声波，放大身边特定的声响。战斗时，则用声波扰乱对手的方向感，将其压制。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME hover around their Trainers and are capable of controlling sound waves to amplify certain noises around them. In battle, POKENAME uses these sound waves to disorient and overpower foes.

entry: POKENAME高速钻行于沙漠时，会发出蒸汽火车般的巨响。它虽不善隐蔽，却以速度弥补，在恶劣地形中飞快前进，毫不停歇。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME makes a loud steam-train-like noise while digging through desert sands at high speeds. What it lacks in subtlety, it makes up for in speed, moving quickly and relentlessly through the harsh terrain.

entry: POKENAME扇动头上的翅膀，向对手吹出热风。热度足以煮沸水，对敢于挑战它的敌人发起炽烈猛攻。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME flaps the wings on its head to blow hot air at an opponent. The air is hot enough to boil water, creating an intense and fiery attack against any foe that challenges it.

entry: POKENAME能从身体播放音乐，因此很受城市与派对欢迎。
author: blazerxz
source: POKENAME has the ability to project music from its body. It is popular in cities and at parties for this reason.

entry: 它在空中飞翔，运送艺术家与音乐家之间往来通信的音符邮件。若给它乐谱，便会准确而富有活力地唱出曲子。
author: quackquackattack
source: It flies through the air carrying Music Mail, which is used for correspondence between artists and musicians alike. If given sheet music, it sings the song with precision and vigor.

entry: 发现新事物时，POKENAME不是狠狠咬上一口，就是发出超声波轰击，试探一番。因此，它不太受养宠物的人欢迎。
author: josh707
source: When discovering something new, POKENAME will either test it with a strong bite or by blasting ultrasonic sound. For this reason, they are not popular pets.

entry: POKENAME的两个头合不来。它们震耳欲聋的争吵声，在7英里以外都能听见。
author: josh707
source: POKENAME has two heads that do not get along. POKENAME's deafening arguments can be heard over 7 miles away.

entry: 日落将近，POKENAME便离巢飞上天空捕猎，用刺耳叫声让猎物失聪。它们大群筑巢，会留下少数成员照看群中的幼崽。
author: chibitales
source: As sunset approaches, POKENAME emerge from their roosts and take to the skies to hunt, using their harsh cries to deafen prey. They nest in large groups with a few individuals staying behind to care for the group's young.

entry: POKENAME用高频声波冲击洞壁，将宝石震落后吃下。操纵声音的本领让它在黑暗深处也能轻松搜寻、采集食物。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses high-frequency noise blasts to knock gems off cave walls, which it eats. Its ability to manipulate sound helps it gather food with ease, making it a proficient scavenger in the dark depths.

entry: 自从融合后，POKENAME便迷上了电子音乐。它随身带着一台手提音响，盼着把这份热爱分享给全世界。
author: nellnast42
source: Since Fusion, POKENAME has become enamored by electronic music. It carries around a boombox, hoping to share its passion with the world.

entry: POKENAME睡觉时，耳朵会冒出冷雾。雾气一碰到水就能将其冻住，让它成为寒冷环境中不可小觑的存在。
author: .izik
source: A cold mist comes from POKENAME's ears while it sleeps. The mist can freeze water on contact, making it a natural force to be reckoned with in cold environments.

entry: POKENAME栖居寒冷山区，是飞行时悄无声息的危险猎手。关于旅人一觉醒来，发现同行的宝可梦全被它掳走或冻成冰块的故事，流传着许多。
author: sk372
source: Flying in complete silence, POKENAME is a dangerous hunter inhabiting cold mountain areas. Many stories exist of travelers waking up to find their entire party either missing or frozen solid due to POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME狡黠又善于潜行，痴迷于囤积最美的珠宝。世界各地的安防系统都对它恨之入骨，因为它似乎总能找到绕过防线的办法。
author: sk372
source: Highly sneaky and crafty, POKENAME has an obsession with hoarding the most beautiful of jewels and gems. Security systems the world over curse POKENAME's name, as it always seems to know a way around their defenses.

entry: POKENAME的耳朵能察觉水中最细微的振动，凡闯入它水域的生物，都会遭到猛烈袭击。它躲在暗洞里，却因视力差而常撞上洞壁，气得愈发暴躁。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's ears are able to detect the slightest vibrations in the water, violently attacking anything that enters its waters. It hides in dark caves, but due to its bad eyesight, it often bumps into walls, further angering it.

entry: POKENAME是首种被观察到在水下突破音障的生物。每当它突破音障，周围所有水属性宝可梦都会失聪三个月。
author: epping_forest
source: POKENAME was the first creature to be seen breaking the sound barrier underwater. Every Water-type Pokémon around it goes deaf for three months when it breaks the sound barrier.

entry: POKENAME在泥沼地带静静潜伏。发现猎物后，先低声嗡鸣，再追上前去，发出令人毛骨悚然的尖啸，让目标心生恐惧。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME lurks completely still in boggy areas. When it spots prey, it emits a low hum before chasing after it, then lets out a blood-curdling screech to instill fear in its target.

entry: 战斗时，POKENAME会蓬起周身白毛，挡开敌人的攻击。它发出的尖叫威力惊人，听见的生物都会被震得眩晕数秒。
author: fiordaliso
source: When fighting, POKENAME puffs up the white fur around its body and uses it as protection to deflect enemy attacks. It can emit screams so powerful that they stun anyone who hears them for a few seconds.

entry: POKENAME飞过雾蒙蒙的山区，耳中发出高亢尖啸。声音在雾中回荡，为夜间的飞行平添几分诡异。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME flies through hazy, mountainous regions, unleashing high-pitched screeches from its ears. The sound echoes through the mist, adding an eerie atmosphere to its nocturnal flights.

entry: 遮住双眼的红色护目镜，让它拥有出色的夜视能力。双耳发出的声波冲击，威力足以击穿金属板。
author: mistymagius
source: The red visor covering its eyes gives it excellent night vision. The sonic blasts it produces from its ears are powerful enough to punch a hole through a metal sheet.

entry: POKENAME的嚎叫足以震碎玻璃。尽管如此，它却是无声的猎手，浓密毛皮让它飞行时不发出一丝声响。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's howls are loud enough to shatter glass. Despite this, it is a silent hunter, its dense fur allowing for it to fly without making a sound.

entry: 人们常在农场饲养POKENAME，收取它的鳞片。用这些鳞片制成的乐器与鼓，都是奢侈品。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: POKENAME are often raised on farms for their scales. Instruments and drums made out of their scales are a luxury.

entry: POKENAME飞行灵巧得出人意料，身体也非常结实。它用声波扰乱或震晕敌人，再以翅上的利爪了结对方。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME is surprisingly agile in flight and has a highly durable body. It uses sound waves to confuse or stun foes so that it can finish them off with the claws on its wings.

entry: POKENAME的凶暴仅次于它的美貌。虽然能在全黑环境中行动，它却常待在月光照耀的空地上，用醒目的体色引来猎物。
author: quantumradiation
source: The violent demeanour of POKENAME is second only to its beauty. Although POKENAME is able to function in complete darkness, it often positions itself in moonlit clearings, using its striking colouration to lure in prey.

entry: POKENAME用超声波轰碎洞中的黄玉矿床，趁别的生物还没赶到，就兴高采烈地将宝石吞食。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses ultrasonic blasts to shatter topaz deposits in caves. It gleefully devours the gems before others can reach them.

entry: POKENAME不靠视力行动，而是先用超声脉冲探明周围，再发起袭击。等目标听见回声时，早已挨了一击。
author: vracken
source: POKENAME navigates without sight, using ultrasonic pulses to map its surroundings before striking. By the time POKENAME's target hears the echo, it has already been struck.

entry: POKENAME在田间站岗，担任哨兵。若有尾立等觅食者出现，便尖声呼唤同伴，一同发起围攻。
author: .izik
source: Standing guard in crop fields, POKENAME acts as a sentry. If a forager like Sentret appears, it screeches to summon allies and launch a group attack.

entry: 白天的POKENAME几乎无害，也很友善，会随着自创的曲调跳上许久。入夜后却变成极具攻击性的猎手，动作依旧如舞者般灵巧优雅。
author: sk372
source: During the day, POKENAME is almost harmless and quite amiable, dancing the hours away to a tune all its own. When night falls, it becomes a very aggressive hunter, moving with a dancer's finesse and agility.

entry: POKENAME的壳内始终回响着低沉轰鸣。哪怕只出现一道裂缝，封在里面的声音也会喷涌而出，震碎周围岩石。
author: .izik
source: A low rumble echoes within POKENAME's shell at all times. If even one crack appears, the contained sound bursts out, shattering the surrounding rock.

entry: POKENAME全身先迸出亮光，随后发出超声尖啸。声音的威力足以震裂钢筋混凝土。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body flashes brightly before unleashing a supersonic screech. The sound is powerful enough to crack reinforced concrete.

entry: POKENAME对人类的求爱很感兴趣，常被发现躲在山边或洞穴附近，偷看傍晚约会的情侣。有人觉得它可爱，有人却不胜其烦。
author: sk372
source: Intrigued by human courtship, POKENAME has been spotted often hiding close to couples on evening dates near mountains or caves.  Depending on the couple, this is either adorable or annoying.

entry: POKENAME会在洞顶掘洞，躲在里面等候猎物。不幸的目标一经过，便发出震耳尖啸，用落下的碎石将其困住。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME burrow into the roof of caverns and hide until they spot their prey. Once the unfortunate target stumbles by, POKENAME releases deafening screeches to trap the prey beneath falling rubble.

entry: 它停在树枝上，静候最佳时机，再张开宽大的黑翼俯冲，无声伏击猎物。耳朵发出骇人的咆哮般的声音，驱赶试图闯入领地的生物。
author: fiordaliso
source: It ambushes prey in silence by perching on tree branches and waiting for the perfect moment to swoop down with its wide black wings spread. Its ears emit sounds similar to terrifying roars, keeping away intruders that try to enter its territory.

entry: POKENAME会和其他宝可梦在海滩开派对，吸引大批观众，已多次导致海滩封闭。若有另一只POKENAME在附近开派对，两者便会展开激烈的说唱对决。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME hosts beach-side parties with other Pokémon, gathering large crowds the has caused multiple beach closures. If another POKENAME starts a party nearby, the two of them will get into a heated rap battle.

entry: POKENAME靠小翅膀能短暂飞起，不过通常更喜欢奔跑。耳朵将吠声放大成咆哮，往往能吓跑比它还大的敌人。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME can fly for short bursts thanks to their small wings, though they often prefer to run. Their ears help to amplify their bark into a roar that will often scare off foes larger than it.

entry: POKENAME的吠声能超过150分贝。若有人被困洞中，它就用这声音震碎挡路的岩石。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME can bark at a volume of over 150 decibels. It will use this to break rocks that have trapped people in caves.

entry: POKENAME将舌头当作乐器，能发出高达200分贝的声音。若一直使用这种能力，就会失聪，直到解除融合才恢复。
author: celio_0230
source: By using its tongue as a instrument, POKENAME can reach sounds up to 200 decibels. Constant use of its abilities will cause it to go deaf until unfused.

entry: POKENAME会精心调整音叉发出的声音，让目标始终难以忍受。它读取对方的心思，找出最讨厌的声响，以此打断其专注。
author: .izik
source: The sound POKENAME emits from its tuning forks is carefully constructed to always be unbearable to its target. It learns their least favorite noise by reading their mind, using this power to break their concentration.

entry: POKENAME刺耳的咆哮声位居野外最响之列，常让敌我双方都受惊。传说，它能将声音凝聚于四拳，不必碰触，就能震碎山岳。
author: ozydamians
source: POKENAME's cacophonous roars are some of the loudest in the wild, often frightening friend and foe alike. Stories say this Pokémon can condense sound into its four fists and shatter mountains without physically touching them.

entry: POKENAME常在夜间举办音乐会，让其他宝可梦聆听、欢庆。不演出时，通常待在洞中训练、锻炼身体。
author: binkyman1106
source: POKENAME frequently holds nighttime concerts for other Pokémon to listen to and celebrate. It usually stays in caves to train and exercise when not performing.

entry: POKENAME的岩石身躯内部中空，能让声音响亮回荡。战斗时，它将放大的声音汇聚到耳朵放出，使敌人失去行动能力。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's rock body is hollow inside and can echo noises loudly. It funnels the sound out from its ears to incapacitate foes, using its amplified noise as a weapon in battle.

entry: POKENAME披着猩红火焰飞奔草原，借助翅膀跃出很远。未经驯服便想骑上去的人会被火焰灼伤，它的尾巴也能将大多数敌人打飞。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME dash across plains and leap far with their wings while clad in crimson flames. Their flames burn whoever tries to ride them without taming them and their tails can send most of their foes flying.

entry: 善待POKENAME的训练家，会得到十分忠诚的伙伴。它的猩红火焰比普通火焰燃烧得更久，哪怕只是一团火球，也足以对付大多数猎物。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are very loyal companions to Trainers who treat them well. The crimson flames of a POKENAME will continue to burn longer than normal fire, so even a single fireball can be enough against most prey.

entry: POKENAME的目力极佳，即使近乎漆黑也能看清。到了水下深洞等光线永远照不到的地方，还能发出声波，以回声定位探查周围。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's eyes are extremely powerful and allow them to see in nearly pitch-black conditions. In places where no light ever reaches, such as deep underwater caverns, they can emit sonar frequencies and detect what's around them through echolocation.

entry: POKENAME能迅速穿行于水中，跃出、潜入的速度与高度都令人惊讶。毛皮保护它抵御严寒，敏锐视力让它轻易发现近处物体。不过，它大多分不清颜色。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME can dart and leap in and out of the water with surprising speed and height. Its fur protects it in freezing conditions, and its sharp eyesight lets it detect nearby objects easily. However, it is mostly colorblind.

entry: POKENAME身体沉重，无法飞行，因此生活在地底深处，极少来到地面。它从耳中发出各式声波，与同类交流。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's heavy body prevents it from flying, so it lives deep underground, rarely coming up to the surface. It communicates with others of its kind with a variety of sound waves emitted from its ears.

entry: 它带来的音乐，明明响得很，却很容易让人听着入睡，即使原本毫无倦意，也不例外。
author: thefinalkalgonus
source: The music that this fusion brings with it is really loud, but it is very easy to fall asleep to it, even when you are not tired.

entry: 人们初见POKENAME时，被它爪中握着的简陋镰刀吓了一跳。其实它相当无害，只用这工具割掉高草，好在地上啄食种子与其他食物。
author: sk372
source: People were intimidated by POKENAME when they first sighted it due to the makeshift scythe it wields in its talons. It's quite harmless, however, only using the tool to clear out tall grass to better pick at the ground for seeds and other food.

entry: 单只POKENAME只能掀起微弱的风，但若一群合力，就能轻易把任何目标吹到远处。
author: gren24242
source: POKENAME can only create small gusts of wind by itself, but a whole group of them can easily blow any target far away.

entry: POKENAME身上点缀的云朵，让它举止优雅，轻如羽毛。它爱干净、讲究打扮的名声远扬，常被服装店选作吉祥物。
author: mimisha_m.lkpowder
source: The clouds that adorn a POKENAME give its movements a graceful, featherlight quality. Known for its strong sense of cleanliness and style, it is often chosen as a mascot by clothing shops.

entry: POKENAME住在高耸的火山上，每天清晨欢快鸣叫，宣告新一天到来。手脚上蓬松的绒毛像耐热糖霜，糕点师会剪下，用作甜点的辛辣涂层或馅料。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME lives high on volcanic mountains where it heralds every morning with gleeful, squawking cries. The puffy arm and leg fluffs are similar to a heat-resistant frosting, so pastry chefs trim it as a spicy coating or filling to desserts.

entry: POKENAME颈部与尾巴的毛，柔软细腻，很受孩子喜爱。它又友好得很，跟谁都容易交上朋友。
author: thefinalkalgonus
source: Children love POKENAME because of the soft, delicate fur on its neck and tail. It is extremely friendly, making friends with anyone very easily.

entry: 当POKENAME待在电脑里时，点击它便会唱出一小段优美的电子音乐。曲子没有固定的结尾，只有它自己想停，音乐才会结束。
author: sk372
source: Clicking on POKENAME while it's inside one's computer causes it to sing a digitized bit of beautiful music. There's no set ending to the song; the music only stops once POKENAME feels like stopping.

entry: POKENAME不靠飞行，而是在网络空间中穿梭，抵达目的地。看似棱角分明，摸起来却像云朵一样蓬松。
author: seanothan_23
source: Instead of flying, POKENAME warp through cyberspace to get to their destination. Despite having sharp edges, they actually feel fluffy, like a cloud.

entry: 这种形态的POKENAME常以只有自己才懂的方式，清理、归整文件。若有人打乱文件排列，它就会大为恼火，头上的灯光闪烁，手里的刷子挥个不停。
author: chibitales
source: This variant of POKENAME is most often seen cleaning and sorting files in a way only known to them. Messing with the organization of the files causes POKENAME great upset, flashing the light on their head and flailing the brush they hold.

entry: 有时能看见POKENAME随风飘过近岸的波痕。它的壳在远古吸收的气体形成了身上的云，古生物学家会研究这些云，分析遥远过去的大气。
author: mimisha_m.lkpowder
source: POKENAME can sometimes be seen drifting with the wind along near-shore ripple marks. Paleontologists study its clouds, which were produced by gases absorbed by its shell eons ago, to analyze the atmosphere of the distant past.

entry: POKENAME身上云朵般的绒毛会慢慢生长，直到包覆全身。它会在一周内蜕下这层绒毛长满的皮，不久又开始长出新的云层。
author: sk372
source: The cloud-like fluff on POKENAME's body slowly grows over time until it covers it completely. It sheds the fully-fluffed skin within the week, and begins growing a new cloud layer shortly after.

entry: POKENAME凭借超能力，即使用柔软蓬松的棉花翅膀当枕头睡觉，也能悬在空中。它喜欢藏在云间，所以在野外极少能听见它歌唱。
author: fiordaliso
source: Thanks to its psychic powers, POKENAME can levitate in midair even when it uses its soft, fluffy cotton wings as a pillow to sleep on. It is extremely rare to hear it sing in the wild, since it prefers to remain hidden among the clouds.

entry: POKENAME凭借超能力，即使用柔软蓬松的棉花翅膀当枕头睡觉，也能悬在空中。它喜欢藏在云间，所以在野外极少能听见它歌唱。
author: fiordaliso
source: Thanks to its psychic powers, POKENAME can levitate in midair even when it uses its soft, fluffy cotton wings as a pillow to sleep on. It is extremely rare to hear it sing in the wild, since it prefers to remain hidden among the clouds.

entry: POKENAME羽毛漂亮，歌喉动听，是富裕街区很受欢迎的宠物。饲主们会定期聚会，让各自的伙伴一展歌喉，组成合唱。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a popular pet in affluent neighborhoods for their plumage and vocals. POKENAME owners will regularly get together and create a chorus with their pets' songs.

entry: POKENAME在浓雾弥漫的森林安家。觅食时，用云朵般的翅膀融入雾气，躲开潜在的捕食者。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME makes its home in forest areas with heavy mist. It uses its cloud-like wings to help blend in with the misty haze and hide it from potential predators as it forages.

entry: POKENAME吐出的丝，与遍布全身的云状物质相同，结网时身上的绒毛会随之变薄。若短时间吐丝太多，就会秃光；得等绒毛长够，才能重新结网。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's webbing is made of the same cloud-like material that grows across its body, which thins out as it weaves webs. If it spins too much web too quickly, it goes bald and can't create new webs until sufficient fluff has grown back.

entry: 爱好音乐的孩子很喜欢饲养POKENAME。许多歌手、舞者也让它陪伴身旁，激励了更多人踏上表演之路。它的动作与歌声一样轻盈。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are popular pets for children who enjoy music. Many singers and dancers have POKENAME accompany them, further inspiring many to become performers. Their movements are as light as their voice.

entry: 它能改变云尾的密度，借此漂在空中。不过，这项本领，尚未完全掌握。
author: staghorn
source: It can change the density of its cloud-like tail, allowing it to float through the air. It has not yet learned to fully control this ability.

entry: POKENAME造出云朵般的外壳，遮住让自己飞行的小翅膀。据认为，这是过去天敌众多时留下的防御手段，如今许多天敌早已灭绝。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME create the cloudy shell around their body to hide the small wings that allow them to fly. This is thought to be a defense mechanism when from POKENAME once had many predators, many of which are now extinct.

entry: 飞行时，POKENAME喜欢藏进云雾，躲开潜在的捕食者。它目力强，即使隔着云雾，也能清楚看见极远处的动静。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME prefers to hide within clouds or fog when flying to obscure itself from potential predators. Its strong eyes let it see clearly through these hazes and spot movement even from vast distances.

entry: POKENAME的绒毛出了名地难缝制，手法稍有不慎，哪怕只是轻碰，也会让它蒸散。
author: zazafable
source: The wool of POKENAME is notoriously difficult to sew, as even the slightest clumsy touch causes it to evaporate.

entry: POKENAME身上只有头顶那片绒毛可以安全剪下。躯干上的绒毛至关重要，能确保电流从一侧翼尖流向另一侧。
author: sk372
source: The fleece on POKENAME's head is the only patch that can be safely sheared from it. The fluff on its torso is crucial to ensuring its electrical circulation reaches from one wingtip to the other.

entry: 轻盈的身体随风飘行时，身上云朵般的物质会落下些许碎片。这些小团块深受爱吃甜食的宝可梦追捧。
author: sk372
source: As its light body is carried along by the winds, small pieces of the cloud-like matter on its body fall towards the ground. These clumps are highly sought by Pokémon possessing a sweet tooth.

entry: POKENAME躲在云中，调皮地吓唬飞过的鸟宝可梦。晴天时，它会睡在树梢，直到云朵再次出现。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME hides amongst the clouds, cheekily surprising Bird Pokémon that fly by. During clear days, they will sleep in the treetops until the clouds return.

entry: 随着宝可梦融合日渐普遍，POKENAME开始担负传播种子的重要生态作用。无论是吃下后随排泄物排出，还是挂在羽毛上再掉落，种子都借此传播，让植物繁衍。
author: bobosmith01
source: With Pokémon Fusion on the rise, POKENAME has begun playing a key ecological role: the spreading of seeds. Through its byproduct after consumption or the seeds getting caught and then falling from its feathers, the propagation of flora is performed.

entry: POKENAME翅上长出的白色植物纤维非常脆弱。飞行太久，就会成块脱落。
author: .izik
source: The white plant fibers growing on POKENAME's wings are extremely brittle. When flying for too long, the fibers fall off in chunks.

entry: 它们爱吃各种慕斯，喜欢那如同自身一般轻软蓬松的口感。也常凝视镜子，被自己蓬松的模样迷住。
author: quackquackattack
source: They love eating various mousses, as they adore the light, fluffy texture that reminds them of themselves. They are also known to stare into mirrors, fascinated by their fluffy appearance.

entry: 它背上的“云”由棉孢子构成，其中混有各种花粉。身体轻得惊人，能高高跃起，也能跳出很远。
author: infinex21
source: The "cloud" on its back is made of cotton spores that are laced with various pollens. Its body is remarkably light, allowing it to make large jumps and to leap rather far.

entry: POKENAME喜欢偷偷溜到人身后，用不祥的尖叫吓人。它收集负面能量，储存在身上的水晶珠里。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME enjoys sneaking behind people and frightening them with an ominous shriek. It gathers negative energy and stores it in the crystal beads on its body.

entry: POKENAME在空中逗留，用云状物质拼出文字。它们乐于合作，将消息传给下方的居民。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME linger in the sky, forming words with their cloud-like substance. They are eager to work together to send messages along to those who live below.

entry: POKENAME把钢铁翅膀藏在层层棉絮下，让对手放松警惕。与训练家结为朋友后，常会欢快地哼唱小曲。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME hides its steel wings beneath layers of cotton, tricking opponents into lowering their guard. Once it forms a bond of friendship with its Trainer, it often chirps cheerful little tunes.

entry: 受到威胁时，它会昂起身子，发出震耳的雷鸣。登山客在它巢穴周围立起标牌，提醒他人不要打扰。
author: bandedbodypress
source: When threatened, it rears up and emits a deafening thunderclap. Hikers post signs around its nests to warn others not to disturb it.

entry: POKENAME会把棉絮般的耳朵绕在人身上，像拥抱一样表达亲近。它双耳力大，足以带动庞大身躯飞起，许多人愿意付钱到马戏团一睹这般奇景。
author: foolish_weasel
source: As a sign of affection, POKENAME will wrap its cottony ears around people like a hug. Its ears are strong enough to propel its large body into flight, with many willing to pay circuses to see such a wonder.

entry: POKENAME腿上棉絮般的绒毛极轻，让它毫不费力就能浮在水面。口渴时，会反复低头喝水，同时警觉地留意四周。
author: .izik
source: The fluffy cotton-like material on POKENAME's legs is extremely light, allowing it to float effortlessly on the water's surface. Should it grow thirsty, it bobs its head repeatedly to drink while keeping a close watch on its surroundings.

entry: 除非表面干净、颜色均匀一致，POKENAME才肯用尾巴的分泌物作画。幸好，尾巴也能清除各种脏污，还能像鸡毛掸子一样用来掸灰。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME refuses to paint with its tail secretions unless the surface is cleaned and of a single uniform color. Thankfully, POKENAME's tail can take care of any dirty mess; POKENAME can also use it like a feather duster.

entry: POKENAME住在高山，用小石块筑巢。它只需很少的空气就能生存，还会用蓬松羽毛吸收额外氧气。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME lives high in the mountains, building its nest out of small rocks. It is able to survive on very little air, absorbing extra oxygen in its fluffy feathers.

entry: POKENAME喜爱水，云朵般的尾巴却无法挡水，所以常被淋得湿透。跟着它的雨云很擅长为事物补充水分。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME loves water, but its cloudy tail is incapable of deflecting water, so it often gets soaked. The raincloud that follows it is good at rehydrating things.

entry: POKENAME喜爱水，云朵般的尾巴却无法挡水，所以常被淋得湿透。跟着它的雨云很擅长为事物补充水分。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME loves water, but its cloudy tail is incapable of deflecting water, so it often gets soaked. The raincloud that follows it is good at rehydrating things.

entry: POKENAME住在高山，在崖壁石缝中筑巢。它看似弱小，古老传说却说，曾有训练家想偷它的蛋，被它吹下悬崖。
author: johnhandicraft
source: POKENAME live high in the mountains, nesting in rocky cracks in cliffsides. Though it seems weak, an ancient myth tells of a Trainer who was blown off a cliff for trying to steal a POKENAME's egg.

entry: POKENAME栖息于高耸山顶，那里空气清新，没有污染。即使遇到猛烈风暴，也很少躲避；尾巴既可固定身体抵御强风，也能安全接地，减轻雷击伤害。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME roosts at the top of towering mountains where the air is free of pollution. It rarely seeks shelter from heavy storms, as it can use its tail as an anchor against strong winds and as a safety ground to minimize harm from lightning strikes.

entry: POKENAME走到哪里，都带着自己做的两根云朵般的甜软绒絮。它有两张嘴，各吃各的那根糖。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME carries two sticks of sweet cloud-like fluff it creates wherever it goes. It has two different mouths, so each one eats from its own stick of candy.

entry: 不知为何，POKENAME的啼鸣能让栖居的树木更快长叶。科学家研究多年后发现，整群合力，对恢复森林极为有效。
author: .izik
source: The chirps POKENAME makes somehow cause leaves to grow more rapidly in its home tree. Scientists have studied this for years and found that a full flock can be remarkably effective at reforestation.

entry: POKENAME飞过栖居的草甸时，臂上的叶片最长可伸至4英尺。即使生病或饥饿，也能连续飞行数小时。
author: .izik
source: The leaves on POKENAME's arms extend up to 4 feet when it flies across its meadow home. It can fly for hours without stopping, even when sick or hungry.

entry: POKENAME天生体暖，又有棉絮般的羽毛，因此很少为了过冬迁徙。遇袭时，会释放自身热量，发出高亢声音；喷火时也会发出类似的声响。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME rarely migrate for winter due to their inherently warm bodies and their cottony feathers. If attacked, they emit high-pitched noises produced by venting their own heat; they produce similar noises whenever they spit fire.

entry: POKENAME以巢穴一尘不染闻名。它用臂上棉絮般的羽毛，轻松扫去灰尘、杂物。家政人员常与它合作，一起打理房屋。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME are known for keeping their nests impeccably clean. Using the cotton-like feathers on their arms, they sweep away dust and debris with ease. Housekeepers often partner with them to help maintain homes.

entry: POKENAME把尾巴浸水，再快速摇动，不知为何就能飞起来。只要尾巴仍湿润，就能长时间飞行。
author: .izik
source: By dipping its tail in water and wagging it rapidly, POKENAME is somehow able to get airborne. It can fly for extended periods as long as its tail remains wet.

entry: POKENAME云朵般的绒簇中充满空气，远比外表看着轻。遇袭时，会把对手引向泥地，让其陷住，自己则飘在上方，一尘不染地得意洋洋。
author: imaginita
source: Thanks to its air-filled, cloud-like tufts, POKENAME is much lighter than it looks.  If attacked, it will lure its opponent to muddy ground where it will get bogged down, while POKENAME floats above, spotless and triumphant.

entry: POKENAME头顶的小毛对周围变化十分敏感，弥补了视力差的缺点。它喜欢从圆顶般的头部洒下绒毛碎片，送给自己亲近的对象。
author: sk372
source: The small hair on POKENAME's head is highly attuned to its surroundings, making up for its poor eyesight. It likes to shower those it's fond of with bits of fluff dispersed from its dome.

entry: POKENAME通常在云上休息，不过雾天会降到地面起舞。最好远远观赏，因为一受打扰，它就会使出瞬间移动。
author: lucioleuh
source: POKENAME is most often seen resting on clouds, but on misty days it dances at ground level. It is recommended to observe it from a distance, as it will use teleport if disturbed.

entry: POKENAME歌声婉转，性情温柔，极受欢迎。歌唱时，一道宽阔的彩虹从它身上的云中浮现，弯弯伸向听众。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is extremely popular for its melodious voice and gentle demeanor. When it sings, a voluminous rainbow emanates from the clouds of its body, arcing over towards those listening to its song.

entry: 年幼的尼多兰会成群赶来，聆听POKENAME轻柔甜美的歌声。它们闹腾时，父母很乐意请它在身旁，用歌声把孩子们聚拢。
author: sk372
source: Young Nidoran will flock to hear POKENAME's soft and sweet song voice. Nidoran parents enjoy having one around to help corral their children with their song when they are being rowdy.

entry: POKENAME十分讲究巢穴及周边环境，凡能收拾、清洁的地方，都会尽心打理。身体颜色反映健康与心情；颜色浅，便是快乐、健康的表现。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are meticulous about their nests and their immediate surroundings, taking care to organize and clean up whatever they can. Their bodies change color to reflect their health and mood; lighter colors are a sign of joy and good health.

entry: POKENAME不靠翅膀飞行，而是从体内喷出高压气流，将自己送上天空。睡觉时，用金属爪挂在粗壮树枝上。
author: mistymagius
source: Instead of using its wings to fly, POKENAME fires jets of pressurized gas from within its body to launch itself into the sky. It uses its metal claw to hang from thick tree branches while it sleeps.

entry: POKENAME飞得不算快，必须急扇棉絮般的翅膀，才能将圆胖身体带上天空。它在水边树上筑巢，用坚硬的喙在树干凿洞。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME is not a particularly fast flier, and must beat its cottony wings rapidly to lift its plump body into the air. It nests in trees near water, where it will use its hard beak to carve a hole in the trunk.

entry: POKENAME周围的棉絮绒毛厚实浓密，能吸收大多数身体攻击，保护柔软身躯。婉转歌声还能削弱攻击者的力量，进一步助它防守。
author: sk372
source: The cottony fluff surrounding POKENAME is dense and thick, absorbing most physical blows and protecting its soft body. Its melodic voice also weakens the strength of those attacking it, further aiding in its defense.

entry: 暴风雨中，POKENAME会欢快地张嘴咬住落下的雨滴。目前看来，这举动除了让它开心，并没有其他作用。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME gleefully snaps at raindrops as they fall during storms. This behavior serves no known purpose other than its own enjoyment.

entry: 它个头虽小，胃口却大得惊人。头部伸出的云团中藏着一副强壮的颚，能吞吃大块食物，填饱肚子。身体足够轻，还能乘风飘出很远。
author: infinex21
source: Its small size conceals a voracious appetite. Within the cloud-like mass extending from its head is a powerful set of jaws, with which it can consume large foods to sate itself. It is light enough to ride the winds across fair distances.

entry: POKENAME任由上升气流与强风托起身体飞行，降落时则把云朵般的翅膀收拢在两侧。头部伸出的云状羽饰能像嘴巴一样合拢，所以被用来储存食物。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME fly by letting updrafts and strong gusts lift them into the air and land by folding their cloud-like wings against their sides. The cloudy plumes extending from their heads can close like mouths, so they use them to store food.

entry: POKENAME身体轻盈，仿佛由蓬松棉花组成。它在空中飘游，常轻轻落在人肩上，给人一个惊喜。大多数人却觉得它面具般的脸有些瘆人。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's lightweight body seems to be made of fluffy cotton. It drifts through the air and often surprises people by softly landing on their shoulder. Most people find its mask-like face unsettling.

entry: POKENAME轻得能够漂浮，大部分时间都与同伴结群，在高空云间旅行。也因为体重太轻，风一旦够强，就会把它们吹得翻来滚去，偏离族群的飞行路线。
author: _pixelar_
source: A POKENAME is light enough that it can float; it spends most of its time traveling together with others in a pod high up in the clouds. Strong enough winds can toss the Pokémon around and out of the pod's flight path because of how little it weighs.

entry: 它天性友好，常想停到人头顶。可惜，积存的多余水分往往会化成雨，淋在毫无防备的人身上。
author: catsquatch_geography
source: Friendly by nature, it often attempts to perch atop people's heads. Unfortunately, the excess water its gathered tends to rain down on its unsuspecting host.

entry: POKENAME壳顶堆着蓬松的云状绒毛。许多小型飞行宝可梦会钻进去，寻个安全地方歇脚，它也乐于提供庇护。
author: sk372
source: A set of fluffy cloud-like piles of fluff rest on top of POKENAME's shell. Many small flying Pokémon take shelter in these clouds for rest and safety, which POKENAME is all too happy to provide.

entry: POKENAME在丰缘各地游荡，为青绵鸟提供洁净的歇脚地，让它们在自己体内的水中洗澡。作为回报，身体弄脏时，它会请青绵鸟帮忙清洁。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME wander around Hoenn, providing a clean respite for Swablu, who bathe in their water. In return, they employ the Swablu to clean their bodies should they get dirty.

entry: POKENAME后部的云让它得以漂浮。它喜欢爬到人身上，再坐在人头顶，假装自己是一顶帽子。
author: lydiaprower8
source: The cloud on POKENAME's rear allows it to float. It likes to climb onto people and sit on their heads, pretending that it's a hat.

entry: POKENAME的翅膀摸起来无比蓬松。不过，那些云由毒雾构成，会让人发痒或起疹子。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: POKENAME's wings are incredibly fluffy to the touch. However, the clouds are made up of a toxic mist that causes itchiness or a rash.

entry: POKENAME用云造出更大、更灵活的身体，在战斗中提升机动力与力量。足够专注时，甚至能点燃这具身体的四肢，再添几分优势。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME creates a larger, agile body out of clouds to make itself more mobile and strong in battle. With enough concentration, it can even ignite the body's limbs to give it a little more of an edge.

entry: POKENAME一旦找到伴侣，就会相守一生。面对猛烈风暴时也会站在伴侣身旁，用蓬松羽毛与体温相互取暖。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: Once a POKENAME finds itself a partner, the pair become bonded for life. POKENAME will stand with its partner through harsh storms, using its fluffy feathers and body heat to keep one another warm.

entry: POKENAME翅上的厚厚棉絮总是湿漉漉的。许多人一看见下雨，就误以为只是它从头顶飞过。
author: .izik
source: The thick cotton on POKENAME's wings is always sopping wet. Many mistake the sight of rain for one simply flying overhead.

entry: POKENAME既被磁力吸引，也喜爱云朵。它们在山间聚居，结群追随风暴。为了让它们过得好，建议训练家给它们一块磁铁拿着，并在家中养上几只。
author: lucioleuh
source: POKENAME is attracted to both magnetism and clouds. Colonies group in mountains and flock to follow storms. For their well-being, it is advised that Trainers give them a magnet to hold and keep a few at home.

entry: POKENAME穿过云间飞行时，触须上会脱落大团棉絮般的绒羽。这些绒羽通常只有冬天才显眼，其余时节都融为平滑的条带。
author: .izik
source: Large tufts of cotton-like down shed from POKENAME's feelers as it flies through the clouds. They tend to only become noticeable in winter, blending into smooth bands the rest of the year.

entry: 它的身体与那许多棉絮般的绒簇一样轻。它格外用心保持绒簇干净。有人说，绒簇柔软得能让摸到的人都放松下来；不过，蜕下的绒簇只会送给信任的对象。
author: infinex21
source: Its body is as light as its many cotton-like tufts. It takes great care to keep its tufts clean. Some say that its tufts are so soft that they soothe anyone who touches them; it does not share its shed tufts with anyone but those it trusts, however.

entry: POKENAME身体极轻，能站在云上。它凭借强壮的双腿，在云朵之间跳跃，优雅飘过天空。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME's body is incredibly light, allowing it to stand upon clouds. Using its powerful legs it can leap between them, drifting gracefully through the skies.

entry: 它把棉孢子裹在上肢，让肢体显得比实际更大。它待其他生物温顺而柔和，因此人们认为，这些棉孢子还能减轻它自身攻击的冲击。
author: infinex21
source: It clads its upper limbs in cotton spores to make them appear larger than they are. Given its docile and gentle demeanor around others, it is believed it uses its cotton spores to dampen the impact of its own attacks as well.

entry: POKENAME头上的绒毛，比最好的丝还柔软，因此，人们常把POKENAME当枕头。
author: blazerxz
source: The fluff on POKENAME's head is softer than the finest silk. Because of this, people like using POKENAME as pillows.

entry: POKENAME的火焰不冒烟，反而似乎能清除空气中的毒素。因此，它成了很受欢迎的天然空气清新剂。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's flame does not produce any smoke. In fact, it seems to purify the air of any toxins. Because of this, POKENAME has become popular as a natural air freshener.

entry: POKENAME以婉转歌声闻名，脾气急躁也同样出名。不论为何打断它唱歌，都会让它愤愤不平地点燃尾巴，甩出火球。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is known for its melodious singing voice, but also for its short temper. Interrupting its song for any reason results in it igniting its tail and indignantly flinging fireballs.

entry: POKENAME飞过浓云时几乎什么也看不见。触角感知气流与动静，引导它穿行天空。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME flies through dense clouds almost completely blindly. Its antennae detect air currents and movement, guiding it through the skies.

entry: 这只宝可梦埋进云中，以云为家。选中的云一旦变暗、变厚，POKENAME便钻出来摩擦翅膀，以振动催云落雨，同时奏出轻柔旋律。
author: milchik
source: This Pokémon buries itself into the clouds, making them its home. When its chosen cloud darkens and thickens, POKENAME comes out and rubs its wings, the vibrations of which forcing the cloud to rain and creating a soft melody.

entry: POKENAME一靠在腹部的大团棉絮上，就忍不住睡去。它常分出地方给孩子，让他们也能安稳入睡。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME cannot stay awake when resting on the large cotton tuft on its belly. It often shares its space with children so they too can sleep peacefully.

entry: 太阳升起时，它一边欢快啼唱，一边蹦跳。蓄积电力时，身上的绒云闪起电花，响起隐约雷鸣。
author: sk372
source: It sings a happy chirping song and prances about when the sun rises. When it charges up electricity, the clouds of fluff on its body spark and rumble like faint thunder.

entry: POKENAME身上棉絮般蓬松的羽毛会积存静电。它亲昵地蹭训练家时，可惜也会将静电猛烈释放出来。
author: vic1312
source: The fluffy, cotton-like feathers on its body store static electricity. POKENAME will rub on their Trainers affectionately, which unfortunately results in a violent release of the static charge.

entry: POKENAME的绒毛很适合填枕头，十分抢手。它看似冷淡，遇到清不干净的脏毛团，却会主动找人帮忙取下。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: The tufts of fur on POKENAME are sought after for pillow stuffing. While they act aloof, they will seek out people to remove dirty tufts that they cannot clean.

entry: 很少有声音能穿透POKENAME蓬松的翅膀，所以它睡得极沉。伐木工人常得摇醒它，免得它受伤。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are heavy sleepers because very few sounds are able to penetrate through their fluffy wings. Lumberjacks often need to shake them awake to ensure they do not get hurt.

entry: POKENAME无声掠过沙漠，等待伏击猎物。它张大颚俯冲而下，一口就能咬凹铸铁。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME soars quietly over deserts, waiting to ambush prey. It drops with jaws open wide, strong enough to dent cast iron with a single bite.

entry: 常能看到POKENAME从高崖一跃而下，盼着飞起来。幸好，头部覆着极柔软的羽毛，不至于让自己真正摔伤。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME can be seen throwing themselves off of tall cliffs in hopes of taking flight. Luckily, its head is covered in incredibly soft feathers that prevent it from doing any real damage to itself.

entry: POKENAME棉絮般蓬松的翅膀，闻起来香甜诱人。不过人可别去吃，因为它也喜欢往翅上添铁屑，好在阳光下闪亮。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME has fluffy, cotton like wings that smell incredibly sweet and delicious. Humans shouldn't try to eat it, though, as it also likes to add flecks of iron filings into its wings to make them shine in the sun.

entry: POKENAME的花苞内藏着剧毒的刺，毒液足以放倒10名成年人。不过，花苞很少开放，只有光照与湿度都恰到好处时才会张开。
author: mistymagius
source: Inside of POKENAME's bud is an incredibly poisonous thorn that contains enough venom to take out 10 fully grown adults. However, POKENAME's bud isn't open very often, only when the light level and humidity are just right.

entry: POKENAME的玫瑰带着春风般的宜人香气。花瓣太轻，常被强风吹落，让它闷闷不乐，直到花瓣重新长出。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's roses carry the lovely scent of the spring breeze. Because of how light its petals are, they often end up getting blown off in strong winds, leaving POKENAME moping around until they grow back.

entry: POKENAME身上垂挂的看似毛团，其实都是云。饲养场会采收这些云，织成外套，甚至在寒冷地区铺作地毯；它们轻盈有弹性，保暖却很出色。
author: kungfucutbug
source: What appear to be tufts of fur hanging from POKENAME's body are actually clouds. POKENAME farms harvest these clouds to weave them into coats and even carpet floors in cooler areas, as they're lightweight and bouncy but very good at retaining heat.

entry: POKENAME用柔软毛发，安慰身边的伙伴。性情友善，又爱陪人玩，是备受喜爱的伴侣。
author: sand_coffin
source: POKENAME uses its soft fur to comfort those around it. It is very friendly and loves playing with people, making it a beloved companion.

entry: POKENAME身上看似毛发的，其实是一缕缕云，能让身体足够轻，跃上高空。高山之巅，常能看见它们在崖壁间蹦跃。
author: katieplaysgames
source: What looks like body fur is actually wisps of cloud that POKENAME uses to help make itself light enough to leap high in the air. They can be found high up in mountaintops bounding across cliff faces.

entry: POKENAME身上覆盖的棉絮厚实、温暖，又便宜。神奥人会将其织成耐用围巾，在冬日市集售卖。
author: .izik
source: The cotton covering POKENAME's body is thick, warm, and inexpensive. In Sinnoh, it is woven into durable scarves sold in winter markets.

entry: POKENAME的棉絮几乎轻如空气，让它无忧无虑地随风飘荡。这些棉絮常被制成透气的夏装，十分珍贵。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's cotton is almost as light as air, allowing them to float along the breeze without a care in the world. Its cotton is highly valuable, as it is commonly used to make highly breathable summer clothing.

entry: POKENAME住在最高的崖上，喜爱风拂过鳞片的感觉。它以为自己的小翅膀有力到足以飞行，因此常跳下矮崖，试着飞起来。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME lives on the tallest cliffs as it loves the feeling of the wind in its scales. It thinks its small wings are strong enough to fly and can be seen throwing itself off small cliffs to try and get airborne.

entry: 古时，人们攀登时信赖POKENAME帮忙固定绳索。它能飞到高处的岩台，凭借稳固的抓握力，将绳结打得分毫不差。
author: .izik
source: In ancient times, POKENAME was trusted to secure ropes during climbs. It could fly to high ledges and tie perfect knots with unshakable grip.

entry: 晴天里，POKENAME成群聚集，在阳光下欢快鸣叫。羽毛无比柔软，又不易沾污，是制作鸡毛掸子的理想材料。
author: mistymagius
source: Flocks of POKENAME gather on clear days, cheerfully chirping while the sun is out. Their feathers are incredibly soft and resistant to grime, making them ideal for use in feather dusters.

entry: 冬天，POKENAME翅上棉絮般的羽毛会发热。它用这份温暖，在寒冷月份为蛋保温。
author: .izik
source: In winter, the cottony feathers on POKENAME's wings grow hot. It uses this warmth to insulate its eggs during the cold months.

entry: POKENAME虽然讨厌脏污，却在洞中栖居。它寻找有地下瀑布的洞穴，再用湿翅膀打扫整个空间，直到岩石、泥土、宝石都像镜子一样闪亮，才肯停下。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME roost in caves, despite their hatred for dirt. They look for caverns containing underground waterfalls, then use their wet wings to clean the entire space. They will only stop when the rocks, dirt and gemstones have a mirror-like shine.

entry: 遭捕食者追赶时，POKENAME会躲进云里，那里也藏着其他同伴。若对方追进来，它们便从四面八方喷射毒液。
author: .izik
source: When chased by predators, POKENAME hides within clouds where the rest of its flock conceals itself. Should the predator follow, they fire bursts of poisonous liquid from all directions.

entry: POKENAME覆着棉絮，滚动时几乎没有声音。白色绒毛中混有黏性毒物，一接触便会发痒、起疹。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME rolls nearly silently thanks to its cotton coating. The white fluff is laced with a sticky poison that causes itchy rashes on contact.

entry: POKENAME性情活泼开朗，每天早晨都用快乐的歌声问好。它没有双臂，便靠上颚那颗喙状尖牙与外界互动。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has a vibrant and upbeat personality, greeting every morning with a happy song. Lacking arms, it interacts with the wider world using the beak-like fang on its upper jaw.

entry: POKENAME温顺可爱的外表只是伪装，让其他生物误以为安全。等对方放松警惕，它就从翅膀扇出冰寒气流，将其彻底冻住。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's docile and cute appearance is a facade meant to lull others into a false sense of security. When their guard is down, POKENAME freezes others solid with gusts of freezing-cold air from its wings.

entry: POKENAME以帮助植物在各地繁衍闻名。它口衔种子，扇动云朵般的花瓣飞行，落地后便把种子种下。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is known for helping plants propagate across the land. It carries seeds in its mouth and flies by flapping its cloud-like petals, planting the seeds when it lands.

entry: POKENAME在云间安然优雅地起舞。风暴将近时，它开始慌张，脚步变得吃力，也略微乱了节拍。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME dances between clouds with a serene grace. When a storm approaches, its steps become labored and slightly off beat as it begins to panic.

entry: 每天清晨，POKENAME成群落在垃圾填埋场，一起啼唱。歌声一停，便对附近的垃圾大吃特吃。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's flock lands atop landfills each morning to chirp a song together. The moment the song ends, they gorge on any nearby trash.

entry: POKENAME的歌声美得摄人心魄，深夜时分能听见它在林中歌唱。它用迷人的歌声将孩子引入家中，走进去的孩子几乎都再没出现。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME possesses a hauntingly beautiful voice, heard singing in the dead of night in forests. It uses this bewitching song to lure children into its home; those who do are almost never seen again.

entry: POKENAME用头顶长出的羽毛，塑造空气中水分的形态，并将水分留在身边。于是看起来，它们走到哪里，头上都绕着小小的云。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME use the feathers sprouting from their head to shape moisture in the air and keep it close to their body. This has the effect of making them look like they walk with miniature clouds around their head at all times.

entry: 遍布全身的云状羽毛，是天然的隔音材料。另一只POKENAME发动声音攻击时，它就用羽毛遮住原本敏感的耳朵。
author: bobosmith01
source: The cloud-like feathers that grow over its body are used as natural soundproof material: when another POKENAME lets out a sound-based attack, it will cover its otherwise sensitive ears.

entry: 柔软雪白的羽毛，让POKENAME完美融入云中。若看见飞行中的飞机，它会飞近，用翅膀擦亮钢铁机身。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its soft, snow-white plumage allows it to blend perfectly into the clouds. If POKENAME spots an airplane in flight, it will fly close to buff the steel fuselage clean with its wings.
