entry: POKENAME全身覆着轻盈气泡，得以浮在地面上方。雾蒙蒙的清晨，它们会成群聚集，欢快地一同歌唱。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's body is covered in a coating of airy bubbles that allows it to float above the ground. They gather in large groups on foggy mornings, cheerfully singing together.

entry: POKENAME生活在半荒漠地带，浓密绒毛不适合真正沙漠的酷热。它无法飞行，会轻轻拔下身上绒毛筑巢，安稳躲藏。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME live in sub-desert environments, their dense fluff not suited to true desert heat. They are incapable of flying and will gently pluck their fluff from their bodies to build nests where they can keep safe.

entry: 夜晚，POKENAME把自己埋进海岸沙中休息。日出时，便与同伴一齐振翅而起，在晨光中闪耀成一片。
author: .izik
source: At night, POKENAME buries itself in coastal sand to rest. At sunrise, it and its flock burst into flight in a shimmering morning display.

entry: POKENAME住在人口聚居地附近，需要帮忙清洁时会主动找人。它的蘑菇磨成粉，能舒缓喉咙疼痛，因此深受歌手与演说家欢迎。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME lives near populated areas and will seek out humans if it needs help cleaning itself. Its mushrooms can be ground into a powder that soothes sore throats, making this Pokémon especially popular with singers and public speakers.

entry: POKENAME活泼爱玩，喜欢为人类与宝可梦唱歌跳舞，也很享受演出时，收获的目光。
author: hexx_vixtar
source: POKENAME is very playful, and it enjoys singing and dancing for both people and Pokémon. It enjoys the attention it receives from its performances.

entry: POKENAME的蘑菇生出浓密菌丝，将身体裹成云朵般的模样。它总是不停清洁菌丝，唯独心情差时会任由污垢堆积，变得像片乌云。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME's mushroom produces a thick mycelium that envelops its body in a cloud-like appearance. It obsessively cleans the mycelium, unless it is in a bad mood, letting grime give it the appearance of a storm cloud.

entry: POKENAME的鳞片由独特物质构成，触碰时是固体，却几乎轻如空气。虽然具有巨大的科研潜力，但鳞片一脱落，就会开始缓缓蒸散。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's scales are made of a unique substance that is solid on contact but is almost as light as air. While the scales have major scientific potential, they will start to slowly evaporate as soon as they are shed.

entry: POKENAME成群爬上蓝球果树吃果实。一被发现，便四散逃开，许多还没来得及追踪，就已消失在天空。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME flocks climb Blue Apricorn trees to eat fruit. If spotted, they scatter in all directions, many vanishing into the sky before they can be followed.

entry: 它身上部分区域的绒毛无比柔软，也十分兜风。只要一阵风足够强，就能托起POKENAME，让它乘风飘行。
author: fireblade141
source: The fluff covering parts of its body is incredibly soft. It's also excellent at catching air, allowing POKENAME to ride the wind if struck by a sufficiently powerful gust.

entry: POKENAME的白色条纹十分柔软，像黏土一样能塑形。人们既用它清洁，也用来制作模型。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME's white stripes are very soft and mouldable like clay. They've been used as both a cleaning product and for modeling.

entry: POKENAME花很多时间学习如何在空中飘行，常为此累坏。特别的一层白色云状绒毛，能在它掉到地上时保护身体。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME spend much of their time learning how to float through the sky and often get tired from doing so. They have a special layer of white cloudy fur that protects them whenever they fall to the ground.

entry: 这只宝可梦非常重视洁净与完美，大部分时间都在梳理蓬松白毛，或为巢穴挑选最合适的小树枝。谁弄脏它的毛、扰乱它的巢，就会立刻遭到报复。
author: _pixelar_
source: This Pokémon places much importance in cleanliness and perfection, spending most of its time grooming its fluffy white fur or gathering the perfect twigs for its nest. Anyone who soils its fur or disturbs the nest is met with swift retribution.

entry: POKENAME飞过清晨天空时，周身气流会变得炽热。飞得越快，热度越高。
author: .izik
source: The air currents around POKENAME's body grow intensely hot as it flies through the morning sky. This heat intensifies the faster it flies.

entry: POKENAME从壳中放出一团团清新空气，让附近生态欣欣向荣。虽然对治理污染帮助很大，它却讨厌待在重度污染地区。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME produces clouds of fresh air from its shell, allowing the nearby ecosystem to thrive. While it is a great help in fighting off pollution, POKENAME hates being in highly polluted areas.

entry: POKENAME像青绵鸟柔绵冰一样冰凉香甜。身体会落下细小冰晶，淋上糖浆，就是美味点心。许多POKENAME乐于给厨师帮忙，因为可以免费享用可口甜食。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are as cold and sweet as a Swablu Shaved Ice. Their bodies flake off tiny ice crystals that make a delicious treat when paired with syrup. Many POKENAME enjoy working alongside chefs where they get free access to delicious treats.

entry: 小型宝可梦喜欢在POKENAME头顶休息，蓬松羽毛就像柔软坐垫。它坐在树上，小心地把羽毛中的细枝、叶片挑出来。
author: mistymagius
source: Small Pokémon love to rest on POKENAME's head, with its fluffy feathers acting as a soft cushion. It sits in the trees, carefully plucking twigs and leaves out of its feathers.

entry: POKENAME头顶的羽毛，像戴着一顶棉絮帽子。它出了名地友善，常把柔软羽毛分给特别喜欢的人。
author: mepp.
source: The feathers on POKENAME's head make it seem like it's wearing a cotton-fluff hat. It is known to be a very friendly Pokémon, often sharing these soft feathers with people it particularly likes.

entry: 许多观鸟者喜爱POKENAME，因为它们在空中飞成心形，啼唱动听而暖心的旋律。科学家认为，它们散发的淡香能让周围的生物平静。
author: bobosmith01
source: Many birdwatchers love POKENAME, as they fly in the sky in the shape of a heart and chirp lovely, heart-warming melodies. Scientists believe the mild scent they emit calms those around them.

entry: POKENAME翅上轻盈的绒毛，是制作讲究围巾的珍贵材料。猫老大的毛与青绵鸟的羽毛独特相融，呈现光滑柔软的光泽。
author: ozydamians
source: The airy fluff on POKENAME's wings is prized for its use in the production of Choice Scarves. The unique combination of Persian fur and Swablu feathers creates a sleek and soft sheen.

entry: POKENAME臂上柔软的绒毛具有安抚作用，很适合轻轻按摩，让其他生物平静。不过，它大多用来揉自己疼痛的脑袋。
author: sk372
source: The soft fluff on POKENAME's arms has a soothing property, making it excellent at calming others with light massages. It mostly uses it to rub its own aching head, though.

entry: POKENAME在海边参差的峭壁上筑巢，因为天敌飞不到巢穴所在的高度。它的歌声吸引世界各地的游客前来。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME nests on jagged beachside cliffs, as its predators cannot fly to reach its nests. Its singing brings tourists from around the world to visit.

entry: POKENAME躲在云层之上高处，静静冥想，无人打扰。只有天空一片云也没有时，才会降到地面。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME hides high above the clouds, quietly meditating while no one can disturb it. It will only come down to the surface when the sky is completely clear of clouds.

entry: POKENAME用念力轻轻托起其他生物，让它们也体验类似飞行的快乐。它也为自己云朵做的胡须颇感自豪。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses its telekinesis to gently lift others so they can experience something akin to the joy of flight. It's also quite proud of its cloud-formed mustache.

entry: 云朵般的手臂压缩内部空气，就能打出毁灭性的重拳。战斗太激烈时，手臂会变暗，甚至放出小闪电。
author: markusknight
source: Their cloudy arms can send a devastating punch by compressing the air in them. When they fight too intensively, the arms turn darker and can even release small bolts of lightning.

entry: POKENAME摆出健美姿势时，胸前的云状绒毛会膨胀。对手之间会比赛展示肌肉，比谁的胸毛最蓬、最威风。
author: sk372
source: When flexing, the cloud-like fluff on POKENAME's chest expands. Rivals will have flexing contests to see which one has the most expansive and thus most impressive chest-fluff.

entry: POKENAME在洋葱田上空飞翔，寻找筑巢地点。选定后，就啄出浅洞，破开土表，再将根扎进深处。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME soars above onion fields searching for nesting grounds. Once it has chosen, it pecks a shallow hole to break the surface and sends roots deep beneath the soil.

entry: 它精神旺盛，性情好斗，总盼着与其他生物切磋。可惜双臂与拳头由云组成，挥拳并没有多大威力。
author: sk372
source: It has a spirited and combative personality, always eager to spar with others. Because its arms and fists are made of clouds, its punches don't pack much power.

entry: POKENAME收集小石子，藏进云朵般的四肢。战斗时，将装满石头的云球抛出，击中时的冲击力比外表看着猛烈得多。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME gathers up small stones to hide within its cloud-like limbs. When battling, it flings cloud orbs filled with rocks to pack deceptively potent punches on impact.

entry: POKENAME的火焰，摸着却柔软极了。它爱在天上奔跑，从一朵云，跃向另一朵云。
author: kiwikelly
source: POKENAME's fire is extremely soft to the touch. It likes to gallop in the sky, prancing from cloud to cloud.

entry: POKENAME不断放出云，在周围形成外壳，让自己悬浮、滑翔。它常成群前往受旱地区，为下方的人类与宝可梦送去雨水。
author: badtothebow
source: POKENAME constantly emits a cloud that forms a shell around it, allowing it to hover and glide. It often flocks to drought-stricken areas to provide rain for people and Pokémon below.

entry: 它携带的棒子顶端，裹着自己定期产生的云状物质。它会将这份棉絮般、甜味浓烈的点心，送给亲近的对象。
author: sk372
source: The stick it carries is tipped with a cloudy substance it regularly produces. It offers this up to those it is close to; the flavor of the cottony confection is powerfully sweet.

entry: POKENAME的三个头都有同样婉转的嗓音，也都爱歌唱，却合唱不好。它们各唱不同的曲子，声音一撞上，就会吵起来。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's three heads all possess the same melodic voice and love of singing, but do not harmonize well. Each attempts to sing a different song, leading to fights when the songs overlap.

entry: POKENAME用翅膀般的鳍肢，掠过海边悬崖。棉絮一湿，就会拖累身体，得等上数小时才能再次飞行。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME glides across coastal cliffs with its wing-like flippers. When wet, the cotton weighs POKENAME down, so POKENAME must wait several hours before it is able to fly again.

entry: POKENAME的云状尾节虽然摸着蓬松，中央却是实心石头。感到威胁时，它会毫不犹豫地甩动身体，把挑衅者打飞。
author: sk372
source: Although fluffy to the touch, within the center of POKENAME's cloudy tail segments are solid stone. If it feels threatened, it won't hesitate to swing its body around and send an agitator flying.

entry: 它用爪上棉絮般的绒团，给大型宝可梦清洁牙齿，换取零碎食物。
author: kiwiarms
source: It uses the cottony puffs on its claws to clean the teeth of larger Pokémon in return for scraps of food.

entry: POKENAME的脖子长短各异，有的比巴士短，有的却高过路灯。广为流传的民间故事说，有一只脖子长到云上，一名青年试着爬到顶端。
author: bigoljax
source: Every POKENAME's neck varies in length, with some shorter than buses and others taller than lampposts. A popular folktale tells of an POKENAME's neck growing beyond the clouds, with a young man trying to climb to the top.

entry: 不想伤到对手时，POKENAME会用柔软的云状羽毛垫住拳头。温柔的性情，让它深受初学拳击的人重视，是很好的陪练。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME can cushion their fists with soft, cloud-like plumage when they wish to avoid hurting their opponents. This gentle nature makes them highly valued training partners for novice boxers.

entry: POKENAME在空中起舞，吸入有毒气体，再将其净化。空气清洁完毕，便开始悠扬哼唱。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME dance through the skies, consuming toxic gases before purifying them. When the process of air cleansing is done, POKENAME start to melodically hum.

entry: POKENAME结成小群捕猎，唤起强风，让猎物慢下来。它们很擅长捕食其他在空中飞行的宝可梦。
author: gren24242
source: POKENAME hunts in small packs, summoning powerful winds to slow its prey down. They are effective hunters of other airborne Pokémon.

entry: 轻柔的歌声能让附近所有宝可梦，进入舒适的沉睡。为了保持翅膀色彩鲜艳，POKENAME必须吸食某些植物的汁液，而它们只生长在海拔1,000米以上。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its gentle song can lull any nearby Pokémon into a pleasant, deep sleep. To keep the vibrant colors of its wings, POKENAME must feed on the sap of specific plants that grow only at altitudes above 1,000 meters.

entry: POKENAME能造出蓬松洁白的物质，甜得像棉花糖，却完全不含糖。它在嘉年华、游乐会上，一边哼歌，一边把这物质缠到棒子上，免费送给人们。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME can create a fluffy white substance that is sweet like cotton-candy, but completely sugar-free. It will spin this onto sticks to give away to people at carnivals and funfairs, humming while it works.

entry: POKENAME覆着棉絮的钳子既有力，也能轻柔握住东西。它性情善良，会用钳子帮小型宝可梦够树果，或爬回不慎跌下的树。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's cotton-covered pincers are strong, but just as able to hold onto things gently. It has a kind disposition, using its pincers to help small Pokémon reach berries or climb up trees they have fallen from.

entry: POKENAME以强大力量和柔软白毛闻名。纵然力大、野性难驯，一旦取得信任，就会成为忠诚的伙伴，连孩子也能与它相伴。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are renowned for their strength and for their soft, white fur. Despite how strong and wild they can be, when their trust is earned, they become faithful companions, even for children.

entry: POKENAME虽然弱小，歌声却颇为动听，前提是待在水下。若到水面上唱，就只剩沙哑、咕噜作响的歌声，得不到什么好评。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is weak, but has a rather pleasant singing voice, provided it remains underwater. If it tries to sing above water, it can only emit raspy and gurgling songs that draw no positive attention.

entry: POKENAME极其罕见，据说能凭自身力量，翱翔在积雨云之上。有人相信，它能将暴风云引离人类聚居地，守护整座城市免遭猛烈风暴。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is an exceptionally rare Pokémon said to soar above cumulonimbus clouds on the strength of its powers. Some people believe it can steer storm clouds away from human settlements, shielding entire cities from devastating tempests.

entry: POKENAME极其罕见，据说能凭自身力量，翱翔在积雨云之上。有人相信，它能将暴风云引离人类聚居地，守护整座城市免遭猛烈风暴。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is an exceptionally rare Pokémon said to soar above cumulonimbus clouds on the strength of its powers. Some people believe it can steer storm clouds away from human settlements, shielding entire cities from devastating tempests.

entry: POKENAME在周身造出充满氦气的小泡泡，借此飞行。泡泡先在身上的绒毛中形成，再移到皮肤表面，将身体覆住。
author: .izik
source: An POKENAME forms small helium-filled bubbles around its body to fly. The bubbles form within the fluff on its body, then move to cover its skin.

entry: 这些宝可梦蓬松无比，在洁净市区难得一见，却很受喜爱。它们常用惹人怜爱的声音啼叫，向人讨食；不出所料，从不为吃饭发愁。
author: ocxin
source: Incredibly fluffy, these Pokémon are a rare but beloved sight in clean urban areas. They can often be seen begging for food from humans as they chirp with endearing voices. They unsurprisingly do not struggle for meals.

entry: 附在POKENAME身上的泡泡，让它即使睡着，也能浮在离地数英寸处。科学家研究这奇特浮力数十年，仍没有明确答案。
author: .izik
source: The bubbles clinging to POKENAME allow it to hover several inches above the ground, even while asleep. Scientists have studied this strange buoyancy for decades without clear answers.

entry: POKENAME将覆身的蓬松棉絮加热到发光，以此赶走野生宝可梦。它也会轻哼摇篮曲，逗训练家开心，或助其入睡。
author: fiordaliso
source: It keeps wild Pokémon away by heating up the fluffy cotton covering its body until it glows. POKENAME hums gentle lullabies to entertain its Trainer or help them fall asleep.

entry: POKENAME将覆身的蓬松棉絮加热到发光，以此赶走野生宝可梦。它也会轻哼摇篮曲，逗训练家开心，或助其入睡。
author: fiordaliso
source: It keeps wild Pokémon away by heating up the fluffy cotton covering its body until it glows. POKENAME hums gentle lullabies to entertain its Trainer or help them fall asleep.

entry: 它窝在云朵般的羽毛里，比卡比兽还爱睡觉。据说，用它的羽毛填成枕头，就能保证做个好梦。
author: bostroms
source: Nestled within its cloudlike feathers, it enjoys sleeping even more than Snorlax.  Pillows that are stuffed with its feathers are said to guarantee good dreams.

entry: 它窝在云朵般的羽毛里，比卡比兽还爱睡觉。据说，用它的羽毛填成枕头，就能保证做个好梦。
author: bostroms
source: Nestled within its cloudlike feathers, it enjoys sleeping even more than Snorlax.  Pillows that are stuffed with its feathers are said to guarantee good dreams.

entry: 它窝在云朵般的羽毛里，比卡比兽还爱睡觉。据说，用它的羽毛填成枕头，就能保证做个好梦。
author: bostroms
source: Nestled within its cloudlike feathers, it enjoys sleeping even more than Snorlax.  Pillows that are stuffed with its feathers are said to guarantee good dreams.

entry: POKENAME最喜欢带小孩子飞过云顶，来一趟刺激的空中旅行。与它同行的飞行，每次都安全无虞。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME's favorite activity is to take young children and give them an exciting flight over the tops of clouds. No flight with an POKENAME is ever unsafe.

entry: POKENAME喜欢在云里玩耍，不停钻进钻出。即使晴天，也会造出小云朵来玩。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME love to play in clouds, constantly passing in and out of them. They even create miniature clouds to play with on clear days.

entry: 常能看见POKENAME住在花田中央，用婉转嗓音歌唱。颈边的棉絮随微风飘散，附着花朵，哪怕天气恶劣，也能为花提供养分。
author: sk372
source: One can often spy an POKENAME residing in the middle of flower fields, singing with a melodious voice. The cottony puff around its neck spreads along with the breeze, clinging to flowers and providing them nourishment even in adverse weather.

entry: POKENAME的云彩会随天空颜色变化，因此世界各地的个体都有些不同。它接连使出求雨与大晴天，再用尾巴为每朵生成的云塑出独特花纹。
author: bigoljax
source: The unique coloring on POKENAME's clouds change depending on the color of the sky, making each one slightly different around the world. They use Rain Dance and Sunny Day back-to-back, using their tails to make distinct patterns with each cloud made.

entry: POKENAME歌声婉转，喜欢坐在河边自顾自地唱。别的宝可梦若听得入迷，靠得太近，就会被它用喙狠狠啄一口，连歌声都不会因此中断。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME possesses a melodious voice and enjoys sitting by rivers and singing to itself. If other Pokémon get too close while enjoying its song, it delivers a painful nip with its beak, without even stopping its singing.

entry: POKENAME用力量准确预知云的形状与变化。若从中预见风暴将至，就会低沉歌唱，提醒附近所有生物。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME uses its powers to accurately forecast cloud shapes and patterns. If these future readings predict an incoming storm, it sings with a deep voice to alert all beings nearby.

entry: 水一溅到POKENAME翅上，毛间就慢慢泛起肥皂般的泡沫，滴落下来。这混合物帮助野外的它们清洁身体，毕竟它们怕脏、怕病菌，出了名地紧张。
author: bigoljax
source: Whenever water splashes onto POKENAME's wings, a soap-like mixture begins to slowly foam up and drip down from their fur. This mixture helps POKENAME clean themselves in the wild, as they're known to be very frantic germaphobes.

entry: 家里闹POKENAME，反倒说明屋子干净，因为它们讨厌污秽。它们常成群藏在七夕青鸟翼间，搭顺风车远行。
author: santon5512
source: A POKENAME infestation is a sign of a clean home, as these Pokémon hate filth. Packs of POKENAME often hide out among Altaria's wings, hitching a ride to travel long distances.

entry: POKENAME冷得能让周围空气凝结，看着总像站在云上。从口中喷火时，这片云会暂时散开。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME is so cold that it can condense the air around it, so it always appears as if it is standing on a cloud. This cloud briefly disperses when it shoots flames from its mouth.

entry: POKENAME沿水道漂行时，喜欢懒洋洋地哼唱。平静婉转的歌声，让听众仿佛置身悠闲的暑假。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME likes to hum lazily as it floats along water ways. Its calm melodic singing makes listeners feel like they are on a summer vacation.

entry: 强烈阳光下，POKENAME会用云朵般的壳遮住硕大、敏感的眼睛。结果，晴天飞行时，它反而看不见路。
author: oddwalls
source: In bright sunlight, POKENAME covers its large, sensitive eyes with its cloudlike shell. As a result, on sunny days POKENAME can no longer see where it's flying.

entry: POKENAME外表天真，却会对在自己照看下小睡的生物产生占有欲。非得满意，觉得对方“休息够了”，才肯让其醒来。有人说，它唱歌是为了让你别动，并非安抚。
author: curazy
source: While it appears innocent, POKENAME becomes possessive of those who nap under its watch, refusing to let them wake until it's satisfied they've “rested enough.” Some say it sings not to soothe, but to keep you still.

entry: 构成POKENAME的物质十分独特，受力时流得更快，结晶后却成了有着绒羽、棉絮般外观的岩石。核心的特殊肌肉缓缓驱动它笨重的身体前行。
author: vic1312
source: The material that POKENAME consist of is unique, flowing faster when force is applied and crystallizing into a rock with a downy, cotton-like appearance. Specialized muscles within their core gently drive their ponderous locomotion.

entry: POKENAME的翅膀质地像棉絮，沾湿后会变重。遇到暴雨，连沿直线飞行都很困难。
author: .izik
source: Its wings have a consistency similar to cotton, and become heavy when wet. During a rainstorm, an POKENAME has trouble flying in a straight line.

entry: POKENAME飞在高高云端，远离所有天敌。每次降到地面，都会掀起足以吹倒树木的狂风。
author: gren24242
source: POKENAME flies high above the clouds away from all predators. Whenever it descends to the ground, it creates a fierce wind capable of toppling trees.

entry: POKENAME友善又爱交际，常陪成群的青绵鸟穿越平原，既作伴，也让它们在云朵般的象鼻中歇息。
author: cpnquacken
source: An extremely friendly and sociable Pokémon. POKENAME tend to travel across the plains with flocks of Swablu, giving them company and a place to rest within its cloudy trunk.

entry: POKENAME的电子嗓音悦耳动听，一唱歌便奏出欢快旋律。许多不同媒体的配乐，都会采用它歌声的采样。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's digital voice is very pleasant to listen to, making joyful melodies whenever it sings. Many different media use samples of POKENAME songs in their musical scores.

entry: POKENAME的四肢每次旋转挥动，都会留下云迹。云逐渐包覆它，遮住战场上的动作，以此迷惑对手。
author: sk372
source: Every spinning swing of POKENAME's limbs leaves behind a cloud trail. It uses these to confuse opponents by slowly enveloping and obscuring its battlefield movements over time.

entry: POKENAME能在云状毛皮中发光，模仿暴风云威吓其他生物。为了引诱猎物，它演化出轻哼与旋律般动听的声音；也能发出刺耳噪声，赶走威胁。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME can emit light within their cloud-like furs to imitate storm clouds and intimidate others. To lure in prey, POKENAME have evolved to emit hums and sounds like an alluring melody; they can also emit harsh noises to scare away threats.

entry: POKENAME的云里，盛着牛奶般的液体，滋味比普通大奶罐的奶还新鲜。身上的斑纹，有时也会发亮。
author: t.i.a.
source: POKENAME's clouds hold milk-like liquid that tastes fresher than average Miltank milk. The markings on its body seem to glow sometimes.

entry: POKENAME开朗友好，喜欢把自己产的蛋，分给朋友。煮熟后，蛋质轻盈蓬松，却没什么味道。
author: almightyonion
source: A joyful and friendly Pokémon, POKENAME loves to share the eggs it lays with its friends. When cooked, the eggs are light and airy, but lack flavor.

entry: POKENAME云朵般的鬃毛，会定期分出小团块，飘向远处。它们充满强大电能，很快就变成猛烈的微型雷暴。
author: sk372
source: Small chunks of POKENAME's cloud-like mane will periodically separate and float away from it. Supercharged with its electrical energy, they quickly turn into violent miniature thunderstorms.

entry: POKENAME将污水吸入蓬松翅膀，拧出净水，化为雨水落下。残留污染物变成气体，让它足够轻盈，得以乘北风旅行。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME absorbs polluted water into its fluffy wings and wrings out the purified water in the form of rain. The remaining pollutants transform into gases that make it floaty enough to catch and travel the north winds.

entry: POKENAME唱起空灵、仿佛亘古流传的歌谣时，周围植物就会飞速生长。歌声催树根穿透岩地，因此它栖居的山林总是繁茂浓密。
author: pattybgoode
source: As POKENAME sings a timeless, airy ballad, plants begin to grow rapidly around it. It lives in lush, thick mountain forests because its song encourages trees to push their roots through rocky ground.

entry: 它摩擦手腕上云朵般的毛，产生静电，再导入尾巴储存。蓄电越多，尾巴越暗，愈发像一片暴风云。
author: infinex21
source: By rubbing the cloud-like fur on its wrists together, it generates static electricity, which is channeled to and stored within its tail. Its tail darkens with more stored electricity, increasingly looking like a storm cloud as it builds a charge.

entry: 有人推测，某些古画上被视为雷神的形象，其实是POKENAME。也有历史学家不赞同，认为那是另一种在合众也罕见的宝可梦。它态度和善，却有些疏离。
author: bobosmith01
source: It has been theorized that some old paintings depicting what was believed to be a lightning deity showed POKENAME, although some historians disagree and suggest a Pokémon rarely found in Unova instead. It has a pleasant but detached attitude.

entry: POKENAME周围裹着蓬松、结实的云，蜷成球就能停止浮空。人们鼓励训练家剪下绒毛，因为它是很好的油炸裹料。
author: ghostslythe
source: Surrounded in fluffy, durable clouds, POKENAME rolls up in a ball to stop floating in the air. Trainers are encouraged to shear this fluff, which makes great breading when deep-fried.

entry: POKENAME云朵般的翅膀与蓝色身躯，让猎物误以为只是一片云，任它无声地从上方跟踪。捕获目标后，它会轻哼安抚的曲调，防止猎物挣扎、呼救。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's cloud-like wings and blue body trick its prey into thinking it's just a cloud as it silently stalks them from above. After capturing its target, it sings a soothing hum to prevent any struggle or cry for help from them.

entry: POKENAME悠悠飘过丛林上空的蓝天。谁若伤害林中的动物，它就会张口喷出火球。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: POKENAME drifts serenely through the blue sky above jungles. It will launch fireballs from its mouth at anyone who is harming the jungle's fauna.

entry: 尾上的蓝刺其实是硬毛，激动时会变得坚硬，云状尾毛也会竖起。它每天至少磨爪两次，直到锋利得能在大石上凿出深痕。
author: infinex21
source: The blue spikes in its tail are quills that become rigid when it is agitated; the cloud-like fur of its tail becomes bristly as well. It routinely sharpens its claws at least twice a day until they are sharp enough to gouge a large stone.

entry: POKENAME的战姿优雅，无可匹敌。拳脚如微风般掠过空中，命中时却有龙卷风的威力。
author: bluenido.
source: POKENAME fights with unmatched grace. Its punches and kicks glide through the air like breezes and strike with the force of a tornado.

entry: POKENAME挥舞缎带般饰物，优雅起舞，抚平愤怒、烦乱者的心绪。随后再唱一曲，让对方安然入睡。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's graceful and ribbon-laden dance eases the hearts and minds of those enraged and upset. Afterwards, it sings a melody that makes them fall asleep.

entry: POKENAME极其罕见，只有几道彩虹相近出现时，才比较常见。难得一见的身影，让许多人相信，它就是传说中彩虹尽头的宝藏。
author: cinnamoone_redfield
source: It is said POKENAME are incredibly rare, only frequently appearing when multiple rainbows form close together. Their scarcity has led many people to believe that this Pokémon is the fabled treasure at the end of the rainbow.

entry: 许多人会留意云中特别的切痕，发现POKENAME的踪迹。它切开云，是为了不让云挂住身体，拖慢速度。
author: bigoljax
source: Many can spot an POKENAME by noticing distinct slicing patterns in the clouds. They do this so clouds won't catch on their body and make them slower.

entry: POKENAME穿梭天空，婉转哼唱。暴风雪中几乎难以察觉，会击倒猎物，拖回巢穴。它云朵般的毛与柔软羽毛，也让它成为露营者的理想伙伴。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: As POKENAME zip through the skies, they melodically hum. During blizzards, they are almost undetectable, taking down prey and dragging them back to their dens. Their cloud-like fur and soft feathers make them perfect companions for campers.

entry: POKENAME身后拖着的大云，藏着一张利齿密布的嘴。它先哼唱平静曲调，让敌人放松警惕，再猛合双颚咬住。
author: chibitales
source: The large cloud trailing POKENAME hides a mouth of sharp teeth. It hums a calming tune to lull foes into a false sense of security before clamping its jaws around them.

entry: POKENAME身下的翅膀看着像云，其实是极细的羽毛。它也很有音乐天赋，哼唱能为太古羽虫、太古盔甲充当摇篮曲。
author: dukefrogpeasant
source: The wings under an POKENAME's body look like clouds, but are actually very fine feathers. It is also very musically talented, and its humming serves as a lullaby for Anorith and Armaldo.

entry: POKENAME大半天都躺在柔软棉翼上哼歌。谁敢偷翅膀上哪怕一小块，它就会用尽懒散度日积下的力气，毫不留情地反击。
author: darkweavile428
source: POKENAME spends most of the day laying on its soft cotton wings and humming songs. If anyone tries to steal even a small piece of its wings, POKENAME will attack them mercilessly using all of the energy it has stored by lazing about.

entry: POKENAME连大气最细微的变化，也能感知。它的出现，常预示当地将有猛烈雷暴。
author: codewolfie
source: POKENAME can sense even the slightest atmospheric changes. Its presence signifies a severe thunderstorm in the area.

entry: POKENAME通常密度如云，优雅漂浮，极少触地。它将食物放进云状身体进食，吃得不留痕迹。它的歌声尤其能使人平静。
author: entomoxie
source: As the average POKENAME is as dense as a cloud, it floats gracefully and rarely touches the ground. It eats by placing food into its cloudy body, leaving no trace behind. Its songs are known to be especially calming.

entry: POKENAME是能漂浮的宝可梦中体型最大的种类之一，通过滤食，吞下空中更小的飞行生物。它与青绵王结群飘行时，从地面望去，常被当成真正的云群。
author: _pixelar_
source: One of the biggest Pokémon with the ability to float is POKENAME, which feeds itself by filter feeding on smaller flying critters from the air. Floating together with Swablords, the pod is often confused for a real cloud formation from the surface.

entry: 哲学家记载，POKENAME飞过的城市，会迎来长久的好运。无论是巧合还是它的影响，各地区都会仔细记录这些目击事件。
author: .izik
source: Philosophers record that cities POKENAME flies over experience prolonged good fortune. Whether coincidence or influence, these sightings are carefully documented across regions.

entry: 小型飞行属性宝可梦，会被POKENAME背上蓬松的云吸引。无论哪只宝可梦，只要在云中歇息，都能享受香甜的沉睡。
author: hophoppip
source: Small Flying-type Pokémon are attracted to the fluffy clouds on POKENAME's back. Any Pokémon who rests in these clouds will experience deep, blissful sleep.

entry: POKENAME常在空中平和地飞翔，用女高音般的嗓音歌唱。听见它的声音，便是春天开始的信号；冬季，它住在最高耸的山间，大多待在云中。
author: heal_fire
source: POKENAME is known to fly peacefully in the sky, singing with its soprano voice. Hearing its sounds marks the start of spring, as POKENAME spends winter in some of the highest mountains, spending most of its time inside the clouds.

entry: POKENAME在空中疾飞，借云的力量，比风还快。它不断寻找能与自己竞速的对手，一同飞越天空。
author: heal_fire
source: POKENAME can be seen flying fiercely through the sky, using its cloud to go even faster than the wind. It's constantly looking for a rival to race across the sky with.

entry: 野外的POKENAME独来独往，找僻静处练习婉转歌唱。它好胜，组织合唱团很费工夫；不过一旦成功，合奏的音乐便无可挑剔。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME keeps to itself in the wild, finding solitary spots to practice its melodic singing. Its competitive nature makes organizing a group chorus a chore, but when successful, the music they can create is impeccable.

entry: 它的歌声令所有听众心生敬畏，甚至能让战斗停息。古老国度中安宁的城市，曾让POKENAME担任守卫与保护者。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Its song inspires awe and commands respect from all who hear it. It is even capable of stopping battles. Peaceful cities in ancient lands used POKENAME as a guardian and protector.

entry: POKENAME住在最高山峰的云层之上，将整座山视为己有。兴奋时，便齐声歌唱，和谐鸣声在山谷回荡数英里。
author: _pixelar_
source: POKENAME dwell above the clouds atop the tallest peaks, claiming the mountain as their own. When excited, they sing in unison, their harmonious calls echoing for miles through the valleys.

entry: 炎热地区，有时能看见被称作“沙漠乐团”的孤云。其实，那是POKENAME用急振翅膀与嘹亮嗓音求偶，声音覆盖的区域可达十英里。
author: ocxin
source: In hot areas, singular clouds called desert orchestras are sometimes observed. In truth, they are POKENAME sounding out with their fast-beating wings and powerful voices for courtship over a zone of up to ten miles.

entry: POKENAME爱慕虚荣，喜欢用闪亮石头装点身体。天水交界模糊的日子里，它会载歌载舞地飞起，向观者展示优雅姿态。
author: sylphon22
source: POKENAME are vain Pokémon that enjoy decorating their bodies with shiny stones. On days when the boundary between the sky and the water's surface fades, they are known to take flight in song and dance, showing off their grace to any onlookers.

entry: 身体轻如空气，随风任意起舞，无忧无虑。芭蕾舞者也从POKENAME优雅的飘带中，汲取舞蹈灵感。
author: mistymagius
source: Its body is as light as air, it whimsically dances along wind currents without a care in the world. Ballerinas have taken inspiration from POKENAME's graceful ribbons in their dances.

entry: 古时，人们将POKENAME的角磨成粉，制药治疗胃溃疡与发烧。
author: .izik
source: The ground-up horn of an POKENAME was used in ancient times to create remedies to treat stomach ulcers and fevers.

entry: POKENAME用强大而共鸣的嗓音，将海水推退。从大气中蒸发的水分越多，云朵般的羽毛就越浓密、越庞大。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME push back the sea using their incredibly powerful, resonant voices. The more moisture they evaporate from the atmosphere, the denser and more expansive their cloud-like plumage becomes.

entry: POKENAME不停穿行天空，即使在平流层飞行，也能同时睡觉。蜕下的白色绒羽，看起来像天际一道闪烁星迹。
author: cobalt0135
source: POKENAME moves endlessly across the skies and can even sleep while it maintains flight in the stratosphere. When it molts its white down, they'll look like a trail of sparkling stars across the sky.

entry: POKENAME在高高的平流层起舞，风暴过后，便到云间玩耍。偶尔能见它在积雨云之间跳跃，不过大多数目击者，都以为只是风吹动的丝丝云絮。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Dancing high in the stratosphere, POKENAME plays amongst clouds in the wake of storms. They can rarely be seen jumping between cumulonimbus clouds, though most who see them mistake them for wisps of cloud blown by the wind.

entry: POKENAME在高高的平流层起舞，风暴过后，便到云间玩耍。偶尔能见它在积雨云之间跳跃，不过大多数目击者，都以为只是风吹动的丝丝云絮。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Dancing high in the stratosphere, POKENAME plays amongst clouds in the wake of storms. They can rarely be seen jumping between cumulonimbus clouds, though most who see them mistake them for wisps of cloud blown by the wind.

entry: POKENAME往往温顺，保护其他生物，哪怕对方曾攻击自己。上肢最多能伸出一英尺，重击足以打裂树木；不过，它更喜欢用催眠孢子制服敌人。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME tend to appear rather docile and protective of others, even if POKENAME are attacked by them. Their upper limbs can stretch up to a foot away and can hit hard enough to crack a tree; they prefer to subdue foes with soporific spores, however.

entry: POKENAME翱翔时动作僵硬，看着像提线木偶。它飞得不够优雅，常在空中撞上其他宝可梦。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME soar through the sky with rigid movements that make them seem like puppets. Their lack of grace causes them to bump into other Pokémon while airborne.

entry: POKENAME很乐意让其他生物，把头靠在自己柔软丰厚的绒毛上。对方倚着它时，它就用婉转歌声安抚，确保对方做个好梦。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is all too happy to let others rest their head against the soft and luxurious fluff of its body. While they lay against it, it soothes them with the melodious sounds of its voice, which ensures pleasant dreams.

entry: POKENAME有时清晨会停在山顶，唱一首忧郁的曲子。老人听了，可能会感到头晕。
author: .izik
source: An POKENAME will sometimes perch on a mountain top in the morning to sing a depressing tune. The tune can cause dizziness in the elderly.

entry: POKENAME身上的绒毛炽热无比。一旦进入寒冷气候，绒毛就会变脆，成团脱落。
author: .izik
source: The wool on its body is extremely hot. Should an POKENAME enter a cold climate, the wool will become brittle and fall off in clumps.

entry: POKENAME体贴，也爱保护其他生物。它让小型宝可梦躲进云中，再有力挥动斧头般的长牙，抵御捕食者。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has a caring and protective nature. It shelters smaller Pokémon within its clouds, defending them from predators with strong swings of its axe-like tusks.

entry: 传说描绘POKENAME翱翔天空，寻求冒险。在某些地方，它因极强的正义感与勇气，被尊为英雄。
author: actliux
source: Legends depict POKENAME soaring across the skies in search of adventure. In some places, they are honored as heroes for their extreme sense of justice and bravery.

entry: 它取来遗失、遭弃的毛绒玩具填充物，用来装扮自己。谁若往伪装下面偷看，就会沉沉睡去。
author: almightyonion
source: It takes the stuffing from lost and thrown-away plushes to use in its disguise. Any who peek under its disguise will fall into a deep sleep.

entry: 它九条云状尾巴，每条都蕴藏强大的龙之能量。女高音般的嗓音美妙动听，唱起来像人用无人能懂的语言诉说。
author: .jerden
source: Each of its nine cloud-like tails holds powerful draconic energy. They have a beautiful soprano voice and sing like a human speaking in a language nobody can decipher.

entry: POKENAME飘游空中，任何靠近的小宝可梦都会被咬。它其实颇温顺，不攻击比自己大的对象。
author: duskrd
source: POKENAME will drift through the sky, biting any small Pokémon that approaches. It is actually quite docile and won't attack anything larger than it.

entry: POKENAME的绒毛柔软如云。不过，它不喜欢未经允许就被触碰，谁侵入它的私人空间，就会被一阵乱拳招呼。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME's fluff has a soft, cloud-like texture. However, it does not like to be touched without permission and will unleash a flurry of punches to anyone who invades its personal space.

entry: POKENAME降落时，常甩下翅上的云，用来分散捕食者的注意，扰乱其视线。
author: hortensia_xxiii
source: POKENAME will often shed the clouds on their wings when landing, using them as a distraction to throw off the eyes of predators.

entry: POKENAME肺活量极佳，能连续婉转歌唱超过三十分钟。音乐在它栖居的大洞中回荡，安抚野生宝可梦，让它们不再那么好斗。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has excellent lung capacity, letting it sing its melodic song for over thirty minutes straight at a time. Its music echoes across its cavernous home, soothing the wild Pokémon and making them less aggressive.

entry: POKENAME眼上覆着空灵的白色水晶，能探知其他宝可梦身上的诅咒能量。它轻唱摇篮曲，安抚受诅咒的宝可梦，同时吸收这些能量。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have ethereal white crystals over their eyes that detect cursed energy in other Pokémon. They soothe cursed Pokémon with a soft lullaby while absorbing the cursed energy.

entry: 人们观察到，POKENAME会对某些宝可梦怀有极深、永不消散的怨恨，尤其是体型小、颜色粉红的那些。研究者至今还没找出怒气从何而来。
author: tisgabe
source: It has been observed that POKENAME form deep, unending grudges against select Pokémon. Specifically those of the small, pink variety. Researchers have yet to figure out where the anger originated.

entry: 这只宝可梦在最蓬松、泡团般的云中休息，喜爱深睡与充满冒险的梦。若有人想和POKENAME粗野打闹，尤其跳高去够它，它可不会高兴。
author: tisgabe
source: Found resting amongst the bubbliest of clouds, this Pokémon is very fond of deep sleep and adventurous dreams. POKENAME don't take kindly to those who roughhouse with it, specifically by jumping up high to reach it.

entry: 丰缘有个传说，一只POKENAME守护着被水晶环绕的泉水。只有愿意与它一起唱歌的人，才准进入。
author: .izik
source: There is a legend in Hoenn of an POKENAME that guards a spring surrounded by crystals. It will allow entry only to those who sing with it.

entry: POKENAME覆身的云状毛皮，是极好的护盾。偷猎者向它开枪，往往没留意这层防护，子弹却已被厚毛挡下。观鸟者说，它闻起来像刚下过雨。
author: bigoljax
source: The cloud-like fur covering POKENAME's body works very well as a shield, often going unnoticed by poachers shooting at them because the bullets are stopped by their thick fur. Bird watchers describe POKENAME as having a scent similar to fresh rain.

entry: POKENAME外表光滑，身上其实覆满剃刀般锋利的鳞片。只要蹭上船，就可能造成严重损坏。
author: .izik
source: Despite its smooth appearance, its body is covered in razor-sharp scales. Should an POKENAME rub against a ship, it can cause massive damage.

entry: POKENAME的大翅膀让它即使在无风时，也能长距离滑翔。不过，身形太小，强风会打乱飞行，让它被阵风卷走，在空中翻滚。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's large wings let it glide for long distances during windless days. However, its small frame means strong winds will disrupt its flight and send it tumbling through the air as it is swept up by the wind gusts.

entry: 两只POKENAME融合，竟成了完全由云构成的身体。模样似乎很像，遥远地区某种现象带来的形态。
author: jackjirachi
source: This self-fusion of POKENAME is made purely out of clouds. It seems to resemble a certain form caused by a phenomenon in a faraway region.

entry: POKENAME的云由独特黏液黏合，维持身体结构，因此羽毛比普通七夕青鸟更结实。这种黏液也是强力天然黏合剂，常被采集来制作胶水。
author: mimisha_m.lkpowder
source: POKENAME's clouds are bound by a unique slime that maintains its body's structure. This makes its plumage firmer than that of the average Altaria. This slime is also a potent natural adhesive, frequently harvested to produce glue.

entry: 胆小、温柔的POKENAME住在云层之上的荒僻山中，远离人类。雨来时，便随雨降下，在倾盆大雨中快乐地飞翔、玩耍。
author: t3isukone
source: The timid and gentle POKENAME lives in desolate mountains above the cloud layer, far away from humans. When rain comes, POKENAME descends with it, flying and playing joyfully in the downpour.

entry: 白色羽毛会分泌难以清除的黏性毒素。因此，它在高树间跳来跳去时，常把其他东西黏到自己身上。
author: mistymagius
source: Its white feathers secrete a sticky toxin that is very difficult to get off. Because of this, it will often get other objects stuck to itself while jumping around tall trees.

entry: POKENAME蘑菇底部蓬松的生长物，可以取下来配成治疗剧烈咳嗽的药。它栖居山林，唱歌的节奏短促分明。
author: pjporwoll
source: The puffy growths on the bottom of POKENAME's mushrooms can be removed to concoct medicine for severe coughs. It is found in mountainous forests where it sings in staccato rhythms.

entry: POKENAME在云上嘹亮歌唱，吸引小型宝可梦，邀请它们到自己体内避难。不过，一旦饿了，也可能将它们消化掉。
author: nexusshenanigans
source: POKENAME sings loudly above the clouds, attracting smaller Pokémon and offering them sanctuary within its body. However, it may digest them if it becomes hungry.

entry: 民间传说里，这样的宝可梦会在来世，迎接你的到来。它的旋律，能让每只宝可梦安定下来。
author: dodoowner_
source: Folktales say a Pokémon like this will greet you in the afterlife. Its melodies can calm each and every Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME一边飞，一边唱，把云当作舞台。旋律温柔，让听见的生物，都能得到慰藉。
author: hexx_vixtar
source: POKENAME loves to sing as it flies through the sky. It uses the clouds as a stage, singing a song that comforts all who hear its tune.

entry: POKENAME在空中起舞时，会利用整个周围环境，穿云飘升、下落，让表演更精彩。它改变云状翅膀的密度，让其更接近液体或气体，借此改变体重。
author: _pixelar_
source: When dancing in the air, an POKENAME will use its entire environment to enhance the performance by floating and falling through the clouds. It can change its weight by changing the density of its cloud-like wings, making them more liquid or gaseous.

entry: 据说POKENAME是孩子梦中幻化的存在。它的模样确实如同童话，超能力也满是奇思妙想。
author: frokachu
source: Said to be a dream conjured up from a child, POKENAME indeed have a fairy tale like appearance, and their psychic powers invoke a lot of whimsy.

entry: POKENAME靠蘑菇维生，所以取药材时，只能摘下能再生的蓬松生长物。它常在山顶唱起听来悲切的旋律。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is sustained by the mushroom, so only the puffy growths should be removed for their medicinal properties since they can be regrown. It is known to sing mournful-sounding melodies from mountaintops.

entry: POKENAME用柔软绒羽制成手里剑。多枚高速掷出，声音便如同合唱。战斗时也会哼歌，让自己始终显得从容。
author: chaoticanzu
source: POKENAME creates throwing stars out of its soft down. When multiple are thrown at high speeds the resulting sound resembles a chorus. It hums in battle to always appear composed.

entry: 它体型不同，婉转歌声的音高也相差甚远，从天籁般的女高音，到雄浑的男高音都有。周身棉絮隐约像颗南瓜，夜间在田里很容易认出。
author: fiordaliso
source: Depending on its body size, the pitch of its melodious voice can vary greatly, ranging from a celestial soprano to a powerful tenor. The cotton surrounding its body vaguely resembles a pumpkin, making it easy to spot in fields at night.

entry: POKENAME开个人演唱会时，先轻啼小调，再逐渐唱成欢庆的女高音。它最爱在高山之巅起舞，觉得那里最自由，脚步也最轻盈。
author: soup1900
source: To start its personal concert, POKENAME first starts chirping a small tune and slowly works its way up to a festive soprano. It likes to dance atop tall mountains the most, as that's where it feels the most free and light on its feet.

entry: POKENAME低空前行时，用云环绕身体，提供缓冲。受惊时，就将周围的云扩成雾气，掩护逃离。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME surround themselves with clouds to cushion themselves while they travel low to the ground. When they're startled, POKENAME will expand the clouds that surround them into a fog to help them escape.

entry: 高地村民把POKENAME释放的闪亮雾气装瓶，拿到当地集市售卖。据说只要在枕上滴一滴，就会梦见自己飘在群星之间。
author: jaminmcready
source: The shimmering mist released by POKENAME is bottled by highland villagers and sold at local markets. Just a drop on a pillow is said to bring dreams of floating among the stars.

entry: POKENAME能降下极细的毛毛雨，通常不超过5秒。繁殖季节，雨滴会变成粉红色，吸引伴侣。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME create the slightest of drizzles, which are usually no more than 5 seconds. During breeding season, their droplets will become pink to impress a mate.

entry: POKENAME的三颗头，总爱一起唱歌。可想唱得和谐，倒是极难得的事。
author: serversizeme
source: The three heads of POKENAME are often together in song. However, it's a rare occurrence for all of them to harmonize.

entry: POKENAME一到地面就会持续偏头痛，待得越久，痛得越厉害。在天上能缓解头痛，所以常见它睡在云间。
author: bigoljax
source: Whenever on the ground, POKENAME has a constant migraine that becomes more painful as time goes on. Being in the skies soothes these migraines, which is why they're commonly seen sleeping amongst the clouds.

entry: POKENAME全身覆着绒毛般的物质。鸠羽港有一位女裁缝，会用这些绒毛制作潜水装备。
author: .izik
source: A wool-like substance covers its body. There is a seamstress in Hutber Port that utilizes the fluff from an POKENAME to create scuba gear.

entry: 它在威风的脚掌下形成云状软垫，就能在天空奔跑。每天清晨，天使般的歌声乘风传遍山谷，被视为祝福。住在POKENAME附近，被认为是鸿运的象征。
author: fiordaliso
source: It can run across the sky by forming cloud-like cushions beneath its majestic paws. Each morning, it fills the valleys with its angelic song carried by the wind, believed to be a blessing. Living near POKENAME is considered a sign of great fortune.

entry: 它在威风的脚掌下形成云状软垫，就能在天空奔跑。每天清晨，天使般的歌声乘风传遍山谷，被视为祝福。住在POKENAME附近，被认为是鸿运的象征。
author: fiordaliso
source: It can run across the sky by forming cloud-like cushions beneath its majestic paws. Each morning, it fills the valleys with its angelic song carried by the wind, believed to be a blessing. Living near POKENAME is considered a sign of great fortune.

entry: 它在脚掌下形成柔软的云，自由驰骋天空。每天清晨，天使般的歌声随微风流过山谷，据说能带来祝福。住在POKENAME附近的人，被认为格外受命运眷顾。
author: fiordaliso
source: By forming soft clouds beneath its paws, it races freely across the sky. Each morning, its angelic song flows through the valleys on the breeze, believed to bring blessings. Those who live near POKENAME are thought to be especially favored by fate.

entry: POKENAME柔软翅膀的形状，让它能融入多云天空，尾焰也常被误认为阳光。它高声歌唱，警告其他生物领地所在；谁敢无视，就会遭到攻击。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME can blend into a cloudy sky thanks to the shape of its soft wings, and its tail flames are often mistaken for sunlight. It warns others about its territory by singing loudly and attacks anyone who dares to ignore its vocal warnings.

entry: 一只POKENAME就能操纵方圆两千英里内的所有云朵，借这魔法隐藏自己，躲避捕食者。
author: gurguro
source: A single POKENAME is able to control every cloud within a two thousand mile radius. They use this magic to hide themselves from predators.

entry: POKENAME在高空清洁身体，少有天敌能到那里。它却颇为孩子气，常把清洁抛在一旁，玩起自己造的泡泡。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME clean themselves high in the sky, where few predators can reach them. POKENAME are quite childish and will put off cleaning themselves in order to play with bubbles they make.

entry: POKENAME扎根高空的云里，远离大多数天敌。它喜欢能提供水分的雨云，不过一变成风暴，就会弃云而去。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME root themselves high in the clouds, keeping them out of reach of most predators. They prefer rain clouds due to the moisture they provide, though they will abandon the cloud once it turns into a storm.

entry: POKENAME能为业余运动员充当可移动、可调高低的篮球架，以嘴作篮筐，以叶作篮板。它会浮到贴近地面，让年幼球员练习灌篮。
author: oddwalls
source: POKENAME acts as a portable adjustable basketball hoop for amateur athletes, with its mouth as the hoop and its leaf as the backboard. POKENAME will float close to the ground to allow young players to practice their slam dunk skills.

entry: 飘动的白毛比丝绸更柔软，可若还没取得信任，一摸就会烫手。待在信任的对象身旁时，它会用美妙的女高音轻哼、鸣唱。
author: infinex21
source: Its fluttering white fur is softer than silk and yet is burning hot to the touch if its trust has not been gained. When it is with those it trusts, it hums and cries in a beautiful soprano voice.

entry: POKENAME丰厚的白毛永远温暖，哪怕剪下或蜕落也一样；还可升到明火般的高温，驱退威胁。它虽然群居，却因各自放出的热量，极少紧挨着聚集。
author: infinex21
source: A POKENAME's lush, white fur is always warm, even when sheared or shed, but can achieve the heat of an active flame to ward off threats. Although POKENAME live in herds, they rarely group up closely due to their own emitted heat.

entry: POKENAME一边梳理蓬松白羽，一边唱起三声部和声。若有一个头烦躁，就会故意跑调，打乱另外两个头。
author: mochauspocus
source: POKENAME sings in three-part harmony as it preens its fluffy white feathers. When one of its heads is agitated, it sings discordantly to disrupt the other two.

entry: POKENAME背炮涌出的棉絮状泡沫，是传统隔热材料的可持续替代品。新房施工时，常请它来到现场，直接给墙壁填上隔热层。
author: oddwalls
source: The cottony foam that pours from the cannons on POKENAME's back provides a sustainable alternative to traditional insulation materials. New home builds regularly have POKENAME on-site to insulate walls on the spot.

entry: POKENAME全身覆着一层轻盈气泡，能浮在水中。爪子的威力比外表看着大得多，单凭握力就能捏碎石头。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's body is coated in a layer of airy bubbles which allow it to float in the water. Its claws are deceptively powerful, strong enough to shatter stone from its grip strength alone.

entry: POKENAME住在水边，时不时入水、出水，让黏滑身体保持舒适湿润。受到威胁时，会产生黏液，一接触空气就迅速变硬。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME live close to the water's edge, dipping in and out periodically to keep their slimy bodies comfortably damp. When threatened they produce a sticky mucus that rapidly hardens on contact with the air.

entry: POKENAME十分依恋随身的骨头。它把身上的黏液涂上去，防止被夺走；黏液将骨头牢牢黏住，很难强行从它手中拔出。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME gets strongly attached to the bone it carries around. It coats it with the goop from its body to deter others from taking it, the mucus leaving it strongly tethered and difficult to forcefully remove from its grip.

entry: POKENAME睡在祖先遗骸周围，与其他宝可梦隔绝，等待进化。巢穴肮脏无比，任何生物若毫无防备地进去，都会有危险。
author: npshi
source: POKENAME sleep around the remains of their ancestors, isolating themselves from other Pokémon while they wait for Evolution. The nests POKENAME reside in are extremely filthy, making it a hazard for anyone to enter without precautions.

entry: POKENAME体内分泌的黏液，略带酸性，黏得出奇，十分难洗掉。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME produces a viscous slime from inside its body. The slime is slightly acidic and incredibly hard to wash off.

entry: POKENAME用黏液将自己固定在潮间带岩池中，海水定期更替，让身体保持湿润。它几乎不能移动，得靠藏身避人，安然等到进化。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME anchor themselves within tidal rock pools using sticky mucus, remaining hydrated thanks to the regular refreshing of the sea waters. They are largely immobile and rely on hiding out of sight to stay safe long enough to evolve.

entry: POKENAME的蛋像软糖一样柔软有嚼劲，也很有营养。因此，商店将其作为健康零食，卖给正在长身体、爱吃甜食的孩子，大受欢迎。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME eggs are soft and chewy, like gummi candies. They're quite nutritious as well, so they've become very popular in stores as a healthy treat marketed towards growing, sweets-loving children.

entry: POKENAME不停从身上分泌黏液，抵御身体攻击，免受伤害。它能在黏液干燥变硬时将其塑形，做成临时翅膀，用来飞行。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME constantly secrete a sticky mucus from their bodies to protect themselves from harm, using it to ward off physical blows. They can shape this mucus as it hardens and dries, making temporary wings that they use to fly.

entry: POKENAME立方体般的身体，边缘会渗出绿色黏液。人们曾试验将它作为天然散热材料，用于过热的系统。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's cube-like body seeps green slime from its edges. This substance has been tested as a natural heat sink for overheating systems.

entry: POKENAME身上每颗绿球都会渗出腐蚀性黏液，它将其涂遍鳞片，抵御天敌。自身不受黏液伤害，却会避开水，因为入水后黏液的效力会减弱。
author: .izik
source: Each green orb on its body leaks a corrosive slime that POKENAME rubs all over its scales to keep itself safe from predators. It is immune to its own slime but avoids water, where it loses potency.

entry: POKENAME平时会玩自己富有弹性、可塑形的黏液。黏液还能按不同需求改变性质，甚至变得可以食用。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME normally play with their bouncy and malleable goo. The goo itself can be altered to serve different needs and can even become edible.

entry: POKENAME爱与训练家玩捉迷藏，躲的位置总有巧思。可一路留下的黏液，又让它轻易被找着。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME loves to play hide-and-seek with its Trainer. Although the trail of goo it leaves behind makes it easy to find, it has creative hiding spots.

entry: 它们群居生活，彼此保湿、降温，用体液交流。可体液不能用得太多，否则自己就会干掉。
author: soup1900
source: They live in groups to keep each other moist and cool. It uses its bodily fluids to communicate, but it can't use too much of it or it'll dry up.

entry: POKENAME是种不太讨喜的融合体，飞行时分泌的黏稠物会四处飞溅。这身胶质羽毛，比起黏糊，更多的是弹性。
author: blake
source: POKENAME is a fusion that is largely disliked because it secretes a gloop that spreads wildly as it flies. This gelatinous plume is more elastic than gloopy.

entry: 这位能吸水的垂钓者，全身覆着滑溜溜的液体，能轻松挡下各类攻击。它在脸颊与触角产生发光物质，为深海中的其他生物引路。
author: evilgammon
source: This absorbent angler is covered in a slick fluid which allows it to shrug off all sorts of attacks. It produces a luminous substance in its cheeks and antennae to guide others in the deep sea.

entry: POKENAME体表黏液导电性极强，周围总有微弱电场。它们控制不精，常一激动想亲热，就电到训练家。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Coated in highly conductive slime, POKENAME are constantly surrounded by weak electrical fields. They lack fine control over these fields and often shock their Trainers in their eagerness to show affection.

entry: POKENAME虽然喜欢被摸，顺着它的心意时也得小心。黏糊糊的外层带着微弱电流，接触太久会让身体发麻。
author: sk372
source: Though POKENAME loves to be pet, caution must be taken for those that indulge it; its gooey coat contains faint traces of electricity that will cause numbness with prolonged contact.

entry: 它以抓得黏牢闻名，极少肯松开手中的物品；看到可以偷的金色凰梨果，便是少数例外之一。不论正在干什么，它都会停下来，凑近看看那闪亮的树果。
author: quackquackattack
source: Known for its sticky grip, one of the few known instances where it loosens its slimy grip on an item is when it spots a Golden Pinap Berry to steal. It will stop whatever it is doing to get a closer look at the shiny berry.

entry: POKENAME住在泥沼，无忧无虑地在烂泥里打滚。它不擅长判断身边状况，所以常得靠滑溜外膜，逃脱天敌的追捕。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME lives in muddy swamps, carefreely rolling around in the muck. Its slick membrane helps it escape from predators: as POKENAME is not good at processing its immediate surroundings, this use case is not uncommon.

entry: POKENAME许多方面都傻乎乎的，判断将至的天气却很在行。许多宝可梦还没准备好应对热浪，它就已找到安全凉爽处，歇下来避暑。
author: bobosmith01
source: Although dim-witted in many aspects, POKENAME has an excellent sense in terms of determining approaching weather. Before many Pokémon are even prepared for a heat wave, POKENAME has already found a safe place to cool off and rest.

entry: POKENAME的器官全紧挤在小小身体内。食物中的脂肪则全流向尾上长出的巨大肥厚诱饵，因此紧要关头总有储备能量可用。
author: kiwiarms
source: All of POKENAME'S organs are packed tightly into its tiny body. All the fat from food it eats goes straight to the enormous blubbery decoy sprouting from its tail, meaning it always has reserves of energy in a pinch.

entry: POKENAME的羽毛覆着厚厚黏液。虽然不利于飞行，却能抵御环境侵害，避免尖刺、树枝伤到身体。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have a thick coating of mucus across their feathers. Whilst this makes them less competent at flying, the layer offers protection against the environment and prevents damage from sharp thorns and branches.

entry: POKENAME感到威胁时，会喷出满是细菌与微生物的黏稠物。只要碰到，就会生一场重病。
author: dodoowner_
source: If POKENAME feels threatened, it will shoot out a goo filled with bacteria and microbes. If you come in contact with this substance, you will become severely sick.

entry: POKENAME的黏液与它榨出的树果汁混合，形成始终冒泡的饮料。持续气泡加上酸涩滋味，让这种果汁颇受部分人欢迎。
author: sk372
source: The slime POKENAME generates mixes with the berries it juices to create a berry juice that is perpetually fizzy. The drink is somewhat popular for that attribute as well as its tart and sour flavor.

entry: POKENAME常犯些小罪，在附近偷摸毫无防备者的口袋。不过，碰过的东西全会留下黏痕，所以这些恶作剧往往逃不过追究。
author: krogens
source: POKENAME has a tendency to commit petty crimes and pickpocket unsuspecting people in their vicinity. However, due to the sticky residue they leave on everything they touch, they don't often get away with their mischief.

entry: POKENAME喜欢把香甜多汁的蜂蜜，涂遍黏糊糊的全身。平时没能舀起吃掉的部分，之后也会慢慢被身体吸收。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME loves to smear sweet, succulent honey all across its gooey body. Whatever it isn't able to scoop up and consume normally will be absorbed into its body over time.

entry: POKENAME是最弱小的龙属性宝可梦之一，靠高温、满是病菌的黏液驱赶天敌。不过，黏液温度近似岩浆，病菌根本活不下来。
author: starmanmatt
source: Despite being one of the weakest Dragon-type Pokémon, POKENAME uses its high temperature disease-riddled mucus to ward off predators. But, due to its mucus having a similar heat to magma, its germs can't survive.

entry: POKENAME把浓痰吐在树上，冷却后数秒就变硬。这种物质夜间发光，闻起来像腐烂水果，向其他生物标明领地。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spits a thick phlegm onto trees that hardens within seconds as it cools. This substance glows at night and smells of rotting fruit, marking its territory from others.

entry: POKENAME没有鼻子，改用头上的角感知气味。虽不如小山猪的鼻子灵，水下却很好用。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME does not have a nose, so the horns on its head act as smell receptors instead. They're not as effective as a Swinub's nose, though they work well underwater.

entry: POKENAME性情十分温顺，常让水宝可梦靠近，吃背上分泌的黏液。
author: novellavaria
source: POKENAME is a very docile Pokémon. It is often spotted letting Water types eat the slime that's produced on its back.

entry: POKENAME善用天生弹性，能将嘴扩张到惊人的大小。不但能吞下格外庞大的猎物，也能喷射巨大、强劲的水流。
author: deniablecredibility
source: POKENAME makes excellent use of its natural elasticity by being able to expand its mouth to truly remarkable proportions. This allows it to not only swallow exceptionally large prey but also to fire extremely large and forceful blasts of water.

entry: POKENAME弱小胆怯，一受惊便翻倒装死。即使被翻正，也会再翻回去，坚决把戏演到底。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME is weak and timid, flopping over to play dead when frightened. If turned the right way up, it simply flops over again, fully committed to its ruse.

entry: POKENAME会提醒电脑用户：资料正在泄漏，不久还会损坏。许多人选择无视，因而丢失珍贵的文件与照片。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME warn PC users that a data leak is occurring and that data corruption is to come shortly thereafter. Many users choose to ignore POKENAME, leading to many users losing precious documents and photos.

entry: POKENAME会提醒电脑用户：资料正在泄漏，不久还会损坏。许多人选择无视，因而丢失珍贵的文件与照片。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME warn PC users that a data leak is occurring and that data corruption is to come shortly thereafter. Many users choose to ignore POKENAME, leading to many users losing precious documents and photos.

entry: POKENAME释放厚厚的凝胶，帮助电脑散热，避免过热。即使用得太多，也很容易擦掉。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME protect PCs from overheating by releasing a thick gel that acts like a heat sink. This gel is easily wiped off if they end up using too much.

entry: POKENAME奇怪地痴迷于画凤王。不过，受限于圆形视野，怎么也画不准形状。
author: theaceofhearts0306
source: POKENAME have an odd obsession with painting Ho-oh. However, due to their restricted circular vision, they can never quite get the shape right.

entry: 它把酸性黏液吐到青金石上，将其溶成糊后吃下。这让鳞片泛起灿烂的蓝色光泽。
author: .izik
source: It spits its acidic goo onto lapis lazuli to dissolve it into a paste before consuming it. This process makes its scales shimmer with a brilliant blue hue.

entry: POKENAME身上覆着黏膜，容易失去平衡、摔倒。为了不干掉，喜欢黎明时坐在户外，吸取晨露。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME's have a tendency to lose their balance and fall due to the slimy membrane covering their bodies. To keep themselves from drying out, POKENAME enjoy sitting outside at dawn to soak in the morning dew.

entry: POKENAME常沿黏液轨迹滑行，因而练出极佳平衡感。许多个体已学会利用滑润黏液，在战斗中快速移动。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME has excellent balance because it spends its time sliding on trails of mucus. Many POKENAME have learned to harness this slick mucous to move quickly in battle.

entry: POKENAME最爱下雨，身上的细鳞会吸收水分，再把水变成黏稠液体。
author: clawshdi
source: POKENAME love the rain. They soak up moisture through the small scales on their body, later transforming that liquid into a slimy substance.

entry: 它们的身体几乎全是脂肪与肌肉，因此结实得惊人，在泥泞沼泽中也能像在水里一样游动。
author: ocxin
source: Their bodies consist almost entirely of fat and muscle. As a result, they are astoundingly durable and can swim through muddy marshes like they're in water.

entry: POKENAME与周围世界嬉戏时，会把独特的虹彩黏液涂得到处都是。一窝窝这样无力自保的幼崽，都受父母奋力保护。
author: turron_turron
source: As they play with the world around them, POKENAME cover their surroundings in a unique iridescent mucous. Litters of these helpless POKENAME are fiercely protected by their parents.

entry: 身上滴下的黏液极滑。它让金属身体在凝胶中打滚，打磨得闪亮，常因此招来天敌；对方追赶时，却会滑倒。
author: .izik
source: The goo that drips from its body is extremely slippery. It rolls its metallic body in the gel to make itself shiny, often attracting predators that slip when pursuing it.

entry: POKENAME的身体由黏稠灵质组成，走到哪里都滴得到处都是。被它缠上的建筑，每个表面都会覆满黏液。
author: bostroms
source: POKENAME's body is composed of a viscous ectoplasm that drips everywhere. A building haunted by POKENAME will have this slime covering every surface.

entry: 它从沙丘里跃出扑向猎物，发射翡翠色黏液团，拖慢敌人。涂上黏液的沙子干燥后，会硬化为保护壳。
author: .izik
source: It leaps out of sand dunes to pounce on prey, firing globs of emerald-colored slime to slow foes. The sand it coats in slime hardens into a protective shell when dry.

entry: POKENAME的触手分泌黏液，让被它抓住的生物难以逃脱。人们发现黏液具有抗菌作用，成了许多家用洗洁精的重要原料。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME's tentacles secrete a sticky slime, making its grip very hard to escape from. This slime has been discovered to have antibacterial qualities, making it a vital ingredient in the creation of many household dish soaps.

entry: POKENAME用头撞击时，果冻般的圆顶会破开，黏稠物洒向周围，让对手无法动弹。黏液球顶很快再生，确保头骨始终受到保护。
author: sk372
source: When POKENAME headbutts something, the gelatinous dome bursts and spreads an immobilizing goop all around it. The slimy bulb regenerates shortly, ensuring its skull is always protected.

entry: POKENAME很想打架，奈何身体黏软脆弱，几乎维持不住，只好折中，专挑湿淋淋的宝可梦交手。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME wants to fight, but can barely contain its weak, slimy composition. It compromises by exclusively fighting wet Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME的刃缘虽钝，却意外擅长用黏液挡开攻击。挨打时，黏液帮助缓和冲击，或将攻击引离要害。
author: musicsheep.
source: Its edge is dull, but POKENAME is surprisingly good at deflecting strikes by using its slime. When struck, the slime helps soften blows or redirect attacks away from vital areas.

entry: POKENAME能随意软化、硬化黏液，既可缓冲攻击，也可割伤对手。不过，硬化后也会像玻璃一样，很容易碎裂。
author: musicsheep.
source: POKENAME can harden and soften the slime at will, allowing it to soften blows and cut up opponents. However, when hardened, the slime can very easily shatter apart like glass.

entry: POKENAME用触须抹开自身黏液，让身体在干燥天气也能保持湿润。黏液摸起来凉凉的，却含有许多可能危害其他生物的病菌。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME use their feelers to help spread out their own mucus, which helps them to remain hydrated even during dry weather. Though this mucus is cool to the touch, it contains many germs that could be harmful to others.

entry: POKENAME伸展诡异翅膀、发出骇人哀号，努力震慑其他生物，给对方留下深刻印象。过去人们以为，碰到柔软身体会致命；其实最严重也只会轻微发麻。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME make great efforts to impress and intimidate others by stretching their eerie wings and letting out a horrid wail. It was once thought POKENAME's squishy body was lethal to touch, but it only causes a slight numbing sensation at worst.

entry: POKENAME身体大多柔软黏稠，却能缩进坚硬金属壳里自保。若仍被纠缠，就会伸出金属爪，劈向攻击者。
author: .jerden
source: Most of POKENAME's body is soft and gooey, but it can retract inside a hard metal shell for protection. If anything continues to bother it, it will extend its metal claws to slash at its attacker.

entry: 它用腹部产生的黏液困住猎物，也用这黏合剂将蛋黏牢，背在背上携带。
author: cait_sith
source: It traps prey using the sticky goo produced from its abdomen. This goo also doubles as an adhesive for its Eggs so it can carry them on its back.

entry: POKENAME的火焰看似是真火，其实由胶质黏液构成。它能将其加热，灼烧来犯者自卫，不过自己的身体也会因此开始融化。
author: sk372
source: Though it has the appearance of fire, POKENAME's flame is made of a gelatinous, slimy substance. It can heat it up to high temperatures to burn others in self-defense, though this causes its own body to begin melting.

entry: POKENAME分泌的易燃油很适合烹饪与取暖，最长能连续燃烧一周。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's body secretes a flammable oil that is very useful in cooking and heating. The oil can burn for up to a week without interruption.

entry: POKENAME全身覆着黏液，大多住在潮湿处，避免干燥。身体唯一坚硬的部位是锋利长牙，能以强大力道与速度挥击。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME is covered with slime and mostly lives in damp places to avoid drying out. The only hard parts of its body are its sharp tusks, which it can swing around with great power and speed.

entry: 皮肤质地像布丁，一碰就颤悠悠地晃动。它先向洞中的岩石构造吐出绿色酸液，再吃下去，留下闪亮痕迹。
author: .izik
source: Its skin has a texture similar to pudding, jiggling when touched. It spits green acid on cave formations before eating them, leaving behind sparkling marks.

entry: POKENAME的尾巴产生黏稠附着性强的黏液，用来涂遍全身。黏液帮助调温，遇到高热会起反应，安全散去热量，同时仍保持液态。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME tails produce a clingy, viscous mucus that they use to coat their entire body. The mucus helps to regulate their temperature, reacting to disperse intense heat harmlessly whilst still remaining fluid.

entry: POKENAME体型虽小，身体却很结实，头部撞击也颇具威力。它对训练家无比忠诚，无论奉命面对什么敌人，都会迎战。
author: .jerden
source: Despite its small size, POKENAME's body is durable, and its head can strike with great force. It will be incredibly loyal to its Trainer, fighting against any foe it is commanded to.

entry: POKENAME住在浑浊的泥沼，将凝胶身体压入泥下，静候猎物。随后鼓起身体，从藏处弹出，伸展双颚，整只吞下。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME dwell within murky bogs, squishing their gelatinous bodies beneath the mire to lie in wait for prey. They puff up their bodies to launch themselves from their hiding spots, extending their jaws to swallow their prey whole.

entry: POKENAME用凝固的黏液造出头盔，保护自己跳崖试飞。好在身体像凝胶，角度偏了也能缓冲撞击。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME create a protective helmet out of solidified mucus to help protect them as they launch off of cliffs in attempts to fly. Luckily, their bodies are rather gelatinous, helping them to cushion the blow if their angle is off.

entry: POKENAME全身覆着厚厚黏液，免受身体伤害。强烈体热让黏液保持液态；有些个体的腿部，也会被这些黏液妨碍。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are coated in a thick layer of mucus, protecting their bodies from physical harm. This mucus is kept liquid by an intense internal body heat and, for some POKENAME, can result in their legs being impeded by the slime.

entry: 下过雨后，POKENAME喜欢在水洼里扑腾。玩够便甩干身体，也将多余黏液甩出，帮助植物生长。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME enjoy splashing around in puddles after rainy days. They shake themselves dry once they're done, releasing excess slime from their bodies that helps plants grow.

entry: POKENAME不能自行发电，雷雨时就坐在树梢，收集雷击的电能。尖刺般的毛发，黏得像树汁。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME cannot generate its own electricity, so during stormy weather it sits in treetops and gathers electrical energy from lightning strikes. Its spiky fur is as sticky as tree sap.

entry: 长牙渗出的黏液闻起来像西梨果，曾被用来涂贝果。黏糊的身体让它能在逃避天敌时，牢牢贴住树木。
author: .izik
source: The slime it leaks from its tusks smells like Wepear Berries and has been used as a spread for bagels. Its gooey nature helps it cling to trees when escaping predators.

entry: 许多POKENAME会出现在墓中，用绿色黏液修补陶器。黏合力极强，修好的古物也像新的一样结实。
author: .izik
source: Many POKENAME are found in tombs using their sticky green slime to repair pottery. Their slime is so strong that restored artifacts are as durable as new.

entry: POKENAME总是旋转不停，周身黏膜也厚实坚韧，足以承受。黏性的保护层让它能贴在墙上，行动十分灵活。
author: creaturecore
source: The slimy membrane surrounding POKENAME is thick and sturdy to accommodate its constant whirling about. It can stick to walls because of its tacky protection, giving it great maneuverability.

entry: 它挥舞浓稠黏液做的绒球，为伙伴加油。也能产生微弱电流，保护自己。
author: hophoppip
source: It cheers on its allies by waving pom-poms made from thick mucus. It can generate a weak electric charge to defend itself.

entry: 这只宝可梦用含有病菌的黏滑外膜保湿，在栖居水域附近的沙地上蹦跳。这层外膜也让想拿POKENAME当点心的天敌，很难下口。
author: chiari_queen
source: This Pokémon uses its slimy, germ-laden mucous membrane to retain moisture, allowing it to bounce along the sand near the waters where it resides. Additionally, this same membrane makes POKENAME very unpleasant to any predator looking for a snack.

entry: 构成POKENAME大半身体的黏液，毒性令人难受，还略带酸性。它知道少有生物受得了待在身边，便独居深林，接受孤独的生活。
author: sk372
source: The slime comprising most of POKENAME's body is painfully noxious and even slightly acidic. Knowing that few can stand to be near it, it isolates itself deep within forests and accepts its lonely existence.

entry: 双翼由颊囊分泌的黏性物质构成。食谱一不合适，就会飞不起来，因此饲养费用相当高。
author: staghorn
source: Its wings are made up of slime and mucus secreted from its cheek pouches. Feeding it the wrong diet will make it unable to fly, so it's a rather expensive Pokémon to take care of.

entry: POKENAME把危险又恶臭的黏液涂遍全身，驱赶天敌。只要有生物陷进它留下的黏液轨迹，它就能感知，主要以此捕猎。
author: npshi
source: POKENAME cover their bodies with a dangerous, stinky mucus that deters predators. POKENAME can sense when anyone falls into their gooey trail, which they mainly use to hunt prey.

entry: POKENAME用头刺上覆盖的黏膜，从水中吸取养分。它喜爱太阳珊瑚，可长得像好坏星，常让想结交的太阳珊瑚吓得逃跑。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME absorbs nutrients from the water via gooey membranes coating its head spikes. It has an affinity towards Corsola, but its similar appearance to Mareanie often causes the Corsola it tries to befriend to run away.

entry: POKENAME的身体由细沙组成，外覆一层黏膜。头上的铲子很难拔下，谁拔走，它就会不断攻击，直到铲子归还。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME's body is made up of fine granules of sand covered in a layer of gooey membrane. The shovel atop POKENAME's head is difficult to remove and doing so causes it to attack the offender until the shovel is returned.

entry: POKENAME背上的蘑菇渗出绿色糖浆，气味腐臭。煮过后，可用作润喉糖的有效成分。
author: .izik
source: The mushrooms on POKENAME's back leak a green syrup that is putrid in scent. When boiled, it can serve as an active ingredient in throat lozenges.

entry: POKENAME的舌头分泌浓稠唾液。这些黏滑、附着力强的物质，慢慢软化岩石与骨头，让它们更好入口，也更容易吃下。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME secrete a thick saliva from their tongue. This adhesive, slimy substance slowly softens rocks and bones, making them more palatable and easier for POKENAME to eat.

entry: POKENAME蘑菇流出的液体闻起来像瓜西果，曾被用来烘焙甜点。清爽滋味多年来都是庆典料理的常客，不过热量很高，应当少量食用。
author: .izik
source: The fluid flowing from POKENAME's mushroom smells like Watmel Berries and has been used in baked treats. Its refreshing flavor has been a staple of festival cuisine for years, though it should be eaten in small amounts due to its high calorie count.

entry: POKENAME感到威胁时，黏滑的头鳞会散发可怕恶臭。全身黏糊，很难被抓牢或关住。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's slimy head scale emits a terrible stench when it feels threatened. Its gooey body makes it difficult to grapple or contain.

entry: POKENAME全身柔软，连保护鳞片也像橡胶，毫不坚硬。攻击因此常被弹开，让它有机会挥动肌肉发达的手臂，强力反击。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's entire body is soft, and even its protective scales are rubbery rather than hard. This means that attacks frequently bounce off it, giving POKENAME the opportunity to counterattack with powerful swings of its muscular arms.

entry: POKENAME靠覆身鳞片，保护柔软身体免遭攻击。它看着不强，却能打出强劲上勾拳，常让靠得太近的宝可梦吃一惊。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME relies on the scales covering it to protect its soft body from attack. Although it doesn't seem strong, it can deliver powerful uppercuts, often surprising other Pokémon that get too close.

entry: POKENAME背部的特殊腺体，不断分泌黏液。它梳整、塑出翅膀，长距离滑翔，寻找食物。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME produce a steady supply of mucus from specialised glands on their backs. They groom and shape their mucus into wings, allowing them to glide across great distances in search of food.

entry: POKENAME身体大多由水组成，为了不干掉，极少离水。多数时间浸在池塘里，浮在水面下方。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's body is mostly made of water, so it rarely leaves water to avoid drying out. It spends most of its time submerged in ponds, floating just below the surface.

entry: POKENAME全身覆着薄薄黏液，离水时能防止背叶干燥。不过，它多数时间仍在池塘边的浅水处爬行。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME is covered by a thin layer of slime. This stops the leaf on its back from drying out when it leaves the water, although it still spends most of its time crawling around in the shallow water around the edges of ponds.

entry: POKENAME全身覆着厚厚黏液，免受身体伤害。强烈的体热让黏液保持液态，训练家接触它时，最好格外小心。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are coated in a thick layer of mucus, protecting their bodies from physical harm. This mucus is kept liquid by an intense internal body heat, so it is advised that Trainers take great care when handling POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME全身覆着浓稠黏液，很难与它直接接触。黏液一碰就烫，毫无防备的人可能被严重灼伤。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have dense and sticky slime covering their bodies, making it hard to make physical contact with them. Their slime is scalding to the touch and can cause nasty burns for the unwary.

entry: 它钻到丛林树木下，用酸性鼻涕溶解树根，再吃下去。留下的黏液滋养土壤，孕育新的生长。
author: .izik
source: It digs beneath jungle trees, using acidic nose drippings to dissolve roots before eating them. The slime left behind nurtures the soil for new growth.

entry: POKENAME住在温暖海域，因人们相信它一吻就能治好任何伤势，而备受追寻。研究表明，它的黏液能促进组织再生，加快开放伤口凝血。
author: wiz0z
source: In the warm seas where they reside, POKENAME are sought out due to the belief that their kisses can heal any injury. Research has shown that their mucus prompts tissue regeneration and accelerate blood-clotting on open wounds.

entry: 三只鼻子滴落的腐蚀性鼻涕，涂满地道，泛起橄榄色光芒。它用这光吸引昆虫钻进洞穴。
author: .izik
source: The corrosive snot that dribbles from its three noses lines its tunnels, leaving an olive-colored glow. It uses this glow to attract insects into its burrow.

entry: POKENAME酷似洗翠曾有的古老品种，深受卡蒂狗爱好者喜爱。它忠诚又贪玩，是好伙伴，不过可能把家里的地板弄满黏液。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME is loved by Growlithe enthusiasts for its resemblance to a historical breed from Hisui. It makes a loyal and playful companion, though it may leave slime on the floors of your house.

entry: POKENAME的黏液炽热燃烧，足以把沙熔成玻璃。战斗中，它先甩出熔融黏液，再补上一记灼热的火花。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's slime burns hot enough to melt sand into glass. In battle, it flings this molten slime before following up with a searing Ember.

entry: POKENAME生性贪玩，总想找时间和训练家一起跑来跑去。它喜欢凑近、被摸摸，可黏滑的皮肤让许多人却步。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are playful Pokémon, always eager to find time to run around with their Trainer. They enjoy getting up close and being pet, but their slimy skin is off-putting to many.

entry: POKENAME产生的黏液一接触空气，就会迅速变硬，失去柔韧。它利用这特点造出翅膀，让自己飞上天空，行动十分灵便。
author: katieplaysgames
source: When the slime POKENAME produce makes contact with the air, it rapidly stiffens and becomes inflexible. They use this quality of their slime to create wings that enable them to take to the air, offering them excellent mobility.

entry: 它把腐蚀性黏液，吐向猎物，好更容易吃下。也有人拿这种黏液，清理生锈的金属。
author: kittyluv090
source: It spits corrosive slime on its prey, making it easier to eat. Some people use this substance for cleaning rusted metal.

entry: 皮肤覆着薄薄一层既防水又保湿的油，已成为很受欢迎的防晒霜原料。这油似乎有助于它迅速缩进壳中，即使酷热，也能放松歇息。
author: infinex21
source: Its skin is coated in a thin film of a water-repellant yet moisturizing oil, which has become popular in the making of sunscreens. This oil seems to aid it in swiftly withdrawing into its own shell and allows it to relax even in intense heat.

entry: 下午，POKENAME会钻进湖底富含细菌的生物膜层睡觉，只把尖刺留在黏稠物外。尖刺带有强毒，对游泳者可能是个隐患。
author: vic1312
source: In the afternoon, POKENAME burrow into the bacteria-rich mats of biofilm at the lake bottom to sleep. They leave their spikes sticking out of the goopy material. These spikes can be a hazard to people swimming as they pack a potent venom.

entry: POKENAME把黏液聚在颈间，用来隔热。这些黏液，还能帮助入睡。
author: thefinalkalgonus
source: POKENAME collects slime around its neck and uses it as protection against heat. This slime also has properties that facilitate sleep.

entry: POKENAME的骨头覆着带青柠香的黏液，干后黏性极强。它用这物质标记、宣示领地。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's bone is coated in a lime-scented slime that becomes highly adhesive when dry. It uses this substance to mark and claim its territory.

entry: POKENAME在囊袋里生成黏液球，送给喜欢的训练家。黏液常用于高档防晒霜，其实相当值钱。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME produce slimeballs in its pouch that it gives out to Trainers it likes. The slime is actually quite valuable as it is commonly used in high quality sunscreens.

entry: 沉重的壳让它只能沿海底缓缓挪行，寻找食物。浓稠黏液却渐渐侵蚀壳，使其变得相当脆弱。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Its heavy shell forces it to slowly inch across the seafloor while looking for food. Its thick mucus gradually wears away at the shell, leaving it quite brittle.

entry: POKENAME对天气非常敏感，只在雨天出巢。走到哪里，都留下一道黏液，数百年来一直被人们用来保湿。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is very sensitive to the weather, only coming out of its den on rainy days. It leaves behind a trail of slime wherever it goes, which has been used as a form of moisturizer for centuries.

entry: POKENAME会欢欢喜喜地把难闻黏液，蹭到喜欢的人和物品上。气味恶臭，既能天然驱退其他生物，也让它总能找回心爱的东西。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME gleefully rub their repugnant mucous on people and objects they're fond of. The odor is foul enough to serve as a natural repellent while also ensuring POKENAME can always find and return to their favorite things.

entry: POKENAME头部的黏液能溶解许多材料。它先将食物溶化，再经皮肤吸收。高兴时，会散发与先前食物相似的气味。
author: chibitales
source: The goo secreted from POKENAME's head is able to dissolve many materials. It uses this goo to melt food before absorbing it through its skin. When happy, POKENAME produces a smell similar to what it previously ate.

entry: POKENAME叶片滴落的黏液，含有类似肥料的养分，混进土里就能让植物繁茂。用它种出的蔬果，气味与滋味都略带辛辣。
author: chibitales
source: The goo dripping from POKENAME's leaves contains nutrients similar to fertilizer, allowing plants to flourish if it is mixed into the soil. Fruits and vegetables grown using it have a hint of a spicy smell and taste.

entry: POKENAME叶片滴落的黏液，含有类似肥料的养分，混进土里就能让植物繁茂。用它种出的蔬果，气味与滋味都略带辛辣。
author: chibitales
source: The goo dripping from POKENAME's leaves contains nutrients similar to fertilizer, allowing plants to flourish if mixed into the soil. Fruits and vegetables grown using it have a hint of a spicy smell and taste.

entry: POKENAME的两枚诱饵内，装着能发光、能导电的黏稠物。科学家仍在研究这些黏液的用途。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's twin lures are filled with a slimy substance that can glow and conduct electricity. The slime's uses are still being researched by scientists.

entry: POKENAME必须不断发光，才能看清周围。它视力极差，所以饲主整晚都不会关灯。
author: bandedbodypress
source: It has to constantly emit light in order to see its surroundings. It has very poor eyesight, so POKENAME owners keep lights on all night.

entry: POKENAME覆着厚厚的酸性防水黏液，睡着时常沉入栖居的泥滩深处。旱季休眠时，黏液能让它保持湿润。
author: vic1312
source: Sleeping POKENAME will often sink deep into the mud flats they call home due to their thick coating of acidic, water-resistant mucus. In the dry season, this mucus keeps them wet during their hibernation.

entry: POKENAME产生蒸气，经皮肤排出，调节体温。蒸气剧毒，又有难闻气味，因此它非常不讨喜。用肥皂覆住身体，有助于中和蒸气。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: To regulate its body temperature, POKENAME produces a vapour that it expels through its skin. This vapour is highly toxic and carries an unpleasant odour, leading to POKENAME being very unpopular. Covering it in soap helps to neutralise the vapour.

entry: POKENAME已经失去视力，靠胡须与角感知周围。它不断啃咬坚硬岩石，磨短快速生长的牙齿。
author: bluenido.
source: POKENAME lost its ability to see, relying on its whiskers and horns to sense its surroundings. It constantly gnaws on hard rocks to keep its fast-growing teeth worn down.

entry: POKENAME爪上产生胶状毒液，能制服猎物。但毒液太稠，POKENAME有时很难将其注入。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME claws produce a glue-like poison which it uses to incapacitate its prey. However, POKENAME can have difficulty injecting the poison due to its thickness.

entry: 这些可怕宝可梦的身体渗出致命毒液，覆满铁颚。矿工若在地下深处遇见它们，可得小心。
author: mistymagius
source: The bodies of these monstrous Pokémon seep a deadly poison that coats their iron jaws. Miners should be afraid of encountering these Pokémon while mining deep underground.

entry: 在坚硬的壳内，POKENAME把收集来的叶子与树皮，加工成浓稠的胶。遇上天敌，便用胶将其黏在原地，趁机逃走。
author: mistymagius
source: Inside its tough shell, POKENAME produces a thick glue-like paste from the leaves and bark it likes to collect. It uses the glue to stop predators in their tracks, allowing it to escape.

entry: POKENAME的壳由硬化黏液构成，所有器官都藏在其中。它的黏液连纯钢梁也能熔蚀。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME's shell is made out of hardened goo and houses all of its organs. Its mucus can melt pure steel beams.

entry: POKENAME用背上的两条附肢在水下呼吸。这些附肢还能抓取水中浮游生物，供它进食。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME breathes underwater using the two appendages on its back. These appendages are also able to grab onto plankton in the water for consumption.

entry: POKENAME背上绿色卷尾，藏着全部重要器官。尽管很沉，它也必须抬着走，因为拖在地上，会伤到里面的器官。
author: soup1900
source: The green swirly tail on POKENAME's back houses all of its vital organs. It must carry its tail around despite it being very heavy, as dragging it around would cause damage to the organs inside.

entry: POKENAME的金属爪上覆着多种腐蚀物，被抓伤十分危险。它们头脑简单，只想着吃饭与睡觉。
author: mistymagius
source: Its metallic talons are coated with many corrosive chemicals that make POKENAME a dangerous Pokémon to be scratched by. They are simple-minded Pokémon who only desire food and sleep.

entry: POKENAME撞倒障碍，再用象鼻中的腐蚀性酸液将其溶解。它看不见瞄准何处，所以最好远远避开。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME knocks obstacles down and dissolves them with corrosive acid from its trunk. Because they can't see where they're aiming, it's advised to give POKENAME a wide berth.

entry: POKENAME滚动时留下滑黏液，常将追兵弄得晕头转向。它们爱玩，喜欢陪孩子嬉戏，尤其喜欢被揉肚子。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME leave a slippery slime as it rolls that often disorient its pursuers. They are quite playful Pokémon and love to play with children. They especially love belly rubs.

entry: 最好让POKENAME尽可能长久、频繁地待在网络空间。数字世界中，身上滴下的黏液无害；现实世界里，一碰到电子设备与机器，就会迅速将其熔坏。
author: sk372
source: It is best to let POKENAME inhabit cyberspace as long and often as possible. Within the digital world, the slime dripping from its body is harmless, but in the real world it will quickly melt electronics and machinery on contact.

entry: 受到威胁时，POKENAME会吐出强酸，足以把人腐蚀得只剩白骨。有人推测，POKENAME原本可能是某种外星生物的茧。
author: mistymagius
source: When threatened, POKENAME spits a strong acid that is strong enough to melt anyone straight to the bone. Some people have theorized that POKENAME was originally some sort of alien cocoon.

entry: POKENAME覆着冰寒黏液，天气热时会滴落。皮革工匠很珍视这种黏液，用来处理、保藏珍稀兽皮。
author: .izik
source: A freezing slime coats POKENAME's body which drips off on hot days. Leatherworkers prize it for curing and preserving rare hides.

entry: POKENAME柔软的身体能吸进数加仑水，每吸收一升，就更结实。它开心地摇摆前行，寻找水洼喝水，不喝到见底绝不离开。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME's squishy bodies soak up gallons of water, becoming more resilient with each liter absorbed. They happily waddle about in search of puddles to drink from, which they won't leave until the water is completely drained.

entry: POKENAME通常在雨林茂密树冠下，懒洋洋地生活。它有许多驱赶天敌的办法，最出名的便是飞快穿行、留下浓稠黏迹，让对手行动缓慢，累得筋疲力竭。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME typically lives a languid life under the dense canopy of the rainforest. It has many ways to deter predators, but its most known for creating thick gooey trails while it blitzes around the environment, slowing down and tiring out opponents.

entry: POKENAME用体内的热黏液球战斗。研究者则利用黏液的腐蚀性，分解有机物。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME fights using hot slime balls from within its body. Researchers harness the corrosiveness of POKENAME's mucous to break down organic material.

entry: 核事故后，常有这些宝可梦的目击记录。黏软的身体能挤过细缝，因此巢穴也极其狭窄。
author: mistymagius
source: Sightings of these Pokémon are common after nuclear accidents. Their dens are incredibly narrow since their viscous bodies allow them to squeeze through tight gaps.

entry: POKENAME强壮得出人意料。常能见到它在厚厚烂泥里，推动比自己更大的巨石锻炼。
author: ocxin
source: POKENAME are surprisingly strong. They can be seen training themselves by pushing boulders larger than themselves through thick mud.

entry: POKENAME近乎失明，靠感知振动行动。泥中物体的细微震动，让它连复杂形状或移动目标，都能准确描绘。
author: ocxin
source: POKENAME are nearly blind, instead relying on sensing tremors to move around. The fine vibrations of objects in the mud allow them to accurately picture even complex or moving targets.

entry: POKENAME射出舌头，力道如同小火车。食物匮乏时，野生个体会成群洗劫附近城市的水果、蔬菜与糖果。
author: turron_turron
source: POKENAME can propel its tongue with the force of a small train. When food is scarce, groups of wild POKENAME plunder nearby cities of fruits, vegetables, and candy.

entry: POKENAME先积聚大量黏液，再猛然喷出，将自己向前推出，在空中前进。留下的黏液一段时间内酸性很强，应当等其性质稳定些，再去接触。
author: sk372
