source: POKENAME propels itself through the air by amassing and then releasing large amounts of slime to jettison it forward. The slime left behind is highly acidic for a time and should be left alone until it becomes less volatile.

entry: 有人推测POKENAME来自天外。双臂喷出的绿色酸液，几乎能熔掉一切。灵敏的触角还能感知50英尺外的其他生物。
author: mistymagius
source: Theorized to be an extra-terrestrial being, POKENAME fires an acidic green liquid from its arms that can melt just about anything. Its sensitive antennae are able to sense other creatures over 50 feet away.

entry: POKENAME用分泌的腐蚀性黏液，在坚岩中溶出洞来。它藏进这些小缝隙，再跃出伏击任何靠近的生物。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME uses the corrosive mucus it secretes to dissolve holes in solid rock. POKENAME will hide within these small crevices, then leap out to ambush anything that approaches.

entry: POKENAME以强酸溶穿坚岩，寻找稀有矿物为食。它们极其好斗，谁来打扰，就想咬谁。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME uses a strong acid to melt through solid rock in search of rare minerals to eat. They are very aggressive Pokémon and will attempt to bite anyone who disturbs them.

entry: POKENAME视力差，长触角却能借声音与气味，感知周围。它靠这本领，在漆黑地道中捕猎。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's eyesight is poor, but its long antenna gives it the ability to sense its surroundings through sound and smell. It uses this to hunt for prey in pitch-black underground tunnels.

entry: POKENAME视力差，长触角却能借声音与气味，感知周围。它靠这本领，在漆黑地道中捕猎。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's eyesight is poor, but its long antenna gives it the ability to sense its surroundings through sound and smell. It uses this to hunt for prey in pitch-black underground tunnels.

entry: POKENAME滴落的膜状物能侵蚀触碰者的心智。受害者会暂时视它为神圣存在，不过效力只持续一天便消退。
author: .izik
source: The film dripping from POKENAME can corrupt the minds of those who touch it. Victims briefly believe it to be divine, though the effect fades after a single day.

entry: POKENAME对外界温度十分敏感，寒冷月份会冬眠。春天到来，便能看见它用富含养分的黏液，帮助植物生长。
author: mepp.
source: As POKENAME is highly sensitive to external temperatures, it hibernates through the colder months. When spring arrives, it is seen helping plants grow with its nutrient-rich mucus.

entry: POKENAME头盔般的壳比铁还硬。壳上覆着滑溜的毒物，一接触就会起疹子。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's helmet-like shell is harder than iron. The shell is coated in a slick poison that causes rashes on contact.

entry: POKENAME缎带般的器官分泌黏液，能让接触者平静下来。许多药剂，甚至部分麻醉药，都用它作原料。
author: infinex21
source: The slime secreted from its ribbon-like organs has a calming effect on those it touches. POKENAME's slime is used in many remedies and even in some anesthetics.

entry: POKENAME能从背炮向敌人喷射高压黏液。不仅冲击力强，黏液中的酶还会慢慢溶解一切，唯独它自己的金属铠甲例外。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME can fire high-pressure slime at foes from the cannon on its back. In addition to striking with great physical force, enzymes within this slime will slowly dissolve anything except POKENAME's own metal armor.

entry: 它潜行于失落文明的遗迹，以腐蚀性黏液侵蚀纪念建筑。浓密丛林的湿雾，携带着它有感染性的孢子。
author: ozydamians
source: It skulks around the ruins of fallen civilizations, eroding monuments with its corrosive goo. The humid mists of dense jungles carry its infectious spores.

entry: POKENAME的身体由有毒、腐蚀性的黏液组成。它快速挥拳，将黏液附在拳上，一边震晕猎物，一边将其溶解。
author: bacondlx
source: The body of POKENAME is made up of a toxic, caustic mucus. It throws rapid punches imbued with this mucus to simultaneously stun and dissolve its prey.

entry: POKENAME的刃与尾巴滴着绿色黏液。被这些天生武器击中的目标，都会被消化酶慢慢溶解。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's blades and tail drip with sticky green mucus. Anything it strikes with these natural weapons will slowly be dissolved by its digestive enzymes.

entry: POKENAME身上的木夹固定着柔软的身体，免得散开。绿色黏液性质似油，有人推测它能成为极佳的能源。
author: mistymagius
source: The wooden clamps on POKENAME's body keep its soft body from falling apart. The green slime it produces acts similar to oil and is theorized to be an amazing energy source.

entry: POKENAME体表覆着橡胶般的物质，抵抗物理攻击的本领出奇强。胶层难吃的味道，也让其他宝可梦不愿攻击。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's body is coated in a rubber-like substance that is oddly resistant to physical attacks. The unpleasant taste of the rubber discourages other Pokémon from attacking it.

entry: POKENAME有三个强劲的头，几乎什么都能毁掉。好在它安静又爱好和平。
author: prof.whitebeam
source: POKENAME has three powerful heads that can destroy almost anything. Fortunately, this Pokémon is very quiet and peaceful.

entry: POKENAME的毛覆着厚厚黏液，帮助它免受伤害。黏液由颈部特殊腺体分泌，再用尾巴涂遍身体。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME fur is coated in a thick layer of mucus that helps to protect them from harm. They secrete the mucus from special glands along their neck and use their tails to coat their body in it.

entry: 深洞生活让POKENAME视力不佳，总拿头撞到周围的东西。好在身体柔软，不易受物理损伤。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME has poor eyesight due to living in deep cave systems, which is why it will constantly headbutt its surroundings. Luckily, its soft body is resistant to physical injury.

entry: POKENAME的壳由大囊构成，里面装着酸性黏液。一被刺破，就会喷出。它们几乎不离开巢穴，耐心等待进化。
author: mistymagius
source: The large sacs that make up POKENAME's shell are filled with an acidic slime which sprays out if these sacs are punctured. They almost never move from their dens, waiting patiently for evolution.

entry: 獠牙上覆着强酸性的绿色黏液，让POKENAME几乎无物不切。哪怕只是轻轻擦过，也可能危及生命。
author: mistymagius
source: The green slime that coats its tusks is extremely acidic. This allows for POKENAME to slice through basically anything. Even the slightest graze from these tusks can be life-threatening.

entry: POKENAME靠黏软的身体附在洞壁。虽然没牙，仍会咬住猎物，用腐蚀性唾液将其溶化，再由POKENAME吸食干净。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME sticks itself to cave walls using its gooey body. Despite its lack of teeth, it will bite into its prey, using its corrosive saliva to melt them until POKENAME can slurp them up.

entry: 它看不见，靠极其灵敏的触角感知猎物。不捕猎时，便在触角上覆满保护黏液。
author: bandedbodypress
source: It is blind, so it uses its hypersensitive antennae to sense prey. When it's not hunting, it coats them with protective mucus.

entry: POKENAME颈边的泡沫黏性极强，连最大的宝可梦也能当场黏住。它们十分友善，喜欢得到人类的疼爱。
author: mistymagius
source: The foam around POKENAME's neck is extremely sticky and can stop even the largest of Pokémon in their tracks. They are very friendly and adore human affection.

entry: POKENAME的花滴着恶臭污液。自卫时，它摇动身体，将污液喷向敌人。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's flower drips with a horrid-smelling gunk. To defend itself, it shakes its body to spray the gunk at enemies.

entry: 它们淘气又爱耍花招，用翼上黏液迷惑敌人、拖慢动作，甚至遮住视线。滑溜的身体，也让它们轻松逃离天敌。
author: mistymagius
source: These mischievous Pokémon like to play dirty, using the slime on their wings to disorient, slow down, or even blind their opponents. Their slippery bodies allow them to escape predators with ease.

entry: POKENAME背上的生长物，能控制黏液产量。若被强行取下，多余酸液便开始外泄，灼伤、损坏一切碰到的东西。
author: sk372
source: The growths on POKENAME's back serve to keep its slime production in check. Should they be forcibly removed, POKENAME will begin leaking the excess acidic slime, burning and damaging anything that comes in contact with the goop.

entry: POKENAME常舔训练家，把对方涂满黏液，表达亲近。它的牙虽小，却极其锋利、坚固。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME has a habit of licking and coating its Trainer in mucus to show its affection. Its fangs are small but extremely sharp and sturdy.

entry: POKENAME十分谨慎，会拼命保护训练家。毛上覆盖的黏液，会被采集来制作强效祛痘霜。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is highly cautious and fiercely protective of its Trainer. The mucus coating its fur is harvested to create powerful acne creams.

entry: POKENAME的鳞片产生厚厚黏液，抵御身体攻击。虽然拳击因此稍弱，却能以酸液攻击弥补。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's scales produce a thick layer of slime which protects them from physical hits. While its punches are a little weaker because of it, it makes up for it with its acid-based attacks.

entry: POKENAME的保护鳞片由硬化黏液构成。它们很脆，无论自身出拳还是挨打，强力冲击都常令鳞片开裂；不过分泌的黏液很快就能修好、补上。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's protective scales are made of hardened slime. They are brittle enough to frequently be cracked by the powerful blows POKENAME delivers and receives, but will quickly be repaired or replaced by the slime POKENAME secretes.

entry: 这只宝可梦分不清敌友，会用身上产生的黏稠物，溶掉碰到的一切。训练家若想妥善照料POKENAME黏糊的身体，务必戴上手套。
author: b3llda1zora
source: Unable to discern who is friend or foe, this Pokémon uses the gloop produced from its body to melt down anything it touches. Trainers should always wear gloves if they wish to properly care for POKENAME's gooey exterior.

entry: POKENAME向敌人脸上喷射黏性口水泡，让其看不见。它常从比自己慢的宝可梦那里偷树果，知道自己身手敏捷，能安然逃走。
author: fiordaliso
source: To blind its enemies, it shoots sticky saliva bubbles from its mouth at their faces. POKENAME has a habit of stealing berries from Pokémon slower than itself, knowing that its developed agility will allow it to get away undisturbed.

entry: POKENAME的翅膀只有掺着水，才能保持柔韧。它等到下雨才离开藏身处，张大翅膀，尽可能多地收集水分，让自己飞起来。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME wings can only remain flexible when mixed with water. They wait until there's rain to emerge from their hiding places, spreading their wings wide to gather as much moisture as they can to allow them to fly.

entry: 有些美发店聘请POKENAME，帮忙做深层护发。它天然分泌富含养分的黏液，再用柔软双手梳入发间，连最脏的头发也能变得顺滑有光泽。
author: jaminmcready
source: Some salons keep a POKENAME on staff to help with deep conditioning. It naturally secretes a nutrient-rich mucus that it then combs through hair with its soft hands, leaving even the dirtiest hair smooth and glossy.

entry: POKENAME常摇摇晃晃地飘过雾蒙蒙的草甸，留下一道闪亮黏迹。据说，它旋涡般的眼睛能迷住对手，令其短暂混乱。
author: eiskitsune
source: POKENAME is often found drifting unsteadily through misty meadows, leaving behind a glittery trail of slime. Its swirling eyes are said to mesmerise opponents, causing brief bouts of confusion.

entry: POKENAME分泌黏液，溶解周围的岩石与生物组织，挖出地下通道。若成群在路下挖掘，可能造成地面塌陷。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME dig underground tunnels by secreting a slime that dissolves rocks and biological matter around them. Groups of POKENAME can cause sinkholes when they dig below roads.

entry: POKENAME靠近喜爱的对象时，黏液会不由自主地沸腾。即使心情平静，也最好别紧贴着抱它。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's slime unintentionally boils when it is near someone it loves. Even when calm, it is advised not to cuddle up to it.

entry: POKENAME奔走时，身后滴下酸性黏液，落到哪里就烧掉哪里的植物。一天驰过各地，就能留下长达数百英里的焦植物痕迹。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME leave droplets of acidic mucus behind them as they walk, burning away plant growth wherever their mucus lands. They can leave a trail of burned plants hundreds of miles long within a single day as they race across the landscape.

entry: POKENAME的黏液虽然不具腐蚀性，却热得足以烫伤任何触碰者。幸好，遇水就迅速冷却，因此只需将烫伤处放到流动水下，便能处理。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME's slime, while not corrosive, is hot enough to burn anyone who touches it. Thankfully, its slime cools rapidly in the presence of water, so treatment is as simple as placing the burn wound under running water.

entry: POKENAME虽然看不见，却有敏锐的超能力，能感知周围。它好奇心强，喜欢探究新事物。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME is blind, but it has keen psychic powers to sense its surroundings. It's very curious and loves to investigate new things.

entry: POKENAME用弹性外壳保护柔软娇弱的身体，任何飞来物都能弹开。想快些移动，就缩起四肢，如足球般滚行。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME protects its soft, delicate body with its elastic shell, which allows any projectiles to bounce off of it. To get around quickly, it will tuck in its limbs and roll around like a soccer ball.

entry: POKENAME一向悠闲，行动慢得惊人。夹在背上的大舌贝，已经变得像钢铁一样坚硬。
author: hophoppip
source: Ever-leisurely, POKENAME moves at an incredibly slow pace. The Shellder clamped onto its back has developed a steely hardness.

entry: POKENAME的钳子内侧分泌酸性黏液。它把小型猎物夹进大钳，彻底困住，再慢慢溶解。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME secrete an acidic slime from the inside of their claws. These Pokémon catch smaller prey inside their larger claw, trapping them completely and slowly dissolving them.

entry: POKENAME一滚动就容易头晕，索性改为靠滑润污泥滑行。
author: camtft
source: POKENAME are quick to get dizzy from their rolling motion. Instead, they opt to glide around on their slippery sludge.

entry: POKENAME性格软弱，常被大型宝可梦欺负。若受欺负太多，就会恼怒地爆炸，把周围涂满带电黏稠物。
author: sk372
source: It often gets picked on by larger Pokémon due to its meek personality. If bullied too much, POKENAME will explode in frustration and coat its surroundings with a sticky, electrified goop.

entry: POKENAME见到人类或宝可梦，就会滚过去，黏糊糊地蹭蹭。若遭拒绝，便会爆炸，让附近所有生物都沾满黏液。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME rolls toward people and Pokémon it spots to give them a slimy nuzzle. If POKENAME is rejected, it will explode to cover everyone nearby in slime.

entry: 这些宝可梦不适应干燥环境，干燥空气会伤到翅膀。遇到威胁时，会用翅膀将对方裹住，靠黏液中的毒孢子使其中毒。
author: kam_doodle_snek
source: These Pokémon do not fare well in arid environments; the dry air damages their wings. When threatened, they smother the threat with their wings, intoxicating them with poisonous spores infused in the mucus.

entry: 它喜爱与同类共舞，可每次尝试，最后总滑倒在彼此的黏液上。看它跳舞太久，可能会暂时觉得全身都变成果冻，无法自己站稳。
author: epping_forest
source: It loves dancing with others of its kind, but they always end up slipping on each other's goo when they try. Watching its dance for too long may cause you to feel for some time like your entire body is made of jelly and unable to stand on its own.

entry: POKENAME触手渗出的黏稠物，也参与消化。其中的强效酶，能分解骨头、矿物沉积等原本难以吃下的部分。
author: bobosmith01
source: The goo-like substance that oozes from its tentacles is used partially in POKENAME's digestive process, as it contains powerful enzymes that can eat away at parts that are otherwise hard to consume, such as bone or mineral buildup.

entry: POKENAME触手渗出的黏稠物，也参与消化。其中的强效酶，能分解骨头、矿物沉积等原本难以吃下的部分。
author: bobosmith01
source: The goo-like substance that oozes from its tentacles is used partially in POKENAME's digestive process, as it contains powerful enzymes that can eat away at parts that are otherwise hard to consume, such as bone or mineral buildup.

entry: POKENAME极为友善，喜欢与同伴聚在海底。要养在缸里并不容易，因为缺少陪伴，它便闷闷不乐；它分泌黏稠物，饲养时也得定期清理。
author: jadey.1557
source: POKENAME is an extremely friendly Pokémon that enjoys clustering with others on seabeds. Keeping it in tanks is challenging, as it becomes sullen without companionship. The slime-like substance it secretes means it needs regular cleaning.

entry: POKENAME的刃渗出有毒汁液。液体下的刃硬如钢铁，几乎什么材料都能切开。
author: hermsmegerms
source: The blades of POKENAME ooze a poisonous sap. As hard as steel beneath the fluid, they can slice through nearly any material.

entry: POKENAME能随意改变黏液性质，将翅膀塑成最适合当前飞行路线的形状。它用硬化黏液，在高山之巅筑巢。
author: staghorn
source: A POKENAME can change the properties of its slime at will, shaping its wings to best match its current flight plan. It creates nests on high mountain peaks out of hardened slime.

entry: 体内蕴藏惊人的能量，让它每次攻击都威力十足。谁欺负它或它关心的对象，常会挨上尾巴重击，或犄角猛攻。
author: infinex21
source: It contains a remarkable amount of energy within its body, which empowers its every attack. Those who pick on it or the ones it cares about are often met with a powerful strike of its tail or fierce blows from its horns.

entry: 翼膜覆着浓稠黏液，保持洁净，不沾杂物。它们平时虽然温顺，为了保护其他生物，却会奋勇作战。
author: infinex21
source: The webbing of their wings is clad in a concentrated mucus that keeps them clean and free of debris. Though typically meek, they fight fiercely to protect others.

entry: 它贪玩地带着吹泡泡棒，逗孩子开心。吹出的泡泡软软的，却很结实。
author: busilisk
source: This playful Pokémon carries a bubble wand, which it uses to entertain children. The bubbles it creates are squishy but durable.

entry: 它住在林间溪流旁，更喜欢靠光合作用获得全部能量。不过，强健的内脏也让它能吃下多种多样的实物。
author: bobosmith01
source: It lives by forest streams and prefers to get all of its energy through photosynthesis, although it may consume many different kinds of physical matter thanks to its hardy innards.

entry: POKENAME气味恶心得惊人，会把其他宝可梦熏走。覆身的黏液却富含养分，有助于植物生长。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME smells positively revolting and drives other Pokémon away. The slime that covers its body is full of nutrients that help plants grow.

entry: POKENAME平常乖巧，受欺负时却会用强壮双颚，死死咬住来犯者。牙齿虽不算锋利，黏口水却极具刺激性，接触太久还会削弱肌肉。
author: sk372
source: Though generally well-behaved, if bullied POKENAME will latch onto aggressors with its powerful jaws. Though its teeth are not particularly sharp, its gooey saliva is a powerful irritant and weakens muscles after prolonged contact.

entry: POKENAME站进巨坑或山谷，放出大量黏液，最终，便形成一座供自己居住的黏液湖。
author: gurguro
source: POKENAME will produce massive amounts of goop while standing in a large crater or valley. The result is a lake of slime that becomes their home.

entry: POKENAME用细长、黏糊的身体缠住其他生物，表达亲近。接受这份善意的对象，免不了沾满黏液。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME wraps its long, sticky body around others as a sign of affection. The objects of this kind gesture are inevitably coated with gooey slime as a result.

entry: POKENAME的网能使身体发麻，又是黏合极快的黏合剂，比大多数强力胶更牢。哪怕只有几滴黏丝，单凭蛮力也很难扯下。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME's web acts as a numbing, extremely fast-bonding adhesive; stronger than that of most ultra-strong glues. Even a few drops of POKENAME's gooey silk will prove arduous to remove with force alone.

entry: POKENAME会被善良温柔的对象吸引，总忍不住给对方拥抱。它身上的黏液黏在人皮肤上时，似乎能赐予好运。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is attracted to those of kind and gentle natures, compelled to give them hugs often. The slime its body generates seems to give a blessing of good luck while it clings to a person's skin.

entry: POKENAME的黏液导电性能极佳。它让电流通过皮肤时，黏液还会发光。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME's slime is an excellent conductor of electricity. This slime is also luminescent, glowing whenever POKENAME runs an electric current across its skin.

entry: POKENAME的黏液始终泛着微弱光芒。爱好者喜欢把黏液装罐，放在家里代替蜡烛。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Its slime constantly emits a somewhat dim glow. POKENAME fans love jarring up its slime to have around their homes as a replacement for candles.

entry: POKENAME泡泡上的黏液，化学成分与人类鼻涕相同。它向黏液泡中充氦气，升得更高；排出气体，就向下飘。
author: musicsheep.
source: The mucus on its bubbles is the same chemical makeup as human snot. POKENAME fills these slime bubbles with helium to rise higher and drains them to float downward.

entry: POKENAME通常不在白天上岸捕食，不过雨能让皮肤凉爽湿润，使它们在外待得更久。结果往往吃得太多，许多捕猎结束后，都会呕出黏液。
author: soup1900
source: While POKENAME normally don't go on land during the day to hunt food, rain keeps their skin cool and moist, allowing them to stay out for longer. However, this causes them to overeat, with many barfing up goo after the hunting period is over.

entry: POKENAME靠鳃上覆着的黏液，感知周围。奇怪的是，黏液并不妨碍呼吸。它还在水边巢穴周围铺层薄黏液，预先察觉天敌来袭。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME sense their environment using the goo coating their gills. Oddly, the goo does not interfere with breathing. They spread a thin layer of slime around their waterside nests to act as an early warning system against predators.

entry: POKENAME的有毒黏液，会被采集来制作稀有颜料。妥善处理后，能调出深浓色泽，用于制成服装染色工具套装。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME's toxic slime is harvested to make rare pigments. When properly treated, it produces deep hues used in crafting a Clothing Dye Kit.

entry: POKENAME身上渗出的黏汗，闻起来像松针与咖啡。加到茶里，不但能让茶保持温热，还会添上极浓厚的风味。
author: .izik
source: The slimy sweat leaking from POKENAME's body smells of pine needles and coffee. When used in tea it not only keeps the liquid at a steady warm temperature but adds an incredibly deep flavor.

entry: POKENAME全身覆着滑润而奇妙的膜，具有多种能力。例如，能让它在水面飞奔，或影响空气中的离子，改变附近生物的心情。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's body is coated in a slick and wondrous membrane that possesses a variety of powers. For instance, the membrane can allow POKENAME to race along the surface of water or shift the mood of those nearby by affecting the ions in the air.

entry: 它神秘而难寻，几乎一见到其他生物就逃。它能在水面奔跑，覆下一层薄膜，将此后进入的污染物与毒素净化。
author: bobosmith01
source: It is a mysterious and elusive Pokémon that runs away at the sight of almost any other living being. It can run on the surface of water and cloak it with a thin layer of film that causes any later pollution or other toxins to become purified.

entry: 强力拳击会迸出黏液，长时间困住对手。它不爱战斗，所以一旦敌人被黏牢，往往就小跑离开。
author: infinex21
source: Its powerful punches release bursts of sticky goo that will trap opponents for long periods. It prefers not to fight, so once its foe is stuck, it will often trot away.

entry: 它停在训练家头顶，为其挡雨，遮蔽恶劣天气。可惜，宽檐冠帽底下滴落的灵质黏液团，也足以把人弄得一身狼狈。
author: ozydamians
source: It lingers above its Trainer's head to protect it from rain and other inclement weather. Unfortunately, you're liable to get just as messy from the globs of ectoplasmic goo that drip from underneath its wide-brimmed crown.

entry: POKENAME初被发现时，因外形像飞船，又常向敌人喷黏液、将其困住，被认为是外星生物。任何物体撞到柔软身体，都会被巨力弹回，连飞机也不例外。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME was believed to be a space alien when first discovered due to resembling a spaceship and its tendency to spray icky slime at foes to trap them. Anything that impacts its squishy body rebounds with immense force, including airplanes.

entry: POKENAME许多细长触肢，由柔软胶质构成。它用粗大的藤蔓手臂将对方拉近拥抱，等终于松手，对方已被涂满黏液。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's many tendrils are made of a soft gelatinous substance. It wraps its large vine-arms around others and pulls them into hugs, which leaves them coated with POKENAME's slime when it finally lets go.

entry: POKENAME皮肤渗出的绿色黏液，含有大量微藻。它们吸收阳光，把能量传进柔软身体，让攻击蕴含太阳之力。
author: .jerden
source: The green slime that oozes from POKENAME's skin is full of microscopic algae. These absorb sunlight and transfer the energy into POKENAME's soft body, charging its attacks with the power of the sun.

entry: POKENAME每天早晨花30分钟，用黏液润滑翅膀，尽量减少空气阻力。虽然牙齿只用来吸果汁，天蝎王吸血的故事，仍让许多人害怕它。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME spends 30 minutes each morning lubricating its wings with its slime to minimize its air resistance. Although it only uses its teeth to drain fruit juices, many people fear it due to stories of Gliscor sucking blood.

entry: POKENAME吃下的资料越多，身上渗出的绿色黏液就越多。黏液闻着格外香甜，却有毒，不能食用。
author: .izik
source: The more data POKENAME consumes, the more green slime oozes from its body. The slime is incredibly sweet-smelling but should not be eaten due to its toxic properties.

entry: 覆身的黏液能驱赶寄生生物，对植物有益。它的尾巴只需横扫一下，连庞大独石也能挪动。
author: fiordaliso
source: The sticky slime coating its body has beneficial effects on plants, as it keeps parasites away. A single sweep of its tail is powerful enough to move even large stone monoliths.

entry: 它害羞却强大，喜欢住在潮湿洞穴。靠覆身的膜，即使环境极干燥或极潮湿，也能生存。
author: bobosmith01
source: A shy but powerful Pokémon that prefers to live in damp caves. It is able to survive in extremely dry or humid conditions thanks to the film that covers its body.

entry: POKENAME对人类与宝可梦都极其友善，却格外护着训练家。任何想伤害主人的对象，都会成为它试图摧毁的目标。
author: jennybean
source: POKENAME are known to be extremely friendly towards people and Pokémon. However, they are extremely protective of their Trainers, and will attempt to destroy anyone who tries to harm them.

entry: 为了保护训练家，POKENAME会将对方紧紧搂住，再用手臂遮挡。不过裙子不断渗出黏液，这份关怀可黏糊得很。
author: topazthemagi
source: To protect its Trainer, POKENAME will hold them close and shield them with its arms. Since its dress oozes slime, this is a very sticky affair.

entry: POKENAME用肠道产生的浓稠油液，标记领地。这物质一有动静就会剧烈反应，闪现各种颜色，吓退可能前来的对手。
author: turron_turron
source: POKENAME marks its territory with a thick, oily liquid produced in its gut. This substance reacts violently to motion, scaring away potential rivals with a display of flashing colors.

entry: POKENAME柔软黏滑的身体，受比钢更硬的鳞片骨架保护。柔软部分在蹦跳时吸收冲击，又蕴藏丰厚肌肉，让它行动、攻击都快得惊人，力道十足。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's soft and slimy body is protected by a scaly framework harder than steel. The soft sections act as shock absorbers as it leaps around, but also contain so much muscle that POKENAME can move and attack with incredible speed and force.

entry: POKENAME体内始终至少有108加仑黏合剂。向敌人吐出多少，身体就立刻再生成多少，补足储量。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body always contains at least 108 gallons of adhesive. Should it spit any at a foe, its body immediately generates more to replace it.

entry: POKENAME住在地下，把柔软身体挤进石缝。猎物靠近时，皮肤渗出的绿黏液提供润滑，让它滑出缝隙袭击。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME lives underground, squeezing its soft body into crevices. When prey approaches, POKENAME will slide out to attack, lubricated by the green slime that oozes from its skin.

entry: POKENAME皮肤覆着一层滑润黏液，摩擦极小。因此既能高速飞过天空，也能在地下掘洞时，顺畅滑过泥土。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's skin is covered by a layer of slippery slime, minimizing friction. This enables POKENAME to fly through the air at high speed, as well as smoothly slide through the earth when tunneling underground.

entry: POKENAME皮肤覆着一层滑润黏液，摩擦极小。因此既能高速飞过天空，也能在地下掘洞时，顺畅滑过泥土。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's skin is covered by a layer of slippery slime, minimizing friction. This enables POKENAME to fly through the air at high speed, as well as smoothly slide through the earth when tunneling underground.

entry: POKENAME一察觉危险，皮肤就开始分泌剧毒绿黏液。它游荡沼泽，保护落单的年幼黏黏宝。
author: fiordaliso
source: When POKENAME senses danger, its skin begins secreting an extremely toxic green slime. It wanders through the marshlands, offering protection to young Goomy left on their own.

entry: 颈间黏稠的褶边，可用来制药。有野生宝可梦急需治疗时，它甚至会主动喂对方黏液。
author: zeeroooo
source: The goo frill around its neck can be used to make potions. Sometimes it will even feed wild Pokémon its goo if they need immediate medical help.

entry: POKENAME吃掉一切够得着的食物，将多余能量存进厚厚脂肪。脂肪既保温，也供给其下的强壮肌肉，因此四肢、尾巴或柔韧犄角，连沉重敌人也能打飞。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME eats any food within reach, storing excess energy in a thick layer of fat. This fat provides insulation but also fuels powerful muscles beneath it, so POKENAME's limbs, tail, or flexible horns can knock even heavy foes flying.

entry: POKENAME的口与皮肤渗出有毒黏液。身体虽然大多柔软，前部却有硬鳞保护，所以面对威胁，通常会正面迎敌。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME oozes a toxic mucus from its mouth and skin. Although most of its body is soft, tough scales protect its front, so it usually faces any threat head-on.

entry: POKENAME的覆身黏液，会悄悄影响触碰者。古老文明曾将它尊为神明般的存在，尽管它从没帮过他们什么忙。
author: .izik
source: The mucus covering POKENAME subtly influences those they touch. Ancient cultures once revered it as a godlike being despite it doing nothing to assist them.

entry: POKENAME背上的植物总是茂盛，结出独特果实，外层黏，里面多汁。年幼的龙属性宝可梦最爱这点心，它一到附近，就纷纷围来。
author: sk372
source: The plantlife growing on POKENAME's back is always thriving with a unique type of fruit with a sticky exterior and juicy insides. It's a favored treat among young Dragon types, who flock to POKENAME when it travels near.

entry: 保卫自己挖出的洞穴时，POKENAME把柔软身体挤进狭窄入口，堵得严实，再将背刺朝外，指向敌人。利刺上覆着有毒绿黏液，足以吓退大多数攻击者。
author: .jerden
source: When defending the burrow it digs, POKENAME will squeeze its soft body into the narrow entrance to completely fill it, then point the spines on its back out at foes. These sharp spikes are coated with toxic green slime, deterring most attackers.

entry: POKENAME最有力的部位，是肌肉发达的犄角与尾巴。角能像连枷一样甩动，把敌人打倒；尾巴拍地，力道也足以撼动大地。
author: .jerden
source: The most powerful parts of POKENAME's body are its muscular horns and tail. It can knock foes down by swinging its horns like flails or strike the ground with its tail with enough force to shake the earth.

entry: POKENAME常显得温顺，弱小攻击只会被厚脂肪弹开，它也懒得理会。真正受到威胁时，才会凶猛反击，通常试着用庞大身躯将敌人压垮。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME often seems to be meek and will ignore weak attacks that simply bounce off its thick fat. If it is actually threatened, it will attack viciously and usually tries to crush foes beneath its bulk.

entry: POKENAME刚孵化时，手掌黏性极强。可只要一碰到东西，就会沾满碎屑，弄得脏兮兮，再也黏不住。
author: musicsheep.
source: When hatched, the palm of POKENAME is extremely sticky. However, the moment it touches something, it gets covered in debris, making it dirty and unable to stick to anything.

entry: 它的两只手常缠在一起。一旦如此，得反复尝试数小时，才能解开。
author: musicsheep.
source: Its two hands often get tangled together. Once this happens, untangling them can take hours of trial and error.

entry: POKENAME的手能伸得极长，远超大多数宝可梦所及。它利用这份柔韧与冲势，给对手狠狠一巴掌。
author: musicsheep.
source: POKENAME can stretch its hand far beyond what most Pokémon can reach. It uses this flexibility and momentum to deliver powerful smacks to its opponents.

entry: POKENAME的皮肤不停渗出毒黏液，谁碰到都可能中毒。虽然平常友善，却必须教它别用拥抱表达亲近，否则会让人生重病。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's skin constantly oozes toxic slime, and can poison anyone that makes contact with it. Although it is usually friendly, is important to train POKENAME to not show affection by hugging people, as this can make them very sick.

entry: POKENAME特别爱依偎，却常低估自己的力量与体型。它玩耍时扑向训练家，或想坐到对方腿上，这份黏人劲常将自己的训练家压伤。
author: piponus
source: An incredibly cuddly Pokémon, POKENAME often underestimates its own strength and size. Unfortunately, its clinginess often crushes POKENAME's own Trainers due to tackling them during play, or attempting to sit on their laps.

entry: 黏滑皮肤下，是岩石般坚实的肌肉。它大多无视攻击，不过对方纠缠不休，也会被激怒，低头用金属头盔上的利角冲锋。
author: .jerden
source: Beneath its slimy skin is muscle as hard as rock. While it mostly ignores attacks, it can be provoked by persistent attackers. It will lower its head and charge with the sharp horns on its metal helmet.

entry: POKENAME四处飞行，向猎物吐出黏液团。黏液既腐蚀又极黏，让它有充足时间俯冲，以爪牙攻击。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME flies around, spitting blobs of goo out of its mouth at prey. This corrosive slime is also incredibly sticky, giving POKENAME plenty of time to swoop in and attack with its claws and fangs.

entry: POKENAME四处飞行，向猎物吐出黏液团。黏液既腐蚀又极黏，让它有充足时间俯冲，以爪牙攻击。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME flies around, spitting blobs of goo out of its mouth at prey. This corrosive slime is also incredibly sticky, giving POKENAME plenty of time to swoop in and attack with its claws and fangs.

entry: POKENAME亲昵得过了头，常用覆着黏液的缎带缠住训练家，表达喜爱。黏液有镇静作用，也被用于制作医用镇静剂。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME are dotingly affectionate and will wrap their goo-covered ribbons around their Trainers to show affection. The goo has calming effects and is used in medical sedatives.

entry: POKENAME身体看似柔软，厚脂肪下却有结实肌肉。除了用强力尾巴缠敌，它也会用头上触角卷住对手，再刺入利角。
author: .jerden
source: Although POKENAME's body seems soft, beneath its thick fat is a layer of solid muscle. In addition to wrapping its powerful tail around foes, POKENAME will wrap grab them with the antennae on its head, then plunge in its sharp horn.

entry: 若雨水摸着略带黏感，就能知道风暴由POKENAME唤来。尽管质感不舒服，许多人仍相信，经它祝福的水特别有助于补水。
author: imaginita
source: You can tell when a storm was summoned by a POKENAME, because the rain will have a slightly gooey feel to it.  Despite this unpleasant texture, many believe that water blessed by a POKENAME is exceptionally good for hydration.

entry: POKENAME背上的炮，能发射黏稠物，妨碍对手行动。大多数不愿伤害其他生物，会先喷黏液，再逃离战斗。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: The cannon on POKENAME's back shoots a gooey substance to hinder an opponent's movement. Most POKENAME prefer to avoid causing harm to others, shooting this goo before fleeing from battle.

entry: POKENAME金属铠甲内循环着黏稠物，可由背炮射出。插入不同卡带，还能让物质带电，或变得灼热、冰寒。
author: .jerden
source: A slimy substance is pumped around inside POKENAME's metal armor and can be fired out of the cannon on its back as sticky goo. Different Drives may be slotted in to energize this substance with electricity, or make it scorching hot or freezing cold.

entry: POKENAME的花产生肥皂般的花蜜，常被用于化妆品。浓稠花蜜的香气受食物影响，野生个体会靠气味相互辨认。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME produce a soap-like nectar from their flowers that is often used as an ingredient in cosmetics. The content of their diet influences the aroma their thick nectar possesses, with wild individuals using their scent to recognize one another.

entry: POKENAME由柔软黏稠的物质构成，无论受到多少打击，最后都会恢复原状。它看着天真，其实十分狡猾，乐于留下黏液陷阱。
author: deniablecredibility
source: POKENAME is made from a squishy, sticky substance that always reverts back to its original form, no matter how much punishment it takes. Despite its innocent appearance, it is a highly devious Pokémon that delights in leaving gooey traps.

entry: 满月之夜，POKENAME用有力的角把东西抛向空中，仿佛想将它们送到月亮上。听觉极敏锐，所以会用自身黏液塞耳，减轻巨响。
author: soup1900
source: On full moon nights, POKENAME will launch objects into the air with its strong horns as if trying to send them to the moon. Since it has super-sensitive hearing, it fills its ears with its own slime to muffle the loud sounds.

entry: POKENAME筑巢的地方，常覆满释放微弱电脉冲的黏网。凡碰到网的生物，都会被黏牢，再被电流麻痹。
author: chibitales
source: Nesting sites of POKENAME are often covered in gooey webs that give off small electrical pulses. Anything that comes in contact with the webbing is glued in place and paralyzed by the electricity.

entry: POKENAME触肢上的黏液，黏合力极强，让它贴住洞壁与洞顶。它以洞中的苔藓为食，在潮湿黑暗中独居。
author: musicsheep.
source: The slime coating POKENAME's tendrils is an extremely sticky adhesive that helps it stick to cave walls and ceilings. It feeds on moss found in cave systems and lives a solitary life in damp darkness.

entry: POKENAME的长牙常吓到其他宝可梦，其实平时很温顺。它大多只用利刃剪下树枝吃；不过遭袭时，也会奋力挥击自卫。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's tusks often frighten other Pokémon, but POKENAME is usually very meek. It mostly uses its sharp blades to prune branches from trees to eat, although it will swing them with great force to defend itself if attacked.

entry: POKENAME身上的黏液温暖舒适，也非常耐热。火山地区的冒险者会让它拥抱，用黏液涂遍全身，好应对极端高温。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's slimy coating is pleasantly warm and very heat-resistant. Adventurers in volcanic areas will let a POKENAME hug them and coat them in slime to better deal with the extreme temperatures.

entry: POKENAME的角看似柔软，嘴也没牙，却强壮无比。它能弯角打击或紧紧抓住敌人，还能靠硬牙龈与腐蚀性口涎，将食物压碎。
author: .jerden
source: Although its horns seem soft and its mouths are toothless, POKENAME is incredibly strong. It can flex its horns to strike foes or seize them in a tight grip, and can crush food with its hard gums, aided by the corrosive slime it drools.

entry: POKENAME友好，也总是饥饿。它会用臂端黏糊糊的头，亲昵地轻咬训练家；同样的肢体也会吞下所有看见的食物，让浮空身体保持圆胖。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME is very friendly and constantly hungry. It will affectionately nibble its Trainer with the slimy heads on the ends of its arms, but will use the same limbs to devour any food it sees, keeping its floating body plump.

entry: POKENAME非常友善，常庇护弱小宝可梦，帮助其成长。不过，若被欺负，也会记恨数十年。尾巴分泌的黏稠物，十分温暖。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME is very friendly and is often found sheltering weaker Pokémon and helping them grow. Despite this, its known to hold grudges for several decades if picked on. The gooey secretions from its tails are very warm.

entry: POKENAME极爱亲近，谁靠近，就用长触角拉来拥抱。它也用覆身黏液，加固沿河所筑水坝的铰接处。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is extremely affectionate and tries to hug anyone who gets close, pulling them in with its long antennae. It uses the sticky slime covering its body to reinforce the hinges of the dams it builds along rivers.

entry: POKENAME一察觉危险，皮肤就开始分泌剧毒绿黏液。它游荡沼泽，保护落单的年幼黏黏宝。
author: fiordaliso
source: When POKENAME senses danger, its skin begins secreting an extremely toxic green slime. It wanders through the marshlands, offering protection to young Goomy left on their own.

entry: POKENAME产生的凝胶，让自身火焰烧成浅绿色。它靠两团火焰，不断烧掉身上的凝胶，否则便会越积越多、渐渐硬化。
author: quackquackattack
source: The gel POKENAME produces causes any flames it produces to burn a light green color. It relies on its twin flames to constantly burn gel from its body, as the gel will build up and harden if not used.

entry: POKENAME看似软弱，常被其他宝可梦攻击。其实小小身体肌肉发达，只要尾巴抵住地面，就能挥动头上利角，打出斧头般的力道。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME is often attacked by other Pokémon because it seems soft and weak. However, its small body is very muscular, and by pushing its tail against the ground, it can swing the sharp horn on its head with the force of an axe.

entry: POKENAME受威胁时，会吐出难以清除的毒黏液，试图逃跑。毒素慢慢侵袭神经系统，让敌人失去感知，直到毒效消退。
author: chibitales
source: When threatened, POKENAME spits poisonous goo that is hard to remove and attempts to escape. The poison slowly attacks the nervous system, leaving foes devoid of their senses until it wears off.

entry: POKENAME常在含铁泉中，把全身藏进橙色水面下。它吃下矿物，积聚进化的能量。虽然全身没入，紫色身体却很显眼。
author: karmaofevil
source: POKENAME can be found in chalybeate water springs, covering itself completely under the orange surface. It consumes the minerals, gathering energy for evolution. Despite being completely covered, its purple body is easy to spot.

entry: POKENAME的黏稠铠甲受压会硬化，形成与骨骼化石一样结实的结晶鳞片。唾液能溶解钢铁，却只用来在石巢中开路。
author: bionic_man
source: POKENAME's viscous armor hardens under pressure, forming crystalline scales as strong as fossilized bone. Its saliva can dissolve steel, yet it uses it only to carve paths through stone lairs.

entry: POKENAME的披风约束着身体产生的黏液，不让它过度外溢。一旦没抓牢，黏液便漏得到处都是，把附近弄得又黏又乱。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's cloak keeps the slime its body generates from getting too excessive. Should it lose its grip, the slime will leak all over and cause the immediate area to become sticky and messy.

entry: POKENAME的翅膀自然分泌黏液，并不断积存。为了清理翅膀，它快速旋转起舞，将道道黏液甩向四面八方。
author: jaminmcready
source: Slime naturally secretes from POKENAME's wings and constantly builds up within them. To clear its wings, POKENAME performs rapid spinning dances that scatter streams of slime in every direction.

entry: POKENAME欢快地为训练家加油，却不慎把浸透黏液的绒球甩得四处飞溅。因此，许多选择养它的训练家，也养成大多时候穿雨衣的习惯。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME cheer merrily for their Trainers, inadvertently spreading gunk from their saturated pom-poms as a result. Many Trainers who elect to raise POKENAME pick up a habit of wearing a raincoat most of the time as a result.

entry: POKENAME由独特、适应力强的细胞构成，凝胶能用于医药、营养、发电或防御等多种用途。不过，它罕见又避世，取得的样本很少。
author: quietcognition
source: Due to being made of unique adaptive cells, POKENAME can use its gel for many purposes such as medicine, sustenance, power generation, or defense. However, due to this Pokémon's rarity and reclusive nature, few samples have been obtained.

entry: POKENAME的翅膀质地如浓稠黏液。可一旦飞行，就变得比空气还轻，也有了棉絮般的触感。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME's wings have the consistency of viscous goo. Yet when POKENAME flies, its wings become lighter than air and adopt the texture of cotton.

entry: 与两个组成来源一样，POKENAME也会拥抱训练家，表达亲近。同样，这种拥抱并不舒服，因为对方既会重伤，也会沾满黏液。
author: hophoppip
source: Like both its components, POKENAME hugs its Trainer to show affection. Also like its components, these hugs are not pleasant, as they leave the recipient both severely injured and covered in slime.

entry: POKENAME用多足缠住珊瑚，将其碾碎，让主要猎物太阳珊瑚无处可藏。身体黏软，一旦用腿围成穹顶，大多数天敌都难以攻击。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME pulverizes coral by wrapping around them with its many legs to remove any hiding spot that Corsola, its main prey, may have. With how gooey and squishy its body is, most predators have trouble attacking it once it creates its leg dome.

entry: POKENAME分泌的黏液，常被收集制作可反复使用的凝胶袋。不论低于冰点，还是加热到高温，黏液都保持半流体状态。
author: chibitales
source: The goo secreted from POKENAME's body is often collected for use in reusable gel packs. This goo stays semifluid despite being below freezing or heated to high temperatures.

entry: POKENAME黏液虽然剧毒，阿罗拉居民却认为它的爪是美味。据当地厨师说，爪子变成鲜橙色，就代表火候正好。
author: theaceofhearts0306
source: Despite POKENAME goo being highly toxic, Alolan residents find their claws to be a delectable treat. According to Alolan chefs, POKENAME claws are cooked to perfection when they take on a bright orange hue.

entry: POKENAME十分亲热，常用强壮手臂，把训练家拉进黏糊糊的怀抱。它也这样抓敌人，随后却会将其摔倒，用沉重身体压住。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME is very affectionate and will frequently pull its Trainer into a slimy embrace with its strong arms. It will grab enemies in a similar way, but then wrestles them to the ground and crushes them under its heavy body.

entry: POKENAME试着晃鳞发响，震慑敌人，软黏身体却大多只发出咕唧声。它常被轻视，可覆鳞双拳的力道，比重量级拳手还强百倍以上。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME tries to intimidate foes by jingling its scales, but its soft and slimy body mostly makes squelching sounds. While it often isn't taken seriously, its scaled fists strike with more than a hundred times the force of a heavyweight boxer.

entry: 它分泌的黏液可以吃，有香甜柑橘风味。虽然已成为很受欢迎的甜点原料，烘焙师也得小心处理，因为它黏性极强，很难洗掉。
author: hophoppip
source: The slime it secretes is edible, with a sweet citrusy flavor. Though the slime has gained popularity as an ingredient in desserts, bakers must work with it carefully, as it's incredibly sticky and difficult to wash off.

entry: POKENAME大嗓门，爱吹嘘，随时准备挑衅另一只宝可梦，惹起打斗。最能激起反应的招数，往往是从身上抓一大把黏液，丢到对方脸上。
author: sk372
source: A loudmouthed braggart, POKENAME is always ready to taunt another Pokémon in order to start a fight. The action that usually gets the most reaction is to lob a thick handful of goo from its body into another's face.

entry: 科学家用从POKENAME提取的黏液，增强特防强化的效果。它天生强大的防御力，在黏液中留下效力惊人的残留物。
author: jaminmcready
source: To heighten the effects of X Sp. Def, scientists use goo extracted from a POKENAME. Its naturally high defensive abilities leave behind powerful residue in the goo.

entry: POKENAME头上的绿色宝石，其实是浓稠黏液团结晶而成。它们比钻石还结实，轻易就能把钻石压成粉。
author: soup1900
source: The green gems on POKENAME's head are actually thick globs of slime that have been crystallized. These gems are even stronger than diamonds, easily being able to crush them into dust.

entry: POKENAME的黏液，是一种黏性聚合物。兴奋时，不只会困住敌人，连同伴也可能被黏住。不过，交给好厨师烤过，滋味也很不错。
author: greystorm101
source: POKENAME's goo is a sticky polymer that can trap foes and even allies when excited. It's also delicious when roasted by a great chef.

entry: POKENAME平时温顺，却能在几分钟内变得无比凶暴。黏液有促使肾上腺素分泌的作用，许多人认为，这或许正是它稍受挑衅，就迅速变凶的原因。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are typically docile yet are capable of becoming incredibly aggressive within a few minutes. Their mucus has adrenaline-inducing effects, which many believe may be why they can turn aggressive so swiftly over the slightest provocation.

entry: POKENAME把尾巴在水中搅动，产生黏合力极强的黏液。它天性叛逆，喜欢把黏液涂到训练家重视的物品上，做个恶作剧。
author: bradlybro199
source: POKENAME produces goo by swirling its tail in water. This goo is a particularly powerful binding agent. Due to POKENAME's naturally rebellious disposition, it likes to apply the goo to objects deemed important by their Trainers as a prank.

entry: POKENAME住在沼泽，雨天更加活跃。它很友好，常与沼王、乌波在一起，用强大超能力，为它们收集食物。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME lives in swamplands and becomes more active on rainy days. A friendly Pokémon, it's often seen alongside Quagsire and Wooper, gathering food for them with its powerful psychic abilities.

entry: 无论什么活动或比赛，POKENAME都会热情地为训练家加油。见到它时，最好隔开三英尺，免得沾上黏液。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME enthusiastically cheer on their Trainers no matter what activity or competition is happening. If you see POKENAME, it is advised you stay three feet apart so as to not get slimed.

entry: POKENAME性子柔弱，初次见面，本能反应就是躲进柔软黏滑的壳。趁它躲着，托住壳轻抱一会儿，就能很快交上朋友。
author: sk372
source: Due to its softhearted personality, POKENAME's first instinct upon meeting someone is to hide in its soft, slimy shell. Holding its shell while it hides and hugging it softly for a time is a quick way to become friends with it.

entry: POKENAME覆着浓稠黏液，只要有毒的喙能通过，身体就能挤进狭小空间。它胆怯，见到新事物就逃；训练家若耐心、平和地探访数周，就能与野生个体建立信任。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME's viscous slime-coating allows it to squeeze into tiny spaces, as long as its venomous beak can fit through. It is timid, fleeing from new sights, so a persistent and calm Trainer can build trust with a wild one over weeks of visits.

entry: POKENAME能控制黏滑身体，不灼伤或毒害直接触碰的对象。脱落的污泥却没那么安全；毒性虽不算强，酸性却至少能迅速烧穿衣物等材料。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can control its slimy body so that it will not burn or poison those it touches directly. Sludge that falls from it is less safe; though not overly toxic, its acidic nature will at least burn through clothing and other materials quickly.

entry: POKENAME柔软的身体，藏在自身黏液冻成的壳中。这种物质，比普通冰结实得多。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's soft body is protected inside a shell made from its own frozen slime. This substance is significantly more durable than regular ice.

entry: POKENAME的身体富含植物生长所需的矿物。许多园丁寻找从它身上脱落的小石子，用来种植营养丰富的蔬果。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME's body is rich in minerals that are vital to plant growth. Many gardeners seek out pebbles that have broken off from POKENAME's body to grow nutritious fruits and vegetables.

entry: 野外的POKENAME极难寻找，身体几乎完美融入巨石与碎岩。它稍受惊扰就容易爆炸，因此打扰它相当危险。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are extremely difficult to locate in the wild, their bodies blending in nearly seamlessly with boulders and rubble. They are dangerous Pokémon to disturb due to their propensity to explode at the slightest disturbance.

entry: POKENAME由细粒砂岩构成，强大电荷加固了将沙粒胶结在一起的物质。它能控制电荷，转化成惊人的爆炸威力。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are formed of fine-grained sandstone, the matrix binding the sand in their bodies together reinforced by a potent electrical charge. They are able to control their electrical charge, turning it into dramatic explosive potential.

entry: POKENAME由细粒砂岩构成，强大电荷加固了将沙粒胶结在一起的物质。它能控制电荷，转化成惊人的爆炸威力。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are formed of fine-grained sandstone, the matrix binding the sand in their bodies together reinforced by a potent electrical charge. They are able to control their electrical charge, turning it into dramatic explosive potential.

entry: 据说，古人曾将POKENAME用作烟雾弹。它们偏爱用脆石裹身，让气体能排出，免得积在体内引爆。
author: frokachu
source: Thought to have been used as smoke bombs in ancient times, POKENAME prefer brittle rocks to coat their body, so that their gases don't get trapped and cause them to explode.

entry: POKENAME埋在土下，柔软身体受石层保护。它能休眠数千年，可地鼠掘过、惊动它时，冲击会触发突然进化。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME lies buried beneath the soil, its soft body protected by a coating of stone. It can remain dormant for millennia, but when a Diglett tunnels through and disturbs it, the shock triggers a sudden evolution.

entry: POKENAME的岩石身体含有大量硫，周身喷气孔不断排出毒气。烟气杀死附近所有植物，所经之处化为荒地。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME's rocky bodies contain high amounts of sulfur, constantly expelling toxic gases from the fumaroles along their bodies. These fumes kill any nearby plant life, leaving barren wastelands in their wake.

entry: POKENAME埋在土下，柔软身体受石层保护。一见光就绷紧，试图装成石头。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME lies buried beneath the soil, its soft body protected by a coating of stone. It tenses when exposed to light, attempting to give the appearance of a rock.

entry: POKENAME能一连冲锋数天，每一步都令大地轻震。这种状态下几乎无可阻挡，身体连山也能撞穿。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME will charge for days at a time, each step they take causing small tremors in the earth. Almost nothing can stop them in this state, their bodies able to barrel through mountains.

entry: 有些POKENAME住在喷泉上，与周围雕像融为一体。目前还不清楚它为何偏爱喷泉，不过已有记录：谁往里丢硬币，就会被它喷水。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME have been known to take residence on some fountains, blending in with the statuary around them. It is not yet clear why they prefer fountains, but it has been documented that they spit water at anyone who throws in coins.

entry: POKENAME喜欢住在干燥或多岩地区的森林。它用角中的特殊酸性毒液，将石头溶成软浆，吃下充饥。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME prefers inhabiting forests in dry or rocky areas. It uses a special acidic poison in its horn to melt down stones into a soft slurry it can consume for sustenance.

entry: POKENAME体内的火焰囊让全身温暖，仿佛每块石头都晒过数小时太阳。除了吐火，也能从体内喷出炽热岩块，击退对手。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's internal flame sac leaves its body warm, as if every stone had basked in the sun for hours. Aside from fire breath, it can spit blazing hot rocks from inside its body to repel its opponents.

entry: 大多数人见过的POKENAME，都处于静止状态，坐在岩地，毫不回应外界刺激。据说按特定节奏，敲击不同侧面，就能将它激活。
author: sk372
source: Most have only ever encountered POKENAME while it is inactive, sitting still in rocky areas and not responding to stimuli. It's rumored that knocking on its various sides in a specific pattern will activate it.

entry: POKENAME喜欢从天花板落下，砸碎下方一切。它如此古怪，有些科学家把它放进电子游戏，以了解其行为。
author: agostostino
source: POKENAME loves to drop from the ceiling and smash anything below it. POKENAME is so peculiar that some scientists put it in videogames to understand its behavior.

entry: POKENAME有时被当成巧克力板，可它实在太硬，想吃的人反被崩坏牙。它常出现在各家糖果店，帮店员做各种工作。
author: agostostino
source: POKENAME is sometimes mistaken for a chocolate bar, but it is so hard that people who tried to eat it had their teeth broken. POKENAME is known for being found in different candy shops, helping the employees with different tasks.

entry: POKENAME的花岗岩壳无比坚硬，健康时能抵御猛烈重击。一旦生病，壳就开始剥落，直到康复。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's granite shell is incredibly hard, capable of withstanding severe blows when it is in good health. When it falls ill, the shell begins to chip away until it recovers.

entry: POKENAME守护着古代沙漠文明的遗迹，以骇人面貌驱赶闯入者与敌人。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME is found guarding the remnants of ancient desert civilizations. It holds a fearsome visage to drive away any intruders and enemies.

entry: 它蕴藏庞大能量，能发射毁灭性的破坏光线自卫。战斗中身体受损，就钻行于松散石块间，修补或替换损坏部位。
author: infinex21
source: It contains vast energy that allows it to release devastating Hyper Beams to defend itself. It burrows through loose rocks to repair or replace any of its body that gets damaged in battle.

entry: POKENAME用超能力，将石头紧密堆砌成巢穴睡觉。每天换用不同石头重塑巢穴，绝不会连续保留同一设计。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses psychic power to costruct tightly-packed dens made of stone to sleep in. Every day it reshapes the den with different rocks, never keeping the same design back-to-back.

entry: 人们能在杂草丛生的遗迹里发现随意滚动的POKENAME。它身上苔藓中突出的“石头”，其实是外壳极硬的甜树果。
author: hummusishome
source: POKENAME can be found haphazardly rolling through overgrown ruins. The rocks protruding from the moss growing on them are actually sweet berries with extremely hard shells.

entry: POKENAME大部分时间都在小心维持平衡，好让全身各部件聚在一起。头顶的岩石像声呐，能探知风的变化，帮助它随时调整姿态。
author: hummusishome
source: POKENAME spend most of their time maintaining the delicate balancing act of keeping all of their parts together. They use the rock on the top of their heads like sonar to detect changes in the wind and adapt to them to stay balanced.

entry: POKENAME严守各地草木蔓生的遗迹。它们缓步巡逻领地，始终高度戒备，七只眼睛各自扫视四周。
author: hummusishome
source: Overgrown ruins across the region are ferociously guarded by POKENAME. They lumber through their territory on constant high alert, scanning the area with each of their seven eyes.

entry: 据说，一位伟大的炼金术士曾试着重现雷吉奇卡斯赐给人类的奇迹。他赋予岩石生命，让它们从此永远站岗，守护创造者与其珍宝。
author: doxtordaemon
source: It is said that a great alchemist once sought to recreate the miracle Regigigas bestowed on mankind. Breathing life into rocks that now forever stand watch, guarding their creator and his treasures.

entry: 它们产生的气体极易燃烧，温度接近摄氏1400度。POKENAME整天坐着烧气，直到最终进化。
author: hummusishome
source: The gas they create is highly flammable and burns at close to 1400 degrees Celsius. POKENAME sit around burning this gas all day until they eventually evolve.

entry: POKENAME一移动，背上排列的石头就会开裂，放出极易燃烧的气体。受威胁时，它们会主动将气体点燃。
author: hummusishome
source: As POKENAME move, cracks form in the stones lining their backs, releasing highly flammable gas. They ignite this gas voluntarily when threatened.

entry: POKENAME外壳的特殊气孔，会排出体内产生的易燃废气。气体究竟由什么化学成分构成，仍不得而知。
author: hummusishome
source: Specialized vents in the outer shells of POKENAME expel the flammable gas they produce as a waste product. The true chemical composition of this gas is still unknown.

entry: POKENAME从某地取来石头，纳入身体，就能与当地相连，感知那里的过去与未来。人们相信，只要收集足够多的太空岩石，它就能看见宇宙诞生。
author: soup1900
source: When POKENAME takes a rock from an area and adds it to its body, it's able to link to and sense both the past and future of that region. It is believed that with enough rocks from outer space, it gains the ability to view the birth of the universe.

entry: POKENAME停在崖顶，数小时纹丝不动。它这样做，是为了保护自己领地内山谷中的所有岩属性宝可梦。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME perches atop cliff tops, remaining motionless for hours. It does this to protect all Rock-types along the valleys it claims as its territories.

entry: POKENAME是行动缓慢的沙漠拾荒者，藏在岩群中，直到夜幕降临。有时也会偷走熟睡旅人的小饰品。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a slow-moving desert scavenger that hides among rock formations until nightfall. It has been known to pilfer trinkets from sleeping travelers on occasion.

entry: POKENAME住在覆雪的高高山丘，欣赏冰湖映出的天空。可一发现训练家站在自己上方，就会害怕，引发山体滑坡，将自身藏起。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME lives high up in snow-covered hills, admiring the reflection of the sky in frozen lakes, but if it finds itself below a Trainer it will feel scared and hide itself by causing a landslide.

entry: POKENAME背上突出的石头，由类似石棉或铅的有毒材料构成。若睡觉时受打扰，就将背石磨成细粉，向敌人扬撒毒尘。
author: quackquackattack
source: The stones that gut out from POKENAME's back are made of a toxic material similar to asbestos or lead. When disturbed from their slumber, they grind the stones on their back into a fine powder before unleashing toxic dust over foes.

entry: POKENAME看似有两个独立身体，其实共用一个意识，行动一致。神秘叫声与符号般的身体，让网友制作起这种融合体的搞笑图片。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: While POKENAME appears to have two separate bodies, they share one mind and act in unison. POKENAME's cryptic cry and symbolic body have led the people on the internet to create joke images of this fusion.

entry: POKENAME只有住在全黑之处才满足，谁把光带入巢穴，它就会暴走。科学研究发现，它似乎没有脑，也没有任何实体器官代替脑的作用。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME will only be content if it lives in total darkness and will rampage if anyone brings light into its lair. Scientific studies have determined that POKENAME appears to lack a brain or any kind of physical substitute.

entry: POKENAME会成群警觉地停在结实树上。谁在树下歇脚，就会被它们用石头身体俯冲轰击。
author: lampent12
source: A flock of POKENAME will perch vigilantly in a sturdy tree. If anyone stops to rest under their tree, they will divebomb with their stone bodies.

entry: POKENAME常只将头状石块露在沙上，因此在沙漠家园中很难被察觉。猎物靠近，它便醒来，迅速扑上去，用沙状身体将其闷住。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are often spotted with just the head-like rock lying atop sand, which causes them to go unnoticed in their desert homes. When prey draws close, they awaken and quickly move to smother them with their sand-like bodies.

entry: POKENAME缓缓巡行古代遗迹，用石灰石修补身体。因为每走一步，身体都会渐渐磨成细沙。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME can be seen slowly patrolling ancient ruins, using the limestone to rebuild its body. This is because as it moves, its body slowly grinds down to a fine sand.

entry: 它蜷起身体，就像一堆大小石块，借此避开其他生物。多块石头组成的“象鼻”，能轻松举起大卡车。
author: infinex21
source: By curling upon itself, it can appear as a cluster of rocks and boulders in order to avoid others. Its "trunk" of multiple rocks is strong enough to lift a large truck with ease.

entry: 出现在电脑中的POKENAME，常是未组装的状态，需要用户动手拼好。弄清哪个部件放在哪里，也正是与它相处的乐趣之一。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME that appear on PCs are often unassembled and require user input to put them together. The puzzle of figuring out which parts go where is part of the fun when dealing with POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME每次战斗后，都会稍微改变身体，从地上收集石头，附在四肢。久而久之，这些石头也会塑造它擅长的格斗技巧。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME alters its body slightly after every battle, gathering stones from the ground and attaching them to its limbs. Over time these stones will help shape the fighting techniques it specializes in.

entry: 野生POKENAME需要休息、恢复力量时，常静止不动，融进岩地。它能相当轻松地举起体型两倍的巨石，还会用毁灭性的破坏光线保卫家园。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME often go immobile and blend into their rocky environments when they need to rest and regain their strength. They can lift boulders twice their size with relative ease and defend their homes with destructive Hyper Beams.

entry: 古庙中发现的石雕，似乎描绘着POKENAME，至今令科学家困惑。比例虽然稍有偏差，对它特征的描绘却明确无误。
author: .izik
source: Stone carvings in ancient temples have been found that appear to depict POKENAME, confusing scientists to this day. While the proportions are slightly askew, the references to its features are unmistakable.

entry: POKENAME的岩石身体头重脚轻，走路时常向前踉跄。每逢受惊，就发出神秘叫声，头顶羽毛也迸出火焰。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME's rocky body makes it top-heavy, causing it to stumble forward as it walks. Whenever it is startled, POKENAME lets out a cryptic cry accompanied by a burst of fire from the feathers on its head.

entry: POKENAME由精神意识维系沙石而成，能随意分离、操纵岩石部件。据说只要核心石头完好，无论受何损伤，都能重塑自己。
author: sk372
source: Composed of sand and stone held together via a psychic consciousness, POKENAME can separate and manipulate its rocky parts at will. It's said that as long as its core stone is intact, it can reform itself from any damage.

entry: POKENAME住在古墓深处，内部各处都铺满尖石与沙。它制造水的幻象，引来迷路、缺水的登山男，再用数磅岩石将对方活埋。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME reside deep in ancient tombs, coating each surface inside with jagged rocks and sand. It lures in lost, dehydrated Hikers, creating mirages of water before burying the Hiker alive with pounds of rocks.

entry: POKENAME将能量集中到背上朱砂晶体，就能悬浮，甚至操纵石块碎片。谁威胁领地，它就会给石头涂上汞，驱赶对方。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: By focusing energy into the cinnabar crystals on their backs, POKENAME can levitate and even manipulate fragments of stones. If someone threatens a POKENAME's territory, it will coat its stones in mercury to repel them.

entry: 这大团活岩石用较小的身体作诱饵，将敌人与猎物一同引入洞窟般的巨口。等对方走得太深、无法逃走，洞穴般的双颚便合拢，最终将里面的一切消化。
author: infinex21
source: This massive cluster of living rock uses its smaller body as a decoy to lure foes and prey alike into its cavernous maw. Once they are too far within to escape, its cave-like jaws seal shut and all within are eventually digested.

entry: 它厚实的头骨，无论光滑程度还是颜色，都像光滑泥球。为了保持顺滑，会用头蹭岩石，打磨头骨。
author: quackquackattack
source: Its thickened skull resembles a Polished Mud Ball in smoothness and color. To maintain its smoothness, it rubs its head against rocks to polish its skull.

entry: POKENAME跺脚时，前方地面就会升起巨大石柱。石柱似乎不易被侵蚀，已确认有数千年历史的样本，看起来仍崭新如初。
author: sk372
source: When POKENAME stomps its feet, great stone pillars rise from the ground in front of it. These pillars seem resistant to erosion, as specimens identified as thousands of years old still appear brand new.

entry: 古代战士曾挥舞POKENAME作为武器，它一挥就能让大地震动。如今游荡岩山，将巨石粉碎成能吃的块状，吸收进身体。
author: santon5512
source: Once wielded by ancient warriors, POKENAME hold the power to send tremors through the ground with a single swing. They roam rocky mountains, crushing boulders into edible chunks and absorbing them into their bodies.

entry: 刀刃用来切开岩石。若POKENAME身体有部位崩落，这些石料，便能拿来修补。
author: .flipside3
source: Its blades are used to cut through rock. POKENAME uses this rock to repair itself if parts of it break off.

entry: POKENAME劈中敌人时，岩刃会崩下碎片，让对方身上再添割伤、瘀伤。它操纵其他宝可梦为自己添石，能把剑与盾扩大得无比巨大。
author: soup1900
source: When POKENAME slashes a foe, bits of its rocky blade break off and cause more cuts and bruises to appear across the enemy's body. By manipulating other Pokémon to attach stones to it, POKENAME can grow its sword and shield to be gigantic.

entry: 它会替换所有受损石头，不过对替换材料十分挑剔。闪光的节奏有近似潜意识暗示的作用，能在战斗爆发前，平息躁动。
author: infinex21
source: It replaces any of its damaged stones, though it is quite picky about which stones it will replace them with. Its patterns of flashing lights have an effect akin to subliminal messaging, which subdues agitation before a fight might break out.

entry: 它游荡广大的地下洞穴网络，聚集岩属性宝可梦，建立王国。POKENAME守护王国时若掉了石头，臣民就会替它修补。
author: bandedbodypress
source: It roams vast underground cave networks, amassing kingdoms of Rock-type Pokémon. If it ever loses a stone protecting its kingdom, POKENAME's subjects will repair POKENAME.

entry: 据说POKENAME漫游大海，收集残骸与岩石，扩大威风的石鳍。传闻尾巴只需一动，就能掀起毁灭性的海啸。
author: fiordaliso
source: It is said that POKENAME roams the seas collecting debris and rocks to expand its majestic stone fins. Rumor has it that a single movement of its tail can unleash devastating tsunamis.

entry: 战斗中岩石碎裂时，POKENAME会操纵时间，将其恢复。不过这并不让它无敌，用得太多，也可能失去战斗能力。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: If its rocks break in battle, POKENAME use their time manipulation to restore them back together. This ability does not make it invincible, as POKENAME can faint from overusing it.

entry: POKENAME一听见有人靠近，就成群布置在山口。人走得太近，它们便用投石机发射巨石，引发突如其来的岩崩。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME swarms position themselves along mountain passes when they hear people approaching. They launch boulders from their catapult when people get too close, triggering impromptu Rock Slides.

entry: POKENAME极害羞，会借岩石身体伪装成不动的雕像，躲避陌生者。若不得不战斗，就会挥动头上细长岩块，力道足以将树打成两截。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are incredibly shy and will utilize their rock bodies to pose as inanimate statues to avoid strangers. If given cause to fight, they will swing the long rock formations on their heads around with enough force to snap a tree in half.

entry: POKENAME沉稳坚定，极少回应威胁或危险。唯独被碰耳朵时，会突然膨胀成巨大的体型，吓退敢碰这敏感部位的生物。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME behaves in a steadfast manner, rarely responding to threats or dangers. The only exception is if its ears are touched, whereupon it suddenly inflates to a massive size to scare off whatever dares to touch such sensitive spots.

entry: POKENAME岩石般坚硬的双颚，一口就能把最结实的石头咬成粉。它常吃岩石，将矿物存进体内，再嗝出细小沙云，驱赶、扰乱攻击者。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's rock-solid jaws can crush even the solidest of stones into powder with a single bite. It consumes rocks regularly, storing the minerals within and belching them out as miniature sand clouds to deter and disorient attackers.

entry: POKENAME沉重的石头身体，总会重新摔回地面。可它依然不停跳跃、尝试飞行，决心有朝一日翱翔云上。
author: sk372
source: Its heavy stone body is always tumbling back to the ground. POKENAME never stops leaping and attempting to fly, however; it's determined to soar above the clouds one day.

entry: 据说POKENAME携带着数千年前人们的记忆。身体哪处受损，就会慌忙添上更多石头。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME are said to carry the memories of people who lived thousands of years ago. It frantically attaches more rocks to its body if any part is damaged.

entry: 古人曾用POKENAME的石牙当野外工具，砍断路上一切障碍。它将世界各地的岩石纳入身体。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: People in ancient times once used POKENAME's stone tusks as field tools to cut down any obstacle in their path. It incorporates rocks from around the world into its body.

entry: POKENAME嵌进裸露的岩层，在同一处待上几个月，吸取周围养分。待得足够久后，就会冲破头顶堆积的石块，常因此引发山崩。
author: hummusishome
source: POKENAME embed themselves into rocky outcroppings and spend months in one spot absorbing nutrients around them. Once they've spent enough time in one place, they break through the rocks that have accumulated above them, often causing rockslides.

entry: POKENAME缓缓滚过岩地，触角在地上犁出深痕。它吸收滚过的石头，增大体型，也增强防御。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME rolls slowly through rocky areas, leaving deep gashes in the ground with its antennae. It absorbs rocks it rolls over to increase its size and defenses.

entry: POKENAME虽罕见，偶尔仍能在野外发现。人们相信，它们是朽木妖的木身，石化而来。
author: cristata
source: While rare, POKENAME have sometimes been spotted in the wild. It is believed they're the result of a Trevenant's wooden body undergoing petrification.

entry: POKENAME大半生都在寻找走路草一家。找到后，便引它们到古老岩群旁，静止不动。研究者不清楚这有何意义，毕竟走路草常毫无兴趣地摇摆走开。
author: theaceofhearts0306
source: POKENAME spends most of its life searching for families of Oddish. Once it finds one, it guides them to ancient rock formations and becomes very still. Researchers are unsure of their significance, as the Oddish often waddle away uninterested.

entry: POKENAME游荡沙漠，寻找大石块，添进身体。看似吓人，其实颇温柔，会载上疲惫旅人同行。
author: mcnchsschl
source: POKENAME wanders the desert, searching for large rocks to add to its body. Although it appears intimidating, it will give weary travelers a ride, and it's actually quite gentle.

entry: POKENAME在冰川底部形成，庞大冰体沉重的底部，压迫、摩擦下方基岩。它从冰川的冰碛处现身，身体由冰与石混合构成。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME form at the bottom of glaciers, the heavy base of the immense ice structures putting pressure on and grinding against the underlying bedrock. POKENAME emerge at the moraine of the glacier, their bodies a composite of ice and stone.

entry: POKENAME在冰川底部形成，庞大冰体沉重的底部，压迫、摩擦下方基岩。它从冰川的冰碛处现身，身体由冰与石混合构成。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME form at the bottom of glaciers, the heavy base of the immense ice structures putting pressure on and grinding against the underlying bedrock. POKENAME emerge at the moraine of the glacier, their bodies a composite of ice and stone.

entry: POKENAME以干燥峡谷为家，在岩石间的裂隙筑巢。附近长着岩石般的蘑菇，通常能借此找出巢穴。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME makes its home in dry canyon areas, nesting in the crags between rocks. One can typically tell where its layer is located thanks to rock-like mushrooms growing in the vicinity.

entry: POKENAME用音响系统播放轰鸣摇滚乐。音量开到最大，混响足以震碎周围最硬的石头，轻易赶走入侵者。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME utilizes its sound system to play booming rock music. At max volume, the reverb could shatter the hardest stone around it and easily send intruders packing.

entry: POKENAME背上的巨石，为周围一圈蘑菇遮阴。虽然真菌慢慢消化着构成身体的岩石，它仍会倾斜身子，护着它们免受伤害。
author: .jerden
source: The giant rock on POKENAME's back provides shade for a ring of mushrooms growing around it. Although these fungi slowly digest the rocks POKENAME is made of, it will tilt its body to shield them from harm.

entry: POKENAME通常出现在易发泥石流的峡谷池塘，因此极难见到。
author: seanothan_23
source: A POKENAME sighting is extremely rare as it is usually found in ponds located in canyons with high chances of mudslides.

entry: POKENAME的身体由散落巨石与宝石组成，据说宝石会像太阳一样发光。山区天气恶劣时，能看见它用闪光指引旅人，前往安全地带。
author: ruben2309295
source: A POKENAME's body is made from a combination of stray boulders and gems that are said to glow like the sun. During harsh weather in the mountains, POKENAME can be seen using their glimmering light to guide travellers to safety.

entry: POKENAME笨重前行，收集硬币、亮石与小饰物，必要时甚至直接从其他生物那里抢来。它藏在选定地点，奇怪地按近似脸上花纹的图案摆好。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME gathers coins, shiny stones and other trinkets as it lumbers around, even physically stealing it from others if need be. It hoards them in select spots, and strangely keeps them organized in patterns resembling the one on its face.

entry: POKENAME在火山地区生活得很好。身体虽然大多是岩石，跑起来依旧快得惊人。不过，它不太聪明，容易受伤；倒也无妨，因为换上新石头，就能重建身体。
author: lootererswillbeboated
source: POKENAME thrives in volcanic areas. Even though its body is comprised mostly of rocks, it can still run at amazing speeds. However, it is not very intelligent and is prone to injury. This doesn't matter, though: it can rebuild itself with new rocks.

entry: POKENAME周身包着薄而坚实的石层，容纳过热的核心。野生个体环游世界，在临时拼起的外壳上添各种石块，再用热将其熔接。
author: npshi
source: POKENAME have a thin, sturdy layer of stone that surrounds their bodies, which serves as a container for their superheated core. Wild POKENAME travel the world, attaching various rocks to their improvised shell and using heat to fuse them together.

entry: 科学家仍在试图了解POKENAME的燃烧反应。不过，至今还没有谁能靠得够近，又不被尾巴轰击。
author: notsaying.
source: Scientists are still trying to understand the combustion reactions of POKENAME. However, nobody has been able to get close enough to it without being blasted by its tail.

entry: 它能支配岩石，用连自己也打不碎的最硬石块，打造外部身体。据说，最喜爱的那块，会摆在腰部正上方。
author: bobosmith01
source: It has dominion over rocks, and it crafts its outer body out of the sturdiest stones that even it can't manage to break. Apparently, it places its favorite stone just above the waist.

entry: POKENAME有四只巨大岩拳，身体也由实心石头组成，攻防都很惊人。它常先承受对手攻击，展示自身坚韧，再打出决定性一击。
author: bluenido.
source: With four massive rock fists and a body of solid stone, POKENAME possesses formidable offense and defense. It frequently endures an opponent's attacks to display its rugged durability before launching a decisive strike.

entry: POKENAME几乎不动，将自己伪装成雕像。根从底部扎进地下，吸收水分与珍贵矿物，维持岩石身体。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are largely immobile, instead disguising themselves as statues. Their roots sink into the ground from their base, absorbing water and valuable minerals that they use to maintain their rocky bodies.

entry: POKENAME刚起跑时动作迟缓，随后迅速加速。它驰骋峡谷，吃下石头，化为身体的一部分，增大体型、增强力量。
author: sk372
source: When POKENAME begins to run, its movements begin sluggishly before quickly gathering speed. It gallops across canyons, feeding on stones that will become part of its body and increase its size and strength.

entry: POKENAME经过的地面，会自行变成带规律凸纹的形状。近年，人们利用这特点，迅速为新路铺出盲道，让通行更便利。
author: deadshields
source: Terrain that POKENAME moves over spontaneously warps into a bumpy, patterned texture. In recent years, this trait has been used to quickly produce tactile paving for new roads, making them more accessible.

entry: POKENAME一天大多时间静止不动，常被当成雕像或岩群。每天只动一次，走入水中，砸开大舌贝的壳，再将其吃掉。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME stays still for much of the day, often being mistaken for a statue or rock formation. It only moves once a day to go into the water and smash the shells of Shellders before eating them.

entry: 一群摄影师最早发现POKENAME，当时还以为只是岩群。岩石身体大多藏在沙中，耐心等毫无防备的宝可梦爬上来，再将它们拖下沙里。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME was first discovered by a group of photographers, believing it to simply be a rock formation. Most of their rocky bodies are hidden by the sand, waiting patiently for unsuspecting Pokémon to climb on their bodies so they can pull them under.

entry: 一群摄影师最早发现POKENAME，当时还以为只是岩群。岩石身体大多藏在沙中，耐心等毫无防备的宝可梦爬上来，再将它们拖下沙里。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME was first discovered by a group of photographers, believing it to simply be a rock formation. Most of their rocky bodies are hidden by the sand, waiting patiently for unsuspecting Pokémon to climb on their bodies so they can pull them under.

entry: 这种融合体，最初发现于积雪苔原。POKENAME放出的闪电，不留灼伤，反在皮肤上结出片片冰。
author: chorb33
source: This fusion was first discovered in a snowy tundra. POKENAME emits lightning that leaves patches of ice on the skin instead of burns.

entry: POKENAME向四面八方放出强力闪电，所到之处，留下厚厚冰层。这特性，近来引起了科学家兴趣。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME emits strong lightning in all directions, leaving behind thick layers of ice. This property has recently aroused the interest of scientists.

entry: POKENAME用坚实的北极冰块，雕出棍棒与头盔，更好地度过冰原荒地。手持冰块既是坚固武器，也能让它在战斗中发射冰寒光束。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME carves itself a club and helmet out of solid arctic ice to better survive the frozen wastes. The ice shard it holds is a solid weapon, and also lets it fire freezing beams in combat.

entry: 头盔与冰制棍棒已和身体融为一体，让POKENAME全身变成实冰。如今，它能冻结空气中的水蒸气，源源不绝地造出新的冰武器战斗。
author: sk372
source: The helmet and ice club it wields have merged with it, making POKENAME's entire body solid ice. It can now freeze water vapor in the air to create an infinite supply of new ice weapons to battle with.

entry: POKENAME虽由实冰构成，却轻得出奇，很容易留在空中。它放出的冰寒雾气，被吸入后会让身体发麻。
author: infinex21
source: Despite being made of solid ice, POKENAME are surprisingly light and stay aloft with little issue. The frigid haze they exude has a numbing effect on those who inhale it.

entry: 训练家把铁甲蛹遗弃在霜抹山，才形成这种天然融合体。它梦想着进化，再回来复仇。
author: dodoowner_
source: This natural fusion occured when a Trainer abandoned a Metapod in the Glaseado Mountains. It dreams of evolving and getting revenge.

entry: POKENAME吸收空气中的水分，在体内冻结，让自己永远冰冷、坚实。水中杂质则随冰雾排出，一碰到生物就能将其冻住。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME absorbs ambient moisture in the air and freezes it within its body to keep itself eternally cool and solid. Impurities within the moisture are expelled via clouds of chilling mist that can freeze those they touch.

entry: POKENAME由两只雷吉弹相撞而成，极低温让身体融合在一起。如今，冰寒毒雾更为强劲，大多数吸入者都会发麻、昏昏欲睡。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME is the result of two Regifing colliding and their bodies fusing together due to their extreme cold temperatures. The cold, toxic haze it emits has grown strong enough to numb and lull most who inhale it.

entry: 世界上许多著名河谷，都是POKENAME迁徙后留下的。从冰河时代起，它们就在改变地貌。
author: notadoctor75
source: Many of the most notable river valleys in the world have been formed in the wake of POKENAME migrations. They have been transforming landscapes since the ice age.

entry: POKENAME冰翼扬起的飞雪，会先使敌人入睡，几分钟后再将其冻住。这是登山者命丧雪峰最常见的原因之一。
author: rockageddon
source: POKENAME's glacial wings produce flurries that will put opponents to sleep, then freeze them after a few minutes. This is one of the most common ways hikers pass away on snowy peaks.

entry: POKENAME高傲又自恋。谁不肯好好陶醉于它的美丽荣光，就会因这份无礼，被狂暴风雪招呼。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME displays a lot of haughty and self-absorbed behavior. Those that don't properly bask in its beautiful glory will be hit with a raging blizzard for their impertinence.

entry: POKENAME被饲养在特殊的家用水族箱中，水里掺矿物，降低冰点。它体温低于水的冰点，摸起来十分寒冷。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME is kept in specialized home aquariums, where the water is mixed with minerals to lower the freezing point. Its body temperature is below the freezing point of water, making it cold to the touch.

entry: POKENAME与同群成员一道，以惊人速度滑过冻原。虽然少见，一旦被发现，便会全体在原地猛烈使出跃起，吓退天敌。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME slides across tundras at incredible speeds alongside other members of its school. Sightings are rare, but when spotted, they will all hop in place in a furious Splash to scare away predators.

entry: POKENAME的身体由奇异的物质构成，即使比冰点低上几百度，仍柔软得能随意变形。任何东西一碰到这团黏液，就会瞬间冻结。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's body is made out of a strange substance that somehow stays soft and malleable even hundreds of degrees below freezing. Anything that comes in contact with the slime will freeze instantly.

entry: POKENAME哪怕只部分沾水，也能近乎隐形。世界极北之地，那些看不见的冰山撞沉船只的古老故事，或许其实与附近生活的它有关。
author: bobosmith01
source: If even partially doused in water, POKENAME can become nearly invisible. Old tales of invisible icebergs that sunk ships in the far north of the world may have actually been the result of POKENAME living nearby.

entry: 初秋，POKENAME将自己冻在池塘里，储备进化能量。直到春分到来，才会再度现身。
author: dodoowner_
source: At the start of autumn, POKENAME freezes itself in ponds to conserve energy for evolution. It will not reappear until the spring equinox arrives.

entry: POKENAME再生能力惊人，只要头还在，整个身体都能长得完好如初。身上的绿球是浓缩化学物质，无物不溶。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME have amazing regenerative abilities; as long as its head remains, it can grow its body back good as new. The green orbs on its body are a concentrated chemical that can melt through anything.

entry: 这些贪玩的宝可梦，常在雪地打滚，实冰身体很容易沾满雪。因为太容易越滚越失控，附近常立有标牌，提醒训练家留意它们。
author: infinex21
source: These playful Pokémon are often witnessed rolling across fields of snow, which easily cling to their bodies made of solid ice. There are often signs warning Trainers of their presence due to how easy it can be for them to roll out of control.

entry: POKENAME最常在南北极之间迁徙时被看见。若在其他地方长期逗留，当地往往会出现有记录以来的最低温。
author: icelevelincarnate
source: POKENAME are most commonly seen when migrating between the North Pole and South Pole. Any other areas where POKENAME stay for an extended period of time tend to experience their lowest recorded temperatures.

entry: POKENAME受到挑衅时，能制造猛烈暴风雪，十分危险。它对环境极其敏感，因此冬季将尽，就会退回山中。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME are capable of creating violent blizzards when provoked, making them incredibly dangerous. They are highly sensitive to their environment, so when the winter season nears its end, they retreat back into the mountains.

entry: POKENAME让冷空气沿翼尖流转，飞行中展现出绚丽冰霜。突然遭遇暴雪的旅人，常说看见它的身影掠过头顶。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME circulates freezing air through the tips of its wings, creating a stunning display of icy frost mid-flight. Travelers who find themselves faced with sudden snowstorms often report seeing its silhouette overhead.

entry: 这种极其罕见的宝可梦，住在最寒冷环境的深处。收藏家渴求它冰体的蓝色光泽，视其为财富与好运的象征。
author: .realthree
source: This exceedingly rare Pokémon lives deep in the coldest of environments. The blue sheen of its icy body is coveted by collectors as a symbol of wealth and luck.

entry: POKENAME的超能力潜能庞大，单凭心念就能造出冰冻飞射物。被冰片击中者，迅速冻成冰块或被精神能量震得晕眩，两者机会相同。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's vast psychic potential lets it create frozen projectiles through sheer force of mind. Those hit by these shards have an equal change of being rapidly frozen solid or dazed by psychic energies.

entry: 从POKENAME采集的冰中，发现了DNA痕迹。每块冰都有不同宝可梦的DNA，甚至包括野外已灭绝数千年的种类。
author: imaginita
source: Ice collected from POKENAME has been found to contain traces of DNA. Each fragment of ice has the DNA of a different Pokémon, including Pokémon that have been extinct in the wild for thousands of years.

entry: POKENAME一察觉暴风雪将至，就离开冰洞，为花草树木覆上保护霜层。它欢迎需要冬眠的宝可梦进洞，提供安全的休息地点。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME emerge from icy caverns at the signs of approaching snowstorms in order to coat flowers and trees in protective layers of frost. They welcome Pokémon that need to hibernate into their caverns so that they have a safe place to rest.

entry: POKENAME身体极冷，连颈边迸出的火焰都无法将其融化。它常先用冰寒吐息造出冰道，再以火焰推进身体，撞向敌人。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's body is so cold that not even the flames that burst free around its neck can melt it. It often creates a path of ice using its frigid breath and then launches itself with its flames to hurl itself into its opponents.

entry: POKENAME的丝网既冷又耐火，可用于制作消防装备，让消防员在猛烈大火中保持凉爽。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME's webbing is fire-resistant as well as cold, allowing it to be used in equipment for firefighters to keep them cool when battling intense blazes.

entry: POKENAME结出的网，浸满过冷水。毫无防备的人或宝可梦一碰上，水便瞬间冻结，将其困住，直到它从隐蔽巢穴中降下。
author: divinelunaria
source: POKENAME spin webs drenched in supercooled water. When unsuspecting Pokémon or people touch the webs, the water instantly freezes. This traps the victim long enough for POKENAME to descend from their hidden dens.

entry: 需要快速移动时，POKENAME将脚下地面冻住，再用细尾在冰面滑行。
author: hophoppip
source: When it needs to move quickly, POKENAME freezes the ground beneath it, then skates across the ice on its thin tail.

entry: POKENAME极少移动，常被当成冰山。它排出的薄膜，能将碰到的雪直接化为冰。皮肤坚韧，连冰锥也刺不穿。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME is often mistaken for an iceberg as it rarely moves. It excretes a thin film that turns any snow it touches straight to ice. Its skin is so tough that even an Ice Pick cannot pierce it.

entry: POKENAME极少移动，常被当成冰山。它排出的薄膜，能将碰到的雪直接化为冰。凝视它的许多眼睛，会让体温骤降。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME is often mistaken for an iceberg, as it rarely moves. It excretes a thin film that turns any snow it touches straight to ice. Looking into its many eyes causes your body temperature to drop drastically.

entry: POKENAME的冰体，即使整天晒太阳也不会融化。它能调整姿势，让透明冰体折射、汇聚阳光，迸出亮光，暂时晃盲敌人。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's icy body does not melt, even if it spends the whole day in the sun. POKENAME can position its body so that the clear ice refracts and focuses sunlight, creating bright flashes to temporarily blind foes.

entry: POKENAME的冰体中，休眠着许多病原体。受威胁时，会从背上的种子放出，常让攻击者重病一场。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: Many pathogens lie dormant within POKENAME's icy body. It releases the pathogens from the bulb on its back when threatened, often causing severe illness in the attacker.

entry: 背后的花朵，几秒内便能冻住附近的一切。北极光升起时，常能看到成群POKENAME，躺在光幕下面休息。
author: skymaster426
source: The flower on its back can freeze anything near it within seconds. When the aurora borealis starts, groups of POKENAME can be sighted resting below.

entry: POKENAME附近若有大冰块，就会被不明力量一点点削成字母形状。不清楚这是否是它有意尝试交流。
author: sk372
source: If POKENAME is in the presence of large chunks of ice, the chunks will start being chipped away by an unknown source until it resembles letters. It's unclear if this is an intentional attempt at communication or not.

entry: POKENAME极胆小，常待在地下，只到地面吃树果、喝水，维持冰体。它时刻担心，自己的冰身体会被打碎或融化。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are very timid Pokémon that often remain underground, only surfacing to feed upon berries and to drink water which helps sustain their bodies of ice. They live in constant fear of their ice bodies being shattered or melted.

entry: POKENAME能瞬间冻住空气中的微粒，用浮空冰片挡下攻击。即使地底深处压力与温度升高，它也能像在地面一样，轻易冻住一切。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME can instantly freeze particles in the air and use these floating ice pieces to block opponents' attacks. Even when deep underground where pressure and heat are increased, it can freeze anything just as easily as it can on the surface.

entry: POKENAME零度以下的冰体，在地底高压、高温下，连裂纹也不会出现。穿透冰川与冰原的奇怪洞穴，很可能是它一路啃出的。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's subzero, icy body doesn't so much as crack under underground high pressure and heat. Strange holes found going through glaciers and ice sheets are likely caused by POKENAME chomping through them.

entry: POKENAME身上的冰十分耐热，让它能住在温暖气候。它的角力大，足以掀翻波士可多拉，也确实曾在领地争端中这样做。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: The ice on POKENAME's body is highly resistant to heat, allowing them to live in warmer climates. POKENAME have the strength to flip over Aggron using their horn and have been documented doing so during territorial disputes.

entry: POKENAME在冰川巢穴中，用爪在巨冰侧面刻下深痕，标记领地。面对入侵者，便从躯干圆点射出环状排列的冰冻光束。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME marks territory in its glacial lair by carving deep claw marks in the sides of giant ice chunks. It fires out a circular arrangement of Ice Beams from the dots on its torso when facing down intruders.

entry: POKENAME的壳由蓝冰构成，晶体结构没有丝毫杂质或气泡。它住在冰川，慢慢在冰冷家园中钻出条条地道。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME shells are formed of blue ice, the shell's crystalline structure containing no traces of impurities or bubbles. They make their home within glaciers, slowly boring tunnels throughout their icy home.

entry: POKENAME的壳由蓝冰构成，晶体结构没有丝毫杂质或气泡。全球气温升高，种群不断退向高山，因此越来越少见。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME shells are formed of blue ice, the shell's crystalline structure containing no traces of impurities or bubbles. They are becoming a steadily rarer sight as their populations retreat high into the mountains due to rising global temperatures.

entry: POKENAME的冰奇特地能反射、封存热量，因而极难融化。壳内明亮火焰经冰折射，映出绚烂光影，让观者欢喜。
author: katieplaysgames
