source: POKENAME ice has the strange property of reflecting and containing heat, making them very resistant to melting. The bright flame within their shell creates a dazzling light display, refracting through the ice and delighting those who see it.

entry: 除了纯实冰的壳，它全身极像液态氦。身体很容易裹进冰雪，随后便可将其喷出自卫。
author: infinex21
source: Its entire body is incredibly similar to liquid helium, save for its shell that is simply made of solid ice. Its body easily tracks ice and snow within it, which it can expel to defend itself.

entry: 有时能看见POKENAME漫无目的地漂在极地海域，冰壳让它浮在海面。若冰山飘得够近，就会爬上去搭乘，盼着返回冰原。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME can sometimes be seen floating aimlessly through polar waters, their icy shell allowing them to bob along the surface of the ocean. The climb aboard icebergs if they drift close enough, riding them in the hopes of returning to the ice sheet.

entry: POKENAME即使部件分离也能运作，拼好后却才能发挥全部潜力。谁肯花时间，细心完成复杂的组装，就会得到永远忠诚、无比强大的伙伴。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can function while in its detached state, but reaches full potential when put together. Those that take the time to meticulously complete the complex process of building it will gain an eternally loyal and greatly powerful ally.

entry: POKENAME栖居的洞里，摆满自己雕刻的华美冰雕。若成群合作，冰雕最高可达100英尺。
author: mistymagius
source: Caves where POKENAME lives are filled with gorgeous ice sculptures that it carved itself. Groups of POKENAME can create sculptures up to 100 feet high.

entry: 奇怪的是，POKENAME看不见任何器官，只有本该是心脏的地方有个毒囊。它的酸液几乎能溶解任何材料，训练家接触时，务必极其小心。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME curiously has no visible organs other than a poison sac where its heart should be. The acid it produces can melt nearly any material, so any Trainer handling it must be extremely cautious.

entry: POKENAME能以闪电般的速度移动。直路上，几乎可以无限加速。可惜冰体摩擦太低，转不了弯，常撞上障碍才猛然停住。
author: jadey.1557
source: POKENAME can move at the speed of lightning. When on a straight path, it can accelerate nearly infinitely. Unfortunately, due to the low friction of its icy body, it can't take corners and will often come to an abrupt stop by hitting obstacles.

entry: POKENAME的核心让它能随意制造浓密暴雪，多只眼睛让它在风暴中心也看得清清楚楚。它遮住身形，暗中袭击，强行逐走冰山家园的入侵者。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's core lets it generate a thick blizzard of snow on command, its multiple eyes giving it perfect visual clarity in the heart of the storm. It obscures itself to strike unseen and forcefully banish intruders in its icy mountain home.

entry: POKENAME的许多实冰羽毛，内部闪耀着彩虹色泽。掉落后只有少数能保留，捡到完好羽毛的人，将得到一整年好运。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's many feathers of solid ice glisten and shine with the colors of rainbows within them. Only a few of these feathers survive their fall, and those who find ones intact will be blessed with good fortune for a year.

entry: POKENAME是雪中的恶作剧高手，只住在不断降雪、下冰雹的地方。它并无恶意，却会向看见的旅人连掷雪球，直到有人还击。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are snowy tricksters that only live in areas constantly visited by snow or hail. Though not malicious, they will pelt any travelers in their sights with many snowballs until someone fires back.

entry: POKENAME能将自己碎成多块，分别浮在空中。有时会靠这本领躲开攻击。
author: camtft
source: POKENAME can shatter themselves into multiple floating pieces. They sometimes use this ability to dodge attacks.

entry: POKENAME向往森林，却无法适应那里的气候。它用冰肢与触肢，将周围所有动植物冻住，让环境更适合自己。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is attracted to forested areas, but cannot properly survive in the climate. It uses its icy limbs and tendrils to freeze all the flora and fauna in the area to make the land more hospitable for itself.

entry: POKENAME由冻结的荆棘组成。全身冰刺保护它，抵御近身攻击。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME is made up of frozen brambles. The icy spikes covering its body protect it from melee attacks.

entry: POKENAME传递热能的效率极高。冰晶吸收空气中的热，再传向构成另一半身体的熊熊烈火，能量几乎毫无损耗。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME's body is remarkably efficient at transferring thermal energy. Its ice crystals absorb heat from the air, transferring the energy to the blazing inferno that forms the other half of its body with near-perfect conservation of energy.

entry: 它们飞过的地方，都将迎来温柔降雪。只在冬季现身，确保每座城镇，一年至少都能下上一场雪。
author: infinex21
source: Wherever these Pokémon fly shall be graced with a gentle snowfall. They only appear during Winter and ensure that no city or town will be unvisited by at least one snowfall a year.

entry: POKENAME的体温最低可达摄氏零下200度。它常邀请猎物搭乘，等对方冻成冰块，再吃下去。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: The body temperature of POKENAME can reach lows of -200 degrees Celsius. POKENAME frequently offers lifts to its prey, eating them only after they have frozen solid.

entry: POKENAME照料寒冷地区的植物。谁毁掉它种的植被，就会被利尾劈中，封在厚冰里。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME nurtures plants that grow in colder regions. It slashes anyone who destroys the vegetation it planted with its sharp tail, freezing them in a thick layer of ice.

entry: 人们推测POKENAME最初出现在冰河时代，如今栖居冰川之上，由紧密的蓝冰组成。它冷得惊人，登山客最好避开，免得体温过低。
author: katieplaysgames
source: A Pokémon theorised to have first appeared during the Ice Age, POKENAME live atop glaciers in modern times and are formed of densely packed blue ice. They are so cold that hikers are advised to avoid them due to risk of hypothermia.

entry: POKENAME只要出现，附近所有电子设备就一定会彻底死机。之后还可能直接碰机器，让厚冰包住机身，这回是真冻住了。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's presence will, without fail, cause all electronics near it to freeze up completely. It may follow this up by directly touching the machines, freezing them more literally as a thick layer of ice forms around them.

entry: 若遇见彻底冻上的泥塘，很可能里面就住着POKENAME。它不喜欢洁净无瑕，极少远离池塘或泥源，好往冰体上抹泥。
author: sk372
source: Should one come across a muddy pond completely frozen over, it's likely POKENAME is living within. It dislikes being pristine and rarely ventures far from its pond or a source of mud to smear on its icy body.

entry: POKENAME被视为冬天的先驱，光是出现就能冻住湖泊。它冰冷又孤独，据说谁送它一条围巾，谁就会成为训练家。
author: ghostslythe
source: Considered to be the harbinger of winter, POKENAME's very presence freezes lakes. A cold, lonely Pokémon, it is said whoever offers it a scarf becomes its Trainer.

entry: 传闻POKENAME从冻结数万年的冰川中现身。有人观察到，它们向厚冰内部发出奇怪信号。
author: pattybgoode
source: POKENAME are rumored to have emerged from glaciers frozen for tens of thousands of years. They have been observed sending strange signals into thick ice.

entry: 环绕POKENAME的晶体，由永不融化的纯实冰构成。它将晶体高速旋转，掀起冰寒暴雪，浓得只能看清数英寸之内。
author: sk372
source: The crystals circling POKENAME are made of pure solid ice that never melts. By rotating them at high speeds, it creates freezing snowstorms thick enough to limit visibility to only a few inches.

entry: POKENAME住在冰川洞穴深处，吸入吹进来的冷风。每当北极研究员想研究它所在的洞，就会喷出冰寒强风，任何被吹走的生物，都会严重冻伤。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME dwell deep in glacier caves, inhaling the chilly winds that blow into the cave. Whenever arctic researchers try to study the caves it's in, it blows out chilling gusts that cause extreme frostbite to anything blown away.

entry: POKENAME大半生都静默不动地冥想，所以初被发现时，被当成冰雕。它拥有强大寒气，一次能量脉冲，就能将人彻底冻住。
author: sk372
source: So much of POKENAME's life is spent in silent, still meditation that it was first thought to be an ice-carved statue upon discovery. It possesses a powerful chilling aura that can freeze a person solid with a single pulse of energy.

entry: POKENAME由纯净、永不融化的冰构成。碳定年结果表明，这些冰已冻结超过一亿年。全球变暖后，它们愈发深居不出，极难寻找。
author: dukefrogpeasant
source: A POKENAME is made of pure, never-melting ice. Through carbon dating, this ice has been determined to have been frozen for over one hundred million years. Due to global warming, they have become very secluded, making them very hard to find.

entry: POKENAME全由冰构成，无需进食。不过，敏锐的捕食本能，仍驱使它猎杀那些罕见闯入荒凉冰原家园的猎物。
author: t3isukone
source: Though POKENAME is entirely made of ice and has no need to eat, its keen predatory instincts drive it to hunt the rare prey that enters the desolate ice sheets it calls home.

entry: POKENAME是古老宝可梦，已活过百万年以上，冰体却从未融化。只需喝水便能维生；若有冰块断落，同样的水也会结成新冰补上。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are ancient Pokémon that have lived for over a million years without the ice of their bodies ever melting. They only need to drink water to sustain themselves, and this same water will form new ice should any of their ice break off.

entry: POKENAME由极寒空气构成，毫无防护地靠近，就可能冻伤。它在极寒之地跟随旅人，无形中吸取对方体热，直到猎物倒下。
author: t3isukone
source: POKENAME is composed of air so cold that being near it unprotected can cause frostbite. They follow human travelers in places of extreme cold, invisibly feeding off the travelers' heat until their prey collapses.

entry: POKENAME体型庞大，却仍足够轻，能浮在水面。小型北极宝可梦会聚在它身上。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME is enormous, but still light enough to float on water. Smaller arctic Pokémon gather on top of it.

entry: POKENAME只需一跺蹄，就能竖起雄伟冰柱。这些冰柱似乎不可能融化，甚至有一根在火山深处被发现，仍毫无损坏迹象。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can erect mighty ice pillars with just a single stomp of its hooves. These icy columns seem impossible to melt, as one was even found in the depths of a volcano, showing no signs of deterioration.

entry: 它一见阳光，就会定在原地，像座雕像。不论晒多久，身体都不会融化。
author: h0bojoe
source: It freezes in place like a statue whenever it is exposed to sunlight. No matter how long it remains in the sun, its body never melts.

entry: 背上的山峰，测得的温度始终是华氏零下328度。外壳荒凉、无法居住，正如它战斗时毫不留情的性子。
author: h0bojoe
source: The mountains on its back are perpetually measured at -328 degrees Fahrenheit. The desolate and uninhabitable nature of its shell mirrors its unforgiving nature in battle.

entry: 小型冰属性宝可梦在POKENAME背上筑巢。不过，若没准备好应对极寒，靠得太近就可能瞬间冻成冰块。
author: h0bojoe
source: Small Ice-type Pokémon build their nests on POKENAME's back. However, those unprepared for extreme cold may instantly freeze solid if they approach too closely.

entry: 传说POKENAME拥有灵异力量，能冻结敌人的心与意识，让其永远服从命令。任何刀刃都削不动身体，钢铁武器撞上冰体，反会折断。
author: soup1900
source: Legends tell of POKENAME as having spectral powers that freeze the hearts and minds of its foes, making them forever submissive to its commands. Its body cannot be chipped by any blade, with steel weapons breaking on impact against its ice.

entry: 传闻POKENAME守护着冰洞深处的神秘遗迹。身上冰晶充当催化物，助它发动致命电击。
author: fiordaliso
source: Rumor has it that POKENAME stands guard over mysterious ruins hidden deep within icy caves. The ice crystals on its body act as catalysts for its lethal electric attacks.

entry: POKENAME由美丽澄澈的冰构成，凝视的人会看见真实自我。全身多眼能在敌意刚生时就察觉，瞬间冻住心怀敌意者。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's body is made of a beautifully clear ice that causes those who look into it to see their true selves. With the many eyes throughout its body, it can spot hostility the moment it arises and instantly freeze the source.

entry: 据报道，POKENAME现身之地，便能看见极光。身体虽像覆冰的玻璃，却比多数金属更坚固。
author: pepperthepirate
source: It is reported that, where POKENAME appears, an aurora can be seen. Though its body resembles iced over glass, it is stronger than most metals.

entry: 这些宝可梦似乎只在暴风雪中现身，即使如此，也只能凭明亮黄眼辨认。纯净流雪构成的鬃毛，能制造幻象，将猎物引入冰冷幽暗。
author: infinex21
source: These Pokémon only seem to appear during snowstorms, and even then they are only recognizable by their bright, yellow eyes. Their manes of pure, flowing snow allow them to create illusions that lure prey into cold obscurity.

entry: POKENAME的缎带轻轻一碰，就能将生物彻底冻住。完全冻结前，受害者会涌起极度愉悦，让凝固的冰像永远留着幸福表情。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can freeze beings solid with just a touch of its ribbons. Before they freeze completely, a euphoric sensation flows through the victim, ensuring the frozen statues are stuck in an expression of bliss.

entry: POKENAME将遇见的一切冻住，好用尾巴轻易打得粉碎。身体的紫色部分，其实是冻结、凝固在冰中的毒液。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME freezes over everything it comes by so that it can easily shatter them into smithereens with its tail. The purple sections of its body are actually venom that has frozen over and solidified within its ice.

entry: POKENAME全身由实冰构成，中空处却流动着大量水。无论身体多冷，都能安然游过任何水域，不会将周围的水冻住。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's entire body is made of solid ice yet there is also an abundance of water flowing within its hollow spaces. Despite how cold its body must be, it can swim safely through any water without freezing said water around itself.

entry: 至今，只有一只POKENAME被记录为活动状态，休眠个体却发现过许多。人们推测，若全体同时苏醒，就会迎来另一次冰河时代。
author: bradlybro199
source: Only one POKENAME has ever been recorded as active, though many have been found dormant. It is theorized that if they all awakened at once, another ice age would occur.

entry: 据说，细长冰体让它能飞越太空，寻找流星摧毁，守护世界。它吃下冰雪，帮助盘绕的冰体受损后重新长回。
author: fiordaliso
source: It is said that its long, icy body allows it to fly through outer space in search of meteors to destroy, protecting the world from harm. To regenerate its frozen coils, it feeds on snow and ice to help them grow back.

entry: 据说POKENAME来自宇宙最寒冷的深处，体温仅略高于绝对零度。它会残酷地以寒冰之力，熄灭一切找到的热源。
author: mistymagius
source: Said to have come from the coldest depths of space, POKENAME's body temperature is only barely above absolute zero. It will brutally snuff out any source of heat it can find with its icy powers.

entry: POKENAME的身体由极坚实、近乎无法打破的冰构成。炮口射出的冰冻光束威力极强，几分钟内就能冻住一英里宽的区域。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's body is comprised of extremely solid, nearly unbreakable ice. Ice Beams fired from its cannon are extremely potent and can freeze an area a mile wide within minutes.

entry: 传说POKENAME由冻死者未散的怨恨形成。体温远低于冰点，抓住的任何东西，都会慢慢被冰封住。
author: mepp.
source: According to legend, POKENAME are formed by the lingering grudges of those who perished in the cold. As its body temperature is far below freezing, anything it grips is slowly encased in ice.

entry: POKENAME的身体由等离子体与永远冰冷的冰混合构成。据说，家中冰箱保持运转，就能得到它的祝福。
author: secondatheniangadfly
source: POKENAME's body is composed of a mix of plasma and eternally cold ice. POKENAME is said to bless homes wherein the fridge is left running.

entry: POKENAME看似冻得坚实，其实相当柔韧，活动毫无困难。训练家最好别触碰，因为它冷得只需接触数秒，就可能冻伤。
author: infinex21
source: Although a POKENAME's body appears to be frozen solid, it is actually rather malleable and capable of moving with no difficulty. Trainers are advised to not touch them, for they are so cold that even mere seconds of contact could result in frostbite.

entry: 这只宝可梦，来自迷失北地的旅人充满悲伤的灵魂；旅人的遗体已被实冰封住。它游荡冰原，提醒其他生物，别重蹈自己的覆辙。
author: infinex21
source: This Pokémon is born from the grief-filled soul of a traveler who became lost in northern areas and their body became encased in a chunk of solid ice. They wander frozen plains to warn others to not succumb to the same fate as they once did.

entry: POKENAME的丝由细小冰晶构成，摸着极冷。它常把没吃完的猎物裹进丝中，保存起来，下顿再吃。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's silk is made of small ice crystals, making it incredibly cold to the touch. It will often wrap uneaten prey in its silk to preserve them for a later meal.

entry: POKENAME的球形身体，由永不融化的冰构成。里面每片雪花，都是一个被吞噬的灵魂。
author: hereisanimations
source: POKENAME's globe-like body is composed of ice that will never melt. Every snowflake it contains is a soul that has been consumed.

entry: POKENAME的火焰无声而酷寒，因此不会熔化冰质身体。谁一靠得太近，它便消失。
author: aurange
source: The flames POKENAME produces are silent and freezing cold. As a result, they do not cause its icy body to melt. It vanishes if anyone comes too close.

entry: POKENAME通常住在最高山峰与最冷冰川。身上的束带一取下，就能瞬间冻住周围一切。传说它由雷吉奇卡斯创造，负责守护冰川。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME are typically found on the tallest of mountains and coldest glaciers. When the bands on a POKENAME's body are removed, it can freeze everything around itself instantly. Tales tell of POKENAME being created by Regigigas to guard glaciers.

entry: POKENAME精心制作伪装，尽可能接近冰块。它还在周围产生冷气，装得更像冰，却抵御不了自身力量；用得过头，自己也会冷得发抖。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME carefully fashions its disguise to look as close to ice as possible. It can generate cold air around it to further simulate ice, but isn't resistant to its own power, causing it to get chills if it overdoes it.

entry: POKENAME在冰山内部长大，只有火力足以熔开冰山，才会破冰而出。这确保了它有足够力量生存。
author: bitterchemicalhaze
source: POKENAME grow up inside of icebergs, breaking free only when their fire powers have grown strong enough to melt the iceberg. This ensures POKENAME is strong enough to survive.

entry: POKENAME的冰体格外坚实，能安全地以超音速飞行。受伤后，便飞进地球高层大气，让身体重新结冰疗伤。
author: staghorn
source: The ice composing a POKENAME's body is uniquely sturdy, allowing it to safely fly at supersonic speeds. It heals its wounds by flying into the Earth's upper atmosphere and letting its body ice over once more.

entry: POKENAME体内温热，外部却如北极般冰冷，因此总被雾笼罩。电影公司与科学家争着用它，一方想代替造雾机，另一方想研究天气变化。
author: ghostslythe
source: Due to its internal body heat and Arctic cold exterior, POKENAME is constantly shrouded by fog. Movie studios and scientists fight over whether to use it in place of fog machines or to study weather patterns.

entry: POKENAME虽然全由实冰构成，身体却比钛还坚硬。齿轮天生能极速旋转，不过到了暖地，就得放慢，免得过热。
author: entomoxie
source: Despite being made of solid ice, POKENAME's body is tougher than titanium. The gears can naturally spin with extreme speed but are forced to slow down in warmer areas to avoid overheating.

entry: POKENAME的尾巴不断生出粉雪。触碰尾巴，会造成严重冻伤。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME's tail constantly produces a powdery snow. Touching its tail causes severe cases of frostbite.

entry: POKENAME只向有实力抵达它栖居的最高冰峰的人现身。战斗中落败后，会送给胜者一朵永不融化的冰玫瑰，作为友谊信物。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME only reveals itself to humans who have the strength needed to reach the highest icy peaks where it lives. When defeated in battle, it gives the winner a frozen rose that never melts as a token of friendship.

entry: POKENAME受惊时，会射出冰晶耳朵，冻住攻击者，让自己跳开脱险。射出的耳朵，一天内就能重新长好。
author: sk372
source: If frightened, POKENAME will fire off the ice crystal ears it possesses to freeze its attacker and let itself hop away to safety. The dislodged ears will reform within a day.

entry: POKENAME的身体由无法融化的独特冰构成。它常在猛烈暴雪中，出现在迷路者面前，引导他们回到安全地带。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's body is made of a unique ice that cannot be melted. It often appears to those lost in intense blizzards to guide them back to safety.

entry: POKENAME会到喷泉泡水，给自己降温。虽然摸着总冷冰冰，浸水时身上却会冒起蒸气。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME will visit fountains in order to take a dip in the water and cool itself down. Steam rises from its body as it soaks, despite it always seeming to be quite cold to the touch.

entry: POKENAME看起来像普通的冻结水洼，谁踩上，就会被彻底冻住。它慢慢吸干冰冻猎物的生命，供给自身力量。
author: hophoppip
source: It looks like an ordinary frozen puddle, but anyone who steps on it is frozen solid. POKENAME slowly drains the life from its frozen prey to fuel its powers.

entry: POKENAME住在偏远冰封地区，对毫无准备的旅人相当危险。它会攻击、咬住闯入领地者，注入毒素，让身体由内向外慢慢冻结。
author: sk372
source: Located in remote frozen regions, POKENAME is a danger to unprepared travelers. It attacks and bites trespassers in its territory, injecting a toxin that causes the body to slowly freeze from the inside out.

entry: 它以惊人速度冲下冰山。许多胆大的滑雪者试图靠灵巧身手胜过它，最终却遭遇不幸。
author: bostroms
source: It barrels down icy mountains at incredible speeds. Many daredevil skiers have met unfortunate ends trying to outmaneuver them.

entry: 这只宝可梦不透明的冰外骨骼下，藏着已知最致命的毒物之一。只要没把POKENAME带离冰冷栖地、搬到暖处，它就不会主动威胁人类；一旦变暖，便开始融化、活跃起来。
author: _pixelar_
source: Hidden under this Pokémon's opaque ice exoskeleton lies one of the deadliest known poisons. POKENAME is no active threat to humans unless removed from its freezing habitat and moved to a warmer place, where it begins to melt and become active.

entry: 实验室里的一场意外，让周围的冰，获得生命。一声咆哮，就能令山中暴雪，持续数周。
author: skymaster426
source: The surrounding ice has been brought to life via a freak accident in a lab. It can cause a blizzard on mountains for weeks with a single roar.

entry: 这种罕见宝可梦，大多在冰川与冻原附近被目击。人们认为，POKENAME以冻住的宝可梦与树果为食，是拾荒者。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: Most sightings of this rare Pokémon have been around glaciers and tundras. It is believed that POKENAME are scavengers who eat frozen Pokémon and berries.

entry: POKENAME大量吞吃冰雪与各种树果。雪状身体常被果汁染色，因此呈现各式配色。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME gorge themselves upon large quantities of snow and ice together with various berries. Their snowy bodies often become stained with the juices of the berries they eat, causing them to bear various color combinations.

entry: POKENAME成群漂在极地水中，吞噬眼前的一切。构成身体的冰始终锐利，强韧得足以击碎巨石。
author: mistymagius
source: Schools of POKENAME float in arctic waters devouring anything in sight. The ice that makes up its body always stays sharp and is strong enough to shatter boulders.

entry: 冰河时代，常能看见这种宝可梦飞过北极地区。它能发出声波，眨眼就将生物冻住。
author: reipudim_35860
source: During the ice age, it was common to find this Pokémon flying through arctic areas, and it could produce sound waves capable of freezing anyone in the blink of an eye.

entry: 冰河时代，POKENAME待在冰冻洞穴内，作为休息、等待进化的场所。身体极坚硬，让它在进化前无法飞行。
author: reipudim_35860
source: During the ice age, POKENAME were found inside frozen caves, which served as a resting place for them to evolve. POKENAME had very hard bodies, which prevented them from flying until they evolved.

entry: POKENAME天生是拥有冰之力的猎手，用翅膀冻结、震晕敌人。它通常独自在寒冷洞穴，等候猎物。
author: reipudim_35860
source: A born hunter with icy powers, POKENAME uses its wing to freeze and stun its opponents. This Pokémon is usually found alone in cold caves waiting for prey.

entry: 传说POKENAME翼间流下的雪永不融化。飞过山间，身后就会跟着暴风雪。
author: mepp.
source: Legends say the snow that flows from POKENAME's wings never melts. When it flies over mountains, blizzards are said to follow in its wake.

entry: POKENAME的冰体极冷，有记录表明，浸入岩浆也毫无影响。反而是包围它的岩浆，开始冻结。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's icy form is so cold that even a dip in magma was observed to have no effect on it. In fact, the reverse occurred, and the magma it was submerged in began to freeze.

entry: 融合中的基因错误破坏了它的核心。如今竟同时结冻、融化，形成矛盾的状态。
author: skymaster426
source: A genetic error in the fusion process corrupted the core of this Pokémon. It is paradoxically freezing and melting at the same time.

entry: POKENAME游荡冻原，身体随时间不断变大。它大多保持中立，不过谁试着凿下身体碎块，就会遭到攻击。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME wanders the tundra, its body growing larger and larger as time goes on. It's mostly neutral, but it will attack those who try to chip off bits of its body.

entry: POKENAME覆身的最外层冰，与构成其余身体的冰不同。这层冰吸收它产生的冷气，又大幅增加重量，妨碍本领发挥，让它无比迟缓。
author: soup1900
source: The outer layer of ice that covers POKENAME differs from the rest of the ice it is made of. This ice impedes POKENAME's capabilities by absorbing any frigid air it creates while also weighing it down significantly, making it incredibly sluggish.

entry: 它全身由冰雪构成。在冻原寒夜中跟踪人类，等寒冷拖慢对方脚步，再发起袭击。
author: hophoppip
source: Its body is made entirely of ice and snow. On cold nights in the tundra, it stalks humans until the cold slows them down, then strikes.

entry: POKENAME栖居冻原，却最常在冰川内部被发现。已有记录显示，它用牙啃穿冰层，再吐出唾液瞬间冻成冰，封住入口。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME inhabit tundras, but have been spotted most often inside glaciers. POKENAME have been recorded chewing through the ice with their teeth, then sealing over their entrances with spit that they flash freeze back into ice.

entry: POKENAME的歌声飘过最猛烈的暴雪，令人忍不住停步聆听。谁一直听到最后，就会在末段渐强的歌声结束时，彻底冻住。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's song drifts through the heaviest snowstorms, compelling travelers to stop and listen. Those who hear the song to the finish are frozen solid when the final crescendo ends.

entry: POKENAME用音响系统播放轻松、舒缓的音乐。音量开到最大，混响足以震碎周围坚冰，轻易赶跑入侵者。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME utilizes its sound system to play chill and relaxing music. At max volume, the reverb could shatter the solid ice around it and easily send intruders packing.

entry: 研究者循着冰风旋律，走入北极深洞，首次发现这种宝可梦。体温远低于冰点，哪怕触碰冰一般的头发，也几乎立刻会冻伤。
author: chibitales
source: This Pokémon was first discovered after researchers followed a melody of icy winds into a deep arctic cave. Its body remains far below freezing; even touching its ice-like hair can cause near-instant frostbite.

entry: POKENAME用前肢尖锐的冰柱，掘进冰山深处，一年大多时间都在休眠。沉睡时，冰封家园的外侧，会长出冰做的蘑菇。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses the pointed icicles on its front limbs to burrow its way deep into icebergs, hibernating much of the year. As it slumbers, the exterior of its frozen home grows mushrooms made of ice.

entry: POKENAME的冰体亮得惊人，看太久可能失明。力量过强时，会向四面八方射出冰寒光束，散去能量。
author: sk372
source: The ice comprising POKENAME's body is so bright that looking at it for prolonged amount of times risks potential blindness. If its power grows too large, it dissipates its energy by firing freezing light beams in all directions.

entry: POKENAME在地理两极游荡，仔细监测冰山与冰架的状态。遇到正在融化的，就将冰杖插入，数秒内重新冻住。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME wander around geographical poles, closely monitoring the status of icebergs and ice shelves. When they come across one that is melting, they plant their frozen staff into the ice and refreeze it in seconds.

entry: POKENAME壳内的核心极不稳定，需要接近绝对零度，才能避免猛烈爆炸。核心的光经冰体折射，映出绚烂缤纷的景象。
author: mistymagius
source: The heart of its shell is incredibly unstable, requiring temperatures near absolute zero to keep it from violently exploding. The light it gives off refracts off POKENAME's icy frame to make a wonderful display of brilliant colors.

entry: 首个发现的POKENAME个体，嵌在北极冰川深处。它常将自己封进厚冰，隔绝外界，十分难以研究。
author: sk372
source: The first POKENAME specimen found was embedded deep in an arctic glacier. It is difficult to study, as it regularly freezes itself in a thick block of ice to protect itself from the outside world.

entry: POKENAME全身由冰河时代的南极冰构成，用无声的冰掌穿行暴雪。捕猎时收起剃刀般的冰爪，只有攫取反光的闪亮硬币时，才显露出来。
author: shivaequinox
source: POKENAME entire body is made from antarctic ice dating back to an ice age, it stalks through snowstorms on silent, frozen paws. It retracts razor-sharp icicle claws while hunting, emerging only to snatch glittering coins that catch the light.

entry: 野生POKENAME在冰川附近结成小群生活。它头痛时，身旁十分危险，因为会放出冰寒气息，造成冻伤。
author: mepp.
source: In the wild, POKENAME are found in small colonies near glaciers. It is dangerous to be around POKENAME when they experience a headache, as they release a frigid chill that causes frostbite.

entry: POKENAME胸前将射出强力冰冻光束前，躯干的旋涡纹会飞快旋转。它住在中大型池塘，冰体让水温降得近乎结冰。
author: sk372
source: The swirl marking on POKENAME's torso rotates quickly just before it fires a powerful Ice Beam from its chest. It resides in moderately large ponds, the water's temperature chilled to almost freezing due to its icy body.

entry: POKENAME是真正的英雄，能随心重塑身体。它与另外九只宝可梦组队，用各自的力量守护世界。
author: ethewriter
source: A true hero, POKENAME can reform its body at will. It works with a team of nine other Pokémon, protecting the world with their powers.

entry: POKENAME受到威胁时，缩进冰霜外壳，不给爪子任何抓住的缝隙。采取这防守姿态时，看起来就像一块不融冰。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME retreats into its frosty shell when threatened, leaving no opening for claws or talons to grab onto. When in this defensive state, it resembles a piece of Never-Melt Ice.

entry: POKENAME周身的厚冰十分结实。它只在冰洞深处出现。
author: mepp.
source: The thick ice that surrounds POKENAME's body is very durable. They are only found deep in icy caverns.

entry: POKENAME体温低于摄氏零下100度，身上的火却始终燃烧。此现象，至今尚未经过研究。
author: chorb33
source: Although POKENAME's body temperature is below -100 degrees Celsius, the fire on its body burns continuously. This phenomenon has not yet been studied.

entry: POKENAME虽困在大块实冰中，依然能正常活动，用念力与其他生物互动。脑波检查表明，呆呆兽甚至没意识到自己的处境。
author: sk372
source: Though it is stuck within a large block of solid ice, POKENAME still functions normally and can interact with others via telekinesis. Examination of brainwaves suggests the Slowpoke does not even realize its predicament.

entry: 不清楚POKENAME是否有能完全称为脑的器官。没有命令，它绝不移动，哪怕正被攻击。天气冷到地面结霜时，身体就会自行修复。
author: bobosmith01
source: It is unclear if POKENAME possesses an organ that can truly be entirely defined as a brain; it never moves unless it has been given orders, even if it is under attack. Its body repairs itself when it's cold enough for frost to cover the ground.

entry: POKENAME移动时，身体的液体像水一样流动；可一停下，便立刻冻结成实冰。
author: hophoppip
source: Though it's able to flow like water when the fusion moves, the liquid that makes up POKENAME's body freezes solid the moment it is still.

entry: POKENAME飘行北极海域，不断冻住身旁的水，直到与大冰山难以区分。漂流时留意威胁，大船经过附近，也可能激起它的领地意识。
author: mr.gravy
source: POKENAME spends its time drifting through arctic waters while freezing the water closest to it, until it becomes indistinguishable from a large iceberg. While drifting it monitors for threats and can be territorial around large ships passing through.

entry: POKENAME曾被视为大岩蛇的地区形态。直到科学家发现，两者身体的原子结构完全不同，这看法才改变。
author: prof.whitebeam
source: POKENAME were once considered a regional form of Onix. However, this changed when scientists discovered that its body has a completely different atomic structure.

entry: POKENAME的冰寒身体，比普通冰密得多，沉重双钳能打穿厚冰川。夏天便闲坐海底，等待气温转冷。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's frigid body is much denser than regular ice, allowing it to break through thick glaciers with its heavy pincers. During the summer, it sits idly on the sea floor, waiting for colder temperatures.

entry: POKENAME能随意开合背上球状结构，将遇见的金属存入其中，供它消耗。这让球状结构长得更大，也增强招式威力。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME can activate the bulb-like structure on its back to open and close at will. It stores metal it comes across in there, which the structure consumes. This makes it grow bigger and boosts the power of POKENAME's moves.

entry: POKENAME把体内的爆炸能量，导向上半部的圆顶。圆顶上的球体能射出明亮能量束，一碰到物体或表面，就会引发强烈爆炸。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME channels the explosive energy within its body into the dome on its upper half. Beams of bright energy can be shot from the dome's orbs, which cause powerful explosions once they hit an object or surface.

entry: POKENAME常被当成普通安保无人机。它发展出的精神联系，让各个部件能作为整体运作。
author: addithewise
source: Often confused for simple security drones, POKENAME has developed a psychic connection that allows each of its parts to work as a whole.

entry: POKENAME的每个头各自独立计算，导致动作迟缓。叶状手臂收集太阳能，存入体内电池。
author: addithewise
source: Each of POKENAME's heads makes its own calculations separate from the whole, resulting in sluggish movement. Its leaf-like arms gather solar energy, storing what it gathers in an internal battery.

entry: POKENAME挥舞着看似某种奇怪废弃肢体的东西。这件临时武器结实沉重，是极有效的自卫钝器。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME wields what appears to be a strange, discarded limb of some sort. Sturdy and heavy, this makeshift weapon makes a highly efficient bludgeoning tool for self-defense.

entry: POKENAME手持的金属碎片，能放出能量刃，切开几乎任何材料。它也能远程控制，将其当成回旋镖，先追击敌人，再飞回来。
author: sk372
source: The metal shard POKENAME wields emits a blade of energy that lets it cut through almost any material. It can control it remotely as well, letting it be used as a boomerang that homes in on opponents before returning.

entry: POKENAME蓄能时纹丝不动，常被当成雕像。随后用金属弹簧腿跃上高空，重重落下，力道足以引发地震。
author: shyguy11011
source: POKENAME is often mistaken for a statue as it remains perfectly still while charging its energy. It then uses its metallic spring legs to leap high into the air, crashing down with enough force to cause earthquakes.

entry: 训练家常把POKENAME当成死物，像沙袋一样，拿来训练自己的宝可梦。不过，它可能突然以闪电般的刺拳还击，让对手来不及反应，就被打倒。
author: shyguy11011
source: Trainers often mistake POKENAME for an inanimate object, using it to train their Pokémon like it is a punching bag. However, it can suddenly retaliate with a lightning-fast jab, often knocking opponents out before they can react.

entry: POKENAME的舌头像传送带，把舔到的各种食物，送入口中。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's tongue functions like a conveyer belt, transporting the various food items POKENAME licks into its mouth.

entry: 空气严重污染的地方，有时能看见POKENAME飘过。它吸入污浊空气，排出洁净氧气。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: In places saturated with air pollution, it's possible to spot POKENAME floating by. POKENAME suck in polluted air, expelling clean oxygen in its place.

entry: 野外的POKENAME独来独往，喜欢避开其他生物。天敌来袭，就从颅部展开威力惊人的能量炮，自卫反击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME keeps to itself in the wild, preferring to avoid contact with others. If a predator attacks, it deploys a surprisingly powerful energy cannon from its cranium to defend itself.

entry: POKENAME的茧由格外强韧、可塑形的金属构成。每次遇袭后，脸上圆点便亮起，分析、调整身体，更好地抵御来犯攻击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's cocoon is made of a uniquely strong, malleable metal. After any attack, the dots on its face light up as it analyzes and adapts its body to better resist whatever is assaulting it.

entry: POKENAME清除污染的能力，似乎比同类更强。额外的储存舱，让较小模块在危险时，能利用收集的毒素防御。
author: addithewise
source: POKENAME appears to clear pollution with greater potency than others of its kind. With the addition of a storage capsule, if ever endangered, the smaller module may utilize the captured toxins in defense.

entry: POKENAME的金属藤蔓极灵活，又无比坚固。缠住目标后，还能从身上脱开，形成几乎无法逃脱的钢网。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's metal vines are highly flexible yet extremely sturdy. It can detach them from its body after wrapping around a target, creating a steel net that's almost impossible to escape from.

entry: POKENAME住在丰缘海洋深处，远离水面光线，黑暗中只看得见眼睛与全息鳍。身体太重，无法快速移动，只会抓住岩石与残骸。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME live deep underwater in the oceans of Hoenn far beyond the reach of the light of the surface, only their eyes and holographic fin visible in the dark. They are too heavy to move quickly, simply holding onto rocks and debris.

entry: POKENAME的嘴能发射快速、精准的远程能量弹。即使相隔数英里海面，也能分毫不差地狙击敌人。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's mouth contains the capacity to fire quick and highly-accurate energy shots across long distances. It could snipe a foe with perfect accuracy from miles across the ocean.

entry: POKENAME金属身体密实，游得很慢，无法在水中迅速行动。不过它绝非毫无防备，能聚集力量，发射纯能量冲击。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are slow swimmers, their dense metal bodies preventing them from moving swiftly through the water. Despite their low speed, they are far from defenceless as they are able to gather power into blasts of pure energy.

entry: POKENAME来回摇晃，移动快得出奇。有时会被错认成剃须刀。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME can move surprisingly quickly by rocking back and forth. It's occasionally mistaken for a shaving razor.

entry: POKENAME在深海海底轻松移动，观察当地其他水生宝可梦。若发现训练家，便迅速躲藏，试图混进其他海星星中。
author: addithewise
source: POKENAME shifts about with ease in deeper areas of the sea floor, monitoring other aquatic Pokémon within. If it spots a Trainer, it quickly hides, attempting to camouflage itself with other Staryu.

entry: POKENAME友善得很，可模样令人不安，大多数人依然害怕，远远避开。
author: blitzydragon
source: POKENAME is an incredibly friendly Pokémon but because of its unsettling appearance most people fear and avoid it entirely.

entry: POKENAME的身体由特殊合金构成，让它成为极坚韧、善战的斗士。红翼一展，就代表准备挥出剃刀般的利镰。
author: fiordaliso
source: The special metal alloy that forms POKENAME's body has made it an extraordinarily tough and capable fighter. When it spreads its red wings, it is ready to strike with its razor-sharp scythes.

entry: POKENAME能用体内储能，为双钳充能。蓄到最满时，钳子会泛起明亮猩红色，夹中目标还会掀起冲击波。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's pincers can be charged and powered up with its internal energy stores. At maximum charge, the pincers glow a bright crimson, and create shockwaves when they clamp down on a target.

entry: 这些宝可梦住在深湖，常无需进食，沉睡不醒。若被惊醒，就会暴走一整天。传说唯有生态灾难，才会让它们真正苏醒。
author: infinex21
source: These Pokémon live within deep lakes, often slumbering without a need to eat. They will rampage for an entire day if disturbed from this slumber. Stories claim they will only truly awaken in response to ecological disasters.

entry: 裸露皮肤碰上冰冷的金属身体，就会黏住。POKENAME的声响会损坏现代设备，尤其导航系统，因此海上贸易航线禁止它出现。
author: sontyp
source: Bare skin touching the freezing metal of its body sticks. The sounds POKENAME makes can damage modern technology and especially navigational systems, so it's prohibited along naval trade routes.

entry: POKENAME的身体由极易塑形的黏液与钢铁构成。因此只要扫描，就能极其准确地变成任何宝可梦。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME's bodies are made out of incredibly malleable goo and steel. This has given them the ability transform into any Pokémon with incredible accuracy after scanning them.

entry: POKENAME吸收空气中潜藏的电力，蓄满时，鬃毛噼啪作响。需要自卫时，鬃毛一秒能射出数十根带电的等离子体针。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's body absorbs latent electricity in the air, its mane crackling with power when fully charged. This mane can fire off dozens of electrified plasma needles a second when it needs to defend itself.

entry: POKENAME通常出现在工厂，凭借不稳定的火焰，以极高温度帮助熔炼各种矿石与矿物。
author: fxncy_poland
source: POKENAME are typically seen in factories and are helpful in smelting different ores and minerals at extreme temperatures due to their volatile flames.

entry: POKENAME的性能先进，足以储存、分析海量资料。不过体型与强大性能，也让它住进的几乎任何电脑，都变得无比卡顿。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's specs are sophisticated enough to let it store and analyze massive quantities of data. Its size and power cause almost any computer it inhabits to lag greatly.

entry: POKENAME的金属茧坚韧无比，至今没有被凹伤、刮伤的记录。脸上圆点同时全亮，就代表准备进化。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's metal cocoon is so resilient that nothing has been recorded denting or scratching it. When all the dots on its face light up at once, it is ready to evolve.

entry: POKENAME脸上的圆点，以不同节奏闪烁，表示心情或思考过程。已辨认的图案中，最常见的是：不小心被踩到时的恼怒。
author: sk372
source: The dots on POKENAME's face flash in different patterns to indicate its mood or thought process. Of the identified patterns, the most commonly seen is one pertaining to annoyance from being accidentally stepped on.

entry: POKENAME不断睡觉，保存能量，留待需要时用。胃能把一切化成能量，连机器与发霉蔬果也不例外，不过原理至今不明。
author: npshi
source: POKENAME are known to constantly sleep to preserve energy for when they need it. The stomach of a POKENAME is able to convert anything into energy, including machinery and moldy produce, though how this occurs is unknown to this day.

entry: POKENAME火焰充满身体，经胸孔射出燃烧的激光。它演化出无须氧气也能燃烧的能力，适应地底深洞等环境，因此火焰呈暗红色。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME fires flaming lasers from its fire-filled body through the holes on its chest. The flames burn dark red because of its evolution to be able to burn without oxygen, like inside of deep underground caves.

entry: POKENAME每隔几个月，会蜕下金属皮。蜕皮内侧能看到隐约线路，脱落后短时间内，还会随残留能量闪烁。
author: sk372
source: Once every few months, POKENAME will shed its metal skin. Faint bits of circuitry can be seen on the inside of the discarded skin, which flicker with lingering energy for a short time after shedding.

entry: 这种人造宝可梦，据称以梦幻为原型，身体由可变形的未知材料构成。即使完全静止，也不断学习、适应，所以红眼始终闪烁。
author: infinex21
source: The body of this artificial Pokémon, supposedly modeled after Mew, is made of an unknown material that can change its shape. Its red eyes are always flashing because it is always learning and adapting, even when its body is completely still.

entry: 这种宝可梦漫游世界时，奇特身体始终流变，在各式形状与质地之间转换。凡被视为威胁的对象，都会遭到炮口放出的强力能量束轰击。
author: infinex21
source: This Pokémon's strange body is always in a state of flux, shifting between various shapes and consistencies as it scours the world. Anything it deems to be a threat shall be met with a powerful beam of energy let loose by its cannon.

entry: POKENAME直接从阳光获取能量，头上看似叶片，其实是太阳能板。它友好、好养，可身体极重，还喜欢往训练家胸口跳。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME draw their energy directly from sunlight, the apparent leaf on their head actually being a solar panel. They are friendly and easy to raise, but are extremely heavy and have a habit of trying to jump on their Trainer's chest.

entry: POKENAME头上接着柔韧太阳能板，供给活动能量。它性情平和，会安静地追随太阳，哪里最亮就去哪里。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have a flexible solar panel attached to their heads, using the panel to fuel their activities. They are placid Pokémon and will peaceably follow the sun to wherever it is brightest.

entry: POKENAME最初记录于帕底亚的第零区，如今多数工业开发区都能见到。颈边一圈二极管储存太阳能，头上长出的全息叶，也会储存阳光。
author: katieplaysgames
source: First documented within Paldea's Area Zero, POKENAME can now be found in most industrial developments. They have a ring of diodes around their neck that store solar power, and a holographic leaf sprouting from their head that stores sunlight.

entry: POKENAME用颈边太阳能板吸收日光，增强草属性招式。身体由比钻石更硬的神秘金属构成。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME absorbs sunlight using the solar panels around its neck to power up its Grass-type moves. Its body is composed of a mysterious metal harder than diamond.

entry: POKENAME用炮管般的手臂，精准发射装有毒液的飞镖。毒会带来剧痛，不过已被认定不会致命。遇到特别难缠的敌人，就用钻头冲锋。
author: infinex21
source: From POKENAME's cannon-like arms, it precisely fires darts packed with venomous payloads at its targets; the venom causes severe pain, but it has been deemed nonlethal. For particular tough foes, it utilizes its drill and charges at them.

entry: 这种融合体强得惊人，咬合力之大，连钻石都能咬碎。
author: famerman2
source: This fusion is extremely strong. It can bite with enough force to crush diamonds.

entry: POKENAME被设计、派出，唯一目的便是观察、研究周围世界。它只配备有限武装，用来分散来犯者注意，好让自己逃离。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME were designed and deployed for the sole purpose of observation and the study of the world around them. They have minor weapon systems meant only to distract aggressors so that they may flee.

entry: POKENAME的毒液不会立刻发作，却含镉、铅、砷等有毒金属；营养充足、训练良好的个体，甚至含钋。这种毒液，曾深受忍者重视。
author: epping_forest
source: POKENAME's poisonous serum doesn't act immediately, but it contains toxic metals like cadmium, lead, arsenic, and even polonium in well-fed and trained specimens. This serum was highly valued by ninjas.

entry: POKENAME先进的眼睛，连最黑暗的环境也能看清。胸部能喷出奇异能量构成的网，捕捉猎物，网丝几乎无法扯断。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's technologically-advanced eyes let it see clearly through even the darkest elements. Its thorax can jettison a net made of strange energy to capture prey, the threads of which are nearly impossible to break.

entry: POKENAME能一次静立数千年，观察星球未来将发生的事。古籍记载，曾有文明捕获一只，却没有任何力量能逼它分享所见。
author: soup1900
source: A POKENAME can stand still for millennia at a time as it watches the future of planetary happenings. Ancient texts record civilizations that captured one of these Pokémon, but no force could compel it to share its insights.

entry: POKENAME能一次静立数千年，观察星球未来将发生的事。古籍记载，曾有文明捕获一只，却没有任何力量能逼它分享所见。
author: soup1900
source: A POKENAME can stand still for millennia at a time as it watches the future of planetary happenings. Ancient documents record civilizations that captured one of these Pokémon, but no force could compel it to share its insights.

entry: POKENAME由坚韧的未知物质构成，优雅起舞时，裙摆却如流水波动。头上七个圆点随舞步按规律闪烁，音乐家推测代表音符。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is made of a tough, unidentified substance, but its skirt ripples fluidly while it dances gracefully. The seven dots on its head blink in patterns as it dances, which musicians theorize represent musical notes.

entry: POKENAME的滑板轻盈，却比大多数已知金属都结实。无论山坡多陡，它单板滑下也从不失手，令人叹服。
author: jangodiot
source: POKENAME's board is lightweight but sturdier than most known metals. POKENAME snowboards down mountains, never failing no matter how steep the slope, making this Pokémon all the more impressive.

entry: POKENAME几乎随时都发出低沉、颤转的低音。走过沼泽时，蛙类宝可梦往往像被催眠一般，跟在身后。
author: sk372
source: A deep, warbling bass emits from POKENAME at almost all times. If it travels through swampy areas, frog-like Pokémon tend to follow it as if hypnotized.

entry: POKENAME从手臂发出引力波，让自己浮空。大部分能量，都用来维持头顶植物的最佳状态。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME keeps itself aloft using gravitational waves emitted from its arms. It dedicates most of its energy to keep the plant on its head in tip-top condition.

entry: POKENAME一旦侵入家中，就很难赶走。敏锐听觉让它察觉一切靠近的动静，尾巴则向任何凑近的目标，发射强力能量束。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a difficult pest to get rid of should it infest a household. Sensitive hearing lets it know when anything approaches it, and its tail fires off powerful energy beams at anything that comes close.

entry: POKENAME转动头顶金属叶，就能短暂飞起。它辗转一片片花丛，花粉与阳光都充分吸收。
author: sk372
source: Spinning the metal leaves on its head allows POKENAME to achieve short bursts of flight. It travels from flower patch to flower patch, soaking up pollen and sunlight in equal measures.

entry: POKENAME连在泥水中，也能清楚探测无线电波。因此被养在水下基地，确保信号准确接收。解读信号时，神情格外专注。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME can detect radiowaves clearly, even in muddy water. They are kept in underwater bases to ensure signals are properly received. They have a look of intense concentration when deciphering the signals.

entry: POKENAME连在泥水中，也能清楚探测无线电波。因此被养在水下基地，确保信号准确接收。它很难撑住自身重量，所以常坐着。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME can detect radiowaves clearly, even in muddy water. They are kept in underwater bases to ensure signals are properly received. They struggle to hold their own weight, so are often found sitting down.

entry: POKENAME白天休息，吸收阳光，为电池充电。夜晚启动能量轮，在各地疾驰，追逐猎物。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME rests during the day, absorbing sunlight to charge its battery. At night, it activates its energy wheels and speeds around the landscape as it chases prey.

entry: 有人推测，这种人造宝可梦的意识，与许多设计相近的人造宝可梦相连。因此，尽管它们总在思考而不行动，所有型号的POKENAME仍受到仔细监测。
author: infinex21
source: The mind of this artificial Pokémon is theorized to be connected to the minds of many other artificial Pokémon with designs similar to it. As such, any models of POKENAME are carefully observed, even though they're always thinking rather than acting.

entry: 一圈眼睛围着中央眼转动，各自扫描感兴趣的物体，再决定如何行动。POKENAME的每只眼睛都能射出奇异的精神能量束，向敌人倾泻不休不止的弹幕。
author: sk372
source: The ring of eyes circles around the center eye, each one scanning objects of interest before deciding on a course of action. Each of POKENAME's eyes can fire beams of strange psychic energy, showering foes with a relentless barrage.

entry: 古籍将这种人造宝可梦描述为不停掘进的武器，挖行时能撕开任何障碍。据说体内装有无数武器，可无人敢靠近，确认是否属实。
author: infinex21
source: Ancient texts describe this artificial Pokémon as an ever-tunneling weapon that will tear through any obstacle as it digs. Supposedly, it has myriad weapons installed within its body, but none have dared approach it to determine if this is true.

entry: POKENAME似乎偏爱深海洞穴。一旦受扰，体内就会释放毁灭性的能量，化为爆炸。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME appears to prefer inhabiting deep underwater caves. If bothered, calamitous energy is unleashed from its body, channeled into an explosion.

entry: POKENAME用遍布身体与双钳的红色光眼，凶狠地盯住猎物。钳上的金属能伸长、缩短，完美贴合想抓住、撕开的物体。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME uses the glowing red eyes along its body and claws to menacingly peer at its prey. It can stretch or shrink the metal on its pincers to perfectly suit the object it wants to grab and rip apart.

entry: POKENAME的钢壳让它能藏身其中，几乎抵御各种攻击，毫发无伤。壳内有刀刃等工具，数秒就能将树果榨成鲜果汁。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's steel shell lets it hide away and resist nearly any type of attack that comes its way without a scratch. Inside the shell lies blades and other objects that let it turn berries into fresh juice in seconds.

entry: POKENAME由灼热液态金属构成，非常耐受身体攻击。它行踪难寻，又灵活得出奇，大多数旅人只瞥见一眼，它就流走了。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's body is made up of a burning-hot liquid metal, and is highly resistant to physical assaults. Elusive and surprisingly agile, most travelers only catch a fleeting glimpse of it before it oozes away.

entry: 两种宝可梦彼此不相容，让融合体融化，行动艰难。可它似乎毫不在意，仍拖着壳，慢慢往前走。
author: ohok3441
source: Due to the incompatibility of both Pokémon, this fusion is melted and struggles to move. It seems unbothered and continues to drag along its shell.

entry: POKENAME飞起时，金属翅膀产生的能量大得能掀起旋风。坚不可摧的喙，能极其精准地刺穿任何材料。
author: fiordaliso
source: When POKENAME takes flight, its metal wings generate so much energy that they create whirlwinds. Its indestructible beak can pierce through any material with incredible precision.

entry: POKENAME的目击记录极少。它靠能量推进飞行，而同样的能量，也供给腹部下方的精密武器。
author: infinex21
source: Very few POKENAME have ever been sighted. These Pokémon fly about, propelled by the same energy that powers their precision weapons along their underbellies.

entry: POKENAME栖居海沟，双眼在漆黑海水中发光。身体密度极高，对深海潜艇是个隐患；它游得虽慢，不留神的潜航器撞上，也会凹下一大块。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are found in ocean trenches, their eyes glowing in the pitch black ocean. They are a hazard for deep sea submarines due to their hyper-dense bodies, collisions between the slow moving Pokémon and unwary submersibles causing large dents.

entry: POKENAME住在深海沟中，缓缓游动，靠钢皮免受伤害。它能从口中高速发射弹丸，攻击其他深海宝可梦。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME live deep in ocean trenches, swimming slowly and relying on their steely skin to protect themselves from harm. They can fire projectiles from their mouths at high speed, using them to attack other deep sea Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME看似毫无感情，善于分析，常守护防备森严的资料库。脚部发出的光束，在网络空间几乎能删掉一切，任何防护都挡不住。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a seemingly-emotionless, analytical creature often seen protecting high-security data stores. Beams fired from its feet can delete almost anything in cyberspace no matter the defenses.

entry: POKENAME的身体由神秘金属构成，比其他一切已知金属都硬。它似乎还能根据处境，变成更合适的形态。
author: blaizegamer
source: POKENAME's body is made of a mysterious metal which is harder than any other known metal. POKENAME also seems to have the ability to transform itself into a more suitable form based on the situation.

entry: POKENAME很容易动怒，敌人一进入视野，便立刻攻击。不过，它转身困难，敌人很容易打它个措手不及。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are quick to anger, firing off attacks the moment an enemy enters their line of sight. However, they struggle to turn, allowing enemies to catch them off guard easily.

entry: POKENAME的身体由神秘金属构成，比其他一切已知金属都硬。它似乎还能根据处境，变成更合适的形态。
author: blaizegamer
source: POKENAME's body is made of a mysterious metal which is harder than any other known metal. POKENAME also seems to have the ability to transform itself into a more suitable form based on the situation.

entry: POKENAME总想变强，会攻击附近一切来锻炼。钢铁身体让它挨打也不觉疼，能无休无止地战斗。
author: shyguy11011
source: POKENAME is always seeking to improve its strength, lashing out at anything nearby to train. Its steel body allows it to shrug off any blows without feeling pain, enabling POKENAME to battle endlessly without rest.

entry: POKENAME速度不快，却以惊人的防御弥补。它的金属身体势不可挡，以头为轴旋转蓄能，再向对手放出耀眼光环。
author: shyguy11011
source: While POKENAME is not fast, it makes up for it with its devastating defense. This unstoppable metallic Pokémon spins on its head, gathering energy before releasing a blinding ring of light at its opponent.

entry: POKENAME靠尾巴传出的信号互相连接，利用远距离通信，控制比平常更大的区域。
author: camtft
source: POKENAME can connect to each other through signals sent from their tails. They utilize their long-range communication to control larger areas than is normally possible.

entry: POKENAME移动起来，几乎快如闪电。可动作不够协调，跑着跑着，就可能撞上东西。
author: famerman2
source: POKENAME can move nearly as fast as lightning. However, it is not very coordinated and can run into things while doing so.

entry: 这些宝可梦不断往返世界各地水域，用触须分析水质。若查出有害物质，就会采取行动，净化水源。
author: infinex21
source: These Pokémon are always traveling to and from bodies of water across the world. They use their feelers to analyze the purity of the waters and will take action to cleanse these waters if they detect hazardous materials within.

entry: POKENAME是西尔佛公司制造的人造宝可梦，以保护勇闯白银山的训练家、充当完美伙伴为卖点。价格昂贵得惊人，只有最成功的训练家才负担得起。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are artificial Pokémon produced by Silph Co. and are marketed as the perfect partner to protect Trainers preparing to brave Mt. Silver. They are prohibitively expensive for all but the most successful Trainers.

entry: POKENAME身体的金属光滑又柔韧，能以不可思议的速度与灵活度，穿行空中、海中。体内涡轮让它能从口中喷出猛烈强风。
author: sk372
source: The smooth and flexible metal of POKENAME's body lets it slice through the air and sea with uncanny speed and maneuverability. Turbines within its body let it generate massive gale-force winds from its mouth.

entry: POKENAME能用神圣火焰，将普通矿石锻成七种独特金属。七者熔成合金后，会形成闪耀彩虹光的材料，据说永远不会损坏。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME is able to forge seven unique metals by applying its sacred flames onto common ores. When these seven metals are alloyed together, it creates a shining, rainbow material that supposedly is eternally indestructible.

entry: POKENAME造出的时间通道压力极强，会扭曲、压碎试图穿越的一切。然而，它的奇异金属竟能逆转效果，反而修复所有伤害。
author: soup1900
source: The time portals POKENAME creates are extremely pressurized, distorting and crushing anything that attempts to go through. Yet, POKENAME's strange metal somehow reverses these effects, healing all damage done instead.

entry: 乍看之下，这些宝可梦全身像缠满各种电缆与线绳。可研究者细看后发现，那是未知材料构成的触肢，保护着POKENAME的核心。
author: infinex21
source: At a glance, the bodies of these Pokémon appear to be covered in a tangled mess of various cables and cords. But, upon closer inspection, researchers learned that they are tendrils made of an unknown material that protect the core of POKENAME.

entry: 丰缘各地神庙中出土的古抄本，画着POKENAME。令科学家困惑的是，抄本上的文字，竟很像现代程序语言。
author: .izik
source: Ancient manuscripts found in temples across Hoenn contain drawings of POKENAME. This baffles scientists, as the text on the manuscripts resembles modern coding languages.

entry: 多年生活在密林中，让这种宝可梦磨练出适合丛林顶级猎手的身躯。尾部涌出的能量推动它高速前进，臂上能量刃则切开敌人。
author: infinex21
source: Years of living deep within jungles have honed this Pokémon's body into a form fitting of an apex jungle predator. The energy that surges from its tail helps to propel it forth at great speeds, while the energy blades on its arms slice through foes.

entry: 人们相信POKENAME是人工制造的，身体材料却仍未知。发红光的强大能量驱动它，让它能一连数天，不停掘穿泥土与岩石。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are believed to have been artificially made, though the materials of their bodies are yet unknown. They are powered by a potent energy that glows red, which allows them to dig through ground and rock without rest for multiple days.

entry: POKENAME长年承受自身火焰，钢铁身体被淬炼得完美无缺。灼热双腿发出喷气机般的轰鸣，推动它飞越城市，或碾碎对手。
author: h0bojoe
source: POKENAME's steel body is tempered to perfection by years of enduring its own fire. Its superheated legs unleash jet-like roars as it propels itself over cities or crushes opponents.

entry: POKENAME用高深超能力操纵周围金属，包括自身身体。它尤其擅长造出近乎无法穿透的金属盾，保护自己与训练家。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses advanced psychic powers to manipulate metal around it, including that of its own body. It is especially proficient in forming near-impenetrable metallic shields to protect itself and its Trainer from harm.

entry: POKENAME的长裙虽像布一样飘动，据说却由奇妙材料构成，比任何金属都更结实、柔韧。传说唯有得到它认可的人，才能见识真正力量。
author: thatlittletwerp
source: The gown that adorns a POKENAME, despite flowing like cloth, is said to be composed of a wondrous material far more durable and flexible than any kind of metal. Legends suggest that their true power is only revealed to those they deem worthy.

entry: POKENAME拙劣地装成沉重球，偷偷滚进建筑工地、挖掘场。靠近重型机械后，就悄悄钻出伪装，开始吸收里面的电线。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME poorly disguises itself as a Heavy Ball, sneakily rolling into construction and excavation sites. When it gets near any heavy machinery, it quietly comes out of its disguise and starts to absorb the wires within.

entry: POKENAME躲在废弃科研设施深处，控制里面被遗忘的设备。若都市探险者想拿走设备，它就会突然现身，将人吓出设施。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME hide deep in abandoned science facilities, taking control of each device left forgotten inside. If any urban explorers try to take these devices, POKENAME will suddenly appear and terrify them out of the facility.

entry: 这些宝可梦能在体内产生神秘能量，既可凝成冲击射出，也能塑成武器。它们只与值得一战的对手，或威胁弱小者的敌人交战。
author: infinex21
source: These Pokémon are able to generate a mysterious energy within themselves that they can release as condensed blasts or shape into weapons. They only engage opponents they deem worthy of the effort or those who threaten the defenseless.

entry: POKENAME纯为战争而造，力量毫无拘束，也不带怜悯。POKENAME眼中朱红的光，宛如双刃，能刺穿迷雾。
author: rooboid
source: Built only for war, POKENAME boast unfettered, callous strength. The vermillion glow of POKENAME's eyes can cut through the fog like two sabres.

entry: POKENAME上半身两侧的球体能张开，露出数十条粗壮金属藤，鞭打敌人。特别顽强的对手，则会遭到口中射出的高威力能量束轰击。
author: sk372
source: The orbs on the side of POKENAME's upper body can open up to reveal dozens of thick, metallic vines to strike enemies with. Particularly stubborn opponents get blasted by a high-powered energy beam shot from its mouth.

entry: POKENAME的模样，是许多虚构机械生物的原型。曾有人试着训练它，主演自己的电影，结果造成巨大财产损失。幸好，那番破坏让观众看得十分过瘾。
author: bukie
source: POKENAME's appearance is the basis of many robotic creatures in fiction. An attempt to train POKENAME to star in its own film resulted in massive property damage. Thankfully, the carnage was highly entertaining to audiences.

entry: 这些宝可梦通常都在休眠。醒来往往也只有一小会儿，因为大部分能量，都用来一拳轰碎崎岖地形了。
author: infinex21
source: These Pokémon are usually found in a state of hibernation. When they awaken, it is often for a short time because they will use most of their energy to pulverize misshapen terrain with a single punch.

entry: POKENAME非常擅长察觉附近危险。人们却因此谴责它，认定它是不祥的报信者。
author: camtft
source: POKENAME are very adept at sensing danger nearby. This has led to people condemning them, believing them to be an evil herald.

entry: 液态金属环绕POKENAME身体流动，一接触便引起强烈妄想。常见的一种幻觉，就是让受害者深信它是神。
author: .izik
source: Liquid metal flows around POKENAME's body and induces powerful delusions on contact. One common hallucination convinces victims it is a god.

entry: POKENAME背上长着独特金属构造。许多建筑师从这微型生态中汲取灵感，用于未来的建筑开发。
author: sk372
source: Unique metallic structures grow from POKENAME's back. Many architects are taking inspiration from this miniature ecosystem for future building developments.

entry: 科学家创造POKENAME，想造一件坚不可摧的新型强力武器。机械化的兵装，也让POKENAME足以击败任何敌人。
author: thefinalkalgonus
source: POKENAME was created by scientists to become a new indestructible, powerful weapon. Thanks to its cybernetic weaponry, POKENAME can defeat any enemy.

entry: 触须由未知的可塑材料构成，能在有限范围内变形。六只红色“眼睛”几乎总闪着光，图案奇妙地令人平静。
author: infinex21
source: Its feelers are composed of a malleable, unknown material that has limited transformative capabilities. Its six red "eyes" are almost always flashing with light in oddly-soothing visual patterns.

entry: POKENAME在深海游荡时，许多红眼发光，仿佛正在寻找什么。有的理论说是在觅食，也有人认为，甚至是在找古代海底城市。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's many red eyes glow as they wander deep underwater, almost as if they're searching for something. Theories include them searching for food or even ancient underwater cities.

entry: 古代文明造出的机械巨蛇，原为保护创造者，却最终失控，反成了毁灭他们的祸首。
author: theeggoverlord
source: A mechanical serpent built by an ancient civilization. Though originally created to protect them, it went rogue and became their destroyer.

entry: POKENAME包裹着极密实的钢甲。它用时间之力迅速逆转损伤，是难以击倒的对手。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are encased in exceptionally dense steel armor. They use their temporal abilities to rapidly reverse damage, making them highly durable opponents to face.

entry: POKENAME包裹着极密实的钢甲。它用时间之力迅速逆转损伤，是难以击倒的对手。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are encased in exceptionally dense steel armor. They use their temporal abilities to rapidly reverse damage, making them highly durable opponents to face.

entry: 据说POKENAME是毁灭的预兆。许多报告记载，目击它后，高耸的金属建筑便崩塌成尘。
author: bigoljax
source: It is said that POKENAME are omens of destruction. Many reports have been written about tall, metallic buildings crumbling to dust after POKENAME sightings.

entry: 科学家高估了自己的融合本领，才产生POKENAME。它比普通金属更容易生锈，徘徊在废弃神殿附近。
author: patch_bros
source: POKENAME is the result of scientists overestimating their fusion capabilities. It rusts faster than normal metal and wanders around abandoned temples.

entry: POKENAME炮口射出的激光，由世界其他地方不会产生的奇异能量构成。虽然尚未证实，人们认为来源是独特金属成分引起的化学反应。
author: soup1900
source: The lasers POKENAME fires from its cannon are made up of a strange energy that's not produced anywhere else in the world. While unproven, the source of this energy is believed to originate from chemical reactions with its unique metal composition.

entry: POKENAME背上的炮，能快速连发多枚纯能量弹，消灭潜在威胁。幸好，它极少将其他事物认定为值得开火的威胁。
author: infinex21
source: The cannon upon a POKENAME's back is capable of rapidly releasing multiple projectiles of pure energy that quickly eradicate any potential threats. Thankfully, it very rarely labels anything else as a threat worthy of firing upon.

entry: POKENAME的火焰热得足以熔钢。虽然人们推测它的身体就是钢制的，构成身躯的结构却仍保持固态。
author: nyoomymph
source: The fire produced by POKENAME is hot enough to melt steel. Though its body is hypothesized to be made of it, the structures that make up POKENAME's body remain solid nonetheless.

entry: POKENAME靠推进器，带着庞大钢躯飞行，宛如尖端飞机。冷却系统会瞬间启动，稳定重要器官，同时在周围放出冰寒雾气。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its boosters allow POKENAME to fly through the air with its massive steel body as if it were a cutting-edge aircraft. Its cooling system activates instantly to keep its vital organs stable, releasing a freezing mist around it.

entry: POKENAME靠推进器，带着庞大钢躯飞行，宛如尖端飞机。冷却系统会瞬间启动，稳定重要器官，同时在周围放出冰寒雾气。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its boosters allow POKENAME to fly through the air with its massive steel body as if it were a cutting-edge aircraft. Its cooling system activates instantly to keep its vital organs stable, releasing a freezing mist around it.

entry: POKENAME被设计为街头艺人，娱乐大众，尤其是孩子。头上的长臂常用来抛接物体，或助它完成奇异杂技。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME were engineered to serve as street performers for the masses, though especially for children. The long arms upon their head are often seen juggling objects or helping them to perform outlandish acrobatic maneuvers.

entry: POKENAME走到哪里，哪里就长出奇怪金属蘑菇。它挥动铁拳打击敌人，技巧不输职业拳手。
author: bee4082
source: Wherever POKENAME wanders, strange metal mushrooms grow. It strikes foes with its iron fists with the same skill as professional boxers.

entry: 它能一定程度控制抓住的机器，机器越小，控制越强。手掌会放出红色电流，双掌一拍，就能产生危险电弧。
author: infinex21
source: It can exert some level of control over machines it grabs hold of, though the smaller they are the more control it can exert. It releases red electricity from its palms and by clapping its hands together, it can create dangerous bolts.

entry: POKENAME身体虽硬如钢，却也轻得能乘风而行。它常爱恶作剧，不过遇见受困者，也会真心尝试帮忙。
author: infinex21
source: Although POKENAME have bodies as tough as steel, they are also light enough to ride upon wind currents. Although POKENAME tend to act rather mischievously, they will genuinely attempt to aid anyone in trouble.

entry: 这些异常宝可梦住在古代遗迹，柔韧而结实的四肢，能攀附墙壁与洞顶。它们产生未知能量，以各种方式释放，消灭敌人与入侵者。
author: infinex21
source: These anomalous Pokémon dwell within ancient ruins, their flexible, yet durable, limbs allowing them to cling to walls and ceilings. They generate an unknown type of energy that they can loose in myriad ways to dispatch foes and invaders.

entry: POKENAME的身体由奇异金属构成，又由同样奇异的能量驱动，两者仍在研究中。它平常不具敌意，自卫时却会将身体塑成各种武器。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's body is made of a strange metal and powered by an equally strange energy, both still being scientifically studied. It is not typically hostile, but it will reshape its body into various weapons in self-defense.

entry: POKENAME常守卫高科技设施，以高威力激光焚毁入侵者。不过使用后，必须休息几分钟，免得身体过热。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME can be found guarding high-tech facilities, incinerating any intruders with high-powered laser beams. After using its lasers, however, it has to rest for a few minutes to prevent its body from overheating.

entry: 坚韧的金属身体，让这只宝可梦感觉不到疼痛。因此，两个头动手打起架来，能一连数周也分不出结果。
author: busilisk
source: Its durable metallic body prevents this Pokémon from feeling pain. As a consequence, physical fights between its two heads can remain unresolved for weeks.

entry: POKENAME的核心产生近乎无尽的能量，供三个头发射毁灭性光束。它尤其敌视龙属性宝可梦。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's core generates almost limitless energy to fuel the destructive beams of light it can fire from all three of its heads. It shows a particularly strong enmity towards Dragon types.

entry: POKENAME是力量骇人的金属龙，三个头发出的能量束，几乎能消灭任何敌人。三道光束合一，一击就能将整座山轰成原子。
author: sk372
source: A metallic dragon with monstrous power, POKENAME's three heads fire beams of energy capable of dispatching most any foe. Combining all three beams together could atomize a mountain in one shot.

entry: 这些人造宝可梦被设计为隐匿单位，共同任务是观察其他生命。POKENAME感到威胁时，能扭转自身周围的现实，暂时隐形。
author: infinex21
source: These artificial Pokémon were designed to be stealth units with the shared goal of observation of other life. When a POKENAME feels threatened, it is able to wrap reality around itself and render itself invisible for a period of time.

entry: 必要时，POKENAME能以音速移动。追踪能力也超乎寻常，即使正在外逸层飞行，也能察觉地上的一只电电虫。
author: bradlybro199
source: When necessary POKENAME can travel at the speed of sound. They also have extraordinary tracking abilities, like being able to detect a joltik on the ground, while traveling in the exosphere.

entry: 这些人造宝可梦被设计为隐匿单位，共同任务是研究生物情感。许多POKENAME学会感受，而不再只会思考，便脱离控制，努力与其他生物共同生活。
author: infinex21
source: These artificial Pokémon were designed to be stealth units with the shared goal of studying the emotions of living beings. Many POKENAME have gone rogue as they learn what it means to feel rather than just think and will strive to live with others.

entry: 这种异常宝可梦看似金属的手臂，能随意伸长、缩短或长大。头上红点的图案闪烁发光，仿佛正在积极尝试交流。
author: infinex21
source: This anomalous Pokémon's seemingly-metal arms are able to stretch, shrink, and/or grow however it desires. The pattern of red dots on its head flicker and glow as if it is actively trying to communicate.

entry: POKENAME前部的显示画面，会随心情改变表情。看似耳朵的部位，其实是扬声器，能将强力摇篮曲传到极远处。
author: sk372
source: The visual display on POKENAME's front changes expression to fit its moods. What look to be ears are actually speakers that allow it to emit its potent lullaby across vast distances.

entry: 它用仿佛电子合成的婉转嗓音唱歌。听见歌声的生物，很快就会睡着。
author: hophoppip
source: It sings with a seemingly digitally synthesized melodic voice. Those who hear this singing are quickly put to sleep.

entry: POKENAME有特殊金属甲，很难刮伤。甲上若有瑕疵，尾焰就会将其熔去，迅速修复损伤。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME has a special metal plating that is difficult to scratch. Any blemishes to this metal armor are melted away by the flame at its tail to quickly fix injuries.

entry: POKENAME能操纵磁力，浮上天空。它的身影，已多次被误认成飞碟。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME can manipulate magnetism to levitate into the sky. Sightings of POKENAME have been confused for flying saucers a number of times.

entry: POKENAME是颗带刺金属种子，似乎来自太空。外壳由未知矿物构成，科学家试着分析，却找不到打开的方法。
author: mcnchsschl
source: POKENAME is a spiky metal seed that seems to have come from space. Scientists attempting to analyze it have found no way to get through the shell, which is made of some unknown mineral.

entry: 这只宝可梦好奇心极强，不断记录感兴趣的一切。目前还不知道，为何会有这种行为。
author: cyboobr
source: This Pokémon is highly curious, constantly recording anything of interest. The reason for this behavior is currently unknown.

entry: 野外的POKENAME，只曾被看见与同类结群。它们会肆意破坏金属物体，损毁重要机械。
author: espresso_shotz
source: POKENAME have only ever been spotted in packs with one another in the wild. They're known for ravaging through metallic objects and destroying important machinery.

entry: POKENAME虽沉重，动作却灵巧得惊人。即使高速移动，炮管射出的光束，也能准确命中。
author: famerman2
source: POKENAME is shockingly agile for its weight. It can accurately fire beams out of its cannon even at high speeds.

entry: POKENAME个头虽小，体重却超过十吨，能承受相当于海洋最深处的压力。因此，即使最伟大的博士，也不清楚它内部如何运作。
author: weirdmageddonprepper_93813
source: In spite of its slight stature, POKENAME weighs more than ten tons and can withstand pressures equivalent to that of being in the deepest parts of the ocean. As such, its inner workings have remained a mystery for even the greatest professors.

entry: POKENAME被设计为空袭单位，能发出声波攻击，扰乱敌方机械。趁敌人尚未缓过来，便俯冲而下，将尾巴当拆楼铁球，猛砸对方。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME were engineered as aerial assault units capable of emitting sonic attacks that disrupt enemy machinery. While the enemy reels from their sonic attack, they will swoop down and swing their tail like a wrecking ball upon them.

entry: POKENAME友善，喜欢和训练家散步、来个黏糊拥抱，尤其是平时很少能遇见同类。眼中能射出强力激光，让许多可能成为朋友的生物不敢靠近。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are friendly Pokémon and enjoy walks and slimy hugs with their Trainer, especially since they do not meet many of their kin often. The powerful lasers that can be shot from their eyes deter many potential friends from approaching.

entry: POKENAME被认为较友善，常玩闹着追赶训练家。不过仍要小心，激动时会从面罩射出等离子能量，连最硬的合金也能熔化。
author: theaceofhearts0306
source: POKENAME is recognized as a relatively friendly Pokémon, often seen playfully chasing its Trainer. Caution is advised, as when agitated, POKENAME will fire a blast of plasma energy from its visor, capable of melting even the toughest alloys.

entry: 这些宝可梦游荡寻找伙伴时，构成身体的未知可塑物质，会不断渗出、滴落。即使本体已走得很远，滴下的物质也会在几小时后返回身上。
author: infinex21
source: The unknown, malleable material of these Pokémon oozes and drips from their bodies as they wander in search of companions. The drippings of their bodies eventually return to them after a few hours, even though they have already wandered far away.

entry: POKENAME形成于废弃工地，住在未完工建筑的地基中。钢筋穿过混凝土，塑成新的宝可梦。它们四处游荡，寻找自身使命。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME form within abandoned construction sites within the foundations of buildings that were never completed. Rebar threads its way through the concrete and gives form to the new Pokémon. They wander in search of purpose.

entry: POKENAME的身体由特殊金属构成，几乎不可能熔化，甚至很难留下瑕疵。身旁温度寒冷刺骨，力量一涌出，就能冻住周围30米的一切。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's body is comprised of a special metal that is nearly impossible to melt or even blemish. Temperatures near it drop to chilling levels, and it can surge its own power to freeze solid everything within 30 meters around it.

entry: POKENAME在废料场游荡，用灼热核心熔掉找到的金属，再裹到身上塑形。它被认为极具敌意，最好别去打扰。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME wanders scrapyards, melting metal it finds by using its heated core and shaping it around its body. It is considered incredibly hostile, and it is recommended to leave it alone.

entry: POKENAME中央放出高电压，成为许多钢属性宝可梦的充电站。闲置时纹丝不动，吸收附近洛托姆的能量。
author: theaceofhearts0306
source: Due to the high voltages emitted from its center, POKENAME functions as a charging station for many steel-type Pokémon. While in an idle state, it lies still, absorbing energy from nearby Rotom.

entry: POKENAME的手臂装有未知古代科技，能发射激光，唯独构成自身身体的那种金属能反射。身体的金属不断拉伸，维持体形，也让它持续受苦。
author: soup1900
source: The arms of POKENAME are fitted with unknown ancient tech that allows it to fire lasers that only the type of metal that makes up its body can reflect. Its metal is being constantly stretched to form its body shape, giving it constant pain.

entry: POKENAME察觉威胁时，头顶触角会发出尖声，提醒附近宝可梦。中空壳内能存下充足物资，让许多年幼宝可梦躲在里面，生存数天。
author: infinex21
source: When a POKENAME detects a threat, the antennae atop its head will emit a shrill noise that alerts nearby Pokémon. Its hollow shell is able to house enough supplies to allow many young Pokémon to survive for days within its shelter.

entry: POKENAME的腿虽然完好，却更喜欢轻轻悬浮着前进。遇险时，从蘑菇放出孢子云，再蜷成球滚走。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: While their legs are perfectly fine, POKENAME prefer to softly hover to travel. If endangered, POKENAME will release a spore cloud from their mushrooms, curl into a ball, and roll away.

entry: POKENAME是人造宝可梦，勘察人类难以生存的极寒北地。它负责监测巨大冰川，留意是否融化或崩裂。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are artificial Pokémon that survey northern lands with climates too cold for humans to properly survive. Their task is to monitor the state of massive glaciers should any melt and/or break apart.

entry: POKENAME是人造宝可梦，负责防止巨大冰川崩裂。若冰川开始破碎，附近雷吉龙便会通知最近的POKENAME，前来固定碎块，重新冻合。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are artificial Pokémon tasked with preventing massive glaciers from breaking apart. Should any massive glaciers begin to break, nearby Regiaura will alert the nearest POKENAME to come secure the pieces and freeze them back together.

entry: 它强壮又坚韧，常被富裕训练家用来护宅。机械化的双眼与尾巴一齐搜寻，便无人能逃过。
author: thefinalkalgonus
source: A strong and resilient fusion often used to defend the homes of wealthy Trainers. With the help of its cybernetic eyes and tail, no one can escape it.

entry: POKENAME用音响系统播放重金属乐。音量开到最大，混响足以震碎周围坚固金属结构，轻易赶跑入侵者。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME utilizes its sound system to play heavy metal music. At max volume, the reverb could shatter solid metal structures around it and easily send intruders packing.

entry: POKENAME靠一种等离子能量飞行，在身后形成红色光环。能量向周围放出独特波动，让附近生物陷入多梦的沉睡。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's flight ability is fueled by a type of plasma energy that forms a red ring behind it. The energy releases unique wave pulses around it that cause living beings nearby to fall into deep, dream-filled sleeps.

entry: POKENAME的爪能张开，射出灼热光束，烧毁地形，让那里看似荒芜。过一段时间，烧焦处却会长出奇怪金属蘑菇。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's claws can open up to fire out beams of searing light that burn away the terrain and leave it seemingly barren. Some time later, strange metallic mushrooms will begin to grow in the seared spots.

entry: 这种人造宝可梦周围配着各种圆盘状无人机，几乎不用动，甚至完全不动，也能操纵。无人机能精准发射能量弹，或投出广阔护盾，让POKENAME成为危险的对手。
author: infinex21
source: This artificial Pokémon is clad in various disc-like drones that it can control without having to move much, if at all. These drones can fire precise energy blasts or project expansive shields, which make POKENAME a dangerous foe to ever face.

entry: POKENAME无法穿透的铠甲，由与雷吉斯奇鲁身体相同的神秘金属构成。它精神不稳定，先以善意引来受害者，再一边嘲笑，一边凶狠杀死对方。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME's impenetrable armor is made of the same mysterious metal that made up Registeel's body. It is mentally unstable and will lure victims in with kindness before violently terminating their existence while mocking them.

entry: 传说将POKENAME描述为凶猛战士，击倒一切反抗者。实际目击却发现，它颇为平和，常修剪花木。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Legends describe POKENAME as a fierce warrior that struck down all that opposed it. Sightings of POKENAME have revealed that POKENAME is quite peaceful, often pruning trees and flowers.

entry: 这些奇怪宝可梦住在深洞，从身上红色部分放光，扫描周围。发现有趣事物，耳朵便竖起，发出短促尖声，再陷入休眠。
author: infinex21
source: These strange Pokémon dwell in deep caverns, emitting lights from the red portions of their bodies that scan all around them. When they find something interesting, their ears will perk up and they will emit a short, shrill noise before going dormant.

entry: POKENAME的盾比钻石还坚硬。它有英雄本色，自然灾害发生时，会用盾保护平民。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: The shield of POKENAME is tougher than diamonds. Due to its heroic nature, POKENAME uses its shield to protect civilians from harm during natural disasters.

entry: POKENAME是异常的机械宝可梦，能使用神秘力量。魔杖尖端是一团未知材料，为了执行未知任务，可以变成无数形态。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME is an anomalous, mechanical Pokémon capable of wielding mystical powers. The tip of its wand is a mass of unknown material that can take any number of forms for the sake of an unknown mission.

entry: POKENAME颈边线缆末端的卡片，用来收集更多资料，归档见闻。它常潜入资料中心，接入系统，寻找关于世界的知识。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: The card at the end of the cables around a POKENAME's neck act as a way for them to gather more information and catalog what they've seen. POKENAME often sneak into data centers to plug into their systems as they search to learn about the world.

entry: POKENAME似乎是生物与机械结合的宝可梦，机械部分由未知可塑材料构成。不知为何，它常召集并带领雷吉小子群。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME appear to be cybernetic Pokémon with the mechanical portions of their bodies made of an unknown, malleable material. For a yet-unknown reason, they often can be found gathering and leading groups of Regiggy.

entry: 船只利用POKENAME的睡莲叶，充当声呐，避免撞上水生宝可梦。不过，带它上船不一定是好主意，因为它有时会把船引向浮标，打算吃掉浮标。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Ships utilize POKENAME's lily pad as a form of sonar to make sure they don't hit any water Pokémon. Having POKENAME onboard is not always recommended, as sometimes POKENAME guide ships to buoys in order to eat them.

entry: 船只利用POKENAME的睡莲叶，充当声呐，避免撞上水生宝可梦。不过，带它上船不一定是好主意，因为它有时会把船引向浮标，打算吃掉浮标。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Ships utilize POKENAME's lily pad as a form of sonar to make sure they don't hit any water Pokémon. Having POKENAME onboard is not always recommended, as sometimes POKENAME guide ships to buoys in order to eat them.

entry: POKENAME头顶卫星碟形天线，传送当地天气现象的资料信号。天线也容易积满雨水，它免不了跳起慌乱的“舞”，把水甩掉。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME bear a satellite dish atop their heads, which transmit data signals about local weather phenomena. The dishes are also prone to filling with rain water and POKENAME will inevitably engage in a frantic "dance" to rid themselves of this water.

entry: 不论落地多重、从多高处摔下，POKENAME的金属身体从不会刮伤或凹陷。人们相信，金属壳保护着由难以想象的能源构成的核心。
author: sk372
source: No matter how hard or from how high POKENAME plummets to the ground, its metallic body never gets scratched or dented. It is believed its metal shell protects a core made of an unfathomable energy source.

entry: POKENAME的金属身体，能承受重返大气的高热与落地冲击，毫无损伤。战斗时，多个圆点会射出奇异的宇宙能量。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's body is composed of a metal sturdy enough to survive the heat of reentry and impact with the ground without a blemish. A strange sort of cosmic energy fires off from its multiple dots when in combat.

entry: POKENAME用尾端火焰调节能量。紧张时，或尾火烧得更猛烈时，它会因混乱而胡乱攻击。
author: addithewise
source: POKENAME uses the fire at the end of its tail as its energy regulator. Whenever POKENAME is stressed, or the tail has been burning at an increased intensity, it has been known to lash out in confusion.

entry: POKENAME身体的奇特材料，比钻石硬，却又极易塑形。它常在深洞中，用下半身充当激光发射器，开采各种材料。
author: infinex21
source: The strange material of a POKENAME's body is harder than diamonds and yet is extremely malleable as well. These strange Pokémon are typically found within deep caverns using their lower body as a laser emitter to mine for various materials.

entry: POKENAME坚韧的金属身体，几乎不受外来攻击，却依然受头痛折磨。偏头痛加剧时，头部会放出奇怪脉冲能量。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's tough metal body makes it nearly impervious to outside attacks, but it still suffers painful headaches. When the migraines intensify, its head emits a strange pulsing energy.

entry: POKENAME聪明又精于计算，转瞬就能制定战术。精神力供给额头宝石，能射出灼热能量束，仿佛任何材料都切得开。
author: sk372
source: Highly intelligent and calculating, POKENAME formulates battle tactics in fractions of a second. Psychic power fuels the gem on its forehead, which can release a searing beam of hot energy that can cut through seemingly any material.

entry: POKENAME的金属身体，比钛还坚硬，因此被认为无法摧毁。若一连飞行太多天，不休息，就可能过热，失去对自身行动的控制。
author: fiordaliso
source: The metal that makes up its body is tougher than titanium, giving rise to the belief that POKENAME is indestructible. If it flies for too many days in a row without resting, it risks overheating and losing control of its own actions.

entry: POKENAME用池水保湿，金属身体一干，运作就没那么顺畅。硕大的红球能扫描360度，观察周围。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME keeps itself moistened with pond water, as its metallic body functions less optimally when dried out. The large red orbs are able to scan 360 degrees to survey its surroundings.

entry: 这种形态的POKENAME，视觉、听觉似乎比其他个体差。不过水中速度更快，躯干球体的能量输出也更强。
author: sk372
source: This variant of POKENAME appears to have poorer senses of vision and hearing than others. Its speed in the water has increased, however, as has the energy output from the orbs on its torso.

entry: POKENAME柔韧的金属身体，比起承受冲击，更擅长分散热量与电流。一察觉将遭袭，通常会瞬间移动离开，不去硬接。
author: .jerden
source: The flexible metal that POKENAME is made of disperses heat and electricity much better than it withstands physical force. If POKENAME senses it will be attacked, it usually teleports away rather than trying to take the hit.

entry: POKENAME身体与手中汤匙，由同样的反光金属构成。每次使用超能力，附近金属物体都会像液体一样，扭曲变形。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's body is composed of the same reflective metal that the spoon it holds is made out of. Whenever it uses its psychic power, nearby objects made of metal will warp and deform as if made of liquid.

entry: POKENAME的金属身体反光极强，大部分能量都会直接弹开。它极少移动，只浮在空中，用超能力生成、引导红色能量束，攻向敌人。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's metal body is highly reflective, and most energy will simply deflect off it. It rarely moves, simply floating in the air and using its psychic powers to create and direct beams of glowing red energy towards foes.

entry: POKENAME个头像个孩子，却能压倒比自己更大的敌人。因此，训练家常找它作护卫。
author: addithewise
source: Despite its childlike stature, POKENAME has been known to overwhelm opponents larger than it. As such, Trainers seek POKENAME as a means of protection.

entry: POKENAME的金属肌肉，即使休息也散发能量。为了控制巨大输出，它常向巨石开炮，打成更小、容易清理的碎块。
author: addithewise
source: The metallic muscles of POKENAME radiate energy, even while at rest. As a means of controlling this tremendous output, it often fires its cannon at boulders to break them up into smaller, easier-to-clear debris.

entry: POKENAME身体的合金，被认为近乎无法摧毁。它的格斗本领极难抵挡，甚至可能无从防御。它常寻找值得挑战的训练家。
author: addithewise
source: The alloys that make up POKENAME's body are thought to be almost indestructible. Defending against its martial prowess may prove challenging, if not impossible. POKENAME often seeks worthy Trainers to challenge.

entry: POKENAME受到威胁时，会伏低、蜷进壳里。外壳比钻石还硬，几乎不可能穿透。
author: quackquackattack
source: When threatened, POKENAME bunkers down and curls into its shell. Its shell is tougher than diamonds, making penetrating through the shell nearly impossible.

entry: POKENAME行走山区时，定期停下，握住各种石头分析。似乎很少有石头能通过审查，不过还不知道它究竟在找什么条件。
author: sk372
source: As POKENAME travels around mountainous regions, it stops regularly to grip and analyze various stones. Very few rocks seem to pass its scrutiny, though it is still unknown what criteria it is searching for.

entry: POKENAME身上装着大量引擎，让它奔行快得目眩。全速时，可能不到一天，就能绕世界一周。
author: sk372
source: The large amount of engines attached to POKENAME's body let it dash around at blindingly fast speeds. At max velocity, POKENAME could potentially circumnavigate the whole world in less than a day.
