entry: POKENAME尾内藏着巨型能量炮，威力足以毁掉地形。可它忘了自己有这本领，极少放出比照明光束更厉害的东西。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's tail contains a large energy cannon that possesses enough force to decimate the landscape. However, POKENAME has forgotten it has that capacity, and rarely creates anything more than a simple beam of illuminating light.

entry: POKENAME闲着时，尾尖产生奇异能量。性质仍未知，因为一察觉其他生物靠近，就立刻将尾巴收进身体。
author: sk372
source: When idle, POKENAME generates a strange type of energy from the tip of its tail. Its nature is unknown, as POKENAME immediately tucks its tail into its body when it senses another nearby.

entry: 据说POKENAME的巨大尾巴，藏着可能无穷尽的信息，足以让所有人获得启迪。可惜，它不是毫无所觉，就是彻底忘光，反而整天懒散度日。
author: infinex21
source: The large tail of a POKENAME is said to contain potentially-infinite information that could bring enlightenment to all. Unfortunately, it is either completely unaware of this or has completely forgotten about it and instead lazes about all day.

entry: POKENAME扫描每个敌人，计算战斗胜算。宝可梦巡护员建议，若被它逼入绝境，拉扯电线就能扰乱扫描器，轻松逃走。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME scan every foe, calculating the odds of success in combat. Pokémon Rangers recommend that if one were to be cornered by POKENAME, pulling on their wires disrupts their scanners, allowing an easy escape.

entry: 人们相信POKENAME由太空中的先进文明创造。它结实无比，甚至能提取目标的DNA。被它追赶，少有生物能逃脱。
author: autismgaming89_51746
source: It is believed that POKENAME were created by an advanced civilization from space. POKENAME are incredibly durable and can even extract one's DNA. Few can escape when being chased by one.

entry: POKENAME金属身体虽沉，在冰寒水域依然游得快而灵活。头上圆点发出的光束，能瞬间冻住碰到的一切。
author: sk372
source: Despite the heavy weight of its metal body, POKENAME swims through frigid waters with great speed and agility. The beams fired from the dots on its head can instantly freeze whatever they touch.

entry: POKENAME所到之处，机器腐蚀、金属生锈。核心虽然满是锈蚀腐败，任何攻击却都划不伤。
author: celio_0230
source: Wherever POKENAME treads, machinery corrodes and metals rust. Its metal core, despite being covered in rust and decay, is unable to be scratched by any attack.

entry: POKENAME由类似汞的神秘金属构成，触碰也同样有毒、有害。银色黏液吞下的物体，片刻就会被溶解。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME's body is composed of a mysterious metal similar to mercury and is just as toxic and harmful to the touch. Objects swallowed by its silvery slime are dissolved in a matter of moments.

entry: 城市的友好商店，有时用POKENAME代替普通收银机。有些经过训练，能辨别真假，把所有假钱吐出来。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Poké Mart in cities occasionally have POKENAME in place of standard cash registers. Some POKENAME have been trained to detect forgery and will spit out any counterfeit Pokédollars.

entry: 纤细灵巧的四肢，与大得荒唐、难以驾驭的巨钳，形成鲜明对比。这只钳子，足以轻易将它自己压碎。
author: bukie
source: Its slender and dexterous limbs are contrasted by its absurd, unwieldy claw, which could easily crush itself.

entry: 背上的种子，已开成一朵大红花，花心能释放各种孢子。它还能散发甜美花香，让敌对宝可梦失去战意。
author: fiordaliso
source: The seed on its back has blossomed into a large red flower, from whose center it can release various kinds of spores. It has the ability to emit a floral aroma so sweet that it makes opposing Pokémon lose the will to fight.

entry: POKENAME的肉极易引发过敏，天敌哪怕只啄一口，嘴里也会剧痛、发炎。因此，它从容生活，毫不畏惧其他宝可梦。
author: t3isukone
source: POKENAME's flesh is incredibly allergenic, and even a peck at it causes severe pain and inflammation in the mouths of its predators. Thus, it goes about its life placidly, showing no fear of other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME的三个头，各自掌管花朵的一种防御功能。由不同的头主导时，散出的花粉能治疗、伤害，或让沾染者动弹不得。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's three heads each control an aspect of the flower's defense functions. Depending on which one is in control, the pollen spread can heal, harm, or immobilize those afflicted by it.

entry: POKENAME把花蜜抹在骨头盔上，画出与孵化地植物相同的花纹。遇见陌生人或宝可梦时很警惕，不过送上花朵，它很快就会亲近。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME smears nectar on its bone helmet to create flower patterns that match the flora from the area it hatched in. It is wary of meeting new people and Pokémon, but warms up quickly if given flowers.

entry: POKENAME一心守护整窝蛋，几乎顾不上吃饭；幸好花会散出花粉，引来小猎物。孩子孵化后，它教它们利用周围材料制作武器，有效战斗。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME single-mindedly defends its egg clutch nearly to starvation, but its flower emits a pollen that attracts small prey. When its offspring hatch, it teaches them how to fashion weapons from their surroundings and fight effectively.

entry: POKENAME一心守护整窝蛋，几乎顾不上吃饭；幸好花会散出花粉，引来小猎物。孩子孵化后，它教它们利用周围材料制作武器，有效战斗。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME single-mindedly defends its egg clutch nearly to starvation, but its flower emits a pollen that attracts small prey. When its offspring hatch, it teaches them how to fashion weapons from their surroundings and fight effectively.

entry: POKENAME一心守护整窝蛋，几乎顾不上吃饭；幸好花会散出花粉，引来小猎物。孩子孵化后，它教它们利用周围材料制作武器，有效战斗。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME single-mindedly defends its egg clutch nearly to starvation, but its flower emits a pollen that attracts small prey. When its offspring hatch, it teaches them how to fashion weapons from their surroundings and fight effectively.

entry: 阳光充足的季节，POKENAME的花瓣会长到最繁盛。每走一步，花瓣晃动，散出浓浓毒花粉。它还会用强力踢击，将花粉吹散到更广的地方。
author: shyguy11011
source: During the sunny seasons, POKENAME's petals will grow and bloom to their fullest. With every step, the petals shake, releasing heavy clouds of toxic pollen. POKENAME will use its powerful kicks to disperse the pollen over a large area.

entry: 暖季，POKENAME产生大量花粉，让周围笼起橙色雾霭，刺激呼吸。身上的花苞越长越大，直到无法悬浮，便必须将其蜕掉。
author: pjporwoll
source: In warm seasons, POKENAME generates excessive clouds of pollen, leading to an orange haze in its environment that irritates breathing. The buds on its body grow to large sizes until it cannot hover, after which it must shed them.

entry: POKENAME将毒花粉凝成密实、硬如岩石的壳，保护发育中的身体。这层铠甲一碰就剧毒，天敌凡以身体攻击，立刻就会中毒。
author: ambrosia04
source: To protect their developing bodies, POKENAME condense toxic pollen into a dense, rock-hard shell. This armor is highly toxic to the touch, ensuring that any physical attacks from predators result in immediate poisoning.

entry: POKENAME产生恶臭雾气，驱赶啃食花朵的害虫。园丁依玉虹市花店主设计的配方调制堆肥，引它住进园中，也让雾气多了施肥作用。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME generates a rank haze which drives away pests that would feed on its flowers. Gardeners craft a compost mixture designed by a Celadon City florist that coaxes it to live on their grounds and adds a fertilizing aspect to the haze.

entry: POKENAME受惊时，会散出浓密黄孢子，使对方麻痹、失去方向感。一旦跑起来，非得撞上东西才停得下。
author: infinex21
source: A startled POKENAME will scatter thick, yellow spores that can cause paralysis and disorientation. Once it starts running, it cannot stop until it collides with something.

entry: POKENAME转动钻头般的角时，花瓣也会向周围散出令人晕头转向的孢子。全身肌肉厚实，硬如石头。
author: infinex21
source: When it spins its drill-like horn, it also scatters disorienting spores all about from its petals. A POKENAME's body is packed with thick muscles and is as hard as stone.

entry: POKENAME拼命保护孩子，把它们装在育儿袋里，由巨花遮阴。危险靠近，就释放催眠花粉，带着幼崽以惊人速度逃走。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME fiercely protects its young, carrying them in their pouch where they are shaded by their giant flower. When danger approaches, it releases sleep-inducing pollen while fleeing with surprising speed.

entry: POKENAME飘行于热带表层水域，用能抓握的尾巴缠住浮木，或相互缠在一起。背上的叶状鳍吸收阳光，靠热带太阳的能量维生。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME drift through the surface waters of tropical regions, using their prehensile tail to cling to driftwood or to one another. They absorb sunlight through the leafy fin on their back, sustaining themselves on the energy of the tropical sun.

entry: POKENAME头顶花朵提供伪装，体色又警告水中天敌，肉里有毒，所以极少被捕食。模样美丽，性情平静，深受富裕水族爱好者喜爱。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is rarely predated upon as it is camouflaged by the flower from above and its coloration warns aquatic predators of its poisonous flesh. It is favored by wealthy aquarium hobbyists due to its beauty and calmness.

entry: POKENAME假扮成沼泽植物的花。有人靠近，便先撒出大量剧毒花粉，再赶紧逃走。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME likes to disguise itself as the flower of a swamp plants. Anyone approaching it is bombarded with highly toxic pollen before it flees.

entry: POKENAME浮在沼泽表面，以甜香引来虫宝可梦，再用花粉，让对方麻痹。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME floats on the surface of bogs. It emits a sweet scent to attract bug Pokémon, which it then paralyzes using pollen.

entry: POKENAME躲在林间空地的洞里，用花伞保护巢穴。若发现你踩上花伞，就会以屏障困住，直到你成了花的食物。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME hides in holes in forest clearings, with its flower parasol protecting its den. If POKENAME finds you stepping on its parasol, it traps you in a Barrier until you become food for its flower.

entry: POKENAME虽然好看，头顶恶臭花朵却让其他生物敬而远之。它会追着其他宝可梦亲吻，可许多都不愿接受。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME may be beautiful to look at, but their foul-smelling flowers atop their heads makes others keep their distance. POKENAME chase other Pokémon to give them kisses, a prospect many find unappealing.

entry: 从上方看，POKENAME酷似花朵，免受空中威胁。头上毒刺平常收在花心，只有需要自卫，才会伸出。
author: pjporwoll
source: From above, POKENAME mimics the appearance of a flower, protecting it from aerial threats. It normally keeps its venomous head spike retracted into the center of the flower, extending it only when needed for protection.

entry: POKENAME攻击性极强，容易狂暴发作。大闹时，鳍会散出剧毒花粉。
author: raydrago
source: POKENAME is a highly aggressive Pokémon, prone to violent outbursts. During its rampage, it scatters extremely toxic pollen from its fins.

entry: POKENAME看似普通花朵，身体却既黏又毒。触碰会引发危险而严重的皮肤刺激，可能持续一个月以上。
author: mistymagius
source: While looking like a regular flower, POKENAME's body is both incredibly sticky and poisonous. Touching it will cause dangerously severe skin irritation that can last over a month.

entry: 产花粉最多的季节，POKENAME会无意间让其他生物麻痹。幸好，周围的粉云也成了警告，提醒那些初见可爱外表、毫无防备的生物。
author: yourfriendhare
source: POKENAME cause unintended paralysis in seasons where they produce the most pollen. Luckily, when POKENAME are surrounded by a cloud of powder, it serves as a warning for those who are unaware of this at first due to their cuteness.

entry: POKENAME的花瓣泛着微光，呈现鲜艳红色。它天生对进化石充满好奇，接近石头的能量时，花便满怀期待地波动摇曳。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME petals have a luminescence to them that give them a vibrant red hue. They have an innate curiosity about elemental stones, their flower rippling and moving with anticipation as they get close to their energies.

entry: POKENAME的皮肤一干，头上的花就会发出极刺鼻的气味。训练家最好随时备好保湿手段，免得家中臭气熏天。
author: sk372
source: As POKENAME's skin dries out, the flower on its head emits an extremely pungent aroma. POKENAME Trainers are advised to always be ready to moisturize it to keep their home from smelling horribly.

entry: POKENAME的花粉带静电，让颗粒相互黏住，也附在毛上。它能突然反转自身电荷，扬起花粉云，遮挡视线，刺激眼睛。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME pollen carries a static charge that causes the grains to stick to one another and to the fur of POKENAME. POKENAME can abruptly invert their own electrical charge, creating a cloud of pollen that obscures vision and irritates eyes.

entry: POKENAME常被温暖舒适的橙色花粉围绕。花粉暖得能熔雪，所以许多园丁会养一只，帮忙度过冬季。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are often wreathed in plumes of a warm, comforting, and orange pollen. This pollen can be so warm that it can melt snow, so many gardeners have a POKENAME to aid them during winter.

entry: POKENAME受到威胁时，退进壳中。若壳再受扰，会剥落细小薄片，吸入后引发剧烈痉挛。春夏时，壳会重新长好。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: When threatened, POKENAME retreats into its shell. Should its shell be disturbed, small flakes of it break off that cause violent seizures if inhaled. The shell regrows in spring and summer.

entry: POKENAME钻入林地，只露出花朵。花会分泌香甜如蜜的花蜜，越接近出壳，分泌量就越少。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME burrows into the forest floor so only the flower remains exposed. It excretes a sweet honey-like nectar from the flower, which dwindles in quantity as it nears emerging from its shell.

entry: POKENAME的大花已占据外壳。它在丛林爬行，花朵就是极好的伪装。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME has a large flower that has taken over its shell. It scuttles in jungles where the flower makes for great camouflage.

entry: 它身上气味刺鼻，走过时，就能让一些人类与宝可梦，当场昏倒。
author: theheroict
source: The scent given off by this Pokémon is pungent. It causes some Pokémon and humans to faint when it walks by.

entry: 花一开始散出花粉，就代表它快要醒来。醒着时，会不断释放这种虽刺激、但除此无害的花粉。吃饱树果与水果后，又会睡去。
author: infinex21
source: When pollen is loosed from its flower, it is about to awaken from its slumber. It will continue to loose this irritating, but otherwise harmless, pollen while awake. It falls asleep after gorging itself on berries and fruits.

entry: POKENAME很为自己的花自豪，总爱展示给愿意看的生物。唯有训练家尊重它、给足体面，芳香花朵才肯绽放。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME takes a great amount of pride in its flowers, proudly flaunting them to anyone who will watch. Its fragrant flowers only bloom for Trainers who treat this Pokémon with great dignity and respect.

entry: POKENAME寻找恶臭花朵采蜜，带回臭气熏天的巢。若敌人太危险，不宜用臂上花瓣刺击，就打开腹部，将储存的毒孢子全数喷向对方。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME seeks rank-smelling flowers to collect nectar and return to its putrid-scented hive. When it encounters a threat too dangerous to jab with its arm petals, it opens its abdomen to unleash its entire payload of toxic spores on the foe.

entry: POKENAME动用精神能量时，头顶花朵涌出浓密刺鼻的花粉。吸入后，心智会麻木、衰弱，让它更占上风。
author: sk372
source: When POKENAME exerts psychic energy, thick and pungent pollen pours from the flower on its head. This pollen numbs and weakens the minds of those who inhale it, further giving POKENAME an edge over its opponents.

entry: 谁惹烦POKENAME，就会被喷上头顶花瓣产生的麻痹孢子。它喜欢用力量变成遇见的宝可梦，只为看对方困惑的反应。
author: fiordaliso
source: If someone annoys POKENAME, it sprays them with paralyzing spores generated by the petals on its head. It loves using its powers to take on the appearance of Pokémon it encounters, just to watch their confused reactions.

entry: POKENAME贪玩，爱恶作剧，不过大多无害。它瞬间移动到人面前，再洒下花粉，让受害者整整24小时，都沾着恶臭。
author: sk372
source: A playful but mostly harmless prankster. POKENAME teleports before people, then douses them with pollen from its flower, leaving the victim coated with a repugnant smell for 24 hours.

entry: 它们转动头顶叶片，扬撒有毒花粉，通常用来吓退威胁。POKENAME吃树果与小植物，食物也会影响叶片香气。
author: infinex21
source: They twirl the leaves on their heads around to cast around their noxious pollen, typically as a deterrent for threats. POKENAME feed on berries and small plants, which influence the aromas of their leaves.

entry: POKENAME头顶长着一片花瓣，向地面垂下。边缘锐利，只要把握时机甩头，就能切开植物。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have a single petal growing from their heads that droops downward toward the ground. The petal's edge is sharp, able to cut through plant matter with a well timed swing of the head.

entry: 有些POKENAME腿格外长，能穿行浓密灌丛。这些罕见个体凭借身高，啃食其他同类难以够到的树枝。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Some POKENAME have unusually long legs that they use to traverse through dense undergrowth. These rare POKENAME use their height to feed on branches that other POKENAME struggle to reach.

entry: POKENAME游荡密林，寻找高枝上的水果。头顶花朵染上所吃水果的香气，食谱越丰富，闻着就越像一整盘水果。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME roam through dense jungle in search of fruit to feed on in high branches. The flower on their head takes on the scent of the fruit they feed on, with more varied diets resulting in POKENAME that smell like an entire fruit bowl.

entry: POKENAME的花耐火，又厚实得能提供可观防护。它通常十分胆小，会躲在自己的花下。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME flowers are fireproof and dense enough to offer substantial defense. They are typically very timid Pokémon that will hide under their own flowers.

entry: 感到威胁时，花朵喷出浓浓毒花粉。每粒花粉一点燃，都会猛烈爆开。除了帮助战斗，这些花粉也被用在部分烟花中。
author: infinex21
source: Thick plumes of noxious pollen erupt from its flowers when it feels threatened. Each speck of pollen will violently burst if set aflame. Although this serves it well in battle, this pollen is also used in some fireworks.

entry: POKENAME发怒时，点燃花中产生的花粉，制造耀眼爆炸，晃盲敌人。近年，人们也用花粉制作格外绚丽的烟花。
author: mepp.
source: When angered, POKENAME ignites the pollen produced by its flowers to create a dazzling explosion that blinds enemies. In recent years, this pollen has been used to create especially colorful fireworks.

entry: POKENAME大多数时候，产生的只是普通花粉。不过星光明亮的夜里，花粉往往会像天上星辰一样闪耀。虽然漂亮，对大多数宝可梦却很危险。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME produce fairly ordinary pollen most of the time. However, during nights with bright starlight, the pollen tends to shine like the stars above. While beautiful, this pollen is dangerous to most Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME靠花蜜为食，寻找能找到的最大植物。它会染上采蜜花朵的香气，头顶花散发宜人芳香。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME feed on the nectar of flowers, searching for the largest plants they can find. They take on the scent of the flowers they drink from, the flower on their head exuding a pleasing aroma.

entry: POKENAME一感觉花开始绽放，就爬向能找到的最高处。到顶后摇动腹部，向空中释放花粉，让微风带走。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME crawl up to the highest points they can find once they feel their flower start to bloom. They shake their abdomen once they have reached the peak to release the pollen into the air to be picked up by the breeze.

entry: POKENAME在水下放出花粉云自卫时，花会迸出亮光。即使没被光晃盲，也很可能因碰到残留花粉，而看不见。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's flower flashes brightly when it expels a cloud of pollen underwater in self-defense. Those that aren't blinded by the light itself will likely still be blinded from contact with the pollen left behind.

entry: POKENAME的花粉效力极强，随着它沿林地蹦跳而散开，催生新植物迅速冒出。
author: mepp.
source: The pollen that POKENAME produces is very potent. It spreads as it hops along the forest floor, causing new plant growth to quickly spring up.

entry: 丛林风暴中，POKENAME挥杖、散发浓香，带领小型宝可梦前往安全处，确保队伍不失散。它保护着这群同伴，谁来威胁，就用十万伏特攻击。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME shepherd smaller Pokémon to safety during jungle storms, waving their staff and exuding a strong aroma to ensure they never lose track of them. They are protective of their flock, launching Thunderbolts at anyone who threatens them.

entry: POKENAME花瓣内部结构复杂，受击就能产生静电。它站在倾盆暴雨中蓄电，一感到威胁，就释放能量攻击。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME flower petals contain a complex internal structure that allows them to generate a static charge when struck. They stand out in torrential rainstorms to build up their internal charge, letting loose as an attack should they feel threatened.

entry: POKENAME释放能减轻痛感的花粉，舒缓理疗的疼痛。它与医护合作，确保花粉剂量恰当，帮助康复。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME assuages the pain of physical therapy by releasing pollen that numbs pain. It works alongside medical staff to ensure the pollen is given at the right dose to facilitate healing.

entry: 傍晚，POKENAME在长草的空地起舞。满月照耀下，花瓣闪烁微光。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME dances in grassy clearings during the evening. Its petals shimmer and glow under the light of the full moon.

entry: 这种悠闲的融合体，画画颇有功力，不过主要用来画些滑稽东西。
author: hophoppip
source: This laid-back fusion is capable of drawing with proficiency, though it mainly uses this skill to draw silly things.

entry: 田间、园中，常用POKENAME代替稻草人。它装成树木，释放麻痹花粉，赶走威胁。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are common alternatives to scarecrows in fields and gardens. They pose as trees and loose paralytic pollen to dispatch threats.

entry: POKENAME住在茂密丛林，清晨穿行树冠，白天便静止休息。头顶大花能从远处引来虫属性宝可梦。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME live in lush jungles, moving through the canopy in the mornings and settling in place during the day. The large flowers on their heads draw in bug Pokémon from great distances.

entry: POKENAME的花定时喷出少量花粉，帮助感知风向。看见花粉飘向想去的地方，就跃上空中，张开双臂乘风。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME's flowers give periodic puffs of pollen that help them to sense the direction the wind is blowing in. When they see their pollen travel in the direction they want to go, they leap into the air and spread their arms wide to catch the breeze.

entry: POKENAME一感觉风大起来，就兴奋挥臂，花瓣在微风中翻动。训练家通常能循着空中浓花香，轻易找到野外的它。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME wave their arms around excitedly when they feel the wind pick up, their petals ruffling in the breeze. Trainers can usually find POKENAME easily in the wild by the strong scent carried through the air from their flowers.

entry: 玉虹市周围常见POKENAME，搜寻修剪下来的植物碎屑充饥。它在向阳处蜷起小睡时，与普通花朵毫无区别。
author: pjporwoll
source: A frequent sight around Celadon City, POKENAME scavenges for plant clippings for sustenance. When it curls up to nap in a sunny spot, it is indistinguishable from a normal flower.

entry: 这些宝可梦蹦跳前进，每跳一下，头顶花朵就喷出一团黄孢子。花粉营养丰富，能让田地、农场生长茂盛。
author: infinex21
source: These Pokémon move by hopping about and with every hop, they release puffs of yellow spores from the flowers atop their heads. This pollen is rich with nutrients, which help fields and farms to grow lush.

entry: POKENAME走路时，摇晃长颈上的头，向周围撒出浓密黄花粉。吸收的阳光让花粉富含养分，摸起来暖暖的。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME sway their long-necked heads around as they walk, scattering clouds of thick, yellow pollen around them. This pollen is nutrient-rich from the sunlight they absorb and feels warm to the touch.

entry: 天气越暖，POKENAME的臭味越难闻。虽然没有毒，单凭气味，就足以让食草动物不敢下口。
author: .jerden
source: The warmer the weather, the more unpleasant POKENAME's stench becomes. Although it isn't poisonous, the smell alone is enough to deter any herbivores from trying to eat it.

entry: POKENAME适应冷水，却感知不到温度。脸颊花朵一热，就开始散出刺鼻气味，惹得其他宝可梦驱赶它。奇怪的是，这反而帮它留在凉爽地方。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME is adapted to cold waters but is unable to sense temperature. The flowers on its cheeks begin to emit a pungent smell if they get too warm, causing other Pokémon to chase them away. Oddly, this reaction helps it stay in cooler areas.

entry: POKENAME完全不知道，自己的花粉既臭又毒。它不断寻找伙伴，不懂对方为何躲着它，或相处一会儿就生病。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is completely unaware of the stench or toxicity of the pollen its flower spreads. It constantly seeks out companions, not understanding why they avoid it or grow ill after spending time with it.

entry: POKENAME相当懒惰，头顶巨花常被当成普通花，虫类与鸟类宝可梦想来啃食。它或花一受袭，就放出浓浓毒花粉，逃之夭夭。
author: infinex21
source: Because POKENAME are rather lazy, the large flowers on their heads are often mistaken for normal flowers that bug and bird Pokémon try to feed on. When they or their flowers are assailed, POKENAME release plumes of toxic pollen and run away.

entry: POKENAME背上的种子已长成硕大深红花朵，散出浓浓强效孢子。据说甜香能安抚最凶猛的宝可梦，消磨战意。
author: fiordaliso
source: The seed on POKENAME's back has matured into a grand crimson bloom that releases clouds of potent spores. Its sweet fragrance is said to calm even the fiercest Pokémon, draining their will to battle.

entry: 白天，POKENAME把身体埋进土里，只露花朵，在丛林向阳处边取暖边睡觉。夜间再钻出地面，聚在一起交往。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME bury themselves up to their flower in soil during the day, sleeping in sunny patches of the jungle whilst they warm themselves. At night they dig themselves out and gather together to socialise with one another.

entry: POKENAME用漂亮花帽引人靠近，再朝脸喷出一团引发过敏的花粉。
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher
source: POKENAME lures people in with the beautiful appearance of its flower cap before releasing a burst of allergenic pollen into their face.

entry: POKENAME休息时，很容易被当成鲜艳大花，因此常被打扰。谁碰花瓣，都会被扑上来咬，更别说踩上去了。
author: infinex21
source: When POKENAME rest, they are easily mistaken for large, vibrant flowers; because of this, they are often disturbed from their slumber. When their petals are touched, let alone stepped on, they lunge at and bite the perpetrator.

entry: 这只宝可梦脾气暴躁，自己的花挡住视线，让它几乎随时准备打架。POKENAME一乱挥乱动，就从花中撒出浓密花粉，令人发痒、烦躁。
author: infinex21
source: This short-tempered Pokémon is almost always ready to brawl due to its own flower blocking its vision. When it thrashes around, POKENAME scatters thick clouds of pollen from its flower; in fact, its pollen can induce itchiness and irritability.

entry: POKENAME能将花中的毒粉，存进有力双钳。这样就能抓住敌人的头，确保对方将每一粒毒粉都吸进去。
author: epping_forest
source: POKENAME can store the poisonous powder of its flower in its strong claws. This way, it can grab the heads of its enemies and make sure not even a single particle of that poison is left unbreathed.

entry: POKENAME把身体钻进落花散下的花瓣间，用柔软花瓣藏身。遇到威胁，便缩回花瓣中，等周围危险过去。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME thread their bodies through the discarded petals of fallen flowers, using the soft material as a hiding place. When threatened, they retreat within the petals and wait out whatever danger is around.

entry: POKENAME与开花植物共生，把植物护在壳中，带着移动，确保光照、水分充足。作为回报，花结出树果，让它储存，饿时再吃。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME form a symbiotic relationship with flowering plants, keeping the plant safe within their shell and moving it to ensure it is well lit and watered. In return, the flower grows berries that POKENAME can stockpile and eat when they're hungry.

entry: POKENAME与开花植物共生，把植物护在壳中，带着移动，确保光照、水分充足。作为回报，花结出树果，让它储存，饿时再吃。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME form a symbiotic relationship with flowering plants, keeping the plant safe within their shell and moving it to ensure it is well lit and watered. In return, the flower grows berries that POKENAME can stockpile and eat when they're hungry.

entry: POKENAME的眼睛对光很敏感，强烈阳光容易让它目眩。为适应白天，它与花朵共生，让花始终为自己遮阴。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have very light sensitive eyes and are easily dazzled by strong sunlight. To help them manage in daylight, they have formed a symbiotic relationship with a flower that provides them with constant shade.

entry: 熔融身体散发刺鼻硫臭。虽然热如岩浆，近期研究却发现，它与植物有许多共同特征。
author: hophoppip
source: Its molten body gives off a pungent sulfurous odor. Despite being as hot as lava, recent studies have found that it shares many characteristics with plants.

entry: POKENAME的花不断向空中释放花粉。颗粒覆着薄薄黏液，一碰到表面便黏上。花粉容易引起过敏，有时还会造成呼吸问题。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME flowers release a constant stream of pollen into the air. The pollen particles are coated in a thin layer of mucus, binding to the first surface they touch. Their pollen is allergenic and can sometimes cause respiratory problems.

entry: POKENAME的花散发恶臭，常被比作烧焦肉味。气味引来远方传粉者，再循着它留下的黏液轨迹，找到本体。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME flowers give off a foul odour that is often likened to the smell of burnt meat. The smell draws pollinators from far away, using the slimy trail that POKENAME leaves behind it to find it.

entry: POKENAME颈根周围的花不断散粉，吸入便会昏昏欲睡。飞行时留下花粉轨迹，常让下方宝可梦接连睡倒。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The flower growing around the base of the necks of POKENAME constantly exudes pollen that has a soporific effect on those that inhale it. They leave a trail of this pollen as they fly, often resulting in Pokémon falling asleep below them.

entry: POKENAME挖地寻找植物根吃，毛中便积满土与污物，纠结成块。泥土多得能养活植物，背上因此长出大花。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME's fur becomes densely matted with soil and dirt as they dig through the ground in search of plant roots to feed on. Their fur is packed with enough soil that it can support plant life of its own, large flowers growing from their back.

entry: POKENAME的毛中挤满植物，根与毛缠在一起，吸取挂住的碎屑为食。乱根中定期冒花，持续的刺鼻气味，让它烦乱难安。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME fur is thick with plant matter, roots matting in amongst the hairs and feeding on the detritus that gets caught in their fur. Flowers periodically bloom from the mess of roots, driving POKENAME to distraction with the constant pungent smell.

entry: POKENAME盘在大树旁，想用巨花引来虫类宝可梦。巴大蝶、大针蜂等传粉者，能让它饱上好几天。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME sits coiled near large trees, hoping to lure in bug Pokémon with its large flower. Pollinators like Butterfree and Beedrill can keep POKENAME sated for several days.

entry: POKENAME寻找落果与树果吃，让花酿出浓郁花蜜。所吃树果不同，花蜜的风味、质地也变，可辛辣，可香甜，也可咸鲜。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME seek out fallen fruits and berries to eat to help their flower develop a rich nectar. The nectar's flavour and texture change depending on what berries POKENAME have eaten, and can be spicy, sweet, or savoury.

entry: 它们的长牙中空，更像软管，在特定季节释放孢子。象鼻力大，能举起巨石，也十分善于从土地吸取养分、吸水。
author: infinex21
source: Their tusks are hollow and serve more like hoses that loose their spores during specific seasonal times. Their trunks are strong enough to lift boulders and are very efficient at absorbing nutrients from the land and at absorbing water.

entry: POKENAME睡在丛林地面的花间，完美模仿花朵质地。猎物靠得太近，就喷出粉红粉末，一接触便能造成麻痹。
author: .izik
source: While sleeping among flowers on the jungle floor, POKENAME mimics their texture perfectly. When prey ventures too close, it releases bursts of pink powder capable of causing paralysis on contact.

entry: 压榨宽大花瓣所得的液体，营养极其丰富，有助于增强免疫力。它温和顺从，常住在靠近树林的农场。
author: fiordaliso
source: The liquid obtained by pressing its broad petals is extraordinarily nutritious and helps strengthen the immune system. It is a gentle and docile creature commonly found on farms built near woods and forests.

entry: POKENAME是治疗草属性宝可梦的行家，敏锐又总乐于助人。它温柔照顾病患，训练家若试图干扰工作，却会受到训斥。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are astute experts at healing Grass-type Pokémon and are always willing to help others. They are gentle with Pokémon they take care of and are known to chastise Trainers who try to interfere with their work.

entry: 这些宝可梦休息时，头顶大羽毛常被当成大花。飞过天空时，身后跟着道道无害黄花粉。
author: infinex21
source: The large feathers upon the heads of these Pokémon are often mistaken for a large flower when they are resting. They are trailed by plumes of harmless, yellow pollen as they fly through the sky.

entry: POKENAME飞过农田，从头顶花朵撒下毒粉，让作物无法发芽。它记仇又恶毒，毁掉领地附近的收成。
author: fiordaliso
source: As it soars over farmlands, POKENAME scatters toxic powder from the bloom on its head, preventing crops from sprouting. With its vengeful and maleficent nature, it devastates harvests near its domain.

entry: 巨花帮助它躲避威胁，却也让它吸收过多水分。为了平衡体液，它把多余水分化成眼泪排出。
author: infinex21
source: Its large flower helps it to hide from threats, though it also causes it to absorb too much water. To balance its fluid levels, it releases the excess as tears.

entry: POKENAME用电荷刺激花朵生长，寻找电势高的地方。常能在发电厂周边田野见到它，正享受着周围的能量。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME use electrical charges to help stimulate the growth of their flower, seeking out areas with high electrical potential to aid them. They are a common sight in the fields surrounding power plants, basking in the ambient energy.

entry: POKENAME用臂部肌肉与掌心开口，向敌人发射孢子弹和大种子。它喜欢住在近山的森林边缘，或长草的洞穴里。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME can use the muscles in its arms and the open ports in its palms to fire spore bombs and large seeds at foes. They prefer to live near mountains on the edge of forests or within grassy caves.

entry: POKENAME虽然白天活动，却对阳光极其敏感。厚厚藤蔓如毯，加上大花瓣投下的阴影，保护着皮肤。
author: t3isukone
source: Though diurnal, POKENAME is extremely sensitive to sunlight. It protects its skin with its thick carpet of vines and the shade cast by its large petals.

entry: POKENAME大半天都在晒太阳。遇到威胁，便从手臂发射阵阵毒花粉。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME spend most of their day basking in the sun. When threatened, they fire bursts of toxic pollen from their arms.

entry: 它挖洞藏身，让巨花留在地面作伪装。身体沾水会讨厌，花被浇水却很喜欢。
author: infinex21
source: It digs holes to hide in, with its large flower kept above ground and serving as camouflage. It hates if its body gets wet, but loves when its flower is watered.

entry: POKENAME高速振动厚花瓣，保持浮空，发出轰隆嗡鸣。猛烈拍动扬起阵阵毒尘，所以一听见嗡鸣，最好离开附近。
author: lordjoostmeister
source: POKENAME beats its thick petals at high speed to keep itself in the air, creating a rumbling buzz. The petals' furious movement throws off gusts of toxic dust, so it is prudent to leave areas where POKENAME's buzz can be heard.

entry: POKENAME用巨牙清掉树木、灌丛，开辟宽阔林间空地，整天懒洋洋地晒太阳。研究者推测，这是为了减少巨花争夺阳光的竞争。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME use their great tusks to clear away trees and bushes and create large glades where they can spend their days lazing in the sun. Pokémon Researchers theorise that they do this to reduce competition for sunlight for their gigantic flowers.

entry: POKENAME游荡丛林，培育真菌。分泌物是这些菌类的绝佳肥料，对植物、人类与其他宝可梦却有剧毒。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: POKENAME wanders the jungles growing fungi. Its secretions act as a great fertilizer for said fungi, but they are incredibly toxic to plants, people, and other Pokémon.

entry: 这只宝可梦释放有毒花粉自保，让人头痛欲裂。人们发现，花粉一碰火花，极易燃烧。
author: bradlybro199
source: This Pokémon protects itself by releasing a noxious pollen that gives people a splitting headache. The pollen has been discovered to be extremely flammable if hit by a spark.

entry: POKENAME每天练腿，撑住头上不断长大的花。反复踢击带来的旋转，也将花中团团花粉甩出。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME train their legs daily so they can support the growing flowers on their heads. The gyration that results from the many kicks they perform results in plumes of pollen being scattered from their flowers.

entry: POKENAME用微弱超能力，托住不断长大的花。橙色犄角能感知其他生物的情绪，若察觉恶意，就躲到花下。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME use their weak psychic powers to help support their growing flowers. Their orange horns allow them to sense the emotions of others and they will hide under their flowers if they sense malice.

entry: 据说，它的超能力强得足以预见未来。通常在晴天出现，于田间起舞，黄色花粉云绕着身体旋转。
author: infinex21
source: Supposedly, its psychic powers are great enough for it to see into the future. It is mostly seen on sunny days, dancing in fields with clouds of its yellow pollen swirling around it.

entry: POKENAME旋转起舞，身后留下一道道在空中闪亮的花粉。表演惊艳，不过致敏花粉会慢慢积聚，只有在户外，才能安全观赏。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME leave trails of pollen glittering in the air in their wake as they dance and twirl. Their performances are breathtaking, but can only be safely watched outside due to the gradual build-up of their allergenic pollen.

entry: POKENAME腰间长着下垂长花瓣，组成优雅裙装。再配上头顶宽檐大花，让它在时装秀极受欢迎。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have long, draping petals sprouting from their waist that form an elegant dress. This, combined with the broad-rimmed flower adorning their head, make them incredibly popular Pokémon at fashion shows.

entry: POKENAME的花瓣柔软如丝，可作优雅礼服。它穿行舞会，留下花香，总能让宾客欢喜。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME petals have a soft, silk-like texture that allows them to function as elegant dresses. They sweep through balls, leaving a floral scent in their wake that invariably delights guests.

entry: POKENAME腰间的花瓣裙，垂着长长半透明纤维，覆有细花粉。移动时渐渐散出，吸入后，会生出亲密友好的感觉。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The skirt of flower petals around the waist of POKENAME trail long strands of translucent fibres that are coated in a fine layer of pollen. This pollen gradually disperses as they move and, when breathed in, it engenders feelings of camaraderie.

entry: POKENAME战斗时，用巨花作盾，受击就释放使身体发麻的花粉。趁敌人受影响，再用刀刃般的手臂，使出叶刃反击。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME uses its large flower as a shield during battle, which releases numbing pollen when struck. It will counterattack with a Leaf Blade from its blade-like arm while its foe is affected by this pollen.

entry: POKENAME挖大洞，用巨花伪装自身，避开争斗。夏季产生浓浓干燥花粉，颗粒感如同沙子。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME dig large holes and use their large flowers to disguise themselves and avoid conflict. During summer, they produce thick plumes of a grainy and dry pollen reminiscent of sand.

entry: 野生POKENAME在洞中休息，让后部花朵朝外，作为伪装。巡护员会记录找到的个体，因为它能嗅出、吃下有毒植物；不过这种食谱，也让角带了毒。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME rest in burrows with their rear flowers aimed outward, serving as camouflage. Rangers keep track of any they find, because these Pokémon can sniff out, and will eat, poisonous plants. This diet, however, causes their horns to be toxic.

entry: POKENAME不能自行产生叶绿素，必须大量吃植物，才能保持花朵健康。它们一家会啃倒树木，吃上方枝条的嫩叶。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are not able to produce their own chlorophyll and have to rely on eating large quantities of plant matter to ensure they can keep their flowers healthy. Families of POKENAME gnaw down trees to eat the young leaves on the upper branches.

entry: POKENAME不能自行产生叶绿素，必须大量吃植物，才能保持花朵健康。若找不到足够食物，花就变褐、枯萎。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are not able to produce their own chlorophyll and have to rely on eating large quantities of plant matter to ensure they can keep their flowers healthy. Their flowers turn brown and wilt if they're not able to find enough food.

entry: 一朵半透明花，从POKENAME的石头里探出。花臭得几乎无法忍受，勉强靠近者还会发现，它向一切太近的生物释放毒花粉。
author: sk372
source: A translucent flower emerges from within POKENAME's stone. The stench of the flower is almost overpowering, and those who manage to get near will find that it dispenses poisonous pollen to anything that gets too close.

entry: POKENAME遇袭时，向空中放出各种孢子，遮住敌人视线，再用尖刺刺击。等平静后，训练家收集花粉，增强解毒药效。
author: ghostslythe
source: When under attack, POKENAME releases various spores into the air to blind its foe before stabbing them with their thorns. After it calms down, Trainers collect its pollen to strengthen their Antidotes.

entry: 白天，POKENAME把身体埋进土里，只露花朵，在丛林向阳处边取暖边睡觉。夜间再钻出地面，聚在一起交往。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME bury themselves up to their flower in soil during the day, sleeping in sunny patches of the jungle whilst they warm themselves. At night they dig themselves out and gather together to socialise with one another.

entry: POKENAME产生的花粉，存进巨颚中。暖季产量最高时，巨颚会合拢，保护花粉不被贪吃的三蜜蜂夺走。
author: poppyisconfused
source: The pollen produced by POKENAME is stored inside its large jaw. During warm seasons when pollen production is at its highest, POKENAME's jaw closes to protect it from greedy Combee.

entry: POKENAME每次用头撞击，花都会严重受损。看有多少枯花瓣，就能知道它打过多少架。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Every time a POKENAME headbutts, it receives substantial damage to its flower. You can tell how much fighting it does by the amount of wilted petals it has.

entry: POKENAME用坚硬金属头，保护鲜艳花朵。它最爱小洞穴，用头堵住入口，确保花不受伤害。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME use their hard, metal heads to protect their vibrant flowers. They are most fond of small caves as their homes, where they use their heads to seal off the entrance to ensure nothing harms their flowers.

entry: POKENAME常平躺在丛林或森林的空地，因此身上往往长出一层苔藓。它会以毒花粉与惊人力量，坚决捍卫领地。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME often lay flat in clearings within jungles and forests, which is why they often develop a layer of moss upon their bodies. They will fervently defend their territories with noxious pollen and their remarkable strength.

entry: 古时候，POKENAME会袭击村庄。白天若看见它，就意味着不久会遭到伏击。
author: codewolfie
source: In ancient times, POKENAME would ravage villages. Seeing one during the day signified an ambush in the near future.

entry: POKENAME头顶的花大到遮住视线，让它难在林地行走。不过，花也提供极佳伪装，帮助躲开危险，弥补这份不便。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The flowers growing out of the heads of POKENAME are large enough to obscure their vision, making it hard for them to navigate the jungle floor. This liability is offset by the excellent camouflage it provides, helping them stay hidden from danger.

entry: POKENAME结成小群移动，沿途啃食丛林低矮植物。感到威胁时，一齐低头、挤成一团，看着像一大丛花。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME move together in small herds, grazing on the jungle undergrowth as they do. When they feel threatened, they lower their heads in unison and huddle together, making them appear to be a single large bush of flowers.

entry: POKENAME演化出与妙蛙花相同的生态位，常被拿来比较。它在神奥演化，需要竞争的有毒草属性宝可梦少得多，因此转而发展出地面属性。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have evolved to fill the same ecological niche as Venusaur, leading many to compare the two. Having evolved in Sinnoh, POKENAME has far fewer poisonous Grass type Pokémon to compete with and so developed a Ground type instead.

entry: POKENAME白天结群睡觉，紧紧挤在高高的树枝上。它们的花朵，将睡处巧妙地掩饰起来，看上去只是枝头开满了花。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME troupes sleep together during the day, spending the daylight huddled together high up in the tree branches. Their flowers help disguise their sleeping place, making it appear as though the branches are simply in bloom.

entry: POKENAME白天结群睡觉，紧紧挤在高高的树枝上。它们的花朵，将睡处巧妙地掩饰起来，看上去只是枝头开满了花。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME troupes sleep together during the day, spending the daylight huddled together high up in the tree branches. Their flowers help disguise their sleeping place, making it appear as though the branches are simply in bloom.

entry: POKENAME藏在大花瓣下，向猎物隐去身形。它从花瓣释放麻痹孢子，捕捉猎物。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: POKENAME hides beneath the large petals of its flowers to disguise itself from its prey. POKENAME emits paralyzing spores from its petals to hunt.

entry: POKENAME一家结群，灵活而快速地荡过树梢，寻找鲜果。移动时留下花粉轨迹，像细雨般落向林地，标出它们的路线。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are agile Pokémon, swinging through the treetops at a rapid pace in family troupes in search of fresh fruit. They leave a trail of pollen as they move, a gentle rain of it falling to the forest floor and marking out their path.

entry: POKENAME战斗时，故意大幅扫动身体，抖落团团花粉。四肢一挥，将粉云扇向对手，还能用火焰骤然将其点燃。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME deliberately make broad sweeping movements in battles to shake loose large puffs of pollen. They use sweeps of their limbs to waft the pollen clouds at their opponents, and can use bursts of flame to cause the clouds to abruptly ignite.

entry: POKENAME的性格，被形容为和头上喷出的花粉一样毒。它极度排外，林中只要稍有闯入者踪迹，就会连吐种子与毒液轰击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has been described as having a personality as toxic as the pollen it spews from its head. Extremely isolationist, even a hint of a trespasser in its forest is met with a barrage of spit-up seeds and poison.

entry: 这根手杖会放出黄色的花粉云，效力强得足以让人麻痹。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: This staff emits a clouds of yellow pollen that is so potent it can cause paralysis.

entry: POKENAME有两种削弱猎物的办法。头花散出遮挡视线的花粉，尾花则放出另一种浓花粉，造成麻痹。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has two different ways of debilitating its prey. The flower on its head spreads out blinding pollen, while the flower on its tail can send out thick puffs of a different pollen that causes paralysis.

entry: POKENAME保护花田，谁破坏天然植被，就会遭攻击。若某块田地被翻坏，它便撒种，恢复受损部分。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are protective of flower fields, attacking anyone who tries to destroy the natural flora. If a section of the fields is torn up, POKENAME spread seeds to restore the damaged section.

entry: 密林深处，数十只、甚至更多POKENAME彼此扣连，像活体工厂般协作，制造令人窒息的花粉云。等花朵占满一片区域，便分开，迁往别处。
author: icelevelincarnate
source: Deep in the jungle, dozens upon dozens of interlocking POKENAME will work together like an organic factory and produce smothering clouds of pollen. Once an area is overrun by their flowers, they break apart and move elsewhere.

entry: POKENAME的花粉能致幻，让吸入的训练家以为它是人、可信赖的宝可梦，或当地植物。若被识破，它就在一团黄花粉中消失。
author: ghostslythe
source: POKENAME's pollen contains hallucinogenic properties, allowing it to appear to Trainers inhaling it as a person, trusted Pokémon, or plant native to the area. If discovered, POKENAME disappears in a cloud of yellow pollen.

entry: 身上的大花，散出安抚心神的香气，让任何靠近的生物，都渐渐平静。
author: melodydelune
source: The large flowers on its body emit a calming aroma that pacifies anyone that comes near.

entry: 它庞大笨重，住在毒植物繁密的森林。POKENAME花中放出的刺鼻孢子云，能让植物长在任何表面，石头、金属，甚至人的皮肉也不例外。
author: sk372
source: A huge lumbering denizen of forests heavy with poisonous plants. The pungent spore clouds POKENAME's flower releases can cause flora to grow on any surface, such as stone, metal or even human flesh.

entry: 据说，它会在雨后漆黑的夜里出现。甜腻的花粉能让人类与宝可梦瞬间入眠。
author: busilisk
source: It is said to appear during dark nights after rain. Its cloying pollen can put people and Pokémon to sleep instantly.

entry: 太阳出来，POKENAME便变得十分贪玩，常跟着训练家走。不过甜香会招虫，园丁不太喜欢选它作伙伴。
author: poppyisconfused
source: When the sun is out, POKENAME becomes incredibly playful, often seen following trainers. However, it is an unpopular choice among gardeners due to its sweet scent that attracts bugs.

entry: 它从头顶、尾尖喷出黏花粉，强烈刺激周围生物。甚至能激怒附近宝可梦，让它们攻击一切沾着花粉的目标。
author: bandedbodypress
source: It puffs out sticky pollen from the top of its head and tip of its tail. This pollen is extremely irritating to anything around it. It can even enrage nearby Pokémon into attacking anything covered in the pollen.

entry: POKENAME能释放带电花粉，震晕附近宝可梦。能量不足，就从被震晕的宝可梦身上吸取能量，重新充电。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME can release electrically charged pollen, stunning nearby Pokémon. It leeches off of these stunned Pokémon to recharge when low on energy.

entry: POKENAME领地意识极强，靠独特恶臭辨认同类。一察觉陌生气息，就喷出刺鼻毒气，臭味能传遍半径50英里的范围。
author: creaturecore
source: It's extremely territorial, and recognizes others of its kind by their distinct vile scent. When it senses any unknown presence, POKENAME spews a noxious gas so pungent that the stench can reach a 50 mile radius.

entry: 某些广袤森林里，能见POKENAME碾过沿途一切，身后长出一道花。它被认为剧毒而危险，据说只碰一下，就可能折寿。
author: penguiweeni
source: In some vast forests, some POKENAME have been spotted crushing everything through their path, causing a trail of flowers to grow. It is said that POKENAME are very dangerous and poisonous, as one touch could shorten your life.

entry: POKENAME身上受热的花瓣，产生灼烫花粉。它能操纵周围花粉云，烧伤靠得太近的宝可梦。
author: .jerden
source: The heated petals on POKENAME's body produce scorching pollen. POKENAME can control the cloud of pollen it creates around itself and uses it to burn Pokémon that get too close.

entry: 羽毛沾满剧毒、刺人的花粉。一激动，便拍起双翅，让令人窒息的粉尘，充斥四周。
author: staghorn
source: Its feathers are saturated with toxic, stinging pollen. When agitated, it flaps its wings and chokes its surroundings with its suffocating powder.

entry: POKENAME九条尾巴都由花瓣般的物质构成，一碰就烫。激动时，会从身上抖下毒花粉，接触便会灼伤。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's nine tails each have the composition of flower petals and are hot to the touch. When agitated, it shakes loose toxic pollen from its body that burns on contact.

entry: 这些宝可梦极其罕见，一旦遇见，最好逃跑。POKENAME巨大、缓慢，却致命，有人称它们为异世界的可怖怪物。
author: naivetotoro
source: These Pokémon are extremely rare, and it is advised to run if you encounter one. POKENAME are enormous and slow, but deadly. Some people call them otherworldly abominations.

entry: 这些宝可梦极其罕见，一旦遇见，最好逃跑。POKENAME巨大、缓慢，却致命，有人称它们为异世界的可怖怪物。
author: naivetotoro
source: These Pokémon are extremely rare, and it is advised to run if you encounter one. POKENAME are enormous and slow, but deadly. Some people call them otherworldly abominations.

entry: POKENAME释放浅色花粉，在空中如星星闪烁。吸入后，会看见最深的愿望成真的幻觉。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME releases a light-colored pollen that sparkles in the air like stars. Breathing in this pollen causes hallucinations where one's greatest wishes come true.

entry: POKENAME游泳时，像巨花浮在河上。它筑坝为巢，以带刺、有毒植物装点，作为防御。性情友好，花粉却极易引起过敏。
author: milchik
source: When POKENAME swim, they look like huge flowers floating on top of a river. They build dams as their nests and adorn them with thorny and poisonous vegetation for defense. POKENAME are very friendly, but their pollen is extremely allergic.

entry: 有些地区，POKENAME的花呈美丽淡粉色，令人想起春日清晨。花瓣干后极易燃烧，经过后若没清理干净，就可能留下火灾隐患。
author: katieplaysgames
source: In some regions, POKENAME flowers bloom in a beautiful pale pink, evoking the feel of a spring morning. Their petals are highly flammable when dried out and can cause fire hazards if not properly cleaned up after a POKENAME has passed by.

entry: POKENAME从头顶花瓣放出格外甜美的香气，感谢听它唱歌的生物。许多医生建议聆听它的歌声，因为人们相信，有助于疗养。
author: fiordaliso
source: It thanks those who have listened to its songs by releasing an extraordinarily sweet fragrance from the petals on its head. Many doctors recommend listening to POKENAME's singing, as it is believed to hold therapeutic properties.

entry: 花瓣饱含液体与养分，身体却依然有力，能走上数英里才歇息。天气温暖潮湿时，它会摇身，向周围撒出浓浓毒花粉。
author: infinex21
source: The petals of its flower are thick with fluid and packed with nutrients, yet its body is strong enough to walk miles before resting. During warm and humid weather, it will shake itself and scatter plumes of thick, noxious pollen all around itself.

entry: POKENAME吸收阳光时，背上植物充满能量，头顶花瓣随之晃动，散出毒花粉。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: While absorbing sunlight, the plant on POKENAME's back becomes energized; shaking the petals on its head and spreading poisonous pollen.

entry: 最好让POKENAME尽可能多晒太阳。离开直射阳光越久，头花吐出的花粉就越有毒、越让人窒闷。
author: sk372
source: It is best to keep POKENAME in sunlight as long as possible. The longer it goes without direct exposure, the more noxious, cloistering pollen the flower on its head exhales.

entry: POKENAME用花跳起繁复舞蹈，身后留下浮空的金色花粉。舞者很喜欢它，想学习动作，融入自己的编舞。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME perform elaborate dances with their flowers, leaving traces of golden pollen floating in their wake. They are popular with dancers who seek to learn their movements and incorporate them into their own choreography.

entry: POKENAME的花太沉，影响了跳跃本领。可谁也劝不住它继续尝试，哪怕已经倒栽着卡住。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME's flower is so heavy that its jumping abilities are compromised. But it cannot be convinced to stop trying, even when it gets stuck upside down.

entry: POKENAME飘行花田，采集附近花朵的花粉。它散出的芳香，被用来助眠，帮助失眠者睡着。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME floats around flower fields where it collects pollen from nearby flowers. The aroma produced by POKENAME is harnessed as a sleep aid, helping people with insomnia fall asleep.

entry: POKENAME钻进地下，只露头花。每逢受伤，就放出浓烈金属气味，引火属性宝可梦前来，烧烤那些打扰它的家伙。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME burrow themselves underground so only the flower on their head is exposed. Whenever they are hurt, they release a thick, metallic scent that lures in Fire-type Pokémon into the area to roast whoever is bothering them.

entry: POKENAME将头花的毒粉汇入口中，咆哮时喷出浓云。极少有植物或人能接触花粉，而不生一场重病。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME funnels the poisonous pollen from the flower on its head into its mouth, letting out thick clouds whenever it roars. Very few plants or people can be exposed to the pollen without getting extremely ill.

entry: POKENAME走到哪里，就撒花粉，催花生长。若抓到训练家破坏自然，便从头花产生奇雾，将对方变成自家花园的雕像。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME scatter pollen to grow flowers wherever they go. If they catch a Trainer harming nature, they will produce an odd mist from the flower atop their heads, turning the Trainer into a statue for their garden.

entry: POKENAME几乎无声地旋舞在月下树林，每一步都搅动空气，优雅如幽影。观众常忘了鼓掌，看得入迷，什么也顾不上做。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME twirls through moonlit groves in near silence, each step stirring the air with a ghostly grace. Audiences often forget to applaud, too mesmerized to do anything but watch.

entry: POKENAME只吃腐坏或过熟的树果，因此农民收获时，常让它留在身边，清掉不要的农作物。
author: kittyluv090
source: POKENAME is known to only eat spoiled or over-ripened berries, so farmers often keep it around during harvests to clean up unwanted produce.

entry: 有些商家会直接拒绝接待养POKENAME的训练家，哪怕精灵球仍封得严严实实。它散发的恶臭，足以让附近小型宝可梦昏倒。
author: jangodiot
source: Some businesses will outright deny services to a Trainer who owns a POKENAME, even if its Pokéball is sealed. This Pokémon releases a stench so foul it can make smaller surrounding Pokémon pass out.

entry: POKENAME不常见，不过至今的目击地点，全在花田。若被踩到，就尖叫、散出毒花粉，再迅速飞走。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are an uncommon sight, though anytime they have been spotted has been within a field of flowers. If they are ever stepped on, they emit a shrill cry and scatter toxic pollen from their flowers before quickly flying away.

entry: POKENAME花瓣的恶臭，只有同类觉得好闻、诱人。秋天产生的奇特紫花粉，会引发严重过敏。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME's petals release a foul stench that only members of its own species find pleasant and appealing. In autumn POKENAME produces a peculiar purple pollen that can trigger severe allergic reactions.

entry: POKENAME随风散出的花粉，闻着颇为香甜。有时会吸引虫属性宝可梦成群涌来。
author: universal9449
source: The pollen that POKENAME's flowers release into the wind smells quite sweet. This smell can sometimes attract Bug-type Pokémon to swarm in the area.

entry: POKENAME的羽毛虽被认为很漂亮，穿云飞行时散出的恶臭，却让它被视为麻烦。
author: hophoppip
source: Though POKENAME's plumage is considered quite beautiful, it's seen as a nuisance due to the noxious odors it spreads when it flies through the clouds.

entry: 这只大花宝可梦，花瓣长得太盛，几乎动不了身，便用花粉诱来其他宝可梦，照顾自己。
author: theheroict
source: A large flower Pokémon overgrown with petals. It can barely move, but uses pollen to lure Pokémon in to care for it.

entry: POKENAME的花瓣能脱落，露出甜菜根般的核心。环纹越多，水分越充足，因此在干旱地区，是很好用的水分指标。
author: jaminmcready
source: The petals on POKENAME can fall off to reveal a beetroot-like core. The more rings it has, the more hydrated it is, making it a useful indicator in dry regions.

entry: 这种霸王花自融合体的花粉，比未融合的霸王花更容易引起严重过敏。如果花粉过敏特别厉害，尤其不在花粉季，也可能是附近住着一只。
author: infranscia
source: This self fusion of Vileplume has even more horrendously allergenic pollen than an unfused Vileplume.  If you're having an extra bad case of hay fever, especially out of season, it's possible one of these Pokémon is living somewhere nearby.

entry: POKENAME头上的花放出恶臭，驱走天敌。花朵也常用于传统药物，舒缓感冒与疼痛。
author: mepp.
source: The flowers on POKENAME's head release a terrible odor that keeps predators away. These flowers are often used in traditional medicines to alleviate colds and aches.

entry: POKENAME是芳香疗法师很喜欢的伙伴，贪玩性子让它总想亲近人，香气也令人充满年轻活力。它爱寻找花朵，送给人们。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are popular companions for aromatherapists, their playful nature making them constantly eager to be around people whilst their scent elicits feelings of youthful energy. They love to seek out flowers to gift to people.

entry: POKENAME结群游荡丛林觅食，合作击倒更大的宝可梦。嗅觉敏锐，不必看见，也能凭彼此尾花的气味，掌握同伴所在。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME packs roam through jungles in search of food, working together as teams to take down larger Pokémon. They keep track of one another using their keen sense of smell, able to scent the tail flowers of one another without needing to see them.

entry: 夜幕降临，POKENAME摇曳头顶华丽花朵，放出甜香，引来毫无防备的猎物。石爪坚硬锐利，连钢铁也能刮伤。
author: fiordaliso
source: When night falls, POKENAME sways the petals of the magnificent flower on its head to release a sweet scent and lure in unsuspecting prey. Its stone claws are so tough and sharp that they can scratch even steel.

entry: 夜幕降临，POKENAME摇曳头顶华丽花朵，放出甜香，引来毫无防备的猎物。石爪坚硬锐利，连钢铁也能刮伤。
author: fiordaliso
source: When night falls, POKENAME sways the petals of the magnificent flower on its head to release a sweet scent and lure in unsuspecting prey. Its stone claws are so tough and sharp that they can scratch even steel.

entry: 它用欺人的旋律迷住毫无戒心的宝可梦，再借花粉催眠，强迫对方失神地替自己收集食物。
author: hexx_vixtar
source: It captivates unassuming Pokémon with its deceitful melody. Using its pollen, it hypnotizes and forces the Pokémon to mindlessly gather food for it.

entry: POKENAME能产生各式香气，有的美妙，有的难闻。它用花状身体蜕下的碎片做袋子，装着一瓶瓶气味。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME produces fragrances of all varieties, both lovely and horrid. It carries bottles of its fragrances in a bag made from shed pieces of its flowery body.

entry: 植物学家长期研究POKENAME，着迷于背上花朵与蘑菇的独特共生。蘑菇给花提供重要养分，花则向风中释放孢子。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Botanists have spent a lot of time studying POKENAME, fascinated by the unique symbiosis between the flower and the mushroom that grow on their backs. The mushroom provides the flower vital nutrients, whilst the flower releases spores to the wind.

entry: POKENAME靠轮子滚行时，很善于保持平衡。它在黑夜疾驰，寻找食物与住处。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME is skilled at balancing while rolling on its wheels. It zooms about in the dark of night, searching for food and shelter.

entry: POKENAME用花粉制造雾，悄悄行动。需要撤退时，便扇动花瓣，让周围覆满花粉。
author: hiroshima0042_23263
source: POKENAME creates fog from its pollen to sneak around. When POKENAME needs to retreat, it flaps its petals and the area gets covered in pollen.

entry: POKENAME头部释放的花粉，一入空气，就迅速凝成实心团块。哪怕只是轻轻一甩，也足以把猎物打飞，再裹上一层毒孢子。
author: soup1900
source: When POKENAME releases its pollen into the air, they quickly congeal into a solid blob from its head. Even the most casual flip of a POKENAME's blob is enough to send its prey flying, along with powdering them in a coat of noxious spores.

entry: POKENAME对音乐反应强烈，会随曲调改变行为。听到激烈或战斗风格的乐曲，就一边合拍摇身，一边抛撒毒花粉。
author: heal_fire
source: POKENAME react strongly to music, adapting their behaviour to the tune of the song. When they hear aggressive or martial music, they start throwing around some toxic pollen while shaking their body in rhythm.

entry: 夜间，POKENAME钻出地面，飞上高空，花瓣绕身旋转，吸收月光。它们已多次被误报成外星飞船。
author: santon5512
source: At night, POKENAME emerge from the ground and soar high into the sky, their petals rotating around their bodies as they absorb moonlight. Many of these Pokémon have been falsely reported as alien spaceships.

entry: POKENAME住在森林地道，贴住洞顶，露出花朵。任何生物走进巢穴，都会被喷上黄色酸液。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME lives in forest tunnels, clinging to the ceilings with its flower exposed. It sprays yellow acid at anything that wanders into its den.

entry: POKENAME的鳍鲜红漂亮，水中动作流畅夺目，是水族箱中很受欢迎的宝可梦。想保持鲜艳体色，就必须持续以榴石果喂养。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The vivid red fins of POKENAME make them a popular Pokémon to keep in aquariums, their movements eye-catching and fluid in the water. To maintain their striking colouration in tanks, they require a steady diet of Pomeg berries.

entry: POKENAME大群住在森林地道，散发凰梨果香。它们协调从洞壁喷出道道酸液，压倒猎物。
author: .izik
source: Large groups of POKENAME inhabit forest tunnels, releasing Pinap Berry scents. They coordinate acidic torrents from the walls to overwhelm prey.

entry: POKENAME夜间活动，徘徊寻找花粉丰富的地方休息。它是杂食者，几乎从不挑食。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is a nocturnal Pokémon that prowls around searching for pollen-filled areas to rest in. It is an omnivore; turning its nose up to any food is extremely uncommon.

entry: POKENAME即使睡着，也能用胡须感知附近任何振动，立刻警觉。高兴时，花会散出宜人香气，所以很受家庭喜爱。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME can sense, and become alert to, any vibrations nearby with their whiskers, even while asleep. Their flowers emit a pleasant scent when they are happy, so they are popular as household companions.

entry: POKENAME释放的花粉太多，是各地清洁工与管理员的噩梦。它常猛烈打喷嚏，力道大得足以引发头痛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are a nightmare for janitors and custodians everywhere because of the amount of pollen they release. They often violently sneeze with enough force to cause headaches.

entry: POKENAME脸上微笑，心里却怒火翻腾。越是暴怒，POKENAME越会撒毒花粉，偏偏又会引发POKENAME自己的过敏，让它更加火大。
author: darkweavile428
source: Despite POKENAME's smiling face, it is seething with rage on the inside. When it is especially angry, POKENAME will begin spreading poisonous pollen. This pollen also triggers POKENAME's allergies, which serves to make it even angrier.

entry: 若房屋被孢子云盖住，多半要怪POKENAME。它兴奋过头，就狂热地摇身，把孢子撒得到处都是。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: When clouds of spores cover houses, it's likely a POKENAME is to blame. When one becomes overexcited, it will feverishly shake its body, sending spores everywhere.

entry: POKENAME绕敌奔跑，留下滚滚花粉云，再踢起火花，制造大爆炸。战斗外，它很温顺，散发使人平静的花香。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME leave behind billowing clouds of pollen as they run around opponents before kicking up sparks to create large explosions. Outside of battle, they are very docile, releasing a soothing floral incense.

entry: POKENAME翱翔天空时，毒孢子从翼间落下。曾有记录，多只聚居的地区，天空一度被孢子染黄。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: When POKENAME soars through the skies, toxic spores fall from its wings. In an area with multiple instances of POKENAME, it was documented that the sky was temporarily blotted yellow with these spores.

entry: POKENAME游泳时，总把花留在水面，吸收照下的阳光。若被碰到，花便喷出雾般刺鼻的花粉，驱赶天敌。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME always keeps its flower on the water's surface as it swims, absorbing sunlight that shines down on the water. If touched, the flower sprays a mist-like pungent pollen to deter predators.

entry: 头上花瓣像帽子，保护它免受日晒。周围宝可梦太吵时，POKENAME就放出催眠孢子，让它们睡着，自己也好接着睡。
author: fiordaliso
source: The petals on its head protect it from the sun as if they were a kind of hat. If the Pokémon around it are too noisy, POKENAME releases sleep-inducing spores to make them fall asleep, and to go back to sleep itself.

entry: POKENAME受到威胁时，释放使人衰弱、诱发失忆的花粉。它独居，整天冥想，磨练超能力。
author: mepp.
source: When POKENAME is threatened, it releases debilitating pollen that induces amnesia. A solitary Pokémon, it spends its day meditating to hone its psychic powers.

entry: 它们的花沉重得惊人，身体因此长得十分强壮。为了跟上花的生长，总在不停训练。
author: infinex21
source: Their flowers are remarkably heavy, which has led their bodies to grow physically strong. They are always training to keep up with the growth of their flowers.

entry: POKENAME散出的孢子香甜，常受人追寻。传闻用孢子做成的古龙水，会让使用者显得更亲切、容易接近。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME is often sought after for the sweet-smelling spores it emits. Rumor has it that a cologne made from these spores makes the wearer more approachable.

entry: 它越动用精神力量，身体尤其是花瓣，就散出越多花粉。花粉强健身体、刺激肌肉，让体能超越极限；这可能是好事，也可能是坏事。
author: infinex21
source: The more it psychically exerts itself, the more pollen it releases from itself, especially its petals. This pollen bolsters the body and enflames the muscles, allowing one to exceed physical limits; this can be good or it can be bad.

entry: POKENAME从身上长出根，相互连接，形成地下网络。春天协同释放花粉，尽量提高授粉机会。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME sprout roots from their body and connect to each other to form an underground network. During spring, they coordinate to release the pollen from their flowers to maximize the chances of pollination.

entry: 野生POKENAME从嘴上叶片放出浓香，引来猎物。人们曾用叶片泡草药茶，帮助缓解消化不良与便秘。
author: cobalt0135
source: Wild POKENAME release a strong aroma from the leaf over their mouths to attract prey. These leaves have been used to make a kind of herbal tea that helps treat indigestion and constipation.

entry: POKENAME散出浓烈气味，让捕食宝可梦以为有受伤猎物。等对方来寻找伤者，它便用猛烈毒素伏击。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME emits a powerful scent that predator Pokémon interpret as injured prey. Once these Pokémon come near to find the injured Pokémon, POKENAME ambushes them with virulent poison.

entry: POKENAME释放黏稠凝胶，附在其他鱼类宝可梦身上。凝胶慢慢蚀掉鳞片与骨头，将它们化成柔软的一餐。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME releases a viscous gel that sticks onto other fish Pokémon. The gel slowly eats away at scales and bones, turning other Pokémon into a soft meal for it to eat.

entry: POKENAME常见于崎岖田野、山道，脾气很坏，会向靠太近的登山客喷毒花粉。幸好花瓣够大，远处就容易看见。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Commonly found in rugged fields and mountain trails, POKENAME has a very ornery disposition and will spray poisonous pollen at hikers who come too close. Thankfully, since it has such large petals it is easy to see POKENAME from afar.

entry: 这种非自然的POKENAME形态，是为选美比赛大力选育的结果。火焰强度、花瓣颜色与整体速度，都是评审考虑的特征。
author: ludacriswell
source: This unnatural variant of POKENAME is a result of heavy selective breeding for pageantry competitions. Intensity of flame, coloration of petals, and overall speed are some of the traits evaluated during judging.

entry: POKENAME会射出装满自身花粉的泡泡。泡泡一破，就释放能引起麻痹的剧毒粉末。
author: 0reomilka
source: POKENAME uses its pollen to shoot bubbles filled with it. If one of these bubbles explodes, it will release a highly toxic powder that can cause paralysis.

entry: POKENAME的两个头，喜欢在一天不同时间光合作用，一个吸阳光，另一个便睡觉。右头通常最强，因为大花挡住另一头珍贵的日照。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's two heads prefer different times of the day to photosynthesize, one absorbing sunlight while the other sleeps. The right head is usually the strongest since its large flower deprives the other head of valuable sunlight.

entry: POKENAME头上的花，只能在冰冷环境生存，所以它从不离开栖居的冰洞、冷水。它天然放出的浓香，在市场上很受珍视。
author: fiordaliso
source: The flower on POKENAME's head can survive only in icy environments, so it never leaves the frozen caves or cold waters it inhabits. It naturally releases highly fragrant aromas that are prized on the market.

entry: POKENAME常陪着农民，却一遇新鲜作物就忍不住吃。为了克制贪嘴，它可能渗入农田泥土，假扮作物，免得训练家生气。
author: theaceofhearts0306
source: Commonly seen alongside farmers, POKENAME cannot help themselves when eating fresh crops. In an effort to combat their gluttonous nature, POKENAME may seep into farm soil, pretending to be crops in order to avoid upsetting their Trainers.

entry: 这种双壳宝可梦，从两壳合缝处分泌黏稠汁液。让POKENAME猛合外壳，也不伤内脏，敌人难以穿透。
author: quackquackattack
source: The bivalve Pokémon releases a viscous sap from where the shells meet together. This enables a POKENAME to slam its shell shut without damaging the internal organs, making it hard to pierce through.

entry: 它们极少打开花状外壳，除了捕捉猎物或吃饭。壳一开，就放出毒花粉云，许多人说，冷得让身体发麻。
author: infinex21
source: They rarely open their flower-like shell other than to snatch prey and, or, to eat. When they open, they release a plume of toxic pollen that many say is numbingly cold.

entry: 它气息芳香，快乐地飘来飘去，把愉悦的芬芳，传给四周，因此十分受欢迎。
author: theheroict
source: A Pokémon with a pleasant scent. It happily floats around spreading joy with the pleasant fragrant. It's very popular as a result.

entry: POKENAME先呼出催眠花粉，再吃熟睡受害者的梦。刚吃过的个体，花瓣气味会比平常好闻得多。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME breathes out a soporific pollen before it consumes the sleeping victim's dream. A POKENAME that has recently eaten emits a remarkably better aroma from its flower petals than normal.

entry: POKENAME需要极大量光能，背上的种子才能长大一点点。它追随太阳移动，确保尽可能多地吸收日光。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME requires very large amounts of light energy to even grow the bulb on its back by even a little. It will travel along with the sun to make sure it receives as much sunlight as possible.

entry: POKENAME稍碰就爆炸，很难留住体内光能。透过上半身的透明圆顶，能清楚看见收集了多少能量。
author: soup1900
source: With POKENAME always exploding at the slightest touch, it has a hard time containing its light energy. The amount of light energy it has collected can be visibly seen from inside the transparent dome that's the upper half of its body.

entry: 很久以前，奈克洛兹玛吸收一只顽皮雷弹，形成了POKENAME。上半球是光之能量，下半球则为暗能量。
author: the_smirker
source: Long ago, a Necrozma absorbed an Electrode, creating POKENAME. Its upper hemisphere is light energy, while the lower hemisphere is dark energy.

entry: POKENAME把武器保养得洁净无瑕，反光极强，再用它将光反射回自己身上。它无法忍受身体太久没有光照。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME keeps its weapon pristine to the point of it being highly reflective. It uses it to reflect light back on itself, as it cannot stand to be without some source of light on its body for too long.

entry: POKENAME用手中棱镜棍敲击身体，就能操纵小块杂质，绕棍悬浮、射向敌人。找到光源后，会凶猛敲打，直到所有光能被逼出来。
author: soup1900
source: By tapping the prism club it holds against its body, POKENAME can command small impurity pieces to levitate around the club and launch at foes. When POKENAME locates a light source, it aggressively bashes it until all the light energy is forced out.

entry: POKENAME将吸收的光能，转成彩虹色光污染，从身体排出。长期接触会引起睡眠障碍、压力，甚至色盲。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME converts light energy it has absorbed into rainbow-colored light pollution, which it emits from its body. This pollution causes sleep disorders, stress, and even color blindness with prolonged exposure.

entry: POKENAME准备进化时，覆身的棱镜状杂质慢慢溶去，露出真实身体。能看见其中储存着，完成进化所需的全部光能。
author: soup1900
source: When POKENAME is preparing to evolve, the prismatic impurities that cover it slowly dissolve away. This reveals its true body, where all the stored light energy that it needs to complete its evolution can be seen.

entry: POKENAME用周身水晶吸光，再喷出浓浓霓虹彩烟。令人目眩的景象，能遮住附近其他光线，让困在里面的生物只看见旋转色彩。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME absorb light through the crystals along their body before producing thick plumes of neon, rainbow-colored smoke. The dizzying display can block out other light in the area, leaving anyone caught inside only able to see the swirling colors.

entry: POKENAME奔跑会产生大量动能。遭遇报告称，它时速约200公里，产生的能量足以供整座城市使用两周。
author: operativevalkyrie
source: POKENAME generates large amounts of kinetic energy when it runs. Reports of POKENAME encounters claim it can reach speeds of roughly 200 kilometres an hour, enough to power an entire city for two weeks.

entry: POKENAME绕猎物快速游圈，在目标身上唤起喷泉般的光柱。留下的片片彩墨，很容易标出它的猎场。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME rapidly swims in circles around prey in order to summon geysers of light on them. Its hunting grounds can easily be identified by the blasts of colored ink left behind.

entry: 近期医学发现，利用POKENAME充满光能的棱镜状鳍，能治愈人的色盲。可要大量生产很困难，因为谁靠近，它就会发射激光。
author: soup1900
source: Recent medical science has discovered that using POKENAME's prismatic fins imbued with light energy can cure a person's color blindness. The problem with mass-producing these is that POKENAME will fire lasers if anyone approaches it.

entry: POKENAME的大翅膀支撑小小身体，同时吸收阳光。吃饱后，身体泛起柔和紫光。
author: infinex21
source: A POKENAME's large wings support their small bodies while absorbing light from the sun. Their bodies emit a gentle, purple glow when they are well-fed.

entry: 只要彩虹棱镜核心持续得到光能，POKENAME就能清除身上长出的杂质。它只用核心闪光晃盲敌人，因为会消耗珍贵光能，挥霍不起。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME can purge impurities that grow onto its body as long as its rainbow prism core stays powered with light energy. It only flashes its core with light to blind foes, as that costs it precious light that it can't afford to use extravagantly.

entry: POKENAME飞快辗转各处，留下彩虹轨迹。它以极快速度挥镰劈击，连连斩击间，还会迸出发光能量弧。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME leaves behind a rainbow trail as it quickly darts around from place to place. It can slash at foes with its scythes at such a quick pace that luminous energy arcs are also unleashed in the flurry.

entry: POKENAME能量不足时，身体迅速吸取周围光粒，让附近一片漆黑。沉重呼吸，能让光线短暂变成灼热火束。
author: soup1900
source: When POKENAME runs low on energy, its body rapidly absorbs surrounding light particles, darkening the surrounding area to a pitch-black. With heavy breathing, it can cause light rays to become scorching beams of fire for but a moment.

entry: POKENAME用黑光照射自己，激怒到失控，获得危险力量。棱镜身体几乎不可能刮伤，只有遇上比自己更凶的敌人，才会留下战痕。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME blasts itself with black light to infuriate itself beyond control and become dangerously powerful. It will only gain a battle scar from battling a foe more vicious than itself since its prism body is nearly impossible to scratch.

entry: 寻找光，让这种宝可梦来到陆地。POKENAME虽然真成了离水的鱼，为了这能量，却会不顾一切。
author: aberry8286
source: Its search for light has led this Pokémon onto land. Although it's quite literally a fish out of water, POKENAME will stop at nothing to find this energy.

entry: POKENAME的咆哮能撕开究极之洞，让它进入其中，寻找更多食物，也就是光。误入洞中者，很可能看见它仿佛在里面“游泳”。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's roar can tear open Ultra Wormholes, through which it will enter in search of more food, which is light itself. Those who ever find themselves within such a Wormhole may likely witness POKENAME seemingly "swimming" within.

entry: POKENAME变成其他宝可梦时，大部分都模仿得完美，唯独一块大棱镜始终突出身体。这是故意的，否则就无法吸收遇见的光能。
author: soup1900
source: Most of POKENAME perfectly transforms when it changes into other Pokémon; however, a large prism protrusion will always stick out of its body. This is intentional, as without it, POKENAME will have no method to absorb any light energy it encounters.

entry: POKENAME的双眼很怕光。头盔会吸收日光，替眼睛挡住阳光，可也遮去了不少视线。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME's eyes are sensitive to light. Its helmet shields its eyes from sunlight by absorbing it, but it also obscures its vision.

entry: POKENAME住在深海洞穴，人类难以穿越。它游过黑暗，多彩褶饰便照亮地道。反射自然光时，在水中又能近乎隐形。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME live in deep, underwater caves that are hard for humans to traverse. As they swim through the darkness, their multicolored frills illuminate the tunnels in brilliant light. By reflecting natural light, they become nearly invisible in water.

entry: POKENAME住在深海洞穴，人类难以穿越。它游过黑暗，多彩褶饰便照亮地道。反射自然光时，在水中又能近乎隐形。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME live in deep, underwater caves that are hard for humans to traverse. As they swim through the darkness, their multicolored frills illuminate the tunnels in brilliant light. By reflecting natural light, they become nearly invisible in water.

entry: 杂质覆上POKENAME的毛并硬化，使毛永远停在先前的姿态。它体内有个能发光的器官，却已经休眠很久。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's fur is always locked into the position they were last in before impurities grew over and hardened on them. There is an organ in its body that is able to produce light; however, it has been dormant for a long time now.

entry: POKENAME用吸来的光能，点燃、供给发火器官中的火焰。因此，烧过的东西都会化成彩虹色灰烬。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME uses the light energy it absorbs to ignite and fuel the flames in its fire-producing organ. Due to this, anything it burns is charred in a rainbow ash.

entry: POKENAME一进电脑，几乎总意味这台机器大祸临头。身体会自然快速吸收资料与电力，几分钟就让电脑彻底关机。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's presence on a computer almost always spells doom for the machine. Its body naturally absorbs the data and electricity of the machine quickly, shutting it down completely in minutes.

entry: POKENAME覆着黑色晶茧，牢牢挡住爪子攻击。谁靠近，它就发射激光，吓退许多天敌。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME is covered in a black, crystalline cocoon that serves as a sturdy barrier against claws and talons. It fires lasers at anyone who comes near, scaring many potential predators away.

entry: POKENAME一看见有东西离地，哪怕只是跳起，并非飞行，也会用强力激光将其摧毁。飞到哪里，都在下方投下巨大阴影，贪婪地不让地面生物得到光。
author: soup1900
source: If POKENAME spots something off the ground, even if it was just a jump and not flight, it will obliterate them with a powerful laser. Wherever it flies, it always casts a large shadow below to greedily gatekeep light from beings on the ground.

entry: POKENAME偷光后，当地气温会下降，覆上冰霜。因为它吞吃光源的光时，连光源与周围的热能，也一并吃了。
author: soup1900
source: When POKENAME steals light, the location it stole from drops in temperature and becomes covered in frost. This is because when it devours light from a light source, it also ends up eating the heat energy from the source and surrounding area as well.

entry: POKENAME能造出暗云，飘到哪里，就将光能困在哪里。它造出数十朵，放任游荡数周，再环游世界，吞食收集的光。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME are able to create dark clouds that trap light energy wherever the clouds drift. They create dozens of these clouds and let them roam free for weeks before flying around the world to devour the collected light.

entry: POKENAME燃着异样火焰，由遍布身体的奇怪晶体供能。研究者根据晶格结构，确认这些晶体来自究极空间。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME burn with an unearthly fire that is fuelled by strange crystals laced throughout their body. Pokémon Researchers have determined from the lattice structures of these crystals that they originate from Ultra Space.

entry: POKENAME燃着异样火焰，由遍布身体的奇怪晶体供能。火光奇幻如万花筒，元素组成仿佛不停无规律地变化。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME burn with an unearthly fire that is fuelled by strange crystals laced throughout their body. The flame from these crystals produces a strange kaleidoscopic fire, its elemental composition appearing to shift erratically.

entry: POKENAME的晶体身体折射光，在周围形成美丽光晕。可别被奇景迷住，因为它颇具敌意。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's crystalline body refracts light to form a beautiful aura around it. Don't let this marvelous sight distract you, however, for POKENAME is quite hostile.

entry: POKENAME环游世界，寻找挑战，追随掠过各地区的日出。它用初升阳光恢复力量，准备下一场交锋。
author: elibromax314
source: POKENAME travels around the world searching for a challenge, following the sunrise as it passes over the various regions. It uses the light of the rising sun to recover before its next bout.

entry: POKENAME靠彩光推进，一发现光源，就能全群瞬间涌去。刺尖发射细小、强力又精准的激光，快速连射，击倒敌人。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME propel themselves with colorful light so that they can all instantly swarm to a light source if one gets found. They fire powerful, tiny, high-precision lasers from the tips of their stingers to rapidly fire and take down any foe.

entry: POKENAME身上杂质越多，各种本领就越难施展。即使隐形，偷取物体光能时仍可能被发现，因为杂质不会跟着隐去。
author: soup1900
source: The more impurities POKENAME grows on its body, the harder it is for it to use its many kinds of techniques. It can be spotted taking light from objects despite turning invisible since the impurities don't become invisible with it.

entry: POKENAME在身体裂隙吸收、储存光能，再向猎物释放。闪光能瞬间晃盲人类与宝可梦。
author: operativevalkyrie
source: POKENAME absorbs and stores photoenergy within the fissures on its body and releases it upon prey. The resulting flash can instantly blind humans and Pokémon alike.

entry: 吞食光，是POKENAME活力的来源。力量积够，就能放出喷泉般的能量。也有传说，它曾分享光能，帮助植物光合作用。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: Consuming light is the source of a POKENAME's vitality. Once they reach sufficient amounts of power, POKENAME can release a burst of energy similar to a geyser. There are tales of POKENAME helping plants photosynthesize by sharing light energy.

entry: POKENAME的牙齿厚厚地覆着杂质，咬硬物时也不会疼。它喜欢使尽力气压碎东西，哪怕只能再榨出一丁点光能，也不放过。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's teeth are heavily coated with impurities, meaning it won't feel any pain from biting on tough items. It likes to crush objects as hard as it can to squeeze even the slightest bit of extra light energy from them.

entry: POKENAME的利牙，其实是从口中突出的杂质。吸满大量光能后，杂质会从身体崩解，让它变得没那么吓人。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's sharp fangs are actually impurities that protruded from its mouth. When it fills itself with lots of light energy, it will become less threatening, as these impurities will disintegrate from its body.

entry: POKENAME的身体由浓缩光构成，脊背上棱镜般的刺，储存庞大力量。能量向前汇聚，便能从口中发射强力激光。
author: ambrosia04
source: With a body made out of concentrated light, POKENAME stores immense power within the prism-like spikes along its spine. By channeling this energy forward, it can fire a powerful laser from its mouth.

entry: POKENAME只在星光明亮的夜间现身。没有星光力量，就弱小胆怯。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME only emerges at night when the stars are shining brightly. Without the power of starlight, it's weak and timid.

entry: POKENAME腹部闪着美丽虹彩。它用这景象取悦强大宝可梦，盼对方保护自己。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's abdomen shimmers with beautiful rainbow iridescence. It uses this display to impress stronger Pokémon in hopes that they'll protect it from harm.

entry: 这些虫类宝可梦腹部的晶体器官中，旋转着无数彩光。许多训练家喜欢让它们充当气氛灯，或孩子的夜灯。
author: infinex21
source: Myriad colored lights swirl around in the crystalline organ located in the abdomen of these Bug Pokémon. Many Trainers favor them as mood lights or as night lights for children.

entry: POKENAME足尖是晶体，一照到光，就闪出各色。眼睛颜色随心情改变，变色丝网也深受艺术家、服装设计师喜爱。
author: infinex21
source: The tips of a POKENAME's legs are crystals that flicker with various colors when exposed to any source of light. The colors of their eyes change depending on their mood. Artists and clothing designers love them for their color-shifting silk webbing.

entry: POKENAME的速度虽超过许多飞机，却一点也不隐蔽，因为身后不断射出道道光束。
author: quackquackattack
source: While POKENAME's speed surpasses many airplanes, they are far from stealthy creatures. This is because they constantly shoot beams of light in their wake.

entry: POKENAME罕见，不幸遇见的渔民常叫它“迷途海中钓手”。野生个体会追随自身触角的光，向附近一切开火。
author: npshi
source: POKENAME are a rare sight, often nicknamed "lost sea anglers" by fishermen unlucky enough to encounter them. Wild POKENAME will follow the light from their own antennae, firing at anything within their vicinity.

entry: POKENAME贪婪吞光，却始终存不住太多、太久。已有能量定期化为激光或其他形式释放，几乎不受控制。
author: stevethebarbarian
source: POKENAME greedily devours light, but it can never store much of it for long. What it has is regularly released in the form of lasers or other energy with very little control.

entry: 光源供给POKENAME能量，让它能蹦跳、用小翅膀放光束。黑暗降临，就虚弱得连小腿也撑不起身体。
author: sk372
source: Light sources fuel POKENAME's body, giving it the energy to hop around and produce beams from its small wings. When darkness falls, it grows too weak for its small legs to hold its body up.

entry: POKENAME颈边的绒毛，储存极其浓缩的光能。这是唯一能存光的地方，因为身上杂质挡住更多绒毛生长。
author: soup1900
source: The wool around POKENAME's neck contains highly compacted light energy. This is the only location where it can store all its light energy, as impurities on its body block the growth of any more wool.

entry: POKENAME主要用尾端灯球传出强烈光信号。从其他光源偷到足够光后，尾巴便耀眼难视，在世界另一端都能看见。
author: antler_zero_
source: POKENAME will primarily use the bulb on its tail to send powerful light signals. If it steals enough light from other sources, its tail becomes blinding, visible from across the world.

entry: POKENAME听觉极佳，从灯具到萤火虫，只要亮起，就能分辨。大口吸气，便能一次收集、吞下大量光能。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME has superb hearing that allows it to tell when something flickers on from lamps to even firefly lights. By taking large inhales, it can gather and consume lots of light energy at once.

entry: POKENAME乘着究极空间力量形成的旋流、涡流，在空中飘行，用微型通道产生升力与推力。它四处寻找细小晶片，试着嵌进身体。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME drift through the air on whorls and eddies of power originating from Ultra Space, using micro-portals to generate lift and thrust. They spend their time searching for tiny crystal fragments that they attempt to fit into their bodies.

entry: POKENAME体内的棱镜，会在晶体内部捕获、折射光。结构尚未完全弄清，却已证实与阿罗拉的Z纯晶十分相似。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The prisms lodged in the bodies of POKENAME capture and refract light within their matrices. The structure of these crystals isn't fully understood, but they have been demonstrated to bear a remarkable similarity to that of Z-Crystals from Alola.

entry: POKENAME向地面发射激光，让自己留在空中，颜色随心情变化。越生气，光束越红，能量也足以损坏物体，甚至将其点燃。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME keeps itself airborne by firing lasers at the ground, the colour depending on its mood. As it grows angry, the beams shift toward red and gain enough energy to damage objects, even setting them on fire.

entry: POKENAME体内的棱镜，会在晶体内部捕获、折射光。结构尚未完全弄清，却已证实与阿罗拉的Z纯晶十分相似。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The prisms lodged in the bodies of POKENAME capture and refract light within their matrices. The structure of these crystals isn't fully understood, but they have been demonstrated to bear a remarkable similarity to that of Z-Crystals from Alola.

entry: POKENAME向地面发射激光，让自己留在空中，颜色随心情变化。不高兴时，光束转向紫色，常被当成不明飞行物的灯光。
