author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME keeps itself airborne by firing lasers at the ground, their colour depending on its mood. When it becomes upset, the beams shift toward violet and have often been mistaken for UFO lights.

entry: POKENAME白天从树梢吸收光能。到了夜晚，就变得凶野，用三只巨爪撕碎猎物。
author: h0bojoe
source: POKENAME absorbs light energy from treetops by day. At night, it turns feral, shredding prey with its three giant claws.

entry: POKENAME借太阳之力造出光束，消灭对手。不过，通常只有先遭攻击，才会还击。
author: spider26
source: POKENAME uses power from the sun to create beams of light to obliterate opponents. However, it typically doesn't attack unless attacked first.

entry: POKENAME白天睡在清澈池塘底，吸收阳光。夜晚释放光，映出五彩奇景，照亮周围。
author: lampent12
source: POKENAME sleeps at the bottom of crystal clear ponds during the day, absorbing sunlight. At night, they release the light in a multicolored spectacle, illuminating the whole area.

entry: POKENAME张嘴浮在水上，吸收日月的光。这让周围变得潮湿、寒冷。
author: lampent12
source: POKENAME floats on the water, mouth open, as they absorb the light from the sun and moon. This causes the surrounding area to become damp and chilly.

entry: 身上杂质妨碍POKENAME判断气流，它改靠蛮力行动。它能以阳光代替自身黑光，持续为头顶圆球供能，施展超能力招式。
author: soup1900
source: With the impurities on POKENAME's body impeding its ability to read air currents, POKENAME relies on brute strength instead. It can keep the orb on its head powered to use psychic moves by substituting sunshine for its black light.

entry: 身上杂质妨碍POKENAME判断气流，它改靠蛮力行动。它能以阳光代替自身黑光，持续为头顶圆球供能。
author: soup1900
source: Impurities on POKENAME impede its ability to read air currents, so it relies on its brute strength instead. It can keep the orb on its head energized by substituting sunshine for its black light.

entry: 奈克洛兹玛没有与呆呆王本体融合，反而融合了头上的大舌贝。POKENAME似乎总在盘算什么坏事。
author: hophoppip
source: Rather than fusing with Slowking's body, Necrozma has fused with the Shellder on its head. POKENAME always seems to be plotting some devious deed.

entry: POKENAME背上有独特的种子状能量核心，吸收光能，像植物一样光合作用。大片金属板柔韧又结实，察觉危险，就会将核心遮住。
author: operativevalkyrie
source: POKENAME has a unique, bulb shaped energy core on its back that absorbs photoenergy and undergoes photosynthesis, like plants. The large metal plates are very flexible yet sturdy, and they will conceal its core when it senses danger.

entry: POKENAME常缺乏光能，沉睡在黑暗石壁旁，很难发现。杂质使它们变形，原本代表什么含义，已无从得知。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME are usually found slumbering, devoid of light energy, along dark, stony walls, making them difficult to spot. Impurities have caused them to change shape, making it impossible to know what their original meaning was.

entry: POKENAME通常挂在太阳能板上，将光能全占为己有。谁敢在它吸光时打扰，就会被巨手压碎。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME typically hang onto solar panels, absorbing all the light energy for themselves. Anyone who tries to disturb them while they are absorbing light energy will be crushed by their giant hands.

entry: POKENAME把吸来的光，存进硬化棱镜壳。敌人试图威胁时，会反射性地连发多道激光。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME stores the light it has absorbed within its hardened prism shell. It will reflexively fire off multiple laser beams against enemies who try to threaten it.

entry: POKENAME的大钳里有光晶体，随时能发射激光。将光源吸干后，便把失去用处的残骸捏碎、丢掉。
author: soup1900
source: Inside POKENAME's large pincer is a light crystal always ready to fire off a laser at any given moment. After draining a source of all its light, it crushes and discards it, having no use for it anymore.

entry: POKENAME用强钳捏碎光源，同时吸走光能。飞行会大量耗能，因此它尽可能少拍翼，保存更多光能。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME siphons light energy when it crushes the light source with its powerful pincers. Flying causes it to burn through its energy, so it prefers to flap its wings as little as possible to preserve as much light as it can.

entry: POKENAME喜欢一直飞行，因为几乎不消耗有限的光能。修长身体能穿过窄缝，不必破坏东西，就够到光源。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME prefers to fly all the time because it requires little to no use of its limited light energy. Its long, lean body allows it to slip through small gaps to reach sources of light without being destructive.

entry: POKENAME结群捕猎，不停发射激光，用压倒性力量击败挡路的一切。虽然常制造混乱、破坏，却绝不攻击关了灯的房子。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME hunt in packs, constantly firing off laser beams to defeat anything standing in their way with overwhelming force. While they can cause lots of mayhem and destruction, they will never attack houses that have their lights shut off.

entry: POKENAME从现代网站学来深色、浅色模式切换。训练家常为哪种模式更好看，争吵不休。
author: .flipside3
source: POKENAME adapted the option to change between dark and light modes from modern websites. Trainers often get into fights about whether it looks better in dark or light mode.

entry: POKENAME从现代网站学来深色、浅色模式切换。想得到关注时，就把附近屏幕变得太亮或太暗，根本没法用。
author: .flipside3
source: POKENAME adapted the option to change between dark and light modes from modern websites. When it wants attention, it makes nearby screens too bright or too dark to use.

entry: POKENAME的鹿角由珍贵黑水晶构成，激战时容易折断。碎晶可以打造成强力匕首。
author: wise_peacock_50796
source: POKENAME has antlers made of valuable black crystal that are prone to breaking off in the heat of battle. The crystal shards can be fashioned into powerful daggers.

entry: 这种形态的POKENAME，由反光极强的不透明黑玻璃构成。角会释放强大能量，让敌人衰弱。
author: partypooperrex
source: This variant of POKENAME is made out of opaque black glass that is highly reflective. Its horns give off powerful, debilitating energy.

entry: POKENAME护目镜般的眼中，闪出五彩光。先催眠受害者，再用剑让对方晕倒。
author: partypooperrex
source: Colorful lights shine out of POKENAME's visor-like eye. This hypnotizes its victims before they are swooned with its sword.

entry: POKENAME吸收光能，再用尾巴在空中画出道道彩虹光。许多聚在一起，就会展开令人惊叹的灯光艺术竞演。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME absorb light energy and use that light to draw streaks of rainbow glows into the air using their tails. When many of these Pokémon gather, astounding light show competitions of artistry and display will commence.

entry: 胸前眼状花纹发出明亮棱镜光，以催眠图案让猎物出神。毒牙分泌的毒液，也会微微发光，带有致幻作用。
author: infinex21
source: The eye-like patterns upon its chest emit bright, prismatic light in hypnotic patterns to lull prey into a trance. The poison secreted from its fangs faintly glows and has a psychedelic effect.

entry: POKENAME用背爪打倒敌人，再以道道黑光轰击。光能不足时，杂质在脚踝堆积，妨碍动作，便无法飞奔各地。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME uses the claw on its back to knock over foes before showering them in bolts of black light. It becomes unable to bolt across lands when lacking light energy as impurities build up on its ankles and hinder its movement.

entry: POKENAME咆哮时，附近光源突然变亮，让它一次吞下更多光。光能一满，就按捺不住，带着新活力四处疾奔。
author: soup1900
source: When POKENAME roars, light sources nearby suddenly become brighter, giving it more light to devour at once. Once full of light energy, it becomes unable to contain itself and dashes all around with its newfound vitality.

entry: POKENAME体温低得能麻木一切痛感，因此十分平和。它住在北方针叶林，吸收周围光，让天敌难以猎杀当地宝可梦。
author: operativevalkyrie
source: POKENAME's body temperature is cold enough to completely numb any pain, and as a result, it is very peaceful. It lives in boreal forests and absorbs the light around it, making it difficult for predators to hunt down the native Pokémon.

entry: 传说POKENAME能用巨臂捏碎星星，再一口吞下。覆身杂质虽不断使它疼痛，却也让它感受不到外来攻击的伤痛。
author: soup1900
source: According to legends, POKENAME can crush stars with its mighty arms before devouring them in a single chomp. While the impurities that cover its body constantly give it pain, they also make it so it feels no pain or damage from outside attacks.

entry: 它也被称作“永恒之波奈克洛兹玛”。融合后的超能力，足以让整片海洋，从中分开。
author: toxicrown
source: This Pokémon is also known as Eternal Wave Necrozma. With its combined psychic powers, it is able to cause the ocean itself to split apart.

entry: POKENAME在阴影中行动。看见敌人，就用爪状尾巴按住，再聚集光，使出十万伏特电击。
author: seanothan_23
source: POKENAME moves in the shadows. When it sees an opponent, it pins them with its claw-like tail. Then it gathers light and uses it to zap the opponent with a Thunderbolt.

entry: 它也被称作“永恒之热奈克洛兹玛”。吸收凤王体内的热量后，POKENAME能放出世上最炽热的火焰之一。
author: toxicrown
source: This Pokémon is also known as Eternal Heat Necrozma. By absorbing the heat within Ho-Oh, POKENAME can create some of the hottest flames in existence.

entry: POKENAME用尾巴熟练打开建筑入口，悄悄吸走里面所有光。战斗时，双尾凶狠猛揍，常令人觉得像两只宝可梦一起暴走。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME uses its tails to capably open entrances into buildings and absorb all the light there without being spotted. In battles, it so savagely wails on foes with its tails that it oftentimes makes it feel like it is two rampaging Pokémon at once.

entry: POKENAME缺光时，背上杂质长出独特花纹，随时间、地点而变。晴天便整天掠过海面，尽量多吸光。
author: soup1900
source: When POKENAME lacks light energy, impurities grow on its back in unique patterns that differ based on time and location. On sunny days, it spends all its time skimming the top of the ocean to absorb as much light as possible.

entry: POKENAME狂怒时，伸出纯光能构成的爪，将挡路一切撕碎。激光留下的熔地，以及周围毫无亮光，都是它领地的标志。
author: soup1900
source: When enraged, POKENAME extends claws made of pure light energy to shred anything in its way into pieces. Signs of its territory can be spotted by melted ground left behind from a laser and the absolute lack of brightness in the area.

entry: POKENAME用掌心孔洞储存发光物，始终备有光能。厚厚棱镜铠甲覆盖全身，让它能承受大量各种攻击。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME uses the holes in its palms to store light-producing objects so it always has a supply of light energy on it. It can withstand an extreme amount of attacks of any kind due to being heavily coated in prismatic armor.

entry: POKENAME常用整个身体贴住大光源。吸光越多，多片翅膀就越会泛起不断变换的彩光。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME often cling to large sources of light with their entire bodies. Their multiple wings emit a shifting, multicolored glow the more light that they absorb.

entry: POKENAME白天温顺，选择吸收日光，而不捕猎。不过，它无法通过光合作用产能。原本脆弱的头冠与尾巴内，反倒会长出捕猎用的武器。
author: operativevalkyrie
source: POKENAME is docile during daylight, choosing to absorb sunlight instead of hunting. However, it cannot produce energy through photosynthesis. It instead grows inside of its otherwise fragile crest and tail to function as a weapon for hunting.

entry: POKENAME出现在臭氧层受损的地区，吸收阳光中未经过滤的紫外线。作为回报，放出独特雾气，中和二氧化碳与甲烷。
author: operativevalkyrie
source: POKENAME can be found in regions where the ozone layer has been damaged. It absorbs  unfiltered ultraviolet rays from sunlight, and in return it releases a unique mist that neutralizes carbon dioxide and methane.

entry: POKENAME飞行无声，能悄悄俯冲，吞掉光源，再飞走，无人察觉。即使灯泡已被吸干，也能用牙直接吸取白炽发光的能量。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME can easily swoop down, devour a light source, and take off without anyone realizing its presence due to its soundless flying. Even after draining a lightbulb, it can use its teeth to feed directly on the incandescence created for energy.

entry: POKENAME的棱镜身体材料出了差错，让所有穿过的光都被折射，无法吸收。它因此总在挨饿，偏偏这差错也让它不再需要吸光维生。
author: soup1900
source: An error in the material of its prism body has caused POKENAME to refract all light passing through it instead of absorbing it. While this constantly starves it, the error also caused it to no longer need to absorb light in order to live.

entry: POKENAME酷似某个臭名昭著的网站。虽然模仿人类书写、说话，却两样都不懂。
author: .flipside3
source: POKENAME resembles an infamous internet website. Although it mimics human writing and speech, it does not understand either.

entry: POKENAME酷似某个臭名昭著的网站。靠近设备，就会让上面冒出奇怪弹窗。
author: .flipside3
source: POKENAME resembles an infamous internet website. It causes strange pop-ups to appear on devices it gets close to.

entry: 进化让POKENAME的主体，大多由吸收的光构成。力量虽然大增，却也必须吞下更多光，维持这副模样。
author: soup1900
source: Evolution has caused POKENAME's main body to be primarily made of light it has absorbed. While this tremendously boosts its power, it must also devour larger quantities of light in order to maintain this appearance.

entry: POKENAME身手极灵活，以头顶镰刀般的光刃劈敌，眨眼就能击倒。也能看见它晒太阳，收集攻击所需的光。
author: ambrosia04
source: Using its incredible agility, POKENAME slashes at opponents with the scythe-like blade of light on its head, defeating them in the blink of an eye. POKENAME can be observed sunbathing to gather the light it needs to channel its attacks.

entry: POKENAME用背上成列种子，始终储存大量光能。谁拿走一颗，就会惹它大怒，让叶状尾巴蓄起强力激光，消灭窃贼。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME always keeps a large store of light energy via the seeds lined on its back. If a seed is ever taken, it becomes very angry and will charge up a high-power laser from its leaflike tail to obliterate the thief.

entry: POKENAME集中光能，造出、发射光球，消灭敌人。缺光时，全身会极冷，杂质逐渐侵占身体。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME focuses its light energy in order to create and launch balls of light to obliterate foes. Without light energy, it becomes extremely cold while impurities overtake its body.

entry: POKENAME厌恶黑暗，喜欢待在光里，天然光、人造光都行。它能存光，支持挖掘一段时间，寻找能充当棱镜的晶体。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME abhor darkness, preferring to stay in light, be it natural or artificial. They can store light so they can dig for periods of time, which they do in search of crystals that function like prisms.

entry: POKENAME吸足光后，能借能量，把滚动速度提升到惊人程度。滚前从不完全蜷身，免得尖刺挡住遇到的光。
author: soup1900
source: When POKENAME has absorbed a lot of light, it can use that energy to boost the speed of its rolling to insane speeds. It never fully curls up its body before rolling, since its spikes would block any light it comes across.

entry: POKENAME以光速反复踢击物体，直到彻底粉碎。完全狂怒时，身体的黑暗也会越发浓重。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME repeatedly kicks at objects at the speed of light until they have been completely pulverized. The darkness of its body increases and intensifies when it is fully enraged.

entry: POKENAME光能充足，就能让招式更锐利，行动更快、跳得更高。花费大量光能，还能造出光鞭，瞬间撕碎敌人。
author: soup1900
source: Having lots of light energy allows POKENAME to hone the sharpness of its moves and increase its quickness and jump power. At a heavy cost of light energy, it can create lashes made of light that can shred opponents in an instant.

entry: POKENAME在河岸长久睡眠、吸光。若被打扰，就会将积存的光化为毁灭性光束。
author: amberaxolotl223
source: POKENAME sleep and take in light for long periods of time on riverbanks. When disrupted, POKENAME will unleash devastating beams of the accumulated light.

entry: POKENAME光能不足时，改为反复捶石，磨掉身上长出的杂质。鳍总指向最近光束，让它找得到离开暗洞、地道的路。
author: soup1900
source: When POKENAME runs low on light energy, it repeatedly punches rocks to abrade the impurities that grow on it instead. Its fin always points to the nearest beam of light, allowing it to find its way out of dark caves or tunnels.

entry: POKENAME腿上杂质太多，就走不稳，必须四肢着地。将泥与光能混在一起，抹到身上，就能除掉杂质，恢复正常走路。
author: soup1900
source: When POKENAME grows too many impurities on its legs, it is no longer able to keep balance while walking and must get on all fours. By applying a mixture of mud and light energy onto itself, it can heal off the impurities and walk normally again.

entry: POKENAME发怒时，以巨力掀起猛烈大浪，让船翻覆。为了吃掉灯塔灯光，它会砸毁下方峭壁，让整座灯塔倒向自己。
author: soup1900
source: When enraged, POKENAME uses its massive strength to create large, rough waves in the water and cause ships to capsize. To devour the light from the beacons lighthouses contain, it smashes the cliffs they stand on to topple the structure down to it.

entry: POKENAME能用超能力操纵光，这种现象称为“控光”。有些同类穿的不是裙子，而是棱镜状短裤。
author: roundabout_robin
source: POKENAME's psychic power allows it to manipulate light, a phenomenon known as photokinesis. Some members of the species are known to wear prismatic shorts instead of a skirt.

entry: POKENAME纯靠各种光维生，也能以不明方式，将光转成强大能量。背上的第二对手臂，能稳定、控制超能力造出的微型黑洞。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME sustains itself purely on all manners of light, which it also somehow turns into potent energy in turn. The second pair of arms on its back allow it to stabilize and control miniature black holes formed from its psychic powers.

entry: POKENAME能吸收周围光源。为保护训练家，旅行时会吸尽对方身边的光，借黑暗遮住行踪。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is capable of absorbing light sources around it. To protect its Trainer, it removes all light around them during travel so the resulting darkness will keep them hidden from sight.

entry: 战场被光照亮时，POKENAME能感知光能扰动，判断敌人动作，因此冷静警觉。若一片黑暗，就像盲了一样，凶狠地四处挥爪。
author: soup1900
source: When the battlefield is being bathed in light, POKENAME can remain calm and vigilant as it can read disturbances in light energy to sense a foe's actions. However, if it's dark out, it instead savagely slashes its claws everywhere as if blind.

entry: POKENAME吸足光能，力量增强，身手与反应速度大幅提升。攻击时，造出纯彩虹光组成的锯齿刃，刺穿敌人。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME becomes empowered once it absorbs lots of light energy, having its agility and reaction speed greatly increased. When attacking, it conjures serrated blades made of pure rainbow light to pierce through foes.

entry: POKENAME吸光，存进硬刺中，不过每个动作都很快消耗储量。被逼入绝境，就能向周围射出凝聚的光束。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME absorb light and store it within their quills, though their every action drains their stored light rather quickly. When cornered, they can release their stored light as focused beams all around them.

entry: POKENAME一照到不同颜色的光，身体就短暂闪出同样的鲜亮色泽，再变回黑。它着迷于棱镜，寻找它们分出的彩光，沐浴其中。
author: pattybgoode
source: When POKENAME is exposed to different colors of light, its body briefly flashes a brilliant hue of that same color before returning to black. It is fascinated by prisms, seeking to bathe in the divided light they produce.

entry: 巨爪有毁灭性力量，还能直接从猎物身上抽取光与能量。吸光越多，主体的紫光就越强。
author: infinex21
source: Its massive claws have destructive strength and the ability to siphon light and energy directly from its prey. The more light it absorbs, the more intensely its main body will glow purple.

entry: POKENAME让自己附着棱镜，从一道白光折成7道彩光。这让它能做更多坏事，攻击、发射激光的速度，都达到原来的7倍。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME keeps itself attached to a prism so it can be refracted into 7 separate colored light beams rather than a singular white one. This allows it to cause way more mischief, as it can now attack and fire lasers 7 times as fast.

entry: POKENAME被微型黑洞束缚，光能不断被吸走。若没聚集至少108个不同光源，不论多小，就会虚弱得被吸进黑洞。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME is bounded by a miniature black hole that is constantly draining light energy from it. If it doesn't have at least 108 different light sources gathered, no matter how small, it will become too weak and get sucked into the black hole.

entry: POKENAME会奋力保护人类与宝可梦，用反射壁、光墙，替伤者挡下攻击。它还能用波导察觉恶意，是极好的伙伴。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME are known to fiercely protect people and Pokémon alike, using Reflect and Light Screen to shield injured people and Pokémon from incoming attacks. POKENAME can use their aura to sense malicious intent within others making them great allies.

entry: POKENAME复制其他宝可梦的生物资料，重现它们的本领，适应各种敌人。有时甚至连性格也会复制，因此对宝可梦研究很有价值。
author: actliux
source: POKENAME copy the biodata of other Pokémon to replicate their skills, adapting themselves to any foe. Sometimes, POKENAME will even copy the personality of their target, making them valuable assets for Pokémon research.

entry: POKENAME能将吸收的光转成波导，造出强力波导弹。折射身旁光线，还能生成光能屏障，抵挡攻击。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME have the ability to absorb light and convert it into aura, allowing them to create powerful  Aura Spheres. By refracting the light around themselves, POKENAME can generate barriers of light energy to shield against incoming blows.

entry: POKENAME以黑光推进，飞速是任何喷气机的数倍。它不断寻找新光源，摧毁一切障碍。
author: soup1900
source: Using black light as propulsion, POKENAME can fly at speeds multiple times faster than any jet plane. It is constantly looking for new light sources, destroying anything that gets in its way.

entry: POKENAME能用光能造出光刃，切开一切。不断以此打倒敌人，杂质也大量积在身上，让它愈发凶狠。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME can use its light energy to create blades of light that will slice through anything. By constantly using its light energy like this to take down foes, many impurities have built up on its body, making it even more vicious.

entry: POKENAME喜欢躺着睡，头上巨颚却逼它不停前进，吞更多光。不过，战斗时身体与巨颚倒能合力，凶猛迎敌。
author: pattybgoode
source: POKENAME prefers to lie down and sleep, but the jaw on its head forces it along to consume more and more light. Even so, in battle, both the body and the jaw on its head fight with a combined ferocity.

entry: POKENAME在街上暴走，撞击经过的每盏路灯，想让之后吃光更方便。可它撞坏了电路与灯泡，反倒一口光也没得吃。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME rampage down streets, headbutting any streetlight they pass by. The intent is so they can easily devour the light later on; however, since they smashed the circuits and the bulbs, there is no light left for them to eat.

entry: POKENAME撞击找到的每个光源，因为头部能直接吸光。结果头拿走大部分能量，其他身体却逐渐变黑，长出杂质。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME headbutts every light source it finds because it can directly absorb the light energy with its head. This leads to its head getting most of the energy, leaving the rest of its body to darken and grow impurities.

entry: 树状棱镜似乎与POKENAME深深相连，从没见过两者相隔很远。晶树白天大量吸光，夜晚明亮发光，它也会拼命保护。
author: vic1312
source: The prism-like growth appears to be deeply connected to POKENAME, as one is never seen very far from the other. This tree-like crystal absorbs a great deal of light during the day and shines brightly at night. POKENAME defend them relentlessly.

entry: 它性情凶恶，先吸干受害者的光能，再将其困入黑暗。吸来的能量，被化为强力激光射向敌人。
author: coridiant
source: It possesses a vicious disposition and feeds off the light energy of its victims before trapping them in darkness. With this energy, it fires off powerful laser beams towards opponents.

entry: POKENAME体型极大，一口就能吞掉微型恒星的全部光。如此大量吸光虽然会带来灾难，它却从不一次吃这么多，因为自身也承受不了。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME is able to swallow all the light from a miniature star in a single gulp due to its sheer size. While such a huge absorbance of light would be catastrophic, it never devours that much energy at once since it would overwhelm its body.

entry: 据说，光明与黑暗，正由这只宝可梦创造。消耗了大半光能，身体也已黯淡下来。
author: soup1900
source: It is said that this Pokémon was responsible for the creation of light and darkness. Its body has darkened due to using most of its light energy.

entry: 它穿行各个世界，吞尽所有光芒。许多世界因此沉入永夜，最终走向灭亡。
author: soup1900
source: It traverses through various realms, devouring all the light there is. This has caused many worlds to plunge into eternal darkness and eventually die.

entry: POKENAME吃光不足，头叶就会暗淡、枯萎。一旦如此，唯一让叶长回的方法，就是究极爆发，变成究极奈克洛兹玛的融合形态。
author: soup1900
source: If POKENAME doesn't devour enough light, the leaves on its head dull out and wither away. If this happens, the only method to regrow its leaves is to Ultra Burst to transform into an Ultra Necrozma fusion.

entry: POKENAME鼻腔积起杂质，发痒时就打喷嚏，喷出彩虹光。大部分光能用来控制3个小朝北鼻部件，因为它们行动、采光都快得多。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME sneezes out rainbow light when its nose gets itchy due to a buildup of impurities inside its nasal cavities. It uses most of its light energy to control the 3 Mini-Nose units since they can travel and collect light energy much faster.

entry: POKENAME吸收光，再化作缤纷光刃，射向敌人。始终无法满足的饥饿，让它战斗时格外凶狠。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME absorbs light and fires the energy back out as colorful blades of light. Its constant hunger makes it a vicious fighter.

entry: POKENAME吸收光，再化作缤纷光刃，射向敌人。始终无法满足的饥饿，让它战斗时格外凶狠。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME absorbs light and fires the energy back out as colorful blades of light. Its constant hunger makes it a vicious fighter.

entry: 古老民间故事说，世界终结时，POKENAME会劈开世界间的屏障，带来永恒黑夜。它十分骄傲，唯有具备骑士勇气的人，才配挥舞它。
author: _pixelar_
source: An old folk tale claims that at the end of the world, POKENAME will cleave through the barrier between worlds, heralding an eternal night. POKENAME is a very proud Pokémon, only letting someone with the valour of a knight wield it.

entry: POKENAME将本体藏在究极空间，用超能力打开究极之洞。谁靠得太近，就会遭到密集的斩击。
author: munchyaxolotls
source: POKENAME hides its body in Ultra Space, using its psychic energy to create ultra wormholes. Those who wander too close are bombarded with slashes.

entry: POKENAME遇到极大危险，就将有限光能注入盾，投出光屏障自保。剑尖有醒目彩虹棱镜，凝视者会被催眠、控制。
author: soup1900
source: When under extreme danger, POKENAME will use its limited light with its shield to project a barrier of light as protection. The tip of its blade houses a rather eye-catching rainbow prism that hypnotizes and controls anyone who stares into it.

entry: POKENAME的剑刃内部平常中空，却能注入光能，重新补全。它总侧身平躺，让自己更容易被捡起，好吸走持有者的光。
author: soup1900
source: The inner section of POKENAME's blade is normally empty, but it can fill that gap with light energy to make its blade whole again. It always lies flat on its side so that it's more likely to be picked up and can drain the light from whoever holds it.

entry: POKENAME冷酷命令成群驹刀小兵寻找光源，填补无底胃口。军队应付不了的阻碍，它便亲自斩倒，或以足以穿透实钢的光束轰击。
author: slavman9057
source: POKENAME ruthlessly commands groups of Pawniard to seek out sources of light to fuel its insatiable hunger. Any resistance proving too great for its army is personally cut down, or is met by blasts of light strong enough to tear through solid steel.

entry: POKENAME用双臂大量吸光，再化为强劲冲击射出。需要近战，也能将光凝成刀刃。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME absorbs light in great quantities through its arms before firing it off in powerful bursts. It can condense this light into blades when close combat is called for.

entry: POKENAME夜间四处游荡，常晕头转向，因为没光能，就连墙壁、地面都看不见。索性朝正前方胡乱射出巨大激光，盼着免撞障碍。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME become very disoriented when roaming around at night, since without any light energy they're unable to see any walls or floors. So instead, they just blindly fire giant lasers straight ahead to hopefully avoid bumping into obstacles.

entry: 身体硬如钨，黑如黑曜石。它能吸收各种光，再向四周释放无数光束与能量自卫。
author: infinex21
source: Its body is as hard as tungsten and as dark as obsidian. It can absorb all manners of light and will defend itself by releasing myriad beams of light and energy all over.

entry: POKENAME喜欢在明亮晴天捕猎，借日光掩护，不让猎物发现。深黑棱镜如墨镜般遮眼，挡住强光，代价却是夜间只看得见一片黑。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME like to hunt during bright, sunny days where the sunshine can provide them cover from prey. Deep black prisms in the shape of shades cover over their eyes, protecting them from shining lights at the cost of seeing only darkness at night.

entry: POKENAME沿湖面游动，吸收周围光维生。需要自卫时，尾巴就能向四面八方，放出储存光能化成的棱镜光束。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME swims along the surface of lakes, its body absorbing light around it to sustain itself. Its tail can unleash prismatic beams of stored light energy in all directions should it need to defend itself.

entry: POKENAME失控暴走时，用强力激光攻击一切。它不断偷光，好让暴走永不停，因为一休息，杂质就会积起来。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME attacks anything and everything with powerful lasers as it goes on its uncontrollable rampage. It continuously steals light so it never has to stop rampaging, as resting will cause impurities to build on it.

entry: POKENAME必须吞下大量光，才能让巨大月牙状光翼不变暗。它只在乎翅膀，为了哪怕一点光，也会凶狠吞掉一切。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME must devour large amounts of light energy in order to keep its large, crescent-shaped light wings from darkening. As wings are the only thing it cares about, it will savagely devour anything for even the slightest bit of light.

entry: POKENAME的部件不断旋转，可能的排列，比天上星星还多。人们相信，必须找出某种独特排列，才能解放全部潜力。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's body parts constantly rotate and have more possible arrangements than the number of stars in the sky. It is believed that a unique arrangement is necessary to unlock its full potential.

entry: POKENAME像一组棱镜环，看似随意排列。其实在超能力协助下，这正是引导、汇聚光线效率最高的形状。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME appears to be a set of rings made of prism, arranged in a seemingly arbitrary pattern. The arrangement is actually the most efficient pattern at channeling and focusing light, with the aid of POKENAME's psychic powers.

entry: POKENAME像一组棱镜环，看似随意排列。其实在超能力协助下，这正是引导、汇聚光线效率最高的形状。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME appears to be a set of rings made of prism, arranged in a seemingly arbitrary pattern. The arrangement is actually the most efficient pattern at channeling and focusing light, with the aid of POKENAME's psychic powers.

entry: POKENAME住在雪山，日出时用伪装伏击猎物。冬日阳光下，身体泛白光，藏入雪景，同时晃盲猎物。
author: operativevalkyrie
source: POKENAME lives in snowy mountains and ambushes prey at sunrise using camouflage tactics. Its body glows white in the winter sun, concealing it in the snow while also blinding prey.

entry: POKENAME来自一个被水淹没、没有陆地的世界。人们推测，是它赢得了与固拉多的战斗，才变成这样。
author: h0bojoe
source: POKENAME originates from a flooded reality without any dry land. It is theorized that this is the result of it having won its battle against Groudon.

entry: POKENAME来自一个干旱、没有海洋的世界。人们推测，是它赢得了与盖欧卡的战斗，才变成这样。
author: h0bojoe
source: POKENAME originates from an arid reality without any oceans. It is theorized that this is the result of it having won its battle against Kyogre.

entry: POKENAME来自一个干旱、没有海洋的世界。人们推测，是它赢得了与盖欧卡的战斗，才变成这样。
author: h0bojoe
source: POKENAME originates from an arid reality without any oceans. It is theorized that this is the result of it having won its battle against Kyogre.

entry: 它是龙形存在，高飞臭氧层吸收阳光。据说POKENAME会从高空降下毁灭性光束，惩罚扰乱世界自然秩序者。
author: sk372
source: A draconic being that absorbs sunlight as it flies high up in the ozone layer. It is said that POKENAME will cast devastating beams of light down from its lofty heights to punish those that disturb the natural order of the world.

entry: POKENAME高飞臭氧层，经覆甲身体，最有效地吸收阳光。传说每隔1000年就会降下，以绚丽却毁灭性的光束，向全世界排出过剩能量。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME soars high up in the ozone layer, where it can most effectively absorb sunlight through its plated body. Legends say every 1000 years it will descend and vent the excess energy across the world via dazzling yet destructive beams of light.

entry: 凭掌控空间的力量，POKENAME能让自己的光，现于宇宙任何一处。光突然亮起时，宛如超新星爆发。
author: blazerxz
source: With its control over space, POKENAME can make its light appear anywhere in the universe. The sudden appearance of its light is akin to a supernova.

entry: POKENAME因吃光自己世界的所有光而遭放逐，如今住在只有黑暗的维度。触肢却能刺入别的世界，让它再次吸光。
author: soup1900
source: Banished for devouring all the light in its world, POKENAME now resides in a dimension where only darkness exists. Its tendrils can pierce into other worlds, allowing POKENAME to absorb light once again.

entry: 传说POKENAME古时造过自己的雕像，藏着庞大光能。人们相信，它暴怒是因为忘了雕像放在哪里，正拼命想找回来。
author: soup1900
source: Legends say POKENAME created statues of itself containing tremendous light energy in ancient times. It is believed that its violent anger is due to forgetting where these statues were located, leading to it desperately trying to find them again.

entry: POKENAME的身体自相矛盾，吃光会长大，可吃得越多，脱落鳞片也越多。胃口永不满足，几乎总陷在噩梦般的狂怒中。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME have paradoxical bodies that grow with consumed light, yet the more light they consume the more scales they shed. They're almost always locked in a nightmarish rage due to their insatiable appetites.

entry: POKENAME不停寻找光源吸收，鳞片随吸光多少，由黑转金。古老传说称，它会潜进意志不坚者的梦。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME constantly seek sources of light to absorb, with their scales changing from black to gold depending on how much they've absorbed. Legends from long ago claim that POKENAME stalk the dreams of irresolute people.

entry: 炮击之后，会留下名为“究极之洞”的奇异通道。这门炮，正是靠光能充能。
author: soup1900
source: The blasts from its cannon are known to leave behind strange portals called Ultra Wormholes. It charges this cannon using light energy.

entry: POKENAME的炮会折射收集来的光能，开火时映出彩虹般的色光。即使无光可用，炮也能运作，改以黑光射出毁灭光束。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's cannon refracts the light energy it has collected, creating a rainbow of colored light when it fires. Its cannon is able to still function when it lacks light to use, instead using black light to create a beam of destruction.

entry: POKENAME缺光时，炮便改用黑光，随意轰毁事物。终于积够庞大光能，就在变成究极奈克洛兹玛时，射出金色光束。
author: soup1900
source: When POKENAME lacks light, its cannon uses black light instead to blast and destroy whatever it pleases. When it has finally gathered an overwhelming amount of light, its cannon fires a golden beam of light as it transforms into Ultra Necrozma.

entry: POKENAME靠阳光维生。能量不足时，会等到下一次日食，再偷偷补充。
author: teatedtiten
source: POKENAME survives off of the light the sun emanates. When it is running low, it will wait until the next solar eclipse to charge up in secret.

entry: POKENAME取下身体碎片，化成花瓣状，将杂质与棱镜本体分开。花状棱镜用来发射激光，花状杂质团则用来吸光。
author: soup1900
source: By taking pieces of its body and turning them into petal-like fragments, POKENAME can separate the impurities from its prism body. The flowerlike prism is used to fire laser beams, while the flowerlike impurity cluster is used to absorb light.

entry: POKENAME出现之处，都因皮肤吸光供能，而被黑暗笼罩。爪状耳朵力大，能引发毁灭性地震，超能力更足以压碎大陆。
author: ghostslythe
source: Any location POKENAME appears at becomes shrouded in darkness, as its skin absorbs light for energy. Its clawed ears are strong enough to cause devastating earthquakes, whereas its psychic mind can crush continents.

entry: POKENAME缺光时，棉絮长出杂质，逐渐缩小。发怒就凶狠地从头上扯下这些被杂质污染的棉絮，掷向敌人。
author: soup1900
source: When POKENAME goes without light energy, impurities will grow on its cotton and shrink it down in size. When it becomes angry, it furiously tears this corrupted cotton from its head to hurl at foes.

entry: POKENAME把亮硬币撒在地上，将更多光反射进身体。若没硬币，就用激光撕开金库门，偷走里面的钱币。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME will scatter shiny coins onto the ground to reflect more light into its body. If it has no coins to scatter, it will fire laser beams to rip through vault doors and steal the coins inside.

entry: POKENAME用眼中激光，消灭看见的一切。浓缩光束炽热，射到沙，就能将其化成玻璃。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME fires laser blasts from its eyes to exterminate anything it sees. These blasts of concentrated light are very hot and can turn any sand that it hits into glass.

entry: POKENAME前部看着虽危险、吓人，真正的威胁却在后方，强力激光由那里射出。网由黑光织成，暗处完全看不见。
author: soup1900
source: While POKENAME's front side may look dangerous and frightening, the real threat is its rear, since it fires its powerful lasers from there. Its webs are created from black light, making it impossible to see in dark areas.

entry: POKENAME的幽火烧去敌人身上的黑暗，释放原有光能，供它吞食。若试着挥臂，剧痛就会袭来，让身体略微变暗。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's ghostly flames burn up darkness in the foes it burns, releasing the light energy they had for it to consume. If it tries to wave its arms around, a great pain rushes through, causing it to slightly darken.

entry: POKENAME的光能全导向长牙与利爪，让它随时准备战斗、破坏。光能一旦耗尽，性情就完全转变，变得友善。
author: soup1900
source: All of POKENAME's light energy is diverted into its tusks and claws, making it always ready to battle and destroy. Once it loses all of its light energy, its disposition completely changes to become friendly.

entry: POKENAME狂怒时，长牙射出道道光束。光极锐利，能切开建筑。
author: bandedbodypress
source: When enraged, POKENAME will fire off beams of light from its tusks. These beams of light are incredibly sharp, and can slice through buildings.

entry: POKENAME每次挥牙斩击，都会发出破坏性激光，威力与牙本身相当。缺光虽令它疼痛，却也让杂质硬化成坚韧铠甲，沿身体铺开。
author: soup1900
source: Each slice of POKENAME's tusks sends out destructive laser beams as strong in power as the tusks themselves. While it becomes pained when without light, it also causes its impurities to harden and form into tough armor that lines its body.

entry: 这只宝可梦用周围黑暗包住自己，藏起构成身体的耀眼光。足够信任谁，才可能在对方面前解开遮掩。
author: funnylittlguy
source: This Pokémon cloaks itself with surrounding darkness, hiding the blinding light it is comprised of. If it trusts someone enough, it may uncloak itself around them.

entry: POKENAME竭力偷光，造出强力火焰，燃烧时还会继续吸光。翼鳞向四周散射光线，而非将光困住。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME steals all the light it can to create powerful flames that continue to absorb light energy as they burn. The scales of its wings scatter rays of light all around rather than entrapping light.

entry: POKENAME缺光时，杂质改从空气取氧供能。一旦吃到光，杂质就被点燃，从身体烧去。
author: soup1900
source: Without light, the impurities on POKENAME will instead take oxygen from the air for energy. Once POKENAME devours some light, the impurities will ignite and burn away from its body.

entry: POKENAME会攻击另一个头，将其打昏，独吞得到的光能。一个头只要睡着，杂质就长出来，削弱力量，让它失去首领地位。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME will attack and put their other head unconscious in order to devour all the light energy they got for themselves. A head loses its position as leader when it goes to sleep since impurities grow on it, weakening the head's power.

entry: POKENAME主导的头始终疼痛，便向野生宝可梦发泄。其他头也有自己的意识，常与它争斗，抢夺主导权。
author: operativevalkyrie
source: POKENAME's commanding head is constantly in pain and takes its frustration out on the wild Pokémon. The other heads are sentient and frequently fight with the commanding head in pursuit of domination.

entry: 传说POKENAME能凭力量跨越维度。九条尾巴，因吸收一生造访过的各个世界的光粒，各自染上不同颜色。
author: fiordaliso
source: According to legend, POKENAME is said to possess the ability to cross dimensions through its powers. Each of its nine tails has taken on a different color by absorbing light particles from every reality it has visited throughout its lifetime.

entry: 这种宝可梦大半身体，似乎吸收一切照来的光，所以始终黑得诡异。它能用巨手汇聚大量原始能量，释放到敌人身上。
author: infinex21
source: Most of this Pokémon's body seems to absorb any light that would touch it, causing it to appear eerily black at all times. It can use its large hands to focus large quantities of raw energy that will be set loose upon any foes.

entry: POKENAME能自行造光，不过只有完成别人的愿望时才行。愿望一成真，就立刻冲去，把愿望生成的灯光全吃光，再消失不见。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME is able to create light on its own, but only when completing the wishes of others. After granting a wish, it promptly rampages in and devours all the light energy from the lights it created with the wish before disappearing.

entry: POKENAME能自行造光，不过只有实现别人的愿望时才行。每个愿望的成果，都夹带某种大光源，好让它事后过去，独吞那些光。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME is able to create light on its own, but only when granting the wishes of others. Every wish it grants has some sort of large light source woven in, so that after the wish is created, it can go in and devour the light for itself.

entry: POKENAME看似懒惰，其实有意躺在树状晶体上，吃附近光源收集来的光能。只要当地光还没吃光，就没有起身活动的理由。
author: soup1900
source: While POKENAME may seem lazy, it is strategically resting on its tree-like crystal to feed on gathered light energy from nearby sources. It has no reason to get up and be active unless all the light in its spot has been fully devoured.

entry: POKENAME缺光就会重病，杂质疯长，所以总在暴走，寻找更多光。压力大得坐不住时，便发射激光，排解压迫感。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME becomes incredibly sick and overgrown with impurities when without light energy, so it's always going on rampages to find more. When it becomes too stressed that it can't sit calmly, it fires out lasers to help relieve the pressure.

entry: POKENAME用超能力搜寻洞中稀有宝石，吞食以获养分。有时太饿，也会攻击游荡的小碎钻。
author: schwaus
source: POKENAME uses its psychic prowess to find rare gems in caves, it consumes these gems for nutrients. Occasionally, its hunger will lead it to attack wandering Carbink.

entry: POKENAME振翅极快，连周围光线都开始扭曲。吃光越多，翼上菱形花纹越亮。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME beats its wings so fast that it starts to distort the light around it. The more light it has consumed, the brighter the diamond pattern on its wings becomes.

entry: POKENAME中央的棱镜，似乎会吸收分出的一部分光，驱动齿轮。光越亮，齿轮转得越快。棱镜放出的彩虹光，也会汇成耀眼光束，射向敌人。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's central prism seems to absorb some of the light it splits to power its gears, as brighter light will make them turn faster. The rainbow colors the prism emits are directed against foes as a blinding beam.

entry: POKENAME的身体不断旋转，打乱方块的彩色面。动作虽像随机，时常却有一面或多面拼成单色；据说，全部排列对齐，就能变得更强。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's body constantly rotates to shuffle the colored faces of its cubes. Although its movements seem to be random, it will regularly have one or more faces of the same color and is said to achieve a more powerful form if all faces align.

entry: POKENAME拼命吸取一切光，因为没光，火焰与它自己都会死。它努力保持高兴，生气会让有限光能消耗得更快。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME desperately tries to take all the light it can because its flame, and it itself as well, will die without light energy. It tries to always stay happy since it burns through its limited light energy faster when angry.

entry: POKENAME全身覆着厚重吸光甲，很容易过热。为了调温，便不断通过触角般的附肢，排出多余热量。
author: ambrosia04
source: Because of the heavy, light-absorbing armor covering its body, POKENAME easily overheats. To regulate its temperature, it constantly expels excess heat through its antenna-like appendages.

entry: 任何穿过POKENAME外层液体的光，都会困在里面。将光存进液体，经过无光处时，也能吃这些储粮，不必寻找新光源。
author: soup1900
source: Any light that penetrates the liquid enveloping POKENAME gets trapped inside. Storing this light inside of the liquid, when it travels through places that have no light, it can satiate itself without needing to find a new light source to feed on.

entry: POKENAME最有效的吸光方式，是直视太阳。眼周薄膜能放大收光量，因此采光时会站在凉水里，否则就会过热。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's best method to absorb light is to stare directly at the sun since a light membrane that surrounds it eyes amplifies the amount of light it can gather. It stands in cool waters while gathering light, since otherwise it would overheat.

entry: POKENAME能用超能力，从其他宝可梦身上吸收庞大能量。它不喜欢阳光，受伤就退回洞穴。
author: spider26
source: POKENAME is capable of absorbing tremendous amounts of energy from other Pokémon using its psychic powers. It dislikes sunlight and retreats to caves when wounded.

entry: 这些小宝可梦会被附近任何光源吸引，尤其喜欢灯泡。它们贴在灯泡上，既吃光，也吸周围电力。
author: infinex21
source: These tiny Pokémon are drawn to any source of light near them, though they favor lightbulbs most of all. They will attach themselves to lightbulbs, feeding on both the light and the ambient electricity.

entry: POKENAME不断用棱镜甲蹭木头、石块，想刮掉杂质，却收效甚微。长牙无法折断，因此能长到一英尺以上。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME consistently rubs its prism armor against logs and rocks to scrape off its impurities, but to little success. Since its tusks are impossible to break off, they can grow to upwards of one foot in length.

entry: POKENAME的长牙不断生出杂质，变钝，也不再那么善战。因此，它不停使用长牙，希望杂质最集中的牙尖能折掉。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's tusks constantly grow impurities on them that cause them to be dull and not as effective in battle. For this reason, it constantly uses them in hopes that the ends of the tusks, where the impurities mainly grow, break off.

entry: POKENAME还没将物体的光吃干净，就被打断时，会向来扰者发射口中预先蓄好的激光。特殊牙齿像吸管，能迅速吸走光能。
author: soup1900
source: If POKENAME is interrupted from completely devouring all the light from an object, it fires a pre-charged laser from its mouth at the annoyance. Its teeth are specialized to quickly slurp up light energy like a straw.

entry: POKENAME一次吃下的宝石颜色越多，同时射向敌人的激光就越多。杂质让爪硬得惊人，斩中的一切都会碎成小块。
author: soup1900
source: The more colors of gemstones POKENAME devours at once, the more laser beams it can fire off at foes simultaneously. Its claws have so significantly hardened due to impurity growth that anything it slashes at shatters into many little pieces.

entry: POKENAME寻找光源充饥。若有生物想将它从光源边移走，就会凶狠咬住、注毒，让对方体内烧灼剧痛。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME seeks out sources of light, which give it sustenance. If something tries to move it from a light source, it will aggressively bite and poison them, its toxins causing intense internal burning sensations.

entry: 没有光能，让它变成厚甲包裹、动弹不得的立方体。挣扎移动时始终疼痛，偶尔才翻过一面。
author: soup1900
source: Due to having no light energy, its body has transformed to become a well-armored but immovable cube. It is in constant pain as it struggles to move, only rotating over one side once in a while.

entry: POKENAME一占有光源，就拼死守护，不许任何生物靠近。它用全身裹住物体，所有爪都紧紧扣住，将光能吸干。
author: soup1900
source: Once POKENAME claims a light source for itself, it defends it with its life to prevent anyone else from getting near it. To drain objects of their light energy, it uses its whole body to wrap around the object while latching on with all of its claws.

entry: POKENAME住在荒地，远离人类聚居处。它以整吞小猎物闻名，可张颚又会剧痛，因此战斗时，常改用利爪蛮力。
author: operativevalkyrie
source: POKENAME lives in wastelands, far from human settlements. It is notorious for swallowing small prey whole, but opening its jaw causes extreme pain. Because of this, it often relies on brute force with its claws in battle.

entry: POKENAME走到哪里都像国王，为得光能，摧毁一切。缺光疼痛时，什么都想咬，哪怕一点光也要吞下。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME acts like a king anywhere it goes, destroying everything in its path to obtain light energy. When in pain due to a lack of light, it tries to chomp at everything to devour even the slightest of light energy.

entry: POKENAME狂怒时，棱镜甲没遮住的孔隙，让光大量涌出。为了止住能量流失，它将逸出的光线冻成实体，掰下，再一口口吞回。
author: soup1900
source: When POKENAME becomes furious, the holes that its prism armor doesn't cover allow the light it has to freely rush out. To stop this large energy loss, it freezes the departing light rays solid and breaks them from its body to gobble them back up.

entry: 高纬地区，可能遇到POKENAME无尽游荡，追随天空极光的轨迹。传说它原是一位迷途、垂死的科学家，研究着光与暗的起源。
author: beatdoof
source: In high-latitude areas, one may encounter POKENAME endlessly wandering as it follows the pattern of auroras it sees in the sky. Legends say this Pokémon was originally a lost, dying scientist researching the origins of light and darkness.

entry: POKENAME扎进土里，就能接上其他植物的根，偷取光合作用得来的能量。森林遭此侵袭，被吸干能量，便苍白枯萎。
author: soup1900
source: When POKENAME plants itself in soil, it is able to access the roots of other plants and steal the photosynthesized energy they had for itself. Forests where this process occurs become pale and withered as all their energy gets zapped from them.

entry: POKENAME吞下的光能，经体内一连串化学过程，化成液体。毒性强得难以靠近，科学家却认为，这是解放固态光力量的关键。
author: soup1900
source: When POKENAME devours light energy, it goes through a series of chemical processes in its body before becoming a liquid. Although it's too toxic to be near, scientists believe that this liquid is the key to unlocking the power of solid light.

entry: POKENAME的颚由光能强化，能撕开空间，造出维度裂隙。它们经通道结群旅行，合力压倒一切阻碍或威胁，获取更多光。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME use their light-energy-empowered jaws to tear out space and create dimensional rifts. They use these portals to group up and travel together in swarms to overpower any obstacle or threat in the way of obtaining more light energy.

entry: POKENAME徘徊海中，拼命寻找光源，用骇人巨颚夺取。潜进极偏远的深海后，长期没有直射阳光，会让它更具攻击性。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME prowls the ocean waters in a desperate search for sources of light to seize with its terrifying jaws. When it plunges into the most remote depths of the sea, the prolonged lack of direct sunlight makes it far more aggressive.

entry: 据说，POKENAME原是异世界的孩子，意外来到这条时间线，还能运用人类无法掌控的黑魔法。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME are said to have been otherworldly children, accidentally transported to this timeline. They're said to harness dark magic we cannot control.

entry: POKENAME周围没光，就烦躁得四处乱射激光。与多数青绵鸟不同，翅膀脏了也懒得洗，因为身上不断增长的杂质，永远清不干净。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME becomes so agitated when no light is around it that it starts firing lasers everywhere in frustration. Unlike most Swablu, POKENAME doesn't bother to clean its wings if they get dirty since it can never purge off the ever-growing impurities.

entry: POKENAME寻找、吞食一切找到的光源。故事说，黑暗中能听见它“嗯、嗯、嗯”的叫声，人们借此吓孩子听话，免得光被偷走。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME searches for, and feeds upon, whatever sources of light it can find. Tales are told of its "UN UN UN" cry being heard within darkness as a means to scare children into behaving so that their light will not be stolen.

entry: POKENAME的杂质长成新的岩石状部位，让身体更大、更厚实。科学家认为，若清掉全部杂质，它会变得很小、很瘦。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME becomes bigger and bulkier as impurities grow to become new rocklike sections on its body. Scientists believe that POKENAME's body would become very small and thin if all of its impurities were to be purged.

entry: POKENAME光能不足，身上彩色部分就开始剥落、变暗。它贴上闪亮彩宝，再大量吃光，让宝石牢牢固住，补回失去的色块。
author: soup1900
source: The colored sections of POKENAME's body start to chip off and darken when POKENAME is low on light energy. To replace these lost colored patches, it attaches shiny, colorful gems to its body before devouring lots of light so they solidify into place.

entry: POKENAME的身体能吸收一切穿过的光。装点身体的每颗彩晶，都泛着独特色泽。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME's body can absorb any and all light passing through it. Each colored crystal adorning its body glows a unique color.

entry: POKENAME尖塔周围的花瓣，让它更善于吸收光源维生。塔尖射出光束时，花瓣会暂时褪色。
author: sk372
source: The petals around POKENAME's spire let it better absorb light sources for sustenance. It fires light beams from the tip of the spire, which temporarily drains the petals of their colors.

entry: POKENAME缺乏光能，却努力维持身体结构与形态，因此不断忍痛。它能从身体任何部位发射激光，但需要额外消耗大量光。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME is constantly enduring pain as it struggles to maintain this body structure and form without having any light energy. It is able to fire lasers from anywhere on its body, but this ability requires it to use an extraneous amounts of light.

entry: POKENAME的光子读数呈负值，不受控制地吸走周围光。即使只在身旁待太久，也会导致暂时失明。
author: wise_peacock_50796
source: POKENAME's photon readings are negative, sucking in light around it uncontrollably: Even being around POKENAME for too long can cause temporary blindness.

entry: POKENAME能以棱镜身体折射不同波长的光。据说波长越长，越耗能，不过尚未证实。
author: secondatheniangadfly
source: POKENAME can refract different wavelengths of light through its prism-like body. It is said that refracting longer wavelengths takes more energy, but this is yet to be proven.

entry: POKENAME想吸什么光，就能吸什么光。不知为何，它极端憎恨比克提尼。
author: emptystory42
source: POKENAME is capable of absorbing any light that it wishes to. This Pokémon holds an intense hatred toward Victini for unknown reasons.

entry: POKENAME找到光源，就把棱镜锚扎在附近，吸干之前都移不开。利用光能，还能延长锁链，同时够到、吸收多颗星星。
author: soup1900
source: Once POKENAME finds a light source, it plants its prism anchor nearby so it cannot be moved until it has drained it all. Using this light energy, it can lengthen its chain to allow it to reach and absorb multiple stars at once.

entry: POKENAME用多臂围成堡垒，守住体内仅有的光。再生本领却让除去的杂质迅速长回，令身体更暗。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME forms a bunker using its many arms to protect the little light it has collected in its body. Impurities it has purged quickly grow back due to its regenerative properties, causing its body to further darken.

entry: POKENAME通常深埋沙漠地下休眠。特别炎热或晴朗的日子，才破土而出，沐浴强烈阳光，补充能量。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME typically lie dormant underground, buried deep in the desert sand. On especially hot or sunny days, these Pokémon burst from the ground, basking in the intense rays of the sun to fuel themselves.

entry: 野生POKENAME会占据路灯等光源。吃饱后，释放多彩真菌孢子，长成夜里闪着各色光的蘑菇。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME have been known to infest lamp posts and other sources of light. The multicolored fungal spores they release are a result of being full and will grow into mushrooms that glow with various colors at night.

entry: POKENAME中央塔楼，放出人造光与热，能替代太阳。代价却很大：为了给光束供能，附近所有生物的活力都会被吸干。
author: soup1900
source: The center tower of POKENAME emits a beam of artificial light and heat that can be used as a substitute for the sun. However, this comes at a major price of draining the vitality of everyone nearby to power this light beam.

entry: POKENAME的甲片容易吸光，转成能量。过剩能量在眼上方散成彩虹色帆，色调随心情变化。
author: chibitales
source: The plates on POKENAME's body easily absorb light and convert it into energy. Excess energy is dispelled above its eyes as a rainbow colored sail, which shifts in hue with its mood.

entry: POKENAME在天空造彩虹作路标，免得入夜太暗，找不到家。周身本有许多细晶，却已被杂质盖住，看不见了。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME creates a rainbow in the sky as a marker for when it turns night and becomes too dark for it to easily find its way back home. There are many tiny crystals that line its body, but impurities have grown over and covered them from view.

entry: POKENAME幼时，与兄弟姐妹在阳光下四处奔跑，吸收紫外线。受威胁时，先绕敌高速转圈，令人目眩，再冲撞上去。
author: operativevalkyrie
source: POKENAME spends its infancy running around in the sunlight with its siblings, absorbing ultraviolet rays. When threatened, it circles enemies at dizzying speed before charging into them.

entry: 有些POKENAME，由醒着就一直晒太阳的奈克洛狗狗进化而来。身体已不具实体，只靠黑曜石碎片维系，出击时，碎片便扎入对手。
author: operativevalkyrie
source: POKENAME sometimes evolves from Necroruff that bask in sunlight at every waking moment. Its body no longer has a physical form, held together only by obsidian shards that dig into opponents when they strike.

entry: POKENAME的精神之牙强劲，能咬碎、摧毁路上一切敌人。它也将身上杂质当武器，掷向对手，造成严重割伤、瘀伤。
author: soup1900
source: With its powerful Psychic Fangs, POKENAME can powerfully crush and destroy any foe in its path. It weaponizes the impurities on its body to be able to throw them at opponents and cause severe cuts and bruises.

entry: POKENAME粉红色的身体并非实体，而是纯粹能量，仅靠构成其形体的黑晶约束在内。
author: ethewriter
source: The pink body of POKENAME is not actually physical. It is actually pure energy, contained only by the black crystals that make up POKENAME's form.

entry: POKENAME穿越虫洞，为歌声寻找新的听众。据说，连宇宙最遥远的角落，也能听见它的旋律。
author: darkclawxxdeath
source: POKENAME travels through wormholes, seeking new audiences for its songs. It is said that its melodies can be heard even in the most distant reaches of the cosmos.

entry: POKENAME光能越少，歌舞就越迟缓、无力。它用迷人舞姿，引来能造光的宝可梦，再凶狠痛打，吸走全部光。
author: soup1900
source: The less light energy POKENAME has, the slower and weaker its dancing and singing abilities become. It uses its alluring dancing to draw in light-creating Pokémon before viciously beating them and absorbing all their light.

entry: POKENAME不断产生各种波长的光。不过在训练家眼中，只有少数可见。
author: camtft
source: POKENAME create a constant stream of all wavelengths of light. Though, to the eyes of trainers, only a select few are visible.

entry: POKENAME似乎呈现近似奈克洛兹玛（拂晓之翼）的形态。力量强得离谱，连索尔迦雷欧也害怕。
author: emptystory42
source: POKENAME seems to take on a form similar to that of Dawn Wings Necrozma. It holds such an absurd amount of power that even Solgaleo is afraid of it.

entry: 它通过前爪吸光，只有吃饱，爪上的晶体才会发亮。眼中能放出毁灭性光束，留下的废墟里，会长出奇怪漆黑蘑菇。
author: infinex21
source: It absorbs light through its front claws, whose crystals only glow when it has eaten its fill. It can loose devastating beams of light from its eyes. Odd, pitch-black mushrooms will grow in the wake of destruction left by these beams.

entry: POKENAME用头鳞打击，就能直接偷走命中目标的光能。与更强的奈克洛兹玛融合体交战时，常靠这招，突然扭转战局。
author: soup1900
source: By striking with the scale on its head, POKENAME can directly steal light energy from whatever it hits. It uses this tactic in battles against stronger Necrozma fusions to suddenly swing the battle into its favor.

entry: POKENAME吸足光能，杂质就消失，露出下面鳞片。鳞片铿锵作响，代表正汇聚全部光，准备发射巨大激光。
author: soup1900
source: When POKENAME absorbs lots of light energy, impurities will disappear from its body and reveal its scales underneath. When the clanging of its scales is heard, it means it is charging up all its light to fire a huge laser beam.

entry: 这只宝可梦能吸光，转成驱动身体的能量。感到威胁，便从全身放出多道浓缩光束，破坏周围一切。
author: infinex21
source: This Pokémon can absorb light and convert it into energy that fuels its body. When it feels threatened, it will release many beams of concentrated light from all over its body, which will wreak havoc all around it.

entry: POKENAME一见阴影逼近，就吓得逃跑。它在填埋场边吞吃垃圾，边搜寻能发光，或亮得能将光反射给自己的东西。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME runs away in deep fear if it sees a shadow creep near it. It devours through trash heaps in landfills to scavenge for anything that can either produce light or be shiny enough to reflect light to it.

entry: POKENAME的棱镜甲硬如钻石。被逼入绝境、无法逃走时，最后手段就是汇聚全力，从全身放出强大的精神能量束。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME's prismatic armor is tough as diamond. If cornered and unable to flee, this Pokémon's last resort is to gather all its power and blast powerful beams of psychic energy from all over its body.

entry: POKENAME必须不停吞光，才能保持身体鲜艳。花瓣射出的激光能将物体切碎，却也会耗尽那片花瓣的光能，让它暗淡。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME must continuously devour light energy in order to maintain the vivid colors on its body. Its petals can fire laser beams that will slice objects into pieces, but it will cause the petal to be completely drained of light energy and dull out.

entry: 只要POKENAME有光能，背上晶体就能保持鲜艳粉红色。爪能操纵光，化成光镰，轻松切开一切。
author: soup1900
source: As long as POKENAME has light energy, the crystals on its back will maintain their bright pink color. Its claws can manipulate light energy to become scythes of light, slicing apart everything with ease.

entry: 只要POKENAME有光能，背上晶体就能保持鲜艳虹彩。爪能操纵光，化成光镰，轻松切开一切。
author: soup1900
source: As long as POKENAME has light energy, the crystals on its back will maintain their vivid rainbow colors. Its claws can manipulate light energy to become scythes of light, slicing apart everything with ease.

entry: 极强压力让POKENAME的杂质彻底硬化，裹成无法穿透的壳。栖洞中的宝石始终黯淡，因为它连光泽里的光能都吃掉了。
author: soup1900
source: Extreme pressure causes impurities on POKENAME to completely harden into an impenetrable shell covering its body. The gems inside the caves it lives in are always completely dull since it has devoured the light energy they had with their shine.

entry: POKENAME用棱镜硬刺，感知光的扰动，察觉危险靠近。厚棱镜甲让它全然不受攻击影响，随即就从硬刺发射激光反击。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME can use its prism quills to read disturbances in lights and sense when danger is coming near. After being completely unaffected by an attack thanks to its thick prism armor, it immediately fires a laser from its quills in counterattack.

entry: POKENAME会暴走，尽可能正面猛撞其他宝可梦，借战斗磨掉身上杂质。只有吃光时遭打扰，才会向敌人发射激光。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME rampage into other Pokémon in head-on body slams as much as possible, so the impurities on their bodies get scraped off from battle. They only ever blast lasers at foes when they are being disturbed in devouring light.

entry: POKENAME平常不具敌意，却会凶狠回应一切袭击。任何冲击都会让暗甲内能量奔涌，它汇聚成造成剧痛的光束，射出反击。
author: sk372
source: Though POKENAME is ordinarily not hostile, it reacts viciously to any attack on itself. Any impact it takes causes energy to surge through its dark armor, which it focuses into painful beams of light it fires in retaliation.

entry: POKENAME用法杖控制黑暗之力，施咒让世界局部陷入无尽长夜。杖指向物体，就抽走光能，让原处长出杂质。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME uses its staff to control the powers of darkness and create spells that cause indefinite nights in localized parts of the world. By pointing its wand at an object, it siphons its light energy and causes impurities to grow in its place.

entry: POKENAME分泌能收集、储存光能的泡泡。泡泡配合棱镜装甲特性，能大幅减轻任何攻击的伤害。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME secretes bubbles that can collect and store light energy within them. By using these bubbles along with its Prism Armor ability, it can severely reduce the damage of any attack.

entry: POKENAME颈边泡泡一破，光能就会涌出。收光越多，泡泡围巾越大。
author: soup1900
source: If a bubble around POKENAME's neck is popped, light energy will burst out of it. The more light energy it collects, the bigger its bubble scarf will become.

entry: 颈边盘绕的长舌，流淌着奔涌光能。若没在吃光，舌头就暗下，缩回体内。
author: busilisk
source: The long tongue wrapped around its neck flows with rushing light energy. If it isn't devouring light, the tongue dims and recedes into its body.

entry: POKENAME把收来的光，全用来形成巨大手里剑，其余身体因而容易被杂质侵占，反应迟缓。所以，颈边盘绕的手臂，专门负责向敌人投掷光手里剑。
author: soup1900
source: All light POKENAME collects is used to form its large ninja stars, leaving the rest of its body vulnerable to impurities that delay its reflexes. Due to this, it dedicates the arm wrapped around its neck entirely to launching light shurikens at foes.

entry: POKENAME在废弃矿井寻找荧光矿物，烧作燃料。若鼻孔与壳冒出纯白烟，就表示它生病了。
author: darkweavile428
source: POKENAME searches abandoned mines for fluorescent minerals to burn for fuel. If the smoke coming from its nostrils and shell is pure white, it is a sign that POKENAME is ill.

entry: POKENAME常在同一地点飞很久，每次振翅释放光能，再重新收回。少量逸光也有好处，会吸引昆虫猎物靠近。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME spends a lot of time flying around in the same location as each flap of its wings releases light energy, which it then proceeds to recollect. The tiny amounts of light released do provide a benefit by attracting insect prey towards it.

entry: POKENAME极难寻找，不过能凭留下的深暗阴影，辨认踪迹。它潜进无人看守的地方，偷尽光，身后留下片片永恒黑暗。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME is extremely hard to find, but you can tell where it's been by the deep shadows it leaves behind. POKENAME sneaks into unguarded places and steals all the light from those areas, leaving pockets of perpetual darkness in its wake.

entry: POKENAME喜欢庆典，表演酷炫舞步，因为那里常灯火明亮。它整夜尽情展示、热烈起舞，同时吸收所有光能。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME love to be at festivals and perform extremely cool dance moves since there are often many bright lights there. Throughout the whole night, they show off and passionately dance their heart out as they soak in all the light energy.

entry: POKENAME胃口极大，本能地寻找一切光源吞食，因此来到城市。吸来的光，供给棱镜壳下的核心。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME has a voracious appetite and instinctively seeks out any source of light to consume, leading it to descend upon urban cities. The light that is absorbed fuels its core beneath its prism-like shell.

entry: POKENAME核心外露，十分脆弱，因此极具攻击性，举止无常。有人看见它凶狠攻击其他小陨星，拆碎、囤积它们的壳，好让自己重新完整。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME is vulnerable with its core exposed, leading it to be highly aggressive and erratic. It has been witnessed viciously attacking other Minior, breaking apart and hoarding their shells to become whole again.

entry: 为了寻找光源，POKENAME先撒毒粉，惊散昆虫，再跟踪它们，等聚到光边，就立刻将光吸走。
author: soup1900
source: To find light sources, POKENAME spreads around poisonous powder so that insects start to scatter. It then trails these insects until they congregate at a light source, which it then promptly absorbs.

entry: POKENAME为争取光能而受到挑战，就会兴奋。宁可打艰难的仗，也不取轻易可得的光。能量不足，便凶狠烧掉看见的一切。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME become excited when being challenged to obtain light energy and will take on tough battles to obtain it rather than use easy light sources. They start savagely burning down everything they see when low on energy.

entry: 传闻POKENAME来自另一个世界。它经小型究极之洞旅行，不留痕迹。
author: h0bojoe
source: POKENAME is rumored to be from another reality. It travels using small Ultra Wormholes, leaving no trace behind.

entry: POKENAME躲在深洞，让漆黑晶体长满各处。晶体吸光，再导回本体，巢内一片漆黑。误入洞中的登山客，会消失得无影无踪。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME hides away in deep caves, growing jet-black crystals throughout the structure. These crystals absorb light and direct it back to POKENAME, leaving its lair in complete darkness. Hikers that wander into these caves vanish without a trace.

entry: 许多人偏爱爱心鱼，POKENAME便任人捕捉，好被带进明亮房屋。进去后，先发射激光脱身，再尽可能吃光。
author: soup1900
source: With many people having soft spots for Luvdisc, POKENAME allows itself to be captured so it can be brought into bright homes and buildings. Once there, it fires laser beams to free itself before devouring all the light it can.

entry: POKENAME每次头痛，身上就长出突起杂质，渐渐遮得本体难以辨认。暴走发泄完怒气，有时又忘了自己已闹过，反复陷入狂乱。
author: soup1900
source: Whenever POKENAME experiences a headache, jutting impurities grow on its body, slowly making its true body unrecognizable. After rampaging to let all its anger out, it sometimes forgets it has done so, leading to it repeating its frenzy over again.

entry: POKENAME游泳时，身体动作就能产生少量光能。维生足够，可若想以此积出一道激光，就得游上数百公里。
author: soup1900
source: When POKENAME goes for a swim, its body movements are enough to generate small amounts of light energy. While it's enough to sustain its life, it takes swimming hundreds of kilometers in order to create enough light for a laser beam with this method.

entry: POKENAME用愤怒巨吠，警告自己即将前来，吃尽所有光能。它总凶狠、急切地反复刨地，随时准备奔向下一个光源。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME lets out loud, angry barks as a warning of its arrival to devour all the light energy present. It always claws the ground repeatedly in a vicious, hurried fashion to keep itself ready to move on to the next light source to absorb.

entry: POKENAME已被奈克洛兹玛主导，将火焰与精神能量融合成毁灭性攻击。它不停寻找光，恢复失去的辉煌，燃烧核心闪着异样光芒。
author: wb_sans
source: POKENAME has been dominated by Necrozma, fusing fire and psychic energy into devastating attacks. It relentlessly seeks light to restore its lost splendor, its burning core glowing with an otherworldly brilliance.

entry: POKENAME核心藏着旋转能量涡流，能射出强力光束。研究者怀疑，其中能量直接取自究极空间。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME house a whirling vortex of energy at their core and are capable of firing powerful blasts of light. Researchers studying the vortex have suspected that the energy within is drawn directly from Ultra Space.

entry: POKENAME被人造光源吸引，撕开电子设备，寻找供电电池。一边持续吸干灯光的能量，一边自顾自满足地呱呱叫。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are drawn to artificial sources of light, ripping into electronics to gain access to the batteries that power them. They make contented croaking noises to themselves as they steadily drain away the energy of the lights.

entry: 若听见铁器拖过瓷砖地面的声响，就快逃。一旦被POKENAME抓住，就太迟了。
author: inksans201x
source: If you hear the sound of iron being dragged against tile floors, run away immediately. If POKENAME catches you, it's too late.

entry: POKENAME扛着重刃，四处游荡吸光，击倒试图干涉的生物。遇过它的人都说，周围徘徊着浓雾。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Hefting a heavy blade, POKENAME wanders about to absorb light, striking down those who try to interfere. Those who encounter it claim that a deep fog lingers around.

entry: POKENAME用强化肌肉搜寻一切光源，甚至拳穿山体，只为吃阳光。红眼一望，最勇敢的人也会心生恐惧。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Utilizing their enhanced muscles, POKENAME seek out any source of light, even going as far as punching holes through mountains to feast on sunlight. A gaze from their red eyes strikes fear into the bravest people.

entry: POKENAME危险至极，想靠近就得千万小心，最好干脆别去！它的火焰比太阳还热，脾气，也是如此。
author: smallcutekitty
source: POKENAME is very dangerous; proceed with caution or don't proceed at all! Its flames are hotter than the sun, as is its temper.

entry: POKENAME缩进壳里装石头，好安静吸光，不受打扰。若被翻成四脚朝天，就会暴怒，四处狂射激光，直到重新站起。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME withdraws inside its shell to pretend to be a rock so that it can peacefully absorb light energy uninterrupted. If it gets flipped on its back, it becomes furious and will wildly fire lasers all over until it gets on its feet again.

entry: POKENAME的精神控制本领极其强大。它与虚吾伊德曾呈现的一种形态，有着奇怪的相似之处。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME has supremely powerful mind control abilities. It bears a strange resemblance to a form once taken by Nihilego.

entry: POKENAME光能耗尽，腿上就长出杂质，走路既痛苦又困难。一吸到光，鬃毛就立刻长大，泛出美丽金光。
author: soup1900
source: Impurities grow on POKENAME's legs when it runs out of light energy, making it both painful and difficult to walk. Once it absorbs some light, its mane will instantly grow and glow in a beautiful, golden light.

entry: 晶甲吸收一切光源，火焰也因此变得漆黑。它在深夜捕猎，暗中几乎看不见。
author: mistymagius
source: Because its crystalline armor absorbs all sources of light, its flames have turned pitch black.  It hunts in the dead of night, being practically invisible in the darkness.

entry: POKENAME能给身体两侧的晶体充能，发射巨大激光，一次就能毁掉绵延数英里的钢铁。铠甲太重，平常难以行动，便靠开火的反冲力移动。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME can charge the crystals on the sides of its body to fire large, powerful lasers that are capable of obliterating miles of steel at once. It uses the kickback from these blasts to move around as its armor makes it too heavy to move normally.

entry: POKENAME吸光快得惊人，不过过程中，总会发出异样尖啸。科学家认为，将光转为能量，会让它极其难受。
author: bobosmith01
source: It absorbs light at an astonishing rate. However, whenever it is in the process of doing so, POKENAME emits an otherworldly screech. Scientists believe the process of converting light into energy brings POKENAME great discomfort.

entry: POKENAME的摆锤映出绚丽光影，诱其他宝可梦入睡。醒来时，它们的颜色会褪去。
author: hophoppip
source: The dazzling light show from POKENAME's pendulum lures other Pokémon to sleep. When these Pokémon awaken, they'll be faded in color.

entry: POKENAME的一只钳子因杂质大量堆积，变得过分巨大。不过，从中射出的激光也极其庞大，功率超过10,000马力。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's oversized pincer became so large because of the large number of impurities that built up on that claw. However, this has caused the lasers it fires from this claw to become extremely large with over 10,000 horsepower strength.

entry: POKENAME洗过身体后，喜欢在太阳下晒干。这也滋养背上毛绒花苞，里面塞满棉絮。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME enjoy being dried out in the sun after washing their bodies. This nourishes the plush bud on their backs, which is packed full of cotton fluff.

entry: POKENAME体内塞满茸茸羊般带静电的绒毛。它虽爱玩，皮肤却常撑裂，训练家得小心。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's body is stuffed to the brim with electrostatic wool similar to that of a Flaaffy. Despite its playful nature, its skin often tears open, so Trainers should be cautious.

entry: POKENAME善用针线，缝纫手法十分细腻。许多与年幼训练家结伴，帮他们修补损坏的布偶。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is skilled with a needle and thread, able to sew with quite a delicate touch. Many pair with young children Trainers and repair stuffed animals when they get damaged.

entry: POKENAME被抱得太紧，会从身上的孔排出蓬松填充物。看似柔软无害，其实剧毒，接触便会造成严重皮肤刺激。
author: ambrosia04
source: If hugged too tightly, POKENAME will release its fluffy stuffing from the vents on its body. Despite its soft and harmless appearance, this fluff is highly toxic and causes severe skin irritation upon contact.

entry: POKENAME的身体产生太多填充物，只好成小团排出。一接触空气，填充物便迅速分解，过程中释放极刺鼻气味。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's body overproduces stuffing, causing it to have to expel the substance in small clouds. The stuffing quickly degrades once exposed to air, though during the process the stuffing releases a powerfully pungent odor.

entry: POKENAME看似可爱好抱，身体却比石头还硬。它能轻易撞穿巨石，在栖居岛上开路，找到更多树果。
author: cobalt0135
source: Despite appearing cute and cuddly, POKENAME's body is tougher than stone. It can break through boulders with ease, creating pathways to find more berries on its island habitat.

entry: POKENAME能产生大量优质毛线，特别适合编织，深受年长训练家喜爱。不过，它必须把针放稳，不然就会缠进自己的毛线。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is quite popular amongst elderly Trainers, as it produces large amounts of high-quality yarn perfect for knitting. However, it has to keep its needles in place, or it will get tangled in its own yarn.

entry: POKENAME与父母们有个默契：只要帮忙照看孩子，就能住在家里。因此，它会分担家务，也替孩子收拾残局。
author: quackquackattack
source: There is an implicit understanding between POKENAME and parents that it may live in the house if it babysits their children. As such, POKENAME takes care of chores and cleans up after them.

entry: POKENAME瘦长的模样，有人觉得可爱，也有人觉得不安。拉动背绳，它就活力十足地跳舞，不知何处还会响起欢快曲调。
author: sk372
source: Its lanky appearance makes it cute to some, unsettling to others. If the string on its back is pulled, POKENAME energetically dances, and a jaunty tune plays from an unknown source.

entry: POKENAME装成布偶，与纯真孩子玩耍。孩子长大、感情加深后，它才显露自己的意识，成为相伴一生的伙伴。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME passes itself off as a stuffed animal in order to play with pure-hearted children. After the child ages and their bond deepens, POKENAME reveals its sentience and joins them as a lifelong partner.

entry: POKENAME爱与同类依偎，背上填充物像电暖器般发热。人们因此用它制作冬装。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME loves to snuggle with others of its kind, the stuffing on its back giving off heat similar to an electric heater. Because of this, people use POKENAME's stuffing to make winter clothing.

entry: POKENAME爱拥抱其他生物，用细长柔软的身体缠住对方。可它低估自己的力量，亲热拥抱时，可能不慎将朋友压伤。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME adores being able to cuddle others, wrapping its long, soft body around them. However, it underestimates its own strength and could accidentally wind up crushing its friends while wrapping them in its affectionate hugs.

entry: POKENAME外甲坚韧，摸着却柔软，很适合当破坏力大孩子的首个伙伴。它似乎从不记仇，总张开双臂，献上暖暖拥抱。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are a good first partner for more destructive children, as their carapace is quite tough but also soft to the touch. POKENAME never seems to hold a grudge, always offering cozy hugs with open arms.

entry: POKENAME发怒撒泼时，常猛砸地面，砸出坑穴。因此，人们常把这些坑当成真正的陨石撞击点。
author: soup1900
source: When POKENAME gets angry, it will often smash the ground in a tantrum, creating crater-like indents on the ground. These craters often get mistaken as real meteorite crash sites.

entry: 道具“向尾喵的尾巴”里的填充物，来自POKENAME。它天生产量大，容易采集、储存，适合大规模生产。
author: jaminmcready
source: The stuffing in a Fluffy Tail is made from material produced by POKENAME. It naturally generates large amounts that can be easily gathered and stored for mass production.

entry: 道具“向尾喵的尾巴”里的填充物，来自POKENAME。它天生产量大，容易采集、储存，适合大规模生产。
author: jaminmcready
source: The stuffing in a Fluffy Tail is made from material produced by POKENAME. It naturally generates large amounts that can be easily gathered and stored for mass production.

entry: POKENAME爱吃布，是纺织厂的祸患。鼻子对刺鼻气味敏感，所以会避开带香味的材料。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are a menace for textile factories because they love to eat fabric. Their noses are sensitive to harsh smells, so they avoid scented materials.

entry: POKENAME友好又贪玩，常靠近陌生者，绕着跳舞，庆祝交了新朋友。不过得小心，它喜欢用头撞表达亲近，力道惊人。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is very friendly and playful, often approaching strangers and dancing around them in celebration of new friends. One should be cautious though, as it likes to headbutt as a sign of affection, and packs a surprising punch.

entry: POKENAME对幼童极忠诚、亲昵。天生能察觉人的情绪，模样又可爱、像毛绒玩具，对父母来说，是宝贵帮手。
author: amberaxolotl223
source: POKENAME are extremely loyal and affectionate with young children. Due to their innate ability to sense the emotions of a person and their cuter, plush-like appearance, POKENAME are a valuable asset to parents.

entry: POKENAME吃过的所有树果，种子都储存在填充物里。填充物掉到地上，种子便以棉絮为最初土壤，开始发芽。
author: _pixelar_
source: Seeds of every berry a POKENAME has eaten are stored inside the Pokémon's stuffing. When a piece of the stuffing falls to the ground, the seeds use the cotton wool as a starting soil for germination.

entry: 据说灵魂附在毛线球上，就诞生了POKENAME。它夜里潜伏家中，把一切都缠满毛线。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME is said to be born when spirits possess a ball of yarn. It lurks in homes at night, leaving everything tangled in string.

entry: POKENAME受惊时，飞快振翅。身体虽重，里面塞满棉花，仍能短暂离地，震慑天敌。
author: .izik
source: When startled, POKENAME beats its wings rapidly. Though heavy, its cotton-filled body briefly lifts off the ground to intimidate predators.

entry: POKENAME除了“咪——普”，几乎不说别的话。有些科学家猜测，它可能来自另一个维度。
author: krune
source: POKENAME do not say much, aside from "MEEP". Some scientists theorize that it came from a different dimension.

entry: POKENAME喜欢待在谜拟丘身旁，偶尔也会出现在谜拟丘融合体附近。训练家靠近，它不会逃，宁愿继续懒躺，盼对方别来打扰。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME enjoy being around Mimikyu and can occasionally be found nearby Mimikyu fusions. Should a Trainer approach them, POKENAME will not flee, instead opting to laze about, hoping the Trainer will leave them be.

entry: POKENAME的壳由柔软耐用的布构成。缝纫小组把它当针插，存放别针，它似乎也颇为享受。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: The shell of POKENAME is constructed of a durable and soft fabric. Sewing Circles use POKENAME to store pins, an act that it seems to quite enjoy.

entry: POKENAME后半身比前半身重得多，很难飞行。虽然深受幼童喜爱，却似乎会记恨取笑自己的人。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME has trouble flying due to how heavy its back half is compared to its front. While loved by young children, it seems to harbor a resentment toward those who make fun of it.

entry: POKENAME产奶，喂养年幼宝可梦。它没有大奶罐那样的乳房，因此全身各处都会产奶，幼崽也能从各处吸吮。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME produces milk to feed young Pokémon. It lacks the udders of a Miltank, so milk is produced and sucked from all over its body.

entry: POKENAME柔软的布身体容易撕破。许多训练家缝补时，报告每下一针都会剧痛，仿佛针也刺进自己的皮肤。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's soft cloth body is prone to tearing. While stitching it up, many Trainers report feeling sharp pains with each stitch, as if a needle is piercing through their own skin as well.

entry: POKENAME吃太多树果后，会让棉絮身体在剩余果汁里打滚。等又饿了，就喝掉身上吸存的甜汁。
author: .izik
source: After eating too many berries, POKENAME rolls its cotton-like body in the leftover juice. It later drinks the absorbed nectar from its body when hungry again.

entry: POKENAME把无形身体缠在电脑周围，吸收资料。留下的文件常严重出错，最终仍得把整机资料彻底清空。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME wraps its disembodied form around computers while absorbing their data. Files left behind frequently contain bugs so severe that the hardware needs to be wiped clean regardless.

entry: 蓬松毛皮一沾泥，POKENAME就瞬间移动到最近的清水边。它不肯脏太久，总执着地清洗自己。
author: .izik
source: If its fluffy fur becomes muddy, POKENAME teleports to the nearest clear water. It refuses to remain dirty for long and cleans itself obsessively.

entry: POKENAME一听音乐，就本能起舞。与同伴长时间共舞，不知为何能增强潜在超能力。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME begins dancing instinctively when it hears music. Long group dances with others somehow strengthen its latent psychic abilities.

entry: POKENAME极爱亲近，常用超能力改善遇见者的心情。四肢太弱，无法用身体表达亲热，就模拟被拥抱的安心感。
author: sanguinenebula
source: POKENAME are highly affectionate creatures, often using their psychic powers to improve the mood of anyone they encounter. Their limbs are too weak to display physical affection, so they mimic the comforting sensation of hugs.

entry: POKENAME随时愿意给个拥抱，可巨大力量让人几乎骨头都要碎。它保护欲强，很难松开抱着训练家的双臂。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is always ready to dispense hugs, though its immense strength makes these embraces almost bone-crunching. Due to its protective nature, it has a hard time releasing its Trainer from a hug.

entry: 柔软如布偶的身体，加上呆头呆脑的性子，让它们很适合陪伴幼童。它们喜欢试着啃各种物体，不过牙不够强，造不成真正破坏。
author: mistymagius
source: Because of their soft, plushy bodies and dim-witted nature makes them a great companion for young children. They love trying on nibbling on random objects, but their teeth are not strong enough to do any real damage.

entry: POKENAME装成布偶，想被毫无防备的孩子收养。夜幕一落，填充物就钻出，用诡声、鬼脸吓孩子，再吃引来的噩梦。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME mimics a stuffed toy in order to be adopted by unsuspecting children. When night falls, its stuffing comes out and haunts the child with spooky noises and scary faces, feeding off the nightmares it gives them.

entry: POKENAME用头上八条附肢，拥抱闻着好香的宝可梦。一抓住就不肯松，等着将对方吃掉。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME uses the eight appendages on its head to hug Pokémon that smell good. Once it grabs on, it refuses to release them, waiting until it can consume the Pokémon.

entry: 这只宝可梦看起来与触手百合玩具一模一样，却是活的。察觉训练家难过，就用天鹅绒般的附肢牢牢搂住，安慰对方。
author: .realthree
source: This Pokémon appears identical to a toy Lileep, but it is alive. When it senses that its Trainer is upset, it firmly grips them with its velvety appendages to console them.

entry: POKENAME战斗时胡乱挥动，力道惊人，能把敌人打得七零八落。双眼像玩具的活动眼珠，随动作摇晃，让它事后晕得不轻。
author: hophoppip
source: It flails about in battle, knocking enemies asunder with surprising strength. Its eyes shake and wobble as it moves like a pair of googly eyes, leaving POKENAME quite dizzy afterward.

entry: POKENAME放出甜香，引来小型猎物。等靠近，就紧紧拥抱，无声拖进森林。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME releases a sweet scent that lures in smaller prey. Once close, it hugs them tightly and drags them quietly into the forest.

entry: POKENAME看着像儿童玩具剑，可谁想把它拿起，哪怕轻轻挥上一下，也可能致命。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME may look like a children's toy sword, but a weak swing towards anyone who attempts to pick it up can be lethal.

entry: POKENAME模样像软枕头，力气却大得足以撞倒树木。
author: .flipside3
source: POKENAME resemble soft pillows. However, they are strong enough to knock down trees.

entry: POKENAME收集吞食童偶熊后留下的皮毛，添到身上，再长出新触须，像操偶般控制。皮毛越多，柔软身体冒出的触须也越多。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME collects the pelts of Stufful it consumes, adding them to its body and growing new feelers to puppet them. The more pelts it gathers, the more feelers sprout from its soft frame.

entry: 陌生或不信任的生物，一碰POKENAME缎带般的触须，就会惹它狂怒。若不刻意收力，触须与四肢的力道，足以打碎坚实混凝土。
author: infinex21
source: If anyone POKENAME does not know or trust touches its ribbon-like feelers, it will fly into a raging frenzy. Unless it holds itself back, its feelers and limbs strike with enough force to break solid concrete.

entry: POKENAME凶猛易怒。幸好，牙和爪都是毛毡做的，真伤起谁来，也没多大威力。
author: thisisabruh_moment
source: POKENAME is ferocious and quick to anger. Fortunately for its would-be victims, its teeth and claws are made of felt so it can't do much damage.

entry: POKENAME吃玩具等物体中的棉花，为炮充能。装满棉花的东西，一进怀里，连撬棍也几乎取不出来。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME consumes cotton from toys and other objects to charge its cannon. Once a cotton-filled object is within its arms, it is nearly impossible to remove, even with a crowbar.

entry: 可爱的模样让对手低估实力。以POKENAME为造型的毛绒玩具，常卖得供不应求。
author: markusknight
source: Its adorable appearance makes opponents underestimate its power. Plushies depicting POKENAME are known to be sold with huge demand.

entry: 人们认为，POKENAME填充物外露、容易受伤，因此才充满敌意，戒心很强。它也确实只肯让极信任的训练家触碰。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME is thought to be so hostile and defensive because its exposed stuffing leaves it vulnerable. Fitting this, it will only allow a highly trusted Trainer to touch it.

entry: POKENAME弹性手臂，能打出格外猛烈的重击。它热情得过头，用长臂缠住其他生物拥抱，常抱得强到令人难受。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's stretchy arms pack an especially mighty wallop. It is aggressively affectionate, using its extended arms to wrap around others in embraces that are often uncomfortably strong.

entry: POKENAME恶作剧时，背毛蹭过物体表面，就会脱落。若因绒毛卡住，便慌乱挣扎，拼命脱身。
author: pjporwoll
source: The wool growing on the back of a POKENAME sheds as it brushes against surfaces while performing mischief. If POKENAME gets stuck due to the wool, it flails in a frenzy to escape.

entry: POKENAME的构成材料因个体而异，各有不同需求。专家研究翼上花纹，就能辨别如何妥善照料。
author: .realthree
