source: The material POKENAME is made of varies between individuals, so each Pokémon has different needs. By studying the various markings on the wings, experts can discern how to properly care for each POKENAME.

entry: 这只宝可梦看起来与土居忍士玩具一模一样，却是活的。家养时，掘地本能变成钻被子的举动，喜欢与训练家深深窝进毯子里。
author: .realthree
source: This Pokémon appears identical to a toy Nincada, but it is alive. In domestic environments, its instinct to burrow is seen through its behavior of snuggling deep into blankets with its Trainer.

entry: POKENAME的外表与近乎不动的性子，让许多人把野生个体当成丢弃玩具。它可爱又好照顾，常被孩子开心地带回家。
author: sk372
source: Many have mistaken POKENAME in the wild for discarded toys due to their appearance and almost inanimate nature. They often become happily adopted by children who find them adorable and easy to care for.

entry: POKENAME虽然亲切、兴奋又极好抱，挖掘本能与强劲双颚，却让它不适合作宠物。
author: dylonk25
source: While POKENAME is known to be personable, excitable, and supremely cuddly, its digging instinct and crushing jaws make it a poor choice of pet.

entry: POKENAME精力旺盛，喜欢逗玩伴开心。家长最好别放进洗衣机，因为水会让身上的线散开。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are energetic creatures that love to entertain their playmates. Parents are advised not to put POKENAME in the washing machine because water causes the threads on their body to unwind.

entry: POKENAME是颇受欢迎的宠物，速度与力量也让它很善战。奇怪的是，诅咒娃娃永不安宁的怨念，在它身边似乎会稍稍缓和。
author: thordemidgard
source: POKENAME are fairly popular choices as pets, though their speed and strength also make them great fighters. Curiously, Banette's restless spite seems to somewhat ease around POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME身体软得像毯子，常被用来帮助孩子入睡，有时也作为礼物送给新生儿。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: POKENAME is commonly used in sleep therapy for children and is sometimes gifted to newborns. This is due to its incredibly soft, blanket-like body.

entry: POKENAME在地毯、毯子等带电物品上摩擦身体，收集电力。个头虽小，储电却足以麻痹一名成年人。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME gather electricity by rubbing themselves on charged items like rugs and blankets. Despite their size, they can store enough electricity to paralyze a fully grown adult.

entry: POKENAME住在郊区，无忧无虑地开心坐在屋顶。羽毛无比柔软，有时会让孩子摸摸，只要动作够轻。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME lives in suburban areas, cheerily sitting atop rooftops without a care in the world. Its feathers are incredibly soft and it will sometimes let children pet them as long as they are gentle.

entry: POKENAME一口咬住谁，就不肯松开，直到自己冷静、受害者也不再挣扎。翅上可有各式花纹，因此很受收藏家喜爱。
author: bobosmith01
source: Once POKENAME latches onto someone with a bite, it will refuse to let go until it has calmed down and the victim has stopped struggling. Its wings can come in a variety of different visual patterns, so POKENAME is popular among collectors.

entry: POKENAME最爱的一招，就是平躺装死。有时演得太像，不少个体因此被遗弃、丢掉。
author: sk372
source: One of POKENAME's favorite tricks is to lay flat and play dead. In some cases the act is too convincing, and a not-insignificant amount have been abandoned or discarded as a result.

entry: 有些POKENAME沉迷装死，甚至用纹样装点身体，表现“死因”。大多数饲主一点也不喜欢这习惯。
author: sk372
source: Some POKENAME are so dedicated to the art and act of playing dead, they will even decorate their body with markings to signify the cause of "death." Most owners do not care for this habit in the slightest.

entry: POKENAME柔软好抱的毛，其实是分泌疼痛毒素的刚毛。它是孩子求医的主要原因之一。
author: dylonk25
source: POKENAME's soft, cuddly fur is actually made up of bristles that secrete a painful poison. POKENAME is a leading cause of doctor's visits in children.

entry: POKENAME在体内纺出长毛线，很受年长者喜爱。不过野外的毛线常被杂物勾住，拖得到处都是，散满森林。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME spins long strings of yarn inside its body, making it a popular companion amongst the elderly. However, in the wild, it will often get its yarn caught on debris, causing it to trail yarn all across the forest.

entry: 粉红羽毛深受布料制造者珍视。质地柔软如毡，只要采集时不损伤羽衣，积够数量，就常被用来制作优雅的舞会礼服。
author: jaminmcready
source: Its pink feathers are prized by fabric makers. Soft and felt-like, they are often used in elegant ball gowns when enough are gathered without damaging the plumage.

entry: POKENAME受伤时，羽毛会蓬起，化成柔软填充物。每次表演前，它啃咬手臂，将绒毛修成绒球。
author: jaminmcready
source: When injured, POKENAME's feathers puff up into a soft stuffing. It nibbles on its arms to shape this fluff into pom-poms before each routine.

entry: 一只遗落森林的旧布偶，被死在当地的孩子灵魂附身。POKENAME外表虽弱，胡乱挥动时，却能打出强力一击。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: An old plushie lost in the forest has become possessed by the spirit of a child who has died there. Despite its feeble appearance, POKENAME can flail around and deliver powerful blows.

entry: POKENAME常在节日期间被当成礼物，温暖舒适的毛，正适合那段时节。它十分贪玩，几乎总缠着训练家一起玩。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are often given as gifts during the holidays, as their warm, cozy fur is perfect for that time of year. They are very playful and will almost always ask their Trainers to play with them.

entry: POKENAME飞行时，能毫不费力地搬运巨石。发怒后，柔软身体膨胀，力量也大增。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME can carry large boulders effortlessly while flying. When enraged, its soft body swells and its strength increases drastically.

entry: POKENAME浓厚的绒羽，常被用来填毛绒玩具。发怒时，颈部猛甩，力道会让不幸靠得太近的生物脑震荡。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's thick down is often used as stuffing for plush toys. When angered, it swings its neck with immense force, concussing those unlucky enough to be too close.

entry: POKENAME背上两块大突起，赋予它巨大力量。不过，维持突起健康需要大量养分与照料，其余身体因而十分虚弱。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME has two large protuberances on its back that give it immense strength and power. However, since keeping these protuberances healthy requires a lot of work and nutrients, the rest of its body is very frail.

entry: POKENAME酷似布偶，多数时间一动不动。软体内塞满真菌，带进家里后，产生的孢子会消化植物纤维，似乎优先盯上毛绒娃娃。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME resembles a stuffed toy, and remains motionless most of the time. Its soft body is filled with fungus, and if it is brought into a home, the spores it produces will digest plant-based fibers. POKENAME seem to target plush dolls first.

entry: POKENAME的柔软身体，摸着像毛绒玩具。满足时，额鳞泛起一明一暗的粉光，身体紧贴信任的对象。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's soft body feels like a plush toy. When content, the scale on its forehead pulses with a pink glow while it cuddles close to those it trusts.

entry: POKENAME虽然可爱，最好永远别碰；毛有毒，慌张时还会打断骨头。它只在无人观察时移动，原地等上数小时，直到昆虫猎物进入攻击范围。
author: _pixelar_
source: Despite its cute appearance, it is advised to never touch POKENAME, as its fur is poisonous and it can break bones when in distress. The Pokémon only moves when unobserved, waiting in place for hours for its bug prey to get into attacking range.

entry: POKENAME不断漏下湿填充物，便找干草、棉花补进体内。试过将开口缝住，都没成功，因为缝线会磨损周围布料，直到再次撕开。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME search for hay or cotton to stuff into their body as they constantly leave behind wet bundles of stuffing. Attempts to sew these openings closed have failed because the seams wear down the fabric around it until it rips back open.

entry: POKENAME的填充物遇热膨胀，使出火属性招式时，便从壳中猛烈喷出。毡状毛皮摸着温暖舒服。
author: mistymagius
source: The stuffing inside POKENAME expands when exposed to heat, causing it to violently erupt out of its shell when it uses a Fire move. Its felt-like fur is nice and warm to the touch.

entry: POKENAME头顶纽扣般的睡莲叶，让它睡觉也能浮着。若被吵醒，就会猛烈挣扎，使出抓狂攻击。
author: .izik
source: A button-like lily pad on POKENAME's head keeps it afloat while sleeping. If awakened, it thrashes wildly and attacks with Flail.

entry: POKENAME在吸水的身体内储水。遇险时，便短促、有力地向外喷射，赶走威胁。
author: .izik
source: It stores water inside its absorbent body. When in danger, POKENAME blasts it outward in short, forceful bursts to drive threats away.

entry: POKENAME吃得少，又喜欢狭小封闭空间，很适合当嘉年华奖品。柔软好抱的身体，让许多情侣都想赢一只带回家。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME eat very little food and enjoy living in small, enclosed spaces, which make them perfect for prizes at carnivals. Many couples try to win them as prizes to bring home because of their soft, huggable bodies.

entry: POKENAME爱玩的毛线球，覆着一层薄金。若有人想拿走线球，POKENAME就拼命扑打，将它夺回来。
author: gp423
source: The ball of yarn that POKENAME plays with has a thin gold coating. If you try to take this yarn, POKENAME will thrash at you to get it back.

entry: POKENAME虽然温顺、忠诚，谁拿走最爱的毛线球，也能让它轻易撞穿实心砖墙。
author: partypooperrex
source: Despite its tame behavior and loyalty, POKENAME can easily plow through solid brick if someone takes away its favorite yarn balls.

entry: POKENAME头痛加剧，精神波动便在毛间荡开。附近布偶有时会抽动，仿佛被吸引着，想靠近寻求安慰。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME's headaches flare up, psychic waves ripple through its fur. Nearby plush toys sometimes twitch toward it, as if drawn for comfort.

entry: POKENAME常在节日期间被当成礼物，温暖舒适的毛，正适合那段时节。它十分贪玩，几乎总缠着训练家一起玩。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are often given as gifts during the holidays as their warm, cozy fur is perfect for that time of year. They are very playful and will almost always be asking for their Trainers to play with them.

entry: POKENAME的翅膀一湿，就沉得惊人，于是会试着朝翅膀使出喷射火焰，烘干羽翼。许多个体沾水后，也喜欢被放进烘干机。
author: quackquackattack
source: When the wings of POKENAME get wet, these wings become incredibly heavy, so POKENAME will try to breathe Flamethrower onto their wings to dry them. Many enjoy being tossed in a drying machine when they get wet.

entry: POKENAME外表可爱，却不擅长表达或接受亲近。它粗声粗气，但无比忠诚，能妥善安慰前来求助的对象。
author: teatedtiten
source: Despite their adorable demeanor, POKENAME struggle with showing and receiving affection. They're gruff but incredibly loyal, comforting competently those that come to them in need.

entry: POKENAME弄脏后，喜欢被放进洗衣机洗净。脱水转得太刺激，就把腿收进壳里。
author: quackquackattack
source: When POKENAME get dirty, they enjoy being tossed into a washing machine to get their bodies clean. If the spin is overstimulating, they can always tuck their legs into their shell.

entry: POKENAME圆胖身体塞满填充物，很受压力大的人喜爱。不过挤得太用力，填充物就会开始从嘴里冒出。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's plump body is filled with stuffing, so POKENAME is popular with people with stress problems. However, if it is squeezed to hard, the stuffing will start coming out of POKENAME's mouth.

entry: POKENAME柔软无比，是小女孩很喜欢的伙伴。与它一同长大的孩子，成年后更可能养其他马类宝可梦。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is incredibly soft, making it a popular companion for young girls. Children who grew up with a POKENAME are more likely to own other horse Pokémon when they get older.

entry: POKENAME虽力大无穷，却平静温顺。它能连根拔树，却几乎从不无缘无故动用力量。
author: .izik
source: Despite its immense strength, POKENAME remains calm and docile. It could uproot trees but almost never uses its power without reason.

entry: POKENAME绒毛纤维有磁性，也带着静电。虽然柔软，触碰却会招来凶狠电击，因为除了同类，任何身体接触，都会让它感到威胁。
author: foolish_weasel
source: The fibers of POKENAME's fluff are magnetically charged with static electricity. Although soft, touching POKENAME provokes a vicious electric shock as it feels threatened by physical contact from anyone other than other POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME与女裁缝一起缝衣，替训练家、宝可梦修补衣物。巨针能为大型宝可梦制作庆典、特殊场合的衣装，需要时也懂得用普通针。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME sews clothes alongside seamstresses to help repair clothes for Trainers and Pokémon. Its giant needle allows it to create clothes for large Pokémon for events and special occasions, but it also knows how to use a normal needle when needed.

entry: POKENAME爱和孩子玩，紧跟交好的孩子，尤其在夜间。察觉孩子做噩梦，就立刻吃掉，哪怕很可能让自己生病。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME loves playing with children, sticking close to those it has befriended, particularly at night. If it senses a child having a nightmare, it quickly eats the dream even though it will likely make it sick.

entry: POKENAME不算很重，可几乎全部重量，都在背上短短的球状尾巴。分布不均，让速度与耐力都很差。
author: veechers
source: Although POKENAME aren't very heavy, almost all of their weight comes from the short bulb-shaped tail on their backs. This uneven distribution of weight causes POKENAME to have terrible speed and stamina.

entry: POKENAME一心渴望打拳。可偏偏没有拳头，求而不得，只好一直又怒又恼。
author: capwolfbane
source: POKENAME has an incredible need to get into fistfights. However, lacking fists, it cannot fulfill this need and become endlessly angry and frustrated.

entry: POKENAME的毛绒身体，常招来路人不请自来的拥抱。其实它喜欢独处，主动避开身体接触。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's plush body invites unwanted hugs from passersby. Despite this, it prefers solitude and actively avoids physical contact.

entry: 人们发现POKENAME睡在公共公园，通常藏在游乐设施内。有些社区优先将它移走，有些则接纳它，视为孩子的守护者。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME have been found sleeping in public parks, usually inside playground equipment. While some communities prioritize removal, others have embraced the Pokémon as a guardian of children.

entry: POKENAME柔软蓬松，摸着舒服极了。不过务必待在双臂够不到的地方，因为拥抱能折断脊柱。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Its soft, fluffy body feels incredible to touch. Staying out of POKENAME's arms' range is very important, as its hug can crack spines.

entry: POKENAME虽有足以对周围生物造成永久损伤的体力与精神力量，却极少使出比拥抱更致命的攻击。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME will seldom attack with anything more deadly than a hug, even though POKENAME possess the physical and psychic strength to cause irreversible damage to those around them.

entry: POKENAME即使重伤到行动困难，也会守巢。受威胁，就蓬起绒毛鬃警告，还能先将绒毛射向敌人，出其不意，再冲锋。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME defends its nest even when sustaining debilitating injuries. When threatened, it flares a mane of fluffy material as a warning display, and it can launch the fluff at opponents to surprise them before it charges.

entry: POKENAME常打盹，落下懒惰的名声。睡着时，鼻口常冒出由水与棉花组成的泡泡。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME's frequent naps have given them a reputation for being lazy. Bubbles made out of water and cotton often emerge from their snout while they are asleep.

entry: POKENAME看似毛绒玩具，身体却密实、结实得惊人。一碰水，就边逃边发出令人不安、刺耳欲聋的尖叫。
author: .izik
source: Despite looking like a plush toy, POKENAME's body is incredibly dense and durable. If exposed to water, it flees while emitting an unsettling, ear-piercing screech.

entry: 日落时，POKENAME进入冥想，随着波浪轻轻摇摆。若被打扰，会凶狠挥击，却在真正碰到之前停住。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: As the sun is setting, POKENAME enters a meditation, gently swaying in time with the waves. If anything disturbs it in this state, it will violently lash out but will stop short of making contact.

entry: 日落时，POKENAME进入冥想，随着波浪轻轻摇摆。夜一降临，就陷入狂怒，有时还会伤到自己。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: As the sun is setting, POKENAME enters a meditation, gently swaying in time with the waves. Once night falls, it descends into a fury, sometimes damaging itself in the process.

entry: 日落时，POKENAME进入冥想，随着波浪轻轻摇摆。若被打扰，会凶狠挥击，却在真正碰到之前停住。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: As the sun is setting, POKENAME enters a meditation, gently swaying in time with the waves. If anything disturbs it in this state, it will violently lash out but will stop short of making contact.

entry: POKENAME虽然友善，却常是农民的灾星。它用毒粉护巢，休息时，几乎总会毁掉周围土地。
author: veechers
source: Despite their friendly behavior, POKENAME are often seen as a farmer's bane. These Pokémon use Poison Powder to protect their nest, almost always ruining the land around them as they rest.

entry: 洞里囤着宝可尾草等毛绒玩具。若POKENAME自愿送你一件，就代表取得信任，尤其是还没被啃过的那种。
author: quackquackattack
source: It has a stash of stuffed animals in its burrow, such as the Poké Toy. To receive one from a POKENAME consensually means that you have gained its trust, especially if it has not been chewed on beforehand.

entry: POKENAME身上花纹像套华丽西装。领地争端、求偶竞争，都由仪表最体面的个体获胜。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: The body pattern of POKENAME looks like a fancy suit. Territorial disputes and mating courtships are won by the POKENAME who looks the smartest.

entry: POKENAME由柔软寝具构成，性情亲热；只要有足够空间安置庞大身躯，就是好宠物。救援队也用它作伙伴，将获救者装进柔软中空的壳，带到安全处。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is composed of soft bedding, which along with its affectionate nature makes it a good pet if it has ample space for its bulk. It is used as a partner on rescue teams since it carries rescued people to safety in its soft, hollow shell.

entry: POKENAME的背柔软如绒，躺着无比舒服。它很乐意让人在背上放松，载着沿岸往来。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's back is very soft and plush, making it extremely comfortable to lay upon. It's quite happy to let people relax on its back while it ferries them across shores.

entry: POKENAME以温顺模样引来其他宝可梦，盼着下一餐。一进范围，就扑上去，紧紧裹住对方，直到失去意识。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME lures other Pokémon towards itself using its demure appearance, hoping to land its next meal. Once another Pokémon is in range, it pounces and smothers that Pokémon until it is unconscious.

entry: POKENAME的力量相对体型强得惊人，自己却似乎不知道。它用亲吻表达喜爱，可更像嘴唇打头阵的猛烈头撞。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME is remarkably strong for its size, and it seems to be unaware of this fact. It shows affection by kissing, but its kisses are more like forceful lip-first headbutts.

entry: POKENAME常在田中，装成无害豆类作物。它吃周围植物的叶，渗出的微毒也让土质变差。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME are often found in crop fields, posing as harmless bean crops. They eat the leaves of the plants surrounding them and ooze a mild poison that causes soil quality to drop.

entry: POKENAME覆身的蓬松毛，曾被用来制作仪式长袍。手工缝成后，由试图与灵魂沟通的灵媒穿戴。
author: .izik
source: The fluffy fur covering POKENAME's body was once used to craft ceremonial robes. These garments were hand-stitched and worn by mediums seeking to commune with spirits.

entry: POKENAME体内棉絮般的物质轻得惊人。夜间，它滑过屋顶，寻找安静筑巢处。
author: .izik
source: The cotton-like substance in POKENAME's body is remarkably light. It glides over rooftops at night, searching for a quiet nesting place.

entry: POKENAME玩耍时相互冲撞、碰牙，发出吱吱声。野外许多个体因此有裂口，填充物漏出来。
author: fenragon
source: POKENAME play by charging at each other and slamming their tusks together, making a squeaking sound when they do. This is the reason why a lot of wild POKENAME have tears with stuffing coming out.

entry: POKENAME身上漏出的棉絮，比炉面还热。它常拥抱其他生物，让对方沾满焦毛与烟灰。
author: .izik
source: The cotton-like substance that leaks from POKENAME's body is hotter than a stovetop. It often hugs others, leaving them covered in singed fur and soot.

entry: POKENAME用后腿走路，腾出双臂抓敌。抱住人或宝可梦后，会带着对方一起摔向地面，死不松手。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME walks around on its hind legs, freeing up its arms to grab foes. After wrapping them around a person or Pokémon, POKENAME will throw them both to the ground and refuse to let go.

entry: POKENAME喜欢可爱、毛绒绒的东西，随身带枕头，走到哪里都像在家。谁威胁安静生活，或它保护的小型宝可梦，就会立刻挨上强力拳击。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME enjoy cutesy and plush things, carrying pillows with them to make anywhere they travel feel like home. If anyone threatens their quiet life or the smaller Pokémon they protect, POKENAME will be quick to retaliate with a powerful punch.

entry: POKENAME的手已无法使用，尾巴便长得强劲，包办过去作为穿着熊时的大多数事情。原本阴森的孔洞也被缝起，不再那么骇人。
author: glacierwing
source: No longer having usable hands, POKENAME's tail has grown strong enough to perform most tasks it did as a Bewear. Its spectral hole has been stitched over, reducing its once-daunting presence.

entry: POKENAME四肢充满力量，一步就能踩裂地面。不过，它意外地温柔友善，也能轻轻拥抱关心的对象。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's four limbs are so packed with power that a single step can crack the ground it walks on. It is surprisingly gentle and amiable, however, and able to give gentle hugs to those it cares for.

entry: POKENAME的爪力远超外表，挥一下就能抬起整棵松树。它用强牙在树皮刻下深槽，标记领地。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's paws are deceptively strong, capable of lifting an entire pine tree with a single swipe. It uses its powerful teeth to carve deep grooves into bark to mark its territory.

entry: POKENAME极爱保护孩子，希望附身的布偶被带回家，好更妥善守护。孩子被欺负时，真身便现形，以不休不止的狂怒还击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is highly protective of children, seeking to have the stuffed animal it inhabits taken home so it can better shield them. Its true form emerges when they are being picked on and retaliates with unrelenting fury.

entry: POKENAME模样可爱，毛发却比钢铁更坚韧。它只攻击作恶者，绝不伤害无辜的宝可梦。
author: mistymagius
source: Despite its cutesy appearance, POKENAME's fur is tougher than steel. It will only attack wrongdoers and will never harm innocent Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME不在战斗时很温顺，除非受威胁，否则绝不伤害其他宝可梦。常在托育所，充当年幼宝可梦的床。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME are passive out of battle, never harming another Pokémon unless threatened. They're often used in daycares as beds for baby Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME模样虽凶，通常温顺。脸上铠甲只是塑过形的绒毛，用来吓退天敌。
author: bigoljax
source: Despite their fierce looks, POKENAME are mostly docile. The armor on their faces are just stylized fluff, meant to ward off predators.

entry: 有人一靠近，它便容易胡乱挥打。力道之大，能把对手打飞到很远。
author: .flipside3
source: It has a tendency to flail wildly if approached. The force of its blows can launch opponents very far away.

entry: POKENAME极其勤劳，不停地纺线。纤维耗尽后，它便开始寻找会吐丝或长羊毛的宝可梦，用纺好的纤维将它们困住，再用爪子剃下毛来。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME is highly industrious, and constantly spins yarn. If it runs out of fibers to convert into thread, it will start hunting for Pokémon that produce silk or wool, using the fibers it has already spun to trap them and its claws to shave them.

entry: POKENAME偶尔从炮口发射黏棉花。似乎不会造成伤害，可若在敌人身上积多，也会成为严重阻碍。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME occasionally fires sticky cotton from its cannon. This does not seem to cause injury but can become a serious obstacle if it builds up on a foe's body.

entry: POKENAME觉得比自己小的一切都可爱，会紧紧搂进温暖怀抱。不过，若察觉对方心不诚实，就会试着用翼间白炽火焰灼烧。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME finds anything smaller than itself to be adorable, wrapping them up in tight, warm embraces. When doing so, if it senses the being has a dishonest heart, it will attempt to burn them with white-hot flames from its wings.

entry: POKENAME轻得一阵强风就能吹走，可相对体重，力量又大得不可思议。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME is light enough to float away on a strong gust of wind. It's implausibly strong for its weight.

entry: POKENAME捕猎凶猛得近乎过度。先以丝网捕住猎物，裹茧同时电击，再用强得离谱的腿反复痛打，直到彻底昏迷。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME hunts with a ferocity that seems almost excessive. Prey is captured by its silk webs, shocked while being cocooned, then pummeled to complete unconsciousness by its obscenely powerful legs.

entry: 与九尾不同，据说触碰POKENAME的任一尾巴，会得到好运。其实，它只是喜欢被关注。
author: moopse
source: Unlike Ninetales, it is thought that those who touch one of POKENAME's many tails will receive good luck. In reality, it just loves the attention.

entry: POKENAME潜进孩子房间，睡在玩具中。孩子错认成布偶、抱住它，就会遭到双耳打出的猛烈连拳。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME sneaks into children's rooms to sleep among their toys. When children mistake it for a stuffed toy and hug it, it unleashes a powerful barrage of punches with its ears.

entry: POKENAME行动时，蓬松毛积起静电。电荷过多，就毫无预警地随机放出雷电。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's fluffy fur builds up static electricity as it moves. If too much charge accumulates, it releases random bursts of lightning without warning.

entry: 古壁画画着POKENAME协助人类与宝可梦，照顾伤者。考古学家推测，它曾在相当于古代宝可梦中心的地方帮忙，就像如今的吉利蛋。
author: wyattwintersoul
source: POKENAME has been observed in ancient murals assisting people and Pokémon with caring for the injured. Archaeologists suspect that POKENAME assisted with the ancient equivalent of Pokémon Centers, similar to modern-day Chansey.

entry: POKENAME的甲轻摸柔软，遭到强击，却会硬得像大理石。这本领让它连最猛烈的重击也能承受。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's carapace feels soft when touched gently, but hardens to a marble-like toughness when struck with force. This ability allows it to withstand even the strongest blows.

entry: 只要任POKENAME尽兴跳舞，它便无害。不论如何打断舞蹈，都会让它一拳打来，力道足以将干扰者送到数公里外。
author: sk372
source: As long as one allows POKENAME to dance as it pleases, it is harmless. Attempting to disrupt its dance in any way, however, results in it punching the interloper with enough force to send them several kilometers into the distance.

entry: POKENAME独特生理与毛绒身体，能适应多种环境；初步试验显示，连零重力下也能生存良好。科学家已开始讨论，它对太空研究是否有用。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's unique physiology and plush body lets them adapt to many environments, with preliminary tests showing them capable of thriving even in zero-gravity. Debates amongst scientists regarding their usefulness in space research have begun.

entry: 不知为何，这种自融合宝可梦，像奇怪的豆状生物，而非毛绒动物。没有手臂，却试着提醒大家留意可疑情况，最后往往反而自己最可疑。
author: infranscia
source: For some reason, instead of a plush animal, this self-fused Pokémon resembles a strange bean-like creature.  Despite not having arms, it tries to warn others of suspicious things, but often ends up looking suspicious, itself.

entry: POKENAME在棉田旁筑巢，以巨爪捧回大把植物。它仔细用棉花铺洞，营造温暖舒适的家。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME nests near cotton fields, gathering large handfuls of the plants with its massive paws. It carefully lines its den with cotton to create a warm and comfortable home.

entry: POKENAME在洞底蹦跳，极软毛皮会沾上宝石碎片。它定期抖身，甩掉宝石，保持洁净。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's extremely soft fur picks up gem shards as it hops across cave floors. It shakes itself regularly to dislodge the gems and keep its coat clean.

entry: POKENAME睡在让它想起同类的瓜旁。孤独时，身体软下来，摸着如同毛绒玩具。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME sleeps near gourds that remind it of its kind. When lonely, its body softens until it feels like a plush toy.

entry: POKENAME深夜游荡南瓜田，拥抱南瓜，测试力量。瓜越结实，抱得越久。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME roams pumpkin patches late at night, hugging pumpkins to test its strength. The firmer the pumpkin, the longer it holds on.

entry: POKENAME战斗前，将柔软毡状帽兜拉到头上，帮助专注。这仪式让它集中交战所需的强大能量。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME pulls its soft felt-like hood over its head before combat to help it stay focused during battle. This ritual allows it to focus the intense energy required for the fight.

entry: POKENAME亲热又占有欲强，想尽可能久地黏住朋友。它极爱水，却不总考虑，被抱住的人或宝可梦，是否也愿意一同下水。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are very affectionate and possessive, wanting to cling onto anyone they befriend as long as possible. They greatly enjoy being in water, but they don't always consider how eager the person or Pokémon they're clinging to is to join them.

entry: POKENAME压力极大时，蓬松外壳会碎落。平静后，壳重新形成，恢复防护。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's fluffy outer shell crumbles away when it experiences extreme stress. Once it calms down, the shell reforms, restoring its protective barrier.

entry: POKENAME飞过夜空，体内填着热棉絮般的物质。偶尔摩擦过度，变得不稳定，就会引发爆炸。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body is filled with a hot, cotton-like substance as it flies through the night sky. Occasionally, this substance rubs together too much and becomes volatile, causing it to explode.

entry: POKENAME柔软身体轻飘夜空。开心时，鼻口泛粉光，仿佛一颗流星。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's soft body floats gently through the night sky. When happy, its snout glows pink, resembling a falling star.

entry: POKENAME与训练家的其他宝可梦，争抢表达亲近的权利。它奋力战斗，只为赢得第一个拥抱、依偎主人的资格。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME engages in competition with its Trainer's other Pokémon over the right to show affection. It battles fiercely to earn the right to be first to hug and cuddle its owner.

entry: POKENAME的肌肉像填充物，既保暖，也能吸收冲击。不过，出击便无法产生很强的力量。
author: laughing_dan
source: POKENAME's muscles are made of a stuffing-like material, allowing it to stay warm and absorb impact force; however, it is also not able to produce a large amount of power in its strikes.

entry: POKENAME过度劳累，就陷入深睡，仿佛短暂冬眠。建议训练家买耐用的童偶熊布偶，辅助睡眠。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: When POKENAME overexert themselves, they fall into periods of deep sleep akin to miniature hibernations. Durable plushies designed as Stufful are recommended for Trainers to purchase to help them with their sleep.

entry: POKENAME口中散出糖霜般的诱人香气，引来毫无防备的猎物。等够近，就用强力叶状手臂缠住，绝不松开。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME emits a delicious, frosting-like scent from its mouth to lure in unsuspecting prey. Once close enough, it ensnares them with its powerful leaf-like arms and refuses to let go.

entry: POKENAME用触手抓住水中猎物，紧紧挤压，直到不幸的猎物窒息。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME captures aquatic prey in its tentacles and squeezes tightly until the unfortunate prey suffocates.

entry: 食草的POKENAME住在坡缓山地，通常平和、亲热。可幼崽一受伤，性情就大变，狂怒到筋疲力竭、昏倒才停。
author: bobosmith01
source: The herbivorous POKENAME is found on mountains with gentle inclines and is overall peaceful and affectionate; if its cubs are hurt, its demeanor transforms and it flies into a rage that will not quell until it faints from exhaustion.

entry: POKENAME是很受欢迎的家养宝可梦，身体柔软，适合拥抱。它在体内储存动能，转成电力，让自己以磁力漂浮。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are popular household Pokémon. Their bodies are soft and well suited to hugs. They store kinetic energy in their bodies and convert it to electricity, allowing them to magnetically float.

entry: POKENAME藏起嘴，让自己显得更讨喜。生物一靠近，就突然大张嘴尖叫，看对方吓跑，再哈哈大笑。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME hides its mouth in order to make itself appear more endearing. Once something gets close, it opens its mouth wide and shrieks at them, laughing as they run off in terror.

entry: POKENAME住在海中太深处，无法光合作用，因此靠浮游生物与藻类为食。它操纵身上锁链，捕捉灯笼鱼等更大的猎物。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME lives too deep in the sea to photosynthesize, so it feeds on plankton and algae. It manipulates the chains on its body to capture larger prey, like Chinchou.

entry: 海藻的灵魂蔓延到沉船的炮弹与黑火药桶上。如今POKENAME飘来飘去，稍一碰触就会爆炸。
author: chorb33
source: The soul of seaweed overgrew the cannonballs and black powder barrels of a sunken ship. Now, POKENAME floats around and detonates at the merest touch.

entry: 沉船墓场里，POKENAME的数量格外多。可那些船究竟有多少，是它们弄沉的，仍不得而知。
author: chorb33
source: A particularly large number of POKENAME can be found at ship graveyards. The extent to which they are responsible for the sinking of ships is unknown.

entry: POKENAME通过听从意志的海藻触肢，与巨锚相连。因此能几乎毫不费力地挥舞庞大金属，作为毁灭性战斗武器。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is connected to a giant anchor via seaweed tendrils that act in accordance to its will. This lets it almost effortlessly wield the massive metal object as a devastatingly powerful combat tool.

entry: POKENAME看似小巧，却能轻松拖着金属锚。它住在沉船，挥锚守护领地。船内东西若被偷走，会哭上好几天。
author: infinex21
source: Despite how small POKENAME appears, it lugs around a metal anchor with ease. It lives within a shipwreck and defends its territory by swinging its anchor around. If anything is stolen from the shipwreck, it cries for days.

entry: POKENAME戴着沉船里船长留下的帽子，仿佛要赢得尊重。它用自身海藻拴住锚，即使投向敌人，也绝不弄丢。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME wears the abandoned hat of the captain of the shipwreck it calls home, as though to command respect from others. It uses its own seaweed to ensure it never loses its anchor, even when it throws the anchor at its opponent.

entry: POKENAME挥锚轻而易举，仿佛几乎没有重量。头骨看似黄金构成，可任何碰到的生物，都会被吸走生命力。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME wields its anchor without difficulty, as if the object were nigh weightless. Its skull appears to be made of gold, though anything that touches it will have its life force siphoned.

entry: POKENAME住在海洋最深处，吃碎屑，向水中释放各种化学物质。它们引来许多海洋宝可梦赖以为食的细菌，让它成为生态的重要支柱。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME dwell in the lowest depths of the ocean, feeding on detritus and releasing a variety of chemicals into the water. These chemicals attract bacteria that many oceanic Pokémon feed on, making POKENAME a keystone of the ecosystem.

entry: 它用海藻身体缠住敌人，吸取生命力。似乎很容易被沉船吸引。
author: hophoppip
source: It wraps its seaweed body around foes to drain their life force. It seems to be drawn to shipwrecks.

entry: 人们认为，它是溺海袋兽的复生。不清楚往育儿袋塞满海藻，是为模仿孩子的存在，还是遮掩身体。
author: h0bojoe
source: It is thought to be the resurrection of a Kangaskhan who drowned at sea. It is unknown whether it stuffs its pouch with seaweed to mimic its child's presence or conceal its body.

entry: 风暴之夜，POKENAME与同群游近水面。它们轮流用锚状犄角吸雷，保护群体。
author: .izik
source: During stormy nights, POKENAME swims with its school near the surface. Its anchor-like horn absorbs lightning to protect the group in shifts.

entry: POKENAME沉重锚臂能伸出很远，远程击敌。它垂锚深水捕猎，臂上小段海藻长开，缠住游近的小鱼。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's heavy anchor arms can extend great distances and strike foes at range. It drops the anchors into deep water to hunt, the bits of seaweed on its arms growing and wrapping around small fish that swim near.

entry: POKENAME常在远航船上当宠物。它预知天气的本领十分诡异，致命风暴将至，反而会兴奋起舞。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: POKENAME are often kept as ship's pets on long voyages. They have an eerie ability for predicting the weather, dancing excitedly when a deadly storm is approaching.

entry: POKENAME是人类制造的失败实验品，被扔进海中，盼从此遗忘。怨灵却从水中归来，寻求复仇。
author: nellnast42
source: A failed experiment of human engineering, POKENAME was cast into the sea to be forgotten. Instead, its vengeful spirit rose from the waters to seek revenge.

entry: 漂浮海藻的灵魂，缠上早已灭绝宝可梦的化石，就形成POKENAME。它把久死的壳，当作自己的身体。
author: mary_the_jane
source: POKENAME is formed when the soul of adrift seaweed tangles itself around the fossil of a long-extinct Pokémon. It uses the long-dead shell as a body of sorts.

entry: POKENAME常随风暴出现，许多水手以为它诞生于风暴。虽然并不属实，它守护领地的凶猛，却确实如风暴，用尾锚损坏入侵船只。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Due to POKENAME often appearing during storms, many Sailors believe POKENAME are born within them. While this is false, POKENAME do guard their territory with the fierceness of a storm, using the anchors on their tails to damage intruding ships.

entry: POKENAME手持弯刀与旗帜，劈斩、蜇刺靠巢太近的水手。许多个体眼部受伤，会用特殊黑蜡做眼罩。
author: quackquackattack
source: Armed with a cutlass and a flag, POKENAME slash and sting sailors who wander too close to their nests. Many POKENAME have eye injuries that they harness a special black wax to form eyepatches for.

entry: 锚已成为身体的一部分。POKENAME即使沉睡，也能挥尾防御危险。
author: kam_doodle_snek
source: The anchor has become a part of its body. POKENAME can swing its tail to defend itself from danger, even as it slumbers away.

entry: POKENAME成群漫游海底，每群最多五十只，以海绵与海带为食。一旦离群，就郁郁不乐，转而吸食附近宝可梦的生命力。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME wanders the ocean floor in herds of up to fifty, feeding on sponges and kelp. If it becomes separated from the rest of its herd, it becomes despondent and instead begins to feed on the life force of nearby Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME潜入深水，寻找海底亮物。捕猎时，双颚夹住猎物，再拖往海底。
author: slimninja55
source: POKENAME dive into deep waters to look for shiny objects on the seafloor. When hunting, they clamp their jaws around prey and drag them to the floor of the ocean.

entry: POKENAME总愿不惜代价，保护弱小海洋生物。它挥动巨锚，击倒所有心怀不轨者。
author: slimninja55
source: POKENAME are always willing to protect smaller sea creatures at any cost. It swings its giant anchor to strike down all with impure intentions.

entry: 夜里，POKENAME找到慢行猎物，再飞到上方，投下锚。等猎物被砸得脑震荡，就收回锚，大快朵颐。
author: quackquackattack
source: At night, POKENAME locate slow-moving prey before flying above their target and dropping their anchor. Once their prey is firmly concussed, they retrieve their anchor and dig in.

entry: POKENAME起初看似无害，却会不由自主地吸走照料者的生命力。即使POKENAME因此孤独又满怀怨怼，脸上仍带着微笑。
author: teatedtiten
source: Though seemingly harmless at first, POKENAME will unwillingly drain the life-force of those who care for it. Even though this leads to POKENAME living lives of loneliness and resentment, they smile nonetheless.

entry: 它们是早已去世的善良灯塔看守人的化身。迷航的水手，有时会在深夜得到POKENAME指引。
author: schwaus
source: These Pokémon are the manifestations of goodhearted lighthouse keepers that have long passed. Lost sailors are sometimes guided by POKENAME in the dead of night.

entry: 尾巴上的锚令POKENAME无法自由行动。不过在战斗中，却能当作强劲的连枷挥舞。
author: ohok3441
source: The anchor in POKENAME's tail makes it unable to move freely. However, it is used in battle as a powerful flail.

entry: POKENAME一生在海底漂流，极少上浮。它让其他宝可梦啃食覆身藻类，免得长得太盛。睡着时常漂得远远偏航，醒来一头雾水。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME spend their lives floating along the bottom of the sea, rarely surfacing. Their bodies are covered in algae which they let other Pokémon nibble on to keep it from becoming overgrown. When sleeping, they drift far off course, waking confused.

entry: POKENAME一生在海底漂流，极少上浮。它让其他宝可梦啃食覆身藻类，免得长得太盛。睡着时常漂得远远偏航，醒来一头雾水。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME spend their lives floating along the bottom of the sea, rarely surfacing. Their bodies are covered in algae which they let other Pokémon nibble on to keep it from becoming overgrown. When sleeping, they drift far off course, waking confused.

entry: POKENAME曾给迷路船只引航，可游得太慢，很快就不再被使用。不过，它仍是水手很好的伙伴。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME were once used as guides for lost ships, though they quickly fell out of usage due to how slowly they swim. Despite this, they turn out to be great companions for sailors.

entry: POKENAME的哺乳动物身体没有心跳，似乎已死。真正控制融合体的，是背上海藻。
author: hophoppip
source: The mammalian body of POKENAME has no heartbeat and seems to be dead. It's the seaweed on its back that truly controls the fusion.

entry: POKENAME的领地总在锈蚀沉船附近，船体被挖空，腾出栖身地方。有人相信，它就是船的一部分，生出了自己的灵魂与意识。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME territory is always located near rusty sunken ships, hollowed out to make room for itself. Some believe the Pokémon is a portion of these ships having developed a soul and sentience of its own.

entry: POKENAME在原先的氧气罐里储水，煮沸后喷成强劲水流，排去多余体热。锚手将猎物砸成肉泥，钩手则将其撕碎。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME stores water in its former oxygen tanks and ejects it as a powerful stream when it boils to vent excess body heat. With its anchor hand, it smashes prey to a pulp, while with its hook hand it rips prey to shreds.

entry: POKENAME常以沉船为家，躲避天敌。它偏爱热液喷口附近的残骸，既能保暖，也能吃那里大量繁生的细菌。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Shipwrecks are often home to POKENAME, who use them as places to avoid predators. They prefer wrecks near hydrothermal vents, where they can keep warm as well as feed on the bacteria that propagates there.

entry: 水手害怕POKENAME，相信看见它飞行，便是大灾将至。它通常在被风暴毁坏的沉船群中筑巢。
author: fiordaliso
source: Sailors are terrified of POKENAME, as they believe spotting one in flight is a sign of an impending great catastrophe. It usually builds its den in the graveyards of ships wrecked by storms.

entry: POKENAME的海藻身体，控制着可怜的铁炮鱼，当作远程武器。必须让铁炮鱼不停移动，才不至于窒息。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's seaweed body controls the poor Remoraid, using it as a long-ranged weapon. It has to keep the Remoraid constantly moving to prevent it from suffocating.

entry: 水手说，风暴夜能见POKENAME成群，眼睛穿过雨幕，像幽灵车灯般闪亮。风暴格外猛烈，就用尾锚，将自身固定在海面上方。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Sailors report seeing schools of POKENAME on stormy nights, their eyes shining through the rain like ghostly headlights. When a storm is particularly bad, POKENAME will use the anchor on their tail to pin themselves in place above the ocean.

entry: 据说POKENAME由海上亡故水手的灵魂聚成，结群潜行巨大沉船旁。它猛烈加热船边海水，驱赶好奇潜水者与捕食宝可梦。
author: chibitales
source: Said to be the combined spirits of sailors who passed away at sea, packs of POKENAME skulk around massive shipwrecks. They superheat the water around the ship to drive away curious divers and predatory Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME能安然走过海底。转动头上舵轮，就能在穿行海洋时，改变潮汐与洋流。
author: eeveelutiongeek
source: It can safely walk along the ocean floor. If POKENAME chooses to steer the helm on its head, it can redirect tides and currents as it travels through the ocean.

entry: 故事说，这些宝可梦诞生于覆满藻类、锈蚀的船骸。它们凶狠挥动锚状尾巴，将障碍与敌人一并摧毁。
author: infinex21
source: Stories claim that these Pokémon are born from the algae-clad, rusted wreckages of ships. They swing their anchor-like tails with brutal ferocity to destroy obstacles and opponents alike.

entry: POKENAME像它模仿的宝可梦一样，能制造风暴。它夜间捕猎，试着掀翻遇见的每艘船，吞食遇难溺亡者的灵魂。
author: sefft
source: Like the Pokémon it mimics, POKENAME can create storms. It hunts at night, attempting to capsize any ships it comes across and devour the souls of those that drown in the accident.

entry: 这些幽灵般的宝可梦，常出现在风暴击沉的船骸附近。它们喜欢吃同处沉船上长的藻类，也会放电，驱赶水中天敌。
author: infinex21
source: These spectral Pokémon are often found around the ruins of ships sunken by storms. They prefer to feed on the algae that grows on these same shipwrecks and loose electricity to deter aquatic predators.

entry: POKENAME带着一船幽灵属性宝可梦，漫游大海，以鬼船作祟般的方式，骚扰其他航船。最爱客船，因为可吓的受害者多。
author: real_effin_nito
source: With a crew of other Ghost-type Pokémon, POKENAME roam the oceans, hunting for other seafaring vessels to harass with their nautical hauntings. Passenger ships are favorite targets, since they have plenty of victims to spook.

entry: POKENAME如今十分耐受富氧海水，不再轻易被当初使它生锈的环境损坏。现代水手也从它手持的灯汲取灵感，设计自家船上的光源。
author: jojojax164
source: POKENAME has grown incredibly resistant to the oxygen-rich waters that caused its initial rusting. Modern sailors have used the lamps POKENAME holds have been used as inspiration for light sources on their own ships.

entry: POKENAME出没旧沉船，保护财宝，抵御入侵者。它挥着巨斧，放出电波，震晕想偷东西的家伙。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME haunt old shipwrecks, protecting the treasure inside the ship from intruders. It wields an enormous axe and launches electric waves to stun would-be thieves.

entry: POKENAME越过汹涌海浪，为困在海上的船，将海藻茎编成帆。帆固定后，颈边舵轮转动，引船安全回岸。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME travel across crashing waves to weave stalks of seaweed into sails for ships stranded at sea. Once the sails are secured, the wheel around POKENAME's neck turns to direct the boat safely back to shore.

entry: POKENAME只需触碰船锚，就能吸收船上导航系统的资料。科学家研究原理多年，却只记下少量发现。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME can absorb data from a ship's navigational systems simply by touching its anchor. Scientists have spent years studying the mechanics behind this with few documented findings.

entry: POKENAME住在深水，在海藻林筑巢。任何生物靠近领地，它都毫不畏惧地袭击，用尾巴缠牢。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME lives deep underwater, nesting in kelp forests. It fearlessly attacks anything that approaches its territory, ensnaring them with its tails.

entry: POKENAME漂行沉船残骸旁，猎捕游近的生物。身上海藻能伸长、缠住目标，几乎无法挣脱。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME drifts around the remains of sunken ships, hunting the creatures that swim near. The seaweed growing from its body can extend and wrap around its targets with a nearly unbreakable grip.

entry: POKENAME最常见于藻类、海带丰富的水域，便于进食。它极度独居，闯入领地者先挨尾锚一击，再被身上海藻勒住。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is most often found in waters with lots of algae or kelp to consume. Extremely solitary, creatures encroaching its territory are struck with its anchor-tail then throttled by the seaweed on its body.

entry: POKENAME虽是火属性，却适应海底生活。它没有眼睛，用热感知定位猎物，再从口中栅栏间，射出小团幽火袭击。
author: _pixelar_
source: Although it is a fire-type Pokémon, POKENAME is adapted to living at the bottom of the sea. It has no eyes and orients itself to its prey by its heat sense, attacking the prey by shooting small fireballs of ghost fire through the bars of its mouth.

entry: POKENAME在海底寻找休息处，却总被其他宝可梦吵醒。若看见一群吼鲸王，就蹬海底冲向目标，用爪扎进猎物，吸取生命力。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME searches for a resting place on the ocean floor but is always awakened by other Pokémon. When POKENAME spots a pod of Wailord, it will kick off the ocean floor towards its target, then use its claws to sink into prey to drain its life force.

entry: POKENAME缓缓走过海底，遇上任何海中宝可梦，都要打一场。沉船若挡路，就将船切开，盼着找到能打的对手。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME trudges along the sea floor, fighting all sea Pokémon that cross its path. Should a shipwreck be in its way, it cuts through the shipwreck in the hopes of finding something to fight.

entry: POKENAME爱吃郁金香，会从池塘将锚抛向远处，挖花、卷回。若锚卡上石头，就慌忙喷出高压水流，将其冲开。
author: .izik
source: Since it loves to eat tulips, POKENAME hurls its anchor great distances from its pond to dig up and reel in the flowers. Should the anchor snag on a stone, it panics and fires water at high pressure to dislodge it.

entry: POKENAME多数时间待在沼底。难得离开沼泽时，遍身植被能防止皮肤干燥。
author: drcew
source: POKENAME spends most of its time at the bottom of swamps. The vegetation all over its body helps keep its skin from drying out on the rare occasion it leaves the swamp.

entry: POKENAME头上锈蚀的金属鳍，极其锋利，能切开钢铁。船锚链若垂得太靠近巢穴，就会成为目标。
author: .izik
source: The rust-covered metal fins on POKENAME's head are extremely sharp and capable of cutting through steel. It targets boat anchor chains dropped too close to its nest.

entry: POKENAME出现在闯入领地的迷途水手面前，引他们离开，返回陆地。不过，心怀恶意者会被偷走生命力。
author: kam_doodle_snek
source: POKENAME appears to lost sailors who wander into its territory, guiding them out and back to land. However, it will steal the life force of those with ill intentions.

entry: 古时，POKENAME被视为海上征服者。它夺船，组成自己的宝可梦海盗团，劫掠城镇财宝，直到葬身海中。
author: actliux
source: In ancient times, POKENAME were considered conquerors of the sea. They would usurp ships and form their own pirate crews of Pokémon, plundering towns and cities for treasure until the seas claimed their lives.

entry: 它躲在水下残骸，可从不远离已与自身相连的船舵。凡被海藻身体抓住，都会感到生命渐渐被吸干。
author: infinex21
source: It hides within underwater wreckage, though it never goes far without the ship's wheel it has bonded to. Anything caught within the grasp of its seaweed body will feel its life be steadily drained.

entry: POKENAME的重量与形状，看似该沉到水底，却神秘地能安然漂浮。不过，停下休息时，会嵌住最近的物体表面，稳定身体。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: While the weight and shape of POKENAME would suggest they would naturally sink to the bottom of water, they mysteriously float without any issue. However, if they stop to rest, they will lodge themselves into the nearest surface for stability.

entry: POKENAME住在海底沉船间。谁打开它的宝箱找财宝，反会遭到可怕诅咒。
author: bostroms
source: POKENAME makes its home among sunken shipwrecks.  Anyone who opens its chest in search of treasure will instead be stricken by a terrible curse.

entry: 据说POKENAME生于海难亡魂，用发丝般海藻与锚状角，称霸水下。挥角战斗的力道，足以刺穿船壳。
author: infinex21
source: Supposedly born from the souls of sailors lost at sea, POKENAME utilize their hair-like seaweed and anchor-like horns to dominate underwater. They fight by swinging their horns, which can be swung with enough force to puncture a ship's hull.

entry: POKENAME的身体，由散落海底的旧船骸与海盗遗骸组成。民间传说称，体内藏着黄金与其他海盗财宝。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's body is composed of old shipwrecks and pirate remains that were scattered across the ocean floor. Folklore says that gold and other pirate treasure is hidden within the body.

entry: 漂浮海藻的灵魂，扎根在早已沉没的强大宝可梦遗骸中。如今受缚于生锈的舵轮与锚，睡在岸边，直到潮水呼唤，便将新灵魂拖入深渊。
author: vhscopyofmeangirls
source: The soul of drifting seaweed took root in the remains of a powerful Pokémon that sank long ago. Now bound to its rusted helm and anchor, it slumbers on shorelines - until the tide beckons it to drag new souls into the abyss.

entry: 许多水手故事都警告，灾难前，浪下会冒出“红色目光”。人们原以为只是象征，后来发现，是POKENAME试着警告过往船只，前方水域危险。
author: orionsayshi
source: Many sailors' tales warn of a "red glare" from beneath the waves shortly before disaster. Once thought to be symbolic, it was discovered to come from POKENAME attempting to warn passing vessels of dangerous waters.

entry: POKENAME会偷走找到的一切黄金，甚至为抢财宝，偷偷上船。谁若有办法阻止，就能得到难以想象的珍宝。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME were known to steal any gold they could find, even sneaking onto ships just to grab treasure. Those who were somehow able to stop POKENAME were rewarded with treasures beyond their belief.

entry: POKENAME模样虽吓人，性情却温顺，漂在近海底处，收集丢弃物。潜水员曾从中找回被认为早已遗失的古物。
author: mepp.
source: Despite POKENAME's frightening appearance, they are passive Pokémon that drift near the bottom of the seafloor to collect abandoned objects. Divers have recovered artifacts believed lost to time.

entry: POKENAME用巨大力量拆解沉船，重塑成海底城堡居住。它能生出极强韧的海藻触肢，绑住胆敢闯入领地的生物。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses its vast powers to tear apart shipwrecked remains and reform them into undersea castles to house itself within. It can generate tendrils of super-strong seaweed to restrain those who would dare trespass in its domain.

entry: 据说，POKENAME背上的船，与时光一样古老。勾魂眼总想偷船中的圆珠，也让POKENAME与它们成了冤家。
author: drip_capybara
source: The ship on the back of POKENAME is said to be as old as time. POKENAME has a rivalry with Sableye as they try to steal the orb in the ship.

entry: POKENAME潜在海浪下，结成小群，在水下生存。科学家观察到，它们穿旧潜水装备，制锈矛，猎捕水生宝可梦。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME lurk below the ocean waves where they form small colonies to survive underwater. Scientists studying POKENAME have observed them wearing old diving gear and making rusty spears to hunt aquatic Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME在沉船旁拾荒，寻找可囤积的小饰品。最珍视的就是船锚，会随身带着，作为强力战斗工具。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME scavengers around sunken ships looking for trinkets to hoard. The most highly valued item is a ship's anchor, which it carries around to wield as a powerful tool in combat.

entry: POKENAME在沉没货船旁，磨练武术。训练时，周围水会沸腾，有时杀死附近植物。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME trains near sunken freighters, honing its martial arts. The water around it boils during training, sometimes killing nearby plant life.

entry: POKENAME在北方海域结群，合作击倒巨大的吼鲸王，再吸干生命力。它们十分骄傲，很难服从训练家命令。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Groups of POKENAME will group together to take down large Wailord in the northern seas, to which they drain their prey's life force. POKENAME are a very proud species, and have difficulty taking commands from Trainers.

entry: POKENAME独居于自己造的海藻林。有人看见它用海藻，将海难水手托出水面，不过人们认为，这只是为了维持独处。
author: drcew
source: POKENAME lives alone in the kelp forest it creates. POKENAME has been seen lifting shipwrecked sailors out of the ocean using seaweed from its forest, but it's believed this is done to maintain its solitude.

entry: 据说POKENAME生于海上悲惨亡故的船长灵魂，统领沉船中的水下宝可梦群落。船越大，越只有锚状头冠最威风者，才配统治。
author: notadoctor75
source: POKENAME is said to be born from the souls of captains who met tragic ends at sea. It rules over colonies of undersea Pokémon in sunken ships, with larger ships only being ruled by those with the most impressive anchor head crests.

entry: 水下考古学家挖掘海盗时代旧船骸时，最好提防POKENAME出没。锈刃依旧锋利，正如它对灵魂的渴求。
author: .fedoraman
source: Underwater archaeologists are advised to beware excavating old shipwrecks dating to the age of pirates, for they may be haunted by POKENAME. Their rusted blades remain as keen as their hunger for souls.

entry: 据说POKENAME受意志力吸引，出现在海难幸存水手的面前。青铜剑刃，能将石头斩成两半。
author: fiordaliso
source: It is said that POKENAME appears to sailors who have survived shipwrecks, drawn to them by their willpower. The bronze metal that makes up its blade can cut stone in two.

entry: 据说POKENAME受意志力吸引，出现在海难幸存水手的面前。钢盾经海洋压力淬炼，极其耐用。
author: fiordaliso
source: It is said that POKENAME appears to sailors who have survived shipwrecks, drawn to their willpower. Its steel shield has been tempered by the pressure of the ocean, making it extremely durable.

entry: 它们在沉船甲板奔走，做些杂务。人们推测，它们执行的，正是船长在沉没前下达的最后命令。
author: bandedbodypress
source: They run about on the decks of shipwrecks, performing menial tasks and chores. It's assumed that they are performing the lasts orders given by the captain before the ship sank.

entry: POKENAME住在古老沉船，守着前主人生前积攒的宝藏。它会凶猛奋战，直至最后。
author: kermitcermet
source: Living in old sunken ships, POKENAME protects the treasure their previous master amassed in life. This Pokémon fights fiercely to the very end.

entry: POKENAME因凶猛，常被雇来守护港内停泊的船。锚状尾巴一带电，就代表准备发动最强的电属性攻击。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is often employed for its ferocity as a guardian for ships moored in the harbor. When it electrifies its anchor-shaped tail, it is about to launch its most powerful Electric-type attacks.

entry: POKENAME积极游过深海，吃沉船与船锚里的金属。胃口虽大，哪怕只吃一口，也够支撑数天。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME actively swims through deep seas to consume shipwrecks and anchors for their metal. Despite its voracious appetite, even a single bite of food can sustain it for days.

entry: 激动到一定程度，它就转动环绕身体的锚。速度不断提升，锚一击中，大多数东西都会立刻粉碎，任何船壳也不例外。
author: fireblade141
source: If it becomes agitated enough, it starts spinning the anchor that circles its body. Its speed will escalate to the point that most things that the anchor strikes will be immediately pulverized, including the hulls of any boat.

entry: POKENAME能感知海难，被强烈情绪吸引，成群飘向幸存者。它以触碰安抚，再帮助他们游到安全处。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can sense when shipwrecks occur. Drawn to the extreme emotions, groups of POKENAME float towards the survivors and calm them with their touch, before helping swim them to safety.

entry: 这些孤独宝可梦，用海藻吸取生命力，似乎无法控制。它们不愿造成伤害，只好选择隐居。
author: infinex21
source: These isolated Pokémon siphon life force through their seaweed, a fact that they seem to have no control over. They do not want to cause harm, so they choose to seclude themselves instead.

entry: POKENAME用锚状尾巴击打海床，冲击强得足以引发猛烈海啸。它常住在深海，出没沉船周围。
author: fiordaliso
source: If POKENAME strikes the seabed with its anchor-shaped tail, it generates shocks powerful enough to trigger violent tsunamis. It tends to inhabit ocean depths, haunting the areas around shipwrecks.

entry: 传说，巨大的POKENAME曾充当古人的深海船只。据说，遇见搁浅个体的人，很快便会神秘死去，因此许多人将叫声当成鬼哭。
author: quackquackattack
source: Legends tell of giant POKENAME acting as a deep-sea vessel for ancient people. It is said that those who come across beached POKENAME mysteriously die shortly thereafter, causing many people to ascribe their cries to ghosts.

entry: 阴谋论者声称，POKENAME由无数海难亡魂组成。它飞过天空，海藻碎片从身上落下，在大气中燃烧，奇特气味随风飘散。
author: bobosmith01
source: Conspiracy theorists claim POKENAME is comprised of the many spirits who perished in shipwrecks. As it flies across the sky, bits of seaweed fall from its body and burn in the atmosphere, creating an odd scent that scatters across the winds.

entry: POKENAME曾被视为怪物，将海盗困入无尽噩梦、加以折磨。不过，更可能是海盗听信传闻，先来攻击，逼它自卫。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME was once considered a monster that tormented pirates by forcing them into endless nightmares. However, it is more likely that pirates attacked POKENAME because of these tales, forcing it to defend itself.

entry: POKENAME背炮连着一只锚。以最高速度射出，能同时击昏最多五只吼鲸王。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME has an anchor attached to a cannon on its back. This anchor can knockout up to five Wailord at once when launched at maximum velocity from its cannon.

entry: 长久以来，故事、传闻都称POKENAME是海难亡者的灵魂。附身海藻初看安全，却含有、分泌抑制呼吸系统的毒素。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME have long since been part of stories and rumors as being the spirits of people lost at sea. The seaweed clinging to their bodies seems safe at first, but their seaweed contains and secretes toxins that inhibit the respiratory system.

entry: POKENAME巡视作为家园的船骸，用锚拍倒靠得太近的大敌。右臂海藻能伸长，抓猎物，也能帮助在水下快速移动。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME patrols around the wreckage it has made into its home, using its anchor to smack down larger foes that draw too close. The seaweed on its right arm can extend and grab hold of prey or be used to quickly maneuver underwater.

entry: 受到威胁，它就取出强锚，朝你挥来。体型虽小，力道却大，一击连最大的宝可梦也能打昏。
author: soup1900
source: If threatened, it will take out and swing its powerful anchor at you. While small in size, it packs a punch, knocking out even the biggest of Pokémon in one blow.

entry: 这种罕见变异的POKENAME，拥有异常巨大的锚。虽然更沉、挥得更慢，却远比通常的小锚强大、可怕。
author: soup1900
source: This rare mutation of POKENAME has an abnormally large anchor. While heavier and slower to use, this anchor is far more powerful and more threatening than the smaller anchor this Pokémon normally has.

entry: 海盗时代，POKENAME常是船员，报酬是香蕉。它爱与猿类宝可梦结仇，不清楚这习性起自古时，还是近年才有。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: During the time of pirates, POKENAME were often a part of crews, and paid with bananas. POKENAME have a proclivity for forming rivalries with ape Pokémon; it's unclear if this originated in the past or is a recent development.

entry: POKENAME把自己固定在洞壁，从钩子射网，捕角金鱼与鲤鱼王。它纹丝不动，直到有东西拉扯网。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME anchors itself to cave walls, firing webbing from its hook to snare Goldeen and Magikarp. It remains motionless until something tugs the web.

entry: POKENAME诞生自大型邮轮沉入海中的吊灯。泡海太久，钢铁早已锈成了坚实的一团。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME is born from sunken chandeliers on large cruise ships. Its steel rusted solid after all the time in the ocean.

entry: 贪婪的钥圈儿，曾像海盗一样搜宝，最终为追逐海底财宝而死，被破破舵轮占据身体。如今成了POKENAME，只能漫无目的地漂流。
author: slowforest
source: Once a greedy swashbuckler, Klefki met its end chasing treasures in the deep sea, where Dhelmise seized its body. Now POKENAME, it drifts aimlessly.

entry: 有人相信POKENAME来自坠入深海的飞船。它用链状四肢收集船骸，不过没人知道，那些废料究竟拿来做什么。
author: sk372
source: Some believe that POKENAME came from a spaceship that crashed deep into the ocean depths. It gathers the remains of shipwrecks with its chain-like limbs, though none are certain what it does with the scrap it collects.

entry: POKENAME常在深海，懒懒爬行，仿佛正在擦洗栖居处的远洋沉积物。水手故事说，它们是迷失的已故水手长灵魂。
author: beatdoof
source: POKENAME is often found deep in the sea, lazily crawling from place to place as if swabbing the pelagic sediments it resides in. Sailors tell the tale of these Pokémon being the wayward souls of lost boatswains.

entry: POKENAME焦躁不安，总拖着锚游过深海。饿了，就不停搜遍海洋，寻找水生宝可梦巢穴，吃它们的蛋。
author: beatdoof
source: POKENAME is a restless and always agitated species, dragging the anchor it carries as it swims across the deep seas. When it's hungry, it will relentlessly scour the ocean for other aquatic Pokémon nests and eat their eggs.

entry: POKENAME常在深水漂流，任洋流带着走。休息便静止，有时吃海藻、苔藓也会如此，让两者都长在身上。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME frequently drift within deep waters, letting themselves be carried by currents to move around. They become immobile when they rest, which they may do during meals of seaweed and moss; this has led for both to grow upon their bodies.

entry: POKENAME成群沿海底爬行，寻找大型猎物合力击倒。它偏爱吼鲸王富铁的肉，一只倒下的吼鲸王，就够吃几个月。
author: brilliantdarkness
source: Colonies of POKENAME scuttle along the ocean floor, seeking large prey to take down. They favor the iron-rich meat of Wailord and sustain themselves off a single fallen Wailord for months.

entry: POKENAME沿海底缓行，捡来锈蚀废金属打造铠甲。受威胁时便猛然挥锚，力道足以碎骨。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME slowly walk along the seafloor, gathering rusted scrap metal to build its armor. When threated they will swing its anchor with enough force to shatter bone.

entry: POKENAME似乎住在沉船残骸旁，藏入碎片，不露身形，再用海藻状触肢，困住毫无防备的小猎物。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME appears to reside near the wreckage of sunken ships. It hides amongst the debris out of sight, before using seaweed-like tendrils to ensnare small unwary prey.

entry: 古老传说称，两船相撞，残骸便会交缠，化为POKENAME。两个舵轮各自旋转，似乎不影响实际前进方向。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Old legends claim that if two ships were to crash into each other, the remains would intertwine and become a POKENAME. The two wheels rotate independently of each other, seeming to have no effect on the direction that the POKENAME actually travels.

entry: POKENAME腐朽身体，永远被幽灵锁链束缚。它以诡异哀号求助，让听见者都心神不宁。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's rotting body is forever bound in ghostly chains. It cries out for help with haunting wails that unsettle all those who hear them.

entry: 这只宝可梦固定在海底，像一枚破旧水雷。虽然不会爆炸，皮肤依然坚实，足以重创不慎撞上的船。
author: fireblade141
source: Securing itself to the seafloor, this Pokémon resembles a decrepit sea mine. Although it will not explode, its sturdy skin is still solid enough to deal significant damage to any boats that accidentally bump into it.

entry: 据说POKENAME是海难亡者的魂，如今拴在沉锚上。水手故事说，它用附魂海藻抓住倒霉泳者，抽走灵魂，好在来世有个伴。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is said to be the soul of a person lost at see, now tethered to a sunken anchor. Sailors tell tales that it will grab hapless swimmers with possessed seaweed and remove their soul so that it may have company in the afterlife.

entry: 吼鲸王常无意吞下POKENAME珍视的水晶。它因此暴怒，不停追猎肇事者，决心取回水晶、报仇。
author: periperi_chicken
source: Wailord often swallow prized crystals belonging to POKENAME without noticing. Enraged, POKENAME will relentlessly hunt the ones responsible, determined to reclaim their crystals and take revenge.

entry: POKENAME戴着旧潜水头盔护身，在海底找食物。据说，谁想拿下头盔，便会遭到诅咒。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME use old diving helmets as protection as they search the ocean floor for food. It is said to curse anyone who tries to remove the helmet.

entry: POKENAME在海底休息，装成石头。小型宝可梦靠近寻求遮蔽，就会被头顶海藻裹住，吸干热量。
author: bacondlx
source: POKENAME rests at the bottom of the sea floor, imitating a rock. When smaller Pokémon approach it for cover, it engulfs them in the seaweed covering its head and drains the heat from them.

entry: 它热爱表演，却难找到观众，多半因为拿水雷当绒球，让人担心。幸好，水雷已经失效。大概吧。
author: kiwiarms
source: It loves to perform, but it has trouble finding an audience. This is likely due to concern over the sea mines it uses as pompoms. Thankfully, they're inert. Probably.

entry: POKENAME收集海底丢弃物吃。垃圾一空，就开始啃附近船上的锈。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME gathers discarded objects from the seafloor to consume. Should it run out of trash, it begins eating the rust off of nearby ships.

entry: POKENAME船壳般的身体，吱嘎作响地穿过深海，拖着链条与松散海带。水手低声传说，有桨帆船被发现漂流，甲板撕开，船员却全无踪影。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME's hull-like body creaks through the ocean depths, trailing chains and lose kelp. Sailors whisper of galleys found adrift, their decks torn open and their crews gone without a trace.

entry: POKENAME附身沉船碎片，用海藻与系锚的链条维持身体。锚在身后拖着，手持锁链，却仿佛毫无重量。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Possessing the fragments of a sunken ship, POKENAME hold their bodies together with seaweed and the chains that support their anchors. They carry the chains as if they have no weight, even as their anchors trail behind them.

entry: POKENAME从海下放出强音，扰乱船舶导航设备。它藏在海藻丛，兴致勃勃地看船只不知不觉兜起大圈。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME releases powerful bursts of sound from beneath the sea to disrupt ship navigation equipment. Hidden within kelp beds, it watches with interest as they unintentionally sail in large circles.

entry: POKENAME在雾夜走出海洋，能在岸边游荡数日，最后却必须潜回水下，为中空的身体灌满海水。
author: danarchist
source: POKENAME emerge from the ocean on misty nights. They can wander the coast for days, but must eventually return beneath the waves to refill their hollow bodies with sea water.

entry: POKENAME漏出盐水，看着似乎在疼，其实并非如此。减轻水的重量，反而让它战斗时逐步变快。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: While the saltwater leaking might make it seem like POKENAME is in pain, the truth is very different. By decreasing their water weight, POKENAME incrementally become faster during fights.

entry: POKENAME挥动覆藻巨锚臂，用压倒性的力量，碾碎挡路之物。它能先以强悍握力困住对手，再用巨锚重重一击。
author: msdawgs
source: POKENAME swings its massive, algae-covered anchor arm with devastating momentum, using overwhelming strength to crush anything in its path. It can trap opponents with a crushing grip before delivering a heavy, nautical blow.

entry: 据说，POKENAME曾属于很久以前的一位名船长。谁敢从船长室偷走受诅咒的财宝，就会遭它们攻击。
author: lemmymaster
source: POKENAME are said to have belonged to a famous captain from long ago. They attack any who dare to steal their cursed treasure from the captain's room.

entry: 海盗船员的亡魂，与沉船融为一体，形成了它。据说，海上看见这只宝可梦，是不幸将至的预兆。
author: sonicdestroyer12
source: This Pokémon was formed when the souls of a pirate crew united with their sunken ship. Seeing it at sea is said to be an omen of ill fortune.

entry: 据说POKENAME原是一艘海上失踪船只的船首像。它漂泊海洋，舵轮无目的地转着，寻找新的船员。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME is rumored to be the figurehead of a ship lost at sea, its ship's wheel spinning aimlessly as it drifts the ocean, searching for a crew.

entry: 深受船员喜爱的沉船残骸获得灵魂，得以重游大海。POKENAME看似随意漂流，其实始终在寻找迷失的灵魂，加入自己的船队。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: The wreckage of a sunken ship, beloved by its crew, gained a soul so that it may roam the seas once again. POKENAME appears to drift aimlessly, but it's actually on a constant search for lost souls to join its crew.

entry: 老水手故事里，POKENAME曾率领一群贪婪宝可梦。可它们后来叛变，反将POKENAME沉入大洋深处。
author: chorb33
source: An old sailor's tale tells of POKENAME leading a band of rapacious Pokémon. However, they mutinied and sank POKENAME to the depths of the ocean.

entry: POKENAME沙状身体内，藏着锈链。它躲在浓密海藻林，甩链缠住猎物，拖向更深处，在猎物挣扎时，慢慢吸走能量。
author: .izik
source: Concealed within POKENAME's sand-like body is a rusty chain that it lashes out to wrap around prey while hiding in dense kelp forests. It drags them deeper into the kelp, slowly draining their energy as they struggle.

entry: POKENAME待在海底，很少挪动。有人见过大钳蟹把它当成住处，试着往身体里钻。
author: jokerswild
source: Found on the sea floor, POKENAME rarely move. Krabby have been spotted trying to enter these Pokémon, mistaking them for shelter.

entry: 人们害怕POKENAME惑人的歌声，将它拴到锚上，扔进大海。可水手们说，时至今日，仍能听见它唱。
author: hexx_vixtar
source: People feared POKENAME's alluring voice, so they chained it to an anchor and tossed it into the sea. Sailors claim they can still hear it to this day.

entry: POKENAME爱被关注，希望用歌吸引大量听众。可唱着唱着，总插进阵阵炮火，往往把大家全吓跑。
author: bostroms
source: POKENAME loves attention and hopes to attract a wide audience with its singing.  However, it punctuates its songs with bursts of cannon fire, which tends to scare everyone off.

entry: POKENAME大多时间静躺海底，装成普通海藻堆。生物一游近，就突然活过来，伸出海带状触肢，拖下猎物吃掉。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME will spend much of its time lying motionless on the ocean floor, mimicking a simple pile of seaweed. If something swims close, it springs to life and sends out kelp-like tendrils that drag its new prey down to be consumed.

entry: POKENAME古时曾被视为海盗的好伙伴。不过，它也常害得大群船员丧命，主要因为远航时，吃掉了大部分食物储备。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME were once considered great allies for pirates long ago. However, POKENAME often caused larger crews to meet their fates, mostly by eating most of their food supplies during long voyages.

entry: POKENAME外形像可怕船只，一旦寡不敌众，却会以惊人速度逃走。为脱险，泳速最高可达每小时100英里。
author: .izik
source: Despite its fearsome ship-like appearance, POKENAME will flee at incredible speeds if outnumbered. It can swim up to 100 mph to escape dangerous situations.

entry: POKENAME倒挂在海藻田中睡觉，混进周围海藻。沉重锚角固定身体，抵抗洋流。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME sleeps upside down in kelp fields, blending in with the seaweed. Its heavy anchor-horn holds it in place against ocean currents.

entry: POKENAME紧贴邮轮与帆船下方，沿它们的路线跟随。发现有人落海，就试着送回岸边，救活对方。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME travels directly under cruise ships and sailboats and follows their direct paths. If it notices someone has fallen overboard, it attempts to bring them back to shore and resuscitate them.

entry: POKENAME的魔杖，用海滩找到的浮木做成。它挥杖操纵海藻，攻击敌人。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's wand is crafted from driftwood found on beaches. It uses this wand to manipulate seaweed and attack foes.

entry: 它投掷收集的残骸，巨大的向心力让每块都旋转，如圆锯般切开木头。敌人若拉近距离，POKENAME便挥巨锚，将其赶走。
author: imaginita
source: It attacks by throwing gathered debris, sending each spinning with such centripetal force that it can cut through wood like a buzzsaw.  If a foe tries to close the distance, POKENAME will drive them away by swinging its massive anchor.

entry: POKENAME缓缓走过海底，大量海藻从壳边铺开。小生物游得太近，就被叶片抓住，拖进壳里吃掉。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME slowly walks along the ocean floor, massive amounts of seaweed spreading out from its shell. Any small creatures that swim too close are seized by the leaves and dragged into its shell to be consumed.

entry: POKENAME身上的锈，常扩散到栖居的湖里，传播疾病。不论湖被污染到什么程度，头顶海藻都能茂盛生长。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: The rust along a POKENAME's body often spreads through the lakes it calls home, causing the spread of diseases. No matter how polluted a lake gets, the seaweed atop a POKENAME's head can thrive under any condition.

entry: POKENAME虽然总皱着脸，性子却很孩子气，爱拿锚让船停下。锁链似乎无穷长，所以研究船考察海沟时，会借它帮忙。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Despite their perpetual scowl, POKENAME are quite childish, finding joy in using their anchor to stop ships. Since their chain is seemingly infinite, research boats will use POKENAME when they want to study ocean trenches.

entry: 它感到航船士气低落，就现身带领水手唱起热烈、喧闹的海员歌，鼓舞精神。不过，几乎总盼着分一点船上的钱财，存进宝箱。
author: notadoctor75
source: It senses when spirits are low on sailing vessels and appears to lead the sailors in riveting, uproarious shanties, uplifting their morale. For this, it almost always expects a small share of the ship's coffers, which it stores in its chest.

entry: 水手提醒，小心POKENAME从天而降。故事说，它用尾锚钩住不幸的船，再靠密实沉重的身体，拖往海底。
author: sk372
source: Sailors warn to watch for the sight of POKENAME shooting down from the sky. The tales say that POKENAME latches onto unfortunate ships with its anchor-tail before using its dense and heavy body to drag the ship down to the ocean floor.

entry: POKENAME向同类吹出心形小泡，互相沟通。老水手故事说，它诞生于海难情侣的灵魂。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME blows small heart-shaped bubbles at others of its kind to communicate. Old sailors' tales say POKENAME was born from the spirits of couples lost at sea.

entry: 据说POKENAME载着渴望永世征服七海的海盗之魂。老船长们说，附近若有财宝，受诅咒的硬币就会发亮。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME is said to carry the souls of pirates seeking eternal conquest across the seven seas. Tales from old captains claim its cursed coin gleams when it detects nearby treasure.

entry: POKENAME游得快，海藻随着行动发热，身后留下道道热泡。常能见它守护沉船，驱赶掠夺者与拾荒者。
author: sk372
source: Swift swimmers, POKENAME's seaweed heats up as it moves around, leaving trails of hot bubbles behind. It's often seen guarding sunken ships from looters and scavengers.

entry: POKENAME住在海中，附着码头基部。退潮后露出水面，很快就成了鸟类宝可梦的点心。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME live in the sea, where they attach themselves to the base of piers. They are left exposed at low tide, which makes them a quick snack for bird Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME裹着吓人的碎屑、头骨，让模样威风又致命。有人觉得，这只是为弥补力气、毒性都不怎么样，虚张声势得过了头。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME cloaks itself in intimidating detritus and skulls to give itself an imposing, deadly appearance. Some think it's overcompensating for its rather meager strength and toxin.

entry: POKENAME用海藻般的长肢捕捉猎物，罗盘似的双眼，则能追踪任何目标。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME uses its long, seaweed-like limbs to capture prey. It can track anything using its compass eyes.

entry: POKENAME海藻状的触肢，一碰就放出麻痹毒。猎物被抓住，便拖往海底，吸干活力。
author: bacondlx
source: The seaweed-like tendrils on POKENAME release a paralyzing poison upon contact. Prey caught in these tentacles are dragged to the ocean floor where they have their vitality drained.

entry: 覆身的“毛”，其实是日积月累的锈。质地尖锐不平，最好别揉。
author: .izik
source: The 'fur' covering its body is actually rust accumulated over time. Rubbing it is not recommended due to its jagged texture.

entry: POKENAME全由海藻构成，收集找到的各类残骸，拼成坚壳。不过，壳通常很沉，很难带着走。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME are comprised entirely of seaweed. They gather whatever wreckage they can find to create a tough shell, though this shell is usually heavy and hard to carry around.

entry: POKENAME是幼童喜爱的伙伴，孩子喜欢骑上去，随它缓慢平稳地前后摇。把海藻鬃毛梳理好，是让它乖巧的最好办法。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a popular companion for small children, who enjoy riding it as it rocks back and forth at a slow and steady pace. Keeping its seaweed mane well-groomed is the best way to ensure it stays well-behaved.

entry: 如果在溪流或河边发现POKENAME，千万不要靠近，更不要伸手去碰它的缰绳。若不听劝告，就可能被它拖入水中淹死。
author: cristata
source: If you spot a POKENAME by the side of a creek or river, do not approach, and never reach for their bridle. If you don't succeed, you will be drowned.

entry: 如果在溪流或河边发现POKENAME，千万不要靠近，更不要伸手去碰它的缰绳。若不听劝告，就可能被它拖入水中淹死。
author: cristata
source: If you spot a POKENAME by the side of a creek or river, do not approach, and never reach for their bridle. If you don't succeed, you will be drowned.

entry: 如果在溪流或河边发现POKENAME，千万不要靠近，更不要伸手去碰它的缰绳。若不听劝告，就可能被它拖入水中淹死。
author: cristata
source: If you spot a POKENAME by the side of a creek or river, do not approach, and never reach for their bridle. If you don't succeed, you will be drowned.

entry: POKENAME将其他宝可梦拖进大水域，吸走生命力。身体则由生锈的锚与海藻组成。
author: blue_mythic
source: POKENAME drags other Pokémon into large bodies of water, stealing their life force. Its body is made of rusted anchors and seaweed.

entry: POKENAME尾巴连着旧沉船残骸。有人说，盘踞其中的灵魂，偶尔会短暂控制它，展现远胜平常的力量与智慧。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has the remains of an old sunken ship attached to its tail. According to some, spirits haunting the wreckage will sometimes take control of POKENAME for a short time and make it exhibit much greater strength and intelligence.

entry: 雾一起，POKENAME就漫游海上，用光帮渔船找到回家路。它很怕生，谁试着与它说话，就迅速潜下水。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME roams the sea whenever fog rises, using its light to help fishing boats find their way back home. It is very shy around humans and quickly dives underwater whenever someone tries to speak to it.

entry: 传说POKENAME生于海难水手的灵魂，因此帮助仍在航海的人。三个头上的灯球间歇闪烁，提醒船只留意附近礁石，免得船壳受损。
author: fiordaliso
source: Legend has it that POKENAME was born from the souls of sailors who perished at sea, which is why it helps those still sailing. The bulbs on its three heads flash intermittently to warn ships of nearby rocks and prevent them from damaging their hulls.

entry: 水手相信POKENAME守望大海，引船远离危险。三个头上的灯球，如信标般明灭，照亮凶险水域，引船避开暗礁。
author: fiordaliso
source: Sailors believe POKENAME watches over the sea, guiding ships away from danger. The glowing bulbs atop its three heads pulse like beacons, illuminating treacherous waters and steering vessels clear of hidden reefs.

entry: 它在海底无精打采地游，直到找到能挥舞的锚。若锚上附着海带般的羽毛，就代表POKENAME在附近。
author: silverscloudy
source: It swims at the bottom of the ocean listlessly until it finds an anchor to wield. Finding kelp-like feathers attached to an anchor means a POKENAME is nearby.

entry: 据说POKENAME出没于冰盖附近的沉船，对海上迷途之人而言，是不祥的征兆。
author: murmarine
source: Said to haunt ship wrecks near ice sheets, POKENAME are rumored to be bad omens for those lost at sea.

entry: POKENAME慢慢啃食沉船，主要吃锈。宝可梦或人类潜水者靠近残骸，就会遭它埋伏。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME slowly chew their way through sunken ships, mostly feeding on rust. If Pokémon or human divers approach the wreck, POKENAME will lie in wait to ambush them.

entry: POKENAME会占据海底的沉船，将其视为自己的领地，赶走入侵者。它常把那艘船的锚，当作武器挥舞，巩固自己的统治。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME will take over sunken ships at the bottom of the ocean, claiming them as territory and chasing off intruders. It often wields the anchor from said ship as a weapon to help enforce its rule.

entry: POKENAME搜寻沉船，找东西装饰自己。两只交战，胜者就会夺走败者部分饰物，作为战利品。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME searches the wreckage of sunken ships, looking for items to adorn itself with. If two POKENAME clash, the victor will steal some of the loser's accessories as spoils of war.

entry: POKENAME用藤蔓，把猎物拖入背上种子覆盖的毒刺间，令其难逃。它吃枯死植物与真菌，维持体内毒素。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME drags its prey with vines into the poisonous thorns covering its bulb, making escape difficult. It feeds on dead plants and fungi to sustain the toxins in its body.

entry: POKENAME的每个头，似乎控制不同触手。它们合力，以利刺接连猛戳猎物，每刺都能注入强毒，慢慢削弱目标。
author: .jerden
source: Each of POKENAME's heads seems to control different tentacles. They work together to attack prey with a relentless series of jabs with their sharp spikes, each capable of delivering potent poison to slowly weaken the target.

entry: POKENAME精力旺盛，爱捣乱，捕猎时常释放多余毒素。若把一湖猎物吃尽，就用长腿迁往新猎场。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are very energetic and mischievous in nature, spreading more toxins than they need to during their hunts. If they fully clear out a lake of potential prey, they will use their long legs to travel to a new hunting ground.

entry: 它认定是猎物，就不顾一切冲去，想用众多毒刺中的一根刺破皮肤。可别把POKENAME当普通独角犀牛，骑在背上。
author: craigprime
source: It charges recklessly towards anything it deems as prey, aiming to break skin with one of its many poison-laced spikes. Riding on top of POKENAME as though it's a normal Rhyhorn is ill-advised.

entry: POKENAME尾部渗出的蓝毒，足以制服成年男子。它先用泡泡拖慢猎物，方便出击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's blue venom leaks from its tail, which is capable of subduing a full-grown man. It uses bubbles to slow down its prey, making it easier to attack.

entry: POKENAME发射泡泡扰乱敌人，再吐毒墨制服。墨让对手迷失方向，更容易被它击中。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME shoots bubbles to confuse foes, then spits poison ink to subdue them. The ink causes disorientation, making it easier for POKENAME to strike.

entry: POKENAME滑过海底，用毒角与同类互戳，切磋动作近乎舞蹈。这是展示领地内支配地位的行为。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME glides across the seafloor, jabbing its venomous horn at others of its kind in an almost dance-like sparring match. This behavior is a display of dominance within its territory.

entry: POKENAME的黏性，让它能贴在岸边巨石上。黏合物一碰就中毒，让天敌不敢靠近。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's adhesiveness allows it to stick to boulders near the shore. The adhesive is poisonous on contact, deterring potential predators from getting too close.

entry: POKENAME在陆地扑腾时，从鳞片放毒，以毒黏液裹住自身。挣扎着试图站稳时，这能保护它，免遭捕食。
author: .izik
source: When flopping on dry land, POKENAME releases poison from its scales, surrounding itself with a toxic slime. This helps protect it from predators while it struggles to regain its footing.

entry: POKENAME攻击太靠近领地的船，用毒触手将水手拖下。它易怒，又讨厌巨响，凶猛而难以预测。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME attacks vessels that get too close to its territory, dragging sailors down with its venomous tentacles. It becomes enraged easily and hates loud sounds, making it a fierce and unpredictable creature.

entry: POKENAME过去曾愉快地载人过海。谁想从主人那里偷走它，背刺就会刺穿窃贼、注毒，保护心爱伙伴。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME was once used to ferry people across the sea happily. Should someone try to steal it from its owner, the spines on its back will skewer them and inject venom, defending its beloved companion.

entry: POKENAME在海岸筑巢，巡视浅海上空。它用刺欺负其他宝可梦，每根都装着虽不致命、却极痛的毒液。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME makes hives in coastal regions, patrolling over the shallower parts of the ocean. It bullies other Pokémon with its stingers, which each contain a non-lethal but very painful dose of venom.

entry: POKENAME用超能力收集珊瑚礁污染物，以心念液化，再经皮肤吸收，制成更强的毒液。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its psychic powers to gather pollutants found in coral reefs. It liquefies them with its mind before absorbing them into its skin to create more potent venom.

entry: POKENAME用强颚咬住角金鱼等猎物，注入毒液，造成持续数日的麻痹。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME bites down on prey like Goldeen with powerful jaws, injecting a venom that causes paralysis lasting several days.

entry: 潜水者必须小心野生POKENAME。它闪动头灯引猎物，靠近后用毒攻击，据说感觉像静电电击持续不停。
author: deelee2020
source: Divers must be wary of wild POKENAME. They draw in prey by flashing the light on their head, then attack with poison once they draw near. This attack is said to feel like an ongoing static shock.

entry: POKENAME用触角灯光引来猎物，再向水里吐出数加仑毒液，将其制服。毒一小时就散去，只留下猎物残骸。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME attracts prey with lights on its antennae, then exhales gallons of poison into the water to subdue them. The poison dissipates in an hour, leaving behind only the remnants of its prey.

entry: POKENAME的壳一碰就中毒，可磨成粉后，药师却能用来配解毒药。危险归危险，仍是珍贵材料。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's shell is venomous to the touch, but when ground up, it can be used to make Antidotes by apothecaries. This makes it a valuable resource despite its dangerous nature.

entry: POKENAME的毒液带来强烈幸福感，让人24小时忘却一切悲伤。因此很能安抚烦忧者，不过效果只是暂时。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's venom causes intense feelings of happiness, making people forget about any sadness for 24 hours. This makes it an effective tool for calming troubled souls, though its effects are only temporary.

entry: POKENAME猎捕太阳珊瑚时，把尾巴当连枷甩。这份狂野活力，帮助它先打昏猎物，再施以毒击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME swings its tail like a flail while hunting Corsola. This wild, energetic behavior helps it knock its prey out before delivering a venomous strike.

entry: POKENAME在水洼扑腾，抹满泥。泥藏起身上倒刺，让它能在敌人意想不到时，突然出击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME splashes in puddles, covering itself in mud. The mud conceals the barbs on its body, allowing it to surprise foes by striking when they least expect it.

entry: POKENAME懒躺浅溪，吃附近植物。触手般的头发中，有多个毒囊，帮助捍卫领地。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME lazes about in shallow creeks, eating nearby flora. Its tentacle-like hair contains multiple poison sacs that help it protect its territory.

entry: POKENAME深夜潜水，无声袭击熟睡的太阳珊瑚。毒牙的毒，让猎物无法醒来。
author: lampent12
source: In the dead of night, POKENAME dives into the water, silently taking down sleeping Corsola. The venom in their fangs prevents prey from waking up.

entry: POKENAME捕猎高效，无声滑过猎物上方，伸出触手注毒。目标倒下后，POKENAME便绕回，用爪抓走。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are efficient hunters, gliding silently over their prey and extending their tentacles to inject them with venom. Once the prey is down, POKENAME will loop back around, carrying them away with its claws.

entry: 每只POKENAME都坚信，自己是最漂亮的小公主。没错，它们每一只都是。
author: cristata
source: POKENAME are all convinced that they are the prettiest little princess. They are all correct.

entry: POKENAME先吸满水，再高速射出毒刺。攻击既快又致命，连最坚韧的敌人也能刺穿。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME fills with water before shooting venomous barbs at high speeds. This quick and deadly attack can pierce through even the toughest of enemies.

entry: POKENAME刻薄又好胜，训练家若不够重视、尊重它，就常反抗。发怒时，瞬间冻住触肢，让毒刺更锐。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Incredibly catty and competitive, POKENAME often rebel against Trainers that don't give them the proper attention or respect. When angered, they flash freeze their tendrils to further sharpen their poisonous barbs.

entry: POKENAME慢慢爬过珊瑚礁，寻找太阳珊瑚吃。背上一排毒触手，以刺痛驱走想吃它的鱼类宝可梦。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME feed on Corsola, making their way slowly across coral reefs in search of their prey. The venomous tentacles lining their back protect them from fish Pokémon that might try and eat them, warding them away with nasty stings.

entry: POKENAME的再生力，少有其他宝可梦可比。只要睡在洁净无污染的水里，受损的刺或触须，一夜便能长回。
author: deelee2020
source: POKENAME has regenerative abilities not found in many other Pokémon. If a spike or feeler is damaged, it will grow back overnight, as long as the Pokémon sleeps in clean, unpolluted water.

entry: POKENAME用触手吸盘固定太阳珊瑚，再使出章鱼桶炮，发射强力毒弹。攻击强得能穿透钨。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses the suction cups on its tentacles to hold Corsola in place before using Octazooka to deliver a powerful, poisonous blast. This attack is strong enough to pierce tungsten.

entry: POKENAME趴在海面，鳍展得宽而近乎平坦。睡着时，向周围渗出粉红毒液，警告入侵者。
