author: .izik
source: POKENAME lays on the surface of the ocean, its fins spread wide and almost completely flat. It exudes a pink poison around it as it sleeps, warning off any intruders.

entry: POKENAME飞过珊瑚礁，俯冲抓走太阳珊瑚，带回巢。钢躯与利爪，让它成为高效猎手。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME flies over coral reefs and dives down to grab Corsola, carrying them back to its nest. Its steel body and sharp talons make it an efficient hunter.

entry: POKENAME沿水底蜿行，能在水下憋气数小时。它同时用身体与触手缠猎物，注入致命毒液。
author: alindrome
source: Slithering along waterbeds, POKENAME can hold its breath underwater for hours. It constricts prey with both its body and tentacles, delivering fatal poison.

entry: POKENAME想饱餐柔嫩太阳珊瑚，却总吃不到：群体稍一瞥见那可怕模样，就立刻四散。它只好闷闷不乐地盘住其他猎物，用粗大身体将其困住、麻痹。
author: alindrome
source: POKENAME yearns to feast on tender Corsola but cannot: their colonies instantly scatter at the slightest hint of its terrifying visage. Glumly, it settles for paralysing other prey in its great coils.

entry: POKENAME把带刺触手扎进水下峭壁，贴附着等待进化。从脸上的孔洞排出积气，就能向天敌喷毒。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME stab their spiked tentacles into underwater cliffs, clinging on as they await evolution. By releasing built-up gas from the holes in their face, they can spew poison at predators.

entry: POKENAME经触手释放强大电流，震晕、制服靠得太近的生物。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME emits powerful electrical surges through its tentacles. This electrical discharge helps it stun and subdue any creatures that come too close.

entry: POKENAME肢上细管，能帮助黏附、攀过物体表面。它常啃食船壳附着的海洋生物，帮忙清洁，可没得到报酬，就很容易觉得受冒犯。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME has tiny tubes on its limbs that help it adhere to and climb over surfaces. It frequently helps clean the hulls of ships by eating marine fouling organisms growing on them, but it is easily insulted if not rewarded.

entry: POKENAME跃入、跃出水面，精准猎捕太阳珊瑚。既贪玩，又有捕食本能，是外海的好猎手。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME leaps in and out of the water, hunting Corsola with great precision. Its playful yet predatory nature makes it a skilled hunter in the open sea.

entry: POKENAME飞行时，向猎物吐出团团毒口水。能从上方进攻，让猎物难以逃脱。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spits globs of poisonous saliva on prey while flying. This allows it to attack from above, making it difficult for prey to escape.

entry: POKENAME的紫色珊瑚命匣，存着大部分能量。它释放阵阵能量，制造旋涡，困住猎物。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's violet coral phylactery retains the majority of its energy. It releases bursts of this energy to create whirlpools that ensnare prey.

entry: POKENAME的尖刺带着致命剧毒，打斗也不择手段。开战前，还会摇晃毒囊。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME's spikes are lethally poisonous, and it fights dirty. It shakes the poison in its sack right before a fight.

entry: POKENAME有两条触手，末端是利刃。除了很适合作战武器，刃上尖刺还带着最浓的毒，能有效削弱猎物。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME possesses two tentacles that end in sharp blades. Aside from being excellent weapons in combat, both contain spines on the blade that carry the most concentrated of POKENAME's poison, making them very effective at debilitating its prey.

entry: POKENAME将触手伸得极远，抓住靠礁太近的海滩游客。先注入安抚却剧毒的毒液，再拖进浪下。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME extends its tentacles at great distance to seize beachgoers who venture too close to its reef. It injects them with a calming yet extremely toxic venom before dragging them beneath the surf.

entry: 触手里有强毒，是配制某些安抚身心药物的珍贵材料。幸好一夜就能再生，只要善待、喂饱它，它也愿意让人采集。
author: infinex21
source: Within its tentacles is a potent toxin that is priceless in crafting certain remedies that calm the mind and body. Thankfully, its tentacles regrow overnight, and it is willing to let them be harvested, so long as it is treated and fed well.

entry: POKENAME的恶意助长毒素。越恨某个敌人，尖刺的毒就会在对方体内留得越久。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's malice fuels its toxins. The more hateful it feels towards an enemy, the longer the venom from its spikes will linger in their system.

entry: POKENAME毒液极强，咬一口，数分钟便能让训练家彻底麻痹。它在浅礁捕猎，以鲜艳体色混进珊瑚间。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's venom is incredibly potent. A single bite can fully paralyze a Trainer within a matter of minutes. It hunts in shallow reefs, using its bright colors to hide amongst the coral.

entry: POKENAME口中吐出的内脏，一碰就有毒。能吓退潜在威胁，确保野外安全。
author: .izik
source: The innards that come out of POKENAME's mouth are poisonous to the touch. This acts as a deterrent to potential threats, ensuring its safety in the wild.

entry: POKENAME收集各种贝壳装点身体，每个都涂毒防盗，让谁也偷不走珍藏。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME collects different seashells it finds to decorate its body. Each shell is coated in poison to prevent theft, ensuring that no one can steal its prized collection.

entry: POKENAME浮在海面起伏，用倒刺贴上客船。取下时得小心，方法不当，就可能被注毒。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME bobs on the surface of seas, sticking to passenger ships with its barbs. One must be careful when removing them, as doing so improperly could lead to a venomous injection.

entry: POKENAME侧躺瀑布底部睡觉，用急流保持尖刺湿润。刺有毒，不能吃。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME sleeps on its side at the base of waterfalls, using the rushing water to keep its spines moist. Its spines are poisonous and should not be eaten.

entry: POKENAME一被踩，毒倒刺就伸出，释放引发高热的毒素。这份防御本领，让毫无防备的旅人陷入危险。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's venomous barbs extend when stepped on, releasing a toxin that causes intense fevers. This defensive mechanism makes it a dangerous encounter for unwary travelers.

entry: 吃过太阳珊瑚后，POKENAME会收起剩余珊瑚枝，藏在巢里。它尤其喜欢异色太阳珊瑚的枝。
author: mistymagius
source: After feeding on Corsola, POKENAME will collect the leftover branches of coral and stash them away in its dens. It especially loves to collect the branches of Shiny Corsola.

entry: POKENAME巨口有多排毒牙，一口咬住猎物，紧紧扣牢。同时注入强毒，慢慢削弱，直到对方无力反抗。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME has multiple rows of venomous teeth in its maw, and it bites down on prey to latch on. As it does, it injects a potent toxin, slowly weakening its prey until they can no longer resist.

entry: 它引诱其他宝可梦，吃下头顶毒叶，让对方弱得无力抵御攻击。POKENAME住在暖水，促进有毒叶片生长。
author: fiordaliso
source: It lures other Pokémon into eating the poisonous leaves that grow on its head, leaving them too weak to defend themselves from its attacks. POKENAME dwells in warm waters that promote the growth of its toxic foliage.

entry: POKENAME的牙缘呈锯齿，是高效猎手。口水有毒，甚至还没咬紧，猎物就可能中毒。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's fangs have serrated edges, making it an efficient predator. Its saliva is toxic, capable of poisoning its prey before it even bites down.

entry: POKENAME咬过后留下毒口水，初次攻击过去很久，仍持续毒害目标。因此，在栖居水域是令人畏惧的猎手。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's bites leave behind toxic saliva that continues to poison its target long after the initial strike. This makes it a feared predator in its aquatic territory.

entry: POKENAME爬过珊瑚礁，寻找太阳珊瑚，用毒触肢困住。毒液削弱猎物，让它能拖回巢穴。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME scuttles through reefs, seeking to entrap Corsola with its venomous tendrils. Its venom weakens its prey, allowing it to drag them into its lair.

entry: POKENAME趴在岸边，毒刺朝上，专门困住海滩游客。尖刺释放毒物，让闯入者难逃。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME lays on shorelines with toxic spikes sticking upward which are designed to entrap beachgoers. The spikes release a toxic substance that makes escape difficult for any intruders.

entry: POKENAME背上大蘑菇长出倒刺，随年龄越来越锐。刺产生的毒极黏，闻着像烂水果。
author: .izik
source: The large mushroom growing from POKENAME's back develops barbs that sharpen with age. The venom these barbs produce is extremely sticky and smells of rotten fruit.

entry: POKENAME头上手臂随心情变色，多数时候是满足的蓝色。它能操纵手臂，以毒尖戳敌；毒令人寒冷，直到无法动弹。
author: chibitales
source: The arms on POKENAME's head change color according to its mood, most often being a content blue. It can manipulate these arms to jab at opponents with poisoned tips. The poison chills the opponent until they can no longer move.

entry: POKENAME用婉转歌声，让大群太阳珊瑚入睡。猎物沉眠时，跟随它的好坏星，便来享用轻松到手的一餐。
author: lampent12
source: With their melodious song, POKENAME lulls hoards of Corsola to sleep. While their prey slumbers, their Mareanie followers settle in for an easy meal.

entry: POKENAME的歌朗朗上口，风格悠闲，深受音乐爱好者喜爱。它却不太照顾跟着自己的铁炮鱼。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME has become popular with music lovers for its catchy songs and laid-back style. It takes poor care of the Remoraid that accompanies it.

entry: POKENAME头上触手能麻痹猎物，再以尖牙咬穿防御，完成捕猎。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME has tentacles on its head that can paralyze prey. It then bites them to finish the hunt, using its sharp teeth to pierce through the prey's defenses.

entry: POKENAME长触手盘在身边，每次移动都散出真菌孢子。各条完全伸展，最长可达一米，很适合阻挡攻击。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME has long tentacles coiled around its body that spread fungal spores whenever they move. Each of these fungi-spreading tentacles can reach up to a meter in length when fully stretched out, making them perfect for blocking attacks.

entry: POKENAME从鳞片放毒，激怒附近更强的宝可梦，确保有足够切磋对象，再利用混乱占优。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME discharges poison from its scales that cause stronger Pokémon nearby to grow enraged. It does this to ensure it has ample sparring partners, using the chaos to its advantage.

entry: 与好坏星不同，POKENAME的触手切下后，仍保留美味，因此成为数道昂贵料理的高级食材。不过，得仔细去除遍布全身的咸腥味。
author: bobosmith01
source: Unlike Mareanie, POKENAME's tentacles retain a delicious flavor even when cut, so it is used as a gourmet ingredient in several expensive dishes. Great care is needed to remove the salty smell that permeates all throughout POKENAME's body.

entry: POKENAME一与谁对视，就立刻头撞，以头刺送毒。攻击后保持距离，等着看对手是否被毒制服。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME will immediately headbutt anyone it makes eye contact with, delivering poison through the spikes on its head. After this attack, it will keep its distance, waiting to see if the foe succumbs to poison.

entry: 野生POKENAME结成小帮派，首领是头上毒触手最长的个体。头撞敌人常使触手受损，长回又费时，因此地位不断变化。
author: .jerden
source: Wild POKENAME form small gangs, led by the one with the longest poisonous tentacles on its head. These are often damaged when used to headbutt foes and take a while to regrow, so the hierarchy constantly changes.

entry: POKENAME平趴浅水，触肢向外铺开。若被踩到，就放出强毒，引发高烧。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME lies flat in shallow waters, spreading its tendrils outward. If stepped on, it will release a potent venom that can cause fevers.

entry: POKENAME渗入周围水里的毒，会让触碰者陷入强烈迷恋。很危险，因为受害者可能痴念心上人，反而溺水。
author: .izik
source: The poison that leaks into the water around POKENAME can cause intense infatuation in anyone who touches it. This is dangerous, as victims may drown while obsessing over their beloved.

entry: POKENAME容易无聊，总想找点消遣。通常就是玩弄更小的宝可梦，先蜇一下，看猎物逃走，再扑上去抓回来。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME grow bored easily and find themselves searching for a distraction whenever they do. Their distractions usually involve them toying with a smaller Pokémon, stinging and watching its prey try to get away before they pounce and catch it again.

entry: POKENAME身上渗出的毒，谁碰到都会剧烈头痛。这份防御，让天敌不敢靠近。
author: .izik
source: The poison leaking from POKENAME's body can cause massive headaches to anyone who touches it. This defensive mechanism deters predators from getting too close.

entry: POKENAME高速游过湖面，身后留下毒泡沫，吓退天敌，保护自己。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME swims across lakes at high speeds, leaving poisonous foam behind it. This foam acts as a deterrent to predators, ensuring its safety.

entry: POKENAME用满是毒液的附肢，麻痹、抓住目标，再吃下。胸前旋涡也能催眠天敌，让对方听命。
author: big_clanker
source: POKENAME uses its poison-full appendages to paralyze and apprehend its target before consumption. The swirl on its chest is also used to mesmerize its natural predators into doing its bidding.

entry: POKENAME浮在池面，从尖刺释放薄薄毒膜，让天敌保持安全距离。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME floats along the surface of ponds, releasing a thin toxic film from its spines. The substance keeps predators at a safe distance.

entry: 听见敲鼓，或双脚轻踏声，就能找到POKENAME。若泡泡在你身上破开，可能会涌起难以抗拒的跳舞冲动。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME can be found by either the banging of their drums or by the sound of the tapping of their feet. Should a bubble pop on you, you may feel an overwhelming urge to dance.

entry: POKENAME长触手上，有装毒的细小倒刺，能引起强烈恶心。毒一接触就迅速扩散，让猎物失去行动能力。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's long tentacles hold tiny barbs filled with toxin, capable of causing intense nausea. The toxin spreads quickly upon contact, incapacitating its prey.

entry: POKENAME以触手爬过珊瑚礁，啃食珊瑚。哪怕仅五只，不到一周也能毁掉整片礁，因此保护人士努力控制数量。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME crawls across coral reefs with its tentacles, feasting on the coral. Even a group of five can decimate an entire reef in under a week, so conservationists work to keep them in check.

entry: 炸POKENAME触手配上打发奶油，被视为美味。红莲岛厨师能安全料理，因为烹调时，毒会被除去。
author: .izik
source: Fried POKENAME tentacles served with whipped cream are considered a delicacy. Chefs on Cinnabar Island prepare them safely, as the poison cooks out during preparation.

entry: 好坏星附上呆呆兽，就形成POKENAME。强毒激活了通常只在伽勒尔形态呆壳兽身上，才会出现的特征。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME comes into being when a Mareanie latches onto a Slowpoke. Mareanie's strong toxins have activated traits in POKENAME that are usually only present in Galarian Slowbro.

entry: POKENAME虽然剧毒，触手仍被采作珍稀汤品的原料。美食家常激烈争论，究竟哪个头的触手最好吃。
author: ozydamians
source: Despite its extreme toxicity, POKENAME tentacles are harvested as ingredients for rare soups and broths. Fierce debates are held among gourmands over which head's tentacles taste best.

entry: POKENAME吃海底垃圾，补充触手里的毒。吸来的毒素，让它在原生环境尤其危险。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME fuels the poison in its tentacles by eating trash off the ocean floor. The toxins it absorbs make it a dangerous foe, especially in its native environment.

entry: POKENAME的黏滑外膜酸性极强，连铁也能侵蚀。它趴在海底吃碎屑，在有毒环境生活得很好。
author: .izik
source: The slimy film covering POKENAME's body is highly acidic, capable of eroding even iron. It lays on the ocean floor, eating debris and thriving in its toxic environment.

entry: 鲜亮的硬壳，是给天敌看的警告。可倒刺里的毒，还没成熟到能真正发挥效用。
author: xephyr
source: The vibrancy of its hard shell is meant to ward off predators. However, the poison in its barbs has not matured into an effective toxin yet.

entry: POKENAME的壳坚如岩，覆满致命毒刺。它用可伸缩内刺，刺中猎物、拖进壳，再以小而畸形的牙啃食。
author: mr.bonesii
source: POKENAME's shell is rock-solid and covered with deadly, venomous spines. It uses a retractable inner spine to stab prey and drag them into its shell, where it gnaws on them with its small, misshapen teeth.

entry: POKENAME的爪有细小倒刺，各覆强毒。一旦感到威胁或受挑衅，双钳就是致命武器。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's claws have tiny barbs, each coated in potent poison. This makes its pincers a deadly weapon when it feels threatened or provoked.

entry: 这只宝可梦切下好坏星的触手，夹在钳中，充当毒拳套。POKENAME自己也不免疫，因此带着触手走时，必须格外小心。
author: milchik
source: This Pokémon cuts off pieces of tentacles from Mareanie and holds them in its claws, using them as venomous boxing gloves of sorts. POKENAME itself isn't immune to this venom, so it has to be extra careful when carrying these tentacles around.

entry: POKENAME的毒让它臭如烂蛋。虽跑不快，却能用心灵感应，找出躲藏的宝可梦，再以毒刺戳击。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's poison gives it a strong stench, like rotten eggs. Although it cannot move quickly, it uses telepathy to locate other Pokémon that are hiding, then jabs them with its venomous spikes.

entry: POKENAME用带刺手臂，将头完全罩住自保。靠心灵感应察觉周围，直到目标背对自己，才会放下戒备攻击。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME protects itself from harm by completely covering its heads with its spiky arms. It senses its surroundings using telepathy and will not lower its guard to attack until its target faces away from it.

entry: POKENAME身体大多是一条带刺肢体，既可像伞遮阳，更是主要武器。利刺击中敌人，就会送入强毒。
author: .jerden
source: Most of POKENAME's body consists of a single, spiky limb. It uses this like a parasol to shade itself from the sun, but it is primarily a weapon, delivering potent poison to any foe struck by its sharp spines.

entry: POKENAME的刺毒性偏弱，因此特别爱用结实断珊瑚作武器。不打架时，也很适合拿来挠痒痒的背。
author: sk372
source: A sturdy piece of broken coral is POKENAME's particular weapon of choice, as the toxins in POKENAME's spikes are rather weak. When not using it to fight, it works quite effectively as a way for POKENAME to scratch its itchy back.

entry: POKENAME被认为是最有效的太阳珊瑚猎手之一，常在礁旁浅滩。它以尖珊瑚刺中猎物，翻到岸上，再用头锤砸开，裹进毒触肢。
author: ghostslythe
source: Thought of as one of the most effective Corsola hunters, POKENAME is found on shoals around reefs. Using sharpened coral, it spears its prey, flipping it onto the land. The beached Pokémon is cracked open by a Headbutt and wrapped in toxic tendrils.

entry: POKENAME全身毒刺，少量注毒就让受害者肌肉僵硬。经常由角注入的大剂量，会使肌肉逐渐变硬、凝固，常导致全身麻痹。
author: chibitales
source: Each of the stingers on POKENAME's body releases venom that, in small doses, causes the victim's muscles to stiffen. Larger doses, often injected via the horn, force these muscles to gradually harden and solidify, often leading to full paralysis.

entry: POKENAME独自捕猎，从全身发射毒刺，让猎物失去行动能力。等动不了，再用强力触手撕成能吃的块状。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is a solitary hunter, firing toxic spines from all over its body to incapacitate its prey. Once immobilized, it will rip its catch into edible pieces using its strong tentacles.

entry: POKENAME所有刺都带微量毒，最浓的却在头角。它领地意识极强，无论人或宝可梦，只要出现在巢中，就会被攻击。
author: evilgammon
source: While all of POKENAME's spikes contain trace amounts of poison, the most concentrated form of this venom is found in the horn on its head. It is extremely territorial, attacking human and Pokémon alike if they are spotted in its lair.

entry: POKENAME常见于丰缘丛林，性情内敛，以四条毒臂飞行。对训练家却体贴得意外，会护着免伤，再以毒刺围住威胁者。
author: ghostslythe
source: Generally found in the jungles of Hoenn, POKENAME is a reserved Pokémon that flies using four of its venomous arms. Surprisingly nurturing to its Trainer, it will shield them from harm while surrounding threats in toxic barbs.

entry: POKENAME住在丛林，吸食热带繁茂植物的汁液。头顶致命双钳能切岩，尖刺的烈毒，更让受害者无路可逃。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME dwells in the jungle, feeding on the sap of plants that thrive in tropical climates. It has deadly pincers atop its head capable of slicing through rock, while its spines carry a lethal toxin that leaves no escape for its victims.

entry: POKENAME住在丛林，吸食热带繁茂植物的汁液。头顶致命双钳能切岩，尖刺的烈毒，更让受害者无路可逃。
author: fiordaliso
source: It dwells in the jungle, feeding on the sap of plants that thrive in tropical climates. POKENAME has deadly pincers atop its head capable of slicing through rock, while its spines carry a lethal toxin that leaves no escape for its victims.

entry: POKENAME不论变成什么形态，背上毒甲都会保留。铠甲随变身长大、缩小，始终覆盖所选形态的背部。
author: evilgammon
source: When POKENAME transforms, any form it takes retains the toxic armour on its back. This armour grows or shrinks in size depending on the transformation, always covering the back of POKENAME's chosen form.

entry: POKENAME见到会动的东西，就会攻击，连同族也不放过。这种融合体，对珊瑚礁危害极大。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME will attack anything that moves, including others of the same species. This fusion wrecks havoc on coral reefs.

entry: POKENAME用壳前大肢按住猎物，让多条触手有时间注毒。麻痹后，再拖回水下家中吃掉。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses the large limbs at the front of its shell to pin down prey long enough to administer venom from its many tentacles. Once paralyzed, it drags them back to its underwater home to consume them.

entry: POKENAME每周只离开岛上家园一次，外出捕猎。翼火生出剧毒烟雾，吸入者麻痹、剧痛，轻易就被饥饿的它猎走。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME ventures out only once a week from its island home to hunt. The flames on its wings generate terribly toxic fumes that leave those who inhale them paralyzed and wracked with pain, easily picked off by the hungry POKENAME.

entry: 融合给了POKENAME惊人的超能力，可它只把力量，用来恐吓当地的太阳珊瑚群。
author: nellnast42
source: Fusion has granted POKENAME incredible psychic powers. However, it only uses these abilities to terrorize local Corsola populations.

entry: POKENAME野外极少见，躲在尾巴的圆顶下，随即隐形。被刺扎到，会失忆整整三天。
author: sk372
source: Extremely rare to see in the wild, POKENAME hides beneath the dome on its tail, turning invisible shortly after. Those pricked by its spines suffer a three-day long bout of amnesia.

entry: POKENAME气味诱人，却带着毒。即使毒气让人痛苦不堪，许多宝可梦仍不顾一切，寻香而来。
author: cristata
source: POKENAME have an alluring yet toxic scent. Despite the excruciating pain from the fumes, many Pokémon will still blindly seek it out.

entry: 带刺附肢既保护身体，也能以多种方式，向敌人引导火焰。每根刺一碰就烫，还分泌会灼伤的毒。
author: infinex21
source: Its spiked appendages provide ample protection and a range of ways to channel its flames at its foes. Each of its spikes are burning hot to the touch and secrete a burn-inducing poison.

entry: POKENAME用丝造出穹顶，躲避天敌。也用网捕猎，先以毒麻痹，再裹起来，留待之后吃。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME are create domes made out of string to shield themselves from predators. POKENAME also use their webs for hunting, paralyzing their prey with venom before wrapping them up for later consumption.

entry: POKENAME的带刺四肢，既行走，也捕猎。它四处飞，发现目标，就由上俯冲，用四片翅膀一同注入强毒。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's spiked limbs work both for locomotion as well as hunting. It flies about until it spots potential prey, dive-bombing it from above and injecting powerful toxins into it with all four of its wings.

entry: POKENAME的毒液导电效率惊人。受威胁时，经倒刺导雷，电击想来捕食的敌人。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's venom conducts electricity with terrifying efficiency. When threatened, it channels lightning through its barbs to shock would-be predators.

entry: 毒液让受害者对光极其敏感。即使服了解药，它发出的光，也仍会引起偏头痛。
author: staghorn
source: Its poison makes its victims extremely sensitive to light. Even if the victim takes an antidote, the light it emits will still give them migraines.

entry: 它是热带宝可梦，静伏潟湖，往水里放毒。看似不好，毒性却只够清除细菌与寄生生物。当地人奉POKENAME为洁净的象征。
author: slimmagma
source: A tropical Pokémon, it stays motionless in lagoons, poisoning the waters. Whilst this may seem bad, its poison is only potent enough to clear the waters of bacteria and parasites. POKENAME is locally worshipped as an icon of hygiene.

entry: 它把爪扎进敌人或猎物，再对着扇翅，将毒刺压入体内。也能下水猎捕，再将猎物拉上空中。
author: infinex21
source: It digs its claws into foes and prey, then flaps its wings against them to drive its poisonous spikes into their bodies. It can swim underwater in search of prey and then pull them up into the air.

entry: POKENAME剧毒，却相对温顺。哪怕被尖刺轻轻扎一下，也可能立刻休克。
author: frokachu
source: POKENAME are highly poisonous, but are relatively docile. Getting poked by one of its thorns even slightly can immediately send someone into shock.

entry: POKENAME不在乎自己乱撞受伤，因为伤口好得极快。嘴张得太大时，偶尔会不慎吞下自己射出的刺。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME does not care about the injuries it gets for carelessly bumping into objects since those wounds heal extremely quickly. When it leaves its mouth open wide, it can sometimes accidentally swallow its own spike that it released.

entry: POKENAME用触手遮脸，保护眼睛免受强光。夜幕降临，就守在沙滩，等待扑向被浪冲上的太阳珊瑚。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME covers its face with its tentacles to protect its eyes from the bright sunlight. Once night falls, it waits along sandy beaches, waiting to pounce on Corsola that wash ashore.

entry: POKENAME把触肢毒刺扎进猎物，注毒。强烈致幻效果，让受害者看见最深的恐惧成真。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME stab the spikes on their tendrils into prey, injecting toxins into their bodies. This toxin has intense hallucinatory effects, making victims see their greatest fears come to life.

entry: POKENAME住在海底，主要吃珊瑚。战斗时，以磁力射出毒刺，让敌人麻痹，毒性甚至足以让吼鲸王昏倒。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME are known to dwell at the bottom of oceans, primarily eating coral. In battle, POKENAME use magnetism to shoot their poison barbs at foes, paralyzing them with a toxin strong enough to faint a Wailord.

entry: POKENAME外表虽威严，危险却只来自意外。它胆怯易惊，一被吓，就不假思索地挥出毒尖肢体。
author: sk372
source: Despite its imposing appearance, POKENAME is only dangerous in an accidental sense. It is quite timid and jumpy, and swings at anything that startles it with its poison-tipped limbs without thinking.

entry: POKENAME的壳以美丽受珍视，鲜艳色泽与奇异形状，让许多收藏家爱不释手。人们在珊瑚礁，循浓厚黏液轨迹寻找。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME shells are prized for their beauty, the vivid colours and exotic shape of the shell making them a valued addition to many collections. Collectors seek out POKENAME within coral reefs, following their thick trail of mucus to find the Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME的壳以美丽受珍视，鲜艳色泽与奇异形状，让许多收藏家爱不释手。泳者收集时得小心，因为它能从壳中发射毒刺。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME shells are prized for their beauty, the vivid colours and exotic shape of the shell making them a valued addition to many collections. Swimmers are advised to be wary of collecting the shells as POKENAME can launch venomous barbs from them.

entry: POKENAME背上的枝梗装满强力珊瑚毒液。水中敌人哪怕只轻轻擦过，也会严重麻痹。
author: .izik
source: The stalks on POKENAME's back are filled with a potent coral-based venom. Even a brush against them can cause intense paralysis in aquatic foes.

entry: POKENAME用倒刺触手裹住猎物，直到对方被强毒制服。某些地区把它视为珍馐，不过只能由专业人士料理。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME wraps its prey with its barbed tentacles and then holds them there until they succumb to its powerful toxin. POKENAME is a rare delicacy in some regions; however, they should only be prepared by professionals.

entry: POKENAME大量吞食污染水域里密集的碎屑。因此，全球科学家追踪它的种群，监测生态健康。
author: turron_turron
source: POKENAME feast on the high concentrations of detritus found in polluted waters. Due to this behavior, scientists across the world track POKENAME populations in an effort to monitor ecological health.

entry: POKENAME能在带刺触肢下蜷起身体，筑成坚实防线。它探头喷出毒液水柱，随即又缩回。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME can curl up its body under its spiked tendrils, creating a solid defensive wall. It pokes its head out to fire jets of venom before retreating again.

entry: POKENAME全身毒刺驱退来犯者，感到威胁就伏低贴地。种群一大，难以迁走，可能广泛破坏生态。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are covered in toxic spines to deter attackers and will hunker down close to the ground if it feels threatened. Large populations can cause widespread damage to an ecosystem due to the difficulty in relocating them.

entry: POKENAME兜帽上的花纹，像太阳珊瑚的脸。它潜入群落，赶在被发现前吃掉珊瑚枝。
author: hophoppip
source: The pattern on POKENAME's hood resembles a Corsola's face. It sneaks into Corsola colonies and consumes the branches before it can be caught.

entry: POKENAME漫游珊瑚礁，收集受伤的太阳珊瑚。轻轻放进育儿袋，再以倒刺注入药液，麻木痛感，加快康复。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME roams coral reefs, collecting wounded Corsola. It stores them gently in its pouch, injecting a barbed serum that numbs pain and speeds recovery.

entry: POKENAME的毒会造成最长3天的暂时麻痹。患处感觉像石头，若没及时处理，还可能蔓延全身。
author: vlavoc
source: The poison from a POKENAME causes a temporary paralysis lasting up to 3 days. It can make the affected area feel as though it's made of stone, and it can spread throughout the entire body if not treated quickly enough.

entry: POKENAME用再生极快的触手覆身作甲，看似从不受伤。跺脚能摧毁整片珊瑚礁，挥触手又在身后撒下层层毒菱。
author: soup1900
source: Armoring its entire body with its extremely regenerative tentacles, no damage ever seems to be taken by POKENAME. Its stomps can collapse entire coral reefs while its tentacles swing around and scatter layers of Toxic Spikes in its wake.

entry: POKENAME吐出的暗色火焰，还不如随后产生的紫烟危险。烟剧毒无比，吸入少量也会致命。
author: sk372
source: The dark-colored fire that POKENAME breathes out is less dangerous than what comes after. The purple smoke its fire creates is incredibly toxic, being lethal if only a small amount is inhaled.

entry: POKENAME使出电磁飘浮，持续在空中冲浪。战斗时用刺尾猛击，以雷电与毒的双重力量，让敌人失去行动能力。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME constantly surfs through the air, using Magnet Rise to keep itself elevated. In battle, it slams foes with its spiked tail, crippling them with a combination of lightning and poison.

entry: POKENAME贴水低飞捕猎，再飞走享用。也会栖在岩上，留意路过的太阳珊瑚，当作饭后点心。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME fly low over the surface of the water to catch prey before flying away to feast. They perch atop rocks to keep a lookout for passing Corsola to snack on as dessert.

entry: POKENAME用体内毒液，在网上猎捕恶意程序。可惜容易弄混，也可能攻击无关程序。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses the venom stored within its body to hunt down malware on the internet. Unfortunately, it is easily confused and can attack unrelated programs in the process.

entry: 有POKENAME出没的丛林，十分危险。它平趴在地上，谁若踩到它的尾巴，就会挨上一蜇，剧痛足以让人接连三天痛不欲生。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: The jungle is a dangerous place with POKENAME around. It will lie flat on the ground, and stepping on its tail will result in a sting so painful that one will be in agony for three days straight.

entry: POKENAME酷似远方国度的一位伟大战士。据说中了它的迷人，就会遭到可怕诅咒。
author: shocktopus1717
source: POKENAME resembles a great warrior from a faraway land. It is said those who fall for its Attract will suffer a terrible curse.

entry: POKENAME本能地折断太阳珊瑚的枝，欺负对方。不过，太阳珊瑚一哭，它便犹豫着离开。
author: musicsheep.
source: POKENAME instinctively bullies Corsola by snapping off their branches. When Corsola starts to cry, POKENAME hesitates and leaves.

entry: POKENAME将带刺石头贴在崖壁，伺机跃到目标上，用尖刺注毒、吸取力量。吸能时，幽灵形态现身，开心地咯咯笑。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME lets its spiny stone stick to cliff faces until it is time to leap onto something, poisoning and draining its strength with its spikes. As it siphons energy, its spectral form appears and cackles with glee.

entry: POKENAME的壳甲硬如钢，轻易挡下强力身体攻击。铠甲虽厚，身手却意外敏捷，以惊人动作压制对手。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME's shell plating is as strong as steel, able to shrug off powerful physical attacks with ease. Despite its armor, it is surprisingly agile, using impressive maneuvers to dominate its opponent.

entry: POKENAME的刺飞行时空气阻力极小，能从远处射向敌人。一见珊瑚礁，就如子弹潜入水下，捕捉最爱的太阳珊瑚。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's spikes are both very aerodynamic and have little air resistance, allowing it to launch them at foes from long range. When it spots a coral reef, it instantly dives below the surface like a bullet to catch its favorite prey, Corsola.

entry: POKENAME住在暖海，猎捕太阳珊瑚。它以触手困住猎物，分泌能麻痹身体的毒性消化酶。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME live in warmer parts of the ocean where they hunt their prey: Corsola. POKENAME hunt by ensnaring their prey with their tentacles, which excrete a paralyzing but toxic digestive enzyme.

entry: POKENAME能察觉挑战者将近领地，会格外好斗地准备迎战。观察这行为，可预判稀有强大融合体的出现。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME can sense when a challenger will soon approach its territory and will become especially aggressive to prepare for it. This behavior can be used to predict the appearance of rare and powerful fusions.

entry: 这只臃肿生物浮在水面下，伪装成废弃科研圆顶。谁好奇靠近，就会遇上十二条倒刺肢体与震耳尖叫。
author: jaminmcready
source: This bloated creature floats just under the surface, disguised as an abandoned research dome. Anything curious enough to approach is met with a dozen barbed limbs and a deafening shriek.

entry: POKENAME施展空手道般的复杂动作，同时从腿放出极热毒液，几乎立刻让目标高烧。
author: .izik
source: While pulling off complex karate-like maneuvers, POKENAME fires incredibly hot venom from its legs. This poison can cause intense fevers almost instantly.

entry: POKENAME很为模样自豪，常仔细用岩石磨刺。每群通常四至五只。
author: mepp.
source: As POKENAME takes great pride in its appearance, it is often seen meticulously sharpening its spines on rocks. Flocks of POKENAME typically consist of four to five members.

entry: POKENAME是极严酷的首领，对部下要求很高。失败者会挨毒刺惩罚，剧痛持续数天。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is an extremely harsh taskmaster in regards to its leadership. It holds its troops to a high standard, with failure punished via being stung by its poisonous spines, leading to several days of excruciating pain.

entry: POKENAME静伏珊瑚礁，装成珊瑚。太阳珊瑚靠太近，就猛合双颚，力道足以咬碎钢铁。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME lies still on coral reefs, posing as coral. When Corsola wander too close, it snaps shut its jaw, which is powerful enough to shatter steel.

entry: POKENAME潜行海底，装成无害的海洋生物，轻易便能靠近毫无防备的太阳珊瑚群。
author: nellnast42
source: POKENAME skulks across the ocean floor, disguised as a harmless sea creature. This lets it easily sneak up on unsuspecting Corsola populations.

entry: POKENAME用覆着浓稠透明毒液的触须，抽打敌人。接触后可能咳嗽不止、发烧，有时甚至失明。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's feelers are coated in a thick transparent toxin that it slaps at foes. Contact can cause a mix of coughing fits, fevers, and in some cases blindness.

entry: 尖刺末端一碰到东西，就放出剧痛毒液。若不处理，甚至会损伤神经。不过，它们很少主动争斗，只挥动触肢吓退威胁。
author: infinex21
source: Their spikes release a painful venom when the tips come into contact with something; if untreated, this venom will damage the very nerves. They rarely seek conflict, however, and merely wave their tendrils about to deter threats.

entry: 它耐心躲在带刺的拱壳下面。太阳珊瑚一游过，壳便打开，POKENAME射出致命毒弹。
author: nellnast42
source: It waits patiently sheltered under its spiky dome. When Corsola swim by, the dome opens up, and POKENAME fires off a lethal toxic bullet.

entry: POKENAME四只耳朵的力气，足以撑起身体。听觉灵敏度是长耳兔的两倍，因此遇上巨响就逃。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's four ears are strong enough to support its body weight. Its hearing is twice as sensitive as a Lopunny's, so it will flee from loud noises.

entry: POKENAME利刺的毒，能让人痛上一周。它极其记仇，无论多久前，只要认为人或宝可梦对不起自己，就会无情追击。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's sharp spikes carry poison that can cause pain for a week. It is incredibly vindictive and will mercilessly pursue any Pokémon or human it feels has wronged it, no matter how long ago the event happened.

entry: 这贪玩的融合体，奇怪地喜欢泳池玩具。想从POKENAME手中拿回偷走的玩具，可能严重中毒，所以最好先收好。
author: hophoppip
source: This playful fusion is oddly drawn to pool toys. Trying to take the toys back from a POKENAME who's swiped them may result in severe poisoning, so it's best to hide the pool toys in the presence of a POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME十分暴躁，用毒触肢缠住猎物就绝不放开。大眼看见的几乎一切，都会成为目标。
author: foolish_weasel
source: This Pokémon is very violent. POKENAME will wrap its venomous tendrils around its prey and never let it go. It will target nearly anything its large eyes lay sight on.

entry: POKENAME不织网，喜欢在珊瑚礁周围捕猎。尖刺产生麻痹毒，2分钟内就能让太阳珊瑚动不了。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME do not build webs, as they prefer to hunt around coral reefs. It produces a paralyzing venom from its spines, powerful enough to immobilize a Corsola within 2 minutes.

entry: 它躲在隐蔽角落，等宝可梦被网中电流震晕，才现身。若猎物逃走，POKENAME就跟踪，在前路再织一张覆满致命毒素的网。
author: lordjoostmeister
source: It lurks in hidden nooks, only emerging when Pokémon are stunned by its web's electrical charge. If prey manage to escape, POKENAME will stalk them and weave a second web in their path, coated with a deadly toxin.

entry: POKENAME体内各种毒素，能燃出独特霓虹火焰。据说长期接触产生的蒸气，会折寿。
author: turron_turron
source: The bodies of POKENAME contain various toxins that burn with distinctive, neon flames. Prolonged exposure to the vapors produced by POKENAME is said to reduce one's lifespan.

entry: POKENAME以海上恐怖闻名，水手互相讲述它的骇人凶暴。细长抓握肢体，会从船上拽走水手，拉入洞窟般的巨口。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME is known as a terror of the sea, with sailors swapping stories of its horrific brutality. Its long, grasping limbs rip sailors from their boats and pull them into its cavernous maw.

entry: POKENAME的毒一接触氧气，就产生大量热。它用来先煮熟猎物，保护敏感的胃，免受细菌伤害。
author: turron_turron
source: POKENAME toxins produce high amounts of heat when exposed to oxygen. They use this property to cook their prey prior to consumption, protecting their sensitive stomachs from bacteria.

entry: POKENAME有许多手臂可注毒、撕敌，主要却用发育最好的两条，看起来像小头。它聪明绝顶，不停盘算如何统治珊瑚礁，尽情吃珊瑚。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME has many arms it can use to poison and tear at foes, but it mostly uses the two most developed arms that look like small heads. It has a vast intellect that constantly schemes the best plan to control reefs and eat all the coral it wants.

entry: 下半身的多片“瓣”能合成炮，释放扰乱方向感的毒雾。这种宝可梦拥有心灵感应，轻易就能避开或找到其他生物。
author: infinex21
source: The multiple "flaps" of its lower half can come together to form a cannon through which it will release a disorienting, poisonous mist. This species of Pokémon boasts telepathic abilities that let them avoid or seek others with ease.

entry: POKENAME的毒会造成强烈灼烧感，持续九天九夜。遇袭，或珍视的尾巴被弄脏，就会喷出火焰与毒蒸气。
author: infinex21
source: Those afflicted with poison from POKENAME experience a severe burning sensation that can last for nine days and nights. They spew flames and poisonous vapors when attacked or when their precious tails are sullied.

entry: POKENAME睡在卷起的刺触肢中。若有人想滥用它的力量，就展开触肢，以神经毒攻击，把对方困在最渴望的幻境里。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME slumbers while wrapped in its spiky tendrils. If someone approaches it to abuse its power, it will unfurl its tendrils before striking them with a neurotoxin that will trap them in an illusion of their greatest fantasy.

entry: 发红光的眼睛能感知热量，让POKENAME看透最暗深海。它徘徊海底，尽可能猎捕太阳珊瑚。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Its glowing red eyes can sense heat, which allows it to see through the darkest depths of the ocean. POKENAME prowls on the ocean floor hunting Corsola wherever possible.

entry: POKENAME住在水下洞穴，耐心等猎物游过，再从上方伏击。刺毒虽然极强，却更喜欢直接把猎物咬成两半。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME live in underwater caves, patiently waiting for its prey to swim by before ambushing them from above. Despite having an incredibly potent poison in its spines, POKENAME prefers to just bite its prey in half.

entry: POKENAME贪婪吞下遇到的一切珊瑚，唯独留下装点杖顶的那些。法杖是施展强大诅咒的媒介。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME voraciously devours any coral it comes across, save for the pieces it uses to top its staff. The staff serves as a focus for powerful curses.

entry: POKENAME或许是世界上最凶猛、善用毒的融合体之一。多爪、多刺，几乎有无数办法钩住猎物，注入强烈削弱身体的毒。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is perhaps one of the most aggressively venomous fusions in the world. Its many claws and spines offer it nearly countless ways to latch onto prey and deliver an incredibly debilitating poison.

entry: POKENAME一出现在浅水，周围就争相逃命。触手抓住逃走猎物，送入口中，双颚连刺甲贝的壳也能咬穿。
author: bandedbodypress
source: When POKENAME appears in the shallows, it becomes a mad rush to escape. Its tentacles grab fleeing prey to bring to its mouth. Its jaws can snap right through the shell of Cloyster.

entry: POKENAME残暴无比，用牙撕敌，向攻击者射毒针。尾鳍让水中动作格外灵活，因此也深受水上竞赛欢迎。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is exceedingly brutal, ripping into foes with its teeth and launching venomous needles at attackers. The caudal fins allow POKENAME exceptional maneuverability, making it a popular Pokémon in aquatic competitions.

entry: POKENAME捕猎时，用满是毒刺的翅膀裹住猎物，注入削弱身体的毒。它似乎偏爱小型宝可梦，因为毒生效更快。
author: chibitales
source: When hunting, POKENAME wrap their stinger-laden wings around prey, injecting a weakening poison. They seem to prefer hunting smaller Pokémon, as the poison takes hold much quicker.

entry: POKENAME吸干珊瑚礁的生命与颜色，转成能量，只为自己得利，让礁死成灰色。为了在冷水生存，它向海底发射激光，开出专属地热喷口。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME drains coral reefs of their life and color to create energy, leaving them dead and gray for its own gain. To survive cold waters, it fires a laser into the ocean floor to open its own personal geothermal vent.

entry: POKENAME随洋流漂行，倒刺深钩船壳。水手常当成藤壶腐蚀，置之不理，直到太迟。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's barbs anchor deep into ship hulls as it drifts with the current. Sailors often mistake the damage for barnacle corrosion, ignoring it until it's too late.

entry: POKENAME困扰各地区海滩，常被冲上岸，再钻进沙里。安顿后，剧毒倒刺让它极难移走。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME plagues beaches across every region, often washing up on shore and burrowing into the sand. Once settled, it is extremely difficult to remove due to its highly poisonous barbs.

entry: POKENAME突然擒抱毫无防备的猎物，紧紧挤压，让尖刺扎入，释放强毒，了结对方。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME attacks by grappling unsuspecting prey. It then squeezes tightly so its spines can pierce and release a potent toxin to finish its prey off.

entry: POKENAME天生贪婪，占据沙漠绿洲，禁止其他生物靠近。谁敢来，就被长臂反手痛打，每根刺还带着强毒。
author: sk372
source: Greedy by nature, POKENAME stakes a claim over desert oases and forbids others from approaching. Those that try get pummeled by painful backhands from its long arms, with spikes that each contain highly potent toxins.

entry: POKENAME慢慢走过冷海底，寻找最爱的太阳珊瑚。先将猎物赶进毒菱，再尾随逐渐虚弱的对方，直到动不了。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME slowly cross the floor of cold seas in search of their favored prey, Corsola. After chasing Corsola into a set of Toxic Spikes, they stalk the weakening Pokémon until it is too weak to move.

entry: POKENAME结群漫游北极海域，寻找适合庞大体型的猎物。它们召起覆满毒菱的冰墙，合力围困目标，身上纱幕随心情闪着鲜色。
author: chibitales
source: Herds of POKENAME roam arctic seas, searching for prey to suit their large sizes. They work together to corner their prey by summoning walls of ice covered in Toxic Spikes. Their veils shimmer in bright colors depending on their mood.

entry: POKENAME将触手贴身卷起保温，一发抖就放出真菌孢子。主要吃退潮时找到的海带，也会用利爪破椰子，吃多汁果肉。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME keeps its tentacles curled against its body to retain body heat and releases fungal spores whenever it shivers. Its main diet consists of kelp found at low tide, but it also breaks coconuts with its sharp claws to eat the juicy flesh inside.

entry: POKENAME拳中的毒，含有造成麻痹的成分。人们正在研究，能否将这些成分安全加入麻醉药。
author: chibitales
source: The poison from the punch of a POKENAME contains compounds that cause paralysis. Efforts are being made to see if the compounds could be safely added to anesthetics.

entry: POKENAME伏击目标，以抓握手臂，将猎物拉入胸腔。困住后，内部尖刺伸出，刺中不幸受害者，注入毒液。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME ambushes its target, using its grasping arms to pull its prey into its chest cavity. Once the victim is trapped, spikes extend from within, pricking and poisoning the unfortunate casualty.

entry: POKENAME是残暴而高效的猎手，在珊瑚礁潜行，以鲜色混入环境，再精准致命地扑向目标。它用剧毒，消灭敌人与猎物。
author: nyoomymph
source: POKENAME is a brutally efficient predator. It stalks coral reefs, using its bright colours to blend in with the environment, and pounces with deadly accuracy upon its chosen target. POKENAME utilizes toxic poison to eliminate its foes and prey alike.

entry: POKENAME用毒刺攻击侵入领地的人或宝可梦。鳞皮坚韧无比，打消耗战时，只要成功让敌人中毒，通常就能撑得比对方久。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME use their toxic spines to attack any people or Pokémon that intrude on their territory. Their scaly skin is incredibly tough, and in a battle of attrition, POKENAME will usually outlast any foe they manage to poison.

entry: POKENAME身体微闪，模仿心之鳞片的光泽。潜水者若受骗靠近，就会遭到毒倒刺鞭击。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME's body faintly glimmers, mimicking the shine of a Heart Scale. If any divers are fooled by the disguise and approach, it will lash out with its venom-laced barbs.

entry: POKENAME无声潜行珊瑚礁，用彩色触手混进珊瑚。它仔细留意礁间动静，太阳珊瑚一经过，就扑上去。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME creep silently through coral reefs, relying on their colourful tentacles to camouflage them against the coral. They watch carefully for movement in the reef, pouncing on any Corsola that crosses their path.

entry: POKENAME常伏在海滩或浮在水上，抱头想缓解持续头痛。刺里的毒，也会让被击中者同样疼痛。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME is often seen hunkered down on beaches or floating in water, clutching its head in an attempt to relieve constant headaches. The poison in its spikes can cause similar pain in those it strikes.

entry: POKENAME能向上折起鬃毛，形成保护头部的锥体。它对陆地生物温和，对海洋居民却有点爱欺负。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can fold its mane upward to act as a defensive cone for its head. It is mild-mannered towards terrestrial creatures, but has a bit of a bullying streak when it comes to ocean dwellers.

entry: POKENAME徘徊群岛上空，捕鱼、欺负小宝可梦。太常挑弱者下手，真遇上势均力敌或更强的对手，反而很少准备充分。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME hovers around archipelago regions, fishing and finding small Pokémon to pick on. It picks on weaker creatures so often that it is rarely prepared to take on an opponent equal to or stronger than it.

entry: POKENAME的毒削弱目标的精神防线，再一道精神脉冲，就让生动骇人的幻觉充满脑海。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's venom weakens a target's mental defenses. With a single psychic pulse, it floods the mind with vivid and terrifying hallucinations.

entry: 哪怕单只POKENAME，数天也能毁掉一片珊瑚礁。它扯下太阳珊瑚的碎块作食物、战利品，再任其再生。保护人士训练磨牙彩皮鱼，把它赶离脆弱栖地。
author: pjporwoll
source: Even a lone POKENAME can devastate a coral reef in days, tearing pieces from Corsola for food and trophies before letting them regenerate. Conservationists train Bruxish to drive them away from sensitive habitats.

entry: POKENAME常在海岸城镇表演，用音乐吸引人。有时会以头上的腿，和喜欢音乐的游客共舞。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME often perform at coastal towns, drawing people in with their music. They sometimes use the legs on their head to dance with tourists that enjoy the music.

entry: POKENAME极危险，刺毒强得足以放倒整只吼鲸王。它主要猎大型鱼类宝可梦，用强爪撕碎。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are incredibly dangerous as the poison in their spines is potent enough to take out a whole Wailord. They mostly hunts large fish Pokémon, ripping them apart with their powerful claws.

entry: POKENAME极其沉重，全靠强大的双腿，才能游泳。水手畏惧它，因为故事中，它会用能抓握的肢体捉住船，拖往海底。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME is extremely heavy and can only swim thanks to its incredibly powerful legs. It's feared by sailors due to stories of it grabbing boats with its grasping limbs and dragging them to the ocean floor.

entry: POKENAME体力弱，却以强毒弥补。它更喜欢跑向可信的大型宝可梦求保护；可若独自被逼入绝境，就会将毒刺撞向天敌，自卫反击。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME are physically weak, but they compensate with a highly potent poison. While they prefer running to larger, trusted Pokémon for protection, if cornered alone, they will defensively ram their toxic spikes into predators.

entry: POKENAME几乎总伏低身体，只露尾巴。它用尾上毒倒刺钩住小型海洋生物，再拖进庇护处吃掉。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME is almost always seen hunkered down, with only its tail poking out. It uses this tail to snag small sea creatures on its venomous barbs, then draws them into its shelter to eat.

entry: POKENAME态度强硬，中间的头最凶。其他宝可梦都远离它的领地。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME has a strong attitude, with the middle head being the most aggressive. Other Pokémon stay far away from a POKENAME's territory.

entry: POKENAME的舌能伸得极长，像钩子取回远物。垂进水里，就以舌尖毒倒刺钩猎物。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME can extend its tongue to extreme lengths, using it like a hook to retrieve distant objects. It lowers the tongue into the water to fish, snagging prey with the poisonous barb at its apex.

entry: POKENAME用带甲利刺，打破冰封海面上的厚冰。破冰而出后，就在水面上捕猎熟睡生物。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its armored spikes to smash through ice sheets above frozen seas. Once through, it hunts above the surface for sleeping prey.

entry: POKENAME常住在污水、密集船骸中，腐蚀性身体几乎能溶解任何材料。它藏起脸，混入废物与海床，躲避察觉。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are common residents of filth-ridden waters and dense shipwrecks, their corrosive bodies being capable of dissolving nearly any material. To avoid detection, they conceal their faces and blend in with waste and the seabed.

entry: POKENAME从刺壳突出的炮口，喷出紫色毒液水柱，击倒猎物。它与超坏星合作，袭掠珊瑚礁，囤下成群太阳珊瑚。
author: fiordaliso
source: To bring down prey, POKENAME fires jets of violet venom from the cannons protruding from its spiky shell. It teams up with Toxapex to raid coral reefs and hoard schools of Corsola.

entry: POKENAME极具攻击性，谁想打扰，就夹住、注入强力神经毒。非得耗尽体力，或被强行撬开，才肯松手。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is very aggressive and if anything tries to disturb it, it will clamp down on them and inject them with a powerful neurotoxin. It will not let go until it either runs out of energy or is pried off by force.

entry: POKENAME能在北极海水休眠数周，等待猎物。射出的沉重毒刺，能麻痹成年吼鲸王，长回却要三天。
author: mr.bonesii
source: POKENAME can lie dormant in arctic waters for weeks, waiting for prey. It shoots heavy, toxic spikes that can paralyze a grown Wailord and take three days to regenerate.

entry: 阳光让POKENAME的皮肤硬化、干燥。入夜，便离开洞穴，试着骗别人给食物。
author: turron_turron
source: Exposure to sunlight causes POKENAME's skin to become hard and dry. During the night, POKENAME venture out from their caves and attempt to trick people into giving them food.

entry: POKENAME感到威胁，就展开头上触手威吓。双钳藏着许多毒倒刺，先削弱猎物，再将其撕碎。
author: mistymagius
source: When POKENAME feels threatened, it will extend out the tentacles on its head as an intimidation tactic. Its claws hide a bunch of toxic barbs which it uses to weaken and then tear apart its prey.

entry: 冷水让POKENAME的爪绷紧，难以转向、抵抗洋流。战斗时挥动巨钳分散注意，再悄悄在敌人脚边布下数十枚毒菱。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's claws tense up when in cold waters, making it difficult to steer correctly and fight against currents. In battles, it swings around its oversized pincer to distract foes from it laying dozens of Toxic Spikes around their feet.

entry: 它对吃的叶片十分挑剔。其他宝可梦若想吃它看中的叶，就会飞上高空，重重用身体撞下。
author: h0bojoe
source: It is very picky about the leaves it eats. If another Pokémon attempts to eat a leaf it craves, it will fly high in the air and then deliver a devastating body slam.

entry: POKENAME高速撞向对手。虽然没法施展常规摔角技巧，仍能靠撞击与诡计，把敌人赶出擂台。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME barrels into foes at high speeds. While it cannot rely on standard wrestling techniques, it can still knock and trick foes out of the ring.

entry: POKENAME战前用棍击石作响，宛如摔角赛敲铃。它本想光明正大地打，若感到走投无路，却会慌乱地用棍按住敌人。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME strike their clubs against rocks to create a noise before they battle, akin to how a bell is rung in wrestling matches. Although they try to fight honorably, they panic and pin their foe using their club if they feel cornered.

entry: 它停在树枝和岩石上，等待值得一战的对手进入视野。一发现中意的强敌，便高声呼喊，举起棍棒，朝对方跃去。
author: infinex21
source: It perches atop branches and rocks in wait of worthy opponents to cross its sight. When it spots one it deems a worthy foe, it cries out and leaps at them with its club raised.

entry: POKENAME战前尝到的味道，会影响战斗风格：甜味偏防守，辣味偏进攻，等等。许多训练家不辞辛劳，寻找最完美的口味搭配，打造理想打法。
author: sk372
source: The type of flavors POKENAME tastes before a fight influence its combat style: sweet for defensive, spicy for offensive, etc. Many POKENAME Trainers work tirelessly to find meals with the perfect flavor combo to create the perfect fighting style.

entry: POKENAME精力无穷，放出的肾上腺素云能激起战意。战况越激烈，它们喝彩越响，释放的烟雾也越多。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Constantly full of energy, POKENAME release clouds of adrenaline that will motivate people to fight. The more dynamic the battle, the louder they cheer and the more smog they release.

entry: 藤蔓能一定程度塑形、伸长，让它打击、擒抱的范围，远超乍看之下。甚至会摆出挑衅或胜利手势，扰乱对手心理。
author: sk372
source: Its vines can shape and extend to some extent, giving it more range for strikes and grapples than a first glance would suggest. It will even shape its vines into taunting or victorious gestures to psych out opponents.

entry: POKENAME总带孩子上战场，也竭尽全力保护。等对手几乎倒下，就让孩子打最后一击，练习战斗。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME always brings its child onto the battlefield with it, though it does its absolute best to protect it from harm. Once it has nearly taken down an opponent, it lets the child strike the final blow as combat practice.

entry: POKENAME主要住在活火山地区。最爱的消遣，也是炫耀手段，就是从高处跳进岩浆池，再跃出、甩掉熔岩，毫发无伤，若无其事。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is found primarily in areas with active volcanic activity. A favorite pastime (and method of showboating) for POKENAME is to leap from on high into a pool of lava, leaping out and shaking off the molten liquid, unharmed and unfazed.

entry: POKENAME使出强大破坏招式前，总像攀瀑般沿空中向上游。需要速战速决，就会暴走，猛烈甩动身体。
author: soup1900
source: Before unleashing a powerful, highly destructive move, POKENAME always swims up through the air as if ascending a waterfall. It violently thrashes around in a rampage when it needs to end battles quickly.

entry: 它最爱在电视看拳击、武术与摔角赛，好变成人类选手，复制战斗风格。
author: epping_forest
source: Its favourite activity is to watch boxing, martial arts and wrestling matches on TV. This way, it can transform into the human fighters and copy their combat style.

entry: 它最爱在电视看拳击、武术与摔角赛，好变成人类选手，复制战斗风格。
author: epping_forest
source: Its favourite activity is to watch boxing, martial arts and wrestling matches on TV. This way, it can transform into the human fighters and copy their combat style.

entry: POKENAME一出现在电脑屏幕，就有激昂战斗乐伴奏。它战意高昂，常想跟用户的鼠标游标来场冲撞对决。
author: sk372
source: Whenever POKENAME appears on a computer screen, bombastic fight music accompanies it. It has great fighting spirit, often trying to get into tackling matches with a user's mouse cursor.

entry: 这只宝可梦好斗，用鲜艳羽毛引人注意，发起战斗。POKENAME一落败，可能羞愧到压力大得开始掉羽。
author: milchik
source: This Pokémon loves fighting and brings attention to itself with its bright feathers in order to initiate a battle. If defeated in a fight, POKENAME may become so ashamed of itself that it'll start losing its feathers out of stress.

entry: POKENAME为灵活空战很自豪，一有机会，就秀惊人速度与技巧。野外个体甚至只在空中打，落地便算输。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is quite proud of its aerial mobility, showing off with spectacular feats of speed and skill whenever it can. POKENAME that battle in the wild even exclusively fight in the air; being grounded is considered a loss.

entry: 这种宝可梦经基因改造而成，是终极摔角手。它用强翼从上方袭击，几乎总能取胜。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: This Pokémon was created via genetic manipulation as the ultimate wrestler. It uses its powerful wings to attack from above, a move that almost always wins.

entry: POKENAME的尾力大，能把班基拉斯举上高空。它常举起敌人或猎物，旋转一番，再全力摔向地面。
author: infinex21
source: The tails of POKENAME are strong enough to lift Tyranitar high into the sky. They are known to lift any foe or prey into the sky and spin them about before throwing them to the ground with all their might.

entry: 它们借翼状火焰喷流，跃起翱翔。虽然能远程用火攻击，却更爱靠体能，公平较量。
author: infinex21
source: They leap and soar through the air with their wing-like jets of flames. Although they can strike from afar with their flames, they tend to prefer to fight evenly with physical prowess.

entry: POKENAME精通徒手空战，尤其在夜里。森林最暗时，敌对个体激战，直到一方被打落、昏倒才停。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a master of unarmed aerial combat, especially at night. Rivals get into fierce battles with one another while the forest is at its darkest, not stopping until one has been grounded and knocked out.

entry: 野生POKENAME常为筑巢地争斗。激战过后，胜者惯常从败者身上拔几根羽毛，加入之后搭建的巢。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME often get into fights over nesting area in the wild. After a spirited round of combat, it's customary for the winner to pluck a few feathers from the loser to use as part of the nest it later builds.

entry: POKENAME总是精神满满，尽力跳高，练习飞行。它们常想从上方冲撞同伴，结果却互相弹开，一起飞远。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Constantly full of energy, POKENAME bounce as high as they can to try and practice flying. They often try to tackle each other from above, but only end up bouncing off each other and flying away.

entry: 锐利视力让它察觉对手最细微的动作，反应快极了。小小身形不断闪避，等敌人累得躲不开，再反击。
author: sk372
source: Its sharp eyesight allows it to detect even the faintest twitch of movement from its opponent, giving it exceptional reaction speed to attacks. It uses its tiny frame to dodge attacks until the foe is too exhausted to avoid its counterstrikes.

entry: 它原地踏步、小跑，摩擦毛皮产生静电，让尾巴亮起。战斗中，这份亮光就成了华丽招式的背景灯。
author: sk372
source: It shuffles and trots in place, rubbing its fur together to create a static charge that makes its tail shine brightly. This bright glow serves as the backdrop lighting for its dramatic moves in combat.

entry: POKENAME比起参战，更热爱观战。若聚很多只看比赛，助威的舞蹈与欢呼，甚至能增强支持选手的力量。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME are much more passionate about observing battles than participating in them. If many gather together to watch a fight, their supportive dances and cheers can even bolster the strength of the combatant being cheered for.

entry: 它战斗时立得纹丝不动，等对手出能反制的招。一逮到机会，就以夸张跳击与惊人摔投，重创进攻者。
author: sk372
source: It stands stock-still in battle, waiting for an opponent to make a move it can counter. When the chance arises, it devastates the attacking foe with dramatic jump strikes and stunning throws.

entry: 单只POKENAME，就能击倒体型是自己两倍的敌人。它记住每种宝可梦的弱点，下次再遇同种，就专攻那里。
author: periperi_chicken
source: A single POKENAME can take down a threat twice its size. It memorises every Pokémon's weak spot and will target that area the next time it fights that type of Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME吸收日光，便能随时放出聚光灯般的亮光。它为战友打出戏剧化灯光，助阵同时，让表演更添风采。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME absorbs sunlight so that it may produce a bright shine like a spotlight on command. It does this to support allies in battle, providing dramatic lighting to give their performance added flair.

entry: POKENAME爱从高处跃下滑翔，再潜入下方水中；只会选附近水量充足的高处。有人开始打赌，看一只入水能溅多大水花。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME love to leap from tall heights to glide, then dive down into the water below; they only leap from heights with plenty of water nearby. Some people have begun to make a game of betting on how large a splash a diving POKENAME will create.

entry: POKENAME能略微预见未来，在战斗中占优。成功反制预见的招式时，额头宝石便短暂发亮。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has slight precognitive capabilities, which it uses to its advantage in battle. The gem on its forehead shines briefly when it successfully counters a move it saw in advance.

entry: POKENAME挑战同类，败者必须献出珍藏。打斗或许光明正大，争的东西却常来路不正。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME challenges others of its kind to combat, with the loser forced to give up prized possessions to the winner. The fighting may be honorable, but the items fought for are often ill-gotten gains.

entry: POKENAME总想痛快打一场，与挑战者直视对眼。眼中催眠光线激起战意，让对方更渴望交手。
author: sk372
source: Always itching for a good fight, POKENAME stares down challengers, looking them directly in the eyes. Its eye emits a hypnotic ray that stokes combativeness in those who gaze into it, making them more eager to meet POKENAME in battle.

entry: 有人说，后半身的头是它邪恶的一面。虽有点贪玩，可POKENAME想堂堂正正交战，后头却似乎总怂恿使阴招。
author: sk372
source: Some say the head on its back half is its evil side. While a bit playful, it does seem that while POKENAME wants to fight honorably, its back end seems to encourage the use of dirty tactics.

entry: POKENAME想方设法偷走同类腰带，正面对决反而少见。它认为偷得成功，更能证明本领。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME tries to sneakily poach the belts away from others of its species. Direct fights are uncommon, as POKENAME considers a successful steal as a stronger example of its prowess.

entry: POKENAME虽然战技高超，实际却相当胆小。若陷入自认无法获胜的战斗，它就用强壮的双颚咬住对手，趁对方分心，迅速飞走。
author: mistymagius
source: Despite its expert combat skills, POKENAME is actually quite cowardly. If it's locked in a fight, it thinks it can't win, it will bite its opponent with its powerful jaws and quickly fly off while they're distracted.

entry: POKENAME打斗爱用花哨却不实用的招，更想讨观众欢心，而非快点赢。因此，很受尚未学会最佳取胜方式的新手训练家喜爱。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME love to make flashy and inefficient moves during a fight, more to impress a watching crowd than to quickly win. This tendency makes them popular with inexperienced Trainers who have yet to learn the best way to win a Pokémon battle.

entry: 它爱打架，却毫无荣誉感。什么大物件拿得到，就拿来痛殴敌人，阴招用尽。
author: bostroms
source: While it loves fighting, it has no sense of honor.  It will fight dirty and smack its opponents around with any large object it can find.

entry: POKENAME像杂技演员般，在雪地跳来跳去，以敏锐感官找埋着的猎物。奋力一跺，震动穿过积雪，把隐藏食物掀出来。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME jumps like an acrobat around snowy landscapes, using its keen senses to locate buried prey. With a powerful stomp, it sends tremors through the snow, unearthing hidden food sources.

entry: POKENAME只将蜕下的羽，分享给有高尚气节的对象。人们相信，用羽毛制成的饰物，能增强持有者的活力。
author: sk372
source: It only shares the feathers it molts with those it deems to have an honorable spirit. People believe accessories made with POKENAME feathers grant the owner a boost to vitality.

entry: POKENAME准备战斗，会用象鼻吹曲，以专属主题乐让自己兴奋。观察战友比赛，还会为它们另谱主题曲。
author: sk372
source: When readying itself for battle, POKENAME will blow a tune with its trunk, hyping itself up with a personal theme. It will compose additional themes for its allies when it observes their battles.

entry: 有人看见POKENAME收留落单的小小象，传授本领，尤其会教如何滚起身体再展开，让动作最有戏剧效果。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has been observed taking in stray Phanpy and tutoring them in its ways. In particular, it teaches them how to roll and unfurl from said roll with the maximum amount of dramatic flair.

entry: POKENAME总想痛快打架，维持体能。若没谁愿意陪练，就用鹿角微弱的催眠力，激起对方斗志，变得迫不及待想打。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is always itching for a good brawl to keep itself in shape. If no others seem in the mood to practice with it, it will use faint hypnotic powers from its antlers to stoke their fighting spirit and make them raring to fight.

entry: POKENAME的战技胜过同辈。身手灵活、体能出色，招式又富表演性，让力量与风格都更占优势。
author: quackquackattack
source: The battle prowess of POKENAME eclipses the fighting ability of their peers. Their flexible athleticism and theatrical fighting moves give them an edge in both strength and style.

entry: 史籍记载，POKENAME是长羽的蛇神，令人敬畏。它紧缠的身体无从逃脱，尤其深咬一口、注毒之后。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME appear in some historical records as a feathered, serpentine deity that struck awe and fear into many. None can escape their constrictive grasp, especially not after they deliver their poison with a single, deep bite.

entry: POKENAME体型壮硕，是战斗强手，适合各类训练家的队伍。可多数人很快被胜利庆祝吓退，因为它会向自己与队友头上喷奶。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's size and robust body make it a potent powerhouse in combat, good for any Trainer's team. However, most find themselves quickly put off by its victory celebration, where it sprays milk above the heads of it and its teammates.

entry: POKENAME以精湛格斗本领闻名，爪牙出击快如闪电。一按住敌人，就唤出巨大雷电，作为终结一招。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME is legendary for its fighting skills and attacks foes with lightning-fast strikes with its claws and fangs. Once it has a foe pinned, it will create a massive thunderbolt as its finishing move.

entry: POKENAME使出羽毛舞，向周身撒下极热羽毛。因十分罕见，羽毛深受收藏家追捧。
author: .izik
source: When using Feather Dance, POKENAME scatters incredibly hot feathers all around its body. Due to its rarity, these feathers are highly coveted by collectors.

entry: POKENAME在敌人周围跳跃、滑翔，以雷电轰击。它很为战技自豪。
author: mcnchsschl
source: POKENAME leaps and glides around opponents, blasting them with lightning. It's very proud of its fighting skills.

entry: POKENAME现身节庆与游行，以活力感染众人。青少年常特地找POKENAME，让派对闹得更欢。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME appears during festivals and parades, invigorating everyone with a lively spirit. Teenagers often go hunting for POKENAME to make their parties even more wild.

entry: 野生POKENAME发明了类似篮球的游戏，教给孩子，培养合作。游戏能锻炼跳跃肌肉与手眼协调，有些训练家甚至教会了它们真正的篮球。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Wild POKENAME have developed a game that they teach their young to encourage teamwork that is similar to basketball. The game builds their jumping muscles and improves hand-eye coordination. Some Trainers have managed to teach them real basketball.

entry: POKENAME能灵活运用舌头的每块肌肉，在交战间隙为自己制作茶点。
author: camtft
source: POKENAME are capable of utilizing every muscle of their tongues to create refreshments for themselves in the middle of fights.

entry: 构成翅膀与后背的藤蔓随风翻动，看似披风。敌人因而忘记，它们和POKENAME其他部位一样能抓握，给了它可乘之机。
author: sk372
source: The vines comprising its wings and back flutter in the wind, giving the illusion of a cape. This illusion lulls foes into forgetting they are just as prehensile as the rest of POKENAME, giving it an opportunistic advantage.

entry: 它用翅膀快速、精准调整动作；羽毛随移动摩擦，迅速积起静电。POKENAME能悬在空中，以长尾与电击准确攻敌。
author: infinex21
source: It uses its wings to quickly and precisely adjust its movements; the friction of its feathers as it moves quickly builds a static charge. POKENAME can hover in the air and precisely attack foes with its long tail and electrical bolts.

entry: 头顶橙羽显示年龄，以及离进化还有多近。此时肌肉已很强，带爪拳头一击，就能打碎实岩。
author: infinex21
source: The orange feathers growing upon its head denote its age and how near it is to its evolution. At this point, its muscles are strong enough that it can break solid rock with a single strike of their clawed fists.

entry: 野生POKENAME大半生都爬上能找到的最高树木，既筑巢，也练习飞行。即使摔下，几乎总会再爬起尝试。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME spend most of their lives climbing atop the tallest trees they can find, both to form nests and to practice flying. Even if they crash, they almost always get back up and try again.

entry: 它巡视森林家园的广大范围，用翼穿梭树间，或掠过树冠。遇上敌意宝可梦，POKENAME便俯冲，以足以踢裂树木的重踢，迅速解决。
author: infinex21
source: It patrols a wide area within its forest home, using its wings to weave through the trees or to glide atop the tree canopy. POKENAME swoops down and delivers tree-cracking kicks to quickly deal with any hostile Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME善用翅膀，快速突然地变换动作，战斗时尤其如此。先以种子机关枪连射，再用强力叶刃收尾。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME utilize their wings to perform swift and sudden maneuvers, especially during battle. They are known for pelting their targets with Bullet Seed before finishing them with powerful Leaf Blade attacks.

entry: 臂下长出小羽，最终也会从部分甲片间冒出。它们常先滑翔，再俯冲地面，以更快速度继续挖掘。
author: infinex21
source: Small feathers grow under their arms and will eventually grow from between some of their plates. They can glide through the air, which they will oft do before diving toward the ground to continue digging at higher speeds.

entry: 背羽能绷紧、硬化如刺，既提供出色防护，也能让它以背部压落，重创敌人。它挖地锻炼，还能从地底跃出极高。
author: infinex21
source: The feathers on its back can tense and harden like quills, offering excellent defense and a means to deliver devastating "senton" attacks. It will dig to keep its body trained and can launch out of the ground to great heights.

entry: POKENAME战斗时，力量、优雅都经过熟练计算。见过的人很难决定，该把这些动作叫打斗，还是舞蹈。
author: sk372
source: In combat, it moves with practiced and calculated grace and strength. Those who have observed POKENAME in battle are torn between describing its movement as fighting or dancing.

entry: POKENAME探索野外，总寻找对手。它用超能力，只挑同样想打一场的对象挑战。
author: cerealjamalt
source: When exploring the wild, POKENAME will seek out opponents to fight. It uses its psychic powers to find and challenge only those looking for a fight.

entry: 它是优雅斗士，灵巧空袭往往更重表演，而非暴力。臂羽虽像刀刃，却可能要击中超过一百次，才能打倒敌人。
author: stevethebarbarian
source: An elegant fighter, its agile midair attacks are often more for showmanship than violence. Though the feathers on its arms have bladelike qualities, it may need to strike foes more than a hundred times before they are defeated.

entry: POKENAME讨厌用伪装，非必要绝不用。猎人以为它醒目、好捉，等被能抓握的舌卷住甩开，就会知道错了。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has a distaste for using its camouflage abilities unless absolutely necessary. Hunters that think it will be easy prey because it stands out will be taught otherwise when grappled and tossed aside by its prehensile tongue.

entry: POKENAME个头不大，力气却大得惊人，连更大的对手也能摔。第二颗头仿佛自行行动，会猛地撞向敌人。
author: houndrys.
source: POKENAME is remarkably strong for its size, capable of wrestling bigger foes. Its second head seems to act on its own and bodily slams into foes.

entry: 远古的POKENAME，是迅速凶猛的猎手，不抓到猎物绝不放弃。博物馆十分渴求它铠甲的化石。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: In the ancient past, POKENAME were swift, ferocious hunters who never gave up the chase until their prey was caught. Its fossilized armor is highly coveted by museums.

entry: POKENAME用镰刀般的爪，打出凶猛一击，只要命中，便有要害之威。可惜，准头实在很差。
author: nellnast42
source: With its scythe-like claws, POKENAME's savage blows are guaranteed to pack a critical punch. However, these attacks are very inaccurate.

entry: POKENAME身体沉重，很难飞，通常从山上跳下，慢慢滑过天空。遇险时，便离地飞起，再由上方扑向敌人。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: Due to their heavy bodies, POKENAME have trouble flying. They typically jump off mountains and slowly glide across the skies. When endangered, POKENAME will fly off the ground and throw themselves at their opponents from above.

entry: POKENAME以采集的食物为赌注，彼此摔跤。输家往往比起挨饿，更在乎自尊受挫。
author: cheroace
source: POKENAME will compete in wrestling matches with one another, putting the food they have gathered on the line. The losers often care more about their bruised egos than going hungry.

entry: 这些宝可梦以秀肌肉，展示对潜在对手的优势。常把自己倒影当成敌对POKENAME，挑衅这个看似势均力敌的对手。
author: turron_turron
source: These Pokémon flex their muscles to assert dominance over potential rivals. They regularly mistake their own reflections for opposing POKENAME, provoking combat against what they perceive as an equal.

entry: POKENAME自认领地内所有年幼宝可梦的守护者。它让幼崽看自己的比赛，赞颂力量与荣誉，也教会自卫。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is protective of all the young Pokémon in its domain, considering itself their guardian. It makes sure they watch its fights, so it can extol virtues of strength and honor as well as teach them self-defense.

entry: 有人质疑POKENAME故意制造灾难，好救人成英雄。这完全不实；它只是觉得助人也能帅气，不过救援始终第一。
author: sk372
source: Some naysayers believe POKENAME causes disasters just so it can look like a hero saving people from them. This is patently false; POKENAME simply believes it can help people and look cool while doing so, but rescue is always the first priority.

entry: POKENAME战斗又快又巧，许多人比作忍者。很多个体会建自己的胜利花园，每赢一场苦战，就种下一颗种子。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME battles with speed and finesse, many likening it to the movements of a ninja. Many POKENAME will create their own victory gardens, planting a seed each time they win a hard-fought battle.

entry: POKENAME的羽毛并非完全耐火。它点燃羽毛吓天敌、吸引人，却常费尽力气，也灭不掉火。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Its feathers are not entirely fireproof. POKENAME will ignite its plumage to intimidate predators and impress people, but it often struggles in extinguishing its feathers.

entry: POKENAME爱与其他宝可梦摔角，尤其有观众时。火焰让攻击华丽，但它会收力，避免伤敌。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME love to wrestle with other Pokémon, especially when there is an audience. They harness the power of their flames to make their attacks look flashy but hold back to avoid hurting their opponent.

entry: 耐火羽衣间，长着许多喷火器官。POKENAME靠喷射推进，迅速飞过竞技场，调整位置。
author: bandedbodypress
source: It has many flame-emitting organs between its fireproof plumage. POKENAME swiftly repositions itself in flight by boosting itself across the arena.

entry: 披风的每根羽毛，都蕴藏自身火焰。覆灭帝国的士兵曾将羽毛戴进头盔，传承它永不熄灭的炽热斗志。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Each feather on its cape is imbued with its fire. Soldiers of a fallen empire would wear its feathers in their helmets to inherit its undying fiery spirit.

entry: 这些宝可梦很灵活，一发现目标，就能从高处跃下。爱以闪亮利刃交战，有时也能见它们滑过树间。
author: salt
source: These Pokémon are very agile. They can jump from high up when they notice a target. They love to battle using their shiny, sharpened blades. They can sometimes be seen gliding between trees.

entry: POKENAME是骄傲斗士，不论如何，绝不攻击对手背部。招牌是强力后抛摔：带敌升上高空，再以轰炸般的势头，极速俯冲地面。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are proud fighters that will never strike their opponent's back, no matter what. Their signature move is a powerful suplex where they take their opponent into high skies before diving down swiftly to the earth with a dive bomb.

entry: POKENAME用幻象假扮人类或其他宝可梦，甚至模仿它们独特的战斗风格。幻象一破，就自豪摆姿势，宛如隆重登场。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME uses its illusion to pretend to be other people or Pokémon and will even try to mimic their unique fighting styles. Whenever this illusion is broken, POKENAME poses proudly, as if making its grand entrance.

entry: POKENAME用缎带激起别人的战意，方便寻找切磋对手。战斗时，缎带也是抓握、摔投敌人的好工具。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses its ribbons to stoke the fighting spirit in others, so it can easily find a new opponent to spar with. The ribbons also double as effective methods in combat for grappling and throwing foes around.

entry: POKENAME战如起舞，巧妙闪避、出击，毫不动摇。流畅动作与反应，让它优雅躲招，连对方也仿佛成了舞蹈的一部分。
author: slimmagma
source: POKENAME fights in a dance-like state, expertly dodging and attacking without faltering. Its fluid movements and reaction time result in an elegant avoidance of attacks, making the opposing Pokémon seem like part of the dance.

entry: 它们聚集山谷，一同训练、模拟对战，展现敏捷、速度与力量。
author: cristata
source: These Pokémon gather in valleys to train together and fight in mock battles, putting on a show of agility, speed, and strength.

entry: 它们聚集山谷，一同训练、模拟对战，展现敏捷、速度与力量。
author: cristata
source: These Pokémon gather in valleys to train together and fight in mock battles, putting on a show of agility, speed, and strength.

entry: POKENAME虽爱打一场，却不特别好斗，很少先动手。唯独满月，战意骤增，稍受挑衅就准备开战。
author: sk372
source: Although POKENAME enjoys a good brawl, it is not especially combative and rarely initiates. The only exception is during the full moon, when it gets a surge of fighting spirit, ready to battle at the slightest provocation.

entry: POKENAME飞越大地，搜寻对手。谁看起来比自己更强，POKENAME就毫不留情地攻过去。
author: gurguro
source: It searches for opponents while soaring across the lands. If a POKENAME sees something that looks stronger than it, it will attack mercilessly.

entry: POKENAME在暗中微光闪耀，火焰随动作摇曳。它跳着迷人战舞，慢慢吸取看太久者的能量。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body glows faintly in the darkness, its flame flickering with every movement. It performs mesmerizing combat dances, slowly draining the energy of those who watch for too long.

entry: POKENAME用火迫使敌人在战场走位。六条尾巴抛出火球，逼对方四处躲闪，直到位置正好，让它打出关键一击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses its flame powers to force an opponent's movements in battle. It flings fireballs from its six tails to make them dodge and dip around until they're in the perfect spot for POKENAME to land a critical strike.

entry: POKENAME不断练习战技，让动作更华丽。有时偷路人小饰品，非得看它秀新招，才肯归还。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME consistently practices its battle techniques in order to add more flair to its movements. On occasion, it will steal trinkets from passersby, refusing to return the objects until they watch it show off its new moves.

entry: POKENAME用翼火铺出壮观烟火背景，让战斗声势浩大。它讨厌雨中或海边交手，因为不易炫出绚烂火景。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME generates flames from its wings to make amazing pyrotechnic backdrops for its bombastic battles. It hates fighting in the rain or near the ocean, as it limits its ability to make a fiery spectacle.

entry: POKENAME以心灵感应，察觉、追踪威胁自己或弱小宝可梦的对象。它常高速扑向敌人，却绝不莽撞。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME utilize telepathy to detect and track potential threats to themselves and to other, weaker Pokémon. POKENAME tend to throw themselves against their foes at intense speeds, yet they never do so recklessly.

entry: 弹射器般的后腿，让它一跃能超过身长的50倍。擒拿本领极佳，连体型大数倍的宝可梦，也能掀翻抛出。
author: staghorn
source: It can jump over 50 times its body length thanks to its catapult-like back legs. It is an extremely capable grappler and can flip and throw Pokémon several times its size.

entry: 首领佩戴力量护踝等奖品，表明身份。它们切磋争夺佩戴权，反应太快，想偷走几乎不可能。
author: quackquackattack
source: Leaders of their pack are identified with a trophy they wear, such as a Power Anklet. They spar each other for the right to wear the trophy, and stealing it is nearly impossible due to their reflexes.

entry: POKENAME总想引人注目，鼓起身体，发出昂扬战吼，宣告准备决战。谁若看表演看睡着，就会挨上一阵毛绒拳。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Always seeking attention, POKENAME inflate themselves before releasing triumphant battle cries to declare they're ready for a showdown. If anyone falls asleep during a POKENAME's performance, they will be met with a flurry of plush fists.

entry: POKENAME从上方俯冲，把猎物按在沙漠深坑中伏击。强喙一击，就能啄开最坚硬的外骨骼。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME ambushes prey by diving from above and pinning them in deep desert pits. Its powerful beak can crack through the hardest exoskeletons with a single strike.

entry: POKENAME的齿轮分离、接回，对敌人使出精巧摔角技。动作太快，资深职业摔角手，也跟不上连招。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's cogs detach and reattach to perform intricate wrestling moves on an opponent. They move so fast that even a seasoned wrestling pro cannot keep up with its rapid techniques.

entry: POKENAME在树枝间跳跃，练习武术。击败敌人后，就向天喷火庆祝。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME leaps between tree branches, practicing martial arts techniques. After defeating a foe, it shoots flames into the air in celebration.

entry: POKENAME精通场面功夫，先鼓胀浮空，再用猛烈的飞踢击倒敌人。它们对安排战斗的喜爱，几乎不亚于亲自上阵。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Masters of spectacle, POKENAME inflate themselves to lift into the air before delivering devastating drop kicks to their opponents. They enjoy organizing battles almost as much as the battles themselves.

entry: POKENAME扑向猎物时，总忍不住加入翻转、绕圈等空中杂技。有时太沉迷华丽表演，反让猎物逃掉。
author: sk372
source: When diving at prey, POKENAME cannot resist the urge to add aerial acrobatics such as twists and loops. Sometimes it gets so caught up in its flourishing performance that its prey escapes.

entry: 需要额外饰物助华丽大赛夺胜时，人们会给它们红色头巾，更显帅气。它们敢冒经过盘算的风险，惊艳评审，胆量让表现格外出众。
author: quackquackattack
source: Whenever they need an extra accessory to help them win Pokémon contests, they are given a Red Scarf to help them project a cool aura. Their daring personalities help them stand out, as they are willing to take calculated risks to amaze judges.

entry: 年幼POKENAME同时练习格斗与飞行。先从巢使出飞身重压，再尽力飞高、再来一次，直到能从最高树枝俯冲。
author: icelevelincarnate
source: Young POKENAME develop their fighting and flying skills simultaneously. They perform a Flying Press from their nest, then fly as high as they can for another, until they're able to dive from the highest branch.

entry: POKENAME先点燃双翼，再冲入战斗，让摔角招式拖着火迹。它练习空中摔击，直到落地也不灭火。
author: reaverlamont
source: POKENAME ignites its wings before diving into battle, surrounding its wrestling moves with trails of flame. It practises aerial takedowns until it can land without extinguishing its fire.

entry: POKENAME高速滚动，扰乱敌人，再以准确毒刺戳击。动作又快又难预测，很难扎实命中它。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME rolls at high speeds to disorient its opponent before striking with a precise, venomous jab. Its rapid, unpredictable movements make it difficult to land a clean hit on it.

entry: 它出手迅猛，招式又诡诈。有些训练家，反而觉得看这套战法，十分有趣。
author: .flipside3
source: It attacks with vicious speed and deceptive tactics. Some Trainers consider its tactics interesting to watch.

entry: POKENAME是庞大可怕的暴君，以蛮力统治领地，却遵守荣誉准则。若被其他宝可梦击败，就承认对方更强，放弃统治。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a large terror of a tyrant, ruling its territory with brutish methods, but it abides by a code of honor. Should another Pokémon defeat it in combat, it acquiesces to their superior strength and relinquishes its rule.

entry: 据说POKENAME的尖叫，能让敌人定在原地，破绽大开。它先以实冰覆身，再用毁灭性力道撞向对手。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's piercing cry is said to freeze opponents in their tracks, leaving them wide open for it to strike. It coats its entire body in solid ice before careening into an opponent with devastating force.

entry: POKENAME住在极寒之地，性子却只能说“火热”。它造出其他宝可梦的冰像，用来擒抱、摔投，练习招式。
author: sk372
source: Despite living in the most frigid of areas, POKENAME has a personality that can only be described as "fiery." It practices its moves by creating ice statues of other Pokémon to grapple and toss around.

entry: POKENAME寻找强敌，以独特武术挑战。若取胜，就将对手冻住，带回巢当战利品。
author: darkweavile428
source: POKENAME seeks out strong opponents and challenges them with its unique style of martial arts. Should it best its opponent, POKENAME will freeze them and take them back to its den as a trophy.

entry: POKENAME重正义、友情，又热切想在战场证明自己，许多人觉得可爱。可它在垃圾场练招，朋友也必须学会忍受刺鼻臭气。
author: sk372
source: Most find POKENAME endearing for its strong sense of justice and friendship, and its eagerness to prove itself in battle. Because it practices its moves in garbage dumps, however, its friends must learn to endure its pungent stench.

entry: 两只POKENAME战场相遇，通常先一起举行歌舞仪式。拒绝参加，会被视为对荣誉的恶意侮辱。
author: sk372
source: When two POKENAME meet on the field of battle, it's customary for both to engage in pre-combat song and dance rituals. Refusing to participate is considered a vicious snub towards the other's honor.

entry: POKENAME用云朵般的软翼吸收来袭冲击，再以强踢反攻。动作优雅，仿佛边打边舞。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its soft, cloud-like wings to absorb incoming blows before countering with a powerful kick. Its graceful movements make it appear as if it's dancing mid-battle.

entry: POKENAME身体黏滑，轻易就能挣脱抓握。出手前把黏液涂上羽毛，让敌人挨中后难以恢复。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's slimy body allows it to slip effortlessly out of an opponent's grasp. It coats its feathers in a sticky mucus before striking, making it difficult for foes to recover after a hit.

entry: POKENAME通常是摔角鹰人群的首领，骄傲地伸展强翼，鼓起肌肉。它爱使出夸张的空中动作炫耀力量，登场也必须华丽。
author: thepandasharky
source: POKENAME is usually the leader among groups of Hawlucha, flexing its powerful wings and bulging muscles with pride. It performs dramatic aerial moves, showing off its strength while still loving a flashy entrance.

entry: POKENAME大身体增添力量，攻击更沉。强肌能扛大多数招式，让它不怕反击，尽情炫技。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's large body bolsters its extra strength, letting its attacks pack even heavier blows than before. Its powerful muscles shrug off most attacks, allowing it to showboat extravagantly without worry of counterattack.

entry: 它为迷失沙漠者送水、护送平安，再如海市蜃楼消失。因为报告者都是疲惫的幸存者，POKENAME一直被当成幻觉，直到近年才证实存在。
author: sk372
source: It grants water and safe travels to those lost within the desert sands, then disappears like a mirage. As those reporting it were exhausted survivors, POKENAME was thought to be a hallucination until recent times proved it to exist.

entry: 它制造冷风，让敌人在战斗中受寒、变慢。风也会吹动POKENAME的翼状片，让它格外享受这份戏剧效果。
author: sk372
source: It can create cold gusts of wind to chill and slow its opponents in battle. It also has the side effect of making POKENAME's wing-like flaps flutter in the wind, giving it a dramatic flair that it relishes.

entry: POKENAME通常躲在人眼看不见的地方，流连庆典。若有人看见一只，便被认为会有好运。
author: mr.sans2010_67506
source: POKENAME usually hang around festivals out of sight from the human eye. Those who see one, though, are considered good luck.

entry: POKENAME打架时，全身羽毛蓬起，更显威吓。它极骄傲，哪怕只输一场，也可能几个月都失去战意。
author: fiordaliso
source: When POKENAME fights, the feathers on its body puff up, making it look more intimidating. POKENAME is an extremely proud Pokémon; if it loses even a single battle, it may lose the will to fight for months.

entry: POKENAME常去滑板场，拿周围东西当滑板。眼尖观众会发现，它用超能力作弊，确保安全落地，或在空中多停一会儿。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME frequent skate parks, using any items nearby as a skateboard. Keen-eyed spectators may notice that POKENAME use their psychic abilities to cheat, guaranteeing safe lands or more time in the air.
