entry: POKENAME戴着黏滑甜香的面具。蛋糕般香气引来猎物，再以毁灭性的飞身重压收尾。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME wears a slimy, sweet-smelling mask. Its cake-like aroma lures in prey, which it finishes with a devastating Flying Press.

entry: 谁靠近领地，POKENAME就以惊人身手，展示复杂战斗动作。它四肢平衡撑地，在屋顶跳跃，如训练有素的体操选手。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME performs complex combat maneuvers with incredible agility to any who get close to its territory. It balances on all fours and bounces across rooftops like a trained gymnast.

entry: 它通常对外界刺激毫无反应。可激战若在眼前发生，就会微微移动，空洞眼中也闪过极弱的光。
author: sk372
source: It seems generally unresponsive to outside stimuli, but if fierce battles take place in front of it, it can be observed shifting slightly with the faintest of lights flickering within its hollow eyes.

entry: POKENAME的眼睛，映着体内燃烧的斗志。它从空中全身冲撞敌人，力道如流星坠落。
author: sk372
source: Its eyes are alight with the fighting spirit burning from within. POKENAME charges into foes with full-bodied tackles from the air, impacting with force akin to a falling meteor.

entry: POKENAME靠利爪，拥有极强握力。混战时尤其残暴，使出终结技的同时，以牙、火与爪猛攻。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME have an incredibly strong grip thanks to their sharp talons. They tend to be particularly brutal in free-for-all battles, sinking teeth, flame, and claw into opponents as they execute finishing moves.

entry: POKENAME精于攀树，在树间跳跃，寻找强敌。最爱飞到树冠上方，再以背摔将对手砸向地面。
author: mistymagius
source: Expert tree climbers, POKENAME leap from tree to tree looking for strong opponents to fight. Its favorite move is to fly high above the treetops and then suplex its opponent into the ground.

entry: POKENAME平日温顺，不爱主动出手。可哪只宝可梦一碰它，就会挨上一记足以折骨的背摔。
author: staghorn
source: POKENAME are normally meek and passive. Any Pokémon that so much as touches one, though, will be hit by a bone-breaking suplex.

entry: POKENAME是出色斗士，穿梭海天，从各方消磨敌人。黄色圆球汇聚念力，先以华丽景象玩弄对手，再打出终结一击。
author: soup1900
source: An amazing fighter, POKENAME traverses both sea and sky to whittle opponents down from all angles. It focuses its telekinetic powers with its yellow orbs to create a flashy display and toy with its foe before dealing a finishing blow.

entry: POKENAME训练时很容易兴奋，尤其摔角之类的活动。它努力冷静，却常亢奋过头，没察觉已经伤到陪练。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME is known to get easily excited by training, especially when activities like wrestling are involved. Though it tries to keep itself calm while training, it can often get too hyperactive, not noticing when it is hurting its sparring partner.

entry: POKENAME精力无穷，想养的人得留意它常有的过火举动。哪怕只是捡回游戏，也会加入跑酷，既添花样，又消耗更多体力。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has boundless energy, so prospective owners should be aware of how excessively it tends to act. Even a simple game of fetch will end up with parkour added so POKENAME can add flair and burn off more energy.

entry: POKENAME跃出水面，撞击自认在争夺池塘统治权的宝可梦。它爱打得华丽壮观，好警告其他生物别抢领地。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME leap high from the water to tackle any Pokémon that they believe is challenging them for control of their pond. They prefer to fight in a showy manner, creating a spectacle as an example to other Pokémon not to take their territory.

entry: POKENAME自豪于擅长炒热开战气氛。它对着麦克风尖声呼喊，参战者便斗志高昂，想打出配得上这份声势的精彩比赛。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME prides itself as a master of hyping up the beginnings of a battle. As it chants sharp cries into its mic, everyone participating will be more fired up, eager to make a spectacle worthy of POKENAME's hype.

entry: 合众小镇里，POKENAME陪孩子玩耍，目击记录因此增多。力量虽强，却因虚荣，成了糟糕的队友。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Small towns in Unova have seen an increase of POKENAME sightings on account of them playing with children. Despite their strength, POKENAME are horrible teammates on account of their vanity.

entry: POKENAME采用了更讲究身手的战斗方式——舞蹈。起舞时会掀起风刃，伤害对手。
author: skymaster426
source: POKENAME has embraced a more acrobatic style of fighting, Dance. When it dances, it whips up blades of wind to hurt its opponents.

entry: POKENAME在伽勒尔很受欢迎，四臂加上运动天赋，能给孩子表演足球花式。它轻易就能击败两只怪力，毫不费劲，也深得家长喜爱。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are popular in Galar, using their four arms and athleticism to perform soccer tricks to children. They are also popular with parents, as POKENAME have enough strength to easily defeat two Machamp without breaking a sweat.

entry: POKENAME喜欢近身交战，以旋转跳踢、由上劈下的手刀攻敌。可叶臂与细根腿，让威力没想象中好。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME likes to get up close and personal in battle, assailing foes with spinning jump kicks and karate chops from above. Because of its leaf arms and spindly root legs, these strikes aren't as effective as it would like.

entry: POKENAME以头藤支撑平衡，再做精巧杂技，用柔韧身体闪避。被逼入绝境，就吐酸遮住敌眼，再翻身脱险。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME balances on its head vine before performing intricate acrobatics, using its flexible body to evade attacks. If cornered, it spits a blinding acid before flipping away to safety.

entry: 野生POKENAME比赛推搡，比谁先将对方沉重身体推出界。它也与铁掌力士有强烈竞争关系。
author: sk372
source: Matches between POKENAME in the wild consist of pushing and shoving to see which fighter can push their opponent's heavy body out of bounds. POKENAME is known to have a strong rivalry with Hariyama.

entry: POKENAME受到威胁，就低头果断冲锋。披风如旗拖在身后，蹄火每跨一步都更亮，少有障碍扛得住冲击。
author: reaverlamont
source: When threatened, POKENAME lowers its head and charges without hesitation. Its cape streams behind it like a banner, while the flames from its hooves grow brighter with every stride until few obstacles can withstand its impact.

entry: 尾上的大舌贝咬住特定神经，引起反射，控制POKENAME的战姿。胜利后，甚至会让它鞠躬。
author: sk372
source: The poses it strikes in battle are controlled by the Shellder on its tail, biting on specific nerves to trigger a reflexive movement from POKENAME. In victory, the Shellder even makes POKENAME take a bow.

entry: POKENAME用弯喙啄开极硬坚果与结实水果。啄击虽猛烈，更出名的却是快速连踢。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are known for their curved beaks, which they use to break open extremely hard nuts and tough fruits. Though they can deliver devastating pecking attacks, they are more known for their rapid kicking attacks.

entry: POKENAME常见于马戏团、水上乐园，尽享娱乐的快乐。水中杂技与抛接表演，都是拿手好戏。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a common sight in circuses and water parks, reveling in the joy of entertainment. Aquatic acrobats and acts of juggling are its forte.

entry: POKENAME爱出没夜间常打宝可梦战的场地。它突然现身打断比赛，同时迎战原来的双方，让场面更热闹。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME likes to haunt venues where nighttime Pokémon battling is common. It loves to interrupt fights with its sudden appearance, taking on both sides of the initial battle at once and turning the moment into a true spectacle.

entry: POKENAME小手臂意外有力，轻易抓住岩壁。它借此从洞顶出击，在洞穴家园交战时，做更多杂技动作。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's small arms are deceptively strong, allowing it to grip onto rock walls with ease. It uses this to help it strike from ceilings and make more acrobatic maneuvers when fighting in its cavernous home.

entry: POKENAME在背上仙人掌里储水，能适应干燥环境。吸收阳光越多，花就越健康。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME store water within the cacti on their backs, allowing them to survive in arid environments. The more sunlight they absorb, the healthier their flowers become.

entry: POKENAME在仙人掌内孵化、生活，几乎不出来。因此野外极难看见。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: POKENAME hatch and live inside cacti, almost never emerging. Because of this, it is very rare to see one in the wild.

entry: POKENAME的黄色头骨，在沙漠热气中放出舒缓气味。温度越高，气味越浓。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's yellow skull releases a soothing scent in desert heat. The hotter the temperature, the stronger the aroma becomes.

entry: POKENAME装成普通的小仙人掌，避开注意。体内产生营养丰富的液体，远比所需多，于是多余部分就像泪，从眼中排出。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME pretends to be a normal, albeit small, cactus to avoid the attention of others. It produces a nutrient-rich liquid within itself. It produces far more than it needs, so the excess is expelled like tears from its eyes.

entry: POKENAME的舌分泌黏汁，闻着像仙人掌花蜜。它涂在尖刺上，黏住昆虫，再吃下去。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's tongue secretes a sticky sap that smells like cactus nectar. It uses this to coat its spines, trapping insects before consuming them.

entry: POKENAME的壳硬得妨碍动作，只好靠细刺赶走天敌与滋扰者。凭茧中储存的养分，数月不饮水也能活。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME's shell has hardened so much that it limits its movements, so it uses its thin spines to ward off predators and other nuisances. It can survive for months without water thanks to the nutrients it stores within its cocoon.

entry: POKENAME住在沙漠，四处飞行，躲开沙暴。翅膀材料能利用猛烈日光，制造养分。
author: notmax22
source: POKENAME live in deserts where they fly around avoiding sandstorms. Their wings are made of a material that allows them to produce nutrients using the harsh desert sunlight.

entry: POKENAME身体如海绵吸水，在太阳下待数天，也不必急着返回水源。它高速旋转，向敌人甩出可伸缩的刺。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME's body soaks up water like a sponge and can endure days in the sun before returning to a water source. It hurls retractable spines at enemies while spinning at high speed.

entry: POKENAME用超能力让尖刺暂时脱离身体，射向敌人，再将尖刺飘回身边。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME uses its psychic powers to temporarily detach spikes from its body and fire them at opponents before causing them to float back to it again.

entry: POKENAME把自己埋在沙里，晒沙漠太阳。迷路旅人常错认成绿洲，背上的水也帮助调节体温。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME bury themselves in the sand, basking in the desert sun. Lost travelers will often mistake these Pokémon for an oasis, the water on their backs helping to regulate their temperature.

entry: POKENAME身体如方块，满是尖刺，靠稀少资源维生。它的身体会被制成绿色染料，给衣物、旗帜上色。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are cubic and prickly creatures that nourish themselves off of scarce resources. Their bodies are made into green dyes that colors clothing and flags.

entry: POKENAME常见于沙漠，一生多数时间静止。细根扎进地里，供给养分，也固定身体。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are common in desert biomes where they remain stationary for much of their lives. They nourish themselves off of their small roots, which dig into the ground to prevent them from moving.

entry: POKENAME住在沙漠绿洲周边，只在沙漠暴雨中移动。其他宝可梦想吸走储水，让它每天磨刺，以便刺穿硬皮。
author: ghostslythe
source: Found surrounding desert oases, POKENAME only move during arid rainstorms. Due to other Pokémon attempting to drain their water, they sharpen their quills daily to pierce hardened hides.

entry: POKENAME的身体极善吸水、保水，从没被见过在沙漠酷热中干枯。遇到口渴旅人，会分享体内的水，帮忙补水。
author: sk372
source: A POKENAME's body is highly effective at absorbing and retaining moisture within itself, so it is never seen drying out in the desert heat. If it comes across thirsty travelers, it shares some of the water within its body to rehydrate them.

entry: POKENAME有点易惊，一受吓就用仙人掌尾拍人。之后用一些精神力量治好造成的伤，作为道歉。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a bit jumpy and prone to smacking others with its cactus tail when surprised. It uses some of its psychic energy to heal the injuries it deals as a way to apologize.

entry: POKENAME静止时，常被错认成普通仙人掌。战斗中则狂甩刺尾，痛打敌人。
author: mepp.
source: When POKENAME stands completely still, it can often be mistaken for a normal cactus. In battle, it wildly swings its spiked tail to bludgeon foes.

entry: 沙漠暴洪一来，POKENAME就急忙跃入。它信赖浮力强的尾巴留在水面，贪婪吸水，存够撑过数月干旱的量。
author: lordjoostmeister
source: When flash floods sweep through the desert, POKENAME rushes to leap into the flow. Trusting its buoyant tail to keep it at the surface, POKENAME greedily absorbs enough water to sustain itself through months of drought.

entry: POKENAME站得纹丝不动，装成仙人掌躲天敌。可身上的刺，其实是岩石突起。
author: santon5512
source: To avoid predators, POKENAME disguise themselves as cacti, standing incredibly still. Despite their appearance, the spikes on their bodies are actually rocky protrusions.

entry: POKENAME一被人看见，就常高速逃走，因此目击极少。受到威胁，就旋转身体，射出数千根针。
author: actliux
source: Sightings of POKENAME are incredibly few as they often flee at tremendous speeds upon being seen by humans. When threatened they will spin around and fire thousands of needles from their body.

entry: 若在沙漠中看见野生POKENAME，就能确定附近有绿洲。它的花朵越大，那片绿洲也就越美。
author: cristata
source: If you see a wild POKENAME in the desert, you can be sure there's an oasis nearby. The bigger its flower, the more beautiful its oasis is sure to be.

entry: 这些小沙漠居民结成小群，无水也能穿沙丘数天。尖刺外表挡住许多天敌，刺的数量也常代表群内地位。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: These small desert dwellers can live in small packs and travel for days across sandy dunes without water. Their spiky exterior protects them from many predators, and the number of spikes often denotes their rank within the group.

entry: POKENAME住在食物稀少的沙漠。常吃其他宝可梦的骨头，营养丰富的骨髓，帮助保持强健。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME survives in the desert where there is a paucity of food. It can be found eating bones of other Pokémon as the nutrient-rich bone marrow helps it stay strong.

entry: POKENAME的两个组成来源，栖地截然不同，野外行为仍在研究。若多孔身体吸入太多不适应的颗粒，就会随强毒，从尖刺漏出。
author: bobosmith01
source: Due to its components having radically different habitats, study of POKENAME's behavior in the wild is still ongoing. If it absorbs too many particles that its porous body disagrees with, it will leak them from its spines along with a powerful toxin.

entry: POKENAME住在沙漠，爱甜食，尤其蜂蜜。它用手刺赶走来犯者，保护心爱蜂蜜时，更不手软。
author: rirnok
source: POKENAME is a honey-loving sweet tooth found in desert regions. It uses the spikes on its hands to ward off attackers, particularly when defending its much-loved honey.

entry: 身体渗出浓稠黏液，通常太热，不能安全触碰。不过冷却的样本，可用作润肤乳。
author: hophoppip
source: Its body oozes a thick slime. It's typically too hot to safely touch, but cooled down samples of the slime can be used as lotion.

entry: POKENAME的身体会滴出湿润的汁液，借此在地面上滑行。不过，饮用这种汁液会引起消化不良。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's body drips a moist sap, allowing it to slide along the ground. Drinking the sap, however, will cause digestive problems.

entry: POKENAME花数天飞越沙漠找绿洲，一找到，就尽量多喝。只有沙暴将至才离开，飞上天空，抢在风暴前头。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME spend days flying through deserts in search of oases, drinking as much water as they're able to once they find them. They will only move on when sandstorms start to roll in, taking to the skies to get ahead of them.

entry: POKENAME皮肤吸水性极强，靠沙漠稀少的雨水就能生存。攻击猎物时，身体最远能伸展15英尺。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's skin is very absorbent, allowing it to survive on the little rain the desert provides. They can stretch up to 15 feet when striking their prey.

entry: POKENAME在鼻口里储针，抵御恶意程序。电脑文件一受感染，就朝恶意程序投针，注入空白代码行，直到将其化解。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME store pins inside their snout to arm themselves against malware attacks. When malware begins to infect files in a PC, POKENAME throw pins at the malware to inject blank lines of code until it is neutralized.

entry: POKENAME喜欢突然亲其他宝可梦一口。可嘴巴粗糙又带刺，多数宝可梦都宁愿离POKENAME远些。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME loves to give other Pokémon a surprise smooch. Since its mouth is rough and thorny, most Pokémon prefer to keep their distance from POKENAME.

entry: 夜游沙漠者，很可能遭POKENAME缠住。它先细细吸干选中猎物的全部水分，再收紧盘躯，让对方再无生路。
author: secondatheniangadfly
source: Those who wander the deserts at night are at great risk of being constricted by a POKENAME. It takes great care to suck all of the moisture out of its chosen prey before tightening its coils past the point of no return.

entry: 有些登山者将吓人的POKENAME错当普通仙人掌，毫无戒备地靠近，结果严重烧伤。
author: chorb33
source: Some hikers have suffered nasty burns because they mistook the frightening POKENAME for a normal cactus and approached it without caution.

entry: POKENAME用棍棒般的尾巴砸开沙丘，寻找沙漠里的水源。可找法粗笨，它一离开，找到的水很快又被沙埋住。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME will bash through sand dunes using their bludgeon-like tails. They do this in search of sources of water within the deserts they live in. Due to their inelegant means of searching, the water they find is quickly buried when they move on.

entry: 几只POKENAME会在夜间聚在一起练习某种舞蹈。一旦失去平衡，就会哭着退开。
author: pokopish
source: Multiple POKENAME come together at night to practice a sort of dance. It cries and retreats if caught off balance.

entry: POKENAME在干沙漠下掘洞，吃仙人掌根、喝地下水。生存所需全在地下，极少上地面，所以强光常让它受惊。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME tunnel beneath arid deserts to eat cactus roots and drink from underwater reservoirs. They rarely come to the surface because everything they need to survive is underground, so many POKENAME are startled by bright lights.

entry: POKENAME每根针里，都有大量压缩数据。技术人员试了多年，也没能整理成可理解的内容，因为数据实在混得太乱。
author: .izik
source: Each needle on POKENAME's body contains a high amount of compressed data. Technicians have spent years trying in vain to unscramble it into something intelligible, as the data is so thoroughly mixed up.

entry: POKENAME背叶营养丰富，水分也多。它分给沙漠旅人，让他们在烈日下保持水分。
author: sk372
source: The leaves that grow on POKENAME's back are nutritious and contain a lot of moisture within. It offers them to desert travelers to help keep them hydrated beneath the sweltering sun.

entry: POKENAME依靠魔法的力量汲取养分，可以一直不喝水。虽然体形娇小，但浑身的刺让其他生物不敢招惹它。
author: hellaluyeah
source: POKENAME can survive indefinitely without water, drawing nutrients from magical sources instead. Though tiny, it is left alone due to its spines.

entry: 在空旷辽阔的沙漠中，POKENAME能尽情起舞，抒发情感。若发现有人偷看，就会把对方扎得满身是刺。
author: hellaluyeah
source: In the vast emptiness of the desert, POKENAME has room to dance emotionally. If it spots someone watching, it will leave the voyeur with many pricks.

entry: POKENAME精于伪装，用刺皮混入沙漠景色。体色又能变换成夕阳各色，吓唬敌人。
author: dylonk25
source: POKENAME is a master of camouflage, using its spiky skin to blend into the desert landscape. It shifts through sunset colors to startle foes.

entry: POKENAME利爪能轻松切石。它飞过沙漠家园觅食，偏爱被酷热拖累的猎物。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's sharp claws are sharp enough to cut through stone with ease. It flies around its desert habitat seeking prey, preferring to target prey exhausted by the heat.

entry: POKENAME臂上长针，很适合吓退威胁。针会分泌少量毒液，它有时喝下，恢复能量。
author: camtft
source: POKENAME's arms feature long needles perfect for scaring off potential threats. Their needles secrete a small toxin that they may drink to regain energy.

entry: POKENAME吃通通果，降低吞食毒属性宝可梦后的中毒风险。严酷沙漠食物稀少，能吃这些猎物，让它得以兴旺。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME eat Kebia Berries to reduce the risk of poisoning themselves after eating Poison-type Pokémon. In the harsh desert where food is scarce, being able to eat Poison-type Pokémon allows them to thrive.

entry: POKENAME每天都需要足够多的水，免得身体干燥、变脆。只要花些力气，它就能从背壳长出尖刺，射出自卫。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME needs a good amount of water daily in order to keep its body from drying out and becoming brittle. With some effort, it can grow and shoot spines from the shell on its back as a method of self-defense.

entry: POKENAME的肉质饱含清洁可饮用的水。口渴的捕食者靠近时，它就会脱落背上的球体，趁机逃走。
author: staghorn
source: POKENAME's flesh is saturated with clean, drinkable water. When a thirsty predator nears, it detaches the spheres on its back and makes its getaway.

entry: POKENAME把水储存在棒状的身体结构中。除了用它敲打目标，还会发射身上的刺。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME stores water in its club-like structure. It shoots off its thorns in addition to bludgeoning its victims.

entry: 它们营养越好，黄色越鲜艳。缎带状器官散发诱人香气，引来猎物，再以准确攻击，迅速击倒。
author: infinex21
source: They develop more vibrant, yellow colors the more well-nourished they are. Their ribbon-like organs exude an alluring aroma to attract prey, which they quickly down with precise strikes.

entry: POKENAME盲目游荡，寻找阳光。碰到任何东西，就释放一团棉孢子。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME blindly wander in search of sunlight. When they bump into anything, they release a cloud of Cotton Spores.

entry: POKENAME用带刺拳头飞快击石，磨练力量。冲击迸出小股能量，帮助感知附近宝可梦的情绪。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME trains by rapidly striking rocks with its spiked fists. The impact releases small bursts of energy, which helps it sense the emotions of nearby Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME住在绿洲，照料周围自然，让环境充满生机、清新宜人。迷路旅人常把友善的它当成幻影，直到真被针扎到。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME dwell within oases, helping tend to the nature around them to help them stay lively and refreshing. Lost travelers often assume friendly POKENAME to be mirages until directly feeling their needles.

entry: 毛皮既能储存庞大静电，也藏住头、背上的利刺。睡觉时蜷成球，护住柔软腹部。
author: comfortablybrum
source: Its fur can store a tremendous amount of static electricity, as well as concealing the sharp thorns that cover its head and back. It curls up into a ball when it sleeps, keeping its soft belly protected.

entry: POKENAME跃入沙漠绿洲，大量吸水，身体随之膨大、圆胖。之后小心摇摆着走开，把水喷洒、分享给需要补水的生物。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME leaps into desert oases and soaks up large amounts of water, its body growing larger and more rotund as it does so.  It then carefully waddles away to spray and share the water with others who need hydration.

entry: POKENAME的刺放出细绿粉，隐约带着新鲜香草气味。粉末有助于栖居旱地的植物生长。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's spines release a fine green powder that smells faintly of fresh herbs. This powder encourages plant growth in the arid environments where it lives.

entry: POKENAME常长久静坐，头花散出甜香。不过刺上有毒，最好别采蜜。
author: manager_of_managers
source: POKENAME sits still for long periods of time. The flower that adorns its head secretes a sweet scent. Its thorns are covered in a poison, however, so obtaining nectar is ill-advised.

entry: POKENAME带刺的身体覆着半透明膜，即使极热也能保湿。体液太少，刺就变脆、脱落。
author: .izik
source: A translucent membrane covers POKENAME's spiny body, keeping it hydrated even in extreme heat. If its fluid levels drop too low, its spines become brittle and break off.

entry: POKENAME野外极难察觉，被踩就放电，很难研究。多数训练家因此穿厚重耐用的靴子，减轻电击。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME is incredibly difficult to spot in the wild and will release jolts of electricity if stepped on. This fact makes it difficult to study, so most Trainers wear a set of heavy-duty boots to absorb the shock.

entry: 白色的毛发，其实是一根根纤细而极锋利的尖刺。它喷出的火，足以把沙子熔成玻璃，再用玻璃加固尖刺。
author: staghorn
source: Its white fur is composed of thin but extremely sharp spines. The fire it produces is hot enough to melt desert sand into glass, which it uses to reinforce its spines.

entry: POKENAME半埋沙中，看着就像普通含苞仙人掌。许多沙漠爱好者，会数头上花苞的数量，辨认区别。
author: quackquackattack
source: When half buried in the desert sand, POKENAME look like any other budding cactus. Many desert enthusiasts can tell them apart by counting how many flowering buds are on their head.

entry: POKENAME常结群在沙漠跳舞，经身上的花吸收日光。绒球一摇，尖刺飞散，天敌便不敢近身。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are often found in groups, dancing in the desert as they absorb sunlight through the flowers in their bodies. Spikes fly from their pom-poms as they shake them, keeping predators at bay.

entry: POKENAME头上的果子本身无毒，有毒的是POKENAME的黏性汁液。因此，必须彻底去除污染，果实才能食用。
author: mistymagius
source: The fruit on POKENAME's head isn't naturally poisonous, but POKENAME's sticky sap is. Because of this, the fruit needs to be thoroughly decontaminated before it can be eaten.

entry: POKENAME的仙人掌头，长在构成大半身体的枯荆棘团上。不知为何能飞，科学家推测，荆棘内部或许藏云。
author: soup1900
source: The cactus head of POKENAME grows from the large bundle of dead bramble that makes up most of its body. It is unknown how it can fly, but scientists theorize that there may be clouds hidden inside the bramble.

entry: POKENAME只生长在富含金属的沙地，身体出奇地致密坚韧。常被人尊为古老力量的先兆。
author: quant9690
source: Only growing in sandy areas heavy with metals, POKENAME are surprisingly dense and resilient. They are often revered as heralds of an ancient power.

entry: POKENAME身上有寄生花，从本体取水、取养分，在严酷沙漠也能开花。花的存在，迫使它不停找水。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have parasitic flowers that use their bodies as a source of water and nutrients to allow them to bloom despite harsh desert conditions. The presence of these flowers force POKENAME to constantly be on the search for water sources.

entry: 它走过数英里沙漠，寻找可吸水、取养分的绿洲。背上圆仙人掌储着水，助它在酷热中保持凉爽。
author: chibitales
source: This Pokémon wanders miles of desert looking for oases to absorb water and nutrients from. The round cactus on its back holds the water it needs to keep cool in the blistering heat.

entry: POKENAME似乎不知道，尾巴覆满刺。兴奋摇尾时，有时会扎到站太近的生物。
author: _subject
source: POKENAME doesn't seem to realize its tail is covered in thorns. When a POKENAME becomes excited and begins wagging its tail, it sometimes pricks those standing too close to it.

entry: POKENAME住在沙漠深处，藏于仙人掌等带刺植物间，只在夜间移动。它以爪牙刺穿厚皮，喝内部汁液解渴。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME live amongst cacti deep in the desert, hiding amongst the thorny plants and only moving at night. They use their claws and teeth to puncture the thick hide of the cacti and drink the juice within to quench their thirst.

entry: POKENAME攀住仙人掌侧面，用爪吸水、取养分。背上蘑菇伪装成花，利用吸来的能量，生成孢子感染其他仙人掌。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME clings to the side of cacti, using its claws to leach water and nutrients. The mushroom on its back camouflages it as a flower, and uses the energy it absorbs to produce fungal spores to infect other cacti.

entry: POKENAME带刺身体覆着树皮般的坚壳，随时间不断硬化。吸收阳光，供给快速生长，臂边也冒出小叶。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's spiny body is covered in a tough, bark-like shell that hardens over time. It absorbs sunlight to fuel its rapid growth, sprouting small leaves along its arms.

entry: POKENAME裹着厚仙人掌壳，相互冲撞也能保护自己。大雨后，壳吸水膨胀，再随水分耗尽，慢慢缩小。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are surrounded by a thick cactus shell that protects them as they ram into each other. Their shell swells with water after heavy rainfall and slowly shrinks as the water is depleted.

entry: POKENAME结实铠甲能挡多种攻击，可体型与重量也损害健康。活动需大量水，太久缺水，就迅速枯萎、散架。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's sturdy armor helps protect it from multiple kinds of attacks, but its size and weight are a detriment to its health. It requires large amounts of water to function, wilting and falling apart quickly if it goes without water for too long.

entry: POKENAME大吃沙子，身体处理不了的，化成尘烟排出。通常身体中段越大，处理食物就越有效率。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME feasts on sand. Whatever is not processed by its body is ejected as dust and smoke. Typically, the larger a POKENAME's midsection is, the more optimal its body is at processing its food.

entry: POKENAME中空身体夜里微光闪耀，引流浪旅人深入沙漠。据说，那诡异闪光，像迷失灵魂在找家。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's hollow body glows faintly at night, luring wandering travelers deeper into the desert. The eerie flicker is said to resemble a lost soul searching for home.

entry: 头冠内长的果实甜美、营养，却覆着数百根细针。在POKENAME的自然栖地，只有呆火驼、喷火驼适应了无伤吃果。
author: milchik
source: The fruits this Pokémon grows inside its crown are sweet and nutritious, but are also covered in hundreds of tiny needles. In POKENAME's natural habitat, only Numel and Camerupt are adapted to eating these fruits without hurting themselves.

entry: POKENAME带着弹性袋装的水，穿行沙漠，让根保持湿润。谁想抢水，就会挨上带针的猛烈头撞。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME travel across the desert holding water with their elastic pouches to make sure that their roots stay properly hydrated. If anyone tries to take a POKENAME's water, they will be met with a powerful headbutt laden with needles.

entry: 倾盆大雨中，POKENAME不断膨胀、吸雨，直到饱满。之后忍受数周、甚至数月缺水，身体才慢慢缩小。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME expands and absorbs rainwater during torrential downpours until it is full and replete. It slowly shrinks in size as it endures weeks or even months without water.

entry: POKENAME靠阳光与正面情绪维生，尤其是爱。许多住在沙漠的老夫妇，家里养着大个体，象征长久恩爱。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME survives off of sunlight and positive emotions, particularly love. Many old couples living in the desert have large POKENAME in their homes, a sign of enduring love and affection.

entry: POKENAME体内储水，能扛最严酷的温度。它向天敌射刺；天敌一靠得太近，它就立刻退回洞里。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME store water within their bodies, allowing them to survive in the harshest of temperatures. They shoot spikes at predators, retreating into their burrows the moment they get too close.

entry: POKENAME烦躁时会快速甩尾，频率也随怒气增长。惹到一定程度，就挥尾反击，以沿尾尖刺刮伤惹怒自己的对象。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME tails swish rapidly when they're annoyed; the frequency of their tail flicks reflects their growing irritation. If sufficiently provoked, they lash out with their tail, scratching the source of their ire with the thorns lining it.

entry: POKENAME摇摆着穿过沙漠找绿洲，有时跋涉数周，才遇上难得的水。找到后，便全身没入，尽量吸水，存着之后喝。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME waddle through the desert in search of oases, sometimes travelling weeks to reach the rare pockets of water. When they find them, they submerge themselves and soak in as much water as they can, storing it to drink later.

entry: POKENAME摇摆着穿过沙漠找绿洲，有时跋涉数周，才遇上难得的水。找到后，便全身没入，尽量吸水，存着之后喝。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME waddle through the desert in search of oases, sometimes travelling weeks to reach the rare pockets of water. When they find them, they submerge themselves and soak in as much water as they can, storing it to drink later.

entry: POKENAME摇摆着穿过沙漠找绿洲，有时跋涉数周，才遇上难得的水。迷路旅人最好跟它的足迹走，往往能找到水源。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME waddle through the desert in search of oases, sometimes travelling weeks to reach the rare pockets of water. Travellers lost in the desert are advised to follow POKENAME tracks as they will often lead them to water.

entry: POKENAME卑鄙狡诈，只要有机会，就准确无误地打击敌人弱点。拳脚利刺，也会在战斗中充分利用。
author: deniablecredibility
source: POKENAME is a devious and underhanded combatant, striking unerringly at its opponent's weak spots whenever possible. It uses the prickly thorns on its fists and feet to its full advantage in a fight.

entry: POKENAME着迷于竞赛，爱玩各种夏季运动。可惜，针般利刺让某些项目，比其他项目更难参加。
author: deniablecredibility
source: POKENAME has a fascination with competition and enjoys playing all manner of summertime sports. Unfortunately, its needle-sharp spines make some sports more difficult to participate in than others.

entry: POKENAME天生强壮，又能长期滴水不进，是荒僻环境中牧场主的珍贵伙伴。
author: deniablecredibility
source: POKENAME's natural strength and ability to go for long periods without a single drop of water makes it an invaluable companion for ranchers in inhospitable environments.

entry: 它们住在表土已流失的沙漠。地下根系相互交织，共享养分，也将身体固定。
author: quackquackattack
source: It is seen living in desert environments where the topsoil is no longer present. They mingle their roots underground so they can share nutrients and remain grounded.

entry: POKENAME口中撒的种子生命力极强，最干的沙漠也能扎根。许多仙人掌地，正是它游荡播种后留下的。
author: .izik
source: The seeds POKENAME scatters from its mouth are highly fertile and can take root even in the driest desert sands. Many cacti fields owe their existence to the wandering travels of this Pokémon.

entry: 这些宝可梦爱恶作剧，常挥动棒状附肢，打坏东西玩。单独时虽乱来，结群却配合惊人，如同一个整体。
author: big_clanker
source: These mischievous Pokémon are known for swinging their club-like appendages to break objects in play. Though chaotic alone, when grouped they show remarkable coordination and act as one seamless unit.

entry: POKENAME缓缓穿过沙漠，吃沿途仙人掌维生。留下的有毒轨迹，最终会长出新仙人掌，不过刺也有毒。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME slinks through the desert, gathering sustenance by consuming the cacti dotting the landscape. The toxic trail its movement leaves behind will eventually grow new cacti, albeit ones with poisonous spines.

entry: POKENAME是沙漠精灵，只有夜深才现身。若聚起几只，就能幻化出水源充足的绿洲，欺骗旅人。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a desert spirit that only comes out in the late evenings. If several congregate together, they can conjure up an illusion of a watery oasis to trick travelers.

entry: POKENAME住在酷热沙漠，会吸走周围热量，意外为旅人带来烈日下的清凉。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Found in sweltering deserts, POKENAME provides travelers a surprising reprieve from the hot sun as it is known to absorb heat from its surroundings.

entry: POKENAME头骨覆满针，随年龄变得更锐。成年个体的骨头投出，能刺穿石头。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's skull is covered in needles that sharpen with age. An adult's bone can pierce stone when thrown.

entry: POKENAME潜伏沙漠绿洲，以带刺棍棒抽打闯入者。棍内装满养分与水，需要时能吸取；常走沙漠的旅人，也会备几根防急用。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME stalk desert oases and lash out at intruders using their thorn-clad clubs. Their clubs are packed with nutrients and water that they can siphon as they need; frequent desert travelers often have a few of these clubs in case of emergency.

entry: 它游荡沙漠，寻找对手，拳术强劲，双手满是扎人的尖刺。
author: hophoppip
source: It wanders through the desert, searching for an opponent. It's a formidable fistfighter, and its hands are studded with painful spikes.

entry: POKENAME常被沙漠宝可梦当成普通仙人掌。若被扰，就不停用强力水流轰击来犯者。即便如此，依然接近食物链底层。
author: mcnchsschl
source: POKENAME is often mistaken for a regular cactus by desert-dwelling Pokémon. If disturbed, it relentlessly blasts the aggressor with a powerful water blast. Despite this, it remains near the bottom of the food chain.

entry: POKENAME造出无形墙壁，抵挡猛烈沙暴。也用这些屏障，困住猎物。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME creates invisible walls to help shield itself from raging sandstorms. It uses these barriers to trap prey.

entry: POKENAME在沙漠游荡歌唱，带刺的身体有节奏地摇动，为急促的歌声加上沙沙伴奏。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME roams through deserts singing. It shakes its thorny body rhythmically to add rattling noises to its rapid singing.

entry: POKENAME为其他宝可梦提供营养丰富的水，是沙漠生态的重要一环。可人类为售卖这种奇特饮品而猎捕，让野外所剩无几。
author: _pixelar_
source: POKENAME are crucial to the desert ecosystem as they provide other Pokémon with the nutritious water they produce. Few are left in the wild because of hunting by humans trying to sell the exotic drink.

entry: POKENAME常见于沙漠，活动只需极少水。长身体能拆成小块，送进工厂，提取绿色染料。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are common in desert biomes and need very little water to function. Their long bodies can be broken down into smaller pieces that are sent to factories to extract green dye.

entry: POKENAME常在沙漠深处长期独居，靠少量食水维生。若被扰，就用强大超能力与棒状尾巴反击。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME isolate themselves for extended periods within the depths of the desert, subsisting on little food and water. If disturbed, they will lash out with their psychic might and bludgeon-like tail.

entry: POKENAME皮肤覆着短细针，肉眼却看不见。科学家研究这些针，寻找制作更细、更坚韧医疗工具的灵感。
author: imaginita
source: Although not visible to the naked eye, POKENAME skin is covered with short, fine needles. Scientists are studying these needles as inspiration for developing thinner, sturdier medical tools.

entry: POKENAME已经适应了沙漠生活，如今栖息在宽大的地洞里，不再住在树上。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME have adapted to live in deserts, and now live in large burrows instead of trees.

entry: POKENAME弱小，为省养分与水，保持静止。等强风把它吹到沙漠城镇，便靠热心居民照顾，直到进化。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME is a weak Pokémon that stays still to conserve nutrients and moisture. It waits for strong winds to carry it to desert towns, where it relies on helpful citizens to care for it until evolution.

entry: 古时沙漠居民，把POKENAME养作守卫。陌生者靠近，就从鳃喷刺，刺的颜色表示是否欢迎来客。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: In desert communities long ago, Trainers kept POKENAME as guards. They would spew thorns from their gills as strangers approached, the colour of these thorns would indicate if the strangers were welcome.

entry: POKENAME漫游沙漠平原，大量吸月光，进行光合作用维生。谁靠太近，就用身上、尾上的刺威胁。
author: fiordaliso
source: It feeds by photosynthesizing using the moonlight it absorbs in large quantities as it roams the desert plains. If anyone gets too close, POKENAME threatens them with the spines that grow on its body and tail.

entry: POKENAME月光不足，就特别暴躁，用身上绿刺威胁其他宝可梦。它爱独自漫游广大沙漠，不愿长住一处。
author: fiordaliso
source: If POKENAME doesn't get enough moonlight, it becomes particularly irritable and starts threatening other Pokémon with the green spines on its body. It prefers to lead a nomadic, solitary life in vast deserts rather than settle in one place.

entry: POKENAME喜欢闪亮且能反光的物品。可惜一看见自己的倒影就会受惊逃走，把宝贝也丢在原地。
author: cristata
source: POKENAME love shiny, reflective objects. Unfortunately, they startle at the sight of their own reflection, leaving their prize behind as they flee.

entry: POKENAME喜欢闪亮且能反光的物品。可惜一看见自己的倒影就会受惊逃走，把宝贝也丢在原地。
author: cristata
source: POKENAME love shiny, reflective objects. Unfortunately, they startle at the sight of their own reflection, leaving their prize behind as they flee.

entry: POKENAME白天冥想，夜里醒来巡视沙漠家园。它聪明过人，巧妙指挥铁炮鱼，协助管教不听话的宝可梦。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME spends the day meditating, awakening at night to patrol its desert home. With its incredible intellect, it skillfully commands Remoraid to aid it in disciplining unruly Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME总在寻找更大的仙人掌，作为身体的一节。为了争夺巨大的仙人掌，同类之间常常打起来。
author: gurguro
source: A POKENAME is always looking for bigger cacti to use as segments for its body. Members of the species often fight over large cacti.

entry: POKENAME漫游最严酷沙漠，天然伪装帮助躲避天敌。行动又慢，即使近在旁边，天敌也几乎发现不了。
author: bigoljax
source: Roaming the harshest deserts, POKENAME's natural camouflage keeps it safe from predators. Due to their slow movements, predators barely notice POKENAME even if they're right next to it.

entry: POKENAME花数小时扔干草捆，磨练力量。不训练时，常能见它在乡村舞会跳舞。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: POKENAME spend hours training their strength by throwing around hay bales. When it's not training, POKENAME can often be seen dancing in hoedowns.

entry: POKENAME在沙漠烈日下热过头，就以头为轴旋转散热。奇怪的是，任凭转多快，也不会越钻越深，除非自己想这么做。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spins on its head to disperse excess heat from its body when temperatures rise too high in the desert sun. Oddly, it does not drill deeper into the sand, no matter how fast it spins, unless it chooses to do so.

entry: POKENAME埋进沙漠躲避酷热。小猎物一来，就跃出，用尖刺紧紧攀住。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME buries itself in the desert sand to protect itself from the heat. When small prey comes along, it hops out and clings to it with its spines.

entry: 它们全身许多刺，含有强毒。脱落的刺却能像种子扎根，长成带着醉人香气的紫花。
author: infinex21
source: Their bodies are lined with many thorns that contain a potent toxin. Any shed thorns can actually take root like seeds and grow into purple flowers that have an intoxicating aroma.

entry: POKENAME腹部渗液，是干沙漠的重要水源，也常被拿来发酵。
author: hophoppip
source: The liquid that seeps from POKENAME's abdomen is a vital source of water in the arid desert. It's also popular for fermentation.

entry: POKENAME手持的仙人掌储有清水，旱季也不缺水。它总会帮助遇险孩子，向想拐走他们的飘飘球射刺。
author: santon5512
source: The cacti POKENAME hold contain fresh water, helping these Pokémon stay hydrated even during droughts. These Pokémon will always help children in danger, firing their spikes at Drifloon that try to snatch them up.

entry: 从丰缘沙漠返回的训练家说，一片仙人掌忽然拔根、跑走了。其实，那是结群POKENAME，体色与带刺头冠，才让人远看认错。
author: sirg44
source: Trainers returning from the desert regions of Hoenn tell tales of a stand of cacti that suddenly uprooted themselves and ran away. In truth, these sightings are packs of POKENAME, mistaken from a distance thanks to their coloration and thorny crest.

entry: 严酷沙漠的生活，让身体保存了大量水分。不知为何，这似乎也会产生庞大电力，科学家至今难以解释。
author: sontyp
source: Because it lives in harsh deserts, its body conserves large amounts of water. Somehow this seems to generate large amounts of electricity, a phenomenon scientists still struggle to find an explanation for.

entry: POKENAME挖出精巧洞穴，收集、留住水，不晒太阳时就慢慢喝。其他宝可梦想抢水，就会在洞口遭伏击。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME dig elaborate burrows to catch and hold water, which they slowly drink when not basking in the sun. If other Pokémon try to take any of this water, POKENAME will ambush them at the entrance to its tunnel.

entry: 会静止不动地进行光合作用、节省能量，数十年不喝水也能存活。POKENAME会成群在夜间迁徙。
author: capwolfbane
source: It can last several decades without water, laying still to photosynthesize and conserve energy. Bands of POKENAME migrate at night.

entry: POKENAME耐心等在旷野，装成普通稻草人。任何生物靠太近，它就钻出地面，追赶入侵者。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME patiently waits in open fields, pretending to be a regular scarecrow. If anything gets too close, it will pop out of the ground and chase away the intruders.

entry: POKENAME穿行网页，会掉下尖针。不慎卡进页面，就引发大量错误，直到网页重建。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME sheds its needles as it traverses webpages. Should one accidentally become lodged in a page, it will experience widespread errors until the page is rebuilt.

entry: POKENAME挖出精巧洞穴，收集、留住水，不晒太阳时就慢慢喝。其他宝可梦想抢水，就会在洞口遭伏击。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME dig elaborate burrows to catch and hold water, which they slowly drink when not basking in the sun. If other Pokémon try to take any of this water, POKENAME will ambush them at the entrance to its tunnel.

entry: POKENAME受威胁时，蜷成满是利刺的球。起初静止装圆仙人掌，若再遭攻击，就高速滚走。
author: .jerden
source: If threatened, POKENAME will curl up into a ball of sharp spines. At first it will remain still in imitation of a round desert cactus, but if it is attacked it will roll away at high speed.

entry: 沙漠中的POKENAME有强腿，覆满吸能尖刺，一踢便造成多处伤。血液组成近似熔融玻璃，遇新鲜空气就迅速硬化。
author: bobosmith01
source: The desert-dwelling POKENAME has powerful legs cloaked with energy-sapping spines: a single kick can cause numerous injuries. Its blood is similar in composition to molten glass and rapidly hardens if exposed to fresh air.

entry: POKENAME白天混入仙人掌丛，装成普通沙漠植物。夜间，发光琥珀眼锁住猎物，无声跟过干沙，再以针般锋锐的盘卷毒尾突袭。
author: msdawgs
source: POKENAME blends into cactus patches by day, mimicking an ordinary desert plant. At night, its glowing amber eyes lock onto prey. It stalks victims silently across arid sands, striking unexpectedly with its toxic, needle-sharp coiled tail.

entry: POKENAME啃掉仙人掌的刺，把茎干改成睡觉的巢。若有谁闯入，整群便会合力催生尖刺，赶走入侵者。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME gnaw down the spines of cacti in order to form the stems and bodies into dens for them to sleep within. If someone invades the den, the whole herd will combine their powers to regrow the spines and drive the intruder out.

entry: 许多训练家注意到，POKENAME使出的沙暴，风势格外猛烈。它暗猎沙漠登山男，用沙慢慢吸走水分，让对方毫无察觉。
author: bigoljax
source: As POKENAME uses Sandstorm in battle, many trainers have noted how the winds created are a lot more violent. They secretly hunt Hikers through the desert, using their sand to slowly drain their moisture without notice.

entry: POKENAME生活在炎热干旱的岛屿，装作无害的植物，慢慢跟踪猎物。手臂末端长出的带刺果实，香甜多汁，人们常寻来点缀菜肴。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME lives on hot, arid islands where it slowly stalks prey while it pretends to be a non-threatening plant. The prickly fruit that grows on the ends of its arms has a sweet flavor and a juicy texture, making it sought out to top off dishes.

entry: POKENAME自古就生活在严酷沙漠，以极少的水，长时间维生。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME have lived in harsh desert climates since ancient times. It is known for its ability to subsist on very little water for extended periods of time.

entry: POKENAME完全由草构成，吞下的活物都会直接穿过身体。它真正的养分来自受害者的恐惧。
author: retrocrow
source: Being made entirely out of grass, all living things that POKENAME eats go right through it. They instead get their nutrients from the victim's fear.

entry: POKENAME视力极锐，连沙漠夜间也能看出数英里。它跟踪猎物数小时，再趁黑暗出击。
author: comfortablybrum
source: Incredibly sharp eyesight allows POKENAME to see for miles in the desert, even at night. It will stalk prey for hours, then strike in the dark.

entry: POKENAME入夜跟踪旅人、宝可梦，等酷热耗尽体力再袭击。触须连猎物的养分也能吸取，过程中，受害者常异样地平静。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME stalks travelers and Pokémon as night falls, waiting for them to tire out due to the heat before it strikes. It can absorb nutrients through its feelers, even from prey, and the process often renders the victim unnaturally soothed.

entry: POKENAME只需极少水，多数养分来自沙。全身刺充满毒，靠近时务必小心。
author: bacondlx
source: POKENAME requires very little moisture to live, and it gets most of its nutrients from sand. Take extra care when approaching it, as the spikes covering its body are filled with poison.

entry: 许多沙漠地区交易用POKENAME花朵制成的花朵薰香。古时，人们也把臂上利刺磨成原始矛头、箭头。
author: ilazerheart
source: Many desert regions trade Rose Incense made from POKENAME's flowers. Long ago, the spiky thorns on its arms were honed into heads for primitive spears and arrows.

entry: POKENAME无声穿行沙漠，日落前极少现身。速度快得目眩，能伏击猎物，再消失无踪。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME moves silently through the desert, rarely appearing before the sun sets. Its blinding speed allows it to ambush prey before disappearing without a trace.

entry: 饥渴驱使它捕食一切能装进体内的东西。旅人可以把食物或水扔进它体内，趁机迅速逃走。
author: quant9690
source: Hunger and thirst have driven this Pokémon to hunt whatever can fit inside of its body. Travelers can throw water or food into it and quickly escape.

entry: 沙漠将暮，POKENAME出现在边缘，跟踪迷路旅人。入夜后，便为迷失灵魂照亮黄沙中的死亡之路。
author: pattybgoode
source: As dusk nears in the desert, POKENAME appears on the periphery to stalk lost travelers. When night falls, POKENAME lights lost souls the way to dusty death.

entry: POKENAME振翅一次，就能掀起猛烈沙暴。风中气温接近华氏200度，足以对付任何想袭来的沙漠天敌。
author: staghorn
source: A POKENAME can kick up a raging sandstorm with a single flap of its wings. The air inside these sandstorms can reach temperatures of nearly 200°F - more than enough to deal with any would-be desert predators.

entry: POKENAME夜里徘徊在沙漠昏暗的沙丘间，几乎对什么都漠不关心。无论发生何事，也不作反应，只沿自己的路走。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME roams the dark dunes of deserts at night. It seems almost apathetic, as it shows no reaction no matter what happens and stays on its path.

entry: POKENAME住在烈日沙漠深处，一家慢慢同行沙丘。难得下雨时，尾巴会迅速开出短命花朵。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME live deep in the desert under intense sunlight, families of them travelling slowly together across the dunes. On the rare occasions that it rains, their tails will rapidly bloom with short-lived flowers.

entry: POKENAME体内的甜汁，在沙漠解渴极有效。特别干旱的月份，保护壳会因失水而变弱。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: POKENAME produces a sweet juice inside its body which is incredibly effective at slaking thirst in deserts. In particularly dry months, its protective shell is weakened due to moisture loss.

entry: POKENAME满怀遗憾，无法安息，留在这个世界上。它们会一直依附着自己的躯壳，直到躯壳消散。
author: quant9690
source: Unable to pass on and full of regret, POKENAME linger in this world. They will stay attached to their husk until it fades away.

entry: 科学家曾将POKENAME视为寄生者，如今知道它有益宿主。它贴上大型宝可梦吸血，利用其中废物，再把水还回，让宿主能在更干地方生存。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Once considered a parasite, scientists now understand that POKENAME benefits its host. It latches onto larger Pokémon and drinks their blood, using the waste products and returning the water, letting the host survive in drier regions.

entry: POKENAME没有咬人的牙，便从翅射利刺，钉住猎物。目标不动后，再俯冲，吸干体液。
author: sk372
source: Since it lacks teeth to bite with, POKENAME pins prey down by flinging sharp spines from its wings. Once a target has been immobilized, it can swoop down and begin draining its fluids.

entry: 许多人和宝可梦误将POKENAME当成无害的稻草人，因靠得太近而丧命。
author: fenragon
source: Many people and Pokémon alike have lost their lives by getting too close to a POKENAME which they mistook for a harmless scarecrow.

entry: POKENAME蜷球防守，坚韧刺皮提供充足保护。尾巴射出的剧毒刺，会让中者迅速脱水。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME goes on the defensive by curling into a ball, its tough and prickly exterior providing ample defense. It fires highly toxic spines from its tail that cause rapid dehydration in those hit.

entry: 这些残暴宝可梦在沙漠如水般游动，背鳍的身影，是许多人的噩梦。速度快得能卷出旋转沙坑，极少有生物逃出。
author: infinex21
source: These brutal Pokémon live and swim within desert sands as if they were mere water, the sight of their dorsal fins a common nightmare for many. They can swim so fast as to create a swirling pit of sand that few have ever escaped from.

entry: 夜里，POKENAME静立沙丘顶，散出芳香的丁香花气味。据说，疲惫旅人会沉沉睡去，无从防备沙漠危险。
author: .izik
source: At night, POKENAME stands motionless atop desert dunes, releasing a fragrant lilac scent into the air. This scent is said to lull weary travelers into a deep slumber, leaving them vulnerable to the desert's dangers.

entry: POKENAME进食后，把水存进身体深处，无水也能活数天。尖啸回荡沙漠，让它得了“沙漠报丧女妖”的绰号。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME can survive days without water by storing moisture deep within its body after it eats. Its loud screeches echo across the desert, giving it the nickname the “Desert Banshee”.

entry: POKENAME周围总有自己的沙暴，借不稳定风暴腾空。它爱干燥环境，若遇大雨，就寻找沙漠或稀树草原。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME surrounds itself with a personal sandstorm, using the unstable storm to travel through the air. They prefer arid environments and will seek out deserts and savannahs if there's heavy rainfall.

entry: 猛烈的沙尘暴完全吓不倒POKENAME。它们反而经常聚集起来，在炙热的狂风中起舞。
author: quant9690
source: Brutal sandstorms do not phase POKENAME at all. On the contrary, they often go to gather together and dance within the blistering winds.

entry: 白天会一动不动地站着，以免皮肤中的水分被烈日蒸干。夜间则用锋利的爪子撕碎猎物。
author: mr.person__prinplup_enjoyer
source: It stands completely still at day so it doesn't lose moisture in its skin to the sun. At night, it uses its razor-sharp claws to tear apart prey.

entry: POKENAME出没的沙漠一到夜间就会变得极度寒冷，足以危及生命。谁也不知道它们白天去了哪里。
author: staghorn
source: The deserts where POKENAME are found get dangerously cold at night. Nobody knows where they go during the daytime.

entry: POKENAME静立峡谷岩台，观察四周，竖起带刺尾巴，防天敌俯冲。
author: _subject
source: POKENAME stands perfectly still along canyon ledges to observe the land around it, perking its spiny tail up so predators cannot swoop at it.

entry: POKENAME藏在大片仙人掌中，等正午烈日耗尽猎物体力。在沙漠野花间发现一只，被视为格外幸运。
author: _subject
source: POKENAME camouflage in large swathes of cacti, waiting for prey to exhaust themselves in the midday sun. Spotting a POKENAME among the desert wildflowers is considered especially lucky.

entry: POKENAME夜间慢跟猎物，被看见就静止，装仙人掌。终于靠近疲惫目标，再使出足以断骨的猛烈头撞。
author: _subject
source: POKENAME slowly stalks prey at night, standing still to camouflage among the cacti when looked at. When it is finally close enough to its weary target, it delivers a crushing headbutt hard enough to break bones.

entry: POKENAME纤巧身体，很适合已精通的多种舞风。它借舞引来赖以为食的鸟类宝可梦。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: POKENAME's lithe body is perfect for the many dance styles it has mastered. It uses these skills to lure in the avian Pokémon it preys upon.

entry: POKENAME爬上仙人掌，吸干水与养分。等只剩干壳，就跳下，漫游沙漠；若找不到下一株，就改猎其他宝可梦。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME climbs up on top of cacti to drain them of water and nutrients. Once the cactus is a dry husk, POKENAME will leap down and wander the desert. If it cannot find another cactus, it will start hunting other Pokémon instead.

entry: POKENAME主要吃种子与根。沙漠烈日下，头顶长细刺，加强防御，适应严酷环境。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME primarily eats seeds and roots for its diet. In the hot desert sun, tiny spines grow from its head, adding to its formidable defense and helping it adapt to its harsh environment.

entry: 沉重壳内，是一池池沸腾的沙。只要活着、醒着，沙就永不停流。它们能控制喷沙，迅速制服猎物与多数敌人。
author: infinex21
source: Within their heavy shells are pools of boiling sand that has an unending flow, so long as they are awake and alive. They can release controlled blasts of this sand to quickly conquer prey and most foes.

entry: POKENAME的肉甜美多汁。飞过沙漠的宝可梦若从上方认出，就会成群尾随，盼着咬一口。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's flesh is both juicy and sweet, so provided it is properly recognised from above, swarms of flying desert Pokémon will begin to follow it in hopes of taking a bite.

entry: POKENAME裤状下半身，质地像仙人掌肉。厨师用蜕下的皮层，制成香煎罗子果料理，风味独特、鲜香。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's pants-like lower half is similar in consistency to cactus flesh. Chefs use its shed layers in a delightful sautéed Rindo Berry dish, creating a unique and savory treat.

entry: POKENAME借沙暴潜行荒漠，完美混进干地。它拉起带刺兜帽般的皮，嘲笑敌人，再打出虚实难辨、足以断骨的连踢。
author: msdawgs
source: POKENAME stalks desert badlands under the cover of sandstorms, blending seamlessly into the arid landscape. It mocks foes by pulling up its spiky, hood-like skin before unleashing a barrage of deceptive, bone-crunching kicks.

entry: POKENAME常维持迈步一半的姿势，一动不动。感到雨点节奏，就跳起欢庆舞，摇出沙沙响，直到雨停，才再度睡去。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME are often found frozen mid-step. However, when it feels the rhythm of rain upon its body, it bursts into festive dance, shaking itself to create a sandy rattling noise. This continues until the rain ends and it sleeps once more.

entry: 在沙漠中行走时，可能会遭到突然从地下冒出的POKENAME伏击。它会将尖刺混着沙子射向目标。
author: fenragon
source: When walking in the desert, you might get ambushed by a POKENAME suddenly sprouting from the ground. It attacks by shooting a mix of thorns and sand.

entry: POKENAME是穿沙漠者喜爱的坐骑。硬皮抵御沙暴，速度与耐力，则让它能在一天内，送乘客抵达目的地。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are a popular mount for people who need to travel through the desert. Their tough hide makes them resistant to sandstorms, whilst their speed and endurance allow them to ferry their passenger to their destination within a single day.

entry: POKENAME从沙漠的烈日中汲取热能，为火焰攻击提供能量。体内的沙子能保护仙人掌身躯不被烧着。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME will draw heat energy from the harsh desert sun to fuel its fiery attacks. The sand within its body keeps its cactus body from burning.

entry: POKENAME越老越懒，常逃掉平时承担的农活。通常宁可额外练负重，也不去做该做的任务。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: As they get older, POKENAME get lazy and will often try to skive off from the farming work they are often used for. This often takes the form of extra weight training instead of carrying out tasks.

entry: POKENAME似乎明白，大家都喜欢弱者，却特别爱将遇到的弱者彻底碾压。战后需休数天，因为沙质血液很难给肌肉送足养分。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME appears to understand that everyone loves an underdog and seems to take great pleasure in absolutely overwhelming any that it faces. After fights it must rest for several days, as its sandy blood struggles to bring nutrients to its muscles.

entry: POKENAME晒沙漠太阳，散出随风飘荡的甜瓜香。可这香气只是陷阱，猎物一靠近就会挨打。
author: .izik
source: Basking in the desert sun, POKENAME emits a sweet, melon-like scent that drifts through the air. However, this alluring aroma is merely a trap - it strikes at prey the moment they wander too close.

entry: POKENAME的血虽像沙，身体摸着却颇温暖。它疾驰沙漠，用尾缠住猎物。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's body is quite warm to the touch despite its blood having sand-like properties. It dashes across the desert, ensnaring prey with its tail.

entry: POKENAME在沙漠中游荡，寻找训练家并送给对方一枚摆锤。到了夜里，这件小饰品会让收下它的人永远沉睡。
author: thefinalkalgonus
source: POKENAME wanders the desert in search of Trainers, to whom it gives a pendulum. Come night, the trinket will make the recipient fall asleep forever.

entry: POKENAME由特殊沙构成，能在海滩爬行。进化、进入蛹期前，会大量吃海带。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are constructed out of a special sand that allows them to crawl on beaches. They eat lots of kelp before evolving and entering into their pupal state.

entry: 它虽像沙滩球，却别捡来玩，稍受挑衅就会爆炸。许多人的假期，因此毁掉。
author: bostroms
source: While it resembles a beach ball, it should not be picked up or played with, as it will explode at the slightest provocation.  This has ruined many people's vacations.

entry: 这些宝可梦对大多数生物害羞，唯独不怕年幼宝可梦、人类孩子。会挥舞小朋友分享的工具、玩具，可一弄坏，就哭起来。
author: infinex21
source: These Pokémon are shy around most, except for young Pokémon and human children. They wield the tools or toys shared with them by their young friends but cry if said tools or toys are ever broken.

entry: 这爱海滩的宝可梦，戴贝壳护头。它照看玩耍的幼小宝可梦与孩子，也会用孩子的铲子，挺身保护其他生物。
author: infinex21
source: This beach-loving Pokémon wears a shell to protect its head. It watches over young Pokémon and human children as they play and will use a child's shovel to fight for the sake of others.

entry: POKENAME引来争论：有人觉得，反正能重塑，推倒无妨；也有人觉得，推倒它很恶意。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are at the center of a contentious issue: some people believe that knocking over a POKENAME is acceptable because they can reform, while others believe that knocking them over is mean-spirited.

entry: POKENAME的翼由伞组成，常被阵风卷走。要留在地上，就得有沉重阳伞翼，上面通常挂饰物增重。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have wings that are made of umbrellas and often get swept away by gusts of wind. Their ability to remain grounded is contingent on having heavy parasol wings, which are usually adorned with charms to make them heavier.

entry: POKENAME体内水量不同，身体就膨胀、收缩。头顶铲子纯装饰，真正的刺针在尾巴。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME expand and contract in size depending on how much water is in their body. The shovel atop their head is solely decorative, as their stinger is found on their tail.

entry: POKENAME将身体塑成精巧城堡，吸引观众。个体不同，细节也不同，曾见火焰、雷云、护城河、太阳或月亮、森林、雪人、爱心图案。
author: sk372
source: It forms its body into intricate castles to impress onlookers. The castles come with extra details depending on the POKENAME: flames, thunderclouds, moats, a sun or moon, forests, snowmen and heart motifs have been observed.

entry: POKENAME能化沙、泥或水，挤过极细裂缝。它喜欢封闭空间，寻宝者常在宝箱里发现它打盹。
author: ghostslythe
source: POKENAME is able to squeeze through tiny cracks due to its ability to turn into sand, mud or water. They enjoy enclosed spaces, and are found napping by treasure hunters inside treasure chests.

entry: POKENAME研究建筑资料，每天细微调整结构。许多人相信，没有两只会完全相同。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME studies architectural data to subtly alter its structure each day. Many believe no two individuals are ever identical.

entry: POKENAME寻找装有蓝图的软盘、U盘，吸进沙体。身体随设计变化，几乎分毫不差地复制蓝图。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME seek out floppy disks and flash drives containing blueprints, absorbing them into their sandy bodies. Their bodies will morph to match the designs of these blueprints, replicating them with nearly perfect accuracy.

entry: POKENAME常在孩子爱去的海滩。它不介意人用自己的铲子、小桶，可若不归还，就会生气。
author: cloudmaker2169
source: POKENAME are found on beaches often visited by children. It doesn't mind when people use its shovel and pail but will get angry if they aren't returned.

entry: POKENAME会用沙子捏出大针蜂，吓退海滩上的水属性宝可梦。然而，这反而常常引来大型鸟宝可梦的袭击。
author: duskrd
source: POKENAME forms a Beedrill out of sand to ward off beach-dwelling water types. However, this often results in it being attacked by large bird Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME靠高度凝聚的精神能量维系。施展力量时，形体逐渐拉得狭长，负荷过大就塌成沙堆。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are held together by dense psychic energy. Their form becomes more oblong as they use their powers and collapse into a pile of sand when overwhelmed.

entry: POKENAME把海滩弃置的休闲用品重新摆好。曾见它躺在毛巾上，有人靠近就逃，却也会怯怯地和孩子们一起筑沙堡。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME take abandoned recreational beach objects and set them back up. They've been seen lounging on towels, but will flee when approached. However, POKENAME will meekly join children who are building sandcastles.

entry: POKENAME全身点缀小石子，每多收一颗，控沙能力就增强。常在海滩帮孩子筑沙堡，用头铲舀沙。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are speckled with small pebbles all over their body, each pebble they gather amplifies their ability to control sand. They can be seen helping children build sandcastles at the beach, scooping sand with the shovel on their head.

entry: POKENAME的背上会自然生成熔融的玻璃。吹制玻璃和安装玻璃的工匠常在店里养一只。
author: capwolfbane
source: POKENAME naturally generate molten glass on their backs. Glassblowers and glaziers often keep a POKENAME in their shop.

entry: 火焰热得能熔背上的沙，形成厚玻璃层。玻璃反射火光，明亮得让敌人目眩。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: Its flames are hot enough to melt the sand on its back, creating a thick layer of glass. The glass shines brightly due to the reflection of the fire, dazzling its foes.

entry: 火焰的高热，让它背上形成厚玻璃层。它得小心铲子，一靠火焰太近，就会彻底熔掉。
author: mistymagius
source: The intense heat from its flames creates a thick layer of glass to form on its back. It has to be careful with its shovel because if it gets too close to its flames, the shovel will completely melt.

entry: POKENAME体内积起极高热，升向表面。因此，部分沙熔成玻璃，塑出火焰般的雕像。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: POKENAME builds up extreme heat inside its body, which rises to the surface. As a result, some of its sand melts into glass, forming a sculpture akin to fire.

entry: POKENAME成群埋在海边，等游客到来。等人安顿休息，就一齐跃出，施展沙暴规模的泼沙，尽量抢走食物、零食，再飞离。
author: pjporwoll
source: Flocks of POKENAME hide buried at the seaside, waiting for beachgoers to arrive. Once people have set up for relaxation, the flock bursts up with Sand Attacks at the level of a sandstorm, steals as much food and snacks as possible, and flies away.

entry: POKENAME白天常长睡在向阳海滩。它爱和孩子玩，以细长沙体环住孩子，挡开自认的威胁与滋扰。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME spends long stretches of the day napping on sunlit beachfronts. It enjoys playing with children, and will circle them with its long, sandy body to protect them from perceived threats and nuisances.

entry: POKENAME的沙紧实，耐受伤害。它在海滩蹦跳，把铲子当临时麦克风，练习唱歌。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's sand is tightly packed, making it resilient to harm. It bounds around beaches, using its shovel as a makeshift microphone to practice singing into.

entry: POKENAME跑遍海滩，钻进沙堡，将其认作新家。谁想把它搬走，它就会一边哭，一边向对方扬沙。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME runs about beaches and dives into sandcastles, claiming them as its new home. It cries and flings sand at those who would try to remove it from its castle.

entry: POKENAME常收集喜欢的小石子，放在身上。据说若送你一颗，就会带来好运。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME often collects small pebbles it likes and keeps them on its body. It is said to bring good fortune if a POKENAME gifts you one of its pebbles.

entry: POKENAME胆小，大多藏在沙里。它爱僻静海滩，因为讨厌游客拉扯铲子。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is very timid and spends most of its time hiding in the sand. It prefers to hide on secluded beaches as it hates when beachgoers try to tug at its shovels.

entry: POKENAME静立晒烫的沙丘，直视烈日。有人相信，若它移开视线，脑中就会涌满迷失沙漠、死去者的幻景。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME stands motionless atop sun-scorched dunes, staring directly into the blazing sun. Some believe that if it ever looks away, it's flooded with visions of those who died lost in the desert.

entry: 身体大多是沙，强风容易将它带起。不过每隔一段时间，就得落在柔软海滩，免得被风吹散。
author: mistymagius
source: Due to its body being mostly composed of sand, it is able to be easily carried by strong wind currents. However, it needs to land on soft beaches every so often to prevent its body from being blown apart.

entry: POKENAME与同类沿岸漂流。发现独行人，就降下，用蓬松绒球堵住尖叫，再拖进沙里。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME drifts along coastlines with others of its kind. Upon spotting a lone human, they descend and quiet their target's screams with their fluffy puffball before pulling them beneath the sand.

entry: 它爱恶作剧，用长尾偷游客的帽子、凉鞋、零食。偷来便埋好，再用小沙堡作标记。
author: jaminmcready
source: It delights in playing pranks on beachgoers by stealing hats, sandals, or snacks with its long tail. The stolen items are then buried and marked with tiny sandcastles.

entry: POKENAME一浸水，几乎隐形，只有头铲仍是实体，暴露踪迹。据说谁想拿走铲子，就会被诅咒，慢慢化成沙。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME turn almost invisible when submerged in water, only given away by the shovel on their head that remains solid. Anyone who attempts to take the shovel is said to have a curse put on them that causes them to slowly turn into sand.

entry: POKENAME浸在水中时几乎隐形，只有头顶的小桶仍是实体，暴露踪迹。据说谁试图拿走小桶，就会被诅咒，慢慢化成沙。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME turn almost invisible when submerged in water, only given away by the bucket on their head that remains solid. Anyone who attempts to take the bucket is said to have a curse put on them that causes them to slowly turn into sand.

entry: POKENAME把桶固定头顶，帮助集中超能力，维持实体。睡觉时，任身体散回沙，藏在安全的桶里。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME secure buckets atop their heads to help them concentrate their psychic power on maintaining a physical form. While sleeping, they allow their bodies to dissolve back into sand, hiding within the safety of their buckets.

entry: 海滩常见蜿蜒长沙痕，却不通向任何地方。那是POKENAME懒散挖出的路，大部分时间都慢吞吞地钻行浅沙下。
author: jaminmcready
source: Often you will see long, winding trails in the sand on beaches that lead to nowhere. These are the lazy burrowing paths of a POKENAME, which spends most of its time sluggishly tunneling just beneath the surface.

entry: POKENAME装成小沙丘，静静等候。有人靠近，就跃起以强颚咬住，拖入沙下。
author: .izik
source: Disguising itself as a small dune, POKENAME waits in silence. If someone approaches, it springs up, latches on with powerful jaws, and drags them beneath the surface.

entry: POKENAME吃古老熔岩流，把富含二氧化硅的岩石化成沙，纳入身体。种群多的海滩，因白沙明亮，成为热门景点。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME feed on old lava flows, breaking down the silica-rich rocks into sand and incorporating the grains into their bodies. Beaches with large POKENAME populations are popular tourist destinations for their brilliant white sands.

entry: POKENAME住在热带海滩，收集铲子，嵌进背沙。可身体大多是岩石，因此没有额外防护效果。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME live on tropical beaches and collect spades to embed within the sand on their back. Since POKENAME's body is mostly made of rock, this provides them with no additional protection.

entry: POKENAME伏低冲过海滩，以巨躯扫起贝壳、碎屑，像把推沙犁。有时卡在潮池，只能乱扑腾，才脱得出。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME charges low across beaches, using its massive body to sweep up shells and debris like a sand plow. Occasionally, it gets stuck in tidepools and can only get out by flailing wildly.

entry: POKENAME进入网络空间时，沙质身体便会化作代码，自由活动。离开后又变回沙子，常在原先的机器里留下一些沙粒。
author: chibitales
source: While within cyberspace, POKENAME's sandy body takes on the form of code, allowing it to move freely. When exiting, its body becomes sandy once more, often leaving bits of sand within the machine it exited from.

entry: POKENAME大多在海滩，制作壮丽沙雕。艺术品常引来大量观众，它却极怕谁不慎将作品弄坏。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME spends most of its time on the beach creating magnificent sculptures out of sand. While it often gathers large crowds wanting to view its art, it is terrified of anyone accidentally damaging them.

entry: 雷雨时，海带般的尾巴朝天吸雷。电存进铲状耳朵，游客靠太近，就猛烈释放。
author: .izik
source: During thunderstorms, its kelp-like tail points skyward to absorb lightning. It stores the electricity in its shovel-like ears and unleashes it in a violent burst if tourists wander too close.

entry: POKENAME难寻，藏在僻静海滩沙下，极少接触其他生物。家园若受威胁，就掀起灼热沙暴，闪着彩虹各色。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is very elusive, hiding beneath the sands of remote beaches and rarely interacting with others. However, if something threatens its home, it whips up searing sandstorms that flicker all the colors of the rainbow.

entry: 它在沙中造小竞技场，用贝壳碎片与遗失饰物模拟战斗。每场小仗结束，就仔细复原场地，准备下一轮。
author: jaminmcready
source: It builds miniature arenas in the sand and stages battles between shell fragments and lost trinkets. After each mock skirmish, it carefully resets the field for another round.

entry: POKENAME雷雨时在海滩举尾，吸引雷击。尾与部分身体化成雷击石，脆弱玻璃状材料，闪着封住的雷光。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME draw lightning strikes to themselves during storms, raising their tails on beaches to make them easy targets. Their tail and parts of their body are turned into fulgurite, the fragile glassy material sparkling with captured lightning.

entry: POKENAME造出小卡比兽模样的替身，以可爱外表靠近讨食。别人送的食物，存进替身胃里，再送回本体。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME creates a facsimile of Munchlax in order to approach others and ask for food, beguiling them with its cute appearance. Donated food gets stored in the decoy's stomach, which returns the meals back to the main body.

entry: 头顶铲状附肢，能察觉附近最快乐的人。它把快乐当养分，飞向目标，以沙包住对方，吸走幸福。
author: .izik
source: The shovel-like appendages on its head detect the happiest person nearby. It feeds on joy like a nutrient, soaring toward its target and blanketing them in sand that drains their happiness.

entry: POKENAME让周围沙里冒海藻，缠住靠近的人。它虽食草，仍会困住几小时才放，好把人吓离巢穴。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME causes seaweed to erupt from the sand around it to ensnare humans who venture too close. Despite being an herbivore, it will hold them for hours before releasing them to frighten them away from its den.

entry: 炎夏晴日，训练家会用POKENAME的尾遮阴。不熟悉热带环境的人，会把种荚当成小椰子。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Trainers of POKENAME use their tails as shade on bright summer days. Those unfamiliar with tropical environments mistake their seed pods for small coconuts.

entry: POKENAME藏在海滩，避开多数人，却似乎乐于陪孩子与年幼宝可梦。可谁碰头铲，就会遭反击、喷火。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME hide along beaches and avoid most people, though they seem to happily spend time with children and young Pokémon. If anyone touches the shovels in their heads, however, they will lash out and spew flames.

entry: 与许多水跃鱼融合体不同，POKENAME不喜欢潮湿、泥泞。水分会削弱身体、拖慢动作，所以尽量保持干燥，远离一切水源。
author: sk372
source: Unlike many Mudkip fusions, POKENAME does not enjoy getting wet and muddy. Moisture causes its body to weaken and grow sluggish, so it tries to stay as dry as possible and avoid any water sources.

entry: POKENAME常在海滩，爱和孩子筑沙堡。不过，孩子最好别试着拿走小桶，因为它很记仇。
author: imaginita
source: POKENAME are commonly found on beaches and love playing with children who are making sandcastles. Children should beware trying to take their bucket, however, as POKENAME are known to hold a grudge.

entry: POKENAME常陪训练家一家到海滩。孩子若开始被卷向外海，就用尾巴搭救。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME can be found with family Trainers on beach days. They use their tails to rescue children in case they begin to get swept out to sea.

entry: POKENAME莫名被海滩弃桶吸引，戴作头盔。它太怕羞，几乎不露脸，不过有孩子说，一起玩时见过。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are mystifyingly drawn to the abandoned sand pails on beaches and don them as helmets. They almost never reveal their faces because they are so shy, but some children claim they have seen them when playing with POKENAME on the beach.

entry: POKENAME孤独害羞，很难在海滩主动接近其他生物。通常只敢靠近自认友善的孩子，盼找到玩伴。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is lonesome and shy, and has difficulty approaching others at the beach. It can usually only gather enough courage to approach children it thinks will be kind, hoping to find a playmate.

entry: POKENAME自以为独处，就会轻声唱歌，许多人形容美得令人沉醉。一发现有人听，就赶紧逃进海里。
author: sk372
source: When POKENAME thinks it is alone, it will sing to itself in a voice many have described as hypnotically beautiful. It quickly flees into the ocean if it notices someone listening to its song.

entry: 构成POKENAME的沙，平铺古老沙漠墓周，完美混入环境。它会突然扑出，将探险者拖进地下。
author: .izik
source: The grains of sand making up POKENAME's body lay flat around ancient desert tombs, blending in perfectly. It lunges out and drags explorers into the ground.

entry: POKENAME任孩子碰铲，帮忙筑沙堡。城堡完工，就附身沙雕，更直接地和孩子玩。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME lets its shovel be touched by children, aiding in the building of their sandcastles. Once the castle is complete, it possesses the sand sculpture in order to play with the kids more directly.

entry: POKENAME休息时，仿佛只是沙滩上的巨花。谁去戳弄，等它怒气冲冲挺起全身，就会吓得不轻。
author: sk372
source: When at rest, POKENAME appears to be little more than a giant flower sitting on the beach sands. Those who poke and prod the flower get a nasty scare when POKENAME angrily rises up to its full size.

entry: POKENAME爱漫步海滩，捡石装饰自己。不用的小桶，就收在第二张嘴末端。
author: hummusishome
source: POKENAME love to stroll beaches and collect rocks to decorate themselves with. When not in use, they store the bucket at the tip of their second mouth.

entry: POKENAME在沙里挖浅坑，用浮木、海藻盖身，等候猎物或闯入者。谁迈得太近，就骤然警觉，嘶声作响。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME digs shallow pits in the sand, covering itself with driftwood and seaweed. It lies in wait for prey or intruders, snapping awake with a hiss if anyone steps too close.

entry: POKENAME安静温柔，常和孩子在海滩玩。不过，头铲极敏感；哪怕有人轻轻一碰，它就瞬间消失。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is quiet and gentle, enough so that it will regularly play with children on the beach. However, the shovel on its head is extremely sensitive; it will vanish instantly if anyone touches it even lightly.

entry: POKENAME受惊会塌成沙堆，觉得安全才重塑。背上椰子一裂，就哭个不停，身体都湿透，直到椰壳修好。
author: jaminmcready
source: If startled, POKENAME crumbles into a pile of sand, only reforming once it feels secure. POKENAME cries nonstop if the coconut on its back cracks, making its body soggy until the shell is fixed.

entry: POKENAME埋在岸边，模仿四周环境。谁靠太近，就被刺藤缠住，拖进沙下。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME buries itself along the shoreline, mimicking the surrounding environment. Should someone draw too close, it entangles them in thorny vines and drags them beneath the sand.

entry: POKENAME爱在海滩玩沙。有孩子想跟它一起堆沙，它便兴奋得尾焰更亮。若成人想将孩子带走，它就会凶猛地朝对方扬沙。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME enjoys playing in the sand on beaches and gets excited when a child wants to build with it, causing the flame of its tail to burn brighter. If an adult tries to take the child away from it, POKENAME will aggressively throw sand at them.

entry: POKENAME有近乎狂热的挖洞冲动，总想在栖息的海滩上挖出许多洞。谁想劝阻这种习惯，它就会用尾上的蓝焰驱退对方。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has an almost manic compulsion to dig many holes in the sand at the beach it inhabits. If anything tries to dissuade it from this habit, it repels them with the blue flames on its tail.

entry: POKENAME平趴沙漠，等着发现迷路人。一看见，就尖叫着冲出沙，一路跑向对方。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME lies flat in desert sands, waiting to spot lost humans. Should it see one, it bursts from the sand screeching and sprints toward them the entire way.

entry: POKENAME常见于凉爽海滩，边玩边吐鲜彩泡泡，黎明时美景颇有名。若碰到后部铲子，却会立刻暴怒。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are common along beaches in cooler climates, often playing and spitting out vividly colorful bubbles, which are famous for the sight they provide at dawn. If the shovels on their rears are ever touched, they quickly become enraged.

entry: POKENAME的巢总在沙漠，四周沙子却极湿。猎物凑太近查探，就会被拖下。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME nests can always be found in deserts surrounded by extremely damp sand. It pulls prey beneath the surface if they investigate too closely.

entry: 游客离开海滩后，POKENAME用大鼻吸起留下的沙，渐渐添进身体，慢慢长大。
author: .izik
source: After human visitors leave the beach, POKENAME inhales the sand left behind through its large nose. It gradually adds the absorbed grains to its body, slowly growing in size.

entry: POKENAME附身于铲子，还能操纵沙子。会先向受害者的眼睛扬沙，再将其打倒活埋，吸取生命力。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME possesses a shovel and can control sand. It throws sand in its victims eyes, bludgeons them, and buries them alive to drink their life force.

entry: POKENAME附身于铲子，还能操纵沙子。会先向受害者的眼睛扬沙，再将其打倒活埋，吸取生命力。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME possesses a shovel and can control sand. It throws sand in its victims eyes, bludgeons them, and buries them alive to drink their life force.

entry: 据说，红缎带是朋友的礼物，可能已很久远。它友好温顺，爱和其他生物在海滩玩，可谁碰缎带，就会变凶。
author: infinex21
source: Its red ribbons are said to be gifts from friends, potentially far in the past. It is a friendly and docile Pokémon that loves to play with others on the beach; it grows aggressive if anyone touches its ribbons, however.

entry: 夜间退潮时，这些神秘的宝可梦会出现，把沙滩上留下的贝壳与石子重新摆成星座的形状。
author: cristata
source: At night when the tide is low, these mysterious Pokémon will appear and rearrange the left behind shells and stones into constellations on the sand.

entry: POKENAME夜间慢慢升出沙，无声滑过海滩，收拾人类垃圾。它用体内玻璃碎片撕碎废物，警告游客要妥善处置。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Slowly rising from the sand at night, POKENAME sliently glide along beaches to collect litter left behind by humans. They tear up the debris with the glass shards in their bodies to warn visitors that they should properly dispose of their trash.

entry: POKENAME铲状的翼，能短暂快速飞行。每年春天，东方海岸上空可见大群，景象绚丽，却不祥。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's shovel-like wings allow it to take short, rapid flights. Swarms can be seen filling eastern coastline skies each spring in a dazzling but ominous display.

entry: 夜间退潮时，这些神秘的宝可梦会出现，把沙滩上留下的贝壳与石子重新摆成星座的形状。
author: cristata
source: At night when the tide is low, these mysterious Pokémon will appear and rearrange the left behind shells and stones into constellations on the sand.

entry: POKENAME经过后可能会留下玻璃碎片。曾有报告称，一位训练家的宝可梦在与它相遇后，一条肢体被玻璃包住了。
author: uncookie
source: POKENAME may leave glass shards in its wake. It was reported that a Trainer's Pokémon once had a limb encased in glass after an encounter.

entry: POKENAME爱收集铲子，背上能放多少就放多少，甚至因此和沙丘娃起冲突。谁想拿走一把，都会惹它极不高兴。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME loves to collect as many shovels as it can fit on its back and will even start conflicts with Sandygast because of it. It gets incredibly upset if anyone tries to take any of its shovels.

entry: POKENAME在海滩沙下掘洞，吃游客遗弃的食物。地道绵延数英里，连接群落其他巢穴。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME tunnels beneath beach sands, feasting on discarded food left by tourists. Its networks of tunnels stretch for miles, connecting to nests of others in its colony.

entry: POKENAME随意霸占沙滩巾当床，几乎在所有游客间都声名狼藉。它似乎没恶意，只是太任性，需要多得夸张的休息。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are infamous among nearly every beachgoer for how they will casually lay claim to beach towels as their beds. They do not seem to have ill intent, but rather, they seem to be very self-indulgent and require exorbitant amounts of rest.

entry: POKENAME住在岸边浅水，让部分身体塌散，躲避人类。吃饭时才完整成形，向海中滚去，凡从嘴里穿过，都会被吸干灵魂。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME live on the shores of beaches just beneath the water, partially collapsing their bodies to hide from humans. To eat, they fully form their bodies and roll out to sea, draining the soul of anything that passes through their mouths.

entry: 它在海滩造沙坑，既休息，也捕新生大钳蟹等弱小宝可梦。坑一进水，就迅速换地方，另挖一个。
author: bobosmith01
source: It creates sandpits on the beach to act as both a place of rest and a trap for small, weak Pokémon, such as newborn Krabby. If the pit fills with water, it quickly relocates and creates another.

entry: 核心与腿部由硬沙构成。组成外壳的沙子经常脱落，因此需要不断补充。
author: mr.person__prinplup_enjoyer
source: Its core and legs are made of hardened sand. The sand that makes up its shell falls off frequently, so it has to place more.

entry: 这只宝可梦像水泥搅拌机。有人往盆里添沙、砾石，就特别开心。
author: fireblade141
source: This Pokémon resembles a cement mixer. It will become very happy if someone pours more sand or gravel into its bowl.

entry: POKENAME需要水维持形体，却极怕不慎熄掉尾火。两难矛盾，让多数训练家很难照料。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME need water to maintain their form but are viscerally scared of accidentally putting out the fire on their tail. This contradictory dilemma makes taking care of them difficult for most Trainers.

entry: POKENAME像沙子的外层其实由数万亿粒细小种子组成。头顶铲形花极为敏感，触碰就会让它露出难受的表情。
author: .izik
source: The sand-like coating of POKENAME's body is actually composed of trillions of tiny seeds. The shovel-shaped flower atop its head is extremely sensitive and will cause it to wince if touched.

entry: POKENAME的身体，由数万亿粒沙状种子组成。暴雨时，种子可能开始发芽，促使它把这些种子丢出身体。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body is made up of trillions of seeds that resemble sand. During rainstorms these seeds may begin to sprout, prompting it to discard them from its body.

entry: 它慢慢浮过海滩，飘在云层下方。无风日若觉得头顶落下细沙，可能正有POKENAME在天上望着你。
author: jaminmcready
source: It floats slowly above beaches, drifting just beneath the clouds. If you feel grains of sand sprinkling down from above on a calm day, it may be a POKENAME watching you from the sky.

entry: POKENAME喜欢收集小贝壳装饰身体，也喜欢孩子，常在海滩陪他们玩。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME loves to collect small seashells to decorate its body. It has a fondness for children and can often be seen playing with them on the beach.

entry: POKENAME一见海滩遗下垃圾，就冲去铲起、丢开。可当场抓到训练家乱扔时，却常不敢对抗，只好等人离去再收拾。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: If POKENAME spot trash left behind on the beach, they will rush over to scoop it up and fling it away. Unfortunately, they often have trouble standing up to Trainers they catch littering, waiting for them to leave before cleaning up for them.

entry: POKENAME在岸边摇摆走动，收集玻璃与塑料碎片，再把最喜欢的那些摆在身上。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME are found waddling near the coast, collecting pieces of glass and plastic. They will display their favorite pieces on their bodies.

entry: 即使POKENAME用沙与铲子摆出可爱面孔、形状，旅人也别跟随。浮空泡泡与贪玩模样或许让人信任，可跟着引路者，会消失在流动沙丘中，永远迷失。
author: silentscript89
source: Travelers are warned never to follow POKENAME, despite the cutesy faces and shapes it forms with its sand and shovel. Its floating bubble and playful shapes may evoke trust, but those who heed its guide vanish, lost forever among shifting dunes.

entry: 儿童鬼故事说，POKENAME会把头骨当面具，扣在旅人脸上，夺走控制，让其无尽漂泊沙漠，直到倒下，消失于流动黄沙。
author: silentscript89
source: In children's ghost stories, POKENAME is said to place its skull over a traveler's face like a mask, seizing control and leading them to drift endlessly through the desert until they collapse and disappear amidst the shifting sands.

entry: POKENAME十分珍惜自己的铲子，因为它承载着遥远而令人怀念的往事。喜欢堆建金字塔。
author: houndrys.
source: POKENAME treasures its shovel greatly, for it holds nostalgic memories long passed. It loves to build pyramids.

entry: POKENAME在栖居海滩下挖洞，结群捕猎。猎物靠近，便释放电流麻痹，再合力慢慢拖入沙下。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME hunt in swarms by burrowing beneath the beaches they inhabit. When prey is near, they unleash a burst of electricity to paralyze their target before slowly dragging them below the sand together.

entry: 古老岛歌说，吹制玻璃的工匠曾利用POKENAME。它的沙极纯，是制作精美玻璃的珍贵材料。
author: .izik
source: Ancient island songs speak of POKENAME being used by glassblowers. Its sand is so pure it was highly prized for crafting fine glass.

entry: 它偏爱野火烧过的焦沙，羽毛覆着细灰。余烬般的铲子，夜里微光闪耀，引来昆虫宝可梦，再埋起留待之后。
author: jaminmcready
source: It prefers scorched sands where wildfires once passed through. Its feathers are coated in fine ash, and its ember-like shovel glows faintly at night, attracting insect Pokémon it then buries for later.

entry: POKENAME静坐岸边，铲沙、筛沙，寻找珍珠或被海浪磨圆的玻璃。若见训练家帮忙捡垃圾，就送一件收来的小饰物，表示感谢。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME silently sit along shorelines, shoveling and sifting the sand in search of pearls or seaglass. If a POKENAME spots a Trainer helping to pick up trash from the beach, it will offer them a trinket from its haul as thanks.

entry: POKENAME的身体，得大到紧贴桶状壳壁，才会舒服。若沙流失太多，就与同类合作，威吓其他生物，帮忙收沙。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is not comfortable unless its body is large enough to press firmly against the sides of its bucket-like shell. If its body erodes too much, it will work together with other POKENAME to intimidate others to assist in gathering its sand.

entry: POKENAME头顶不是铲子，而是一小簇海滨草。根如血管贯穿身体，提供稳固支撑，让它能用双脚走路。
author: aggrave
