source: Instead of a shovel, POKENAME adorns a small patch of beachgrass. The plant's roots run through its body like veins and give it enough stability to move around on two feet.

entry: POKENAME袋状身体装满沙，气味像烂水果与肥料。它把沙撒遍海滩，驱赶游客。
author: .izik
source: The sand filling POKENAME's bag-like body smells of rotting fruit and fertilizer. It scatters this around its beach to keep tourists away.

entry: 这种宝可梦常因污染而出现在海滩。谁想前来清理，就会遭它攻击。
author: lydiaprower8
source: This Pokémon is often found on polluted beaches as a result of the pollution. It attacks anybody who tries to get rid of it.

entry: 这种宝可梦常出现在污染海滩。谁想清除污染，就会被它用铲子拍打。
author: lydiaprower8
source: This Pokémon is often found on polluted beaches. It attacks those who try to clean up the pollution by smacking them with its shovel.

entry: 这种宝可梦常出现在污染海滩。它攻击任何试图清除污染的人。
author: lydiaprower8
source: This Pokémon is often found on polluted beaches. It attacks anybody who tries to clean up the pollution.

entry: 每当有人往海滩乱丢垃圾，POKENAME就会爬出藏身处，将其吃掉，然后钻入沙中。海滩管理员为维持洁净、免受污染，会捕捉许多个体。
author: rycronicgames
source: When humans throw litter on the beach, POKENAME crawls out of their hiding spot to eat them, digging into the sand afterwards. Caretakers of beaches catch many POKENAME in order to keep their beaches clean and pollution-free.

entry: POKENAME偏爱许多人溺亡的海滩。死者越多，似乎聚集的个体也越多。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME prefers to inhabit beaches where many drowning victims have perished. The more who have drowned at a beach, the more POKENAME seem to congregate there.

entry: POKENAME的身体看似沙，其实是无数细种子。它因此能钻进窄缝，夜里入地睡觉。
author: .izik
source: While it appears to be made of sand, POKENAME's body is actually composed of countless tiny seeds. This allows it to slip into small cracks and burrow for sleep at night.

entry: POKENAME白天仔细听各种声音，夜里飞上天，模仿那些声音，将毫无防备的人引向岸边。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME listens intently to the voices it hears during the day. At night, it takes to the skies and mimics those voices to lure unsuspecting people toward the shoreline.

entry: POKENAME被海滩玩耍孩子的笑声吸引，偷来别人的玩具送给孩子，拼命想加入玩乐。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME is drawn to the laughter of children playing at the beach. It steals toys from other people and delivers them to the children, desperately trying to join in their fun.

entry: POKENAME本可方便落水者漂浮，却不喜欢分享自己的浮圈。表面覆着毒蜡，抓住就会中毒。
author: ozydamians
source: It would be a convenient flotation device for struggling swimmers, but POKENAME doesn't like to share its buoy. It's coated in a toxic wax that poisons those who grab on.

entry: POKENAME藏在阳光明媚的海滩沙地中收集光能。谁想偷走它的铲子，它就会从沙中扑出发动攻击。
author: mikk09
source: POKENAME hides in the sand of a sunny beach, collecting light. POKENAME will lunge out of the sand to attack anyone that tries to steal its shovels.

entry: POKENAME身体的沙，其实是细小锈粒。击昏猎物后，就用锈粒覆盖，吸取活力。
author: .izik
source: The sand making up POKENAME's body is actually composed of tiny bits of rust. Once it knocks out prey, it covers them in this substance to leech their vitality.

entry: POKENAME头顶铲子藏着毒刺。只蜇一下，就让意识极度清醒，而全身麻痹可持续最长20分钟。
author: .izik
source: The shovel atop POKENAME's head conceals a venomous stinger. A single sting causes extreme awareness but full-body paralysis lasting up to 20 minutes.

entry: 它爱用沙建造，每天铲沙、塑形数小时。可铲子一被拿走，就做什么都提不起劲。
author: mistymagius
source: It loves to build structures out of sand, spending hours a day shoveling and sculpting sand. However, if its shovel is taken, it loses the motivation to do anything.

entry: 这只宝可梦走到哪，都漏下泥浆，混着淤沙般的颗粒。看着像破稻草人或遗忘的海滩废物，静止到入夜，才无声跟踪徘徊者。
author: jaminmcready
source: This Pokémon's body leaks a grainy, silt-like sludge wherever it walks. It blends in with worn scarecrows or forgotten beach trash, remaining motionless until nightfall, when it quietly pursues wanderers.

entry: POKENAME极护铲子，弄丢一把，就很沮丧。找到新铲前，会用细枝或叶子暂代。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME is extremely protective of its shovel and grows depressed if it ever loses one. It will replace a lost shovel with a twig or leaf until a proper one can be found.

entry: POKENAME背上铲状蘑菇满是微孔，释放腐蚀孢子。孢子让游客失去行动能力，轻易就被拖进沙下。
author: .izik
source: The shovel-like mushrooms on POKENAME's back are filled with tiny pores that release corrosive spores. These spores incapacitate beachgoers, making them easy prey to drag under the sand.

entry: 介于沙丘娃与噬沙堡爷之间的形态。十分喜爱头上的铲子。
author: mr.person__prinplup_enjoyer
source: An in-between of Sandygast and Palossand. It's very fond of the shovel on its head.

entry: POKENAME傍晚升出海滩沙，巡视领地。要攻击时，就压紧、硬化头部的沙，让头撞更强。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME rises up from the  beach sands during the evening, patrolling its territory. It compacts and hardens the sand comprising its head when it needs to attack, making its headbutt stronger.

entry: POKENAME用音乐之力遮掩身形，歌声的振动能让沙凝固。它精通振动，能任意控沙，还常将观众困在流沙，想走也走不了。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME shade their bodies with the power of music, as their songs solidify sand using sound vibrations. Their mastery over vibrations allows them to bend sand to their will, often creating captive audiences stuck in quicksand.

entry: 背上的沙由菌丝结构维系，有时可从沙中小孔看见。它格外依恋卡在菌丝里的铲子，一被碰，就焦躁。
author: infinex21
source: The sand upon its back is held together by mycelia structures, which sometimes can be seen through small holes in the sand. It displays an odd attachment to the shovel caught in its mycelia and will become agitated if the shovel is touched.

entry: POKENAME夜里蜂拥海滩，搜寻被丢弃的食物。光刚出现，便立刻钻进沙，消失地表下。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME swarm the beaches at night, scouring the sand for discarded food. At the first sign of light, they burrow instantly, vanishing beneath the surface.

entry: 它的身体由砂岩构成。人们推测，头部的松沙渐渐压实，融入下方身体，令它长大。栖居海滩，正好提供所需的水与沙。
author: fireblade141
source: This Pokémon's body is made of sandstone, and it is theorized that its head, which is made of loose sand, is gradually compacted into the body below to make it grow. It lives on beaches that provide both the water and sand required for this purpose.

entry: POKENAME常蜷在游乐场、公园边缘。虽然看似疲惫，高兴时却轻轻弹跳，常发出高低起伏、像咯咯笑的哨声。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME is commonly found curled up near the edges of playgrounds and parks. Despite its tired appearance, POKENAME bounces slightly when happy and often emits a whistling sound that rises and falls like giggling.

entry: POKENAME住在托育所，和各种年幼宝可梦玩。它似乎格外喜爱甲壳类宝可梦，送沙表达友谊。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME live at daycares, playing with the various baby Pokémon. They seem to have a fondness for crustacean Pokémon, giving their sand to them as a sign of friendship.

entry: POKENAME住在海滩旁，因为身体至少得有些湿润，不然就开始散沙。它喜欢孩子，常帮忙筑沙堡。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME live near the beach because it needs to keep its body at least somewhat moist otherwise its sandy body will start to fall apart. It loves to play with children, often helping them build their sandcastles.

entry: POKENAME是沙之守卫，保护作为家园的海滩。看见孩子受欺负，或察觉沙堡被踢倒，就会挺身保护，用整个身体挡在前面。
author: imaginita
source: POKENAME is a sand guardian, guardian of the sandy beaches it calls home.  If it sees a child being bullied or senses a sand-castle get kicked over, it will move to protect the victim, shielding them with its whole body.

entry: POKENAME沿岸旅行，把泥与沙添在身上。头撞有时震落沙，便在每战后补回，确保防御稳固。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME travels across shorelines, gathering mud and sand onto its body. Its headbutts sometimes shake sand loose, which it replenishes after each fight, ensuring its defense is always reinforced.

entry: 它虽然极护铲子，却盼着陪孩子玩沙，独处太久就哭。眼泪会化成比普通贝壳更亮的贝壳，深受收藏家珍视。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Despite being fiercely protective of its shovel, it longs to play with children in the sand, and will cry if left alone for too long. These tears turn into shells that shine brighter than normal ones, and are treasured by collectors.

entry: POKENAME花数天搜寻海滩的南国贝壳，自豪地戴在身上。孩子走近，会送一枚；同一个孩子，却绝不会再获赠第二枚。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME spends days searching beaches for Tropical Shells, which it proudly wears on its body. When a child approaches, it will give them one Tropical Shell but will never offer that child another.

entry: POKENAME花数天搜寻海滩的南国贝壳，自豪地戴在身上。孩子走近，会送一枚；同一个孩子，却绝不会再获赠第二枚。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME spends days searching beaches for Tropical Shells, which it proudly wears on its body. When a child approaches, it will give them one Tropical Shell but will never offer that child another.

entry: POKENAME住在旅游海滩，钻沙时几乎看不见。它爱孩子的沙滩玩具，从桶铲下冒出，顶作帽子，自得其乐。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME make their home on tourist beaches, nearly invisible as they dig their way under the sand. They have a fondness for children's beach toys and will emerge underneath buckets and spades, wearing them as hats for their own amusement.

entry: POKENAME用塑料喙挖沙，收集找到的物件。很舍不得这些珍藏，谁拿走，就会伤心。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME likes to collect objects it finds in the sand, using its plastic bill to dig for them. It is very sentimental about its treasures, and it will be saddened if someone takes them.

entry: POKENAME平趴岸边，与沙融为一体。人靠太近，就抓腿迅速拖进海，同时用念力合住对方的嘴。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME lays flat against the shoreline, blending with the sand. If a human steps too close, it grabs their legs and drags them swiftly into the sea while using its psychic powers keep their mouth shut.

entry: 据说POKENAME由迷失海滩的卡蒂狗化成，会找幼童玩耍、挖洞，帮忙筑沙堡。可与POKENAME玩过的孩子，大多从此不知所终。
author: mistymagius
source: Said to be a Growlithe that became lost on the beach, POKENAME will approach young children to play, digging holes or helping to build sandcastles. However, most children who play with a POKENAME are never seen again.

entry: POKENAME以沙泥为食，用尾把沉积物舀进体内。养分不断被吸收，腹中留下干燥旋涡，需要定期浇水，免得塌散。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME feed on sand and mud, using their tail to scoop the sediment directly into their body. Nutrients are absorbed from the sediment constantly, creating a dried out spiral in their belly that needs regular watering to keep from collapsing.

entry: POKENAME喜欢玩沙，用铲子和超能力，堆出各种形状与图案。玩够以后，它会将沙子留成一堆堆，当作被子，舒舒服服地小睡。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME enjoys playing in the sand, using its shovel and psychic powers to construct different shapes and patterns. Once it's done playing, it will let the sand rest in piles to act as blankets for a nap.

entry: POKENAME用念力控制周围的沙，使其流动、旋转，困住敌人。足够专注时，还能造出规模最大达一公里的巨大塌坑。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME telekinetically controls the sand around it, making it shift and swirl to entrap its opponents. With enough focus, it can make giant sinkholes up to a kilometre in size.

entry: POKENAME用沙质肌肉搬沙，摆到合适位置，雕出艺术品。创作本领受力量限制，较弱个体，很难举起湿沙团。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can be found sculpting works of art out of sand, using their sandy muscles to lift sand into the right place. Their artistry is only as good as their strength, as lifting clumps of wet sand can be difficult for weaker POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME埋在沙里，等小宝可梦落进嘴。幸好没牙，人不慎踩上，不太会受伤。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME buries itself in the sand, waiting for small Pokémon to fall into its mouth. Luckily, because of its lack of teeth, people are unlikely to be injured by accidentally stepping on one.

entry: POKENAME在海底钻行，躲到时机合适，再以触手缠水中宝可梦。沙头与海藻触手，都很适应深海。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME burrow along the ocean floor, hiding until the right moment to ensnare aquatic Pokémon with their tentacles. Their sandy heads and seaweed tentacles are well adapted for the ocean depths.

entry: 它住在沙滩，通常和同类在一起。日落时，常能见它沿海跑。传说POKENAME生于孩子玩沙跌倒后的懊恼。
author: fiordaliso
source: This creature dwells on sandy beaches, usually among others of its kind. It is often seen running by the sea at sunset. Legends say POKENAME was born from the frustration of children who tripped on the sand while playing.

entry: 它伏在沙滩下，准备突袭宝可梦，吸取生命力。但多数时候，却因无聊而睡着，或干脆忘了自己在等猎物。
author: staghorn
source: It lurks in the sand of beaches, ready to ambush Pokémon and drain their life force. Most of the time, however, it gets bored, falls asleep, or forgets that it was waiting for prey.

entry: POKENAME遇天敌，就把铲子当标枪扔出，有时卡进鳞片或毛里。若天敌带着铲子逃跑，它就追着讨回。
author: quackquackattack
source: They are known to toss their shovel like a javelin whenever facing a predator, sometimes lodging it into scales or fur. If a predator attempts to escape with their shovel, POKENAME are known to chase after them.

entry: POKENAME在真头旁，用压实沙造出假头，迷惑敌人。假头呆望，真头就怪叫或扬沙，扰乱来犯者。
author: jaminmcready
source: To confuse enemies, POKENAME builds a decoy head out of packed sand near its real one. While the fake head stares blankly, the other will make erratic calls or throw sand to disorient threats.

entry: 在沙滩休息时若忽感困倦，可得当心，或许是POKENAME在作祟。等目标熟睡，它就从下方陷开沙坑，将人困进沙墓。
author: staghorn
source: If you feel yourself becoming drowsy while relaxing on a sandy beach, be careful; it may be due to a POKENAME's influence. Once its target is fast asleep, it will open a sinkhole below them and trap them in a sandy tomb.

entry: POKENAME以超自然力量催眠附近生物，引往僻静岸边。中招者开始给它添沙，让身体更大、更强。
author: bobosmith01
source: Using supernatural powers, POKENAME hypnotizes those nearby and lures them towards secluded shores. Then, those under its spell begin to add sand to its body, allowing it to grow bigger and stronger.

entry: POKENAME在安静海滩埋伏，看似无害。一靠近，就被利钳抓住，拖往深海。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME lies in wait on quiet beaches, appearing harmless. When approached, it seizes its victim with sharp pincers and pulls them into the ocean depths.

entry: POKENAME用蘑菇传电，可蘑菇未必承受得了全部电流，结果便突然爆炸。
author: .realthree
source: The mushrooms that POKENAME directs its electricity through can't always hold all of the amperage. The result is a sudden explosion.

entry: POKENAME在洞中爬行，也会外出喝晨露。关都流行童谣，说一踩到它，就会爆出钱币。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME scuttles about in caves, venturing out to drink morning dew. A popular Kantonian nursery rhyme claims that stepping on POKENAME causes it to explode into Pokédollars.

entry: POKENAME约半身被强烈真菌感染。大多似乎只略影响行动，不过偶尔，也能发现行为、精神状态的差异。
author: sk372
source: About half of POKENAME's body has been overtaken by a strong fungal infection. This mostly seems to only affect its mobility slightly, but some differences in its behavior and mental state have been occasionally noticed.

entry: POKENAME用自身孢子，在武器骨头上长出坚硬蘑菇。骨棍一撞，就释放孢子，持续吸走对手能量。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses its own spores to grow hard and solid mushrooms on the bones it uses as weapons. These bone clubs release spores on impact that drain its opponent's energy over time.

entry: 吸取养分的蘑菇已成为POKENAME身体的一部分，让它非常擅长使用吸取拳。不过，无论从对手身上吸来多少能量，三分钟后仍然必须休息。
author: imaginita
source: Thanks to the nutrient-draining mushrooms that are now part of its body, POKENAME is an expert at using Drain Punch.  No matter how much energy it absorbs from its foe, however, it still needs a break after three minutes.

entry: 真菌分解POKENAME吃下的植物，产生让身体鼓胀的毒气。每次排气，也会喷出浓浓孢子。
author: .jerden
source: The toxic gas that inflates POKENAME's body is produced by a fungus that breaks down any plant matter POKENAME eats. Whenever it vents gas, it also spews out thick clouds of spores.

entry: 菌丝在POKENAME的铠甲下蔓延，不断削弱骨骼。幸好覆甲外皮足以抵挡坦克炮弹，保护日渐衰弱的身体。
author: pjporwoll
source: Fungal mycelium spreads under the armor of POKENAME, steadily sapping the strength of its bones. Its plated hide is durable enough to withstand tank rounds, protecting the weakened body.

entry: POKENAME脸部褶饰上的菌丝，能感知较暖洋流，指引迁徙。它和墨海马群同行，游动时留下孢子。
author: .izik
source: The mycelium on the frills of POKENAME's face allows it to sense warmer water currents for migration. It travels with schools of Horsea, leaving spores behind as it swims.

entry: POKENAME角上长着蘑菇，不便刺穿猎物。真菌却会在撞击时放出孢子，过一会儿才造成麻痹；它只需跟踪，等毒效发作再捕捉。
author: sk372
source: The mushroom growing on POKENAME's horn makes it inefficient for skewering prey. Instead, the fungus releases spores on impact that have a delayed paralysis effect, letting POKENAME follow and pick off its prey once it takes effect.

entry: POKENAME看似失明，却能通过伸入地下、延向空中的极细菌丝网络，准确感知四周。
author: .realthree
source: Though POKENAME appears to be blind, it can accurately sense its surroundings through an extremely fine system of mycelium it spreads through the ground and air.

entry: POKENAME能用手臂，把自己拖离危险，不过只作为最后手段。常活动的个体，进化后的健康状况，反而不如静止的同类。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME can use its arms to pull itself away from danger, but this is only used as a last-ditch tactic. POKENAME that move around a lot are less healthy after evolving than ones that stay still.

entry: POKENAME表演默剧，分散观众注意，同时散布细小到难以察觉的孢子。感染者无法控制自己的动作，只能被迫模仿POKENAME。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME does mime performances to distract viewers while it infects them with imperceptibly tiny spores. Those infected lose control of their motor functions and are compelled to mimic POKENAME's movements.

entry: POKENAME常住在丛林，从灌木、树枝伏击猎物。科学家不懂，为何有些会呈现这副形态，尤其竟与猫老大相似。
author: sondededoo
source: POKENAME often take residence within jungles, where they ambush prey from bushes or the branches of trees. Scientists are baffled as to why POKENAME sometimes take on this form, especially because of its similarities to Persian.

entry: 它能从全身释放孢子。吸入后会灼痛，眼前景象晃动，如困在热浪幻影中。
author: imaginita
source: It can release spores from all over its body.  If inhaled, these spores cause a burning sensation and make the victim's vision swim, as if stuck inside a heat mirage.

entry: POKENAME变身前，先用闪亮金孢子盖住自己。散出的孢子越多，变身就越准确。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME covers itself in shimmering golden spores before it transforms. The more spores it scatters, the more accurate the transformation becomes.

entry: POKENAME背上的蘑菇，总噼啪闪着电。它从空气收集静电，提升速度。
author: .realthree
source: The mushrooms on POKENAME's back are always crackling with electricity. It gathers static charge from the air and uses it to enhance its speed.

entry: POKENAME尾边的蘑菇始终烧着。烤蘑菇的气味，有人喜爱，也有人讨厌。
author: .realthree
source: The mushrooms near POKENAME's tail are always ablaze. The smell created by the cooking mushrooms is loved by some and hated by others.

entry: POKENAME常在复杂机器的程序里制造异常，成了所有程序员的头号敌人。
author: dusknoir64
source: POKENAME is often found creating abnormalities in the code of complex machines. It has become enemy number one of all programmers.

entry: POKENAME背上蘑菇常大到遮住全身日照。菌丝异常粗厚，有时能硬如石头。
author: .izik
source: The mushroom on POKENAME's back regularly grows large enough to cast its entire body in shadow. The mycelium is incredibly thick and can sometimes become as hard as stone.

entry: POKENAME只需利刃划一下，就能让对手感染吸取生命力的真菌。之后只管等待，任猎物逐渐撑不住。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME only needs to make a single cut with its blades to infect an opponent with a life-draining fungus. It then simply bides its time and waits for its prey to succumb to the effects.

entry: POKENAME虽然没有翅膀，却能跳得极高，因为感染的真菌强化了双腿。
author: .realthree
source: Despite lacking wings, POKENAME can jump incredibly high. This is because the fungus infecting it has strengthened its legs.

entry: POKENAME常盘在大树干上。每当它换树，调查旧树总会发现，内部已腐烂，寄生着与它背上一样的蘑菇。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME are usually found wrapped around the trunk of large trees. Investigation after POKENAME moves on to another tree always finds that they are rotten within, infested by the same mushrooms that grow on POKENAME's back.

entry: 据说POKENAME的蘑菇有神奇疗效。它把蘑菇放在看似随机的地方，危险洞穴、僻静遗迹都有。
author: mepp.
source: The mushrooms of the POKENAME are said to hold miraculous healing properties. POKENAME sets its mushrooms in seemingly random places, anywhere from perilous caves to isolated ruins.

entry: POKENAME头上蘑菇的孢子，闻着像罗勒，却有剧毒。战斗时会甩动蘑菇，将孢子散满战场。
author: .izik
source: The spores emanating from the mushroom on POKENAME's head smell like basil but are extremely toxic. It swings the mushroom during combat to spread spores across the battlefield.

entry: POKENAME颈边一圈蘑菇，经妥善浸泡，能制成有效的家用药剂。它挥大叶散孢子，让森林家园多长真菌。
author: sk372
source: The mushrooms circling POKENAME's neck can make an effective home remedy for sickness when steeped properly. It waves its large leaf around to spread spores that help grow fungi in its forest home.

entry: POKENAME收集秋叶，塞在外骨骼节段之间，喂养体内真菌。一年间，枯叶会慢慢被拖进几丁质外壳内部。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME collect autumnal leaves and stuff them between the segments of their exoskeletons to feed the fungus that inhabits their bodies. Throughout the year, the dead leaves are slowly pulled into the interior of their chitin.

entry: POKENAME背上鲜艳蘑菇，远看常被当成火焰。它们能自行发光，走到哪里，都照亮四周。
author: .realthree
source: The brightly colored mushrooms on POKENAME's back are often mistaken for flames from afar. They're bioluminescent and shed light wherever POKENAME goes.

entry: POKENAME背上冒出的蘑菇，不断释放孢子。胃口永不满足，让它见什么靠近就咬，也将真菌感染传开。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have mushrooms bursting from their back that constantly release spores. Their ravenous hunger causes them to bite at anything that comes near them and spread the fungal infection.

entry: POKENAME口中长满产生孢子的器官。一旦咬住目标，留下的咬痕，就会在之后几天，冒出疼痛皮疹。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's mouth is lined with spore-producing organs. If it manages to bite down on something, the marks left behind from the bite will begin developing painful rashes over the coming days.

entry: POKENAME在背上蘑菇里储水，混满孢子，再吐向洞壁，催生蘑菇。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME stores water in the mushrooms on its back, filling them with spores. It spits this water onto cavern walls to encourage mushrooms to grow.

entry: 它想尽量以尾撑高身体，散播孢子。可胆子太小，稍有危险迹象，就放弃尝试，赶紧逃走。
author: imaginita
source: To spread its spores, it tries to elevate itself on its tail as high as possible.  It's very nervous, however, and will abandon the attempt and flee at the first sign of danger.

entry: 野生POKENAME会寻找感染同一种真菌的宝可梦群。其他成员睡觉、吃饭时，它以尾站起警戒，伙伴也会用采来的食物喂它。
author: .jerden
source: Wild POKENAME seek out groups of other Pokémon infested with the same fungus. While the rest of the group sleeps or feeds, POKENAME lifts itself up on its tail to watch for threats and will be fed by food the other Pokémon gather.

entry: POKENAME在树下挖出蜿蜒长洞，吃树根。头菇的孢子，渐渐让洞壁覆上一层真菌。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME digs long and winding burrows beneath trees to feed on their roots. The spores produced by the mushrooms on its head will gradually coat the walls of these tunnels with a layer of fungus.

entry: 记录显示，POKENAME常在火山岛的神庙出现。据传，若喷发威胁村落，它便会平息活火山。
author: imaginita
source: Records indicate POKENAME was often found at temples situated on volcanic isles. According to stories, POKENAME would calm active volcanoes should its eruption threaten human villages.

entry: POKENAME体液气味古怪，让附着的寄生蘑菇排斥本体。因此，它不必充当宿主，也能利用派拉斯部分的两只前爪与致衰孢子。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: The parasitic mushrooms attached to POKENAME reject it due to the funky scented fluid in its body. This allows it to utilize the two front claws and debilitating spores of its Paras half without acting as a host.

entry: POKENAME蘑菇里的毒素，很容易涂到网中，让它收获丰盛。
author: ametonian
source: The toxins in POKENAME's mushrooms allow for its webs to be easily poisoned, letting POKENAME end up with a bountiful harvest.

entry: 细看才知，POKENAME的网，不像多数蛛形宝可梦以丝织成，而是从身上蘑菇抽来的极细、极黏真菌物质。
author: sk372
source: Close examination reveals that POKENAME's webbing is not made of thread like most arachnid Pokémon. Instead, it is made of a very fine and extremely sticky fungal matter siphoned from the mushrooms growing on its body.

entry: POKENAME翼上薄菌丝，战斗时变得极硬、极锐，轻易就能切断钟乳石。
author: .izik
source: The thin layer of mycelium on POKENAME's wings grows incredibly hard and sharp during combat. It can cut a stalactite in half with ease.

entry: POKENAME触角上的发光蘑菇囊，充满氦气，让它浮空捕猎。深夜看见它漂在海上，实在令人不安。
author: .izik
source: The glowing mushroom sacks on POKENAME's antennae are filled with helium, allowing it to float through the air while hunting. This can be extremely unnerving when spotted drifting above the sea late at night.

entry: POKENAME是派拉塞普斯菌的一个可移动节点，不知为何酷似皮丘。它吃塑料与乙烯基制品，身体覆着珍贵的接触麻醉物质。
author: mogor0771
source: A mobile node of the paraceps fungus, POKENAME closely resembles Pichu for reasons still unknown to science. It eats plastic and vinyl, and its body is coated with a valuable contact anaesthetic.

entry: POKENAME唯一愿望，是喝最甜的月光露，强过露水来源的月亮。不清楚，这愿望来自本体，还是扎根头部的寄生蘑菇。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: POKENAME's one desire is to drink the sweetest dew made from moonlight and grow powerful beyond the moon that the dew came from. It is unclear if this desire stems from POKENAME itself or the parasitic mushrooms rooted in its head.

entry: POKENAME试着用孢子感染蛋，可若蛋壳还有天然保护膜，常会失败。喂食时，必须去掉这层膜，菌丝才能穿过蛋壳孔隙。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME try to infect eggs with their fungal spores but often fail when an egg's bloom is present. When feeding POKENAME, it is vital to remove this bloom so that their fungal tendrils can enter through the pores on the egg.

entry: POKENAME温和害羞，通常待在高处树冠。翼间孢子最终长成蘑菇，据说吃下能得好运。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a gentle and shy creature typically sticking to the upper canopies of forests. Spores spread by its wings eventually become mushrooms that are believed to grant good luck when eaten.

entry: POKENAME的蘑菇有助改善视力，食用却得小心。若吃前没妥善浸泡，之后可能一段时间眨不了眼。
author: sk372
source: The mushrooms growing on POKENAME are used to help with poor eyesight, but care must be taken when consuming. If not properly steeped before eating, a person may not be able to blink for some time afterward.

entry: 曾有公司用POKENAME的毛，作廉价服装的主原料。发现穿着会引起皮肤瘙痒、红疹后，这系列很快就停产。
author: sk372
source: A company once used POKENAME wool as the main ingredient in a line of cheap clothing. The line was quickly discontinued when it was discovered that wearing the clothes caused itchy rashes to develop on the skin.

entry: 寄生POKENAME的冬虫夏草越健康，羽毛就越鲜艳。生活干燥处的个体，颜色会苍白。
author: .realthree
source: The healthier that the tochukaso fungus infesting POKENAME is, the more vibrant POKENAME's feathers are. POKENAME living in dry conditions will take on a pale appearance.

entry: POKENAME覆身的白绒毛，其实是寄生真菌的触肢。真菌看似不直接造成不适，可为养活它，必须比同体型宝可梦吃得多。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The white wool covering the bodies of POKENAME is actually tendrils of a parasitic fungus. While the fungus doesn't appear to cause the Pokémon any direct discomfort, POKENAME eat considerably more than other Pokémon of their size to maintain it.

entry: POKENAME覆身的浅色绒毛，其实是寄生真菌的触肢。它们用爪为同群成员修剪，减少真菌生长，努力不让它蔓延太广。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The pale wool covering the bodies of POKENAME is actually tendrils of a parasitic fungus. POKENAME use their claws to try to shear and reduce the growth of this fungus on other members of their flock, working to stop it spreading too far.

entry: POKENAME尾上的蘑菇帮助调节电力。战斗时强光闪耀，越投入，蘑菇就越亮。
author: .izik
source: The mushroom on POKENAME's tail helps it regulate its electricity. During battle, the mushroom glows intensely, growing brighter the more invested in the fight it becomes.

entry: POKENAME月下起舞，头菇散出美丽银孢子，闪闪发亮。许多人从远方赶来，就为观赏这些华尔兹。
author: .izik
source: While POKENAME dances in the moonlight, beautiful silver spores glitter from the mushrooms on its head. Many travel from remote locations to witness these waltzes.

entry: POKENAME长出的叶片与蘑菇，过去会制成庆典用的热茶羹。随着原料现代化生产，这习俗渐不流行，只剩少数村落仍在制作。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME produces leaves and mushrooms that were once made into tea caudles for celebrations. With the advent of modern production of these ingredients, this practice has fallen out of popularity, with only a few villages still producing caudles.

entry: POKENAME耳、尾上的寄生蘑菇，装满有浮力的油，让它顺河漂流。尾菇也可作诱饵，用来钓宝可梦。
author: foolish_weasel
source: The parasitic mushrooms on its tail and ears are filled with a buoyant oil that allows POKENAME to float on river streams. It uses the mushroom on its tail to act as bait to fish for Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME用手上真菌的孢子感染树木，让树长菇、变色，自己也更容易混入，装成另一棵树。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME infests trees with spores from the fungi on its hands. The infection causes them to grow mushrooms and change color, making it easier for POKENAME to blend in and pretend to be another tree.

entry: POKENAME爬树吃细枝、叶，头上的蘑菇帮助消化。它动得极慢，看起来完全可以装成一根光秃树枝。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME climbs up into trees to feed on twigs and leaves, which the mushrooms on its head help it to digest. It moves so slowly that it can pretend to be nothing more than a leafless branch.

entry: POKENAME飞行时，拍打头菇散孢子。孢子落下，会让下方生物昏昏欲睡。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME smacks the mushrooms on its head to scatter spores while flying. This causes drowsiness in those it drifts over as the spores fall.

entry: POKENAME头上菌盖富弹性，想飞就充满空气。想降下时，便从菌褶排气，同时在附近释放孢子。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have an elastic mushroom cap on their heads that fills up with air when they want to fly. To lower themselves, they release this air through their fungal gills, releasing spores nearby.

entry: POKENAME旋转着飘过平原上空。夜间向草地撒发光蓝孢子，让下方泛出梦幻般的天蓝色。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spins and floats through the skies above the plains. At night, it scatters illuminated blue spores onto the grass below, making it glow an ethereal cerulean.

entry: POKENAME用尾在树间荡行，寻找稀有蘑菇吃。头菇无毒，可若烹调不当，会韧得像橡胶。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME swings from tree to tree using its tail, looking for rare mushrooms to eat. The mushrooms on its head are non-toxic but are incredibly rubbery unless cooked properly.

entry: POKENAME慢爬森林地面，找到高大健康的树，就埋进根下进食。除非进化，或树木死去，否则绝不上来。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME scuttles slowly across the forest floor. Once it finds a tree that looks large and healthy, it buries itself beneath its roots to feed and will not resurface until it evolves or the tree dies.

entry: POKENAME虽像花，阳光却会迅速晒干它。白天大多埋地吃树根，只在傍晚露头，散出身上蘑菇的孢子。
author: .jerden
source: Although POKENAME resembles a flower, sunlight rapidly dries it out. It remains buried underground most of the day to feed on tree roots, and only raises its head above the surface in the evening, scattering spores from the mushroom growing on it.

entry: POKENAME贴地低飞，快速振翅刺激附近真菌，让家园蘑菇充足，便于进食。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME sticks relatively low to the ground when in flight. Vibrations from its rapid wingbeat stimulate fungi in the area, helping keep its home flush with mushrooms for it to eat.

entry: POKENAME脸颊冒出的子实体，是寄生的冬虫夏草蘑菇。它们接管本体的腺体，生产黏甜物质，供菌体进食。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: The fruiting bodies erupting from POKENAME's cheeks are parasitic tochukaso mushrooms. The mushrooms have hijacked POKENAME's glands and use them to produce a sticky, sweet substance which they feed on.

entry: POKENAME脸颊冒出的子实体，是寄生的冬虫夏草蘑菇。它们接管本体的腺体，生产黏甜物质，供菌体进食。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: The fruiting bodies erupting from POKENAME's cheeks are parasitic tochukaso mushrooms. The mushrooms have hijacked POKENAME's glands and use them to produce a sticky, sweet substance which they feed on.

entry: POKENAME脸颊冒出的子实体，是寄生的冬虫夏草蘑菇。它们接管本体的腺体，生产黏甜物质，供菌体进食。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: The fruiting bodies erupting from POKENAME's cheeks are parasitic tochukaso mushrooms. The mushrooms have hijacked POKENAME's glands and use them to produce a sticky, sweet substance which they feed on.

entry: POKENAME多半懒躺沼水，将真菌的根状结构伸开，吸收泥中养分。头上蘑菇可采下，混入溶剂，制成柔和橙色染料。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME mostly lounge in swampy water, where they spread fungal roots to absorb nutrients from the mud. The mushrooms on their head can be harvested and mixed with a solvent to produce a soft orange dye.

entry: POKENAME的真菌孢子，通常能控制任何宿主心智。可这次宿主的头脑实在太简单，反而没法被完全接管。
author: autismgaming89_51746
source: The fungal spores growing on POKENAME usually would be able to control any host's mind; however, they are not strong enough to fully take control of POKENAME due to its host's extreme simple-mindedness.

entry: POKENAME的孢子能带来暂时心灵感应。可惜难以控制，多人思想同时涌来，让受影响者偏头痛欲裂。
author: .izik
source: The spores POKENAME releases can cause temporary telepathy. Unfortunately, this is difficult to control, leading to massive migraines as the victim is assaulted by the thoughts of multiple people simultaneously.

entry: POKENAME有暗中发光的特殊花纹。碾碎孢子，装进玻璃小管，就能利用生物发光物质，制成荧光棒。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have unique markings on their body that glow in the dark. When their spores are crushed and put into glass ampoules, the bioluminescent substance can be harnessed as glowsticks.

entry: POKENAME爱偷，虽惹人烦，却很好应付。只要给一颗够大、够美味的蘑菇，几乎任何赃物，都愿意拿来交换。
author: sk372
source: While POKENAME has annoying kleptomaniac tendencies, it is fairly easy to deal with. It will trade almost anything it has pilfered if offered a sufficiently large and tasty mushroom.

entry: POKENAME头上的寄生真菌，限制了原本很高的智慧。通常得等吃饱，寄生者暂时满足，才会展现聪明才智。
author: sk372
source: A parasitic fungus on POKENAME's head limits its typically high intelligence. Most of its displays of intellect come after it has been fed, when the parasite's appetite is temporarily sated.

entry: POKENAME的门牙连最密实的根也能咬断。冬季为找暖处，常钻穿地下室墙壁，造成破坏。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME use their incisors to cut through even the densest roots. They cause damage to basements in the winter by burrowing through the walls, seeking heat.

entry: 除非被天敌逼出，POKENAME一生都待在地下。体内储存的养分丰富多样，因此很受追捧。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME spend their entire lives underground unless a predator forces them out. They're highly sought after because of the rich variety of nutrients that they store in their bodies.

entry: POKENAME背上蘑菇虽无叶绿素，却对阳光反应良好。它们产生的能量，也让本体心情更好。
author: .realthree
source: Though the mushrooms on POKENAME's back lack chlorophyll, they respond well to sunlight. The energy they produce put POKENAME into a happier mood.

entry: POKENAME会散播寄生在身上的冬虫夏草菌的孢子，隔空吸取猎物体内的养分。
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher
source: POKENAME spreads the spores of its parasitic tochukaso mushrooms to remotely absorb nutrients from its prey.

entry: 最好别在POKENAME身旁深吸气。孢子一吸入，就会影响大脑语言中枢，让人一段时间无法正常阅读、说话。
author: sk372
source: One should be careful not to breathe deeply near POKENAME. The spores it produces will, when inhaled, negatively affect the language center of the brain, rendering a person unable to read or speak properly for some time.

entry: POKENAME真正的身体，是组成尾巴的蘑菇，其余只是分散注意的诱饵。假身遭攻击，就会甩动，向周围撒出令人窒息的孢子。
author: sk372
source: The mushroom that makes up POKENAME's tail is its true body, the rest being a decoy to deflect attention. Attacking the false form causes it to swing about and spread out suffocating spores around itself.

entry: POKENAME全身冬虫夏草遮住视线，什么也看不见，只能靠其他感官察敌。所有办法都失效时，就会爆炸。
author: bobosmith01
source: The tochukaso mushrooms growing all over POKENAME prevent it from seeing anything at all. As a result, it relies purely on its other senses to detect foes. When all else fails in a situation, POKENAME explodes.

entry: POKENAME从橡果壳释放黏孢子，有很高药用价值。摄入能帮助疤痕组织愈合，对接受康复理疗的人颇有帮助。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME releases sticky spores from its acorn shell which are valuable for pharmaceutical purposes. The spores help people in physical therapy, as they aid in healing over scar tissue when ingested.

entry: 阴暗、潮湿又有风的地方，最适合POKENAME。头上蘑菇在这里长得最好，孢子也散得最多。本体温顺，通常挂在树枝上不动。
author: bobosmith01
source: The ideal place for POKENAME is a place that is dark, moist, but also windy. The mushroom on its head grows and spreads its spores the most in these conditions. POKENAME itself is docile and typically remains still, hanging from tree branches.

entry: POKENAME覆身菌丝硬如石。一收紧外壳，就能把卡车拦停。
author: .izik
source: The mycelium covering POKENAME's body is as hard as stone. When it clenches its shell tight, it can stop a truck in its tracks.

entry: POKENAME用尾巴钻墙，再往洞里填孢子，让整个洞穴家园长出真菌。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME drills holes into walls with its tail before filling them with spores. This allows fungi to grow throughout its cavern home.

entry: POKENAME在森林地下挖洞，吃树根，留下随树腐烂而生长的真菌孢子。若树木表面无伤，却接连死去，可能就是地下的它所为。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME tunnels beneath forests to devour tree roots, leaving fungal spores in the ground that grow as the trees rot. If the trees in a forest begin to drop dead without visible damage on the surface, an underground POKENAME may be responsible.

entry: 有人觉得POKENAME短鼻、大眼很可爱，便喂最好的园艺覆盖料与树皮碎片，让蘑菇繁茂。
author: .jerden
source: Some people consider POKENAME's snub nose and large eyes to be very endearing. They will feed it with the highest quality mulch and finest bark chippings to ensure its mushrooms flourish.

entry: POKENAME鼓起身体，发射利刺自卫。刺一碰就放孢子，让目标感染真菌，迅速被吸走能量。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME puffs up and fires off sharp spines from its body in self-defense. On contact, the spines release spores that infect the body with a fungus that quickly saps the energy of the infected.

entry: 千万别喝POKENAME制成的树果汁。身上真菌污染榨汁过程，饮后可能出现各种意外副作用。
author: sk372
source: It is highly advised not to drink any berry juice created by POKENAME. The fungi growing on it taint the process, and the juice could cause any number of unexpected side effects after consumption.

entry: 隔上几年，夏季就有一波POKENAME暴增，大群占据森林，引来成群捕虫者与蘑菇迷。有些地区还办比赛，看谁找到的背菇最大。
author: wiz0z
source: Every few summers, the population of POKENAME surges with swarms taking over forests. This event is met with hordes of bug catchers and mushroom enthusiasts. Some areas have started contests for finding the largest mushrooms on POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME喜欢寒冷潮湿，冬季吃常绿树。它用利爪划开树皮，喝流出的汁液，吸得太多，树通常会死。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME prefer cold, damp climates, feeding on evergreen trees during the winter. They will use their sharp claws to slice into the bark so that sap runs out for them to drink, draining so much that the tree usually dies.

entry: 过去，人们用蜂蜜引猎POKENAME，取它味甜的蘑菇。这做法早已遭禁，可惜现今仍有偷猎。
author: sk372
source: Honey was once used to lure and hunt POKENAME for its mushrooms due to their sweet flavor. This practice was banned long ago, but unfortunately, poaching incidents do still occur in modern times.

entry: POKENAME身上耐热蘑菇，释放灼烫孢子。碰到后的烧灼感，只有用水才能去除。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME has heat resistant mushrooms growing from its body that release scorching spores. The burning sensation that results from touching the spores can only be removed with water.

entry: POKENAME用坚硬的嘴和锋利的爪子，便能轻松挖掘。它最爱吃树根，若挖出蘑菇，却只会盯着看一会儿，就继续前行，并不吃掉。
author: imaginita
source: POKENAME digs with ease using its hard mouth and sharp claws. Its favorite food is the roots of trees. If it uncovers a mushroom, it will stare at it for a moment before moving on without eating it.

entry: 水只需经过POKENAME的菌褶一次，就能变干净。许多个体在下水道贴着其他水生宝可梦，吃宿主产生的残余物。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can produce clean water after a single pass through their fungal gills. Many POKENAME cling to other aquatic Pokémon in sewers to eat any leftovers that their host creates.

entry: POKENAME吐出的墨，混有蘑菇孢子。若一处海域，许多游动生物身上都长菇，附近大概就有它的巢。
author: sk372
source: The ink POKENAME spews out is laced with mushroom spores. If an ocean habitat has many creatures swimming with mushrooms marking their bodies, a POKENAME den is likely somewhere nearby.

entry: POKENAME低飞森林、田野，寻找无叶死树。一找到，就盘住树干，开始啃木。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME flies low over forests and fields, searching for dead trees without leaves. As soon it finds one, POKENAME will wrap its body around the trunk and begin gnawing at the wood.

entry: POKENAME结小群，穿沼泽捕猎。身体喷出团团红孢子，让对手睡着。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME travels in small packs to hunt prey throughout marshlands. It explodes puffs of red spores from its body that cause opponents to fall asleep.

entry: POKENAME嚎叫时，身上蘑菇变得极热。偶尔掉落，连落地的土都会烧焦。
author: .izik
source: While howling, the mushrooms on POKENAME's body become superheated. They occasionally fall off, singeing the soil they land on.

entry: POKENAME会顽皮地冲野外路过的生物发出吹号般的叫声，同时从鼻孔喷出孢子，通常会感染对方。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME playfully trumpets at any creature that passes by it in the wild. Doing so also expels spores from its nostrils, which typically end up infecting those it trumpeted at.

entry: POKENAME在电脑里好奇地戳遇见的一切。碰过的物体长出无害数字真菌，点击就会啪地破掉。
author: sk372
source: When on a computer, POKENAME behaves in a curious manner, poking at anything it comes across. The objects it interacts with grow harmless digital fungi that pop when clicked on.

entry: POKENAME攻击时，释放粉红粉云。城都药师过去曾用粉末制敷剂，帮助消炎。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME releases pink powder clouds during attacks. In Johto, pharmacists once used this powder in poultices to reduce inflammation.

entry: POKENAME尾端作画的液体，混着蘑菇孢子。画液还湿时，站得太近，就可能产生幻觉。
author: sk372
source: The liquid on POKENAME's tail that it uses to paint with is laced with spores from its mushrooms. Standing too close to its art while the liquid is still wet may result in hallucinations.

entry: POKENAME贴住树干，吸食汁液。树汁既提供养分，也保湿敏感的嘴唇。
author: imaginita
source: POKENAME attach themselves to tree trunks, feeding on sap. The sap not only nourishes the POKENAME, but also keeps its sensitive lips moist.

entry: POKENAME找能量吸取时，会撞倒电话杆，再用爪缠电线，吸收其中电力。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME knocks down telephone poles while searching for energy to siphon. It wraps its claws around the wires to absorb the electricity within.

entry: POKENAME的奶里能长各种细菌与其他生物，因此不会量产供人食用。美食爱好者说，每只产奶的风味，都略有不同。
author: bobosmith01
source: All sorts of bacteria and other organisms can grow in POKENAME's milk, so it is not mass produced for human consumption. According to culinary enthusiasts, each POKENAME produces a slightly unique flavor of milk.

entry: POKENAME的奶以浓郁鲜味闻名。有一道丰盛炖菜，就以这奶配背上的蘑菇制成。
author: mepp.
source: The milk produced by POKENAME is known for its rich umami flavor. A hearty stew uses this milk along with the mushrooms that grow on its back.

entry: POKENAME乐于分享的蛋，其实是身体慢慢生成的特殊蘑菇。疗效很强，吃下后，除最严重的疼痛与疾病外，都能治好。
author: sk372
source: The egg that POKENAME is happy to share with others is actually a unique type of mushroom that its body creates over time. It has strong healing properties, curing all but the strongest aches and illnesses upon consumption.

entry: 真菌已遍布POKENAME，融入神经系统。因此能跑得极快，可有时也会违背自己意愿，突然奔跑。
author: .realthree
source: The fungus that grows throughout POKENAME has become integrated with the Pokémon's nervous system. POKENAME can run incredibly quickly because of that, but at times it will take off running against its will.

entry: POKENAME很怕旁观者。若在草甸闲逛被发现，就猛喷深红孢子，高速逃走。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME is extremely shy around onlookers. If spotted wandering through a meadow, it explodes in crimson spores before darting away at high speed.

entry: POKENAME爪力惊人，轻松就能挖进花岗岩洞壁。它在掏空处种孢子，成熟后便会发光。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's claws are surprisingly strong, allowing it to burrow into granite cave walls with ease. It plants spores in these hollowed areas, which glow when fully matured.

entry: POKENAME能穿越时间，主要用来直接跳过夏、冬月份，因为头上蘑菇，太热太冷都长不好。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME can travel through time. It mostly uses this ability to skip ahead through the summer and winter months, as the mushroom growing on its head cannot flourish if it is too warm or too cold.

entry: POKENAME把尾上大蘑菇当蹦床，跳着消遣。每次弹跳都释放孢子，之后会长出更多真菌。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME bounces on the large mushroom on its tail as a form of leisure and entertainment. Each bounce causes the fungus to let loose spores that will create more fungi in the future.

entry: 它用耳状手臂上的爪，掰开水果。POKENAME吃来的大半养分，都用来硬化身体，尾菇因此一直干瘪。
author: oddwalls
source: It uses the claws on its earlike arms to break open fruit. Since most of the nutrients POKENAME ingests serve to harden its body, the mushroom at the end of its tail remains shriveled.

entry: POKENAME先用末端长菇的尾巴连击。蘑菇释放麻痹孢子，让它能近身，以爪攻击。
author: imaginita
source: POKENAME first strikes with consecutive blows from its mushroom-tipped tails. These mushrooms release spores that paralyze the opponent, allowing POKENAME to come in close and attack with its claws.

entry: POKENAME初看无害，力量的后果，却要受影响几天后才显现。诅咒会带来长期疲劳、渴望吃菇的症状，只有喝酸性饮料才能消除。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME may seem innocuous at first, but the extent of its powers is only revealed a few days after exposure. A hex from a POKENAME results in chronic fatigue and a craving for mushrooms that can only cured by drinking acidic drinks.

entry: 干燥日，POKENAME常像在哭。它确实不喜欢炎热，但这是在有意润湿干硬的皮肤，免得头上蘑菇枯萎。
author: .jerden
source: On dry days, POKENAME often seems like it is crying. While it does dislike the heat, it is deliberately moistening its hard dry skin to prevent the mushrooms on its head from withering.

entry: POKENAME走向比自己大的生物，献上手持蘑菇。礼物被接受，会很开心，却也因重量不均，向后摔倒。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME wanders towards any creature larger than it, offering the mushroom it carries as a gift. While accepting this gift makes it happy, it falls backwards afterward due to uneven weight distribution.

entry: POKENAME爱骑在训练家头上或肩上。孢子带电时，会传来安抚感觉，能舒缓紧张，甚至让宝可梦入睡。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME adore riding on their Trainers' heads or shoulders. When their spores are electrically charged, they convey a soothing feeling that can relieve tension or even put Pokémon to sleep.

entry: POKENAME头上真菌，让胃口与营养需求大增。它吃遍一片森林的每株植物、树果与真菌，再转往下一片。
author: sk372
source: The fungus on POKENAME's head increases its appetite and need for sustenance. It will gorge itself on every plant, berry, and fungus in a forest before moving on to the next.

entry: POKENAME会偷走在它居住的森林中熟睡者的物品。偷完常从身上摘一朵蘑菇留在现场，仿佛自己的名片。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a thief known to pilfer items from those who sleep in the forests it inhabits. It tends to leave a mushroom plucked from its body behind after stealing as something of a calling card.

entry: POKENAME靠菌丝网络辨方向，离真菌越远，本领就越弱。若远离菌类同伴，便迷糊得无法专注。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME relies on mycelium networks to orient itself, and that ability dissipates the farther it is from fungi. If it strays too far from its fungal brethren, it becomes confused and unable to focus.

entry: POKENAME背上伸出的菌丝束，能探测无线电波，追踪电源，吸取其中能量。
author: .izik
source: The mycelium cords extending from POKENAME's back can detect radio waves. This allows it to track electric sources so it can consume their power.

entry: POKENAME高空滑翔，翼释孢子随空气传播，最终落到某些虫属性宝可梦身上，长成冬虫夏草，再次循环寄生。
author: gaogao028
source: As POKENAME glides high in the sky, its wings release spores that propagate through the air, eventually reaching certain Bug-type Pokémon. They then grow into tochukaso mushrooms, repeating its parasitic spread cycle.

entry: POKENAME住在能找到的最大死树中，吃正在腐烂的木。头上真菌帮助消化，也会分走养分。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME makes its home inside the largest dead tree it can find, feeding on the wood as it rots. The fungus growing on its head helps POKENAME to digest its food, but also takes nutrients from it.

entry: POKENAME在树枝间跳跃，凭声响判断内部健康还是腐朽。一听空响，就用爪钻过树皮，吃里面较软的木。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME leaps from branch to branch and can tell from the sound it makes whether a tree is healthy or rotten within. Once it hears a hollow sound, it will burrow through the bark with its claws to feed on the softer wood inside.

entry: POKENAME细心培育体上同种真菌，把孢子种在林中死树上。等真菌开始分解，自己也吃腐木，从中获益。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME carefully cultivates the same fungus that grows on its body, planting its spores on dead trees throughout the forest. POKENAME also benefits from this, as it eats the rotten wood once the fungus has started to break it down.

entry: POKENAME兴奋时，四处蹦跳，吱吱叫。受惊时，头菇喷出大团孢子，裸露皮肤会起灼痛的疹。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: When POKENAME gets excited, it begins hopping around and making chittering noises. When POKENAME becomes startled, the mushroom on its head releases a large puff of spores that leave exposed skin with a burning rash.

entry: POKENAME视力差，靠本能生存。只在夜间出动，用利爪刺树，饱餐树皮流出的汁液。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME have poor eyesight and rely on their natural instincts to survive. Only coming out at night, POKENAME stab into trees using their claws and talons, then feast upon the fluids that flow from the bark.

entry: POKENAME在营养浓厚的泥沼，生活得很好。它能把岩石压成细粉，再以真菌触肢吸收。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME thrive in swamplands where the mud is dense with nutrients. They can crush rocks into a fine powder before absorbing them with their fungal tendrils.

entry: POKENAME挖入泥滩、盐沼，找植物根吃。也吃很多泥，这似乎帮助脸颊蘑菇繁茂生长。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME burrows in mud flats and salt marshes, digging up plant roots to eat. While it also eats a lot of mud, this seems to help the fungus growing on its cheeks to flourish.

entry: POKENAME甜甜叫着自己的名字，引起关注。头上蘑菇吸收触碰者的情绪，作为养分。
author: laughing_dan
source: POKENAME sweetly cries its own name to get attention. The mushrooms on POKENAME's head absorb the emotions of those who touch them, which they use for nutrients.

entry: POKENAME与伙伴建立深厚的亲人般纽带，吸收情绪为养分。蘑菇被用作药材，治疗焦虑、抑郁，也舒缓压力与愤怒。
author: laughing_dan
source: POKENAME form strong familial bonds with their partners and absorbs the emotions as nutrients. Their mushrooms are used as a medicine to treat anxiety, depression, stress, and anger.

entry: POKENAME从头部散孢子，安抚其他生物，降低攻击性。感染者似乎也极不愿离开它身旁。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME spreads out spores from its head meant to pacify and limit aggression in others. Those infected by the spores also seem highly reluctant to ever leave POKENAME's side.

entry: POKENAME几乎完全不动，只有翼膜随风弯曲、起伏。有人说，这些鳃状结构会捕捉灵魂，喂养背上诡异的蘑菇。
author: imaginita
source: POKENAME are almost completely immobile, except for their wings' membranes, which bend and ripple in the wind.  Some claim that these gill-like structures capture souls to feed the unearthly mushrooms growing from the POKENAME's back.

entry: POKENAME住在热带、温带森林，常藏进地上落叶，很难发现。若踩到伪装中的后背，就会扬起孢子云。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME are found in tropical and temperate forests, though they often go unnoticed by camouflaging themselves among dead leaves on the ground. Stepping on a disguised POKENAME's back will result in a cloud of spores launching into the air.

entry: POKENAME啃断树木、将其放倒后，留下背菇的孢子，帮助同种蘑菇长入木头。
author: .izik
source: After chewing through trees to knock them down, POKENAME leaves behind spores from the mushrooms on its back. This helps other mushrooms of the same type to grow within the wood.

entry: 人们相信POKENAME是林中亡者的灵魂，聚住一朵蘑菇。它试着侵入其他生物的身体，附身后如操偶般控制。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is believed to be the spirits of those who fell in the forest now haunting a single mushroom. POKENAME attempts to invade the bodies of others to possess them and puppet their body around.

entry: POKENAME用惊人咬力，凶狠护住林中真菌。蘑菇全囤给自己吃，供养头菇，让它变得更大、更强。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME fiercely defends forest fungi from others with its impressive bite. It hoards the mushrooms for itself to consume, which feeds the one on its head and helps it grow larger and stronger.

entry: 据说POKENAME鳞上真菌有多种医疗用途。可它以爪牙激烈自卫，科学检验这些说法，几乎没有进展。
author: .jerden
source: The fungus growing on POKENAME's scales is said to have many medical applications. However, POKENAME defends itself so aggressively with its claws and teeth that little progress has been made on scientifically testing these claims.

entry: POKENAME全速时，爪能击倒树木，不过通常仅限内部已腐的树。身后孢子云落在倒木，又长出新菇。
author: .jerden
source: When POKENAME accelerates to its top speed, its claws can bring down trees, although usually only ones that are already rotten inside. The cloud of fungal spores it scatters behind it will fall on the fallen wood to form new mushrooms.

entry: POKENAME假嘴内的牙，总带着大量孢子。任何东西靠近都会被咬、感染；只要结实咬中一次，便立刻停止攻击。
author: sk372
source: The teeth within POKENAME's false mouth carry numerous spores at all times. It chomps onto anything near in order to infect them, ceasing aggression the moment it lands a solid bite.

entry: POKENAME把上半身藏在枝叶里，看似受伤派拉斯。天敌靠近，就甩触手抓住，散布真菌孢子感染。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME hides its upper body in foliage, making it appear to be a wounded Paras. When predators come near, it lashes out and grabs them with its tentacles, infesting them with fungus spores.

entry: POKENAME讨厌日光，太阳一升，就躲进海蚀洞。照得太久，皮肤会严重灼伤，孢子产量也下降。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME dislikes sunlight, skittering into sea caves the moment the sun rises. Prolonged exposure causes its skin to burn heavily, decreasing its spore production.

entry: 坚硬菌盖保护POKENAME的头骨，头撞也不受损。背上蘑菇同样结实，因此完全不可食用。
author: sk372
source: A solid mushroom cap protects POKENAME's skull from damage when it headbutts others. The mushrooms growing on its back are similarly sturdy, and thus are completely inedible.

entry: POKENAME总像在打什么，不是腐木，就是附近巨石。每击都足以打碎目标，也让一团孢子在四周散开。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME always seem to be attacking something, whether it be rotten logs or large rocks in the area. They always strike with enough impact to break whatever they are attacking, resulting in a cloud of spores proliferating in the area nearby.

entry: POKENAME从附近森林，采各种蘑菇种在身上。人们看见它照料、保护真菌，宛如家长守护家人。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME collect various kinds of mushrooms from forests around them and plant them on their bodies. The Pokémon have been observed caring for and protecting the fungi as a parent would for their family.

entry: POKENAME友好，爱蹭新认识的朋友。可吸入蘑菇孢子，会令人觉得大难临头，限制了交友。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a friendly creature that loves to rub itself against new acquaintances. Unfortunately, inhaling the spores its mushrooms generates fills a person with a sense of impending doom, limiting its ability to make friends.

entry: 它想隐形时，红色斑点尾却不消失，看似一朵小菇浮在地上。虽然试着突然现身吓孩子，实际不太吓人。
author: imaginita
source: When it tries to turn invisible, its spotted red tail does not fade, so it looks like a little mushroom floating above the ground.  It will try to appear suddenly to spook children, but it's not particularly frightening.

entry: POKENAME在暗中极慢漂浮，似乎对周围毫无觉察。空头骨里的真菌，朝感知到生命的方向抽动，本能地喷出孢子。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME floats around the darkness at a very slow rate, seemingly oblivious to the world around it. The fungus in its hollow skull twitches in the direction of perceived life, shooting puffs of spores on instinct.

entry: 它中空的身体，似乎只装着头内垂下的真菌。有敌靠近，就喷孢子麻痹，再张口试着吸进体内。
author: imaginita
source: The fungus hanging within its head appears to be the only thing inside its hollow body.  If a foe approaches, it will shoot a puff of spores to paralyze them before opening its mouth to try to suck them inside.

entry: 它常呆望远方，腹部的嘴敞着。人们说，是灵界与身上蘑菇传来相互冲突的命令，让它不知所措。
author: imaginita
source: It can often be seen staring blankly off into space, the mouth on its belly hanging open.  People say this happens because the Pokémon is overwhelmed by conflicting instructions coming from the world of spirits and from the mushrooms on its body.

entry: POKENAME漂过海洋，让背菇保持湿润，却不浸水。到了海滩，就拖身上岸，整吞树木，散出能占满岛屿的孢子。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME floats across the ocean, keeping the mushrooms on its back moist but not submerged. When it arrives at a beach, it drags itself out of the water to devour trees whole, scattering spores that can take over entire islands.

entry: POKENAME头、背上的真菌，分解吃下的落叶。它定期喝水，免得蘑菇干掉。
author: .jerden
source: The fungus growing on POKENAME's head and back breaks down the leaf litter it eats. POKENAME regularly drinks water to keep the mushrooms from drying out.

entry: POKENAME在阴暗潮洞休息，正适合背上真菌。若碰硬壳伸出的蓬松白突起，就会扬起孢子云。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME rests in dark, damp grottoes, the perfect environment for the fungus growing on its back. If the fluffy white protrusions from its hard shell are touched, a cloud of spores will rise up into the air.

entry: POKENAME不介意小宝可梦上背休息、遮阴，可最好别这样做。大蘑菇放孢子，让接触者长出惹人不适的真菌。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has no problem letting smaller Pokémon rest on its back for comfort or shade, but it isn't recommended. The large mushroom dispenses spores that will cause irritating fungal growths on those afflicted.

entry: POKENAME头上灰孢子极易燃，战斗时先撒满地。被逼入绝境时，还能点燃孢子，轻松扭转局面。
author: .izik
source: The grey spores emanating from POKENAME's head are extremely combustible. It spreads them across the ground during combat so that it can easily turn the tide by igniting them if it gets cornered.

entry: POKENAME攀爬灵巧，爬上树，钻进树洞。它吃洞里的木头时，会燃烧尾端孢子，放出有害烟气，驱赶任何靠近的宝可梦。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME is an agile climber, scaling trees to reach tree hollows. It uses the noxious fumes produced by burning spores at the end of its tail to drive away any Pokémon that approach it as it feeds on the wood within the tree.

entry: POKENAME头上的火，其实是孢子燃烧。吸入后，肺中会灼痛不已。
author: bigoljax
source: The fire coming from POKENAME's head is actually burning spores. Those who breathe in these spores feel a blistering pain in their lungs.

entry: POKENAME的脚适合钻进树根、吸取养分，却很难走路。为保颜面，它宁愿扎在一处，等没人看，才肯移动。
author: imaginita
source: Its feet are made for digging into tree roots and extracting nutrients from them, but this also means POKENAME has great difficulty walking. To protect its pride, it prefers to stay rooted in one spot until it is not being watched.

entry: POKENAME望北时感到安慰，察觉强电磁脉冲，就会聚集。谁不慎撞见，它们便一齐喷巨大孢子云，赶走打扰集体观景的家伙。
author: npshi
source: Finding solace in gazing northward, POKENAME are drawn together when they sense a strong electromagnetic pulse. If one stumbles upon a POKENAME gathering, they expel a huge spore cloud in unison to repel those who threaten their communal sightseeing.

entry: POKENAME满头蘑菇，似乎妨碍了呼吸。它常接连打喷嚏，将大团孢子撒向四周。
author: sk372
source: The mushrooms all across POKENAME's head seem to have adversely affected its breathing. It is prone to sneezing fits, which spread large clouds of spores all around it.

entry: 这种蘑菇进化出了制造尸体供自己食用的本领。会将刀刃插进地下藏好，等受害者走近。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: This mushroom species evolved to create corpses for it to feed on. It sheathes in the ground to hide its blade from oncoming victims.

entry: POKENAME的形态简单而小巧，能将刀刃收进地下，伪装成普通蘑菇，同时用眼睛观察四周。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME's simple, diminutive design allows it to sheath in the ground and disguise as an ordinary mushroom while watching out with its eye.

entry: POKENAME的双刃配合，让敌人感染蘑菇孢子。一刃穿梭交战、分散注意，另一刃便绕过防线，趁隙击中，传入孢子。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's two blades work in tandem to infect opponents with mushroom spores. One blade dives around to fight and distract its foe while the other slips behind their defenses to make the infectious strike.

entry: POKENAME尖肢只需轻扎，就能让人感染起疹的蘑菇孢子。不过平时并不好斗，只有受更大的派拉斯融合体命令，才会感染其他生物。
author: sk372
source: A single prick from POKENAME's pointed limbs is enough to infect a person with rash-inflicting mushroom spores. It is not normally aggressive, however; it only infects others at the behest of larger Paras fusions that order it to do so.

entry: POKENAME臂爪伸出细长刀刃。刃的致密程度随养分变化，获得养分越少，就越脆弱。
author: .izik
source: Long, thin blades extend from the claws on POKENAME's arms. The density of these blades varies based on its nutrition, becoming more frail the less it receives.

entry: POKENAME与身上蘑菇完美共生。蘑菇充当催化剂，帮助储电，供它以电火花攻击。它天生怕羞，多夜间活动，可领地受威胁，也会凶猛守卫。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME lives in perfect symbiosis with the mushrooms growing on its body, using them as catalysts to store electricity for its sparking attacks. It is naturally shy and mostly nocturnal, but will fiercely defend its territory if threatened.

entry: POKENAME的蘑菇味苦，却富铁，多年来被用于营养补充品。
author: .izik
source: The mushrooms growing on POKENAME's body taste bitter but are high in iron. They have been used in nutritional supplements over the years.

entry: POKENAME的致幻孢子，让吸入者看见怪异幻象、海市蜃楼。它能伸出头上丝状物，缠上树根，吸收养分。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME produce hallucinogenic spores that cause anyone who inhales them to witness odd illusions and mirages. POKENAME can extend the strands from its head to intertwine with tree roots and absorb their nutrients.

entry: 行走时会挥动缎带，将孢子散播到周围。以腐殖物和堆肥土壤为食。
author: melodydelune
source: They use their ribbons to spread to the spores around as they walk. Their diet consists of mulch and compost soil.

entry: POKENAME体内蘑菇，有时让它疯狂攻击。重获控制后，却像不明白自己刚才在做什么。
author: .realthree
source: The mushroom growing in POKENAME sometimes prompts the Pokémon to attack wildly. When POKENAME regains control of itself, it seems confused as to what it was doing.

entry: POKENAME常跟着到访自己森林的陌生者，无声地俯视他们。访客不走，就一直盯着看；可除了令人不自在，尚未观察到其他危害。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME has a tendency to follow strangers to its forest, looming over them soundlessly. Though it never breaks eye contact until the visitor leaves, it has never been observed causing any problems other than discomfort.

entry: POKENAME掉下的孢子，一接触就能催眠。昏睡时的梦恐怖异常，来自受害者最深的恐惧。
author: .izik
source: The spores that shed from POKENAME's body can induce sleep on contact. The dreams experienced during this unconsciousness are horrifying, drawn from one's deepest fears.

entry: POKENAME用巨大力量撕树吃。大多数森林，很难长期供养超过三四只的群体。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME uses its immense strength to rip apart trees to eat. Most forests can't support a population of POKENAME larger than three or four individuals for long.

entry: POKENAME四处走，自豪展示臂菇。被鲜香引来的宝可梦，很快就会发现蘑菇有毒，而它正等着以利爪袭击猎物。
author: .jerden
source: As POKENAME walks around, it proudly displays the mushrooms on its arms. Any Pokémon drawn in by their savory aroma will quickly discover that they are poisonous and that POKENAME is waiting for an opportunity to attack prey with its sharp claws.

entry: POKENAME背上充气隆起里，满是极热孢子。它轻易漂过远路，寻找筑巢的山。
author: .izik
source: The spores filling the gas-filled hump on POKENAME's back are incredibly hot. It floats easily over long distances in search of mountains to build its nests on.

entry: POKENAME受惊的本能反应，是以大耳挥向来者。耳朵击中，就让人感染麻痹孢子，无力追赶逃走的它。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's first instinct upon being startled is to swing its large ears at the surprise. Getting hit by these ears infects the person with fungal spores that cause paralysis, denying them the opportunity to chase the fleeing POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME头上蘑菇成熟极快。幼嫩时采下，是丰缘各地菌菇汤底的常用材料。
author: .izik
source: The mushrooms growing from POKENAME's head mature rapidly. When harvested young, they are widely used in mushroom-based broths throughout Hoenn.

entry: POKENAME飞得快又乱，肉眼难追。不过，可沿真菌翼留下的淡孢子云，追踪路线。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME flies so rapidly and erratically that it is hard to keep track of visually. Its flight path can be tracked by the thin clouds of spores its fungus-wings leave behind as it flies.

entry: POKENAME进入电脑，就带来不可逆的真菌感染。离开后，屏幕还会长出无法清除的全息蘑菇。
author: sk372
source: Computer devices POKENAME enters are irrevocably infested by its fungus. After it leaves, the machine will grow holographic mushrooms on its monitor that cannot be removed.

entry: POKENAME充满妖精属性能量，让身上的冬虫夏草长得巨大。若曾经过家里，便能从留下的霉斑辨出。
author: .realthree
source: The tochukaso mushrooms that grow from POKENAME's body grow to enormous sizes because of the Fairy-type energy that is so abundant in this species. You can tell if a POKENAME has passed through your house because of the mold spots it leaves behind.

entry: POKENAME与腹部的蘑菇和谐共生。蘑菇用黏孢子覆住带电蛛网，让猎物难逃；作为回报，POKENAME会与蘑菇分享养分。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME live in harmony with the mushrooms on their abdomen, as the mushrooms coat their electric webs with sticky spores that make it difficult for prey to escape. In return for this added stickiness, POKENAME share nutrients with the mushrooms.

entry: POKENAME身上的长蘑菇，覆着强黏汁。冬月休息时，就借黏汁贴在洞顶。
author: .izik
source: The long mushrooms on POKENAME's body are covered in a strong adhesive juice. It uses this to stick to cave ceilings while resting through the winter months.

entry: POKENAME的蘑菇，白天也异常明亮，引人注意。谁吃下，就腹内烧痛，引来大群同类，等着受害者再也动不了。
author: icelevelincarnate
source: Even during the day, POKENAME's mushroom glows abnormally bright to attract attention. Whoever eats it will feel an immense burning sensation in their stomach, attracting swarms of POKENAME that wait until the victim can't move any more.

entry: 它有时与至少一朵寄生蘑菇，同步抽动。谁想碰这些蘑菇，就会遭到斧状长牙反击。
author: infinex21
source: At times, its body twitches in sync with at least one of its parasitic mushrooms. If anything tries to touch these mushrooms, it will lash out with its axe-like tusks.

entry: POKENAME身上蘑菇的分子结构，与所有已知真菌都不同。真菌学家正在研究，它们是否可能来自遥远星球。
author: .realthree
source: The mushrooms that POKENAME hosts don't match the molecular structure of any other known fungus variety. Mycologists are looking into the possibility that the unique fungus could originate from a distant planet.

entry: POKENAME白天大多半埋松土，吃土。受威胁时，从嘴喷出一团菌丝，充当额外肢体，痛打来犯者。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME spends most of the day half-buried within loose soil and feasting on dirt. If threatened, it spews out a hunk of mycelium from its mouth that acts as an extra limb to pummel its would-be attacker.

entry: POKENAME能控制采来、放进育儿袋的蘑菇。谁想偷一朵，所有蘑菇就会喷出刺激孢子云，让人看不见。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME gains control of all the mushrooms it gathers and places in its pouch. Trying to steal one from it results in all of them dispensing a blinding cloud of irritating fungal spores.

entry: 如同其他伪装，POKENAME身上的蘑菇也是假的。它装作向空中喷孢子，实际只是抛出收来的泥土、灰尘。
author: sk372
source: Just like the rest of its disguise, the mushrooms on POKENAME are fake. It mimics the act of spewing spores into the air, though in reality it is merely flinging dirt and dust it has gathered up.

entry: POKENAME的活动眼珠，常让天敌与猎物困惑、分心。它趁机挤菇散孢子，震晕猎物，也遮住自己，躲避天敌。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME's googly eyes often confuse predator and prey, distracting them enough for an attack. POKENAME capitalize on this confusion to squeeze their mushrooms, releasing a cloud of spores, stunning prey and concealing them from predators.

entry: 融合似乎改变了蘑菇本性，身体渗出的橙色物质，千万别碰。它早被感染夺去心智，无目的攻击周围一切。
author: fireblade141
source: The mushroom's nature seems to have been transformed through fusion, and the orange substance now oozing from its body should not be touched. It aimlessly attacks everything around it, having long lost its mind to its infection.

entry: POKENAME头菇完全盖住眼睛，却能凭蘑菇本身声呐般的奇怪能力，安全行动。
author: .izik
source: The mushroom growing on POKENAME's head completely blocks its eyes from sight. Despite this, it navigates safely using an odd sonar-like ability from the mushroom itself.

entry: 感染POKENAME的蘑菇，似乎影响认知。两个头认不出彼此同属一体，争地盘的内斗不断。
author: sk372
source: The mushrooms infecting POKENAME appear to affect its cognition. The two heads do not recognize each other as being another part of the same creature, leading to constant territorial infighting.

entry: POKENAME极速掠过天空，留下发黄绿色光的孢子。过去许多人相信，在光痕消散前许愿，就能成真。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME streaks across the sky at incredible speeds, leaving behind lime green glowing spores. Many once believed these glowing streaks could grant wishes if one was made before they dissipated.

entry: POKENAME全身长的九朵蘑菇，只有一朵能安全吃。其他八朵，谁碰到都会有不同副作用。
author: .realthree
source: Out of the nine mushrooms that grow on POKENAME's body, only one is safe to eat. The other eight mushrooms inflict varying side effects on anybody who touches them.

entry: 这只宝可梦四处窜行，随时准备攻击眼前的一切。遭它咬伤，就会感染真菌，连心智也被一点点侵蚀。
author: theheroict
source: A Pokémon that scuttles about, ready to attack anything it sees. Its bite spreads a fungal infection that consumes the minds of its prey.

entry: 据说，在真菌密布的森林深处，POKENAME会为访客实现愿望。可去过的所有人，回来都记忆朦胧，身上满是长菇的疹。
author: sk372
source: It is said that deep within fungus-infested forests, POKENAME resides and will grant wishes to its visitors. All who have ventured into its domain have returned with hazy memories and mushroom-laden rashes.

entry: POKENAME太像普通派拉斯，研究者花了数年，才发现是不同物种。它也促使人们提出一些理论，认为派拉斯、土居忍士或有共同祖先。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME looks similar enough to normal Paras that it took several years before researchers realized it was a different species. Its existence ignited a few theories of Paras and Nincada sharing common ancestry.

entry: 背上蘑菇的寄生方式似乎有些不同。心智看似无碍，可养分被吸走，让POKENAME长期疲惫乏力。
author: sk372
source: The mushrooms on its back exhibit a different parasitism than the norm. The mind seems unaffected, but the nutrients drained from the body leave POKENAME perpetually lethargic.

entry: 与多数过动猿融合体相比，POKENAME看起来明显更平静。人们认为，是寄生蘑菇吸走了大半过剩能量。
author: sk372
source: Compared to most Vigoroth fusions, POKENAME seems decidedly calmer. It is believed this is due to the mushrooms infesting its body siphoning much of its excess energy.

entry: POKENAME虽住在湖里，也能弹跳上岸，啃食植物。身体一开始变干，它就立刻回水，似乎是靠头上的蘑菇感知。
author: .jerden
source: Although POKENAME lives in lakes, it can bounce its body onto the shore to graze on plants. It returns to the water as soon as it begins to dry out, and seems to use the mushrooms on its head to sense this.

entry: POKENAME受威胁，可摇动头尾，放出遮目孢子云。通常不会趁机逃，反而扑上去咬，再补强力电击。
author: .jerden
source: If POKENAME is threatened, it can release a blinding cloud of fungal spores by shaking its head and tail. Rather than fleeing, it will usually seize this opportunity to attack with its sharp fangs, then deliver a powerful electric shock.

entry: POKENAME贪玩，喜欢把蘑菇送给宝可梦、训练家。它向菌丝网传出冲击波，蘑菇就突然活跃，让附近蘑菇产生电荷。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are playful creatures that enjoy giving out mushrooms to Pokémon and Trainers. These mushrooms burst to life when POKENAME send shockwaves through the mycelium network, causing nearby mushrooms to produce an electrical charge.

entry: 谁碰POKENAME的尾，就会被诅咒，感染本体同种真菌。症状通常只像鼻伤风，可也有人说，行为发生变化。
author: .realthree
source: Anyone who touches a POKENAME's tails is cursed to become infected with the fungus that grows on the Pokémon. Though this infection usually only resembles a head cold, some people have reported changes in their behavior as well.

entry: POKENAME的蘑菇看似普通，其实是金属，硬如自身铠甲。少有宝可梦咬得动，即使吃到，也平淡无味。
author: sk372
source: Though the mushrooms growing on POKENAME appear normal, they are actually metallic and just as sturdy as its armor. Very few Pokémon have teeth strong enough to eat them, and even then the fungi are bland and tasteless.

entry: POKENAME身体坚韧，近乎金属。偶尔脱落的蘑菇同样硬、不能吃，曾见小型宝可梦拿来作棍棒。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's body is quite sturdy, nearly as strong as metal. The mushrooms that occasionally fall off its body are equally hard and inedible; smaller Pokémon have sometimes been seen using them as bludgeoning tools.

entry: POKENAME住在旱地，藏身仙人掌等沙漠植物下。它从地下啃食植物，同时取得食物与水。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME live in arid environments and shelter in burrows beneath desert plants like cacti. They obtain both food and water by devouring these plants from below.

entry: POKENAME只飞到找到沙漠植物所需的距离。落下后，慢慢吃进内部，摩擦双翼发出超声波，驱赶其他宝可梦。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME only fly as far as is necessary to find a desert plant to feed on. After landing on one, they slowly eat their way inside it, driving off any other Pokémon by rubbing their wings together to generate ultrasonic waves.

entry: POKENAME练习飞行，会从高崖跃下。落地时，头上菌盖缓冲冲击，每撞一下，就喷出大团孢子。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME attempts to fly by diving off of high cliffs to practice. The mushroom cap on its head cushions the blow when it hits the ground, releasing a large cloud of spores with every impact.

entry: POKENAME用能力，把蘑菇伪装成树果，骗其他宝可梦吃下，帮助传播孢子。损失的蘑菇，也很快重新长回。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME use their abilities to disguise their mushrooms as Berries. This tricks other Pokémon into eating the mushrooms, helping spread its spores. Mushrooms quickly regrow on POKENAME's body to replace the loss.

entry: POKENAME手持的蘑菇，能放大歌声音量。没了它，歌声就很难在战斗中派上用场。
author: .realthree
source: The mushroom that POKENAME holds amplifies its singing's volume. Without it, POKENAME's songs aren't able to be much help in a battle.

entry: 冬虫夏草吸走过量养分，让POKENAME背花枯萎。成熟时，花瓣已全落光。
author: .realthree
source: The flower on POKENAME's back is withered from the excessive nutrients that the tochukaso fungus draws from it. All the petals have fallen off by the time a POKENAME reaches maturity.

entry: 蘑菇越大、菌丝越广，POKENAME越不爱动。它坐在森林或洞穴的池边轻哼，引宝可梦靠近，再用蘑菇孢子攻击，吃掉猎物。
author: pjporwoll
source: As the mushroom grows in size and its mycelium spreads more, POKENAME becomes less active. It sits near a pond in a forest or cave and emits a quiet humming sound to attract Pokémon near enough to hit with a Spore attack and consume.

entry: POKENAME叶状头顶长的蘑菇，被用来制作始于关都的辣炖菜。成本低，留些孢子便迅速长回，是可持续食材。
author: .izik
source: The mushroom growing from the top of POKENAME's leafy head is used in a spicy stew, first conceptualized in the Kanto region. It is cheap to make and quick to regrow if spores are left behind, making it a sustainable ingredient.

entry: POKENAME躲在树冠，垂下诱饵。宝可梦毫无防备地抓住，就会被猛拉上树，感染孢子。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME hides in the canopy of trees and dangles a lure to the ground below. Unsuspecting Pokémon that grab it are whisked up above to be infected by POKENAME's spores.

entry: POKENAME展开长菌盖的耳朵，拍敌自卫。撞击释放孢子，挨打处会起难受、疼痛的疹。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME defends itself by unfurling its mushroom-capped ears to hit foes with. Spores release on impact that leave the spot hit with a nasty and painful rash.

entry: POKENAME散播黄孢子时，蘑菇向上伸展。吸入会呕吐，是驱赶入侵者的实用防御。
author: .izik
source: The mushroom extends up when POKENAME tries to spread its yellow spores. These spores can cause vomiting when inhaled, a useful defensive mechanism against intruders.

entry: POKENAME常是令人不安的营火怪谈主角。故事说，它等倒霉露营者睡着，便把真菌核心伸向头部，用孢子感染大脑。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is the subject of unsettling campfire stories. According to the tales, it waits until hapless campers go to sleep before extending its fungal core to the sleeper's head, infesting their brain with its spores.

entry: POKENAME头部裹着特殊胶状物，干燥时帮助保湿。随着超能力发展，头菇也会长大。
author: oddwalls
source: A specialized gel-like substance surrounds POKENAME's head, moisturizing it in dry conditions. As its psychic powers develop, the mushroom on its head grows.

entry: POKENAME裹着难吃液体，驱退天敌。体上的爪状蘑菇，随精神能量摄入而生长。
author: oddwalls
source: A foul-tasting fluid envelops POKENAME, deterring predators. The claw-like mushrooms on its body grow as it consumes psychic energy.

entry: POKENAME全身长着数百种真菌，毒性、副作用各不同。它啃大叶时，常留下一小部分菌群。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME has hundreds of different types of fungus growing on its body, all of them varying in toxicity and side-effects. It nibbles on large leaves, often leaving small bits of its colony behind.

entry: 许多人以为POKENAME身上的蘑菇是寄生物。研究却表明，蘑菇能帮它从吃下的电力中获取更多能量。
author: kitarchen
source: Many assume the mushrooms on POKENAME are parasitic. However, research has revealed they are used to acquire more energy from the electricity it eats.

entry: POKENAME身上细小锐利的蘑菇，冬月变得更尖。可伸出、缩回，帮它攀附洞壁或离开。
author: .izik
source: The tiny sharp toadstools growing from POKENAME's body get sharper during winter months. It can extend and retract them into its body to attach to and dislodge from cave walls.

entry: POKENAME性情意外温顺。脑活动放慢，代表快进化：体内器官正被真菌消耗，供它们随进化过程长大。
author: bobosmith01
source: It is surprisingly docile in nature. When POKENAME's brain activity slows down, it's about to evolve: its organs are being used for their nutrients, which the fungi uses to grow along with evolution process.

entry: POKENAME颇温顺，在树上磨长牙，也顺便喝树汁。无论吃多少，身体总长得比蘑菇慢。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are fairly docile Pokémon that hone their tusks on trees, which also allows them to feed on the sap within. Their bodies grow slower than their mushrooms, despite how much they consume.

entry: 古文明用POKENAME协助采集。它天生知道，哪些蘑菇人能安全触碰、吃下，帮采集者避开中毒祸事。
author: sk372
source: Old civilizations used POKENAME to assist in foraging. It has an innate sense of what mushrooms are safe for humans to touch and eat, helping gatherers avoid nasty poisoning debacles.

entry: POKENAME飞到刚喷发的火山附近，在灰中找好地方撒孢子。孢子迅速生长，成为现成的筑巢地。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME flies to areas that have recently experienced a volcanic eruption in search of optimal spots within the ash to spread its spores. These spores grow rapidly, providing it with a ready-made nesting area.

entry: POKENAME的蘑菇极辣，上桌时会切细片。哪怕轻咬，也能留下持久疼痛，有效吓退天敌。
author: .izik
source: The mushrooms on POKENAME's body are extremely spicy. They are sliced finely when served. Even a small nibble can leave a lasting pain, making them a potent deterrent for any predators.

entry: POKENAME进化出大眼，适应微光。洞中登山男很嫌它们，因为任何生物经过，都要被俯冲咬上。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME have developed large eyes to help them navigate in low-light conditions. Hikers in caves find them to be a nuisance, as the Pokémon swoop and bite at anything that walks by.

entry: POKENAME的翼膜，其实是真菌子实体。水分不足，翅膀就会破洞，让它飞不起来。
author: .realthree
source: The membrane on a POKENAME's wings is actually formed of a fungus's fruiting body. If the fungus doesn't have enough moisture, POKENAME develops holes in its wings that prevent it from flying.

entry: 森林里得当心，别踩到POKENAME。全身蘑菇一受触碰，就释孢子，让惹出反应的人，遭遇无数健康问题。
author: sk372
source: One must watch their step in forests lest they step on POKENAME. Upon contact, the many mushrooms on its body will release spores into the air, which will cause countless medical issues to whoever triggered the reaction.

entry: POKENAME以宝石维生，一颗会吃上一周、甚至更久。蘑菇颜色，也可能随所吃宝石种类，慢慢变化。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME subsists on gems, consuming a single stone over the course of a week or more. The colors of its mushrooms may change over time based on the type of gemstones it eats.

entry: 古时，POKENAME撒孢子，以真菌标记领地。能察觉入侵者擦过真菌，只要有人闯入，就凶暴大闹。
author: sk372
source: In ancient times, POKENAME spread its spores around to mark its territory with fungi. It could sense intruders brushing against the fungi and rampaged viciously whenever a trespasser came forth.

entry: 别试着脱下POKENAME的披风。它既为本体挡风雨，也保护其他生物，不碰到披风下不断产生的感染孢子。
author: sk372
source: One should not try to remove a POKENAME's cloak from its body. Besides protecting it from the elements, it protects others from the constant generation of infectious spores happening beneath the cloak.

entry: 研究显示，控制POKENAME的蘑菇，已变异得能耐极端零下温度。宿主冰壳的裂缝，会放出寒雾，把孢子传向四周。
author: the_lunarian
source: Research indicates that the mushrooms controlling POKENAME have mutated to survive extreme sub-zero temperatures. Cracks in the host's icy shell release a chilling vapor, spreading spores to the surrounding area.

entry: POKENAME的蘑菇在餐饮界很珍贵，美食家形容，有冬天本身的滋味。可它爱以幻象捉弄采菇者，很难取得。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME's mushrooms are highly valued in the dining industry, described by connoisseurs as having the taste of winter itself. Obtaining these mushrooms is difficult, as POKENAME enjoy tricking mushroom hunters with their illusions.

entry: POKENAME的羽毛自然脱落时，羽根会分泌致命毒液。可用盐水煮过，就变成绵滑酱汁，常配蘑菇。
author: jaminmcready
source: When a POKENAME's feather falls naturally, its calamus secretes a deadly poison. When boiled in salt water, however, it turns into a creamy sauce often served with mushrooms.

entry: POKENAME左右摇身，混合胃里的物质，生成剧毒，储着战斗时用。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME sways its body side to side to mix the substances in its stomach. This creates a vile poison, which it stores for use in battle.

entry: POKENAME体表蔓延的孢子据说相当美味。本体中毒或麻痹时，风味更浓烈，起舞时尤其如此。
author: jaminmcready
source: Spores creep across POKENAME's body and are said to be quite tasty. They grow more pungent when POKENAME is poisoned or paralyzed, especially during dancing.

entry: POKENAME与身上蘑菇，都靠吃厨余获得养分。若遇免疫其毒的宝可梦，就把四肢收进当壳的垃圾桶自保。
author: .jerden
source: Both POKENAME and its mushrooms growing on its body are nourished by the food waste it eats. POKENAME can withdraw its limbs inside the garbage can it uses as a shell to protect itself from any Pokémon immune to its toxins.

entry: POKENAME游得太快，头上的蘑菇就会不时脱落。通常几分钟长回，可饿着时，会长得更慢。
author: .izik
source: The mushrooms on POKENAME's head periodically fall off when it swims too fast. They normally regrow within minutes, though this process takes longer if it is hungry.

entry: POKENAME释放超声波，让附近蘑菇振动，扬起遮目浓孢子云，轻松捕食。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME release ultrasonic waves that cause mushrooms in the area to vibrate. This results in a dense cloud of spores so thick that it obscures vision, allowing POKENAME to easily capture prey.

entry: POKENAME把红孢子散在洞底，催生蘑菇。即使植物活不了，也能让环境繁茂。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spreads a red spore across cave floors to cause mushrooms to grow. This unique ability helps its environment flourish even if plants cannot survive.

entry: POKENAME扇翅造孢子云，震晕追赶者，也遮掩自己逃走。
author: imaginita
source: POKENAME can create a cloud of spores by flapping its wings.  The resulting cloud will stun any pursuers and obscure the POKENAME's escape.

entry: POKENAME每朵蘑菇，都有独立的脑，争夺身体控制。动作因此既乱又迟缓；哪朵几天争不到控制，就枯萎脱落。
author: laughing_dan
source: The mushrooms on POKENAME each house a unique brain, all of which vie for control over POKENAME. This makes its movements appear to be both erratic and sluggish. If a mushroom isn't able to take control for a few days, it will wither and fall off.

entry: POKENAME体表的小孔不断渗出黏液，防止皮肤和真菌干燥。蘑菇长大到脱落时，它就会用尾巴带着，散播孢子。
author: .jerden
source: Slime constantly oozes from pores on POKENAME's body, stopping both its skin and the fungus growing on it from drying out. Whenever a mushroom becomes large enough to break off, POKENAME will carry it with its tail to scatter spores from it.

entry: POKENAME两侧的菌盖比钢还硬。爪能向地面射奇异能量束，让蘑菇瞬间萌发生长。
author: sk372
source: The mushroom caps on either side of POKENAME are harder than steel. It can fire strange beams of energy from its claws to the ground that cause mushrooms to instantly sprout and flourish.

entry: POKENAME全身巨菇，需要同样大量的日光维生。哪怕一小块身体没被直照，真菌都会迅速干缩。
author: sk372
source: Massive mushrooms grow across POKENAME's body, requiring equally massive amounts of sunlight to sustain themselves. If even a small part of POKENAME's body lacks direct light, the fungi quickly begin to dry and shrivel.
