entry: POKENAME落在海边石头，静等猎物，以根状菌丝缠住胆小虫等目标。菌丝极黏，一碰就有毒。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME lands on stones near the ocean, waiting motionlessly and using its mycelium roots to snare prey like Wimpod. The roots are extremely sticky and poisonous to the touch.

entry: POKENAME住在林间空地的腐树桩旁。驱赶天敌的孢子充满空气，为蘑菇宝可梦留出安全空间。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME make their homes along rotting stumps in forest clearings. Their predator-deterring spores fill the air there, making a safe space for mushroom Pokémon.

entry: 派拉斯的虫体与蘑菇完美共生时，就会长成巨大的体形。大脑中的菌丝让它迅速成长。
author: .realthree
source: When the bug and mushroom of a Paras coexist in perfect balance, it grows to large sizes. It grows quickly as a result of the mycelium in its brain.

entry: POKENAME在林中爬行，停到人行小径旁。谁好奇走进中空身体，就会被孢子催眠，再吸干生命力。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME scuttles around the forest, placing itself near trails people walk along. If anyone is curious enough to enter POKENAME's hollow body, they will be put to sleep by fungal spores, then drained of their life force.

entry: POKENAME照亮内部，装成林中装饰奇怪的小屋。若成功引人进去，就以孢子催眠，再吸干生命力。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME illuminates its interior to make itself seem like an oddly decorated hut in the woods. If this succeeds in luring people inside, they will be put to sleep by fungal spores, then drained of their life force.

entry: POKENAME害怕时，背上蘑菇变得极冷。稍有接触，就散出能造成冻伤的孢子。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME becomes scared, the toadstools growing from its back become incredibly cold. Even brief contact can disperse spores capable of causing frostbite.

entry: POKENAME的蘑菇白天普通，夜里却闪彩虹光。不宜食用，因为致幻作用很强。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's mushrooms appear ordinary during the day, but at night they glow a shimmering rainbow of colors. Consumption of the mushrooms is discouraged, as they are highly hallucinogenic.

entry: POKENAME爱蹭人、蹭物。不清楚是在亲热，还是仅仅为了传播孢子。
author: imaginita
source: POKENAME love to rub themselves against people and objects. It is unclear whether this behavior is a sign of affection or just a way to spread their spores.

entry: POKENAME在洞中冥想，想平息攻击性。冥想时若被扰，就先喷孢子、碎石，再暴走。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can be found meditating in caves in an effort to quell their aggression. When disturbed in this meditative state, they release a burst of spores and gravel before going on a rampage.

entry: POKENAME的鬃毛不是毛发，而是体上真菌长出的浓密纤维网。硬甲每受冲击，头顶就洒落一片白孢子。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's mane is not made of hair, but is a dense network of fibers produced by the fungus growing on its body. Every impact against POKENAME's hard carapace dislodges a shower of white spores from its head.

entry: POKENAME虽小，却以格外凶猛闻名。古洗翠文献证实，这种行为，数世纪未变。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME is famous for being particularly aggressive despite its small size. Writings from ancient Hisui confirm that this pattern of behavior has remained unchanged for centuries.

entry: POKENAME用头上硬鳞撞倒小树，再吃根。咚咚巨响，常把其他宝可梦吓离它栖居的偏僻森林。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME strike small trees with the hardened scales on their head until they topple over, then devour their roots. The loud thumping sound this makes frightens many other Pokémon away from the remote forests they live in.

entry: POKENAME以比实心橡木更硬的菌盖作甲。它摇出木琴般的声响威吓敌人，也从较软的下侧散孢子。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's body is armored by mushroom caps harder than solid oak. To intimidate foes, it rattles these to make sounds like a xylophone, scattering spores from their softer undersides.

entry: POKENAME的蘑菇遭到身体重击，就释放孢子云，吸走触碰者能量。等来攻者精疲力尽，反击便迅捷、高效。
author: thesilverowls
source: When POKENAME's mushrooms are impacted by a physical blow, they release a spore cloud, sapping the energy of whatever made contact. When the attacker is exhausted and drained, their counterattack is swift and efficient.

entry: POKENAME细心在洞穴网络撒孢子，培育真菌。它易惊怕光，一照到就逃，偏爱阴影的安全。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spreads spores throughout cave systems with great care to plant fungus. It is skittish and will flee quickly if exposed to light, preferring the safety of the shadows.

entry: POKENAME以巨爪在沙中挖沟，种下孢子。长出的茎丛能遮阴，战败时也可藏身。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its massive claws to dig trenches in the sand to plant spores. The stalks that grow from these provide it with shade and a place to hide when defeated in combat.

entry: POKENAME头边繁茂绿叶，托住从几丁质外骨骼长出的蘑菇。叶片留住水分，保护年幼柔嫩的子实体。
author: .realthree
source: The lush greenery growing around POKENAME's head cradles the mushrooms sprouting from its chitinous exoskeleton. The leaves help hold moisture in and cover the younger, more tender fruiting bodies.

entry: POKENAME背菇负责吸收空气水分。照料不易，若没养好，本体皮肤也会干燥。
author: .realthree
source: The mushrooms growing from POKENAME's back are responsible for absorbing moisture from the air. These fungi are difficult to care for, and POKENAME will develop dry skin if they are not treated properly.

entry: POKENAME向整片森林的植物撒孢子，扩大领地。长出的真菌慢慢占据环境，吸走附近植物生命力。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spreads spores across plant life throughout the forest to expand its domain. The fungi that grow from this slowly take over the environment, leeching the life from nearby plant life.

entry: POKENAME体内蘑菇虽已高度发育，本体仍完全掌控自己。来自湿林的个体，对人尤其友善、温柔。
author: .realthree
source: Though the mushroom inhabiting POKENAME's body lives in such an advanced stage of growth, the Pokémon maintains complete control over itself. POKENAME from humid forests are known to be particularly friendly and gentle towards humans.

entry: 另外两朵蘑菇冒出，吸走主菌养分，削弱了它对宿主心智的掌控，让POKENAME过得更正常些。
author: sk372
source: A separate pair of mushrooms have sprouted and siphon nutrients from the main fungus. This saps some of its hold on the host's mind, letting POKENAME live a more normal existence.

entry: POKENAME背菇太沉，有时压得难以呼吸。训练家最好经常让它歇息。
author: .realthree
source: The mushroom on POKENAME's back is so heavy that POKENAME sometimes struggles to breathe under the weight. Trainers are advised to allow frequent breaks for this Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME持刃、盾保护其他生物，动作却有点僵。它从蘑菇盾放孢子，削弱敌人肌肉、拖慢速度，以此抵消对手优势。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME fights with a blade and shield to defend others, though its movements are a bit stiff. It evens the playing field by releasing spores from its mushroom shield that weaken the muscles of its foe to slow them down.

entry: POKENAME大耳里的菌丝长得过盛，常妨碍听觉。摇头时，脆菌丝被甩出，耳朵才暂时清净。
author: .izik
source: The mycelium growing in excess within POKENAME's large ears regularly disrupts its ability to hear. The fragile mycelium flings out when it shakes its head, clearing its ears for a short period.

entry: POKENAME温暖的壳，适合各种真菌生长。真菌富含必需养分，所以许多人把它养在家里。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's warm shell makes it a suitable home for various fungi to grow. Many people keep POKENAME in their homes, as these fungi are rich in essential nutrients.

entry: POKENAME在洞穴家园种满蘑菇。蘑菇可吃，味如南瓜派，让居民住得舒服，也有满处美味可采。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME plants mushrooms throughout its cave home. The mushrooms are edible and taste like pumpkin pie, making it a comfortable home for the resident Pokémon and a delicious environment to grow food.

entry: POKENAME乍看很像毛球，可剃去毛发后，人们发现，几乎与派拉斯一模一样。
author: .realthree
source: Though POKENAME bears many visual similarities with Venonat at first glance, specimens that have been shaved were discovered to be nearly identical to Paras.

entry: 熟睡的POKENAME可能被当成烂南瓜。它爱藏在南瓜田，突然吓一吓前来丢弃它的农民。
author: wiz0z
source: A sleeping POKENAME might be mistaken for a rotting pumpkin. They like to hide in pumpkin patches and surprise farmers that come to throw them away.

entry: POKENAME嗜甜，用腿刺树，吸食汁液。蘑菇也带着独特糖浆风味。
author: oddwalls
source: To satisfy its desire for sweet food, POKENAME feeds on sap by puncturing a tree with its legs. Its mushrooms have a distinct syrupy flavor.

entry: POKENAME在袋状蘑菇中蹦跳，边走边散孢子。双臂被真菌寄生得残损无力，最有效的攻击，反而是甩头。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME hops about in its sack-like mushroom, scattering spores as it goes. Because its arms are too crippled and weak from being parasitized by the fungus, its most effective attack involves swinging its head at its foes.

entry: POKENAME细心培育领地内的蘑菇。谁伤到真菌，就会被它带着大群宝可梦冲来，围殴一顿。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME carefully cultivates the mushrooms that grow within its territory. If anyone damages these fungi, POKENAME rushes over with a large horde of other Pokémon to beat up the trespasser.

entry: POKENAME住在湿地，让蘑菇保持黏性。它产生水性溶剂，困住腐烂植物残质与小猎物，供自己和寄生真菌进食。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME lives in damp environments so that its mushroom can stay sticky. It generates a water-based solvent to trap decaying plant matter and small prey which it and its parasitic fungus feast upon.

entry: POKENAME的橙色，来自体内产生的冬虫夏草孢子。它能排孢子驱敌，不过用得越多，颜色也越淡。
author: imaginita
source: POKENAME's orange color is due to the tochukaso spores produced within its body.  It can expel these spores to deter attackers, but the more spores it uses, the more it fades.

entry: POKENAME飞过夜空，尽量散出孢子。为了不重摔落地，会给蘑菇充气，让自己轻轻飘行。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME fly through the nighttime sky, scattering their spores as much as possible. To avoid crash landings, they inflate their mushrooms to help them drift softly.

entry: 调节POKENAME体温的蘑菇，一被土盖住就不灵。所以它常将头探出土，给自己降温。
author: .realthree
source: The mushroom that regulates POKENAME body temperature doesn't work well while covered by dirt, so POKENAME frequently pops its head out of the soil to cool down.

entry: POKENAME向空中吐心形孢子团。团块爆开后，吸入者数小时都会异常欣快、充满爱意。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME spits out heart-shaped clumps of spores into the air. Inhaling these spores after the clumps burst causes a person to feel exceedingly euphoric and amorous for hours afterward.

entry: 人们喜爱POKENAME的笑脸，有时在花园摆塑料模型。可真个体有点好斗，会攻击闯进洞穴的生物。
author: .realthree
source: Plastic POKENAME are sometimes set up in gardens because people enjoy their smiling faces. However, real POKENAME are somewhat aggressive and will attack those that intrude upon their caves.

entry: 感染POKENAME的真菌，让一切痛感变迟钝，因此捕猎、战斗格外凶猛。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME is infected with a fungus that dulls any pain the Pokémon feels, so it is ferocious in hunting and battling.

entry: POKENAME脚端纤细，让奔跑时抓地力变小。若捕食不足，寄生真菌就开始抢夺肌肉的能量。
author: .realthree
source: The delicate points on the ends of POKENAME's legs reduce traction as the Pokémon runs. If POKENAME doesn't hunt enough food for itself, the fungus it hosts will start robbing energy from its muscles.

entry: POKENAME施超能力，头上蘑菇便发光。它爱在浅水游，让干燥皮肤得到水分、降温。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a mushroom on their head that glows whenever they harness psychic powers. They enjoy swimming in shallow water because it hydrates and cools their dry skin.

entry: 在丛林中遇见POKENAME时，要避开它的目光。它会凶狠地抓挠任何与它对视的人。
author: .realthree
source: If you encounter a POKENAME while travelling through the jungle, avert your eyes. It claws ferociously at anyone who makes eye contact with it.

entry: 感染POKENAME脑部的蘑菇长进眼中，让视野只剩狭窄前方。发怒时完全看不见两侧，对手就能从盲区偷袭。
author: .realthree
source: The mushrooms infecting POKENAME's brain have grown into its eyes, which gives it tunnel vision. When it starts raging, it can't see anything to either side of it, giving its opponents the opportunity to blindside it.

entry: POKENAME只栖息在不流动的水域，依靠大雨将孢子传播到更远的地方。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME only lives in stagnant water. It relies on heavy rain to be able to spread its spores further.

entry: POKENAME一天大多平静待在浅水。可威胁靠近，臂端蘑菇就将它拖出水，痛打来者，直到失去知觉。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME lives peacefully in shallow waters for most of its day, but if a threat approaches, the mushrooms growing at the ends of POKENAME's arms pull it out of the water to pummel the would-be attacker senseless.

entry: POKENAME似乎与遇上的一切都要交战。它猛挥重拳，每次出击，都从拳状蘑菇散出无数感染孢子。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME seems driven to combat any and all that cross its path. It lashes out with powerful punches, each strike releasing countless infectious spores from the mushrooms that make up its fists.

entry: POKENAME和气，常挥手请训练家进家。也曾见野生个体，以大团孢子反制身体攻击。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are amiable Pokémon, often waving Trainers into their homes. Wild POKENAME have been spotted countering physical attacks by releasing a mass of spores.

entry: POKENAME和气，常挥手请训练家进家。也曾见野生个体，以大团孢子反制身体攻击。不知为何，特别亲近穿粉红衣的训练家。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are amiable Pokémon, often waving Trainers into their homes. Wild POKENAME have been spotted countering physical attacks by releasing a mass of spores. For some reason, they gravitate towards Trainers that wear pink.

entry: POKENAME按严格食谱吃天妇罗与米饭，维持体格。传说，它还能以孢子把人变成天妇罗。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME maintain their physique through a strict diet of tempura and rice. There exist tales where POKENAME turn people into tempura through their spores.

entry: 复杂的黏菌覆盖POKENAME皮肤，形成的图案让某些人不安。不过，黏菌与宿主互利，帮助吸收空气水分。
author: .realthree
source: A complex slime mold grows over POKENAME's skin. Though the pattern it forms unnerves some people, the slime mold has a mutualistic relationship with its host and helps POKENAME absorb moisture from the air.

entry: POKENAME出生后长得不多，因为90%的能量都用来养头上蘑菇。它用空心牙咬猎物，慢慢吸干养分。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME don't grow that much after they are born, as 90 percent of its energy goes into feeding the mushroom on its head. It bites its prey with its hollow fangs, slowly draining them of their nutrients.

entry: 落入POKENAME口中的一切，都会在之后数周慢慢消化。完成后嗝出孢子云，将来又长成巨大真菌。
author: sk372
source: Anything caught within POKENAME's mouth will be slowly digested over the coming weeks. Once digestion is complete, POKENAME belches out a cloud of spores that will grow massive fungi in the future.

entry: POKENAME沿山坡漫游，挖岩石、小植物吃。本体虽不能消化木叶，体内真菌却会代为分解，利用能量，从菌盖放出更多孢子。
author: .jerden
source: When roaming mountainsides, POKENAME digs up rocks and small plants to eat. Although it is unable to digest wood or leaves, the fungus inside its body will break them down instead, using the energy to release more spores from its mushroom caps.

entry: 表面看，POKENAME只长着少量蘑菇。可体内土壤，藏着密集根状菌丝网，悄悄影响行为，促进真菌生长。
author: .jerden
source: Superficially, it appears that only a small number of mushrooms are growing on POKENAME. However, the earth inside its body contains a dense network of fungal roots, which subtly influence its behaviour to promote further fungal growth.

entry: POKENAME行走时，从体上蘑菇散孢子。蘑菇也能吃，味道浓烈、鲜香、辛辣，常被形容像挨了它一脚。
author: chibitales
source: As POKENAME travel, they scatter spores from the mushrooms on their body. These same mushrooms are also edible and are sought after for their strong, savory, and spicy flavor, often described as getting kicked by a POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME半水生，一天最热时待在水下。等太阳不再直照头顶，就爬出，啃食树根。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME are semi-aquatic Pokémon that spend the hottest part of the day underwater. Once the sun is no longer at its zenith, they climb out of the water to feed on tree roots.

entry: POKENAME喜欢在群岛筑巢，享受海风。巢旁散的孢子，会让闯入者受到化学灼伤。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME prefers to nest in archipelagos, enjoying the sea air. It spreads spores around its nest that can cause chemical burns on intruders.

entry: POKENAME靠身上蘑菇分解食物，不能吃无机物。食谱虽变，许多个体仍与臭泥、臭臭泥住在同处。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME rely on the mushrooms on their body to break down food and are unable to eat non-organic matter. Despite this change in diet, many can still be found in areas with other Grimer or Muk.

entry: POKENAME其实是捕食虫类，与有生命污泥团的共生。污泥庇护虫，虫则分享猎物。
author: dylonk25
source: POKENAME is actually a symbiotic relationship between a predatory bug and a living pile of sludge. The sludge shelters the bug, and the bug shares its prey with the sludge.

entry: POKENAME产生的孢子，污染了喷出的水。人类、宝可梦都曾因喝这些水而生病。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME produces spores that infect the water it shoots. People and Pokémon alike have gotten ill from drinking the water it produces.

entry: 聚集在POKENAME层层甲壳之间的藻类腐烂后，会成为寄居真菌的食物。
author: .realthree
source: The algae that gathers between POKENAME's layered shells decomposes and becomes food for the fungus living in it.

entry: 它身上的真菌，喜爱潮湿，例如挖在河岸的洞。充分长大后，POKENAME走到哪里，都会散蓝孢子。
author: .jerden
source: The fungus growing on its body thrives in damp conditions, such as the holes it digs into river banks. Once this fungus has fully grown, it scatters blue spores wherever POKENAME travels.

entry: POKENAME用唯一一只巨钳斩树，再以强颚啃木。头菇孢子落在留下的碎木上，让真菌继续传播。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME uses its single massive pincer to cut through trees, chewing the wood in its powerful jaws. Spores from the mushrooms on its head settle on the small pieces it leaves behind, spreading the fungus.

entry: POKENAME非常贪玩，常出现在孩子们爱去的海滩。它会帮忙在栖居的沙滩上堆沙堡，还会让孩子们使用自己头上和背上的工具。
author: cloudmaker2169
source: POKENAME are highly playful Pokémon, frequently sighted on beaches that children often visit. They will assist in building sand castles on the beaches where they reside, allowing children to use the tools on their heads and backs.

entry: POKENAME在海滩埋伏，只露铲子。毫无防备的路人一碰，就在沙与电火花中爆炸。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME lies in wait at beaches with its shovel sticking up out of the sand. If an unsuspecting passerby disturbs the shovel, it explodes in a shower of sand and sparks.

entry: POKENAME用铲子在家园海滩雕出精巧沙像。最常见的，是快乐宝可梦陪幼崽玩耍的场景；完成后，它会满怀向往地看着作品。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses its shovel to help dig and form intricate sand sculptures on beaches it calls home. The sculptures most commonly depict happy Pokémon playing together with their young. It gazes at its creation longingly when finished.

entry: POKENAME的沙体内有来历不明的骨头。看见骨头，仿佛满心悔恨，忍不住哭。它用儿童玩具铲战斗，谁碰铲子或骨头，都会遭反击。
author: infinex21
source: Within the sandy bodies of POKENAME are yet unknown bones, the sight of which seems to fill them with remorse and causes them to cry. They fight with toy shovels often used by children, and lash out at those who touch the shovels or the bones.

entry: 为了让POKENAME的镜头更好看，电影制作人刻意将它们翅膀里的沙子染了色。然而，染色的翅膀让它们更容易被捕食者发现，导致近期种群数量下降。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have dyed sand in their wings thanks to a contrived effort from filmmakers to enhance shots of POKENAME. They are more likely to be spotted by predators because of their dyed wings, leading to a recent decrease in the population.

entry: POKENAME经常不顾一切地冲撞敌人，结果可能撞掉部分身体，只好等待沙子重新聚拢成形。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: POKENAME often charge foes recklessly. This can cause it to lose parts of its body, requiring it to then wait for the sand to re-form.

entry: POKENAME极友善，谁遇上都想陪玩，连想离开者也不放过。它常让玩伴塑形、装饰大部分沙体。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are incredibly friendly Pokémon that will play with anyone they meet, sometimes even trying to play with those who simply want to leave. They regularly let their playmates mold and decorate much of their sandy bodies.

entry: POKENAME在沙质鬃毛里储电，再猛烈放出。雷击地面形成脆弱的雷击石尖刺，用来标记、守护巢穴。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME stores electricity in its sandy mane and releases it in powerful bursts. When its lightning strikes the ground, it forms fragile fulgurite spikes that it uses to mark and defend its den.

entry: POKENAME看起来像某种古老庙宇。沿海滩漫游时，它会将找到的贵重物品融入身体；与它亲近者，偶尔可能收到这些小宝物。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME takes on the shape of what appears to be an ancient temple of some kind. It will collect any valuables it finds while roaming along beaches by incorporating them into its body, and may sometimes offer these trinkets to those it bonds with.

entry: POKENAME的模样，像某种古庙。人们认为形状太具体，不可能只是偶然，可至今没找到相似的真实建筑。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME takes on the shape of what appears to be an ancient temple of some kind. Its shape has been deemed too specific to just be random, but as of yet, no one has found a real structure that resembles it.

entry: POKENAME用沙子塑造出大针蜂模样的宝可梦，足以吓退除最强者以外的飞行宝可梦。夜间经常与音波龙冲突。
author: duskrd
source: POKENAME forms a Pokémon resembling Beedrill out of sand to ward off all but the strongest flying Pokémon. It often clashes with Noivern at night.

entry: POKENAME每粒沙，都含完整遗传密码，即使只剩最微小残余，也能再生。身体靠纯粹精神意志维系。
author: imaginita
source: Every grain of sand that makes up a POKENAME contains its full genetic code, allowing it to regenerate from even the smallest remains. Its body is held together by pure psychic will.

entry: POKENAME放出柔和香气，安抚宝可梦，让植物恢复生机。它比多数噬沙堡爷融合体温柔。
author: honestly_vitali
source: POKENAME releases a soothing scent that calms Pokémon and revives plants. It's gentler than most Palossand fusions.

entry: 背部放热，让POKENAME部分沙体熔成玻璃利刺。刺若碎了，又累得造不出更多热，就可能用海边的玻璃或碎贝壳盖背。
author: hophoppip
source: The heat emitting from its back has turned part of its sandy body into sharp glass spikes. If a POKENAME's spikes break while it's too tired to produce more heat, it may cover its back in beach glass or broken pieces of seashells.

entry: 猎物靠近，POKENAME从沙面下喷出道道水流，震晕后，再以强颚拖进沙中。
author: .izik
source: When prey approaches, POKENAME shoots jets of water from beneath the sand's surface. Once stunned, it pulls the prey below with its incredibly strong jaws.

entry: POKENAME的沙体不断脱落、重塑。其他宝可梦若碰到松散沙粒，会麻痹最长4小时。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: The sandy body of POKENAME is constantly being shed and reformed. If another Pokémon comes into contact with the loose grains, they will be paralysed for up to 4 hours.

entry: POKENAME搜遍海滩，寻找独特亮饰，装点身体，吸引同类。训练家会特别寻找含有化石、进化石等珍品的个体。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME scours beaches for shiny and unique trinkets to decorate its body and impress other POKENAME. Trainers will search for specimens that have incorporated fossils, evolution stones, and other rare items.

entry: POKENAME爱藏在公共海滩沙下，偷零食再跑回巢。也有报告说，它试着将其他宝可梦拖进沙，留作之后一餐。
author: npshi
source: POKENAME like to hide under the sand on public beaches, stealing snacks from others before scampering away to their nest. There have been reports of POKENAME attempting to hunt other Pokémon by dragging them into the sand, to serve as a future meal.

entry: POKENAME爱吃沙，享受其中多样矿物。吃不同氧化物，还能改变玻璃状身体的颜色，不过只维持几小时。
author: _pixelar_
source: POKENAME likes to feed on sand as it enjoys the various kinds of minerals this provides. Additionally, this Pokémon can change the color of its glass-like body by consuming different oxides, though this effect only lasts a few hours.

entry: POKENAME在海滩寻找旧壳，当作受惊时可以缩进去的庇护所。藏好后若仍被纠缠，它们就会将铲子当作投射武器发射，径直刺向敌人。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME seek out old shells on the beach, using them as shelter to withdraw into when spooked. They are able to launch their shovels as projectile weapons, spearing them into their foes if they aren't left alone after hiding away.

entry: POKENAME占据弃壳，将沙体藏在里面。谁想破坏新家，就会遭到强力暗影球攻击。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME claim abandoned shells as their own, hiding their sandy bodies within them. They are defensive of their new homes, attacking those who would damage their shell with powerful Shadow Balls.

entry: POKENAME会主动熔化沿途的沙子，将其融入身体，令体型增长。谁若打破它脆弱的外壳，就会立刻遭到凶猛反击，被灼热的沙子与玻璃袭击。
author: _pixelar_
source: A POKENAME can grow in size by actively melting any sand it moves on and incorporating it into its body. Should anyone ever break a POKENAME's brittle shell, it will immediately viciously attack the one responsible with burning hot sand and glass.

entry: 巢中看似大蛋的东西，其实是POKENAME的宫殿。里面有猎物遗骨，都是用灵活长颈与巨喙抓来的。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: What looks like a large egg in a nest is actually POKENAME's palace. Inside are the bones of its prey, which it captures using its agile neck and large beak.

entry: POKENAME的沙粒压得极密，让沙塔硬如岩。它静止时，小宝可梦可能进去躲藏，却会立刻被流动沙埋住。
author: .jerden
source: The sand grains of POKENAME's body are incredibly tightly packed, making its sandy towers as solid as rock. If they remain still, small Pokémon may try to shelter inside, but will immediately be buried by shifting sand.

entry: 有种广为流传的说法认为，POKENAME曾是海滩的王者，后来被水属性宝可梦推翻，至今仍在伺机复仇。
author: dodoowner_
source: A popular theory claims that POKENAME were once kings of the beach. They were since overthrown by Water types, and seek vengeance to this day.

entry: POKENAME飞快跑过海滩，捡垃圾、碎屑，留下洁净海岸。它会与清洁队合作，短暂停下鞠躬致谢。
author: pattybgoode
source: Swiftly dashing across beaches, POKENAME picks up trash and other debris, leaving a pristine shoreline. It is known to collaborate with clean-up crews, stopping briefly to bow in thanks.

entry: POKENAME只在晴天造访海滩。先扬起刺痛的沙风赶走人，再踩碎沙堡，用尾推倒阳伞。
author: .jerden
source: Whenever POKENAME visits a beach, it drives people away by whipping up a storm of stinging sand, then starts crushing sandcastles underfoot and toppling parasols with its tail. It only makes these visits on sunny days.

entry: POKENAME是当之无愧的堆沙堡冠军。每次比赛它都会破坏别人的沙堡，至于这与夺冠有没有关系，就不好说了。
author: patch_bros
source: POKENAME is the undisputed champion of sandcastle building. This may or may not be due to it sabotaging the other sandcastles every competition.

entry: POKENAME身上看似贝壳的，其实是石头。埋进沙时，孩子常误抓住它，它便害怕地跑走。
author: sleepyman0731
source: Despite their appearance, the seashells on POKENAME are rocks. When POKENAME bury themselves in the beach sand, children commonly grab POKENAME by mistake. POKENAME will then run away in fear.

entry: POKENAME陪小孩子在海滩玩，让他们随意塑造身上的沙。形体一成，它便跳滑稽的舞，逗孩子们开心，再变回原形，重新开始。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME plays with small children on beaches by allowing them to manipulate its sand into whatever shape they wish. Once they've given it a form, it does a funny dance to amuse them before shifting back and starting the game over.

entry: POKENAME的叶状部位散出带咸味的气息，很受海滩宝可梦喜爱。若嫌太拥挤，就甩出密沙压成的利叶，驱散群体。
author: sk372
source: The leafy parts of POKENAME's body emit a salty smell loved by beach-dwelling Pokémon. If it gets too crowded for POKENAME's tastes, it slings out sharpened leaves made out of densely-compacted sand to disperse the crowd.

entry: POKENAME吃电脑设备，在沙体内分解。沙中可以找到留下的小零件碎片。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME consumes computer equipment and breaks it down within its sandy body. Small fragments of the equipment can be found left behind in the sand.

entry: POKENAME用蜿蜒海藻茎，缠住闯入或乱扔垃圾的人，吸走能量，再潜回沙。第一次不受教训的，还会被喷贝壳碎片。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME use their winding seaweed stalks to wrap up people who trespass or litter on their beaches, draining their energy before disappearing back into the sand. They spit out shards of shells at those who don't learn their lesson the first time.

entry: POKENAME伏在泥滩，等不留神的大钳蟹等猎物，或海藻等随潮漂来的东西吃。若被潮水浸得太湿，沙体可能硬化、碎开，形成沙丘鱼。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is found in mudflats, waiting to eat unobservant prey like Krabby or tidal flotsam such as seaweed. If its sandy body becomes too waterlogged from the tide, it may harden and break apart, resulting in Sandykips forming.

entry: 海滩若有POKENAME，最好看紧贵重物。它找到什么，都会添进偷来的海滩物品收藏。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: If a beach has a POKENAME, it's encouraged to keep an eye on your valuables. POKENAME will add anything it finds to its collection of stolen beach goods.

entry: POKENAME是海岸孩子常见、喜爱的宠物。可父母觉得不太幸运，因为家里总被带进满地沙。
author: beandrawsthings
source: POKENAME is a common and beloved pet for children who live near the coast. This is considered somewhat unfortunate by the parents of said children, who have to deal with sand being constantly tracked into the home.

entry: POKENAME在岸边发出迷人叫声，引听者前来。有些地区因为水手听到后出问题，只好把它迁走。
author: camtft
source: POKENAME produce entrancing cries from the shores of beaches, luring those that hear towards them. Some regions had to relocate them due to problems with Sailors hearing them.

entry: POKENAME让大多数人觉得害怕，其实却善良温柔，爱陪其他生物玩。它便折衷，站在海滩任人玩沙，等所有人离去才动。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME appear rather frightening to most people, yet they are very kind and gentle Pokémon that love to play with others. They compromise by standing on beaches and letting others play with their sand without moving until everyone has left.

entry: POKENAME的岩身生出旋转沙丘，攻击敌人。夜里练习控沙时，有人声称，能听见一千个声音。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's rocky body produces swirling mounds of sand to attack its foes. It practices controlling this sand at night, during which some claim the sound of a thousand voices can be heard.

entry: POKENAME生成旋转沙龙卷自卫。龙卷似有些意识、恶意，会显出脸，边咯咯笑，边吹走对手。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME generates a spinning sand tornado as a defense mechanism. The tornado shows a measure of sentience and malevolence, a face forming and cackling as it blows away its opposition.

entry: POKENAME漫游海滩，炫耀背上沙堡。谁改成它不喜欢的模样，就会被一动不动压在身下，直到生命力被吸完。
author: cloudmaker2169
source: POKENAME are often found roaming beaches, parading about the sand castle on its back. If someone alters the castle in a way POKENAME does not like, they will lie immobile atop the person until they have absorbed their life force.

entry: 与噬沙堡爷不同，POKENAME温柔体贴。石居蟹、电电虫等小宝可梦想躲长翅鸥，都能藏进嘴里。它只喝海水，便能强化身体。
author: dukefrogpeasant
source: POKENAME, unlike Palossand, are quite gentle and caring creatures. They allow smaller Pokémon seeking shelter from Wingull, such as Dwebble and Joltik, to hide in their mouths. Their diet consists solely of seawater, which fortifies their bodies.

entry: POKENAME懒躺海滩，常半埋、纹丝不动，被当成普通沙堆。可任何东西靠太近，都会立刻遭攻击。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME lazes about on beaches, remaining so still and often half-buried that sometimes it is mistaken for an ordinary mound of sand. However, it will instantly lash out at anything that gets too close.

entry: POKENAME常见于高塔附近。它高跃空中，再向目标落下，以随身铲状武器，打出致命一击。
author: actliux
source: POKENAME are frequently seen near places with high towers. They will jump high into the air before descending on their target, delivering a deadly blow with the shovel-like weapon they always carry.

entry: POKENAME常见于大片空地附近。它高跃空中，再向目标落下，以随身铲状武器，打出要害一击。
author: actliux
source: POKENAME are frequently seen near places with a lot of open space. They will jump high into the air before descending on their target, delivering a critical blow with the shovel-like weapon they always carry.

entry: POKENAME鼻部大壳一裂，就不断吸食大壳猎物，直到找到合用替品。不想吸食的小壳猎物，则被操纵作棋子。
author: soup1900
source: If the large shell that forms its nose cracks, POKENAME endlessly drains large-shelled prey until it finds a suitable replacement. Smaller shelled prey it doesn't want to drain instead are controlled and used as its pawns.

entry: POKENAME战斗经验越多，就收集越多奖品，自豪摆在身上。从贝壳，到败者的毛，都可能成为宝物。
author: bobosmith01
source: As it becomes a more experienced battler, POKENAME collects more and more trophies and displays them proudly on its body. These treasures can range from seashells to the fur of Pokémon they have defeated.

entry: POKENAME由特殊沙组成，能把地面水分吸进体内。多余水凝成反光鳞片，抵挡来袭宝可梦。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME is made of a special type of sand that wicks moisture from the ground into its body. Excess water is solidified into reflective scales that shield it from attacking Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME靠齿轮咬合、转动，带起身旁悬浮的一圈沙。沙力足以击倒敌人，也会吸来更多尘，形成旋转沙暴。
author: .jerden
source: By interlocking and rotating its gears, POKENAME can spin the circle of sand floating around it. The sand can move with enough force to knock foes to the ground, and will draw in more dust to create a spinning sandstorm around POKENAME.

entry: 缎带遍及大半身体，据说把它维系成形。有人相信，它散出诅咒般的气息，让其他生物忍不住陪玩、装饰沙体。
author: infinex21
source: Its ribbons extend throughout much of its body, supposedly holding itself together. Some believe that it exudes a curse-like aura that compels others to play with it and to decorate its sandy body.

entry: POKENAME花上多年筑成沙塔，会以狂怒捍卫。塔里埋着的骨头，属于那些曾想夺走它家园的人。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: After spending years building its sand tower, POKENAME will protect it with immense fury. Inside the tower are the bones of those who have tried to take its home.

entry: POKENAME的沙粒，因力量被昵称“时之沙”。它掀起的沙旋风，能让包围的事物，变老或变年轻。
author: sk372
source: The granules comprising POKENAME's body have been nicknamed the Sands of Time due to its power. It can whip up a whirlwind of sand that ages or de-ages whatever it surrounds.

entry: POKENAME埋在海滩沙下。有人或宝可梦熟睡，就悄悄靠近；可往往还没近到能出击，对方就先被它带来的噩梦惊醒。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME burrows into beaches to conceal itself beneath the sand. When people or Pokémon are sleeping on the beach it will slowly approach them, but the bad dreams it causes usually wake them up before POKENAME gets close enough to attack.

entry: POKENAME外层湿沙太沉，浮不起来。为弥补，便沉进地底深处，模仿游泳动作。
author: bigoljax
source: Due to the weight of their outer layer of wet sand, POKENAME are unable to float. To make up for this, they sink themselves deep into the ground and mimic swimming motions.

entry: 体内猛烈的幽焰，将POKENAME部分沙身熔成玻璃。独特的构造让POKENAME的光芒照得极远，连最深的夜色也能穿透。
author: rakunk
source: The intense spectral flames within POKENAME's body have fused portions of its sandy form into glass. This unique body shape has allowed POKENAME to shine from across great distances, cutting through even the darkest nights.

entry: 野生POKENAME闲躺海滩，不介意孩子或其他宝可梦踩过沙体。它把朋友的铲子戴在身上，也当武器保护关心的对象。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME will lounge along beaches, unfazed by any children or other Pokémon that may step upon their sandy bodies. They wear the shovels of their friends and wield them like weapons to defend those they care for.

entry: POKENAME在桶柄挂着各种铲子，很适合帮忙挖掘。这些铲子，也用来掩埋被它吸收的受害者留下的骨头。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME carries a variety of shovels on its bucket handle, making it a handy Pokémon to have around for digging. These collected shovels are used to bury the discarded bones of victims it has absorbed.

entry: POKENAME不稳定，臂上无脑的头乱拉乱扯，甚至损坏脆沙体。为解决，它找到随身带水的办法，让身体硬些。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: POKENAME are unstable, the brainless heads on its arms pulling around so much that it can damage its delicate sand body. To counter this, POKENAME have found a way to carry water around with them, which hardens up their body.

entry: POKENAME试着指挥周围生物，帮忙筑沙坝。联手建造若失败，就很沮丧，退进沙里生闷气。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME attempts to direct others near it to assist in building a dam made of sand. It gets quite dejected if the joint construction attempt ends in failure, retreating into the sand to sulk.

entry: POKENAME的硬齿轮覆着沙。它沿滩磨碎沙堡，偶尔误对沙丘娃、噬沙堡爷下手，闹出冲突。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's hard gears are coated with a layer of sand. POKENAME will roam around beaches to grind up sandcastles, occasionally getting into conflict with Sandygast and Palossand after accidentally targeting them.

entry: POKENAME的两枚硬齿轮，用周围的沙造出第三枚。平贴沙面，又能添更多咬合齿轮，慢慢把整片海滩变成转动的沙制钟表机构。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's two hard gears form a third gear from sand picked up from their surroundings. By lying flat against a sandy surface, POKENAME can form additional interlocking gears, slowly converting entire beaches into spinning clockwork made of sand.

entry: POKENAME演化出利用贪心引旅人跟随的本领。气泡内生成的小浮宝石，留下一路闪亮痕迹；追踪者被引入沙丘深处，一去不返。
author: silentscript89
source: POKENAME has evolved to tempt travelers to follow it by preying on their greed. It leaves a glittering trail with the tiny floating gems formed within its bubble and those who chase this trail are lured deeper into the dunes, never to return.

entry: POKENAME随潮漂过各处海岸，想将人赶离海滩，保护环境。人们相信，目击增多，是冰山融化所致。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Drifting from shore to shore with the tides, POKENAME seeks to clear humans away from beaches in hopes of preserving the environment. It is believed that the increase in POKENAME sightings is a result of melting icebergs.

entry: POKENAME跳舞、举翼，沙便层层泻下。这些表演常引发大规模沙漠化，水无法到达土壤，重要养分也被夺走。
author: jaminmcready
source: When POKENAME dances and raises its wings, sand pours down in waves. These performances often cause mass desertification, blocking water from reaching the soil and robbing it of vital nutrients.

entry: POKENAME轻轻摇身，让猎物误以为安全。趁分心悄悄靠近，再迅速以身体包住。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's gentle swaying lures prey into a false sense of security. While its prey is distracted, POKENAME creeps closer before swiftly enveloping them with its body.

entry: POKENAME通常由葬身流沙的孩子变成。据说它们会故意制造沙坑，拉更多人一起受苦。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME are usually children who have died due to quicksand. They are said to purposely create sand traps so more humans can suffer with them.

entry: POKENAME爱躺海滩看浪。华美彩色花瓣如阳伞，为身体遮阳。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME loves watching the ocean waves while resting its sandy body on the beach. Its magnificent multicolored petals act as a parasol, shielding it from the sun.

entry: 据说POKENAME由受困水手的灵魂，以及被遗弃在海上的海盗亡魂汇聚而成。估计每只都包含超过一千个灵魂。
author: nexusshenanigans
source: POKENAME are said to be culminations of the spirits of marooned sailors and pirates abandoned at sea. It's estimated that POKENAME are made up of over a thousand of these souls.

entry: POKENAME爱躺海滩看浪。华美彩色花瓣如阳伞，为身体遮阳。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME loves watching the ocean waves while resting its sandy body on the beach. Its magnificent multicolored petals act as a parasol, shielding it from the sun.

entry: POKENAME找到游客遗下的玩具、工具，就占为己有，再添在身上作饰物。
author: bigoljax
source: If POKENAME finds a left-behind toy or tool from beachgoers, they will take it for themselves. They then add it to their bodies as an accessory.

entry: POKENAME操纵了整片海滩的居民，把自己建成一座宏伟的城塞。再以此为据点，在大陆上肆意作恶。
author: nellnast42
source: POKENAME has controlled the population of an entire beach to erect itself as a grand citadel. From here, it enacts its evil whims on the mainland.

entry: POKENAME爱在沙滩挖洞。找到喜欢的贝壳、石头或垃圾，它就会将宝贝添进蓬松的毛领，自豪地摇起尾巴。
author: mochauspocus
source: POKENAME loves to dig holes in sandy beaches. When it finds a shell, rock, or piece of trash that it likes, it will add the treasure to its fluffy collar of fur, wagging its tail with pride.

entry: POKENAME一唱，周围沙便随声波共鸣，形成独特图案。每曲各有图案，还会随曲程改变。
author: quackquackattack
source: Whenever POKENAME sing, the sand around them resonates with the sound waves they produce to form unique patterns. Each song produces a unique pattern that shifts as the song progresses.

entry: POKENAME即使睡着，也能借散出的孢子感知猎物走过沙面。孢子许多性质像沙，几乎无法辨别。
author: .izik
source: The spores POKENAME scatters allow it to sense prey moving across the sand's surface even while it sleeps. The spores share so many qualities with sand that they are nearly impossible to tell apart.

entry: POKENAME的沙状鳞片，其实硬如岩，还有贝壳加固。它把海滩遗留物串成长长饰物，随动作飘动，铿锵碰响。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: Despite appearances, the sandy scales of POKENAME are hard as a rock with seashells to reinforce them. It uses left behind items from the beach to create long, flowing strands that clang together as it moves around.

entry: 据说它戴的大桶里有复杂菌丝网，维系沙状身体。大桶一被触碰，它就会攻击对方，连自己的训练家也不例外。
author: infinex21
source: Supposedly, within the large pail it wears is a complex network of mycelia that hold together its sand-like body. If the pail is ever touched, even by its Trainer, it will lash out.

entry: POKENAME耳中海藻成倍猛长，导致听力下降。为了控制，常请大钳蟹等甲壳类，帮忙修剪。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: The seaweed inside POKENAME's ears grow exponentially, leading to hearing loss. To keep it in check, POKENAME often enlist the aid of crustaceans such as Krabby to keep the plants trimmed.

entry: POKENAME极护体上的沙堡。谁敢毁掉，沙就因怒变得滚烫。面对它怒火的肇事者，之后极少再被见到。
author: te4mst4r.boris
source: POKENAME is very protective of the sand castles on its body. If anyone dares to destroy its castles, POKENAME's sand becomes scorching hot with anger. It's rare for the offenders to ever be seen again after facing POKENAME's wrath.

entry: 两只POKENAME若在野外相遇，就会斗得格外凶。它们用尾上的铲子敲打，或向对方抛掷热沙，直到一方被迫屈服、退走。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME are incredibly combative should two of them meet in the wild. They strike at each other with the spades on their tails or by chucking heated sand at the other until one is forced to yield and retreat.

entry: POKENAME常住火山岛海滩，张嘴藏在沙中。谁冒失靠近，都会被咬。
author: cloudmaker2169
source: POKENAME are often found on the beaches of volcanic islands. They will hide in the sand, their mouth agape, biting anyone who is foolish enough to come close.

entry: 人们把见到POKENAME当作繁荣与好运的象征，日落时在潮水中遇见，更是如此。它有力的手握着满袋细金粉，可偷走哪怕一点，所有好运都会被吸光。
author: tamszen.ore
source: The sight of POKENAME represents good prosperity and luck, especially at sundown on the tides. Gripped in its mighty hands is a sack filled to the brim with fine particles of gold, though stealing even a speck of it will drain all your fortune.

entry: POKENAME多在海滨度假村活动，爱在沙堡比赛中假扮沙雕。不过，它太虚荣，也太为体格自豪，装不了多久，就会向游客炫耀。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Found mostly at beach-side holiday resorts, POKENAME love to impersonate sand sculptures during sand castle competitions. They're too vain and proud of their build to maintain their charade for long and will often show off to beachgoers.

entry: POKENAME静躺沙中，把触手藏进地下，装成普通沙堡。猎物一走近，众多带刺肢体便抽出，将其拖进饥饿的嘴。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME lies inert in the sands, hiding its tentacles underground to maintain the illusion of being a simple sandcastle. Once prey steps near, numerous thorny limbs lash out and drag it into its hungry mouth.

entry: POKENAME把头、四肢收进身体，就能装成海滩上的普通沙堡。谁想破坏，等它完全站起时，便会大吃一惊。
author: sk372
source: Retracting its head and limbs into its body lets POKENAME mimic a normal sandcastle at the beach. Those who try to damage the structure are in for a rude awakening when POKENAME rises up fully.

entry: 刚发现时，许多POKENAME被误认成水马妖。可首只被捕后，脾气十分古怪，坚决不肯离开原来的海滩。
author: jojojax164
source: Many POKENAME were thought to be kelpies when they were first discovered. However, when the first POKENAME was caught, it was so temperamental it refused to leave the beach it came from.

entry: POKENAME只住沙滩，对湿度极敏感。它常随潮汐迁移，让水分保持在最合适的程度。
author: northkira
source: Residing only on sandy beaches, POKENAME is highly sensitive to moisture. POKENAME will often migrate depending on the tide to maintain an optimal level of moisture.

entry: POKENAME喜欢把磁性物品藏在沙下，常替路过的游客偷来贵重物品。强大磁场，还会让附近沙粒振动。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME loves to stash magnetic items underneath the sand, often stealing valuable items for passing beachgoers. The powerful magnetic field it creates causes the surrounding sand to vibrate.

entry: POKENAME爱在凉爽又阳光充足的地方打盹。背上冰晶吸光闪亮，有些冰属性宝可梦觉得味甜，喜欢舔，让它很不高兴。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME enjoys napping in cool areas with lots of sunlight, the ice crystal on its back glimmering brightly as it absorbs the light. Some Ice-type Pokémon enjoy licking the crystal, finding the taste sweet and appealing, much to POKENAME's chagrin.

entry: POKENAME由冰封数百万年的一块弹片复原。炸碎它的爆炸，是否也造成了埋冰，至今不清楚。
author: h0bojoe
source: POKENAME was restored from a piece of shrapnel that had been frozen for millions of years. Whether or not the explosion that shattered it was the same that created its icy burial remains unknown.

entry: POKENAME挥舞冰川冰制成的武器，用头上的头骨打磨，直到锋利如冰凌。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME wields a weapon made out of glacial ice. It sharpens the object with the skull on its head until it's as sharp as an icicle.

entry: POKENAME戴头骨、持骨棍，两者其实都是实冰塑成骨骼残骸的模样，用来吓唬其他生物。夜里，冰制骨骸闪着极光。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME wear skulls and wield bone clubs, each made of solid ice and shaped into skeletal remnants to intimidate others. At night, these constructs of ice shimmer with auroral lights.

entry: POKENAME宝石般的体节，暗中泛起微光，照亮四周。挥镰割开家园过盛的植物时，也留下淡淡光迹。
author: sk372
source: Jewel-like segments of POKENAME's body glow faintly in the dark, illuminating its surroundings. Equally faint trails of light are left behind when it swings its scythes, cutting through any overgrown plants in its homeland.

entry: POKENAME清晨飘飞在寒冷地区，双翼散出多彩花粉。接触量太大，会造成严重肌肉无力。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME flutters around colder regions in the early hours of the morning. Its wings spread a very colorful pollen that causes severe muscle weakness if exposed to large amounts.

entry: 全球升温，让POKENAME变身后的形体逐渐融化、扭曲。融化会损伤细胞结构，因此很少变身，即使变，也只短短一瞬。
author: soup1900
source: Due to rising global temperatures, POKENAME's transformations will slowly start to melt away and become deformed. As this melting damages its cellular structure, it rarely transforms, and if it does, only for a very brief moment.

entry: POKENAME性情平和，已知天敌不多，部分原因正是它快乐的性格。不过DNA不稳定，辨认、复原它的化石都极困难。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: POKENAME peaceful creatures and have few known predators in part due to their happy disposition. However, their unstable DNA has made the identification and restoration of fossils of these Pokémon extremely difficult.

entry: 被POKENAME寄住的软件常常卡死。这通常只影响程序，可它在电脑里住得太久，机器甚至可能真的冻结，内部结出冰来。
author: santon5512
source: Software inhabited by POKENAME is prone to constantly freezing. While this effect is typically limited to software, computers inhabited by these Pokémon for too long may actually begin to freeze, with ice forming inside them.

entry: 在极寒的雪峰筑巢，那里冷得让大多数生物无法承受。偶尔有登山者报告看见POKENAME虹彩般的翅膀。
author: carameldog
source: It nests on snowy peaks where it's much too frigid for most. The sight of POKENAME's iridescent wings is occasionally reported by mountain climbers.

entry: POKENAME近来吃得越多，额头宝石就越亮。难得吃饱时，强光甚至足以照亮全身。
author: sk372
source: The gem on POKENAME's forehead emits a glow relative to how much it has eaten in recent times. On the rare occasion POKENAME is full, it glows with enough intensity to illuminate its entire body.

entry: 它们隐居极寒地区，用小晶体放出的冷雾遮身。蜕下鳞片一碰就冷，受光时如极光闪耀。
author: infinex21
source: They live reclusively within frigid cold areas, able to veil themselves with a cold mist released from their small crystals. Their shed scales are cold to the touch and shimmer like auroras when struck by light.

entry: 晶球比实冰更冷，闪着极光般的光。一鸣叫，就放出冰寒雾幕，驱退大多数生物。
author: infinex21
source: Its crystalline orbs are colder than solid ice and glow with shimmering light akin to an aurora. When it cries out, it releases a frigid veil of mist that deters most others.

entry: 它们结小群，住在寒冷高丘与山中。天空一现极光，便腾空飞起，仿佛正乘光而行。
author: infinex21
source: They live in small herds upon tall hills and mountains clad in cold weather. When an aurora shines in the sky, they take to the air and fly as if riding upon the lights themselves.

entry: POKENAME飞过寒空，身后跟着棱镜般的极光。旅人从远方赶来，只为一睹美丽飞行轨迹。
author: sk372
source: A prismatic aurora follows behind POKENAME as it flies through the frigid air. Travelers come from far and wide to catch a glimpse of its beautiful flight patterns.

entry: 喜欢用颚咬碎大块的冰，也因此为其他宝可梦疏通了水道。
author: capwolfbane
source: It enjoys crushing large chunks of ice with its jaws. This behaviour also clears waterways for other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME不习惯与好斗或领地意识强的宝可梦共处，于是躲在草丛中避开冲突、寻找食物。
author: goldegummybear
source: POKENAME are not used to living with aggressive or territorial Pokémon, so they resort to hiding in grasses to avoid conflict and foraging for food.

entry: POKENAME与同伴关系紧密，一同栖在冰洞。飞到哪里，都留下闪亮雾迹。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME form tight-knit bonds and roost together in icy caves. They leave a trail of sparkling mist wherever they fly.

entry: POKENAME很难控制自己的冰系攻击。虽然在可爱类比赛中很受欢迎，也有评论者认为，这不利于它的身心健康。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME struggles to control its icy attacks. Though it's a popular choice for cuteness contests, some critics believe it's detrimental to POKENAME's well-being.

entry: 寒冷冬夜，POKENAME会在树上仰望夜空。北极光一出现，POKENAME体内潜藏的超能力便会苏醒。
author: mistymagius
source: On cold winter nights, POKENAME can be seen in the trees staring up into the night sky. When the northern lights appear in the sky, a latent psychic power awakens within POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME虽然不喜欢冲突，却会奋力自卫。与进化前相比，它的信心和力量都大有增长。
author: goldegummybear
source: POKENAME dislikes conflict but will protect itself fiercely as its confidence and strength have grown much in comparison to its previous evolution.

entry: POKENAME曾被用来解释某些沉积物，如何从沼泽到达山顶，存在与否长期有争议。真正获确认后，科学界大为震动，多年研究终于得到支持。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: The existence of POKENAME was long debated, as it was used to explain the movement of certain sediments from marshes to mountaintops. The confirmation of its existence sent a shockwave through the scientific world, validating years of research.

entry: 古时候，POKENAME曾试着偷走无人看守的巢中的蛋，却常因背帆散发的鲜艳色彩而被发现。
author: darkweavile428
source: In ancient times, POKENAME attempted to steal eggs from unguarded nests, but often got caught due to the bright colors emitted by its sails.

entry: 登山男喜欢让POKENAME作登山伙伴。它不知疲倦的精神，鼓励人再多走一段路，又会引人攀上山顶，热切帮助完成壮举。
author: quackquackattack
source: Hikers enjoy having POKENAME as a hiking partner, as their restless spirit inspires people to continue on for an extra mile. They encourage people to follow them up to the summit of mountains, eager to help people achieve great feats.

entry: POKENAME壳心虽热到熔融，液态身体外侧却清凉。急速冷却，有时会在周围形成极光般的景象。
author: notadoctor75
source: While the core of POKENAME's shell reaches molten temperatures, the outside of its liquid body is cool to the touch. The rapid cooling sometimes creates an effect similar to an aurora around this Pokémon.

entry: 科学家发现POKENAME有彩羽，很是震惊，因为化石记录从未暗示，颜色竟如此鲜艳。如今，它们又如古时般，翱翔无尽天空。
author: quackquackattack
source: Many scientists were shocked to find that POKENAME have colorful feathers, as there is nothing in the fossil record that indicates they would have such vibrant feathers. Nowadays, they soar through the endless sky as they once did ages ago.

entry: POKENAME进出这条时间线，穿越岁月，身后留下极光。它无疑拥有尚未被人发现的古老力量与知识，却似乎不想分享。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME travels in and out of this timeline, leaving auroras in its wake as it passes through the ages. Although POKENAME no doubt has ancient power and knowledge that humans have yet to uncover, it seems uninterested in sharing these assets.

entry: POKENAME不爱别人摸头发，弄乱了就发脾气。因为没打理好，就难以用头发造出漂亮极光。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME dislikes having others touch its hair, throwing tantrums if it gets tussled. This is because if it isn't properly kept, it disrupts its ability to generate pretty auroras from its hair.

entry: POKENAME极光里的高电压，能制服整群天敌。研究者借它探索，如何将极光用作新的电力来源。
author: soup1900
source: Using the high electrical voltages within its auroras, POKENAME can incapacitate an entire group of predators. It is used by Researchers in determining how auroras can be utilized as a new source of electricity.

entry: POKENAME住在沙漠，主要夜间活动，图的是较低温度，而非黑暗。它天生好奇，会主动靠近；可一觉得受威胁，就蜷成球。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are desert Pokémon that are primarily active at night, not for the darkness but for the lower temperatures. They are inherently curious and will approach others, though if they feel threatened they will curl up into balls.

entry: POKENAME用冰爪挖地，开出安全食物储藏处。不采食时，就游荡在雪林，寻找玩伴。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME burrow into the ground with their icy claws to make a safe place to store food. When they are not gathering food, they wander the snowy forests they live in searching for playmates.

entry: POKENAME体内温度低，尾上的毒液冻成冰沙。毒素也因此变性，使冰沙安全、美味，成了夏日的人气点心。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: Due to POKENAME's low internal temperature, the poison in its tail has frozen into slush. This process has also resulted in denaturing these toxins, making this slush tasty and safe to eat, making it a popular treat in the summer season.

entry: POKENAME从来没有过热问题，可部分软件严重过时，常会死机。据说，要完成一次全面的软件更新，大约需要30年。
author: ruben2309295
source: POKENAME are known to never have problems with overheating, but due to some of their software being heavily outdated, POKENAME tend to freeze up. It's been said that a full software update would take around 30 years to complete.

entry: 爪子由坚实的不融冰构成，连猛烈沙漠酷热也能承受。它喜欢夜里出现，让众多硬刺的极光般光芒显露。
author: infinex21
source: Its claws are made of solid, Never-Melt Ice that can endure even harsh desert heat. It prefers to come out at night, which exposes the shimmering, aurora-like lights of its many quills.

entry: 冰雪龙的基因让POKENAME的身体过于庞大沉重，令它很不舒服。它大多时候都躺在雪里，一副生无可恋的样子。
author: theeggoverlord
source: The Amaura genes in POKENAME cause its body to be uncomfortably big and heavy for it. It spends most of its time lying in snow, as if done with life.

entry: POKENAME虽挑剔外表，却极其忠诚。裙子在光中，从不同方向看会变色、闪耀，启发了许多华丽设计衣装。
author: chibitales
source: Though finicky about their appearance, POKENAME are known to be fiercely loyal. Depending on the direction their dress is seen when in light, the color shifts and sparkles. This has led to many designer outfits inspired by the dazzling display.

entry: 凝视POKENAME鲜艳身体的人，竟报告听到落雪、星闪声，令人费解。都市传说称，有只野生个体，生于已故登山者的灵魂。
author: bobosmith01
source: Those who stare into POKENAME's vivid body illogically report hearing the falling of snow and the twinkling of stars. Urban legends speak of a wild POKENAME that was born from the souls of deceased mountain climbers.

entry: POKENAME的宝石，是鲜艳毒液结晶。压成细粉，会得到美丽、却剧毒的蓝色染料。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME's gems are composed of a vibrant crystallized venom. Crushing these crystals into a fine powder leaves a beautiful but extremely toxic blue dye.

entry: 近日，雪峰市以东冰层发现数千只冻结的POKENAME。研究者测定，它们的起源在10万多年前。
author: .izik
source: Thousands of frozen POKENAME were recently discovered in ice east of Snowpoint City. Researchers dated their origin to over 100,000 years ago.

entry: POKENAME用覆冰的头，撞穿巨大冰川。人们推测，冰河时代，它曾很常见。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME uses its ice-covered head to smash its way through massive glaciers. It is theorized that this Pokémon was very prevalent during the ice age.

entry: 据说，两只POKENAME以巨力撞头，就会形成极光。暖季时，它们也撞碎冰块，带回家降温。
author: soup1900
source: Auroras are said to form when two POKENAME clash heads with tremendous force. During warmer seasons, they headbutt chunks of ice into pieces to carry home as coolants.

entry: 据说，两只POKENAME以巨力撞头，就会形成极光。暖季时，它们也撞碎冰块，带回家降温。
author: soup1900
source: Auroras are said to form when two POKENAME clash heads with tremendous force. During warmer seasons, they headbutt chunks of ice into pieces to carry home as coolants.

entry: 鳞片与骨骼，都由冻结岩石构成，而非钙质。全力撞障碍时，身体常崩落碎块，它却似乎不觉得疼。
author: stevethebarbarian
source: Its scales and bones are both made of frozen rocks rather than calcium. When it smashes full-force into obstacles, it often chips parts of its body, but it seems to feel no pain.

entry: POKENAME头顶平面极冷，物体一碰就冻。若骤然变暖，冰甲会脆得危险，很容易碎裂。
author: .izik
source: The flat surface of POKENAME's head is extremely cold, freezing objects on contact. If rapidly warmed, the icy plating becomes dangerously brittle and prone to shattering.

entry: POKENAME自负得惊人，举止却冰冷优雅。谁没欣赏它的优雅，常转眼就被冻成冰块。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME carries itself with overwhelming self-importance and icy grace. Those who fail to admire its elegance are often frozen solid within moments.

entry: POKENAME是已灭绝的古宝可梦，背壳由压实冰雪构成。
author: h0bojoe
source: POKENAME is an ancient Pokémon that has gone extinct. The shell on its back is made of packed snow and ice.

entry: 古时，POKENAME在冰冻原野帮助迷路、疲惫的宝可梦，背到僻静泉边休息。乡村里，它头上宝石是救援的象征。
author: h0bojoe
source: In ancient times, POKENAME would help lost and exhausted Pokémon in icy tundras by carrying them to secluded springs for rest. In rural communities, the gem on its head serves as a symbol of rescue.

entry: 有人发现POKENAME潜到600米以下。深处光线稀少，它们便靠发光的头冠，避免迷失方向。
author: staghorn
source: POKENAME have been found diving at depths of over 600 meters. Because there is so little light at those depths, they use their luminescent crests to keep from getting lost.

entry: POKENAME只在严寒、偏僻山坡出现。研究很难，因为一靠近，它就扇翼扬雪，分散注意，再匆匆飞走。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME is only found in frigid, remote mountain sides. Researchers struggle to learn about POKENAME because when it's approached, it kicks up snow with its wings as a distraction before hurriedly flying away.

entry: POKENAME的齿轮转动，在周围造出极光。转得越快，光越亮，空气也越冷。
author: .jerden
source: The turning of POKENAME's gears generates an aurora in the air around them. The faster the gears turn, the brighter this will glow, and the colder the air will become.

entry: POKENAME常很友善，迅速与训练家、宝可梦交好。它能在毛中造小冰晶，调节体温。
author: robobunnybutt
source: POKENAME often possess a very friendly disposition, allowing them to bond quickly with Trainers and other Pokémon. It is capable of controlling its body temperature by generating small ice crystals within its fur.

entry: 它夜里腾跃，彩色附肢闪光，因此得名“起舞极光”。必须养在寒冷环境，否则不到一天，就会生病。
author: infinex21
source: It has earned the moniker "Dancing Aurora" due to its colorful appendages that shimmer with light at night while it prances about. It must be kept in cold environs, or else it will grow ill within less than a day.

entry: POKENAME是寒地常见猎手，在雪中跟踪目标。视力演化得极好，猛烈暴雪中，也能看见数英里外的猎物。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME is a common predator in cold environments, stalking its prey in the snow. Its vision evolved in a way that lets it see prey from miles away, even during severe blizzards.

entry: 谁以为POKENAME的伪装一打就垮，会大吃一惊。浅蓝布下是某种硬物，不知是魔法般密实的冰，还是普通石头。
author: imaginita
source: Those who attack an POKENAME and expect its disguise to collapse with ease are in for a shock. Under the pale blue fabric is some kind of hard substance. It is unknown whether it is magically dense ice or just a rock.

entry: POKENAME连沙漠寒夜也能活动。有人推测，过去头冠可能随栖居沙漠不同而有各种颜色，可尚未证实。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME can stay active even during cold desert nights. It has been theorized that POKENAME's head crests could have come in all different colors depending on which desert it lived in, but that has yet to be proven.

entry: POKENAME两个头的外表、行为一模一样。齿轮转动时，脖子偶尔缠在一起，尤其两头同吃一株植物时；必须反转齿轮，才能解开。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's two heads are identical in both appearance and behavior. Occasionally, their necks will become tangled as their gears rotate, especially if both are feeding on the same plant, and POKENAME's gears must run in reverse to untangle them.

entry: POKENAME的大齿轮虽像雪花，却是金属晶体，不是冰。摩擦并不让它发热，反而转得越快，本体越冷。
author: .jerden
source: Although its large gear is shaped like a snowflake, it is made from a metallic crystal rather than ice. Rather than generating heat through friction, the faster POKENAME turns, the colder it gets.

entry: 据说，北极光最亮时，POKENAME会出现在雪丘，顶着绚烂天空优雅转圈。看见它们聚集，被认为能带来好运。
author: rakunk
source: POKENAME are said to appear when the northern lights shine at their brightest, twirling gracefully beneath the vibrant skies atop snowy hills. Seeing a gathering of these Pokémon is considered good luck.

entry: POKENAME大半生，都用长牙在实冰中雕出家。过程让牙更强、更锐，反过来也更能自卫。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME spend much of their lives carving homes within formations of solid ice using their tusks. This process helps their tusks to grow stronger and sharper, allowing them to better defend themselves in turn.

entry: POKENAME在冷、暖环境都十分自在。头顶触肢振动，让周围空气闪起彩光。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME finds itself perfectly at home in both cold and warm temperatures. The tendrils poking out from its head vibrate and create colorful shimmers in the air around it.

entry: POKENAME住在冻原，圆而密实的身体，能轻松滚过冰雪。平常缓慢，可极光一现，就更活跃，转得也更快。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME live within the tundra, their round and dense bodies allowing them to roll along ice and snow with ease. Although they typically move slowly, they become more active during an aurora and spin even quicker.

entry: 研究者在植物化石上，找到符合POKENAME双颚的咬痕。它咬过的一切会瞬冻，将遗骸保存数千年。
author: .izik
source: Researchers have found bite marks on fossilized plant life that match POKENAME's jaws. Anything it bites freezes instantly, preserving the remains for millennia.

entry: POKENAME起舞时会扬起冰雪。羽毛将阳光折射成粉、蓝、黄、紫色的光束。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME kick up snow and ice as they dance. Their feathers refract sunlight into beams of pink, blue, yellow and purple.

entry: POKENAME日落时成群飘过天空，每次扇翼，都散开彩云。夜间栖息，云中光芒便消散，飘进群星。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Flocks of POKENAME drift across the skies at sunset, spreading vibrant clouds with every flap of their wings. They perch at night, the light of their clouds dissipating and drifting away among the stars.

entry: 临近日落，POKENAME展翅，云状双翼融入晚霞的多彩余光。夜深、空气转寒，群体轻哼便从西方地平线飘来。
author: pattybgoode
source: Taking wing as sunset approaches, POKENAME's cloud-like wings blend with the multicolor rays of last light. As night falls and the air grows colder, the gentle hums of POKENAME flocks float from the western horizon.

entry: POKENAME生活在寒冷地区，身体几乎冻结。分泌的黏液冰冷刺骨，千万不能毫无防护地触碰。
author: sand_coffin
source: POKENAME's body is nearly frozen due to living in a cold climate. The slime it produces is freezing cold; never touch one without protection.

entry: POKENAME分泌的黏液呈酸性，冰冷刺骨。据说徒手触碰造成的伤势，永远也无法完全痊愈。
author: sand_coffin
source: The goo POKENAME produces is acidic and freezing cold. Anyone who touches it barehanded is said to never fully recover from their injuries.

entry: POKENAME栖息在山顶，分泌的黏液温度低于零度。即使做好防护，触摸它也可能冻伤。
author: sand_coffin
source: POKENAME inhabits mountain peaks, producing goo that reaches subzero temperatures. Even with protection, touching this Pokémon can cause frostbite.

entry: POKENAME喜欢筑冰冷的沙堡，让它们在月光下闪亮。有人拍拍结霜的头，发光颈帆便欢快摇曳；摇摆走开时，偶尔还留下一小堆雪。
author: jitteryjared
source: POKENAME loves building icy sandcastles that sparkle in the moonlight. Its glowing sails flutter happily when someone pats its frosty head, and it sometimes leaves behind tiny snowpiles as it waddles away.

entry: POKENAME生活在寒地，从常绿树吸取养分。爪子坚硬，能挖穿冻土，够到下方的根。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME lives in cold lands, where it drains nutrients from evergreen trees. Its claws are hard enough to burrow through frozen soil to reach the roots below.

entry: POKENAME体内晶体逐渐吸光，将过剩能量化为绚丽极光释放。宝石极少脱落，又美又抢手，珠宝商因此卖出天价。
author: sk372
source: The crystals within POKENAME's body absorb light over time, releasing excess in the form of dazzling auroras. Jewelers sell its rarely-shed gems at an exorbitantly high price due to their beauty and demand.

entry: POKENAME口中火焰带着极光色彩。学者认为，软毛间冒出的晶体，能扩大攻击范围。
author: fiordaliso
source: The flames that POKENAME blows from its mouth have the hues of the aurora. Scholars believe that the crystals that sprout from its soft fur amplify the range of its attacks.

entry: POKENAME用软尾拖着法杖划地，就能产生鲜艳彩火。科学家近日挖出冰雪深层下的结晶化石，将它复活。
author: fiordaliso
source: By dragging the staff held in its soft tail along the ground, POKENAME is able to produce vivid, colorful flames. Scientists recently revived this Pokémon after unearthing its crystallized fossils buried beneath many layers of ice and snow.

entry: POKENAME用软尾拖着法杖划地，就能产生鲜艳彩火。科学家近日挖出冰雪深层下的结晶化石，将它复活。
author: fiordaliso
source: By dragging the staff held in its soft tail along the ground, POKENAME is able to produce vivid, colorful flames. Scientists recently revived this Pokémon after unearthing its crystallized fossils buried beneath many layers of ice and snow.

entry: POKENAME吐烟时，有时连冰块也一起吐出。它以冰块供能，避免自身在高温下融化。
author: soup1900
source: When POKENAME is blowing out smoke, it sometimes blows out chunks of ice along with it. It uses ice cubes as its energy source to prevent itself from melting in high temperatures.

entry: POKENAME快乐地划过天空，留下冰尘轨迹。着陆时，会寻找雪地，缓冲落地冲击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME streaks joyfully across the sky, leaving behind a trail of icy dust. When landing, it seeks out snowy fields to cushion its fall.

entry: POKENAME每次挥拳，都留下小小闪光轨迹。越生气，光迹越亮、越醒目。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's fists leave small shimmering trails with each swing. The trails it leaves become brighter and more noticeable the angrier it gets.

entry: 只要集中精神，POKENAME就能让拳头覆上厚冰。一拳下去，能瞬间冻住整座湖。
author: .izik
source: By concentrating, it can form thick layers of ice on its fists. A punch from an POKENAME can freeze an entire lake in an instant.

entry: POKENAME鬃毛的火焰随心情变色。极光盖满夜空时，群体会聚在冻原平地，寻找伴侣。
author: chibitales
source: The flames making up POKENAME's mane change color depending on their mood. When an aurora blankets the night sky, herds of these Pokémon gather together in tundra plains to find mates.

entry: 在冰冷多雾的环境中，会凭鲜艳的鳍辨认其他POKENAME的动向。
author: staghorn
source: It uses its brightly colored fins to keep track of other POKENAME in icy, foggy conditions.

entry: POKENAME的黏稠身体始终凉爽。有人采集这些物质，制成舒缓烧伤的药膏。
author: hophoppip
source: The goop that comprises POKENAME's body maintains a cool temperature at all times. Some people harvest it to use as a salve to soothe burns.

entry: POKENAME壳内不断流出细雾。雾中充满冰晶，在空中飘动时，映出美丽光影。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME produce a fine mist that constantly flows from the interior of their shells. This mist is filled with ice crystals that create a beautiful light display as they drift through the air.

entry: 寒冷地区的极光之夜，能看见POKENAME。即使远离北极，也会带来刺骨北风。
author: pattybgoode
source: POKENAME is seen in cold climates on nights when aurorae are visible in the sky. Even away from arctic areas, it brings a chilling northern wind.

entry: POKENAME对刺激极敏感，一感到威胁就瞬间冻住自己。近日，冰川中发现一只，看来它乐意如此等上数百万年。
author: h0bojoe
source: POKENAME is extremely sensitive to stimuli and will instantly freeze itself whenever it feels threatened. One was recently found in a glacier, indicating it is content to wait in this state for millions of years.

entry: POKENAME在菱形晶体内，以极高压力储存冷空气。存得太多，就会不受控制地向四周喷出，冻住附近一切。
author: h0bojoe
source: POKENAME stores cold air under very high pressure in its diamond-shaped crystals. If it ever stores too much, it will erratically expel the air around itself, freezing everything in its vicinity.

entry: POKENAME的骨头始终冰冷。敌人哪怕短暂碰到，也会结霜，行动变慢。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's bone remains icy cold at all times. Even brief contact can cause frost to form on foes, slowing their movement.

entry: 春夏期间，POKENAME必须在头盔、棍棒外包上冰雪，免得融化。高兴时，头上帆状鳍会美丽闪耀。
author: infinex21
source: Throughout spring and summer, POKENAME must pad their helmets and clubs with ice or snow to keep them from melting. When POKENAME are happy, the sail-like fins upon their heads shimmer beautifully.

entry: POKENAME从晶体与帆状薄幕散出寒雾，让自己保持凉爽，也保护冰制棍棒不融化。头骨比不融冰更冷，比钻石还硬。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME exudes a frigid vapor from its crystals and from its sail-like veils that keeps itself cool and protects its ice club from melting. Its skull is colder than Never-Melt Ice and harder than diamond.

entry: POKENAME的坚壳耐受极寒。它从身上晶体放冷气，将自己封在冰中，直到准备进化才解冻。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME's tough shell can withstand extremely cold temperatures. By releasing freezing cold air from the crystals on their bodies, they encase themselves in ice, remaining frozen until ready to evolve.

entry: POKENAME生成温度为华氏零下240度的毒气，微粒带着微弱电荷。排出时如极光闪耀，引来被美景迷住的猎物。
author: wickedwiccan
source: POKENAME generates toxic gases at a temperature of -240 degrees Fahrenheit, giving their particles a faint electrical charge. These gases shimmer like an aurora when expelled, drawing in any prey entranced by their beauty.

entry: 晴夜里，POKENAME成群飞上天，寻找月亮。满月的光照到翅膀，就会泛起极光般的色彩。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: On clear nights, POKENAME swarm the skies in search of the moon. On full moon nights, the moonlight causes POKENAME's wings to shine like an aurora.

entry: 天空充满色彩时，POKENAME便大群聚集，把自身光芒添进极光、彩虹。不知为何如此，流行解释是吸收外界的光，增强自身光彩。
author: deadshields
source: POKENAME gather in droves whenever the sky fills with colours, adding their own glow to the auroras and rainbows overhead. It is not known why they do this, but the popular theory is they absorb the lights to add to their own.

entry: POKENAME成群在夜空下起舞，头顶造出闪亮极光。即使无风，头发也轻轻飘动、发亮。
author: chibitales
source: As groups of POKENAME dance under the night sky, they create glittering auroras above them. Their hair flutters and glimmers gently even when no wind is present.

entry: POKENAME结大群寻找食物。双翼产生极细粉尘，一碰就冷，帮助它们吓退天敌。
author: arveral
source: POKENAME travel in large groups in search for food. POKENAME's wings produce a very fine dust that is extremely cold to the touch, helping deter predators from attacking them.

entry: POKENAME以头两侧的褶饰，保护背上的乘客。看似轻薄无力，冰冷闪亮的表面，摸着却坚如岩石。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME protects anyone it carries on its back using the frills on either side of its head. Although these seem thin and insubstantial, their cold, shimmering surface feels as solid as rock.

entry: POKENAME只在天空有极光的夜间歌唱，让周围浮起亮光。有人为看这隐居宝可梦的演出，会在冻原跋涉数小时。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME only sing on nights when the aurora is visible above, creating bright lights in the air around them. Some people travel for hours across the tundra to witness the performances of this reclusive Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME只在天空有极光的夜间歌唱，让周围浮起亮光。有人为看这隐居宝可梦的演出，会在冻原跋涉数小时。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME only sing on nights when the aurora is visible above, creating bright lights in the air around them. Some people travel for hours across the tundra to witness the performances of this reclusive Pokémon.

entry: 若极光不是自然曲线，而呈多边形图案，就是POKENAME造的。它视觉记忆不佳，面对美景，可能一看就是几小时。
author: epping_forest
source: If the aurora lights in the sky happen to take the form of polygonal patterns instead of the natural curvy lines, it means that they were cast by POKENAME. Since they have no good visual memory, they may stay hours viewing at a beautiful landscape.

entry: POKENAME由遥远冰川出土的化石复活。捕猎手段凶猛，会俯冲袭击困在猛烈暴雪中的猎物。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME were revived from fossils found in far-off glaciers. They are known for their aggressive hunting tactics, such as dive-bombing prey that are caught amidst raging snowstorms.

entry: POKENAME展开双翼，反光形成耀眼极光。仰望者被吸引、分心，它就更容易俯冲，抓走猎物。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's wings reflect light while unfurled, creating dazzling aurora-like displays. These auroras are able to distract those looking up, making it easier for POKENAME to swoop down and snatch some prey.

entry: POKENAME长尾散出的寒气会形成极光，始终跟在身后。战斗时，翅膀也像绚丽极光般发亮，释放冰寒能量前尤其明显。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are always trailed by an aurora cast by the frigid air exuded by their long tails. Their wings glow like prismatic auroras during battle, especially before they release their frigid energies.

entry: 这些夜行宝可梦飞过夜空，留下华美极光。POKENAME一鸣，便预示暴雪；也有人猜测，暴雪其实就是它造的。
author: infinex21
source: These nocturnal Pokémon leave gorgeous auroras in their wake when they fly across the night sky. The cry of an POKENAME will herald a snowstorm, though some speculate they are capable of creating snowstorms.

entry: 两只POKENAME求偶时，会在空中共舞，映出壮观彩光。有些冒险者，甚至愿走遍世界，只为一睹这景象。
author: zweizweihander
source: When two POKENAME produce their courtship ritual, they dance in the skies, creating a stunning display of colorful lights. Some adventurers are willing to travel across the whole world just to witness this phenomenon.

entry: POKENAME用褶饰遮眼，不断变换花纹，吓退来犯者。若没用，就伴冷风展开脸部；据说，凝视能将任何生物冻成冰块。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME keep their frills covering their eyes, the patterns on them constantly shifting to ward off attackers. If this fails, they will unfurl their faces with an icy gust of wind, their gaze said to be able to freeze anyone solid.

entry: POKENAME能从众多晶体放出寒气，几秒就造出坚冰构造。储存的能量若释放，也能彻底冻住路径上的一切。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME can release frigid air from their many crystals that is capable of creating formations of solid ice in seconds. The energy they store within themselves is able to solidly freeze anything in its path if loosed.

entry: POKENAME飞行时，翅膀能在身后造出耀眼极光。它常用来保护弱小生物，突然闪光分散天敌注意，再将猎物救往安全处。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's wings can create a dazzling aurora of light behind it as it flies. It often uses this as a tactic to defend weak creatures, distracting predators with the sudden shimmering display and spiriting away the would-be prey to safety.

entry: POKENAME最醒目的，是冰冷螫针。它先放寒气，封住目标行动，再高速冲前，以带毒、覆冰的重击攻击。
author: lesbian_garlicbread
source: POKENAME icy stingers are its most striking feature. It releases freezing air to immobilize its targets before darting forward at high speed to deliver poisonous, ice‑coated blows.

entry: POKENAME虽喜欢独居，却心怀怜悯。它用超能力控制空气，形成屏障，保护被雪崩困住的生物。
author: mepp.
source: Though POKENAME prefer to live in isolation, they have a compassionate heart. Using their psychic powers, they control air to form barriers to protect those caught in avalanches.

entry: 历代传说都提到，寒地夜空曾飞过一颗美丽光球，内部彩色旋转。那便是POKENAME，飞行时会投出念力极光屏障自保。
author: sk372
source: Tales across time speak of a beautiful, glowing orb of swirling colors flying through the night sky in colder regions. These legends were speaking of POKENAME, which projects a psychic aurora barrier to protect itself from harm while it flies.

entry: POKENAME的冰息极强，瞬间就能冻住活物。花状褶饰反射光，造出华丽极光，让敌人目眩、不愿交战。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's Frost Breath is extremely potent, being able to freeze living beings solid in an instant. By reflecting light off of its flower-shaped frill, it creates magnificent auroras that bedazzle opponents and make them unwilling to fight.

entry: POKENAME的吐息能让植物恢复生机，必要时，也能冻住敌人。星夜，它朝天嚎叫，造出极光。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME's breath has the ability to revive plant life, yet it can also freeze foes if needed. On starry nights POKENAME howls at the sky, creating auroras.

entry: POKENAME通常性情温顺，不喜欢打斗。受威胁时却能造出冰墙自保，还能将敌人封在冰中。
author: goldegummybear
source: Usually very docile, POKENAME dislike fighting. However, when threatened, they can create walls of ice to protect themselves and encase enemies.

entry: POKENAME只在寒冷的冬夜现身。额头的水晶能从极光中汲取能量，供给潜藏的超能力。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME have only been seen on cold winter nights. It uses the crystal on its forehead to draw energy from auroras to fuel its latent psychic powers.

entry: 它织出光亮毒网，引来小宝可梦，再咬猎物，使其剧烈寒冷。背上褶饰在夜间发光，吸引其他POKENAME。
author: korro0490
source: It produces lustrous but poisonous webs that lure small Pokémon. It then bites its prey, causing an intense chilling. The frills on its back illuminate at night to attract other POKENAME.

entry: 学会与如今的宝可梦共处后，POKENAME的领地意识更强了。不过，只要有可能，还是会避免冲突。
author: goldegummybear
source: Having learned to coexist with the Pokémon of today, POKENAME have grown more territorial. However, they still avoid conflict whenever possible.

entry: POKENAME从触角晶体释放美丽光芒，让周围水域如同极光。受威胁时，则用晶体将敌人彻底冻住。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME release beautiful lights from the crystals on their antennae, giving the surrounding water the appearance of an aurora. If threatened, they will use these crystals to freeze foes solid.

entry: 头顶褶饰释放粉笔般的粉末，缓冲摔落冲击。少了这些粉，落地就容易擦伤身体。
author: quackquackattack
source: The frill atop its heads releases a chalky powder that cushions its falls. Without this powder, it is prone to scratch its body when landing on the ground.

entry: 耀眼的外形令许多训练家着迷，然而只需用力一振翅，就会掀起阵阵寒风，冻结沿途的一切。
author: goldegummybear
source: Its dazzling appearance captivates many Trainers, but one strong flap of its wings causes gusts of frosty winds that freeze everything in their path.

entry: POKENAME操纵泥，形成冰冻晶体。每颗组成各不相同，都能卖出高价。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME can manipulate mud in such a way that it creates frozen crystals with it. These can fetch high prices, and the composition of each is unique.

entry: POKENAME曾在冰河时代的酷寒中繁盛，也能适应现代气候。背火呈现人眼无法尽见的色彩，释放的能量与北极光相同。
author: sontyp
source: POKENAME used to thrive in the freezing temperatures of the ice age, but can adapt well to modern climates. The fire on its back produces more colors than the human eye can perceive and emits the same energies as the northern lights.

entry: POKENAME住在北极海域，以喙、触手挖进冰与岩。外套膜里的晶体能操纵冰，挡开攻击、封住逃路。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME lives in arctic oceans, where it burrows into ice and rock using its beak and tentacles. The crystals in its mantle allow it to manipulate ice, deflecting attacks and blocking off escape routes.

entry: POKENAME住在北极海域，以喙、触手挖进冰与岩。外套膜里的晶体能操纵冰，挡开攻击、封住逃路。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME lives in arctic oceans, where it burrows into ice and rock using its beak and tentacles. The crystals in its mantle allow it to manipulate ice, deflecting attacks and blocking off escape routes.

entry: POKENAME住在北极海域，以喙、触手挖进冰与岩。外套膜里的晶体能操纵冰，挡开攻击、封住逃路。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME lives in arctic oceans, where it burrows into ice and rock using its beak and tentacles. The crystals in its mantle allow it to manipulate ice, deflecting attacks and blocking off escape routes.

entry: 宽大美丽的双翼，让它与荧光鱼竞争“海中狩猎凤蝶”的称号。不过比起水中，人们更常见它在空中滑翔。
author: crazynaturekitty
source: Its large, beautiful wings are have caused it to rival Finneon for the title of 'Beautifly of the sea'. However, it's more often seen gliding through the air than in the water.

entry: POKENAME尾部的材料划过空气，会留下极光般的轨迹。它以此造出壮观奇景，惊艳穿行寒地的旅人。
author: sk372
source: The material on POKENAME's tail creates an aurora-like trail behind it when moved through the air. Using this, it creates breathtaking spectacles to wow those traveling through its frigid habitat.

entry: POKENAME还不擅储电。挥臂旋转发电时，角上会产生极光般的光环。
author: the_fireplace
source: POKENAME is not good at storing electricity yet. Spinning its arms around to generate electricity makes its horns produce an aurora-like halo.

entry: 它的鬃毛像细柔薄纱，散发极光般的辉光。覆盖POKENAME全身的宝石会增强它放出的雷霆，用来惩罚污染雪地的生物。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its mane resembles a fine veil that radiates an aurora-like glow. The gemstones covering its body amplify the thunder POKENAME unleashes to punish those who pollute snowy habitats.

entry: POKENAME奔到哪里，脚下便延展永久冻土，身后却有火焰噼啪。嚎叫搅动天际极光，一呼吸，能融开冻原，也能冻住整座山峰，两种极端不断冲突。
author: jaminmcready
source: Wherever POKENAME runs, permafrost spreads beneath its feet while flames crackle in its wake. Its howls stir auroras across the sky, and with each breath, it can melt tundras or freeze entire peaks - embodying two extremes in constant conflict.

entry: POKENAME的壳由晶体材料构成，微光下闪亮，周围泛起淡极光。进化后留下的碎片，常被采集，售作昂贵饰物。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's shell is made of a crystalline material that glimmers in low lighting and creates a faint aurora around it. Many collect shards left behind after it evolves to be sold as high-priced accessories.

entry: POKENAME不断冻住身边空气，睡处地面也随之结冰。脾气与巨力都很可怕，狂怒经过后，曾让整片森林被冰封。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME constantly freezes the air around it, leading to ice forming along the ground where it sleeps. Its notorious temper and terrible strength have led to entire forests being encased in ice after it rampaged through in a fury.

entry: POKENAME受其他宝可梦威胁，褶饰就发出响亮颤音。中了它的毒，敌人的静脉与血液会开始冻结。
author: bigoljax
source: When threatened by another Pokémon, POKENAME's frills start to make a loud shimmering sound. When under the effects of POKENAME's venom, the foes veins and blood start to freeze.

entry: POKENAME自古以来就成群狩猎。会包围猎物，再从菱形晶体中发出冲击，将其冻结。
author: darkweavile428
source: Hunting in packs since ancient times, POKENAME surround their prey and freeze it with blasts from their diamond-shaped crystals.

entry: 尾尖宝石能释放寒冷的力量，让沙漠洞穴整天保持凉爽。也曾见它蜷成球旋转，同时放出寒雾，为自己降温。
author: infinex21
source: The gem-like tip of its tail can release a freezing energy capable of keeping its desert burrows cool throughout the day. It has been seen curling into a ball and spinning while releasing this vapor to cool itself off.

entry: 夜空光亮、空气冰寒时，POKENAME就会现身。它用菱形晶体冻住自身毛皮，映出璀璨景象。
author: lesbian_garlicbread
source: When the night sky lights up and the air is frigid, POKENAME will appear. Using its diamond-shaped crystals, it freezes its own fur, creating a glittering spectacle.

entry: POKENAME的爪由比不融冰更坚固的冰构成。闪亮硬刺会放寒雾，助它在沙漠酷热中保持凉爽。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME claws are made of ice that is stronger than Never-Melt Ice. Their shimmering quills can release a frigid vapor that help them to stay cool in the desert heat.

entry: POKENAME以强腿攀冰山，救助遇险登山者。发现急需救治者，就用绚丽极光点亮天空，通知其他队员。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME ascends icy mountains with its powerful legs to rescue hikers in perilous situations. When POKENAME finds someone who needs immediate medical attention, it lights up the sky with brilliant auroras to signal the rest of its team.

entry: POKENAME高兴就爱跳舞，偏爱冰等光滑表面，好滑行。也有报告说，它冻住周围地面，纯粹为了让舞跳得更好。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME tend to dance when they feel happy, favoring slick surfaces such as ice to skate along. Some POKENAME have reportedly coated the terrain around them in ice purely to enhance their dancing capabilities.

entry: POKENAME合用冰霜之力与神秘能量，造出城堡般的坚冰巢穴，数年不融。它很少离巢，除非察觉善良生灵的存在。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME channels its powers of frost together with its mystical energies to create castle-like dens of solid ice that can last for years without melting. They rarely leave their dens unless they sense the presence of a kind soul.

entry: POKENAME初被发现时，曾让人误以为神灵。优雅空灵的模样，也常成为婚纱的设计灵感。
author: arveral
source: When POKENAME was first discovered in the wild, people mistook it for a divine being. POKENAME's elegant and ethereal appearance is often used as inspiration for wedding dresses.

entry: POKENAME是卡洛斯广受欢迎的点心，几乎每家餐馆菜单都有。厨师常加自选食材、饰物，装点出各自的独特风格。
author: sk372
source: Considered a very widely-enjoyed treat within the Kalos region, POKENAME is present on nearly every eatery's menu. Chefs will often decorate it with their own ingredients and accessories to add a custom flair.

entry: POKENAME罕见，许多最初目击都被当成幻景。它优雅如幻影，穿行冰冻苔原，体表流动着令人着迷的极光花纹。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is so rarely seen that many first sightings were assumed to be mirages. It moves with ethereal grace through the frozen tundras, its body covered with a moving, hypnotic aurora pattern.

entry: POKENAME用众多晶体，瞬间在手臂造出冰刃，也以冰片击败敌人与威胁。调动晶体力量时，飘动的头冠便鲜亮发光。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME use their many crystals to instantly form ice blades on their arms and shards of ice to dispatch foes and threats. Their flowing crests glow vibrantly when they command the power within their crystals.

entry: POKENAME身上的褶饰，能探知最微弱的磁场。它靠这本领寻找天然磁石，大吃一顿。
author: w3ird0_r4tz
