source: The frills on POKENAME's body can pick up the faintest of magnetic fields. It uses this ability to locate lodestones to gorge itself on.

entry: POKENAME近乎无形的身体，不断放出极光般的耀眼颜色；色彩也如极光，会随附近强磁场改变。科学家正研究持续产生的辐射。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's nigh-incorporeal body constantly outputs intense dazzling colors reminiscent of an aurora; indeed, just like an aurora, the colors shift with nearby strong magnetic fields. Scientists are studying the radiation it constantly produces.

entry: POKENAME高速飞行时，褶饰在身后映出极光。它升空捕猎，先从体上晶体射出冰冻光束，冻住目标，再俯冲抓走。
author: sk372
source: When POKENAME flies through the air at high speeds, its frills cast a shimmering aurora behind it. It takes to the sky to hunt, casting Ice Beams from the crystals on its body to freeze prey before it swoops down to grab them.

entry: POKENAME优雅美丽，令人目眩，不过最好远观。许多为它着迷的小宝可梦，已被巨颚吞下。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's elegant appearance is dazzling to behold. It's best to admire it from a distance, however, as many a small Pokémon enamored by POKENAME has been devoured by its enormous jaws.

entry: POKENAME住在寒海，头上起伏的褶饰，其实是花瓣。身上晶体，被认为是冰封的种子。
author: kam_doodle_snek
source: The rippling frills on POKENAME's head are actually petals. The crystals that grow on its body are thought to be seeds encased in ice. It lives in cold oceans.

entry: POKENAME争夺伴侣，会轮流造钻石、冰墙，让对手砸碎。先倒下昏迷者输，可往往一赛就是整天。
author: stevethebarbarian
source: When competing for a mate, POKENAME take turns producing walls of diamond and ice for their rivals to smash. The first to collapse unconscious is the loser, but these contests often take all day.

entry: POKENAME潜入冰川下，冷却海水，尽量维持家园环境与结构。褶饰摇曳，即使深海中，也像北极光。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME dive beneath glaciers, chilling the waters to try and preserve the environment and structure of their homes. The swaying of their frills resembles the northern lights even from the depths of the seas.

entry: POKENAME统治冰封土地，以全力驱逐入侵者。帆与体上圆环，会放出遮眼暴雪。
author: ishdra
source: POKENAME rules over the icy lands. It uses its full power to drive out those who encroach on its territory with a blinding blizzard from its sails and the ring on its body.

entry: POKENAME住在积雪最厚的山间，允许登山者在背上扎营。人们相信，古时它与象牙猪住在相似环境。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME are known to live on some of the snowiest mountains, allowing mountaineers to set up camps on their backs. It is believed that in ancient times, Mamoswine and POKENAME lived in similar habitats.

entry: POKENAME花很多时间、精力，用褶饰造耀眼极光。景象没有实际作用，纯粹想炫耀，让其他生物惊叹。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME dedicates a great amount of time and energy to great dazzling auroras using its frills. The displays serve no practical purpose; it simply wants to show off and impress others.

entry: 谁握住POKENAME的剑柄，就会被冻成实冰，生命力从冰冻身体中，慢慢被吸走。
author: lesbian_garlicbread
source: If grabbed by the hilt, POKENAME will freeze the person to solid ice, slowly draining that person's life force from their frozen form.

entry: 每年一次，POKENAME在北方冰山上空的夜里交战，决定下任首领。闪翼与极光束，造出壮丽北极光，引来许多游客。
author: leandermalurt
source: Once every year, POKENAME battle in the northern night sky above frozen mountains to decide the next leader of the herd. Their shimmering wings and Aurora Beam attacks create a fantastic display of northern lights that draws in many tourists.

entry: POKENAME齿轮转快，钻石便泛彩虹光。能量可化作闪亮光晕，将空气水分凝成冰，冻住附近敌人。
author: .jerden
source: If POKENAME's gears begin to rotate faster, the diamonds on them will begin to glow with rainbow light. This energy can emanated out as a shimmering aura, condensing moisture in the air into ice and freezing nearby foes solid.

entry: POKENAME攻击性很强，以空灵的鬃毛散光，让敌人目眩。等对方晕头转向，再用钻石爪凶狠撕碎猎物。
author: ludacriswell
source: POKENAME is a highly aggressive Pokémon. It uses its ethereal mane to scatter light and dazzle enemies. After they have been sufficiently disoriented, POKENAME then uses its diamond claws to furiously rip apart and dispose of its prey.

entry: POKENAME能用幻象，造极光主题的亮光，暂时晃盲敌人。以前在庆典很受欢迎，近期惨剧却让人气下降。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME use their ability to make illusions to temporarily blind their foes, they do this by creating aurora-themed lights. While they used to be popular at festivals, POKENAME's popularity has declined due to recent tragedy.

entry: POKENAME以菱形晶体造坚冰墙，保护自己、幼崽。缎带状器官放出冷气，让它们在恶劣环境也保持凉爽。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME defend themselves and their young by creating walls of solid ice using their diamond-shaped crystals. They exude a cold aura from their ribbon-like organs, which can keep themselves and their young cool in harsher environments.

entry: POKENAME主要吃岩石，偶尔也吃一两颗晶体，当甜点。
author: the.the.the.the.the.the
source: POKENAME eats mostly rocks. It will sometimes eat a crystal or two as a sweet treat.

entry: POKENAME住在北极深海，鳍的华光，连水面都看得见。只在冬夜上浮，吸取北极光的力量。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME lives in the deep arctic ocean, The gorgeous light from its fins can even be seen from the surface of the water. It will only surface on winter nights, drawing power from the northern lights.

entry: POKENAME独特的晶体，映着不同时间的片段。光一照过，就会投出里面的景象。
author: thordemidgard
source: POKENAME's unique crystals display different moments in time. When light shines through one, the scene it contains is projected.

entry: POKENAME能弯折空间，塑成极光般的缎带。保护朋友时，便在四周放出特殊极光幕，化作无限维度的屏障。
author: epping_forest
source: POKENAME can bend and fold space into the shape of a ribbon that resembles an aurora light. When it tries to protect its friends, it casts a special aurora veil around them that acts as an infinite dimensional barrier.

entry: POKENAME独居最冷的北极地区，取下冰川碎块，雕成其他生物的精巧冰像。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME maintains a solitary lifestyle in the most frigid arctic regions. It removes chunks of glaciers to carve the ice into intricate statues of other lifeforms.

entry: 极光在上方闪耀，POKENAME就着迷地向天伸手。臂边霜晶在暗中发亮，看着像在拥抱星光。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME reach up to the sky whenever the aurora glitters overhead, entranced by the majestic display above. Frost crystals glitter in the dark around their arms when they do so, making it appear as though they are hugging starlight.

entry: POKENAME是现代长耳兔的祖先，以强化听觉追踪地下河。找到后，便搜寻主要食物——晶洞石。
author: ghostslythe
source: Ancestors of the modern Lopunny, POKENAME used their enhanced hearing to track underground rivers. Once found, they scavenged for their main source of nutrition, geodes.

entry: POKENAME的菱形晶体在周围造出闪亮极光。极光虽然没有实体，却蕴含精神能量，使固体物体无法穿过。
author: .jerden
source: The diamond-shaped crystals of POKENAME's body create a shimmering aurora around them. Although it is not physical, this aurora is infused with psychic energy that prevents solid objects from passing through it.

entry: 入夜，北极光给予POKENAME飞行力量，让它在暗中发亮。据说偶尔在夏夜，身上蓝宝石色的宝石会亮如星座中的群星。
author: fiordaliso
source: When night falls, the light of the aurora borealis grants POKENAME the power to take flight, glowing amidst the darkness. It is said that on rare summer nights, the sapphire-colored gems on its body gleam as brightly as the stars of a constellation.

entry: POKENAME会在极光出现时聚集，在空中闪耀。这时，它们的魔法闪耀与极光束威力都会增强。
author: uncookie
source: POKENAME gather during auroras, shining brightly in the air. At these times, their Dazzling Gleams and Aurora Beams are amplified in power.

entry: POKENAME会找上它认定虚荣或自私的人，让对方看见真实的自己。若被指责撒谎，就把受害者冻成冰块。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME will appear in front of people who it considers vain or selfish to show them their true reflection. If it is accused of lying, however, it will freeze its victim solid.

entry: 它能从钻石般突起释放寒气，更多时候却由斧状长牙放出。牙利得能切金属，还常冻住切口周围。
author: infinex21
source: Although this Pokémon can release chilling air from its diamond-like protrusions, it most often releases it from its axe-like tusks. These tusks are sharp enough to cut through metal and will often freeze the area around the cuts they make.

entry: POKENAME的鳍富含磷，泛着温暖光。它也能用体上晶体，在暗云上投出壮丽光影。
author: nexusshenanigans
source: The fins on POKENAME's body are potent in phosphorus, giving them a warm glow. Using the crystals on its body, POKENAME can cast stunning displays of light onto dark clouds.

entry: POKENAME飞到哪里，极光就跟到哪里。迁徙季，群体造出美丽光秀；双翼摸着光滑清凉。
author: nyoomymph
source: Where POKENAME flies, an aurora trails behind. Flocks of POKENAME create beautiful light shows during their migration season. Their wings are smooth and cool to the touch.

entry: POKENAME只在新月时现身，身上的光会为迷途者指引方向。
author: weirdtux
source: POKENAME will only appear during new moons. Its light serves as a guide for those who have lost their way.

entry: POKENAME视力很差，平时只能看见紧邻身边的事物。夜里，颈部周围的褶饰能发出更亮的光，照清四周，帮助它辨认前路。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has poor eyesight, only able to naturally see its most immediate surroundings. At night, the frill around its neck can glow brighter in order to illuminate the area around it and help it see where it's going.

entry: POKENAME的翼是纯晶体，澄澈得让光完全穿过。经过很久，穿透的光便开始呈现极光般的样子。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME's wings are made out of pure crystal, clear enough for light to fully pass through. The light that passes through starts to mimic the appearance of an aurora after a long period of time.

entry: 它以天空极光互相沟通。两只POKENAME，相隔数英里，也能靠超能力感知彼此。
author: hophoppip
source: It communicates by producing auroras in the sky. A pair of POKENAME can psychically sense one another from miles away.

entry: POKENAME通常温顺镇静，四只成群，造冰墙、电场自卫。除非迫不得已，绝不会咬。
author: heal_fire
source: POKENAME are usually very passive and calm. They live in packs of four Pokémon and create ice barriers and electric fields to defend themselves. They never bite unless forced to.

entry: 看头冠的形状和颜色，就知道POKENAME吃了多少，甚至能分辨热量、蛋白质、钠与碳水化合物的摄入量。它很爱干冷天气的微风。
author: epping_forest
source: From the shape and color of its crest, you can tell how much POKENAME has eaten, and even details like the amount of calories, proteins, sodium and carbohydrates. It loves to feel the breeze of dry and cold weather.

entry: 它们驮着巨大冰晶花，靠许多钻石般的寒霜器官放冷气，维持冰寒。花光如极光，哪怕只见一次，也被视为莫大福气。
author: infinex21
source: These Pokémon carry large crystalline flowers of ice kept cold by the frigid air loosed by their many, diamond-like frost organs. These flowers shimmer like an aurora and to witness them even once is considered a great boon.

entry: POKENAME卷起耳朵，让柔韧颈帆在冰冻苔原保暖。展开时，虹彩毛皮与帆一同闪耀，看者都忘了走。
author: t3isukone
source: POKENAME rolls its ears up so they can keep its flexible sails warm in the icy tundras it lives in. When it unfurls them, the mesmerizing display of its iridescent fur and sails stops onlookers in their tracks.

entry: 传说POKENAME是冬日霜雪的化身。它以善心闻名，常在猛烈暴雪中，为迷路旅人引路。
author: mepp.
source: Legends claim that POKENAME are the wintry personification frost and snow. It is known for its kind heart, guiding lost travellers during terrible blizzards.

entry: 它们的长牙始终覆着层层利冰，保护正在发育的部分。即便如此，每年仍会蜕牙，重新长出更好的。
author: infinex21
source: Their tusks are always clad in layers of sharp ice to keep them safe as they continue to develop. Even with this, they still shed their tusks every year so they may regrow better than before.

entry: POKENAME盖着雪埋伏，等毫无防备的目标。察觉压力，就放电麻痹，之后慢慢冻住身体，留着以后吃。
author: laughing_dan
source: POKENAME cover themselves in the snow and lies in wait for an unsuspecting victim. When it feels pressure, POKENAME lets out electrical currents to paralyze the creature; it will then take its time freezing the body to consume at a later date.

entry: POKENAME以晶体眼造出硬如岩石的无形屏障，阻挡攻击。袭矿找宝石吃时，便靠它抵御人类与宝可梦。
author: .jerden
source: Using its crystalline eyes, POKENAME can create invisible barriers as hard as rock to block opponent's attacks. It uses this to protect itself from humans and their Pokémon as it raids mines searching for gems to eat.

entry: 背上大帆反光时，会映出美丽、独特的光景。人们常拍成影片上网，也有人走遍世界，只为亲眼一见。
author: northkira
source: The massive sail on its back creates beautiful and unique light displays when light reflects off it. Often filmed and posted online, people travel across the world to see the light display for themselves.

entry: 在它们栖居的冻原上，一团翻滚的寒雾，常预示着这些宝可梦正在靠近。它们张口吐息，就能将大多数猎物冻得结结实实，再用强大的双颚，瞬间压碎。
author: infinex21
source: A rolling cloud of freezing mist is oft a harbinger of the advance of these Pokémon within the tundra they call home. They can freeze most prey solid with a breath loosed by their maws and instantly crush them with their mighty jaws.

entry: POKENAME不断追猎，造出如极光般的极寒急流。水生宝可梦若不慎游入，可能冷得无法动弹。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME creates freezing jetstreams that closely resemble auroras as it relentlessly chases its prey. Water Pokémon who unknowingly swim into its jetstream may become immobilized by the cold.

entry: POKENAME住在最高峰，召来暴雪幕环绕家园。巨吼能冻住入侵者，转瞬将其掀下山。
author: lasercraft32
source: POKENAME lives atop the highest peaks, summoning a veil of blizzards to surround its home. Its mighty roar can freeze intruders, launching them off the mountain in an instant.

entry: POKENAME被困在冰山深处，完全无法收集光。它会从手臂上的菱形晶体，对一切不认识的东西发射极光束。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME are found deep inside icebergs, completely trapped inside and unable to gather any light. It uses the diamond-shaped crystals on its arms to fire Aurora Beam at anything it doesn't recognize.

entry: POKENAME见其他生物太热，会用褶饰扇凉。有时太热心，扇得过多，反将对方冻成冰块。
author: sk372
source: If another creature appears to be overheating, POKENAME will fan them with its frills to cool them down. It sometimes gets overzealous, flapping too much and freezing the other creature solid.

entry: POKENAME夜里游荡荒凉冰原，帮助遭遇突发暴雪的旅人。它借身上晶刺造冰梁，搭建临时庇护所。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME wanders through the desolate frozen steppes at night, coming to the aid of travelers caught in sudden snowstorms. From the crystal spikes on its body, it can forge icy beams that it uses to build makeshift shelters.

entry: 研究者推测，POKENAME的样子，可能最接近远古冰雪巨龙。嘹亮叫声，最远五英里也能听见。
author: chibitales
source: Researchers theorize that POKENAME's appearance may be the closest to what Aurorus looked like in the ancient past. Their bellowing cries can be heard up to five miles away.

entry: POKENAME爪牙由钻石构成，能攀冰、刺穿最硬外皮，是凶猛顽强的猎手。吃饱后，就找向阳处，暖暖睡一觉。
author: laughing_dan
source: POKENAME's claw and fangs are made of diamond, allowing it to climb up frozen surfaces and puncture the hardest of hides, making it a ferociously unyielding predator. When it's fed, POKENAME will find a place in the sun for a delightful warm nap.

entry: POKENAME头顶极坚实的冰晶，让头锤威力强大。胜利后得意嚎叫，背上褶饰翻动，在身后形成闪光幕。
author: sk372
source: An extremely solid ice crystal on POKENAME's head gives it a very strong Headbutt attack. When it lets out a triumphant howl after winning a battle, the frills on its back flutter and create a shimmering veil behind it.

entry: POKENAME只在弦月之夜现身。滑过寒空时，双翼落下细冰晶，微微闪亮。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME appears only on nights with a quarter moon. As it glides through the chilly air, its wings shed fine ice crystals that sparkle faintly as they fall.

entry: POKENAME磨牙时，额头宝石强光闪耀，周围出现浓厚极光。这很适合分散注意、遮住身形，帮助它逃离天敌。
author: sk372
source: When POKENAME grinds its teeth, the jewel on its forehead glows bright and casts a thick aurora around it. This works excellently as a distraction that can help mask POKENAME's form and make it easier to escape incoming predators.

entry: 神奥各地的冰淇淋甜点，常用POKENAME的蘑菇块。甜美菌肉能衬出周围滋味，让点心绵滑，却带鲜香。
author: .izik
source: Chunks of POKENAME's mushroom are used in ice cream-based desserts throughout the Sinnoh region. The sweet flesh amplifies surrounding flavors, resulting in a creamy yet savory treat.

entry: POKENAME住在极寒陆地，调动力量，华美颈帆就亮起。捕猎时，远程以冰冻光束冻结，再用硬爪打碎身体。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME inhabits extremely cold terrestrial habitats. Its beautiful sails glow brightly whenever it channels its power. It hunts by freezing prey solid with an Ice Beam from afar, then shattering their bodies with its hard claws.

entry: POKENAME住在遥远北方的雪林，体色随情绪变化。赤手触碰身体，很可能冻伤。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME lives in snowy forests far to the north. Its beautiful colors shift in hue depending on what it is feeling, and touching its body with a bare hand will likely cause frostbite.

entry: POKENAME用体上晶体射出鲜艳彩光，提醒同伴危险将近。脾气有些傲，也常低估敌人。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME emits beams of vivid, colorful light from the crystals on its body to warn its companions of imminent danger. Its somewhat arrogant temperament often leads it to underestimate its opponents.

entry: POKENAME昵称“冰之指挥家”，挥杖便能造闪亮极光。人们认为，群体用这些表演，教幼崽野外求生；极少给人类表演。
author: chibitales
source: Nicknamed the Maestro of Ice, POKENAME creates beautiful, twinkling auroras using its wand. It's thought that groups use these shows to teach their young survival skills in the wild. They rarely perform for humans.

entry: POKENAME只需精准挥杖几下，就能造出复杂冰构造。有个童话说，它为想赴舞会的女孩，做过冰礼服与马车。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME can conjure up intricate ice structures with just a few precise waves of its wand. One fairy tale tells of an POKENAME creating a dress and carriage of ice for a girl wishing to go to a ball.

entry: POKENAME会造魔法冰分散注意，同时将对手痛打在地。冰也有助于破开坚甲，不过通常拳头就够用了。
author: weirdmageddonprepper_93813
source: POKENAME creates magical ice as a distraction as it beats its opponent into the ground. The ice can also help break through tougher armor, though its punches tend to do the trick.

entry: POKENAME飞过冻原，留下一团团冰寒雾气。冷雾为超凡外貌更添几分神秘，所经之处都留霜路。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME leaves puffs of ice-cold mist as it flies over tundras. This chilling trail adds to its otherworldly appearance, creating a frosty path wherever it goes.

entry: POKENAME滑过冰山峰旁，尾部流出寒雾。飞越地形时，身后便结出道道霜迹。
author: .izik
source: A freezing mist flows from POKENAME's tail as it glides near icy mountain peaks. Trails of frost form in its wake as it soars over the terrain.

entry: POKENAME会挖穿雪山，无意引发雪崩。在它出没的地区登山，被列为极限运动。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME are known to burrow through snowy mountains, unintentionally causing avalanches. Mountain climbing in areas with POKENAME is classified as an extreme sport.

entry: POKENAME头痛得太厉害，就从身体放出猛烈暴雪。为了缓解，会用额头宝石冻住头顶，减轻疼痛。
author: santon5512
source: If POKENAME's headaches become too painful, they will release violent blizzards from their bodies. To combat this, they use the gem on their foreheads to freeze the tops of their heads, easing the pain.

entry: 据说，POKENAME清晨漫游冻原，每道脚印都冒出蒸气，遮住它的身影。
author: bitterchemicalhaze
source: POKENAME is said to roam the tundra in the early morning, leaving steam with each footprint that obscures it from vision.

entry: 最初从冰中发现POKENAME时，人们估计它已被困100年。证据表明，这期间大脑仍在发育。
author: incognito1234
source: When POKENAME was first found in ice, it was estimated to have been trapped for 100 years. Evidence shows its brain still developed during this time.

entry: POKENAME佩着镶晶体的腰带，调节巨力与冷气。人们相信，它的披风或曾启发早期人类，绘出最初的星图。
author: wickedwiccan
source: POKENAME sports a belt adorned with crystals, which regulate both its immense strength and the cold air it exudes. It is believed that POKENAME's cape may have inspired early humans to create the first star charts.

entry: POKENAME游泳时，褶饰留下闪亮冰晶轨迹，宛如游在星海。种群过大，会使湖泊逐渐冻结。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME frills leave trails of glittering ice crystals in the water as they swim, making it appear as though POKENAME are swimming through a starscape. Large populations of POKENAME can cause lakes to gradually freeze over.

entry: 会疾驰着穿越森林与湖泊，冻结沿途的一切。古代的描绘中，它横渡大海，将整片浪涛化作寒冰。
author: capwolfbane
source: This Pokémon races across forests and lakes, freezing everything in its path. Ancient depictions show it crossing the sea, turning whole waves to ice.

entry: POKENAME从嘴喷细冰末，以闪光图案互相沟通。餐馆很喜欢用它帮忙，许多甜点，都拿这些粉状冰作基底。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME spray a fine powdered ice from their mouths, creating glittering displays to communicate with one another. They are a popular Pokémon to employ in restaurants, with many deserts using their powdered ice as the base for desserts.

entry: POKENAME壳上宝石，能奇特地冷却周围空气。炮口不断排出水蒸气，在冷空气中反光，映出美丽极光图案。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The shells of POKENAME are studded with gemstones that have a unique chilling effect on the air around them. Their cannons exude a constant stream of water vapour that reflects light in beautiful auroral patterns due to the chilled air around them.

entry: POKENAME是勇敢的小家伙，从不临阵逃走。害怕时，背上种子会产生发麻孢子，可仍会坚持打到精疲力竭。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are brave little creatures that never run away from a fight. The bulb on their back produces numbing spores whenever the are scared, but they will always fight until they are exhausted.

entry: POKENAME在尾巴里藏骨头，偶尔取出啃啃。其他宝可梦想偷，就会遭它使出猛烈吼叫，吓得退开。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME stashes bones in its tail, occasionally taking them out to nibble on. If another Pokémon attempts to steal its bones, it lets out a violent Roar to scare them away.

entry: POKENAME不停锻炼，维持最佳体能。它随身绑着临时重物，战斗时卸下，速度便会大增。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME trains relentlessly to keep itself in top physical condition. It wears makeshift weights on its body that it can remove in battle for a massive boost in speed.

entry: POKENAME精神坚定，性情友好，被广泛视为初学拳击者的理想伙伴。
author: ichosuzu
source: With its unwavering spirit and friendly nature, POKENAME is widely regarded as an ideal partner for prospective boxers.

entry: 这些宝可梦性情友好，进化路线又多样，很受新手训练家喜爱。POKENAME会成群用坚硬如岩石的爪子划树，标记领地，再一起嚎叫，宣示存在。
author: chibitales
source: These Pokémon are popular among new Trainers for their friendliness and variety of evolutions. Packs of POKENAME will use their rock solid claws to mark trees within their territory and howl together to assert their presence.

entry: POKENAME坐在喜爱的山丘、崖顶，对太阳或月亮嚎叫。可两者同时出现，就会犹豫、慌张，不知该对谁叫。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME sit atop their favorite hilltops and cliffs, looking skyward and howling at the sun or moon. If both are visible at the same time, POKENAME will become indecisive and panic, unsure which celestial body they should howl at.

entry: POKENAME个头小，却坚韧，咬力也强。外表虽蓬松，毛下却藏着锐利岩刺，摸背很危险。
author: .jerden
source: Despite its small size, POKENAME is tough and has a powerful bite. Although it looks fluffy, it has sharp, rocky spikes beneath the fur, making it dangerous to stroke its back.

entry: POKENAME满嘴锋利石牙，颚力太强，牙常卡在咬住的物体里。好在牙齿即使掉落，也很快会长新。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's mouth is full of sharp stone teeth. Its jaws are so powerful that these fangs frequently get stuck inside things it bites, but any teeth that are lost will quickly be replaced.

entry: POKENAME全身覆着粗硬岩鳞。必须教它别以咬表达亲近，否则强颚与石牙，很容易意外造成重伤。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's body is covered in rugged, rocky scales. They must be trained not to express affection by biting, as their powerful jaws and sharp stony teeth can cause serious injury by accident.

entry: POKENAME友好，常住在人家附近的树上。它会学邻居的作息，总知道何时最可能有空，适合去玩。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a friendly creature often residing in trees near to human domiciles. It learns the daily schedule of those nearby, so it always knows when someone is most likely free for it to visit and play with.

entry: POKENAME喜欢用羊毛裹住别人，亲昵依偎。但毛中尖锐的石块可能会不小心伤到对方。
author: toxicrown
source: POKENAME love to cuddle people in their wool, but the jagged stones in their coats can cause them to accidentally hurt those they snuggle with.

entry: POKENAME通常在岩地筑巢，也会进城镇吃垃圾。它用毛中石块，在进食处周围布隐形岩，赶走天敌。
author: santon5512
source: While POKENAME typically make their dens in rocky terrain, they will wander into civilization to consume trash. Using the rocks tucked in their fur, they lay out Stealth Rock around where they are eating, keeping predators at bay.

entry: POKENAME友好，每天只需少量日光与水，是年幼训练家很好的首只宠物。高兴时，头顶叶片会快速颤动。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is friendly and needs only a small amount of sunlight and water daily to survive, making it an excellent first pet for young Trainers. The leaves on its head twitch rapidly when it is happy.

entry: POKENAME害怕时，会用尾拍地，鳃也发抖。最好别在此时靠近，它会将冰冷水泼向自认的威胁。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: When POKENAME is scared, it thumps its tail against the ground while its gills quiver. Approaching one when they are in this state is not advised, as they have been known to drench perceived threats in ice-cold water.

entry: 傍晚，POKENAME随群穿过林冠。发现猎物，便齐声嚎叫，再使出岩石封锁。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME flies with its flock through forest canopies at dusk. Upon spotting prey, they howl in unison before striking with Rock Tomb.

entry: POKENAME嗅觉惊人，连20英里开外的树果也闻得到。它通常把果埋进地里，可有时会忘了埋在哪里。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME have an amazing sense of smell, able to detect berries from over 20 miles away. They will usually bury their berries in the ground but will sometimes forget where they buried them.

entry: POKENAME由熔融岩石构成，需要吃小石子补充。可体表恰好冷到，人能触碰而不灼伤。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's body is made of molten stone, which it needs to replenish by eating small pebbles. However, the surface of its body is just cool enough that people can touch it without getting burnt.

entry: 受到稀树草原其他群居宝可梦的影响，POKENAME好斗、领地意识强。若护不住自己的蛋，就连它自己也不会被那些宝可梦放过。这份凶猛，也让其他宝可梦不敢轻易打扰。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are aggressive and territorial due to the influence of other pack Pokémon in the savannah and are not spared if they fail to defend their Eggs from them. Their fierce nature causes other Pokémon to leave them alone.

entry: POKENAME随群滚过丘陵。夜里会围成圆圈，朝月亮嚎叫，声音和谐无比。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME rolls through hills alongside its pack. At night, they form a circle and howl at the moon in perfect harmony.

entry: POKENAME像电脑上某热门游戏的可执行文件。点击后，会发出像岩狗狗叫声的吠叫、呜咽。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME resemble an executable file of a popular game found on PCs. When clicked, they produce barks and whines that resemble the cry of a Rockruff.

entry: POKENAME能改变岩石般的身体纹理，模仿游戏图标。它借此引起训练家注意，骗对方离开家。
author: blaizegamer
source: POKENAME has the ability to alter the rocky texture of its body to mimic the icons of video games. It uses this ability to gain the attention of its Trainer and trick them into leaving their home.

entry: POKENAME的蓬松尾巴极软，也很敏感。它会躲雨，毛没干就不肯动。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's fluffy tail is incredibly soft but sensitive. It hides from the rain, refusing to move until its fur is dry.

entry: POKENAME爱抛接小石头，常表演给喜欢的孩子看。可谁想打断，就会被石子砸，直到离开。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME loves to juggle small stones and will often show off to young children it likes. However, if someone tries to interrupt it, it will pelt them with stones until they leave.

entry: POKENAME会啃下岩块，带回巢穴作食物。可进食时太兴奋，偶尔取下太多，连自己也没察觉，结果造成岩石崩落。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME gnaw away at rock formations to bring back to their dens for food. Unfortunately, their enthusiasm during their feasts occasionally results in them taking more than they realize and causing rockslides.

entry: POKENAME夜里嗅寻根与小宝可梦吃。耳尖弯曲，挖掘时，能挡住泥土碎屑，不落进眼和内耳。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME sniffs out roots and small Pokémon to feed on during the night. The tips of its ears are curved to keep dirt and debris out of its eyes and inner ear while digging.

entry: POKENAME天生优雅，又能共情、读懂观众，很受丰缘选美比赛欢迎。知道观众想看什么，就远比竞争者占优。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are popular Pokémon for Hoenn's beauty contests thanks to both their natural grace and their empathic ability to read the crowd. Knowing what their audience wants to see gives them a huge advantage over their competitors.

entry: POKENAME友好忠诚，似乎喜爱遇见的几乎所有生物。善良本性，也常让它收养野外遇到的岩狗狗。
author: sk372
source: Friendly and loyal, POKENAME seems to love nearly every living creature it comes across. Its kind nature often leads to it adopting a wild Rockruff it meets up with in the wild.

entry: POKENAME察觉危险，就低吼提醒同群。若被逼得太紧，会注入毒液，造成疼痛水疱。
author: .izik
source: When sensing danger, POKENAME growls to alert its pack. If pressed, it injects a venom that causes painful blistering.

entry: POKENAME夜间筑坝，精准得令人吃惊。完工后跑上坝顶，在月下骄傲嚎叫。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME builds dams at night with surprising precision. Once finished, it runs to the top and howls proudly under the moon.

entry: 遇见悼念已故岩狗狗的训练家，POKENAME会窥见对方与爱宠的珍贵回忆，再试着重现。
author: dodoowner_
source: When POKENAME encounters Trainers mourning their deceased Rockruff, it gazes into their cherished memories with their pet and attempts to recreate them.

entry: POKENAME住在水分稀少的地方。食谱里包括千香果，帮助它保持干燥。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME live in habitats where there is little moisture. Part of their diet consists of Passho Berries, which help keep their body dry.

entry: 有些文化曾将POKENAME视为失去伙伴的预兆。其实，它会聚向悲伤者，带来安慰与陪伴。
author: mistymagius
source: Some cultures used to believe POKENAME were omens of the loss of a companion. However, POKENAME actually flock to those who are grieving to give comfort and companionship.

entry: POKENAME的毛皮里藏着许多小石子般坚硬的尖刺。尖刺带有使人麻木的毒素，战斗时，它会通过摩擦对手来下毒。
author: celio_0230
source: POKENAME carries many hard, pebble-like quills within its fur. These quills carry a numbing toxin, which it uses in combat by rubbing up against the opponent.

entry: POKENAME心太软，只肯嬉闹打架，战况一激烈，就更想退走。犬类宝可梦会被刀刃吸引，忍不住舔咬，令它颇为苦恼。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is too gentle at heart to do anything more than play-fighting, preferring to retreat if a battle gets too rough for its liking. Canine Pokémon are attracted to its blade, compelled to lick and chew on it, much to its dismay.

entry: POKENAME勇猛地保护训练家，如同忠心的护卫犬。只要察觉威胁，全身倒刺就会齐齐竖起，准备迎敌护主。
author: celio_0230
source: POKENAME protects its Trainer with fierce bravery, much like a loyal guard dog. If it senses a threat, all of its barbs bristle up at once as it prepares to protect its Trainer.

entry: POKENAME在巢口造幻象石墙，保护同群。维持幻象耗尽能量，因此必须长时间休息。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME protects the rest of its pack by creating illusory stone walls at the entrance of its den. Maintaining the illusion drains all its energy, so it must rest for long periods.

entry: POKENAME极易兴奋，会追自己的触须，或其他移动物。连打架也更重好玩，而非取胜，不过仍会被引得咬住敌人。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are very excitable Pokémon who will chase their own feelers or other moving objects. Even during battle, they are less concerned with winning than they are with having fun; they will be enticed to bite onto their foes nonetheless.

entry: 这位持矛斗士亲热，却有些古怪，常在最奇怪的地方睡觉。X光显示，铠甲下仍是岩狗狗短粗的四足身体，似乎正驾驶着整副铠甲。
author: bobosmith01
source: A spear fighter that has an affectionate yet peculiar personality. It naps in the oddest spots. X-Rays have shown that underneath the armor is still the stubby, four-legged body of a Rockruff, seemingly piloting the suit.

entry: 这位持矛斗士亲热，却有些古怪，常在最奇怪的地方睡觉。X光显示，铠甲下仍是岩狗狗短粗的四足身体，似乎正驾驶着整副铠甲。
author: bobosmith01
source: A spear fighter that has an affectionate yet peculiar personality. It naps in the oddest spots. X-Rays have shown that underneath the armor is still the stubby, four-legged body of a Rockruff, seemingly piloting the suit.

entry: POKENAME的几个头，即使训得好，也很少和睦，总为点心、玩具吵。它是从收容所领养后，最常被退回的宠物之一。
author: milchik
source: Even if trained properly, this Pokémon's heads rarely make peace wth one another, constantly bickering over treats and toys. POKENAME is among the most returned pets when it comes to adopting Pokémon from shelters.

entry: POKENAME很受孩子喜爱，忠诚无比。训练家一受威胁，毛便亮得耀眼，发出警告。
author: brapollo
source: POKENAME has become a popular Pokémon for children. It is incredibly loyal, and when its Trainer is threatened, its fur glows brilliantly in warning.

entry: POKENAME虽忠于训练家，却不适合作宠物。颈边利石会让被刮者遭高压电击；同样，也很容易训练成优秀守卫。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME make for poor pets, as while they are loyal to their Trainer, the sharp rocks around their neck deliver a high-voltage shock to anyone they scratch. For the same reason, they are easy to train to be excellent guards.

entry: POKENAME亲热，爱跳起来和训练家拥抱。可体型虽小，身体却密实沉重，毛皮质地又像钢丝绒。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are very affectionate and love to jump up for cuddles with their Trainers. Unfortunately, they are also very dense and heavy for their size, and their fur has the consistency of wire wool.

entry: POKENAME睡觉时，本能地变成不起眼石头。野外虽能避天敌，却常让训练家在午睡后，到处找消失的伙伴。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME instinctively transform into unremarkable stones when sleeping. While effective at keeping wild POKENAME safe from predators, it can prove to be inconvenient for Trainers who search high and low for their missing Pokémon after naptime.

entry: POKENAME藏在洞穴、树间，等有人毫无防备地扔下东西。随后就冲去捡起，送还原主。
author: laughing_dan
source: POKENAME hides in caves and trees, waiting for an unsuspecting person to throw something away. It then takes off to fetch it and brings it back to the owner.

entry: 会在岩石上刻出深深的划痕来标记领地。POKENAME经验越丰富，獠牙上的划痕与缺口也越多。
author: soup1900
source: They mark their territory by leaving deep cuts into rocks. The more experience POKENAME has, the more scratched and chipped its tusks are.

entry: POKENAME的毛覆着矿物，连部分最强攻击也能抵御。矿物种类，反映着领地里的岩矿。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME's fur is coated with minerals, making it resistant to some of the strongest attacks thrown at it. The types of minerals in its fur reflect those found in its territory.

entry: POKENAME周围常有许多钢属性宝可梦，于是吃霹霹果，减轻钢招式的疼痛。可身上倒刺锐利，训练家滑倒在它造的冰上，就常不慎受伤。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME live in places with lots of Steel-type Pokémon around them, so they eat Babiri Berries to make Steel-type attacks hurt less. The barbs on their body are quite sharp and often accidentally hurt Trainers that slip on the ice they make.

entry: 午夜过后，POKENAME会从沼泽朝月嚎叫。一旦被发现，就躲入中空树桩，避开视线。
author: .izik
source: From within the swamps, POKENAME howls at the moon once the midnight hour passes. If seen, it disappears into hollow stumps to avoid detection.

entry: POKENAME很适合看家。超声吠叫，会让听者方向感大乱，能有效赶走、协助制服窃贼。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME makes for an excellent home guard. It can bark at an ultrasonic frequency that causes extreme disorientation in those who hear it, making it very effective at deterring or helping detain burglars.

entry: POKENAME自古与人同住，担任夜间看门犬。发现可疑之物，就大声嚎叫，吓跑敌人。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME has lived with people since ancient times, acting as nocturnal guard dogs. When it spots something suspicious, it lets loose a loud howl that scares off enemies.

entry: POKENAME爱冒险，总探索新地方。家养时需定期梳理，因为翼上绒毛会在途中沾满泥与碎屑。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is an adventurous sort, always exploring new locales. As a pet, it requires regular grooming, as the fluff on its wings gathers up lots of dirt and detritus from its adventures.

entry: 它喜怒无常，对亲近者以外的生物都很危险。可一旦获得信任，POKENAME也会成为忠诚伙伴。
author: larky_
source: It's fickle and highly dangerous to anyone that isn't a close friend. However, POKENAME makes for a loyal companion once you gain its trust.

entry: POKENAME忠心守卫训练家，从地下冒出，咬住潜在威胁者的脚跟。
author: craigprime
source: POKENAME are known to loyally defend their Trainer, emerging from the ground to bite the heels of any potential threats.

entry: 成簇毛发保护POKENAME敏感部位，免受风雨。蘑菇可以安全吃，不过奇怪地，会让食客在之后数日毛发生长过旺。
author: sk372
source: Tufts of fur keep the more sensitive parts of POKENAME's body safe from the elements. Its mushrooms are safe to consume, but doing so strangely causes excessive hair growth in the consumer for a few days afterward.

entry: 无论追捕猎物还是巡视领地，POKENAME的三颗头总在争吵不休与默契配合之间来回转变。
author: kitarchen
source: The three heads of POKENAME are constantly in a flux between bickering and uncanny coordination as they hunt down prey or patrol their territory.

entry: POKENAME亲热又贪玩，会跳向训练家，缠着要关注、抚摸。可总低估自己的体型与重量，可能不慎压伤训练家。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are affectionate and playful, bounding up to their Trainers and insisting on attention and fuss. They constantly underestimate how large and heavy they are and can accidentally injure their Trainers with their weight.

entry: 休息时，握着POKENAME颈边的一块岩石，就会感到爱与安慰。短暂黄昏里，毛发会闪光；可那时没有其他现象，原因至今不明。
author: soup1900
source: The rocky pieces from POKENAME's neck give feelings of love and comfort to anyone holding one while they rest. During the short hours of dusk, its fur glistens. However, it is unknown why, since nothing happens during that time period.

entry: POKENAME坚壳暖心，在年长训练家中很常见。常能见它主动充当凳子，让训练家坐。
author: theaceofhearts0306
source: Common among elderly trainers, POKENAME are known for their tough shells and warm hearts. They can often be seen volunteering as a stool for their trainers.

entry: POKENAME住在南瓜田，夜里登上最大南瓜嚎叫。它警觉留意拾荒者，靠太近就使出咬碎。
author: .izik
source: Living in pumpkin patches, POKENAME howls atop the largest pumpkin at night. It watches vigilantly for scavengers, attacking with a Crunch if they get too close.

entry: 这些幼犬由同一本体分离，想法都相同。可脑中只有争夺支配权，常彼此打架，长大后更严重。没有咬痕的POKENAME，非常罕见。
author: periperi_chicken
source: These pups all think alike, having split from one original body. However, they only think about dominance, leading to frequent fighting between them, which only worsens as they grow. Finding a POKENAME without bite marks is a rarity.

entry: POKENAME爱参加宝可梦对战，因为喜欢娱乐观众。尤其爱扮弱者，从几乎必败的局面，勉强争得胜利。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME loves participating in Pokémon Battles because they enjoy entertaining audiences. They particularly enjoy playing the role of underdog because they can eke out victory from almost certain defeat.

entry: 传说，战士曾用POKENAME袭击北方村落。故事描述，它以尾上利岩，切开村门。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Legends tell of warriors using POKENAME to raid villages in northern regions. These legends describe POKENAME using the sharp rocks in their tails to slice through village gates.

entry: POKENAME极忠于训练家，可运动不足，就容易咬人。幼年个体会与同群伙伴碰角，嬉闹切磋。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME is very loyal to its trainer, but is prone to biting if it doesn't get enough exercise. Young POKENAME playfights by knocking its horn against other youngsters in its pack.

entry: POKENAME的两个头都爱被摸，争抢训练家关注。它喜欢抛接游戏，行动灵活，追投出的球时，时速最高可达60英里。
author: katieplaysgames
source: A highly affectionate Pokémon, the two heads of POKENAME each love receiving pets and will compete for the attention of their Trainer. They love playing catch and are highly mobile, able to sprint after a thrown ball at up to 60 miles per hour.

entry: 这些宝可梦贪玩，会主动凑近船只，讨人关注。钓客却很头疼，因为它们常把甩竿当成你丢我捡的游戏，立刻带回钓饵。
author: joeofthealps
source: These Pokémon are very playful and will go right up to seacraft for attention. They can be very frustrating for anglers, as they will often think their casts are attempts to play fetch and bring their lures right back.

entry: POKENAME收集石头，装饰成自身模样。石头聚在一起，就能释放超能力。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME collects stones and decorates them to imitate itself. When the stones gather together, it can unleash psychic abilities.

entry: POKENAME静伏冬雪下，等迁徙群经过。惊角鹿的蹄一碰，就触发进化，让它猎得数月来第一餐。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME lies motionless under the winter snows, waiting for migrating herds to come by. When the hooves of Stantler jostle it, Evolution is triggered, and it seizes its first meal in months.

entry: 太阳只要在天，POKENAME就会狂怒。唯有夜幕降临，才表现出些许平静、镇定。
author: sk372
source: As long as the sun is up, POKENAME will be raging. Only once the night comes will it behave with any semblance of calm and composure.

entry: 这些宝可梦敢战更大的敌人，用敏捷与颈边利岩，慢慢消耗。成熟后，整群会出发寻找进化石，一起进化。
author: chibitales
source: These Pokémon will take on foes larger than themselves, using their agility and sharp rocks around their neck to whittle down the opponent. When they reach maturity, the pack will journey to find evolution stones and evolve together.

entry: POKENAME根据吃下的资料，在体表显示变化图像。进食时发出有节奏的哔声，像远处嚎叫。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME displays shifting images across its body based on the data it consumes. As it feeds, it emits rhythmic beeps resembling distant howls.

entry: POKENAME极难寻找，沙漠环境太适合藏身。叫声仅有寥寥几次记录，录音也只捕到峡谷里的回响。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME are incredibly rare to find, as their desert habitats are perfect for hiding. Their loud cries have only been documented a few times, with the recordings only capturing their cries echoing throughout canyons.

entry: POKENAME冷静谨慎，捕猎时藏在水下或岩后。猎物一近，便扑出，以锋利岩爪、岩牙迅速袭击。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME is calm and cautious and will conceal itself underwater or behind rocks when hunting. As soon as prey gets close, POKENAME will pounce, quickly attacking with its sharp, rocky claws and fangs.

entry: POKENAME以强拳击碎巢洞巨石，为同群腾出空间。冬月睡觉时，会紧挤一起保温。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its strong fists to break boulders in its cave den, creating more space for its pack. They sleep in tight groups to conserve warmth during winter months.

entry: POKENAME很擅长牧咩利羊，常被用来看守羊栏、聚回走失的羊。
author: musicsheep.
source: POKENAME are great at herding Mareep. They are often used to guard Mareep pens and herd up lost Mareep.

entry: POKENAME飞过山地时，嗡嗡作响。天敌靠同群太近，就会被迅速使出的冲岩击倒。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME buzzes while flying through mountainous regions. It uses a swift Accelerock to take out predators that get too close to its pack.

entry: POKENAME若预见恶行，就会凶狠吠叫。咬力很强，连石头也能咬断。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME barks aggressively if its precognitive abilities detect evil actions. It can bite with enough force to break stone.

entry: POKENAME自古帮人，常作狩猎伙伴。如今，也被训练用手完成各种事务，甚至帮助难以自行穿衣的人。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME have been known to help humans since ancient times, often acting as hunting companions. In the present, they are trained to use their hands to aid in a variety of tasks, even helping people who may struggle to dress themselves.

entry: POKENAME将符文刻进石头，引导魔力。每日正午，摆符文石成圈，自己浮在中央蓄能。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME channels its magical power by carving runes into stones. At noon each day, it arranges its runestones in a circle and floats in the circle's center to charge its power.

entry: POKENAME看似毛绒的尖刺，其实是硬石，每根都渗绿毒。毒性强得足以击昏吼鲸王。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's furry spikes are actually hard stones, each one leaking green venom. The venom is strong enough to knock out a Wailord.

entry: 只要养育得当，POKENAME对训练家就忠诚至极。战斗时，凭出色的波导操控，以意念驱石砸向敌人。
author: blaizegamer
source: If POKENAME are properly raised, they will show utmost loyalty to their Trainers. When engaged in battle, they use their incredible control in aura to telepathically pelt their foes with rocks.

entry: POKENAME背上岩构造，是夜行宝可梦白天的便携庇护所。谁威胁乘客，它就嚎叫、放孢子，让所有吸入者沉睡。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: The rocky structures on the backs of POKENAME act as portable shelters for nocturnal Pokémon during the day. If anyone threatens the safety of their passengers, POKENAME howl as they release spores that ensure all who inhale them sleep soundly.

entry: POKENAME虽然友善，探索、玩耍和自卫时却天生习惯用咬的。因此，训练时需要十分用心。
author: cristata
source: While friendly, biting is a natural way for POKENAME to explore, play, and defend themselves. As such, they need to be trained very carefully.

entry: POKENAME找同群切磋，测试力量。对练时，会以角作出骑枪比武般的动作。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME picks fights with others from its pack to test its strength. It performs jousting motions with its horn while sparring.

entry: POKENAME住在高大岩山，喜爱高海拔的宁静。性情本平和，可领地一受威胁，就失控狂乱，毁掉沿途一切，直到疲惫。
author: theartemis1
source: POKENAME makes its home in tall, rocky mountains, finding solace in high-altitude environments. Though calm by nature, it enters an uncontrollable frenzy if its territory is threatened, destroying everything in its wake until it eventually tires.

entry: 它绕敌奔跑，飘动触须让对方着迷、迷惑。触须尖硬如岩，能准确击敌。
author: infinex21
source: Its fluttering feelers entrance and befuddle foes as it runs circles around them. The tips of its feelers are as tough as rock and are used to deliver precise attacks.

entry: POKENAME操控时间的力量，潜藏腿上纵横沟壑，只用来加速操岩。一只，就能把任何沙暴，变成卷着锋利巨石的毁灭龙卷。
author: guacamole_dog
source: A POKENAME's control over time lies dormant in the ravines stitched across its legs, only being used to accelerate its manipulation of rocks. It just takes one to turn any sandstorm into a destructive tornado of sharp boulders.

entry: POKENAME尾尖的毛硬如铁。它边嚎叫、边用尾拍洞壁，将猎物引到空处。
author: .izik
source: The fur at the tip of POKENAME's tail is as hard as iron. It slaps it against cave walls while howling to draw prey out into the open.

entry: POKENAME平常四足行走，交战才以后腿站起。尾部发电器官为肌肉强力供能，让动作更快、力量更强。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME normally walks on all fours, riding onto its back legs when engaging in combat. An electricity-generating organ in its tail supercharged its muscles to give it faster movement and greater strength.

entry: POKENAME从头上孔洞发射强岩，速度不断增加，痛打敌人。尾一拍地，又在四周撒下不易察觉的小石片，伤到偷近的粗心对手。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME pummels foes by launching powerful rocks at accelerating speeds at them using the holes on its head. By smashing its tail on the ground, it scatters small, hidden stone fragments around to hurt incautious foes that try to sneak up on it.

entry: 它食肉，眨眼就能击败鸟类宝可梦。无论俯冲衔住，还是以岩崩压下，单只就能逼退几乎所有飞行属性。成群POKENAME，会对生态产生不利影响。
author: bobosmith01
source: A carnivore that can defeat bird Pokémon in a blink of an eye. Whether dive bombed and snatched in their jaws or crushed under their Rock Slide, just one can make almost any Flying-type flee. A pack of POKENAME can adversely affect ecosystems.

entry: POKENAME轻声呜咽，借可怜外表讨同情。战斗时却截然不同，以鬃毛石刃，飞快劈击敌人。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME makes soft whimpering sounds, attempting to gain sympathy from others with its pitiful appearance. In combat, it acts very differently and will quickly slash foes using the stone blades in its mane.

entry: POKENAME放出电击前，会响亮地使出长嚎。打完却仰躺着，盼有人摸腹部。
author: .izik
source: Before unleashing an electrical attack, POKENAME will Howl loudly. After a fight, it lays on its back, hoping for belly rubs.

entry: POKENAME的泥水，让毛皮保持湿润。谁靠洞太近，就会遭精神能量轰击；每次出击，泥水也泛起涟漪。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's muddy water keeps its fur moist. It unleashes psychic blasts if anyone gets too close to its cave, the muddy water rippling with each blast.

entry: 沙漠地区常叫POKENAME“蒙面强盗”。白天藏在灼沙下，夜里靠条纹潜过训练家，偷背包里的东西。
author: ghostslythe
source: Commonly referred to as a Masked Bandit in desert regions, POKENAME spends the daytime camouflaged under burning sands. At night its stripes allow it to pass by Trainers stealthily, to steal from their backpacks.

entry: 据说，被夜行POKENAME长爪抓伤的人，死后会变成同类。满月时，群体悲声嚎叫，据说在悼念失去的白昼。
author: .realthree
source: It is said that those who are scratched by a nocturnal POKENAME's long claws will transform into one when they die. When the moon is full, POKENAME gather together and howl mournfully, supposedly in grief for the daylight they lost.

entry: POKENAME是坚定可靠的伙伴，也意外亲热。鬃毛里的石块毛绒绒的，柔软得伤不了谁。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME is a stalwart companion and surprisingly affectionate. The rocks in its mane are too plush to hurt anyone.

entry: 这双头宝可梦狡猾又快，心灵相连，再加上敏锐的眼、耳、鼻与利颚，什么也逃不掉！
author: wolfbrine
source: This two-headed Pokémon's cunning, speed, and linked minds ensure nothing escapes its keen eyes, ears, noses, and jaws!

entry: POKENAME被注入炽热太阳之力，成长快得惊人。鬃毛透出的光，据说能切开一切。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME has been imbued with the blazing power of the sun, allowing it to grow at an incredible rate. The shining light piercing from its mane is said to be able to cut through anything.

entry: POKENAME头毛看似软，却藏满利石。虽然牙也很锋锐，它仍爱扑向敌人，以石头般的头部冲撞。
author: st4rdustyugure
source: The fur on POKENAME's head may appear soft, but it is filled with sharp rocks. It uses it as a weapon, lunging at its enemies to headbutt them, even though it has pretty sharp fangs.

entry: POKENAME岩石般的毛皮，散出宜人蛋糕香。猎物被引进洞，便遭整群同时袭击。
author: .izik
source: A pleasant cakelike aroma wafts from POKENAME's rocky fur, attracting prey to its cave where its pack will attack in unison.

entry: POKENAME乐感敏锐，电台播音员、唱片骑师常选作伙伴。它偏爱磁带音乐，会送训练家一盒磁带，表示完全信任。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME possess a keen ear for music, prompting radio announcers and DJs to have them as their partner Pokémon. POKENAME prefer music from cassette tapes and will deliver one to their Trainer as a sign of complete trust.

entry: POKENAME以念力让石头浮起，掷向敌人。很少放弃交战，愿冒受伤风险，争取胜利。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME harnesses the power of its telekinesis to levitate and throw stones at its foes. It rarely gives up a fight, as it is willing to risk injury to secure victory.

entry: 矿工用POKENAME帮助挖掘，因为力气相当于两名工人。可惜，岩狗狗有时也会跟来，干扰工作。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Miners employ POKENAME to aid in excavation since their strength is equivalent to two workers. Unfortunately, Rockruff occasionally follow after POKENAME, interfering with work.

entry: POKENAME用四条岩臂英勇交战。坚爪能裂铁，强壮肌肉似乎永不疲倦。
author: fiordaliso
source: With its four rocky arms, POKENAME battles valiantly against its foes. Its tough claws can crack even iron, and its powerful muscles seem never to tire.

entry: POKENAME四条粗砺手臂，战斗时从不迟疑。锯齿爪能断金属，密实肌肉则以接连巨力，压倒敌人。
author: fiordaliso
source: The four rugged arms of POKENAME never hesitate in combat. Its jagged claws can fracture metal, and its dense muscles allow it to overpower opponents with relentless force.

entry: POKENAME毛茸茸的藤蔓散着宜人的零余果香。它把藤蔓垂在巢穴入口，将猎物引出，再使出藤鞭解决。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's furry vines waft a pleasant Chesto Berry scent. It dangles them over den entrances to lure prey out. Once exposed, it will dispatch the prey with a Vine Whip.

entry: POKENAME永远忠于训练家，听从每个命令。它用岩石打磨刀状角，保持锋利。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME is eternally loyal to its Trainer and will follow their every command. It keeps its knife-like horn sharp by scraping it against rocks.

entry: POKENAME的几颗头彼此争强，个个都想第一个接住抛来的球，或第一个在战斗中出手。好胜心让它莽撞固执，训练起来颇为棘手。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The heads of POKENAME are competitive with one another, each wanting to be the first to catch a thrown ball, or be the first to strike in a fight. Their competitiveness leads POKENAME to be reckless and headstrong, making them a challenge to train.

entry: POKENAME群体夜间徘徊，寻找恶作剧机会。发现独行人，就嚎叫吓其逃跑；等对方吓得够呛，再不知从哪冒出，咯咯笑着吓一跳。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME packs prowl through the night in search of chances for mischief. They find people walking alone at night, howling to scare them into running. Once the person is sufficiently scared, they appear from nowhere to startle them while cackling.

entry: POKENAME群体夜间徘徊，寻找恶作剧机会。它们爱追人，以响亮狂笑般的嚎声吓唬。虽然取乐于惊吓，却极少攻击。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME packs prowl through the night in search of chances for mischief. They take pleasure in chasing after people, spooking them with loud, cackling howls. Despite the joy they take in scaring people, they very rarely attack.

entry: POKENAME的大声嚎叫，能让人睡着。吃掉噩梦后，会高兴吠叫。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's loud howling can cause someone to fall asleep. It barks happily after eating a bad dream.

entry: POKENAME背上浓密的鬃毛下，藏着一颗小种子。种子很脆弱，厚毛既能抵御外来伤害，也能替它保暖。
author: sk372
source: Beneath the large mane of fur on POKENAME's back lies a small plant bulb. The bulb is fragile, so the heavy fur coat is there to protect it from outside harm as well as keep it warm.

entry: POKENAME全身覆着浓密而敏感的毛，帮助它在黑暗中辨别方向。毛尖带有刺激性毒素，能吓退捕食者；虽然看起来柔软，却不宜抚摸。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are covered in a thick coating of sensitive hairs that help them navigate in the dark. These hairs are tipped with an irritating poison to deter predators, and despite their soft appearance it is not advisable to stroke them.

entry: POKENAME在网络游戏里寻找强敌，利用对手代码的差异。现实中，卡片外观让敌人误以为安全，再跃出边框攻击，退往安全处。
author: pjporwoll
source: In cyberspace, POKENAME appears in games to seek tough foes and exploits their differing code. Outside cyberspace, its card-like appearance lulls foes into a false sense of security before it leaps out of the frame, attacks, and retreats to safety.

entry: 与多数超能力属性宝可梦不同，POKENAME在地上步行，沉重脚步，伴着地面震响。据说，肯出手时，就能预见数百种结局，闪电般避招，再以残酷斩击回应。
author: ghostslythe
source: Unlike most Psychic-types, POKENAME walks on the ground, its heavy footsteps echoing as the ground rumbles. It is said when it deigns to fight that it foresees hundreds of outcomes, dodges attacks lightning-fast and responds with brutal slashes.

entry: 傍晚一到，POKENAME就爱嚎整夜，让训练家无法安睡。只要仔细观察其他宝可梦，还能模仿外形与招式。
author: fiordaliso
source: As soon as evening arrives, POKENAME delights in howling through the whole night, leaving its Trainer no chance of peaceful rest. Watching another Pokémon closely enough allows it to mimic both its form and its moves.

entry: 这只宝可梦游泳灵巧，可离水后并不快。为了在陆地捕猎，POKENAME会用偶尔脱落的岩鳞，制成矛。
author: milchik
source: This Pokémon is a pretty agile swimmer but isn't very fast outside of water. To help itself with hunting on land, POKENAME crafts spears out of the rocky scales it occasionally sheds.

entry: POKENAME身体坚如岩，多数攻击打来，也只管继续进攻。只要够近，便双臂抓住猎物，用剃刀般利牙撕咬。
author: .jerden
source: With a body as solid as rock, POKENAME responds to most attacks by simply continuing to attack. As soon as it is close enough, it will seize prey with its arms and start tearing into it with its razor-sharp teeth.

entry: POKENAME夜里停在死树上，以出色视力扫描四周，再用岩崩制服卡拉卡拉等猎物。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME perches in dead trees at night, using its superior eyesight to scan regions. It uses Rock Slide to subdue prey like Cubone.

entry: POKENAME一察觉落石，就吐出厚网，将岩块固定，为同群争取逃生时间。
author: .izik
source: If POKENAME notices a rockslide, it spits out thick webbing to hold the rocks in place. This gives its pack time to flee.

entry: 月光最亮的夜里，POKENAME朝天空嚎叫。长嚎一整晚，黎明才跳回巢，白天休息。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME howl into the night sky when the moon shines brightest. When dawn comes after a long night of howling, they hop back into their nests to rest during the day.

entry: POKENAME通常只在满月、朔月出现。夜里朝天高呼，传说正是叫声，让月亮改变月相。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are usually only seen at either the full moon or the new moon. They make loud calls to the sky at night, and legends claim their cry causes the moon to change phases.

entry: POKENAME是凶猛猎手，翱翔夜空寻食。它会抓起大猎物，从崖边扔下，再降落领取战利品。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are vicious hunters, soaring through the night sky in search of prey. These Pokémon have been known to pick up larger prey and drop them off the side of cliffs, descending to claim their prize.

entry: POKENAME虽蓬松，毛下却藏着岩石般的尖刺。靠近猎物后，就用这些刺猛撞。
author: manofmasks
source: Although very fluffy, POKENAME has sharp, rock-like spines hidden underneath its fur. Once it gets close, it will slam into prey with said spines.

entry: POKENAME攻击时，不顾自身安危。夜间的高亢嚎声，周围数英里都听得见。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME will attack without regard for its own safety. At night, their high-pitched howl can be heard for miles around.

entry: POKENAME白天潜在水下耐心等待，夜里全力出击。训练家若被咬，得尽快送医，否则会开始无法控制地流口水。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME hides underwater during the day, patiently waiting. At night it strikes with its full power. If a Trainer is bitten by POKENAME, it is important to get them to hospital quickly, otherwise they will begin dribbling uncontrollably.

entry: POKENAME白天潜在水下耐心等待，夜里全力出击。身材虽小，一记头撞也能把敌人打飞。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME hides underwater during the day, patiently waiting. At night it strikes with its full power. Despite its small stature, a single headbutt can send its foe flying.

entry: POKENAME戒心很强，无法迅速与训练家亲近。陌生人想摸，就会遭到猛烈攻击。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME are very distrustful and are not able to quickly establish a bond with a Trainer. If someone POKENAME doesn't know attempts to pet them, they will aggressively attack the person.

entry: POKENAME天生的毛皮披风主要有两个作用：保暖，以及在冲向敌人时显得更有威慑力。
author: cristata
source: A POKENAME's natural fur cloak serves two main purposes: retaining warmth, and making them all the more intimidating as they charge at their foes.

entry: POKENAME天生的毛皮披风主要有两个作用：保暖，以及在冲向敌人时显得更有威慑力。
author: cristata
source: A POKENAME's natural fur cloak serves two main purposes: retaining warmth, and making them all the more intimidating as they charge at their foes.

entry: POKENAME从口中使出喷射火焰，石角便热得发红。深夜嚎叫，召集同伴，开始捕猎。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its stone horns glow red-hot whenever POKENAME unleashes its Flamethrower attack from its jaws. In the dead of night, it howls to summon its companions and begin the hunt.

entry: POKENAME固执，甚至不服管教，会挑战更大宝可梦，抢地盘、食物或地位。被打退只会让它更坚定，下次会更快卷土重来，手段也更狡猾。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME are obstinate if not unruly, picking fights with larger Pokémon to steal their territory, food, or status. Getting beaten back only strengthens POKENAME's resolve, coming back quicker and more guileful during their next assault.

entry: 农民总提防狡猾POKENAME。这夜行猎手，单只一晚，就能重创整群咩利羊。
author: banzai.exe
source: Farmers are always on the lookout for cunning POKENAME. As nocturnal predators, a single one can devastate a herd of Mareep overnight.

entry: POKENAME黑夜形态的叶片，看似枯萎，其实是石头。它以剃刀般锐利的延伸部位，劈击敌人四肢，使其动不了。
author: hypersonic06
source: The leaves POKENAME's midnight form possesses may seem wilted, but they are actually made of stone.  It uses these razor-sharp extensions to slash at the limbs of its enemies, immobilizing them.

entry: 满月时，POKENAME朝天大声嚎叫。声音所及的电脑，程序都会在嚎声期间出错。
author: .izik
source: During a full moon, POKENAME howls loudly at the sky. Any computer within range of the sound experiences glitches in its installed programs for the duration of the howl.

entry: POKENAME的毛坚硬如岩。捕猎时便迎头冲撞、奋力劈击，力道足以砍倒树木。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME's fur is as tough as rock, which they use while hunting by charging headlong at opponents and slashing with enough force to cut down trees.

entry: POKENAME热切想完成训练家吩咐，凭心灵感应，对方还没开口，就先办好。坚贞忠诚，让需要可靠朋友的训练家很喜爱。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are eager to do the bidding of their Trainer and rely on their telepathy to complete tasks before their Trainer can say a word. Their unyielding loyalty makes them popular among Trainers who need a reliable friend.

entry: 它像远方国度的一位战士。不知为何，野生POKENAME对人类怀有强烈怨恨。
author: mercsthorn
source: This Pokémon resembles a warrior from a far-off land. Wild POKENAME hold an intense grudge against humans for reasons unknown.

entry: POKENAME的毛会收集利石，抵挡近战。牙带甜香毒液，能使目标严重混乱。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's fur collects sharp stones, protecting it from melee attacks. Its fang carries a sweet-smelling venom that causes intense confusion.

entry: POKENAME潜伏林中，以嚎叫、低吼驱逐靠近者。可在凶狠态度背后，其实渴望一个不怕它与外貌的伙伴。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME lurk within forests, howling and growling to scare away any that get closer. Despite their aggressive attitude, POKENAME truly desire a companion that is not afraid of them or their appearance.

entry: 这些凶猛宝可梦爱激怒敌人，引对方攻击自己。POKENAME一被击中，常借势甩头，以岩石般的鬃毛，使出猛烈头撞。
author: infinex21
source: These fierce Pokémon love to antagonize their enemies into attacking themselves. When a POKENAME is struck, it will often utilize the momentum to swing its head and deliver a crushing headbutt with its rocky mane.

entry: POKENAME最爱休息，讨厌被强行打断。除了自己的训练家，任何打扰者都会被它追击不休。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME despises being forced from its favorite pastime of resting. With the exception of their Trainers, POKENAME will relentlessly attack anything that disturbs its relaxation.

entry: POKENAME主要夜行，在山地与同群出击。头上石角有强毒，能引起恶心。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME is primarily active at night, striking with its pack in mountainous regions. The stone horn on its head carries potent venom that induces nausea.

entry: POKENAME身上尖刺有节奏地碰撞，像白噪声，让宝可梦安睡整夜。可发怒时，会咆哮、来回旋动，刺耳刮擦将周围全吵醒。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: The rhythmic clacking of the clashing spikes along POKENAME acts as white noise that helps Pokémon sleep through the night. When POKENAME get angry, they howl in rage and rotate back and forth, the dissonant scraping waking up all around them.

entry: 它是惊角鹿狡猾的夜间天敌。POKENAME既善幻术，又耐受惊角鹿的力量，成群便能轻易逐一猎杀，连紧密鹿群也难逃。
author: bobosmith01
source: The cunning nocturnal predator of Stantler. Through use of its illusory abilities and its resistance to Stantler's powers, a pack of POKENAME easily picks off even a well-knit group of them one by one.

entry: 它是惊角鹿狡猾的夜间天敌。POKENAME既善幻术，又耐受惊角鹿的力量，成群便能轻易逐一猎杀，连紧密鹿群也难逃。
author: bobosmith01
source: The cunning nocturnal predator of Stantler. Through use of its illusory abilities and its resistance to Stantler's powers, a pack of POKENAME easily picks off even a well-knit group of them one by one.

entry: POKENAME一见日落，就开始嚎叫。声音往往能安抚附近同类。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME howls the moment it sees the sunset. The sound of its howl tends to soothe others of its kind nearby.

entry: POKENAME乱挥触须，挑衅、激怒其他生物。等目标上钩，便以坚韧触须接招，再打出猛烈反击。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME flail their feelers about to taunt and agitate others. When a target takes the bait, they endure their hits using their tough feelers and deliver crushing counterattacks.

entry: 全身坚硬如基岩，触碰就会中毒。战斗时，坚不可破的头与沉重尾巴交替出击，攻势连绵不绝。
author: celio_0230
source: Its entire body is as hard as bedrock, and toxic to the touch. It alternates between using its unbreakable head and its heavy tail to continuously deliver strikes when fighting.

entry: POKENAME是真正的凶兽，鲜少有谁敢争领地。深夜一声长嚎，多数宝可梦都会惊醒，逃离附近。
author: frokachu
source: A truly savage beast that has few contenders for territory. When a POKENAME howls in the dead of night, most Pokémon will wake and flee the area.

entry: POKENAME是穷追不舍的海中猎手，海洋生灵极难逃脱。它挥爪便能改变水流，利爪还能轻易撕开沙石，摧毁猎物打算藏身的洞穴。
author: sk372
source: A relentless undersea hunter, POKENAME is extremely difficult for sea creatures to escape. It can shift the currents with a swing of its claws, and said claws easily tear through sand and stone to tear up any dens that prey thinks to hide within.

entry: POKENAME极自负，以挑衅手势、沙哑狂笑激敌。等挨打，笑容反而更大，扛住攻击，再以带火的头撞还击。
author: sk372
source: Very cocky, POKENAME goads its opponents with taunting gestures and raspy cackles. Once they strike, its grin grows wider as it withstands the attack and delivers a fiery headbutt in return.

entry: POKENAME把尾巴产生的雷电，导入头冠。低头后放出强雷，将前方土地劈出伤痕。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME channels the lightning generated by its tail into the crest upon its head. It brings its head down and casts powerful thunderbolts that scar the land in front of it.

entry: POKENAME白天纹丝不动，傍晚才活跃、充满敌意。它以头击地，令前方一排冰柱迸出。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME stays perfectly still during the day, before becoming active and hostile during the evening. It strikes the ground with its head, creating an eruption of icicles in a line in front of it.

entry: POKENAME好斗，交战时快如闪电，或以爪戳敌，或用混着岩石的毛皮冲撞。只要善待，它便对训练家忠诚一生。
author: jadey.1557
source: POKENAME loves to fight. In combat, this Pokémon moves with lightning speed, jabbing opponents with its claws or smashing into them with its rock-laced fur. If raised kindly, POKENAME is loyal to its Trainer for life.

entry: POKENAME头毛柔软蓬松，很愿让人摸。可下面是实岩，一记头撞，足以断骨。
author: .jerden
source: The hair on its head is soft and fluffy, and POKENAME enjoys letting humans pet it. The head underneath is made from solid rock and can headbutt foes with bone-breaking force.

entry: POKENAME发怒，毛会闪出鲜红强光，让注视者目眩。再冲向敌人，用头顶锐岩刺击。
author: .jerden
source: When POKENAME is angry, its fur flashes bright red, dazzling anyone looking at it. POKENAME then rushes towards its foe to strike with the sharp spike of rock on its head.

entry: POKENAME岩石般的鬃毛，有导电纤维，头撞时也能电击。它忠于同伴，可陌生者靠近，就会凶狠攻击。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's rocky mane contains fibers that conduct electricity, enabling it to shock foes it headbutts. While loyal to its allies, POKENAME will aggressively attack anyone unfamiliar who approaches.

entry: POKENAME经常骗家长带孩子来听自己的演唱会，随后在台上大声飙脏话，还毫无愧疚。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME often trick parents into bringing their children to its concerts, where they scream curse words and don't feel guilty about it.

entry: POKENAME用齿轮压碎卡在毛中的岩石，磨成细粉。挨打时，直接吹向敌眼，立刻抢占战机。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME crush any rocks trapped within their fur using their gears, turning them into a fine powder. When attacked, they blow this dust straight into their opponents' eyes, instantly giving them the edge in battle.

entry: POKENAME目力强，能暗中视物。野蛮叛逆，唯有老练训练家才能驯服、掌控，因此想成为驯龙师的人，常捕它证明本领。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME have powerful eyes that let them see in the dark. Only experienced Trainers can tame and control their savage and rebellious nature, so aspiring Dragon Tamers try to catch them to prove their worth.

entry: POKENAME夜里漫游沼泽，大声嚎叫，让附近树木听命移动。走到哪里，地貌就被重新塑造。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME lets out a loud howling noise while wandering through marshes at night. This animates nearby trees to move on its command, reshaping the landscape as it walks.

entry: POKENAME装得弱小，引敌攻击柔软微黏的身体。等对方戒心放下，就硬化头毛，打出疼痛的强力头撞。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME goads opponents into thinking it is weak, letting them strike at its soft, slightly sticky body. When a foe's guard is down, it hardens the fur on its head and delivers a painfully strong headbutt.

entry: POKENAME的毛，其实是数千颗细小利石。它夜里捕猎，能凭战技，击败体型超过自身两倍的宝可梦。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's fur is actually made out of thousands of tiny, sharp stones. It hunts during the night, using its combat skills to take down Pokémon over twice its size.

entry: 融合后，这只宝可梦呈现本物种黄昏形态的外观。它时而平静安宁，时而凶猛好斗、不肯罢休，两种性情能瞬间切换。
author: sk372
source: After fusion, this Pokémon takes on the appearance of the Dusk variant of its species. It can flip between serene calmness and a fierce, relentless fighter at a moment's notice.

entry: POKENAME结成小群狩猎，能借月相在相隔遥远时相互协调。它们每天齐声长嚎两次，正午一次，午夜一次。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME hunt in small packs and can co-ordinate with one another across vast distances using the phases of the moon. They howl in unison with one another twice a day, once at midday and once at midnight.

entry: POKENAME易怒，却把怒气当成音乐灵感。它珍视吉他，困难时，总能帮助自己平静。
author: chaotic_aspergers
source: POKENAME has anger issues, which it uses as inspiration for its music. POKENAME values its guitar deeply, as it helps keep it calm during rough times.

entry: POKENAME用吉他演奏，也毫不介意拿它砸向敌人，即使吉他碎成片，也要轻松取胜。它跳舞的方式，总能激怒观看者，让他们也想大打一场。
author: soup1900
source: While POKENAME uses its guitar to play its music, it has no problem bashing it against foes and letting it crumble into pieces to gain an easy victory. It dances in such a way that it always agitates those who watch and makes them want to brawl.

entry: POKENAME以嚎叫、摇响尾上岩板，威吓穿过领地者。不懈训练带来巨力，强爪一挥，连建筑也能打倒。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME howls and rattles the rock plates on its tail to intimidate those who wander through its territory. Its relentless training has made it so powerful that a single swipe of its mighty paw can bring down a building.

entry: POKENAME喜欢团队战术，协调同群一同使出落英缤纷，制服敌人。攻击时单脚站立，远看颇优雅。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME prefers pack tactics to strike at foes, coordinating joint Petal Blizzard attacks to subdue them. It stands on one leg while performing its attack, looking elegant from afar.

entry: POKENAME白天睡在火山里，月亮一出，就醒来离巢。捕猎靠宽翼、利爪，夜间视力与力量，都最强。
author: cerealjamalt
source: POKENAME spends its day sleeping inside volcanos, but once the moon comes out, it wakes up and leaves its home. When hunting, it uses its vast wings and sharp claws to catch prey. Its vision and strength is strongest at night.

entry: POKENAME一生充满战斗，不断挑战强敌，寻求痛快对决。岩石般的肌肉，每赢一次就更强。它尊重胜者，却鄙视自认弱小的对象。
author: thesilverowls
source: Life is full of battles for POKENAME. They challenge other strong Pokémon in a search for a good challenge, their rocky muscles growing stronger with each victory. They respect those who win, but look down on those they deem as weaklings.

entry: POKENAME常去派对，借机欢闹、炫耀体格。有人说，运气够好，可能还见到异色岩狗狗陪伴。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME frequent parties, which they use as an excuse to party and show off their physique. Some say that if you are lucky enough, you might find a shiny Rockruff accompanying them.

entry: 捕猎时，单只POKENAME故意落在后方，装伤、装弱，引来伦琴猫等大宝可梦。时机一到，同群便扑向这想捕食的敌人。
author: chibitales
source: When hunting, a single POKENAME will lag behind the pack and pretend to be injured or weak in an attempt to lure in bigger Pokémon like Luxray. When the moment is just right, the rest of the pack will pounce on the would-be predator.

entry: POKENAME是速度最快的捕食者之一，轻松就能跑过任何对手。曾被发现以追逐猎物直至其筋疲力尽为乐。
author: crypticanexe
source: One of the fastest predators, POKENAME easily outraces any opponent. It's been known to chase prey to exhaustion as a form of entertainment.

entry: POKENAME以炮口发出引噩梦的尖叫，似乎将人困进梦魇。即使捂耳，背上众眼，也能一眼催眠。
author: antonio_9onzalez
source: POKENAME uses its cannons to produce nightmare-inducing screams that seem to trap people in nightmares. Even if you cover your ears, the many eyes on POKENAME's back will put you to sleep at a glance.

entry: POKENAME喜欢突然现身，吓训练家一跳。训练家越享受这些恶作剧，POKENAME就越尊重对方。
author: teatedtiten
source: POKENAME likes to play pranks on its Trainer, usually with jumpscares.  The more the Trainer enjoys its pranks, the more POKENAME respects them.

entry: POKENAME即使还生疏，也爱唱歌。藤蔓轻柔拿起打击乐器，为歌声配上稳定节拍。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME love to sing, even if they are inexperienced. Their gentle vines pick up percussion instruments to add a steady beat to their singing.

entry: POKENAME打架时，跟着自己哼唱的节拍出拳。以它战斗节奏写成的歌，是运动电影的热门配乐。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME times its punches to the beat of music it hums to itself during fights. Songs based around the beats formed during POKENAME battles are popular tracks used in sports films.

entry: POKENAME拍翼奏出美妙旋律。成群POKENAME常伴着自己的音乐，欢快起舞。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME produces a beautiful melody as it beats its wings. Swarms of POKENAME can be seen joyfully dancing to their own music.

entry: POKENAME有一副为歌剧演唱而生的嗓音。张扬、虚荣的个性，也很适合在歌剧聚光灯下放声。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a voice dedicated to singing opera music. Their flamboyant and vain personalities are well-suited to sing in the spotlight of opera.

entry: POKENAME捕猎时会从管风琴般的角放出刺耳杂响。任何听见这种声音的宝可梦，都会吓得僵住。
author: cyboobr
source: When hunting, POKENAME will release a horrible cacophony from it's organ-like horns. Any Pokémon that hears it becomes frozen with terror.

entry: POKENAME在世界各地的水族馆里，活力四射地表演水上秀。杂技与音乐都惊艳，令观众久久难忘。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME live exuberant lives at aquariums around the world performing in water shows. Their tricks and musical performances amaze audiences and leave a lasting impression.

entry: 据说POKENAME很为自己能启发新歌而自豪，也十分保护训练家受其启发创作的作品。它常以猛烈水流痛击冒名、抄袭者。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: It is said that POKENAME are very proud of their ability to inspire new songs and are very protective of the work of Trainers inspired by them. They will often target impersonators and plagiarists with painful blasts of water.

entry: POKENAME能唱出全世界所有曲调，完美复制任何音乐风格。传闻音乐就起源于它。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME has the ability to sing every tune in the world, perfectly replicating any style of music. It's rumored that the origins of music stem from POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME歌唱时，会重新长出能奏响旋律的护身鬃毛。唱得越多，鬃毛就越大。
author: gurguro
source: When POKENAME sing their song, they regenerate their melodic mane, which protects them. The more they sing, the larger their mane.

entry: POKENAME扇翅时，会以振动模拟歌声。到了夜间，这歌声似乎更清晰。
author: dodoowner_
source: When POKENAME flaps its wings, its wings vibrate in a way that replicates a singing voice. This voice seems to get clearer during the night.

entry: POKENAME是隐居的虫类歌姬，下半身常受旁人评头论足，因此极少被看见。它织的网能传递美丽旋律，不改音高与曲调。
author: infinex21
source: Very few POKENAME have ever been spotted, for they are reclusive songstress Bug Pokémon that have been judged for their lower bodies by many. The webs they spin can carry their beautiful melodies without changing the pitch or tune of their notes.

entry: POKENAME歌唱本领仍在成长，依靠歌手教导，学习改进。它天天练习，盼成为世界最好的歌手。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are still developing their singing ability and rely on singers to help teach them ways to improve. They practice every day in the hopes of becoming the best singers in the world.

entry: 看见这稀有宝可梦对日落歌唱，被视为凶兆。听见POKENAME忧伤小夜曲的人，脑中会闪过未来悲剧的片段。
author: milchik
source: Spotting this rare Pokémon singing to the sunset is considered a bad omen. Whoever hears POKENAME's melancholic serenades will see glimpses of the future tragic events in their heads.

entry: POKENAME热爱音乐，却很难弄懂乐器怎么用。它偏爱木琴，因为主要只会演奏这个。
author: chaotic_aspergers
source: POKENAME loves music, but has a hard time understanding how to use the instruments. POKENAME favors the xylophone, as it is the main instrument it can play.

entry: 无线电发明前，海军用POKENAME将伤亡消息传回岸上。报信时唱的悲痛旋律，常使各国请求议和。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Before radios were invented, POKENAME were used by navies to relay casualties back to shore. The heart-wrenching melodies they sang when telling the news often caused nations to sue for peace.

entry: POKENAME爱指挥野生宝可梦的叫声，组成交响乐。它聪明，音乐记忆完美，听过的任何曲子都能重现。
author: milchik
source: POKENAME loves conducting the cries of wild Pokémon to create symphonies. This clever Pokémon has a perfect memory for music, able to recreate any song it has ever heard.

entry: POKENAME天真好奇，连自己能造音乐，都觉得惊叹。花粉云让乐谱振动，帮助观众跟上演奏进度。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are full of naive wonder and are in awe of their own ability to produce music. They release clouds of pollen that vibrate sheet music, helping audience members keep track of where POKENAME are in a musical piece.

entry: POKENAME爱把周围听来的音乐化为可见景象，因此一出现，空中就花粉四散。虽经验不足，仍决心扩充曲目。
author: quackquackattack
source: Bursts of pollen fill the air whenever POKENAME are around, as they love to visualize the music they hear around them. Even though they are inexperienced, POKENAME are determined to improve their musical repertoire.

entry: POKENAME散出花粉与叶云，在空中组成音符，飘过、随风消散。许多个体欣赏音乐艺术，会与乐师合作。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME release a cloud of pollen and leaves to form notes in the air, which float by and scatter into the wind. Many POKENAME work with musicians out of an appreciation for the art of music.

entry: POKENAME唱歌时，以牙齿相叩作乐。连啃岩石、木头的声音，也悦耳舒心。
author: m1918_94884
source: POKENAME clicks its teeth together like an instrument when it sings. The sound of one gnawing on a rock or a log is soothing to the ear.

entry: POKENAME站上乐器，乐器就会自行演奏。曲调空灵诡异，仿佛任何人类都无法正确重现。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME will place itself atop musical instruments which then begin playing by themselves. The music played by the instruments are ethereal, eerie tunes that seem impossible for any human to properly replicate.

entry: POKENAME头部唱女高音，尾巴唱男中音。合奏出迷人、上口的旋律，让世界各地乐迷屏息等候。
author: beatdoof
source: POKENAME's head is a soprano, while its tail is a baritone. Together, they create mesmerizing, catchy melodies that fans the world over wait for with bated breath.

entry: POKENAME尾上的头不会唱，却很欣赏前面那个头的歌。节奏加快，后半身就尽力合拍，蹦跳起舞。
author: sk372
source: The head on POKENAME's tail cannot sing, but clearly has an appreciation for the songs the main head sings. As the tempo picks up, the back half prances and dances about to the tune as best it can.

entry: POKENAME深掘地下时，体刺振动，奏出像歌唱的独特旋律。钻洞掉下的毛，常作弦乐器琴弓的材料。
author: chibitales
source: As POKENAME burrows deep underground, the vibrations caused by its body spikes produce a unique melody that sounds like singing. The hair that falls away as it burrows is often used to make bows for string instruments.

entry: POKENAME声带小而紧，唱得不好，于是改从壳孔，奏出优雅旋律。
author: kittyluv090
source: POKENAME cannot sing well due to its small and condensed vocal cords, so it instead plays elegant melodies through the holes in its shell.

entry: 这狡猾宝可梦爱出风头。POKENAME以欢快旋律分散注意，趁机靠近，再用迅捷锐爪，打个措手不及。
author: lesbian_garlicbread
source: This cunning Pokémon loves the limelight. With upbeat melodies, POKENAME distracts foes just long enough to slip in close, startling them with swift, razor‑sharp claws.

entry: POKENAME漫游森林，敲击鼓状外壳。常参加巡游，也往往是最受瞩目的主角。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME roam forests, playing their drum-like shells. They're often used in parades and are usually the main highlight.

entry: POKENAME嗓音低缓甜美。难得被发现时，通常正在大葱园，嚼着大葱。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME sings in a slow, mellifluous voice. On the rare occasions it's found, it's usually in a leek garden, munching on leeks.

entry: POKENAME的歌，常唤起快乐、爱情，也会激起暴怒。可观众若冷漠、无聊，它便烦躁。
author: imaginaryneon
source: POKENAME's songs often evoke emotions such as happiness, love, and outbursts of rage. However, if a POKENAME's audience displays apathy or boredom, it will become irritated.

entry: 破晓时能听见它们歌唱，森林家园也随歌苏醒。鹿角对声音有反应，能大幅放大歌声。
author: infinex21
source: The singing of these Pokémon can be heard at the crack of dawn, their forest homes coming to life in tandem with their songs. Their antlers are reactive to sound and amplify their songs greatly.

entry: POKENAME在合唱团练习，磨练嗓音。可不够自信站在聚光灯下，常控制不好音量。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME practice singing in choirs to develop their voice. They often struggle with the volume of their voice because they lack the confidence to be in the spotlight.

entry: POKENAME外表优雅，蛇般身体却能轻易压倒敌人。比起打斗，它更想歌唱，以美丽嗓音与深情旋律平息对方。
author: kam_doodle_snek
source: Despite its graceful appearance, POKENAME can easily overpower foes with its serpentine body. It prefers to sing to its opponents over fighting, quelling them with its beautiful voice and soulful melody.

entry: POKENAME敲击躯干的鼓，为歌声打拍。轻柔旋律带着恢复活力的能量，舒缓伤者疼痛，帮助宝可梦更快康复。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses the drum on its torso to provide a beat for its singing. The gentle tune of its song has a rejuvenating energy that helps soothe the pains of injured Pokémon and encourages quicker healing.

entry: POKENAME神秘，常到海滨小镇酒馆唱歌。许多水手说，只要提供能启发新歌的点子，它就会引人回家。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: POKENAME are highly mysterious Pokémon who tend to visit taverns in local beach towns often to sing. Many sailors say they will guide them home in exchange for ideas that inspire their newest songs.

entry: POKENAME无精打采地漂浮，靠近却能隐约听见空灵旋律。传说，枷锁若断，它就会传播诅咒歌，为人类带来灾难。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME floats about listlessly, but those who venture close can faintly hear an ethereal melody play. According to legends, if its shackles were broken, it would spread a cursed song that would spell disaster for humanity.

entry: POKENAME歌声洪亮、有共鸣，适合大量听众。演出常有机器助阵，它放电激活，让烟火绽放。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a resonant voice that they rely on when singing for large audiences. Their performances often feature machines that they zap with electricity to unleash pyrotechnics.

entry: POKENAME最擅长唱古典音乐。浑厚歌声回荡歌剧院，完美音准与悠长延音，让观众惊叹。
author: sk372
source: Classical music is POKENAME's forte when it comes to singing. Its booming voice is often heard echoing across opera houses as it wows audiences with its perfect pitch and long-held notes.

entry: POKENAME由裹满黏液的触手组成。拨动触手，便能奏出竖琴般舒缓的旋律。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's body is made of a collection of slime-coated tentacles. It will strum its tentacles to create a soothing melody similar to that of a harp.

entry: POKENAME飞行时，双翼振出婉转轻哼，让猎物平静。这让捕猎轻松，能在猎物不反抗的情况下将其带走吃掉。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME's wings vibrate as they fly, creating a melodic hum that lulls their prey into a calm state. This allows these Pokémon to hunt without trouble, carrying their prey away to eat without a fight.

entry: POKENAME降低体温，在声带旁形成冰晶，让嗓音空灵回荡。据说，还能发出晶体相碰般的叮当声。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: POKENAME lower their body temperature to create ice crystals along their vocal cords that cause their vocals to have an echoing and haunting quality. It is said they can produce a clinking sound similar to crystals.

entry: POKENAME热心帮管弦乐作曲家，试写大型演出的乐谱。可天生不懂乐理，虽热情，往往帮倒忙。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME often look to help orchestral composers with their work, attempting to generate scores for big performances. Despite their enthusiasm, they are often more of a hindrance than a help, as they lack any inherent understanding of music theory.

entry: POKENAME唱欢快旋律，随着节拍踏步，把动作融入舞蹈。谁打断临时音乐会，就会被按歌的节奏，接连踢打。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME perform lively melodies where they stomp along to the beat of songs as part of their dances. If anyone interrupts one of a POKENAME's makeshift concerts, it will repeatedly kick them to the rhythm of the song.

entry: POKENAME害羞，声如轻声耳语，只有近旁能听见。它容易怯场，训练发声共鸣也很困难。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are shy creatures that have a hush, whispered voice that can only be heard by those nearby. Training them to develop their resonance is a difficult task because of their stage fright.

entry: POKENAME嗓音婉转动听，能读训练家的心思，唱主人喜欢的歌。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a melodic voice that is pleasant to listen to. POKENAME can read the minds of Trainers and will sing songs that their Trainer enjoys.

entry: 除最凶残者外，POKENAME的歌声一定能安抚所有听者。嗓音优美，但最美的歌只留给自己的训练家私下聆听。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's song is guaranteed to soothe all but the most savage of hearts. Its voice is melodic, though it saves its most beautiful songs for only its Trainer to hear in private.

entry: 它的歌曲，让人类、宝可梦都成了乐迷。不过常有人说，最美的旋律，只会留给最信任的对象。
author: infinex21
source: This Pokémon's songs have gained it many fans among humans and Pokémon alike. Yet it is oft said that its most beautiful melodies are saved only for those it trusts most.

entry: POKENAME爱附身遇到的训练家、宝可梦，先让对方按欢快节奏跳舞，自己再蹦跳着离开。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME enjoys possessing Trainers and Pokémon that cross its path. POKENAME makes them dance to an upbeat rhythm before hopping away.

entry: 它独自在严酷荒野练习多年，提升嗓音。POKENAME通过歌唱，释放波导冲击波。
author: dylonk25
source: It has spent years training alone in the harsh wilderness, improving its voice. POKENAME releases aura shockwaves by singing.

entry: POKENAME背上的鼓每敲一下，一英里远也能听见。与其他乐师合作时，负责稳拍，让大家出彩。
author: quackquackattack
