source: Each thud of the drum on the backs of POKENAME can be heard from a mile away. In a group of other musicians, POKENAME help keep a steady beat to allow others to shine.

entry: POKENAME全身心投入歌舞，每场表演都竭尽全力。旋律特别激昂时，就猛甩头发；头发仿佛活过来，利齿也合拍咬响。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME dance and sing with their entire soul, giving their all for their performances. During particularly energetic melodies, they whip about their hair as it seems to take on a life of its own, gnashing its sharp teeth along the beat.

entry: POKENAME跳奇怪舞蹈，引来有史前渊源的宝可梦。舞姿将它们催眠，直到演出结束，个个都觉得异样疲惫。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME dances a strange dance that draws in the curiosity of Pokémon with prehistoric connections. The moves hypnotize them until the performance is done, and leaves them all feeling strangely drained.

entry: 听见POKENAME的歌，便意味着当地灾难将至。它想借歌警告，却被许多人当成召灾的声音。
author: sk372
source: If POKENAME's song is heard, it means disaster is soon to strike the area. It intends for its songs to be warnings, but many have instead believed them to be summoning disasters.

entry: POKENAME唱歌时，头发如火翻涌，曲速越快，就越猛烈。连最疲惫的火属性宝可梦，也能因此重燃斗志。
author: sk372
source: As POKENAME sings, its hair whips and roils like a burning flame, increasing in intensity when its songs grow faster in tempo. These songs can reignite the fighting spirit of even the most exhausted of Fire-type Pokémon.

entry: 它以歌产生电能，让尾星越来越亮。据说，听见POKENAME嗓音的人，都会精神一振，变得乐观。
author: fiordaliso
source: By singing, it can generate electrical energy that makes the star on its tail glow ever brighter. It is said that anyone who hears POKENAME's voice will feel a surge of energy and optimism.

entry: POKENAME住在宁静湖底，偶尔上浮歌唱。歌声给听者心灵带来喜悦与祝福。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME lives at the bottom of serene lakes, but occasionally comes to the surface to sing. This sound brings joy and blessings to the souls of listeners.

entry: POKENAME旋舞时，触须划过空气，小孔发出笛声。历代艺术家被这音乐启发，因而称它为“墨之缪斯”。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's feelers have tiny holes that produce a flute-like noise when waved through the air during pirouettes. This music has inspired artists throughout the ages, earning it the title of Muse of the Ink.

entry: 许多生物被歌吸引，毫不知情绪正受影响。若歌声还制服不了敌人，它们就用触须绑住，直到对方屈服。
author: infinex21
source: Many are drawn to the songs of these Pokémon, blissfully unaware that these songs influence their very emotions. If their songs alone fail to subdue their foes, they will restrain them with their feelers until they submit.

entry: POKENAME穿越时间前，会先唱旋律。稀有录音被重新混音，传往世界各地。
author: amberaxolotl223
source: POKENAME sing melodies before jumping through time. Rare recordings of the songs are remixed and distributed all over the world.

entry: 朔月之夜，能听见POKENAME在树、楼顶唱幽幽旋律。据说听够久，就会被拉进噩梦，歌曲在脑中永远回响。
author: actliux
source: During the night of a new moon, POKENAME can be heard singing a haunting melody from atop trees and buildings. It is said that if one listens long enough, they will be pulled into a nightmare, where its song plays endlessly in their head.

entry: POKENAME舞跳越久，炮威力越强。快节奏又会让它跳得更激烈，进一步加快蓄能。
author: .izik
source: The longer POKENAME dances, the stronger its cannons become. Higher tempo music tends to make it dance more vigorously, further increasing the charge speed.

entry: POKENAME带着强烈情绪歌唱，就会生火。感情越激动，火越强，让歌曲美丽又危险。
author: eiskitsune
source: When POKENAME sings with intense emotions, it generates flames. The more emotional it is, the stronger the flames become, making its songs both beautiful and dangerous.

entry: POKENAME常像偶像团体一样合唱，吸引来热爱它们音乐的忠实追随者。
author: jackjirachi
source: POKENAME often sing in groups similar to idols. Because of this, they gain devoted followers who enjoy listening to their music.

entry: POKENAME的耳朵十分敏感，因此歌声轻如耳语，只有贴近嘴巴正前方，才能听见旋律。听到歌声的人，会涌起身在远方、思念故乡的情绪。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME sings in such a quiet whisper due to its sensitive ears that its melodies can only be heard when listening right in front of its mouth. To those who can hear it, its songs bring up feelings of homesickness and being faraway.

entry: POKENAME合着自己的曲子摇摆，撒下音符状火焰。被烧到者，部分生命力就会被吸走，供它继续跳舞。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME sheds flames in the shape of musical notes as it wiggles and dances to its own tune. Those burned by the cast-off flames have some of their life force drained to fuel POKENAME's continued dancing.

entry: POKENAME住在荒僻闹鬼宅邸，用美丽色彩、幽幽旋律引来好奇者。中计靠近，就会被身上灼热光束轰击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME makes its home in desolate, haunted mansions, luring the curious towards it with its beautiful colors and haunting melody. Those that fall for the trick are then blasted with searingly hot beams of light from POKENAME's body.

entry: 听见POKENAME歌声的人，总忍不住喜爱它。科学研究认为，歌本身很可能引发迷恋。
author: bobosmith01
source: When people hear POKENAME's song, they can't help but feel affection for POKENAME. Scientific studies have concluded that the song itself likely causes infatuation.

entry: POKENAME常在花园，混在植物间。园丁会拔起来做沙拉，才发现外皮硬如岩，几乎破不开。
author: actliux
source: POKENAME is usually discovered in gardens among other plants and vegetation. Gardeners will often pluck POKENAME from the ground to use it in salad dishes, only to discover its rock-hard exterior is nigh impenetrable.

entry: POKENAME齿轮一转，清亮的古典旋律钟声便响起。已有专用装置，让它保持恒速转动。
author: quackquackattack
source: The bright and crisp chimes of classical music melodies fill the air when POKENAME's gears are turned. Special devices have been made to keep POKENAME turning at a consistent speed.

entry: POKENAME非常爱唱歌，一有机会，尾端的火焰就会明亮起来。比它缺乏经验更引人注目的，只有那份热情。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME love to sing, so much so that the flame at the end of their tail glows bright when they get the opportunity. Their lack of experience is only surpassed by the strength of their passion.

entry: POKENAME爱唱，却讨厌被听。发现谁在听歌，就冲去毒咬，让受害者暂时失去听觉。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME enjoys singing, but detests being heard. If it comes across someone listening to its song, it charges to deliver a venomous bite that causes temporary hearing loss in its victim.

entry: POKENAME在雪地舞蹈，召出能掩埋村庄的巨大风暴。一察觉有人看，就跳得更兴奋。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME dances in snowy regions to conjure massive storms capable of burying villages. It dances more excitedly upon noticing anyone watching.

entry: POKENAME每天醒来时，羽毛上的音符图案都不相同。它会按这些音符组成的旋律，唱歌跳舞好几个小时。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME awakens each day with different musical notes patterned across its feathers. It spends hours singing and dancing to the melody they create.

entry: POKENAME大部分时间都埋在地下，只露出头顶的叶子。若被拔出来，它尖锐的惨叫可能让听见的人昏倒。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME spends most of its time buried underground, with only the leaves on its head visible. If it is pulled up, its high-pitched screaming may cause anyone who hears it to faint.

entry: POKENAME在高山顶上载歌载舞，歌声回荡数英里。每个族群都有一处由闪亮岩石围成的舞台，会在那里跳上好几个小时。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME dance and sing atop tall mountains with voices that echo for miles. Each flock has its own stage ringed with glittering rocks where they dance for hours.

entry: 街头艺人表演时，有时能看见POKENAME混在其中。它们用能影响人心的歌声，诱使训练家献上甜美的树果。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Where street performers perform, POKENAME can sometimes be spotted among them. With their influential songs, they provoke Trainers into giving them sweet berries.

entry: POKENAME有两种状态。高兴时会播送和谐的歌声，安抚周围的生物；烦躁时则会从手臂的红点发射小型管状炸弹。
author: sondededoo
source: POKENAME have two states; when happy they will begin broadcasting a harmonic song that can soothe those around them. When agitated, they will begin launching small pipe bombs from the red spots on their arms.

entry: 把POKENAME鬃毛上的圆点当成乐谱上的音符排列，就能谱出一首优美而独特的歌。将它们的歌声录下并绘成声谱图，图案竟与极光十分相似。
author: staghorn
source: Arranging the dots along a POKENAME's mane as if they were notes of sheet music produces a beautiful and unique song. Their songs bear a striking resemblance to auroras when recorded on a spectrogram.

entry: POKENAME已精通歌声形态的歌舞，诸般艺术皆能熟练施展，如今甚至能演奏过去、现在与未来的旋律。
author: jackjirachi
source: Having mastered the Aria styles of song and dance, POKENAME has become fully proficient in all of its arts. It is now capable of preforming melodies from the past, present, and even the future.

entry: 少数目击者表示，发光的电子音箱会放大它的歌声。除此之外，关于POKENAME仍所知甚少。
author: jackjirachi
source: According to the few eyewitness accounts that exist, its songs are amplified by its glowing electronic speakers. Little else is known about POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME飞过夜空时会唱起空灵的摇篮曲。据说听者会因此夜夜好梦，直到最终忘却它唱过的旋律。
author: quantumradiation
source: POKENAME sings an ethereal lullaby as it flies across the night sky. It is said that hearing its song blesses the listener with lovely dreams, until they eventually forget the melody it sang.

entry: POKENAME是许多战士诗人的灵感来源。它唱着战歌，以优雅而协调的攻击压倒对手。水手若听见海底传来它的乐声，会因古老的迷信而赶紧绕行。
author: pjporwoll
source: An inspiration for many warrior-poets, POKENAME sings a battle hymn as it overpowers opponents with graceful and coordinated attacks. Sailors hearing its music resonate from the ocean depths quickly route around the area due to old superstition.

entry: POKENAME用镰刃奏出小提琴般的优美乐曲。艳丽绿瓣也能充当临时乐器，声音还颇为悦耳。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME plays beautiful melodies on its sickles, similar to a violin. Its gorgeous green petals can be used as makeshift instruments and even sound quite pleasant.

entry: POKENAME每次表演都会全力以赴，边唱边蹦跳，全身心沉浸在音乐中。虽然这会耗尽体力，它似乎仍为唱过的每一首歌感到自豪。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME always give their all during their performances, bouncing along with their singing as they fully immerse themselves in the music. While this process tires them out, they still seem proud of each and every song.

entry: POKENAME通过巴松管引导力量，轰出大团高度凝聚的火焰。不战斗时，POKENAME能一边演奏，一边让烟雾中浮现未来事件的景象。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME channel their powers through their bassoons, allowing them create large blasts of concentrated fire. When not in combat, POKENAME can make images of future events appear in smoke as they play.

entry: 许多糕点师雇用POKENAME，帮忙评判配方的好坏。若POKENAME吃下甜点后献上一场漫长而气势十足的演出，糕点师就知道自己做出了佳作。
author: sk372
source: Many pastry chefs employ POKENAME to assist them in judging the quality of their recipes. If POKENAME performs a lengthy, bombastic performance after consuming a sweet, the chef knows it has created something special.

entry: 即使藏在地下，它也会大声歌唱。那些神秘歌声，却曾被错怪是幽灵作祟。
author: busilisk
source: This Pokémon sings loudly, even while hidden underground. These mysterious songs have been erroneously blamed on ghosts.

entry: 有月光的夜晚，POKENAME会成双聚到岸边歌唱。据说新婚夫妇若听见歌声，就能得到永世和睦的祝福。
author: mepp.
source: On moonlit nights, pairs of POKENAME gather near the shoreline to sing. It's said that newlyweds who hear its song are said to be blessed with everlasting harmony.

entry: 这些猫形歌手通常出没于繁华都市的街头，尤其常见于大型娱乐区。POKENAME爱唱歌，也同样喜爱人们赏给它的闪亮物品。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: These feline singers are usually found on the streets of busy cities, especially in large entertainment areas. POKENAME love to sing, but they enjoy the shiny items they receive just as much.

entry: POKENAME已从街头歌手成长为真正的流行歌星，为人们带来欢乐。它为自己的嗓音自豪，也曾成为潜心表演者的伙伴。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: No longer a singer for the city streets, POKENAME has become a full pop star bringing joy to others. They are proud of their voice and have been known to be companions for dedicated performers.

entry: POKENAME轻柔舒缓的歌声能治愈听者的头痛。可惜，唱歌对POKENAME自己那持续发作的剧烈头痛毫无帮助。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's soft and soothing songs can cure headaches to those that hear the music. Unfortunately, singing does nothing to cure POKENAME of its own constant painful headaches.

entry: POKENAME训练时会唱歌给自己听，以振奋精神、保持干劲。听见歌声的人也会突然充满锻炼身体的冲动。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME sings to itself during training regiments to keep its spirits and motivation up. Those who hear the song are themselves filled with a sudden urge to exercise and work out.

entry: 这只宝可梦的上半身其实是喉部延伸而成的精巧诱饵。它以此唱出蜜糖般柔滑的歌声，再散发同样甜美的气味，将猎物引到足以一口吞下的距离。
author: icelevelincarnate
source: This Pokémon's upper half is an elaborate decoy, an extension of their throat. They use it to sing with a voice as smooth as honey, then emit a similarly sweet scent to lure prey close enough to be devoured.

entry: POKENAME一边唱歌，一边用拳头敲击巨石伴奏。有时太过投入，会因敲得太用力而不小心把石头打碎。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME beats its fists on large rocks to provide a drum beat to the songs it sings. In some cases, it gets so passionately into the music that it drums too hard and winds up shattering the stone on accident.

entry: POKENAME性格张扬，最适合演奏朋克音乐。它们用吉他奏出的和弦，能引起许多青少年的共鸣。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are best fit to perform punk music because of their boisterous personality. The chords they play on their guitar resonate with many teenagers.

entry: POKENAME沙哑的嗓音很适合金属乐，响亮的嘶吼能鼓舞许多叛逆青年。嗓音的不足，全靠满腔热情弥补。
author: quackquackattack
source: The gravelly voice of POKENAME makes them the perfect candidate for metal music, where their loud screams can inspire many rebellious youths. Their sheer passion makes up for the quality of their voice.

entry: POKENAME把毛发在背后盘成锥形螺旋，借此保持平衡，用两条后腿站立。只有这样直立时，它才能唱出低沉、和谐而优美的歌声。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME fashions its hair in a conical coil style behind its back to allow it to balance and stand on its two hind legs. Only while in this upright position is it able to sing beautifully in a deep, harmonic voice.

entry: POKENAME不断播出来源不明、仿佛异界传来的优美音乐。偶尔会迸出一连串火花，天线随之转向，乐曲也突然换了旋律。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are constantly projecting beautiful otherworldly music from an unknown source. They occasionally unleash a series of sparks, their antennas changing directions and their music suddenly changing melodies.

entry: POKENAME一边唱着节奏鲜明的歌，一边挥动随身携带的大葱，偶尔还会转动它。曲调十分上口，在一些网络圈子里颇受欢迎。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME sings a rhythmic song while swinging or occasionally spinning the leek it carries around. The tune is catchy enough that it has become quite popular on some online circles.

entry: 过去的水手流传着关于POKENAME歌声诱惑力的可怕警告。它唱歌并无恶意，但声音悦耳得令人着迷，水手为了靠近它，会不顾恶浪，直到船只被撞得支离破碎。
author: sk372
source: Sailors in the past shared grim warnings about the allure of POKENAME's song. Though it means no harm when it sings, its voice is so pleasingly hypnotic that sailors would tear their ships apart through rough waters trying to get closer.

entry: 在管弦乐团中，POKENAME会用背上的角吹出号声，与其他擅长音乐的宝可梦合奏。它不时用水冲洗背上的角，细心保养。
author: quackquackattack
source: In an orchestral setting, POKENAME let the horns on their back trumpet alongside other musical Pokémon. They take care of the horns on their back by flushing them with water every so often.

entry: POKENAME向受害者唱出诡异的旋律，让对方感到孤独，并恐惧周遭的一切。歌声轻得只有目标听得见，最终令其发疯，也被旁人视为疯子。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME sings eerie melodies at victims that cause them to feel alone and afraid of everything around them. These songs are played faintly so that only the target can hear them, resulting in them being driven mad and perceived as crazy by others.

entry: POKENAME沿街行进时，会用角吹出明亮刺耳的嘹亮号声。它用水冲洗背上的角，确保音色始终稳定而洪亮。
author: quackquackattack
source: When marching through the streets, POKENAME let the bright, piercing sound of their horns trumpet loudly. They take care of the horns on their back by flushing them with water to ensure the sound they produce is consistent and resonant.

entry: POKENAME常因弹错而苛责自己，因此花许多时间练习钢琴。演奏时，有时会从炮管喷出水雾，让自己看起来更上镜。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME dedicate much of their time to practicing the piano, as they tend to be hard on themselves when they make mistakes. While they perform, sometimes they shoot a watery mist from their cannons to make themselves look photogenic.

entry: POKENAME长大并吃下足够食物后，会站在枝头原地旋转。这是进化的开始：它一边转动，一边吐丝缠住自己，直到全身包进茧中。
author: sk372
source: After growing and consuming enough food, POKENAME stands upon a branch and pirouettes in place. This is the start of its evolution process, spinning thread around itself as it twirls, until it is completely wrapped in a cocoon.

entry: POKENAME的拳击会让目标头边响起音符声，震得听不见其他声音。也有人见过它朝对手唱歌，试图扰乱对方。
author: camtft
source: Punches from POKENAME cause the target to be deafened by the sound of musical notes ringing around their head. Some have been seen singing at their opponents in an attempt to throw them off.

entry: POKENAME跳舞时，能不可思议地修复损坏或已删除的文件。这种数字表演有记录的实例极其罕见。
author: .izik
source: While dancing, POKENAME can mysteriously restore corrupted or deleted files. Documented instances of these digital performances are exceedingly rare.

entry: 无论走到哪里，似乎都有一段神秘旋律相随。它随音乐有节奏地摇摆的姿态，曾为历史上许多传统舞蹈带来灵感。
author: bostroms
source: A mysterious melody seems to follow it wherever it goes.  The way it rhythmically sways in time to the music has inspired many traditional dances throughout history.

entry: POKENAME像小小的吟游诗人，在森林中游荡。它围巾般的毛皮形似五线谱，每次动作都会奏出轻柔旋律，吸引附近的宝可梦，也让听见温柔歌声的人精神振奋。
author: silentscript89
source: POKENAME wanders forests like a tiny troubadour. Its scarf-like fur resembling a music-sheet staff chimes with soft melodies at every movement, charming nearby Pokémon and lifting the spirits of anyone who hears its gentle song.

entry: 这只难觅踪影的宝可梦会朝着日出唱起欢快的歌，让听者想起过去的快乐时光。在野外偶遇POKENAME跳舞，被视为好运的征兆。
author: milchik
source: The cheerful tunes this elusive Pokémon sings to the sunrises bring memories of the happier past to whoever hears them. Catching POKENAME dancing in the wild is considered good luck.

entry: 传说目睹POKENAME跳羽毛舞的人，会得到持续五年的好运。它十分罕见，优雅地翱翔于森林上空，不断练习，让飞行姿态更臻完美。
author: fiordaliso
source: According to legend, those who witness POKENAME perform Feather Dance are blessed with good fortune for five years. A rare creature, it soars gracefully over forests, constantly training to perfect the elegance of its flight.

entry: POKENAME随音乐舞动时，活力四射，连平时难得起舞的沼王也会被打动。它穿梭于沼王笨重的舞步之间，彼此嬉戏泼水。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: When POKENAME moves in time with music, its energising presence is one of the few things that can persuade a Quagsire to dance. They playfully splash each other with water, as POKENAME weaves in and out of Quagsire's lumbering moves.

entry: POKENAME个头虽小，却是出色的舞者。背上的音乐盒会奏出振奋人心、催人奋进的旋律，因此很受格斗属性专家欢迎。
author: kam_doodle_snek
source: Despite POKENAME's short stature, it is an incredible dancer. The music box on its back plays an invigorating and motivating melody; POKENAME is quite popular among Fighting-type specialists for this reason.

entry: POKENAME看似笨重，动作却很灵活，伴着欢快的曲调跳舞时，能跃起四米高。内心足够纯净的人，还能听见从它花朵深处传出的轻柔旋律。
author: milchik
source: Despite its bulky appearance, POKENAME is quite agile and can jump up to four meters high when dancing to a cheerful tune. If a person's heart is pure enough, they can hear a quiet melody coming deep from POKENAME's flower.

entry: POKENAME的壳完全中空，内部构造能放大敲击声。它喜欢用壳制造声响，会甩动头部，用长触须敲击壳的表面。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME's shell is completely hollow with an internal structure built to amplify noise when struck. They love to make noise using their shell, swinging their head around to strike at the surface of the shell with their long feelers.

entry: 只要有人站在POKENAME栖身的屏幕前观看，它就会奏乐，并献上扭动旋转的舞蹈。许多人忍不住跟着跳，几天后脑中还回响着那上口的旋律。
author: sk372
source: Whenever POKENAME has an audience in front of a screen it inhabits, it creates music and performs a twisting, twirling dance for them. Many find it hard to resist joining in the dance, the catchy music staying stuck in their head for days afterward.

entry: POKENAME把身体紧紧盘起，藏住真身。靠近人类时，会轻唱诡异的旋律来安抚自己。若有人想一探究竟，它就会发出经盘绕身体放大的尖叫，震耳欲聋。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Coiled tightly to hide its true body, POKENAME quietly sings eerie melodies to calm itself down when near humans. If a human tries to investigate, it will emit a deafening shriek amplified by the acoustics of its coils.

entry: 最猛烈的雷暴中，有时能看见POKENAME蹦跳起舞。据说它借着轰鸣的雷声与劈啪的闪电，以舞蹈将风暴的能量引入体内。
author: sk372
source: In the midst of the most raging of thunderstorms, one may find POKENAME prancing and dancing about. Its dance is said to siphon the storm's energy into its own body, fueled by the booming thunder and crackling lightning.

entry: POKENAME的大尾巴拍到地面时，会发出悦耳的吱声，为它旋转跳跃的舞蹈伴奏。不过它十分害羞，一发现有人观看，就会立刻停下。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's large tail creates a melodic squeak on impact with the ground, which it uses to create a musical backdrop for its twirling, hopping dances. It is, however, very shy and will instantly stop dancing if it realizes it's being watched.

entry: POKENAME最喜欢在脱不开身的观众面前昂首阔步、梳理毛发并表演。它以许多复杂的舞蹈，展现自己对其他宝可梦的权威。
author: t3isukone
source: POKENAME loves nothing more than performing in front of a captive audience while strutting and preening. It demonstrates its authority over other Pokémon through many complex dances.

entry: POKENAME随歌起舞时，会重组附近设备的数据，再随机重新分配。若对音乐格外入迷，这种能力的范围能覆盖整座城镇。
author: .izik
source: While dancing to a song, POKENAME reorganizes data on nearby equipment and redistributes it at random. The range of this ability can extend to cover an entire town if it is particularly enjoying the music.

entry: POKENAME在池塘中及岸边的巨石上跳舞。动作与周围水流相合，流畅的身姿将美丽舞蹈与击裂岩石的招式融为一体。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME dances on boulders in and near ponds. Its movements match the movement of water around it, and its flowing form combines beautiful dancing with stone-cracking strikes.

entry: POKENAME最适合在潮湿泥泞的地方表演。在泥中会更有自信，身体湿润时，动作也更加优雅灵巧。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's performances are best done in humid and muddy areas. It feels more confident in the mud and moves with much more grace and nimbleness while its body is moistened.

entry: POKENAME能操控自身重力，在舞蹈中做出幅度格外大而优雅的跳跃。它的舞能安抚凶暴的心灵，亲眼看过后仍想战斗的寥寥无几。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's ability to manipulate its own gravity allows it to take particularly large, graceful jumps as part of its dance routines. Its dances soothe a savage soul; few bare witness to them and still have a desire to fight.

entry: POKENAME喜欢附身于路遇的训练家和宝可梦。POKENAME会强迫他们跳芭蕾，直到筋疲力竭地倒下。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME enjoys possessing Trainers and Pokémon that cross its path. POKENAME forces them to perform ballet dances until they collapse in exhaustion.

entry: 所有宝可梦都期待着POKENAME的演出。即使最疲惫的听众，也能从它的音乐中恢复精神。
author: hexx_vixtar
source: POKENAME's performance is something all Pokémon look forward to. Hearing its music can energize even the most exhausted listeners.

entry: POKENAME看似平和，却会毫不犹豫地用缎带猛攻任何敌人或猎物。用缎带缠住对方后，会唱歌安抚，让其不再想要挣脱。
author: soup1900
source: Despite its peaceful look, POKENAME does not hesitate to use its ribbons to furiously assault any foe or prey. Once it has wrapped the opponent in its ribbons, it pacifies them with a song, rendering them unwilling to break free.

entry: POKENAME的歌声备受珍爱，却鲜有人还记得，它的歌能强烈影响听者的情绪。战斗时舞姿优雅，触须飘动，随时抽出重击。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's songs are treasured by many, though few remain aware that its singing can heavily influence the emotions of those who hear it. It dances elegantly during battle, its feelers fluttering and lashing out to deal harsh blows.

entry: POKENAME看似平和，却会毫不犹豫地用缎带猛攻任何敌人或猎物。用缎带缠住对方后，会唱歌安抚，让其不再想要挣脱。
author: soup1900
source: Despite its peaceful look, POKENAME does not hesitate to use its ribbons to furiously assault any foe or prey. Once it has wrapped the opponent in its ribbons, it pacifies them with a song, rendering them unwilling to break free.

entry: POKENAME先唱出悦耳的曲调，平复敌人的情绪，再从正面近身进攻。它能跳出精彩的舞蹈，做出漂亮动作，同时用缎带状触须织出富有节奏的视觉图案。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME sings a melodic tune to calm the feelings of foes before attacking them head-on in close combat. It can perform impressive dances and moves while using its ribbonlike feelers to create visual patterns and rhythms.

entry: POKENAME先唱出悦耳的曲调，平复敌人的情绪，再从正面近身进攻。它能跳出精彩的舞蹈，做出漂亮动作，同时用缎带状触须织出富有节奏的视觉图案。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME sings melodic tunes to calm the feelings of foes before attacking them head-on in close combat. It can perform impressive dances and moves while using its ribbonlike feelers to create visual patterns and rhythms.

entry: POKENAME表演时，旋转会带起冰冷气流，造出冰雕供它绕着起舞。演出结束，它鞠躬致意，所有冰雕同时轰然碎裂。
author: sk372
source: During POKENAME's performances, its spins produce freezing air that creates ice statues for it to twirl around. Once the performance finishes, it gives a bow as all the statues dramatically shatter.

entry: 这只难觅踪影的宝可梦，没有固定栖息地的记录。旋转时，振奋精神的香气会弥漫空中。若遭伏击，POKENAME能散播攻击中枢神经系统的孢子。
author: bobosmith01
source: An elusive Pokémon with no recorded consistent habitat. As it twirls, an energizing aroma fills the air. If POKENAME is ambushed, it can spread spores that attack the central nervous system.

entry: POKENAME是天才魔术师。精彩的戏法与幻术让观众赞叹不已，也激励许多人走上表演之路。
author: jackjirachi
source: POKENAME are talented magicians. They amaze audiences with their tricks and illusions, inspiring many to become performers.

entry: POKENAME是天才魔术师。精彩的戏法与幻术让观众赞叹不已，也激励许多人走上表演之路。
author: jackjirachi
source: POKENAME are talented magicians. They amaze audiences with their tricks and illusions, inspiring many to become performers.

entry: POKENAME会突然飞来，用赤褐色的头发缠住猎物。随后把食物当玩具，一边按表演般的路线飞行，一边让受害者反复快速旋转，直到对方倒下。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME are known to fly in from out of the blue and entangle prey with their auburn hair. Afterwards, they play with their meal, rapidly twirling them over and over while they fly around in performative patterns until the victim falls over.

entry: POKENAME跳舞时，能把伪装翻过来，露出这副新形态。它旋转摇摆时，人们似乎会不由自主地为它奏乐；没有乐器，就拍手或跺脚伴奏。
author: .jerden
source: When POKENAME dances, it can turn its disguise inside out to reveal this new form. People seem to be compelled to play music as it spins and sways, clapping their hands or stamping their feet if no instruments are available.

entry: POKENAME的两个身体分别向相反方向旋转时，齿尖碰撞，发出一连串清脆鸣响。两者用卷曲的部分勾在一起，来回甩动彼此，便奏出明快活泼的旋律。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: As the two bodies of POKENAME spin opposite each other, the collision of tines creates a series of chimes. When the two bodies link together by their curls, they swing each other back and forth, ringing out in vibrant and lively melodies.

entry: POKENAME在自己的齿轮上像陀螺般旋转，同时如舞蹈般摆动双臂。金属碰撞的声音并不刺耳杂乱，反而像钟声般悦耳。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME sways its arms as if dancing while spinning like a top on its own gear. Rather than sounding harsh or discordant, the impact of metal on metal causes it to ring like a bell.

entry: POKENAME的上半身几乎总裹在花苞中，只有唱歌时才打开。歌声虽美，却也将猎物引入花苞打开时一同释放的有毒花粉云中。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's upper half is almost always enclosed in a flower bud that only opens so it can perform its songs. Although these songs are beautiful, they also serve to lure prey into the clouds of noxious pollen that are also released when the bud opens.

entry: POKENAME刻苦锻炼体魄与敏捷性。不过，顽固的自尊常使它不顾后果地迎战，新手训练家很难驾驭。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME spends its time intensely training its body and agility. However, its stubborn pride often makes it approach battle recklessly, which can be difficult for novice Trainers to manage.

entry: POKENAME不筑普通的巢，而是在龙卷风顶端养育幼崽。它们原地旋转，掀起局部风暴，让自己和蛋始终不落地。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Rather than building traditional nests, POKENAME raise their young at the top of tornados. They spin in place to whip up localised wind storms to keep themselves and their eggs from ever touching the ground.

entry: 舞蹈教室筹备大型演出时，有时能在表演者中发现POKENAME。POKENAME喜欢成为焦点，常随正在练习的歌曲节拍旋转。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Should a dance studio prepare for a big performance, POKENAME might be spotted among the performers. POKENAME enjoy the spotlight on them, often spinning around to the beat of the song being practiced.

entry: 这种美洛耶塔的变体以动听的歌声吸引众人。POKENAME的歌如此美妙，有幸亲眼欣赏表演的人，心中会永远充满平静与喜悦。
author: jackjirachi
source: This variant of Meloetta uses its lovely singing voice to captivate others. POKENAME's songs are so lovely, that those fortunate enough to witness its performances are permanently filled with peace and joy.

entry: 这种形态的POKENAME喜欢在雨中表演。它撑着伞欢快起舞，开心地歌唱，给目睹的人带来欢乐。
author: jackjirachi
source: This form of POKENAME likes to perform during the rain. It happily dances with its umbrella while singing gleefully, bringing those who witness it joy.

entry: 舞步形态的POKENAME精通自身技艺后，便能达到这一形态。灵动、优雅又富技巧的动作，启发了许多武术招法。
author: jackjirachi
source: Pirouette POKENAME that have mastered their style can assume this form. Many martial arts techniques were derived from their dynamic, graceful, and acrobatic movements.

entry: 舞步形态的POKENAME精通自身技艺后，便能达到这一形态。灵动、优雅又富技巧的动作，启发了许多武术招法。
author: jackjirachi
source: Pirouette POKENAME that have mastered their style can assume this form. Many martial arts techniques were derived from their dynamic, graceful, and acrobatic movements.

entry: 即使战况激烈，POKENAME的动作仍像舞蹈般优雅。它娴熟地操控火焰，灼烧敌人。
author: mepp.
source: Even during intense battles, POKENAME moves in an elegant, dance-like manner. It expertly controls flames to scorch its foes.

entry: POKENAME跳舞快得脚掌常会起火，随后全身燃起烈焰，让观众看得入迷。表演后，它会筋疲力竭，需要细心照料。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME performs dances at such speeds that its paws will often set on fire. Once this happens, it becomes engulfed in flames, mesmerizing viewers. After these performances, it is exhausted and needs to be carefully attended to.

entry: POKENAME强健的四肢让它能一连跳舞好几个小时。身躯虽庞大，舞姿却十分优雅。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's strong limbs allow it to dance for hours on end. Despite its bulk, it dances quite gracefully.

entry: 人们会租来POKENAME，让它随迪斯科音乐旋转。这种复古音乐，让许多人想起蓬松发型与喇叭牛仔裤的旧日时光。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are rented out to spin while disco music is playing. This retro music brings back nostalgic memories of fluffy hair and bell-bottom jeans for many people.

entry: POKENAME随迪斯科音乐旋转时，会闪闪发光。这种动感的音乐，唤起世界各地许多舞者的怀旧之情。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME shimmer and sparkle as they spin to disco music. The groovy music brings nostalgia for many dancers throughout the world.

entry: 这种形态的POKENAME所唱的旋律，不及歌声形态那样受欢迎。不过，仍有许多人喜欢这种更舒缓的曲调。
author: kam_doodle_snek
source: The melody POKENAME sings in this form is not quite as popular as its Aria form. Nevertheless, there are still many people who enjoy this more relaxed melody.

entry: POKENAME以优雅的舞蹈和各个脑袋之间相互鞠躬来增进感情。哪怕只有一步没配合好，整支舞也算失败，必须重来。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME perform graceful dances and bow their heads for one another to strengthen bonds. If the heads are uncoordinated on even a single step, the entire dance is considered ruined and they start over.

entry: 大多数POKENAME用槌子敲击巨大的钟摆，奏出催眠的旋律。有些个体偏爱更振奋人心的节拍，颇受现代音乐人欢迎。
author: kam_doodle_snek
source: Most POKENAME play a hypnotic melody by swinging a mallet against their giant pendulum. Some individuals prefer to play more invigorating beats that have become quite popular among modern day music artists.

entry: POKENAME沐浴月光，将能量储存在背上的环中。白天则把能量分给嫩芽与树苗，让它们茁壮成长。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME basks beneath the moonlight, storing energy within the ring on its back. During the day, it shares its energy with sprouts and saplings, ensuring that they grow big and strong.

entry: POKENAME的脑袋像行星一样相互绕行。周围的能量环吸收的月光越多，就越明亮，散发的光能让看见的生物入睡。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME's heads orbit around each other like planets. The rings of energy around them glow brighter the more moonlight they absorb; the light they give off is able to put those who see it to sleep.

entry: POKENAME喜欢在远处看别人睡觉。若被发现，就会挥骨精准攻击，颇有剑术大师的风范。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME enjoys watching others sleep from afar. If noticed, it attacks with precise bone strikes reminiscent of master swordsmen.

entry: 这种夜行宝可梦，会代谢通过新月形的角吸收的日光。它的棍棒每次击中人或物，都会洒出闪亮的微粒。
author: infinex21
source: A nocturnal Pokémon that metabolizes sunlight absorbed through its crescent horns. Its club scatters shiny particles whenever it strikes someone or something.

entry: POKENAME无论去哪都蹦蹦跳跳，每次跃起之间会漂浮一段。弯月之夜，身后会拖出绚丽的极光。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME prances wherever it goes, floating between each leap. On the night of a crescent moon, a stunning aurora trails behind it.

entry: 锋利的新月形角具有与月之石相似的性质。心情好时，会让训练家做能预知未来的梦。
author: axolotlhunter
source: Its sharp, crescent-shaped horns possess similar properties to moonstone. When happy, it provides prophetic dreams to its Trainer.

entry: POKENAME的翅膀会自行发光，夜间很容易被发现。曾遭偷猎者过度捕猎，如今大多生活在人工饲养的环境中。
author: dodoowner_
source: Since POKENAME's wings are bioluminescent, they are easy to spot at night. They were overhunted by poachers, and are now mostly kept in captivity.

entry: 人们相信，POKENAME身上轻柔飘逸的新月形缎带与梦境世界相连。凝视POKENAME发光的核心，会立刻陷入沉睡。
author: sk372
source: It is believed the wispy crescent ribbons attached to POKENAME's body hold a connection to the Dream World. Gazing into POKENAME's core while it glows causes the viewer to immediately fall into a deep sleep.

entry: POKENAME睡卧的蓬松粉云也是身体的一部分，会随呼吸改变大小。虽然看起来总在睡觉，它仍保持着足以战斗的意识。
author: chibitales
source: The puffy pink cloud POKENAME sleeps on is also a part of its body, changing in size as it breathes. Despite looking as if it is always sleeping, it remains aware enough to battle.

entry: POKENAME从水源中升起，优雅地滑翔过天空，常被误认成流星。据说它在太空中游动时，能找到附近行星上的水。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: POKENAME is often confused for shooting stars as they rise from water sources and glide gracefully across the sky. It is said that they are capable of locating water on nearby planets as they swim through space.

entry: POKENAME奔跑时，颈部的圆盘会高速旋转，产生催眠效果，让旁人入睡。随后又会顽皮地放出一道无害的静电，把对方电醒。
author: ambrosia04
source: When POKENAME run, the disc on their necks spin rapidly, creating a hypnotic effect that lulls others to sleep. They then playfully zap them awake with a harmless bolt of static electricity.

entry: 这只宝可梦能让在附近睡觉的人做美梦。不过，在它影响下做梦越久，就越能看出梦中3D模型粗糙之类的破绽。
author: epping_forest
source: This Pokémon brings sweet dreams to anyone who sleeps nearby. However, the more time someone spends dreaming under its influence, the more obvious such things as the low-quality 3D models of those dreams will become.

entry: POKENAME耐心等待进化，几乎总是一动不动，令人发毛。夜里静坐时，POKENAME会从月光中汲取能量，让其环绕身体。
author: mega_beedrill
source: POKENAME waits patiently for its evolution and is almost always eerily still. As it sits quietly at night, POKENAME gathers energy from the moonlight, which then encircles its body.

entry: POKENAME燃烧的双翼上，闪耀着恒星与星系的图景。其中星辰的排列，似乎与可观测宇宙中的相近。连身上抖落的余烬，也会闪着最后一点星光才消失。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME's flaming wings shine with images of stars and galaxies. The stars shown seem to be similar in placement to those in the observable universe. Even embers shaken from its form glimmer with final motes of starlight before disappearing.

entry: POKENAME体型小巧，又常能让人安然入睡，因此许多父母选它陪伴孩子。蜕去旧皮时，薄纱般的部位会洒出许多明亮微粒。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are favored by many parents as companions for their children due to their small size and the gentle sleep they oft provide. They scatter many bright particles from their veils when they shed and slough their old skins.

entry: 它的结晶遇月光便会发亮，薄纱般的部位也会随之洒出许多闪光微粒。体内积蓄着庞大能量，能灵活释放，用来吓退敌人。
author: infinex21
source: Its crystals glow when exposed to moonlight, which also causes it to release many shining particles from its veils. It accumulates vast energy within itself, which it can deftly loose to deter foes.

entry: POKENAME披上神奇的薄纱，隐身翱翔于繁星夜空，只留下一道淡淡的虹色闪光轨迹。睡前瞥见这道轨迹的人，会做最甜美的梦。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME cloaks itself in a magical veil to hide itself as it soars through the starry night sky, the only evidence of its flight being a faint rainbow trail of sparkles. Those that glimpse the trail before sleeping will have the sweetest of dreams.

entry: 每晚，POKENAME都会在周围轻快穿行，用精神能量让人入睡。被它催眠的人，心灵会暂时彼此相连，共享POKENAME赐予的一场愉快梦中冒险。
author: sk372
source: Every night, POKENAME whisks around the area putting people to sleep with psychic energy. Each person it sends to slumber temporarily links their minds with the others, all sharing the same pleasant dream adventure POKENAME grants them.

entry: 满月之夜，POKENAME会成为出色的猎手。过后，附近的鬼斯和哭哭面具便会多起来。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME becomes a skillful hunter on full-moon nights. After those days, Gastly and Yamask are abundant.

entry: POKENAME能窥入人的潜意识，唤来雾气，重现早已遗忘的梦。POKENAME喜欢睡在云层高度，更让人相信云朵上也能睡觉。
author: gileme__
source: POKENAME can peer into someone's subconscious and summon a mist to reproduce previously forgotten dreams. POKENAME's preference for sleeping at cloud level has fueled the belief that clouds can be slept on.

entry: 有POKENAME在身边会更容易入睡，但梦境似乎总离不开数POKENAME跳栅栏。有记录的最高成绩，也不过数到三就睡着了。
author: musicsheep.
source: Sleeping is easier when POKENAME is around, but seemingly every dream involves counting POKENAME jumping over fences. The highest recorded count before falling asleep is three.

entry: POKENAME总带着一柄形似舂米臼的锤子。每当把锤子砸下，就会释放一阵冲击波，让附近睡意弥漫，敌我双方都会入睡。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are always seen carrying a hammer that resembles a mortar used to pound rice. Whenever they slam their mortar down, it releases a shockwave that spreads drowsiness across the nearby vicinity, putting friends and foes alike to sleep.

entry: POKENAME能在周围产生很微弱的引力，借此接住较小的攻击，并快速连续发出自己的攻击。
author: camtft
source: POKENAME produces a very small gravitational pull around itself. It uses this to catch smaller attacks and fire off its own attacks in rapid succession.

entry: 人们在养鱼场旁饲养POKENAME。它很了解鱼的需求，也能将其传达给人类。养在POKENAME附近的鱼，到了被捞上水面的时候也比较平静。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME are kept alongside fish farms, as they are very attuned to the needs of fish, and can convey it to humans. Fish that are kept in POKENAME's vicinity are calmer when it comes time to bring them to the surface.

entry: 它喜欢悬浮在训练家的脑袋旁，发出近距离的精神波，让人困倦并做上美梦。
author: .flipside3
source: It likes hovering near Trainers' heads. It emits short-range psychic waves that induce sleepiness and cause pleasant dreams.

entry: 月光明亮时，POKENAME会张开鳞片，在月光照耀下闪闪发亮。朔月时则会将鳞片完全合拢。据说它每100年会产生一种驱除噩梦的液体。
author: bobosmith01
source: When the moon is bright, POKENAME's scales are open. As the moonlight shines upon them, they glitter. However, if it is a new moon, their scales are completely closed. It is said that every 100 years, they produce a liquid that wards off nightmares.

entry: POKENAME在现实中撕开孔洞，造出通往梦境的短暂门户。它借此操纵潜意识，为许多饱受恐惧症折磨的人除去噩梦的根源。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME tears holes in reality to create a transient gateway into dreams. It relies on this gateway to manipulate subconscious thoughts, removing the source of nightmares for many plagued with phobias.

entry: POKENAME背上构成圆壳的岩石，看起来很像一轮小月亮。科学家检验化学成分后发现，它与真正的月岩没有区别。
author: beandrawsthings
source: The rock that forms the round shell on POKENAME's back appears much like a small moon. Scientists who have tested the chemical components have found it is indistinguishable from actual moon rock.

entry: POKENAME成群在夜间沿山坡迁行，为途经村庄带去安宁的梦。镇上的农民和织工，会收集它脱落的毛，织成柔软舒适的毯子。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Herds of POKENAME traverse along mountainsides at night, granting peaceful dreams to any villages that they pass by. Farmers and weavers from these towns weave blankets out of shed POKENAME fur to craft into soft, comforting blankets.

entry: POKENAME会出现在熬夜加班、累得睡着的上班族电脑中。它会保存电脑上的全部数据，播放舒缓的音乐，让人安稳休息。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are known to appear on the PCs of tired office workers who fall asleep from pulling all-nighters. They save all the data on the PC and play soothing music to ensure a peaceful rest.

entry: POKENAME会出现在熬夜读书或赶作业的学生电脑中。它会保存文章，为课本页添加书签，并播放宁静的音乐，让学生充分休息。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are known to appear on the PCs of students pulling all-nighters for studying or completing homework. They save essays, bookmark textbook pages, and play peaceful music to ensure students get lots of rest.

entry: POKENAME周围的环，会随月相变化而亮起。满月时，它会整夜献上华丽的舞蹈，用精神力转动鹿角上的两颗圆球。
author: wyzi
source: The ring surrounding POKENAME lights up according to the different phases of the Moon. When it is full, it performs a sumptuous dance all night long, twirling the two spheres on its antlers with its psychic powers.

entry: POKENAME喜欢恶作剧，常在城市中瞬间移动，涂改墙上的涂鸦。若被路人看见，就会再次瞬移离开。
author: camtft
source: POKENAME like to cause mischief. Commonly, they teleport around cities and draw over graffiti. When seen by onlookers, they simply teleport away again.

entry: POKENAME奔跑时，烟雾般的鬃毛会飘出余烬，仿佛点点星光。余烬落到人或宝可梦身上，几乎立刻就能催眠，让其安稳入睡。
author: chibitales
source: As POKENAME runs, embers fly off its smokey mane, resembling motes of starlight. Embers that land on people or Pokémon have a near immediate soporific effect, lulling them into a restful sleep.

entry: 人们初次看见POKENAME，是在一个有月光的夜晚，它从深海浮出，水滴与闪光微粒一同从双翼洒落。它只在夜间活动，飞在云层高度，身后拖着星光般的轨迹。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME was first sighted emerging from deep ocean waters on a moonlit night, with shining particles cascading from its wings together with droplets of water. It only becomes active at night and flies at cloud level with a star-like trail behind it.

entry: POKENAME夜里现身，为孩子带来好梦。常受噩梦困扰的人，会养着它，借摇篮曲般的甜美叫声安睡。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME will appear in the night to bring children good dreams. People with frequent nightmares keep this Pokémon to help them sleep with their sweet lullaby-like cries.

entry: POKENAME擅长寻找和收集由太空落下、含稀有金属的石头。不幸的是，一些想靠这些收藏发财的不法之徒，因此对它趋之若鹜。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has a knack for locating and collecting stones made of rare metals that landed from space. This has unfortunately made them highly sought after by unscrupulous sorts hoping to get rich off their collections.

entry: POKENAME会将附近的巨石带入自己的小小轨道，让它们像卫星一样绕着自己旋转。必要时也能重新放出巨石。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME brings nearby boulders into its own small orbit, where they revolve around it as satellites. If necessary, it can re-release them.

entry: POKENAME会从掌心的孔洞喷出闪光粉尘。吸入的人都会昏倒，弯月之夜甚至会因此陷入昏迷。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME fires blasts of shimmering dust from the holes on its palms. This dust can knock out anyone who breathes it in. On the night of the crescent moon it can even put you into a coma.

entry: POKENAME吸取猎物的血时，双翼会泛起柔和闪烁的光，仿佛星空。它用尾巴缠住敌人，传去安宁梦境的讯号，让对方被了结时也感觉不到疼痛。
author: soup1900
source: When POKENAME drains blood from prey, its wings take on a soft, twinkling glow mimicking a starry night sky. It sends signals of peaceful dreams to foes it wraps its tail around, ensuring they feel no pain when it finishes them off.

entry: POKENAME偶尔会在弯月出现时现身，遇见它的人往往随后会做发热般迷离的梦。这些梦大多不合情理，但几乎所有做梦的人都说，醒来时心情愉快。
author: notadoctor75
source: POKENAME appears sporadically around the crescent moon, and those who encounter it often experience fever-like dreams afterwards. While these dreams rarely make sense to those who have them, almost all dreamers report feeling happy upon waking.

entry: 历史学家认为，POKENAME这类宝可梦，可能是几位著名月亮神话人物的原型。据说它薄纱的光能驱走噩梦，让人整夜安睡，好梦相伴。
author: thatlittletwerp
source: Historians believe that Pokémon such as POKENAME may be the inspiration behind several famous mythological figures associated with the moon. The light of its veil is said to banish nightmares, ensuring a peaceful night's rest and pleasant dreams.

entry: 一些虚构作品把POKENAME描绘为“光之女皇”，会现身消灭那些胆大到敢杀害小精灵或妖精的家伙，无论其出于勇气还是愚蠢。它在领地中飞行时，四片翅膀会洒出许多美丽微粒。
author: infinex21
source: Some works of fiction depict POKENAME as an "Empress of Light" that will appear to eradicate those daring, or foolish, enough to slay pixies or fairies. Its four wings scatter many beautiful particles as it flies about through its territory.

entry: POKENAME会进入受夜惊困扰的孩子梦中，消灭折磨孩子心灵的一切邪恶梦魇。
author: musicsheep.
source: POKENAME enters the dreams of children suffering from night terrors. It vanquishes whatever evil nightmares plague the child's mind.

entry: POKENAME能借月光之力使用复生祈祷。光环剥落的碎屑是珍贵的星尘。
author: dodoowner_
source: A POKENAME can use Revival Blessing with the power of the moonlight. It's halo shredded is a precious stardust.

entry: POKENAME以磁力保持悬浮，移动时留下一道闪光微粒的轨迹。有些地区的人会在床头上方挂POKENAME形状的护符，以免睡不安稳。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME keeps itself aloft through magnetism and leaves behind a trail of shimmering particles as it moves. In some regions, people place POKENAME-shaped charms above their beds to stave off restless sleep.

entry: POKENAME的石头会散发催眠的气场，让附近的人进入甜美梦乡。待人睡着，POKENAME才显形并包裹受害者，吞食他们的美梦。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's stone has a soporific aura, causing those near it to fall into a pleasant slumber. Once asleep, POKENAME manifests itself and envelops its victims in order to consume their happy dreams.

entry: POKENAME踪迹难寻，只在弦月之夜出现。用背上的花能泡出一种特殊的茶，有助入睡，也能带来美梦。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME is an elusive Pokémon, only seen on nights of the quarter moon. A special tea can be brewed from the flower on its back, which promotes sleep and pleasant dreams.

entry: POKENAME通常只在月球上出现，十分罕见，能够驱走可怕的噩梦。取代噩梦的新梦境里，往往满是太古羽虫。
author: dukefrogpeasant
source: Normally found only on the moon, POKENAME are rare creatures capable of warding off terrible nightmares. The dreams they replace those nightmares with are often filled with Anorith.

entry: 两只POKENAME相聚时，会轻轻抵住头骨，接触之处散出闪亮微粒。看似安静平和，其实正展开激烈的精神交锋。这种战斗有何目的，尚不清楚。
author: vic1312
source: When two POKENAME gather, they will gently touch their skulls together, emitting shiny particles where they meet. While they seem quiet and calm, they are engaged in a fierce psychic battle. It is unknown what purpose this combat serves.

entry: 古代壁画描绘过POKENAME守在熟睡的训练家面前，让其安享美梦。如今，POKENAME仍坚持帮自己的训练家睡好觉，用结晶反射舒缓的月光。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Ancient murals depict POKENAME standing guard in front of sleeping Trainers to ensure they dream peacefully. In modern times, POKENAME are insistent on helping their Trainers get proper sleep, reflecting soothing moonlight from their crystals.

entry: 它神出鬼没，会向饱受夜间惊惧的人现身，据说此后便能护其远离噩梦。月光下，POKENAME的铠甲几乎能挡住大多数攻击，力量也能迅速恢复。
author: evilgammon
source: This elusive Pokémon appears to people plagued with night terrors, and is said to shield them from bad dreams thereafter. In the light of the moon, POKENAME's armor is near impervious to most attacks, and is able to recover its strength rapidly.

entry: POKENAME从远处守护尼多一族的群落。察觉群体成员争执过多时，便会飞到上空洒下闪亮粉尘，让所有成员进入平静安宁的睡眠。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME watches over Nidoran colonies from afar. When it senses excessive strife among the pack members, it flies overhead and casts down sparkling dust that sends all the Nidoran into a peaceful, calming slumber.

entry: POKENAME极其罕见，人们认为它只在特定天象出现时现身。据说亲眼瞥见它，就能在余生中夜夜好梦。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is extremely rare, believed to only appear during specific astronomical events. Catching even a glimpse of it in person is said to bless the viewer with pleasant dreams for the rest of their days.

entry: POKENAME的三个环会在夜里微微发光，洒出闪亮微粒，宛如华美的薄纱。它常被受噩梦困扰的人吸引，用鼻子贴住对方的头，给予安慰。
author: infinex21
source: The three loops of a POKENAME will shimmer at night and release shiny particles around them like a majestic veil. They will often be drawn to those plagued with nightmares and press their noses to their heads to offer comfort.

entry: POKENAME喝水时，头上的新月会微微亮起。背上的硬壳，其实由聚集成团的星尘构成。
author: mephone56_93546
source: The crescent moon on its head lights up slightly when POKENAME drinks water. The hard shell on its back is actually made of stardust clumped together.

entry: POKENAME聚在月光下，将能量储存在背上的环中。人或小型宝可梦若睡在自己信赖的POKENAME发光的环下，就会做美梦。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME gather beneath moonlight and store energy along the rings on their backs. Any person or small Pokémon that sleeps beneath a trusted POKENAME's glowing rings will experience sweet dreams.

entry: POKENAME乘着圆环飞驰，探索太空。身上的火焰由气体与星尘组成。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME zips around on its ring, exploring space. Its flame is made of gases and stardust.

entry: POKENAME的头看似石头，实际比看上去轻得多。它似乎最喜欢在满月之夜待在户外。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's head resembles stone, but is much lighter than it looks. It seems to enjoy being outside most on nights of the full moon.

entry: 据说POKENAME会被梦想守护子民的人执掌。只有少数个体是在古老王国的遗迹之外发现的。
author: karmaofevil
source: POKENAME is said to be wielded by those who dream of protecting their people. Only a few have been found outside the ruins of old kingdoms.

entry: POKENAME把让别人睡个好觉视为自己的责任。它夜里巡游城镇，找到熟睡的人便戳一戳；利刃轻轻一刺，就能带来美梦。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME sees a personal duty in ensuring others get a good night's sleep. It patrols towns at night, finding sleepers and poking them; a light jab from its blades has the ability to induce pleasant dreams.

entry: POKENAME常被誉为最美的融合宝可梦之一。只要见过一次，便再也无法忘怀，之后每夜都会梦见它。
author: t3isukone
source: POKENAME is often termed one of the most beautiful fusions of all. Those who see a POKENAME once will never forget it, dreaming of it again night after night.

entry: 半透明的行星环状结构围绕POKENAME的齿轮，转动得如游荡天体般难以捉摸。据说看见它悬浮在夜空，就能安宁地做上一夜好梦。
author: beatdoof
source: Translucent, planet-like rings surround POKENAME's gears, its rotations as erratic as a rogue celestial body. It is said that spotting it hovering in the night sky guarantees a night of serene and peaceful dreams.

entry: POKENAME能制造极其逼真的幻象，用黑暗笼罩天空，诱使夜行宝可梦醒来，再从暗处逐一捕杀。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME have the ability to create incredibly realistic illusions, which they use to cast a veil of darkness across the sky. They do so to lure nocturnal Pokémon out of their slumbers, picking them off from the shadows.

entry: POKENAME在高空挥动触须画圈，释放能让附近所有生物入睡的气场。据说因此睡去的生物，总会做美梦。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME waves its feelers in circular patterns high in the sky to release an aura capable of putting anyone nearby to sleep. It is said that those who succumb to this will always have pleasant dreams.

entry: POKENAME独居于海底洞穴深处。虽喜欢清静，却不会攻击闯入者，只会让其沉睡，再操控海流将其送回水面。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME lives an isolated existence deep within an undersea cavern. Though it prefers solitude, it is not aggressive to intruders: it simply puts them into a deep sleep before manipulating undersea currents to send them back to the surface.

entry: POKENAME能用能力催人入睡，帮助失眠者。丰缘的民间传说称，被POKENAME催眠的人，会梦见它创造各种陆地。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME uses its abilities to put others to sleep, helping those who struggle with insomnia. According to Hoennian folklore, those who are put to sleep by POKENAME will have dreams depicting it creating various landmasses.

entry: 传说中，POKENAME被称为“睡眠守护者”，无休止地巡游天空，奋勇对抗世间的噩梦。飞行时，两片粉色翅膀的灿烂光辉，会在身后留下一道美丽极光。
author: mepp.
source: In legends, POKENAME is called the "Guardian of Sleep" as it endlessly patrols the sky, fiercely fighting the nightmares of the world. As it flies, the radiant glow from its two pink wings leaves behind a beautiful aurora.

entry: POKENAME翱翔天际，用双翼洒下耀眼微粒。POKENAME会使目睹它的人入睡，赠予安宁的梦。数百年前的描绘中，POKENAME会穿过空间裂隙前往梦境世界。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME soar through the skies, scattering dazzling particles with its wings. POKENAME put those who witness it to sleep, giving the observer peaceful dreams. Centuries ago, POKENAME were depicted traveling to the Dream World through spatial rifts.

entry: 它薄纱般的鬃毛会在月光下发亮，洒出许多闪光微粒。有些传说称，这些微粒会化作夜空中更多的星辰。庞大身躯光是移动就耗能巨大，因此需要经常休息。
author: infinex21
source: Its veil-like mane glows under moonlight and scatters many sparkling particles that some legends claim will become more stars in the night sky. It needs to rest often because it uses so much energy just to move its sizeable body.

entry: POKENAME飞行时，身后拖着闪亮微粒。POKENAME借此掩护攻击，在猎物最不提防时，用锋利的钢爪猛然划出。
author: imaginita
source: Shiny particles trail POKENAME while in flight. POKENAME uses them to veil its attack, slicing out with its sharp, steel claws when its prey least expects it.

entry: POKENAME吸收月光，将其转化为电力。满月时力量最强，亮得方圆数英里外都能看见。
author: bostroms
source: POKENAME absorbs moonlight and converts it into electricity. It is at its most powerful during the full moon, when it glows brightly enough to be seen for miles around.

entry: 弯月之夜，POKENAME会在能一览天空的地方悠闲歇息。尾巴飘动，闪耀着正在积蓄的月光能量。它在黎明前离去，等待下一次弯月。
author: chibitales
source: During nights with a crescent moon, POKENAME lounges in areas with an unobstructed view of the sky. Its tails flutter and shine with the lunar energy it's storing. It will leave just before dawn to await the next crescent moon.

entry: 过去，人们有时在梦中见到POKENAME，却不知其为何物，因此一直以为它只是传说。在梦中走近它的人，心中所想会化为现实。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME was originally believed to be a myth in times past, as people sometimes saw it in their dreams without ever knowing who or what it was. The people who approached it in their dreams had what they imagined become reality.

entry: 据说梦见POKENAME是好运的征兆。它会整夜守在做梦的人身边，保护心灵，让其安稳休息，不受噩梦侵扰。
author: ambrosia04
source: Seeing a POKENAME in a dream is said to be a sign of good fortune. It remains by a dreamer's side to guard their mind through the night, ensuring a peaceful rest free from nightmares.

entry: 有些人相信，它的嘴是通往梦境世界的门户，合众目前正对此展开研究。已知的是，POKENAME吃下的东西，很可能会再次出现在训练家的梦中。
author: deadshields
source: Some believe its mouth works as a portal to the Dream World, research on this topic is currently underway in Unova. What is known is that anything POKENAME eats is likely to reappear in its trainer's dreams.

entry: POKENAME由形似新月、相互咬合的齿轮构成，转动受月相决定，因此常被天文台与太空研究中心使用。只有发生蚀象时，它才停止转动。
author: beatdoof
source: Made of interlocking gears resembling crescent moons, POKENAME is often used by observatories and space research centers because its rotation is determined by the phases of the moon. It only stops its movement during an eclipse.

entry: 由于持续转动，POKENAME的一个齿轮会吸收月光能量而膨大。转动中每一处细微变化，以及眼睛的闪烁，都在示意某种特定的月亮现象。
author: beatdoof
source: Due to constant rotation, one of POKENAME's gears absorbs lunar energy and expands. Every minute shift in its rotation, along with the blinking of its eye, signals a specific lunar occurrence.

entry: POKENAME埋进土里睡觉时，身上的环会让独特的蘑菇一夜间冒出。吃下这些蘑菇能快速有效地助眠。
author: sk372
source: When POKENAME buries itself in the soil to sleep, its ring causes unique mushrooms to sprout overnight. The mushrooms are an effective and fast-acting sleep aid when consumed.

entry: POKENAME想要什么时，会发出能传到数英里外的精神讯号。这些讯号通常十分微弱，只有在梦中才能感知。
author: .flipside3
source: When POKENAME wants something, it sends out psychic signals that can travel for miles. These signals are usually too faint to be sensed except while dreaming.

entry: POKENAME在月球的洞穴中数量众多。虽会洒出美丽的星尘，但若不进化，就永远看不到自己的杰作。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME is abundant in caves on the moon. Although it emits a beautiful stardust, if it doesn't evolve, it'll never be able to see its work.

entry: 野生POKENAME会溜进卧室，尽量贴近人类睡觉。熟睡的POKENAME周围泛起的光晕，似乎能让人安稳休息。到了早晨，POKENAME便会蓄满精神力量与电能。
author: .jerden
source: Wild POKENAME sneak into bedrooms to sleep as close to people as they can. The glowing aura around sleeping POKENAME seems to grant others a peaceful rest, and by morning, POKENAME will be fully charged with psychic power and electrical energy.

entry: 野生POKENAME会溜进卧室，尽量贴近人类睡觉。有熟睡的POKENAME在，似乎就能安睡一整夜。到了早晨，POKENAME便会蓄满精神力量与电能。
author: .jerden
source: Wild POKENAME sneak into bedrooms to sleep as close to people as they can. The presence of a sleeping POKENAME seems to guarantee a full night's sleep, and by morning, POKENAME will be fully charged with psychic power and electrical energy.

entry: 盯着POKENAME的嘴看，就会立刻睡着。它喜欢做梦者的鲜血，随后便会吸取对方的生命力。
author: dodoowner_
source: Staring into POKENAME's mouth will immediately make you fall asleep. It then sucks your life force, as it loves the blood of those that are dreaming.

entry: 弯月之夜，POKENAME会挑战能找到的任何虫属性宝可梦，用威风的角将对手掀翻。
author: hophoppip
source: On nights of the crescent moon, POKENAME battles with any other Bug-types it can find, using its impressive horn to flip its opponents over.

entry: POKENAME夜里巡逻荒原，默默守护熟睡的宝可梦。若发现入侵者，就会发出神秘的吼声，却不会惊扰已经入梦的生物。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME patrol through wastelands at night, silently keeping watch over slumbering Pokémon. If a POKENAME spots an intruder, it releases a mystical roar that won't disturb anyone already dreaming.

entry: POKENAME起舞时，新月形的双翼会合成一个完美的圆环。传说若四只步调一致地起舞，所有见证者都会一生好运。
author: duskrd
source: POKENAME's crescent wings form a perfect ring while it dances. Legends say that if four POKENAME dance in sync, all witnesses will be forever lucky.

entry: POKENAME高声庆祝月相变化，一边鸣叫，一边用精神力造出月亮般的物体，在身边旋转。歌声节奏虽欢快，仍会让听者困倦，渐渐入睡。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME loudly celebrate the changing phases of the moon, twirling psychic constructs resembling the moon around themselves as they chirp. Their song induces drowsiness in those who hear them, lulling people to sleep despite the upbeat tempo.

entry: 只有在看得见明月的夜晚，POKENAME才会走出巢穴。双翼闪耀着令人着迷的微粒，飞过后洒落身后。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME only appear from their dens on nights where the moon is visible and shining bright. Their wings shimmer with mesmerizing particles that are scattered in their wake.

entry: POKENAME飞行时，覆盖双翼的闪亮物质会释放淡淡的闪光星尘。偶然接触到这些微粒的人，会感到舒适的睡意涌来。
author: sk372
source: The shimmering material covering POKENAME's wings releases a faint sparkling stardust when it flies. A pleasant drowsiness washes over those that happen to come in contact with the particles.

entry: 有人相信它体内藏着一个独立完整的宇宙。不过，这个大胆的假说尚未得到科学证实。
author: chorb33
source: Some people believe that within its body is a self-contained universe. Such an adventurous hypothesis has not yet been proven by science.

entry: 有人相信它体内藏着一个独立完整的宇宙。不过，这个大胆的假说尚未得到科学证实。
author: chorb33
source: Some people believe that within its body is a self-contained universe. Such an adventurous hypothesis has not yet been proven by science.

entry: POKENAME的黏液非常舒缓，训练家与宝可梦一碰就会犯困。能忍受浑身沾满黏液的训练家，常借POKENAME帮助入睡。
author: elibromax314
source: POKENAME's goo is very relaxing, causing Trainers and Pokémon alike to become sleepy if they touch it. Trainers that can withstand being covered with goo often use POKENAME to fall asleep.

entry: POKENAME从身体放出强光，能让被光触及的生物入睡。趁敌人熟睡时，它会吞食附近的所有光线。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME releases an intense light from its body that can induce sleep in those it touches. While the foe is asleep, it will use this time to consume any light nearby.

entry: 月光最明亮时，POKENAME会在沙漠悬崖上冥想，欣赏闪耀的美景。手臂上的饰物，似乎固定在与太阳、月亮对应的位置。
author: dodoowner_
source: When the moon shines its brightest, POKENAME meditates on a cliff in the desert, admiring the shimmering beauty. The accessories on its arms seem to be fixed in the positions of the sun and the moon.

entry: POKENAME的身体在月光下如星辰般闪烁。受到威胁时，会把构成身体的催眠沙尘抛向敌人，让对方入睡。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME's bodies twinkle in the moonlight like stars. If threatened, they will fling the soporific sand that makes up their bodies at foes, putting them to sleep.

entry: POKENAME的身体在月光下如星辰般闪烁。受到威胁时，会把构成身体的催眠沙尘抛向敌人，让对方入睡。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME's bodies twinkle in the moonlight like stars. If threatened, they will fling the soporific sand that makes up their bodies at foes, putting them to sleep.

entry: POKENAME总是一副舒舒服服的样子。光是待在那里，就能安抚最愤怒的宝可梦，让它们入睡。
author: pokebio
source: POKENAME is always comfy. It's so comfy that its simple presence can calm the most enraged Pokémon and put them to sleep.

entry: POKENAME总张着嘴睡觉，口中展现出壮丽的群星。附近的宝可梦一连看上数小时，也不会厌倦。
author: pokebio
source: POKENAME always sleeps with its mouth open, revealing a magnificent star show. Nearby Pokémon can watch it for hours on end without getting bored.

entry: POKENAME缓缓起舞，唱着催人入梦的迷人摇篮曲。观看演出的对象会陷入沉睡。
author: hexx_vixtar
source: POKENAME dances in a slow rhythm as it sings its hypnotically enchanting lullaby. Those who watch its performance will fall into a deep sleep.

entry: POKENAME的歌声纯净得能让整座夜间营地安静下来。人们相信，在它身旁入睡，就会梦见在沙漠明月下的宁静旅程。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME sings with a tone so pure that it calms entire campsites at night. It is believed that those who slumber near it dream of peaceful voyages beneath glowing desert moons.

entry: 若察觉有人失眠，POKENAME会跋涉数英里赶去。它站到对方家顶上挥动魔杖，几秒内就强制让人入睡。
author: .izik
source: Should POKENAME sense someone suffering from insomnia, it will travel for miles to reach them. It stands atop their home and waves its wand, forcing them to sleep within seconds.

entry: POKENAME能唱出美得罕有的摇篮曲，守护所有伴其歌声入睡的人。据说POKENAME会让听者梦见在月照沙漠中展开的奇妙冒险。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME can sing lullabies of rare beauty, protecting the sleep of anyone who drifts off to its song. It is said that POKENAME makes listeners dream of fantastic adventures across the moonlit sands of the desert.

entry: 据说POKENAME会现身保护做梦者，使其免受噩梦侵扰。目击者很少能记住那些梦，因此人们对它知之甚少。
author: hexx_vixtar
source: POKENAME is said to appear to protect dreamers from nightmares. Little is known about this Pokémon, as few witnesses of it could remember said dreams.

entry: 古老传说中，一位公主因POKENAME的一根羽毛，陷入近乎永恒的沉睡。这种宝可梦很少在人前现身，喜欢独居于宁静森林。
author: chibitales
source: A legend from long ago tells of a princess who was put into a near eternal sleep with a single feather from a POKENAME. These Pokémon rarely show themselves to humans, preferring solitude in quiet forests.

entry: 古老传说中，一位公主因POKENAME的一根羽毛，陷入近乎永恒的沉睡。这种宝可梦很少在人前现身，喜欢独居于宁静森林。
author: chibitales
source: A legend from long ago tells of a princess who was put into a near eternal sleep with a single feather from a POKENAME. These Pokémon rarely show themselves to humans, preferring solitude in quiet forests.

entry: 感染POKENAME的真菌，赋予它强大的灵视能力。POKENAME背上的粉色蘑菇似乎可以取下，但没人见过这团寄生物下方的模样。
author: jojojax164
source: The fungus that infects POKENAME grants it intense clairvoyant power. The pink mushroom POKENAME dons upon its back appears to be removable, though no one has been able to see what is under the parasitic growth.

entry: POKENAME扇动背上的翅膀，会释放催眠微粒，让沾染者安然入睡。它喜欢清静，因此常让旁人睡去，以维持这份安宁。
author: sk372
source: When POKENAME flutters the wings on its back, it releases soporific particles that send those afflicted into a peaceful slumber. It prefers peace and quiet, so it sends others to sleep often to maintain that solace.

entry: POKENAME白天完全看不见，需要靠眼睛反射月光视物。受到挑衅时，会抖落毛皮中的毒粉，在光线下如星辰般闪烁。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are entirely blind during the day, reflecting moonlight off their eyes in order to see. They shake off toxic dust from their fur when provoked, which shimmers like stars in the light.

entry: POKENAME是美梦的守护者，用环形利刃斩破噩梦。它常出现在阴暗恐怖的地方，那里汇聚着大量噩梦，等着POKENAME消灭。
author: mrdunklestein
source: A defender of good dreams, POKENAME slashes through nightmares with its circular blades. It is commonly found near dark, horrifying locations - cesspools of nightmares for POKENAME to vanquish.

entry: 深夜，POKENAME壳上的宝石会涌出闪光薄雾。POKENAME缓步穿过安静的城镇，散播雾气，让人们安稳入睡，再消失于夜色中。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Late at night, a shimmering mist billows out from the gems along POKENAME's shell. POKENAME slowly strolls through quiet towns, spreading its mist to ensure that the people  sleep peacefully before it disappears into the night.

entry: POKENAME头上长出的果实，甜美无比、营养极丰富，据说味道像棉花糖与火龙果。果实要整整一个月才能重新长出，因此它只会送给最需要这些营养的人。
author: mochauspocus
source: The fruit growing on POKENAME's head is an incredibly sweet superfood, said to taste like cotton candy and dragonfruit. Since it takes a full month to regrow, it only gives the fruit to those who most need the nutrients it provides.

entry: POKENAME翅膀脱落的细小鳞片，如星尘般散入夜空。它快速飞过上空，让飞行路线下方的所有生物短暂入眠，做上美梦。
author: sk372
source: Small scales shed from POKENAME's wing scatter like stardust in the night sky. It flies quickly overhead, putting anyone under its flight path into a short slumber filled with pleasant dreams.

entry: POKENAME让伴侣二人沉睡，梦见共同的未来。人们认为，这种共享心意的时刻挽救了许多婚姻，因此POKENAME颇受欢迎。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME lull couples into a deep sleep to give them dreams about their future together. This moment of shared unity has been credited with saving many marriages, making POKENAME quite popular.

entry: POKENAME靠精神力量，将梦境变得愉快。它会在梦里留下一只施了魔法的特殊橡皮鸭，作为自己的标记。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME rely on their psychic powers to help transform dreams into a pleasant experience. Their calling card is a special enchanted rubber duck that is left inside dreams.

entry: POKENAME见到人的第一反应，就是挥拳将其打昏。人们认为这并非暴力之举，因为昏迷的受害者会做美梦，梦见与POKENAME一同玩耍。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's first instinct upon meeting someone is to punch them and knock them out. It is believed this isn't a violent act, due to the unconscious victims having pleasant dreams of playing alongside POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME用强大的精神力量，让附近的生物陷入沉睡。梦境不但愉快，还能传授知识，醒来后智力会明显提高。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses its powerful psychic powers to put those near it into a deep slumber. Their dreams are pleasant but also serve to educate them; their intelligence is notably increased after waking up.

entry: POKENAME睡前会跳一套节奏复杂的舞蹈。瑜伽专家声称，这些舞蹈有助睡眠。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: To ready itself for sleep, POKENAME performs an intricate rhythmic dance. Experts on yoga claim these dances help with sleeping.

entry: POKENAME的壳看起来与真正的月球一模一样。训练家甚至注意到，每当真正的月球遭流星撞击，自己的POKENAME身上也会出现新的环形坑。
author: moopse
source: POKENAME's shell appears to be identical to that of the actual moon. Trainers have even noted new craters appearing on their POKENAME whenever the real moon is hit by meteors.

entry: 曾有人在满月下观察到几只带着发光圆环的POKENAME。它们悬浮在池塘与河流上空，将水向上吸成水柱。
author: chorb33
source: A few POKENAME with glowing rings have been observed hovering over ponds and rivers under a full moon, drawing water upwards into pillars.

entry: POKENAME的各个球体都有很强的引力，悬浮在水面上方时会吸起水流，掀起波浪。
author: chorb33
source: Because its individual spheres have a strong gravitational pull, POKENAME attracts water when it hovers above the surface, causing waves.

entry: POKENAME的身体由未知物质构成，似乎与月球物质密切相关。长时间接触会使人困倦，顺势睡去的人会梦见关于太空的美梦。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's body is made out of an unknown substance, though it appears closely related to lunar materials. Prolonged exposure leads to drowsiness, and those who give in to sleep have pleasant dreams about space.

entry: POKENAME光彩夺目。连怕虫怕得要命的人，都不介意POKENAME爬到自己身上。它的魅力就是如此惊人。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME is an absolutely dazzling Pokémon. Even those who are deathly afraid of bugs do not mind a POKENAME crawling up onto them. Such is the extent of this creature's charisma.

entry: POKENAME能用一团烟雾，瞬间给人的脸化妆，留下鲜艳得俗气的色彩。许多小丑乐意请POKENAME帮忙上妆，画出新奇有趣的图案。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can instantly apply cosmetics to people's faces with a cloud of smoke, leaving people with garishly bright colors on their face. Many clowns happily allow POKENAME to help them apply makeup to create new and exciting patterns.

entry: 它不停从毛孔喷出浓稠、多彩且致幻性极强的气体，让敌人迷醉得无力战斗，轻易将其压倒。
author: hophoppip
source: The gas it constantly spews from its pores is thick, colorful, and strongly hallucinogenic. It easily overpowers its foes by making them too intoxicated to fight.

entry: POKENAME的颜色会随心情快速变化。有些对手光看着就会头晕。
author: camtft
source: The colors of POKENAME rapidly change in response to their mood. Some opponents become dizzy at the sight of them.

entry: 它用力扇动翅膀，释放各种有毒孢子。孢子还含有色素，它会涂在皮肤上衬托自身色彩，就像化妆一样。
author: foolish_weasel
source: It releases a variety of toxic spores by flapping its wings vigorously. Additionally, these spores have pigments that it puts on its own skin to compliment its coloring, not unlike applying makeup.

entry: POKENAME穿着古怪而优雅的裙装，能借此在水中快速游动。它会咬住船只，唱出诡异的歌，让水手心生恐惧。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have an eccentric yet elegant dress that allows them to swim quickly in water. They are known to bite onto ships and sing eerie songs that instill a sense of dread in sailors.

entry: POKENAME将两只钳子互相碰撞，向周围发出精神能量脉冲，让猎物剧烈头痛，痛得无法躲开它的逼近。
author: sk372
source: Clashing POKENAME's two pincers together sends out pulses of psychic energy around it. Using this, it gives prey crushing headaches that leave them too wracked with pain to avoid its approach.

entry: 这种宝可梦最初在平柑岛附近被发现，因此科学家对POKENAME鲜亮的粉色是否来自饮食，仍争论不休。它脾气暴躁，发狂时破坏力极强，很难研究。
author: milchik
source: Because this species was first discovered near the Pinkan Island, scientists debate on whether POKENAME's bright pink colors are the result of its diet or not. This Pokémon is hard to study due to its hot temper and how destructive its rampages are.

entry: POKENAME身上劈啪跳动着多彩电流。被POKENAME电击后，会看见闪烁色彩的幻觉。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's body crackles with multicolored electricity. Getting electrocuted by a POKENAME will make you hallucinate flashing colors.

entry: 它曾住在史前海岸，以钻石般的牙咬穿菊石兽、化石盔等宝可梦的外壳。
author: staghorn
source: It once lived on prehistoric coasts, using its diamond-like teeth to bite through the shells of Omanyte, Kabuto, and similar Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME每次发动精神能量屏障时都会磨牙。球形屏障还会让噪声回荡，折磨附近生物的心神。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME grinds its teeth whenever it activates its barrier of psychic energy. The sphere-shaped barrier also causes the noise to echo and grate on the minds of those near it.

entry: POKENAME的花瓣不断闪动，色彩剧烈变换，让捕食者晕头转向。长脖子能伸到棕榈树高处够取椰子，再用牙齿撕开硬壳。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME's petals pulse and shift colors wildly, disorienting predators. Their long necks allow them to reach coconuts high up in palm trees, tearing through their shells with their teeth.

entry: 它的火焰色彩夺目。这些颜色来自POKENAME的饮食，因此它常吃颜色鲜艳的食物，连美术用品也不放过。
author: hophoppip
source: Its flames burn in striking colors. The source of these colors is POKENAME's diet, so it frequently dines on brightly colored foods and even art supplies.

entry: 为了维持背上的多彩火焰，POKENAME每天必须吃下超过十二罐颜料，往往把这件事看得比吃真正的食物还重要。
author: dylonk25
source: To sustain the colorful blaze on its back, POKENAME must eat over a dozen cans of paint per day. It tends to prioritize this over actual food.

entry: 它从土中拔出根或虫子，然后大口吃个饱。若还没力气独自捕猎，有些人会给它肌力之羽，帮它增强力量。
author: quackquackattack
source: It yanks roots or bugs from the ground before stuffing itself with the meal. If it is not strong enough to hunt on its own, some people give it a Muscle Feather to give it an extra boost.

entry: POKENAME的毛皮色泽美丽、富有光泽，很受制作毛织衣物的人欢迎。宝可梦巡护员需要保护它的族群，免得野外数量减少过度。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The fur of POKENAME has a beautiful sheen and colour to it. This makes them a popular source of wool for clothing items. Their populations need protection by Pokémon Rangers to help ensure they are not overly depleted in the wild.

entry: POKENAME毛皮光滑美丽，是讲究时尚的训练家十分喜爱的伙伴。它在野外的分布地点受到严密保密，以免族群数量减少过度。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have sleek and beautiful fur and are very popular companions for fashion-conscious Pokémon Trainers. Their location in the wild is a closely guarded secret to make sure that their population doesn't become too depleted.

entry: POKENAME与善良的人相处时，会开心地磨牙。不幸的是，这让那些人十分烦躁，最终把POKENAME赶走。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME grinds its teeth in happiness when it is with kind people. Unfortunately, this act causes great annoyance to said people, leading to POKENAME being shooed away.

entry: POKENAME的羊毛不停闪烁着令人眼花缭乱、具有催眠效果的图案。人们开发了专用眼镜，免得饲养它的牧场主看得发晕。可惜，眼镜挡不住羊毛中积起的静电。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME's wool constantly shimmers with a dazzling, hypnotic pattern. To help Ranchers raising these Pokémon avoid being dazed, special glasses have been developed. Unfortunately, they do not help much against any static built up in POKENAME's wool.

entry: 跳舞时，花瓣彼此摩擦，发出磨牙般的声音。据说这舞蹈，是唤醒海中某种存在的仪式。
author: apixelperfectionist
source: When it dances, its petals rub together and make a sound like gnashing teeth. It's said that their dance is a ritual to awaken something in the ocean.

entry: POKENAME以令人不安的外表和脉动噪声般的精神波，震慑猎物与捕食者。它靠捡食为生，会吓跑刚捕猎成功的宝可梦，享用它们的战利品。
author: pickledthyme
source: POKENAME uses its unnerving appearance and psychic waves of pulsing noise to stun prey and predator alike. It scavenges, scaring off other Pokémon after their successful hunts to feast on their spoils.

entry: POKENAME用鳍乘风，轻松漂浮在水面上。它先用闪亮鳞片迷住猎物，再将其拖入波涛之下。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME floats effortlessly above the water's surface, using its fins to catch the wind. It mesmerizes prey with its shimmering scales before dragging them beneath the waves.

entry: POKENAME为自己的外貌自豪，每天花好几个小时梳理打扮。谁敢嘲笑它的长相，尾巴上的嘴就会立刻咬过去。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME takes pride in its appearance, which it maintains with hours of grooming a day. The mouth on its tail will quickly chomp at anyone who dares to insult its looks.

entry: POKENAME头上的大舌贝看似一双柔软嘴唇，牙齿却十分锋利。因此，每当大舌贝咬紧，POKENAME就会突然暴躁起来。
author: hophoppip
source: Though the Shellder on POKENAME's head looks like a soft pair of lips, its teeth are quite sharp, hence POKENAME's burst of aggression when the Shellder bites down.

entry: 它的身体由色彩鲜艳、容易崩裂的石头构成。POKENAME身上掉落的碎块，可当作耐水的路面彩色粉笔。
author: hophoppip
source: Its body is made of brightly-colored stone that easily chips. Broken pieces of POKENAME's body can be used as water-resistant sidewalk chalk.

entry: POKENAME身体虽色彩斑斓，却像钢铁一样坚硬。它能用颚状口器轻易撕开珊瑚礁，在其中猎食爱心鱼。
author: kam_doodle_snek
source: Despite its colorful body, POKENAME is as tough as steel. Using its jaw-like mandibles, it can easily tear through coral reefs, where it hunts for Luvdisc to feed on.

entry: 它非常珍爱自己的爪子，花许多时间在树上打磨，修出完美的形状与长度。为了不毁掉心血，它选择以牙齿作为主要的近身武器。
author: hophoppip
source: It's highly proud of its claws, which it spends much time filing on trees to achieve the perfect shape and length. To avoid ruining its hard work, it opts to use its teeth as its primary physical weapon.

entry: POKENAME壳上的斑点会以令人眩晕的图案闪动，迷惑猎物和捕食者。它的利齿能切开坚硬的壳，古代沿海村庄曾用来制作武器。
author: chibitales
source: The spots on POKENAME's shell flash in disorienting patterns to confuse prey and predators. Their sharp teeth were used to make weaponry in ancient coastal villages, as they can shear through tough shells.

entry: POKENAME虽是拥有强壮颚部的顶尖猎手，许多训练家仍因它俗艳的配色而不愿收服。许多个体因此怨恨训练家，被拒绝时便会攻击。
author: quackquackattack
source: Even though POKENAME are apex hunters with a powerful jaw, many Trainers decide not to capture them because of their lurid colors. Many develop a spitefulness for Trainers and attack when they are rejected.

entry: POKENAME的尖牙能咬碎小型水生生物的壳。它习惯吐出高压水柱，让猎物受惊并失去方向。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's sharp teeth allow it to crush the shells of smaller aquatic creatures. It has a habit of spitting high-pressure jets of water to startle and disorient prey.

entry: POKENAME通过磨牙发动精神力量，发出刺耳的静电噪声般的响动。主要用这份力量在身边形成精神护盾，保护自己。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME activates its psychic powers by grinding its teeth together, making a grating static-like noise. It primarily uses its power to generate a psychic shield around itself for defense.

entry: 它俗艳的鲜明配色是一种警告。毒刺会向猎物注入强效且同样鲜艳的毒液，经适当处理，也能当作化妆品染料。
author: hophoppip
source: Its garishly vivid coloration serves as a warning. Its stinger injects prey with potent and equally vivid venom, which can also be used as a dye in makeup with proper treatment.

entry: POKENAME每次动用精神能力时，头冠周围都会燃起俗艳的多彩火焰。它奔行大地，唤醒休眠火山，给各地带来混乱。
author: sk372
source: A garish, multicolored flame surrounds POKENAME's crest whenever it uses its psychic abilities. It races across the land, awakening dormant volcanoes in order to cause havoc among populations.

entry: POKENAME的尾巴与额头圆斑都能产生闪电。电流总是呈现不断变换的鲜艳色彩，让战斗如同一场奇观。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can generate lightning from both its tail and the circle on its forehead. The electricity it creates always comes out in a shifting, vibrant variety of colors, making combat a spectacle.

entry: POKENAME翱翔天际，所到之处都留下彩虹。鲜艳的羽毛十分醒目，但许多训练家嫌它外貌俗艳，不愿追赶。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME soar through the sky leaving rainbows behind them wherever they go. Their brightly colored feathers make them easy to spot, yet many Trainers opt not to chase after them because of their garish appearance.

entry: POKENAME在陆地与水下都自在自如。POKENAME的尾巴很擅长抓住树枝和珊瑚枝，能在林间或珊瑚礁间高速荡行。
author: shreks_stepfather
source: POKENAME is equally at home on land and underwater. POKENAME's tails are very proficient at gripping both tree limbs and coral branches, allowing it to swing through woodlands or reefs at high speeds.

entry: 它的喙里长满利齿，一击就能咬碎石头。POKENAME会把鲜艳羽毛抖落到敌人身上，警告对方：强力攻击即将到来。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its beak is lined with sharp fangs capable of crushing stones in a single strike. POKENAME sheds its brightly colored feathers over its foes as a warning that a powerful attack is about to follow.

entry: 它攻击时放出的电火花色彩鲜艳而美丽。因不喜欢弄脏或弄伤自己，会从远处放电攻击。
author: hophoppip
source: The electrical sparks it emits when attacking are brightly colored and beautiful. It releases shocks from afar, as it dislikes getting dirty or roughed up.

entry: POKENAME头上的突起能产生电场，用来探测水下的其他宝可梦。找到猎物后，POKENAME就漂过去，用满口利齿咬住。
author: .jerden
source: The protuberance on its head generates an electric field that POKENAME can use to detect other Pokémon underwater. After using this to locate prey, POKENAME will float over to sink in its many sharp teeth.

entry: POKENAME对自己的外貌很没自信，会攻击一切比自己漂亮的对象，常常因此引发混乱。
author: gurguro
source: POKENAME are very insecure about their looks and will assault anything that looks prettier than them. This frequently results in chaos.

entry: POKENAME能从双臂末端喷射热水。除了直接攻击，在水下还会用沸腾的气泡包围敌人，令其晕头转向，再趁乱用尖牙进攻。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME fires hot water from the ends of its arms. While it can use this to attack directly, when underwater it disorientates foes by surrounding them with boiling bubbles, then strikes with its fangs in the confusion.

entry: POKENAME在网上看到喜欢的图片时，身体的鲜艳色彩会剧烈变化。可惜，图片也会因此失真，颜色奇怪地跟着它的身体变换。
author: .izik
source: The bright colors on POKENAME's body dance wildly when it finds an image it likes online. This unfortunately causes the image to distort as well, shifting its colors in odd ways that mirror the changes on its own body.

entry: 这只骄傲的宝可梦讨厌被忽视。若觉得自己的训练家太过傲慢，便可能用魔法诡计与精神催眠暗中捣乱。
author: hophoppip
source: A prideful Pokémon with that dislikes being ignored. If it believes its Trainer too be too arrogant, it may sabotage them with magical tricks and psychic hypnosis.

entry: POKENAME相当狡诈，总想获得更多力量。计谋虽然聪明，却总被野生宝可梦或训练家的行动破坏。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are quite devious and are always seeking more power. While they have clever schemes, they are always foiled by wild Pokémon or their Trainer's actions.

entry: POKENAME头顶悬浮的器官，散发奇异而鲜艳的光，吸引其他生物靠近。从正面看会轻微头痛并出现幻觉，据说从背面看，更会永久损伤人的心智与灵魂。
author: sk372
source: The organ floating above POKENAME's head emits an odd, vibrant glow that draws others closer. Viewed from the front, it causes mild headaches and hallucinations, but it's said viewing it from behind will permanently damage a person's mind and soul.

entry: 人们认为，它体表长出的珊瑚是神经系统的重要部分。不过，珊瑚远比钢铁坚硬，战斗时瞄准那里也没用。
author: stevethebarbarian
source: The coral growths on its surface are believed to be critical parts of its nervous system. However, they are much harder than steel, so aiming for them isn't effective in battle.

entry: 远处传来咯吱磨牙声，就表示POKENAME来了。这烦人的声音会影响附近生物的心智，让POKENAME更容易用幽灵力量下咒。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME makes itself known by the sound of gnashing and grating teeth echoing in the distance. This irritating sound affects the minds of those nearby, making it easier for POKENAME to hex them with its ghostly abilities.

entry: POKENAME为自己的巨口自豪，会故意磨动、咬合大嘴里的牙齿炫耀。若因此不小心崩坏或掉了一颗牙，几乎怎么安慰都没用。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME grinds and gnashes the teeth within its large mouth as a way of showboating, proud of its giant maw. If it accidentally chips or loses a tooth doing this, it becomes almost inconsolable.

entry: 雄性POKENAME遇到雌性时，会缓缓摆动鳍来吸引对方。一旦结为伴侣，就会相守终生。
author: zeeroooo
source: When a male POKENAME encounters a female, it will wave its fins in a slow motion to impress her. These Pokémon mate for life when bonded.

entry: POKENAME是奇异的海底生物，厌恶闯入领地者，会从头部放出精神能量脉冲驱赶。它占据的深海洞穴，常装点着鲜艳的珊瑚与海生植物。
author: sk372
source: As a strange undersea being, POKENAME detests intruders in its domain and repels them with pulsing psychic energy from its cranium. The deep-sea caverns it claims are often decorated with bright coral and undersea plants.

entry: 它的牙齿像刀刃一样锋利。据说牙齿相互磨动的声音，比被它刺中还痛苦。
author: kiwiarms
source: Its teeth are as sharp as its blade, and the sound of them gnashing together is said to be more painful than being stabbed by it.

entry: 宝可梦对战中，POKENAME会展示能反光的鳞片，让对手平静。待对方放松下来，就猛扑过去，用尖锐参差的牙齿咬住。
author: quackquackattack
source: During a Pokémon battle, POKENAME flourish their reflective scales to induce calmness in opponents. Once pacified, they lunge forward to bite with sharp, jagged teeth.

entry: POKENAME性情温和，在海中漫游，寻找舒适的睡觉地点。反光的鳞片能让周围宝可梦平静，使它能在海底安稳入睡。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are benign creatures that roam the ocean for a nice place to sleep. Their reflective scales calm other Pokémon around them so that they can peacefully sleep on the ocean floor.

entry: POKENAME耀眼的外貌散发一种气场，让所有看见的生物顿觉舒心，觉得POKENAME既可爱又美丽。一旦它露出大大的开心笑容，就要直攻对手的弱点了。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's dazzling appearance radiates auras that cause anyone looking to suddenly feel soothed and believe POKENAME to be very cute and beautiful. When it takes on a big, happy smile, it is about to attack straight at an opponent's weak spot.

entry: POKENAME耀眼的外貌散发一种气场，让所有看见的生物顿觉舒心，觉得POKENAME既可爱又美丽。一旦它露出大大的灿烂笑容，就要直攻对手的弱点了。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's dazzling appearance radiates auras that cause anyone looking to suddenly feel soothed and believe POKENAME to be very cute and beautiful. When it takes on a big, bright smile, it is about to attack straight at an opponent's weak spot.

entry: POKENAME从深海向熟睡宝可梦的心中发出精神脉冲，让其噩梦连连。它们休息不好，疲惫得无力逃脱POKENAME的巨口。
author: wiz0z
source: From the depths of the ocean, POKENAME release psychic pulses into the minds of sleeping Pokémon, filling them with nightmares. These Pokémon are unable to get proper rest, leaving them too tired to escape POKENAME's jaws.

entry: 它背上伸出的精神器官如同一门灵能炮，能从远处让整群人恶心作呕。
