author: kiwiarms
source: The psychic organ protruding from its back acts as a psionic cannon, able to induce nausea in entire crowds from afar.

entry: POKENAME的蜡中含有化学物质，因此火焰呈多种颜色。若把牙齿磨得咯咯响，火就会烧得更旺，色彩也更鲜明。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME's flame is multicolored due to the chemicals present in its wax. If it gnashes its teeth together, the fire will burn larger and more vibrantly.

entry: POKENAME能纹丝不动地站着，靠鲜艳配色融入珊瑚礁。花形头冠感知有宝可梦接近时，POKENAME便想用有力的双臂抓住，可往往动作不够快。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME can stand totally motionless, using its bright coloration to blend in with coral reefs. When its flower-shaped crest senses another Pokémon approaching, POKENAME will try to grab it with its powerful arms, but it often isn't fast enough.

entry: 它渴望被认为美丽，因此用化妆品和美容用品装扮自己。据说破布下的真容恐怖得能让人动弹不得。
author: hophoppip
source: It longs to be seen as beautiful, so it decorates itself with makeup and beauty supplies. The true face beneath its rag is said to be paralyzingly horrific.

entry: 它们鲜艳的鳞片是极强的颜料，待在附近都要当心被染上颜色。更糟的是，皮肤接触鳞片还曾引起刺激和皮疹。
author: ocxin
source: Their colorful scales make for a highly potent color pigment, so much so that one must take care not to get stained in their vicinity. Worse still, skin contact with the scales has been known to cause irritations and rashes.

entry: POKENAME唱歌时，头上的突起会奇怪地扭动，激发精神能量向外涌出，更有效地让听见歌声的生物沉睡。
author: sk372
source: The protuberance on POKENAME's head wiggles about strangely as it sings. The gyration stimulates its psychic energy, cascading outward to better send those who hear its song into a deep slumber.

entry: 据说死后仍不肯移开自恋目光的灵魂，会在彼岸变成POKENAME。若打断它照镜子欣赏自己，就会勃然大怒。
author: milchik
source: The spirits of the most narcissistic of people who can't tear their gazes from themselves even after death are thought to become this Pokémon in the afterlife. POKENAME will get furious if distracted from admiring itself in the mirror.

entry: POKENAME会尾随参加宝可梦华丽大赛的训练家，盼着被收服。大而俗艳的牙齿却吓跑了大多数训练家，它只好另找一人跟踪。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME is known to stalk Trainers who compete in Pokémon Contests, hoping to get caught. Its large, garish teeth scare most Trainers away, which leads it to find another Trainer to stalk.

entry: POKENAME的翅膀涌动着精神力量，迷惑对手，随后便以尖牙和拍打的双翼进攻。
author: chibitales
source: The wings of POKENAME pulse with psychic power to confuse opponents. It then strikes with sharp teeth and battering wings.

entry: POKENAME先用催眠舞蹈震慑目标，再用剃刀般锋利的牙齿咬住。常能看见POKENAME成群共舞，安抚海中的鱼群，好饱餐一顿。
author: npshi
source: POKENAME stun their targets with a hypnotic dance before biting down onto them with their razor-sharp teeth. POKENAME are often seen in flocks, dancing together to pacify schools of ocean fish for their next meal.

entry: POKENAME的舞蹈将水搅成螺旋幻景，花形宝石有节奏地脉动，扭曲光与声音，化作催眠的潮汐。在它水域附近受困的生物，会被卷入潮中，屈服于令人发狂的摇篮曲。
author: vhscopyofmeangirls
source: POKENAME's dance stirs water into spiraling mirages, its floral gem pulsing rhythmically to warp light and sound into hypnotic tides. Those caught out near its waters find themselves pulled into its tide, succumbing to a lullaby of madness.

entry: POKENAME翻找垃圾桶，使用剩下的化妆品。虽然外貌俗艳，它仍梦想参加宝可梦华丽大赛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME digs through garbage cans to use leftover cosmetics. It aspires to participate in Pokémon Contests despite its garish appearance.

entry: 只要颜色鲜艳，POKENAME什么都吃，无论看上去多么不能入口。它用刚吃下的东西制成鲜艳液体，喷射出来抵御敌人。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME will consume anything brightly-colored, no matter how inedible it looks. It fends off enemies with blasts of vivid fluid made from whatever it's recently eaten.

entry: POKENAME磨牙放出精神波，让旅人晕头转向，迷失森林。待他们恐惧地徘徊时，POKENAME又用幽灵魔法进一步折磨。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME grinds its teeth to send out psychic waves that disorient travelers and get them lost in the forest. While they wander in fear, POKENAME torments them further with its ghostly magic.

entry: 大群POKENAME飞在海面上，兴奋地向彼此炫耀鲜艳色彩。夜间会睡在珊瑚礁中，保持伪装。
author: mistymagius
source: Large groups of POKENAME can be seen flying above the ocean, enthusiastically showing off their bright colors to each other. During the night, they sleep amongst coral reefs to keep themselves camouflaged.

entry: 它昂首阔步，炫耀外貌，脚步声响彻大地。科学家目前还不清楚，它的耳环究竟挂在哪里。
author: hophoppip
source: The sound of its footsteps echoes through the land as it struts about, flaunting its appearance. Scientists are currently unsure what its earrings are attached to.

entry: POKENAME的歌声刺耳，许多人都很讨厌。不过，谁若表现出不满，就会被灌注精神力量的旋律击中，大脑中的所有情绪都彻底麻木。
author: soup1900
source: The sounds POKENAME makes when it sings are grating and are hated by many people. However, anyone who displays their disliking of the songs will be shot with psychokinetic-infused melodies that completely paralyze all emotions in the brain.

entry: POKENAME的歌声刺耳，许多人都很讨厌。不过，谁若表现出不满，就会被灌注精神力量的旋律击中，大脑中的所有情绪都彻底麻木。
author: soup1900
source: The sounds POKENAME makes when it sings are grating and are hated by many people. However, anyone who displays their disliking of the songs will be shot with psychokinetic-infused melodies that completely paralyze all emotions in the brain.

entry: POKENAME耀眼的舞姿，让猎物惊叹得愣住。随后会吹出由精神能量构成的飞吻，让对方身心麻痹，再吞食充作下一餐。
author: soup1900
source: The movements from POKENAME's dazzling dances leave prey stunned in awe. It then blows a kiss made of psychic energy to physically and mentally paralyze them before devouring them as its next meal.

entry: POKENAME在珊瑚礁间爬行觅食。虽然主要吃藻类，凡是塞得进嘴里的东西都会吞下，若不加控制，就会重创生态系统。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME scuttle around coral reefs, searching for food. While they mostly eat algae, they devour anything that can fit in their mouths, and will devastate the ecosystem if left unchecked.

entry: POKENAME喜欢搜集能找到的最绚丽的珍珠，常袭击成群的珍珠贝，抢走它们的宝物。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME have a tendency to collect the most colorful pearls they can find. They often attack groups of Clamperl, stealing their treasures.

entry: 一位著名画家曾以宠物POKENAME为灵感画了一组画，结果宠物买卖盛行，野生POKENAME数量骤减。不过，保育人士已成功让族群数量回升。
author: beetlething
source: A famous artist once used their pet POKENAME as a muse for a series of paintings, causing the population of wild POKENAME to go down significantly from pet sales. However, conservationists have been successful in bringing the numbers back up.

entry: POKENAME必须保持脸和嘴唇清洁，否则会被族群驱逐。独居的日子很不好过，因为鲜艳的颜色很容易被捕食者发现。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME must keep their face and lips clean, or else they'll be expelled from their clan. They do not do well by themselves, as their bright color causes predators to easily spot them.

entry: 它磨动硬糖牙齿，发出精神频率。头两侧的球体有层次丰富、浓郁鲜明的水果味，却也酸得惊人，因此训练家常被人激着去舔一口。
author: hophoppip
source: It grinds its hard-candy teeth to emit psychic frequencies. The spheres on either side of its head have a complex and vivid fruity flavor, but they're also incredibly sour, so Trainers are often dared to lick them.

entry: POKENAME悠闲地待在浑浊池塘中，用鲜艳鳞片引来毫无防备的猎物。受惊时会发出诡异笑声，连更大的宝可梦也会吓一跳。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME lounges in murky ponds, using its vibrant scales to lure in unsuspecting prey. It lets out eerie laughter when startled, startling even larger Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME的鳞片在月光下闪耀，让潜水员争相一睹。它会释放令人放松的信息素，使附近的宝可梦无法集中精神。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's scales shimmer in the moonlight, making it a sought-after sight for divers. It releases a relaxing pheromone that causes Pokémon nearby to lose focus.

entry: POKENAME有很强的超能力潜质，牙齿也强壮有力。被POKENAME咬一口就会传送到可怕地方的传言，一直流传不绝，却没有证据。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME possesses strong psychic potential as well as strong teeth. Many rumors persist that a bite from a POKENAME will teleport you somewhere terrible, though these are unsubstantiated claims.

entry: POKENAME身上的鲜艳配色并非天生，而是用口红般的管状物画上去的。虽说如此，它通常并不以艺术才能闻名。
author: dylonk25
source: The bright coloration of POKENAME's body is not inherent; it paints patterns on itself using a lipstick-like tube. Despite this fact, it is not generally known for its artistic capability.

entry: POKENAME浓烈的色彩与爱吹飞吻的习惯，常让对手失去戒心。据说与POKENAME对战，既让人迷惑不解，又十分痛苦。
author: dylonk25
source: POKENAME's intense coloration and habit of blowing kisses has a tendency to put its opponents off guard. Fighting POKENAME is said to be a deeply confusing and painful experience.

entry: POKENAME战斗如同演戏，会展示肌肉，夸张地摆动身体，还从头顶的小附肢喷出鲜艳的水。
author: dylonk25
source: POKENAME fights in a theatrical manner, flexing its muscles and exaggerating its motions. It spouts brightly colored water out of the small appendage on its head.

entry: POKENAME的第三个头没有眼睛，却能靠第一个头花朵放出的精神脉冲看见周围。这些脉冲能感知最远50英尺外的意图与情绪。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's third head has no eyes but can see through psychic bursts emitted from the flower on the first head. These bursts can sense intent and emotions from up to 50 feet away.

entry: 它潜伏水中的多彩污泥，会把水染得鲜艳。看着虽美，对人和宝可梦却完全不安全，因为POKENAME的污泥有毒。
author: hophoppip
source: The waters it lurks in are dyed in vivid colors by its chromatic sludge. Though pretty, this water is entirely unsafe for humans and Pokémon, as POKENAME's sludge is toxic.

entry: POKENAME在海底游荡，吸收恰好漂到附近的任何垃圾。环保人士特意在肮脏海域繁育它，试图减少污染。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME wanders on the ocean floor, absorbing any trash that happens to float nearby. Environmentalists intentionally breed it in filthy seas in an effort to reduce the pollution.

entry: POKENAME会利用自身配色躲进壳里，迷惑潜水员。等对方靠得太近，就用极其锋利的牙齿攻击。
author: seanothan_23
source: Because of POKENAME's colors, they like to confuse divers by hiding in their shell. When the divers get too close, they attack with their extremely sharp teeth.

entry: POKENAME颚部的力量堪比捕兽夹，会夹住任何靠得太近的东西。它还用硕大、如披甲般的嘴唇，砸开硬壳猎物。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's jaw strength rivals that of steel traps, clamping onto anything that wanders too close. It uses its large, armored lips to smash open hard-shelled prey.

entry: POKENAME夜里闹鬼，折磨家中那些不符合它审美的人。它实在太自负，至今没有任何人达到标准的记录。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME haunts homes at night, tormenting those that don't meet its standards of beauty. Because of its massive ego, there have been no records of anyone meeting said criteria.

entry: POKENAME极其虚荣，阻止它四处闹鬼最快的办法，就是用泥污把它弄脏。它会急忙逃去，执着地重新打扮，一时半会儿不太可能回来。
author: sk372
source: Extremely vain, the quickest way to halt POKENAME's haunting sprees is to sully it with dirt and grime. It will hastily and obsessively run away to beautify itself, unlikely to return any time soon.

entry: POKENAME背上的蘑菇已长得过大，控制了它的心智。它以濒死树木的根为食，滋养自己，真菌则给予战斗所需的能量。
author: fiordaliso
source: The mushroom on POKENAME's back has grown so much it now controls its mind. It feeds on the roots of dying trees to nourish itself, while the fungus grants it the energy needed to fight.

entry: 蘑菇消耗宿主大量营养，让POKENAME始终饥饿不堪，见到什么食物都狼吞虎咽。若不制止，一大群POKENAME一周就能毁掉数英亩农田。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME voraciously consumes any food it comes across as the mushrooms consume much of the host's nutrients, keeping it in a very hungry state. An army of POKENAME can decimate acres of farmlands in a week if left unchecked.

entry: POKENAME脾气一触即发，稍受惊吓或刺激就会爆炸，将无数真菌孢子散播到很大范围内。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has a hair-trigger temper and will explode at the slightest bit of surprise or stimulation. The explosion causes it to release countless fungal spores within a large radius.

entry: POKENAME背上的蘑菇不仅模仿顽皮雷弹的外形，连功能也相近：受到刺激就会爆裂，把麻痹孢子散到周围数米，帮助逃脱捕食。
author: sk372
source: The mushroom on POKENAME's back mimics the appearance of Electrode, but also possesses a similar function: if agitated, it will burst open explosively, spreading paralyzing spores several meters around it, helping it escape predation.

entry: 受到威胁时，派拉电球的身体会张开，露出缕缕菌丝，有时还会组成手，攻击捕食者。不过，在极罕见的情况下，派拉电球会炸成一团四散的菌丝。
author: adeli.net
source: When threatened, Paraorb's body opens up to reveal strings of mycelium, sometimes forming a hand to use for attacking predators. On extremely rare occasions, however, Paraorb will explode into a mess of mycelium.

entry: POKENAME的举止仿佛始终迷茫，对周围毫无知觉。掀看菌盖下方，会发现三个萎缩干瘪、眼睛却泛着光泽的脑袋。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's movements suggest a constant feeling of confusion and unawareness of its surroundings. Examining beneath the mushroom cap reveals three shriveled and shrunken heads with glossy eyes.

entry: 为了让菌丝伸得尽可能远，POKENAME将根状菌丝接到附近树木及其他植物上，形成庞大的根状结构与细丝网络。农民常试着赶走POKENAME，免得作物受损。
author: quackquackattack
source: To maximize the reach of their mycelium, POKENAME connect fungal roots to trees and other nearby plants, creating a massive network of roots and tendrils. Farmers often try to scare off POKENAME to avoid crop damage.

entry: POKENAME的心智被寄生真菌完全占据，不再感到悲伤或失落，只剩本能地猎捕其他生物、用孢子感染它们的欲望。
author: sk372
source: With its mind completely taken over by the parasitic fungus, POKENAME no longer feels sorrow or loss. It only feels the instinctive need to hunt others to infect with its spores.

entry: 皮下生长的菌丝让POKENAME身体肿胀，撑破皮肤，从破洞涌出，连原本贴身保护的头骨也被撑碎。它会寻找阴凉潮湿的洞穴，让蘑菇长得更壮。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME's body has swollen due to the fungal mycelium growing beneath its skin, bursting holes in its skin through which the mycelium leaks and shattering the fitted, protective skull. It seeks out cool, damp caves to strengthen the mushrooms.

entry: POKENAME凭尖钳与闪电般的踢击，压倒大多数目标。它生性鲁莽，寄生物因此常接管行动，影响它避开威胁。
author: ehard
source: POKENAME uses its sharp pincers along with lightning fast kicks to overwhelm most targets. Due to its reckless nature the parasite often takes over, influencing its actions to avoid threats.

entry: 没人见过它进食，却常看见它一路舔舐树木与草地。POKENAME舔过的地方，一周内就会长满真菌。
author: sk372
source: It's never seen feeding, but has been observed constantly licking trees and grassy ground as it ventures forth. Within a week, the spots POKENAME licked will be overrun with fungi.

entry: POKENAME喷出一团团有害气体，散播孢子。吸入黏性孢子与气体的人，都说自己会咳嗽不止。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME proliferate spores by shooting out puffs of noxious air. People who inhale the sticky spores and noxious gas report experiencing coughing fits.

entry: POKENAME不断从身体释放气体。气体本身无毒，却夹带数以千计的微小孢子，吸入可能引起感染。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME release a constant stream of gas from their bodies. The gas isn't toxic in itself, but it contains thousands of microscopic spores that can cause infections when inhaled.

entry: 稀释后的POKENAME气体，会用于高级料理。喷在食物上再点燃，能让菜肴带上淡淡的烟熏蘑菇风味。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Diluted POKENAME gas is used in high-end cooking. Spraying the gas on food and igniting leaves a dish with a faint smoked mushroom taste.

entry: POKENAME大部分甲壳下，都已蔓延着蘑菇菌丝。生命的这一阶段，它会在阴凉树林中缓慢行走，撞倒树木，为蘑菇提供养分。
author: pjporwoll
source: Mycelium from the mushrooms has spread beneath most of the armor of POKENAME. It spends this stage of its life plodding in shaded woods to topple trees as nourishment for the mushrooms.

entry: 受寄生蘑菇影响，POKENAME领地意识极强。它猎捕草属性宝可梦获取营养，猎捕岩石属性宝可梦则为继续传播蘑菇感染。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is very territorial due to the influence of the parasitic mushroom. It hunts Grass-type Pokémon for nourishment and Rock-type Pokémon to continue spreading the mushroom infection.

entry: 它每天培育蘑菇群落，让其茁壮繁盛。偶尔长出芳香蘑菇时，就会剪下丢到一旁，留给热衷美食的人发现。
author: quackquackattack
source: Its daily tasks include cultivating mushroom colonies, ensuring that they grow and prosper. A Balm Mushroom occasionally forms in a mushroom colony, which it prunes and tosses aside for gourmet maniacs to find.

entry: POKENAME头顶的大蘑菇吸走营养，令藤蔓干瘪无力。老藤定期脱落，新藤长出后也很快被吸干，像其他藤蔓一样萎缩。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's vines are shriveled and weak thanks to the nutrients drained by the large mushroom atop it. Old vines fall off regularly, replaced by new ones that are quickly drained and shrivel up like the rest.

entry: 即使被寄生物感染，母爱仍未消失，只是如今转向了幼小的派拉斯。讽刺的是，POKENAME会竭力阻止自己养育的派拉斯进化，免得它们也被蘑菇控制。
author: sk372
source: Though infected by a parasite, maternal love still shines forth, now directed at young Paras. Ironically, POKENAME tries its best to make sure the Paras it raises never evolve and have their mushrooms overtake them.

entry: 海藻被冲上岸时，能看见POKENAME在四周爬来爬去。POKENAME不时往海藻上滴下充满孢子的墨汁，同时发出啾啾叫声。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: When seaweed washes ashore, POKENAME can be spotted scuttling around them. POKENAME periodically drip ink laden with spores onto the seaweed, chirping as they do.

entry: POKENAME的角是一簇敏感的菌丝，能提醒它附近有其他生物。它迅速游去冲撞，蘑菇则在撞击时放出无数能造成感染的孢子。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's horn is an outcropping of sensitive mycelium that alerts it to other creatures nearby. It swims quickly to charge into them, its mushroom releasing countless infectious spores upon impact.

entry: POKENAME的翅膀对日光敏感，除了构成脉络的菌丝纤维，其他部分都半透明。夜里采蜜时，会把真菌孢子留在花上，寄生花朵。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME's wings are sensitive to sunlight and translucent except for the mycelium fibers that structure them as veins. During the night, it parasitizes flowers by leaving fungal spores on them when gathering nectar.

entry: POKENAME细心维持周围适合真菌生长的最佳湿度，照料蘑菇。还会用爪子清除杂草，向想吃蘑菇的宝可梦喷水。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME take assiduous care of mushrooms around them by maintaining the optimal humidity for fungal growth. They also cull weeds with their claws and spray water at Pokémon that try to eat the mushrooms.

entry: POKENAME身体中央的宝石，与爪子由同样的组织构成。宝石能闪光晃住捕食者，让POKENAME逃走。
author: bigoljax
source: The gem in the middle of POKENAME's body has the same tissue as their claws do. These gems can flash predators, letting POKENAME get away.

entry: 控制派拉斯特的寄生者，为寻找更好的宿主，感染了魔墙人偶。获得超能力后，它几乎能骗过任何训练家或宝可梦，使其成为后代的下一任宿主。
author: ogriphor
source: Attempting to find a more suitable host, the parasite controlling Parasect has infected a Mr. Mime. Now armed with psychic abilities, it can trick nearly any Trainer or Pokémon into becoming the next host to its offspring.

entry: 与大多数飞天螳螂不同，POKENAME通常静止不动，伪装成覆满蘑菇的木头。等猎物够近，POKENAME便以快得看不清的速度猛扑。
author: pjporwoll
source: Unlike the majority of Scyther species, POKENAME usually remains immobile, disguised as a mushroom-covered log. When prey is close enough, POKENAME lunges too fast to be detected.

entry: POKENAME在蘑菇圈旁举办舞会，吸引大批训练家与宝可梦。催眠般的舞姿让旁人不得不跟着跳，往往直到筋疲力竭。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME hosts dancing parties near mushroom circles, drawing in large crowds of both Trainers and Pokémon. Its hypnotic dance compels others to dance with it, often to the point of exhaustion.

entry: POKENAME极力保护毛皮上的蘑菇，会猛抓路过者，电击靠近的生物。无意间，它成了酵母微生物的完美宿主，一队队蜂蜜酒酿造者为采集酵母不择手段。
author: ghostslythe
source: POKENAME is very protective of the mushrooms on its fur, slashing violently at passersby and shocking any who get close. Unwittingly, it proves a perfect host to yeast microorganisms, and teams of mead makers use any means to harvest it.

entry: 它身上的蘑菇，总笼罩着一团闪亮孢子。POKENAME虽能生火，却只在冬季用来防止自己冻僵，因为真菌最适合在阴凉潮湿的环境生长。
author: .jerden
source: The mushrooms growing on its body are always shrouded in a shimmering cloud of spores. Although POKENAME can create fires, it only does this in winter to prevent itself from freezing, as the fungus grows best in cool, damp environments.

entry: 当POKENAME的虫体与蘑菇共生时，蘑菇会在战斗中压制虫体的痛感，让它专心作战。之后，虫体会细心清洁蘑菇，真菌则为虫体分泌舒缓的药膏。
author: pjporwoll
source: When POKENAME is a symbiotic relationship between bug and mushroom, the mushroom suppresses pain in the bug during combat so it can focus. Later, the bug takes great care to clean the mushroom while the fungus secretes a soothing salve for the bug.

entry: 当POKENAME的虫体被蘑菇寄生时，蘑菇会吸走养分，只留足以用角撞倒树木的力气。无论宿主受伤多重，POKENAME都要等到蘑菇脱离，才会停止战斗。
author: pjporwoll
source: When POKENAME is a host-parasite relationship, the mushroom drains the bug except to leave it strong enough to topple trees with its horns. Regardless of the damage to the host, POKENAME will only stop fighting if the mushroom becomes unattached.

entry: POKENAME被扎根脑内的蘑菇控制。它会拼死守护赖以进食的树，见到任何入侵者就冲撞过去。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is controlled by the mushrooms that have taken root inside its brain. It will defend the tree it feeds on to the bitter end, charging at any intruder it spots.

entry: 许多人把POKENAME视为城都罕见的美味，切好的鱼肉已由体内孢子预先调了味。可惜对厨师而言，它的咬伤能让人麻痹，使它得以跃起，逃回栖身的河流。
author: ghostslythe
source: Considered by many as a rare Johto delicacy, POKENAME's meat when filleted is pre-seasoned by its internal spores. Unfortunately for the Chefs, its bite is paralytic in nature, allowing it to Splash back into the rivers it calls home.

entry: POKENAME在森林地面爬行，寻找落叶吃。蘑菇头盔会释放带苦味的有毒孢子，赶走捕食者。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME scuttles across the forest floor in search of fallen leaves to eat. Its mushroom helmet releases toxic spores that taste bitter, which keeps predators away from it.

entry: POKENAME在树根间钻行，用敏锐嗅觉寻找树上其他蘑菇。吃掉这些碍事的蘑菇后，就在树根撒下自己的孢子，再前往下一棵树。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME burrows around tree roots, using its keen sense of smell to hunt for other mushrooms growing on the tree. It eats the offending mushrooms and scatters its own spores on the tree roots before moving on to the next tree.

entry: POKENAME的孢子传染性极强，能在猎物体内潜伏数月，才萌发长出真菌。头上的大蘑菇驱使POKENAME尽可能广泛地传播感染。
author: alice_alice
source: POKENAME's spores are highly contagious and can lie dormant in its prey for months at a time before sprouting into fungal growths. The large mushroom on its head compels POKENAME to spread the infection as broadly as possible.

entry: 它用蛇形身体缠住树木，将真菌孢子传给树，让新蘑菇的侵袭蔓延整座森林。POKENAME格外凶猛，因此许多生物都不敢挑战它。
author: fiordaliso
source: It wraps its serpentine body around trees to infect them with its fungal spores and spread the invasion of new mushrooms throughout the forest. POKENAME is known for being particularly ferocious, which is why many creatures avoid challenging it.

entry: 与其他拉普拉斯族群相比，偷猎者往往不去招惹POKENAME群。它们移动时仿佛一个整体，而非一群个体，也常一齐发起攻击。
author: chibitales
source: Compared to other Lapras populations, POKENAME pods are often left alone by poachers. These Pokémon have been seen moving as if they are one single unit rather than a group, often seen striking in unison.

entry: 与其他拉普拉斯族群相比，偷猎者往往不去招惹POKENAME群。它们移动时仿佛一个整体，而非一群个体，也常一齐发起攻击。
author: chibitales
source: Compared to other Lapras populations, POKENAME pods are often left alone by poachers. These Pokémon have been seen moving as if they are one single unit rather than a group, often seen striking in unison.

entry: 它会变形，模仿自己想感染的生物。不过，即使变身，也无法除去身上的蘑菇，因此这种骗局谁也骗不过。
author: sk372
source: It transforms its body in order to replicate the forms of others it wishes to infect. Because it cannot get rid of the mushroom on its body even while transformed, however, none are fooled by the attempted deception.

entry: POKENAME被寄生蘑菇控制，被迫用变形能力，将孢子传播到更远的地方。
author: zweizweihander
source: POKENAME are controlled by a parasitic mushroom, and are made to use their shapeshifting powers in order to spread the spores further.

entry: POKENAME害怕时，会躲到巨大蘑菇的菌盖下，直到危险过去。毛皮因此常沾满孢子，使真菌随它散播到整片领地。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME shelter beneath giant mushrooms when they're afraid, hiding beneath the spore caps until the danger has passed. Their fur often becomes coated in spores as a result, leading them to spread the fungus throughout their territory.

entry: 它的蘑菇会吸收大量水分，并用孢子污染水体。有POKENAME出没的水域污染极为严重，饮用其中的水会产生强烈幻觉。
author: mistymagius
source: Its mushrooms absorb large amounts of water to infect it with its spores. Waters where POKENAME can be found are incredibly contaminated and consumption can cause severe hallucinations.

entry: POKENAME不停产生孢子云，在颈部形成鬃毛。碰到时会有刺麻感，但长时间接触会导致暂时的全身麻痹。
author: sk372
source: A constantly-produced cloud of spores creates a mane around POKENAME's neck. Touching the cloud causes a tingling sensation, but prolonged contact will lead to temporary full-body paralysis.

entry: POKENAME的孢子摸起来滚烫，碰到就会起水泡。不过，处理得当，就能成为味道宜人的辛辣配料，用在披萨上。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME's spores are hot to the touch, inducing blisters to those that make contact. However, if prepared correctly, it can make a pleasantly spicy ingredient used for pizzas.

entry: POKENAME的孢子对生物无害，却必须远离机器。只要几粒，就会让机器内部长出多处真菌，严重损坏零件。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's spores are harmless to biological creatures, but should be kept away from machines. Just a few will cause multiple fungi to grow within the machine and cause much damage to the internal components.

entry: POKENAME死后，身体会爆散成数百万孢子。只要孢子接触电脑，POKENAME便会重生。
author: bandedbodypress
source: When a POKENAME dies, its body explodes into millions of spores. If these spores come in contact with a computer, POKENAME will be reborn.

entry: 古生物学家在多种蘑菇的菌盖中发现过POKENAME化石，说明它如今与真菌的寄生关系，可能已延续数百万年。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Palaeontologists have found POKENAME fossils nestled within the spore caps of various mushroom species, suggesting their modern parasitic relationship with fungi has existed for millions of years.

entry: POKENAME用触手抓住游动的宝可梦，紧贴对方身体，再用锋利的颚咬住，吸取能量。有时一只吼鲸王身上，会寄生着几十只POKENAME。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME use their tentacles to grab onto swimming Pokémon, clutching tightly to their bodies and draining their energy by biting with their sharp jaws. Wailord can sometimes be found with dozens of POKENAME infesting them.

entry: POKENAME用触手抓住游动的宝可梦，紧贴对方身体，再用锋利的颚咬住，吸取能量。谁想把它弄下来，就会被它用爪子猛击，力道大得惊人。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME use their tentacles to grab onto swimming Pokémon, clutching tightly to their bodies and draining their energy by biting with their sharp jaws. They use their claws to ward away attempts to dislodge them, striking out with surprising force.

entry: POKENAME用触手抓住游动的宝可梦，紧贴对方身体，再用锋利的颚咬住，吸取能量。谁想把它弄下来，就会被它用爪子猛击，力道大得惊人。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME use their tentacles to grab onto swimming Pokémon, clutching tightly to their bodies and draining their energy by biting with their sharp jaws. They use their claws to ward away attempts to dislodge them, striking out with surprising force.

entry: POKENAME沿海底挖浅洞，在淤泥中寻找埋藏的宝可梦充饥。发现大舌贝后，就用利爪刺穿外壳，吸取能量，供自己生长。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME make shallow burrows along the sea floor, searching through the silt for buried Pokémon they can feed on. They use their sharp claws to pierce through Shellder shells when they find them, draining their energy to fuel their own growth.

entry: POKENAME爪上的刀刃极其锋利，能随意伸缩。划伤对方时也会使其感染，随后一路跟踪，直到真菌感染令猎物衰弱，轻易就能了结。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's claws have extremely sharp blades that can extend and retract at will. It infects others when it cuts them with these claws, stalking them until the fungal infection weakens them enough to be finished off with ease.

entry: POKENAME停在树枝上，从树液汲取营养，散播真菌孢子。孢子只会长在与史前植物相似的植物上，因此POKENAME专找银杏这类树木进食。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME lands in tree branches, absorbing nutrients from sap and scattering fungal spores. These spores only grow on plants similar to the ones from prehistoric times, so POKENAME specifically seeks out trees like the Ginkgo to feed on.

entry: POKENAME靠背上的真菌收集营养，拥有大量能量。不过，它只用这些能量连续吃上数日，再睡上同样久。
author: slimninja55
source: POKENAME have large amounts of energy because they gather nutrients with the fungi on their backs. However, they only use this energy to eat for days at a time, before sleeping just as long.

entry: 据说它每次振翅都会释放孢子。摸起来像冰屑，几乎立刻就会造成冻伤。
author: imaginita
source: It is said to release spores with every flap of its wings. These spores feel like shards of ice to the touch and inflict frostbite near-instantly.

entry: POKENAME栖息于关都地区的森林深处。它的蘑菇可以生吃，只是味道涩得很难入口。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME are found deep in forests of the Kanto region. Its mushrooms can be eaten raw, though their astringent flavor makes them quite unpleasant.

entry: POKENAME的孢子比空气轻，会从身体向上飘，让它升上天空。它把孢子播进云里催雨，雨后蘑菇便迅速生长。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME spores are lighter than air, drifting upward from their bodies and enabling them to take to the skies. They seed clouds with their spores, causing rains that are followed by rapid mushroom growth.

entry: POKENAME定期在阴凉潮湿处蜕皮，留下会长成蘑菇的孢子。POKENAME的皮似乎是这种真菌生长的绝佳基质，但非要等皮蜕下才会萌发。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME regularly sheds its skin in cool, damp areas, leaving behind spores that grow into mushrooms. POKENAME's skin seems to be the perfect substance for this fungus to grow on, but it will not sprout until after the skin is shed.

entry: POKENAME游过海带林，把孢子传播给海藻。等菌丝蔓延各处，POKENAME便能远程控制海藻，缠住猎物。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME swim through kelp forests, spreading their spores to seaweed. Once the mycelium has spread throughout, POKENAME can control the seaweed from afar to ensnare prey.

entry: POKENAME吃下大量腐木，在体内储存能量。然而，大部分能量并不供自己使用，而是被头部和尾巴的蘑菇吸走，用来制造更多孢子。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME stores up energy inside its body from all the rotting wood it eats. Rather than using this for itself, most of it is drained by the mushrooms on its head and tail, and used by them to produce more spores.

entry: POKENAME用爪子攀住大型猎物，再用毒针注入蘑菇孢子。随后观察受害者是否足够强壮，能成为蘑菇的新宿主，还是太虚弱，只能充作食物。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME latches onto large prey with its claws and then injects them with mushroom spores from its stinger. It then watches to see if the victim will be strong enough to become a new host for the mushroom or will be too weak and become food.

entry: POKENAME头上的菌盖，大部分装着脑组织，其间遍布菌丝网络。两套系统形成一个心智，将出众的智慧全用于传播孢子。
author: .jerden
source: The mushroom cap on POKENAME's head is mostly filled with brain tissue, permeated by a network of fungal mycelium. The two systems form one mind, which devotes its considerable intelligence to the task of spreading spores.

entry: 菌丝从POKENAME背上的蘑菇伸出，连通全身。POKENAME能像操纵肌肉一样自如地驱动这些白色长丝，吸取植物的生命。
author: .jerden
source: Fungal mycelium extends out from the mushroom on POKENAME's back, connecting to every part of its body. POKENAME uses these long, white filaments to drain life from plants, moving them as easily as it moves its own muscles.

entry: POKENAME头顶的缕缕菌丝，对温度和湿度极其敏感。为了避免干燥，POKENAME住在茂密树林中，那里很少有阳光能照到地面。
author: .jerden
source: The strands of fungal mycelium on top of POKENAME's head are incredibly sensitive to temperature and humidity. To prevent it from drying out, POKENAME live in dense woodlands where little sunlight makes it through to the forest floor.

entry: 战斗前，POKENAME会转动头上苍白的叶子，释放振奋精神的孢子云。天气干燥时，则用叶子为颈部一圈蘑菇遮阴。
author: oddwalls
source: Before a battle, POKENAME twirls the pale leaf on its head to release a cloud of invigorating spores. In dry conditions, it uses the leaf to shade the mushrooms in a ring around its neck.

entry: POKENAME颈部的一圈蘑菇，会产生不同效果的孢子，有时让宝可梦入睡，有时又将其唤醒。释放哪种孢子，似乎由POKENAME头顶长出的真菌决定。
author: .jerden
source: The ring of mushrooms around POKENAME's neck produces spores with various effects, sometimes putting Pokémon to sleep and sometimes waking them up. Which spores are released seems to be determined by the fungus sprouting from POKENAME's head.

entry: POKENAME的呼气含有颈部真菌的孢子，会立刻让草木开始腐烂。POKENAME吃下腐烂植物，喂养真菌，还会伸长脖子，够取树枝。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's breath contains spores from the fungus around its neck and will immediately causes grass and plants to begin to rot. POKENAME feeds the fungus by eating this rotting vegetation, using its long neck to reach up to tree branches.

entry: POKENAME的呼气含有背上真菌的孢子，会立刻让草木开始腐烂。POKENAME吃下腐烂植物，喂养真菌，还会伸长脖子，够取树枝。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's breath contains spores from the fungus on its back and will immediately causes grass and plants to begin to rot. POKENAME feeds the fungus by eating this rotting vegetation, using its long neck to reach up to tree branches.

entry: 几百年来，茶馆都高价收购POKENAME孢子，用来冲泡舒缓的热茶。POKENAME茶曾是富人的奢侈享受，如今已十分普及。
author: oddwalls
source: For centuries, teahouses paid handsomely for POKENAME spores, which can be steeped to create a soothing hot tea. Formerly an indulgence of the wealthy, POKENAME tea is now widely available.

entry: 受到威胁时，POKENAME会蜷在蘑菇下，散出一团孢子，吸入会灼伤肺部。菌盖若受损，便会脱落，由下方菌丝网络长出新的替代。
author: .jerden
source: When threatened, POKENAME will curl itself up beneath its mushroom and scatter a cloud of spores that burn the lungs when inhaled. If the mushroom cap is damaged, it will be shed and replaced by the fungal network beneath it.

entry: 火岩鼠的耐火毛皮对POKENAME很有用，让它能施展强力火焰攻击，又不伤害蘑菇的宿主身体。火焰在蘑菇内积起压力后，蘑菇便可能喷爆，炸出大量孢子。
author: bobosmith01
source: Quilava's fireproof fur comes in handy for POKENAME, allowing it to use powerful fiery attacks without damaging the mushroom's host body. As its flames build up pressure inside of the mushroom, the mushroom can erupt in an explosion of spores.

entry: POKENAME能藏身于闪亮的真菌孢子云中。若毒素未能让敌人失去行动能力，POKENAME便会摩擦毛茸茸的腿，擦出火花，将整团孢子点成一场烈焰爆炸。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME can conceal its body within a shimmering cloud of fungal spores. If its toxins do not incapacitate a foe, POKENAME will rub together its furry legs to create sparks, igniting the entire cloud in a fiery explosion.

entry: POKENAME全神贯注地追捕猎物。咬住东西后，只有头上或背上的蘑菇遭到攻击，才会松口，似乎保护蘑菇胜过一切。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME pursues prey with intense focus. The only time it will ever release something it has seized in its toothy jaws is if the mushrooms on its head or back are targeted, as it seems to prioritize protecting those from harm above all else.

entry: POKENAME飞得不快，必须依靠其他防御手段。蘑菇虽然无毒，鲜艳的配色仍能吓退许多捕食者。
author: notsaying.
source: POKENAME, unable to fly very quickly, has to rely on other defenses. The vibrant coloring of their mushroom is able to deter many predators, despite the mushroom having no poisonous qualities.

entry: POKENAME用大爪按住猎物，再用颚撕咬。陆地与水中都不算快，却会不停追赶其他宝可梦，绝不休息，直到猎物跑得筋疲力竭才追上。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME pins down prey with its large claws, then tears into it with its jaws. Although it is not fast in either land or water, it pursues other Pokémon without ever stopping to rest, catching up to its prey once it is exhausted by the chase.

entry: POKENAME能钻过看起来只有自身一半大的孔，侵入健康树木。它从内部啃食树皮，长久下来，树上便会渐渐长出多处真菌。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can infest healthy trees by slipping into holes half its apparent size. It chews on bark from the inside, its presence slowly causing the tree to develop multiple fungal growths over time.

entry: POKENAME在树干上挖洞，把菌盖抵住洞口，吃内部较软的木头。若不制止，大群POKENAME会吸尽树木的能量，足以使其死亡。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME dig hollows into the trunks of trees, resting their spore cap against the opening whilst they feed on the softer wood inside. Large flocks of POKENAME can prove deadly to trees if left unchecked, draining the plant of all of its energy.

entry: POKENAME时间感精准无误，能预判散播孢子的最佳时机。POKENAME喜欢睡在潮湿雨林的树上，尤其偏爱浓密树冠遮住阳光的地方。
author: distinguishedmanlygentleman
source: Using its perfect sense of time, POKENAME can predict the best time to scatter its spores. POKENAME prefers to sleep in the trees of damp rainforests, especially where thick canopies block out the sun.

entry: POKENAME的蘑菇白天会释放刺激性化学物质，促使宿主保持休眠，直到夜幕降临。夜里升空时，POKENAME身后会留下一道闪亮孢子，在空中飘散。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME mushrooms release an irritating chemical during daytime, encouraging their host to remain dormant until nightfall. When they take to the air at night, POKENAME leave a glittering trail of spores drifting through the air behind them.

entry: 寄生蘑菇日益壮大，POKENAME已无法抵抗感染。如今沦为宿主，飞过小片森林，喷洒混有体液的孢子，震晕猎物后吞食。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: With the parasitic mushroom grown in size and strength, POKENAME is no longer able to resist the infection. Now as a host, it flies across small forests, spraying out spores mixed with its body fluid to stun and consume its prey.

entry: POKENAME遭真菌严重侵染，蘑菇从身体长出，撑裂了多处甲壳。它能把部分菌丝织成网，捕住食物，喂养寄生物。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are heavily infested with fungus, their carapace splitting in places as mushrooms grow from them. They can spin some of the mycelium fibres into webbing, using them to ensnare food to feed their parasite.

entry: POKENAME用强壮的翅膀在洞顶划出沟槽，放入孢子。孢子生长迅速，能控制与其长时间接触的其他宝可梦。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its strong wings to cut grooves into cave ceilings to deposit its spores. These spores grow rapidly and can control other Pokémon that have prolonged contact with them.

entry: POKENAME的喙由厚实菌丝构成，能穿透树皮，找到藏在其中的虫属性宝可梦。它先往洞口释放孢子，令猎物无法行动，再开始进食。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's beak is composed of thick mycelium capable of breaking through bark to reach Bug types hiding within. It releases spores into the opening to incapacitate them before feeding.

entry: POKENAME在洞穴中漂浮时，触角末端的菌丝会发出鲜红光芒，吸引好奇的宝可梦。随后猛然放电，制服对方后大快朵颐。
author: .izik
source: The mycelium at the end of POKENAME's antennae glows a bright crimson as it floats through caves, attracting curious Pokémon. It then unleashes bursts of electricity to subdue them before feasting.

entry: POKENAME栖息于海滩和潮池。背上的蘑菇完全控制了它的行动。如今，POKENAME一心向其他宝可梦传播孢子，常通过战斗达成。
author: nyoomymph
source: POKENAME can be found on beaches and in tidepools. The mushroom on its back is in full control of its movements. POKENAME now seeks to spread its spores to other Pokémon, often through battle.

entry: 满月时，POKENAME的孢子产量会增至平时的三倍。只需一只，就能轻松产生足以装满热气球的孢子。
author: .izik
source: During full moons, POKENAME's spore production increases threefold. Even a single one can produce enough spores to easily fill a hot air balloon.

entry: POKENAME的歌声像是由多个声音合唱，却始终独自游荡。露营者受到提醒，若进入曾发现它的领地，身边至少要留一处明亮光源。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME's singing sounds as if multiple voices are contributing to the music, but it always is wandering alone. Campers are warned to keep at least one bright light nearby if they wander into territory where one has been spotted.

entry: 它的真菌外壳里塞满孢子。吸入后会感到幸福而顺从，让受害者很容易听从命令。
author: imaginita
source: Its fungal shell is stuffed with spores. When inhaled, these spores induce a feeling of happiness and agreeability, making the victim susceptible to being commanded.

entry: 都市传说猜测，吃下POKENAME的蘑菇，便能预见未来。宝可梦研究员未能证实，考虑到可能有毒，强烈劝人不要尝试。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Urban legends speculate that consuming a POKENAME mushroom grants the imbiber the ability to see into the future. Pokémon Researchers have been unable to verify these claims and, given the potential toxic risk, strongly advise against doing so.

entry: 都市传说猜测，吃下POKENAME的蘑菇，便能预见未来。宝可梦研究员未能证实，考虑到可能有毒，强烈劝人不要尝试。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Urban legends speculate that consuming a POKENAME mushroom grants the imbiber the ability to see into the future. Pokémon Researchers have been unable to verify these claims and, given the potential toxic risk, strongly advise against doing so.

entry: POKENAME身上覆着一层细密孢子，触碰会引起难以预测的效果。它飞过头顶时，头上的长菌丝会释放孢子，常造成仿佛窥见未来的幻觉。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are coated in a fine layer of spores that can cause unpredictable effects when touched. When they fly overhead, the long mycelium threads on their heads release these spores, often causing hallucinations likened to glimpsing the future.

entry: POKENAME摇动尾巴，释放一团蘑菇孢子，让饥饿的捕食者入睡，好让POKENAME逃脱。研究员正探索用这些孢子制作助眠药的方法。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: By shaking their tails, POKENAME can create Spore clouds, putting hungry predators to sleep so POKENAME can escape. Researchers are looking into using these spores to make sleeping aids.

entry: POKENAME飞行时，翼羽持续向下方空中洒落孢子。从它飞行路线下方经过的人，常说自己会困上好几个小时。
author: .izik
source: As POKENAME flies, the feathers on its wings release a steady trail of spores into the air below. Those caught beneath its flight path often report drowsiness lasting several hours.

entry: POKENAME头上和尾巴的蘑菇，傍晚会发出微光，照亮四周。它释放的孢子长成的真菌，也都会在黑暗中发亮。
author: sk372
source: The mushrooms on POKENAME's head and tail will emit a faint glow in the evening, illuminating its surroundings. Any fungus grown from the spores it releases will also glow in the dark.

entry: POKENAME在月光下有节奏地摇摆，将发蓝光的孢子散入天空。这常会让咕咕这类猎物从空中落下，全身麻痹。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME sways rhythmically in the moonlight, releasing glowing blue spores into the sky. This tends to knock prey like Hoothoot from the air, paralyzing them.

entry: POKENAME会在明亮日光下跳舞，从蘑菇散出孢子。孢子往往很快生根，因此常能在大片长着各种蘑菇的地方附近发现它们。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME will dance under bright sunlight, scattering spores from their mushrooms. These spores often take root quickly, so these Pokémon are commonly found near fields of various mushrooms.

entry: POKENAME的蘑菇泛着蜡质光泽，能排斥水分。沿河岸吃植物时，蘑菇因此保持干燥；同种物质还能让散出的孢子漂在水上。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's mushroom has a waxy sheen that repels water. This keeps it dry as POKENAME feeds on plants at the side of rivers, and the same substance also enables the spores it scatters to float on water.

entry: POKENAME把腿埋进树根吸取养分，随后一动不动，假装只是长满蘑菇的枯枝。若有人或宝可梦靠近，POKENAME便会向其洒下大量孢子。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME bury their legs inside tree roots to feed, then remain motionless, pretending to be nothing more than a dead branch infested by mushrooms. If any person or Pokémon approaches, POKENAME will shower it with spores.

entry: POKENAME释放气味宜人的孢子，转动腹部的催眠图案，引猎物靠近。这招对它最爱的点心——蜻蜻蜓与远古巨蜓，尤其有效。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME lure their prey close by releasing pleasant smelling spores and gyrating the hypnotic pattern on their stomachs. This is particularly effective on Yanma and Yanmega, their favorite snacks.

entry: POKENAME高速转动两朵蘑菇，升上空中。它从一片草地飘向另一片觅食，飞行时无意中在身后留下一道孢子。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME whirl their twin mushrooms at high speed to take off into the air. They drift from meadow to meadow in search of food, inadvertently leaving a trail of spores behind them as they fly.

entry: POKENAME的蘑菇质地轻盈松软，很适合炖菜。它会吸收周围食材的味道，掩盖本身淡淡的草味。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME mushrooms have a light, airy texture to them. They are popular ingredients in stews as they take on the flavour of the surrounding food, masking their natural slightly grassy flavour.

entry: POKENAME快速振动身体上的三朵蘑菇，释放孢子。风将孢子送往远方，因此哪怕只有一只POKENAME，侵入扩散的能力也很强。
author: distinguishedmanlygentleman
source: POKENAME can emit spores by rapidly vibrating the three mushrooms attached to its body. These spores are then carried far away by the wind, making even one POKENAME heavily invasive.

entry: POKENAME背上的寄生蘑菇完全控制着身体，驱使它们进入阴暗潮湿的垃圾箱，不停吞吃垃圾。
author: santon5512
source: The parasitic mushrooms on POKENAME's back have full control over their bodies. It leads these Pokémon into dark, damp dumpsters, where they will constantly consume trash.

entry: POKENAME用尾巴上手掌般的蘑菇，抓住洞顶的沟槽，向经过者散播孢子。这些孢子会使人头晕、昏倒，有时甚至控制心智。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses the hand-like mushroom on its tail to grip grooves on cave ceilings, spreading its spores on anyone who passes by. These spores can cause dizziness, fainting, and sometimes even mind control.

entry: POKENAME侵入树根下方，长年一点点吸取营养。单只POKENAME能在一棵树下生活数年，直到把树吸干，才需要搬走。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME infests trees beneath the root, siphoning small amounts of nutrients over time. A lone POKENAME will live under a single tree for years before having drained it dry and needing to move on.

entry: POKENAME漫步森林，设法向其他生物传播孢子。孢子无害，只会让接触者突然欣喜若狂，几个小时都停不下笑容。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME traipses around forests, looking to spread spores onto other living beings. The spores are harmless, only causing those contacted to feel sudden jubilation, unable to stop smiling for a few hours.

entry: POKENAME每次振翅，都会抖落一团孢子，在飞过的身后不断扩散。孢子长出的蘑菇，吃下会让人坐立不安。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME shake loose clouds of spores with each whir of their wings, leaving a spreading trail in their wake as they fly. The mushrooms that grow from these spores induce feelings of restlessness when consumed.

entry: POKENAME每次振翅，都会抖落一团孢子，在飞过的身后不断扩散。孢子长出的蘑菇，吃下会让人疲倦，有时用来助眠。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME shake loose clouds of spores with each whir of their wings, leaving a spreading trail in their wake as they fly. The mushrooms that grow from these spores induce feelings of fatigue when consumed and are sometimes used as a sleep aid.

entry: POKENAME埋进泥里，接上地下真菌与树根的网络，从中吸取养分。它一动不动，常让人难以分辨死活。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME buries itself in mud and is able to connect itself to the underground network of fungi and tree roots which it leaches nutrients from. It is often difficult to determine if POKENAME is dead or alive, as it stays perfectly still.

entry: 进化后，真菌更加强大，完全接管了POKENAME。临死前，POKENAME会游到湖底，将孢子传播给其他宿主。
author: autismgaming89_51746
source: The fungus has grown stronger after evolution, resulting in it taking complete control over POKENAME. Before it dies, POKENAME will swim to the bottom of a lake to spread spores to other hosts.

entry: POKENAME的孢子释放后，仍与POKENAME保持数小时的精神联系。它借此控制被孢子附着的生物，通常强迫受害者带来食物和水。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME spores retain a psychic connection to POKENAME for several hours after they've been released. They use this connection to control the minds of anything the spores settle on, usually compelling their victim to bring them food and water.

entry: POKENAME的孢子释放后，仍与POKENAME保持数小时的精神联系。它能借此操纵物体，用意念让孢子与其覆盖的东西一起浮起。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME spores retain a psychic connection to POKENAME for several hours after they've been released. They can use this connection to manipulate objects, telekinetically levitating the spores and whatever they have covered.

entry: 巨大的蘑菇控制着POKENAME的身心，平时意识混沌，唯有满月之夜才能醒来。它能完美融入灌木丛，是捕猎高手。
author: fiordaliso
source: On full moon nights, POKENAME manages to awaken its consciousness, which is otherwise clouded by the enormous mushroom that has taken control of its mind and body. Because it can blend in perfectly with the underbrush, it is a master hunter.

entry: 满月时，POKENAME能产生极大量的孢子。孢子落到坠下的陨石上，迫使皮皮迁往别处。
author: bigoljax
source: During the full moon, POKENAME can produce an intense amount of spores. Their spores land on fallen meteors, forcing Clefairy to travel somewhere else.

entry: POKENAME利用外貌混入黑暗鸦群，以孢子感染它们。不久，整个族群便会沦为它的奴仆，一心只为它收集食物。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses its appearance to infiltrate Murkrow flocks, infesting them with its spores. Before long, the entire group will become its thralls, seeking only to gather food for it.

entry: 有POKENAME栖息的城镇，会避免种植室内植物，因为它立刻就会被吸引过来，吸走养分。它还把毒孢子撒到收藏品上，防止小偷窃取。
author: soup1900
source: Towns where POKENAME live avoid growing house plants, as POKENAME will immediately be attracted to them and drain their nutrients. It scatters poisonous spores onto objects it collects to deter thieves from stealing them.

entry: POKENAME会摘下主菌冠上长出的蘑菇，种到其他生物身上。这些蘑菇会使被种植者智力迟钝，让POKENAME相比之下显得更聪明。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME will pluck the mushrooms growing off of its main mushroom crown and plant them on others. These mushrooms dull the intellect of those implanted, allowing POKENAME to be the smarter creature by comparison.

entry: POKENAME把自己埋进湿土，舒适地吸收营养。为了吓退捕食者，POKENAME皮肤覆着一层苦味毒膜，吃下会恶心作呕。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME bury themselves in moist dirt to comfortably absorb nutrients. To deter predators, POKENAME's skins are coated in a bitter, poisonous film that induces nausea in the consumer.

entry: 这只宝可梦已被背上的寄生蘑菇完全控制。蘑菇会释放孢子，感染更多宝可梦。
author: ayutac
source: This Pokémon is completely overtaken by the parasitic mushroom on its back. The mushroom sends out spores to infect more Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME夜里不停闯入厨房，四处散播孢子。孢子的毒性，已让许多人被送进医院。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME constantly raid kitchens during the night, spreading their spores everywhere. This has caused many to be hospitalized due to how toxic the spores can be.

entry: POKENAME把自己嵌进树皮，吸取树木的养分。脱离后留下的印痕会长出真菌，形成一个酷似POKENAME的图案。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME feeds by embedding itself into tree bark and siphoning nutrients from the tree itself. After it dislodges itself, the imprint it leaves behind will grow fungi, leaving a facsimile of POKENAME's image.

entry: POKENAME背上的蘑菇虽长着脸，却是中空的诱饵，每次挨打都会散出孢子。这似乎就是真菌传播孢子的方式，因为POKENAME会特意寻找好斗的宝可梦来攻击自己。
author: .jerden
source: Although it has a face, the mushroom on POKENAME's back is a hollow decoy and scatters spores every time it is struck. This seems to be how the fungus spreads its spores, as POKENAME deliberately seeks out aggressive Pokémon to attack it.

entry: 奇怪的是，POKENAME后部的小脑袋，似乎比主头还聪明。不过两个头都十分好斗，后头会不停向附近任何生物喷出能造成感染的孢子。
author: sk372
source: Strangely, the small head on POKENAME's rear seems to exhibit more intelligence than its main head. Both are highly aggressive, however, with the rear head constantly blowing out infectious spores at any living creature nearby.

entry: POKENAME使用自爆时，孢子会随风飘出数英里。因此，它时不时会毫无预兆地释放多余能量并爆炸，全为散播蘑菇孢子。
author: bobosmith01
source: If POKENAME uses Self-Destruct, spores fly in the winds for miles. As a result, it will release excess energy and explode every now and then without warning, all to spread its mushroom's spores.

entry: POKENAME伸出壳外的菌盖，也一样坚固。防御时，能从壳内发射较小的蘑菇，一旦命中，力道十分惊人。
author: sk372
source: The mushroom caps that extend outside of POKENAME's shell are no less sturdy. For defense, it can fire smaller mushrooms from within that pack a mighty wallop if they connect.

entry: POKENAME的蘑菇太重，让它几乎动弹不得。它用剩余的力气挖深洞居住，长年慢慢吃土，供养蘑菇。
author: sk372
source: The heavy weight of POKENAME's mushroom leaves it almost immobile. It uses what strength it has to dig deep holes to live in, slowly consuming the soil over time to keep the mushroom nourished.

entry: POKENAME极其亲人，见到谁都会跑去蹭一蹭、舔一舔。这也把POKENAME头上蘑菇的孢子传播开，唾液还能防止孢子干燥。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME are incredibly affectionate and will run up to any people they see to nuzzle and lick them. This spreads spores from the mushroom on POKENAME's head, and its saliva stops them from drying out.

entry: POKENAME是农民的噩梦，飞过田野觅食时，会释放真菌孢子，侵染庄稼。它爱在腐树洞中筑巢，那里最适合让共生真菌保持健康。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is a nightmare for farmers, since as it flies over fields in search of food, it releases fungal spores that infest the crops. It loves to nest in the hollows of rotting trees, which are ideal for keeping its symbiotic fungus healthy.

entry: POKENAME用大爪挖出树根，再用强壮的颚咬成小块。若有其他宝可梦靠近，它会一边嚼木头，一边木然地盯着对方，试图吓退来者。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME uses its large claws to unearth roots, then crushes them into small pieces with its powerful jaws. If any other Pokémon approach, it will try to intimidate them simply by staring at them blankly while chewing wood.

entry: POKENAME把蘑菇塞进岩缝，吸水胀大，将自己固定在海底。它用力抖动身体，吸引捕食者，挨打时便释放孢子云，传播真菌。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME anchor themselves to the sea floor by wedging their mushroom into crevices in the rock and inflating it with water. They vigorously shake their body to attract predators, releasing clouds of spores when struck to spread their fungus.

entry: POKENAME的蘑菇像钛一样坚固，挖掘树根时能保护POKENAME。它快速振翅，让菌盖下维持很高的湿度。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME's mushroom is as durable as titanium, protecting POKENAME while it digs for roots. It rapidly flutters its wings to maintain a high level of humidity below the mushroom cap.

entry: POKENAME的蘑菇像钛一样坚固，挖掘树根时能保护POKENAME。它快速振翅，让菌盖下维持很高的湿度。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME's mushroom is as durable as titanium, protecting POKENAME while it digs for roots. It rapidly flutters its wings to maintain a high level of humidity below the mushroom cap.

entry: POKENAME放进岩壳的树果，会被真菌完全消化。树果丰富的地方，这种真菌会长出高耸的菌盖，尽可能多地散播孢子。
author: .jerden
source: Berries that POKENAME places within its rocky shell are completely digested by fungus. In places with many berries, this fungus produces towering mushroom caps to scatter as many spores as possible.

entry: POKENAME用爪子割开树果灌木的皮，吸食汁液，而不吃结出的树果。壳内真菌将糖发酵成酒精，但酒精似乎对POKENAME毫无影响。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME uses its claws to cut into the bark of berry bushes, feeding on their sap rather than on the berries they produce. The fungus within its shell ferments the sugar into alcohol, but this alcohol doesn't seem to have any effect on POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME用爪子守卫觅食地，只有迫不得已，才用顶端长着蘑菇的角。角撞中目标时，会喷出催眠孢子，却也伤到蘑菇，需要POKENAME照料恢复。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME defends its feeding grounds with its claws, only using its mushroom-tipped horn as a last resort. When it slams the horn into a target, it erupts with sleep-inducing spores but also injures the mushroom, requiring POKENAME to heal it.

entry: POKENAME迅速攀上高树，用尖钳钩住树枝。它钻进树冠，吸食树梢新生部分中甜美的树液。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME rapidly scale tall trees, using their sharp pincers to hook themselves onto branches. They dig into the crowns of trees, feeding on the sweet sap found in the fresh growth at the very top of the trees.

entry: POKENAME身上的蘑菇，会分泌充满孢子的蜜状物质。吃下便可能被控制心智，POKENAME却仍选择食用。
author: hiroshima0042_23263
source: The mushroom on POKENAME secretes a honey-like substance filled with spores. The substance can take over a host's mind when eaten; POKENAME still chooses to eat it.

entry: POKENAME能释放特殊孢子，迫使宝可梦与自己战斗。因此，人们常沿着一长串倒下的宝可梦，找到POKENAME的洞穴。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME can release specialized spores that force Pokémon to fight it. This often causes many to find long trails of fainted Pokémon leading to POKENAME's cave.

entry: POKENAME失明又行动缓慢，常被认为十分可怜。因此，宝可梦收容所里经常能见到POKENAME。
author: bigoljax
source: Due to their blindness and slow speeds, POKENAME are often considered to be pathetic. This causes POKENAME to be commonly found in Pokémon shelters.

entry: POKENAME容易长出寄生真菌。它会寻找树木化石，吃下这些石化的树，吸收足够矿物，让蘑菇尽可能长大。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are prone to parasitic fungal growths. They seek out petrified wood, feeding on the fossil trees to absorb enough minerals to help their mushrooms grow as large as possible.

entry: 它们的身体由类似琥珀的半流体构成。坚硬岩壳上长满蘑菇，并已开始向身体其他部位蔓延。
author: infinex21
source: Their bodies are made of a semiliquid reminiscent of amber. Their shells of hard rock are overrun with mushrooms that have begun to spread to the rest of their bodies.

entry: POKENAME全身的寄生真菌使心智迟钝，对周围事物反应缓慢而木然。喜剧编剧爱在情景喜剧里借它衬出笑点，让原本可能冷场的笑话变得好笑。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have deadpan, slow reactions to events around them, their wits dulled by the parasitic fungal growths throughout their body. Comedy writers like to make use of them in sitcoms to punctuate jokes that might otherwise fall flat.

entry: POKENAME寻找其他鸟宝可梦，在空中交战。获胜后，便向败者咳出孢子。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME seek out other bird Pokémon to fight in the sky. Upon winning they cough up spores onto their defeated foe.

entry: 野外常能见到POKENAME兜圈子。嗅觉让它察觉到一朵强大的蘑菇，却不知道自己追的，正是头顶那一朵。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is often seen moving in circles in the wild. Its sense of smell alerts it to the scent of a powerful mushroom, unaware that it is chasing after the one atop its own head.

entry: POKENAME对自己的孢子过敏，吸多了偶尔会打喷嚏。喷嚏一打，所有蘑菇都会掉下来，落进土里生长蔓延。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are allergic to their own spores, occasionally sneezing if they inhale too much. When they sneeze, all their mushrooms fall off, landing in the soil to begin growing and spreading.

entry: POKENAME身上的蘑菇能在盐水中茁壮生长，让它将孢子散播到整片珊瑚礁。它能远程控制自己长出的蘑菇，封住靠得太近的鱼宝可梦的退路。
author: .izik
source: The mushrooms on POKENAME's body thrive in salt water, allowing it to spread spores throughout reefs. It can control the mushrooms it creates remotely, closing off escape routes for fish Pokémon that venture too close.

entry: POKENAME喷出混有微小孢子的墨汁，附着于海中其他水生生物。人们也会采集这种浓墨，用于书法。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME shoot out ink infused with microscopic spores that cling to other aquatic life in the sea. This thick ink is also harvested to be used as calligraphy ink.

entry: POKENAME夜间活动，能从嘴里吐出毒雾，似乎强烈厌恶所有幽灵属性宝可梦。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a nocturnal creature that possesses the ability to spit out a poisonous mist from its mouth. It seems to have a strong dislike of any and all Ghost-type Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME已无法从嘴里制造墨汁，改为吐出浓稠的菌丝孢子团，接触物体便向外爆开，一次感染大群生物。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME no longer possesses the ability to generate ink from its mouth. Instead, it spits out thick globs of mycelium and spores that burst outward on contact and infect large groups at once.

entry: 战斗中，POKENAME从长满蘑菇的尾巴抓起一团团孢子，抛向敌人。摸起来冰冷至极，几秒内就会让人神志错乱。
author: .izik
source: During combat, POKENAME grabs clusters of spores from its mushroom-covered tail to lob at foes. Extremely cold to the touch, they can cause delirium within seconds.

entry: POKENAME在森林上空飞行，一边寻找腐木吃，一边散播孢子。常有感染同种真菌的宝可梦陪伴，紧紧攀住POKENAME，让自己的孢子也一同散播。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME flies above forests, scattering spores as it searches for rotting wood to devour. It is often accompanied by other Pokémon infected by the same fungus, who will tightly cling to POKENAME so that their own spores are also scattered.

entry: POKENAME双翼覆着少量孢子，只用来让敌人入睡，再逃离战斗。飞走前，尾巴还能迅速划上一击。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME's wings have a light spore dusting on them, only used to inflict sleep on a foe before escaping the battle. Their tails can get a quick slash in before they fly off.

entry: POKENAME把真菌孢子吹到猎物身上，即使对方逃走，也能循气味追踪。头上的真菌越大，火焰攻击就越致命。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME blows its fungal spores onto its prey so that it can track them down by scent if they manage to escape. The larger the fungus on its head grows, the more deadly its fiery attacks become.

entry: 它们成群行动，配合一致，却没有明确的首领。若一只POKENAME失去背上的大蘑菇，就会被其他同伴丢下，仿佛已被遗忘。
author: imaginita
source: They travel in packs, acting in unison without a clear leader. If the large mushroom on a POKENAME's back is lost, the Pokémon will be left behind by the rest, as if forgotten.

entry: POKENAME休息时，会用长长的真菌身体缠住树木，睡梦中向树上散播孢子。若猎物恰好靠近，就能伸展修长的鳞状身体，猛然行动。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME wrap their long fungal bodies around trees whenever they rest, spreading spores up the tree as they sleep. If prey coincidentally comes close while they are at rest, they can spring into action by stretching their long, scaly bodies.

entry: 静水中，POKENAME的倒影有时会无故泛起波纹。训练家说，即使它双眼闭着，或被花状菌菇遮住，仍有被注视的感觉。
author: mgfox_66676
source: In still water, POKENAME's reflection sometimes ripples without cause. Trainers report feeling watched, even when its eyes are closed or hidden by the bloom.

entry: POKENAME以巨力将健康树木连根拔起，好够到树根。它们成小群吃根，用鼻子劈开木头，饮用里面的树液。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME use their immense strength to topple healthy trees, ripping them from the ground so that they can get at their roots. They feed on the roots in small herds, using their trunks to break the wood open and drinking the sap within.

entry: POKENAME的身体由厚甲壳构成，会蜷起身体，从鼻子喷出孢子，保护自己免遭捕食。POKENAME用鼻子推倒树木，再住进树中，吸尽养分。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME's body is made from a thick carapace. It protects itself from predators by curling up and shooting spores from its trunk. POKENAME knock over trees with their trunks, before nesting inside them and draining them of their nutrients.

entry: POKENAME在电脑间穿行时，会释放孢子。奇怪的是，即使孢子长成蘑菇，电脑仍能正常运作，极少数时候甚至性能更好。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME releases spores as it travels through computers. Oddly, should these spores grow into mushrooms, the computer will behave normally or on rare occasions perform better than before.

entry: POKENAME毫无意识地用画笔般的尾巴涂抹物体表面，画出古怪而不知所云的图案。有些画廊会挂起POKENAME的画，称之为先锋派杰作。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME mindlessly strokes its brush-like tail against surfaces, making bizarre and nonsensical designs. Some art galleries hang POKENAME paintings, calling them avant-garde masterpieces.

entry: POKENAME沉重的蘑菇，让它倒立时更稳一些。每次旋转，四肢都会甩出一道道能使人麻痹的蘑菇孢子。
author: sk372
source: The heavy weight of POKENAME's mushroom gives it somewhat of a boost to keep balance while upside-down. Any time it spins, its limbs cast off trails of paralytic mushroom spores.

entry: POKENAME一感知到活物，就会本能地爬向最近的目标，想亲吻对方。务必避开，因为唇上的蘑菇孢子会感染被亲吻的一切生物。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME instinctively scuttles towards the nearest living creature it senses, intent on kissing them. One should avoid this, as its lips contain mushrooms spores that will infect whatever it kisses.

entry: 注视POKENAME躯干的斑纹时，它们仿佛会移动起伏，引来好奇的猎物。受害者被催眠、进入射程后，POKENAME便向其喷出大量毒孢子。
author: sk372
source: When observed, the marks on its torso seem to shift and undulate to draw in curious prey. Once within range, POKENAME ejects large amounts of toxic spores onto the hypnotized victim.

entry: 真菌吸取体内养分，限制了POKENAME的火焰能力。它只能在一阵阵咳出真菌孢子的间隙，吐出少量火焰。孢子接触皮肤，会引起灼痛的皮疹。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's fire ability is limited due to the fungus draining its body. It manages to spit up a small amount of fire between bursts of coughed-up fungus spores that cause burning rashes upon contact with flesh.

entry: 喝下POKENAME的奶，会恍惚入迷数分钟。长期饮用的影响仍在研究，但有一点已经确定：它变质得非常快。
author: bobosmith01
source: Those who consume POKENAME's milk fall into a trance for several minutes. The long-term effects of consuming the drink are still being studied. One thing is certain, though: it spoils very quickly.

entry: 腹部生长的蘑菇可以采摘，带着浓郁的奶香，被厨师们视为上等食材。
author: gasmaskblacky
source: The mushrooms growing on its belly can be harvested. They have a milky yet hearty flavor and are regarded as high quality ingredients by chefs.

entry: 腹袋里的蘑菇操控POKENAME的宿主体，改变脑内化学状态，让它始终幸福满足、温顺听命。究竟是共生还是寄生，争议很大。
author: sontyp
source: The mushroom in its belly pouch mentally controls POKENAME's host body, keeping it docile by inducing a constant state of happy contentment in its brain chemistry. Whether this is symbiosis or parasitism is heavily discussed.

entry: 只要咬一口POKENAME袋中带着的蘑菇，人或宝可梦就会欣喜陶醉。POKENAME会拼命保护蘑菇，让它逃走，重新开始生命循环。
author: pjporwoll
source: Even one bite of the mushroom carried in the pouch of a POKENAME will send a person or Pokémon into a euphoric state of happiness. The POKENAME will protect the mushroom with its life, allowing the mushroom to escape to begin the life cycle again.

entry: POKENAME被头上的菌盖控制，受驱使永不停歇。奔跑时，身后散落的滚烫孢子云会点燃森林，让蘑菇从灰烬中萌发。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME is controlled by the mushroom cap on its head, which compels it to never rest. The hot cloud of spores it scatters behind it as it runs sets fire to forests, enabling mushrooms to sprout from the ashes.

entry: POKENAME不断往背上的蘑菇滴纯水，防止它们干燥。每当北风吹起，蘑菇就会将孢子撒入空中。
author: .jerden
source: To keep the mushrooms on its back from drying out, POKENAME constantly drips pure water onto them. Whenever the north wind blows, these mushroom scatter their spores into the air.

entry: 洞穴深处的POKENAME群落轮班睡觉，轮流挖开岩石，找出并吃掉其中的植物。这种群体生活，让食物来源始终不断。
author: .izik
source: Colonies of POKENAME sleep in shifts deep within caves, taking turns digging into stone to unearth and devour plant life. This communal behavior ensures they have a constant food source.

entry: POKENAME钻过山根，在坚硬基岩中开路，寻找富矿脉。它吃下矿物，供蘑菇生长，也让子实体带上浓郁的泥土风味。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME dig through the roots of mountains, carving their way through the tough bedrock in search of rich mineral veins. They feed on these minerals to fuel their mushroom's growth, lending the fruiting body a rich, earthy flavour.

entry: POKENAME的甲片下藏着一层遍布全身的菌丝。这层真菌能缓冲身体，减轻受到的肢体打击。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME's armoured plates conceal a layer of mycelium that extends across the entirety of their body. This fungal layer cushions their body, reducing the harm they suffer from physical blows.

entry: POKENAME的甲片上覆着一层遍布全身的菌丝。这层真菌像第二套肌肉般收缩，提高反应速度与打击力量。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME's armoured plates are coated in a layer of mycelium that extends across the entirety of their body. This fungal layer contracts like a second layer of muscles, improving their reaction time and striking power.

entry: POKENAME的甲片寄生着侵略性很强的真菌，让它饱受全身不停长蘑菇的折磨。它寻找沙暴，试着用风沙磨掉身上的寄生物。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME's armoured plates play host to an aggressive fungus, leaving them plagued with constant mushroom growth across their body. They seek out sandstorms, trying to use the abrasive storms to clean the parasitic growths from themselves.

entry: POKENAME只出现在污染最严重的水域，传播危险孢子。看到鲤鱼王身上长满真菌，就知道POKENAME在附近。
author: weirdtux
source: Only found in the most polluted bodies of water, POKENAME spreads dangerous spores. You can tell POKENAME is near when the Magikarp are covered in fungus.

entry: POKENAME在潮湿的森林家园中跟踪猎物。靠得够近后，POKENAME便洒下大量孢子，让受害者看见爬行类怪物的幻觉。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME stalk their prey through the humid forests they call home. Once close enough, POKENAME shower their prey with spores, causing the afflicted to have hallucinations of reptilian monsters.

entry: 雷雨时，POKENAME头上的蘑菇会脉动。每次闪电划过，都会让它向周围空中喷出一团团孢子。
author: .izik
source: The mushroom on POKENAME's head pulsates during thunderstorms. Each flash of lightning causes it to burst out puffs of spores into the surrounding air.

entry: POKENAME摇动后部的大蘑菇，会散出多彩的真菌孢子。身上长出的部分似乎都源自这朵大蘑菇，因此有人相信，真正掌控身体的是它。
author: infinex21
source: When a POKENAME shakes the large mushroom on its rear, it scatters multi-colored fungal spores. The growths along their bodies seem to stem from the large mushroom, leading some to believe it is the one in control.

entry: 阴凉潮湿的日子，有时能见到多只POKENAME在同一棵古树上取食。古树总会在当天结束前倒下，所有POKENAME则会在倒下前一刻消失。
author: .jerden
source: On cool damp days, multiple POKENAME may be found feeding on a single ancient tree. Trees they feed on always fall over by the end of the day, with all of the POKENAME vanishing right before this happens.

entry: 曾有村庄因附近森林里神秘的跳动蘑菇传闻而惊恐。后来发现，那是一群POKENAME，用头弹跳，把蘑菇尾巴高举在空中。
author: imaginita
source: A village was once terrified by reports of mysterious bouncing mushrooms in the nearby forest. It was revealed to be a pack of POKENAME, which bounce on their heads with the mushroom-tail held in the air.

entry: POKENAME住在果园，把果实贴在菌盖上，任其腐烂。甜得发腻的汁水淌遍身体，它再通过皮肤吸收糖分。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME can be found living within orchards, clutching fruit to the cap of their mushroom and allowing it to decompose. They let the sickly sweet juices trickle over their body, absorbing the sugars through their skin.

entry: POKENAME会试着把头上的蘑菇贴向人和其他宝可梦。接触会把真菌孢子转到对方身上，随后孢子脱落，散向远方。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME will try to press the mushroom on its head against other people and Pokémon. This contact transfers spores from the fungus onto their bodies, eventually detaching to spread spores far and wide.

entry: POKENAME用两条强壮的尾巴按住猎物，再倾下大量红色孢子，使其无法行动，好拖回巢中进食。
author: .izik
source: After pinning prey down with its two strong tails, POKENAME releases a deluge of red spores onto them. These spores incapacitate the prey so it can drag them back to its nest to feed.

entry: 据说POKENAME的叫声能催眠，其实是周围孢子云的效果。POKENAME通常用来对付敌人，有时也会寻找失眠者，赐予一场无梦的睡眠。
author: .jerden
source: It is said that its cries induce sleep, but this is actually the effect of the cloud of spores that surrounds it. While POKENAME usually uses these against foes, sometimes it will seek out insomniacs and grant them the gift of dreamless sleep.

entry: POKENAME头上的大蘑菇会产生孢子，吸引感染同种真菌的其他宝可梦。若POKENAME停在树上，这群宝可梦便会围来，迅速将其吃光。
author: .jerden
source: The large mushroom on POKENAME's head produces spores that attract other Pokémon infested by the same fungus. If POKENAME lands in a tree, this crowd of other Pokémon will gather around and quickly devour it.

entry: POKENAME很难融入栖息地，因此收集、培育蘑菇，尝试伪装。觉得蘑菇够多后，就把部分身体埋进蘑菇丛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME has a difficult time camouflaging into its habitat, so it collects and grows mushrooms to try to blend in. When it decides there are enough mushrooms, it will partially bury itself into the mushroom patch.

entry: POKENAME用抽动般的舞姿，试图逗乐身边的生物。效果却往往让人不安，多过让人发笑。POKENAME还把缺乏好反应，当作需要更加努力跳怪舞的信号。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME make twitchy, dancing motions in an attempt to entertain those around them. The effect is often unnerving rather than amusing, though POKENAME take the lack of positive response as a sign to try harder with their strange dance.

entry: POKENAME通常纹丝不动，直到有活物走近，尾巴才本能地反应，用抽打与电击震晕猎物，再缠住拖近，使其感染。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME tends to sit completely motionless until something biological moves near, whereupon its tail reacts instinctively, stunning prey with whipping and electric jolts before wrapping around and dragging them closer to be infected.

entry: POKENAME头上的蘑菇模仿小卡比兽的模样，借此吸引鸟宝可梦降落，再将其拖进洞穴。
author: bigoljax
source: The mushroom on POKENAME's head mimic the look of a Munchlax. This is so they can attract bird Pokémon down so they can drag them into their burrows.

entry: POKENAME的身体像风筝一样乘风，能飘很远。吃过腐木后，POKENAME会在刮风的日子爬上树顶，启程寻找下一处食物。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's body catches the wind like a kite, carrying it for long distances. After feeding on rotting wood, POKENAME will start searching for the next one by climbing up to the top of a tree on a windy day.

entry: POKENAME与一群感染同种真菌的宝可梦共同捕猎，捕食草属性宝可梦。冬季最为活跃，因为猎物那时往往处于休眠，十分脆弱。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME preys upon Grass-type Pokémon, hunting together with a group of other Pokémon infested with the same fungus. They are most active in winter, when their prey is likely to be dormant and vulnerable.

entry: POKENAME通常在地上爬行，不过也能漂浮到高空。它把孢子散到树上，让果实腐烂。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME usually crawl on the ground, though they can levitate high into the air. They spread their spores onto trees, causing the fruit on them to rot.

entry: POKENAME夜里借磁力排斥，悬浮飞行于森林上空。它洒下孢子轨迹，引导感染同种真菌的宝可梦，找到可以进食的树。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME flies high above forests at night, levitating through magnetic repulsion. It scatters trails of spores to direct other Pokémon infected by the same fungus towards trees they can feed on.

entry: POKENAME能用有力的舌头把自己弹向前方，加快速度。背上的蘑菇渗出树液般的物质，具有很强的麻醉效果。
author: oddwalls
source: POKENAME can accelerate by using its powerful tongue to launch itself forward. A sap-like substance, which functions as a powerful numbing agent, oozes from the mushroom on its back.

entry: 蘑菇菌丝与毒蕈几乎占满POKENAME的身体，让它近乎无法动弹。其他宝可梦吃下蘑菇，孢子便传播给新宿主。
author: pjporwoll
source: Mushroom mycelium and toadstools have overtaken the body of POKENAME to the point of near immobility. Other Pokémon feed on the mushrooms, allowing the spores to spread to new hosts.

entry: POKENAME如同一大堆会走路的真菌细丝，用四肢接触遇见的树，把根状结构扭动着钻进去。被侵染的树，几天内必定长出大量真菌。
author: sk372
source: A massive walking mound of fungal tendrils, POKENAME uses its limbs to touch and wriggle its roots into any trees it comes across. Inevitably, these tainted trees will grow massive amounts of fungi within days.

entry: POKENAME戴着的面具，似乎能阻挡毒气与烟雾吸入。人们常雇它代替危险物质处理人员，前往可能遭遇危险双弹瓦斯的地方。
author: bigoljax
source: The mask POKENAME wears seems to block toxic gases and fumes from being breathed in. They're often hired as replacements for hazmat technicians for possible dangerous Weezing encounters.

entry: POKENAME发射炽热孢子弹，压倒敌人。头上的蘑菇越大，孢子毒性就越强。身体虽散发高热，它仍偏爱寄生真菌所喜的阴凉潮湿处。
author: user2414.
source: POKENAME launches fiery spore bombs to overwhelm foes. As the mushroom on its head grows, its spores become more toxic. Though its body radiates intense heat, it prefers cool, damp places favored by the parasitic fungus it hosts.

entry: 它用大爪挖掘地面，寻找富含养分的土壤与水。头上的蘑菇，能帮助它从爪子挖到的东西中吸收营养，一周比一周大。
author: infinex21
source: It uses its large claws to burrow through terrain in search of nutrient-rich soil and water. The mushroom on its head serves to help absorb nutrients from whatever it digs it claws into and grows larger with every passing week.

entry: POKENAME没有翅膀，只能靠快速爬行移动。遇到危险，背上的蘑菇就会猛然喷出大量孢子。
author: bigoljax
source: Due to their lack of wings, POKENAME have to rely on crawling around quickly. The mushrooms on their backs create large bursts of spores when in danger.

entry: POKENAME的身体从太阳获取能量，身上的蘑菇则从有机物中获取能量。日常十分简单：以光合作用长出细胞，供养真菌；没有阳光时，就散播孢子。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's body gets energy from the sun, and the mushrooms on POKENAME's body get energy from organic matter. Its routine is simple: photosynthesize to grow cells for the fungi's benefit, and spread spores when the sun is not out.

entry: 冻住的蘑菇不再产生真菌孢子，转而向周围传播粉雪。雪落下的地方，会长出由雪构成的无害真菌。
author: sk372
source: The frozen mushroom no longer produces fungus spores, but instead seeks to spread powder snow around it. Places the spread snow lands will grow harmless fungi made of snow.

entry: POKENAME用爪子吊在树枝上，吸食渗出的树液。POKENAME也会伺机捕猎，若有什么从下方经过，POKENAME便洒下大量孢子，再从上方落下攻击。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME use their claws to hang from tree branches, feeding on sap that leaks out. POKENAME is an opportunistic hunter, and if anything passes below, POKENAME will shower it with spores then drop down to attack from above.

entry: POKENAME用爪子吊在树枝上，吸食渗出的树液。POKENAME也会伺机捕猎，若有什么从下方经过，POKENAME便洒下大量孢子，再从上方落下攻击。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME use their claws to hang from tree branches, feeding on sap that leaks out. POKENAME is an opportunistic hunter, and if anything passes below, POKENAME will shower it with spores then drop down to attack from above.

entry: POKENAME飞过干旱地区，释放充满孢子的云团。孢子混入沙中，能潜伏多年。
author: reveriezfunicular
source: POKENAME release clouds full of spores as they fly over arid regions. The spores mix with the sand where they can remain dormant for years.

entry: POKENAME的真菌皮肤厚得能被制革工做成蘑菇皮革。日常使用足够结实，但极端气候会让这种皮革制成的衣物迅速损坏。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME's fungal hide is so thick that tanners can turn it into mushroom leather. While this leather is sturdy enough for everyday use, extreme climates can quickly degrade clothing made of this leather.

entry: 身上的蘑菇太重，POKENAME通常就待在同一棵枯树里。真菌将菌丝网络伸遍树木，供自己和POKENAME取食，逐渐长大，产生更多孢子。
author: .jerden
source: The mushroom on their body weighs them down, so POKENAME usually remain inside a single dead tree. This fungus extends a network of mycelium throughout the tree to feed itself and POKENAME, growing larger and producing more spores over time.

entry: POKENAME通常待在高大枯树顶端，向风中散播真菌孢子。只有等当前的树腐烂得随时可能倒下，POKENAME才会搬去另一棵。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME are usually found at the top of tall dead trees, scattering fungal spores into the wind. POKENAME will only move on to another tree once their current one is rotten enough to topple at any moment.

entry: 寄生在POKENAME身上的真菌，驱使它不停觅食。得不到稳定养分时，它会暴躁好斗，抓挠、喷火攻击任何妨碍进食的东西。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are parasitised by a fungus that drives them to constantly seek out food. They can grow aggressive and irritable if not provided a steady source of nutrients, scratching and spitting fire at anything stopping them from eating.

entry: 它挖穿洞壁寻找凹穴，在长出的蘑菇间睡觉，同时散播孢子。这些蘑菇会吸收周围有机物的营养。
author: .izik
source: It claws through cave walls to find alcoves, spreading spores as it sleeps among the growing mushrooms. These mushrooms serve to absorb nutrients from the surrounding organic material.

entry: POKENAME的孢子让自己发痒，促使它抓挠身体，抖落孢子。孢子还很密实、容易燃烧，被人当作一种火药。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME's spores make them itchy, prompting them to scratch these spores free from their body. These spores are also dense and flammable, leading them to be used as a kind of gunpowder.

entry: POKENAME体内通常涌动着大量肾上腺素，多余能量便储存在蘑菇中。企业正尝试寻找方法，把这些蘑菇加入能量饮料。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME typically have so much adrenaline coursing through their bodies that this excess energy is stored in their mushrooms. Companies are attempting to find ways to incorporate these mushrooms into energy drinks.

entry: POKENAME经常用湿黏土抹满全身，盖住皮肤上生长的菌丝。研究员推测，它这样做是想减轻寄生物引起的瘙痒。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME regularly cover themselves in damp clay, plastering it over the mycelium growing over their skin. Researchers speculate they do this in an effort to reduce the itching that their parasitic growths cause.

entry: 它大部分时间埋在湿土中，只露出蘑菇。只要有什么碰到蘑菇，POKENAME便破土而出，挥动粗壮双臂，试图猛击入侵者。
author: imaginita
source: It spends most of its time buried in moist soil with only the mushrooms visible. If anything touches a mushroom, POKENAME will burst out of the ground and attempt to bash the intruder by swinging its thick arms.

entry: POKENAME把菌盖拉低，尽量一动不动，免得招惹捕食者。受惊时，先畏缩着躲到孢子云后，再瞬间移动到安全处。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME pull their mushroom caps down and stay as still as they can to avoid drawing the ire of predators. When startled, they cower behind a cloud of spores before teleporting to safety.

entry: POKENAME被养在娇弱作物旁，只有夜里才真正活跃。行走时散出的孢子，对植物完全无害，却能让宝可梦麻痹，久到足以被转移到别处。
author: ghostslythe
source: Cared for alongside sensitive crops, POKENAME is only truly active during the night. As it walks around, its body sheds spores that are completely harmless to plants. Pokémon, however, end up paralyzed long enough to be relocated.

entry: POKENAME能通过头上的蘑菇看见未来。若POKENAME预见自己即将受伤，蘑菇便会产生有疗伤作用的药液，储存起来，以备需要时使用。
author: jangodiot
source: POKENAME can see into the future through the mushroom on its head. When POKENAME foresees that it will be harmed in the near future, the mushroom produces a medicinal healing liquid that can be stored for whenever it is needed.

entry: 据说POKENAME是孩子走进蘑菇仙女环后诞生的。它能接入附近的菌丝，借此向其他POKENAME传递消息。
author: laughing_dan
source: POKENAME are said to be created when children wander into fairy rings. They are able to connect to nearby mycelium and use it as a way to send messages to other POKENAME.

entry: 沙奈朵遭派拉斯特伏击，沦为空壳与寄生宿主。据说为了护主，它不惜牺牲自己，也不惜牺牲其他所有宝可梦。
author: ogriphor
source: After Gardevoir was ambushed by a Parasect, it became a husk of its former self, becoming the host for the parasite. It is said that it would not only give its life to protect its Trainer, but also the life of any and all Pokémon.

entry: 大量纤细的菌丝控制着它的四肢，也将肢体维系在一起。它看不见，对声音极度敏感，还讨厌阳光。
author: thefinalkalgonus
source: Multitudes of thin fungus control its limbs and keep them attached. It is blind and hypersensitive to sound. It also hates sunlight.

entry: 大多数研究员认为，POKENAME的主体几乎已死，仅靠背上的真菌维持大脑存活。
author: bigoljax
source: Most researchers consider the main body of POKENAME to be almost dead. Only the fungi on their backs keep their brains alive.

entry: POKENAME背上的蘑菇控制着躯壳，使其散出毒孢子。孢子会榨干接触到的生物，夺取能量，让背上的蘑菇长大。人们相信，它甚至能吸走生命力。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: The mushroom POKENAME's back controls the shell, making it scatter poisonous spores. These spores drain the life out of anything they touch, stealing their energy to enlarge the mushroom on its back. It is believed it can even drain life force.

entry: POKENAME挖出土里的蘑菇吃，通常专找有毒的，不过训练家也教会了它寻找可食用的蘑菇。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME digs up mushrooms from under the soil to eat. While it usually searches for poisonous ones, Trainers have taught it how to find mushrooms that are safe to eat.

entry: POKENAME用尾巴攀住树枝，让身上的真菌伸入树中吸取营养。遭受攻击时，POKENAME会用长满真菌的长舌送出毒孢子，保护自己。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME clings to tree branches with its tail, enabling the fungus on its body to extend into the tree and absorb nutrients from it. POKENAME defends itself from attack by delivering toxic spores with its long, fungus-covered tongue.

entry: POKENAME坚硬甲壳上的真菌，具有不寻常的晶体结构。体内的菌丝网络连通四个大脑，它们似乎通过真菌交流。
author: .jerden
source: The fungus on top of POKENAME's hardened carapace has an unusual crystalline structure. A mycelial network inside POKENAME's body forms connections between its four brains, and it seems that they communicate with each other through the fungus.

entry: POKENAME把倒木啃成木屑，吃下一部分，供养背上的真菌，再往剩下的木屑撒孢子，培育新蘑菇。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME gnaw at fallen trees until they reduce them to wood chippings. They eat some of these to nourish the fungus on their back, and scatter spores on the rest to grow new mushrooms.

entry: POKENAME的蘑菇会释放发光孢子云，造成鲜明的幻觉，内容通常围绕受害者过去的错误。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME's mushroom emits a cloud of glowing spores. These spores cause vivid hallucinations that typically revolve around the victim's past mistakes.

entry: 接管意识的真菌，增强了它对波导的感知，使其能预判对手攻击。POKENAME连珠般出拳，连巨石也能击碎。
author: fiordaliso
source: The fungus that has taken over its consciousness has heightened its perception of auras, allowing it to anticipate its opponent's attacks. With its flurries of punches, POKENAME is capable of shattering even large boulders.

entry: POKENAME在树根处挖洞，住进阴凉潮湿的洞中。若有其他宝可梦靠近，POKENAME就会跳出来，用尖牙攻击。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME rests inside cool, damp burrows that it digs into the base of trees. If any other Pokémon approaches, POKENAME will leap out to attack with its sharp fangs.

entry: 抱着POKENAME，会感到舒适安心。这种融合宝可梦虽然没有嘴，却有人说能听见它向自己低语。
author: hophoppip
source: Holding a POKENAME induces feelings of comfort and reassurance. Though the fusion lacks a mouth, some say they can hear it whispering to them.

entry: POKENAME借头上的突起，寻找濒死树木。用利爪撕开树干后，POKENAME便能在内部散播蘑菇孢子。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME use the protuberances on their heads to help them track down dying trees. Using their sharp claws, they tear into these trees, allowing POKENAME to scatter mushroom spores inside.

entry: POKENAME镰刀般的爪上覆着真菌。POKENAME用它砍倒树木，第二天树桩就会冒出蘑菇。若不阻止，POKENAME会慢慢砍光整片山上的树。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's scythe-like claws are coated with fungus. After POKENAME uses them to cut down a tree, mushrooms will begin sprouting from the stump the very next day. If not stopped, POKENAME will slowly clear entire mountains of their tree cover.

entry: POKENAME的龙鳞覆着厚厚一层菌丝。丰缘各地的餐馆，会用来给炖菜增添辛辣风味。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's draconic scales are coated in a thick layer of mycelium. Restaurants throughout the Hoenn region use this as a spicy garnish in stews.

entry: POKENAME似乎受背上的蘑菇群控制。呼出的孢子效果强劲，连狂怒的龙都能安抚。
author: manidrake
source: POKENAME appears to be controlled by the patch of mushrooms growing on its back. It breathes potent spores capable of soothing even raging dragons.

entry: POKENAME性情温和，能与领地外的人和其他宝可梦结下深厚友谊。它会送蘑菇给认定的朋友，若有人拒收，就会觉得受冒犯，急忙爬回家。
author: quackquackattack
source: Its gentle temperament allows POKENAME to make beloved friends with people or other Pokémon outside its territory. It gifts mushrooms to those it regards as friends but will become offended by anyone who refuses the gift and skitter away back home.

entry: POKENAME一动不动地站着，直到有活物靠近，才用假颚一把抓住。几小时后再吐出来，受害者身上已长出畸怪的蘑菇。
author: sk372
