source: POKENAME stands stock-still until something living happens near it, whereupon it snatches them up in its false jaws. A few hours later, it spits them back out, the victim sporting grotesque mushroom growths.

entry: 晴朗的夜里，POKENAME会站在浅水中吸收海水。高盐分让POKENAME的蘑菇越长越大，直到脱落。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: On clear nights POKENAME stand in shallow waters, absorbing saltwater. The high salt content of the water causes POKENAME's mushrooms to grow bigger and bigger until they pop off.

entry: POKENAME的菌柄会随年龄增长而变长。有报告称，某些菌柄长达25英尺，从海浪下高高伸出水面。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's mushroom stalk grows longer with age. Some stalks have been reported to reach 25 feet in length, towering above the ocean's surface from the waves below.

entry: POKENAME伪装成珊瑚，耐心地静候数日，等猎物游过才出击。POKENAME通过让珊瑚感染真菌繁殖，被认为是珊瑚礁遭破坏的主要原因之一。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: Disguised as coral, POKENAME are patient hunters, staying stationary for days on end waiting for prey to swim by before striking. POKENAME reproduce by infecting coral with fungi; they are believed to be a leading cause of reef destruction.

entry: POKENAME接入海蚀洞内的菌丝网络，追踪闯进家中的猎物。它与同类一拥而上，释放黄色毒孢子云，让对方无法行动。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME links with mycelium networks within sea caves to track prey entering its home. It swarms them alongside others of its kind and releases clouds of yellow poisonous spores to incapacitate them.

entry: 由于感染真菌，POKENAME被认为已完全失明。因此，它常会猛烈攻击自己以为是捕食者的东西。
author: bigoljax
source: Due to the fungus that infects POKENAME, they're considered completely blind. This often causes them to violently attack whatever they think is a predator.

entry: POKENAME用头撞击敌人后，头上的蘑菇会爆开，散出一接触就引起强烈混乱的孢子。吃过苔藓或其他植物后，蘑菇很快就会重新长出。
author: .izik
source: After headbutting a foe, the mushrooms on POKENAME's head burst and spread spores that cause intense confusion on contact. They regrow rapidly after it eats moss or other plant life.

entry: POKENAME与同类切磋时，会用蘑菇头相互撞击。若哪一方掉下一块，双方都会惊慌，照料受伤的同伴。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spars with others of its kind by colliding their mushroom heads together. Should a chunk break off either combatant, they will panic and tend to the injured participant.

entry: 蘑菇对POKENAME身体的影响，已使痛觉完全麻木。它察觉不到任何打击，即使攻击不断擦过坚墙般的头骨，仍一味向前冲。
author: sk372
source: The mushroom's effect on POKENAME's body has completely dulled its sense of pain. It will not register any strikes against it, charging forward even as attacks glance off of its solid wall of a skull.

entry: 蘑菇虽侵入POKENAME身体深处，似乎并未对宿主造成重大不良影响。有些科学家认为，原因是真菌也继承了请假王懒散的天性。
author: sk372
source: Despite infesting deep within POKENAME's biological symptoms, the mushroom appears not to adversely affect the host in any major capacity. Some scientists believe the reason is that the fungus inherited Slaking's lethargic nature.

entry: POKENAME住在阴暗潮湿的洞穴，有助体内寄生真菌生长。领地常以蘑菇圈标记，它会试着把寄生物传给任何闯入者。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME make their home within dank, moist caves that help to encourage the growth of their parasitic fungus. Their territories are often marked by mushroom circles, and they try to introduce their parasite to anyone who trespasses on their home.

entry: 阿勃梭鲁变成POKENAME十分罕见，但这种感染并不妨碍它预知灾难。见过POKENAME的人，可能在一周内被孢子感染。
author: ilazerheart
source: It is rare for an Absol to become a POKENAME, however its affliction does not stop it from predicting catastrophe. Those who see a POKENAME can become infected with the spores within a week.

entry: 过去，POKENAME被视为肮脏的带病者与厄运先兆。不过，研究发现，它不受真菌控制，还会主动避开生物，只向愿让它接过负担的派拉斯一系融合宝可梦现身。
author: thordemidgard
source: In the past, POKENAME were seen as vile carriers and harbingers of doom. However, research has found that it's immune to the fungus' control and actively avoids life, only showing itself to fusions of the Paras line who will let it take their burden.

entry: POKENAME的身体完全中空，只在释放真菌孢子云时张嘴。只需用手或爪触碰树干，就能吸食树木的生命力。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's body is entirely hollow, and it only opens its mouth to release clouds of fungal spores. It feeds on the life force of trees simply by touching their trunks with its hands or claws.

entry: POKENAME前往已感染真菌的树旁，耐心等待树木死去。一旦死亡，POKENAME便用大嘴从树枝到树根，吃得一干二净。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME travels to trees that are already infested with fungus, then patiently waits for the tree to die. As soon as this happens, POKENAME will use its large mouth to entirely devour it, from its branches to its roots.

entry: POKENAME体内满是真菌，充当消化系统，每次呼气都会散出孢子。大多落进海中，少数吹到陆地上，便能扎根长出新蘑菇。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's entire body is filled with fungus, functioning as its digestive system, and it scatters spores every time it breathes out. While most of these land in the sea, the ones that blow onto land can take root as new mushrooms.

entry: POKENAME释放的孢子，能腐蚀吸入者的心智。受害者往往深信它是一位神明。
author: .izik
source: The spores released by POKENAME can corrupt the minds of those who inhale them. Victims often become convinced it is a deity.

entry: POKENAME偶尔会在大型宗教集会上现身。它一旦出现，附近所有派拉斯都会被迫进化。
author: weirdtux
source: POKENAME will rarely appear during large religious gatherings. When POKENAME does appear, every Paras in its vicinity is forced into evolution.

entry: POKENAME漫无目的地游荡在枯死森林中，嚼食断枝。吃完后，背上的蘑菇会射出一大团孢子，繁衍自身。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME wanders aimlessly around dead forests, munching on broken twigs. After it finishes eating, the mushroom on its back fires off a large clump of spores to propagate itself.

entry: POKENAME被背上的蘑菇完全控制，在林中缓慢蹒跚，啃咬树木和来不及逃走的宝可梦，让真菌吸干它们的生命力。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME is completely controlled by the mushroom on its back. It shambles slowly through the forest, biting trees and any Pokémon that doesn't move fast enough to escape it, enabling the fungus to drain their life force.

entry: POKENAME行动缓慢，看似漫无目的，却从不停歇。任何想停在它背上的生物，都会被洒上一身有毒蘑菇孢子。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME lumbers about at a slow pace, never stopping despite its seemingly aimless wandering. Any creature that tries to perch on its back will be showered in toxic mushroom spores.

entry: 野外的POKENAME伪装成一堆被蘑菇群落连在一起的骨头。猎物走得太近，就先放出孢子云扰乱方向，再起身向前冲撞。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME can be found in the wild, masquerading as a pile of bones held together by a mushroom colony. When prey wander too close, POKENAME disorients them with a cloud of spores before getting up and charging forward.

entry: POKENAME住在阴暗潮湿的洞穴，有助体内寄生真菌生长。寄生物开始长出子实体时，它会行动迟缓，站在洞口，让孢子随风飘散。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME make their home within dank, moist caves that help to encourage the growth of their parasitic fungus. They become sluggish when their parasite begins its fruiting phase, standing at the mouth of the cave to allow spores to drift in the wind.

entry: 蘑菇完全接管POKENAME身体后，尾火就会熄灭，取而代之的是源源不断的孢子。POKENAME用尾巴刺穿地面、扎入树根，吸取养分。
author: distinguishedmanlygentleman
source: Once the mushroom has entirely taken over POKENAME's body, the flame on its tail is extinguished, replaced by a constant stream of spores. POKENAME uses its tail to stab through the ground and into the roots of trees, sapping their nutrients.

entry: 孢子不停从菌盖散出，随风飘动，如同火焰。趁对手被孢子分散注意，POKENAME会冲上去攻击。孢子还会使感官迟钝，让对手更难专心。
author: imaginita
source: Spores continuously emanate from its cap, blowing in the wind like a flame. While its opponent is distracted by spores, POKENAME will rush in to attack. The spores dull the senses, helping to distract opponents.

entry: POKENAME在同类群中昂首阔步，寻找能爬到的最高处，想要站得比谁都高。一群中位于最高点的POKENAME会释放孢子，试图把寄生物传给其余同伴。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME strut through crowds of their peers searching for the highest point they can reach, aiming to be the one to stand tallest. The POKENAME at the peak of a given grouping releases its spores, aiming to pass its parasite to the rest.

entry: POKENAME在同类群中昂首阔步，寻找能爬到的最高处，想要站得比谁都高。一群中位于最高点的POKENAME会释放孢子，试图把寄生物传给其余同伴。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME strut through crowds of their peers searching for the highest point they can reach, aiming to be the one to stand tallest. The POKENAME at the peak of a given grouping releases its spores, aiming to pass its parasite to the rest.

entry: 春天，POKENAME摇摇晃晃地走过林地，不断释放孢子。吸入者可能连续打喷嚏，长达五分钟也停不下来。
author: mepp.
source: During springtime, POKENAME constantly releases spores as it waddles along on the forest floor. Those that inhale these spores are known to uncontrollably sneeze for up to five minutes.

entry: POKENAME嗅寻健康的树，只要最新鲜的树液。等吸尽养分，就会把树推倒，再让其感染真菌。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME sniff out healthy trees, looking for only the freshest sap. When the tree is fully drained, they push the tree over and infect it with fungi.

entry: POKENAME脸上巨大的真菌覆着金属层。受磁力吸引，会靠近金属物，喷出孢子，腐蚀表面，同时长成更多金属蘑菇。
author: .jerden
source: The immense fungus growing on POKENAME's face has a metallic coating. It is drawn towards metallic objects through magnetic attraction, then blows out spores that corrode the surface while growing into more metallic mushrooms.

entry: 独特的生理结构让POKENAME既能独自在森林狩猎，也能用菌盖附着并控制宿主。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME's unique physiology allows it to hunt in the forest independently or attach and control a host with its mushroom cap.

entry: POKENAME用利刃砍倒树木，再埋进树桩，吸取树根的生命力。期间用菌盖保护自己，直到树完全腐烂，才转移到下一棵。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME use their blades to cut down trees, then bury themselves in the stump to drain the roots of life force. POKENAME shield themselves from harm using their mushroom cap until the tree is completely rotten, then move on to the next tree.

entry: 面对陌生者，POKENAME总会先挑起冲突，用渗出真菌毒液的前角撞击入侵者。POKENAME格外重视领地，确保弟妹有成长的空间。
author: quackquackattack
source: When confronted with strangers, POKENAME will be the first to initiate hostile encounters, ramming into intruders with its front horn that oozes fungal venom. POKENAME are particularly territorial, ensuring its younger siblings have space to develop.

entry: POKENAME带领一群感染同种真菌的宝可梦，用手上的锋利钢刃劈开树木，供大家取食，也用来抵御任何袭击者。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME leads a group of other Pokémon infested with the same fungus. It uses the sharp steel blades on its hands to cut open the trees they all feed upon, and to defend the group from any attackers.

entry: POKENAME全身的蘑菇已占据心智，将头部完全包裹。它不停在林中游荡觅食。受威胁时，真菌会发光，释放足以压倒任何敌人的强力电击。
author: fiordaliso
source: The mushrooms covering POKENAME's body have overtaken its mind, fully enveloping its head. This Pokémon roams the forests endlessly in search of food, and when threatened, the fungi glow and unleash potent electric shocks that overpower any foe.

entry: POKENAME全身都很结实，蘑菇尤其坚固，硬得如同钢铁。吸入蘑菇释放的孢子，会感到身体极其僵硬沉重。
author: sk372
source: While every part of POKENAME's body is sturdy, its mushrooms are particularly robust, being as solid as steel. Inhaling the spores from its mushrooms causes one to feel extremely stiff and heavy.

entry: POKENAME游荡沙漠，割开遇见的每一株植物，汲取里面的水和食物。它从不把植物吃光，却总会留下真菌孢子，在受损植物内部生长。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME roams the desert, slicing open any plant it encounters to extract water and food from within. It never fully consumes these plants, but always leaves behind fungal spores that grow inside the damaged plant.

entry: POKENAME在湖底吃水生植物。它向周围水中释放的真菌孢子，能让人和宝可梦放松，但过量会失去意识。与POKENAME在同一片水域游泳非常危险。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME feeds on underwater plants at the bottom of lakes. The fungal spores it releases into the water around it relax both people and Pokémon, but too much causes unconsciousness. It is highly dangerous to swim in the same waters as POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME从嘴里吐出孢子，通常用来对付惹怒自己的宝可梦。这些孢子似乎储存在翅膀中。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME breathe spores from their mouths, usually against Pokémon who have angered them. The spores they breathe seem to be stored in their wings.

entry: POKENAME身上的真菌吃树根时，齿轮静止不动。只有真菌准备从蘑菇散播孢子时，才会高速旋转，把孢子甩向远方。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's gears remain still as the fungus that grows on it feeds on tree roots. They only begin to turn once this fungus is ready to scatter spores from its mushrooms, and will spin at high speed to fling spores long distances.

entry: POKENAME融入阴影，头上真菌控制身体，留在黑暗中吞食无防备的猎物。锐爪，便于它悄然偷袭。
author: thepandasharky
source: POKENAME blends into the shadows, the fungus on its head controlling it to stay in the dark and feed on unsuspecting prey. Its sharp claws allows it to strike stealthily from the darkness.

entry: POKENAME身体安抚心绪的特性，让它与蘑菇形成了共生关系。双方都能从中获得养分与保护。
author: melodydelune
source: The calming nature of POKENAME's body has led it and the mushroom to form a symbiotic relationship where they both gain nutrients and protection.

entry: POKENAME极其凶暴，不容任何生物闯入家中。它会失去理智地狂追，把沿途挡路的树、岩石和其他一切都撕碎撞毁。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is extremely aggressive and does not abide by intruders in its home. It chases them down with a mindless fury, tearing and shattering trees and rocks and anything else that gets in its way while in pursuit.

entry: POKENAME偶尔游向河流上游，随身带来的持续暴雨会引发洪水。等POKENAME离去、洪水退下，每一处湿表面都会开始长出小红蘑菇。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME occasionally swims up rivers, causing flooding with the constant downpour it brings with it. When POKENAME moves on and the floodwaters recede, tiny red mushrooms will begin to sprout from every damp surface.

entry: POKENAME头上的巨大蘑菇，似乎从不受它制造的烈日伤害。散入干燥空气的孢子，也仿佛能在足以杀死大多数真菌的干旱环境中茁壮生长。
author: .jerden
source: The immense mushroom on POKENAME's head never seems to be harmed by the harsh sunlight it creates. The spores it scatters into the dry air seem to thrive in dry conditions that would kill most other fungi.

entry: POKENAME住在阴暗湿穴，以遍布的孢子标记领地。孢子中提取的毒物，还能制成致命毒素。
author: over9001
source: POKENAME lives in dark, damp caves which it infests with spores to mark its territory. The poison extracted from its spores can be used to create a deadly toxin.

entry: POKENAME身上的真菌，似乎在高空生长得很好，只以尘埃为食。POKENAME飞得足够低，能经常穿过云层，防止真菌在高处干燥。
author: .jerden
source: The fungus growing on POKENAME's body seems to thrive high up in the air, feeding only on dust. POKENAME flies low enough to regularly pass through clouds, keeping their fungus from drying out at high altitude.

entry: POKENAME一次能释放大量孢子，传染性极强，会引起迅速衰老与腐败。
author: elekboy88
source: POKENAME can emit large volumes of spores at a time. These spores are highly infectious and cause rapid aging and decay.

entry: POKENAME用爪子抓住树木，不折断木头就将其扭曲，在原本实心的木材中开出大洞。这样，POKENAME便能吸食树液，同时往树内散播孢子。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME grabs trees with its claws and warps the wood without breaking it, opening up a large hollow cavity in what was previously solid wood. This enables POKENAME to feed on the sap while scattering spores inside the tree.

entry: POKENAME寻找生物密集的林区，用孢子增强当地宝可梦的攻击性。趁它们忙着彼此争斗，POKENAME便继续传播蘑菇。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME seek out populated forest areas, then use their spores to increase aggression in the Pokémon present. While the Pokémon are occupied fighting each other, POKENAME spreads more mushrooms.

entry: POKENAME动作迟缓，因为任何活动都会牵扯包裹全身的蘑菇群落。探索古代遗迹的人建议，从POKENAME旁跑过去；目标跑得太远时，它往往就放弃追赶。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are slow to react as any movement strains the mushroom colony that envelops their body. People exploring ancient ruins advise running past POKENAME as they often give up the chase if their target is too far away.

entry: POKENAME喜欢在潮湿森林中休眠。传说POKENAME吸取树根养分，增强力量，改变地形。它还会向打扰者释放毒孢子。
author: riel.vndxgrxvnd
source: POKENAME prefers damp forests to lie dormant. Stories tell of POKENAME draining nutrients from tree roots to fuel its strength and shift landforms. It also releases poisonous spores on those who disturb it.

entry: POKENAME的孢子造成噩梦般幻觉，对受害者真实得可怕。夜里，它还会爬上天花板，散布恐惧。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME spores cause nightmarish hallucinations that feel incredibly real to its victims. It appears in the night, crawling on the ceiling to inflict terror.

entry: POKENAME从背上的炮发射孢子，将敌人麻痹在原地。制服后，POKENAME会用利爪检查捕获的猎物。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME fire spores from the cannon on their backs to paralyze foes in place. Once subdued, POKENAME examines their catch with their sharp claws.

entry: POKENAME每次振翅都会释放孢子，飞行时将浓密的孢子云送入大气。孢子混进云层，引起局部天气变化，降雨几天后，蘑菇便会长出。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME release spores with each flap of their wings, releasing dense plumes into the atmosphere as they fly. Their spores mix with clouds, causing localised weather changes and resulting in rains followed by mushroom growth a few days later.

entry: POKENAME白天看不见，月亮升起后却能看得清楚。它常试着在月光下跳舞，结果也常常东倒西歪。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME are blind during the day, but when the moon rises, they can see clearly. They often try to dance in the moonlight, but often end up stumbling around.

entry: 它的蘑菇内部发电时，会发光嗡鸣。电力通过大爪释放，因此受到工程师使用。
author: infinex21
source: Its mushrooms glow and hum as electricity generates within them. It releases electricity through its large claws, which has led to it being used by engineers.

entry: POKENAME感染树根，吸取养分。营养积累后，粗厚的白色真菌丝会在全身蔓延。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: POKENAME infects tree roots and saps nutrients from them. As those nutrients accumulate, thick strands of white fungus grow across its body.

entry: POKENAME有一种让其他宝可梦无法抗拒的鲜香。被引来的生物，都会被POKENAME周围飘浮的毒孢子云制伏，因此它根本不必主动捕猎。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME has a savory scent that makes it smell irresistible to other Pokémon. Anything that is lured in will be incapacitated by the cloud of toxic spores that floats in the air around POKENAME, so it has no need to hunt for prey.

entry: 白天，POKENAME紧贴树干，看起来更像一朵大蘑菇，而非宝可梦。夜间才松开，乘风飘去，把鲜艳的孢子洒遍森林。
author: .jerden
source: During the day, POKENAME clings to tree trunks so tightly that it resembles a large mushroom rather than a Pokémon. At night, it lets go and floats off in the wind, scattering its brightly colored spores across the forest.

entry: 白天，POKENAME紧贴树干，看起来更像一朵大蘑菇，而非宝可梦。夜间才松开，乘风飘去，把鲜艳的孢子洒遍森林。
author: .jerden
source: During the day, POKENAME clings to tree trunks so tightly that it resembles a large mushroom rather than a Pokémon. At night, it lets go and floats off in the wind, scattering its brightly colored spores across the forest.

entry: POKENAME热切地靠近其他宝可梦，一接近就从耳朵和尾巴散出孢子。若被攻击，会用强力踢击还击，因为覆盖脚部的真菌已硬化成皮革状物质。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME eagerly approaches other Pokémon, scattering spores from its ears and tail as soon as it gets close. If it is attacked, it will fight back with powerful kicks, as the fungus covering its feet has hardened into a leathery substance.

entry: POKENAME的寄生蘑菇控制动物部分捕猎，在尸体上留下孢子。探索炎热潮湿的森林时，应留意它的领地，那里以一堆堆红黄蘑菇为标记。
author: pjporwoll
source: The parasitic mushroom of POKENAME controls the animalistic half to hunt prey and leave spores on the carcass. Explorers in hot, humid forests should be wary of its territory, which is marked by mounds of the red and yellow mushroom.

entry: POKENAME背上的蘑菇已控制心智，驱使它越飞越快，寻找养分。真菌需要的营养越多，它的翅膀就扇得越疯狂。
author: fiordaliso
source: The mushroom on its back has taken control of POKENAME's mind, driving it to fly faster and faster in search of nutrients. The more sustenance the fungus requires, the more frantically the Pokémon's wings beat.

entry: POKENAME藏在诅咒娃娃外壳内，从内部操纵它。天冷时动作僵硬，会暴露这副躯壳并非真正的诅咒娃娃。
author: gasmaskblacky
source: POKENAME takes cover inside its Banette shell and controls it from within. In cold weather, its stiff movements will give it away as a fake.

entry: 对研究放射性物质的科学家而言，POKENAME已成为处理危险同位素的重要帮手。身体不仅能吸收辐射，还能操作机器，协助重要实验。
author: quackquackattack
source: For scientists working with radioactive materials, POKENAME have become vital to handling dangerous isotopes. Not only are their bodies capable of absorbing radiation, but they are also capable of operating machinery for important experiments.

entry: 孢子混入身体，使POKENAME体表的液体膜泛着橙色。多次测试表明，这种混合物极其危险，但只能以细小液滴流出。
author: bigoljax
source: The liquid coating covering POKENAME's body appears to have an orange tint due to spores mixing with their bodies. Multiple tests show that this mixture is highly dangerous, but can only come out in small droplets.

entry: 野生POKENAME会聚在一起，站成名为仙女环的圆圈。虽然完全静止无声，地下的真菌却正延伸菌丝网络，吸取养分。
author: .jerden
source: Wild POKENAME will gather together to stand in circles known as fairy rings. Although they remain totally still and silent, beneath the ground their fungus will be spreading out a network of mycelium to feed.

entry: POKENAME能钻过最细小的缝隙。白天借此潜入地下吃植物根，夜里则挤进人家，在找到的每一处阴暗潮湿角落留下真菌孢子。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME can slip through the smallest of cracks. During the day they use this ability to burrow underground and eat plant roots, while at night they squeeze into human homes to leave fungal spores in every dark, damp place they can find.

entry: 世界各地都会用POKENAME背上的真菌炖菜。味道独一无二，因此人们成群寻找POKENAME及其蘑菇。
author: dyanz0
source: The fungi growing on POKENAME's back are used in stews across the world. Its flavor gives off a taste like no other, which results in groups hunting for POKENAME and its mushrooms.

entry: 考古学家把POKENAME视为祸害。它一旦钻进墓穴，孢子就会让里面一切覆满真菌，迅速分解古代文物与保存的木乃伊。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME are considered a menace by archaeologists. If they make it inside a tomb, their spores will cover everything inside with fungus, rapidly breaking down any ancient artifacts and preserved mummies inside.

entry: POKENAME背上长着稀有蘑菇，很受收藏家追捧。POKENAME生活在偏僻潮湿的环境，很难找到。
author: seffffffffffffff
source: POKENAME is well sought after by collectors due to the rare mushrooms that grow off its back. POKENAME lives in secluded damp environments, making it difficult to obtain.

entry: POKENAME被认为极其危险，穿行已知栖息地时必须十分小心。它攀在洞顶和树冠，伸出真菌细丝，感染接触到的一切。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is considered very dangerous, and great care should be taken when venturing through its known habitats. It clings to cave ceilings and tree canopies, extending fungal tendrils that will infect anything they come in contact with.

entry: POKENAME趴在树根上，吸取树木生命力，让头上的蘑菇发光。谁若碰到它，能量也会开始被吸走。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME rests its body on tree roots, making the mushroom on its head glow using the life force it absorbs from the tree. If anyone touches it, their energy will also begin to be leeched away.

entry: POKENAME的蘑菇在黑暗中如火焰般发亮，常被误认成新奇灯笼。光来自它悬挂的树木的生命力，靠近的人也会被吸走能量，可能累得昏倒。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME are often mistaken for novelty lanterns, as their mushrooms glow like fire in the dark. This light is fueled by the life-force of the trees POKENAME hang from, but people who approach are also drained and may pass out from exhaustion.

entry: POKENAME头上的蘑菇，会分泌像烛蜡一样能燃烧的物质。POKENAME把利爪扎进树皮，吸取真菌所需的营养，让头顶的火持续燃烧。
author: .jerden
source: The mushroom on POKENAME's head secretes a substance that burns like candle wax. POKENAME will sink its sharp claws into the bark of trees to obtain the nutrients the fungus needs to keep the fires on its head burning.

entry: 它们用长牙割开树木，汲取树液与养分，茁壮成长。POKENAME鸣叫时，蘑菇会震动，放出可能长成小型寄生蘑菇的孢子。
author: infinex21
source: They thrive on the sap and nutrients in trees, both accessed through the cuts made with their tusks. When POKENAME cry out, their mushrooms shake and release spores that may develop into small, parasitic mushrooms.

entry: POKENAME身上的蘑菇，以核心的能量为食。能量不断流出，既防止核心爆炸，也让蘑菇长得硕大。
author: wiz0z
source: The mushrooms on POKENAME's body feed on the energy from the core. The constant flow of energy prevents the core from detonating while also helping the mushrooms grow to massive sizes.

entry: POKENAME是杂食生物，几乎什么都能吃，连塑料也不例外。处境艰难时，会把这些人造物熔成稠浆，再让真菌孢子将其分解成可食用的糊。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are omnivorous creatures that can eat nearly anything, including plastic. When conditions are dire, they melt these manmade products into a sludge before allowing fungal spores to break it down into an edible paste.

entry: 受到威胁时，POKENAME嘴里会猛然伸出巨大的爪状附肢，痛击任何试图靠近的捕食者。
author: bigoljax
source: When threatened, a large claw-like appendage shoots out of POKENAME's mouth. This appendage clobbers any predators that try to get near.

entry: POKENAME对闪亮物品很感兴趣，会用自己培育的蘑菇交换。这些蘑菇磨成粉后，是缓解记忆力减退药物的重要原料。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are interested in shiny objects, trading them for the mushrooms they grow. These mushrooms can be ground down, becoming a key ingredient in medicine to aid with memory loss.

entry: POKENAME的大部分身体，已由感染它的真菌占据，只有头和脚等少数部位未受感染。它靠光合作用获取营养。
author: bigoljax
source: Most of POKENAME's body is the fungus that infects them, leaving only their head and feet as their few uninfected parts. They rely on photosynthesis as their way of getting nutrients.

entry: POKENAME飞到高空，释放易燃孢子，传播真菌。蘑菇受损时会喷火。
author: hiroshima0042_23263
source: POKENAME flies high into the air to release flammable spores that spread the fungus. The mushroom releases fire when it is damaged.

entry: POKENAME跟在派拉斯和派拉斯特后面，盼着吃到沿途的小蘑菇。若菌盖开始破裂，就会寻找训练家，求其修补伪装。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME trail after Paras and Parasect, hoping to eat any small mushrooms along the way. Should their cap begin to tear, they will seek out a Trainer and beg them to repair their disguise.

entry: 它身上发光的生长物，是一种稀有真菌，会像器官般搏动。所持武器由树木化石制成。动作古怪而不规则，似乎被真菌拖着走。
author: infinex21
source: The glowing growth upon its body is a rare species of fungus that pulsates and throbs as if it were an organ. The weapon it wields is made from petrified wood. Its moves in odd and erratic ways, seemingly being dragged around by the fungal growth.

entry: 许多故事声称，这只宝可梦的真身，藏在上方悬垂的大蘑菇里。从蘑菇伸出的菌丝，似乎控制着下半身的行动。
author: infinex21
source: Many stories claim that the true body of this Pokémon resides within the large mushroom hanging overhead. The tendrils of mycelium extending from the mushroom seem to control the movements of the lower half of its body.

entry: POKENAME聚集于森林火灾的灰烬中，以烧焦树木留下的肥沃残骸为食。据说它火焰的温暖，能促使这些荒芜地区重新萌发生机。
author: femaledog
source: POKENAME gather in the ashes of forest fires, feeding on the fertile remains of charred trees. The warmth of their flames is said to encourage new growth in these desolate regions.

entry: POKENAME只在夜间外出，因为阳光会让蘑菇干燥。蘑菇有自己的意识，主体又看不见，因此常由蘑菇领着四处走。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME only comes out at night, as its mushrooms will end up drying out in the sun. The mushrooms have a mind of their own and often lead the main body around due to its lack of vision.

entry: POKENAME的脑袋完全被菌盖遮住，靠真菌对空气微粒的敏感性辨路。若有几株可供真菌进食的植物同样近，两个头就可能朝不同方向拉扯。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's heads are completely covered by mushroom caps, and it navigates using the sensitivity of this fungus to particles in the air. If multiple plants the fungus could feed on are equally close, the two heads may pull in different directions.

entry: POKENAME手臂上的两个头虽能咬东西，却由菌丝构成。POKENAME漂过森林时，背上伸出的菌柄会缠住附近植物，吸取养分。
author: .jerden
source: Although they can bite, the two heads on POKENAME's arms are made of fungal mycelium. As POKENAME floats through forests, the mushroom stalks emerging from its back will wrap themselves around nearby plants to drain nutrients from them.

entry: POKENAME能与被撒上孢子的人心灵感应。孢子洗掉前，这些人都会不由自主地收集腐烂植物，带给POKENAME吃。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME can communicate telepathically with people they scatter their spores on. Until those spores are washed off, these people will experience a compulsion to gather up rotting plants and bring them to POKENAME to eat.

entry: POKENAME能用心灵感应察觉他人情绪，再从蘑菇散出孢子操纵。有些孢子让敌人平静得睡着，另一些则激起怒火，使其攻击POKENAME以外的宝可梦。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME can telepathically sense the emotions of others, and manipulate them by scattering spores from its mushroom. Some spores make foes so calm that they fall asleep, while others incite rage so that they attack Pokémon other than POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME在古树根部挖洞，以树根为食，度过其他食物稀少的寒冷月份。它极力守家，谁想伤害树木，就摇尾向其洒下大量有害孢子。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME dig their burrows at the roots of ancient trees, feeding on them to get through the colder months when other food is scarce. They are protective of their homes, shaking their tails to shower noxious spores on any that try to harm their tree.

entry: 野外发现活着的POKENAME的记录很少。被收容的个体不断变异，长出新的部分，似乎始终痛苦不堪。科学家虽努力研究，仍未找到治疗方法。
author: chinigan
source: There are few records of POKENAME being spotted alive in the wild. Those brought into containment seem to be in constant agony as their bodies mutate and develop new growths. Despite scientists' attempts, no cure has been developed.

entry: 据说来自遥远的真菌宇宙。会拖着沉重的步伐四处行走，用双手刺穿猎物，还会结网捕捉更多猎物食用。
author: theheroict
source: Said to be from a far-away fungal universe, it trudges around and stabs prey with its hands. It spins webs to trap additional prey to consume.

entry: POKENAME与同类求偶时，会释放浓密的真菌孢子云。科学家最近开始在坠落的陨石上，发现微量这种物质。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME releases thick clouds of fungal spores during courtship rituals with others of its kind. Scientists have recently begun discovering trace amounts of this substance on meteorites that have crashed.

entry: 据说深入森林、走进POKENAME长满真菌的家园，便能获它实现愿望。少数自称见过它的人，都无法完整回忆经过，身上通常还带着奇怪的蘑菇形印记。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is said to grant wishes to those who venture far enough into its fungus-laden home deep within forests. The few who claim to have seen it cannot fully recall the encounter, and typically bear strange mushroom-shaped markings on their body.

entry: POKENAME挖到树根处进食，却让背上的蘑菇露在外面散播孢子。POKENAME会一动不动，直到供它取食的树死去，才爬走寻找下一棵。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME dig down to tree roots to feed, but leave the mushrooms on their back exposed to scatter spores. POKENAME will remain completely motionless until the tree they are feeding on dies, at which point they will crawl away searching for another.

entry: POKENAME与派拉斯争食，常与这种同为虫属性的宝可梦交战，争夺特定树木。蘑菇长得格外密的POKENAME，攻击性更高，似乎正试图用孢子感染派拉斯。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME compete with Paras for food, often battling their fellow Bug-type for control over specific trees. POKENAME with particularly dense mushroom growth show heightened aggression, suggesting they are attempting to infect Paras with their spores.

entry: POKENAME头上的蘑菇喜欢潮湿，因此POKENAME用木头筑坝，供孢子生长。真菌很快让木头腐烂，POKENAME只得不停砍树，赶在溃坝前加固。
author: .jerden
source: The mushroom on POKENAME's head thrives in damp conditions, so POKENAME build dams out of wood for its spores to grow on. The fungus quickly rots the wood, so POKENAME must constantly cut down trees to reinforce their dam before it bursts.

entry: 侵染POKENAME的蘑菇又重又吸取养分，让它无法行动。这也可能反过来害了真菌，因为宿主或许会无法进食，难以维生。
author: sk372
source: The mushroom infesting POKENAME weighs it down and drains it to the point of being immobile. This can backfire on the fungus, as it may leave its host unable to feed and sustain itself.

entry: 寄生蘑菇增强了POKENAME的精力与攻击性，让它领地意识极强，尤其面对其他蘑菇宝可梦时。它很少休息，只有受伤或准备进化时才歇下。
author: pjporwoll
source: The parasitic mushroom enhances POKENAME's energy and aggression, making it highly territorial, especially when interacting with other mushroom Pokémon. It rarely rests, only doing so if injured or ready to evolve.

entry: POKENAME往体内灌满水，便能在地面弹跳。它借此散播蘑菇孢子，弹起时不规则地翻滚，能将孢子撒得很远。
author: .jerden
source: By filling its body with water, POKENAME can bounce along the ground. It uses this to spread spores from its mushroom, and its erratic tumbling as it bounces can spread them far and wide.

entry: POKENAME毫无意识地啃咬接在外部插座上的设备电线。偶尔被电到，反而会兴奋地喵喵叫。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME mindlessly chew wires of devices plugged to exterior sockets. Occasionally they get zapped, whereupon they meow excitedly.

entry: POKENAME重视领地，用蘑菇孢子划定地盘。它通过菌丝网络传递电流，电击领地内的入侵者。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME is territorial and marks its territory using mushroom spores. It sends jolts of electricity through the mycelium network to shock intruders within its territory.

entry: POKENAME在古树根部挖洞，以树根为食，度过其他食物稀少的寒冷月份。它用许多尾巴堵住洞口，防止其他生物进入藏身处。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME dig their burrows at the roots of ancient trees, feeding on them to get through the colder months when other food is scarce. They block the entrance to their burrows with their many tails, preventing others from accessing their shelter.

entry: POKENAME在古树根部挖洞，以树根为食，度过其他食物稀少的寒冷月份。POKENAME的蘑菇会带上木质风味，又令人联想到所居树木的果实。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME dig their burrows at the roots of ancient trees, feeding on them to get through the colder months when other food is scarce. POKENAME mushrooms develop a woody flavour that's reminiscent of the fruits of the tree they live under.

entry: POKENAME漂过森林，留下一道催眠孢子。它会被音乐吸引，许多露营者都说，放完音乐后，惊讶地发现它正在营地边缘默默看着自己。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME floats through forests leaving a trail of sleep-inducing spores. It is attracted to music, with many campers reporting their surprise upon finding one silently watching them from the edge of their campsite after playing music.

entry: 蘑菇吸走POKENAME大量养分，让它通常坚硬的金属壳变弱。为弥补防御下降，真菌会释放大量麻痹孢子。
author: sk372
source: The mushroom has drained many nutrients from POKENAME, weakening its typically hard metal shell. The fungus dispenses large amounts of paralyzing spores to compensate for the drop in defensive strength.

entry: POKENAME穿行沙漠，不停寻找绿洲。找到后，就把半身泡进水中，让寄生蘑菇尽情吸水，同时将真菌孢子渗入水中。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME traverse deserts in a constant hunt for oases. When they find one, they sit themselves half submerged in the water and allow their parasitic mushroom to absorb as much as it can, fungal spores leaking into the water as they do.

entry: POKENAME通过咬伤传播真菌孢子，让不幸被咬的宝可梦感染寄生真菌。训练家受到建议，应尽快带受影响的宝可梦去最近的宝可梦中心。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME transmit fungal spores through their bites, spreading the infection of their parasitic fungus to any unfortunate Pokémon that they bite down on. Trainers are advised to take affected Pokémon to the nearest Pokémon centre as soon as possible.

entry: POKENAME通过咬伤传播真菌孢子，让不幸被咬的宝可梦感染寄生真菌。训练家受到建议，应尽快带受影响的宝可梦去最近的宝可梦中心。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME transmit fungal spores through their bites, spreading the infection of their parasitic fungus to any unfortunate Pokémon that they bite down on. Trainers are advised to take affected Pokémon to the nearest Pokémon centre as soon as possible.

entry: POKENAME用薄薄真菌形成的翅膀飞越沙漠，寻找水源。身后一道孢子飘入沙中，等下一场雨来，沿途就会冒出蘑菇。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME soar across the desert on wings formed of thin fungus in search of watering holes. They leave a trail of spores drifting to the sands as they fly, mushrooms sprouting in their wake with the next rains.

entry: POKENAME在池塘游动，吞食漂浮植物，借体内寄生真菌帮助消化。它能清除水中杂草，但普遍被认为太丑，不适合养在观赏池。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME swims around in ponds, swallowing floating plants and digesting them with the aid of a fungus that infests its body. It can be used to keep water clear of weeds, but is widely considered to be too ugly to include in ornamental ponds.

entry: POKENAME成群攀在洞壁睡觉。一只醒来，其余也会跟着醒，追逐吞食看见的任何生物，如同受一个心智控制，是十分难对付的群体。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME sleep in clusters while clinging to cave walls. If one awakens, the rest follow suit, chasing and devouring any creature they spot as if controlled by one mind, making them a formidable group.

entry: POKENAME的蘑菇很坚固，足以抵挡大多数直接打击。它会主动寻找危险，任由自己挨打，每挨一下就释放一团孢子。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME mushrooms are tough enough to allow them to resist most physical blows. They seek out danger, allowing themselves to be struck and releasing clouds of spores every time they suffer a blow.

entry: POKENAME的孢子让吸入者产生幻觉，往往误以为面对的是另一种宝可梦。POKENAME借这份混乱，在战斗中以意想不到的方式攻击。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME spores induce hallucinations in those that breathe them in, often causing the afflicted to believe they are facing a different Pokémon. POKENAME take advantage of this confusion, striking in unexpected ways in battle.

entry: POKENAME双眼对强光敏感，不愿白天外出。夜里现身时，会彼此歌唱，蘑菇和谐共鸣，帮助它们在黑暗中找到同伴。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME eyes are sensitive to bright light, making them unwilling to come out during the day. When they emerge at night, they sing to one another, their mushrooms resonating in harmony and helping them find each other in the dark.

entry: POKENAME是首个有记录的真菌感染如此巨大宿主的案例。可惜，宿主的体形限制了它的行动能力。
author: patch_bros
source: POKENAME is the first recorded case of a fungus infecting a specimen this large. Unfortunately, the size of the host limits this creature's mobility.

entry: 失去了控火能力，取而代之的是释放浓烈气味孢子的本领。奇怪的是，孢子闻起来像烧焦的蘑菇。
author: patch_bros
source: It has swapped its pyrokinetic abilities for the ability to give off powerful smelling spores. Oddly enough, the spores smell like burnt mushrooms.

entry: POKENAME住在潮湿洞穴，纹丝不动，蓬松真菌慢慢从主体向外蔓延。红蘑菇虽是美味，却十分危险，想采摘的人只要碰到白色真菌，就会被吞噬。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME inhabits damp caves where it remains immobile as a fluffy fungus slowly spreads from its core body. The red mushroom is a dangerous delicacy since any trying to retrieve it who comes in contact with the white fungus will be consumed.

entry: 熟睡的POKENAME常被误认成常青森林中最罕见的大蘑菇。它们可以食用，但为驱虫而生的极辣味，如今反让采集者盯上了它们。
author: lucioleuh
source: Sleeping POKENAME are often mistaken for the rarest Big Mushrooms of Viridian Forest. They are edible but have a very spicy taste, originally meant to deter insects, which now makes them a forager's target.

entry: 手臂上玫瑰状的马勃释放的孢子，毒性足以让大多数其他宝可梦昏迷。若POKENAME找到潮湿环境扎根，头上带刺的蘑菇便会越长越大。
author: .jerden
source: The spores released from the rose-shaped puffballs on its arms are toxic enough to knock most other Pokémon unconscious. If POKENAME finds a damp environment to take root in, the spiky mushroom on its head will grow larger and larger over time.

entry: POKENAME快速展开卷着的长耳，将耳上菌盖的孢子散出。听觉敏锐，听见捕食者或火焰劈啪声，就会立刻藏起。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME scatters spores from its mushroom caps by quickly unrolling the long ears they are attached to. It has a keen sense of hearing and will immediately hide if it hears a predator or fire crackling.

entry: 菌盖下，是受感染蘑蘑菇近乎干枯的躯壳。POKENAME一直休眠，直到有什么碰到它，便喷出一阵孢子，感染并吸干下一个受害者。
author: sk372
source: Beneath the cap lies the nearly-dried husk of the infested Shroomish. POKENAME lays dormant until something touches it, spreading a burst of spores to infect and drain its next victims.

entry: 一种奇怪液体在POKENAME核心周围，形成蘑菇状的保护膜。哪怕轻轻一碰，也会让人患上相当严重的真菌感染。
author: sk372
source: A strange liquid forms a protective mushroom-shaped membrane around POKENAME's core. Even just a small touch will infect a person with a rather nasty fungal infection.

entry: POKENAME不守着一处熟悉栖息地，而是周游世界，既获取知识，也传播孢子。孢子包在体外浓稠的果冻状物质中，这层胶质还能帮助土壤保持湿润。
author: bobosmith01
source: Instead of staying in one familiar habitat, POKENAME moves around the world, both in order to gain knowledge and to spread its spores. Its spores are contained in the thick jelly-like substance around its body. The jelly helps keep the soil moist.

entry: POKENAME的身体轻得刚好能被较强的风带走。它飘过大地时，会在半空旋转身体，把蘑菇孢子撒到下方地面。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's body is just light enough to be carried along the wind when the breeze is strong. It spins its body in midair to spread mushroom spores across the ground below as it floats across the land.

entry: POKENAME钻行于森林地面的湿土，只让头和菌盖露出地面。体内真菌从土里吸取营养供养它，但为保护蘑菇，谁靠近都会被咬。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME burrows through the damp soil of the forest floor, with only its head and mushroom cap above the surface. The fungus on its body feeds it with nutrients drawn from the dirt, but to defend its mushroom, it will bite anyone who approaches.

entry: POKENAME躲在黑暗洞穴和隧道中，盲目地爬来爬去，吃植物根和地下蘑菇。它们在黑暗中彼此低唱，歌声诡异，回荡不绝。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME keep to dark caves and tunnels, scuttling about blindly and feeding on plant roots and underground mushrooms. They croon to one another in the dark, singing an eerie, echoing song.

entry: POKENAME用粗厚菌丝裹住身体，减轻外力伤害。它们完全失明，在黑暗洞穴中爬行时，靠声呐辨路。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME wrap their bodies in thick strands of mycelium, helping to protect themselves from physical harm. They are totally blind, relying on their sonar to navigate as they scuttle around dark caves.

entry: POKENAME在漆黑洞穴中寻觅食物，似乎靠身上的蘑菇感知周围。真菌若闻到空气中的腐败气息，就会引导POKENAME前往可能有食物的地方。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME scavenges for food inside pitch-black caverns, and seems to sense its surroundings using the mushrooms growing on its body. If the fungus senses the scent of decay in the air, it will direct POKENAME towards this potential source of food.

entry: 它的真菌孢子是沙漠仙人掌的养分，会在不停觅食的途中无意间散播。谁敢碰头上的蘑菇，POKENAME就会受原始本能驱使，咬向对方。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its fungal spores serve as nourishment for cacti in the desert; it spreads them unintentionally as it wanders ceaselessly in search of food. POKENAME bites anyone who dares to touch the mushroom on its head, driven by a primal instinct.

entry: POKENAME在墓地里把自己埋到颈部，将菌丝网络伸入土中。许多人觉得它们分解尸体令人不安，也有人把鲜艳蘑菇视为生命延续的象征。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME bury themselves up to the neck in cemeteries and extend a network of mycelium out into the soil. While many find it unsettling that they break down dead bodies, others see their colorful mushrooms as a reminder that life goes on.

entry: POKENAME常被误认成巨大的芳香蘑菇，是各地采集者的克星。庞大的蘑菇身体里，储存着电力。
author: seffffffffffffff
source: Often mistaken for large Balm Mushrooms, POKENAME is the bane of collectors everywhere. It contains stores of electricity within its large mushroom body.

entry: 受到威胁时，POKENAME会向四面发射尖刺。刺不算锋利，却装满毒孢子，让其弥漫空中。
author: imaginita
source: When threatened, a POKENAME will shoot spikes in all directions. These spikes are not very sharp, but they are packed with poisonous spores that fill the air.

entry: POKENAME嘴里长出的长牙状蘑菇十分坚硬，击中敌人时会留下一团团孢子。既能打击敌人，也能让孢子削弱对方。
author: .izik
source: The tusk-like mushrooms sprouting from POKENAME's mouth are very hard and leave behind puffs of spores when it strikes a foe. This serves both as an attack and a way to weaken the enemy with a debilitating effect.

entry: POKENAME用尖锐长牙割开树木，再以爪子从切口吸取养分。有时蘑菇会抽动，爪子也随之一同动作。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME use their sharp tusks to cut open trees. Using their claws, they can siphon nutrients from the cuts they make. At times, their mushrooms twitch and their claws move in sync with the twitching.

entry: POKENAME部分身体由黏土构成，其他部分则像虫属性宝可梦。缕缕菌丝将身体连在一起，像肌肉般收缩舒张，驱动POKENAME行动。
author: .jerden
source: Parts of POKENAME are made of clay, while other sections resemble a Bug-type Pokémon. Strands of fungal mycelium hold its body together, moving POKENAME around by contracting and relaxing like muscles.

entry: POKENAME在感染真菌的树木周围巡逻。从它对任一真菌受损的反应看来，控制它的似乎是所有这些真菌，而不只是身上长的那些。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME patrols around trees infested by fungi. Based on the way that it responds to damage to any of these fungi, it seems to be controlled by all of them, not just the ones growing on its body.

entry: POKENAME背上柔韧的蘑菇不断拍动，推动身体飞行。抽搐般的动作令人不安，很少有捕食者愿意捕猎它。
author: .realthree
source: The flexible mushroom on POKENAME's back flaps to propel the Pokémon through the air. Few predators will hunt this Pokémon due to its unnerving, jerking movements.

entry: POKENAME全身长满真菌，会提高体温，摸起来温暖。这些真菌让POKENAME能进入寒冷地区，不必担心维持正常体温。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME is covered with fungal growths that increase its body temperature, making it warm to the touch. These growths allow POKENAME to venture into cold climates without worrying about maintaining a healthy body temperature.

entry: 白天，POKENAME攀在潮湿洞穴的顶上。日落后才捕猎，用爪子攀住猎物，再扎入两根口器，一边取食，一边注入蘑菇孢子。
author: pjporwoll
source: During the day, POKENAME clings to the ceiling of moist, humid caves. After the sun has set, it hunts for prey, latching onto them with its claws, and embedding its twin proboscis to feed and inject mushroom spores.

entry: POKENAME看起来虽然美味，却十分凶猛。极少有人能咬上一口，而吃到的人最后都食物中毒了。
author: patch_bros
source: It may look delicious, but POKENAME is highly aggressive. Very few have managed to grab a bite, but those who have ended up getting food poisoning.

entry: POKENAME不断释放发光孢子，覆满栖息的洞穴。洞里泛着诡异橙光，让它能找到露出的宝石吃。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME release a steady stream of glowing spores, coating the caves they live in with the spores. Their homes glow with an eerie orange light, allowing them to seek out exposed gem stones for consumption.

entry: POKENAME住在地下隧道，挖开洞壁，寻找植物根吃。闯入者都会被POKENAME的真菌孢子弄昏，醒来时已长满蘑菇。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME live in underground tunnels, digging in the walls to search for plant roots to feed on. Anyone that ventures into these tunnels will be knocked unconscious by POKENAME's fungal spores, and will wake up covered with mushrooms.

entry: POKENAME不断释放发光孢子，覆满栖息的洞穴。它寻找露出的祖母绿，把孢子抹上去，促使更多黑色菌盖的蘑菇生长。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME release a steady stream of glowing spores, coating the caves they live in with the spores. They seek out exposed emeralds, smearing their spores onto the gems and encouraging the growth of more black-capped mushrooms.

entry: POKENAME住在地下隧道，挖开洞壁，寻找植物根吃。闯入者都会被POKENAME的真菌孢子弄昏，醒来时已长满蘑菇。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME live in underground tunnels, digging in the walls to search for plant roots to feed on. Anyone that ventures into these tunnels will be knocked unconscious by POKENAME's fungal spores, and will wake up covered with mushrooms.

entry: 派拉斯特与勾魂眼融合后，前者的巨大蘑菇与勾魂眼的身体合为一体。战斗和捕猎时，蘑菇能精确操纵身体，如同提线木偶，令人毛骨悚然。
author: infinex21
source: The fusion between a Parasect and a Sableye resulted in the former's giant mushroom merging with the body of the Sableye. The mushroom puppeteers the body with eerie accuracy during battle and when hunting for food.

entry: POKENAME群居于森林深处，入夜便啃食腐烂植物。蘑菇脱落后，它们会把蘑菇放在巢穴周围，吓退捕食者。
author: mistymagius
source: Colonies of POKENAME live deep within the forest, nibbling on rotting plant matter once night falls. Once their mushrooms fall off, they will place them around their den to deter predators.

entry: 它滚动时会在洞穴各处散播孢子，借此感到舒适。孢子长成小蘑菇后，便通过相连的根状网络，吸收附近有机物的营养，同时供养真菌与自身。
author: .izik
source: While rolling, it spreads its spores around caves. This helps it feel comfortable, and as the spores grow into tiny mushrooms, absorbing nutrients from nearby organic material due to interlocking root systems that nourish both the fungus and itself.

entry: POKENAME体型庞大，十分笨拙胆小。孢子虽然有毒，却常被用于药物。
author: bigoljax
source: Due to their large size, POKENAME are incredibly clumsy and timid. Despite their spores having toxic properties, they're often used in medicines.

entry: POKENAME整天用强壮的颚嚼木头。自己虽然无法消化，背上的真菌却能分解木头，并供给POKENAME生存所需的营养。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME spends all day chewing wood with its strong jaws. Although it cannot digest the wood, the fungus on its back can and will supply POKENAME with the nutrients necessary to survive.

entry: POKENAME住在遍布真菌的森林深处。一声怒吼，就能从口中放出大量孢子，让植物感染寄生蘑菇，其他生物则会起真菌性皮疹，变得虚弱。
author: sk372
source: Deep within fungi-infested forests, POKENAME dwells. With a single roar it spreads out massive amounts of spores from its mouth that infest plant life with mushroom parasites, and enfeeble anything else with fungal rashes.

entry: 有些POKENAME变体的敌意和传染性，都比其他类型低，但很难一眼分清。较温和的类型通常独来独往，以老枯树为食。
author: sk372
source: Some variants of POKENAME are less hostile and infectious than others, though the difference is difficult to tell at a glance. The calmer type typically keeps to itself, feasting on old dead trees for sustenance.

entry: 冬季，POKENAME寻找耐霜的蘑菇裹住身体，藏在菌盖下，等待寒冷过去。途中会留下一道孢子，无意间将真菌传播到身后各处。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME seek out frost-resistant mushrooms to wrap around their body during winter months, sheltering within the mushroom caps to wait out the cold weather. They leave a trail of spores as they travel, inadvertently spreading the fungi behind them.

entry: POKENAME总在颤抖。并非因为寒冷或不适，而是一直在抖落软乎乎披风上的孢子。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME are always shivering. Not because they are cold or in discomfort, but because they are constantly shaking spores off of their mushy cloak.

entry: POKENAME的身体除了纠缠的菌丝，完全中空。里面的空气始终阴凉潮湿，是适合真菌的绝佳环境。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's body is entirely hollow, except for a tangle of fungal mycelium. The air inside is always cool and damp, creating the perfect environment for the fungus.

entry: POKENAME住在雪地，把致幻孢子混进飘雪。受影响者被引到巢中，进一步感染能使人麻痹的蘑菇，成为它收藏的战利品。
author: sk372
source: Living in snowy areas, POKENAME hides the hallucinogenic spores it spreads among the snowfall. Those affected are lured into its den, infected further with paralytic mushrooms, and kept as trophies.

entry: 专门团队在实验室合成它的真菌孢子，用来制造强效镇静剂。POKENAME太弱，无法保护身上的共生真菌，因此一察觉危险，就本能地逃跑。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its fungal spores are synthesized in the laboratory by specialized teams to create powerful sedatives. Since it is too weak to protect the fungus that lives in symbiosis on its body, POKENAME instinctively flees as soon as it senses danger.

entry: POKENAME在阴暗潮湿处漫无目的地跳舞，走到哪里都散下孢子。听见音乐，POKENAME往往会不由自主地随节奏摇摆，附近的蘑菇也会长得快得多。
author: icelevelincarnate
source: POKENAME aimlessly dance in damp, dark places, shedding spores wherever they go. In response to music, POKENAME tend to sway to the rhythm uncontrollably, and any mushrooms nearby grow much faster.

entry: POKENAME头上的大蘑菇，驱使它寻找有机物，供真菌消化。它用敏锐嗅觉和大爪翻找垃圾堆，直到挖出埋藏的厨余。
author: .jerden
source: The large mushroom on POKENAME's head compels it to seek out organic matter for the fungus to digest. It will use its keen sense of smell and its large claws to rummage through garbage heaps until it unearths buried food waste.

entry: POKENAME捕猎时近乎失去理智，凶猛地咬住一切能咬的东西，传染真菌孢子。甚至能长出真菌细丝，撑起身体，在陆地奔跑，继续追猎。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME hunts with an almost mindless aggression, biting down on anything it can to infect them with fungal spores. It can even sprout tendrils of fungal matter to lift itself up and run on land to continue a hunt.

entry: 它附着于洞壁，像树一样扎根。散出的孢子会造成绿色斑痕，最终寄生有机物，长出蘑菇，供它取食。
author: .izik
source: It attaches to cave walls, rooting in like a tree. It spreads spores that cause green blemishes, eventually parasitizing organic material to grow mushrooms for nourishment.

entry: POKENAME确实吸取树木生命以获取能量，却也会产生一种生物副产物，促进附近植物生长，并飞快修复损伤。因此，有POKENAME在，环境通常会更加繁盛。
author: bobosmith01
source: Although it's true that POKENAME drain life from trees for energy, they also produce a biological byproduct that promotes and heals damage to nearby plants with incredible swiftness; typically, this means environments flourish with POKENAME around.

entry: POKENAME确实吸取树木生命以获取能量，却也会产生一种生物副产物，促进附近植物生长，并飞快修复损伤。因此，有POKENAME在，环境通常会更加繁盛。
author: bobosmith01
source: Although it's true that POKENAME drain life from trees for energy, they also produce a biological byproduct that promotes and heals damage to nearby plants with incredible swiftness; typically, this means environments flourish with POKENAME around.

entry: POKENAME慢吞吞地爬来爬去，毫无意识地沿途撒下孢子。有时，它的酸性口水会滴到下方的孢子上，让孢子失去活性。
author: frokachu
source: POKENAME slowly scuttle about, thoughtlessly dropping spores in its path. Sometimes its acidic drool will land on the spores below them, rendering them useless.

entry: 白天，POKENAME躲在地下，背上厚厚的真菌毯以树根为食。无月之夜才出来捕猎，在黑暗中用回声定位找到猎物，再用蘑菇孢子将其弄昏。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME hides underground during the day, the thick mat of fungus on its back nourishing itself on tree roots. On moonless nights, it emerges to hunt, locating prey in the dark using echolocation, then knocking it out with spores from its mushrooms.

entry: POKENAME蓬松的翅膀全由真菌构成，每次活动都会掉下孢子。POKENAME飞行时会轻哼，却只有一个持续的音，而非歌曲。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's fluffy wings consist entirely of fungus, and shed spores every time it moves. POKENAME hums as it flies, but produces only a single continuous note rather than a song.

entry: POKENAME周身的膜里充满毒孢子，碰过的人应仔细洗手。它们喜欢阴暗潮湿的地方。
author: imaginita
source: The membrane surrounding a POKENAME's body is filled with poisonous spores, so anyone who touches it should wash their hands thoroughly.  They thrive in dark, damp places.

entry: POKENAME看似无精打采，缓缓爬向能探到的任何水源。黏糊的身体先浸进水洼或池塘，再蜷入壳中，慢慢吸取下方地面的养分与水。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME appear lethargic, slithering towards any water they can detect. They dip their gooey bodies inside puddles and ponds before curling inside their shells, slowly absorbing the nutrients and any water from the ground below them.

entry: POKENAME皮肤黏滑，上面生长的真菌控制着大脑，让它如恍惚般踉跄而行。虽然似乎无法复杂思考，POKENAME仍能用利爪与强壮尾巴，狠狠打击敌人。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME stumbles around as if dazed, because its brain is controlled by fungi growing on its slimy skin. While it seems to be incapable of complex thought, POKENAME can still use its sharp claws and muscular tail to strike foes with great force.

entry: POKENAME用菌丝包裹岩石，搭成身体并控制行动，还会拾取新石头，让体型增大。久而久之，全身长出小蘑菇，新蘑菇附近的部位便能移动得更精准。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME covers rocks with fungal mycelium to build a body and control its movements, even picking up new rocks to increase its size. Over time, small mushrooms grow across its body, allowing for precise locomotion in the new mushroom's vicinity.

entry: POKENAME在寒冷地区的森林里缓慢行走。任何生物接触到蘑菇产生的孢子，都会发冷好几天。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME lumbers around slowly within forests of colder regions. Anything that comes in contact with the spores its mushroom produces develops chills for several days.

entry: POKENAME慌乱地四处移动，撞遍能碰到的表面。体重太重，常会跌倒，压到其他宝可梦身上。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME scatter around frantically, bumping into every surface they can. Due to their heavy weight, they often tumble down onto other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME背上的蘑菇越大，吸走的能量就越多。这种寄生关系会产生毒花粉，对POKENAME和其他宝可梦都有害。
author: calikov
source: The larger the mushroom on POKENAME's back, the more energy it saps. This parasitic relationship creates toxic pollen, harmful to both POKENAME and other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME体内遍布真菌，动作僵硬笨拙。挨打时，一团团孢子便会飞出，寻找新的生长地点。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME movements are stiff and awkward due to the fungal growths that spread throughout their bodies. When they're struck, clouds of spores fly free with the goal of finding a fresh place to grow.

entry: 研究员推测，POKENAME鲜艳的色彩与奇异的声音，是为了招来捕食者打击自己，好散播孢子。电子游戏公司从POKENAME获取灵感，设计出以它为原型的角色。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Researchers theorise that the vibrant colours and outlandish noises of POKENAME are so that they can be struck by predators to spread their spores. Video game companies take inspiration from POKENAME and create characters based on them.

entry: 感染POKENAME的真菌，驱使它无端猛攻其他宝可梦。目的竟是受伤到露出毛绒内里，将一团孢子释放到空中。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The fungus infecting POKENAME drives them to aggressively launch unprovoked attacks on other Pokémon. They do this with the goal of getting injured enough to reveal their plush interiors, launching a cloud of spores into the air.

entry: 感染POKENAME的真菌，驱使它无端猛攻其他宝可梦。目的竟是受伤到露出毛绒内里，将一团孢子释放到空中。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The fungus infecting POKENAME drives them to aggressively launch unprovoked attacks on other Pokémon. They do this with the goal of getting injured enough to reveal their plush interiors, launching a cloud of spores into the air.

entry: POKENAME的长菌丝根攀住一组锚状爪子。谁妨碍POKENAME散播孢子，就会被整个锚头的重量狠狠砸打。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have long mycelium roots that cling to a set of claws that resemble an anchor. If anything stops POKENAME from proliferating their spores, they are bludgeoned with the full mass of the anchor head.

entry: POKENAME各条肢体会慢慢积存、释放沉重的孢子。孢子不致命，却会在接触皮肤时引起刺激，吸入则令人困倦。若挨上足够重的一击，POKENAME储存的孢子就会同时全部释放。
author: pkbonusducks
source: Each of POKENAME's limbs slowly accumulate and dispense heavy spores. These spores aren't deadly, but irritate skin on contact and induce drowsiness if inhaled. If hit by a strong enough blow, all of POKENAME's stored spores release simultaneously.

entry: POKENAME能静止近一周，等待猎物试咬蘑菇般的触手。一旦被咬，就会吐出毒液，让猎物衰弱。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME are able to remain still for nearly a week, waiting for prey to try taking a bite out of their mushroom-like tentacles. When bitten, they spit out a poisonous liquid, leaving their prey weakened.

entry: POKENAME的孢子富含营养，世界上许多干旱地区都会加入肥料中。孢子遇水迅速膨胀，能被缺水的植物轻松吸收。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME spores are so dense with nutrients that they are included in fertilizers in many arid regions of the world. These spores rapidly expand when hydrated, allowing them to be readily absorbed by thirsty plants.

entry: POKENAME在沙漠中央一动不动，直到有活物走近。随后便从身体射出大量仙人掌刺，刺穿并感染目标。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME stands motionless in the middle of the desert until something living moves near it. It then fires off numerous cactus spines from its body meant to pierce and infect its targets.

entry: 野生POKENAME通常待在彩色蘑菇环的中央。有些人称之为仙女城堡，但任何想借此栖身的宝可梦，都会被POKENAME吸走生命力。
author: .jerden
source: Wild POKENAME are usually found at the center of rings of colorful mushrooms. While some people refer to them as fairy castles, POKENAME will drain the life-force of any Pokémon that tries to use it as shelter.

entry: POKENAME最初被复原时，人们以为背上的蘑菇是冬虫夏草。后来却发现，那其实是一种古老真菌，过去一直以为早已消失于岁月之中。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: When POKENAME was first revived, the mushroom on its back was thought to be a tochukaso mushroom. However, it was discovered to actually be an ancient species, previously assumed to be lost to time.

entry: 傍晚，POKENAME的褶边会产生鲜艳极光，随着移动拖曳身后。看着虽美，靠近却很危险，因为极光由高浓度毒孢子构成。
author: sk372
source: In the evening, POKENAME's frills create a vibrant aurora that trails behind its movements. Though visually appealing, the aurora is dangerous to be near due to the high concentration of toxic spores it is composed of.

entry: POKENAME精力充沛，常四处奔跑，希望训练家定期带自己散步。由于POKENAME容易沿途留下孢子，训练家受到提醒，散步时要顾及他人，做好清理。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are filled with energy, often racing around and wanting their trainers to take them on regular walks. Trainers are advised to be considerate and clean up when doing so as POKENAME are prone to leaving trails of spores behind them.

entry: POKENAME即使状态完好，也不停喘气。许多人认为，是真菌的影响让大脑误以为身体缺水。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME are constantly panting, even when they're in perfect condition. Many believe this is due to the fungi's influence making the brain believe they're dehydrated.

entry: 寄生蘑菇试图让自己远离危险，但面对强敌时，POKENAME鲁莽的本能就会发作，不顾自身安危地攻击。
author: imaginita
source: The parasitic mushroom tries to keep itself out of danger. When faced with a powerful opponent, however, POKENAME's reckless instincts kick in, causing it to attack without care for its own well-being.

entry: 据说POKENAME能通过幽幽歌声释放催眠孢子。民间故事尊它为“孢子女王”，会寄附熟睡的宝可梦，吸取生命，维持自身生存。
author: riel.vndxgrxvnd
source: POKENAME is said to release sleep-inducing spores through its haunting voice. Revered in folktale as the "Queen of the Spores," it leeches upon sleeping Pokémon, draining their life to sustain its own.

entry: 只要附近有观众，POKENAME就会跳起舞。等舞蹈结束，POKENAME已筋疲力竭，观众也被孢子催得睡着了。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: If there's an audience nearby, POKENAME will break out into dance. By the time this dance has finished, POKENAME will be exhausted, and their audience will have fallen asleep by spores.

entry: 长时间吸入POKENAME洞穴里的孢子，受害者会陷入沉睡。期间，它能远程控制对方，驱使其一步步走向领地深处。
author: .izik
source: Prolonged inhalation of spores from POKENAME's cavern will put the victim into a deep slumber. During this time it can control them remotely, walking them deeper into its domain.

entry: 头上的真菌突起产生精神力量，将POKENAME从水中托到空中。尾巴牢牢抓住树枝后，POKENAME便能用不断磨动的牙，啃穿结实的树干。
author: .jerden
source: The fungal protrusion from its head generates psychic power, lifting POKENAME out of the water and into the air. Once its tail gets a solid grip on a tree branch, POKENAME's gnashing teeth can gnaw through the solid wood of the tree trunk.

entry: 据说行为不端的人，在野外见到POKENAME就会中毒。关于它的传闻很多，还有人声称，背上的真菌其实是控制身体的寄生物的一部分。
author: _alex_0o
source: Seeing a POKENAME in the wild is said to poison those who have behaved poorly. Many rumors surround it, including claims that the fungus on its back is actually part of a parasite controlling its body.

entry: POKENAME抖动背上鳞片，发出诡异的唧唧声，彼此交流。相遇时，会用大前爪互相梳理，试着清除对方身上的真菌感染。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME rattle the scales on their back to communicate with one another, creating an eerie chittering noise when they do. They groom one another with their large foreclaws when they meet, trying to keep one another clean of fungal infection.

entry: POKENAME住在长满真菌的洞穴，吃从外面冲进来的腐烂物质。听见任何东西靠近，便会逃走，融入周围蘑菇和菌丝中藏身。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME can be found inside caves filled with fungi and will feed on decaying material that washes in from outside. They will flee if they hear anything approach them, then hide by blending in with the mushrooms and mycelium around them.

entry: POKENAME游荡湖底，劈开大石寻找猎物。它常把爪子当钝器，从上往下猛砸。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME wander the bottom of lakes, cracking open large rocks to find prey. They often use their claws as blunt weapons, attacking in downward motions.

entry: POKENAME动作虽慢，却很擅长战斗。混沌的心智，让它攻击时毫不犹豫。
author: bigoljax
source: Though their movements are slow, POKENAME are very capable fighters. Their fogged up minds force them to not hesitate when attacking.

entry: 真菌不断从宿主吸取养分，长得过大，几乎让其无法动弹。一察觉有什么靠近，POKENAME便散出孢子，拼命想找到新宿主，继续繁衍。
author: sk372
source: The fungus has grown so much from siphoning from its host that it has grown so large as to leave it nearly immobile. POKENAME spreads spores at the hint of something approaching, desperate to propagate further with a new host.

entry: 蘑菇从宿主夺取太多，让双方都成了褪色的空壳。POKENAME摸起来干燥易碎，受外界刺激，会惊恐地释放孢子，然后逃走。
author: sk372
source: The mushroom has taken so much from the host that both have become a discolored husk. POKENAME is dry and brittle to the touch, and reacts to outside stimuli with a fearful release of spores before fleeing.

entry: POKENAME毛皮覆满毒孢子，每次动作都会散播。大脑藏在蘑菇下面，因此极不建议尝试采摘蘑菇。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's fur is covered in toxic spores, spreading them around with every move. Its brain hides under its mushroom, so trying to harvest the mushroom is highly ill-advised.

entry: POKENAME靠共生真菌保护自己，以密实菌丝网缓冲直接打击。它们相互战斗，帮助蘑菇在家族群体内传播。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME use their symbiotic fungus to protect themselves from harm, relying on the dense mesh of mycelium to absorb the impact of physical blows. They battle one another to help spread the mushrooms within their family groups.

entry: POKENAME靠共生真菌保护自己，以密实菌丝网缓冲直接打击。战斗时耐心等待，寻找用巨爪反击的机会。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME use their symbiotic fungus to protect themselves from harm, relying on the dense mesh of mycelium to absorb the impact of physical blows. They bide their time in battle, waiting for an opportunity to strike back with their giant claws.

entry: 被迫在日光下行走时，POKENAME会摘下附近最大的蘑菇。孢子极易燃烧，因此必须让身体始终遮在阴影中。
author: ghostslythe
source: When forced to walk in the daylight, POKENAME plucks the largest mushroom nearby. Its spores are highly combustible, thus it must keep its body constantly shaded.

entry: 在原生雨林里，POKENAME常被误认成树苗，白天乐于静止不动。日落后才活跃起来，把易燃的蘑菇当火把，引来毫无防备的虫属性宝可梦。
author: ghostslythe
source: Usually mistaken for a sapling in its native rain forests, POKENAME is content to stay still during daylight hours. At sundown, it comes to life, using a flammable mushroom as a torch to attract unsuspecting Bug types.

entry: 晴天，POKENAME在一处扎根，尽可能吸收日光。为了驱赶威胁，POKENAME会弹动蘑菇，扬起孢子云，再打喷嚏将其点燃。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME root themselves in one spot on clear days to absorb as much sunlight as they can. To ward off threats, POKENAME flicks their mushroom to cast a spore cloud before sneezing to ignite them.

entry: POKENAME体内的真菌，增强了它的忍术。它能隐入菌盖散出的浓密孢子云，再从阴影中用臂上利刃攻击。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's ninjitsu is enhanced by the fungus within it. It can vanish into a thick cloud of spores scattered from its mushroom cap, then strike from the shadows using the sharp blades on its arms.

entry: POKENAME性情暴烈，体内因此积起很大压力。背上的蘑菇利用产生的蒸汽动力散播孢子，之后POKENAME便会平静下来。
author: mcnchsschl_69424
source: Due to POKENAME's violent tendencies, it builds up a lot of internal pressure. The mushroom on its back uses the resulting steam power to spread its spores. Once this happens, POKENAME calms down.

entry: POKENAME爬上南瓜紧紧攀住，让头上的真菌消化瓜体。发现南瓜全被POKENAME吃光的人，有时会抓住它们，当作替代的节庆装饰。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME climb on top of pumpkins and cling tightly as the fungus growing on their heads digests the gourd. People who discover that all their pumpkins have been devoured by POKENAME may capture them to use as alternative holiday decorations.

entry: 蘑菇夺走POKENAME摄入营养的90%，让主体迟缓虚弱。不过，蘑菇也是宝贵的防护：任何咬上去的生物，都会很快丧命。
author: mistymagius
source: As the mushroom takes 90 percent of the nutrients POKENAME consumes, the main body is slow and frail. However, the mushroom acts as valuable protection, as anything that bites into it will meet a swift end.

entry: POKENAME从腹部的嘴吐出带感染性的南瓜籽，走到哪里种到哪里。种子长得飞快，几天内就能形成迅速扩张的南瓜地。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME spits out infectious pumpkin seeds from the mouth on their stomachs, planting them wherever they go. These seeds grow rapidly, creating fast-spreading pumpkin patches within days.

entry: POKENAME产生甜美的糖浆状液体，吸引猎物。许多人认为，液体其实由它吃过的猎物制成。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME produce a sweet, syrup-like liquid to attract prey. Many believe this liquid is actually made of the prey they've eaten.

entry: POKENAME在森林家园中踉跄而行，流下能促进真菌生长的液体。受到威胁时，POKENAME会吐出浓缩的毒粉球，随后继续蹒跚前行。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME stagger through their forest homes, drooling a fluid that stimulates fungi growth. If threatened, POKENAME spits concentrated balls of Poison Powder before resuming their shambling.

entry: 鲜艳的配色，警告许多捕食者它很难吃。不过，POKENAME味道其实并不坏，只是在模仿独角虫等物种天生的警戒色。
author: bobosmith01
source: Its bright coloration warns many predators of its foul taste. However, POKENAME actually tastes just fine: it is instead mimicking the natural warning signals species like Weedle use.

entry: POKENAME大部分白天都泡在栖身的河里，只有菌盖在水面浮动。谁想采摘蘑菇，它就扑过去，用强壮的爪子抓住采集者。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME spend most of their day with their body submerged within their river homes, only their spore cap bobbing above the water. They lunge at anyone that tries to gather their mushroom, grabbing at the would-be forager with their powerful claws.

entry: POKENAME尽力模仿乐天河童的舞蹈。不过，心智极度混沌，常让它踉跄跌倒。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME try to mimic the dances of Ludicolo as best as possible. However, their minds are incredibly foggy and often cause them to stumble and fall around.

entry: 大群POKENAME划过夜空，在高层大气中翻滚，留下闪亮轨迹。采集轨迹的大气样本后，发现那些竟是孢子云。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Swarms of POKENAME can be seen streaking across the night sky, tumbling through the upper atmosphere and leaving a glittering trail behind them. Atmospheric samples of the trail they leave have determined them to be spore clouds.

entry: POKENAME的蘑菇夺走了摄入的大部分营养，迫使它不停移动觅食。它会被强光吸引，夜里有时能看见它爬上路灯。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME mushrooms parasitise most of the nutrients that they consume, forcing them to be constantly on the move in search of food. They are drawn to bright lights and can sometimes be seen climbing up streetlights at night.

entry: POKENAME用强壮锋利的爪子撕开树皮。战斗时，偏爱挥动尾巴，释放灼热孢子。
author: oddwalls
source: POKENAME uses its powerful, sharp claws to tear into tree bark, and prefers to fight by producing scorching spores with a swing of its tail.

entry: POKENAME在整片隧道中释放浓密孢子，能引起高烧。有些人相信，事先吃一颗桃桃果就能中和毒素。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME releases dense spores throughout its tunnels that can cause violent fevers. Some believe eating a Pecha Berry beforehand neutralizes the toxins.

entry: POKENAME身上抖落的孢子，会长成覆有菌丝的小晶体。晶体很脆，一破就碎成数千细屑和孢子，吸入会损伤呼吸道。
author: chibitales
source: Spores shaken from POKENAME's body grow into small, mycelium-covered crystals. These crystals are brittle, shattering into thousands of tiny shards and spores upon breaking and causing damage to the respiratory tract if inhaled.

entry: POKENAME游泳时，不断向水中释放孢子。它不适合圈养，因为养它的水族箱必须定期清理过滤系统里长出的蘑菇。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME shed a constant stream of spores into the water as they swim. They are poorly suited to captivity, as any aquarium housing them needs to have mushrooms regularly cleaned out of their filtration systems.

entry: POKENAME的身体几乎全由蘑菇状物质构成。它建造庞大的地下迷宫，孢子浓密地悬浮其中，空气几乎无法呼吸。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body is composed almost entirely of a mushroom-like substance. It builds vast underground labyrinths where spores hang so thick the air becomes nearly impossible to breathe.

entry: POKENAME虽已失明，仍能靠蘑菇触角释放的感知孢子，灵巧地穿行栖息地。常在树顶捕猎鸟宝可梦，或供自己取食，或传染蘑菇孢子。
author: pjporwoll
source: Despite having lost its eyesight, POKENAME deftly navigates its habitat due to the mushroom antennae releasing sensory spores. It is often found in treetops hunting bird Pokémon to feed its body or infect them with the mushroom's spores.

entry: POKENAME通常温顺懒散，喜欢在阴凉潮湿的暗处小睡，取悦控制身体的蘑菇。若有人碰蘑菇，就会暴怒，用覆有真菌孢子的爪子抓挠。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is generally docile and lazy, preferring to nap in cool, damp shadows to keep the mushroom in control of the hybrid happy. It becomes enraged if anyone touches the mushroom, slashing them with claws coated with fungal spores.

entry: 菌盖紧贴POKENAME的头骨，令它持续不适。它试着抓挠来减轻疼痛时，反会散出大量孢子。
author: sk372
source: The mushroom cap clings tightly to POKENAME's skull, causing it constant discomfort. When it scratches it in an attempt to alleviate the pain, it dispenses large amounts of spores.

entry: POKENAME的真菌球状体需要大量水分维持，因此会涉入河流溪水，充分补水。难得离水时，就会散播孢子，培育蘑菇。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME's fungal bulb requires lots of water to maintain, so they wade in rivers and streams to ensure the bulb is well-hydrated. During their few trips out of the water, they proliferate spores to grow mushrooms.

entry: POKENAME的心智只剩本能的愤怒。它会大发雷霆，攻击身边的一切，试着抓伤对方，传染孢子。
author: sk372
source: The only thing left of POKENAME's mind is an instinctive anger. It will fly into a rage and strike at anything close to it, attempting to scratch it and infect it with spores.

entry: POKENAME朝附近的一切挥拳，并非出于攻击性或领地意识，而是拳击的冲撞会让拳头释放孢子，在挨打者身上长出新蘑菇。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME throws punches at anything nearby, not out of aggressive or territorial tendencies, but because the impact of the punch causes its fists to release spores that grow new mushrooms in those it punches.

entry: POKENAME对烟味极其敏锐，闻见东西燃烧，就会赶上数英里来到火场。等火熄灭，便留下能在焦木上茁壮生长的真菌孢子。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME has an incredibly sensitive nose for smoke, and if it smells something burning it will travel for miles to reach the fire. Once the flames burn out, it will leave behind the spores of a fungus that thrives on charred wood.

entry: POKENAME用许多条腿长途跋涉后，摇动蘑菇尾巴，散出带火的孢子。引起的大火烧过森林，耐火的孢子便能在灰烬里长出新蘑菇。
author: .jerden
source: After travelling long distances on its many legs, POKENAME scatters fiery spores by shaking its mushroom tail. The fires this creates burn through forests, enabling the fireproof spores to produce new mushrooms from the ashes.

entry: POKENAME站在睡莲叶上，摇动尾巴上的蘑菇，将孢子散入空中。引来飞行属性宝可梦后，就喷水攻击，再拖进水面之下。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME stands on lily pads and wags the mushroom on its tail to scatter spores into the air. This attracts Flying types that it then sprays with water and drags beneath the surface.

entry: POKENAME坐在浅池中，通过皮肤吸水，让蘑菇保持湿润。腹部的螺旋纹警告捕食者：它的蘑菇致幻性极强。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME sits in shallow ponds, absorbing the water through its skin to keep its mushroom hydrated. The spiral pattern on its belly warns predators that its mushroom is highly hallucinogenic.

entry: 缠在POKENAME身上的根状结构形似血管，发怒时甚至会变粗。它常试着用孢子污染小池塘，让那里只有自己能生存。
author: bigoljax
source: The roots wrapped onto POKENAME's body mimic veins, even thickening when angered. They often try to pollute small ponds with spores so only they can live in them.

entry: 寄生蘑菇吸走POKENAME所有体力，让它几乎总在睡觉。它增强精神力量，以便与真菌建立共生关系。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME almost always sleeps since the parasitizing mushroom saps all of its physical energy. It builds its psychic powers to forge a symbiotic relationship with the fungus.

entry: POKENAME的蘑菇能吸收其他宝可梦的脑波，因此会被熬煮，制成调节精神、提高专注力的药物，以及特攻强化。它在潮湿洞穴与森林里冥想，增强蘑菇的力量，吞食更多想法，从中学习。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME's mushroom absorbs the brainwaves of other Pokémon, and so are boiled to create psychoactive medicines to enhance focus and X Sp. Atk. It meditates in damp caverns and forests to empower its mushroom to consume more ideas so it can learn.

entry: 蘑菇接管了POKENAME的意识，增强了它的超能力。它的孢子具有致幻效果。
author: mistymagius
source: The mushroom has taken over POKENAME's mind, amplifying its psychic powers. POKENAME's spores have hallucinogenic properties.

entry: POKENAME结合真菌与人形身体的力量，增强吸取心智的孢子，压倒大多数宝可梦的意志。据说，吸收的所有知识都存于不断长大的蘑菇中。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME utilizes the combined powers of its fungus and humanoid bodies to enhance its mind-draining spores to overpower the will of most Pokémon. It is believed that all of the knowledge it has absorbed is stored in the ever-growing mushroom.

entry: POKENAME战斗时，身上的蘑菇可能掉落。这些蘑菇用于运动医学，缓解酸痛与偏头痛。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: As POKENAME fight, the mushrooms along their body might fall off. These mushrooms are used in sports medicine to relieve aches and migraines.

entry: POKENAME悄悄拖步行走，寻找可以展示肌肉的对象。每次发力秀肌肉，身体特定部位都会散出孢子，因此想盯着看的人，最好离得很远。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME shuffles around quietly in search of others to flex its muscular body at. Each flex releases spores from specific parts of its body, so those who dare to stare should keep a large distance.

entry: POKENAME在森林中寻觅濒死树木，将其连根拔起。随后，POKENAME会释放大片孢子云，落在肥沃地面上。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME stalk through forests seeking dying trees to rip out of the ground. Afterwards, POKENAME releases a large cloud of spores to settle on the fertile ground.

entry: POKENAME成群行动，伪装成森林中的一簇簇蘑菇，同时吸取树木能量。它们选定下一个目标前，喜欢住在长满真菌的倒木中。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME travel in groups to resemble collections of mushrooms amongst the forest as they drain energy from trees. Fallen logs overgrown with fungus make for popular POKENAME dens while they consider their next target.

entry: POKENAME会缩进构成外壳的蘑菇里躲避危险。然而，每次重新出来，体内的真菌感染都会加重、蔓延。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME will retreat into the mushroom comprising its shell to avoid danger. However, each time it reemerges, the fungus infection on its body worsens and spreads.

entry: POKENAME在森林里游走，从大张的嘴中不断呼出毒孢子。面前的一切都会被整个吞下，短短几秒就消化完。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME slightly wanders around the forest, constantly exhaling toxic spores from its gaping mouth. It swallows anything in front of it whole as the food will quickly be digested in a matter of seconds.

entry: POKENAME用钳子抓住猎物，深深刺入皮肤。随后吸干猎物，再用孢子填补被吸走的部分。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME will grab onto prey with their pincers, stabbing deep into the skin. They will then drain the prey and replace what has been drained with spores.

entry: POKENAME漫无目的地漂过海洋，用爪子笨拙地抓向游得太近的宝可梦。它不时摇动身体，向水中放出一团团孢子。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME drift aimlessly through the oceans, clumsily grabbing at Pokémon that swim too close to them with their claws. They periodically shake their bodies, releasing clouds of spores into the water as they do so.

entry: POKENAME把不幸的猎物拖入深处，强行注入毒素。满意后便放走猎物，却已让其感染孢子。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME will drag unfortunate prey down into the depths with them, forcing their poison into them. They then let the prey go when satisfied, leaving it infected with their spores.

entry: POKENAME沿山路爬行，努力攀向更高山峰。找到足够高的位置后，就释放一团寄生孢子，飘下山去，感染更多宝可梦。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME scuttles across mountain trails seeking to climb to higher summits. Once it has found a suitably high elevation, it will unleash a cloud of parasitic spores that drift down the mountain and infect more Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME把圆形身体缩进蘑菇，沾满孢子，再滚下山。每次翻滚撞击，都会将更多孢子抛入空中，帮助散播繁衍。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME tucks its circular body into the mushroom to coat itself with spores, then rolls down mountains. Each tumble and impact casts more of its spores out into the air and helps them spread and propagate.

entry: POKENAME滚下山，尽可能传播孢子。若未成功，就会使用自爆，把孢子散到很大范围。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME roll down mountains, hoping to spread their spores as much as possible. If they fail, they Self-Destruct, spreading their spores in a large radius.

entry: 真菌完全覆盖POKENAME的岩石身体，在石上茁壮生长。POKENAME不断撞上物体和其他宝可梦，却并非意外，而是真菌驱使POKENAME这样做，好传播到新的表面。
author: .jerden
source: A fungus completely covers POKENAME's rocky body, thriving on the stone. POKENAME constantly bump into objects and other Pokémon, but not by accident. POKENAME are compelled to do this by the fungus, spreading it to new surfaces.

entry: POKENAME的蘑菇不停燃烧，以吃下的植物为燃料。耐火孢子乘热气升空，如烟雾般四处散播。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's mushrooms are constantly burning, fueled by the plants it eats. Their fireproof spores are lifted into the air by this heat, spreading them like smoke.

entry: POKENAME奔过原始森林，沿途留下孢子，让控制身体的蘑菇繁衍。森林火灾后，训练家会派它前去，让孢子长成蘑菇，分解残骸，重振土地生机。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME gallops through old growth forests, trailing spores to propagate the mushroom in control of the Pokémon. Trainers will use it in the wake of forest fires so its spores grow mushrooms to break down detritus and revitalize the land.

entry: 它常懒洋洋地待着，连暴风雨也不例外，背上的蘑菇因此长得硕大。有时四肢与尾巴会僵硬地抽动，让人怀疑身体已被蘑菇控制。
author: infinex21
source: The mushroom upon its back has grown massive due to how often it will laze about, even during storms. Sometimes its limbs and tail will jerk around awkwardly, leading some to believe that the mushroom is in control of the body.

entry: POKENAME受威胁时会缩进壳，靠壳抵御伤害。若打中壳上部的柔软表面，就会喷出一团团孢子，使吸入者虚弱。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME withdraw into their shell when they feel threatened, relying on it to shield them from harm. Strikes that land against the soft upper surface of their shell cause puffs of spores to release, debilitating those that inhale the cloud.

entry: POKENAME有时侵入旧电器，以电力为食，产生能分解木头与塑料的孢子。强力磁铁让人很难把它弄下来。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME can sometimes be found infesting old electrical devices, feeding on electricity while producing spores that break down wood and plastic. Their powerful magnets make them very difficult to remove.

entry: 头上的蘑菇，让POKENAME的心智只剩纯粹的战斗本能，会反射性地用蘑菇武器格挡任何攻击。每次招架都会喷出孢子，削弱进攻的敌人。
author: sk372
source: The mushroom on POKENAME's head has reduced its mental state to pure combat instinct, reflexively blocking any attacks with its mushroom weapon. Each counter causes a burst of spores that weaken whatever foe is attacking it.

entry: POKENAME分为两个不同的个体。其中一颗头已完全受孢子控制，另一颗也正逐渐沦陷。
author: lam0u3tt3
source: POKENAME is separated into two different entities. One head is entirely controlled by spores, and the other is slowly succumbing.

entry: 它游泳时会向水中释放真菌孢子，拖慢其他水生宝可梦的行动，让捕猎容易得多。POKENAME极力保护背上的大蘑菇，因为共生对双方都大有益处。
author: fiordaliso
source: As it swims, it releases fungal spores into the water that slow down the movements of other aquatic Pokémon, making hunting much easier for it. POKENAME protects the large mushroom on its back, since living together is extremely beneficial.

entry: POKENAME攀在瀑布后的石壁，向逆流而上的鱼宝可梦释放孢子。鱼被震晕后，它便下去饱餐。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME clings to stone walls behind waterfalls, releasing spores onto fish Pokémon that swim upward. These spores stun the fish Pokémon, allowing it to descend and feast.

entry: 侵染POKENAME的蘑菇，改变了身体的化学成分。留下的任何黏液都会长出毒蘑菇，但真菌本身很快又会分解，化为稠浆。
author: sk372
source: The mushroom infesting POKENAME's body has changed its chemical makeup. Any slime it leaves behind will grow toxic mushrooms, but the fungi themselves will quickly degrade and melt into goo.

entry: POKENAME留下的黏液轨迹，是多种稀有蘑菇的繁殖地。因此，真菌学家正尝试将它引入受损的生态系统。
author: kiwiarms
source: POKENAME leaves a trail of ooze that becomes a breeding ground for various rare species of mushrooms. For this reason, mycologists are trying to introduce it into damaged ecosystems.

entry: 它最爱到处抛洒孢子，却从不留下来看蘑菇长出。光是传播孢子，就已足够满足。
author: kiwiarms
source: It loves nothing more than throwing around spores, but it never sticks around to see the resulting mushrooms grow. The act of spreading spores is its own reward.

entry: POKENAME沿森林地面爬行，什么进嘴就吃什么，还会杀死沿途的低矮植物。
author: dylonk25
source: POKENAME creeps along the forest floor, eating whatever enters its mouth and killing any undergrowth in its path.

entry: 蘑菇堵住POKENAME肩上的炮管。若被清除，每根炮管都会失控地喷出大量孢子，直到重新堵住才停。
author: sk372
source: Mushrooms clog up the cannons on POKENAME's shoulders. If the fungi are removed, it will begin to spew large amounts of spores uncontrollably from each cannon until they are plugged again.

entry: POKENAME在海底爬行觅食。遇险时，会把四肢缩入巨大蘑菇的钟形菌盖中，躲到危险过去。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME scuttle across the sea floor in search of food. When faced with danger, they tuck their limbs within the bell of their gigantic mushroom, hiding away until the danger has passed.

entry: POKENAME在海蚀洞中八只一组，挤在一起睡觉。猎物靠近时，就会放出灰色孢子云，引起强烈眩晕与恶心。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME sleeps in clusters within sea caves in groups of eight. When prey draws close, they release a cloud of grey spores that causes intense dizziness and nausea.

entry: POKENAME的身体像一粒超大的蘑菇孢子。POKENAME飘在空中，寻找植物吸取生命，周身的毒雾则能防止自己被吃。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's body resembles a single oversized mushroom spore. As POKENAME floats through the air searching for plants to drain life from, the haze of toxins that surrounds its body prevent it from being eaten.

entry: POKENAME夜里漂荡于黑暗森林，完全无声。它悄悄靠近人或其他宝可梦，再发出笑声般的声音，呼出一团毒孢子。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME float around in dark forests at night, remaining completely silent. They will stealthily approach people or other Pokémon, then make a sound like laughter as they breathe out a cloud of toxic spores.

entry: 长满蘑菇的森林传来神秘笑声，就表示POKENAME在附近。若任它进入影子，就会感觉POKENAME头上的蘑菇正慢慢接管自己的心智。
author: darkweavile428
