source: Mysterious laughter emanating from mushroom-ridden forests is a sign that a POKENAME is nearby. Should you allow it to enter your shadow, you will feel the mushroom on POKENAME's head slowly take over your mind.

entry: POKENAME只有头顶露出地面，常被误认成大蘑菇。其余身体都在地下，钻过泥土，吸取树根生命。
author: .jerden
source: With only the top of its head above the surface, POKENAME is often mistaken for a large mushroom. The rest of its body remains underground, burrowing through the soil to leech life from tree roots.

entry: 它从大蘑菇散出的孢子，能使其他生物入睡。因孢子睡着的生物，无论做美梦还是噩梦，都会被它吃掉梦境。
author: infinex21
source: The spores it scatters from its large mushroom have a sleep-inducing effect on others. It will feed upon the dreams and nightmares of those who fall asleep due its spores.

entry: POKENAME一察觉威胁，头上的大蘑菇就会散出毒孢子云。它用爪挖出植物根，同时供养自己与真菌。
author: .jerden
source: If POKENAME detects a threat, the large mushroom on top of its head scatters a cloud of toxic spores. It uses its claws to dig up plant roots that feed both the Pokémon and the fungus.

entry: POKENAME挥动有力的钳子，与其他生物交流。感染同种真菌的宝可梦，似乎都懂这些手势，因而能合作挖出植物吃。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME waves its powerful claws to communicate with others. Any Pokémon infected by the same fungus seems to understand what these gestures mean, enabling them to work together to dig up plants to eat.

entry: POKENAME在身后放出金光，推动自己以光速滚动。理论上，它的爆炸与恒星爆炸有同样效果，会引发巨大的超新星爆发，使引力本身坍缩，冲击波传遍太空。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME emits golden light behind it to roll itself at light speeds. In theory, an explosion from it has the same effects a star does when it explodes, creating a giant supernova that collapses gravity itself and sends shockwaves throughout space.

entry: POKENAME体内散发的光强大无比，必须定期排出，否则可能伤到自己。它用骨头聚光、发射光束，减轻负担。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's body radiates so much powerful light that it needs to regularly discharge it from its body or risk hurting itself. It uses a bone to help it focus and fire light beams to relieve it of its burden.

entry: POKENAME的鳞片泛着神秘光芒。它会用光暂时晃瞎捕食者，再趁机逃跑。
author: raydrago
source: POKENAME's scales give off a mysterious glow. It uses this glow to ward off predators by blinding them temporarily before fleeing.

entry: POKENAME主要以自然光为食，一天中任何时候都能见到。扇翅时，空气闪闪发亮，映出仿佛另一个世界的幻象。
author: ultron_suprem3
source: The diets of POKENAME largely consist of natural light, and they can be seen at all times of the day. As they flap their wings, the air shimmers, creating illusions of what is thought to be another world.

entry: 已知存在的POKENAME极少，全都住在这颗星球的轨道上，更直接地摄取太阳光。若有什么试图伤害它们，就会从眼睛般的核心放出毁灭性光束。
author: infinex21
source: There are very few POKENAME known to exist, and all of them live in our planet's orbit to feed upon our sun's light more directly. If anything attempts to harm them, they will release a beam of destructive light from their eye-like core.

entry: POKENAME使用跃起时，身体会规律地闪光，能晃瞎附近的生物。因此切勿盯着看太久。
author: .izik
source: While using Splash, POKENAME's body releases regular flashes of light that can blind those nearby. It is important not to stare at one for too long.

entry: POKENAME的大翅膀像棱镜般滤光，散出彩色光线。自然光含有所有可能的颜色，因此双翼几乎能滤出任何颜色。
author: ultron_suprem3
source: The large wings of POKENAME filter light like prisms, scattering light into colored rays. Almost any color can be filtered from their wings, as natural light contains all possible colors.

entry: POKENAME吞食过量光线后，如今也会向外放出光。无论去哪里，辐射的光都会给周围带来混乱与毁灭。
author: infinex21
source: After gorging itself with an overabundance of light, POKENAME now radiates that which it consumes. Wherever it goes, the light it radiates wreaks havoc and destruction all around it.

entry: 据说这种形态的POKENAME会穿行于世界之间，分享自己的光。它将能量聚到金色晶壳的各个尖端，向多个方向射出灿烂激光。
author: pattybgoode
source: POKENAME is said to travel between worlds in this form to share its light. Focusing energy into each of the points of its golden, crystalline shell, it shoots brilliant lasers in many directions.

entry: POKENAME毛皮闪耀着可见光谱中的每一种颜色。胸口和尾巴劈啪涌动着纯粹光能，POKENAME竭力将其压住。因此，附近电器很可能短路。
author: chibitales
source: The fur on POKENAME's body shines with every color of the visible spectrum. Its chest and tail crackle with pure light energy as POKENAME struggles to keep it contained. Electric devices near it have a high chance of short-circuiting due to this.

entry: 它闪亮的身体偶尔会发出刺眼闪光。人们曾试着把POKENAME当电池，可它能穿过任何墙壁。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Its glimmering body occasionally emits blinding, flashing lights. Attempts have been made to make POKENAME a battery, but it can clip through any wall.

entry: POKENAME化石常见于来自未知领域的碎石中，据说能吸收周围的光。复原的宝可梦接触曾经埋藏自己的石头后，就会变成POKENAME。
author: divinelunaria
source: POKENAME fossils are often found in fragments of stone from a realm unseen, and are said to drink in light from all around them. The revived Pokémon transform into POKENAME when exposed to the stones they were once buried within.

entry: 睁眼前，有些人会觉得POKENAME温顺。它虽然不大活动，光芒却无比强大，足以十倍弥补这点不足。
author: aberry8286
source: It appears docile to some before it opens its eyes. Although POKENAME doesn't move much, its incredibly powerful light makes up for that tenfold.

entry: 长年吸收、释放能量后，POKENAME的身体会过载，引发方圆两公里内的雷暴。它常与同类争夺领地。
author: operativevalkyrie
source: After years of absorbing and discharging energy, POKENAME's body becomes overloaded, causing thunderstorms within a two-kilometer radius. It often clashes with others of its kind over territory.

entry: POKENAME亮得令人睁不开眼，连正午太阳都相形见绌。维持形态需要极大量能量，只有在阿罗拉发现的奇异结晶附近，才能做到。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are blindingly bright Pokémon that can outshine even the midday sun. It takes a tremendous amount of energy for them to maintain their form and they can only manage it in the presence of strange crystals found in Alola.

entry: POKENAME亮得令人睁不开眼，连正午太阳都相形见绌。维持形态需要极大量能量，只有在阿罗拉发现的奇异结晶附近，才能做到。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are blindingly bright Pokémon that can outshine even the midday sun. It takes a tremendous amount of energy for them to maintain their form and they can only manage it in the presence of strange crystals found in Alola.

entry: 一些古老传说称POKENAME为“光之龙子”。传说中，总有一天，它的力量会成长到足以用炽热光能净化整颗星球。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is nicknamed "the dragon child of light" in some ancient legends. According to these tales, it will one day grow in power enough to purify the entire planet with its searing light energy.

entry: 茧内积蓄的能量，让POKENAME不停颤抖。准备破茧时，茧会裂开，涌出道道光束。
author: opossiblymage
source: POKENAME shakes constantly from all the stored energy inside its cocoon. As it gets ready to emerge, the cocoon cracks and beams of light pour out.

entry: POKENAME以精神力量引导身体吸收的光，从尾巴或爪子射出光束。有人说，陷入绝境时，它能化为纯粹光能的形态。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME mentally channels the light its body has absorbed, firing it in the form of beams shot from its tail or claws. Some say it can take on a form of pure light energy in times of desperation.

entry: POKENAME能释放任何种类的光，包括可能伤害周围生物的光。它甚至把战斗当游戏，因此是否意识到自己造成的伤害，尚不清楚。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME can release any type of light, even those that may be harmful to others around them. Whether they have any awareness of the harm they cause is unsure, as they will even treat battles as mere games.

entry: POKENAME产生的光，都会集中从背上涌出。受惊时，背上的光会增强，闪得格外刺眼，晃瞎敌人。
author: soup1900
source: All the light POKENAME produces gets concentrated and poured out of its back. If it becomes startled, the light from its back grows and flashes extremely brightly, blinding its enemies.

entry: POKENAME沿身体吸光，再从背部释放灿烂的能量爆发。虽然会产生高热，能量似乎只灼烧POKENAME想烧的东西。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME draws in light along its body before unleashing brilliant bursts of energy along its back. Despite the intense heat produced from this process, the energy only seems to burn what the POKENAME wants it to.

entry: POKENAME通过虫洞在地区内传送，前往感知到大量消耗光能的地方，因此常出现在城市。它始终用光织的网连着虫洞，受威胁时便能退回。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME warps by wormhole around the region to places it senses large expenditures of light energy, so it is often seen in cities. It always remains attached to its wormhole with a web of light so it can retreat if threatened.

entry: POKENAME会被光源吸引，就像绅士蛾扑火。它在领地周围织出泛着淡黄光的网，常为洞穴和森林中迷路的旅人指路。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are drawn to sources of light like Mothim are drawn to flames. The webs they spin glow with a faint, yellow light which they weave around their territory, often helping to guide lost travelers within caves and forests.

entry: 传说POKENAME双翼由纯光构成，什么都能切开。它飞过黑夜，将四周照得如同白昼。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's wings are said to be made of pure light, allowing it to slice through anything. It flies through the night, illuminating the dark as if it was day.

entry: POKENAME刺激过度时，会造出巨大的光球包住自己，以平复情绪。这种行为无法阻止，强光还可能扰乱当地生态系统。
author: dodoowner_
source: When POKENAME gets overstimulated, it will create a large ball of light surrounding itself to calm down. There is no way to stop this behavior from occurring. The powerful light may disrupt local ecosystems.

entry: POKENAME能从尾巴射出极其精准的激光，击穿大多数金属。
author: musicsheep.
source: POKENAME can fire off high-precision lasers from its tail. These beams of light are able to tear a hole through most metals.

entry: 据说总有一天，POKENAME会扎根地下，夺走所有生物的生命力，满足永无止境的饥饿。不过，它似乎光靠光合作用就能获取足够能量。
author: dodoowner_
source: It is said that one day, POKENAME will root itself in the ground and steal the life force from every living thing to fuel its everlasting hunger. However, it seems to get enough energy from photosynthesis.

entry: POKENAME大多日子都悠闲地躺在河面，因为所处的水都会变成冒着蒸汽的金色温泉。有人见过它像摆弄气球一样，把光弯成各种形状。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME spends most of its days lounging around on the surfaces of rivers since any water it's in turns into a steaming, golden-colored hot spring. Some people have spotted it bending light into many shapes as if it were a balloon.

entry: POKENAME白天活动，大部分时间都用来吸收大量日光，增强力量。获得的力量却会超出承受范围，常以发狂收场。
author: rycronicgames
source: POKENAME are active during the day, using most of their time to absorb drastic amounts of sunlight to increase their power. The power gained from the process becomes overwhelming to them, often ending in a rampage.

entry: POKENAME用双翼在水中滑行。身体发出的光，足以照亮深海，数日都不会消散。光褪去前，它经过的区域会短暂充满生机。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME uses its wings to glide through the water. The light its body emits is enough to light up the depths of the ocean, and doesn't dissipate for several days. Until the light fades, areas where POKENAME has passed are briefly filled with life.

entry: POKENAME强大的能力，来自吸收的光，月光尤其有效。有些人信誓旦旦地说，它吸收月光时，天上的月亮都变暗了。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's mighty abilities are fueled by the light it absorbs. Absorbing moonlight is particularly effective; some swear they've seen the moon dim in the sky when POKENAME takes in its moonbeams.

entry: POKENAME急于补充能量，能找到的任何光学与光线相关文字，都能成为栖身处。它以未知方式从信息中汲取能量，再释放成一波波色彩与光。
author: santon5512
source: Desperate to fuel themselves, POKENAME make their homes in any and all texts relating to optics and light that they can find. They draw energy from this information by unknown means, releasing it in waves of colors and light.

entry: POKENAME爆炸时，会释放全部光能，熔化爆炸范围内的一切。外壳大部分由纯粹的光构成，形成松果般的外观。
author: soup1900
source: When an POKENAME explodes, it releases all of its light energy, causing it to melt everything caught within the explosion. Pure light makes up the majority of this Pokémon's shell and creates its pinecone-like look.

entry: POKENAME能用纯粹光线包裹自己，让任何攻击都失效。一旦试着打开壳，就会涌出大量光能。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME can encase itself in pure light, rendering any attack ineffective towards it. Massive amounts of light energy will pour out if it ever tries to open its shell.

entry: POKENAME以光速连续出拳，痛击敌人。扇动翅膀时，会放出炽热光芒，熔化接触到的一切。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME beats up enemies by repeatedly firing off punches against them at the speed of light. By flapping its wings, it radiates a burning hot light that melts all that they touch.

entry: 头角几乎无物不斩。若真遇到斩不开的，散出的热量仍能将其熔化。
author: incognito1234
source: The horn on its head is able to cut through just about anything. If for some reason it cannot, the heat it radiates will still melt it.

entry: POKENAME在强光一闪间出现在猎物面前，让对方晕眩失明。它以骇人的速度挥爪，撕扯再庞大的敌人，直到其倒下。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME appears before its prey in a flash of intense light that leaves them dazed and blinded. It moves with frightening speed, tearing at even the largest of foes with its claws until they fall.

entry: POKENAME出没于阿罗拉群岛海滩，翻筛沙子，寻找结晶碎片吃。身体泛着异界般的光，高热足以熔沙，走过后留下一道玻璃。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are found on the beaches of the Alolan islands, sifting through the sands for crystal fragments to feed on. Their bodies shine with an otherworldly light that blazes hot enough to melt sand, leaving a trail of glass behind them as they move.

entry: POKENAME的喙灌满身体产生的多余热量，能瞬间烤熟猎物。扇翅时，POKENAME光亮得如第二颗太阳。
author: gileme__
source: The beak of POKENAME is infused with excess heat produced from its body, able to cook its prey instantly. The beating of its wings makes a glow so bright that POKENAME resembles a second sun.

entry: POKENAME游泳时，灿烂光线穿透水中。古时候，POKENAME常被视为预言的使者。
author: nyoomymph
source: Brilliant rays of light shine through the water as POKENAME swims. In olden times, POKENAME was often seen as a herald of prophecy.

entry: POKENAME从现代网站学会了切换深色与浅色模式。若被切换得太频繁，就会烦躁不安。
author: .flipside3
source: POKENAME adapted the option to change between dark and light modes from modern websites. It becomes agitated if it is switched between modes too frequently.

entry: POKENAME从现代网站学会了切换深色与浅色模式。它喜欢让附近设备跟自己采用同一模式，还会因这让人抓狂而开心。
author: .flipside3
source: POKENAME adapted the option to change between dark and light modes from modern websites. It likes to make nearby devices match its mode, and is entertained when this causes frustration.

entry: POKENAME奔跑快得惊人，沿途留下长长的、无法穿过的光之轨迹。轨迹消散前，会迸出劈啪电流，威力是闪电的两倍。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME dashes at such incredible speeds that it leaves behind long, impassable trails of light wherever it travels. Before they disappear, they burst out with crackling electricity twice as powerful as lightning while they fade away.

entry: 传说POKENAME的吼声，会引发太阳系里的太阳耀斑。体内涌出的光灼烧接触到的一切，让周围宛如火山荒地。
author: soup1900
source: Legends say that the roar of POKENAME causes solar flares to occur in our solar system. The light that pours out of its body scorches anything they touch, transforming the area to look like a volcanic wasteland.

entry: POKENAME追逐雷暴，在一道道落雷间疾驰，吸收闪电的光。蓄够光后，就会奔过大地，身后拖出闪亮虹光。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME chases thunderstorms, dashing from lightning strike to lightning strike to absorb the light from them. Once it has charged enough light, it races across the land, a shimmering rainbow of light behind it.

entry: POKENAME飞行时吸收光线，羽毛泛着近乎刺眼的光。虹色羽毛能喷出大片光束，据说击中什么，便能将其化为灰烬。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's feathers emit an almost blinding glow as it absorbs light during flight. These rainbow colored feathers can erupt in a plume of light-beams that are said to reduce anything they hit to ash.

entry: 这种形态的POKENAME，小小身体里流过太多光能，始终承受压力。它不停弹跳，试着释放部分能量，尾巴能把它弹得近乎光速。
author: milchik
source: In this form, POKENAME is in a state of constant stress due to how much light energy courses through its small body. It tries to relieve some of this energy by bouncing around unstoppably, its tail sending it flying nearly at the speed of light.

entry: POKENAME以光为食，无论天然或人造，因此也总在发光。它能照明，在黑暗洞穴很受欢迎，但若遭攻击，就会将光化为毁灭性射线。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME feed on light, be it natural or artificial, and are always emitting their own light as a result. They are welcome sights in dark caves due to their emitted light, though if they are attacked they will release this light as destructive rays.

entry: POKENAME飞行快得所到之处都化作一大片闪光。振翅时，会连续发射激光，始终瞄准对手弱点。
author: soup1900
source: When POKENAME flies, it moves around so fast that everywhere it goes turns into one big flash of light. It rapid-fires lasers when it churns its wings, always aiming them at opponents' weak spots while doing so.

entry: POKENAME飞在高空，通过双翼折射日光，在下方造出绚丽彩虹。它转动翅膀，调出不同色彩组合，有人观看时，还会高兴地欢呼。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME fly high in the sky, refracting the light of the sun through their wings to create dazzling rainbows below them. They angle their wings in different directions to create new mixes of colors, gleefully cheering as people watch their displays.

entry: POKENAME的模样像某个臭名昭著的网站。想吸引训练家注意时，就会发出强光。
author: .flipside3
source: POKENAME resembles an infamous internet website. It flashes brightly when it wants attention from its Trainer.

entry: POKENAME的模样像某个臭名昭著的网站。面对其他人造宝可梦会害怕，却会故作凶狠，试图吓走对方。
author: .flipside3
source: POKENAME resembles an infamous internet website. It is intimidated by other artificial Pokémon, and will act aggressive to try to scare them away.

entry: 强光沐浴整片丛林，让草木茂密强壮。它独自静坐，滋养赖以栖居的森林。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: Its intense light bathes the whole jungle, allowing it to grow thick and strong. It sits in solitary, feeding its home jungle.

entry: POKENAME体内藏着惊人潜力，只有阿罗拉的稀有结晶才能激发，让火焰烧出强烈刺眼的光。训练家受到提醒，切勿直接触碰滚烫的身体。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME contain incredible potential within their bodies that can only be realised with rare crystals from Alola, their flames burning with an intense, blinding light. Trainers are advised not to handle the blazing hot Pokémon directly.

entry: POKENAME已觉醒，释放体内全部潜力。它的存在，让现实本身如黑洞的事件视界般弯曲；光线则向所有威胁训练家的生物倾下毁灭。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME has awakened and unleashed all of the latent power within itself. Reality itself bends around its presence like the event horizon of a black hole, while its rays of light rain devastation upon all who threaten its Trainer.

entry: POKENAME是纯光构成的英勇战士，据说会从遥远维度现身，重建世间正义。挥动光刃时，连空气也因耀眼的能量而震颤。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is a valiant warrior made of pure light, said to appear from distant dimensions to restore justice to the world. When it swings its radiant blade, even the air trembles from its dazzling energy.

entry: 它满溢着强光与原始能量，能以各种方式操控分离的肢体。还会聚光，从脸上的X形标记发出毁灭性光束。
author: infinex21
source: It is overflowing with bright light and raw energy, which allows it to control its separate limbs in various ways. It can focus and release beams of destructive light from the "X" on its face.

entry: 只有石头吸收过大量光线，POKENAME才会显形。一旦现身，就会狂暴地射出吸收的光，灼烧触及的一切。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME only manifests if its stone has been exposed to great amounts of light. Upon manifestation, it rages and expels out beams of the absorbed light that sear anything they touch.

entry: 据说POKENAME是另一宇宙的究极存在，光辉近乎令人失明。它似乎靠吞光维持运作，因为处在无光地区时，会凶暴地四处乱撞。
author: sk372
source: Said to be the ultimate being of another universe, POKENAME's radiance is almost blinding. It seems to consume light to keep functioning, as it thrashes around aggressively when in areas devoid of illumination.

entry: POKENAME被称为光本身的化身，人们怀疑光与暗都由它创造。虽然光曾被尽数吞噬，如今却已重获真正的力量。
author: operativevalkyrie
source: Said to be the embodiment of light itself, POKENAME is suspected to be responsible for the creation of light and darkness. Despite all of its light having been consumed, it has since regained its true power.

entry: POKENAME的壳是一扇维度门户，让不可见的领域与这个世界相互作用。它情绪多变，随时可能毫无预兆地攻击，因此POKENAME很难训练。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: The shell of POKENAME acts as a dimensional gateway, allowing unseen realms to interact with this world. Its temperamental nature makes POKENAME difficult to train, as it is liable to lash out without warning.

entry: POKENAME的盾如彩绘玻璃，却与钻石一样坚硬。它聚光产生激光，以棱镜般的光景，展现惊人力量。
author: pattybgoode
source: POKENAME's shield has an appearance of stained glass, but it is as hard as diamond. It focuses light to produce lasers in a prism-like display of wondrous power.

entry: 吞下过量光后，它褪去大部分甲片，身体如今散发炽热强光，能量奔涌。它能将大量能量引成毁灭性光束，在灼烧的土地上留下伤痕。
author: infinex21
source: It sheds much of its armor-like plating after having gorged upon too much light, its body now radiating a burning, bright light and surging with energy. It can channel much of its energy into a devastating beam that can scar the soil it burns.

entry: POKENAME将双翼拍向地面，便能唤出高耸明亮的光能柱，破土而出。敌人被晃得睁不开眼、灼烧受伤，POKENAME却有无形力场保护，不受影响。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME can summon bright, towering pillars of light energy to erupt from the ground when it slams its wings against the surface. While very blinding and burning against foes, an invisible field surrounding POKENAME shields it from the effects.

entry: POKENAME的齿轮闪闪发亮，仿佛由黄金而非钢铁构成。转得越快，光就越亮，直到远处看也十分刺眼。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's gears gleam as if made of gold, not steel. As the gears turn faster, the light becomes brighter, until it becomes blinding even from a distance.

entry: POKENAME以精神力量，将构成身体的圆形棱镜完美对齐后，就会像镀金结晶般灿烂发亮。稍稍调整身体排列，便能射出灼热光束。
author: .jerden
source: After using its psychic powers to perfectly align the circular prisms its body is made of, POKENAME gleams brilliantly, like gilded crystal. A slight adjustment of its body's arrangement enables it to fire off beams of burning light.

entry: POKENAME以精神力量，将构成身体的圆形棱镜完美对齐后，就会像镀金结晶般灿烂发亮。稍稍调整身体排列，便能射出灼热光束。
author: .jerden
source: After using its psychic powers to perfectly align the circular prisms its body is made of, POKENAME gleams brilliantly, like gilded crystal. A slight adjustment of its body's arrangement enables it to fire off beams of burning light.

entry: POKENAME用明亮强大的闪光保护其他生物。光虽可能造成持久伤害，有些科学家却已找到聚光用于医疗的方法，例如精密手术激光。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME defend others with flashes of bright and powerful light. Although their light can cause lasting damage, some scientists have discovered ways to focus their light for medical use, such as precise surgical lasers.

entry: POKENAME在太阳近旁及周围飞行，披着赖以为食的光。每逢太阳耀斑就会吼叫，曾让一些人一度相信，是它的吼声引起了耀斑。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME flies near and around the sun itself, clad in the light it also feeds upon. It roars whenever a solar flare occurs, which lead some to believe, for a time, that its roar would cause solar flares.

entry: POKENAME全身各处都能发射激光，但炮管射出的最具破坏力。高度凝聚的炮击光线，能让天空染上灼亮的黄色，数日不褪。
author: soup1900
source: While POKENAME can fire lasers from anywhere on its body, ones from its cannon are the most destructive. The condensed light from its cannon blasts is so intense that it stains the sky in a burning yellow for days.

entry: POKENAME吸收巨量光线，大幅增强电力。体内能量充沛得足以把闪电投向星球另一面的目标。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME absorbs light in massive amounts to supercharge its electrical abilities. Its body contains enough power that it could fling lightning bolts at a target on the other side of the planet.

entry: POKENAME寄生于人造光源，钻进路灯等电器，吸走光。等离子体气场明亮得惊人，毫无防护地直视，可能永久损伤视力。
author: milchik
source: POKENAME parasitizes artificial light sources, inhabiting electronics such as street lamps and sucking their light out. Its plasmatic aura is so bright that looking at it directly without protection might damage one's sight permanently.

entry: POKENAME用无尽光能，在嘴两侧造出巨大金斧，能将大型小行星劈成两半。虽然可怕，却习惯周游世界，善意地尽可能向众人分享光。
author: soup1900
source: Using its limitless light energy, POKENAME conjures gigantic golden axes on the sides of its mouth that can cleave large asteroids in half. Although terrifying, it habitually goes around the world to kindly share its light with everyone it can.

entry: POKENAME镜子般的身体，会映出观看者深藏并早已遗忘的记忆。许多旅人看着过往画面在表面流转，连时间都忘了。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME's mirror-like body reflects memories locked away and long forgotten by its viewers. Many travelers lose track of time while watching scenes from their past play across its surface.

entry: POKENAME满溢的光能，连最漆黑的夜也能照成白昼。它虽不是太阳，光与热却足以为大多数动植物代行太阳的作用。
author: soup1900
source: The overflowing light energy from POKENAME causes even the darkest of nights to look like bright daytime. While it is not a sun, the light and heat energy from it allows it to mimic being one for most plants and animals.

entry: POKENAME能扭曲、弯折光，在周围制造许多视错觉。还能用弯折的光波罩住其他物体，使其隐形。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME can distort and bend light, causing many optical illusions around it. With this power, it can also cloak other objects with these bent light waves, rendering them invisible.

entry: POKENAME展开全部尾巴，便能释放刺眼强光，长时间照射会灼伤皮肤。它傲慢自恋，谁若靠近却未献上应有贡品，就很可能被光攻击。
author: sk372
source: Unfurling all of its tails allows POKENAME to unleash blindingly bright light that sears the skin after prolonged exposure. Haughty and vain, it's likely to send this light out at any who approach it without giving it proper tribute.

entry: 这种外星宝可梦可能来自另一宇宙。吞尽一颗星球的所有光源后，就会前往下一颗。
author: bobosmith01
source: An extraterrestrial Pokémon that may hail from another universe. When it finishes devouring all sources of light on one planet, it moves onto the next.

entry: 这种外星宝可梦可能来自另一宇宙。吞尽一颗星球的所有光源后，就会前往下一颗。
author: bobosmith01
source: An extraterrestrial Pokémon that may hail from another universe. When it finishes devouring all sources of light on one planet, it moves onto the next.

entry: 包裹POKENAME的液体阻止光线外泄，让它每秒都更加明亮刺眼。若挨上一记重击，液体便会破裂，所有光瞬间涌出。
author: soup1900
source: The liquid encapsulating POKENAME prevents any light from leaking out, causing it to become brighter and more blinding with each second. If it were to take a heavy blow, the liquid would break, and all this light would surge out in an instant.

entry: POKENAME用固态光织网，建成巨大的发光巢穴，许多虫宝可梦住在其中。这些光纤维还极易导电，能帮助建成更好的护巢蛛网陷阱。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME spins webs out of solid light, creating vast luminous nests inhabited by numerous bug Pokémon. These fibres of light can also conduct electricity extremely well, enhancing the construction of webbing traps used to protect the nest.

entry: POKENAME的眼睛，是由吃下的最稀有矿物形成的精纯结晶。极高的纯度，帮助POKENAME将发出的强光聚成光谱斑斓的光束。
author: wavypavy_1
source: POKENAME's eyes are highly refined crystals made from the rarest minerals it has consumed. Their exceptional purity helps POKENAME focus the bright light it emits into a dazzling spectrum of beams.

entry: POKENAME能照亮整片森林，扰乱夜间自然环境。它等着被光迷住的宝可梦靠近，再挥出剃刀般锋利的爪子。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME can illuminate entire forests, disrupting the natural environment at night. It waits for any captivated Pokémon to come close, then it swings its razor sharp claws towards them.

entry: POKENAME冷酷无情，夺走所有光与温暖供自己享用，任其他宝可梦受冻。反抗者会被关进纯光构成的晶体结构。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is a ruthless, apathetic Pokémon, taking any source of light and warmth for itself and leaving other Pokémon to freeze. It imprisons those who defy it in a crystalline structure made of pure light.

entry: 当对光的渴望与桃粉色花蜜相调和，它的心智便清明起来，从内心与羽毛中获得顿悟。随万物共舞时，对光的炽烈渴望渐消，内心也归于平和。
author: quackquackattack
source: When its desire for light is in harmony with Pink Nectar, its mind clears and finds epiphany within itself and its feathers. It dances in synchronicity with all life as its burning desire for light fades, and it finds peace within itself.

entry: POKENAME咬穿现实，穿行世界，留下巨大的空间裂口。返回穿过裂口时，缝隙便会闭合，但它极少不吃一顿大餐，就结束狩猎离开。
author: thesilverowls
source: POKENAME chew holes through reality to traverse the world, leaving large rifts in space. The rifts close when the POKENAME goes back through them, but they rarely leave without a large meal to end the hunt with.

entry: 北方城镇将POKENAME视为漫长冬季中的光明象征，黑夜里会把树装饰成它的模样。它很喜欢这些仿像，但若一年中制作得太早，就会不高兴。
author: thesilverowls
source: In northern towns, POKENAME are seen as a symbol of light during the long winter, with people making trees decorated to look like them on dark nights. They adore these effigies, but dislike them if made too early in the year.

entry: POKENAME的双翼由会发光的黏液构成，夜里十分明亮。遗留的黏液轨迹，能在它经过后数百年间持续照亮沼泽。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME's wings are formed from glowing bioluminescent slime that shines brightly at night. Trails of this slime can illuminate swamps for centuries, long after it has passed through.

entry: POKENAME能用光能随时随地造出极光。散去光能，还能调节体温，在更热的环境生存。
author: soup1900
source: Using its light energy, POKENAME can create auroras at will, no matter the location. By dispelling light energy, it can regulate its temperature to survive in hotter environments.

entry: 这只宝可梦涌出的光，其实冰冷刺骨，会将四周完全冻结。它用极光包围对手，困进美丽的光之牢笼。
author: soup1900
source: The light that pours out of this Pokémon is actually icy-cold, completely freezing its surroundings. It surrounds its opponents with auroras, trapping them inside a beautiful light prison.

entry: POKENAME长时间暴露于未经过滤的紫外线，会变异，过早发育出某些特征，尤其是颚。奔跑时速最高可达150公里。
author: operativevalkyrie
source: When POKENAME are exposed to unfiltered ultraviolet rays for long periods, they mutate and develop features prematurely, most notably a jaw. They can run at speeds of up to 150 kilometres an hour.

entry: 挣脱棱晶牢笼后，POKENAME用歌声肆虐破坏。据说死于其歌，是世上最美的死法。
author: galactakiller
source: Now unleashed from its prismatic prison, POKENAME will wreak havoc through its songs. It is said to be the most beautiful death one could receive.

entry: POKENAME的舞蹈运用大量光能，吸引附近所有目光。歌唱音调越高，身体越明亮，唱到最高音时，便会迸出金光。
author: soup1900
source: The dance performances of POKENAME catch the eyes of everyone nearby due to the overwhelming amount of light energy used in them. Its body shines brighter the higher the pitch it sings until, at the highest note, it bursts in golden light.

entry: 最早的POKENAME描绘记录，称它为“黎明梦境之龙”。据说它伴日出现身，光辉让一些人失明，又让另一些人沉睡数月。
author: sk372
source: The first recorded depiction of POKENAME called it The Dawn's Dragon of Dreams. It was said to appear along the sunrise, its radiant glow blinding some and sending others into months-long slumbers.

entry: 吸收足够光后，POKENAME能变成这种形态，释放巨大的发光孢子云。这团蘑菇云亮得数英里外都能看见。
author: .jerden
source: After absorbing enough light, POKENAME can assume this form to release a giant plume of glowing spores. This mushroom cloud is bright enough to see from miles away.

entry: POKENAME涌出的光极其明亮，理论上，可能相隔一个星系都看得见。它既罕见，又有致盲风险，几乎无法研究。
author: chibitales
source: The light pouring from POKENAME is so extremely bright it is theorized it could be seen from a galaxy away. Study of this Pokémon is practically impossible, not only due to its rarity, but because of the risk of blindness.

entry: 身体释放的热与光，足以抹去靠近这只宝可梦的一切。已有整个生态群系因此遭受破坏。
author: enderlord_guest2.0
source: The heat and light its body gives off is enough to obliterate anything that comes near this Pokémon. Entire biomes have suffered due to its effects.

entry: 这只宝可梦涌出的刺眼光芒，对裸眼极其危险。它以所有可见色彩的频闪光脉冲压倒对手，防护不足的生物都会失去方向。
author: fireblade141
source: The blinding light that pours from this Pokémon's body is highly dangerous to the naked eye. It overwhelms opponents with strobing pulses of light in all perceivable colors, causing anyone not sufficiently protected to become disoriented.

entry: POKENAME闪亮的鳞片相互碰撞时，会迸出数英里外可见的强光。可鳞片一脱落，就立刻漆黑，仿佛光芒突然尽失。
author: infinex21
source: When the shining scales of POKENAME clang together, they emit bright flashes of light that can be seen for miles. The moment any of these scales fall off, however, they turn pitch-black as if all the light suddenly leaves them.

entry: POKENAME用四条手臂造出光能激光镰，切毁触及的一切。它用这些镰刀熔化奈克洛兹玛融合宝可梦，后者却奇怪地总被POKENAME的光吸引。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME uses its four arms to create laser scythes of light energy that slice and destroy anything they touch. These scythes are used to melt away Necrozma fusions who are strangely attracted to POKENAME's light.

entry: POKENAME能在全身任何地方造出光能镰刀，斩倒任何敌人。它的光，奇异地吸引许多收集光的宝可梦，因此在许多世界和维度都很受欢迎。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME can create sickles of light energy anywhere on its body and use them to slice down any foe. The light it emits is strangely attractive to many light-gathering Pokémon, causing it to be popular in many worlds and dimensions.

entry: POKENAME用魔杖操纵光能，施展各种法术。从造出美丽彩虹，到施放整颗光弹砸向敌人，都能做到。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME uses its magical wand to manipulate light energy, casting various spells. These spells can range from creating beautiful rainbows to casting entire light bombs to drop onto enemies.

entry: POKENAME用魔杖驾驭光的力量，施展各种法术。从造出美丽彩虹，到召唤整颗光弹砸向敌人，都能做到。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME harnesses the power of light using its magical wand to cast various spells. These spells can range from creating beautiful rainbows to summoning entire light bombs to drop onto enemies.

entry: POKENAME的发光粉末，会让接触者双眼灼痛，最终视线模糊。这种毒素唯一已知的疗法，是待在漆黑房间里数日，直到粉末失去光能。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's glowing powder causes anyone they touch to feel a burning sensation in their eyes and wind up with blurred vision. The only known cure for this toxin is to stay inside of a pitch-black room for days until the powder loses its light energy.

entry: POKENAME的发光粉末，会让接触者双眼灼痛，最终视线模糊。这种毒素唯一已知的疗法，是待在漆黑房间里数日，直到粉末失去光能。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's glowing powder causes anyone they touch to feel a burning sensation in their eyes and wind up with blurred vision. The only known cure for this toxin is to stay inside of a pitch-black room for days until the powder loses its light energy.

entry: POKENAME用光能，支撑自己痴迷挖掘的习惯。留下的洞里，有时会射出激光，在旁逗留十分危险。
author: h0bojoe
source: POKENAME uses light energy to fuel its obsessive digging habits. Laser beams sometimes fire out of the holes it has left behind, making them dangerous to linger around.

entry: POKENAME来自一处被自己疯狂挖掘得支离破碎的现实。学者相信，不把每一个宇宙都挖遍，它绝不会停下。
author: h0bojoe
source: POKENAME originates from a reality that was torn asunder through its obsessive digging. Scholars believe it will never stop digging until every single universe is excavated.

entry: 唯一能与POKENAME光辉媲美的，就是它的忠诚。古代卷轴曾描绘它守护朋友，对抗邪恶与黑暗。
author: quackquackattack
source: The only thing that rivals the brightness of POKENAME's radiant glow is its loyalty. It was once depicted in ancient scrolls defending its friends from evil and darkness.

entry: POKENAME尾尖的光，随着吸收的光越多，便越发刺眼。它会引导这些光，从口中轰出强力激光。
author: santon5512
source: The blinding light at the tips of POKENAME's tails shines brighter the more light they've absorbed. They channel this light into powerful laser blasts that they fire from their mouths.

entry: 腰带结晶给予POKENAME的力量，强得能击碎光束。得不到光就会衰弱，因此它用剑猎杀那些想夺走它能量的生物。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: The strength POKENAME draws from the crystal on its belt makes it powerful enough to shatter beams of light. As its strength wanes without access to light, it uses its sword to hunt down those that would deprive it of energy.

entry: 传说四只POKENAME拉着战车，载太阳横过天空。它们能跑得快到令人眼花，极速时只剩一道模糊光影。
author: santon5512
source: Legends tell of four POKENAME pulling the sun itself across the sky on a chariot. These Pokémon are capable of running blindingly fast, appearing as nothing more than a blur of light at top speeds.

entry: POKENAME全速移动时，身后会留下一道刺眼强光。跃过长空的姿态，被形容为第二颗太阳飞快划过天空。
author: sk372
source: When POKENAME moves at top speed, it leaves a blindingly bright trail of light behind it. Its great leaps through the air have been likened to seeing a second sun cut rapidly through the sky.

entry: POKENAME的身体几乎全由闪亮的冰与充满光的水构成。潜入海中时，激起的水花会晃得附近所有生物目眩失明。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME's body is made almost entirely of shimmering ice and water filled with light. When it dives into the ocean, the resulting splash dazzles and blinds all nearby.

entry: POKENAME旋转时，会照亮四周一切。炮管射出的光束，亮得能让人瞬间失明。
author: seanothan_23
source: When POKENAME spins it lights up everything around it. It shoots beams of light from its cannons that are bright enough to instantly blind a person.

entry: 吸入POKENAME的气体，会导致暂时失明。被惹怒时，还会释放灼热闪光。
author: .realthree
source: Inhaling an POKENAME's gasses can cause temporary blindness. If angered, it will let out a searing flash of light.

entry: POKENAME背上的种子里，有松动的鳞片。它用尾巴拍打种子，发出轻轻的叮当声。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have loose scales inside the bulb on their back. They slam their tail into the bulb to produce a light jingling sound.

entry: POKENAME鼓起脸颊，就是准备吹出毒雾，驱赶巢边的害虫。它抖动种子下的鳞片，提醒群中同伴，必要时便能逃走。
author: fiordaliso
source: When it puffs out its cheeks, POKENAME is preparing to blow a poisonous mist that serves to keep pests away from its den. By shaking the scales under its bulb, it alerts the others in its pack, so that they can flee if necessary.

entry: POKENAME用随身骨头敲击头骨上的鳞片，会发出清脆洪亮的声音。它快速敲打，制造刺耳噪声，惹得捕食者受不了而离开。
author: sk372
source: Whacking the bone POKENAME carries against the scale on its skull produces a sharp, resounding sound. It rapidly strikes its skull to produce the shrill noise to irritate and drive off predators.

entry: POKENAME从不背对对手，受威胁时会发出巨响。不过，与信任的人相处时，会把背部变成对方最爱宝可梦的脸，让人欢喜，短裤小子尤其喜欢。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME never turns its back on opponents, and makes loud noises when threatened. Yet when it is with someone it trusts, it shapes its back into the face of their favourite Pokémon, sparking joy, especially among Youngsters.

entry: POKENAME与训练家结下深厚羁绊后，会送上一片华美鳞片。它适应能力出众，在野外许多不同环境中都能见到。
author: fiordaliso
source: When POKENAME forms a deep bond with its Trainer, it offers one of its magnificent scales as a gift. In the wild, it can be found in many different habitats thanks to its remarkable adaptability.

entry: POKENAME从脸上鳞片发出编码讯号。这些脉冲能干扰附近电脑，引发故障。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME emits coded signals from the scales on its face. These pulses can disrupt and malfunction nearby computers.

entry: 准备进化时，POKENAME头上的鳞片会泛起柔光。期间，它只在熟悉水域游动，好让自己安心。
author: .izik
source: The scale on POKENAME's head glows softly when it's ready to evolve. During this time, it only swims in familiar waters to feel safe.

entry: POKENAME用尾部大鳞片碰触头上的鳞片交流。急促敲击代表敌意，缓慢的金属刮擦声警告附近有危险，单次回荡的铿锵声则表示友好。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME communicates with others by using the large scale on its tail against the one on its head. Rapid tapping implies aggression, a slow metallic scraping warns of nearby danger, and a single echoing clang is a sign of friendship.

entry: 战斗时，POKENAME将尾上的锋利鳞片当战扇挥舞。鳞片增强精神力量，让它能娴熟地格挡袭来的攻击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME wields the sharp scale on its tail like a war fan during combat. The scale augments its psychic powers, allowing it to expertly parry incoming attacks.

entry: POKENAME的鬃毛由叶片构成，起着鳞甲的作用。叶片散发辛香，增强其他生物的攻击性。
author: foolish_weasel
source: A POKENAME has a mane that consists of leaves which function as armored scales. The leaves emanate a spicy aroma that pumps up aggression in others.

entry: POKENAME用角轻敲树木，判断树液的多少与好坏。找到合适的树后，会用爪撕开树皮，因为不愿让所求的树液弄脏自己的角。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME senses the amount and quality of sap within a tree by rapping its horn against it. Once it finds a suitable tree, it tears the bark away with its claws, as it detests getting its horn dirtied by the sap it seeks.

entry: POKENAME非常在意外貌与声音，一有机会就细心清洁鳞片。鳞片最亮、声音最好听的POKENAME，会带领整个族群。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME cares very much about their appearance and sound. They meticulously clean their scales whenever they have a chance. The POKENAME with the shiniest and most pleasant-sounding scales leads the pack.

entry: POKENAME常在训练家学校附近闲逛，与住在周围的宝可梦玩耍。不知为何，它极力维护自己高高梳起的前发，谁敢取笑，无论敌友都会挨打。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME loiter around Trainer Schools, usually playing with other Pokémon that live nearby. For some reason, POKENAME is very defensive of their pompadour and will lash at anyone, friend or foe, who makes fun of it.

entry: POKENAME成群住在海边小湾，把鳞片浸入盐水，保持光亮。受打扰时，会一齐使出啄钻攻击。
author: .izik
source: Flocks of POKENAME live in seaside coves, dipping their scales in saltwater to stay polished. If disturbed, they attack in unison with Drill Peck.

entry: POKENAME摇动鳞片，产生各种声音与振动，与同类交流。它的毒液能提炼成驱除寄生虫的洗剂，保护许多结果的树木。
author: fiordaliso
source: When it shakes its scales, POKENAME produces a wide variety of sounds and vibrations that it uses to communicate with others of its kind. Its venom can be distilled into antiparasitic lotions that protect many fruit-bearing trees.

entry: POKENAME独特的黄色鳞片储存着电力。雷暴让它精力充沛，忍不住挑战周围一切，唯独自己的训练家除外。
author: t3isukone
source: POKENAME's distinctive yellow scales store its electricity. Thunderstorms fill it with energy and inspire it to pick fights with anything around it that isn't its Trainer.

entry: POKENAME用头上鳞片的锋利边缘切开石头，再吃下碎块，强健身体。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses the sharp edge of its head scale to slice into stones. Afterward, it eats the fragments to strengthen its body.

entry: 过渡阶段，POKENAME的四肢开始缩进身体，行动力下降，让它十分沮丧。这一过程标志着变态发育的开始。
author: ultrazombie929
source: During its transitional stage, POKENAME becomes frustrated by its lost mobility as its limbs begin to recede into its body. This process signals the start of its metamorphosis.

entry: POKENAME花许多时间，用覆鳞的头猛撞岩石，锻炼身体。力道太大，常因此引发山坡岩崩与雪崩。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME spends a lot of its time toughening itself up by slamming its scaly head against rocks. It does this with so much force that it is frequently responsible for setting off rockslides and avalanches on mountainsides.

entry: 城都群山曾回响着POKENAME坚硬羽毛的喧响。登上最高峰的探险者，仍声称能听见随风而来的欢庆钟鸣余音。
author: ozydamians
source: The mountains of Johto once clamored with the sound of POKENAME's rigid feathers. Explorers who summit the highest peaks still claim to hear the echo of a celebratory chime carried by the wind.

entry: 它们挖掘地面时，鳞片会发出声音。POKENAME习惯收集喜爱的石头，互相敲打，制造声响。
author: infinex21
source: Their scales emit sound as they dig through terrain. POKENAME have a habit of collecting their favorite stones and smacking them together to make noise.

entry: POKENAME蹦跳时，鳞状羽毛相撞，发出金属声，与周围交流。不高兴时，POKENAME会抖起鳞片，振出威吓声。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: When POKENAME hop around, their scale feathers will clang together to create metallic noises that are used to communicate with those around them. When displeased, POKENAME will ruffle its scales, causing it to vibrate with an intimidating sound.

entry: 它的刺虽坚硬，却是中空的。烦躁时会竖起，风吹过便发出钟鸣般的声音。
author: infinex21
source: Its quills are hollow despite being tough. When agitated, its quills stand on-end and emit chime-like noises as the wind runs along them.

entry: POKENAME聚在一起，敲击额头鳞片，向彼此、盟友和训练家表达感情。据说若感知旁人愉快，鼓声可能像风铃一样。
author: am3lie._.137
source: POKENAME gather in groups to drum against the scale on their forehead to communicate their feelings to one another, their allies, and their Trainer. It is said that if they sense the cheerfulness of others, their drumming may sound like wind chimes.

entry: 这种POKENAME在最高的山峰跳舞。有开心的观众欣赏时，它会一边跳，一边敲鳞片，传达遇上好观众的喜悦。
author: zebrarook_
source: This POKENAME dances at the highest peaks of mountains. When seen by a happy audience, it taps their scales while they dance, communicating how glad they are to have a good audience while they dance.

entry: POKENAME头上的鳞片会发出强磁场。有时不知不觉，就黏在金属物上了。
author: .izik
source: The scale on POKENAME's head emits a strong magnetic field. It sometimes sticks to metal objects without realizing it.

entry: POKENAME通过头上鳞片引导龙之能量，用盘旋的流沙地狱困住对手。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME channels draconic energy through the scale on its head. This energy lets it trap opponents in swirling Sand Tombs.

entry: POKENAME花朵的花瓣与叶片厚实，边缘覆有金属化合物。既足以挡住攻击，又能相互撞出响亮金属声，同时起到防护与警告的作用。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The petals and leaves on the flower of POKENAME are dense and edged in a metallic compound. They serve a dual function of protection and warning, being dense enough to block attacks whilst also making a loud clanging noise against one another.

entry: POKENAME用爪敲鳞片，奏出打击旋律，彼此交流。大群POKENAME的声音能回荡数英里。
author: bee4082
source: POKENAME communicate with percussive melodies made by smacking their scales with their claws. The sounds of a large group of POKENAME can echo for miles.

entry: 行进中的POKENAME群，总有一只在前方望风。发现威胁，就挥尾发出铿锵声，提醒同伴逃到安全处，或列队迎战。
author: reflecbeat
source: A roaming group of POKENAME always has one in front acting as a lookout. If it spots a threat, it waves its tail, making a clanging sound that alerts its brethren either to flee to safety or to enter a battle formation.

entry: POKENAME深夜相聚，用头互撞，决定竞争者间的地位。金属头骨撞出的颤鸣，常被误认成恶灵作祟的哭号。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME meet in the dead of night to butt heads against each other to establish hierarchy between rivals. The clang of their metal skulls creates a warbling wail that many confuse for the haunted cries of evil spirits.

entry: POKENAME在栖身的高山周围飞行。威胁靠近时，会转动核心周围的金鳞，晃瞎靠得太近的生物。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME can be spotted flying around the tall mountains they call home. If a threat approaches, they rotate the golden scales around their core to blind those that get too close.

entry: 古代雕刻描绘过军队带POKENAME作战。它们与人类盟友并肩战斗，受训不惜一切代价保护人类，因此成为历史上受敬重的战士。
author: .izik
source: Ancient carvings depict armies using POKENAME in battle. They would fight alongside their human allies, trained to protect them at all costs, making them revered warriors in history.

entry: POKENAME是骄傲的伙伴，很少拒绝战斗。作战虽凶猛，脾气却控制得很好。可一旦受人怂恿，POKENAME的怒火就极难平息。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME are prideful companions who seldom turn down a fight. Despite their ferocity in battle, their temper is under tight control. Although if they are abetted, it can become extremely difficult to calm POKENAME's rage.

entry: POKENAME振翅的声音音调极高，让许多生物迷乱分心。它趁机俯冲，用头上坚硬鳞片撞击目标。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's beating wings create a sound that is quite high in pitch. It is disorienting and distracting to many, creating openings it can use to divebomb and headbutt targets with the hard scale on its head.

entry: 有些地区追捧POKENAME鳞片的光泽与色彩。它制造幻象躲避偷猎者，让对方以为找到脱落的鳞片，实际捡起的却是无用垃圾。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's scale is sought after in some regions for its shininess and color. To evade poachers, it casts illusions to make others believe they've discovered shed scales, while in actuality they've only gathered up useless garbage.

entry: POKENAME缓缓挥动尾上鳞片，释放平静气场，安抚猎物。待对方放松戒备，便使出强力舍身冲撞。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME slowly waves the scale on its tail to release a calming aura that subdues its prey. Once they are off guard, it strikes with a powerful Double-Edge.

entry: 它有许多相互撞击鳞片的方式，各自表达不同情绪。无论战斗还是捕猎，都会用触须上的利鳞精准出击。
author: infinex21
source: It has many different patterns of clashing its scales together that each express different emotions. It strikes with precision using the sharp scales upon its feelers, be it in battle or against prey.

entry: POKENAME十分胆小，只有遇险才会碰响鳞片。它只与赢得自己信任的对象决斗。
author: m1918_94884
source: POKENAME are very timid, only clanging their scales together if they are in danger. They will duel only those who have earned their trust.

entry: POKENAME用尾尖撞击其他鳞片交流。背部或帽形头顶的鳞片挨打时，就会散出毒孢子。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME uses the tip of its tail to communicate by clashing it against its other scales. When the scales on its back or its cap-like head are struck, toxic spores are scattered.

entry: POKENAME头上的鳞片整天吸收太阳热量。过热时，会从颈部毛皮中排出暖气。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's head scale absorbs solar heat throughout the day. When it overheats, warm air is vented through the fur on its neck.

entry: POKENAME的两个头，花许多时间互撞坚硬鳞片。巨大的噪声会吓跑领地内的其他宝可梦。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's two heads spend much of their time clashing their hard scales against each other. This makes a lot of noise, frightening other Pokémon away from their territory.

entry: POKENAME喜欢挑战遇到的每只宝可梦，锻炼自己。若没有敌人可打，POKENAME双臂末端的两个头，就会互撞覆鳞的脑袋。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME loves to toughen itself up by fighting any Pokémon it encounters. If POKENAME lacks an enemy to fight, the two heads at the ends of its arms will clash their scaled heads together.

entry: POKENAME听见训练家许愿，就会好奇地敲击头上鳞片，判断对方是否心地纯洁。若敲出清音，POKENAME胸前的心形部位便会发光，愿望也会实现。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Whenever a POKENAME hears a Trainer make a wish, it will curiously tap the scale on its head to determine if they are pure of heart. If the scale produces a clear note, the heart on a POKENAME's chest will glow and the wish will be granted.

entry: 野外只需听声音，就知道POKENAME靠近了。它精力无穷，在林间跑来跑去，不停用爪刮擦、敲击头顶金属鳞片，响声不绝。
author: sk372
source: One will know the approach of a POKENAME in the wild due to the noise it makes. Full of boundless energy, it runs around woods loudly scraping and clanging its claws against the metal scale on its head.

entry: POKENAME用强颚夹住目标后，会突然使出龙爪，再追击一次。可大嘴太碍事，这些后续攻击往往打不中。
author: .izik
source: After clamping onto its target with its powerful jaws, POKENAME will attempt to strike again with a sudden Dragon Claw. Due to the size of its maw, these follow-up attacks often miss.

entry: POKENAME反应慢，行动也不快。不过，有父母或训练家送的先制之爪帮助，仍能抓住出击时机。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have slow reaction times and cannot move very fast. However, with the help of a Quick Claw given to them by their parents or Trainer, they can find moments of opportunity to strike.

entry: 覆盖身体的条条肌肉，能抵御猛烈撞击与恶劣天气。POKENAME遇到其他龙属性宝可梦，会碰响颈部鳞片，发起挑战。
author: fiordaliso
source: The bands of muscle covering its body protect it from violent impacts and adverse weather conditions. When POKENAME encounters another Dragon-type Pokémon, it challenges it by making the scales around its neck jingle.

entry: 这只宝可梦大胆又亲人，尤其以尾巴和头顶坚固鳞片的外观为傲。战斗时两者都会用上，战后还会用力梳理清洁。
author: bobosmith01
source: This Pokémon has a bold yet affectionate personality. It is particularly prideful over the appearance of its tail and the sturdy scale atop its head and will incorporate both of them in battle, while vigorously grooming them afterwards.

entry: POKENAME攻守兼备，用角尖攻击，以大鳞片格挡。POKENAME的鳞片挨打时，会发出嘹亮鸣响，与长牙共鸣。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are masters of offense and defense, striking with the tips of their horns and blocking with their large scales. When a POKENAME's scale is struck, it creates a loud ringing that resonates with the POKENAME's tusks.

entry: POKENAME用长牙撞击敌人时，头上鳞片会发出悦耳鸣响。声音常比撞击本身更让敌人受惊。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME slams into foes with its tusks, the scale on its head rings with a pleasant chime. The sound often startles enemies more than the impact.

entry: POKENAME腹部的巨大心形鳞片，能保护核心免遭外界伤害。鳞片挨打产生的能量，让POKENAME积蓄热量，再喷出强力火息。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: The large, heart-shaped scale on a POKENAME's stomach helps to protect its core from any external harm. Energy from the scales being struck allow POKENAME to build up heat before unleashing powerful fiery breaths.

entry: POKENAME头顶的鳞片攻守皆宜。鳞片越热，它就飞得越快。
author: mr.person__prinplup_enjoyer
source: The scale atop POKENAME's head is useful for both offense and defense. The hotter the scale is, the faster it can fly.

entry: 这种淘气的宝可梦，住在山中隧道深处。它会敲击头上鳞片，发出惊人而诡异的声音，吓唬路过者。
author: bobosmith01
source: A mischievous Pokémon that lives deep in mountainous tunnels. It will beat against the scale on its head to create a startling and eerie sound to frighten passerby.

entry: POKENAME跳舞时，头上鳞片会奏出悦耳音调。每迈出优雅的一步，节奏就更加复杂。
author: .izik
source: As POKENAME dances, its head scale produces a melodic tone. The rhythm grows more complex with each elegant step.

entry: POKENAME独特的冠状鳞片锋利如剃刀，曾是地位的象征。收藏家争相追捧，有些人甚至觉得比心之鳞片还珍贵。
author: t3isukone
source: The distinctive crest scale of a POKENAME is razor-sharp and used to be a status symbol. It's highly sought after by collectors, with some even prizing them above Heart Scales.

entry: POKENAME休息时，鳞片轻轻晃动，释放粉球果般的香气。小型宝可梦被引来后，就会遭它伏击。
author: .izik
source: While resting, POKENAME's scales gently wobble, releasing a scent like Pink Apricorns. The aroma lures small Pokémon, which it ambushes.

entry: POKENAME飞行时若发现碎屑坠落，金色耳朵就会发光。它能立刻使出守住，免受伤害。
author: .izik
source: While flying, POKENAME's golden ears glow if it notices falling debris. It can instantly use Protect to shield itself from harm.

entry: POKENAME压低翅膀滑翔，避免鳞片沙沙作响。抬翼俯冲或振翅起飞时，鳞片才会奏出悦耳音调，向族群报知行踪。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME glide with their wings held low to stop their scales from rustling. When they lift their wings to dive or flap their wings to take off, their scales will ring out in lovely tones that signal their travels to their flocks.

entry: POKENAME安睡时，头上黏性的鳞片会散出淡淡的橙橙果气味，吸引寻找花蜜的虫宝可梦。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME is peacefully asleep, its sticky head scale gives off a faint scent of Oran Berries. This scent attracts Bug Pokémon seeking nectar.

entry: POKENAME蓬松的身体被抱住时，头上鳞片就会亮起鲜粉色。这可能是开心，也可能是即将动粗的警告。
author: .izik
source: When hugged, POKENAME's fluffy body causes the scale on its head to glow bright pink. This can mean happiness-or a warning of coming violence.

entry: POKENAME头上鳞片般的结构，其实是一朵极薄的蘑菇，用来散播孢子。孢子微微发光，能照亮栖身的洞穴。
author: .izik
source: The scale-like formation on POKENAME's head is actually a very thin mushroom it uses to scatter spores. These spores glow slightly, allowing it to illuminate its cave home.

entry: 这只宝可梦大胆又亲人，尤其珍爱尾巴和头顶坚固鳞片。战斗时两者都会用上，不过战后会用力梳理清洁。
author: bobosmith01
source: This Pokémon has a bold yet affectionate personality. It is particularly prideful of its tail and the sturdy scale atop its head and will incorporate both of them in battle, but will groom them vigorously afterwards.

entry: POKENAME住在杖尾鳞甲龙巢穴下方的地下，躲进脱落鳞片中，保护自己。若被发现，就会急促碰响鳞片，通知杖尾鳞甲龙：领地有威胁。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME dwell underground beneath Kommo-o dens, hiding within the discarded scales for protection. If they're spotted, they will rapidly clang their scales to alert the Kommo-o of a threat to its territory.

entry: POKENAME用锋利鳞片钻穿山壁。它一边切开致密岩石，一边为同类挖掘通道。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME tunnels through mountain walls with sharp scales. It uses them to slice through dense rock while digging paths for its kind.

entry: POKENAME很难取悦。不满时，会来回甩尾，让尾端重物敲在背上，发出巨响。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are difficult to please. They show their displeasure by swishing their tail back and forth, clanging the weight at the end of their tail against their back and making a loud noise.

entry: POKENAME从头上鳞片发出引起头痛的脉冲。混乱或惊慌时，波动会更强。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME sends out headache-inducing pulses from the scale on its head. The waves grow stronger when it's confused or panicked.

entry: POKENAME训练过度，每周都会把坚硬鳞片一片片磨损、崩落。虽然痛苦，新长的鳞片却一次比一次锋利坚固。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME train excessively, wearing down and chipping off each of their tough scales every week. While painful, new scales will grow in their place, each sharper and more durable than the last.

entry: POKENAME看起来瘦弱，却能用鳞片发动强力攻击。它通过相互敲击鳞片交流。
author: lydiaprower8
source: While it looks scrawny, POKENAME can deliver powerful attacks with its scales. It communicates by smacking those scales together.

entry: POKENAME喜欢嬉戏着互相撞头。有巨大鳞片保护脑袋，POKENAME不会受伤，但鳞片相碰，会响起钹声般的巨响。
author: fireflower20002
source: POKENAME like to playfully headbutt each other. This doesn't hurt the POKENAME since their heads are protected by a giant scale, but they do make a loud sound similar to cymbals when their scales collide.

entry: POKENAME挥动末端有硬鳞的藤蔓，守护雨林树冠中的巢。打击的力量足以击碎岩石。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME swings a vine tipped with a hardened scale to defend its jungle canopy nest. Its strikes can shatter stone.

entry: POKENAME用头上利鳞，从洞穴矿层切下少量大理石，再吃掉石屑，强化岩石身体，让战斗时更坚固。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses the sharp scale on its head to cut off small bits of marble from deposits in caves. It then eats the shavings to strengthen its stony body, improving its durability for battle.

entry: POKENAME靠近矿床时，鳞片会变暖。若感知到锡矿，就会不知疲倦地挖掘，寻找最爱的美食，有时能挖到一英里多深。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's scales grow warm when it nears ore deposits. If it senses tin ore, it digs tirelessly to uncover its favorite treat, sometimes over a mile deep.

entry: POKENAME很容易被闪亮物分散注意，连自己的鳞片也不例外。它常想抓住尾尖，却在移动尾巴、闪亮物消失时，困惑不已。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are easily distracted by shiny objects, including their own scales. They often try to catch the tips of their own tails, only to get confused when they move their tails and the shiny objects disappear.

entry: POKENAME的鳞片泛橙光，就表示准备释放强力泡沫光线。威力足以在石头上打出凹痕。
author: .izik
source: When its scale glows orange, POKENAME is ready to unleash a powerful Bubble Beam. This attack is strong enough to leave dents in stone.

entry: POKENAME用尾巴猛拍覆鳞的种子，发出铿锵巨响。连睡得很沉的生物，也会被POKENAME吵醒。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME slam their tail against their scaly bulb to produce clanging noises. Even heavy sleepers awaken when POKENAME creates this noise.

entry: POKENAME遇险时，会把尾端硬鳞甩向袭击者。只需几分钟就能长出新鳞，因此不会长久失去防御手段。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME, when in danger, flings the hardened scale at the end of its tail at aggressors. A new one grows back in only a few minutes, so it's never without a defense mechanism for long.

entry: POKENAME收集被遗弃的龙属性宝可梦蛋，拼命守护。任何捕食者靠得太近，都会被它用锋利鳞片驱赶。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME gathers abandoned Dragon-type eggs and guards them fiercely. It uses its sharp scales to fend off any predator that comes too close.

entry: 野外，POKENAME会用刃状双臂刮擦头上鳞片，向对手挑战。POKENAME的鳞片伤痕和瑕疵越多，就越被认为强大。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME scrapes its bladed arms across the scale on its head as a sign of challenge to rivals in the wild. The more scars and blemishes a POKENAME's scale possesses, the more strong they are seen as.

entry: POKENAME用刀刃般的尾巴劈斩敌人，以翅膀格挡攻击。翼膜看似薄，却覆着金属般坚固的鳞片。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME slashes at foes with its bladed tail, while using its wings to block attacks. Although their membranes seem thin, they are covered with scales as durable as metal.

entry: 这种宝可梦的皮肤由多种鳞片构成，蜕皮时都会同时脱落。POKENAME蜕得很频繁，每次都会更长更大，长到足够大时，就准备进化了。
author: heal_fire
source: This Pokémon's skin is made of multiple kinds of scales, but they're all removed at the same time when it sheds. POKENAME is known for shedding a lot, growing longer and larger with each cycle. Once it is big enough, it is ready to evolve.

entry: POKENAME暴怒时，会将闪亮鳞片举向天空，召来猛烈雷暴。传说雷声，就是它的战吼在高处回荡。
author: .izik
source: When enraged, POKENAME lifts its radiant scale skyward to call down violent thunderstorms. Legends say the sound of thunder is its war cry echoing from above.

entry: 它头顶的鳞片不易切断。身体其他部分虽然更柔嫩脆弱，战斗时仍会勇敢地使出全身迎战。
author: bobosmith01
source: The scale atop its head cannot easily be severed. Although other parts of its body are more tender and vulnerable, it nonetheless bravely fights with its whole body in combat.

entry: POKENAME的叶片坚硬无比，连另一只POKENAME的叶子也划不伤。叶片脱落后，任何想吃的宝可梦，都只会伤到自己。
author: reflecbeat
source: POKENAME's leaves are hard enough that not even the leaves of another POKENAME will scratch them. When it sheds these leaves, any Pokémon that tries to eat one of them will only end up hurting itself.

entry: POKENAME额头有巨大的黄色鳞片，是力量的象征。当地人相信鳞片藏着神秘力量，有人还说能掌控战局，赋予持有者巨力。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME has a massive yellow scale on its forehead, a symbol of strength. Locals believe the scale holds mysterious powers, with some claiming it can control the flow of battle, granting immense strength to its wielder.

entry: POKENAME定期蜕鳞。人们发现，磨成粉加入它的奶中，会带来独特的蜜糖般甜美余味。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME sheds its scales on a regular basis. It's been found that grinding them into a powder and adding them to its milk gives it a distinctly sweet, honey-like aftertaste.

entry: POKENAME能把覆鳞的尾巴当铲子挖地。它总渴求矿物，通常会把挖出的土直接送进嘴里。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME can use their scaled tail like a shovel to dig through the ground. They usually deposit the soil directly into their mouth, as they are constantly hungry for minerals.

entry: POKENAME在黑暗洞穴中沉睡，准备进化。危险靠近，头上鳞片就会快速振动，提醒它有捕食者。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME slumbers in dark caves as it prepares to evolve. When danger nears, the scale on its head vibrates rapidly to warn it of predators.

entry: POKENAME虽常发狂破坏，却会先用力碰响鳞片，激起斗志，发出充分警告。若这段表演被打断，POKENAME可能不再攻击，而是退走。
author: .jerden
source: While POKENAME regularly goes on destructive rampages, it provides plenty of warning by loudly striking its scales together to work itself up. If this performance is interrupted, POKENAME may retreat instead of attacking.

entry: POKENAME头上鳞片相碰，会发出令人发冷的声音。周围空气明显降温，掉落的鳞片一天就能长回。
author: .izik
source: The scales on POKENAME's head emit a chilling sound when they clink. The air around it cools noticeably, and lost scales regrow in a day.

entry: POKENAME披着坚硬锋利的鳞片，靠经常挖地保持锋刃。至少每周会在挖掘时蜕一次鳞，半周后便重新长好。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are clad in tough, sharp scales that they keep honed by digging through terrain regularly. At least every week they shed their scales while digging, which will regrow in half a week's time.

entry: 大雨过后，POKENAME金属般的身体亮得如抛光钢铁。它用刀刃般的爪状双臂，发动破坏力惊人的攻击。
author: .izik
source: After heavy rainfall, POKENAME's metallic body gleams like polished steel. It attacks with devastating force using its bladed, claw-like arms.

entry: POKENAME啃咬尾上鳞片，保持锋利，咀嚼时响起回荡的咔嗒声。若啃得太多让鳞片掉落，几天内就会长回。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME nibbles on the scale on its tail in order to keep it sharp, making a reverberating clacking noise as it chews. If the scale falls off from excessive chewing, it grows back within a few days.

entry: POKENAME的鳞片掉落后，会被收进整理得井井有条的巢。珠宝匠珍爱这些闪亮碎片，用来制作稀有项链。
author: .izik
source: If its scales fall off, POKENAME hoards them in a carefully organized den. Jewelers prize these gleaming pieces for crafting rare necklaces.

entry: POKENAME性情傲慢，很少与同类结群，更喜欢寻找能一同训练的对手。坚固羽毛常在激战中掉落，被人捡去制作厨具。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME rarely forms groups with its kind due to its haughty nature, preferring to seek out rivals to train alongside. Its durable feathers are often lost due in its intense battles, leading to them being scavenged for crafting cooking utensils.

entry: POKENAME头顶的鳞片比剃刀更锋利，能劈开板岩。身上奇特的金属甲，比看起来轻得多。
author: .izik
source: The scale atop POKENAME's head is sharper than a razor and can cleave slate. The strange metal armor it wears is lighter than it looks.

entry: POKENAME大部分身体覆着坚固岩石。谁靠近占据的领地，它就用尾尖敲击臂上金属鳞片，大声警告，再用角与爪攻击。
author: .jerden
source: Solid stone covers most of POKENAME's body. It will loudly clash the tip of its tail against the metallic scales on its arms as a warning to anyone who approaches territory it has claimed, before attacking with its horns and claws.

entry: 开战前，POKENAME用长鞭般的缎带抽地，威吓对手。训练家却说，这是祈求必胜的战前仪式，不过并未证实。
author: teatedtiten
source: When entering a battle, POKENAME will crack its whip-like ribbons on the ground to intimidate its opponent. Its Trainers instead say this is a pre-fighting ritual to ensure victory, though this is unproven.

entry: 古代文明曾用POKENAME为洞穴探险者领路。力气极大，最适合清除狭窄通道中的碎石。
author: .izik
source: Ancient civilizations used POKENAME to guide cave explorers. Its immense strength made it ideal for clearing rubble from tight passageways.

entry: POKENAME成对的头顶鳞片，对声音与热量极其敏感。生物靠近，便会猛烈抽动，提醒它出击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's twin head scales are hypersensitive to sound and heat. They twitch violently when a creature approaches, alerting it to strike.

entry: POKENAME的脑袋互撞，响亮共鸣让自己斗志高昂。也能强化头骨上的鳞片，让它更善于战斗。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's heads headbutt each other, psyching itself up for battle with the resonating clang it creates. This also serves to strengthen the scales on its skulls, making it more effective in combat.

entry: POKENAME通常用双臂末端脑袋上的硬平鳞片攻击敌人。有时会一边碰响这两片鳞片，一边用主头吼叫，威吓对方。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME usually strikes foes using the hard, flat scales on top of the heads at the end of its arms. It will sometimes intimidate foes by clashing these two scales together while roaring with the main head.

entry: POKENAME与同类互相撞头，锻炼身体。力道足以撞碎鳞片，新鳞却会长得更坚固，让切磋双方都更强壮。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME toughens itself up by butting heads with others of its kind. It strikes with enough force to break its scales, which grow back tougher, strengthening both rivals as they spar.

entry: POKENAME全身闪亮的鳞片，密实无比。岩崩时会蜷成球，防止被落石击伤。
author: .izik
source: The shiny scales covering POKENAME's body are incredibly dense. During rockslides, it curls into a ball to protect itself from falling debris.

entry: POKENAME击中敌人时，长牙上的鳞片可能崩落。只要饮食丰富、富含蛋白质，就很容易重新长出。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME strikes a foe, scales may chip from its tusks. These regrow easily if it maintains a rich, protein-heavy diet.

entry: POKENAME从头上金鳞发出强力声波，瞬间让受害者失去行动能力，震昏猎物后再进食。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME emits powerful sonic waves from the golden scale on its head. It does this to knock out prey before it feeds, using sound to disable its victims in a flash.

entry: POKENAME住在阴暗潮湿处。若有其他宝可梦攻击，就会大叫，再慢慢跳向对方，用头上锋利鳞片狠狠打击。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME makes its home in dark, damp places. If any other Pokémon attack it, it will let out a loud yell, then slowly hop towards them, striking them forcefully with the sharp scale on its head.

entry: 风吹过时，POKENAME头上松动的鳞片会轻轻鸣响。它私下会让黏液覆身的身体随声舞动，但一察觉有人观看，就立刻僵住。
author: .izik
source: The loose scale atop POKENAME's head chimes softly in the wind. It dances with its slime-covered body to the sound in secret but freezes instantly if it notices anyone watching.

entry: POKENAME用尾上利鳞守卫领地，定期巡逻洞口，阻止不受欢迎的来客进入。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses the sharp scale on its tail to guard its domain. It patrols cave entrances regularly to keep out any unwelcome visitors.

entry: POKENAME的金鳞即使脱落，仍然滚烫。这些好斗的宝可梦住在火山地区的洞穴，让穿行当地变得危险。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME's golden scales remain burningly hot even after they're shed. These aggressive Pokémon inhabit caves in volcanic regions, making the land dangerous to traverse.

entry: POKENAME头上的闪亮鳞片能反光，晃瞎从上方扑食的宝可梦。脱落鳞片能卖高价，许多潜水员争相寻找。
author: mepp.
source: The shiny scale on POKENAME's head reflects light, blinding Pokémon that try to prey on it from above. Many divers seek out these shed scales, as they fetch high prices.

entry: 春天，POKENAME碰响翼上鳞片，呼唤伴侣，一同分享、守卫领地。不受欢迎的来客，会被它从口中喷出的火舌驱赶。
author: fiordaliso
source: In spring, POKENAME chimes the scales on its wings to call for a partner to share and defend its territory. It keeps unwelcome visitors away by puffing tongues of fire at them from its jaws.

entry: POKENAME每年夏季蜕下的鳞片，被用来定制服装和手提包。它从圆滚滚的身体放电，威吓对手。
author: fiordaliso
source: The scales POKENAME sheds each summer when it molts are used to customize clothes and handbags. It releases electric discharges from its round body to intimidate its opponents.

entry: POKENAME挥舞一根骨头般的小杖，覆满一生蜕下的无数鳞片。挥动时，杖上鳞片相互碰撞，奏出迷人而宁静的旋律。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME wield a small bone-like rod clad in myriad scales that it has shed throughout its life. When it waves this rod, the scales attached to it clatter together in a fascinatingly tranquil melody.

entry: POKENAME振动头上金属鳞片，发出嗡鸣，吓退闯入珍爱花园的生物。明亮威严的外貌，让它受到许多古代文明王室的喜爱。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses vibrations of the metal scales on its head to create a buzzing noise to scare off invaders to its precious flower gardens. Its bright and regal appearance made it popular with royalty in many ancient civilizations.

entry: POKENAME奔过稀树草原与灌木地时，鳞片会响亮而有节奏地鸣响。数千年前的多部史诗，都详述过它惊人的力量、暴烈脾气及彼此复杂的关系。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME's scales loudly and rhythmically ring as they gallop through savannas and shrublands. Several epics from millennia ago delve into great detail about POKENAME's extraordinary strength, wild temper, and complex relationships with one another.

entry: POKENAME的幼崽学会走路后不久，父母就会离开，靠幼崽的硬鳞保护自己。新手训练家常寻找幼年POKENAME，因为它们很适合作为学习时的伙伴。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME will abandon their young shortly after they are able to walk, relying on the rigid scales that the pups possess to protect them. Young POKENAME are often sought out by new Trainers, as they make excellent partners for learning Trainers.

entry: POKENAME披着金鳞，游泳迅捷灵巧，借河流推动身体前进。鳞片擦过船壳时，会响起雷鸣般的一连串鼓声。
author: ultron_suprem3
source: Crested in golden scales, POKENAME are swift and agile swimmers, using river currents to push themselves forward. When the scales of a POKENAME brush against the hull of a ship, they make a sound like a thunderous drumline.

entry: POKENAME相互碰撞鳞片，擦出火花，点燃毛皮。这种感觉让POKENAME舒适放松，不战斗时，常在需要休息时把自己点燃。
author: thesilverowls
source: POKENAME strike their scales against each other to create sparks, which cause their fur to catch fire. The sensation is soothing for POKENAME, and outside of battle they will often ignite themselves when they need to rest.

entry: POKENAME飞过空中，鳞片叮当如风铃。它能挥动尾上利鳞，以长柄战斧般的力道，攻击下方敌人。
author: .jerden
source: As POKENAME flies through the air, the jangling of its scales sounds like wind chimes. It can swing the sharp scales on it tail at enemies below it with the force of a poleaxe.

entry: POKENAME不停蜕鳞，再长出新鳞。鳞片不及杖尾鳞甲龙的坚硬，常先在攻击中受损，再被POKENAME抛弃。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME constantly sheds its scales and grows new ones. They are not as hard as the scales of a Kommo-o, and frequently get damaged by attacks before being discarded by POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME在空中甩尾，尾巴会咔嗒作响，摇晃身体时，头周围的鳞片也同样响。若巨响未能威吓敌人，POKENAME就用尾端的棍棒猛击。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's tail makes a rattling sound when shaken in the air, as do the scales around its head as it sways back and forth. If this loud noise fails to intimidate its foes, POKENAME will strike them with the club at the end of its tail.

entry: 它飞过天空时，许多鳞片会发出金属巨响，常被误认成雷声。蜕下的鳞片，常被制成祈求躲过可怕风暴的装饰品。
author: infinex21
source: Its many scales emit loud, metallic noises as it flies through the sky, often loud enough to be mistaken for thunder. Any shed scales are often used in decorations meant to ward off terrible storms.

entry: 战斗中，POKENAME使出花瓣舞，让金属叶片卷成凶猛旋风。花瓣相互撞击，响得震耳欲聋，连POKENAME自己和敌人都会晕头转向。
author: foolish_weasel
source: In battle, POKENAME unleashes its metal leaves in a fierce whirlwind with its Petal Dance attack. The petals clang against each other, producing a deafening cacophony of sound that disorients both POKENAME and its foes.

entry: 朋友一旦证明自身价值，POKENAME就会始终忠诚相待。战斗时，它用精神力造出类似自身鳞片的甲片，覆盖盟友，保护对方。
author: sk372
source: Once they've proven themselves worthy, POKENAME is unfailingly loyal to its friends. It forms psychic plates of armor similar to its own scales and places it on its allies in battle for their protection.

entry: POKENAME巡逻古墓时，尾上鳞片叮当作响。令人不安的声音，提醒考古学家它已靠近，随后便会释放龙的狂怒。
author: .izik
source: The scales on POKENAME's tail jingle as it patrols ancient tombs. This unsettling noise warns archaeologists of its approach before it unleashes a draconic fury.

entry: POKENAME用金属角敲击背鳞，每片鳞的音调略有不同。战前用这乐声激起斗志，不战斗时似乎也喜欢演奏。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME clash their metallic horn against the scales on their back, each scale ringing with a slightly different tone. POKENAME use this musical sound to work themselves up before battle, but also seem to enjoy playing it outside of combat.

entry: 这种高贵的宝可梦，会在危急时保护其他生物。POKENAME奔跑时，储电的鳞片相互摩擦，发出雷暴般的隆隆声。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: This noble Pokémon is known to shield others in times of crisis. Electricity stored within POKENAME's clangorous scales rub together while it runs, creating the sound of a rumbling thunderstorm.

entry: POKENAME准备作战时，会碰响鳞片，擦出火花。未被开场的闪焰冲锋击败的敌人，会被按倒，再被它身上众多燃火鳞片反复灼烧。
author: soup1900
source: When POKENAME readies for battle, it clatters its scales together to ignite sparks. Anything that isn't defeated by its opening Flare Blitz is then pinned down and repeatedly scorched by the many scales lighting flames on its body.

entry: 野生POKENAME住在地下，主要靠强壮尾巴挖土。人类建筑工能用它挖掘，因为不断碰响的鳞片，能提醒大家它正靠近。
author: .jerden
source: Wild POKENAME live underground, mostly using their powerful tail to dig through the earth. They can be used for excavation by human construction workers, as their constantly jangling scales provide a useful warning that they are approaching.

entry: POKENAME从身体喷出气流，推动自己在空中前进。身后拖着的鳞片叮当如风铃，POKENAME撞到坚硬物体时，又会相碰，响得如同铜钹。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME propels itself through the air by expelling jets of gas from its body. As it does this, the scales trailing behind it jangle like wind chimes, crashing together like cymbals whenever POKENAME collides with a solid object.

entry: POKENAME碰响鳞片威吓其他生物，尖锐金属声传遍栖身的山地。竞争中获胜的个体，会扯下对手鳞片佩戴，作为胜利的战利品。
author: sk372
source: The sharp metal sound of POKENAME ringing its scales to intimidate others can be heard all around its mountainous home. Victorious rivals will tear scales off of their opponent to wear as symbolic trophies of their victory.

entry: 一些岛屿社群的民间传说，将POKENAME视为强大海上雷暴的化身。战斗时，鳞片振动产生充足静电，足以射出强力闪电。
author: sneakywalrus0
source: According to folklore, POKENAME are the embodiment of powerful offshore thunderstorms to some island communities. When they fight, their scales vibrate and produce enough static electricity to fire off mighty lightning bolts.

entry: 它的许多鳞片互相撞击时，各自发出尖锐声响。挖地能让鳞片保持锋利，因此它偏爱更坚硬的地面，好磨得如剃刀一般。
author: infinex21
source: Its many scales each emit shrill sounds when they are clashed together. These scales are kept razor sharp by it digging through terrain, favoring harder terrains to keep them at their sharpest.

entry: POKENAME抓住敌人后，会飞到高空，急速碰响鳞片，让强烈冲击波贯穿对方身体。修长的翼鳞很适合做风扇叶片，因为很容易兜住并搅动空气。
author: soup1900
source: Once POKENAME grabs a foe, it flies high into the air and rapidly rattles its scales together to send critical shock waves down through their body. Its elongated wing scales make for great fan blades since they catch and churn air very easily.

entry: POKENAME照顾幼崽时，鳞甲能抵御利爪捕食者。若觉得威胁适合给幼崽练手，就会威吓地碰响甲片和长牙，把较弱的捕食者赶到它们面前。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME's armored scales protect it from sharp-clawed predators while it watches over its young. If it thinks a threat will be good training for the young, it will herd a weak predator to them by clanking its armor and tusks in a threatening manner.

entry: 丛林冒险者有时会发现，树干中插着坚硬鳞片。那是POKENAME在标记领地，若遇上留下标记的本尊，可能就没命回来讲述了。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: Adventurers in the jungle can find rigid scales stuck into tree trunks. This is POKENAME marking its territory, and if the adventurer finds the Pokémon responsible, they may not live to tell the tale.

entry: 烦躁时，背鳞会颤动相撞，发出让大多数生物不安的尖声。它能碰撞红爪，发出集中的声音，既可交流，也能战斗。
author: infinex21
source: When agitated, the scales on its back tremble and clash together, emitting shrill noises that unnerve most others. It can clash its red claws together to emit focused sounds, both for communication and for battle.

entry: 有人说，蜕下的鳞片残留着精神力量，因此被视为幸运符。POKENAME送训练家一片蜕鳞，被认为是守护的誓言，从此结下牢不可破的羁绊。
author: thatlittletwerp
source: Some say that their discarded scales carry an echo of their psychic abilities, and are seen as a good luck charm. A POKENAME giving their Trainer one of its shed scales is considered to be a vow of protection, thus establishing an unbreakable bond.

entry: POKENAME虽满身沉重金属鳞，仍能灵巧地跳来跳去。它喜欢把爪握成拳，从上方击打敌人的头。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME is agile enough to leap around, despite the heavy weight of the metallic scales covering its body. It prefers to attack foes by striking them on the head from above, after clenching its claws into fists.

entry: POKENAME的大部分身体，恰由108片亮鳞构成。它能分别操控这些鳞片，让其如疾风中的军刀，劈向敌人。
author: .izik
source: Exactly 108 gleaming scales make up the majority of POKENAME's physical body. It can control these scales independently, sending them slicing at foes like a flurry of sabers.

entry: POKENAME先用钢镰重创敌人，再挥动斧尾，将其彻底摧毁。满身鳞甲让它觉得自己近乎无敌，连暴飞龙这种危险敌人，也敢无惧追猎。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME uses its steel scythes to brutally injure foes before utterly destroying them with a swing from its axe tail. Being covered in scales gives it the confidence of near-invincibility, so it hunts down dangerous foes like Salamence without fear.

entry: POKENAME的身体有厚毛与鳞甲保护。找到好食源后，其他宝可梦无论恐吓还是强行驱赶，它都不理会，宁可一直挡住攻击，等对方放弃，也不还手。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's body is protected by thick fur and scale armor. If it finds a good food source, it will ignore attempts by other Pokémon to frighten it away or remove it by force, preferring to block attacks until they give up rather than striking back.

entry: POKENAME为自己的金鳞深感自豪，细心保持清洁光亮。谁若弄脏，就会惹它大发脾气，能持续好几个小时。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are very prideful about their golden scales and take great care to keep them clean and polished. If anyone were to dirty their scales, they will fly into a tantrum that can last for many hours.

entry: POKENAME身上许多石鳞镀着薄薄贵金属，一动就会大声碰响。POKENAME把蜕鳞囤在地下巢穴，谁敢拿走，就会遭到猛烈攻击。
author: .jerden
source: Many of the stone scales covering POKENAME's body are gilded with a thin layer of precious metal and clink loudly whenever it moves. POKENAME hoards its own shed scales inside an underground lair, viciously attacking anyone who tries to take any.

entry: POKENAME翱翔时，翼上许多鳞片会叮当碰响。许多人珍爱这些金鳞，却只能等它蜕下，因为它连自己的训练家也不许拔取。
author: infinex21
source: The many scales of a POKENAME's wings will clatter and jingle as it soars through the sky. Many treasure these golden scales, but their only hope of obtaining them is when they are shed for this Pokémon will not even allow its Trainer to pluck them.

entry: POKENAME会模仿山中遇见的旅人，变成对方的样子，借此迷惑他们，让其不慎踏出悬崖。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME imitates travelers it encounters in the mountains by mimicking their appearance. It does this to confuse them into unintentionally walking off cliffsides.

entry: POKENAME释放强力月亮之力前，鳞片会泛起柔和粉光。月光直照时，威力更强，能轻易摧毁巨石。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's scales glow a pastel pink shortly before it unleashes a powerful Moonblast. In direct moonlight, the force magnifies, allowing it to destroy boulders with ease.

entry: 据说这种宝可梦会在战前碰响硬鳞，平复心情，但尚未证实。有些古老故事称，握住它蜕下的鳞片，能缓解紧张、抚慰内心。
author: infinex21
source: Supposedly, these Pokémon clash their rigid scales together to calm themselves before battle, though this has yet to be proven. Some old tales claim that holding one of their shed scales calms a person's nerves and soothes their heart.

entry: POKENAME的缎带全由金属鳞片构成，缠住猎物就会压碎骨头。鳞片碰撞会产生气场，瞬间让敌人充满恐惧与绝望。
author: soup1900
source: With POKENAME's ribbons being made entirely of metallic scales, any prey it wraps them around will have their bones crushed. The clattering of its scales creates auras that instantly instill fear and hopelessness in its foes' bodies.

entry: POKENAME住在火山深处，厚重鳞甲保护它，能沐浴在炽热岩浆中。强爪连最硬的石头都能撕开。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME live deep within volcanoes, their hefty scale armour protecting them from the intense heat of the lava they bathe in. Their powerful claws allow them to tear through even the hardest of stone.

entry: 传说POKENAME降临，便预示安宁未来。古老习俗称，危急时敲响祭铃，与其鳞片鸣响共振，就能将它召来。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Legends claim that the arrival of POKENAME is a sign of a peaceful future. Ancient traditions say that ringing ritual bells will resonate with the clanging of POKENAME's scales and summon it in times of need.

entry: POKENAME的金色板状鳞片由高导电合金构成，是战术的关键。战斗时，先蜕鳞布陷阱，再用尾巴放电，让电光在落鳞间跳跃。
author: deadshields
source: POKENAME's golden plate-scales are made of a highly conductive alloy, a key part of their battle strategy. In combat, they shed their scales to lay traps before launching electric bolts from their tail that bounce between their dropped scales.

entry: 过去，有人为向王室成员求爱，猎取POKENAME的金花。POKENAME力量凶猛，还能伸出带刺鞭状藤蔓，让这件事极其困难。
author: sk372
source: In the past, some would hunt POKENAME for their golden flowers, used for the sake of courting royalty. POKENAME's ferocious power and the thorny, whip-like vines it extended made this an extremely difficult endeavor.

entry: 由于目击记录一度中断，POKENAME曾被认为已经灭绝。不过，最近又见到它们成群游荡野外，用巨大的锁链状翼臂劈斩挑战者。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME were once thought to be extinct in the past due to a pause in recorded sightings. Recently however, groups have been seen roaming the wild, using their massive chain-like wing arms to slash at foes that challenge them.

entry: 余烬从鳞片缝隙散出，让敌人与猎物受惊。趁对方愣住，它用利爪攀住，贴近发出震耳尖叫，将其震昏。
author: infinex21
source: Embers scatter from between the cracks of its scales to startle foes and prey alike. While its foe is stunned, it will latch onto them with its talons and emit a deafening screech up close to knock them unconscious.

entry: POKENAME飞行时，翼鳞发出金属巨响，让其他宝可梦有机会逃走，因为POKENAME的三个头，会攻击下方地面上看见的一切。
author: .jerden
source: The scales on POKENAME's wings make loud, metallic noises as it flies. This gives other Pokémon a chance to flee, as POKENAME's three heads will attack anything it sees on the ground below it.

entry: POKENAME展开全部九条尾巴，让尾上鳞片鸣响，就表示准备作战。口中喷出的火焰，温度高得足以熔化金属。
author: fiordaliso
source: When POKENAME fans out all nine of its tails and makes the scales on them chime, it is a sign that it is ready for battle. The flames it breathes from its jaws can reach temperatures high enough to melt metal.

entry: POKENAME的身体披着岩石与金属构成的尖刺。它大声用尾巴敲击附近岩石，阻止入侵者进入领地；若警告被无视，就用同一条尾巴如棍棒般挥击。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's body is armored by sharp spikes made of rock and metal. It will deter intruders from entering its territory by loudly drumming its tail against nearby rocks, then swinging the same tail like a club if this warning is ignored.

entry: POKENAME曾试着把蜕鳞做成翅膀，用来飞行。虽然每次都失败，钢铁般坚硬的鳞片却能保护它，坠落时毫发无伤。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME have tried turning their shed scales into wings and flying with them. While these attempts always fail, the steel-hard scales protect them from taking any damage from the fall.

entry: POKENAME准备战斗时，尾上的金鳞会裹上烈焰。它顽强好斗，面对对手绝不逃跑。
author: fiordaliso
source: When POKENAME prepares for battle, the golden scales on its tail are wrapped in blazing flames. It is an extremely tenacious and combative Pokémon that never flees from an opponent.

entry: POKENAME蜷成车轮，高速滚行。摆尾、抖鳞调整方向，沿途金属鸣声嘈杂不绝。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are able to curl themselves up into a wheel to roll at incredible speeds. They rattle their scales and swing their tails to steer, creating a cacophony of clanging as they travel.

entry: POKENAME能用两足行走，平时偏爱四足，追猎物时才用后腿奔跑。年纪越大，越依赖四足行动，也会用锋利的颚配合爪子作战。
author: thesilverowls
