source: POKENAME are facultative bipeds, preferring to walk on all fours but chasing after prey on their hind legs. As POKENAME get older, they tend to rely even more on quadrupedal movement, using their sharp jaw as a weapon alongside their claws.

entry: POKENAME头上反光的鳞片，既防撞击，也遮日光，因为下方黏滑身体很容易干燥。虽常被认为无害，却能跃向敌人，撞出惊人的头锤。
author: .jerden
source: The reflective scales on POKENAME's head protect it from both physical impacts and sunlight, as the slimy body below dries out easily. Although it is often dismissed as harmless, it can leap up towards foes to headbutt them with surprising force.

entry: POKENAME头上反光的鳞片，既防撞击，也遮日光，因为下方黏滑身体很容易干燥。虽常被认为无害，却能跃向敌人，撞出惊人的头锤。
author: .jerden
source: The reflective scales on POKENAME's head protect it from both physical impacts and sunlight, as the slimy body below dries out easily. Although it is often dismissed as harmless, it can leap up towards foes to headbutt them with surprising force.

entry: POKENAME的四根触角，让它听觉敏锐。野外会借此寻找杖尾鳞甲龙群，再碰响自己的鳞片，说服对方接纳它加入。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's four antennas give it a keen sense of hearing. In the wild, it will use this to seek out groups of Kommo-o, then jangle its own scales to convince them to let it join their group.

entry: POKENAME碰响金属鳞片，吓退敌人。其余身体看似柔软，脂肪下却是结实肌肉，让POKENAME挥臂甩尾时力量惊人。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME clatters its metallic scales to frighten foes. Although the rest of its body seems soft, beneath a layer of fat is solid muscle, enabling POKENAME to swing its arms and tail with great force.

entry: POKENAME卷曲的尾巴硬如金属，能当棍棒挥舞。POKENAME通常避免战斗，行走时不断摇摆，让金属鳞片碰着身体，发出悦耳声，警告其他宝可梦远离。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's coiled tail is as hard as metal and can be swung around like a club. POKENAME mostly avoids combat and constantly sways as it moves to warn other Pokémon away using the musical sound of its metallic scales clinking against its body.

entry: POKENAME的鳞片能完美抵挡同一栖息地中许多可怕宝可梦的攻击。古代，出征的部落首领会戴上仿制这种样式的头饰。
author: atlas3339098
source: POKENAME's scales are a perfect defense from many fearsome Pokémon who share its habitat. In ancient times, an imitation of this headdress was worn by war chiefs who went to battle.

entry: POKENAME若太久不动，身体就会长出过多鳞片，妨碍行动、遮挡视线。它凶狠地将鳞片抛向敌人，既蜕去多余鳞片，也造成沉重钝击。
author: soup1900
source: If inactive for too long, POKENAME grows so many scales on its body that they start to get in its way and block its vision. It sheds these scales by viciously and aggressively chucking them at foes to deal heavy blunt damage to them.

entry: POKENAME用力抖动前臂，让引以为傲的金属鳞片大声相撞。炎热夏日，大群POKENAME的响声最远一英里外都听得见。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME shakes its front arms vigorously so the metallic scales it boasts clash together loudly. On hot summer days, the sound of hordes of POKENAME doing this can be heard up to a mile away.

entry: POKENAME群居于严寒山峰。危险宝可梦靠近，就会大声抖响鳞片，吓走对方。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME is found living in herds on the peaks of frigid mountains. When dangerous Pokémon approach, they rattle their scales loudly to scare them off.

entry: 每个冬季结束、回归北方时，POKENAME常蜕下较小的鳞片。不知为何，脱落多年仍保持冰冷，让许多人用来保存食物。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's smaller scales are often shed at the end of every winter cycle as it returns to northern lands. These scales somehow remain cold for years even after being shed, which led to many people using them to help preserve their foods.

entry: POKENAME的鳞片比钻石更坚硬。据说古代曾被用作部落的盾牌与铠甲，是珍贵的交易资源。
author: icecreeper720
source: POKENAME's scales are harder than diamonds, and in ancient times they were believed to have been used as tribal shields and armor, serving as a valuable trading resource.

entry: POKENAME的铠甲由密实金属鳞组成，覆盖大部分身体。受威胁时，会用爪反复敲鳞，响起喧天锣声，听得太久便会失聪。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME's armor consists of dense metallic scales that cover most of its body. When threatened, it will repeatedly strike its own scales with its claws, creating an uproar of gonging noises that will deafen anyone exposed to it for too long.

entry: POKENAME的鳞片需要勤于照料，才能保持闪亮，也展现训练家的用心。随心情不同，鳞片相撞既能奏出美妙旋律，也可能吵得可怕。
author: sara886a
source: It requires diligent care to maintain the shininess of POKENAME's scales, showing off the dedication of its Trainer. Depending on its mood, the clanging of its scales can make a beautiful melody or horrible cacophony.

entry: POKENAME的壳外观如镀金，曾被猎取，制作奢华张扬的甲胄。一位王族珍爱的POKENAME遭偷猎，引发激烈追捕后，这类行为很快就被禁止。
author: sk372
source: The gilded appearance of POKENAME's shell caused it to once be hunted as material for ostentatious armor pieces. Such an act was quickly outlawed, after a royal's prized POKENAME was poached, which sparked a furious manhunt.

entry: POKENAME在地下挖掘时，鳞片共鸣，远没到目的地就能听见。自己虽很吵，却不喜欢城市中的巨响。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can be heard long before they arrive at a location, as their scales resonate as they dig underground. Despite being quite noisy themselves, they do not like the loud sounds that can be found in urban environments.

entry: POKENAME身上会长出华贵纯金构成的鳞片与金块。古时的国王王后佩戴这种金打造的珠宝，象征无上的财富与权力。
author: soup1900
source: Scales and chunks made of pure, luxurious gold grow on the body of POKENAME. Kings and queens of long ago would wear jewelry forged from this gold, symbolizing their absolute wealth and power.

entry: 一部一千多年前的儿童剧，把反派POKENAME称为“狂暴之钹”，大概是因它飞过头顶时，响声如灾难般可怕。它能突然全身裹火，使出闪焰冲锋。
author: bobosmith01
source: A children's play dating back over a thousand years describes a villainous POKENAME as "The Savage Cymbal", likely due to the calamitous noise that plays as POKENAME flies overhead. It can suddenly become covered in fire and let loose a Flare Blitz.

entry: POKENAME挥舞一根带刺、覆鳞的棍棒，攻守兼用。谁碰撞到棍棒，都会响起叮当声，让POKENAME微笑：那正是POKENAME最开心的时候。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME wields a spiky, scale-covered club for both defense and offense. When someone collides into it, the club makes a jingle that makes POKENAME smile: that is when POKENAME is at its happiest.

entry: POKENAME自豪又欢快，领军打仗与主持庆典，都一样热情。不同节奏的鳞片鸣响，宣告开战或庆祝的开始。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are very prideful and joyful creatures, leading battles and festivals with the same passion. They will clang their scales together in different rhythms to signal the start of war or celebration.

entry: 一部一千多年前的儿童剧，把反派POKENAME称为“狂暴之钹”，大概是因它飞过头顶时，响声如灾难般可怕。它能突然全身裹火，使出闪焰冲锋。
author: bobosmith01
source: A children's play dating back over a thousand years describes a villainous POKENAME as "The Savage Cymbal", likely due to the calamitous noise that plays as POKENAME flies overhead. It can suddenly become covered in fire and let loose a Flare Blitz.

entry: 一部一千多年前的儿童剧，把反派POKENAME称为“狂暴之钹”，大概是因它飞过头顶时，响声如灾难般可怕。它能突然全身裹火，使出闪焰冲锋。
author: bobosmith01
source: A children's play dating back over a thousand years describes a villainous POKENAME as "The Savage Cymbal", likely due to the calamitous noise that plays as POKENAME flies overhead. It can suddenly become covered in fire and let loose a Flare Blitz.

entry: POKENAME奔跑时，鳞片碰撞如爆竹。若活火山将要喷发，就会跑过附近的人和宝可梦，提醒危险。
author: kittyluv090
source: As POKENAME runs, the clanging of its scales sounds like firecrackers. If an active volcano is about to erupt, it will run past nearby people and Pokémon to warn them.

entry: POKENAME胆小，常把半身埋进地里，伪装成岩石。不过，若有人想坐上去，它就会爆炸，把人赶下来。
author: seanothan_23
source: Due to their cowardly nature, POKENAME often bury themselves halfway in the ground to disguise themselves as a rock. However, when people try to sit on them, they resort to exploding to get people off them.

entry: POKENAME试图装得强大可怕，却常不成功。它会冲向领地内的入侵者，可对方只要稍露还手之意，就立刻掉头逃跑。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME tries and often fails to appear powerful and intimidating. It will try to charge down intruders in its territory, but the moment one shows even a hint of wanting to fight back, it immediately turns tail and runs away.

entry: 这只宝可梦外表坚硬、壳上带刺，却十分胆小。跑得太慢逃不掉，受威胁时就把头和四肢藏进壳，假装石头。
author: t3isukone
source: Despite its tough appearance and spiky shell, this Pokémon is very cowardly. It's too slow to run away, so when it feels threatened, it hides its limbs and head inside its shell and pretends to be a rock.

entry: POKENAME十分胆小，逃跑前会用翅膀散出一小团鳞粉。它连可能与其他宝可梦接触都十分抗拒，因此只在清晨外出授粉。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is very timid, scattering small clouds of scales with its wings before fleeing. Due to it hating any threat of interaction with other Pokémon, it only goes out pollinating in the early morning.

entry: POKENAME极其胆小，但若受威胁太大，也会用锋利得可怕的镰状爪攻击。不过，通常稍有危险迹象就飞快逃走。
author: evilgammon
source: While being extremely timid, POKENAME will lash out with its wickedly sharp, scything claws if threatened too greatly. However, it usually zips away at the slightest sign of danger.

entry: POKENAME站得高大威武，展示粗壮双臂与剃刀般锋利的角，威吓袭击者。其实它极易受惊，威吓一失败，就会尽快逃跑。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME stands tall and imposing, flexing its muscular arms and razor-sharp horns to intimidate attackers. It's extremely skittish, however, running away as fast as it can if its intimidation tactic fails.

entry: POKENAME连最肮脏的水域也能生活。它胆小，受惊时会害怕地以惊人速度游走。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME can be found living in even the dirtiest bodies of water. It has a cowardly nature, and swims away in fear at incredible speeds when startled.

entry: 坚固的壳与不错的弹跳能力，让POKENAME能轻松逃过捕食。若跳跃时意外落到活物身上，会惊慌地从爪尖释放毒素，再跳走。
author: sk372
source: A solid shell and decent leaping ability lets POKENAME handily escape predation. If it accidentally lands on a living creature when leaping, it delivers poison from the tips of its claws in a panic before jumping away once more.

entry: POKENAME极其焦虑，尤其担心毒针可能伤到人或宝可梦。刺中什么后，就会大哭，飞回蜂巢，伤心地睡上一觉。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is incredibly anxious, especially about possibly injuring people or Pokémon with its stingers. After it stabs something, it cries profusely and flies off to its hive to take a sadness nap.

entry: POKENAME好奇却容易受惊，跟踪时一被发现，就立刻瞬间移动离开。传送后会留下一小团毒粉，阻止对方追来。
author: sk372
source: Curious yet jumpy, POKENAME immediately teleports away if something spies it following them. Its teleportation leaves behind a small cloud of poison dust to deter attempts at pursuing it.

entry: POKENAME极容易受惊，除非确定没有其他生物，通常都不离开树内的巢。外出时若有什么靠近，就会扇出令人不适的翼上绒毛，帮助逃脱。
author: sk372
source: Very easily frightened, POKENAME tends not to come out of its nest inside trees unless it's certain no other creatures are about. If something approaches while it's out, it flaps up irritating fluff from its wings to help it escape.

entry: POKENAME夜里成群来到柿仔果树，趁黑取食。陌生东西靠近，就尖声鸣叫，让整个群体四散逃走。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME flocks at night to Persim Berry trees, feeding under cover of dark. If anything unfamiliar approaches, it hoots sharply to send the group scattering.

entry: POKENAME多疑紧张，总四下张望，寻找潜在危险。若被成功吓到，逃跑与直接昏倒的概率一样大。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a paranoid and twitchy species, always looking to and fro for potential dangers. If something manages to frighten it, it has an equal chance of fleeing or fainting outright.

entry: POKENAME大耳朵让听觉敏锐，一听到其他宝可梦靠近就迅速逃跑。它太胆小，不敢捕猎，只能捡食能找到的任何可食之物维生。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's large ears give it a keen sense of hearing, and it is quick to flee as soon as it hears another Pokémon approaching. Since it is too cowardly to hunt prey, POKENAME survives by scavenging anything edible it can find.

entry: POKENAME是捡食为生的害兽，会翻垃圾找食物。听觉极强，又十分多疑，哪怕极轻微的意外声响，也会让它逃离现场。
author: bobosmith01
source: A scavenging pest, POKENAME will root through trash to find food. It has incredible hearing; its paranoia will cause it to flee the scene at even the slightest unpredictable sound.

entry: POKENAME住在蕉香果树上，用长尾摘果。若被发现，就会惊慌地在树冠间荡走逃脱。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME lives in Nanab Berry trees, picking fruit with its long tail. If spotted, it panics and swings away through the canopy to escape.

entry: 后院花园会引来大群POKENAME，吃掉杂草与入侵植物的嫩芽。感应灯一闪，它们就会尖叫着四散奔逃。
author: .izik
source: Backyard gardens attract swarms of POKENAME, who devour weeds and invasive sprouts. The flash of a motion-activated light sends them screeching in every direction.

entry: POKENAME躲在树间，迅速从树皮孔洞钻出，吃树果，偶尔也吃小虫。只有受惊逃跑才会飞，速度快得离谱。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME hides among the trees, scuttling quickly out from holes in the bark to feed on berries and occasionally small bugs. It only flies to retreat when it's startled, and does so at ludicrously high speed.

entry: POKENAME覆着黏滑凝胶，几乎抓不住。凝胶还能麻痹感觉，很久以前曾用作麻醉剂。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME is covered in a slimy gel that makes it almost impossible to grab. The gel also numbs feeling, so it was used long ago as an anaesthetic.

entry: 夜里，POKENAME格外细心地啄下建筑墙壁上的霉菌。路灯突然亮起，就会尖叫飞走。
author: .izik
source: By night, POKENAME pecks mold off building walls with surprising care. Sudden light from streetlamps causes it to shriek and take flight.

entry: POKENAME长时间晒太阳，让坚固壳上的甲片干燥硬化，保护下方种子。它十分害羞，一听巨响，就立刻躲进附近灌木。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME rests for long periods under the sun to dry and harden the plates of its sturdy shell, protecting the seed underneath. It is very shy, so if it hears a loud noise, it immediately seeks refuge in nearby bushes.

entry: POKENAME默默吸食树液，只有觉得四下无人时才出来。哪怕察觉一点动静，也会立刻消失在灌木丛。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME feeds on tree sap in silence, venturing out only when it believes it's alone. At the faintest sign of movement, it vanishes into the underbrush.

entry: POKENAME用形状奇特的尾巴当临时铲子挖洞，藏在地下。若有人查看或扰动洞穴，就会跳出，狠狠咬上一口，注入毒液。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME hides in holes it makes in the ground by using its unusually shaped tail as a makeshift shovel. If the hole is investigated or tampered with, it springs out and strikes with a venomous bite.

entry: 无论如何苦练，POKENAME在战斗中都弱得可怜。不过反应很快，大多数冲突都能在开打前避开。
author: mistymagius
source: No matter how hard it trains, POKENAME is completely pathetic in battle. However, due to its quick reaction time, it can avoid most encounters before a fight breaks out.

entry: POKENAME害羞易惊，稍受刺激就逃跑。瞬间移动离开时，会留下毒烟云，削弱受影响者的肌肉，让追赶更加困难。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is shy and easily startled, fleeing at the slightest provocation. When it teleports away, it leaves behind a cloud of poisonous smoke that weakens the muscles of those afflicted, making pursuing it more difficult.

entry: POKENAME摆出凶狠架势，可一旦不敌，就会蜷缩身体，狼狈逃走。虽有铠甲与毒刺，在野外仍以无可救药的胆小鬼闻名。
author: eiskitsune
source: POKENAME puts on a fearsome display, but the moment it's outmatched, it folds in on itself and flees in disgrace. Despite its armour and poisoned spikes, it's known as a hopeless coward in the wild.

entry: 矛盾的是，这只宝可梦要么像胆小虫一样极其懦弱，要么像大牙狸一样有钢铁般的胆量。研究员正在调查，哪一种性格在POKENAME中更常见。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Paradoxically, this Pokémon will have either the extremely cowardly disposition of Wimpod or the nerves of steel of Bidoof. Researchers are currently conducting a survey to see which personality is more prevalent in POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME胆小善躲，见到危险就飞奔藏起。外壳还柔软、尚未发育完全，面对重击毫无防御力。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME is skittish and evasive, and will sprint to hide at the sight of danger. Its shell is still soft and developing, leaving it defenseless against a powerful blow.

entry: POKENAME十分胆小，一见危险迹象就想藏身。可体型太大，很难藏好，野外受惊的POKENAME，常只把头和脖子塞进巨石下或地洞里。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are cowardly Pokémon, prone to hiding themselves away at the first signs of danger. Their size makes this difficult, and spooked POKENAME in the wild can be found with just their head and neck wedged under boulders or in holes in the ground.

entry: POKENAME用触须拿食物、清理巢穴，仔细得大多数人都觉得一丝不苟。它意志薄弱，一有麻烦就逃，哪怕必须丢下巢也在所不惜。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME use their feelers to retrieve food and to keep their dens clean, to a degree that most would call meticulous. They are weak-willed and flee at the first sign of trouble, even if it means abandoning their dens.

entry: POKENAME会躲开任何看起来比自己更自信的宝可梦。若藏不住，就扭曲空间，加快撤退，把前方地面折叠起来，缩短需要跑的距离。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME hide from any Pokémon that appears more confident than they are. If they are unable to remain hidden, they distort space itself to expedite their retreat, folding the ground in front of them to shorten the distance they need to run.

entry: POKENAME摆出可怕利爪，试图吓退敌人。若不成功，POKENAME便从炮管喷气，把自己弹飞到安全处。
author: oddwalls
source: POKENAME attempts to ward off foes by posturing with its fearsome claws. If this fails, POKENAME releases a burst of air from its cannon and sends itself flying to safety.

entry: POKENAME格外害羞，避开训练家，喜欢住在荒废地带。废弃建筑中能发现它们，常聚在屋顶。受打扰，就靠轻盈身体乘风飘走。
author: katieplaysgames
source: An unusually shy Pokémon, POKENAME avoids Trainers and prefers to live in abandoned areas. It can be found in derelict buildings and tends to congregate on rooftops. When disturbed, it uses its light body to float away on the wind.

entry: POKENAME大部分时间躲在巢里，确定四下无人，才会离开。速度却出奇地快，眨眼间就能把自己埋进沙下。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME hides in its den most of the time, only leaving once it's sure there is no one there. It is surprisingly quick, able to bury itself underneath the sand within a blink of an eye.

entry: POKENAME的壳坚固得惊人，冶金学家推测，可能由一种早已绝迹的古老金属构成。它一感到敌意，就想赶紧爬走，可身体实在缓慢，反而因此陷入不利。
author: beatdoof
source: POKENAME's body is made of surprisingly sturdy shells, which metallurgists speculate may be a since-extinct metal from an ancient past. It prefers to skitter away from any perceived aggression, much to its very slow-moving body's detriment.

entry: POKENAME成小群生活，轻巧甲壳让它能随潮漂流。因害怕捕食者，便躲在浅潮池，只吃冲进来的海藻。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME lives in small clusters, its lightweight carapace allowing it to float with the tide. It hides in shallow tidepools, only feeding on seaweed that washes in due to its fear of predators.

entry: POKENAME从家电偷取少量电力为食。进食时若被发现，就立刻逃跑，沿途迸出一小串串火花。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME feeds on small bits of electricity siphoned from household appliances. If spotted in the act of feeding it retreats immediately, spreading small bursts of sparks as it runs.

entry: POKENAME仗着坚硬带刺的壳，大胆追逐、骚扰视野中的一切。可目标一旦反击，便不复逞强，尖叫着旋入土中逃走。
author: pjporwoll
source: Thanks to its tough and spiked shell, POKENAME fearlessly chases down and harasses anything that enters its field of view. Despite its bravado, the moment its quarry fights back, it gives a shrill cry and spins into the soil to escape.

entry: POKENAME住在浅溪与沼泽，藏身泥下。受惊时，会先释放微弱电击，再迅速游走。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME lives in shallow creeks and marshes, burying itself underneath the mud. When startled, it releases a weak shock before swiftly swimming away.

entry: POKENAME藏在荒废海滩，吃能找到的残渣。它相当顽强，靠极少的食物也能撑上数周。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME hides away on abandoned beaches, feeding on any scraps it can find. It's quite the hardy Pokémon, able to survive on very little food for weeks on end.

entry: POKENAME热爱舞蹈，会在隐蔽巢穴练习，例如森林灌木间或建筑里少人经过的角落。若发现有人观看，就会尖叫，羞窘地逃走。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME adores dancing and practices this skill in hidden dens, whether in the underbrush of forests or in less traversed spots in buildings. If it sees anyone watching it dance, it screams and scampers off in embarrassment.

entry: POKENAME胆小，稍有动静就跑，途中喷出诱人香粉，分散捕食者注意。可香味太好闻，人们反而故意吓它，收集香气。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME's cowardice leads it to flee at the slightest disturbance. It sprays a powder with an enticing aroma to distract predators as it runs away, but the pleasantness of the smell has led to people scaring POKENAME to harvest the scent.

entry: 野外被拦住时，POKENAME会惊慌地快速振翅，把云朵般的绒毛撒得四处都是。若慌过头，匆忙逃跑时，甚至可能掉光翼上绒毛。
author: sk372
source: If confronted in the wild, POKENAME will panic and flap its wings rapidly, spreading cloud-like fluff everywhere. If it panics too much, it may lose all the fluff on its wings in its haste to escape.

entry: POKENAME通常沿海滩寻找食物。平时胆小得不敢战斗，头上的壳一被碰，却会暴怒。
author: spider26
source: POKENAME can typically be seen scouring beaches for food. While normally too cowardly to fight, this Pokémon will become enraged when the shell on its head is touched.

entry: POKENAME极其胆小，会脱落蘑菇防御。蘑菇虽然无毒，吃下的生物却会被恐惧与多疑淹没。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is incredibly timid and will shed its mushrooms as a defense mechanism. While the mushrooms are not toxic, anything that eats them will be overcome with fear and paranoia.

entry: POKENAME每晚搜寻一处海岸，寻找刚冲上岸的海藻等冰凉食物。若被看起来凶狠的野生宝可梦突然吓到，就会立刻逃走，身后留下一阵寒风。
author: andromeda102037
source: POKENAME scour over a single shoreline a night in search of cold food, such as recently washed-up seaweed. If caught off guard by wild Pokémon that look threatening, they will immediately flee, leaving behind a frigid gust of wind in their wake.

entry: POKENAME用四条腿迅速逃离战斗。触须能感知五英里开外的一切，因此野外极难见到。
author: dukefrogpeasant
source: POKENAME use their four legs to quickly flee from battles. Their feelers can sense anything from over five miles away, so it is very rare to see one in the wild.

entry: POKENAME的壳硬如钢铁，爪子能切开坚岩。力气虽惊人，却胆小得很，连轻易就能赢的战斗也会逃走。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME's shell is as hard as steel, their claws able to slice through solid rock. Despite their impressive strength, these Pokémon are huge cowards, fleeing from battles they could easily win.

entry: POKENAME极容易受惊，稍有声响或动静就跑。它用刚毛状的细毛过滤水，吃水中的微生物。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are incredibly skittish, fleeing at the slightest noise or movement. They feed on tiny microorganisms in the water, filtering the water through their bristle-like hairs.

entry: POKENAME住在河流、湖泊等水底的泥中。极其胆小，冒头查看周围时很少久留，一看见附近有别的生物，就立刻缩回去。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME lives in the mud underneath rivers, lakes, and the like. Extremely timid, it rarely pops up for long to survey its surroundings, disappearing back below the minute it spies another creature nearby.

entry: POKENAME渴望变强，虽害怕，仍不停寻找对手战斗。它会试着挑战体型更大的敌人，可一受伤，就赶紧逃跑。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME desire to become stronger and always seek out opponents to fight despite their fears. While they try to take on opponents larger than themselves, they quickly run away if they get injured.

entry: POKENAME大部分时间都待在坚韧的壳里，始终恐惧周围世界。只有钓取食物，或训练家与它交好、让它安心时，才会出壳。
author: evilgammon
source: Spending most of its time in its resilient shell, POKENAME lives in constant fear of the world around it. It only leaves its shell when fishing for food or if a Trainer befriends and gets it to feel safe.

entry: POKENAME藏在珊瑚礁中，耐心等猎物直接游进嘴里。不过它胆小得很，遇上任何比自己大的宝可梦，都会慌忙游走。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME hides in coral reefs, patiently waiting for prey to swim directly into it mouth. However, it is incredibly timid and will frantically swim away if it encounters any Pokémon bigger than it.

entry: POKENAME珍爱大葱武器，可一感到危险，就会尖叫着把葱扔向自认的威胁，再飞走。冷静后又后悔丢了葱，偷偷回来寻找。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME loves its leek weapon but the moment it feels in danger, it shrieks, flings the leek at the perceived threat, and flies away. Once it calms down, it regrets throwing the leek, so it sneaks back to find it.

entry: POKENAME沿昏暗海岸安静地聚成小群取食。哪怕一根树枝折断的声音，也能让整群慌忙逃进海沫中。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME gathers in quiet clusters along dark shorelines to feed. Even the snapping of a twig can send the entire group scrambling into the sea foam.

entry: 坚硬的外骨骼挨打时，POKENAME会分泌毒孢子防御。它性情平和，尽量避免不必要的战斗。
author: fiordaliso
source: When its hard exoskeleton is hit, POKENAME secretes poisonous spores as a defense. Due to its calm nature, it tries to avoid unnecessary fighting.

entry: POKENAME每条腿都有特殊反射，受伤时便会发动，促使它蜷成球滚走，逃离危险。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME has a special reflex in each of its legs that helps it escape danger. This reflex activates whenever it gets hurt, prompting it to escape by curling into a ball and rolling away.

entry: POKENAME的大爪坚硬如石，能粉碎矿物，挖穿基岩。坚固外骨骼能保护它，抵御地下的极端温度。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's large claws are as hard as stone, capable of crushing minerals and tunneling through bedrock. Its tough exoskeleton protects it from intense temperatures underground.

entry: 最近，人们在西达岛附近发现一群POKENAME。游轮靠近时，它们会嬉戏般相互切磋，向观看的游客炫耀。
author: .izik
source: A school of POKENAME was recently sighted near Sayda Island. When cruise ships approach, they spar playfully with each other to impress watching tourists.

entry: POKENAME从爪中射出泡泡，震晕捕食者。若难以招架，就会放出浓黑墨云，再高速逃走。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME shoots bubbles from its claws to stun predators. If overwhelmed, it releases clouds of dark ink before fleeing at high speed.

entry: POKENAME劈斩鱼宝可梦，检验爪子的威力。胜利后，头上的角会满足地泛起粉光，持续数小时。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME slashes at fish Pokémon to test its claws. After victory, the horn on its head glows pink in satisfaction for several hours.

entry: POKENAME以两只披甲的爪作盾防守，用镰状爪攻击。大翅膀让它极其敏捷，绕着对手疾行，攻击盲区。
author: actliux
source: POKENAME uses its two armored claws as shields to defend itself, while using its scythe-like claws to attack. It is incredibly agile thanks to its large wings, dashing around its opponents to hit their blind spots.

entry: POKENAME的壳坚固无比，保护身体免遭强力攻击。它稳住身体扛下打击，再向前冲锋，用角逼退任何威胁。
author: msdawgs
source: POKENAME has an incredibly tough shell that shields its body from powerful attacks. It braces itself against blows before charging forward, using its horns to drive back anything that threatens it.

entry: 这种顶尖捕食者大部分身体覆着甲片，很少落败。POKENAME误把船只当猎物，用强颚击穿船壳，对船只构成巨大威胁。
author: fireblade141
source: This apex predator is very rarely defeated due to the armor plating on most of its body. POKENAME is a huge threat to ships since it mistakes them for prey and punches through their hulls with its mighty jaws.

entry: POKENAME极其温柔聪明，曾被用来探索冰冷海域的偏远岛屿。年纪越大，背鳞就越厚越坚硬。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is an extremely gentle and intelligent creature that was once used to explore remote islands in frozen waters. The older it grows, the thicker and tougher the scales on its back become.

entry: POKENAME看见鼠标指针滑过网页，就会将其当作猎物，用水流喷射攻击。这种行为磨炼了反应与战斗反射。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME notices a mouse cursor drifting across a webpage, it attacks it as though it were prey by use of its Aqua Jet. This behavior sharpens its reactions and combat reflexes.

entry: 史前时期，POKENAME会挑战镰刀盔，展开残酷决斗，检验实力，巩固自己对领地的支配。
author: .izik
source: In prehistoric times, POKENAME would challenge Kabutops to brutal duels. These fights were used to test its strength and enforce its dominance over its territory.

entry: POKENAME会带领小群宝可梦，其中也有格外信任的伙伴。它似乎极其憎恨头盖梦，双方经常激烈争斗。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME are known to lead small packs of Pokémon, even having some they trust more than others. They seem to deeply hate Crantwo and regularly have intense rivalries with them.

entry: POKENAME在洞口织漏斗状蛛网，藏在崎岖的入口，等猎物走进来。咬伤带毒，战斗时会迅速扑咬一口，再退后等待毒发。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME weave funnel webs at the mouths of caves, hiding within the craggy entrance for prey to wander in. Their bite is venomous; in combat they dart forward to deliver a swift bite before retreating and waiting for their poison to work.

entry: POKENAME触角内的紫色液体，像电池一样储存大量电力。它与同类切磋，释放强烈电流，检验蓄电的威力。
author: .izik
source: The purple liquid filling POKENAME's antennae stores large amounts of electricity like batteries. It tests the strength of this charge by sparring with others of its kind using powerful bursts.

entry: POKENAME捕猎时，触角的红色尖端会发亮。爪状鳍能毫不费力地撕开厚船壳。
author: .izik
source: The red tips of POKENAME's antennae glow while hunting. Its claw-like fins can tear through thick hulls without resistance.

entry: POKENAME飞行能力极强，先在海面上空高飞，再俯冲扑向看见的猎物。光滑羽毛与强大力量，让它连海豚大小的猎物也能带走。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME is an incredibly strong flier. It hunts by soaring high above the ocean's surface before diving onto any prey they see. Its slick feathers and high strength allow it to carry away even dolphin-sized prey.

entry: POKENAME在沼泽交战时，会向对手泼泥。保持最干净的一方获胜，赢得当地领地的使用权。
author: .izik
source: In swamp battles, POKENAME splashes opponents with mud. The one who stays cleanest is declared the winner and gains local territory rights.

entry: POKENAME吃下废物与沼泽植物，产生强效毒液。毒性最强的个体，凭这份化学力量成为群体首领。
author: .izik
source: By eating waste and swamp plants, POKENAME develops potent venom. The most toxic individual becomes leader of its school through chemical strength.

entry: POKENAME一与同类对上目光，就会战到一方昏迷为止。凭自我再生，连足以击倒大多数生物的重击也能撑过。
author: .izik
source: If POKENAME locks eyes with another of its kind, it fights until one is unconscious. Its ability to Recover lets it survive blows that would fell most others.

entry: 意见不合时，POKENAME会以高压水柱对决。胜者决定群体下一步行动，其他成员毫无异议。
author: .izik
source: When disagreements arise, POKENAME duels by firing high-pressure water jets. The victor decides the group's next move without question.

entry: POKENAME的触手强大，是难缠的对手，却喜欢一见危险就躲好，或借墨云喷射逃走。不过，铠甲让捕食者很少，这些手段也很少用得上。
author: pjporwoll
source: While POKENAME is a formidable opponent due to its powerful tentacles, it prefers to hunker down in a hiding spot or jet away in a cloud of ink at the first sign of danger. These actions are rarely necessary as its armor means it has few predators.

entry: POKENAME是伏击猎手，有许多手段杀死被盯上的不幸生物：用披甲的身体盘卷压碎、以爪劈斩，或用毒咬杀死猎物。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME is an ambush predator packing numerous ways to kill any unfortunate creature it decides to hunt, such as crushing prey in its armored coils, slashing them with its claws, and poisoning them with its bite.

entry: POKENAME力量惊人，一次猛挥就能劈开海水。壳硬如钻石，只有同样强大的宝可梦才能打伤。它们住在沉船中，常与破破舵轮交战。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME are overwhelmingly powerful; with one mighty swing, they can cleave through seawater. With shells as tough as diamond, only an equally powerful Pokémon can damage them. They are known to inhabit sunken ships, often battling Dhelmise.

entry: POKENAME夜间活动，会从海面下浮起袭击船只，悄悄将人逐个拖下水。之后如何对待受害者，尚不清楚。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME is nocturnal and is known for attacking boats by rising up from below the ocean's surface and secretly dragging people overboard one by one. What it does with its victims is unknown.

entry: 它在水下冥想，即使保持警觉，也会静止不动。等毫无防备的猎物经过，才以惊人速度扑出，叼着新到手的食物退回。
author: bobosmith01
source: It spends its time underwater meditating. However, even when alert, it remains still until unsuspecting prey passes by, where it will then lunge out at incredible speeds before retreating with this new food in its mouth.

entry: POKENAME的爪能轻易捏碎巨石。它住在泥中，有东西靠近巢穴，就会猛然钻出。风暴时，POKENAME会把蛋搬到沉船中，研究员正进一步研究这种行为。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME's claws have the ability to crush boulders with ease. They live in mud, bursting out when something gets close to their nests. During storms, POKENAME will move their eggs to shipwrecks; this behavior is being further studied by researchers.

entry: 据说POKENAME的耐心与智慧，抵得上四十多人之和。它久居深海，很少移动。脑部扫描显示，即使静止，也在进行激烈而复杂的思考。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is said to possess the patience and wisdom of over forty men combined. It lives a sedentary life deep under the ocean's surface. Brain scans reveal that, even when still, it is engaged in intense and complex thought.

entry: POKENAME通过冥想，增强对波导的感知。战斗时纹丝不动，直到挨攻击，才完美反击，用巨爪回敬毁灭性重击。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME's mediation allows it to heighten its abilities to sense aura. In battle, it remains completely motionless until attacked, at which point it will counterattack perfectly and deal a devastating strike in return with those massive claws.

entry: 这种凶猛宝可梦住在地表洞穴，领地意识极强。闯入家中者，会被它扑倒，用全部六只爪撕成碎片。
author: fireblade141
source: This ferocious Pokémon inhabits surface-level caves. It is fiercely territorial, and anyone who intrudes upon its home will find themselves pounced upon and shredded to bits by every one of its six claws.

entry: POKENAME是住在珊瑚礁的捕食者。动作虽慢，强颚却能咬碎岩石，因此专找逃不掉的带壳宝可梦，巨颚轻易就能将壳咬开。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME is a predator that makes its home in coral reefs. Though it is slow, its powerful jaws can crush rock, so it seeks out prey that can't run away from it: shelled Pokémon, which those massive jaws have no problem breaking open.

entry: POKENAME成群随洋流漂动。若两只接触过久，就会突然爆发激烈交锋，争夺主导地位。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME drifts in ocean currents while clustered. If two touch for long periods, they clash in sudden, fierce bursts of energy to establish dominance.

entry: POKENAME会伺机捡食，沿海底爬行，寻找沉下的尸体吃。若遇上较小的宝可梦，也会以惊人速度攻击，用末端带爪的触手刺穿猎物。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME are opportunistic scavengers that crawl along the seafloor looking for sunken carcasses to eat. If they come across any smaller Pokémon, they will lash out with surprising speed and pierce their prey upon their claw-tipped tentacles.

entry: POKENAME密实的外壳，能轻易弹开大多数投射物。它在蜿蜒沼泽水道中游动，潜伏水面下，跟踪毫无防备的猎物。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's dense outer shell can deflect most projectiles with ease. It swims through winding bayous, lurking beneath the surface as it stalks unsuspecting prey.

entry: POKENAME与对手撞头，检验实力。之后还会用利爪攻击，一次干脆的挥斩，就能劈开钨。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME rams heads with rivals to test strength. Afterward, it strikes with claws sharp enough to cleave tungsten in a single clean swipe.

entry: POKENAME顶着覆铁的头，沿海底猛冲。它吞食珊瑚礁，压碎藏在碎屑中的猎物。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME barrels along the seafloor with its iron-plated head. It devours coral reefs and crushes prey hidden among the debris.

entry: 这种温和的巨兽以滤食维生，只在受挑衅时攻击。天生庞大，又有甲片，让它游得缓慢，却也很难被捕食者击倒。
author: fireblade141
source: This gentle giant is a filter feeder that will only attack when provoked. Its natural bulk, combined with its armor plating, makes it a sluggish swimmer, but difficult for predators to take down.

entry: POKENAME的背部如潮池，是胆小虫的理想藏身处。平时温顺，可小伙伴一受威胁，就会变得极其好斗。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME's back serves as a tide pool providing an ideal place for Wimpod to take shelter. This Pokémon is typically docile, but if its smaller friends are threatened, it will become very aggressive.

entry: POKENAME切开残骸收集金属屑，展示为支配地位的战利品。其他POKENAME会挑战它，争夺这些碎屑。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME carves up debris to collect metal shavings, displaying them as dominance trophies. Other POKENAME will challenge it to claim the scraps.

entry: 它战斗凶猛又讲究策略，会与具甲小兵合作击败敌人。爪和刀刃都能像切纸一样，轻松切开橡胶与石头。
author: bobosmith01
source: It battles strategically yet ferociously, working in tandem with Goliard to defeat foes. Both its claws and blades can slice through rubber and stone as if it were paper.

entry: POKENAME战技出众，极其坚固的外骨骼如铠甲，抵挡敌人攻击。尾尖有一对利爪，能蓄电，打出最具破坏力的一击。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is an exceptional fighter, its extremely durable exoskeleton serving as armor that shields it from enemy attacks. At the tip of its tail, it bears a pair of sharp claws that it charges with electricity to deliver its most devastating blows.

entry: POKENAME战技出众，极其坚固的外骨骼如铠甲，抵挡敌人攻击。尾尖有一对利爪，能蓄电，打出最具破坏力的一击。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is an exceptional fighter, its extremely durable exoskeleton serving as armor that shields it from enemy attacks. At the tip of its tail, it bears a pair of sharp claws that it charges with electricity to deliver its most devastating blows.

entry: POKENAME远比外表温柔，会种下几棵树，或帮虫宝可梦筑巢，保护环境。捕猎时却不如此，任何看见的钢属性宝可梦，都会被它无情刺穿吞食。
author: beatdoof
source: POKENAME is far more gentle than it seems, protecting its environment by planting several trees or helping Bug Pokémon make their nests. This doesn't extend to its hunting behavior, mercilessly skewering and devouring any Steel Pokémon it sees.

entry: POKENAME快速振翅会产生轻微毒素，削弱受影响者的肌肉，让对方难以攻击它。这正合它温顺、爱好和平的性情。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's rapid wingbeat produces a mild toxin that weakens the muscles of those afflicted. This makes others unlikely to be able to attack it, which suits POKENAME's meek and pacifistic nature just fine.

entry: POKENAME的翅膀变成巨臂，再也飞不起来，让它十分沮丧。谁来打扰，就会被它砸下巨臂，用利爪刺穿，发泄不满。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME's wings have become massive arms that no longer allow for flight, which frustrates it. It takes out its frustration by slamming those arms down upon any that bother it, skewering them upon its sharp claws.

entry: 臂上甲片足以承受、弹开大多数攻击。它会保护其他生物，尤其是弱者，独自挡住威胁，让他们逃走。
author: infinex21
source: The platings of its arms are strong enough to endure and deflect most attacks. It shields others, especially those who are weak, and allows them to flee while it holds off any threats.

entry: POKENAME会帮助弱者，甚至救下受破破舵轮威胁的水手。外骨骼硬如钢铁，爪子能轻易劈开海水。大多数POKENAME终生未尝败绩。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME are known to help those weaker than themselves, even rescuing sailors threatened by Dhelmise. Their exoskeletons are tough as steel and their claws slice through seawater with ease. Most POKENAME go their entire lives without being defeated.

entry: POKENAME既能用六条腿爬行，也能用两条腿蹦跳。大耳朵动作快得出乎意料，力道足以粉碎混凝土。它还会旋转身体，以向心力进一步增强耳朵的砸击。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME can both skitter on six legs and hop about on two. Its large ears can move surprisingly fast for their size and are strong enough to pulverize concrete. It uses pirouettes to enhance the ears' smashing power further with centripetal force.

entry: POKENAME的双臂占去大部分体重，能击碎钻石，飞行时却拖在地上。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME's arms account for most of its bodyweight. They can break through diamond, but drag on the ground during flight.

entry: POKENAME住在偏远洞穴，冥想时会把坚实双翼折叠在身周，保护自己。战斗时，弯曲的翅膀能改变自身火焰的方向，将火喷向四处。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME lives in remote caves, where it can be found with its solid wings folded up around its body to protect it while it meditates. In battle, the curvature of the wings allows it to divert its own flames, spewing fire everywhere.

entry: POKENAME滚过海面，用爪切开猎物。旋转攻击能在几秒内摧毁整片珊瑚礁。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME rolls across the ocean's surface, slicing prey with its claws. Its spinning attacks can destroy entire coral reefs in seconds.

entry: POKENAME进化时，体内的壳会裂成许多尖刺，让内部细丝向外舒展。它用尖刺切开岩石和宝石，带回巢里囤积、取食。
author: beatdoof
source: The shell in POKENAME's body bursts upon evolution, splitting into various spikes and allowing its inner tendrils to spread out. It uses these spikes as a way to cut open rocks and gemstones and bring them back to its nest to hoard and eat.

entry: POKENAME的壳甲能扛住极强重击，连穿刺也仅能擦伤内里的躯体。它不满足于收集无生命的岩石和宝石，也会猎捕岩石与钢属性宝可梦。
author: beatdoof
source: POKENAME's shell armor can withstand especially powerful blows and even piercing strikes that barely graze through its inner body. Dissatisfied with just gathering inert rocks and gemstones, it also hunts Rock and Steel-type Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME沿海底行走，寻找各种双壳贝类吃，牙齿几乎瞬间就能将其撕开。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME walk on the ocean floor, trying to find any type of bivalve to consume. It can rip them apart with their teeth almost instantly.

entry: POKENAME成群在湖中切磋，打得水花翻沸。败得最多的成员会被逐出群体，被迫独居远方水域。
author: .izik
source: Schools of POKENAME spar in lakes, creating frothing water. The most defeated member is exiled from the group and forced to live alone in distant waters.

entry: POKENAME穿行沙漠，用眼镜保护双眼免遭风沙，喜欢收集一切自认为“酷”的东西。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME traverses through the desert, using its glasses to protect its eyes from sand. It likes to collect anything it considers "cool".

entry: 这种宝可梦能瞬间爆发出破坏力惊人的速度。POKENAME有时会不听命令，执意冲向敌人。
author: cyboobr
source: This Pokémon is capable of destructive bursts of speed. POKENAME has been known to ignore orders in favor of charging foes.

entry: 自古以来，POKENAME就凭厚甲与耐火凝胶鬃毛，成为顶尖捕食者和战士。它更爱安静地陪伴幼崽，但任何被视为威胁的生物，都会遭到猛烈攻击。
author: pjporwoll
source: Since ancient times, POKENAME has been an apex predator and combatant thanks to its thick armor plates and flame-resistant gel mane. It prefers to quietly spend time with its young but fiercely battles anything it deems a threat.

entry: POKENAME外表吓人，实际却出奇平和，大多数日子都在海下冥想。若受打扰，POKENAME会用强颚将敌人撕成碎片。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: In contrast to their intimidating looks, POKENAME are surprisingly peaceful. They spend most of their days meditating under the seas. If disturbed, POKENAME will tear their foes to shreds with their powerful jaws.

entry: POKENAME与同类相互撕咬、竞速，决定首领。选定之后，必须等一年才能再次挑战。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME bites and races others of its kind to determine leadership. Once a leader is chosen, it can only be challenged again one year later.

entry: POKENAME外表虽吓人，实际温柔亲近，尤其对自己的训练家。拥抱的力量，足以媲美穿着熊。
author: blindedcambion
source: Despite its appearance, POKENAME is quite kind and affectionate, especially towards its Trainer. Its hugs are strong enough to rival a hug from a Bewear.

entry: 这种深水宝可梦能静止多年，等待值得一战的对手。将头抵住胸口、四肢缩入体内，POKENAME就能化为披甲圆球，快速滚动。
author: milchik
source: This Pokémon that lives deep underwater can spend years motionless, waiting for a worthy opponent to challenge it. By pressing its head to the chest and drawing its limbs inside the body, POKENAME can turn itself into an armored fast-rolling sphere.

entry: POKENAME把大小相近的船锚错当对手，发起攻击。发现对方不会还手，就很快失去兴趣。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME attacks ship anchors similar in size, mistaking them for rivals. Once it realizes they don't retaliate, it quickly loses interest.

entry: POKENAME坚硬的甲壳挨打时，会渗出浓稠紫色毒液。光是气味，就足以赶走大多数捕食者。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's tough carapace oozes a thick purple toxin when struck. Its scent alone is enough to ward off most predators.

entry: POKENAME住在水下洞穴深处，壳坚固得连潜艇撞击也能承受。它往水中分泌少量毒素，驱赶入侵者。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME lives deep within underwater caves, where its shell can withstand even submarine collisions. It secretes faint toxins into the water to ward off intruders.

entry: POKENAME凶猛地占据沼泽水道，咬向任何胆敢靠近的生物。还会定期挑战同类，展开残酷决斗，证明支配地位。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME fiercely claims bayous as its territory, biting any who dare approach. It regularly challenges others of its kind to brutal duels to prove its dominance.

entry: 这种宝可梦比普通具甲武者更具流线形，能游出惊人速度。坚硬甲壳难以打伤，锋利带钩的爪则能撬开猎物的铠甲。
author: fireblade141
source: This Pokémon has a much more streamlined body than a regular Golisopod, allowing it to swim at surprising speed. Its tough carapace makes it hard to damage, while its sharp, hooked claws can pry apart armor off its prey.

entry: POKENAME的甲既能防护，又不太密实，行动轻便。它会主动捕猎，靠配色伪装潜近，再猛扑过去，用巨大锋利的双臂划出致命一击。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME's armor is protective but less dense, allowing for easy movement. This Pokémon is an active hunter; its coloration gives it camouflage, allowing it to get in close and then pounce to deal a fatal slash with its large, sharp arms.

entry: 这种宝可梦平时保存体力、潜心冥想，甲壳如铠甲，很少受到打扰，却能一拳打碎树。凡是认为值得的挑战，它都会接受，力量与技巧并重。
author: infinex21
source: Although this Pokémon usually conserves its strength and meditates, rarely disturbed due to its armor-like shell, it is able to shatter a tree with a single punch. It will accept any challenge it deems worthy, equally utilizing strength and skill.

entry: POKENAME有轻巧鳞片保护，会从暗处跃出，以利爪伏击敌人。若首击失手，或挨上重创，就会像现身时一样，迅速无声地退走。
author: .jerden
source: Protected by lightweight scales, POKENAME will leap from the shadows to ambush foes with its sharp claws. If this initial attack fails or if it takes a serious hit, it will retreat as quickly and as silently as it appeared.

entry: POKENAME会从暗处跃出，用能切开钢铁的刀刃伏击敌人。若首击失手，或挨上重创，就会像现身时一样，迅速无声地退走。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME will leap from the shadows to ambush foes with its blade, which is sharp enough to cut through steel. If this initial attack fails or if it takes a serious hit, it will retreat as quickly and as silently as it appeared.

entry: POKENAME平静地在水域游动，发现冲突就会漂远。若被迫交战，却也绝非弱手，众多手臂强得能轻松扔飞水箭龟。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME swims placidly in its waters, drifting away from conflict if spotted. If pushed into combat however, it's no slouch; its many arms have enough strength to hurl a Blastoise with ease.

entry: POKENAME反应快、性格讨喜，很受阿罗拉训练家欢迎。一些较大的POKENAME，还能让年幼训练家骑乘。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME is popular amongst Alolan Trainers both because of its rapid reaction time and its personable nature. Some larger POKENAME are able to be ridden by young Trainers.

entry: POKENAME既能飞过天空，也能游过海洋。强势个体为争夺资源，会激烈地互撞披甲的头，看看谁更坚硬。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME is capable of both flying through the air and swimming through the seas. Dominant individuals of the species will compete fiercely over resources, bashing their armored heads together to see who's tougher.

entry: POKENAME是炒菜大师。所有手臂同时开工，便能以人类厨师无法企及的速度，炒出美味佳肴。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME is a master stir-fry chef. Using all its arms at once, it can prepare an excellent stir fry at a speed unattainable to human chefs.

entry: 为选出首领，POKENAME会缠住彼此的触手，反复刺击。最后昏倒的一方，被拥为胜者。
author: .izik
source: To choose a leader, POKENAME wrap their tentacles and sting each other repeatedly. The last to fall unconscious is crowned the victor.

entry: POKENAME住在水下深洞，厚壳保护身体免受水压。每根触手末端，都有能伸缩的刺，分泌使人麻痹的毒液。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME live in deep underwater caverns, their thick shells protecting them from the water pressure. Each of their tentacles has a retractable spike at its tip that secretes a paralyzing venom.

entry: POKENAME天生重视领地，沿海底与海滩搜寻残渣取食。若被攻击，会变得极其凶狠；一旦获胜，也乐得吃掉被打倒的敌人。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME is a highly territorial scavenger by nature, combing the seafloor and beaches for detritus to consume. If attacked, it will become highly aggressive; if it emerges from this conflict the victor, it is happy to consume its felled foe.

entry: 它背上长出的叶片坚韧又可食，厨师会在战后采叶做菜。用叶子能做出类似卷心菜汤的料理，只要也给它一份点心，它就勉强接受。
author: quackquackattack
source: The leaves sprouting from its back are both tough and edible, so chefs harvest its leaves after a battle to cook with. A meal similar to cabbage soup is made out of its leaves, which it begrudgingly accepts if it also gets a treat.

entry: 它们从戴着三叶草冠的头部吐出光滑丝线，在森林地面爬行，寻找三叶草叶子，添到自己的冠上。
author: quackquackattack
source: They shoot a smooth silk from their heads, which is adorned with a crown of clovers. They scuttle across the forest floor to look for clover leaves to add to their crown.

entry: 它留下的球状部分会自然从主体脱落，不会造成伤害，味道像蒸西兰花。因此，食草动物走到哪儿都跟着，想吃上一口。
author: quackquackattack
source: It leaves behind bulbs that harmlessly fall away from the main body, which taste like steamed broccoli. As such, herbivores follow it around wherever it goes to secure a bite to eat.

entry: POKENAME握着的“骨头”，其实是干枯花茎。直接晒太阳，会让这件武器更加坚固。
author: dodoowner_
source: The 'bone' POKENAME holds is actually a dried-out flower stem. Direct exposure to sunlight makes the weapon more durable.

entry: POKENAME吸食骨髓，补充仅靠日光无法获得的营养。年纪渐长，叶子与藤蔓会开始吞没外面的头骨。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME feed on bone marrow for nutrients that they cannot gain through merely absorbing sunlight. As they grow older, their leaves and vines begin to subsume their outer skulls.

entry: 密密的粉色藤网覆盖身体。据说没人知道真容，却有许多人确信一定很美。POKENAME十分害羞，躲在灌木中，夜里才出来找食物。
author: fiordaliso
source: A dense net of pink vines covers its body. It is said that no one knows its true appearance, but many are convinced that it must be beautiful. As POKENAME is very shy, it hides in the bushes and comes out at night in search of food.

entry: POKENAME成大群一起晒太阳、休息，一只不管因何逃走，其他成员都会跟着逃。温暖季节结束时，POKENAME会趁夜迁往远方。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME live among one another, sunbathing and resting in expansive groups; if one flees for whatever reason, so will the rest of the group. POKENAME migrate to faraway lands during the night at the end of the warm season.

entry: POKENAME蜷起小睡时，像极了一朵盛开的花。这种模仿引来虫属性宝可梦，烦得POKENAME发起攻击。
author: pjporwoll
source: When POKENAME curls up to nap, it looks exactly like a blossoming flower. This mimicry attracts Bug-type Pokémon, annoying POKENAME into attacking.

entry: 温暖的日子，POKENAME会躺着晒太阳。有些收藏家声称这对进化有益，但有经验的照料者会听出，POKENAME在发出呼噜声，只是喜欢温暖的感觉。
author: drakon1c
source: POKENAME can be found lying in the sun on warm days. Some collectors claim that this enhances its evolution; however, a practiced caretaker will recognize that POKENAME is purring. It simply loves the warm feeling.

entry: 这种状态的POKENAME静止不动，让传粉者从叶片吸蜜。花粉辅助光合作用，加快生长，促使它走向进化。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME remains still in this state, allowing pollinators to sip nectar from its leaves. The pollen supplements its photosynthesis to accelerate its growth towards evolution.

entry: POKENAME以芒芒果为主食，似乎让精神力量更加有效。它难觅踪影，又极其谨慎，稍有沙沙声，就会退回所居丛林的深处。
author: fiordaliso
source: It seems that its Mago Berry-based diet helps POKENAME further enhance the effectiveness of its psychic powers. It is an extremely elusive and cautious Pokémon; at the slightest rustle, it retreats into the heart of the jungle where it lives.

entry: 白天，POKENAME以尾巴作浮标，潜在水下，再展开尾上的四片叶子，吸收阳光。
author: darkweavile428
source: During the day, POKENAME dives underwater using its tail as a buoy. It then opens the four leaves in its tail so that it can absorb sunlight.

entry: POKENAME用灵巧的牙啃食树果。吃饱后，会释放备受喜爱的宜人香气，因此许多想闻香的人家都会养它。
author: blaizegamer
source: POKENAME use their nimble teeth to gnaw at berries. After they are satiated, they release a pleasant aroma appreciated by many; therefore, they are found at households who wish for their scent.

entry: POKENAME只吃一种含有全部所需微量营养素的海藻，其余养分则从海水中自然吸收。若被迫吃别的东西，头顶就会开始散发难闻气味。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME only eat a certain type of seaweed which contains all the micronutrients they need, the rest they absorb passively through seawater. If they are forced to eat something else, the tip of their head begins to smell unpleasant.

entry: 它夜里飞来飞去，白天落地，从爪中伸根，吸收土壤养分。受打扰时，会先尖叫，再次飞走。
author: .izik
source: It flies around at night, then lands during the day and extends roots from its talons to absorb nutrients from the soil. If disturbed, it will screech loudly before taking flight again.

entry: POKENAME漂过花田，小心切下即将凋败花朵的茎，编成花环，送给疲惫旅人。舒缓香气，能帮助他们恢复精神。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME drift through flower fields while carefully slicing the stems of flowers about to decay. They weave these flowers into chains and offer them to weary travelers, granting them a soothing aroma to help restore their energy.

entry: POKENAME的小叶翼受损后都会再生，这十分有用，因为虫属性宝可梦很爱啃它的翅膀。休息时吊在树枝上，就能让它们够不到。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have small leafy wings that grow back whenever they get damaged. This is quite handy because Bug-type Pokémon love to chew on their wings. Hanging from tree branches prevents Bug-type Pokémon from reaching their wings while they rest.

entry: 它咬下灌木，供腹中的火燃烧。吃的叶子决定火色，从鲜橙色到诡异的绿色都有。
author: .izik
source: It bites chunks off of bushes to fuel the fire in its belly. The leaves it eats determine the color of its flames, ranging from bright orange to eerie green.

entry: 白天，这些宝可梦蜷成与花朵无异的模样，睡着吸收太阳能量。入夜后，就能悄悄爬进毫无防备的鸟宝可梦巢中，吞食鸟蛋。
author: b3llda1zora
source: During the day, these Pokémon curl up to look identical to flowers. As they sleep, they absorb the sun's energy so that when night falls, they can slither up to unsuspecting bird Pokémon's nests and consume their eggs.

entry: 白天，POKENAME休息蓄能，为夜晚准备。天黑后，释放甜香，引来毫无戒备的切磋对象。每次出拳都会散香，吸引更多对手。
author: afilthycasual
source: During the day, POKENAME rests, storing energy to prepare for the night. After dark, it wafts a sweet aroma to lure in unsuspecting sparring partners. Each punch spreads the scent, attracting more foes.

entry: POKENAME上午睡在阳光下，用尾巴紧紧抱着训练家。因此，它很受爱睡懒觉的夜猫子欢迎。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME spend their mornings sleeping in sunlight, holding their Trainers tight in their tails. This has caused POKENAME to become popular among night owls who enjoy sleeping in.

entry: POKENAME以咒语之力，让枯萎花园重新美丽生长。因此，常与宝可梦巡护员搭档，修复被激战破坏的自然环境。
author: opossiblymage
source: POKENAME uses the power of their incantations to help withered gardens grow beautifully. For this reason, they are commonly partnered with Pokémon Rangers to help restore natural environments that were destroyed from fierce battles.

entry: POKENAME整天模仿剑术大师，练习运用刀刃般的双手。不过十分笨拙，复杂招式经常做不成。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME spends its days attempting to master wielding its blade like hands by mimicking master swordsmen. It is very clumsy however and often fails its complex manoeuvres.

entry: 它握着棍子，整夜守望水坝周围。若附近响起尖声哀号，不是有入侵者，就是某个同伴弄丢了棍子。
author: quackquackattack
source: It holds onto a stick and monitors the area around its dam during a nightly vigil. If a high-pitched wail is heard nearby, it either means an intruder is nearby, or one of its cohorts has lost its stick.

entry: POKENAME挥动刃状叶片，会释放舒缓香气，隐约像零余果。这气味常在战斗中掩盖它的存在。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME swings its bladelike leaf, it releases a soothing aroma that smells faintly of Chesto Berries. This scent often masks its presence in battle.

entry: 厨师进林寻找芳香蘑菇时，会带上能与植物根部交流的POKENAME。感知附近有真菌，它就以钢刃般的劈斩，娴熟采下。
author: ghostslythe
source: Used by Chefs on Balm Mushroom hunts in the woods, POKENAME communicates with the roots of plants. When it senses fungi nearby, it expertly harvests them with steely slashes.

entry: 它醒着时，叶片与触须会散发宜人、舒缓的香气。常在林间空地或田野坐下，展开草叶般的触须，沐浴阳光。
author: infinex21
source: Its leaves and feelers emit a pleasant, soothing aroma when it is awake. It will often sit in clearings or fields and bask in the sunlight with its grassy feelers spread out.

entry: POKENAME用体内火焰的温暖，帮助领地里的花生长。POKENAME周围的花越健康，自己的色彩也越鲜艳。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses the warmth from the flame in its body to help with the growth of flowers in its home territory. POKENAME's own coloration grows more vibrant the healthier the flowers it surrounds itself with.

entry: 它用垃圾和叶子替换部分伪装，融入腐败植物中。靠嚼食落叶补充能量，却尽可能避开阳光。
author: .izik
source: It replaces portions of its disguise with trash and leaves, blending in with decayed plant matter. It chews on fallen leaves to gain energy but avoids sunlight as much as possible.

entry: 白天，它释放混有毒孢子的甜香。只有虫与毒双属性宝可梦，才喜欢待在身旁。夜里可能会寻找更清澈的水，让孢子毒性更强。
author: torterraguy26
source: During the day, it releases a sweet scent mixed with toxic spores. The only creatures who enjoy being around it are the Bug-Poison type Pokémon. At night, it might search for clearer waters so its spores can become more toxic.

entry: POKENAME无声漂过稻田。饿了便降下，偷走一团团植物，再飘走。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME floats silently over rice fields. When hungry, it descends to steal clumps of vegetation before drifting away.

entry: POKENAME头顶散发甜美花香，许多人因此寻找它的孢子，用于美容用品。不过，孢子本身毒性极强，打算提取时必须谨慎。
author: porterofgames
source: The top of a POKENAME's head has a sweet and floral aroma, causing many to seek out their spores for use in beauty products. However, these spores are also highly toxic on their own, so caution is advised if one plans on extracting them.

entry: 晴天，POKENAME乘风漂浮，展开叶片，尽可能收集日光。成群的POKENAME会将肢体连在一起，边漂边组成旋转的环。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME floats with the wind on sunny days, spreading its leaves to gather as much sunlight as possible. Groups of POKENAME will link their limbs together and form rotating rings as they float about.

entry: POKENAME夜里快速扇动叶状翅膀，穿行林间，吸食过熟果实的汁液。咬处留下针尖大小的孔，是夜间进食的细微痕迹。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's leaf-like wings flap rapidly as it navigates wooded areas at night. It feasts on the juice of overripe fruit, leaving small pin-sized holes where it bites- a subtle sign of its nocturnal feeding habits.

entry: 它钻进林地落叶，向打扰休息的生物发射电网。蛛网也能把日光传向叶状身体，增强能量。
author: .izik
source: It burrows in leaves in forested areas, shooting electric webs at anything that disturbs its rest. The webs also help conduct sunlight to its leafy body, enhancing its energy.

entry: POKENAME一边吸收阳光，一边假装睡觉，散出甜香，吸引虫类宝可梦聚在身旁。等对方靠近，它便凭回声定位，咬住这顿美餐，吸取血液。
author: darkweavile428
source: By pretending to be asleep while soaking up sunlight and luring Pokémon in with a sweet scent, POKENAME gets bug Pokémon to gather around them. Once the bug Pokémon are close, they rely on echolocation to bite and drain blood from their meal.

entry: 成群POKENAME用锋利口器修剪小灌木和树木，让它们整齐美观，常被园艺爱好者饲养。
author: mistymagius
source: Swarms of POKENAME can be seen trimming small bushes and trees with their sharp mandibles to make them look neat and tidy. They are commonly kept by gardening enthusiasts.

entry: 白天，它睡觉吸光。若POKENAME吸收的能量不足，夜里就会猎捕能找到的任何小型宝可梦。
author: larky_
source: During the day, it sleeps and soaks up light. If POKENAME doesn't absorb enough energy, it spends the night hunting any small Pokémon it can find.

entry: POKENAME住在雪山顶，隆冬晴朗的早晨，会下到附近村庄。传闻它会夺走行为不端者的声音，让其呼吸永远带着薄荷味。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Living atop snowy mountains, POKENAME makes its way down to nearby villages on sunny mornings in the middle of winter. It is rumoured to steal the voices of those that have acted badly and make their breath smell forever of mint.

entry: 它白天专心通过光合作用获取能量，夜里四处游荡。休息时，把部分身体埋进土里，免遭盯上。宝可梦若吃下它头顶的叶子，会觉得很苦。
author: bobosmith01
source: It focuses on photosynthesizing energy during the day, while it roams around at night. To prevent it from being targeted, it buries itself partially in the ground while it rests. If a Pokémon eats the leaves atop its head, they will find them bitter.

entry: POKENAME藏在温室里的堆肥箱，吃可降解的残渣，比起土，更喜欢果皮和腐叶。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME hides in compost bins inside greenhouses. It feeds on biodegradable scraps, preferring fruit rinds and rotting leaves over soil.

entry: POKENAME住在森林深处的树桩中。它睡在哪个树桩，总能一眼认出：住过的木头都会长出粉色小花，为腐木添上生机。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME inhabits stumps in deep forests. One can always tell the stump it sleeps inside- small pink flowers grow from the wood in anything it enters, adding a touch of life to the decaying timber.

entry: POKENAME睡着时，身上的海藻会缠进海带丛。虽然形似船锚，若没攀牢，仍会被潮水带走。
author: .izik
source: When asleep, POKENAME's seaweed intertwines with kelp beds. Though it resembles an anchor, tides can carry it away if not securely latched.

entry: 它割下附近树叶，嚼成细浆，培育小片真菌，作为POKENAME的私藏粮库。真菌吸收日光，会长得更壮。
author: .izik
source: It chops leaves off of nearby trees and chews them into a fine pulp to cultivate small fungal patches. These fungi act as a personal food storage for POKENAME, growing stronger as they absorb sunlight.

entry: POKENAME耐寒，被雪埋住也能生存。只要太阳出来，POKENAME就会把头探出雪面，吸收日光。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME is resistant to the cold and can survive being buried in snow. Whenever the sun comes out, POKENAME will poke its head above the surface to take in sunlight.

entry: 叶片长得更多，让POKENAME能更充分利用日光。叶子也更锋利，越发像被甜香吸引的虫形宝可梦。看着凶，只是长相如此。
author: entomoxie
source: The increased leaf growth allows POKENAME to make greater use of the sun's rays. Its leaves grow sharper and more closely resemble the insectoid Pokémon attracted to its sweet scent. It may look aggressive, but this is simply its appearance.

entry: POKENAME抖动身体，使出带有淡淡嘉珍果气味的麻痹粉。即使它逃远，香味仍久久不散。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME shakes Stun Spore attacks from its body that smell faintly of Jaboca Berries. The scent lingers long after it flees the scene.

entry: POKENAME烦躁时，会释放腐烂南瓜的恶臭，再迈着短腿追赶入侵者，赶出领地。
author: .izik
source: When grumpy, POKENAME releases a foul rotten pumpkin scent. It chases intruders with its stubby legs to drive them out of its territory.

entry: 野生POKENAME栖息于火山脚下，享用火山灰带来的肥沃养分。
author: skelesoul
source: A wild POKENAME finds its habitat amongst the base of volcanoes where it indulges in the nourishing fertilization of volcanic ash.

entry: POKENAME藏在草甸，与野花和高草融为一体。一群POKENAME受惊时，会突然缩进草中，藏起身体，假装刚长出的植物。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME hide in meadows, blending in with wild flowers and tall grass. When a glade of POKENAME are startled they will abruptly withdraw their bodies into the grass, hiding away and pretending to be newly growing plants.

entry: POKENAME在海底叶丛间疾行，有机会就吃海藻。受惊时，会把身体的绿色部分向外展开，让自己看着大上一倍。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME darts from between leafy parts of the ocean floor, eating seaweed when it can. When frightened, it spreads the green parts of its body outward to make itself appear twice as big.

entry: POKENAME住在树篱和灌木中，借植物掩护，安全地待在地上晒太阳。它们很容易被忽略，远看就像新长出的植物。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME make their homes in hedgerows and bushes, using the shelter of the plants to safely stay above ground and soak in the sun. They are easily overlooked Pokémon, as from a distance they appear to be simply freshly growing plants.

entry: POKENAME潜伏灌木，等猎物经过，配色和叶片帮它融入周围。不捕猎时，最爱慵懒地晒太阳，让叶子吸收温暖日光。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME lurk in bushes waiting for prey to come by, their colouration and leaves helping them blend in and remain hidden. When they aren't hunting they love to lounge in the sun, their leaves soaking in the warm sunlight.

entry: POKENAME带着收集的一小把钱币，来到晨光下。虽然能正常光合作用，晒着亮币反射的光时，似乎会更开心。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME gathers up a small collection of coins to carry with it beneath the morning sunlight. While it can photosynthesize normally, it seems happier when basking near light reflected off of shiny coins.

entry: POKENAME进化前，尾巴有蜜糖般的滋味与花香，很受大舌贝喜爱，经常被咬。虽说如此，POKENAME却很爱拥抱大舌贝，白天在阳光下打盹，入夜才稍活跃。
author: heal_fire
source: Shellder love to bite the tails of POKENAME before it evolves, due to their honey-like taste and their flower-like smell. Despite that, POKENAME is really fond of hugging Shellder, dozing in the sunlight before being a bit more active at nightfall.

entry: POKENAME需要晒好几个小时太阳，才能让体色保持鲜艳。受威胁时，会从背上种子释放毒粉。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME needs to spend many hours in the sun to keep the colors on its body vibrant. When it feels threatened, it releases a poisonous powder from the bulb on its back.

entry: 花田盛开处，就有POKENAME照料。鲜艳配色让它融入花丛，引来巴大蝶等传粉者。害虫若侵袭植物，它就把镰刀当回旋镖，迅速赶走。
author: ghostslythe
source: Where fields of flowers bloom, POKENAME is a caretaker. Its bright colors allow it to blend in with the blooms, attracting pollinators like Butterfree. If pests attack the plants, it quickly drives them away using its scythe like a boomerang.

entry: POKENAME的动作如流畅舞蹈，花瓣色彩变换，宛如迪斯科灯光秀。舞动时配合节奏精准出腿，让对手来不及反应。
author: shyguy11011
source: POKENAME's movements resemble a fluid dance, its petals shifting into vibrant colors like a disco light show. While dancing, it delivers precise kicks in time with its movements before its opponents can react.

entry: POKENAME待在水面，给角蓄积太阳能。能量足够，就释放激光刃切断树枝，吃上面的叶子。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME charges solar energy into its horn by remaining at the surface of bodies of water. Once sufficient energy has been generated, it releases laser blades to cut down branches so that it can eat the leaves.

entry: POKENAME吃鲜花，让美丽鲜艳的双翼保持明亮光泽。它难养得出了名，需要十分特定的温度与湿度，才能健康生长。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME feeds on fresh flowers to keep the colours of its beautiful, vivid wings bright and lustrous. It is notoriously difficult to raise, as it requires very specific temperature and humidity conditions to thrive.

entry: POKENAME与造型师、裁缝合作，为训练家制作衣服。它裁剪编织布料，做出能登上杂志的美丽裙装。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME work alongside stylists and tailors to create clothes for Trainers. They cut and weave fabric to create beautiful dresses that get featured in magazines.

entry: POKENAME极其讲究外貌，花许多时间梳理打扮。所用镰刀，与头上花朵由同种材料构成。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is very particular about its appearance and spends much of its time grooming itself. It uses a scythe made out of the same material as the flower upon its head.

entry: 想培育兰花般宝可梦的园丁，很喜欢体质强健、性情温和的POKENAME。它吃腐败植物，因此厨房残渣也不会损害健康。
author: pjporwoll
source: Gardeners wishing to grow orchid-like Pokémon are drawn to POKENAME since it has a hardy constitution and a mild personality. It eats decomposing plants, so cooking scraps will not hamper its health.

entry: POKENAME是较冷地区常见的交通宝可梦，能摆渡，送孩子过水。性情温和，是社区备受珍视的一员。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME is a popular transport Pokémon in cooler climates, used as a ferry for taking children across bodies of water. Its gentle nature makes it a valued member of the community.

entry: POKENAME是较冷地区常见的交通宝可梦，能摆渡，送孩子过水。性情温和，是社区备受珍视的一员。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME is a popular transport Pokémon in cooler climates, used as a ferry for taking children across bodies of water. Its gentle nature makes it a valued member of the community.

entry: POKENAME漂在河面节省能量，用尾巴钓鱼。捕获后，就会精神十足地回到群体，分享食物。
author: ghostslythe
source: POKENAME conserves its energy by floating on the surface of rivers, while fishing with its tail.  After a successful catch, it makes its way energetically to its school and shares its meal.

entry: POKENAME用植物尖刺产生更强的静电，保护自己喜爱的花圃与庭园。
author: mary_the_jane
source: POKENAME generates a stronger static with its plant quills. It uses this to protect flower beds and gardens it has grown to like.

entry: POKENAME是时尚界受欢迎的宠物。它常陪模特走上伸展台，展示最新宝可梦时尚。
author: beetlething
source: POKENAME are a popular pet within the fashion industry. It will often accompany models on the runway, showing off the latest Pokémon fashion trends.

entry: POKENAME藏在桃桃果间，安全等待进化。即使被带离，POKENAME仍保留浓郁果香。
author: puppylev
source: POKENAME hides itself among Pecha Berries, where it bides its time safely until it evolves. If removed from its place, POKENAME retains a strong fruity scent.

entry: POKENAME翼上的花瓣极锋利，能给对手造成细小割伤，最终将其压倒。它需要肉和蔬菜等多种食物，维持鲜艳体色。
author: chibitales
source: The petals on POKENAME's wings are extremely sharp, allowing it to cause minor cuts to opponents and eventually overwhelm them. It needs a wide variety of food including meat and vegetables to maintain its vibrant coloration.

entry: POKENAME用长喙钻进树木，花数小时吸取水与树液。休息时，栖在树冠上展开鲜艳双翼，更好地吸收日光与月光。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME use their long beaks to penetrate trees and suck out the water and sap over a span of a few hours. When they rest, they roost atop tree canopies with their vibrant wings spread out to better absorb sunlight and moonlight.

entry: POKENAME的美貌，掩盖了凶残好斗的性情。先用爪抓住猎物，再刺入麻痹毒素，就能悠闲享用。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME's beautiful appearance belies an aggressive and vicious disposition. It snags prey in its claws before stinging them with a paralytic toxin, allowing it to leisurely feed on its catch.

entry: POKENAME常见于庭园，春季尤其多，会用舒缓香气引来害虫。若POKENAME常来家中，就说明主人很会园艺。
author: dualblades1147
source: POKENAME are commonly spotted in gardens, especially in the springtime, using their calming fragrance to draw in pests. It is a sign of a good gardener if a POKENAME frequents their abode.

entry: POKENAME花许多时间梳理颈后的叶状鬃毛。发怒时，鬃毛会起火，可惜冷静下来后，又得重做一遍细致的梳理。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME spends a good amount of time preening the leafy mane on the back of its neck. If angered, the mane will ignite, which unfortunately means it will have to repeat the meticulous grooming process once it calms down.

entry: POKENAME夜里扇动宽阔叶翼，无声滑翔，寻找最爱吃的野生牛至丛，一直啃到天亮。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME glides silently at night, flapping its broad leaf-like wings. It seeks wild oregano patches, its favorite food, to munch on until dawn.

entry: POKENAME住在细香葱与芳香草本植物间，织出几乎看不见的丝线，阻挡害虫，让花园茁壮繁盛。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME makes its home among chives and fragrant herbs. It spins near-invisible silk throughout the area to keep pests away, ensuring its garden thrives.

entry: POKENAME格外在意羽毛是否完美无瑕。若够不到背上新生的羽毛，又没有同类或训练家帮忙，就会大发脾气，变得好斗。
author: puppylev
source: POKENAME is exceptionally aware of the state of its pristine feathers. If it can't reach the pinfeathers on its back and is not given assistance from another POKENAME or its Trainer, it is known to lash out and become aggressive.

entry: POKENAME水陆两栖，住在沼泽，埋进泥里，在水下张嘴，等猎物意外游进来。花瓣鲜艳、性情温顺，很受年轻训练家欢迎。
author: opossiblymage
source: POKENAME is amphibious and lives in marshlands. It buries itself in mud and keeps its mouth open under the water, waiting for prey to accidentally swim in. The bright colors of its petals and docile demeanor make it popular with younger Trainers.

entry: 背上的种子会随空气湿度改变颜色。POKENAME格外提防人类，因此偏爱避开人，在丛林安静生活。
author: fiordaliso
source: The bulb on its back changes color depending on how much moisture is in the air. POKENAME is a creature that is particularly wary of humans, which is why it prefers to avoid them and lead a peaceful life in the jungle.

entry: 美丽花朵的花瓣覆着毒膜，谁都不敢吃。POKENAME力气大得能用草本藤蔓，举起巨石。
author: fiordaliso
source: The petals of its beautiful flower are coated with a poisonous film, so that no one dares to eat them. POKENAME is so strong that it can even lift large boulders using its herbaceous vines.

entry: POKENAME以小拳石为食，已适应地下生活。鲜艳配色引来不警觉的猎物，再用能劈开钻石的爪，破开对方外皮。
author: ghostslythe
source: With a diet consisting of Geodude, POKENAME has adapted to underground living. It uses its bright coloration to reel in unwary prey, then breaks through their hide with claws that can split diamonds.

entry: 它的前臂坚硬如钢、锋利如剃刀，既是强力武器，也是坚固盾牌。常与同类互撞前臂争夺领地，直到一方撑不住。
author: hobiewankenobi
source: Its forearms are hard as steel and razor sharp, and act as both powerful weapons and incredibly strong shields. They often compete with each other for territory by slamming their forearms together until the other falters.

entry: POKENAME在热带丛林捕猎，用锋利双镰猛烈攻击。体型太大，很难靠伪装骗过猎物，却能散出甜香，让对方放松戒备。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME hunts in tropical jungles, fiercely attacking its prey with its sharp scythes. While it's too big to convincingly camouflage, it emits a sweet scent from its body that often makes its prey let their guard down.

entry: POKENAME从树上直直垂下，模仿悬挂的花朵。人或宝可梦走过下方，都很容易被落下的POKENAME咬伤。
author: puppylev
source: POKENAME hangs straight down from trees in an attempt to mimic hanging flowers. Humans and Pokémon alike who wander underneath it are prone to getting bitten when POKENAME drops onto them.

entry: POKENAME住在鲜艳的热带珊瑚礁，用吻部射出蕴含日光的激光捕猎。养起来很昂贵，必须细心照顾水质和光照，否则会褪色、发脾气。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME inhabits vivid, tropical reefs where it hunts by blasting sun-infused laser beams from its snout. It is an expensive pet to care for since it requires diligent attention to the water chemistry and lighting, lest it lose its color and temper.

entry: POKENAME把叶状四肢蜷进身体，以可怕速度滚过山坡。极速超过大多数巴士，遇上它十分危险。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME curls its leafy limbs inward and rolls across hills at terrifying speed. Its top velocity exceeds that of most buses, making it dangerous to encounter.

entry: POKENAME尽可能久地晒太阳，光越多，花开得越快。数百年前，POKENAME的花瓣曾用于爱情药水。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME bask as long as they can in sunlight, with more light causing their flowers to bloom faster. Centuries ago POKENAME's petals were used in love potions.

entry: POKENAME用颈部催眠较小宝可梦，让其听命。成功后，POKENAME便躺着晒太阳，等被催眠者送来食物。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME use their hoods to hypnotize smaller Pokémon to obey them. After being successful, POKENAME lounge in the sun as they wait for the hypnotized Pokémon to bring them food.

entry: POKENAME一声吼，鬃毛就会放出几十片剃刀般的花瓣，切开附近一切。凭唱反调特性，它每次试图耗掉强大力量，反而都会大幅增强。
author: soup1900
source: A roar from POKENAME causes dozens of razor-sharp petals to release from its mane and slice everything in its vicinity. With its Contrary ability, each time it tries to expend its sheer power, it instead increases it dramatically.

entry: POKENAME外貌可爱，受收藏可爱宝可梦的人追捧，脾气却往往暴躁。若未受应有赏识，还可能故意不听训练家的话。
author: puppylev
source: While POKENAME is widely sought after by collectors of cute Pokémon for its appearance, it tends to have a cranky disposition and may purposefully disobey its Trainer if not properly appreciated.

entry: POKENAME通常在树顶晒太阳。它们调皮得很，经常用仙人掌刺戳彼此。
author: cinna0175
source: POKENAME are usually found bathing in the sun amongst the treetops. They are very cheeky Pokémon, and will often poke each other with their cactus spines.

entry: POKENAME在寒冷地区的晴天最活跃，体色鲜亮，尤其在雪地十分醒目。任何靠近的宝可梦，很快就会发现，花瓣的锯齿边缘锋利如剃刀。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME are most active in cold regions on clear days, their bright colors making them clearly visible, especially against snow. Any Pokémon that approaches quickly discovers that the serrated edges of POKENAME's petals are razor-sharp.

entry: POKENAME的体色与磁力强弱，深受它与周围环境契合程度的影响。热带地区的个体，力量最强、色彩最鲜艳。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's coloration and magnetic strength are strongly affected by its affinity towards its surroundings. The strongest and most vibrant specimens can be found in tropical regions.

entry: POKENAME身边有鲜艳盛开的花时，火力就会增强。这时射出的火焰，会呈现美丽的粉色。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's firepower is increased if it is in the presence of vibrant and blooming flowers. The fire it shoots while empowered this way takes on a beautiful pink hue.

entry: 这些宝可梦喜爱晒太阳，收集能量，转化成电力，再从藤状尾巴释放。有些人将POKENAME当宠物养，充当活太阳能电池。
author: milchik
source: These Pokémon love sunbathing to gather energy, which they convert into electricity and release through their vine-like tails. Some people keep POKENAME as pets, using them as living sun batteries.

entry: POKENAME钻进沙中，只露头部。头上绿色触须既能光合作用，也能探测气流。察觉生物靠近，POKENAME就缩进自己挖的洞，等对方经过。
author: puppylev
source: POKENAME burrows into the sand with its head poking out, the green feelers on its head serving both as photosynthesizers and as detectors of air currents. If it feels a creature approaching, POKENAME ducks into the burrow it created until they pass.

entry: POKENAME外表迷人，攻击却迅猛凶狠得惊人。它偏爱桃桃果树，更容易在其中伪装。
author: josh707
source: Despite its charming appearance, POKENAME will strike with startling speed and ferocity. It favors trees bearing Pecha Berries, as they allow easier camouflage.

entry: 有人见过POKENAME脸朝下埋进沙里，背刺看起来如花朵。它还会造出一条小通气道，延长待在地下的时间。
author: puppylev
source: POKENAME has been observed burying itself in the sand face down, as the spines on its back resemble a flower. When doing so, it creates a small tunnel of air to extend its time underground.

entry: POKENAME很受和服女孩喜爱，常陪伴她们学习传统艺术。POKENAME喜欢模仿训练家，常等自己的训练家睡下后，再玩玩具茶具。
author: beetlething
source: POKENAME are a popular pet for Kimono Girls, often accompanying them during their studies of the traditional arts. POKENAME enjoy mimicking its Trainer, often playing with toy tea sets after its Trainer has gone to bed.

entry: POKENAME裙装般的花瓣十分娇弱，因此动作都谨慎而优雅。鲜艳体色，也显示训练家照顾得有多好。
author: lasercraft32
source: Its dress-like petals are highly delicate; because of this, POKENAME moves with calculated grace and elegance. Its vivid coloration is an indicator of how well its Trainer takes care of it.

entry: POKENAME有“自然花艺师”之称，会在衰败草甸起舞，吸引传粉者。它以未知力量，让脚下冒出紫罗兰，引来更多宝可梦，形成美丽的天然花艺。
author: ghostslythe
source: Nicknamed Nature's Florist, POKENAME dances in dying meadows, attracting pollinators. Using unknown powers, violets sprout under its feet as more Pokémon are brought to the area, making beautiful natural arrangements.

entry: POKENAME裙装般的花瓣十分娇弱，因此动作都谨慎而优雅。鲜艳体色，也显示训练家照顾得有多好。
author: lasercraft32
source: Its dress-like petals are highly delicate; because of this, POKENAME moves with calculated grace and elegance. Its vivid coloration is an indicator of how well its Trainer takes care of it.

entry: 这种宝可梦天性温顺，会照顾森林里迷路的人。可朋友一受威胁，就会变得极其凶猛。花瓣颜色，能反映情绪状态。
author: fireblade141
source: This Pokémon is naturally docile and will care for those who get lost in the woods. However, it will become extremely fierce when its friends are threatened. The color of its petals is indicative of its emotional state.

entry: POKENAME动作缓慢、性情温和，用皮肤吸收日光，将能量集中到头顶光环。受威胁时，就会从光环不停发射能量束。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME is slow-moving and docile. It absorbs sunlight with its skin and concentrates the power into the glowing halo above its head. When threatened, it will fire energy beams from that halo relentlessly.

entry: POKENAME背上的叶状褶边，会散发宜人的甜甜香气，引其他生物靠近，再用毒刺刺中，使其严重麻痹。
author: .izik
source: The leaf-frills on POKENAME's back emit a pleasant Sweet Scent to lure others close. It then stabs them with a venomous thorn that causes severe paralysis.

entry: POKENAME镰形花瓣，能迅速击倒猎物与敌人。鲜艳的蜕鳞被人收集，用作装饰镶嵌。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's sickle-shaped petals swiftly take down prey and enemies. Its vivid shed scales are collected and used as decorative inlay.

entry: POKENAME厌恶自认不洁肮脏的事物。POKENAME会跟踪符合这一描述的生物，若闯入POKENAME的领地，就会将其除掉。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME despise anything it considers unclean and dirty. POKENAME stalks creatures that fall into this description, taking them out if they enter POKENAME's territory.

entry: 雄性同伴外出捕猎后，它便负责看守巢穴，尤其照料幼小宝可梦。若有幼崽想离巢，就会用柔软花瓣，引导它回去。
author: quackquackattack
source: Once its male packmates leave to hunt, it is left in charge of monitoring the nest, especially the baby Pokémon in its care. If any of the babies try to leave the nest during this time, it guides the baby back using its soft petals.

entry: POKENAME把全部八只爪举到头边，伪装成花，散发宜人香气。谁想来授粉，这些手臂就会迅速将其抓住，整个吞下。
author: santon5512
source: By raising all eight of their claws up to their heads, POKENAME will disguise themselves as flowers while releasing a pleasant aroma. These arms will swiftly grab anyone looking to pollinate them, consuming them whole.

entry: 这种宝可梦极力保护幼崽，会用生长让自己胀大，却也常因此吓到孩子。
author: puppylev
source: This Pokémon is fiercely protective of its young. It uses Growth to puff itself up, but that often also frightens its babies.

entry: POKENAME战斗冷酷，用灌注黑暗能量的双镰残酷劈斩对手。它却害怕自己的力量，因此独自隐居，迫不得已才攻击。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is ruthless in combat, brutally slashing its opponents with its scythes, which are imbued with dark energy. Fearful of its own power, it isolates itself and will only attack as a last resort.

entry: POKENAME粉色叶状身体完全中空。它吃牛至、薄荷等香草，为诡异能力提供能量，用来惊吓、迷惑敌人。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's pink leafy body is completely hollow inside. It will eat herbs like oregano and mint to fuel its eerie powers, which it uses to spook and disorient its foes.

entry: POKENAME白天漂在水面，进行光合作用。需要富含营养的水域，才能维持鲜艳色彩与庞大身躯。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME floats on the water's surface during the day to photosynthesize. It requires nutrient-rich waters to maintain its vibrant colors and massive body.

entry: POKENAME虽能夷平城市，却更爱晒太阳，梳理自己。对照顾方式可能极其挑剔，但有能力的训练家，很快就能赢得POKENAME信任。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Despite being capable of leveling cities, POKENAME prefer to lounge in the sun, grooming themselves. While they can be extremely picky about how they're taken care of, a capable Trainer can quickly earn a POKENAME's trust.

entry: POKENAME背上长着鲜艳的异域植物。它静卧时藏进甲壳，伪装成奇异花园，保护自己。善待幼体的人，往往能收获一位终生朋友。
author: jadey.1557
source: POKENAME sprout vibrant, xenobiotic flora on their backs. While lying motionless, POKENAME hide in their carapace and disguise themselves as unusual gardens to remain protected. Those kind to young juveniles usually enjoy a new friend for life.

entry: POKENAME晒太阳，让叶状身体吸收太阳能，增强头上毒刺产生的毒素。
author: .izik
source: By basking in the sun, POKENAME's leafy body absorbs solar energy. This strengthens the toxin produced by the thorn on its head.

entry: POKENAME的爪毒性很强，用来削弱闯入领地者。求偶季节，身体会散出极其浓郁的花香。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its claws are very poisonous, and POKENAME uses them to weaken intruders who invade its territory. During the mating season, its body gives off a very intense floral scent.

entry: POKENAME的叶刃很娇弱，却会在攻击前几秒变得坚硬如钢。冬天，POKENAME群常为食物争斗，以维持鲜艳体色，颜色越苍白，便越凶狠。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME's leafy blades are delicate, but turn hard-as-steel mere seconds before attacking. During winter, POKENAME groups frequently fight over food to maintain their vivid coloration, with paler-colored POKENAME being much more vicious.

entry: POKENAME藤状的尾巴，流动着强烈电流。蓄积的电压，让轻轻一碰也能电昏成年人。
author: .izik
source: The vine-like tail of POKENAME channels intense electricity. Even a casual touch can knock out a full-grown human due to the voltage it stores.

entry: POKENAME独居深湖，只有附近发生战斗才现身。据说宜人的花香，会随周围生物的情绪变化。
author: quantumradiation
source: It is a reclusive Pokémon, only emerging from the deep lakes it dwells in if there is fighting nearby. It is said that the lovely floral scent of POKENAME changes depending on the moods of those around it.

entry: POKENAME主要靠光合作用获取养分，维持鲜艳体色。它能将日光引入触须，使出精准得可怕的日光刃。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME perform photosynthesis to get most of their nutrients, which helps to keep their colors vibrant. They can harness sunlight into their feelers to perform Solar Blade attacks with terrifying precision.

entry: 据说POKENAME来自植物色彩远比这里鲜艳的世界。彩色影子只要轻轻一触，连枯死的花也能重新盛放。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is said to come from a world with much more vibrantly-colored plant life than ours. A touch from its colored shadow will bring even a wilted, dead flower to full bloom again.

entry: POKENAME白天待在云中，少受打扰，享受日光。若有鸟宝可梦撞上来，POKENAME会毫不犹豫地惩击入侵者。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME spend their days in the clouds, enjoying the sunlight with few interruptions. Should a bird Pokémon collide into them, POKENAME will smite the intruder without hesitation.

entry: POKENAME的冠状角，象征它那十足的骄傲。若被抛弃或受辱，POKENAME便会蜕去这坚硬结构，同时失去重要防护。
author: puppylev
source: POKENAME's crown-like horns represent their pride, which is something they tend to have an abundance of. If it is abandoned or disgraced, the POKENAME will shed this tough outgrowth and lose a vital piece of its defence in the process.

entry: 它的速度与震耳叫声，本已足够扰乱敌人，还会卷起花瓣风暴，令其更加混乱。一有机会，就用足以撕开钢铁的力量，挥落双镰。
author: bacondlx
source: Although its speed and deafening cry would be enough to disorient its foes, it whips up a storm of flower petals to confuse them even further. When there is an opportunity to strike, it brings down its sickles with enough power to tear through steel.

entry: POKENAME在月光下漂过废物场，把种子种进丢弃的毛绒玩具。不知用什么方式，让玩具动起来，抵御领地入侵者。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME floats above junkyards under moonlight. It plants seeds in discarded plush toys, somehow animating them to defend its territory from intruders.

entry: POKENAME虽对光和噪声敏感，却很爱社交。有时会借辅助器具保持活跃，其中用樱子果做的眼罩，很受POKENAME欢迎。
author: puppylev
source: Though POKENAME are sensitive to light and noise, they are highly social. They sometimes use adaptive equipment to help them stay active. One popular aid amongst POKENAME is an eye covering fashioned out of Cheri Berries.
