entry: 野生POKENAME用大爪保护幼崽，也修剪森林家园周围的草木，防止过度生长。电网能把日光传入体内，维持鲜艳体色。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME use their large claws to defend their young as well as to trim the greenery around their forest homes to prevent overgrowth. Their electric webs help them to conduct sunlight into their bodies, which help to maintain their vivid colors.

entry: POKENAME性情高傲，总忙着打扮，弄脏就大发脾气。它还很有时尚品味，让越来越多大姐姐选它作伙伴宝可梦。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are snobbish creatures, always seen fussing over their appearance and becoming irate if they're dirty. They also have a sense of fashion, leading to a rise in Beauties having them as partner Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME看似威猛凶暴，实际通常很平静，战斗时也十分聪明。它用舒缓香气骗过敌人，移动到上方，再倾下大片花瓣，将其摧毁。
author: soup1900
source: Despite how imposing and violent it looks, POKENAME is usually very calm and possesses a high intelligence in battles. It tricks foes with calming scents to position itself over them before unleashing onslaughts of petals to obliterate them.

entry: 它据说寿命长达千年，一生中色彩会逐渐鲜亮。传统上认为这是祝福，其实与毛发日渐稀疏有关，剩下的毛因此显得更亮。
author: puppylev
source: Throughout its lifespan, which supposedly spans a millennium, its colours will steadily get brighter. Traditionally thought to be a result of some blessing, this is related to its fur thinning out over time, so the remaining fur becomes brighter.

entry: POKENAME没有嘴，靠光合作用获取营养。它能用甜甜香气，让人和宝可梦入睡。
author: puppylev
source: Lacking a mouth, POKENAME relies on photosynthesis for its nutrition. It can put people and Pokémon to sleep with its Sweet Scent.

entry: POKENAME鲜艳的颜色与甜得发腻的气味，都来自花瓣上的毒液状涂层。POKENAME混入花田，贴伏地面，等猎物被美味陷阱引来。
author: puppylev
source: POKENAME's bright color and sickly sweet smell are both characteristics of the venom-like coating along its petals. POKENAME blends into flower fields, pressing itself to the ground and waiting for something to be coaxed by its tasty trap.

entry: POKENAME尾尖的火焰，会释放一种天然熏香。数种文化用这烟驱散负面气场，振奋精神。
author: puppylev
source: The flame at the end of POKENAME's tail releases a form of natural incense. This smoke is used in several cultures as a way to cleanse negative auras and revitalize one's spirit.

entry: POKENAME能把自己胀到近乎原来三倍大。偶尔用于防御，主要却是扩大身体表面积，增强光合作用。
author: puppylev
source: POKENAME can puff itself up to almost triple its size. It uses this occasionally as a defense mechanism, but primarily to expand the surface area of its body to facilitate an increase in photosynthesis.

entry: POKENAME视力原始而极其有限。白天倒挂树上吸收日光，夜里则精神恢复，靠自身振翅声辨路。
author: puppylev
source: POKENAME's eyesight is primitive and extremely limited. It hangs upside down in trees during the day to absorb sunlight, and during the night it uses the sound of its own wing flaps to navigate with renewed energy.

entry: POKENAME用混有电网、彼此连牢的叶子，覆盖森林中的洞穴。前爪能修剪、保养自己和同类的叶状身体。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME cover their forest burrows with leaves mixed and held together with electric webbing. Their front claws help them to trim and maintain the leafy bodies of themselves and others of their kind.

entry: 它凶悍且破坏力强，却只吃草属性宝可梦。吞下的宝可梦的气味，会从花瓣散入空气。
author: teatedtiten
source: Though this Pokémon is fierce and destructive, it only feasts on Grass-type Pokémon. Its petals permeate the air with scents of the Pokémon it ingests.

entry: POKENAME细心照料大片美丽花园，极力守护。谁践踏花园，它在发怒攻击前的吼声，都会让人不寒而栗。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME carefully tends to large and beautiful flower gardens, of which it is quite protective. The roar it makes before unleashing its fury on those that trample its garden is quite bone-chilling.

entry: POKENAME身体敏感，蜷在大花瓣做的披风下，抵御风雨。住在温暖、气候温和地区的个体，披风颜色更鲜艳。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's body is sensitive, so it keeps itself huddled beneath a cloak made of its large petals to shield it from the elements. Specimens living in warm, temperate areas possess a much more vibrantly-colored cloak.

entry: POKENAME胸前的大突起看似嘴，其实是个荚状部位，能储存能量。人们推测，假嘴的外观是为了吓跑潜在捕食者。
author: puppylev
source: The large protrusion on POKENAME's chest resembles a mouth, but is actually a pod which stores energy. The fake mouth's appearance is presumed to be to frighten off potential predators.

entry: POKENAME远看华美，却藏着暴烈脾气。它以锋利花瓣和甜香引其他生物靠近，再释放超声波，扰乱敌人方向。
author: lesbian_garlicbread
source: POKENAME may appear glamorous from afar, but it hides a fierce temper. Using razor‑sharp petals and sweet scents to draw others in, it unleashes ultrasonic waves to disorient its foes.

entry: POKENAME以迷人美貌闻名，尤其是花苞随风轻轻起伏时。用这些花制成的香水，很受年轻女性欢迎。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME is known for its enchanting beauty, especially when its flowerbuds ripple gently in the wind. Perfumes made from these flowers are popular amongst young women.

entry: 野生POKENAME永远无法发挥全部潜力，毛发会长得过密，某些招式一用就伤到自己。专心而有爱的训练家，能帮它梳理、训练，让它施展毁灭性的攻击。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: A POKENAME can never reach its full potential in the wild, as its fur gets overgrown and it cannot perform certain moves without damaging itself. A dedicated and loving Trainer can groom it and train it to be able to perform devastating attacks.

entry: POKENAME黏糊糊的，身体柔软可弯，因此常被认为温顺。不过，收藏家常把它们视为艺术创作的绝佳助手和模特。
author: th3randomguy
source: POKENAME are quite sticky Pokémon, bendable and often perceived as meek for their vividly soft nature. Despite this, they are commonly seen among collectors as perfect assistants and models for the arts.

entry: POKENAME住在阳光与植物丰富的热带岛屿，两者都让体色保持鲜艳。它会照料在家附近虚弱倒下的人，待对方康复，又因害羞藏起。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME makes its home on tropical islands with lots of sun and plant life, both of which help keep its coloration vibrant. It tends to those people who are weakened and collapsed near its home, but hides when they recover due to shyness.

entry: POKENAME外貌酷似温和的虫属性宝可梦，力量却强得出人意料。大嘴雀等捕食者靠得太近，就会遭到足以碎骨的拳击。
author: .izik
source: Though it appears to be a peaceful Bug-type mimic, POKENAME is deceptively powerful. When a predator like Fearow gets too close, it retaliates with a bone-shattering punch.

entry: POKENAME背上的花没有叶子。POKENAME会爬上树，啃开树枝，喝到树液，供养这些花。
author: .jerden
source: The flowers growing on POKENAME's back do not have any leaves. POKENAME nourishes them by climbing up into a tree and gnawing at a branch until it can drink the sap within.

entry: POKENAME需要充足日光，维持鲜艳体色，但气温过高，又会很快褪色。POKENAME偏爱晴朗冬日，夏天则把自己埋进冰中度过。
author: .jerden
source: Maintaining POKENAME's vivid coloration requires it to get plenty of sunlight, but it will quickly fade if the temperature gets too hot. POKENAME prefers clear winter days and will bury itself in ice to make it through summer.

entry: POKENAME虽住在寒冷环境，仍会抓住一切机会吸收日光，存进结晶。能量能助它度过冬日的黑暗，也能释放为强光爆发或闪亮屏障。
author: .jerden
source: Although it lives in cold environments, POKENAME absorbs sunlight at every opportunity, storing it in its crystals. It can use this energy to make it through dark days in winter or unleash it to produce bright blasts or shimmering barriers.

entry: POKENAME花太多时间梳理，让训练家把不爱动误当作弱小。它会用迅捷迷乱的动作，让对手大吃一惊，优雅地将其击倒。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME spends so much time grooming that Trainers mistake inactivity for weakness. It surprises its opponents with quick, confusing movements, taking down opponents elegantly.

entry: POKENAME夜里沿林间小径追猎铁甲蛹等猎物。找到后，就用剃刀般锋利的叶片，利落切开外壳。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME stalks forest paths at night in search of prey like Metapod. When it finds them, it strikes with razor-sharp leaves, slicing cleanly through their shells.

entry: POKENAME载歌载舞时，花瓣会更加鲜亮多彩。表演最后，会以强力日光刃压轴。
author: soup1900
source: As POKENAME sings and dances, the colors of its petals grow more brilliant and colorful. It performs a powerful Solar Blade as the finisher for its dancing performances.

entry: POKENAME华美的歌舞引来许多宝可梦。虫属性宝可梦聚得够多，优雅动作就会突然变得凶暴，用剃刀般的手臂和腿劈斩它们。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME attracts lots of Pokémon due to its glamorous dancing and singing. Once enough Bug-type Pokémon have gathered around it, its graceful movements turn violent as it slashes them with its razor-sharp arms and legs.

entry: 为了维持鲜艳外貌，POKENAME必须吸取整片树林的养分。想养出华美POKENAME的人，得做好成为专业树木养护师的准备。
author: imaginita
source: In order to maintain its vivid appearance, POKENAME has to drain nutrients from whole groves of trees. Anyone who wants to raise a glamorous POKENAME must be prepared to become a professional arborator.

entry: POKENAME的花瓣铠甲硬如钢铁。守卫领地时，会摇动花瓣，模仿虫宝可梦的声音，让对手不安。
author: bacondlx
source: The petals armoring POKENAME are hard as steel. It shakes its petals while defending its territory, unnerving its opponents by mimicking the sounds of bug Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME甲面含有能进行光合作用的物质，却不能只靠日光生存，因此会切开树木喝树液。POKENAME天性平和，只在受挑衅时攻击。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME has compounds on the surfaces of its armor that allow it to photosynthesize, but it cannot survive on sunlight alone, so it will slice open trees to drink the sap. POKENAME is naturally passive, only attacking if provoked.

entry: 据说雌性POKENAME与雄性POKENAME交配后，还会继续长出翅膀和手臂。奇怪的是，此后就不见雄性POKENAME的踪影。
author: weirdmageddonprepper_93813
source: It is said that female POKENAME continue to gain wings and arms after mating with a male POKENAME. Oddly, the male POKENAME are not seen after this process.

entry: POKENAME侵入森林，吸取当地植物养分，供自己生长、维持健康。若有同类颜色更亮，显出吃得过多的迹象，它们便会转而攻击。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are known to infest forests and siphon nutrients from local flora for the sake of their own health and growth. They will turn on their own kind if any attain brighter colors, which is a sign of having overfed.

entry: 这些宝可梦五只一群捕猎，动作配合精准。它们投出锋利如剃刀的花形手里剑，了结猎物。
author: apieli
source: These Pokémon hunt in packs of five, coordinating their movements with precision. They finish off their prey by throwing razor-sharp floral shurikens.

entry: 许多人把POKENAME的战法误认成舞蹈。优雅举止却颇具欺骗性，镰形双臂能将厚金属板一分为二。
author: blaizegamer
source: The fighting style used by POKENAME has been mistaken by many as a form of dance, but their elegant demeanor is deceiving; their sickle-shaped arms are capable of splitting thick metal plates in two.

entry: POKENAME甜香与鲜艳体色，引来许多以为能饱餐的虫子。体表黏丝将其捕住，再吸进POKENAME体内吃掉。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's sweet scent and vibrant coloring attract many bugs towards it, expecting a tasty meal. The sticky strings coating its body capture those insects, to be sucked up inside POKENAME and consumed.

entry: POKENAME常拼命帮忙，偏偏事情根本用不上POKENAME。难免因碍事被训斥后，往往反而会更加努力地帮忙。
author: beetlething
source: POKENAME often try very hard to help in tasks that do not require a POKENAME. When it is inevitably told off for being in the way, it will often try even harder to help.

entry: POKENAME住在树果丛中，既得保护，又不愁食物，从出生起就很少离家。因此下半身长什么样，科学家至今仍在争论。
author: rakunk
source: POKENAME lives in berry bushes for protection and a steady food source, rarely leaving its home since birth. As a result, scientists are still debating what its lower half looks like.

entry: 它会晒好几个小时太阳，用鬃毛收集纯粹的太阳能，或供光合作用，或让POKENAME裹住能量，高速向前冲撞。
author: fireblade141
source: It basks in sunlight for hours to gather raw solar energy with its mane. This energy is either used for photosynthesis or in battle by allowing POKENAME to dash forward in a high-speed energy-cloaked charge attack.

entry: POKENAME需要定期运动，维持鲜艳肤色。它很受想养成健康习惯的人欢迎，因为让POKENAME保持好颜色，也成了一起运动的动力。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME require regular exercise to maintain the vivid colouration of their skin. They are popular companions amongst those hoping to get into healthy habits, as maintaining POKENAME's colouration provides motivation to exercise with them.

entry: POKENAME喜欢懒洋洋地待着，常在太阳下小睡。它容易受惊，一害怕就会迅速瞬间移动离开。
author: cinna0175
source: POKENAME enjoy lazing about and can often be found taking a nap under the sun. They are easily started and will quickly teleport away if frightened.

entry: POKENAME常慵懒地躺在树上，让结实肌肉沐浴日光。维持最佳状态要花许多心力，因此色彩鲜艳的POKENAME，象征训练家对它健康的用心。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME can be found lounging in trees, enjoying the sunlight on their sculpted muscles. Due to the amount of effort needed to keep these Pokémon in top shape, a vibrant POKENAME is a symbol of its Trainer's dedication to its health.

entry: 宁静森林的黎明，有时能看见POKENAME嬉戏。它很害羞，任何意外声音都会让它四散逃走。要过许多天，觉得重新安全，才会回来。
author: fenragon
source: In peaceful forests, people may find POKENAME frolicking around at dawn. Because it is very shy, any unexpected sound will send the playful Pokémon scattering. They will not return for many days until they feel it is safe again.

entry: 构成POKENAME外壳的炮管，由光合作用供能。收集足够日光后，就射出轻盈花种，落水后迅速生长。
author: puppylev
source: The cannons that make up POKENAME shells are powered by photosynthesis. When enough light has been gathered, they will shoot out lightweight flower seeds that grow rapidly in water.

entry: POKENAME酷似一位著名阿罗拉科学家。POKENAME很会操弄局面，把自己的恶作剧栽赃给无辜宝可梦，逃避处罚。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME bear a striking resemblance to a famous Alolan scientist. POKENAME are quite manipulative, scapegoating their mischievous deeds onto innocent Pokémon to evade punishment.

entry: POKENAME以海中植物和宝可梦为食，紫色甲壳会随饮食更鲜艳。有人报告，POKENAME一天会搜遍超过50英里的海底，寻找食物。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME's purple carapace becomes more vibrant based on their diet of sea-dwelling plants and Pokémon. POKENAME have been reported scouring over 50 miles of seafloor in a day in search of food.

entry: POKENAME由石头构成，背上有一颗珍贵宝石。深洞中的矿工常把它误认成天然晶洞石，过度捕猎让POKENAME濒临灭绝。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are made of stone, with a single precious gem on their backs. Many miners deep inside caverns mistake them for naturally occurring geodes, and as such, POKENAME are an endangered species due to overhunting.

entry: POKENAME吃岩石和宝石，食欲旺盛得能毁掉洞穴，把一切值钱东西吃得干干净净。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: POKENAME eat rocks and gemstones. Due to their voracious appetites, they can wreck caves, completely cleaning them out of anything valuable.

entry: POKENAME很容易被滚动的弹珠分散注意，跟个不停。科学家认为，鲜艳色彩吸引了它，它还对弹珠怀有奇怪的同类亲近感。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME is easily distracted by a rolling Marble and will follow it endlessly. Scientists believe it is drawn to their bright colors and believe POKENAME have a strange sense of kinship with them.

entry: POKENAME住在洞穴深处，通常选结晶丰富的地方。它引发的爆炸威力强大，却也明亮美丽得惊人。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME rests in the deeper areas of cave dwellings, typically in areas where plenty of crystals can be found. The explosions it generates are powerful, but also strikingly bright and beautiful.

entry: POKENAME在黑暗深洞里，拿结晶棍棒不知疲倦地训练，击打岩石，磨炼本领。孤独时，宝石般的面具会泛起淡淡哀伤蓝光。
author: .izik
source: Deep within dark caves, POKENAME tirelessly trains with its crystal club, striking rocks to hone its skills. When lonely, the gemstone-like mask on its face glows with a faint, sorrowful blue light.

entry: POKENAME皮肤上长着美丽结晶，装点身体。受威胁时，会用舌头取下，甩出去当武器。
author: evilgammon
source: Beautiful crystals decorate POKENAME's body, growing on its skin. It uses its tongue to remove these crystals and fling them as weapons if threatened.

entry: POKENAME能操控晶体蛹周围的岩石。受威胁时，晶蛹会胡乱冲出地面。它在茧中摇晃，热切等待蜕变。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can control rocks near its crystalline chrysalis, which haphazardly bursts out from the ground when it is threatened. It wobbles inside its cocoon, eagerly waiting for its metamorphosis.

entry: POKENAME的粉尘，曾因出色的隔绝性能被誉为神奇材料。但近期研究发现，粉尘会堵塞肺部，引起呼吸系统疾病。许多人已开始检查家中，清除这种危险粉尘。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME dust was once marveled at as a miracle insulator, but recent research has found that this dust causes respiratory diseases, as it clogs up people's lungs. Many people have since begun checking their homes to remove this dangerous dust.

entry: 它猛撞洞壁，震落墙上或洞顶的宝石吃，常引发坍塌。不过，它只是从碎石中挖出来，再找新洞穴。
author: sk372
source: It crashes into cave walls in order to knock loose any jewels in the wall or ceiling so it can eat. Its efforts regularly cause cave-ins, but it simply digs its way out of the rubble and looks for a new cave.

entry: POKENAME的结晶部分，尤其是角，坚固得几乎无法摧毁。它把角当钻头，深入岩层，挖出最爱的结晶美食。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's crystalline portions, particularly its horn, are incredibly solid to the point of being nearly indestructible. It uses its horn as a drill to dig into stone depths and dig up crystals, its favorite meal.

entry: POKENAME身上长出的宝石，有时到掌心大小便会脱落。它收集后送给与自己交好的生物，宝石往往带有微弱疗愈力量。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME grows gems from its body that occasionally fall off once they reach palm size. It collects these gems and gives them to those who befriend it, and they are often imbued with a minor power of healing.

entry: POKENAME住在洞穴，舔饮石笋上的液体，常与超音蝠争夺领地。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: POKENAME live in caves, drinking liquids off stalagmites. It often competes with Zubat for territory.

entry: POKENAME的身体主要由几乎无法穿透的结晶构成。它把环境光吸进中央宝石，化为灿烂光束，抵御袭击者。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's body is primarily made up of near-impenetrable crystals. It absorbs ambient light into the gem in its center, which fuels radiant beams of light it uses to defend itself from attackers.

entry: 传闻POKENAME被石头包住前，曾是一只鲤鱼王。如今扑腾的动作，明显更僵硬拘束。
author: coquelicot
source: It's rumored that POKENAME was once a Magikarp before being encased in stone. Its splashing is now noticeably stiffer and more restrained.

entry: 多只POKENAME相聚，会用体内结晶的光，在上方造出极光般的光影表演。景象罕见美丽，被视为世界最壮观的自然奇观之一。
author: sk372
source: When multiple POKENAME gather, they create aurora-like light shows above them using lights from the crystals on their bodies. These rare and beautiful sights are considered one of the greatest natural wonders of the world.

entry: POKENAME长期因壳上珍贵的结晶遭到捕猎。即使如今，也有一队队宝可梦巡护员保护它，阻挡偷猎者。
author: fiordaliso
source: For a long time, POKENAME was hunted for the valuable crystals on its shell. Even today, it is protected by teams of Pokémon Rangers who guard it from poachers.

entry: POKENAME住在有水池的洞穴，通常避开完全淹没的洞，因为喜欢与其他宝可梦相处。它并不稀有，但能在水下隐形，因此很难找。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: POKENAME live in caves with pools of water. They often avoid completely underwater caves as they enjoy being around other Pokémon. They are not rare, but are difficult to find underwater due to their ability to turn invisible.

entry: 洞穴矿工常说工具突然失踪，后来却在POKENAME居住的清澈水池底，发现成堆工具。它虽害羞，谁想拿回物品，仍会被它顽皮地泼水。
author: _subject
source: Cave miners report their tools suddenly going missing, only for piles of them to be found at the bottom of crystal-clear pools where POKENAME reside. Despite being shy, they'll playfully splash anyone that try to take their items back.

entry: 据说它的结晶，能给经历失落的人带来希望与动力。结晶广告常用的口号是：“POKENAME，伴你继续前行。”
author: hophoppip
source: Its crystals are said to provide hope and motivation to those experiencing loss. Advertisements for the crystals often use the slogan “POKENAME with your life”.

entry: POKENAME处理吃下的数据，将其凝结成实体宝石。科学家研究数十年，仍未弄清方法。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME condenses the data it consumes into solid gemstones after processing it. Scientists have studied this phenomenon for decades without uncovering its method.

entry: POKENAME稀有，受矿工追捧，常藏在洞穴最深处、靠近熔岩池的地方。防身手段很少，容易成为饥饿勾魂眼或狡猾矿工的目标。
author: actliux
source: A rare and sought-after Pokémon by miners, POKENAME tend to hide in the deepest parts of caves, often near pools of lava, They have very little means to defend themselves, making them an easy target for hungry Sableye or a cunning miner.

entry: POKENAME帮助珠宝匠，将珍贵宝石镶进戒指和项链。腿虽短，动作却精准，能轻松处理精巧珠宝。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME help jewelers set precious gems into rings and necklaces. Their short yet precise legs allow them to handle delicate jewelry with ease.

entry: POKENAME与宝石雕刻师合作，将宝石雕成艺术品。它小心挥动锋利爪刃，经过它手的每颗宝石，都能成为美丽珠宝。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME work alongside lapidaries to carve gems into works of art. By carefully wielding their sharp claw blades, every gemstone they touch becomes a beautiful piece of jewelry.

entry: POKENAME是大洞穴中的顶尖猎手，捕猎飞行宝可梦。翼上尖晶断落也不伤本体，断口还能留下锋利边缘，用来切开猎物。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are apex predators that hunt flying Pokémon inside large caverns. The sharp crystals on their wings can harmlessly snap off and leave a sharp edge to slice their prey with.

entry: POKENAME住在严寒洞穴深处，十分少见，因为它会用无法穿透的冰墙封住洞口，保护熟睡的小碎钻。
author: mepp.
source: Living deep in frigid caves, POKENAME is rarely seen. This is due to it sealing the cave entrances with impenetrable walls of ice to protect slumbering Carbink.

entry: 它从结晶角射出凝聚光束防身。钻行泥土和岩石时，也会蜕去旧皮，轻易就能磨掉。
author: infinex21
source: It defends itself by firing beams of concentrated light from its crystalline horn. It sheds it old skin as it burrows through ground and rock, which is easily stripped away in the process.

entry: POKENAME住在地下湖深处，极少露面。据说只向心地善良者现身，用结晶角的光沐浴对方，赐予兴旺的祝福。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME lives deep in underground lakes and is rarely seen. It is said to only appear to kind-hearted people, bathing them in a light from their crystalline horn to bless them with prosperity.

entry: POKENAME披着许多锯齿状结晶，常被认为比钻石更珍贵。它能在结晶内储存能量，也能凝聚后释放。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are clad in many jagged crystals oft considered to be more precious than diamonds. They store, and can concentrate and loose, energy inside of their crystals.

entry: 它腹部朝上飞行，沐浴光线。调整翼角，便能凝聚、引导光束，赶走敌人。
author: infinex21
source: It bathes in light as it flies with its belly facing up. By angling its wings, it can concentrate and direct beams of light to fend off foes.

entry: POKENAME尾上的美丽宝石极耐钝击，能发出毁灭光束。POKENAME细心照料，还常特意打磨找到的任何珍贵石头。
author: pkbonusducks
source: The beautiful gemstone on POKENAME's tail is immensely resilient to blunt force and can fire destructive beams. POKENAME take great care of these gems and often go out of their way to polish any valuable stones they find.

entry: POKENAME成小群住在远离人烟的积水洞穴。身上的结晶鳞片，比钢铁更坚硬。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME live in small colonies in waterlogged caverns far from civilization. The crystalline scales covering their bodies are harder than steel.

entry: POKENAME保护族群，猛烈攻击踏入栖身洞穴的生物。过去，人们相信POKENAME不产蜜，而是以某种方式产出宝石，因此到处寻找POKENAME的蜂巢。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME protect their colonies, fiercely attacking those who set foot in the caverns they live in. It was once believed that instead of honey, POKENAME somehow produced precious gemstones; this led to many people searching for hives of POKENAME.

entry: 古代城都的部分地区，曾为取结晶爪捕猎POKENAME，供贵族作奢华装饰。因此，族群变得极稀少、隐居避人，直到现代仍如此。
author: sk372
source: In some regions of ancient Johto, POKENAME was hunted for its crystal talons, used by nobility as ostentatious decorations. The species became very rare and reclusive as a result, even in modern times.

entry: POKENAME拍翅飞到洞壁，寻找珍贵宝石，尤其是蓝宝石与托帕石。找到矿簇后，就用尖牙啃下矿物吃，让闪亮身体更强健。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME flutters up to cave walls in search of precious gems, particularly sapphires and topaz. Once it locates a cluster, it chips away at the minerals with its sharp fangs, consuming them to strengthen its shimmering form.

entry: 它住在地下湖，结晶诱饵放出耀眼蓝光，照亮洞壁。诱饵越大，就越有可能找到伴侣。
author: mistymagius
source: It lives in underground lakes, its crystal lure illuminating the cave walls with a dazzling blue light. The larger its lure, the more likely it is to find a mate.

entry: POKENAME在夜空下闪烁，如小月亮般反射星光。据说凝视它的结晶，能带来好运。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body twinkles under the night sky, reflecting starlight like a tiny moon. It is said that gazing into its crystals brings good fortune.

entry: POKENAME大多时间纹丝不动，静静冥想。若因此窥见未来，结晶双眼就会闪出明亮蓝光。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME spends much of its time standing stock still, quietly meditating. If its meditation leads to it catching a vision of the future, its crystal eyes flash a bright blue.

entry: POKENAME飞行中，流畅挥翼，将钻石羽毛甩向敌人。它是顶尖猎手，拒绝与其他宝可梦分享领地。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME hurls its diamond feathers at enemies with a sinuous sweep of its wings, all while still in flight. It is an apex predator that refuses to share its territory with other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME移动时，羊毛中的静电会让颈部宝石发光。每年旧宝石脱落、新宝石替上，掉落的仍留有部分电力。
author: sk372
source: As POKENAME moves around, electric static in its wool causes the gems around its neck to light up. Each year the gems fall off to be replaced by new ones, the discarded ones still retaining some stored electricity.

entry: POKENAME摆动腰部，身上的宝石便会美丽地反光。有些矿工用POKENAME的动作，预测哪里最适合找宝石。
author: hophoppip
source: When POKENAME sways its hips, the gemstones on its body reflect light beautifully. Some miners use POKENAME's movements to predict the best spots to find gemstones.

entry: POKENAME除非受打扰，否则很少移动。只出没于深洞，常被探险者误认成天然结晶群。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME rarely moves unless disturbed. As it is only found in deep caverns, explorers often mistake it for a natural crystal formation.

entry: POKENAME吃栖身洞穴里的岩石维生，十分喜爱闪亮物，吃石时找到的宝石，都会囤进巢里。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME derives sustenance from eating rock and stone from their cavernous homes. Enamored by sparkling things, any gems found while eating are hoarded in its nest.

entry: POKENAME通常住在积水深洞，地上很少见到。每次被发现，都有人在网络社群发布位置，让研究员得以准确研究它们。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: It is rare to find a POKENAME above ground as they often live deep in flooded caves. There are online communities that post the whereabouts whenever one is spotted. This has allowed researchers to accurately study them.

entry: 它在月光下为构成身体的结晶蓄能，增强身体力量与耐力。POKENAME天性温和，夜里保护弱小宝可梦免遭捕食，总在最需要时出现。
author: fiordaliso
source: It charges the crystals that form its body under the moonlight to increase its physical strength and endurance. Gentle by nature, POKENAME spends its nights protecting weaker Pokémon from predators, appearing at the very moment they are in need.

entry: 超能力者与灵媒珍爱POKENAME掉落的结晶碎片，据说能增强超自然能力。更有光泽的结晶，据说只属于最有智慧的POKENAME。
author: quantumradiation
source: Psychics and mediums treasure broken-off shards of POKENAME's crystals, as they're said to increase one's supernatural abilities. Crystals with increased luster are said to belong only to the wisest of POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME身体结实、守护意识强，会攻击靠洞穴太近的人和宝可梦。POKENAME会用背上宝石反光，短暂晃瞎矿工，将其驱走。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are sturdy and protective, attacking people and Pokémon that wander too close to their burrows. POKENAME are known to ward off miners by momentarily blinding them by reflecting light with the gem on their backs.

entry: POKENAME久居地下深处，双眼大多已退化。需要查看周围时，就感知附近生物的精神气息，身上宝石也会随之发亮。
author: reflecbeat
source: As POKENAME live deep underground, their eyes are mostly atrophied. When they need to look around, they sense the psychic signatures of living things nearby, which makes the gems on their body glow.

entry: POKENAME收集矿物碎片与树皮，加固岩壳。每只都会形成独特图案，没有两只POKENAME相同。
author: fertve
source: POKENAME gathers fragments of minerals and tree bark to reinforce its rocky shell. Each one forms unique patterns, making no two POKENAME alike.

entry: POKENAME体内不稳定的结晶核心，迫使它长出多层厚甲。强化的壳能封住不稳定能量，同时保护自己与附近盟友。
author: fertve
source: The unstable crystal core inside POKENAME forced it to develop multiple thick layers of armor. These reinforced shells help contain its volatile energy while protecting itself and nearby allies.

entry: POKENAME钻入地下深处，挖出内壁满是闪亮结晶的隧道，有时能通往隐藏的宝石富矿脉。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME burrows deep underground, where it forms tunnels lined with sparkling crystal formations. These tunnels sometimes lead to hidden veins of precious gems.

entry: POKENAME吃深埋地下的红宝石。吃得越多，覆满宝石的身体就越强壮坚硬。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME feeds on rubies buried deep within the earth. The more it consumes, the stronger and harder its gem-covered body becomes.

entry: POKENAME把绿柱石碎块囤在小岩缝，长久打磨。一些储存最久的宝石，已泛起近乎透明、宛如玻璃的光泽。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME hoards pieces of beryl inside small rock crevices, polishing them over time. Some of its oldest stored gems have taken on a glassy, near-transparent sheen.

entry: POKENAME大吃富含黄水晶的矿物，身体便泛起金光，不知为何还会散发蜜香。吃得越多，宝石般的甲就越强壮坚固。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME feasts on citrine-rich minerals, causing its body to take on a golden shimmer and somehow produce a honey-like aroma. The more it consumes, the stronger and more durable its gemstone-like armor becomes.

entry: POKENAME背上的壳以炽热岩石为核心，外层接触空气后冷却。喂给POKENAME特定矿物，就能长出美丽结晶，装点身体。
author: beandrawsthings
source: The shell on POKENAME's back is made of a core of hot rock, the outside cooling where it meets the air. When POKENAME is fed certain minerals, it can create beautiful crystalline structures that decorate its body.

entry: POKENAME住在地壳下方的深层隧道，覆满闪亮结晶。结晶耐热、清透，在科技行业变得相当值钱。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME are found in tunnels deep below the crust covered in glittering crystals. These crystals have become quite valuable in the tech sector for their heat resistance and clarity.

entry: 除了结晶尖牙，POKENAME嘴里还有齿舌，覆满微小的结晶齿。研究显示，这些齿比任何其他天然材料都硬。
author: hophoppip
source: In addition to its crystal fangs, POKENAME has a radula covered in microscopic crystal teeth inside its mouth. Studies show these teeth to be harder than any other natural material.

entry: POKENAME挖穿冰洞，寻找冻土中埋藏的蓝宝石。吃到格外纯净的宝石，身体就会闪起淡蓝微光。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME burrows through icy caves in search of sapphires buried in the permafrost. When it eats a particularly pure gemstone, its body sparkles with a faint blue glow.

entry: POKENAME与勾魂眼建立共生关系，提供食物，帮忙清洁。作为交换，勾魂眼会奋力保护它，抵御捕食者和其他威胁。
author: kam_doodle_snek
source: POKENAME has established a symbiotic relationship with Sableye. It provides food and hygiene for the Sableye. In exchange, the Sableye fiercely protect it from predators or other threats.

entry: POKENAME的身体由密实矿物层构成，坚固无比。高速滚动时，身后会留下一道微微发光的尘迹。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body is composed of dense mineral layers, making it incredibly durable. When rolling at high speeds, it leaves behind a faintly glowing dust trail.

entry: POKENAME爱在洞壁画画，用来标记领地。颜料里含有微小结晶，让画在光下如亮粉般闪耀。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME love to draw pictures along cave walls, using these drawings to mark their territories. Due to the microscopic crystals in their paint, these drawings will glisten in the light like glitter.

entry: POKENAME虽能从结晶发出微弱光束，却更喜欢近身作战。它反复击打石壁训练，身上的道道裂痕，就是刻苦的证明。
author: sk372
source: Though it can fire weak light beams from its crystals, POKENAME prefers close-quarters combat. It trains by striking stone walls repeatedly, forming cracks across its body as proof of its dedication.

entry: POKENAME常躺在光滑青金石矿层上休息。结晶身体吸收石头的深蓝色泽，看着仿佛睡在夜空之上。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME is often found resting atop smooth lapis lazuli deposits. Its crystalline body absorbs the stone's deep blue hues, making it appear as though it is sleeping on the night sky.

entry: 它头顶的圆珠，与手中抱着的蛋，由同种结晶材料构成。无论哪颗宝石不见，它都会不惜一切找回来。
author: quackquackattack
source: The Marble atop its head and the egg it holds are made of the same crystalline material. Whenever it loses track of either gem, it will stop at nothing to find it.

entry: POKENAME习惯溜进废矿，偷走孔雀石矿料，把绿色石头囤在深洞，形成隐秘宝库。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME has a habit of sneaking into abandoned mines to steal malachite deposits. It hoards the green stones deep within caves, forming a hidden trove.

entry: POKENAME在结晶洞穴筑巢，囤积最闪亮的石头。开心时，会把发光碎片撒上天空，如流星划过。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME nest in crystal caves, hoarding the shiniest stones. When happy, it scatters glowing shards across the sky like shooting stars.

entry: POKENAME在头上造出结晶冠，晃晕对手。影子般的尾巴才是真身，控制着自己雕成、用来护身的岩石结构。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME construct crystalline crowns along their heads to dazzle and stun opponents. The shadowy tails are actually the true bodies that control the rocky structures they've sculpted to protect them.

entry: POKENAME覆满结晶的外表，能融入岩群。它一动不动数小时，让捕食者误以为只是普通宝石。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's crystal-covered exterior disguises it among rock formations. It remains motionless for hours, tricking predators into believing it is an ordinary gemstone.

entry: 珠宝匠常把POKENAME当作捣蛋鬼。POKENAME一拿到贵重宝石，就会造出假复制品，混在一起抛接玩耍。
author: mega_beedrill
source: POKENAME is often considered a troublemaker by jewelers. Should POKENAME get hold of a valuable gem, it will create fake copies of the gem and proceed to juggle them all together.

entry: 暴风雨时，野生POKENAME通过蓬松尾巴吸收大量电力，让体表结晶强烈发光，毛皮也充满静电。
author: keiracm35_
source: When there are storms, wild POKENAME absorb a large amount of electrical energy through their fluffy tails, which makes the crystals on their bodies glow intensely and their fur become charged with static electricity.

entry: POKENAME住在地下深处，用独特能力磁化宝石，将其吸来，推测是留着以后吃。有理论认为，它们会为住在宝石宫殿的女王，寻找最珍贵的矿石。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME live deep underground, they use their unique ability to magnetize gemstones to pull them in, presumably for later consumption. There is a theory that POKENAME search for the most precious ores for their queen that lives in a gemstone palace.

entry: 最近，野生大岩蛇挖通了有宝可梦沉睡的洞窟，深藏地底的POKENAME群落才被发现。它们身上的结晶，被认为已有数百万年历史。
author: mepp.
source: A colony of POKENAME was recently discovered deep underground after a wild Onix had tunneled through the cavern it had been sleeping in. The crystals growing on its body are thought to be millions of years old.

entry: POKENAME放进设备后常会振动，因为会与许多电子时钟系统内的石英晶体共鸣。它用可拆下的头底部的绒毛，刷拭、打磨自己的宝石。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME often starts vibrating when placed inside a device, since it resonates with the quartz crystal built into many electronic clock systems. To polish its jewels, it uses the fluff at the bottom of its detachable head to brush over them.

entry: POKENAME住进树中，会让树皮冒出奇异结晶，颜色随饮食变化。
author: .izik
source: While inhabiting a tree, POKENAME causes curious crystal growths to appear on the bark. The color of these crystals shifts based on its diet.

entry: POKENAME的钩爪，很适合攀爬洞壁。头上结晶锋利如剃刀，能切开钢铁。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME's hooked claws make them well-suited for scaling cave walls. The crystal on their head is razor-sharp, capable of slicing through steel.

entry: POKENAME住在植物丰富的洞穴。感知到危险，身上结晶就会泛起微光。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME are known to inhabit caves filled with abundant plant life. The crystals along their bodies glow faintly when they sense danger.

entry: POKENAME挖掘深隧道，寻找变石，让结晶身体拥有变色特性。刚吃下后，随光线不同，看起来可能是绿色或红色。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME digs deep tunnels in search of alexandrite, which gives its crystalline body a color-changing quality. Depending on the light, it may appear green or red immediately after eating.

entry: POKENAME挥爪劈敌时，能从爪尖宝石发射光束。POKENAME成群住在地下深处，保护被视为首领的蒂安希。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME uses the gems on the tips of its claws to fire beams when it slashes at foes. POKENAME can be found deep underground in groups that are protecting the Diancie they see as their leader.

entry: POKENAME在地下深处训练，享受高温带来的安适。矿工借POKENAME的踢击，震落大块矿石。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME train deep underground, finding solace in the high temperatures. Miners use POKENAME's kicks to dislodge large chunks of ore.

entry: 它把宝石般的尾巴举向空中，吸收日光，再化为光束防身。颈部白绒能吸水，让它离水数小时后，才需要重新潜入。
author: infinex21
source: It raises its jewel-like tail to the air to absorb sunlight, which it can then release like beams in defense of itself. The white tuft around its neck absorbs water, allowing it to stay out of water for hours before it needs to resubmerge itself.

entry: POKENAME会从头顶的结晶鳍发射高能光束防身。强健后腿能吸收后坐力，让射击时保持稳定。
author: imaginita
source: To defend itself, POKENAME will fire high-energy beams from the crystal fin on the top of its head. Its toughened hind legs are able to absorb the recoil to keep it steady as it fires.

entry: POKENAME喷出高压泥水，将晶洞石从洞壁冲松，搬回自己的池塘，藏起来，不让其他生物发现。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spits high-pressure muddy water to knock geodes loose from cave walls. It carries them back to its pond and hides them from others.

entry: POKENAME住在洞穴系统最深处，通常害羞胆小，直到找到同类。群居后，会用宝石闪光，警告同伴危险靠近。
author: spookypookie.
source: Found living inside the deepest bowels of cave systems, POKENAME are typically shy and timid until they find another one of their own. When living communally, they flash lights from their jewels to warn others of approaching danger.

entry: POKENAME在地下群居，以矿物为食。睡前会一起跳复杂舞蹈，让宝石照亮栖身洞穴。
author: spookypookie.
source: POKENAME lives communally underground and feeds on minerals. Before they go to bed, they perform intricate group dances that allow their jewels to light up the caverns they live in.

entry: POKENAME比对应的艾路雷朵融合体稀少得多，一个地下群落通常只有一只。它担任女首领，用宝石造出绚丽光影表演。
author: spookypookie.
source: POKENAME is much rarer than its Gallade counterparts, typically only one will exist in a given underground community. It acts as a matriarch in its community, using its jewels to create dazzling light shows.

entry: POKENAME能以精神力量，操纵身上和近旁的结晶。它从宝石射出光束，保护珍爱的训练家。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's psychic powers let it manipulate the crystals on its body, as well as any in its immediate vicinity. It fires light beams from the jewels in order to protect its precious Trainer.

entry: POKENAME安静内敛，却是地下群落危险的守护者。手上的宝石，既能当钝器，也能发射强力激光。
author: spookypookie.
source: Despite its quiet and reserved nature, POKENAME is a dangerous guardian of its underground community. It utilizes the jewels on its hands as both blunt weapons and tools to discharge powerful lasers.

entry: 随着POKENAME变老，身体的结晶部分会呈现不同色彩。据说生命达到顶峰时，结晶会泛起虹色，若不及时采下，很快就会褪去。
author: infinex21
source: As POKENAME age, the crystalline parts of their bodies take on differing colors. It is said that at the very climax of their lifespan, their crystals take on a rainbow-like hue that quickly fades if not harvested fast enough.

entry: 它的身体由一团旋转的碎宝石构成，让POKENAME看着美丽，碰起来却危险。
author: just__a__cat
source: Its body consists of a swirling mass of crushed jewels. This makes POKENAME beautiful to look at, but dangerous to touch.

entry: POKENAME庞大沉重，经过时，脚下岩石都会震动。POKENAME用背上宝石，让岩石相互猛撞，直到开出舒适的休息洞穴。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are large and heavy, causing the rocks beneath them to tremble before their presence. POKENAME create burrows by using the gems on their backs to smash rocks into each other until they become a comfortable space to rest.

entry: POKENAME钻进深洞，寻找富含石榴石的土。用强颚磨碎宝石，再吸收其中矿物精华。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME burrows into deep caverns in search of garnet-rich soil. It grinds the gemstones with powerful jaws before absorbing their mineral essence.

entry: POKENAME身上的宝石价值极高，却会在被强行取走时破碎。每百年会像蜕皮般脱落一次，再长出新宝石。它们的寿命可达约一百万年。
author: dukefrogpeasant
source: The gemstones on a POKENAME's body are of great value, but break if forcibly taken from them. Once every hundred years, it will drop the gemstones in a molt-like fashion, to then grow new ones. They can become about a million years old.

entry: POKENAME用坚硬耳朵猛砸结晶簇，凭巨力击碎，再贪婪吞食碎片，让宝石般的身体更强壮。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME slams its hardened ears into clusters of crystals, breaking them apart with sheer force. It then greedily devours the fallen shards, using them to strengthen its gem-like body.

entry: POKENAME吃下大量缟玛瑙后，壳变得近乎无法打破。它常一动不动数小时，完美融入黑暗洞壁。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME has a near-unbreakable shell after consuming large amounts of onyx. It often remains motionless for hours, blending in perfectly with dark cavern walls.

entry: 在萨克斯或钢琴声回荡的爵士乐场所，POKENAME会随乐起舞。舞动时，盾形面部反光，让整个房间泛起柔光。
author: quackquackattack
source: In jazz venues where music from a saxophone or piano fills the air, POKENAME are known to dance to the music. Their dance reflects light from their shield-like faces, which illuminates a room with a soft glow.

entry: 第一只POKENAME被发现时，正睡在矿井深处，四周全是巨大的珍贵矿物群。醒来后吃下大量矿物，最后又睡着了。
author: infinex21
source: The first POKENAME was discovered sleeping deep within a mine, surrounded entirely by large formations of precious minerals. When it became active, it consumed large portions of precious minerals and eventually fell asleep again.

entry: POKENAME粗糙的鬃毛，由数百万岩石纤维构成，帮助保暖，也能用来打磨、磨利宝石爪。
author: pinecone1987
source: POKENAME's coarse manes are made of millions of rock fibers, which help keep them warm. They also use their manes to polish and sharpen their gemstone claws.

entry: 人和其他宝可梦还没察觉可能的塌洞，POKENAME身上的宝石就已发光。虽然会传出诡异的高声尖鸣，POKENAME通常很温顺。
author: bobosmith01
source: Before a potential cave-in becomes perceptible to other Pokémon and humans, the jewels on POKENAME's body have already begun glowing. Although the high-pitched screeching noises that come from them are eerie, POKENAME are usually docile.

entry: POKENAME脸上的水晶球，能折射各方向的光，帮助POKENAME查看四周。一瞥见闪亮宝石，POKENAME就会走去拾取，无论前方有什么阻挡。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: The crystal orb on a POKENAME's face refracts light from all angles, allowing the POKENAME to scan its surroundings. When a POKENAME catches the glimpse of a sparkling gem, it will walk to pick it up no matter what stands in its way.

entry: POKENAME会用嘴里存的水，灌溉衰败的生态环境。水似乎从结晶牙齿中产生，过程却仍是谜。
author: thistleblower
source: POKENAME is known for its tendency to irrigate dying ecosystems with water stored in its mouth. This water seems to manifest from its crystalline teeth, but how the process occurs remains a mystery.

entry: POKENAME容易受惊，会从胸前结晶向任何自认的威胁发射光束。有时也包括其他POKENAME，结果双方光束齐发。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME's skittish nature leads it to fire beams from the crystals around its chest at anything it sees as a threat. This sometimes includes other POKENAME, leading to barrages of beams fired from both parties.

entry: POKENAME吃下的土质越好，身上植物的结晶叶片就越闪亮。可惜宝石嫩芽稀有美丽，让它饱受偷猎之苦。
author: sk372
source: The crystal leaves of POKENAME's plant become more sparkly based on the quality of the soil it eats. The species sadly has a poaching problem, hunted due to the jeweled sprout's rarity and appearance.

entry: POKENAME背上如羊毛的部分，由细玻璃丝构成。受威胁时，POKENAME会向目标射出大团玻璃丝，里面还常嵌着坚硬宝石。
author: turron_turron
source: The wool covering POKENAME's back consists of thin glass filaments. When threatened, POKENAME will propel large chunks of this substance, which is often embedded with hard gemstones, at targets.

entry: POKENAME通过结晶尾巴引导光能，从背上晶洞石内的一点放出。光在许多结晶间反复反射，聚成强力激光，切岩石如切黄油。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME channel light energy through their crystalline tail, releasing it from a spot within the geode on their back. The light bounces through the many crystals within, focusing into a powerful laser that can carve through rock like butter.

entry: POKENAME壳上有一个由结晶植物组成的小生态系统。它的水因纯净而受追捧；据说取树上一片结晶叶，种进花园，能让附近植物更健康。
author: sk372
source: A small ecosystem of crystal plants grow upon POKENAME's shell. Its water is sought for its purity, and planting a crystal leaf from its tree in a garden is said to greatly increase the health of plants that grow near it.

entry: 它用头尾宝石发出的彩色光束，在黑暗洞穴辨路。其中最热的光束，能熔穿坚岩。
author: catsquatch_geography
source: It navigates dark caverns using colored beams of light emitted from the jewels on its head and tail. The hottest of these beams can melt through solid rock.

entry: POKENAME身上的结晶，战斗时会烧得通红。即使脱落，也能热上好几天。
author: .izik
source: The crystals on POKENAME's body grow red hot during combat. Even after breaking off they retain their heat for days.

entry: POKENAME用炽热拳击熔化洞壁岩石，松动其中红宝石。吃下一颗，火焰强度最高能增加50%，持续整整一天。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's fiery hot punches melt the stone around cavernous walls to loosen rubies. Consuming one can increase its flame strength by up to 50 percent for a full day.

entry: POKENAME眼睛上方有特殊腺体，滤除血液多余盐分，得以靠海水生存。多余的钠让头周围结出盐，能由专业人士采集。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: To survive on seawater, POKENAME possess specialized glands above their eyes that filter excess salt from their bloodstream. The excess sodium creates a salt buildup around their heads, which can be harvested by specialists.

entry: POKENAME用鳍的尖端，从洞壁切下宝石吃。有些训练家将这份本领用于艺术，雕刻岩石等材料。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses the sharp tips of its flippers to carve gems out of cavern walls so it can eat them. Some Trainers have taken to using its skills in artistry, carving sculptures out of stone and similar materials.

entry: POKENAME用刀刃钻入地下深处，寻找洞穴。主食是结晶与盐，偶尔也会到地面喝河水。
author: bigoljax
source: Using their blades, POKENAME can drill deep into the ground to find caves. Their main diet consists of crystals and salt, though they occasionally come to the surface to drink river water.

entry: POKENAME的结晶鼻有特殊嗅觉，轻易就能闻出藏在洞壁和地下深处的宝石，再用独特磁力取出吃掉。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's crystal nose gives it a special sense of smell allowing it to easily sniff out gems deep within cave walls and the ground. A unique magnetism allows it to extract these jewels so it can consume them.

entry: POKENAME用似乎永不会变钝的结晶身体，劈斩敌人。它大多时间都在岩石上磨蹭，打亮自己的表面。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME slashes through foes with its crystal body that never seems to get dull. It spends much of its time rubbing against rocks to polish its shiny surface.

entry: POKENAME终生住在深洞系统，开采宝石装点身体。有记录称，它们开凿过雷文市大小的矿洞，容纳超过200只POKENAME及其他宝可梦。
author: _pixelar_
source: POKENAME live their entire lives in deep cave systems, mining for precious stones to decorate their bodies with. There are records of POKENAME-made mines the size of Nimbasa City, housing more than 200 POKENAME and other Pokémon.

entry: 尼多力诺原来硬如钻石的角，如今换成真正的钻石角，反倒稍软一些。不过，能发射能量束，足以弥补。
author: hophoppip
source: Nidorino's horn, as hard as a diamond, has been replaced by a horn made of actual diamond. As such, it's slightly less hard, but its ability to fire energy beams makes up for it.

entry: POKENAME的钻石刀刃，近乎无法摧毁。精准战法与醒目外观，让它成为华丽大赛强壮、帅气项目的绝佳选手。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME's diamond blades are nearly indestructible. Its precise fighting style and striking appearance make it a perfect contender in Toughness and Coolness Contests.

entry: 据说卡洛斯战争期间，高级官员曾用POKENAME作护卫。它的身体，几乎和刀刃一样锋利。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME were said to be used by high-ranking officials during the Kalos War as guards. Their bodies are nearly as sharp as their blades are.

entry: POKENAME大吃橄榄石矿后，身体会微微闪烁。黑暗中放出柔和绿光，看清漆黑隧道。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body sparkles faintly after feasting on peridot deposits. It emits a soft, green light in the dark, allowing it to see through pitch-black tunnels.

entry: POKENAME常与小碎钻同住，奋力保护它们，连自己群落以外的也不例外。因此，附近小碎钻一被勾魂眼或尖牙陆鲨袭击，就常能看见POKENAME冲向敌人。
author: slavman9057
source: A POKENAME often lives alongside Carbink, and is fiercely protective of them, even those outside its own colony. Because of this, it's not uncommon to see a POKENAME charging at a Sableye or Gabite that tried attacking a nearby Carbink as a result.

entry: POKENAME用结晶扭曲周围的光，制造幻象。但只对视觉有效，等对手识破伪装，还得靠岩甲护身。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME creates illusions by distorting light around it with its crystals. These are only visual illusions, so POKENAME's rocky armor protects it when its opponent finally sees through its facade.

entry: 它用触须的结晶尖端折光，能凝聚成精准强大的光束。除了颈部白毛，身体硬如钻石。
author: infinex21
source: It uses the crystalline tips of its feelers to refract light; it can concentrate light enough to create precise and powerful beams. Its body is as hard as diamond, save for the white fur around its neck.

entry: POKENAME聚集体内结晶吸收的光能，驱动操纵空间的能力。它惯住地壳深处，很少有人亲眼见过。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME gathers up light energy absorbed by the crystals in its body to power its space manipulation abilities. Few have seen it in person due to how deep within the planet's crust it tends to live.

entry: POKENAME躲避一切接触，逼自己雕出结晶小像，盼着赋予生命。可每次都失败，便越挖越深，退向洞穴深处。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME keep themselves sheltered from any type of contact, forcing themselves to build small statues made of crystal, hoping they can give them life. With each attempt, they fail, digging themselves deeper and deeper into the caves they reside in.

entry: POKENAME领地意识极强，闯入家中洞穴的一切，都会受到攻击。背炮能向敌人发射石头与光束。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: POKENAME are very territorial, attacking anything that enters their home caves. The cannon on their back fires rocks and beams at foes.

entry: POKENAME宝石般的身体，在月光下泛着柔光，如星辰闪烁。有人相信，睡在附近的宝可梦会做安宁的梦。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's gemstone-like body glows softly under moonlight, resembling a twinkling star. Some believe Pokémon that sleep near it will experience peaceful dreams.

entry: POKENAME的结晶花朵，是许多不同艺术作品喜爱的题材。花上反射的光能让人睁不开眼，POKENAME会借此扰乱对手。
author: quantumradiation
source: The crystalline flowers of POKENAME make it a popular subject of many different art pieces. Light that reflects off these flowers can be blinding, which POKENAME uses in battle to distract its opponents.

entry: 废物场里，POKENAME的宝石在丢弃的毛绒玩具旁发光。它寻找受珍爱的玩偶，收藏进如宝库般的深洞巢穴。
author: .izik
source: In landfills, POKENAME's gems glow near discarded stuffed toys. It seeks out beloved ones to store in its cavernous, treasure-like den.

entry: POKENAME周身的覆盖层由纯结晶构成，必须一直用精神力量悬浮。若因外力坠地，全身都会出现巨大裂缝。
author: bigoljax
source: The coating around POKENAME's body is made of pure crystal, and they constantly have to use psychic power to keep their bodies afloat. If they hit the ground due to an outside force, massive cracks form along their entire bodies.

entry: 月亮最明亮时，POKENAME岩石身躯上的宝石就会发光。它们会寻找其他POKENAME，在月下共舞。
author: quackquackattack
source: Whenever the moon shines brightest in the sky, the gems across POKENAME's rocky body begin to glow. They seek out other POKENAME to dance under the moonlight.

entry: 它的结晶闪闪发亮，光强得足以灼伤。曾有它在栖身的黑暗洞穴里，引矿工走错路的记录。
author: hophoppip
source: Its crystals glimmer and glow with a light strong enough to cause burns. It's been known to lead miners astray in the dark caves it calls home.

entry: POKENAME常在地下深处，打磨体表结晶，守护栖身洞穴。民间传说称，POKENAME由蒂安希创造，用来保护小碎钻群落。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME are commonly found deep underground, polishing the crystals on their bodies and protecting the caverns they reside in. In folklore, POKENAME were created by Diancie to protect colonies of Carbink.

entry: 珠宝店让POKENAME变成顾客想要的戒指，将盗窃风险降到最低。偷走POKENAME的小偷，得赶在少根手指前，求商场保安帮忙。
author: quackquackattack
source: Jewelry outlets make POKENAME morph into rings that patrons desire so that there is a minimal risk of theft. Thieves who escape with a POKENAME need help from mall security before they lose a finger.

entry: POKENAME翱翔无垠天空，寻找格外关爱宝可梦的训练家。一找到特别善良的训练家，结晶翅膀就会欣喜地振动鸣响。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME soar through the endless sky searching for Trainers who have shown exceptional love for their Pokémon. Their crystal wings vibrate and ring with joy whenever they locate a particularly kind Trainer.

entry: POKENAME从附近洞穴收集宝石，囤进隧道内临时辟出的藏宝室。隧道如迷宫，充满陷坑，还有肉眼看来一模一样的走廊。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME gathers gems from nearby cave systems and stores them in makeshift treasure rooms within their tunnels. These tunnels are labyrinthine, filled with pitfalls and corridors that all look identical to the naked eye.

entry: POKENAME每挨一次打，身体和变强的决心都会更坚实。当结晶部分开始不断散出可见光晕，就表示POKENAME快要进化。
author: sk372
source: Every strike against POKENAME hardens its body and its resolve to grow stronger. When aura is seen visibly and constantly emanating from the crystalline parts of its body, POKENAME is nearing evolution.

entry: POKENAME在宝石丰富的洞穴筑巢。不饿时动作很慢，甚至会趴在用爪挖出、本打算大吃一顿的宝石上睡着。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME form their dens within caves and caverns rich with precious stones. They move very slowly when they are not hungry and may even fall asleep atop the precious stones they have dug out with their claws to gorge upon.

entry: POKENAME精力旺盛，始终活跃，谁打扰就会立刻遭到攻击。爪子比钻石还硬，轻易就能挖出矿物吃。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME is constantly active because it is brimming with energy and will quickly lash out at anything that disturbs it. Its claws are harder than diamond, allowing it to easily dig in search of minerals to consume.

entry: POKENAME住在地下湖，把覆满宝石的腹部露出水面，引来勾魂眼等吃石头的生物。受骗猎物爬上身体，它便潜下去，将其吞食。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME lives in subterranean lakes where it exposes its gem-covered belly above the water's surface to lure geovores like Sableye. When the tricked prey climb upon it, POKENAME submerges to feed on them.

entry: POKENAME迷路时，会放出小火花，经洞壁结晶反射，形成信标，帮助妈妈找到。群体虽由雄性小猫率领，幼年POKENAME却只听雌性的。
author: periperi_chicken
source: When a POKENAME gets lost, it will make small sparks that reflect against crystals embedded in the cave walls, creating a beacon to help its mother find it. Despite the packs being led by a male Caray, young POKENAME only listen to the females.

entry: POKENAME散发强大气场，据说水晶尾巴内蕴藏着远古力量。它是纯洁的化身。
author: astrael1
source: POKENAME emits a powerful aura, and it's rumored to contain ancient strength within its crystal tails. It embodies purity.

entry: POKENAME有歌坛明星般的个性，吸引许多生物来做观众。头顶发光宝石，引起众多野生宝可梦注意，留下听它唱歌。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME charm many into becoming their audience with their diva-like personalities. The glowing gem atop their head draws the attention of many wild Pokémon, who stay to listen to their songs.

entry: POKENAME住在深穴，吃富碳岩石，强化晶体铠甲。可甲层太厚，POKENAME又会难以行动。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME lives in deep caves, eating the carbon-rich rock to help strengthen its crystalline armor. However, if the armor gets too thick, POKENAME starts to have difficulty moving around.

entry: POKENAME体表的白色矿物，虽与外层结晶甲同样坚韧，却并不很硬。常能看见POKENAME下巴搁在洞底，其他小型宝可梦也靠着休息。
author: bobosmith01
source: Although still just as tough as its outer crystalline armor, the white minerals on POKENAME's body are actually not very hard. It isn't uncommon to see POKENAME with its chin resting on the cavern floor with other small Pokémon leaning on it, too.

entry: POKENAME颚中满是极锋利的钻石牙，磨碎吞下的一切。它在洞穴的岩石地面挖隧道，设下可怕伏击。
author: fiordaliso
source: The jaws of POKENAME are packed with countless extremely sharp diamond teeth, which it uses to grind up everything it swallows. It digs tunnels through the rocky floors of caves to set terrible ambushes.

entry: POKENAME振动结晶翅膀，让洞里的超音蝠和大嘴蝠保持安全距离，自在游荡。战斗时，会用力量宝石，将钻石般硬的结晶碎片甩向敌人。
author: fiordaliso
source: By vibrating its crystal wings, POKENAME keeps the Zubat and Golbat living in caves at a safe distance, allowing it to roam undisturbed. When it battles, it hurls shards of diamond-hard crystal at its enemies using Power Gem.

entry: POKENAME齿轮上的齿，因不停转动而光滑闪亮。它们爱高速旋转，因为喜欢那空灵、回荡的鸣响。
author: periperi_chicken
source: The teeth of POKENAME's gears are smooth and shiny from constant rotation. They like to spin at high speeds because they love the ethereal, resonant ringing it makes.

entry: POKENAME通过尾上结晶折光，造出灿烂闪光。棱镜角度合适时，就能聚光，以凝聚的热量引起小火花。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME refract light through the crystals on their tails to create brilliant sparkling displays. If they angle their prisms correctly, they can focus the beams to create small sparks from the concentrated heat.

entry: POKENAME是优雅的歌手，清澈嗓音让观众赞叹。据说连传说的宝可梦都能听哭，不过大概是夸张。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are graceful singers who amaze audiences with their crystal-clear voices. Their songs are said to move legendary Pokémon to tears, though this is likely hyperbole.

entry: POKENAME埋入地下时，周围会长出美丽结晶花。这些花稀有，曾被用于价值连城的雕塑。
author: lydiaprower8
source: When POKENAME buries itself in the ground, beautiful crystal flowers grow around it. These flowers are rare and have been used in priceless sculptures.

entry: 它们在富含矿物与营养的地下水池旁，组成紧密群体，很少远离。研究员追踪族群数量与移动，研究长期气候趋势。
author: brilliantdarkness
source: They live in tight-knit social groups near mineral- and nutrient-rich groundwater pools, rarely venturing far. Researchers track their populations and movements to study long-term climate trends.

entry: POKENAME成群捕猎，用闪亮的珠宝身躯引来毫无防备的人。有人靠得太近，就会被整群以丝状手臂缠住，拖进深洞。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME hunt in swarms, using their twinkling, bejewelled bodies to lure unsuspecting humans. Once someone gets too close, the group ensnares them with their stringy arms and drags them deep into their caves.

entry: POKENAME住在地下湖，水中丰富矿物让胶状身体保持韧性。它用意念从地面与洞壁拔出宝石，装点岩石核心。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME inhabits underground lakes, the high mineral content of the water helping keep its gelatinous form resilient. It uses telekinesis to pull gems from the ground and walls to decorate its stone core with.

entry: POKENAME成群来到废矿井，吃矿工留下的宝石碎屑。碎片被身体吸收，让双翼泛起反光的光泽。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME flock to abandoned mineshafts to eat shards of gems miners leave behind. The gem shards get absorbed into their bodies, which gives their wings a reflective shimmer.

entry: 它一次花好几个小时，打磨、凝视尾巴握着的钻石。有人说，POKENAME是贪婪愚人的灵魂转世。
author: hophoppip
source: It spends hours at a time polishing and gazing at the diamond held in its tail. Some say that POKENAME are the reincarnated spirits of greedy fools.

entry: POKENAME成群进洞休息，领地意识极强。休息时若有人进入，宝石般的眼就会因愤怒发亮，再向入侵者喷出阵阵余烬。
author: .izik
source: Flocks of POKENAME inhabit caves when they need to rest. Highly territorial, their gem-like eyes glow with rage should anyone enter while they rest, before firing bursts of embers at the intruder.

entry: POKENAME最近才在火山洞穴深处被发现。它从体表结晶放出灼热光束防身。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME was recently discovered living deep inside volcanic caverns. It defends itself by shooting scorching beams from the crystalline parts of its body.

entry: 它的大翅膀在光下闪亮，宛如雕刻师嵌进了一千片海边的玻璃。事实也相差不远，它会取玻璃或结晶碎片，添到翅膀上。
author: quackquackattack
source: Its large wings sparkle in the light as though a sculptor wedged a thousand pieces of Beach Glass into them. The reality is not far off, as it takes pieces of glass or crystal and adds the pieces to its wings.

entry: POKENAME对托帕石贪得无厌，连看守最严的宝石藏库也会偷。得手后，身体就会闪着点点金光。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME has an insatiable appetite for topaz and will steal from even the most well-guarded gem caches. Its body glistens with golden flecks after a successful heist.

entry: POKENAME常见于大型富矿洞穴，沿能爬到的任何表面，寻找矿物与宝石啃食。受威胁时，会从身体的宝石部分放出强光。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are common sights within large, mineral-rich caverns. They scuttle along any surface they can in search of minerals and gems to nibble upon. If they feel threatened, they will emit bright light from the jewel parts of their bodies.

entry: 人们发现绵长的古生物洞穴时，常将其与POKENAME联系起来，因为洞壁散布着数百结晶。附近洞画描绘过古人与POKENAME相遇的场面。
author: bigoljax
source: Findings of long paleoburrows are often connected to POKENAME, as these burrows have hundreds of crystals scattering along the walls. Cave paintings found near these burrows depict ancient people coming into contact with a POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME体内如晶洞，满是数千结晶。张嘴就能发出强力光束，晃瞎被击中的生物。
author: santon5512
source: The insides of POKENAME's bodies are like geodes, filled with thousands of crystals. Upon opening their mouths, they can fire powerful beams of light, blinding anyone they hit.

entry: 它活力十足地跳舞，挥动尖端有结晶的双臂。光通过这些结晶绒球反射，造出耀眼光景。
author: hophoppip
source: It performs energetic dances, waving its crystal-tipped arms about. Light is reflected through these crystal pom-poms to create a dazzling display.

entry: POKENAME舞动时，结晶翅膀折射光，投出催眠图案，令亡灵与生者都着迷。突然的动作会打乱节奏，引发灼热的棱镜能量爆发，驱赶入侵者。
author: vhscopyofmeangirls
source: POKENAME's dance refracts light through its crystalline wings, casting hypnotic patterns that mesmerize both spirits and the living. Sudden movements shatter its rhythm, triggering a searing burst of prismatic energy to repel intruders.

entry: POKENAME吃下的垃圾，会在体内慢慢凝聚。每月一次，咳出一颗由此形成、形状完美的宝石。
author: .izik
source: The trash POKENAME consumes slowly condenses within its body over time. Once per month, it coughs up a perfectly formed gemstone produced by this process.

entry: 它在城市废墟寻找垃圾吃，在核心内以化学方式提炼，让全身长出锯齿状结晶。受威胁时，体内宝石便引导能量，释放棱镜光束。
author: shivaequinox
source: It scours city ruins to consume refuse, chemically refining the waste within its core to produce jagged crystals across its body. When threatened, the gems embedded in its body channel internal energy to discharge prismatic beams of light.

entry: POKENAME成群住在满是结晶的湖。结晶不断强化POKENAME的牙齿，让咬力惊人。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME lives in swarms in crystal-filled lakes, where the crystals build up POKENAME's teeth, making its bite incredibly powerful.

entry: 许多人相信，孩子若一直迷失在洞中，就有可能变成POKENAME。据说看进它的结晶，能看见幽灵般的脸。
author: periperi_chicken
source: Many believe that if a child remains lost in a cave, they have a chance of becoming a POKENAME. It is said that if you look into its crystals, you can see ghostly faces.

entry: POKENAME用超声波，寻找岩层下藏着的蓝宝石。只喜欢最深蓝的石头，因为能强化结晶身体。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses ultrasonic waves to locate sapphires hidden beneath layers of rock. It prefers only the deepest blue stones, as they strengthen its crystalline body.

entry: POKENAME在发光洞穴中，大吃欧泊矿，留下闪亮粉尘。飞行时，粉尘反射月光，让它如一座移动星座。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME feasts on opal formations in glowing caves, leaving behind shimmering dust. When it flies, the dust reflects moonlight, making it appear like a moving constellation.

entry: POKENAME翼上的结晶不断生长，最终会从蓬松外层伸出来。长到这时，额外重量会让POKENAME很难持续飞行。
author: sk372
source: Crystals grow on POKENAME's wings to the point that they will eventually begin poking out from behind their fluffy coating. When the crystals have grown to that point, their extra weight causes POKENAME difficulty staying airborne.

entry: POKENAME冰冷的外层，是坚硬如宝石的甲壳，让它能承受大多数冰属性宝可梦难熬的高温与干旱。无论环境如何，核心始终冰冷刺骨。
author: jadey.1557
source: The icy exterior of POKENAME is a hard, gem-like carapace. This allows it to endure high temperatures and arid conditions that most other Ice-type Pokémon would struggle with. Its core remains freezing cold regardless of environment.

entry: 光通过POKENAME的宝石花瓣折射，被光束照到的生物，都会不适恶心。即便如此，特别痴迷的石头收藏家，仍愿承受这些影响。
author: pizzarcato
source: Light refracted through POKENAME's gemstone petals causes discomfort and nausea for anyone hit by the beams. Despite this, especially devoted rock collectors still choose to suffer the ill effects.

entry: POKENAME柔软的身体覆满宝石，力量却出乎意料。它能举起大自身许多倍的巨石，存进地下洞穴，用途未知。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's soft, gemstone-covered body is deceptively strong. It can lift boulders many times its size, storing them in underground caverns for unknown purposes.

entry: POKENAME用宝石照亮黑暗洞穴和隧道，对采矿业极有帮助。不过，只喜欢高品质结晶，不合标准就会扔掉。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is incredibly useful in the mining industry, using its gemstones to light up dark caves and tunnels. However, it only likes its high-quality crystals and will throw away any that are not up to its standards.

entry: POKENAME沙状身体内的宝石，一察觉附近有猎物就会发光。它趁猎物熟睡偷偷靠近，若被发现，就僵在原地。
author: .izik
source: The gems within POKENAME's sand-like body glow when it senses prey nearby. It sneaks toward them while they sleep, freezing in place if spotted.

entry: POKENAME大群吸取树根养分，看着并非只把树杀死，而是将其石化。POKENAME用这些石质树皮筑巢。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: POKENAME drains nutrients from tree roots in large swarms. Rather than simply killing the tree, this seems to petrify it into stone. POKENAME build their nests out of this stony bark.

entry: 数亿年前，POKENAME住在冰冻苔原边缘的洞穴。夜里闪亮的褶边如极光，受到古人崇拜。人们相信，它们是大竺猪的远祖。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: Hundreds of millions of years ago, POKENAME resided in caves near the end of frozen tundras. Ancient people worshipped them, as their glistening frills in the night resembled auroras. It is believed that they are the distant ancestors of Megaswine.

entry: POKENAME看似独居，却有满月时成群聚集、吸收月光能量的记录，景象堪称自然界最壮观的光影表演之一。
author: arveral
source: While POKENAME appears to be solitary, its been documented that herds of them will gather under a full moon to feed on its energy, resulting in one of the most spectacular light shows in all of nature.

entry: 深处嵌满宝石的洞穴，偶尔会有POKENAME演出。它们一边合唱，一边从平台射出光束，增添奇观。POKENAME容易受惊，只为信任的训练家表演。
author: chibitales
source: Deep, gem-lined caves are uncommonly host to POKENAME performances. As they harmonize together, they fire beams from their platforms to add to the spectacle. POKENAME are known to be skittish and will only perform for Trainers they trust.

entry: POKENAME挖出结晶与宝石吃，获取养分。背上的结晶能放出强光，让敌人晕头转向。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME derive nutrients from the crystals and gems they dig up and eat. They can emit bright lights from the crystals on their backs to disorient enemies.

entry: POKENAME的结晶翼裂开后，碎片仍会漂在身旁。每片都映着断裂的那一刻，即使已过去几十年。
author: jaminmcready
source: When POKENAME's crystal wings crack, the shattered fragments continue floating around it. Each fragment displays the exact moment it broke, even if that moment occurred decades ago.

entry: POKENAME变换形态时，迅速长出晶体，再利用体内反射的阳光，射出一道道光束。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME rapidly produces crystals upon shifting form. It shoots beams of light from the sun rays reflecting within its body.

entry: POKENAME的结晶鳞光滑，活动身体时就会叮当响。敲击POKENAME头顶的鳞片，会发出回荡的鸣响。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have smooth, crystalline scales that jingle whenever they move their body. The scale atop a POKENAME's head produces a resonant ring when struck.

entry: POKENAME住在含有珍贵宝石的洞穴，先用体表宝石晃晕猎物，再用镶钻的利爪劈斩。
author: theredemerald
source: Found in caverns containing precious gems, POKENAME uses the gems on its body to bedazzle its prey, before slashing the victim with its diamond-encrusted claws.

entry: POKENAME漂过洞穴，体表蓝晶散着柔和白光。看见宝石被动过，结晶就会亮成深红，再用月亮之力攻击附近所有生物。
author: .izik
source: The blue crystals on POKENAME's body emit a soft white glow as it drifts through caverns. When it sees gemstones are disturbed, its crystals blaze crimson before it attacks anyone nearby with Moonblast.

entry: POKENAME覆着柔软毛皮，眼睛与触角由宝石构成。一生都用毛皮打磨双眼，年龄越大，视力便越精准。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME's body is covered in a soft pelt, their eyes and antennae made of jewels. They use their fur to polish their eyes throughout their lives, their vision becoming more fine-tuned as they age.

entry: POKENAME从手臂长出粗木，挖取洞壁宝石。若吃下绿松石，附近洞穴的苔藓就会加速生长。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME grows thick pieces of wood from its arms to excavate gems from cavern walls. Should it consume turquoise, nearby cave moss grows at an accelerated rate.

entry: POKENAME的身体由密实岩石与结晶构成，几乎无法被任何常规攻击穿透。它在深洞静静冥想，但感知小型宝可梦遇险，就会跃起保护。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's body, made up of dense stone and crystal, is nearly impenetrable to any sort of conventional attack. It resides deep in cavern areas, quietly meditating, though it leaps to the defense of smaller Pokémon it senses are in danger.

entry: POKENAME的棍子由结晶精雕而成。用它生火时，火焰会呈现美丽浅色，边烧边闪亮。
author: sk372
source: The stick POKENAME wields is carefully and meticulously carved out of crystal. When creating fire with it, the flames on the stick turn a beautiful pale color and sparkle as they burn.

entry: 凝视POKENAME身上的宝石，会陷入催眠状态。POKENAME借此迷惑捕食者和猎物，再困进火焰漩涡。
author: dodoowner_
source: Staring into the jewels adorning POKENAME's body induces a hypnotic state. POKENAME utilizes this effect to its benefit, disorienting predators and prey alike before it entraps them in a fiery vortex.

entry: POKENAME住在结晶洞穴，身姿灵巧，能穿过巨大晶柱间的曲折通道。泡沫围巾看似柔软，其实由细小结晶纤维构成。
author: vic1312
source: Residing in crystalline caves, POKENAME use their nimble form to navigate the twists and turns between massive crystal columns. Their foam scarf appears to be made of a soft material, but is truly formed from small crystal fibers.

entry: POKENAME搜寻宝石，耗费漫长时间，将其磨成刀刃武器。谁来打扰，就会迅速向其甩出结晶碎片。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME scavenges for gemstones, spending countless hours honing them into bladed weapons. Should anyone interrupt it, it will swiftly fling shards of crystal at the interloper.

entry: POKENAME运送大量煤炭，哪里需要就去哪里。虽然沉重，却跑得相当快，时速可达18英里。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME takes large amounts of coal wherever it's needed. It's able to run rather quickly for its weight, clocking in at 18mph.

entry: POKENAME因美丽的结晶双翼受到觊觎。光穿过时，结晶闪出万千色彩，月光下尤其美丽。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are coveted for the beauty of their crystalline wings. Their crystals glitter a myriad of colours when light is shone through them and are at their most beautiful under the light of the moon.

entry: POKENAME只在午夜时分，被见到漂荡于黑暗深洞。宝石放出诡异光芒，如黑暗中浮现恶意的笑脸，令旅人惊恐。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is only ever seen floating around in the midnight hours deep within dark caverns. Its gems emit an eerie glow that terrifies travelers, looking like a malevolent grinning face looming from within the darkness.

entry: POKENAME比任何人造检测仪器，都更能分辨矿物纯度的细微差别。为免宝石弄脏，POKENAME成群用舌头互相清洁。
author: distinguishedmanlygentleman
source: POKENAME can distinguish the faintest of differences in the purity of minerals better than any manmade testing device. To prevent their gems from becoming filthy, packs of POKENAME use their tongues to clean each other's gems.

entry: POKENAME蓬松的软垫摸着粗糙，因为嵌着数千细小矿屑。过去，许多纺纱设备曾被这些绒毛毁坏，损失高达数千。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME's fluffy pad is rough to the touch because of the thousands of tiny mineral bits stuck in it. Many yarn-spinning devices have been destroyed due to this fluff in the past, causing damage worth well into the thousands.

entry: POKENAME虽能活到数百万岁，性情却顽皮，喜欢恶作剧。最爱假装宝石雕像，趁没人看时偷偷移动。
author: torterrable
source: Though POKENAME can live to be millions of years old, it has a mischievous personality and likes to play tricks. One of its favorites is pretending to be a jeweled statue, then moving around when no one is looking.

entry: POKENAME常看着像雕像，一听欢庆音乐，却会立刻跳舞。宝石身体的中空部分如钟鸣，配合节拍伴奏。
author: torterrable
source: Though it often looks like a statue, POKENAME bursts into dance when it hears festive music. The hollow parts of its gemstone body act as chimes to keep time with the beat.

entry: POKENAME刚孵化时十分脆弱，钻石要在栖身的臭氧层压力下，随时间形成。科学家据此，推算出高层大气与外太空的压力。
author: _pixelar_
source: When a POKENAME hatches from an egg it is very vulnerable, as its diamonds only form over time in the pressure of the ozone layer where it lives. From this data scientists have deduced the pressure present in the upper atmosphere and outer space.

entry: POKENAME主要住在火山活动区附近的洞穴。野外对手会激烈交战，试图折断对方一只结晶角，证明支配地位。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is primarily found in caverns located near volcanic activity. Rivals in the wild fight each other aggressively, aiming to break one of the other's crystalline horns as a sign of dominance.

entry: POKENAME住在黑暗晶洞的水池。许多洞穴探险者寻找它，想借闪亮身躯，邀请恋人约会。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME can be found in pools in dark crystal caves. Many spelunkers have sought out this Pokémon to ask out their lover with its shiny body.

entry: POKENAME住在黑暗晶洞的水池。许多洞穴探险者寻找它，想借闪亮身躯，邀请恋人约会。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME can be found in pools in dark crystal caves. Many spelunkers have sought out this Pokémon to ask out their lover with its shiny body.

entry: POKENAME常替珠宝匠守护货品，用尖端带宝石的爪劈向小偷，阻止犯罪。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can often be found working for jewelers as guards to protect merchandise. They slash at thieves with their gem-tipped claws to prevent crime.

entry: POKENAME会戴上仿制珠宝，吸引顾客进店。它极力维护外表，与其他宝可梦相处时，姿态十分傲慢。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can be seen wearing replicas of jewelry to convince people to enter the retail outlet. They take great pride in maintaining their appearance and act pompously around other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME把结晶喙浸进矿泉水，保持光亮。它常在洞穴或湖边游荡，寻找树果吃。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME keeps their crystalline bill polished by submerging the bill in mineral water. They can be found wandering in caves or around lakes looking for berries to eat.

entry: POKENAME成对守在洞外，对入侵者吼叫，大声得能引发岩崩，堵住入口。训练家若赢得POKENAME信任，便能进洞，获赠大批宝石。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME sit in pairs outside of caves, roaring at any intruders loud enough to cause a rockslide to collapse the entrance. If a Trainer gains the trust of POKENAME, they will be permitted into the cave and rewarded with troves of jewels.

entry: POKENAME稀有，住在洞穴，以地下溪边的宝石矿为食。腹部绒毛能透水透气，直接将水分与氧气吸进体内。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME is a rare cave-dwelling Pokémon that feeds on gemstone deposits near underground streams. The fluff on its abdomen is permeable, allowing it to absorb moisture and oxygen directly into its body.

entry: 它用镐深入洞穴，挖掘稀有宝石。人们相信，吃下宝石能增强智慧与精神力量，因此它才这样做。
author: sk372
source: It uses its pick to dig deep in caverns for rare jewels. It's believed that it does this because consuming the gems increases its intellect and psychic powers.

entry: POKENAME吃深洞的蓝宝石，强化石质身体。一拳就能推倒小楼。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME strengthens its stony body by eating sapphires found deep in caves. With one punch, it can topple a small building.

entry: POKENAME出乎意料地柔韧敏捷，躲避攻击，免得构成身体的岩石与宝石受污。若真弄脏，嘴里能吐出液体，几秒内溶掉污垢。
author: sk372
source: Surprisingly flexible and agile, POKENAME dodges away from attacks so they won't tarnish the rock and gems that make up its body. If it does get dirty, it can spit a fluid from its mouth that melts away the grime in seconds.

entry: 野生POKENAME飞在满是结晶的洞中，从闪亮腹部射出明亮热束，再经尾尖宝石聚焦，如激光般攻击。
author: .jerden
source: Wild POKENAME fly around inside caverns full of crystals. They attack foes by firing bright beams of heat from their glittering belly, passing these beams through the gemstone at the tip of their tail to focus them like lasers.

entry: POKENAME的壳由坚固结晶构成。将身体缩进壳中旋转，便会向四面射光，晃瞎捕食者。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME's shells are made of a durable crystal. By tucking their bodies inside and spinning, they release beams of light in all directions, blinding predators.

entry: POKENAME身体分开时，体内晶洞的结晶遇光闪耀。它一直待在黑暗洞穴，避免被寻找闪亮物的训练家和宝可梦拐走。
author: quackquackattack
source: Whenever POKENAME splits apart, the geode inside its body shimmers as light strikes the crystal formation. It remains in dark caves to avoid being kidnapped by Trainers and Pokémon looking for shiny objects.

entry: 它把粉笔石块扔向其他宝可梦，没什么缘由，只因为对方在那里。偶尔，对方会把石块丢回，单方面的投掷就变成了游戏。
author: quackquackattack
source: It hurls chunks of Chalky Stone at other Pokémon, for no particular reason other than the fact that they are there. On occasion, other Pokémon will return the tossed chunk, which turns the one-sided affair into a game.

entry: POKENAME如钻石的外壳，被认为是人类目前所知最坚固的物质之一。有理论认为，它连星球核心的高压高热也能承受。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's diamond-like shell is considered one of the sturdiest substances known to humans at this time. It's theorized it could even survive the pressure and heat of the planet's core.

entry: 角是POKENAME最大的骄傲。断角的POKENAME，常会与角完好的个体打架，心怀怨恨，想把对方的结晶角也打碎。
author: xenellia
source: POKENAME's horn is its greatest pride. POKENAME with broken horns can often be seen fighting those with intact ones, attempting to shatter their crystal appendage out of spite.

entry: 最初在野外遇见POKENAME的人，以为只是精巧雕像，直到碰触时有了反应。POKENAME太心不在焉，一天大多数时间，只是忘了移动。
author: sk372
source: The first to encounter POKENAME in the wild thought it was nothing more than an intricate statue until it responded to touch. POKENAME is so absentminded it simply forgets to move throughout most of the day.

entry: 据说POKENAME能活许多年，期间壳上会长出许多硬宝石，吸引野生勾魂眼。POKENAME借此与它们结群，用宝石换取食物。
author: icelevelincarnate
source: POKENAME are said to live for many years. During that time, many hard gemstones grow from their shell, attracting the attention of wild Sableye. POKENAME take advantage of this to form packs that'll provide food in exchange for gems.

entry: POKENAME的结晶挨打时，身体会因受压释放电脉冲。POKENAME受击越重，结晶产电越多。
author: quackquackattack
source: Whenever POKENAME's crystals are struck, its body discharges an electrical pulse in response to mechanical pressure. The harder POKENAME is struck, the more electricity the crystals produce.

entry: POKENAME的美丽宝石市价很高，却很难取得，因为栖身洞穴常高温难耐，还有干扰电子设备的强磁场。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME's beautiful jewels sell for a high price on the market. However, the jewels are difficult to obtain because the caves in which they live often contain high temperatures and powerful magnetic fields that interfere with electronic equipment.

entry: POKENAME对矿工是罕见却危险的隐患。它出现，矿道就得关闭，毒素还能让矿道一封数年。
author: quantumradiation
source: POKENAME is an uncommon but dangerous hazard to miners. Mining tunnels have to be shut down due to its presence and can remain closed for years because of POKENAME's toxins.

entry: POKENAME的钻石壳引来勾魂眼。发现太大吃不下，勾魂眼就留下帮忙，把宝石装进POKENAME炮管，再由它以高压水射向敌人。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's diamond shell attracts the attention of Sableye. Once they realise that it is far too big to eat, these Sableye stick around to help POKENAME by loading gemstones into its cannons, which it then fires at foes using pressurized water.

entry: 壳上的尖刺像冰，却比钻石还硬。它们在海底最深处的巨大压力下形成。
author: stevethebarbarian
source: The spikes on its shell look like ice but are harder than diamonds. They are formed under the enormous pressure at the very bottom of the sea.

entry: POKENAME漂过地下洞穴，吸收紫水晶的养分。吃下格外纯净的宝石后，诡异光芒会更强。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME drifts through underground caves, absorbing amethyst for nourishment. Its eerie glow intensifies after consuming a particularly pure gemstone.

entry: POKENAME的形象常见于告诫贪婪的故事：伸手拿不属于自己的诱人宝石，手可能被咬，甚至更惨。POKENAME手上宝石变色，就表示要攻击。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's visage is often used in a tale about greed: sticking one's hand out to reach an alluring jewel that doesn't belong to them may result in it being bitten, or worse. When the gems on POKENAME's own hands change color, it is about to attack.

entry: POKENAME藏在晶洞群中等猎物。还没来得及察觉它在，就已被吸走生命力。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME hides itself in geode formations, awaiting its prey. Before you have a chance to realize it's there, it sucks your life force away.

entry: POKENAME爱宝石，嘴里常含着许多。它耐心等勾魂眼离巢，再带着对方珍爱的宝石藏品逃跑。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME loves gemstones, carrying large amounts of them in its mouth. It will patiently wait for Sableye to leave their dens, before running away with their prized hoard of gems.

entry: 曾有人声称，POKENAME就是当地传说里恶名远扬的“水晶大岩蛇”，后来却被证实不是。久居地下深处，让它的岩石与结晶坚硬得近乎不受损。
author: sk372
source: Some have claimed POKENAME was the infamous "Crystal Onix" local folklore spoke about until proven otherwise. Living deep underground has hardened its stone and crystals to the point of being near impervious.

entry: POKENAME挑剔自己催眠后吃下的梦，只吃能找到的最快乐的梦，因为能让结晶部分更洁净闪亮。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is particular about the dreams it consumes from those it sends to sleep. It only eats the happiest dreams it can find, as those dreams help keep its crystalline portions more pristine and shiny.

entry: POKENAME住在普通陆路到不了的水下洞穴。巨钳狠狠一夹，便能阻止勾魂眼靠近；面对更大的寻宝者，也绝不手软。
author: wormspawn
source: POKENAME live in underwater caverns inaccessible by normal land routes. Firm pinches from their claws dissuade Sableye from getting too close, and they won't hesitate to do the same to larger treasure-hunters.

entry: POKENAME的钻石壳能承受巨大热量与压力。除水柱外，POKENAME的炮管也能发射锋利宝石碎片，或闪亮强光。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's diamond shell can endure immense heat and pressure. In addition to jets of water, POKENAME's cannons can also fire sharp fragments of gemstones or shimmering blasts of bright light.

entry: POKENAME好奇开朗，常在森林家园四处跑，寻找冒险。背上的坚果藏着强效毒液，能经坚果壳的刺释放。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is inquisitive and upbeat, often scampering around its woodland home in search of adventure. The nut on its back contains a potent poison which it can release with the spines on the shell of the nut.

entry: 人们相信，POKENAME能与森林之灵心灵交流。它不断长出新刺，脱落的刺很受占卜师觊觎。
author: pastapockets
source: POKENAME are believed to communicate telepathically with the spirits of the forest. It constantly grows new quills, and its shed quills are highly coveted by fortune tellers.

entry: POKENAME通常大胆无畏，热爱探索周围世界。陷入险境，就靠利齿脱困。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME tend to be bold, fearless creatures that love to explore the world around them. If they are caught in a dangerous situation, they rely on their sharp teeth to escape harm.

entry: 冬季到来，POKENAME爱帮训练家往树上和家中挂灯。刺状羽毛，让它轻易就能把灯挂上房屋。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME love to help their Trainer hang lights on trees and homes whenever the winter season comes around. They can easily hang lights on houses with their quill-like feathers.

entry: 它们住在高树上，POKENAME住得越高，群中地位就越高。它们喜欢从高处跳向毫无防备的路人，用带刺坚果瞄准人和宝可梦的脑袋。
author: milchik
source: They live in tall trees; the higher a single POKENAME resides, the higher its position in the group's hierarchy. From up high, they like to jump on unsuspecting passers-by, aiming their spiky nuts at the heads of people and Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME蜷成一团漂在水面，像颗硕大的带刺种子。一有什么碰到，就会绷紧、硬化身体，让尖刺能刺穿袭击者。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME curls up and floats on the top of the water, resembling a large, spiked seed. If anything touches it, it flexes and hardens its body, causing its spikes to be able to pierce the attacker.

entry: POKENAME漂过古代遗迹，好奇地观察考古学家发掘往事秘密。它常把柔韧身体扭成不同形状，仿佛试着用失传语言交流。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME drift through ancient ruins, curiously observing archaeologists working to uncover the secrets of the past. They regularly twist their flexible body into different shapes, appearing as though they're trying to communicate in a lost language.

entry: POKENAME在栗树下等待成熟坚果落下，凭强颚，连最硬的种子也会毫不犹豫地咬碎。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME waits beneath chestnut trees for ripe nuts to fall. Its powerful jaws can crush even the hardest seeds without hesitation.

entry: POKENAME皮厚，刺与爪又强又利，能与大针蜂正面交锋，抢走蜂蜜。不过它很贪吃，吃得太多，饭后很快就睡着。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME have rather tough hides and strong, sharp quills & claws, all of which allow them to go toe-to-toe with Beedrill to claim their honey for themselves. They are rather gluttonous, however, and eat so much that they quickly sleep after a meal.

entry: POKENAME平时软乎乎的尾巴，能硬到连压缩机也压不坏，是极其好用的钝击武器。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's normally squishy tail can harden to the point it cannot be broken by even a compression machine. This makes it an extremely useful bludgeoning tool.

entry: POKENAME通常顽皮无忧，却被许多人视为麻烦，因为最爱的游戏，就是朝路人扔橡子，再赶紧跑掉。
author: craigprime
