source: POKENAME generally has a playful and carefree demeanor, although many consider them to be a nuisance; this is because a POKENAME's favorite game involves throwing acorns at passing people before scampering away.

entry: POKENAME用撞头交流和战斗。烦躁时，尖刺会硬化，变得滚烫。还会喷火烤食物、驱赶威胁。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME communicate and fight with headbutts. Their quills harden and become scalding hot when they are agitated. They spit flames to roast food and to deter threats.

entry: 它使出全力弹起，撞向树木，尽可能震落果实。偏爱坚果，会与附近能找到的人或宝可梦分享，似乎尽量避免冲突。
author: infinex21
source: It uses all of its strength to launch itself and headbutt trees, knocking loose as many fruits as possible. It prefers to eat nuts and will share food with any nearby people or Pokémon it can find; it seems to avoid conflict as much as it can.

entry: POKENAME为守护弱者，堂堂正正地战斗。手握巨大的矛状尖刺，即使被敌人缴械，也能以意念轻松操纵。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME fights with honor to defend those weaker than itself. Though it wields a large spear-like spine in its hands, it can easily wield it with telekinesis should a foe manage to disarm it.

entry: POKENAME几乎全身都能隐形，唯独戴着的叶盔不行。它常用尾巴吊在树枝上数小时，偷偷观察其他宝可梦。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME can turn almost its entire body invisible, except for the leafy helmet it wears. It often hangs from branches by its tail for hours, secretly watching what other Pokémon are doing.

entry: POKENAME虽有吓人的第二个头，性情却友好，爱给朋友收集树果与鲜花。受威胁时，就把第二个头当连枷，保护自己与同伴。
author: infinex21
source: Despite their menacing second head, POKENAME are friendly Pokémon that love to gather berries and flowers for their friends. They will use this second head like a flail to defend themselves and others when threatened.

entry: POKENAME爱惹事，每天都对其他宝可梦恶作剧。它会用燃烧的尾巴点着藤蔓，阻止对方追赶。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME enjoy causing mischief and pull pranks on other Pokémon daily. They are known for using their flaming tails to light vines on fire to prevent other Pokémon from chasing after them.

entry: POKENAME用飞弹针打落树果，吃日光催熟的果实。果实不肯掉，常让它烦躁，却又拒绝帮助，谁想来帮就赶走。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME eat sun-ripened berries after knocking them from berry trees with Pin Missiles. They often become frustrated when the berries won't fall, but will refuse any help and chase away those who try.

entry: POKENAME从树上采集坚果，冬季存入水下巢穴。生病时，身体会覆上一层薄树皮。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME gathers nuts from trees to store in its underwater dens during winter. When sick, a thin layer of bark covers its body.

entry: POKENAME从鼻子下方吸入种子进食。体内储存的种子越多，磁力就越强。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME consumes seeds by inhaling them through the bottom of its nose. Its magnetic force increases the more seeds it stores internally.

entry: POKENAME天性友好，用藤蔓为自己和在意的生物拿取食物。保护其他生物时，能绷紧耳朵，让耳上尖刺硬化，坚硬得能刺穿树木。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are friendly by nature and use their vines to acquire food for themselves and for others they care for. To defend others, they can flex their ears to harden the quills upon them; these quills can pierce a tree when hardened.

entry: POKENAME害羞，见到陌生对象常会蜷起，藏住脸。满月时，体表尖刺会变长，泛起淡淡银光。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has a shy nature, often curling up and hiding its face when confronted with someone new. During the full moon, the quills on its body grow longer and emit a faint silvery glow.

entry: POKENAME收缩肌肉时，电力积蓄，头顶软刺也会变尖。碰到刺尖，就会挨上一记狠电。
author: periperi_chicken
source: When POKENAME contracts its muscles, its electricity builds and the soft spines on its head grow sharp. Touching the tip of a spine will deliver a nasty zap.

entry: 它虽披坚甲，头刺平时却软，必要时能硬化得足以刺穿岩石。主要吃树果与铁，强化铠甲。
author: lydiaprower8
source: Despite it having sturdy armour, its head quills are usually soft but can harden to be tough enough to pierce rocks. It eats mostly berries and iron to build up its armour.

entry: POKENAME厚木质头骨上长满硬刺，撞头十分危险。POKENAME会一头撞树，震落坚果与树果。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's thick wooden skull is covered with hard spikes, making its headbutts very dangerous. POKENAME will run headfirst into trees to make nuts and berries fall from them.

entry: POKENAME羽毛上长出的强韧刺，秋季会变得极其锋利。春来便脱落，再在整个夏季重新生长。
author: .izik
source: The strong thorns growing from POKENAME's feathers become incredibly sharp during autumn. Once spring arrives, they shed before regrowing throughout the summer.

entry: POKENAME用强喙破开坚硬种子和树果。吃得越多，头壳就越坚固。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME uses its powerful beak to break open hard seeds and berries. The more it eats, the more durable its head-shell becomes.

entry: POKENAME用种子炸弹，震落洞壁的蓝宝石。光吃这些宝石，就足以维生。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses Seed Bomb to knock sapphires from cave walls. It can sustain its diet entirely on these gems.

entry: POKENAME吃堆肥箱里的庭院废料，也吃各种来源的种子。淋雨太久，身体就常会长出各式植物的嫩芽。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME consumes yard waste from compost bins along with seeds from various sources. If it stays in the rain too long, sprouts of random plants will frequently begin growing from its body.

entry: POKENAME虽不特别好斗，却会给过往船只惹麻烦。它啃咬硬物，磨利门牙，漂过的船也可能遭殃，甚至因此沉没。
author: sk372
source: Although not particularly aggressive, POKENAME can be a problem for passing ships. It gnaws on solid objects to keep its buck teeth sharp, which can include boats that float by, potentially resulting in sinking them.

entry: POKENAME虽对豚草过敏，仍在附近筑巢。猛烈的喷嚏会释放养分，大大滋养周围植物。
author: .izik
source: Though allergic to ragweed, POKENAME nests near it. Its explosive sneezes release nutrients that greatly enrich nearby plant life.

entry: 野生POKENAME在森林中，从一棵树滑翔到另一棵，用生物声呐查看树干内部。发现其他宝可梦藏的树果或坚果，就偷来归自己。
author: houseoffallingflowers
source: In the wild, POKENAME glides from tree to tree in forests, using its biological sonar abilities to look inside the trunks. When it detects a stash of berries or nuts left by another Pokémon, it steals them for itself.

entry: POKENAME花瓣富含叶绿素，作用更像叶子。花朵坚韧有弹性，能防外力伤害，让它安心地在任何地方休息。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME's petals are full of chlorophyll, functioning more as leaves than as the petals of flowers. The tough, springy texture of their flower lets them protect themselves from physical harm, allowing them to rest wherever they please without fear.

entry: POKENAME不作战时，尖刺柔软得如天鹅绒，软乎乎的。受威胁就瞬间硬化，让身体很难被咬伤或刺穿。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's spikes remain velvety soft and squishy unless it is in combat. When threatened, they harden instantly, making its body difficult to bite or pierce.

entry: POKENAME白天奔过沙漠，从身体撒出尖锐种子。夜里，种子迅速长成各种仙人掌。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME scatters sharp seeds from its body as it dashes through the desert during the day. At night, the seeds grow rapidly into a variety of cacti.

entry: POKENAME喜欢阳光海滩，嚼食附近沙丘植物的种子。白天炎热时，会融入沙中休息。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME prefers sunlit beaches, where it chews on seeds from nearby dune plants. It blends into the sand when resting during the heat of the day.

entry: 它们在宝可梦世界很早便被驯养，信任人又忠诚，会回报人们的善意。夜里常与其他宝可梦交锋，保护训练家免受夜间威胁。
author: quackquackattack
source: Domesticated very early in the world of Pokémon, they are trusting and loyal, which causes them to return kindness given to them from people. They often clash with other Pokémon at night to defend their Trainers from nocturnal threats.

entry: POKENAME友好温柔，很少参与战斗。刺尖很钝，POKENAME得费些力气，才能暂时变得足够锋利，用于战斗。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has a friendly, gentle nature, rarely getting itself into combat. Its spines are dulled at the tip and require effort on POKENAME's part to temporarily sharpen enough to be used in a fight.

entry: POKENAME还不能完全控制头背尖刺，有时软硬变化不当，反会损坏物品或伤到自己。它每天吃下与体重相当的树果，帮助尖刺变坚固。
author: notadoctor75
source: POKENAME does not have perfect control over the quills on its head and back, and sometimes will damage objects or itself by toughening or softening its quills inappropriately. It eats its body weight in berries daily to help toughen the quills.

entry: POKENAME橡胶般的皮肤，散着淡淡草香。受威胁时，会像拉起兜帽般，提起叶状外层，威吓敌人。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's rubbery skin emits a faint grass-like scent. When threatened, it pulls its leafy outer layer up like a hood to intimidate foes.

entry: POKENAME有栗壳般的外壳保护。刺看似连着壳，可壳一掉，刺其实仍留在POKENAME身上。
author: pinkyoshi2350
source: POKENAME is protected by a shell similar to that of a chestnut. While the quills appear to be attached to the shell, they actually remain on POKENAME's body if the shell falls off.

entry: 外壳破裂后，POKENAME变得脆弱许多，必须吃大量树果，才能让壳重新长回。
author: pinkyoshi2350
source: POKENAME became much more vulnerable after its outer shell broke. This Pokémon must eat a lot of berries for its outer shell to grow back.

entry: POKENAME的硬壳能将撞击力转为热能，吸收攻击。挨打越多，壳就越热。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME's hard shell absorbs attacks by converting the force from the impact into heat energy. The more blows it takes, the hotter its shell becomes.

entry: POKENAME在海面附近高速游泳。头上大木块很厚，连撞上船也若无其事。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME swims near the ocean's surface at high speeds. The large chunk of wood on its head is so thick that even a boat collision does not faze it.

entry: POKENAME是贪婪的小家伙，最爱收集钱币。若被训练家冷落，会用利刺划开钱包和钱袋，偷走硬币。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are greedy little creatures that love collecting coins. They are known to slice open purses and coin bags with their sharp quills to steal coins if their Trainer neglects them.

entry: 野生POKENAME常成群与当地其他宝可梦，大吃树果。它们在树上筑巢，以巢作高处瞭望点，向毫无防备的路人发射小针。
author: npshi
source: Clusters of wild POKENAME are often seen gorging themselves on Berries with other local Pokémon. POKENAME make their nests in trees, using the nest as a vantage point to shoot small needles at unsuspecting passerby.

entry: POKENAME的刺柔软可弯，有时被比作鸟宝可梦的绒羽。用POKENAME软刺做的被子格外保暖，是受欢迎的冬季被褥。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME quills are soft and pliable, their texture sometimes being compared to the feathery down of bird Pokémon. Quilts made with POKENAME quills are particularly good at retaining heat and are popular for winter blankets.

entry: POKENAME有尖刺与厚重外壳保护，却常因壳太重，翻倒在背上，需要帮忙才能起来。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have sharp quills and heavy shells to protect themselves from danger. They often fall onto their backs because of the weight of their shells and need help to get back up.

entry: POKENAME收集树上坚果，安全藏进大嘴。夜里睡得安稳，叶状附肢上下摇摆，仿佛缓慢平稳地呼吸。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME collects nuts from trees, storing them safely inside its large maw. At night, it sleeps soundly while its leafy appendages sway up and down, mimicking slow, steady breathing.

entry: POKENAME爱啄蒲公英，让种子随风飞散，再兴奋地追着吃，把进餐变成游戏。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME enjoys pecking at dandelions, scattering their seeds into the wind. As they float, it eagerly chases and eats them, making a game out of its meal.

entry: POKENAME虽主要夜行，白天也能靠长触角引路行动。背上种子有厚毛保护，储存着进化所需的能量。
author: fiordaliso
source: Although POKENAME is mostly nocturnal, it can move even during the day by following its long antennae. The seed on its back is protected by thick fur, storing the energy it will need for its evolution.

entry: POKENAME用成簇的眼睛，在夜里发现目标，再以毒性爆炸攻击。爆炸后，触角会遗落原地，但它能让触角完全再生。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME uses its clusters of eyes to spot targets at night, then attacks with a poisonous explosion. After the blast, its antennae are left behind, but it can regenerate them completely.

entry: POKENAME发怒时，双眼闪红，预示即将爆炸。粉尘爆炸会让人咳嗽不止，有时还会麻痹。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's eyes blink red when enraged, signaling imminent detonation. Its powdery explosion causes coughing fits and sometimes paralysis.

entry: 它发动精神攻击时，各个头的触角会同步移动。若一个头受伤，其余的头便能顺畅接替它的功能。
author: .izik
source: The antennae of all its heads move in unison when it launches a psychic-based attack. If one head is damaged, the others will take over its functions seamlessly.

entry: POKENAME的触角能探知最微小的气流变化，掌握敌人动作。踢击威力惊人，连巨石都能粉碎。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME manages to keep track of its enemies' movements thanks to its antennae, which detect even the slightest movement of air. Its kicks are so devastating that they can even crush large boulders.

entry: POKENAME与其他虫属性宝可梦训练，改善出拳轨迹，抵御森林里的危险。触角能感知敌人动作，即使黑暗中也能发现。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME trains with other Bug-type Pokémon to improve the trajectory of its punches so it can fend off dangers from the woods. Its antennae help it sense the movements of enemies, allowing it to spot them even in the dark.

entry: POKENAME的舌头覆着厚红粉，舔到哪里就沾到哪里。粉末在人身上停留太久，会让受害者失忆。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's tongue is covered in a thick red powder that spreads to any surface it licks. The powder can cause amnesia in the victim when it lingers on a human for too long.

entry: 它视力很好，却看不见正前方。追捕猎物时，常不小心撞上东西。
author: mistymagius
source: Despite how good its eyesight is, it cannot see directly in front of it. It will often run into things by accident while trying to catch its prey.

entry: POKENAME的许多藤蔓摸着微微毛绒，令大多数人觉得舒服。家养POKENAME会伸长藤蔓，给毫无防备的主人挠痒痒。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's many vines have a slightly fuzzy texture to the touch that most find pleasant. Domestic POKENAME use their extendable vines to tickle their unsuspecting owners.

entry: POKENAME能从成簇眼睛发射光束，保护幼崽。孩子还在发育，只能放出短暂刺眼闪光防身。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can fire beams of light from its clustered eyes to protect its young. The child is still developing so it can only make a short flash of blinding light in self-defense.

entry: POKENAME用白触角，引来毫无防备的猎物。POKENAME带倒刺的鳞片可用于解毒剂和药物，但它相当好斗，很难取得。
author: blebbyisblebby
source: POKENAME use their white antennae to lure unsuspecting prey. POKENAME'S barb-like scales are used in antidotes and cures, but getting the barbs can be a challenge, as they are quite aggressive.

entry: POKENAME看起来与巴大蝶几乎一模一样，却具有剧毒。
author: staghorn
source: Though they look nearly identical to Butterfree, POKENAME is highly toxic.

entry: POKENAME胡乱踉跄，让捕食者摸不着头脑。其实它的古怪动作，是在躲避只有自己看得见的无形障碍。
author: cwynwyn
source: POKENAME stumbles around haphazardly, throwing off predators. Its erratic movements are actually the POKENAME attempting to dodge invisible obstacles that only it can see.

entry: POKENAME的触角能察觉最细微的动作或姿态改变，据此调整刀刃，精准出击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's antennae sense the slightest motion or shift of stance. It uses this data to align its blades for a perfectly placed strike.

entry: POKENAME受惊时，会在参差尖钳上分泌毒液。外表虽可怕，却常选择逃跑，而非战斗。
author: .izik
source: When frightened, POKENAME secretes poison over its jagged pincers. Despite its fearsome looks, it often flees rather than fighting.

entry: POKENAME竞争时会抖动身体，让鬃毛里的细毛扬成云团。云团更大的一方，就被视为上位者。
author: sk372
source: Rival POKENAME establish hierarchy by shaking their bodies and releasing a cloud of tiny hairs from their mane. The one that creates the bigger cloud is considered the superior.

entry: POKENAME的毛看似蓬松，其实僵硬，还覆着油脂，游泳时能防水。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: Despite looking fluffy, the fur of POKENAME is stiff. It's also coated in oils to protect it from the water it swims in.

entry: POKENAME住在树果树上，慢慢啃食果实。身体覆着厚毛，一碰就有毒。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME can be found in berry trees, slowly nibbling away at the berries. Its body is covered in a thick layer of hair that is toxic to the touch.

entry: POKENAME覆着细绒，摸起来柔软。激动时，绒毛会分泌麻痹毒，贸然碰触就可能有危险。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are covered in a fine fuzz that is soft to the touch. When they get riled up, their fuzz secretes a paralytic poison that can make them dangerous to handle.

entry: POKENAME的复眼对光敏感，能通过进化，迅速适应周围环境。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have compound eyes that are sensitive to light. They are capable of rapidly adapting to their surroundings through evolution.

entry: POKENAME的复眼善于暗中视物，进化时往往获得新力量。POKENAME进化的时间与地点不同，新能力也会变化。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have compound eyes that are effective at seeing in the dark and often gain new powers when POKENAME evolve. These new powers change depending on when and where POKENAME evolve.

entry: POKENAME有特殊复眼，潜水时也能看清。它游泳熟练，会追逐水生宝可梦玩耍。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have specialized compound eyes that keep their vision clear when they dive into the water. They are adept swimmers that chase after aquatic Pokémon for fun.

entry: POKENAME行动极难预测，电光火石间，从一处跳到另一处。皮肤沾上太多毒粉，会导致四肢麻痹。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's movements are incredibly erratic, jumping from place to place with lightning-fast speed. Getting too much of its poisonous dust on your skin will cause limb paralysis.

entry: POKENAME凭绝佳视力，在夜里寻找猎物。复眼能射出阵阵余烬，将猎物点燃。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME rely on their superb vision to locate prey at night. Their compound eyes fire bursts of embers to set their prey aflame.

entry: POKENAME夜里趋向强光，常隔窗盯着电脑屏幕。若有人允许它进入设备，就会试着帮忙，吃掉系统里的病毒。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME flock to bright lights at night and often find themselves staring through windows to observe computer screens. If a person allows them to access the device, they will try to be helpful by eating any viruses that are in the system.

entry: 有什么靠近，POKENAME就会疯狂振动，抖落细毛。大多数生物会因此严重过敏，视线模糊，喷嚏不止。
author: sk372
source: If something approaches POKENAME, it vibrates rabidly and sheds tiny hairs from its body. These hairs cause extreme allergic reactions in most creatures, leaving them with blurry vision and uncontrollable sneezing.

entry: POKENAME夜间活动，白天很少见。它摸黑爬树，寻找虫属性宝可梦。POKENAME眼睛敏感，因此应避免把提灯带到它聚居的地方。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME are rarely seen during the day because of their nocturnal nature. They climb trees in the dark, searching for Bug-type Pokémon. POKENAME have sensitive eyes, it is heavily advised to keep lanterns away from POKENAME infested areas.

entry: 光秃秃的腹部会分泌黏甜的液体，吸引并困住小虫。POKENAME便懒洋洋地将它们捡来吃掉。
author: pokepower
source: Its bald stomach secretes a sticky and sweet goo. Small insects are attracted and get trapped, which POKENAME picks off and eat as it lazes.

entry: POKENAME的火，不停烧掉翼上细小却长得极快的毛。每次振翅留下的灰，一接触就会让受害者双眼剧烈灼痛、受刺激。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's flames are constantly burning off tiny yet rapidly-growing hairs on its wings. The ashes that are left behind from each flap cause extreme burning and irritation to the eyes of those unfortunate enough to come into contact with them.

entry: POKENAME用复眼追踪甜蜜蜂蜜的来源，再运回蜂巢储存。
author: .izik
source: Using its compound eyes, POKENAME tracks down sources of sweet honey. It carries the honey back to its hive for storage.

entry: POKENAME一动不动地睡在黑暗森林，等待入夜。受打扰，也只花恰好足够赶走干扰的力气。月亮升起后，POKENAME醒来，搜遍家园，寻找虫宝可梦。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME sit motionless as they sleep in dark forests, awaiting nightfall. If disturbed, they only expend as much energy as is required to make the disturbance go away. When the moon rises, POKENAME awaken and scour their homes for bug Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME常被尾尖绒球分散注意，不停追逐、试着扑住，很快就把自己累坏。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME often get distracted by the fluffy ball at the end of their tails, constantly chasing and trying to pounce on it. This causes them to quickly tire themselves out.

entry: 面对敌人，POKENAME会加热背部一块区域，把多余毛发烧成能控制的粉尘云。既能藏身，也能刺激对手视线，取得优势。
author: sk372
source: When faced with opposition, POKENAME heats up a segment of its back, burning up excess hair on its body into a cloud of dust it can control. This lets it obscure itself or agitate the vision of opponents, giving it an edge.

entry: POKENAME常在住宅区筑巢，有时意外钻进人家。羽毛覆着毒粉，吸入可能轻微发热，并引起严重偏头痛。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME tend to nest in residential areas, sometimes accidentally getting into people's homes. Their feathers are coated in poisonous dust that, if inhaled, can cause mild fevers and severe migraines.

entry: 它左右摇摆，从毛皮散出紫粉。若受惊，会发出诡异尖叫，让袭击者晕头转向。
author: .izik
source: It rocks side to side while unleashing a violet powder from its fur. If startled, it will let out an eerie screech that disorients attackers.

entry: POKENAME夜视极佳，极暗光线下，也能追踪远处动作。值夜班的守卫与警察，很喜欢带它作伴。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have fantastic night vision and are able to track movement across great distances in even the dimmest light. They are a favourite companion of guards and policemen on the night shift.

entry: POKENAME夜里容易被车灯与路灯分散注意，常因此被机动车碾过。许多环保人士提议设置气味诱捕装置，引它们远离道路。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are easily distracted by bright lights at night from cars and lamp posts that often ends with them getting run over by motor vehicles. Many environmentalists have proposed putting scent traps to steer POKENAME away from roads.

entry: POKENAME倒着滑翔，融入天空紫色星海。目光似乎始终盯着远方的一颗星。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME glides upside-down, blending in with the violet cosmos in the sky. Its gaze seems to be fixated on a distant star.

entry: POKENAME视力强，远处猎物最轻微的动作也能看见。它细心观察，计算最佳织网位置，用小网捕住想逃的猎物。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's strong eyesight lets it observe even the faintest motions of prey from a distance. It carefully watches and calculates the best place to spin tiny webs that will catch prey as it tries to flee.

entry: POKENAME捕猎时，会射出黏住猎物的银丝，得以长途跟踪。夜里，丝线在微光下闪亮，确保POKENAME不会跟丢目标。
author: quackquackattack
source: When POKENAME hunt, they shoot out a silver thread that sticks to their prey, enabling them to stalk prey over long distances. At night, this thread shimmers in low light conditions, ensuring POKENAME never lose their target.

entry: POKENAME悄悄接近猎物，再用毛皮分泌物使其麻痹。若猎物太大，带不回洞穴，就留在原地，任其从麻痹中恢复。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME quietly sneak up on their prey before paralyzing them with secretions from their fur. If the prey is too big to carry back to their cave, they leave the Pokémon there to recover from the paralysis.

entry: POKENAME的羽毛覆着剧毒粉尘，每次振翅都会散播。不过，去除毒素后，粉尘很适合缓解关节炎疼痛。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's feathers are coated in a highly poisonous dust that it spreads every time it flaps its wings. However, once the toxin is removed, the dust is quite good at treating arthritis pains.

entry: 据说这层细硬毛，是为了护身而进化的。每根毛即使脱落，仍会劈啪跳动着静电。
author: infinex21
source: Its coat of thin, bristly hair is said to have evolved for their protection. Each piece of hair crackles with static electricity even after being shed.

entry: POKENAME只在夜里现身，凝视满天星座。嘴里呼出的毒粉，如银色星尘般闪耀。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME emerges only at night to gaze at the constellations scattered across the sky. The poisonous dust it exhales from its mouth shimmers like silver stardust.

entry: POKENAME在地面振翅，扬起尘土，抖落身上无数细毛，能有效让猎物看不见，轻易捕住，带回家。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME flaps its wings on the ground to kick up dust and dislodge countless small hairs from its body. This is highly effective at blinding prey and making them easily snatched up and carried off back to its home.

entry: POKENAME用头上触角吸收空气中的电子，将电能引进身体。大眼睛对日光敏感，因此主要夜行。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME uses the antennae on its head to absorb electrons from the air and channel electrical energy into its body. It is a mostly nocturnal Pokémon, since its large eyes are quite sensitive to sunlight.

entry: POKENAME白天藏在密林，夜里才出来对月起舞，似乎被月光吸引。双眼能在暗中看清，也能发现可能靠近的捕食者。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME will hide out in dense forests during the day, emerging at night to dance by the moon, seemingly drawn to its light. Their eyes allow them to see well in the dark, allowing them to spot any predators that may be approaching.

entry: POKENAME强大的眼群能看见微弱动作，哪怕察觉一点活物迹象，也会静止。若有什么想伤害它，就从手中甩出刺激性花粉，弄进对方眼里，让其看不见。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's powerful cluster of eyes allows it to see faint movement, becoming still if it detects even a hint of a living creature. If something attempts to harm it, it flings irritating pollen from its hands in their eyes to blind them.

entry: POKENAME夜行，日落后成群聚集。蓬乱毛皮，既能抵御捕食者，也能在寒夜保暖。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME are nocturnal and gather in swarms after sunset. Their shaggy coats help them defend against predators and keep them warm on cold nights.

entry: POKENAME蹦跳于花田，用触须取来其他花的花粉，添到自己的花上。挨攻击，就从花中喷出刺激、难闻的粉末，让袭击者愣得足够久，方便跳走。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME hops about flower fields, using its feelers to take pollen from other flowers and add it to its own. If attacked, it sprays an irritating, smelly powder from its flower that stuns attackers long enough for it to hop away.

entry: 它们的眼睛由成簇晶状体构成，帮助从各角度观察。一察觉危险，就立即朝难以预测的角度跳跃，咬向任何靠得太近的东西。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Their eyes are composed of clusters of lenses that help them view their surroundings from all angles. If they detect danger, they immediately leap at erratic angles, sinking their teeth into anything that gets too close.

entry: POKENAME需要大量日光生长，却是夜行生物，常在黎明睡着。许多个体只得靠路灯的光滋养身体。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME require lots of sunlight to grow, but often fall asleep at dawn because they are nocturnal creatures. Many rely on the light released from street lamps to nourish their body.

entry: POKENAME夜里长时间盯着路灯或其他强光源。太阳升起时，早已睡着。
author: quackquackattack
source: At night, POKENAME stare at street lamps or other sources of bright light for long periods of time. By the time the sun rises, they are already asleep.

entry: POKENAME跳过湿地，毛茸茸的触角释放香甜毒雾。球状大眼，连沼泽雾气中的猎物也能追踪。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME hops through wetlands emitting a sweet but toxic mist from its fuzzy antennae. Its bulbous eyes can track prey even in swampy fog.

entry: POKENAME感官敏锐，能察觉迫近的危险。它以接触时释毒的方式防身。
author: riel.vndxgrxvnd
source: POKENAME has heightened senses and can detect imminent danger. They release poison through touch as a self-defense mechanism.

entry: POKENAME夜里靠横贯身体的黄带发光。两只POKENAME相遇，会彼此凝视，欣赏对方的光辉。
author: quackquackattack
source: At night, POKENAME glow in the dark with the power of their yellow bands across their body. When two POKENAME meet, they stare at each other and admire the glow that they produce.

entry: POKENAME视力极强，在极弱光线下，也能远远发现闪亮物的微光。它振翅散出细毛云，晃瞎人，再偷走物品。
author: sk372
source: Its strong eyesight lets it see the glimmer of anything shiny from long distances with minimal lighting. POKENAME disperses clouds of small hairs with a flap of its wings to blind people and swipe their belongings.

entry: POKENAME毛发上的毒粉影响心智，使其发狂。它会拿到什么就用什么，造出各种古怪装置。
author: mistymagius
source: The poisonous dust from POKENAME's hair negatively affects its mind, causing it to go mad. It can be seen making odd contraptions out of anything it can get its hands on.

entry: POKENAME体内的睡眠节律相冲，常因此入睡。黎明与黄昏最活跃，既能吸收日光，又不至于被睡意压倒。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have conflicting internal sleep schedules that cause them to fall asleep often. They are most active during the dawn and dusk where they can still absorb sunlight without being overwhelmed by their desire to rest.

entry: POKENAME大眼睛对光十分敏感，因此偏爱只在夜里捕猎。即使看不见，敏锐胡须与尾巴，也能清楚感知四周。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's large eyes are very sensitive to light, so it prefers to only hunt at night. Even if it is blinded, its sensitive whiskers and tail allow it to get a good picture of its surroundings.

entry: POKENAME白天睡觉，午夜嬉戏。两根尾部触角，像有自己的意识般来回摆动，提醒POKENAME附近可能潜伏的危险。
author: reflecbeat
source: POKENAME sleep during the day and frolic at midnight. The two tail antennae flit about as if they have a mind of their own, and alert the POKENAME to any danger that may be lurking nearby.

entry: 有些人觉得POKENAME愁眉苦脸的表情可爱，很爱养作宠物。可梳理相当费劲，清洁后一抖身体，细毛又会散得到处都是。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is well-liked by some as a pet, finding its grumpy expression adorable. It is an arduous task to keep it groomed, however, and when it shakes its body after cleaning, tiny hairs spread everywhere.

entry: 它用强角压住敌人，再向其释放毒粉。蛮力与有毒孢子相结合，让它成为可怕的对手。
author: .izik
source: It will hold a foe down with its powerful horn while unleashing a poisonous powder on them. The combination of brute strength and toxic spores makes it a fearsome opponent.

entry: POKENAME的身体由一群虫属性宝可梦组成，维持形态需要极大量能量。它们被甜饮吸引，尤其爱蜂蜜酒。可惜，糖分就会把宝可梦灌醉。
author: ghostslythe
source: POKENAME's body is made up of a colony of Bug types, overall requiring extreme amounts of energy to maintain their form. They are attracted to sweet drinks, with a fondness for mead. Unfortunately, the sugars inebriate the Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME性格奔放又可爱，出了名地爱吃饼干。胃口惊人，一找到饼干，就会弄得一片狼藉。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME are known for their wild, sweet personalities. They're also known for their massive appetite for cookies, making a complete mess whenever they find some.

entry: 野生POKENAME被面包店视为祸害，常闯进去大吃饼干。虽有这名声，有些店仍雇POKENAME，担任正式试吃员。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Wild POKENAME are considered menaces to bakeries, as they often break in to devour cookies. Despite this reputation, some bakeries hire POKENAME as workers, having them act as official taste testers.

entry: POKENAME全身细毛不停生长，活动时很容易脱落。触碰可能让毛扎进皮肤，引起痛苦灼热感。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are covered in fine hairs that grow constantly. These hairs shed easily as they move about and can end up being embedded in skin if touched, creating a painful burning sensation.

entry: POKENAME靠触角，即使全黑也能感知猎物行动。尖喙的打击强得连橡树树皮都能刺穿。
author: fiordaliso
source: Thanks to POKENAME's antennae, it is able to sense its prey moving even in total darkness. Its sharp beak can deliver blows so powerful that they can even pierce the bark of oak trees.

entry: 它用后脚抓挠耳后毛，扬起毒粉云。体热让粉末威力更强，灼痛附近生物的眼睛。
author: .izik
source: It scratches the fur behind its ear with its rear paws, letting loose clouds of poisonous powder. The heat from its body makes the powder even more potent, burning the eyes of those nearby.

entry: POKENAME会缠住猎物，却不将其勒紧。它会用毛中的粉末闷住猎物，使对方无力反抗。
author: pokepower
source: POKENAME wraps up prey, but doesn't constrict them. It instead uses the powder in its fur to smother its prey, rendering them vulnerable.

entry: 毛球会被光吸引，POKENAME却会被网络广告吸引。它们聚在广告旁，盯着图像或视频看几分钟，再移向下一个广告。
author: quackquackattack
source: While Venonat are attracted to light, POKENAME are attracted to advertisements on the internet. They congregate around ads to stare at the image or video for a few minutes before moving on to the next ad.

entry: POKENAME通过发光鹿角，蓄起幻象光线。若打偏，就一边退走，一边放出扰乱对方的毒雾。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME charges a Psybeam through its glowing antlers. If the attack misses, it retreats while releasing a distracting poison mist.

entry: POKENAME看不清物体细节，双眼却对一切动作极其敏感。连刚出生的电电虫，在玉米地里缓慢爬动，也能看见。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME cannot see the details of objects very well, but its eyes are extremely sensitive to any motion. As a result, it can even see a newborn Joltik slowly inch throughout a field of corn.

entry: POKENAME体表不断分泌毒液，保护自己免遭捕食。传闻毒液来自净水时吸收的毒素。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: POKENAME are constantly protected from predators by a poisonous ooze secreted all over their bodies. It is rumored that this poison originated from the toxins they have absorbed from water they have purified.

entry: POKENAME的壳上长满浓密扎人的毛。夜间会喷出毒气，推动自己前进。
author: houndrys.
source: POKENAME's shell is covered in dense, prickly fur. At night, it propels itself with poisonous gas.

entry: POKENAME毛皮覆着导电粉末。战斗时，会用力抖落，再发出无差别电击，电流被任何沾上粉末的东西吸引。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME fur is coated in a conductive powder. When they're in battle, they shake their body vigorously to release the powder before loosing an indiscriminate electric shock, the bolts of electricity drawn to anything covered in the powder.

entry: POKENAME把备用食物藏在毛茸茸背部的凹处。有时拿来与朋友分享，对方拒绝沾满绒毛的零食时，它似乎很困惑。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME stores spare food within the recesses of its fuzzy back. Sometimes it offers to share with friends, seeming confused when they refuse to partake in the fuzz-covered snacks.

entry: POKENAME体型庞大，却相当胆小，深藏森林和洞穴，除非足够信任某个对象，否则不肯出来。它似乎担心，个头太大可能伤着别人。
author: sk372
source: Despite its hulking size, POKENAME is a rather timid creature, hiding away deep in forests and caves and refusing to come out unless it sufficiently trusts someone. It seems afraid of potentially hurting someone due to its size.

entry: POKENAME挖洞时，会掉下彩色毒粉，标记隧道。每只个体的粉末微观图案，都独一无二。
author: .izik
source: As it burrows, POKENAME sheds colored poison dust that marks its tunnels. The powder's microscopic patterns are unique to each individual.

entry: 宝可梦对战中，POKENAME靠复眼，精准找到对手弱点。选定目标后，就释放一阵密集叶片，压倒对方。
author: quackquackattack
source: In a Pokémon battle, POKENAME rely on their compound eyes to pinpoint weak spots on their opponent. Once they find a suitable target, they release a flurry of leaves that overwhelm their opponent.

entry: POKENAME住在北方针叶林，有许多雪可以玩。受威胁时，会从复眼释放刺骨寒霜。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME live in boreal forests where there is plenty of snow to play in. When threatened, they release a chilling frost from their compound eyes.

entry: POKENAME浓密的皮毛让它能在寒冷环境中生存。冰河时期，大多虫属性宝可梦因严寒而灭绝，它是当时罕见的宝可梦。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME's furry coat lets it survive in cold environments. This was a rare Pokémon during the Ice Age, as most Bug types died out from the cold.

entry: POKENAME生病时，会不时打喷嚏，向四周喷出一团蓝粉。粉末若落到手机上，就可能清除其中数据。
author: .izik
source: When sick, POKENAME periodically sneezes puffs of blue powder into the surrounding area. Should this powder land on a cellphone, it can wipe the data inside.

entry: POKENAME很胆小，稍觉危险就迅速爬上树。细毛有毒，又很难弄掉，谁想吃它，都会很不好受。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are quite timid, quickly climbing up into the trees at the slightest sense of danger. The hairs are both toxic and hard to get rid of, causing immense displeasure in those who try to eat them.

entry: 它们蓬乱的尾巴满是细针般的毛，能像尖刺一样绷紧。双眼进化得无论天气多恶劣，也能发现最小猎物。
author: infinex21
source: Their bushy tails are full of thin, needle-like hair that can tense like their quills can. Their eyes have evolved to spot even the smallest of prey, no matter how fierce the weather may be.

entry: POKENAME的长触角能感知水中振动，因此全黑也能熟练游泳。它用鳍灵巧甩泥，阻碍对手行动。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its long antennae allow POKENAME to sense vibrations in the water, which is why it can swim skillfully even in total darkness. With its fins, it skillfully whips mud at its opponents to hinder their movements.

entry: POKENAME覆满无数细毛，柔软毛绒。它最爱拥抱其他生物，抱着虽舒服，之后却会让人微微发痒。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's body is coated in countless fine furs, making it very soft and fuzzy. It loves to give embraces to others, which are pleasant but leave the hugged person feeling slightly itchy afterward.

entry: POKENAME夜里悬在路灯旁，纹丝不动。背上裂缝不断漏出毒粉，常在身边形成云团。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME can be seen hovering around street lights at night, completely motionless. The crack along their backs constantly leaks a toxic powder, often forming clouds around themselves.

entry: POKENAME毛皮里藏着毒刺。只扎一下，就能让大多数捕食者疲倦迟缓。
author: .izik
source: Concealed within POKENAME's coat are venomous barbs. A single prick can induce fatigue and sluggishness in most predators.

entry: 它全身都能变色，唯独眼睛不行。藏好身形后，用强眼捕捉小虫的微弱动作，再以闪电般的舌头捉来吃。
author: sk372
source: It can change the color of all of its body except for its eyes. It hides away from sight, using its powerful eyes to scope out the faint movement of small insects, before its tongue lashes out at lightning speed to catch and eat them.

entry: POKENAME不停从楔石产生毒尘。唯一可靠的制止方法，是让POKENAME照着强光；它会被迷住，暂不散尘，直到光消失。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME constantly produce a toxic dust from their keystone. The only certain way to stop this is to expose POKENAME to bright light, which they will be so captivated by that they will hold back their dust until the light is gone.

entry: POKENAME力量与速度都很强，却容易受惊、陷入慌乱。野外一被吓到，有时一挥就砍倒整棵树，只为掩护飞快逃跑。
author: sk372
source: Despite formidable strength and speed, POKENAME is jumpy and prone to panicking. When startled in the wild, it's not unheard of for it to cut a tree down in a single swing, just to cover its rapid escape.

entry: 摩鲁蛾似乎被POKENAME花中储存的花粉吸引。POKENAME极讨厌这些不速之客，一看见摩鲁蛾就攻击。
author: sk372
source: Venomoth appear drawn to the pollen stored in POKENAME's flower. POKENAME detests the unwelcome visitors, to the point of attacking Venomoth on sight.

entry: POKENAME每天脱落毒毛，让捕食者远离巢穴。触角对巨响很敏感，因此住得偏远。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME sheds its poisonous fur on a daily basis, which keeps predators away from its den. Its antennae are very sensitive to loud noises, so it lives in more remote areas.

entry: POKENAME覆着坚硬的保护毛。发光双眼引来小虫，再用颚状的角将猎物夹住。
author: haypile
source: POKENAME is covered in stiff protective hairs. Its glowing eyes attract small insects, then its jaw-like horns snap the prey up.

entry: POKENAME把上半身缩进毛更厚的下半身，藏在密灌木里，等待合适猎物。一靠近，POKENAME就伸出众多黏性触角，抓住拖走，充作美餐。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME retracts the upper parts of its body into the fuzzier lower half, hiding in thick bushes until suitable prey draws near. Once it does, POKENAME extends its many sticky antennae out to grab and drag away its new meal.

entry: 它总显得心不在焉，连战斗也如此。有人推测，复眼的每个透镜都在盯着不同宇宙的事，只留一个，观察这里。
author: epping_forest
source: It always acts distant, even in battle. Some theorize that the cause of this may be the fact that each lens of its compound eyes is staring at something happening in a different universe, leaving only one lens for what's happening here.

entry: POKENAME住在污染地区，吃残羹与垃圾。有时会结伴，从郊区人家偷取更大份的食物。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME live in polluted areas, feeding on leftover scraps and garbage. They will sometimes team up with each other to steal larger meals from suburban homes.

entry: POKENAME挤压尾尖，便能放出有害气体。POKENAME用力程度不同，吸入后的效果，从短暂晕眩到立即昏迷都有。
author: distinguishedmanlygentleman
source: By squeezing the tip of its tail, POKENAME can expel a noxious gas. Depending on how hard POKENAME squeezes, the effects of inhaling this gas can range from brief wooziness to immediate unconsciousness.

entry: POKENAME角上的毛，会渗出恶臭毒液。它很少真用角，主要靠威吓避战。
author: .izik
source: A foul-smelling poison seeps from the fur on POKENAME's horn. It rarely uses the horn itself, relying on intimidation to avoid battle.

entry: POKENAME全身毛皮覆着毒尘，谁敢攻击就会中毒。体内积电时，触角泛起强烈黄光。
author: fiordaliso
source: The fur covering POKENAME's entire body is coated with toxic dust, poisoning anyone who dares to attack it. When it accumulates electricity in its body, its antennae glow with an intense yellow light.

entry: POKENAME好奇，却很容易因意外动作惊慌。逃离危险时，会快速振翅，吹走体表无数细毛，刺激并蒙住前方生物的视线。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a curious sort, but quick to panic at any unexpected movements. It escapes from danger by flapping its wings rapidly, blowing away countless tiny hairs on its body that agitate and blind those in front of it.

entry: POKENAME眼上有特殊覆盖层，挡住空气中的沙粒。因此，能在夜间沙暴里盯着强光，也不怕眼睛受伤。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a special cover over their eyes that protect them from sand particles in the air. This allows them to stare at bright lights at night in the middle of sandstorms without worrying about eye injuries.

entry: 眼睛如雷达般搜寻小虫与其他猎物。会用缎带挖出蛴螬。
author: melodydelune
source: Their eyes act as radars, scanning for small bugs and prey to to eat. Their ribbons allow them to dig up grubs.

entry: POKENAME胸前的光点像毛球的眼睛，但从未见过毛球从POKENAME体内出来，光点仍是谜。
author: stevethebarbarian
source: The lights that can be seen on POKENAME's chest are similar to Venonat's eyes, but no such Pokémon has been seen exiting POKENAME's body, so the lights remain a mystery.

entry: POKENAME用大眼追踪想吃自己花蜜的生物。等对方靠近，POKENAME便挥动毒触角抽打。
author: hoppygolucky
source: POKENAME uses its big eyes to track down those who want a taste of its nectar. Once they get close, POKENAME whips at them with its poisonous antennae.

entry: POKENAME漂在亮灯的小屋旁，等待住户放松警惕。敏锐的触角能察觉情绪状态。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME floats near illuminated cottages, waiting for residents to lower their guard. Its sensitive antennae can detect emotional states.

entry: 这些小宝可梦体表有一层等离子体保护，似乎也让它们悬浮。它们会被光源吸引，尤其是能吸走电力的灯泡。
author: infinex21
source: These tiny Pokémon are covered, and protected, in a layer of plasma that seems to allow them to levitate. They are drawn to sources of light, especially lightbulbs which they will drain electricity from.

entry: POKENAME行走时，掉下稀薄粉末，月光下会更浓。颜色随每个月相变化，让研究员困惑。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME sheds a faint powder while walking, which thickens under moonlight. The powder's color shifts with each lunar phase, baffling researchers.

entry: 它用复眼在暗中视物，吐出黏网捕猎。蛛网带电，挣扎过度的生物就会被电击震住。
author: .izik
source: It uses its compound eyes to see in the dark while dispensing sticky webs to trap prey. These webs carry an electrical charge, stunning anything that struggles too much.

entry: POKENAME藏在阴影里，与昆虫和虫属性宝可梦共处。进食时抛下伪装，显露骇人真形，将猎物整个吞下。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME lives in the shadows, with insects and Bug-type Pokémon. It throws off its disguise and unveils its horrendous form to eat its prey whole.

entry: 它喜欢黑暗，毛上覆着紫粉，活动便会散落。视力虽然差，却能用细毛感知附近猎物。
author: .izik
source: It prefers dark areas, and its fur is covered in a purple powder that scatters as it moves. Despite its poor eyesight, it uses its fine hairs to sense nearby prey.

entry: 据说POKENAME会释放可瞬间致命的未知毒素，速度也极快。这个物种最近才被虫类专家记录。
author: riel.vndxgrxvnd
source: Said to release an unknown poison that can instantly prove fatal, POKENAME is an extremely fast Pokémon. Its species was only recently documented by bug experts.

entry: POKENAME大群聚在腐烂树果树旁，吃尽能找到的残渣。受威胁时，就大声振翅，发出令人痛苦的嘈杂嗡鸣。
author: mistymagius
source: Swarms of POKENAME gather near rotting berry trees, eating all the scraps they can. When threatened, they will loudly vibrate their wings, creating a painful cacophony of buzzing.

entry: POKENAME的毛极其敏感，能感知其他宝可梦的情绪。不过，毛上覆有少量毒素，会产生奇怪的心理影响。
author: mistymagius
source: The hairs on POKENAME's body are incredibly sensitive, allowing it to sense the emotions of other Pokémon. However, the hairs are coated with small amounts of poison that cause strange psychological effects.

entry: POKENAME毛里的毒尘不停刺激自己，让它四处发狂。人们已商业采集这种粉尘，用作强效兴奋剂，却只用极微量。
author: mistymagius
source: The poisonous dust in POKENAME's fur is constantly irritating it, causing it to rampage all over the place. The dust has been commercially harvested as a powerful stimulant, but only in minuscule doses.

entry: POKENAME的毛由细金属丝构成，里面储存的粉末接触皮肤，会造成轻微灼伤。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's fur is made of fine metallic strands. The powder it stores within can cause mild burns upon contact with skin.

entry: POKENAME燃烧体表粉尘，在尾上产生紫火。极少数粉尘用尽的情况下，火焰才会恢复原色。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME burn dust from their body to produce a purple flame on their tail. This purple flame returns to normal on the rare occasion they run out of dust.

entry: POKENAME受威胁时，会疯狂挥臂，放出剧毒粉末。成年人若未获治疗，也会重病至少一周，其他毒属性宝可梦却能用粉末疗伤。
author: kittyluv090
source: If it feels threatened, POKENAME will wave its arms around wildly, releasing a highly toxic powder that can make a grown adult fall horribly ill for at least a week if not treated. Fellow Poison-types use this powder to heal themselves.

entry: POKENAME的紫毛覆着真菌孢子，在林间蹦跳时释放。它喜欢阴暗潮湿，因此通常在浓密植物挡住阳光的地方筑巢。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME's purple fur is covered in fungal spores that it releases as it hops through the woods. It thrives in dark, damp places, which is why it usually makes its den where dense vegetation blocks out the sunlight.

entry: POKENAME轻轻漂浮，像摆钟般摇动触角，通过触角发出精准得诡异的精神冲击。
author: .izik
source: Floating gently, POKENAME swings its antenna like a pendulum. It channels psychic blasts through it with eerie precision.

entry: POKENAME夜里漂向路灯，盯着强光。若试着拖走，便会出现奇异液体，让人抓不牢。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME float to lampposts at night to stare at bright lights. Efforts to drag them away are met with an odd fluid that makes grabbing them difficult.

entry: POKENAME常住废弃建筑，爱吃积起的灰尘。接触毒毛，会引起严重皮疹，最长可持续5个月。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME often inhabits abandoned buildings, as it loves to feed on the dust that builds up there. Coming into contact with its poisonous fur will cause severe rashes that last up to 5 months.

entry: POKENAME视力强，又会回声定位，捕猎时几乎无法躲藏或逃脱。对大多数生物来说，幸好它通常只猎小虫。
author: sk372
source: Possessing powerful eyesight and echolocation, POKENAME makes it nearly impossible to hide or evade it when it's on the hunt. Fortunately for most, it only tends to hunt small insects.

entry: POKENAME活动时，毛里劈啪跳着微弱静电。兴奋或惊慌，就通过触角释放电脉冲。
author: .izik
source: As POKENAME moves, its fur crackles with faint static. It releases electrical pulses through its antennae when excited or alarmed.

entry: 它感知捕食者时，眼睛会闪出鲜红光。身体由细小金属碎片构成，谁咬它，就会吃一嘴参差的钢铁粉尘。
author: .izik
source: Its eyes blink a vibrant red light while it senses for predators. Its body is made up of tiny metal shards. Any attacker that bites it will end up with a mouthful of jagged steel dust.

entry: POKENAME用尖长牙刮开树木，再从毛中放出酸性粉末，迅速溶解已经受损的树干。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME claws at trees with its sharp tusks before releasing acidic powder from its fur. The powder quickly dissolves the weakened trunk.

entry: POKENAME通常不在夜里出行，只白天迁徙。不过，路灯装好后，如今也能循光，在夜里从一座城市迁往另一座。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME typically do not travel at night and only migrate during the day. However, with the installation of lamp posts, they can now migrate at night by following lights from city to city.

entry: 它扑翅飞过夜空，抖落毛里的毒粉。毒素留在空中，让捕食者难以追赶。
author: .izik
source: As it flutters through the night, it shakes loose poisonous powder from its fur. The toxin lingers in the air, making it difficult for predators to follow.

entry: POKENAME夜里设下陷阱，潜伏林地，等毫无防备的受害者踩过。一被踩，硬毛就钩住目标，释放使其衰弱的毒。
author: evilgammon
source: Laying traps at night, POKENAME lurk on forest floors waiting for unsuspecting victims to walk over them. When stepped on, their stiff hairs latch onto the target, releasing a weakening poison.

entry: POKENAME能蜷起身体，以惊人的速度滚走。蓬松的皮毛像安全气囊般缓冲碰撞，避免自己受伤。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME can curl up and roll away, reaching surprising speeds. Their fluffy fur cushions collisions like an airbag so that it does not injure itself.

entry: POKENAME能在原地像轮胎一样旋转，再高速冲出。皮毛能在碰撞时保护身体。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME can spin like a tire when stationary and then race off at high speed. Its fur protects it in the case of collisions.

entry: POKENAME能在原地像轮胎一样旋转，再高速冲出。皮毛能在碰撞时保护身体。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME can spin like a tire when stationary and then race off at high speed. Its fur protects it in the case of collisions.

entry: 无论坡度多陡，POKENAME都能爬上去。遭到飞行宝可梦袭击时，会直接落下，用厚毛缓冲坠地的冲击。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME can climb any slope, no matter how steep. If it is attacked by a flying Pokémon, it can drop down and cushion the fall with its thick fur.

entry: POKENAME把毒花粉覆在身上，让其他宝可梦不敢吃。它喜欢潮湿，暴雨前会成群聚集。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME covers its body in its poisonous pollen, dissuading any other Pokémon from eating it. It loves damp weather and groups of them will gather together before rainstorms.

entry: POKENAME没有羽毛，只有厚毛，欢快地跳舞，快速旋转却会让毛打成死结，只有少数梳毛高手才能解开。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME has no feathers but thick fur instead. It dances joyfully, yet its rapid spinning tangles the fur into hopeless knots that only a few expert groomers can untangle.

entry: POKENAME欢呼时，触角疯狂摆动，常缠在一起。它的绒球由黏性毒分泌物粘合，对人和宝可梦都有害。
author: jaminmcready
source: When cheering, POKENAME's antennae bob wildly and often tangle. Its pom-poms are bound with a sticky, toxic secretion harmful to humans and Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME毛上覆着一闻就催眠的黏液。舞动时，留下黏滑轨迹，四周尽是打瞌睡的人和宝可梦。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME's fur is coated in a mucus that induces sleep when smelled. As it dances, it leaves a slimy trail surrounded by dozing humans and Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME看似有翅膀，其实只是多余毛发塑成羽毛状。它用自己的毒唾液，把末端染红。
author: jaminmcready
source: Though it looks like it has wings, POKENAME's flaps are just excess fur shaped to mimic feathers. It dyes the tips red with its own poisonous saliva.

entry: POKENAME只在夜里捕猎，用雷达般的眼睛，探测暗处猎物。白天则睡在少光甚至无光的洞穴。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME hunts exclusively at night, using its radar-like eyes to detect prey lurking in the darkness. During the day, it sleeps in caves with little to no light.

entry: 光穿过POKENAME虚幻的身体，让藏在树间的它很难被看见。这种伪装是唯一防御，一旦被发现，就十分无助。
author: comfortablybrum
source: Light filters through the ethereal body of POKENAME, making it very hard to see as it hides among the trees. This camouflage is its only defense mechanism, leaving it quite helpless when spotted.

entry: POKENAME藏住身体，等猎物擦过覆有黏稠甜腻毒素的叶片，便突然跳出咬住。
author: holgast
source: POKENAME hide their bodies and wait for prey to brush by their leaves, which are covered in a sticky, cloying toxin. Then, they pop out and bite.

entry: POKENAME的蘑菇极怕日光，照着时无法生长，也不能产孢。它们促使宿主挖进地下，只准夜里出来。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME mushrooms are extremely sensitive to sunlight, being unable to grow or produce spores while exposed to the light. They prompt their host to burrow underground, only allowing them to surface during the night.

entry: 很久以前，覆盖POKENAME身体的毛绒蘑菇，曾被溶进液体，制作PP多项小补剂。可惜，味道极差，还会让人剧烈头痛。
author: .izik
source: The fuzzy mushroom covering POKENAME's body was once dissolved in liquids to create Elixirs in times long ago. Unfortunately, they were very poorly tasting and caused massive headaches.

entry: POKENAME沿海底爬行，用雷达般的大眼寻找食物。全身硬毛能抵御好坏星这类水下捕食者。
author: theartemis1
source: POKENAME scuttles along seabeds, using its large radar-like eyes to scavenge for food. The stiff hairs covering its body offer it protection from underwater predators like Mareanie.

entry: POKENAME是极顽固的害虫，大部分植物都能吃，没得选还会啃木头，甚至猎捕小型草属性宝可梦。找到美餐，就会放出信息素云，召唤同伴。
author: lucioleuh
source: POKENAME is a very persistent pest. It can feed on most plants, resort to eating wood, and even hunt small Grass-type Pokémon. When it finds a tasty meal, it emits a pheromone cloud to call its peers.

entry: 没有证据表明它的身体除了硬毛之外还含有别的东西。连X射线也无法穿透浓密的毛。
author: pokepower
source: There's no evidence its body is made of anything except stiff hairs. Even x-rays can't penetrate the dense fur.

entry: POKENAME体内涌出的烟，含有极吸引毛球的信息素。常能看见一小群毛球，聚在POKENAME烟云中玩耍。
author: sk372
source: The smoke billowing out of POKENAME's body contains a pheromone highly attractive to Venonat. It's very common to see small groups of them swarming and playing amongst POKENAME's clouds.

entry: 两只毛球融合，让POKENAME的DNA迅速发育，开始显现进化型特征。过度发育的身体，需要更多食物，训练家出行应多带口粮。
author: katieplaysgames
source: A fusion of two Venonat causes the DNA of POKENAME to develop rapidly and begin expressing traits of their evolved form. Their over-developed bodies require a greater amount of food and Trainers are advised to bring extra rations on journeys.

entry: POKENAME是农村常见的家中害虫，会被户外灯和提灯吸引。鳞粉毒性很强，发现时，建议请专业人士处理。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is a common house-pest in rural areas, drawn to outdoor lamps and lanterns. Its scales are highly toxic, so it's recommended to call a professional if one is spotted.

entry: 领地被闯入，POKENAME的眼睛就会闪出深红光，再撒出细酸粉，驱赶入侵者。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's eyes flash crimson when its territory is breached. It then scatters a fine acidic powder to repel the intruder.

entry: POKENAME高速飞行时，脱落多余毛发。细绒很快烧掉，沿飞行路线留下一道彩色火花，如彗尾拖曳。
author: sk372
source: When flying through the air at high speeds, POKENAME sheds excess fur from its body. This fuzz burns up quickly, creating a colorful trail of sparks behind its flight paths, akin to a comet's tail.

entry: POKENAME将脱落粉尘与尾火结合，造出毒烟云。吸入烟的宝可梦会疲倦，无法打中目标。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME combine the dust shed from their body with their flaming tail to produce clouds of toxic smoke. Pokémon that inhale the smoke find themselves tired and unable to land attacks.

entry: 土和其他微粒总钻进POKENAME毛绒身体，因此POKENAME梳理时，附近生物常会打喷嚏。它夜视能力很强。
author: bobosmith01
source: Dirt and other particles are always getting in POKENAME's fuzzy body, so it's common for those nearby to start sneezing when POKENAME grooms itself. POKENAME has powerful night vision.

entry: POKENAME住在急流，靠尖牙和抓握的手，稳住水中位置。细毛不断脱落、堵塞过滤系统，因此很不适合养在水族箱。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME can be found in fast-flowing streams, their sharp fangs and grasping hands helping them stay in place in the current. They make poor aquarium Pokémon as their fine hairs constantly shed and clog up filtration systems.

entry: POKENAME睡在接近地表处，露出触角感知危险。受威胁时，就放出浓密麻痹粉尘。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME sleeps near the surface with its antennae exposed to sense danger. When threatened, it releases thick clouds of paralyzing dust.

entry: POKENAME产生的辣粉，在许多墨西哥卷饼菜式中很受重视。人们常从废隧道收集，但接触可能引起刺激。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME produces a spicy powder prized in many burrito dishes. People often harvest it from abandoned tunnels, though exposure can cause irritation.

entry: POKENAME可爱又好抱，爱玩训练家给的玩具。养POKENAME唯一的麻烦，就是应付不停掉落的粉尘。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are cute, cuddly creatures that enjoy playing with toys that their Trainer provides. The only downside to owning a POKENAME is dealing with the constant shedding of dust.

entry: POKENAME头痛时，会僵住，纹丝不动。看着像毛绒玩具，天真的孩子常想抱起，却被全身细毒毛弄得中毒。
author: ambrosia04
source: When suffering from headaches, POKENAME freeze and stay completely motionless. Because they look like plush toys, naive children often try to pick them up, only to be poisoned by the fine, toxic fur covering their bodies.

entry: 想逃离愤怒的POKENAME，往往很难真正甩掉。它视力极敏锐，脾气又固执，哪怕追上好几个小时，也很少放弃。
author: sk372
source: If something flees from an angry POKENAME, it will find it difficult to truly escape; its vision is highly acute, and its stubborn personality means it rarely gives up a chase, even after hours.

entry: POKENAME傍晚最活跃，用微微发光的尾巴当诱饵，大吃被光引来的虫子。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME is most active in the evenings, using its dimly glowing tail as a lure. It feasts on bugs attracted by this light.

entry: POKENAME住在潮湿沼泽，吃浸湿的叶和根。毛皮覆着毒油，接触皮肤会引起刺激。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME lives in the damp marsh, feeding on soaked leaves and roots. Its fur is covered in a toxic oil that causes skin irritation on contact.

entry: POKENAME的螺旋快速转动，双眼泛起鲜粉光。这种催眠组合，能让敌人突然入睡。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's spiral spins rapidly as its eyes glow bright pink. This hypnotic combination can lull foes into sudden sleep.

entry: POKENAME的敏锐毛发，能察觉风最细微的变化。怀疑有训练家靠近，就会在被发现前瞬间移动离开。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can detect the slightest change of the wind with their sensitive fur. If they suspect a Trainer is nearby, they teleport away before they are spotted.

entry: POKENAME在儿童节目里表演，用所谓的超能力辨别真金与仿品。其实，多数靠敏锐双眼判断，精神力量几乎没起作用。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME play in kids shows where they use supposed psychic powers to distinguish gold from counterfeits. In reality, many rely on their sensitive eyes to make this decision, as their psychic abilities play little role in their judgement.

entry: POKENAME曾被带去矿场探矿。人们常误以为靠超能力，实际是它能看见暗矿洞壁上的矿石微光。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME were once brought to mining sites to dowse for ore. It is a common misconception that they harness psychic powers to find ore, as it turns out that they can spot glints of ore in the walls of the dark mines.

entry: POKENAME常与都市传说联系在一起，体型虽大，实际相当胆小。它的绒毛，常被用于高档冬装。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are often associated with urban legends. Despite their large size, they are actually quite timid. The fluff of a POKENAME is often used in high-end winter clothing.

entry: POKENAME在荨麻旁扎根，吃刺为生。受打扰，就会突然使出幻象光线还击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME roots itself near nettles and consumes their thorns as a food source. If disturbed, it retaliates with a sudden Psybeam.

entry: POKENAME覆着敏感细绒，用来探知动作。细绒不防水，因此游泳时，除四肢外都缩进壳中。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are covered in sensitive fuzz used to detect movement. The fuzz is not waterproof, so when swimming, they tuck everything but their limbs into their shells.

entry: POKENAME从高树枝落下伏击，用中空尖牙吸取猎物体液。不过，重新爬回树上，几乎要花一整天。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME ambushes its prey by dropping from high tree branches and draining their fluids with their hollow fangs. However, it takes them almost a full day to climb back into the trees.

entry: POKENAME的钟形部位里，有能慢慢消化虫宝可梦的有害酸液。一有猎物掉入，就会释放孢子，催其入睡。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME has a pernicious acid inside its bell that slowly digests bug Pokémon. Whenever one falls in, it releases spores to lull the prey to sleep.

entry: POKENAME体表不停渗毒。宝可梦巡护员提醒徒步者留意脚下，踩上POKENAME可能致命。它夜猎虫子，白天埋地休息。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME's body is coated in poison that continuously oozes from it. Pokémon Rangers warn hikers to watch their step as stepping on POKENAME can be fatal. It hunts bugs at night and during the day it rests by burying itself into the ground.

entry: POKENAME夜里用粗壮双臂抓虫捕猎。眼睛如雷达，哪怕只有一点光，也能发现小虫。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME hunts bugs at night by snatching them up with its burly arms. Its eyes act like radar that can detect bugs in even just a small amount of light.

entry: POKENAME细毛散出的淡香，会让闻者困倦而满足。许多人爱把它当枕头小睡，POKENAME丝毫不介意。
author: sk372
source: A faint scent emitted by POKENAME's hairs induces drowsiness and contentment in those who smell it. Many enjoy using it as a pillow to nap on, which POKENAME doesn't mind at all.

entry: POKENAME有浓密感知毛、敏锐耳朵和能看清黑暗的眼睛，对环境变化极其敏感。察觉危险靠近，就缩进壳，等其过去。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are highly attuned to their environment thanks to a coating of dense sensory hairs, sensitive ears, and eyes that can see even in the darkest conditions. When they sense danger approaching they retract into their shells to wait it out.

entry: POKENAME用触角，吸食空气中无线电波的能量。因此，POKENAME的身体常会播放电台广播，成了露营者的常备伙伴。
author: turron_turron
source: POKENAME use their antenna to feed on the energy of radio waves present in the air. As a result, POKENAME can often be found emitting radio broadcasts from their bodies, and have become a staple amongst campers.

entry: 它先振翅，再从复眼释放幻象光线。突然掀起的风，能把催眠粉吹遍整片田野。
author: .izik
source: It flaps its wings before releasing a Psybeam from its compound eyes. The sudden gust of wind it creates can spread its sleep-inducing powder across an entire field.

entry: 复眼看见心爱的人，它就会开心地疯狂挥臂，把墨黑黏液溅得到处都是。这份亲昵，已毁掉许多训练家的衣服。
author: .izik
source: If it sees someone it loves with its compound eyes, it will flail its arms wildly in happiness, splashing inky slime everywhere. This affectionate display has ruined many Trainers' clothes.

entry: POKENAME的身体成分，是绒毛与污泥的奇怪混合。人碰到残留物，哪怕清掉黏液，接触处仍会痒上数日。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's body composition is a strange mixture of fuzzy and sludgy. Should some part of a person come in contact with its residue, that spot will remain itchy for days, even after removing the goop.

entry: POKENAME伸展黏滑身体，捕食较小的虫宝可梦。接触过多构成身体的黏液，会让受害者长时间失明。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME stretches its slimy body around to catch smaller Bug Pokémon to eat. Exposure to too much of the goop comprising its form can cause lengthy periods of blindness in the victim.

entry: 它用催眠粉让猎物睡着，再享用梦境。察觉格外鲜明的噩梦，触角就会抽动。
author: .izik
source: It uses Sleep Powder to put prey to sleep before feasting on their dreams. Its antennae twitch when it detects a particularly vivid nightmare.

entry: POKENAME以钟摆反射不同节奏的闪光，引发不同梦境。毛软得惊人，略有薰衣草香，让人相信用它的毛做枕头，就能做美梦。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME reflects a pattern of light bursts off of its pendulum, which induces different types of dreams. Its fur is incredibly soft and smells slightly of lavender, leading to the belief that pillows using its fur will lead to sweet dreams.

entry: POKENAME炮管内的灯夜里十分明亮，引来大量摩鲁蛾。光射出时，摩鲁蛾会迅速跟上，等于向敌人“发射”整群蛾。
author: santon5512
source: The lights inside POKENAME's cannons shine brightly at night, attracting tons of Venomoth. When these lights are fired, the Venomoth will quickly follow behind, allowing these Pokémon to effectively shoot swarms of them at their enemies.

entry: POKENAME拿背上种子磨蹭石头与树，削去脆弱部分，让壳更坚固。鼻子、耳朵和种子上的红刺，会分泌种子内部产生的毒液。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME rubs the bulb on its back against stones and trees to strengthen the shell, shaving off weakening sections. The red spikes on its nose, ears, and bulb secrete the poison gestating within the bulb.

entry: POKENAME用于情绪治疗，吸收情绪，再化作气体释放，让治疗师体会。坚壳保护它免受伤害，连压倒性的怒气，也能平静承载，是情绪疏导的可靠伙伴。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME are used in therapy, as they absorb emotions and release them as a gas that a therapist can experience. Their tough shell protects them from harm, so even overwhelming anger is carried calmly, making them reliable partners in emotional care.

entry: POKENAME顽皮忠诚，也很会看家。它会从尾部射出倒刺，驱赶入侵者。
author: opossiblymage
source: POKENAME is both playful and loyal, but also makes for a good guard of the house. It fends off intruders by shooting barbs from its tail.

entry: POKENAME臂上长的叶片，其实极其密实锋利，是危险武器，尤其摘下投出时。
author: craigprime
source: The leaves that grow from POKENAME's arms are actually incredibly dense and sharp. They function as dangerous weapons, especially when detached and thrown.

entry: 野生POKENAME成大群共居，彼此切磋，锻炼小小身体。每只体内各有一个火囊，生成火球，常吐出打落果实。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME live together in sizable groups and spar with one another to strengthen their small bodies. Within themselves are singular flame sacs, which is where they form their fireballs; they often spit fireballs to knock down fruit.

entry: POKENAME不停相互切磋，锻炼肌肉与耐力。战斗时，POKENAME以利爪攻击，靠带刺羽毛抵御对手。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME are constantly sparring with each other to train their muscles and endurance. During combat, POKENAME will fight with their sharp claws and rely on their spiny feathers to counter the opponent's attacks.

entry: POKENAME通常随和，任何训练家的命令，都能平静而毫不犹豫地执行。可即便不是自己的训练家，POKENAME也会听令。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME tend to be very easygoing. They calmly carry out any Trainer's command without hesitation. However, POKENAME will even listen to the orders given by people who aren't their Trainers.

entry: POKENAME互相冲撞，锻炼双腿，好在泥地站稳。它挡开捕食者的攻击，再用尖刺反击。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME runs into another of its kind to build up its legs so they can have even footing on mud. It deflects predators' attacks and counterattacks with its quills.

entry: POKENAME感知周围的情绪时，身上的尖刺便会随之伸长。越觉得危险，就有越多的刺冒出来保护自己，随时准备从体表发射。
author: sk372
source: Quills across POKENAME's body lengthen in response to the emotions it senses around it. The more it feels endangered, the more quills come out to protect itself, ready to be launched from its body at a moment's notice.

entry: POKENAME一相遇就切磋，纯为检验意志与力量，很少怀有恶意。绷紧肌肉时，尾巴会紧紧卷起，射舌前也如此。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME always clash when they meet, purely to test each other's mettle and strength; rarely do they clash with malicious intent. Their tails curl tightly whenever they tense their muscles, including before they fire out their tongues.

entry: POKENAME用强大的嘴夹紧敌人。它天性善良，也会咬碎硬食给其他生物。两只POKENAME相遇，会为检验彼此意志与力量而战。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME constrict their foes with their strong maws. Kind by nature, they also use their maws to crush up hard foods for others. When two POKENAME meet, they will engage in battle for the sake of testing each other's mettle and power.

entry: POKENAME体重大，很适合撞树震落熟果。其他宝可梦带来它最爱的树果，就能分享；那果实长在带刺灌木上，需要比它更灵巧的动作，才能摘到。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME's great weight makes it ideal for running into trees to dislodge ripe fruits. It shares these with Pokémon that bring its favorite food, a berry that grows on thorny bushes and requires more dexterity to pick than it has.

entry: POKENAME背部灌木下，藏着成簇待发的尖刺。许多捕食者突然挨上一阵尖锐弹雨，只得逃跑。
author: sk372
source: Beneath the bushes on POKENAME's back hide packs of thorns ready to be launched at opponents. Many predators have found themselves fleeing due to a surprise deluge of pointed projectiles being unleashed on them.

entry: POKENAME有点傲气，对战技极有自信。它能短距射出小刺，每根尖端都燃着小火，灼伤命中目标。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has a cocky streak and is highly confident in its combat prowess. It can fire little spines from its body over a short distance, each spike tipped with a tiny burning flame to singe the targets they hit.

entry: POKENAME没有牙齿，靠喙和嘴里的特殊软刺，帮助吞咽猎物。吞的时候，POKENAME会拍小鳍、摇身体，协助下咽。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: Due to a lack of teeth, POKENAME utilize special soft spines in their beaks and mouth to help them swallow prey. POKENAME flap their small flippers and shakes their bodies while doing so to help the process.

entry: POKENAME吐出细水流，打落树上的芒果，再用爪剥皮，吃里面的果肉。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spits thin streams of water to knock mangoes from trees. It uses its claws to peel the fruit before eating what lies within.

entry: POKENAME全身覆着坚固植物材料，抵御各种攻击。POKENAME细心维护领地，还会定期种下新树。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's body is covered with sturdy plant materials to protect it from any attack. POKENAME takes great care maintaining its territory, which includes periodically planting new trees.

entry: 即使野生POKENAME，也不肯无正当理由挑起战斗。它用带刺触须，保护其他生物，制止无谓争吵。
author: infinex21
source: Even in the wild, POKENAME refuse to start fights without an honorable reason. Instead, these Pokémon use their thorn-clad feelers to protect others and to put an end to unnecessary quarreling.

entry: POKENAME相互冲撞弹开，每天还吃下一吨树果，锻炼身体。它在陆地生存的时间，比普通吼吼鲸更长。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME build their bodies up by ramming into and bouncing off each other, and eating a ton of berries daily. It can survive on land longer then a normal Wailmer can.

entry: POKENAME以嬉戏切磋，增强腿力。若有同伴受伤，其余会围坐，帮忙梳理毛皮，表示歉意。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME will strengthen their legs by playfighting. If one gets hurt in the fray, the others will sit together and groom its coat as an apology.

entry: POKENAME身体的尖针带着高压电。成群POKENAME碰触彼此头刺，便能分享情绪。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: The spiky needles that make up POKENAME's body are charged with high voltage electricity. Packs of POKENAME can share their emotions by touching the spines on their heads together.

entry: POKENAME始终追求更强的力量，同类一见面就会交锋，考验彼此的气魄。身上的尖刺，比钢铁还硬，每月会脱落一次。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME always strive to be stronger, leading to them clashing with each other whenever they meet; this also serves to test the mettle of each other. The spikes along their bodies are harder than steel and are shed monthly.

entry: POKENAME的壳极其坚固，能挡开捕食者。它吃废弃铁轨，再用下半身撞击其他POKENAME，强化铠甲。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME has a really sturdy shell to deflect predators. It builds up that armor by eating abandoned railroad tracks, and its lower body ramming into another POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME的身体裹在硬木壳中，免受伤害。它几乎不吃东西，靠日光滋养，直到准备进化。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's body is encased in a hard wooden shell to protect it from damage. It eats almost nothing, relying on sunlight for nourishment until it is ready to evolve.

entry: 雨淋过后，POKENAME的绒羽会长出小树苗。它用喙拔掉，免得影响飞行。
author: .izik
source: Tiny saplings grow from POKENAME's down after rain hits it. It picks these out with its beak to prevent complications with flight.

entry: POKENAME既保护弱小海底宝可梦，也是强大的捕食者。它用覆刺的坚固身体，撞向欺负弱者的家伙，将其变成自己的猎物。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME protects the weaker undersea Pokémon while simultaneously being a powerful predator. It tackles those preying on the weak with its sturdy, spine-covered body, turning the bullies into its own prey.

entry: POKENAME穿过森林吃种子时，会发出孩子般的咯咯笑声。每年春天，身体长出的芽，总来自它吃过的种子。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME makes a childlike giggle while traveling through the forest, consuming seeds. The sprouts that grow from its body each spring are always plants from seeds it has eaten.

entry: POKENAME在敌人上空盘旋，用木质耳朵发出萨克斯般的巨响。听得太久，会让人恶心。
author: .izik
source: The loud saxophone-like noise POKENAME produces from its wooden ears can cause nausea after prolonged exposure. It makes this noise while flying in circles above its foe.

entry: POKENAME住在沙漠气候中，为保存水分，尖刺会变红。受威胁便射出一阵带倒钩的刺，很难拔除。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME live in desert climates where the need to conserve water causes their quills to turn red. Whenever threatened, they shoot a burst of barbed quills that are difficult to remove.

entry: POKENAME完全感觉不到疼痛，会用身体撞树，吃撞下的树皮。饲养者教POKENAME什么适合撞时，最好准备结实护垫。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME are completely numb to pain and ram their bodies into trees, feasting on the bark that shatters off in the impact. Trainers who raise them are recommended to purchase sturdy padding while teaching their POKENAME what is appropriate to ram.

entry: POKENAME沿途找到香草，就塞满嘴，存着以后用。明显偏爱迷迭香、罗勒等芳香品种。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME fills its mouth with any herbs it finds while traveling, storing them for later. It shows a clear preference for aromatic varieties such as rosemary and basil.

entry: POKENAME挺身充当小型宝可梦的守护者，以硕大体型威吓欺凌者。其实主要就靠这架势，因为变大的身体反而大幅降低行动力。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME props itself up as a defender of smaller Pokémon, intimidating bullies with its immense size and girth. It relies mostly on this threat display, as its new size is actually a detriment due to losing a lot of mobility.

entry: POKENAME用惊人力量互撞训练，却丝毫不痛。长大后换下的壳，很受制作运动护具的人追捧。
author: notadoctor75
source: POKENAME train by tackling each other with awe-inspiring force, but do not feel even the slightest bit of pain. Outgrown shells from this Pokémon are highly sought for use in making protective gear for sporting events.

entry: POKENAME啃咬坚固树木的枝条，用强韧木料充实披甲身体。它常与同类训练，力求把铠甲锻炼到最佳。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME chew on sticks from durable trees, the strong wood serving to enrich their armored bodies. They train against each other often, seeking to hone their armor to a peak.

entry: POKENAME用钉头锤打击对手，若觉得战斗艰难，就会将锤点燃。它格外用心培育作锤头的带刺坚果，也保护结这种果子的树。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME battles by smacking opponents with its mace, which it will ignite if it believes the battle will be challenging. It takes special care in growing the spiked nut that it uses for the mace, protecting trees that produce them.

entry: POKENAME收集散落叶片，用黏性唾液粘在身上，再到树冠休息，融入景色。天性大多善良，不爱冲突。
author: prolucario_
source: POKENAME collects scattered foliage and sticks it to itself using adhesive saliva. It then rests in canopies, blending into the scenery. They are largely kind and non-confrontational in nature.

entry: POKENAME用双臂接住冲来的胖胖哈力，训练力量。传闻身体挡开攻击时，能听见灵体的哀号。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME train their strength by catching charging Quilladin with their arms. Rumors say that the wails of spirits can be heard whenever it deflects an attack with its body.

entry: POKENAME发光的尾端，始终烧得通红。它用来在树上烙痕，标记领地。
author: .realthree
source: The glowing end of POKENAME's tail is always red-hot. It uses it to burn marks into trees to denote its territory.

entry: POKENAME静静观察附近的伴侣，想守护爱情。若发现威胁二者的东西，就从尾鳍伸出尖刺射击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME quietly watches couples near it, aiming to protect their love. If it spots something that threatens the couple, it extends and fires pointed spines from its tail fin.

entry: POKENAME脾气极暴，连落叶声都能惹怒。凶猛程度转眼飙升，刚还在花间嬉戏，下一刻就用百万吨重拳猛打巨石。
author: ghostslythe
source: POKENAME has a very short temper, even the sounds of falling leaves send it into fury. It increases its level of violence extremely quickly, jumping from frolicking in flowers to using Mega Punch on boulders.

entry: POKENAME的嬉戏十分粗犷，远远相对，再加速奔向彼此，使出强力猛撞。它们似乎很享受碰撞，撞完还会亲昵地相互蹭。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME engage in rough forms of play with one another, facing off at each other from great distances before racing into one another with powerful Take Downs. They appear to enjoy the collisions, nuzzling each other affectionately after the impact.

entry: POKENAME从不因愤怒挑起战斗。它与其他格斗属性宝可梦友好切磋，磨炼天赋。
author: ozydamians
source: POKENAME never starts a fight out of anger. It spars in friendly matches with other Fighting-type Pokémon to nurture their natural talents.

entry: POKENAME扑向同类检验实力，撞穿沿途阻碍。若能接住另一只冲来的POKENAME，就把对手扔远，赢得领地。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME test their strength by launching themselves at each other, barreling through whatever stands in their way. If one POKENAME manages to catch another mid-charge, it will fling the opponent away to claim the territory.

entry: 野生POKENAME虽独居，每年春天仍会高兴地与家人团聚，一起庆祝、比较力量。头尾蓬松的橙毛，带着欢庆般的坚果香。
author: bobosmith01
source: Although it lives independently, a wild POKENAME happily reunites with its family every spring; the group will celebrate and compare one another's strength. The fluffy orange fur on its head and tail has a festive nutty aroma.

entry: POKENAME撞倒树木，围巢筑墙。背上的坚果含有对人类太危险的毒，不能吃，壳却美味无毒。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME charges into trees, knocking them down to create walls around its nest. While the nut on its back contains a poison too dangerous for human consumption, the shell is delicious and nontoxic.

entry: POKENAME与训练家羁绊深厚，从蛋养大的尤其如此。它常随爆破队，熟练处理各种爆炸物；即使已在安全距离，也会护住训练家，抵挡爆炸。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME form strong bonds with their Trainers, especially POKENAME raised from eggs. They are often sighted with demolition teams handling various explosives with expertise and shielding their Trainers from the blast even at safe distances.

entry: POKENAME爱吃寄生植物，常到老树寻找。全身密布的小硬刺，连最顽强的捕食者也能吓退。
author: turron_turron
source: POKENAME love snacking on parasitic plants, frequently visiting old trees in search of them. Their bodies are covered in small, rigid spikes that deter even the hardiest of predators.

entry: POKENAME一被叫醒，就会烦躁地在森林横冲直撞，轻易撞倒树木。只有食物，才能安抚怒气。
author: bigoljax
source: Whenever awoken from their sleep, POKENAME go on grumpy rampages through the forest. They're strong enough to knock down trees with ease, with food being the only thing to soothe their anger.

entry: POKENAME的绿火，让它能在密林伪装，更容易捕猎。若有其他宝可梦争食，就会让双翼耀眼地闪动，威吓对方。
author: bigoljax
source: The green coloring of POKENAME's fire helps them camouflage through thick forests, making it easier to hunt prey. When challenged over their food by another Pokémon, they flash their wings brightly as a threat.

entry: POKENAME头顶的大叶，柔韧又结实，能承受大多数物理攻击。POKENAME弯动叶柄，从各方向保护自己与盟友。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: The large leaf atop a POKENAME's head is both flexible and sturdy, allowing it to endure most forms of physical attacks. POKENAME flex and bend the stalks of their leaves to shield themselves and their allies from all angles.

entry: POKENAME被视为丛林守护者，与周围植物十分协调。若察觉入侵者进入，就在地面铺出一片荆棘，阻人靠近。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are seen as guardians of the jungles they inhabit, completely in tune with the plant life around them. If they sense any intruders entering the jungle, these Pokémon will send out a carpet of thorns across the ground, keeping anyone at bay.

entry: POKENAME的精神感知，能察觉附近遇险生物的情绪。它赶去援助，立起屏障与光墙保护对方，自己则正面迎战攻击者。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's psychic senses alert it to the feelings of beings in danger nearby. It rushes to their aid, erecting Barriers and Light Screens to protect them from harm while it takes on the aggressor directly.

entry: 它庇护较小的宝可梦，作族群首领，公正统领。POKENAME喜欢和平解决冲突，但同伴一遇险，就会奋勇作战，不惜代价守护。
author: milchik
source: It takes smaller Pokémon under its protection and rules over them fairly as the leader of the pack. POKENAME prefers to solve conflicts peacefully, but if its packmates are in danger, it'll fight fiercely and defend them at all costs.

entry: POKENAME高架的壳，保护下方坚果免遭鸟宝可梦啄食，如今壳还能产毒，经尖刺传出。它躺在阳光下，强化壳的防御。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME's elevated shell protects the tree nuts underneath from bird Pokémon, especially since the shell now produces a poison that can be transmitted by its spikes. It lies in sunlight to strengthen the defensive prowess of its shell.

entry: POKENAME住在废城堡，偏爱铜屋顶。它们保护马类宝可梦，会记恨伤马者。可惜个头小，很难吓住对方。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME make their homes in abandoned castles, preferring those with copper roofing. They are protective of horse Pokémon, holding grudges against those who harm them. Their small stature makes it difficult for them to be an effective threat.

entry: POKENAME住在废城堡，偏爱铜屋顶。它们保护马类宝可梦，会记恨伤马者。可惜个头小，很难吓住对方。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME make their homes in abandoned castles, preferring those with copper roofing. They are protective of horse Pokémon, holding grudges against those who harm them. Their small stature makes it difficult for them to be an effective threat.

entry: POKENAME虽以凶暴闻名，也会帮助电击怪学会控制电力。训练家会派它们，对付总欺凌其他宝可梦的乌鸦头头与黑暗鸦群。
author: bigoljax
source: Though known for their brutality, POKENAME are also known for helping Elekid learn to control their electricity. They're sent out by trainers to deal with Honchkrow and their flocks of Murkrow who keep tormenting other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME将两半盾合起，身前便形成近乎无法穿透的防线。森林家园里有居民遇险，就会跃身保护，耗尽敌人体力，再发动反击。
author: sk372
source: Combining the two halves of POKENAME's shield creates a near-impenetrable defense in front of it. It leaps to defend any forest denizens in its home from danger, waiting out and exhausting its foe before launching a counterattack.

entry: 这种宝可梦虽小，撞击却强得能劈开完全长成的树。它正面扛住打击，再以撞击或炽热火焰还击。
author: infinex21
source: Although it is small, this Pokémon's Tackle is forceful enough to split a full-grown tree. It will take hits head-on and retaliate with Tackle attacks or by spitting out hot flames.

entry: POKENAME冬季培育辛辣坚果，受制作特殊甜点的厨师追捧。面对不认识的人，POKENAME会用利剑，保护自己种出的果实。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME cultivate spicy nuts during the winter, which are sought after by culinarians for special desserts. If POKENAME does not recognize a person, they will attempt to defend what they have grown with their sharp sword.

entry: POKENAME极爱保护其他生物，以身挡伤。身材虽小，却坚固得连大钢蛇冲来撞上，也会当场停住。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is quite protective of others, shielding them from harm with its body. Despite its small stature, its body is incredibly durable; a charging Steelix would be stopped dead in its tracks if it collided with POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME会引诱对手走上站不稳的泥地，再用带刺拳头，轻易将其痛打一顿。
author: imaginita
source: To defeat its opponents, POKENAME will try to lure its opponent onto muddy ground that offers poor footing.  There, it can easily deliver a thrashing with its thorned fists.

entry: POKENAME披着厚重甲皮，在草原家园活动，少惧袭击。若有足够强的威胁，就会团结起来，用身体排成尖刺盾墙。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Covered in a thick armoured hide, POKENAME move about their grassland homes with little fear of attack. When threatened by something powerful enough to pose a danger, they will band together and present a spiky shield-wall with their bodies.

entry: POKENAME用盾与长枪，保护训练家。随着羁绊加深，原本带刺的脾气，也会慢慢化成亲昵。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME defend their Trainer from harm with their shield and lance. Their prickly personality slowly melts into affection as they bond with their Trainer.

entry: POKENAME极力保护训练家，用大盾遮住，不让附近训练家看见，避免不必要的对战。战斗时，盾能释放自然能量脉冲，将敌人推远。
author: thesilverowls
source: POKENAME are fiercely protective of their Trainer, keeping them out of sight of nearby Trainers with their large shield to prevent unnecessary battles. When in battle, their shield releases pulses of natural energy that push enemies far away.

entry: 即使在野外，POKENAME也是坚定的守护者。小小身体满是密实肌肉，能正面扛下大多数打击。它会变色伪装，却从不在战斗时使用。
author: infinex21
source: Even in the wild, POKENAME are stalwart protectors of other Pokémon. Their small bodies are densely packed with muscle, so they can withstand most blows head-on. They can change their hues for camouflage, but they never do so in battle.

entry: POKENAME背上树干般的结构里，有特殊肌肉，能调节保护壳的高低，遮住或露出结坚果的枝条。这些坚果广泛用于点心，也当沙拉配料。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME can manipulate the elevation of its protective shell with specialized muscles of the treetrunk-like growth on its back. This protects or exposes the branches that grow tree nuts, which are widely used as snacks and as salad toppings.

entry: POKENAME用大嘴吃硬食，力气足以咬穿钢板。它勇敢，毫不犹豫地帮助、保护其他生物，还常拿大嘴当盾。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME eat tough foods with their large maws, which have enough strength to bite through a sheet of steel. They have valiant hearts and will not hesitate to help and protect others; notably, they often use their maws as shields.

entry: 这些披甲巨兽，有时被称为“森林中沉睡的堡垒”。它们更爱在树荫休息、大吃落果，但一旦行动，力量与怒火都堪称传奇。
author: karagar
source: These armored behemoths are sometimes called "sleeping bulwarks of the forest". While they prefer to relax in the shade and gorge themselves on fallen berries, when driven to action, their strength and fury are legendary.

entry: 气温过高，POKENAME背上的厚木会渗出琥珀色树液。若脱水，树液就变得极其浓稠。
author: .izik
source: The thick wood on POKENAME's back sweats an amber-colored sap when the temperature grows too high. If dehydrated, this sap becomes incredibly thick.

entry: POKENAME的壳近乎无法穿透，在森林家园缓缓行走，毫无畏惧。它习惯固定，每天走同一条路，小型宝可梦会靠它，安全前往食物与水源。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME has a nigh-impenetrable shell and has no fear when they lumber about in the forests they call home. They fall into easy habits, traveling the same route each day, and small Pokémon will rely on POKENAME to get to food or water safely.

entry: POKENAME往果实里灌奇异的易燃树液，扔向靠巢太近的生物。果实一撞就炸，滚烫果浆向四面飞溅。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME fills fruit with a peculiar combustible sap before lobbing it at those who venture too close to its nest. The fruit explodes on impact, spraying hot pulp in all directions.

entry: 密实骨骼与沉重护壳，让POKENAME很擅长潜水，觅食时能迅速抵达深水。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: Dense bones and a heavy protective shell make POKENAME an excellent diver. These traits allow it to reach deep waters quickly when searching for food.

entry: POKENAME翼上薄树皮，帮助它在寒水中高速游动。偶尔会从水里跃起，将种子甩向四面。
author: .izik
source: The thin layer of bark on POKENAME's wings helps it swim at high speeds through chilly waters. It occasionally leaps into the air from the water, flinging seeds in all directions.

entry: POKENAME是宽厚的统领，把自认子民的安全与防护放在首位。臂盾能扛巨力，反击的尖刺连加固钢材也能穿透。
author: notadoctor75
