source: POKENAME is a magnanimous ruler, putting the safety and defense of those it considers its subjects above all else. The shields on its arms can withstand tremendous force, and it will retaliate with spikes that can pierce reinforced steel.

entry: 它的触须虽能自如挥动，却坚硬无比。很少挑事，但为护弱者，毫不犹豫地介入争斗，用触须挡开攻击，庇护其他生物。
author: infinex21
source: Its feelers are incredibly hard despite how freely they can flail about. It rarely starts fights but will not hesitate to interfere with fights to protect the weaker party. It uses its feelers to repel attacks and to shield others.

entry: POKENAME操控地面，更好地保护其他生物。它把在意的生物罩进石穹顶，直到危险被击退。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses its powers to manipulate the ground to better protect others. It shields those it cares about by encasing them in a protective stone dome until it has fended off the danger.

entry: POKENAME是坚韧战士，不停蜕甲，让新甲长得更强。战斗时用耳朵当棍棒，猛击敌人。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are durable fighters, shedding their armor constantly so it can regrow even stronger. They use their ears as clubs in combat, bludgeoning their foes.

entry: POKENAME背披刺甲，尾巴肌肉强健，爪能劈斩，颚能猛咬，双目视觉也完美。种种本领齐备，几乎从任何方向都难以接近它。
author: stevethebarbarian
source: POKENAME has spiked armor on its back, a heavily muscled tail, slashing claws, gnashing jaws, and perfect binocular vision. Between them all, it is almost impossible to approach it from any direction.

entry: POKENAME挥连枷攻击，任其裂开，向大片区域散出尖刺。性情虽严肃，遇火却极其紧张。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME swing their flails to attack, letting them crack apart to release spikes across a wide area. Despite their serious nature, they are extremely nervous around fire.

entry: POKENAME钢铁身上长出的刺，极其锋利，似乎矿石吃得越多，刺就越尖。
author: .izik
source: The thorns growing from POKENAME's steel body are extremely sharp. They appear to grow even sharper the more ore it consumes.

entry: POKENAME出没于火山附近，享受熔岩带来的温暖。初步研究显示，面对穿红衣的对象，似乎会变得好斗。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME can be found near volcanoes, enjoying the warmth that lava brings. Preliminary research shows that they seem to become aggressive when faced with someone wearing red.

entry: POKENAME对垃圾有近乎着迷的食欲，不停吃垃圾箱和路上残留的垃圾。有些甚至掀翻整辆垃圾车，只为吃车内的垃圾堆。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME have an obsessive hunger for garbage, constantly eating out of dumpsters and trash left behind on trails. Some have even flipped over whole garbage trucks just to eat the piles of trash they carry.

entry: POKENAME头壳上长着极坚固的鳍，连游艇撞上，也不会凹陷。
author: .izik
source: The shell on POKENAME's head sports an incredibly strong fin atop its body. This fin is durable enough to emerge undented even if a yacht collides with it.

entry: POKENAME飞行时，在领地四处撒小种子。夜里释放尖锐高频声，让种子迅速生长。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME scatters small seeds around its territory as it flies. At night, it releases a high pitched frequency that causes the seeds to grow rapidly.

entry: POKENAME受威胁时，会把头低向敌人，靠花朵的坚韧花瓣吸收撞击。它爱护其他生物，也会挡住袭向较小宝可梦的打击。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME lower their head toward their foe when they feel threatened, relying on the tough petals of their flower to absorb impacts and keep themselves safe. They have a protective nature and will also block strikes intended for smaller Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME的蘑菇易燃，常被采来作森林露营徒步者的引火物。孢子会附到附近树上，因此宝可梦巡护员会定期刮掉蘑菇，防止野火。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME mushrooms are often harvested for their flammable properties, acting as tinder for hikers who camp out in forests. Their spores cling to nearby trees, so Pokémon Rangers routinely scrape off these mushrooms to avoid wildfires.

entry: POKENAME的蘑菇有栗香，干时极硬，久泡后却会变柔韧。在山区用于炒菜，备受珍爱。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's chestnut-scented mushroom is incredibly hard when dry. When soaked for extended periods it becomes pliable and is used in stir-fry dishes in mountainous regions, where it is highly regarded.

entry: 它碰击手臂和手上的鳞片交流。强壮尾巴上的刺，也是种子，因此尾巴击过的地方，常会长出植物。
author: infinex21
source: It communicates by striking together the scales on its arms and hands. The spikes on its strong tail are also seeds, so plants often grow where its tail has struck.

entry: POKENAME利用对手的好斗，摆出守势，任其攻击钻石般坚硬的身体。等敌人耗尽体力，POKENAME便以强力冲撞了结，自己毫发无损。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME takes advantage of aggressive opponents by letting them attack its diamond-hard body while it takes a defensive posture. Once the foe has tired itself out, POKENAME finishes them off with a powerful tackle without having taken any damage.

entry: POKENAME穿过田野与花园，撒下橄榄石碎晶，蕴含帮助植物生长的神秘能量。古传说称，入冬前收回碎片，能让次年的魔力更强。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Traveling through fields and gardens, POKENAME scatter shards of peridot crystals laced with a mystical energy that helps plants grow. Old legends claim that recollecting the shards before winter will amplify the magic the following year.

entry: POKENAME重壳防御无懈可击，却严重限制行动。战法是扛下重击，再用强力撞头或刺痛敌人的尖刺反击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's heavy shell gives it impeccable defenses, but severely limits its mobility. Its battle style relies on tanking its opponent's heavy blows before countering with powerful headbutts or painful stabs with its quills.

entry: POKENAME是真正的森林守护者，铠甲与盾硬如钢铁。POKENAME常自信十足地迎向偷猎者和伐木者，将连枷高挥过头，冲向对方。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are a true guardian of the forest, their armor and shield as hard as steel. POKENAME will often confront poachers and loggers with unbridled confidence, swinging their flails high above their heads as they charge towards them.

entry: POKENAME用魔杖远程控制花朵，操纵根部缠住敌人，再以精神冲击追击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its wand to control flowers from a distance. It manipulates their roots to ensnare foes before following up with Psyshock.

entry: POKENAME召唤的刺果，能挡住一切接近的企图。对手往往还没进到攻击范围，就烦得放弃。
author: notadoctor75
source: The burrs that POKENAME summons are able to block any and all attempts to approach it. Opponents often get annoyed and abandon their attempts before ever getting within range for an attack.

entry: POKENAME背上的叶片，准备战斗时会变硬，锋利如刀。用后迅速腐烂，几乎不留下POKENAME参与战斗的证据。
author: drcew
source: POKENAME grows leaves on its back that stiffen and become as sharp as knives when it's ready to battle. These leaves will rapidly decay after use, leaving little evidence of POKENAME's involvement in the battle.

entry: POKENAME在多风山顶脱去护壳，常被卷上天空。身体太密重，浮不住，就坠进山谷，砸出深坑，自己却毫发无伤。
author: eiskitsune
source: After shedding their protective shells on windy peaks, POKENAME are often swept into the air. Too dense to stay aloft, they plummet into the valleys below, creating deep impact craters but emerging completely unscathed.

entry: POKENAME尾端的栗子一碰就燃，因此POKENAME会用这颗奇异坚果，打击敌人，驱赶威胁。背上的大刺也同样如此。
author: .realthree
source: The chestnut at the end of POKENAME's tail combusts if touched. Because of that, POKENAME wards off threats by striking its foes with the unnatural nut. The large spikes on its back work in the same way.

entry: 曾有哲人说，与POKENAME相伴到老的训练家，会度过漫长充实的一生。它忠诚无比，又十分亲昵。
author: bobosmith01
source: It was once said by a philosopher that a Trainer who grows old with POKENAME at their side will lead a long and fulfilling life. It is deeply loyal and highly affectionate.

entry: POKENAME卸下身上铠甲，将其打造成直接作战的武器。新钉头锤虽沉重，POKENAME却灵巧善谋，击击精准。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME shed the armor from their bodies in favor of fashioning it into a weapon to use directly in battle. Despite the bulk of their new mace, POKENAME are dexterous and calculating, always landing precise blows.

entry: POKENAME常见于拆迁队。坚甲与高速，让它能充当破拆球，冲撞承重墙，拆倒预定拆除的建筑。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are a common sight amongst demolition crews. Their tough armour and high speed allow them to function as wrecking balls, charging at supporting walls to bring down buildings scheduled for destruction.

entry: POKENAME飞巡领地，从空中向入侵者投下种子炸弹。长久下来，占据的崎岖山地，会变成茂密森林。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME fly around their territories, dropping seed bombs from above on any intruder. Over time, the rugged mountains they claim transform into dense forests.

entry: POKENAME硬壳能吸收或挡开大多数投射物。缩入壳中、耗费大量能量后，POKENAME能让护壳短暂胀到原来的五倍。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME's hard shell can absorb or deflect most projectiles. By retreating inward and expending a lot of energy, POKENAME quintuple the size of their protective shells for a few moments.

entry: POKENAME的壳，连最强力量也穿不透。它能控制根，将自己牢牢固定，即使软沙也推不动。进攻时，就用刺壳撞向被根缠住的对手。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's shell is impenetrable even against the most intense forces. It can use its power over roots to anchor itself and become immovable, even in soft sand. For offense, it rams into root-bound opponents with its spiked shell.

entry: POKENAME用背部长出的藤状枝条攻击。若碰到滚烫耳朵，枝条可能意外烧起来。
author: h0bojoe
source: POKENAME attacks using vine-like sticks that sprout from its back. If these touch its hot ears, they may accidentally burst into flames.

entry: POKENAME从森林收集枝条，做小型训练假人练拳。训练时，拳头会迸出小火花与火苗，最后往往把假人烧着。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME will gather sticks from the forests to create small training dummies to practice punching against. Its fists generate small sparks and flames as it trains, leading to it eventually setting the dummies on fire.

entry: POKENAME常飞在树枝间，寻找能增强微弱火焰的辣树果。耳毛柔软蓬松，其他宝可梦还会想偷走筑巢。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME often flies among tree branches in search of spicy berries that can strengthen its still-weak flames. The fur growing from its ears is so soft and fluffy that other Pokémon try to steal it to build their nests.

entry: POKENAME靠手势向敌人射出余烬、施放火焰。依赖手语交流的人，发现POKENAME能理解动作，会十分开心。
author: quackquackattack
source: To cast fire upon their foes, POKENAME rely on hand gestures to shoot embers at their foes. People who rely on sign language to communicate are delighted when POKENAME understand their gestures.

entry: POKENAME的毛不断闷烧，走到哪儿都留下淡淡焦痕。它领地意识强，会在泥地画发光图案，警告入侵者离开。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME's fur constantly smolders, leaving faint scorch marks wherever it walks. It is fiercely territorial and has been seen drawing glowing patterns in the dirt to warn intruders away.

entry: POKENAME偏爱独居，大吃焦枝。有时会为填饱肚子，放火烧树，因此被朽木妖等宝可梦憎恨。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME prefers to live in solitude, spending its time feasting upon charred branches. It has been known to set trees ablaze to satiate its hunger, leading it to be hated by Pokémon like Trevenant.

entry: POKENAME饮食极特别，只吃树枝。腹内火焰让身体不断散暖，是冬季绝佳睡伴。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME have a very particular diet consisting of only sticks. Their bodies emit constant warmth due to the flames in their stomachs, making them the perfect sleeping companion in the winter.

entry: 这种宝可梦友善却害羞，身体温暖毛绒，很适合抱。但受惊或不知所措时，就会隐形逃走。拿根小枝给它啃，便能哄出藏身处。
author: imaginita
source: A friendly but shy Pokémon. Because of its warm, fluffy body, it is excellent for cuddling with, but if startled or overwhelmed, it will turn invisible and flee. It can be coaxed out of hiding by offering a twig for it to nibble on.

entry: 它每天都得剪毛，照顾很费心。毛原本用于制作“向尾喵的尾巴”，如今则纺成给老人用的毛线。
author: quackquackattack
source: It is a high-maintenance creature because it needs to be sheared daily. Its wool was originally used in the process of creating a Fluffy Tail, but nowadays it is spun into yarn for elderly people.

entry: 它的毛被认为是世界最保暖的材料之一，做成毛衣，却会让穿者挨上厉害静电。发生几起因此住院的事件后，POKENAME的毛便从国际市场召回。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Its fleece is considered to be some of the warmest material in the world, however sweaters made from it give wearers a nasty static shock. After a few hospitalizations from these occurrences, POKENAME fleece was recalled from international markets.

entry: POKENAME没食物时，会改吃树枝。耳朵能排出暖气，在冬天保暖。
author: santon5512
source: When without food, POKENAME will resort to eating sticks instead. They can release warm air from their ears, keeping themselves warm in the winter.

entry: POKENAME皮肤上的油脂，味道火辣。气味若刺鼻，吃起来会比平时更辣。
author: dodoowner_
source: The oils on POKENAME's skin have a fiery taste to them. If the substance has a pungent odor, it will be spicier than usual.

entry: POKENAME用背部长出的藤状枝条攻击。若碰到滚烫耳朵，枝条可能意外烧起来。
author: h0bojoe
source: POKENAME attacks using vine-like sticks that sprout from its back. If these touch its hot ears, they may accidentally burst into flames.

entry: POKENAME晒太阳、吃小枝，供养背上花苞。过热时，花苞会排出超过华氏390度的空气。
author: h0bojoe
source: POKENAME absorbs sunlight and eats twigs to nourish the bulb on its back. When overheated, the bulb vents air exceeding 390 degrees Fahrenheit.

entry: POKENAME常见于卡洛斯森林，啃食落枝，磨利牙齿。兴奋时体温骤升，干燥月份可能因此引发森林火灾。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are a common sight in the forests of Kalos, gnawing on fallen branches and twigs to keep their teeth sharp. When they get excited, their body temperature spikes; in drier months this can cause them to trigger forest fires.

entry: POKENAME钻入地下深处，用烈焰熔化挡路巨石。有些留下的隧道，数小时都保持炽热。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME burrows deep underground, melting any boulders in its path with intense flames. Some tunnels left in its wake remain superheated for hours.

entry: POKENAME覆着黄色泥状物，温度可比熔岩。它常无意引发野火，只得住在荒凉地区。
author: .izik
source: The yellow, mud-like substance coating POKENAME's body can reach temperatures comparable to molten lava. Without meaning to, it frequently starts wildfires, forcing it to live in desolate areas.

entry: POKENAME用尾巴保持平衡，够取高处爱吃的小枝。有时短暂窥见未来，会让它不安。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME balances on its tail to help it reach the higher twigs that it likes to snack on. It sometimes gets brief visions of the future that cause it distress.

entry: POKENAME常在树枝上啃小枝和树叶。战前，会点燃正在嚼的东西，扔向可能的敌人。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are often seen munching on twigs and leaves atop tree branches. They will ignite whatever they are munching on and fling it at potential foes before battling.

entry: POKENAME爱吃小枝零食，却很挑食，每只各有偏爱木材。枝条给体内火焰供燃料，确保吐火始终强劲。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME snack on small pieces of twigs, though they are rather picky eaters; they each prefer specific types of wood to snack on. By eating twigs, they fuel their internal flames and ensure the fire they spit out is always strong.

entry: POKENAME比起其他植物，更爱吃木头，尤其偏好针叶树材。体内强火既保暖，也能加热喷向敌人的水。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME eat wood over other vegetation, though they prefer to eat softwood most of all. They have strong flames within themselves, which keep them warm and heat up the water they spit out at foes.

entry: 最容易在热沙上找到晒太阳的POKENAME。大耳朵如散热片，既吸日光，提供火焰能量，也在POKENAME过热时排热。
author: imaginita
source: The best place to find a POKENAME is sunbathing on hot sand.  Its large ears act as a heat sink, absorbing the sun's rays to provide POKENAME with fiery energy, but also acting as a vent if POKENAME overheats.

entry: POKENAME用敏锐耳朵，感受人的情绪。遇威胁时，会吃小枝，增强瞬间移动的力量。
author: ghostslythe
source: POKENAME uses its sensitive ears to feel people's emotions. It is known to eat twigs to power up its teleportation if threatened.

entry: POKENAME一边探索，一边用意念折下树顶营养丰富的枝条吃。蜕毛做的外套轻巧、天然保暖，在寒冷地区很受欢迎。
author: chibitales
source: Using their telekinesis, POKENAME snap nutrient-rich branches from the tops of trees to munch on as they explore. Coats made using shed fur from these Pokémon are popular in cold regions because of their light weight and natural warmth.

entry: POKENAME友好忠诚，却不太好养。它总想练习火焰法术，过分热情，有时会意外把东西烧着。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is very friendly and loyal, but can be difficult to raise. It constantly wants to practice its fire spells, and its zealousness can sometimes lead to things accidentally being set on fire.

entry: POKENAME能让毛燃起不同颜色的火焰，取决于情绪和吃得好不好。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME can ignite its fur in various shades of flame. The color of its fire depends on its mood and how well it is fed.

entry: POKENAME时刻警觉，竖起大耳朵，倾听四方。牙齿还在长，因此先将树果弄碎、熔化，再进食。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Always on alert, POKENAME keep their large ears raised to listen in all directions. Their teeth are still growing, so they break up and melt down berries before eating them.

entry: POKENAME耳朵伸出的毛状藤蔓，十分敏感，能听见最远一英里外的声音。
author: .izik
source: The fur-like vines extending from POKENAME's ears are very sensitive. It can hear things from up to a mile away because of them.

entry: 它体表温暖，体内却最高可达800℃。耳朵和尾巴冒的火，是还无法完全控制的多余热量。
author: catsquatch_geography
source: Though its body is warm on the outside, its internal temperature can reach up to 800°C. The fires that burn from its ears and tail are excess heat it cannot yet fully control.

entry: POKENAME体内温度能超过华氏350度。为保护自己，会从宽大耳朵和火焰状尾巴排出热气。
author: imaginita
source: POKENAME's internal temperature can reach over 350 degrees Fahrenheit. To keep itself safe, it vents hot air through its roomy ears and flame-shaped tail.

entry: POKENAME吃小枝，在冰冷气候中保暖，多余热量从耳朵散出。它宁愿自己找枝条，也不要别人送。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME eats twigs to keep itself warm in its icy cold climate, with excess heat escaping from its ears. It prefers finding the twigs itself rather than having them given to it.

entry: POKENAME定期梳理耳毛，向盟友展示骄傲。哪怕一根毛乱得太久，也会让它十分不快。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME regularly grooms the fur in its ears as a display of pride to its allies. It grows very upset if even a single strand is out of order for too long.

entry: POKENAME放出强力火焰攻击前，鼻子会烧得通红。积蓄的热量，让它能感知空气变化，迅速应对威胁。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's nose glows red-hot just before it unleashes a powerful fire-based attack. The accumulated heat lets it sense changes in the air, allowing it to react quickly to threats.

entry: 谁想抓住POKENAME，它就立刻排热，烫伤对方手。手杖哪怕只擦到别物，也会马上燃起，雨里也不例外。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME will immediately vent hot air and burn the hand of the person who attempted to grab hold of it. If its rod so much as scrapes against another object, it will immediately combust, even during rain.

entry: POKENAME尖刺渗出的黏稠毒液，极易燃烧。它能随意点燃，再用力摇头，将火撒得尽可能远，吓退对手。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME spines exude a viscous toxin that is highly flammable. They can ignite this toxin at will, shaking their head vigorously to scatter their flames as far as possible to scare off rivals.

entry: POKENAME嚼小枝当零食，维持体内强火。多余热量，从长触须化作温暖舒缓的气场释放。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME munch on small twigs as snacks, which help to keep their internal flames strong. They release some of their excess heat as a warm and soothing aura from their long feelers.

entry: 它一排热，飞行高度就会下降。因此，从嘴里使出火属性招式时，POKENAME会开始沉向地面。
author: bobosmith01
source: When it vents heat from its body, its altitude lowers. As a result, when it spits Fire-type moves from its mouth, POKENAME will start sinking to the ground.

entry: POKENAME成群蹦过稀树草原，震得大地发颤。帽子吸收、储存日光，留在寒夜保暖，尾巴则散去余热。
author: wyzi
source: Packs of POKENAME cause the ground to tremble as they bound across the savannah. Their hats capture sunlight, which they store to keep warm during cold nights, while their tails release the excess heat.

entry: 许多训练家在林中追POKENAME，却很少追上。有理论认为，POKENAME能记住多达300处不同藏身点。
author: .realthree
source: Many Trainers attempt pursuing POKENAME through the woods, but they rarely catch up to it. It is theorized that a POKENAME can memorize the location of as many as 300 different hiding places.

entry: 这只宝可梦常被孩子抱着走。既可爱又容易照顾，主食是小枝。
author: pix3l_655
source: This Pokémon is often seen being carried around by children. It is both cute and easy to care for, with its diet mainly consisting of twigs.

entry: POKENAME十分爱吃木头，会寻找干枝啃。似乎只听枝条被踩断的声音，就能找到。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME has a great hunger for wood and will seek out dry sticks to chew on. They seem to locate them simply by listening for the sound they make when they break underfoot.

entry: POKENAME每天花好几个小时，磨炼力量与速度。出拳快得拳头都会着火。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: POKENAME dedicates hours to honing its strength and speed every day. When it strikes, its punches are so fast that its fists catch fire.

entry: 它住在遍布沙漠的某个洞穴，每天换一处废弃沙漠住所。游牧民按照神话传统，与它同行，但起源和目的，已随岁月失传。
author: quackquackattack
source: It rests in one of the burrows sprawling through the desert, hopping between abandoned desert homes daily. Nomads travel alongside it as part of a mythological tradition, though of what origin and purpose has been lost to time.

entry: POKENAME吃小枝、落叶和其他腐败植物。受威胁时，会一边试着逃走，一边喷出一阵火花。
author: theartemis1
source: POKENAME feeds on twigs, fallen leaves and other decaying plant matter. When threatened, it spouts a flurry of Embers as it attempts to escape.

entry: POKENAME在强风中飞行，会掉落羽毛。落地时仍滚烫，足以点燃森林。
author: .izik
source: Feathers drop from POKENAME's body as it flies through high winds. The feathers that touch the ground are so hot that they can ignite forest fires upon landing.

entry: POKENAME的尖牙，能热得超过商用炉的温度。咬过猎物会留下发光咬痕，攻击过后许久，仍继续闷烧。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's fangs can heat up beyond the temperature of a commercial furnace. It leaves glowing bite marks on its prey, which continue to smolder long after the attack.

entry: POKENAME发现猎物，会先发出令人胆寒的吼声，再扑上去，用熔岩般滚烫的尖牙咬住。据说灼热一口，强得能熔铁。
author: .izik
source: After spotting its prey, POKENAME unleashes a blood-curdling roar before lunging in to bite with its molten-hot fangs. Its scorching bite is said to be strong enough to melt iron.

entry: POKENAME在火圈中旋转，跳出复杂舞蹈，让观众着迷。带羽的身体随动作扬起余烬，造出灿烂光景。
author: .izik
source: Spinning in fiery circles, POKENAME performs an intricate dance that mesmerizes those who watch. As it moves, embers flare from its feathered body, creating dazzling displays.

entry: POKENAME最爱沙漠附近长的辣椒。食物越辣，能发出的声爆就越响。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's preferred food is the peppers that grow near deserts. The spicier the food it consumes, the louder the sound bursts it can produce.

entry: POKENAME通常独居沙漠，吃虫属性宝可梦和其他小猎物。偶尔也会成大群，捕猎体型更大、肉更多的物种。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME are usually solitary, desert-dwelling Pokémon that feed on Bug-type Pokémon and other small prey, but from time to time, they form large groups, allowing them to hunt larger, meatier species.

entry: POKENAME披着密实树皮状甲，手臂轻轻一挥，就能点燃附近物体。年纪渐长，铠甲会长出如树木纹脊的沟痕。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can set nearby objects alight with a flick of the arm with their dense bark-like armor. As they grow older, grooves form in their armor that resemble ridges of a tree.

entry: 盟友难过时，POKENAME会往天上射小火球。火球爆开，绽出烟花般的灿烂光景。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME shoots small fireballs into the sky when its allies are sad. These balls explode into brilliant displays resembling fireworks.

entry: POKENAME占据森林的一部分，在周围布下鬼火，标明领地的边界。据闯入者所述，他们曾出现幻觉、中暑、短期记忆丧失等多种症状。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME claims parts of the forest as its own and marks its territory with will-o'-wisps that mark the area's circumference. Those who enter its domain report a number of symptoms, such as hallucinations, heat stroke, and short-term memory loss.

entry: 这种宝可梦用体热推动身体，速度极快。颈边烟雾帮助排出多余能量，最高可达华氏400度。
author: torterrable
source: This Pokémon can move extremely quickly by using the heat from its body to propel itself. The smoke around its neck helps vent extra energy and can get as hot as 400 degrees Fahrenheit.

entry: 有些温泉让POKENAME把腿伸进水里，加热泉水。这消耗不少能量，因此得储备许多捆树枝，供POKENAME吃。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Some hot springs use POKENAME by having them put their legs in the water and heat them up. This uses up quite a bit of energy, requiring these springs to house many bundles of sticks for POKENAME to eat.

entry: POKENAME干枝吃得越多，壳里涌出的烟就越浓。呼吸带着淡淡焦木味。
author: .izik
source: The more dry twigs POKENAME eats, the thicker the smoke that billows from its shell. Its breath smells faintly of charred wood.

entry: POKENAME从地面弹起，折下树上小枝。更大、更有营养的树枝，能让身体烧得更亮、更久。
author: icelevelincarnate
source: POKENAME launch themselves from the ground to snap twigs off of trees. Bigger, nutrient-rich branches help their bodies burn brighter and for longer.

entry: POKENAME蓬松的尾尖，是产热中心。若那里的毛掉了，就很难保持足够温暖。
author: .realthree
source: The fluffy tip of POKENAME's tail is the center of its heat production. If it loses the fur there, it has a hard time staying warm enough.

entry: 这种可爱宝可梦，喜欢吃大小枝条。木头增强它回溯过去的能力，让它清楚、无误地看见往事。
author: beatdoof
source: This adorable Pokémon enjoys eating twigs and branches. The consumed wood strengthens its power of retrocognition, allowing it a clear, untarnished view of the past.

entry: POKENAME海带吃得越多，体内火焰就越热。达到最高温时，吐火能在金属上熔出洞。
author: .izik
source: The flames within POKENAME's body grow hotter the more kelp it consumes. At peak temperatures, it can melt holes in metal by spitting these flames.

entry: POKENAME很容易学会取物游戏，追着扔出的树枝，开心地边啃边送回训练家。它爱在巢里收集枝条，夜里当磨牙玩具。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are easily trained to play games of fetch, chasing after any sticks thrown and happily chewing on them as they return them to their Trainer. They like to keep a collection of sticks in their den, using them as chew toys at night.

entry: POKENAME一直过热，处于半清醒状态。耳朵和鬃毛释放的热量，足以引发森林火灾。
author: ghostslythe
source: POKENAME is in a constant state of overheating, leaving the Pokémon in a semi-conscious state. Its ears and mane give off enough heat to start forest fires.

entry: POKENAME疾跑时，耳朵随之弹动，每步都撒出细小余烬。跑得越快，火绒便烧得越热。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's ears bounce as it dashes, scattering tiny embers with every step. Its fiery fluff burns hotter the faster it runs.

entry: POKENAME三个头都能喷火，温度高得足以熔钨。暴怒时，合力吐息，会在身周形成灼热旋风。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME can unleash flames from each of its three heads, reaching temperatures high enough to melt tungsten. When enraged, its combined fiery breath creates a searing whirlwind around it.

entry: POKENAME背上的枝条，也是身体的一部分，能像藤蔓般伸展，再点燃，吓退捕食者。
author: h0bojoe
source: The stick on POKENAME's back is a living part of its body. It stretches it like a vine and sets it ablaze to deter predators.

entry: POKENAME常漫无目的地游荡，随意施法，不顾后果，常因此引发森林火灾。
author: kiwiarms
source: POKENAME are known to wander aimlessly and cast spells without care for the consequences. This often results in forest fires.

entry: POKENAME很少被看见，但温暖夏夜，能听见它在城都森林四处翻找。黎明前夕，POKENAME成群聚集，以喧闹宴席和舞蹈庆祝日出。
author: turron_turron
source: Though rarely seen, POKENAME can be heard rummaging throughout the forests of Johto on warm summer nights. At the brink of dawn, groups of POKENAME gather to celebrate the sunrise with raucous feast and dance.

entry: POKENAME用棍子施展精神力量，唤出火焰。它会造出一道道火光，引擅入者远离家园。
author: kam_doodle_snek
source: POKENAME uses its stick to conjure flames with psychic powers. It will create trails of fiery wisps to lead trespassers away from its home.

entry: POKENAME吃啮齿类宝可梦，会用巧计引出洞穴：把树枝塞进去点燃。火烧起来，洞中住客便被引到等候的POKENAME面前。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME eat rodent Pokémon and rely on a clever ploy to coax them out of burrows. They shove sticks into burrows and set them on fire. As the fire burns, the burrow residents are drawn out to where POKENAME are waiting.

entry: POKENAME的法杖既能引导火，也能导电。一旦掉了法杖，力量就会大幅削弱。
author: hophoppip
source: The staff POKENAME wields can channel both fire and electricity. It is greatly weakened if it drops the staff.

entry: POKENAME的花瓣，常被争相用来制作秋季花环。它又像小女巫，因此成了一些节庆连锁店的吉祥物。
author: opossiblymage
source: POKENAME's petals are coveted for making wreaths for the autumn season. As it also has the appearance of a tiny witch, it has been adopted as a mascot for some holiday chain stores.

entry: 古老故事称，是POKENAME教人类控制火，也尊重火。讽刺的是，如今气候变化引发前所未有的野火，反而威胁POKENAME的栖息地。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: There are tales of POKENAME in ancient times being the Pokémon that taught humans how to control fire, and to respect it. It is ironic that POKENAME habitats are now at risk due to unprecedented wildfires caused by climate change.

entry: 背上花苞长出的藤状枝条，可用于战斗。吸收日光越多，火焰就烧得越热。
author: h0bojoe
source: Vine-like sticks grow from the bulb on its back and are used in battle. The more sunlight it absorbs, the hotter their flames burn.

entry: POKENAME睡觉时劈啪跳着静电，为尾里的枝条充能。抽出枝条，静电积起，点燃枝尖。
author: gekkou.
source: POKENAME crackles with static as it sleeps, charging the branch in its tail. When the branch is drawn from its tail, static builds up and sets the tip ablaze.

entry: POKENAME能给小物件施魔法，使其防火，也能通过实物媒介，聚焦施展招式与法术。两种用途，POKENAME通常都选木棍。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME has the power to enchant a small object to become fireproof. It is also able to focus moves and spells through a physical medium. In both cases, POKENAME's choice is often a wooden stick.

entry: POKENAME把采来枝条、练习魔火的树，视为神圣。谁伤害这些树，就会领教POKENAME火术的全部威力。
author: sk372
source: The trees from which POKENAME gathers the branches it uses for practicing its magical fire are considered sacred to it. Those who harm said trees will be shown the full might of POKENAME's pyrotechnic capabilities.

entry: POKENAME的尾巴终生生长，看尾上叶片多少，就能判断年龄。不过，最末端始终是裸枝，方便引导POKENAME的火。
author: imaginita
source: A POKENAME's tail continues to grow its entire life, so you can tell how old one is by how many fronds its tail has.  However, the very end is always a bare branch, so that it can channel POKENAME's fire.

entry: 秋季苹果园里，POKENAME很常见。它用尾点起的篝火，通常温暖、欢迎所有生物，但果园受威胁，就可能热到危险。
author: notadoctor75
source: POKENAME is a common sight in apple orchards in the fall. While the bonfires it starts with its tail are usually warm and inviting to all, they can reach dangerous temperatures if the orchard is threatened.

entry: POKENAME的火焰攻击，总从喙发出，先绕体盘旋，再像法术般攻向敌人。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's flame-based attacks swirl around its body before being deployed at foes like a spell. They always originate from its beak.

entry: POKENAME擅长远近战，能用尾里的棍棒点起火焰，射向对手。近身时，它则挥爪劈斩，以强腿踢击。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME excels at ranged and close combat fighting. Using the stick from its tail, POKENAME can light flames and launch them at opponents. Up close, this Pokémon utilizes its claws for slashing and powerful legs for kicking.

entry: POKENAME用精神力量，悬在栖身湖泊中央的水面上方冥想。期间，周围的水会开始沸腾。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME meditates at the center of its lake home, using its psychic abilities to levitate above the water. During this meditation, the surrounding water begins to boil.

entry: POKENAME在泥里跺步，把小枝好好藏在尾中。待沼气积聚，就迅速抽出枝条，摩擦将气体点燃。
author: imaginita
source: POKENAME keeps its twig safely tucked away in its tail while stomping about in the mud. Then, once the marsh gases have built up, it swiftly pulls out the twig, and the friction sets it all alight.

entry: POKENAME随身的棍子，能远程移动泥巴。谁走得离巢太近，就向旅人抛泥。
author: .izik
source: The stick POKENAME carries can be used to move mud from a distance. It hurls mud at travelers who venture too close to its den.

entry: POKENAME察觉附近有悲伤，火焰就会变强。有人相信，它是想让对方开心。
author: .izik
source: The flames POKENAME produces grow stronger when it senses sadness nearby. Some believe it does this in hopes of cheering the person up.

entry: POKENAME能借意念，在空气中制造摩擦，点燃小枝。战斗时，用枝条催动能力。
author: sylia
source: POKENAME's telekinetic abilities allow them to create a friction from the air to light up their twig. They use it in combat as a catalyst for their abilities.

entry: POKENAME棍上的火，反映当时的情绪。越想防御、保护其他生物，枝端火便越大、越热。
author: sk372
source: The flame on the stick reflects POKENAME's emotional state at the time. The more defensive and protective of others it feels, the bigger and hotter the fire burning on the end.

entry: 只有荆棘灌木摘来的小枝，才适合引导它的元素能量。与POKENAME玩取物得小心，扔去的东西送回来时，会燃着火，还沾满毒唾液。
author: ozydamians
source: Only twigs plucked from thorny bushes are suitable conduits for its elemental energy. Be careful when you play fetch with POKENAME, it returns what you throw aflame and covered in poisonous saliva.

entry: 它能抓握的尾巴，始终牢牢攥着一根小枝。用特选木柴堆起的篝火，会燃出绚丽虹焰。
author: bandedbodypress
source: It always has a twig firmly grasped in its prehensile tail. The bonfire it builds with its specially-chosen firewood produces a vibrant rainbow blaze.

entry: POKENAME遇险，会点燃躯干两侧细丝的尖端。细丝源源不断地产火球，供它投出，再以控火能力引导。
author: sk372
source: When in danger, POKENAME ignites the tips of the tendrils lining its torso. These tendrils produce a constant supply of fireballs that it can fling about and direct using its pyrokinesis abilities.

entry: POKENAME把小枝夹在毛簇间，寻找寒冷潮湿灌木里的食物时，用来引火保暖。黎明常能听见POKENAME彼此呼唤，传达附近有适合收集的木头。
author: catsquatch_geography
source: POKENAME accumulates twigs between tufts of fur, using it as kindling for warmth while searching for food in cold, damp undergrowth. Calls between POKENAME can often be heard at dawn, signaling to others that ideal collectable wood is nearby.

entry: POKENAME灵巧挥动火尾，既攻击，也向群中同伴传讯。即使吊在墙上或天花板，也能瞄准火焰。
author: imaginita
source: POKENAME deftly wields its fiery tail both to attack and to signal the other members of its troupe. It can even aim its fire while hanging from the walls or ceiling.

entry: POKENAME像转旋钮般转动小枝，调节火势。全力释放的火焰，几秒就能熔钢。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME can control the intensity of its flames by turning its twig like a knob. At maximum output, these blasts can melt steel within seconds.

entry: 它弄丢尾巴里的棍子，宁愿换根更大的，也不求助找回，免得伤自尊。若是被偷，就会暴怒迎战，找小偷算账。
author: catsquatch_geography
source: It will replace a lost tail stick with an even larger one rather than ask for help retrieving it, to avoid bruising its pride. If the stick is stolen, it furiously launches into battle to confront the thief.

entry: POKENAME能用棍子，操纵最近接触过的水，让水如蛇般移动，不受重力束缚。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME can direct water it has recently touched using its stick. The water moves in serpentine patterns, defying gravity.

entry: 战斗变艰难时，POKENAME会把双刃相互刮擦，摩擦让剑燃起，大幅增强战力。
author: sk372
source: When a battle begins to become arduous, POKENAME scraps both of its blades together. The friction causes the swords to ignite, greatly enhancing its combat abilities.

entry: 它的尾毛极热，抽出大棍时，仅摩擦就足以点燃。它挥动棍子与自己的触须交流，也用来驱赶威胁。
author: infinex21
source: The fur of its tail is so hot that mere friction is enough to set its large stick alight when drawn. It waves this stick and its own feelers around to communicate and to ward off threats.

entry: POKENAME能从尾巴放出随时可点燃的孢子，再衔着棍子，如指挥家般引导火焰。
author: busilisk
source: POKENAME can release spores from its tail that ignite at a moment's notice. Like a conductor, it directs these flames using the stick held in its mouth.

entry: POKENAME会与街头魔术师一同表演，令观众惊叹。满月之夜则暂停表演，沐浴月光，恢复魔力。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can be seen performing with street magicians to amaze audiences. They take breaks on nights of the full moon to bask in the moonlight and recharge their magical powers.

entry: POKENAME一兴奋，头顶小枝就会烧起来。它会用来点燃附近物体，直到火熄，再寻找替代枝条。
author: .jerden
source: Whenever POKENAME gets excited, the twig on top of its head will burst into flames. POKENAME will use this to set fire to nearby objects until it burns out, at which point POKENAME will begin searching for a replacement.

entry: POKENAME用燃火小枝感知情绪，颜色随新感受而变。野外，POKENAME会看彼此火焰，确认大家是否开心，因此族群关系紧密。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME use their flame tipped twig to sense emotions, changing colours as it detects new feelings. In the wild, POKENAME read each others flames to know if everyone is happy. Their groups are tight knit because of this.

entry: 它结合电脉冲与随身棍子的烟讯，和群中同伴交流。捕猎时，会把高热或高电压导入爪中，选择对猎物最有效的一种。
author: notadoctor75
source: It communicates with members of its pack using a mix of electrical impulses and smoke signals from the stick it always carries. It will channel either intense heat or voltage through its claws to hunt, whatever is most effective against its prey.

entry: POKENAME十分温暖，寒冷地区的训练家会让它暖床。小枝通常不点燃，只在作战或需要火时才亮起。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME is really warm, so Trainers in cold areas use it to warm their beds. Its twig is usually unlit, but becomes lit when in battle or whenever fire is needed.

entry: POKENAME挥动火翼，在空中描出神秘图案。它的舞蹈诡异，带有催眠力的余烬会引来灵体。嘲弄仪式，就会惹起复仇之火，缠住冒犯者，纠缠不休，让他们忘不了曾经的无礼。
author: vhscopyofmeangirls
source: POKENAME's flaming wings trace cryptic patterns in the air, weaving hypnotic embers that lure spirits to its ghostly dance. Mocking its ritual ignites vengeful flames, which cling to offenders as ceaseless, haunting reminders of their disrespect.

entry: POKENAME口中的巨响，能让远处敌人失去平衡，再从天上倾下火球，将其了结。
author: .izik
source: The loud noise POKENAME produces from its mouth can throw enemies off balance from afar. It then rains fireballs down from the sky to finish them off.

entry: POKENAME拿珍爱的木棍敲臂上硬鳞，彼此交流。开战时，POKENAME快速依次敲过所有鳞片，同时点燃鳞片和棍子。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME communicate with each other by knocking their prized sticks against the hard scales on their arms. When entering combat, POKENAME strikes all the scales in a row quickly, igniting them and its stick at the same time.

entry: POKENAME暖得舒服，许多洞穴宝可梦会在寒夜靠着取暖。若生病，宝石却会热得瞬间灼伤皮肤，没有防护不可触碰。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME are toasty warm, and many cave-dwelling Pokémon cuddle up with it on cold nights. If it becomes ill, it should not be touched without protection, as its gems become hot enough to sear skin instantly.

entry: POKENAME不停搜寻森林，寻找最完美的棍子，一找到就会终生携带。POKENAME与棍子结下特殊纽带，学会通过它引导火焰。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME constantly search the forests they live in for the perfect stick, which they will carry with them for their entire lives. POKENAME forge special bonds with these sticks, learning to channel their fire through them.

entry: POKENAME走到哪里，都带着燃烧的棍子照亮周围。遭遇危险宝可梦，就会射出燃烧的利叶，吓走对方。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME carry a flaming stick with them wherever they go to illuminate the area around them. When confronted with a dangerous Pokémon, they can shoot flaming razor-sharp leaves to scare them away.

entry: 与盟友并肩作战时，POKENAME枝尖产生的火球，会泛起淡紫色。这时的高温，足以熔石。
author: .izik
source: When fighting alongside an ally, the fireballs POKENAME produces from the tip of its twig take on a slightly purple hue. In this state they are hot enough to melt stone.

entry: POKENAME通过棍子导火，毛尖便亮成灿橙色。火焰放出后仍能操纵，最远15英尺外，也能完美控制。
author: .izik
source: The tips of POKENAME's fur glow a brilliant orange as it channels fire through its stick. It can wield the flames even after producing them, maintaining perfect control from up to 15 feet away.

entry: POKENAME会与宝可梦巡护员合作，对林地进行安全的受控燃烧。泡泡呈灰色，常被认为是积灰所致。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME can be seen working with Pokémon rangers, creating safe and controlled burns of forests. The grey coloring of their bubbles is often attributed to ash buildup.

entry: POKENAME在苹果园附近游荡，把落果藏进毛里，留作以后的饭。战斗时，会向敌人发射熔糖。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME can be seen wandering near apple orchards, storing fallen fruit in its fur for later meals. In battle, it launches molten sugar at foes.

entry: 它们拨旺的火，会如星辰闪耀。夜里往天上投华丽火球，与盟友交流。火球落下时，常被气象学家误认成陨石。
author: icelevelincarnate
source: The fires they stoke sparkle like stars. At night, they lob magnificent fireballs into the sky to communicate with allies. Meteorologists often mistake these fireballs for meteorites when they rain back down.

entry: POKENAME很难从尾巴抽出棍子。幸好，不抽出也能像划火柴一样，用粗糙表面擦燃。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME has a hard time pulling its stick out of its tail. Luckily, it can still ignite the wood without removing it by striking it against a rough surface, just as a matchstick.

entry: POKENAME用小枝，记下心中所见、此刻发生的事。据说随后写下的内容，还能操纵当下之事。
author: beatdoof
source: With its own twig, POKENAME writes whatever it sees happening in the present through its mind. It is said that this Pokémon can manipulate what is happening in the present depending on what it writes next.

entry: POKENAME生气时，周围的水会沸腾。暴怒后，会向敌人吐出高热泡泡。
author: .izik
source: The water around POKENAME's body boils when it grows angry. It spits highly heated bubbles at foes when enraged.

entry: 干旱地区的旱季来临前，消防员会让POKENAME清除干燥引火物和灌木。它擅长寻找高火险地带，开出防火带，预防野火蔓延。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are employed by firefighters to clear out dry tinder and underbrush ahead of the dry season in arid areas. They have an aptitude for finding areas at high risk of fire, creating firebreaks in case a wildfire starts.

entry: POKENAME收集多种树木的大小枝条，铺在巢口。有记录称，它会跋涉数千英里，只为找到能采枝的新树。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME collect twigs and sticks from a variety of tree species to line the entrance of their dens. They have been documented travelling thousands of miles just to find new trees to gather from.

entry: POKENAME用尾巴带着棍子练魔法。主要的练习方式，是先打嗝吐出大量泡泡，再用棍子点燃。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME carries a stick with its tail to use for practicing magic. It belches up a large amount of bubbles before setting them alight via the stick as its primary way of magic practice.

entry: POKENAME游过湖泊，身后的水便沸腾。任何植物接触这水，都会当场煮熟。
author: .izik
source: The water behind POKENAME boils as it swims through lakes. Any plantlife exposed to this water will cook on the spot.

entry: POKENAME开始蓄攻击时，耳中绒毛会亮起。蓄满后，毛发燃起，向两侧喷出长长的火焰。
author: sk372
source: The fluff in POKENAME's ears glows brightly as it begins to charge up an attack. Once it fully charges, the fur ignites and fires off lengthy plumes of flame on either side.

entry: POKENAME在空中挥骨，操纵火焰。顺时针旋转骨头，会让火烧得热上许多。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME manipulates flames by waving its bone through the air. Spinning the bone clockwise causes the fire to burn significantly hotter.

entry: POKENAME关爱有需要的野生宝可梦，给它们住处，以精神力量疗伤。神话却说，它不喜欢人类，会把扰乱清静的训练家，变成暖暖猪或跳跳猪。
author: milchik
source: POKENAME shows its caring nature towards any wild Pokémon in need, providing them with shelter and healing their wounds with its psychic powers. Myths say it dislikes humans and will turn any Trainer who disturbs its peace into a Tepig or Spoink.

entry: POKENAME总带着燃烧的树枝，点着易燃物，连人家也不放过。看着烧几分钟后，又似乎后悔，开出防火带，阻止火势蔓得太远。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME always carry a burning branch and will use it to set fire to flammable objects, including human homes. After watching it burn for a few minutes, they seem to show remorse and will create fire breaks to stop the flames from spreading too far.

entry: POKENAME能随意在背上生起旺盛篝火，还能决定是否灼伤其他生物。因此，它是出色的旅伴，寒冷地区尤其适合。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has the ability to start a roaring campfire upon its back at will and control whether it burns others or not. This makes it excellent as a traveling companion, particularly in colder regions.

entry: POKENAME虽如危险的活体热反应堆，天性却出奇温顺，几乎能完美调节体温。因此，许多爬行类宝可梦很爱与它作伴。
author: thegreenscorpion
source: Despite the danger they pose as living thermal reactors, POKENAME are remarkably docile by nature and can regulate their body temperature almost perfectly. Many reptilian Pokémon enjoy the company of POKENAME as a result.

entry: POKENAME力量与精神能力都很强，却宁可慵懒休息，用树枝烤零食，也不想唤出未来景象。
author: opossiblymage
source: POKENAME is imbued with both great strength and psychic powers. However, it would rather lounge and use its branch for roasting snacks rather than conjure visions of the future.

entry: 许多山村为当地POKENAME建神龛。每晚，村民摆满食物饮料，盼POKENAME以好运祝福回报。
author: turron_turron
source: Many mountainside villages build shrines dedicated to their local POKENAME. Each night, villagers fill these shrines with food and drink in the hopes that POKENAME will thank them with blessings of good fortune.

entry: POKENAME穿行火山之间，从盘旋升起的烈焰中现身。它号令周围一切火，乘风滑翔时闪耀橙金光彩。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Traveling between volcanoes, POKENAME appears within a rising spiral of flame. It commands all flames around it, shining in vibrant hues of orange and gold as it glides along the wind.

entry: POKENAME满溢火焰与精神能量，必须用法杖，协助引导、驾驭大部分力量。即使如此，能量太多，法杖与尾巴几乎总在燃烧。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is brimming with fiery and psychic energy, so much so that it requires a staff to help channel and harness most of it. Even with this aid, the staff and its tail are almost always alight due to the surplus of energy.

entry: POKENAME住在火山附近，喜爱灰烬气味。山上若绿意太盛，就常点起野火。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME live near volcanic mountains where they love the scent of ash. They often start wildfires if there is too much greenery on their mountains.

entry: POKENAME法杖顶端的火焰宝珠，能扩大可怕火焰的范围。格外烦躁时，毛里能量涌动，甚至迸出电火花。
author: fiordaliso
source: The Flame Orb set atop its staff amplifies the reach of POKENAME's terrifying flames. When especially irritated, its fur seethes with so much energy that it crackles with sparking electricity.

entry: POKENAME用捡来的棍子或其他垃圾，当临时魔杖，将火引成强力爆发。POKENAME会先烤焦食物再吃，过程中常把周围也点着。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME use sticks or other trash they find as makeshift wands, funneling their flames through them into powerful blasts. POKENAME scorch the food they find before eating, often setting the surrounding area on fire in the process.

entry: POKENAME控火娴熟，却大多时间都用法杖玩泥、塑形。不过，受威胁仍会用火进攻。
author: naivetotoro
source: POKENAME are highly skilled with fire, but spend most of their time playing with mud and shaping it with their staff. However, they will use fire offensively if threatened.

entry: 许多虚构故事，把这种宝可梦描绘成女巫与巫师的伙伴，不论善恶。有理论却说，POKENAME曾是人，自愿或因诅咒变成宝可梦。
author: infinex21
source: This Pokémon is commonly portrayed as a companion to witches and wizards alike in many fictional stories, be they good or evil. There are theories, though, that claim POKENAME once were humans that either became Pokémon by choice or by curse.

entry: POKENAME用潜藏的精神力量，让棍子在岩壳中搅动，熔化树果与香草，调出特制饮品。再倒出来，为小型宝可梦提供点心和药物。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME use latent psychic powers to stir their sticks around the inside of their stony shells, melting down berries and herbs into specialized brews. They spill out their concoctions to offer treats and medicine to smaller Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME携带的火，能在水下燃烧，照亮穿行的水下洞穴。也能造出火焰漩涡，赶走敌人，保护自己。
author: santon5512
source: The flames POKENAME carries are capable of burning underwater, lighting the way as they traverse underwater caverns. They can use these flames to defend themselves as well, creating fiery whirlpools to drive away foes.

entry: POKENAME花数日，用长牙静心雕刻木头，刻痕如余烬发亮。虽然能把木头当法杖，增强法术般的攻击，往往却直接拿来猛砸。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME spends days using its tusks to meditatively carve a log, with the carvings glowing like embers. While it can use the log like a magic staff to augment its spell-like attacks, it tends to just wallop opponents with the log.

entry: POKENAME耳毛被采来，给电源线等重要电脑线缆作绝缘层。调热能力，有时甚至能提高相连设备的效率。
author: chibitales
source: The fur growing from POKENAME's ears is collected and used as insulation for important computer cables, such as the power cord. Its ability to regulate heat sometimes even boosts the efficiency of the device they are connected to.

entry: POKENAME的奶蕴含强大魔力。许多人试着装瓶，可只要落入人手，牛奶便瞬间蒸发。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's milk is potent in magical power. Many have tried to bottle it, but the milk evaporates the moment a human gets their hands on it.

entry: 每群POKENAME都有自己的秘密暗语，用冰构成的分形图案、火焰展示、巨石割痕等交流。因此，群体之间几乎解不开彼此的暗语。
author: bobosmith01
source: Each group of POKENAME develops their own secret code languages. They utilize various methods to communicate: fractals of ice, displays of fire, gashes in boulders, and so on. This makes code-breaking between groups nearly impossible.

entry: POKENAME常在秋季现身野外，体温会暖热空气。很久以前，人们相信它能预知秋季的起止。它还用光合作用，清洁周围空气。
author: te4mst4r.boris
source: POKENAME often appear in the wild during autumn, when their body temperature heats up the air. Long ago, this Pokémon was believed to be able to predict the beginning and end of the season. It cleans the air around itself through photosynthesis.

entry: 一年大多数时候，POKENAME都高度警觉，守护森林。秋叶转红橙，就能融入其中，耐心静坐，思考未来。
author: imaginita
source: Throughout most of the year, POKENAME is constantly on high alert, guarding its forest. During autumn, when leaves turn red and orange, this allows POKENAME to blend in. It sits patiently, thinking about the future.

entry: 据说吃下背上长的苹果，能获得预知力量。农民极重视POKENAME，盼借它预测庄稼收成。
author: notadoctor75
source: The apples that grow on its back are said to grant the power of foresight when consumed.  POKENAME is highly valued by farmers, who hope to use its power to predict the yield of their crops.

entry: POKENAME几乎总叼着一根细枝，慢慢啃食。战斗时，它们会点燃枝条挥舞，或丢开细枝，改为吐出火球。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are almost always found with a twig in their beaks, which they slowly feed on. They will fight by igniting these twigs and waving them around, or they may toss aside their twigs and spit out fireballs.

entry: 武术家积极寻找POKENAME，学习“燃枝之道”，一门注重预判对手动作的持械战法。不训练时，常能见它深入冥想。
author: ghostslythe
source: Martial artists actively seek out POKENAME to learn the way of the burning branch, a style of armed combat focusing on foreseeing opponents' moves. When not training, these Pokémon can be found in deep meditation.

entry: POKENAME发现捕食者靠巢太近，就会从杖端变出沸水，抛向威胁，将其赶走。
author: .izik
source: Should POKENAME notice a predator drawing too close to its nest, it conjures boiling water from the end of its wand. It then lobs this water at the threat to deter it.

entry: POKENAME用魔杖，以意念托起地上泥球，再用火烧硬。随后以惊人速度掷出，击昏敌人。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its wand to telekinetically lift mudballs from the ground and hardens them with its flames. It hurls these at foes with incredible speed to knock them out.

entry: POKENAME把初萌的精神力量引进随身棍，施展颇精彩的小型火术，用来取悦、保护交好的小型宝可梦。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME channels its budding psychic powers into the stick it carries, letting it create some impressive minor pyrotechnics.  It uses these to impress and protect other small Pokémon it manages to befriend.

entry: POKENAME喜欢和训练家玩很快分出胜负的游戏。训练家赢了，POKENAME就高兴地转圈；训练家输了，它便会恶作剧，常把衣服变得过大。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME enjoy playing quick games with their Trainers, spinning with glee if their Trainer wins. Should their Trainer lose, POKENAME will pull a prank, often involving making their Trainers' clothes oversized.

entry: POKENAME用占卜能力守护训练家，不惜一切，哪怕牺牲自己。迫不得已，会造出火球，将威胁吸进去。
author: sylia
source: POKENAME uses their divination abilities to protect their Trainer at all costs including their own life. As a last resort, they creates a fireball that sucks in the threat.

entry: POKENAME顽皮又自负，忍不住向其他生物炫耀火术。有时过分自信，卖弄太过，反而意外烧着周围。
author: sk372
source: Mischievous and cocky, POKENAME can't resist the urge to show off its pyrotechnic abilities towards others. Its overconfidence sometimes leads it to excessive showmanship that can lead to accidentally burning its surroundings.

entry: POKENAME会隐去身形，凝神等待最佳攻击时机。一出手，就迸出扰乱敌人的虹彩。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME can go into an invisible trance, waiting for the perfect time to attack. When it does, it erupts in a rainbow of disorienting colors.

entry: 野生POKENAME讨厌受打扰，会用达108度的魔法火焰，轰向靠近者。厨师借这热量，请POKENAME帮忙熬汤炖菜。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Wild POKENAME despise being disturbed, blasting anyone that comes near with Mystical Fire reaching 108 degrees. Because of this heat, chefs utilize POKENAME to help cook soups and stews.

entry: 大锅里的药水效果各异，却总滚烫。有人说，用其中的小枝慢慢搅拌，就能在药水表面看见未来景象。
author: hophoppip
source: The effect of the potion in its cauldron varies, but it is always scalding hot. Some say visions of the future can be seen on the surface of the potion if one slowly stirs it with the twig inside.

entry: POKENAME用耀眼火枝引来猎物，再用背后伪装成飘逸长发的巨颚，将其整个吞下。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME entices its prey with its dazzling, flaming branches before using its back jaw, disguised as its long, flowing hair, to swallow them whole.

entry: POKENAME用爪尖摩擦捡来的木棍，点燃成火把，驱赶捕食者，也欺压小生物，赶走它们，抢取食物。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME rubs the tips of its claws on sticks it gathers to set them alight with flame. It uses the torches it creates to ward off predators and bully smaller creatures away from meals it wishes to steal.

entry: 冬天，POKENAME凝视自己点起的篝火，能在摇曳火焰中看见未来。占卜下一年的情况后，总会抢在其他宝可梦之前，到达树果与坚果丰富之地。
author: .jerden
source: In winter, POKENAME stares into the campfires it creates and can see the future in the flickering flames. After scrying for the next year, it will always be found at locations with plenty of berries and nuts, getting there before any other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME收集木棍点燃，凝视火焰，窥见未来可能的灾难，得以设法阻止。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME gathers up sticks to set alight and gaze into the flames. Within the fire it glimpses potential future disasters, allowing it to work towards preventing the catastrophes from taking place.

entry: POKENAME树上落下的叶子，会在下落时燃起。有人说，落地前接住一片，能带来好运。
author: .izik
source: The leaves that fall from POKENAME's tree burst into flames as they descend. Some say catching one before it hits the ground brings good luck.

entry: POKENAME凝视枝尖火焰冥想，火便越长越大，既让POKENAME更专注，也能震慑对手。
author: imaginita
source: POKENAME gazes into the flame at the tip of its branch to meditate. As it does so, the flame grows larger and larger, not only intensifying POKENAME's focus, but intimidating its opponents.

entry: 人们有时供奉野生POKENAME，安抚高傲的天性。作为回报，它可能通过随身火枝的火焰，赐予未来景象。
author: catsquatch_geography
source: Offerings are sometimes made to wild POKENAME to appease its prideful nature. In return, it may grant a vision of the future through the flames of the burning stick it always carries.

entry: POKENAME住在瀑布附近，受打扰就会把水导向敌人。操纵中的水，总是滚烫。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME makes its home near waterfalls, redirecting the water toward foes if disturbed. The water is always scalding while being manipulated.

entry: POKENAME把附近所有火焰吸进水晶球，储存备用。受挑衅时，就能释放为强力攻击。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME absorb any nearby flames into their crystal balls, storing them for later. When provoked, they can unleash these flames in powerful attacks.

entry: 它凝视棍上的火，达到全然平静，据说由此开悟。它避战，也试着平息正在发生的战斗，人们相信这愿望源自平和心境。
author: infinex21
source: By staring into the flame upon its stick, it can achieve a state of total serenity that is said to grant it enlightenment. It will avoid fighting and try to end ongoing fights, which is believed to be a desire born of its serene mindset.

entry: POKENAME常住在梦境世界等魔法普遍的领域，因此人们惊讶于把戏时，它反而困惑。温暖蓬松的身体很适合拥抱，可身躯太大，家长却会把它赶走。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME often lives in realms like the Dream World where magical phenomena are common, so it gets confused when people are surprised by its tricks. Its warm, fluffy fur makes it great for cuddles, but parents banish it away for its imposing size.

entry: POKENAME的毛柔软保暖，是冬季受欢迎的伙伴。它也因保护欲受重视，会毫不犹豫地向敌人放出2000度烈火，常以熔化雪人消遣。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME's fur is soft to the touch and retains heat, making them a desired partner during winter. They are also valued for their protectiveness, not hesitating to blast 2,000-degree fire at foes. A popular outlet for them involves melting snowmen.

entry: POKENAME以绚丽火焰推动身体飞行，开心地唱歌。它天性好奇、有创造力，沿途采集植物，调制新药和饮品。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME sing gleeful melodies as they propel themselves through the sky with dazzling displays of fire. They are curious and creative by nature, collecting plants along their travels to brew new medicines and beverages.

entry: POKENAME挥魔杖，为观众表演各种常见魔术。可那全是障眼法，真正的魔法，是POKENAME趁目标分心，偷偷布下的火焰恶作剧与陷阱。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME wave their wands to perform a wide variety of common magic tricks for their audience. However, it's all misdirection. The real magic is the fiery pranks and traps POKENAME subtly plant on their distracted targets.

entry: 密阿雷市入冬时，POKENAME会被引到街上。每条尾巴都散出一百多度的热，让行人舒适漫步。
author: ghostslythe
source: When winter strikes in Lumiose City, POKENAME are lured into the streets. Each of their tails radiates over one hundred degrees of heat, allowing pedestrians to stroll comfortably.

entry: 数千年前，POKENAME很受重视，气场能保暖，带来舒适与平静。许多村庄在困境中仍心怀未来希望，都有POKENAME的功劳。
author: periperi_chicken
source: Millennia ago, POKENAME were highly valued, as their aura keeps people warm and radiates comfort and calm. POKENAME can be credited with keeping many villages hopeful for the future in times of hardship.

entry: POKENAME总带着燃烧的枝条，尽可能延长燃烧，严格磨炼控火本领。技艺精进后，一根枝条能烧上数月。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME carry a burning branch with them at all times, maintaining a disciplined control over their power over fire by keeping it burning as long as possible. As their skill grows, they can maintain a single branch for months.

entry: 传说POKENAME预示重生，爱挥火枝，也常因此烧尽森林。灰肥沃土中新长的植物，总比原来的更健康。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have been described in legends as Pokémon heralding rebirth, their penchant for wielding burning branches often leading them to burn down forests. The plants that grow from the ash-rich soil are always healthier than those that came before.

entry: POKENAME钢铁身体的内部如炉，热与烟从头上孔洞排出。受挑衅，就把头烧热，再撞向敌人。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME's steel bodies act as furnaces internally, releasing heat and smoke from the holes in their heads. If provoked, they will heat their heads up to high temperatures before ramming into foes.

entry: POKENAME藏在暗处，只露发光杖尖作诱饵。洞穴宝可梦前来查看，它就扑出，抢走随身结晶吃。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME uses its glowing staff as bait, hiding in the darkness with only the bright tip exposed. When cave Pokémon investigate, it pounces, stealing and eating any crystals they were carrying.

entry: POKENAME战斗时跳舞，将火杖和捡来的物品一起抛接。似乎只为分散对手注意、取悦旁观者，没有其他用途。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME juggles its flaming wand alongside other objects that it finds as it dances during combat. This activity appears to serve no purpose beyond distracting the foe and entertaining onlookers.

entry: POKENAME栖在树上，挥动火杖，指挥同类以强大嗓音奏乐。最远5英里外，也能听得清楚。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME waves its flaming wand in the air while perched in trees to direct others of its kind in producing music with their powerful voices. This can be heard clearly from up to 5 miles away.

entry: POKENAME遇险，会向四周释放易燃孢子。若还不足以警告，就用火焰能力点燃，引发爆炸。
author: zweizweihander
source: When endangered, POKENAME releases flammable spores into the surrounding air. If that does not suffice as a warning, it can ignite the spores with its flame powers, causing an explosion.

entry: POKENAME用火术，让对战更有戏剧效果。火圈和猛烈爆炸，只是它作战时造出的部分光景。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses its pyrotechnic capabilities to add extra dramatic flair to its matches. Rings of fire and mighty explosions are just a few examples of the kind of displays it will conjure while fighting.

entry: POKENAME有一群宠爱它的粉丝，不断称颂、赞美音乐。忠实粉丝既爱音乐也爱火术，都为火焰舞蹈着迷赞叹。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have doting fans that extol and sing praises for its music. The fiery dances it performs mesmerizes and amazes its loyal fans, who love both music and pyrotechnics.

entry: POKENAME覆着极细的菌丝纤维，任何天气都能保暖。真菌有刺激性，吃下会灼热，因此很受爱辣的人欢迎。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are coated in fine mycelium fibres that keep their bodies warm through any weather. The fungus is an irritant that causes a burning sensation when eaten, making it popular amongst people who love spicy food.

entry: POKENAME满溢魔法光，不同颜色，能给被照者带来不同效果。若加在火焰漩涡上，漩涡便能催动魔力，让其传播更广。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME overflows with enchanted light, with each color of light giving a different effect to those hit by it. When this light is used on its fiery vortexes, they become a catalyst, spreading the magical powers even more.

entry: POKENAME喜欢钓鱼，常拿棍作钓竿。钓客有时会借它窥看未来，看看某处能否有好渔获。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME enjoy fishing, often using their stick as a fishing pole. Anglers sometimes use them, having them see into the future to see if a particular spot will have a bountiful catch.

entry: 毛绒袖子让POKENAME难以挥爪，因此改用熔岩般热的毛，点燃枝条进攻。独处时，会清掉毛里的泥，保持鲜艳颜色。
author: ghostslythe
source: Due to its fuzzy sleeves, POKENAME has difficulty bringing its claws to bear. Instead, it attacks by lighting a branch on its magma-hot fur. When alone, it cleans mud from its hair to keep its bright coloration.

entry: POKENAME把红缟玛瑙结晶举到火上，就能在宝石各切面，同时看见一个人所有可能的未来。浮上宝石表面的时间线，最有可能发生。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: By holding its sardonyx crystal above a fire, POKENAME can see every possible future of a person at once refracted across the facets of the jewel. Whichever potential timelines rise to the surface of the gem are the ones most likely to happen.

entry: POKENAME在世界各地的偏远处独居，态度冷硬、不合群，却会用火杖引导遇见的迷路旅人，走向安全出口。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME lives a secluded life in remote locations across the world. It has a gruff, antisocial personality, but it will guide lost travelers it comes across to a safe exit using its flaming staff.

entry: POKENAME造出灼热火墙，阻挡敌人。若袭击者纠缠不休，就预判最佳反击位置，用火墙引敌过去，打出制胜一击。
author: notadoctor75
source: POKENAME creates walls of searing fire to deter its foes. Against persistent attackers, it predicts the best location to launch a counterattack and uses flaming walls to direct its enemies to where it will land a decisive strike.

entry: POKENAME只要闭眼、举枝指向，就能占出熔岩源。若在1000英尺内，就能瞬间找到。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME can divine lava sources simply by closing its eyes and pointing its twig. If lava exists within 1000 feet, it locates it instantly.

entry: POKENAME力量满溢，耳朵和尾巴都冒火。过去，占卜者积极寻找POKENAME的魔杖，相信它能影响未来。
author: chibitales
source: Fire blazes from POKENAME's ears and tail due to their overflowing power. In the past, those practicing divination actively sought out POKENAME's wands, believing them to hold the power to influence the future.

entry: POKENAME携带符咒，引导火焰精准出击，眨眼间结束战斗。它能散火隐入夜色，只有攻击时闪烁的火花，才暴露位置。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME carry talismans to direct their flames in precise strikes, finishing battles in the blink of an eye. They can dispel their flames to disappear into the night, only the flickering sparks from their attacks revealing their location.

entry: POKENAME由秋收时被施咒的植物化成。它对诞生时周围的普通植物，占有欲极强，会试着吓走农民。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME form from bewitched plants in the autumnal harvest. They become very possessive of the inanimate plants that were around them when they form and will try to scare off farmers.

entry: POKENAME的火能亮如恒星。不知为何，往往就在猛烈流星雨预计来临前几小时，开始疯狂挥棒。
author: icelevelincarnate
source: A POKENAME's flames can burn as brightly as a star. For reasons yet to be explained, they tend to frantically wave their stick around only hours before intense meteor showers are predicted.

entry: POKENAME尾尖迷人的火，引来围观者。凝视过的人都说差点获得异象，可还没到那一步，就被宝可梦攻击，从没人真正见到。
author: .realthree
source: The mesmerizing flame at the end of POKENAME's tail draws onlookers in. Though those who have stared at it claim that they were on the verge of receiving a vision, nobody has ever reached such a point due to being attacked by the Pokémon.

entry: 传说POKENAME生于世界火山深处的火焰与矿石。凝望白炽火的人，据说能得到自身未来的启示。
author: mepp.
source: Legends claim that POKENAME was born from the flames and ore nestled deep inside the world's volcanoes. Those who peer into its incandescent flames are said to witness revelations of their futures.

entry: POKENAME手持木制魔杖，唤出烈火占卜，窥看感兴趣者的未来。火吼得越凶，预言中的命运就越难逃。
author: beatdoof
source: Wielding a magical wooden staff, POKENAME summons a scrying inferno to divine the future of anyone who catches its interest. The more violently the fire roars and rages, the more inescapable the predicted fate becomes.

entry: POKENAME游过珊瑚礁时，用随身枝条作寻物棒，轻易找出最美味的藤壶吃。
author: .izik
source: The branch POKENAME carries acts as a dowsing rod while it swims through coral reefs. This allows it to easily locate the tastiest barnacles to eat.

entry: POKENAME奔在森林大火前，携火枝提醒其他宝可梦，危险即将来临。宝可梦巡护员密切关注POKENAME族群，获取火灾早期警讯。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME race ahead of forest fires, carrying burning branches with them in an effort to warn other Pokémon of the danger coming their way. Pokémon Rangers keep a close eye on POKENAME populations for early warnings of fire outbreaks.

entry: POKENAME奔在森林大火前，带着火枝跑在烈焰之前。宝可梦巡护员却观察到，它会故意用火枝引起更多火，迫使更多宝可梦离家。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME race ahead of forest fires, carrying burning branches with them as they run ahead of the blaze. Pokémon Rangers have observed them deliberately using their burning branch to start further fires, driving more Pokémon from their homes.

entry: POKENAME身上长的枝条，在极热干旱气候中长得很好，将吸收的热化作烈火。木头若太潮，可能腐烂脱落，妨碍POKENAME生存。
author: ohok3441
source: The branches growing from POKENAME thrive in extremely hot and arid climates, turning absorbed heat into blazing fire. If the wood experiences too much moisture, it can rot and fall off, hindering a POKENAME's ability to survive.

entry: POKENAME凝视杖端火焰，脑细胞与智商便成倍增长。专注足够久，POKENAME就会聪明到能推知未来走向。
author: darkweavile428
source: When POKENAME gazes into the flame at the end of its wand, its brain cells and IQ multiply. If POKENAME concentrates long enough, it will become smart enough to determine the course of the future.

entry: POKENAME挥动燃角，让袭击者目眩，光芒分散注意，连POKENAME射来的火球也看不见。
author: periperi_chicken
source: When POKENAME waves its flaming horn, it dazzles attackers. They become so distracted by the glow that they can't see POKENAME's incoming fireball.

entry: POKENAME聚成群，开发独特忍术，主要练习用背上毒泡，震慑、麻痹敌人。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: POKENAME gather in groups to develop unique ninjutsu techniques. They primarily focus on using the poisonous bubbles on their back to stun and paralyse foes.

entry: POKENAME从身体喷出毒泡沫，覆满领地。生病时，泡沫不再有毒，反而像肥皂般有清洁消毒作用。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME spew a toxic foam from their bodies, covering their territories in it. When these Pokémon are sick, the foam they produce is no longer toxic, instead having a sanitizing effect similar to soap.

entry: POKENAME喜欢游在进入领地的游轮旁。想恶作剧时，POKENAME会试着用背上蒸气，盖满乘客。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME enjoy swimming next to cruise ships that enter their territory. If POKENAME are feeling mischievous, they will try to coat passengers in the vapor from their backs.

entry: POKENAME痴迷泡泡，会瞬间移动到游园会等泡泡丰富的地方。POKENAME喜欢吃泡泡，一停止产生，就大发脾气。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are obsessed with bubbles and will teleport to locations where they are abundant, such as fairs. POKENAME enjoy eating the bubbles, throwing a fit once they stop forming.

entry: POKENAME很难对战或捕捉，受威胁便造出泡泡，让身体看起来更长。多出的部分一受扰，就直接溶掉，POKENAME毫发无损。
author: bradlybro199
source: POKENAME are deceptively difficult to battle or catch, since when they are threatened they produce bubbles that appear to make their body longer. When these sections are disturbed in any way, they simply dissolve, leaving POKENAME unharmed entirely.

entry: POKENAME的泡泡不能用剪刀或机器剪，十分娇弱，必须轻轻舀起，也不适合作衣料。
author: musicsheep.
source: POKENAME's bubbles cannot be sheared using shears or machinery. The bubbles are delicate and must be gently scooped up. They're not useful as clothing material.

entry: 别被可爱表情骗了。这种危险水生宝可梦，用有弹性的泡泡伪装、减轻打击。POKENAME喜欢伏击，在水中尤其危险。
author: chaoticanzu
source: Don't let its cute expression fool you. This aquatic menace camouflages itself with springy bubbles that lessen the force of attacks. POKENAME's penchant for ambushes makes it especially dangerous in water.

entry: POKENAME身体滑，能轻松钻进细缝，侵入人家。若被发现，就吐出大量高速泡泡，打中十分刺痛。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's slick body allows it to smoothly hide in tiny cracks, making it easy to infiltrate homes. If discovered, the pest spits out a high amount of fast-moving bubbles that sting quite a bit on impact.

entry: POKENAME用机警大眼，不断查看环境，寻找食物与威胁。翅膀看着如阳光照耀的水面。
author: t3isukone
source: With its large, alert eyes, POKENAME monitors its environment for food and threats constantly. Its wings appear like sunlit water.

entry: POKENAME懒躺河里，有时向树叶喷水，测试准头。研究员记录的最远一发，达400英尺，展现出色的控水本领。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME lies lazily in rivers, sometimes spitting water at leaves to test its own accuracy. The furthest shot recorded by researchers was 400 ft, showcasing its impressive control and skill with water.

entry: POKENAME需要稳定水源，用浓厚泡沫团，将水锁在体内。POKENAME会定期回到水中，补充储水。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME require a consistent source of water and use thick clumps of foam to trap water within their body. POKENAME will return to the water periodically to refresh their store.

entry: 它背上的泡沫，开心时会膨大，放出清新气味，安抚附近宝可梦。潜水员常借POKENAME寻找平静水域，避开危险水流。
author: jaminmcready
source: The foamy growth on its back expands when it is happy, releasing a fresh scent that soothes nearby Pokémon. Divers often use POKENAME to find calm waters and avoid dangerous currents.

entry: 它的皮肤覆着略有毒的膜，吓退捕食者，触碰会带来强烈麻刺感。盘起身体后，能突然高速猛击。
author: bobosmith01
source: Its skin is laced in a somewhat poisonous film that deters predators; touching it will result in what feels like a strong buzz. When coiled, it can suddenly lash out at high speeds.

entry: 它的皮肤覆着略有毒的膜，吓退捕食者，触碰会带来强烈麻刺感。盘起身体后，能突然高速猛击。
author: bobosmith01
source: Its skin is laced in a somewhat poisonous film that deters predators; touching it will result in what feels like a strong buzz. When coiled, it can suddenly lash out at high speeds.

entry: POKENAME走过不久，身后就能看见酸性泡沫。能耐酸的宝可梦，有时会用来清洁身体。
author: bobosmith01
source: Wherever POKENAME goes, a trail of acidic foam is sure to be spotted not long after. Pokémon that can handle the acidic nature sometimes use the foam to help clean their own bodies.

entry: POKENAME的泡泡，能阻挡无线电波。有时会把自己包住，屏蔽不想接收的本地网络讯号。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's bubbles have a special ability to block radio waves. It sometimes encases itself with these bubbles to block unwanted transmissions from local networks.

entry: 它用娇弱泡泡保护部分身体，尤其是爪子，战斗时才露出。遇上危险敌人，能迅速裹满泡泡，卷成球逃走。
author: infinex21
source: It protects parts of its body with foamy, delicate bubbles. Namely protected are its claws, which it unveils during battle. It can rapidly cover itself in bubbles and roll into a ball to escape a dangerous foe.

entry: POKENAME自认是森林家园池塘的守护者，也会保护想闯入其中的其他生物。力量虽不足，坚定信念却无可置疑。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME considers itself the protector of ponds in its forest homes, defending others who would intrude upon them. Though its strength is lacking, none can doubt its staunch conviction.

entry: POKENAME体表泡泡，充满栖身池塘里的微生物。人接触后，可能严重过敏，包括关节肿胀。
author: .izik
source: The bubbles that form on POKENAME's body are filled with microbes from its pond habitat. Contact with these can trigger terrible allergic reactions in humans, including swelling in the joints.

entry: POKENAME通常活跃好动，全身覆着柔软泡泡。泡泡由遇空气就起泡的可燃液体构成，因此能撒出、点燃，驱赶威胁。
author: infinex21
source: Because they are typically very active and energetic, POKENAME coat themselves in many soft bubbles. These bubbles are made from a flammable fluid that froths when exposed to air, so they may scatter and ignite it to deter threats.

entry: POKENAME警觉四周，挨攻击就迅速行动。身上产生的泡沫覆盖羽毛，能减轻敌人打击。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME are watchful of their surroundings and quick to leap into action if attacked. Producing foamy bubbles to cover their feathers, this coverage helps dampen the blow of oncoming attacks from foes.

entry: POKENAME生气时，会在头顶鳍上聚泡沫。怒气积得太多，泡沫便蔓延全身，让行走困难。
author: .izik
source: When angry, POKENAME gathers foam on the fin atop its head. Should its anger build too much, the foam spreads across its entire body, making it difficult to walk.

entry: POKENAME腹部皮肤格外薄，干燥天气能方便地吸收地面水分。为保护腹部，会分泌泡沫覆盖。
author: hophoppip
source: The skin on POKENAME's abdomen is especially thin, making it useful for absorbing moisture from the ground on dry days. To protect its abdomen, it secretes a coat of bubbles to cover it.

entry: POKENAME察觉附近有人暴躁，就从身体产出泡沫。许多人声称，只需徒手捧起，就足以让人露出笑容。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME senses someone nearby is irate, it produces foam from its body. Many claim that holding this foam with bare hands is enough to put a smile on anyone's face.

entry: 它“帽子”上的假眼，能吓退捕食者。最爱雨天，会开心地跳过水洼。
author: hophoppip
source: The false eyes on its "hat" frighten predators away. It adores rainy weather, and will dance happily across puddles.

entry: POKENAME披着闪亮泡泡，保持洁净。优雅地滑过泡沫，让四周空中满是泡泡，再瞬移离去。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME cloak themselves in sparkling bubbles to ensure that they stay clean. They gracefully glide along the froth, filling the air around them with bubbles before they warp away.

entry: POKENAME将黏性泡泡涂在身上防护，也附在其他表面，方便落脚。它能从远处用舌头精确放置泡泡，油性唾液使泡泡不黏住舌头。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME applies adhesive bubbles to itself for protection and to surfaces to give itself footholds. It uses its tongue to precisely apply its bubbles from a distance; its saliva is oily, preventing the bubbles from sticking to it.

entry: POKENAME从楔石投出的身体，全由水和泡泡构成。若完全消失，可能昏倒了，也可能只是躲回石里，等POKENAME再现身，吓敌人一跳。
author: .jerden
source: The body that POKENAME projects out from its Odd Keystone is entirely made of water and bubbles. If it vanishes entirely, POKENAME may have been knocked unconscious, or may just be hiding within the keystone to surprise foes when it remerges.

entry: POKENAME在水里休息时，用第二套颚作诱饵，好安心吃藻类和水草。大颚上的泡泡，多一层保护，也提供浮力。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME uses its second set of jaws as a decoy while it lies or rests within water; it utilizes decoy tactics so it may consume algae and weeds in peace. The bubbles coating its large jaws provide an extra layer of protection and make them buoyant.

entry: POKENAME睡觉时，嫩芽顶端会冒出大泡泡。一戳破，就会迷迷糊糊地醒来。
author: .izik
source: While sleeping, a large bubble forms at the top of POKENAME's sprout. If popped, it will wake in a daze.

entry: POKENAME背上的泡泡，装着香气宜人的气体。幼崽生病或烦躁时，能得到安慰。
author: .izik
source: The bubbles that form on POKENAME's back fill with a delightfully scented gas. This comforts its young when they fall ill or become irritable.

entry: POKENAME从后部产出许多柔韧泡泡。跳跃能力出众，能极快攀上陡峭悬崖。
author: chaoticanzu
source: POKENAME secretes numerous flexible bubbles from its rear end. Its extraordinary jumping abilities allow it to scale sheer cliffs extremely quickly.

entry: POKENAME战斗时挥尾，用尾上泡泡格挡攻击，也借墙壁和天花板，发动空中攻势。
author: chaoticanzu
source: POKENAME swings its tail around in battle to block attacks with the bubbles that grow from it. It uses ceilings and walls to launch aerial attacks.

entry: POKENAME把头顶分泌的泡泡，涂满手、脚和尾巴，再迅速冲向对手，以各条肢体接连进攻。
author: chaoticanzu
source: POKENAME covers its hands, feet, and tail, with the bubbles secreted from the top of its head. It then quickly rushes the opponent with attacks from every limb.

entry: 它一觉得危险，就喷出保护泡泡。训练家不肯听它的意愿，也会挨上一阵泡泡，表达不满。
author: quackquackattack
source: It spews out protective bubbles whenever it believes it is in danger. When a Trainer refuses to listen to its desires, it shoots a burst of bubbles to demonstrate its frustration.

entry: POKENAME在深海收集被海浪磨过的玻璃，用翼上泡泡洗净，再加入收藏。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME gathers sea glass from the deepest parts of the ocean. It uses the bubbles from its wings to clean the glass before adding it to its collection.

entry: POKENAME在沙漠绿洲间飞行，洒下难得的雨。跟随而来的旅人，称它为“活的海市蜃楼”。
author: t3isukone
source: POKENAME flies across the desert from oasis to oasis, sprinkling it with rare rain. Travelers drawn after it have termed it 'the living mirage'.

entry: POKENAME潜进湖水，只露头顶睡莲叶藏身。能突然跃出水面，以强尾猛击，伏袭敌人。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME conceals itself in lakes by submerging everything except the lily pad on its head. It can ambush foes by suddenly leaping out of the water and striking with its powerful tail.

entry: POKENAME傍晚藏在水下洞穴。若遇猎斑鱼等捕食者，就释放滚滚泡沫，掩护逃脱。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME hides in underwater caves during the evening. If threatened by predators like Huntail, it releases torrents of foam to obscure its escape.

entry: 呱呱泡蛙不只受蛙迷欢迎，POKENAME也做出它的伪装，想沾上这份人气。腿小，跳跃有限，却能用爪把自己弹上空中，模仿伪装的对象。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME constructs a Froakie disguise to capitalize on the Pokémon's popularity beyond even frog enthusiasts. Its aptitude for jumping is limited due to its small legs, but it can use its claw to propel itself into the air to mimic its disguise.

entry: POKENAME喜欢孩子，爱吹泡泡，只为看他们笑。若察觉哪个孩子比其他人更难过，就格外关注。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME like children and they enjoy blowing bubbles, just to watch them laugh. If it can detect a child who is sadder than the others, it will pay special attention to it.

entry: 它从头上小喷口产泡，保持陆上皮肤湿润。POKENAME爱把泡沫喷向其他生物，一起玩耍。
author: sk372
source: It generates bubbles from a small spout on its head to help keep its skin moisturized while on land. POKENAME enjoys playing with others by spraying them with these foamy bubbles.

entry: POKENAME受威胁，就用大量泡泡包住身体。泡泡带电，但触碰只会挨轻微静电。
author: evilgammon
source: When POKENAME feels threatened, it surrounds itself in a mass of bubbles. These bubbles are charged with electricity, but touching them only causes a minor static shock.

entry: POKENAME从花苞分泌薄泡沫，哪部分被舀走，就会重新补足，防止脱水。虽无忧无虑，POKENAME仍警惕四周。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME secretes a thin, bubbly foam from their bud that replenishes itself whenever any part is scooped off. The foam prevents them from getting dehydrated. Despite its carefree nature, POKENAME is wary of its surroundings.

entry: POKENAME覆着黏液，往里充气，以泡泡护身。它表现得甜美开心，实际只是接近猎物的伪装。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME is covered in mucus that it pushes air into, protecting it in a bubble. It acts sweet and happy, but this is a façade to get close to its prey.

entry: POKENAME用泡沫覆体，防止陆上皮肤干燥。泡中有毒化学物，会让皮肤疼痛受刺激，保护POKENAME免遭袭击。
author: .jerden
source: To prevent its skin from drying out on land, POKENAME covers itself in foam. These bubbles contain toxic chemicals that can painfully irritate the skin, protecting POKENAME from attacks.

entry: POKENAME表现得天真无邪，其实全是演技。等猎物安心，就以连发的飞水手里剑进攻。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME acts childlike and innocent, but this is purely an act. It waits until its prey is comfortable before attacking with rapid-firing water shurikens.

entry: POKENAME高速追猎，射出黏在对方身上的泡泡，拖慢动作。一靠得够近，就会咬下，力量足以在卡车上留下凹痕。
author: .izik
source: When speeding after prey, POKENAME fires bubbles that cling to their body to slow them down. Once within range, it bites with enough force to dent a truck.

entry: POKENAME从厚皮分泌泡泡，用精神力量射向对手。不过，伤害并不大。
author: deelee2020
source: POKENAME secretes bubbles from its thick skin and uses psychic powers to launch them at the opponent. The bubbles don't do much harm, however.

entry: POKENAME看似覆满结晶，其实并非如此。它分泌泡泡，结成硬团，如宝石闪亮，却让勾魂眼等捕食者不想吃。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME are not covered in crystals, despite their appearance. Instead, they secrete bubbles which harden in clumps that shine just like jewels, whilst making them unappealing to predators like Sableye.

entry: POKENAME爱在齐膝水洼中扑腾。它玩闹着把自己摔到背上，再旋转，每摔一次，背壳便更坚固。
author: thezekrom
source: POKENAME loves to splash around in knee-deep puddles. By throwing itself on its back and spinning, it playfully hardens the back of its shell further with each throw.

entry: POKENAME喜欢保护弱者，用泡泡作掩护，让弱小宝可梦逃走。POKENAME的泡泡产不完，有时也会到生日会逗孩子开心。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME have protective natures, and will use their bubbles to create cover, allowing weaker Pokémon to flee. POKENAME can make an endless amount of these bubbles and can sometimes be found at birthday parties entertaining children.

entry: POKENAME讨厌干燥，用大耳朵散去余热，捕猎时则从嘴里射泡泡。
author: mcnchsschl
source: POKENAME hates drying out, so it uses its large ears to dissipate excess heat. It launches bubbles from its mouth to hunt prey.

entry: POKENAME用随身棍子，把泡泡塑成衣服。成群POKENAME还会举办小型时装秀，展示泡泡装。
author: drcew
source: POKENAME will use the stick they carry to mold the bubbles they produce into clothing. Groups of POKENAME will put on small fashion shows to show off their bubble outfits.

entry: 它看似随和，覆着娇弱泡泡，却始终警觉。受挑衅，就以令人眼花的速度发射泡泡，压倒敌人。
author: torterrable
source: It acts easygoing as it coats its body in delicate bubbles, but it is always observant. When provoked, it launches bubbles with blinding speed to overwhelm its foes.

entry: POKENAME从胸背分泌大量泡泡，造出帅气的泡沫围巾，藏住脸。可惜，通常忘了把其他身体也藏好。
author: imaginita
source: POKENAME secretes numerous bubbles from its chest and back, creating an awesome frothy scarf to hide its face.  Unfortunately, it usually forgets to hide the rest of its body.

entry: POKENAME尾端的泡沫极烫，却不会烧伤POKENAME自己，因此它常满不在乎。
author: .realthree
source: The foam produced at the end of POKENAME's tail is extremely hot. Even so, it doesn't burn POKENAME, so it tends to be careless with it.

entry: 爱心毛绒玩具常做成蓝色或缀着缎带，灵感就来自这种宝可梦。冲浪者相信，看见POKENAME，预示真爱将至。
author: deelee2020
source: It's common for heart plushies to be blue or adorned with ribbon, taking inspiration from this Pokémon. Among surfers, seeing POKENAME is a sign of true love to come.

entry: POKENAME顽皮，喜欢不被察觉地潜行。它用黏性泡泡分散注意，再迅速抓走闪亮物，藏进最近的隐蔽处。
author: curazy
source: POKENAME is a mischievous Pokémon that enjoys sneaking around unnoticed. It uses sticky bubbles to distract others, then quickly snatches anything shiny before disappearing into the nearest hiding place.

entry: POKENAME优雅谨慎，偏爱远远跟踪猎物。它无声穿过高草，用泡泡遮掩动作，再扑向毫无防备的目标。
author: curazy
source: POKENAME is a graceful and cautious Pokémon that prefers stalking its prey from a distance. It moves silently through tall grass, using its bubbles to conceal its movements before pouncing on unsuspecting prey.

entry: POKENAME分泌柔韧的泡膜，保护厚实拳头。战斗中，这层软垫一受损，就会怒不可遏。
author: theartemis1
source: POKENAME secretes a pliable film of bubbles to protect its meaty fists. Should this padding be damaged in battle, it will fly into a blind rage.

entry: POKENAME漂在海面附近，向猎物放毒泡，待其被震住，再挥动触手攻击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME floats near the ocean surface, releasing toxic bubbles at prey. Once stunned, it strikes with lashing tentacles.

entry: POKENAME走过草原，身后留下一串泡泡。有时互相绕圈追逐，想戳破对方的泡，结果整群都跟着兜圈。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME release bubbles in their wake as they roam through fields of grass. Sometimes, they chase each other in circles as they try to pop each other's bubbles, leading to the entire herd moving in a loop.

entry: 它舌头上的海沫，能过滤水中的杂质。POKENAME以藻类为食，强化外壳，抵御海里其他宝可梦的攻击。
author: fiordaliso
