source: Its tongue is covered with sea foam that allows it to filter impurities from the water. POKENAME feeds on algae to strengthen the shell that protects it from attacks by other Pokémon living in the ocean.

entry: 它以钟摆聚力，用精神力量控水。POKENAME每天花好几个小时，静静磨炼本领。
author: hophoppip
source: Using its pendulum as a focus for its power, it psychically manipulates water. POKENAME spends many hours a day silently honing its abilities.

entry: 强腿让它们能跃过岸边岩石。POKENAME受威胁，会裹上泡沫，看着更加庞大。
author: santon5512
source: Their strong legs allow them to leap between rocks along the shore. When threatened, POKENAME will cloak themselves in foamy bubbles to appear larger.

entry: POKENAME投向敌人的大骨头，巨大得必须双手扔。回旋镖虽慢却沉重，一次掠过，就能打断钢梁。
author: quackquackattack
source: The large bones that POKENAME toss at foes are so big that they must throw them with both hands. Their slow yet hefty boomerangs break steel beams with a single pass.

entry: POKENAME的翼由泡沫构成，挨打会变形，绕开攻击，只有打中主体才有效。它连续射出的泡泡，也让精准命中十分困难。
author: quackquackattack
source: The only way to effectively attack a POKENAME is by attacking the main body, as they have wings made out of a bubbly foam that deform and warp around attacks when struck. Their barrage of bubbles makes landing a precise attack difficult.

entry: 冰冷吐息造出浓雾，掩盖海上行动。壳周围的一圈泡泡，是健康的标志；POKENAME生病，就会接连破裂，直到完全康复。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its icy breath generates a thick veil of fog that conceals its movements at sea. The ring of bubbles lining its shell is a sign of good health; when POKENAME falls ill, the bubbles begin bursting one by one until it fully recovers.

entry: POKENAME快速穿行森林，杂屑常黏进胶状身体。它用泡沫裹住碍事的碎屑，偶尔把长长一串，丢到以碎屑为食的生物聚集处。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME will travel swiftly through forests, getting detritus stuck within their gelatinous form. They will form bubbles of foam around the offending pieces of material. They occasionally discard long chains in places rich in detritivores.

entry: POKENAME的壳覆着自己产生的数百万微小泡泡，调节体温。它们成群贴在海蚀洞壁上，睡梦中稍稍挪动，就会传出清楚的破泡声。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's shell is covered in millions of tiny bubbles it produces to regulate its body temperature. They cluster on sea cave walls, making distinct popping noises as they shift subtly in their sleep.

entry: POKENAME住在海中和湖边，时而游泳，时而飞行。换地方时，天气也跟着变。POKENAME借天气变化，构思深奥复杂的战术。
author: heal_fire
source: POKENAME live in the sea and around lakes, alternating between swimming and flying. When it changes locations, the weather changes alongside it. POKENAME uses the changing weather to form deep, complex strategies for battles.

entry: POKENAME身手敏捷，数秒便能攀上600米高塔。它爱爬到树冠顶端，朝天呱呱唱歌。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME is a nimble Pokémon that can scale a 600 meter tower in a few seconds. It enjoys climbing to the top of tree canopies to croak songs into the sky.

entry: POKENAME灵巧无比，约两秒就能造出、投掷飞水手里剑。动作也敏捷，瞬间反应，便能避开许多攻击。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are incredibly dexterous Pokémon that can conjure and throw water shuriken in a couple of seconds. They are also quite nimble, as they can dodge many attacks with split-second reaction speeds.

entry: POKENAME非常顽皮，不停挪走训练家的物品，或向其喷水。可若有其他宝可梦前来威胁，就会挺身面对，不顾自身安危。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME are very mischievous; they constantly move their Trainer's belongings or squirt them with water. However, if another Pokémon threatens them, they will stand and face the threat, no matter the danger to them.

entry: POKENAME把空气藏在毛里，得以水下呼吸。气泡慢慢逸出，在身后形成尾巴般的轨迹。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME trap air within their fur to enable them to breathe underwater. The air bubbles escape slowly, forming a trail behind them reminiscent of a tail.

entry: POKENAME视力敏锐，能发现周围沼泽水中最细微的变化。精准啄击，让它能从浑水抓出水生宝可梦，饱餐一顿。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have sharp vision that allows them to notice minute changes in the swampy water around them. Their precise pecks allow them to snatch up aquatic Pokémon from murky water, securing their next meal.

entry: POKENAME眼力敏锐，哪怕沼泽浓雾弥漫，也能轻松辨路。捕猎时，将长脖子扎进水里抓猎物。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's keen eyesight allows it to effortlessly navigate its swamp habitat, even when it is filled  with dense fog. When hunting, it plunges its long neck into the water to grab prey.

entry: POKENAME尖牙虽满是毒，却不够锋利，刺不穿鳞片或外皮，因此改喷黏在猎物身上的腐蚀泡沫，溶掉防护。
author: quackquackattack
source: Even though POKENAME fangs are full of venom, they are not sharp enough to pierce through scales or hide. They instead spray a caustic foam that clings to their prey to melt through their defenses.

entry: POKENAME的牙太钝，注不了毒，因此改向猎物喷碱性泡泡，慢慢溶化。巢穴也覆着这些泡泡，作防线。
author: mistymagius
source: Because its fangs are too dull to inject venom, POKENAME will instead spray alkaline bubbles at its prey, slowly melting them. It covers its den in these bubbles as a line of defense.

entry: 它把能量凝成带电手里剑，投向敌人，使其麻痹。POKENAME在水边树木间，建造藏身处。
author: fiordaliso
source: It channels its energy to forge electric shurikens, hurling them at enemies to leave them paralyzed. POKENAME builds its hideout among the trees that grow near bodies of water.

entry: 卡洛斯传说称，巫师曾用POKENAME随心改变天气。故事描述，POKENAME用泡沫胡须造云，引发倾盆大雨。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: According to Kalosian legend, POKENAME were used by wizards to change the weather on a whim. These stories describe POKENAME using their beard of bubbles to make clouds and downpours.

entry: POKENAME将叶片裹进泡泡，做成小靶，再练习投叶制手里剑，提高准头。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME practice throwing leafy shuriken at targets to improve their accuracy. They create small targets for themselves by encasing leaves in bubbles.

entry: POKENAME跃过树木，巡视整片森林，担任守护者。从上方高速吐出大量裹着泡泡的种子，打击自认为有威胁的生物。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME leaps from tree to tree, surveying entire forests as their designated protector. From above, it pelts those it deems a threat with bubble-coated seeds spat out at high volume and rapid speeds.

entry: POKENAME远战娴熟，隔着整个足球场，也能打落罐子。泡泡与剃刀般锋利的叶片，让它有许多办法击倒敌人。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are highly proficient with ranged combat, as they can knock down a can from across a football field. Their bubbles and razor-sharp leaves give them many options on how to take down foes.

entry: POKENAME吃含籽食物，把种子单独留在嘴里，覆上遇空气就发泡的可燃液，再吐向目标。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME eat foods that contain seeds, keeping the seeds separate and stored within their mouths. They coat these seeds in a flammable fluid that froths like foam when exposed to air, then spit them at their targets.

entry: POKENAME高速游过河流，身后留下泡沫。鳍始终露在水面，向同类显示支配地位。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME leaves foam in its wake as it swims through rivers at high speeds. It keeps its fin above the water to assert dominance over others of its kind.

entry: POKENAME体表的泡泡，装满极其恶臭的水。它把泡扔到池岸，阻止人靠得太近。
author: .izik
source: The bubbles on POKENAME's body are filled with incredibly foul-smelling water. It tosses them onto the shoreline of its pond to deter humans from drawing too close.

entry: POKENAME用尾巴吊在树枝，观察其他生物。若觉得被发现，就变色融入周围。还会用长舌取来坚果与石头，扔向敌人。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME use their tails to hang from branches as they observe others; if they think they have been spotted, they can change hues and blend in. Using their long tongues, they retrieve nuts and stones to throw at their foes.

entry: POKENAME把极热泡沫喷满战场，拖慢敌人。它偏爱保持距离，用惊人杂技身手，阻人靠近。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME sprays extremely hot suds across the battlefield to slow foes. It prefers to maintain distance, using its incredible acrobatics to keep opponents at bay.

entry: POKENAME吹大尾巴和颈部泡泡，让自己显得庞大。一分钟内，能攀上高达2000英尺的悬崖。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME blows up the bubbles on its tail and neck to make it look bigger. It can scale a cliff of up to 2000 feet in a minute's time.

entry: POKENAME有独特战法，利用头部产生的泡沫。它不停训练，精进技艺。
author: corra_universe
source: POKENAME has a unique fighting style that utilizes the foam produced from its head. It trains constantly to push its techniques further.

entry: POKENAME自认是正直的见习忍者战士，哪怕似乎没必要，也会跃身保护其他宝可梦。喷出的小泡泡，快得接近子弹。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME fancies itself as an honorable warrior-ninja in training. It leaps to the defense of other Pokémon, even if it seems unnecessary, spitting out small bubbles that travel close to the speed of a bullet.

entry: 同类相遇，POKENAME会一边对视，一边吹泡泡。吹得最大、又不把泡弄破的，就是胜者。
author: .izik
source: Should POKENAME encounter another of its kind, they will blow bubbles while maintaining eye contact. The one who blows the largest bubble without popping it is declared the winner.

entry: POKENAME借可爱与优雅，收到训练家送的小物件，再装进泡泡缎带。挥动时，就能将礼物当弹丸，射向敌人。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME takes advantage of its cuteness and elegance to receive small objects as gifts from Trainers. These are then loaded into its bubble ribbons so that when it swings them around, it can launch projectiles at foes.

entry: POKENAME裹着近乎透明的泡泡，保护自己，对其他宝可梦恶作剧。要赶紧逃走时，POKENAME就能飘走或游走，躲开随后的麻烦。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME surround themselves with a nearly transparent bubble that protects them while they play pranks on other Pokémon. Whenever they need a quick escape, POKENAME can float or swim away to avoid consequences.

entry: 它用密集泡泡包围对手，部分会黏住、拖慢动作。随后向敌人放电，电流在近旁泡泡间跳跃。
author: quackquackattack
source: It surrounds its opponent with a flurry of bubbles, some of which stick to and slow down the opponent. Afterwards, it releases a shock towards the opponent, which ricochets from bubble to bubble in close proximity.

entry: POKENAME跳动圆滚滚的身体移动，能从头部精准射泡，隔着距离，将溶在泡内的毒素送到其他宝可梦身上。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME moves its round body by hopping around. It can fire bubbles out of its head with great precision, delivering dissolved toxins to other Pokémon while remaining at a distance.

entry: POKENAME收集、吞吃水面漂浮垃圾。吃够后，就脸朝下在水里睡着，漂过湖泊。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME gathers and consumes trash floating on the water's surface. Once it eats enough, it sleeps face-first in the water while drifting across a lake.

entry: POKENAME在背上造出蘑菇状泡泡，制造视觉扭曲，分散捕食者注意。泡一破，就爬去藏好，直到能安全重造。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME creates a mushroom-shaped bubble on its back to create visual distortions to distract predators. If the bubble pops, it scuttles into hiding until it can safely rebuild it.

entry: POKENAME有神射手般的准头，能远远射出树皮镖，制服敌人。近处镖不太管用，就改靠沉重橡木甲承受打击。
author: quackquackattack
source: With the precision of a marksman, POKENAME can reliably shoot darts made out of bark to subdue foes from long range. These darts are less effective at close range, so their heavy, oaken armor soaks up the damage instead.

entry: POKENAME的壳坚固光滑。同类相遇，会把壳当雪橇，沿浅河展开友好竞速。
author: thezekrom
source: The shell covering POKENAME is sturdy but smooth. When it encounters others of its kind, it uses its shell like a sled to start friendly races through shallow rivers.

entry: POKENAME是出色的战术家，挥动裹着泡泡的木棍与盟友交流，十分擅长制定战斗策略。
author: mcnchsschl
source: An incredible tactician, POKENAME waves its bubble-covered stick in the air to communicate with its allies. It's great at devising battle strategies.

entry: POKENAME比呱呱泡蛙更熟练，却仍小巧，会连续掷出裹着泡泡的弹丸，保护其他生物。若觉得敌人不把自己当回事，POKENAME就加倍努力。
author: sk372
source: Becoming more skillful than Froakie but retaining its small stature, POKENAME defends others with bubble-coated projectiles thrown in rapid succession. POKENAME doubles its efforts if it feels a foe isn't taking it seriously.

entry: 融合后，POKENAME颈周的泡泡，变成皂液般的质地。它用来拖慢逃跑猎物。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: The bubbles around the necks of POKENAME became soapy in consistency following fusion. It uses its bubbles to slow down fleeing prey.

entry: POKENAME敏捷迅速，肉眼很难跟上。多数时候，能证明POKENAME经过的，只有身后一点云状泡沫痕迹。
author: imaginita
source: POKENAME is so agile and speedy that it's hard to follow with the naked eye.  In most cases, the only sign that a POKENAME has passed by is the slightest trail of cloud-like froth in its wake.

entry: 战斗中，POKENAME从水面探头，精准射出水枪，再迅速潜回。动作太快太灵活，难以好好研究下半身。
author: bobosmith01
source: In battle, POKENAME peers its head above the surface of water, shoots a highly precise Water Gun, and then quickly retreats back underwater. It is too swift and nimble to properly study its lower body.

entry: POKENAME向敌人发射爱心泡，内有抑制暴力冲动的特殊液体。许多敌人被安抚后不知所措，正好让POKENAME趁机进攻。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME launches heart-shaped bubbles at foes filled with a special liquid that suppresses violent urges. Many foes are left confused after being pacified by the bubbles, giving POKENAME an opportunity to strike.

entry: POKENAME尾颈飘出的泡沫，含有一接触任何碳化合物就会燃烧的物质。若在POKENAME栖身的岩地看见湿痕，最好别碰。
author: .realthree
source: The foam that floats out of POKENAME's tail and neck contains a chemical that combusts when it makes contact with any carbon compounds. If you come across any wet spots in the rocky lands where POKENAME live, it is best not to touch them.

entry: POKENAME从嘴里释放黏性泡沫，能附在羽毛和毛皮上。不高兴时，就会飞上天空，朝训练家喷泡沫。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME release a sticky foam from their mouths that clings to feathers and fur. Whenever they are upset, they take to the sky to spew foam over their Trainer.

entry: POKENAME用水造出锋利匕首，投向敌人。力道强得足以击碎石头。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME creates bladed daggers out of water to fight against its foes. These aquatic weapons are thrown with enough force to shatter stone.

entry: POKENAME靠轻盈泡泡浮起，在水上奔跑。点燃泡沫鬃毛，还能拍出漂亮照片。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME relies on its lightweight bubbles to keep itself afloat as it gallops across water. Its bubbly mane can be set aflame to create photogenic shots.

entry: POKENAME顽皮，爱造泡泡，与训练家玩耍。一无聊，就精准地朝训练家射泡，吸引注意。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are playful creatures that enjoy creating bubbles and playing with their Trainer. Whenever they are bored, they shoot bubbles at their Trainer with remarkable accuracy to get attention.

entry: POKENAME皮肤极冷黏腻。光是待在旁边，就让人皮肤湿冷、心中不安，仿佛被注视。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's skin is incredibly cold and sticky. Its mere presence causes clammy skin and general unease, as if one were being watched.

entry: POKENAME的舌头大得嘴里放不下，只好把多余部分绑在背上。解开舌头才能攻击，需要时间，期间容易受伤。
author: pokebio
source: POKENAME has a tongue too large for its mouth, so it ties the surplus to its back. Untying the tongue to attack takes time, so it is vulnerable while doing so.

entry: POKENAME如忍者，巡逻温泉和火山地带。吐出浓蒸气遮掩行动，再迅速投出沸水制成的手里剑，无声突袭。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME operates as a ninja patrolling hot springs and volcano areas. It breathes out thick plumes of steam to hide its movements, striking unseen with quickly thrown shurikens made of boiling-hot water.

entry: 敌人成群围攻，POKENAME就竖毛反击，放出数百枚压缩水刺。它用颈边舌头，给敌人涂满黏液，让下一击能造成猛烈电击。
author: soup1900
source: When enemies swarm on POKENAME, it bristles its fur to release hundreds of spikes made of compressed water to counterattack. It covers foes in slime using the tongue around its neck to set them up to become severely electrocuted in its next attack.

entry: POKENAME爱溜到毫无防备的训练家和宝可梦身后。一被发现，POKENAME就用长舌拍一下，再突然消失。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME enjoy sneaking behind unsuspecting Trainers and Pokémon. Once spotted, POKENAME slaps them with their long tongue before abruptly disappearing.

entry: POKENAME舌头过大、身体太小，难以看清，只能靠水纹感知危险。不过，舌头也能当武器，快速抽击。
author: actliux
source: POKENAME's oversized tongue combined with its small body makes it difficult for it to see, so it relies on water ripples to sense danger. This tongue however also serves as a weapon, capable of unleashing swift lashes.

entry: POKENAME在树间荡来荡去，用汗水制成的手里剑，打落蕉香果。它大量收集，送给盟友。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME swings from tree to tree, using shuriken created from its own sweat to knock loose Nanab Berries. It gathers them in great quantities as gifts for its allies.

entry: POKENAME借湍急河流掩护，跟踪毫无防备的猎物，蓄能伏击。猛然跃出水面，先投飞水手里剑，再使出能破甲的踢击。
author: ghostslythe
source: Using rough river rapids as cover, POKENAME tracks unsuspecting prey while gathering energy for an ambush. It breaks the surface with a mighty jump, throwing a Water Shuriken before landing an armor-piercing kick.

entry: POKENAME以果实为食，把树果汁存进壳里，用来维生与作战。特意留下种子，让果汁制成的手里剑，带有强劲磨蚀效果。
author: slavman9057
source: POKENAME are frugivorous, eating berries and storing the juice in their shells to both survive and to fight. They purposefully leave the seeds inside, as the shurikens they form with the juice are granted a powerful abrasive effect.

entry: POKENAME壳里伸出的舌头，热得一碰就会灼伤。战斗时高速挥动，既伤害敌人，也能将其缠住。
author: .izik
source: The incredibly hot tongues emerging from POKENAME's shells can cause burns on contact. It whips them at great speed during combat to both damage and grapple foes.

entry: POKENAME舌上满是小毒腺，会用舌缠住猎物，使其无法动弹、逐渐衰弱，再整个吞下。
author: acid_pen
source: POKENAME's tongue is covered with small poison glands. It immobilizes prey by wrapping them with its tongue, weakening them, and then swallowing them whole.

entry: POKENAME飞在漆黑夜空，尽心守护海洋。双翼能造出巨大水制手里剑，穿空破海的速度，快得能引发漩涡与台风。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME flies in the dark of night, dedicated to keeping the seas safe. It can create massive shurikens of water in its wings, and cuts through both air and sea fast enough to create whirlpools and typhoons.

entry: POKENAME反应如电，在战场四处疾行，从各方向攻击。尾根的手里剑充当螺旋桨，让它能在水下游泳。
author: chibitales
source: With lightning-fast reflexes, POKENAME darts around the battlefield and strikes from all angles. The shuriken at the base of its tail acts as a propeller, allowing it to swim underwater.

entry: POKENAME战斗时，用灵巧舌头掷出带电飞水手里剑。随蓄电量不同，一击便可能打倒体型超过自身十倍的敌人。
author: theartemis1
source: In battle, POKENAME uses its dexterous tongue to hurl electrically charged Water Shurikens at its opponent. Depending on the amount of charge stored, a single hit can down an enemy over ten times its size.

entry: POKENAME以离子化的水攻击，低悬水面，用磁力造出水制手里剑。不过，空中动作笨拙，力量只能用于悬浮或进攻。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME use ionised water as a means of attack, floating low over water surfaces and using their magnetic powers to create water shurikens. They are cumbersome in the air, however, only able to use their powers to float or to attack.

entry: 它们灵巧迅速地用长舌，舔视野中的一切，判断能否吃。似乎能主动关闭味觉与触觉，得以用舌对付恶臭黏腻的臭臭泥等敌人。
author: bobosmith01
source: They swiftly and adeptly use their long tongue to lick anything in sight to determine its edibility. It appears they can voluntarily switch off their sense of taste and touch in order to use its tongue to fight foes such as the foul and gooey Muk.

entry: POKENAME舌头直连躯干的发电器官。展开围巾般的舌头，就能引导能量，掷出由电力与水混合形成的手里剑。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's tongue is directly connected to an electricity-generating organ in its torso. When it unfurls it from its scarf-like position, it channels that energy to fling out shuriken made of electricity and water mixed together.

entry: POKENAME十分狡黠，身手敏捷得无与伦比，几乎无法击中。它能瞬间蜷缩成球，以外壳护住弱点，一边迅速闪避，一边投掷沙弹阻碍敌人。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is a cunning Pokémon, nearly impossible to hit thanks to its unmatched agility. It can curl into a ball in an instant, shielding its weak points with its shell, and hurls sand bombs to hinder foes while executing swift evasive maneuvers.

entry: POKENAME敏捷隐秘，即使遭追，也能优雅穿行树间。被挑战时，先用能抓握、如围巾般的舌头缠住敌人，再以飞水手里剑反击。
author: blaizegamer
source: POKENAME are very agile and stealthy, maneuvering through trees gracefully even when being chased by foes. When challenged to a fight, they use their prehensile tongue-scarf to immobilize foes before countering with Water Shuriken.

entry: 它树脂般的唾液，覆在长舌上，起保护作用。POKENAME用长舌在树枝间荡行，巡查领地，寻找入侵者与新鲜食物。
author: infinex21
source: Its saliva is like tree resin, which covers its long tongue to protect it. POKENAME uses its long tongue to swing between tree branches as it patrols its territory, searching for intruders and for fresh food.

entry: POKENAME造出水制武器，切开敌人。远攻时，则结合利叶与水制手里剑，结束战斗。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME conjure weapons made of water to cut through their opponents. For long range attacks, they rely on a mix of razor-sharp leaves and water shuriken to finish off a battle.

entry: POKENAME住在沼泽，努力保护当地小型宝可梦。它用锋利尾巴割开芦苇，让猎手暴露。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME live in marshes, seeking to protect the small Pokémon that live there. They use their sharp tails to slice through reeds and expose hunters.

entry: POKENAME用奇特舌头引诱、缠住猎物，也用来抛水甩火。它常栖在树枝上，随时准备出其不意地对付威胁。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME use their peculiar tongues to lure in and ensnare their prey, as well as to fling water and fire. They often rest atop tree branches so they may catch any threats by surprise.

entry: 它背上的刺，其实由凝聚的水构成。POKENAME把刺当苦无，一次掷出多枚，压倒比自己大得多的敌人。
author: kam_doodle_snek
source: The quills on its back are actually made of condensed water. POKENAME can use these quills like kunai, throwing multiple at once to overwhelm foes much larger than itself.

entry: 这种隐秘宝可梦，像忍者般从高处伏击。目标进入攻击范围，POKENAME就跃出藏身处，以强腿使出飞身踢。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: This stealthy Pokémon takes advantage of high vantage points to ambush prey like a ninja. Once a target is within striking range, POKENAME leaps from its hiding spot and drop kicks the target with its powerful legs.

entry: POKENAME身姿敏捷优雅，踢击迅猛，被大多数人视为顶尖忍者。脚能产出蒸气，遮掩潜行。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: With its agile grace and blistering kicks, POKENAME is considered by most to be an apex ninja. To aid in sneaking, it can produce steam from its feet to create cover.

entry: POKENAME看守水跃鱼聚集处，在暗处默默保护。它投出泥水手里剑，处理潜在危险。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME watches over areas where Mudkip gather, working as a quiet protector from the shadows. It takes care of potential dangers by flinging shurikens made of muddy water.

entry: POKENAME从河底深处伸舌，抓取水面上的猎物与果实。年纪越大，舌头越长。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME extends its tongue from deep beneath rivers to snatch prey and fruit from above the surface. Its tongue grows longer the older it gets.

entry: POKENAME的速度与体型，很适合一击即走的战术。它收集泥水做成脏手里剑，既伤敌，也能蒙住视线。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's speed and size make it excellent at doing hit-and-run tactics. It gathers up muddy water to form into dirty shurikens to throw at foes as a way to both injure and blind them.

entry: POKENAME体表包着薄黏膜，能用这层黏液做手里剑，利落切断钢缆。
author: imaginita
source: The surface of POKENAME's body is enveloped by a thin, sticky film.  From this mucus, it makes shuriken that can cut cleanly through steel cables.

entry: POKENAME平衡与敏捷性出众，竟能在栖身湖泊的睡莲叶上站稳，连风暴也不失衡。谁来打扰，就会被它怒吼着喷泥。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME has a superior sense of balance and agility, somehow managing to balance on lily pads across its lake home. It maintains this even through stormy weather, bellowing angrily and spitting mud at any human who disturbs it.

entry: POKENAME如忍者般迅捷优雅，以精神力量制造幻象，更好地藏身，悄悄对付敌人。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME moves with the swiftness and grace of a ninja. It uses psychic powers to cast illusions to better hide itself, making it even more capable of stealthily dealing with opposition.

entry: 穿着水裙的POKENAME，更擅长水中活动。陆地虽也灵活，真正速度与技艺，要到水下才最明显。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME seen with a skirt made of water are known for being more aquatically inclined. While mobile on land, its true speed and skill becomes most prevalent once it's underwater.

entry: POKENAME总被水漩涡包围，靠得太近就会被困。远离虽然较安全，漩涡中的水仍能甩出手里剑，击中更远的敌人。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME is constantly surrounded by a whirlpool of water, trapping anyone who gets too close. While it is safer to keep away, the swirling water can fling out shuriken to strike more distant foes.

entry: 据说，无论藏得多好，哪怕看不见，POKENAME也能凭天生的波导感知找到。它借此躲开危险敌人，或追猎物。
author: blaizegamer
source: It is said that no one can hide from POKENAME, even those it cannot see, due to its innate ability to sense aura. It uses this ability to hide from dangerous foes or hunt its prey.

entry: POKENAME努力培养自制力，让战斗更讲策略。为此，它用长舌盖住嘴巴，帮助自己克制本能，免得又只顾着咬对手。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME attempts to teach itself discipline and fight more tactically in combat. To that end, it covers its mouth with its long tongue, to help prevent itself from falling to its instincts and resorting to simply biting opponents.

entry: POKENAME绰号“沙漠巨牙鲨”，在浅层地下绕行，吸食仙人掌根的水。露出地面的背鳍一碰到训练家或宝可梦，就破沙而出，以固态水镰迎战。
author: ghostslythe
source: Nicknamed the desert Sand Sharpedo, POKENAME circles shallowly underground, feeding off the water from cactus roots. When its dorsal fin above ground hits a Trainer or Pokémon, it explodes from the sand, confronting foes with solid water scythes.

entry: POKENAME像流动道场，教呱呱泡蛙与妙蛙种子一系的融合体学习忍术。若里面的学员受威胁，POKENAME便急转背上水手里剑，射出刀刃般锐利的水滴。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: A POKENAME acts as a sort of traveling dojo for Froasaur, helping to teach them the art of ninjutsu. If anyone threatens the Froasaur inside, the POKENAME will rapidly spin the water shuriken on its back and launch razor-sharp droplets.

entry: POKENAME一见食物就流涎，唾液浸满舌头。POKENAME能迅速展开长舌，甩出唾液手里剑，只动一个部位，就能制服猎物。
author: .jerden
source: Whenever POKENAME sees food, it will drool, soaking its tongue with saliva. POKENAME can quickly uncoil its long tongue to fling shuriken made from this liquid, taking down its prey by moving only a single body part.

entry: POKENAME一见食物就流涎，唾液浸满舌头。POKENAME能迅速展开长舌，甩出唾液手里剑，只动一个部位，就能制服猎物。
author: .jerden
source: Whenever POKENAME sees food, it will drool, soaking its tongue with saliva. POKENAME can quickly uncoil its long tongue to fling shuriken made from this liquid, taking down its prey by moving only a single body part.

entry: 春天，POKENAME背上树木的粉叶间，开满雪白花朵。花落时，它就用长舌吃掉。
author: .izik
source: The pink leaves on the tree on POKENAME's back become littered with snow-white blossoms in spring. It uses its long tongue to eat the blossoms as they fall.

entry: 它善于应对危险，用敏锐舌头与火尾探知敌人，再调整手里剑攻势，尽可能发挥效果。
author: catsquatch_geography
source: It shows great resourcefulness in the face of danger, utilizing its sensitive tongue and fiery tail to detect its enemies, then modify its shuriken attacks for maximum effectiveness.

entry: POKENAME用头顶分泌的特殊硬化黏液，做成剑与剑鞘。战斗时以舌持剑，连背后对手也能有效格挡、攻击。
author: chaoticanzu
source: POKENAME crafts a sword and scabbard out of a special hardened mucus secreted from the top of its head. In battle, it wields the sword with its tongue and can effectively block and attack opponents behind it.

entry: POKENAME分泌特殊唾液，能保住体热、减小水中阻力。捕猎前，会用舌把这滑液涂遍全身。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME secretes a special saliva that helps retain body heat and reduce drag in the water. Prior to hunting, it uses its tongue to coat itself in this slick substance.

entry: POKENAME朝游轮投手里剑，分散用餐客人的注意，再用长舌抢食物逃走。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME flings shuriken at cruise ships to distract patrons during their meals. It then uses its long tongue to snatch their food before fleeing.

entry: POKENAME体型庞大沉重，速度与敏捷却惊人，让许多敌人意外。鳍能射出许多硕大锋利的水制手里剑，阻人靠近。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME surprises many a foe with blazing speed and agility in spite of its heavy girth and size. From its flippers, it fires off a multitude of large and sharp water shuriken to keep its opponents at bay.

entry: POKENAME快速搅水，造出锋利如剃刀的刃。水刃悬空环绕，随劈斩方向移动，延长攻击范围。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME rapidly stir up water in order to construct razor-sharp blades. The blades float in the air and circle around them, following the direction of their slashes to extend the range of their attacks.

entry: 它投掷电与水制成的手里剑。饮食越有营养，投得就越快。
author: lydiaprower8
source: It throws stars made out of electricity and water. The more nutritious its diet, the faster its throwing speed.

entry: POKENAME虽练成高超幻术与忍术，却有致命弱点：舌头。伪装时被发现，就会挥舌攻击，再退走。
author: musicsheep.
source: Despite honing great illusions and ninjutsu skills, POKENAME has a fatal flaw: its tongue. If discovered mid-disguise, it will lash out with it before retreating.

entry: POKENAME迅捷坚定，保护其他生物。舌上唾液能强效舒缓、麻醉，用来照料小伤，也能平息闹腾的个体。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are swift and stalwart protectors of others. The saliva of their tongues is a powerful soothing and numbing agent. They utilize this saliva to tend to small injuries, though it can be used to quell rowdy individuals.

entry: POKENAME以强腿跳跃旋转，能突然伸臂，用爪劈斩，打个措手不及，也能以强壮舌头和尾巴猛击。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME leaps and spins using its powerful legs. It can catch foes off guard by suddenly extending out its arms to slash with its claws, or by delivering powerful strikes with its muscular tongue and tail.

entry: 这种滑溜忍者，奇怪地喜爱黄金、珠宝等闪亮物。浅红市附近，也曾出现POKENAME的踪影。
author: saberman3885
source: This slippery shinobi shows a strange interest in shiny items, such as gold and jewels. POKENAME has also been seen nearby Fuchsia City.

entry: 人们相信，POKENAME就是多则传说中，在深夜闹事的神秘宝可梦。真正起源，仍是谜。
author: corra_universe
source: POKENAME is believed to be the subject of several legends describing a mysterious Pokémon causing havoc in the dead of night. Its exact origins are a mystery.

entry: POKENAME身体沉重，便用长舌迅速拉动自己，也借此撞击敌人。收回舌头，覆上黏性腐蚀唾液，就能快速吃掉小金属碎片。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME uses its long tongue to pull itself around quickly, given how heavy its body is; it will also use this tactic to slam into its foes. It withdraws its tongue to coat it in a sticky, corrosive saliva in order to quickly eat small metal scraps.

entry: POKENAME身体几乎全是水，却能切断钢缆。惹怒后，安抚比躲藏明智，因为墙挡不住它，速度也极快。
author: periperi_chicken
source: Despite being composed almost entirely of water, POKENAME can slice through steel cables. If angered, calming it down is wiser than hiding - walls won't stop it, and it moves incredibly fast.

entry: POKENAME两半身体联动旋转，吸来附近的水，体型、力量与速度随之增大。战斗时，两半都能如一对手里剑飞旋。
author: sk372
source: The connective rotation of POKENAME's two halves draws in water from nearby sources. This causes it to grow in size, strength, and speed, both halves able to fly around like twin shuriken in combat.

entry: POKENAME很少停下，常高速移动，保护尾火。受威胁时，会密投压缩水制成的小型不稳定手里剑，为逃跑争取时间。
author: theartemis1
source: POKENAME is rarely spotted at rest, often maneuvering at high speeds in an effort to protect the flame on its tail. When threatened, it hurls a flurry of small but volatile throwing stars formed from compressed water, buying itself time to escape.

entry: POKENAME周身环着利刃，能藏进孢子云。它自己动不快，偶尔会被其他宝可梦拎住舌头，当烟雾弹扔出，或如手里剑般旋转。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's body is ringed with sharp blades, and it can conceal itself within a cloud of spores. While it cannot move quickly on its own, other Pokémon occasionally pick it by the tongue to toss like a smoke bomb or spin like a shuriken.

entry: POKENAME通常不及其他勾魂眼融合体贪食，因为能把压缩水喷进岩石与沉积物，自己造钻石吃。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME are typically less food driven than other Sableye fusions. This is because they make their own diamonds to eat by spraying compressed water into rocks and sediment.

entry: POKENAME虽然又大又重，却是攀爬高手，能用小爪爬上丛林树，或以指垫贴住潮湿河崖。它便这样悄悄接近猎物，再伸舌抓住。
author: milchik
source: Despite its size and weight, POKENAME is an expert climber, able to crawl up the jungle trees with its small claws or stick to wet river cliffs with its finger pads. That way, this stealthy predator sneaks up to its prey, catching it with its tongue.

entry: 这种奇异水生生物藏在珊瑚礁。头上貌似珊瑚枝的部分，其实是敏感器官，探测周围水中的化学物质。
author: hophoppip
source: This odd aquatic creature hides in coral reefs. What look like coral branches on its head are actually sensitive organs that detect chemicals in the water around them.

entry: POKENAME的长舌极黏，最远能缠住10英尺处的猎物。抓住后，咬力足以压碎船壳。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's long tongue is incredibly sticky and can ensnare prey from up to 10 feet away. Once captured, it bites down with enough force to crush a ship's hull.

entry: POKENAME精于伏击，水中既无声又疾如闪电。有多起报告称，POKENAME会在追逐中消失，突然出现在猎物前，再使出咬住，重创猎物。
author: chibitales
source: A master of ambush tactics, POKENAME is both silent and lightning-fast underwater. Several reports claim to see POKENAME vanish mid-chase only to reappear in front of its prey, delivering a devastating Bite.

entry: POKENAME用巨大水制手里剑，切开一团团光能，造出传送门，前往任何想去的地方。许多报告称，它会突然出现在敌群背后，将其劈成碎片。
author: soup1900
source: Using its large water shurikens, POKENAME can slice open pockets of light energy to create portals that teleport it anywhere it wants. Many reports have been made of this species suddenly appearing behind groups of foes and slashing them to bits.

entry: POKENAME靠矿物维生、成长，喝下溶有矿物的洞水获取养分，还会用长舌，舔净平时够不到的地方。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME feeds on minerals in order to sustain itself and grow. It acquires these minerals by drinking cave water that they are dissolved in, using its long tongue to lick clean what it wouldn't normally be able to reach.

entry: POKENAME外表笨重，却能巧妙绕行，在敌人攻击前缴械、制服。它能把水塑成任何形式的防御工事或武器，不过更爱手里剑。
author: notadoctor75
source: Despite its bulky appearance, POKENAME can weave around opponents masterfully, disarming and disabling foes before they can attack. It can shape water into any form of fortification or weapon to aid in its defense, though it prefers shurikens.

entry: POKENAME对本领太自信，比起稳妥取胜，更爱戏耍对手。它从棍端连投水制手里剑，逼敌人躲个不停。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's confidence in its skills is enough that it prefers to play with its opponents rather than secure victory. It flings numerous water shuriken from the end of its stick to force its foe to dodge endlessly.

entry: POKENAME反应极快，因此人们相信它能预见未来。双节棍使得快又准，外貌虽不友善，一旦对谁产生好感，就忠诚无比。
author: mcnchsschl
source: POKENAME can react so fast that it is believed it can see the future. It wields its nunchakus with incredible precision and speed. Despite its unfriendly looks, it is incredibly loyal once it takes a liking to someone.

entry: POKENAME用水造的手里剑，最大可达身体的三倍。越大，就越难控制。
author: .izik
source: The shuriken POKENAME creates from water can grow up to three times the size of its body. The larger they become, the less control it has over them.

entry: POKENAME虽已尽力，仍比普通宝可梦略慢。为弥补劣势，会猛喷一阵阵浓蒸气，危急时遮掩自己。
author: theartemis1
source: Despite its best efforts, POKENAME is somewhat slower than the average Pokémon. To compensate, it releases thick steam from its body in large bursts, masking its presence from foes in a pinch.

entry: POKENAME用黏舌攀爬崖壁。唾液引起升温的化学反应，因此爬过后，会留下焦痕。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME uses its sticky tongue to scale cliffs and walls. As it does so, it leaves scorch marks behind, as its saliva causes a chemical reaction that raises the temperature.

entry: POKENAME向敌人射爱心泡，液体冷却身体、平复心绪，压下暴力冲动。据说，连最愤怒的宝可梦也能安抚。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME suppresses a foe's violent urges by shooting heart-shaped bubbles at them, the liquid cooling their body and calming their mind. It is said that these bubbles can calm even the angriest of Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME能用精神力量，造出并骑乘水制手里剑。样子虽滑稽，却有英雄气概，许多故事都讲它救人和宝可梦脱险。
author: kam_doodle_snek
source: POKENAME's psychic powers allows it to create and ride the water shuriken it uses. Despite its goofy appearance, it is heroic in nature. There are many stories of POKENAME rescuing people and Pokémon from peril.

entry: POKENAME能根据水流图案预测未来。它用勺子作标记，持续追踪、核对，看看先前预见的结果是否仍会成真。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are able to predict the future based on the patterns of flowing water. They utilize their spoons as markers to keep track of their readings over time, cross-referencing if outcomes they foresaw will still come true.

entry: POKENAME不求敏捷隐秘，更爱凭蛮力作战。为练肌肉，会带着平均重50磅的巨大冰手里剑，到处行走。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Instead of agility and stealth, POKENAME prefer fighting their battles through raw strength. To train their muscles, they carry around a large ice ninja star weighing an average of 50 lbs.

entry: POKENAME只在防守时，把舌头卷到背上。进攻通常用来缠住、勒紧对手，再从炮管发射水制手里剑。
author: seanothan_23
source: POKENAME only curls its tongue on its back for defense. When they are attacking they usually wrap it around their opponents to constrict them, then fires water shurikens from its cannons.

entry: POKENAME长舌覆毒，只舔一下，就能让有些生物痛得在地上翻腾。它虽能融进别人的影子，藏得毫无痕迹，也有顽皮合群的个体记录。
author: bobosmith01
source: Poison coats POKENAME's long tongue: a single lick can leave some flailing on the floor in pain. Although it has the ability to melt into another's shadow and stay perfectly hidden, there are several cases of playful and social POKENAME, too.

entry: 背上种子不停冒烟，有时带毒。POKENAME每天得吃几十颗树果，维持高体温，否则可能生病。
author: fiordaliso
source: A constant stream of smoke rises from the seed on its back, sometimes containing toxic substances. POKENAME must eat dozens of berries each day to keep its body temperature high, or it risks falling ill.

entry: POKENAME察觉威胁，就从尾部释放浓烟，隐入其中，消失无踪。主食是森林家园树根处的树果。
author: fiordaliso
source: When POKENAME detects a threat, it releases a thick smoke from its tail and vanishes into it without a trace. It feeds primarily on Berries found at the base of trees in the forests it inhabits.

entry: POKENAME身体散出的热，足以让附近地面冒汽起火。它能爆出能量与滚烫蒸汽，威力足以留下小坑。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's body radiates enough heat to cause the ground near it to steam and ignite. It can explode in a burst of energy and scalding steam, powerful enough to leave a small crater behind.

entry: POKENAME武器产生的烟，反映情绪。受威胁，烟就变浓，以黑雾笼罩周围。
author: mepp.
source: The smoke created from POKENAME's weapon reflects its emotional state. When threatened, the smoke thickens and shrouds the area in an black haze.

entry: POKENAME释放热烟，吸走周围水分。它对湿度敏感，不断放烟，调节空气湿度。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME release a hot smoke that wicks moisture from the area around them. They are sensitive to moisture in the area, so by constantly releasing smoke they can adjust the humidity in the air.

entry: POKENAME放出的烟，有灰烬与泥土味。有些人用这味道，帮助火山地区的宝可梦，离开原生栖息地后也更安心。
author: sk372
source: The clouds of smoke emanated from POKENAME have an ashy and earthen scent to them. The smell has been used by some to help Pokémon from volcanic areas feel more comfortable when away from their natural habitat.

entry: 煤矿设施常遭POKENAME闯入，寻找最爱的煤。滚烫岩甲虽让动作慢，却很难赶走。
author: chibitales
source: Coal mining facilities are a frequent target of POKENAME raids as they barrel through trying to find their favorite food: coal. Their blazing hot, rocky armor makes them slow, but tough to repel.

entry: POKENAME强劲过热的钻头，能穿过任何地形。一没兴致再钻，就把能量改送角尖，炸开任何岩石。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME's powerful, superheated drill can power through any terrain. When its love for drilling is exhausted, it will reroute its energy into the tip of its horn, exploding any kind of rock.

entry: 壳内蒸气让POKENAME触手湿润，得以行动。移动时蒸气逸出，因此只能短促地移动，免得肢体干燥。
author: sk372
source: Steam within the shell keeps POKENAME's tentacles moist and able to move it around. Because the steam escapes as it moves, it only moves in short bursts, lest it risk its limbs drying out.

entry: POKENAME胃里烧到华氏3000度，常被铁匠当炉。POKENAME还常让小炭仔住在胃里，给予养分与保护。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME's stomachs burn at 3,000 degrees Fahrenheit, often being used as furnaces by blacksmiths. POKENAME will often house Rolycoly in their stomachs, giving them sustenance and protection.

entry: POKENAME喷出的烟形成巨大背鳍，推动水中前进。它常游荡火山岛附近海域，尤其仍有活火山的岛。
author: sk372
source: The expulsion of smoke that propels POKENAME through the water takes the form of large back fins. It typically roams around the oceans near volcanic islands, particularly those with still-active volcanoes.

entry: POKENAME从翼上红热气孔放出浓烟，吓走捕食者。夜里背部气孔发亮，又能造出凶恶怪物的幻象。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME release clouds of smoke from the red-hot vents on their wings to scare away predators. At night, the vents on their back glow and create the illusion of a menacing monster.

entry: POKENAME能操纵耳中蒸气，形成实体屏障。多余烟从核心涌出，周围始终薄雾弥漫。
author: evilgammon
source: The steam vented from POKENAME's ears can be manipulated to form solid barriers. Excess smoke pours from its core, creating a constant haze around it.

entry: POKENAME头上不停冒烟。为保护肺部，建议训练家将它留在精灵球中。
author: hophoppip
source: Smoke billows out from its head at all times. POKENAME Trainers are advised to keep it in its Poké Ball for the safety of their lungs.

entry: 战前，POKENAME尾火烧到白炽，喷出遮眼浓烟，再以灼热余烬攻击。
author: .izik
source: Before battle, POKENAME's tail flame burns white-hot. It spits blinding smoke to obscure its foe, then strikes with searing embers.

entry: 这种宝可梦很难驯养，脾气急，稍不顺心就横冲直撞。平静后，却又深深后悔自己发火。
author: quackquackattack
source: Domestication of this Pokémon is difficult, as it has a short temper and is prone to run amok over the slightest inconvenience. Once it calms down, it expresses deep remorse over its lost temper.

entry: POKENAME不能自己挖煤，必须靠人和其他宝可梦喂食维生。煤灰污染栖身河海，除其他鲤鱼王外，任何宝可梦都无法居住。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME is unable to dig up coal for itself, so other Pokémon and people must hand it food for its survival. The soot it creates pollutes the rivers and oceans that it lives in, making them unlivable for any Pokémon except for other Magikarp.

entry: 受攻击时，POKENAME释放浓厚烟雾，其中有弱毒，刺激皮肤与眼睛。
author: mepp.
source: When under attack, POKENAME releases plumes of thick smog. This smoke contains a weak poison that irritates the skin and eyes.

entry: POKENAME在城镇横行，将其变成满是灰烬浓烟的荒地。使出喷火，一击便能熔毁整片街区。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME rampages through towns, turning them into ashy, smoke-filled wastelands. The Eruption it launches can completely melt away entire neighborhoods in one blow.

entry: POKENAME必须吃煤，供跨海旅程所需，通常住在火山岛。虽偏爱暖水，POKENAME载人穿过最冰冷海域，也毫无问题。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME have to eat coal to fuel their journeys across oceans, typically living on islands with volcanoes. Despite their preference for warm waters, POKENAME have no issue with ferrying people through the iciest of seas.

entry: 它吃煤和其他材料，头顶就冒出阵阵烟。烟云会化成其他宝可梦的模样，甚至模仿举止，再消散。
author: sk372
source: As it consumes coal and other materials, puffs of smoke rise from its head. The clouds shift into the shapes of other Pokémon, even mimicking their behavior before dissipating.

entry: POKENAME尾里燃着烈火，健康最佳时，火会在岩石般坚硬的尾壳内，亮得灿烂。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's tail holds a fiercely burning fire. When in peak health, the flames glow brilliantly inside its rock-hard tail casing.

entry: POKENAME靠吃电脑系统里的煤炭图片，制造烟雾。但若认不出那张煤炭图的格式，哪怕数日未进食，它也不肯吃。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME creates its smoke by feeding off of images of coals inside of computer systems. However, if it can't discern the image format of the picture of coal, it will refuse to eat the image even if it hasn't eaten in days.

entry: POKENAME多住在海滩或火山周边水域。遭遇敌人，就先放毒烟，再匆匆爬回水里。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME tend to live on beaches or in the waters surrounding volcanoes. If confronted, they release toxic smog before scurrying back into the water.

entry: POKENAME战斗时，从鼻孔喷浓烟，遮住自己，取得优势。它偏爱煤与其他矿物丰富的洞穴。
author: mepp.
source: During battle, POKENAME blows thick smoke from its nostrils to obscure itself and gain an advantage over its foes. It prefers to live in caves rich with coal and other minerals.

entry: POKENAME越长越大，吹出的煤灰也越多，必须不停吃煤、燃煤维生。持续耗能又需要煤，因此野外数量很少。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME blows out lots of soot as it grows larger, meaning it must continuously eat and burn coal to survive. This constant use of energy and need for coal is why so few exist in the wild.

entry: POKENAME体表球状部位，定期排出大量蒸气，调节温度。据说，在它栖身的火山区，看见它威风地游过熔岩，是好运征兆。
author: sk372
source: The orbs on POKENAME's body regularly vent out large amounts of steam in order to regulate its temperature. Seeing it majestically swim through lava in the volcanic regions it inhabits is said to be a sign of good fortune.

entry: 野生POKENAME爱住煤矿丰富、山峦起伏的偏远岛屿。它用烟讯，引导迷航水手，远离危险礁石和猛烈风暴。
author: soup1900
source: Wild POKENAME enjoy living on mountainous remote islands rich with coal. They create smoke signals to guide lost sailors away from dangerous rocks or violent storms.

entry: 每天一块煤，就足够这只宝可梦吃饱。它整天卧在精神力量维系的烟云上，慢慢啃煤。
author: infinex21
source: One piece of coal a day is enough to keep this Pokémon fed. It will nibble on the coal all day while lounging on a cloud of smoke held together with its psychic powers.

entry: POKENAME仅靠体内燃煤得到的能量与烟气，就能进行光合作用。因此，仍能使出强力日光束。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME can photosynthesize just by feeding off the energy and fumes it gets from burning coal within its body. For this reason, it can still unleash powerful Solar Beams.

entry: POKENAME能从背壳突然喷出烈火，常用来威吓。可惜，不但会产生浓烟，也会让它疲惫很久。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME can release intense fire from the shells on their backs in sudden bursts, which they often do to intimidate others. Unfortunately, this act not only produces thick smog, but also exhausts them for quite some time.

entry: POKENAME的壳硬如玄武岩，却很少像身体其他部位一样热。它能控制火烟释放，远远投火攻击时，也能遮掩动作。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's shell is as hard as basalt, yet it rarely ever feels as hot as the rest of its body is. It can control the release of its flames' smoke, allowing it to conceal its movements as it pelts foes with flames from afar.

entry: POKENAME用煤块和焦枝装饰巢。战斗时，羽毛会放出大片浓黑烟云。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME decorates its nest with pieces of coal and burnt twigs. When battling, its feathers release a thick cloud of dark smoke.

entry: POKENAME偏爱海滩附近的暖水，只为吃煤上岸。颚虽强，POKENAME却不爱在陆上冲突，会先喷烟，再跑回水里。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME's preferred habitats are warm waters near beaches, only going on land to eat coal. Despite having strong jaws, POKENAME prefer to avoid conflict on land, emitting smog before running back into water.

entry: POKENAME常欺负较小宝可梦，逼它们收集食物。烦躁时，会急速排热，让周围温度飙升，超过50℃。
author: turron_turron
source: POKENAME often bully smaller Pokémon into collecting food for them. When irritated, they rapidly expel heat, causing ambient temperatures to soar upwards of 50°C.

entry: POKENAME的丝，连最冷气候也能散暖，常被用作登山者昂贵睡袋的内衬。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME's threads can radiate warmth, even in the coldest of climates. They are often used to line the inside of expensive Sleeping Bags for mountaineers.

entry: POKENAME在火山崖顶筑巢，用高温孵蛋。孵出后，就喂雏鸟熔岩，直到它们会飞。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME makes nests atop volcano cliffs because the high temperatures help incubate its eggs. After the eggs hatch, it feeds its chicks molten rocks until they are able to fly.

entry: POKENAME住在火山附近，吃熔岩。碰水会迅速降温，因此它放出电脉冲，汽化水，避免接触。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME lives near volcanoes and eats molten rocks. Contact with water rapidly reduces its body temperature, so it will send out a pulse of electricity to vaporize and avoid contact with water.

entry: POKENAME从石质身体的气孔，排烟和热气飞行。一发现烟让谁难受，就会立刻停飞，哪怕这样会伤到自己。
author: staghorn
source: POKENAME flies by emitting smoke and hot gas from vents in its stony body. It will immediately stop flying if it sees that its smoke is causing someone distress, even if it would injure itself by doing so.

entry: POKENAME喷出一阵阵烟，助推前进，弥补弱小的飞行能力。陷入深思，喙中便会冒汽。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME unleashes bursts of smoke to boost it along and make up for its meager flight capabilities. Puffs of steam come from its beak whenever it is deep in thought.

entry: POKENAME释放巨大烟云前，会稳住身体，扛住内部强压。有些智者，能从POKENAME的烟读出未来。
author: ambrosia04
source: Before releasing a massive, billowing cloud, POKENAME braces itself to withstand the intense pressure within its body. Some sages can read the future from a POKENAME's smoke.

entry: 对POKENAME而言，毛皮脏是健康的标志。毛里的煤灰，能赶走电电虫等烦人虫宝可梦。
author: mepp.
source: For POKENAME, having a dirty coat is a sign of good health. The soot in its coat keeps pesky bug Pokémon like Joltik away.

entry: POKENAME涌出的烟比空气轻，让它能随风漂游。微量灰烬落进土里当肥料，使植物即使酷热也能茁壮。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME billow out smoke that's lighter than air, allowing them to drift along the wind. They scatter trace amounts of ash into soil to act as fertilizer, helping plants grow strong even under intense heat.

entry: POKENAME产生吸水白烟，有效化解针对它的水攻。它会漫步海滩和湖边，欣赏自然美景。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME produces a white smoke that absorbs moisture, which effectively neutralizes water used against it. It is known to wander beaches and lakes where it absorbs the beauty of the natural world.

entry: POKENAME从身体排白烟，吸收接触到的一切水分。它住在湖边，常一连数小时欣赏风景。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME pumps out white smoke from its body, which absorbs moisture from anything it touches. It can be found near lakes where it admires the scenery for long hours at a time.

entry: POKENAME独自很弱，靠烟讯与族群交流。尾巴喷出的烟形，会提醒同伴具体有何危险。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME is weak on its own, so it relies on smoke signals to communicate with its flock. The shape of the smoke it emits from its tail warns its flock of specific dangers.

entry: POKENAME进行过于复杂的推理或计算，头饰就冒出滚滚黑烟。它多住火山区，用耐心与智慧，引导、帮助年轻宝可梦。
author: fiordaliso
source: If POKENAME engages in overly complex reasoning or calculations, the headpiece on its head emits thick plumes of black smoke. It tends to live in volcanic regions, where it uses its patience and wisdom to guide and assist younger Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME智力很高，在野外担任年轻宝可梦的导师，以心灵感应传授生存技巧。每有一个念头，头烟就更浓。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME is highly intelligent and acts as a tutor to younger Pokémon in the wild, using telepathy to instruct them on survival tactics. The smoke from its head gets denser with every thought it has.

entry: POKENAME发育中的身体，产出过量蒸气，从壳内排出。不断产汽、排汽，让它疲惫懒散。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's developing body causes it to create an excessive amount of steam vented from within its shell. The constant production and subsequent expulsion of steam leaves it tired and lethargic.

entry: POKENAME燃烧火山岛找到的煤，供养背上火山般的花苞，能阵阵喷出带火的花粉。
author: zgaroff
source: Fueled by the burning coal it finds on volcanic islands, POKENAME nurtures a volcanic bulb on its back that releases bursts of fiery pollen.

entry: POKENAME固定住沉重、铁般坚硬的壳，用炉般的身体产生巨大反向压力，抵住攻击。挨打时，气孔喷出超热蒸气，以爆发高热，将伤害还给对手。
author: msdawgs
source: POKENAME anchors its heavy, iron-hard shell in place, using a furnace-like body to generate overwhelming counter-pressure against enemy attacks. When struck, it blasts superheated steam from its vents, returning the damage with explosive heat.

entry: POKENAME是火山区的温和巨兽，通常离人类聚居地不远，很少活动。它友好得甚至让其他生物，把自己热汽腾腾的身体当临时桑拿。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a gentle giant living a very sedentary lifestyle in volcanic regions, usually not far from human civilization. It is friendly enough that it even allows others to use its hot, steaming body as a makeshift sauna.

entry: POKENAME住在多雾山顶，雾气帮助降温。它容易兴奋，若吃得好，能让区域迅速热到不舒服。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME live on foggy mountain peaks where the mist helps keep their body temperature down. They are easily excitable and, if well fed, can cause an area to heat up rapidly to uncomfortable levels.

entry: POKENAME硬钢般的拳，也储存着热能。挨一拳很痛，被它攥住，却更难受。
author: bandedbodypress
source: The hardened steel of POKENAME's fists also houses its thermal energy. Being punched by it hurts, but its grasp is so much worse.

entry: POKENAME在山里生活艰辛，不停往返火山区与森林，找煤和果实维生。据说POKENAME一天，只能休息一小时。
author: catnip2390
source: POKENAME live a rough life in the mountains, constantly traveling between volcanic areas and forests in search of coal and fruit to sustain their bodies. It is said that POKENAME can only rest for one hour per day.

entry: POKENAME熔岩般的身体外覆着壳，很少移动。它把头探出壳洞进食，顺便从孔隙排出多余蒸气。
author: sk372
source: Due to the shell over its magma-like body, POKENAME rarely moves. It sticks its head out from the holes in the shell in order to feed and vent excess steam from its pores.

entry: 它是记录中最慢的宝可梦之一。POKENAME即使全速走满24小时，最多也不过十英尺。
author: sk372
source: It is one of the slowest-moving Pokémon recorded; a POKENAME moving at top speed for 24 hours would travel only a scant ten feet at best.

entry: POKENAME沿活火山温暖的崖壁筑巢。受惊就一边逃，一边从尾部喷浓烟。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME nests along the warm cliffs of active volcanoes. When frightened, it releases thick smoke from its tail as it flees.

entry: POKENAME找到什么，都用来给壳内的火当燃料，让呼出的烟剧毒。它独居火山区，藏在无人打扰的地方。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME will use anything it can find to fuel the fire in its shell, causing the smoke it exhales to be heavily toxic. It is a reclusive Pokémon, hiding away in volcanic regions where no one will disturb it.

entry: POKENAME能拖动卡车般重的货物，在岩石般硬皮下燃煤蓄压。冲锋时，超热烟从鼻孔喷出，释放储存的能量。
author: moga6
source: A POKENAME can drag loads as heavy as trucks while burning coal inside its rock-hard hide to build pressure. When it charges, superheated smoke blasts from its nostrils, releasing the stored energy.

entry: POKENAME的处理系统承受压力时，会以猛烈火焰排出余能。因此，研究员和训练家，都得格外仔细留意它的需求。
author: mepp.
source: When POKENAME's processing systems are under stress, it vents excess energy as powerful bursts of flame. Researchers and Trainers alike must take great care in monitoring the needs of this Pokémon as a result.

entry: POKENAME的蛋，总是煮得恰到好处的温泉蛋。因为与温泉有关，POKENAME在釜炎镇十分受欢迎。
author: musicsheep.
source: POKENAME's eggs are always perfectly boiled hot spring eggs. POKENAME is extremely popular in Lavaridge Town, due to its hot springs association.

entry: 它背着极重的壳，移动时积热，蒸气便从身体孔洞涌出。使出泰山压顶，会用重壳将敌人压扁。
author: infinex21
source: It carries a very heavy shell upon its back, with steam pouring from openings in its body due to the heat that builds up when it moves. Its Body Slam attacks utilize its heavy shell to crush and flatten foes.

entry: POKENAME用尾巴弹跳，几乎不停排出干净白烟与灰烬，这是体内极高温度所致。饮食差的POKENAME，烟可能更黑，显得不那么洁净。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME bounce about on their tail, which nearly constantly emits a clean, white cloud of smoke and ash. This is due to their incredibly high internal temperature. POKENAME that have poor diets may have darker, less clean-looking smoke.

entry: POKENAME带着灿烂笑容弹跳，从头顶黑壳排出阵阵白烟。体内炉火温暖小身体，准备把袭来的攻击，用力弹回。
author: msdawgs
source: POKENAME vents puffs of white smoke from the dark shell on its head while bouncing with a cheerful grin. It uses its internal furnace to warm its small body, preparing to forcefully bounce back any incoming attacks.

entry: 传闻POKENAME的蒸气能让人看见自身未来，因此人们来蒸汽浴，求得预言。它读心，在人脑中展现好结局，再吃下由此产生的快乐情绪。
author: pjporwoll
source: The steam emanating from POKENAME is rumored to give visions of one's future, so people get steam baths made by it to receive prophecies. It reads their minds, then feeds off of their happy emotions when it puts positive outcomes into their heads.

entry: POKENAME在山里试着用磁力吸煤。可煤不带磁性，只吸来大堆别的矿物。于是POKENAME改与矿工交换，拿矿物换煤。
author: darkweavile428
source: POKENAME spends its time in the mountains attempting to use its magnetism to gather coal. Unfortunately, coal is not magnetic, and it ends up with loads of other minerals instead. POKENAME then trades these minerals with miners in exchange for coal.

entry: POKENAME住在火山区，大吃各种矿物。受威胁时，会从掌心孔洞喷出滚滚浓烟。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME inhabits volcanic regions, feasting on a variety of minerals. When threatened, it spews heavy plumes of smoke from the holes in its palms.

entry: POKENAME常在善待工人的煤矿附近，收集剩煤。据说能察觉纷争，不烧受虐工人挖的煤。矿工会带着有它形象的信物，当作好运象征。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME loiter around coal mines with ethical employment practices, gathering leftover coal. It is said that they can detect strife and don't burn coal mined by mistreated workers. Miners carry tokens depicting POKENAME as an icon of good luck.

entry: POKENAME敏捷惊人。奔跑的气流，让体内炉火烧得更热，耳尾喷出浓烟，如疾驰的蒸汽机车。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME possesses incredible agility. As it sprints, the rushing air causes its internal furnace to burn hotter, venting  thick plumes of smog from its ears and tail like a speeding steam engine.

entry: 它的尾巴强得能撑起重身，但这时排出的蒸气与烟，也会变成两倍。缩入壳，再从尾部喷出热与火，便能以火箭般速度推进。
author: infinex21
source: Its tail is strong enough to hold up its heavy body, though it vents twice as much steam and smoke when it does this. By withdrawing into its shell and expelling heat and fire from its tail, it can propel itself with the speed of a rocket.

entry: POKENAME通过头上羽毛般的气孔，调节体温，避免过热。常能看见它高兴地吃木炭。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME regulates internal body temperature through the feather-like vents on its head to avoid overheating. This Pokémon is often seen joyfully eating charcoal.

entry: POKENAME能吃各种有机和无机材料，维持体内火焰。食物种类与品质，可从烟看出；有些会让烟里多出许多灰与火花。
author: corra_universe
source: POKENAME can consume various organic and inorganic materials to maintain its internal flames. The type and quality of the food can be seen in the smoke as some foods can cause the smoke to contain larger amounts of ash and sparks.

entry: 这种宝可梦大半天都在找煤，供体内火燃烧。察觉威胁，POKENAME就吐黑烟，再用强腿跳向安全处。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: This Pokémon spends the majority of its day in search of coal to fuel its fire. When it feels threatened, POKENAME will exhale a cloud of black smoke before using its powerful legs to jump to a safer location.

entry: POKENAME常在铁路调车场，快速抬起、搬动车厢和火车头。只要喂足煤，POKENAME就能把满载的10节列车推离轨道，送往目的地，毫不费力。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME are often utilized at rail yards to quickly lift up and move around train cars and locomotives. As long as POKENAME are fed lots of coal, they can push a loaded 10-car train off the tracks to their destination without sweat.

entry: POKENAME头里的火以煤为燃料，感到正面情绪，就烧得明亮清澈。察觉敌意，则喷出浓黑烟，让POKENAME趁机使出瞬间移动。
author: .jerden
source: The fire in POKENAME's head is fueled by coal and burns bright and clear when it senses positivity. If it senses hostility, it will spew out thick black smoke, giving POKENAME the opportunity to Teleport away.

entry: 周围的人兴奋，POKENAME的火就烧得更热。战斗时如舞者旋转，用体内炉火产生的烟云与闪动热浪，遮住身形。
author: .jerden
source: If people around it are excited, POKENAME's fire will burn hotter. In battle, it spins like a dancer, cloaking itself with clouds of smoke and shimmering heat haze produced by its internal furnaces.

entry: POKENAME双臂各有强劲煤炉，一察觉战斗将至，就会升温。肘部喷烟太浓，POKENAME甚至能将其塑成实体刀刃。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's arms each contain a powerful coal-fired furnace, which increases in temperature whenever it senses that battle is imminent. The smoke that spews out at its elbows is so thick that POKENAME can form it into solid blades.

entry: POKENAME感到危险，就立刻从壳中冒烟，提醒同伴找掩护。全身有剧毒角与倒刺，用来抵御捕食者。
author: fiordaliso
source: When POKENAME senses danger, it immediately puffs smoke from its shell to warn its companions to take cover. Its body is covered in highly venomous horns and barbs, which it uses to defend itself from predators.

entry: POKENAME在活火山温暖的崖边筑巢，背上不停排出一道道烟。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME nest near the warm cliffs of active volcanoes. They release trails of smoke from their backs constantly.

entry: 这些地底宝可梦，用消化煤产生的热与烟推进。把头缩进坚实玄武岩壳，就能轻松扛住大多数攻击。
author: infinex21
source: These underground Pokémon propel themselves with heat and smoke, both of which come from when they digest coal within themselves. By withdrawing their heads into their shells of solid basalt, they can endure most attacks with ease.

entry: POKENAME借双臂的开放孔口，从掌心迅速吞入可燃物，在臂内燃烧，产生能量。POKENAME还会喷热与烟，推动自己。
author: infinex21
source: By utilizing the open ports on POKENAME's arms, it can quickly consume combustible materials through its palms; as these materials are burned within its arms, POKENAME generates energy for itself. It will fire out heat and smoke to propel itself.

entry: POKENAME吃煤与硫磺，在体内火焰中燃烧供能。“消化”时，敞开、泛红的孔口会喷出烟火。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME eat coal and sulfur, which are burned within their inner flames to produce energy for themselves. As they "digest" their food, they exude smoke and flames from their open, glowing-red ports.

entry: 它把脸的影像投进蒸气，却和烟一样，没有实体。古代丰缘人会在附近烧香，相信它与祖先灵魂相连。
author: sk372
source: It projects an image of its face within the steam it expels, but this is just as incorporeal as the smoke. In olden Hoenn times people would burn incense near it, believing it held connections to their ancestors' spirits.

entry: POKENAME极其兴奋，就从背孔喷出黑烟云。遇见什么都啃，保持牙齿锋利清洁。
author: fiordaliso
source: When it gets extremely excited, POKENAME blows clouds of dark smoke out of the hole in its back. It keeps its teeth sharp and clean by gnawing on whatever objects it comes across.

entry: POKENAME的巨颚不停涌烟，必须持续排放，免得毒素在体内累积。对战时，巨颚能喷出火热熔岩，也能咬住对手。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME constantly billows out smoke from its massive jaws, which needs to be constantly vented to prevent toxic accumulation in its body. In Pokémon battles, its massive jaws can shoot out fiery plumes of lava, or bite onto its opponent.

entry: POKENAME头上浓烟不散，从没人见过真容。它坐在温泉里，只露出头。
author: cait_sith
source: Due to the thick smoke pouring out of its head, nobody has ever seen POKENAME's face. It sits in hot springs with only its head above the surface.

entry: POKENAME蒸发的水盐分很高，因此烟带海味。靠身体底部排汽的压力，不知如何，竟能稳稳悬在半空。
author: dukefrogpeasant
source: The smoke excreted by POKENAME smells like the sea, as the water it evaporates is very saline. With the pressure of the steam exhausted from the bottom of its body, it somehow manages to float mid-air just fine.

entry: 野生POKENAME会与同类冲锋撞头。碰撞后，头部如火山喷发，让头锤威力更强。
author: bandedbodypress
source: It will charge and butt heads with other POKENAME in the wild. After their heads collide, they will propel a volcanic burst from their head, making their Headbutt much more powerful.

entry: POKENAME用壳与头部的受控爆炸，增强头锤，也借爆炸控制冲锋方向，突然转弯，也不减冲势。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME uses controlled explosions on its shell and head to power its Headbutt. These explosions also control the direction of its charge, letting it make sudden turns without losing momentum.

entry: POKENAME的香炉，不停释放无味怪烟。许多人误以为它是灾兆，史料却记载，它只在悲剧已发生后出现。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's censers perpetually release a strange smoke that has no scent. Although many mistake its presence as an omen of disaster, historical accounts note it only arrives after tragedy has struck.

entry: POKENAME缓缓漂过火山和沙漠。烈箭鹰等火属性鸟宝可梦，喜欢在POKENAME的烟云里筑巢。
author: amberaxolotl223
source: POKENAME drift slowly above volcanoes and deserts. Talonflame and other Fire-type bird Pokémon like to nest within the clouds of POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME背上的火山偶尔喷发，熔岩倾泻而出。部分落回身上冷却，形成坚固板片，充当临时护甲。
author: evilgammon
source: On occasion, the volcano on POKENAME's back erupts, sending magma cascading out. Some of this magma settles on it and cools, creating sturdy plates that function as makeshift protective armour.

entry: POKENAME壳里藏着熔岩，气孔喷出热灰。它住在炎热干旱的气候中，因为空气中的任何水分，都会令它剧痛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME houses molten rock in its shell and spews hot ash from its vents. It is found in hot, arid climates, as any moisture in the air causes it great pain.

entry: POKENAME背上火山般的构造，会定期喷发，维持健康。留下的灰，能极大滋养植物。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: The volcanic structure on POKENAME's back erupts periodically to maintain its health. The ashes left behind are incredibly fertile for plant life.

entry: POKENAME敏捷顽皮，在废弃豪宅的屋梁间荡行。冷了便嚼旧木保暖。
author: .izik
source: Agile and mischievous, POKENAME swings through the rafters of abandoned mansions. It chews on old wood to warm itself when cold.

entry: POKENAME用排烟制造烟幕，迷惑敌人，再借甲上裂缝与凹坑，接住、挡开对手的攻击。
author: staghorn
source: A POKENAME uses its emissions to create smokescreens and bamboozle its foes. It uses the cracks and craters in its armor to catch attacks and parry its opponent's blows.

entry: 它把头探出石质身体，进食或释放大量蒸气。丰缘一些度假村，会雇它参与桑拿设施。
author: sk372
source: It pokes its head out of the stone body in order to eat or release large amounts of steam. Some resorts in Hoenn have taken to employing them as a part of their saunas.

entry: POKENAME在钉头锤内，燃烧收集的生命能量生烟。这些灵魂随后栖入、控制烟雾，把烟当手，挥动POKENAME，为己所用。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME produces its smoke by burning collected life energy inside of its mace. These souls then inhabit and control this smoke, using it as their hand to wield POKENAME for their own purposes.

entry: POKENAME成群合作，收集大量煤供燃烧，以高压烟流，轻易切开岩石。
author: mistymagius
source: Groups of POKENAME work together to collect large amounts of coal for them to burn. They use jets of pressurized smoke to effortlessly cut through the rocks.

entry: 它们最爱煤，比起寻常矿石与石头，也更喜欢金属。兴奋、开心或生气，体内火都会更热。
author: infinex21
source: Their favorite food is coal, though they also enjoy metal more than typical ores and rocks. Their internal flames burn hotter when they are excited, happy, or angry.

entry: POKENAME的飞行方式极耗能，因此每年只醒一次，吃够再休眠51周的量。那些夜晚恶名远扬，POKENAME会突破音障，用音爆震住猎物。
author: .fedoraman
source: POKENAME's method of flight consumes a lot of energy, so it only awakens once a year, eating enough to last another 51 weeks of hibernation. These nights are infamous as POKENAME break the sound barrier and create supersonic booms to stun prey.

entry: 它们的猎物，会随季节成群婚飞，聚满夜空。这些夜晚，POKENAME醒来，火箭般冲进群体，最多吃下自身体重三倍的食物，再回巢睡一年。
author: .fedoraman
source: Their prey undergo seasonal nuptial flights, swarming in the night sky. On these nights, POKENAME awakens and rockets itself into the swarm, consuming up to three times its body weight before returning to its den and sleeping for another year.

entry: POKENAME从身体喷出缎带般的浓厚蒸气。吸入吐出的烟气，会平静下来，体内泛起暖意。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME puffs out steam from its body in the form of thick, ribbon-like clouds. Those who wind up inhaling the exhaled smoke find that it produces a calming effect and causes a feeling of warmth internally.

entry: 它想独战整群强大宝可梦。若招架不住，就蜷起身体，从壳中使出喷火。
author: bandedbodypress
source: It seeks to fight entire groups of strong Pokémon by itself. If it is ever overwhelmed, it curls over and releases an Eruption from its shell.

entry: POKENAME只以煤为食，在体内磨碎、燃烧，产生巨大能量。排出的烟尘能遮住天空，为它们争取战斗优势。
author: npshi
source: POKENAME have a diet consisting solely of coal, which they grind down and burn inside themselves to generate an immense amount of energy. POKENAME can use the soot released from within to obscure the sky, giving them an advantage in battle.

entry: POKENAME尽可能避战，会从炮管散出浓蒸气，遮住自己，更容易找地方躲到威胁过去。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME prefers to avoid conflict wherever possible. To aid in avoiding battles, it spreads thick clouds of steam from its cannon to obscure itself and make it easier to hide somewhere until the threat passes.

entry: POKENAME让物理学家和生物学家都困惑：壳太重浮不起来，却从不落地进食，还能不断涌烟。它必须不停移动才能活，也让这些问题很难研究。
author: .fedoraman
source: POKENAME is a mystery to physicists and biologists alike because its shell is too heavy to float, and it produces an unending plume of smoke without ever landing to eat. It's hard for these questions to be studied, as it must keep moving to live.

entry: POKENAME呼吸声尖锐，很容易辨认。可惜，它很容易缺矿物，导致生病，呼吸节律也极不规律。
author: jangodiot
source: POKENAME are easily recognized from the high-pitched noises created when they respire. Unfortunately, these Pokémon are quite prone to mineral deficiencies, causing illness and highly irregular breathing patterns.

entry: POKENAME住在因火灾废弃的建筑，附在天花板，吃残烟中的毒性一氧化碳，用单调哔声与同类交流。
author: milchik
source: POKENAME inhabits buildings abandoned due to fires, attaching itself to the ceilings and feeding off of poisonous carbon monoxide from the residual smoke. It communicates with others of its kind using monotonous beeping noises.

entry: 小小身体平时拖不动巨壳。POKENAME要移动，就缩入壳，用排出的蒸气推进。
author: sk372
source: Its tiny body is too small to haul its massive shell around normally. When POKENAME needs to move, it retreats into the shell and uses expelled steam to propel itself forward.

entry: POKENAME顶部不停喷出巨大烟柱。偶尔能看见迷失灵魂在烟中盘旋，这股力量又会被导入幽灵攻击。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME constantly spews a great column of smoke out of its top. Occasionally, a lost soul will be seen swirling in the smoke, which is channelled into its ghostly attacks.

entry: POKENAME从身体产生大量浓烟，是极好的户外暖炉，在露营者与徒步者间尤其受欢迎。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME produces large amounts of thick smoke from its body and is often used as an excellent outdoor heater. They seem to be most popular among campers and hikers.

entry: POKENAME老去后，会帮助牙牙、斧牙龙学习龙属性招式。传说末日降临时，POKENAME会前来扭转危局。
author: agostostino
source: When a POKENAME gets old, it helps Axew and Fraxure as they learn how to use their Dragon-type moves. Legends say that when the world ends, POKENAME will come to save the day.

entry: POKENAME老去后，会帮助牙牙、斧牙龙学习龙属性招式。传说末日降临时，POKENAME会前来扭转危局。
author: agostostino
source: When a POKENAME gets old, it helps Axew and Fraxure as they learn how to use their Dragon-type moves. Legends say that when the world ends, POKENAME will come to save the day.

entry: POKENAME从嘴里喷出手形黑灰，拦住靠近的捕食者。还会用烟在天空做手势，与附近海岸的其他POKENAME交流。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME ejects black soot in the shape of a hand from its mouth to hold back predators that near it. It can also use its smoke to create hand signals across the sky to communicate with other POKENAME across nearby shores.

entry: POKENAME体内压力越积越高，钥匙便响得越快、越大声。片刻后，滚烫蒸气爆出，足以熔化金属。
author: .izik
source: As pressure builds inside POKENAME, its keys rattle faster and louder. Moments later, scalding steam erupts, capable of melting metal.

entry: POKENAME壳上的烟升起，在身后形成九条尾巴。谁试着碰，就会惹怒POKENAME，突然从孔隙喷出大量蒸气。
author: sk372
source: Smoke from POKENAME's shell rises up to form a group of nine tails behind it. Attempting to touch these tails results in POKENAME suddenly blasting a large amount of steam from its pores in anger.

entry: POKENAME唱歌时，壳上会升起浓厚催眠烟。露营者曾把鼾声误当火山轰鸣，撤离当地，巡护员却只发现它安稳做梦。
author: jaminmcready
source: When POKENAME sings, puffs of thick, hypnotic smoke rise from its shell. Campers once mistook its snores for volcanic rumblings and evacuated the area, only for the rangers to find it dreaming peacefully.

entry: 这些宝可梦开心放白烟，生气放黑烟，爱吃可燃物与原矿。排出的残渣，常带微量精炼金属。
author: infinex21
source: When happy, these Pokémon release white smoke and when angry they release black smoke. They love to eat flammable materials and raw ores. Their refuse often contains traces of refined metals.

entry: 它们准备冲锋，就释放热烟，嗅煤本领敏锐，是矿工的常见伙伴。
author: infinex21
source: They release hot smoke when they prepare to charge forward. They have a keen sense of smell for coal, making them common allies to miners.

entry: POKENAME会在火山周围的熔岩湖中游泳。体内蒸汽机，把熔岩强热转成能量。
author: camtft
source: POKENAME are found swimming within lava lakes around volcanoes. Their internal steam engine converts the intense heat of the lava into energy.

entry: 齿轮缓慢却稳定地转动，供给生命能量，同时冒出小缕烟。有人觉得，声音像蒸汽机缓慢的隆隆声。
author: sk372
source: Its gears churn slowly but steadily to give it life energy, releasing small bits of smoke as it does so. Some liken the sound it makes to the slow chug of a steam engine.

entry: 旋转齿轮产生蒸气，散去余热。主齿轮在内部蓄积强压，释放时，就将其他齿轮向前射出，保护自己。
author: sk372
source: The spinning gears generate steam to dissipate excess heat. The main gear stores intense pressure within, releasing it to launch the other gears forward in self-defense.

entry: 壳状外罩里的火关乎生命，因此POKENAME尽量节省尾部燃煤。愤怒时，会比平时烧得更快，保持旺火。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME burns as little coal as possible in its tail, as the fire inside its shell-like casing dictates its life. When it becomes angry, it burns coal at a faster rate than usual, which it needs to keep its fire blazing.

entry: POKENAME受威胁，灰玫瑰就会放出烟与灰。采蜜人常用它，因为烟似乎能防大针蜂躁动。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's grey roses release clouds of smoke and ash when POKENAME feels threatened. They are often used by honey collectors as their smoke seems to prevent Beedrill from becoming agitated.

entry: POKENAME拔出胡萝卜，吹小火苗烤熟，再高兴地吃。睡觉时，耳朵会冒出小火焰。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uproots carrots and blows tiny embers over them to roast the vegetables before happily eating its meal. When sleeping, it will expel small flames from its ears.

entry: POKENAME的叶子极辣，世代在丰缘料理中备受珍视。厨师用来丰富特制炖菜的滋味。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's leaves are intensely spicy and have been prized in Hoenn cuisine for generations. Chefs use them to enrich special stews.

entry: POKENAME聚到火山吃熔岩，释放消化时积起的烟。受威胁，就吐火球，吓走捕食者。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME flocks to volcanoes to eat molten rocks, and releases smoke that builds up while digesting rocks. When threatened, it spits out balls of fire to scare away predators.

entry: POKENAME的许多尖刺，能帮助它附在岩石表面。有时会住进烟囱，吃向上飘的煤灰。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's many spikes help it attach to rocky surfaces. It can be occasionally seen inhabiting chimneys, feeding on the soot that drifts up.

entry: POKENAME体内不停漏出毒蒸气，触角也在发热。煤吃得越多，烟就越浓、越致命。
author: .izik
source: Toxic steam constantly leaks from POKENAME's body as its antennae grow hot. The more coal it consumes, the denser and deadlier the fumes become.

entry: 捕食者想抓POKENAME，它就释放滚烫浓烟防御。它在干旱或炎热地区筑巢，因为太冷会陷入长久休眠。
author: fiordaliso
source: If a predator tries to catch it, POKENAME releases thick plumes of scorching smoke as a defensive measure. It builds its nest in arid or hot regions, since temperatures that are too cold would send it into a long hibernation.

entry: 它从鼻孔排出大量烟，推动身体，让跳跃更远。烟形似翅膀，令POKENAME仿佛在飞。
author: sk372
source: It lengthens the distance of its leaps by expelling vast amounts of smoke from its nostrils to propel it further. The smoke takes on an appearance similar to wings, making POKENAME appear to be flying.

entry: POKENAME用鼻中蒸气推动身体，极速穿过空中。但储量有限，常见它在地面休眠，等待体内积起更多蒸气。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME vents steam from its nose to propel itself extremely fast through the air. Its supply is limited though, so it is often seen dormant on the ground while more steam builds inside itself.

entry: POKENAME在领地奔跑，靠吃煤保持充沛精力。背上的坑穴，排出余热与有毒烟雾。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME consumes coal to keep its energy high as it gallops around its territory. The craters on its back vent excess heat and poisonous smog.

entry: POKENAME一吼，几缕小蒸气就会增强，合成一道喷泉般的烟柱。它常想打破自己的吼声与喷发威力纪录。
author: sk372
source: When POKENAME lets out a roar, the small plumes of steam it releases intensify into a singular geyser of smoke. It often tries to beat its own personal record for roar and eruption power.

entry: 考古学家认为，POKENAME可能曾是古代火山区的霸主。长颈、强颚、坚壳与造烟本领，让它成为强大的史前猎手。
author: sk372
source: Archaeologists believe POKENAME may have been the apex being within ancient volcanic regions. A long neck, powerful jaws, a sturdy shell and smoke production all combined to make it a formidable prehistoric hunter.

entry: POKENAME的叶，由密实温灰构成。每月一次，叶子会“脱落”，在地上化成灰堆。随后，它埋进去，等新叶长出。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's leaves are made of a tightly packed warm ash. Once a month, the leaves "shed" into a dusty pile on the ground. It buries itself into the pile afterward and waits for a new set of leaves to grow back.

entry: 音乐节拍越快，POKENAME头顶的蒸气就越浓。这种自然反应，让它在俱乐部很受欢迎，充当活体高级烟雾机。
author: jaminmcready
source: The steam that comes of the head of POKENAME becomes thicker as the beat of the music becomes faster. This natural process makes it a popular sight in clubs, where it serves as a living, high-grade smoke machine.

entry: POKENAME双臂藏在浓蒸气中，拍手让水汽带上静电，浓云却仍遮得双手看不见。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME's arms are hidden by dense steam. It claps to charge the vapor with static, though its hands remain invisible through the thick cloud.

entry: POKENAME轻轻摇摆，防止身体放出浓密的烟。这样能维护空气质量与周围生物健康，尤其照顾呼吸困难者。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME gently sways around to prevent thickly packed smoke from being released from its body. This is done to maintain the air quality and health of those around it, especially those who may have breathing problems.

entry: POKENAME以烟翼飞行，十分胆小，更爱藏进烟幕避开冲突，而非迎战。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME flies through the air on wings made of smoke. It is very timid and tends to avoid conflict by hiding in smokescreens rather than engaging in battle.

entry: POKENAME不停产烟，把猎物吓出洞。猎物一离巢，POKENAME就释放炽热烟气，当场烤熟。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: POKENAME constantly produces smoke, which it uses to scare prey out from their burrows. As prey leaves its burrow, POKENAME releases blazingly hot fumes, cooking its prey instantly.

entry: POKENAME蒸气的硫磺味，赶走大多数人。但能忍受者，找到了用它滚烫石板烹饪的方法。
author: hophoppip
source: Though the sulfurous scent of its steam repels most people, those who can tolerate the odor have found ways to use POKENAME's hot stony plate to cook food.

entry: 它越开心，尾巴排出的蒸气就越多。训练家抱得太紧，POKENAME也可能喷出过量蒸气。
author: sk372
source: It belts out increasing amounts of steam from its tail depending on how happy it is. POKENAME may also release excessive steam if hugged too hard by its Trainer.

entry: POKENAME吃下的煤，会加热头周围的壳。它使出的水属性攻击滚烫，很容易造成烫伤。
author: chibitales
source: The shell surrounding POKENAME's head is heated by the coal it consumes. Water-type attacks from this Pokémon are scalding hot and likely to cause burns.

entry: POKENAME在温泉周围岩石挖洞，休息时保暖。受惊，就从壳缝喷出滚滚蒸气。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME carve dens out of the rocks surrounding hot springs to keep themselves warm while they rest. If startled, they blast out plumes of steam from the cracks in their shells.

entry: 天冷得冻鼻，POKENAME就在明火上烤坚果和点心。人和宝可梦都围着火，暖暖地待在一起。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME roasts nuts and treats on an open fire when frost nips at people's noses. People and Pokémon alike cozy up by its fire, helping everyone keep warm.

entry: 它壳旁的烟，其实是浓密的滚烫孢子。休息时缩进壳，再用更多孢子遮住自己。
author: infinex21
source: The smoke around its shell is actually dense plumes of hot spores. It will withdraw into its shell when it rests, veiling itself with even more of these spores.

entry: POKENAME的壳提高防御，却拖慢速度。因此，它能扛住大多数野生宝可梦的攻击，而不必逃跑。
author: erudite_phoenix
source: The shell of POKENAME increases its defense in exchange for lower speed, allowing it to endure most attacks from other wild Pokémon rather than fleeing.

entry: POKENAME必须持续吃煤，维持鲜艳体色。可POKENAME常吃下任何像煤的东西，不少训练家只好把误食沥青的它，送进宝可梦中心。
author: beetlething
source: POKENAME must be fed coals consistently in order to retain its vibrant colors. POKENAME will often eat anything that looks like coal, which leads many Trainers to take POKENAME to the Pokémon Center because it has ingested asphalt.

entry: POKENAME温顺却强大，能制造最高摄氏650度的巨大热浪。岩石身体浸入熔岩储能，再由宝石放出亮光，据说能治愈百病。
author: aurange
source: POKENAME is a docile, yet powerful Pokémon capable of producing vast heat waves up to 650° Celsius. They store energy by submerging their rocky bodies in lava, then expel it through their gemstones as gleaming light that is said to cure any illness.

entry: POKENAME成群聚在流动熔岩旁蓄能。平时被动，受扰或威胁就会暴怒。传说，一个曾经繁荣的村庄惹怒它们，连山体本身，都烧了三天三夜。
author: aurange
source: POKENAME gather in groups at active lava flows to store energy. If disturbed or threatened, the normally passive Pokémon become enraged. Legend says a once-thriving village angered them, and the mountain itself burned for three days and three nights.

entry: POKENAME用浓烟云遮住弱点。起风，就会找地方躲，保持烟幕完整。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME surrounds itself in a cloud of thick smoke that obscures its weak points. If the wind is blowing, it will take shelter to keep its shroud intact.

entry: POKENAME大耳朵涌出浓烟，焦木气味沿森林小径与火山坡飘散。它爱吃树上掉的小枝。
author: .izik
source: Thick smoke pours from POKENAME's large ears, carrying the distinct scent of burnt wood through forest paths and volcanic slopes. It snacks on small twigs that fall from trees.

entry: POKENAME煤吃饱，就有货运列车般的力量，能拖重货。找煤时，厚甲能弹开可能掉来的岩石和碎屑。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME can pull heavy cargo with the strength of a freight train while it's full on coal. Its heavy plating deflects away rocks and other debris that may fall onto it while it's searching for coal.

entry: POKENAME体温持续高得能熔钢，不断散热，也让POKENAME很难与其他物种相处。
author: ruben2309295
source: POKENAME are known to consistently reach temperatures high enough to melt solid steel. POKENAME constantly radiate heat, which makes it difficult for them to interact with Pokémon outside of their species.

entry: 它收集煤，在覆着硬壳的身体底部燃烧。煤光明亮的孔洞，据说会为死于塌洞的迷失灵魂指路。
author: pattybgoode
source: It collects coal to burn within the base of its body, which is covered by a hard shell. The holes where the glow of coal burns brightly are said to guide lost souls who died in cave-ins.

entry: POKENAME夜唱诡异歌曲，躯干毛孔流出浓烟。烟云能化作手，抓住、缠住其他生物，拖回POKENAME巢穴。
author: sk372
source: As POKENAME sings its eerie song at night, thick smoke flows from the pores in its torso. These clouds can form into hands that can grab and ensnare others to be dragged off to POKENAME's den.

entry: 许多人发现，POKENAME有淡淡新烤面包香。身体天然温暖，很受欢迎，适合做伴。
author: mepp.
source: Many have observed that POKENAME smells faintly of freshly baked bread. Its naturally warm body makes it a popular Pokémon for companionship.

entry: POKENAME生命第一年四处游荡，再选地方定居。若在面包店筑巢，就被视为店家出色的标志。饱餐后排出的香蒸气，据说比吃下的点心还香。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME wanders for its first year before choosing a place to settle. If it nests in a bakery, it is seen as a mark of excellence. After a hearty meal, it vents fragrant steam said to smell even better than the treats it consumed.

entry: POKENAME生命第一年四处游荡，再选地方定居。若在糖果店筑巢，就被视为店家出色的标志。饱餐后排出的香蒸气，据说比吃下的点心还香。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME wanders for its first year before choosing a place to settle. If it nests in a confectionery shop, it is seen as a mark of excellence. After a hearty meal, it vents fragrant steam said to smell even better than the treats it consumed.

entry: POKENAME把煤块藏在松垮皮肤里，随时有饭吃。体内燃煤供能，每次呼吸都排热，攻击前，鼻孔会先喷烟。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME store pieces of coal within their saggy skin so that they always have a meal on hand. They burn coal within themselves for energy and vent the heat with every breath taken. They exhale smoke from their nostrils before they attack.

entry: POKENAME群体常有煤小子，头冠最大、最鲜亮的POKENAME当首领。它们一起挖煤吃，首领总分到最大块。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME often live in packs that include Torggy, with the one POKENAME that has the largest and most vibrant crest acting as the leader. They collectively mine for coal to eat, with the pack leader always being given the largest piece.
