entry: POKENAME爱躺在熔岩湖休息，头顶排汽。露营者很喜欢带POKENAME，因为头能当便携炉面。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME likes to rest in lava lakes, venting steam from the top of its head. Campers love to have POKENAME around as its head acts like a portable stovetop.

entry: POKENAME战斗时挥尾，放满浓热烟。敌人看不见、又被灼伤后，就再多烧煤，增强最后的火焰吐息，结束战斗。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME whips its tail around in battles to fill the area with thick, hot smoke. Once the foe is blinded and burned, it finishes the battle by burning more coal to power up a final fire breath attack.

entry: POKENAME觉得两人可能成对，就会吐出爱心烟。若觉得一对情侣不会长久，则送上黑煤灰做的碎心。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME will blow hearts of smoke at people it thinks could be a potential couple. On the contrary, couples it thinks aren't going to last will instead be blown broken hearts made of black soot.

entry: POKENAME能天生汲取地热，对地热发电厂很有用，例如卡洛斯的一家工厂。不过，维生仍靠煤和其他碳基材料。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME are useful in geothermal power plants, such as one located in Kalos, for their ability to naturally siphon heat from the ground. They sustain themselves on resources like coal and other carbon-based materials, however.

entry: POKENAME缺煤，就燃烧部分翅膀作燃料，久而久之留下许多洞。它喷出的燃烟，一碰就点火，蔓延极远，因此整座城市都得疏散。
author: soup1900
source: When POKENAME is low on coal, it burns parts of its wings for fuel, leaving them with many holes over time. Entire cities must evacuate when it blows out its burning smoke, as it ignites anything it touches and spreads fires over great distances.

entry: POKENAME躯干上红热的螺旋，很像炉灶。不过，不宜真当炉用，因为仰躺会暴露弱点，它会用火焰攻击自卫。
author: hophoppip
source: The red-hot spiral on POKENAME's torso brings to mind a stovetop burner. It's unwise to use POKENAME as a burner, however, as lying on its back leaves it vulnerable, and it will use fiery attacks in its defensive state.

entry: POKENAME把弃壳叠到背上，练负重。若没壳用，就可能请其他宝可梦，甚至训练家，站到身上帮忙训练。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME stacks discarded shells on its back as a form of weight training. If it lacks shells to use, it may instead request other Pokémon or even Trainers to stand on it as it works out.

entry: 它每次攻击前都会绷紧肌肉，从壳孔排烟。冒烟的孔越多，下一击就越强。
author: sk372
source: It flexes before every attack, expelling smoke from the holes in its shell as it does so. The more holes emitting smoke, the stronger the attack it's about to unleash.

entry: POKENAME曾因力量与蒸气，被视为巨大威胁。如今更常见POKENAME窝在壳里，悠闲享用热炖汤。研究确认，那汤确实美味。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME were once considered major threats due to their strength and steam. In the present, it's more common to find POKENAME lounging in their shells, enjoying a hot stew. Research has concluded that the soup is delicious.

entry: POKENAME呼出的烟，能让附近植物生长速度加倍。这种罕见强效肥料，极受植物学家觊觎。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME exhales smoke that causes nearby plants to grow twice as fast. Botanists highly covet this rare and potent fertilizer.

entry: POKENAME生气，岩石头部就喷出火车般浓烟。它会贪婪地大吃原煤块。
author: .izik
source: When angered, POKENAME's rocky head vents thick smoke like a steam train. It feeds voraciously on lumps of raw coal.

entry: POKENAME的岩壳完全中空，储存积起的火与烟。战斗时释放压力，便引起毁灭性的熔岩与烟雾喷发。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME's rocky shell is completely hollow, allowing for its built-up fire and smoke to be stored inside. In battle, it releases this pressure, causing a devastating eruption of lava and smoke.

entry: 煤维系着生命，吃得越多，POKENAME越有活力。最活跃的POKENAME会引爆剩煤，如火箭般在山间飞窜。
author: bandedbodypress
source: The coal it eats gives it life; the more coal it eats the more vigorous POKENAME is. The most energetic POKENAME rocket around mountains by exploding leftover coal.

entry: POKENAME极速不高，却以奔跑本领自豪。看似涌烟的部分，其实是柔软、灰扑扑的毛。
author: sk372
source: Despite having a low top speed, POKENAME prides itself on its galloping ability. What appears to be smoke billowing from it is actually a soft, ashy fur.

entry: POKENAME跑得越快，烟越浓，足以吞没整条道路。过去，盗匪骑POKENAME逃避追捕，用浓烟掩盖踪迹。
author: jaminmcready
source: The smoke that POKENAME produces thickens the faster it runs, leaving a dense cloud that can engulf entire roads. Long ago, bandits rode POKENAME to escape capture, using the thick smoke to conceal their tracks.

entry: 三个头都能喷蒸气，中间那个最喜怒无常，也最常被见到使用，因此最令人联想到这项能力。
author: sk372
source: All three heads possess the capacity to breathe out steam, but as the center head is the most temperamental of the bunch, it is the one most associated with and seen using the ability.

entry: POKENAME体内有甲壳碎片和黑曜石，不断挪动，维持体热。下雨，就把碎壳推到外层，试着挡住水分。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have pieces of shells and obsidian in their body, which constantly shift to keep their body hot. Whenever it rains, they push the shell pieces to the exterior of their body in an attempt to ward off moisture.

entry: POKENAME的喷口，既能喷火也能喷水。同时释放会产生蒸气，据说能缓解肌肉酸痛。
author: mary_the_jane
source: POKENAME has the unique ability to blast both flames and water out of its spouts. When fired at the same time, steam is created that is said to be good for muscle aches.

entry: POKENAME自在漂过火山区，最爱吓唬靠冒泡熔岩坑太近的旅人。受害者惊叫，它就大笑。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME floats freely through volcanic regions, delighting in scaring travelers who stray too close to bubbling lava pits. It laughs loudly when its victim screams in fear.

entry: POKENAME在火山区附近钻地。越靠近地底熔岩深处，越舒服，周围越热，产汽也越多。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME tunnels its way underground near volcanic areas. It is most comfortable the closer it is to molten depths, its steam production increasing the higher the temperature around it is.

entry: POKENAME的熏香，能让接触者沉睡。经过训练的POKENAME，会在医院帮助护士与麻醉医生工作。
author: _pixelar_
source: POKENAME's incense has the ability to put anyone who is exposed into a deep sleep. Trained POKENAME can be found in hospitals helping the nurses and anaesthesiologists with their work.

entry: POKENAME的爪很热，不断冒汽。虽能有效进攻，它却偏爱造出更浓蒸气，藏好自己，逃离潜在危险。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's claws emit constant steam due to their heat. Though effective for offense, it prefers creating a thicker cloud of steam to obscure itself and flee from potential dangers.

entry: POKENAME双爪都产大量蒸气，较大的里面，还储存、产生沸水。谁惹恼它，就可能挨上一阵滚烫水花。
author: sk372
source: Both of POKENAME's claws produce copious amounts of steam, but the larger actually contains and produces boiling water. Any who agitate it risk being hit with a scalding spray.

entry: 野生POKENAME常找僻静浅水处，用热身体暖水。各类宝可梦会聚来，与POKENAME共享临时温泉。
author: mrsspace
source: Wild POKENAME often find secluded areas of shallow water, heating the area with its hot body. Different Pokémon often gather to enjoy these makeshift hot springs alongside the POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME秋季最常见，出现在乡村田野。它友好、容易训练，喜欢陪年轻训练家探索宝可梦世界。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME is most commonly found in the autumn, appearing within the fields of rural communities. They are friendly and easily trained, enjoying the company of young Trainers as they explore the Pokémon world.

entry: 风暴中，POKENAME用强丝把南瓜固定地面。丝韧得足以抵御飓风。
author: .izik
source: During storms, POKENAME secures pumpkins to the ground with strong silk. The threads are resilient enough to withstand hurricane winds.

entry: POKENAME每个头都长深褐藤，夜里会相连。共享根系传递养分，也会一同低语、交流想法。
author: .izik
source: Each of POKENAME's heads grows dark brown vines that connect at night. These shared roots transfer nutrients and whisper thoughts in unison.

entry: POKENAME偷南瓜，刻成保护头罩。大多是让人想起卡拉卡拉的头骨造型，不过也有人见过其他形状。
author: _pixelar_
source: POKENAME will steal pumpkins and then carve them to act as a protective head covering. Most of the time the Pokémon will carve the pumpkin into a skull form, reminiscent of Cubone, but there have been sightings of other shapes over time.

entry: 它假扮南瓜精，引来毫无防备的训练家，再放毒气。传闻被气熏昏者，灵魂会困在它体内。
author: h0bojoe
source: It pretends to be a Pumpkaboo to draw in unsuspecting Trainers before releasing its toxic gas. Rumors state those who faint to its gas get their spirits trapped inside it.

entry: 据说POKENAME袋中的南瓜，带着一位新逝者的灵魂。它紧紧抱着、陪伴着，直到对方平静，能安心离去。
author: sk372
source: The pumpkin in POKENAME's pouch is said to carry the soul of someone recently departed. It holds them close and grants them company until they feel enough peace to properly move on.

entry: POKENAME用棕藤，控制住野生蔓藤怪，再把身体铺到土下。暗藏的陷阱，会缠住任何靠近所护庄稼的生物。
author: .izik
source: Using its brown vines, POKENAME overtakes wild Tangela and then spreads its body beneath the soil. These hidden traps ensnare any who near the crops it protects.

entry: 秋夜庆典上赢取POKENAME，是很流行的传统。它的角很甜，偷猎者和糖果师都争着寻找。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: It's a popular tradition to win POKENAME during autumn night festivals. Due to their sweet-tasting horn, POKENAME are highly sought after by poachers and confectioners alike.

entry: 秋季庆典常能见到POKENAME，用华丽灯光娱乐人群，也爱搞逗乐的小恶作剧。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME are a common sight during autumn festivities, entertaining crowds with their flashy lights. They are also known to enjoy playing light-hearted pranks as well.

entry: POKENAME头藤会变成锋利毒针。敢靠近它地盘的捕食者，只挨一针，便会发烧，痛苦不堪。
author: .izik
source: The vine on POKENAME's head sharpens into a venomous needle. A single jab causes painful fevers in predators bold enough to approach its patch.

entry: 它适应能力出众，环境多恶劣也能应付。受特定进化石辐射，眼中光色就会改变。
author: infinex21
source: It has a remarkable capacity for adaptation, no matter how harsh its environment may be. The light of its eyes changes as it is exposed to the radiation of certain evolutionary stones.

entry: 它的身体泛着柔火。在火暖中歇一会，或许能看见逝去已久的生命留下的记忆。
author: hophoppip
source: Its body glows with soft flames. If you rest in the warmth of its fire's heat for a while, you may witness memories from lives long past.

entry: 秋季，有些训练家用POKENAME装饰房屋或庭院。它等夜里毫无防备的人靠近，再突然动起来，一边飘浮，一边怪笑，把人吓走。
author: sk372
source: During the autumn months, some Trainers will place POKENAME on their home or yard as decorations. It waits until unsuspecting people travel near at night, then springs to life, floating and cackling and frightening them off.

entry: POKENAME壳上部分区域，会以图案发光，与挂在树上的同类交流。捕食者靠近时，就能无声提醒彼此。
author: .izik
source: Portions of POKENAME's shell glow in patterns to communicate with others of its kind hanging from trees. This allows them to silently warn one another when predators are nearby.

entry: 它用发光双眼与精神力量，催眠人和宝可梦。外表阴森，让许多人怕它这样是为作恶，其实POKENAME只是想找个玩伴。
author: imaginita
source: It hypnotizes people and Pokémon with its glowing eyes and psychic powers. Because of its haunting appearance, many fear it does this to enact wicked deeds, but really POKENAME just wants someone to play with.

entry: POKENAME多在十月现身，与同类一起到麦田闹鬼。不过，据说看见它会带来兴旺好运，农民从不驱赶。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME tends to appear in October, when it gathers with others of its kind to haunt wheat fields. However, it is said that spotting one brings prosperity and good fortune, so farmers never drive it away.

entry: POKENAME始终提防捕食者，靠绝佳夜视辨路。受惊就跳进树间，皮毛融入幽暗叶丛。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is always on the lookout for predators, using its excellent night vision to navigate during the night. When frightened, it will jump into the trees, its fur blending in with the dark foliage.

entry: POKENAME在森林和农田奔走，捡拾食物带回洞穴。收获时节，献上刺耳果，就能请它帮忙。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME scurries around forests and farmland, scavenging for food to take back to its burrow. During harvest season, it can be persuaded to help out with an offering of Colbur Berries.

entry: 夜深时，POKENAME以悠长诡异的咕鸣，呼唤同类。每月一次，POKENAME成群聚在森林，合唱空灵和声。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME lets out long, haunting hoots late in the evening, calling out to others of its kind. Once a month, flocks of POKENAME gather in the forest to sing an ethereal harmony together.

entry: POKENAME腹孔发光，夜间司机常误认成另一辆车。其实那光能让猎物看不见，也能吓退捕食者。秋夜是寻找这胆小宝可梦的好时机。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is often mistaken for another car by nighttime drivers due to the glowing holes in its belly, which are actually used to blind prey and frighten predators. Autumn nights are fortuitous times for people hoping to spot this skittish Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME用藤蔓寄生芭瓢虫群，让它们传播种子。它凶猛守卫草甸，攻击所有闯入者。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its vines to parasitize Ledyba colonies, converting them into seed-spreaders. It fiercely defends the meadow, attacking all intruders.

entry: POKENAME在南瓜田织半透明丝线。任何一根被碰，整群就会警觉，再用黏黏网困住入侵者，防止逃走。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spins translucent threads across pumpkin fields. If one is touched, the swarm is alerted. It traps intruders using Sticky Web to prevent escape.

entry: POKENAME让身体发出最强光，引来毛球等宝可梦。靠近后，就会发现自己缠进POKENAME布在周围的强韧黏网。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME attracts Pokémon like Venonat by letting its body glow at full strength. When they approach, they find themselves tangled in the powerful sticky webs that POKENAME spun around the area.

entry: POKENAME只夜猎，靠绝佳夜视，全黑也能发现猎物。白天吊在腐树上，希望融入幽暗叶丛。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME only hunts at night, able to detect prey in pure darkness using its excellent night vision. During the day it hangs from decaying trees, hoping to blend into the dark foliage.

entry: POKENAME在秋季庆典的满月时现身，其余一年都静住洞里。它们开心起舞，与大家一起庆祝。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME emerge during the full moon of an autumn festival and live quietly inside caves during the rest of the year. They happily dance and celebrate the occasion alongside others.

entry: 传说吃下POKENAME南瓜锅里熬的稠液，就能看见未来。有时，会少量加进甜点糖霜或饮品，带来晕乎乎的感觉。
author: pjporwoll
source: Legends claim that consuming the goo brewed in POKENAME's pumpkin cauldron bestows visions of the future. A splash of the liquid is sometimes added to dessert frostings or beverages to induce a woozy feeling.

entry: 它的尾巴是一盏灯，看一眼灯孔的光，就可能受其控制。POKENAME凭敏锐听觉，能轻易察觉灵体。
author: doctorjazznumber6215
source: Its tail is a lantern; one look at the light from the hole of this lantern can put one under its control. POKENAME can easily detect spirits with its ears' sensitive hearing.

entry: POKENAME成群随风漂游，灯光只在夜里可见。目击者形容，POKENAME如夜空中移动的小星星。
author: mistymagius
source: Flocks of POKENAME drift along the wind, the light from their lanterns only visible during the night. Spectators describe POKENAME sightings as looking like small stars moving across the night sky.

entry: 格外黑的夜里，成群POKENAME乘风漂游，以诡异光芒照亮地面。所到之处，都带来奇异的南瓜甜香。
author: mistymagius
source: On particularly dark nights, clusters of POKENAME can be seen drifting on the wind, illuminating the ground below in an eerie light. They bring the oddly sweet scent of pumpkin wherever they go.

entry: POKENAME用灯笼的诡光催眠幼童，带进森林。没人知道它为何要这些孩子，可一进入，往往就再无踪影。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME lures young children into the forests, hypnotizing them with the eerie glow of its lantern. No one knows why it wants these children, but they are often never seen again once they enter the forest.

entry: POKENAME的亮眼，让它能在暗中看路。常聚居南瓜地，把大南瓜和葫芦当作巢。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME's glowing eyes let them see where they are going in the dark. These Pokémon commonly infest pumpkin patches, making their dens inside large pumpkins and gourds.

entry: POKENAME只在夜里出来，顽皮地捉弄路过者。最爱的把戏，是藏在空葫芦里，等人拿起。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME only come out at night, cheekily playing pranks on anyone that passes by. Its favorite prank is to hide inside hollow gourds and waiting for someone to pick it up.

entry: POKENAME飞行时，闪动尾上南瓜般的球体交流。若光闪红，就是提醒附近群体有危险。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME flashes the pumpkin-like orb on its tail mid-flight to communicate. If the light flickers red, it signals danger to the swarm nearby.

entry: POKENAME头上总糊满泥，潜水也不例外。没人知道泥下是什么，因为传说，谁想擦净，就会受诅咒。无论真假，连最大胆的训练家，也不动这泥。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME's head is always caked in mud, even while submerged. No one knows what lies beneath, as legend warns that anyone who tries to wipe it clean will be cursed. Whether myth or truth, even the boldest Trainers leave the mud untouched.

entry: POKENAME的光，会让照到的植物表现得如在夜里。它一出现，白天开的花就合拢，夜间开的花却绽放。
author: .realthree
source: The light shed from POKENAME has the unusual effect of causing the plants it shines on to act as if it were nighttime. Day-blooming flowers close and nocturnal blossoms open in the presence of this Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME在农业社区很受欢迎，与收获的神秘联系，让它成了维持庄稼健康的宝贵帮手。它天生能感知，作物何时成熟、可以采收。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are popular in farming communities, their ethereal connection to the harvest making them invaluable for maintaining a healthy crop. They have an innate ability to sense when a crop is ripe for picking.

entry: 它的壳像荔枝，颜色也一样。壳受损，还会渗出味道像荔枝的糖浆。
author: quackquackattack
source: Its shell reminds people of Lychee, especially since its shell is the same color. When its shell is damaged, it also oozes out syrup that tastes like the fruit too.

entry: POKENAME把金南果存进壳里，靠滚动调成果汁。在关都，这种甜饮的香气与风味，都备受称赞。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME stores Pumkin Berries in its shell, rolling to mix them into a juice. In Kanto, this sweet drink is praised for its aroma and flavor.

entry: POKENAME爱甜瓜与南瓜，常闯当地农场抢取。可谁想偷它的储藏，就会被追打不休。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME loves melons and pumpkins and will often raid local farms to get its hands on them. However, anyone that tries to steal its stash will be relentlessly pursued and attacked.

entry: POKENAME闯进熊宝宝的巢，寄生它们，练习模仿叫声，引来圈圈熊，再伏击，获取养分。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME invades Teddiursa dens to parasitize them. It practices and mimics their cries to lure in Ursaring, which it ambushes for nutrients.

entry: POKENAME咀嚼不需要的植物，将其烧成灰，吐到南瓜田。它会避免烧有用植物，除非资源紧缺。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME burns unwanted plant life by chewing it to ash and spitting it onto pumpkin fields. It avoids burning useful flora unless resources run low.

entry: 相信POKENAME引迷失灵魂去往来世的人说，能从背上南瓜的大小，看出它带着多少灵魂。
author: imaginita
source: Those who believe POKENAME help to bring lost souls to the afterlife claim that you can tell how many souls one is carrying by how large the pumpkin on its back is.

entry: POKENAME常在农田，把鼻子贴地，寻找根茎蔬菜。它习惯挖空南瓜，当作家。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are often found within farm fields, their noses pressed to the ground in search of root vegetables. They have a habit of hollowing out pumpkins to serve as homes.

entry: POKENAME厚毛保暖，能住在严寒地区。夜里会亮起躯干下部的孔洞，如鬼眼般发光，吓退可能的袭击者。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's thick fur is effective at keeping it warm in the frigid areas it inhabits. At night, it scares off potential attackers by lighting up the holes in its lower torso and making it appear like ghostly glowing eyes.

entry: POKENAME藏在珊瑚礁，夜里胸前泛柔光。潜水员常误认宝藏，直到它消失在黑暗中。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME hides in coral reefs, shining a soft light from its chest at night. Divers often mistake it for treasure until it vanishes into the dark.

entry: POKENAME宽嘴能产生极强的光。它住深海暗处，突然闪光，让袭击者看不见，为逃离捕食者争取充足机会。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's wide mouth can generate an intensely bright light. Living in the darker depths of the ocean, flashing this light blinds attackers and gives POKENAME ample opportunity to escape predators.

entry: POKENAME收集腐南瓜的种子，存进袋状尾巴，吃前会铺在太阳下晒干。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME collects seeds from decaying pumpkins and stores them in its sack-like tail. It lays them out to dry in the sun before eating.

entry: POKENAME外表吓人，实际极友好。人们相信，它会引导逝者灵魂到觉醒神殿，得以重生。
author: shocktopus1717
source: Though it may appear intimidating, POKENAME is actually extremely friendly. It is believed to guide the spirits of the departed to the Cave of Origin, so that they may be reborn.

entry: 它身体较浅色的节段会发光，引来部分猎物，也吓退部分捕食者。清晨入睡时，就会回地下巢穴。
author: bobosmith01
source: The lighter-colored segments on its body can glow, luring in some prey while also driving off some predators. When it sleeps in the early hours of the morning, it goes into its underground nest.

entry: POKENAME腹光，在深海黑暗中引来猎物。据说，它不吃对方身体，只困住灵魂，产生更多光。
author: stevethebarbarian
source: The light on POKENAME's underbelly attracts prey in the dark of the deep sea. It's said that it does not eat their bodies, instead merely trapping their souls to produce more light.

entry: POKENAME利用小小象群滚过田野，翻土作垄。形成的南瓜地，会靠凶猛攻击，严加守护。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses Phanpy herds to roll through fields and churn planting rows. The resulting pumpkin patches are heavily guarded by hostile attacks.

entry: POKENAME夜里睡在南瓜田，模仿周围瓜果。若被吵醒，就对扰醒者使出锁定，吐南瓜籽攻击，再逃走。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME sleeps in pumpkin patches at night, mimicking the gourds around it. Should it be woken, it will Lock On to the offender and spit pumpkin seeds at them before fleeing.

entry: POKENAME是农业社区的常见伙伴，用来吓退飞行属性宝可梦。宝可梦若扰乱它保护的庄稼，它就会主动交战，即使胜算很小。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are common companions in agricultural communities, used as a deterrent to keep Flying-Type Pokémon away. They will pick fights with Pokémon that disturb the crops under their protection, even if they are unlikely to win.

entry: POKENAME是农业社区的常见伙伴，用来吓退飞行属性宝可梦。宝可梦若扰乱它保护的庄稼，它就会主动交战，即使胜算很小。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are common companions in agricultural communities, used as a deterrent to keep Flying-Type Pokémon away. They will pick fights with Pokémon that disturb the crops under their protection, even if they are unlikely to win.

entry: 据说南瓜田若屡遭偷盗，POKENAME就会出现守护，吼声能击垮任何靠太近小偷的意志。
author: .izik
source: Should a pumpkin patch face repeated theft, it is said a POKENAME will appear to guard it. Its roar is said to break the will of any thief who draws too close.

entry: 这种宝可梦把装着灵魂的南瓜，磨成光滑圆球，骑在上面移动，模仿那个灵魂生前的举动。
author: chaoticanzu
source: This Pokémon smoothed out a pumpkin holding a spirit into a ball and now travels on it, mimicking the actions the spirit once took in life.

entry: POKENAME空心头里的电光，被认为能吸引虫属性宝可梦，给尾上南瓜花授粉。秋季很常见，一有入冬迹象，就会藏起。
author: .realthree
source: The electric lights that glow within POKENAME's hollow head are thought to attract Bug-type Pokémon to pollinate the pumpkin flower on its tail. These Pokémon are commonly seen throughout fall, but they hide away at the first sign of winter.

entry: POKENAME秋季常来镇村，装成孩子，大吃糖果。大家明知是宝可梦，多数仍宠着，给糖和其他点心。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME often show up in towns and villages during autumn, pretending to be children so that they may gorge themselves with candy. Although everyone knows they are Pokémon, most still indulge them with candy and other treats.

entry: 这种宝可梦蜷在南瓜田，假装真南瓜。它爱把别的南瓜，也打扮成POKENAME，捉弄逛瓜田的人。
author: lydiaprower8
source: This Pokémon can be seen curled up in pumpkin patches, posing as an actual pumpkin. It likes to prank humans wandering around the pumpkin patch by dressing up other pumpkins to be just like POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME白天懒洋洋地在向阳处小睡。暮色降临，就能把吸收的光重新放出，照亮旅途。
author: .realthree
source: During the day, POKENAME nap lazily in sunny places. Once twilight falls, they can re-emit the absorbed light to guide their way as they travel.

entry: POKENAME喜欢与农民同住，耕地、驱赶入侵者，让庄稼健康生长。滑翔时挥尾撒种，寒夜也会给幼芽照明。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME enjoy living with farmers, tilling the soil and repelling intruders to help make sure crops grow nice and healthy. While they glide, they swing their tails to scatter seeds. They provide light for the sprouts even during cold nights.

entry: 疲惫的丛林旅人，夜里可能遇上POKENAME。它是友善灵体，会给冒险者一块用自己身体做的派。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: Weary travellers of the jungle may encounter POKENAME at night. It's a friendly spirit that will offer a slice of pie made from its own body to adventurers.

entry: 这种宝可梦蜷在南瓜田，假装真南瓜。它爱把别的南瓜，也打扮成POKENAME，捉弄逛瓜田的人。
author: lydiaprower8
source: This Pokémon can be seen curled up in pumpkin patches, posing as an actual pumpkin. It likes to prank humans wandering around the pumpkin patch by dressing up other pumpkins to be just like POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME背上长刺，很像玉米糖。许多孩子想咬下看似美味的刺，一咬却掉了一颗牙。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME grow long spikes on their back that resemble candy corn. Many children have tried to bite off a delicious-looking spike, only to lose a tooth while biting down.

entry: POKENAME寄生水跃鱼群，为南瓜田浇水。水跃鱼喷水，它则使出种子机关枪，赶走前来捡食的生物。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME parasitizes Mudkip colonies to water its pumpkin fields. The Mudkip spray water while it uses Bullet Seed to keep scavengers away.

entry: 这种孩子般的宝可梦，常在夜里敲门讨点心。紫苑镇居民会在门前阶上放小篮糖果，免得这灵体捣乱。
author: chiari_queen
source: This childlike Pokémon has a tendency for knocking on doors at night to ask for treats. Citizens of Lavender Town have taken to leaving small baskets of candy out on their front steps, lest they get tricked by the spirit instead.

entry: 细看才发现，POKENAME微微浮在地面之上。研究者认为，是为了掩饰短腿行动无力、速度至多只能爬行的事实。
author: ohok3441
source: On close inspection, POKENAME appears to float just above the ground. Researchers believe it is to cover up the fact that their tiny legs lack the locomotion to get anywhere faster than a crawl.

entry: POKENAME守着草甸一片地盘，向入侵者射毒针。一位伽勒尔烘焙师发现，把它和通通果一起烤成派，便可食用，风味微酸、口感细滑。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is territorial of a patch of its meadow, launching venomous needles at intruders. A Galarian baker discovered that baking it in a pie with Kebia Berries made it edible and produced a pie with a slightly sour flavor with a smooth texture.

entry: POKENAME收集南瓜瓤，涂在河边住处周围。气味能标记领地，让其他宝可梦不敢靠近。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME gathers pumpkin innards and smears them around its riverside lodge. The scent marks its territory and keeps other Pokémon at bay.

entry: POKENAME很焦虑，向任何靠近的陌生者吐籽。吐满108颗，若对方仍没离开，POKENAME就会试着逃走躲藏。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are quite anxious, spitting seeds at any stranger that approaches them. After spitting 108 seeds, if the stranger has not left, POKENAME will try to run away and hide.

entry: POKENAME吐尖锐种子，给敌人注入消耗耐力的毒素。临近收获季，就在农田游荡，寻找捡食剩余作物的猎物。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME spits sharp seeds which inject foes with an endurance-sapping poison. It prowls farm fields near harvest season, looking for prey scavenging the last of the crops.

entry: 它用天生的可爱与强光，引来迷失灵魂，带往死后世界。若周围没有迷魂，就引其他活物过来，将其撕碎。
author: sakuraneko
source: It is known to use its natural cuteness and bright lights to lure in and carry lost souls to the afterlife. If no lost souls are around, it will draw in other living creatures before tearing them apart.

entry: POKENAME白天用大叶盖眼睡觉。夜里，双眼泛起神秘却亲切的光，邀请看见者加入POKENAME的庆典。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME slumbers during the day, covering its eyes with its large leaves. At night, its eyes glow with a mysterious but welcoming light, inviting all who see it to join in POKENAME's festivities.

entry: 森林暗处的POKENAME亮眼，衍生许多恐怖都市传说。与故事不同，POKENAME其实温和，更爱独处，也希望彻底避开冲突。
author: sk372
source: Many frightening urban legends have arisen from spotting POKENAME's glowing eyes in the forest darkness. Contrary to what the stories say, POKENAME is quite gentle and prefers to avoid company and conflict entirely.

entry: POKENAME偶尔与倒霉的人相遇。这些人报告，见过POKENAME后，遇到的就全是好事。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME occasionally crosses paths with those who are unlucky. Reports from these people claim only lucky occurrences happen to them after witnessing POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME漂过墓园，胸前光点按诡异图案闪动。地方传说称，盯太久，家族血脉可能受诅咒。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME floats through graveyards, blinking its chest lights in eerie patterns. Local legends claim staring too long can curse your family line.

entry: POKENAME成群来到尼多一族的家庭，利用它们的听觉。它会用尖角巡守南瓜田，赶走入侵者。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME flocks descend on Nidoran families to harness their hearing. With its sharp horn, it patrols pumpkin fields and drives intruders away.

entry: 日落，POKENAME就不安分，从墙和天花板弹来弹去。满月下，尾巴会裹上催眠火焰，让凝视者陷入恍惚。
author: santon5512
source: As the sun sets, POKENAME become restless, bouncing from the walls and ceilings. Their tails become enveloped in hypnotic flames under a full moon, lulling anyone who looks at them into a trance.

entry: 野生POKENAME平时怕接触，却很少犹豫，会引迷路旅人走出森林。藤蔓一碰就使人平静，不过有些传说称，是它吸收、吃掉了恐惧。
author: infinex21
source: Although usually afraid of contact with others, wild POKENAME will rarely hesitate to help guide lost travelers out of forests. The touch of their vines instills calmness, though some tales claim this is because these Pokémon absorb and feed on fear.

entry: POKENAME抖落的孢子，有熟南瓜味，会让四肢麻木，几天才能完全消退。
author: .izik
source: Spores shaken from POKENAME's body smell like ripe pumpkins. They cause limb numbness that can take several days to fully wear off.

entry: POKENAME夜里在森林蹦跳，体光吸引其他生物。秋季，许多POKENAME会相聚唱歌跳舞。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME prances around the forest at night, its body casting a glow that draws others to it. Many POKENAME will congregate together to sing and dance during the autumn seasons.

entry: POKENAME以躯干柔光交流。体内满是纠缠藤蔓，能伸到远处，抓取海生植物吃。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME communicates with soft glows from its torso. Its innards are tangled vines that extend to grab and consume sea plants from afar.

entry: POKENAME群落寄生熟睡的土居忍士，收集富含养分的土。准备大片南瓜苗床时，地下会泛起黄光。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME colonies parasitize sleeping Nincada to collect nutrient-rich soil. They glow yellow underground as they prepare vast pumpkin beds.

entry: POKENAME用爪拍碎南瓜，锻炼身体。察觉有人害怕，就会靠到对方身边，寻求安慰。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME trains its body by smashing up pumpkins with its paws. When it senses that someone is afraid, it goes up to them for comfort.

entry: 有人发现南瓜田被砸，通常是这种宝可梦进田吃瓜，强化厚厚的葫芦状铠甲。
author: lydiaprower8
source: Sightings of pumpkin fields being smashed are usually due to this Pokémon going into those fields and eating the pumpkins to build up its thick, gourd-like armor.

entry: POKENAME在某些祭灵节庆出现，黄毛像火般闪烁，据说能驱邪灵。POKENAME兴奋时，闪得更强，还散出新鲜南瓜香。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME appear during certain spirit festivals. The yellow fur on their bodies flickers like fire and is believed to drive away malevolent spirits. The flicker is more intense and a fresh pumpkin smell is produced when POKENAME are excited.

entry: POKENAME住在黑暗森林，体内发光液帮助看清周围。父母常给孩子一只POKENAME，当作夜灯。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME live in dark forests, the bioluminescent fluid inside its body helping them to see their surroundings. Parents will often give their child a POKENAME to act as a nightlight.

entry: POKENAME最爱在树间伪装，吓唬路人。大多住在暗林，也会进入废弃房屋和豪宅。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME loves to spook passersby by camouflaging itself amongst the trees. While mostly found in dark forests, it will also inhabit abandoned homes and mansions.

entry: POKENAME咬电线吸电。充满后，体内光就像闪动灯笼，快速明灭。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME bites into power lines to absorb electricity. When fully charged, the light inside its body flashes rapidly like a blinking lantern.

entry: POKENAME夜行，用发光触须照亮黑暗。受威胁时，POKENAME会从嘴里喷出热橙液，很像南瓜泥。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are nocturnal, using their glowing feelers to illuminate the darkness. When threatened, POKENAME will spew out a hot, orange liquid from its mouth similar to pureed pumpkin.

entry: POKENAME藏在树枝间伪装，准备出击。突然从体内照出强光，便能惊住猎物，抢先攻击。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME camouflage themselves among tree branches until they are ready to strike. By shining a bright light from within their bodies, they can surprise their prey and attack first.

entry: 建议农民让珠宝、结晶远离农田。POKENAME会潜伏南瓜田，试着催眠农民，交出宝石。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Farmers are advised to keep any jewelry and crystals far away from their land. POKENAME will lurk in pumpkin patches and attempt to hypnotize the farmers into giving up their gems.

entry: POKENAME吃毒藤与毒漆树，增强毒素。毒性最盛时，身体就发鲜橙光，取代黄光。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME eats poison ivy and poison sumac to enhance its toxins. When its venom peaks in potency, its body glows a brilliant orange instead of yellow.

entry: POKENAME白天睡在南瓜田。受打扰就施毒，强得能造成暂时失明。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME sleeps in pumpkin patches during day. If disturbed, it strikes with venom so potent it can cause temporary blindness.

entry: POKENAME的舞蹈织出催眠色彩，引迷魂安息，也让生者陷入恍惚。扰乱节奏者，可能沦为幽魂猎物，被迫像它曾引渡的灵魂般漂泊。
author: vhscopyofmeangirls
source: POKENAME's dance weaves hypnotic hues, guiding lost souls to rest while ensnaring the living in a trance. Those who disrupt its rhythm risk becoming spectral prey, bound to wander as the spirits it once ferried.

entry: POKENAME附身腐南瓜后，行动很困难，稍不小心，身体就可能散架。所到之处，都跟着刺鼻腐味。
author: mistymagius
source: After POKENAME possesses a rotting pumpkin, it struggles to get around without risking its body falling apart. The pungent scent of decay follows it wherever it goes.

entry: 据说POKENAME是游荡灵体，被大型化装聚会和南瓜田吸引。它爱参加诡异庆典，享受惊吓的刺激。
author: chiari_queen
source: POKENAME is said to be a wandering spirit that is drawn to large gatherings of costumed people and pumpkin patches. It loves to join spooky festivities, adoring the thrill of a good scare.

entry: POKENAME把尽可能多的灵体囚在体内。数量够多，灵魂才能挣脱，爆发的能量，也会让POKENAME改变形态。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME takes as many spirits as possible and keeps them captive inside its body. These souls can only break out once enough of them are present, and when that happens, their bursting energy will cause POKENAME to transform.

entry: POKENAME夜巡农田，胸口与爪透着诡光。发现入侵者，就尖叫冲锋，许多人说，那声音像龙卷风警报混着无线电杂音。
author: .izik
source: At night, POKENAME patrols crop fields using the eerie glow from its chest and paws. If it spots an intruder, it charges while screaming a sound that many state sounds like a tornado siren crossed with radio static.

entry: POKENAME的藤蔓铺过海底，探知远处振动。有时会把沉船完全覆盖。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's vines stretch across the ocean floor, detecting vibrations from far away. Sometimes its vines completely overtake sunken ships.

entry: 寒冷沙漠的夜里，POKENAME脸上微光闪动，帮助同类在全黑中协调捕猎。
author: .izik
source: During cold desert nights, POKENAME's face glows faintly. The flickering lights help others of its kind coordinate hunts in total darkness.

entry: POKENAME整天巡田，为农民保护庄稼。任何野生宝可梦入田，就会用鬼面驱赶。
author: cobalt0135
source: POKENAME will patrol the fields all day protecting crops for their farmers. They will use Scary Face to frighten away any wild Pokémon that invades their fields.

entry: POKENAME身上长黄蘑菇，吃下可能入睡。有人说，这样睡着，更容易做格外真切的噩梦。
author: jaminmcready
source: Yellow mushrooms grow on POKENAME's body and can cause sleep when eaten. Some say those who slumber this way are more likely to experience vivid nightmares.

entry: POKENAME由发磷光的植物与石头构成，晒过太阳，最长还能亮四小时。它忠诚，又不会引燃气体，很受洞穴探险者与矿工喜爱，拿来照明。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is made of phosphorescent plants and stones, which can glow for up to four hours after sun exposure. This loyal Pokémon is a preferred partner for cave explorers and miners as a non-igniting light source should they encounter gasses.

entry: POKENAME极力隐瞒最爱听的音乐，也断然拒绝任何以音乐打动它的尝试。
author: chaotic_aspergers
source: POKENAME tries very hard to keep its favorite music secret. It will outright refuse any attempts to impress it with music.

entry: POKENAME背上有厚葫芦护甲，却没有根，只能用爪吸取露出的树根养分。树慢慢枯萎，它则能长得极大。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's back is armored by a thick gourd. Since it lacks roots, it uses its claws to drains nutrients from exposed tree roots, and can grow to great size as the tree slowly withers away.

entry: POKENAME秋天把半身埋进叶堆。娇弱的头藤，遇冷会变脆，自然折落。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME burrows halfway beneath leaf piles in the fall. Its delicate head vines become brittle in cold weather and naturally break away.

entry: POKENAME越专注看远处，双眼就越亮。光眼吓过许多夜行训练家，但POKENAME无害，只是好奇。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's eyes glow brighter the more it focuses its vision on something in the distance. Its glowing eyes have frightened many Trainers traveling at night, but POKENAME is harmless and merely curious.

entry: POKENAME不断散热，身体内部发光。白天藏在南瓜田，夜里找树枝吃。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME's bodies emit constant heat, the inside of their bodies glowing. During the day, they hide themselves in pumpkin patches, foraging for sticks to eat at night.

entry: POKENAME每次对战前，都会点起木棍，像魔杖挥舞，引导亡灵，增强灼热火焰。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME light their sticks before every Pokémon battle and wave their sticks like a wand. They channel spirits of the dead to strengthen their scorching flames.

entry: 融合后，POKENAME放出的光只会更强。它借此引大批灵体，前往死后世界。
author: .b4ring_my.t33th
source: The light emitted by POKENAME only grows stronger with fusion. With this power, it guides hordes of spirits into the afterlife.

entry: POKENAME翼上的斑点，暗中闪亮。人们常误认成迷失灵体，跟着POKENAME走入森林深处。
author: mistymagius
source: The spots on POKENAME's wings glow brightly in the dark. People often mistake these spots for lost spirits and end up following POKENAME deep into the woods.

entry: POKENAME附身的南瓜，甜得异常。厨师有时会在特殊场合，烹煮这种南瓜。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: The pumpkin that POKENAME possesses is unusually sweet. Chefs will sometimes cook the pumpkin for special occasions.

entry: 这只贪吃宝可梦最爱南瓜，数英里外都能闻到。南瓜农传统上会为POKENAME烤特制南瓜甜点，免得它吃庄稼。
author: hophoppip
source: This hungry Pokémon loves to feed on pumpkins, which it can smell from miles away. Pumpkin farmers traditionally bake a special pumpkin dessert for POKENAME to keep it from eating their crops.

entry: 十月晚间，POKENAME用皮肤当袋子，陪孩子讨糖。糖果越装越沉，拖慢POKENAME，结果被大家不小心落在后面。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Using their skin as a bag, POKENAME accompany children on October evenings in order to earn candy. This candy ends up weighing POKENAME down, leading to them being unintentionally left behind.

entry: 它背上的东西，质地、味道和香气都像南瓜派，却不容易弄坏。有些训练家比POKENAME的体型、香气，有时连派的味道也要比，证明自家的POKENAME更出色。
author: bobosmith01
source: The item on its back has the texture, taste and smell of a pumpkin pie, but it cannot easily be physically damaged. Some Trainers compare POKENAME's size, aroma, and sometimes even the taste of their pie to prove their POKENAME is superior to others.

entry: 秋夜，POKENAME漂在田野上方，灯光按奇怪图案闪动。原因仍不明。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME can be seen hovering over fields on autumn nights, flickering their lights in an odd pattern. The reason for this behavior remains unknown.

entry: 据说野外看见POKENAME的人，会变得焦虑，永远遇不到真爱。
author: ambrosia04
source: It is said that anyone who sees a POKENAME in the wild will develop anxiety and never experience true love.

entry: POKENAME的帽子虽与身体材质相同，却不相连，常被风吹走。大风天，成群POKENAME会追帽子，试着用意念抓回。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Despite being made of the same material as their body, POKENAME's hat constantly flies off in the wind, as it's not attached to them. On windy days, flocks of POKENAME chase their hats, using their psychokinetic abilities to try and grab them.

entry: POKENAME出没南瓜田，极力防范真实或自认为存在的伤害。可惜，常把来收庄稼的农民，也赶走。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME haunt pumpkin patches, vigorously protecting them from both real and perceived harm. They have an unfortunate habit of chasing off farmers looking to harvest their crop.

entry: POKENAME出没南瓜田，极力防范真实或自认为存在的伤害。它把灵力聚到拳上，打向任何敢吃瓜的宝可梦。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME haunt pumpkin patches, vigorously protecting them from both real and perceived harm. They summon spiritual energy to their fists, striking at other Pokémon that would dare attempt to feed on the growing gourds.

entry: POKENAME腹部空洞，不断渗出浓厚橙色黏液。有胆尝过的人形容，甜味仿佛人工调制，还略带糖浆味。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME release a steady ooze of thick orange slime from the hollow in their stomach. Those who have been brave enough to taste it describe the flavour as being artificially sweet, with a slight syrupy taste.

entry: POKENAME常在南瓜田打盹，装成南瓜。察觉有什么靠近，就瞬间移动到另一片瓜田。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME is often seen dozing off in pumpkin patches, posing as one of the pumpkins. When it senses something coming close to it, it teleports to another pumpkin patch.

entry: 人们相信，POKENAME是秋季出现的善灵，保护南瓜田，免受其他生物影响。它用超凡精神力量，造强力屏障，或让附近物体悬浮。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is believed to be a benevolent spirit that appears during autumn to protect pumpkin fields from the influence of other creatures. It uses its extraordinary psychic powers to create powerful barriers or make nearby objects levitate.

entry: 秋天，POKENAME会掏空南瓜，到附近村庄讨点心。若屡遭拒绝，就用可怕踢击，夷平房屋。
author: .izik
source: In autumn, POKENAME hollows pumpkins to request treats from nearby villages. If denied too often, it flattens homes with terrifying kicks.

entry: 十月夜里，常能见POKENAME秀肌肉讨糖。糖果是POKENAME主要能量来源之一，一次能吃完一袋十磅糖果。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME can often be spotted on October nights, flexing to receive candy. POKENAME consume candy as one of their primary sources of energy, able to eat a ten-pound bag in one sitting.

entry: POKENAME主要水生，却能在陆地上空漂浮数小时。夜里离水，头上南瓜般的部分，会发出仿佛来自异界的光芒。
author: sk372
source: Though primarily aquatic in nature, POKENAME can float above land for several hours without issue. When outside the water during the night, the pumpkin-like growths on its head emit an otherworldly glow.

entry: POKENAME在水下摇动发光尾巴，引来大舌贝。若被咬，便慢慢抬头，盯着攻击者好几个小时。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME waves its glowing tail underwater to attract Shellder. If bitten, it lifts its head slowly and stares at the attacker for hours.

entry: POKENAME常混进杰尼龟与卡咪龟群，模仿动作。究竟为食物、安全，还是单纯作伴，仍是谜。
author: victor9106
source: POKENAME are often found blending into packs of Squirtle and Wartortle, mimicking their movements. Whether their objective is food, safety, or simple companionship remains a mystery.

entry: POKENAME优雅精准地挥火把，战斗时以弧线横扫，再把动作当仪式，反复练习。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME wields a burning torch with graceful precision. In battle, it strikes with sweeping arcs, then repeats the motions as ritual practice.

entry: POKENAME身体有古怪甜香，带着落叶与过熟南瓜味。气味很应秋景，可若POKENAME一直在身边，就可能浓得受不了。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's body has an oddly sweet scent, smelling of fallen leaves and overripe pumpkin. While the scent is perfect for the autumn season, it can get overpowering if POKENAME is around all the time.

entry: 收获季的夜里，这些狡黠宝可梦会出来玩，藏在南瓜中，再飞向农民，将其吓昏。
author: actliux
source: On nights during the harvest season, these devious Pokémon come out to play. They hide in pumpkins and fly out at farmers, scaring them to the point of fainting.

entry: POKENAME用催眠火，让其他生物帮忙照料附近土壤。民间故事称，贸然跟火星从田间走进森林的人，会被POKENAME变成灵体吞食。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's hypnotic flames influence others into helping tend to the nearby soil. Folktales mention that those foolish enough to follow their fiery embers from the fields and into the woods will be turned into a spirit by POKENAME and devoured.

entry: POKENAME用巨翼，夜游森林，寻找养分，变得更强。白天藏在树里，避开可能损伤背上种子的日光。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME uses its huge wings to roam the forests at night, seeking nourishment to grow stronger. During the day, it hides inside trees, avoiding sunlight that could damage the seed on its back.

entry: POKENAME振翅散出的鳞粉，让人泪流不止、视线模糊。POKENAME便趁机偷走受害者的食物。
author: sk372
source: The scales scattered by POKENAME's flapping wings cause a person's eyes to water uncontrollably and obscure their vision. POKENAME uses this opportunity to pilfer food from its victims.

entry: POKENAME夜行，用长舌捕食灯边聚集的虫宝可梦。唾液毒性很强，能让较小目标麻痹，对较大目标，却只会轻微发痒。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are nocturnal, using their long tongues to snatch Bug-type Pokémon swarming around lights. Their saliva contains a potent toxin capable of paralyzing smaller targets, though it only causes mild itching in larger targets.

entry: POKENAME能控制体内气体密度，让自己比空气轻或重，悬在原地，再用翼移动。紧急时，一次排出大量气体，突然加速。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME can control the density of their internal gases to become lighter or heavier than air, levitating in place and using their wings to move around. In an emergency they can release large puffs of gas all at once, providing a burst of speed.

entry: POKENAME寻找铅、砷等有毒矿物，岩石皮肤会吸收毒性。它必须不停振翅，防止翅上积起太多岩石。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME hunts for deposits of toxic minerals like lead and arsenic. Its rocky hide absorbs their toxic qualities. It must constantly flap its wings to prevent too much rock from building up on them.

entry: POKENAME体表的藤蔓又脆、又难吃，还带剧毒，因此天敌很少。
author: cait_sith
source: The brittle vines covering its body are both unappetizing and highly toxic. Therefore, POKENAME has few natural predators.

entry: POKENAME身旁常跟着一小群毛球。毛球们轮流坐进它的育儿袋里。
author: staghorn
source: POKENAME are usually accompanied by small swarms of Venonat. The Venonat take turns riding in the POKENAME's pouch.

entry: POKENAME每季都会迁往森林不同地方，保持温暖。沿路捕食者很多，它们便扬起大片毒花粉，阻止靠近。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME migrate to a different part of the forest every season to keep themselves warm. The journey is full of predators along the way, so they produce a large cloud of toxic pollen to deter predators.

entry: POKENAME用复杂默剧分散敌人注意，暗中施放毒粉。若POKENAME看似在跳舞，可能其实在生气。
author: cwynwyn
source: POKENAME distracts foes with elaborate pantomime routines while secretly attacking them with poisonous dust. If a POKENAME appears to be dancing, it may actually be angry.

entry: POKENAME爱强光，常冲向路灯等城市光源。途中却会不小心砍倒一切挡路物，给居民带来许多麻烦。
author: agentyoshi
source: POKENAME love bright lights, often charging at streetlights or other urban light sources. This creates many issues for the city's inhabitants, however, as POKENAME are known to inadvertently cut down everything in between them and the light source.

entry: POKENAME不直接袭击猎物，而是慢慢跟踪，直到对方倒在毒尘之下。通常不追大型宝可梦，因为很难搬回巢。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME does not attack its prey, instead it will slowly stalk them until they succumb to its poisonous dust. It usually doesn't go after larger Pokémon since it has no easy way to carry them back to its den.

entry: POKENAME夜里出巢觅食，会沿途撒下银色粉末，确保总能找到归路。遇上捕食者，它就用尾上的毒刺防身。
author: fiordaliso
source: When POKENAME leaves its den at night to search for food, it scatters a silvery powder so it can always find its way home. It uses the venomous spine on its tail to defend itself from predators it encounters.

entry: POKENAME跃出水面，快速振翅起飞，向下洒出浓水雾。别待在飞行路线下方，因为翼上抖落的水含有强毒。
author: sk372
source: As POKENAME leaps from the water and flaps its wings rapidly to fly, it sprinkles a heavy mist of water beneath it. One must be careful not to be beneath its flight path, as the water shaken from its wings contains potent toxins.

entry: POKENAME能通过进化，快速适应环境。但进化后，仍然痴迷强光。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are capable of rapidly adapting to their surroundings through evolution. Their obsession with bright lights remains ever present after they evolve.

entry: POKENAME夜里积极游动，追逐其他夜行宝可梦。很少离水，因为不泡在水里，皮肤就会干燥。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are active swimmers at night and chase after other nocturnal Pokémon. They are rarely found outside of a body of water because their skin dries out when they are not submerged in water.

entry: POKENAME夜行，最爱盯着亮物。幸好，它能点小火，把小灌木烧起来，打发时间。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are nocturnal creatures that love to stare at bright objects. Thankfully, they can light small flames to set small bushes ablaze and occupy their time.

entry: POKENAME夜里在窗外扑翅，盯着电脑屏幕。黎明神秘消失，只在原处留下银尘。
author: quackquackattack
source: At night, POKENAME flutter outside windows to stare at computer screens. They mysteriously vanish at dawn, leaving behind a silver dust where they were observing from.

entry: POKENAME能绘制与卫星照片一样准确的地图。画好一处，就去别处画新地图。
author: whiteupgrade
source: POKENAME can create maps that are as accurate as satellite pictures. After it has mapped one area, it travels somewhere else to make a new map.

entry: POKENAME通常温柔，却对其他龙属性宝可梦好斗。从翼上甩出的毒鳞，特别能让龙无法行动。
author: sk372
source: While generally gentle towards others, POKENAME behaves aggressively towards other Dragon types. The toxic scales it can flick from its wings are particularly effective at immobilizing other dragons.

entry: 它们每天为银粉争斗，靠它生存。原生地冬季愈发多变，这种抑制饥饿的物质，已成必需品。
author: quackquackattack
source: Daily skirmishes erupt over Silver Powder, as they rely on this substance to survive. The hunger suppressant has become a necessity as winters have become more volatile in their native environment.

entry: POKENAME夜行，却受强光吸引。有研究员认为，是因为它吃同样趋光的小生物；另一些则说，光能补充精神力量。
author: imaginita
source: POKENAME is nocturnal, but attracted to bright lights. Some researchers believe this is because it eats small creatures that are also attracted to light, while others claim that it is because the light fuels its psychic powers.

entry: POKENAME随季节迁往世界各地，却常被城市强光分心，迷失方向。许多科学家正在人们睡后调暗灯光，努力减少光污染。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME make seasonal migrations to different parts of the world but often get lost when they are distracted by bright lights from cities. Many scientists are working on cutting back on light pollution by dimming lights when people are asleep.

entry: POKENAME只在夜里现身，被满月之光吸引。翼上的鳞粉相当有毒，似乎还会轻微致幻。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME only comes out at night, drawn to the light of the full moon. The scales it produces from its wings are quite toxic and seem to have a mild hallucinogenic effect.

entry: 野生POKENAME竞相振翅，比谁扬起的花粉更绚丽。旁边若有不幸被毒翼弄得中毒的生物，它们也不在乎。
author: sk372
source: Rival POKENAME in the wild compete to see who kicks up the more dazzling display of pollen from their flapping wings. The competitors pay no heed to anyone unfortunate enough to get poisoned by their toxic flaps.

entry: POKENAME飞过夜空，体表散落奇异粉尘。晴夜里，粉尘在月光下如星辰闪烁。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME scatters a strange dust from its body as it flies through the night sky. On a clear night, this dust glimmers in the moonlight like stars.

entry: POKENAME茫然凝视夜空，只有驱赶袭击者时才振翅。若把强光放在面前，它会慢慢跟随，几乎像被催眠。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME gazes blankly into the night sky, only flapping its wings to deter attackers. However, if you put a bright light in front of it, it will slowly follow it, almost like it's in a hypnotic trance.

entry: POKENAME释放令人乏力的孢子，吸入会困倦。许多伐木工，都曾因此在工作中睡着。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME release enervating spores that cause drowsiness when inhaled. Many lumberjacks have fallen asleep on the job because of the spores of a POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME翼很娇弱，突然动作就容易受伤，白天便藏在林间灌木。夜里出来举翼，乘平缓夜风，漂入黑暗。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME wings are delicate and easily damaged by sudden movement, leading them to shelter in the forest undergrowth during the day. At night they emerge and lift their wings to catch the calmer night-time breeze, drifting away in the dark.

entry: POKENAME细绒虽软，却不适合做衣料。纤维带细倒钩和刺激性毒，织成布又扎又难受。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Despite its soft texture, the fuzz growing from POKENAME makes for poor clothing. The fibres of the fluff have fine barbs coated in an irritating toxin, making cloth spun from it scratchy and unpleasant.

entry: POKENAME翻垃圾时若受惊，就快速振翅，释放毒粉云，掩护逃跑。
author: .izik
source: If startled while scavenging through trash, POKENAME rapidly flaps its wings. This releases a cloud of Poison Powder to mask its escape.

entry: POKENAME夜里被路灯吸引，爱吊在灯柱上晃荡。甚至会用尾巴敲碎玻璃，拿走里面灯泡；灯一灭，POKENAME就十分失望。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME love to hang and swing from lampposts at night, attracted to their light.  POKENAME have even been seen using their tails to break through the glass to take the lightbulb inside, left quite disappointed once the light shuts off.

entry: POKENAME似乎会被彼此脸上发出的光吸引。每晚聚在一起，全神贯注地互相凝望，看得如痴如醉。
author: cristata
source: POKENAME are seemingly attracted to the glowing light of their own faces. They gather nightly to gaze intently at one another, completely entranced.

entry: POKENAME会向附近生物，传送心灵感应讯息。内容多半围绕光和明亮物品。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME release telepathic messages to anyone in the nearby vicinity. These thoughts often revolve around light and bright objects.

entry: POKENAME夜行，爱追逐其他宝可梦。特别狡黠时，还会用意念，把障碍推倒在目标前方。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are nocturnal creatures that love to chase after other Pokémon. When they feel particularly sly, they use their telekinesis to topple obstacles in front of their target.

entry: POKENAME振翅散出毒尘，防止其他生物在它睡觉时靠近背上花朵。它贪婪吸食树液，直到树完全发白、枯萎。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME beats its wings to release a poisonous dust so that no one tries to approach the flower on its back while it sleeps. It feeds by greedily sucking the sap from trees until they turn completely white and withered.

entry: POKENAME先咬住敌人，再释放紫色麻痹粉，让对方麻痹，暴露弱点。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME bites down on its foe before releasing a violet-hued Stun Spore. This combination leaves enemies paralyzed and vulnerable.

entry: 这种宝可梦身体覆毛。受威胁，多彩双翼就显出吓人花纹，散出会致幻的毒尘。
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher
source: This Pokémon's body is covered in fur. When threatened, its multicolored wings take on a threatening pattern and shed toxic dust that causes hallucinations.

entry: POKENAME最初被人发现时，对方以为自己出现了幻觉。翅膀让它更加灵活，便于发现危险。
author: notsaying.
source: When POKENAME was first spotted by a person, they assumed they were hallucinating. Its wings allow for extra mobility to spot danger.

entry: POKENAME白天收翼，像松果吊在树上，只在夜里飞。鳞间粉尘既有毒又极易爆炸，其他宝可梦都避开。
author: .jerden
source: During the day, POKENAME tuck away their wings and hang from trees like pine cones, and only fly around at night. They scatter a dust from between their scales that is both poisonous and highly explosive, so other Pokémon avoid them.

entry: POKENAME有第三对翅膀，模仿上部铠甲，保护下半身。喷口能射出锋利毒壳碎片，让敌人无法行动。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME has a third pair of wings that it uses to protect its lower half by mimicking its top armor. It fires sharp, toxic shards of its shell from its spouts to incapacitate foes.

entry: POKENAME眼睛多，对光与太阳格外敏感。为避开光照，体型再大，也适应了地下生活。
author: patch
source: Due to its many eyes, POKENAME is hypersensitive to light and the sun. To remedy this, it has adapted to living underground despite its massive size.

entry: POKENAME是凶猛猎手，先飞到高空，再无差别撒下数十根毒刺。麻痹毒很快生效，让POKENAME有充足时间，悠闲享用被刺穿的猎物。
author: sk372
source: Aggressive hunters, POKENAME fly up high before raining down dozens of toxic spines from their bodies indiscriminately. The paralyzing toxin takes effect quickly, giving POKENAME plenty of time to consume speared prey at their leisure.

entry: POKENAME住在熔岩流过后留下的巨石和碎屑间，白天藏着睡觉，夜里才吃周围富含矿物的玄武岩。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME live amongst the boulders and debris found in the aftermath of a lava flow, spending the day hidden amongst the rocks as they sleep. At night they emerge from their hiding places, feeding on the mineral rich basalt around them.

entry: POKENAME华美双翼一振，就能释放刺激性粉末，麻痹猎物。夜里极活跃，主要吃小型虫属性宝可梦。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME, with a single flap of its majestic wings, can release an irritating powder that paralyzes its prey. It is an extremely active predator at night and tends to feed mainly on small Bug-type Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME群居山地，寒冷时节挤在一起保暖。夜温下降，就成群优雅地滑向低处山坡，寻找庇护。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME live in colonies in mountainous regions, huddling together for warmth in colder months. When temperatures drop at night they glide down to the lower slopes, gracefully descending together in search of shelter.

entry: POKENAME只夜里出巢，猎捕其他夜行宝可梦。鳞粉的强毒一碰就让人剧痒，永不消退。唯一已知的止痒办法，是烧灼皮疹处。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME only emerge from their dens at night, hunting other nocturnal Pokémon. Their scales contain a potent toxin that causes intense itching upon contact, which never fades. The only known way to stop this itching is by cauterizing the rash.

entry: POKENAME翅膀尚未发育完全，只能在地上爬，用身体撞敌。也会从头部吐出怪色液体，既吸引对手，又造成伤害。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's wings have yet to fully develop, so POKENAME slithers on the ground and slams into foes instead. In addition, it can spit out a strange colored fluid from its head that both attracts and harms foes.

entry: POKENAME很难捕捉，鹿角能催眠，翅膀能释放多种毒素，防御手段繁多，让训练家难以下手。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is notably difficult for Trainers to catch due to its defense mechanisms; between hypnosis with its antlers and a variety of toxins emitted from its wings, it has a multitude of ways to make capturing it a challenge.

entry: POKENAME常把找到的光源存进袋中，夜里吸引其他虫属性宝可梦。灯光一灭，就会极其难过，悲伤地藏进洞穴数周。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME often keep lights they find in their pouches, attracting the attention of other Bug-Type Pokémon at night. When these lights go out, they become incredibly distressed, hiding out in caves for weeks in sadness.

entry: 它在湖面滑行，捕猎虫属性宝可梦，用娇弱的翅膀转向。身后脱落的鳞粉撒在水里，让水面闪闪发亮。
author: haypile
source: Its delicate wings are used for steering when it skates across lakes to hunt Bug-type Pokémon. It leaves a dusting of shed scales in its wake that makes the water sparkle.

entry: POKENAME经腹部引导电流，边飞边蓄能，短促释放电力，驱赶威胁。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME channels electricity through its abdomen, storing energy as it flies. The charge can be released in short bursts to ward off threats.

entry: 它们长得如入侵的旋花藤一样快，两者吃下都有毒。园丁很喜欢POKENAME在旁，因为它会帮忙除草、浇水。
author: quackquackattack
source: They grow as fast as the invasive bindweed, and both are poisonous to consume. Gardeners appreciate whenever a POKENAME is around, since the Pokémon will do the weeding and watering instead.

entry: POKENAME住在近缘物种挖的地道，担任哨兵。发现可能危险的入侵者，就用角发警戒声，提醒同伴。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME live in underground tunnels built by related species. They act as lookouts, sounding signals through their horns to alert others when they spot a potentially dangerous intruder.

entry: POKENAME夜里最活跃，趁其他宝可梦睡着，在林间游荡。它们投掷叶子做的长形飞盘，与其他夜行宝可梦玩耍。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are most active at night and wander forests while other Pokémon are asleep. They play with other nocturnal Pokémon by tossing elongated discs made of leaves.

entry: POKENAME释放冰霜，冻结想捕猎自己的生物，也能冻住池湖表面，滑走脱险。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME release an icy frost to freeze predators that try to hunt them. They can also freeze the surface of a pond or lake and skate away from danger.

entry: POKENAME生活在极地，靠厚厚的脂肪和蓬松的毛发抵御寒冷。它们整个夏季都在休眠，直到极夜才现身，在无尽的黑暗中，漫游冰原。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME live in polar regions, their thick layers of fat and coating of fuzzy fur helping to protect them from the cold. They hibernate through the summer months and emerge in the polar night, roaming the ice fields in the constant darkness.

entry: POKENAME生活在极地，靠厚厚的脂肪和蓬松的毛发抵御寒冷。它们整个夏季都在休眠，直到极夜才现身，在无尽的黑暗中，漫游冰原。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME live in polar regions, their thick layers of fat and coating of fuzzy fur helping to protect them from the cold. They hibernate through the summer months and emerge in the polar night, roaming the ice fields in the constant darkness.

entry: POKENAME的大眼对光很敏感，因此住在小洞穴。尖刺携带大量毒素，POKENAME受惊时，常会把这些毒散到空中。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME lives in small caves as its large eyes are very sensitive to light. Its spines carry a large amount of poison that often gets thrown into the air when POKENAME is frightened.

entry: POKENAME参加宝可梦对战时，会快速振翅，腾空使出接连的踢击。振翅还会抖落带麻痹性的鳞粉，若进入未愈合的伤口，就会伤害敌人。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME flutter their wings rapidly when they get into Pokémon battles, lifting off the ground as they launch their flurry of kicks. The flutter of their wings dislodges paralytic wing scales that harm their foe when they get into open injuries.

entry: POKENAME在月光下互相练习武术，身影飞转，拳脚纷飞。交战时，它们十分依赖翅膀，借翅膀带来的灵活性，取得优势。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME practice their martial arts with one another under the light of the moon, whirring around in a flurry of punches and kicks. They rely heavily on their wings during fights, using the manoeuvrability they afford them to their advantage.

entry: POKENAME夜行，聚在月下共舞。强光也会吸引它们，有时城市街道上，就会聚起大群跳舞的POKENAME。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are nocturnal Pokémon, gathering together to dance with one another under the moonlight. They are drawn to bright lights at night, and cities sometimes have large gatherings of POKENAME dancing in the street.

entry: POKENAME在月下，以超凡优雅姿态漂游，偶尔振翅调整方向。交谊舞编舞者常寻找POKENAME群体，汲取灵感。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME drift under the light of the moon with an unearthly grace, adjusting their course with occasional flutters of their wings. Gatherings of POKENAME are commonly sought out as a source of inspiration for ballroom choreographers.

entry: POKENAME在月下，以超凡优雅姿态漂游，偶尔振翅调整方向。参加化装舞会的训练家很爱带它，为夜晚增添神秘气氛。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME drift under the light of the moon with an unearthly grace, adjusting their course with occasional flutters of their wings. They are popular companions for Trainers attending a masked ball, lending an air of mystique to the evening.

entry: POKENAME聚在黑暗空地，随星光飞舞。触角能感知负面情绪，会跟随紧张旅人，作伴，抚平不安。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME gather together in dark clearings, fluttering together under the light of the stars. They can sense negative emotion through their antennae and will follow nervous travellers in an effort to offer companionship and soothe their unease.

entry: POKENAME群落合力挖出庞大地道，找块茎与根吃。夜里，有些POKENAME会伏在入口振翅，为群体带进新鲜空气。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME colonies dig extensive tunnel networks, working together to expose tubers and roots to feed on. At night, some POKENAME will crouch at the entrance to the tunnel network and whir their wings, bringing fresh air in for the colony.

entry: POKENAME极胆小，常被强光吓到。害怕就振翅散毒鳞，往往让袭击者喘不过气。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is incredibly timid and is often spooked by bright lights. When scared, it will flap its wings to scatter its poisonous scales, which often leaves its attacker gasping for air.

entry: POKENAME太迷强光，会停下手边一切，盯着看。即使如此，POKENAME每早仍会回楔石。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are so captivated by bright lights that they will stop whatever they are doing to stare at them. Despite this fascination with bright lights, POKENAME return to their keystone every morning.

entry: POKENAME有敏锐的能力，能感知其他生物的情绪与意图。它在空中撒出细鳞粉，观察鳞粉与其他生物波导的互动，再从细微动静中判断对方的神态变化。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have an uncanny ability to sense the emotions and intent of others. They do this by scattering fine wing scales into the air and watching them interact with the auras of others, reading changes in demeanour through their subtle movements.

entry: POKENAME背上华美花朵的花瓣，会随饮食变色。它强大又稀有，深受所有捕虫训练家喜爱。
author: fiordaliso
source: The petals of the majestic flower on its back can change color based on POKENAME's diet. It is a creature highly appreciated by all Bug Catchers for its strength and rarity.

entry: POKENAME的翅膀像临时耳朵，能捕捉空气最微弱的振动。它十分胆小，迫不得已才会动用强毒。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's wings act like makeshift ears, being able to pick up the slightest vibrations in the air. It is an incredibly timid Pokémon and will only use its potent poison if it absolutely has to.

entry: POKENAME一生大多在睡，只有夜里出来找食物和水，活动约两小时。休息被扰，就会愤怒好斗，把巨石和倒木扔向吵醒它的东西。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME spend most of their life sleeping, only emerging for food and water for a couple of hours at night. If their rest is disturbed, they grow angry and aggressive, hurling boulders and fallen trees at whatever woke them.

entry: POKENAME兴奋时会迅速振翅，散播毒鳞粉。它不懂得控制自己的力量，经常伤到小型宝可梦。
author: sand_coffin
source: When POKENAME gets excited, it rapidly flaps its wings, spreading poisonous scales. Unaware of its strength, it often harms smaller Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME住在城市公园，白天睡觉，让其他宝可梦在宽壳上玩。夜里灯亮，它便寻找同类的灯光，一起交往。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME make their homes in city parks, sleeping throughout the day and allowing Pokémon to play atop their broad shell. During the night, their lamp ignites and they search for the light of other POKENAME so they can socialise together.

entry: POKENAME在紫杉树上筑巢，用角折枝。有什么靠得太近，就会被撒上毒尘。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME nests in yew trees, breaking branches with its horn. It scatters a poisonous dust at anything that strays too close.

entry: POKENAME的攻势如旋风，迅速有效。面对更快的敌人，双三叉戟每挥一次都会留下花粉，拖慢对手，越战越容易命中。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's whirling dervish of an offense is quick and efficient. Against speedier foes, the twin tridents leave pollen behind with every swing that slows opponents down, making them easier to strike as the battle goes on.

entry: POKENAME扇翼撒鳞，在战场形成迷惑敌人的毒雾。它能感知雾中一切动静，确定目标，再迅速劈倒。
author: santon5512
source: By fanning their wings, POKENAME scatter their scales across the battlefield, creating a toxic fog to disorient opponents. They can sense the movement of anything in this fog, pinpointing their targets before swiftly cutting them down.

entry: POKENAME在紫杉巢树的根部撒粉红粉末，让其沾住入侵者。等毒发时，它就在附近伏击。
author: .izik
source: At the base of its yew tree nest, POKENAME spreads pink powder that lingers on intruders. As the poison sets in, it waits nearby to ambush.

entry: POKENAME夜里最活跃，会飞到合适位置，观察其他宝可梦对战。它关注战术，有时还大声嗡鸣，发出指导。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are most active at night, fluttering into position to observe battles between other Pokémon. They take interest in the strategic manoeuvres on display and will sometimes emit a loud buzz of instruction.

entry: POKENAME夜视出众，星光下巡逻辽阔领地。遇到潜在对手，就快速振翅，释放一串带电鳞粉。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have exceptional night vision and patrol their vast territories under the light of the stars. When they encounter a potential rival, they rapidly flutter their wings, unleashing a stream of electrically charged wing scales.

entry: POKENAME能可靠地伪装成其他宝可梦，却有个破绽：一有强光，POKENAME总会盯住光源，掉下淡紫鳞粉。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can reliably disguise themselves as other Pokémon but have a certain tell that reveals their true self. In the presence of bright lights, POKENAME always stare the source and shed lavender scales.

entry: 途经POKENAME栖地的训练家要小心。它会用鳞粉麻痹训练家，再抢走树果和零食。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Trainers are advised to be cautious when traveling through areas that POKENAME lives in. This is because POKENAME have been known to use their scales to paralyze Trainers before robbing them of their berries and snacks.

entry: 巨大的翅膀会洒下带着大量毒粉的鳞片。城市的明亮灯光经常将它引入人类聚居地。
author: melodydelune
source: Its large wings release scales that are full of toxic dust. It is often lured into civilization by the bright lights of cities.

entry: POKENAME毛中毒粉在飞行时散落。对人无害，却会削弱小型宝可梦。它的外貌，还启发了用绳牵着走的儿童玩具。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME's fur contains poisonous powder that scatters as it flies. While not harmful to humans, this powder weakens smaller Pokémon. Its appearance has inspired a children's toy that is dragged with a string.

entry: 历史上，POKENAME曾很受宫廷欢迎，被认为能增添优雅精致气氛。花只夜里开，散出让人放松戒备的甜香。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME were historically a popular Pokémon in royal courts, their presence considered to add an air of elegance and refinement. Their flowers bloom only at night and give off a disarmingly sweet fragrance.

entry: 历史上，POKENAME曾很受宫廷欢迎，被认为能增添优雅精致气氛。花只夜里开，散出让人放松戒备的甜香。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME were historically a popular Pokémon in royal courts, their presence considered to add an air of elegance and refinement. Their flowers bloom only at night and give off a disarmingly sweet fragrance.

entry: POKENAME战斗时先以毒尘藏身，再用带毒爪尖进攻。敏捷与隐秘出众，对手还没动，就能被它击倒。
author: mistymagius
source: In combat, POKENAME will obscure itself with its poisonous dust before striking with its poison-tipped claws. Its incredible agility and stealth allow it to fell its opponent before they can even move.

entry: POKENAME爱与人玩，恶作剧，陪着跑。若被训练家抛弃，它会找到对方，再抱一次，用毒鳞麻痹训练家，永远抱着不放。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME enjoy playing with people, pulling pranks and running alongside them as they travel. If a POKENAME is abandoned by its Trainer, it will seek them out to hug them once more, using its toxic scales to paralyze the Trainer to hold them forever.

entry: 好奇的虫属性宝可梦靠近，POKENAME就会强光一闪，电击猎物。之后身边会多出微小摩鲁蛾，因此有人相信，每只摩鲁蛾都是POKENAME偷来的灵魂。
author: icelevelincarnate
source: When curious Bug-type Pokémon draw near them, POKENAME unleashes a brilliant flash and zap their prey. More tiny Venomoth appear around them after they do this, so some believe each of their Venomoth are souls that POKENAME have stolen.

entry: POKENAME夜里胸前发强光，引来其他虫属性宝可梦。猎物靠得太近，就会被它一挥，整群抓住。
author: santon5512
source: At night, POKENAME emit a bright light from their chests, luring in other Bug-type Pokémon. Once their prey wanders too close, they strike, snagging entire swarms in a single swipe.

entry: POKENAME是夜行猎手，深夜穿过森林，寻找小型宝可梦吃。它急促抽动着搜寻，凡是动着、可能可食的东西，它都会扑过去。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are nocturnal predators that hunt through forests for smaller Pokémon to feed on in the dead of night. They move with quick, jerky motions as they search, pouncing on anything they see move that could be food.

entry: POKENAME是夜行猎手，深夜穿过森林，寻找小型宝可梦吃。受威胁时，快速摩擦双腿，从毛中释放一团带电粉尘。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are nocturnal predators that hunt through forests for smaller Pokémon to feed on in the dead of night. They rub their legs together rapidly when threatened, releasing a cloud of electrically charged dust from their fuzz.

entry: POKENAME悬在树枝或建筑檐下，柔和脉动的光，把昆虫引进半透明身体。占卜师声称，观察这些虫的消化，就能预见未来。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME suspends itself from tree branches and building overhangs while gently pulsing light to attract insects into its translucent body. Fortune tellers claim to observe the digestion of these bugs to divine the future.

entry: POKENAME每夜巡林，维持广阔领地，寻找可能威胁统治的生物。当地巡护员应避免手电筒，因为强光会让它变得好斗。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME maintain large territories, patrolling the woods each night in search of potential threats to their rule. Rangers operating in their territory are advised to avoid using flashlights as they grow aggressive if they encounter a bright light.

entry: POKENAME成群飞过，留下闪亮鳞粉，映在夜空格外耀眼。孩子常误认成流星雨，边看边许未来的愿望。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Swarms of POKENAME leave a trail of glittering wing scales behind them as they fly, a sparkling trail shining brightly against the night sky. Children often mistake a passing swarm as a meteor shower, making wishes for the future as they watch on.

entry: POKENAME夜里相互飞舞玩耍，星光穿过半透明双翼。它们很容易分心，一见流星雨，就会追过去。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME flutter and play with one another at night, their translucent wings letting the light of the stars shine through. They are easily distractible in their play and chase after meteor showers when they spot them passing by.

entry: POKENAME战时翻飞到对手上方，连续抓踢。振翅还会扬起粉尘般鳞片，让敌人更加迷乱。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME flips and flies over its opponent in battle, pummelling them with repeated scratches and kicks. Its flapping wings create a cloud of dust-like scales which further disorients its opposition.

entry: POKENAME的毛发覆着细粉，吸入后会产生麻痹效果。它们振翅，将粉尘撒向敌人，还能给粉尘充电，呈现出绚丽夺目的光景。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME fur is coated in a fine dust that has paralytic effects when breathed in. They flutter their wings to unleash this dust at their foes and can electrically charge it to make a dazzling light display.

entry: POKENAME开演前，会猛吸气，准备歌唱。唱着释放的毒尘，吸入就会困倦。
author: quackquackattack
source: Whenever POKENAME are about to perform, they take a sharp breath in to prepare for their song. As they sing, they release a toxic dust that creates drowsiness upon inhalation.

entry: POKENAME快速振翅，向周围散出有毒鳞粉，接触者会恶心、头痛。它们还将鳞粉混进巢穴的沙里，增添一层防御。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME rapidly beat their wings together to scatter their poisonous scales around them, causing nausea and headaches in anyone who comes into contact. These Pokémon mix these scales with the sand in their burrows as an added layer of defense.

entry: POKENAME成群伪装成森林野餐者，引好奇生物靠近，再释放麻痹粉，拖走受害者。
author: .izik
source: Disguised as forest picnickers, groups of POKENAME lure in the curious. Once close, they release paralyzing powder and drag their victims away.

entry: POKENAME不会飞，却常扇翅，掉落一碰就灼皮的鳞粉。POKENAME只在夜里活动，吐出火光，照亮暗处。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME cannot fly but often flap their wings, shedding powdery scales that burn skin on contact. POKENAME are only active at night and will spit out flashes of fire to illuminate their dark surroundings.

entry: POKENAME飞行时深吸气，再呼出闪亮蓝尘，能立即击昏猎物。春季最活跃。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME inhales deeply in flight, then exhales shimmering blue dust. This powder knocks out prey instantly. It is most active in spring.

entry: POKENAME爱群居，夜里相聚月下。快速展开卷耳，能打出强拳，命中还会喷一团毒粉，迷惑敌人。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are social creatures, emerging at night to gather under the moonlight. By rapidly uncoiling their ears, they can deliver a powerful punch, releasing a puff of toxic powder on impact to disorient foes.

entry: POKENAME夜里漂在路灯旁看光，不断掉落亮粉，黏在体外液体上，让POKENAME染成明亮淡紫色。
author: quackquackattack
source: At night, POKENAME float around lampposts to stare at the bright light. Through the course of the night, POKENAME shed a bright dust that clings to the fluid around their body, dyeing themselves a bright lilac color.

entry: 核心的不同部分能独立移动，却多保持蛾形。外层胶壳，接触久了会引起幻觉。
author: sk372
source: The different bits of its core can move individually, but tend to stay in the shape of a moth. The gelatinous shell around it contains hallucinogenic properties if prolonged contact is maintained.

entry: POKENAME翼毒较弱，只能靠振翅速度和次数弥补。先让猎物几乎沾满毒、无法行动，再吸食血液。
author: sk372
source: The poison in POKENAME's wings is mild, so it must make up for potency with the speed and amount of flapping. It almost completely coats prey with poison to immobilize them before it begins drinking their blood.

entry: POKENAME在蛛网间飞行，定期把电送入导电纤维，维持每张网带电。它们极敏捷，却很弱小。
author: evilgammon
source: Able to fly from web to web, POKENAME keeps each structure charged by regularly depositing electricity into the conductive fibres. They are extremely nimble, but very weak.

entry: POKENAME夜里常吊在路灯上。种子剧毒，落地处整整一个月，都长不了植物。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME can usually be seen hanging from streetlamps during the night. Its seeds are so toxic that the area where the seeds land will be barren of plant life for a full month.

entry: POKENAME夜里聚向城市，因为人造灯光会激活脑中与安全感有关的部分。黎明后，又继续原本的迁徙。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME flock to cities at night because the artificial lighting activates a part of their brain associated with safety. Once dawn comes, they resume their migration to wherever they were headed.

entry: POKENAME飞得不好，却几乎能攀上丛林所有表面。它在树顶吃叶子，也散播毒孢子。
author: bobosmith01
source: While it cannot fly very well, POKENAME has the ability to climb on nearly any surface in the jungle. From the treetops, it spreads toxic spores while it feasts on leaves.

entry: POKENAME滚过开阔林地，从翼上掉落紫粉。吸入者几分钟内，就会陷入沉睡。
author: .izik
source: As it rolls through open glades, POKENAME sheds violet powder from its wings. Victims who inhale it fall into a deep sleep within minutes.

entry: POKENAME过于沉重，翅膀已无法带它飞行，转而用来释放有毒且能致幻的花粉。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME has become too heavy to fly with its wings. Instead, it uses them to exude poisonous and hallucinogenic pollen.

entry: POKENAME十分胆小，只在多云夜晚出来。翼上产生的毒鳞云，会让沾染的植物逐渐枯萎。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are very timid and will only come out on cloudy nights. Their wings produce clouds of poisonous scales that can cause any contaminated plant to slowly wither away.

entry: POKENAME周围总有薄尘云。这些粉尘质感像粉笔，数量足够多时，会成为神经毒素。
author: turron_turron
source: POKENAME is always surrounded by a thin cloud of dust. Chalky in texture, this substance acts as a neurotoxin in high enough quantities.

entry: POKENAME难觅踪影，只爱在黑夜捕猎。它怕强光，会攻击人造光源，试图熄灭，因此对低飞飞机十分危险。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are elusive Pokémon that prefer to hunt only on dark nights. They are sensitive to bright lights and attack artificial light sources in an effort to extinguish them, making them a hazard to low-flying aircraft.

entry: POKENAME腹部产细丝，绕身形成毛绒外层。翼上毒尘困在丝中，挨打就会散成浓云。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME produce a fine silk from their stomachs, forming a fur-like coat around themselves. Toxic dust from their wings gets trapped within this silk, scattering in a thick cloud when struck.

entry: POKENAME群落附近村庄的住户，夜里最好把灯调暗。它们受强光吸引，见屋内灯亮，就会爬上窗户，沿途留下满窗黏液。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Households in villages near POKENAME populations are advised to dim their lights at night. POKENAME are drawn to bright lights and crawl up windows if they see lights left on inside, leaving a trail of slime all over the windows as they do.

entry: POKENAME背上的蘑菇鲜亮美味，采摘却须小心。一摘下，POKENAME就会本能地从蘑菇孔口，喷出一阵刺激性毒。
author: sk372
source: The mushrooms on POKENAME's back are bright and flavorful, but great care must be taken if harvesting them; when removed, POKENAME instinctively releases a burst of irritating poison from the mushroom's pore.

entry: POKENAME头上长着耀眼翼状结构，虽然抢眼，真正用途却是放大歌声。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have dazzling, wing-like structures that grow from their heads. As attention grabbing as these structures are, their true purpose is to magnify the volume of their songs.

entry: POKENAME头上长着耀眼翼状结构，虽然抢眼，真正用途却是放大歌声。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have dazzling, wing-like structures that grow from their heads. As attention grabbing as these structures are, their true purpose is to magnify the volume of their songs.

entry: POKENAME的大蘑菇不停落孢子，在腿上积成薄尘。积得太难受，就会振翅散去，无意间传播真菌。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME constantly shed spores from their large mushrooms, a fine dusting of them settling on their legs. When the build up becomes too irritating for them, they flap their wings to disperse them, inadvertently spreading the fungus as they do.

entry: POKENAME住在岩岸，白天在海边洞穴休息。入夜，受灯吸引，曾被看见用爪攀上灯塔。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME live on rocky shores, resting in seaside caverns until night. Once dark, POKENAME have been seen using their claws to scale lighthouses, attracted to their light.

entry: POKENAME毒粉多得能把整辆汽车埋在五英尺深的粉尘里。想与POKENAME共事的训练家，基本得全程戴呼吸防护面具。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is covered in so much poisonous dust, that it can bury an entire car five feet deep. Trainers that want to work with POKENAME are basically required to wear a respirator at all times.

entry: POKENAME抵不住光诱惑，会穿过开窗偷灯，到哪都带着。毛不停掉，在闯过的人家留上数日，引起刺激。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are irresistibly attracted to light, slipping through open windows to steal lamps from homes, carrying them wherever they go. Their fur sheds constantly and lingers in the houses they've raided for days, causing irritation.

entry: POKENAME吊在腐树，随风散播毒鳞。谁靠得太近，就用藤缠住，再一振翅，以鳞粉迎面猛袭。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME hangs from decaying trees. spending its poisonous scales along the wind. If anyone gets too close, it will wrap them in its vines before blasting them with a gust of its scales.

entry: POKENAME双翼泛虹彩，微光下颜色最灿烂。宝石能引导精神力量，让它安全地远攻。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME wings shimmer with an iridescent sheen, the colours at their most brilliant in dim light. Their gem is used to channel psychic power, enabling them to launch attacks from a safe distance.

entry: POKENAME深藏森林，用腹光引来其他虫宝可梦。藤上数千毒鳞，一吸入就十分危险。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME hides away deep in the forest, the light from its belly attracts other Bug Pokémon. Its vines are covered in thousands of poisonous scales that are incredibly dangerous to breathe in.

entry: POKENAME靠车轮，各种地形都能轻松通过。它以击败强大龙属性宝可梦闻名，有时被叫作“屠龙者”。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's wheels allow it to traverse over all terrains with equal ease. It has a reputation for defeating powerful Dragon-type Pokémon in combat, sometimes being nicknamed The Dragonslayer.

entry: 有些POKENAME比未融合的摩鲁蛾，长出更厚的体绒，能住在更高海拔，却也更倾向避开火焰。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Some POKENAME develop much thicker body fuzz than unfused Venomoth. Their thicker body fuzz allows them to make their homes at higher altitudes but makes them more likely to avoid flames.

entry: 有些POKENAME比未融合的摩鲁蛾更吓人，翼上有明亮眼斑，腹部似有毒刺。看着凶，实际却不比其他POKENAME更危险。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Some POKENAME have a far more intimidating appearance than unfused Venomoth, their wings bearing bright eye spots and their abdomen appearing to have stingers. Despite their aggressive appearance, they are no more dangerous than other POKENAME.

entry: 有人推测，POKENAME比未融合的原型更聪明。它用刺威吓，也当可抓握物体的工具。
author: arveral
source: POKENAME has been speculated to possess more inteligence compared to their unfused counterpart. It uses its stingers in both threatening displays and as prehensile tools.

entry: POKENAME产生明亮、易燃的凝胶，烧后形成毒烟云。许多人报告，吸入后会长期迟缓无力。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME produce a bright, flammable gel that creates toxic clouds of smoke when burnt. Many people report prolonged sluggishness after they inhale the noxious smoke.

entry: POKENAME夜里出来，撒亮紫粉麻痹猎物，再拖到地下，慢慢吞食。
author: .izik
source: At night, POKENAME emerges to scatter shimmering purple dust that paralyzes prey. It then drags victims underground to consume them slowly.

entry: POKENAME看见有人在洞里游荡，就从隐蔽地道释放粉红粉末，先震住入侵者，再拖往地下。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME spots someone wandering its caves, it releases pink powder from its hidden tunnels. The powder stuns intruders before they are dragged underground.

entry: POKENAME智力迟钝，飞来飞去，看似漫无目的。其实它有“趋闪性”，大眼一直在搜寻闪亮东西。
author: creaturecore
source: POKENAME has an extremely dull intellect and flits and flutters seemingly aimlessly. In actuality, it's "shinytactic" - it is attracted to shiny things, and its big eyes are always scanning for them.

entry: POKENAME翅膀掉落的细粉，会引发剧烈偏头痛。长时间接触，还常使人混乱、失去方向。
author: .izik
source: The fine powder that falls from POKENAME's wings can trigger intense migraines. Prolonged exposure often causes confusion and disorientation.

entry: 路人一靠近，它就暴怒，无端攻击。可POKENAME为散毒尘用力振翅，小小身体常反被带上天空，远离目标。
author: lordjoostmeister
