source: It flies into a rage when passersby approach, attacking unprovoked. However, since POKENAME energetically beats its wings to scatter poisonous dust, its small body is often carried up and away from its target.

entry: POKENAME发怒，尘云就会包住身体。这些粉尘增强肾上腺素反应，往往让事态越闹越大。
author: quackquackattack
source: Whenever POKENAME are angry, they produce a billow of dust that surrounds their body. This dust heightens an adrenaline response that tends to escalate situations.

entry: 牧场主常用POKENAME照看派拉斯。它警觉而温柔，吃到最爱的蘑菇点心，还会放出多彩火花，逗孩子开心。
author: ghostslythe
source: Used heavily by Ranchers to herd Paras, POKENAME is a watchful and gentle guard Pokémon. When given its favorite mushroom treat, it often sends out sparks of various colors to entertain children.

entry: POKENAME飞行时释放一串串泡泡，清除前方障碍。泡上有奇异保护层，闪闪发亮。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME releases streams of bubbles mid-flight to clear obstacles in its path. The bubbles shimmer with a strange, protective coating.

entry: POKENAME的毒鳞只要碰到皮肤，毒就会迅速渗入大脑，使人失去知觉。幸好，它只在夜里活动。
author: darkweavile428
source: If any of POKENAME's poisonous scales touch your skin, the poison will quickly seep into your brain and make you unconscious. Thankfully, it is only active at night.

entry: 据说，它所持的花蕴含月光。POKENAME虽肌肉强壮，却优雅胆小，宁愿逃走，也不参加本可凭力量获胜的战斗。
author: kam_doodle_snek
source: The flower it wields is said to be imbued with moonlight. Despite POKENAME's muscular build, it is an incredibly graceful and timid Pokémon. It would rather flee from a battle that it would otherwise win due to its strength.

entry: POKENAME在林间找最重的植物，选好就连根拔起，带着飞一整夜，锻炼力量。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME flit around woodlands searching for the heaviest plants they can find. Once they find a likely candidate, they heave it out of the ground and spend all night flying with it to work on their strength.

entry: POKENAME肌肉发达、战法多样，是摔跤手喜爱的伙伴，能陪训练家磨炼动作。POKENAME也能抓住敌人飞起，使出猛烈的地球上投。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are popular companions for wrestlers, their muscular physique and varied combat style giving their Trainers the opportunity to practice their form. POKENAME can deliver a brutal Seismic Toss by grabbing their foe and flying through the air.

entry: POKENAME吊在高树，从翼上散毒尘。入夜后，POKENAME便飞下林地，吃被毒尘击倒的生物。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME hangs from tall trees, spreading poisonous dust from its wings. Once night falls, POKENAME will fly down to the forest to feed on anything that has succumbed to its dust.

entry: POKENAME用长而柔韧的肢体，在树枝间荡行，找白天睡觉的地方。大眼怕光，却能暗中视物，帮助夜里寻找树果。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME use their long, flexible limbs to swing through tree branches in search of a place to sleep for the day. Their bulbous eyes are sensitive to light and allow them to see in the dark, helping them find berries to feed on during the night.

entry: POKENAME住在原始森林深处，夜里用长触须，翻找倒木里的猎物。人造光让巨复眼疼痛，因此它避开人类。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME make their homes deep in old-growth forests, using their long tendrils to search through fallen trees for prey at night. They shun human contact, as the artificial lights used by people are painfully bright to their giant compound eyes.

entry: POKENAME大眼敏锐，石头最细的裂缝也能发现。它会花数日把巨石打成碎块，强化臂肌。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's wide eyes possess a sharp sight, letting it detect even the faintest cracks in stone. It strengthens its arm muscles by pummeling boulders into rubble over the course of several days.

entry: POKENAME身后留下闪亮尘云，喜爱夜里奔过草地，也会被附近人家的强光吸引。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME leave clouds of shimmering dust in their wake. They enjoy galloping through grass at night and are drawn to bright lights from nearby homes.

entry: POKENAME疾跑时，从翼上释放滚烫紫粉，身后的空气，因带毒热浪而闪动。
author: .izik
source: While sprinting, POKENAME releases clouds of hot purple powder from its wings. The air behind it shimmers with toxic heat.

entry: POKENAME一生大多懒躺，只有食物唾手可得，才肯移动。闲扇翅膀时不断掉鳞粉，在周围积成大堆，有时甚至把它自己吞没。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME prefer to lounge around for most of their lives, only moving when given an easy meal. These Pokémon constantly shed dusty scales from their wings as they idly flap, which build up around them in large piles, sometimes even consuming them.

entry: POKENAME尾毛带微小尖刺，接触会受刺激、发痒。毛不断脱落，散得训练家家中到处都是。
author: santon5512
source: The fur along POKENAME's tail is lined with microscopic spikes, causing irritation and itching upon contact. This fur constantly sheds, scattering throughout its Trainer's homes.

entry: POKENAME用小杖般的东西，向其他生物散出小团花粉。它似乎以为在施助人法术，花粉实际上却常使人病倒。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses a small wand of sorts to spread little bursts of its pollen to others. It seems to believe it is casting helpful spells, but in reality, the pollen tends to make others sick.

entry: POKENAME太重，飞不起来，沉重护壳又限制行动。它改用翅膀扇风攻敌，同时抖落毒粉。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are too heavy to be able to fly, their weighty protective shell heavily limiting their mobility. Instead, they use their wings to flap gusts of wind at their foes, shedding toxic powder from their wings as they do so.

entry: POKENAME飞行时，不断释放毒尘云。粉尘刺激性极强，谁碰到都会发痒。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME's body constantly emits a toxic cloud of dust as they fly. This dust is highly irritating, causing itching in anyone it comes into contact with.

entry: POKENAME在树果树间嬉戏，洒下帮助树木生长的粉末。粉末也能安抚心绪，用于治疗失眠与焦虑。
author: noel5229
source: POKENAME frolics among Berry trees, sprinkling powder which helps them grow. Its powder's soothing properties are used to treat insomnia and anxiety.

entry: POKENAME虽因发光身体显得可怕，实际很友好。许多个体会帮咖啡馆卖食物，甚至愿意让人取身体，做成“南瓜精焗菜”来吃。
author: quackquackattack
source: While POKENAME may seem scary because of their glowing bodies, they are rather friendly. Many POKENAME enjoy helping cafes sell food and even allow people to eat from their bodies in the form of Gratin a la Pumpkaboo.

entry: POKENAME夜游森林、城镇，用棍子奏诡异旋律。有些人形成献供传统，安抚它，也避开传闻由乐声引起的诅咒。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME wander forests and towns at night, using their sticks to create eerie melodies. Some people have made a tradition of leaving offerings for these Pokémon to appease them and ward off the speculated curses wrought by their music.

entry: POKENAME的面具不断生长，因此带着骨制刻刀，调整孔洞。没刻刀，面具孔就会合拢，让它看不见。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME wear a mask that grows constantly, so they carry a carving knife made out of bone to adjust the holes in their mask. Without the carving knife, the holes in their mask would close and render them unable to see.

entry: POKENAME用头发连打对手，拳头能击碎混凝土。出拳时头发还能伸长，远攻、缠住敌人。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME use their hair to send a flurry of punches at opponents, their fists able to break concrete. They can extend their hair while punching, striking foes from afar, and ensnaring them.

entry: POKENAME用覆满黏毛的双臂，拖动身体。捕食者想吃它，就把手臂塞进对方嘴里，让毛脱落，引起强烈刺激。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME pulls its body around using arms covered in sticky hairs. It also uses these arms as defense against Pokémon that would eat it by sticking the arms into the predator's mouth and allowing hairs to flake off, causing intense irritation.

entry: POKENAME轻轻抱住不安的草属性宝可梦，释放温暖的金南果香，几乎立刻安抚。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME hugs distressed Grass-type Pokémon gently. It releases a warm Pumkin Berry scent that calms them almost instantly.

entry: 平静夜里，POKENAME成群涌向农场，大吃庄稼。农民说，袭击后，空气留着南瓜味。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: On calm nights, POKENAME swarm farms to feast on the crops. Farmers report a scent of pumpkin in the air after an attack.

entry: 朔月之夜，POKENAME爱把人困进无形迷宫，追赶穿行。歌结束前没到出口，就会被拖往死后世界。
author: chaoticanzu
source: On the night of a new moon, POKENAME likes to trap people in invisible mazes and chase them through. Those who fail to reach the exit before its song ends are dragged to the afterlife.

entry: POKENAME无声穿过暗林，用身体发光的空心面孔催眠目标。对方被诡光迷住，便从阴影以剃刀般的镰爪，精准出击。
author: msdawgs
source: POKENAME slips silently through dark forests, using the glowing, hollow face on its body to hypnotize targets. Once they are dazed by the eerie light, it strikes flawlessly from the shadows with its razor-sharp, scythe-like claws.

entry: 谁骑上POKENAME，都会被载往死后世界。发状双臂冰冷，一碰就令受害者动弹不得，方便带走。
author: soup1900
source: Anyone who rides on POKENAME gets sailed into the afterlife. Its hairlike arms are freezing to the touch, immobilizing the victim and making them easier to carry off.

entry: 据说POKENAME各个体的歌，随环境而异，听者却全会受诅咒。看似耳朵的其实是手臂，能彻底缠住目标。
author: infinex21
source: The song of each individual POKENAME is said to be different depending on their environs, yet it is said that songs curse all who hear them. What appear to be ears are actually arms, with which they can thoroughly ensnare their targets.

entry: 这些湖居宝可梦，从发丝般的大触须放出明亮却不祥的光，最暗深处也照得见。满月之夜会浮出，唱迷人旋律，引来许多生物。
author: infinex21
source: These lake-dwelling Pokémon emit a bright, albeit ominous, light from their large, hair-like feelers even from the darkest depths. On nights with full moons, they emerge and sing enchanting melodies that draw many to them.

entry: 这些宝可梦能制造、储存大量电力，连身体也泛起微光。它们放电，让其他生物震住受惊，产生许多恐惧供自己吃。
author: infinex21
source: These electrogenic Pokémon can produce and store so much electricity that their own bodies will emit faint flashes of light. They release electric bolts to stun and startle others, producing plenty of fear for them to feed on.

entry: POKENAME唱歌排出多余空气，帮助体内火囊冷却。战斗时，用发状附肢缠敌，再喷火。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME sing to expel excess air, which helps to keep their internal flame sacs cool. In battle, they use their hair-like appendages to entangle foes before breathing fire upon them.

entry: 发光火焰的舞动吸引众多生物，噼啪声据说像音乐，且每个体的“音乐”各不相同。战斗时，火焰轰鸣，头发般的藤蔓升起。
author: infinex21
source: The dancing of its luminescent flames entices many, while the crackling of said flames is said to sound like music. Reportedly, the "music" sounds different for each individual. In battle, its flames roar and its hair-like vines rise into the air.

entry: POKENAME体内柔光，从前方孔洞透出。虽然暗，却能安抚婴幼儿，常哄得他们入睡。
author: jaminmcready
source: A soft light glows from inside POKENAME and shines through holes on its front. Though dim, the glow calms infants and young children, often lulling them to sleep.

entry: POKENAME在秋日傍晚漂过田野，散播发光孢子，滋养枯萎植物。农民欢迎它，将其到来视为丰收征兆。
author: vracken
source: POKENAME drifts through fields on autumn evenings, scattering glowing spores that nourish withering plants. Farmers welcome its arrival as a sign of a bountiful harvest.

entry: POKENAME腹部发光的灯笼脸，引猎物入网。黏住后，许多手便把猎物完全裹好。网有糖甜南瓜味，不洗就十分黏。
author: pjporwoll
source: The glowing lantern face on POKENAME's abdomen attracts prey to its web, where they become stuck and it fully webs them up with the aid of its many hands. The webbing has a sugary pumpkin flavor, but is very sticky until washed.

entry: POKENAME夜里高兴地漂在金南果树上方，白天睡枝头，发出轻柔、令人安心的咕咕声。
author: .izik
source: At night, POKENAME floats joyfully above Pumkin Berry trees. During the day, it naps on the branches, letting out soft, comforting coos.

entry: POKENAME的毛由体内长出的细根构成，跳跃时随风飘动。身体极轻，轻易就能跳很远，是敏捷迅速的旅者。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's hairs are made up of tiny roots that grow from its body, fluttering through the air as it hops. Its body is extremely light and able to jump long distances with little effort, making it a swift and agile traveler.

entry: POKENAME用耳状双臂收集泥，涂在身上降温，因此总带潮湿泥土味。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME gathers mud with its ear-like arms and coats its body to stay cool. Its habit gives it a constantly damp and earthy scent.

entry: 许多故事说，POKENAME会在月夜沿街走，唱诡异旋律。满月时，部分身体泛柔光，歌也最响。
author: infinex21
source: Many tales speak of POKENAME that appear on moonlit nights, strolling through streets while singing eerie melodies. On nights when the moon is full, parts of their bodies glow softly, and their songs are at their loudest.

entry: POKENAME羽毛带南瓜香，质地像叶。许多文化将羽毛与茶同煮，给压力大的人喝，以舒缓香气带来慰藉。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's pumpkin-scented feathers are similar in texture to leaves. Many cultures boil the feathers with tea as a calming drink for those who are stressed, offering relief with its soothing fragrance.

entry: 附在POKENAME头上的南瓜怪人，像操木偶一样，控制每个动作。据说，它们正吞食这些宝可梦的灵魂，让躯体漫无目的地游荡。
author: santon5512
source: The Gourgeists attached to POKENAME's heads puppeteer them, controlling their every move. It is said that they are consuming these Pokémon's souls, leaving their bodies wandering around aimlessly.

entry: POKENAME的怪歌，曾被发现能促进多种作物生长。每年秋季，许多村庄会举行特别仪式，感谢它。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's strange song has been known to boost the growth of various crops. Every autumn season, many rural villages hold special ceremonies to give thanks to the Pokémon.

entry: 日落，POKENAME头发如火把闪动，以光诱旅人走向悬崖，吃他们坠落时的恐惧。
author: .izik
source: At sunset, POKENAME's hair glows like a flickering torch. Its blinking lights lure travelers toward cliffs so it can feed on their fear as they fall.

entry: POKENAME上半身本能地保护南瓜状躯干。挨打，就会从嘴里突然轰出精神能量还击。
author: .izik
source: The upper half of POKENAME moves instinctively to protect its pumpkin-like torso. If struck, it retaliates with a sudden psychic blast from within its mouth.

entry: POKENAME吊在松树，散出腐南瓜味，驱赶捕食者。迫不得已，就会引爆烈火，保护自己与家。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME hangs from pine trees, releasing a rotten pumpkin scent to keep predators away. As a final resort, it unleashes a fiery explosion to defend itself and its home.

entry: 十月过后，有时能见POKENAME吃丢弃的雕刻南瓜。有些训练家，还用POKENAME烹煮南瓜籽。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME can sometimes be found feeding on abandoned carved pumpkins after October. Some Trainers use POKENAME to cook pumpkin seeds.

entry: POKENAME嚎声在中空身体里共鸣，响得可怕，听得到的一切都会着火。少有例外，只有它珍爱的对象，仅毛发被燎焦。
author: dolly_cholli
source: POKENAME's howls resonate in its hollow body, making a dreadful cacophony that sets anything in earshot alight. There are rare exceptions, as those dear to it only find their hairs singed.

entry: POKENAME几乎不需进食，大多安睡海底。不过，据说一被打扰，就能把附近所有宝可梦吓死。
author: stevethebarbarian
source: POKENAME barely needs to eat and mostly slumbers peacefully on the seafloor. When it's bothered, though, it's said it can frighten all nearby Pokémon to death.

entry: 被POKENAME寄居的设备，会发出怪南瓜味。人们认为，它们住进胆小者的电脑，吸收对方的疑惧维生。
author: chibitales
source: Devices that POKENAME have infested emit an odd pumpkin smell. They are thought to gain sustenance by absorbing feelings of paranoia from the meeker people whose computers they inhabit.

entry: 那股蛇形的诡异气息，才是POKENAME真身，铠甲由收集的腐蔬菜构成。出没时，常伴腐南瓜恶臭。
author: adam_dnh
source: The serpentine ghastly aura is POKENAME's true body, while its armor is formed from rotten vegetables it has gathered. Sightings of this Pokémon are often accompanied by the putrid stench of decaying pumpkins.

entry: 这只美丽宝可梦，偶尔飞过秋夜天空。传闻若它飞过农田，秋季就会丰收。
author: opossiblymage
source: This beautiful Pokémon is sometimes spotted flying in the autumnal night skies. It is rumored that if it flies over a plot of farm land, the fall harvest will be bountiful.

entry: POKENAME带着大锅，据说里面炖汤能治好大多数病痛。它常分给病饿的宝可梦，因此POKENAME很受医院欢迎。
author: actliux
source: The large cauldron POKENAME carries is said to contain a stew that can cure most ailments. It is often seen giving this stew to sick or hungry Pokémon, making POKENAME a popular choice for use in hospitals.

entry: 朔月升起，这只宝可梦用诡声引人，模仿对方最想见的人，再带往死后世界。
author: chaoticanzu
source: When a new moon rises, this Pokémon lures people in with an eerie voice, mimicking the person they most wish to see before leading them to the afterlife.

entry: 这些生物爱树果，最爱营养与甜美恰好的茄番果。吃得太多，消化完全部树果后，反会更慢。
author: quackquackattack
source: These creatures love berries and prefer the Tamato Berry above all else as it is the perfect balance of nutrition and sweetness. They are known to eat so much that they get slower after digesting all the berries.

entry: POKENAME以惊人高速，向目标发射爆炸南瓜。收获季，常被派去守瓜田，对付黑暗鸦之类。
author: actliux
source: POKENAME shoots explosive pumpkins at insane velocities at their target. They are often deployed to defend pumpkin patches from the likes of Murkrow during the harvest season.

entry: POKENAME高速划过暮空，眼中燃光留下不散的诡光轨迹。有人把振翅声，比作低低怪笑。
author: sk372
source: The burning light in POKENAME's eyes casts a lingering trail of eerie light as it cuts through the evening sky at high speeds. Some have likened the sound of its beating wings to soft, creepy laughter.

entry: 歌声的诅咒会带来沉睡，可失眠者等一些人，反而视作福音。它们代谢月光，产生洁净空气，这也是多数人容忍它们的原因。
author: infinex21
source: The curses wrought by their songs bring deep slumber, yet some, such as insomniacs, consider this a boon rather than a curse. They metabolize moonlight and produce clean air around them; the latter is why most put up with them.

entry: 它能冻结发状触须上的刚毛，变成利刃，在北方针叶林游荡。叫声如诡异歌谣，许多人相信，会令听者受无尽寒冷的诅咒。
author: infinex21
source: It can freeze the bristles lining its hairlike feelers to turn them into sharp blades. It wanders boreal forests, its cries reminiscent of eerie songs that many believe will curse listeners to an endless cold.

entry: POKENAME守护南瓜田，赶走黑暗鸦、烈雀等闯入的宝可梦。白天非战斗时更爱静止，夜里则活跃许多。
author: jangodiot
source: POKENAME watch over pumpkin patches and scare off any intruding Pokémon like Murkrow or Spearow. These Pokémon prefer to be stationary in the day outside of battle, but become much more active at night.

entry: POKENAME不断评估自身损伤，觉得快被击倒，就会投出警告标志。昏倒前，还唱警告歌，催训练家介入。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME constantly assess the level of damage they have suffered, projecting warning signs when they believe themselves to be in danger of being knocked out. They sing a warning song just before they faint, urging their trainer to intervene.

entry: POKENAME看似顽皮，却极忠于训练家，守护作为家园的田地。训练家或家受威胁，就会以骇人速度踢出南瓜。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Despite their mischievous appearance, POKENAME are incredibly loyal to their Trainers and will guard the patches they call home. Should they encounter a threat to their Trainer or home, they will kick their pumpkin at breakneck speeds.

entry: POKENAME在浅泥打盹时被扰，会从鳍放出葫芦般恶臭，驱赶入侵者。若仍不走，就喷出高压水柱。
author: .izik
source: When disturbed while napping in shallow mud, POKENAME emits a foul gourd-like odor from its fins to drive intruders away. If this does not deter them, it will spit water in highly pressurized jets.

entry: 传闻听到POKENAME哼顽皮歌曲，会受诅咒数周。奇怪的是，它似乎更常在乐观者身边哼唱。
author: h0bojoe
source: Those who hear POKENAME hum its playful song are rumoured to be cursed for weeks. Strangely, it seems to hum more often around those with positive dispositions.

entry: 它喜欢其他生物开心，常唱歌表达喜爱。不过，惹它不快，不是受永久诅咒，就是被意念碾碎。
author: h0bojoe
source: It delights in the happiness of others and will often sing to express its adoration. However, those who upset it will either be cursed forever or psychokinetically crushed.

entry: 它夜里漂过街道，邪歌诅咒所有听者。以意念将敌人压进地面，逼其听歌，直到心神枯竭。
author: h0bojoe
source: It floats through town streets at night cursing anyone who hears its wicked melody. It psychokinetically crushes foes into the ground, forcing them to endure its song until their spirits wither.

entry: 它夜里漂过街道，邪歌诅咒所有听者。以意念将敌人压进地面，逼其听歌，直到心神枯竭。
author: h0bojoe
source: It floats through town streets at night cursing anyone who hears its wicked melody. It psychokinetically crushes foes into the ground, forcing them to endure its song until their spirits wither.

entry: 它夜游街道，遇见谁就打斗抢劫，开心唱着邪曲，用诅咒镰刀劈倒对手。
author: h0bojoe
source: It wanders through town streets at night fighting and robbing anyone it finds. It joyfully sings a wicked tune as it cuts down opponents with its cursed scythe.

entry: POKENAME体内满是南瓜籽，恰有108颗包含大部分能量。其中任何一颗离体，它都会变得十分迟钝。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body is filled with countless pumpkin seeds, but exactly 108 contain the majority of its energy. Should any be separated from its body, it grows very sluggish.

entry: POKENAME深受乡村训练家喜爱，与秋收有天生联系，能判断南瓜何时成熟，是宝贵的帮手。它们爱在田间奔跑玩耍，叶片拖在身后。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are popular Pokémon for Trainers in rural communities, their innate connection to the autumn harvest making them invaluable at knowing when pumpkins are ripe. They love to play in the fields, racing around as their leaves trail behind them.

entry: POKENAME照料背上南瓜，秋季庆典用来吸引孩子。聚得够多，就一起玩游戏，分发瓜里的树果。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME maintain the pumpkin atop their backs to attract children during fall festivals. Once enough children have gathered, they play games and distribute berries from within the pumpkin.

entry: POKENAME用发状触手挖出沙中猎物，缠住后，分泌消化酶。传闻朔月之夜，岸边能听见POKENAME受害者的声音。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME use their hairlike tentacles to dig up their prey in the sand. Once found, POKENAME ensnare their prey before excreting a digestive enzyme. On nights of a new moon, it is said that POKENAME's victims can be heard on shorelines.

entry: POKENAME厚鳞的成分，类似南瓜壳。受压时会硬化，坚固得超过大理石，增强抵御物理攻击的能力。
author: .izik
source: The thick scales on POKENAME's body are similar in makeup to pumpkin shells. When stressed, the shells harden to become sturdier than marble, providing enhanced defense against physical attacks.

entry: 传说，若广受敬奉，POKENAME一天能种出1000个南瓜。多数学者只把它当儿童民间故事。
author: .izik
source: Legends claim that when widely revered, POKENAME can grow 1,000 pumpkins in a single day. Most scholars consider these accounts children's folklore.

entry: 野生POKENAME夜巡暗镇，寻找迷路宝可梦，引往下一站。它如何知道对方想去哪，至今仍是谜。
author: npshi
source: At night, wild POKENAME patrol dark towns to find lost Pokémon and guide them to their next destination. How they know where the Pokémon wishes to go remains a mystery to this day.

entry: 若对战未决，POKENAME就会一路跟踪对手，直到再次受挑战。果肉状鬃毛里的种子，可以烤来吃。
author: hophoppip
source: If a battle against it is left unfinished, POKENAME stalks its foe until challenged again. The seeds from its pulpy mane can be roasted and eaten.

entry: 这只宝可梦绰号“南瓜女巫”，会折磨闯入所住瓜田者。每次使坏之后，三个迷你葫芦就齐声怪笑。
author: hophoppip
source: Nicknamed the Pumpkin Witch, this Pokémon torments anyone who enters the pumpkin patch where it lives. Its three Mini-Gourds let out a chorus of cackles after each devious trick.

entry: POKENAME爱在城镇挑起骚乱。造成的混乱越多，火把越亮；环境平静，火就变暗。一熄灭，POKENAME就退入暗处，谋划下一场动乱。
author: actliux
source: POKENAME love to incite riots in towns and cities. The fire on their torch burns brighter the more anarchy they cause, and dims in calm environments. When the fire goes out, POKENAME will retreat to the shadows to plot its next uprising.

entry: 满月时，POKENAME漂过市街，发出诡异歌声。据说它从南瓜长出，后来生翼飞走。
author: blueberry_da_dwagon
source: As POKENAME floats down city streets on the full moon, POKENAME emits an eerie singing noise. It is said to have grown from a pumpkin, but grew wings and flew off.

entry: POKENAME伪装成人，混进秋季庆典人群。幻象虽好，强烈南瓜派香，却总会暴露身份。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME disguises itself as a human to blend in with crowds during fall festivals. Despite its illusions, its strong pumpkin pie scent always gives it away.

entry: 朔月之夜，许多森林都能听见POKENAME甜美却阴森的嗓音。它用缎带状双臂抓猎物，吃下由此产生的恐惧。
author: chibitales
source: The sweet, yet haunting voices of POKENAME can be heard throughout many forests on nights with a new moon. They use their ribbon-like arms to grab prey, feeding off the fear they create by doing so.

entry: POKENAME毒性减弱，体内就发强光，以耀眼威吓，骗敌人以为仍很强。
author: .izik
source: When its poison weakens, POKENAME glows brightly from within. It uses this radiant intimidation display to trick foes into thinking it's still strong.

entry: POKENAME葫芦吃得越多，炮越强。即使没蓄满，也能从炮管连续射籽。
author: .izik
source: The more gourds POKENAME consumes, the stronger its cannon becomes. Even when not fully charged it can fire seeds from the cannon in rapid succession.

entry: POKENAME迅速用发状双臂抓住受害者，再浮起，带往死后世界。必须持续取魂，才能升空，否则会坠地，无法动弹。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME promptly grabs the victim using its hairlike arms before quickly floating up and away to the afterlife. It must continuously take spirits to keep itself airborne; otherwise, it will crash into the ground and become immobile.

entry: 这些宝可梦极谨慎，只在夜里出来，在森林家园蹦跳起舞。训练家若开始听见歌，应远远离开，避免诅咒。
author: infinex21
source: These extremely cautious Pokémon only come out at night, bouncing around and dancing within their forest homes. If a Trainer ever begins to hear them sing, they are advised to move far away to avoid being cursed.

entry: POKENAME让手臂伸长、生长，缠住受害者。被较大型个体抓住，逃脱希望很渺茫。
author: bacondlx
source: POKENAME makes its arms stretch and grow to wrap around its victims. Getting ensnared by the larger variants leaves little hope for escape.

entry: POKENAME藏在南瓜田的稻草人之间，一连数日不动。看似填满干草，填充物结构却更像合成棉。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME hides among scarecrows in pumpkin patches, unmoving for days. Though it appears stuffed with hay, its filling is closer to synthetic cotton in structure.

entry: POKENAME乘秋风旅行，喜欢用滑稽恶作剧，吓唬、打扰人类。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME travels by drifting on the autumn wind. It delights in spooking and disrupting humans with silly pranks.

entry: POKENAME从树顶家中，用发丝纠成的网伏击猎物。缠好后，再使电磁波加深麻痹，随后进食。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME waits to ambush prey from its treetop home with a web of tangling hairs. When its prey is properly ensnared, it uses a Thunder Wave to paralyze them further before feasting.

entry: POKENAME背部发光，提醒附近有危险。捕食者靠近，就使出神秘守护，保护自己与盟友。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's glowing back alerts others of nearby danger. It casts Safeguard to shield itself and allies when predators approach.

entry: 秋夜，它会漂过人类街区敲门。开门的人必须给糖，否则下一晚，就会遭它纠缠闹鬼。
author: hophoppip
source: On autumn nights, it floats through human neighborhoods, knocking on doors. Anyone who opens their door must give it candy, or they will be haunted on the following night.

entry: 两个头都顽皮，却常意见不合，不知怎样恶作剧最好。双头齐声怪笑，就表示POKENAME想出了真正刁钻的把戏。
author: hophoppip
source: Both of its heads are mischievous, but they tend to disagree on how best to perform their tricky deeds. When the two heads cackle in unison, POKENAME has devised a truly devious trick.

entry: POKENAME攀在洞壁，有节奏地闪光。这些光脉冲构成完整语言，用来在隧道间分享信息。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME clings to cave walls and glows in rhythmic flashes. These light pulses form a full language, used to share information across tunnels.

entry: POKENAME缓慢微弱的歌声带诅咒，听者接下来的7天，都会极度昏沉乏力。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's slow, faint singing carries a curse that afflicts those who hear it. Victims of the hex become greatly lethargic for the next 7 days.

entry: 摇柄转得够久，POKENAME就弹出盒子，狡黠怪笑。受害者的惊吓，会给它力量。
author: hophoppip
source: When its crank is turned for long enough, POKENAME springs out of its box and cackles deviously. The fright of its victim gives it strength.

entry: POKENAME头上的根，随年龄能长得极长。穿过墓园时拖在地上，让它徘徊静墓的身影更阴森。
author: .izik
source: The root growing from POKENAME's head can become extremely long as it ages. It will drag it along the ground as it travels through cemeteries, adding to its eerie presence as it haunts the quiet graves.

entry: POKENAME覆着南瓜香黏液，漂过森林时泛柔光，用精神脉冲搜寻猎物。
author: .izik
source: Pumpkin-scented ooze covers POKENAME's body, glowing softly as it floats through forests. It scans for prey using psychic pulses.

entry: POKENAME夜里脸与体膜发光，如暗中浮动的面孔。它最爱借外貌吓旅人，看他们惊逃，便自己怪笑。
author: sk372
source: At night, POKENAME's face and membrane glow, creating the image of a floating face in the darkness. It delights in casting fear in travelers with its appearance, cackling to itself as they flee in terror.

entry: POKENAME乘秋风漂过薰衣草田，散出烤南瓜籽香。身体轻盈，能毫不费力地悬浮好几个小时。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME drifts above lavender fields on autumn winds, emitting a scent of roasted pumpkin seeds. Its light body allows it to hover effortlessly for hours.

entry: POKENAME滚动时用藤转向，得以加速、急拐，身后留下一道黄光。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its vines to steer while rolling. This control lets it accelerate and carve tight turns, leaving a yellow glow in its wake.

entry: POKENAME曾是古代世界的夜间恐怖猎手，深夜捕食。中空躯干漏出的毒液，用来标记领地，警告对手与闯入者。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME was a nocturnal terror of the ancient world, hunting prey in the dead of night. The fluid leaking from its hollowed-out torso was a toxic substance meant to mark territory and warn rivals and trespassers.

entry: 世界各地厨师都寻找它，因为叶片晒干，能制成醋栗味糖浆。厨师与保育人士合作，既维持野外数量，也满足顾客需求。
author: quackquackattack
source: It is sought after by chefs around the world, as their leaves can be dried to produce a syrup that tastes like currants. Chefs are working with conservationists to keep the wild population high while still catering to the needs of customers.

entry: 据说POKENAME由灵魂附上一大堆腐南瓜瓤形成，也会在仲秋夜出没，取走浪费者的灵魂。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME is said to form when spirits possess a large pile of rotten pumpkin innards. It's said to lurk on mid-autumn nights to take the souls of those who are wasteful.

entry: 树液发黄光，照亮空腔。体内空腔如近似竖笛的木管乐器，有风穿过，就会发出尖鸣。
author: quackquackattack
source: Their sap produces a yellow luminescent glow that illuminates cavities. Their body cavities act as a woodwind instrument close to the recorder, as wind passing through produces a high-pitched whine.

entry: POKENAME夜飞时，腹部随振翅节奏明灭，用空气利刃抵御空中威胁。
author: .izik
source: While flying at night, POKENAME's belly pulses in time with its wingbeats. It uses Air Cutter to defend itself from aerial threats.

entry: POKENAME从耳朵放出声波，同时散发南瓜派般的甜香。组合使敌人迷惑，它就趁乱攻击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME blasts sonic waves from its ears while releasing a sweet aroma like pumpkin pie. The combination bewilders foes before it attacks under cover of confusion.

entry: 满月之夜，POKENAME飞过乡村，唱着诡异歌曲。双翼由一缕缕纤维组成，很像南瓜藤。
author: pattybgoode
source: POKENAME cries an eerie song as it flies through country villages on nights of a full moon. Its wings are made of fibrous strands similar to pumpkin vines.

entry: POKENAME会自然产生南瓜味的可食用黏液，世界某些菜系将其作为美味意式饺子的馅料。它常漫游沼泽，无月之夜格外活跃。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME naturally produces an edible slime with a pumpkin flavor, used in some cuisines around the world to fill delicious ravioli. It tends to wander through marshlands, becoming especially active on moonless nights.

entry: POKENAME在中空躯干，储存不稳定的幽灵能量。暴怒时，会从核心变出幽灵般的手臂，以可怕力量击倒威胁。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME stores volatile ghostly energy within its hollow torso. When enraged, it forms spectral arms from its core to strike down threats with terrifying force.

entry: 许多POKENAME借秋收满月的力量，装成无生命稻草人，守护贵重作物。任何野生宝可梦靠近，就会迅速醒来，毫不留情地攻击。
author: cobalt0135
source: Powered by the harvest moon, many POKENAME stand guard to protect valuable crops from wild Pokémon while appearing as lifeless scarecrows. They will awaken and quickly attack any approaching wild Pokémon with extreme prejudice.

entry: POKENAME背上的毒蘑菇带葫芦味，渗出大量苦粉。多年来，人们把粉末用于增强力量的药剂。
author: .izik
source: The gourd-scented toadstools on POKENAME's back leak high amounts of bitter powder. This powder has been used in strength-enhancing elixirs throughout the years.

entry: POKENAME出现在空地或暗林间，试着把其他生物引进体内。它制造幻觉，吃受害者的恐惧。满足后会把对方吐出，过程不会伤害对方，随后消失在夜色中。
author: icelevelincarnate
source: Appearing in empty lots or dark forest clearings, POKENAME will attempt to lure others inside of them. They create hallucinations and feed off of their victim's fear, but will harmlessly spit them out once satisfied before vanishing into the night.

entry: POKENAME夜里出藏身处，以悦耳嗓音吟唱，引人和宝可梦听歌。人们说，听后昏沉乏力，像被抽走活力。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME comes out of hiding at night and chants with a euphonious voice that draws both people and Pokémon to listen to its music. People report feeling lethargic after hearing its song as though they were drained of their vitality.

entry: POKENAME在林中寻找裸露的树根进食，背上中空发光的葫芦中回荡着诡异摇篮曲。据说里面寄着POKENAME吃过的所有树的灵魂。
author: .jerden
source: As POKENAME wanders through forests searching for exposed roots to feed on, a sound like an eerie lullaby echoes out from the hollow, glowing interior of the gourd on its back. It is said to hold the spirits of all the trees POKENAME consumes.

entry: POKENAME用巨力，保护不能自保的幽灵属性宝可梦。谁敢伤害被护者，就会被POKENAME诅咒。
author: m1918_94884
source: POKENAME uses its immense strength to protect Ghost-type Pokémon who cannot fend for themselves. Anyone who dares hurt the Pokémon it protects is cursed by POKENAME.

entry: 秋季，POKENAME在树间跳跃，搜寻窃贼。它用围巾般的长发倒吊树上，惊住目标，再制服。
author: actliux
source: During the autumn season, POKENAME can be seen jumping from tree to tree in search of thieves. They use their long, scarf-like hair to hang upside down from trees to surprise their quarry before subduing them.

entry: POKENAME飞行时双翼发亮，散出南瓜香粉。橙色粉尘强得能击昏班基拉斯。
author: .izik
source: As it flies, POKENAME's wings shine while spreading pumpkin-scented powder. This orange dust is strong enough to knock out a Tyranitar.

entry: 据说节庆秋夜，POKENAME会游过南瓜田，找人带往死后世界。小镇也常有给POKENAME糖果的传统。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: It is said that on festive fall nights, POKENAME can be seen wandering pumpkin patches searching for people to take to the afterlife. Small towns often have traditions involving giving POKENAME candy.

entry: 这些宝可梦常被误认成讨糖桶。谁吃下从它体内来的甜点，都会受到诅咒。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: These Pokémon often get mistaken as trick-or-treat buckets. Anyone who eats the sweet treats that come from inside its body will be cursed.

entry: POKENAME头顶的睡莲叶极甜。许多文化把煮好的叶片切成细条，放在南瓜派上，做成甜味与泥土风味平衡的美妙甜点。
author: .izik
source: The lily pad on POKENAME's head is extremely sweet. Many cultures serve small boiled slivers of the lily pad on top of a slice of pumpkin pie for a delightful dessert that balances sweetness with earthiness.

entry: 它催眠老人，让他们与自己共跳探戈，边跳边引往死后世界。秋季庆典结束后，最常见到。
author: bobosmith01
source: It will dance a tango with the elderly, hypnotizing them into dancing with them as it guides them to the afterlife. They are most often found after an autumn festival.

entry: POKENAME夜里高悬南瓜田，用力量宝石吓走黑暗鸦等宝可梦，确保庄稼不受打扰。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME floats high over pumpkin patches at night to ensure the crops are left undisturbed by Pokémon like Murkrow. It will use a Power Gem to scare them away, ensuring the patch's safety.

entry: POKENAME体表黄光脉动，高高飞在农田上方，迅速巡天，寻找入侵者。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME flies high above crop fields with a yellow glow pulsing from its body. It patrols the skies swiftly, seeking intruders from above.

entry: POKENAME大多时间在地下，地面偶尔却能听见诡歌。它从植物下方经过时，植物就会开始枯萎。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME spends most of its time underground, but its eerie singing can occasionally be heard on the surface. When POKENAME passes beneath them, plants will begin to wilt.

entry: 它糖甜的内里一接触空气，就会硬成可食糖块。POKENAME喜欢将这些身体糖块，送给看见的乖孩子。
author: griddle
source: Its sugary sweet innards harden into edible candy pieces when exposed to the open air. POKENAME enjoys gifting the candied pieces of its body to any well-behaved children it sees.

entry: POKENAME扮成恐怖装饰，用碗状尾巴引来毫无防备的讨糖者。有人说，只要拿起硬币，它就会迅速抓住那人，对方也会变成更多钱币，加入它的收藏。
author: dolly_cholli
source: POKENAME masquerades as a spooky decoration, using its bowl-like tail to lure in unsuspecting trick or treaters. Some say that once they grab a coin, it swiftly snatches them as they become more coins for its hoard.

entry: POKENAME头上喙状叶，曾用于治疗偏头痛的粉剂。叶片磨碎，与红球果煮，再盛进木杯，带来舒缓。
author: .izik
source: The bill-like leaf protruding from POKENAME's head was once used in powders to treat migraines. The leaf was ground up and boiled with Red Apricorns, served in wooden cups for soothing relief.

entry: POKENAME深夜游荡乡村，体内满溢灵力。它们找其他夜行宝可梦交战，挥动幽灵般的拳头，连续猛击。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME wander through rural communities in the dead of night, their bodies overflowing with spiritual energy. They seek out other nocturnal Pokémon to do battle with, striking out with their spectral fists in a flurry of blows.

entry: POKENAME每次战胜对手，都会取走对方一件珍爱物，藏进亲手刻出的大南瓜。藏品越多，同类中的地位就越高。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME takes a prized possession from every foe it bests in combat, hoarding it in large pumpkins it personally carves. The greater the hoard, the higher its status among its kind.

entry: 头下燃着空灵火焰，让POKENAME即使没有头骨，也能行动。所有扑灭这异火的尝试，都失败了。
author: sk372
source: An ethereal flame burns beneath the head, allowing POKENAME to function even without its cranium. All attempts made to douse this otherworldly fire have failed.

entry: POKENAME滚动时散出南瓜派香，一撞东西，就可能突然炸开，四散碎石。
author: .izik
source: As it rolls, POKENAME releases a scent like pumpkin pie. Should it bump into something, it may suddenly detonate in a burst of gravel.

entry: 寒夜，POKENAME奔过城镇，为辛勤工作的人带来光暖。有些镇形成传统，离开前送它蜡烛，帮助灯火不熄。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME run through towns to bring light and warmth to those hard at work during chilly nights. In some towns, it has become tradition for people to help keep the lanterns burning by giving a POKENAME a candle before it leaves.

entry: POKENAME温柔，常在农场拉满载南瓜的车。兴奋时，体内火焰会让眼睛泛起温暖火光。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is a gentle creature often used on farms to pull carts filled with pumpkins. When it becomes excited, the flames burning inside its body cause its eyes to glow with a warm, fiery light.

entry: 据说，它的锅是很久以前蜕下的自身部分，如今配着大植物茎，制作饭食与其他调配物。它极聪明，从不浪费任何资源或动作。
author: infinex21
source: Its pot is said to be a part of itself that it has long since shed, which it now uses in tandem with its large plant stalk to make meals and other concoctions. It is a very intelligent Pokémon that never wastes a single resource nor a single action.

entry: POKENAME黏糊的内里，比南瓜怪人形的外部身体动得更多，令人怀疑真正的大脑在污泥里。POKENAME专注时，较坚实的外部身体，完全停止闪烁。
author: bobosmith01
source: It is the goopy insides of POKENAME that move around far more than the Gourgeist-shaped body, leading many to suspect that what constitutes a brain actually resides in the muck. While POKENAME focuses, the more solid body stops blinking entirely.

entry: POKENAME常在夜林催眠迷路孩子。睡前故事把它描成食人怪物，POKENAME实际却带走失孩子回家。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME often appears in the woods at night to find and hypnotize lost children. Despite bedtime stories depicting it as a monster that eats people, POKENAME actually leads wayward kids back home.

entry: 它的身体蓬松、像糖果，常被误认成棉花糖，背上的拐杖糖尾巴却很锋利。有时会被高档餐厅用来测试菜肴的甜味和苦味。
author: duskit___
source: Its fluffy, candy-like body is often mistaken for cotton candy, and the candy-cane tail on its back is sharp. It is sometimes used in fancy restaurants to test dishes for sweetness and bitterness.

entry: POKENAME嗜甜，蜂蜜、甘蔗、枫糖浆都大口吃。临近进化，能吃自身体重数倍的食物。
author: petratheangel
source: POKENAME has a voracious appetite for sweet things, such as honey, sugar cane and maple syrup. It will eat several times its own weight when it gets close to evolving.

entry: POKENAME容易爆炸，有些人因此视为祸害。物理损伤虽不大，黏棉花糖却会射满四周，难清理得令人头痛。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a bit of a menace to some due to its tendency to explode. While it doesn't cause much physical damage, the explosion shoots sticky candy floss all over its surroundings, which is painfully difficult to clean up.

entry: 一群POKENAME找到喜爱的糕点，就会随身带着。其他宝可梦想偷，POKENAME便会猛烈攻击。
author: dodoowner_
source: If a group of POKENAME finds a pastry they like, they will carry it around with them. If any Pokémon tries to steal it, POKENAME will violently attack.

entry: POKENAME戴精巧的糖骷髅，住在墓地，在坟前留甜面包，希望引来友善访客。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME wears a skull made of exquisitely crafted sugar. It lives in cemeteries and leaves sweet breads at the graves there in hopes of enticing friendly visitors.

entry: POKENAME很受聚会欢迎。手套取下的棉花糖，可以添进茶里，带来意外浓厚的风味。
author: shyguy11011
source: POKENAME is beloved at parties. Cotton candy taken from its gloves can be added to tea, where it results in an unexpectedly strong flavor.

entry: POKENAME放出的甜香气体，仍可能毒害生物。POKENAME比起其他食物，更爱甜树果。
author: bobosmith01
source: The sweet-smelling gas POKENAME emits still has the potential to be toxic to living beings. POKENAME prefers to eat sweet Berries over other types of food.

entry: POKENAME用一长段拐杖糖作角，会邀请爱甜的宝可梦来吮，直到角变尖。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME has a long piece of candy cane that it uses as a horn. It may invite Pokémon that like to eat sweets to suck on the horn until it is sharp.

entry: 据说野生POKENAME极爱甜食。只要在附近，甜点据说就会至少好吃十倍。
author: rumia_archer
source: Wild POKENAME are said to have a major sweet tooth. Whenever one is nearby, sweets are said to taste at least ten times better.

entry: 它用杏子与奶油制成的硬镰，切开对手。极少数镰刀被吃掉的情况，一天便能再生。
author: quackquackattack
source: It slices through opponents using hardened scythes made of apricots and cream. On the rare occasion its scythes are eaten, it regenerates the scythes in one day.

entry: POKENAME用自身甜毛，如圆丝蛛织丝般，编出复杂巢穴，无意困住被糖香引来的虫宝可梦。
author: lampent12
source: Using the sweet fur they produce like Spinarak silk, POKENAME weaves intricate nests for themselves. They unintentionally trap Bug Pokémon drawn to the sugary smell.

entry: POKENAME战斗时，先用香甜黏丝缠敌，再使出头锤。它什么甜食都爱，常因偷吃惹上麻烦。
author: chibitales
source: When in battle, POKENAME will tangle its opponent in sweet and sticky threads before striking with a Headbutt. It enjoys eating any sweets it can find, often finding itself in trouble when it ends up stealing said sweets.

entry: POKENAME有水果风味，却认不出是哪种，因此被认为像已灭绝的浆果。许多地方将它视为美味珍馐。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME have a fruity flavour, but the specific fruit is unrecognisable, so it is believed to taste like an extinct berry species. For this reason, they are seen as a delicacy in many locations.

entry: POKENAME一相遇，就爱用黏舌舔其他生物，常被嫌过分热情。身体十分柔软，如海绵。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are oft considered to be overly friendly due to how they will lick others with their sticky tongues just after meeting them. Their bodies are extremely soft and spongey.

entry: POKENAME产的蜂蜜，闻着、尝着都像棉花糖。它极力守蜜，向入侵者连发数十次毒针，能采到蜜的人常高价出售。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME produce honey that smells and tastes like cotton candy. They are very protective of this honey and pelt intruders with dozens of Poison Sting attacks. People who manage to collect the honey often sell it for a high price.

entry: 据说POKENAME的软糖尾，吃起来像世上每一种甜食，却没人靠得够近证实。尾上还漾着诡异脉动，让许多人深感不安。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME's gummy tail is said to taste like every single sweet food in the world, but no one has ever gotten close enough to confirm it. The tail also ripples with a strange pulse that many find deeply unsettling.

entry: POKENAME十分害羞，受善待却会友好、忠诚多年。它放香甜黏丝缠敌，有些也会拿来缠朋友，当作恶作剧。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are incredibly shy, though become very friendly and remain loyal for years if treated well. They will loose sticky  and sweet threads to entangle foes and some will do the same to their friends as a sort of prank.

entry: POKENAME颈上小浆果富含糖分，孩子很容易吃上瘾。果实也常被用作天然甜味剂。
author: mistymagius
source: The small berries that grow from POKENAME's neck are packed with sugar, which makes them highly addictive amongst young children. The berries have been commonly used as a natural sweetening agent.

entry: 它受威胁就从背部产热。装点身体的糖纤维，很快着火，猛烈燃烧。
author: hophoppip
source: When threatened, it produces heat from its back. The sugary fibers adorning it quickly catch fire and burn powerfully.

entry: POKENAME嗜甜，也爱咬东西，特大硬糖是很好的点心。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME has a sweet tooth and a penchant for biting things. Oversized hard candies make an excellent treat for a POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME能用可伸缩的锥状尾巴，撑高身体，更好地查看周围。还会顽皮地抛身体黏块，和其他生物分享甜味。
author: sk372
source: A retractable cone-like tail lets POKENAME lift itself up to better survey its surroundings. It playfully lobs parts of its sticky body at others in order to share the sweetness of its taste.

entry: POKENAME夜间活动，身后留下的几缕带糖味雾气，是它唯一的踪迹。雾气会把虫属性宝可梦引到农田甚至人家，因此它常被嫌烦。
author: roundabout_robin
source: POKENAME is nocturnal, with the only sign of its presence being the trailing wisps of sugary mist it leaves behind. It is often seen as an annoyance due to this mist attracting Bug-types to fields of crops and even homes.

entry: POKENAME是游园会摊位的热门宝可梦，甜丝裹成团，就当棉花糖卖。它常得赶走想偷孩子糖的飞行属性宝可梦。
author: ghostslythe
source: Popular Pokémon at fair booths, POKENAME's silk is sweet in nature and bundled up as cotton candy. They often have to fight off Flying-types that try to steal children's candy.

entry: POKENAME用发光棒棒糖诱饵的甜香捕猎，诱人得连POKENAME自己，也忍不住偶尔尝尝。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME uses the sweet scent of its glowing lollipop lure to hunt for its prey. It is so tempting that POKENAME can't help giving it the occasional taste.

entry: POKENAME精力骤然爆发，四处奔跑，身体黏丝沾住碰到的一切。又会毫无预兆地倒地睡着。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME runs around with an outburst of hyper energy, the sticky strings that compose its body clinging to all surfaces it touches. Without warning, it crashes to the ground, asleep.

entry: POKENAME覆着细软可食毛，滋味甜美，是糖果师喜爱的宝可梦。据说吃下POKENAME的毛，还会做美梦。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are covered in a fine layer of soft, edible hair with a wonderfully sweet flavour. They are popular Pokémon for confectioners, and POKENAME hair is said to give the eater sweet dreams.

entry: POKENAME的羊毛全是棉花糖，却酸得像电击味蕾。
author: musicsheep.
source: POKENAME's wool is entirely made of cotton candy. The taste is so sour that it can feel like an electric shock to your taste buds.

entry: POKENAME羽毛柔软，常被比作棉花糖。它对幼童有耐心，很能容忍抚摸，即使不小心被扯到羽毛。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME's feathers have a soft texture that has been compared to cotton candy. They're patient with young children and tolerate petting well, even when their feathers are accidentally pulled.

entry: POKENAME极轻，身体大多由蓬松糖丝构成，最轻的微风，也能让它轻松漂游。
author: anonymous_moose
source: POKENAME's incredibly light body is mostly made up of fluffy spun sugar fibres, which allow it to drift effortlessly atop the lightest breeze.

entry: POKENAME爱糖，会偷钻进糖多的地方。它曾吃掉整袋原糖，在糕点师间恶名远扬。
author: petratheangel
source: POKENAME loves sugar and will sneak into any place with lots of it. They're infamous among pastry chefs for eating entire bags of raw sugar.

entry: POKENAME外号“烘焙师的噩梦”，最爱黎明偷进面包店，翻找新美食。被发现，就往追赶者眼里撒面粉。
author: merclipse
source: Known as "The Baker's Nightmare". POKENAME are mischievous creatures that love sneaking into bakeries at dawn to rummage for new delicacies. If discovered in the act, they tend to throw handfuls of flour into the eyes of pursuers.

entry: POKENAME产生甜糖浆状凝胶，游遍海洋，寻找完美搭配。一找到，就欣喜不已，随后进化。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME produces a sweet syrup-like gel and travels the ocean seeking to find the perfect accompaniment to it. Once it finds it, it is overcome with joy and evolves.

entry: POKENAME产生甜糖浆状凝胶，游遍海洋，寻找完美搭配。找到后，会与另一位分享。有些训练家有幸尝到，一辈子都赞不绝口。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME produces a sweet syrup-like gel and travels the ocean seeking to find the perfect accompaniment to it. If it finds it, it will share it with one other, some Trainers have been lucky to try it, and rave about it for the rest of their lives.

entry: POKENAME背上的拐杖糖很锋利，尤其烘焙师常刮下碎片，添进烘焙食品。甜美蓬松身体的部分，也被加进甜点。
author: quackquackattack
source: The candy-cane on the back of a POKENAME is quite sharp, especially since bakers shave off pieces to add to baked goods. Pieces of their sweet and fluffy bodies are incorporated into desserts.

entry: 糖果店旁一出现POKENAME，店主就得紧急应对。若不阻止，POKENAME几分钟便能吃光全店。
author: petratheangel
source: Spotting a POKENAME near a candy store is considered an emergency for the owner. If not stopped, POKENAME will devour everything in the store in only a few minutes.

entry: POKENAME产甜蛋白霜，烘焙师采来做杯子蛋糕。作为交换，第一批蛋糕会送给POKENAME，免得受诅咒。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME produce a sweet meringue that bakers harvest for cupcakes. In exchange for this meringue, bakers offer the first batch of cupcakes to POKENAME to ensure they will not get cursed.

entry: POKENAME吊在树顶，很少有捕食者能碰到，但行动有限，一掉下就脆弱。硬壳上覆甜层，常有其他宝可梦来啃。
author: santon5512
source: While hanging in the treetops, POKENAME are safe from most predators, though, due to their lack of mobility, they're quite vulnerable once they fall. Due to the sweet coating on their hard shells, other Pokémon are often found gnawing on them.

entry: POKENAME壳上覆黏棉花糖，碰到的东西都会沾糖。POKENAME就一个劲地舔净黏糖的地方，因为最爱自己糖果的味道。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's shell is covered with a layer of sticky candy floss. Anything that touches it will get the candy stuck to them, whereupon POKENAME will fervently lick the sticky part clean, as it adores the flavor of its own candy.

entry: POKENAME终生住在地下深处，只有察觉甜食，才会到地面来。研究员仍不明白，它如何从那么深的地方，准确找到糖。
author: laughing_dan
source: POKENAME spend their lives deep underground, surfacing only when they feel the presence of sweets. Researchers are still unsure how POKENAME are able to accurately locate sweets from so far underground.

entry: POKENAME的牙是软糖，太软，很难找到能吃的食物。它在公园靠人喂软食，特别爱甜的。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME struggle to find food they can eat because of their soft teeth made out of gummies. They rely on people to feed them soft food at parks and are particularly fond of sweets.

entry: POKENAME仿佛由融化的棉花糖组成，零碎物品一碰就黏住。身体还滚烫，若停得太久，自己就会烧起来。
author: mistymagius
source: Its body seems to be made of melted marshmallows, with any loose items getting stuck to it. POKENAME is also extremely hot, and its own body will start to burn if stationary for too long.

entry: 融化的巧克力不断从POKENAME壳中流出，爬到哪，就留甜痕。它吃水果，维持天生高糖，也会给喜欢的人裹巧克力的树果。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Molten chocolate constantly flows from POKENAME's shell, leaving a sweet trail behind them wherever they crawl. They feed on fruit to maintain their naturally high sugar levels, offering chocolate-covered berries to people they like.

entry: POKENAME精力旺、掉毛多，需要愿意花时间训练的耐心主人。毛带微辣甜味，常被当作点心，或冰淇淋配料。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME has a lot of energy and sheds profusely, so it requires a patient owner who is willing to spend time training it. Its fur has a slightly spicy and sweet flavor, so it is often used as a treat on its own or as a topping for ice cream.

entry: POKENAME吐出香甜黏液，闻着如最上等棉花糖。被缠住者报告，会感到恶心、虚弱。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME spits a sweet, sticky substance that smells of the finest cotton candy. When ensnared by this substance, those affected have reported feeling nausea and weakness.

entry: POKENAME每次出拳踢腿，都伴着一阵甜酥蛋糕香，让空气更甜。战得越激烈，香气越浓。
author: .izik
source: Each of POKENAME's punches or kicks is paired with a burst of shortcake-like scent, sweetening the air with every strike. The scent grows stronger the harder it fights.

entry: POKENAME每天吃下与体重相等的糖，不够就闹脾气。听见雷声，还会异常亢奋。
author: roundabout_robin
source: POKENAME eats its own body weight in sugar every day and becomes grumpy if it doesn't get enough. It becomes hyperactive when it hears the sound of thunder.

entry: 这种融合宝可梦极亲人，爱缠住友好训练家，给出温暖却黏糊的拥抱。好意虽真，残留物却必须立即洗净，否则可能生病。
author: afilthycasual
source: A very affectionate Pokémon, this fusion enjoys wrapping its body around a friendly Trainer in a warm but sticky hug. While the gesture is genuinely kind, the sticky residue must be cleaned immediately or sickness may ensue.

entry: 它们吐的黏丝，像可食棉花糖，多数人却嫌太酸。丝能导电，让猎物与捕食者都麻痹。
author: infinex21
source: Although the sticky threads they spit to ensnare foes are reminiscent of cotton candy, and are edible, they are considered far too sour by most people. Their threads can conduct electricity and help them to paralyze prey and predator alike.

entry: POKENAME糖吃够，就从嘴里产薄荷糖。这些糖能留存好几个小时，吃下便会困倦。
author: jaminmcready
source: When POKENAME consumes enough sugar, it produces mint-flavored candies from its mouth. These last for hours and cause anyone who eats them to grow drowsy.

entry: POKENAME嗅得出面包店，一英里开外也能发现糖粉。最爱卡诺里甜馅卷，还会偷进厨房，只为舔奶油馅。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME has a nose for bakeries and can detect powdered sugar from over a mile away. Cannoli are its favorite, and it's known to sneak into kitchens just to lick the cream filling.

entry: POKENAME在松土里挖洞，躲避被糖皮吸引的虫属性宝可梦。它一生不断蜕甲，甲片被收集、敲开，露出极甜内核，作酥脆甜点。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME digs in loose dirt to hide from Bug-type Pokémon that are attracted by its sugary hide. It sheds its armored plates throughout life, which are collected and cracked open to expose the intensely sweet core as a crunchy dessert.

entry: POKENAME是当地最受欢迎的宠物之一，饲育者会带去高级美容师那里，修出完美刘海。若不喜欢手法，它会突然冻住毛，反而做出了受欢迎的甜冰食。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: POKENAME is one of the most popular pets in the region, which breeders take to high-end groomers for the perfect bangs. If a groomer does something it doesn't like, it will suddenly freeze its fur, but this just creates a sweet and popular icy treat.

entry: POKENAME的皮毛全由甜食构成，糖绒多得连别人扯下一团吃掉，它也不会察觉或在意。糖做的长牙虽然脆，却能再生，因此朋友们也能拿来吃。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's fur coat is made of sweets; it creates so much candy fluff that it will not notice or care if clumps are taken and eaten by others. Its candy tusks are brittle and regenerate, so they too can be eaten by its friends.

entry: POKENAME每秋蜕旧羽，让新羽生长。掉落的羽毛极甜，常被比作壶壶汁，可作冰淇淋及其他甜点配料。
author: _pixelar_
source: Ever autumn, POKENAME shed older feathers to make room for new ones, with the sheddings collected to be used as a topping for ice cream and other desserts. These feathers are very sweet and the taste has often been compared to Shuckle juice.

entry: POKENAME身体覆着厚糖，是嘉年华和马戏团的热门伙伴，会主动跑向孩子。糖耗尽，就蜷起，等它重长。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME bodies are coated in a thick layer of sweet candy. They are popular companions at carnivals and circuses where they will run up to children unprompted. When their candy is depleted they will curl up and wait for it to regrow.

entry: POKENAME住在沙漠，避开会损伤糖质护层的水。它细心刷去砂粒和糖块，一离开，捡食者就来抢走。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is found in deserts where it can avoid water, which is dangerous to its sugary, protective coat. It can be found meticulously brushing grit and sugar clumps from its coat, which scavengers snap up once it moves on.

entry: POKENAME散出烤糖般宜人的气味。利爪很黏，能在攻击时牢牢抓住敌人。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME gives off a very pleasant smell similar to toasted sugar. Its talons are very sticky, helping it keep a firm grip on the enemy while it attacks.

entry: 它在水里会释放糖香黏液。下雨时明显更黏，因此举巨石也更容易。
author: lydiaprower8
source: It releases a sweet-smelling mucus that smells like sugar when in water. It gets noticeably sticky in rain, making it easier to lift boulders.

entry: POKENAME靠精神力量漂浮，所到之处甜香四溢。天性慷慨，会取身体上美味的糖团，给其他生物振奋精神。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME floats with the aid of its psychic abilities and spreads a sweet aroma wherever it goes. It has a generous nature, offering clumps of delicious sugar from its body to lift the spirits of others.

entry: POKENAME制作极甜美味的糖果，让其他生物开心。战斗时也能用，敌人尝后会懒怠，失去战意。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME creates incredibly sugary and delightful sweets to lift the spirits of others. This skill can also be used in battle, as enemies who taste these sweets are rendered slothful and lose the will to fight.

entry: POKENAME甜香引来其他宝可梦品尝。POKENAME似乎不介意被舔，舔过者后来却会做可怕噩梦，梦见被活糖果吃掉。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's sweet smell attracts other Pokémon to come and taste it. While POKENAME does not seem to mind the act, those who lick it will later have terrible nightmares of being consumed by living sweets.

entry: 圆筒状管子，其实是棉花糖制造器。POKENAME受伤，能产新糖，帮助愈合，也很能帮烘焙师做甜点。
author: duskit___
source: Its cylinder-like tube is actually a cotton candy maker. If POKENAME gets hurt, it can heal itself by making new candy to help heal its wounds. They are a great help to bakers in making sweet desserts.

entry: POKENAME产的甜绒，吃下只有轻微毒性。可味道太令人上瘾，许多生物停不了口，反而吃得重病。
author: _._starry_._
source: The sweet-smelling fluff that POKENAME produces is only mildly toxic when ingested. However, its taste is so addictive that many make themselves seriously sick because they can't stop eating it.

entry: POKENAME的大嘴由棉花糖构成，吸引捕食者。它会吐出极甜、极黏的物质防身，再逃走。
author: nugamallow
source: POKENAME's maw is made of cotton candy, attracting predators. To defend itself, it spits out a very sweet and sticky substance before running away.

entry: POKENAME会在体育赛事和嘉年华，给大家送棉花糖。买完还粗鲁的顾客，却会眼看点心被它吃掉。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME can be found at sporting events and carnivals, offering cotton candy to everyone. Customers who are rude after purchasing get their sweet treat eaten right in front of them.

entry: POKENAME吓唬误认身体为棉花糖的孩子。若哪个特别淘气，POKENAME会瞪住，让其动不了，再裹进黏丝。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME scares children who mistake its body for cotton candy. If a child has been particularly naughty, POKENAME immobilizes them with a glare and wraps them up in sticky threads.

entry: 据说POKENAME能做出任何想要的甜食。许多贪吃者追着它，希望得到完美零食。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are said to have the ability to create any sweet that is desired. Many gluttons have chased after them hoping to create the perfect snack.

entry: POKENAME的身体与重要器官，都在壳里。身上长的棉最有名，可以安全制衣，采走后，两周又能长回。
author: operativevalkyrie
source: POKENAME's body and vital organs are in the shell. It is most known for the cotton that grows from it, which can be used to make clothing without harm. When its cotton is harvested, it regrows after two weeks.

entry: 野生POKENAME群居陡崖和高树，凶猛得出人意料。会挤出黏而滚烫的丝，保护群体，驱赶入侵者。
author: brilliantdarkness
source: Troops of wild POKENAME make their home high atop sheer cliffs and tall trees. Deceptively fierce, they defend their tribe from intruders by extruding a sticky and burning-hot thread.

entry: 这种宝可梦精力旺盛，有灵巧、可再生的尾巴。它鲁莽又重视领地，会用尾与其他POKENAME交战，争夺支配地位。
author: brilliantdarkness
source: This highly energetic Pokémon has a dextrous tail that can regenerate. Brash and territorial, it wields its tail in fights with other POKENAME to establish dominance.

entry: POKENAME和火属性宝可梦，关系往往不太平，原因仍未完全清楚。有人说，POKENAME是生前生意不佳的糕点店之灵。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME tend to have tumultuous relationships with Fire-type Pokémon for reasons that are still not entirely clear. Some say that POKENAME are the spirits of patisseries that had little financial success in life.

entry: POKENAME的刀刃，味道与口感像许多加糖硬糖，却远比糖果坚固。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's blade has a similar taste and texture to many sweetened hard candies. However, it is far more sturdy than candy!

entry: 每把刀刃都有独特滋味。冒失的野生宝可梦若想舔POKENAME，就会被带往不明之地。POKENAME用幽灵力量梳理，拒绝人手清洗。
author: bobosmith01
source: Each blade has a unique flavor. Foolish wild Pokémon that attempt to lick POKENAME are spirited away to parts unknown. POKENAME groom themselves with spectral powers and refuse to be washed by hand.

entry: POKENAME甜绒闻着香，却不适合吃。糖分混有麻痹毒素，能让人的嘴麻上数日。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Despite the sweet smell their fluff gives off, it's not advisable to eat the candy that POKENAME produce. The sugars of their fluff are mixed with a numbing toxin that can leave a person's mouth numb for multiple days.

entry: POKENAME会不由自主地服从它能找到、气味最甜最宜人的对象。选定首领后，就不知疲倦地做糖，讨其欢心。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is compelled to follow the orders of whoever has the sweetest and most pleasing scent it can find. It tirelessly cooks up sweets for its chosen leader in order to stay in their good graces.

entry: POKENAME糖果状触须上带大理石般的彩纹，仿佛波纹冰淇淋。甜美外表勾起饥饿，使敌人分心、平复敌意，独特花纹也启发甜点艺术。
author: mimisha_m.lkpowder
source: Marbled colors run along POKENAME's candy-shaped feelers, reminiscent of ripple ice cream. Its sweet-looking body induces hunger that distracts and pacifies foes, while its unique patterns inspire dessert art.

entry: POKENAME一见朋友或猎物，就拉进足以碎骨的拥抱。对朋友给满口水的亲吻，对猎物则抛上空，再狠狠撞头。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME pull both friend and prey into bone-crushing hugs upon seeing them. While they give slobbery kisses to their friends, they fling prey into the air so they can deliver a sharp headbutt.

entry: POKENAME生气，会从背炮高压射出棉花糖。听似无害，冲击却能贯穿铁板。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME fires high-pressure bursts of cotton candy from the cannon on its back when angry. Despite sounding harmless, the impact can punch holes through iron slabs.

entry: POKENAME毛里有甜分泌物，是糖果师的常见伙伴。油脂滋味随时段变化，午夜最佳。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are common companions for confectioners thanks to the sweet secretions they produce from their fur. The taste of the oils they produce varies with time of day and is at its best in the middle of the night.

entry: POKENAME总饿，每天吃下与体重相等的糖，由此在头顶长出大量可食棉花糖，送给路过孩子。
author: heal_fire
source: POKENAME is always hungry, eating its own weight in sugar each day. By doing this, it produces a lot of edible cotton candy on top of its head, which it offers to children who pass by.

entry: POKENAME脚印留着棉花糖般的黏物，蓬松尾颈还会掉毛。残留物虽能吃，却可能短暂诱发嗜甜欲。
author: beatdoof
source: Wherever POKENAME walks, it leaves behind sticky, cotton candy-like residue from its footprints, alongside shed fur from its bushy tail and neck. Despite their edibility, consuming these remnants can cause a brief addiction to sweets.

entry: 每年，POKENAME会出藏身处，帮做农历交年时吃的特制甜点。制作糕点的勤奋程度，只有放进去的糖量才比得上。
author: quackquackattack
source: Once a year, POKENAME come out of hiding to help produce special desserts that get eaten on the turn of the lunar calendar. Their diligence in making these cakes is only rivaled by the amount of sugar they put into them.

entry: POKENAME平时爱玩、好脾气，甜食喂不足，却会不高兴。通常用黏糖丝铺满区域，表达不满。
author: quantumradiation
source: While usually fun-loving and good-natured, POKENAME becomes upset if not fed enough sweet foods. It usually expresses this displeasure by carpeting areas with sticky threads of sugar.

entry: POKENAME住在废建筑，偏爱曾经卖食物的地方。它会从容器般身体里，送路人巧克力，可总有粉笔般的怪余味。
author: quantumradiation
source: POKENAME can be found in abandoned buildings, preferring places that once sold food. It offers any passerby a chocolate from inside its container-like body, but these chocolates always have a strange, chalky aftertaste.

entry: POKENAME照料花园时，蓬松身体散出柔暖。这是开心的征兆，还伴着在空中留连的淡玉米糖香。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's fluffy body radiates gentle warmth when tending to gardens. This warmth is a sign of joy accompanied by a soft candy corn fragrance that lingers in the air.

entry: POKENAME生来只有一条软白尾，甜如糖丝。随着长大，新尾一条比一条金棕更深，焦糖香也越浓。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME are born with a single soft white tail as sweet as spun sugar. As they grow, each new tail becomes a darker golden brown and carries an increasingly rich caramel scent.

entry: 许多水族爱好者因外观独特、香气宜人而寻找POKENAME。阿罗拉很流行做成它模样的松露巧克力。
author: mepp.
source: Many aquarists seek out POKENAME due to its unique appearance and pleasant aroma. Chocolate truffles made in the Pokémon's image are a popular confection in the Alola region.

entry: POKENAME只吃高糖食物，其他一概拒绝。饮食太极端，因此很少能在野外活下去。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME will only eat things containing high amounts of sugar and refuse anything else. Consequently, they can rarely survive in the wild due to this extreme diet.

entry: POKENAME吃过甜点，波导感知能力就会增强。能察觉一英里开外的恶意，随后便竖起毛。
author: .izik
source: After eating a dessert, POKENAME's aura-sensing powers become amplified. It can detect malicious intent from over a mile away and responds by puffing up its fur.

entry: POKENAME跳动时，棉花糖毛积起静电，阵阵爆出。雨会溶掉糖丝，让它迟缓、暴躁。
author: .izik
source: As POKENAME bounces around, its candy floss fur builds up static that explodes in bursts. Rain dissolves the sugar strands, leaving it sluggish and grumpy.

entry: POKENAME轻柔歌声，连最闹的孩子也能哄睡。呼吸带着熟草莓香。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME sing soft songs that can put even the rowdiest children to sleep. Their breath smells like ripe strawberries.

entry: 它不停寻找甜食。野外，会用大颚把浆果压成糊，榨出甜汁。
author: adam_dnh
source: It's constantly on the move in search of sweet food. In the wild, it uses its large jaws to crush berries into a paste to extract the sweet juices out.

entry: POKENAME齿轮转动，便散出浓郁酸甜糖香。全速旋转时，香得附近宝可梦都会流口水。
author: .izik
source: The gears on POKENAME's body emit a powerful tart-sugar scent as they turn. When spinning at full speed, the aroma is strong enough to make nearby Pokémon drool.

entry: 特殊生理构造，让POKENAME非常不耐水，大雨就能造成严重身体损伤。若被水属性攻击打伤，训练家要注意让它休息。
author: bobosmith01
source: Due to its unique biological makeup, POKENAME is highly incompatible with water. A downpour can cause it great physical harm. Trainers need to be careful to let it rest if it is hurt by a Water-type attack.

entry: POKENAME可爱又有香甜毛，吸引各年龄训练家，孩子尤其喜欢。实际却善变、极难训练，小得不能再小的理由，也能让它闹脾气、不听话。
author: milchik
source: POKENAME's adorable looks and sweet-smelling fur appeal to Trainers of all ages, especially children. In reality, this capricious Pokémon is incredibly hard to train, as it can throw a tantrum and stop obeying for the most insignificant reason.

entry: 面包店与糖果铺，有时养POKENAME看店。遇窃贼，它就从棉花般头顶散出粉红孢子，让对方惧怕甜食、咳嗽不止。
author: beatdoof
source: In bakeries and confectioneries, POKENAME is sometimes kept as a guard Pokémon. It releases pink spores from the top of its cotton-like head toward thieves or shoplifters, giving them a fear of sweets and incessant coughing.

entry: POKENAME软身体周围，裹着棉花糖状物。旧层结晶时，外层不断替换、重塑。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: The squishy body of POKENAME is surrounded in a candyfloss-like substance. This coating is constantly being replaced and reformed as old layers crystalise.

entry: POKENAME虽没眼睛，空中辨路却毫无困难。敏锐舌头能品尝空气，寻找猎物。
author: petratheangel
source: Despite not having eyes to see with, POKENAME has no problems navigating through the air. Its highly sensitive tongue can taste the air around it to hunt for prey.

entry: POKENAME总带宝芙蕾，陈旧发霉也不放。可以劝它拿旧的换新的，但新鲜的必须是POKENAME喜欢的口味。
author: quantumradiation
source: POKENAME always carries around a Poké Puff, and will hold onto it even when it becomes stale and mouldy. It can be convinced to exchange the one it carries with a fresh one, but only if it's a flavour that POKENAME likes.

entry: POKENAME的网由香甜糖物质构成，能做美味甜点。受它体型所限，很难收集大量蛛网，让甜点成了罕见佳肴。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME's webbing is made out of a sweet, sugary substance, which is made into a delightful dessert. However, due to the Pokémon's size, getting a large amount of the webbing is difficult, making the dessert a rare dining commodity.

entry: POKENAME用甜香引来野生宝可梦。够近，就跃出藏身处，扑上目标，分泌糖浆将自己黏牢。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME attracts wild Pokémon with its delightfully sweet smell, luring them to approach. When close enough, it leaps from its hiding place and latches onto its target, sticking to them with a secreted sugary syrup.

entry: POKENAME几乎只吃糖，转成结晶形态，再做出冰糖武器。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's diet consists almost entirely of sugar. The sugar it consumes is converted into a crystalline form, which it uses to create rock candy weapons.

entry: POKENAME糖香极浓，数英里外也能察觉。虽像童话里走出，却是凶猛猎手，咬力极强。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME body gives off an intense sugary scent that can be detected from miles away. Despite looking as though it stepped out of a fairy tale, POKENAME is a fierce predator with an incredibly powerful bite.

entry: POKENAME头上的棉花糖绒，由数十亿根细丝般的藤蔓组成。走动时散出浓郁派香，随情绪和土质变化。
author: .izik
source: The cotton candy fluff on POKENAME's head is made of billions of thread-thin vines. As it walks, they exude a rich pie-like scent that varies with mood and soil.

entry: POKENAME战斗太久，糖羽可能因火焰攻击的高温，开始熔成焦糖。它便顺势将滚烫焦糖射向对手。
author: dodoowner_
source: If POKENAME spends too much time in a battle, its sugary feathers may start to melt into caramel due to the extreme temperature required for its fire attacks. It takes advantage of this tactic, shooting scalding caramel towards opponents.

entry: POKENAME跳舞时，散发新烤杯子蛋糕般的舒缓香气。香气能安抚野生宝可梦，也被用于节庆，平静人群。
author: .izik
source: While dancing, POKENAME releases a soothing scent like freshly baked cupcakes. The aroma pacifies wild Pokémon and has been used in festivals to calm crowds.

entry: POKENAME在山顶筑巢，躲避陆上捕食者。离巢下降时，会沿飞行路线留下一簇簇轻软糖食。
author: pattybgoode
source: POKENAME makes its nest on mountaintops to evade terrestrial predators. As it descends from its nest, it leaves tufts of wispy, sugary treats in a trail along its flight path.

entry: 烘焙师喜爱POKENAME分泌的甜香黏液，因为质地柔软蓬松。可在野外，香味反而引来捕食者，对POKENAME不利。
author: aster_oid1701
source: The sweet-smelling, sticky slime that POKENAME secrete is sought after by bakers due to its soft, fluffy texture. The scent POKENAME emit is often a detriment in the wild, as predators tend to seek them out because of it.

entry: 人们饲养POKENAME，采集大花产生的甜蜜，与其他原料混合，为面包店制作糖浆和果酱。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME are raised for the sweet nectar that is produced from their large flower. The nectar is mixed with other ingredients to make syrups and jams for bakeries.

entry: POKENAME臂上的大糖晶，供给全部能量与力量。积攒要花很久，因此哪怕崩掉一点，也会令它极其愤怒凶暴。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME has large sugar crystals present on its arms that give it all its energy and power. Since it takes a long time to accumulate these sugar crystals, it becomes exceptionally furious and violent if any amount chips off.

entry: POKENAME伪装成棉花糖，引无防备的受害者靠近，再用锚攀住，吃掉积极情绪，留给对方剧烈腹痛。
author: vlavoc
source: POKENAME disguises itself as cotton candy to lure unsuspecting victims. Once they are close enough, it latches on with its anchor and feeds on their positive emotions— leaving them with a nasty bellyache.

entry: POKENAME的孢子甜如糖，吃下却会使精力骤然亢奋。POKENAME自己也不免，野外常能见到它高高跳起。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME's spores taste sweet like sugar but can cause major bursts of hyperactivity upon consumption. POKENAME is not immune to this and can be found jumping high into the air in the wild.

entry: POKENAME跃过天空，把糖纺成棉花糖云。身上冻成晶的糖反射日光，让云上泛起闪亮涟漪，据说还能增添风味。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME leap through the sky, spinning sugar into clouds made of cotton candy. The crystallized, frozen sugar along their bodies reflects the light of the sun, creating shimmering ripples along the clouds that are said to enhance their flavor.

entry: POKENAME从树液吸糖，再纺成背上棉花糖。碰到这些甜食，就会脱落，以糖浆丝缠住袭击者。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME absorbs sugar from tree sap, then spins it to form the puffs of cotton candy on its back. If touched, these sugary treats will break away and entangle attackers in their syrupy strands.

entry: POKENAME用背上的棉花糖堆，引来虫属性宝可梦，以黏丝捕住。等猎物挣扎得疲惫，再用硬糖爪出击。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME uses the mound of cotton candy on its back to attract Bug-type Pokémon and traps them in its sticky strands. Once they are exhausted by the struggle, POKENAME will strike with its hard candy claws.

entry: POKENAME从装点身体的各种糖果里射出黏丝攻击。习惯高压环境的它们，每天只会大吃硬糖。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME attack by shooting sticky threads from the various candies decorating their bodies. Being used to high-pressured environments, they only gorge down on hard candies every day.

entry: 大部分体重来自厚毛，却仍轻得能浮上一阵。毛平时软如棉花糖，受威胁，每根都能竖成细针般。
author: infinex21
source: Most of its body weight comes from its thick fur, yet it is still so light that it can float for periods of time. While its fur is usually soft like cotton candy, when threatened each strand of its hair can stand on end like thin needles.

entry: POKENAME的毛摸着如棉花糖，柔软蓬松。尾巴散出的甜香，能削弱敌人的战意。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's fur has the soft and fluffy feel of cotton candy. The sweet aroma that wafts from its tail weakens the enemy's will to fight.

entry: POKENAME颈部产出棉花糖般的黏泡沫，捕住猎物，还顺便调甜。它拒吃任何不甜的东西。
author: corra_universe
source: POKENAME's neck secretes a sticky cotton candy-like foam which it uses to catch and flavor prey. It refuses to eat anything that isn't sweet.

entry: POKENAME烟里散出美味香气，引来潜在捕食者。可舔咬派状外层，却很可能烫伤。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME's smoke emits a delicious aroma that attracts potential predators. However, licking or biting down on the pie-like exterior is likely to cause burns.

entry: 秋季常见POKENAME寻找各种南瓜味甜食。有些糖果店会在十月，用它替店中糖果宣传。
author: shadeofblu
source: POKENAME's are often seen around the fall, trying to find any form of pumpkin flavored sweets. some candy stores use this Pokémon as a means to advertise their candy during October.

entry: 无论其他宝可梦还是人造食物，甜香都会吸引POKENAME。它能吐极黏的丝抢食，令许多生物十分烦恼。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are drawn to sweet scents, be they from other Pokémon or from human-made foods. To the frustration of many, they can spit incredibly sticky threads which they use to snatch food away from others.

entry: POKENAME爱甜食，常闯糖店，能搬多少拿多少。糖吃太多，便亢奋得不经思索，开始破坏东西。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME loves sweet treats and will often break into candy stores to grab as many as it can carry. If it eats too much sugar, it will become so hyper that it starts breaking things without thinking.

entry: 头上蛋糕状帽子散甜香，虫属性宝可梦无法抗拒，总想抓住。帽上果实，会随POKENAME吃的树果种类变化。
author: fiordaliso
source: The cake-shaped cap on its head emits a sweet aroma that is irresistible to Bug-type Pokémon, who constantly try to capture it. The fruit on its hat changes depending on the type of Berry POKENAME eats.

entry: POKENAME由来自外太空、甜而坚硬的冰糖构成。数块小糖绕着身体运行，每块都有独特的天外滋味。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are made out of sweet yet hard rock candy that comes from outer space. They have several smaller pieces of candy orbit around their body, each with their own unique extraterrestrial flavor.

entry: POKENAME兴奋，尾火就闪成蓝色。火变大，身体便开始有焦糖味。
author: periperi_chicken
source: When POKENAME gets excited, the flame on its tail flickers blue. When the flame grows bigger, its body starts to smell like burnt sugar.

entry: 身体由出乎意料坚固的棉花糖组成。据说它能瞬间做出任何糖食，实际却只能做不同口味的糖丝。
author: roundabout_robin
source: Its body is made of surprisingly sturdy cotton candy. It is said that it can create any sugary treat it wants in an instant, but in reality, it can only make various flavors of spun sugar.

entry: 据说，一种如今流行又美味的糖果，最初受POKENAME启发。研究员不明白，它体表出现的文字，有什么生物学用途。
author: mepp.
source: The inception of a now popular and tasty candy was said to be inspired by POKENAME. Researchers are perplexed in regards to the biological purpose of the words that appear on the Pokémon's bodies.

entry: 据说，一种如今流行又美味的糖果，最初受POKENAME启发。研究员不明白，它体表出现的文字，有什么生物学用途。
author: mepp.
source: The inception of a now-popular and tasty candy was said to be inspired by POKENAME. Researchers are perplexed regarding the biological purpose of the words that appear on the Pokémon's bodies.

entry: POKENAME常梳理自己，只为尝尝构成爪尾的甜奶油。其他生物也能尝，只要拿亮硬币交换。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME often grooms itself just to taste the sweet flavor of the cream that makes up its paws and tail. It allows others to have a taste as well, provided they give it a shiny coin in exchange.

entry: POKENAME身体虽由甜食组成，牙齿却与其他可达鸭相同。高糖饮食，常让它蛀牙。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME may be made out of sweet treats but have the same teeth as any other Psyduck. They often have cavities because of their high sugar diet.

entry: POKENAME用长喙拌面团，还能刮净碗里每一点面团。许多面包店，就为此雇它帮忙。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can mix dough with their long bills to scrape up every bit of dough from the mixing bowl. Many bakeries employ the help of POKENAME for this very purpose.

entry: 浓密蓬毛散出强烈甜香，又因POKENAME的含糖汗液，摸着黏糊，十分难洗干净。
author: fireblade141
source: Its dense, fluffy fur emits a very strong sweet scent. The fur is also sticky in texture thanks to POKENAME's sugary sweat, meaning that it's a total pain to keep clean.

entry: POKENAME身体软甜，许多都成了饥饿宝可梦的美食。为免被吃，POKENAME会用糖水灌满对方的胃，直到不饿。
author: quackquackattack
source: Many POKENAME end up as a tasty snack for hungry Pokémon because of their soft, sweet bodies. To avoid being eaten, POKENAME fills the stomachs of hungry Pokémon with sugary water until their hunger is gone.

entry: POKENAME在陆上分泌黏甜液，帮助调温。入水后，液体慢慢溶解，留下一道粉红痕迹。
author: pattybgoode
source: When on land, POKENAME secretes a sticky, sweet-smelling fluid that helps it regulate its temperature. When in the water, the fluid dissolves slowly, leaving a pink-tinted trail.

entry: POKENAME起初被误认成小仙子，如今归为栖居草原与森林、眨眼就能消失的宝可梦。不在秘密巢穴睡觉时，就大吃蜂蜜与甜花蜜。
author: bobosmith01
source: While first mistaken for a pixie, POKENAME is now classified as a grassland and forest-dwelling Pokémon that can disappear in the blink of an eye. It gorges itself on honey and sweet nectar when it is not sleeping in its secret den.

entry: 天气好时，它偶尔到郊区找甜点。挥动满是糖的魔杖，便有糖粒聚集，可用来攻击或进食。
author: bobosmith01
source: During fair weather, it makes rare appearances in suburban areas in search of sweet confectionery. With a wave of its sugar-laden wand, particles of sugar gather and can be used for offense or consumption.

entry: POKENAME常与糖果师共事，用精神力量拉糖，拉出许多气泡，再做硬糖。只要求公平分到一份，作为回报。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME often work with confectioners, as they can use their psychic abilities to pull sugar until it's full of air bubbles and can be turned into hard candy. All they ask for in return is a fair share of the candy they make.

entry: POKENAME能解开构成全身的棉花糖与扭结甘草糖，灵巧躲开大多数攻击，再用糖缠住对手，使其动弹不得。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can unravel the candy floss and the twisted licorice that comprise its entire body. This lets it nimbly weave away from most attacks while wrapping up its opponents with the immobilizing sweets.

entry: POKENAME由特殊、极硬的冰糖组成。孩子想咬碎片，往往先崩坏自己的牙。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are made out of special rock candy that is incredibly hard. Children often break their teeth trying to bite down on POKENAME flakes.

entry: POKENAME奔过平原，体表甜液带来宜人糖香，似乎连唾液都甜！不过，大部分身体不能吃。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME emit a pleasant sugary fragrance as they run across the plains, thanks to the sweet fluid their body exudes. Apparently, even their saliva is sweet! Most of their body is not edible, however.

entry: POKENAME奔过平原，体表甜液带来宜人糖香，似乎连唾液都甜！不过，大部分身体不能吃。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME emits a pleasant sugary fragrance as it runs across the plains, thanks to the sweet fluid their body exudes. Apparently, even their saliva is sweet! Most of their body is not edible, however.

entry: POKENAME奔过平原，体表甜液带来宜人糖香，似乎连唾液都甜！不过，大部分身体不能吃。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME emits a pleasant sugary fragrance as it runs across the plains, thanks to the sweet fluid their body exudes. Apparently, even their saliva is sweet! Most of their body is not edible, however.

entry: POKENAME的尾巴曾因甜味受追捧，后来才发现，绒毛同样甜美可食，取得还更人道。它很乐意与其他生物分享毛。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's tail was once lauded for its sweet flavor, until it was discovered that POKENAME's fluffy fur is just as sweet and edible, and far more humanely obtained. It's happy to share its own fluff with others.

entry: POKENAME的黏性羽毛怕热。训练时，应避开直射日光，带好应急药物，处理灼伤。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME's sticky feathers are sensitive to heat. Trainers should avoid direct sunlight and carry emergency medicine to heal burns while training POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME看着、闻着都像棉花糖膏，借此骗其他宝可梦吃下自己，让对方生病。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME has the appearence and scent of marshmallow fluff, using this as a ruse to get other Pokémon to eat it and get sick as a result.

entry: POKENAME吞下大量海水，把盐存进体内，与炮管的分泌物混合，制成香甜太妃糖，最爱分给其他宝可梦。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME swallow large mouthfuls of saltwater, storing up the salt within their bodies. They mix it with a secretion produced from their cannons to create a sweet taffy that they love to share with other Pokémon.

entry: 它的壳上有能产生鲜鲜奶油的阀门，厨师采来烘焙。不开心时，它会把壳向下收拢，停止产奶油，直到需求得到满足。
author: quackquackattack
source: Its shell has valves that produce a Fresh Cream, which chefs collect to produce baked goods. When it is upset, it curls its shell down and stops producing cream until its needs are met.

entry: POKENAME毛一湿就开始坏，只得住在干旱沙漠的沙下。毛极甜，在许多地区的游园会，是热门甜点。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME's fluffy fur will begin to deteriorate when wet, forcing them to live in arid deserts beneath the sand. Their fur is incredibly sweet and a popular dessert at fairs in many regions.

entry: POKENAME能把梦变棉花糖，梦越好，糖越甜。它避开噩梦，据说噩梦做的糖，苦得恶心。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME has the strange power to turn dreams into cotton candy; the better the dream, the sweeter the treat. It avoids bad dreams, as the cotton candy they produce is said to be disgustingly bitter.

entry: 冰淇淋身体很甜，但顶部冻层，并非POKENAME本体。这份天然美味滋味细腻，很受烘焙师喜爱。
author: duskit___
source: Its ice cream body is sweet, but the frozen layer atop it is not actually part of POKENAME itself. This natural treat is adored by bakers for its delicate flavor.

entry: 它总怕甜苹果被多边蛇等宝可梦吃掉，宁可自己连苹果一起被吃，也不愿果子被夺，因此始终黏着。
author: epping_forest
source: It lives in constant fear of its sweet apple being eaten by another Pokémon, like Poryans. They would rather be eaten whole with their apple than have it taken away, which is why they are always sticking to it.

entry: POKENAME常被误认成大糖食，遭其他生物袭击，想尝甜。实际身体酸得可怕，它也不怕爆发性地放电。
author: infinex21
source: Often mistaken for large confectioneries, POKENAME are prone to being assailed by others seeking to taste their sweetness. In reality, however, their bodies taste horribly sour, and they are unafraid of explosively discharging electricity.

entry: POKENAME外层是硬糖壳，任其他生物舔。酸味却强得尝过者说，如舌头遭爆炸电击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's exterior is a solid shell of candy coating. It allows others to lick it freely, but the sour flavoring of its shell is so intense that those who taste it liken it to an explosive electric shock to the tongue.

entry: POKENAME全身都能吃，脆糖壳包着焦糖般美味黏心。因此，野外很难见到。
author: mistymagius
source: Every part of POKENAME's body is edible, the brittle sugar shell encasing a delicious gooey center similar to caramel. Because of this, POKENAME is very rarely seen in the wild.

entry: POKENAME身上的可可豆，能制成极甜巧克力。特别向阳处的POKENAME，豆子也特别甜。
author: lydiaprower8
source: The cacao beans that grow on POKENAME have been used to make an incredibly sweet chocolate. POKENAME that live in particularly sunny places have very sweet beans.

entry: POKENAME给骨头武器涂浓唾液，凝成极硬糖球防身。甜香引来许多宝可梦捕猎，只得隐蔽独居。
author: fiordaliso
