author: .izik
source: Before battle, POKENAME pulls its hood over its head to guard its cave. It growls deeply as it fights, using Scary Face to intimidate foes.

entry: POKENAME用尾巴上的液体在墙上涂画，标记领地。它们之间的地盘争夺战，会让整片地区都沾满颜料。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME marks its territory by painting on walls with the fluid from its tail. Territorial wars between POKENAME leave entire areas coated with paint.

entry: POKENAME好勇斗狠，见什么都想打。尾巴一挥就能粉碎实心钢铁，速度又快得令人眼花，是个相当难缠的对手。
author: patch01774
source: POKENAME is an antagonistic Pokémon that fights anything it sees. Its tail is capable of crushing solid steel in one swipe and its blinding speed makes it quite the tough opponent.

entry: 成群的POKENAME攀在洞壁上放哨，用鬼面驱赶闯入领地的生物。
author: .izik
source: Clusters of POKENAME cling to cave walls as sentries. They use Scary Face to drive away intruders from their domain.

entry: POKENAME一生中会与其他野生宝可梦结成紧密的群体。到了冬天，这些群体便会袭击附近城镇，搜罗食物、药品和贵重物品。
author: turron_turron
source: Over the course of their lives, POKENAME form tightly-knit groups with other wild Pokémon. During the winter, these groups will raid nearby cities in search of food, medicine, and valuables.

entry: POKENAME能轻松用尾巴流出的酸液标记领地。受到威胁时，它会使出强力的飞膝踢反击。
author: .izik
source: The acid from POKENAME's tail marks its territory with ease. If threatened, it retaliates with a powerful High Jump Kick.

entry: 每只POKENAME都占有大片森林，会以利爪劈砍驱逐入侵者。只有承认它为首领的宝可梦才能进入，但即便是追随者，它也绝不容忍任何不敬。
author: .jerden
source: Each POKENAME claims a large area of forest, driving off intruders with slashes from its sharp claws. Only Pokémon that acknowledge it as their leader may enter its territory, but POKENAME will not tolerate any disrespect from its followers.

entry: 与进化前不同，POKENAME十分保护训练家。它会预知未来，查看训练家是否有危险。一察觉威胁，就会以卑鄙的战术将其击退。
author: mintvy.
source: Differing from its pre-evolution, POKENAME is very protective of its Trainer. It uses its ability to see the future to see if its Trainer is in danger. When it senses a threat, it fights off the danger using dirty fighting tactics.

entry: POKENAME背上的金属褶边能提升专注力。它使出的念力能让对手昏昏沉沉好几个小时。
author: .izik
source: Metal frills along POKENAME's back enhance its focus. Its Confusion attack can leave opponents dazed for hours.

entry: POKENAME极力守护自己居住的沙漠绿洲。一发现入侵者，便先以流沙地狱将其困住，再迅速解决。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME is fiercely territorial of its desert oasis home. If it spots an intruder, it traps them in a Sand Tomb before swiftly finishing them off.

entry: POKENAME后方嘴部的褶边能感知空气中的水分，帮助它在幽深洞窟里找到地下水源。
author: .izik
source: The frills on POKENAME's rear mouth detect moisture in the air. This helps it locate underground water sources in deep caves.

entry: POKENAME蜕下的皮硬如钢铁。遇袭时，它会拉起皮肤防御，再以强力踢击反击。谁想从背后偷袭，就会被它下颚般的角咬住。
author: darkweavile428
source: POKENAME's shed skin is as hard as steel. When attacked, it will pull up its skin to defend itself, then retaliate with a powerful kick. Anyone who tries a sneak attack from behind will get chomped by its jaw-like horns.

entry: POKENAME的头结实得惊人，即使最坚硬的岩石也能轻松撞碎。因此，它深受洞窟作业者和拆除工人的欢迎。
author: kam_doodle_snek
source: POKENAME's head is very durable; it can easily smash through even the toughest of rocks. As such, it is a very popular Pokémon among those who work in caves or demolition.

entry: POKENAME把大片丛林划为领地，谁闯进来都会遭到猛烈殴打。松垮的皮肤能当口袋，让它随身携带大量树果。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME claims large areas of jungle as its territory and will violently pummel anyone who enters it. Its loose skin acts like a pouch, allowing it to carry large amounts of berries.

entry: POKENAME天生反骨，为了显得与众不同，会故意不听指令。遇到同类时，它还会刻意避开对方的行为方式，彰显自己不随大流。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is a natural rebel and will intentionally disregard commands just so it can stand out. If it encounters another POKENAME, it will try to avoid copying their behavior so it can be seen as non-conforming.

entry: POKENAME藏身于人口密集的贫民区，残忍欺负比自己弱小的人和宝可梦。它常伪装成普通棒球棒，想骗毫无防备的孩子拿起自己。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME hides out in populated slums, cruelly bullying any people or Pokémon weaker than it. It will often disguise itself as a regular baseball bat, trying to trick unsuspecting children into picking it up.

entry: POKENAME围巾般的皮肤能察觉细微温差。雨快来时，它会把金属身体藏好，以免生锈。
author: .izik
source: The scarf-like skin of POKENAME detects subtle temperature shifts. When rain nears, it hides its metal body to avoid rusting.

entry: POKENAME是臭名昭著的小偷，会从训练家身上顺走精灵球等贵重物品，藏在蜕下的毛皮披风里，偷偷运给别人。可谁想反过来偷它的东西，就会挨一记报复的头锤。
author: kungfucutbug
source: POKENAME are notorious thieves, swiping valuable items such as Poké Balls from Trainers and smuggling them to others in cloaks of their molted fur. Attempts to steal from them instead, however, will be met with a retaliatory Headbutt.

entry: POKENAME会成群聚集，交流如何制作最酷的专属衣服与配饰。穿得最有狠劲的那只，就是群体首领。
author: alestrius
source: POKENAME gather in packs, where they trade ideas for how to create the coolest custom clothing and accessories. The leader of the pack is the one with the toughest-looking fashion.

entry: POKENAME把厚皮充满热空气，在沙漠上空飘荡，从高处寻找毫无戒备的猎物。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME fills its thick skin with hot air to drift across desert skies. It searches from above for unaware prey.

entry: POKENAME打架很有派头，先用大耳朵扇打，再接上沉重的踢击。它把色彩鲜艳的蜕皮做成臂带、护腿和面罩，启发了合众朋克圈一种缤纷的时尚风格。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME fights with attitude, leading with slaps from its large ears and following with heavy kicks. Its use of colorful skin sheddings as armbands, legguards, and a facemask has inspired a vibrant fashion style in the Unovan punk scene.

entry: POKENAME合在一起的眼睑既能恐吓敌人，又能挡住沙粒和阳光。袭击其他宝可梦的巢穴时，它会把蜕皮拉到口鼻上，遮住面貌，也显示自己有把握不用牙就能取胜。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME's fused eyelids serve as an intimidation tactic and eye protection from sand grains and sunlight. When raiding a Pokémon's den, it pulls the shedding over its snout, hiding its features and signaling confidence it will not need its jaws.

entry: POKENAME全靠愤怒驱动，暴怒时能毁掉整座森林。它的斧头几乎坚不可摧，挥动的力道足以夷平一栋摩天大楼。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is fueled by pure anger, destroying entire forests in fits of rage. Its axe is nearly indestructible and POKENAME can swing it with enough force to level a skyscraper.

entry: POKENAME乘着沙漠的风翱翔，寻找梦歌仙人掌作为猎物。发现目标后，它会高速俯冲，以一记迅捷的火焰踢解决对方。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME soars on desert winds as it searches for Cacturne to prey upon. When it finds its target, it swoops down at high speeds and dispatches them with a swift Blaze Kick.

entry: POKENAME厌恶阳光，会把松垮的皮披在几个头上当兜帽。强光会让它本就不佳的视力变得更差。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME loathes sunlight, draping its loose skin over its heads like a hood. Bright light worsens its already poor eyesight.

entry: POKENAME用强力头锤撞倒树木，拦河筑坝。坝筑好后，它会在黄昏时站在上面，得意地欢呼。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME rams trees with powerful Headbutts to dam rivers. After completing its dam, it proudly cheers atop it at dusk.

entry: POKENAME头上和背上的皮肤会硬化成金色铠甲，抵挡攻击，连坠落的碎石瓦砾也能挡下。
author: .izik
source: The skin on POKENAME's head and back hardens into golden armor. This shields it from attacks and even falling debris.

entry: POKENAME很在意别人怎么看自己，旁边有人时，通常会把皮肤裹得严严实实。不过没人看时，就能见它破坏财物，四处惹麻烦。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is very self-conscious and will usually keep its skin tightly closed when others are around. However, when no one is looking, it can be seen destroying property and generally being a nuisance.

entry: POKENAME为了显示自己强悍，蜕下的皮落在哪里就丢在哪里。尽管平时态度冷淡，只要见到黑眼鳄被欺负，它就会攻击惹事的家伙。
author: pjporwoll
source: In an attempt to demonstrate its toughness, POKENAME simply leaves its shed skin where it falls. Despite its indifferent attitude, if it sees anything bothering a Sandile, it will attack the offending presence.

entry: POKENAME挥动长牙，划出八角形的弧线示威。若警告无效，它便使出毁灭性的真气拳。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME swings its tusks in octagonal arcs to intimidate. If the warning fails, it strikes with a devastating Focus Punch.

entry: POKENAME飞行时得提着松垮的皮，因此并不擅长飞行。它领地意识很强，会试着损伤对手的翅膀，希望让对方无法行动。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is not the best flyer, as it has to hold up its loose skin while it flies. It is quite a territorial Pokémon and will try to damage its opponent's wings in the hopes of immobilizing them.

entry: POKENAME每隔一两天就会蜕下一层黏滑的皮，防止身体干燥。留下的皮具有抗菌作用，常被当作一种特殊面膜出售。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME sheds a slimy layer of its skin every day or two, keeping its body from drying up. The leftover skin carries anti-bacterial properties and is often sold as a special type of face mask.

entry: POKENAME布料般的皮肤能轻松缓冲攻击。一看到敌人站不稳，它便会与同伴一齐使出头锤，将其压倒。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's clothlike skin absorbs blows with ease. If it sees a foe stagger, it and its allies will Headbutt in unison to overwhelm them.

entry: POKENAME松垮的皮肤能展开成长翼，让它使出复杂的空战动作。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's loose skin unfurls into long wings. It uses these to execute complex aerial combat maneuvers.

entry: POKENAME发现野生宝可梦群体时，会挑战首领单独决斗，赢了就抢走整群的食物储备。它与滑滑鱼共生，还会把对方当作射击武器。
author: milchik
source: When it spots a group of wild Pokémon, it challenges the leader for a one on one duel and robs the group of the food supplies if POKENAME wins. It has a symbiotic relationship with Scraraid and uses it as a shooting weapon.

entry: POKENAME会把掉落的鳞片收进松垮的皮里。新鳞片不到一小时就能长好，几乎无法靠消耗战拖垮它。
author: .izik
source: When scales fall off, POKENAME stores them in its loose skin. New ones regrow in under an hour, making it nearly impossible to wear down.

entry: POKENAME脾气不好，为它清洗华丽的毛发时，训练家和它自己都苦不堪言，很难相处。洗澡时它又踢又打，等彻底洗干净后，却又不肯出浴缸。
author: beetlething
source: POKENAME is a difficult companion because its temper makes cleaning its luxurious coat miserable for both its Trainer and POKENAME. POKENAME will punch and kick when bathed, but then refuse to get out of the bath after a thorough cleaning.

entry: 它总把松垮、橡胶般的皮肤往上提，保护混战中的要害。巨大的扇形头冠也并非摆设，使出强力头锤时，就像一根沉重的大棒。
author: willowwhisker_98658
source: It constantly hitches up its sagging, rubbery skin to protect its vitals during a brawl. Its massive, fan-like crest isn't just for show; it acts as a weighted club when delivering a devastating headbutt.

entry: 这只爱惹事的POKENAME几乎见什么都偷，尤其偏爱亮晶晶的物件和食物。它还格外喜欢千层面，趣味有些奇特。
author: hophoppip
source: This troublemaking POKENAME steals nearly anything it finds, favoring shiny objects and food. It has an odd preference for lasagna.

entry: POKENAME无论整理多少次仪容，都很难把衣服穿好。不少个体白白忙上无数个小时，忙得头痛，最终沮丧地放弃。
author: quackquackattack
source: No matter how many times POKENAME try to fix their appearance, they always struggle to properly wear their garments. Many develop headaches out of the countless hours they waste and eventually give up out of frustration.

entry: 哪怕极淡的食物气味，POKENAME的鼻子也能察觉。一看到别的宝可梦在吃东西，它就会怒火中烧，常带动附近的猴怪加入，一起使出围攻对付敌人。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME can detect even the most subtle scent of food with its nose. If it sees another Pokémon eating, it will fume into a rage—often triggering nearby Mankey to join in and coordinate to Beat Up the foe.

entry: POKENAME以发达的肌肉和看似毫无来由的残忍闻名。它会一时兴起，殴打自己认为低等的生物。人类也在此列。
author: dylonk25
source: POKENAME is known for its large muscles and seemingly pointless cruelty, beating up creatures it views as lesser on a whim. This description includes humans.

entry: 或许由于外表更接近人类，POKENAME开始模仿人的行为。各个个体喜欢的活动不同，有的听音乐，有的甚至做运动。不过，它的力量依然致命。
author: bobosmith01
source: Perhaps due to its more humanoid appearance, it has begun mimicking human behavior. Each POKENAME engages in different human activities, such as listening to music or even sports. It is still deadly powerful.

entry: POKENAME领地意识极强，凡是踏入领地的其他草属性宝可梦，都会被它殴打。因此，它被视为入侵物种。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are incredibly territorial as they will beat up any other Grass Pokémon that enters its territory. Because of this, POKENAME are considered an invasive species.

entry: 野生POKENAME潜在溪池中漂浮休眠，看起来与周围睡莲叶几乎无异。背叶吃下有毒，可用来抵御天敌。
author: theartemis1
source: When floating dormant beneath a stream or pond, wild POKENAME are nearly impossible to distinguish between the surrounding lily pads. The leaf on its back is poisonous to ingest, serving as a defense mechanism against any potential predators.

entry: POKENAME浮在池塘水面下方，吃着漂到附近的小型水生植物。宽叶和香蒲般的附肢，让它融入周围的芦苇丛，躲过头顶飞过的鸟宝可梦。
author: eiskitsune
source: POKENAME floats just beneath the surface of ponds, feasting on small aquatic plants that drift nearby. Its broad leaf and cattail-like appendage help it blend into the surrounding reeds, hiding it from bird Pokémon flying overhead.

entry: POKENAME平时在湖底或池底休息，睡着时却会浮上水面。只要有东西跳上它的睡莲叶，就会把它惊醒，继而引发爆炸。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME generally rests on the bottom of lakes and ponds, but floats to the surface when sleeping. Anything that hops onto its lilypad will wake it up and cause it to explode.

entry: POKENAME生活在湖底，藤蔓永不停长。藤蔓长得过于蓬乱时，它便走上岸，让食草宝可梦帮忙修剪，露出被遮住的脸。
author: standing__water
source: POKENAME lives at the bottom of lakes and its vines never stop growing. If POKENAME's vines grow too shaggy, it will walk to land and let plant-eating Pokémon trim the vines away from its concealed face.

entry: POKENAME用背上的叶片载着其他宝可梦，以前鳍划水。比起养在水缸里，它更喜欢生活在池塘和河流中。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME carries Pokémon on its back pad while using its front fins to swim. It prefers to live in ponds and rivers as opposed to living in a tank.

entry: 许多POKENAME努力锻炼，想把训练家驮在背上，还会背着成捆石块增强力量。据说，一旦成功背训练家渡过河流，它便会因为无比喜悦而进化。
author: quackquackattack
source: Many POKENAME strive to carry their Trainer on their back, developing their strength with bundles of rocks. It is said that if they are able to carry their Trainer on their back and cross a river, their overwhelming joy causes them to evolve.

entry: POKENAME在使用矮桌的餐馆里，是十分受欢迎的服务生。它的睡莲叶很适合当托盘，能摆上几个茶杯等小物件，友善的模样也让许多客人感到安心。
author: beetlething
source: POKENAME make for incredibly popular waiters at restaurants with low-rise tables. POKENAME's lily pads make for a great serving plate for multiple small items such as teacups, and its friendly appearance puts many customers at ease.

entry: 它心满意足地在湖泊池塘中划行，为附近的人和宝可梦提供接送。小型宝可梦可以骑在它头上，人和较大的宝可梦则能坐在睡莲旁。
author: pattybgoode
source: It contentedly paddles around lakes and ponds, offering transport to any nearby people and Pokémon. Small Pokémon can ride on its head, and people and larger Pokémon can sit with the water lily.

entry: 比起空气，它似乎更喜欢水，因此悬浮时常用精神力让一团水泡包住自己。它乐意用头载着小型宝可梦，送它们去想去的地方。
author: imaginita
source: It appears to be more comfortable in water than in air, so when levitating, it will often use its psychic powers to carry a bubble of water around it. It happily carries small Pokémon on its head to wherever they want to go.

entry: POKENAME背上与莲叶童子一样长着宽叶，乍看很难区分。不过它的叶片摸起来很烫，甚至会让周围的水看似沸腾。
author: deniablecredibility
source: POKENAME has the same broad leaf growing from its back as a Lotad, and it can be difficult to tell them apart at a glance. However, POKENAME's leaf is hot to the touch, so much so that the water around it may appear to be boiling.

entry: POKENAME头顶的睡莲叶会影响飞行平衡。即使只是从树上摘一颗绿球果，它也常要试好几次。
author: .izik
source: The lily pad atop POKENAME's head throws off its balance during flight. It often requires several tries to pluck even a single Green Apricorn from trees.

entry: 夜里，POKENAME脸朝下睡在池塘中。早晨则慢悠悠地吃着岸边生长的花。
author: .izik
source: At night, POKENAME sleeps face-down in ponds. In the morning, it grazes lazily on nearby flowers growing along the banks.

entry: POKENAME会在池塘上方织出精巧的网。黏网专门捕捉滑翔得太近的飞行宝可梦。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spins intricate webs stretched across ponds. The sticky nets are designed to catch flying Pokémon gliding too close.

entry: 它的“羊毛”其实由数百万根微小植物纤维构成，是通过光合作用生成的。这种材料用途广泛，能制成许多植物纺织品。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Its “wool” is actually made up of millions of tiny plant fibers it creates through photosynthesis. This material is very versatile and used to create a lot of plant-based textiles.

entry: POKENAME尾巴上盛开的花散发甜香，能把远处的虫属性宝可梦吸引过来。一池POKENAME虽然芳香宜人，伴随而来的大群虫子却常让人扫兴。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The flower that blooms on POKENAME's tail has a sweet aroma that draws Bug-type Pokémon from great distances. Though the aroma of a pond full of POKENAME is pleasant, the experience is often spoiled by the large swarms of bugs that accompany them.

entry: POKENAME一家会在水道里用尾巴互相勾住，聚在一起。它们把耳朵露出水面，聆听危险。一受威胁，全家就会拍起纷乱水花，一齐游走。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Families of POKENAME cluster together in waterways, using their tails to attach to one another. They keep their ears above the waterline to listen for danger, with the entire family swimming away in a frenzy of splashes if they're threatened.

entry: POKENAME头顶的睡莲叶能增加重量，防止轻飘飘的身体被风吹偏。不过，叶片若积了太多雨水，它又会重得完全飞不起来。
author: sk372
source: The lilypad on POKENAME's head helps to counteract its light weight and keep winds from blowing it off course. If it gathers too much rainwater, however, it becomes too heavy to be airborne at all.

entry: POKENAME的身体比水轻，能毫不费力地顺着河流、小溪漂行。它常用睡莲叶载小型宝可梦过河。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's body is lighter than water, allowing it to effortlessly float along rivers and streams. It often helps smaller Pokémon cross the river on its lily pad.

entry: POKENAME刚出生时，头上的叶子还不比新芽大，随后会迅速长大。叶片大小象征地位，而莲帽小童的叶片却大多差不多大，因此有些个体选择不进化。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: When POKENAME are born, the leaf on their head is no larger than a new sprout, but it grows rapidly as they mature. Leaf size is a sign of status, and some POKENAME choose not to evolve, as Lombre all possess similarly sized leaves.

entry: POKENAME会吸引许多虫属性宝可梦来为背上的睡莲授粉。作为回报，授粉者能在它背上的叶片歇息片刻。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME draw many Bug-type Pokémon to the water lily on their back to pollinate it. In exchange for pollination, many Bug-type Pokémon are given a moment of respite on the pad on their back.

entry: POKENAME在湖边芦苇丛深处筑巢。一受打扰，就会立刻喷出强劲水流反击，驱走入侵者。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME nests deep in lakeside reeds. If disturbed, it will immediately retaliate with a forceful blast of water to drive intruders away.

entry: 对想穿越冰封湖泊、河流的宝可梦来说，POKENAME是可靠的帮手。它的睡莲叶覆着疏水凝胶，水和冰都会滑落，让乘客坐在头上也不会弄湿。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME is a reliable helper for Pokémon who want to traverse across frozen lakes and rivers. Since its lily pad is coated with a hydrophobic gel, water and ice slide off its head, allowing other Pokémon to sit on its head without getting wet.

entry: POKENAME把睡莲花收进口袋，只敢摘最美、最健康的花。找到合适的伴侣后，它会献出收藏，希望获得青睐。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME collects water lilies in its pouch, only daring to pick the prettiest and healthiest flowers. When it finds a suitable partner, it presents its collection, hoping to be accepted.

entry: POKENAME尾巴上的花会分泌散发恶臭的粉色墨汁。它用墨汁在树桩和石头上绘出奇怪的记号。
author: .izik
source: The flower on POKENAME's tail secretes pink ink with a foul odor. It uses the ink to paint strange markings on stumps and rocks.

entry: POKENAME攻击前，会先让电流通过睡莲叶。它的十万伏特只需一击就能打倒一棵树，足见电力之强。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME channels electricity through its lily pad before it attacks. Its Thunderbolt is strong enough to take down a tree in one strike, showcasing its powerful electric abilities.

entry: 它打赢对战，就盼着之后能得到食物。因此，训练家常喂它一包包即食咖喱，既便宜又容易买到。
author: quackquackattack
source: It wins battles with the expectation that it gets fed afterwards. As such, Trainers opt to feed it packets of Packaged Curry because it is cheap and easy to find.

entry: POKENAME栖居在沙漠绿洲，常能见它一边转圈一边悠闲放松。离水太久会迅速干燥，从睡莲叶的变化就能看出来。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME reside in desert oases, often found relaxing while spinning in circles. They rapidly dry out when out of water for prolonged periods of time, which can be seen in their lily pad.

entry: 暴雨过后，POKENAME会把水储存在头顶叶片里。这段时间，它皮肤上会冒出带洋葱味的小芽。
author: .izik
source: After a rainstorm, POKENAME stores water in the leaf on its head. During this time, small onion-flavored sprouts grow from its skin.

entry: POKENAME是沼泽战斗的高手，沼泽也是它的家。据说它睡莲叶里的水能让死气沉沉的池塘重获生机，生态繁盛，莲花也开得格外灿烂。
author: notadoctor75
source: POKENAME is a master of combat in the marshes it calls home. The water in its lily pad is said to be capable of revitalizing stagnant ponds into a thriving ecosystem, with lotuses blooming brilliantly.

entry: POKENAME的叶状羽毛能推动小巧的身体，在栖居的池塘中游动。小型宝可梦可以跳上它头顶温暖的叶片，搭乘它渡水。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME's leafy feathers help propel this Pokémon's small body through the water of the pond they live in. Small Pokémon can hop onto the warm leaf on POKENAME's head and get a ride across the water.

entry: POKENAME身上覆着水生植物，通常待在水质洁净的池塘附近。兴奋时，它会上岸蹦跳，吐出点点火星。身体过热，就会回到水中。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: Covered in aquatic plants, POKENAME generally stay near ponds that have clean water. When it gets excited, POKENAME will step onto land and hop around, spitting out small sparks of fire. If it gets overheated, POKENAME returns to the water.

entry: POKENAME栖居在沙漠绿洲，常能见它一边转圈一边悠闲放松。它也会和来访的其他宝可梦玩耍，让对方坐在睡莲叶上转圈。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME reside in desert oases, often found relaxing while spinning in circles. They will also play with other visiting Pokémon, spinning them around on their lily pad.

entry: POKENAME常背朝上浮在湖里，用睡莲叶遮住身体，躲避捕食者。它也会收集找到的植物，留待之后享用。
author: whiteupgrade
source: POKENAME often float in lakes with their back up, hiding its body with its lilypad from predators. It also collects plants it finds to eat later.

entry: POKENAME喜欢在家园的池塘中游泳，会潜入水下，只露出叶状的头羽。若察觉家附近有危险，它便发出尖叫，吓退威胁。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: Preferring to swim in the pond waters it calls home, POKENAME will submerge itself so only its leafy head feather can be seen from the surface. If it senses danger near its home, POKENAME will let out a sharp cry to ward off any threats.

entry: POKENAME会毫不犹豫地保护同族居住的洁净水域。这份勇气，让这一物种赢得了“池塘守卫”的称号。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME will not hesitate to protect the clean waters where their kin reside. This display of courage has earned this Pokémon species the title “Defenders of the Pond”.

entry: POKENAME的力量出奇地大，只要人或宝可梦能坐得进它头顶，就都载得动。它偏爱较浑浊的水域。
author: torterraguy26
source: POKENAME is surprisingly strong, so it can ferry any person or Pokémon that can fit on its head. It prefers to live in muddier waters.

entry: POKENAME会向树上的橙子喷水，把果实打下来饱餐一顿。它试着用睡莲叶接住，成功时就会开心地轻叫。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spits water at oranges in trees to knock them down for a quick meal. It attempts to catch the fruit in its lily pad, letting out a tiny squeak of happiness when successful.

entry: 它们游在湖泊和河流表面，需要干净的水域栖身。若有人在水边野餐或钓鱼，它们便会漂过去，迫不及待想凑热闹。
author: quackquackattack
source: They swim on the surface of lakes and rivers, as they require clean water to wade in. They float to people who are having picnics or fishing by the water's edge, eager to join in on the fun.

entry: POKENAME只在未受污染的湖泊池塘中定居，因此它的出现被视为水域生态健康的标志。日出时，或许能瞥见它在水面上欢快起舞。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's presence is considered a sign of a healthy aquatic ecosystem, as it only settles in unpolluted lakes and ponds. At sunrise, one may catch a glimpse of it dancing joyfully on top of the water.

entry: POKENAME无法处理海水，只出现在淡水水域附近，也只有在淡水里才能改变体色。头顶的叶片平时不会变色，除非身体状况不佳。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME cannot process saltwater, so they are only found near bodies of freshwater; similarly, they can only change the colors of their bodies within freshwater. The pads upon their heads do not change color unless they are in poor health.

entry: POKENAME被束缚在一张大睡莲叶上，满足地漂在池塘和湖面。想换个景色时，它便附身到附近睡着的宝可梦身上，叫受害者把睡莲叶搬去另一片水域。
author: pkbonusducks
source: Bound to a large lilypad, POKENAME contentedly float along the surface of ponds and lakes. If they desire a change in scenery, POKENAME possess a nearby sleeping Pokémon and have the victim carry their Lilypad to new waters.

entry: POKENAME背上有一朵特殊的花，一受扰动就会扬起花粉云。但不少同类仍会把它的背当跳板，因为动作够灵巧，花粉根本沾不到身上。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a special flower atop their backs that releases a cloud of pollen when disturbed. This does not stop many POKENAME from using their backs as a springboard, as many are too nimble for the cloud to cling to them.

entry: POKENAME身上滴落的水富含养分。古人视其为神物，声称能治愈一切疾病。
author: .izik
source: Water dripping from POKENAME's body is rich in nutrients. Ancient peoples believed it divine, claiming it could cure any illness.

entry: 发现捕食者时，POKENAME头顶的粉色花朵会迅速逆时针旋转。它从花中喷出的水柱，威力足以推倒一棵橡树。
author: .izik
source: The pink flower on POKENAME's head spins rapidly counterclockwise when a predator is spotted. It fires jets of water from the flower with enough force to topple an oak tree.

entry: POKENAME知道纯净泉水从哪里涌出。它会让其他宝可梦坐上睡莲叶，游过水域，把大家送去那里。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME knows where pure springwater wells up, and it lets Pokémon sit on its lily pad so it can carry them there by swimming through bodies of water.

entry: POKENAME壳上的小花带着清淡怡人的绿球果香。睡着后，香气会更浓，让周围变得舒适宜人。
author: .izik
source: The tiny flower on POKENAME's shell carries a pleasant, subtle Green Apricorn scent. This smell intensifies while it sleeps, making the surrounding area pleasant to be in.

entry: POKENAME平时虽然懒洋洋地漂在水面，动作却比看起来敏捷得多。只要折起头顶的睡莲叶，把四肢收紧，就能以惊人的速度游动。
author: catsquatch_geography
source: Though they typically drift lazily across the water's surface, POKENAME are far more agile than they appear. By folding the lilypad atop their heads and tucking their limbs close to their bodies, they can swim at remarkable speeds.

entry: POKENAME喜欢吃水源附近采来的苔藓，会先在手中烤焦再吃。由于代谢旺盛，它一顿能吃下超过5磅的苔藓。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME prefers to eat moss gathered near water sources, scorching it in its hand before consuming it. It can eat over 5 pounds of moss in a single meal due to its high metabolism.

entry: 成群POKENAME的睡莲叶聚在一起，像一张筏子，因此水中的一群便被称为“一筏”。它们一生超过80%的时间都在水里度过。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: A group of POKENAME in the water is known as a "raft" due to the way their lily pad-like features cluster together. These Pokémon spend over 80% of their lives in the water.

entry: POKENAME头顶的睡莲叶在一天里偶尔会脱落。高速游泳时碰上这种情况，尤其麻烦。
author: .izik
source: The lily pad on POKENAME's head occasionally detaches throughout the day. This becomes especially problematic when it swims at high speeds.

entry: 它藏在池塘水面下，靠漂浮的布制睡莲叶保持浮力。如果有宝可梦从下方游过，它就赶紧爬向岸边，免得被从下面看见。
author: pattybgoode
source: It hides beneath the surface of ponds, buoyant through the aid of a floating cloth lily pad. When a Pokémon is swimming beneath it, it hurriedly scurries to the water's edge to avoid being seen from below.

entry: POKENAME以实现愿望闻名，不过许愿得来的东西总是莫名湿透。实现愿望时，它的表情似乎毫无变化。
author: pattybgoode
source: POKENAME is known to grant wishes, but any objects wished for arrive mysteriously soaked. When granting wishes, its expression seems not to change at all.

entry: POKENAME成群聚在河流和小溪里，用宽大的睡莲叶状头部，给小型宝可梦搭出渡水的路。它们虽只有一个脑，却不清楚究竟长在水面上的懒人獭头里，还是下方的莲叶童子头里。
author: brilliantdarkness
source: Groups of POKENAME gather in rivers and streams, using their wide lilypad-shaped heads to provide crossings for smaller Pokémon. Though they possess one brain, it is unclear if it is housed in the Slakoth head above water or the Lotad head below.

entry: POKENAME让电流通过头顶的睡莲叶。绿毛虫等小型宝可梦若靠近池塘，就会被它电击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME channels electricity through the lily pads on its head. It shocks small Pokémon like Caterpie when they approach its pond.

entry: 它头上的叶片能吸收水及其中的矿物质。它靠吃矿物质获得养分，吸收或喝下的大部分水则会存起来，用于喷射敌人。
author: infinex21
source: The pad upon its head is capable of absorbing water and any minerals within the water as well. Although they gain nutrients from consuming minerals, most of the water they absorb or consume is simply stored so it may be expelled at their enemies.

entry: 这些宝可梦常出现在瀑布附近，或直接站在瀑布下方。它们性情十分平静，喜欢水流倾泻到背上盛开睡莲的感觉。
author: naivetotoro
source: These Pokémon are often found near waterfalls or standing directly beneath them. They are very calm and love the feeling of water cascading onto the blooming water lily on their backs.

entry: POKENAME会在洞窟中飞行，寻找迷路的人。它靠回声定位在黑暗中辨路，即使深入水下也没问题。有人靠近洞窟时，它会用尖叫声烦扰对方。
author: laughing_dan
source: POKENAME will fly around in caves to find lost people. They use echolocation to find their way in the dark, even deep underwater. POKENAME will use its sharp cries to annoy anyone approaching their caves.

entry: POKENAME用长长的芦苇编出精巧的球形巢穴。巢通常离水很近，方便随时找到芦苇修补。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME take long pieces of reeds to weave intricate nests that resemble an orb. Many nests are close to water so that POKENAME can quickly find reeds for any impromptu repairs.

entry: 别看POKENAME这副模样，它对大多数宝可梦都很凶，会用电攻击认定的威胁。草属性似乎是例外，它乐意让它们坐在自己身上休息。
author: sondededoo
source: Despite their appearance, POKENAME are incredibly aggressive towards most Pokémon, attacking those they deem threats with electricity. Grass-types seem to be the exception, as POKENAME will happily allow these Pokémon to rest on top of them.

entry: POKENAME用叶片运水，浇洗沾满泥土的晶体。晶体越干净，吃起来就越合它口味。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME will use its leaf to carry water, which it pours over dirt-coated crystals. The cleaner the crystals, the better they taste to POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME啃食水生植物和小鱼，直到把当地的食物吃光。之后，它靠头顶盘中储存的水维生，上岸寻找新的觅食区。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME munches on underwater plants and small fish, eating until the food sources are depleted. Water stored in the dish on its head sustains it as it travels on land to find a new feeding zone.

entry: 调酒师会与POKENAME合作，供应美味饮品。它的花蜜是许多甜饮的重要原料，平坦的头顶也能让客人搁放杯子。
author: quackquackattack
source: Bartenders work alongside POKENAME to serve delicious drinks. Its nectar is an important ingredient for many sweet beverages, and its head provides a flat surface for patrons to rest their glasses on.

entry: POKENAME靠吸取垃圾填埋场的渗滤液维生。因此，它所有的水流攻击都充满细菌，应尽量避开。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME survives off leachate siphoned from landfills. Because of this, all of its water attacks are filled with bacteria and should be avoided when possible.

entry: POKENAME开心地飞过池塘，边滑翔边唱歌。睡觉时，它更喜欢安静地浮在水面。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME joyfully flies over ponds, singing as it glides. It prefers to sleep floating peacefully on the water's surface.

entry: POKENAME头顶沉重的叶片让它在陆地上行动迟缓。身体浮力足以让它浮在水面，因此下水游泳就快多了。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's movements on land are slowed by the heavy leaf on its head. It moves much more quickly by swimming in the water, as it is buoyant enough to float at the surface.

entry: POKENAME浸入水中时，棉絮般的内里会膨胀。这种奇异的适应方式，让它在水里的力气大幅增强。
author: .izik
source: When submerged, POKENAME's cotton-like innards expand. This bizarre adaptation greatly boosts its physical strength in the water.

entry: POKENAME用背上长出的睡莲叶接雨水。只要小心走路，它就能把少量水从一个地方运到另一个地方。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME catches rainwater in the lily pads growing from its back. If it walks carefully, it can use them to transport small amounts of water from one place to another.

entry: POKENAME的蘑菇极其柔软湿润，滋味鲜美，常用于长管通心粉料理。它与乳酪、酱汁尤其相配，是厨师梦寐以求的食材。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's extremely soft and moist mushroom is savory and used in a number of ziti dishes. The flavor pairs exceptionally well with cheese and sauce, making it a coveted ingredient among chefs.

entry: POKENAME常借栖居沼泽里茂密的植物，遮住身体下半部。为何这样做，目前仍不清楚。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME often uses the overgrowth of its marshy home to hide its lower torso from view. Its reason for doing so is unknown.

entry: POKENAME常载着不会游泳的其他宝可梦渡水，彼此互载却很少见。经过大量研究才发现，它们纯粹是在玩。
author: metcassette
source: Although POKENAME are commonly seen ferrying other Pokémon that can't swim, it's a rare sight to see them carrying each other. After much research, it turns out they're simply having fun.

entry: POKENAME沿蜿蜒河道游动，日子过得悠然自得。它对其他野生宝可梦很友好，会主动帮忙载它们渡水。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME swim through meandering rivers, taking a languid approach to their life. They are amiable toward other wild Pokémon and offer to help carry them across the water.

entry: POKENAME头顶的睡莲叶吸收越多阳光，就长得越大。古代文化曾相信吃下一部分能忘却失恋之痛，实际却只会引起强烈恶心。
author: .izik
source: The lily pad on POKENAME's head grows increasingly large the more sunlight it absorbs. Ancient cultures once believed that eating portions of it would help someone forget heartbreak, though in reality, it caused only intense nausea.

entry: POKENAME喜欢在池塘、湖泊里玩水，把身体潜下去，只露出睡莲叶。让训练家头痛的是，它却讨厌洗澡，谁想帮它洗，就会被它抓。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME enjoy playing in ponds and lakes, submerging themselves so that only their lily pad is visible above the water. Frustratingly for their trainers, POKENAME hate having baths, scratching at people whenever someone tries to wash them.

entry: POKENAME头痛剧烈时，头顶的睡莲叶会变成褐色。吃树果能暂时缓解疼痛。
author: .izik
source: When suffering from intense headaches, the lily pad on POKENAME's head turns brown. Eating berries can ease the pain temporarily.

entry: 发怒时，POKENAME会摘下头顶的睡莲叶，像手里剑一样掷向敌人，力道惊人。没有睡莲叶压在头上，它的平衡感会明显改善。
author: .izik
source: When enraged, POKENAME detaches the lily pad from its head and hurls it like a shuriken at its foe with surprising force. Its balance improves dramatically when the lily pad is off of its head.

entry: POKENAME浮在热带湖面，总是一刻不停。给它最爱的黄瓜，就能让它安静下来。
author: mr.person__prinplup_enjoyer
source: POKENAME float on the surface of tropical lakes and are always on the move. Their restlessness stops if they are given a cucumber, their favourite food.

entry: POKENAME对家园森林池塘中的污染物很敏感。若没有干净的水可以嬉戏，它腹部的旋涡纹就会变成病态的黄色。
author: pattybgoode
source: POKENAME is sensitive to pollutants in the forest ponds it calls home. The spiral pattern on its belly will turn a sickly yellow if it does not have clean water to splash in.

entry: POKENAME伸展身体睡在池塘水面，享受雨水或阳光。若有人踩着它的背走过，而它察觉对方心怀恶意，就会瞬间移动，让人掉进水里。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME sleep along the surface of ponds, stretching out and basking in either rain or sunlight. If a POKENAME senses ill intentions while someone steps along its back, it will teleport away and let them fall into the water.

entry: 偶尔能在水流平缓的小溪和不太深的池塘旁，见到罕见的POKENAME冥想，或平静地与野生宝可梦交流。人们认为，它是在像贤者一样为别人指点迷津。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is rarely spotted by gentle streams and somewhat shallow ponds, meditating and calmly communicating with other wild Pokémon on occasion. It is thought POKENAME imparts advice onto others in a sagely fashion.

entry: POKENAME天生体弱，只能靠举香蒲增强力量。锻炼后，它会把香蒲吃掉，补充蛋白质和钾。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME is weak by nature and can only build up its strength by lifting cattails. Afterward, it eats the cattail for a boost of protein and potassium.

entry: POKENAME把根扎在池底，伸长藤蔓般的躯干，只露出头。波波等猎物经过时，它就发射溶解液，把对方打进水里。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME anchors its roots at the bottom of ponds, exposing only its head by stretching its vine-like torso. It fires Acid at passing prey like Pidgey to knock them into the water.

entry: 炎热的日子里，POKENAME会四处奔跑，分享鬃毛里的水。帮助其他宝可梦后，它便到凉爽的浅水池中休息。
author: pattybgoode
source: On hot days, POKENAME will dash about to share the water from its mane. After assisting other Pokémon, POKENAME rests in cool, shallow pools.

entry: POKENAME悠然飘在空中，把头上的叶片当帆。叶片还能当雨衣，保护磁铁不生锈。
author: hortensia_xxiii
source: Drifting placidly in the sky, POKENAME use the leaves on their heads as sails. These leaves double as a raincoat, shielding their magnets from rust.

entry: POKENAME的三个头轮流探进湖中，把水盛进共用的大睡莲叶，留待之后使用。水滴下时会经过睡莲叶过滤，滋润它中间的身体。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: The three heads of POKENAME take turns bobbing down into lakes, gathering water in their large shared lilypad to save for later. The lilypad filters the water as it falls, moisturizing POKENAME's central body.

entry: 看见湖上漂着睡莲叶时，要多加小心。那可能是POKENAME，只要有什么碰到它头上的叶片，就会立刻爆炸。
author: sk372
source: Care should be taken when one sees a lilypad floating on a lake. It could actually be POKENAME, which will explode the moment something touches the lilypad on its head.

entry: POKENAME生活在茂密的沼泽地，把巢筑在杂草间。头顶睡莲叶的质地出奇致密，由一种类似骨骼的材料构成。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME lives in dense swamps, building its nest amongst the weeds. The lilypad on its head is surprisingly dense, being made up of a material similar to bone.

entry: POKENAME十分调皮，常突然从河里冒出来吓人，再用角轻轻推撞。虽然爱玩，它却能轻松碾碎巨石。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME are mischievous creatures, frequently popping out of rivers to startle people before nudging them with their horns. Despite their playful nature, they can crush boulders with ease.

entry: POKENAME把藤蔓伸进池水，探知并捕捉蚊香蝌蚪等猎物。一旦捕获，就会把猎物往岸边岩石上反复摔打。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME extends its vines through the pond water, using them to detect and capture prey like Poliwag. Once captured, it repeatedly slams the prey against shoreline rocks.

entry: POKENAME照顾群落中年少的宝可梦，在浅水处设计游戏，用头冠里的水泼它们。野火发生时，它会引导年幼和受伤的宝可梦去水边，照料力所能及的伤者。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME cares for the adolescent Pokémon in its community, creating games in the shallows and splashing them with water from its crown. During wildfires, it shepherds young and injured Pokémon to the water, where it tends to those it can help.

entry: POKENAME的翅膀点缀着沼泽原生的小红花。花朵释放令人陶醉的怡人香气，吸引其他宝可梦。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME wings are peppered with small red flowers that are native to swampy environments. They release an intoxicatingly pleasant aroma that attracts other Pokémon.

entry: 若察觉池塘附近有入侵者，POKENAME会迅速竖起看不见的墙，保护领地。墙壁能坚固得如同钢铁。
author: .izik
source: If it senses intruders near its pond, POKENAME will quickly erect invisible walls to protect its territory. The walls can be as strong as steel.

entry: POKENAME和莲帽小童一样，喜欢突然跃出水面，惊吓人和宝可梦。不过它很难待着不动，晃动的胯部常在吓人之前就暴露了行踪。
author: standing__water
source: Like Lombre, POKENAME enjoy startling people and Pokémon by suddenly jumping out of water. However, POKENAME have difficulty holding still and the swaying of their hips often gives them away before the fright.

entry: POKENAME身体的成分与池水相似。身上长着水生植物，能让它在池塘中完美伪装。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's body is similar in composition to pond water. Aquatic plants grow on it, granting it excellent camouflaging in ponds.

entry: POKENAME把头顶睡莲叶和芦苇般的尾巴露出水面，吸引不同种类的猎物。目标一靠近，它便喷出滚烫的水攻击。
author: deniablecredibility
source: POKENAME keeps the lily pad on its head and its reed-like tails above water, attracting different types of prey. It strikes with super-heated water whenever a target draws near.

entry: POKENAME背上不断流出细小水流，生气时便会喷涌成间歇泉。据说拔掉它背上的一根芦苇，就能让它平静下来。
author: pattybgoode
source: POKENAME's back constantly produces tiny streams of water that erupt into geysers when POKENAME is angry. Plucking a reed from its back is said to pacify it.

entry: POKENAME厚实防水的绒羽，形成一身令人羡慕的暖和羽衣。每逢秋季，登山男都会跋涉到它栖居的山区，寻找换羽时落下的羽毛。
author: pattybgoode
source: POKENAME's thick waterproof down constitutes a coat of enviable warmth. Every autumn, Hikers trek through POKENAME's mountainous homes to track down their feathers after they molt.

entry: POKENAME翅膀上的叶片，让它能在湖面下高速游动。敏捷的身手使它既擅长游泳，也是迅速的猎手。
author: .izik
source: The leaves on POKENAME's wings allow it to reach high speeds while swimming under a lake's surface. Its swift movements make it an excellent swimmer and a fast hunter.

entry: POKENAME一动不动站在池塘里时，会对附近生物的未来产生不可思议的洞见。不知为何，水能增强它预知未来的能力。
author: .izik
source: While standing motionless in a pond, POKENAME gains uncanny insight into the future of anyone nearby. Somehow, the water enhances its precognitive abilities.

entry: POKENAME的头和尾巴覆着睡莲叶，浮力极强，即使游泳时睡着也不会溺水。睡眠不足的日子里，这一点尤其管用。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's lilypad-covered head and tail are extremely buoyant, preventing it from drowning if it falls asleep while swimming. This is especially useful on days where it gets little sleep.

entry: POKENAME漂在池塘中，只把睡莲叶和耳朵露出水面。浮力十足的身体与沉重尾巴互相平衡，让它毫不费力地停在水面。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME drift in ponds with just their lily pad and ears visible above the water's surface. Their buoyant bodies are counterbalanced by their weighted tail, allowing them to remain at the surface with no effort.

entry: 起风时，常能见到POKENAME乘风飘行。不过雨季里，头顶盘中积水太重，它便飘不起来了。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME will often be seen riding the breeze during windy days. It cannot float around during the rainy season, however, as it will be weighed down by water gathered in the dish on its head.

entry: 天气暖和时，POKENAME的叶片会开花。能见到五只聚成一组，在空中围成圈跳舞。
author: lydiaprower8
source: In warm weather, POKENAME's pad blooms with flowers. A group of five can be seen dancing in a circle in the air.

entry: POKENAME把水储存在头顶睡莲叶里。它飞行平稳优雅，无论速度多快，都不会洒出一滴。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME stores water inside the lilypad on its head. It flies with such steady grace that not even a single drop is spilled, no matter how fast it moves.

entry: POKENAME白天在池塘和小溪中开心戏水，为训练家们带来欢笑。夜里，它会倒着睡，用睡莲叶当浮标，轻轻漂过水面。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME spends its days playfully splashing in ponds and streams, bringing festivity to all Trainers. At night, it sleeps upside down, using its lily pad as a buoy to float gently across the water's surface.

entry: 流出POKENAME睡莲叶的水，会从它身体分泌的油脂中积累养分。许多药店备有加入这种水的止咳糖浆，因其舒缓作用而闻名。
author: .izik
source: Water that flows out of POKENAME's lily pad accumulates nutrition from the oils that come from its body. Many pharmacies stock cough syrups that contain this ingredient, which is known for its soothing properties.

entry: 无论是格外晴朗还是下雨的日子，POKENAME都能跳出身长好几倍的距离。不过年纪越大，跳得就越近。它身上长出的叶片带有剧毒。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME can jump several times their length on both particularly sunny or rainy days. However, the older they get, the less far they can jump. The leaves that grow from their body are very poisonous.

entry: POKENAME浸满水的身体能轻松吸收攻击。大多数时候，它都平静而被动，尤其是安静吃东西时。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's water-soaked body absorbs attacks with ease. It remains calm and passive in most situations, especially when it's quietly eating.

entry: POKENAME用白丝把自己吊在松树上。暴风雨时，它会用睡莲叶接雨水，免得为了补水还得四处奔走。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME suspends itself from pine trees with white silk. It collects rainwater in its lily pad during storms to avoid traveling for hydration.

entry: POKENAME栖居沼泽，会从水中捕捉小型鱼宝可梦。有人闯入领地时，它喜欢把睡莲叶丢到对方头上，在树梢嘎嘎叫，像是在嘲笑。
author: santon5512
source: Living in swamps, POKENAME hunt small fish Pokémon out of the water. These Pokémon enjoy dropping lily pads onto the heads of people who intrude on their territory, cawing at them from the treetops as if laughing at them.

entry: 战斗时，POKENAME头顶的睡莲叶会渐渐盛满熔岩。它把熔岩泼向敌人，让对方无法靠近，弥补自己不够敏捷的缺点。
author: .izik
source: The lily pad on POKENAME's head gradually fills with lava during combat. It splashes this at foes to keep them at bay, compensating for its lacking agility.

entry: POKENAME飞行优雅得连头顶睡莲叶里的水都能稳稳端住。它平时虽然温和，若有人敢破坏栖居池塘的生态，也会毫不犹豫地用长喙攻击。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its grace in flight is such that it can balance water on the lily pad atop its head. Although POKENAME is usually peaceful, it does not hesitate to strike with its long beak at anyone who dares to harm the ecosystem of the pond where it lives.

entry: POKENAME运送太阳珊瑚等小型宝可梦时，会把海水盛在鳍里。这样在珊瑚礁之间穿行，便能保护乘客免受好坏星等捕食者袭击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME gathers seawater in its fins as it ferries small Pokémon like Corsola. This keeps them safe from predators like Mareanie between reefs.

entry: POKENAME以绘画为乐，尤其喜欢风景画。若画中还有和它头顶一样的睡莲叶，它就会欣喜若狂。
author: chaotic_aspergers
source: POKENAME paints as a hobby, particularly enjoying landscapes. If the subject includes lily pads, like the one on its head, POKENAME becomes ecstatic.

entry: 肚子饿时，POKENAME从头部释放电脉冲，煮熟附近的水草。吃不完的水草，会储存在池底。
author: .izik
source: When hungry, POKENAME releases pulses of electricity from its head to cook water herbs nearby. It stores uneaten herbs at the bottom of its pond.

entry: POKENAME头顶的睡莲叶散发强烈热量，能煮沸栖居的池塘。其他宝可梦都会避开这片滚烫的水域。
author: .izik
source: The lilypad atop POKENAME's head radiates intense heat, boiling the pond it lives in. Other Pokémon avoid the scalding water it calls home.

entry: POKENAME优雅又有派头地端稳碗碟，用珍稀草药泡出奇妙的茶。茶香甚至能安抚最暴躁的敌人。
author: jaminmcready
source: With grace and flair, POKENAME brews strange teas by steeping rare herbs in the bowls it balances. The aroma of its concoctions can soothe even the most irritable foes.

entry: POKENAME以五只一组行动，夜里会上岸，用睡莲叶里的存水维持湿润，安然待到天明。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME travel in groups of five, beaching themselves at night with water stored in their lily pads. This keeps them safe and hydrated until dawn.

entry: POKENAME生活在沙漠绿洲，除了头顶叶片，整个身体都沉在水下。有人靠近水边，它就会跳出来吓人。离水太久，皮肤会迅速干燥，叶片也很快枯萎。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME live in desert oases, completely submerged except for the leaf on their head, but will leap out to surprise anyone who approaches the water. If POKENAME leaves the water for too long, their skin quickly dries, and their leaves soon wilt.

entry: POKENAME天性顺从，总想讨人欢心。头顶的叶片能把菜肴端给客人，因此是很出色的餐馆服务生。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME is always eager to please because of its servile nature. It makes a great restaurant waiter because the pad on its head helps it carry dishes to customers.

entry: POKENAME是出了名的小捣蛋鬼。它在池塘四周蹦跳，跳到兄弟姐妹长叶的头上吓它们，再开心地啾啾叫着跑开。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME are known for being little pranksters. Hopping around their pond, they will jump onto the leafy heads of their siblings to startle them, then cheep happily as it runs away.

entry: POKENAME会使劲跃出河面，锻炼腿部肌肉。这种训练方式，却常无意间吓到附近的宝可梦。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME jumps out of rivers as high as it can to train its leg muscles. This training method unintentionally startles the Pokémon in the surrounding area.

entry: POKENAME叶绿的身体能完美融入家园的池塘、河流。它喜欢等敌人靠得够近，再突然使出上勾拳吓对方一跳。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME's leafy green body helps it blend perfectly into their home ponds and rivers. It enjoys waiting for enemies to get close enough before startling them with an uppercut.

entry: 夏季里，POKENAME头顶的睡莲叶很快就会干燥，因此它尽量潜在水中，避开阳光直晒。
author: .izik
source: The lily pad on POKENAME's head dries out rapidly during the summer months. Because of this, it strives to stay submerged and out of direct sunlight.

entry: 参加宝可梦华丽大赛时，训练家有时会为它配上绿色头巾，帮助它设计新颖精彩的表演。它擅长开创水上娱乐的新花样，用绿色头巾让观众惊叹。
author: quackquackattack
source: When they enter Pokémon contests, a Trainer may include a Green Scarf to help foster innovative displays of brilliance. They are known to excel at providing new ways of aquatic entertainment, utilizing the Green Scarf to amaze audiences.

entry: POKENAME会单脚站在睡莲叶上冥想，引导精神能量，增进内心专注与肌肉力量。期间，它会发出低低的哼鸣。
author: .izik
source: To meditate, POKENAME balances on one leg atop lilypads, channeling psychic energy to promote inner focus and muscular strength. It makes a humming noise during this time.

entry: POKENAME白天睡在池塘里，除了头顶睡莲叶，其他部位都会伪装起来。它很容易受惊，一察觉危险，就会逃走躲藏。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME sleeps in ponds during the day, camouflaging every part of its body except for the lily pad on its head. It is very skittish and will run away to hide if it senses danger.

entry: POKENAME生活在水边，喜欢找领地内钓鱼人的麻烦，用利齿咬断鱼线。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME lives close to the water's edge. It enjoys being a nuisance to fishermen in its territory, using its sharp teeth to cut their lines.

entry: POKENAME寻找清澈见底的池塘，把头上嘴巴般的睡莲叶装满水，再带回去给幼崽，提供安全的戏水场所。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME seek out crystal-clear ponds, filling the mouth-like lily pad on their heads with water. They take this water back to their young, giving them a safe place to splash and play.

entry: POKENAME静伏在湖边，模仿植物，诱捕经过的猎物。它也喜欢吓唬人类。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME lies still near the edge of lakes, mimicking a plant to lure and ambush prey. It has been known to take delight in startling humans as well.

entry: 它沿水面漂行，偷吃掉进水里的零食和蔬菜。它偏爱清淡、多汁的食物，因此总先挑黄瓜片。
author: quackquackattack
source: It floats along the surface of the water to steal snacks and vegetables that fall into the water. It prefers bland and watery food, which is why it goes for cucumber slices first.

entry: 它会走进学校或公园，寻找挑食的人，偷吃对方不要的食物。它喜欢清淡、多汁的点心，因此这些挑食者会从沙拉里拣出黄瓜等蔬菜给它。
author: quackquackattack
source: It wanders into schools or parks to seek out picky eaters to steal undesired food from. It loves bland and watery treats, so these picky eaters remove cucumbers and other vegetables from their salads for it to eat.

entry: POKENAME壳上长出的大花散发带苔藓气息的松香，吸引虫属性宝可梦前来，帮助减少积聚的花粉。
author: .izik
source: The large flower growing from POKENAME's shell gives off a mossy pine scent. This attracts bug types to help alleviate the buildup of pollen.

entry: POKENAME头顶睡莲叶里的水放久了就会沸腾。它会把水甩向敌人，试图让对方看不见。
author: .izik
source: Water that lingers too long in the lily pad on POKENAME's head begins to boil. It flings this at foes in an attempt to blind them.

entry: POKENAME收集浑圆的睡莲叶，拿来当临时帽子。若发现更大的，它会马上丢掉旧帽，向伙伴们炫耀新帽子。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME collects perfectly round lily pads and wears them as temporary hats. If it finds one larger than its current one, it will immediately discard the old one and show its new hat off to its buddies.

entry: POKENAME一天大部分时间都泡在池塘里。它用覆着灌木的鼻子吸水，滤掉矿物质和碎屑，让纯水从头顶流回池中。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME settles itself into ponds to soak for a majority of the day. It inhales water up through its bush-covered nose, filtering out minerals and detritus, creating pure water that flows from its head back down into the pond.

entry: 白天，常能见到POKENAME在平静的水域里安睡。入夜后，它则常在栖居的湖边优雅起舞、四处恶作剧。
author: krivaswell
source: POKENAME are often seen peacefully sleeping in calm bodies of water during the day. When night falls, POKENAME will often elegantly dance and cause mischief around the lakes they sleep in.

entry: POKENAME把大睡莲叶当帆，乘风漂向远方，借此寻找偏僻的沼泽筑巢。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its large lily pad like a sail, catching winds to drift across great distances. It uses this to find secluded swamp nesting spots.

entry: 受威胁时，它会从腹内弹出藤蔓，猛地跃出水面，搬往新的池塘或溪流。
author: bandedbodypress
source: When threatened, it will eject a vine from its guts and spring out of the water, relocating itself to a new pond or stream.

entry: POKENAME从沼泽水中跃出，睡莲叶四散飞扬，水做的翅膀随之展开。在湿地，看见野生个体迎着日出飞翔、晨光映在翅膀上，已成了当天将会幸福的预兆。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME bursts from marsh water in a dazzling shower of lily pads as it unfurls its watery wings. In wetlands, seeing a wild POKENAME flying with the sunrise reflecting off of its wings has become a sign of a happy day ahead.

entry: POKENAME尾巴上睡莲叶的长势取决于营养。懒得捕猎时，它会吃河边的香蒲补充体力。
author: .izik
source: The lily pad on POKENAME's tail grows based on its nutrition. It will eat cattails at the river's edge when it feels too lazy to hunt, using them to replenish its strength.

entry: POKENAME个头虽小，却能用头顶叶片驮起几乎有自己两倍大的巨石。它能从身体各处的开口喷水，大多只是为了吓唬别人。
author: infinex21
source: Although POKENAME are small, they are strong enough to carry boulders nearly twice their size atop the pads on their heads. They can release water from the ports along their bodies, which they mostly do for the sake of startling others.

entry: POKENAME很爱玩，喜欢拿头顶叶片中的水泼别人，再用尾巴把水保温。健康个体的火焰更旺、水也更热，不过必须小心，别让火熄灭。
author: torterrable
source: POKENAME is a playful Pokémon that likes splashing others with water from the leaf on its head, which it keeps warm with its tail. Healthy POKENAME have stronger flames and hotter water, but must be careful not to let the fire go out.

entry: POKENAME带着调皮的魅力。它会先用优美舞姿迷住对手，再朝敌人发射飞镖。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME has a mischievous charm to it. It captivates with a beautiful dance before firing darts at the enemy.

entry: POKENAME接触沼泽水后，胶质外层会变厚。肚子饿时，它会用精神力抬起香蒲，一口吞下。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's gelatinous outer layer thickens when it touches swamp water. It uses psychic power to lift cattails and devour them when hungry.

entry: 它们白天在浅而缓慢的河水里休息，傍晚飞起。身体滑腻得厉害，通常带着淤泥味。
author: bobosmith01
source: They rest in shallow and slow-moving rivers during the day, and take flight during the evening. Their bodies are terribly slimy, and they typically smell of muck.

entry: POKENAME既是机敏的猎手，又是捣蛋鬼。它在沼泽水中伪装成睡莲叶守候，突然冒出来抓鱼宝可梦，或把训练家吓一跳。
author: opossiblymage
source: POKENAME is both a clever predator and a prankster. It lies in wait in the swamp water, disguising itself as a lily pad, before popping out to snatch fish Pokémon or frighten Trainers.

entry: 筑巢时，POKENAME会从其他宝可梦那里偷些巢材，往往比自己找芦苇和树枝更省事。许多巢都方便地建在水边，让它能随时洗澡。
author: quackquackattack
source: When nest building, POKENAME steal nest parts from other Pokémon, as this is often easier than finding reeds and twigs themselves. Many nests are conveniently located near water, allowing POKENAME to bathe as needed.

entry: POKENAME喝富含养分的沼泽水维生。夜里，它的睡莲叶会明显升温，让捕食者在它睡觉时不敢靠近。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME drinks nutrient-rich swamp water to survive. At night, its lily pad heats up significantly, keeping predators away while it sleeps.

entry: POKENAME滑翔过沼泽，向猎物喷射沼泽水。等对方被击晕，它便使出吸血，抽干剩余的力量。
author: .izik
source: As it glides over marshes, POKENAME spits jets of swamp water at prey. Once stunned, it uses Leech Life to drain their remaining strength.

entry: POKENAME把睡莲叶像轮子般旋转，高速滚过沼泽，热切寻找最爱的点心——香蒲。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME rolls through marshes at high speed, spinning its lily pads like wheels. It searches eagerly for cattails, its favorite snack.

entry: POKENAME是丛林河床里的小讨厌鬼。它假扮睡莲叶四处漂浮，有人靠近就突然冒出，喷出混着收集来种子的水，纯粹为了惹人烦。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a little pest inhabiting jungle riverbeds. Floating around pretending to be a lily pad, it pops up suddenly when others are near to spit a mixture of water and seeds it has gathered, solely to irritate them.

entry: POKENAME跳舞时会用脚爪交替颠动睡莲叶，在战斗中为同伴打气。这种有节奏的动作能鼓舞士气，让队伍保持活力。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME bounces its lily pad between its talons while it dances, cheering on its allies during combat. This rhythmic motion boosts morale, helping its team stay energized.

entry: POKENAME在水面跳舞，叶状翅膀来回摆动。它大多只在夜里起舞，显得更加神秘迷人。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME waves its leaf-like wings back and forth while it dances on the water's surface. Most of its dancing only happens at night, adding to its mysterious allure.

entry: POKENAME用头顶睡莲叶里的水溶解腐烂垃圾。它食量很小，每周吃不到5磅废物就能维生。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME dissolves rotting trash in water stored within the lily pad on its head. It eats very little, surviving on less than 5 pounds of refuse per week.

entry: POKENAME沿沼泽岸边巡行，确保没有入侵者威胁家园安全。人们认为，它是那些被污染得面目全非的生态环境孕育出的复仇亡灵。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME wander along swampy shores to ensure that no intruders threaten the safety of the marshlands they call home. It is believed that POKENAME are vengeful spirits from ecosystems polluted beyond recognition.

entry: 温暖潮湿的夜里，能听到POKENAME飞过天空的声音。它喜欢紧挨着船只俯冲，把船上的人吓一跳。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME can be heard flying through the sky on warm, humid nights. They enjoy diving right beside boats to scare those inside.

entry: POKENAME生活在洁净的溪流和池塘附近，以恶作剧闻名，例如朝毫无防备的钓鱼人喷水。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME is found living near clean streams and ponds. It is known for its mischievous antics, which include spraying water on unsuspecting fishermen.

entry: POKENAME飞越河流等水域，唱着甜美的旋律。只有降落进食、睡觉时，它才会停止歌唱。
author: bee4082
source: POKENAME fly over rivers and other bodies of water, performing sweet melodies. It only stops singing when it comes to the ground to eat and sleep.

entry: 它的翅膀由柔软湿润的苔藓构成，是寻求庇护的小型宝可梦最爱的藏身处。心情好时，POKENAME会用天籁般的嗓音唱出旋律，让栖居的池塘为之陶醉。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its wings, made of soft, damp moss, are the favorite refuge of small Pokémon seeking its protection. When it is in a good mood, POKENAME enchants the ponds where it lives with melodies sung in its heavenly voice.

entry: POKENAME身体若过度缺水，就会虚弱得连战斗的力气都没有。由于必须靠近水生活，它通常栖居在小池塘或河岸边。
author: fiordaliso
source: If its body becomes excessively dehydrated, POKENAME becomes so weak that it no longer even has the strength to battle. Since it needs to live in close proximity to water, it usually inhabits small ponds or lives along riverbanks.

entry: POKENAME很擅长伪装，跳进沼泽水中后，头顶叶片会有一部分没入水里。睡莲叶中央的深红花朵也带毒，因此会捕食它的野生生物不多。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are experts at camouflage, as the leafy pad on their head gets partially submerged when they hop into swampy water. The crimson flower in the middle of their lily pad is also poisonous, which limits the number of wild predators they have.

entry: POKENAME棉花般柔软的睡莲叶里盛着水，过去曾被用来制作敷药。草药师声称，它能以惊人的速度治愈割伤、缓解偏头痛。
author: .izik
source: The water in POKENAME's cotton-soft lily pad was once used in poultices. Herbalists claim it healed cuts and migraines with surprising speed.

entry: POKENAME仰面漂在池塘里，蓬松的身体像海绵一样吸水。受到打扰时，它会使出强力踢击，驱走入侵者。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME floats on its back in ponds, its fluffy body absorbing water like a sponge. When disturbed, it delivers powerful kicks to drive intruders away.

entry: POKENAME每条触手都长着一组粉色毒爪，能抓住猎物。哪怕只是轻微划伤，也可能引起抽搐，靠近它十分危险。
author: .izik
source: Each of POKENAME's tentacles has a set of pink toxic claws that grab onto prey. Even a small scratch can cause seizures, making it a highly dangerous creature to approach.

entry: 有人说，夜里在湖边或许能看见POKENAME如入迷般摇摆起舞。它闭上双眼，仿佛由风引领身体，只让自然之声伴奏，以月亮作聚光灯。
author: _pixelar_
source: Some say that near a lake at night, you may see a POKENAME dance, swaying as if in a trance. It will close its eyes and move like the wind itself guides its body, only the sounds of nature acting as its accompaniment and the moon as its spotlight.

entry: POKENAME原生于沼泽和热带海岸，靠模仿睡莲叶偷偷恶作剧。它喜欢咬破渔网，或用精神力让船驾驶者头痛，害船搁浅。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME are native to swamplands and tropical coasts, where it uses its lily pad mimicry to stealthily make mischief. It delights in biting through fishing nets or psychically causing headaches in boat pilots so they run aground.

entry: POKENAME会在沼泽湿地中找到养分充足的泥土，培育一片片蘑菇。虽然头顶长着睡莲叶，它却不喜欢被人踩。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME cultivates patches of mushrooms to grow in nutrient-rich mud that can be found in swamps and marshes. Despite having a lily pad atop its head, it does not like the sensation of being stepped on.

entry: POKENAME靠颈部叶片的浮力托住身体，坐在水里吃藻类。旱季水干时，它会把下半身埋入土中，不吃东西，只喝泥里积的少许水。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME sit in the water, eating algae, held up by their buoyant neck leaf. In dry seasons when water dries up, it will bury its lower half in the ground, eating nothing and drinking the small amount of water pooling in the dirt.

entry: 睡觉时，POKENAME会用奇特的香蒲状尾巴，操控少量水流进头顶睡莲叶。它整夜吸收这些水，保持身体湿润。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME manipulates small amounts of water into the lily pad on its head while sleeping, using its peculiar cattail. It absorbs this water through the night to stay hydrated.

entry: 过去几年，冲浪比赛上越来越常见POKENAME。它会突然从水里冒出，把冲浪者吓得跌下冲浪板。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME have been spotted more and more at surfing contests over the past few years. They are seen popping out of the water and scaring surfers into falling off their boards.

entry: POKENAME的壳里盛着水和吃下的草药，在晒太阳时慢慢煮成茶。温度恰到好处时，壳里会冒出一团蒸汽，泡好的茶在丰缘被视为珍品。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME's shell contains water and consumed herbs that steadily brew while it basks in the sun. A steam cloud billows from its shell when the mixture has reached the perfect temperature, with the resulting tea being considered a delicacy in Hoenn.

entry: POKENAME坐在河底，耐心等其他宝可梦落上睡莲叶。一有乘客，它便伸手将其拖入水下，始终潜着，慢慢吸干对方的生命力。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME sits at the bottom of the river, patiently waiting for other Pokémon to land on its lily pad. Once they do, it will drag them underwater with its arms and slowly drain them of their life force while still submerged.

entry: POKENAME生活在静水池塘，潜在水中时与莲叶童子难以区分。它懒洋洋的，很难提起干劲，只想整天坐着晒太阳。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME live in still ponds and are indistinguishable from Lotad whilst submerged in the water. They are very lethargic and are hard to motivate, preferring to just sit in the sun all day.

entry: POKENAME轮流把两个头伸出水面，让水下的头交替吃水草。两个头性情不同，最常见的是一个友善，另一个暴躁。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME alternate which of their two heads they keep above the water, taking turns to have the head underwater feed on pond weed. Their heads have different temperaments, most commonly one is friendly whilst the other is cantankerous.

entry: POKENAME会挖洞钻进住宅花园的池塘，等主人来查看突然出现的睡莲叶。一靠近，它就猛地冒出，朝对方脸上喷水。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME digs its way into ponds within home gardens, waiting for owners to inspect the newly-appeared lily pad. Once they come close, it pops out and spits water in their face.

entry: 传说，想着心爱之人，喝下POKENAME睡莲叶里的池水，就能得到对方的爱。事实上，这只会引起肚子痛。
author: .izik
source: Legends claim drinking pond water from POKENAME's lilypad while thinking of a loved one ensures returned affection. In truth, it only causes stomachaches.

entry: POKENAME不喜欢强烈阳光，日落后才捕猎。它用睡莲叶伪装，在浅水中悄悄追踪猎物。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME dislikes bright sunlight and hunts after sunset. It uses its lily pad to camouflage as it stalks prey in shallow waters.

entry: POKENAME喜欢翻找泥泞河床里的亮晶晶物件。考古学家寻找古代聚落遗迹时，有时会请它帮忙，在水里寻找古钱币。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME enjoy sifting through muddy river beds in search of shiny objects. Archaeologists will sometimes make use of them when searching for evidence of ancient settlements, relying on POKENAME to find old coins in the water.

entry: 它会用头顶运水，帮助园丁播种、浇灌各种树果。不过，勿花果等辣味品种会被它挖出，扔到一旁。
author: quackquackattack
source: It is known to help gardeners sow and water many types of berries by carrying water on top of its head. However, it digs up spicy ones such as the Figy Berry and tosses them aside instead.

entry: POKENAME白天把身体藏在水下，只让睡莲叶浮在水面。夜里才外出，但若身体太干，似乎就会剧烈头痛，最后总得重新潜回水里。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME keep their body underwater during the day with only their lily pad resting above the surface. They venture out at night, but appear to experience intense headaches if they become too dry, invariably leading them to submerge themselves again.

entry: POKENAME喜欢用背载其他宝可梦兜风，但一看到训练家，就会带着乘客一起瞬间移动逃走。察觉训练家离开原先的地方后，它才会返回，继续载客。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME enjoy ferrying Pokémon around on their back but teleport away when a Trainer is spotted, bringing the rider with them. Once they sense that the Trainer has left the area they were in, POKENAME teleport back to continue the ride.

entry: POKENAME是能操控水和湿地植物的捣蛋鬼。有人靠得太近，它便让对方跌进烂泥或淋成落汤鸡，自己却始终待在够不着的地方。
author: bobosmith01
source: A trickster Pokémon that can control water and wetland plants, POKENAME pranks those who come too close by causing them to fall into muck or soaking them in water all while staying out of reach.

entry: 它们一找到花啤果就会吃得醉醺醺，借此在睡前平静下来。醒来时，有时会短暂迷糊，不知道自己身在何处。
author: quackquackattack
source: They become intoxicated on a Hopo Berry whenever they find one, which helps calm them down before they sleep. When they wake up, they may become confused and unable to recognize where they are for a moment.

entry: POKENAME能把棍子末端的睡莲叶摘下来，当铁饼投掷。力道足以击倒一棵柳树。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME can detach the lilypad from the end of its stick, hurling it like a discus. The blow is strong enough to topple a willow tree.

entry: POKENAME生性调皮，会假装和水做的假头争吵，吸引旁人注意。翅膀虽然短得飞不起来，却能提供足够升力，让它踩着水面跑掉，逃离麻烦。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME has a mischievous spirit and will create fictitious feuds with its fake water heads to draw attention to itself. While its wings are too short to fly, they give it just enough lift to allow it to run across water to escape trouble.

entry: POKENAME在陆地上行动困难，因此通常浮在水上，也便于伪装。它贪玩又调皮，喜欢从水里突然冒出来吓人。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME has difficulty traversing land, so it typically floats on water, which allows it to camouflage itself well. It has a mischievously playful spirit, and likes to pop out of the water to give people a scare.

entry: POKENAME一听见音乐，就忍不住欢快地扭动起舞，摇落头上大量水果和树果，因此很容易从它身上采到食物。
author: sk372
source: Hearing music compels POKENAME to begin gyrating and dancing about in glee. Doing so causes it to shake loose copious fruits and berries growing on its head, making it an easy food source to gather from.

entry: POKENAME常接受精准舞蹈训练，用动作准确呈现音乐。它以跳跃、踢击构成的腾空舞姿，单靠动作就能传达音高、节奏和强弱。
author: pattybgoode
source: POKENAME are often trained in precise dances that can accurately transcribe music. In its aerial style of leaps and kicks, POKENAME can communicate pitch, tempo, and dynamics purely through its movement.

entry: POKENAME大声唱出悠扬音调，响得连周围的水都会泛起波纹。环绕身体的气泡回荡着音符，仿佛一支合唱团，为它的歌声伴唱。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME bellow out melodic tones loud enough to ripple water around them. The bubbles that surround their bodies echo with the notes of their songs, creating a chorus singing along to their tunes.

entry: 秋季，POKENAME会在河床上结伴跳舞，吸引伴侣。大量个体聚集的地方，会降下暴雨。
author: pattybgoode
source: In autumn, POKENAME dance together in riverbeds to attract mates. Rainstorms occur where many POKENAME congregate.

entry: 星光满天的夜里，POKENAME面向海面，有节奏地摇摆，用低于人耳听觉范围的声音轻轻哼唱。
author: pattybgoode
source: On starry nights, POKENAME sways rhythmically while facing towards the ocean's surface. With a sound lower in frequency than humans can hear, POKENAME hums gently.

entry: POKENAME几年前曾红极一时，如今人气似乎渐渐衰退。它以古怪、仿佛永远不会结束的舞蹈广为人知。
author: jangodiot
source: POKENAME was famous a good few years ago, but this Pokémon has seemingly declined in popularity over time. POKENAME is widely known for its eccentric dances that never seem to end.

entry: POKENAME带着一把简易阳伞，既能接雨水，又能让自己保持干爽。晴空万里时，它会开心起舞，把纯净的水分享给其他宝可梦。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME carries a makeshift parasol to gather rainwater and keep itself dry. When the weather is bright and sunny, it dances with joy and shares the pure water with other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME沿河游动时会轻哼曲子，给旅途添点趣味。遇到无法游过急流的水生宝可梦，它会让对方爬上叶片搭乘。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME quietly hum a tune as they swim along rivers, keeping themselves busy as they travel. They let other water Pokémon climb onto their pads, in case they are unable to swim along strong streams.

entry: 只要有人边放音乐边靠近，POKENAME就会在对方身边欢快蹦跳。用这招太容易把它从沼泽引出来，盗猎者的捕捉已让这一物种濒临灭绝。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME frisks playfully around anyone who approaches while playing music. Because it's so easy to lure this species out of marshes this way, POKENAME are endangered due to the actions of poachers.

entry: POKENAME喜欢在雨后的水洼玩耍。几只一起玩时，溅水的节奏会配合得整整齐齐。
author: pattybgoode
source: POKENAME love to play in puddles after it rains. When multiple POKENAME are playing together, they splash in a coordinated rhythm.

entry: POKENAME在各处水域间游荡，用镰刀般的大手臂沿途剪下并收集花朵。找到湖泊歇息后，它会把花洒在水面，送给当地的野生宝可梦。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Wandering between bodies of water, POKENAME use their large scythe-like arms to trim and collect flowers from along their travels. Once they find a lake to rest in, they scatter their collection along the water as a gift to the local wild Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME听见求雨的声音，就会迅速冲出雷云，带着倾盆大雨加入嬉戏。
author: pattybgoode
source: When POKENAME hears the sound of a Rain Dance, it jets swiftly from a thundercloud to join in the frolic, bringing a downpour with it.

entry: 飞行时，它的帽子随风翻动，有时还会飘落地面。若你捡到帽子并还给POKENAME，它便会在每年迁徙途中拜访你家，跳上一支舞。这舞能带来雨水，让植物生长。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Its hat whips in the wind while it flies, and sometimes flutters to the ground. If you find and return the hat to its POKENAME, it will drop by your house and dance during its annual migrations. This dance brings rain and makes plants grow.

entry: POKENAME似乎一听见任何音乐，就忍不住起舞。不过音乐一停，它便会试着逃走或躲起来。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME seem to be compelled to dance whenever they hear any form of music. Once the music stops, however, they will attempt to flee or hide.

entry: POKENAME游泳时，会让小型宝可梦坐在颈部的大睡莲叶里渡水。途中它唱歌鼓舞大家，到达后再鞠躬，让乘客安全下来。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME ferries smaller Pokémon across the water while it swims by carrying them in the large lilypad along its neck. It sings to keep spirits high on its trips, taking a bow once it reaches its destination so its passengers can get down safely.

entry: POKENAME生活在湖边，很喜欢与人和宝可梦来往。跳舞时，它会散发温暖、令人振奋的气息。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME lives near lakes and loves to socialize with Pokémon and people alike. It produces a warm, invigorating aura as it dances.

entry: 野生POKENAME一拿到椰子，就会跳起类似桑巴的舞。它的鳍疯狂摆动，动作却依旧流畅优雅。
author: .izik
source: If given a coconut, wild POKENAME burst into a samba-like dance. It flails its fins wildly while still moving with fluid grace.

entry: 这种宝可梦全身覆着光亮羽毛，完全防水。与大多数鸟宝可梦不同，POKENAME更喜欢在雨里飞翔。
author: .jerden
source: The glossy feathers covering this Pokémon's body are completely waterproof. Unlike most bird Pokémon, POKENAME prefers to fly in the rain.

entry: POKENAME尾端的灯能闪出不同强度和颜色的光，节奏感也几乎无人能及。狂欢舞会等场合很喜欢请它助兴。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's tail-light can flash at varying different intensities as well as colors, and its sense of rhythm is almost unparalleled. It's very popular to include in raves and other similar venues.

entry: POKENAME在野外极其罕见，却似乎无论在哪里都能自在生活，从嶙峋山区到繁忙城市皆然。它十分合群，常与其他宝可梦一起住。
author: bobosmith01
source: Though exceedingly rare to find in the wild, POKENAME appear to be comfortable living just about anywhere, from the rockiest mountains to the busiest cities. It is highly social and often lives with other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME能带来满满的欢乐节庆气氛，让无聊的聚会热闹起来。无论公园、野餐地，还是任何有空地的户外，它都会鼓励大家唱歌跳舞。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can ameliorate boring parties by bringing a lot of happy festive energy. It encourages others to sing and dance at parks, picnics, or wherever there is space outside.

entry: POKENAME生活在水中，却很容易被音乐引上岸。它会合着节拍用尾巴拍地，满脸喜悦。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME live in water but are easily brought to shore by the sound of music. They thump their tail against the ground in time to the music, with a look of pure delight on their face.

entry: POKENAME一听见雨水奏出的旋律，全身细胞都会振奋起来，随着节奏舞动。它从水中获取养分，因此能在泥地上跳一整天，也不觉得饿。
author: ._term.
source: When POKENAME hears the melody produced by rain, all the cells in its body are galvanized, and it begins moving in rhythm. Because it gets its nutrients from the water, it can dance on the mud all day long without feeling hungry.

entry: POKENAME的嘴十分灵活，能变换形状，使出多种水流攻击。不过它通常更喜欢唱歌，会调整嘴形，唱出不同音符和旋律。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME have rather malleable mouths that allow them a wide range of water attacks. They typically prefer to sing and will adjust their mouths to reach different notes and achieve different tunes.

entry: POKENAME会被网络空间中活泼欢快的音乐吸引。最常能在音乐视频网页上见到它，随节拍抖动起舞。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is attracted to parts of cyberspace where peppy and upbeat music can be found. The most common place to spy it is web pages with music videos, where it vibrates and dances along to the beat.

entry: 训练家知道，播放节庆音乐能帮助POKENAME锻炼，让它的肌肉充满活力。随后，它便会用舞蹈般的格斗方式训练。
author: shyguy11011
source: Trainers know to help POKENAME train by playing festive music, which helps it fill its muscles with energy. It then trains with its dance-like fighting style.

entry: POKENAME喜欢摇响尾巴奏乐，边奏边跳。不肯陪它跳舞的，往往会被喷水。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME love to dance while making music with their rattle-tails. Those who refuse to dance with them will often be sprayed with water.

entry: POKENAME整天寻找珍稀的仙人掌果实，用来产出浓厚而营养丰富的乳汁。它会把乳汁分给有需要的生物，也会在庆典上分享。
author: zeterzero
source: POKENAME spends its days searching for rare cactus berries, with which it produces a potent and nutritious milk. It shares that milk with those in need as well as at celebrations.

entry: POKENAME总想显得强悍、稳如磐石，但欢快的节庆音乐一响，就忍不住跳起滑稽的舞。虽然害臊，这种舞却能刺激肌肉细胞，加速生长。
author: pattybgoode
source: POKENAME tries to appear tough and unshakeable, but it can't resist doing a silly dance when festive music is playing. Despite its embarrassment, this particular dance stimulates its muscle cells to accelerate growth.

entry: POKENAME在山间游荡，寻找值得一战的对手，以舞蹈挑战。据说它充满活力的节奏，曾让山岳崩塌。
author: girgraffe
source: POKENAME wanders through the mountains, seeking worthy opponents to challenge through dance. This Pokémon is said to have made mountains crumble to its energetic rhythm.

entry: 千万别打断POKENAME的舞蹈。它脾气多变，谁害它跳错一步，它就会毫不犹豫地电击对方。
author: sk372
source: One should never interrupt a POKENAME in the middle of its dance routine. It is quite temperamental and will not hesitate to shock anyone who causes it to miss a step.

entry: POKENAME踩着睡莲叶冲浪板，沿水流和电流滑行，寻找树果、坚果饱餐。两只或更多野生个体相遇时，会比赛谁冲得最好。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME surf along water and electrical currents with their lily pad surfboard, searching for berries and nuts to feast upon. When at least two wild POKENAME meet, they will compete with each other to see who surfs best.

entry: 这些宝可梦大多悠闲待在海滩，吸收海浪与棕榈树的能量。喝完椰子水后，它们便聚在一起跳草裙舞。
author: karmaofevil
source: These Pokémon spend most of their time chilling on the beach shore, absorbing energy from the waves and the palm trees. After finishing their coconut water, they group up to hula dance.

entry: POKENAME在沼泽里漫步，身体慢慢左右摇摆。人们认为，它脑中一直响着曲子，才会不停跳舞。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME roam in marshes, their bodies slowly sway side to side. It is believed that a tune is constantly playing in their heads, causing them to dance.

entry: POKENAME的舞蹈能让干枯萎蔫的植物重获生机，常能见它在沼泽芦苇间活力十足地舞动。若沼泽遇袭，同样的舞步又能迅速变成强力踢击。
author: notadoctor75
source: POKENAME's dances carry the ability to revitalize dried and wilted plants, and it can often be seen dancing energetically among marshy reeds. If its marsh comes under attack, it can quickly shift those same dance moves into powerful kicks.

entry: 这种宝可梦喜欢拍动叶状羽毛、踏水起舞。摇头时，头顶植物发出的声音像沙槌。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: This Pokémon loves to dance by flapping its leafy feathers and splashing in the water. When it shakes its head, the plant on top sounds like a maraca.

entry: 这些宝可梦是训练有素的舞者和斗士。协调的动作与强壮双腿，让POKENAME几乎能配合任何音乐起舞，即使战斗中也不例外。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: These Pokémon are disciplined dancers and fighters. Their coordination and strong legs allow POKENAME to dance to nearly every type of music, even when in combat.

entry: 这些宝可梦既精通武术，也精通舞蹈。专业舞团会找POKENAME帮忙进行体能训练和编舞。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: These Pokémon are masters of martial arts, as well as dance. Professional dance teams seek out POKENAME to assist with their fitness training and choreography.

entry: POKENAME睡觉时，体内不断积蓄液体，满溢后便流入头顶叶片。睡得太久，叶片里的水也会溢出，把它弄醒。
author: .izik
source: While sleeping, POKENAME constantly builds up liquid in its body until the overflow collects in the leaf on its head. If it sleeps too long, it spills over and wakes it up.

entry: POKENAME会用手掌拍打物体表面奏乐，让附近的宝可梦跳舞。它通常只在有雾的日子这么做，免得被太阳晒干。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME slaps its palms on surfaces to create music for nearby Pokémon to dance to. It typically only does this on misty days to protect itself from the sun drying it out.

entry: POKENAME把植物茎秆当临时麦克风，一边唱一边合拍起舞。不肯主动加入的，也会被它用精神力操控，强迫跳舞。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses plant stalks as makeshift microphones, singing into them as it dances about rhythmically. Those that don't willingly join in the dance will be manipulated into forcibly dancing through its psychic powers.

entry: POKENAME无忧无虑、性情温和，生活在池塘、湖泊和河流附近。它几乎不停变色来融入环境、躲避麻烦，连休息时也不例外。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are carefree and docile Pokémon that live near ponds, lakes, and rivers. They almost constantly change their colors to blend in and avoid trouble, even as they rest.

entry: POKENAME体贴温顺，比起打架，更喜欢吃饭、睡觉和跳舞。它能改变体色，常用于伪装；跳舞时，颜色还会随着舞姿变化，仿佛在配合旋律。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are caring and docile Pokémon that prefer to eat, sleep, and dance rather than fight. They have the ability to change their hues, which they often utilize for camouflage; their hues change as they dance, seemingly to the music's tune.

entry: POKENAME会合着曲子拍手，特别擅长炒热气氛。有些还会佩戴铃铛，为掌声添上悦耳的叮当声。
author: bigoljax
source: Using their hands to clap along to tunes, POKENAME are perfect for hyping up a crowd. Some are even fitted with bells to add a nice jingle to these claps.

entry: POKENAME唱着欢快的挽歌，把猎物引到池边，吞下108个灵魂后，就会在楔石中休息108天。轻快的音乐会让它跳舞，因此神奥沼泽一旦传出它的目击消息，徒步者就会播放音乐。
author: pjporwoll
source: Singing a cheery dirge, POKENAME lures prey to its pool to consume 108 souls, upon which it will rest in its keystone for 108 days. Jaunty music causes it to dance, so hikers in Sinnoh marshes play music when a POKENAME has been reported in the area.

entry: POKENAME踏着稳稳的节奏缓缓走动，用柔韧的藤蔓摇响沙槌。它会邀请小型宝可梦在背上清凉的水池里游泳。
author: kilough_kc
source: POKENAME lumbers about in a steady rhythm, shaking its maracas with flexible vines. It invites small Pokémon to swim in the refreshing pool on its back.

entry: POKENAME有两张嘴，不过较大的那张尝不出食物滋味。音乐对它影响极大，几乎什么歌都能让它跳起来，甚至会把大嘴当舞台。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME have two mouths, though their larger mouths cannot taste what they eat. POKENAME seem to be influenced quite strongly by music, nearly any song being capable of causing them to dance; they may even use their large mouths as a stage.

entry: 不管POKENAME多么想跳，躯干那部分身体就是动不起来。为了弥补，它会把头和触手舞得格外起劲。
author: soup1900
source: No matter how much POKENAME wants to, it is unable to dance with the torso section of its body. To make up for this, it will dance with its head and tentacles extra vigorously.

entry: 为了安抚幼崽，POKENAME会把它们放进帽檐里，开心地跳舞。它虽有些傻气，也不是严厉的父母，但一听见幼崽遭遇困境，便会立刻认真起来。
author: icelevelincarnate
source: To calm their young, POKENAME will place them in the brim of their hat and joyfully dance around. Although silly and not a very strict parent, POKENAME becomes dead serious at the sound of its young in distress.

entry: 它一听见有节奏的声音或音乐，就会上下弹跳。靠着光合作用，在晴空艳阳下，它能这样跳一整天。
author: catsquatch_geography
source: It will bounce up and down when it hears rhythmic sounds or music. Due to its photosynthesis, these dancing motions could last for the entire day under bright sun and clear skies.

entry: 它会在公园或野餐的人面前跳舞，想趁机偷吃。它尤其盯着沙拉，因为最有机会从中弄到几片西葫芦。
author: quackquackattack
source: It will dance in front of people at parks or picnics in an effort to steal food. It especially goes after salads, which is its best chance at a few courgette or zucchini slices.

entry: POKENAME性情和善，在葱郁的地方漫游。它会大方邀请宝可梦在背上的淡水生态里嬉戏生活，非常享受大家的陪伴。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a pleasant creature that roams across verdant areas. It freely invites Pokémon to frolic and thrive in the freshwater ecosystem on its back, greatly enjoying the company.

entry: 下雨时，POKENAME会摇摆起舞，雨水刚碰到身体就滋滋作响。若雨在舞跳到一半时停了，它便会大发脾气。
author: .izik
source: During rainfall, POKENAME begins swaying in a dance, rain sizzling the moment it touches its body. Should the rain stop mid-dance, it throws a tantrum.

entry: POKENAME连简单的小事都要变成大表演，做什么都加上转圈和鞠躬。暴雨中，它们会比赛谁溅起的水花最大，胜者能在接下来一周领着群体围圈跳舞。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME turns even simple tasks into big performances, adding spins and bows to everything it does. During rainstorms, groups compete to make the biggest splash, and the winner leads the colony's dance circles for the next week.

entry: POKENAME会比赛谁的舞技最出色。获胜者能带领整个群体跳舞，直到一个完整月相周期结束，才再次比赛。
author: notadoctor75
source: POKENAME compete among themselves for who has the most impressive dancing skills. The one who wins their dancing competitions gets to lead their colony in dances for a full lunar cycle before the competition begins again.

entry: POKENAME唱歌时，它附身的莲叶童子状同伴会围着它转圈，合着音乐喷水。没有两支歌谣完全相同，每只都有独属于自己的歌。
author: sk372
source: As POKENAME sings, the Lotad-shaped companions it possesses all twirl and circle around it, spraying water in time with the music. No two ballads are alike; each POKENAME has its own unique song to sing.

entry: POKENAME能用掌底和脚底敲出响亮的鼓点。树皮、石头等表面，都是它们奏乐的地方。
author: bigoljax
source: Using the bottoms of their hands and feet, POKENAME can create loud, drum-like thumping sounds. They use surfaces like bark and stone to make these sounds.

entry: POKENAME听到歌声，就会拍动翅膀，配合人声的频率。它边拍边在空中起舞，对翅膀能模仿得如此准确感到有趣。
author: bigoljax
source: As it hears singing, POKENAME flaps its wings so they can match the frequency of the vocals. They dance around in the air whenever they do this, amused by how accurate their wings can be.

entry: POKENAME的活力极具感染力，在湖边跳舞时，许多宝可梦都会加入。它性情温柔顺从，也以营救落水者闻名。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME's liveliness is extremely contagious, and when it dances on the shore of lakes, many Pokémon end up joining in. It is a gentle and docile creature that is known for rescuing people who fall into the water.

entry: 即使在战斗中，这种宝可梦也边跳舞边闪避、攻击，缎带般的触角随动作飘扬。它总是朝同一侧睡，好让水汇入并流经头顶的植物。
author: infinex21
source: Even during battle, this Pokémon dances while evading and launching attacks, its ribbon-like feelers fluttering to accentuate every move. It always sleeps on the same side so that it may collect water in and through the plant on its head.

entry: POKENAME在世界各地的剧院里，为观众献上夸张热烈的表演。高涨的热情使它充满活力，以舞姿和纷飞花瓣令观众目眩神迷。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME deliver histrionic performances in front of audiences at theaters across the world. Their emboldened passion gives them the vigor to dazzle audiences with their dance and flurry of petals.

entry: 古老传说称，POKENAME头顶泉中的水喝了能返老还童。水虽然没有这种功效，却格外纯净。
author: chibitales
source: Legends from the past claim that the fountain on POKENAME's head contained water that would make those who drank it younger. While the water does not have these properties, it is exceptionally pure.

entry: POKENAME喜欢记住收音机里听到的曲子，再试着用吉他弹出来。有些个体甚至被认为胜过职业吉他手。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME love to memorize tunes they hear on the radio, trying to copy them on their guitars. Some are considered even better than professional guitar players.

entry: POKENAME被庆典和聚会吸引，沉浸在欢乐气氛中。它以这种气氛为食，催着人们玩过头；有它在场，可能会让人累到危险的程度。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are drawn to festivals and celebrations, revelling in the positive energy. They feed off the atmosphere and push people to continue partying beyond their limits - their presence can cause dangerous exhaustion.
