entry: 节庆音乐响起，POKENAME诡异的火焰就会越烧越旺，化作烈火。据说只要它在附近，亡灵都会随着欢快的音乐轻轻哼唱。
author: pattybgoode
source: When festive music plays, POKENAME's eerie blaze crescendos to an inferno. It is said that the spirits of the dead hum along to any festive music when POKENAME is near.

entry: POKENAME为了参加训练家举办的节庆，会披上鲜艳布料、戴上帽子。头顶果实看着好吃，却有人声称吃起来像塑料。
author: thegreenscorpion
source: Wishing to participate in the festivals organized by Trainers, POKENAME decorates itself with a bright colored cloth and hat. The fruit on its head looks tasty but some have claimed that it tastes like plastic.

entry: POKENAME的伪装近乎完美，在沼泽湿地里几乎无法察觉。它会用尾巴引诱毫无戒备的大尾狸。
author: bigoljax
source: Due to their near perfect camouflage, POKENAME are nearly impossible to notice in swamps and marshes. They use their tails to lure in unsuspecting Bibarel.

entry: POKENAME在秋季最为活跃，一家会用多条尾巴扫拢落叶，再跳进叶堆。研究者找不到实际用途，它们似乎只是想玩。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are most active in Autumn, with families of them gathering fallen leaves into piles with sweeps of their many tails before leaping into them. Researchers are unable to find any practical reason for this; they appear to simply want to play.

entry: 这些小型宝可梦常把幼崽、水果或矿石块顶在头上。音乐似乎很容易让它们兴奋起来，精神抖擞地到处跺脚。
author: infinex21
source: These small Pokémon are often seen carrying their young, fruits, or chunks of ore atop their heads. Music seems to stimulate their kind rather easily, causing them to become energetic and quickly stomp their feet all about.

entry: 身处繁花茂盛的花园时，POKENAME会开心地左右弹跳起舞。头顶花苞像沙槌般作响，帽子般的睡莲叶则洒出点点水珠。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: When this Pokémon is in a flourishing garden, POKENAME will happily bounce side to side, dancing. While it dances, the bud on its head will rattle like a maraca while water sprinkles from its hat-like lily pad.

entry: POKENAME中央的物体闻起来像熟透的凰梨果。宝可梦只要碰到任何一个触觉感受器，它就会像贝壳般合拢，将猎物夹碎在陷阱里，之后再慢慢消化。
author: bobosmith01
source: The object in the center smells like a perfectly ripened Pinap Berry. If a Pokémon touches any of POKENAME's touch receptors, it clamps up like a shell, crushing the prey inside the trap, where it will later be digested.

entry: POKENAME在洞窟里寻找大小不一的宝石，按从小到大的顺序排好，再用爪子轻敲，奏出清脆轻快的音乐。附近的宝可梦会聚来，闻声起舞。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME will search caves, collecting gems of all different sizes. Then they will line each one up in ascending size and tap their claws against them, creating light, plinking music. Nearby Pokémon gather to dance to the sound.

entry: 音乐一响，POKENAME就会以完美的节奏蹦跳。它也会帮忙载走在人群里迷路的聚会来宾。
author: bigoljax
source: Whenever music is played, POKENAME hop around in perfect rhythm. They help carry partygoers who get lost in crowds.

entry: POKENAME用巨大有力的下颚改造、修复衰败的湿地环境。生态恢复后，宝可梦被吸引回来，它流出的水又能让大家恢复活力。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME utilize their massive, powerful jaws to transform and restore collapsing wetland habitats. The water that pours from POKENAME energizes the Pokémon that are drawn back to the restored wetlands.

entry: POKENAME会出现在人前，表演奇妙的舞蹈，令人忍不住加入。若谁跳得不够合它口味，就会因缺乏节奏感而被冻成雕像。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME appears before others and performs a strange dance that compels viewers to join in. Those who don't dance well enough for POKENAME's tastes will be frozen into statues for their lack of rhythm.

entry: 春分时，POKENAME会与同类在池塘水面上优美旋舞。人们把这样一群起舞的POKENAME称为“一个节奏”。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME performs beautiful twirling movements with others of its kind on pond surfaces during the spring equinox. These gatherings are called a 'rhythm' of POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME战斗时跳着桑巴，把渗滤液洒满战场。每场战斗都因此臭气熏天，令附近的人反胃。
author: .izik
source: While performing a samba during battle, POKENAME scatters leachate across the battlefield. This causes each bout of combat to reek, turning the stomachs of anyone nearby.

entry: POKENAME平时和大多数巨牙鲨融合体一样凶猛，但阻止它攻击的方法很简单。只要在它面前放欢快的音乐，它就会立刻平静下来，忍不住随曲起舞。
author: sk372
source: Although typically as vicious as most Sharpedo fusions, there is a simple way to stop POKENAME from attacking. Playing upbeat music in its presence immediately pacifies it and compels it to dance to the tune.

entry: 下雨时，POKENAME用头顶碗状的叶片接水。跳舞的动作让水泼洒出来，滋润周围的草木。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME gathers water in the bowl-like leaf on its head during the rain. Its dancing movements cause water to slosh out, hydrating the local foliage.

entry: POKENAME探索四周时，会发出古怪的咔嗒声和冒泡声。多数人只觉得毫无意义，却有人声称，这些声音藏着反复出现的规律或秘密信息。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME makes odd clicking and bubbling sounds while exploring. Though most hear only gobbledygook, some claim the noises follow a repeating pattern or hidden message.

entry: POKENAME平时在野外很少见，节庆时反而最容易遇到。似乎是现场播放的音乐吸引了它。
author: bigoljax
source: Usually a rarity in the wild, POKENAME are most commonly encountered during festival time. It seems the music played attracts POKENAME.

entry: 随着湿地不断遭排水，这种本就罕见的宝可梦也越来越少被目击。它性情十分平和，是沼泽家园里所有野生宝可梦的温柔朋友。
author: .realthree
source: As the draining of wetlands continues, this already-rare Pokémon has had fewer and fewer sightings. It is very peaceful, acting as a gentle friend to all of the other wild Pokémon in its marshy home.

entry: POKENAME总按自己的节奏跳舞。帽子上的小树会扬起花粉云，吸入的生物便会不由自主地随它舞动。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is always dancing to the beat of its own rhythm. It spreads clouds of pollen from the little tree on its cap that, once inhaled, compel others to dance along to its movements.

entry: POKENAME是热带的贪玩居民，几乎总在按自己的曲调跳舞。被尖刺刺中的生物，会因毒素阵阵亢奋，大约一小时内都无法安静待着。
author: sk372
source: A playful tropical denizen, POKENAME is almost always dancing about to its own tune. Toxins from its spikes cause bouts of hyperactivity in those pierced, leaving them unable to remain still for around an hour.

entry: 它突然的动作和瞪大的双眼虽可能吓人，其实只是在跳舞。它常随着只有自己听得见的节拍摇摆。
author: atlas3339098
source: While its sudden movements and wide-eyed expression can be frightening, it's actually dancing. It often sways to a beat only it can hear.

entry: POKENAME寻找人潮众多的庆典和派对，被人群中丰富的正面情绪吸引。据说，与它一同合拍跳舞的生物能做个好梦。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME seek out festivals and parties that are attended by large crowds of people. They are drawn to the wealth of positive emotion within the gatherings, their rhythmic dancing said to bring good dreams to those they dance with.

entry: POKENAME背上的睡莲叶让它轻松融入栖居的池塘。它常载着不会游泳的小型宝可梦渡水。
author: atlas3339098
source: The lily pad on POKENAME's back allows it to easily blend into the ponds it inhabits. It often gives rides to smaller Pokémon who can't swim.

entry: 构成POKENAME身体的金色芦苇极善于反光，晴天时很难直视。它还能把自身反射的光照向土地，让大片地区变成沼泽。
author: .realthree
source: The golden reeds that comprise POKENAME's body reflect light extremely well, which makes it difficult to view this Pokémon on sunny days. POKENAME has the power to turn large swaths of land into marshes by reflecting light from its body onto them.

entry: POKENAME会被节庆音乐吸引，越是跳舞玩耍，鳞片就越坚硬。它们常边演奏边一齐嚎叫，办起盛大的派对。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are drawn to festive music, their scales growing tougher the more they dance and play. Groups can often be heard howling together as they play their instruments, throwing huge parties.

entry: POKENAME鳞片覆着纤维状的防水物质，有助于在沼泽家园中行动。它特别容易被音乐吸引，常兴奋地靠近进入领地的乐手，与对方互动。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's scales are covered in a fibrous, water-repellant material that aids it in navigating its marshland habitat. Notably drawn by music, it will often approach and excitedly engage with musicians who enter its territory.

entry: 它小小的身体僵硬，动不了多少，但一听见音乐，耳朵就忍不住跟着摇。如果有人陪它跳，它便兴奋地冲出水面，旋转着把水珠溅得到处都是。
author: periperi_chicken
source: Though its rigid little body cannot move much, as soon as it hears music, it cannot help but wiggle its ears to the sound. If others dance with it, it will excitedly propel itself out of the water, spinning and splashing droplets everywhere.

entry: POKENAME的外层毛发粗硬，不会吸水。游完泳或在雨里逛过后，它会跳一支甩干舞，瞬间抖掉毛上所有水分。
author: pattybgoode
source: Its outer coat is made of coarse, stiff hairs that do not absorb water. After a swim or a jaunt in the rain, POKENAME does a drying dance and instantly shakes off all the moisture on its coat.

entry: POKENAME欢快得像节日，总邀请别人一起在阳光下跳舞。若有人遇险，它会用身体挡住危险，脸上始终挂着招牌笑容。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is an incredibly cheerful and festive Pokémon that often invites others to dance with it under the sunlight. If someone is in danger, it shields them with its body without ever losing its trademark smile.

entry: POKENAME能用召来的水编织壮丽的形状与画面，有时还会讲述尚未发生之事的奇妙故事。一察觉有人观看，它就忍不住表演起来。
author: notadoctor75
source: POKENAME is able to weave spectacular shapes and images using the water that it summons, sometimes telling fantastic stories of things that have yet to come. Whenever it senses that it is being watched, it can't help but put on a show.

entry: POKENAME会按只有自己听得见的曲调战斗。节奏时而急促多变，让对手始终摸不透，落于下风。
author: imaginita
source: POKENAME fights in rhythm to a tune only it can hear.  The rhythm can be rapid and unpredictable, so opponents are never quite able to predict it, and are left on the back foot.

entry: POKENAME听见节庆音乐，鼻孔就会涌出滚烫泡沫，接触的生物可能遭严重烫伤。音乐渐停，泡沫也会停下，它便去找煤补充燃料。
author: darkweavile428
source: When POKENAME hears festive music, super-heated foam pours from its nostrils which can severely burn those it touches. When the music dies down, the foam stops too and POKENAME searches for coal to refuel.

entry: POKENAME常见于沼泽湿地，夜里在其中飞舞。它被有节奏的声音吸引，音乐节期间会成群飞向附近聚落，随节拍振翅。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are commonly found in swamps and marshes, fluttering through the wetlands at night. They are drawn to rhythmic noises and will swarm toward nearby settlements during music festivals, flapping in time with the beat.

entry: POKENAME会迷惑训练家，让对方加入复杂的排舞，趁分心时偷走贵重物品。等训练家察觉受骗，它早已逃之夭夭。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME charms Trainers into joining it in complex line dances to distract them while it pilfers their valuable items. By the time the Trainers realize they've been swindled, POKENAME has already fled.

entry: POKENAME喜欢派对，会开心地漂在泳池里，为来宾送饮料或小礼物。活力十足的音乐响起时，它似乎格外快乐。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME enjoy parties and happily float in pools to deliver drinks or party favors to guests. They seem particularly happy when energetic music is playing.

entry: POKENAME懒洋洋地待在河里，几乎什么都不做。若你站到它头上播放音乐，它便会活跃起来，载你沿河前行。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME will laze about in rivers, never doing much. If you stand on its head and play music, it will become active and ferry you along rivers.

entry: POKENAME原生于遥远而矿藏丰富的地区，在那里四处游荡，召集宝可梦追随者，传授复杂的舞蹈。它热爱舞蹈，即使战斗时，也会把华丽夺目的表演放在战术之前。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is native to a distant, ore-rich region where it wanders gathering Pokémon followers to teach elaborate dances. Its passion is dance and will prioritize a flamboyant and eye-catching performance over tactics in battle.

entry: POKENAME在海滩发现情侣，就会召来同群伙伴，在海面起舞。表演最长可持续20分钟。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME spots a couple at the beach, it gathers others from its school and dances at the sea's surface. These performances can last up to 20 minutes.

entry: 节庆时，POKENAME喜欢为围观者跳舞，努力献上最有趣的表演。不过观众若不投硬币，它就会闷闷不乐；比起面值，它更在意硬币亮不亮。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME enjoy performing dances for onlookers during festivals, doing their best to put on the most enjoyable performance. They start to sulk if those watching them don't throw them coins, though the value of the coins is secondary to the shininess.

entry: POKENAME必须时刻保持活动，因为动作能缓解头痛。它常出现在派对和庆典上，喜欢跟着现场音乐跳舞。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME need to constantly move at all times, as movement soothes their aching heads. They're usually seen at parties and festivals, as they love dancing to the music they play.

entry: POKENAME充满活力，却也容易发怒，生活中的各个方面都难以捉摸。它随兴流露的喜悦，鼓舞了许多难以摆脱常规生活的人。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are dynamic yet quick to anger, leading them to be quite unpredictable in all aspects of their lives. Their spontaneous joy inspires many people who struggle to deviate from routines.

entry: POKENAME一听见节庆音乐就会兴奋，精力充沛地跑来跑去。它的步伐往往会和音乐节拍同步。
author: pattybgoode
source: POKENAME becomes excited at the sound of festive music, causing it to run about energetically. Its gait tends to sync with the tempo of the music it hears.

entry: POKENAME头顶储存的水始终沸腾。战斗时，它边跳舞边把水泼向敌人，以此占得上风。
author: .izik
source: The water stored on POKENAME's head is constantly boiling. It dances during combat, splashing it at foes to gain the upper hand.

entry: POKENAME无忧无虑，无论什么场合都跳着滑稽的舞。它甚至能用精神力操纵别人的肌肉，强迫对方一起跳。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME is a carefree Pokémon that performs silly dances regardless of the situation. It can even force others to dance by manipulating their muscles with its psychic powers.

entry: POKENAME体内总盛满酸酸的果味液体，因此只能弹跳着移动。它虽想和朋友分享，但酸得大多数生物都受不了。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME is always full of a sour, fruity liquid and so it must bounce to get around. Although it tries to share this liquid with its friends, it is so sour that most cannot withstand it.

entry: 野生POKENAME一到下雨就懒散下来，让雨水积在背上那株似乎连着身体的草状植物里。阳光明亮时，植物会颤动，它便重新上路。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME laze about whenever it rains and lets the water collect in the grassy plant seemingly attached to its back. When the sun shines bright, this plant trembles and the POKENAME will resume its journey.

entry: POKENAME在水下起舞时，周围冰冷的浪花会搅动发光藻类。它动作的节奏，让水中仿佛出现璀璨的蔚蓝极光。
author: pattybgoode
source: As POKENAME dances underwater, the icy surf around it stirs up bioluminescent algae. The rhythm of its movements produces the appearance of a brilliant azure aurora.

entry: 这种栖居沼泽的宝可梦喜欢参加热闹的节庆。若发现有人心情不好，它便施展催眠，鼓动对方陪它跳舞。
author: opossiblymage
source: This swamp-dwelling Pokémon enjoys showing up at lively festivals. If it sees someone in a foul mood there, it utilizes its hypnosis to encourage them to dance with it.

entry: 透过POKENAME壳上裂缝发出的光色，可以判断球茎会长出哪种植物。若尚未准备开花，壳就提早破损，球茎此前的生长便会前功尽弃。
author: soup1900
source: The type of flora POKENAME will grow from its bulb can be determined by the color that glows through its shell's cracks. If this shell is prematurely broken before it's ready to bloom, all the progress it had in growing its bulb is lost.

entry: POKENAME用来自外太空的陨石碎块制作头盔和简易棍棒。棒端偶尔会涌动奇妙的能量，让它暂时获得强大力量。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses parts of broken meteors from outer space as a helmet and a makeshift club. The end of the club will occasionally pulse with a strange energy and gift POKENAME with a temporary surge of great power.

entry: POKENAME姿势松软地冥想，几乎不理会周围动静。不过只要有什么太靠近脚边，它就会突然振作，以极快、极强的踢击迎击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME meditates in a limp pose, rarely reacting to anything going on around it. If something gets too close to its feet, however, it snaps to life and strikes with incredibly fast and powerful kicks.

entry: POKENAME平时一动不动，对外界刺激几乎毫无反应。但若有什么试图攻击，它就会突然活跃起来，迅速闪躲，再以更快的拳头反击。
author: sk372
source: Ordinarily, POKENAME stands motionless, barely responding to outside stimuli. If something tries to strike at it, however, it suddenly springs to life, making quick dodges and even quicker punches.

entry: POKENAME大多安静休眠，身边最多只愿有少量同伴。不过一听见孩子哭喊，壳上就会出现裂缝，空洞的眼中亮起强光。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME primarily lays quiet and dormant, preferring small amounts of company at most. If it detects the cry of a child, however, cracks form in its shell, and a strong glow forms within its hollow eyes.

entry: 这些宝可梦会朝对手和猎物吐出小石子。看似空洞的眼中，有时会隐隐泛起蓝光。
author: infinex21
source: These Pokémon spit small pebbles at opponents and prey alike. Blue light sometimes dimly glows from within its hollow-seeming eyes.

entry: POKENAME的舞蹈充满异域风情，源自这个世界尚不了解的文化。舞步由僵硬而缓慢的动作构成。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME's dance is exotic, coming from a culture that this world is unfamiliar with. The dance is composed of stiff and slow movements.

entry: POKENAME沉重的岩壳让它不易受伤，却也压得身体难以承受。肌肉孱弱的它连浮在水中都很勉强，常沉到接近水底。
author: .jerden
source: While their heavy rock shell makes them hard to damage, it also weighs POKENAME down. With its weak muscles, it struggles to even remain afloat in the water and will sink close to the bottom.

entry: POKENAME在高层大气飞行时，通常处于休眠状态。它偶尔会开始坠向地面，似乎还刻意瞄准人类聚落。
author: .jerden
source: While flying high in the upper atmosphere, POKENAME usually remains dormant. It will occasionally start falling to the ground and seems to aim itself towards human settlements.

entry: 一本受欢迎的儿童读物以这种宝可梦为主角。故事里，胆小的POKENAME躲在外壳后，随着慢慢交到朋友，终于走出自己的壳，露出缤纷的核心。
author: _pixelar_
source: A popular children's book features this Pokémon as the main character. It tells the story of a timid POKENAME who hides behind its mantle but, over time, makes friends and begins to come out of its shell, revealing its colorful core.

entry: POKENAME从臭氧层落到地面后，常被医院或护理机构收养。人们喜欢收集它尾部产生的水，因为其中没有空气污染物和过敏原。
author: _pixelar_
source: When a POKENAME falls from the ozone layer down to the surface, it is often adopted by hospitals or care facilities. They like to gather the water it creates around its tail, as the water is free from any air pollution or allergens.

entry: POKENAME若失去保护外壳，暴露核心中储存的大量电子就会立刻引发雷击。趁敌人昏倒或麻痹之际，它便逃之夭夭。
author: _pixelar_
source: Should a POKENAME ever lose its protective outer shell, the massive amount of electrons stored in its now-exposed inner core will immediately result in a lightning strike. Afterwards it will flee as the enemy either fainted or is left paralyzed.

entry: POKENAME坚硬外壳下的熔融核心，温度最高可达900摄氏度。由于高温，凡是外壳未遮住的部分，都会泛出柔和的橙光。
author: _pixelar_
source: Underneath its hard outer shell, POKENAME's molten core can reach temperatures up to 900 degrees Celsius. Any part not obscured by its shell glows a soft orange hue due to the immense heat.

entry: POKENAME摄取的数据越多，岩石外壳便越硬。若意外吞入病毒，壳就会变得脆弱而不稳定。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's rocky exterior hardens as it consumes more data. If it accidentally ingests a virus, its shell becomes brittle and unstable.

entry: POKENAME即将进化时，会升上天空。到达足够高度后，它便坠落，靠撞击挣脱外壳。
author: staghorn
source: When a POKENAME is about to evolve, it will rise into the air. Once it reaches a high enough altitude, it will fall, using the impact to free itself from its shell.

entry: 流星雨的夜里，偶尔能见POKENAME划过天空，沿途留下迷人而超凡的光辉。它由岩石和一种尚未确定的发光宇宙物质构成。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME is rarely seen streaking through the sky on meteor shower nights, creating a mesmerizing, otherworldly glow wherever it flies. It is made of rock and a glowing cosmic substance yet to be identified.

entry: POKENAME岩石外层的裂缝，能让核心喷出火焰般的等离子体，热得连站在附近都可能烫伤。它通常待在平流层上部，吃着尘埃和其他微粒。
author: chibitales
source: The cracks in POKENAME's rocky exterior allow its core to vent fire-like plasma. The heat is so intense that standing nearby can cause burns. It is known to stay around the upper stratosphere eating dust and other particulates.

entry: 除了太空探索，人类很少见到POKENAME。它对飞行操控自如，喜欢高速绕世界运行，从臭氧层外俯瞰地面。
author: karishi
source: POKENAME is rarely seen by humans except in space exploration. It has excellent control over its flight and loves to orbit the world at high speeds, looking down from outside the ozone layer.

entry: POKENAME用陨石岩打造特殊外壳，封住过于强大的力量。若撞上一颗行星，没有关爱它的人帮助驯服力量，释放的能力便可能酿成灾难。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME constructs a specialized shell of meteoric rock to contain its overwhelming powers. If it impacts on a planet, the unleashed abilities could prove catastrophic without caring individuals to help POKENAME tame its power.

entry: POKENAME总在寻找新体验，兴趣不断转移。有人认为，它的好奇心或许源于它根本来自另一颗星球。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is always seeking something new to experience, flitting from one interest to the next. Some people believe its curiosity stems from it possibly being from another planet entirely.

entry: POKENAME行动缓慢而有条不紊，在空旷处会尽量避免冲突。受惊时，火焰从背部和眼窝喷出，试图吓退攻击者。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME moves around slowly and methodically, avoiding conflict as much as possible when out in the open. If frightened, flames erupt from its back and eye sockets in order to scare off attackers.

entry: 细细的熔岩不断从POKENAME体表的孔中流出。它常在火山家园的岩浆里洗澡，让甲壳保持洁净温暖。
author: sk372
source: Rivulets of lava constantly leak from the pores in POKENAME's body. Bathing in the magma of its volcanic habitat is common, as it helps keep its carapace clean and warm.

entry: 白天常能看见POKENAME一动不动地坐在阳光里。为了警告群体有危险，它会用石质尾巴敲头，发出响亮的咚咚声。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME are usually spotted during the day, sitting motionless in the rays of the sun. To alert their colony to danger, they whack their stony tail against their head, making a loud thudding sound.

entry: POKENAME在冬日天空飞行时，靠岩石外壳保温。壳若裂开，它便收起翅膀，在泥里打滚，修补外层。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its rocky shell for insulation while flying in winter skies. If cracks form, it folds in its wings and rolls through mud to repair its casing.

entry: 许多人认为，POKENAME就是皮宝宝来自外太空的活证据。不过，研究者尚未找到令人信服的依据，证明两者确有关联。
author: antler_zero_
source: Many believe POKENAME are living proof that Cleffa originate from outer space. However, researchers have yet to find compelling evidence of this supposed connection.

entry: 它的羊毛能储存流星风暴产生的静电。地磁剧烈变动时，壳上裂缝会猛烈闪烁，释放出一阵阵耀眼电光。
author: jaminmcready
source: Its wool stores static from meteor storms. During intense geomagnetic shifts, the cracks in its shell flicker violently, releasing bursts of radiant discharge.

entry: POKENAME厚实的皮肤硬如石头，能抵挡大多数危险。常能见到一群群个体啃食坠落的陨石，科学家只好赶在它们前面抢救样本。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME's thick skin is as hard as stone, protecting them from most dangers. Swarms of these Pokémon can often be found feasting on fallen meteorites, leaving scientists racing to recover them before POKENAME does.

entry: POKENAME坠进沼泽时，常被泥土掩埋。停滞的水防止岩石身体腐坏，因此许多个体就留在沼泽中，直到被训练家唤醒。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME often get buried in mud when they crash into swamps. The stagnant waters prevent their rocky bodies from decaying so many POKENAME remain in these swamps until awakened by a Trainer.

entry: 过去，人们会观察晴空中是否出现POKENAME，预测蚀象将近。为了获得更多阳光，它栖居臭氧层中比大多数小陨星更高的地方，所有超能力属性招式都靠阳光供能。
author: _pixelar_
source: People used to predict a nearing eclipse by looking out for POKENAME in the open blue sky. It lives much higher in the ozone layer than most Minior, doing so for the increase in sunlight. It relies on this sunlight to power all of its Psychic moves.

entry: 过去，人们会观察夜空中是否出现POKENAME，预测红月将近。数百年前，世界各地便有它从天空家园坠落、被错认成流星的记载。
author: _pixelar_
source: People used to predict a nearing red moon by looking out for POKENAME in the night sky. Writings of POKENAME falling from its home in the sky and being confused for a shooting star are common all around the world, dating back hundreds of years.

entry: POKENAME的身体、叶片和花苞，全由不同石材构成。谁想触碰花苞，许多岩石藤蔓就会突然从空洞眼窝里窜出，挥打对方。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's body, leaves and flower bulb are all made of different types of stone. Any attempts to interact with the bulb result in numerous rocky vines suddenly emerging and lashing out from its hollow eye sockets.

entry: POKENAME总是酷似一片乳酪，让科学家百思不解。尽管外表如此，岩石外壳却不能吃，不过研究者仍不肯放弃尝试。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME always bears a strong resemblance to a slice of cheese, baffling scientists. Despite its appearance, its rocky shell is inedible, though this has not stopped researchers from trying.

entry: 许多古老的天文学典籍，书页里至少住着一只POKENAME。扁平身体让它能藏进纸张褶缝，只有观察最仔细的人才能发现。
author: .izik
source: Many old astronomy tomes have at least one POKENAME living inside the pages. Its flat body allows it to hide within the folds of paper, remaining undetected by all but the most observant.

entry: POKENAME白天倒挂着睡，把翅膀收进坚硬外壳下保护。夜里，翅膀接住月光、汲取能量，飞走时闪闪发亮。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME hang upside-down to sleep during the day, tucking in their wings to guard them beneath their durable shells. At night, their wings catch the moonlight, gathering energy and twinkling as they fly away.

entry: POKENAME生活在臭氧层，会先吃掉大气中的捕食者，保护其他小陨星。它吃得越多，体内就越有东西蠢蠢欲动，仿佛即将破壳而出。
author: beatdoof
source: Living in the ozone layer, POKENAME protects its fellow Minior from other predators in the atmosphere by eating the predators first. The more POKENAME eats, the more something stirs within it, as if it's about to burst out of its shell.

entry: POKENAME始终覆着一层冷却的玄武岩外壳，行动缓慢，却能抵御身体伤害。移动时，玄武岩皮肤不断裂开、重新闭合，伴随响亮的碎裂声。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are covered in a constant crust of cooled basalt, slowing their movements but making them resistant to physical harm. Their movement is accompanied by loud cracking noises, their skin of basalt breaking apart and re-sealing as they move.

entry: POKENAME夜里栖在雕像上，橙色羽毛泛着微光。若有人靠近，它便突然使出精准的啄钻攻击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME perches on statues at night, its orange feathers glowing faintly. If approached, it attacks with a sudden and precise Drill Peck.

entry: 它融入海底岩石中，避免被发现。向猎物发射能量前，刺眼的闪光会先暴露它的位置。
author: hophoppip
source: It blends in with undersea rocks to avoid notice. Its location is revealed by a blinding flash of light before it fires an energy burst at its prey.

entry: POKENAME的翅膀虽然很少使用，却始终锋利。它似乎无力飞行，便待在地上，切下树上的树果吃。
author: sk372
source: While used very little, POKENAME's wings retain a constant sharpness. It seemingly lacks the energy to fly, staying to the ground and cutting down berries from trees to eat.

entry: POKENAME通常栖居高处，但吃得越多身体越重，常因此滚下去。从领地滚落后，坠地的冲击往往会留下小坑。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME typically reside at high elevations, though they often roll down due to their bodies growing heavier the more they consume. The impacts from their crash after rolling down from their domains often leave small craters.

entry: POKENAME始终有一只眼盯着地面，一发现猎物，就会从轨道上精准俯冲。落地后，强壮的双腿再把它送回轨道，爆发的巨大力量甚至能引起局部地震。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: With one eye always fixed on the ground, POKENAME dives from orbit with pinpoint precision upon spotting prey. Once it lands, its powerful legs launch it back into orbit - the sheer force has been known to trigger localized earthquakes.

entry: 小陨星与小卡比兽的饮食截然不同，POKENAME却常吃太多身体无法充分处理的食物，最终导致中毒。训练家务必让它少量进食以矿物质为主的餐点。
author: bobosmith01
source: Minior and Munchlax's diets are extremely different; POKENAME is known for overeating foods its body cannot perfectly process, eventually leading to toxicity. Trainers must make sure POKENAME eats small portions of mineral-based meals.

entry: POKENAME只能靠滚动移动，但一睡着就完全不动，根本滚不起来。由于重得惊人，睡觉时只有搬运手推车才能挪动它。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME can only move by rolling, but it becomes completely still when asleep and cannot roll at all. Due to its tremendous weight, a Dolly is the only way to move one while it slumbers.

entry: POKENAME在大气中翱翔，快速拍翼提高速度。它吃天空中的尘埃充饥，并用这些微粒为高速飞行供能。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME soars through the atmosphere, its wings beating rapidly to increase its flight speed. It eats dust in the sky to keep itself satiated, using the particles to fuel its high-speed flight.

entry: POKENAME长出叶状附肢，靠光合作用获取能量。叶片能承受臭氧层的环境，许多科学家因此研究它，探索其他植物如何在外太空存活。
author: _pixelar_
source: POKENAME grows leaf-like appendages to gain energy from photosynthesis. Their leaves are capable of enduring the conditions of the ozone layer. Due to this, many scientists study this Pokémon to see how other plants could stay alive in outer space.

entry: 这种宝可梦身边的水分子都会冻成微小雪花。光线恰好照上时，POKENAME仿佛被一团光彩夺目的雾云围绕。
author: _pixelar_
source: Any water molecules in the immediate vicinity of this Pokémon freeze into tiny snowflakes. When light hits them just right, it appears as though POKENAME is surrounded by a radiant cloud of mist.

entry: POKENAME静静挂在岩檐或洞顶，储存能量。这样也能战斗，但偏重防守、动作缓慢。遇险时，它便冲破岩壳，舍去防护，换取力量。
author: nyoomymph
source: Silently, POKENAME hangs from a rocky overhang or cave ceiling, storing energy. It can fight as it is, but it is defensive and slow. When in danger, POKENAME bursts from its rocky shell, trading protection for power.

entry: POKENAME缓缓漂过夜空，寻找飞行器的信号。它不时会被这些飞行器撞上，猛地坠向地面。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME floats slowly through the night sky in search of signals from aircraft. It is periodically struck by these aircraft, sending it hurtling toward the ground.

entry: POKENAME温柔害羞，独自在峡谷地带生活，安静地远远观察别人。受惊后，它便悬浮起来，像流星一样飞过天空，躲得远远的。
author: sk372
source: Gentle and shy, POKENAME keeps to itself in canyon areas, quietly observing others from afar. If scared, it will retreat, levitating and flying away through the sky like a meteor.

entry: POKENAME安静跟着训练家，似乎很少流露情感。不过一察觉训练家身边有危险，它空洞的眼中便会亮起异光，释放强大精神能量，挺身保护。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME follows its Trainer quietly, showing seemingly little emotion. However, the moment it senses danger near its Trainer, its hollow eyes glow with strange light and it emits powerful psychic energy as it leaps to their defense.

entry: POKENAME散布在世界各地，静如雕像，对外界刺激毫无反应。若有人在它面前做出不光彩的举动，它就会启动，用能量刃击倒对方。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can be found dotted across the world, remaining still as a statue, unresponsive to outside stimuli. Dishonorable behavior in its presence causes it to activate and strike down the offending party with energy blades.

entry: 由于POKENAME具有磁性，人们推测它来自富含金属的小行星。夜里，它会飞在空中，以磁感应扫视地面，寻找猎物。
author: gileme__
source: POKENAME are theorized to come from metal-rich asteroids because of the magnetic properties they exhibit. At night, POKENAME fly through the air while scanning the ground with their magnetic senses in search of prey.

entry: POKENAME汇集多个大脑的力量，计算来袭陨石的精确轨迹。配合现代科学家提供的数据，它能提前好几天，准确预测陨石撞出坑洞的时间和地点。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME combines the might of its many brains to calculate the precise trajectory of incoming meteors. When paired with data from modern scientists, it can soundly predict the time and location of an impact crater multiple days in advance.

entry: POKENAME从楔石现身时，会产生奇异的真空吸力，把附近石头吸入本体。它收集这些岩石的目的，目前仍不清楚。
author: sk372
source: When POKENAME emerges from its keystone, it generates a strange vacuum power that sucks in nearby stones. These rocks are sucked into POKENAME's main body, though it's not known for what reason it collects them.

entry: POKENAME飞行时，由后方的嘴朝前带路。它着迷于划过夜空的天体，看见流星就想追。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's rear mouth leads the way while flying. It tries to chase any shooting star it sees, fascinated by the celestial objects streaking across the night sky.

entry: POKENAME长途飞行时，部分岩壳会剥落。它会降落在泥沼里，用泥涂满鳞片，重建铠甲。
author: .izik
source: As POKENAME flies over long distances, parts of its rocky casing flake away. It lands in bogs to coat its scales in mud and rebuild its armor.

entry: POKENAME造访宇宙各处的行星，欣赏奇景。古老绘画中，成千上万的它们保护世界，抵御毁灭性的陨石。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME visits planets across the cosmos, admiring the wondrous views. Ancient drawings depict thousands of POKENAME protecting the world from devastating meteors.

entry: POKENAME在战斗中挥舞泛紫光的双手，让敌人迷失方向。趁对方分心，它便使出奇异之光，让敌人失去行动能力。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME waves its violet-glowing hands during battle to disorient foes. Once distracted, it strikes with a Confuse Ray to incapacitate them.

entry: 有些科学家认为，POKENAME外壳下藏着足以引爆恒星的能量，但目前研究不足，尚无法支持这个理论。部分能量会从甲壳裂缝中渗出。
author: milchik
source: Some scientists believe that underneath its shell, POKENAME contains enough energy to make a star explode, but not enough research has yet been made to support this theory. Some of this energy leaks through the cracks in this Pokémon's armor.

entry: POKENAME身体密度极高，竟没早早坠地，本身就是奇迹。也靠着这种密度，它能承受最沉重的攻击，再挥尾反击。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's body is so dense that it is a marvel that it didn't crash down to the ground sooner. Thanks to its own density, it can withstand even the heaviest blows and then retaliate with a swing of its tail.

entry: POKENAME在太空旅行时，庞大的质量会吸引陨石碎块聚来。强大的引力有时还会把四散碎屑困在绕行轨道上。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: As POKENAME travels through space, it accumulates chunks of meteors due to its large mass. Its strong gravitational pull can sometimes trap random debris in orbit.

entry: POKENAME的缎带覆着坚硬石层，不会随风飘扬，而是静止贴在身上。夜里，它喜欢在天空跳舞，动作优雅迷人。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's ribbons are encrusted in a hard stone that does not blow in the wind, instead staying perfectly still on its body. At night, it finds joy in dancing in the sky, its movements graceful and mesmerizing.

entry: POKENAME遇到来自太空或高层大气的宝可梦时，触角最为活跃，那也是它的故乡。有些已记录的触角活动高峰仍无法解释，科学家还在研究。
author: _pixelar_
source: POKENAME's feelers become most active when it senses or interacts with a Pokémon from space or the upper atmosphere, where it originates. Some recorded spikes in such activity have yet to be explained, but scientists are working on it.

entry: POKENAME投入战斗时，岩壳会渗出有毒的灵质。它在大地上横冲直撞，灵质所经之处，整座森林都会变得寸草不生。
author: mistymagius
source: When POKENAME is locked in combat, a poisonous ectoplasm seeps out from its rocky shell. It rampages across the land, its ectoplasm leaving entire forests barren.

entry: 这些宝可梦常被描绘得非常巨大，其实只有大岩蛇左右的体形。它们生活在行星大气的各层之中，最底层的个体最重，因为外壳已变得极其致密。
author: infinex21
source: These Pokémon are often depicted as being quite large, though they are only about the size of an Onix. They live within the layers of the planet's atmosphere. Those in the lowest layer are the heaviest, as their shells have become incredibly dense.

entry: 当外壳重得无法继续停留在臭氧层，它便坠向地面，撞出巨大的陨石坑。核心放出的宇宙能量充盈着全身。
author: infinex21
source: When its shell grew too heavy for it to remain in the ozone layer, it fell to the ground below and left a massive crater upon impact. Its body is brimming with cosmic energy radiated from its internal core.

entry: 无云的夜里，能见到野生POKENAME一动不动，静静仰望星空。传闻称，它们来自月球背面。
author: h0bojoe
source: On cloudless nights, wild POKENAME can be found motionless, silently staring up at the stars. Rumors state they originated from the dark side of the moon.

entry: 满月时，POKENAME全身会蔓延出细小、泛白光的裂缝。这些缥缈的光线明亮闪耀，让它在月光下显得神秘莫测。
author: .izik
source: During full moons, tiny white glowing cracks spread throughout POKENAME's body. These ethereal lines glow brightly, giving it a mystical appearance under the moonlight.

entry: POKENAME会在满月夜空悬浮，姿势始终不变。它能不休息地悬浮移动最远3英里，一直保持安宁优雅的身姿。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME floats in the night sky during the full moon without changing its pose. It can levitate for up to 3 miles without rest, maintaining its serene and graceful form.

entry: POKENAME是远古人造宝可梦，受命保护人类。传说它们所做却恰恰相反，逼得最强术士将它们封进石像。
author: eminemace
source: POKENAME are man-made Pokémon created a long time ago, ordered to protect humans. Legends state that they did the complete opposite, forcing the best sorcerers to trap them in a stone statue.

entry: 即使战斗时，POKENAME也保持蜷缩。受威胁时，它会喷出夹着细碎岩石的喷射火焰，造成割伤与灼伤。
author: chibitales
source: Even during battle, POKENAME maintains a curled position. When threatened, it spews a Flamethrower filled with fine rocks that inflict cuts and burns.

entry: POKENAME的身体大多中空，因此能漂浮在云间。虽然很轻，它却是民航飞机的一大隐患。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's body is mostly hollow, allowing it to float among the clouds. Even though it is quite light, it has been known to be a major hazard for commercial airplanes.

entry: 这种POKENAME变体数百年来一直与邪恶组织合作，过程中常犯不少错。它们很喜欢蕉香果。
author: lydiaprower8
source: This variant of POKENAME has collaborated with villainous organizations for centuries, often making more than a few mistakes in the process. They have a fondness for Nanab Berries.

entry: POKENAME能若无其事地扛下攻击，常选择不还手。大多数攻击者反而会被岩石身体和尖刺伤到。有些论坛因此赞扬它，视其为坚忍克己的典范。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME shrug off attacks, often choosing not to fight back. Most attackers are damaged by their rocky bodies and sharp spikes. There are forums that praise POKENAME, regarding it as a prime example of stoicism.

entry: POKENAME对捕食其他宝可梦毫无兴趣，整天吃沙、泥土和岩石。随着成长，它最活跃的时段会从早晨逐渐推迟。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME have no interest in preying on other Pokémon and instead spend their days eating sand, dirt, and rock. The time they are most active shifts from morning to later into the day as they mature.

entry: POKENAME核心的宇宙力量透过外壳闪耀。它用这股力量增强甲壳防御，连最强烈的打击也能抵挡。
author: camtft
source: The cosmic power of POKENAME's core gleams through their outer shell. They utilize this to empower their shell armor, protecting them from the strongest of blows.

entry: POKENAME每天只会短暂漂浮，而且离地很近。它平时活动不多，但附近一有孩子，就会变得活跃有精神。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME only floats for a short amount of time per day, and remains low to the ground. While it behaves with low general activity, the presence of children nearby makes it become more active and energized.

entry: POKENAME猎食其他陨石宝可梦，直到吃得够多，便猛坠向地面。传闻若有个体不住在行星轨道，而在宇宙中四处狩猎，体形和密度都能增长得极其惊人。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME hunts other meteor Pokémon until it has consumed enough that it hurtles toward the world. It is rumored that one not living in the planet's orbit could grow to immense sizes and density as it hunts across the cosmos.

entry: 受古老本能驱使，POKENAME会冲进峭壁，撞碎沉积岩，挖出化石。一挖到过去的遗物，它就飞回巢里，保护这些远古同胞。
author: quackquackattack
source: Fueled by an ancient instinct, POKENAME plunges into cliff faces to break sedimentary rock and unearth fossils. Once it excavates a relic of the past, it soars back to its nest to keep its primeval brethren safe.

entry: POKENAME捕猎时，会用明亮闪烁的蔚蓝下颚迷惑猎物。靠近后，它便以碾压般的咬力下口，连花岗岩都能轻松咬碎。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's brightly blinking azure jaw disorients prey mid-hunt. Once close, it bites with a crushing force strong enough to shatter granite with ease.

entry: POKENAME的外壳由冻结的黏土形成。接触表面稍久，短短几秒内便可能严重冻伤。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's outer shell is formed from frozen clay. Prolonged contact with its surface can result in severe frostbite within seconds.

entry: POKENAME外表虽像岩石，壳摸起来却冰冷刺骨。即使只是短暂接触，也可能造成疼痛的冻伤。
author: .izik
source: Despite its rocky appearance, POKENAME's shell is ice-cold to the touch. Even brief contact may result in painful freezer burn.

entry: 它们通常栖居深海，有人猜测，坠落的小陨星与利牙鱼融合，便形成了POKENAME。它们能从水中跃起极高的距离，不过自然环境中尚未观测到这一行为。
author: bobosmith01
source: They are typically found deep in the sea; some suspect Minior that have fallen from the sky manage to fuse with Carvanha, creating POKENAME. They can leap incredibly high from the water, although this has not been observed in natural conditions.

entry: 为了安全休息，POKENAME会用沼泽泥裹住自己。睡着时，它也会本能地操控附近树木，以猛烈的力量驱退入侵者。
author: .izik
source: To rest safely, POKENAME encases itself in swamp mud. While asleep, it reflexively controls nearby trees to ward off intruders with violent force.

entry: POKENAME生活在高层大气，成熟后便会坠落。头顶陨石蕴藏大量宇宙能量，一被敲开，能量就会爆发。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are found in the upper atmosphere, falling once they reach maturity. The meteorites on their heads contain large amounts of cosmic energy, which explode out once they are broken open.

entry: POKENAME颈周的晶体发光，就代表即将放出响亮尖啸攻击。这声音能轻易震碎石头，威力令人畏惧。
author: .izik
source: When the crystals around POKENAME's neck glow, it is about to unleash a loud screeching to attack. This sound is powerful enough to break stone easily, making it a fearsome force.

entry: 它致密的外壳因内部困住的压力而震动，释放微弱的声音脉冲。下降穿过云层时，周围空气会变得僵滞，仿佛在阻止它通过。
author: jaminmcready
source: Its dense outer shell vibrates with trapped pressure, releasing faint pulses of sound. When it descends through cloudbanks, the air around it stiffens as if resisting its passage.

entry: 坚固的外壳包住POKENAME，让它既不能吸收，也无法释放任何光能。即使狂暴发作，见什么都拿身体猛撞，壳也绝不会破。
author: soup1900
source: A durable outer shell encases POKENAME, preventing it from both absorbing and releasing any light energy. Even if it goes on savage rampages and bashes its body around everything it sees, the shell won't ever break.

entry: 它常被摆在老房子入口附近，静止无声。危险靠近时，它会发出低沉、碎裂般的呻吟，壳上裂缝开始猛烈闪烁。
author: jaminmcready
source: It's often placed near the entrances of old homes, unmoving and silent. When danger approaches, it emits a deep, cracking groan and the fissures in its shell begin to flicker violently.

entry: POKENAME施展武术动作时，身上会掉落脆石，药剂师常将其磨粉。兑水饮用后，能增强力量与耐力，因此是备受追捧的补剂。
author: .izik
source: The brittle stone that comes off POKENAME's body while it does martial arts moves is frequently ground into powder by apothecaries. When mixed with water, it can boost strength and stamina in those who imbibe it, making it a sought-after tonic.

entry: POKENAME从太空落到行星后，沉重的外骨骼让它无法回去。坠落虽不会伤到它，但晴朗夜里，能见到这些个体聚在树梢，遥望旧日家园。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME that fall onto the planet from space are unable to return due to their heavy exoskeleton. Though the plummet doesn't injure them, fallen POKENAME can be seen gathering on the tops of trees on clear nights to gaze at their old home.

entry: 某些星座排列成特定位置时，它的光芒会更深沉，叫声带上哀伤的回响。那些夜里，光线会在它周围奇异地弯折，在寒冷中投下边缘分明的光环。
author: jaminmcready
source: Its glow deepens and its cry takes on a mournful echo when certain constellations align. On those nights, light bends strangely around it, casting sharp rings into the cold.

entry: 每击败一个对手，它的鬃毛就更明亮。即使沉重外壳压身，它的速度和凶猛仍如嗜血野兽。
author: h0bojoe
source: Its mane glows brighter with each opponent it defeats. Despite being weighed down by a heavy shell, it moves with the speed and savagery of a bloodthirsty beast.

entry: POKENAME听见音乐时，操控它动作的谱线状物体上会亮起光点，与听到的音符一一对应。
author: hophoppip
source: When POKENAME hears music, glowing dots appear on the staff-like entity that controls its movements, matching up with the notes it hears.

entry: POKENAME把鲜艳体色藏在暗淡外壳下，好融入海底，不被潜在猎物注意。代价是甲壳限制了它的行动和精神力。
author: milchik
source: POKENAME hides its bright colors beneath a dull shell in order to blend with the bottom of the sea and become less noticeable to potential prey. As a trade-off, the armor limits POKENAME's mobility and psychic powers.

entry: POKENAME穿行大气时，包住身体、硬如岩石的蘑菇会脱落。一旦出现裂缝，大量孢子就会泄出。
author: .izik
source: The rock-hard mushroom encasing POKENAME's body sheds as it travels through the atmosphere. Should cracks appear, large amounts of spores will leak out.

entry: POKENAME用巨大的石质前臂当盾，挡开战斗中的攻击。随着战斗进行，身体裂缝里会腾起缕缕明亮能量。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses its large stony forearms as a shield to deflect blows in combat. Wisps of bright energy flare up from cracks in its body as the battle progresses.

entry: POKENAME漂在大气中吃尘埃。累了就高速坠地，猛撞地面时释放南瓜气味。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME floats in the atmosphere eating dust. When it gets tired, it plummets to the ground at high speeds, letting loose a pumpkin scent as it smashes to the ground.

entry: 坚硬外壳保护着POKENAME脆弱的身体。壳磨下来的粉尘有咸咸的可可风味，会用于一些高级甜点。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's vulnerable body is protected by a hard shell. Ground-off dust from the shell has a salty, cocoa-like flavor, and is used in some fancy desserts.

entry: POKENAME的壳重得无法浮空时，便以毁灭性的力道猛坠，常留下燃烧的坑洞。核心能量庞大得连外壳都罩着一层纯粹能量。
author: infinex21
source: When POKENAME's shell grows too heavy to stay aloft, it comes hurtling down with destructive force that often leaves a burning crater behind. The energy of its core is so immense that even its shell is veiled in pure energy.

entry: POKENAME从大气中坠落后，会趁身体脆弱时迅速钻入地下。它们在大岩蛇挖出的隧道里安家，稍有危险迹象就躲藏起来。
author: mepp.
source: When POKENAME falls from the atmosphere, they quickly burrow underground while in this vulnerable state. They make their homes in tunnels created by Onix, hiding away at the first sign of danger.

entry: POKENAME休眠时常趴着，因为肚子是全身最软的部位。受到攻击时，它会释放精神波，引发头痛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME often lie flat on their stomachs when dormant because it is the softest part of their body. When they are attacked, they release psychic waves that cause headaches.

entry: POKENAME很容易被骗得原地转圈，晕眩常会引起头痛。最好的恢复方法，就是落地趴着，好好休息。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are easily tricked into running in circles, and the dizziness can often lead them to get a headache. The best way for them to recover is by landing on their stomachs and resting.

entry: POKENAME泳技高超，能在水中飞快穿行，躲避捕食者。找到合适的休息处后，它便收紧四肢，进入休眠。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are superb swimmers that zip through the water to avoid predators. Once they find a suitable spot to rest, they go dormant and tuck their limbs close to their bodies.

entry: POKENAME游到哪里，就留下一道星尘。这些轨迹在水下尤其迷人，铺展出美丽的星尘光景。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME release a trail of stardust wherever they swim. These trails are particularly mesmerizing underwater, where they create a beautiful glowing display of stardust.

entry: 其他宝可梦一从POKENAME面前逃跑，它就会本能地追赶。速度达到极限时，身后会洒出闪亮星尘。
author: quackquackattack
source: When another Pokémon runs away from POKENAME, their instincts urge them to chase after the escaping Pokémon. When they reach their max speed, they release a glittery stardust behind them.

entry: POKENAME柔韧得出奇，喜欢追逐别人。长途追赶后，它会沿着自己留下的星尘轨迹，回到训练家身边。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are surprisingly limber Pokémon that love to chase others. After a long chase, POKENAME follow the trail of stardust they left behind to return to their Trainer.

entry: POKENAME的外壳密度高得无法停留在高空时，便会从臭氧层下降。落下后，它就会寻找对手，试试自己的力量。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME descend from the ozone layer when their shells have grown too dense to stay aloft so high. Once they have descended, they will seek out opponents to test their strength against.

entry: 据说POKENAME静止冥想时，灵魂会远游至太空深处的未知之地。流星雨降临的夜晚，它会抬头凝望，眼中亮起光芒。
author: sk372
source: When POKENAME stays motionless and meditates, it's said it astral-projects itself far into the depths of space to parts unknown. On the evening of meteor showers, it gazes upward and regards the display with its eyes glowing bright.

entry: 包住POKENAME身体的石层增加了负重，让肌肉力量不断增强。
author: hophoppip
source: The stone that encases POKENAME's body gives it extra weight to carry, constantly increasing the strength of its muscles.

entry: 有人说，POKENAME的外壳是为了限制它无与伦比的力量而造。每当肌肉绷紧，壳就会发出不祥的隆隆碎裂声。
author: sk372
source: Some say POKENAME's outer shell was created to limit the unparalleled strength it possessed. Its shell makes ominous rumbling crackles with every flex of its muscular body.

entry: POKENAME致密的外壳能抵挡许多身体攻击。它常栖居在大型火山和破火山口，吃岩石、矿物质维生，喷射火焰的温度如岩浆般炽热。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME's shell is dense, offering them protection from many physical attacks. They are often found in large volcanoes and calderas, feeding on rocks and minerals. Their Flamethrower attacks are as hot as magma.

entry: 疲倦时，POKENAME在夜空漂行的速度会慢很多。吃下大量岩石后，它便能靠矿物质补充能量，恢复活力。
author: .izik
source: When tired, POKENAME floats through the night sky much more slowly. It regains its vigor after eating copious amounts of rocks, using the minerals to recharge its energy.

entry: POKENAME在夜空奔腾，留下点点火光。途中会脱落炽热的壳块，让下方变得危险。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME gallops through the night sky, leaving behind flickers of flame. It sheds chunks of its heated shell as it travels, making its path dangerous to those below.

entry: POKENAME在高层大气时，有时会从炮口喷出强劲水柱推进。水在严寒中立刻结冰，不会迅速落地，看起来像慢动作般缓缓飘下。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: When POKENAME is high up in the atmosphere, it sometimes shoots highly powered jets of water from its cannons to propel itself. The water immediately freezes in the cold, instead of quickly falling to earth, it seems to drift down in slow motion.

entry: POKENAME坚硬的身体泛起紫光时，就能穿过实体。白天，它靠这能力躲进细小石缝，几乎无法被找到。
author: .izik
source: When its hard body glows purple, POKENAME can walk through solid objects. It uses this ability to hide within small crevices during daylight hours, making it nearly impossible to find.

entry: POKENAME对看不见的宇宙射线极其敏感。常在没有任何明显原因时，突然爆炸，绽放出耀眼星光。
author: pattybgoode
source: POKENAME is extremely sensitive to invisible cosmic rays. Absent any perceivable reason, it can explode in a dazzling display of starry lights.

entry: POKENAME一停止滚动，未知晶体的碎片就会四散飞出。因此它会翻滚着冲下峭壁，好保持稳定的动量。
author: loikthescreamo
source: When a POKENAME stops rolling, shards of an unknown crystal fly out in various directions. As a result, it tumbles itself down cliffs to keep a steady momentum.

entry: POKENAME闪耀着骨白色的天体光辉。它的骨制回力镖能掷得极高，甚至会被错认成流星。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME shine bright with a celestial, bone-colored glow. Their boney boomerang can be tossed high into the air, high enough to be mistaken for a shooting star.

entry: POKENAME出拳后，会留下流星般的光迹。据说它守护天空，在威胁穿过臭氧层前，就将其击落。
author: shyguy11011
source: POKENAME's punches leave glowing trails like shooting stars. It is said to protect the skies, striking down threats before they can breach the ozone layer.

entry: 这种宝可梦什么都吃，不管能不能食用，都会消化成一团五彩闪光的物质，存进肚子。自卫时，POKENAME会把它吐出来，模样虽美，气味却臭得厉害。
author: milchik
source: This Pokémon devours all kinds of things, edible or not, and digests them into a colorful sparkling mass. Storing it in its belly, POKENAME pukes it out as a means of self-defense, and while it looks stunning, it also smells terribly.

entry: 这种宝可梦什么都吃，不管能不能食用，都会消化成一团五彩闪光的物质，存进肚子。自卫时，POKENAME会把它吐出来，模样虽美，气味却臭得厉害。
author: milchik
source: This Pokémon devours all kinds of things, edible or not, and digests them into a colorful sparkling mass. Storing it in its belly, POKENAME pukes it out as a means of self-defense, and while it looks stunning, it also smells terribly.

entry: POKENAME体内装的并非毒气，而是能让它保持浮力的星际气体和尘埃。不过，这些物质仍会给其他生物造成严重呼吸问题。
author: bostroms
source: Rather than poison gas, POKENAME is filled with interstellar gas and dust that allows it to remain buoyant.  However, this still causes major respiratory problems in others.

entry: POKENAME喷出一团团星尘，在夜里闪闪发亮。星尘虽然美丽，吸入后却会引起阵阵剧烈咳嗽。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME spew out clouds of stardust that shimmer at night. Though these clouds of stardust are beautiful, the stardust is known to cause coughing fits when inhaled.

entry: POKENAME漂过大气时，全身明亮发光。有些古老文化把它的身影视为给新妈妈带来好运的流星，象征希望与庇护。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body glows brightly while it drifts through the atmosphere. Some old cultures thought sightings of this Pokémon were a shooting star that gave luck to new mothers, a symbol of hope and protection.

entry: POKENAME的翅膀由一种晶体物质构成，类似陨石中发现的晶体。受威胁时，翅膀会发出灿烂闪光，连最强的宝可梦也能被晃得看不见。
author: kam_doodle_snek
source: POKENAME's wings are composed of a crystalline substance similar to the crystals found within meteorites. When threatened, its wings emit a brilliant flash of light capable of blinding even the strongest Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME中央旋转的能量团似乎是动力源，赋予它强大力量与耐力。谁试图触碰能量核心，都会招来极其激烈的敌意。
author: sk372
source: A mass of swirling energy in POKENAME's center appears to be the power source, giving it great power and stamina. Attempting to touch the energy core elicits a very aggressive reaction.

entry: 人们以为看见流星，其实常是名叫POKENAME的太空宝可梦在夜空舞动。身体转起来，核心就越来越亮，如同星辰本身。
author: infinex21
source: Often enough, what people think are shooting stars are actually a space-bound Pokémon known as POKENAME dancing across the night sky. When they spin their bodies, their cores shine increasingly brighter, like the stars themselves.

entry: POKENAME高速掠过天空，身后留下闪亮的翅鳞轨迹。曾有人观察到它用镰刀捕住鸟宝可梦，带着猎物猛冲向地面进食。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME hurtle through the sky at high speed, leaving a glittering trail of wing scales in their wake. They have been observed catching bird Pokémon with their scythes, careening to the ground with their prey to feed.

entry: POKENAME的歌声如天使般超凡，让周围所有生物都为之倾倒。它一停止歌唱，就会渐渐隐入宇宙。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME's voice is angelic and otherworldly, causing everyone around the Pokémon to admire its song. Once POKENAME stops singing, it will fade into the cosmos.

entry: 蜕去沉重外壳后，POKENAME变得灵活得多。虽然也更容易受伤，它却能高速游动，跃出水面躲避攻击，甚至跳上瀑布。
author: .jerden
source: After shedding its heavy shell, POKENAME becomes much more maneuverable. While it is also more vulnerable to attack, POKENAME can swim fast enough to leap out of the water to avoid attacks and jump up waterfalls.

entry: POKENAME坠地后，岩壳会粉碎，接着便狂暴地破坏附近一切在初次撞击中幸存的东西。毁完后，它再飞回天空休养。
author: .jerden
source: After crashing into the ground, POKENAME's rocky shell shatters, and it will rampage to destroy everything nearby that its initial impact didn't demolish. Once it has finished, it will fly back into the sky to rest and recover.

entry: POKENAME壳上的光会随所唱音符改变颜色。它歌声极其悠扬，繁殖季常有旅行团到栖地，专为聆听鸣唱。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: The lights on POKENAME's shell change colours based on which note POKENAME is currently singing. Its voice is so melodious that tour groups frequent POKENAME's environment during mating season to hear their cries.

entry: POKENAME半透明的身体吸收空气中的矿物质后，表面会形成微光花纹。由于柔软身体容易受伤，它总躲在洞窟里。
author: mepp.
source: When POKENAME's translucent body absorbs minerals from the air, it creates faintly glowing patterns on its surface. POKENAME spends its time hiding in caverns, as its soft body makes it vulnerable to attacks.

entry: POKENAME常从水域上方的夜空坠下，因为大片水面反射的星光吸引了它。夜里潜入水中，即使微微发光，它也几乎能隐去身影。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: POKENAME are frequently found falling from the night sky over bodies of water. They are attracted to the large bodies of water because they reflect starlight. They can almost turn invisible under the water at night, despite their soft glow.

entry: 科学家如今会收集POKENAME的星尘，增强速度强化的效果。它速度快得惊人，粉尘也残留着运动产生的微弱能量。
author: jaminmcready
source: To heighten the effects of X Speed, scientists now use stardust gathered from a POKENAME. With such incredible speed, its dust holds faint energy from its movements.

entry: POKENAME吞下大量数据后，会伴着灿烂闪光，从最近的显示器里冲出。随后飞走，寻找更多信息吞食。
author: .izik
source: After devouring large amounts of data, POKENAME erupts from the nearest monitor in a brilliant flash. It then soars off in search of more information to consume.

entry: POKENAME身体庞大得能产生微弱引力场，研究者认为，这也是它能浮空的原因。防御时，它能把引力场捕住的所有碎屑发射出去。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's body is so large that it has a minor gravitational field, which researchers believe is also what allows this Pokémon to stay aloft. To defend itself, it can launch all debris caught in its gravitational field.

entry: POKENAME贪吃成性，尤其爱吃星星碎片，一顿能吃掉1600多块。流传很广的说法称，只要喂得够多，它就会变成一颗行星。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are gluttonous creatures with a taste for Star Pieces, able to eat upwards of 1600 Pieces in one sitting. A popular rumor claims that if fed enough, POKENAME will become a planet.

entry: 别看POKENAME体形庞大，它仍能跃上高空，起跳时在地面留下小坑。它像陨石般砸向敌人，身后拖着一条燃烧的星尘尾迹。
author: santon5512
source: Despite their size, POKENAME can leap high into the sky, leaving a small crater in the ground as they push off. They drop onto foes like meteors, leaving a fiery trail of stardust behind them.

entry: 若在意料之外的地方看见北极光，可能就有一群POKENAME在附近。它们在臭氧层摆动尾巴，制造从地面也能看见的绚丽光景。
author: ambrosia04
source: Unexpected sightings of northern lights may be a sign that a flock of POKENAME is near. They swish their tails in the ozone layer, creating splendid light shows that can be seen from the ground.

entry: POKENAME吸收闪电获取能量，每一道雷击都会让外壳更硬。不稳定的核心燃烧时带有辐射，不断侵蚀身体，因此它生活在雷暴中，补充能量，延缓崩解。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME absorbs lightning as a source of power, with each bolt hardening its outer shell. Its volatile core burns radioactively, decaying its body, so it lives in thunderstorms to recharge and delay disintegration.

entry: POKENAME吸收闪电获取能量，每一道雷击都会让外壳更硬。不稳定的核心燃烧时带有辐射，不断侵蚀身体，因此它生活在雷暴中，补充能量，延缓崩解。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME absorbs lightning as a source of power, with each bolt hardening its outer shell. Its volatile core burns radioactively, decaying its body, so it lives in thunderstorms to recharge and delay disintegration.

entry: 偶尔能在高山之巅找到POKENAME。它身体发出的光温暖，却不会热到危险。休息时，明亮光芒会减弱，变得柔和。
author: nyoomymph
source: Rarely, on the peaks of tall mountains, POKENAME can be found. The light that emits from its body is warm, but not dangerously hot. When POKENAME rests, its shining light dims to a softer glow.

entry: 这些太空宝可梦对新景物的反应，似乎说明它们是出于好奇才来到我们的世界。充盈的能量让它们不停脱落微光鳞片，如同洒下星尘。
author: infinex21
source: These space-dwelling Pokémon seem to be drawn to our world out of curiosity, given how they react to new sights. They are brimming with energy that causes them to constantly shed their glimmering scales like stardust.

entry: 它们绕着我们的行星运行，暴食宇宙碎屑，直到吃得太胀，终于坠向地面。嘴和角都能释放强大能量。
author: infinex21
source: They gorge themselves on cosmic debris as they fly around in orbit of our planet, until they become so bloated that they eventually fall to the ground. They can loose potent energies from their mouths and horns.

entry: 它身体的一部分披着吃下的同种宇宙碎屑，其余部位则因体内能量而闪耀。它行动快得惊人，能以陨石般的冲击力击打敌人。
author: infinex21
source: Parts of its body are clad in the same cosmic debris it feeds upon, though the rest shines with the energy within itself. It can move astonishingly quick and strike a foe with the force of a meteor.

entry: POKENAME大部分时间待在平流层，只有发现值得一战的对手才会下降。它的主要攻击手段之一，就是把小陨星掷向敌人。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME spend most of their time in the stratosphere and only descend if they find an opponent they consider worthy. One of POKENAME's primary attacks is to hurl Minior down at their foe.

entry: POKENAME全身始终散发奇妙的宇宙能量。在它身边待得太久，就会开始看见自己漂浮在太空深处的幻象。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's body radiates a strange sort of cosmic energy at all times. Being in its presence for too long causes one to begin experiencing visions of floating through deep space.

entry: POKENAME怒气太盛，岩壳几乎包不住身体。愤怒加剧时，火焰会烧成深红，强烈得无法封住的力量让烈火涌出壳外。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME can barely contain itself in its rocky shell due to its overwhelming rage. When its anger rises, its fire burns a deep crimson and spills out of its casing, as its power becomes too intense to be contained.

entry: POKENAME聪明又顽皮，常策划小恶作剧或事件，让自己扮演受害者或救星，以换取同情和点心。一看它得意的笑，就知道是否又在打什么主意。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME are mischievous, intelligent creatures. They often stage small pranks or incidents where they are seen as the victim or savior in order to gain sympathy and treats. Their smug smile is an immediate way to tell if they're planning something.

entry: 太阳落下时，POKENAME橙色的光反而更加明亮。一位令人难忘的诗人，曾给它取名“第二个太阳”。
author: hophoppip
source: As the sun sets, the orange glow of POKENAME brightens. One memorable poet gave this Pokémon the nickname of the Second Sun.

entry: POKENAME继承的小陨星特征，增强了天生的时间感，能预测事件发生的确切时刻。它凭此在夜间行动，精准得不可思议。
author: msdawgs
source: POKENAME's Minior traits enhance its natural sense of time, allowing it to predict the exact moment events will occur. It uses this ability to navigate the night with uncanny precision.

entry: POKENAME在高高的夜空成群旅行。飞行时光芒强烈，旁观者常把它们错认成流星。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME travel in large groups high across the night sky. Onlookers frequently confuse them for meteors due to the intense glow they emit while in flight.

entry: 无云的夜里，能看见POKENAME在夜空竞速。白天睡觉时，它用岩石般的鞘翅伪装自己。
author: staghorn
source: On cloudless nights, POKENAME can be spotted racing each other through the night sky. They use their rock-like elytra to camouflage themselves while they sleep during the day.

entry: POKENAME把蛛网织成微缩的夜空织锦，网上浮现出星座。这些纤细复杂的图案，常耗时数天到一两个月，网一捕到猎物，却又会被扯碎。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME creates miniature tapestries of the night sky as constellations form in its webs. These delicate and intricate patterns often take a few days to a couple of months to produce, only to be torn apart once the webs catch prey.

entry: 即使落地，POKENAME泛蓝光的翅膀仍不断扑动。它脱落的发光羽毛，深受珠宝匠与收藏家珍视。
author: .izik
source: Even after landing, POKENAME's blue-glowing wings continue to flutter. It sheds luminous feathers prized by jewelers and collectors alike.

entry: POKENAME十分结实，在太空漂浮时撞到东西，也能反弹回来。它很容易难过，一哭起来，就会以惊人的速度猛坠向地面。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is durable, allowing it to bounce off of objects it impacts while floating around in space. It is easily upset, and when it cries, it hurtles to the ground at an intense speed.

entry: POKENAME漂过雷暴时，能把闪电引向捕食者，借此保护自己和其他宝可梦。
author: .izik
source: While floating through thunderstorms, POKENAME redirects lightning to predators. It uses this ability to protect itself and its fellow Pokémon from danger.

entry: POKENAME绕行星运行，常被错认成彗星。每过一个行星年，就能看见它闪出明亮缤纷的光景。
author: musicsheep.
source: Most often mistaken for a comet, POKENAME orbits planets and can be seen every planetary year, flashing bright, colorful displays.

entry: POKENAME小得让前庭系统无法正常工作。它能跳得很远，却很少能稳稳落地。
author: hophoppip
source: Because POKENAME are so minuscule, their vestibular systems don't work properly. They can leap far, but they rarely stick the landing.

entry: POKENAME飞过夜空时，会留下被视为希望象征的彩色碎片。由于外表空灵，许多人把它错认成与急冻鸟、火焰鸟、闪电鸟一样的另一种传说之鸟。
author: kam_doodle_snek
source: When it flies through the night sky, POKENAME leaves behind colorful shards that are believed to be a sign of hope. With its ethereal appearance, many have mistaken POKENAME to be another legendary bird like Articuno, Moltres, or Zapdos.

entry: POKENAME不断寻找新的矿物质来吃。每吃下一种新东西，眼睛和尾巴的光便更鲜亮。
author: pattybgoode
source: POKENAME is constantly seeking new kinds of minerals to eat. With each new item eaten, the glow of its eyes and tail becomes more vibrant.

entry: POKENAME飞得快到发光，常被错认成流星。落到地面后，它会用尾巴把自己重新弹上空中。新生个体力量不足，只能仰赖其他宝可梦收留。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Often mistaken for a shooting star, POKENAME fly through the sky so fast that it glows. When it reaches the ground, it uses its tail to spring back into the air. Newborn POKENAME do not have the strength, and rely on other Pokémon taking them in.

entry: POKENAME在海底静止休息，积蓄能量。此时身体脆弱，便会覆上一层有毒薄膜。能量攒够后，它就会进化，冲上大气。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME sit at rest on the seabed, gathering energy. They are vulnerable in this state and cover themselves in a toxic film. Once enough energy is gathered, they evolve and shoot up into the atmosphere.

entry: POKENAME用沼泽湿地的泥涂满身体，遮住光芒。体内能量很快就会烘干泥层，因此它得经常重新裹泥。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME covers the glow of its body by coating itself with mud from swamps and marshes. The energy of its body dries the mud out quickly, requiring it to regularly refresh the muddy coat.

entry: POKENAME在轨道上击碎陨石，分解其中矿物质获取能量，增强精神力。
author: ambrosia04
source: By fragmenting meteors in orbit, POKENAME breaks down their minerals to use as energy, amplifying its psychic powers.

entry: POKENAME散发的能量，足以为整座发电厂供能数周。虽然得吃铀才能持续释放，许多人仍认为，能换来可控制、可使用的能量，是划算的代价。
author: blaizegamer
source: The energy exuding from POKENAME can power an entire power plant for weeks. Although they need to eat uranium to continue releasing this energy, many consider this a fine tradeoff for manageable and usable energy.

entry: 黑暗鸦喜欢明亮闪烁的东西，因此常尾随POKENAME。它却不喜欢这份过分关注，会让双眼放出刺目闪光，试图赶走黑暗鸦。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME often finds itself being followed by Murkrow due to the latter's love of bright and shiny things. POKENAME itself does not appreciate the obsessive interest, attempting to drive off Murkrow with blinding flashes from its eyes.

entry: POKENAME过去住在高层大气，为的是更靠近太阳，吸收更多阳光。它所做的一切，都是为了让背上的种子生长成熟。
author: ruben2309295
source: POKENAME used to live high up in the atmosphere; they did this to get closer to the sun and absorb more of the sun's rays. POKENAME do all this so that they can get the seed on their back to grow and mature.

entry: 宇宙力量化作从POKENAME背上生出的花与藤蔓。外表虽令人着迷，这股能量却有剧毒，连最强悍的对手也能击倒。
author: kam_doodle_snek
source: Cosmic power manifests as the flower and vines that sprout from POKENAME's back. Despite its mesmerizing appearance, the energy is highly toxic and can defeat even the toughest opponents.

entry: POKENAME飞过天空时，会快速旋转尾巴。尖牙若长得太长，它有时会去啃飞艇。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spins its tail rapidly while flying through the sky. It will sometimes gnaw on blimps if its fangs grow too long.

entry: 据说凝视POKENAME的核心，能窥见时空，甚至其他维度。研究仍无定论，因为看得太久的人都会昏迷，醒来后几乎记不得所见。
author: sk372
source: It's said that gazing into POKENAME's core gives a glimpse through time and space, possibly even dimensions. Research is inconclusive, as all who look for protracted periods fall unconscious and remember little of what they saw once awake.

entry: POKENAME发现目标便俯冲而下，凭速度与明亮身体让猎物晕头转向、无法看清。俯冲攻击时，它会留下一道闪烁的紫色粉尘。
author: gileme__
source: When they spot a target, POKENAME swoop down to attack, using their speed and the brightness of their bodies to disorient and blind their prey. As POKENAME dive to attack their prey, they produce a trail of shimmering purple dust.

entry: POKENAME在小陨星丢弃的外壳里安家。因此，人们常误以为它们来自太空。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME make their homes in the discarded shells of Minior. Because of this, it is a common misconception that these Pokémon come from space.

entry: POKENAME展开双翼，划过夜空，身后闪烁的星尘仿佛发光云霞。许多旅人把它错认成流星。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME streaks through the night sky with wings outstretched, trailing glittering stardust that shimmer like glowing clouds in its wake. Many travelers mistake it for a shooting star.

entry: POKENAME敞开的壳里长着鲜亮的珊瑚。它自己躲在其中，只有什么勾起好奇心时，才会悄悄出来。
author: sk372
source: A bright set of coral grows from within POKENAME's opened shell. POKENAME itself hides within the coral, only slipping out of hiding when something stokes its curiosity.

entry: 它以诡异的平静滑过高层大气，双翼展开，缀着闪亮碎屑。身后散落的金属屑如同流星。
author: jaminmcready
source: It glides through the upper atmosphere with an eerie calm, wings outstretched and glittering with debris. In its wake, metal shavings scatter like shooting stars.

entry: 坚硬外壳破碎后，它潜藏的能量终于释放。它能通过长管般的嘴，将这股能量和水柱像子弹一样射向对手。
author: infinex21
source: Its latent energies have unleashed now that its hard shell has broken. It can channel this energy and jets of water through its long, tube-like mouth like bullets at its opponents.

entry: POKENAME从外太空撞落地面，能在陨石坑中找到，性情欢快。研究者推测，它在太空时会用碎屑和岩石保护身体，但尚未观测到。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME crash to the ground from outer space. They are found in meteor craters and have a joyful demeanour. Researchers speculate that whilst in space POKENAME use debris and rocks to protect their bodies, though this has yet to be observed.

entry: 蜕去大部分致密外壳后，它行动相当迅速，能快速使出滚动，连小型车辆也能碾碎。它吃下岩石和土石碎屑，慢慢积成包住身体的新厚壳。
author: infinex21
source: It moves rather quickly after having shed most of its dense shell, being able to swiftly deliver Rollout attacks that could crush small vehicles. It consumes rocks and earthy debris, which slowly accumulates to reform the dense shell around its body.

entry: POKENAME运算能力极强，几秒内就能完成复杂的计算机任务。不过，它在场会让电脑释放少量辐射，形成潜在隐患。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME exhibits a large amount of processing power, able to complete complicated computer tasks in seconds. However, its presence causes computers to emit small amounts of radiation, making it a potential hazard.

entry: POKENAME极其罕见，在星空下看见它被视为大吉之兆。数百年来，科学家一直把这种宝可梦错认成夜空中的星座。
author: fiordaliso
source: Spotting POKENAME under a starry sky is considered a sign of great fortune due to its incredible rarity. For centuries, scientists mistook this Pokémon for a constellation in the night sky.

entry: POKENAME旋转时，核心明亮发光，形成光涡。速度越来越快，便像流星在夜空中起舞。
author: shyguy11011
source: As POKENAME spins, its core shines brightly, creating a glowing vortex. As it gains speed, it resembles a shooting star dancing across the night sky.

entry: 这些宝可梦常在远高于云层的天空蹦跳。当它们踏着云朵奔跑，就会降下纯净清澈的雨。
author: infinex21
source: These Pokémon are typically seen prancing high in the sky, well above the clouds. When they run atop a cloud, a pure, clean rain will follow.

entry: POKENAME把储在脸颊中的宇宙能量转成电力。它极其贪玩，战斗时也令人惊叹，人们相信它曾是古代某位守护者的伙伴。
author: kam_doodle_snek
source: POKENAME generates electricity from cosmic energy that it stores in its cheeks. Incredibly playful and astonishing in combat, it's believed that this Pokémon was the companion to a guardian from ancient times.

entry: POKENAME用飘扬鬃毛中的微型黑洞，吸收太空尘埃和碎屑，为宇宙魔法供能。看见它划过夜空，人们会迷信地反复许愿，希望它为自己施法。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME absorbs space dust and debris with the miniature black hole contained in its flowing mane to fuel its cosmic magic. When it is seen streaking across the night sky, people superstitiously chant wishes in hopes it will cast a spell for them.

entry: POKENAME用飘扬鬃毛中的微型黑洞，吸收太空尘埃和碎屑，为宇宙魔法供能。看见它划过夜空，人们会迷信地反复许愿，希望它为自己施法。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME absorbs space dust and debris with the miniature black hole contained in its flowing mane to fuel its cosmic magic. When it is seen streaking across the night sky, people superstitiously chant wishes in hopes it will cast a spell for them.

entry: 在野外看见这种形态的POKENAME，就说明它状况危急。它必须吃下大量但不过量的岩石材料，才能自然重建硬壳；否则最终会死去。
author: bobosmith01
source: When this form of POKENAME is visible in the wild, POKENAME is in a critical status. It must devour a large but healthy amount of rocky material in order to be able to naturally reform its hardened shell; without it, POKENAME will eventually perish.

entry: POKENAME收集陨石，既当铠甲，也当弹药。发射时，会使用从陨石本身提取的可燃物质。
author: notsaying.
source: POKENAME collects meteorites and uses them as armor, as well as ammo. To launch them, it uses a combustible material that is derived from the meteorite itself.

entry: POKENAME周身总有静电噼啪作响，多余的能量让它发光。大部分力量集中在尾尖，只有分享电力或保护朋友时才会动用。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Constantly crackling with static, POKENAME glows due to all of its excess energy. It focuses the majority of its power into the tips of its tails, only wielding them to share electricity or defend its friends.

entry: POKENAME以惊人速度掠过夜空，留下一道灿烂能量轨迹。据说亲眼看见它飞行，连最纷乱不安的心也能彻底平静下来。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME zooms across the night sky at incredible speed, leaving behind a brilliant trail of energy. Witnessing the sight of it in flight is said to cause even the most turmoil-filled hearts to feel complete and utter tranquility.

entry: POKENAME在高层大气中蜷起身体，减缓时间对自身的影响，几乎完全停止衰老。坠地后，研究者会寻找它，测定年龄。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: When high in the atmosphere, POKENAME curls up and slows the effects of time on itself, almost completely stopping aging. When it falls to earth, researchers seek it out to determine how old it is.

entry: 它的翅膀一阵阵突然拍动，让晶体粉尘在空中盘旋。发出的声音像警报般起伏，使飞得太近的生物迷失方向。
author: jaminmcready
source: Its wings beat in sudden bursts, sending crystalline dust spiraling through the sky. The sound it emits rises and falls like a siren, disorienting anything that flies too close.

entry: POKENAME周围有一圈辐射场，用于在洞窟中捕猎。辐射强得能熔化洞壁，也因此它的爪子十分孱弱。
author: animecreep4
source: POKENAME has a field of radiation around it, which it uses to hunt prey within caves. The radiation is so strong that it melts cave walls, which is why POKENAME has very weak claws.

entry: 脱离外壳后，POKENAME能以从前办不到的速度和灵活度猛攻。身体的光明亮得过于惹眼，正是它此前躲在壳里的原因。
author: nyoomymph
source: Now free from its shell, POKENAME attacks in bursts of speed and agility that it previously couldn't manage. The bright, eye-catching light from its body was the reason it hid inside the shell.

entry: POKENAME呈现的颜色取决于吃下的图像文件。因此，很少有两只个体的配色完全相同。
author: .izik
source: The colors POKENAME displays are based on the image files it consumes. Because of this, few individuals share the exact same color palette.

entry: POKENAME会把身体蜷成球，从天猛坠，攻击它认为正在伤害树木的生物，保护丛林树木。其余时间，它都平静地在天空漂行。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: POKENAME protects the trees of the jungle by balling itself up and hurtling to the ground at anyone it believes is harming the trees. Otherwise, it spends its time serenely floating around the sky.

entry: POKENAME在夜空留下的长长光迹，几英里外都能看见。不过人们不知道，一旦靠得太近，为了保护家园丛林，它就会像火矛般俯冲向地面。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: Its long light trails can be seen from miles away in the night sky. What people don't realise is, if they get too close, POKENAME will dive towards the ground like a fiery spear, wanting to protect its home jungle.

entry: POKENAME是丛林的终极守护者，会在夜空巡视。想砍树的工人遭它俯冲袭击，甚至来不及看清是什么撞上了自己。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: The ultimate protector of the jungle, POKENAME will scout in the night sky. Workers looking to fell trees don't even see what hit them when POKENAME plummets to attack.

entry: 破壳后，POKENAME开始悬空，只有睡眠或受威胁时，才偶尔再钻进地下。尖刺会在黑暗中发光，除非被挖来的泥土盖住。
author: krune
source: Upon breaking its shell, POKENAME starts levitating off the ground, rarely burrowing down again unless slumbering or feeling threatened. Its spikes glow in the dark, unless covered with dirt from digging.

entry: POKENAME不断减弱周围的重力，让自己以优雅步伐欢快跃动。受惊时，重力会突然增强，使它猛坠回地面自卫。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME constantly lessen the effects of gravity around them, allowing them to prance gleefully in graceful strides. If a POKENAME is startled, its gravity will suddenly intensify, causing it to plummet back to the ground in self-defense.

entry: 据说POKENAME已完全掌控重力，能随意扭曲时空。人们相信，若受威胁，它施加的重力甚至足以创造一颗恒星。
author: sanguinenebula
source: It is said POKENAME have completely mastered control over gravity, using it to bend space and time to their will. It is believed that if threatened, it can apply enough of it to create a star.

entry: POKENAME战斗时，会从肘部伸出纯能量构成的刀刃。锋刃每次挥动，都会留下闪烁缤纷的星尘轨迹。
author: sk372
source: When in combat, POKENAME extends blades made of pure energy from its elbows. Every swing of these sharp blades leaves a sparkling, multicolored trail of stardust behind.

entry: 为了更好躲避捕食者，POKENAME会用身体反射光线，融入周围环境。即使伪装时，仍会微微闪光。有些剧院会让它参演，突出特定场景。
author: chibitales
source: To better hide themselves from predators, POKENAME reflects light off their bodies to blend in with their surroundings. Even while camouflaged, their bodies give off a subtle shimmer. Some theaters use these Pokémon in plays to emphasize scenes.

entry: POKENAME住在废弃的小陨星壳中，用望远镜看见时，常被错认成微型星云。它喜欢收集石头，让石块环绕自己运行。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Dwelling within ababdoned Minior shells, POKENAME are often confused for miniature nebulae when spotted from telescopes. They enjoy gathering stones to form their own orbits.

entry: POKENAME在黑暗洞窟安家，身体明亮发光，照亮周围。这光扰乱了喜暗宝可梦原本的栖地，让它们离开它身边。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME makes its den in dark caves, its body shining brightly to light up the area around it. This light causes Pokémon that enjoy the darkness to leave its immediate vicinity, as it disturbs their natural habitat.

entry: POKENAME冲撞前发出叫声时，头顶彩色的圆顶会明亮发光。头锤一旦命中，头骨便会放出刺眼闪光。
author: sk372
source: When POKENAME lets out a cry before charging at something, the colorful dome on its head glows brightly. A successful headbutt causes its cranium to emit a blinding flash of light.

entry: POKENAME在山峰之间翱翔，下降前，角会明亮闪烁。它巡视领地时，会用这光芒示威。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME soars between mountain peaks, its horn flashing brightly before descent. It uses this as a display while patrolling its domain.

entry: POKENAME像飞驰的彗星，在各地区间穿行，预感灾难将至就会营救人们。发光的身体与眼中旋转的奇妙能量，让它看起来比本意更吓人。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME moves like a speeding comet from region to region, acting to save people from disasters it senses approaching. Its glowing body and the strange swirling energy in its eyes make it seem more frightening than it means to.

entry: 这种宝可梦能在陨石核心中找到，会让发现它的人看见奇妙幻象。目睹者声称，幻象是在预警某场大灾难，不过究竟是哪种灾难，一直争论不休。
author: riley_muir_qu33n_in_yellow
source: Found in the core of meteors, this Pokémon gives those who find it strange visions. Those who see the visions claim them to be warnings of some great calamity, though the disaster's nature has been hotly debated.

entry: POKENAME在墓地发现盗墓贼时，身体会亮起鲜明橙光。诡异光芒能吓退入侵者，保护这片神圣土地。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body glows a bright orange in cemeteries when it spots grave robbers. The eerie glow helps scare off intruders, protecting the sacred grounds.

entry: 据说POKENAME在宇宙中游泳，吞下濒死恒星，把多余能量化成身后新生的恒星。据传，这也能维持自身能量稳定，直到保护外壳终于重新形成。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME is said to swim through the very cosmos, swallowing dying stars and releasing the excess energy as a brand new star in its wake. Supposedly, this also helps to keep its own energy stable until its protective shell finally reforms.

entry: 极少有人见过这种宝可梦脱壳的模样。POKENAME以陨石般的速度穿行太空，从经过的恒星汲取能量，在身后塑造新的恒星。
author: milchik
source: Very few people have ever seen this Pokémon with its shell shed. POKENAME travels through open space with the speed of a meteor, drawing energy from the stars it passes and shaping new ones in its wake.

entry: 极少有人见过这种宝可梦脱壳的模样。POKENAME以陨石般的速度穿行太空，从经过的恒星汲取能量，在身后塑造新的恒星。
author: milchik
source: Very few people have ever seen this Pokémon with its shell shed. POKENAME travels through open space with the speed of a meteor, drawing energy from the stars it passes and shaping new ones in its wake.

entry: POKENAME似乎有使不完的能量，常在树间飞快荡来荡去。尾巴释放独特星尘，一接触外界空气，就会化成蓝焰。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME seems to be bursting with boundless energy, often found quickly swinging from tree to tree. Its tail emits a unique stardust that turns to blue flame when exposed to the open air.

entry: POKENAME饮食中的矿物质，让尾巴燃起闪闪发亮的蓝焰。它动起来的景象十分美丽。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's tail blazes with sparkling blue flames thanks to the minerals in its diet. A POKENAME in motion is a beautiful sight.

entry: POKENAME能随意蜕去陨石外壳。绝招是先飞进大气，裹上壳，让重力把自己拖下，再在下落时抛开外壳，用巨刃斩向敌人。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME can shed their meteoric shell at will. Their finishing move is to fly into the atmosphere, encase themselves in their shell, and let gravity drag them down where they will cast away their shell and strike their foe with their massive blade.

entry: 即使脱壳，它的身体仍致密沉重，只是能释放更多体内能量。它会把全部能量从嘴里喷成光束，将自己送回平流层。
author: infinex21
source: Even with its shell shed, its body is still dense and heavy though now it can unleash more of its internal energy. It will unleash all of its energy as a beam from its mouth to send itself back into the stratosphere.

entry: 它的缎带以惊人力道向前抽打，把星星碎片高高抛上天空。据说有些能到达中间层，在云层上方无声燃烧。
author: jaminmcready
source: Its ribbon whip forward with surprising force, launching star fragments high into the sky. Some are said to reach the mesosphere, where they burn silently above the clouds.

entry: POKENAME开心地跃向天空，身后拖着星尘。坠地后会留下闪亮坑洞，能一连闪耀好几天。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME leaps into the sky with joy, trailing stardust behind it. When it crashes down, it leaves glittering craters that can shimmer for days.

entry: POKENAME挖掘陨石坠落形成的坑洞，作为家园。古老传说警告，切莫打扰它的巢穴，否则坑壁会从地面升起，化为火山。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME carve out craters from meteor landings to make their homes. Ancient legends warn not to disturb a POKENAME's den or else the walls of the crater will rise from the ground and form a volcano.

entry: POKENAME体形庞大，在行星大气最外层飞行，暴食行星碎屑。吃得越多，身体周围的厚壳越发达，最终会重得把它拖下去。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are large Pokémon that fly within the outermost layer of the planet's atmosphere, gorging themselves upon planetary debris. The more they feed upon, the more they develop a thick shell around themselves that eventually weighs them down.

entry: POKENAME由超凡的宇宙能量构成，靠扭曲周围重力在太空飞行。它会吸引陨石碎片和其他碎屑，试图形成自己的星云。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME's body is constructed from an otherworldly cosmic energy. It flies through space by warping gravity around it, pulling in shards of mteors and other debris to try and form its own nebula.

entry: 想家时，它们会侵入别人的梦，强迫对方幻想太空。有人觉得安慰，也有人形容那是黑暗而令人发寒的噩梦。
author: h0bojoe
source: Upon getting homesick, they invade the dreams of others and force them to fantasize of space. Although some find it comforting, others describe it as a dark and chilling nightmare.

entry: POKENAME用炮口高速发射陨石。不同颜色的个体，射出的陨石在大小、材质和数量上也各不相同。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME fires high-velocity meteorites from its cannon. Different colors of POKENAME shoot meteorites of differing sizes, materials, and quantities.

entry: POKENAME鲜亮的蓝焰让它备受追捧。为了赶走捕捉者，它会从尾巴发射陨石碎片，快得足以嵌入电话线杆。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are highly sought after for their vibrant blue flames. To ward off trappers, POKENAME expel meteor shards from their tail at speeds high enough to embed them in telephone poles.

entry: POKENAME凝视满月时，发光身体的颜色会快速变化。它无法控制这种变化，月夜里看起来格外迷人。
author: .izik
source: While staring at a full moon, POKENAME's glowing body shifts colors rapidly. It cannot control this change, so it is a captivating sight during moonlit nights.

entry: POKENAME常在高轨道漫无目的地漂荡，直到肚子饿。能量不足时，它会潜入人造卫星，借技术定位可供吞食的陨石。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are often found in high orbit, where they drift aimlessly until growing hungry. When low on energy, they infiltrate satellites, using the technology to locate meteors to consume.

entry: POKENAME用精神力浮在臭氧层，吸收小块太空碎屑，平静地四处漂游。人们认为，飞机起飞时耳中突然“啪”地一响，就是它受到打扰所致。
author: tlord
source: POKENAME uses its psychic powers to float in the ozone layer, absorbing small space debris and peacefully floating around. POKENAME, when disturbed, are believed to be why your ears pop when your airplane leaves the ground.

entry: 满月夜里，POKENAME浮过夜空，身体颜色迅速变化。这种变化展现了它的神奇能量，以及与月相周期的联系。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body rapidly changes color during the night of a full moon while it floats through the night sky. This transformation is a magical display of its energy and connection to the lunar cycle.

entry: POKENAME独特的眼睛能分析天体成分。科学家计划在未来太空采矿时，用它寻找有价值的陨石。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Its unique eyes allow it to analyze the makeup of celestial bodies. Scientists plan to use POKENAME to detect valuable meteors on space mining expeditions in the future.

entry: 它始终摇摆着跳舞。舞蹈节奏似乎从不改变，但靠近墓地时，身上的闪光会更多。
author: bandedbodypress
source: It keeps up a constant, swinging dance. While the pace of this dance never seems to change, it sparkles more near graveyards.

entry: 为了增强特攻强化的效果，科学家开始使用POKENAME的星尘。它天生攻击速度快，粉尘也带着残留的力量。
author: jaminmcready
source: To heighten the effects of X Sp. Atk, scientists have begun using stardust from a POKENAME. Because of its naturally high attack speed, the dust carries traces of its power.

entry: 为了增强特攻强化的效果，科学家开始使用POKENAME的星尘。它天生攻击速度快，粉尘也带着残留的力量。
author: jaminmcready
source: To heighten the effects of X Sp. Atk, scientists have begun using stardust from a POKENAME. Because of its naturally high attack speed, the dust carries traces of its power.

entry: 据说有幸瞥见POKENAME展开燃烧双翼、飞越宇宙的人，都将获得极大的兴盛与好运。
author: mepp.
source: It's said that those who are able to catch a glimpse of POKENAME flying across the cosmos on its burning wings will be blessed with great prosperity.

entry: POKENAME翅膀的色彩如太阳般灿烂。翱翔时，会洒下耀眼的多彩火星。
