author: mepp.
source: The colors from POKENAME's wings radiate as splendidly as the sun. As it soars, dazzling multi-colored embers are scattered.

entry: POKENAME笨手笨脚，容易撞上岩石，把硬壳撞破。可惜缤纷的核心一暴露，它们往往很快就会死去。
author: whimsi_call
source: Prone to clumsiness, POKENAME break their tough shell by crashing into rocks. Unfortunately, with their colorful core exposed, they tend to die off quickly.

entry: POKENAME的几个头总为食物打架。人们推测它来自太空，以大气尘埃为食，核心颜色则取决于吃下的尘埃种类。
author: whimsi_call
source: POKENAME's heads are constantly fighting over food. Theorized to originate in space, their diet consists of atmospheric dust. The color of its core depends on what types it consumes.

entry: POKENAME在臭氧层飞驰，留下一道彩色鳞片轨迹。有时会被错认成流星。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME zip around in the ozone layer, leaving behind a trail of colorful scales. POKENAME are sometimes mistaken for shooting stars.

entry: POKENAME只出现在太空深处，人们认为它能给星际旅人带来极好的运气。有时，它会试着用超自然力量，帮助旅人平安返乡。
author: garliclol
source: Only found deep in space, POKENAME are thought to bring very good luck to interstellar travelers. On occasion, these Pokémon try to use their supernatural powers to help these travelers return home safely.

entry: POKENAME毛色惊艳，火焰又美得耀眼，深受宝可梦协调训练家喜爱。据说，它一生能为真心爱着的人实现一个愿望。
author: nyoomymph
source: POKENAME is popular with coordinators due to its stunning fur colours and the dazzling beauty of its fire. It's said that a POKENAME can grant a single wish in its lifetime to a human it truly loves.

entry: POKENAME平时懒洋洋的，偶尔却会突然爆发惊人活力，并散发奇妙光芒。人们认为，这种突变与天体运行有关。
author: sk372
source: While normally lethargic, on rare occasions POKENAME may suddenly act with extreme bursts of energy while radiating a strange light. It is believed this sudden shift has something to do with the movements of celestial bodies.

entry: POKENAME从尾巴喷出发光粉尘，组成点和短线，与同类交流。生命将尽时，它全身会像恒星一样明亮。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME sends out puffs of glowing dust in the form of dashes and dots from its tail to communicate with other POKENAME. When it is nearing the end of its life, its whole body glows brightly like a star.

entry: POKENAME唱歌时，沉重的岩壳会逐渐剥落。唱得越响、越久，它就飞得越高，因此成了年轻艺术家喜爱的象征。
author: pjporwoll
source: When POKENAME sings, its heavy, rocky shell steadily breaks away.The louder and longer it sings, the higher it flies, making this Pokémon a popular symbol for young artists.

entry: 失去大部分沉重外壳后，它能以惊人速度飞窜。尖刺是最深处核心的延伸，散发着强烈能量。
author: infinex21
source: Without the majority of its heavy shell, it can dart around at remarkable speed. Its spikes are extensions of its innermost core and radiate intense energy.

entry: 这种POKENAME变体数百年来一直与邪恶组织合作，过程中常犯不少错。它们很喜欢蕉香果。
author: lydiaprower8
source: This variant of POKENAME has collaborated with villainous organizations for centuries, often making more than a few mistakes in the process. They have a fondness for Nanab berries.

entry: POKENAME体内混有多种金属，即使失去大部分硬壳，也相当坚固。一记头锤就能轻松撞皱钢板。
author: infinex21
source: Its body is laced with myriad metals that keep it rather durable even without most of its hard shell. A Headbutt from a POKENAME can easily crumple a sheet of steel.

entry: POKENAME唱歌时，沉重的岩壳会逐渐剥落。唱得越响、越久，它就飞得越高，因此成了年轻艺术家喜爱的象征。
author: pjporwoll
source: When POKENAME sings, its heavy, rocky shell steadily breaks away.The louder and longer it sings, the higher it flies, making this Pokémon a popular symbol for young artists.

entry: POKENAME唱歌时，沉重的岩壳会逐渐剥落。唱得越响、越久，它就飞得越高，因此成了年轻艺术家喜爱的象征。
author: pjporwoll
source: When POKENAMEf sings, its heavy, rocky shell steadily breaks away. The louder and longer it sings, the higher it flies, making this Pokémon a popular symbol for young artists.

entry: 星星能让POKENAME在短时间内远行。到达目的地后，星星便撞向地面，暂时消失。有些个体会这样周游世界，帮助许多生物。
author: infranscia
source: The star allows POKENAME to travel great distances in short periods of time.  Once it reaches its destination, the star will crash into the ground and disappear for a time.  Some POKENAME travel this way to help many around the world.

entry: POKENAME以背上花朵的鲜艳色彩闻名。它喜欢飞高，靠近太阳，但身体太重，总是从空中猛坠下来。
author: ruben2309295
source: POKENAME are known for the vibrant colours produced by the flowers on their backs. POKENAME like to travel high up to get closer to the sun, but because of how heavy they are, they are constantly hurtling out of the sky.

entry: POKENAME从碎裂的壳中升向天空，高声歌唱。壳上的彩虹斑点十分美丽，太空爱好者和高级珠宝匠都会收集这些碎壳。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME rises from its shattered shell towards the sky while singing loudly. The shattered shell of POKENAME is collected by space enthusiasts and luxury jewelers alike due to the beautiful flecks of its rainbow coat.

entry: POKENAME的花苞释放彩色微粒，滋味美得足以吸引捕食者，却含有大量毒素。失去外壳后，它无法在严寒环境中存活。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's bud releases colorful particles that taste delicious enough to attract predators but contain high amounts of toxins. They are unable to survive in frigid environments without their outer shell.

entry: POKENAME鲜亮的橙色来自食物中的胡萝卜。对种菜的农户来说，它是相当讨厌的害兽。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's vivid orange color comes from the carrots in its diet. It's quite a pest for vegetable farmers.

entry: POKENAME年纪越大，壳就越重。成年或年老个体常见于天空，也会被错认成流星。
author: notsaying.
source: As POKENAME grows older, its shell becomes heavier. Adult or elderly individuals are commonplace in the sky and can be mistaken for shooting stars.

entry: POKENAME待在陨石坑附近的沙漠，等待从沙里伏击猎物。闪亮的身体会暴露行踪，幸好它不需要进食。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME sits around deserts near craters, waiting to ambush prey from the sand. Its shimmering body gives it away, but luckily it does not need to eat.

entry: 它常出现在古老陨石坑里，靠啃陨石残块磨牙。掉落牙齿的成分，与星尘完全相同。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Often found in ancient craters, it gnaws on the remnants of meteorites to sharpen its teeth. Any teeth that fall out have an identical makeup to stardust.

entry: POKENAME潜伏在宇宙中，凭出色视力从高处寻找猎物。一发现食物，就会高速俯冲地面。据报告，这景象仿佛陨石撞上行星。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME lurks in the cosmos, utilizing its extraordinary eyesight to spot prey from high above. As soon as it finds food, POKENAME dives towards the ground at high speeds. According to reports, this activity resembles a meteor striking the planet.

entry: 保护层破碎后，POKENAME急忙猎食岩石宝可梦，以免身体烧尽消散。重建岩壳能保护它一段时间，但壳不稳定，会不断崩落。
author: pjporwoll
source: With its protective layer shattered, POKENAME hastily hunts down rocky Pokémon to eat to stave off its body burning up and fading away. Reforming its rocky coat will protect it for some time, but the shell is unstable and steadily crumbles.

entry: 保护层破碎后，POKENAME急忙猎食岩石宝可梦，以免身体烧尽消散。重建岩壳能保护它一段时间，但壳不稳定，会不断崩落。
author: pjporwoll
source: With its protective layer shattered, POKENAME hastily hunts down rocky Pokémon to eat to stave off its body burning up and fading away. Reforming its rocky coat will protect it for some time, but the shell is unstable and steadily crumbles.

entry: POKENAME一见流星雨就会欢快蹦跳。尾巴随之燃起火光，常不小心引发火灾损害。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME prance about whenever they see meteor showers. Their tails flare up when this happens, often leading to accidental fire damage.

entry: POKENAME的吼声能震开云层，回荡数英里。即使它离开很久，附近石缝里仍闪着奇异的宇宙矿石。
author: jaminmcready
source: Its roar splits clouds and can echo for miles. Long after POKENAME vanishes, cracks in nearby stone glisten with strange cosmic ore.

entry: POKENAME身体散发冰蓝光芒，过热时便会转红。它会朝周身吹冰，迅速降温，确保体温维持在可承受范围。
author: .izik
source: The icy blue glow coming off POKENAME's body will turn red if it is overheating. It blows ice around itself to rapidly cool down, ensuring its body temperature remains manageable.

entry: POKENAME的冰蓝光在夜里格外醒目，景象令人难忘而不安。它飘过天空，沿途留下一道道冷雾。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's icy blue glow is extremely visible at night, making it a haunting sight. It floats through the sky, leaving trails of cold mist behind it as it travels.

entry: POKENAME充满能量，几秒内就能消化吃下的垃圾。有些地方开始用它快速处理垃圾废料，因为它的食欲似乎没有尽头。
author: sk372
source: Surging with energy, POKENAME digests any trash it ingests within seconds. Some locations have begun using it as a quick way to get rid of refuse and waste material, as its appetite seems bottomless.

entry: POKENAME身体由各种珍稀矿物杂糅而成，体内一种化学物质会将它们照亮。阿罗拉一家大型地质实验室，曾被饥饿的它吃光所有标本。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's body is a mess of rare minerals, illuminated by a chemical in its body that makes them glow. A major geology lab in Alola once lost all its specimens to a hungry POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME又被称为“海之彗星”，通常靠沙子和热液喷口的微粒，过着悠闲生活。不过一有什么吸引目光，它就会快得令人眼花地冲过去，把东西收进嘴里。
author: bobosmith01
source: Also known as "The Comet of the Sea", POKENAME typically lives an idyllic life living off sand and particles from hydrothermal vents. However, if an object catches its eye, it bolts towards it with blinding speed, collecting it in its mouth.

entry: POKENAME以光速穿行宇宙，寻找食物填补无底洞般的饥饿。太空根本无猎物可寻，因此它已适应吞食星尘。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME zips through the cosmos at lightspeed, trying to find food to fuel its insatiable hunger. It has adapted to eating stardust, as finding prey in space is impossible to accomplish.

entry: POKENAME以光速穿行宇宙，寻找食物填补无底洞般的饥饿。太空根本无猎物可寻，因此它已适应吞食星尘。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME zips through the cosmos at lightspeed, trying to find food to fuel its insatiable hunger. It has adapted to eating stardust, as finding prey in space is impossible to accomplish.

entry: 它剥下附近树木的树皮，一层层盖住发光身体，把光藏在木节和腐朽处下。受惊时，树皮会稍稍裂开，闪出紫色火焰。
author: jaminmcready
source: It strips bark from nearby trees and layers it over its glowing body, hiding its light beneath knots and rot. When startled, the bark splits slightly, revealing a flash of violet fire.

entry: POKENAME用高频振动寻找隐藏的星体碎片。声音会吸引成群夜行宝可梦，敬畏地悬停在旁。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME uses high-pitched vibrations to locate hidden star fragments. The tone draws flocks of nocturnal Pokémon, who hover motionless in awe.

entry: POKENAME以无与伦比的优雅翱翔晴空，叫声又像陨石坠落，因此常被误认成高速坠下的小行星。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME are known to soar across clear skies with unmatched elegance. With cries that sound similar to meteors falling, people often mistake POKENAME for fast-crashing asteroids.

entry: POKENAME的内脏释放辐射，使上半身发光。进食后光芒更亮，胶质身体也会随着消化震动。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's upper body glows due to the radiation emitted by its internal organs. It glows brighter after it's eaten, its gelatinous body vibrating as it digests.

entry: POKENAME喜欢来巢边的旅人，会邀请他们避难或休息。若特别亲近某人，它还可能送上一个小毛绒玩具。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME enjoys travelers who wander by its den, inviting them to take shelter or rest. When the Pokémon feels particularly close to someone, it may offer them a small plush toy.

entry: 闯入POKENAME山间巢穴的生物，会先迎来碾压般的拥抱，接着再挨一记强力的力量宝石，确保彻底败下阵来。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME greets intruders to its mountain den with a crushing hug. It follows up with a devastating Power Gem attack to ensure their defeat.

entry: POKENAME外表像外星生物，常在科幻电影中扮演外星入侵者。它再生触手的能力，看着有些令人不安。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: Because of its extraterrestrial appearance, POKENAME is often cast as an alien invader in science fiction movies. Its ability to regenerate its tentacles can be unnerving to watch.

entry: POKENAME施展连贯武术动作时，披风上发绿光的部分会明亮闪烁。闪光给动作增添华彩，先让对手眼花，再落下决定性的一击。
author: .izik
source: The glowing green portions of POKENAME's cape flash brightly while performing martial arts combinations. The flashes add flair to its movements, dazzling its opponents before landing a decisive strike.

entry: POKENAME挣脱沉重的保护外骨骼后，身体轻得足以返回星空家园，但在熄灭前，能返乡的时间很短。归途中的光芒，数英里外都看得见。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME that break free of their heavy, protective exoskeleton are light enough to return to their starry home, but they only have a short time to do so before they are extinguished. The glow of their return journey can be seen from miles away.

entry: POKENAME跃过夜间云层，明亮闪耀，常被错认成不明飞行物。不过突如其来的暴风雪，会揭示它的真面目。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME glows brilliantly as it leaps across night clouds. Mistaking it for a UFO is common, but a sudden blizzard reveals its true nature.

entry: 失去外壳后，它变得致命得多，代价却是寿命呈指数缩短。它凶狠地拼命战斗，毫不在意自身死活。
author: h0bojoe
source: The loss of its shell has made it far deadlier, but at the cost of an exponentially shortened lifespan. It fights with reckless ferocity, unconcerned for its own survival.

entry: 若有毫无戒备的旅人误入领地，POKENAME会从高崖跃下袭击。它光靠尘埃就能吃饱，尘埃颜色还会大幅改变毛色。
author: npshi
source: POKENAME leap from high cliffs onto unsuspecting travellers that stumble upon their territories. POKENAME satiate their diet with dust alone, with the colour of the dust changing the hue of their fur drastically.

entry: POKENAME追随着流星和彗星，沿途唱着美妙的歌。流星雨时，最高的山顶会聚集成千上万的听众，只盼听到哪怕一个音符。
author: dualblades1147
source: POKENAME follow meteors and comets, singing a beautiful song along the way. During meteor showers, thousands gather on top of the tallest mountains to hopefully hear even a single note from this melody.

entry: POKENAME披着迷人的星尘，飞到哪里都留下绚丽色彩。据报告，沐浴阿罗拉月光之后，它会闪得最亮。
author: dodoowner_
source: It cloaks itself with a mesmerizing stardust, leaving a stunning trail of colors wherever it flies. Reports say POKENAME shines the brightest after basking in the Alolan moonlight.

entry: POKENAME的牙齿能碾碎最坚硬的矿物和外壳，连陨石碎块也不是它下颚的对手。头顶突起释放的闪亮粉尘，其颜色取决于食物。
author: milchik
source: Its teeth are strong enough to crush even the hardest minerals and shells; even pieces of meteors are no match for POKENAME's jaw. The colors of the sparkling dust it releases through the protuberance on its head are determined by what it eats.

entry: POKENAME在月见山的峰顶漫游，凝望星辰。或许因为同样对太空有兴趣，它会让皮宝宝骑在自己的几丁质身体上。
author: theaceofhearts0306
source: Found roaming the peaks of Mt. Moon, POKENAME gaze at the stars. Seemingly due to their shared interest in space, POKENAME allow Cleffa to ride their chitinous bodies.

entry: POKENAME燃烧的陨石鳞片，让拳头能打出威猛无比的冲击。不过鳞片很快会烧尽崩解，它必须在身体变得太脆弱前，解决敌人并吃掉。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's burning meteor scales allow it to dish out powerful punches with enormous impact force. However, since these scales burn off and disintegrate quickly, it must finish off and feast on its foe before it becomes too vulnerable.

entry: POKENAME燃烧的陨石鳞片，让拳头能打出威猛无比的冲击。不过鳞片很快会烧尽崩解，它必须在身体变得太脆弱前，解决敌人并吃掉。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's burning meteor scales allow it to dish out powerful punches with enormous impact force. However, since these scales burn off and disintegrate quickly, it must finish off and feast on its foe before it becomes too vulnerable.

entry: POKENAME身体相当脆弱，因此把岩石钳当作保护壳。战斗中受威胁时，它会从钳子射出强大的宇宙射线束。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's body is quite delicate, so it uses its rocky pincers as a defensive shell. When threatened in battle, it fires powerful beams of cosmic rays from its pincers.

entry: POKENAME的双眼能力出众，既有敏锐视力，又能发射远距离光束。即使相隔极远，光束也快而准，让人怀疑是否具备追踪能力。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's eyes are very strong, possessing acute vision and the ability to fire long-range beams of light. These shots are so fast and accurate even from extreme distances, some wonder if they possess homing capabilities.

entry: POKENAME会送陨石形护符给喜欢的训练家。这些石质小饰品摸起来温暖，有时还在月光下微微闪烁。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME gifts meteor-shaped charms to Trainers it likes. These rocky trinkets are warm to the touch and sometimes shimmer faintly under moonlight.

entry: POKENAME体内神奇的太阳能量充沛得让身体始终明亮发光、散发暖意。拿法杖施法纯粹是做样子，因为它喜欢把魔法表演得盛大夺目。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's body is bursting with so much magical solar energy that its own body glows bright and radiates warmth constantly. Its use of a staff to cast spells is purely performative, as it enjoys making a spectacle of its magic.

entry: POKENAME用凝固星尘做成的魔杖，朝空中撒出火花。火花落下时，留下闪光粉末，像沙子一样附在地面。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME uses a wand made of hardened stardust to cast sparks in the air. When the sparks fall, they leave behind a trail of glitter that clings to the ground like sand.

entry: 陨石外壳破碎后，POKENAME显露出纯粹星辰能量化身的真貌。据说它曾有肉身，与灵魂合而为一后，便将肉身舍去。
author: infinex21
source: With its meteor-clad shell broken, POKENAME reveals its true form as a manifestation of pure astral energy. This Pokémon is said to have once had a corporeal form that it shed after becoming one with its soul.

entry: POKENAME睡在安静的河底，静止身体常被错认成蓝宝石。水中透下的光让表面如珠宝般闪耀，吸引好奇的目光。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME sleeps at the bottom of quiet rivers, its still body mistaken for a blue sapphire. Light passing through the water makes its surface shimmer like a jewel, drawing curious eyes.

entry: 黄昏时，POKENAME几乎无声地跃过湖面。每次落下都留下一片闪亮泡沫，天亮前就会消散。
author: jaminmcready
source: At dusk, POKENAME skips across lake surfaces with barely a sound. Each landing leaves behind a glittering patch of foam that fades before morning.

entry: 谁看见POKENAME的真身，都会被晃得动弹不得。身体仿佛折射着星辰本身，将目标牢牢定住。
author: jaminmcready
source: Anyone who sees POKENAME's true form is dazzled into stillness. Its body seems to refract the stars themselves, locking its targets in place.

entry: POKENAME凭无比强壮的双腿，能把自己一路送进臭氧层，再猛坠回地面，以陨石般的毁灭冲击打敌人一个措手不及。
author: ambrosia04
source: Using its incredibly powerful legs, POKENAME can propel itself all the way into the ozone layer. It then plummets back to earth, catching enemies off guard by striking with the devastating force of a meteor.

entry: POKENAME拖出的烟迹里夹着点点宇宙尘埃。它很少移动，保存核心热量，直到突然爆发，放出明亮轰击。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME's smoke trails contain flecks of cosmic dust. It rarely moves, conserving its core's heat until it erupts with sudden, radiant blasts.

entry: POKENAME贪玩地躲在农田里，藏进一行行作物之间。夜里，身上柔和闪烁的光却会暴露藏身处。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME playfully hides among farmland, nestling between rows of crops. At night, its glow flickers softly, giving away its hiding spots.

entry: POKENAME飘过星夜时，下半身像钟摆一样来回晃动。所在之处会飘出奇异的南瓜味，让附近的人既好奇又不安。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's lower half wobbles back and forth like a pendulum as it floats through a starry night sky. An odd scent of pumpkin wafts from its location, drawing both curiosity and unease from those nearby.

entry: POKENAME在满月下的墓地起舞，光芒如烛火闪烁。它的光在墓碑间缓缓移动，投下修长游移的影子。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME dances in graveyards under the full moon, flickering like a candle. Its light drifts slowly between headstones, casting long, wandering shadows.

entry: POKENAME用星尘做糕点，仔细捏出真正甜点的模样。不过咬上一口后，它常嫌弃地吐出来。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME forms pastries out of stardust, carefully shaping them to resemble real desserts. After taking a bite, it often spits them out in disgust.

entry: POKENAME收集世界各地的糖果，裹上闪亮星尘，戴在身上。肚子饿就吃一颗，再赶快做一颗新的戴上。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME collects candies from around the world and coats them in sparkling stardust for it to wear. If it gets hungry, it eats one and quickly crafts another to wear.

entry: POKENAME腰间围着核心冷却后形成的锯齿状石块。石头拖着身体，它总是恼火地哼哼，试图用脚踢掉。
author: jaminmcready
source: Around POKENAME's waist are jagged stones that formed as its core cooled. The rocks weigh it down, and it constantly tries to kick them loose with frustrated grunts.

entry: 岩石会自然吸附在POKENAME身上，常把它拖得沉重不堪。为了脱身，它会突然猛动，用爆发的动作震碎石块。
author: jaminmcready
source: Rocks are naturally attracted to POKENAME's body and often weigh it down. To free itself, it snaps suddenly, breaking the stones with bursts of motion.

entry: POKENAME能感知地下深处的珍贵矿石。它会倒着卧在隐藏矿藏上方，用发光核心静静守护。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME can sense precious ores deep underground. It lays upside down over those hidden pockets, quietly guarding them with its glowing core.

entry: POKENAME把河水舀进头顶睡莲叶状的石盘，轻轻摇晃，淘取珍稀矿物。有时里面已闪出金属碎屑，它却仍不停打转。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME scoops river water into the lily pad shaped rock on its head, swishing it gently to pan for rare minerals. Sometimes small flecks of metal sparkle inside, but it keeps swirling anyway.

entry: POKENAME的帽子脆弱又头重脚轻，常一动就碎。这时，它会聚拢附近岩石，在头顶仔细塑造新帽子。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME's hat is fragile and top-heavy, so it often breaks apart when it moves. When this happens, it gathers nearby rocks to carefully shape a new one atop its head.

entry: POKENAME储存的能量近乎无穷，大部分却用来封住自身。如果实体封印一旦破裂，引发的爆炸将是灾难性的。
author: chaos_emblemx
source: POKENAME have nearly limitless stored energy, but most of it is spent keeping themselves contained. If their physical seals were ever to break, the resulting explosion would be catastrophic.

entry: POKENAME眼中的明亮旋涡，热得如同小型恒星。它旋转跳舞时，尾上的岩石甚至会热到足以熔化陨石。
author: ambrosia04
source: The bright swirls on POKENAME's eyes are as hot as a small star. When POKENAME spins and dances, the rock on its tail grows hot enough to melt meteorites.

entry: POKENAME以烧得赤红的爪子闻名，主要用来捕猎。记录显示，眼睛和爪子产生的火焰颜色不同，是因为火中所含矿物不同。
author: ruben2309295
source: POKENAME are known for their red-hot burning claws, which they primarily use to hunt their prey. It's been documented that the flames produced by their eyes and claws are different in colour because of the mineral content in the flames.

entry: POKENAME从高层大气下降时，几乎总会落入大海。它慢慢沉到最深的海底，安静地在深海礁石间定居。
author: ambrosia04
source: When descending from the upper atmosphere, POKENAME almost always end up falling into the sea. They slowly sink to the very bottom of the ocean, where they quietly settle among the deep-sea reefs.

entry: POKENAME从天坠落时，像粉色流星，人们会向它祈求爱情。人们相信，若在地面找到这些心形宝可梦，一生都能拥有健康美满的关系。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME resemble pink shooting stars as they fall from the sky, to which people wish for love to. Finding these fallen, heart-shaped Pokémon on the ground is believed to promise a lifetime of healthy relationships.

entry: 夜里，POKENAME会从洞中弹射而出，飞上高空。它能在空中停留数日，闪耀着缤纷色彩。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME shoots itself from its holes at night to fly at high altitudes. It can stay airborne for days, dazzling in many colors.

entry: POKENAME喜欢在水边放松，一连好几个小时仰望星辰。受打扰时，它会释放令人头痛的星尘云，让许多宝可梦不敢打断它。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME love to relax at the edge of a body of water and stargaze for hours at a time. When disturbed, they release a cloud of stardust that causes headaches, which deters many Pokémon from interrupting them.

entry: POKENAME游到哪里，都留下一道星尘，用美丽光景照亮水域。星尘的光很快消散，因此这短暂景象只能维持几秒。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME create a trail of stardust wherever they swim and brighten bodies of water with a beautiful display of light. These transient displays last for a few seconds, as the light from the stardust dissipates quickly.

entry: POKENAME喜欢在无云的夜里炫耀空中杂技。身后留下的岩石微粒微微发光，很快便会崩解。
author: shreks_stepfather
source: POKENAME loves showing off its aerial acrobatics on cloudless nights. It leaves behind a trail of rocky particles that glow faintly and quickly disintegrate.

entry: POKENAME生气时，体内能量升温，让身体升上空中。一看见惹怒自己的家伙，它便释放全部能量，猛坠回地面，轰出强力一拳。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: When a POKENAME gets angry, the energy in its body heats up and causes it to lift into the air. When it sees the cause of its anger, it releases all of its energy and plummets back down to the ground to deliver a powerful punch.

entry: POKENAME翱翔夜空，追逐一切会飞的东西。追逐途中，身后的星尘形成一场美丽光景。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME soar through the night sky chasing anything that flies. These chases create a beautiful display of stardust that trails behind them.

entry: POKENAME喜欢追赶宝可梦，身后留下闪亮星尘。追上目标后，它喜欢把爪子按在对方头上，确认一切都会安好。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME love to chase after Pokémon and leave glittery stardust in their wake. Whenever they catch up to their target, they like to press a paw on their head to confirm that everything is going to be okay.

entry: 挣脱厚壳后，POKENAME显露真身，是由火焰和宇宙能量构成的龙形宝可梦。这种形态更敢于挑战强敌，非得耗尽体力才会返回臭氧层。
author: infinex21
source: Freed from its thick shell, POKENAME's true form is revealed as a draconic Pokémon made of flames and cosmic energies. In this form, it becomes more daring in who it fights with and will only return to the ozone layer when it has exhausted itself.

entry: POKENAME在视野中忽隐忽现，快得让人错认成故障的传送装置。几乎无法预测它下一刻会出现在哪里。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME blinks in and out of sight so quickly that some mistake it for a malfunctioning Teleporter. It's nearly impossible to predict where it will appear next.

entry: POKENAME集中精神力，防止实体消散。战斗时，它会用念力把碎壳的星形残片射向敌人。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME focuses its psychic powers to keep its physical form from fading away. It fights by telekinetically shooting star-shaped pieces of its shattered shell at foes.

entry: POKENAME掌握着天文学家迫切渴求的宇宙知识，却只肯把发现告诉自己完全信任的人。
author: nyoomymph
source: POKENAME possesses knowledge of the cosmos that our astronomers are desperate to gain, but it will not pass on its discoveries to anyone it doesn't trust implicitly.

entry: POKENAME攻击时，身体上发浅蓝光的部分会反复闪烁，分散敌人注意，接着轰出强力拳击，击倒所有挡路者。
author: .izik
source: The light blue glowing portion of POKENAME's body flashes repeatedly while it attacks, acting as a distraction while it lets off powerful punches that can knock out any foe in its way.

entry: 热闹的夜里，POKENAME在公共街道滑行，给遇到的每个人发糖。它喜欢和人类赛跑，谁能赢过它，就能拿走它所有甜食。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME skate through public streets on crowded nights, handing out candy to all they find. They enjoy racing humans and will give up all their sweets to those who beat them.

entry: 宇宙能量化作POKENAME释放的灿烂火焰。飞过夜空时，尾焰像极了彗星划过太空的轨迹。
author: kam_doodle_snek
source: Cosmic energy manifests as brilliant flames that POKENAME generates. Flying through the night sky, the flame on its tail closely resembles the trail of a comet streaking through space.

entry: POKENAME的壳散发惊人高热，触碰十分危险。它常栖居在火山深处的空腔，吃岩石和矿物质。在科学进步以前，人们以为它的喷射火焰和太阳一样热。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME's shell is dangerous to touch due to the immense heat it radiates. They are often found in deep volcanic chambers, feeding on rocks and minerals. Before scientific advances, their Flamethrower attacks were thought to be as hot as the sun.

entry: POKENAME庞大的能量输出，让它能凭空自由创造、操控少量水。外壳由极其坚固的材质构成，能承受惊人的压力。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's vast energy output lets it freely create and manipulate small amounts of water out of thin air. Its shell is made of an extremely durable material that can withstand amazing amounts of pressure.

entry: 宇宙各处都能找到POKENAME，守护行星免遭陨石轰击。它常被行星引力捕获，不由自主地像月亮一样绕其运行。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME are found throughout the cosmos protecting planets from meteors blasting down at them. They are often caught in a planet's gravitational pull and involuntarily orbit the planet like a moon.

entry: POKENAME受惊时，发光身体周围悬浮的石块会四散飞窜。它得亲手把石头重新收回来，才能恢复防御力。
author: .izik
source: The stones levitating around POKENAME's glowing body flit in different directions should it be startled. If this happens, POKENAME must regather the stones by hand to restore its defensive strength.

entry: 构成POKENAME耳朵和尾巴的白绒，其实是宇宙尘埃。壳由陨石物质形成，受威胁时，它便缩进去。
author: kam_doodle_snek
source: The white fluff that makes up POKENAME's ears and tail is composed of cosmic dust. Its shell is formed from meteorite material, which it retreats into when threatened.

entry: POKENAME的三个部分都会释放强力电磁辐射脉冲。它们常聚在太空研究机构的建筑附近，脉冲会扰乱设备，因此被视为麻烦。
author: sk372
source: All three parts of POKENAME pulse with a powerful electromagnetic radiation. Space institutes consider them a nuisance, as they tend to conglomerate near the buildings and cause havoc on the machinery with their pulses.

entry: POKENAME的棒子亮得如汽车远光灯，夜里格外醒目。有些乡间机场会靠它帮忙，引导飞机安全通过跑道。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME batons can shine as bright as a car's high beams, which makes them perfect for being seen at night. Some rural airports rely on POKENAME to help guide planes safely on the runway.

entry: 背上的喇叭能发出足以震碎巨石的声波。可POKENAME十分友善，常与其他宝可梦结队游行。
author: mistymagius
source: The trumpets on its back are able to produce sonic blasts powerful enough to shatter boulders. Despite this, POKENAME are very friendly and can be seen parading around with other Pokémon.

entry: 野生POKENAME若在同一颗行星的大气里停留超过几周，就会开始消散。它们会成群飞走，如倒流的流星雨般升空，寻找新世界。精灵球技术能减轻这种迁移需求。
author: pjporwoll
source: A wild POKENAME will begin to fade if it stays within the atmosphere of the same planet for longer than a few weeks. Groups of them will fly away in search of new worlds, flying up in reverse meteor showers. Poké Ball technology mitigates this need.

entry: 野生POKENAME若在同一颗行星的大气里停留超过几周，就会开始消散。它们会成群飞走，如倒流的流星雨般升空，寻找新世界。精灵球技术能减轻这种迁移需求。
author: pjporwoll
source: A wild POKENAME will begin to fade if it stays within the atmosphere of the same planet for longer than a few weeks. Groups of them will fly away in search of new worlds, flying up in reverse meteor showers. Poké Ball technology mitigates this need.

entry: POKENAME飘过天空时，有时会对窗边的孩子做鬼脸。它闪动发光身体吸引注意，再用古怪表情逗孩子笑。
author: .izik
source: While floating through the sky, POKENAME sometimes makes faces at children in windows. Its glowing body flashes to get their attention, trying to make them laugh with its odd faces.

entry: POKENAME是大气中转瞬即逝的现象，以混乱能量活动，最后在狂喜的爆发中烧尽消失。太空里能活得更久，它会撞偏卫星，并用响亮尖叫回应无线电波。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is a fleeting phenomenon within the atmosphere, acting with chaotic energy before burning out of existence in a euphoric rush. It survives longer in space, where it knocks satellites off course and responds to radio waves with loud screams.

entry: 据说看见POKENAME摇动小陨星般的钟摆，会获得仿佛来自异世界的幻象和知识。目睹者最终却陷入近似昏迷的恍惚，喃喃说着像疯癫阴谋论般的胡话。
author: beatdoof
source: Those who see POKENAME swinging its Minior-like pendulum are said to experience visions and knowledge they think is from beyond this world. They end up stuck in a coma-like daze, mumbling gibberish that resembles deranged conspiracies.

entry: 它会用布满尖刺的种子吓退敌人，让对方不敢轻易攻击。随后，再用自身产生的易燃毒液反击。
author: soup1900
source: Its enemies don't like to attack it, since it uses its thorny bulb as a deterrant. It then uses the flammable toxin it creates to counterattack.

entry: 它们尚未掌握火属性攻击，因此不管多危险，都会不顾一切地用小小身体撞向敌人。只有把对手彻底裹住，才肯停止吐丝。
author: bobosmith01
source: They have yet to master their Fire-Type attacks, so they recklessly smack their small bodies into their enemies no matter how dangerous it may be. They won't stop spraying silk until they have fully wrapped their opponent up.

entry: 务必让POKENAME远离同类。极端的争强好斗和敌意，会驱使它们互相冲撞，而撞击必然引发巨大的烈焰爆炸。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME should be kept away from others of its kind at all costs. Extreme rivalry and aggression compel them to charge into each other, and the impact will inevitably cause a huge fiery explosion.

entry: 哭泣时，戴着的头骨会冒黑烟。据说毛是世上最软的，可谁碰了都会严重灼伤。
author: sautomagically
source: When it cries, black smoke puffs out from the skull it wears. Rumors say its fur is the softest thing in the world, but anyone who touches it will end up with a nasty burn.

entry: POKENAME凭致命踢击，以残酷而精准的方式战斗。战况最激烈时，它会把火焰导入双腿，用灼热踢击烧伤敌人。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME battles with brutal precision, relying on lethal kicks. In moments of peak intensity, it channels fire into its legs, scorching enemies with searing blows.

entry: POKENAME为擂台而生，不懈训练，磨炼火焰拳法。输了比赛，它会难过得好几天不肯吃饭。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME lives to fight in the ring, training relentlessly to perfect its fiery punching techniques. If it loses a match, it takes it so hard that it may refuse to eat for days.

entry: POKENAME身体不断排出有毒、易燃的气体。它会挥动尾巴威胁其他宝可梦，却可能点燃体内气体，引发爆炸。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME constantly vents a noxious and flammable gas from their bodies. They threaten other Pokémon by brandishing their tail, which can ignite the gases inside them and cause an explosion.

entry: POKENAME在火山外的岩崖间漫游，用尾焰保护自己。它会先硬化全身鳞片扛住攻击，再甩动尾巴，把敌人点燃。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME wander around rocky crags outside volcanoes, using the flame on their tails to defend themselves. They harden the scales around their body to endure attacks before swinging around their tails to set their foes ablaze.

entry: POKENAME身上，只有背部火焰比樱红色的壳更明亮。背上每根刺都能喷出熔化金属的火焰。
author: quackquackattack
source: The only thing brighter than a POKENAME's cherry shell is the flames on their backs. Each spine on their back is capable of producing flames that can melt metal.

entry: POKENAME身体放出猛烈高热，把厚重铠甲烧得赤红。鼻端钻头般的角飞快旋转，燃起火焰，连实心金属也能钻穿。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME's body releases such intense heat that its heavy armor glows red-hot. The drill-like horn on its snout spins at blazing speed, igniting in flames and allowing it to pierce even solid metal.

entry: POKENAME看似只是缠着藤蔓的火恐龙，四肢和颈部却比看起来长得多。由于身体非常灵活，它战斗时更喜欢用爪，而不是火。
author: oreee0230
source: Although POKENAME looks like a Charmeleon wrapped in vines, its limbs and neck are much longer than they appear. Because of its great flexibility, POKENAME tends to use its claws rather than fire in battles.

entry: POKENAME向尾焰喷射易燃气体，能制造强大的火焰爆发。火在水下也能燃烧，碰到什么就烧焦什么。
author: santon5512
source: By spraying flammable gas at the flames on their tails, POKENAME can create powerful blasts of fire. These flames burn even underwater, scorching anything they touch.

entry: POKENAME以火焰鳍为荣。夜里，它们会比赛谁跃出水面最高，常被错认成烟火。
author: radiance8990
source: POKENAME is quite proud of its fiery fins. At night, POKENAME are seen competing with each other to see who can jump the highest out of the water. They are often mistaken for fireworks.

entry: 退潮时，POKENAME会熔化面前的沙子制成玻璃，帮助自己滑回海里。沙中浸满水，因此这过程可能耗上好几个小时。
author: quackquackattack
source: At low tide, POKENAME melt the sand in front of them to create glass and help slide themselves back into the ocean. This process can take a couple of hours because the sand is saturated with water.

entry: POKENAME尾巴始终发光，身体在暗处也常泛红光，却很怕突然的闪光。一被晃得看不见，它就会到处狂暴冲撞。
author: bobosmith01
source: Although it constantly emits light from its tail and often radiates a reddish glow from its body when in darkness, POKENAME is sensitive to sudden flashes and will rampage around when blinded.

entry: POKENAME用尾上的火焰抽打敌人，将其逼入绝境。若生病，它得泡熔岩浴，才能恢复免疫系统。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME lashes out at enemies with the flame on its tail to corner them. If it gets sick, it needs to bathe in lava to restore its immune system.

entry: POKENAME的钳子热得能熔化钢梁。它讨厌寒冷，天气冷时会变得暴躁凶狠。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME's pincers are hot enough to melt steel beams. POKENAME dislikes the cold, and will become violent in cold weather.

entry: POKENAME凶猛异常，以尖角和火焰吐息积极守护群体。作为保护的回报，群体找到的树果都会分给它。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are ferocious creatures that aggressively defend their herd with their sharp horns and fiery breath. In exchange for protection, POKENAME are given any berries that the herd finds.

entry: POKENAME用火焰尾巴烧掉高草，制造烟雾。烟能吓退捕食者，让它有充足空间啃食草和叶片。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME burns tall grass using its fiery tail to create smoke. This smoke scares away predators, so it has plenty of space to graze on grass and leaves.

entry: POKENAME的火焰炽热明亮。它攀爬草木寻找食物时，常会引发灌木火灾。
author: silver175
source: POKENAME's flames burn hot and bright. It frequently starts brushfires as it climbs the foliage searching for food.

entry: 暴怒时，POKENAME会喷出蓝白色火焰，所经之处只剩燃烧的废墟。即使潜入水中，尾焰也从不熄灭。
author: nomadinstasis
source: When enraged, POKENAME blows out bluish-white flames, leaving blazing ruins in its wake. Its tail never extinguishes when submerged.

entry: POKENAME性情极其冲动鲁莽，常惹上麻烦。尾焰烧得旺盛，就说明它身体非常健康。
author: fiordaliso
source: Due to its highly impulsive and reckless temperament, POKENAME often ends up getting into trouble. When the flame on its tail burns intensely, it means it is in excellent health.

entry: POKENAME栖居火山海滩，会迎着涨起的浪头奔跑，或跑上火山岩，测试力量。它争强好胜，绝不退缩逃避挑战。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: POKENAME can be found on volcanic beaches, where they test their strength by running into rising surf or up volcanic rock. They are highly competitive and will not back down from a challenge.

entry: POKENAME激动起来，头上的火便会剧烈摇曳、噼啪作响。爪温高得在划伤对手时，还会轻微烧灼伤口，使其封合。
author: sk372
source: The fire on POKENAME's head flicks and crackles wildly when it is getting worked up. The heat of its claws is high enough that it lightly cauterizes the gashes it inflicts on its opponents.

entry: 让POKENAME在电脑里四处游走时，要多加小心。它脾气多变，心情不好就可能拿尾焰烧文件。
author: sk372
source: One should be careful letting POKENAME roam about in one's computer. It is quite temperamental, and if in a bad mood may attempt to burn files with the fire on its tail.

entry: POKENAME的壳能让体内保留大量热量。虽然喷火能力很强，在水里捕猎时，它最拿手的仍是爪子。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME's shell retains a lot of heat inside its body. Although it has a strong ability to spit fire, its best way to hunt in water is still with its claws.

entry: POKENAME等待进化时，会凶猛甩动火尾，攻击附近一切，保护自己。若两只选了同一根树枝悬挂，就会互喷烈火，直到一方被逼下树。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME swings its fiery tail fiercely at anything nearby, protecting itself while it waits to evolve. Should two POKENAME choose the same branch to hang from, they fiercely flame at each other until one is forced off the tree.

entry: 古时候，镇上铁匠会与POKENAME交好，请它给锻炉加热。后来又发现，它的水枪还能给赤热刀刃淬火，这种共生关系因此延续数百年。
author: ghostslythe
source: In ancient eras town blacksmiths would befriend POKENAME to heat their forges. In time it was discovered their Water Guns could also quench red-hot blades, causing this symbiosis to last for centuries.

entry: 它从嘴里喷出阵阵火焰，恐吓其他宝可梦，令其远离巢穴。POKENAME捕猎时善于乘着气流，长时间停留空中。
author: fiordaliso
source: It intimidates other Pokémon by breathing gusts of fire from its jaws, keeping them away from its den. POKENAME skillfully rides air currents to stay aloft for long stretches while hunting for prey.

entry: 捕猎时格外兴奋或斗志高涨，尾焰就会烧得更旺。POKENAME通常在沙漠岩石峡谷的高处筑巢。
author: fiordaliso
source: When especially excited or driven during a hunt, the flame on its tail burns more intensely. POKENAME tends to nest atop the rocky canyons of the desert.

entry: 训练家若不定时喂食，POKENAME就会变得极不听话、凶暴好斗。吃到喜欢的食物时，尾焰会变大一倍。
author: fiordaliso
source: If POKENAME'sTrainer does not feed it regularly, it becomes extremely unruly and aggressive. When it eats food it enjoys, the flame on its tail doubles in size.

entry: POKENAME越激动，火焰越会转成蓝白色，温度和强度也不断提高。它会俯冲敌人，用锋利得毫不留情的爪子将其撕裂。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: As POKENAME gets agitated, its flames will begin to glow blue and white, increasing with heat and intensity. It'll dive towards foes and shred them with its unforgivingly sharp claws.

entry: POKENAME体温极高，蜕皮时旧皮会稍稍熔粘在身上。为了继续长大，它会找其他宝可梦友好切磋，借战斗松开旧皮，好顺利蜕下。
author: linhasxoc
source: POKENAME's body temperature is so hot, its molt lightly fuses to its body when it sheds its skin. To be able to grow, it seeks out friendly battles with other Pokémon, which dislodges the molt and allows it to shed its skin properly.

entry: POKENAME生活在树林，与同群伙伴一同筑巢。它极富攻击性，会烧毁敌对巢穴宣示地位，再以毒刺猛攻敌人。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME dwells in woods and forests, where it builds a nest alongside other members of its swarm. It is a highly aggressive Pokémon that sets rival hives ablaze to assert its dominance, striking foes with fierce attacks using its poisonous stings.

entry: POKENAME喜欢用珍稀矿物和钻石磨爪。产生的金属粉尘可能在尾焰中燃烧，改变火焰颜色。
author: pastapockets
source: POKENAME likes to sharpen its claws on rare minerals and diamonds. This can cause metal dust to ignite in POKENAME's tail flame and change its color.

entry: POKENAME始终散发类似草药加热的香气，具体气味却因栖居地区而异。一旦发怒，香气就会变成焦物冒烟的味道。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is constantly releasing an aroma that reminds one of the smell of heated herbs. However, the exact smell varies on the region POKENAME is found in. In addition, if POKENAME is angered, the aroma turns to that of smoking charred matter.

entry: POKENAME对战时，会从满是尖牙的大嘴喷出灼热烈焰争取胜利。赢得多了，不少个体会变得傲慢，因此训练家常安排艰难的战斗，教它如何坦然接受失败。
author: quackquackattack
source: In a Pokémon battle, POKENAME release scorching hot flames from their toothy maw to secure victory. Many develop a certain haughtiness if they win often, so Trainers often give them challenging fights to teach them how to lose gracefully.

entry: 小小的身体几乎容不下内心怒火。每叫一声，就喷出一道烈焰。
author: ozydamians
source: Its small body can hardly contain the rage that burns within. It spouts jets of fire with every chirp.

entry: POKENAME能瞬间切换出击的脚，用带利爪的脚趾迅速撕扯对手。攻击虽然凶猛，节奏却无论什么情况都始终相同。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME can instantly switch the foot it attacks with, rapidly tearing opponents with its sharp-clawed toes. Despite its savageness, its attacks always happen in the same rhythm, no matter the situation.

entry: POKENAME攻击前，脸部的簇毛会燃烧起来，显示敌意。食物总让它们争斗，两只追逐同一猎物时，常会发生冲突。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's facial tufts ignite as a sign of aggression, moments before it goes on the attack. Food is a constant source of competition between specimens, as two often clash while chasing the same prey.

entry: POKENAME将燃烧的尾巴弯到头顶，驱退天敌。它们领地意识极强，谁惹怒它，就想烧谁。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME arcs its flaming tail over its head to ward off predators. They are very territorial and will try to burn anyone that aggravates it.

entry: 四片灵巧翅膀拍得越勤，尾上的红焰就越热。POKENAME会无情攻击任何靠得太近的生物，接近时必须谨慎。
author: fiordaliso
source: The more it flaps its four agile wings, the hotter the red flame on its tail becomes. POKENAME mercilessly attacks any creature that comes too close, so it must be approached with caution.

entry: POKENAME烧出只有从空中才能看清的火线，标记领地。愚蠢地跨过神秘灰痕的人，可能遭到来自头顶的致命袭击。
author: ozydamians
source: POKENAME marks its territory by burning a fire line that can only be seen from the sky. A fool who steps across a mysterious trail of ash is likely to face death from above.

entry: POKENAME天生胆大，常主动挑衅更强的对手。喷火时，攻击的反作用力会把轻巧的身体震退。
author: white_cinnamon50
source: POKENAME are brazen by nature and frequently pick fights with stronger opponents. When unleashing fire, their lightweight bodies are blasted backward by the force of their own attacks.

entry: 它每弹跳一次，就会洒出能点燃附近灌木的小火星。若没有悉心关爱地抚养，POKENAME可能变得顽劣，以放火烧林为乐。
author: fiordaliso
source: With every bounce, it scatters tiny sparks that can ignite nearby bushes. If not raised with care and love, POKENAME may develop a mischievous nature and amuse itself by setting forest fires.

entry: 它化作蓝白火球，以超越声音的速度划过天际。等听见POKENAME尖锐的叫声，猎物早已被利爪贯穿。
author: ozydamians
source: Faster than sound, it blazes across the sky as a blue-white ball of flame. By the time POKENAME's shrill cry is heard, its prey has already been skewered by deadly talons.

entry: POKENAME的羊毛防火，还充满静电。储存的电和热越多，羊毛就越亮。它吼叫时，尾焰会猛地窜高。
author: infinex21
source: Their wool is fireproof and rife with static electricity. POKENAME wool glows as more electricity and heat are stored within. When a POKENAME roars, the flame on its tail will flare up.

entry: POKENAME领地意识强，常为花田与对手打架。战斗掉落的火星可能把花田烧掉，让争斗结果毫无意义。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is territorial and regularly gets into fights with rivals over flower fields. Embers shed from these fights may end up setting the field on fire, rendering the results of the battle moot.

entry: 气温越暖，POKENAME就越暴躁好斗。训练家常学会用冷水喷它，免得太闹腾；温度一降，它就会犯困。
author: sk372
source: The warmer the temperature, the more feisty and combative POKENAME behaves. Trainers often learn to spray it with cold water to keep it from being too rambunctious; the drop in temperature causes it to become drowsy.

entry: POKENAME喜欢给人表演把戏，常被形容为有趣的伙伴。火焰尾巴能同时抛接、烹烤树果，不过必须小心，别点着其他东西。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are often described as amusing to be around because they love to perform tricks for people. Their flaming tails can juggle and cook berries at the same time, but they have to be careful not to set anything else on fire.

entry: 别的宝可梦一使出火之誓约，POKENAME就会发狂。唯一能在酿成太多破坏前让它冷静的方法，就是用冰冷的水浇它。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: If another Pokémon uses Fire Pledge, POKENAME goes berserk. The only way to calm it down before it causes too much damage is to douse it in ice-cold water.

entry: 尾焰的强弱会随夜空月相变化。满月时，火烧得极旺，POKENAME光是擦过植物或灌木，就可能不小心将其点燃。
author: fiordaliso
source: The flame on its tail burns with varying intensity depending on the lunar phase in the night sky. When the moon is full, the fire becomes so fierce that POKENAME may accidentally ignite plants or bushes just by brushing against them.

entry: 尾焰的强弱会随月相变化。无月之夜，POKENAME觉得自己虚弱得无力战斗，会尽一切可能避战。
author: fiordaliso
source: The flame on its tail burns with varying intensity depending on the moon's phase. When the sky is moonless, POKENAME avoids battles at all costs, feeling too weak to fight.

entry: 背上的仙人掌开始开花了。谁想采摘这株仙人掌，都会迎来一份火辣辣的“惊喜”。
author: soup1900
source: The cactus that is on its back has started to bloom. Anyone who tries to harvest this cactus will be met with a fiery surprise.

entry: 随着花苞开始绽放，POKENAME能把太阳能转化为火焰的燃料。它也能直接喷出这种有腐蚀性的燃料，攻击敌人。
author: benevolent
source: With its bulb beginning to bloom, POKENAME can convert solar power into fuel for its flames. It can also spray this corrosive fuel to attack its foes.

entry: POKENAME凶狠好斗，脾气反复无常，一见认定的敌人就会攻击。想要什么，就会竭尽所能弄到手；试图夺走它的东西，是愚蠢的主意。
author: bobosmith01
source: It is a violent and aggressive Pokémon. POKENAME has a volatile temper and will attack what it perceives as foes on sight. If it wants something, it will do everything in its power to get it; trying to take something away from it is a foolish idea.

entry: 它相当傲慢，会用诡异的低语贬低别人。它以他人的痛苦为食，获得能量助燃火焰。
author: kam_doodle_snek
source: It's a rather haughty Pokémon, belittling others with spooky whispers. It feeds on the misery of others, using the energy to fuel its flames.

entry: POKENAME移动时会留下焦痕，很容易据此判断它就在附近。沿背部燃烧的火，一碰到干燥物品就能迅速点燃。
author: mepp.
source: One can easily tell if a POKENAME is nearby because as it moves, it leaves behind scorched trails. The flames along its backside quickly ignite dry objects that it brushes against.

entry: POKENAME不喜欢别人靠近栖居的树。它会扯下部分甲片，用尾巴点燃，再向下掷向入侵者。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME does not take kindly to others coming near the trees it inhabits. It pulls off some of its own plates and ignites them with its tail before flinging them down at the intruders.

entry: POKENAME学习新技能时任性又固执。不少个体一想到训练就抗拒，不过用对零食，就很容易劝动它。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a willful stubbornness when it comes to learning new skills. Many resist the thought of training but are easily swayed by the right snacks.

entry: POKENAME凶狠好斗，脾气反复无常，一见认定的敌人就会攻击。想要什么，就会竭尽所能弄到手；试图夺走它的东西，是愚蠢的主意。
author: bobosmith01
source: It is a violent and aggressive Pokémon. POKENAME has a volatile temper and will attack what it perceives as foes on sight. If it wants something, it will do everything in its power to get it; trying to take something away from it is a foolish idea.

entry: POKENAME常与同类成群掠过草原，靠数量压倒敌对宝可梦。它从不在雨里飞行，怕尾焰被浇灭。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME tends to swarm across grasslands with others of its kind, overwhelming rival Pokémon through sheer numbers. It never flies in the rain, fearing the flames on its tail might be extinguished.

entry: POKENAME荣誉感很强，会挺身保护弱小的宝可梦，免受欺负。战斗认真起来，尾焰就会变得更大。
author: fiordaliso
source: It is a Pokémon with a strong sense of honor, fighting to protect weaker Pokémon from being bullied by others. When POKENAME gets serious in battle, the flame on its tail grows even larger.

entry: POKENAME通过烧毁灌木丛恐吓其他宝可梦。比起吓人，它更喜欢在同类间争夺支配地位，因此有些个体活像暴君。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME terrorize other Pokémon by burning bushes and shrubs. The only thing they love more than scaring others is asserting dominance over each other, leading to a few POKENAME acting like tyrants.

entry: POKENAME激动时，尾焰会猛涨，鼻孔也喷出猛烈火焰，驱赶或解决威胁。它很擅长辨别、追踪气味，因此深受寒冷地区的训练家喜爱。
author: infinex21
source: An agitated POKENAME will flare up its tail flame and snort intense flames to ward off or dispatch threats. POKENAME can distinguish and track scents rather well, so they are popular with Trainers in colder climates.

entry: POKENAME过去曾受军方训练，用燃烧的利爪抓住车辆。如今许多个体生活在自然保护区，把熔穿笼子当作丰富日常生活的活动。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME were once trained by the military to grab onto vehicles with their fiery talons. Many are now a part of nature reserves where they melt through cages as an enrichment activity.

entry: 尾焰消耗大量能量，迫使它不停找食物。发现可吃的东西，就会凶猛扑击，以灼热鳞片缠紧，再用毒牙咬下。
author: baverbrugge
source: The flame on its tail consumes a lot of energy, so it is constantly searching for prey. When it spots something edible it strikes aggressively, constricting with burning scales and biting with venomous fangs.

entry: POKENAME生活在海底火山附近，当地海水常热得让其他宝可梦无法生存。它总寻找极端环境，证明自己最强。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME lives near underwater volcanoes where the ocean is often too hot for other Pokémon to live. It regularly seeks out extreme environments to prove that it's the strongest.

entry: POKENAME住在火山岛岸边，猎食蛋蛋等生物。一发现目标，就会先发出响亮的哔哔声，再射出密集火球。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME lives near the shorelines of volcanic islands, hunting prey such as Exeggcute. Upon spotting one, it lets out a loud beeping noise before unleashing a barrage of fireballs.

entry: 找不到值得一战的对手，POKENAME就会烦躁，训练家可从尾焰的亮度看出。输了战斗，它会试图一直打，直到赢为止。
author: beatdoof
source: POKENAME becomes agitated when it can't find a worthy opponent, which Trainers can detect by how bright its tail's flame is. If it loses a fight, it will try to keep fighting until it wins.

entry: 两只野生POKENAME一相遇，就忍不住竞争，边转圈边用爪互挠。尾焰可能旺得让它们被小而猛烈的火龙卷包围。
author: sk372
source: Two POKENAME that spot each other in the wild cannot resist the urge to compete, spinning and clawing away at each other. The flames on their tails may flare up so strongly that they become engulfed in small and fierce fiery tornadoes.

entry: 它好斗暴躁，一心要当领地的顶级猎手。POKENAME受威胁时会昂身，颈膜如风箱鼓起，大声嘶鸣，牙间噼啪跳着刺鼻的火焰。
author: baverbrugge
source: An aggressive and ornery Pokémon that wants to be the apex predator in its territory. When feeling threatened, POKENAME will rear up, its hood expanding like a bellows, and hiss loudly, acrid flames crackling between its fangs.

entry: POKENAME产出的温热乳汁，能帮助幼年宝可梦入睡。需求十分旺盛，因此它几乎没有停止生产、歇口气的时候。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME produce a warm milk that helps baby Pokémon fall asleep. The high demand for this milk means that POKENAME rarely get a break from production.

entry: POKENAME口袋里冒出的火，温度恰好适合煎炸。它一心想精进厨艺，常会请其他宝可梦品尝。
author: leshii
source: The fire coming from POKENAME's pocket burns at the perfect temperature for frying. Fiercely determined to improve, POKENAME often feed other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME住在干旱气候区，强大火焰在那里最为猛烈。它会用火星点燃洞穴，猎取食物。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME live in arid climates where their powerful flames are strongest. They hunt for food by setting burrows ablaze with embers.

entry: POKENAME身体发育期间会留在原地，直到进化。它能让坚硬外壳来回摇晃，扬起灼热粉尘，烫伤来袭的宝可梦。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME remain in one place while their body develops until they evolve. Their sturdy shell can rock back and forth to kick up searing hot dust, which can burn Pokémon that attack them.

entry: POKENAME的外壳很烫，遭攻击时会扬起粉尘。炽热粉尘能点燃羽毛或皮毛，逼退攻击者。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have hot shells that can kick up dust whenever they are attacked. This searing hot dust can set feathers or fur ablaze and cause their attacker to retreat.

entry: POKENAME先放出烟云遮掩动作，再冲上前咬住猎物。一群个体释放的烟，足以在小片地区遮住沙漠烈日。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME release clouds of smoke to obscure their movements before they rush in to bite down on prey. Groups of POKENAME can release enough smoke to block out the harsh desert sun in a small area.

entry: POKENAME好战，也对自身本领充满信心。为了测试实力，它会穿越时间，挑战处于生命巅峰的强大宝可梦。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is combative and confident in its abilities. To test its prowess, it travels across time to challenge strong Pokémon during the prime of their lifetimes.

entry: POKENAME能把电直接转成热能，也能反向转换，过程几乎不损失能量。这种近乎无缝的能量转换，让它成了能源行业的抢手对象。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME is able to convert electricity directly into thermal energy and vice versa with little loss of energy in the process. This near-seamless conversion between forms of energy has made POKENAME a hot commodity in the energy sector.

entry: POKENAME的鳞片摸起来很热，不过平静时是安全的。一兴奋，鳞片就会升温，接触即可造成一度灼伤。
author: linhasxoc
source: Its scales are hot to the touch, but safe as long as POKENAME is calm. When it gets excited, the scales heat up and cause first-degree burns on contact.

entry: 宽阔的翅膀能借助尾巴升起的热气，让POKENAME轻松浮在空中。被它蜇伤后，灼痛会持续数天。
author: robosoup
source: POKENAME can stay afloat with little effort, as its broad wings catch the hot air rising from its tail. A sting from this Pokémon will burn for days.

entry: POKENAME一边向附近生物胡乱挥爪甩尾，一边撒出尾上的火星，因此被认为极其凶暴。其实，这种爆发是剧烈抽动导致身体失控所致。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME is believed to be extremely violent since it spreads around embers from its tail while wildly slashing with its claws and tail to anyone nearby. This outburst is actually caused by it losing control of its body due to extreme twitchiness.

entry: POKENAME毫无畏惧地挥动烈焰尾巴，击打、驱走可能危害家人或栖树的入侵者。它也细心照料森林树木，清除并烧掉枯死、腐烂的枝条。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME fearlessly uses its blazing tail to smash and drive away intruders who might endanger its family or the tree it lives in. It also cares for the forest trees, removing and burning dead or rotten branches with great attention.

entry: POKENAME会抓挠树干，保持脚爪锋利。它的火尾走到哪里，就把火星撒到哪里。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME scratch tree trunks to keep their talons sharp. Their flaming tail sheds embers wherever they go.

entry: POKENAME的鳞片摸起来很热，不过平静时是安全的。一兴奋，鳞片就会升温，接触即可造成一度灼伤。
author: linhasxoc
source: Its scales are hot to the touch, but safe as long as POKENAME is calm. When it gets excited, the scales heat up and cause first-degree burns on contact.

entry: 随着成长，它产生的火焰越来越热，也更稳定。高温引发爪内的化学反应，让硬度升到几乎与铁相当。
author: linhasxoc
source: As it matures, the fire it creates burns hotter and more consistently. The intense heat causes chemical reactions in its claws, increasing their hardness to nearly that of iron.

entry: 头顶燃烧的火能感知附近人和宝可梦的情绪。若POKENAME察觉某种情绪惹自己生气，火焰就会泛蓝。
author: fiordaliso
source: The flare burning atop its head allows it to sense the emotions of nearby Pokémon and humans. When POKENAME detects emotions that provoke its anger, the flame takes on a bluish hue.

entry: POKENAME与训练家的羁绊日渐加深，火焰也随之增强。许多训练家会先调动自己的兴奋情绪，好帮助它在战斗中进步。
author: quackquackattack
source: The flames of POKENAME grow stronger over time as they bond with their Trainer. Many Trainers mentally prepare themselves to be excited to help POKENAME improve in battle.

entry: POKENAME火焰爪的强度取决于训练家的情绪。训练家越兴奋，火焰就越强。
author: quackquackattack
source: The strength of POKENAME's flaming claws is contingent on their Trainer's temperament. The more excited their Trainer is, the stronger their flames.

entry: POKENAME依赖训练家的信心，获得好好表现的动力。失去这份支持，它的火焰就只剩闷烧的余烬。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME rely on the confidence of their Trainer to give them the motivation to do well. Without this confidence behind them, their flames become smoldering embers.

entry: POKENAME以训练家的活力为火焰供能。若训练家胆怯害怕，火焰便会减弱，它也会变得迟钝。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME rely on their Trainer's energy to fuel their flames. If their Trainer is timid or scared, this weakens their flames and makes them sluggish.

entry: POKENAME的精神力会随着斗志逐渐增强。虽然战斗时通常用精神力控火，必要时它也能同样轻松地用爪攻击。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME's psychic power gradually strengthens with its fighting spirit. Although it usually uses psychic power to control flames in battle, it can just as easily attack with its claws if needed.

entry: 随着成长，它产生的火焰越来越热，也更稳定。高温引发爪内的化学反应，让硬度升到几乎与铁相当。
author: linhasxoc
source: As it matures, the fire it creates burns hotter and more consistently. The intense heat causes chemical reactions in its claws, increasing their hardness to nearly that of iron.

entry: 随着成长，它产生的火焰越来越热，也更稳定。高温引发爪内的化学反应，让硬度升到几乎与铁相当。
author: linhasxoc
source: As it matures, the fire it creates burns hotter and more consistently. The intense heat causes chemical reactions in its claws, increasing their hardness to nearly that of iron.

entry: POKENAME在原生地区是常见的害兽。过去，人们用模仿流水声的响器驱赶它；如今改用扬声器播放类似声音，它便会为了保护尾巴而避开。
author: .fedoraman
source: A common pest in their native region, POKENAME were traditionally warded off with noisemakers mimicking running water. Today, speakers are used to produce similar sounds, which POKENAME avoid to protect their tails.

entry: POKENAME能让全身隐形，唯独腹部燃烧的条纹藏不住。隐形的它曾多次被错认成灌木火而遭扑灭，令它十分恼火。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME are able to render every part of themselves invisible save for the flaming stripe on their stomach. On multiple occasions, an invisible POKENAME has been mistaken for a brushfire and extinguished, leaving them very upset.

entry: 每年夏天，POKENAME会聚在一起，尽可能捕捉虫属性宝可梦，展示自己求偶。猎获最多、最珍稀的个体，在异性眼中最有魅力。
author: _pixelar_
source: Every summer, as a courtship display, a group of POKENAME will gather and catch as many Bug-type Pokémon as they can. The individual with the most and rarest catches is seen as the most attractive to POKENAME of the opposite gender.

entry: POKENAME在楔石周围唤出火焰，保持干燥。火虽然比厨房灶台更热，但楔石只要沾上一点水分，就会消散。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME conjures flames around its keystone to keep it dry. Even though these flames are hotter than a kitchen stovetop, they fade away if any moisture hits its keystone.

entry: POKENAME完全由火构成，会散入束缚自己的煤块，等待伏击。一察觉敌人或对手，煤块便会点燃，它随即冲出攻击。
author: t3isukone
source: POKENAME is made entirely of fire and dissipates into the piece of coal it's bound to, waiting for an ambush. When it senses an enemy or rival, the coal ignites as it bursts out and attacks.

entry: POKENAME住在山巅，守卫领地，抵御所有入侵者。它用钢刺给予重击，口吐烈火。遇上更强的敌人挑战，尾焰就会烧得更旺。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME lives atop mountain peaks, guarding its territory from any intruder. It delivers devastating blows with steel spikes and breathes fierce fire. When challenged by stronger foes, its tail flame burns with even greater intensity.

entry: POKENAME在高山以强烈的自尊守护领地。它口吐熔融般的热息，用金属尖刺攻击，面对强敌时，尾焰会更加明亮。
author: fiordaliso
source: High in the mountains, POKENAME guards its territory with fierce pride. It attacks with molten breath and strikes using metal spikes, its tail flame blazing brighter against powerful foes.

entry: 据说POKENAME的鳞片连最严重的高烧都能治好。不过它脾气暴躁，又会喷火，很难采到这味药材。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME scales are said to cure even the most severe fevers. However, due to its hot temper and fiery breath, it is very hard to collect this remedy.

entry: POKENAME用强壮的尾巴作武器，积极争夺领地和食物。背上的蓝色花苞温度超过1,000摄氏度，训练家接触时务必小心。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME actively fights for territory and food, using its strong tail as an effective weapon. The blue bud on its back reaches temperatures of over 1,000 ℃; trainers are advised to be cautious when handling it.

entry: POKENAME身上的辣椒在阳光下会释放辣味。它常与鸟宝可梦对峙，因为鸟想吃辣椒，它却想猎鸟。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME's chili peppers release their spiciness under the sun. They often face off against bird Pokémon because they want to eat the peppers, while POKENAME wants to hunt them.

entry: 背上的仙人掌一直被火烧着，究竟如何生长至今不明。其中含有多种毒素，不能食用。
author: soup1900
source: It is unknown how the cactus on its back could even grow since it is constantly set ablaze. The cactus contains many toxins that render it inedible.

entry: 以DNA组成为考量，POKENAME竟出奇害羞，在群落中负责简单劳作。它需要训练家鼓励，才肯在战斗中全力以赴。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME are unusually shy, considering their DNA components, and are used for simple labor within their colonies. They need encouragement from their Trainer to give it their all in battles.

entry: POKENAME的大耳朵对声音极其敏感，太吵就会暴怒，尾焰也会凶猛窜高。背上的毒刺浸满毒液，能防范其他宝可梦。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its large ears are extremely sensitive to noise; if there is too much commotion, POKENAME flies into a rage, and the flame on its tail flares menacingly. Its back is covered with venom-soaked spines that serve as protection against other Pokémon.

entry: 脸部铠甲让POKENAME在战斗中无所畏惧。头锤命中时，火势就会沿着尾巴猛涨。
author: bradlybro199
source: The armor on its face makes it fearless in combat. When POKENAME lands a headbutt, the fire it produces flares into larger flames along its tail.

entry: POKENAME群落互相争夺领地，边界变化，巢也得经常搬。常能看见雌性费力抱着大团筑巢材料。
author: .fedoraman
source: Colonies of POKENAME fight each other for territory and must frequently relocate their nests as borders shift. Females are often seen struggling to carry large tangles of nesting material in their arms.

entry: POKENAME背上的毒刺浸满毒液，能防范其他宝可梦。大耳朵对声音极其敏感，太吵就会暴怒，尾焰也会凶猛窜高。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its back is covered with venom-soaked spines that serve as protection against other Pokémon. Its large ears are extremely sensitive to noise; if there is too much commotion, POKENAME flies into a rage, and the flame on its tail flares menacingly.

entry: POKENAME热情又固执，常争夺支配地位。同一群落的个体，只有一起照顾幼崽时，才会暂时放下分歧。
author: .fedoraman
source: POKENAME are impassioned and stubborn Pokémon, frequently vying for dominance. POKENAME in the same colony only put aside their differences to care for the colony's young together.

entry: POKENAME很难传达即将发生的灾难有多紧迫，因此会在人们能看见来临危险的地方点起小火。努力很少获得认可，但只要大家最终平安，它就满足了。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a hard time communicating the urgency of an upcoming disaster, so they light small fires where people can see the incoming danger. They rarely receive credit for their efforts, but they are content if people end up safe.

entry: 这种受激素影响的宝可梦，情绪变动难测，容易毫无来由地破坏。沮丧时，它会用坚硬头部猛撞岛屿，鼻孔喷出的火柱足以焚毁整片森林和村庄。
author: ecstaticwoop64556455
source: This hormonal Pokémon is prone to unpredictable mood swings and senseless destruction. It's been known to ram its hard head into islands when it feels frustrated, expelling jets of flame from its nostrils which can torch entire forests and villages.

entry: 人类聚落的光、热和气味常吸引成群POKENAME。它们燃烧的尾巴，会给当地带来许多苦恼。
author: .fedoraman
source: The light, heat, and smell of human settlements often attracts packs of POKENAME who cause much grief due to their flaming tails.

entry: POKENAME生性叛逆，随时准备大干一架。局面让它不自在时，尾巴就会喷出火焰威吓对方。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME has a rebellious nature and is always up for a fight. If the situation becomes uncomfortable, its tail spews threatening flames.

entry: POKENAME生性叛逆，随时准备大干一架。局面让它不自在时，尾巴就会喷出火焰威吓对方。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME has a rebellious nature and is always up for a fight. If the situation becomes uncomfortable, its tail spews threatening flames.

entry: POKENAME自尊心很强，会与群体中的其他成员竞争。领地争夺战中落败的一方，必须永远离开族群。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME has a strong ego and competes with other members of its group. Whoever loses a territorial battle must leave the group forever.

entry: 这把怨灵附身的战镐一挥就能瞬间熔穿铠甲与血肉，是披甲敌人的克星。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: This haunted war pick instantly melts through armor and flesh in one swing, making it the bane of armored foes.

entry: POKENAME愤怒时，火焰会裹住整片刀刃；平静时则缩小成一簇火苗。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME's flames engulf its whole blade when it is angry, but dwindles to a single flame when it's calm.

entry: POKENAME火气上来时，刀刃状火焰就会伸长增强，切什么都像切黄油一样。平静下来后，火焰又会完全缩小，只剩匕首大小。
author: soup1900
source: When POKENAME becomes hotheaded, the flames that form blade shapes become long and powerful and can slice through anything like butter. If it ever calms down, the flames completely shrink until they become dagger-sized.

entry: POKENAME的叉子能高效解决小型猎物。若必须交战，它会先试着用夹钳限制对手动作，再以叉子攻击。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME's fork can efficiently take down small prey. If a fight is necessary, POKENAME will try to use its tongs to restrain the opponent's movements and then attack with the fork.

entry: POKENAME离巢搜寻树果和其他点心，准备带回去。它相当凶，会用燃烧的毒刺攻击训练家。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME wanders from their nest in search of berries and other treats to bring back. They are quite aggressive and will attack Trainers with a flaming stinger.

entry: POKENAME是这一进化家族中最凶猛的，愤怒咆哮时会迸出火花。
author: supersonicloki
source: As the most ferocious of its family, POKENAME creates sparks when it roars in anger.

entry: POKENAME像暴君般统治其他宝可梦。它会悬在田野上方，要求效忠，命令臣属攻击不服从的宝可梦。
author: tqz7
source: POKENAME rule over other Pokémon like tyrants. They will hover over fields, demand fealty, and order their subjects to attack Pokémon that don't fall in line.

entry: POKENAME的毛能喷出浓烟。它会在烟火中制造恐怖幻象，驱赶入侵者。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME's fur can spray thick smoke. It can create terrifying illusions in the smoke and flames to drive away intruders.

entry: 感知训练家陷入困境时，会迅速焦躁起来。焦躁时，火焰温度会升至平时的近两倍。
author: melodydelune
source: It becomes agitated quickly if it senses its Trainer is in distress. When agitated, its flames burn nearly twice as hot.

entry: POKENAME有一根能同时产生火焰和毒液的特殊角，两者并用，常让猎物措手不及。加上性情凶暴，很少有朋友能容忍它。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a special horn that produces both flames and venom and often surprise their prey when attacking with both. This horn, along with their aggressiveness, give them few friends who tolerate their presence.

entry: 由于性情使然，野生POKENAME数量不多，造成的影响却极大。它狂暴起来无人能及，只有累得倒下才会停歇。
author: .fedoraman
source: Due to their disposition, there are not many POKENAME in the wild, but they make up for it in impact. Their rampages are unmatched, only simmering down once the POKENAME collapses from exhaustion.

entry: POKENAME的火焰明亮，比大多数火属性宝可梦更加断续。它能学会靠火光闪烁传递简单信息，无线电出现以前，曾在战争中用来传递信号。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME's flames are very bright and more intermittent than most other Fire-type Pokémon. POKENAME can be taught to send basic messages through the flickering flames and were used as signals during war prior to radio.

entry: POKENAME极其凶暴，见什么都攻击。除了强大的火与冰之力，爪子还能直接撕开实心钢铁。
author: mcnchsschl_69424
source: POKENAME is very aggressive and will attack anything it sees. Not only does it have strong fire and ice powers, but its claws can tear straight through solid steel.

entry: POKENAME战斗凶狠，不断寻找对手。为战斗兴奋起来，体温会升得炽热，不过这也会让毒的整体效果减弱。
author: quantumradiation
source: POKENAME is a vicious battler, constantly seeking out opponents. In its excitement to battle, it increases its temperature to super-hot levels, but this also causes its poison to become less effective overall.

entry: 会烧毁遗弃自己的主人所有的玩具，以此复仇。拉开脸上的拉链就能喷火。
author: soup1900
source: It exacts its revenge on the owner who disowned it by burning down all of their toys. It breathes fire by opening the zipper on its face.

entry: 这只POKENAME附身了一台烤箱。它用体内火焰迅速烤好点心，不过心烦时，可能会把东西烤焦。
author: hophoppip
source: This POKENAME has possessed an oven. It uses its internal flames to bake treats rapidly, but it may burn them if it's feeling agitated.

entry: POKENAME的翅膀其实全是火，却能像普通四肢一样自如操控。满月下跳舞时，火焰迸出的火星如星辰闪烁。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME's wings are actually just fire, but it has control over these flames as if they were normal limbs. When it dances under the full moon, the sparks produced by its flames twinkle like stars.

entry: POKENAME随风飘着，等待毫无戒备的训练家。一看到目标，就会落到对方头顶，燎焦头发和衣服，再飘走。
author: roundabout_robin
source: POKENAME floats in the wind, waiting for unsuspecting Trainers. When it spots one, it drops down on top of them, singeing hair and clothes before floating away again.

entry: POKENAME会锻炼长时间保持燃烧的耐力，为担任夜间守卫做准备。未能通过的许多个体，会被赠给需要取暖的家庭。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME prepare for their job as night guards by developing the stamina to remain lit for long periods of time. Many who fail are gifted to families who need warmth.

entry: POKENAME会尖刺朝前，跳向对手，毫不留情地攻击。它利用内脏和尾巴发力，把自己弹离地面。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME mercilessly attacks foes by jumping spike-first into opponents. The way it does this is by using its internal organs and tail to launch itself off the ground.

entry: POKENAME极其凶暴，领地意识强，连远比自己大的宝可梦也敢挑衅。两个头分工合作，一个咬住敌人，另一个喷出足以熔石的火柱。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is extremely violent and territorial, picking fights even with Pokémon far larger than itself. Its two heads split the work, one biting down while the other breathes jets of flame hot enough to melt stone.

entry: POKENAME极其凶暴，领地意识强，连远比自己大的宝可梦也敢挑衅。两个头分工合作，一个咬住敌人，另一个喷出足以熔石的火柱。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is extremely violent and territorial, picking fights even with Pokémon far larger than itself. Its two heads split the work, one biting down while the other breathes jets of flame hot enough to melt stone.

entry: POKENAME的尾巴始终燃烧，迫使它不断捕食，维持火焰。它会在暗处挥尾引诱猎物，为愚蠢到上前查看的生物设下烈火伏击。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME tails burn constantly, forcing them to hunt for food to keep their flames alight. They wave their tails in the dark to lure prey toward them, laying a fiery ambush for anyone foolish enough to investigate them.

entry: 长久以来，人们相信，只要心守愿望，吹灭POKENAME三团火中的一团，就能如愿。愿望之说尚未证实，但火焰熄灭后，它确实会休眠多年。
author: infinex21
source: There are longstanding beliefs that if a person holds true to a wish as they blow out one of a POKENAME's three flames, their wish shall be granted. While the matter of wishes is not yet proven, if their flames go out, POKENAME go dormant for years.

entry: POKENAME常被用作守卫，精力充沛地巡逻，一察觉陌生波导，火焰就会窜高。受威胁时，体温升至二百多度，让双倍奉还能熔穿铠甲。
author: ghostslythe
source: Generally used as a guard Pokémon, POKENAME energetically patrols areas, its flames flaring when it senses a new aura. If threatened, its body heats to over two hundred degrees, allowing it to melt through armor with its Counters.

entry: POKENAME身体健康时，尾上的燃烧星星便会烧得更旺。战斗中，它能给牙齿通电，使对手麻痹。
author: fiordaliso
source: The blazing star on its tail burns more intensely when POKENAME is in good health. In battle, it can electrify its teeth to paralyze its opponents.

entry: POKENAME虽然看起来气冲冲的，却极力保护亲近的对象，经常挡在训练家与危险之间。
author: supersonicloki
source: Despite its angry appearance; POKENAME is extremely protective of those close to it, often walking between its Trainer and any threat.

entry: POKENAME的尾巴始终燃烧，迫使它不断捕食，维持火焰。它会在暗处挥尾引诱猎物，为愚蠢到上前查看的生物设下烈火伏击。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME tails burn constantly, forcing them to hunt for food to keep their flames alight. They wave their tails in the dark to lure prey toward them, laying a fiery ambush for anyone foolish enough to investigate them.

entry: 野生POKENAME无法抗拒冲向对手、互相碰撞的冲动。沉重身体相撞后，双方还会贴近喷出烈焰，试图逼对方屈服。
author: sk372
source: In the wild, POKENAME is unable to resist the urge to charge down and clash with rivals. Upon crashing their heavy bodies into each other, two POKENAME then breathe intense flames point-blank to attempt to force the other to submit.

entry: POKENAME高速咬合转动齿轮，制造大股烈焰。激烈的性情驱使它不断追求更猛烈的喷火，丝毫不在意周围遭到的破坏。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME churns its gears together at high speed to create large gouts of flame. Its intense nature drives it to try and create increasingly fiery bursts, indifferent to the damage it causes its surroundings.

entry: POKENAME骑乘的轮子出奇稳定，能用于大胆的特技。有时能见它们结成吵闹的车队，四处寻找麻烦。
author: tqz7
source: The wheels POKENAME ride are surprisingly stable and can be used in daring stunts. They can sometimes be seen driving in noisy gangs, seeking out trouble.

entry: 兴奋时，尾巴上的火焰会变成平时的两倍大。总在寻找对手较量，即使落败也乐在其中。
author: soup1900
source: The flame on its tail doubles in size when it gets excited. It constantly seeks for opponents to fight with and has fun doing so, even if it loses.

entry: 这种宝可梦喜欢吞食愤怒、热情等战斗情绪。吃下的情绪越多，周身火焰就越明亮。
author: dualblades1147
source: This Pokémon loves feeding on the feelings of battle, such as anger and passion. The flames that surround it burn brighter the more emotions it has consumed.

entry: POKENAME产出浓稠、易燃且反应剧烈的凝胶。一团凝胶若沾水，就会爆炸，在明亮闪光中把自身汽化。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME produce a thick, flammable gel that is highly reactive. If a blob of POKENAME gel gets wet, the gel explodes and vaporizes the gel in a bright flash of light.

entry: POKENAME飞行生活在洞窟中，避免尾焰遭恶劣天气侵袭。它先用高频超声波震晕猎物，再以猛烈喷火解决。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME lives flying through caves to protect the flame on its tail from harsh weather. It stuns its prey with high-frequency ultrasounds before finishing them off with powerful blasts of fire.

entry: POKENAME携带的每副面具，都像一只它生前认识的火恐龙。它常哭到深夜，怀念还活着、身体也更强壮的日子。
author: crumple_2
source: Every mask carried by a POKENAME resembles the Charmeleon it knew when it was alive. They are known to weep late into the night, longing for the days when they were alive and physically stronger.

entry: POKENAME干劲十足，会挑战实力远超自己的对手，赢了就得意洋洋。它用燃烧的长牙劈砍岩石训练，斩下的碎片会被徒步者收作幸运符。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is spunky, challenging opponents who far exceed its combat prowess and gloating whenever it wins a fight. It trains with its flaming tusks by slashing at rocks, cutting off shards that are collected by hikers as good luck charms.

entry: POKENAME体内热如锻炉，长牙能在造成伤口时，立即将其烧灼封合。它一犯错就容易懊恼，需要耐心的训练家抚养。
author: pjporwoll
source: The interior of POKENAME's body is as hot as a blacksmith's forge, with its tusks being hot enough to instantly cauterize wounds it inflicts. It gets frustrated easily when it makes a mistake, so it requires a patient Trainer to raise it.

entry: POKENAME是凶猛的鸟类，灼热尾巴会甩向靠得太近的生物，可能留下严重灼痕。格外凶暴的个体，甚至能把尾巴点燃，造成更大伤害。
author: sk372
source: An aggressive avian species, POKENAME's hot tail swings its tail at those that get too close, potentially leaving nasty burn marks. Particularly aggressive POKENAME can even ignite their tail to cause further damage.

entry: 这种POKENAME变体通常在关都林地筑巢，那里是适合它繁盛的理想栖地。发光的尾巴既用于捕猎，也用于对抗敌对宝可梦。
author: fiordaliso
source: This variant of POKENAME typically nests in the wooded areas of Kanto, where it has found the ideal habitat in which to thrive. It uses its glowing tail both to hunt and to battle rival Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME烦躁时，尾上炽热的羽毛会裹上烈焰。它格外喜欢樱子果，因此常在果树附近筑巢。
author: fiordaliso
source: When POKENAME is irritated, the searing feathers on its tail become wrapped in intense flames. It has a great fondness for Cheri Berries, which is why it tends to nest near them.

entry: POKENAME飞过森林时，会留下烟迹，标记领地、吓退对手。红羽即使从翅膀脱落，也能温暖好几个小时。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME leaves trails of smoke as it flies through the forest, marking its territory and warding off rivals. Its red feathers stay warm for hours even after falling from its wings.

entry: POKENAME无论飞到哪里，大张的嘴都会淌下一道道朱红火焰。许多宝可梦争相躲避，可能在洞窟里引发踩踏。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME drool trails of vermillion flames from their gaping mouths wherever they fly. Many Pokémon rush to get out of the way of the flames, which can cause stampedes to occur inside caves.

entry: 迷路的矿工会循着远处微弱的火光，盼着找到地面。可那是POKENAME，正引着他们走向地下更深处。
author: robosoup
source: Lost miners will follow a distant glimmer of torchlight hoping to find the surface, but POKENAME is leading them astray, deeper into the earth.

entry: POKENAME用强壮尾巴推动身体，在地面滚动。撞上敌人时，皮肤已因摩擦地面而烧得赤红，尖刺则能注入灼热的毒。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME uses its powerful tail to roll its body along the ground. When it crashes into a foe, its skin will be red-hot from friction with the ground, and its sharp spines can deliver a burning poison.

entry: POKENAME十分自大，常摇晃鲜橙色叶片挑衅敌人。吸引注意后，它又戏弄般逃跑，沿途留下火星。
author: theaceofhearts0306
source: Due to its large ego, POKENAME often shakes its bright orange leaves to taunt foes. Once it has their attention, it flees teasingly, leaving a trail of embers in its wake.

entry: POKENAME天性充满敌意，谁经过都会遭它低吼。唯有跳舞时，它才能平静下来，全心沉浸在动作中。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME is a naturally hostile creature, growling at any who pass by. Only while dancing does it find peace, its thoughts absorbed in its movements.

entry: POKENAME以坚定守护森林闻名，会破坏砍伐或毁坏景观的企图。它烧除过密植物，让养分重新回到土壤。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME is known to be a staunch protector of forests, sabotaging attempts to cut down or otherwise mar the landscape. It burns away overgrown vegetation to cycle nutrients back into the soil.

entry: POKENAME用大耳朵发出刺耳声音震晕敌人，再以强大的火属性攻击解决。温暖皮毛让它即使住在冰窟里，也不觉得冷。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME emits piercing sounds from its large ears to stun foes before finishing them off with powerful Fire-type attacks. Thanks to its warm fur, it can survive even in icy caves without feeling the cold.

entry: POKENAME的翅膀由纯火构成，产生的上升气流能托它升空。它性情残忍，会欢快唱着歌，俯冲向敌人。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME's wings are made out of pure fire, which cause updrafts that help lift it into the air. It has a merciless disposition, and sings gleefully while it descends upon foes.

entry: POKENAME体温随年龄逐渐升高，岩石部分也越来越耐热。战斗时，它把熔岩溅得到处都是，受伤则能用熔岩治愈自己。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME's body temperature gradually rises with age, and its rocky parts also become more heat-resistant. In battle, it splashes lava everywhere, and when it's injured, it can use its lava to heal itself.

entry: POKENAME全身含有高浓度辣椒素，辛辣滋味让大多数捕食者放弃下口。战斗中，敌人只要被尖刺划伤，就会因辣椒素而痛苦难当。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME's whole body contains a high concentration of capsaicin, and most predators will give it up because of the spicy taste. During a fight, once an enemy is scratched by its spikes, the capsaicin will cause unbearable pain.

entry: POKENAME好斗、残忍又爱炫耀，总迫不及待地展示威吓与力量，让对手心生恐惧。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is aggressive, cruel, and a showboat. It eagerly makes displays of intimidation and strength to strike fear in its opponents.

entry: POKENAME背上的火焰减弱时，菌球就会释放成分复杂的毒孢子。为了防止真菌生长、危及内脏，它会用火压制。
author: oreee0230
source: When POKENAME weakens the flames on its back, the fungal bulbs release complex toxic spores. To prevent the fungi from growing and threatening its organs, POKENAME suppresses them with fire.

entry: POKENAME通过身上的钻石和颈间薄纱般的鬃毛，操控冰与火。吼声能制造像阳光一样明亮温暖的极光。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME commands ice and fire from both the diamonds along its body and the veil-like mane along its neck. Its roar can produce an aurora that shines bright and warm like sunlight.

entry: 进化后，POKENAME对其他宝可梦不再那么友好，常与野生宝可梦无谓争斗。它对训练家依然忠诚，却有时会打同伴，因此很难训练。
author: itsthenewisaiah
source: After evolving, POKENAME becomes less friendly toward other Pokémon, often picking unnecessary fights with wild Pokémon. Its loyalty to its Trainer remains strong, but it sometimes fights ally Pokémon, making it difficult to train.

entry: POKENAME普遍脾气暴躁，如今不肯与任何宝可梦相处，连同一训练家的伙伴也不例外。幸好进化之后，它也更懂得克制了。
author: itsthenewisaiah
source: The average temper of a POKENAME is short. This Pokémon now refuses to get along with any Pokémon, including those owned by its own Trainer. Thankfully, it shows more restraint now that it has evolved.

entry: POKENAME整夜嚎叫，吸引值得一战的对手。它从嘴里喷出灼热火舌，威吓其他生物。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME spends the entire night howling to draw in worthy opponents. From its jaws it breathes scorching tongues of fire to intimidate others.

entry: POKENAME的真菌部分支配身体，提供养分和行动能力。面对威胁，宿主身体能产生火焰，借易燃孢子驱退敌人。
author: oreee0230
source: The fungal part of POKENAME dominates its body, providing nutrition and mobility. When it faces a threat, its host body can produce flames, using flammable spores to fend off enemies.

entry: POKENAME以光为能量，连完全真空中也能生火。自燃会灼烧沿途一切，它又能从自己燃起的火焰吸收光。
author: quackquackattack
source: Fueled by light, POKENAME have the ability to produce flames in a complete vacuum. This spontaneous combustion sears everything in their path, absorbing light from the burning flames they produce.

entry: POKENAME用尾巴敲击头冠，将其点燃。尾部大鳞片中一种新发现的化合物，让尾焰始终燃烧。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME lights its head crest by striking it with its tail. Its tail flame constantly burns due to a newly discovered compound in its tail's large scale.

entry: POKENAME先发出可怕吼声宣泄愤怒，再用火拳猛打树木。每次发脾气后，手臂鳞片都会脱落，因导热性极佳，热衷工艺的匠人会将其制成锅具。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME release a terrifying shout to vent anger before punching trees with their fiery fists. The scales covering their arms are shed after each tantrum, and are molded into pots and pans by avid craftsmen due to their high heat conductivity.

entry: 战斗前，它会跳仪式舞，让炽热的身体鳞片叮当作响，吓唬敌人。虽然火焰强大，POKENAME更喜欢靠格斗属性招式的蛮力。
author: fiordaliso
source: Before a battle, it performs a ritual dance, making the scorching scales on its body jingle to intimidate its foes. Despite its strong flames, POKENAME prefers to rely on the brute strength of its Fighting-type moves.

entry: POKENAME白天游荡在辣椒田，融入所模仿的鲜艳植物中。夜里尾巴太亮，难以捕猎，它只好把尾巴藏在附肢下，暂时暴露防御空隙。
author: puppylev
source: POKENAME stalks chili pepper farms during the day, thriving in the brightly colored plants it mimics. It struggles to catch prey at night due to its bright tail, so the tail gets tucked under its appendages, leaving POKENAME temporarily vulnerable.

entry: POKENAME头上的辣椒辣得能损伤食用者的口腔。即便如此，POKENAME口味的薯片仍是许多人最爱的零食。
author: .realthree
source: The peppers that grow on POKENAME's head are so spicy that they have been known to cause damage to the mouths of those who eat it. Despite that, POKENAME-flavored chips are still a favorite snack of many.

entry: POKENAME身上的辣椒容易让人类过敏，因此很少用于烹饪。饲养它的训练家最好戴手套，并避免揉眼睛。
author: .realthree
source: The peppers that grow on POKENAME are rarely used for culinary purposes because they tend to trigger allergic reactions in humans. Trainers that are raising a POKENAME are advised to wear gloves and avoid touching their eyes.

entry: POKENAME的辣椒虽然不太辣，却含有一种能让接触物升温的化合物。摄入太多，可能引起体内燃烧。
author: .realthree
source: Though POKENAME's peppers aren't very spicy, they contain a compound that causes the temperature of matter it makes contact with to rise. Consuming too much of this substance can lead to internal combustion.

entry: 若喂它树枝，耳中的烈火就会窜成鲜蓝色。POKENAME性情难以相处，却是十分受重视的宝可梦伙伴。
author: .realthree
source: The fire blazing from this Pokémon's ears flares a vivid blue if it is fed sticks. POKENAME has a difficult disposition to deal with, but it is highly valued as a Pokémon partner.

entry: POKENAME尾巴里那根奇特棍子，需要很高热量才能燃烧。即使没有火，碰上也会严重烫伤，因此是它绝佳的武器。
author: .realthree
source: It takes a lot of heat for the odd stick in POKENAME's tail to combust. Even when it's not flaming, the stick can cause severe burns when touched, so it makes an excellent weapon for POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME天生独来独往。练习火焰攻击时，它会站在最高处，让附近所有生物都看见，警告大家别靠近。
author: .realthree
