source: POKENAME are solitary creatures by nature. When they practice their fiery attacks, they stand on the highest point so that everyone nearby can see the display and be warned to stay away.

entry: POKENAME火焰产生的烟会聚在颈部。想隐藏行踪时，烟就能扩散，遮住动作。
author: .realthree
source: The smoke emitted by POKENAME's fire gathers around its neck. When it wishes to hide its presence, this smoke can expand to conceal its movements.

entry: POKENAME试图悄悄溜过却被发现时，会从围巾里喷出猛烈热浪和浓烟，扰乱敌人。
author: .realthree
source: If POKENAME is discovered as it attempts to sneak by, it confounds its foes with a blast of blistering heat and smoke from its scarf.

entry: POKENAME每个动作，都伴随膝肘处爆发的烟雾。它借浓烟遮住视线，朝茫然的对手发起稳准的攻击。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME's every movement is accompanied by explosive blasts of smoke from its knees and elbows. It uses the blinding cover of this haze to strike with absolute surety against its bewildered opponent.

entry: POKENAME猛撞对手前，会先让壳和尾巴里的火烧得更旺。激动时，它以惊人速度向空中喷出滚烫白烟，数英里外都看得见。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME will burn the fires in its shell and tail more intensely before aggressively tackling an opponent. When agitated, it spouts hot, white smoke at a tremendous velocity into the air that can be seen from miles away.

entry: POKENAME蜕皮时，下方的新皮会受到刺激，让它心情糟糕。在蜕完之前，谁靠近它都会挨打。
author: .realthree
source: When POKENAME sheds its skin, it irritates the fresh layer underneath, putting this Pokémon in a bad mood. It will attack anyone who approaches until it can complete its molt.

entry: POKENAME快速旋转、从身体各尖端喷火时，能造成大范围破坏，因为周围东西会迅速起火，并把火势蔓延开。
author: fireblade141
source: If POKENAME starts spinning rapidly while spewing flame from each of the points on its body, it is capable of causing extensive damage due to how quickly things around it can catch and spread fire.

entry: 融合能量唤醒了它的龙之基因。性情极为残忍，会将看见的任何人烧成灰烬，连自己的训练家也不例外。
author: soup1900
source: Fusion energy has awakened its draconic genes. It is extremely ruthless and will incinerate anyone it sees, including its own Trainer.

entry: POKENAME能用地下燃烧的根系火灾，烧毁整片森林。它必须不断移动，免得脚下土壤太热。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are capable of setting whole forests ablaze with root fires that burn underground. They are forced to keep moving to prevent the soil beneath them from getting too hot.

entry: POKENAME从背上喷火，热情地追逐相爱的情侣。情侣以为它想攻击、消灭自己，便拼命游走。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME blasts flames from its back to passionately chase after loving couples. The couples, thinking this Pokémon is trying to attack and destroy them, swim furiously away from it.

entry: POKENAME不停移动，防止引发根系火灾。只有身上的火已冷却到不会点燃附近植物，它才会休息。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are constantly on the move to prevent root fires from occurring. They only rest when the flames on their body are cool enough not to light nearby plants on fire.

entry: 夜里，POKENAME从沙下挥动发光尾巴交流。信号横越沙漠，数英里外也能看见。
author: .izik
source: At night, POKENAME lashes their glowing tails from beneath the sand to communicate. The signals can be seen for miles across deserts.

entry: POKENAME常作保安的伙伴。火光让它在夜间十分好用，它还拥有感知大量金钱的奇异能力，有助于发现窃盗。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are commonly used companions for security guards. The light their flame gives off makes them useful Pokémon to have at night, and they have an uncanny ability to sense large volumes of money, helping to detect theft.

entry: 不服管束的POKENAME会在光天化日下扑向旅人抢劫。它们总因傲慢而招惹打不过的对手，最终自食其果。
author: robosoup
source: Unruly POKENAME will pounce on travelers to rob them in broad daylight. Their arrogance is their downfall, as they pick fights they cannot win.

entry: POKENAME身体能像燃煤般烫人，防止别人碰脏它引以为傲的毛发。它天性孤僻，喜欢独居在山路边隐蔽的洞窟。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME's body can scald like burning coal, preventing others from touching and dirtying the fur it takes pride in. Since it is a solitary creature, it prefers to dwell alone in caves hidden along mountain trails.

entry: POKENAME常头痛，因此很容易生气。它会打喷嚏喷出火星，试图缓解头部压力。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are quick to anger because of the frequent headaches they experience. They sneeze out embers in an attempt to ease the pressure in their head.

entry: POKENAME头痛时，会暂时放空思绪，释放破坏性的精神能量。破坏难以预测，大多数宝可梦都想离它远些，连同类也不例外。
author: oreee0230
source: When POKENAME has a headache, it temporarily clears its mind to release destructive psychic energy. Its unpredictable destructiveness causes most Pokémon to try to get away from it, even its own kind.

entry: POKENAME泳技高超，能迅速穿过水域，尾巴却不会湿。流线身体与有蹼的鳍，让它在水中轻松滑行。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are adept swimmers that can zip through water without getting their tails wet. Their sleek bodies and webbed fins allow them to easily glide through the water.

entry: POKENAME靠带蹼的爪子优雅快速地游泳，不会把水溅到尾巴上。若水太冷，它便浮上来喷出一股火焰，把水加热。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME gracefully glide through the water with their webbed claws that allow them to swim quickly without splashing water onto their tail. If the water gets too cold for them, they surface to breathe out a burst of flames that heats up the water.

entry: POKENAME生气时，尾焰热得泛蓝。为了不把火气撒在别人身上，它会踢大石头或石墙泄愤。
author: fiordaliso
source: When angered, the flame on POKENAME's tail becomes so hot it turns bluish. To avoid lashing out at others, it vents its frustration by kicking large boulders or stone walls.

entry: POKENAME很容易生气，也很少放下仇怨。一找到曾冒犯自己的家伙，就会挥出火拳报复。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are quick to anger and rarely let go of grudges. If they find someone who has slighted them, they unleash fiery punches to get even.

entry: POKENAME通常住在火山附近，朱红色毛发能融入环境。它是凶猛的伏击猎手，会用利爪和火尾扑向猎物。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME typically live near volcanoes where their cinnabar-colored fur blends in with the environment. They are ferocious ambush hunters and pounce on prey with their sharp claws and flaming tail.

entry: POKENAME以强大的吼声恐吓对手，连周围空气都为之震动。火焰极其强盛，不到一分钟便能熔化金属墙。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME intimidates its opponents by letting out roars so powerful they make the air around it vibrate. Its flames are incredibly strong and can melt metal walls in less than a minute.

entry: POKENAME的尾巴比未融合的火恐龙更长、更有力。为了高速移动时维持平衡，它常四脚着地奔跑。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME has a longer, stronger tail than unfused Charmeleon. To keep its balance while moving fast, it tends to run on all fours.

entry: 据说POKENAME与超级喷火龙X有许多相似之处。它为何、又是如何变成这副模样，目前仍不清楚。
author: daimposter_60614
source: POKENAME is said to have many similarities to Mega Charizard X. It is currently unknown how or why POKENAME looks like this.

entry: POKENAME的翅膀较弱，只能短途飞行。不过吸热能力很好，能用太阳能量大幅增强火焰攻击，并促进成长。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME's wings are weak and capable only of short flights. They absorb heat well, using the sun's energy to supercharge POKENAME's fire attacks and boost its growth.

entry: 先用巨尾猛击对手，再凶狠地将其焚毁。没有翅膀，行动缓慢，走起路来常重重跺脚。
author: soup1900
source: It slams its large tail onto opponents before viciously incinerating them. Due to its lack of wings, it moves slowly and often stomps while walking.

entry: POKENAME任性好斗，渴望与其他宝可梦交战。这种性情不适合新手训练家，不过多变的战斗方式，仍使它成为热门选择。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are wilful and aggressive Pokémon, eager to get into battle with others. Their aggressive personality makes them ill-suited to novice Trainers, but their versatile fighting style nonetheless makes them popular choices.

entry: POKENAME身上炽热的蓝色铠甲，能增强控火能力。少了它，身体连维持睡眠所需的温暖都办不到。
author: .realthree
source: The heated blue armor affixed to POKENAME augments its pyrokinesis powers. Without it, it would be unable to even keep itself warm enough to sleep.

entry: POKENAME会用燃烧的爪子捶打树木，直到疲惫，以此训练。练上一整天、身体酸痛后，它喜欢吃几颗树果恢复。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME train by punching trees with their flaming claws until they get tired. When they are sore after a long day of training, they enjoy munching on a few berries to recover.

entry: POKENAME的怒气日积月累，会变得易怒，对训练家也充满敌意。经验不足的训练家饲养时务必谨慎，确保它经常有机会宣泄烦闷。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME builds up anger over time, causing it to become irritable and aggressive towards its Trainer. Inexperienced Trainers are advised to be careful when raising a POKENAME, and to make sure it regularly has a chance to vent its frustrations.

entry: POKENAME战斗不只依靠身体力量。下方手臂近身搏斗时，上方手臂会喷火、投出火球，打对手一个措手不及。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME do not rely solely on their physical strength in a fight. While their lower arms engage in close-quarters combat, the upper arms wield blasts of flame and fireballs that catch their opponent unaware.

entry: 背甲上燃烧着熊熊烈火，因此露营者常把POKENAME当作篝火。
author: soup1900
source: The back of its shell sports a huge fire. Because of this, POKENAME is often used by campers as a campfire.

entry: 它用火焰鞭把摩鲁蛾引到嘴边，再烤熟吃掉。POKENAME甩鞭时，也常不小心烧到自己。
author: tqz7
source: It uses its flaming whip to attract Venomoth towards its mouth and then roast them. POKENAME often burns itself while whipping it around.

entry: POKENAME嘴里的液体虽然温度与熔岩相近，却仍是消化液，并非熔岩。它用体热引诱猎物，等目标靠近，就靠喷火起飞捕猎。
author: oreee0230
source: Although the temperature is similar, the liquid in POKENAME's mouth is still digestive juice, not lava. This POKENAME uses its body heat to lure prey and then takes off with flames to hunt when they get close.

entry: POKENAME通过火焰调节体温，加快代谢以发动攻击。触手上的爪子虽强，主要武器仍是毒素。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME controls its body temperature through flames and speeds up its metabolism to launch attacks. Although its clawed tentacles are strong, its main weapon is still its toxins.

entry: POKENAME头上的宝石有眼状结构，能监视来自上方的威胁。必要时，它能靠火焰飞起，在空中抓捕猎物。
author: oreee0230
source: The gem on POKENAME's head has an eye-like structure, so it can watch for threats from above. When needed, POKENAME can fly with flames and catch prey in the air.

entry: POKENAME控火能力极佳，能用火把钢塑成工具零件，也能焊合剪刀、钳子等工具的接合处。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME has a superb level of control over fire, which it uses to form steel into tool parts. It can also fuse joints of tools together, such as shears or pliers.

entry: POKENAME能把钢折成需要的形状。火焰可以对金属进行热处理，再将其组装为钳子、剪刀等工具。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can fold steel to whatever shape it needs to be. Its fire can heat treat metal, which is assembled into tools such as pliers or shears.

entry: POKENAME耐热又强壮，能轻松加工金属，是金属工艺的重要帮手。它为热处理金属的炉子供火，也能用手臂把钢锻成锤头和其他工具零件。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME is an essential part of metalworking, as its heat resistance and strong build make manipulating metal easy. It fuels furnaces that provide heat treatment to metal and its arms can strike steel into hammer heads and other tool parts.

entry: POKENAME奔过草地时，会互相超越。它十分保护群体，发现威胁就会喷火。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME gallop past each other as they run through fields of grass. They are protective of their pack and are known to shoot flames at threats.

entry: POKENAME无论对战还是竞速，只在乎获胜。若训练太久不休息，火焰鬃毛就有熄灭风险，因此必须悉心照顾。
author: fiordaliso
source: The only thing POKENAME cares about is winning, whether it is a battle or a race. Its fiery mane risks going out if it trains for too long without resting, so it must be handled with attention.

entry: POKENAME尾巴分泌甜黏的液体，火焰帮助香气扩散，吸引小型猎物。虽然爪子锋利，反应迟缓却让捕猎效率极低。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME's tail secretes a sweet, sticky liquid, and the flames help spread the scent, attracting small prey. Even though it has sharp claws, its slow reactions make POKENAME's hunting extremely inefficient.

entry: POKENAME战斗时以壳为轴旋转，卷起利爪与火焰的旋风。POKENAME背壳的焦痕，正是历经战斗的骄傲印记。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME spin themselves on their shell during battle, creating a whirlwind of claws and fire to attack. The burn marks around the back of a POKENAME's shell is a sign of pride after many battles.

entry: POKENAME尾上的火从壳末端喷出，免得烤到自己。它虽能用火属性招式捕猎，却几乎不瞄准，也很少命中。
author: oreee0230
source: The flame on POKENAME's tail shoots out from the end of its shell to avoid roasting itself. Although POKENAME can use fire-type moves to hunt, it hardly ever aims and rarely hits.

entry: POKENAME会在体育赛事上转动棒子，为自己的队伍助威。棒子怕潮，因此下雨时它不会表演。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME twirls its batons during sporting events to cheer for its team. It will not perform when it is raining because the baton is sensitive to moisture.

entry: POKENAME喷火，在冰川中开凿巢穴。隧道极其光滑湿滑，除了同族，谁都很难在里面穿行。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME unleashes bursts of fire to carve out dens within glaciers. These tunnels are extremely smooth and hard to navigate by anyone other than its kin due to how slippery they become.

entry: 背上有两具喷火器，通常只喷出近距离的火焰。愤怒时，火焰却能喷出十多英尺远。
author: soup1900
source: This Pokémon has two flamethrowers on its back that expel short-range flames. When angered, though, the flames can reach a distance of over ten feet.

entry: 古老神话中，POKENAME破壳而出，象征晨星诞生，一道炽热身影显现在海岸。
author: tqz7
source: In older mythology, POKENAME emerging from its shell symbolizes the birth of a morning star, a blazing presence appearing at the shore.

entry: POKENAME喜欢点燃人们的衣服、头发之类的东西，故意找麻烦。即使把火扑灭，也可能几周后再次燃起。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME loves to antagonize people by setting things like their clothes or hair on fire. Even if you put out the flames, they have a chance of reigniting weeks later.

entry: 深夜里，POKENAME喜欢用尾巴引来旅人，故意带进更像迷宫的荒野。周围空气温暖，它的身体摸起来却始终冰冷。
author: npshi
source: In the dead of night, POKENAME enjoy using their tails to draw in travellers, to purposely misguide them into a more maze-like wilderness. The air around POKENAME is warm, unlike their bodies, which are consistently cold to the touch.

entry: POKENAME在火山地带附近钻地掘洞。吃下只有当地才有的矿物质后，火焰会烧得最热。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME tunnels underground near volcanic regions. Its flames burn hottest after feeding on  minerals only found in this environment.

entry: POKENAME在热带海湾大量群聚，吃潮水冲上岸的海草和珊瑚。它会让火钳猛燃，吓退入侵者，觉得有危险就会凶狠出击。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME swarms tropical bays with large groups, feeding on seaweed and corals washed ashore by the tide. It flares up its fiery pincers to ward off intruders, striking fiercely if it feels endangered.

entry: POKENAME只住在温暖海域的岸边，较冷的水会让它冬眠。战斗时，它点燃强大双钳，毫不留情地灼烧、夹住、碾碎猎物。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME lives only along the shores of warm seas, as colder waters would drive it into hibernation. To fight, it ignites its mighty pincers and uses them to scorch, seize, and crush its prey without mercy.

entry: POKENAME背着一团格外肥沃的土，能大幅加速植物生长。因此农场和宝可梦培育屋常请它帮忙，用土促进种子、花卉和树果生长。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME carries a clump of especially fertile soil on its back that can greatly accelerate the growth of plants. For this reason, it is often used in farms and Pokémon Daycares so that its soil can help seeds, flowers, and berries grow.

entry: POKENAME在土中一点点前进，寻找根系和植物残屑吃。身后留下翻得松软的土壤。
author: fancyskunk
source: POKENAME inch through the ground in search of roots and plant debris to eat. They leave well-tilled soil in their wake.

entry: POKENAME的大鼻子对触碰很敏感。训练家若未经允许就摸，它会恼得钻进地下，不肯听命令。
author: quackquackattack
source: The large nose of a POKENAME is sensitive to the touch. If a Trainer touches their nose without permission, they will burrow underground and refuse to obey orders out of frustration.

entry: POKENAME挖出化石，用作铠甲和武器。它挥骨头如挥钉头锤，连最坚硬的岩石也能击碎。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME dig up fossils in order to use them as armor and weapons. They swing their bones like a mace, capable of crushing even the strongest rocks.

entry: POKENAME挖出化石，用作铠甲和武器。它挥骨头如挥钉头锤，连最坚硬的岩石也能击碎。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME dig up fossils in order to use them as armor and weapons. They swing their bones like a mace, capable of crushing even the strongest rocks.

entry: POKENAME对健康生态至关重要。钻洞能把表土养分带到地下深处，让大型植物扎下深根。生态学家视庞大种群为环境健康的好迹象。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are vital for a healthy ecosystem; their burrowing pulls nutrients down from the topsoil deeper into the ground, enabling large plants to grow deep roots. Ecologists view large populations as a good sign that the environment is healthy.

entry: POKENAME用硬化的泥和黏土筑茧。茧的颜色，会随栖居地土壤成分而变化。
author: fancyskunk
source: POKENAME form their cocoons with hardened mud and clay. They are known to vary in color depending on the soil contents of their regions.

entry: POKENAME用角钻进河床，便能沿河前进，不必对抗水流。角硬如铁，能轻松钻破石头。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME will drill into the riverbed with their horn, allowing them to follow the river without fighting against the current. Their horn is as hard as iron, able to easily break through stone.

entry: POKENAME到花间进食时，翅膀会沾上种子。之后，这些种子落进它挖掘时翻松的土里。
author: fancyskunk
source: The wings of a POKENAME pick up seeds from the flowers it feeds on. These seeds later drop off into the well-tilled soil it creates while digging.

entry: POKENAME快速旋转，飞快钻过泥土。挖得够快，甚至能把自己弹到好几层楼高的空中。
author: camtft
source: POKENAME spin rapidly to dig through the ground quickly. They are able to launch themselves multiple floors up into the air when digging fast enough.

entry: POKENAME藏在地下，留心听是否有训练家声音悲伤。一发现，就会钻出地面，送对方一个气球。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME hides in the ground, listening for any Trainers who sound sad. If it spots one, it will pop out of the ground and give them a balloon.

entry: POKENAME手上的钩子是绝佳的挖掘工具。它挖的洞又大又多，还常不小心把地下宝可梦也挖出来，得罪对方。
author: sk372
source: The hooks on POKENAME's hands make excellent tools for digging. The holes it digs up are large and numerous, often running afoul of Pokémon living underground as it accidentally digs them up as well.

entry: 说到电线、电缆，POKENAME是熟练的电工。电工常请它帮忙，修理深埋地下的线路。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME are skilled electricians when it comes to wires and cables. They are often used by electricians to help fix wiring that is deep underground.

entry: POKENAME极其讨厌寒冷，在冷地方遇到的野生个体，几乎肯定是迷路了。头上的角能旋转清土，也能互相靠拢，牢牢夹住东西。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME strongly dislikes the cold, so wild ones who are in chilly areas have most certainly gotten lost. They have horns atop their heads that can both rotate and clear dirt, as well as move closer together to grip something tight.

entry: POKENAME极其讨厌寒冷，在冷地方遇到的野生个体，几乎肯定是迷路了。它不像地鼠那样合群。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME strongly dislikes the cold, so wild ones who are in chilly areas have most certainly gotten lost. They are not as social as Diglett.

entry: 徒步者走进这些宝可梦的领地时，务必避免打扰。它们会成群猛冲出地面，奔向惊扰自己的东西。
author: santon5512
source: Hikers must be careful not to disturb these Pokémon when walking through their territory. They will come barreling out of the ground in herds, charging toward whatever has disturbed them.

entry: POKENAME头上的角能在深入地下挖掘时，破开硬岩。尾上的角则主要用于自卫。
author: bagumbothimble
source: The horn on a POKENAME head helps it break up hard rock as it digs deep underground. The horn on its tail is used primarily for self-defense.

entry: POKENAME通常对别人戒心很强，训练家很难与它建立感情。一旦成功，它就会在家中帮些小忙，或躲进房屋的通风处。
author: distinguishedmanlygentleman
source: POKENAME is usually very suspicious of others, making it hard for trainers to bond with it. If a trainer does manage to bond with POKENAME, it can be found performing small tasks around their trainer's house, or hiding in their home's ventilation.

entry: 农夫常让POKENAME变成各种园艺工具，在大片土地上锄草、翻土、种植。不过它只能在夜里维持变形，白天身体过热，就无法稳定。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME are often transformed by farmers into different gardening tools to hoe, till, and plant on large dirt patches. However, they can only keep up these transformations at night; during the day, their bodies become too hot to stay stabilized.

entry: POKENAME能凭空造出完美的石立方体，在建筑业极有用。不过它非常护着坐着的那块石头，谁都不许碰。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME has become incredibly useful in construction due to its ability to create perfect stone cubes out of thin air. However, it is overly protective over the block it sits on and doesn't let anyone touch it.

entry: 只有遇到其他POKENAME丢下的更大外壳时，才能看见它离壳。身体柔软脆弱，稍有危险迹象，它便缩回坚硬壳中。
author: sk372
source: The only time POKENAME is seen outside of its shell is when it comes across a larger shell discarded by another POKENAME. Its body is rather soft and weak, so it retreats into its sturdy shell at the slightest sign of danger.

entry: POKENAME大部分时间待在地下。难得决定飞到地面上方时，也会用精神力把几团泥石留在身边，给自己一点心灵慰藉。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME spends much of its time underground. On the rare occasions it decides to fly above ground, it keeps a few clumps of dirt and stone near it with psychic powers as emotional support.

entry: POKENAME挖地和飞行都不算擅长，却有足够坚定的决心，仍能在野外生存。
author: abiapollo
source: While POKENAME is not especially adept at digging nor flying, it approaches both with enough determination to still be able to survive in the wild.

entry: POKENAME四肢不明显，是进化形成的特征，让它能毫不费力地扭过最狭窄的地下隧道。
author: kiwiarms
source: POKENAME's lack of prominent limbs is an evolutionary development that allows it to wriggle through the tightest of subterranean tunnels without issue.

entry: 温暖季节，POKENAME会定期脱落实心石羽。过去，农夫把这些弃羽当铲子，更轻松地挖土。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME regularly sheds solid stone feathers during the warm seasons. In the past, farmers would use these discarded feathers as spades to more easily dig into soil.

entry: POKENAME成群飞过天空，寻找合适的土壤筑巢。若有个体落单，就会去最近的农场，加入当地干活的地鼠群。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME move in swarms through the sky as they seek out suitable soil to make nests in. If one gets separated from the swarm, that POKENAME will find the nearest farm and join that colony of Diglett workers.

entry: POKENAME准备强力攻击时，会用触角判断对手位置。时机一到，它就跃出地面，使出强大的真气拳。
author: dodoowner_
source: It uses its antennae to determine where its opponent is while it prepares a strong attack. When the timing is right, POKENAME leaps out of the ground and unleashes a powerful Focus Punch.

entry: POKENAME挖出的隧道是小昆虫的安全乐园，可以自由通行。换成别的东西，它就会冒出地面，送上一连串狠拳。
author: sk372
source: Tunnels dug up by POKENAME are a safe haven for small insects, free to travel through them as they please. Anything else sees POKENAME pop up from the ground to deliver a punishing series of punches.

entry: POKENAME会建立庞大的地下隧道网，里面布满蛛网。它不断巡视，耐心等有什么落入网中。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME creates a large network of underground tunnels filled with many webs. It will constantly patrol its tunnels, patiently waiting for something to get trapped in its webs.

entry: POKENAME飞累了，会用喙和爪挖出休息处。为了给蛋造地下巢，它会挖得格外深，一直守到孵化。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses its beak and claws to dig out spots to rest in when tired from flying. It digs particularly deep holes to create subterranean nests for its eggs, which it guards continuously until they hatch.

entry: POKENAME常钻在地下睡觉。有些训练家见过大群个体紧紧偎在一起，研究者推测，它们是在发电。
author: daimposter_60614
source: POKENAME can often be found burrowed in the ground, sleeping. Some Trainers have seen large groups of POKENAME cuddling together, generating electricity, as researchers suggest.

entry: POKENAME翻过的土富含星尘，带着夜空中的丰富矿物。在这种肥土地区，岩石属性和草属性宝可梦都能茁壮生活。
author: lydiaprower8
source: Soil that is tilled by POKENAME is filled with stardust, which is rich in minerals from the night sky. Rock-type and Grass-type Pokémon have been known to thrive areas with this enriched soil.

entry: 每天早晨，太阳初升，POKENAME就会钻出地面观看。它整天保持这姿势，寸步不动，直到日落才把自己埋好过夜。
author: santon5512
source: Every morning, as the sun begins to rise, POKENAME will emerge from the ground and watch. They remain like this for the entire day, not moving an inch until the sun sets, when they will bury themselves for the night.

entry: POKENAME一钻出地面，便立刻从额头宝石放出刺目闪光，震慑可能危害自己的生物。巢里常堆着收藏的雷之石。
author: sk372
source: When POKENAME pops above ground, it immediately lets loose a blinding flash from the gem on its forehead, stunning anything that might be a potential danger to itself. POKENAME dens often house hoarded Thunder Stones.

entry: POKENAME白天随微风轻轻飘荡，吸收阳光。入夜后，它降到地面挖洞睡觉，只把叶片留在地上。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME floats around lightly with the breeze during the day, absorbing sunlight as it does so. When night falls, it lowers itself to the ground and digs itself a hole to sleep in, with only its leaves poking above the ground.

entry: POKENAME大部分时间在地下挖根吃。想吃甜食时，就会钻出地面，飞过森林，寻找甜美树果。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME spend much of their time underground, where they dig up roots to eat. When they have a craving for something sweet, they emerge from the ground and fly around forests searching for sweet berries to consume.

entry: POKENAME常钻进屋里，在地板下或墙中安家。人们因此常养喵喵，防止它们入侵。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME often burrow into houses, making their homes beneath floorboards or in walls. Meowth are often kept in homes in order to keep these Pokémon at bay.

entry: 它会沿直线一连挖行数英里，身后留下碎屑。建筑工人已训练它沿道路挖沟，预防洪水。
author: quackquackattack
source: It is known to dig and meander for miles at a time in a straight line, leaving a trail of debris behind it. Construction workers have trained it to dig a ditch alongside roads to prevent flooding.

entry: 白天，POKENAME会把其他野生宝可梦的巢弄塌进自己的洞，洗劫储粮。夜里，它们聚在一起，分享来路不正的零食。
author: quackquackattack
source: During the day, POKENAME raid the food stores of other wild Pokémon by collapsing nests into their burrows. At night, groups of POKENAME gather together to share their ill-gotten snacks.

entry: POKENAME背上宝石般的果实会剧烈脉动，再放出土色粉末。粉末能催眠，让它用藤蔓把猎物拖入地下。
author: .izik
source: The gemstone-like fruit on POKENAME's back pulses violently before releasing a soil-colored powder. The powder induces sleep, allowing it to drag prey underground with its vines.

entry: 没人知道POKENAME拿来当诱饵的雕像从何而来，有人因此怀疑它天然形成。地质学家可不满意这说法。
author: kiwiarms
source: Nobody knows the origin of the statue POKENAME uses as a decoy, leading some to suspect that it formed naturally. Geologists aren't happy with this theory.

entry: POKENAME的爪子极擅挖土，是建筑工人常见的伙伴。工作间隙，常能见它拿挖出的泥土当零嘴。
author: sk372
source: With claws highly adept at digging through dirt, POKENAME is a common companion for construction workers. Its often seen snacking on the dug-up soil between jobs.

entry: POKENAME用额头铲状的角，钻出长达数百米的隧道。角极其坚固，连最硬的岩石也能刺穿，还常用于与野外强敌残酷决斗。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME uses the shovel-like horn on its forehead to bore tunnels stretching for hundreds of meters. This sturdy appendage can pierce even through the hardest rock and is often wielded in brutal duels against wild foes.

entry: POKENAME身体散发的强烈热量，能把挖过的所有岩石熔化。它一离开，熔岩就会迅速冷却。
author: kiwiarms
source: POKENAME turns any rock it digs through molten with the intense heat radiating off its body. Once the POKENAME moves on, the lava quickly cools.

entry: 幼年POKENAME在火山里挖掘，寻找可当外壳的石头。一找到特别中意的，就会用上一辈子。
author: secondegg
source: A young POKENAME burrows through volcanoes in search of a rock to become its shell. Once it finds a rock it particularly likes, it will keep it for the rest of its life.

entry: POKENAME经常造访海滩与港口，能用沙子和泥土造出交通工具。
author: neonriser
source: POKENAME is often seen visiting beaches and ports. It is capable of making vehicles out of sand and dirt.

entry: 它钻过地面，犹如巨翅飞鱼在水中游动般优雅。地下积起的速度，足以让它跃过整片田地。
author: foolish_weasel
source: It burrows through the ground as gracefully as a Mantine swims in water. It can gather enough speed from underground that it can launch over an entire field.

entry: 寻找珍奇松露的人常带着POKENAME，它很擅长闻出并挖掘这种美味。不过训练不当，就常会自己把松露吞光。
author: anonymous_moose
source: Hunters of exotic truffles will often keep POKENAME by their side, as they are highly proficient at both sniffing out and digging up the delicacy. However, improperly trained POKENAME will often gobble up the truffles themselves.

entry: POKENAME常破坏庄稼和花园，给乡村带来许多麻烦。研究者推测，它之所以扰动农作物和其他植物，是因为以植物根为食。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME cause a lot of problems in rural communities, frequently proving to be disruptive to crops and gardens. Researchers presume their tendency to disrupt crops and plants is due to them feeding on plant roots.

entry: POKENAME似乎大多在网络基础设施中穿行，寻找废弃网站和数据存储处。它吃很久没人访问的文件，偏爱停滞数据的滋味。
author: darkwolfe
source: POKENAME appear to spend most of their time moving through the internet infrastructure looking for defunct websites and data stores. They eat files that have not been accessed in a long time, preferring the taste of stagnant data.

entry: POKENAME以惊人速度旋转，笔直向下钻，直到碰上硬得无法钻穿的岩石才停。接着它反向旋转，沿挖出的洞返回上方。
author: kiwiarms
source: POKENAME digs straight down by spinning at incredible speeds, not stopping until it hits rock too hard to break through. Once it does, it spins in reverse to travel back up the hole it made.

entry: POKENAME转圈挥动手臂挖土，能很快钻入地下。不过隧道很小，身后会迅速塌下。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME excavates earth by spinning its arms in circles. This enables it to burrow underground quite quickly, although the small tunnels it makes quickly collapse behind it.

entry: POKENAME浮在离地几英寸处，用磁铁扫查下方泥土，寻找金属痕迹。发现富含金属的土壤，它便开心放出火花，尽可能多地挖土。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME float a few inches above the ground, scanning the dirt below them with their magnets for traces of metal. When they find a concentration of metal in the soil, they spark happily and scoop as much soil as they can out of the ground.

entry: POKENAME浮在离地几英寸处，用磁铁扫查下方泥土，寻找金属痕迹。发现富含金属的土壤，它便开心放出火花，尽可能多地挖土。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME float a few inches above the ground, scanning the dirt below them with their magnets for traces of metal. When they find a concentration of metal in the soil, they spark happily and scoop as much soil as they can out of the ground.

entry: POKENAME浮在离地几英寸处，用金属探测器扫查下方泥土。探测器威力强，连非磁性金属也能感应，是考古发掘中极珍贵的帮手。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME float a few inches above the ground, scanning the dirt below them with their metal detectors for traces of metal. Their detectors are powerful and able to sense even non-magnetic metals, making them invaluable for archaeological digs.

entry: POKENAME外甲坚硬，能抵御突然撞击，在强大压力下也不受损。世界各地至少有二十只被用作专业建筑拆除工，任何坠落碎屑都伤不到它们。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's outer plating is tough enough to resist sudden impacts and stay unharmed under intense pressure. At least twenty POKENAME have been used as expert construction demolitionists worldwide, as they remain unharmed by any falling debris.

entry: 为了驾驭流经体内的强大电力，POKENAME总让双脚接地。
author: kiwiarms
source: To manage the powerful electricity that flows through its body, POKENAME ensures that its feet are always grounded.

entry: POKENAME待在电脑屏幕旁时，会让屏幕保持关闭，因为蓝光会伤害皮肤。它仔细在设备下挖出大洞，等挖穿上层，就能让设备陷落到自己身边。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME keeps computer screens off while around them since their blue light damages its skin. It carefully digs large holes under devices so it can sink them down to it once it breaches through the surface.

entry: POKENAME挖穿地面时，周围引力场会剧烈变化。泥土常以完美球形贴在身上，保护它免受攻击。
author: santon5512
source: The gravitational fields around POKENAME shift wildly as they dig through the earth. Often, the ground will cling to them in a perfect sphere, protecting them from attackers.

entry: POKENAME捕猎时，会先藏在沙里，再突然扑出，烧灼猎物。不过只有结群或体形大于目标时，它才会这样做。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: When POKENAME hunt, they hide in the sand before pouncing out and searing their prey. However, they only do this when in groups or when they outsize their target.

entry: POKENAME挖掘本领高超，能不休息地前行数百英里。它边挖边吃泥土，把矿物质吸收进爪子，增强硬度。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are exceptional diggers, able to travel for hundreds of miles without break. They will consume the dirt as they dig, absorbing its minerals into their claws to strengthen them.

entry: POKENAME把泥含在嘴里，塑成一颗光滑泥球，再得意地吐出来。制作耗能出奇地大，一天只能做一颗。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME gathers mud in its mouth and then forms a Polished Mud Ball, which it spits up with pride. It can only make one per day, as the process drains a surprising amount of its energy.

entry: 它的后腿已发育得能在陆上行走。头顶那堆石头，其实是成长时突出体外的头骨。
author: bottomusmaximus3
source: Its hind legs have developed enough to allow it to walk on land. The pile of rocks on its head is actually part of its skull that extrudes out during growth.

entry: POKENAME虽然在地下筑巢，白天大部分时间却在地面放哨。巨臂让它战斗时十分强悍，但皮肤柔软，更适合潮湿环境。
author: bottomusmaximus3
source: Although they make their nests underground, POKENAME spend most hours of the day keeping watch above ground. Their giant arms make them formidable in battle, though their skin is soft and more suited to damp conditions.

entry: 压力下，它体内的毒液产量会增加。POKENAME总爱钻过刚播种的软土，无意间毁坏作物，因此是农夫眼中甩不掉的麻烦。
author: fiordaliso
source: When under stress, it ramps up venom production within its body. Farmers find it a persistent nuisance, as POKENAME has an unintentional habit of ruining their crops by burrowing through the soft soil where seeds have recently been planted.

entry: 它曾用尖鼻钻破栖居的金属壳，如今也用鼻子拱土觅食。手臂只是摆设。
author: kiwiarms
source: It used its pointed nose to break through the metal shell it inhabits, and now uses it to root around for food. The arms are just for show.

entry: 没人知道POKENAME如何操纵所住的巨金怪空壳的腿。X射线也无法穿透外层，看清内部究竟发生什么。
author: kiwiarms
source: Nobody knows how POKENAME is able to move the legs of the Metagross husk it inhabits, and x-rays cannot penetrate its outer layer to reveal what goes on inside.

entry: POKENAME能在一定程度上操控楔石周围的泥土。被发现时，它会快速震动，把自己埋起来。洞窟里，这常会引发小型塌方。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME carries some capacity to manipulate the dirt and soil around its keystone. If something discovers it, it vibrates rapidly to bury itself and hide. Within caverns, this often leads to minor cave-ins.

entry: POKENAME凭波导感知，在蜿蜒隧道里辨路。记录中最长的隧道，拉直后足有50英里。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME uses its aura sensing capabilities as a way of navigating its winding tunnels. The longest recorded POKENAME tunnel is 50 miles long, stretched out.

entry: POKENAME视力差，在地下靠鼓起的鼻子探路。它一直挖到鼻子碰上硬物弹回，再反复撞击障碍，直到打通。
author: teatedtiten
source: Because of its weak eyesight, it relies on its bulbous nose when underground.  It will dig until its nose bounces off of something hard, then POKENAME will proceed to repeatedly hit the blockade until it breaks through.

entry: POKENAME背上红色宝石般的果实富含养分。洞穴探险者会切薄片晒干，作为长期口粮。
author: .izik
source: The red gemlike fruit on POKENAME's back is rich in nutrients. Spelunkers dry thin slices of it for long-term sustenance.

entry: POKENAME常帮矿工用硬头撞穿岩石、击碎大块矿层。头结实得即使落石砸下来，也毫无感觉。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are commonly seen assisting miners by using their hard heads to break through solid rock or to break apart large formations of ores. Their heads are hard enough to endure a falling rock without feeling a thing.

entry: 它们平时虽用后腿站立行走，也能四肢着地。需要背运受伤矿工，或搬货物和设备时，常会这样做。
author: infinex21
source: Although they typically stand and walk on their hind legs, they can walk on all four of their limbs. They tend to do this to help carry injured miners or to help haul goods and equipment.

entry: POKENAME头骨顶部眼状的凹痕，其实看不见东西，不过使出金属爆炸等招式时会发光。它不断寻找矿石吞食。
author: bobosmith01
source: The eye-like indents at the top of its skull do not actually allow POKENAME to see, but they will glow when POKENAME uses some moves, such as Metal Burst. It will constantly seek out ore to devour.

entry: 都市传说称，把耳朵贴向地面，就能听见POKENAME在隧道里唱歌。
author: rakunk
source: Urban legend states that if you hold your ear towards the ground, you can hear POKENAME singing from inside its tunnels.

entry: POKENAME在地下挖掘、吞吃大量土石时，会引起震动。人们相信，许多大洞窟其实就是它们挖出来的。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME cause tremors as they dig through the ground, consuming massive amounts of soil and rock. It is believed that many large caves are actually the product of these Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME身体出奇柔嫩敏感，因此会裹上地下挖到的硬石和珠宝。它把部分自身力量注入收集的宝石，让它们能够发射光束。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's body is surprisingly tender and sensitive, so POKENAME coats it with hardened stone and jewels it finds while digging underground. It instills the gems it collects with portions of its own power, making them capable of firing light beams.

entry: POKENAME在地下挖掘时，埋藏的宝物和土块会黏在身上，形成一层防护。寻宝者会寻找它，盼着捡到掉下的宝贝。
author: chibitales
source: As POKENAME digs underground, buried treasures and clumps of dirt stick to their body, forming a sort of protective barrier. Treasure hunters seek out these Pokémon in hopes of collecting any treasures that fall off.

entry: POKENAME住在地下洞穴，却需要到地面光合作用、喝水。它不喜欢阳光直晒，因此光合作用颇为困难。
author: equation8573
source: POKENAME lives in holes underground, but it needs to photosynthesize and consume water on the surface. It dislikes direct sunlight, so it struggles with photosynthesis.

entry: POKENAME一生大部分时间在地下挖掘，为家族建立复杂隧道网。听见别的家族挖过来，它就会冒出地面，愤怒地叫，赶对方远离家园。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME spend most of their lives burrowing underground, creating complex tunnel networks for their family to live in. They surface when they hear other POKENAME families digging toward them, giving angry chirps to scare them away from their home.

entry: 据说POKENAME会在黑暗的隧道中穿行，从毫无戒心的猎物背后突然钻出伏击。说不定此刻，它就在你们中间。
author: xenophacilus
source: It is said that POKENAME goes around dark tunnels in order to ambush and pop up behind unsuspecting prey. It may currently be among you right now.

entry: 人们声称，POKENAME散发着可疑的气息。而它曾破坏绿岭宇宙中心的航天飞机，更让这种印象难以摆脱。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: People claim that POKENAME gives off an aura of suspicion. This isn't helped by the fact that POKENAME have been known to sabotage space shuttles at Mossdeep Space Center.

entry: POKENAME能察觉并挖出附近埋着的东西，仿佛找到了宝藏。建议训练家别带它靠近墓地。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME detects and digs up nearby buried objects as if it were treasure. It's recommended that Trainers keep their POKENAME away from graveyards.

entry: POKENAME看起来像卡在土里，让人想把它拔出来。可一旦有人想握住它，它便会沉进地下更深处躲开。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME's appearance of being wedged in the dirt beckons one to pick it up, but it evades would-be wielders by sinking further into the ground.

entry: 山脚一带能找到POKENAME的隧道，洞网有多个出口，方便寻找食物和水。它用格外坚硬的尖刺挖掘，连最硬的岩石也能刮穿。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME tunnels can be found around the base of mountains, their burrow networks having multiple exits to allow them to search for food and water. They dig using their exceptionally hard spines, scraping through even the toughest rock.

entry: 它钻出地面时，会收集岩石遮护敏感的身体，免遭日晒。水晶角战斗的力道太强，让人推测地下还藏着大得多的身体。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: It gathers rocks as it emerges from the ground to protect its sensitive body from the sun. The strength it carries while fighting with its crystalline horns leads people to theorize it has a much larger body underground.

entry: 据说POKENAME住在地下积水处。它性情温柔，喜欢帮助在地下遇到的同类。
author: thepandasharky
source: POKENAME are said to live in underground water pockets. They are tender in nature and love helping other POKENAME they meet underground.

entry: POKENAME在地下一码深处挖洞，以植物根部为食。农民拔出新鲜蔬菜时，才发现上面缺了几口。
author: melodydelune
source: POKENAME burrows a yard underground, eating the roots of plants. Farmers have pulled up fresh vegetables only to find bite marks taken out of them.

entry: POKENAME耳朵对震动极其敏感，身在地下数米，也能听见头顶的动静。它性情凶，会突然冲出泥土，伏击经过家门的生物。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME ears are extremely sensitive to vibration, enabling them to hear movement above them from several meters underground. They are aggressive and will burst out from the soil to ambush anyone passing their home.

entry: 大雨之后，POKENAME会从干河床冒出地面，岩石四肢翻起富含养分的土。过去农夫认为，它的出现是丰收的祝福。
author: segmoph
source: POKENAME surfaces in dry riverbeds after heavy rains, its rocky limbs stirring up nutrient-rich soil. Farmers once believed its presence was a blessing for abundant harvests.

entry: POKENAME的身体能挪开周围泥土，让它像游水一样滑过实地。地鼠般的触须，有时会像各有意识般行动。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's body shifts dirt around it so that it can glide through solid ground like swimming through water. Its Diglett-like tendrils can sometimes behave as if they have minds of their own.

entry: POKENAME的钻头转速极高。哪怕轻碰石板一下，光凭震动就能把石头化成粉。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's drill spins at an extremely high speed. Even a brief tap against a slab of stone can reduce it to dust from the vibration alone.

entry: 满月夜里，POKENAME聚在一起，挖出圆圈。之后，这些圈里能见到珍稀的岩石属性、草属性宝可梦。
author: lydiaprower8
source: During nights of the full moon, POKENAME get together and dig in circles. Rare Rock-type and Grass-type Pokémon can later be seen in those circles.

entry: POKENAME爱探索无人涉足的洞穴，每到一处，都取一块石头添进石质花朵。红色护目镜能挡住沙土，保护眼睛。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME love to go spelunking in unexplored caves and will collect a single rock from there to add to its rocky flowers. Its red-tinted visor protects its eyes from sand and dirt.

entry: POKENAME吸收地下水，再从头上喷出，浇灌作物。水质格外纯净，因此农夫常把它放进田里。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME absorb water from the ground, spraying it from their heads to water crops. Farmers commonly release these Pokémon into their fields, as the water they produce is especially pure.

entry: POKENAME有金属纤维头发和蜡做的裙子，远看像娃娃。孩子有时因此靠近，让它有机会吞食生命力。
author: hophoppip
source: With metallic fibers for hair and a skirt made of wax, POKENAME resembles a doll from afar. Children sometimes approach it because of this, allowing POKENAME to consume their life-force.

entry: 矿工常带一队POKENAME进深洞，当作方便的光源。它们吃下的矿物质，为光芒供能。
author: kiwiarms
source: Miners often bring a squad of POKENAME with them as a handy light source in deep caves. Their light is fueled by the minerals they consume.

entry: 据说POKENAME是古代地下文明的守卫，巡逻隧道，寻找入侵者。顶上的小脑袋才是真正本体。
author: kiwiarms
source: POKENAME are said to be the guardians of an ancient subterranean civilization, patrolling tunnels for intruders. The small head on top is the actual body.

entry: POKENAME喜欢挖洞藏食物，保护储粮。它狡猾地使出鬼火，吓走太靠近巢穴的宝可梦和旅人。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME loves digging holes to hide food inside and keep it safe. It cunningly uses Will-O-Wisp to frighten off Pokémon and travelers who venture too close to its den.

entry: POKENAME没有手臂，便伸出铲子形的肚子，用来挖地。
author: hophoppip
source: Having no arms, POKENAME instead extrudes its shovel-shaped stomach and uses it to dig through the ground.

entry: POKENAME学会了享受酒的滋味，常钻进酒馆或酿酒厂的地窖。有时，它会把酒桶稳稳搁在翅膀上，带回巢里。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME have learned that they enjoy drinking alcohol and are known for burrowing into cellars of taverns or breweries. They sometimes balance barrels on their wings and take them back to their nest.

entry: POKENAME尾尖裹着熔融岩浆，能钻穿最致密的岩层。各条尾巴能独立活动，让它高速挖掘。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME tails are tipped with molten magma and are used to tunnel through even the densest of rock layers. They can move their tails independently of one another, enabling them to dig at high speed.

entry: POKENAME深居地下，只有察觉到愿意实现的心愿才现身。若有人为私欲强行挖出POKENAME，就会化为水晶，深埋洞中。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME dwells deep within the ground, only emerging when it observes a wish it desires to grant. If someone attempts to dig up POKENAME for selfish reasons, they will be turned to crystal and entombed deep within a cavern.

entry: POKENAME怕阳光，便留在地下吃根和块茎。隧道会削弱上方土层、使作物死亡，因此是农夫眼中的害兽。
author: santon5512
source: Due to their sensitivity to sunlight, POKENAME remain underground, feeding on roots and tubers. Their tunnels weaken the soil above and kill crops, making them pests to farmers.

entry: 人们观察POKENAME，发展出一种新武术。打法是战斗时手里抓着土，眼看要输，就把土撒向对手，然后逃跑。
author: bandedbodypress
source: A new martial art has been developed by watching POKENAME. This martial style involves holding dirt in your hand during a fight, then throwing it at an opponent and running away if you might lose.

entry: POKENAME每天只醒几个小时，寻找根来吃。肚子一饱，就在地下睡到下次醒来。农场里常不小心挖到它。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME spends only a few hours awake to find roots to feed on. Once its belly is full, it sleeps underground until it wakes again. POKENAME are often accidentally dug up on farms.

entry: POKENAME生性活跃，是农场里的麻烦。一天能吃掉相当于自身体重的作物根，连顽强根系也会破坏。有些农场在田边筑地下墙，成功将它阻挡。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME's active nature makes it a nuisance on farms. It can consume up to its body weight in crop roots in a single day and disrupts even hardy root systems. Some farms have seen success in deterring POKENAME with underground walls around fields.

entry: POKENAME靠电脉冲和自身制造的地面震动交流。即使隔着数英里的泥土，也能互相理解。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME communicate with one another through electrical pulses and self-caused seismic vibrations. They are able to understand one another through several miles of earth this way.

entry: 双颚一开一合，便将周围沙子搅成猛烈漩涡，使谁也无法将它从沙里挖出。
author: staghorn
source: By opening and closing its jaws, it churns the sand around it into a raging whirlpool. This makes it impossible to extract it from its surroundings.

entry: POKENAME成群同步行动，巡逻地下深处的隧道。可惜大多数会被其他领地意识强的宝可梦猎杀，让群落很快瓦解。直到几十年前，人们才记录到它的野外存在。
author: bobosmith01
source: Groups of POKENAME work in sync to patrol deep underground tunnels. Unfortunately, most are hunted down by other territorial Pokémon, which quickly causes the colony of POKENAME to unravel. Their natural existence was recorded only some decades ago.

entry: POKENAME用极热的鼻子寻找地表下的根。吃下后，便能为体内火焰补充燃料。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its superheated nose to locate roots beneath the surface. It consumes them to fuel the flames within its body.

entry: 科学家最近发现，POKENAME会用大眼睛看清暗道。据说，歌声能让它们在地下远距离交流。
author: rakunk
source: Scientists have recently discovered POKENAME uses its large eyes to see inside dark tunnels. It is said they sing in order to communicate to one another from long distances underground.

entry: 它用长耳朵钻过泥土，寻找美味蔬菜。农夫的作物若一夜间神秘消失，罪魁祸首常是POKENAME。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: It drills through soil with its long ears in search of delicious vegetables. If a farmer's crops mysteriously disappear overnight, POKENAME is often the culprit.

entry: POKENAME一生不是住在漆黑洞窟，就是待在自己挖的隧道，因此几乎失明。飞行时，它用超声波探测障碍，挖地时则靠嗅觉寻找猎物。
author: apieli
source: POKENAME are almost blind, due to spending their whole lives either in pitch-black caverns or in the tunnels they dig. Instead, they use ultrasonic waves to detect obstacles while flying, and their sense of smell to detect prey while digging.

entry: POKENAME住在地下洞穴，入口藏在覆土的蛛网下。小型宝可梦靠得太近，它就会迅速冒出，抓住猎物。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME lives in an underground burrow concealed by a dirt-covered web. When a small Pokémon comes too close to the hidden entrance, it quickly emerges and snatches the prey.

entry: POKENAME挖洞慢得很，因此常躲在草里，吃植物并吸收能量。若毫无戒备的宝可梦或训练家踩到它，虽然很难踩伤，它仍会攻击。
author: bobosmith01
source: It tunnels extremely slowly, so it instead often hides in the grass, feeding on and absorbing energy from vegetation. If an unsuspecting Pokémon or Trainer steps on it, it will attack, in spite of the fact POKENAME is unlikely to be hurt by the act.

entry: POKENAME将身体埋进地下，只露出岩石般的鳍。它们以鳍凿开石头，挤过窄缝进入洞中，想独自安静歇息。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME bury themselves in the ground with only their rocky fins exposed. They use these fins to carve through rocks, slipping into narrow cracks to get into caves to try and get some rest in private.

entry: 晶体是POKENAME的主食，它会凶猛保卫。宝石璀璨的地下洞窟里，肯定有它准备随时冲出地面，阻挡想偷珠宝的生物。
author: sk372
source: Crystals are its main food source, and it defends them viciously. Dazzling underground caverns full of gems are certain to have a POKENAME ready to erupt from the ground to deter would-be jewel thieves.

entry: 寒冷地区，见到POKENAME被视为好运，因为它擅长翻松冻土。农家的孩子会玩起搭小屋的游戏，吸引它来。
author: wormspawn
source: Spotting a POKENAME is considered good luck in cold regions because it is especially equipped to till soil enveloped in permafrost. Farmers' children make a game of building small shelters to attract them.

entry: POKENAME常在农场附近小群聚集。农夫不介意，因为挖掘有益土壤，它又主要吃腐烂或死去的作物。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME tend to congregate in small groups near farms. Farmers don't mind the presence, as the digging helps the soil, and POKENAME primarily targets rotten or dead crops as its main source of food.

entry: POKENAME收集大团泥土，用于跳舞助威。收好后，它会放电震晕土里的虫子，方便当作小点心吃。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME gathers large clumps of dirt to use for its dances and cheers. After collecting, it lets loose electric shocks that stun any bugs within the dirt, making them easy to consume as a quick snack.

entry: 这种宝可梦大多待在地下啃树根，会发出哀伤、令人心惊的哭声。因此有传闻称，POKENAME是迷失森林、最终死去的孩子的鬼魂。
author: roundabout_robin
source: This Pokémon spends most of its time underground, chewing on tree roots. It lets out mournful, harrowing cries, leading to the rumor that POKENAME are the ghosts of children who become lost and die in forests.

entry: POKENAME嘴里不断流出富含养分的口水。它在地下四处走动，沿途留下液体，滋养地面植物的根。
author: katieplaysgames
source: A constant stream of nutrient-rich drool spills from the mouths of POKENAME. They wander around underground, leaving a trail of the liquid as they walk, nourishing the roots of plants above the surface.

entry: POKENAME身体质地与泥相同，许多人怕弄脏，不愿触摸。它嗅觉敏锐，能在与家族共同挖出的复杂隧道里准确辨路。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its body has the same consistency as mud, so many people avoid touching it for fear of getting dirty. POKENAME has a keen sense of smell that allows it to navigate perfectly through the intricate underground tunnels it digs together with its family.

entry: 它全身覆着厚泥，在泥多的雨水充沛地区生活得很好。干燥地方的土无法裹身，会让它变得胆小。
author: hophoppip
source: Its body is coated in a thick layer of mud. It thrives in rainy areas where mud is plentiful, but becomes timid in dry places where the earth is too dry to serve as a coating.

entry: POKENAME嘴里不断流出富含养分的口水。它在地下四处走动，沿途留下液体，滋养地面植物的根。
author: katieplaysgames
source: A constant stream of nutrient-rich drool spills from the mouths of POKENAME. They wander around underground, leaving a trail of the liquid as they walk, nourishing the roots of plants above the surface.

entry: POKENAME像一座座移动花园，结伴寻找肥沃田地，作为当天家园。它们向上伸展，围着彼此摇摆，颈间花瓣在集体舞蹈中吸收阳光。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Gardens of POKENAME travel together in search of fertile fields to call home for the day. They extend into the air and wave around one another, the petals on their necks absorbing sunlight as they perform their communal dance.

entry: POKENAME栖居的洞窟毫无光亮，因为它会吃掉一切光源。它虽不凶，却会被提灯、手电筒等吸引，吞下新的光，把旅人留在黑暗里。
author: sk372
source: Caverns inhabited by POKENAME are completely devoid of light, as it consumes any source of illumination. Though not aggressive, it is drawn to travelers carrying lanterns, flashlights, etc., casting them into darkness as it consumes the new light.

entry: POKENAME个头虽小，却有很大力气，能轻松挖穿地面。钻出地面时，上方若不幸有东西，就会被它顶飞。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's diminutive stature belies a large amount of strength that lets it dig through the ground with ease. Anything unfortunate enough to be above it when it surfaces will be sent flying.

entry: POKENAME把自己倒过来，大半身体藏进土里，假装普通地鼠。有生物想捕食，它就会翻过来，用众多毒刺使对方中毒。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME sets itself upside down, hiding most of its body beneath the dirt to appear like a normal Diglett. When something attempts to prey on it, it flips over and poisons them with its many toxic spines.

entry: 双臂旋转着掘地，速度最高可达每小时40英里。若地面挖不进去，就只能慢慢摇摆着走。
author: staghorn
source: It can dig rapidly by spinning its arms, reaching speeds of up to 40 miles per hour. If it can't dig into the terrain, it is forced to waddle slowly.

entry: POKENAME像一座座移动花园，结伴寻找肥沃田地，作为当天家园。若与群体走散，它就会孤独地留在原地，盼家人回来找自己。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Gardens of POKENAME travel together in search of fertile fields to call home for the day. If they ever get separated from the rest of their group, POKENAME become lonely, remaining in place in the hopes their family will return to them.

entry: POKENAME在黎明和黄昏吃草，滋养背上的小蘑菇。它挖地前进，背上孢子为上方土壤增肥。
author: oddwalls
source: POKENAME feeds on grasses at dawn and dusk to grow the small mushrooms that cover its back. It travels by digging underground, fertilizing the soil above with the spores on its back.

entry: POKENAME全由沙子构成，成了一群地鼠的家。这究竟是共生，还是寄生，仍不清楚。
author: serversizeme
source: Due to being made completely of sand, POKENAME became the home to a colony of Diglett. It is unknown if this is a symbiotic or parasitic relationship.

entry: POKENAME住在幽深寒冷的洞中，吃挖来的宝石与矿物。虽常与勾魂眼交手，有时也会合力觅食，平分财宝。
author: teatedtiten
source: Found in deep and cold caverns, POKENAME feast on gemstones and minerals they dig up. Though they have bouts with Sableye, they will sometimes work together to find food and split their treasures.

entry: POKENAME热爱挖掘，一旦用利爪开挖，就不肯停。不少个体是农夫翻土的重要帮手，总干到开心又筋疲力竭。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME love to dig and refuse to stop once they start digging with their sharp claws. Many play a vital role in tilling soil for farmers, working themselves until they are happily exhausted.

entry: POKENAME用爪子钻入地下，像真菌般吃植物根。出土散播孢子时，圆滚滚的身体如同土堆。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME burrows underground with its claws, feeding on plant roots like a fungus. When it emerges above the surface to scatter spores, its round body resembles a mound of earth.

entry: POKENAME用锋利的甲鳞击碎石块，轻松挖穿碎石层。它在地下啃树根，吸收能量维生。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME digs through gravel with ease, using its sharp, armored scales to break apart stones. It chews on tree roots underground to absorb energy and sustain itself.

entry: 它性情害羞，住在离岸边不太远、土质刚开始稍硬的地方。受惊时，就以惊人速度钻往地底深处。
author: bobosmith01
source: It is a shy Pokémon that lives somewhat near the shoreline, just when the dirt starts to become a little firmer. If frightened, it digs away far underground at incredible speed.

entry: 比起战斗，它更愿意逃跑，最好根本别被发现。因此，它会在干土里打滚，试图伪装自己。
author: bobosmith01
source: It would rather flee than fight. Ideally, it would prefer not to be spotted at all; it will roll around in the dry dirt to try and camouflage itself.

entry: POKENAME在同类之间很活泼，热衷训练切磋。但有其他生物在场，就会害羞怯懦，常挖个洞躲起来。
author: sk372
source: Among others of its kind, POKENAME is boisterous and eager to train and spar. In the presence of others, however, it is shy and meek, and prone to digging a hole to hide itself in.

entry: POKENAME在河岸泥土中迅速穿行，只为抓虫吃才露面。遇到麻烦，它会发射包在泡泡里的紧实土块。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME moves swiftly through the dirt across riversides, only coming up to catch insects to eat. If it encounters trouble, it uses tightly-packed clods of dirt encased in bubbles as projectiles.

entry: POKENAME能钻入地下，再突然跃出，打目标一个措手不及。即使在地下，也能用舌头抓东西。
author: hiroshima0042_23263
source: POKENAME is able to dig in the ground and jump out to catch its target by surprise. POKENAME uses its tongue to grab things even when POKENAME is underground.

entry: POKENAME常在南瓜田附近挖洞，翻出肥沃土壤。农人若想摸它，就会被头上藤蔓抽打。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME can be found near pumpkin patches, tunneling through the ground to create fertile soil. It will whip farmers with the vine on its head if they try to touch it.

entry: 比起战斗，它更愿意逃跑，最好根本别被发现。因此，它会在干土里打滚，试图伪装自己。
author: bobosmith01
source: It would rather flee than fight. Ideally, it would prefer not to be spotted at all; it will roll around in the dry dirt to try and camouflage itself.

entry: POKENAME一生大多在地下吃植物根。地温太高时，它会挖向地表，在空中扇动翅膀，为身体降温。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME spend large portions of their life underground, feeding on the roots of plants. When the ground temperature gets too warm, they dig toward the surface and fan their wings in the air to cool their bodies.

entry: POKENAME把金色长发探出地面，感知四周。即使抓住头发，也极难把沉重的石质身体从地下拉出来。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME pokes its long golden hair above the ground to sense its surroundings. Even if this hair is grabbed, it is incredibly difficult to pull up its heavy stone body from underground.

entry: POKENAME大多待在地下，偶尔冒出来，常恰好出现在人面前。它用发丝般的手臂抓住猎物，再吸取生命，滋养南瓜身体。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME spends most of its time below the surface, but will occasionally pop up, often right in front of people. It uses its hairlike arms to grab its prey, then drains life from them to nourish its pumpkin body.

entry: POKENAME挖隧道时，用尾上巨焰照路，能一连挖好几天不休息。捕猎时，它会先烤熟猎物，再把残骸埋掉。
author: ruben2309295
source: POKENAME use the giant flames on their tails to light the way while digging  tunnels. They are known to dig for days on end without resting. When hunting, they roast their prey before burying the remains.

entry: 成年POKENAME的身体究竟多长，是科学谜题。目前公认的估计是：“不到一千米，大概吧。”
author: kiwiarms
source: The actual length of a fully grown POKENAME's body is considered a scientific mystery. The current agreed upon estimate is "less than a kilometer, probably".

entry: POKENAME如今大多待在地上，很少再为自己挖洞。有时，它会给其他地鼠挖出、早已废弃的洞填土。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME now spends much of its time above ground, rarely digging holes for itself anymore. It spends some of its time putting dirt back into long-abandoned holes created by other Diglett.

entry: POKENAME如今虽然像阿罗拉的同类，却几乎没有那一变体的特殊特征。即便如此，它似乎很为新长出的那撮头发得意。
author: sk372
source: Although now POKENAME resembles its Alolan counterpart, it exhibits little if any of the variant's differentiating attributes. Despite this, it seems quite proud of its newfound sprout of hair.

entry: 很长时间里，研究者以为POKENAME并非真正的融合体，只是两只地鼠。后来观察到它们始终连在一起，才确定是新的融合物种。
author: katieplaysgames
source: For a long time, researchers assumed that POKENAME were not a true fusion but were instead simply a pair of Diglett. When they were observed constantly sticking together it became clear that they were a new fusion species.

entry: POKENAME能轻松钻进害兽的窝，是优秀的除害帮手。农夫因此常留几只在身边。
author: kiwiarms
source: POKENAME are excellent pest control, as they can easily dig into a varmint's den. Farmers keep several of them around for this reason.

entry: POKENAME常在洞窟附近惹麻烦，咬抓接近洞穴的徒步者。多数人都避开，寻宝者却有时跟着它，盼着拿到嵌在头上的金币。
author: brachionite
source: POKENAME often causes trouble near caves, biting or scratching hikers who approach its burrow. Most people avoid it, but treasure hunters sometimes follow it, hoping to claim the gold coin embedded in its head.

entry: POKENAME以地鼠为猎物，钻地追踪。它会强行把地鼠拽出洞，戏弄一番后再吃掉。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME hunt Diglett as their prey, tracking them as they dig underground. They will forcibly pull them out of their burrows, taunting them before they consume them.

entry: POKENAME把有蹼的手当铲，迅速挖土造隧道。能帮助铺设地下管线，因此很受施工队欢迎。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME use their webbed hands like shovels, rapidly digging through the soil to create their tunnels. They are popular with construction crews for their ability to help with the installation of underground pipes and cables.

entry: POKENAME爱挖长隧道，毛上常覆着厚土和泥。训练家最好让它待在户外，免得一抖就把家具、地毯都甩满泥。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME fur is frequently coated in a thick layer of dirt and mud due to its tendency to dig long tunnels. Trainers are advised to keep POKENAME outside so that they don't shake their mud out all over furniture and carpets.

entry: 人们把POKENAME引入农场，翻土、浇灌植物。它的工作能帮助种出健康作物，许多农夫十分感激。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have been introduced to farms to till the soil and water plants. Many farmers greatly appreciate POKENAME for their work to help farms produce healthy crops.

entry: POKENAME用强壮手臂铲开泥土，迅速钻过地下。农夫喜欢让它翻田，为新作物做好准备。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME dig rapidly through the ground, using their powerful arms to shovel soil out of their way. They are a popular Pokémon with farmers, who use them to turn over their fields ready for fresh crops.

entry: POKENAME想睡觉时，会用精神力挪开泥土，挖出地下空间，再把土移到洞口，掩藏行踪。
author: oddwalls
source: When POKENAME wants to sleep, it excavates an underground space by moving dirt with its psychic powers. POKENAME then moves the dirt to the tunnel entrance to conceal its presence.

entry: POKENAME力量和耐力更强，在农田里逐渐比地鼠更受欢迎。不过它同样怕长时间光照，行动也常比地鼠慢。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME are becoming more and more popular for use on farmlands over Diglett due to their higher strength and stamina. However, they share Diglett's weakness to sustained light, and tend to be less swift than Diglett, too.

entry: 人们常以为看见了地鼠藏在地下的身体，其实那是POKENAME。它会掘地，将猎物拖入土中。
author: ayutac
source: People often think that they saw the body of a Diglett, though it was, in fact, a POKENAME. This Pokémon can burrow, and it pulls its prey under the earth.

entry: POKENAME似乎不像豪力那样，戴着抑制力量的腰带。手臂两侧如血管般的纹路，会随饮食改变颜色。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME does not appear to wear a power-save belt like Machoke does. The vein-like patterns on the sides of its arms vary in color based on POKENAME's diet.

entry: POKENAME用根系挖出精巧隧道，同时从土中吸取水与养分。受威胁时，它能在一瞬间缩回洞里。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME create intricate tunnels using their roots, absorbing water and nutrients from the soil as they do so. When threatened, they can retreat into these burrows in a fraction of a second.

entry: POKENAME吸收养分的方式极不寻常。没有根系的它，会靠吃泥土在地下掘出隧道，直接从中合成维生素和矿物质。
author: bradlybro199
source: The way POKENAME absorb nutrients is very unorthodox. Seeing as they have no root system, they just dig tunnels underground by eating the soil and synthesizing the vitamins and minerals directly from it.

entry: 它用发达手臂抓更多泥土，添进身体周围的土堆。土堆越气派，就越容易找到伴侣。
author: kiwiarms
source: It uses its well developed arms to grab more dirt for the mound around its body. The more impressive the mound, the easier it is to acquire mates.

entry: POKENAME整天往身边堆土，想把身体藏起来，不让外界看见。这源于它格外强烈的羞耻心。
author: kiwiarms
source: POKENAME spends all day packing more dirt around itself, in order to hide its body from the world. It does this out of an advanced sense of shame.

entry: 据说许多地鼠聚在一起时，有时会造出守卫来保护洞穴。不过，守卫获得生命的原理仍不明。
author: fuade
source: It's said many Diglett coming together sometimes build guardians to protect their burrows. The mechanism through which it gained life is unknown.

entry: 人类利用POKENAME爱追逐的性子，已有数十年。一种传统农法就是在田里跑，让它跟在后面钻地，把泥土翻松。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME's desire to chase has been used by humans for decades. A traditional farming method is to run through the field, letting the POKENAME burrow and churn up the earth as they follow.

entry: 从没人见过POKENAME脱壳，因为夹住身体的颚咬得太紧，根本无法把它撬出来。
author: kiwiarms
source: Nobody has ever seen a POKENAME without a shell, as its jaws are clasped too tightly around the Pokémon's body to pry it out.

entry: POKENAME具有磁力，能少量挪动周围泥土。夜里睡觉时，它就靠这能力挖洞，把自己埋进去。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME possesses magnetism that allows it to move and shift dirt around in small quantities. It uses this to dig out holes for it to bury itself in for the night when it sleeps.

entry: POKENAME用磁力吸来富含矿物的土，喂给幼崽，直到它们长大，能自己使用磁铁。
author: kiwiarms
source: POKENAME magnetically attracts soil rich in minerals, which it feeds to its young until they are old enough to use their magnets themselves.

entry: POKENAME总把脚藏在地下，需要时随时钻走。有时拿的大葱太大，却会在挖洞时卡住。
author: frokachu
source: POKENAME always keep their feet underground, ready to burrow when needed. Sometimes it gets stuck while digging if the leek it's holding is too big.

entry: POKENAME头脑极其简单，遇险就把头埋进土里。按照它的逻辑，自己看不见攻击者，攻击者也就看不见它。
author: sk372
source: Extremely simpleminded, POKENAME's response to danger is to bury its head beneath the dirt. According to its internal logic, if it can't see an attacker, the attacker can't see it.

entry: POKENAME移动时，会留下一道厚泥。泥硬化后极其坚固，许多城市便让它帮忙填补裂缝和路坑。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME leaves behind a thick trail of mud as it moves about. This substance is extremely durable when it hardens, so many cities will use the Pokémon to help fill in cracks and potholes.

entry: 它们的身体由浓稠的泥和土构成，方便吸收植物获取养分。构成身体的泥土是极好的肥料，农夫常加以使用。
author: santon5512
source: Their bodies are made of thick mud and dirt, helping them absorb plant life for nutrients. The mud and soil they are made of is an exceptionally good fertilizer, often being used by farmers.

entry: POKENAME借异界之力，在岩间开出小窗，观察感兴趣的人，或打声招呼。奇怪的是，从另一面看，窗子却全无踪迹。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME channel an otherworldly power to make little windows between rocks that they use to observe or greet people they take an interest in. Strangely, these windows are completely invisible when viewed from the other side.

entry: 若你深入地下洞窟，记得别远离火把的光。POKENAME可不欢迎入侵者。
author: jemeremmazza
source: If you find yourself deep in a cavern below ground, stay close to your torchlight. POKENAME don't take kindly to intruders.

entry: POKENAME藏在地下，只露尾尖模仿地鼠。捕食者一上钩，它就会破土而出，以惊人力道攻击。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: While concealed underground, POKENAME expose only the tips of their tails to mimic Diglett. When a predator takes the bait, POKENAME erupt from the earth and strike with tremendous force.

entry: POKENAME用爪钻进沙里，把自己彻底藏好。小型猎物经过，它便猛冲出地面，用爪抓住，拖入地下。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME will use their claws to burrow in the sand, concealing themselves completely. When smaller prey passes by, they will burst from the ground, grabbing them with their claws and pulling them under.

entry: POKENAME的双钳各有初步意识。小钳简单听话，大钳却更凶，发怒时甚至可能攻击本体。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's claws have rudimentary minds of their own. Though the smaller claw is simple and obedient, the larger claw is more aggressive and may even attack the main body if enraged.

entry: POKENAME积极捍卫领地，一感知土壤有动静，就会冒出地面，用背上炮口朝入侵者发射岩石。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME defend their territories aggressively, emerging from the ground when they sense a disturbance in the soil. Using the cannons on their backs, they will fire rocks at intruders.

entry: POKENAME背上的宝石十分精巧，受损时会剥落有毒碎片。它把宝石磨向岩石，便能扬起碎片云，赶走矿工。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME has a precise gem on its back that flakes off toxic shards when damaged. By scraping its gem against rocks, it produces clouds of these shards to ward off miners.

entry: POKENAME在地下深处爆炸后，常留下满坑美丽粉钻。钻石虽惊艳，却极其脆弱，掉落地面，甚至只握得稍紧，就会猛烈爆炸。
author: icelevelincarnate
source: When POKENAME explode deep underground, they often create a quarry of lovely pink diamonds behind. Although breathtaking, these diamonds are incredibly fragile and will violently explode if they're dropped, or even held just a bit too firmly.

entry: POKENAME统治着庞大的小碎钻群。各部族的权杖独一无二，年轻个体准备好继位时，父母就会将其传下。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: POKENAME are the rulers of large groups of Carbink. The sceptre they carry is unique to each tribe and is passed down to a young POKENAME by their parents once they are ready to rule.

entry: POKENAME诞生在地下深处，岩浆流的热量和压力，把岩石头盔压成粉钻。它的诞生十分罕见，因此被部族奉为王族。
author: ghostslythe
source: Born deep underground, the heat and pressure from magma flows harden POKENAME's rock helmet into pink diamonds. Due to the rarity of their birth, they are treated by their tribe as royalty.

entry: POKENAME长大后，会离部族越走越远，对大多数其他物种都很友好。遇袭时，它让敌人靠近，看着攻击被铠甲弹开，再挥重斧反击。
author: ghostslythe
source: As they grow, POKENAME wander further from their tribe and are known to be friendly to most other species. If attacked, they allow foes to close the distance, watch as attacks bounce off their armor, and retaliate with a heavy axe strike.

entry: POKENAME周围常环绕极坚固的宝石，用于在休息时抵挡勾魂眼等捕食者。
author: quitecomical1997
source: POKENAME are often found surrounded by extremely sturdy gems, which it uses to fend off predators like Sableye as it rests.

entry: 野生POKENAME常清洗、打磨各种彩色晶体，甚至让它们变得像口袋里的粉宝石一样光滑。它会把小而光滑的宝石放进口袋，送给朋友。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME will often clean and polish myriad colorful crystals, to the point that they may even grow as smooth as the pink gemstone within their pouch. They will carry some smaller, smooth gems within their pouch and offer them to their friends.

entry: 据说POKENAME头冠的柔光能修复珊瑚礁，但它很少在一处待得够久，让光产生明显效果。虽然常受欺负，它仍深深关爱水中的同胞。
author: quackquackattack
source: The soft glow from POKENAME's tiara is said to help restore coral reefs, though it rarely stays in place long enough for the glow to take noticeable effect. POKENAME cares deeply for its aquatic brethren, even if it often gets bullied.

entry: 有些水手称POKENAME为“海之公主”。它优雅地游在沿海水域，潜到海床寻找宝石，装点头冠。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: Dubbed the "Princess Of The Sea" by some sailors, POKENAME swims gracefully in coastal waters. It dives to the sea floor in search of gems to add to its tiara.

entry: POKENAME双翼遍布光亮鳞片，阳光一照就闪闪发亮。它是优雅的环境守护者，会帮助从树上掉下的宝可梦重新站起来。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have gleaming scales all over their wings that sparkle when the sunlight hits them. POKENAME are elegant protectors of the environment that help Pokémon back up when they fall from trees.

entry: 光穿过POKENAME四肢，就会以美丽粉光照亮四周。受威胁时，它会把炫目光芒集中射进攻击者眼里，让对方暂时看不见。
author: vlavoc
source: Any light that passes through POKENAME's limbs illuminates the area in a beautiful pink glow. When threatened, it will concentrate this dazzling light into its attackers' eyes, temporarily blinding them.

entry: POKENAME厌恶勾魂眼，一见就会不顾一切地冲锋。胆大的勾魂眼会引它撞向洞壁，偷走从毛上碎落的宝石。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME despise Sableye and will blindly charge when they spot one. Brave Sableye goad POKENAME to charge into cave walls, allowing them to steal any gems that break off of POKENAME's fur.

entry: POKENAME主要生活在地下水域附近，也有个体出现在洞窟水域旁。栖地往往盛产珍贵晶体，若不认为来者配得上，它就会拼命守护。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME mainly live near underground bodies of water, though some have been found near bodies of waters in caves. Where they live is oft bountiful with precious crystals that they will fiercely defend if they do not deem one worthy.

entry: POKENAME钻石的几何结构完美，是高科技计算设备极珍贵的部件。紧密的晶格也让身体几乎不受物理伤害。
author: mistymagius
source: Due to the perfect geometric structure of POKENAME diamonds, they have become an invaluable component in high-tech computing equipment. POKENAME's tight crystal lattice also makes its body almost invulnerable to physical damage.

entry: POKENAME在紫水晶洞窟里沉睡，晶体般的肚子闪着强光。周围食物一被照到，似乎就会慢慢化成美丽的宝石和晶体。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME are found in deep slumbers within amethyst caves, a bright glow gleaming from their crystal-like stomachs. The food around them seems to slowly change into beautiful gems and crystals whenever this glow hits them.

entry: POKENAME把空气中的碳压成一团细小钻石，环绕自己旋转。它睡在宝石巢上，即使无意识，力量也会卷起猛烈风暴，让身体悬空。
author: pattybgoode
source: POKENAME presses carbon from the air into a cloud of tiny diamonds that whirl around itself. It sleeps on a nest of gems, and even unconsciously, its power whirls a violent storm that keeps it aloft.

entry: POKENAME每拍一次翅膀，就会把周围空气中的碳压成钻石。景象虽被誉为世间至美之一，身后落下的滚烫宝石雨却会沿途留下毁灭。
author: knilk
source: With each flap of its wings, POKENAME compresses the carbon in the air around it into diamonds. Though it's said to be one of the most beautiful sights in the world, the hail of superheated gems it trails leaves a path of destruction in its wake.

entry: 因多年遭人猎取晶体，这种宝可梦曾所剩无几。幸好近来已开始繁盛，如今敢尝试取走晶体的人极少，连它脱落的也不敢碰。
author: infinex21
source: After years of being hunted for their crystals, there are few of these Pokémon that remain. Thankfully, they have begun to flourish as of late and few remain who would dare to try and obtain even their shed crystals.

entry: 它们照料着进化时剩余能量凝成的大宝石，宝石还会继续储存能量。它们靠大宝石释放的残余能量生活，像护蛋一样保护它。
author: infinex21
source: They care for a large gem that formed from the leftover energy of their evolution, which continues to store more energy. They thrive on the residual energy released by their large gems and protect them as if they were their eggs.

entry: 它的爪比钻石更坚硬，比黑曜石更锋利。翅膀能调整身体位置，好把头顶宝石射出的光束准确对向敌人。
author: infinex21
source: Its claws are tougher than diamond and sharper than obsidian. With its wings, it can position itself to best direct beams of light from the gem upon its head at foes.

entry: POKENAME通过粉石英晶体调谐精神能量。据说，凝视它王冠的生物，便会不由自主地对它言听计从。
author: ghostslythe
source: POKENAME attunes its psychic energies through pink quartz crystals. It is said that any who gaze into its crown become compelled to follow its commands unquestionably.

entry: POKENAME行踪隐秘，人们只曾远远见过，因为一旦靠得太近，它就能完全消失。据说，少数被视为朋友的生物，会获赠一颗来历不明的美丽粉晶。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are elusive Pokémon that have only ever been seen from afar, for they can fully disappear if one draws too near. Those few that a POKENAME considers a friend are said to be blessed with a beautiful pink crystal of an unknown source.

entry: POKENAME长出的光亮叶片，一见光就闪闪发亮。格外慷慨时，它会把叶片送给其他宝可梦。
author: quackquackattack
source: The glistening leaves that POKENAME produce create sparkles when exposed to light. Whenever they feel particularly generous, they give out these leaves to other Pokémon as gifts.

entry: POKENAME晶体反射的闪亮粉光，吸引远近的宝可梦聚来。它像仁慈的君主，用柔和光芒安抚追随者，平息争端。
author: skittytales
source: Pokémon from far and wide flock to the glittering pink light that reflects from POKENAME's crystals. It acts as a benevolent ruler, soothing its followers and dispelling disputes with its calming glow.

entry: POKENAME身上的缎带和珠宝能卷曲成诱饵，引来并缠住猎物。常能见它狡黠地咧嘴、炫耀珠宝，既为夺目外表得意，也在寻找下一餐。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: The ribbons and jewels along a POKENAME's body act as coiling lures to draw in and snare prey. POKENAME are often seen grinning mischievously and flaunting their jewels, proud of their spectacle and looking for their next meal.

entry: POKENAME的尾巴是一块镶满宝石、沉重结实的石头。它却挥得轻如无物，还能借尾巴把小小身体抬高，更好地观察四周。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME possesses a very heavy and sturdy jewel-encrusted stone for a tail. Despite the weight, it swings it around as easily as if it were nothing and uses it to give its small body a boost up for better viewing of its surroundings.

entry: 每天特定时刻，POKENAME的宝石会明亮发光，能量一阵阵脉动。这时它也最为好斗，会从晶体朝打扰者发射能量束。
author: sk372
source: At specific times of the day, POKENAME's gems glow brightly, pulsing with energy. During this time POKENAME is also at its most combative, firing off energy beams from its crystals at those who bother it.

entry: POKENAME胸前会长出心形宝石。盗猎者为取宝石而过度捕捉，如今许多个体只能在动物园见到。
author: camtft
source: POKENAME produce heart-shaped gems along their chest. Many are only found in zoos today, due to poachers overhunting them for their gems.

entry: POKENAME热爱唱歌，把小棒子当麦克风，帮助清澈的歌声传远。其他宝可梦若不理会，它常会大发脾气。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME love to sing and use their small baton like a microphone to help them project their crystal-clear voice. They often throw tantrums when other Pokémon ignore their singing.

entry: POKENAME大部分时间都在睡觉，保存能量，准备长出进化后拥有的翅膀。
author: bitterchemicalhaze
source: POKENAME spends the majority of the time asleep. It is conserving its energy to produce the wings it obtains when it evolves.

entry: POKENAME充满喜悦与奇思妙想，在空中翱翔，与训练家和宝可梦玩游戏。据说晶体碎片能带来大好运，不过只有陪它玩的人才能得到。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are full of joy and whimsy, soaring through the sky and playing games with Trainers and Pokémon. Their crystal shards are said to bring great fortune but are only available to those who play their games.

entry: POKENAME每年只睡一次，一睡整整一周，并用钻石茧保护自己。期间，它统治的小碎钻会拼命守护它。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: POKENAME only sleeps once per year for an entire week, shielding itself in a diamond cocoon. While POKENAME is in this state, the Carbink it rules over will protect it with their lives.

entry: POKENAME用来保持皮肤湿润的凝胶中，含有微量钻石。常能见到勘矿者跟在后面，筛找滴落凝胶中的钻石，盼着发财。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: The gel that POKENAME produces to keep its skin moist contains trace amounts of diamonds. It is not uncommon to find prospectors following this Pokémon and sifting through the gel that drips off it while trying to make it rich.

entry: POKENAME把背上宝石磨向岩石，扬起有毒碎片云。训练家和宝可梦若吸入，都会头晕恶心。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME scrape the gem on their back against rocks to produce clouds of toxic shards. If inhaled, these shards cause dizziness and nausea in both Trainers and Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME生出藤蔓抓住附近岩石，刮下背上宝石的碎片。遇险时，它会掷出碎片，切开敌人。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME creates vines to grab rocks around it, scraping shards off the gem on its back. When in danger, it flings these gem shards to cut through its foes.

entry: POKENAME是和善的施法者，会用缎带向遇到的生物撒出闪亮魔法能量。沾上粉尘后，对方的感知会改变，声称此后一切都更加鲜活美丽。
author: sk372
source: A good-natured spellcaster, POKENAME uses its ribbons to send out sparkling trails of magical energy to those it meets. Those afflicted by the dust have their perceptions changed, claiming that everything seems more vibrant and beautiful afterward.

entry: 神话称，POKENAME在地下迷宫深处筑巢，家中像切割过的钻石般闪耀。它凭发射激光的尾巴和控宝石能力，轻松造出璀璨的宝石雕像。
author: bobosmith01
source: According to myth, POKENAME nests deep in underground labyrinths, its home glittering like cut diamond. With the use of its laser-firing tail and power over gems, it can create dazzling gemstone statues with ease.

entry: POKENAME生活在洞窟深处，以宝石维生，在黏稠体内形成粉钻。这些宝石稀有，因此深受珠宝匠追捧。
author: santon5512
source: Living deep within caves, POKENAME consume gemstones to survive, forming pink diamonds within their viscous bodies. These gems are highly sought after by jewelers due to their rarity.

entry: 接触POKENAME的壳务必极其小心，因为非常脆弱，重新长好需要数月。美丽又易碎的壳，售价十分高昂。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME's shells are to be handled with extreme care; they are incredibly fragile and take months to reform. The shells of POKENAME are sold at high prices due to their beauty and fragility.

entry: 潜藏的龙之力觉醒后，收集的宝石成为身体一部分，让它更加坚硬。它能用管状嘴高速发射晶体，无论尖钝，连水下也一样。
author: infinex21
source: Its collected gemstones have become part of its body due to it awakening its latent draconic powers, which have made its body tougher. It can shoot crystals from its tubular mouth, be they sharp or blunt, at high speeds even underwater.

entry: POKENAME把收集的数据簇保护在粉色晶体内。谁想动这些精细结构，就会迎来猛烈的钻石风暴。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME protect clusters of data they've collected in pink crystals. Anyone attempting to mess with these delicate structures is subject to intense Diamond Storm attacks.

entry: POKENAME曾因华美的粉钻角而遭猎捕。身上宝石放出强光，便代表它正用力量在周围制造幻象。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME was once hunted for its magnificent pink diamond horns. When the gems on its body give off a strong glow, it means POKENAME is using its powers to create illusions in its surroundings.

entry: POKENAME用一周慢慢产出、结晶营养丰富的粉色乳汁，研究者称其为“乳岩盐”。为了庆祝辛苦工作一周，它会把小块乳岩盐分给大家，供收藏或食用。
author: pkbonusducks
source: Over a week, POKENAME slowly produce and crystalize a highly nutritious pink milk, which researchers have dubbed "milk halite." To celebrate a hard week of work, POKENAME hand out small pieces of milk halite for others to collect or eat.

entry: 据说贴近POKENAME携带的宝石，能增强身体自然愈合的能力。它最开心时，口袋里蛋状的宝石会发光。
author: infinex21
source: The gems carried by POKENAME are said to boost the body's natural healing abilities when held close. Their egg-like gemstone within their pouch will glow when they are happiest.

entry: POKENAME跑过水面时，会让水富含矿物质。寻宝者声称，它常去的地方藏有宝石。
author: cait_sith
source: When POKENAME runs across a body of water, it enriches the water with minerals. Treasure hunters claim that POKENAME frequents areas with hidden gemstones.

entry: POKENAME出生时吃下的矿物质不同，长出的晶体也各异。由于又大又纯净，它的晶体在黑市很受欢迎。
author: stevethebarbarian
source: Depending on the minerals POKENAME consumes when it is born, it will grow a variety of different crystals. Due to their size and purity, POKENAME crystals are popular on the black market.

entry: 野生POKENAME在布满晶体的洞窟中跳舞，带着电火花，从一块晶体跃向另一块。身体晶体储存的电，让它散发怡人光芒。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME dance about within crystal-lined caves, hopping from crystal to crystal clad in electrical sparks while in the air. The crystals on their bodies store electricity within them, which causes them to emit a pleasant glow.

entry: POKENAME飞过晴空时，翅膀上的明亮晶体会反射出绚丽彩虹。据说，许多完美珠宝都是它落下的羽毛。
author: t3isukone
source: The brilliant crystals of POKENAME's wings reflect in stunning rainbows when it flies through a sunny sky. Many perfect jewels are said to be fallen feathers from POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME隐居却友善，会施加咒术和幻象，让自己难以在山洞深处被找到。若仍有人能找到它，它就会专门创造一颗美得无与伦比的宝石奖励对方。
author: sk372
source: Reclusive yet friendly, POKENAME casts hexes and illusions that make it difficult to find it deep within mountain caverns. Those that manage to find it despite the spells will be rewarded with a gem of unparalleled beauty it creates for them.

entry: POKENAME会依恋一颗粉宝石，像照顾蛋一样爱护。随身放在口袋里照料得越久，宝石便越光亮滑润。
author: infinex21
source: It will grow attached to a single, pink gemstone and care for it like it were an egg. This gemstone will become polished and smooth the longer that a POKENAME cares for it and carries it around within its pouch.

entry: 看POKENAME有多少珠宝，就能判断年龄。珠宝储存它生成的多余电力，一颗若受损或断成两半，所有储能就会冲出，电击周围一切。
author: milchik
source: This Pokémon's age can be judged by how many jewels it has. These jewels store the excessive electricity POKENAME generates, and if one of them gets damaged or snaps in half, all of the stored energy breaks free and electrocutes everything around.

entry: POKENAME躲在黑暗洞窟，防范捕食者和盗猎者。光束照到晶体时，会折射出彩虹光谱，照亮周围洞窟。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME hide within dark caves to protect themselves from predators and poachers alike. When a beam of light hits one of their crystals, the light refracts into a rainbow spectrum that illuminates the cave around them.

entry: POKENAME每次跃出水面，都会在海中留下细小粉晶。有些珠宝匠会收集它们，制作昂贵项链。
author: .izik
source: Each time POKENAME leaps from the water, it leaves behind tiny pink crystals in the ocean. Some jewelers collect these for use in high-priced necklaces.

entry: POKENAME用晶体做刀刃，裁开布料，设计精巧飘逸的式样，深受高级裁缝喜爱。它用冰晶装点礼服，让穿着者在炎热中保持清凉。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME fashion blades out of crystals to cut through cloth and form intricate, flowing designs, making them popular companions for high-end tailors. They decorate their gowns with icy crystals to keep the wearer cool in the heat.

entry: 它宝石般美丽的身体，坚硬如钻石。这种宝可梦能用巨大健壮的手臂，在洞壁上捶出隧道，头上的钻头刺穿钢铁，也像穿纸一样。
author: jadey.1557
source: Its beautiful, gem-like body is as tough as diamond. This Pokémon is capable of punching tunnels through cave walls with its massive, muscular arms. The drills upon its head can puncture even steel as though it were paper.

entry: POKENAME手臂上的花束由精细切割的钻石构成。它会把钻石当弹丸射向敌人。
author: hophoppip
