source: The bouquets on POKENAME's arms are made of intricately cut diamonds. It fires them as projectiles at its enemies.

entry: 这种欢乐的宝可梦，偶尔能在洞顶很高的宝石洞窟中找到。POKENAME充满爱心、性情善良，在野外天生就倾向于担任保护者。
author: nyoomymph
source: This joyful Pokémon is found, rarely, in gemstone caves with high ceilings. POKENAME is loving and kindhearted, and naturally inclined to the role of a protector in the wild.

entry: 看POKENAME有多少珠宝，就能判断年龄。珠宝储存它生成的多余电力，一颗若受损或断成两半，所有储能就会冲出，电击周围一切。
author: milchik
source: This Pokémon's age can be judged by how many jewels it has. These jewels store the excessive electricity POKENAME generates, and if one of them gets damaged or snaps in half, all of the stored energy breaks free and electrocutes everything around.

entry: POKENAME喜欢在新闻和体育赛事直播中担任吉祥物。它密切留意相关评论，拆解无关或有害的内容，吞食构成评论的数据。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME enjoy acting as mascots during live coverage of news and sporting events. They closely monitor commentary that is being made about the coverage, deconstructing irrelevant or harmful comments and feeding on the constituent data.

entry: POKENAME喜欢闯进直播，用华丽粉钻晃花观众的眼。观看者会陷入恍惚，觉得非看下去不可，还不断念着“小碎钻”。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME like to invade livestreams to bedazzle the viewers with their glamorous pink diamonds. Those watching when this happens fall into a trance where they feel the need to keep watching them while saying "Carbink" repeatedly.

entry: POKENAME翻查大型矿业公司的数据库，希望发现新晶矿的信息。一得知位置，就会飞奔过去，在岩石里寻找，把精选宝石融入身体。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME search through the databases of large mining firms in the hopes of discovering information on new crystal mines. They race to these mines upon discovering them, searching through the rocks and incorporating choice gemstones into their body.

entry: POKENAME被广泛视为丛林最美的宝可梦。它坐在高树上时，鲜亮粉晶透过树冠投下光，在地面织出华美图案。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: POKENAME is widely regarded as the most beautiful Pokémon of the jungle. As it sits high in trees, its bright pink crystals cast light through the canopy, creating a gorgeous pattern on the ground below.

entry: POKENAME身体许多宝石状部分，能吸收、储存附近任何光源的能量。遇险时，它会蜷成球，把储能化成光束，射向四面八方。
author: sk372
source: The many gem-like parts of POKENAME's body absorb and store energy from any sources of light nearby. When in danger, it curls up into a ball and fires the stored energy as beams of light in every direction.

entry: POKENAME被视为小碎钻中的女王，能把纯粹情感化成同样纯净的晶体。许多人把晶体当珍宝，但它和小碎钻臣民都会奋力守护。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME is considered to be a queen among Carbink, capable of manifesting pure emotions as equally-pure crystals. Said crystals are considered treasures to many, but are fervently defended by POKENAME and its Carbink subjects.

entry: POKENAME的晶体心脏在情侣身边会发光，因此传言这光代表两人是灵魂伴侣。有些个体也会参加婚礼，以光芒见证伴侣的结合。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME's crystalline heart shines when in the presence of couples, which led to rumors that this light signifies the couple are soulmates. Some POKENAME are seen taking part in wedding ceremonies, sealing the bond between partners with their glow.

entry: 构成POKENAME的108块晶体碎片，每块都困着一个灵魂。若足够喜爱训练家，它就会丢掉最古老的灵魂，换成训练家的。
author: deer_witch
source: There's a soul trapped in each of the 108 crystal shards that make up POKENAME. If it likes its trainer enough, POKENAME will discard its oldest soul and replace it with its Trainer's.

entry: POKENAME用钻石鳍在地下高速挖洞。它猎食勾魂眼，为的是吃掉对方的宝石。
author: wiseginseng
source: POKENAME uses its diamond fins to dig tunnels underground at high speed. It preys on Sableyes to eat their gems.

entry: 它们的晶体闪着储存的自然光，不过被激怒就会很危险。它们允许信任的生物触碰晶体，却会向威胁释放光束。据说发出的光温柔而暖和。
author: infinex21
source: Though their crystals shine with the natural light they have stored, they are dangerous if provoked. They let those they trust touch their crystals but will loose beams of light at threats; the light they emit is said to be gentle and warm.

entry: POKENAME背上的宝石会自然剥落碎片，供它使用。藤蔓将其高速掷出后，碎片能把有毒化学物质渗入敌人体内。
author: quackquackattack
source: The gem on POKENAME's back naturally flakes off shards for them to use. These shards become high velocity projectiles when thrown from their vines and leech toxic chemicals into the bodies of their foes.

entry: POKENAME住在深海洞窟，用闪亮的钻石状突起吸引猎物。它行动灵活，能钻入淤泥躲避其他捕食者，也能靠侧鳍和尾鳍优雅游泳。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is found in deep ocean caves, attracting prey with its glittering diamond-like growths. It is highly mobile, burrowing into the silt to avoid other predators and swimming gracefully with its side and tail fins.

entry: POKENAME头骨上的宝石十分醒目，却不太坚固。头锤虽然威力惊人，宝石却很容易碎裂。
author: bostroms
source: The gem that covers POKENAME's skull is striking but not very tough.  While its headbutts possess devastating power, the gem fractures easily.

entry: 触碰嵌在它毛里的耀眼钻石，可能会看见将临灾祸或天灾的幻象。数百年来，空灵的美吸引并启发无数诗人，为它献上十四行诗与篇篇诗句。
author: fiordaliso
source: Those who touch the dazzling diamonds embedded in its fur may catch visions of impending disasters or natural catastrophes. For centuries, its ethereal beauty has enchanted and inspired countless poets, who dedicated sonnets and verses to it.

entry: POKENAME面对大多数人都会迅速逃走，却能用许多粉晶保护其他宝可梦，似乎单靠意念就能操控。头上大宝石，还能治愈其他宝可梦的伤。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are quick to flee from most people, but will protect other Pokémon with their many pink crystals that they seem to control through thought alone. They have the ability to heal the injuries of other Pokémon via the large gem on their head.

entry: POKENAME洞窟般的壳，是小碎钻的家。作为回报，小碎钻守卫壳里的珠宝，抵御勾魂眼等入侵者。壳中能自然生长晶体，让它成为备受追捧的融合体。
author: ramensracing
source: POKENAME's cavernous shell serves as a home for Carbink, who will, in return, guard the cave's jewels from Sableye and other intruders. Its ability to naturally grow crystals in its shell has made it a highly sought after fusion.

entry: 这把有意识的剑，剑刃硬如钻石，却远不如钻石易碎。它住在洞窟，用晶体微光引来猎物，再吸干生命力。
author: hophoppip
source: The blade of this sentient sword is as hard as diamond and far less brittle. It dwells in caves, luring in prey with the glimmer of its crystal before sapping its lifeforce.

entry: POKENAME由纯钻石构成，无物不能切开。闪亮的粉色盾牌实在太重，从没有人成功举起。
author: soup1900
source: With it being made of pure diamond, there is nothing that POKENAME can't slice through. No person has ever succeeded in lifting POKENAME's glittering pink shield, as the weight of it is far too great for anyone to handle.

entry: POKENAME美丽的粉钻能催发闪电般迅速的攻击，碾压敌人。自古以来，它就是守卫王族寝宫的热门选择。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME's beautiful pink diamonds act as catalysts for the lightning-fast attacks it uses to crush foes. Since ancient times, it has been a popular choice for guarding the private chambers of royalty.

entry: POKENAME的晶体翅膀不断生长，每次高速掠过天空，才会慢慢磨平。若留在地上太久，翅膀就会重得飞不起来。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's crystalline wings constantly grow, slowly being smoothed out every time it speeds through the sky. If POKENAME ever stays grounded for too long, its wings will become too heavy for it to fly.

entry: 它用纤细触角压缩空气中的碳，造出硬如钻石的晶体，再狂风骤雨般掷向敌人。每天大部分时间，它都在打磨自身晶体，直到明亮闪耀。
author: infinex21
source: It uses its thin feelers to compress carbon in the air to create diamond-hard crystals, which it flings at its foes in furious flurries. It spends much of its day polishing its own crystals until they gleam brightly.

entry: POKENAME翱翔在天空极高处，华美晶体灿烂发光。地面看不见，许多摄影师和观光者因此搭机升空，只为一生难得一见的机会。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME soar through the uppermost parts of the sky where their resplendent crystals shine bright. They are not visible from the ground, so many photographers and sightseers take planes into the sky for a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to see them.

entry: POKENAME住在神奥海拔最高的洞窟，能操控岩石和宝石周围的时空。宝石在它身旁，短短纳秒间就会形成、闪耀、风化。
author: beatdoof
source: Living in the highest-altitude cave in Sinnoh, POKENAME controls the flow of time and space around rocks and gemstones. In its presence, gems form, shine, and erode all in nanoseconds.

entry: POKENAME全身的电气石能收存多余电力，如发电机般蓄能。进入战斗，它便震碎部分晶体，解除限制，全力出战。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: The tourmaline along POKENAME's body helps it contain any excess electricity, building up energy as a sort of generator. When it enters battle, it will shatter off fragments of crystal to remove its limiters and fight at full force.

entry: POKENAME极其虚荣，谁未经允许碰它，就会挨一记快踢。过去，优雅的外貌和举止，让它深受贵族喜爱。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME is extremely vain and punishes those who touch it without permission with a swift kick. In the past, it was a popular Pokémon for nobles due to its elegant appearance and attitude.

entry: POKENAME的凝胶充满细钻和近乎微观的晶体，在光下闪闪发亮。靠近核心的凝胶维持着异常高压，类似地幔深处的环境。
author: quietcognition
source: POKENAME's gel is filled with tiny diamonds and near-microscopic crystals that make it sparkle in the light. The gel close to its core is kept at anomalously high pressures, similar to those in the depths of the mantle.

entry: POKENAME伪装成奢华棺材，引来并惩罚盗贼。它常释放闪亮美丽的粉雾，对曾善待自己的生物，这雾还能恢复活力。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME disguise themselves as extravagant coffins to lure and punish robbers. The pink mist that they often release sparkles beautifully and, to those who have treated them well, it is also revitalizing.

entry: POKENAME头上的火含有大量锂，因此燃成鲜粉色。研究显示，身上滴落的蜡承受高温高压后，能产出锂云母，这种美丽的含锂晶体。
author: bollocksmen
source: The flame on POKENAME's head burns bright pink due to a great concentration of lithium. Studies show that when subjected to high pressure and temperature, the wax which drips from its body can yield lepidolite, a beautiful lithium-based crystal.

entry: POKENAME的长牙锋利坚硬，能切开钻石，而钻石正是它最爱的食物。因此，它体内也会生成同样珍贵的晶体。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's tusks are so sharp and strong that they can cut through diamonds, which is exactly what it prefers to eat. This has resulted in its body producing equally valuable crystals.

entry: POKENAME的晶体身体光芒耀眼，世界各地都能看见。人们相信，它源自古代文明，是为守护文明而造。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: Its crystal body gleams so brightly that it can be seen across the world. It's believed that POKENAME came from ancient civilisations, created in order to protect them.

entry: POKENAME过去曾为年轻贵族小姐保管珠宝。它收藏的耳环、吊坠和戒指，样样都是少女想用来打扮自己的珍品。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME once kept jewelry safe for young noble ladies. Their collection of earrings, pendants and rings were everything a young maiden would have wanted to make themselves look pretty.

entry: POKENAME的晶体翅膀储存大量能量，过程中变得极热。受威胁时，它会猛地释放能量，焚烧四周。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's crystalline wings store large amounts of energy, becoming super-heated in the process. When threatened, it forcefully releases the energy to burn up its surroundings.

entry: POKENAME年纪越大，身上的宝石颜色就越深。以其制作的珠宝，尤其来自年老个体的，能卖出数百万的高价。据报告，佩戴者会感到温暖，心生智慧。
author: chibitales
source: The gems on POKENAME's body grow deeper in color as it ages. Jewelry made from these gemstones, especially from older POKENAME, sells for millions. Reports claim the jewelry gives the wearer a sense of warmth and wisdom.

entry: POKENAME全身披着纯净粉钻，许多人视为美的顶点。它虽能实现愿望，多数求愿者一见钻石就满心贪欲，因此被它置之不理。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME has a body clad in pure, pink diamonds that are considered by many to be the pinnacle of beauty. Although it is able to grant wishes, most who desire so are filled with greed upon the seeing its diamonds and thus are ignored by it.

entry: 它们会掉落熔融碎片，精炼加工后能制成火焰宝珠。它们厌恶一切与水有关的东西，因为哪怕一点水，也会让体内温度迅速降低。
author: quackquackattack
source: They drop molten shards, which when refined and processed can produce a Flame Orb. They abhor everything aquatic, as even a small amount of water rapidly lowers their internal temperature.

entry: 过去，人们以为POKENAME行动迟缓，很容易盗取身上晶体。发现它能把晶体碎片高速射出后，盗猎者才意识到自己错了。
author: sk372
source: Once, it was thought that POKENAME's low mobility would make it easy to poach the crystals from its body. Poachers realized their mistake after learning it can fire these crystal shards from its body as high-velocity projectiles.

entry: POKENAME的宝石看似美丽，其实也是储存极猛烈毒液的容器。向猎物注毒时，能看见宝石的颜色逐渐褪去。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's gems may look beautiful, but they double as containers for POKENAME's exceedingly virulent venom. One can see the color drain from the gems as it injects prey with the toxins.

entry: POKENAME的叶片半透明，在黑暗中也闪着微光。它喜欢住在洞窟和峡谷，栖地常长出大丛晶体，害怕时就躲进去。
author: thesilverowls
source: POKENAME's leaves are translucent and even glimmer in the dark. They prefer to live in caverns and ravines. The regions they live in often grow large clumps of crystals, which they will hide in when scared.

entry: POKENAME优雅翱翔，以歌剧演唱家般的风采歌唱。周身晶体随歌声共鸣，使声音传到数英里外。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME elegantly soar through the sky and sing with the grace of an opera singer. The crystals around their body resonate with their voice so that their song can be heard from miles away.

entry: POKENAME缓缓走过洞底，寻找细晶粉，促进王冠生长。身体能伪装融入洞窟，因此当地许多“活晶体”的传闻都源自它。
author: leandermalurt
source: POKENAME moves slowly across the cavern floor, searching for fine crystal dust to grow its crown. Because its body is camouflaged against the cavern, POKENAME is the origin of many local rumours about living crystals.

entry: 中世纪时，POKENAME的力量、美貌和温柔性情，让许多王族渴望拥有。不过它拒绝服从贪婪、心灵不纯的人，据说还曾毁掉利用它的王国。
author: icelevelincarnate
source: POKENAME's strength, beauty, and gentle nature made it a species that many royalty sought to own in the medieval age. POKENAME also refused to obey those with a greedy, impure heart, and allegedly brought ruin to kingdoms that took advantage of them.

entry: POKENAME由致密金属和晶体双重构成，几乎不受伤害。它把储能导入躯干宝石，再释放巨大的聚光束。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's dual composition of dense metal and crystal makes it almost impervious to damage. It channels stored energy into the jewel on its torso before releasing a massive beam of concentrated light.

entry: POKENAME让激光穿过大粉钻，折射分散成多道耀眼闪亮的粉色光束。不过这番表演后，钻石会变暗，它便轰开地下，寻找更多。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME fires lasers through its large pink diamonds so that they refract and disperse into multiple eye-catching, sparkling pink beams. However, POKENAME's diamonds will darken after this display, so it blasts holes underground to search for more.

entry: POKENAME十分亲人，爱将宝石送给喜欢的对象。不过得保持距离，POKENAME抱得太有力，连岩石也能压成钻石。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is very affectionate and loves to give its jewels to anyone it likes. Just keep your distance, as POKENAME's hugs are powerful enough to compress rocks into diamonds.

entry: 常能见到POKENAME像嚼牙签一样嚼晶体碎片。奇怪的是，体内如血般流动的物质，哪怕只有一滴落下，碰到什么都能让其长出晶体。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME have commonly been seen chewing on crystal shards like toothpicks. Oddly, the substance that courses through them like blood will cause crystals to grow on whatever even just a single drop may fall upon.

entry: POKENAME生活在布满晶体的洞窟，沿各个表面爬行，用晶体爪击碎晶体吃。吃得越多，自己的晶体也长得越大，甚至妨碍行动。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME live within caves lined with crystals, skittering along any surface and using their crystalline claws to break apart crystals to feed on. The more they eat, the more their own crystals grow, even to the point they may struggle to move.

entry: POKENAME的粉晶对它常唱的旋律反应灵敏。晶体能承受高频声音，甚至储存声音，是许多人看重的材料。
author: infinex21
source: The pink crystals of POKENAME are very receptive to the melodies they so often sing. These crystals can endure high sonic frequencies and even can store sound within them, making them valuable materials for many humans.

entry: POKENAME优美旋舞时，会创造闪亮宝石，装点舞台，让表演更出彩。宝石的种类与大小，会随歌舞的音调和速度变化。
author: soup1900
source: As POKENAME twirls around in a beautiful dance, it creates sparkling gems to enhance its performance and set its dance stage. The type and size of each gem it creates changes with the tone and speed of its song and dance.

entry: POKENAME优美旋舞时，会创造闪亮宝石，装点舞台，让表演更出彩。宝石的种类与大小，会随歌舞的音调和速度变化。
author: soup1900
source: As POKENAME twirls around in a beautiful dance, it creates sparkling gems to enhance its performance and set its dance stage. The type and size of each gem it creates changes with the tone and speed of its song and dance.

entry: POKENAME用闪亮晶体装饰身体和舞台，增添舞蹈效果。转圈时，下半身附着的长晶体会向外伸展，把粉钻射向四面八方。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME decorates its body and stage with sparkling crystals to amplify its dancing performances. When it does a spin in its dance, the long crystals attached to the lower parts of its body stretch out and launch pink diamonds everywhere.

entry: 它的众多晶体能接住、储存和折射光，造就了华美传说。双钳能轻松夹碎钻石，不过平时更喜欢从全身释放聚焦光束战斗。
author: infinex21
source: Its many crystals catch, store, and refract light, lending to tales of its resplendent beauty. Its pincers can break diamond with ease, though it typically fights by loosing concentrated beams of light across its body.

entry: POKENAME的晶体始终吸收、储存周围环境光。有理论认为，若一次释放全部储能，爆发的光足以照亮整颗行星，甚至让所有生物失明。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's crystals absorb and store ambient light around it at all times. It is theorized that if it released all its stored energy at once, the resulting burst of light could illuminate and potentially blind the entire planet.

entry: POKENAME每片鳞中都嵌着粉钻，据说防御坚不可摧。它合着鳞片碰撞的节奏敲拳，便会造出钻石碎片，射得到处都是。
author: soup1900
source: With pink diamonds embedded in each of its scales, POKENAME's defense is said to be indestructible. It creates and launches shards of these diamonds flying everywhere when it pounds its fists together in rhythm to its clattering scales.

entry: POKENAME会嵌在靠近洞顶的岩壁内。有岩石属性宝可梦从下方经过，它就落下伏击。勾魂眼难以抗拒它，却敌不过晶体臂刃。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME can be found embedded within cave walls close to the ceiling. When any rock-type Pokémon pass beneath it, it will drop down and ambush them. Sableye find it irresistible, but they are no match for POKENAME's crystalline arm blades.

entry: POKENAME光亮的镰刀由纯钻石构成，无物不能切。它性情温和，却会拼命保护信任的生物。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME's lustrous sickles are made of pure diamond, allowing it to cut through anything. It has a gentle demeanor while also being fiercely protective of those it trusts.

entry: POKENAME在富含宝石的洞窟安家，用找到的最坚固宝石锻造武器，守护家园。鬃毛最长的通常是首领，但仍得在战斗中证明自己。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME make their homes in gem-rich caverns, forging weapons from the sturdiest gems they can find so they may defend their homes. The POKENAME with the longest mane is typically the leader, but they still must prove themselves in battle.

entry: POKENAME把法杖当探矿杖，直达珍贵宝石所在。它凭直觉就能分辨真假珠宝，嫌弃地烧掉赝品。珠宝匠常雇它寻找完美宝石。
author: ghostslythe
source: POKENAME use their staff like a divining rod, leading them right to precious gems. Intuitively they can tell real from fake jewels, and burn replicas in disgust. Jewelers often hire their services for pristine precious stones.

entry: POKENAME最喜欢看两人相爱，常试着强行撮合。这导致一个毫无根据的传言：只要你和伴侣看见它，就会结婚。
author: weirdmageddonprepper_93813
source: POKENAME loves nothing more than seeing two people fall in love and will frequently attempt to force people together. These attempts led to an unfounded rumor that if you and your partner see POKENAME, you will get married.

entry: POKENAME优雅飘过高层大气，珠宝般的身体像活彗星一样闪耀。据说它脱落的粉尘，能给沾上的生物带来好运。
author: ilyhef
source: POKENAME drifts gracefully through the upper atmosphere, its jeweled body glimmering like a living comet. The dust it sheds is said to bring luck to those it touches.

entry: 它美丽的粉色裙装般身体，让各地人和宝可梦都看得赞叹。据说，只一颗粉钻就价值连城。
author: soup1900
source: Its beautiful, pink, dress-like body has caused it to be a sight to behold by people and Pokémon everywhere. A single pink diamond from this Pokémon is said to be worth a fortune.

entry: POKENAME岩石里的晶体，始终充盈着能量。危险靠近，它便让核心猛然发光，把碎片撒向四方。
author: jackjirachi
source: The crystal inside of POKENAME's rock is constantly brimming with energy. When danger nears it, POKENAME flares its core, scattering shards in every direction.

entry: 据说POKENAME头顶的粉色心形钻石，是世上最珍稀的宝石。它使出的钻石风暴璀璨夺目，没有别的宝可梦能重现。
author: soup1900
source: It is said that the pink heart-shaped diamond on POKENAME's head is the rarest gem in the world. A Diamond Storm from this Pokémon creates a dazzling display of gems that cannot be replicated by any other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME珠宝明艳，毛发光滑，是深受喜爱的宠物，也象征地位。它自己也喜欢因美貌而备受关注和赞美。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's radiant jewels and glossy fur make it quite popular as a pet that doubles as a status symbol. POKENAME itself loves being lavished with attention and praise for its beautiful appearance.

entry: 情侣遇到POKENAME，被视为好运。薄纱和石花让它像婚礼上的新娘，喙和鳍状脚又显得可爱，让人难以生气。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are regarded as lucky Pokémon for couples to come across. Their veil and stony flowers make them look like they are a bride at a wedding while their bill and flippers give them a cute look that is hard to get angry at.

entry: POKENAME天性亲热，相信不断关心与送上耀眼礼物，最能让人觉得自己特别。它常花训练家的钱买礼物，还不明白主人为何生气。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: A POKENAME is very affectionate by nature, believing that constant attention and flashy gifts are the best way to make someone feel special. It often uses its Trainers' money to purchase these gifts, not understanding when they get upset.

entry: 一些高级婚庆公司会与POKENAME合作，设计如画婚礼。它不但懂得布置，还能搬动从蛋糕到交换戒指仪式背景柱的一切物件。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Some elite wedding companies work with POKENAME to design picturesque weddings. Not only do they have the eye for where everything goes, but the strength to carry everything from the cake to the pillars to frame the ring ceremony.

entry: POKENAME的翅膀因构造特殊，本身无法用于飞行。不过身体每颗闪亮粉晶都能使它浮空，翅膀上尤其多，因此不拍翼也照样能飞。
author: thordemidgard
source: Because of the way POKENAME's wings are made, it cannot use them to fly. However, each of the shimmering pink crystals that make up its body can make it float in the air; hence why its wings have so many, allowing it to still fly without moving them.

entry: 骑士时代，POKENAME被视为最美、最受敬重的坐骑，只有王国最伟大的人才配拥有。每位拥有它的骑士，都留下无数传说。
author: sk372
source: In the time of knights, POKENAME was considered the most beautiful and revered of steeds, worthy of only the greatest of their kingdoms. Every knight who possessed one had countless legends to their name.

entry: POKENAME携带强大的水晶棒，保护自己和训练家。光照到晶体，反射的光线便照亮周围。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME carry a mighty crystal baton that they wield to protect themselves and their Trainer. As light hits the crystal, the reflected rays of light illuminate the space around them.

entry: 长着大钻石头冠的那个头，因负重更多，颈部也更强壮。POKENAME得大量练习，才能跑得不失平衡。
author: hophoppip
source: The head with the large diamond crest has a stronger neck due to carrying more weight. It takes much practice for POKENAME to run without losing balance.

entry: POKENAME诞生于钻矿底部积聚的污染径流，淤泥身体里满是珍贵宝石。闪亮锋利的石头，既能保护它，也能在战斗中帮忙。
author: yuni_hermit
source: Born from polluted runoff steeped in the bottom of diamond mines, POKENAME's sludgy body is full of precious gems. These shiny, sharp stones protect and aid them in battle.

entry: POKENAME从炮口射出晶莹清水，其中含有微小晶体。在洞窟等暗处或夜里，水几乎泛着白光。有人说，它的水炮像耀眼激光。
author: ricolight
source: POKENAME shoots crystal-clear water out of their cannons with little microscopic crystals inside the water. The water glows almost white in dark places like caves or at night. Some people say POKENAME's Hydro Pumps look like dazzling laser beams.

entry: POKENAME借宝石反光，将自己装成钻石，实际上宝石全是朱砂。矿工若靠得太近，POKENAME会故意打碎多余宝石，释放液态汞。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME reflect light off of their jewels in order to disguise themselves as diamonds. In reality, their gems are made of cinnabar. If a miner gets too close, POKENAME will purposefully shatter spare gems to release liquid mercury.

entry: POKENAME常去美容院修指甲，打扮自己。训练家得准备花上不少宝可元，才能让它开心又光彩照人。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME spend lots of time at salons, where they get manicures to make themselves look pretty. Trainers who take care of POKENAME should be ready to spend lots of Pokédollars to keep them happy and looking fabulous.

entry: POKENAME用强大双钳压缩空气中的碳，瞬间造出几十颗小钻石。接着把钻石吃下，吸收进皮肤，让皮肤更坚硬。
author: santon5512
source: Using their powerful claws, POKENAME will compress the carbon in the air, instantly creating dozens of little diamonds. They then consume these diamonds, absorbing them into their skin in order to toughen it.

entry: 它把柔软粉藤卷成心形，常借此迷住、引来同伴。藤蔓还释放甜香，安抚附近宝可梦。
author: jaminmcready
source: It twirls its soft pink vines into heart shapes to charm others, often using them to lure in companions. These vines also release a sweet fragrance that calms nearby Pokémon.

entry: 它躲在盛开的花间，靠背上的心形花纹完美融入。受惊时，便释放糖香，让捕食者困倦。
author: jaminmcready
source: It hides among blooming flowers, blending perfectly with heart-shaped patterns along its back. When frightened, it releases a sugary scent that lulls predators into drowsiness.

entry: 观察发现，野生POKENAME爆炸后，其他宝可梦的繁殖率会在一段时间内陡增。人们相信，某种精灵球就是照它的外表设计的。
author: sk372
source: Its been observed that after a POKENAME explodes in the wild, the breeding rate of other Pokémon sees a sharp increase for a time. It's believed that a certain type of Pokéball is based on POKENAME's appearance.

entry: POKENAME长得像甜蜜球，性情也同样甜美。不过稍受冲击就会炸成闪光粉末，因此十分危险。
author: aberry8286
source: POKENAME resembles a Love Ball, and has a sweet behavior to match. It is known to be dangerous due to exploding into glitter at the slightest shock.

entry: POKENAME虽然大概是出于好意，爆炸的效果却被视为危险，因为可能让整座城的人只顾情爱，生活其他方面全都受害。
author: sk372
source: Though it presumably means well, the effects of a POKENAME explosion are considered dangerous, as it could render an entire city's population too focused on amorous relations, to the detriment of every other facet of life.

entry: POKENAME用骨头一击，有时能让目标强烈迷恋好几分钟。它会趁这短暂迷乱，安然逃脱。
author: .izik
source: A single strike from POKENAME's bone sometimes induces powerful infatuation for several minutes. It uses this brief confusion to escape unharmed.

entry: POKENAME的棍棒和头骨头盔，由类似心之鳞片的材料构成。它虽然珍惜棍棒，据说仍会送给全心爱着、信任的人。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's club and skull helmet are made from a material similar to Heart Scales. Although it considers the club precious, it is said that it will give the club to someone it loves and trusts with all its heart.

entry: POKENAME在魔杖上生成特殊薄膜，每挥一下都会冒出泡泡。它用纷飞泡泡表达喜爱，轻轻破裂、溅水的声音，能安慰附近孤独的人。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME produce a specialized film along their wands, creating bubbles with every swing. They produce a flurry of bubbles as a sign of affection, the soft popping and splashing soothing any lonely people nearby.

entry: POKENAME光滑的壳泛着柔和粉光，像熟透的果实。森林居民相信，春天遇到它，就能迎来充满爱与丰饶的一季。
author: jaminmcready
source: Its glossy shell gleams faintly with soft pink hues, resembling a ripened fruit. Forest dwellers believe spotting a POKENAME during spring will bring a season full of love and abundance.

entry: POKENAME充满慈爱，用拥抱和依偎表达感情。许多没有训练家或朋友的孤独宝可梦，会扑进它怀里，感受温柔拥抱。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are doting creatures that show affection through hugs and snuggles. Many lonely Pokémon who do not have Trainers or friends throw themselves into a POKENAME's arms to feel their kind embrace.

entry: POKENAME攻击时，泡泡总呈现完美心形。泡泡有时没有伤害，却仍常让敌人眼花。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME attacks, its bubbles always take on perfect heart shapes. These bubbles are sometimes harmless but nevertheless often dazzle foes.

entry: POKENAME孤独时，会把尾巴绕在另一只同类身上，在海里便能安心。据说，若尾巴缠住训练家，便是在表达真切的安慰与喜爱。
author: quackquackattack
source: It is known to wrap its tail around another POKENAME when it feels lonely, which helps it feel safe in the seas. If it wraps its tail around a Trainer, it is said to be a gesture of true comfort and affection.

entry: 潜水者太靠近水下洞窟时，POKENAME会吐出心形泡泡，警告对方离开。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spits heart-shaped bubbles at scuba divers who wander too close to its underwater cave, warning them away.

entry: POKENAME住在婚礼场地附近的湖里，颜色来自最终被扫进水中的花瓣。婚礼举行时，它便浮上水面，兴致勃勃地观看。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME live in lakes near wedding venues, their pigmentation derived from the petals that are eventually swept into the water. When weddings occur, they float to the top of the surface and watch the event with keen interest.

entry: POKENAME游在婚礼场地附近的湖中，花瓣让鳞片染上粉色。它会和新人一起庆祝，兴奋时还会向空中放出粉泡泡。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME swim in lakes near wedding venues, the petals giving their scales a pink tinge. They celebrate alongside couples and release pink bubbles into the air when excited.

entry: POKENAME群出没的地区，是热门的浪漫度假地。据说若有野生个体跟随一对情侣，在近旁振翅，两人便能长久幸福地生活。
author: sk372
source: Areas where swarms of POKENAME roam are popular romantic getaways. It's said that should a wild POKENAME follow and flutter close to a couple, they will have a long and blissful life together.

entry: POKENAME性情温和，不介意人在身旁。有时盗猎者会过早扯下心形肢体，当装饰品卖。幸好这些肢体随时间能重新长出。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME are mild-natured and do not mind the presence of people. Sometimes, poachers prematurely rip off POKENAME's heart-shaped limbs and sell them as decoration. Thankfully, they can regrow back over time.

entry: 夏季，它会浮近海滩，观察路人。若察觉一群人相处愉快，身上的球体便开始放出灿烂光芒。
author: bobosmith01
source: It floats close towards beaches in summertime, observing passerby. If it detects a group of people having a happy time together, the orb on its body begins to glow with a radiant light.

entry: 夏季，它会浮近海滩，观察路人。若察觉一群人相处愉快，身上的球体便开始放出灿烂光芒。
author: bobosmith01
source: It floats close towards beaches in summertime, observing passersby. If it detects a group of people having a happy time together, the orb on its body begins to glow with a radiant light.

entry: 它能靠哑剧动作创造看不见的物件，常用这能力为随意凑成的两个人安排浪漫约会。
author: hophoppip
source: It can create invisible objects by pantomiming them. It tends to use these powers to set up romantic dates for random pairs of humans.

entry: POKENAME镰刀上的巨型心之鳞片十分值钱，因此野外常遭盗猎。若发现情侣之间有怨气，它会猛烈劈砍空气，想把两人吓得重新靠在一起。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME are constant targets of poaching in the wild due to the gigantic Heart Scales on their scythes being very valuable. If they spot bitterness between a couple, they slash furiously at the air to scare them back together.

entry: POKENAME以挑逗的舞蹈吸引注意。人群聚来后，它便释放精神能量，让观众心生善意和爱意。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME dance provocatively to draw attention to themselves. Once a crowd has gathered, they release psychic energy that instills kind and affectionate feelings in the audience.

entry: POKENAME一发现可能相爱的两人，就会用角夹住、拖到一起。不过往往还没凑近，两人就已昏倒，因为角上不小心蹭到他们身上的口红，被错认成了血。
author: soup1900
source: When POKENAME finds a potential couple, it clamps and drags them with its horns to be with each other. However, the couple often faints before they get together, as the lipstick accidentally smeared on them from its horns gets mistaken for blood.

entry: POKENAME一发现可能相爱的两人，就会用角夹住、拖到一起。不过往往还没凑近，两人就已昏倒，因为角上不小心蹭到他们身上的口红，被错认成了血。
author: soup1900
source: When POKENAME finds a potential couple, it clamps and drags them with its horns to be with each other. However, the couple often faints before they get together, as the lipstick accidentally smeared on them from its horns gets mistaken for blood.

entry: POKENAME冲锋时，扬起的尘土会形成小爱心。有些地方认为，它冲向一对情侣，能带来永恒的爱。
author: pattybgoode
source: As POKENAME charges, the dust it kicks up forms tiny hearts. In some places, a POKENAME charging at a couple is said to bring eternal love.

entry: 过去，有人拿POKENAME冒充真正的爱心鱼，骗那些买不起爱心鱼送心上人的人。不过，它亲昵的性情和可爱外表，让它本身也成了受欢迎的礼物。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME was once used to scam those who couldn't afford a proper Luvdisc to give to their loved ones. Its affectionate personality and cute appearance made it become an acceptable gift in its own right.

entry: 它吐出细而黏的丝，像一条条缎带。有时情侣醒来，会发现手上被轻轻缠着这些丝。
author: jaminmcready
source: It spins thin, sticky threads that look like ribbons. Sometimes, couples wake up with these wrapped gently around their hands.

entry: POKENAME看见接吻，就会游出心形轨迹。有人相信，它完全靠别人的情感温暖维生。
author: .izik
source: When it witnesses a kiss, POKENAME swims in heart-shaped loops. Some believe it survives solely on the emotional warmth of others.

entry: 无法飞越水域送信时，它会跨海把冲浪邮件送到不同大陆。它能确保信件干爽抵达，漂流瓶送信已因此过时。
author: quackquackattack
source: When flying across water is not feasible, it passes Surf Mail across the sea to different continents. The letter in the bottle has become obsolete, as it ensures that the letter arrives at the destination without getting wet.

entry: POKENAME必须与训练家配合无间，才能发挥全部潜力。野生个体住在温暖海洋，研究者发现，许多生物靠近它时，情场运气会明显变好。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: POKENAME need to partner with Trainers in perfect sync in order to meet their full potential. In the wild, they live in warm oceans, and researchers have found that many experience significantly more luck in romance when they are near.

entry: POKENAME对人类十分亲热，会跃出水面，给训练家一个充满爱意的冲撞，顺带泼对方一身水。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME is highly affectionate with humans. It's been known to leap from the water to give its Trainer a loving tackle, splashing water on them in the process.

entry: POKENAME最早被记录的出现地点，是历史最久、最成功的网络交友网站之一。传说收到示爱消息后若看见它，就是爱情即将萌芽的好兆头。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's first documented appearance was on one of the oldest and most successful of online dating sites. Rumors say if it appears after one receives a romantic message, it's a positive omen towards a blossoming love.

entry: 古代文明中，人们会送POKENAME给伴侣，作为爱的告白。这传统在现代依然延续。
author: dodoowner_
source: Ancient civilizations gave POKENAME to their partner as a confession of love. This tradition still lives on today in the modern world.

entry: POKENAME的毒液能制成特殊粉墨，情侣用它在法律文书上表达彼此的爱。50只才能产一瓶，因此这种墨水被视为身份象征。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME venom can be made into a special pink ink that is used by couples to show their love for each other on legal documents. It takes 50 POKENAME to produce a bottle of this special ink, which is why the ink is seen as a status symbol.

entry: 它静止不动，但放在情书旁会轻轻哼鸣。有人相信，它正吸收爱意，保护进化过程中的自己。
author: jaminmcready
source: It stays still, but when placed near love letters, it gives off a soft hum. Some believe it's absorbing feelings of love to protect itself during evolution.

entry: POKENAME用镰刀刃反光，制造耀眼的棱彩光景，让目睹者短暂看不见，从而避免冲突。刀刃由和心之鳞片一样迷人的材料构成。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME avoids violence by reflecting light into a dazzling prismatic display using its scything blades, briefly blinding those who see it. These blades are made of the same mesmerizing material as Heart Scales.

entry: POKENAME用复杂舞蹈向潜在伴侣展示自己，虹彩双翼接住光线，显出绚丽色彩。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME show off to their potential partners with intricate dances, their iridescent wings catching the light to display gorgeous colors.

entry: POKENAME极其亲热，常抱住喜欢的生物，好几分钟都不肯放。靠着熟睡的它入眠，常能做浪漫甜蜜的好梦。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a very affectionate sort, often hugging those it likes and refusing to let go for several minutes. Sleeping against a slumbering POKENAME often induces pleasant dreams of romance and love.

entry: 野生POKENAME常在珊瑚礁里休息。睡着时，它散发安抚气息，减轻附近宝可梦的敌意。
author: kittyluv090
source: Wild POKENAME are often found resting in coral reefs. When they sleep, they emit a soothing aura that reduces hostility in nearby Pokémon.

entry: 显微镜下，POKENAME的鳞片呈心形，带着微光。古籍称，它们曾是爱情药水的原料。
author: .izik
source: Under a microscope, POKENAME's scales are heart-shaped and shimmer faintly. Ancient texts claim they were once ingredients in love potions.

entry: POKENAME美丽的鳞片在黑市利润极高，盗猎者几乎将它猎至灭绝。据说若把它带离湖泊，厚云会遮住太阳，一连数日。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: Poachers have almost hunted POKENAME to near-extinction for its lovely scales, which are highly profitable on the black market. It's said that when POKENAME is taken away from its lake, heavy clouds will block out the sun for days on end.

entry: POKENAME能预测一段关系的成败。若发现两人命中注定，它就会强行让彼此相遇。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME predicts whether a relationship will succeed or fail. If it sees two people destined for each other, it will force their paths to cross.

entry: 它快速飞出心形环圈，保护在意的生物。毒刺击中时，会像闪光粉一样闪耀。
author: jaminmcready
source: It flies in fast, heart-shaped loops to protect those it cares about. Its stingers sparkle like glitter when they strike.

entry: POKENAME弱小亲昵，但争夺伴侣时，为了获胜却会绝不留情。据说这种求偶场面可怕得让它没有天敌。
author: icelevelincarnate
source: POKENAME are feeble and affectionate creatures, but when competing for a mate, they are known to be absolutely merciless in the pursuit of victory. These displays of courtship are apparently so horrendous, POKENAME have no natural predators.

entry: POKENAME偶尔出现在热闹海滩的浅水，漂在波浪上方。看见情侣，它便派同群的一只爱心鱼，往两人脸上吹无害泡泡，捉弄一番。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME occasionally appears in the shallow waters of crowded beaches, floating just above the waves. When it sees a couple, it sends one of the Luvdisc from its school to prank them by harmlessly blowing bubbles in their faces.

entry: POKENAME栖居潟湖，喜欢游到船边，用藤蔓泼水陪人玩。颈部长出的海带叶咸甜可口，吃下会促进催产素释放。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME inhabit lagoons and love swimming up to boats to play with people by splashing them with their vines. The kelp leaves growing on their necks have a sweet and salty flavor and stimulate oxytocin release when eaten.

entry: POKENAME虽能上岸行走，却更喜欢水下生活。颈间饰毛常充当光源，照亮深海。
author: chaotic_aspergers
source: Although POKENAME can walk on land, it much prefers living underwater. Its ruff often acts as a light source, illuminating the depths of the ocean.

entry: 古老传统里，伴郎会在仪式中被POKENAME喷水。人们相信，这能带来婚姻幸福。
author: .izik
source: In old traditions, groomsmen would be sprayed by POKENAME during the ceremony. The ritual was believed to bring marital happiness.

entry: POKENAME鸣叫的节奏与心跳相合。据说两只同步歌唱时，听见的人很快就会遇到特别的那个人。
author: jaminmcready
source: Its chirps match the rhythm of a heartbeat. When two POKENAME sing in sync, it's said the people who hear them will soon meet someone special.

entry: POKENAME守护睡在水边的宝可梦，确保连最弱小的也安全。若它们遇险，它便跃上空中，尽可能滑向远处求援。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME stands guard over Pokémon sleeping by the water, making sure even the weakest are safe. If they are in danger, it will leap into the air, gliding as far as it can to request help.

entry: POKENAME身体细长，毛发光滑，游泳快得惊人。爱玩的性子，让它连最固执的宝可梦也能迅速交上朋友。
author: comfortablybrum
source: Thanks to its long, slender body and slick coat of fur, POKENAME is an incredibly fast swimmer. Its playful nature can quickly make friends of even the most stubborn Pokémon.

entry: 满月升起，成群POKENAME在大片水域求偶，把水面染成灿烂玫瑰色。据说，在粉湖岸边求婚的情侣，定能婚姻幸福。
author: afilthycasual
source: When a full moon rises, flocks of POKENAME come together for courtship in large bodies of water, turning the surface a brilliant shade of rose. Couples proposing on the shores of pink lakes are said to be guaranteed happy marriages.

entry: POKENAME喜欢以爱情为主题的节日，常应请求织出心形、花朵的蛛网。令它沮丧的是，有人却拿美丽的网来结束恋情。
author: chaotic_aspergers
source: POKENAME loves romance-centered holidays and often spins webs of hearts and flowers for those who request its help. Much to its dismay, some people use its pretty webs to end romantic relationships.

entry: 情侣遇到这种宝可梦，它就会用网把两人绑在一起，实实在在地连成一体。虽是好意，却常把人吓坏，没能催生爱意，有时反而彻底毁掉关系。
author: soup1900
source: If a couple encounters this Pokémon, it will tie them in a web to physically bond them together. Despite its good intentions, this often frightens the couple rather than instilling love, sometimes ruining their relationship altogether.

entry: 它飞过湖泊时，会落下柔软的心形羽毛。捡到一根被认为代表爱情就在附近，尤其是在清晨。
author: jaminmcready
source: As it flies over lakes, it sheds soft, heart-shaped feathers. Finding one is believed to mean love is nearby, especially during the early morning hours.

entry: POKENAME散发柔光，几乎能迷住任何水属性宝可梦。许多生物把光误认成真爱的信号。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME emits a soft glow that can infatuate almost any Water-type Pokémon. Many mistake its light for a sign of true love.

entry: 据说情侣若在新年第一天看见POKENAME的光，就会永远相守。它开心时，光会闪成红色。
author: .izik
source: It's said that couples who witness POKENAME's glow on the first day of a new year will stay together forever. The light flickers red when it is happy.

entry: POKENAME游在溪流，偶尔释放小电脉冲，在水面闪耀。古老故事称，一起欣赏的情侣永不分离。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME swim in streams, occasionally releasing small electric pulses that sparkle across the water. Old tales say couples who watch this display will never drift apart.

entry: 每到春天，POKENAME在空中成群聚集，互相交换情书。这启发了一款电子游戏：玩家得依据信的内容，把信封送给正确的那只。
author: dodoowner_
source: Every spring, groups of POKENAME flock together in the sky to exchange love letters with each other. This behavior has inspired a video game where players must deliver envelopes to the correct POKENAME based on the contents of the letter.

entry: 它宽大的翅膀扇出温暖、带花香的风。人们说，它飞过头顶时举行的婚礼，会得到长久爱情和好运的祝福。
author: jaminmcready
source: Its wide wings send out warm, flower-scented winds. People say weddings held while it flies overhead are blessed with lasting love and good fortune.

entry: POKENAME独处时十分脆弱，因此结群生活，保障安全。它的静电会把泡泡吸到身体附近。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME are very vulnerable alone, so they live in herds for safety. Its static draws bubbles close to its body.

entry: 很久以前，旅人会沿着POKENAME留在草地、山坡上的花瓣小径走，相信终点有命定爱人。据说有人至今仍徘徊其中，坚信内心的答案就在前方。
author: jaminmcready
source: Long ago, travelers followed the petal trails POKENAME left across meadows and hillsides, believing they would lead to their destined love. It is said some still wander those paths, convinced their heart's answer lies just ahead.

entry: 它们原本的栖地还在从污染中恢复，因此住在野生原野区等自然保护区。想家时，一小瓶海潮薰香就能让它们安心。
author: quackquackattack
source: Their natural habitat is recovering from pollution and as such they live in natural reserves such as the Safari Zone. When they feel homesick, a vial of Sea Incense helps them feel at ease.

entry: 若看见湖边有情侣，POKENAME会采集香蒲绒穗，像花束一样送出。据说它无论在哪里发现爱情，都会为之庆祝。
author: .izik
source: If it spots couples by its lake, POKENAME gathers tufts of cattail and presents them like bouquets. It's said to celebrate love wherever it finds it.

entry: POKENAME爱看情侣亲热，会一动不动地站着，盼被错认成树。不过这计划很少成功。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME loves to watch couples be romantic. It stands very still as it watches in hopes that it will be mistaken for a tree, though this plan rarely works.

entry: POKENAME飘过公园，叶片散发类似蔓莓果的香气。传闻它能让下方的生物突然萌生爱慕。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME drifts over parks, releasing a Razz Berry-like scent from its leaves. It's rumored to spark sudden crushes in those beneath it.

entry: POKENAME靠柔软泡泡浮空，在天空滑翔。难得落地时，孩子们喜欢用它产生的泡泡玩游戏。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME glide through the sky and are kept afloat by their soft bubbles. On the rare occasion they are on the ground, children enjoy playing games with the bubbles POKENAME create.

entry: 它会收集心形种子和食物碎屑，放在喜欢的人附近。捡到一个，就代表这只宝可梦选择信任你。
author: jaminmcready
source: It gathers seeds and crumbs shaped like hearts and leaves them near people it likes. Finding one means this Pokémon has chosen you as someone it trusts.

entry: POKENAME浮在水面进行光合作用，把能量储存在虹彩心形花瓣里。不过得提防相爱的情侣，对方可能想摘花瓣当浪漫礼物。
author: lordjoostmeister
source: Floating at the water's surface, POKENAME photosynthesizes and stores energy in its iridescent, heart-shaped petals. It must keep an eye out for loving couples, who may attempt to pluck POKENAME's petals as romantic gifts.

entry: 两只POKENAME在盛开的花田相遇，就会动作完全同步地摇摆，直到日落。受此启发，有些情侣在它们跳舞的地方种花，盼着爱情长久。
author: jaminmcready
source: When two POKENAME meet in blooming fields, they sway together until the sun sets, their movements perfectly in sync. Inspired by the sight, some human couples plant flowers where the Pokémon danced, hoping for lasting love.

entry: POKENAME产出的泥会用于婚礼妆容，人们相信能增进爱情，让感情在困境中依然牢固。
author: .izik
source: The mud POKENAME creates is used in wedding makeup, believed to strengthen love. It is said to keep bonds strong through hardship.

entry: POKENAME若看见两个自认为相配的人，就会朝他们吐泥。这奇怪举动被视为幸运预兆。
author: .izik
source: If POKENAME sees two people it believes are compatible, it spits mud at them. The odd gesture is seen as a lucky omen.

entry: POKENAME能释放心形泡泡，碰到就令人开心。它悠闲待在浅水，常直接躺在太阳珊瑚上。野生个体往往只在恶劣天气才上岸。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME can release heart-shaped bubbles that, on contact, evoke feelings of happiness in others. It lounges in shallow waters, often right atop Corsola. Wild POKENAME often only come ashore during terrible weather.

entry: POKENAME能从尾巴放出心形泡泡，碰到就令人开心。它视力不好，却能像雷达一样感知附近情绪，用来辨路。
author: bobosmith01
source: Out of its tail, POKENAME can release heart-shaped bubbles that, on contact, evoke feelings of happiness in others. POKENAME cannot see well, but it can sense the emotions of those nearby to navigate, similar to a radar.

entry: POKENAME能从尾巴放出心形泡泡，碰到就令人开心。许多经营夏季生意的公司，会用它的形象宣传品牌。
author: bobosmith01
source: Out of its tail, POKENAME can release heart-shaped bubbles that, on contact, evoke feelings of happiness in others. Many summer seasonal companies use POKENAME's likeness to promote their brand.

entry: POKENAME是能预测年轻情侣是否相配的红娘。毛发极其敏感，能察觉遇到之人的心跳。
author: pattybgoode
source: POKENAME is a matchmaker who can predict the compatibility of young couples. Its fur is so sensitive that it can detect the heartbeats of the people it encounters.

entry: 恋爱中的人一靠近，POKENAME就会释放精神波。这些波动能将情感压抑二十四小时。
author: .izik
source: When approached by someone in love, POKENAME releases psychic waves. These waves suppress feelings for twenty-four hours.

entry: 许多爱心鱼融合体会被恋人互相赠送，POKENAME却另有用途。它几乎什么地方都能悄悄钻进去，因此暗恋者常让它送情书或小礼物。
author: afilthycasual
source: Many Luvdisc fusions are traded between sweethearts, but POKENAME serve a different purpose. Secret admirers frequently use POKENAME to deliver love letters or small gifts thanks to its ability to sneak into virtually any space.

entry: POKENAME每走一步，背上就会飘出心形花瓣。人们常收集出售，供婚礼使用。
author: jaminmcready
source: With each step it takes, POKENAME releases heart-shaped petals from its back. These petals are often collected and sold to be used during weddings.

entry: 它用牙齿在纸片上画红心，再留在住宅和公园里。有人收集这些纸片，相信能带来爱情好运。
author: jaminmcready
source: It uses its teeth to draw red hearts on paper scraps, then leaves them behind in homes and parks. Some people collect them, believing they bring good luck in love.

entry: POKENAME乘海风滑翔，掠走跃出水面的鱼宝可梦。它喜欢一把抱住训练家的脸，表达爱意，不过想把亲热的它撬下来，可不容易。
author: opossiblymage
source: POKENAME glides on the sea breeze, swiping up jumping fish Pokémon as prey. It loves to latch onto its Trainer's face in a big hug to show affection. It can be very difficult to pry a doting POKENAME off.

entry: 没有年幼孩子帮忙送戒指的新人，会租POKENAME在婚礼上担任这角色。许多人觉得它娇小可爱，这做法在小范围内颇受欢迎。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are rented out for weddings as ring bearers for couples who do not a young child available to play the role. Many people find their petite stature endearing, so this practice has gained some niche popularity.

entry: 它与伙伴一阵阵快速急转飞行，像在跳舞。若看见有人孤独，就会在近旁振翅，想让对方开心。
author: jaminmcready
source: It flies in quick, jerky bursts with a partner, making it look like they're dancing. If it sees someone feeling lonely, it flaps near them to cheer them up.

entry: 被POKENAME的毒刺扎到，人可能会爱上下一个看见的人。不过效果只持续一小时。
author: .izik
source: If pricked by POKENAME's venomous barbs, a person can develop a crush the next person they see. The effect, however, only lasts for an hour.

entry: POKENAME会寻找深深爱着彼此的人，向交往中的双方发起残酷战斗，测试羁绊有多牢固。
author: amityblamity
source: POKENAME seeks out people deeply in love. It challenges those in relationships to brutal battles in order to test the strength of their bonds.

entry: POKENAME远没有熔岩虫那么热，带来的是适度温暖，而非灼热。只要照料妥当，它就是理想的暖房帮手。
author: victor9106
source: POKENAME are considerably less hot than Slugma, creating more of a modest warmth than a blazing heat. They can make for perfect space heaters when properly cared for.

entry: 传统爱情药水配方里，会用到POKENAME的壳。虽然没有证据证明药水有效，许多思慕心上人的年轻人仍满怀希望地收集。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME shells are an ingredient in a traditional recipe for love potions. There is no evidence that the potions actually work, but they are nevertheless collected by many young hopefuls pining for their crush.

entry: 它在黎明飞过湖泊，用尖喙在雾里划出心形。诗人过去常观赏，称这是爱情将至的征兆。
author: jaminmcready
source: It flies over lakes at dawn, using its sharp beak to trace heart shapes in the fog. Poets used to watch this, saying it was a sign of love about to begin.

entry: 若察觉丧偶的人在附近游泳，POKENAME的茎秆就会泛粉光。没人知道它如何感知悲伤，但似乎会跟随对方，给予安慰。
author: .izik
source: When it senses a widow or widower swimming nearby, POKENAME's stalks glow pink. Though no one knows how it detects grief, it seems to follow them to offer comfort.

entry: 有人相信，用POKENAME墨汁纹出的图案，能让爱情永不褪色。这类纹身罕见而备受珍视。
author: .izik
source: Some believe tattoos made with ink from POKENAME will cause a romance to never fade. Such tattoos are rare and highly prized.

entry: 这种快乐的宝可梦会送出心形礼物，一碰撞就炸成彩纸。它靠关爱茁壮生活，悲伤持续太久便会消失。
author: jaminmcready
source: This cheerful Pokémon delivers heart-shaped gifts that explode into confetti upon impact. It thrives on affection and disappears when sadness lingers too long.

entry: 豪华餐厅会饲养POKENAME，让它在某些节日于客人上方飞出图案。特别热情的恋人，还能付费请它吹泡泡，为浪漫晚餐助兴。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are raised and kept in lavish restaurants, flying above patrons in patterns during certain holidays. Particularly enthusiastic lovers can pay to have them create bubbles to heighten a romantic dinner experience.

entry: POKENAME在婚礼场地上方翱翔，开心啁啾。粉色金属羽毛在光下如星辰闪烁。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME soars above wedding venues, chirping joyfully. Its pink metallic feathers glint like stars in the light.

entry: POKENAME白天在珊瑚礁间游动，寻找猎物，用令人幸福的毒液制服。脱落鳞片被冲上岸后，会被收集起来，作为送给心上人的信物。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME spends the day swimming through coral reefs in search of prey to subdue with its bliss-inducing venom. Shed scales wash ashore and are collected to be used as tokens to give to a crush.

entry: 它们索要关注和礼物，尤其喜欢贝壳、鳞片等水中物件。赠上一滴神秘水滴，被视为它们能得到的最高赞许，因此人们很少轻易送出。
author: quackquackattack
source: They demand attention and gifts, particularly shells, scales, or other aquatic objects. To give them a droplet of Mystic Water is seen as the highest praise they can receive, and as such, it is given to them sparingly.

entry: POKENAME力量吓人，却是温柔的巨人。它用心形象鼻吸水，再朝相爱的情侣喷洒，映出美丽彩虹。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: Despite its intimidating strength, POKENAME is a gentle giant. It'll suck water up through its heart-shaped trunk before spraying it over romantic couples, causing a beautiful rainbow shine.

entry: 据说POKENAME会出现在孤独之人的电脑上，闪着鲜艳光彩。它为使用者打开特殊网站，联系世界各地的人，寻找可能的伙伴。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are said to appear on PCs of lonely people, shining with vibrant lights and colors. They give the user access to a special site that connects people across the world to find potential companions.

entry: POKENAME不断切磋证明力量，相信每场战斗都能加深友谊。拳头会留下心形痕迹，据说等对手成为朋友，痕迹便会消失。
author: otherian
source: POKENAME constantly spars to prove its strength, believing every battle strengthens friendship. It leaves heart-shaped marks with its punches that are said to fade once rivals become friends.

entry: POKENAME十分可爱，喜欢亲吻，表达喜爱。每吻一次，它都想照照倒影，看看脸上是否蹭了什么。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are adorable creatures that enjoy giving kisses as a sign of affection. After every kiss, they try to check their reflection to see if anything has rubbed off on their face.

entry: POKENAME的毒液能制造令人平静的幻觉，让它攻击后轻易缠住猎物。它也会缠住关爱的生物，不过过分热情，常把对方勒得昏倒。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME's venom causes calming hallucinations, allowing it to easily constrict prey after striking. Alternatively, it may constrict those it cares for, but its overzealous nature often causes them to pass out in its coils.

entry: POKENAME高速驰骋大地，周身迸出粉色电弧。经过的地区会暂时充满情爱能量，让路过者的浪漫情感陡增。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME races across the lands at high speeds, bolts of pink lightning arcing from its body as it does so. Areas it has run past become charged with amorous energy for a time, causing romantic feelings to skyrocket in those passing through.

entry: 看周围石头的形状，就知道某座山是否被POKENAME占据。它一搬入，就会四处把巨石凿成心形，装饰家园。
author: sk372
source: One can tell if a POKENAME has claimed a mountain territory by the shape of the rocks around it. Once it moves in, it goes around chipping and shaping boulders into heart shapes to decorate its home with.

entry: 传说POKENAME只在真爱深系的情侣面前出现。它平时住在深海，守护爱心鱼群，抵御危险和捕食者。
author: fiordaliso
source: According to legend, POKENAME appears only before couples united by a deep bond of true love. It typically dwells in the depths of the sea, where it protects schools of Luvdisc from dangers and predators.

entry: POKENAME在珊瑚礁生活，尤其偏爱太阳珊瑚常去的地方。它用橡胶般的尾巴，把好坏星从栖居的珊瑚台上打下去，维持与太阳珊瑚的互利关系。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME inhabit coral reefs, especially those frequented by Corsola. POKENAME will utilize their rubbery tail to batter Mareanie off the coral shelves they reside on, protecting the mutualistic relationship they have with Corsola.

entry: POKENAME用精神力在两个人周围制造心形泡泡。它其实分不清对方是不是情侣，因此闹出不少尴尬场面。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME uses its psychic powers to create heart-shaped bubbles around pairs of humans. It cannot actually tell if two humans are a romantic couple or not, leading to a number of awkward moments.

entry: POKENAME以携带的心之鳞片为傲，不过需要时也能重新长出。在家园海滩看见相爱情侣散步，它就会摇摇晃晃地上前，害羞送出鳞片。
author: lordjoostmeister
source: Though the Heart Scale it carries is its pride and joy, POKENAME can regrow it if needed. When it sees loving couples strolling on the beaches it makes its home on, POKENAME toddles up to them and shyly offers its Heart Scale as a gift.

entry: POKENAME睡在珊瑚礁上，轻吹心形泡泡。潜水者推测，它梦里装满被遗忘的恋情。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME sleeps atop coral reefs, gently blowing heart-shaped bubbles. Divers theorize its dreams are filled with forgotten romances.

entry: POKENAME用手上炮口轰击，制服对手。除了灼烧敌人，轰击还会让对方心生迷恋。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME subdues opponents with blasts from its hand cannons. In addition to searing the foes, the blasts induce feelings of infatuation.

entry: POKENAME视力不太好，因此把泡泡当天然放大镜。如果潜到一半泡泡破了，它就无法返回水面。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME do not have the greatest eyesight, so they use bubbles as a natural way to magnify. If these bubbles pop in the middle of a dive, they will not be able to get back to the surface.

entry: 传说POKENAME的毒液能让人不再相爱。即使飞姿优美，人们在婚礼上仍惧怕它。
author: .izik
source: Legend says POKENAME's venom can cause someone to fall out of love. It is feared at weddings despite its graceful flight.

entry: POKENAME定期漂过交友网站，吸收数据。途中常把消息弄乱，让原本可能配对的人，反而被介绍给喜好、兴趣完全不合的对象。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME periodically floats through dating websites to absorb data. As it passes through, it often scrambles messages, leading potential matches to be paired with people entirely unsuited to their preferences and hobbies.

entry: 它的尾巴会被切下，作为婚礼沙拉上桌。据说，新人吃下这道菜就永不分离。
author: .izik
source: Its tail is chopped and served in salads at weddings. It is said that newlyweds who eat this dish will never part.

entry: POKENAME手臂叶片散发甜香，能安抚附近所有宝可梦。远古时，人们曾拿这些叶子制作所谓的爱情药水。
author: sk372
source: A sweet scent emanates from the leaves on POKENAME's arms that pacifies any Pokémon in the vicinity. In the distant past, these leaves were used as ingredients for so-called love potions.

entry: POKENAME手臂上有叶质心形刀刃，每次都能把叶片完美切成爱心。想让派对多添一点浪漫，它就是理想伙伴。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have leafy heart blades on their arms that allows them to perfectly cut leaves into hearts every time. They are the perfect companion for making parties feel just a touch more romantic.

entry: POKENAME摆动宽大的心形鳍，在水中推进。它偏爱暖水，因此若在奇怪地点发现大群，附近可能就有活跃的海底火山。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME waves its large, heart-shaped fin to propel itself forwards through water. It prefers warmer waters, so if you find many of them in an odd area, it may mean that there is an active underwater volcano nearby.

entry: POKENAME大约每月会从背上脱落一次粉色心形鳞片。情侣常结伴寻找，表达彼此的爱。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME shed pink heart-shaped scales from their back about once a month. Couples often go searching for these scales to show their love for one another.

entry: POKENAME在珊瑚礁筑巢，游近潜在伴侣时会吹泡泡。若另一只也有意，便同样吹泡回应。求偶季，游客会聚到礁边欣赏。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: Creating nests in coral reefs, POKENAME blow bubbles when swimming near potential mates. If another POKENAME reciprocates the feeling, it will also blow bubbles. Tourists gather near these reefs to witness these bubbles during courtship season.

entry: POKENAME既会相爱，也擅长战斗。一方遇袭，结成伴侣的另一方就会竭尽全力保护。它把水流缠上双脚加速，轻易击退任何威胁。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: Known as both lovers and fighters, if a POKENAME is attacked, its pair-bonded partner will stop at nothing to ensure its mate is safe. Wrapping currents of water around its feet to accelerate movement, POKENAME can easily knock away any threat.

entry: POKENAME产的水会用于婚宴鸡尾酒。据说，喝下的宾客够多，这段婚姻就注定成功。
author: .izik
source: The water POKENAME produces is used in cocktails at wedding receptions. It is said that if enough guests drink it, the marriage is destined to succeed.

entry: POKENAME住在泥泞处附近，帮助情侣免于绊倒摔进泥里。它原生水域的水是粉色。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME lives near muddy areas to help couples from tripping into mud. Bodies of water where POKENAME comes from are pink.

entry: POKENAME藏在公园池塘，等待约会情侣。它以仔细观察两人相处为乐，很少干涉。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME hides in ponds in public parks, waiting for couples on dates. It closely monitors their time together for entertainment, very seldom interfering.

entry: POKENAME天性胆小，却会被附近的爱与亲昵吸引。许多人认为，野生的它主动靠近情侣，是关系牢固的极好预兆。
author: sk372
source: Timid by nature, POKENAME finds itself drawn to feelings of love and affection near to it. Many say that POKENAME approaching a couple in the wild is a fantastic sign for the solidarity of their relationship.

entry: POKENAME原生于珊瑚礁和海滩，却更喜欢偷乘船只。情侣常喂它，认为见到它就是真爱的征兆。
author: smissmassentree_81799
source: Although native to coral reefs and beaches, POKENAME prefer to stow away on ships. It is often fed by couples, who consider spotting one a sign of true love.

entry: POKENAME非常亲热，谁开口要抱，它都愿意。它散发温柔的精神气息，安抚怀里的生物，让对方更加温暖、感到被爱。
author: sk372
source: Highly affectionate, POKENAME is always willing to give a hug to any who ask. It emits a tender psychic aura that soothes those in its grip, helping increase their feelings of warmth and being loved.

entry: 野生POKENAME很罕见，似乎会浮到单身者附近，想让对方看自己的背。据说，凝视其中就能看见真爱的影像。
author: sk372
source: Rarely seen in the wild, POKENAME appears to float near single people and attempt to get them to look at its back. Supposedly, those gazing into it will see an image of their true love.

entry: 这种宝可梦只需一点毒素，就能让人迷恋，化解攻击者的敌意。过去，曾有不择手段的人采毒，酿制所谓的“爱情”药水。
author: afilthycasual
source: Just a small amount of toxin from this Pokémon will cause infatuation, neutralizing aggressors. In the past, unscrupulous individuals harvested this poison for the brewing of "love" potions.

entry: POKENAME颜色鲜亮，性情友善，很受欢迎。不过它天生害羞，会改变皮肤颜色藏身，因此即使只短暂看见一群，许多人也觉得是福气。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are popular for their vibrant colors and friendly demeanors. They are inherently shy and conceal themselves by altering their skin pigmentation; many consider it a boon to witness a school of POKENAME, however brief the sighting may be.

entry: POKENAME浮着举起双臂，表示想和平解决问题。不过若被激怒，它就会伸臂，释放全部力量。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME floats while holding up its arms to show it wishes to resolve problems peacefully. However, if provoked, it will extend its arms and unleash its full force.

entry: 据说野生POKENAME由108个相思成疾的灵魂结合而成，生活在黑暗或其他难以穿行的水域。
author: bobosmith01
source: Wild POKENAME are said to be the result of a union of 108 lovesick spirits. They live in dark or otherwise hard-to-navigate waters.

entry: 孩子们视POKENAME为爱与正义的英雄。它操控波导冲击，让最邪恶的心也能生出爱。
author: enemyphase
source: Children look up to POKENAME as heroes of love and justice. POKENAME manipulates blasts of aura to bring love into even the most wicked hearts.

entry: POKENAME充满爱心，会用轻咬表达喜爱。幸好它很会控制颚部，绝不会咬得太重，伤到所爱。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a very loving creature, and shares its affection by biting those it cares for. Fortunately, it has excellent jaw control, so it will never bite down hard enough to harm those it loves.

entry: POKENAME背上长着许多娇嫩粉花，熟练的草药师会小心采下。花瓣用于调制稀有香水，据说能唤起深沉情感。
author: jaminmcready
source: On the back of a POKENAME grows plentiful, delicate pink flowers that are carefully plucked by skilled herbalists. The petals are used to craft rare perfumes that are said to stir deep emotions.

entry: POKENAME的毒能引起强烈迷恋，持续数日。有时能见它张开尖刺游泳，周围簇拥着各种如痴如醉的宝可梦。
author: afilthycasual
source: POKENAME poison induces a powerful infatuation that could last days. Some individuals have been spotted swimming with their spines extended, surrounded by a group of intoxicated Pokémon of various species.

entry: 大嘴里的一排牙齿出奇柔软，咬到其他生物也只会造成极轻伤害。POKENAME似乎习惯用大嘴轻咬喜欢的人和宝可梦。
author: infinex21
source: The teeth lining its large jaws are surprisingly soft, so even when it bites down on another entity, it does minimal damage. POKENAME seems to have a habit of gently biting people and Pokémon it likes with its large jaws.

entry: POKENAME时不时会脱落坚硬的心形鳞片，每次新长的都比之前更明亮。古代海边居民曾把这些鳞片装饰在铠甲和武器上。
author: milchik
source: POKENAME sheds its tough heart-shaped scales every now and then, and each new set of scales is even brighter and shinier than the last. Ancient people that used to live near the beaches used these scales as a decoration for their armor and weapons.

entry: POKENAME试图拿脆弱的泡泡使头锤，让对手担心得惊恐后退。这种莫名自危的举动，使人怀疑泡泡已经取代了它的大脑。
author: lordjoostmeister
source: POKENAME attempts to headbutt foes with its delicate bubble, causing them to recoil in concerned horror. This perplexingly self-endangering behavior has given rise to theories that the bubble has replaced POKENAME's brain.

entry: 它威胁用脆弱泡泡撞人，让敌人又困惑又惊慌。趁对方忙着想如何在不酿成惨状的情况下打败POKENAME，它却转身，用沉重尾巴给予重击。
author: lordjoostmeister
source: It confuses and alarms foes by threatening to ram its fragile bubble into them. As they scramble for ways to defeat POKENAME without this gruesome scenario occurring, it turns its back and delivers a crushing blow with its weighty tail.

entry: 成群POKENAME沿海滩组成高墙，挡住凶猛的海洋宝可梦。孩子常想陪它们玩，让它们兴奋过头，忘了任务。
author: evilgammon
source: Great walls formed by groups of POKENAME line beaches, acting as barriers against aggressive sea Pokémon. Children often try to play with them, making the POKENAME forget their task in overexcitement.

entry: POKENAME察觉心碎便会现身，却因此招来情侣和训练家的厌恶。它只好寻求独处，哭声数英里外都听得见。
author: vlavoc
source: POKENAME appears when it senses heartbreak, leading couples and Trainers alike to develop a hatred for it. Consequently, it seeks solitude, and its cry can be heard from miles away.

entry: 二月里，训练家热切期盼遇到POKENAME。据说它若出现在面前，就代表情场注定顺利。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: During the month of February, Trainers eagerly hope to come across POKENAME. It's said that if a POKENAME comes across one's path, they are destined to have success in romantic endeavors.

entry: POKENAME若察觉命定情侣，就会试着把两人一起困进巨大的闪亮泡泡。这对情侣可能非常危险。
author: .izik
source: If POKENAME senses a destined couple, it tries to trap them together inside a large, shimmering bubble. This can be incredibly dangerous for the couple.

entry: 过去许多文明视POKENAME为掌管爱情的神，举行仪式安抚它。据说若未好好敬奉，就会受诅咒，一生孤独、无人爱。
author: sk372
source: Many past civilizations performed rituals to appease POKENAME, believing it to be the deity governing over love. Failure to properly venerate it was said to curse a person to be lonely and unloved for the rest of their days.

entry: 樱花季，POKENAME在成堆花瓣中嬉戏。可惜树木重新转绿后，它就会陷入深深的消沉。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME frolics around in piles of petals during cherry blossom season. Sadly, when the trees revert back to green, it falls into a deep depression.

entry: POKENAME的灌木每月会开一次鲜粉色花。花期的甜香，会增强闻到者的情爱。
author: sk372
source: Once a month, POKENAME's bushes bloom with bright pink flowers. While in bloom, the flowers create a sweet scent that increases the amorous feelings in those who breathe in the aroma.

entry: 在POKENAME背上珊瑚礁筑巢的宝可梦，以终生相守闻名。有时同一家族的好几代，都住在一只个体背上。
author: notadoctor75
source: Pokémon that nest in the reef on POKENAME's back are well-known to court for life. Sometimes, multiple generations of the same Pokémon family can be found living on the back of an individual POKENAME.

entry: 情侣间流行一种仪式：把手放在POKENAME头和尾上。据说尾巴若散发温暖，就是真爱的证明。
author: catsquatch_geography
source: A popular ritual among couples is to place their hands upon a POKENAME's head and tail. If its tail radiates warmth, it is said to be proof of genuine love.

entry: POKENAME在沉船安家，喜欢爬上断桅、攀过破绳，再在周围游动。遇到潜在伴侣，它会献上宝物，盼能结成一对。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME makes its home in sunken ships, preferring to climb the broken masts and scale the tattered ropes to swim around them. When POKENAME finds a potential partner, it will present a treasure to them in the hopes of becoming a pair.

entry: 独处会让它消沉，其他宝可梦便以为有机可乘。不过真攻上来，往往会被角刺中，连POKENAME自己都并非有意。
author: ichosuzu
source: If left alone, it will become despondent, leading other Pokémon to believe they can attack it. When they do, however, they tend to end up stabbed by its horn without POKENAME even meaning to stab them.

entry: POKENAME挂在树上，朝旅人摆动彩色尾焰。它是在恶作剧，因为凝视火焰的人，会短暂爱上下一个看见的生物，惹出许多麻烦。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME hangs from trees and swings its colorful tail flame in front of travelers. It does this as a prank, as staring into its flame causes a person to temporarily fall in love with the next creature it sees, causing much mischief.

entry: POKENAME在石头和树侧留下心形灼痕，标记领地。每只留下的爱心形状都略有不同。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME leaves heart-shaped burns on the sides of stones and trees to mark its territory. Each heart differs slightly in shape depending on the individual.

entry: POKENAME在水里灵活得多，在陆地上几乎只能勉强爬行。即便如此，它仍常出现在浪漫主题的文具上。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME is much more agile in the water than on land, where it can barely crawl. Despite that, it is popularly featured in romantic stationery.

entry: 据说POKENAME只会送小石子给喜欢相处的宝可梦。若送给训练家，就代表深深的爱。
author: quackquackattack
source: It is said that POKENAME only gives pebbles to Pokémon it enjoys spending time around. If it gives one to its Trainer, it is a sign of great love.

entry: 求偶季，每只POKENAME都会带颗小石子，表示想寻找伴侣。两只若交换石子，便结成一对，终生忠诚相守。
author: quackquackattack
source: During courtship season, POKENAME each carry a pebble that signals their desire to mate. If two POKENAME swap pebbles, they pair-bond and remain devoted partners for life.

entry: POKENAME对别人的情绪极敏感，会被强烈的正面情感吸引。有人相信，它若出现在情侣面前，两人的爱就能永远持续。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are highly sensitive to the emotions of others, to the point they are drawn to those with strong, positive emotions. Some believe that if a POKENAME appears before a couple, then their love for each other will last forever.

entry: 人们相信POKENAME是熟练的红娘。它的迷你爱心鱼会指向彼此来电的两个人。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME is believed to be a skilled matchmaker. Its Mini-Discs will point towards pairs of people who have good romantic chemistry.

entry: POKENAME既有魅力，也重荣誉。寻找能称作同伴的生物途中，它战斗的目的不是荣耀，而是保护珍爱的人。
author: bringmeadream_
source: POKENAME is a Pokémon who's as charismatic as it is honourable. Throughout its search for those to call its allies, POKENAME fights not for glory, but to protect the people it holds dear.

entry: POKENAME可以很温柔，却也会拼命守护所爱。谁想伤害与它结下感情的爱心娜，就可能被毒角刺穿。
author: ichosuzu
source: POKENAME can be a sweet Pokémon, but it's also fiercely protective. Anyone who tries to harm a Luvrina it bonds with is at risk of being pierced by its toxic horn.

entry: 许多人因花色扑克牌上常有POKENAME而认识它，但天然数量稀少，科学界仍未完全了解。它与同类相处，远比劈斩司令和自己的同类融洽。
author: bobosmith01
source: Although many recognize POKENAME due to it being somewhat common on suited playing cards, it has not been entirely scientifically understood due to its natural rarity. It gets along much better with other POKENAME than Bisharp does with its own kind.

entry: POKENAME极其难得一见，不过据说情侣若在湖里看见，就能长久相爱。身上看得见的亮鳞越多，爱情便能持续越久。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME is incredibly rare to see, but it is said that a couple who spots one in a lake will enjoy a long and lasting love. The more shining scales visible on its body, the longer their love is said to endure.

entry: POKENAME性情开朗，喜欢分享新体验。两个齿轮都努力让彼此感到被珍视，深厚羁绊让它们靠合作克服几乎所有挑战。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME are cheerful Pokémon that love sharing new experiences. Both gears strive to make each other feel valued, and their strong bond lets them overcome nearly any challenge through teamwork.

entry: POKENAME从不吝于表达情绪，无论正面还是负面。据说，它若用触角牵起双方的手，彼此就注定会在一起。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are not hesitant with showing their emotions, be they positive or negative emotions. It is said that when a POKENAME uses its feelers to grab hold of two others' hands, those two are destined to be together.

entry: POKENAME要求别人无条件爱它，自己却很少回报。若谁给的赞美、关爱不够，它就会大发脾气。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME demands that others love it unconditionally, even though it offers little of the feeling back. If someone doesn't show it enough praise and affection, it throws a mighty tantrum.

entry: POKENAME待在云间弹里拉琴。以爱情为主题的节日里，偶尔能见它划过天空。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME spend their time in the clouds, playing music on lyres. On rare occasions they can be seen streaking through the sky on days celebrating love.

entry: 翅膀渗出的液体会微妙影响情绪，让附近的生物心生思念。训练家说，它会被深深想念某人的人吸引。
author: milchik
source: The liquid that oozes from its wings carries a subtle emotional influence, known to stir feelings of longing in those nearby. Trainers say it's drawn to people who miss someone deeply.

entry: POKENAME曾被奉为爱情的原初化身。如今，它漫游海床，陪伴迷路或遭遗弃的宝可梦，为被抛下的生物组成家庭。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME was once worshipped as a primordial embodiment of love. In modern days, it wanders the ocean floor, offering companionship to Pokémon who have become lost or abandoned, forming a family for the forsaken.

entry: POKENAME十分厌恶敌意。若看见人争吵、彼此对抗，它就会从炮口喷洒液体，强迫双方温柔相待。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME responds very negatively towards feelings of animosity. If it sees people arguing or being antagonistic towards one another, it spreads out a spray from its cannon that forces them to behave more tenderly.

entry: 它鼓励人和宝可梦追求明知与自己相配的伴侣。若POKENAME发现双方互相说谎，就会降下沸腾的雨，夷平他们的家。
author: bobosmith01
source: It encourages people and Pokémon to pursue partners who they know they are already compatible with. If POKENAME knows two partners are lying to one another, it will raze down their house in boiling rain.

entry: 它鼓励人和宝可梦追求各自理想的恋人。若得知一方反复不公地对待另一方，就会用局部雷暴摧毁他们的家。
author: bobosmith01
source: It encourages people and Pokémon to pursue their own ideal romantic partners. If it learns of one partner repeatedly treating another unfairly, it will raze down their house in a localized thunderstorm.

entry: 它乘柔风飘行，轻巧优雅地穿过树枝。若察觉陌生人间萌生真爱，就会从上方洒下花朵，再消失在夜里。
author: jaminmcready
source: It drifts on gentle winds, weaving between tree branches with graceful ease. When it senses the spark of true love between strangers, it showers them with blossoms from above before vanishing into the night.

entry: POKENAME性情友善，身体柔软如毛绒玩具，很受孩子喜爱。人们认为，抱住它时，它会吃掉负面情绪。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's friendly nature and soft plushy body make it a popular Pokémon with children. It is thought that POKENAME eats away at negative emotions when it's hugged.

entry: POKENAME翅膀散出粉末，谁吃下都会陷入爱情。古时候，人们曾用粉末制作爱情药水。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME emanates a powder from its wings that will make anyone who consumes it fall in love. In ancient times, this powder was used to make love potions.

entry: 据说POKENAME有能从远处察觉单相思的特殊眼睛。它会缠住察觉到的人，一路跟随催逼，直到对方告白。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is said to have special eyes capable of sensing unrequited love from afar. It latches onto and follows people it has sensed, hounding them until they confess their feelings.

entry: 许多情侣喜欢在POKENAME心形身体前合影。它会用缎带摆出爱心，让每张照片都成为难忘时刻。
author: quackquackattack
source: Many couples love to take photos in front of the heart-shaped body of POKENAME. They form hearts with their ribbons to make every photo a memorable moment.

entry: 它化成浪漫蜡烛的模样，待在自己认为爱意正萌芽的地方。有些迷信说法称，它以附近人们的幸福情感为食。
author: craigprime
source: It takes on the form of a romantic candle, resting itself wherever it believes love is blossoming. Some superstitions claim that it feeds off of the blissful feelings of people nearby.

entry: 据说情人节夜里，POKENAME会出现在孤身者面前，展示爱情幻象。它以人和宝可梦的正面情绪为食。
author: slimee_amogus
source: POKENAME is said to appear at night to those who are alone on Valentine's Day, showing them visions of love. It feeds off of the positive emotions of people and Pokémon.

entry: 格外铺张的情侣会买POKENAME当摆饰，每逢客人来访，就借它展示彼此的爱。它柔和的光，夜里照亮许多家庭。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are bought by particularly lavish couples as a piece of decor to show their love to whenever guests come over. The soft glow they release illuminates many homes at night.

entry: POKENAME出现在风暴中伤心欲绝的人面前，以轻柔触碰默默安慰。被接近者说，会感到奇异的温暖与清明，仿佛悲伤已消散。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME appears to heartbroken humans caught in storms, silently offering comfort with a gentle touch. Those it approaches report feeling a strange warmth and clarity, as if their sorrow has been lifted.

entry: POKENAME靠黏稠内里附在冲浪板底部。据说发现一只，就代表一天内会遇到真爱。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME clings to the bottom of surfboards using its sticky innards. Finding one is said to herald meeting your true love within a day.

entry: 民间传说，把POKENAME的一把钥匙按在胸口，能治愈心碎。许多恋人留着它的钥匙当护符。
author: .izik
source: Folktales say pressing one of POKENAME's keys to your chest can heal heartbreak. Many lovers keep its keys as charms.

entry: POKENAME虽有假眼、披着伪装，却想帮助人们找到真爱。它通常认定一位训练家，陪着环游世界，寻找适合对方的人。
author: quackquackattack
source: Even though POKENAME have spurious eyes and a fake costume, they want to help people find true love. They typically partner with one Trainer and roam the world in search of the right person for their Trainer.

entry: POKENAME在双生同胞爱心欧斯保护下旅行，直到双方都成熟，开始觅偶。等两只都找到伴侣，它就会与同胞分开，建立自己的家庭。
author: milchik
source: POKENAME travels under the protection of its twin Luvtios until both are mature enough to start searching for a mate. Once both Pokémon find their partners, POKENAME separates from its sibling in order to create a family of its own.

entry: POKENAME身旁几乎总有一只爱心亚斯。若伙伴被训练家捕获，它便一直跟着双方，不是攻击训练家，就是让自己也被收服。
author: milchik
source: A single POKENAME is almost never seen without a Luvtias by its side. If its partner gets caught by a Pokémon Trainer, POKENAME keeps following them both, either attacking the Trainer or letting itself be caught too.

entry: POKENAME在隧道里充满数百颗心形泡泡。若捕食者闯入，这些泡泡就会充当警报。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME fills its tunnel with hundreds of heart-shaped bubbles. These serve as an alarm system should a predator enter the tunnel.

entry: POKENAME盖好巢屋后，会把木头啃成心形，放在屋顶。若找不到合适的木头，也可能改用薄石。
author: .izik
source: After building its lodge, POKENAME chews a log into a heart shape and places it on the roof. If it cannot find a log suitable to its design, it may use a thin stone.

entry: POKENAME发现喜欢的人，会害羞地跟着，觉得对方做什么都了不起。一被注意，它就遮脸，咯咯轻叫着跑开；若一直被忽略，最终又会去仰慕别人。
author: periperi_chicken
source: When POKENAME finds someone it likes, it coyly follows them, convinced everything they do is amazing. If noticed, it hides its face and runs off with a giggling yip. If ignored, it eventually moves on to admire someone else.

entry: POKENAME多数时候不游泳，而让水流带着走，甚至边漂边睡。它似乎想靠外表迷住潜在威胁，不过多数生物看了反而不安。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME let themselves be carried around by water currents rather than swim in most cases; they even tend to sleep as they are carried around. They appear to rely on their looks to charm would-be threats, though most find their looks unnerving.

entry: POKENAME浮在海面，用水柱推近相配的人，悄悄牵线。两人互相看见时，它便开心地上下浮动。
author: .izik
source: Floating on the sea's surface, POKENAME spews jets of water to nudge compatible people toward each other, subtly matchmaking. It bobs in happiness when they see eachother.

entry: POKENAME曾因华丽的发光鳞片遭人猎捕，险些濒危。如今阿罗拉设有自然保护区，确保悲剧不再重演。
author: big_clanker
source: There was an era where POKENAME were hunted to the brink of endangerment because of their extravagant, glowing scales. Nowadays, there are nature preserves for them in Alola to ensure it never happens again.

entry: 传闻POKENAME遇见相爱的情侣，心形尾尖就会泛起迷人的粉光。若突然被摸，它则会吓得放出无害电火花。
author: fiordaliso
source: According to rumors, when POKENAME comes across a couple in love, the heart-shaped tip of its tail gives off a charming pink glow. If petted unexpectedly, it releases harmless electric sparks out of surprise.

entry: 这些英勇的宝可梦，以坚韧守护珍爱者闻名。育儿机构常雇用它们，守卫幼年宝可梦。
author: big_clanker
source: These heroic Pokémon are known for their tenacity when it comes to protecting the ones they hold close. Nurseries often employ this species to act as guards for the baby Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME虽然迟缓笨重，心形脑袋却让它成为情侣外出用餐时讨喜的服务生。唯一缺点是，一有机会，它就会吃掉用过的餐具。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME may be slow and lumbering, but their heart-shaped heads make them charming waiters for couples who are dining out. The only downside to having them as waiters is that they eat used cutlery if given the opportunity.

entry: 它摇摇晃晃四处找东西亲。受威胁时，POKENAME会甩头重击捕食者，不过也可能把自己撞得头痛。
author: bukie
source: It toddles around, looking for something to kiss. When threatened, POKENAME whacks predators with a swing of its head, though it may give itself a headache.

entry: 古时候，女巫把POKENAME养在水缸，相信鳞片有制作爱情药水的力量。用到这些鳞片的配方，已随岁月失传。
author: .izik
source: In ancient times, witches kept POKENAME in aquariums, believing its scales held power in love potions. The recipes that included these scales have been lost to time.

entry: POKENAME用头锤表达喜爱，撞完后头冠会变色。人们相信，色彩花纹越鲜艳，就代表它越喜欢被撞的人。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME headbutts others as a sign of affection, its crest changing colors after impact. It's believed the more vibrant the color pattern its crest becomes, the more affection it has for the person it headbutted.

entry: POKENAME的坚硬外壳，保护着为进化做准备的身体。前方甲片的棱彩光芒闪烁变色，催眠攻击者，使其神志不清，消磨斗志。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's sturdy shell protects it from harm while its body prepares for evolution. The prismatic display on the front plates shimmer and shift color in order to hypnotize attackers, clouding their mind and draining their will to fight.

entry: POKENAME的两个身体深爱彼此，天真地滑过水中，除了对方，什么也不理。
author: periperi_chicken
source: Each POKENAME body adores the other intensely. They innocently glide through the water, ignoring everything else but each other.

entry: POKENAME的两个齿轮互相关爱，羁绊却会随时间褪去。它们容易厌倦，常怨恨彼此，都觉得找食物时自己出力更多。
author: periperi_chicken
source: The two gears of POKENAME care for each other, but their bond fades over time. They grow bored easily and often resent one another, each convinced they do more work to find food.

entry: 它总挂着灿烂笑容，得意展示尾尖盛开的玫瑰状花朵。心情越好，花瓣在阳光下就张得越开。
author: jaminmcready
source: It is always seen with a bright smile, proudly showing the rose-shaped flower blossoming at the tip of its tail. The happier it feels, the more its petals unfurl under the sun.

entry: POKENAME身体渗出微光淡色花蜜，曾被用于治疗心脏病。遗憾的是，这药也会让病人全身出现瘀伤。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body leaks a glimmering pale nectar that was once used to treat heart disease. Unfortunately, this medicine also caused bruising all over the patient.

entry: 情侣第一次约会，POKENAME会送小小花束。之后，它一路关注两人的进展，每次约会后送树叶信，每次接吻送银色叶子，有人求婚就送金色叶子。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME delivers a Small Bouquet to couples on their first date. It then follows their journey, gifting a Leaf Letter after each date, a Silver Leaf for every kiss, and a Gold Leaf once one proposes.

entry: 情侣常互赠POKENAME，象征爱意。孩子觉得恋爱肉麻，往往不喜欢它。讽刺的是，它最烦的恰恰是被热恋情侣不停抱着走。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME are often exchanged between couples as symbols of affection. Children tend to dislike them, finding romance gross. Ironically, nothing annoys a POKENAME more than being constantly carried around by a lovestruck couple.

entry: 破壳后，POKENAME开始离地悬浮，很少再钻回地下，除非睡觉或感到威胁。尖刺会在黑暗中发光，除非蒙上挖出的泥土。
author: krune
source: Upon breaking its shell, POKENAME starts levitating off the ground, rarely burrowing down again unless slumbering or feeling threatened. Its spikes glow in the dark unless covered with dirt from digging.

entry: POKENAME终生相守。它栖居的咸湿海岸洞窟里，父母潜海猎食胆小虫时，幼崽的尖叫声总回荡不停。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME mates for life. The salty coastal caves where they roost are filled with screeching from the young specimens as their parents dive into the ocean to hunt Wimpod.

entry: POKENAME常在水下游出心形轨迹，穿行珊瑚礁。它会被孤独的训练家吸引，据说轻柔的机械哼鸣能让对方振作。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME is often found underwater, tracing heart-shaped loops in coral reefs. It's drawn to lonely Trainers and is said to lift their spirits with its gentle, mechanical hum.

entry: 它会停在情侣坐着的长椅，唱甜美旋律，让出游更浪漫。有些传统称，捡拾地上的POKENAME羽毛，能改善情场运气。
author: fiordaliso
source: It settles on benches occupied by couples and sings sweet melodies to make their outing even more romantic. According to some traditions, collecting POKENAME's feathers from the ground is said to improve one's luck in love.

entry: POKENAME是受欢迎的情书信使，却常因人们只顾信件、把自己晾在一边而嫉妒。送信前若未受到尊重和感谢，它就会用心之鳞片撕破信。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Popular messengers for love letters, POKENAME often grow jealous as they're discarded in favor of what they carry. If a POKENAME isn't properly respected and appreciated before a delivery, it will tear through the letter with its Heart Scales.

entry: POKENAME很容易被订婚戒指等人类珠宝吸引，迷醉于表达纯真爱意的宝石。沿海训练家为伴侣挑选戒指宝石时，常会找它帮忙。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are easily fascinated by human jewelry such as engagement rings, dazzled by gemstones that convey pure expressions of love. Trainers in coastal areas often seek out POKENAME when trying to decide on a gem to pick for their partner's ring.

entry: POKENAME吃毒蘑菇，增强体内毒液。它吐出的粉色黏液，会引起强烈迷恋与发烧。
