source: POKENAME's body is made out of molten gold, shedding shards of gold when its body starts to harden. People attempt to collect these hardened fragments to sell them at a high price.

entry: 会经常洗澡，保持身体光亮。POKENAME若看上了别人手中的东西，就会一直大声哭闹，直到如愿以偿。
author: lazyarcanist
source: It bathes regularly to keep its body shiny. If POKENAME covets something you have, it will cry loudly until it gets what it wants.

entry: POKENAME会啄击靠近巢穴的入侵者，除非附近有人扔硬币。无论面值多少，这份供品常能换来安全通行。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME pecks at intruders near its nest unless coins are thrown nearby. The offering often earns a safe pass regardless of the value.

entry: POKENAME从嘴里以惊人力道射出纯金币。虽然不致命，却很可能造成疼痛的瘀伤。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME fires solid gold coins from its mouth with surprising force. Shots from POKENAME are not life-threatening, but they are likely to cause painful bruising.

entry: POKENAME一有机会，就会钻进许愿井，用吸盘收集所有硬币。训练家若待它好，它便常把硬币送作礼物。
author: bradlybro199
source: If given the opportunity POKENAME will find their way into wishing wells and collect all the coins inside them on their suckers. If a Trainer is kind to a POKENAME they will often give these coins as a gift.

entry: POKENAME喷火时，不知为何有时会吐出赤热硬币。科学家研究多年，仍没有合理解释。
author: .izik
source: Sometimes, while spewing flames, red-hot coins come out of POKENAME's mouth for an unknown reason. Scientists have been studying this for many years with no reasonable explanation presented.

entry: POKENAME的响尾由松散金片组成，摇起来像硬币互碰。黑暗鸦、勾魂眼等爱亮物的宝可梦，是它的主要猎物。
author: milchik
source: Its rattle is made of loose golden plates; they create a sound similar to coins jingling against one another whenever POKENAME shakes its tail. Pokémon who are attracted to shiny things, such as Murkrow and Sableye, are POKENAME's main prey.

entry: POKENAME在店外筑巢，模仿店主的举止。人们视此为好运，给它硬币，它便发出传真机般的声音。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME nest outside of shops, imitating the mannerisms of the shop's owner. Having a POKENAME do this is considered a sign of good luck. If given coins, it makes a fax machine-like noise.

entry: POKENAME以喜爱昂贵的颜料和材料著称。有些罪犯会利用它们绘制赝品，再高价售出。
author: skymaster426
source: POKENAME are known for their love for expensive paints and materials. Some criminals use them to paint counterfeits to sell for high prices.

entry: POKENAME常在高空跨地区旅行，寻找甜食。它偏爱闪亮点心，许多个体尤其喜欢裹着可食用闪粉的糖果。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME regularly fly high in the sky, traveling from region to region in search of sweets. They gravitate towards sparkly treats, with many preferring candies coated in edible glitter.

entry: POKENAME常在高空跨地区旅行，寻找甜食。它偏爱闪亮点心，许多个体尤其喜欢裹着可食用闪粉的糖果。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME regularly fly high in the sky, traveling from region to region in search of sweets. They gravitate towards sparkly treats, with many preferring candies coated in edible glitter.

entry: POKENAME战斗热情多于技巧，会快速抓咬对手。虽经验不足，动作却灵巧难捉，是年轻训练家难对付的挑战。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME fight with more enthusiasm than skill, lashing out with rapid scratches and bites at those they're battling. Despite their own inexperience, they are nimble and difficult to pin down, making them a challenge for younger trainers to battle.

entry: POKENAME对信任的人十分亲热，宁愿抱训练家的腿，也不想待精灵球。它不停打磨头上硬币，确保永远闪亮。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are incredibly affectionate toward those they trust, preferring to cling to their Trainer's leg rather than stay in their Pokéballs. They constantly polish the coin on their heads, ensuring it never loses its shine.

entry: POKENAME用额上金币改善导电，更快放电。若摸得它不高兴，它便电击弄乱皮毛的人。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME uses the gold coin on its forehead to improve electricity conduction and generate discharges more rapidly. If rubbed the wrong way, it retaliates by shocking whoever ruffled its fur.

entry: 它生性自私，偷走硬币，谁敢夺走就会被它碾压。贪婪本性加上胸前符号，让它常被火箭队成员使用。
author: sk372
source: It has a selfish nature, stealing coins and crushing those that would threaten to take them away. Fitting its greedy nature and the symbol on its chest, it's become commonly seen used by Team Rocket members.

entry: POKENAME是捣蛋鬼，常电击别人，想惹对方反应，或趁机偷东西。弹一下额上硬币，就会让它哭着乖乖听话，至少暂时如此。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a prankster, often shocking others to get a rise out of them or swipe something from them. Flicking the coin on its forehead will make it cry and behave, at least temporarily.

entry: 有人说，这种宝可梦曾是女巫的使魔，因一次失误咒术获得自己的魔力。不过即使真有魔法，它也懒得展示。
author: calelian
source: Some say that this Pokémon was once a witch's familiar that gained magical abilities of its own after a spell gone awry. However, if it has magic powers, it is too lazy to show them.

entry: POKENAME常在街头跑来跑去，把看似金珠的东西丢向人群。仔细一看，原来只是金珠形的闪亮彩纸。
author: plkfsa32
source: POKENAME is usually seen running around streets throwing what appear to be Nuggets into crowds. However on closer inspection, it only tosses sparkling confetti shaped like Nuggets.

entry: POKENAME习惯从人耳后变出硬币，用小把戏分散毫无防备者的注意，让同群伙伴悄悄扒窃。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME have a habit of pulling coins from behind people's ears. They use this little trick to distract unsuspecting victims, allowing others in their pack to sneakily pickpocket them.

entry: POKENAME收集硬币和光滑亮物，存进口袋。体形相近的宝可梦让它自在，遇到不熟、又大得多的，就可能害怕退缩。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME collects coins and polished objects and stores it in its pouch. It feels comfortable around Pokémon similar in size to itself, but it may feel intimidated and shy away from much larger Pokémon it is not familiar with.

entry: POKENAME从小就懂随身硬币的价值，拼命保护。威胁和强迫都不能让它屈服，连训练家也很少能摸。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME understands from a young age the value of the coin it carries and protects it with fervor. It does not capitulate to threats or force and rarely allows its Trainer to touch the coin.

entry: POKENAME食欲无底，总要求训练家喂食。它偏爱昂贵的鱼宝可梦，拿到进口鱼罐头时，眼睛都会开心发亮。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have an insatiable appetite, constantly demanding their trainers feed them. They have a preference for expensive fish Pokémon, their eyes lighting up with delight when they're offered imported cans of them.

entry: POKENAME一心只想找吃的，常跳上厨房台面，朝主人嚎叫，直到喂食。忽略太久，它就会把台上东西推下去，吸引注意。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have a single-minded focus on finding food and are prone to jumping up onto kitchen surfaces to yowl at their owner until they're fed. If they are ignored for too long, they begin to knock items off of countertops to get attention.

entry: POKENAME一心只想找吃的，常跳上厨房台面，朝主人嚎叫，直到喂食。它偏爱意面料理，尤其喜欢千层面。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have a single-minded focus on finding food and are prone to jumping up onto kitchen surfaces to yowl at their owner until they're fed. They have a preference for pasta-based dishes, with lasagne being a special favourite.

entry: POKENAME十分狡猾，有找到闪亮宝物的奇异本领。四脚或后腿走路都很协调，爪上凹口方便抓小物，还精通摆出“无辜可怜的眼神”。
author: laughing_dan
source: POKENAME is a devious Pokémon. It has an uncanny ability to find shiny treasures, is coordinated on all fours or its hind legs, its claws have notches that allow it to pick up small objects easily, and has mastered the 'innocent sad eyes' ability.

entry: POKENAME挖好洞穴，就在洞外顶上放枚硬币，宣告所有权。这简单举动，同类一看便懂。
author: .izik
source: After digging a den for itself, POKENAME places a coin on the outside roof of the burrow to signify its ownership. This simple gesture is a clear message to others of its kind.

entry: POKENAME看似“毛发”的部分，质地像瓷器般光滑亮泽。许多幸运符都印着它的脸，因为人们相信，它能带来和睦与意外好运。
author: dyo_jonah
source: What appears to be its 'fur' has a smooth, glossy texture similar to porcelain. Many good luck charms have POKENAME's face on them, as they are believed to be bringers of harmony and serendipity.

entry: POKENAME收集一切圆亮物件，最爱数据光碟。一次著名事件中，它夜闯百货公司，偷走价值不菲的招式学习器。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME will collect any round and shiny object, but is most fond of data discs. On one notable occasion, a POKENAME broke into a Department Store at night and stole TMs worth a small fortune.

entry: POKENAME盯上孤独的人，给电脑塞满猫宝可梦表情包。它促使更多弃养猫类宝可梦获领养，城镇里的流浪猫宝可梦大幅减少。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME target lonely people, bombarding their computers with memes of cat Pokémon. POKENAME's actions have seen a rise in adoptions of abandoned feline Pokémon, sharply reducing feral cat Pokémon in towns.

entry: POKENAME找到亮物，就会拍翼、开心啁啾，欢喜蹦跳。随后用喙叼回巢里，把宝贝藏在巢材中。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: When POKENAME finds a shiny object, it will flap its wings and chirp happily as it hops around in joy. Picking up the object with its beak, POKENAME brings it back to its nest and hides the treasure amongst the material.

entry: 硬币是POKENAME最爱的东西，忍不住收集囤积。即使心爱的训练家，也很难让它割爱任何一枚。
author: sk372
source: Coins are POKENAME's favorite thing in the world, and it cannot resist collecting and hoarding them. Even its beloved Trainer will have a very difficult time trying to get it to part with any of its gathered coins.

entry: 主人喜欢把零钱存进POKENAME空壳般的身体。谁在壳里存得多，它就格外喜欢谁。
author: fireflower20002
source: Owners of POKENAME like to save their spare change in POKENAME's empty shell of a body. POKENAME are especially fond of those who have saved up a lot of money in their shell.

entry: POKENAME用带毒口水舔找到的硬币，标记为己有。这让想偷硬币的生物面临中毒危险。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME licks the coins it finds with its poisonous saliva, marking them as its own. This venomous touch makes the coins dangerous to those who try to steal them.

entry: 古老信仰称，摩擦POKENAME的楔石，便能得到108枚纯金币。它性情反复，常不理请求，连训练家也一样。
author: fiordaliso
source: According to an ancient belief, rubbing POKENAME's keystone is said to yield a gift of 108 pure gold coins. It is a capricious Pokémon that often ignores requests, even those from its own Trainer.

entry: POKENAME能清点任意数量的硬币并搬运，赌场因此常雇它。发怒或受威胁时，它会把硬币以突破音障的速度射出。
author: alextheperson
source: POKENAME are often employed by casinos because of their ability to count any amount of coins and transport them from place to place. When angered or threatened, it will launch them at speeds that break the sound barrier.

entry: 谁想摸金币，POKENAME就会用毒爪抓挠。战斗时，它以后腿站起，让对手更加害怕。
author: fiordaliso
source: If anyone tries to touch its gold coin, POKENAME reacts by scratching them with its venomous claws. It stands on its hind legs when it fights to strike more fear into its opponents.

entry: POKENAME把成堆黄金和硬币放在张开的大嘴里，吸引贪婪的宝可梦。忍不住上钩的，便会被整个吞下。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME leave piles of gold and coins sitting in their open jaws, attracting greedy Pokémon. Those who can't help but take the bait are swallowed whole.

entry: POKENAME在洞窟搜寻用过的离洞绳，再拿绳换亮物，最喜欢红宝石。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME scour through caves in search of used Escape Rope. POKENAME have been known to trade the rope for shiny objects, favoring rubies above all.

entry: POKENAME常在小杂货店工作。它坚持客人先付现金，厌恶想赊账的人。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME can commonly be found employed in small general stores. They are rather adamant that customers pay upfront with cash and detest those who try to pay with credit.

entry: POKENAME攒起一小堆硬币，就躺在上面，用大耳朵留意附近。察觉危险或入侵者，它便用尖角攻击。
author: .izik
source: After gathering a small stack of coins, POKENAME lays on top, its huge ears listening for anyone nearby. It attacks with its sharp horn if it senses danger or intruders.

entry: 黄金本来太重太软，不适合做剑刃，但它能够自行修复。还能探测宝藏，一发现就会明显兴奋起来。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: Gold would normally be too heavy and soft for a sword blade, but it's able to repair itself. It can detect treasure, its presence visibly exciting it.

entry: POKENAME用收集的硬币，对敌手使出聚宝功。威力虽不强，双方的荣誉却在互掷的硬币暴雨中受到考验。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses the coins it collects to unleash a Pay Day attack on rivals. While not offensively strong, their honor is tested as they pelt each other with a storm of coins.

entry: POKENAME拿丢进湖边家园的亮饰品装点身体。平时在湖底休息，不过向水里投几枚硬币，就能引它浮上来。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME adorn their bodies with the shiny trinkets they find tossed into their lakeside homes. While they typically rest at the bottom of lakes, they can be lured to the surface with a few coins thrown into the water.

entry: POKENAME用精巧幻象逗乐人们，骗取钱财。它还常为取乐而偷窃、破坏财物。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME tricks people into giving up their money by entertaining them with clever illusions. It often steals and vandalizes property for fun.

entry: POKENAME迷恋闪亮的东西。想收服它的训练家只要送上亮晶晶的礼物，就能轻松与它交好。
author: melodydelune
source: Fascinated by shiny objects, POKENAME can be easily befriended by prospective Trainers by offering it something that sparkles.

entry: 这些小型宝可梦由等离子体构成，因此能迅速飞窜。它们喜爱金币等亮物，总爱抢走囤起来。
author: infinex21
source: These small Pokémon can dart around rapidly due to their bodies that are made of plasma. They favor shiny objects, such as gold coins, and love to snatch them up and hoard them.

entry: POKENAME发现地上硬币，尾巴便泛起奇异光芒。这代表它迷恋亮物，也驱使它寻找越来越珍贵的收获。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's tails make a peculiar glow when it finds a coin on the ground. This glow is a sign of its fascination with shiny objects, which draws it to search for ever more valuable finds.

entry: POKENAME在世界各地的宝箱里生活，把硬币存进身体，活像真钱包。箱里又暗又紧凑，让它感到舒适。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME is found in treasure chests throughout the world and stores coins in its body to appear like an actual purse. It finds chests comfortable because of their dark and compact space.

entry: POKENAME太快，研究者难以研究。被发现时，它常俯冲偷走亮物，收入积藏。许多人推测，带翼鸟猫的童话源自它。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: Researchers have struggled to study POKENAME due to their speed. When they are spotted, they often swoop down to steal shiny objects for their hordes. Many theorize fairytales about winged bird-cat creatures originated from this Pokémon.

entry: 野生POKENAME生活脏乱，食物和水都难获取。与训练家建立信任后，它会献上食物，表示顺服。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME in the wild live in squalid conditions where they have little access to food or water. After building trust with their Trainer, they give offerings of food as a gesture of submissiveness.

entry: POKENAME潜伏城市，在街上游荡，常免费送物品。它不喜欢被看见，因此每次接触都很短，免得伪装被识破。
author: felicia_j.t
source: POKENAME lurks in cities, hanging around in the streets, where it tends to give out items for free. It dislikes being seen, so it keeps interactions short to avoid its disguise being seen through.

entry: POKENAME胡须有特殊酶，能嗅出金属硬币和珠宝。取回宝物后，它喜欢蜷缩片刻，梳理毛发。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have special enzymes in their whiskers that allow them to sniff out metallic coins or jewelry. After retrieving these treasures, they love curling up for a moment to brush their fur.

entry: POKENAME长而粗的毛会被收集，用于高级刷子和扫帚。多条尾巴需要费心打理，才能保持洁净。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME has long, coarse fur that is harvested to make luxury brushes and brooms. Its many tails require lots of maintenance to keep clean.

entry: POKENAME用利爪挖开灌木和泥土寻找金属。它喜欢住在城镇及周边，囤着一小堆遗失、丢弃的硬币。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME use their sharp claws to dig through undergrowth and dirt in search of metal. They have a fondness for living in and around cities and amass small hoards of lost and discarded coins.

entry: POKENAME用木材和泥盖好巢屋后，会搜查四周，寻找掉落硬币。找到什么，就拿来装饰家。
author: .izik
source: After constructing a lodge made of timber and mud, POKENAME scours the area for dropped coins. It decorates its home with whatever it finds.

entry: POKENAME在草铺上排满硬币，睡觉便能安心。硬币在旁，似乎能让它休息得更舒适。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME lines its grass bedding with coins, which set its mind at ease when sleeping. The presence of the coins seems to provide a sense of comfort during its rest.

entry: POKENAME白天大多懒躺在光束里，满足地睡在暖阳下。训练家有时得用闪亮硬币引诱，才肯起身运动。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME laze about in sunbeams for most of the day, content to sleep away the daylight hours under the warm light. Trainers sometimes have to motivate them to get exercise, using the allure of a shiny coin to get them to move.

entry: POKENAME白天大多懒躺在光束里，满足地睡在暖阳下。训练家有时得用闪亮硬币引诱，才肯起身运动。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME laze about in sunbeams for most of the day, content to sleep away the daylight hours under the warm light. Trainers sometimes have to motivate them to get exercise, using the allure of a shiny coin to get them to move.

entry: POKENAME平时独来独往，但一看见人拿硬币，就会兴奋得发狂。它撞向拿钱的人，试图用爪抢走，在大城市尤其惹人烦。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Though they usually keep to themselves, POKENAME fly into an excited frenzy when they see people handling coins. They barrel into whoever is holding the money and attempt to claw it off them, making them a particular nuisance in big cities.

entry: POKENAME平时独来独往，但一看见人拿硬币，就会兴奋得发狂。它撞向拿钱的人，试图用爪抢走，在大城市尤其惹人烦。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Though they usually keep to themselves, POKENAME fly into an excited frenzy when they see people handling coins. They barrel into whoever is holding the money and attempt to claw it off them, making them a particular nuisance in big cities.

entry: POKENAME用硬币与尾巴的亮光，引来黑暗鸦等毫无防备的鸟宝可梦。对方一近，便猛扑捉住，拖回巢中充饥。
author: elite01.
source: POKENAME uses the sharp glare of its coin and tail to lure unsuspecting bird Pokémon like Murkrow. Once they approach, it pounces and drags them back to its den as prey.

entry: POKENAME亲近财富，寻找贵重物品及其囤藏处。它常被用来守银行，人们认为它能给公司带来超自然的好运。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have an affinity for wealth, seeking out valuable items and locations where they're hoarded. They are commonly used to guard banks, their presence considered to bring a supernatural good fortune to the company.

entry: POKENAME亲近财富，寻找贵重物品及其囤藏处。它常被用来守银行，人们认为它能给公司带来超自然的好运。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have an affinity for wealth, seeking out valuable items and locations where they're hoarded. They are commonly used to guard banks, their presence considered to bring a supernatural good fortune to the company.

entry: POKENAME的毛虽然是金做的，身体却极轻。画家形容它的眼睛，像深蓝宝石。
author: mistymagius
source: Despite its fur being made out of gold, POKENAME is incredibly lightweight. Painters have described POKENAME's eyes as resembling deep-blue sapphires.

entry: POKENAME用包着铁甲的头撞自动售货机，震出零钱。掉下的硬币，它都开心吃掉。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME bashes its iron-plated head into vending machines to knock loose change. It happily eats any coins that fall out.

entry: POKENAME由恰好18K金的合金构成。这成分让它格外坚固，同时保留价值。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are made with an alloy that is precisely 18K gold. This composition gives them remarkable durability while also retaining their value.

entry: POKENAME制造幻象时，额上硬币会闪亮发光。它能变出逼真的人形幻象，分散注意，趁机偷公寓里的贵重物品。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The coin on POKENAME's forehead glitters and gives off light whenever they are projecting an illusion. They can create convincing illusions of people, using these figments to distract humans whilst they pilfer valuable items from their apartments.

entry: 纸币发明前，POKENAME全家会在铸币库合作，帮助生产硬币。火焰能迅速熔化金属，也很容易训练它把熔融金属铸成钱币。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Prior to the invention of paper money, entire families of POKENAME worked together in treasuries to help with coin production. They are easily trained to shape the molten metal into coinage, as their flames are hot enough to quickly melt metal.

entry: POKENAME晃动头上硬币，就会释放甜美的樱子果香。香气安抚别人，让它更方便偷东西。
author: .izik
source: By wiggling the coin on its head, POKENAME releases a sweet Cheri Berry scent. The fragrance calms others, making it easier to steal their belongings.

entry: POKENAME美丽的金玫瑰很受富人欢迎。可POKENAME自私极了，绝不许人碰自己的花。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is popular among the wealthy due to its beautiful golden roses. However, POKENAME is a very selfish Pokémon and will never let anyone touch its roses.

entry: POKENAME体内的毛绒娃娃，会随最近与它建立感情的人改变形状。过程原理仍不清楚。
author: .izik
source: The plush dolls within POKENAME shift form depending on the last human it bonded with. The process behind this remains unknown.

entry: 它先用精巧跳跃迷住观众，再洗劫财物。旅人穿过POKENAME栖居的森林前，最好先收好钱和珠宝。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: It dazzles its captive audience with elaborate jumps before robbing them of their belongings. Travelers are advised to secure their money and jewelry before traveling through forests where POKENAME lives.

entry: 家养POKENAME被观察到是个还算可靠的存钱罐。若喂得不够、关爱不足，它就会吃光体内硬币，而非存着。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: A domesticated POKENAME has been observed to be a somewhat reliable coin bank. If it's not fed or loved well enough, it will consume all the coins inside of it instead of storing them.

entry: POKENAME夜里挖隧道进店，盗取无人看守的收银机里的钱。它留下纸币，更喜欢视作亮闪闪宝贝的硬币。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME digs tunnels into shops at night to steal from unmanned cash registers. It leaves paper money behind, preferring the coins that it sees as shiny treasures.

entry: 据说，野外遇见POKENAME象征好运。可谁若得寸进尺，想碰硬币，立刻就会挨电。
author: alumed
source: Finding a POKENAME in the wild is said to be a sign of good fortune, though it is quick to shock any that press their luck and try to touch its coin.

entry: POKENAME一生大多独居。繁殖季开始，它便收集见到的亮物，配上舞蹈和欢快啁啾，打动潜在伴侣。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME live in solitude for most of their life. When the breeding season begins, POKENAME gather any shiny object they find, pairing these gifts with a dance and mirthful chirping to impress potential mates.

entry: POKENAME主要出现在古老海盗宝藏附近，朝靠得太近的生物喷火。火爆性子，让它成了危险的藏宝守卫。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME is primarily found near old pirate treasures, where it spits flames at anyone who gets too close. Its fiery nature makes it a dangerous guardian of hidden riches.

entry: 它们在黄昏最活跃。年幼POKENAME吃得尤其邋遢，不过吃完总会认真梳理全身。
author: bobosmith01
source: They are most active at dusk. Young POKENAME are particularly messy eaters, although they always groom themselves vigorously afterwards.

entry: POKENAME实际上看不见，却似乎对贵重物品和敌人都有第六感，能在环境中自如活动。它通常睡在闪亮珠宝和硬币堆里。
author: bobosmith01
source: Although functionally blind, POKENAME seems to have a sixth sense for both valuables and foes, which allows it to function in its environment. It generally sleeps in its hoard of glittering jewels and coins.

entry: POKENAME实际上看不见，却似乎对贵重物品和敌人都有第六感，能在环境中自如活动。它通常睡在闪亮珠宝和硬币堆里。
author: bobosmith01
source: Although functionally blind, POKENAME seems to have a sixth sense for both valuables and foes, which allows it to function in its environment. It generally sleeps in its hoard of glittering jewels and coins.

entry: POKENAME见到摄像机，就会跑到镜头前糟蹋披萨。什么都不肯认真对待，实在是个麻烦。
author: skymaster426
source: POKENAME can be found destroying pizzas in front of any cameras it can find. It is unable to take anything seriously, making it a nuisance.

entry: POKENAME捕猎波波等目标前，会先把尾毛涂毒。这番准备让攻击致命高效，捕猎轻而易举。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME coats its tail fur in poison before it attacks prey like Pidgey. This toxic preparation makes its strike both deadly and efficient, ensuring an easy hunt.

entry: 文献称，POKENAME登门会带来极佳运气。不过它夜里通常会洗劫贵重物品，有历史学家因此推测，传说是在说反话。
author: bobosmith01
source: It has been written that a house visited by POKENAME will have incredible luck. However, as POKENAME usually robs these houses in the night for valuables, some historians have speculated that these legends were being sarcastic.

entry: POKENAME叶片的金属气味，闻起来像零钱。这独特香气常被误认成新铸硬币，吸引人和宝可梦。
author: .izik
source: The metallic scent coming from POKENAME's leaves smells like loose change. This unique aroma is often mistaken for freshly minted coins, attracting both people and Pokémon alike.

entry: POKENAME跳舞时，会抛出来源不明的硬币。金属碰响是它主要的音乐，节奏与优雅动作相合。
author: .izik
source: While dancing, POKENAME flings coins from that it produces from an unknown source. The clinking of the metal is its primary form of music, creating a rhythm that matches its graceful movements.

entry: 野生POKENAME吃金属垃圾时，会留下硬币。可一被收服或圈养，这怪事便不再发生。
author: .izik
source: While eating metal trash, wild POKENAME leave behind coins. This strange occurrence does not happen after they are captured or while in captivity.

entry: POKENAME用闪亮护符反射阳光，晃花猎物，再迅速狠狠咬下。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME reflects sunlight off its shiny charm to dazzle prey. It then follows up with a swift and powerful bite.

entry: POKENAME会为森林中迷路的训练家指路，换取硬币。钱给得不够，它的树就会走开换位置，让人更迷糊，直到付足。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME reveal themselves to Trainers lost in the forest to guide their way in exchange for coins. If a POKENAME isn't paid enough, its tree will walk away and reposition itself to confuse the Trainer further until they pay in full.

entry: POKENAME头上的金珠散发浓郁糖香，引来独角虫等宝可梦，轻松就能抓住。
author: .izik
source: The Nugget on POKENAME's head gives off a rich, sugary aroma. It lures in Pokémon like Weedle, which it catches with ease.

entry: POKENAME见到硬币就开心地吃。健康个体每月至少吃一磅零钱。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME happily eat coins wherever they can find them. Healthy POKENAME consume at least a pound of loose change every month.

entry: 它只在闻到食物时睁眼，其余时候一直装睡。谁未经允许触摸胶质身体，POKENAME就会咬谁。
author: fiordaliso
source: It only opens its eyes when it smells food; otherwise, it pretends to be asleep the whole time. If anyone tries to touch its gelatinous body without its permission, POKENAME bites them.

entry: POKENAME不放过任何捡零钱的机会，谁想夺走，它就疯狂挥动四肢。身子虽小又像毛绒玩具，力道却能轻松掀翻最魁梧的生物。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME will jump at any opportunity to collect any loose change it spots, swinging its limbs wildly at any who try to take the coins from it. Despite its small and plush stature, these strikes can easily knock over the burliest of beings.

entry: POKENAME在沉船里伪装成水下宝藏。谁伸手想拿，就会被它凶狠夹住。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME poses as sunken treasure aboard shipwrecks. It clamps down viciously on anyone who reaches out to claim it.

entry: POKENAME背上硬币状的蘑菇藏着重要养分。它吃东西滋养蘑菇，蘑菇又反过来为它供养。
author: .izik
source: The coin-like mushrooms attached to POKENAME's back hold vital nutrients. As it eats, it feeds the mushrooms, while they, in turn, provide nourishment to POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME不受管束，为了更多硬币什么都肯做。剃刀般的爪能划开钱包，偷走想要的一切。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are unruly creatures that will do anything to get more coins. Their razor-sharp claws allow them to cut open purses and steal anything they desire.

entry: POKENAME通过头上硬币传导精神力。心怀恶意时，放出的光便会明亮闪烁。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME channels psychic power through the coin on its head. The light it gives off flickers brightly when it has malicious thoughts.

entry: POKENAME执迷寻找掉在暗处的硬币和亮物。它把东西贴在背上，用菌丝固定，珍藏越积越多。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME obsessively seek out coins and other shiny objects that have been dropped in dark places. They attach these items to their back, fungal threads holding the shiny items in place as they build up their hoard.

entry: POKENAME身体饰着金色甲片，需要定期打磨，才能保持光亮。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's body is adorned with golden plates. Regular polishing is required to keep the plates shiny.

entry: POKENAME能奇异地感知埋藏钱币，是考古学家的常见伙伴。它用大前爪挖土，揭出古币，提示可能的发掘地点。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are a common companion of archaeologists thanks to their uncanny ability to sense buried coinage. They use their large front claws to dig through soil to uncover ancient currency, alerting the archaeologist to a potential dig site.

entry: POKENAME性情节俭，常拒绝太贵重的礼物。训练家不妨先给装饰硬币，鼓励它接受赠礼。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME has a parsimonious tendency to reject gifts that are too expensive. Trainers are advised to give it decorative coins to encourage it to accept gifts.

entry: 这种宝可梦痴迷宝物，看见金色或闪亮的东西，就忍不住收进厚毛里。人们最初以为，它毛发的金色来自这些积藏。
author: deadshields
source: A Pokémon obsessed with treasures, they can't help but pocket anything gold or sparkly they find within their thick fur coat. It was originally thought that their hoarded treasures were the source of their fur's gilded colour.

entry: 纸币发明前，POKENAME全家会在铸币库合作，帮助生产硬币。火焰能迅速熔化金属，也很容易训练它把熔融金属铸成钱币。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Prior to the invention of paper money, entire families of POKENAME worked together in treasuries to help with coin production. They are easily trained to shape the molten metal into coinage, as their flames are hot enough to quickly melt metal.

entry: 纸币发明前，POKENAME全家会在铸币库合作，帮助生产硬币。火焰能迅速熔化金属，也很容易训练它把熔融金属铸成钱币。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Prior to the invention of paper money, entire families of POKENAME worked together in treasuries to help with coin production. They are easily trained to shape the molten metal into coinage, as their flames are hot enough to quickly melt metal.

entry: POKENAME把旧钱币堆成巢，蜷在里面，用尾焰加热金属，夜里保暖。用久的巢，会熔成一整团金属。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME gather old coinage to pile into nests, curling up in them and heating the metal with the flame on their tail to help them stay warm at night. POKENAME nests that have been used for a long time melt into a single mass of metal.

entry: POKENAME喜欢在金矿附近挖掘，敲下小碎块，小心囤在地下巢穴。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME prefers digging near gold deposits. It breaks off small fragments and hoards them carefully within its underground den.

entry: 据说把POKENAME的护符与心爱之人交换，就一定能获得回应。这信念曾让它短暂陷入濒危，因为人们盗猎珍贵护符。
author: .izik
source: It is said that if POKENAME's charm is exchanged with the person one loves, it will ensure their love in return. This belief once caused a short period where POKENAME was endangered due to poaching for its precious charm.

entry: 想找POKENAME，可以在巢穴上方地面丢枚硬币。它立刻感知震动，钻上来把东西拉下去。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME can be detected by dropping a coin onto the ground above its lair. It senses the vibration instantly and tunnels up to pull the object below.

entry: POKENAME三者边挖，边各吃土中不同成分：一个吃金属化合物，一个吃泥土，第三个吃有机物。外表也最终反映各自的饮食。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Trios of POKENAME each feed on a different part of the soil as they dig. One feeds on metal compounds, the second on the soil itself, and the third on organic matter. Their appearances end up reflecting their individual diets.

entry: POKENAME三者边挖，边各吃土中不同成分：一个吃金属化合物，一个吃泥土，第三个吃有机物。外表也最终反映各自的饮食。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Trios of POKENAME each feed on a different part of the soil as they dig. One feeds on metal compounds, the second on the soil itself, and the third on organic matter. Their appearances end up reflecting their individual diets.

entry: 喵喵的自融合体会开心招手，欢迎别人靠近。据说，接受邀请的生物都能得到财富与各种好运。
author: infranscia
source: This self fusion of Meowth cheerfully beckons others to it.  It's often said it offers wealth and other types of good fortune to any who will follow its welcoming invitation.

entry: POKENAME身体细长，难以平衡。力量不足以完全挺直，因此总是弯腰。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME has a hard time balancing itself due to its long, lanky body. Its body will always be bent over due to not having enough strength to keep it fully upright.

entry: 自融合的POKENAME总在与自己的良心交战。若一时冲动偷了训练家硬币，之后往往会非常内疚。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: This self-fusion of POKENAME is constantly at war with its own conscience. If POKENAME impulsively steals coins from its Trainer, it tends to feel very guilty afterward.

entry: POKENAME身体细长，难以平衡。力量不足以完全挺直，因此总是弯腰。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME has a hard time balancing itself due to its long, lanky body. Its body will always be bent over due to not having enough strength to keep it fully upright.

entry: POKENAME比同族性情平和，被视为合适的家庭宠物。只要平时给些关爱，偶尔送个亮饰品，它就很满足。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is considered a good family pet thanks to its even temperament compared to others of its family. All it craves is regular affection and an occasional shiny bauble, and it remains content.

entry: 奇怪的是，吃小硬币能帮POKENAME缓解头痛。不过吃得过量，又会变成腹部绞痛。
author: sk372
source: Strangely, consuming small coins assists POKENAME in soothing its painful headaches. Excessively eating them will lead to it developing stomach cramps instead, however.

entry: POKENAME摇摆着走出河中家园，为巢寻找亮物。捡到后便往回走，可就在快到河边时，它又忘了自己当初为什么想要。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME waddle out of river homes in search of sparkly objects for their nest. After picking up something shiny, they make their way home. However, right before reaching the river, they forget why they wanted the shiny object in the first place.

entry: POKENAME若觉得有人要拿走自己想要的闪亮物件，就会不停抓挠对方。可这股盲目的怒气往往让它失去那件宝贝。
author: pokepower
source: If POKENAME thinks someone will take a shiny object it wants, it will scratch them relentlessly. This blind fury usually leads to losing the object.

entry: POKENAME暴怒时，只需轻轻摸一下头上护符，就能立刻平静。不过它发怒会失控乱挥，想碰到可不容易。
author: .izik
source: If POKENAME is in a rage, a single soft touch to the charm on its head will instantly calm it. This maneuver is difficult to pull off, as POKENAME tends to flail uncontrollably when enraged.

entry: 毛发浓密蓬松，常被用于制作冬衣。也是寒冷地区很受欢迎的伙伴。
author: chorb33
source: Its fur is very dense and fluffy, which is why it is often used for winter clothing. It is also a popular companion in cold regions.

entry: POKENAME有这般体格，却十分爱玩。训练需要极大耐心，最后才能得到忠实的伙伴。
author: chorb33
source: Despite its size, POKENAME is very playful. A Trainer needs a lot of patience to train it, but will be rewarded with a loyal companion in the end.

entry: POKENAME贪财得毫不掩饰，在天空翱翔，寻找能偷取宝可元的训练家。每逢不可避免地受伤，它就会变得记仇凶狠。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a crass obsession with coins and money and soar through the sky looking for Trainers to steal precious Pokédollars from. Whenever they inevitably get hurt, they become vindictive and aggressive.

entry: POKENAME腹部嵌着的金块能释放催眠的精神波，捕食者靠近时，便可借此逃走。
author: .izik
source: The gold nugget embedded in POKENAME's belly lets loose psychic waves that can cause someone to fall asleep. This allows it to flee if a predator approaches.

entry: POKENAME腹上的扁硬币闪光，让对手入睡。这催眠效果，能帮助自卫，或不战而擒获猎物。
author: .izik
source: The flattened coin on POKENAME's belly shimmers to lull an opponent to sleep. This hypnotic effect helps it defend itself or take down prey without a fight.

entry: POKENAME靠近硬币就能获得精神力。硬币越大，力量越强。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME gain psychic powers whenever they are near coins. The bigger the coin, the more power they gain.

entry: POKENAME喜欢收零钱袋。附近每多一枚硬币，精神力就更强，尤其偏爱稀有或高价值钱币。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME love being given coin pouches. Their psychic powers increase in strength for every coin near them, especially if the coins are rare or of high value.

entry: POKENAME的精神力依赖零钱袋，很难让它交出。训练家若真拿走，它会一直不开心，直到珍贵硬币归还。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are difficult to separate from their coin pouch because their psychic powers rely on it. If a Trainer does manage to do so, POKENAME will remain upset until given back their precious coins.

entry: POKENAME一动不动藏在花坛，用悄无声息的藤蔓，抢走毫无戒备路人的硬币。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME hides in flowerbeds, standing perfectly still. It uses stealthy vines to snatch coins from unsuspecting passersby.

entry: POKENAME背上的硬壳随年龄增长而更硬。受威胁会收回四肢，不过更常是为了避免被训练家发现偷亮物。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: The hard shell on POKENAME's back hardens as it ages. When threatened, it will retreat its limbs inside its shell. However, more often it retreats to avoid being caught stealing shiny objects from unsuspecting Trainers.

entry: POKENAME大部分时候睡着，只有危及生命才醒。它全靠运气维生，等食物自己走进大张的嘴。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME lie asleep most of the time, only waking up when in life-threatening danger. They rely on pure luck to keep themselves alive, waiting for food to simply wander into their wide-open mouth.

entry: POKENAME在人脚下爬，盼有人掉零钱，因此常被踩。这时它便响亮嘶叫，出拳打踩自己的东西。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME crawls around under the feet of people with the hopes that they drop loose change. Because it is always underfoot, it often gets stepped on. When this happens it lets out a loud hiss and punches whatever stepped on it.

entry: POKENAME吃未加工的金属，融入身体，增加密度。过去，它常高速滚下山坡，冲进金库吃黄金，给山城银行惹麻烦。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME eat raw metals, incorporating them into their body to increase their density. They have historically been a problem for banks in mountain towns as they barrel down the hillside at high speed, breaking into the vaults to eat the gold inside.

entry: POKENAME吃未加工的金属，融入身体，增加密度。过去，它常高速滚下山坡，冲进金库吃黄金，给山城银行惹麻烦。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME eat raw metals, incorporating them into their body to increase their density. They have historically been a problem for banks in mountain towns as they barrel down the hillside at high speed, breaking into the vaults to eat the gold inside.

entry: POKENAME岩壳上形成天然金矿，在阳光下闪耀。它常被盗猎者盯上，只好躲进深山。
author: santon5512
source: Natural gold deposits form on POKENAME's rocky shells, shimmering in the sunlight. These Pokémon are commonly targeted by poachers, leading them to hide out deep in the mountains.

entry: POKENAME有点顽皮，喜欢被摸时突然让火焰窜高。火不会伤人，它只是享受受害者吓一跳的反应。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has a bit of a mischievous streak, and enjoys suddenly flaring its flames up while being pet. The flames remain harmless, but it revels in the startled reactions it gets from its victims.

entry: POKENAME奔跑时，头上护符升温，烧得鲜红。这时火焰攻击强得多，让它成为一股势不可挡的烈焰。
author: .izik
source: The charm on POKENAME's head heats up while it is running, glowing a bright red. During this time, its fire attacks become much stronger, turning it into a blazing force of nature.

entry: POKENAME漫步城镇，寻找一切亮物。捡到就丢进大舌贝里，留着以后用。有些小镇警队会请它找遗失的珠宝和钱包。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME meander through towns, searching for any shiny objects they can find. Upon picking up something, they will toss it into their Shellder to store for later. Some small-town police forces use POKENAME to find lost jewelry and wallets.

entry: POKENAME通过头上护符传导雷电，增强电力，是罕见又强大的小磁怪变体。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME channels lightning through the charm on its head, enhancing its electrical abilities. This makes it a rare and powerful variation of Magnemite.

entry: POKENAME会淘气地用磁力，拉走毫无戒备旅人的钱。它尤其爱偷酒馆里失去意识的人，因为对方通常根本不知情。
author: fireflower20002
source: POKENAME will mischievously and magnetically pull away money from unsuspecting travelers. It especially loves to pilfer those who have been knocked out in taverns since they are usually none the wiser.

entry: POKENAME在城市悄悄游荡，寻找废弃硬币，吸进黏滑身体。训练家若慷慨主动捐零钱，它便欢呼道谢。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME slinks around urban areas, attempting to find discarded coins to absorb into its slimy body. If Trainers graciously donate spare change to it willingly, it gives a thankful cheer in return.

entry: POKENAME常在赌场关门后闯入，把能找到的硬币全吸进身体，因此被视为祸害。若被打扰，它就会亮出尖牙。
author: plkfsa32
source: Casinos regard POKENAME as a menace since it frequently breaks in after hours to absorb every coin it can find into its body. If provoked while doing so, it will show its fangs.

entry: POKENAME反复无常又懒惰，常随处睡大觉。谁想叫醒或挪动它，就会被壳上的水炮口喷水。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is quite fickle and lazy. It spends a good chunk of its time napping wherever it pleases and shoots water from the cannons in its shell at those who try to awaken or move it.

entry: POKENAME来回摇硬币，哄人沉睡。催眠对贪心者最有效，而他们发财的梦，正是它最爱的食物。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME wave their coin back and forth to lull people into a deep slumber. Their hypnotic powers work best on greedy people, and the dreams of wealth these people have are their favourite meal.

entry: POKENAME常在银行工作，用硬币摆锤占卜来客是否富有。富人会被带到经理室，再遭催眠，存入大笔钱。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME often work within banks, using their coin pendulum to divine whether an approaching patron is wealthy or not. Those who are wealthy are led to the manager's office where they are hypnotised into making large deposits of money.

entry: POKENAME以贪婪闻名，把所有自认为值钱的东西藏在巢里。人们从中找回过硬币、稀有树果，甚至宝石。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME is known for its greedy nature, stashing away anything it deems valuable in its den. Items recovered from these dens have included coins, rare berries, and even gemstones.

entry: POKENAME靠静电吸引散落硬币。清点时若受惊，可能会在漫天火花中爆炸。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME attracts loose coins using static electricity. If startled while counting them, it may explode in a shower of sparks.

entry: POKENAME白天大多用舌头清洁自己。舔得太勤，舌头上常会黏住毛球。
author: elite01.
source: POKENAME spend most of their days cleaning themselves with their tongue. Due to this frequent cleaning they often get hairballs stuck to their tongue.

entry: POKENAME进化前无法移动，常把大部分时间拿来打盹。紧张时，它会呼噜，让捕食者困惑得久到失去吃它的兴趣。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME often spend much of their time taking catnaps because they are unable to move until they evolve. They often purr when they are stressed, which confuses predators long enough to lose interest in eating them.

entry: POKENAME的气体对人有轻微毒性，接触太久会改变精神状态。长期吸入，会让人贪婪、渴望囤积财富。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME gas is mildly toxic to people, causing an altered mental state in those exposed to it for too long. Breathing the gas in over long periods of time creates feelings of avarice and a desire to hoard wealth.

entry: POKENAME白天大多懒洋洋地晒太阳，偶尔却突然亢奋，精力爆发。它会到处狂奔，撞穿墙壁和家具，几乎总造成财物损失。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Though POKENAME spend most of their day lazing in the sun, they are sometimes seized by a manic burst of energy. These energy bursts almost always result in property damage due to POKENAME crashing through walls and furniture as they race around.

entry: POKENAME用红宝石角挖洞壁，寻找宝石或稀有矿石。金子气味够浓，它能挖好几个小时。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its ruby horn to dig in cave walls in search of gems or rare ore. It will mine for hours if the scent of gold is strong.

entry: POKENAME保护着育儿袋里养大的喵喵，为孩子十分骄傲。不过喵喵恶作剧、调皮捣蛋时，它却不怎么当回事。
author: kam_doodle_snek
source: It is protective of the Meowth that it raises in its pouch. POKENAME is very proud of its child, though it is rather dismissive of any pranks or cheeky antics the Meowth may commit.

entry: POKENAME虽难照顾，却能给家中水缸添上王者气派。科学家仍争论，头上宝石的颜色和大小，是否受幼时所吃微生物影响。
author: chibitales
source: Though difficult to take care of, POKENAME adds an air of regality to home aquariums. Scientists debate on whether the color and size of the gem on POKENAME's head is influenced by its diet of microorganisms when it's young.

entry: POKENAME出手前，额上宝石先会发光。战斗中，它会胡乱挥刃，劈砍附近一切。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's forehead gem shines before it lashes out. During combat, it swings its blades wildly at anything nearby.

entry: POKENAME十只成群，用黏脚攀墙，在旧棚屋里筑巢。它会存放亮物，引来黑暗鸦等猎物。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME swarm in groups of ten, nesting in old shacks by clinging to walls with their sticky feet. They store shiny objects to lure in prey like Murkrow.

entry: POKENAME以冷酷精准统治水域，闪亮身形如蛇般滑过。其他宝可梦都让开，知道它不容违抗。
author: mgfox_66676
source: POKENAME rules its waters with cold precision, its glittering form gliding past like a serpent. Other Pokémon part before it, knowing it does not tolerate disobedience.

entry: POKENAME狩猎技艺极高，以变身近乎完美地隐藏，等飞行宝可梦落地歇脚，再突然扑出。
author: vibrationjaveline
source: POKENAME are incredibly proficient hunters, using their transformation abilities to hide almost perfectly, then pouncing on flying Pokémon when they land to rest.

entry: POKENAME十分得意于鬃毛，谁停下欣赏，它都常会炫耀。如今不再像从前那样四处找亮物，却会珍爱、守护收到的每件亮礼物。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: POKENAME are incredibly proud of their mane and will frequently flaunt it to all who stop to admire it. They do not hunt down shiny objects as much as they used to, but they will treasure any shiny items given to them and be very protective of them.

entry: POKENAME受惊，毛便刺立，闪起电火花。它通过额上宝石集中强劲雷电，射向惊吓自己的东西。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME fur prickles and stands up on end when they're startled, sparking with electricity. They shoot out powerful bolts of lightning toward whatever scares them, focusing the bolt through their forehead gem.

entry: POKENAME极其高傲，毛一弄脏就会凶暴起来。它能提高红毛的热量，烧掉夹着的小碎屑。若过热，就会休息一整天恢复。
author: infinex21
source: It is extremely prideful and turns aggressive if any of its fur is made dirty. POKENAME is able to amplify the heat of its red fur to burn away small debris caught within it. If it overheats, it will rest for an entire day to recover.

entry: POKENAME身体会定期按网页上最后看见的图像变形。常能在购物网站发现它，吞食销售数据。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body will regularly shift its shape based on the last image it has seen on a webpage. It frequently can be seen on shopping websites, where it consumes sales-based data.

entry: POKENAME在大树枝间群居，吃叶子，捕食者靠近便藏进树皮。它们互相呼噜交流，仿佛树木不断发出低鸣。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME form colonies within the branches of large trees, feeding on the leaves and hiding within the bark when predators approach. They purr to one another to communicate, creating the illusion that the trees are making a constant low noise.

entry: POKENAME用尾巴抓紧树枝，积攒进化的力量。它几乎完全不动，但威胁靠得太近，就会响亮嘶叫，试图吓退。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME use their tails to cling to tree branches while they gather the strength to evolve. They are almost completely immobile but give out a loud hiss to try and scare off threats that get too close.

entry: POKENAME钻石般坚硬的爪子，能破开其他宝可梦的壳。它喜爱亮物，常把遗失珠宝和小珍珠捡回巢里。
author: mistymagius
source: Its diamond-hard claws allow POKENAME to crack through the shells of other Pokémon. It adores shiny objects and will commonly grab lost jewelry or small pearls to take back to its den.

entry: 据说POKENAME环游世界，寻找比自己宝石更亮的珍品，为了收集不惜一切。藏品多得管不过来，才会把小宝石分给喵喵和勾魂眼。
author: npshi
source: POKENAME are said to fly around the world in search of gems shinier than their own, willing to do anything to collect them. They give away smaller gems to Meowth and Sableye once their collection grows beyond their control.

entry: 别的宝可梦一侵入领地，POKENAME额上宝石就会闪出愤怒红光。光引起同类注意，整群便扑向倒霉的入侵者。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The gem on POKENAME's forehead glints an angry red whenever they spy another Pokémon encroaching on their territory. The glint catches the attention of other POKENAME, drawing the entire swarm to descend on the unfortunate intruder.

entry: 额上红珍珠泛深红光，就代表POKENAME将使出非凡念动力。它认定一个人的价值后，会与对方结下一生羁绊。
author: fiordaliso
source: When the red pearl on its forehead glows crimson, POKENAME is about to use its extraordinary psychokinetic powers. It bonds with a single human for life after recognizing that person's worth.

entry: POKENAME的毛一摸就容易起火，不适合养在室内。它似乎不知给别人带来的危险，还会呼噜着，想亲近地蹭所爱之人。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME fur is prone to igniting when stroked, making them a dangerous Pokémon to keep indoors. They appear not to realise the risk they pose to others, purring as they attempt to rub up close against people they care about.

entry: POKENAME用胡须察觉风变，对战时喜欢占上风处。它能让毛间火焰猛燃，释放大股烟，呛住敌人。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME can sense changes in the wind with their whiskers, preferring to be upwind of their opponent during Pokémon battles. They can flare the fire burning in their fur to release large plumes of smoke, choking their foes in battle.

entry: POKENAME偷训练家的硬币和亮物装巢，恶名远扬，因此许多警察会搜它的窝，找失窃物品。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME steal coins and shiny objects from Trainers to decorate their nests. They are so infamous for this practice that many police officers search POKENAME's nests for stolen items.

entry: POKENAME被视为奢华宠物，常陪伴想营造光鲜形象的人。可惜这生活并不合适，它天性紧张，总躲到看不见的暗处。
author: zephyr.txt
source: Considered a luxury pet, they're often kept as companions to people hoping to cultivate a glamorous image. Unfortunately, this is an ill-fitting lifestyle for POKENAME, as its nervous nature leads it to hide in dark places where it cannot be seen.

entry: 农历新年等喜庆时节，POKENAME会向训练家讨小红包。多数人为了免听它哼哼，都选择给几枚硬币。
author: quackquackattack
source: During auspicious events like the lunar new year, POKENAME beg their Trainers for small red envelopes. Most Trainers opt to give them a few coins to avoid their whining.

entry: POKENAME使出识破，预知带宝物的人何时经过，再以不可思议的时机伏击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses Foresight to predict when someone with treasure will pass by. It ambushes them with uncanny timing.

entry: POKENAME需要定期剪毛，才能舒适活动，却对过程极其挑剔。一个动作不对，就会电击剪毛者报复。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME needs to be regularly sheared in order to function and be comfortable, but it is very finicky about the process. One incorrect move and POKENAME will zap the shearer in retaliation.

entry: 古代沙漠遗迹里发现过POKENAME雕刻，年代仍不确定，尚在研究。如今，偶尔能见它在沙漠深处，从一片绿洲飞向另一片。
author: sneakywalrus0
source: Carvings of POKENAME have been found in ancient desert ruins, though their age remains uncertain and is still being researched. In modern times, POKENAME can occasionally be found deep within deserts, flying from oasis to oasis.

entry: POKENAME羊毛柔软珍贵，因此总获悉心照料，保持最佳毛况。不过它很顽皮，连照顾、喂养自己的人也喜欢电。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its wool is incredibly soft and valuable, so POKENAME is always treated with the utmost care to keep its coat in the best possible condition. It is a mischievous Pokémon that enjoys shocking even the humans who care for and feed it.

entry: POKENAME爱模仿训练家，假装拥有自己的精灵球和宝可梦，对战开始还会摆姿势。模仿获夸奖，它就开心呼噜，享受这份关注。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME enjoy mimicking their trainers, pretending that they have their own Poké Balls and Pokémon to battle with, striking poses as a battle starts. They make a happy purring noise when praised for their mimicry, enjoying the positive attention.

entry: 宝石的光会跟随附近观众的目光。近来的盗猎问题，让它们的野生数量逐渐减少。
author: camtft
source: The glow of the gem follows the eyes of nearby onlookers. Due to recent poaching concerns, their numbers in the wild have dwindled.

entry: POKENAME用锡箔、汽水拉环等亮垃圾装饰巢穴。在亮物旁睡觉，令它格外安心。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME decorates its den with shiny refuse like tin foil and soda tabs. Sleeping near the shiny objects gives it great comfort.

entry: POKENAME的球体美丽，收藏家视为珍宝。不过只要靠近，它就会攻击。
author: firstromaniandiscoerd
source: POKENAME's orbs are very valuable among collectors because of their prettiness. However, a POKENAME will attack you if you even get near its orbs.

entry: POKENAME很受孩子欢迎，喜欢被关注，即使玩得稍粗鲁也不介意。它尤其爱让人摸脸上突出的簇毛，满足地呼噜。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME is very popular among children. It loves the attention, even if there is a little roughhousing. It especially loves being stroked on the tufts of fur protruding from its face and purrs contentedly.

entry: POKENAME很受孩子欢迎，喜欢被关注，即使玩得稍粗鲁也不介意。它尤其爱让人摸脸上突出的鳃，满足地呼噜。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME is very popular among children. It loves the attention, even if there is a little roughhousing. It especially loves being stroked on the gills protruding from its face and purrs contentedly.

entry: 人们认为养它很幸运，因为信息素会在周围散出幸运薰香。这些信息素只对人有效，让输掉战斗的人更宽宏。
author: quackquackattack
source: They are considered a lucky Pokémon to raise, as their pheromones release Luck Incense into an area. These pheromones only work on people and help promote a magnanimous feeling after losing a battle.

entry: POKENAME以背叛、操纵别人闻名。它装友好取得信任，等对方松懈就攻击、夺走财物。通常只有养大它的人，才真正使唤得动。
author: bobosmith01
source: Well known for its traitorous and manipulative nature, POKENAME puts on a friendly mask to build trust with others, only to then attack them when their guard is down to rob them of valuables. It typically only truly listens to the one who raised it.

entry: POKENAME看似讨厌小拉达，其实在保护。它假装追逐，让捕食者以为猎物已有主，不值得再追。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME may seem to despise Rattata, but it actually protects them. By pretending to chase Rattata, it tricks predators into believing the prey is already claimed and not worth pursuing.

entry: POKENAME喜欢亲昵地蹭人。幸好花粉和粉尘掉得很少，对易过敏的人是好事。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are sensual creatures that enjoy rubbing against people. Fortunately for those with allergies, they shed very little pollen and dust.

entry: POKENAME捡食时，一发现亮垃圾，就会立刻丢下食物。宝物总要带回巢里。
author: .izik
source: While scavenging, POKENAME will abandon food the moment it finds shiny trash. It always carries treasures back to its den.

entry: POKENAME偶尔在丛林古遗迹漫游，对训练家格外友善，被视为探险者的好运征兆。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME can rarely be found wandering around old jungle ruins and are exceptionally friendly toward Trainers. They are considered to be a sign of good luck for explorers.

entry: POKENAME喜欢被宠爱、崇拜，尾巴似乎享受得最多。若觉得头受到更多关注，尾巴就会攻击头。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME adore being pampered and worshipped, but the tail seems to savour it the most. The tail attacks the head if it believes the head is getting more attention.

entry: POKENAME用有力尾巴挂在粗树枝上，胡须感知周围动静。一察觉猎物，它便落下，合起坚硬的珠宝壳，夹住目标。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME hangs from strong tree branches using its strong tail while using its whiskers to sense disturbances in its environment. When it senses prey, it drops and snaps its tough jeweled shell around the target.

entry: POKENAME发挥猫般魅力，向训练家讨食。多数人最终屈服，因此把它宠得十分娇纵。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME harness their feline charm to beg their Trainers for food. Most Trainers capitulate to their demands, causing them to become quite spoiled.

entry: POKENAME头上宝石按规律闪烁，向群体传信。它们一起攻击踏入地盘的敌对鸟宝可梦。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's head gem blinks in patterns to signal its flock. Together, they attack rival bird Pokémon that enter their turf.

entry: POKENAME宝石一察觉空气流动就会发光，让它迅速反应，以闪避打法躲过攻击。战斗时，它拖着红色光迹，挥金属爪迅捷突刺。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME gems light up when they sense air movement, reacting quickly to incoming attacks with an evasive fighting style. They leave trails of red light behind them as they fight, lunging in with their metal claws for rapid strikes.

entry: POKENAME是邪恶组织尽职的爪牙，毫不顾虑道德。它很实际，只要最终能多吃几口，就会毫不犹豫抛弃训练家。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are dutiful minions of villainous organizations that have no qualms about ethics. They are pragmatic creatures that would abandon their Trainer at the drop of a hat if it meant more food at the end of the day.

entry: POKENAME狡猾残忍，跟踪野生熊宝宝到蜂巢。等熊宝宝采到蜂蜜，它就凭更强力量抢走，让受害者只能无助地看着。
author: bluenido.
source: Cunning and cruel, POKENAME stalks wild Teddiursa to beehives. Once the Teddiursa gathers honey, POKENAME uses its superior strength to attack and steal the treat, leaving its victim to watch helplessly.

entry: POKENAME虽然慢，却几乎无声，潜行本领高超。银行劫匪常用它悄悄偷走整库宝可元。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME, despite being slow, are nearly silent and excellent at sneaking. They're commonly used by bank robbers to steal entire vaults full of Pokédollars without notice.

entry: POKENAME是凶猛猎手，也极其挑嘴。它猎食阿柏怪、拉达等目标时，只吃某些部位，剩下留给食腐者。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a fierce hunter, but also a highly finicky eater. It hunts and eats only certain parts of prey such as Arbok and Raticate, then leaves the rest for scavengers to pick at.

entry: POKENAME先用毒液麻痹人类，再拖走贵重物品。睡觉时，便盘在成堆赃币上。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME paralyzes humans with venom before dragging away their valuables. It sleeps coiled atop piles of stolen coins.

entry: POKENAME受惊，会从额上宝石释放精神波。大多数威胁不等第二波，就已逃走。
author: .izik
source: If startled, POKENAME unleashes psychic waves from its forehead gem. Most threats flee before a second blast is needed.

entry: POKENAME身体柔韧灵活，轻易钻进同体形宝可梦进不去的地方。加上速度快、大蛇瞪眼能定住目睹者，野生个体极难捕捉。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's limber and flexible body allows it to easily fit into places other Pokémon its size could not. With its speed and the ability to freeze those who gaze upon it with a sharp Glare, wild POKENAME prove very elusive to catch.

entry: POKENAME无忧无虑到极点，很难破坏好心情。不过它没幸福蛋那般尽心，在野外不觉得有必要替别人疗伤。若开口请求，再送闪亮饰品，它也许会愿意。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is carefree to the extreme; it is difficult to ruin its good mood. However, it lacks the same devotion as Blissey, and does not feel the need to heal others in the wild. It may do so if asked if given glittery and shining trinkets.

entry: POKENAME很少肯交出手中宝石，礼物再丰厚也一样。若有人想偷，它就会凶猛抓挠攻击者，吓退对方。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME rarely parts with the gem it holds, even when munificent gifts are offered. If anyone tries to steal the gem, it ferociously claws the assailant to scare them away.

entry: POKENAME双牙利如剑，会以惊人速度冲向猎物，咬中一击，再带着猎物飞快离开。耗能极大，因此每餐常吃得很撑。
author: thesilverowls
source: With twin fangs sharp as swords, POKENAME use their blinding speed to maneuver to prey and land one strike with their fangs before darting away with their prey. Because of how much energy is used up, they tend to gorge themselves on each meal.

entry: POKENAME啄击路人，同群伙伴趁机翻口袋偷贵重物。受害者察觉之前，它们就已消失。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME pecks at passersby while its flock rummages through pockets to steal valuables. They vanish before the victim notices.

entry: POKENAME狡猾，喜欢捉弄同伴，常让其他宝可梦惹麻烦，好衬得自己更好。缺点虽多，剃刀般的爪和毅力仍让它战斗占优。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are devious creatures that enjoy pulling pranks on their peers. They often get other Pokémon in trouble so that they look better by comparison. Despite their faults, their razor-sharp claws and perseverance give them an edge in battle.

entry: POKENAME毛线般的藤蔓像灵巧手指，熟练得能不被发现地扒训练家口袋。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's yarn-like vines move like nimble fingers. It's so dexterous it can pickpocket Trainers without being seen.

entry: 某些古代文明，会让POKENAME守护重要地点。想进入的人，得通过它主持的智力考验。
author: sk372
source: In some ancient civilizations, POKENAME was tasked to guard over precious locations. Those who wished to enter would have to pass tests of intellect that POKENAME judged over.

entry: POKENAME在领地各处浅洞埋硬币。记忆精准，一个地点也不会忘。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME buries coins in shallow holes throughout its territory. Its memory is so precise, it never forgets a single spot.

entry: POKENAME住进无人照看的电脑，反复播放可爱猫视频，似乎看得十分开心。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME will inhabit computers that are left unattended. They will repeatedly play cute cat videos, appearing to be greatly amused by them.

entry: POKENAME从树梢向路人吐种子，再俯冲偷饰品，轻易消失在树冠里。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spits seeds at passersby from treetops, then swoops down to steal trinkets. It vanishes into the canopy with ease.

entry: POKENAME的毛发不易沾水，能让它迅速游动。加上大耳朵带来的灵敏听觉，寻找和追赶猎物都很轻松。
author: carameldog
source: POKENAME's fur repels water, allowing it to swim swiftly. Combined with the hearing ability of its large ears, it can find and pursue prey with ease.

entry: POKENAME的毛发不易沾水，能让它迅速游动。加上大耳朵带来的灵敏听觉，寻找和追赶猎物都很轻松。
author: carameldog
source: POKENAME's fur repels water, allowing it to swim swiftly. Combined with the hearing ability of its large ears, it can find and pursue prey with ease.

entry: POKENAME喜欢成群在台上转圈起舞，为观众表演。胡须对其他成员的动作敏感，不必隔着舞台互看，也能保持同步。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME enjoy putting on performances for onlookers, twirling and dancing on stage in groups. Their whiskers are sensitive to the movements of others, enabling them to keep in time without needing to look at one another across the stage.

entry: POKENAME飘在离地不远处，行动完全无声。胡须对别人的情绪敏感，会引它靠近陷入自我怀疑的生物。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME drift along just above the ground, allowing them to move completely silently. Their whiskers are sensitive to the emotions of others, drawing them to those struggling with self-doubt.

entry: POKENAME跟踪富有训练家，趁没看着时，慢慢偷走贵重物。等财富全没了，它最后还会取走灵魂。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME will stalk Trainers with large amounts of wealth and slowly steal away their valuables when they're not looking. Once all their wealth is gone, it will finally take their soul.

entry: POKENAME极度挑食，找不到想要的树果就不吃。它讨厌被摸，训练家想抚摸，就会被毒刺扎。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is an incredibly picky eater, refusing food until it finds the berries it wants. It hates being touched and will jab its Trainer with poisonous barbs if they try to pet it.

entry: POKENAME住在富宅的阁楼或地下室，察觉附近有人就会呼噜。忠诚的它曾阻止许多盗窃，会附身盗贼，逼其像猫老大一样行动，直到警方到场。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can be found in attics or basements of affluent homes, where it releases a purr whenever it senses people nearby. Many robberies have been foiled by a loyal POKENAME, who possesses robbers into acting like Persian until police arrive.

entry: POKENAME把胡须上的毒液涂在巢中硬币上，气味能赶走对手和小偷。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME smears toxic liquid from its whiskers onto the coins in its den. The scent keeps rivals and thieves away.

entry: 据说POKENAME从面前经过，会带来坏运气。它虽然友善，却因此名声不好。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: It is said that if you see a POKENAME crossing your path, you will have bad luck. This has given POKENAME a poor reputation despite its friendly nature.

entry: POKENAME用刁钻谜语守护大宝藏。据说答不出来的人会变成宝可梦，直到学会正确答案。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME protect their grand treasures with tricky riddles. If a person fails to answer their riddles, it is said that they are transformed into a Pokémon until they learn the correct answer.

entry: POKENAME从胡须分泌麻痹毒液，定住目标，再迅速抢走珠宝。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME secretes paralyzing venom from its whiskers to immobilize targets. It strikes quickly to steal jewelry.

entry: POKENAME行动如猫般优雅，用无可匹敌的武术，以劈斩削弱对手。对手越弱，它打得越疯狂，仿佛享受优势不断扩大。
author: ocxin
source: Moving with feline grace, POKENAME fights using a peerless martial style that uses slicing maneuvers to weaken its opponent. The more it weakens an opponent, the more wildly it fights, as if delighting in its increasing advantage.

entry: POKENAME独立又自命高贵，几乎从不允许任何东西碰自己。未经允许靠太近，就会招来连番巴掌和抓挠。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has an independent streak and a sense of superiority to the point that it rarely, if ever, allows anything to touch it. Getting too close without its permission results in a flurry of slaps and scratches.

entry: POKENAME以王者般美貌为荣，要求财富珠宝进贡，增添华贵。地位若遭质疑，它便挥下一片晶体鳍，拍打冒犯者。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME pride themselves on their regal beauty, demanding tributes of riches and jewels to further enhance their grandeur. If a POKENAME's status is questioned, it will bring one of its crystalline flippers down to smack the offender.

entry: POKENAME的鼻子总朝向附近黄金。勘矿者跟着它穿过洞窟，寻找地下矿脉。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's nose always turns toward nearby gold. Prospectors follow it through caves to find ore veins hidden underground.

entry: POKENAME既能充当精心锻造的宝剑，也能充当寻宝探测器，具体取决于剑柄上猫老大头部的心情。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME functions as a finely forged sword as well as treasure detector, determined by the mood of the Persian head pommel.

entry: 这只POKENAME曾由一位传奇寻宝者持用。据说那位探险家能够听懂它的话，与它交谈。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: This POKENAME was once wielded by a legendary treasure hunter. The explorer was said to have been able to verbally communicate and understand it.

entry: POKENAME偷同类的亮物，展示支配地位。积藏最多的，地位也最高。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME steals shiny objects from its own kind to assert dominance. The largest hoard earns the highest status.

entry: POKENAME有许多仰慕者。不过，想收服它的训练家要注意，它对谁亲近可是说变就变。
author: melodydelune
source: POKENAME has many admirers, though prospective Trainers should be warned it is fickle about who it shows it's affection to.

entry: POKENAME真把自己当成了国王，会试图统治同一区域内的其他宝可梦。
author: snugglessam
source: POKENAME thinks of itself as king in a literal sense and will attempt to rule over other Pokémon living in the same area.

entry: POKENAME把不喜欢的食物装进头上投石器，射向敌人。它常指挥附近喵喵一同战斗，大幅提高投石器的准头。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME loads food it dislikes into the catapult on its head to fire at foes. It frequently commands nearby Meowth to team up with it in battle, greatly increasing the catapult's accuracy.

entry: POKENAME喜欢载人飞行，以敏感胡须察觉气流，随意漂游。不过最好结伴搭乘，因为它有时飞到一半饿了，会想吃掉落单乘客。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME enjoy taking people on journeys across the sky, using their sensitive whiskers to sense air currents and drift as it chooses. It's advised to travel in pairs as they sometimes grow hungry during a flight and try to feed on lone occupants.

entry: 菌盖上的毛对最轻微的气流也敏感。它喜欢别人欣赏光亮金毛，但谁不够尊重，就会遭到利爪攻击。
author: .jerden
source: Hairs on its cap are sensitive to the slightest air movement. Although it appreciates being admired for its glossy golden fur, it will lash out with sharp claws at anyone that doesn't show it sufficient respect.

entry: POKENAME凭飞行速度和出爪之快，想要什么就能拿走。它大多住在城市，猎物和人类饭食一样抢。
author: sk372
source: With its aerial speed and quickness of claw, POKENAME is adept at taking anything it wants. Most often found in urban areas, it will snatch up prey and human meals in equal measure.

entry: POKENAME从废料场偷亮物，谁阻止就会被劈砍。爪子留下的奇异伤口，会在月下闪烁。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME steals shiny objects from junkyards and slashes at anyone who tries to stop it. Its claws leave strange cuts that shimmer under moonlight.

entry: POKENAME天性高傲，很少让人看见，只在深夜现身。满月时会友善一点，但也只有一点，隔夜就又冷漠疏远。
author: sk372
source: Haughty by nature, POKENAME rarely lets itself be seen by humans and only comes out during the dark of night. It is more amiable during the full moon, but only slightly; it quickly becomes standoffish again the very next night.

entry: POKENAME的毛被认为是宝可梦中最柔软、最丝滑、最想让人摸的。不过它高傲聪明又顽皮，常不喜欢被摸，靠近得小心。
author: t3isukone
source: The fur of a POKENAME is thought to be some of the softest, silkiest, and most pettable among all Pokémon. These prideful, intelligent, and mischievous Pokémon often dislike being pet, so caution is advised.

entry: POKENAME极在意外貌，大部分时间都在梳理。什么敢愚蠢地挑战耐心，都会遭它狂怒攻击。
author: mepp.
source: As POKENAME is extremely obsessed with its appearance, it spends most of its time grooming itself. It unleashes a furious assault towards anything foolish enough to test its patience.

entry: POKENAME看见硬币，薄毛就会热到危险。科学家百思不解，收藏家却拿它当硬币探测器。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's thin fur grows dangerously hot when it sees coins. Scientists are baffled, but collectors use it as a coin detector.

entry: POKENAME原本的甲片被厚实粗硬的毛发取代。不过，斧状獠牙经常妨碍它梳理毛发。
author: carameldog
source: POKENAME sports thick, coarse fur in place of armored plates. However, its ability to groom its coat is often impeded by its axe-like tusks.

entry: POKENAME原本的甲片被厚实粗硬的毛发取代。不过，斧状獠牙经常妨碍它梳理毛发。
author: carameldog
source: POKENAME sports thick, coarse fur in place of armored plates. However, its ability to groom its coat is often impeded by its axe-like tusks.

entry: POKENAME的毛不易致敏，很受过敏训练家欢迎。人气高涨，培育者因此能在拍卖中卖出大价钱。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are a popular choice among Trainers with allergies because of their hypoallergenic fur. Breeders sell them for large sums of money at auction because of how popular they have become.

entry: POKENAME温顺、食量小，是热门宠物。不过栖地太脏，背上宝石就会暗淡易碎。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are very popular pets as they are both docile and do not require much food. However, if its habitat gets too dirty, the gems on its back will become dull and brittle.

entry: POKENAME虚荣又重领地，觉得任何东西靠近都有损尊严。它会轻蔑地反甩单翼，把火星撒满胆敢侵入自己空间的生物。
author: sk372
source: Vain and territorial, POKENAME will not suffer the indignity of anything being in close proximity to it. With a disdainful backhanded flap of one wing, it spreads embers all over any who would dare invade its space.

entry: POKENAME飞行时，会俯冲追逐被沙漠酷热折磨的猎物。火沿羽面流动，如缎带缠绕，飞到哪里都伴着猛烈热浪。
author: tamszen.ore
source: POKENAME flies around, swooping down to pursue prey suffering from the heat of the desert. Flames slip across the surface of its feathers, surrounding like ribbons. Everywhere it flies, an intense heatwave follows.

entry: POKENAME保持伪装洁净，讨训练家欢心。每次吃饭，它都会留下一块献上，表示顺服。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME keep their disguises clean to appeal to their Trainer. Whenever they eat, they reserve a piece to give as an act of submissiveness.

entry: POKENAME两个头都很讲究外貌。意见不合就会互咬，因此常靠训练家的偏好来平息争执。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have two heads that are particular about their appearance. They often rely on the preferences of their Trainer to break up arguments, as the two heads will bite each other if they cannot come to an agreement.

entry: POKENAME凭敏感胡须和近乎无声的翅膀，隐蔽跟踪猎物。时机一到，它就扑上去，用三张嘴夹住目标肢端，限制行动。
author: chibitales
source: Using their sensitive whiskers and near-silent wings, POKENAME are able to stalk prey while remaining out of sight. When the moment is right, they pounce and restrain the target by clamping their three mouths onto the target's extremities.

entry: POKENAME舌上有特殊倒刺，帮助清洁毛发。毛很容易打结，尤其尾巴，因此它得花大量时间梳理。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have tongues with special backward-facing barbs that help them clean their fur. They spend a significant amount of time cleaning their body because their fur can easily get matted, especially their tails.

entry: POKENAME挑剔又讲究，很难训练照顾。历史记载称，它曾被视为王者灵魂的容器，每条尾巴各藏着一位古代君主。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are fussy and very particular Pokémon, making them a challenge to train and care for. Historical records suggest that POKENAME were once considered to be vessels for regal spirits, each of their tails holding a different ancient monarch.

entry: POKENAME察觉顽皮的波导，身上宝石便会泛粉光。训练家说，它在赌场附近最亮。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME senses a mischievous aura, the gems on its body pulse pink. Trainers say it glows brightest near casinos.

entry: POKENAME看见亮物便兴奋，想也不想就拿走。有时连自己的金爪，也会看得入迷。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME gets extremely excited over shiny objects and will take anything shiny without a second thought. It will sometimes even get mesmerized by its own golden claws.

entry: POKENAME独立，讨厌被摸。若未经信任与允许就伸手，它会嘶叫，毛上迸出火花；这是动用全部利爪和电力前唯一的警告。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is highly independent and hates being touched. Those that try to pet it without its trust and approval will see it hiss and shed sparks from its fur, the only warning they get before it uses its claws and electricity in full.

entry: POKENAME挑剔又讲究，很难训练照顾。历史记载称，它曾被视为王者灵魂的容器，每条尾巴各藏着一位古代君主。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are fussy and very particular Pokémon, making them a challenge to train and care for. Historical records suggest that POKENAME were once considered to be vessels for regal spirits, each of their tails holding a different ancient monarch.

entry: POKENAME毛发丝滑华美，在选美赛中格外出众。它用火焰技法和纯粹美貌，让观众惊叹。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a silky and glamorous fur that makes them stand out in beauty contests. They amaze audiences with their fiery techniques and sheer beauty.

entry: POKENAME额上宝石随歌声泛红，逐拍配合旋律。听者很快入睡，它便蜷在对方身上，一起睡。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The gem on POKENAME's forehead pulses red in time with their song, matching their melody beat for beat. Those who hear their song quickly fall asleep, POKENAME then curl up atop them and sleep alongside them.

entry: POKENAME爱在沙坑玩，挖个凹处，转几圈再坐进去。谁侵入私人空间，它就扑上前，用强大下颚咬。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME enjoys playing in sand pits, digging out hollows before circling around and sitting within them. It lunges at anyone who intrudes on its personal space, snapping at them with its powerful jaws.

entry: 别看POKENAME体形如此，坐着也能向任何方向跃出最远20英尺。胡须能感应贵金属，帮它找到硬币，囤进背上植物。
author: npshi
source: Despite their size, POKENAME can jump up to 20ft in any direction from a sitting position. The whiskers of POKENAME are capable of sensing precious metals, which they use to find and hoard coins in the plant on their back.

entry: POKENAME自满又自大，极以尾焰为荣，常向别人炫耀。若火焰美貌没获足够关注，它就小心眼地放火报复。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is smug and egotistical, intensely proud of the flame on its tail and regularly flaunting it towards others. If enough attention isn't paid to the beauty of its flame, it uses it to set things on fire as petty vengeance.

entry: POKENAME在营地唱轻柔摇篮曲，让旅人困倦，再带着偷来的贵重物飘走。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME sings soft lullabies in campsites to make travelers drowsy. It then floats off with stolen valuables.

entry: POKENAME用敏感胡须察觉气流变化，调整浮力乘风。风暴来时，它会故意把脚缠在树枝上，留在那里直到风暴过去。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME sense changing air currents with their sensitive whiskers, adjusting their buoyancy to catch the breeze. During storms, they deliberately tangle their feet in tree branches, remaining stuck there until the storm passes.

entry: POKENAME用敏感胡须察觉气流变化，调整浮力乘风。它能借风在热带岛屿间漂游，数十英里都不落地。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME sense changing air currents with their sensitive whiskers, adjusting their buoyancy to catch the breeze. They use the breeze to drift between tropical islands, able to travel tens of miles without touching the ground.

entry: POKENAME用精神力，把看见的每枚硬币和珠宝囤进特殊液体。偶尔会把胡须伸出液面，感知附近是否潜着小偷。
author: fiordaliso
source: Using its psychic powers, POKENAME hoards every coin and jewel it spots inside its special liquid. It occasionally extends its whiskers out of the liquid to sense whether any thieves may be lurking nearby.

entry: POKENAME读心找到贵重物，趁受害者睡觉，让物件悬浮偷走。巢中总井然有序，不同颜色各自成堆。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME reads minds to locate valuables, then levitates them away while victims sleep. Its lair is always perfectly organized, placing differently colored objects in their own pile.

entry: POKENAME擅长潜行，常伏击小型猎物或偷取食物。柔软的脚掌让它跑动时悄无声息。
author: carameldog
source: POKENAME are known for stealth, often seen ambushing small prey or stealing food. Their soft paws let them scamper about silently.

entry: POKENAME的呼噜声有催眠效果，能轻轻哄听者入睡。它是优秀的疗愈宝可梦，帮助失眠者睡个安稳觉。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME purrs have a soporific effect, lulling those who hear them gently to sleep. They make excellent therapy Pokémon, helping insomniacs achieve a solid night's sleep.

entry: POKENAME高声尖叫，扰乱洞穴探险者。趁对方捂耳，它就抢走戒指和耳环。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME screeches at a high pitch to confuse cave explorers. While they cover their ears, it snatches rings and earrings.

entry: POKENAME被大量金钱吸引，在街角埋伏，抢过路人的钱。它把赃款交给训练家，因此很受有组织犯罪团伙欢迎。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are drawn to large quantities of money, hanging around street corners and ambushing people to steal their money. This habit makes them popular Pokémon with organised criminals, handing the stolen money to their Trainer.

entry: POKENAME被大量金钱吸引，在街角埋伏，抢过路人的钱。它不懂每张钞票值多少，似乎只是喜欢翻动大叠现金。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are drawn to large quantities of money, hanging around street corners and ambushing people to steal their money. They have no concept of how much an individual note is worth and seem to simply enjoy rifling through wads of cash.

entry: POKENAME先跟踪微小猎物，再猛扑。激光笔的光点，也同样能让它追个不停。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME stalk their minuscule prey before pouncing. They're equally apt to chase the light from a laser pointer.

entry: POKENAME背上长出尖锐红宝石，能像飞镖射向入侵者，事后再捡回最闪亮的。
author: .izik
source: Sharp red gems grow from POKENAME's back. It fires them like darts at intruders, later retrieving the ones that glitter most.

entry: POKENAME柔如天鹅绒的毛与羽，让富人争相追捧。不开心时，它会猛烈拍翼，恼火地释放闪亮火星。
author: chibitales
source: The velvety soft fur and feathers of POKENAME make it highly sought after by the wealthy. If unhappy, it will violently flap its wings, releasing shining embers in frustration.

entry: POKENAME潜行城市屋顶，俯冲撞路人，偷走掉下的东西。出击前，眼中会闪出淘气的光。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME stalks city rooftops, diving to bump into pedestrians and steal whatever they drop. Its eyes glint with mischief shortly before a strike.

entry: 晴天里，POKENAME趴在暖石上吸热。毛发竖起，伴着微弱静电噼啪作响。
author: .izik
source: On sunny days, POKENAME lies flat on warm rocks, soaking up heat. Its fur stands on end, crackling with slight amounts of static.

entry: POKENAME觊觎看见的每件亮珠宝。它等目标分心，再偷走首饰，收入珍藏。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME covets any shiny jewel it sees. It waits for its target to be distracted, then swipes their jewelry for its hoard.

entry: POKENAME的毒性达到顶峰，两侧红宝石就会泛深红光。这常是即将出击的信号。
author: .izik
source: The rubies on POKENAME's sides glow deep red when its venom reaches peak potency. This glow often signals it's about to strike.

entry: POKENAME猛撞旅人，让物品散落，再带着闪亮东西飞快逃走。滚动速度能超过每小时70英里。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME barrels into travelers to scatter their belongings, then zips away with anything that sparkles. It can roll faster than 70 mph.

entry: 别看POKENAME个头如此，却喜欢蜷在训练家腿上，滚成球，大声呼噜，把人压得动不了。它能一待几个小时，关注不够就不肯走。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Despite their size, POKENAME love to curl up in the laps of their trainer. They roll into a ball, purring loudly as they pin their trainer in place. They can spend hours in one place, refusing to move until they've received enough attention.

entry: POKENAME群踏过大地，靠彼此头中石榴石的反光确认同伴位置。追到猎物后，会使出强力咬住，连钢铁也能咬穿。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Packs of POKENAME stomp across the landscape, watching for the glint of the garnets in each other's heads as a means to keep track of others in their pack. When they track down prey, they deliver a powerful Bite that is able to puncture steel.

entry: POKENAME以小群踏过开阔平原，吼叫交流。它们合作把猎物赶向其余成员守候的埋伏圈。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME stomp across open plains in small prides, roaring to one another to communicate. They work together to drive prey into an ambush, where the rest of the pride lies in wait.

entry: POKENAME的叶片可作安抚喵喵、猫老大等宝可梦的药材，它们格外喜欢叶片香气。它虽天性平和，受打扰也会毫不犹豫地以凶猛头锤反击。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its leaves are used as a calming remedy for Pokémon like Meowth and Persian, who are particularly drawn to their fragrant aroma. Though POKENAME is naturally peaceful, it doesn't hesitate to fight back with fierce headbutts if disturbed.

entry: 野生POKENAME吃下大量金属后会产硬币，圈养时却未发现这行为。急需钱的人会尾随野生个体，拿走硬币。
author: quackquackattack
source: Wild POKENAME produce coins after eating lots of metal, but this behavior has not been found while in captivity. People who are desperate for coins follow wild POKENAME to take their coins.

entry: POKENAME唯一比摔角更爱的，就是钱。一点少得可笑的贿赂，就能让它在比赛中故意输掉。
author: kiwiarms
source: The only thing it loves more than wrestling is money. POKENAME are known to take dives in matches for comically small bribes.

entry: POKENAME平时喜欢被摸，但碰到蘑菇就会疯狂抓挠。额头和手臂上的宝石，与孢子材质相同，一碰便使人发痒。
author: soup1900
source: While POKENAME generally likes to be petted, it starts violently scratching if its mushrooms are touched. The gems on its forehead and arms cause itchiness when touched since they are made of the same material as its spores.

entry: POKENAME叛逆又居高临下，很难训练。它只听自信训练家的话，对显出紧张、犹疑的人，命令一概不从。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a rebellious and condescending attitude that makes them difficult to train. They only listen to confident Trainers and refuse to obey commands from those who show nervousness or doubt.

entry: POKENAME会在认定的领地撒孢子。孢子无害，却会刺激除它自己之外所有生物的眼鼻。训练家发现，朝它喷水能减少这种行为。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME will spread spores on spots it claims as its territory. The spores are harmless but irritating to the eyes and nose of anything but itself. Trainers have found that spraying POKENAME with water helps discourage this behavior.

entry: POKENAME住在河底池底，吃远比自己小的宝可梦。敏感胡须连轻微水流也能察觉，一觉得有更大的生物追来，就会迅速躲向安全处。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME live at the bottom of rivers and ponds, feeding on much smaller Pokémon. They can sense even faint water movements with their sensitive whiskers, scurrying to safety the moment they think something larger than them is chasing them.

entry: POKENAME极其虚荣，花很多时间折腾仪容。许多人觉得难伺候，不过它除害的本领确实好。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME is incredibly vain and spends a lot of time fussing over its appearance. A lot of people find them hard to deal with, but they do make great pest control.

entry: POKENAME非常贪玩，什么杂物都能拿来玩。想养它，最好尽可能准备多些玩具。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are very playful and love to play with all types of random objects. If you plan on owning a POKENAME, it best to get them as many toys as possible.

entry: 邪恶组织常用POKENAME，以玩具分散敌方宝可梦的注意。不过它自己也常被玩具吸引，最后只顾绕圈飞。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is often used by evil teams, using its toys to distract enemy Pokémon. However, it frequently gets distracted by its own toys and ends up flying in circles instead.

entry: POKENAME即将喷火时，额上珍贵宝石会先明亮发光。它娇惯得很，拿来不喜欢的食物，甚至可能抓训练家。
author: fiordaliso
source: Just before it breathes fire from its mouth, the precious gem on its forehead shines brightly. POKENAME is an extremely spoiled creature; it might even scratch its Trainer if offered food it doesn't like.

entry: POKENAME从洞里使聚宝功发射硬币。入侵者越靠近家，硬币就射得越快、越猛。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME launches coins from its burrows using Pay Day. The closer intruders get to its home, the faster and harder the coins are fired.

entry: POKENAME挤在洞壁里睡觉，深沉隆隆的呼噜声响亮回荡，隔着实心岩石也能听见。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME sleeps clustered inside cavern walls. Its deep, rumbling purr echoes loudly and can be heard from the opposite side of solid rock.

entry: POKENAME很容易被亮物分心。只需远远扔一枚硬币，就能让它忙上几个小时。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME is easily distracted by shiny objects. A single coin tossed away can keep it busy for hours.

entry: 猫老大的自融合体全身覆着格外长而软的毛。它虽仔细自理，仍常要求主人定期梳毛，清除积起的浮毛。
author: infranscia
source: This self fusion of Persian is covered in extra-long, soft fur.  Though it will meticulously groom itself, it's often demands that its owner brush it regularly to help get rid of built-up, loose fur.

entry: POKENAME平时非常敏捷。但剧烈头痛一来，优雅便荡然无存，变得笨拙，常被自己的脚绊倒。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME are highly agile under normal circumstances. However, when plagued by severe headaches, they completely lose their grace, becoming clumsy and frequently stumbling over their own feet.

entry: 谁靠近硬币藏堆，POKENAME就会暴怒。甚至只是对视，也能引爆脾气。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME becomes violently enraged if anyone approaches its coin hoard. Even eye contact can trigger an outburst.

entry: POKENAME娇惯又情绪多变，极难饲养。想要的东西若没立刻到手，就会挥拳抓挠，大发脾气。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a very difficult Pokémon to raise due to its behavior. Spoiled and moody, if it doesn't get what it wants, when it wants, it flies into a tantrum of swinging fists and slashing claws.

entry: POKENAME以小群体共同生活。胡须最华丽的一只就是首领，所有成员都毫无例外地认可它。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME live together in small packs. The one with the most magnificent beard is the leader, who is accepted by every pack member without exception.

entry: POKENAME极其骄傲，只听老练训练家的话。可一旦认可，也愿为对方冒生命危险。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME is an extremely proud Pokémon that only obeys experienced Trainers. However, it would even risk its life for one.
