entry: POKENAME的毛油亮光滑，让它能在水中轻松游泳。越成熟，毛越鲜艳顺滑，它绝不让别人随便摸。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's fur has a glossy and oily sheen that allows it to effortlessly swim through water. As it matures, its fur becomes even more vivid and sleek; POKENAME never allows anyone else to touch it carelessly.

entry: POKENAME以腹上红宝石为荣，常在河边清洗打磨。宝石独特的旋涡花纹，深受收藏家追捧。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME takes great pride in the ruby on its belly and can often be seen near rivers trying to clean and polish it. The unique spiral pattern on the jewel makes it highly sought after by collectors.

entry: POKENAME虽泳技出众，却想尽办法避免尾巴湿。它用长尾分散、扰乱敌人的注意。
author: empty_set
source: Despite being an outstanding swimmer, POKENAME will do anything to avoid getting its tail wet.  It uses its long tail to distract and confuse adversaries.

entry: POKENAME用精神波让毛线飘出商店窗户，再织成巢，里面铺满天鹅绒和硬币。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME floats yarn out of shop windows with psychic waves. It weaves the strands into nests lined with velvet and coins.

entry: 沐浴奇异薰香的气味时，它们会把渴望传进附近人和生物的脑海。通常，出现的是想喝奶或吃鱼的鲜明画面。
author: quackquackattack
source: When basking in the aroma of an Odd Incense, they transmit thoughts of their desires to creatures and people nearby. Typically, this results in vivid imagery of a desire for milk or fish.

entry: POKENAME被称为海上大征服者，挥爪入侵岛屿，企图控制整片群岛。它们视伤口为勇气象征，用眼罩或威风姿势炫耀。
author: spagalapof
source: POKENAME are known as great conquerors of the seas. With their claws, they invade islands and seek to control entire archipelagos. For them, wounds are synonymous with courage, and they show them off with eye patches or by striking a pose.

entry: POKENAME凶猛的打法被称为“兽王拳”。人气使它在热门电视系列中获得配角戏份，不过角色往往下场不幸。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's aggressive combat style has been dubbed the "Fist of the Beast King." It's popularity resulted in a supporting role in a popular television franchise, though its roles often suffer an unfortunate fate.

entry: POKENAME常被说成拥有伟大英雄事迹和高超剑术。传说真假尚不清楚，却激励着其他同类模仿。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME is often attributed to tales of great heroics and expert swordsmanship. Whether these tales are true has yet to be determined, but they inspire other POKENAME to emulate them.

entry: POKENAME一察觉危险可能损害美貌，就缩进壳里，保护珍贵的丝滑毛发。它虽不爱战斗，却会毫不犹豫地用小爪抓讨厌的生物。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME protects its precious silky fur by retreating into its shell whenever it senses danger that might threaten its beauty. Though it dislikes fighting, it won't hesitate to scratch anyone it dislikes with its small claws.

entry: POKENAME用尾巴挂在树枝上，胡须感知将至的雨。察觉快下雨，它们便互相不满地嚎叫，蜷紧身体，设法避雨。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME hang by their tails from tree branches, using their whiskers to sense incoming rain. When they sense impending rainfall, they yowl unhappily to one another, prompting them to curl up tight and try to shelter from the rain.

entry: POKENAME用尾巴挂在树枝上，胡须感知风变。察觉强风，它们便兴奋呼噜，享受被风吹动。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME hang by their tails from tree branches, using their whiskers to sense changes in the wind. When they sense a strong breeze, they give excited purrs, enjoying the feel of being buffeted by the wind.

entry: POKENAME用尾巴挂在树枝上，胡须感知路过的宝可梦。一觉得太近，就会嘶叫喷酸，想让对方退后。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME hang by their tails from tree branches, using their whiskers to sense passing Pokémon. When they sense a Pokémon getting too close to them, they hiss and spit out acid in an effort to get the other Pokémon to back off.

entry: POKENAME在丛林地面懒躺，大张着嘴。它能好几天不动，等小型宝可梦走进嘴里，再猛地合嘴捕住。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME laze around on the jungle floor with their mouth wide open. They can remain motionless for days, waiting for small Pokémon to wander into their mouth, snapping their mouth closed on their prey when it walks in.

entry: POKENAME潜伏海洋浅水附近，等待大批人群。贪婪驱使它现身，用众多触手尽可能偷走亮饰品，留给自己囤积。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME lurks near the shallow waters of oceans, waiting for large gatherings of people. Its greedy nature compels it to appear before these groups and use its many tentacles to steal as many shiny baubles as it can to hoard for itself.

entry: POKENAME被亮物一引，就会狂奔。训练家有时扔硬币，诱它与同类赛跑。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME will gallop wildly if lured with a shiny object. Trainers sometimes toss coins to coax it into races with others of its kind.

entry: POKENAME看见亮物，火焰便红蓝交闪，叠成近紫色光芒。有人相信，这种火色能让它跑得更快。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME sees something shiny, its flames flicker red and blue, forming a cumulative near-purple glow. Some believe these flame colorings make it run faster.

entry: POKENAME几个头上的宝石储能，给毛发充满静电。三个头协力猛扑，迅速制伏猎物，咬住后令其麻痹。
author: santon5512
source: The gems on POKENAME's heads store energy within them, charging their fur with static electricity. The three heads work in tandem to pounce on and swiftly take down their prey, paralyzing them in their jaws.

entry: POKENAME飞行寻找美丽花朵采摘，整个春天都用来做花束。初夏到来，它们便聚在一起，比谁的花束好。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME fly in search of beautiful flowers to harvest. They spend all spring creating a bouquet, then at the start of summer, POKENAME flock together and compare bouquets.

entry: 家养POKENAME常被形容为娇惯得厉害。三个头为食物、玩具和关爱，吵个不停。
author: sk372
source: Domestic POKENAME are often reported as showing highly spoiled behavior. The three heads constantly fight over food, toys and affection.

entry: 它柔软的毛，过去被冰寒地区的游牧民拿来抵御严寒。宝石角能释放强大的冰冻光束。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its soft fur was used in the past by nomads in frozen regions to protect themselves from harsh temperatures. Its gemstone horn can release powerful ice beams.

entry: 它柔软的毛，过去被冰寒地区的游牧民拿来抵御严寒。宝石角能释放强大的冰冻光束。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its soft fur was used in the past by nomads in frozen regions to protect themselves from harsh temperatures. Its gemstone horn can release powerful ice beams.

entry: POKENAME愤世嫉俗，与邪恶组织合作。它从背部喷射水柱，换取丰厚报酬，若不满意，就拒绝命令。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are cynical creatures that work with villainous organizations. They are well-compensated for the jets of water they fire from their backs and refuse orders if they are not happy.

entry: 能治好POKENAME头痛的，只有长在背上种子里的药草，可它自己偏偏够不到。因此，它常跟在训练家身后，盼着有人帮它缓解疼痛。
author: rakunk
source: The only cure for POKENAME's headaches is the herbs growing on its bulb, which it is unable to reach on its own. As a result, it often follows Trainers with the hope they will help ease its pain.

entry: POKENAME从压力中产生电。压力大到头痛，就会爆炸，释放所有积电。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME generate electricity from the stress they experience. When they are stressed enough to cause headaches, they explode and release all the electricity that has built up.

entry: 最好尽量离POKENAME远些。它容易剧烈头痛，偏头痛一发作，就会因疼痛炸出精神与电能。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME should be given a wide berth where possible. It is prone to painful headaches, and when the migraines begin, the pain causes it to explode in a mix of psychic and electric energy.

entry: POKENAME情绪多变，心情起伏会产生电。压力大到头痛，它就爆炸泄愤。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are moody Pokémon that generate electricity from their various mood swings. When they are so stressed that they have a headache, they explode to vent that frustration.

entry: POKENAME常住进无人照看的篮子等容器，刚好装下各个个体。性子不安分，常会掉出来，摔出裂缝；裂缝越多，头痛越厉害。
author: actliux
source: POKENAME commonly inhabit unattended baskets and other such items capable of holding each individual POKENAME. Due to their unruliness, they often fall out of their home, creating cracks that cause headaches that intensify the more cracks one has.

entry: POKENAME戴着其他宝可梦的头骨，独自生活。它很少与别的宝可梦相处，因为刺激过多，会让常有的头痛加剧。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME wears the skulls of other Pokémon and lives in solitude. It does not spend much time with other Pokémon because its frequent headaches flare up when it is overstimulated.

entry: POKENAME喜欢独居，其他宝可梦太多就容易头痛。戴别的宝可梦头骨，既为保护，也能缓解孤独。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME prefers to live alone, as it easily develops headaches when overwhelmed by other Pokémon. It wears skulls of other Pokémon both for protection and to ease its loneliness.

entry: POKENAME用舌头清洁时一丝不苟，讨厌脏地方。若放在无法清扫、整理的房间，压力就会引起头痛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are fastidious at cleaning with their tongues and hate places that are dirty. If placed in a room where they cannot clean or organize, they develop headaches from the resulting stress.

entry: POKENAME体内臭气的压力会让它头痛。疼得太厉害，就一次放出大量腐臭烟雾，暂时缓解。
author: sk372
source: The pressure of the smelly gases within POKENAME's body causes it to suffer headaches. When the pain is too intense, it unleashes a huge amount of rancid-smelling smog at once to get temporary relief.

entry: POKENAME痒得太久就会头痛，却没有四肢能挠。它只能摇晃身体，盼别的宝可梦帮忙止痒。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME gets headaches whenever it is itchy for long enough, but it has no limbs to scratch that itch. It can only wobble hoping another Pokémon comes to help alleviate the itch.

entry: POKENAME产生的特殊气体，会让接触者严重偏头痛。不过它自己也因这气体，无时无刻不在受苦。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME produces a unique gas that causes severe migraines in anyone exposed to it. However, POKENAME is in constant pain because of its own gas.

entry: POKENAME容易激动焦虑，一旦狂暴，很难让亢奋状态停下。事后即使忘了部分经过，它仍常为破坏感到懊悔。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are easy to agitate into an anxious state. Once they start rampaging, it is difficult to stop their manic state. They often feel remorseful for the destruction they cause, even if they forget part of what happened.

entry: POKENAME先用后腿发力加速，再以尖喙冲撞敌人。力道够强，巨石也能撞穿，不过冲击也会让自己头痛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME rev up a charge with their hind legs before they run into foes with their sharp bill. They can punch through boulders with enough force, but the resulting impact also leaves them with a headache.

entry: POKENAME的藤蔓由橡胶般的聚合物构成，让它轻松浮水。藤蔓可以熔化，常用于制作橡胶玩具。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's vines are made out of a rubber-like polymer that helps it effortless float in water. The vines can be melted down and is commonly used in making rubber toys.

entry: POKENAME着迷于周围的珊瑚礁，常呆呆凝望，缓解持续的偏头痛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are enraptured by coral reefs that surround them. They often stare blankly at the coral reefs to ease their persistent migraines.

entry: 它蜕下的外层鳍和鳞，会被磨粉用于传统药物。鳍还会产出令人麻木的液体，当地人收集作麻醉剂。
author: quackquackattack
source: Whenever it sheds its outer layer of fins and scales, they are ground up for use in traditional medicine. It also produces a liquid from its fins that produces numbness, which locals tap into to use as an anesthetic.

entry: 它在野外的短期记忆只能维持12小时，因此很容易迷路。强化思维训练能延长记忆，不过也会引起头痛。
author: quackquackattack
source: It gets lost easily because of its short-term memory, which lasts for 12 hours in the wild. It can extend its memory span through intense mental training, which also causes it to develop headaches.

entry: POKENAME用角当简易不求人，互相抓痒。若痒处挠不到，就会在水里转圈，直到头痛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME help each other scratch itches by using their horn as a crude backscratcher. If an itch is unable to be scratched, they will swim in circles until they develop headaches.

entry: POKENAME把黏花粉涂在翅膀上，不肯让训练家清洗。因为花粉能让它平静，消除头痛带来的疼痛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME coats its wings with sticky pollen and refuses to let Trainers clean its wings. This is because the pollen helps it calm down and neutralizes the pain that comes from a headache.

entry: POKENAME讨厌被抱起，人或宝可梦想抱，它就会爬开。离开大海很快便会脱水、头痛，直到重新回水下。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME hate being picked up and will try to scuttle away when people or Pokémon try to do so to it. When they are taken out of the sea, they quickly become dehydrated and develop a headache until they are back underwater.

entry: POKENAME能做出盛大夸张的表演，却常忘了屏障放在哪里。最终撞上自己的精神屏障，就会因脑震荡而剧烈头痛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are capable of creating grand and over-the-top performances but are often forgetful of where they place barriers. When they eventually run into one of their psychic barriers, they develop a severe headache from the concussion.

entry: POKENAME手臂刀刃其实是软膜，像脚蹼，不擅切割。不过被它挥中，没多久就会遭受痛苦难忍的偏头痛。
author: sk372
source: The blades of POKENAME's arms are actually soft membranes akin to webbed feet. Though ineffective at cutting, those struck by its swings develop crushingly painful migraines shortly after.

entry: POKENAME在头顶两根突起间蓄电，再以重拳释放。若电能放不出去，就会一直头痛，直到释放为止。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME charge electricity between the two prongs on their head before releasing the electricity in a heavy punch. If they are unable to release this energy, they develop a painful headache until that energy is released.

entry: 它用过头骨上的钳子，就会头痛。越用力，头越疼；若太拼命想夹碎东西，甚至会偏头痛到昏倒。
author: sk372
source: Using the pincers on its skull gives it a headache afterward. The more force it exerts, the stronger the headache; trying too hard to crush something with its pincers may cause it to pass out from the migraine.

entry: POKENAME常见于公园池塘，接受游客喂食。若POKENAME等着吃，你却不喂，它的力量可能让你事后头痛欲裂。
author: staghorn
source: POKENAME are commonly found in parks and ponds, where they are fed by visitors. If you don't feed a POKENAME when it expects to be fed, you may develop a splitting headache afterward due to its abilities.

entry: POKENAME尾端有毒刺，防范潜在捕食者。但不停害怕被吃，压力大得总是头痛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are equipped with a stinger at their tail to deter would-be predators. Their constantly fear of being eaten causes so much stress that they get headaches.

entry: POKENAME从海里升空或从天回海时，若高度变化太快，会因气压骤变头痛。许多个体会慢慢飞升或下降，避免发作。
author: quackquackattack
source: If POKENAME rapidly change altitude when they move from sea to sky, or vice versa, they can develop a headache from the sudden pressure difference. Many slowly fly or fall to prevent these headaches from occurring.

entry: POKENAME愿意用背载客，可记性太差，得不停提醒航向。讨喜的外形，还启发了一系列受欢迎的幼儿洗澡玩具。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is willing to ferry others on its back, but must be reminded of its course constantly due to its poor memory. Its appealing design inspired a popular line of bath toys for young children.

entry: POKENAME出现在世界各地的度假村，帮年幼客人享受玩水。慈爱的性情，让它成为水上活动的可靠伙伴。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME is found at resorts around the world, where it helps younger patrons enjoy the water. Its doting nature makes it a responsible companion for water activities.

entry: 世界各地的海滩都有POKENAME，帮助救生员保护孩子。水里很容易抓住它，让溺水的孩子能借力抬起身体。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are found at beaches around the world where they help lifeguards keep kids safe. They are easy to grab onto while in the water, which helps kids lift themselves up when they are drowning.

entry: POKENAME的喙遇到进化石就会闪亮、产生反应。珠宝店有时用它评估石头纯度，反应越明显，品质就越好。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME beaks shimmer and react to the presence of Evolution stones. They are sometimes used by jewellery stores to assess the purity of the Evolution stones they sell, as a more pronounced reaction from POKENAME indicates a higher quality stone.

entry: POKENAME的喙遇到进化石就会闪亮、产生反应。珠宝店有时用它评估石头纯度，反应越明显，品质就越好。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME beaks shimmer and react to the presence of Evolution stones. They are sometimes used by jewellery stores to assess the purity of the Evolution stones they sell, as a more pronounced reaction from POKENAME indicates a higher quality stone.

entry: POKENAME头痛得受不了时，精神力会在不知不觉间抬高湖水。独特DNA也让它能在水中隐形。
author: fiordaliso
source: When its headache becomes unbearable, its psychic powers raise the lake's water level without it noticing. Its unique DNA allows POKENAME to become invisible while in water.

entry: POKENAME被当作电脑里的虚拟宠物。它像真正的可达鸭一样嘎嘎叫、摇摆行走，甚至抱着头，仿佛正头痛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME is kept as a virtual pet on PCs. It quacks and waddles just like a real Psyduck, and even holds its head as though it were having a headache.

entry: POKENAME在代码中漂游，吃掉看似有错误的部分，想帮程序员。不过它分不清哪些代码重要，结果常让人头痛。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME attempt to help programmers by drifting through computer code, eating anything that looks bugged. Their efforts to help usually end up causing headaches as they are bad at determining what's important within the code.

entry: POKENAME战斗时向前滚，想把喙伸到对手身下，再突然掀上空中。使这招会响亮鸣叫，很享受看敌人在空中翻滚。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME roll forward in battle, seeking to slot their beak underneath their opponent, then abruptly flip them into the air. They honk loudly when they use this manoeuvre, enjoying the sight of their foe tumbling through the air.

entry: POKENAME战斗时向前滚，想把喙伸到对手身下，再突然掀上空中。使这招会响亮鸣叫，很享受看敌人在空中翻滚。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME roll forward in battle, seeking to slot their beak underneath their opponent, then abruptly flip them into the air. They honk loudly when they use this manoeuvre, enjoying the sight of their foe tumbling through the air.

entry: 野生POKENAME若被捕食者发现就会逃跑，因为正面对峙时无力自卫。不断逃离危险的压力，让它常常头痛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME flee from predators that find them in the wild because they lack the ability to defend themselves during a confrontation. The constant stress from running away from danger causes them many headaches.

entry: POKENAME从茧的甲片间释放浓稠毒胶，驱退捕食者。出胶的孔若堵住，压力积起，就会头痛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME release a thick and poisonous gel from the plates of their cocoon that deters predators. If the pores that release this gel get clogged, they develop a headache from the building pressure.

entry: POKENAME飞行时常突然大悟，为此兴奋。它赶回训练家身边想分享，却又忘了自己为什么开心。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME often experience great epiphanies while flying and get excited by the experience. They often rush back to their Trainer to share the news only to forget why they were excited.

entry: POKENAME大部分时间睡觉，因为只有睡着，才能摆脱持续的偏头痛。因此，谁打扰睡眠，都会招来很差的反应。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME spends most of its time sleeping, as the moments it is asleep are the only time it doesn't suffer constant migraines. As a result, it reacts very poorly to anything that disturbs its slumber.

entry: POKENAME优雅游过湖泊，蜿蜒觅食。一种常见迷信称，看见它跃出水面，又听到响亮鸣叫，就会有好运。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME swim elegantly through the water, winding their way through lakes in search of food. A common superstition holds that it brings good fortune to see one breach the water and hear its loud honk.

entry: POKENAME额上宝石闪着精神能量。它不断把多余能量集中进去，避免积蓄压力，引发令人衰弱的头痛。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME's forehead gem sparkles with psychic energy. POKENAME constantly focus their excess energy into their gem, preventing a painful build-up that would otherwise cause debilitating headaches.

entry: POKENAME飞行能力强，可飞太久就会痛苦头痛。它飞着飞着常撞入水中，浸没头部，缓解疼痛。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has strong flight capabilities, but flying for too long gives it painful headaches. It typically crashes into the water during flight to submerge its head and soothe the pain.

entry: POKENAME对巢的领地意识很强，嗡嗡飞绕，随时抵挡闯入者。可持续头痛影响专注，让防御失准、效果变差。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is highly territorial of its nests, buzzing around ready to fend off trespassers. Unfortunately the constant headaches it suffers mess with its focus, making its defense inaccurate and less effective.

entry: 许多POKENAME是残酷实验的受害者，科学家想破解基因密码，在它们身体上试验。实验之后，头痛往往长久不退。
author: quackquackattack
source: Many POKENAME are victims of cruel experiments from scientists trying to unlock the secrets of their genetic code. They often experience lingering headaches from the tests performed on their bodies.

entry: POKENAME的精神潜力极大，会用来安抚、治愈周围生物。尤其能让心神清明，摆脱疼痛与负面情绪。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's psychic potential is vast, which it uses to soothe and heal those around it. In particular, the minds of those around it become clear, free of pain or negative emotions.

entry: 用POKENAME叶片泡茶，是传统的居家缓解头痛方法。近期分析发现，叶中含天然止痛成分，药企因此产生兴趣，希望开发新药。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Tea brewed from POKENAME leaves is a traditional home remedy for headache relief. Recent analysis of their leaves shows that they contain natural painkillers. Pharmaceutical companies have taken an interest in them, hoping to develop new medicines.

entry: POKENAME涉过湿地寻找嫩芽，宽喙很适合拱开泥沙搜寻新生植物。它沿湿地底部行走，伸长脖子，观察水面上方。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME wade through wetlands in search of fresh shoots to feed on, their broad beaks well suited to rooting through mud and silt in search of new growth. They walk along the bottom of the wetlands, using their long neck to keep a view above water.

entry: POKENAME能用念力举起物件，帮助磨牙，弥补短小双手不便握持的缺点。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are capable of harnessing telekinesis to lift objects. They harness this power to help them file their teeth, which their stubby hands are unable to hold.

entry: POKENAME很少记得自己何时使用奇妙的精神力，因此潜能难开发。只要反复训练、夸奖，它便能慢慢形成运用念力的肌肉记忆。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have psychic powers that are difficult to unlock because they rarely remember the moments when they utilize the strange powers. With enough repetition and praise, they can slowly develop the muscle memory to harness telekinesis.

entry: POKENAME用精神力举起骨片磨牙，缓解长新牙时头部积起的压力。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME harness their psychic powers to lift pieces of bone to file down their teeth. This helps them ease the pressure that builds up in their heads whenever they regrow teeth.

entry: POKENAME靠精神力安全修牙，却常忘了修过。照镜子时，才会为牙齿的长度吃惊。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME rely on their psychic powers to safely trim their teeth. They often forget that they trim their teeth and are surprised at the length of their teeth when they look in the mirror.

entry: POKENAME还不习惯庞大身体，游不了多远。体形又吓着其他宝可梦，因此没有朋友。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are incapable of swimming very far because they are not used to their large bodies. Despite this ineptitude, they are scary to other Pokémon because of their size and are left without friends as a result.

entry: POKENAME泳技高超，飞快游过水中，把藻类舀进嘴里。庞大身体让其他宝可梦害怕，因此常没几个朋友。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are superb swimmers that dart through the water to scoop algae into their mouths. Their large bodies are intimidating to other Pokémon so they often have few friends.

entry: 它们健忘，吃各种蘑菇，常因此头痛。想治头痛时，就找特定的大蘑菇，提醒自己把疼痛忘掉。
author: quackquackattack
source: Their forgetful minds eat many varieties of mushrooms and frequently experience headaches as a result. Whenever they want to cure a headache, they look for a particular Big Mushroom so they remember to forget the pain.

entry: POKENAME时间感敏锐，十分守时。日常作息只要偏差超过一分钟，就会困惑得偏头痛，直到重新按时。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a keen sense of time and are very punctual. If their daily routine is offset by more than a minute, they become so incredibly confused that they develop a migraine until they are back on schedule.

entry: POKENAME吃到不喜欢的花，会难受得释放精神波。产生的气场，让附近生物也头痛。
author: .izik
source: If POKENAME eats a flower it doesn't like, it emits psychic waves in distress. The resulting aura causes headaches nearby.

entry: POKENAME成群寻找吃树果的好地方。不断的嗡嗡、嘎嘎声容易造成过度刺激，太吵就会让许多个体头痛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME travel in swarms to search for the best places to eat berries. They are easily overstimulated by the constant buzzing and quacking, leading many to develop a headache if the noises are too loud.

entry: 它头痛时，头上的刺会变深色。害怕时，刺还会渗出有毒物质。
author: .izik
source: The spike on its head will get darker in color when it is experiencing a headache. The spike will also ooze a toxic substance if it gets scared.

entry: POKENAME视力差，靠响亮的嘎嘎声在洞窟定位。飞行时若被强光分心，就可能撞墙，疼得头痛欲裂。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have poor eyesight and rely on their loud quacks to help them locate where they are in a cave. If they are distracted by bright lights while flying, they can bump into walls and develop an agonizing headache from the impact.

entry: POKENAME对气味极其敏感。墨莓果味会让羽毛蓬开，引发严重偏头痛。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME is extremely sensitive to scents. The smell of Bluk Berries causes its feathers to fluff out and triggers severe migraines.

entry: POKENAME有两个会在暗处发光的诱饵，却拿不定主意看哪一个。视线不停切换，常因此头痛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have two lures that shine in the dark but are ambivalent about which one to stare at. They often switch their gaze between the two, leading to headaches from constant shifting.

entry: POKENAME有两个发着生物荧光的诱饵。很难同时看清两个，因此视线不断来回切换。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have two lures that shine with bioluminescent light. They have a difficult time focusing on both at once, so they constantly shift their gaze between them.

entry: POKENAME偏头痛时，触角会猛烈放电。深夜在水里看见这景象，水手就知道得避远。
author: .izik
source: During migraines, POKENAME's antenna discharges violent electric bursts. Sailors who see this in the water late at night know to stay clear.

entry: POKENAME得经常释放体内电力，不然就会严重头痛。每当它记得放电，就给一颗橙橙果，能让它学会把释放能量视为好事。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME often need to discharge electricity from their bodies, or they will develop a nasty headache. By giving them an Oran Berry when they remember to discharge electricity, they learn to associate the release of energy as a good thing.

entry: POKENAME开心时，会欢快嘎嘎叫，释放舒缓的精神波。据说这些波动能预防，甚至治愈头痛。
author: quackquackattack
source: Whenever POKENAME are happy, they release joyful quacks and release soothing psychic waves. It is said that these psychic waves can prevent or even cure headaches.

entry: POKENAME头痛前常会焦虑，便紧抓训练家，因为发作时容易眩晕。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME is known to become anxious before the onset of a headache. It will cling to its Trainer when this happens, as it is vulnerable to getting dizzy during headaches.

entry: POKENAME能窥见未来，知道下次头痛可能何时到来。它会花时间做好准备，减轻未来的疼痛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can see glimpses into the future about when its next headache might come. It will spend time completing tasks that help mitigate the pain from the future headache.

entry: 它的羊毛全年生长，也积起静电，点亮尾端灯泡。静电若释放不当，就会头痛。
author: quackquackattack
source: Its fleece grows throughout the year, which also builds up static electricity to light the bulb on its tail. Improper discharge of this static electricity causes it to develop headaches.

entry: POKENAME能用念力寻找电池等电子设备，却常忘了有这能力。物件一被举起，它还会真的吃一惊。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can harness the powers of telekinesis to locate batteries and other electronics. They often forget that they have this ability and are genuinely surprised when they lift objects.

entry: POKENAME疼痛时，会高举尾巴。通过尾巴释放的精神脉冲，足以夷平一栋房子。
author: .izik
source: When it is in pain, POKENAME raises its tail high. It can unleash psychic pulses through its tail strong enough to level a house.

entry: POKENAME偏头痛时，会释放强效花粉，效力明显增强，有时能弄晕附近小型宝可梦。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME emits intense pollen when it has a migraine. The potency increases dramatically then, sometimes knocking out small Pokémon nearby.

entry: POKENAME是船上常见害兽，逼得游轮饲养猫老大。它用小股高压水枪切开通道，钻进储食间偷面包。
author: ghostslythe
source: A common shipboard pest, POKENAME has forced cruise liners to keep onboard Persian. Using small high-pressure Water Guns, it cuts its way into pantries to steal bread.

entry: POKENAME剧烈头痛时，会从喙喷出高压水，威力足以穿透实心岩石。
author: .izik
source: When suffering from a severe headache, POKENAME spits pressurized water from its beak. The blasts are powerful enough to pierce solid stone.

entry: POKENAME头脑简单，持续头痛甚至不被当作疼痛。发作时，唯一迹象就是连眨几次眼，再轻挠头。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is so simple-minded that its constant headaches don't even register as pain to it. The only sign of a migraine flaring up is a series of blinks, followed by a light scratching of the head.

entry: POKENAME能与训练家心灵感应，不过用太久就会头痛。训练家给树果，让它吃饱，便能缓解。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are capable of telepathically communicating with their Trainer, but using this telepathy for long periods of time causes them to develop a headache. Trainers can mitigate these headaches by giving them berries to keep them well-fed.

entry: POKENAME喜欢夜游湖泊，却常撞上岩石和睡着的宝可梦。游太快，还可能脑震荡、头痛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME love to go for a nightly swim in lakes but often bump into rocks and sleeping Pokémon when they do. If they swim too fast, they can get a concussion and develop a headache.

entry: POKENAME从喙吐出污水守巢，恶臭过去曾被视为诅咒或预兆。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spits foul water from its beak to defend its nest. The stench was once seen as a curse or omen.

entry: POKENAME四肢短粗，够不到背上球茎，因此无法治自己的头痛。它依赖训练家或其他宝可梦帮忙施用花粉。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME cannot reach the bulb on its back with its stout limbs, which prevents it from curing its own headaches. It relies on its Trainer or other Pokémon to assist with administering the pollen.

entry: POKENAME用喙撬锁，进入储食间，半夜再与其他鼠类宝可梦一起偷吃。它能轻易分散猫老大注意，让伙伴洗劫食物。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME breaks locks with its bill to access pantries and sneaks out in the middle of the night alongside other rodent Pokémon to steal food. It can easily distract a Persian while its friends loot the pantry.

entry: POKENAME漫游古老的水下遗迹深处，守护秘密。强力嘎嘎声，能让听者头痛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME roam the ancient depths of underwater ruins to protect the secrets within. They can unleash a powerful quack that causes a headache to those who can hear it.

entry: POKENAME格外能抵御精神攻击，谁用超能力属性招式打它，谁就必然头痛。它似乎不知这抗性，每次挨打仍只是抱着自己的头。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are unusually resistant to mental assault; attempts to attack them with Psychic-type attacks invariably result in headaches for the aggressor. POKENAME seem unaware of their resistance, simply clutching their head whenever they're attacked.

entry: 它靠健忘或星桃果避免头痛。树果能暂时增强脑中随机一部分，大约十分钟后，头痛便会回来。
author: quackquackattack
source: It relies on its forgetfulness or a Starf Berry to prevent headaches. The berry offers a small boost to a random part of its mind for roughly ten minutes before the headaches return.

entry: POKENAME浮在池面，小小脚蹼慢慢划水。受惊时突然开炮，朝随机方向猛冲过水面。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME bob along the top of ponds, slowly paddling along with their tiny webbed feet. They fire off their cannons when startled, abruptly jetting across the water in a random direction.

entry: 许多训练家应付不了POKENAME因头痛而反复发脾气，把它遗弃路边。不过尽心照顾，就能得到忠诚相伴一生的伙伴。
author: quackquackattack
source: Many Trainers abandon their POKENAME on the curbside because they have trouble taking care of a POKENAME's many tantrums that result from their headaches. Devoted Trainers who take care of their POKENAME will have a loyal, lifelong partner.

entry: 捏POKENAME头上的毛能压住好斗行为，却会引起痛苦的偏头痛，因此被视为残酷、不人道的纠正方式。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's belligerent behavior can be curtailed by pinching the hairs on its head, but as this act causes it to suffer a painful migraine, it's considered a cruel and inhumane way of behavioral correction.

entry: POKENAME在壳里发酵树果，却常忘了有多满。最终装满树果汁，又会因放不下更多树果而生气；越想，越可能头痛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME ferment berries within their shell but often forget how full they are. When they inevitably get full of Berry Juice, they get angry that they cannot fit more berries in. This anger can lead to a headache if they ruminate on it.

entry: POKENAME有两个意识，一个在身体，一个在角里。角常被当钝器使用，因此其中的意识总在头痛。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME possesses two consciousnesses: one in the body, and one in the horn. The consciousness within the horn suffers constant headaches due to so often being used as a bludgeoning weapon.

entry: POKENAME身体五彩，在多数生物看来滑稽古怪。它的身体分节，能把中段当弹丸射出，不久又像回力镖般飞回。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's multicolored body makes it look quite comical and strange to most. Its body is segmented, and it can launch the middle segment of its body like a projectile, the segment returning shortly after like a boomerang.

entry: POKENAME偏头痛时，身手反而更敏捷。长爪一阵阵无规律却有效地劈斩，战斗动作很难预测。
author: .izik
source: During migraines, POKENAME's agility improves. It slashes with long claws in erratic but effective bursts, making it hard to predict its movements in battle.

entry: POKENAME焦虑胆小，不敢独自猎取蜂蜜。偷蜂巢前，它常先拉其他宝可梦帮忙。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are anxious creatures that are too timid to go hunting for honey by themselves. They often try to enlist the help of other Pokémon before stealing honeycombs.

entry: POKENAME偏头痛越厉害，呼吸就越冷。喙里释放的寒冷疾风，能冻住浅池。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's breath grows colder when its migraines intensify. It releases frigid squalls from its beak that can freeze shallow ponds.

entry: POKENAME一头痛，就会吐出能冻结河湖的冷息。冻住其他宝可梦后，它常后悔，试着把对方挖出冰层。
author: quackquackattack
source: Whenever POKENAME experience a headache, they release a cold breath that can freeze lakes and rivers. They often feel remorseful for freezing other Pokémon and will try to dig them out of the ice.

entry: POKENAME为抵消持续偏头痛而进化出占据大半身体的大脑。不过神经元距离变大，也让思考花更久。
author: kiwiarms
source: Its brain takes up most of the space in its body as an evolutionary adaptation to offset its constant migraines. It takes longer for POKENAME to think due to the increased space between its neurons.

entry: POKENAME精准喷水，想让人把食物掉进水里。不少个体很固执，不掉下来就不罢休，甚至用力过头，把自己弄得头痛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME fire precise bursts of water to make people drop food into the water. Many POKENAME are particularly stubborn and refuse to give up until the food falls, even to the point of straining their heads until they develop a headache.

entry: POKENAME愤怒地连叫，警告入侵者离开。多数生物觉得好笑，但若不听警告，它接着就会咳出几轮滚烫泡泡。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME attempts to warn away intruders with a series of angry quacks. Though amusing to most, if this warning isn't heeded, it follows up by coughing up several volleys of boiling hot bubbles.

entry: POKENAME滚动时，路面颠簸会让头剧烈震动，引起头痛。碎石多、凹凸不平的路，它更喜欢小跑，不愿滚。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME experiences headaches whenever it rolls because bumps in the road cause jarring head vibrations. For rocky avenues with lots of uneven terrain, it prefers to trot along instead of rolling.

entry: 搜索时，POKENAME会出现在搜索栏，提供提前结束的选项。救生圈般的模样，让使用者能安全退出文件搜索，不损伤系统。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME appear at the search bar during a search to give users an option to end the search early. They resemble a life buoy to give users a way to escape a file search without damaging their systems.

entry: POKENAME常画到一半头痛，忘掉原本构思，再从旧作残片接着画新作。这种奇妙方法，让作品格外独特而超现实。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME often starts an art piece, before suffering a headache that makes it forget the original idea and begin painting a new one connected to the scraps of the old. This odd methodology gives its artwork a very distinct and surreal look.

entry: POKENAME快速旋转，甩动双腿和鳍攻击。不过转得太快，眩晕就会引起痛苦头痛，给对手可乘之机。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME fight by spinning rapidly to swing their legs and flippers against opponents. If they end up spinning too quickly, the dizziness causes a painful headache that gives opponents an opportunity to strike.

entry: POKENAME频繁头痛，会让电力向外涌出。疼得越厉害，头顶两根突起间流动的闪电越多。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's regular headaches cause its electric power to surge outward. The more painful the headache, the more lightning can be seen coursing between its two prongs.

entry: POKENAME绷紧肌肉缠住猎物。使力太大容易拉伤，进而引发头痛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME wrap around their prey by tensing their muscles. When they exert too much force, they are prone to pulling a muscle that can lead to a headache.

entry: 喝POKENAME的乳汁，能暂时缓解头痛，因此药店会出售。
author: lydiaprower8
source: Drinking POKENAME's milk can temporarily soothe a headache. Their milk is sold at pharmacists for this reason.

entry: 剧烈头痛时，POKENAME周身电弧噼啪作响。偏头痛持续越久，火花就越狂乱。
author: .izik
source: During intense headaches, arcs of lightning crackle across POKENAME's body. These sparks grow wilder the longer the migraine lasts.

entry: POKENAME喜欢肢体亲昵，尤其爱拥抱和按摩。可惜舒服起来，它常会不由自主地放电。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME has an affinity for physical affection and especially loves cuddles or massages. Unfortunately, it tends to release volts of electricity involuntarily when it is comfortable.

entry: POKENAME尾巴释放特殊香气，舒缓头痛和偏头痛。训练家与它自己都能从抱尾巴中获益，为受慢性疾病困扰的人带来片刻宽慰。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME produce a special scent from their tails that soothes headaches and migraines. Trainers and POKENAME alike benefit from hugging their tail, giving people with chronic illness a moment of reprieve.

entry: POKENAME笨手笨脚，双尾常撞上东西。靠近易碎物时，它会把尾巴按在头上，既减少打碎的风险，也缓解压力。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are clumsy creatures that bump into objects with their twin tails. When near fragile objects, POKENAME press their tails against their head to both minimize the risk of breaking things and to ease their stress.

entry: POKENAME想融入其他宝可梦，却总担心不成功。痛苦头痛发作时，这种社交焦虑可能变得极端。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME want to blend in with other Pokémon but are constantly worried that they don't. This social anxiety can take an extreme turn when they get painful headaches.

entry: POKENAME苦于自我怀疑、缺乏自信，因此头痛。头痛会让无形精神墙飘在周围，实实在在地把朋友推远。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME struggle with self-doubt and confidence that results in them developing headaches. These headaches can cause invisible psychic walls to float around them as they literally push their friends away.

entry: POKENAME喜欢陪其他幼年宝可梦玩，却容易受过多刺激。训练家限制玩伴数量，就能避免它因此头痛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME enjoy playing with other baby Pokémon but are prone to feeling overstimulated. By limiting the number of playmates they have, Trainers can avoid giving them a headache from the overstimulation.

entry: POKENAME常忘了自己有何本领，直到压力大增。压力引起的头痛，能让它如手术般精准地发射电光。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME often forgets what powers they are capable of until they are under a lot of stress. The pain of a stress-induced headache allows them to fire bolts of electricity with surgical precision.

entry: POKENAME大吃树果，缓解头骨内压力。肚子饱了，头痛便消失，它会短暂进入禅定般的平和状态。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME gorges on berries to ease the pressure within its skull. When its tummy is full, its headache is gone, and for a short period of time, it reaches a zen-like state.

entry: POKENAME创造磁场，让其他宝可梦合拍起舞。图案可随意改变，但通常会选精巧的数学规律，让舞蹈好看。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME create magnetic fields that other Pokémon follow in a synchronous dance. They can change the pattern at will, but usually choose to display some intricate mathematical pattern to make them appealing to watch.

entry: POKENAME灵巧运用可伸长的大舌，抓取大量食物。若中途头痛，它便痛苦挣扎，把舌头胡乱甩动。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses its large extendable tongue with great dexterity to grab large amounts of food. If a headache strikes during this, it flails its tongue about wildly while in its pain throes.

entry: POKENAME能踩自己的尾巴冲浪，不过需要高度专注。专注带来的压力若持续太久，就会痛苦头痛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are capable of surfing on their own tails, but this act requires a lot of focus to complete. The stress that comes with this focus can cause a painful headache if sustained for too long.

entry: POKENAME能一连好几个小时钻地。有时忘了正在做什么，就会绕圈挖，常需要指引，提醒该做的事。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can burrow underground for hours at a time. Sometimes they dig in circles because they forget what they were doing and often need guidance to remind them of what they need to do.

entry: POKENAME喜欢湖泳，靠鳍轻松穿过其他水属性宝可梦之间。不过有时会撞上对方，因脑震荡而头痛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME love to swim in lakes, as their flippers allow them to weave around other Water-type Pokémon with ease. Sometimes they bump into another Pokémon and get a headache from the concussion.

entry: POKENAME喜欢在冰湖游泳，自由舒展身体。不过它对温差敏感，热水会令它极度焦虑，持续太久又会头痛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME love swimming in icy lakes where they can freely maneuver their bodies. They are sensitive to temperature differences, as hot water makes them incredibly anxious. This anxiety can lead to a headache if sustained long enough.

entry: 传闻POKENAME头大，是因为装满宏大点子。其实原因是腺体过度活跃。
author: kiwiarms
source: Rumor has it that POKENAME's head is so large because it's full of big ideas. It's actually caused by an overactive gland.

entry: 不建议尝一口POKENAME。它不仅难吃，哪怕只啃下一点点，也会引发剧烈的偏头痛。
author: patch_bros
source: It is recommended that no one take a bite out of POKENAME. Not only does it taste horrible, but even the smallest nibble can cause intense migraines.

entry: POKENAME负责确保文件正确分类，工作枯燥得发木。可闲置太久，又会因为无事可做而焦虑、偏头痛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have the mind-numbingly dull task of ensuring that files are properly catalogued. If left idle for too long, they develop a migraine from the anxiety of doing nothing.

entry: POKENAME总被严重偏头痛困扰，靠吃家附近的树果缓解。森林干旱时，它会从喙轻轻吐水，灌溉干渴植物。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is constantly plagued by terrible migraines, which it tries to keep at bay by eating the Berries that grow near its home. If the forest is experiencing a drought, it irrigates the parched plants by gently spitting water from its beak.

entry: POKENAME几乎时刻受偏头痛折磨。一尖叫，背上孔洞就冒出大泡泡。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: POKENAME is in near constant pain with migraines. As it screams, large bubbles emerge from holes on its back.

entry: POKENAME需要专心，才能运用念力。目前还不熟练，用太久便常头痛。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME requires deep focus to use its telekinetic powers. It's not yet adept with these powers, and it often gets a headache after using them for too long.

entry: POKENAME在地下视力敏锐，却方向感差，常迷路。最终出土时，还容易撞头，疼得厉害。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have keen vision underground but often gets lost because of their poor sense of direction. When they inevitably surface, they are prone to bumping their head and giving themselves a painful headache.

entry: POKENAME头痛一开始，就会往头上抹泥。凉意能让它平静，哪怕只有片刻。
author: .izik
source: When a headache starts, POKENAME smears mud over its head. The cool sensation helps it stay calm, even for a short while.

entry: POKENAME的喙出奇强壮，能顶起自身体形三倍的重石。头鳍对温变极敏感，变化太快就会头痛。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's beak is surprisingly strong, able to push up heavy rocks thrice its size. The fin on its head is very sensitive to temperature change; should the temperature shift too rapidly, POKENAME gets a headache.

entry: POKENAME仍在发展精神能力，会试着读心。有时想法太复杂，读着读着就头痛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME is still developing its psychic abilities and will try to read people's minds. Sometimes it gets a headache when reading someone's mind because the thoughts are too complex.

entry: POKENAME一心想讨好别人，靠心灵感应迎合期望。一犯错，就容易把自己折腾到头痛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are hyper-focused on pleasing others and rely on their telepathy to meet the expectations of others. They are prone to working themselves into a headache whenever they make a mistake.

entry: POKENAME喜欢随欢快音乐蹦跳旋转。现场演唱和表演常见大群个体，不过音量若弄得头痛，它们就会散开。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME enjoy dancing to upbeat music, hopping and spinning in time with the beat. Groups of POKENAME are a common sight during live concerts and performances, but will disperse if the volume causes them to develop a headache.

entry: 暴雨后，POKENAME静止悬在池塘上方，汲取下方池水，补充周身水环。传闻环绕的水能解宿醉，但数量稀少，很难验证。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME hang motionless above ponds after rainstorms, gathering water from the pond below to add to their halo. The water that floats around them is rumoured to be a cure for hangovers, though their scarcity makes the rumour hard to verify.

entry: POKENAME用喙筛土，寻找小生物吃。成熟后，背部刺开始产毒，保护群体其余成员。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME uses its bill to sift through the dirt, looking for small critters to eat. Once it has matured, the barbs on its back start to produce venom to help protect the rest of its group.

entry: 常能见到POKENAME独自沉思，想的是什么却不清楚。若感到困惑，身体就会不断变色，很容易看出来。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can often be seen pondering to itself, though what it contemplates is uncertain. One can tell if it's feeling confusion, as a confused POKENAME's body constantly shuffles through different colors.

entry: POKENAME能与金属身体的宝可梦心灵感应。海量消息常让它难以承受，因此许多训练家让它远离成群的钢属性宝可梦。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can communicate with other metallic Pokémon using their telepathy. They are often overwhelmed by the sheer number of messages they get, so many Trainers keep them away from groups of Steel-type Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME靠心灵感应与钢属性宝可梦交流。它一头痛，其他钢属性就赶来安抚，因为疼痛也会被传给它们。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME communicate with other Steel-type Pokémon with telepathy. Whenever POKENAME get a headache, other Steel-type Pokémon swoop in to help them calm down because POKENAME inflict the pain that they experience onto them.

entry: POKENAME在脑中做复杂计算，用心灵感应指挥其他钢属性宝可梦完成任务。压力引起头痛时，它会设法独处，避免分享痛苦。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME mentally perform complex calculations and direct other Steel-type Pokémon to complete tasks with their telepathy. When POKENAME experience a headache from stress, they try to isolate themselves and avoid sharing their pain.

entry: POKENAME在蜿蜒林河安家，拱开河沙泥土，寻找水生植物。后脚有蹼，让它轻易逆流游泳。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME make their homes in meandering forest rivers, rooting around in the river's silt for aquatic plants to feed on. Their hind feet are webbed, enabling them to swim against the current with ease.

entry: POKENAME在蜿蜒林河安家，拱开河沙泥土，寻找水生植物。有些四脚都有蹼，陆地更笨拙，泳速却比同类快。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME make their homes in meandering forest rivers, rooting around in the river's silt for aquatic plants to feed on. Some POKENAME have four webbed feet, making them clumsier on land but faster swimmers than others of their species.

entry: POKENAME在蜿蜒林河安家，拱开河沙泥土，寻找水生植物。有些没有脚蹼，游泳较弱，陆上躲避捕食者却胜过同类。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME make their homes in meandering forest rivers, rooting around in the river's silt for aquatic plants to feed on. Some POKENAME lack webbed feet, making them weaker swimmers but better at evading predators on land than others of their species.

entry: POKENAME用宽喙从河床挖泥，带到河道狭窄处筑坝。它们用扁尾拍平，合作为全家盖房。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME dredge up mud from the river bed with their broad beaks, bringing it back to choke points in the river to construct dams. They flatten the mud with their flat tails, working together to build a home for their entire family group.

entry: POKENAME在蜿蜒林河安家，拱开河沙泥土，寻找水生植物。有些没有脚蹼，游泳较弱，陆上躲避捕食者却胜过同类。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME make their homes in meandering forest rivers, rooting around in the river's silt for aquatic plants to feed on. Some POKENAME lack webbed feet, making them weaker swimmers but better at evading predators on land than others of their species.

entry: POKENAME用宽喙从河床挖泥，带到河道狭窄处筑坝。它十分护家，冲入侵者大声嘎嘎叫，试图吓走。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME dredge up mud from the river bed with their broad beaks, bringing it back to choke points in the river to construct dams. They are protective of their homes, loudly quacking at intruders in an effort to scare them away.

entry: POKENAME从巢挖出多个出口隧道，方便随时悄悄进出。想交流时，它会抖动喙，发出低沉咕噜声。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME dig multiple exit tunnels from their nests, allowing them to come and go unobserved whenever they want. They rattle their beak when they want to communicate, making a low growling sound.

entry: POKENAME喜欢摇摆钻进窄处，却常忘了头冠，卡住出不来。试图挣脱自己钻进的缝隙，常会把它弄得头痛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME love to waddle into tight spaces, and they often get stuck because they fail to account for the crest on their head. They often get headaches trying to escape a crevice that they wedged themselves into.

entry: POKENAME喜欢撕开渔网，吃逃出的水属性宝可梦。若自己被网缠住，又会困惑懊恼得头痛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME enjoy tearing into fishing nets to eat the escaping Water-type Pokémon. Whenever they get themselves wrapped in fishing nets, they get so confused and frustrated that they develop a headache.

entry: POKENAME身体有许多锐边，不明白为什么玩伴总被刮伤。这让不少个体反复回想过去举动，想得头痛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have many sharp edges across their body and are often confused when Pokémon they play with end up with scratches. This has led many to constantly ruminate over their past actions to the point where they develop headaches.

entry: POKENAME依赖训练家帮忙采收、使用背上花粉。少了花粉的药效，就无法治愈痛苦的偏头痛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME rely on their Trainer to help them harvest and use the pollen on their back. Without the medicinal properties of their pollen, they are unable to cure the painful migraines they have.

entry: POKENAME泳技不错，能游超过一小时不累。毒刺虽能注入致命毒素，它却常忘了有刺，遇敌多半害怕游走。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are quite good swimmers, being able to swim for over an hour without getting tired. Even though it can inject a lethal toxin from its quills, it often forgets it has them so they will mostly just swim away in fear from foes.

entry: POKENAME巨大的假嘴总让它头痛，依无法控制的本能行动。每次咬嚼捕获的东西，偏头痛都会更严重。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's massive false mouth gives it numerous headaches and acts on an instinct POKENAME cannot control. Any time it bites or chews on something it has caught, POKENAME suffers even worse migraines.

entry: POKENAME后脑大嘴不停吃，食物得经过脑旁才能进胃，因此它持续头痛。
author: maxissaa
source: POKENAME suffers constant headaches due to the large mouth on the back of its head constantly eating food which must travel past POKENAME's brain to reach its stomach.

entry: 用六片翅膀游泳，用两只巨爪牢牢抓住猎物。长期头痛若达到顶点，可能会展现奇异的力量。
author: the_fireplace
source: It swims using six wings, and grips its prey firmly between its two large claws. If its chronic headache peaks, it may exhibit odd powers.

entry: POKENAME用头撞树和巨石，增强对钝击创伤的耐受。头侧尖刺却很脆，受损会引起头痛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME headbutt trees and boulders to build up a tolerance against blunt force trauma. The spikes on the side of their head are brittle and cause headaches when damaged.

entry: POKENAME猛撞物体，试图缓解头痛。它常向训练家讨止痛药，可能让人花费不菲。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME slam their head against objects in an attempt to soothe their headaches. They often beg their Trainer for medicine to stop the pain, which can be a costly endeavor.

entry: POKENAME腿部肌肉强壮，能迅速加速，冲撞物体。若头撞上格外硬的东西，就会头痛，得靠药物解决。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have powerful leg muscles that allow them to quickly accelerate and ram into objects. If they hit their head into a particularly hard object, they develop a headache that needs medicine to fix.

entry: POKENAME厚茧般的额头，能弹开任何攻击。高贵外貌让它很受上流阶层喜爱。
author: kiwiarms
source: Its calloused forehead is able to repel any attack. POKENAME's noble appearance has made it quite popular among the upper class.

entry: POKENAME对周围世界漠然，因为梦里更开心。现实的冲击，让它清醒时常头痛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are indifferent to the world around them because they are happier in their dreams. The jarring experience of reality causes them to develop headaches while awake.

entry: POKENAME照料巢中其他宝可梦，不过对方想外出探索，就常让它头痛。它疑神疑鬼，觉得处处有险，因此压力极大。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME take care of other Pokémon in their nest, which ends up causing many headaches when the other Pokémon want to explore. Their paranoid tendencies cause them great stress when they see danger around every corner.

entry: POKENAME常预见村落受灾，便赶去救助。可预知引发的头痛，反激起超能力，往往造成原本想阻止的破坏。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME often have visions of disasters striking a village and rush in to try and help. However, the headaches that come from their visions set off their psychic powers, often causing the destruction they sought to prevent.

entry: POKENAME产生大量泡泡，增加浮力，在水面漂行。有时做太多，就会飘到空中，直到泡泡破得够多，才回落。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can produce large amounts of bubbles to help its buoyancy and keep it riding along the water's surface. Occasionally it produces too much, and floats through the air until enough bubbles pop and send it back down.

entry: POKENAME游过海洋，朝路过的拉普拉斯和船嘎嘎叫。许多小型宝可梦会躲进泡泡，避开巨牙鲨等捕食者。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME swim along oceans, quacking at Lapras and boats they pass. Many small Pokémon use POKENAME's bubbles to hide from predators such as Sharpedo.

entry: 泡进POKENAME背上的水，几乎谁都能彻底放松、恢复精神。它也很欢迎，因为水里若没有同伴，自己便会头痛。
author: sk372
source: Bathing in the waters on POKENAME's back is a soothing process that leaves almost anyone completely refreshed afterward. POKENAME encourages it as well, as it gets headaches without the presence of another in its waters.

entry: POKENAME喜欢用角戳其他宝可梦，尽管对方觉得不舒服。它能持续游泳最久两小时不累，方便追上想躲它的宝可梦。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME loves to poke other Pokémon with its horn, even though other Pokémon find the sensation unpleasant. It is a persistent swimmer, as it can swim for up to two hours without getting tired. This helps it chase down the Pokémon who avoid it.

entry: POKENAME频繁偏头痛，影响战斗。这是感知未来的结果，因此若能理清混乱幻象，它其实很擅长打。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME suffer from regular migraines that hamper their ability to fight. These migraines are a result of being able to sense the future, making them very effective fighters when they're able to parse the jumbled visions.

entry: POKENAME紧挨着取暖，保留热量。露天待太久，就会因失温发抖，常伴随头痛，直到重新暖和。
author: quackquackattack
source: To stay warm, POKENAME huddle close together to retain heat. If POKENAME remain out in the open for too long, they begin to shiver from the loss of heat, often leading to a headache until they are warm again.

entry: POKENAME通常朝向最近的磁铁，因为面向别处就会严重偏头痛。夹在两块磁铁之间，它便疯狂旋转，想同时面向两边。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are usually faced towards the direction of the nearest magnet because facing any other direction causes them to experience a strong migraine. Whenever they are between two magnets, they spin frantically trying to face both at the same time.

entry: POKENAME有扁刃和窄柄，形似铲子。宝可梦抓住柄后，一松手，就会痛苦偏头痛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME resembles a shovel because of its flat blade and narrow handle. A Pokémon that holds onto the handle of a POKENAME will experience a painful migraine once they let go.

entry: POKENAME热情得咄咄逼人，喜欢拿毒刺蹭其他宝可梦。感觉很不愉快，因此愿意被蹭的朋友不多，大多本就抗毒。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are aggressively doting creatures that love to rub their stinger against other Pokémon. This unpleasant sensation leaves them with few friends to rub against, most of which are already resistant to the poison.

entry: POKENAME剧烈头痛时，得电击其他宝可梦缓解紧张，因此会主动找冲突。鬃毛防水，潜水捕猎也不会湿。
author: fiordaliso
source: When struck by powerful headaches, it must relieve the tension by striking other Pokémon with its electric attacks, so it willingly seeks out conflict. Its mane is water-repellent, so it doesn't even get wet when POKENAME dives to hunt.

entry: POKENAME把头探出水，盼和岸边孩子玩。可孩子一靠近，它开心地挺起全身，往往反而不小心把人吓跑。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME pokes its head out from the water, hoping to play with young children near the shoreline. Unfortunately, when children draw near and it happily rises to its full size, it often accidentally scares them away.

entry: POKENAME几乎一直头痛。建议想饲养它的训练家常备舒缓的音乐，营造没有压力的环境。
author: melodydelune
source: POKENAME suffers from near-constant headaches. Prospective Trainers are advised to keep therapeutic music around and create a stress-free environment.

entry: POKENAME常不知自己庞大身体有多强，抱着就压伤其他宝可梦。大家因这份莽撞力量而避开，让它十分难过。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are often unaware of the power of their size and often crush Pokémon in their grasp. It makes them quite sad when other Pokémon avoid them because of their reckless strength.

entry: 据说POKENAME能以超能力抬起整个海洋。可频繁的头痛总在它充分发挥前，就打乱了专注。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: It is said that POKENAME could lift the entire ocean using its psychic power. However, it experiences frequent headaches that disrupt its focus before it can properly display its power.

entry: POKENAME常潜到一半忘了怎么游，惊慌中掀起突然的巨浪。困惑表情下，藏着庞大的精神力和水之力。
author: segmoph
source: POKENAME often forgets how to swim mid-dive, unleashing sudden tidal waves in panic. Its confused expression masks immense psychic and aquatic power lurking just beneath the surface.

entry: POKENAME来自另一世界，似乎不太适应这里，因此常头痛。发作时，精神力反冲会打开几道通往异维度的门。
author: sk372
source: Coming from a world different from ours, POKENAME seems not entirely compatible with ours, causing it to suffer from headaches. When they strike, the psychic backlash opens up a few portals to this other dimension.

entry: 它高大固执，用奇异力量纠缠其他生物，非得拿到想要的才罢休。它似乎格外喜欢葡萄。
author: footlongdingledong
source: A towering and stubborn Pokémon, it pesters others with strange powers until it gets what it wants. It seems to have a strange affinity for grapes.

entry: POKENAME喜欢在夜空下跳舞。一跳整夜，早上常累坏，疲劳也容易引起头痛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have lots of fun dancing under the night sky. These night-long dances often make them tired by morning and often give them a headache from the exhaustion.

entry: POKENAME必须胀大头颅才能升空，越高、胀得越大，头痛越剧烈。因此大多数个体尽量留在地上。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME must inflate its cranium in order to gain altitude, giving it intense headaches the higher and larger it goes. Naturally, most specimens prefer to stay grounded as much as possible.

entry: POKENAME身上覆着疏水孢子，游泳时能让羽毛干爽。蘑菇浮力极强，也让它睡觉时浮在水面。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's body is coated in hydrophobic spores, which keep its feathers dry while swimming. Its mushrooms are very buoyant, which helps it float on the water while it sleeps.

entry: POKENAME漂过城市垃圾场，靠近旧毛绒玩具便会严重头痛。有人相信，它感知到了昔日主人的记忆。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME floats through city dumps and gets severe headaches near old stuffed toys. Some believe it senses memories of past owners.

entry: 这种融合体占据了一个马桶。和可达鸭一样，它持续头痛，疼得无法承受时，便可能喷涌出水。
author: hophoppip
source: This fusion has taken control of a toilet. Like Psyduck, it suffers from constant headaches, which may cause it to erupt with water when the pain is too overwhelming.

entry: POKENAME在满月夜聚集跳舞。玩得太开心，时间观念都模糊了，黎明到来时常仍迷迷糊糊。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME congregate together during nights of the full moon to dance. They have so much fun that their sense of time becomes a blur, often leaving them confused by the time dawn rises.

entry: 每逢满月，POKENAME在海滩同步起舞。舞蹈持续整夜，到日出都还恍惚。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME perform synchronized dances along beaches whenever there is a full moon. These dances last all night and leave them dazed by sunrise.

entry: POKENAME虽然是水属性，保护用的棉披风一湿，却几乎没用。战斗后，它会找高处挂披风晾干，也避开捕食者。
author: kungfucutbug
source: Despite its Water typing, POKENAME's protective cotton cloak becomes nigh-useless when wet. After battles, it will seek out high places to hang the cloak from to dry and avoid predators.

entry: POKENAME头顶燃烧的火更像水滴，完全不会灼伤。若火熄灭，它会严重头痛，直到专注到足以重新点燃。
author: actliux
source: The fire that burns atop POKENAME's head is more akin to a droplet of water and is incapable of causing any burns. If this fire is ever extinguished, POKENAME suffers a great headache until it can focus hard enough to relight it.

entry: POKENAME的尖喙能轻易切开粗树，甚至金属。甩头会引发偏头痛，疼痛又让它更凶。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's sharp beak can cut through thick trees and even metal with relative ease. Swinging its head around causes it to develop migraines, which makes it behave even more aggressively due to the pain.

entry: POKENAME是吃藻和草的两栖生物。每条尾巴都能点燃，也同样轻易熄灭。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are amphibious creatures that eat algae and grass. Each of their tails can be set aflame, and just as easily be put out.

entry: POKENAME偏头痛时，会精确掌控内脏，用来操作物件，或推动自己游水。
author: .izik
source: When migraines strike, POKENAME gains precise control over its innards. It can use them to manipulate objects or propel itself through water.

entry: POKENAME是两栖生物，陆上水里都能快速移动。每个肉垫之间都有鳍状结构，方便顺畅往返水陆。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are amphibious creatures that can move quickly both on land and in water. They have flippers in between each paw pad that ensure the smooth transition between land and water.

entry: POKENAME十分平和，很难慌乱。哪怕木头砸头、引起头痛，它仍镇定自若。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are placid creatures that are difficult to fluster. Even when they develop a headache after a log falls on their head, they remain calm and collected.

entry: POKENAME若感知到远强于自己的生物的波导，就会严重偏头痛。为了讨训练家欢心，它每天努力练武。
author: fiordaliso
source: If POKENAME senses the aura of a creature far more powerful than itself, it is struck by terrible migraines. It strives to please its Trainer by training hard in the martial arts every day.

entry: POKENAME生活极其简单懒散，一半出于性格，一半因为稍微费力的活动，都会让头疼。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME lives an extremely simple and lethargic lifestyle. This is due in equal parts to its own personality, as well as the fact that even small amounts of strenuous activity cause its head to hurt.

entry: POKENAME胡乱挥动、跑动，吵闹混乱。若不这样，体内过量睾酮会令它痛苦头痛，因此必须不停消耗精力。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME flails and runs about at random, behaving noisily and chaotically. If it didn't, the overabundance of testosterone in its body would cause it to suffer painful headaches, so it must burn off energy ceaselessly.

entry: POKENAME个头大，乍看吓人，却是人们已知最善良的宝可梦之一。许多海滩都有它，让孩子在喙上当滑梯玩。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME may seem intimidating at first because of their large size, but they are some of the kindest Pokémon known to people. They can be found at many beaches where they let children play on their bills, which can act like a slide.

entry: POKENAME发电超过身体负荷，引起难受的头痛。它必须少量多次放雷缓解，可惜只能暂时奏效。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's body generates more electricity than it can handle, causing uncomfortable headaches. It must dispel lightning in small bursts to alleviate the pain, though this is a short-lived and temporary solution.

entry: POKENAME唱歌给宝可梦观众听，却忘了歌会催听众入睡。等唱停，它就生气得头痛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME sing songs to audiences of Pokémon but forget that their songs cause them to fall asleep. When they eventually stop singing, they get so upset that it causes them to develop a headache.

entry: POKENAME身体沉重，会直沉池底，方便吃水生植物。若太深，水压引起头痛，精神力便会托它上浮，漂往岸边。
author: .jerden
source: The heavy bodies of POKENAME sink straight to the bottom of ponds, helping them to feed on underwater plants. If they go deep enough that the pressure causes a headache, psychic force will lift them up to the surface to float to the shore.

entry: POKENAME快速振翅，产生震晕猎物的超声波。不过声波也常让自己头痛，迫使它在捕猎之间休息。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME rapidly vibrate their wings to produce ultrasonic waves that stun their prey. These waves often give POKENAME headaches, however, forcing them to take breaks in between hunts.

entry: POKENAME被暗淡鳞片和持续头痛压得难受，便向水中释放精神冲击波泄压，吓走其他宝可梦。若与训练家交好，就会一生依恋。
author: quackquackattack
source: Overwhelmed by its dull scales and constant headaches, it vents stress through psychic shockwaves in the water, which scare Pokémon away. When a Trainer befriends a POKENAME, it develops a lifelong attachment to that Trainer.

entry: 它们用头撞对手，引发头痛，借此积起大量精神能量。头部隆脊储存能量，再用于强化头锤。
author: quackquackattack
source: They ram their heads into opponents to induce headaches, which allows them to build up a surge of psychic energy. The ridges on their head store that psychic energy produced, which is used to enhance their headbutts.

entry: POKENAME的喙相互咬合，产生圆周运动。转得太快，便可能眩晕。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have bills that weave into each other to produce circular motion. This motion can cause them to get dizzy if they spin too fast.

entry: POKENAME担心尾火，持续头痛。害怕火被扑灭，更让它夜不能寐。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME has constant headaches because it is worried about the fire on its tail. The terror of its fire being snuffed out keeps it awake at night.

entry: POKENAME吸入大量空气，能胀成原本两倍大。有时忘了呼吸，憋太久就会头痛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can expand to twice their size when they inhale lots of air. Sometimes they forget to breathe and develop a headache from holding their breath too long.

entry: POKENAME通常贴近地面，因为细微气压差都会引起剧烈头痛。被风暴吹走时，阴沉的恐惧让它惊慌。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME typically remain close to the ground because minute differences in air pressure cause searing headaches. When they are blown away by stormy weather, they feel a grim sense of dread that causes them to panic.

entry: 它们笨拙又容易分心，因此常撞障碍。每次撞上，便撅嘴生气，气到自己头痛。
author: quackquackattack
source: They are clumsy and easily distracted, which causes them to bump into obstacles. Whenever this occurs, they pout and get so angry they cause themselves to get headaches.

entry: POKENAME天然浮力让它能边浮边吃池塘的藻和水草。许多训练家觉得橡胶般的身体、笨拙举止很可爱，因此很受欢迎。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's natural buoyancy allows it to float while it feeds on algae and other weeds in ponds. Many trainers find its rubbery body and clumsy mannerisms adorable, making it a popular Pokémon.

entry: 严重头痛会扰乱POKENAME的幽灵能力，暂时失去穿墙本领，变得更易受伤。
author: .izik
source: Severe headaches disrupt POKENAME's ghostly abilities. It temporarily loses the power to phase through walls and becomes more vulnerable.

entry: POKENAME浮在泡泡里，隔开外界刺激。头极其敏感，泡泡一破，就会剧烈偏头痛，直到保护层再生。
author: sk372
source: The bubble POKENAME floats in is a protective barrier from external stimuli. Its head is extremely sensitive, so if the barrier is popped, it suffers excruciating migraines until it regenerates.

entry: POKENAME浮在泡泡里，作为自己与世界之间的屏障。泡泡破了，它便完全感知外界，刺激涌来，引起头痛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME float inside a bubble that serves as a protective barrier between themselves and the world. If the bubble is popped, they become fully cognizant of the outside world and experience headaches from the surge of stimuli.

entry: 沙漠阳光常让POKENAME头痛，它便把头埋进沙里。常能见一小群聚在一起，全都只有头埋在地下。
author: sk372
source: The desert sun often gives it a headache, which it solves by submerging it in the sand. It's not uncommon to see a small group of POKENAME together, all with their heads, and only their heads, underground.

entry: POKENAME从喙放出超声波冲击，震晕猎物。等对方动不了，它便全程静止，慢慢吸食对方。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME emits supersonic bursts from its beak to stun prey. Once they're immobilized, it drains them slowly, remaining motionless the entire time.

entry: POKENAME长时间晒着沙漠太阳，会脱水。缺水太久，还会中暑、严重头痛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME become dehydrated when exposed to the desert sun for long periods of time. If they go too long without water, they get heat stroke and develop a nasty headache.

entry: POKENAME活得漫不经心，随意织网、吃虫宝可梦。附近若有同类，它们常对着彼此的网发呆。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are full of insouciance in their lives, mindlessly spinning webs and eating bug Pokémon. If another POKENAME is nearby, they have a tendency to stare mindlessly into each other's webs.

entry: POKENAME生活在池塘，靠身上水生植物产能。持续头痛困扰着它，太严重还可能引起爆炸。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME lives in ponds, producing energy via the aquatic plants that grow on its body. Its plagued by constant headaches, which may cause it to explode when they get severe.

entry: 它头上的刀刃，其实是喙的一部分。一片若折断，它会疼得哭上好几周，直到重新长好。
author: mistymagius
source: The blades on its head are actually a part of its bill. If one of the blades breaks off, it will cry in pain for weeks on end until it regrows.

entry: POKENAME住在地下湖边，防水翅膀让它能轻松潜水。它吃小鱼，不过没有牙，只能整条吞。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME lives near underground lakes, its waterproof wings allowing it to dive into the water without issue. It feeds on small fish, however it has to swallow its prey whole due to its lack of teeth.

entry: POKENAME潜在池底和泥水洼里。若有什么踩到它，头痛触发的精神力就会把对方远远抛走。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME submerges itself at the bottom of ponds and mud puddles. Should something tread upon it, it flings them into the distance with psychic powers triggered by the headache from getting stepped on.

entry: POKENAME看什么都清晰无比，却无法专注单一物件，不少个体因此被过多刺激压得难以承受。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can see everything in crystal clear detail. Their inability to focus on one object leads many to become overwhelmed by the overstimulation.

entry: POKENAME剧烈头痛时，毒性会明显减弱。期间它避开冲突，喜欢躲在潮湿处，等身体恢复。
author: .izik
source: During intense headaches, POKENAME's poison weakens significantly. It avoids conflict during this time, preferring to hide in damp places until it recovers.

entry: POKENAME视力差，靠低微精神力感知四周。它很容易承受不住刺激，遇险便蜷成球，向外放出令人头痛的能量波，驱退威胁。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have poor eyesight and rely on low-grade psychic powers to sense the world around them. They are easily overwhelmed and curl into a ball when they feel endangered, projecting headache-inducing waves of energy outward to drive off threats.

entry: POKENAME长得不平衡，常侧倒在地。等压力积到足够大，就能用念力把自己扶正。
author: apixelperfectionist
source: Due to its lopsided appearance, POKENAME frequently falls on its side. It is able to right itself using psychokinesis once it becomes stressed enough.

entry: POKENAME翻找泥沙，寻找小到能整吞的宝可梦。多条上肢迅速挖开供自己食用的泥土，揭开浅洞，逼出猎物。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME root through silt and mud for any Pokémon small enough for it to swallow whole. It uses its multiple upper limbs to rapidly dig the mud it feeds on out of the way, exposing shallow burrows and flushing out prey.

entry: POKENAME气势汹汹地踏过统治的沼泽池塘，用串串泡泡欺负小生物。不过一看见比自己大的，就会吓得飞快逃走。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME aggressively stomps around the marshes and ponds it rules over, bullying smaller creatures with streams of blown bubbles. It quickly flees in terror at the sight of anything larger than itself, though.

entry: POKENAME开心踩水洼，脚蹼溅水，响亮欢叫。不过受打断就会凶暴，边叫边追，猛扑咬扰乱者。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME stomp happily through puddles, the splashes around their webbed feet accompanied by their happy honking cries. They turn violent if interrupted, chasing after whoever disturbed them with loud honks as they lunge and bite.

entry: POKENAME受热过度，脑中水分被带走，就会头痛。这生存机制让它痛苦，保持凉爽舒适，对它最好。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME develop a headache whenever they are exposed to excessive heat, which wicks moisture away from their brain. This survival mechanism causes them great distress, so keeping POKENAME cold and comfortable is in their best interest.

entry: POKENAME体内产生大量寒气，若不定时排出，就会头痛。它会吐出冰雾，却常不小心冻住身边的东西。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME generates extreme amounts of cold in its body, which gives it headaches if it doesn't vent it out regularly. It breathes out a freezing mist when it does so, often accidentally freezing anything that happens to be nearby.

entry: POKENAME爱跳舞，却受不了大音量。音乐太响，它就惊慌地朝四面喷水，羽毛也到处掉。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME loves to dance but cannot stand loud music. When the volume becomes too much, it panics, spraying water in every direction and shedding feathers wildly.

entry: POKENAME跳舞时通常心情愉快。不过头痛烦躁起来，羽毛会泛蓝；越蓝，脾气就越容易暴躁。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME is usually in a cheerful mood while dancing. However, when it develops a headache and becomes agitated, its feathers take on a bluish tint. The bluer its feathers, the more naturally irritable it becomes.

entry: POKENAME是舞者，却从没有实际跳舞的记录。平日懒洋洋的，据说经常头痛。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME are dancers, but have never actually been recorded dancing. They laze around and often are said to have headaches.

entry: POKENAME一心追求完美外貌，不断检查羽毛是否乱了。跳舞也一样，动作没练到完美，绝不表演。
author: chaotic_aspergers
source: POKENAME is very focused on looking perfect, constantly checking itself for out-of-place feathers. It treats dancing the same way, never performing until it has perfected its moves.

entry: POKENAME以体形来说非常轻，几乎不费力就能漂很远。曾有人发现大群被冲入海中，在大洋环流里安家。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are very light for their size and are able to float across vast distances with very little effort. Large flocks of them have been found washed out to sea, making their homes in ocean gyres.

entry: POKENAME常翻垃圾，被尖物刮住，外表像满身瘀伤。撞头而头痛时，训练家可以给冰袋和能咀嚼的东西帮忙。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME appear bruised and battered because they often dig through the trash and get caught on sharp objects. Whenever they have a headache after bumping their head, their Trainer can help them by giving them an ice pack and something to chew on.

entry: POKENAME会给栖地附近的居民惹麻烦，转移头痛。落单个体会结交利牙鱼群，用滑稽闹剧提供娱乐，换取保护。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME distracts from the pain of its headaches by causing havoc for those living near its habitat. A lone POKENAME will form a relationship with a school of Carvanha, gaining protection in exchange for the entertainment of its slapstick antics.

entry: POKENAME偏头痛时，会生出水质藤蔓，向四周抽打。头痛治好，藤蔓便蒸发成细雾。
author: quackquackattack
source: When POKENAME experience a migraine, they produce watery vines that lash out against their surroundings. When the migraine is cured, the vines evaporate into a fine mist.

entry: POKENAME偏头痛达到顶峰，会把水操控得像活木。液体形成树状肢体，抽打一切靠近的东西。
author: .izik
source: When its migraine peaks, POKENAME controls water like living wood. Treelike limbs form from liquid, lashing out at anything that comes near.

entry: POKENAME头痛时流着口水，疯狂跑动。痛退后，它便把脚扎进土里，睡觉恢复精力。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME start drooling and running around frantically when they suffer from headaches. Once the pain subsides, they root their feet in the soil to sleep and recover their energy.

entry: POKENAME被太多噪声刺激，就会头痛。痛得格外强烈，还会放出不和谐的叫声。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME gets a headache whenever it is overstimulated by too much noise. If the headache gets particularly intense, it releases a dissonant cry.

entry: POKENAME通常在池面游泳，蓬松翅膀吸得湿透。池塘之间飞行时，翅膀一路洒雨，沿途田地便被充分浇灌。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME is usually found in ponds swimming at the surface of the water, its fluffy wings becoming drenched as it swims around. Fields on the flight path between ponds are well-watered when POKENAME travels, its wings raining water down.

entry: POKENAME飞过沿海城镇，能在风暴形成前感知。一旦风暴将近，它就放出精神波，让附近人类头痛。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME soars above coastal towns, sensing storms before they form. When one nears, it releases psychic waves that cause headaches in nearby humans.

entry: POKENAME胆小过头，冲突刚露迹象就退缩。触角对震动极敏感，大声响会让头疼。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME is timid to a fault, shrinking away at the first sign of conflict. Its feelers are very sensitive to vibrations, so loud noises hurt its head.

entry: POKENAME头顶睡莲叶出奇能盛水。不过一装满，额外重量就会让它头痛欲裂。
author: bradlybro199
source: POKENAME's lilypad on its head holds water surprisingly well. When it is full of water, the excess weight on POKENAME's head causes it to have a splitting headache.

entry: POKENAME被认为是最亲热的宝可梦之一，总想拥抱依偎。这也对它有益，因为柔软的怀抱能舒缓头痛。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has been noted as being one of the most affectionate Pokémon around, always seeking hugs and cuddles. This is beneficial to POKENAME as well, as the soft embrace of another soothes its aching head.

entry: POKENAME带着一只大锚，太重，根本举不了多久。它终究会倒下，被锚压住，引起痛苦头痛。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME carries with it a large anchor far too heavy for it to lift for prolonged amounts of time. It inevitably collapses and gets crushed by the anchor, resulting in painful headaches.

entry: POKENAME的毒液会让人类长久偏头痛。光是擦过尖刺，就可能难受得好几天缓不过来。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's venom causes prolonged migraines in humans. Just brushing its spikes can leave someone reeling for days.

entry: POKENAME偏头痛越严重，毒就越强。这时哪怕轻轻划一下，也能让敌人长久受影响。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's toxins intensify as its migraine worsens. Even a light scratch during this time can leave long-lasting effects on its enemies.

entry: POKENAME手臂沉重、覆满尖刺，能有力敲打近敌。不过敏感神经与大脑相连，打中对手，自己必然头痛欲裂。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's arms are heavy and spine-covered, making them effective at clubbing enemies that get too close. However, sensitive nerves in its limbs connect to its brain; hitting a foe will inevitably give it a splitting headache.

entry: POKENAME沙状身体在偏头痛时，更加变化自如。战斗中能塑出复杂形状，模仿肢体或盾牌。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's sandlike body becomes more versatile during migraines. It can shape complex forms mid-fight, mimicking limbs or shields.

entry: POKENAME背上蘑菇直接连着脊柱。受损会向脑传痛，偏头痛能持续数小时，直到蘑菇愈合。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have mushrooms on their back that connect directly to their spine. The mushrooms send pain signals to their brain whenever they are damaged, causing migraines that can last for hours until the mushroom heals.

entry: POKENAME傻乎乎的，喜欢向孩子做鬼脸。开心时长颈左右晃，但晃得太猛，也可能头痛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are silly creatures that love to make faces at children. Their long necks swing from side to side whenever they are happy, though if they swing too vigorously, they may end up with a headache.

entry: POKENAME难得不偏头痛时，颈后会飘起美丽闪光的极光。目睹这一刻，被视为大吉之兆。
author: sk372
source: In the rare moments when it's not suffering a migraine, a beautiful shimmering aurora flutters behind POKENAME's neck. Witnessing this moment is considered a sign of great fortune.

entry: POKENAME会到做噩梦的人身边，帮忙把梦变得愉快。身上连着的救生圈，让它很容易被发现、抓住。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME come to people who have nightmares and help transform the dream into something pleasant. The life buoy attached to their bodies makes them easy to spot and hold onto.

entry: POKENAME漂近渔船，把自己的偏头痛辐射出去。船员看见它后，常会头痛。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME drifts near fishing boats and radiates its migraines outward. Crews often suffer headaches after seeing it.

entry: 蘑菇的重量压住POKENAME头骨，让它严重头痛。摘掉能暂时缓解，不过一周内又会长新蘑菇。
author: sk372
source: The weight of the mushroom presses on POKENAME's skull and causes it strong headaches. Removing the mushroom relieves it for a time, but a new one will grow within a week after removal.

entry: POKENAME头痛加剧，头鳞就会转蓝。这状态能放出集中的精神冲击，强得足以沉船。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME's headache worsens, its head scale turns blue. In this state, it can release focused psychic blasts strong enough to sink a ship.

entry: POKENAME鳞片松松贴着身体，一动就互相拍打、碰响。声音又大又不成调，倒霉听见的生物都会头痛。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME scales are only loosely attached to their body, flapping and clanging against one another whenever they move. The noise their scales make is loud and atonal, causing headaches in those unfortunate enough to hear them.

entry: POKENAME很容易受惊，一点声响就吓得后跳。有时逃跑会撞头，痛得厉害。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are easily frightened and will leap back in terror at the slightest noise. Sometimes they bump their heads while they try to escape, leaving them with a nasty headache.

entry: POKENAME体形强壮，自信地热切迎战。不过一头痛，立刻变胆小，跑去躲着，直到疼痛消退。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's size and strength give it confidence to take on opponents with great eagerness. Should it come down with a headache, however, it immediately turns cowardly and runs to hide until the pain subsides.

entry: POKENAME乐观，喜欢野外探索。不过莽撞冒险后，常头痛地回家，例如掉下峭壁或逃过泥石流。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are optimistic creatures that enjoy exploring out in the wild. They often return home with a headache because of their reckless adventures, such as falling from cliffs or escaping mudslides.

entry: POKENAME敏感触角接收太多信号，常剧烈头痛。为了应对，它会不眨眼地盯附近生物，空洞目光让对视者十分不安。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME suffer from frequent, intense headaches caused by their sensitive antennae receiving too many signals. To cope, they stare unblinkingly at nearby creatures, deeply disturbing anyone who meets their vacant gaze.

entry: POKENAME互撞锻炼身体，不过运动过猛，突来的疼痛也会引发头痛。为此，它们有专门区域，待在那里可望免受伤害。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME ram into each other to strengthen their bodies, but excessively vigorous exercise can cause them to develop a headache from the sudden pain. To prevent this, they have special areas where they can expect to be safe from harm.

entry: POKENAME虽然披着铠甲，一阵精神能量就能让它瑟缩。对精神攻击太敏感，见超能力属性宝可梦就怕交战。
author: quackquackattack
source: Even though POKENAME are covered in armor, all it takes for them to cower is a burst of psychic energy. Their sensitivity to psychic attacks makes them scared to engage in battle whenever they see a Psychic-type Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME把体内多余水分排成蒸汽云。有些医生会建议呼吸不适的训练家，融合出它来当加湿器。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME releases excess water in its body as clouds of vapor. Some doctors advise Trainers with breathing problems to splice this fusion and use it as a humidifier.

entry: POKENAME适合潮湿地区，蹼状翅膀很耐水。翅膀也释放小团粉尘，适当处理后能作强力止痛药。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME thrives in humid areas, as its webbed wings are highly resistant to water. Its wings also release small clouds of dust that, when properly prepared, can be used as a powerful painkiller.

entry: POKENAME从喙喷水灌溉作物。食腐生物靠得太近，它就用精神能量，引发令人虚弱的头痛。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME waters crops using blasts from its bill. If a scavenger gets too close, it uses psychic energy to trigger debilitating headaches.

entry: POKENAME吃很多甜食，因为糖能帮助专注、提供能量。太久不吃含糖食物，就会因随后的偏头痛倒下。
author: actliux
source: POKENAME eats a lot of sweets because the sugar in them helps it focus and gives it energy. If POKENAME does not eat any sugary foods for an extended period, it will collapse from the migraines that follow.

entry: POKENAME头上的香蒲是珍贵药膏原料，但潜藏精神能量，接触可能头痛。即使只磨一株，也得手法小心。
author: .izik
source: The cattails on POKENAME's head are prized in medicinal salves, but handling them can cause headaches due to latent psychic energy. A careful hand is required for grinding even a single plant.

entry: POKENAME偏头痛时，抱住睡莲叶，退到静水中。期间精神力会增强。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME clutches its lily pad during migraines, retreating to still waters. Its psychic powers grow more intense during this time.

entry: POKENAME尾焰随精神状态改变。头脑清楚专注时，火小而稳定；偏头痛时，则明亮又忽强忽弱。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The intensity of the fire that burns on POKENAME's tail varies depending on their mental state. When they are clear-headed and focused, their flame is steady and small. When they experience migraines, their flame burns bright and erratically.
