entry: POKENAME尾焰随精神状态改变。头脑清楚专注时，火小而稳定；偏头痛时，则明亮又忽强忽弱。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The intensity of the fire that burns on POKENAME's tail varies depending on their mental state. When they are clear-headed and focused, their flame is steady and small. When they experience migraines, their flame burns bright and erratically.

entry: POKENAME头痛程度不同，能从尾焰衡量。火焰越短，头痛越厉害。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME experiences headaches of varying intensity, which can be measured by the flame on its tail. The shorter the flame is, the more intense the headache.

entry: POKENAME把舌头当诱饵，骗其他宝可梦以为地鼠出土。目标靠得够近，它就释放令人衰弱的精神攻击，引起剧烈头痛。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME use their tongue as a lure, fooling other Pokémon into believing a Diglett is surfacing. When they successfully lure a Pokémon close enough, they unleash a debilitating psychic attack, causing intense headaches.

entry: POKENAME头痛时，力量会暴涨，让周围生物突然爱意涌升。有它群居的湖，是知名的情侣浪漫胜地。
author: sk372
source: When a headache strikes, POKENAME's powers surge and cause sudden spikes in amorous feelings in those around it. Lakes with POKENAME populations inhabiting it are known to be romantic retreats for couples.

entry: POKENAME笨拙易出事，持续头痛影响平衡。常能见它把头埋进地下避光，减少刺激，同时开心地在空中晃脚。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are clumsy and accident-prone, their constant headaches affecting their sense of balance. They are often found with their heads underground, hiding from the light to reduce overstimulation, waggling their feet in the air happily as they do.

entry: POKENAME在湖床下挖隧道，边挖边放精神波，常让附近生物严重偏头痛。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME tunnels beneath lakebeds, releasing psychic waves as it digs. These waves often cause severe migraines in nearby creatures.

entry: POKENAME拿喙当铲，迅速挖过软土，造出复杂隧道网。它定期探头辨方向，不过日晒太久，会严重偏头痛。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME use their beak like a shovel, rapidly digging through soft dirt to make complex tunnel networks. They periodically poke their head out at the surface to get their bearings, though prolonged sunlight exposure can cause them severe migraines.

entry: POKENAME挖隧道时，会释放令人头痛的精神波。连地面上方超过15英尺处的人，也能受影响。
author: .izik
source: While tunneling, POKENAME emits psychic waves that induce headaches. These effects can reach people standing more than 15 feet above ground.

entry: 会收集人们投进喷泉、水井与池塘的硬币。额头上的硬币靠潜藏的念力固定着。
author: staghorn
source: It collects coins that are dropped into fountains, wells, and ponds. The coin on its forehead stays attached via its latent telekinetic powers.

entry: POKENAME不太需要费心照料，因为活动太闹腾就会痛苦头痛。它大多时间打盹，蹭着照顾自己的生物。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a bit of a low-maintenance pet, as acting too rambunctiously will cause it to develop painful headaches. Instead it spends most of its time napping and nuzzling against those who care for it.

entry: 据说，POKENAME连塑造行星的力量都托得起。不过头太重，它常摔倒，几乎什么也做不了。
author: emptystory42
source: The powers of POKENAME are said to be great enough to lift the forces that forged the planet. However, it is often knocked over by the weight of its head, and is unable to do much of anything.

entry: 自融合把POKENAME的精神潜力推至极限。如今，只有用意念创造微型黑洞，才能宣泄头痛带来的疼痛。
author: sk372
source: Self-fusion has enhanced POKENAME's psychic potential to its maximum. Now the only way it can vent the pain of its headaches is to create miniature black holes with its mind.

entry: 超能力不再让它头痛，因此，性情也平和了许多。
author: mr.person__prinplup_enjoyer
source: It no longer receives headaches from its psychic powers. It is much calmer as a result.

entry: POKENAME终于摆脱持续偏头痛，可以放松、清晰思考。它喜欢看湖面倒影，深思周围世界。
author: sk372
source: Finally freed of its constant migraines, POKENAME can relax and think clearly. It enjoys gazing into its reflection on the surfaces of lakes, thinking deeply about the world around it.

entry: POKENAME很容易怒火中烧，也同样容易忘掉怒气。一头痛，它便抱头受苦，怒火随之平息。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME easily work themselves up into an angry rage but can forget that rage just as easily. Whenever a headache strikes, their rage subsides as they hold their head in pain.

entry: POKENAME喜欢让人挠蓬松鬃毛下面。挠得格外开心时，它会神奇地用精神力举起物件。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME love to get scratches under their fluffy mane. When they are particularly happy with the scratches, they can mysteriously lift objects with their psychic powers.

entry: POKENAME喜欢训练家揉肚子。记性不好，让它不停索要，不过每次的纯粹欢喜都一样。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME love to get belly rubs from their Trainer. Their forgetfulness leads them to constantly demand belly rubs, and the sheer glee they experience remains the same each time.

entry: POKENAME白天大多泡在池塘，只露眼睛和鸭嘴。受惊便大声嘎嘎叫，喙里同时喷出火。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME spend most of their day submerged within ponds, only their eyes and duck bill above the water. When startled, they give out a loud quacking noise, accompanied by a burst of fire from their beak.

entry: POKENAME身体太干，就会痛苦头痛，因此常在河塘边保持湿润。燃烧的尾巴却会慢慢烘干身体，迫使它每天多次游水。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are prone to debilitating headaches if their bodies dry out too much, and are often found around rivers and ponds so they can keep themselves damp. Their burning tail gradually dries them out, forcing them to swim multiple times per day.

entry: POKENAME能飞得很高，却常不愿意，因为升高太快带来的气压差，会让它严重头痛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are capable of flying high in the sky, but often refuse to do so. This is because they are sensitive to the air pressure difference that occurs when they rise in altitude too quickly, which gives them a nasty headache.

entry: POKENAME待在泥塘边，把圆身体浸入凉水，在泥里玩。紧张或兴奋时，尾巴会合拍地敲地。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME hangs around muddy ponds, soaking its round body in the cool water and playing in the grime. It rhythmically slaps its tail against the ground when nervous or excited.

entry: POKENAME圆滚滚的身体、单纯性格和傻气慢步，让爱好者觉得可爱。有些动物园开始用它的形象作吉祥物，吸引孩子。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME fans find it endearing for its rotund body, simple disposition and goofy plodding gait. Some zoos are starting to use POKENAME iconography to make it something of a mascot to appeal to children.

entry: POKENAME是许多孩子喜爱的身影，也是许多动物园的吉祥物。它摇摆着从展区走到展区，确保圈养宝可梦玩得开心。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are a beloved sight for many children and can be found as a mascot for many zoos. They can be seen waddling from exhibit to exhibit to ensure the Pokémon in captivity are having fun.

entry: 它们把头痛化成精神能量，用于漂浮。途中若有东西撞上，就会先爆发一阵精神能量，再落回地面。
author: quackquackattack
source: They channel the pain from their headaches into psychic energy, which they use to float around. If anything bumps into them while they are floating, a surge of psychic energy is released before they fall to the ground.

entry: POKENAME的精神力与头痛强度相连，能借此使用念力。自己办得到这么多事，连它都困惑。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME possesses psychic powers that are connected to the intensity of its headaches, which enable it to use telekinesis. It baffles itself with how much it can do.

entry: POKENAME用念力举大石，再以拳击碎，作为训练。这些练习常让精神力使用过度，之后严重头痛。
author: sk372
source: It uses telekinesis to lift up large boulders to smash with its fists as a form of training. POKENAME often overexerts its psychic powers during these regimens, leading to nasty headaches afterward.

entry: POKENAME外表健壮，却根本不会游泳。再努力也只会在水中乱扑，直到到岸，或昏倒。
author: mistymagius
source: Despite its athletic appearance, POKENAME doesn't actually know how to swim. No matter how hard it tries, it will always end up flailing around in the water until it either reaches shore or passes out.

entry: POKENAME虽有好几条手臂战斗，却喜欢头锤对手，也常因脑震荡头痛。
author: quackquackattack
source: Even though POKENAME have several arms to fight with, they enjoy giving headbutts to their opponents. They often develop headaches from the concussions they get.

entry: POKENAME连出快拳打敌，却很少保护脆弱的头。对手一击中头部，它便痛到无法继续战斗。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME launch a flurry of punches to defeat their foes, but they rarely protect their fragile heads. If opponents manage to land a strike against their heads, they develop searing headaches that render them unable to battle.

entry: 有什么擦过脆弱身体，头痛便会让它鼓起的头更加膨胀。肿胀限制水分供应，它会从根吸收养分，让头缩回。
author: quackquackattack
source: When something grazes its fragile body, its bulbous head will swell from the resulting headache. Nutrients from its roots are absorbed to shrink the head, as the swelling constricts the supply of water to itself.

entry: POKENAME平时迟钝温和，却会极其痛苦地头痛，可能突然啄咬附近的生物。
author: bobosmith01
source: While generally dim-witted and agreeable, POKENAME can have extremely painful headaches. It may lash out and peck or bite those nearby.

entry: POKENAME在海中飞快游动，始终怕被吃，可它的毒对多数捕食者都太强。毒液能治疗重度偏头痛、减轻焦虑，不过必须先小心提取、去除毒性。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME jets around the ocean in constant fear of being eaten, but its toxicity is too strong for most predators. Its venom can be used to treat severe migraines and aid in lessening anxiety, but must be carefully extracted and nullified first.

entry: POKENAME永远焦虑，只任洋流无方向地带走。头痛若强得过头，它便放出令人衰弱的精神波，造成麻痹。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME lives in a perpetual state of anxiety, simply allowing itself to be carried directionlessly by ocean currents. If its headache intensifies too much, POKENAME unleashes debilitating psychic waves which lead to paralysis.

entry: POKENAME身体贴地，本就严重头痛，保育人士因此提醒训练家别踩到。若不听，它就会本能地释放一连串精神攻击。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Since POKENAME are low to the ground, conservationists warn Trainers to be careful not to step on them, as they already suffer from intense headaches. POKENAME will reflexively unleash a psychic barrage when Trainers fail to heed these warnings.

entry: POKENAME先用水喷岩石，再用手击碎软化的矿物。有时外形太像石头，会被踢中头，疼得难受。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME sprays rocks with water before breaking the softened minerals with their hands. Sometimes they are kicked on the head because of their vague resemblance to a rock, which gives them headaches.

entry: POKENAME把大岩石泡水，软到能弄碎后，就大口吞吃富含矿物的石头。吃太饱，还可能嗝出泥。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME break up large rocks by soaking them in water. Once they are soft enough to break, POKENAME stuff their face with the mineral-rich rocks and may burp out mud if they are too full.

entry: POKENAME容易受惊，刺激太多就会跑撞栅栏和门。之后，它顺从地低头贴地，表示为自己行为羞愧。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are easy to spook and will run into fences and gates whenever they are overstimulated. Afterwards, they submissively hold their heads low to the ground to show that they are ashamed of their actions.

entry: POKENAME刺激过度，就无方向地横冲直撞，碰倒沿途一切。之后再羞愧躲着，直到混乱平息。
author: jaminmcready
source: When overstimulated, POKENAME dashes amok without direction, knocking over anything in its path. Afterward, it hides in embarrassment until the chaos settles.

entry: 有人以为POKENAME不太聪明，是脑力全用在精神能力上。不过，多数人同意，它只是没那么聪明。
author: mistymagius
source: Some people think that the reason why POKENAME isn't so bright is that it is using all of its brainpower on its psychic abilities. However, most people agree that it is just not that smart.

entry: POKENAME羽毛格外柔软，吃植物和鱼宝可梦，尤其喜欢刚出生的蚊香蝌蚪。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's feathers are exceptionally soft. Its diet consists of vegetation and fish Pokémon. It especially loves to eat newborn Poliwag.

entry: POKENAME头痛越重，尾上大舌贝咬得越紧。奇怪的是，这反而分散痛感，帮它恢复一点专注。
author: .izik
source: As POKENAME's headache worsens, the Shellder on its tail bites harder. Oddly, this distracts it from the pain and helps it regain some focus.

entry: POKENAME在水下同步舞动，一偏离舞步就会冒火花。多数人都不打扰，免得被电。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME dance in synchronized patterns when they are underwater and produce sparks whenever they deviate from the dance. Most people leave them alone to avoid getting shocked by them.

entry: POKENAME以数学规律同步起舞。谁想把它拉离舞蹈，就会挨电、被推开。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME perform synchronized dances that follow a mathematical pattern. Whenever a Pokémon tries to pull them away from the dance, they get zapped and pushed away.

entry: POKENAME把不断头痛产生的精神能量，储存在大葱棒里。蓄满后，就能把剧烈头痛传给敌人。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME stores psychic energy in its leek baton, fueled by the many headaches it endures. Once full of psionic energy, it can transfer powerful headaches into foes.

entry: POKENAME有多个头共用身体，却常忘了自己仍连为一体。对此的反应，从默默发愣到惊慌失措都有。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are comprised of multiple heads that share a body. They often forget that they share a head and have reactions ranging from a silent stare to utter panic.

entry: POKENAME很会在喙上平衡物件，因此小孩子爱陪它玩。不过水太冷，它就会痛苦头痛。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is quite good at balancing things on its bill, which is why younger children love to play with this Pokémon. If the water it lives in gets too cold, it will get a painful headache.

entry: 它住在污水处理设施，靠近污泥和危险化学物。身体虽是黏胶，空气里各种毒气仍会让它头痛。
author: quackquackattack
source: It lives at water treatment facilities near sludge and hazardous chemicals. Despite its gooey composition, it gets headaches from the myriad of noxious fumes in the air.

entry: POKENAME想靠吃东西压住剧烈头痛。可惜它爱吃垃圾，头痛恰恰来自自己的臭味。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME tries to block out its overpowering headaches by eating. Unfortunately, because it loves to eat garbage, the headaches are caused by its own stench.

entry: POKENAME受惊，便迅速缩回，合起硬壳防御。有时关得太快，喙还没收好就夹住了，引起轻微头痛。
author: sk372
source: When frightened, POKENAME quickly retracts and snaps its hardened shell shut for defense. Sometimes it closes so fast it snaps down on its bill before it fully retracts, causing mild headaches.

entry: POKENAME对四周彻底摸不着头脑，不知在哪、怎么来的，只知道自己什么都碰不到。所有碰到的东西，似乎都会穿过身体。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME is utterly baffled by its surroundings. It does not know where it is or how it got there, but it knows that it cannot touch anything. Anything it touches seems to phase through it.

entry: 它虽形体缥缈，却毫无空间感，完全不明白为什么无法与实体世界互动。
author: mistymagius
source: Despite its ethereal form, it has no spatial awareness. It is completely befuddled as to why it can't seem to interact with the physical world.

entry: POKENAME真会怕自己的影子，影子突然一动，就可能让它猛攻。持续恐惧带来的压力，使它常头痛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are quite literally scared of their own shadow, and any sudden movement from it can cause POKENAME to lash out. They suffer many stress-induced headaches because of this constant fear.

entry: POKENAME高傲，环境合标准才肯休息。最好别给咖啡，因为它很容易迷上，之后每天都会向训练家索要。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are haughty creatures, only resting if their environment is up to their standards. Trainers of POKENAME are advised to not give it coffee, as they become easily obsessed, and will demand it every day from their Trainers.

entry: POKENAME释放催眠波，让其他宝可梦睡觉，可同样的波也可能反弹。它能试着抵抗自己的催眠，不过会因此头痛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME release hypnotic waves that lull other Pokémon to sleep, but those same waves can bounce back at them. POKENAME can try to resist falling asleep to their own psychic waves, but this causes them to experience headaches.

entry: POKENAME平稳规律地摇动橡皮鸭摆锤，哄人入睡。它挑梦吃得很小心，因为噩梦会引发头痛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME swing a pendulum of a rubber duck in a smooth, fixed motion that lulls people to sleep. They are careful with the types of dreams they eat, as eating nightmares causes headaches.

entry: POKENAME没有合适的爪，只好到处挖湿沙泥土，翻找小生物吃。它定期泡水，陆上太干待久了，会痛苦偏头痛。
author: sk372
source: Lacking proper claws, POKENAME goes around digging up wet sand and dirt to uncover small creatures to snack on. It submerges itself in water regularly, as being on dry land too long gives it painful migraines.

entry: POKENAME体内不断生成泡泡，定期从嘴吹出。憋太久，压力会造成头痛，它便爆发一股泡沫光线，释放压力。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's body constantly generates bubbles within, blowing them out its mouth periodically. Going too long without release causes a painful tension headache, resulting in an explosive Bubblebeam to relieve the pressure.

entry: POKENAME吃河湖里丰富的莲叶童子等水生植物宝可梦。吃太多就会头痛，从水炮口喷出水。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME eats Lotad and other aquatic plant Pokémon, which are plentiful in ponds and lakes. Whenever it eats too much, it experiences a headache that causes it to spray water from its water cannons.

entry: POKENAME每条藤蔓末端都有香蒲，住在沼泽，轻松融入当地植物。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME's vines have a cattail plant at the end of each one. They live in swamps where they can easily blend in with the local flora.

entry: POKENAME背上的一对芦苇，能吸收阳光转成能量。额上宝石开始发光，就代表即将使出强劲的水流攻击。
author: fiordaliso
source: The pair of reeds emerging from its back allows POKENAME to absorb sunlight and convert it into energy. The gem on its forehead begins to glow when it is about to launch powerful water attacks.

entry: POKENAME会找一根结实棍子使用，既用于战斗，也帮助在急流游泳时稳住身体。
author: curazy
source: POKENAME will find and wield a sturdy stick. It usies it both for battle and to steady itself while swimming through strong currents.

entry: POKENAME天生亲水，却没有鳍，游不快。它吃大量藻类，性情友善，是家中水缸的实用宠物。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a natural affinity for swimming but cannot swim quickly because they lack flippers. They eat lots of algae and are quite friendly, which makes them useful pets for home aquariums.

entry: POKENAME靠舵状尾巴游过水中，不溅水花。许多个体藏在水面下，免得被飞行属性宝可梦发现。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME rely on their rudder-like tail to swim through the water without causing any splashes. Many hide beneath the water's surface to avoid being spotted by Flying-type Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME善良，会帮其他宝可梦护蛋。高超泳技让它能把蛋运过水域，一点也不沾湿。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are kind creatures that help other Pokémon keep eggs safe. Their superb swimming ability allows them to ferry their egg across bodies of water without getting it wet.

entry: POKENAME泳技出色，能轻松赶到挣扎溺水的宝可梦身边。它也给可达鸭点心、提醒休息，帮许多个体缓解头痛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are excellent swimmers that can easily reach drowning Pokémon when struggling to swim. They also help many Psyduck recover from headaches by giving them snacks and reminding them to rest.

entry: POKENAME身体小，海里游得费力，很容易被水流卷走。它会抓紧海草，避免迷失外海。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME struggle to swim in the sea with their tiny bodies and are easily swept away by a water current. They cling onto seaweed to prevent themselves from being lost at open sea.

entry: POKENAME有脚蹼和鳍，水下控身极佳，能避开捕食者的牙爪。宝石红的角较脆，通常作为最后手段。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have flippers and fins that give them superb control of their bodies underwater, which helps them dodge fangs or claws from predators. Their ruby-red horn is often a last resort tool since it is quite fragile.

entry: POKENAME的闪亮大翅常引来捕食者，也使它们容易受到精神攻击。捕食者盯翼太久，就会被哄睡，让它趁机逃走。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have large sparkling wings that often get the attention of predators but also makes them susceptible to psychic attacks. If a predator stares at their wings for too long, they are lulled asleep, allowing POKENAME to escape.

entry: POKENAME喜欢耀眼表演，控水创造彩虹和泡泡拱门。艺人很爱请它，在生日派对上逗孩子开心。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME enjoy putting on dazzling performances, using their control over water to create rainbows and bubble arches. They are popular with entertainers, commonly being used at birthday parties to delight the children present.

entry: POKENAME伏在浑浊湖塘水面下，等候毫无防备的宝可梦。它用巨钳把目标拖入水下，轻松捕食。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Lurking under the surface of murky lakes and ponds, POKENAME lies in wait to ambush unsuspecting Pokémon. It uses its gigantic pincers to drag its targets underwater, making them easy prey.

entry: POKENAME伏在浑浊湖塘水面下，等候毫无防备的宝可梦。它用巨钳把目标拖入水下，轻松捕食。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Lurking under the surface of murky lakes and ponds, POKENAME lies in wait to ambush unsuspecting Pokémon. It uses its gigantic pincers to drag its targets underwater, making them easy prey.

entry: POKENAME用大喙把藻类舀进嘴里。秋天，能见它跳上瀑布，前往湖泊。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a large bill that scoops algae into their mouths. During fall, they can be seen hopping up waterfalls to reach lakes.

entry: POKENAME翅膀上两枚红点，动用精神力时会发光。它常催眠捕食者，让对方睡着，自己逃走。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have two red dots in their wings that glow whenever they harness their psychic powers. They often hypnotize predators into falling asleep to allow themselves to escape.

entry: POKENAME帮助度假村救生员，保护人免于溺水。它监视深水区，确保泳客安全。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME helps lifeguards at resorts protect people from drowning. It monitors deep water to ensure that swimmers remain safe.

entry: POKENAME有特殊毛层，即使水下仍蓬松。许多个体渴望进化，常在野外寻找进化石。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a special layer of fur that remains fluffy even when underwater. They often roam around the wilderness looking for evolution stones, as many are eager to evolve.

entry: POKENAME泳速极快，几秒就能横渡湖泊。带蹼的尾巴和鳍，让它毫不费力地在水中不停滑行。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are incredibly fast swimmers that can cross lakes in a few seconds. Their webbed tail and flippers allow them to effortlessly glide through water without stopping.

entry: POKENAME游到哪里，都会留下一道火花。追赶的捕食者很难避开，因此火花能保护它。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME leave a trail of sparks wherever they swim. These sparks protect them from predators, who have a difficult time avoiding the sparks while chasing them.

entry: POKENAME能产生水下也能燃烧的特殊火焰。它拿来烤海草，吃起来更酥脆满足。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can produce special flames that can burn while underwater. They use these flames to roast seaweed, which adds a satisfying crunch for them to consume.

entry: POKENAME浮在湖面，长时间望天，直到进化。茧十分滑溜，难以抓住，许多捕食者因此无法把它带走。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME float atop lakes where they stare at the sky for long periods of time until they evolve. Their slippery cocoon is difficult to grab onto and prevents many potential predators from carrying them away.

entry: POKENAME用利爪扣住大型宝可梦，搭便车前往新觅食区。流线外壳让它紧贴宿主，却不明显拖慢泳速。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME use their sharp claws to latch onto larger Pokémon, hitching rides on them to fresh feeding grounds. Their shell is streamlined, allowing them to remain attached without significantly slowing their host's swimming speed.

entry: POKENAME无论空中还是海里，都能劈斩目标，翼间蹼膜在水下也当鳍用。它几乎一直移动，因为无聊就会焦躁。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are capable of slicing through targets both in the air and at sea, as the webbing between their wings also acts as flippers while underwater. They are almost always moving since they tend to get restless if they are bored.

entry: POKENAME尝试穿越铁路后，常在交汇处睡着。人们提出许多办法避免，例如搬到类似原生环境的湖泊。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME often fall asleep at junctions after an attempt to cross railroads. Many solutions have been proposed to help prevent these instances, including relocating POKENAME to a lake that resembles their natural habitat.

entry: POKENAME既是空中高手，也是优秀泳者。不过翅膀流出的水，滚烫伤人。
author: opossiblymage
source: POKENAME is both an aerial ace and an excellent swimmer. The water that flows from its wings is scalding.

entry: POKENAME用剧毒尖刺精准攻击，击倒猎物。它需大量水保持湿润，因此常在河塘边筑巢。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME brings down prey with precise strikes from its extremely venomous stingers. It tends to nest near ponds and lakes, since it needs plenty of water to stay hydrated.

entry: POKENAME不合群，倾向远离其他生物。不过它对可达鸭心软，遇见就会用庞大精神力，缓解困扰它们的头痛。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is antisocial, tending towards keeping itself far from other creatures. It has a soft spot for Psyduck, however, using its vast mental abilities to alleviate the headaches that plague them when it comes across them.

entry: POKENAME远游大海，被游轮上玩乐的人吸引。有时会飞下加入有趣游戏，游戏一结束，就在蒸汽云中消失。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME travels over vast seas, drawn to humans having fun on cruise ships. It will occasionally fly down and attempt to join in games it finds appealing, vanishing in a vapor cloud the moment the game ends.

entry: POKENAME暴怒时，额上红宝石会泛起令人不安的光。它刺扎猎物使其麻痹，再拖入湖底。
author: fiordaliso
source: When POKENAME flies into a rage, the red gem on its forehead begins to glow with an unsettling light. It stings its prey to paralyze them, then drags them down to the bottom of a lake.

entry: POKENAME在深湖、河边筑巢，当地猎物最丰富。准备从喙喷出强劲水柱时，额上宝石会强烈发光，展现全部力量。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME builds its nest near deep lakes and rivers, where its prey is most abundant. When it prepares to unleash a burst of water from its beak, the gem on its forehead shines intensely, revealing its full power.

entry: POKENAME是晨昏活动的宝可梦，在黎明、黄昏最活跃。它用带蹼利爪抓湖里昏沉的鱼宝可梦。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are crepuscular Pokémon that are most active during dawn and dusk. They hunt groggy fish Pokémon in lakes by grabbing them with their webbed talons.

entry: POKENAME速度极快，在海空间精准穿行。它们常结群，从一片森林迁往另一片，抢在树果刚熟时摘下。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are incredibly fast creatures that buzz through both the sea and air with precision. They often gather in groups and migrate from forest to forest so that they can grab berries as soon as they ripen.

entry: POKENAME视力完美，极远处也能发现水下隐藏猎物。只需一拍翼便潜水，展现无匹泳技，继续在水下追猎。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME can spot hidden prey underwater from incredible distances thanks to its flawless eyesight. With a single beat of its wings, it can dive in and demonstrate its unmatched swimming prowess, continuing the hunt below the surface.

entry: POKENAME住在漆黑深海，用两盏鲜红灯泡吸引水生宝可梦。若弄裂一盏，就会不断放电，直到愈合。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME live in the dark depths of the sea where they lure aquatic Pokémon towards themselves with two bright red bulbs. If they manage to crack one of their bulbs, they release a jolt of electricity until healed.

entry: POKENAME用两盏鲜红灯泡引来水生宝可梦。红光会让某些个体凶暴，因此它先电击攻击者，再游走自保。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME draw aquatic Pokémon towards themselves with two bright red bulbs. The red glow that is produced can cause some Pokémon to act aggressively, so they protect themselves by zapping the aggressor before swimming away.

entry: POKENAME能预见未来，很早就预测天气。额上宝石发光，便是在与同族心灵感应。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME can predict the weather far in advance thanks to its ability to see into the future. When the jewel on its forehead glows, it is telepathically communicating with its kin.

entry: POKENAME只需迅速拍动强翼，就能召出危险水龙卷。它每年迁徙一次，连飞数日不休息，直到找到新湖安家。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME can summon dangerous waterspouts simply by rapidly flapping its mighty wings. It migrates once a year, flying for days without rest until it discovers a new lake to call home.

entry: POKENAME摇尾时，会短暂显现精神能力。透视感知敌人位置后，尾上宝石亮起，它便使出电击。
author: pattybgoode
source: POKENAME has transient psychic abilities that appear when it wags its tail. After clairvoyantly locating an enemy, the gem on its tail glows bright as it delivers a Thunder Shock.

entry: POKENAME有保护自然、人和宝可梦的特殊习惯，抵御野生融合宝可梦有时引发的混乱。由于分布广、精神力强，有人相信所有个体都能彼此交流。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME take up an unusual habit of protecting nature, people, and Pokémon from the sometimes-chaotic nature of wild fused Pokémon. With their widespread population and psychic powers, some believe all POKENAME can communicate with one another.

entry: POKENAME能用鳃增强精神力。不过持续太久会过强，它便给鳃涂泥，减弱信号。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME is able to use psychic powers, using its gills to amplify them. However, this can become too intense if sustained, so it coats its gills in mud to dampen the signal.

entry: POKENAME以层层脂肪为傲，气色最佳的个体会成为族群首领。天性温顺，喜欢拥抱。
author: megaban
source: POKENAME's layers of fat are its pride. The most optimal complexion decides the pack's leader. POKENAME are docile in nature and like hugs.

entry: POKENAME生活在沼泽，背上香蒲完美融入环境。它对水的动静敏感，很难被偷袭。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME live in swamps where the cattails on their back blend in perfectly with their environment. They are sensitive to the motion of the swampy water, which makes them difficult to sneak up on.

entry: POKENAME巡逻水下遗迹，守护古代秘密。若在深处发现训练家，就会大声嘎嘎叫，召来其他宝可梦。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME patrol underwater ruins to keep ancient secrets safe. When they find a Trainer within the depths, they release a loud quack that summons other Pokémon.

entry: 战斗中，POKENAME耐心等对手先出招。一察觉来袭，便迅速张嘴，放出震耳欲聋、充满挑衅的鸣叫。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME wait patiently during battle for their opponent to make the first move. They react quickly when they sense an attack coming at them, opening their beaks and shouting out a deafening, defiant honk.

entry: POKENAME尾上宝石发光诱猎。目标靠近，它迅速吸入，胀大身体，把小型宝可梦直接拖进嘴里。
author: mepp.
source: The gem on POKENAME's tail glows to attract prey. Once they draw near, POKENAME quickly sucks in to inflate itself, dragging small Pokémon right into its mouth.

entry: POKENAME总带着一本硬皮书，常翻看，也会拿来打惹烦自己的生物。据说，它的智慧远超最聪明的人。
author: actliux
source: POKENAME always carries around a hard-covered book that it often reads from, and will use it to strike anyone who annoys it. The intelligence of this Pokémon is said to far surpass that of even the smartest human.

entry: POKENAME用精神力时，壳上宝石会泛美丽深红光。它先以念力举起河中猎物，再喷滚水制服。
author: .izik
source: The gem on POKENAME's shell glows a beautiful crimson when it uses its psychic abilities. It uses telekinesis to lift prey from rivers before spitting boiling water at them to subdue them.

entry: POKENAME把周围的水加热成翻涌蒸汽，游过其中更轻松。群体将近时，蒸汽云会先飘到岸边，因此许多传说赋予它神秘力量。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME heat the water around them into a roiling steam, making it easier for them to swim through it. The approach of a pack of POKENAME is heralded by steam banks drifting to shore, leading to many legends ascribing them mystical powers.

entry: POKENAME胸前发光花纹，能定住凝视的宝可梦。猎物动不了，它就以长尾抓住，再用喙整个吞下。
author: .jerden
source: The glowing markings on its chest have the ability to transfix Pokémon that look at them. Once prey is immobilized, POKENAME will seize it with its long tail and then swallow it whole with its beak.

entry: POKENAME如闪电般破水，潜入猎鱼，再跃上陆地，奔过地区。只有雷暴时才慢下来，安静享受雨水。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME cuts through the water at lightning speeds, diving within to hunt fish before breaching onto land and racing across the region. It only slows down during thunderstorms, where it calmly basks in the rainfall.

entry: POKENAME住在高山，寻找山泉放松。体温极高，进哪处泉水，都会迅速加热，变得适合泡浴。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME live high up in mountains and spend their time seeking out mountain springs to relax in. Their bodies run at very high temperatures meaning any spring they climb into quickly heats up and becomes pleasant to bathe in.

entry: POKENAME庞大沉重，会直沉海底。它却常努力训练，每天奋力游回水面。
author: baz2600
source: Due to its sheer size and weight it sinks to the bottom of the ocean. However POKENAME will often train strenuously by swimming to the surface every day.

entry: POKENAME争先赶向池塘访客，都盼第一个获喂新鲜树果。它很执着，能跟人绕公园好几个小时，直到失去兴趣。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME race one another to be the first to reach visitors to their pond, each hoping to be the first to be fed fresh berries. They are persistent, following people for hours around the park until they eventually lose interest.

entry: 它不断从爪间蹼膜产冰，再在双手间压成极坚硬的冰球，砸向不受欢迎的领地入侵者。
author: sk372
source: From the webbing between its claws, it produces ice constantly. It can pack this ice between its hands into extremely solid ice balls it will use to pelt unwelcome intruders in its territory.

entry: POKENAME长出的叶片会拖慢游泳，因此常让其他宝可梦拿叶子当点心，好游快些。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME produce leaves that slow down their bodies when swimming. They often let other Pokémon snack on the leaves so that they can swim faster.

entry: POKENAME用叶片吸收阳光，获得生存所需养分。攒够后，就让其他宝可梦吃叶，游泳不再受累。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME absorb sunlight through their leaves to gain necessary nutrients for survival. Once they have enough nutrients, they allow other Pokémon to eat their leaves so that they can swim unencumbered.

entry: POKENAME滑过冰湖家园，脚下结出光滑霜痕。捕猎时，动作优雅无声。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME glides across its icy lake home, forming slick trails of frost beneath its feet. Its movements are elegant and silent as it hunts for prey.

entry: POKENAME动用精神力，额头和背上的宝石便会闪烁。它轻松穿游丛林河道，轻易躲开捕食者。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: When using its psychic powers, the gems on POKENAME's forehead and back shimmer. It swims effortlessly through the jungle's rivers, easily escaping predators.

entry: POKENAME寻找湿地定居，照料当地宝可梦。它倾听请求和忧虑，尽力帮忙。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME looks for wetlands to settle in, acting as a caretaker for the Pokémon living in the local environment. It listens to the local Pokémon's requests and concerns, doing anything in its power to help.

entry: POKENAME漂过静湖，寻找岸边访客。靠近时宝石发光，传递同理与关爱，希望对方扔食物。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME drift across the surface of still lakes, searching for visitors along the shoreline. Their gems glow as they approach, projecting feelings of empathy and care in the hopes that the person they approach will toss them food.

entry: POKENAME漂过静湖，寻找岸边访客。一看见人，就嘎嘎互告，聚到访客面前伸手，盼获食物。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME drift across the surface of still lakes, searching for visitors along the shoreline. They honk to one another when they spot a person, converging on the visitor before holding out their hands in the hopes of being gifted food.

entry: POKENAME对战时喷射穿水，劈斩对手。它始终光明磊落，拒绝靠卑鄙手段取胜。
author: quackquackattack
source: During a Pokémon battle, POKENAME jet through the water to slice up their opponents. They always fight with honor and dignity, refusing to resort to underhanded tactics to achieve victory.

entry: POKENAME在湖边以小家庭生活，轮流放哨，其他成员则喝水进食。危险来时，鸣叫警告，大家便迅速钻水避险。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME live in small family groups along the edges of lakes. They take turns keeping watch while the rest of the family drinks or feeds, honking out an alarm call for everyone to scurry into the water to safety should danger arise.

entry: POKENAME潜海撕开渔网，抓逃出的水生宝可梦。传统绳网破坏太多，许多渔夫已换更坚韧的网。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME dive into the sea to tear open fishing nets and grab onto whatever aquatic Pokémon that escape. Many fishermen have upgraded to tougher fishing nets because of the damage POKENAME cause to traditional rope nets.

entry: POKENAME轻松切开渔网，放出困着的水生宝可梦。不过它吃掉了本该被网住的水生宝可梦，因此惹怒各地渔夫。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME effortlessly slice through fishing nets to release the aquatic Pokémon trapped inside. They have earned the ire of fishermen everywhere for eating the aquatic Pokémon that were supposed to be trapped in nets.

entry: POKENAME潜伏渔夫常去的地方，方便吃水属性宝可梦。它趁机偷鱼，常与气愤的渔夫冲突。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME stalk places fishermen frequent to get easy access to Water-type Pokémon to eat. These opportunistic creatures often clash with fishermen who are angry with POKENAME for stealing their fish.

entry: POKENAME泳速出奇快，沿途留下花粉。其他植物吸收后，会让部分沼泽对食草者变得毒性很强。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are surprisingly fast swimmers that leave a trail of pollen wherever they go. The pollen gets absorbed into other plants, which end up making sections of the swamp quite toxic to herbivores.

entry: POKENAME守护泳区，谁与自己体形相当，还敢下水，它就猛冲过去。先凶狠鸣叫，吓不走，就用毒刺攻击。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are protective of their swimming grounds, barrelling toward any Pokémon that's as large as them that dares to enter the water. They honk aggressively, lashing out with venomous spines if they can't scare away the target of their ire.

entry: POKENAME生活在湖岸。坚韧的外骨骼、锋利的爪子与强壮的尾巴，让它轻松捕猎、自卫。
author: the_fireplace
source: POKENAME lives on the shores of lakes. Its tough exoskeleton, sharp claws, and strong tail allow it to easily hunt for prey and defend itself.

entry: 常能看见POKENAME在湖中游泳。会用念力与巨爪惩罚污染家园的家伙。
author: the_fireplace
source: POKENAME is often seen swimming in lakes. It uses its telekinetic powers and enormous claws to punish those who pollute its home.

entry: POKENAME头顶的大红圆顶，能吸收头锤的冲击。据说一旦开裂，就会放出一阵精神能量。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a large red dome atop their heads that absorbs the shock from their headbutts. It is said that if it ever cracks, a wave of psychic energy is released.

entry: POKENAME大部分时间抱钓竿睡觉。常钓上可达鸭，再扔回水里。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME spend much of their time sleeping while holding onto their fishing rod. They often reel in Psyduck, which they toss back into the water.

entry: POKENAME用干芦苇和泥编巢，藏在湖岸。它拼命护蛋，冲向其他宝可梦时，宝石般的角会闪出鲜红光。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME weave nests made of dried out reeds and mud, hiding them along the banks of lakes. They are fiercely protective of their eggs, their gem-like horn shining bright red whenever they charge another Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME乘浪来到海岸，警告居民洪水将至。它迅速游向海上渔夫，帮其赶在灾难前回岸。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME arrive on coastlines atop a wave to warn residents of upcoming floods. They swiftly swim to fishermen at sea to help them reach shore before calamity strikes.

entry: POKENAME高速滑过水面追猎。水在身边沸腾，海面留下一道蒸汽轨迹。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME slides across the water's surface at high speeds to chase down prey. The water boils as it passes, leaving a steaming trail across the ocean's surface.

entry: POKENAME通过两侧石头，传导奇异的超自然力量。虽然能在水下找到，却无法靠寻常方式游泳。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME channels odd supernatural powers through the stones at its sides. Although it may be found underwater, it cannot swim through conventional means.

entry: POKENAME通过两侧石头，传导奇异的超自然力量。虽然能在水下找到，却无法靠寻常方式游泳。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME channels odd supernatural powers through the stones at its sides. Although it may be found underwater, it cannot swim through conventional means.

entry: POKENAME以X射线视觉发现隐藏猎物，额上宝石便发红光。它利用栖居的水域，增强毁灭性的电击。
author: fiordaliso
source: When POKENAME spots hidden prey using its X-ray vision, the gem on its forehead glows with a red light. It uses the aquatic environments where it lives to amplify the power of its devastating electric attacks.

entry: 星形尾巴发光，就代表强大的电击将至。这种POKENAME变体通常住在关都河边，因此在当地较容易发现。
author: fiordaliso
source: When its star-shaped tail glows, it means it's about to unleash a devastating electric attack. This variant of POKENAME usually makes its home along the rivers of Kanto, which is why it's easier to spot in that region.

entry: POKENAME泳技绝佳，能极快破水。它专挑大型生物打架，只为闪避攻击，磨炼灵活度。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a marvelous swimmer, cutting through the water at an extremely rapid speed. It picks fights with larger creatures just to evade their strikes and keep its maneuverability honed.

entry: POKENAME靠带蹼的脚掌游泳，在栖息的湖泊与缓流河中优雅穿行。
author: melodydelune
source: POKENAME uses its webbed paws to swim gracefully around the lakes and slow-moving rivers that make up its habitat.

entry: POKENAME的鸣叫回荡整座湖，宣告水域归自己。若两只都想占同一湖，就会互施猛烈身体撞击，争夺霸权。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME honks echo across entire lakes, alerting all those that can hear them that the waters are claimed as their own. When two POKENAME try to claim the same lake, they end up battling for supremacy, exchanging brutal body blows.

entry: POKENAME泳速超过水上摩托。追猎时，炮口快速喷水，能击晕目标，防止逃脱。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME swims through the water at speeds exceeding that of a jet ski. When pursuing prey, quick shots of water from its cannon help it knock them out so they can't escape from it.

entry: 画作中的传说身影，被描绘为世界各地最洁净湖泊的守护者。若从水下家园浮上来，它便用尾巴发射蒸汽，轰击入侵者。
author: sk372
source: A legendary figure depicted in some paintings as the guardian of the most pristine lakes across the world. Should it surface from its home beneath the waters, it will blast intruders with blasts of steam shot from its tail.

entry: 夜里，POKENAME游出星座般的图案。它极重细节，总精确遵循复杂路线。
author: quackquackattack
source: At night, POKENAME swim in patterns that resemble constellations. These complex patterns are always followed with high precision, as POKENAME are incredibly detail-oriented.

entry: POKENAME羽毛防水，能优雅高速游泳，出水时几乎全身干爽。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's plumage is water-repellent, allowing it to swim gracefully at high speeds and emerge from the water almost completely dry.

entry: POKENAME能潜入水中。双眼清楚看见水上水下，双翼也演化成了极佳的鳍。
author: sonic3knuckles
source: POKENAME are capable of submerging their bodies underwater. Their eyes allow them to see above and under the surface rather clearly, and their wings are adapted to serve perfectly as fins.

entry: 它们游过湿地，探水吃植物，尾巴始终露在水面。大型捕食者威胁时，POKENAME便从尾巴放热，点燃沼气，爆出烈焰。
author: hophoppip
source: They swim across wetlands, dabbling to feed on water plants while keeping their tails above the surface. If threatened by a large predator, POKENAME releases heat from its tails to ignite marsh gases and create a burst of flame.

entry: POKENAME好奇地用绑在伪装上的冰淇淋甜筒探查叶堆、检测水质。陌生者靠太近，伪装里的红宝石就会射出激光笔般的小光束。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME curiously poke around using the ice cream cones tied around their disguises to investigate piles of leaves and check water quality. If a stranger gets too close, the red gems in their disguise will shine a small beam like a laser pointer.

entry: 流星雨之夜，能见POKENAME优雅游过静静的河湖。据说头顶宝石藏着宇宙能量，能映出流星，让夜空布满星迹。
author: actliux
source: POKENAME can be found swimming graciously across quiet rivers and lakes on the night of a meteor shower. The jewel on its head is said to hold cosmic energy that can mirror shooting stars to fill the night sky.

entry: POKENAME一开始筑坝，就不许别人靠近湖岸。它撞坏大牙狸和大尾狸的坝，偷碎木料给自己用。
author: sk372
source: Once POKENAME begins building itself a dam, it will accept no others anywhere near the lakefront it lives in. It smashes the dams Bidoof and Bibarel create, and steals the broken wood to use for its own.

entry: POKENAME是救生员的热门伙伴，在水边留意挣扎漂浮的人。一发现遇险者，就跃水游去，胀起身体当救生浮具。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are popular companions to lifeguards, standing watch at the water's edge for anyone struggling to remain afloat. If they spot someone floundering, they leap into the water and swim over, puffing themselves up to be a life float as they do.

entry: POKENAME很善泳。POKENAME开心时，尾巴的泡泡慢慢冒出，发怒时却会猛烈喷涌。
author: krune
source: A POKENAME is an adept swimmer. The bubbles on its tail calmly emerge when POKENAME is happy and burst out when it is enraged.

entry: POKENAME藏在河岸芦苇、灯心草间，靠高草躲危险。受惊后，它会迅速摇摆入水，顺流漂向安全处。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME hide themselves amongst reeds and rushes along river banks, relying on the tall plants to conceal themselves from danger. When they're startled, they rapidly waddle into the water, drifting downstream to safety.

entry: POKENAME群在湖边筑巢，进出水中捕小型虫属性宝可梦。羽毛覆着疏水油，泡再久也干爽，随时能飞。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Flocks of POKENAME make their nests around lakes, darting in and out of the water in their hunt for small Bug-type Pokémon. Their feathers are coated in hydrophobic oil, keeping them dry and ready to fly no matter how long they spend in the water.

entry: POKENAME用利爪挖长隧道，寻找完美宝石。找到又长又平的，就会拿来冲浪，这是它最爱的消遣。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: POKENAME dig long tunnels with sharp claws in search for the perfect gemstone. Once it has found one that's long and flat, it will use it to surf on waves as its favourite pastime.

entry: POKENAME水下狩猎出奇迅速无声。多数鱼还没意识到被盯上，就已为时太晚，整群消失在饥饿大嘴里。
author: sk372
source: Underwater, POKENAME is a surprisingly swift and silent hunter. Most fish won't even realize they're being watched and hunted until it's too late, and an entire school has vanished into its hungry maw.

entry: POKENAME自认是红树林的守护者，藏在水下根系间，垂着宝石，引贪心的来者伸手摘取。
author: wormspawn
source: POKENAME considers itself protector of its mangroves. It lurks among the submerged roots, dangling its gems as bait for anyone greedy enough to pluck one.

entry: POKENAME自认是红树林的守护者，藏在水下根系间，垂着宝石，引贪心的来者伸手摘取。
author: wormspawn
source: POKENAME considers itself protector of its mangroves. It lurks among the submerged roots, dangling its gems as bait for anyone greedy enough to pluck one.

entry: POKENAME云朵般的翅膀让它轻易融入浓雾。它靠雾突袭水生宝可梦，把猎物串上喙。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME easily blend in with heavy fog thanks to their cloudy wings. They rely on this dense fog to surprise aquatic Pokémon, skewering prey onto their beak.

entry: POKENAME来回游过河流，帮宝可梦渡过急流。睡莲叶上虽有毒胶，许多乘客只要在附近水中洗掉便好。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME swim back and forth across rivers to help Pokémon cross the rapid flow of water. Even though they produce a poisonous gel atop their lily pad, many Pokémon simply wash off the toxic substance in the nearby water.

entry: POKENAME总能在沙漠找到水源，因此带着几分得意的自信。至今没有找水失败的记录。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME exhibit a certain smug confidence that comes from their ability to reliably find water reservoirs in the desert. There has been no recorded instance where POKENAME fail to find water.

entry: POKENAME身体上的红刺能察觉极细微湿度变化，很擅长在沙漠找水。一遇绿洲，就会全身浸没，彻底补水。
author: quackquackattack
source: The red spine across POKENAME's body can detect minute changes in humidity, making it great for finding water in the desert. Once it comes across an oasis, it completely submerges its body to thoroughly hydrate itself.

entry: POKENAME皮肤潮湿，又爱游滞水，很容易真菌感染。背上蘑菇入水便释放孢子，传播给未感染的同类。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME's damp skin and tendency to swim in stagnant water leave them vulnerable to fungal infections. The mushrooms that grow on their back release their spores into the water when submerged, letting them spread to uninfected POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME的蘑菇有独特野味，是许多高级餐厅的热门原料。老饕认为潮湿长成的最好吃，因此饲养时常提供充足水源。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME mushrooms are a popular ingredient in many high-end restaurants thanks to their unique, gamey flavour. Connoisseurs feel it is best enjoyed when grown in damp conditions, encouraging POKENAME to be raised with plenty of water access.

entry: 春天，POKENAME脱落宝石红鳞，新鳞柔软，硬化前较脆弱。过去湖边村落会收集旧鳞，作货币使用。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME's ruby-colored scales shed during the spring, leaving new scales that are soft and vulnerable until hardened. In the past, the shed scales were collected and used as currency in lakeside villages.

entry: POKENAME常离开水中家园，拦路人、挑衅打架。它偏爱摔角，为赢不惜一切。若输了，就会认真提供任何被要求的服务。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME often emerge from their aquatic homes to accost and goad passersby into a battle. They typically prefer wrestling and will do anything to win. If POKENAME loses, they diligently provide any service requested of them.

entry: POKENAME的蘑菇有独特野味，是许多高级餐厅的热门原料。不过蘑菇若干燥，它容易感染，滋味也会变坏。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME mushrooms are a popular ingredient in many high-end restaurants thanks to their unique, gamey flavour. POKENAME are prone to infection if the mushroom is allowed to dry out, spoiling the taste.

entry: POKENAME身上的红色部分，是身体自带的宝石。它只有一枚手里剑，一用就是一生。
author: hiroshima0042_23263
source: The red on POKENAME are gems that are part of its body. POKENAME only has one shuriken that it uses for its whole life.

entry: POKENAME头上蛋白霜般的物质，柔滑甜润，很配饼干。糖香很难掩盖，因此总引来许多宝可梦。
author: quackquackattack
source: The meringue-like substance atop the head of a POKENAME has a mellifluous consistency that pairs well with cookies. They attract many Pokémon because their sugary aroma is hard to mask.

entry: POKENAME提高体温，把能量导入肌肉，游得更快。尾焰永不熄灭，即使潜入河湖也一样。
author: fiordaliso
source: To swim even faster, POKENAME increases its internal body temperature, channeling energy into its muscles. The flame on its tail never goes out, not even when it dives into rivers or lakes.

entry: POKENAME巡逻湖泊间的地下路线，只在白天露面，短暂游泳，采芦苇吃。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME patrols underground routes between lakes. It surfaces only during the day to swim briefly and gather reeds for food.

entry: POKENAME争强好胜，不断与同类竞泳，建立群体地位。据说亲眼看见比赛的人，情路会波折不断。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME are competitive swimmers, racing others of their kind constantly to establish hierarchy among a group. It's said those who spy these races in real time will have a tumultuous love life.

entry: POKENAME完全放弃用眼，只靠超感知能力察觉四周。全部精神能量，都储存在脸中央灼红发光的宝石里。
author: ruben2309295
source: POKENAME has completely abandoned the use of its eyes and relies solely on its ESP abilities to sense its surroundings. POKENAME stores all its psychic energy in the glowing, red-hot gem at the centre of its face.

entry: POKENAME脾气反复，常大发雷霆。训练家多选水多的地方训练，让它有处宣泄。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have capricious tempers that come out in tantrums. Trainers often train them in places with lots of water, giving them an outlet to vent frustration.

entry: POKENAME提高体温，把能量导入肌肉，游得更快。尾焰永不熄灭，即使潜入河湖也一样。
author: fiordaliso
source: To swim even faster, POKENAME increases its internal body temperature, channeling energy into its muscles. The flame on its tail never goes out, not even when it dives into rivers or lakes.

entry: POKENAME提高体温，获得水下高速冲刺的能量。神奇的是，尾尖火焰稳定燃烧，完全浸没也依然发光。
author: fiordaliso
source: By elevating its internal temperature, POKENAME generates the energy needed for rapid underwater dashes. Remarkably, the fire at the tip of its tail burns steadily, glowing even when fully submerged.

entry: POKENAME提高体温，获得水下高速冲刺的能量。神奇的是，尾尖火焰稳定燃烧，完全浸没也依然发光。
author: fiordaliso
source: By elevating its internal temperature, POKENAME generates the energy needed for rapid underwater dashes. Remarkably, the fire at the tip of its tail burns steadily, glowing even when fully submerged.

entry: POKENAME独立固执，通常与其他宝可梦合不来。清醒时大多待水下，休息却会上岸。
author: bobosmith01
source: Fiercely independent and stubborn, POKENAME tends to not get along with other Pokémon. While it spends most of its waking moments underwater, it rests on land.

entry: POKENAME按奇妙的旋涡图案游动，从中心向外扩散。特殊尾巴防止周围水花飞溅，让它不偏离预定路线。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME swim in strange swirling patterns that radiate outward from a central focal point. Their specialized tail prevents the water around them from splashing, so they do not deviate from their predetermined path.

entry: POKENAME每天苦练，追求完美泳技。野生宝可梦若打扰，它就以强拳反击。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME trains intensely every day to perfect its swimming abilities. If a wild Pokémon disturbs its practice, it strikes back with its powerful punches.

entry: POKENAME力量耐力十足，不到一小时就能绕小岛游一圈。不过捕食明明很快，它似乎更爱慢慢钓。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME has the strength and stamina to swim around a small island in less than an hour. Despite being able to quickly catch food, they seem to prefer to slowly fish for their meals.

entry: POKENAME独立固执，通常与其他宝可梦合不来。清醒时大多待水下，休息却会上岸。
author: bobosmith01
source: Fiercely independent and stubborn, POKENAME tends to not get along with other Pokémon. While it spends most of its waking moments underwater, it rests on land.

entry: POKENAME独立固执，通常与其他宝可梦合不来。清醒时大多待水下，休息却会上岸。
author: bobosmith01
source: Fiercely independent and stubborn, POKENAME tends to not get along with other Pokémon. While it spends most of its waking moments underwater, it rests on land.

entry: POKENAME独立固执，通常与其他宝可梦合不来。清醒时大多待水下，休息却会上岸。
author: bobosmith01
source: Fiercely independent and stubborn, POKENAME tends to not get along with other Pokémon. While it spends most of its waking moments underwater, it rests on land.

entry: POKENAME身子小，泳速却出奇快，几秒就能横渡湖泊。途中若见捕食者，能立刻蜷进壳里，保护四肢。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are deceptively fast swimmers for their diminutive size since they are capable of crossing a lake in a few seconds. They can curl into their shell mid-swim if they see a predator to protect their limbs.

entry: POKENAME灵活穿过险水，尤其擅长漩涡岛周围的旋涡。运动后，它用触手毒素制伏猎物，悠闲享用。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME swiftly maneuvers through treacherous water, especially the whirlpool formations surrounding the Whirl Islands. It uses the toxins on its tentacles to disable prey for a leisurely meal after exercising.

entry: POKENAME全身火焰，水下也明亮。它的奔跑不会止于岸边，因为脚蹼还能助它游水。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME produce flames from their body that remain bright even when underwater. Their galloping does not end at the water's edge since their flippers allow them to swim.

entry: POKENAME威风地驰骋陆海。身上美丽火焰，吸引许多人夜里观看。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME majestically gallop on both land and sea. The beautiful array of flames that come from their bodies draw many people to watch them travel at night.

entry: POKENAME的大壳会拖慢多数宝可梦，它却泳速惊人。短短几秒，就能达到每小时60英里，也就是接近每小时一百公里。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have large shells that would slow down most Pokémon, but they are deceptively fast swimmers. They reach a top speed of 60 miles per hour, or nearly one-hundred kilometers per hour, in a matter of seconds.

entry: POKENAME能在陆地或水中行动，却很少走得快、游得快。超能力让它与尾巴上的可达贝配合得天衣无缝，想打它一个措手不及，可不容易。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME can move on dry land or in the water, though they are rarely able to walk or swim quickly. Their psychic powers allow them to be in perfect harmony with the Psyder on the tail, so catching them off-guard is quite difficult.

entry: POKENAME喜欢从一边岸线游到另一边比赛。三个头彼此协调、融洽，便能游得更快。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME love to compete and will race one another from one shoreline to another. Having each of their three heads being coordinated and amicable with the others allows them to reach higher speeds.

entry: POKENAME带着巨壳，飞快超过其他水生宝可梦，几秒便游过长距。水炮提供额外推力，也把其他宝可梦撞出路线。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME zip past other aquatic Pokémon in their massive shell to swim long distances in a matter of seconds. Their water cannons give them extra propulsion while swimming, which ends up knocking other Pokémon out of their way.

entry: POKENAME发现别的宝可梦想抢食，宝石便闪愤怒红光。它侧身挨近，威吓地敲钳、响亮鸣叫，想把对方赶走。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME's gems flash an angry red when they spot another Pokémon trying to take their food. They sidle up to their competitor, clacking their claws menacingly and making a loud honking sound to scare them off.

entry: POKENAME接受完全进化的火花训练。它拼命锻炼，希望有朝一日能打败对方。
author: codewolfie
source: POKENAME are trained by fully evolved Primesaur. POKENAME trains furiously, hoping to one day beat them.

entry: 这种领地意识凶猛的宝可梦，需要大量能量进化，却大多耗在抵御其他虫属性、保卫爱树上。因此食量得超过类似融合体的两倍。
author: afilthycasual
source: This aggressively territorial Pokémon needs a lot of energy to evolve, but spends most of it defending its favorite tree from other bug types. Therefore, it requires more than twice the amount of food compared to similar fusions.

entry: 野生POKENAME凶猛易怒，训练家常专门训练，控制它随时爆发的倾向。
author: hextron2000
source: Wild POKENAME are known to be highly aggressive and short-tempered. It's typical for Trainers to work with them specifically to control their explosive tendencies.

entry: 它们紧握粗骨头，因为棍棒让它们想起家人。肯把骨头托付给训练家，就代表对方已是家族一员。
author: quackquackattack
source: They hold onto a Thick Club, as the club reminds them of their family. When a Trainer is trusted with one of these clubs, it is a sign that the Trainer is now a part of their family.

entry: POKENAME常一脸懊悔，为自己的脾气难过。烦躁时，它会疯狂挥棒，直到平静。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME often looks contrite because it feels remorseful for its temper. When upset, it violently flails its club around until it calms down.

entry: POKENAME生气，就反复伸缩身体、胡乱踢脚。脾气一发，常让许多宝可梦挨踢，最后整个群落都互相踢个不停。
author: soup1900
source: When angered, POKENAME will stretch up and down repeatedly and kick out wildly in a tantrum. These tantrums will often result in many Pokémon getting kicked and a whole colony of POKENAME kicking each other repeatedly.

entry: POKENAME生气，就反复伸缩身体、胡乱踢脚。脾气一发，常让许多宝可梦挨踢，最后整个群落都互相踢个不停。
author: soup1900
source: When angered, POKENAME will stretch up and down repeatedly and kick out wildly in a tantrum. These tantrums will often result in many Pokémon getting kicked and a whole colony of POKENAME kicking each other repeatedly.

entry: POKENAME拳力惊人，在许多宝可梦主题格斗俱乐部担任冠军。它必须不断训练，控制强烈怒气，否则出拳会失准得多。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is used as a champion in many Pokémon-themed Fight Clubs thanks to the extraordinary power behind its punches. It must train constantly to keep its overwhelming anger under control, as it risks making its strikes far less precise.

entry: POKENAME的茧由柔软杏色鳞片构成。鳞软又好斗，让它尤其容易遭飞行属性宝可梦袭击，因此野外数量不多。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have soft, apricot-colored scales that comprise their cocoon. They are especially prone to Flying-type Pokémon because of their soft scales and aggressive nature, which makes them uncommon in the wild.

entry: POKENAME在水下游动，头尾并用，凶猛攻击挡路者。殴打只有在必须定期上浮呼吸时，才会停下。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME swims around underwater, aggressively attacking any Pokémon that gets in its way with its head and tail. The pummeling only stops because POKENAME must regularly return to the surface to breathe.

entry: POKENAME极为凶暴危险，会四处飞行，袭击人类和宝可梦，因此很难训练。
author: sottiwotti
source: POKENAME is an extremely violent and dangerous Pokémon. It flies around attacking people and Pokémon, which makes it very hard to train.

entry: POKENAME模仿训练家，想表现得完全像人。若失误、太常露出猴怪习性，就可能暴怒破坏。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME tries to behave exactly like a human through imitation of its Trainer. If it slips up and acts like a Mankey too often, it may fly into a destructive rage.

entry: 没有什么比被骂没用，更让POKENAME生气。它会跃出水面，尾鳍反复扇打冒犯者。可惜这样几乎毫无伤害。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Nothing upsets a POKENAME more than calling it useless. If such an occasion occurs, the agitated POKENAME will leap out of the water to repeatedly slap the aggressor with its tailfin. Unfortunately for the POKENAME, this does little to no damage.

entry: POKENAME极具攻击性，常为食物与其他宝可梦打架。毒刺扎中，会让受害者涌起难控制的怒火。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are hyper-aggressive creatures that often fight other Pokémon for food. Their venomous stinger causes those stung to experience a wave of anger that is difficult to control.

entry: 训练POKENAME务必小心，一点挑衅就能令它疯狂挥打，之前常先低吼、粗重喘息。它缠住对手，再拳打脚踢。
author: chibitales
source: Trainers are recommended to be careful training POKENAME, as it can erupt into violent thrashing at the slightest provocation, often preceded by growling and rough breathing. It wraps its body around opponents and batters them with punches and kicks.

entry: POKENAME脾气很受环境影响。虽然仍反复无常，常青市周边的个体，似乎是观察中最平静的类型。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's temper largely depends on its surroundings. Though still volatile, POKENAME living in the areas around Viridian City seem to be the calmest variety observed.

entry: POKENAME没耐心、容易怒。训练家若晚喂超过十分钟，它就会用带电牙齿见什么啃什么。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are impatient and quick to anger. If their Trainer misses their mealtime for more than ten minutes, they chew on whatever they can with their electrified teeth.

entry: POKENAME很容易发脾气，常毁坏使用者电脑里的数据。可惜试图赶走，只会让它更怒，狂暴破坏得更多。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's temper flares up easily, often involving it damaging the data within a user's computer. Unfortunately, trying to expel it just makes it angrier, causing it to rampage more and cause even more damage.

entry: POKENAME用能抓握的尾巴挂在树枝上，原地等待进化。别的宝可梦爬同一树，它就恼火，甩身体撞向惹怒自己的家伙。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME use their prehensile tails to suspend themselves from tree branches, hanging in place whilst they wait to evolve. They grow irritable if another Pokémon climbs the same tree as them, angrily swinging their body into the source of their ire.

entry: 融合后的姿势，让它一直像在向对手鞠躬。这让POKENAME恼怒，出手更加凶狠。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Due to fusion, its posture causes it to constantly bow to its opponents. This angers POKENAME, causing it to lash out more aggressively at its opponents.

entry: POKENAME缠身绞碎故乡溪流里的石头，以此训练。它十分骄傲，觉得不受尊重，就会从鼻孔喷气，表示不满。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME trains its coils by crushing stones found in its native streams. A very proud Pokémon, it will snort air from its nose to show its irritation if it feels disrespected.

entry: POKENAME体内奔涌的强大能量，有时会让它承受不住，陷入失控的愤怒与焦虑。收服之后，最好让它大量运动。
author: bobosmith01
source: The powerful energy coursing through POKENAME sometimes overwhelms it. As a result, it can fly into uncontrollable fits of rage and anxiety. High amounts of physical exercise is reccomended for caught POKENAME.

entry: 猴怪的愤怒与大针蜂的凶猛，结合成危险、近乎野性的POKENAME。任何东西靠近巢，它们都会蜂拥而下，殴打、毒刺齐上，逼其屈服。
author: sk372
source: Mankey's anger and Beedrill's aggression combined to make a dangerous, almost feral Pokémon. POKENAME descend en masse on anything nearing the hive to viciously beat and sting it into submission.

entry: 梦幻稀有，梦幻融合体更少见，因此POKENAME常孤独，以愤怒表达。训练家最好让它结识其他宝可梦，减轻寂寞。
author: imaginita
source: Because Mew are rare, and Mew fusions even rarer, POKENAME are often lonely, and express this by being angry. It is a good idea for Trainers to socialize them with other Pokémon, so that they don't feel so lonely.

entry: POKENAME在家园河岸嬉戏，互相切磋，争地位、决定食物分配。有些能吃最好的树果，有些只分到残屑。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME frolic along riverbanks where they make their home. They spar against each other to assert dominance and influence food distribution. Some POKENAME receive the best berries, others only receive scraps.

entry: POKENAME脾气极差，谁靠近家就会迎来愤怒的拍翼、尖叫。吓不退，它便扬起大量尘沙，掩护迅速逃走。
author: sk372
source: Extremely ill-tempered, POKENAME flaps and screeches furiously at anything approaching its home. If it fails to intimidate, it kicks up large amounts of sand or dust to cover a quick escape.

entry: POKENAME性子暴躁，难以捕获，不过喂蔓莓果，能让它平静到足以收服。没被训练家打扰时，它会自己找树果。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can be hard to capture because of their hot temper but giving them a Razz Berry helps keep them calm enough to capture. When they are not being pestered by Trainers, they forage for berries.

entry: POKENAME睡觉时，像节拍器一样来回摇。好梦被吵醒，就会暴怒。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME rocks back and forth while sleeping like a metronome. If awoken during a good dream, it flies into a rage.

entry: POKENAME用拳抓花，爬树再吃。谁想抢食，它就大发雷霆。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME grabs flowers with its fists and climbs a tree before eating them. If someone tries to steal its meal, it goes into a rage.

entry: POKENAME从尾尖排出厚蛛网，捕捉猎物。网坚韧得连最强悍对手也能困住，是珍贵的捕猎工具。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME dispenses thick webbing from the tip of its tail to trap prey. The webbing is strong enough to hold even the toughest opponents, making it a valuable hunting tool.

entry: POKENAME用快而准的踢击，猎食绿毛虫等目标，连巨石也能踢碎。强腿还能让它跃上天空，重击挡路敌人。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME hunts prey like Caterpie with quick, precise kicks that can break boulders. It uses its strong legs to launch itself into the air, delivering a powerful strike to any foe in its path.

entry: POKENAME生气，身体就闪出微量电火花。战斗开始，它会用尾巴撑起身体，胡乱蹦跳，想在碰撞时把电放到对手身上。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: When POKENAME get angry, their bodies spark with trace amounts of electricity. They raise themselves onto their tails at the start of battle, leaping around recklessly to try and release electricity onto opponents they collide with.

entry: POKENAME哼着悦耳曲调，催附近生物入睡。不过若发现对方没听，它就会残忍地猛出拳。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME hums a delightful tune that causes those nearby to sleep. If it notices them not listening, it punches them with brutal vigor.

entry: POKENAME想跑，常绊倒，跌坐尾巴。可能要好几个小时，才平静到能重新站起来。
author: monina
source: When trying to run, POKENAME tends to trip and fall on its tail. It can take hours before it calms down enough to get up again.

entry: POKENAME发怒，会飞快啄树，大片木刺四散。这是在警告附近生物避远，因为它可能危险得难以预测。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME gets irate, it will begin rapidly pecking at trees, causing large splinters to fly in all directions. This serves as a warning to others in the area to stay clear, as it can become dangerously unpredictable.

entry: POKENAME毛茸茸的圆身体下，藏着结实肌肉。体重虽大，浮力却强，常浮在流水里，想缓解不断的怒气。
author: sylviasnake
source: POKENAME's furry round body hides dense muscle. Despite its high body mass, POKENAME is still highly buoyant and can often be found floating in flowing water in an attempt to ease its constant anger.

entry: POKENAME虽然好斗，身体却轻得很容易被风带走。常有人看见它在空中愤怒乱挥，被微风逼得远离想打的目标。
author: sk372
source: Though POKENAME has an aggressive temperament, it's still light enough to be carried easily by wind. Many have seen an airborne POKENAME flailing angrily as the breeze forces it away from the target of its ire.

entry: POKENAME总找露营者留下的食物残渣。它好胜易怒，若不够全群吃，连彼此都肯打。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are always hunting for scraps of food left behind by campers. They are highly competitive and quick to rage, even willing to fight each other if there isn't enough food for the whole pack.

entry: POKENAME一怒，就公然不顾后果，很难冷静。训练家应把怒气引向破坏较小的活动，免得财物被毁。
author: quackquackattack
source: Whenever POKENAME gets angry, its flagrant disregard for consequences makes it difficult to calm down. Trainers should redirect its anger to something less destructive to avoid dealing with broken property.

entry: POKENAME开心，头上的尾巴就会飞转，以惊人力量把它送上天空。不过这种情况少见，它大多闷闷地躲在高草。
author: jaminmcready
source: When a POKENAME is happy, the tails on its head spin rapidly and launch it into the air with surprising force. This only happens on rare occasions, as it often spends most of its time sulking in tall grass.

entry: POKENAME的鳃开始震动，就是生气的信号。扔树果或泥丸能安抚，但训练家得快，只有几秒，怒气就会爆发。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: When POKENAME's gills start vibrating, it is a sign of its anger. Throwing them a Berry or a Ball of Mud can pacify them, but Trainers have to be quick, as they only have a few seconds before POKENAME explodes in a fit of anger.

entry: POKENAME小巧凶猛，受收藏家追捧。新手训练家也很喜爱它的斗志。
author: sterbyy
source: POKENAME are sought after by collectors for their tiny size and ferocity. Fledgling Trainers adore them for their fighting spirit.

entry: POKENAME背上萌出的花苞，代表训练开始见效。看到花苞后，它们会更有动力坚持锻炼。
author: codewolfie
source: The flower that starts to bud on POKENAME's back is a sign that their training is paying off. The sight of this bud motivates them to keep training.

entry: POKENAME鼻子敏锐，还没钻进垃圾箱，就能闻清里面每件东西。哪怕最乱、最荒废的地方，也能靠嗅觉找食物和物件。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's nose is so sensitive that it can smell each item in a trash dumpster before it even goes inside. This keen sense of smell helps it locate food or other objects, even in the most cluttered and abandoned places.

entry: POKENAME嗅觉极强，训练家与宝可梦还没进遗迹，就早被察觉。它天生好奇，可遗迹中任何东西受损，好奇就会变怒火。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME detect Trainers and their Pokémon long before they enter their ruins with a superior sense of smell. Their natural curiosity turns into wrath if anything within the ruins is damaged.

entry: POKENAME的尾巴负责吃东西，常因本体频繁发脾气而苦恼。有人相信，尾里藏着不同于猴怪和麒麟奇的独立意识。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's tail handles eating and often appears distressed by its host's frequent tantrums. Some believe the tail houses a consciousness distinct from either Mankey's or Girafarig's.

entry: POKENAME极其难照顾，娇惯又反复无常。觉得关注不够，就会凶猛抓咬训练家。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is quite the difficult Pokémon to care for. It is extremely spoiled and temperamental, and will aggressively swipe and bite at its Trainer if it feels it hasn't been given enough attention.

entry: POKENAME脾气极坏，还护食。别的宝可梦若吃它认领的球果树上的东西，就会被毫不留情地啄，直到退走。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME is extremely grumpy and protective of its food. If it sees another Pokémon eating from an Apricorn Tree that it has claimed as its own, it will mercilessly peck at them until they retreat.

entry: POKENAME发现有人摘领地内的树果，会怒不可遏。它循气味找贼，再用爪攻击，毁掉对方所有食物。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME becomes infuriated when someone takes berries from trees in its territory. When this happens, it uses its sense of smell to find the thief before using its claws to attack and destroy all the food they have.

entry: POKENAME极易怒，不小心撞上树枝，就怪罪整棵树，用啄钻将其砍倒。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME is very short-tempered. If it accidentally flies into a tree branch, it blames the tree and chops it down with Drill Peck.

entry: POKENAME群常为地盘争斗。它们寻找敌对群体，跃出水面高速互撞，想用泰山压顶压倒对手。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME schools are known to get into territorial disputes with one another. They seek out rival schools, leaping out of the water and colliding with one another at high speeds in an attempt to Body Slam their rivals.

entry: 谁闯进领地，它就会咬住对方并注入毒液。越是愤怒，毒性就越强。
author: skymaster426
source: It lashes out at anyone who enters its territory by biting and injecting the target with its venom. The angrier it grows, the more potent the venom.

entry: POKENAME太生气，就会失控滚动，借此泄愤。滚动常像一种疗法，能在情绪彻底过载前，让它平静。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME gets too angry, it will start rolling uncontrollably, using this action to vent its frustration. The rolling can often be seen as a form of therapy, helping it calm down before it becomes too overwhelmed.

entry: POKENAME凶狠、爱破坏，什么能缠住就抓着碾碎。因为只有压碎东西，才能有效缓解压力。
author: sk372
source: It has a vicious temperament and destructive tendencies, grabbing and crushing anything it can wrap itself around. This is because crushing things is the only effective way POKENAME can relieve its stress.

entry: POKENAME越生气，身体机能越旺盛，包括产奶。因此挤奶很危险，工作人员还被鼓励在安全范围内，尽量先惹怒它再采乳。
author: sk372
source: As POKENAME gets angrier, its bodily functions intensify, including its milk production. Milking is therefore a dangerous job, as milkers are encouraged to enrage it as much as safely possible before extraction.

entry: POKENAME暴怒，电火花便迅速从身体落下。放电量惊人，哪怕轻微接触，也会痛苦触电，是危险的对手。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME gets intensely irate, electric sparks begin to fall off its body rapidly. The sheer amount of electricity it discharges makes it a dangerous opponent, as even the smallest contact can cause a painful shock.

entry: POKENAME永远闷闷不乐，常忘了顾尾巴，导致挂在杂物上，再大发雷霆。
author: sylviasnake
source: Perpetually grumpy, POKENAME tend to lose track of their tail, leading to it getting stuck on stray objects and sending POKENAME into a fit of rage.

entry: POKENAME储电远多于雷丘，却怒得根本无法好好运用。
author: mary_the_jane
source: POKENAME stores much more electricity than that of a Raichu. However, it is far too angry to utilize the electricity properly.

entry: POKENAME以很小的群体生活，不断争食，打架抢零嘴。有时打得太投入，忘了食物，被路过的其他宝可梦偷走。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME live in very small groups, competing constantly for food and fighting to steal snacks from the others. These fights can get so involved that the food is forgotten completely and stolen by another wandering Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME的毛敏感，能察觉水中涡流，帮助迅速游海。感知到别的宝可梦留下的水迹，它就生气，追上去想赶走。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME fur is sensitive enough to detect eddies and whorls in the water, helping them move swiftly through the ocean. They grow angry when they sense the trail left by another Pokémon, swimming after them to try and chase them away.

entry: POKENAME用脚扬沙，打对手个措手不及，让人看不清下招。趁分心，它迅速使出强力踢倒，将其击倒。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME kicks up sand with its feet to catch its foe off guard, making it difficult to see what is coming next. Once its opponent is distracted, it strikes swiftly with a powerful Low Kick to knock them down.

entry: POKENAME是已发现最贪吃的宝可梦之一，每天吃下超过体重三倍的食物。这也直接让它持续紧张、烦躁。
author: secondatheniangadfly
source: POKENAME is one of the most gluttonous Pokémon ever discovered. It eats more than three times its own body weight every day, which directly contributes to POKENAME's state of constant stress and frustration.

entry: POKENAME在水潭上方的树安家。若没法从枝上漂亮地跳水，就常生气。
author: mjxpimouss
source: POKENAME makes its home in trees above watering holes. It regularly gets angry if it can't make a proper dive from one of the branches.

entry: POKENAME被宠坏了，稍不如意就大发脾气，很少主动向训练家示好。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are very spoiled Pokémon and will throw temper tantrums any time it doesn't get its way. It very rarely shows outward affection towards its Trainer.

entry: 雌性POKENAME为保护伴侣而战斗。身上层层粗毛如铠甲，强健尖刺带毒，防范潜在对手。
author: getsu
source: A female POKENAME engages in combat to protect its mate. To better protect itself, POKENAME is layered in coarse fur that acts like armor. Its hearty spines are dipped with poison to ward off potential rivals.

entry: POKENAME四个脑配合不良，因此困惑又凶暴。一点不顺心就会暴怒，沉重的金属肢体挥打抓挠附近一切。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's four brains are not attuned to each other properly, leaving it confused and aggressive. It flies into a rage at the slightest upset, its heavy metallic limbs swinging and clawing at anything in its vicinity.

entry: POKENAME头脑简单，脾气却大。一生气，咬得到什么就啃什么。格外狂乱时，能在平静前啃倒大片森林。
author: sk372
source: Simpleminded but temperamental, when POKENAME gets angry it begins gnawing on anything it can sink its teeth into. A particularly frenzied POKENAME can fell a large chunk of forest before calming down.

entry: POKENAME毛间渗出的毒极其黏，谁接触都会阵阵暴怒。
author: .izik
source: The poison that seeps from POKENAME's fur causes fits of rage in anyone who comes into contact with it. The poison is extremely sticky.

entry: POKENAME脾气坏到极点，生气时若只用拳打，已经算幸运。最凶的招，是拿假嘴抓住敌人，四处摔打。
author: sk372
source: Temperamental to the extreme, one should consider themselves lucky if an angry POKENAME only hits them with its fists. Its most vicious attack is grabbing a foe with its false mouth and slamming them all about.

entry: 人们认为，POKENAME之名源于跳到领地入侵者头顶的习惯。它从栖居树枝警觉寻找动静，再挥利爪攻击。
author: ocxin
source: POKENAME's name is understood to be a reference to its behaviour of jumping on the heads of intruders of its territory. Its attentive eyes seek out movement from the branches it lives on before striking with sharp claws.

entry: POKENAME角上滴落的绿毒会引起怒气。一滴，就能让人暴怒好几天。
author: .izik
source: The green venom that drips from POKENAME's horn causes bouts of anger. Even a single drop can make someone rage for days.

entry: POKENAME荡藤蔓，穿过密林。许多个体会以杂技对决，展示运动本领。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME swing from vines to navigate through dense jungles. Many POKENAME face off against each other by performing acrobatic feats to show off their athleticism.

entry: POKENAME的毛与羽共同保暖。不过毛长太多，就会过热，愈发愤怒好斗。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's combination of fur and feathers keeps it insulated from the cold. However, if its fur grows too much, it will begin to overheat and grow angrier and more belligerent.

entry: POKENAME生气，鼻孔会发出急促粗重的喘息。火爆脾气引起周围轻微磁场紊乱，挪动尘土、石头和小微粒。
author: sk372
source: When angered, heavy rapid breathing can be heard from POKENAME's nostrils. Its flaring temper causes mild magnetic disruptions in its surroundings, displacing dirt, rocks and other small particles.

entry: POKENAME脾气急，最小的不便也能让它挑战同类切磋。踢击能轻易断骨。
author: .izik
source: Short-tempered, POKENAME will challenge others of its kind to spar over even the smallest inconvenience. Its kicks are able to break bones with ease.

entry: 敏感触角先试探敌人弱点，再抽出攻击、缠住对方。它经常生气，一怒，打法就更乱。
author: haypile
source: Its sensitive feelers probe foes for weaknesses, then whip out to attack and ensnare. Its fighting gets sloppier when it's angry, a state it is often in.

entry: POKENAME格外凶猛，最微不足道的冒犯也会挑起战斗。生气时，毛发竖起，它奔向惹怒的目标，挥拳痛打。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are unusually aggressive Pokémon that will pick fights over the most trivial of slights. When they're angry, their fur will stand up on end, and they will race toward the target of their ire to pummel them with their fists.

entry: POKENAME在山区小群生活，常四处乱闹。不过满月夜，它会进入恍惚状态，彻底安宁。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME live in small colonies in the mountains. They are often seen running amok; however, on nights of the full moon, they enter a trance-like state and become perfectly serene.

entry: POKENAME怒气越高，温度越升。缎带手臂让拳击更像拍打，打起来便很懊恼，反而升上空中，离对手越来越远。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: A POKENAME's temperature increases based on its levels of anger. When POKENAME attack, their attempts at punching end up more like smacks due to their ribbon-like arms, frustrating them and causing them to rise into the air away from their opponent.

entry: POKENAME能学会为攻击冲动找出口。有些地区会训练它，用强腿和攀爬本领，从高树采树果、坚果。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME can be taught to find outlets for their aggressive energy. In some areas of the world, POKENAME are trained to collect berries and nuts from tall trees using their powerful legs and climbing skills.

entry: POKENAME战斗时会拆下手脚，让它们独立移动，从四面八方擒抱、打击敌人。
author: hophoppip
source: In battle, POKENAME detaches its hands and feet, which can move on their own to grapple and strike opponents from all sides.

entry: POKENAME极易怒，新坝哪怕一小处不对，它都会反复踢烂，第二天再重建。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME is extremely short-tempered. If even a single portion of its recently built dam is out of place, it kicks it repeatedly, destroying it before starting anew the next day.

entry: POKENAME靠训练和冥想，努力保持平和。不过与散发负面情绪波导的生物待在一起，它仍压不住怒火。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME tries to maintain an even temper through training and meditation. It cannot keep its rage suppressed when in the presence of those with negative emotional aura, however.

entry: POKENAME即使暴怒，也可能毫无预兆地睡着，常发脾气到一半就入梦。梦虽不安，仍不妨碍睡足、恢复。
author: .izik
source: Even in the midst of a rage, POKENAME can fall asleep without warning, often drifting off mid-tantrum. During sleep, it has fretful dreams, but this does not stop it from getting the rest it needs to recover.

entry: POKENAME性情倔强，常不听年幼训练家的话。发脾气又爱反抗，让它不适合首次培育宝可梦的人。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME has a recalcitrant personality that leads it to disobey young Trainers. Its temper tantrums and defiance make it a difficult choice for first-time Trainers.

entry: POKENAME容易怒，常发脾气，把壳震裂脱落。每次重新长好，壳都比之前更坚固耐用。
author: metcassette
source: Prone to anger, POKENAME have frequent tantrums that often result in the cracking and shedding of their shell. Each time their shell is regrown, it is stronger and more durable than before.

entry: POKENAME毛柔软，坏脾气却让人避开。孤独令它更怒，胀起身体，猛撞周围泄愤。
author: potato_tub
source: POKENAME's fur is soft to the touch, but its short temper makes people avoid it. Its loneliness only angers it further, causing it to inflate itself and body slam its surroundings in frustration.

entry: POKENAME毛间飘出的萄葡果香，连最温和的人也能激怒。散香时若受惊，效果还会增强一倍。
author: .izik
source: The Grepa Berry scent that wafts from POKENAME's fur can send even the mildest person into a rage. This effect becomes twice as strong if it is startled when dispensing the aroma.

entry: POKENAME天生胆小又好斗，陌生环境里很快积起压力。训练家应让它定期战斗，帮助释放。
author: wiz0z
source: Being skittish and aggressive by nature, POKENAME quickly accrue stress when in unfamiliar environments. Trainers of POKENAME are advised to help them by allowing them to battle on a regular basis to relieve this stress.

entry: POKENAME飞行时从鼻子发出声呐，在黑暗洞窟和密林中辨路，轻松避障找猎物。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME emits sonar from its nose while flying, allowing it to navigate in dark caves and thick forests. This helps it avoid obstacles and find its prey with ease.

entry: POKENAME身形厚重，仍相当敏捷。它可能毫无预兆地凶暴起来，挥拳打向周围一切。
author: gamblebreaker
source: Despite its bulky frame, POKENAME is still quite agile. It can become aggressive without warning, throwing punches at anything around it.

entry: POKENAME怒气爆发，火便烧得明亮。羽毛烫得一碰就能造成严重灼伤。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's bursts of anger cause its flames to blaze brightly. Its feathers are hot enough to cause massive burns if touched.

entry: POKENAME大嘴先发愤怒尖啸，再暴怒地俯冲攻击。格外生气时，可能叫得太久，自己昏过去。
author: sk372
source: With its large mouth, POKENAME lets out a fierce shriek of anger just before it begins swoops and attacks in rage. If particularly angry, it may scream for so long that it passes out.

entry: POKENAME喜欢拿珍贵宝石当点心。找到却不饿，就藏在毛里，留待以后吃。
author: petratheangel
source: POKENAME loves to snack on precious gems. If it finds a gem but isn't hungry it will store it in its fur for later.

entry: 神奥的外套常用POKENAME毛，因柔软、天然花香而珍贵。香气广受喜爱，也常用于香水与熏香。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's fur is used in coats across Sinnoh, prized for its soft texture and natural floral scent. This scent is so coveted that it is often used in perfumes and incense.

entry: POKENAME用尾巴高高撑起身体，看清家园田野外的动静。整田个体一看见讨厌的人，就会立刻发动攻击。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME raise themselves up high on their tails to get a good view of what's happening beyond the field they call home. Entire fields of POKENAME will launch into an attack at a moment's notice if they spot a person they dislike.

entry: POKENAME白天在田间晒太阳，尽量储能。若被打扰，整田个体都会拔根，高速冲向来者，在一阵愤怒中耗尽能量。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME sun themselves in fields to store as much energy as they can during the day. Entire fields of POKENAME will uproot themselves and run at high speed toward anyone who disturbs them, burning all their energy in an angry burst.

entry: POKENAME白天在田间晒太阳，尽量储能。若被打扰，整田个体都会拔根，高速冲向来者，在一阵愤怒中耗尽能量。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME sun themselves in fields to store as much energy as they can during the day. Entire fields of POKENAME will uproot themselves and run at high speed toward anyone who disturbs them, burning all their energy in an angry burst.

entry: POKENAME从头花放出恶臭，妨碍敌人，再以凶猛打法压倒。它需要潮湿环境，因此住在丛林深处。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME releases a foul stench from the flower on its head to hinder its foes, then overwhelms them with its ferocious fighting style. It lives deep in jungles, as it needs humid habitats to thrive.

entry: POKENAME尾巴比悬索桥钢缆更强。幸好它只用来紧抱珍爱的巨大香蕉。
author: kiwiarms
source: POKENAME's tail is stronger than the cables of a suspension bridge. Thankfully, it only uses it to hold tightly to its prized giant banana.

entry: POKENAME把尾巴深插地下，吸取水分。主要会在睡前这么做，整晚站着。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME digs its tail deep into the ground to absorb moisture. It primarily does this before sleeping, standing all night long.

entry: 运动员曾相信，吃POKENAME的蘑菇能增强肌力。这确有一些道理，不过伴随而来的极端攻击性，使采菌最终遭禁。
author: sk372
