source: Athletes once believed that eating POKENAME's mushrooms helped with muscle strength. While there is some truth to that, the extreme increase in aggression that accompanies it resulted in a ban on harvesting the fungi.

entry: POKENAME出了名难驯，被认为无缘无故凶暴，其实并非如此。它们的群体讲究等级，对训练家也要求实力与尊重。
author: quackquackattack
source: Notoriously difficult to domesticate, POKENAME are seen as irrationally aggressive, yet they are not. This is because their hierarchical pack system creates a demand for power and respect from those who become their Trainer.

entry: 据说POKENAME除了愤怒，无法感受其他情绪。它四肢着地，以无尽怒火扑向猎物。
author: lootererswillbeboated
source: It is said to be incapable of experiencing any emotion besides anger. POKENAME drops to all fours and leaps onto prey with never-ending rage.

entry: POKENAME小巧有活力，满身绒毛。它凭敏捷动作与灵敏感官突袭对手，有时还会藏进高草，施以毒击。
author: thepandasharky
source: POKENAME is a small, energetic Pokémon covered in fuzzy fur. It uses its swift movements and keen senses to strike and surprise opponents, sometimes launching toxic strikes while hiding in tall grass.

entry: POKENAME躲在影中，安静观察四周。若潜伏受扰，它就懊恼暴怒，攻击任何打断专注的东西。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME hides away in the shadows to quietly observe its surroundings. Should anything disrupt these stakeouts, it flies into a frustrated rage and attacks whatever broke its concentration.

entry: POKENAME不高兴，会脸朝下睡在浅池，借凉水平静。睡莲叶里的细孔，让它能继续呼吸。
author: .izik
source: When upset, POKENAME sleeps face-first in a shallow pond, as the cool water helps calm it. It is able to breathe through through tiny holes in its lily pad.

entry: POKENAME怒到顶峰，双眼便放出强烈红光。它用拳砸地升空，再冲向附近一切，痛打泄愤。
author: sk372
source: When POKENAME's anger peaks, its eyes start radiating a powerful red glow. It slams the ground with its fists to take to the air and launch itself at anything nearby so it can beat it up out of anger.

entry: POKENAME挖不穿石头，就改用强力尾巴。反复敲击，连巨石也能打碎。
author: .izik
source: If POKENAME cannot dig through stone, it uses its powerful tail instead. Repeated strikes can shatter even massive boulders.

entry: 求偶时，POKENAME会靠近水面，激烈争夺关注。水手最好避开骚动水域，免得船壳受损。
author: afilthycasual
source: POKENAME can be found near the surface during courtship, aggressively competing for attention. Sailors are wise to evade agitated water to avoid damaging their hull.

entry: 安抚愤怒POKENAME的最好办法，就是给一枚亮硬币，让它爱不释手。不过每枚只能管一小会，想让它一直平静，可花费不菲。
author: sk372
source: The best way to calm down an angry POKENAME is by giving it a shiny coin to fawn over. Because it only works a short time per coin, keeping POKENAME perpetually placid can become costly.

entry: POKENAME鼻子灵敏，一英里外极淡的气味也能察觉。它能嗅出洞窟深处或地下埋藏的硬币、贵金属。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's nose has a superior sense of smell, allowing it to detect even the faintest scents from over a mile away. It has been known to sniff out coins and valuable metals hidden deep within caves or buried underground.

entry: POKENAME常因烦躁无目的地乱挥，毛总遮住眼。可想剪毛解决，它却似乎不愿配合。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME constantly has fur in its eyes, as this Pokémon often thrashes about aimlessly in frustration. However, it seems reluctant to cooperate when its fur gets trimmed to solve the issue.

entry: POKENAME躯干本来正常长毛，却常见缺一块少一块。因为发怒攻击前，它会先狂扯自己的毛。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's entire torso grows hair normally, but most are seen lacking patches of fur, due to its tendency to rip its own fur off in a furious display before attacking whatever triggered its ire.

entry: 遇到POKENAME相当危险，尤其对新手训练家。强大力量与一触即发的脾气，能引发极具破坏力的暴怒。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is considered a rather dangerous Pokémon to come across, especially for novice Trainers. Its great strength combined with its hair-trigger temper can result in very destructive temper tantrums.

entry: POKENAME爱出拳、易爆怒，前臂练得异常发达，力量涌动。若有人指出腿的大小反差，多数个体都会大怒。
author: sk372
source: Due to its punch-happy nature and hair-trigger temper, POKENAME has massively developed forearms pulsing with strength. Most specimens are noted to get very angry if the contrasting size of their legs is pointed out.

entry: POKENAME暴怒，会用强手扼住、摇晃同群成员。虽然可能造成重伤，通常还没到那一步，它就已把怒气全发泄了。
author: soup1900
source: When POKENAME get furious, they use their very strong hands to choke and shake other members of their group. While this chokehold can cause serious damage to their bodies, they usually squeeze all their anger out before it gets to that point.

entry: POKENAME战斗时挺起身体、左右摇摆，瞪着对手晃拳，先试图威吓。不奏效，就一直喷孢子，直到敌人倒下。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME raise themselves up and sway back and forth during battle. They shake their fists while glaring down their opponents, attempting to intimidate them at the start of battle. If this tactic fails, they will spray spores until their foe falls.

entry: 生气时，它会从鼻孔喷出水泡，把毛弄乱。一天大部分时间，都在与其他POKENAME打架。
author: fiordaliso
source: When it gets angry, it snorts water bubbles from its nostrils, ruffling its fur. It spends most of its day fighting with other POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME脾气急躁，既用手臂攻击，也用手臂移动。
author: deflador
source: POKENAME has a short temper. It uses its arms as both its means of attacking and moving.

entry: POKENAME拳砸洞壁，震松黄玉吃。它拒绝与同类分享。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME slams its fists into cave walls to knock loose topaz, which it eats. It refuses to share with others of its kind.

entry: POKENAME跳水的池子若太冷，就会暴怒，连同伴也攻击。壳不但保护大胆跳落，也防着它没完没了的打架。
author: fiordaliso
source: If the pool of water it dives into is too cold, POKENAME flies into a rage and starts attacking even its own companions. Its shell protects it not only from daring falls, but also from the constant brawls it keeps getting itself into.

entry: POKENAME两个头不停拌嘴互斗。最好别插手，因为怒气很快就会转向打断者。
author: deniablecredibility
source: POKENAME's two heads are constantly bickering and fighting with one another. It is ill-advised to try to get in the middle of their quarrels, as they are quick to redirect that anger at the interrupter.

entry: 一个流传甚广的故事里，渔夫录下自己钓起“美丽人鱼”的过程，结果立刻被愤怒的POKENAME甩尾重击。野生的它，最好别招惹。
author: bobosmith01
source: A popular word-of-mouth story involves a fisherman who recorded himself fishing up what he thought was a beautiful mermaid. He was then promptly whacked by the hooked POKENAME's tail in its anger. It's best to leave wild POKENAME alone.

entry: POKENAME大多摊在地上吸养分，污染地区尤其常见。若被踩，就会暴怒乱打，过程中常有小块身体掉落。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME spends most of its time spread out over the ground, absorbing nutrients. It is especially common in polluted areas. Should anything step on it, it becomes furious and wildly lashes out, as small pieces of it often come off in the process.

entry: POKENAME的气场，让靠近的生物怒到失去理智。只有焚香的气味，才能让它平静。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME's aura induces blinding rage in anyone who gets near it. It can only be calmed by the smell of burning incense.

entry: POKENAME把鼻子贴在其他生物身上，吸取生命。被打扰容易怒，发完脾气，通常又饿了。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME feed on the life of others by pressing their noses against them. They are quick to anger if disturbed, and the resulting tantrum will typically leave them quite hungry.

entry: POKENAME轻松掘过地下隧道，沿途留下一簇簇毛。探险者和矿工，常在它出没的通道发现。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME digs through underground tunnels with ease, leaving behind tufts of fur as it makes its way through the earth. These tufts are often found by explorers and miners in the tunnels it frequents.

entry: POKENAME藤蔓末端像拳击手套，谁惹怒就打谁。平静时，它大多吃杂草和毒花。
author: fiordaliso
source: The tips of its vines are shaped like boxing gloves, which it uses to punch anyone who angers it. When calm, POKENAME spends most of its time feeding on weeds and poisonous flowers.

entry: 别的宝可梦太靠近，POKENAME毛就竖起。生气会快速抖身，把落毛甩进附近生物眼里。若不奏效，再喷黏丝，扑向敌人。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME fur bristles if another Pokémon draws too close to them. They shake their body rapidly when angry, shedding their hair to get it into the eyes of those nearby. Should that fail, they launch sticky silk instead before jumping at their foe.

entry: POKENAME脾气急，容易暴怒。路过群落得小心，惹怒一只，就可能引发整群连锁自爆。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are short-tempered and prone to outbursts of rage. Care is advised when walking past a POKENAME colony, as upsetting one could result in a chain reaction of Self-Destructs from the entire troop.

entry: POKENAME不停原地抽动、震颤，怒气始终濒临沸点。一点小不顺，就会让它猛烈爆炸。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME twitch and vibrate in place constantly, their anger always close to boiling point. The slightest inconvenience can set them off, causing them to explode violently.

entry: POKENAME手持骨棒，既可当回力镖掷出，也能作钝器打击。它的怒火，只有对训练家的忠诚能与之相比。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME wield bony clubs in their arms to throw as boomerangs or leverage as a bludgeon. Their wrath is only matched by their devotion to their Trainer.

entry: 它每天严格自律地训练，控制怒气，让拳头更准。可擂台上若快输，终究还是会彻底失控、狂怒发作。
author: fiordaliso
source: It trains every day with strict discipline to keep its anger in check and make its punches more precise. However, if it's about to lose a match in the ring, it completely loses control and flies into a furious rage anyway.

entry: 别的宝可梦太靠近，POKENAME毛就竖起。发怒还会放出恶臭，让附近同类也暴怒，整群合力赶走入侵者。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME fur bristles if another Pokémon draws too close to them. They emit a foul odour whilst angry, driving nearby POKENAME into a rage alongside them. Swarms of them work together to chase off intruders.

entry: POKENAME似乎永远愤怒，没耐心地等着破茧进化。壳里能听见敲打和哼声。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are seemingly always enraged, impatiently waiting to break free from their cocoon and evolve. Banging noises and grunts can be heard from within their shells.

entry: POKENAME怒气驱动，一与谁对视，就头朝前冲过去。必要时，能追上数英里。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME will charge headfirst at anyone they make eye contact with, fueled by rage. They will chase their target down for miles if necessary.

entry: POKENAME发作时，突然想拖动大树和巨石，借此冷静。农夫很感激，因为这习性让它成为耕大片田地的最佳选择。
author: bigoljax
source: During its outbursts, POKENAME gains the sudden impulse to drag along large trees and rocks, using these urges to calm itself down. Farmers have grown a great appreciation for it, as these tendencies make it the best option for plowing vast fields.

entry: POKENAME翅鳞吸入有微毒，会让吸入者攻击性增强。它不免疫自己的鳞，因此疯狂扑飞，想找架打。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME wing scales are mildly toxic when inhaled, causing increased feelings of aggression in whoever breathes them in. POKENAME are not immune to their own scales and frenetically flutter around in the hopes of finding a fight.

entry: POKENAME甩手臂发电，也把本就火爆的脾气煽得更旺。之后使出的雷电拳，威力毁灭性十足。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME swings its arms around to generate electricity as well as flare up its already angry temperament. The Thunder Punch attack it delivers after doing so is absolutely devastating.

entry: 它总不爱笑，训练颇难，不是太烦没法笑，就是听不懂笑话。得以实际行动展示勇气与毅力，才能赢得信任。
author: quackquackattack
source: Its agelast tendencies create difficulty during training, as it is either too upset to laugh or the joke is beyond its understanding. A raw demonstration of courage and grit is necessary to gain its trust.

entry: POKENAME脾气大，常在乡野狂暴乱闯。只有一头撞墙，引发严重头痛，才能让它停下。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME have a high temper, usually going on violent rampages through the countryside. The only thing stopping these rampages are the massive headaches POKENAME gets after ramming their heads into walls.

entry: POKENAME翅鳞吸入有微毒，会让吸入者攻击性增强。它不免疫自己的鳞，因此挥动链球，想打晕看见的所有生物。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME wing scales are mildly toxic when inhaled, causing increased feelings of aggression in whoever breathes them in. POKENAME are not immune to their own scales, whirling their ball and chain to try and knock out anyone they see.

entry: POKENAME愿意载旅人，可没乘客的个体一看见，就会暴烈嫉妒。两只随即肉搏，可怜乘客夹在中间。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is willing to ferry travelers, but those without passengers will get violently jealous if they see the act. The two POKENAME will get into a physical brawl, with the hapless passengers caught in the middle.

entry: POKENAME毛发间电火花跳动，不断噼啪作响。愤怒时容易一次放出全部电力，可能造成住家停电。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME fur makes a constant crackling noise as sparks of electricity jump between the hairs. Angry POKENAME can cause power outages in homes as they are prone to discharging all of their electricity at once.

entry: 没有什么比黑客更令POKENAME生气。一旦发生入侵，它就进入网络空间追查责任者，找到之前绝不罢休。
author: darkweavile428
source: Nothing angers POKENAME more than hackers. If there is ever a security breach, POKENAME will enter cyber space to search for the one responsible, and it will not give up until they are found.

entry: POKENAME平时懒散，力量却惊人，甚至被比作请假王。若睡觉提早被叫醒，就会狂怒，攻击附近一切。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: Whilst typically slothful, POKENAME are incredibly powerful, even being compared to the likes of Slaking. If they are woken up from their slumbers early, POKENAME will become wildly furious, attacking anything nearby.

entry: POKENAME喜欢打架，靠密集快拳取胜。毒刺留给生死关头，因为其他宝可梦一被扎，就会重病。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME love fighting with other Pokémon and achieve victory by unleashing a flurry of punches against their opponent. They reserve their stinger for deadly situations, as other Pokémon become seriously ill when stung by their stinger.

entry: POKENAME用精神力寻找强者挑战，以残酷闻名。非得彻底战胜对手，才会满足。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME uses its psychic powers to seek out strong Pokémon to fight. It is known for its brutal nature, and won't be satisfied until it achieves absolute victory over its opponent.

entry: POKENAME怒气强烈，满脑子只想打东西泄愤。它会用念力扣住整群人，只为当沙包打。
author: sk372
source: Full of intense anger, POKENAME can only think of beating things up to vent its frustrations. It will hold entire groups of people hostage with telekinesis just to use them as punching bags.

entry: POKENAME战斗时旋转头，用头上连着的拳击敌。它不经思考便冲进战斗，全靠转头取胜。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME whirl their head during battles, trying to strike their foes with the fist attached to their head. They run headfirst into fights without thinking, relying on the twirl of their head to win the battle.

entry: POKENAME在家园河岸肆虐。领地意识极强，哪只野生宝可梦不尊重边界，就会被攻击。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME wreak havoc alongside riverbanks where they make their homes. Their highly territorial nature causes them to lash out against other wild Pokémon who do not respect their boundaries.

entry: POKENAME栖在城市建筑顶端，监视经过的一切。谁盯太久，它就暴怒，俯冲轰向对方。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME perches on top of urban structures, surveying everything that passes by. If anyone stares at it for too long, it becomes enraged and dive-bombs them.

entry: POKENAME的愤怒能增强凶猛，却有代价。长时间战斗，羽毛会成团脱落，露出明显秃斑。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's fury boosts its ferocity, but comes at a cost. During extended battles, its feathers fall out in clumps, leaving visible bald spots.

entry: POKENAME虽小，巨拳打起来却很有力。满月时尤其精力旺盛，会找周围生物切磋。
author: quackquackattack
source: While POKENAME may be small, its massive fists can pack a punch. It becomes particularly energetic when the full moon is out, sparring with those around it.

entry: POKENAME的拳大多无害，仍坚持每天锻炼。怒到一定程度，身上会有煎蛋味。
author: monina
source: While its punches are mostly harmless, POKENAME still makes sure to work out every day. There is a smell of omelette when it gets angry enough.

entry: POKENAME抽动震颤，望着不远不近的地方，定期发出愤怒颤鸣。研究者相信，它能看未来，是被所见激怒。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME twitch and quiver as they gaze off into the middle distance, periodically making an angry trilling noise. Pokémon researchers believe POKENAME are able to view the future, and that they grow angry at what they can see.

entry: POKENAME本就容易对一切发怒，尤其别碰飘逸鬃毛。那会引发最猛烈的狂暴，拍翼在周围卷出龙卷风。
author: sk372
source: Although its temperament makes it liable to rage at anything, one must take care to never touch POKENAME's flowing mane; doing so sends it into its most violent rage as it flaps and creates tornadoes of wind all around it in anger.

entry: POKENAME头上羊毛间，电火花噼啪作响。发怒时，电弧从毛里向四面迸出。
author: .izik
source: Sparks crackle through the wool on POKENAME's head. When angered, arcs of electricity leap from its fur in every direction.

entry: POKENAME听力太好，一点声响也会招来攻击，通常是带刺尾巴重砸敌人。
author: a_grain_of_rice
source: POKENAME's great hearing causes it to lash out at the slightest noise, usually slamming its spiked tail into enemies.

entry: POKENAME看着懒散没精神，却最小的事都能惹怒。哪怕只是躺着、还醒着时，被一颗软树果砸到，也会暴怒。
author: infinex21
source: Although POKENAME tend to laze around and appear to lack energy, they become riled up over the simplest of things. Even a soft berry falling on them while they are lying around, even while awake, will drive them to a rage.

entry: POKENAME靠心灵感应，始终察觉训练家情绪。若谁欺负人类伙伴，它就暴怒跃去，用肌肉强腿的全部力道撞倒对方。
author: fiordaliso
source: Thanks to its telepathic powers, POKENAME can always sense its Trainer's emotions. If someone mistreats its human partner, it flies into a rage and tries to leap at them, knocking them down with the full strength of its muscular legs.

entry: POKENAME生气，周身环纹会因纯粹的怒气与决心，亮成鲜红。它是忠诚斗士，一打起来，很容易持续整夜。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: When POKENAME get angry, the rings around their bodies glow bright red out of sheer rage and determination. They are fiercely loyal fighters; once they get into a fight, it can easily carry on through the night.

entry: 随着斗志日盛，POKENAME的花朵外长出一道钢箍。钢箍坚不可摧，据说恰如POKENAME不屈的意志。
author: codewolfie
source: As POKENAME's fighting spirit grew, It developed a steel band around its bloom. The band is unbreakable, and said to resemble POKENAME's spirit.

entry: POKENAME轻松跑过艰苦长路，连乱石斜坡也不难。少数“休息”时，它仍怒得跺脚；唯有睡着才不动。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME effortlessly races long grueling distances and can even easily navigate through rocky slopes. It stamps and stomps in rage during its few "breaks"; the only time it does not move around is when it sleeps.

entry: POKENAME在钢壳保护下，不停训练。长臂和钢尖拳能出毁灭重拳，击碎巨石；越生气，拳越强。
author: vic1312
source: Protected within their steel shells, POKENAME train relentlessly. Their long arms and steel-tipped fists launch devastating punches that can shatter boulders. These punches grow even stronger when they grow angry.

entry: POKENAME偏爱用手套般的尾巴攻击。它靠翅膀接近高处目标，专打对手敏感部位，确保胜利。
author: sleepyman0731
source: POKENAME prefer to attack using their glove-like tail. They use their wings to reach taller targets, aiming for sensitive areas on their opponent to ensure victory.

entry: POKENAME群常因小争执哗变。怒气里，一天能多次推翻、更换群体首领。
author: .izik
source: Flocks of POKENAME frequently mutiny over trivial disputes. In their rage, they dethrone and replace their flock leaders several times a day.

entry: 这些不良宝可梦，仗钢铁身体和近战技法，无端惹事。POKENAME腕上链越长，群体地位越高。
author: sontyp
source: These delinquent Pokémon use their steel bodies and close-combat techniques to cause trouble with no provocation at all. The longer the chain on a POKENAME's wrist, the higher it stands in its group's hierarchy.

entry: POKENAME是最易怒的宝可梦之一，小不便就能引爆脾气，小冒犯也记仇。训练家得靠点心慢慢建立信任，同时培养它容忍别人。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME has one of the shortest tempers of all Pokémon, flying into a rage at the slightest inconvenience and holding a grudge over the smallest slight. Trainers must slowly build trust by giving it treats while building up its tolerance for others.

entry: POKENAME虽会毒咬，更喜欢以肌肉身体绞住敌人。不过若被突然袭击，就会疯狂乱挥，盼打中攻击者。
author: mistymagius
source: Despite having a venomous bite, POKENAME prefers to constrict its foes with its muscular body. However, if it is caught off guard by an attack, it will violently flail around to hopefully strike whatever attacked it.

entry: POKENAME虽小，发起脾气却很难安抚。它常拔植物泄愤，是农夫的噩梦。
author: quackquackattack
source: Though small, POKENAME are difficult to calm down once they get into a tantrum. They tend to vent their frustration by uprooting plants, making them a nightmare for farmers.

entry: POKENAME群保护幼崽，家族受威胁便用后腿站起，挥拳反击。若任它们奔撞到力尽，建筑都可能被夷平。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME herds are protective of their young, rearing up on their hind legs and lashing out with their fists whenever their family is threatened. Stampedes of POKENAME can end up levelling buildings if left to wear themselves out.

entry: POKENAME常见于帕底亚烘烘沙漠，把小宝可梦赶离水源，留给自己的群体。粗糙嶙峋的甲胄，让它能撞穿巨石、高速滚动。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are commonly found within Paldea's Asado Desert, bullying smaller Pokémon away from watering holes and claiming them for their own herd. Their rough, craggy body armour allows them to crash through boulders and roll at high speed.

entry: POKENAME厚毛沿铠甲背脊长，因不停打架、滚动而结毡。训练家想梳理，常碰一鼻子灰，因为它没耐心站够久。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME fur grows thickly along its armoured spine, becoming matted from their constant battling and rolling. Trainers who try to groom them are often met with frustration as POKENAME lacks the patience to stay still long enough to be brushed.

entry: POKENAME能操控身体特定点的位置、缩放和旋转，让动画动起来。动画师若反复以不自然方式移动身体，它就会恼怒，把动作锁住一分钟。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can manipulate the position, scale and rotation of specific points on their body to introduce movement to animations. If animators attempt to repeatedly move their body in an unnatural manner, they get upset and lock movement for one minute.

entry: POKENAME即使暴怒，也保持平衡精准。怒火反而磨利专注，让它高效又凶狠地打击弱点。
author: .izik
source: Even while enraged, POKENAME maintains balance and precision. Its fury sharpens its focus, allowing it to strike weak points with brutal efficiency.

entry: 它不像火暴猴那样一直愤怒，却很容易暴怒。发作越频繁，身体越受影响：毒更强，却可能蜕皮更勤，或让消化系统受累。
author: bobosmith01
source: While it is not constantly enraged like Primeape, it is very quick to intense anger. The more frequent the outbursts, the more its physiology is affected: venom becomes more potent, but it may shed more frequently or strain its digestive system.

entry: POKENAME脾气坏又暴力，牧场主仍很想养，因为它对群体绝对忠诚。闯入者若惹怒一次，便再不敢。
author: griddle
source: Ill-tempered and violent, POKENAME are nonetheless highly desirable by ranchers for being steadfastly loyal to their herd. Trespassers who invoke the wrath of a POKENAME never do so again.

entry: POKENAME的怒气问题给环境造成大量破坏。哪怕轻轻一拳，气流也强得足以毁掉村庄。
author: ricolight
source: POKENAME's anger issues causes lots of damage to its envoirment. Even a light punch causes an air current strong enough to destroy a village.

entry: POKENAME没吃够，就会怒得失控，什么东西都吞，不管能不能吃，直到重新吃饱。
author: .izik
source: If underfed, POKENAME becomes uncontrollably furious. In its frenzy, it devours random objects—edible or not—until it feels full again.

entry: POKENAME挖地撞上石头，就会暴怒，直接钻穿。发作时，挖速增至平常十倍。
author: .izik
source: When digging, if POKENAME hits a rock, it flies into a rage and drills straight through. Its digging speed increases tenfold during these fits.

entry: POKENAME在网络空间寻找麻烦病毒和恶意软件，试图消灭。不过代码损坏，有时会让它随机攻击，误删使用者自己的文件。
author: mepp.
source: While navigating cyberspace, POKENAME seeks out troublesome viruses and malware to destroy. However, corruption in its code sometimes triggers it to randomly attack and delete one's own files by mistake.

entry: POKENAME用利爪和强健肌肉挖隧道。受打扰就会暴怒，挖空来者脚下，把对方拖进通道。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME spend their time digging tunnels, using their sharp claws and powerful muscles to carve through the soil. They fly into a rage if disturbed, digging out the ground under whoever interrupted them and dragging them into their tunnels.

entry: POKENAME常为自认为最好的跳水点战斗。别的宝可梦若从旁跳水、把它溅湿，它就会暴怒。
author: mjxpimouss
source: POKENAME regularly fights to defend what it considers the best spot to dive into the water. It erupts in anger if it gets splashed by another Pokémon diving next to its spot.

entry: POKENAME能把情绪投给别人，让对方感同身受。它太容易怒，两只相遇，常演变成狂怒对战。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are able to project their emotions to others, enabling the recipient to feel what they are feeling. Their tendency to grow angry often results in a meeting of two POKENAME devolving into a furious battle.

entry: POKENAME试图控制不停的怒火，却必须捶点东西宣泄，否则会生病。唯一绝不肯痛打的，就是训练家。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME tries to control its ceaseless rage, but needs to vent out the anger by punching something or it will become ill. The only thing it will absolutely refuse to pummel is its Trainer.

entry: POKENAME让目睹者产生无理的愤怒与敌意。宝可梦想打它，却常发现攻击无效，这又必然让投出的怒气更强。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME engender irrational feelings of anger and aggression in those who see them. Pokémon that try to strike them often find their attacks have no effect, invariably leading to the anger being projected by POKENAME to intensify.

entry: POKENAME用利爪和强健肌肉挖隧道。路上碰到预料外的东西就生气，岩石、管线一并劈开，继续前进。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME spend their time digging tunnels, using their sharp claws and powerful muscles to carve through the soil. They grow angry when they encounter an unexpected object in their path, cleaving apart rocks and piping alike to continue their tunnel.

entry: POKENAME在战斗中交替劈抓、钝拳。它缺乏战术知识，不知何时该用哪种，常只顾交替狂攻。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME alternate between using sharp swipes and blunt punches during battle. They lack the tactical knowledge to effectively choose between the two fighting styles, often just alternating between the two in a frenzied assault.

entry: POKENAME失控时，体内毒素效力变为三倍。这时轻轻一抓，也能引发严重反应。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME loses control, the toxins in its body triple in potency. A single scratch during these rages can cause severe reactions.

entry: POKENAME确实聪明，却仍保留火暴猴受足够刺激就无理暴怒的倾向。力量与精神力如今更强，发作也危险得多。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME is certainly quite intelligent, but it still has Primape's tendency to fly into a senseless rage if sufficiently aggravated, where it is now much more dangerous due to its heightened strength and powerful psychic powers.

entry: 会推倒树木砸向敌人。愤怒时，只需几秒就能啃断树干。
author: staghorn
source: It brings down trees on top of its foes. When angered, it can gnaw through a tree's trunk in seconds.

entry: 训练良好的POKENAME会故意激怒敌人，再反过来利用狂暴状态，熟练抓破绽，耗尽对方。
author: bobosmith01
source: A well-trained POKENAME goads foes into rage and aggression and uses their berserk state against them, expertly striking openings and wearing the enemies out.

entry: 融合终于让POKENAME平静下来。可惜，融合带来的失明又让它很恼火，脾气依旧有些急躁。
author: patch_bros
source: Fusion has caused POKENAME to finally calm down. Unfortunately, it is very annoyed by its newfound blindness and is still somewhat irritable.

entry: POKENAME会教导猴怪与妙蛙花一族融合而成的幼年个体战斗。若被徒弟击败，便会退休，由徒弟成为新的师父。
author: codewolfie
source: POKENAME trains young Mansaur to fight. If beaten by its apprentice, the apprentice becomes the new teacher, and POKENAME retires.

entry: POKENAME靠增强的嗅觉追踪毒草，吃下能提升战斗中的毒性。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its enhanced sense of smell to track poisonous plants. When consumed, these increase the strength of its venom during combat.

entry: POKENAME头上拳形假嘴，随怒气变大。一拳就能打裂脚下地面，引起数米外也感得到的震动。
author: sk372
source: The fist-shaped false mouth on POKENAME's head grows in size relative to how much rage it is feeling. A single punch is enough to crack the ground beneath it and cause tremors felt for several meters.

entry: POKENAME拼命护幼，家族一受威胁就失控暴怒。狂暴能持续好几天，常让它反而远离家人。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are fiercely protective of their young, flying into an uncontrolled rage whenever their family is threatened. Their rampages can last for days, often taking them far away from their family in the process.

entry: POKENAME又大又强，能忍受多数生物熬不过的严寒。早期毛皮商却为暖和冬衣猎杀，使某些地区的种群濒危了数百年。
author: bigoljax
source: With the mix of its large size and strength, POKENAME is able to survive cold, harsh conditions that most could not endure. However, early fur traders hunted it for the nice winter coats it made, causing it to be locally endangered for centuries.

entry: POKENAME长腿能踢出毁灭重击。生气时几乎无法控制，不顾一切扑向对手，直到一方获胜。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME's long legs allow it to kick with devastating force. When angry, it becomes nearly uncontrollable and reckless, throwing itself at opponents until one Pokémon stands as the victor.

entry: 传说POKENAME执行神罚。谁激怒它，它就会现身，以纯粹神圣能量和怒火化成的1000只拳痛打。
author: sk372
source: Legends speak of POKENAME as a dispenser of divine punishment. Those who incite its ire would find it appear before them and pummel them with 1000 fists made of pure divine energy and wrath.

entry: POKENAME群扯下枝果，点燃后扔向倒霉路过的宝可梦。格外干燥时，这习惯很容易引发森林火灾。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME troops rip branches and fruit from trees, igniting them before hurling them at any Pokémon unfortunate enough to be passing by. During particularly dry periods, POKENAME are prone to starting forest fires due to this habit.

entry: POKENAME用角打空，就会暴怒。失败只会助长凶性，让它更难被阻止。
author: .izik
source: If POKENAME misses a strike with its horn, it flies into a rage. The failure only fuels its aggression, making it even harder to stop.

entry: POKENAME生气时，毛就会起火，烧得炽热。领地内的探险者要留意头顶树枝火光，那常是攻击将至的唯一预警。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME fur catches on fire when they are angry, blazing with the heat of their rage. Explorers in POKENAME territory are advised to keep watch for fire in the branches above them, as it's often the only warning of an impending attack.

entry: POKENAME后脑的火象征怒气，越怒越热、越狂。若只剩微弱闷烧，健康就出了大问题。
author: sk372
source: The fire at the back of POKENAME's head is symbolic of its rage, burning hotter and wilder the angrier it gets. If it's barely smoldering, something is seriously wrong with POKENAME's health.

entry: POKENAME既聪慧又强悍，在野外是其他宝可梦可靠的领袖。保护欲和脾气一样强，一不开心就陷入狂乱。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are both wise and tough, making them reliable leaders of other Pokémon in the wild. Their protective instincts are as strong as their temper, which sends them into a frenzy whenever they are upset.

entry: POKENAME身边随行的圆石，被认为是限制强大力量与怒气的某种装置。它略有念力，能把重石掷向惹怒者。
author: sk372
source: The circular stones that move along with POKENAME are thought to be some type of limiter for its intense power and rage. It has mild telekinesis capabilities that let it hurl these heavy stones at anything that earns its ire.

entry: POKENAME刀刃若崩口，同类会帮忙磨利。群体以树上独特刻痕标地盘，旅人最好避开。
author: jaminmcready
source: If a POKENAME's blade ever becomes chipped, others of its kind will assist in sharpening it. Packs of POKENAME will mark their territory with unique symbols carved into trees, and travelers are warned to stay clear of these areas.

entry: POKENAME围敌旋转，一有破绽，就迅速冲入，凶狠出击。武术家会陪练，细究它的进攻打法。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME whirl around their foes, darting in for quick and vicious blows whenever an opening appears. Martial artists train alongside them, studying their aggressive combat style closely.

entry: POKENAME暴怒时，把毒全导进最前方的角。只需一次冲锋，就能刺穿铠甲，留下长久毒害。
author: .izik
source: When furious, POKENAME channels all of its venom into its foremost horn. A single charge can pierce armor and inflict a lasting poison.

entry: POKENAME用触角痛打其他宝可梦，非得释放全部积怒才停。没过多久，强烈内疚又会淹没它。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME thrashes other Pokémon with its feelers, refusing to stop until its built-up anger is fully released. Shortly after, it becomes overwhelmed with feelings of guilt.

entry: 许多人以为POKENAME会极其凶暴。奇妙的是，观察到的它却谨慎清醒，守护着家人。
author: mary_the_jane
source: Many expect POKENAME to be an incredibly aggressive Pokémon. Bizarrely, however, it has been observed to be a cautious, clearheaded defender of its family.

entry: POKENAME每天锻炼，尤其爱耸肩。碰上力量不够、拿不下的东西，它就暴怒，想将其毁掉。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME works out every day, particularly shoulder shrugs. Should it encounter something that it is not strong enough to tackle, it flies into a rage, trying to destroy it.

entry: POKENAME每天举巨石、扔沉重宝可梦、拖倒树锻炼。碰上力量不够、拿不下的东西，它就暴怒，想将其毁掉。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME works out every day, lifting boulders, throwing heavy Pokémon and dragging fallen trees. Should it encounter something that it is not strong enough to tackle, it flies into a rage, trying to destroy it.

entry: POKENAME的脾气为背上特制炮供能，越怒越凶，炮内拳头就越烧红。怒到顶峰，它便射出拳形弹丸，以爆炸般的力量命中。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's temper fuels the special cannon on its back, the fist within glowing red-hot the angrier and more violent POKENAME becomes. At the height of its fury, it launches the fist-shaped projectile, which hits with explosive force.

entry: POKENAME表面乖顺，可一见虚假，便会完全失去理智。它挥舞重臂，体内火焰不断积起，最终化作烈焰，击倒玷污真相的生物。
author: sk372
source: Nominally well-behaved, POKENAME loses all sense of reason in the presence of dishonesty. It thrashes its heavy arms about, flames building up inside it until it becomes a raging inferno striking down those that defile truth.

entry: POKENAME永远愤怒，最小刺激也会发脾气。两只打起来能持续数日，彼此猛攻，把整片森林夷平。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are perpetually angry, throwing tantrums over the most minor of stimuli. Fights between two POKENAME can rage for days, entire forests getting flattened as they thrash against one another.

entry: POKENAME怒气直接随月相变化。它始终狂怒，但满月时较有收敛，因此行为只稍稍不那么暴力。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's anger is tied directly to the phase of the moon. It's always raging, but the rage is quite a bit more tempered during the full moon, so it behaves marginally less violently as a result.

entry: 扫描显示，POKENAME大脑活动极少。不过它对自身和四周的感知敏锐，战斗几乎没有多余动作。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME show very little brain activity on scans. Despite this, they demonstrate a keen awareness of their surroundings and their own bodies that allows them to fight with little to no wasted movement.

entry: POKENAME花粉刺激性极强，每次挥臂，只会让原始怒火更旺。
author: mistymagius
source: The pollen from POKENAME's flowers is extremely irritating, so anytime it swings it arms it only intensifies its primal rage.

entry: POKENAME怒火升温，加热体内空气，让自己飘飞。太平静便会掉下来，可这又惹怒了POKENAME，因此从不落地太久。
author: staghorn
source: A POKENAME's red-hot temper heats up the air inside it, which provides enough lift for it to fly. It loses its ability to float if it becomes too calm; since this enrages the POKENAME, it never remains grounded for long.

entry: 暴怒的POKENAME一脚就能踢倒整棵云杉。森林里，常留着暴烈情绪的伤痕。
author: .izik
source: When enraged, POKENAME can kick over entire spruce trees with a single blow. Forests often bear the scars of its violent mood swings.

entry: POKENAME为了战斗更愤怒，会挤压、猛拽自己的耳朵。打完再找安静地方梳耳，吃最爱的树果。
author: pjporwoll
source: To enhance its rage for combat, POKENAME will squeeze and yank its own ears. Once the battle is over, it finds a quiet spot to groom its ears and eat its favorite berries.

entry: POKENAME脾气急，最小的不便也觉得受冒犯。它用爪状双手连刺惹烦者，拳打不赢，就甩尾。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are short-tempered Pokémon, taking offense at the most minor of inconveniences. They use rapid jabs of their claw-like hands to attack whatever's annoyed them, swiping with their tail if they can't finish off their foe just with punches.

entry: POKENAME脾气急，最小的不便也觉得受冒犯。它向一切惹怒者挑衅，冲前迅速使出音速拳，再退回安全距离。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are short-tempered Pokémon, taking offense at the most minor of inconveniences. They pick fights with anything that angers them, darting forward with a rapid Mach Punch before retreating to a safe distance again.

entry: POKENAME拍翼频率与心跳相同，越怒，嗡鸣越快。连拳能迅速突破对手防御，却也让自己暴露反击空当。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME wings beat at the same frequency as their heartbeat, whirring faster and faster as they grow angrier. They are able to land flurries of punches on their opponents, racing past their foes' defences but leaving them open to counter-attacks.

entry: POKENAME怒到身体开始沸腾的事，早已广为人知。愤怒似乎让它无视沸腾带来的剧痛。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME are known to get so angry that their bodies begin to boil. Their anger seems to make them ignore the intense pain the boiling causes.

entry: 旧传闻称，POKENAME体内藏着战败后仍怒得不肯放弃的斗士灵魂。它睡在废弃训练馆和道场，若训练家拿它当普通沙包，就会怒得缝口欲裂，疯狂挥拳。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Old rumors claim that POKENAME contain the souls of fighters too angry to give up after defeat. They sleep in abandoned gyms and dojos, bursting at the seams and wildly flailing their fists in rage if any Trainer uses them as a regular punching bag.

entry: POKENAME脸上长毛遮路，老撞东西，因此极易怒。一发脾气，就以碎石般的重击，攻击面前一切。
author: fiordaliso
source: The long fur on POKENAME's face keeps it from seeing where it's going, so it constantly bumps into things, making POKENAME extremely irritable. When it loses its temper, it attacks whatever is in front of it with blows strong enough to shatter stone.

entry: POKENAME的坝哪怕掉一根小枝，也会狂乱。它怒得推倒附近树木，收集补充用的枝条。
author: .izik
source: If even one twig falls from its dam, POKENAME flies into a frenzy. It topples nearby trees in a blind rage to gather replacement branches.

entry: POKENAME察觉附近有邪恶波导，就会立刻攻击。目标意图越阴暗，它越愤怒。
author: .izik
source: If POKENAME senses an evil aura nearby, it immediately attacks. Its rage grows stronger the darker the target's intent.

entry: POKENAME脾气急，什么靠太近都咬。逃跑的宝可梦会被它追，不过腿短，追不了多久。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are short-tempered Pokémon, snapping at anything that gets too close. They chase after Pokémon that run from them, but aren't able to chase for very long due to their stubby legs.

entry: POKENAME大群嗡嗡飞过沙漠找水。飞得快，到了水源又容易动粗，因此沙漠旅人得留意它们出没。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME whirr across the desert in large swarms when searching for water. Their speed in flight, combined with their predisposition toward violence on arriving at a watering hole, means desert travellers are advised to stay aware of their presence.

entry: POKENAME生气就用氦气胀大拳头，晃身体想打惹怒者。可没有肌肉，拳只浮在身边，必然让它为无能更加恼火。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME puff their fists up with helium when they're angry, waggling their bodies to swing them at whatever's annoyed them. Their lack of muscles means their fists simply float beside them, inevitably leading them to grow angrier at their impotence.

entry: POKENAME讨厌所有人和一切，一点烦扰就会攻击。得靠多年关爱，才能突破这层凶性。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME hates everyone and everything, lashing out at anything that slightly irritates it. It takes years of love and affection to break through its aggressive personality.

entry: POKENAME暴怒时，强翼能把洞顶钟乳石击落。打碎大量石头后，才终于开始平静。
author: .izik
source: When enraged, POKENAME uses powerful wings to slam stalactites loose from cave ceilings. After breaking a large sum, it finally begins to calm down.

entry: POKENAME双拳镶着从深洞找到的珍贵宝石。它能把巨大晶洞砸成小碎块，收藏或慢慢啃。
author: opossiblymage
source: POKENAME's fists are studded with precious gems it has found in deep cave systems. It is strong enough to crumble massive geodes into tiny pieces, which it then hoards or nibbles on.

entry: POKENAME体格厚重，性情凶猛，是危险的对手。带毒拳尖，会毫不留情地痛打敌人。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's bulky physique and aggressive nature make it a dangerous Pokémon to face. It mercilessly pummels enemies with its poison-tipped fists.

entry: POKENAME被形容为纯粹的史前怒火，狂暴时能毁掉整条山脉。除非被强行制止，或累到彻底昏迷，否则绝不停。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has been described as pure prehistoric rage. It can destroy whole mountain ranges during a rampage, and said rampages do not end unless it is forcibly dealt with or exhausts itself to complete unconsciousness.

entry: POKENAME找大块金属举过头，尽可能扔远，借此泄愤。搜救队因此会雇它，在建筑倒塌后清理瓦砾。
author: bigoljax
source: To let off steam, POKENAME looks for large chunks of metal to lift over its head, chucking them away as far as possible. Because of this habit, search and rescue teams hire it to move rubble out of the way after a building collapses.

entry: 它把任何动静都视为威胁，会不停拳击对手，直到对方无法动弹。短短几秒，拳头就能粉碎一间小屋。
author: mistymagius
source: It sees any sort of movement as a threat, and it will punch its adversary until they can no longer move. Its punches can pulverize a small house within a few seconds.

entry: POKENAME头上突起能让水下动作精准，挥动重物时也准得可怕。
author: kiwiarms
source: The protrusions from POKENAME's head allow for precise movement underwater. This lets it swing its weight with frightening accuracy.

entry: 成群POKENAME起初曾被错认成水雷。巨大沉重的尾巴一挥，就能击沉船只。
author: strawberry_boicake
source: Originally mistaken for sea mines, groups of POKENAME can sink ships with a single swing of their large, heavy tails.

entry: POKENAME踏过沙漠，迫不及待想找架打、发泄怒气。腿拳上的刺会随挥动射出，很难完全躲过狂攻。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME stomps around desert areas just itching to find something to fight and vent its anger on. Its legs and fists carry spines it can fire off as it swings, making it difficult to fully escape its raging strikes.

entry: POKENAME的钳子已被蘑菇取代。蘑菇结实得像拳击手套，让它能猛出拳，又不伤敏感身体。
author: kam_doodle_snek
source: Mushrooms have replaced POKENAME's pincers. These mushrooms are as durable as boxing gloves, allowing POKENAME to deliver powerful punches without damaging their sensitive body.

entry: 比起普通磨牙彩皮鱼，POKENAME颜色暗淡，令它十分烦躁。一觉得被忽略，便会爆发怒火。
author: hophoppip
source: Its drab coloration compared to standard Bruxish frustrates it greatly. If POKENAME feels overlooked, it unleashes its fury.

entry: POKENAME满身“毛发”，其实是一种毛茸茸真菌。一点挑衅，就会让它失控暴怒，四处撒孢子。
author: empty_set
source: The "fur" which covers POKENAME is actually a fuzzy kind of fungus.  On the slightest provocation, it flies into an uncontrolled rage and scatters spores everywhere.

entry: POKENAME能长久静止，等最佳攻击时机。等待中，它把自己越想越怒，最终毫无预兆地使出强力空手劈。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are able to remain motionless for long stretches of time, waiting for the perfect moment to strike. They work themselves up into an angry fury while they bide their time, eventually launching a powerful Karate Chop without warning.

entry: POKENAME群容易内斗，常以战斗决出最强。持续交锋锻炼肌肉，团结对抗共同敌人时，便成可怕威胁。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME troops are prone to in-fighting, individuals regularly battling one another to determine who is the strongest. The constant fights help train their muscles, making them a formidable threat when they unite against a common enemy.

entry: POKENAME靠结实身体承受物理打击，好专心磨炼攻势。看见自认为不公的事，它就愤怒地追赶恶霸和小偷，争取公平。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME rely upon their sturdy bodies to absorb physical blows, allowing them to focus purely on their offensive skills. They grow angry when they see acts they perceive to be an injustice, chasing down bullies and thieves in pursuit of fairness.

entry: POKENAME远远投出不受束缚的烈焰攻击。火焰让命中者极度愤怒，更容易在战斗中犯错。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME wield untamed fiery blasts, flinging their attacks at their foes from a distance. POKENAME flames cause those struck to experience intense feelings of anger, making them more likely to make errors during battle.

entry: 野生POKENAME不用手里剑。每只因力量太大，都会戴着钢制负重。
author: hiroshima0042_23263
source: In the wild, POKENAME do not use shurikens. Every POKENAME wears steel weights due to their immense strength.

entry: 人们在田野饲养POKENAME，采毛做厚实冬衣。不过它讨厌被采毛，谁想动手就攻击谁。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are raised in fields for their fur, the thick wool covering their bodies being a popular choice for winter coats. They dislike having their fur harvested, however, and attack anyone who tries to do so.

entry: 谁进入领地，POKENAME就会狂怒失控，使出乱抓，伤及树木、灌木和附近一切。
author: .izik
source: If someone enters its territory, POKENAME flies into a blind rage. It lashes out with Fury Swipes, damaging trees, bushes, and anything nearby.

entry: POKENAME在吵闹人群中很快烦躁。附近聚落想办庆典，就需要宝可梦巡护员看着种群。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME quickly become irritable while in the presence of crowds and loud noises. Populations of POKENAME need to be monitored by Pokémon Rangers when nearby settlements want to host festive celebrations.

entry: POKENAME挖掘受阻，可能暴怒。少数情况中，怒气爆发曾严重破坏地面建筑结构。
author: .izik
source: When its digging is obstructed, POKENAME may enter a violent rage. In rare cases, this outburst has resulted in severe structural damage above ground.

entry: POKENAME极其凶猛，遇到任何其他宝可梦都攻击。虽然与同类也总打架，羁绊却很强，常被当作友好竞争的象征。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME are incredibly aggressive and will attack any other Pokémon they encounter. They form strong bonds with other POKENAME despite constantly fighting with them, and are often used as a symbol of friendly rivalry.

entry: POKENAME挖地撞上硬障碍，就会暴怒，反复撞击，直到打通或倒下。
author: .izik
source: If POKENAME strikes a hard obstacle while digging, it enters a furious rage. It repeatedly slams into the blockage until it breaks through or collapses.

entry: POKENAME一开始怒，几个小时都不会平静。不过零钱或亮物一出现，几乎立刻就能分散注意。
author: .izik
source: Once POKENAME begins raging, it won't calm down for hours—unless it spots spare change or a shiny object, which distracts it almost instantly.

entry: 融合把更大的脾气，塞进更小的身体。POKENAME积怒过多，若不准发泄，器官甚至可能因压力而停止运作。
author: sk372
source: Fusion has caused an even bigger temper to be packed into a smaller body. POKENAME has so much pent-up rage that if it isn't allowed some outlet to vent its temper, it risks its own organs shutting down from stress.

entry: 族群中最强的POKENAME会用众多肢体，同时迎战其他所有成员。首领会独占群体找到的一切食物。
author: al_chimera
source: The strongest POKENAME in a pack will fight every other member at once with its many limbs. The leader of the pack hoards any food the pack acquires.

entry: POKENAME怒气积起，满身金毛就会竖立。它喜欢独处，远离其他群体。
author: bottomusmaximus3
source: The golden hairs that cover POKENAME's body stand on end when it builds up a rage. It prefers to keep to itself, staying away from other packs of POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME先扔巨石震晕对手，再冲入使出强力近身战。牙齿又大又结实，古时候曾作武器。
author: chibitales
source: In battle, POKENAME hurl large boulders to stun opponents before diving in to deliver powerful Close Combat attacks. POKENAME teeth were used in ancient times as weapons due to their size and durability.

entry: POKENAME虽会怒，却克制自己，不想吓着训练家或别的宝可梦。因此它会被派往飓风摧毁的城镇，安慰迷路孩子，直到找到家人。
author: bigoljax
source: Though it can lose its temper, POKENAME keeps itself in check, not wanting to scare its Trainer or other Pokémon. Because of this, it's sent out into towns destroyed by hurricanes, comforting lost children until their families are found.

entry: POKENAME总是烦躁，多数宝可梦避开它和威力惊人的拳头。为了锻炼身体和拳力，它不知疲倦地砸瀑布后的岩崖。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME lives in constant irritability, causing most Pokémon to avoid it and its devastating punches. To strengthen its body and its fists, it tirelessly smashes the rocky cliffs hidden behind waterfalls.

entry: POKENAME睡觉恢复体力，怒气也不退，梦里都在战斗。瞬间移动并非用来逃避战斗，而是直接投入战团。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its fury doesn't subside even while it sleeps to regain energy, even its dreams are filled with battle. POKENAME uses its teleportation abilities not to flee from fights, but to dive straight into the fray.

entry: POKENAME精神力源自愤怒，也靠愤怒增强。据说它一旦平静，便会失去所有精神能力。
author: dualblades1147
source: POKENAME's psychic powers originate from and are empowered by its anger. It is said that if a POKENAME ever becomes calm, it will lose all of its psychic abilities.

entry: POKENAME一生气，血液就猛烈奔涌，常是因为被踩。与身体分离的脚，通过磁力连着循环系统的血液，方便追赶惹怒者。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME's blood bumps furiously when it gets mad, which often happens because something stepped on it. Its disembodied feet are actually magnetically linked to the blood in its circulatory system, allowing it to give chase to any objects of its ire.

entry: POKENAME平时把下方双臂紧收，维持防御。可一旦怒到极点，就会四臂狂攻，直到把目标打昏。
author: sk372
source: Normally POKENAME keeps its lower arms tucked close to keep its guard up, but if it truly gets beyond angry at something, it will unleash four-armed fury on its target until it is pummeled into unconsciousness.

entry: POKENAME一直怒，速度却太慢，追不上敌人。只好拿尾巴打自己泄愤，不过拳头几乎不疼。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are always angry, though their slow speed leaves them unable to chase down foes. Instead, they choose to take this anger out on themselves using their tails, though these punches hardly hurt.

entry: POKENAME战斗时，总被玩自己尾巴的猴怪分心。干扰让防御空虚，对手都快打中了，它才注意到。
author: bigoljax
source: During battle, POKENAME will constantly get distracted by the Mankey that plays with its tail. Due to this interference, it leaves itself vulnerable to its opponent, not noticing the upcoming attack until it's about to get hit.

entry: POKENAME永远愤怒，把全部怒气、磁力和电力导入头顶拳头。它因此以离谱速度飞向敌人，将全身化作强力一拳。
author: sk372
source: Perpetually angry, POKENAME channels all of its anger, magnetism, and electricity into the fist on its cranium. This causes it to fly towards enemies at ludicrous speeds to deliver a powerful full-body punch.

entry: POKENAME不高兴，就挥舞猴怪之爪威吓别人。不过由于某种神秘力量，这只爪很少打中。
author: quackquackattack
source: Whenever POKENAME is upset, it flails its Mankey Paw to intimidate others. It rarely lands a hit with this paw due to some mysterious force.

entry: POKENAME游泳时，会拍打冰山炫耀力量。若打不裂，它便自尊受挫，暴怒攻击附近一切。
author: .izik
source: While swimming, POKENAME swats at icebergs to show off its strength. If it fails to crack one, it enters a rage and lashes out at anything nearby in wounded frustration.

entry: POKENAME生气，会产生强效气体，让吸入者暴怒。它不免疫自己的气体，因此必然陷入恶性循环。
author: empty_set
source: When POKENAME gets angry, it produces a potent gas that enrages anyone who inhales it.  Since it is not immune to its own gas, this inevitably leads to a vicious cycle.

entry: POKENAME用锋利双手抓其他宝可梦，吓它们远离领地。一个眼神不对，就能让它陷入难控制的怒气。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME swipe at other Pokémon with their sharp hands to scare them away from their territory. One wrong glance at a POKENAME can send them into a rage that is difficult to control.

entry: POKENAME卑鄙地用摆锤催眠敌人，取得明显优势。对手一进入梦乡，它便背信地挥出强拳。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME despicably uses its pendulum to put its opponents to sleep, and gain a clear advantage. As soon as its enemies enter the world of dreams, it treacherously strikes them with powerful punches.

entry: POKENAME整天晒太阳保暖，能从背上球茎射出燃烧种子。不过种子有限，再长一批需要时间。
author: mcnchsschl_69424
source: POKENAME lies in the sun all day to keep warm, and it is able to shoot burning seeds from the bulb on its back. However, it only has a limited number of seeds, and growing more takes a while.

entry: 大群POKENAME住在树梢。有什么走过栖树下方，整群就会同时伏击。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: Large packs of POKENAME live in treetops. If anything walks under the trees where a pack lives, the entire group ambushes them at once.

entry: POKENAME带着燃烧的骨棒，照亮夜路。遇到同类，按习俗交换棍棒、嚎叫，再各自上路。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME carry flaming bone clubs that light their path at night. When they meet another POKENAME, it is customary for them to swap clubs and howl before continuing on their way.

entry: POKENAME喜欢陪训练家玩抛接，会开心挖骨头带来，方便游戏。兴奋追骨时，沿途留着火星和焦草。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME love playing fetch with their Trainer and will happily dig up and provide a bone to make playing easier. When they are excited, they leave behind embers and charred grass as they chase after the bone.

entry: POKENAME既有强劲踢击，也能把四肢加热到灼烫。挑架的生物，常带着身上的爪印灼痕逃走。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME pairs strong kicks with the ability to heat up its limbs to a scalding degree. Those who pick fights with it often wind up retreating with paw-print-shaped burns on their body.

entry: 谁太靠近训练家，POKENAME就吐毒气，再用火花点燃，展现对排出气体的完美控制。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spits out toxic gas when anyone gets too close to its Trainer. The gas is then ignited with an Ember attack, showcasing its perfect control of its emissions.

entry: 宝可梦培育屋常雇POKENAME，照料偶尔发现的蛋。它乐在其中，用腹毛把蛋裹得温暖舒适。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are often employed by Pokémon Daycares to take care of any Pokémon eggs that happen to be found. They take great delight in their role, keeping the eggs warm and cosy in their belly fur.

entry: POKENAME不喜欢藤蔓被清洁，会喷嚏带火星，表达反对。造型师通常得先分散注意，才能整理得像样。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME does not like to have its vines cleaned and expresses dissent by sneezing out embers. It usually needs to be distracted while a stylist fashions its vines into something presentable.

entry: 救生艇团队会用一群POKENAME，救回被卷出海的人。敏锐嗅觉和浮力，让它找到水中挣扎者，安全引向救生艇。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Schools of POKENAME are used by lifeboat crews to help rescue people who are swept out to sea. Their keen sense of smell and buoyant bodies let them find people struggling in the water, then safely guide them to the lifeboat.

entry: POKENAME群色彩醒目，深受水族馆珍视。不过它会把栖水加热，常烫得厉害，很难与其他水属性同缸养。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME shoals are prized by aquariums for their striking colouration. They are difficult to keep in tanks with other Water-type Pokémon due to their habit of heating the water they live in, often resulting in scalding temperatures.

entry: POKENAME坐在温泉底，以天然体热调水温。发现杂质，就会不安地轻吠。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME sits at the bottom of hot springs, where it regulates water temperatures using its natural body heat. It lets out small barks of distress whenever it detects impurities in the water.

entry: 凭嗅觉就能轻松找到同类。追踪时会摇摆臀部，路过人们身边时还常常致意。
author: houndrys.
source: Thanks to its sense of smell, it can easily find others of its kind. It sways its hips while tracking and often salutes people while passing by.

entry: POKENAME平时乖顺，遇到同类却很争强。双方不顾周围，比赛谁更会喷火，主人得做好防范。
author: sk372
source: It is usually well-behaved, but becomes very competitive in the presence of another POKENAME. The different POKENAME will try to outdo the other in fire-breathing prowess, regardless of surroundings, so owners should take precautions.

entry: POKENAME忠诚爱玩，热情有时有点麻烦。训练家一来，它就忍不住兴奋冲上去，常因体形和力量把人撞倒。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is loyal and playful to a degree that can be a bit troublesome. It can't help but run at its Trainer in excitement when they arrive, often leading to it knocking them down due to its size and strength.

entry: POKENAME从嘴喷小火，驱赶想抓它的捕食者。头角产的神经毒素，能让肌肉组织虚弱好几个小时。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME breathes small flames from its mouth to deter predators attempting to capture it. The horn on its head produces a neurotoxin capable of weakening muscle tissue for hours.

entry: POKENAME靠敏锐的嗅觉和利爪，在潮池附近挖食物。记录显示，古代沿海聚落中，它就已与人亲近。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's keen smell and sharp claws aid them when digging for food around tide pools. Records show that they were close to humans in ancient coastal settlements.

entry: POKENAME全身毛极柔软，很受宝可梦华丽大赛评委和其他选美赛看重。每年换毛数次，新毛比旧毛更飘逸闪亮。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME's body is covered in incredibly soft fur, highly prized by Pokémon Contest judges and other beauty competitions. It molts several times a year, shedding old fur to grow an even more flowing and shiny coat.

entry: POKENAME全身毛极柔软，很受宝可梦华丽大赛评委和其他选美赛看重。每年换毛数次，新毛比旧毛更飘逸闪亮。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME's body is covered in incredibly soft fur, highly prized by Pokémon Contest judges and other beauty competitions. It molts several times a year, shedding old fur to grow an even more flowing and shiny coat.

entry: POKENAME领地意识极强，恶名来自巢里飞出的大群个体，个个拍着棉絮般的翅膀。看见威胁，它就用爪勾住，不断用毒刺扎。据说扎一下，比活活烧死还疼。
author: ghostslythe
source: Extremely territorial, POKENAME hives are infamous for the swarms they produce, flying upon cottony wings. If it sees a threat, it will hook onto them with its claws and sting ceaselessly. It is said one sting hurts worse than being burned alive.

entry: POKENAME是能浮空的小小幼犬宝可梦，火焰比太阳还热。忠诚与嗅觉都强得惊人。
author: smallcutekitty
source: POKENAME is a tiny, floating puppy Pokémon, and its flames are hotter than the sun. It has an insane sense of loyalty and smell.

entry: POKENAME是能浮空的幼犬宝可梦，用意念操纵火焰。友善而忠诚，为了训练家什么都愿意做。
author: smallcutekitty
source: POKENAME is a floating puppy Pokémon. It can control fire with its mind. It is very friendly and loyal, and it will do anything for its Trainer.

entry: POKENAME发现训练家惊恐发作，会靠体热和毛安抚，紧偎着，确保对方休息。等恢复后，它再退开，留出喘息空间。
author: quackquackattack
source: Whenever POKENAME finds that its Trainer is having a panic attack, it relies on its heat and fur to comfort them, clinging to its Trainer to make sure they take a break. Once its Trainer has recovered, it backs off to give space to breathe.

entry: POKENAME好奇得什么都要用嘴探一探，出了名地难养。训练家既要留意，也要耐心，否则无尽好奇可能惹出意外的乱子。
author: rakunk
source: POKENAME is notoriously difficult to raise due to its curious nature and instinct to investigate everything using its mouth. Trainers must be vigilant and patient, as its relentless curiosity can cause unintended chaos if not properly managed.

entry: 它在巢周300英尺范围飞行，提防阿柏怪等捕食者。发现危险，就使出凶猛的吼叫，吓退对方。
author: .izik
source: It flies in a 300 foot area around its nest, keeping watch for predators like Arbok. If it spots danger, it lets out a fierce Roar to scare them away.

entry: 主人摸POKENAME时，它会像节拍器一样左右摇身。这可爱习惯，是开心的表示。
author: .izik
source: When being petted by its master, POKENAME wobbles its body back and forth like a metronome. This endearing habit is a sign of its happiness.

entry: POKENAME是优秀的夜间猎手，嗅觉、视力都极佳。许多个体与夜班警察和保安配对，帮忙发现、追赶嫌疑者。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is an excellent nocturnal hunter, with superb senses of smell and sight. Many have become partners paired with night-shift policemen and security guards to help spot and chase suspects.

entry: POKENAME玩抛接时，会急切地用网从远处接棍，常在落地前就抓住。有时收回来，却换它扔，等训练家也去捡。
author: sk372
source: A POKENAME playing fetch will use its webbing to eagerly catch the stick from afar, often before it even hits the ground. Sometimes after reeling it back, it will throw the stick instead, expecting its Trainer to fetch, too.

entry: POKENAME领地意识强。即使用吠叫、火焰赶走入侵者，也可能循味飞追，继续教训。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has strong territorial instincts. Even if it drives off an intruder with its barks or flames, it may follow their scent and fly after them to continue teaching them a lesson.

entry: POKENAME很容易兴奋，训练家干什么都热情想加入。它常试着用火帮忙，却不小心引发火灾。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are easily excitable, showing great enthusiasm when trying to join in with whatever their trainer is doing. They are prone to trying to use their fire powers to help out, inadvertently starting fires in the process.

entry: POKENAME通常喜欢信任者的抚摸，尤其喙下。不过突然伸手，它就会本能瞬间移动，躲到一段距离外。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME typically likes physical affection from those it trusts, especially just under their beak. However, suddenly touching them will have them instinctively teleport away some distance.

entry: POKENAME在沸水里也能轻松游泳，偏爱间歇泉附近，酷热让它生活得很好。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME can swim effortlessly in boiling water. It prefers to live near geysers, where it thrives in the intense heat.

entry: 寒冷地区，POKENAME常与救生员合作，跳进冰水，救起挣扎者。身体温暖又有浮力，能护着人游岸，抵御严寒。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME often work alongside lifeguards in cold regions, leaping into the water to rescue anyone who appears to be struggling in the icy waters. Their buoyant and warm body help them keep people safe, staving off the cold while they swim to shore.

entry: POKENAME毛发防水，离水很快就干。泳装公司有整系列衣物，都用它的毛织成。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME fur is water repellent, enabling them to dry off rapidly when they leave the water. Swimwear companies have entire lines of clothing that are woven with POKENAME fur.

entry: POKENAME用火花熔化乳酪，再舔着吃。这特别习惯，让喜爱它聪明劲的训练家更喜欢它。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME melts cheese with an Ember before licking it up with its tongue. This unique habit has made it a favorite among Trainers who enjoy its cleverness.

entry: POKENAME在水边悠闲待着，能闻到鱼群接近。鱼游过就想大吃，不过准头很差，常扑空，再嘟囔着回岸边。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME lounges near water, able to pick up the scent of schools of fish approaching it. As they pass by, it tries to feast, though its aim is fairly poor and often misses them, grumbling as it returns to the waterside.

entry: POKENAME最重忠诚，挑训练家极严。哪怕分离很久，也不会忘掉对方气味。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME value loyalty above all else and are very picky about their Trainers. They never forget the scents of their Trainers, even if they are separated for a long time.

entry: POKENAME背上球茎沉重，连站立都费劲。叶片看似岩石，其实很柔软。
author: mcnchsschl_69424
source: The heavy bulb on POKENAME's back makes it hard for it to stand. While its leaves may look like rock, they're actually quite soft.

entry: 古人将POKENAME描绘成忠诚的伙伴。如今，谁迷失在它栖息的遗迹，它便会悄悄指引。
author: serversizeme
source: POKENAME is a depiction of a loyal companion to ancient people. It will subtly guide those who end up lost in the ruins it inhabits.

entry: POKENAME不停守领地，以吓人的吠声赶入侵者。不过除非直接受挑衅，它并不会真动手。
author: lycanw_8d
source: POKENAME endlessly guards its territory, driving away intruders with its intimidating bark. It does not actually attack these trespassers unless directly provoked, however.

entry: 寒冷地区的年轻训练家，喜欢POKENAME忠诚、爱依偎的性格。暖毛很适合严冬夜里抱着。
author: .izik
source: In cold regions, young Trainers collect POKENAME for their loyalty and cuddly nature. Their warm fur is perfect for nightly snuggles during harsh winters.

entry: POKENAME爱听训练家夸，因此对战总尽全力。害怕时，它便呜咽，寻找训练家。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME loves being praised by their Trainers, so they always do their best during a Pokémon battle. Whenever they feel scared, they whimper and try to find their Trainer.

entry: 人们会用成群POKENAME，从熔岩流中抢救尚未毁坏的贵重物。它们在熔岩划行，头露在熔岩流上方，妥善护住救出的东西。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Packs of POKENAME are used to rescue precious belongings from lava flows before they can be destroyed. POKENAME paddle through the molten rock with their heads held above the flow, holding the rescued items safely out of harm's way.

entry: POKENAME极善感知疼痛。它体小温暖，肌肉痉挛严重的训练家会训练它长时间趴在身上。
author: beetlething
source: POKENAME are incredibly talented at sensing when someone is in pain. Trainers with bad muscle cramps will train POKENAME to lay on them for long periods of time, as it is warm and small.

entry: POKENAME通常住在极地冻原，在毛下加热身体保暖。常用火烤猎物，不过火并不很热。
author: yaboydecky1234
source: POKENAME normally live in the arctic tundra, heating their bodies under their coats to stay warm. They tend to cook what they catch with their fire, but it isn't all that hot.

entry: POKENAME常显得想与所有生物相处。它从蓬松尾巴掏出一条火舌当礼物，却不明白为什么惹来惊慌。
author: pattybgoode
source: POKENAME frequently reflects a desire to get along with everyone. Reaching into its fluffy tail, it presents a tongue of flame as a gift, confused at the panic it causes.

entry: POKENAME看似吓人，却是最忠诚的宝可梦之一。它反映训练家，讨好主人时，从普通障碍训练到凶恶犯罪，什么都肯做。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME may seem intimidating but are some of the most loyal Pokémon in existence. They are a reflection of their Trainer and will do anything from mundane obstacle courses to heinous crimes to please their master.

entry: POKENAME在草原结群。未融合的阿柏蛇会害怕逃走，未融合的卡蒂狗却偶尔猎食它，因此物种间交集很少。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME lives in grasslands as a pack. Unfused Ekans flee from them in fear, while unfused Growlithe may rarely hunt them, leading to little interaction between the species.

entry: POKENAME的角能察觉靠近领地者的心跳。捕食者将近，它就用强力吼叫保护家园。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's antlers detect the heartbeats of anyone approaching its territory. If a predator is near, it unleashes a powerful Roar to protect its home.

entry: POKENAME会在喜欢的东西上留下火热的吻痕。它讨厌脏，一弄脏就会尽快把自己清理干净。
author: houndrys.
source: When POKENAME finds something it enjoys, it leaves a firey kiss mark on it. It hates being dirty and will clean itself up as soon as possible.

entry: POKENAME常参与山地救援，帮宝可梦巡护员寻找山体滑坡后失踪的登山男。夜里生火照路，找到人，就举高火焰提醒训练家。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are often put to work in mountain rescue, helping Pokémon Rangers search for lost Hikers after landslides. At night, they create flames to help light the way, raising their fire high to alert their Trainer when they find someone.

entry: POKENAME常参与山地救援，帮宝可梦巡护员寻找山体滑坡后失踪的登山男。它用力量挪开巨石、瓦砾，找到人就大声吠，提醒训练家。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are often put to work in mountain rescue, helping Pokémon Rangers search for lost Hikers after landslides. They use their strength to shift boulders and rubble out of the way, barking loudly to alert their Trainers when they find someone.

entry: POKENAME雷暴中会吠叫，配合闪电落下的节奏。玩心十足的习惯，让喜欢它活力的训练家很欢迎。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME barks during thunderstorms, timing its cries with lightning strikes. This playful habit makes it popular among Trainers who love its energetic personality.

entry: POKENAME害怕，蓬松球体就会变得很热。野外最好别偷靠近，否则它会朝敌人吐热石。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's fluffy spheres can get very hot when it is scared. Sneaking up on POKENAME in the wild is unwise, as it will spit hot pebbles at foes.

entry: POKENAME在领地兴奋跳跃，成群追逐鸟宝可梦吃。战斗时，吠声会朝敌人喷出带电火焰。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME bound about their territories with enthusiasm, packs of them chasing down bird Pokémon for food. During battle, they bark out blasts of electrical fire at their foes.

entry: POKENAME帮助消防员处理电气火灾，能毫发无伤冲进燃烧建筑，吸走住宅供电处的电力，让消防员安全灭火。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME aid firefighters in combating electrical fires. They are able to rush into burning buildings without risking injury, and then drain the electricity from the power source for the house, enabling firefighters to extinguish the blaze safely.

entry: POKENAME柔毛能做极软毛衣，完美抵御最冷气温。夏天毛长得太长，连眼睛也盖住。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME's soft coat is used to make extremely soft sweaters that insulate perfectly against the coldest temperatures. In summer, its fur grows so long that it even covers its eyes.

entry: POKENAME坚定守护栖居的森林，抵御入侵者。它常叼着闷烧木棍，让自己显得更严肃吓人。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME steadfastly guards the forests it inhabits from intruders. It often carries a smoldering stick in its mouth in order to make itself seem more serious and intimidating.

entry: 陶艺工作室常雇POKENAME，帮忙准备待入窑的陶器。它产的水带着微量灰烬，能给新塑陶器上釉。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Pottery studios frequently employ POKENAME to help with preparing ceramics for the kiln. The water they produce contains traces of ash, allowing it to acts as a glaze for the freshly sculpted ceramics.

entry: 陶艺工作室常雇POKENAME，帮忙准备待入窑的陶器。头鳍对温度极敏感，能监测窑炉，再用火花保持最佳温度。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Pottery studios frequently employ POKENAME to help with preparing ceramics for the kiln. Their head fin is particularly sensitive to temperature, allowing them to monitor kilns and keep them at the perfect temperature with their Ember attacks.

entry: POKENAME用泥衬洞，喷火烤干，造出干爽的育幼处。暴风雨时，它让小型宝可梦共用巢穴，避开恶劣天气。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME line their dens with mud, baking it with their flames to form a dry place to raise their young. During stormy weather, they allow smaller Pokémon to share their den with them, keeping them safe from the poor weather.

entry: POKENAME与工程师合作，在海滩建防风暴工事。强壮肌肉把巨石摆好，再用喷射火焰轰击，熔成一整面坚固墙。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME work with engineers to create storm defences along beaches. They use their powerful muscles to move boulders into place before blasting the rocks with Flamethrowers, melting the barriers into a single solid wall.

entry: POKENAME活跃、擅长运动，爱陪同伴玩，却很少陪陌生者。每小时响亮的嚎叫，表示正在守领地，绝不容闯入。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME are very active, athletic Pokémon who love to play with their companions and rarely with strangers. Loud, hourly howls from POKENAME signal that they are actively guarding their territory and will not tolerate any trespassers.

entry: POKENAME先向敌人吐毒，让其变慢，再以猛烈的火花解决。这样的组合，让它成为熟练猎手。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spits poison at enemies to slow them down before finishing them off with a fierce Ember. This combination makes it a skilled hunter.

entry: POKENAME用鲜艳花朵吸收太阳能量。嗅觉能察觉情绪，花香也能让人平静下来。
author: mcnchsschl_69424
source: POKENAME uses its brightly colored flower to absorb energy from the sun. It can detect others' emotions with its sense of smell, and the aroma of its flower is known to calm people down.

entry: POKENAME受威胁，毛间就会散出淡淡毒雾，阻止捕食者靠太近。它奋力护地盘，先大声吠，再用毒牙咬。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's fur emits a faint, toxic mist when threatened, discouraging predators from getting too close. It fiercely protects its territory, barking loudly before delivering venomous bites.

entry: POKENAME一兴奋，就顾不上四周，不管障碍，直往前冲。野生个体能撞断粗树，家养个体则常把前门撞掉。
author: milchik
source: When excited, these Pokémon stop paying attention to their surroundings and rush forward despite any obstacles. In the wild, a charging POKENAME can break a thick tree in half, while domesticated POKENAME often break the front doors off.

entry: POKENAME嗅觉敏锐，一闻到陌生气味，就会发出雷鸣般的低吼，不必挪动就能吓走入侵者。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME has a keen sense of smell. If it detects any unfamiliar scent, it will growl like thunder, frightening away any intruders into its territory without needing to move.

entry: 野生POKENAME群合作防守大片领地，合力控火，抵御大得多的敌人。它们很吵，还离得极远，就能听见将近。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME packs work together in the wild to defend large territories from much bigger Pokémon, relying on their combined control over fire to fend off aggressors. They are noisy Pokémon and can be heard approaching from great distances.

entry: POKENAME平时乖顺，若突然捣乱，往往是在向训练家传达什么。例如院子里突然挖出许多洞，就代表地震将至。
author: sk372
source: Normally well-behaved, a POKENAME acting out is a sign of it trying to tell its Trainer something. For instance, digging many holes in the yard suddenly is a sign an earthquake is approaching.

entry: 它朝地面喷小火加温，休息时便干爽舒适，也让头叶长得更快。背壳一开裂，就会去泥里打滚，直到完全修复。
author: fiordaliso
source: It breathes small flames onto the ground to warm it, keeping itself dry and comfortable while resting and speeding up the growth of the leaves on its head. When the shell on its back begins to crack, it rolls in mud until it is fully restored.

entry: POKENAME毛间散出的暖意，很适合催熟背上的麦子。加上平静听话的性格，让农夫十分看重。
author: fiordaliso
source: The warmth radiating from POKENAME's fur is ideal for ripening the wheat stalks growing along its back. It is highly valued by farmers not only for this trait but also for its calm and obedient temperament.

entry: 玩抛接时，POKENAME大耳朵快速抖动。捡回东西后，它还会开心朝天喷火。
author: .izik
source: When playing fetch, POKENAME's large ears twitch rapidly. After retrieving the item, it shoots flames into the air with delight.

entry: POKENAME只让自己认可的高尚英雄持用。若察觉别有用心者的恶意，就会燃起自身。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME allows itself to be wielded by those it considers to be a noble hero, but lights itself ablaze when it senses evil intent in another.

entry: POKENAME尖牙滴着轻毒，先削弱猎物，再用烈火吐息攻击。若被激怒，它会毫无畏惧地冲锋，裹上火焰增强攻势。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's sharp fangs drip with a mild toxin, weakening prey before it strikes with fiery breath. If enraged, it charges fearlessly, coating its body in flames to increase its attack power.

entry: POKENAME用幻象变成人最珍爱的宠物，只想多交朋友、让大家开心，尽可能陪着玩。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME casts an illusion over itself to take on the form of a person's most cherished pet. It does this because it wants to make as many friends, make them happy and play with them as much as possible.

entry: POKENAME是普通人最爱养的宠物之一，对主人极为忠诚。
author: melodydelune
source: One of the most popular pets among non-Trainers, POKENAME are extremely loyal and faithful to their owners.

entry: 无论晴朗还是多云，POKENAME夜里总会对月嚎叫。群体太吵，许多疲惫的宝可梦都会避开它们出没的地方。
author: quackquackattack
source: Whether the sky is clear or cloudy, POKENAME will always howl at the moon at night. Packs of POKENAME cause so much noise that many tired Pokémon avoid areas where they are found.

entry: POKENAME忠诚，很快就依恋训练家。它用大耳朵裹住别人，表达喜爱，持续的耳热也能让对方暖和。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is highly loyal and grows attached to its Trainer quickly. It wraps its large ears around others as a sign of affection, warming them up with the heat its ears constantly radiate.

entry: POKENAME玩抛接，六尾会亮成鲜橙色。不过太兴奋，可能不小心朝旁边喷火。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's six tails glow bright orange when it plays fetch. When it gets too excited, it may unintentionally spit flames at those nearby.

entry: POKENAME行为年幼，头脑却极聪明，在难以配备安保系统的住家很受欢迎。它会在领地边界布置小鬼火，灼烧入侵者。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME are extremely intelligent despite their youthful behavior, making them popular guard Pokémon for homesteads where security systems are inaccessible. They place small will-o-wisps along the border of their territory that burn intruders.

entry: POKENAME听见或闻见别的宝可梦靠近，就会大声吠，却仍趴着不动。牙虽锋利、火光闪动，它却很少咬东西。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME will bark loudly if it hears or smells another Pokémon approaching, but will continue to lie flat on the ground. Although its teeth are sharp and flicker with flames, it rarely bites anything.

entry: POKENAME护地盘，却受不了在同处待太久。每过几天就会搬走，再开始驱逐新领地里的其他宝可梦。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME are highly protective of their territory, but get bored with remaining in the same place for too long. Every few days, they will relocate and start chasing other Pokémon out of their new territory.

entry: POKENAME毛间静电噼啪，兴奋就闪火花。陪训练家玩时，它会开心猛扑，释放无害的阵阵火焰与电光。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's fur crackles with static, sparking with electricity whenever it gets excited. When playing with its Trainer, it joyfully pounces while releasing harmless bursts of flame and lightning.

entry: 这种宝可梦常被养作辅助宠物，嗅探训练家的健康状况。哪怕极小的问题也能察觉，方便在严重之前发现、治疗。
author: lydiaprower8
source: This Pokémon is commonly owned as a service pet to sniff out and scan for conditions in its Trainer. It can sniff out the tiniest problems, ensuring they can be detected and treated before it gets serious.

entry: POKENAME释放热空气，为训练家保暖。格外寒冷时，还会点燃小枝，让大家舒适。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME release hot air from their bodies to keep Trainers warm. When it is especially cold they light twigs on fire to ensure everyone is comfy.

entry: POKENAME吃火山边的热石，保持核心温暖。这样的火热饮食，让它能承受极高温。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME eats hot rocks near volcanoes to keep its core warm. This fiery diet makes it resilient to extreme heat.

entry: POKENAME住在沙漠，挖沙洞捕捉钻地宝可梦。它靠喘气降温，长舌常松垮地垂在嘴外。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME is found in deserts, where it digs holes into the sand to catch burrowing Pokémon. Its long tongue often flops outside of its mouth, as it relies on panting to keep its body cool.

entry: POKENAME连水里也能追气味。搜救时，踪迹即使入水，它也追得上，是极珍贵的帮手。不过离开训练家会让它难过。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME can pick up scents even in water. This has made them invaluable in search and rescue operations in which a scent trail enters water, as POKENAME is still able to follow it. Being away from their Trainer makes them sad.

entry: POKENAME连水里也能追气味。搜救时，踪迹即使入水，它也追得上，是极珍贵的帮手，因此很受警员欢迎。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME can pick up scents even in water. This has made them invaluable in search and rescue operations in which a scent trail enters water, as POKENAME is still able to follow it. For this, they are popular Pokémon amongst police officers.

entry: POKENAME友善好奇，四处漂游，嗅闻、记住数百种气味。嘉年华常把它作为孩子赢小游戏的奖品。
author: sk372
source: Friendly and curious, POKENAME floats around sniffing and memorizing hundreds of scents. Carnivals often offer POKENAME up to children as a prize for winning at their games.

entry: 接触POKENAME需要特殊手套，因为凝胶一碰就能烫伤人皮肤。它似乎不知自己危险，野生个体仍热切地滚到人旁，求关注。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME require special gloves to handle, as their gel is hot enough to burn human skin on contact. They seem unaware of the danger they can pose, with wild POKENAME eagerly rolling up to people for attention.

entry: POKENAME先沾满灰，再飘过刚烧毁的森林。均匀撒灰的行为，能帮助当地植物重新生长。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME dips itself in ash before floating over recently burnt forests. This behavior helps regrow local flora by dispersing the ash evenly.

entry: 训练家一扔东西，POKENAME就从嘴射出一团黏稠、极易燃的丝，半空接住。它能迅速织复杂的网，再点火，伤害落网宝可梦。
author: fiordaliso
source: When its Trainer throws an object, POKENAME catches it mid-air, shooting a mass of viscous, highly flammable silk from its mouth. It can quickly create intricate webs and set them on fire to damage Pokémon that get caught in them.

entry: POKENAME的毒能造成轻度灼伤。伤口散发只有它闻得到的气味，即使目标逃掉，也能追踪。
author: drcew
source: POKENAME is able to release a venom that causes minor burns. These burns emit a scent only POKENAME can detect, allowing POKENAME to track its target if they manage to escape.

entry: POKENAME滚动前进，火花点燃地面。仰躺时，柔软温暖的肚子，很适合让信任的同伴揉。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME rolls along, lighting the ground on fire with sparks. When on its back, its soft, warm tummy invites trusted companions to rub it.

entry: POKENAME个头大，却是温柔巨人、忠诚伙伴。不过面对敌人，它会毫不犹豫地用体形和利齿威吓。食欲旺盛，每天得吃大量食物维持精力。
author: chibitales
source: Despite their size, POKENAME are gentle giants and loyal companions. Even so, they will not hesitate to use their size and sharp teeth to intimidate foes. They have voracious appetites and require a large amount of food daily to keep up their energy.

entry: POKENAME受威胁，头上叶状毛就容易起火。燃烧还释放刺鼻气味，帮助吓退捕食者。
author: sk372
source: The leaf-like hair on POKENAME's head tends to ignite when it feels threatened. The burning flame also makes it emit an acrid aroma that helps deter predators.

entry: 训练家回家，POKENAME会用欢迎舞和欢快吠声迎接。舞动时散发热量，让从严寒里归来的人很舒适。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME will greet a Trainer returning home with a welcoming dance and cheerful barks. It radiates heat during the movements, so those coming in from the cold find it very refreshing.

entry: POKENAME可爱蓬松，许多训练家都想在野外找到。可兴奋时，吠声比演唱会还响，还会绕圈飞，散出浓烟。
author: ghostslythe
source: Due to its cute and fluffy nature, many Trainers seek POKENAME in the wild. Unfortunately, when excited its barks echo louder than a concert, and it flies around in circles spreading thick smoke.

entry: POKENAME忠诚护主，无论训练家在哪间房，都在外面站岗。它点燃手掌警告潜在入侵者，核心发出低沉隆隆的吼声。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is very loyal and protective of its Trainer, standing watch outside any room they inhabit. It ignites its palms as a warning to potential intruders, with a low rumbling growl emanating from its core.

entry: POKENAME身体像棉花一样软乎乎，柔软得出奇。它用火点燃木头，造出温暖灰烬，好舒适地睡觉。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body is as squishy as cotton, making it surprisingly soft. It sets logs ablaze with its flames, creating warm ashes for a comfortable sleep.

entry: POKENAME忠诚护主，温暖又蓬松，是受欢迎的伙伴与吉祥物。它们常控制不好力道，好在软绒身体通常能免去重伤。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are fiercely loyal and protective, their warmth and fluffiness making them popular companions and mascots. They often have some trouble controlling their own strength, but their plushiness usually keeps anyone from getting too hurt.

entry: POKENAME与警员合作，用有力却不致命的拥抱，让嫌疑者动不了。令人安心的外表，常让罪犯放松警惕，足够将其逮住。
author: rakunk
source: POKENAME works alongside police officers, subduing suspects with powerful, non-lethal hugs that leave targets unable to move.  Its comforting appearance often disarms criminals long enough for capture.

entry: POKENAME轻松跃下树，用火焰踢击攻击。敏捷精准的身手，让它成为可怕猎手。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME leaps from trees with ease, delivering flaming kicks to foes. Its agility and precision make it a fearsome predator.

entry: POKENAME发现训练家难过，就舔脸让对方振作。忠诚又有活力，很适合即将踏上旅程的年轻训练家。
author: fiordaliso
source: If it notices its Trainer feeling sad, POKENAME licks their face to lift their spirits again. It is a loyal, energetic Pokémon, well-suited for young Trainers about to set off on their journeys.

entry: POKENAME一找到能吃的腐树，就会格外护地盘。闻见陌生味，它便绕树奔跑、大声吠，想吓退潜在入侵者。
author: .jerden
source: Once POKENAME finds a rotting tree to feed on, it becomes incredibly territorial. If it smells an unfamiliar smell, it will try to frighten off any potential intruders by running in circles around the tree and barking loudly.

entry: 会装作小狗，向人类讨取食物与住处。但最终总会露出昆虫般的动作和习性，往往把人吓得发毛。
author: pokepower
source: It acts like a puppy to get food and shelter from humans. Its insectoid movement and behavior is eventually noticed, which usually creeps people out.

entry: POKENAME在餐馆帮忙，为客人的宝可梦送食。它把食物稳放头顶碗里，用控火能力保温。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME help out in restaurants, carrying food to the Pokémon belonging to diners. They balance the food in the bowl on their head, keeping it warm with their control over fire.

entry: POKENAME喷出可怕烈焰，阻止敌人靠近。性子虽冲动，却始终服从训练家，即使得压住本能。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME keeps its opponents at bay by breathing terrifying gouts of fire at them. Despite its impulsive temperament, it always obeys its Trainer's commands, even when that means holding back its own instincts.

entry: POKENAME穿过的土，之后仍能温暖数小时。若烦躁，泥土温度更会显著升高。
author: .izik
source: The soil POKENAME passes through remains warm for hours afterward. If it becomes agitated, the temperature of the dirt increases dramatically.

entry: POKENAME在火山灰里挖掘，大量吞食。吃饱后，体温会升到危险程度。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME burrows through volcanic ash to consume it in large quantities. Once full, its body temperature rises to dangerous levels.

entry: 最好从小教POKENAME尊重物品归属。它既爱亮硬币，又爱训练家，没教好就常偷硬币，送作礼物。
author: sk372
source: It is recommended to teach a POKENAME early about respecting ownership; its affection for shiny coins and its Trainer often leads untrained POKENAME to steal coins to present to its Trainer as gifts.

entry: POKENAME是忠诚的家养宠物，能闻出训练家烦恼，便蜷在身边呼噜，直到对方好过。它喜欢花园晒太阳、暖石蜷卧，也爱看鸟宝可梦来去。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME make for loyal house pets. They are able to smell when their trainer is upset and curl up beside them, purring until they feel better. They enjoy sunning themselves in gardens, curling up on warm rocks, and watching bird Pokémon come and go.

entry: POKENAME火攻用过头，就会严重偏头痛。它在河塘边筑巢，方便补水。
author: fiordaliso
source: If POKENAME overuses its fiery attacks, it suffers from a terrible migraine. It makes its den near lakes and ponds to stay hydrated.

entry: 据说卡蒂狗的自融合体会守护重要宝藏。不过若有幸拥有训练家，最珍爱的往往是主人，以及主人重视的事物。
author: infranscia
source: This self fusion of Growlithe is said to guard important treasures.  Though for one lucky enough to have a Trainer, the thing it treasures as most important is often its owner, and what they hold dear.

entry: POKENAME火焰太旺，流过身体、渗进毛里，仿佛根本容纳不下。不变的忠诚让它可靠听话，随时准备服从训练家。
author: fiordaliso
