source: Its flames burn so fiercely that fire flows across its body and seeps into its fur, as if POKENAME cannot contain it all. Its unwavering loyalty makes it a reliable, obedient partner, always ready to follow its Trainer's commands.

entry: POKENAME对训练家极忠诚，从不离身。条纹毛的光泽和尾焰亮度反映健康；火一暗，就说明生病或虚弱。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is extremely loyal to its Trainer, never leaving their side. The sheen of its striped fur and the brightness of the flame on its tail reflect its health; when the fire dims, it indicates that the Pokémon is sick or weak.

entry: POKENAME只需闻过一次，就知道对方的性情和生活习惯。它喜欢愉快陪伴，会瞬间移动到最近、觉得能给关注和点心的生物旁。
author: laughing_dan
source: Once POKENAME have smelt someone, they learn everything about their nature and living habits. POKENAME enjoy pleasant company and will teleport to the nearest creature they believe will give them attention and treats.

entry: POKENAME自己玩抛接，保持头脑敏锐。它把勺子远扔，再用精神力接回，测试能扔多远、收得多快。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME keeps its mind sharp by playing a game of fetch with itself. It flings its spoon into the distance, catching it with its psychic powers and bringing it back, testing how far it can throw and how quickly it can retrieve it.

entry: POKENAME想用肌力打动训练家，每天至少做一百个俯卧撑。战斗时点燃拳头，灼热拳击能烧伤敌人。
author: fiordaliso
source: To impress its Trainer with its muscular strength, POKENAME performs at least one hundred push-ups every day. In battle, it ignites its fists to deliver scorching punches capable of burning its foes.

entry: POKENAME想用肌力打动训练家，每天至少做一百个俯卧撑。战斗时点燃拳头，灼热拳击能烧伤敌人。
author: fiordaliso
source: To impress its Trainer with its muscular strength, POKENAME performs at least one hundred push-ups every day. In battle, it ignites its fists to deliver scorching punches capable of burning its foes.

entry: POKENAME漂在静池，偶尔睡着嚎叫。叫声让泡泡从水面下轻轻升起。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME floats on still ponds, occasionally howling in its sleep. This noise creates bubbles that rise gently from beneath the surface.

entry: POKENAME很像古代洗翠留下的卡蒂狗画像。身体圆、方便携带，又忠诚，许多训练家旅行时会让它抱在背上。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME bears a striking resemblance to historical depictions of Growlithe from the ancient Hisui region. Because of their round, portable shape and loyal nature, many Trainers will travel with POKENAME hugging their backs.

entry: POKENAME在草地奔跑，与同类玩抛接。鬃毛飞出小火星，夜里景象十分美丽。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME gallops through meadows, playing games of fetch with others of its kind. Tiny embers spark from its mane, creating a beautiful display at night.

entry: 野生POKENAME乖乖跟随群中年长的风速焰马。玩耍时，它们常互相竞速。
author: periperi_chicken
source: In the wild, POKENAME obediently follow the older Arcadash in their herd. POKENAME often race each other when playing.

entry: POKENAME懒得起身，便用精神力把食物拉近。发现入侵者，也更想继续睡，因此不适合守卫。
author: fiordaliso
source: Too lazy to get up, POKENAME uses its psychic powers to pull food toward itself. If it spots an intruder, it prefers to go back to sleep, so it is not ideal as a guard Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME在工厂漂游，确保设备温度安全。一有设备过热，它就会贴上去，试着吸收多余热量。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME floats around factories to ensure devices remain at a safe temperature. If any device begins to overheat, it will attempt to absorb the excess heat by pressing itself against the device.

entry: POKENAME是原本栖居寒水的水生宝可梦。虽然颚力强劲，最广为人知的却是容易训练，以及表演时精彩的把戏。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME are aquatic Pokémon traditionally found in frigid waters, and while they are known for their strong jaws, they are best recognised for their ease to train and the spectacular tricks they do at performances.

entry: POKENAME是原本栖居寒水的水生宝可梦。虽然颚力强劲，最广为人知的却是容易训练，以及表演时精彩的把戏。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME are aquatic Pokémon traditionally found in frigid waters, and while they are known for their strong jaws, they are best recognised for their ease to train and the spectacular tricks they do at performances.

entry: POKENAME喜欢待在废物处理区，帮忙消灭垃圾。它先把垃圾堆烧掉，再吞下还闷烧着的残渣。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME like to hang around waste disposal areas, helping with getting rid of trash. It burns up piles of garbage before gobbling up the smoldering refuse that remains.

entry: 它知道自己外形脏乱、气味难闻，别人很难靠近，却仍渴望陪伴。许多好心人怜惜它，不顾黏液和恶臭，带回家收养。
author: sk372
source: It knows its messy form and nasty smell make it difficult to be near, but it still pines for companionship. Many kind souls take pity on its plight and adopt it despite the goop and stench.

entry: POKENAME烦恼时，会让敌人深睡，陷入充满可怕火焰的噩梦。它用这能力，给对手留下长久创伤。
author: .izik
source: When upset, POKENAME puts enemies into a deep sleep filled with terrifying fire-filled nightmares. It uses this ability to cause lasting trauma in its foes.

entry: POKENAME摆锤有节奏地摇晃，会引许多卡蒂狗靠近火之石。它尽力鼓励进化，不过最终选择，仍由每只卡蒂狗自己决定。
author: quackquackattack
source: The rhythmic sway of POKENAME pendulums lures many Growlithe towards Fire Stones. POKENAME does their best to encourage evolution, but the choice is ultimately up to the individual Growlithe.

entry: POKENAME用灼热长鞭，阻止危险者靠近队友。紧张时，软毛会蒙上一层有毒皮屑。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME uses its searing whips to keep dangerous individuals away from its teammates. When nervous, its soft fur becomes coated in poisonous dandruff.

entry: POKENAME住在热带岛屿，每天绕岛边大步走动找食。三个头一找到吃的，就常为谁先咬而争吵。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME live on tropical islands, stomping around the island perimeter each day in search of food. Their trio of heads frequently squabble with one another over which gets the first bite when they find something to eat.

entry: POKENAME整夜流泪嚎叫，常被误以为悲伤。其实泪中的信息素，能帮助吸引伴侣。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME howls through the night with tears streaming from its eyes. Though mistaken for sorrow, the pheromones in its tears help it attract a mate.

entry: 人们自古就敬畏POKENAME在熔岩中迅速奔跑的身姿。威风凛凛的皮毛下，是极为坚韧的皮肤。
author: darkweavile428
source: People have long revered the sight of POKENAME running swiftly through lava. Beneath its majestic fur is extremely tough hide.

entry: POKENAME一动就容易掉毛，大型宝可梦想抓来吃，也会觉得不舒服。绒毛还常堵住过滤器，因此不适合养在水族箱。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME fur sheds easily as they move, making them unpleasant for larger Pokémon to try to catch and eat. The constant shedding makes them ill-suited to being kept in aquariums, as their fluff often clogs up the water filters.

entry: POKENAME虽然不是流线外形，仍能高速游泳，最高达100节。研究者发现，它把前方水加热至极高温，降低密度，借此迅速加速。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are capable of swimming at high speed despite lacking a hydrodynamic shape, achieving speeds of up to 100 knots. Researchers have determined that they superheat the water in front of them, reducing its density to allow rapid acceleration.

entry: 古老东方传说里，常提到POKENAME的速度和优雅。它一天能走数千英里，拍翼沿途留下火星。不过飞行释放的烟，吸入会中毒。
author: nyoomymph
source: Its speed and grace are spoken of in ancient Eastern legends. POKENAME can travel thousands of miles in one day, leaving trails of embers behind as its wings flutter. Inhaling the smoke it releases when flying can poison you.

entry: POKENAME创造看不见的易燃物，再点燃。火烧得够大，它就会盯着烈焰，被跳动的姿态迷住。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME creates invisible, flammable objects to burn. Once the fire is large enough, POKENAME will stare at the blazing flame, mesmerized by the way it moves.

entry: 古籍记载，它曾与人们同行，带来繁荣和温暖。一个飞吻之后，就会掀起烈焰风暴。
author: houndrys.
source: Ancient texts tell that it walked along people, granting them prosperity and warmth. If it blows a kiss, a storm of fire will follow.

entry: 帕底亚一项传统运动，会让POKENAME进竞技场，对阵只拿红斗篷的斗牛士。斗牛士通常就是训练家，双方合作表演高速冲撞与惊险擦身。
author: katieplaysgames
source: A traditional Paldean sport involves placing POKENAME within an arena, facing off against a matador wielding nothing but a red cape. The matador is usually the POKENAME's Trainer, the pair putting on a show of high-speed charges and near misses.

entry: 研究发现，POKENAME的愤怒粉，会依它喜不喜欢目标而产生不同效果。对敌人会引起发炎，对朋友则让其充满活力。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Research has shown that POKENAME's Rage Powder has different effects depending on if POKENAME likes the target or not. For enemies the powder causes inflammation; for friends it instead energizes them.

entry: POKENAME头和尾上的角，分泌很轻微的毒。作用随环境变化，灼烧、脱水、麻痹、失明、畏光、发冷、皮疹和麻木，都曾被报告。
author: sk372
source: The horns on POKENAME's head and tail secrete a very mild poison. The poison's effects vary depending on its surroundings: burning, dehydration, paralysis, blindness, light sensitivity, chills, rashes and numbness have all been reported.

entry: 常能见POKENAME优雅飞过海洋。鬃毛产生的小火花，景象颇受喜爱。不过野外的它十分凶猛。
author: zekkenbytheden
source: POKENAME are often seen gracefully flying over the ocean. Their mane can create small sparks that make for much-appreciated spectacles. In the wilderness, POKENAME are quite vicious.

entry: POKENAME是忠诚伙伴，能安全载训练家渡过熔岩湖。它从嘴里喷强力火球，无论如何也要护住背上乘客。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are loyal companions, safely ferrying their Trainers across lakes of lava. By spitting powerful fireballs from their mouths, these Pokémon will defend those on their backs no matter what.

entry: POKENAME在空地奔跑，快得雷声都追不上，鬃毛间热与电噼啪作响。传说全速冲刺时，它的爪便不再触地。
author: labreezy187
source: POKENAME races across open ground faster than thunder can follow, its mane crackling with heat and electricity. Legends say that when POKENAME breaks into a full sprint, its paws cease to touch the earth.

entry: POKENAME毛发持续散出强热，周围出现热浪扭曲。有些厨房用它保温，再靠敏锐嗅觉把关，避免食物因热烧焦或凝结成块。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME fur constantly radiates an intense heat, creating a heat shimmer around them. Some kitchens make use of POKENAME to help keep food warm, using their sensitive noses to ensure the food doesn't burn or curdle under the heat.

entry: POKENAME毛发持续散出强热，周围出现热浪扭曲。热得自己不舒服时，它便高速奔跑，借迎面气流降温。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME fur constantly radiates an intense heat, creating a heat shimmer around them. When the heat surrounding them grows too uncomfortable, POKENAME take off running at high speeds, using the air rushing past them to cool down.

entry: POKENAME游泳时，控火加热正前方的水，降低水的密度，提升速度。加上流线外壳，最快能达50节。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME use their control over fire to heat the water directly in front of them when they swim, reducing the density of the water and allowing them to increase their speed. Thanks to their hydrodynamic shell, they can reach speeds of up to 50 knots.

entry: 曾发现太古羽虫化石的甲壳带着烧焦切痕，说明POKENAME远古时可能是凶猛猎手。如今，它用燃烧镰刀先吓退想打架的对手，避免真交锋。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Anorith fossils have been found with burned gouges cut into their armour, suggesting POKENAME were vicious predators in the distant past. Modern POKENAME use their blazing scythes to scare off potential combatants before blows are ever exchanged.

entry: POKENAME快得出乎意料，会突进，以闪电般的劈开攻击。速度和反应让它绕敌穿行，闪避反击。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are deceptively fast Pokémon, lunging at their foes with lightning-quick Slashes. They use their speed and rapid reflexes to evade retaliatory blows, weaving around their foes in combat.

entry: POKENAME快得出乎意料，会突进，以闪电般的劈开攻击。镰刀状刃可加热灼敌，丰富它的战斗手段。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are deceptively fast Pokémon, lunging at their foes with lightning-quick Slashes. Their scythe-like blades can be heated to inflict burns on their foe, providing them additional tools in their skillset during battles.

entry: POKENAME的巢通常在燃煤发电厂，由带刺铁丝、煤灰和建筑保温材料组成。
author: .izik
source: The nest of an POKENAME is usually found in coal-powered power plants. It is made up of barbed wire, soot, and construction insulation.

entry: POKENAME产的蜜深橙色，味道很辣。守领地时，它把毒刺加热到炽亮，再高速冲锋。
author: fiordaliso
source: The honey POKENAME produces is deep orange and has a very spicy taste. It defends its territory by heating its stinger to incandescence and charging at great speed.

entry: POKENAME虽然力量强大，却极其友好，受威胁也不会直接诉诸暴力。有几位顶尖科学家，甚至以它为伙伴。
author: bigoljax
source: Though their power is great, POKENAME are incredibly friendly and never go straight to violence when threatened. A few top scientists even have POKENAME as partners.

entry: 格外寒冷的夜里，POKENAME会用火息点篝火保暖。它也常挑战其他飞行属性宝可梦，比赛谁飞得最快。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME uses its fiery breath to light bonfires and stay warm on especially cold nights. It often challenges other Flying-type Pokémon to flight races to see who is fastest.

entry: POKENAME的大喙能喷出熔化最坚硬金属的烈焰。它忠诚无比，保护训练家不惜一切，甚至牺牲生命。
author: fiordaliso
source: From POKENAME's large beak, it can unleash scorching flames capable of melting even the toughest metals. It is an absolutely loyal Pokémon that would do anything to protect its Trainer, even at the cost of its own life.

entry: POKENAME身子虽小，叫声却响，能惊吓、威慑别人。一生大部分时候，它都难储能，因此毛发噼啪带着静电。
author: infinex21
source: Despite how small their bodies are, POKENAME can let loose loud cries to startle or intimidate others. They struggle to store energy for much of their lives, so their fur crackles with static electricity.

entry: 研究者推测，POKENAME即使极速飞行，也能连飞数日不累。喙里喷出的喷射火焰，热得能熔钢。
author: chibitales
source: Researchers theorize POKENAME can fly for several days without tiring, even at extreme speeds. The Flamethrower it spews from its beak is hot enough to melt steel.

entry: POKENAME长耳连最轻的低语也能听见，远处有人呼救，就会赶去援助。毛总是温暖，生气后更会变得灼热。
author: fiordaliso
source: With its long ears, POKENAME can pick up even the faintest whispers. It uses this ability to rush to the aid of people calling for help, even from far away. Its fur is always warm, and when it becomes angry, it turns scorching hot.

entry: POKENAME摇着毛臂沙沙作响，像在模仿风吹树叶。它藏在树间，鲜艳颜色却很显眼，因此有人推测，它可能色盲。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME rustle their furry arms as though attempting to imitate the noise of leaves shaking in the breeze. They hide amongst trees despite their vivid colours making them easy to spot, leading some researchers to speculate they may be colour blind.

entry: POKENAME频频洗劫地窖，让许多餐馆索性饲养，由厨师好好训练。如今，它用火做乳酪火锅，拿剩余乳酪作奖励。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: The frequency of POKENAME raiding cellars has led to many restaurants domesticating POKENAME so that chefs may train them properly. Now, POKENAME use their flames to cook fondue, earning leftover cheese as a reward.

entry: POKENAME出了名地无忧无虑，喜欢悠闲晒太阳，让漂亮鬃毛吸满水。
author: shadanks
source: POKENAME is known for its legendarily carefree attitude. It loves to let its beautiful mane absorb water while lounging in the sun.

entry: POKENAME意志坚定，绝不违抗信任的训练家。历史上的描绘，常以它象征忠诚与勇气。
author: mepp.
source: Known for its resolute heart, POKENAME never defies a trusted Trainer's orders. It has been depicted across history as a symbol of loyalty and bravery.

entry: POKENAME背上球茎模仿火的颜色与动作，吓退捕食者。古人相信，用球茎制药能延寿，不过花瓣其实有剧毒。
author: wiz0z
source: The bulb on POKENAME's back mimics the color and movement of fire to scare off predators. Ancient peoples believed that medicine made from the bulbs could extend their lives. However, the petals are actually highly poisonous.

entry: POKENAME拼命保护训练家，谁敢太靠近，它就毫不犹豫攻击。尖牙能瞬间灼热，咬击威力惊人。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is fiercely protective of its Trainer and will not hesitate to attack anyone who dares come too close. Its fangs can grow scorching hot in an instant, making its bites devastatingly powerful.

entry: 成群POKENAME漂在古老洗翠遗迹周围，彼此移动似乎毫无规律。它围着当地研究者悬浮，若靠得太近，就合力喷射火焰。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Swarms of POKENAME float around ancient Hisuian ruins, moving around one another seemingly at random. They hover around researchers who are working near the ruins, launching co-ordinated Flamethrowers if they get too close.

entry: 成群POKENAME漂在古老洗翠遗迹周围，彼此移动似乎毫无规律。它好奇围着研究者，观看家园被记入笔记，一有新发现，就兴奋地飞快绕行。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Swarms of POKENAME float around ancient Hisuian ruins, moving around one another seemingly at random. They hover around researchers curiously, watching as notes are written about their home and eagerly racing around in excitement at new discoveries.

entry: POKENAME几乎从不逃避战斗，会用热空气胀起身体，猛烈反击。不过尾巴一遭袭，它就借同样的热气，以奇快速度逃跑。
author: lycanw_8d
source: POKENAME almost never runs away from a battle, instead generating powerful counterstrikes using hot air to inflate itself. When its tail is attacked, however, it runs away at uncanny speeds, propelling itself with that same hot air.

entry: POKENAME喜欢跳过叶丛，常不小心把叶点燃。多年训练后，家养个体会跑过小水池里的茶叶和树果，帮忙泡出新鲜草本茶。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME enjoy leaping through leaves, usually accidentally catching them on fire. Over the years, domestic POKENAME have been trained to run through tea leaves and berries in small pools to help brew new, fresh herbal teas.

entry: POKENAME从双翼喷出烈焰推进，时速最高180英里，用强劲的角贯穿敌人。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME propels itself by shooting intense flames from its wings. It can fly up to 180 mph, impaling its opponents with its powerful horn.

entry: POKENAME外表可怕，却警惕人类，躲进森林深处避开。不过谁威胁幼崽，它就暴怒，喷出足以把整片树林烧成灰的火焰。
author: fiordaliso
source: Despite its fearsome appearance, POKENAME is wary of humans and hides deep within the forest to avoid them. However, if anyone threatens its young, it flies into a rage and unleashes fiery blasts powerful enough to burn entire woods to ashes.

entry: POKENAME住在城市公园，仔细观察准备野餐的人。等注意力散开，它便极速冲前，抓食物塞进尾巴，留待以后吃。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME live within city parks, watching carefully for people settling down to have a picnic. They wait for the picnicker's attention to wander before racing forward at incredible speed, grabbing the food and stuffing it into their tail for later.

entry: POKENAME是热门的夜巡伙伴，夜视极佳，能发现闯入者，再大叫提醒守卫。它快得几乎任何逃跑者都追得上。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are popular for night patrols, their superb dark vision allowing them to spot trespassers whilst their loud cries alert guards. They are fast enough to chase down almost anyone who tries to flee from them.

entry: POKENAME常被称作传说中的宝可梦，对陌生者极凶，却忠于信任的人。野外很罕见，据说目睹便会带来灾难。
author: anonymoose416
source: POKENAME are often called legendary Pokémon. They are extremely aggressive to strangers but loyal to those they trust. Rarely seen in the wild, they are said to bring disaster if sighted.

entry: POKENAME在破火山口安家，为争取最中心的筑巢权而战。它们隔着火山口高速冲向彼此，用角互撞。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME make their homes within volcanic calderas, battling with one another for the right to make their nest at the heart of the crater. They clash with one another by butting horns at high speed, racing into each other from across the caldera.

entry: POKENAME在破火山口安家，为争取最中心的筑巢权而战。灰白外貌让它藏进新火山灰，突然使出精准的火焰牙伏猎。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME make their homes within volcanic calderas, battling with one another for the right to make their nest at the heart of the crater. Their ashen appearance allows them to hide in fresh volcanic ash, ambushing prey with well-placed Fire Fangs.

entry: POKENAME性情火热，喷火又精准，深受驯龙师喜爱。训练足够，超过一百米外的目标，也能稳定命中。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are a popular companion of Dragon Tamers for their fiery demeanour and the precision with which they can spit their flames. With enough training, POKENAME can consistently strike a target from over a hundred meters away.

entry: POKENAME颜色醒目，是许多钓客梦寐以求的收获。它住在深海，得专程出海找，又快又强，只有最厉害的渔夫才钓得上。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME's striking colouration make them a prized catch for many anglers. They make their homes deep in the ocean, necessitating special voyages out to find them, and are fast and strong enough that only the strongest fishermen can catch them.

entry: 身手敏捷，走到哪里都常以滚动前进。一口气能滚过6,000多英里，无需休息。
author: melodydelune
source: This nimble Pokémon can often be seen rolling around wherever it goes. It can roll for over 6,000 miles without needing to break.

entry: 某些文化对POKENAME崇拜极深，科学家因此长期拿不准它是否真实存在。据说，仁君诞生前，它便会到来，为土地带来和平。
author: rakunk
source: For a long time, scientists were unsure if POKENAME actually existed due to its prominent worship in some cultures. They are said to arrive before the birth of a benevolent ruler to bring peace to the lands.

entry: 虽然笨拙，据说却能打动最冰冷的心。以超能力包裹的飞吻，能让任何人都感到愉快。
author: houndrys.
source: Despite being clumsy, it's said to inspire even the coldest heart. By blowing a kiss veiled in psychic power, it brings a pleasant feeling to anyone.

entry: POKENAME爬山快得惊人，再高的山，不到一小时也能从山脚登顶。山地救援队用它找受困登山男，再靠强力把人载下。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME scale mountains at incredible speed, travelling from the foot to the summit of even the tallest mountain in under an hour. Mountain rescue teams employ them to find stranded Hikers, relying on POKENAME's strength to ferry them down.

entry: POKENAME的响亮吠声，让听者恐惧。强咬能压碎汽车，体内火焰支持它连闯数日不休息。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's loud bark strikes fear into everyone who hears it. Its powerful bites can crush cars, and the fire burning within it enables it to rampage for days without rest.

entry: POKENAME卷起凶猛沙暴，借恶劣天气掩护攻击。沙漠旅人得提防在风暴中，被火焰旋涡困住。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME whip up ferocious sandstorms, using the poor weather as cover to launch their attacks from. Desert travellers are advised to be wary of being caught within their Fire Spins during these storms.

entry: 它摩擦脸颊的簇毛发电。毛又软又暖，很受刚起步的训练家喜爱。
author: infinex21
source: It rubs the tufts of fur upon its cheeks to generate electricity. Because its fur is so soft and warm, it is popular among starting Trainers.

entry: POKENAME群靠抓握尾巴，在丛林树冠间荡枝行进。每天能走数千英里，寻找熟果大吃。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME troops travel through jungle canopies using their prehensile tails to swing from branch to branch. They can travel thousands of miles per day in search of food, hunting for ripe fruit to feast on.

entry: 听POKENAME吟唱，可能得好运，也可能坏运，全看它心情。它快速滑过战场，身后留下小片火。
author: spartan_ct
source: Depending on its mood, listening to an POKENAME's chanting can bestow both good and bad luck. It glides swiftly around the battlefield, leaving small patches of fire in its wake.

entry: 据说纷争时，POKENAME会飞近，成为团结人们的和平象征。人们联合对抗邪恶，它就会加入，带领大家获胜。
author: npshi
source: It is said that POKENAME fly nearby in times of strife, acting as a symbol of peace that unites people together. When people unite against evil, POKENAME will join their cause, leading them to victory.

entry: POKENAME抖身时，会撒出火星和电火花。战斗用蓬松尾巴挥敌，尾间雷电噼啪，也烧着炽热火焰。
author: infinex21
source: When they shake their bodies, they scatter sparks of fire and electricity. POKENAME swing at foes during battle with their fluffy tails, which crackle with lightning and burn with intense heat.

entry: POKENAME在活火山脚挖洞保暖。睡觉就用尾巴裹身，留住体热。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME make their burrows at the base of active volcanos to keep themselves warm. They wrap their tail around their body whenever they fall asleep to insulate their body heat.

entry: 黄昏或黎明，若有燃烧彗星仿佛一直跟着你，那可能是POKENAME在天空守护你。
author: bandedbodypress
source: If you ever see a burning comet that seems to follow you at dusk or dawn, it may just be an POKENAME guarding you from up in the sky.

entry: POKENAME在软件里，只需吃饭、睡觉和玩耍就能生存。加上可爱外表，是孩子常养的数字宠物。
author: equation8573
source: POKENAME only needs food, sleep, and playtime to survive in its software. This, coupled with its cuteness, makes it a common digital pet among children.

entry: POKENAME高速跑过草地，爪边迸出火花。不过协调性不强，短腿很难保持冲势，容易绊倒踉跄。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME run at high speeds through grassy fields, kicking up Embers with their claws as they do so. They lack a strong sense of coordination and are prone to tripping and stumbling, unable to maintain their momentum with their stubby legs.

entry: POKENAME以一生守护幼崽。察觉危险，毛就竖起；终于放松后，它喜欢在泥土里打滚。
author: bobosmith01
source: It dedicates its very life to defending its young. If it detects danger, its fur stands on end. When it finally relaxes, POKENAME enjoys rolling in dirt and mud.

entry: POKENAME冲刺极快，每秒能跨出超过十二步。不过肌肉很快因用力过度而过热，极速维持不了多久。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are able to sprint at incredible speed, taking over a dozen strides every second. They can't maintain their top speed for long, as their muscles rapidly overheat from the exertion.

entry: POKENAME每天冲刺数英里，尽量缩短用时，锻炼双腿。腿部肌肉因此强得能踢穿钢铁。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME train their legs by sprinting for several miles each day, trying to cover the distance in as little time as possible. This strengthens their leg muscles, allowing them to kick through steel.

entry: POKENAME用精神力减弱重力，轻轻跃过地面。它能突然爆发速度，每次弹跳，几秒便滑过数百米。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME skip lightly across the ground, their psychic powers letting them reduce the effects of gravity on their body. They are capable of sudden bursts of speed, gliding hundreds of meters in seconds with each bound.

entry: POKENAME能靠共情力量，分享部分能力。把离地漂浮的本领分出去，就能陪其他生物疾驰，一小时走数百英里。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are able to use their empathic powers to share a portion of their power with others. By sharing their ability to float above the ground, POKENAME can race across the landscape with others, covering hundreds of miles in just an hour.

entry: POKENAME能靠共情力量，模仿周围宝可梦的部分本领。察觉别人的战斗热情，就会唤起强大火焰。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are able to use their empathic powers to mimic a portion of the power of Pokémon surrounding them. They conjure powerful flames when they sense the passion for battle in others.

entry: POKENAME能用胸中嵌着的火之石控火。火灾救援常有它，先共情感知受困者，再吸走火焰，让救援队进入。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are able to use the Fire Stone lodged in their chest to control flames. They are often used during fire rescues, using their empathic powers to locate trapped people before siphoning the flames away to allow rescue crews access.

entry: POKENAME极其忠诚，只为保护有需要的生物而战。怕误伤同伴，它只在近距离用火。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is incredibly loyal and will only fight to protect those in need. Because of the risk of friendly fire, POKENAME will only use its flames at close range.

entry: POKENAME的楔石看似熔岩石，因此它常藏在其中。受打扰，会释放超过1,080度的火焰。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME's keystone is visually similar to lava rocks, prompting POKENAME to hide among them. When disturbed, POKENAME unleashes flames upwards of 1,080 degrees.

entry: 据说POKENAME由死去却不肯离去的风速狗灵魂组成。为盼重生而受缚楔石，却不知反而封死命运，永远无法再活。
author: roundabout_robin
source: POKENAME is said to be made up of the souls of Arcanine that perished but refused to move on. Bound to a keystone in hopes of rebirth, it unknowingly sealed its fate, forever unable to live again.

entry: POKENAME靠体热感知周围的人和宝可梦。战斗能极快用金属尖刺攻击，也能裹上强烈热气，点燃附近物品。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME detects people and Pokémon around it by sensing their body heat. In combat, it can strike with incredible speed using the sharp metal spikes on its body, as well as cloak itself in an aura of heat intense enough to ignite nearby objects.

entry: POKENAME常出现在浪漫诗歌、史诗和绘画中。背上的火焰与花，象征坚韧，以及极端事物的共存。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME are common features in numerous romantic poems, epics, and paintings. The flames and flowers atop their backs are used as symbolism for perseverance and the coexistence of extremes.

entry: POKENAME外表厚重，却能爆发惊人速度。战斗中，它突然活跃，用巨大前臂抓打，令对手措手不及。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Despite their bulky appearance, POKENAME are capable of impressive bursts of speed. They use these bursts of high activity in combat to catch their opponents unaware, swiping at them with their massive forearms.

entry: POKENAME预知灾难，参与紧急救援。灵敏嗅觉追踪受困者，强爪挖出，再迅速带往安全处。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME predict impending disasters and aid in emergency rescues. They track trapped victims using their keen sense of smell, digging them free with strong paws before rushing them to safety.

entry: POKENAME被尊为传说中的来世守护者。据说，它会引领逝者的灵魂，前往灵界。
author: captainzscourge
source: POKENAME is revered as a legendary guardian of the afterlife. It is said that it guides those who have passed away into the spiritual realm.

entry: 许多文明相信POKENAME是人类的守护神。大危机时，它会现身，一次带走、救下整座城市和村庄。世界各地，至今仍有醒目的供奉雕像。
author: sk372
source: Believed by many civilizations to be a guardian deity of humanity, POKENAME appeared in times of great crisis to spirit away and rescue entire cities and villages at once. Statues dedicated to it are still prominent across the world.

entry: POKENAME外表厚重，却能爆发惊人速度。战斗中，它突然活跃，用巨大前臂抓打，令对手措手不及。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Despite their bulky appearance, POKENAME are capable of impressive bursts of speed. They use these bursts of high activity in combat to catch their opponents unaware, swiping at them with their massive forearms.

entry: POKENAME群一天能走数百英里找食。它寻找果实特别丰盛的树，再用火烤得恰到好处，才吃下。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME troops can travel hundreds of miles in a single day in search of food. They search for trees with particularly abundant fruit, using their flames to cook their food to perfection before eating it.

entry: 成群POKENAME不止一次被错认成火山喷发。它们如火山碎屑流般冲过干地，以利爪、烈火与尘土裹住不幸的猎物。
author: frink202
source: A pack of POKENAME has on more than one occasion been confused for a volcanic eruption. They surge across dry environments like pyroclastic flows, enveloping any unfortunate prey they find in a flurry of claws, flames and dust.

entry: POKENAME手皮厚实，能承受熔岩数分钟，因此可裹上熔岩，打出重击。危急时，它还会喷出足以熔钢的喷射火焰。
author: chibitales
source: The skin of POKENAME's hands is thick and hardy enough to withstand lava for several minutes, allowing them to coat their fists and strike with devastating power. In a pinch, they release a Flamethrower attack hot enough to melt steel.

entry: POKENAME用稳定火流熔开冰中通道，造出滑道，像滑雪橇一样沿路滑行。冰面光滑，速度最高达每小时九十英里。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME use steady streams of fire to melt channels into their icy home, creating runways that they can toboggan along. The ice is smooth enough that they can reach speeds of up to ninety miles per hour.

entry: 忠诚的POKENAME时速能超过250英里。据说一直在寻找与自己失散的英雄。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: The loyal POKENAME can travel more than 250 miles per hour. It's said to search for a hero who was separated from it.

entry: POKENAME以七至八只的小家庭巡视领地，每天能走许多英里。它们合力大吼喷火，驱离敌对家族。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME roam their territory in small family packs of seven to eight individuals. They can cover many miles in a day, working together to keep rival families of POKENAME away with loud roars and blasts of fire.

entry: 古代传说里，有位战士速度眩目、怒火炽烈。有学者认为，那是现代融合出现前，POKENAME最早的记载。
author: phantom640
source: Ancient tales told of a legendary warrior who would fight with blinding speed and blazing fury. Some scholars believe these tales to be early records of POKENAME, long before modern-day fusion.

entry: POKENAME疯狂拍翼，能放出灼热热浪，碰到就会烧伤。它领地意识极强，会竖鬃咆哮，恐吓入侵者。
author: fiordaliso
source: By flapping its wings frantically, it can release waves of heat so intense that they burn anyone who comes into contact with them. As it is extremely territorial, POKENAME raises its mane and roars to intimidate anyone who invades its turf.

entry: 传说POKENAME能判断水手的内心。若觉得不配，水下便会涌起火焰风暴，蒸干大片海水，让船猛烈坠向海底。
author: epping_forest
source: Legends say that POKENAME can judge the hearts of the sailors. If they deem them unworthy, a firestorm will surge from underwater to evaporate a large portion of the sea, making the ship violently fall into the bottom of the ocean.

entry: POKENAME来自远东，自古以来就因忠诚和亲人的天性备受贵族与王室珍视。
author: melodydelune
source: Hailing from the far east, POKENAME has been prized since ancient times by regals and royalty for its loyalty and loving nature.

entry: POKENAME以雷鸣般步伐巡视火山脊。存在虽令人畏惧，它却会奋力保护弱小宝可梦，把它们藏在身下，抵御塌方和凶猛捕食者。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME patrol volcanic ridges with thunderous steps. Despite their terrifying presence, they fiercely protect vulnerable Pokémon from dangerous cave-ins and aggressive predators, sheltering them beneath their own bodies.

entry: 传说，POKENAME能在毁坏的世界传送门周围筑起火墙，阻挡人类与宝可梦通行。火焰极热，能将接触到的一切焚尽。
author: fiordaliso
source: Legend has it that POKENAME can block access to Pokémon and humans in the Distorted World by generating walls of fire around portals. Its flames are so hot they can incinerate anything they touch.

entry: POKENAME绝对忠于训练家，已磨炼出控制噩梦能力的本领。谁侮辱训练家，它就让对方陷入被烧的痛苦噩梦。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's loyalty towards its Trainer is absolute. It has honed itself to control its nightmare-inducing ability, and sentences those who insult its Trainer to painful nightmares about being burned.

entry: POKENAME跑得越久，内部机械产生的热越多。速度足够高，就会全身被烈焰包围。
author: sk372
source: The longer POKENAME runs, the more heat is generated by its internal mechanisms. If its speed increases enough, it will become completely engulfed in blazing flames.

entry: POKENAME甩尾能打出爆炸般的重击，把目标烧焦。强皮与厚毛共同保护，减轻各类物理伤害。
author: zekkenbytheden
source: POKENAME are capable of delivering explosive blows with their tails, leaving their target scorched. Their strong hide and thick fur work very well together to mitigate all kinds of physical damage.

entry: POKENAME毛厚耐热，飘逸毛簇在冲刺时燃烧，留下一道火星。耳朵肌肉强、能抓握，极速时维持平衡，也能抽打灼伤敌人。
author: cerealjamalt
source: POKENAME's coat is dense and heat-resistant, with flowing tufts of fur that ignites when it sprints, leaving trails of ember. Its ears are muscular and prehensile; it uses them for balance at top speed and as lashing weapons that can scorch enemies.

entry: 关都民间故事常赋予POKENAME不符合现实的神秘力量。其实，它只是隐居，躲避文明常有的强光与噪音。
author: vic1312
source: Often featured in Kantonian folk stories, POKENAME are often ascribed mysticism that is incongruous with reality. In truth, these Pokémon are merely reclusive and shy away from the bright lights and loud noises common to civilization.

entry: POKENAME外表粗犷、自信傲慢，可一看见需要帮助的人或宝可梦，就会毫不犹豫赶去。许多人称它为“沙漠护卫”。
author: clevernamegoeshere.
source: Despite POKENAME's rough and cocky exterior, if it sees a human or Pokémon in need of assistance, it will rush to their aid without any question. It is known by many as the "Desert's Escort".

entry: POKENAME对训练家忠诚无比，随时准备保护。它速度奇快，会点燃刀刃般的长牙，让劈斩更强。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's loyalty towards its trainer is unparalleled; it is always ready to rush to their defense. It moves at fantastic speeds, igniting the blade-like tusks it possesses to make its cutting swings far more powerful.

entry: POKENAME对依恋的生物始终忠诚。有些野外个体被认为已有数百岁，至今仍守着心爱训练家长眠的地方。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is an unfailingly loyal companion to those it grows attached to. Some specimens seen in the wild are believed to be centuries old, still guarding the resting place of their dear departed Trainers to this day.

entry: POKENAME守在家门，尽职挡住一切入侵者，因此深受屋主喜爱。
author: admiralvermin
source: POKENAME will settle on the front doors of houses, and dutifully protect them from any would-be intruders. As such, they're beloved by homeowners.

entry: 豪宅常养一群POKENAME防贼。它附在门上，放行信任的人，对陌生者则发射喷射火焰。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Luxury mansions commonly keep a pack of POKENAME on the grounds to serve as guards against thieves. POKENAME attach themselves to doors, allowing trusted people into the building they guard, whilst launching Flamethrowers at those they don't know.

entry: POKENAME一天能远行，有些记录甚至显示，它从一地区飞到邻区。电话出现前，信使曾靠它传送重要函件。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are capable of covering vast distances within a single day, in some cases even being documented flying from one region to the neighbouring one. They were used by messengers to carry important missives before the advent of telephones.

entry: POKENAME一天能远行，有些记录甚至显示，它从一地区飞到邻区。成群飞过时，常在天空留下燃烧羽毛的轨迹。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are capable of covering vast distances within a single day, in some cases even being documented flying from one region to the neighbouring one. Flocks of POKENAME frequently leave a trail of fiery feathers burning in the sky in their wake.

entry: POKENAME划过夜空，留下火迹。传说若有人追上，并赶在它落地前抓住，就能实现内心最深的愿望。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME streak through the night sky, leaving a trail of fire in their wake. Legends persist that those who are able to chase after one and catch them before they hit the ground will be granted their heart's deepest desire.

entry: POKENAME群轮流以高速头锤撞树根部，合力推倒树。树一落，它们便用火息烤好木头，再吃掉。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME work together in packs to topple trees, taking turns ramming into the base of them with high-speed Headbutts. When the tree falls, they use their fiery breath to cook the wood to perfection before eating it.

entry: POKENAME大多时间跑来跑去，快得能留下燃烧轨迹。敏捷跳跃加上沿垂直表面冲刺，也能迅速攀上峭壁和树。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME spends most of its time running around and can move so fast that it leaves a burning trail behind it. It is also capable of quickly scaling cliffs and trees through a combination of agile leaps and dashing up vertical surfaces.

entry: 常有人见POKENAME高速穿过田野平原，长尾在身后飘动。战斗时，每条尾巴都洒火星，嘴间涌出烈焰。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are oft witnessed crossing fields and open plains at high speeds, their long tails flowing behind them. During battle, embers scatter from each of their tails and flames spill out from between their maws.

entry: POKENAME高速飞过沙漠，猛烈振翅掀起热浪。
author: mistershaokahn
source: POKENAME flies at a high speed through deserts, generating heat waves by violently flapping its wings.

entry: POKENAME满是怒气，颚虽发达，咬起来却几乎不伤。体内会积热，但栖水凉爽，热量很少爆发。
author: zyrum_
source: POKENAME is filled with rage. Despite its well developed jaw, it barely causes any harm when it bites. Heat builds up inside its body, but because of the cool water it lives in, the heat rarely erupts.

entry: POKENAME身体厚毛像铠甲，帮助挡住攻击，也能留住热量，在最寒冷的冬眠中保暖，一直休息到准备进化。
author: santon5512
source: The thick mat of fur surrounding POKENAME's bodies acts like armor, helping to repel and protect from attacks. This fur traps heat within, helping to keep them warm in the coldest temperatures while they hibernate, resting until ready to evolve.

entry: POKENAME花朵不断向空中放花粉，周围火焰制造上升暖流，将花粉送到极远。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME flowers release a steady stream of pollen into the air. The flames surrounding their flower create updrafts of hot air, helping to spread their pollen across great distances.

entry: POKENAME精力充沛，喜欢野外漫游，也喜欢用尾巴点燃一小捆捆木枝。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are energetic little creatures that enjoy roaming around in the wild. They enjoy igniting small bundles of sticks with their tail.

entry: POKENAME体大力强，很适合守家。外表虽可怕，值勤以外却十分温柔友好，尤其对训练家。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's size and strength makes it excellent as a house guardian. Despite a fearsome appearance, it is very friendly and gentle outside of guard duty, particularly towards its Trainer.

entry: POKENAME擅长从强颚抛出巨大火球。据说，这些凝聚火焰的球体，速度和冲击力如陨石撞击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's combat specialty is great balls of fire lobbed out of its powerful jaws. These condensed flame orbs are said to hit with speed and force akin to a meteor impact.

entry: POKENAME先以短低吼和小股喷火，给攻击者离开的机会。若仍纠缠，通常会被巨大力量扔到地平线外。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME gives aggressors a chance to walk away, intimidating them with short growling roars and small bursts of flame from its mouth. Those that persist bothering it typically wind up thrown across the horizon from its titanic strength.

entry: POKENAME蓬松的叶片极易燃。秋季落叶可收来作引火物，若不收，反而增加森林火灾风险。
author: hophoppip
source: The fluffy leaves on POKENAME are highly flammable. When it sheds its leaves in the fall, they can be gathered to use as tinder, but if not gathered, the risk of a forest fire is increased.

entry: POKENAME把耳朵放出的震荡爆音波，与嘴里喷的火结合，造出破坏性火球。毛热得让它能轻松飞到平流层下方。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME combine their concussive Boombursts loosed by their ears with the flames spewed from their mouths to create destructive fireballs. Their fur is so hot that they can fly just below the stratosphere with ease.

entry: POKENAME爬行会留下极易燃的黏液，不小心就可能引火。不过它忠诚无比，始终挺身保护训练家。
author: fiordaliso
source: As it slithers, POKENAME leaves behind a highly flammable slime trail; if it's not careful, it may accidentally start fires. It is an extraordinarily loyal Pokémon that always stands in defense of its Trainer.

entry: POKENAME不爱冲突，喜欢用平和拥抱、缓和情绪化解争斗。不过若被逼交战，仍很可怕，能使出威力惊人的大字爆炎。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are conflict-averse, preferring to resolve fights through peaceful hugs and de-escalation. Despite their aversion, they are fearsome when pushed into a fight and are capable of devastating Fire Blasts.

entry: 传说POKENAME狂吠时，若有人不肯卑躬屈膝，就会连人带家被狂暴的它焚毁。它厌恶剪毛，因为每根毛里都有提供火力的火焰。
author: soup1900
source: In legends, people who didn't grovel to POKENAME when it let out a wild bark were burned down along with their homes in its frenzy. It despises having its fur cut since within the hairs is a burning fire, which provides POKENAME its fiery power.

entry: POKENAME很受孩子们欢迎，常成为他们的第一只宝可梦。性情亲人，也聪明得出奇。
author: cristata
source: POKENAME is a popular first Pokémon for kids. It's very loving and surprisingly intelligent.

entry: POKENAME很受孩子们欢迎，常成为他们的第一只宝可梦。相伴珍爱多年后，条纹也许会褪色，爱却永不消退。
author: cristata
source: POKENAME are popular first Pokémon for kids. After being cherished for many years, their stripes may fade, however, that love never will.

entry: POKENAME外表温顺，其实是凶猛猎手。短程比多数宝可梦跑得快，会用神速把猎物抓进强臂。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Despite their docile appearance, POKENAME are ferocious predators. They are able to run faster than most other Pokémon over short distances, using Extreme Speed to catch their prey in their powerful arms.

entry: POKENAME外表温顺，其实是凶猛猎手。短程比多数宝可梦跑得快，会用神速把猎物抓进强臂。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Despite their docile appearance, POKENAME are ferocious predators. They are able to run faster than most other Pokémon over short distances, using Extreme Speed to catch their prey in their powerful arms.

entry: POKENAME常不知道自己的力量，会给训练家带来什么危险。它很容易学会载客，但必须懂得，多数人受不了突加速，会昏倒。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are often unaware of their strength and the risks that they may pose to their trainer. They are easily trained to take passengers on rides, but they have to be taught that most people cannot handle their abrupt acceleration without fainting.

entry: POKENAME的孢子极易燃，能撒满战场，再点燃，把敌人逼入绝境。
author: .izik
source: The spores POKENAME releases are highly combustible. It scatters clouds of them across the battlefield to ignite and corner foes.

entry: 消防员开始把POKENAME安排在城市各重要位置。两侧消防栓能生成大量水，火一发生，便能迅速到场扑救。
author: sk372
source: Firefighters have begun appointing POKENAME at strategic locations across cities. The hydrants on its sides can generate high amounts of water, making it effective at being a first responder in combating fires that break out.

entry: POKENAME群寻找低枝，用头火烧断。枝条落地，再一起吃上面的果实。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME herds seek out low hanging branches on trees, using the flames that sprout from their head to burn them away from the trunk. When the branches fall to the ground, they gather together to feed on the fruit on the fallen branches.

entry: POKENAME是可靠坐骑，再寒冷也能载人往返村庄。身体持续散热，让乘客途中免受周围冷空气侵袭。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are dependable mounts, ferrying people from village to village through even the coldest environments. Their body constantly radiates heat, ensuring that those riding them are sheltered from the freezing air around them as they travel.

entry: POKENAME以羁绊深厚的家庭群漫游，能走极远，有时连续数日不歇。休息就点大篝火，让所有成员围着睡。
author: sneakywalrus0
source: POKENAME roam in familial packs with tight bonds between members. They are able to cover extremely vast distances, sometimes being able to travel non-stop for days at a time. When resting, they create large bonfires for all to sleep around.

entry: POKENAME翱翔夜空，留下闪亮火星。观赏者常渐渐困倦，看它飞过几分钟，就进入愉快梦乡。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME soar across the night sky, leaving a trail of glittering embers behind them as they fly. Those who watch the display often find themselves feeling drowsy, falling into a pleasant slumber within minutes of watching POKENAME pass.

entry: POKENAME背上真菌吸取宿主体热维生，作为回报，会照亮栖居的黑暗洞窟。互利关系耗氧极多，迫使它不断移动。
author: zekkenbytheden
source: The fungus on POKENAME's back leeches heat from its host's body to survive, and in return lights up the darkness of the caves it resides in. This mutualistic relationship requires a lot of oxygen, forcing POKENAME to constantly be on the move.

entry: POKENAME身上的蘑菇有独特烟熏味，厨师十分珍视。不过它凶猛好斗、牙爪锋利，采集相当棘手。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: The mushrooms growing on POKENAME are prized by chefs for their unique, smokey taste. However, gathering them is quite tricky, as POKENAME is highly aggressive, boasting sharp claws and teeth.

entry: 据说POKENAME放出的光，像吸收了整颗太阳的力量。保护训练家最后关头，它会释放毁灭性的流星雨，试图把敌人化灰。
author: actliux
source: The light that shines from POKENAME is said to be as if it absorbed the power of a whole sun. As a final bid to protect its Trainer, it will unleash a devastating rain of meteors in an attempt to reduce its foe to ash.

entry: POKENAME受威胁便放浓烟，遮住动作、扰乱敌人。身体绿球吸收强攻能量，之后可释放，进行猛烈反击。
author: msdawgs
source: POKENAME releases thick clouds of smoke when threatened, using them to obscure its movements and confuse its foes. The green orbs on its body absorb energy from powerful attacks, which it can later release in a devastating counterattack.

entry: 许多人声称POKENAME来自神奥的毁坏的世界，靠高速在浮空岛间跳跃。已观测到的行为，则是变换火色，吸引飞行、虫属性宝可梦来吃。
author: ghostslythe
source: Many claim POKENAME is from Sinnoh's Distortion World, using its fast speed to jump between the sky islands. What has been observed is it changes its flame colors to attract Flying- and Bug-types to devour.

entry: 传说把POKENAME描绘成投掷火焰手里剑的传奇忍者。人们赞叹它奔过辽阔草原的身姿。
author: hiroshima0042_23263
source: Legends depict POKENAME as a legendary ninja who throws fire shurikens. People admire how POKENAME runs through vast prairies.

entry: POKENAME迅速挖过松土，造出长达数英里的大洞穴。研究者争论用途，最主流的推测是，它只是喜欢挖。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME rapidly dig through loose soil and dirt, creating large burrows that can extend for many miles. Researchers disagree with one another on what the reason is for these burrows, the leading theory being that they simply take joy in digging.

entry: POKENAME把各种珍贵珠宝融入身体，尤其偏爱碧玉和红宝石。珠宝能传导元素力量，储存热量，留待之后放出。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME incorporate various precious jewels into their bodies, having a preference for jaspers and rubies. They use these jewels to channel their elemental powers, storing heat within them to be projected out later.

entry: POKENAME迅速挖过松土，造出长达数英里的大洞穴。它喜欢分享隧道，会兴奋地破土吠叫，带其他宝可梦一起下去。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME rapidly dig through loose soil and dirt, creating large burrows that can extend for many miles. They enjoy sharing their tunnels with others, bursting from the ground to excitedly bark and bring other Pokémon underground with them.

entry: POKENAME迅速挖过松土，造出长达数英里的大洞穴。考古学家用它找发掘地较新的遗骸，不过得防着它啃骨头。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME rapidly dig through loose soil and dirt, creating large burrows that can extend for many miles. Archaeologists make use of POKENAME to find recent remains at dig sites, though care has to be taken to prevent them from gnawing on the bones.

entry: POKENAME在山火区域钻地，寻找迷失的宝可梦。找到后大声吠叫，引向安全处。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME digs through wildfire zones searching for lost Pokémon. Once found, it barks loudly to guide them toward safety.

entry: POKENAME追赶前，会先从地下放出强力嚎声。攻击将至，声音便在隧道回荡。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME releases powerful howls from beneath the ground before giving chase. The sound echoes through tunnels moments before it attacks.

entry: POKENAME始终优雅高傲。训练家必须花时间打理厚毛，否则就可能触怒它。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME always carries itself with elegance and pride. A Trainer of POKENAME must dedicate time to grooming its thick coat or risk facing its ire.

entry: POKENAME频繁偏头痛，唯有泡进微温泉水，才能缓解。即使筋疲力尽，它仍竭力保护、帮助训练家。
author: fiordaliso
source: The only way it can keep the pain from its frequent migraines at bay is by soaking in lukewarm thermal water. Even when it is at the end of its strength, POKENAME gives its all to protect and help its Trainer.

entry: POKENAME嗅觉极灵，闭眼也能辨路。它尽情满足好奇，四处飞奔，探查环境中的新气味。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have a keen sense of smell that is sensitive enough to let them navigate the world even with their eyes closed. They freely indulge their curious side, racing from place to place to investigate new smells in their environment.

entry: POKENAME嗅觉极灵，闭眼也能辨路。头毛太厚，常遮住视线，逼得它靠鼻子行动。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have a keen sense of smell that is sensitive enough to let them navigate the world even with their eyes closed. The fur on their head grows thick enough that it often blocks their eyesight, forcing them to rely on their nose to get around.

entry: POKENAME心脏泵出的血能融冰。它跑得快、身体暖，商人常骑它穿过冰寒山口，往返城镇运货。
author: lupa
source: POKENAME's heart pumps blood that can melt ice. It is incredibly fast and warm, so merchants will often ride it through freezing mountain passes to transport goods from town to town.

entry: POKENAME巡视农场，吠叫赶走想袭家畜的捕食者。人们常给骨头奖励，它再埋入隐秘藏处，防着同群伙伴。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME prowl around farms, barking and chasing off predators that would attack the farmer's livestock. They are commonly rewarded with bones for their efforts, burying them in a hidden stash to keep them from others in their pack.

entry: POKENAME如风暴般的外貌，让神奥研究者很感兴趣。自融合形态与洗翠风速狗相似，引来许多关于遗传、以及它与地区形态关系的问题。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME's stormy appearance is of great interest to Sinnohan researchers. The similarity of the self-fusion's appearance to Hisuian Arcanine has led to a flurry of questions around genetics and the relationship of POKENAME to the regional variant.

entry: POKENAME毛比未融合风速狗厚得多，看起来十分吓人。训练家最好每天梳两次，免得过度打结、凌乱。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME fur grows far thicker than that of unfused Arcanine, giving them a fearsome appearance. Trainers are advised to brush POKENAME twice daily to prevent their fur from becoming overly tangled and unruly.

entry: POKENAME如风暴般的外貌，让神奥研究者很感兴趣。自融合形态与洗翠风速狗相似，引来许多关于遗传、以及它与地区形态关系的问题。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME's stormy appearance is of great interest to Sinnohan researchers. The similarity of the self-fusion's appearance to Hisuian Arcanine has led to a flurry of questions around genetics and the relationship of POKENAME to the regional variant.

entry: POKENAME体温比未融合风速狗高，全身因此始终缠着火。它仍然爱玩，似乎不知道给旁边生物增添了烫伤风险。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have a higher internal temperature than unfused Arcanine, causing their bodies to constantly be wreathed in flames. They retain a playful nature, seemingly unaware of the increased risk of burns they pose to those around them.

entry: POKENAME比未融合风速狗更骄傲，会挑战强敌证明自己。备战时，毛烧起火，随时准备使出强力闪焰冲锋。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are far prouder than unfused Arcanine, seeking to prove themselves through battles against powerful opponents. Their fur blazes as they prepare to fight, kept alight in constant readiness for them to unleash a powerful Flare Blitz.

entry: POKENAME性情躁动，经过训练家妥善训练，却会非常听话。能力多样、力量强，特警常用它突入罪犯藏身处。
author: fiordaliso
source: Despite its restless temperament, it becomes extremely obedient when properly trained by its Trainer. Thanks to its versatility and strength, POKENAME is often employed by special police forces to break into criminal hideouts.

entry: 某座东方寺院，以POKENAME的面貌象征高阶身份。它被尊为智慧的承载者。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's visage is used as a symbol of high rank at one eastern temple. It is well respected as a bearer of wisdom.

entry: POKENAME十分得意于身体，不介意被视为力量象征。不久前的发掘中，曾出土一座描绘它的古代雕像。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is incredibly proud of its body and has no problem being observed as a symbol of strength. There was an ancient statue depicting this Pokémon uncovered at a dig site some time ago.

entry: POKENAME十分得意于身体，不介意被视为力量象征。不久前的发掘中，曾出土一座描绘它的古代雕像。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is incredibly proud of its body and has no problem being observed as a symbol of strength. There was an ancient statue depicting this Pokémon uncovered at a dig site some time ago.

entry: 战斗时，体内火焰回应POKENAME的决心，让体温急升，出拳更猛更快。但若不控制，也可能过热。
author: glacierwing
source: During combat, POKENAME's body temperature rises rapidly, the flame inside its body reacting to the Pokémon's determination. This raises the intensity and speed of its punches, but this can lead to overheating if not managed.

entry: POKENAME群每天走近250英里，在草原家园找食物和水。首领靠竞速决出，还得定期迎战急于挑战的成员，捍卫地位。
author: _pixelar_
source: Herds of POKENAME walk almost 250 miles in a day to search for food and water in the prairies they inhabit. The leader of a herd is decided by a speed competition and regularly has to defend the title from other eager competitors in the herd.

entry: 它在冰寒海下高速游动，不知疲倦。冰川周围的自然栖地里，鬃毛帮助保暖。
author: bionic_man
source: It tirelessly swims under the frigid ocean at high speeds. The mane helps it keep warm in its natural environment around glaciers.

entry: POKENAME把废物垃圾铲进嘴，用熔融唾液烧成燃料。战斗先留下裹毛淤泥，再吐熔岩块，一次点燃整片地区。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME shovel waste and trash into their mouths, using their molten saliva to burn it down into fuel. They fight by leaving trails of fur-covered sludge then spitting out globs of lava to ignite the entire area at once.

entry: POKENAME炮口射出的液体极易燃，一点火星就能把普通喷流化成高温火迹。个头虽大，它泳速却很快，尤其擅长转向。
author: fiordaliso
source: The liquid fired from POKENAME's cannons is highly flammable; a single spark is enough to turn ordinary jets into trails of high-temperature flames. Despite its size, POKENAME is a very fast swimmer, particularly skilled at turning maneuvers.

entry: POKENAME忠于训练家，很能防范闹鬼。它夜里巡视主人家，幽灵属性一想闯入恶作剧，便立刻攻击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's loyalty to its Trainer makes it effective against being haunted. It patrols its owner's home at night, immediately attacking any Ghost types that try to invade and cause mischief.

entry: POKENAME战斗时，把火焰摆锤当武器，高速挥向敌人。火能使人麻木，被烧者会困倦、反应迟钝。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME wield their fiery pendulum as a weapon in battle, swinging it at high speed into their foe. The flames have a numbing effect, inducing drowsiness in those burned by them and dulling reaction times.

entry: POKENAME猛烈喷火后，炮口和外壳可能过热，因此会长时间潜水。个头虽大，它泳速却很快，尤其擅长转向。
author: fiordaliso
source: After firing terrifying bursts of flame, POKENAME's cannons and shell are at risk of overheating; hence, it remains submerged in the water for a long time. Despite its size, POKENAME is a very fast swimmer, particularly skilled at turning maneuvers.

entry: POKENAME把丝喷过尾火。丝本身耐烧，却能带火，方便准确控火、设下燃烧陷阱。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME sprays silk through the fire on its tail. While the silk itself is resistant to burning, it can still carry the flame, allowing POKENAME to better aim its fire and create burning traps.

entry: POKENAME整天滚来滚去，寻找配得上结伴的训练家。有时磁铁会让搜寻受阻，强迫它脱离球形。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME spend their days rolling around in search of a Trainer they feel is worthy to partner with. Sometimes these searches are thwarted by magnets, which force POKENAME out of their ball form.

entry: 别看外表，它们的翅膀很弱，无法长时间浮空。不过火焰极强，能点燃骨棒。
author: infinex21
source: Despite appearances, their wings are too weak to keep them aloft for long. Their flames, on the other hand, are so intense they can ignite their bone clubs.

entry: POKENAME的翼骨长到能兜风，就代表准备好飞行。这些小生物是强韧斗士，独来独往。
author: oreee0230
source: When POKENAME's wing bones grow enough to catch the wind, it means it's ready to fly. These tiny creatures are tough fighters and live a solitary life.

entry: POKENAME先用强火点燃骨棒，再敲打或投掷。翅膀虽小，仍让它移动迅速，更容易取回骨棒。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME use their strong flames to ignite their bone clubs before they strike with them or throw them. Their wings may be small, but allow them to move swiftly and to retrieve their bone clubs with greater ease.

entry: POKENAME战斗中每踢一下，尾焰就随斗志窜高。敌对个体交锋，可能变成烈火与飞脚交错的火海。
author: sk372
source: With every kick POKENAME makes in battle, the flame on its tail grows, flaring in tune with its fighting spirit. A battle between rival POKENAME can turn into a blazing inferno of fire and feet.

entry: 它身体热得连拳上手套都能烫敌。背翼帮助迅速变换位置，利于闪避、反击。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its body burns so hot that even the gloves covering its fists scorch its foes. The wings on its back help it reposition swiftly, giving it an edge in dodging and counterattacking.

entry: 这种宝可梦每次蓄力打击，都配着灵巧穿梭，让对手几乎打不中它。敌对POKENAME的战斗常以平手告终，让双方很不甘心。
author: beatdoof
source: Every charged blow from this Pokémon is paired with deft weaving, making it almost impossible to hit. Battles between rival POKENAME often end in a draw, much to their dismay.

entry: 它体内燃着永不熄灭的火，产生毒气，从毛孔排出。面对强敌，每个开口都喷火，随时可能猛烈爆炸。
author: fiordaliso
source: A never-ending flame burns within its body, producing toxic gases that it vents through its pores. When facing a powerful foe, flames burst from every opening, raising the risk of an explosive outburst at any moment.

entry: POKENAME飞跃长距，快速旋转火尾，制造托起自己的上升气流。身体会硬化，准备承受落地。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME leap great distances through the air, rapidly swirling their fiery tails to create updrafts to carry them. They harden their bodies to help brace for landing.

entry: POKENAME脾气急，不顾一切冲撞挡路者。身体太重，巨翼也只能支撑飞几分钟。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is a short-tempered creature that recklessly charges at anyone who dares stand in its way. Its large wings can only keep it airborne for a few minutes due to the heavy weight of its body.

entry: POKENAME格外受威胁时，会结合水、火属性攻击，造出隔开敌人的蒸汽云，趁机逃走。它也常用翼状鳍，在水面滑行。
author: fiordaliso
source: When POKENAME feels particularly threatened, it combines its Water and Fire-type attacks to create a cloud of steam between itself and its foes, allowing it to escape. It often uses its wing-shaped fins to glide across the water's surface.

entry: POKENAME受挑衅，会拍翼卷出烈焰旋风。鳞片留住体热，海里觅食时，温度也不至太低。
author: fiordaliso
source: When provoked, POKENAME can generate blazing whirlwinds by flapping its wings. Its scales insulate its body's heat, preventing its temperature from dropping too low while it swims in the sea in search of prey.

entry: POKENAME藏在火山岩间，等猎物游过，就喷火烤熟。可被老练厨师料理后，POKENAME自己也是受欢迎的佳肴，据说肉质鲜嫩多汁。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME hide amongst volcanic rock, waiting for its prey to swim by before cooking them with a blast of fire. When prepared by an experienced chef POKENAME is considered a popular delicacy with their meat being described as juicy and tender.

entry: POKENAME能从身体中央宝石喷出强火，吓退危险宝可梦。威胁一走，火又缩回原来的宝石。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can summon powerful flames that erupt from the gem at the center of their body. These flames intimidate dangerous Pokémon into leaving them alone, and return into the gem they came from when the threat is gone.

entry: POKENAME从身体宝石召强火，吓退危险宝可梦。火焰承载着凶猛火属性宝可梦的意志，只服从同样满怀热情的训练家。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME summon powerful flames from the gem on their body to scare away dangerous Pokémon. These flames embody the spirit of a fierce Fire-type Pokémon that only listens to Trainers with as much passion as they have.

entry: POKENAME沿海滩滑翔，帮退潮搁浅的海星星、宝石海星回水。据说一生中每帮助一只宝可梦，它的火焰与念力都会增强。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME glide around beaches helping Staryu and Starmie back into the water after they are stranded at low tide. Their flames and telekinesis are said to grow stronger for each Pokémon they help throughout their lives.

entry: POKENAME仍爱哑剧，却发现加上喷火，更能引人注意。它会挑战其他火属性宝可梦，比赛火焰谁更惊艳。
author: .jerden
source: While it still has a fondness for pantomime, POKENAME find that incorporating fire-breathing into their act gets them much more attention. They will challenge other fire-type Pokémon to produce more impressive flames.

entry: POKENAME翅膀不大，飞速却惊人。它飞过大片地区，寻找值得一战的对手。
author: oreee0230
source: Although its wings aren't big, POKENAME's flying speed is impressively fast. It flies over large areas, looking for opponents worth battling.

entry: 看见POKENAME扭胯跳舞的生物，都忍不住加入，可它只接受最熟练舞伴。跳错一步，就会迎来密集火球。
author: sk372
source: Those who view POKENAME's hip-shaking dance are compelled to join in, but POKENAME only accepts the most skilled of partners. Missteps are met with a barrage of thrown fireballs.

entry: 野生POKENAME为争食，激烈擒抱、互撞双钳。打得够久，斗志更旺，连钳子也会燃烧。
author: sk372
source: Wild POKENAME compete for food by getting into powerful grappling matches, slamming their pincers against one another. If the battles run long enough, their pincers even ignite as their fighting spirit flares up further.

entry: POKENAME暴怒，尾火旺得让体温升高。遇到同类，就忍不住冲锋撞角。
author: fiordaliso
source: When enraged, the flame on its tail blazes so intensely that its body temperature rises. If it encounters another POKENAME, it feels compelled to charge and clash horns.

entry: POKENAME身子小，用翅飞得费劲。它高估保持浮空所需的力道，因而无法飞直。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME struggles to fly with its wings because of its small body. It overestimates the necessary force needed to remain airborne and cannot maintain a straight flight path as a result.

entry: POKENAME领地意识极强、性情凶猛，从高处巡视森林，毫不迟疑地攻击入侵者。
author: silver175
source: POKENAME is extremely territorial and aggressive. It patrols its forest from above, attacking intruders without hesitation.

entry: 它用翅快速往返树枝，采树果吃。吃够后，额上角状火焰更强，增强火属性招式。
author: fiordaliso
source: It uses its wings to quickly move from branch to branch, collecting berries from trees. After eating enough, the horn-shaped flame on its forehead grows stronger, boosting the power of its Fire-type moves.

entry: 每逢它一年一度的迁徙，人们便举办庆典。它喜欢在灼热的烟火中起舞，否则就会焚烧城镇取乐。
author: robosoup
source: Festivals are held on its annual migration, for it loves dancing amongst the hot fireworks, and would otherwise burn towns for entertainment.

entry: POKENAME的两种融合成分同步完成了超级进化，能一直维持这种形态。破坏欲极为强烈。
author: robosoup
source: Both halves of POKENAME have mega-evolved in synchrony, and it can hold this form indefinitely. It has a great urge to destroy.

entry: 科学界没有把POKENAME归类为龙。许多奇幻作家却称，故事里的龙取材于它。
author: bradlybro199
source: A POKENAME is not classified as a dragon by the scientific community. Many fantasy authors claim to draw inspiration from it when crafting dragons in their stories.

entry: POKENAME已不再过分争强，却仍很骄傲。它生活在活火山盆地和海滩，研究发现，常聚在岩浆旁取暖。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: POKENAME have grown past their highly competitive nature but remain very proud. They can be found in active volcanic basins and beaches, where research has discovered they cluster near magma for its warmth.

entry: 它尖刺般的毛不断蓄静电，也为尾焰供能。翅膀可短途滑翔、加快战场移动，让攻击更快、更难预测。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its spiky fur constantly stores static electricity, which also fuels the flames blazing on its tail. It uses its wings to glide short distances and to speed up its movements on the battlefield, making its attacks even swifter and more unpredictable.

entry: 这种宝可梦产热极多，谁靠POKENAME太近，很快便会流汗。战斗唤出的火凶猛，很难扑灭。
author: fireblade141
source: This Pokémon's body produces copious amounts of heat, and anyone who comes too close to POKENAME will soon find themselves sweating. The flames it conjures in battle are fierce and difficult to put out.

entry: POKENAME被引入虚拟世界，保护私人网络免遭有害文件侵袭，是活的防火墙。恶意软件越复杂，它越想迎战。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME was introduced into the virtual world to protect private networks from harmful files, acting as a living firewall. The more complex the malware, the more eager this Pokémon becomes to face it.

entry: 谁靠近悬挂的树枝，POKENAME就攻击谁。它胡乱甩动火尾和大翅，吓走其他宝可梦。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME attacks anything that comes close to the branch it hangs from. It flails its flaming tail and large wings to scare away other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME掠过敌人时会挥火尾攻击，也会边喷火边头朝前猛撞。化石证据让人推测，喷火龙的远古祖先，或许与这种融合体相似。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME swings its flaming tail to attack as it flies past foes, or breathes out fire while crashing into them headfirst. Based on fossil evidence, it has been suggested that Charizard's ancient ancestors resembled this fusion.

entry: 世界许多地方都发现过POKENAME，常与其他宝可梦激烈争地盘。战斗时尾火热如岩浆，也让它更加凶猛。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME have been found in many parts of the world, often getting into vicious territorial disputes with other Pokémon. During battle, the flame on their tail burns hot enough to rival magma, causing POKENAME to become even more vicious.

entry: 无数挂毯、镶嵌画描绘POKENAME的身影，数百年来启发许多充满古老魅力的奇妙故事。不过烈火威猛、性情凶狠，极难驾驭。
author: fiordaliso
source: Countless tapestries and mosaics depict the figure of POKENAME, which has inspired incredible tales of ancient allure for centuries. Its devastating fire and fierce nature make it an extremely difficult creature to control.

entry: POKENAME蓝色翼下并非真正肉身，而是浓集到变色的强热。融合使尾焰太猛烈，因此无法熄灭。
author: grilled7up
source: Its blue underwings are not actually part of its body, but concentrated heat so intense it changes color. POKENAME's tail flame cannot be extinguished due to the extreme intensity caused by the fusion.

entry: POKENAME体热高，常烧掉一层层旧皮。焦皮能保留热量数周，因此常被用于暖手用品。
author: drcew
source: POKENAME's high body heat leads to it burning off layers of old skin often. The charred skin is able to retain some of its heat for weeks, so it is often used in hand warmers.

entry: POKENAME的翼相对身体虽小，飞行却强。它喜欢飞过雷暴，把云层划开，露出背后的蓝天。
author: wiz0z
source: Though their wings are small compared to their body, POKENAME are powerful fliers. They enjoy flying through thunderstorms, cutting them open to show the blue sky behind them.

entry: POKENAME是维持环境平衡的关键物种，没有它，当地往往就不稳定。强大力量与无私天性，让它守护生灵、维持和平。谁破坏安宁，就会招来怒火。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME are keystone Pokémon in otherwise unstable environments. Their strength and altruistic tendencies lead to them being guardians and peacekeepers. Disturbing this peace will evoke POKENAME's wrath.

entry: POKENAME想再加速，就点燃尾刺，像火箭一样向前推进。偷蜜者会被以可怕速度追上，很难逃脱。
author: quackquackattack
source: Whenever POKENAME needs an extra boost of speed, it ignites its tail stinger to propel itself forward like a rocket. This allows it to chase down honey thieves with terrifying speed, making escape difficult.

entry: POKENAME常被视为冷酷无情，遇谁都以猛烈蓝焰浇身。战斗先用精神力定敌，再抛向空中，从下方喷火。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME is typically viewed as a heartless  Pokémon, dousing anyone it comes across in intense blue flames. Its battle style consists of holding down foes with psychic powers before throwing them into the air and blasting fire from below.

entry: POKENAME迎战强敌前，先长时间休息储能。开战便耗尽力量，放出巨大火球，瞬间熔掉敌人。
author: soup1900
source: Before taking on a strong opponent, POKENAME takes a long rest to store up its energy. When it's time to battle, it uses up all its power to unleash a gigantic fireball to instantly melt the foe away.

entry: POKENAME只凭意念，就能让交战敌人不断燃起烈火，直到求饶。DNA编码让尾焰始终极旺，也让它总想战斗。
author: soup1900
source: Using only its mind, POKENAME will constantly ignite foes it is battling into bursting flames until they beg for mercy before it. Its tail will always burn super intensely due to how its DNA is coded, making it always itching for a fight.

entry: POKENAME几乎只做战斗一件事，不断寻找越来越强的敌人。它能让全身裹火，再在战斗中一阵阵释放。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME do almost nothing but battle, constantly seeking out stronger and stronger opponents to fight. They can engulf their entire bodies in flames, releasing them in bursts during battle.

entry: POKENAME想通过打赢每个宝可梦物种的一员，证明自己。强大控火能力，几秒就能唤出燃烧火球。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME seeks to prove itself in battle by besting a member of every single Pokémon species in combat. It can conjure up burning orbs of flame in seconds using its powerful pyrokinesis abilities.

entry: 围绕POKENAME的传说很多。其中一种称，它主要会制造巨型火球，掷向对手。
author: seanothan_23
source: There are many legends surrounding POKENAME. One claims that its main method of attack relies on creating giant fireballs and hurling them at its opponents.

entry: 直到高速摄像机普及，才确认野生POKENAME存在。在此之前，它实在太快，没有可靠记录。
author: oreee0230
source: It wasn't until high-speed cameras became common that wild individuals of POKENAME were confirmed to exist. Before that, because of how fast it was, there were no reliable records of it.

entry: POKENAME的翼很容易折起，不用时便不碍事。速度与火焰，是野外生存最大的本钱。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME's wings can be easily folded so they don't get in the way when not needed. Its speed and flames are its biggest assets for surviving in the wild.

entry: POKENAME背火和口中喷火，都热得能熔石。与训练家建立羁绊后，它可靠坚韧，深受挑战联盟的人喜爱。
author: fiordaliso
source: The flames on its back and those POKENAME breathe are hot enough to melt stone. When bonded with its Trainer, it becomes reliable and tenacious, making it a popular choice for League challengers.

entry: 它高飞在寒冷稀薄的空气中。养鸟人传说，POKENAME若在地上待得太久，羽毛就会起火。
author: ozydamians
source: It flies high above the ground where the air is cold and thin. A birdkeeper legend says if POKENAME spends too much time on the ground, its feathers burst into flame.

entry: POKENAME尾尖火焰极热，冬天也能保暖，无需迁离巢穴。每年换羽一次，保持翅膀强壮。
author: fiordaliso
source: The flame burning at the tip of its tail is so hot that it keeps POKENAME warm during winter, meaning it never needs to migrate from its nest. It moults its feathers once a year to keep its wings strong.

entry: POKENAME修长蛇形身体穿过灌木，寻找强敌或无助猎物。尾巴常引发草原火灾。
author: opossiblymage
source: POKENAME's lithe, serpentine body weaves through the brush, searching for powerful opponents or helpless prey. Its tail is a common cause of grassland fires.

entry: POKENAME虽小，却极其凶猛有威胁。它把翅裹住小身体，旋转踢击对手。
author: silverscloudy
source: Despite their small size, POKENAME are extremely aggressive and threatening. They wrap their wings around their tiny bodies as they spin and kick their opponents.

entry: POKENAME是昼行猛禽，擅长耐力追猎，不过有时会让自己过热。曾有人观察到，它夜里会把火完全熄灭，降低体温。
author: silverscloudy
source: POKENAME are diurnal birds of prey that excel in persistence hunting, though they may overheat themselves in the act. At night, they have been observed to completely extinguish their flames to cool their bodies down.

entry: POKENAME飞过森林，会从翅膀撒出火星。传言每点火星都象征天上一颗星，不过真假不明。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME scatter embers from their wings as they fly through forests. It is rumored that each speck of ember represents a star in the sky, though the veracity of this claim is unknown.

entry: POKENAME尾尖火焰极热，冬天也能保暖，无需迁离巢穴。每年换羽一次，保持翅膀强壮。
author: fiordaliso
source: The flame burning at the tip of its tail is so hot that it keeps POKENAME warm during winter, meaning it never needs to migrate from its nest. It moults its feathers once a year to keep its wings strong.

entry: 战况艰难时，POKENAME会让头部裹上噼啪烈焰，准备全力以赴。羽毛脱落仍温暖，因此常用于某些冬衣的填充料。
author: fiordaliso
source: When a battle becomes tough, POKENAME cloaks its head in crackling flames, ready to give its all. Its feathers stay warm even after they fall off, which is why they are often used as padding in certain types of winter jackets.

entry: 目力比最强的望远镜还精准。从数英里高空，它会撒下炽热的火点，如雨般降落。
author: ozydamians
source: Its eyes are more powerful and precise than even the strongest telescope. From miles above, it rains down superheated motes of fire.

entry: POKENAME个头矮、体重轻，飞行高度能接近喷火龙的两倍。储电越多，尾焰就越强。
author: daimposter_60614
source: Due to POKENAME's small weight and height, it can fly nearly twice as high as a Charizard. The more electricity it has stored, the stronger the flame on its tail gets.

entry: POKENAME想表现可怕，却很少成功。对敌人的咆哮，听起来更像细细的吱叫。
author: bostroms
source: POKENAME tries to project a fearsome image, but it is rarely ever successful.  It will roar at its opponents, but it comes out as more of a squeak.

entry: POKENAME弹上空中，乱甩尾巴，想吓唬大敌。幸好四散火星，通常就足以把对方赶走。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME bounce into the air while flailing their tails to try and intimidate larger foes. Fortunately for them, the stray embers scattered by their tails are usually enough to drive foes away.

entry: 它产生足够的热量与空气，让训练家即使身处太空边缘，也能安然无恙。从遥远下方看，POKENAME很像传说的宝可梦。
author: ozydamians
source: It generates enough heat and air to safely insulate its Trainer even at the edge of space. From far below, you might mistake POKENAME for a legendary Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME战斗时，尾巴像热灯发光，散热如篝火。因此即使浓雾中，也很容易发现它参与的战斗。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME's tail glows like a heat lamp in the midst of battle, putting off heat similar to a bonfire. Fights where POKENAME are involved are easily spotted even through dense fog.

entry: POKENAME边舞边留下燃烧轨迹，吸收阳光，让火更热。据说它的舞能带来酷热浪潮。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME leave a blazing trail as they dance, absorbing sunlight in order to make their flames burn hotter. Their dances are said to bring about scorching heatwaves.

entry: POKENAME边舞边留下燃烧轨迹，吸收阳光，让火更热。据说它的舞能带来酷热浪潮。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME leave a blazing trail as they dance, absorbing sunlight in order to make their flames burn hotter. Their dances are said to bring about scorching heatwaves.

entry: POKENAME无论往翅膀上喷多少次喷射火焰，翅膀总是湿的。太重，走起来不舒服，它因此更喜欢游泳。
author: quackquackattack
source: No matter how many Flamethrowers POKENAME shoots at its wings, they always remain wet. These heavy wings are uncomfortable to walk with, so it prefers swimming instead.

entry: POKENAME飞得快，羽毛很容易脱落，在身后飘荡。羽毛明亮燃烧，便形成飞行留下火迹的错觉。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The speeds at which POKENAME fly cause feathers to easily come loose from their body, drifting behind them in their wake. Their feathers burn brightly, which creates the illusion that POKENAME leave a burning trail behind them as they fly.

entry: POKENAME飞得快，羽毛很容易脱落，在身后飘荡。羽毛明亮燃烧，便形成飞行留下火迹的错觉。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The speeds at which POKENAME fly cause feathers to easily come loose from their body, drifting behind them in their wake. Their feathers burn brightly, which creates the illusion that POKENAME leave a burning trail behind them as they fly.

entry: POKENAME飞得快，羽毛很容易脱落，在身后飘荡。羽毛明亮燃烧，便形成飞行留下火迹的错觉。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The speeds at which POKENAME fly cause feathers to easily come loose from their body, drifting behind them in their wake. Their feathers burn brightly, which creates the illusion that POKENAME leave a burning trail behind them as they fly.

entry: POKENAME食欲旺盛，总是饿，会偷偷进农场仓库，洗劫树果、种子等食物。谁想赶走，就得面对强大火焰。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is a voracious, constantly hungry creature. It sneaks into farm storerooms to raid berries, seeds, and other food. Anyone who tries to drive it away risks facing its powerful flames.

entry: 神奥有传说称，宝可梦统治大地时，POKENAME曾帮阿尔宙斯造太阳。不过其他地区另有说法，使它成为争议话题。
author: firstromaniandiscoerd
source: Some Sinnohan legends say that back when Pokémon ruled the land, POKENAME helped Arceus build the sun. Other legends from different regions say otherwise, making POKENAME a controversial topic.

entry: 两只野生POKENAME相遇，空战便不可避免。它们互咬互撞争霸，斗志越旺，火越热，翅也拍得越快。
author: sk372
source: If two POKENAME meet in the wild, an aerial dogfight is inevitable. The two will bite and bash against each other in a battle for supremacy, their flames heating up and their wings beating ever faster as their fighting spirits ignite.

entry: POKENAME口中喷水，尾巴就会烧红，帮助产生升力，因此起飞前常这样做。拍翼还会产生黏膜，使身形更符合空气动力。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: When POKENAME sprays water from its mouth, its tail glows red-hot. This helps it generate lift, so it often does this before taking flight. As it flaps its wings, it produces a sticky film that makes it more aerodynamic.

entry: POKENAME在火山加热的温暖泥浆池中游泳筑巢。下蛋后便飞走，让咕嘟冒泡的泥孵育幼崽。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME swim and nest within mud pots, places where water superheated by volcanic activity forms warm, muddy ponds. They fly away after laying eggs, leaving their young to be incubated by the bubbling mud.

entry: POKENAME预感危险，就会飞往安全处，因此看见它被视为吉兆。它主动找合适的训练家，一有机会便尝试接触。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME will fly to a safe place after anticipating possible danger, so seeing POKENAME is considered a good omen. It actively seeks out a suitable Trainer and will attempt to make contact with them as soon as it can.

entry: POKENAME喷出灼热火焰，周身环纹便泛金光。性子倔强不屈，有时虽爱训练家，却仍不肯服从。
author: fiordaliso
source: When POKENAME blows scorching bursts of fire, the rings on its body shine with a golden light. It's a Pokémon with an indomitable temperament, which sometimes refuses to follow its Trainer's commands despite the affection it feels for them.

entry: POKENAME在暗处潜猎，借翅膀远跃，打目标个措手不及。它用硬爪和烧焦的地形标记领地。
author: infinex21
source: It prowls in the dark as it hunts for prey, using its wings to leap far and catch its target off-guard. POKENAME marks its territory using its tough claws and by scorching terrain with its flames.

entry: POKENAME喷出灼热火焰，周身环纹便泛金光。性子倔强不屈，有时虽爱训练家，却仍不肯服从。
author: fiordaliso
source: When POKENAME blows scorching bursts of fire, the rings on its body shine with a golden light. It's a Pokémon with an indomitable temperament, which sometimes refuses to follow its Trainer's commands despite the affection it feels for them.

entry: 野生POKENAME栖息在长有仙人掌的稀树草原。人们常采下它背上的仙人掌，做成美味的炸条。
author: soup1900
source: Wild POKENAME can be found in savannah biomes where cacti grow. The cactus on its back is often harvested to make delicious cactus fries.

entry: 野生POKENAME极其凶暴，常因打架而短命。不过若一生都获妥善训练，就会十分亲昵、听话。
author: bobosmith01
source: Wild POKENAME are extremely aggressive and often lead short lives due to getting into fights. However, if properly trained throughout its life, a Trainer's POKENAME will be incredibly affectionate and well-behaved.

entry: POKENAME以周身盘旋的能量团作为主要攻势。它们触碰即爆，并不停追赶指定目标。不过打中本体，就能扰乱精神力，短暂使能量团失效。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME sends forth the wisps that orbit its body as its primary means of offense. These wisps explode on contact and chase a given target relentlessly. However, striking POKENAME will disrupt its psychic powers, momentarily neutralizing the wisps.

entry: POKENAME以周身盘旋的能量团作为主要攻势。它们触碰即爆，并不停追赶指定目标。不过打中本体，就能扰乱精神力，短暂使能量团失效。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME sends forth the wisps that orbit its body as its primary means of offense. These wisps explode on contact and chase a given target relentlessly. However, striking POKENAME will disrupt its psychic powers, momentarily neutralizing the wisps.

entry: POKENAME用炽热的身体熔化岩石，钻过山腹。巨嘴吞下沿途碎屑，也吃宝石矿物，让盘绕的身躯更强。
author: fiordaliso
source: It carves its way through the heart of the mountains, melting the rock with its incandescent body. POKENAME uses its enormous mouth to swallow the debris in its path and to feed on gems and minerals that can make its coils even stronger.

entry: POKENAME在山区群居，喜欢把巢筑在能避雨的岩洞附近。它用强火驱赶入侵者，也用来捕猎。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME lives with its flock in the mountains, as it loves to build its nest near rocky caves that can shelter it from the rain. With its powerful flames, it drives away intruders who enter its territory and hunts down its prey.

entry: POKENAME绕活火山飞，用热加固钻石般的硬皮。它领地意识极强，用火焰抽打驱敌。两只相遇，就会激烈空战。
author: ghostslythe
source: POKENAME circles active volcanoes, using the heat to harden its diamond-tough hide. Fiercely territorial, it drives off Pokémon with flaming lashes. When two meet, a violent aerial clash begins.

entry: POKENAME身体极耐热，头状双爪的眼孔亮起，就代表将喷出大股火。虽能远攻，它仍更喜欢贴身，连续挥出火焰爪击。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME's body is highly heat-resistant. The eyeholes on its head-shaped claws light up when it is about to unleash a torrent of flame from them. Despite this ranged option, it prefers to assault foes up close with a barrage of flaming claw strikes.

entry: POKENAME身体极耐热，头状双爪的眼孔亮起，就代表将喷出大股火。虽能远攻，它仍更喜欢贴身，连续挥出火焰爪击。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME's body is highly heat-resistant. The eyeholes on its head-shaped claws light up when it is about to unleash a torrent of flame from them. Despite this ranged option, it prefers to assault foes up close with a barrage of flaming claw strikes.

entry: POKENAME壳里发酵的树果汁很辣。有人说，想训练它，得喝下这混合汁液，挺得住，还不能掉眼泪。
author: teatedtiten
source: The berry juice fermented in its shell is very spicy.  Some claim that to train POKENAME, you must survive drinking the concoction without shedding a tear.

entry: POKENAME在不活跃的熔岩隧道筑巢，让内部热到危险，因此这些隧道会暂时对公众关闭。敌对个体打起来，也常猛烈到熔化周围岩石。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME nest in inactive lava tunnels, which causes the heat within to rise to unsafe levels and forces these tunnels to be briefly closed to the public. Fights between rival POKENAME are often intense and melt away the surrounding rock.

entry: POKENAME伸长颈探进洞穴、灌木找猎物。够不到，就往巢里喷火，把对方逼出来。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME stretches its long neck into burrows and bushes to find prey. If it cannot reach its prey, it shoots fire into the nest to lure prey out of their homes.

entry: POKENAME尾里存煤，能点燃，变成迷你喷火器。外表虽可怕，它用火十分谨慎，冬天还帮人点壁炉。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME store coal within their tails that can be ignited to turn their tails into miniature flamethrowers. Despite their threatening appearance, they are very deliberate with their flames and even light people's fireplaces in winter.

entry: 军方曾用POKENAME的烈焰与灼热利爪，熔穿坦克。战争结束后，它们住在自然保护区，以熔废金属丰富日常生活。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME were once used by the military to melt through tanks with their fiery flamethrower and searing hot talons. Now that war is over, they live in nature reserves where they melt down scrap metal as an enrichment activity.

entry: POKENAME格外愤怒，头冠就会燃烧。它是凶猛猎手，先喷烈火削弱猎物，再用利爪抓住。
author: fiordaliso
source: The crest on POKENAME head bursts into flames when it is particularly angry. It is a very ferocious predator that weakens its prey with violent bursts of flame before snatching it with its sharp claws.

entry: POKENAME的超热尖牙能熔穿金属防御，这是惊人的生物本领。可外貌乏味，没有角等独特特征，反而掩盖了这份出众。
author: quackquackattack
