source: POKENAME have superheated fangs that can melt through metallic defenses. This amazing feat of biology is undermined by their lackluster appearance, which lacks horns or other unique features to make them distinct.

entry: POKENAME滚动前会发出吵闹的号鸣，让其他宝可梦躲起来。它撞树丛，打落树果，再烤焦调味。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME releases an obstreperous trumpeting whenever they are about to roll, which causes other Pokémon to hide. They ram into trees and bushes to knock down berries before charring them to taste.

entry: POKENAME领地意识极强，总在火山家园上方顺时针盘旋。发现同类，就发出响亮的哔哔吼声，宣告所有权。
author: .izik
source: Extremely territorial, POKENAME flies in clockwise circles above its volcanic home. Should it spot another of its kind, it lets out a loud beeping roar to assert its claim.

entry: POKENAME一交战，就用翅裹身，随之旋转起舞，积起无匹动量。它无论打什么架，都乐在其中。
author: beatdoof
source: The moment it engages in a fight, POKENAME cloaks its body with its wings, spinning around with it to gain unparalleled momentum as it dances. POKENAME finds joy in any fight it's in, no matter what.

entry: POKENAME能用火牙击倒大猎物。尖牙超热，熔穿金属鳞甲和外壳，让很少有宝可梦能抵御。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can take down large prey with their flaming fangs. Their superheated fangs melt through metal scales and shells, leaving few Pokémon capable of defending themselves against POKENAME.

entry: 一被POKENAME缠住，就不可能逃出硫磺烈焰。
author: gasmaskblacky
source: Once a POKENAME wraps its body around a foe, escaping its sulfuric flames becomes an impossible task.

entry: POKENAME会制造完全由奶组成的滚沸风暴，从天降下热奶。坏脾气加上危险奶温，让许多生物不想遇见它。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME create boiling storms made entirely out of milk, raining down the hot liquid from the sky. Their hot temper and dangerously hot milk cause many to avoid encounters with POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME是个急性子的厨师。强烈情绪会让育儿袋里的火焰增强，因此厨艺虽好，却常在压力下把菜烧糊。
author: leshii
source: POKENAME is a hotheaded chef, but the fire in its pouch intensifies with strong emotions. Despite its skill, it frequently burns dishes when stressed.

entry: POKENAME身体散出的能量，曾让当地电网超载停电。因此它常远离现代城市，留在乡野。
author: wiz0z
source: The energy exuding from POKENAME's body has been known to overwhelm local power grids and cause blackouts. As such, POKENAME tend to keep away from modern cities and linger in rural areas.

entry: 激战中，POKENAME用炽热、极不稳定的粉尘裹住自身和附近。牙齿碰击迸出火星，点燃粉尘，引发大爆炸。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME surrounds their body and the immediate area with hot, highly volatile dust in the heat of battle. The snapping of their teeth acts as a spark, igniting the dust and causing a large explosion.

entry: POKENAME的毛收集空气中的易燃微粒，再将其烧掉。这本领能净化空气，因此颇受欢迎。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME's fur collects flammable particles from the air and burns them. Because of this ability, it can purify the air, which makes it pretty popular.

entry: POKENAME身体沉，小翼举不起。不过它喷出的灼热火焰，能烧尽挡路一切，足以弥补。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have heavy bodies that their small wings cannot lift from the ground. They more than make up for this by releasing searing hot flames to burn anything in their path.

entry: 别的宝可梦靠近，POKENAME通常独自躲开。被打扰就非常恼怒，喷出灼热火焰驱赶。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME tend to keep to themselves whenever another Pokémon approaches. They grow incredibly irate when disturbed and will shoot out scorching flames to scare away other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME翅膀强，活动却被壳限制。它靠喷火飞行，在进化前尽量避免一切战斗。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME's wings are strong, but their range of motion is restricted by their shell. They rely on shooting out flames to fly, using this to avoid any battles as much as possible before they evolve.

entry: POKENAME把整座山当领地。哪怕只踏入一只宝可梦，也会被烈火吞没。
author: zaymcawesome
source: POKENAME claims entire mountains as its territory. If even a single Pokémon steps into its domain, it will burn them down in a fiery inferno.

entry: POKENAME生气就放出灼热沙暴，破坏当地生态。许多宝可梦害怕避开，因此不少个体终生孤独。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME unleash searing hot sandstorms whenever they are angry, which wreaks havoc on the local ecosystem. Many Pokémon avoid them out of fear, so many POKENAME live life in isolation.

entry: POKENAME把整座山当领地。哪怕只踏入一只宝可梦，也会被烈火吞没。
author: zaymcawesome
source: POKENAME claims entire mountains as its territory. If even a single Pokémon steps into its domain, it will burn them down in a fiery inferno.

entry: POKENAME凶猛地守地盘，在峡谷中或附近筑巢。火焰持续喷出，热得能熔实心岩石。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are viciously territorial Pokémon that make their nests within or near canyons. Their flames are hot enough that a consistent stream of their fire can melt solid rock.

entry: POKENAME怒到极点，脸颊便放出大量火花。这些火花曾引起大规模森林火灾。
author: dodoowner_
source: When extremely furious, POKENAME will discharge a large number of sparks from its cheeks. These sparks are known to ignite large forest fires.

entry: POKENAME身上火太多，双翼之间竟出现火焰生物。据说这火鸟，是心地纯净的训练家们的心灵显现。
author: kam_doodle_snek
source: The overabundance of fire on POKENAME's body has caused a being of flames to appear between its wings. This fiery bird is said to be the manifestation of the spirits of pure-hearted Trainers.

entry: POKENAME体力不足，更喜欢高速飞着喷火。它常穿越回过去，再战曾交手的强敌，不管当初输赢。
author: actliux
source: POKENAME's physical strength is lacking, so they prefer to fly around at great speeds while breathing fire. They tend to travel back in time to battle a strong opponent they previously fought, regardless of whether they won or lost.

entry: POKENAME的焰爪切油轮船壳，如切黄油般容易。目标若太远，就常朝对方投掷熔融的碎屑。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's flaming claws are hot enough to slice through a tanker hull like butter. If its target is too far away however, it has a tendency to throw molten debris at its target.

entry: POKENAME需要极热才能筑巢，常把部分森林点燃。它啃过焦树，堆在道路上造巢，却不知挡住了救援车辆。
author: jaminmcready
source: To create the extreme heat they need for nesting, POKENAME frequently set parts of the forest ablaze. They gnaw through charred trees and pile them across roads to build their nests, unaware that they are blocking rescue vehicles.

entry: POKENAME体温保护口袋里的蛋，让其充满治愈力量。宽翼能使它迅速穿空，方便在到访城市中快速移动。
author: fiordaliso
source: The warmth from POKENAME's body keeps the egg in its pouch safe and filled with healing power. With its wide wings, it can dart swiftly through the air, a skill it uses to move quickly across the cities it visits.

entry: POKENAME翅膀太轻，不适合长途飞行。不过火中带电，强过喷火龙。据说它在卡洛斯很受欢迎。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME's wings are too light for long-distance flights, but its flames are stronger than Charizard's because they contain electricity. It's said that POKENAME is quite popular in Kalos.

entry: POKENAME存下战斗没用完的电，方便各种情况取用。有时会放出来，让其他宝可梦惊叹，或吓退对方。
author: _alex_0o
source: POKENAME stores excess electricity not used in battle, allowing it to draw upon it in various situations. It sometimes releases this energy to impress other Pokémon or to scare them away.

entry: 它大多只想吃睡，不过有必要，也会战斗抢食。它展开翅膀威吓，希望不必打就能夺走食物。
author: infinex21
source: Though it prefers to eat and sleep most of the time, it will fight others to claim food for itself if it has to. It spreads its wings to intimidate others, hoping to be able to take their food without a fight.

entry: POKENAME闯快餐店，大吃冷冻库里的肉。谁想打扰，一试着靠近，就会看见恐怖的暗示信息。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME break into fast food establishments to feast upon the meat in the freezers. Any who disturb POKENAME find themselves seeing horrific subliminal messages when they try to approach.

entry: POKENAME闯快餐店，大吃冷冻库里的肉。谁想打扰，一试着靠近，就会看见恐怖的暗示信息。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME break into fast food establishments to feast upon the meat in the freezers. Any who disturb POKENAME find themselves seeing horrific subliminal messages when they try to approach.

entry: POKENAME是活跃的战斗狂，渴望与同类和其他宝可梦打。它常切换火、冰属性招式，让对手疲于应付温差。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME is an active battle fanatic, always eager to fight with its own kind and other Pokémon. It often switches between Fire-type and Ice-type moves to keep opponents struggling with the changing temperatures.

entry: POKENAME高温的角，能轻松破开岩壁。有时手臂射出的不是石头，而是熔岩球。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME's high-temperature horns can help it easily break through rock walls. Sometimes, what it shoots from its arms isn't rocks, but balls of lava.

entry: POKENAME学会存下战斗没用完的电，遇到困境便能取用。有时会放出来，让其他宝可梦惊叹，或吓退对方。
author: _alex_0o
source: POKENAME has learned to store excess electricity not used in battle, allowing it to draw upon it in difficult situations. It sometimes releases this energy to impress other Pokémon or to scare them away.

entry: POKENAME脸颊发电，形成电磁场，托身体离地。接着靠翅膀，飞到数百英尺高。
author: daimposter_60614
source: POKENAME will generate electricity in their cheeks, creating an electromagnetic field to lift them off the ground. From here, POKENAME use their wings to fly hundreds of feet into the air.

entry: POKENAME能连续飞5小时。少了砖块状的鳞片，让它更容易受空中捕食者袭击。
author: mystora
source: POKENAME can fly for 5 hours without stopping. A lack of brick-like scales makes them more susceptible to attacks from aerial predators.

entry: POKENAME飞得极快，身体柔韧，灵活度无匹，能轻松穿梭家园森林。行动本领加上猛烈火力，使它成为危险对手。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME flies at extremely high speed, and its flexible body gives it unmatched agility, perfect for weaving through the trees of the forests where it lives. Its mobility, combined with its intense firepower, make it a dangerous opponent.

entry: POKENAME尾焰始终带焦叶味。战意越强，火越大；若整尾都被包住，它很可能攻击下一个看见的野生生物。
author: sk372
source: The flame on its tail constantly emits the smell of burnt leaves. The size of the flame grow as its want for battle increases; if the entire tail is engulfed, POKENAME will likely attack the next wild creature it sees.

entry: POKENAME夜间栖息在城堡塔顶，能听见数英里外闯入者的动静，因此很受王室喜爱。
author: robosoup
source: POKENAME roosts atop castle towers at night, and can hear interlopers from miles away. This makes them a favorite companion of royalty.

entry: POKENAME从不满意自己的力量，会游荡暗网，寻找让火更强的新方法。固执性格，让新手训练家极难驾驭。
author: fiordaliso
source: It roams the dark web in search of new ways to make its flames ever more powerful, as it is never satisfied with its own strength. Due to its stubbornness, POKENAME can be extremely difficult for inexperienced Trainers to handle.

entry: POKENAME黏脚趾能附在任何表面，连火山玻璃也行。火尾在飞行各处，都留下一道烟迹。
author: pastapockets
source: POKENAME can attach to any service with its sticky toes, even volcanic glass. Its fiery tail leaves a smoke trail wherever it flies.

entry: 它的翅膀太小，无法带身体飞起，却能在丛林中以无匹速度滑翔，凭敏锐目光寻找下一位对手。
author: rhynarok
source: Though its wings are too small to carry it into the skies, it glides at unmatched speed through the jungle, searching with keen eyes for its next opponent.

entry: POKENAME这一种火焰极热，父母会在山地育幼。幼崽以攻击学习控火，若在干灌丛中，很容易失控。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME are raised by their parents in mountainous terrain due to this species' intensely hot fire. While learning how to control their internal flames by attacking, this fire can easily grow out of control in areas of dry brush.

entry: POKENAME生气，背刺就裹上烈焰，热得连雨也浇不灭。它常在干旱沙漠的沙丘，独自生活。
author: fiordaliso
source: When angry, the spines on its back are enveloped in flames so hot that they cannot be extinguished even by rain. POKENAME can be found in the dunes of arid deserts, where it leads a solitary life.

entry: POKENAME飞过山中家园，寻找强敌切磋，积累经验。它用利爪、强踢和火息攻击，战况越烈，吐息越热。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: Flying around the mountains it calls home, POKENAME searches for strong opponents to spar with for experience. It attacks with its sharp claws, strong kicks, and a fiery breath that gains heat the more intense the battle gets.

entry: POKENAME好胜，总想打架，常在火山洞里主动寻找强韧对手。自认为对手越强，尾焰就越大。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: These competitive Pokémon are always looking for a fight. POKENAME will hang around inside volcanic caverns, actively seeking out sturdy Pokémon to battle with. The stronger an opponent this Pokémon believes it's fighting, the larger its tail flame.

entry: POKENAME体内火热得惊人，皮肤羽毛天然漆黑，火焰则鲜蓝。被火拳、火脚击中，会留下永久伤疤。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: The fire within POKENAME is so incredibly hot that its skin and feathers are naturally black, and its fire is bright blue. If an opponent gets hit by this Pokémon's fiery feet or fists, the attack will permanently scar the opponent's body.

entry: POKENAME交战时，腕火更亮、更猛烈。流线身体让它迅速移位，连续踢击，再闪开来袭攻击。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: When in combat, the fire around POKENAME's wrists grow brighter and more intense. Its aerodynamic body allows POKENAME to quickly move around the battlefield and attack with kicks in quick succession, then dodge out of the way of oncoming attacks.

entry: POKENAME的翼无法持续飞行，不过跃空后，能帮助朝想要的方向滑翔或俯冲。它的空中飞踢，深受踢拳选手推崇。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: While POKENAME's wings do not allow it to sustain flight, they do help this Pokémon glide or dive in a desired direction after jumping into the air. POKENAME's air dropkicks are idolized by kickboxers.

entry: POKENAME极其敏捷，靠强健双腿和翅膀，在空中与陆地灵活移动。它在山区选视野好的地方安家，方便起飞，伏击威胁巢穴的敌人。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: Extremely agile, POKENAME use their powerful legs and wings to maneuver the air and land. These Pokémon make their homes in the mountains where they have the best vantage points for taking flight and ambushing enemies who threaten their nests.

entry: 长出新翅膀后，POKENAME便不再玩泥巴了。如今，它的目光已投向云端。
author: shocktopus1717
source: With its new wings, POKENAME has abandoned its habit of playing in mud. It has its eyes set on the clouds now.

entry: POKENAME极善游熔岩，翅膀在熔岩和空中都能高速推进。察觉将喷发，就收集大石，保护巢穴。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are uniquely skilled at swimming through lava, their wings propelling them through both molten rock and air at high speeds. When they sense an approaching eruption, they gather large boulders to protect their dens.

entry: POKENAME对别人的情绪、心境敏感，常跟着一起感受。附近有怒气，唤出的火就更强；正面平静的情绪，则让火安静。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are sensitive to the emotions and moods of others, often mirroring how those around them are feeling. The flames they conjure become more powerful in the presence of anger and quieten around positive and calm emotions.

entry: POKENAME跳舞时用双手卷火。这些火球，既是舞蹈的火焰奇景，战斗也同样好用。
author: sk372
source: As POKENAME dances about, it whips up flames with its hands. These fireballs are equally effective as a flaming spectacle for its dances as they are in combat.

entry: POKENAME把特殊舞蹈练至完美，舞动时，身后便显出龙的形象。这道火焰龙影甚至能离开本体，短暂并肩战斗。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME that have perfected the art of their special dances manifest the image of a dragon behind them as they dance. This flaming spirit can even separate and fight alongside them in battle for a time.

entry: POKENAME是骄傲斗士，很难赢得认可。野生个体随时准备战斗，唯有认可的训练家在旁，周身火焰才会平静。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME is a proud warrior, and earning its recognition is a tough challenge. Wild POKENAME is always ready to fight, and the flames around it will only calm down around trainers it acknowledges.

entry: POKENAME身体和精神力量庞大，觉得很少有宝可梦能构成挑战。因此，很少见它在战斗中认真出力。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's vast physical and mental power makes it feel as if there are few Pokémon that could give it a challenge. It is a rare sight to see it put in any more than a cursory effort in combat.

entry: 这种融合体只在圈养下出现，需要经常用多样活动丰富生活，并锻炼身体，才能维持温顺。POKENAME一焦躁，就会用刺与火息破坏围栏，或攻击同处的宝可梦。
author: .fedoraman
source: This fusion only occurs in captivity, but when it does, it needs frequent enrichment and exercise to maintain its docile nature. Restless POKENAME will make use of their barbs and flame breath to damage their enclosure or the other Pokémon within.

entry: POKENAME住在黑暗洞窟，用尾火照路。独自不算强，但成群能完美同步，连成年大钢蛇也能击倒。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME lives in dark caves and uses the flame on its tail to light its path. Although a POKENAME is not particularly powerful alone, a swarm of POKENAME can fight in perfect unison to take down even a full-grown Steelix.

entry: POKENAME汇集体内三个额外大脑的精神力，造出足以熔金属的火。先把猎物逼入绝境，再牙爪并用解决。
author: torterrable
source: POKENAME combines the psychic power of the three extra brains hidden in its body to create fire hot enough to melt metal. It uses these flames to corner its prey before finishing them off with its claws and teeth.

entry: POKENAME每从楔石现身，都大声咆哮。周围火焰极热，水还未接触就蒸发，几乎无法瞄准楔石。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME releases a bellowing roar each time it emerges from its keystone. The flames around POKENAME are so hot that targeting its keystone becomes nearly impossible, as the flames evaporate water before contact is made.

entry: POKENAME的火焰会随感知到的周围人的意图而增强。一旦察觉威胁，便会猛烈蹿起。
author: final_courtesy
source: The flames on POKENAME intensify in response to the detected intentions of people nearby. The flames surge fiercely when a threat is perceived.

entry: 时速可达惊人的1,000英里。不过，飞过后难免留下余烬，有时会引发野火。
author: skymaster426
source: Its speed reaches a blistering 1,000 mph. However, it can't help but leave embers in its wake, sometimes causing wildfires where it flies.

entry: POKENAME全身不断涌出极热烈焰，越兴奋、越怒，还会越热。它凭高速轻松接近，以剃刀般锋利的双臂解决虚弱对手。
author: fireblade141
source: The flames constantly surging from POKENAME's body are incredibly hot and only get hotter the more excited or enraged it becomes. It uses its high speed to easily close the distance and finish off weakened opponents with its razor-sharp arms.

entry: POKENAME在空中翱翔，向下方毫无防备的受害者洒下燃烧的酸液，宛如飞翔的酸液火山，自己却浑然不知造成了多少破坏。
author: benevolent
source: Oblivious to the wreckage it causes, POKENAME soars through the air, spewing flaming acid onto its unwitting victims below like a flying acid volcano.

entry: 它背上花朵的高热煮沸花蜜，辛辣花香传出数英里。拍动巨翼，还能卷起灼热的火焰风暴，烧毁整片森林。
author: shivaequinox
source: The intense heat from its back-flower causes nectar to boil, releasing a spicy and floral scent that can be smelled for miles. By flapping its massive wings it can whip up searing firestorms to incinerate entire forests.

entry: POKENAME以凶猛领地意识和醒目外形闻名。它的雕像，曾被用于装饰城堡和大教堂的外墙。
author: .fedoraman
source: Known for their fierce territoriality and striking features, statues of POKENAME have been used to decorate the outer walls of castles and cathedrals.

entry: POKENAME会到处寻找强敌。虽然个头小，却对自己的力量极为自豪。
author: mossybanana
source: POKENAME will go around looking for tough opponents. Despite its small stature, it is very proud of its power.

entry: 许多人把POKENAME巨颚错认成真头。它外表野性十足，性情却十分友好，新手和资深训练家都能相处融洽。
author: kam_doodle_snek
source: Many people mistake POKENAME's giant jaw as the actual head. Despite its wild appearance, POKENAME is an incredibly friendly Pokémon and gets along well with both young and experienced Trainers.

entry: POKENAME个头虽小，却是活跃猎手。被大型捕食者盯上，便能用强翼迅速逃走。
author: oreee0230
source: Although POKENAME is small in size, it is an active predator. When targeted by bigger hunters, POKENAME can quickly escape using its strong wings.

entry: POKENAME爱吃海鲜大餐，却因火焰无法下水猎。它改在水上飞，用嘴掠过水面，捞走倒霉猎物。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: POKENAME enjoys a seafood feast, but cannot hunt in the water due to its flames. Instead, it flies above the water, skimming the surface with its mouth and picking up any unfortunate prey.

entry: 群落里，除了最强的POKENAME，其他翅膀都很小，从正面看不见。主导雌性倒下前，其余成员不是护蛋，就是离开，加入别群。
author: .fedoraman
source: For all but the strongest POKENAME of the colony, their wings will remain tiny, not visible from the front. Until the dominant female falls, the others either protect its eggs, or leave to join another colony.

entry: POKENAME品性高贵，察觉山火，就会寻找孩子和小型宝可梦，载着飞离危险。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: POKENAME is a very noble creature. When it senses wildfires, it will look for children and small Pokémon so it can fly them away from danger.

entry: POKENAME住在休眠与活跃火山附近，被认为喷发前最活跃。熔岩队用它预测喷发，会趁火山活动时尝试捕多只。
author: northkira
source: POKENAME resides around dormant and active volcanoes. It is thought POKENAME is most active when a volcano is about to erupt. Team Magma uses POKENAME to predict volcanic eruptions, attempting to catch multiple POKENAME during volcanic activity.

entry: POKENAME如此巨大沉重，却仍飞得起，堪称奇迹。光是现身就足以让人疏散，因为它能推倒摩天楼、烧毁岛屿。幸好野生个体很少能活到这危险阶段。
author: ecstaticwoop64556455
source: It's a miracle that this titanic Pokémon can fly despite its tremendous weight. Its mere presence causes evacuation, able to topple skyscrapers and torch islands. Luckily, very few wild POKENAME live to reach this dangerous stage of life.

entry: POKENAME罕见地在各地现身，寻找觉得能痛快一战的对手。目击者称，它挑得很，只与火属性或龙属性宝可梦交手。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME appears rarely across the land, materializing to fight opponents it thinks will give it a satisfactory battle. According to those who have seen it, it is particular about its foes and will only fight Fire- or Dragon-type Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME不断找强敌，找不到就很难驾驭。喷射火焰的热度，最高可达1000华氏度。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME are constantly searching for strong opponents, making them difficult to handle when such opponents are not available. The heat from their Flamethrower can get as hot as 1000°F.

entry: POKENAME用尾巴打倒树，吃叶片。整群能彻底改变环境，烧旧树林，留下肥沃空地，供新植物生长。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME use their tails to knock down trees and feed on the leaves. A herd of POKENAME can completely change their environment, burning away old groves and leaving fertile clearings for new growth.

entry: 群落最强雌性、长翼的POKENAME，是唯一产蛋者。其他成员育幼，雄性扩张领地。一群击败另一群，落败群的雄性便加入胜者。
author: .fedoraman
source: The strongest female in a colony, a winged POKENAME is the only one who lays eggs. The others raise its young while males expand territory. When one colony defeats another, its males join the victors.

entry: 这种融合体只在圈养下出现，POKENAME需要经常用多样活动丰富生活，并锻炼身体。不宜合养，因为玩闹打斗很快就会变成争胜。
author: .fedoraman
source: This fusion only occurs in captivity, but when it does, POKENAME needs frequent enrichment and exercise. It is not recommended to house POKENAME together as playfighting quickly turns competitive.

entry: POKENAME看起来可爱，却能喷出超过1800度的火焰。只要信任训练家，就会不惜一切代价保护对方。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME looks cute, but can spit out flames at over 1800 degrees. If it trusts its Trainer, it will protect them at all costs.

entry: POKENAME毫不留情地捍卫领地，将火与水在巨口中混合，喷出滚烫的蒸汽。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME defends its territory without mercy. It combines fire and water in its maw to spew boiling hot steam.

entry: 身体极为坚固，还能传导热量。POKENAME会飞起加热身体，再将对手从空中狠狠撞落。
author: chorb33
source: Its body is extremely robust and conducts heat. POKENAME flies up, heats up and then rams its opponent out of the air to hit them hard.

entry: 研究者怀疑，POKENAME必须不断喷火维持“剑刃”，这样的持续消耗让它脾气火爆。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: Researchers suspect POKENAME gets its fiery temper from the strain of constantly breathing fire to form its "blade", a constant cycle.

entry: 据说，这柄传说中的战镐，附着巨龙之魂，一挥之下，便能熔穿整支军队。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: This legendary war pick is said to be possessed by the spirit of a dragon and have the ability to melt through armies in one fell swoop.

entry: POKENAME一拔剑，裹刃的火就像伸长，更加明亮。猛烈斩敌时，还能听到愤怒喷火龙的声音。它很骄傲，只听从认定强大的训练家。
author: royrw
source: When POKENAME unsheathes their blade, the flames coating it appear to extend and burn even brighter. When slashing violently at an enemy, the sound of an enraged Charizard can be heard. POKENAME are prideful, only following Trainers they deem strong.

entry: POKENAME会把翅膀当斧头，还能从盾牌状的嘴，喷出灼热的喷射火焰。
author: royrw
source: POKENAME can be found using its wing like an axe. It can also send out a scorching Flamethrower attack from its shield-like mouth.

entry: POKENAME容易怒，常把领地里的火把错认成同类敌手。电筒出现后，这类误会几乎消失。
author: .fedoraman
source: Quick to anger, POKENAME often mistake flame torches for rival POKENAME in their territory. The advent of electric torches has made such incidents all but disappear.

entry: POKENAME奔跑时周身缠绕雷电与火焰，是当地森林火灾和停电的主要原因之一。
author: supersonicloki
source: Cloaked in lightning and flame as it runs, POKENAME is a leading cause of forest fires and power outages in the region.

entry: POKENAME外表凶、领地意识强，却会保护小宝可梦，抵御大型捕食者。加上骑士般的模样，人们常称它为“火之圣骑士”。
author: starpun.
source: POKENAME is as fierce and territorial as it looks, but can been seen protecting smaller Pokémon from larger predators. Given that and its knightly appearance, it's often called "the Paladin of Fire".

entry: POKENAME身披铠甲，责任感非凡，与人类似乎相处格外融洽。不过谁想伤害它保护的人和宝可梦，都会遭反击。
author: kam_doodle_snek
source: Clad in armor, POKENAME has an extraordinary sense of duty. It seems to get along with humans remarkably well, though it will retaliate at those who try to hurt the people and Pokémon it protects.

entry: POKENAME很适应沙漠生活。沙漠蜻蜓宽大的尾扇，在它身上成了灯笼般的火焰外壳。宽硬的翅只适合滑翔，也像太阳能板一样运作。
author: ocxin
source: POKENAME is highly adapted to desert life. What is a broad tail fan for Flygon becomes a lantern-like casing for its flame. Its wings are broad and stiff, only allowing for gliding. Instead, they function akin to solar panels.

entry: 这种POKENAME变体专精龙属性招式，速度极快。猎物常还没意识到它在，狩猎就结束了。
author: oreee0230
source: This POKENAME variant specializes in Dragon-type moves. It's super fast and often finishes its hunt before its prey even realizes it's there.

entry: POKENAME飞行时迅速振翼，奏出美妙旋律。沿途留下灼热空气，在身后形成蜃景。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME quickly vibrate their wings when in flight, resulting in a beautiful melody. Whenever they fly, POKENAME leave a trail of scorching heat, creating mirages in their wake.

entry: 它追求过无数战斗，翅膀布满伤口与疤痕。它会用厚重身体或强腿压住敌人，再直接喷下狂猛火焰。
author: infinex21
source: Its wings are marred with wounds and scars from the many battles it has sought out. It will pin a foe down using its bulky body or stout legs, then loose a torrent of raging flames directly unto them.

entry: POKENAME的力量源于与训练家的羁绊。感情越深，火焰就燃烧得越猛烈。
author: melodydelune
source: The source POKENAME's power is the bond with its Trainer. The closer it is bonded to its Trainer, the more intensely its fire burns.

entry: POKENAME翱翔城镇，以火息和毒刺四处制造混乱。哪只宝可梦敢挑战，都会被它撕开。
author: motion_09
source: POKENAME soars across towns and cities, spreading its chaos with its fiery breath and poisonous spikes, tearing through any Pokémon brave enough to challenge it.

entry: POKENAME把洋流存进尾焰，受威胁就喷出高压水。它虽然爱玩，一挥却能淹掉整片山谷。
author: segmoph
source: POKENAME stores ocean currents in its tail flame, releasing bursts of pressurized water when threatened. Despite its playful nature, it can flood entire valleys with a single swipe.

entry: POKENAME傲立敌人面前。一跺地，就裂开缝隙，向上喷出烈焰。POKENAME的鳞片如熔融金属般滚烫。
author: over9001
source: POKENAME stands proud before its opponent. When it stomps on the ground, it opens cracks that shoot blazing hot flames upwards. POKENAME's scales are as hot as molten metal.

entry: POKENAME傲立敌人面前。一跺地，就裂开缝隙，向上喷出烈焰。POKENAME的鳞片如熔融金属般滚烫。
author: over9001
source: POKENAME stands proud before its opponent. When it stomps on the ground, it opens cracks that shoot blazing hot flames upwards. POKENAME's scales are as hot as molten metal.

entry: POKENAME傲立敌人面前。一跺地，就裂开缝隙，向上喷出烈焰。POKENAME的鳞片如熔融金属般滚烫。
author: over9001
source: POKENAME stands proud before its opponent. When it stomps on the ground, it opens cracks that shoot blazing hot flames upwards. POKENAME's scales are as hot as molten metal.

entry: POKENAME傲立敌人面前。一跺地，就裂开缝隙，向上喷出烈焰。POKENAME的鳞片如熔融金属般滚烫。
author: over9001
source: POKENAME stands proud before its opponent. When it stomps on the ground, it opens cracks that shoot blazing hot flames upwards. POKENAME's scales are as hot as molten metal.

entry: POKENAME不停飞过天空，全身裹着灼热火焰。过去人们十分惧怕，因为它一下降，涌出的高热就会引发干旱。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME flies endlessly through the sky, cloaking its body in scorching flames. People lived in fear of it in the past, as when it descended, the intense heat surging from its body caused droughts.

entry: POKENAME体内一度平息的暴戾再次涌起。它唤出的地狱之火，预示着对手即将前往彼岸。
author: final_courtesy
source: Violence once sated rages anew inside POKENAME. The infernal flames conjured by POKENAME herald an opponent's impending passage to the world beyond.

entry: 有人因过热昏倒后，声称在噩梦里看见POKENAME。不过它看似凶猛，目前还没有表现敌意的记录。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: Individuals who have suffered from overheating claim to see POKENAME in their nightmares after passing out. However, this Pokémon has not been noted as hostile, despite its intense appearance.

entry: 融合能量把POKENAME巨炮变成喷火器，短短几秒，就能焚毁整栋建筑。
author: soup1900
source: Fusion energy has transformed POKENAME's massive cannon into a flamethrower. It can torch down entire buildings in mere seconds using this flamethrower.

entry: POKENAME面对怯懦狡诈的敌人时凶猛不屈。找到合意的伙伴后，金环就会发出灿烂的光芒。
author: final_courtesy
source: POKENAME is ferocious and unyielding towards cowardly, deceitful foes. Its gold rings give off a brilliant glow when it has found a favorable partner.

entry: 莱希拉姆的力量，唤醒了喷火龙潜藏的强大本领。POKENAME身体释放的热量，足以熔化雷吉艾斯，直至蒸发。
author: crazynaturekitty
source: The power of Reshiram has awoken a latent strength in Charizard. The amount of heat POKENAME's body can exert is enough to melt a Regice until it evaporates.

entry: 绰号“岩浆王”，能让地面沸腾。有人将它误认成丰缘的传说宝可梦。
author: pokepower
source: Nicknamed the "Magma King," it can make the ground boil. Some have mistaken it for a legendary Pokémon from the Hoenn region.

entry: POKENAME用壮观焰火标记领地。若看见地盘里有火，就会倾下大量泥土扑灭。
author: .fedoraman
source: POKENAME mark their territory through impressive pyrotechnical displays. If a POKENAME sees a flame within its territory, it extinguishes the flame with a deluge of earth.

entry: 日食时，能见POKENAME绕山区家园盘旋。它朝山上喷火，点燃周围。阴谋论者相信，这是向月亮发送的信号火。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME are seen circling their mountain homes during solar eclipses. They breathe fire onto the mountain, lighting the area ablaze. Conspiracy theorists believe they are creating a signal fire aimed at the moon.

entry: 专家发现，POKENAME火与电的力量结合，令火烧成蓝色。哪怕它点的小火，也能连烧数天不灭。
author: thezekrom
source: Experts found out that POKENAME's fire burns blue due to the combination of its fire and electrical powers. It was discovered that even small fires set by POKENAME can burn for days without extinguishing.

entry: POKENAME常在火山附近吸取高热，为自身充能。皮肤适应热力，碰到熔岩也若无其事。
author: thezekrom
source: POKENAME is often seen near volcanoes, absorbing the extreme heat in the area to energize its own body. Its skin is so adapted to the heat that when coming in contact with lava, it simply shrugs it off.

entry: 据说POKENAME精通相反的冰火之力，能同时冻伤、烧伤敌人，带来极端痛苦。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME is said to have a mastery in the contrasting elements of fire and ice. It can use its powers to freeze and burn opponents simultaneously, inflicting extreme pain upon them.

entry: 它在冰霜覆盖的地带捕猎，无端向一切凶狠喷火。战斗偶尔亮出背上小鳍，让自己更有威胁。
author: h0bojoe
source: It hunts in frost-covered reaches, belligerently spewing fire at anything without provocation. In battle, it occasionally flashes the small fins on its back to appear more threatening.

entry: 它在古老森林捕猎，无端向一切凶狠喷火。战斗偶尔亮出背上小鳍，让自己更有威胁。
author: h0bojoe
source: It hunts in ancient forests, belligerently spewing fire at anything without provocation. In battle, it occasionally flashes the small fins on its back to appear more threatening.

entry: POKENAME先无害地靠近对手，再突然点燃花束发动攻击。不过它不会对自认比自己弱的宝可梦这么做。
author: quantumradiation
source: POKENAME is known to approach opponents in a harmless manner, then suddenly light its bouquets aflame and attack them. However, it will not do this to Pokémon it deems weaker than itself.

entry: POKENAME看似无害，却是火山道路上出名的障碍，领地意识极强。它从高处跃下，用耳滑翔，再让火尾朝前砸向目标。
author: ghostslythe
source: Notorious obstacles on volcanic paths, POKENAME do not appear threatening. However, these Pokémon are extremely territorial. They jump from great heights, using their ears to glide towards their target, then drop leading with their flaming tail.

entry: POKENAME几秒内就能超越音速。双翼和火焰共同推进，飞过之处留下热量与焦痕。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME can exceed the speed of sound in seconds. Its wings, along with its flames, provide thrust, leaving behind heat and scorch marks while flying.

entry: 嘴上的拉链将强烈的火焰封在体内。它不敢轻易拉开，因为喷出的烈焰强得难以控制。
author: skymaster426
source: The zipper on its mouth contains a powerful blaze within its body. It hesitates to unzip its mouth, because the blast is uncontrollably powerful.

entry: POKENAME会迅速烹熟放进口中的食物，可火太热，通常都烧得漆黑。拍动高温等离子体构成的翅膀，它便能浮空。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME will quickly cook any food placed inside its mouth, but its fire is so hot that it usually chars it black. By flapping wings made of hot plasma, POKENAME can levitate in the air.

entry: POKENAME外层羊水烧得极烈，吸收什么就碳化什么。它深思时，尾焰会比平时更旺。
author: fiordaliso
source: The amniotic fluid coating its body burns so intensely that it carbonizes anything it absorbs. While POKENAME is deep in thought, the flame on its tail burns more intensely than usual.

entry: POKENAME在满月夜飞上天空，吸收月光。它兴奋地以美丽火焰、灰烬，照亮夜空。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME soars through the sky during the full moon to absorb moonlight. It lights the night sky with beautiful displays of fire and ash because of its excitement.

entry: 妖精力量让POKENAME心中的火更亮。它用可爱外表引猎物，再把对方烧成灰。
author: nolanmb
source: The fire in POKENAME's heart burns brighter with the added fairy power. This Pokémon lures in it's prey with it's cute looks, and then burns them to ashes.

entry: POKENAME巨颚能咬碎金属。它领地意识强、打法残酷，先用牙耗弱敌人，再释放全部灼热火力结束战斗。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its massive jaws deliver bites strong enough to shatter even metal. POKENAME is a territorial and brutal creature; after wearing down its foe with the power of its teeth, it finishes the battle by unleashing the full force of its searing flames.

entry: POKENAME从黄昏到黎明，不停发光。节庆时巡视街道，向警方报告可疑情况，保护大家安全。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME produce light without rest from dusk to dawn. They monitor streets during festivals and report anything suspicious to the police to keep everyone safe.

entry: POKENAME被愤怒灵魂附身，四处寻找强敌。它常使人陷入催眠般的恍惚，很难挑战。火焰则让人想到它的前世。
author: dahappycute
source: Possessed by an enraged spirit, POKENAME wanders in search of strong opponents. It often induces hypnotic trances, making challenging it difficult. Its flame is reminiscent of its former life.

entry: 月夜里，POKENAME穿过天空，寻找愚蠢到敢挑战的生物。受袭便俯冲，用钻石般硬牙咬住，再背摔，力道足以碎石。
author: ghostslythe
source: On moonlit nights, POKENAME cuts across the skies seeking any foolish enough to challenge it. When attacked, it dives using its diamond-hard teeth to hold foes, then suplexes them hard enough to shatter stone.

entry: POKENAME巡视空中领地，寻找强敌，或需要援助的弱小宝可梦。它极速飞行，螺旋俯冲，用长牙连续劈斩。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME patrols the skies of its territory in search of powerful opponents to fight or vulnerable Pokémon in need of aid. It flies extremely fast, diving at opponents in a corkscrewing spin to deliver multiple slashes from its tusks.

entry: 别看POKENAME体温高，想让它动起来可不容易。它喜欢蜷着毛尾，睡在草铺上。一小时内，草被烤脆得不舒服，它才勉强起身。
author: haypile
source: For such a high-temperature Pokémon, POKENAME is hard to light a fire under; it likes to nap on grass beds with its furred tails curled around itself. When these beds are cooked to an uncomfortable crisp within the hour, it begrudgingly gets up.

entry: POKENAME会不停用大字爆炎轰敌，直到对方倒在烈火里。体内大多由火构成，让它能连续这样攻击数小时。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME will continuously blast opponents with Fire Blast until they succumb to the flames. As its inner body is mostly made of fire, it can relentlessly do this for hours on end.

entry: POKENAME痴迷与火相关的物品。想要训练家的东西，就会主动挑战，争取拿走。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME is obsessed with fire-related items. When it wants something that belongs to a trainer, it will actively challenge them for it.

entry: POKENAME两个头各有大脑，总意见不合。左头只用火属性攻击，右头专用龙属性招式。唯有最坚定耐心的训练家，才能养到成年。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME has two heads with separate brains that are constantly in disagreement. The left head uses only Fire-type attacks, while the right relies on Dragon-type moves. Only the most determined and patient Trainers can raise this Pokémon to maturity.

entry: POKENAME每个头喷的火，温度都不同。它很凶，连自己的训练家，也会毫不迟疑攻击。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME breathes a different temperature of fire from each of its heads. It is vicious and will not hesitate to attack even its own trainer.

entry: POKENAME三个头喷出的烈焰，热得连岩石也能点燃。据说它经过之处，只剩燃烧废墟。
author: geo_ominous
source: POKENAME breathes searing flames from its three heads, which burn so hot that they can ignite even rock and stone. It is said that where a POKENAME passes, only flaming ruins remain.

entry: POKENAME虽然以美貌闻名，尾尖却烫得厉害。谁愚蠢地抓尾，就会留下永远无法痊愈的痛苦灼伤。
author: mepp.
source: Though renowned for their beauty, the tips of POKENAME's tails are extremely hot to the touch. Those foolish enough to grab one of these tails receive painful burns that can never heal.

entry: 据说POKENAME每天都极想变强，或许因此乐于战斗。它绝不参加不公的对决，谁公平打赢，就能获得一个小愿望。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are said to harbor intense desires to grow stronger every single day, which may explain why they are so willing to fight others. They never take part in unfair or unjust fights and will grant a small wish to whoever fairly defeats them.

entry: POKENAME飞过地区，直到感知值得挑战的强者波导。战斗越被逼入绝境，火就越热、越强。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME flies across the region until it senses the aura of a strong opponent worth challenging. The more cornered it becomes in battle, the hotter and more powerful its flames grow.

entry: POKENAME有着老练喷火龙的DNA，知道下雨躲洞，也试着记住饭点。不过性子仍懒，大部分时间都在睡。
author: bobosmith01
source: Possessing experienced Charizard DNA, POKENAME knows to go inside of caverns when it is raining and tries to remember when it is time to eat. However, as it is still very slothful, it often spends most of its time sleeping.

entry: POKENAME向敌人释放烈焰风暴，却很难维持热力。常打到一半就烧尽气势，只能偃旗息鼓地认输，十分扫兴。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME unleash fiery storms over their opponents but can rarely keep up the heat. Their tendency to burn out in the middle of battle creates anticlimactic moments of surrender as they fizzle out.

entry: POKENAME叫得凶，其实没那么爱咬人。它常躺在营地尚未熄灭的火堆里——不过，食物可千万别放在外面！
author: supersonicloki
source: With a bark worse than its bite; POKENAME is usually found laying in smoldering fires at local campsites. Make sure not to leave any food out!

entry: POKENAME迅速拍翼，显得比实际更大、更吓人。它只能产生小火星，因此得靠这些威吓赶走危险。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME rapidly flap their wings to make themselves seem bigger and scarier than they actually are. They are only able to produce small embers and sparks and so are reliant on these threat displays to scare off dangers.

entry: POKENAME嗓门出奇大，吼声最远传一英里。其实远没有声音暗示的危险，战斗只能放小火苗和火星。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are surprisingly loud Pokémon, their roars carrying for up to a mile. They are much less dangerous than their roar would imply, only able to produce small embers and sparks to fight with.

entry: POKENAME寻找族群时常引起骚动。它会展示力量，却往往给当地居民带来灾难。
author: supersonicloki
source: When searching for a pack, POKENAME often causes a commotion. It shows displays of strength that often result in disaster for the locals.

entry: POKENAME多条尾尖火焰渐暗，就会拍翼带来新氧。新鲜空气让火重新旺起，也给它新一阵活力。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME beat their wings to bring in fresh oxygen whenever the flames at the tips of their many tails are starting to dim. The influx of fresh air causes the fires to flare to life, giving them a fresh burst of energy.

entry: POKENAME多条尾尖火焰，热如篝火。战斗会拍翼，把热扇向敌人，靠让对手热衰竭取胜。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The many flames at the tips of POKENAME's tails burn with the intense heat of a bonfire. In battle, POKENAME flap their wings to fan the heat toward their foe, relying on heat exhaustion to help them win their fight.

entry: POKENAME伏击埋在沙里的猎物，也能飞着追。不过巨头在高速下，给脖子太大负担，因此飞不久。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME ambushes prey buried in the sand and can also chase its prey while flying. It can't fly for too long, though, because its huge head puts too much strain on its neck at high speeds.

entry: POKENAME翼小得无法飞行，常因此烦躁，把怒气撒在对手身上。它体形虽小，却以充沛精力和强大力量闻名。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME's wings are too small to allow it to fly, which often frustrates it, and it vents this anger on its opponents in battle. Despite its small size, POKENAME is renowned for being highly energetic and powerful.

entry: POKENAME渴望升空，可灼热外壳太重，翅膀最多只够滑翔。甩尾虽足以碎石，做完却得休息24小时。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME display a longing to take to the skies, yet their burning hot shells are too heavy for their wings to carry beyond gliding. They swing their tails with enough force to shatter stone, but will have to rest for 24 hours if they do.

entry: POKENAME的两个齿轮独立于身体，能攻击看似远在安全距离的猎物。边缘极锋利，它还拿来磨牙。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: The two gears are separate from the body, allowing POKENAME to strike at prey that seem far enough away to be safe. The edges of the gears are so sharp that POKENAME uses them to sharpen its fangs.

entry: POKENAME齿轮会烫伤所有触碰者。它住在废弃工厂。
author: notsaying.
source: The gears of POKENAME will burn anyone that touches them. This Pokémon finds its home in abandoned factories.

entry: POKENAME身体太胖，飞不起，连滑翔也不行。为了持续飞行，它从尾巴喷火推进，身后气味像篝火。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Its body is much too fat to fly, or even glide. To sustain flight, POKENAME blasts fire out of its tail to provide thrust. Its wake smells like a campfire.

entry: POKENAME花蜜是高效燃料，可野生个体太凶，只能从驯服的采集。飞行时，它总不小心把辛辣花粉撒得到处都是。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME's nectar is a highly efficient fuel, but wild individuals are too aggressive, so it can only be collected from those that have been tamed. When they fly, they always unintentionally cause spicy pollen to scatter everywhere.

entry: 翼展是身体大小的六倍。体形小巧、重量轻盈，让它能飞得比喷火龙还高。
author: soup1900
source: Its wingspan is six times the size of its body. It can fly even higher than Charizard thanks to its small size and low weight.

entry: POKENAME周身水膜被核心热量煮得沸腾。暴怒会让沸腾加剧，膜可能爆开，把滚烫液体撒向四周。
author: sk372
source: The watery membrane around POKENAME can be seen boiling due to the core's heat. When enraged, the boiling increases to the point the membrane may burst and send scalding liquid all around it.

entry: POKENAME埋进沙漠热沙，只露尾焰。夜里借火光与温暖吸引猎物，再跃出，张嘴攻击。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME buries itself in hot desert sand, with only the flame on its tail above the surface. They use the light and warmth it produces to lure in prey at night, then leap out to attack with their bite.

entry: POKENAME看不见，靠回声定位找食。若撞上其他宝可梦，还没弄清在和谁交手，它就先猛喷火。
author: fiordaliso
source: It moves blindly, using echolocation to find its food. If it happens to crash into another Pokémon, POKENAME immediately breathes powerful flames at it before even realizing what it is fighting.

entry: POKENAME面具里藏着巨大力量，有人甚至发誓见过面具张嘴喷火。
author: crumple_2
source: So much power is contained within the mask that some swear they've seen a POKENAME's mask open its jaw and breathe fire before.

entry: POKENAME最多十只一群筑巢，互相挑战练战技。野外虽凶，用点心和舒适卧具宠着，就很容易驯养。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME nests in groups of up to ten, where they challenge each other to improve their combat skills. Despite their ferocious nature in the wild, they are easily domesticated if spoiled with treats and comfortable bedding.

entry: POKENAME独居，或只与一位伙伴同住。它在领地岩壁刻符号，警告别者远离；两只合作时，会专找极强敌人，尝试联手打败。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME live either alone or with a single partner and will carve symbols into the rocky walls around its territory to signal others to stay away. A pair of POKENAME working together will seek out extremely tough foes to try and defeat together.

entry: POKENAME滚动时收起翼尾，飞行不佳。不过滚下山丘，再冲出坡道，便能远远滑翔，尾巴还制造暖气，托自己上升。
author: .jerden
source: While rolling, POKENAME tucks in its wings and tail. It cannot fly well, but if it rolls down a hill and then off a ramp, it can glide for long distances, using its tail to create warm air it can rise on.

entry: POKENAME小翼让它飞不久，却很擅长攀爬。它沿山坡寻找强敌，以火尾，或毒牙毒爪攻击。
author: .jerden
source: Although its small wings mean that it cannot fly for long, POKENAME is an agile climber. It crawls across mountainsides searching for strong opponents to challenge, striking with its fiery tail or with its venomous fangs and claws.

entry: POKENAME尚未完全进化，就已傲慢，用阵阵火焰折磨弱小宝可梦。大雨时，它躲进洞，防止火焰颈圈熄灭。
author: fiordaliso
source: Even without being fully evolved, POKENAME acts with arrogance, tormenting weaker Pokémon with bursts of fire. In heavy rain, it hides in its cave to stop its fiery collar from being extinguished.

entry: 它把颈火视为王者身份的象征，十分骄傲。可怕巨颚不只能碾碎巨石，也能向敌人喷出猛烈火焰。
author: fiordaliso
source: The flames burning around its neck are a source of great pride, as it sees them as a symbol of its royalty. Its fearsome jaws can not only crush boulders but also unleash violent bursts of fire against its enemies.

entry: POKENAME张开巨嘴，喷出足以瞬间焚毁森林的烈火。它专横无情，靠蛮力压倒对手，连幼崽和同群伙伴也会毫不犹豫攻击。
author: fiordaliso
source: Opening its colossal maw, POKENAME spews infernos powerful enough to incinerate forests at once. Despotic and merciless, it crushes opponents with raw strength, showing no hesitation to turn on its own offspring or packmates.

entry: 它张开巨颚，就会涌出一波波灼热火焰，瞬间烧掉整片森林。性情暴虐，谁敢面对，就会被纯粹蛮力碾压。
author: fiordaliso
source: When it opens its massive jaws, it unleashes waves of scorching flames that can burn entire forests in an instant. It is a tyrannical and violent creature, crushing anyone who dares face it with sheer brute force.

entry: POKENAME咆哮张颚，灼热火流便喷涌而出，把附近一切化灰。压倒性力量与无情脾气，让它成为令人畏惧的统治者。
author: fiordaliso
source: When POKENAME roars and spreads its jaws, torrents of searing fire spill forth, reducing everything nearby to ash. Its overwhelming strength and ruthless temperament make it a feared ruler among Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME一挥手臂，就能制造强力音爆。军方会用它陪练，磨炼新兵。
author: sk372
source: With a swing of the arm, POKENAME is able to create powerful sonic booms. Military locations use it as a training partner to help toughen up rookies.

entry: POKENAME住在高山隘口，用体热引诱迷路旅人。火焰只有活物能感觉，却不给真正温暖，让这恶意生物骗徒步者走向末路。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Found in high mountain passes, POKENAME uses its body heat as a lure for lost travelers. The flames of its body can only be felt by the living and do not actually provide true warmth, allowing this malicious Pokémon to trick hikers to their doom.

entry: POKENAME身子小，难对付大敌，因此学会快速扇翼，让火焰更大。
author: theaceofhearts0306
source: Due to its small size, POKENAME struggles to combat larger foes. As a result, POKENAME has learned to enlarge its flame by rapidly fanning its wings.

entry: POKENAME跳复杂舞蹈争关注，用翅画优雅图案。表演持续到深夜，火焰让远方也能看见。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME perform elaborate dances to compete with one another for attention, tracing elegant patterns with their wings. They perform late into the night and can be seen from a great distance in the dark thanks to their flames.

entry: POKENAME像活垃圾焚化炉，在体内烧掉吃下的垃圾。过程产生的毒烟从手臂排出，绝不能吸入。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME is like a living trash incinerator, burning all the garbage it consumes within its body. It expels the noxious smoke created by this process from its arms. This smoke should absolutely never be inhaled.

entry: POKENAME是凶猛海底猎手，几秒能击倒巨大猎物。它与同类好斗，附近一出现，就连新到手的一餐也不顾，非打不可。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a vicious undersea hunter that takes down huge prey in seconds. It is highly combative with others of its kind, even ignoring a fresh meal for a fight if it spots another POKENAME in the vicinity.

entry: POKENAME中央圆筒与强火配合，产生惊人推力。翼太小无法飞，只负责转向，让它在高空以接近音速的速度翱翔。
author: darkwolfe
source: POKENAME's central cylinder and intense flame interact to create amazing propulsion. The wings are too small for flight and are used exclusively for steering as they soar at high altitudes at near supersonic speeds.

entry: POKENAME过去被视为随兴纵火的邪恶火焰精灵。其实它只烧掉病树，保护森林家园。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME were once thought to be wicked fire spirits that started forest fires on a whim. In reality, they only burn away diseased trees to help protect their forest home.

entry: POKENAME凶猛危险，皮肤会分泌易燃凝胶，再点燃，让全身裹火。它飞得快而强，对取得信任的生物则十分忠诚。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME is a fierce and dangerous Pokémon. It secretes a flammable gel from its skin, which it can then ignite to cloak its entire body in flame. They are strong, fast fliers and loyal to those who gain their trust.

entry: POKENAME凶猛危险，皮肤会分泌易燃凝胶，再点燃，让全身裹火。它飞得快而强，对取得信任的生物则十分忠诚。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME is a fierce and dangerous Pokémon. It secretes a flammable gel from its skin, which it can then ignite to cloak its entire body in flame. They are strong, fast fliers and loyal to those who gain their trust.

entry: POKENAME杂食，靠回声定位找果实或小宝可梦。拿到食物后会喷火，按喜好烤成微温，或彻底焦黑。
author: slimninja55
source: POKENAME are omnivorous creatures that use echolocation to locate fruit or small Pokémon. Once securing their meal, many unleash fiery flames to cook their food to their liking, ranging from slightly warm to completely charred.

entry: POKENAME身体太大，翅膀又小，却每天尝试起飞。据说，是想去找强敌。
author: secondatheniangadfly
source: Though too big in proportion to its small wings, POKENAME tries to take off daily. Supposedly, it wants to look for strong opponents.

entry: POKENAME从高处降下烈火，烧焦大地，挑衅下方宝可梦交战。面对强敌，它毫不留情，挥爪甩尾，确保取胜。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME rains down powerful fire from above to scorch the land and instigate battles with the Pokémon below. Against powerful foes, it does not hold back in its brutality, slashing its claws and tails at them to ensure its win.

entry: POKENAME背部不断排火，既防捕食者，也调节体内温度，避免过热。
author: theartemis1
source: POKENAME constantly vents flames from its back. These flames are used both as a defense against predators and as a means of regulating its internal temperature, preventing its body from overheating.

entry: POKENAME飞过天空，身后冰火交织，形成美丽光迹。夜里看见时，常被错认成彗星。
author: shocktopus1717
source: As POKENAME soars through the sky, beautiful trails of fire and ice shimmer behind it. When seen at night, it is often mistaken for a comet.

entry: 半夜，POKENAME飞过洞穴与森林，寻找对手。燃烧的鬃毛发出的光，也是引诱猎物的诱饵。
author: al_chimera
source: In the middle of the night, POKENAME flies through caves and forests in search of opponents. The light from its flaming mane serves as bait for prey.

entry: POKENAME唱炽热、充满激情的歌，鼓舞听者斗志。演完，自己也战意高涨，常一唱完就挑战观众中的最强者。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME sings fiery, passionate songs meant to stoke the fighting spirits of those who hear them. Its own thirst for battle spikes by the end of a performance, often challenging the strongest in its audience to combat once it finishes singing.

entry: POKENAME的大蘑菇始终燃烧，象征它对战斗的炽烈热情。喷出大股火时，背火稍退，便能看见蘑菇焦黑的质地。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's large mushroom is constantly burning, a symbol of its raging passion for combat. When it breathes a large plume of fire, the flames on its back recede slightly, letting one see the charred texture of its mushroom.

entry: POKENAME激战时，尾焰最热。同类对战能持续数日，谁都不肯认输。
author: chibitales
source: The flame on POKENAME's tail burns hottest when engaged in a heated battle. Fights between these Pokémon can last for days, neither willing to admit defeat.

entry: POKENAME身上叮当作响的鳞片，能加热到极高温，让火焰拳致命。唯有火爆脾气，能与惊人力量相比。
author: chibitales
source: The jangling scales on POKENAME's body can be heated to extreme temperatures, making its Fire Punch deadly. Its amazing power is matched solely by its fiery temperament.

entry: POKENAME在空中、水里都很擅长，是可怕对手。在一种环境打不过，就会把战斗带到另一边。
author: .fedoraman
source: POKENAME are intimidating opponents, equally adept in the air or water. When outmatched by an opponent in one environment, they move the fight to the other.

entry: POKENAME虚荣到极点，鳞片一脏，就朝弄脏者喷火。它花几个小时，用尾尖和叶片，擦洗梳理全身。
author: ghostslythe
source: Vain to the extreme, POKENAME are easily agitated when their scales get dirty, immediately blasting flames at the source of the mess. They spend hours preening, using their tail tip and leaves to scrub their bodies.

entry: POKENAME的眼睛十分精准，能轻松追踪小飞虫。它喜欢把食物烧得焦脆，会用体内火焰把小型猎物烧成炭。
author: npshi
source: The eyes of a POKENAME are precise, able to track small flying bugs without issue. POKENAME prefer their meals to be burned to a crisp, using the flames stored in their bodies to turn small prey into charcoal.

entry: POKENAME仗厚实防火甲，不顾一切冲敌。奔跑时不断喷火，在接触对手前，就用自己的烈焰裹住全身。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME will recklessly charge at any opponent, relying on its thick, fireproof armor for protection. POKENAME will spray fire from its mouth as it runs forward, covering its body with its own flames before making contact with the foe.

entry: POKENAME把火尾当法杖，挥动喷火。传说，它能透过双色火焰里的幻象，窥见未来片段。
author: fiordaliso
source: It wields its flaming tail like a staff, swinging it to launch bursts of fire at its foes. It is said that POKENAME can glimpse fragments of the future through the visions that appear within its bicolored flames.

entry: 这种宝可梦以火焰编织的复杂舞蹈闻名。战斗用舞姿迷住敌人，降低戒备。
author: ishdra
source: This Pokémon is known for its intricate dances using its flames. It uses these dances to mesmerize its foes in combat, lowering their guard.

entry: POKENAME翅膀不够强，撑不起长时间飞行。它改用翼把烟雾、火焰导向敌人。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME's wings are not strong enough to support its weight in long-term flight. Instead, POKENAME use their wings to redirect the smog and flames it produces towards its enemies.

entry: POKENAME步态大摇大摆，相当有威慑。带火的拳击让它成为难缠对手，不过急躁性格也可被利用，制造关键破绽。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a swagger to their step that make them quite intimidating. Their flaming punches make them a tough foe to defeat, but their hotheadedness can be exploited to create a vital opening.

entry: 人们常误以为POKENAME靠喷火推进飞行，其实它全靠翅膀。孤独时，它会飞进高层大气，寻找值得一战的对手。
author: ruben2309295
source: It is a common misconception that POKENAME use their flames as thrusters for flight, since they rely solely on their wings to fly. When POKENAME get lonely, they will fly into the upper atmosphere in search of a worthy opponent to fight.

entry: 生性好斗，喜欢将其他飞行生物撞落。比起向上飞，更偏爱向下滑翔攻击敌人。
author: soup1900
source: It is aggressive and loves to knock other flying creatures out of the sky. It prefers to glide down to attack its foes rather than fly up.

entry: POKENAME在山下钻地，散去燃烧身体的热。若停下来，周围地面会极热，点燃附近植物。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME dig beneath mountains to spread the heat from their flaming bodies. If they ever stop, the ground around them becomes incredibly hot and lights any nearby plants on fire.

entry: POKENAME游水寻找可能相爱的对象，背上喷火加速。若遇到自认为会成为糟糕伴侣的人，它便喷火将对方熔化。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME swims around in search of potential couples while blasting flames from its back to boost its speed. It will blast flames to melt anyone it thinks would be a terrible person for love.

entry: POKENAME游泳把尾巴露在水外，防火焰弄湿。它却莫名敌视情侣，用喷火打断浪漫时刻。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME swims with its tail above water to keep its flame from getting wet. It's oddly hostile towards couples, interrupting their romantic moments with blasts of fire.

entry: POKENAME在山脚、火山脚安家，当地少有可燃植物。一静止，脚下就极热，因此它挖洞，把热散到隧道各处。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME make their homes at the base of mountains and volcanoes where there is little vegetation to set aflame. The ground beneath them grows incredibly hot whenever they stay still, so they burrow to spread the heat throughout the tunnels.

entry: POKENAME是许多森林地下根系火灾的源头。它很难找到能安全静止的家，常聚在没东西可烧的火山附近。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are the source of many root fires that burn underneath forests. Many struggle to find homes where they can safely remain still and often congregate near volcanoes where there is nothing to burn.

entry: POKENAME钻到巨石下，用火息熔入内部，再从里面液化岩石，凿出石巢。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME burrows beneath boulders and melts into them with fiery breath. It carves stone dens by liquefying rock from within.

entry: POKENAME爱抢贵重物，会带火从空中俯冲受害者。它活跃地区的公共场所，通常配水枪或水属性宝可梦防范。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME loves grabbing valuables and dives at its victims from the air with flames. In areas where POKENAME is active, public places usually have water guns or Water-type Pokémon as security measures.

entry: 这种POKENAME比其他变体聪明，却不太适合野外生活。敏锐头脑、强翼和利爪，仍使它很受训练家欢迎。
author: oreee0230
source: This POKENAME is smarter than other variants but not very suited for life in the wild. Its keen mind, powerful wings, and sharp claws make POKENAME popular among trainers.

entry: POKENAME密集挥爪劈敌，翅膀能让它远飞。脾气虽粗暴，天鹅绒般的红毛，却让它在选美赛很抢手。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME fights its foes by raining slashing claw strikes upon them, and its wings allow it to cover great distances in flight. Despite its fierce and gruff temperament, it is highly sought after for beauty competitions due to its velvety red fur.

entry: POKENAME每次头痛，都大发脾气。疼痛化成烈火和胡乱拍动的翅膀，向外宣泄。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME has major temper tantrums whenever it has a headache. The pain it experiences is expressed through blazing flames and flailing wings.

entry: POKENAME滑过水中寻找猎物，选好目标，便猛扑，用带爪的鳍撕扯。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME glide through the water to search for prey. Once they have located a suitable target, they lunge and tear into their prey with their clawed flippers.

entry: POKENAME喷出灼热火焰，从内部烹烤猎物。等对方倒在烈焰里，已是全熟的一餐。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME release powerful flames that scald their prey. These flames cook their target from within, which makes the prey a fully cooked meal by the time they succumb to the flames.

entry: POKENAME极易怒，一生大多与同群交战。每次获胜都增强尾焰，让它更接近进化。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is a highly irritable Pokémon that spends most of its life battling others in its pack. Each victory strengthens the flames on its tail, bringing it ever closer to evolution.

entry: POKENAME凶猛好战，易被激怒。受挑衅便鼻孔喷火，冲向敌人，准备用强拳击打。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME has a fierce, warlike nature and is easily enraged. When provoked, it breathes fire from its nose and charges at its foe, ready to strike with devastating punches.

entry: 它暴怒时，尾尖火焰会扩到整身毛发。灵敏嗅觉能在极远处察觉火灾，因此消防员把它当伙伴。
author: fiordaliso
source: When it flies into a rage, the flame at the tip of its tail spreads across its entire coat. Firefighters rely on it as a partner Pokémon, as its keen nose can detect the presence of a blaze from remarkable distances.

entry: 这强大生物常守古代遗迹、神圣寺院，绝不容入侵。体热极强，雨一碰毛，就会立刻蒸发。
author: fiordaliso
source: This mighty creature is often employed to guard ancient ruins and sacred temples, as it never allows intruders to trespass. The heat of its body is so intense that rain evaporates the instant it touches its fur.

entry: POKENAME对战时拍动强翼，向敌人扇出灼人的热风。速度与力量，让精英训练家格外喜欢在锦标赛使用。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME flap their powerful wings in battle, sending scorching Heat Waves toward their foes. Ace Trainers are particularly fond of using POKENAME during tournament battles thanks to their speed and strength.

entry: 这强大生物常守古代遗迹、神圣寺院，不让闯入者通过。身体热得雨一碰毛，就立刻蒸发。
author: fiordaliso
source: This powerful creature is commonly used to guard ancient ruins and sacred temples, allowing no intruders to pass. Its body emits such intense heat that rain evaporates instantly upon touching its fur.

entry: POKENAME毛发热如山火。成群跑过大地，身后留着火迹。宝可梦巡护员仔细监测动向，提醒附近聚落准备防火。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME fur blazes with the heat of a wildfire. Packs of them race across the landscape, leaving a trail of fire in their wake. Pokémon Rangers carefully monitor their movements, warning nearby settlements to prepare for potential blazes.

entry: 这强大生物常守古代遗迹、神圣寺院，不让闯入者通过。身体热得雨一碰毛，就立刻蒸发。
author: fiordaliso
source: This powerful creature is commonly used to guard ancient ruins and sacred temples, allowing no intruders to pass. Its body emits such intense heat that rain evaporates instantly upon touching its fur.

entry: 融合能量将POKENAME与体内休眠的遗传物质结合起来。它喷出的火焰温度能够超过华氏10,000度。
author: zoroark73
source: Fusion energy has fused POKENAME with its dormant DNA. Its flames can reach temperatures of over 10,000 degrees Fahrenheit.

entry: POKENAME十分虚荣，常不惜代价，通过竞赛证明力量。比赛多围绕体力，直到它饿了，或对手认输才停。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME tend to suffer from high vanity, often going to great lengths to prove their strength via competitions. These competitions usually revolve around physical strength and will continue until POKENAME get hungry or their opponent gives up.

entry: POKENAME力量无穷，火能熔多种金属，建筑公司争着让它焊接、劳动。甚至因此引发关于劳动法下宝可梦权利的讨论。
author: wickedwiccan
source: POKENAME possesses boundless strength and flames hot enough to melt many metals, making it highly sought by construction companies as a welder and laborer. This has even led to discussions about Pokémon rights under labor laws.

entry: 它的外貌与超级POKENAMEX极为相似，最爱贴近对手，用坚硬的利爪发动攻击。
author: soup1900
source: Its appearance is extremely similar to that of Mega POKENAME X. It loves to attack opponents up close with its tough claws.

entry: 虽然长得像超级POKENAMEX，它却保留着普通POKENAME的配色。战斗时，喜欢贴近对手，用坚硬的利爪出击。
author: soup1900
source: While it looks similar to Mega POKENAME X, it maintains the colors of normal POKENAME. It prefers to attack opponents up close with its tough claws.

entry: 它兼具两种超级进化形态与超极巨化形态的特征。一声咆哮，周围便会迸起炽烈的蓝色火焰。
author: soup1900
source: It has the features of both its Mega forms and of its Gigantamax form. Its roar causes intense blue flames to burst all around it.

entry: 它的外貌近似超级POKENAMEY。速度极快，掠过夜空时，宛如一颗流星。
author: soup1900
source: Its appearance resembles that of Mega POKENAME Y. Its speed makes it look like a shooting star during the night.

entry: POKENAME金属爪磨损、受伤后，得用大量金属补充。它先用火熔矿，再吃下。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME's metal claws require a copious amount of metal to account for wear and damage. POKENAME melts ores with fire and then eats them.

entry: 谁挑战POKENAME，就会被巨大的热风吹飞。除了交战，五个头常吵架，几乎办不成事。
author: soup1900
source: Any opponent that challenges a POKENAME will get blown away by a massive Heat Wave. Except when battling, the five heads of POKENAME often argue with each other, resulting in little getting done.

entry: 谁挑战POKENAME，就会被巨大的热风吹飞。除了交战，五个头常吵架，几乎办不成事。
author: soup1900
source: Any opponent that challenges a POKENAME will get blown away by a massive Heat Wave. Except when battling, the five heads of POKENAME often argue with each other, resulting in little getting done.

entry: 它有着超级POKENAMEY的外貌，配色与火焰却来自超级POKENAMEX。有人推测，这其实是两个形态融合的结果。
author: soup1900
source: While its appearance is that of Mega POKENAME Y, it has the color and flames of Mega POKENAME X. Some theorize it's actually both fused together.

entry: POKENAME把巨大的火焰之翼射向敌人，彻底摧毁。它一咆哮，周围便爆出大股烈火。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME launches its massive wings of fire at enemies to completely obliterate them. The roar from this Pokémon causes large flames to burst up all around it.

entry: 融合的遗传特征遍布POKENAME，显现为诸多纹路。这些纹路能让它藏进火光昏暗的地方。
author: soup1900
source: Fusion genetics course through POKENAME, resulting in the many markings visible on it. These markings help camouflage it inside of dimly flame-lit areas.

entry: POKENAME喜欢近距离用硬爪攻击。千万别碰火焰，光靠近，也可能烧伤皮肤。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME loves to attack opponents up close with its tough claws. One should never touch the flames of this Pokémon; even being near them can cause burns on the skin.

entry: POKENAME流线外形让它几秒内达到马赫级高速。夜里，速度加上火光，让它像流星。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's aerodynamic shape allows it to reach mach speeds in a matter of seconds. At night, this speed combined with its flames causes it to look like a shooting star.

entry: 小巧流线型的身体让飞行速度发挥到极致。POKENAME能从口中猛烈喷出火焰。
author: soup1900
source: Its small, aerodynamic body allows it to maximize its flight speed. POKENAME powerfully spits flames from its mouth.

entry: POKENAME体内翻涌的易燃酸液，快速喷出就会点燃。少量酸暴露空气，会极缓慢地中和，经过数月，变成极苦的植物油。
author: pkbonusducks
source: The volatile acid churning within POKENAME is ignited if quickly expelled from their mouths. Small doses of acid will very slowly neutralize as they're exposed to open air, maturing into an extremely bitter vegetable oil over several months.

entry: POKENAME能高速飞行，朝猎物喷消化液。非为捕食的战斗，它就点燃易燃的消化液来攻击。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME can fly at high speeds and spray digestive fluids at its prey. In battles that aren't meant for hunting, it uses fire to ignite the flammable digestive fluids.

entry: POKENAME每天得吃大量煤，保持高温，避免周身火焰熄灭。烈火强盛，让工厂常请它焊钢。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME must consume massive amounts of coal every day to keep its body temperature high and prevent the flames covering it from going out. Thanks to its intense fire, it is often employed in factories to weld steel.

entry: POKENAME燃烧的陨石外皮，能把一切彻底烧焦。它收头俯冲攻击，必然伴随硫磺炸裂。
author: sondededoo
source: With its burning hide of meteorite, POKENAME is capable of burning anything to a crisp. It attacks by tucking in its head and then dive bombing, which always results in an explosion of brimstone.

entry: POKENAME还不熟练控火，跑得太忘形，就可能不小心在蹄下留出火迹。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is still inexperienced at controlling its flames, so if it gets too carried away while running, it risks accidentally leaving trails of fire beneath its hooves.

entry: POKENAME跑得越快，鬃火越旺。翼虽强健，竞速时却从不用，因为觉得这样占对手便宜，不公平。
author: fiordaliso
source: The faster POKENAME runs, the more its mane flames blaze intensely. Despite having a pair of very strong and sturdy wings, it never uses them during a speed race, considering it an unfair advantage over its opponents.

entry: POKENAME尾端的毛发分叉，护着其中的火焰。常参与艰苦战斗，让壳上留着许多抓痕。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME will have split hairs on the end of its tail to house the flame it has there. It will often have many scratches on its shell due to partaking in many tough battles.

entry: POKENAME神经受高温外壳影响，十分易怒。壳改变重心，拖慢飞行，不过也成了分泌熔岩的武器。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME's nerves are affected by the high temperature of its shell, making it very irritable. The shell affects its center of gravity, slowing down its flight, but it also becomes a weapon for POKENAME to secrete lava.

entry: POKENAME用磁力抵消部分重量，让翅膀专注加速。群体常在雷暴形成前吸电，赶在落雨前逃走。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME can use magnetic force to offset some of its weight, allowing its wings to focus on boosting flight speed. Groups of POKENAME often absorb electricity right before a thunderstorm forms and flee before the rain starts falling.

entry: POKENAME由三个部分组成，彼此保护。它们用电磁波和爆发的火焰，击倒挡路者。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are made of three composite parts that protect each other. They harness electromagnetic waves and dynamic bursts of fire to defeat anyone in their way.

entry: POKENAME挥动、旋转棒子，向远方同类传讯。转动棒子，也表示喜悦开心。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME waves and spins its baton to send messages to other POKENAME from a long distance. Whenever it spins its baton, it is a sign of joy or happiness.

entry: POKENAME天生好斗，总在找架打。太久没战斗，两个头就会彼此动粗。
author: sk372
source: Highly combative by nature, POKENAME is always on the lookout for something to fight. If it goes too long without battling, the two heads will start getting violent towards each other.

entry: POKENAME三个头各有意志，常互相争吵。凶狠脾气和喷出的灼热烈焰，令人畏惧。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's three heads each has a will of its own and often squabble with each other. It is feared for its aggressive disposition and the searing flames it bellows.

entry: POKENAME尾焰格外顽强，完全没入水也不灭。它用火融开冰洞，再从上方扑向猎物。
author: santon5512
source: The flame on POKENAME's tail is incredibly resilient, able to stay lit even when completely submerged underwater. It uses this flame to melt holes in the ice, dropping in on prey from above.

entry: POKENAME的火能在双子岛古冰里，熔出整座洞窟安家。探险者说，隔实冰，一英里外也能听见它吼叫。
author: thisisvisser
source: The flame on POKENAME burns hot enough to hollow out entire caverns in the Seafoam Islands' ancient ice, where it makes its den. Explorers there have said that its roar can be heard through solid ice from over a mile away.

entry: POKENAME四处寻找垃圾吃，身体会熔化沿途的一切。喷出的烟雾能使任何吸入的训练家失去行动能力。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's body melts everything in its path as it searches garbage to eat. The smoke it emits can incapacitate any Trainer that breathes it.

entry: 尾巴上的喷火器像军用武器，能喷出燃烧的液体。液体可在物体表面反弹，将火焰送进视线不及的地方。
author: soup1900
source: The flamethrower on its tail, like a military one, spits a flaming liquid that can bounce off surfaces to project the fire into unseen places.

entry: POKENAME在防爆壳内安全蓄火。时机一到，便开壳射出高度集中的热能束，几秒就能熔钢。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME builds up fire safely within its blastproof shell, so when the time is right, it cracks open to shoot forth an incredibly focused beam of pure heat that can melt steel in seconds.

entry: 大规模山火时，POKENAME常突然现身，互相切磋。它们一来，周围很快就被化成灰。
author: mistymagius
source: During massive wildfires, POKENAME will often appear to spar with one another. If they do, they will appear out of nowhere, and the surrounding area will soon be reduced to ashes.

entry: POKENAME用幽灵般的丝线操纵燃烧气体，形成喷火龙的形状。它以此欺骗对手，确保战斗安全。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME manipulates burning gases with ghostly threads to form the shape of Charizard. It uses this method to trick opponents and make sure it stays safe in battle.

entry: POKENAME用幽灵般的丝线操纵燃烧气体，召出强大龙之能量，形成喷火龙的形状，以此吓敌、摧毁斗志。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME uses ghostly threads to manipulate burning gas, summoning powerful draconic energy that forms the shape of a Charizard. It uses this method to scare opponents and crush their fighting spirit.

entry: POKENAME身体由凝聚的一氧化碳构成，能穿过极小缝隙。战斗中，构成身体的气体燃烧，释放强热。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body is composed of condensed carbon monoxide, allowing it to pass through even the tiniest gaps. In combat, the gas making up its body combusts and releases intense heat.

entry: POKENAME身体由凝聚的丙烷构成，能穿过极小缝隙。战斗中，构成身体的气体燃烧，释放强热。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body is composed of condensed propane, allowing it to pass through even the tiniest gaps. In combat, the gas making up its body combusts and releases intense heat.

entry: POKENAME体内存着火和水，受威胁就从爪中排出。尾火格外顽强，完全浸在液体里也能烧。
author: theartemis1
source: Both fire and water are stored in POKENAME's body, which it expels through its claws when threatened. The flame on its tail is remarkably resilient, capable of burning even while fully submerged in fluid.

entry: POKENAME虽有四条腿，陆上仍摇摇摆摆、笨拙行走。身体覆着滑溜毒液，驱赶捕食者。
author: mepp.
source: Despite the fact POKENAME has four legs, it clumsily waddles on land. Its body is coated in a slick poisonous fluid to deter predators.

entry: POKENAME涉浅水，避飞行属性宝可梦；再爬上岸，避水属性捕食者。这样的两栖生活，让野生种群无需人助也能繁盛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME wade in shallow water to avoid Flying-type Pokémon, and crawl onto land to avoid Water-type predators. This amphibious lifestyle has allowed wild populations of POKENAME to flourish without human intervention.

entry: POKENAME用随身魔杖吹泡，通常用来打招呼、交流。练习后，还能吹出别的生物模样，尤其像亲近的对象。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME blows bubbles through the wand it carries, usually as a form of greeting and communication. With practice, it can even blow bubbles in the shapes of others, particularly those close to it.

entry: POKENAME活得如遭诅咒。柔软身体不断充液，皮肤却满是孔洞，不停漏出。每次成群诞生数百只，却很少能活到进化。
author: chinigan
source: POKENAME lives a cursed existence. Their squishy body perpetually fills itself up with liquid, but their skin is covered in pores and orifices that cause it to leak constantly. They're born in clusters of hundreds, but few live long enough to evolve.

entry: POKENAME身上的透明部位，能看见螺旋肠道。随着准备进化，肠道也会慢慢挪动、变形。
author: hophoppip
source: Its spiraling intestines can be seen through a transparent panel on its body. Over time, these intestines shift and change shape as POKENAME prepares to evolve.

entry: POKENAME放毒雾，隐藏身影，避开森林捕食者。许多个体迁入工厂附近沼泽，吃富含养分的污泥。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME produce a poisonous mist to obscure their presence from forest predators. Many POKENAME have migrated into marshes near factories to eat the nutrient-rich sludge.

entry: POKENAME常藏在河床附近，伪装周围植物。被抓住，就会扯断藤蔓，迅速游离对方宝可梦。
author: joshadow27
source: It often hides near riverbeds, disguising itself as nearby flora. When grabbed, POKENAME snaps its vines to swim away quickly from the opposing Pokémon.

entry: 战况激烈，POKENAME会试着用尾上螺旋催眠敌人。鳍让它连急流里，也能轻松游动。
author: fiordaliso
source: When a battle grows intense, POKENAME tries to hypnotize its opponent with the spiral on its tail. Its fins allow it to swim with ease even in powerful currents.

entry: POKENAME小而弱，靠快泳避战。若被逼到绝境，就喷出混乱螺旋状的水与泡泡，扰乱追兵。
author: sk372
source: Small of stature and strength, POKENAME flees from conflict with its swift swimming capabilities. If cornered, it will blow water and bubbles in a chaotic spiral pattern to confuse pursuers.

entry: POKENAME在浅水清洗飘逸长发和鲜艳裙装，却似乎从不湿。因为头发与裙装覆着疏水物质，水能直接滑落。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME wade in shallow water to clean their long flowing hair and brightly colored dress, which never seems to get wet. This is because their hair and dress are coated with a hydrophobic material that allows water to slide off their bodies.

entry: POKENAME鳞鳍柔软，身体脆弱，战斗挨不了几下。多数训练家会用学习装置，帮助培育。
author: quackquackattack
source: They are frail creatures because of their soft scales and fins and are unable to take many hits in battle. Most Trainers opt to use an Exp. Share to help them raise their POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME游泳时，把自己裹在毒泡里，既能呼吸，也防捕食者。路上累了，就蜷起身，随泡漂流。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME encase themselves in poisonous bubbles while they swim to help them breathe and protect themselves from predators. If they get tired while traveling, they will curl up and simply drift along in their bubble.

entry: POKENAME腹部螺旋的转速随情绪改变。生气时飞转，形成催眠花纹，分散敌人注意，掩护强大的龙卷风。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The spirals on POKENAME's belly swirl at different speeds depending on their emotional state. When they're angry, the spirals spin rapidly and create a hypnotic pattern, distracting their foe from the powerful Twisters POKENAME shoot.

entry: POKENAME需要大量水分维持弹性，很少远离河湖。它喜欢吹出各种生物、物件形状的泡泡，自娱自乐。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's body requires lots of moisture to maintain its elasticity, so it's rarely seen far from ponds and lakes. It entertains itself by blowing bubbles in the shapes of other creatures and objects.

entry: POKENAME在水主题网站的数据中游泳，遇到喜欢的信息，就困进数字泡泡，有时导致加载变慢或故障。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME swims through data on water-themed websites. When it finds information it favors, it traps it in a digital bubble, sometimes causing slow loading or glitches.

entry: POKENAME硬茧包住全身，唯独白肚皮露着，因此始终警惕。它能伸出毒刺，保护自己。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's hardened cocoon covers everything but its white belly, so it always stays alert for danger. It extends a venomous barb to defend itself.

entry: POKENAME吹的泡泡充满动能。敌人挨上一颗，就能被力道抛到100多米外。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: The bubbles POKENAME blows are filled with kinetic energy. When a foe gets hit by one of these bubbles, they are flung over 100 meters from the force.

entry: POKENAME藏在水洼，看人经过。四肢可以再生，万一被踩，倒很有用。
author: hiroshima0042_23263
source: POKENAME hides in puddles as they watch humans pass by. POKENAME can regrow its limbs, which is useful if it's stepped on.

entry: POKENAME受惊，就从背部涌出滚烫泡泡自卫。此时能看见，螺旋状内脏因产热而发光。
author: sk372
source: When frightened, POKENAME creates a flow of piping-hot bubbles from its back in self-defense. When it does so, one can see its spiral-shaped inner organs visibly glowing from the heat production.

entry: POKENAME用腹部螺旋催眠闯巢者，等睡着，再用利刺攻击。身体需要湿润，因此偏爱河流、小湖附近。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME defends its hive by hypnotizing intruders with the spiral on its belly, then hit them with its sharp stinger once they fall asleep. Since its body needs to stay hydrated, it prefers to live near rivers or small lakes.

entry: POKENAME用螺旋催眠绿毛虫等猎物。睡着后，再喷水让对方稳妥地滚回巢。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME hypnotizes prey like Caterpie with its spiral. Once they're asleep, it blasts them with water to roll them safely back into its nest.

entry: POKENAME是河湖里的贪玩居民，喜欢绕泳客螺旋游动，捉弄对方。看它的动作看久了，就会头晕。
author: sk372
source: A playful denizen of ponds and lakes, POKENAME likes to prank others swimming by swimming in a spiral pattern around them until they get dizzy trying to follow its movements.

entry: 深夜，POKENAME睁着大眼看守池塘。它慢慢往返飞行，同时转动腹纹，催眠猎物。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Late in the night, POKENAME keep watch over ponds with their wide eyes. They hypnotize prey by slowly flying back and forth while rotating the spiral pattern on their stomachs.

entry: POKENAME走路比游泳、飞行都难。非要步行，就会单脚跳，一路跳到目的地。
author: ichosuzu
source: POKENAME has a more difficult time walking than swimming or flying. When it needs to travel on foot, it tends to hop on one foot all the way to its destination.

entry: POKENAME在湖岸找水草吃，把空气存进鞘翅，便能长时间潜水。它很容易受惊，一觉得有险，就快速游走。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME forage for pondweed around the banks of lakes, trapping air within their wing cases while they remain underwater for extended periods of time. They are easily startled, rapidly swimming away if they think they're in danger.

entry: POKENAME张翼歇在急流底部。睡觉时，汹涌水流能帮它藏起，避开捕食者。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spreads its wings and rests at the base of river rapids. The rushing water helps hide it from predators while it sleeps.

entry: POKENAME虽爱玩水，一湿却会放光所有电。它练习跑步，适应逐渐长成的脚，过程却常绊倒、踉跄。
author: infinex21
source: Though POKENAME love to play in water, they unfortunately discharge all of their electricity when wet. They run to get used to their developing feet but trip and stumble most of the time.

entry: 满月时，POKENAME腹纹飞转。奇妙的动作，能让附近生物沉入深深梦乡。
author: .izik
source: During a full moon, the spiral on POKENAME's belly spins rapidly. This strange motion lulls nearby creatures into a deep and dreamy sleep.

entry: POKENAME极其柔软，容易被其他宝可梦抛来抛去。它找亚开果吃，让身体变硬，结果被扔向的宝可梦便会受伤。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are incredibly soft creatures that easily get tossed around by other Pokémon. They search for Kee Berries to toughen their soft bodies, which ends up hurting Pokémon they are tossed at.

entry: POKENAME分泌富钙黏液，一接触空气，就会硬化，在下半身形成保护壳。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME secrete a calcium-rich mucus from their bodies. When they come into contact with air, the mucus hardens and forms a protective shell around their lower bodies.

entry: POKENAME用薄薄的螺纹壳护身。游泳时转圈，配合旋转花纹，催眠其他宝可梦入睡。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME coat their bodies in a thin, spiral-patterned shell to try and protect themselves from harm. They spin around when swimming, creating a hypnotic spinning pattern with their spiral to put other Pokémon to sleep.

entry: POKENAME羊毛极吸水，一次能存好几升。大群个体可能不小心吸光池水，引发当地环境问题。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME wool is extremely absorbent, able to hold many litres of water at a time. Large populations of them can cause environmental problems in local ponds, with herds of POKENAME inadvertently soaking up all of the water.

entry: POKENAME羊毛极吸水，一次能存好几升。用来织衣，洗多少次，都总带潮湿霉味。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME wool is extremely absorbent, able to hold many litres of water at a time. Clothing spun from POKENAME wool invariably has a damp, musty smell to it, no matter how many times it is cleaned.

entry: POKENAME进出河水觅食，寻找更小的宝可梦，用爪抓起。它泳技不错，尾翼划水，速度出奇快。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME dive in and out of rivers in search of food, seeking out smaller Pokémon to snatch up with their talons. They are competent swimmers, using their tail and wings to splash through the river with surprising speed.

entry: POKENAME毛下特殊腺体，产出一层薄黏膜。黏液导电极好，能电击意外碰到自己的生物。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are coated in a thin film of mucus produced from specialised glands under their fur. The mucus is an excellent conductor, allowing them to shock anything that touches them unexpectedly.

entry: POKENAME准备攻击，腹纹便噼啪放电。火花亮得数英里外也看得见，有些个体因此被用于大湖导航。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME's stomach spiral crackles with electricity when they prepare to attack. Their electrical sparks are bright enough to be seen from miles away, with some POKENAME being used for navigation on large lakes.

entry: POKENAME身体覆着特殊防水黏液，离水便能迅速干爽。黏液从尾巴渗出，它会定期抹匀全身。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME bodies are coated in a special water-repellent mucus that helps them dry off rapidly when they exit the water. The mucus seeps out of their tail, and they periodically rub it across themselves to ensure they have an even coating.

entry: POKENAME的尾巴由锯齿形的坚韧软骨加固，因此更有力，能对威胁使出强力连环巴掌。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME tails are reinforced with a zig-zag of toughened cartilage. This structure strengthens their tail, enabling them to strike out at threats with powerful Double Slaps.

entry: POKENAME靠头顶长出的双尾，在水里推进。它能爆发惊人泳速，有时直接跃出水，滑翔许多米，逃离捕食者。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME use the twin tails sprouting from their head to propel themselves through the water. They are capable of remarkable bursts of speed when swimming, sometimes leaping clear of the water and gliding for many meters to escape predators.

entry: POKENAME受威胁，就转花，借螺旋催眠来袭者。等对方睡着，它再跳过水面，逃离危险。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME spin their flower around when being threatened, using the spiral to hypnotise their aggressor and put them to sleep. They skip across the water to escape after doing so, fleeing from the danger.

entry: POKENAME把泡泡附在身上，乘风漂过天空。有时泡泡半空破掉，它就翻滚着落地。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME float through the sky by attaching bubbles to themselves and catching the breeze. Their bubbles sometimes pop in mid-air, sending them tumbling to the ground.

entry: 它荡过树枝，寻找下一餐，用一连串哼叫和喷气，表示这里没什么可吃。发现枇杷或其他形似桃子的果实，就会攀住树枝。
author: quackquackattack
