source: It swings between trees in search of its next meal and communicates that an area is barren with a series of grunts and snorts. It latches onto a branch once it finds a Loquat or other fruits that resemble peaches.

entry: POKENAME在池塘游泳，用嫩芽当螺旋桨，也借尾巴推进。它会照料池边植物。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME are seen swimming in ponds using their sprouts as propellers and their tails. They tend to the plants near the ponds.

entry: POKENAME快速掠过多虫沼泽，吹泡把虫子困住，再返回掠过一遍，吃掉捕获的猎物。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME does a quick flying swoop over insect-heavy swamp areas, blowing bubbles that catch the bugs within them. It then makes a second return swoop to consume the captured prey.

entry: POKENAME很喜欢阿西蕾水草，生长在它栖居的清湖底。它吸收会伤害水草的毒素，让草长得更好，双方形成共生。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME loves Salveyo Weed, which is found at the bottom of clear lakes where they live. The weed grows better when living alongside POKENAME as it absorb toxins that would harm the weed, forming a symbiotic relationship.

entry: POKENAME从圆喙喷出水柱，把自己送上空中。它往返屋顶和树木之间，灵活得出奇。
author: .izik
source: By spitting bursts of water from its round beak, POKENAME flings itself through the air. It travels between rooftops and trees with surprising agility.

entry: POKENAME群常到城市喷泉嬉水，保持羽毛湿润。数量大了会护家，朝靠太近的游客使出水枪。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are frequent visitors to urban fountains, flocks of them splashing around in the water features to keep their feathers moist. Large flocks can grow protective of their home, squirting Water Gun attacks at tourists that get too close.

entry: POKENAME靠阴险手段突袭。拿手方法之一，就是先四处喷水，再用冰爪冻住。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME rely on shady underhanded tactics to surprise their opponents. One of their signature methods includes spraying water everywhere before freezing it with their icy claws.

entry: POKENAME皮肤很快变干，必须靠近湖塘。羽毛吸水，飞行时便能带些水走。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME skin dries out very quickly, forcing them to stay close to lakes and ponds. Their feathers are absorbent, letting them carry some water with them as they fly around.

entry: POKENAME先催眠受害者，再用蓝色长触手抓住。若喜欢某个人，它就会吹泡泡逗对方开心。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME hypnotizes its victims before seizing them with its long blue tentacles. When it grows fond of a human, it entertains them by blowing bubbles from its mouth.

entry: POKENAME朝威胁群体的生物吐滚水。身子虽小，灼热喷流却能赶走大上好几倍的捕食者。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spits boiling water at anything threatening its pack. Though small, its scalding blasts can drive off predators many times its size.

entry: POKENAME喜欢钻到凉石下，睡得舒适安全。毒液是较弱的防身手段，能让受害者产生幻觉，因此有人用来制作占卜药水。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME likes to burrow under cool stones to sleep in comfort and safety. Its venom is a weak defense tool which causes hallucinations in the afflicted, which has lead the venom to be used in fortune telling brews.

entry: POKENAME头上黏液源源不断，提供绘画用墨。不过物质始终只有黑白，画作也全是黑白。
author: sk372
source: The mucus on POKENAME's head provides it with a constant source of ink with which to draw. Because the substance is always black and white, all of POKENAME's artwork is similarly monochrome.

entry: 盯着POKENAME兜帽上的螺旋，会陷入恍惚。趁这时，它会逃离，或吃掉中招者。
author: bobosmith01
source: Staring into the spirals on POKENAME's hood causes the viewer to fall into a trance. During this time, POKENAME flees from or devours the one under its spell.

entry: POKENAME能存水存到肚子鼓起，再以不同压力释放。它用尾巴传电，但脸颊一被碰，就会放电。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME can store enough water to bloat their bellies and release said water at varying pressures. They channel electricity through their tails but will discharge their electricity if their cheeks are touched.

entry: POKENAME只在暴雨时离水。群体绕圈漂浮，直到雨停，让人相信它是在施法止雨。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME only leave the water during rainstorms. During the storms, groups of POKENAME float around in circles until the rain stops, leading to the belief that POKENAME cast spells to bring an end to the rain.

entry: POKENAME全身充满泡泡，很轻，步态摇晃。甚至能从嘴伸出泡泡组成的舌头，抓取物件。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's body is filled with bubbles, giving it a very light weight and a wobbly gait. It can even extend a tongue made of bubbles from its mouth to grasp objects with.

entry: POKENAME在湿地筑巢，用石头衬边，防止塌下。腹部螺纹其实是透出的部分肠道，它会蜷成球保护。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME form nests within damp terrain, using rocks to line them so they won't collapse. The spiral patterns on their bellies are actually some of their intestines showing through, which they protect by curling into balls.

entry: POKENAME喜欢在网上伪装成赌博广告。点击后会弹出通知，使用者必须赌赢，否则就会失去重要照片和文件。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are mischievous creatures that post as gambling ads on the internet. Clicking on the ad brings up a pop-up notification where the user has to win or lose important photos and documents.

entry: POKENAME喜欢在网上伪装成赌博广告。点击后会弹出通知，使用者必须赌赢，否则就会失去重要照片和文件。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are mischievous creatures that post as gambling ads on the internet. Clicking on the ad brings up a pop-up notification where the user has to win or lose important photos and documents.

entry: POKENAME腿部肌肉未发达，泳技比走路好。游不过水中捕食者，就把自己弹上岸，再用火花挡敌，直到安全才回水。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME are better swimmers than walkers due to their underdeveloped leg muscles. They launch themselves onto land if they can't outswim aquatic predators. They fire Ember attacks to keep predators at bay until it's safe to return to the water.

entry: POKENAME潜伏湖中，等有什么来到岸边喝水。它蜷成球跃出，砸晕目标，再趁对方没缓过来，拖入水下。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME waits beneath the waters of lakes until something draws close to the edge to get a drink. It then leaps from the water while curled into a ball, landing atop to the target to stun them long enough to drag them underwater.

entry: POKENAME没有手臂，战斗全靠腿和尾。它从嘴吹泡分散注意，让敌人更容易被突然袭中。
author: sk372
source: Lacking arms, POKENAME puts all its combat power in its legs as well as its tail. It blows bubbles from its mouth as a way of distracting foes to make them more vulnerable to its sudden strikes.

entry: POKENAME开心便大量吹泡。可吃泥土的习惯，让泡泡往往是泥球，一破就弄得一团糟，训练家十分苦恼。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME blows bubbles in large amounts whenever happy. Due to its diet of mud and soil, these bubbles are often muddy spheres that make a mess when popped, to the dismay of many POKENAME Trainers.

entry: POKENAME靠共情，感知同一水域内其他宝可梦的情绪。鱼群游过，常让它受不住，眼睛转圈，紧抱头部。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME's empathic powers allow them to sense the emotions of other Pokémon that are within the same body of water as them. They are easily overwhelmed when schools of Pokémon swim by, having to clutch their head as their eyes swirl.

entry: 大雨时，POKENAME出池聚坐，开心分享食物。坐着时，宽扁的尾巴还能挡雨。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME emerge from ponds during heavy rain, sitting together and happily sharing in meals with one another. They use their broad, flat tail to shelter themselves from the rainfall while they sit.

entry: POKENAME游泳时，裙状附肢催眠般起伏，让多数捕食者直接发呆。没受影响的，也可能被周身念力屏障挡退。
author: bobosmith01
source: As POKENAME swims, its dress-like appendage undulates in a hypnotising manner, causing most potential predators to simply space out. Anything not affected may be repelled by the psychokinetic barrier POKENAME sets up around it.

entry: 这些宝可梦腹皮极薄，因此始终贴近地面。有人视尾鳍为美味，不过内含致命毒素，必须妥善处理。
author: infinex21
source: Because the hides of their bellies are extremely thin, these Pokémon keep low to the ground at all times. Some consider their tail fins to be a delicacy, though they must be handled properly due to the deadly toxins within.

entry: 透过POKENAME半透明的肚子，能看见连着舌头的肌肉收紧。睡觉时，尾巴和内脏来回旋摆，像起伏的螺旋。
author: bobosmith01
source: It is possible to see the muscles connected to POKENAME's tongue seize through its semi-translucent stomach. When it sleeps, POKENAME's tail and innards swirl back and forth like an undulating spiral.

entry: POKENAME藏在石里，一股旋水从中涌出。它完全温顺，用水中众多眼睛观察周围，判断是否该逃。
author: sk372
source: A spout of swirling water emerges from the stone POKENAME hides within. It is entirely docile, using a multitude of eyes within the water to survey its surroundings and determine whether it should flee or not.

entry: POKENAME游泳收起毒刺，更灵活穿水。快撞东西时，再张刺减速、猛甩尾巴，急转方向。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME withdraw their barbs while swimming to better manuever through the water. If a POKENAME is about to collide with something, it will flare out its barbs to slow down and suddenly swing it tail to make a sharp turn.

entry: 蚊香蝌蚪一族在POKENAME收集的雨水中产蛋。孵化后，幼年蚊香蝌蚪便与这座家园共生。
author: hophoppip
source: Members of the Poliwag line lay their eggs in the water POKENAME gathers from rain. Once they hatch, the baby Poliwag live in symbiosis with their POKENAME home.

entry: 脆弱的脑外覆着透明薄膜，作为缓冲。可它爱用头撞敌人，仍总在头痛。
author: mistymagius
source: Its delicate brain is covered in a transparent film that acts as padding. Due to its tendency to headbutt its opponents, it is constantly suffering from headaches.

entry: 新长出的腿还很无力，无法奔跑，因此POKENAME的成长时期大多在水中度过。
author: melodydelune
source: Its newly grown legs are weak and prevent it from running. As a result, POKENAME spends the majority of its formative years in the water.

entry: 这种等离子体宝可梦融合体，能附身、操控任何水源。它常把静水变成螺旋旋涡。
author: hophoppip
source: This plasmic Pokémon fusion can possess and manipulate any source of water. It often turns still water into spiraling whirlpools.

entry: POKENAME常在湖岸坐几个小时，仰望夜空。一见流星，腹纹就会兴奋转动。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME spends hours sitting on the shore of the lake it lives in, gazing up at the night sky. If it spots a shooting star, the spiral on its belly begins to spin with excitement.

entry: POKENAME坐在池边，悠闲地用多条尾巴拨水。它控水托起液球，泼向打扰休息的生物。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME sit beside ponds, idly swishing their many tails through the water. They use their control over water to levitate orbs of liquid, splashing them into those who try to disturb their relaxation.

entry: POKENAME的肠道像蚊香蝌蚪一样，平时紧盘成螺旋。伸出后便迅速展开，给予强力抽打。
author: hophoppip
source: Like Poliwag's intestines, POKENAME's intestines are normally in a tight spiral. When POKENAME extrudes its intestines, they unfurl rapidly to deliver a forceful smack.

entry: POKENAME能突然加速，平时却游得慢。两个头难同意方向，总各想游往一边，最后只好在水里漂。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Though capable of sudden bursts of speed, POKENAME are typically slow swimmers. Their twin heads rarely agree on which direction to swim, resulting in them drifting in the water whilst struggling to go in two different directions.

entry: POKENAME多尾搅水，造旋涡困小宝可梦，拖进湖底。曾有人见它用鬼火诱敌，靠近陷阱。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME swish their many tails through the water to create whirling vortexes, entrapping smaller Pokémon and drawing them into the depths of the lakes they live in. They have been seen using Will-O-Wisps to lure Pokémon closer to their traps.

entry: POKENAME沿泥泞河岸挖坑，向路过者喷水，想让宝可梦跌入。靠太近就会被猛扑，泥陷阱让猎物难逃。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME dig pits along muddy river banks, spitting water at those who walk past them in an attempt to make Pokémon fall in. They lunge at anything that gets too close, relying on their muddy trap to keep their prey from escaping.

entry: POKENAME住热带湿地，快速振翼的图案令人着迷。原本敌对的捕食者，也会陷入温顺的恍惚。
author: kianjp2008
source: Found in tropical wetlands, the rapid movement of POKENAME's wings creates a mesmerizing pattern that sets otherwise hostile predators into a docile trance.

entry: POKENAME藏在浓海草间，浑水里几乎看不见。它会放出高压泡泡，击退敌人。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME hides in dense seaweed, nearly invisible in murky water. It attacks with blasts of pressurized bubbles that knock foes away.

entry: 它由两个防锈齿轮组成，互相快速旋转，一当头、一当躯干。躯干的螺纹转起来，能催眠观看者。
author: foolish_weasel
source: It is made up of two rust-proof gears that rapidly spin with each other, with one operating as the head and the other as its torso. The swirly pattern on its torso component will produce a hypnotic effect against onlookers as it spins.

entry: POKENAME头上泡沫，在空中帮身体保湿。泡泡没了，就必须潜水补水。
author: sk372
source: The foamy bubbles atop POKENAME's head help keep it moisturized while airborne. It must submerge itself in water to rehydrate once these bubbles are gone.

entry: POKENAME待在蓝色胶质球里，轻轻随水起伏。卡进芦苇，就用念力浮出，节奏也不打乱。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME bobs gently on water inside its blue gelatinous sphere. If caught in reeds, it uses telekinesis to float free without breaking rhythm.

entry: POKENAME凝胶一接触空气，很快变干。它定期浸进河塘，防止脱水，也从不离家太远。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME gel dries out quickly when exposed to the open air. To keep themselves from getting dehydrated, POKENAME regularly dip themselves into ponds and rivers, never straying far from their home.

entry: POKENAME吹的泡泡膜微黏，会贴在头上，渐渐堆成泡沫。游泳时，泡泡还能伪装，让大型宝可梦从上方难发现。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME blow bubbles with a slightly sticky membrane, sticking them to their head and gradually creating a foam. Their bubbles help to camouflage them as they swim, making it harder for larger Pokémon to spot them from above.

entry: POKENAME栖在石笋上，朝太靠近的训练家喷水。若不理会，整群就发动攻击，把训练家淋透。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME perches on stalagmites and spits water at Trainers who stray too close. If ignored, its entire swarm attacks, leaving the Trainers completely soaked.

entry: POKENAME不走不游，而附在大型宝可梦身上，节省水下旅行的能量。捕食者靠近双方，它便快摆尾，帮忙加速。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME conserves energy by attaching itself to larger Pokémon to travel around underwater, rather than walking or swimming. If any predator does approach the two of them, POKENAME will wag its tail quickly to propel them forward faster.

entry: POKENAME身体周围的薄膜，让它能浮在水面。下潜觅食会蜕膜，只需一两分钟，又能长好。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: A thin membrane surrounds POKENAME's body, which allows it to float on top of the water. When it needs to dive for food, it sheds this membrane and only needs a minute or two to grow it right back.

entry: POKENAME弱小，靠胸前催眠螺纹打消捕食者念头。没有手臂，它通常用独特嘴唇吃苔藓和藻类。
author: chinigan
source: POKENAME is weak, but they use the hypnotic spiral on their chest to dissuade predators. Without arms, they'll usually feed off of moss and algae with their unique lips.

entry: POKENAME先以密集泡泡震晕猎物，再强力拍翼攻击。攻势一开，很少有目标能逃。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME stuns its prey with a barrage of bubbles before striking with powerful wing beats. Few targets escape once the assault begins.

entry: POKENAME主要靠可怜表情防身，盼猎手怜惜。若对方不吃这套，它就往眼里吐点墨，遮住视线，趁机逃走。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's main defense mechanism is in its plaintive expression, hoping that potential hunters will take pity on its sorrowful look. Those that don't will get blinded by a bit of inky spit in their eyes before POKENAME flees.

entry: POKENAME吃缸底沉积的碎屑，因此常养在水族箱。头上两根毒刺，保护它免被大型宝可梦吃掉。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are commonly kept in aquariums due to their habit of feeding on detritus that has sunk to the bottom of the tank. They protect themselves from being eaten by larger Pokémon with the two venomous spines growing from their head.

entry: POKENAME摇摆着走过河床找食，靠结实身体保护。惊慌时能突然加速，迅速摆尾游离危险。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME waddle across river beds in search of food, relying on their tough bodies to protect themselves from harm. When panicked, POKENAME are capable of bursts of speed, rapidly fluttering their tail to swim away from danger.

entry: POKENAME始终节奏流畅，连战斗也一样。它用手上扇子在对手眼前晃动，让对方强烈眩晕。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME always maintains a smooth sense of rhythm, even in the midst of battle. By waving the fans on its hands in front of an opponent's face, it inflicts a strong sensation of dizziness in them.

entry: POKENAME住在森林深处阴暗浑浊的池塘。身体脆弱，便藏在水里，在人发现前先怪叫，把人吓退。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME lives in dark, murky ponds deep within the forest. Because its body is very fragile, it hides in water and lets out an eerie cry to frighten humans away before they discover it.

entry: POKENAME睡觉浮在静池。彻底放松，叶片便散淡淡肉桂香，安抚附近生物。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME floats on still ponds as it sleeps. When fully relaxed, it releases a gentle cinnamon scent from its leaves that calms others nearby.

entry: POKENAME复杂的内脏网络，能分解食物毒素。毒被储存在头顶特殊囊里。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have a complex network of internal organs that allow them to break down toxins in the food they eat. Their toxins are stored in specialised sacs atop their head.

entry: POKENAME受惊，就从花中央喷水，用臭水浇遍惊吓者。有些小丑很喜欢它，用于马戏团的滑稽表演。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME squirt water from the centre of their flower when they're surprised, dousing whatever startled them with foul-smelling water. They're a popular Pokémon with some clowns, being used in comedy routines within the circus.

entry: POKENAME大方展示旋转的催眠花纹。盯太久就晕头转向、困惑不已，让海滩捕食者打消吃它的念头。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME prominently displays its swirling hypnotic pattern, which disorients and confuses anyone who looks at it for too long. This dissuades beach predators from targeting it as a source of food.

entry: POKENAME身体太干，蘑菇就萎缩脱落。因此野生个体住在沼泽池塘，随时都靠近水源。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's mushrooms will shrivel up and fall off if its body becomes too dry. As such, it inhabits swamps and ponds in the wild, places where a source of moisture is always close by.

entry: POKENAME喜欢水流湍急的河流，任水流带着走，并随流水唱歌。游够了，它用嘴唇吸住岩石，爬上岸，休息后再跳舞。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME likes to swim in fast-moving rivers, letting the water sweep it up. It sings along with the flowing water. When it's done swimming, it uses its lips as a suction cup to grab hold of a rock and climb onto land where it dances after resting.

entry: POKENAME用大爪在古树上刻深口，再把圆嘴贴上去吸树液。背上透明菌盖属于消化系统，用来储存两餐之间多余的树液。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME use their large claws to carve deep wounds in ancient trees, pressing their round mouths into the gash to feed on the sap. The transparent mushroom cap on their back is a part of their digestive system, storing excess sap between meals.

entry: POKENAME头身的柔软白外层会吸水，防止陆上行走时变干。它也够有弹性，能弹开攻击，减少伤害。
author: .jerden
source: The soft white covering on POKENAME's head and body soaks up water to stop POKENAME from drying out while walking on land. It is also springy enough to deflect attacks, reducing the damage POKENAME takes when attacked.

entry: POKENAME的薄毛极疏水，入水后会在周身形成小气泡。因此它一潜能待数小时，不必上浮。
author: mistymagius
source: Its thin fur is so hydrophobic that when POKENAME is underwater, it creates a small bubble of air around it. This allows POKENAME to stay underwater for hours at a time without coming up to the surface.

entry: 野生POKENAME进化后，新圆身体浮力很强。不久，它们便离开育幼的岛，任洋流带往新海岸。
author: wyattwintersoul
source: When wild POKENAME evolve, their newfound rounded bodies become very buoyant. They set off from the islands they're raised on shortly after, letting the ocean's currents wash them to new shores.

entry: POKENAME嘴唇有吸力，能黏在天花板，打对手个措手不及。胸口还能发射高压水。
author: hiroshima0042_23263
source: Because of POKENAME having suctioning lips, it can stick to ceilings and catch opponents off guard. POKENAME can fire high-pressure water blasts from its chest.

entry: POKENAME靠头顶泡泡，短暂潜水。回到水面，睡莲叶帮它伪装，泡泡则重新充气。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can dive underwater for short periods of time because of the bubble atop their head. When they come back to the surface, the lily pad atop their head provides camouflage while the bubble fills up with air.

entry: 保护泡泡包住POKENAME连着大脑的敏感植物。音乐响起，植物会与舞步一起扭动震颤。
author: sk372
source: A protective bubble shields the sensitive plant connected to POKENAME's brain. The plant can be seen wiggling and vibrating to music alongside POKENAME's dance moves.

entry: POKENAME住在潮湿的地下湖泊，只短暂露面，大多时间仍留在地底。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME inhabits underground lakes rich in moisture. It emerges only briefly, preferring to remain below ground most of the time.

entry: 爱情节庆时，附近常能见POKENAME游动。据说被它的水枪喷中，感情就会迎来大好运。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are commonly seen swimming nearby whenever there is a love festival. Being sprayed with its Water Gun is said to bring great fortune to one's relationships.

entry: POKENAME随野生爱心鱼群游泳。普通爱心鱼通常与一位伴侣相守终生，它却会与两只或更多结成终生伴侣，每位都同样关爱。
author: hophoppip
source: It swims with schools of wild Luvdisc. While ordinary Luvdisc tend to mate with one partner for life, POKENAME forms lifetime partnerships with two or more Luvdisc, and cares for each one just as much.

entry: POKENAME沿溪挖掘，采最爱的豆瓣菜吃。它会喷高速水流，赶走对手。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME digs alongside creeks to harvest watercress, its favored food. It fires high-velocity water jets to drive away rivals.

entry: POKENAME跳进公园喷泉抢硬币，再叼着逃走。硬币都存进巢里，因为它相信，能带来平静与安慰。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME leaps into park fountains to snatch coins, then flees with them in its mouth. It stores them in its nest, believing they bring peace and comfort.

entry: POKENAME喜欢裹湿泥，让身体凉快湿润，这是喜好，并非身体必需。它也爱挖泥，找埋着、丢弃的亮物。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME prefers to be covered in a layer of wet mud to keep itself nice, cool, and moist; this is done out of preference, rather than necessity. In addition, it also likes to dig in the mud to find buried and abandoned glittering objects.

entry: POKENAME的慢性头痛越重，水流攻击越强。偏头痛全发作时，喷流能穿透实心砖墙。
author: .izik
source: As POKENAME's chronic headache worsens, its water attacks grow more powerful. At a full migraine, its blasts can pierce through solid brick walls.

entry: POKENAME嘴里总含水，增强水属性攻击。不过最出名的是双尾，帮助它在水下精准移动。
author: ruben2309295
source: POKENAME constantly holds water inside its mouth to enhance its Water-type attacks. POKENAME is best known for its twin tails, which help it make more precise movements when it is underwater.

entry: POKENAME拍尾、转腹纹，动作很有节奏。若盯太久，不到十五秒，就能把人哄睡。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME slaps its tail and spins its spiral, the rhythmic motion can lull a person to sleep in under fifteen seconds if they stare too long.

entry: POKENAME会瞬间移动，螺旋内脏又放催眠能量，因此很难观察。它更常出现在淡水池塘。
author: bagumbothimble
source: It is difficult to observe POKENAME due to both its teleporting ability and the hypnotic energy its spiraling innards release. POKENAME is more likely to appear near freshwater ponds.

entry: POKENAME皮肤微透明，锻炼时能看见肌肉收紧伸展。它最常出现在山间河流。
author: bobosmith01
source: As POKENAME's skin is slightly translucent, it's possible to see the muscles seize and flex as POKENAME trains its body. It is most often found in mountain rivers.

entry: POKENAME用四片湿鳍，快速扇打敌人。力量虽大，皮肤太滑湿，却无法稳稳抓住、举起任何东西。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME uses its four wet fins to rapidly slap opponents around. Despite its immense strength, its slick, moist skin makes it impossible for it to get a firm grip and lift anything.

entry: POKENAME一怕就缩壳。壳上螺纹制造视觉错觉，让捕食者迷惑、打偏。等对方彻底晕了，它就悄悄逃走。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME hide in their shell whenever they are scared. The spiral pattern on their shells act as an optical illusion that confuses predators and causes them to miss their target. Once the predators are thoroughly dazed, POKENAME quietly escape.

entry: 养分会顺流而下，成群POKENAME便住在大河。嘴里独特的鳃，能从急流滤出这些养分。
author: mistymagius
source: Groups of POKENAME live in large rivers as useful nutrients end up flowing downstream. They have a unique set of gills in their mouths, allowing them to filter out these nutrients from the rushing water.

entry: POKENAME因重量常沉池底。准备探索陆地时，就用强臂攀水岸。研究者认为，这是它的成长仪式。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Due to its weight, POKENAME will typically sink to the bottom of a pond. When it is ready to explore land it will use its strong arms to climb the edges of the waterfront. Researchers note that this is a rite of passage for POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME尾巴分泌特殊泡泡液。泡泡又滑又弹，能反射攻击，不会破。它把泡泡当甲，保护薄透明皮下露出的内脏。
author: haypile
source: POKENAME secretes a unique bubble solution through its tail. Its bubbles are unusually slippery and bouncy, reflecting attacks instead of popping. It uses these bubbles as armor to protect the thin translucent skin over its exposed insides.

entry: POKENAME能在陆海驰骋。身后释放的泡泡，就是它正在附近玩耍的明显迹象。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are amphibious creatures that can gallop across both land and sea. The bubbles they release in their wake are a telltale sign that POKENAME are playing nearby.

entry: POKENAME觅食时，用宽尾鳍把大舌贝拍上岸。等落地，便以精神力使出定身法，再进食。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its wide tail fin to slap Shellder onto land while fishing. Once they're grounded, it Disables them with psychic force before feeding.

entry: POKENAME不太会游泳，干脆互相抱成大团。腹纹带电，夜里泛微光。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are not very good at swimming, instead clinging together to form one big clump. The spirals on their stomachs are electrically charged, glowing faintly at night.

entry: 构成身体的黏液不断旋转，颜色会随最近吃下的食物而微微变化。
author: staghorn
source: The slime composing its body is constantly swirling. It subtly changes color based on its most recent meal.

entry: POKENAME一潜水，身体便半透明，除了眼嘴，都融入水里。突然现身曾吓到好几个人，其实它只想玩。
author: sk372
source: When submerged, POKENAME's body becomes translucent and blends into the water save for its eyes and mouth. It's accidentally frightened several people with its sudden appearance, though it only wants to play.

entry: 一首流行童谣，说蚊香蝌蚪卡进壳里，人们因此把POKENAME与它联想。有些人想将其拉出，却只会弄伤它。
author: aberry8286
source: POKENAME is associated with a popular nursery rhyme about a Poliwag that got stuck in a shell. This has led people to attempt pulling it out, but this only harms POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME用体内泡泡庇护小蚊香蝌蚪，避开捕食者。若有大型宝可梦威胁幼崽，它就挺身，使出强力摔打赶走。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME keep young Poliwag safe within the bubbles in their body, providing them shelter from predators. They rear up and use powerful Slams to knock away other large Pokémon if they feel they're a threat to their young charges.

entry: POKENAME藏在冰川池塘的巨石间，休息时绕大石盘成螺旋。受扰就引发强震，把自己抖脱，再游去新地方歇息。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME hide amongst boulders in glacial ponds, coiling themselves into a spiral around large rocks as they rest. They cause powerful tremors when disturbed, shaking themselves free before swimming to a new resting place.

entry: POKENAME喜欢只露肚皮游泳。看一群游过，很容易头晕。
author: petratheangel
source: POKENAME likes to swim around with just its belly above the surface. Watching a group of POKENAME swimming is likely to cause dizziness.

entry: POKENAME用藤蔓状附肢击晕猎物，也会砸石，锻炼力量耐力。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME use their vine-like appendages to knock out prey. They smash rocks to try and build up strength and endurance.

entry: POKENAME以小家庭一起滚动。受惊很容易自爆，把一波黏液撒满周围。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME roll around together in small family groups. When startled, they are prone to Self-Destructing and showering the surrounding area in a wave of sticky mucus.

entry: POKENAME从头骨释放精神脉冲，催眠靠近池塘的入侵者。数百英尺外，都能感知这些波动。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME releases psychic pulses from its skull to lull intruders near its pond into sleep. These waves can be felt from hundreds of feet away.

entry: POKENAME翻找湖底久死宝可梦的骨头，当作武器。找到格外结实的，就开心呱叫，巡湖岸也高兴地挥着。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME scavenge around in lake beds for the bones of long-dead Pokémon, wielding them as weapons. They make happy croaking noises when they find a particularly sturdy bone, swinging it happily as they patrol the lake shore.

entry: POKENAME从蛹的螺纹处排黏液，把自己贴在树枝上。黏液溶水，想离树时，只需对自己使出水枪，就会从树上掉下。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME excrete a sticky mucus from the spiral on their chrysalis, using the mucus to attach to tree branches. Their mucus is water-soluble, and when they want to detach from the tree, they simply spray a Water Gun at themselves and fall.

entry: 它腹部口袋带着大量小圆蛋。袋皮能留水，让蛋保持湿润。
author: hophoppip
source: It carries a plethora of small round eggs in the pouch on its belly. The skin of the pouch retains moisture to keep the eggs wet.

entry: POKENAME腹部透明，里面的小蚊香蝌蚪能看妈妈捕晚餐。有时幼崽太兴奋，把妈妈晃得不稳，猎物便逃走。
author: gronkissimo
source: POKENAME's belly is see-through, allowing the Poliwag inside to watch as its mother catches dinner for them. Sometimes it gets too excited, jolting the mother around and letting prey escape.

entry: 池养POKENAME群会缓慢排成螺旋游泳。食物一扔下，整群便疯狂争向中央。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME schools swim in a slow, spiralling formation when kept in ponds. When food is thrown in, a frenzy breaks out amongst the school as each POKENAME fights its way to the middle of the spiral.

entry: POKENAME皮肤怕污染，偏爱清澈湖水。受威胁时，它会猛烈扑动螺纹翅，扰乱敌人。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME prefers to live near lakes with pristine waters, as their skin is sensitive to pollution. When threatened, it aggressively flutters its spiral-patterned wings to disorient foes.

entry: POKENAME用核心的螺旋纹催眠对手。旋转会让它头晕，如今只能用超能力浮空。
author: mr.person__prinplup_enjoyer
source: POKENAME uses the swirl on its core to hypnotise opponents. It now has to float using its psychic powers because spinning would make it dizzy.

entry: POKENAME用锯刃手臂伐木，在湖中央筑巢。宝可梦巡护员会训练群体，在山火逼近时，提前砍倒火势前方的树木。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME cuts down trees with its saw blade arms to use in the construction of a hive in the middle of a lake. Pokémon Rangers train groups of POKENAME to cut down trees ahead of approaching forest fires.

entry: POKENAME体温高，住的池塘蒸汽升腾。它吹几个泡泡，友好招呼别人，可若破裂时靠太近，人就会烫伤。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME-inhabited ponds have rising steam due to the high body temperature of their inhabitants. POKENAME blows several bubbles as a friendly greeting to others, but the bubbles will burn a person if they are too close when they pop.

entry: POKENAME平时温顺，可一碰胡须，很快就会暴怒挣扎。它很为卷曲胡须得意，总要保持正确形状。
author: sk372
source: Typically docile, messing with a POKENAME's whiskers is a quick way to incite thrashing anger, as it takes great pride in the swirling curl and making sure it always keeps its proper shape.

entry: POKENAME是渔业公司受欢迎的吉祥物，气派胡须让它显得优雅精致。营销团队还常给它戴帽，强化这印象。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have proven to be popular as mascots for fishing companies, their impressive whiskers lending them an air of elegance and refinement. To help encourage this perception, it is common for marketing teams to put hats on them.

entry: POKENAME身体分节，下侧甲壳素很薄，能看见内脏。节内的黑螺旋，储存从毒刺排出的毒液。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The chitin on the underside of the body segments of POKENAME are very thin, revealing their internal organs. The black spirals within the segments contain the venom that they secrete from their sting.

entry: POKENAME先盘住猎物，再用腹纹催眠，最后整个吞下。
author: radiance8990
source: POKENAME traps its prey by coiling around and hypnotizing them with the patterns on its belly before swallowing them whole.

entry: POKENAME毛上的螺纹，因个体而各不相同。它睡得极深，期间内脏会产生多种变化，帮助更好适应环境。
author: bobosmith01
source: The spiral-shaped patterns on POKENAME's fur vary in appearance depending on the individual. POKENAME sleeps extremely deeply; during this period, its organs undergo various changes to let it survive better in its environment.

entry: POKENAME旋转全身，把钻头般的毒刺撞进敌人。不过容易晕，无法持续太久。
author: gronkissimo
source: POKENAME attacks by spinning its whole body and ramming its drill-like stinger into enemies. It gets dizzy, however, so it can't do it for very long.

entry: POKENAME挑战其他宝可梦，若开始落于下风，就会隐形逃跑。
author: hiroshima0042_23263
source: POKENAME challenges another Pokémon to fights. When POKENAME starts to lose a fight, it turns invisible and runs away.

entry: POKENAME群每小时同步大声呱叫，短暂喧闹一片。钟表尚未普及的年代，附近居民曾靠叫声计时。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME colonies loudly croak in synchrony once per hour, creating a brief cacophony of noise. Communities that live near POKENAME populations used to use the noise as a means of timekeeping before clocks became more popular.

entry: POKENAME腹纹全天缓转，每24小时正好一圈。古老传说称，它把时间卷进螺旋，存着以后用。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The spiral on POKENAME's belly slowly rotates throughout the day and completes a full rotation once every 24 hours. An old legend claims that they wind the time into their spiral, saving it to use later.

entry: POKENAME把蛛网织成精巧螺旋，确保能存够水保湿。训练家或大型宝可梦靠近，它就落下，摇背纹驱赶。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME weaves intricate spirals into its webs to ensure that it holds enough water to stay properly hydrated. If a Trainer or larger Pokémon approaches its web, the POKENAME will descend and wave the spiral on its back to repel them.

entry: 它们出水仍一直湿滑，很容易从险境脱身。突眼让它们水下、黑暗里都看得清。
author: santon5512
source: When out of the water, their bodies are constantly wet and slimy, allowing them to slip out of danger quite easily. Their bulging eyes allow them to see well both underwater and in the dark.

entry: POKENAME陆上笨拙，腿别扭挪动，跳水常肚皮先拍下。不过游泳时，周身螺纹会闪耀、催眠般旋转，令观者着迷，也让附近宝可梦进入平静、如梦似幻的状态。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME is ungainly on land, its legs shuffling awkwardly and causing it to bellyflop when diving. But once it swims, the spirals on its body shimmer and spin hypnotically, enchanting onlookers and lulling nearby Pokémon into a calm, dreamy state.

entry: POKENAME不爱打架，会转腹纹催敌入睡。背花必须泡水，因此从不远离池塘。
author: fiordaliso
source: Since it dislikes fighting, it makes foes fall asleep by spinning the spiral on its belly. The flower on its back must stay submerged, so POKENAME never strays far from its pond.

entry: POKENAME耳上的眼是假眼，显得自己更大。手会分泌蜜味液体，里面含上一餐没吸收完的养分。
author: chibitales
source: The eyes on POKENAME's ears are false eyes meant to make them seem larger. Their hands secrete a fluid that tastes similar to honey and contains nutrients that weren't fully absorbed from their previous meal.

entry: 它多数内脏装在背部，其他身体都是翻涌的水。能融进普通水里，因此泳速比陆行快，浸水也能恢复自身。
author: imaginita
source: Most of its organs are contained within its back.  The rest of its body is made up of billowing water.  It can meld with regular water, allowing it to swim faster than it can move on land, and restore itself by submerging in water.

entry: POKENAME夜里大声呱叫互告，让群体在黑暗中知道同伴位置。发现威胁，就挥巨拳，阻止靠近。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME make loud croaking calls to one another during the night, keeping the flock aware of where its members are in the dark. If they identify a threat to the flock, they will swing their massive fists at it to keep them away.

entry: POKENAME螺旋游动，催眠鸟和鱼，引近吞食。身上薄膜让捕食者很难抓牢。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME swims in a spiraling motion to hypnotize birds and fish, drawing them close to devour. It is covered in a thin film that makes it difficult for predators to grasp it.

entry: POKENAME自由奔放，常荡树枝跳湖。它常训练作救生员伙伴，强壮身体能抱住遇险者，游向安全处。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is free spirited and is observed swinging from branches to dive into lakes. It often trains as a companion to lifeguards as its muscular body can hold a rescuee while swimming to safety.

entry: POKENAME与其他硬壳宝可梦不同，还长着一只手，能打掉想撬壳的东西。不过它总在深水休息，通常用不上。
author: seanothan_23
source: Unlike other hard-shelled Pokémon, POKENAME also has a singular hand for knocking away anything that tries to pry open its shell. However, it usually isn't needed as it rests deep underwater at all times.

entry: POKENAME发射带电泡泡，麻痹小宝可梦，再拖入水下，带回安静巢穴进食。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME launches electrified bubbles that can paralyze small Pokémon. It then drags them below the surface to feed in its quiet underwater lair.

entry: POKENAME勤快聪明，照料野外树果、草药园，供自己吃或与其他宝可梦交换。有些也愿意拿树果，换人类小饰品。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME tend to be very industrious and intelligent Pokémon. They tend to wild gardens of berries and herbs to eat or exchange with other Pokémon. Some can even be convinced by humans to give berries in exchange for trinkets.

entry: 它始终覆着油性分泌物，既能清洁，也方便钻入钻出自己的洞。遇敌抓住，蜷身便更容易滑脱。
author: infinex21
source: Its body is always covered in an oily secretion, which keeps it clean and makes it easier to slip in and out of the burrows it digs. It curls up to better slip out of the grasps of foes.

entry: POKENAME常在旧办公室电脑里，假扮来电通知，惹人烦。使用者一点击，它就接管系统，把屏幕铺满水样纹理。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are a nuisance found in old office PCs pretending to be a notification for a phone call. If a user clicks on the notification, POKENAME take over the system and fill the screen with a watery texture.

entry: POKENAME常在旧办公室电脑里，假扮来电通知，惹人烦。使用者一点击，它就接管系统，把屏幕铺满水样纹理。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are a nuisance found in old office PCs pretending to be a notification for a phone call. If a user clicks on the notification, POKENAME take over the system and fill the screen with a watery texture.

entry: POKENAME靠黏液爬树，在高枝间跳跃。城市里，它本能地攀上大楼，窗上留下黏痕，惹来许多麻烦。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME use their sticky mucus to climb trees, leaping between branches high above the forest floor. POKENAME cause problems in cities as their instinct to climb drives them to scale large buildings, leaving a trail of slime on windows as they do.

entry: POKENAME在红树林沼泽安家，捡浮果带回巢，留待以后吃。它很护巢，会挥叶刃攻击偷食者。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME make their home in mangrove swamps, collecting floating fruit and bringing it back to their nest to feed on later. They are very protective of their nest, swinging Leaf Blades at those that try to steal food from them.

entry: POKENAME能让下半身花纹旋动，催眠凝视者。对方久久恍惚时，它便逃走自保。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can make the pattern on its lower half swirl around, creating a hypnotic effect on those that stare at it. It uses this as a defensive measure, fleeing while the victim is put in a lengthy stupor.

entry: POKENAME被用于大型水域附近的搜救。宽大柔软的手掌，加上能悬在湖面的本领，让它成为救起挣扎泳客的珍贵帮手。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are used during search and rescue operations around large bodies of water. With their large, soft hands and their ability to hover over the surface of lakes, they are invaluable at saving struggling swimmers from danger.

entry: POKENAME实体是一团不停旋转的水。在北半球、南半球时，旋转方向恰好相反。
author: bostroms
source: POKENAME's physical form consists of a constantly swirling mass of water.  It swirls in opposite directions depending on whether it is in the Northern or Southern Hemisphere.

entry: POKENAME皮肤不断渗出厚胶，盖住毒刺，避免别人被扎。打架时胶会变薄，方便把毒注给对手。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME's skin constantly oozes a thick gel that coats their toxic spines to protect others from being stung. Their gel thins when they get into fights, allowing them to inflict their venom on others more easily.

entry: POKENAME住在广阔湿地，每只各占大池。它们大声呱叫，声音最远一英里，一边呼应，一边守家驱敌。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME live in extensive wetlands, each of them claiming a large pond for themselves. They call to one another with croaking bellows, the sound echoing up to a mile as they guard their home from rivals.

entry: POKENAME以粗壮肌肉手臂闻名，臂上总有某种标记。两只游泳相遇，会迅速展示肌肉，以此交流。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is noted for its beefy muscular arms that always bear some sort of marking upon them. Should two POKENAME pass each other as they swim, they communicate through a series of quick flexes.

entry: POKENAME皮肤产生易燃黏液，先甩敌人，再用火花点燃。有些偏远村庄木料稀少，便靠它帮忙生火。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME produce a flammable slime from their skin, flinging it at foes before following it up with an Ember. POKENAME have been used in some rural villages to help with starting fires when wood is scarce.

entry: POKENAME住在广阔湿地，每只各占大池。它们大声呱叫，用泡泡扩音，传到更远。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME live in extensive wetlands, each of them claiming a large pond for themselves. They call to one another with croaking bellows, using bubbles to amplify their voices and help them carry further.

entry: POKENAME轻轻转动缎带，就能让对手入睡。剑刃始终油润光滑。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME can gently twirl its ribbon around to put its opponent to sleep. Its blade is always slick and well-oiled.

entry: 它在河里起伏滑行，动作如催眠，令观者平静。找到猎物，就紧盘尾巴，再猛挥击晕，随后吃掉。
author: haypile
source: It glides through rivers in hypnotic undulations that pacify onlookers. When it finds suitable prey, it coils its tail tight and then whips it forward to knock the prey out before eating.

entry: 皮肤一干燥，健康状况就会恶化。想饲养它的训练家应每隔几天替它保湿，让皮毛保持光亮健康。
author: melodydelune
source: Its health deteriorates when its skin dries out. Prospective Trainers should moisturize them every few days to keep their coats shiny and healthy.

entry: POKENAME喜欢帮人洗衣，把脏物放进体内洗净。洗碗也能帮，不过家里得确保碗和衣服别混在一起。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME enjoy helping people wash clothes, putting anything dirty in its body to clean. It can also help with washing dishes, though families need to make sure they do not mix dishes with clothes.

entry: POKENAME用黑长缎带紧紧绕身，盘成螺旋。操控极巧，连数米外地上的小石也能拈起。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME keep long black ribbons wrapped around their body in tight spirals, wielding them with enough finesse to be able to pluck small rocks from the ground many meters away.

entry: POKENAME尾巴盘起能催眠猎物，再展开，缠住目标，用出奇的高热烹烤。
author: gronkissimo
source: When coiled up, POKENAME's tail hypnotizes its prey. Then it uncoils and wraps the prey up with it, cooking it with a surprising heat.

entry: 看POKENAME一会儿，就会晕得厉害，常陷入催眠恍惚。幸好两只浮手，会把人拍醒。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Watching POKENAME for any length is absolutely dizzying, often causing onlookers to enter a hypnotic trance. Thankfully its two floating hands will slap them awake.

entry: POKENAME让尾上泡泡按迷人图案移动，催眠靠近爱池的宝可梦。它再用身上油脂和腹火，掷出能黏住目标的火焰。
author: npshi
source: POKENAME move the bubbles on their tails in a mesmerising pattern, hypnotising Pokémon that draw close to their favourite ponds. Using grease on POKENAME's bodies and the flames from their stomach, they can hurl flames that stick to their targets.

entry: POKENAME在淡水湖漫无目的地漂。传说身上螺纹让人忍不住想抓，可它实在太滑，根本抓不住。
author: quantumradiation
source: POKENAME can be found drifting aimlessly around freshwater lakes. The swirl pattern on its body is said to compel one to try to grab hold of it, but it's far too slippery to catch.

entry: POKENAME裹在果冻状物质里，顺河漂流，撞石也无伤。它很少主动移动，任水流带着探索。
author: .izik
source: Encased in a gelatin-like substance, POKENAME drifts down rivers, bouncing harmlessly off rocks. It rarely moves on its own, letting the current guide its exploration.

entry: POKENAME拍翼会放出催眠波，哄敌入睡。群体再扑向睡着的宝可梦，彻底吸干能量。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME flaps its wings, it emits hypnotic waves that lull foes to sleep. Swarms descend on sleeping Pokémon to drain their energy completely.

entry: POKENAME的催眠螺纹、持续凝视和新长拳头，配合出奇有效。它伺机捕食弱小宝可梦，也催眠强者，偷蛋或食物。
author: chinigan
source: The combination of their hypnotic spiral, unbreaking gaze, and newly grown fists is surprisingly efficient. POKENAME are opportunistic predators, hunting weak Pokémon and using their hypnosis to steal eggs or food from stronger Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME附在两栖宝可梦身上，若对方离水太久，就会脱离、换宿主。背纹能催眠敌人，保护宿主免遭捕食。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME attaches itself to amphibious Pokémon but will detach and find a new host if they spend too much time out of the water. The spiral pattern on its back can hypnotize foes, enabling POKENAME to protect its host from predators.

entry: POKENAME用强臂爬过河床，让柔软腹部安全地朝下。受袭就抓紧大石，靠带刺硬皮防护。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME crawl across the bottom of river beds using their powerful arms, keeping their soft under-belly safely turned to the floor. They grip tightly onto larger rocks when they come under attack, relying on their spiny hide to protect them.

entry: POKENAME游过急河，用长牙劈开沿途碎屑。平时温顺，离水太久却会烦躁。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME swims down fast-flowing rivers, using its tusks to slice through debris in its path. Though generally docile, it becomes irritable if kept out of water for too long.

entry: POKENAME在急溪旁的树筑巢，有时潜水抓鱼宝可梦。翼上薄薄的防水黏液，让它轻松进出水面。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME nest in the trees that line fast-running streams. They can sometimes be seen diving into the water to catch fish Pokémon, a thin covering of water-repellent mucus on their wings allowing them to dive in and out without issue.

entry: 黑暗洞窟里，能见POKENAME螺纹先泛微光，再转动。催附近生物睡着后，它就迅速使出翅膀攻击。
author: .izik
source: In dark caves, one can see POKENAME's spiral glow faintly before turning. This hypnotic light puts nearby creatures to sleep, after which it strikes with a swift Wing Attack.

entry: 踩到POKENAME，会让人晕眩迷乱。若这防御仍赶不走敌人，它就扭身乱摆，以惊人速度逃走。
author: bacondlx
source: Stepping on a POKENAME will leave you dazed and confused. If this defense mechanism fails to deter aggressors, POKENAME makes twisting and flailing motions to escape at a surprising speed.

entry: POKENAME伏在浅水下，只让眼状花纹露出，威吓捕食者。受惊扰时，便向来敌喷水，趁隙逃走。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME hides just below the water surface, keeping its eye patterns above the water to deter predators. If disturbed, it will shoot a small jet of water at its attacker, letting it escape.

entry: POKENAME滚动时闭侧眼，形成螺纹，催眠附近目标。旋转中，它靠嗅觉辨路。
author: .izik
source: While rolling, POKENAME shuts its side eyes to form a spiral pattern. This can hypnotize nearby targets. It uses its sense of smell to navigate as it spins.

entry: POKENAME释放蓝球果味的蓝花粉，强得几秒就能催成年人入睡。雇用它的睡眠研究者，十分受益。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME releases blue pollen that smells like Blue Apricorns. The scent is strong enough to put an adult human to sleep in seconds, aiding any sleep researchers who employ it.

entry: POKENAME住在海洋深处仅有微光的水层。眼睛有透明黏膜保护，始终朝水面，捕捉微光，帮助狩猎。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME live deep in the ocean within the twilight zone, where very little light can reach. Their eyes are protected by a transparent layer of mucus and constantly face toward the surface, capturing what little light there is to allow them to hunt.

entry: 据说POKENAME是湖中溺亡孩子的灵魂，借用了蚊香君的催眠螺纹。它以童声哭叫扰乱猎物，再拖入湖里。
author: veryfunnypersonmaybe
source: POKENAME are said to be the spirits of children that drowned in a lake and adopted the hypnotic swirl of Poliwhirl. It uses childlike cries to disorient prey and then drags them into the lake.

entry: POKENAME嘴里流出乐芭果香的口水，引来附近虫宝可梦，再突然用水枪伏击。
author: .izik
source: Aguav Berry-scented drool leaks from POKENAME's mouth, luring nearby bug Pokémon. It ambushes them with sudden Water Gun blasts.

entry: POKENAME似乎没有眼皮，便用油液盖眼，防太阳伤害。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME seem to not have any eyelids. They combat this by covering their eyes in a oily fluid to keep them safe from the sun.

entry: POKENAME背上的蘑菇释放孢子，催眠附近目标。意志薄弱者便成傀儡，常被用来散播更多孢子。
author: .izik
source: The mushroom on POKENAME's back releases spores that hypnotize nearby targets. Weak minds become its puppets, often used to spread more spores.

entry: POKENAME毛发极防水，坐在水面也不会全身浸透。不过它很爱下雨，会开心随雨起舞。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's fur is highly hydrophobic, allowing it to sit atop the water without getting completely soaked. Despite this, POKENAME loves the rain and will cheerfully dance as the rain falls.

entry: POKENAME先挥拳，再从拳中射出水制手里剑。若手里剑接触螺纹，它便能施加巨大的旋转力。
author: hiroshima0042_23263
source: POKENAME follows its punches with water shuriken from its fists. POKENAME can apply immense rotational force to its shuriken if they touch its spiral pattern.

entry: POKENAME翼上螺纹是防御手段，一拍翼就能迷惑攻击者。它住在河塘边，身上细毛让它能停在水面。
author: mistymagius
source: The spiral patterns on POKENAME's wings act as a defense mechanism, confusing its attackers when it beats its wings. It lives near lakes and ponds, the fine hairs on its body allowing it to sit atop the water surface.

entry: POKENAME在湿地放精神能量，催猎物入睡，再带往地下隐蔽湖泊吃。
author: .izik
source: In wetlands, POKENAME releases psychic energy to put prey to sleep. It then carries them underground to secluded lakes to feed.

entry: POKENAME游过暖海，鳞片上的鲜艳色彩不断变化，令观者困倦。游得快时，哪怕只瞥一眼，也会想睡。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's vibrant colors shift across its scales as it travels through warm seas, which can cause drowsiness in those who watch. Even a brief glance can induce sleepiness if it is moving at higher speeds.

entry: POKENAME在水下拍掌，能让附近宝可梦入睡。期间，鳍上螺纹缓缓旋转。
author: .izik
source: By slapping its hands together underwater, POKENAME can cause nearby Pokémon to fall asleep. During this action the spiral on its fin rotates slowly.

entry: POKENAME用强力泡泡挡路，守住自己的豆瓣菜丛。它睡在附近巨石下，始终看着食物来源。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses forceful bubbles to block access to its watercress patches. It sleeps beneath nearby boulders, always watching its food source.

entry: POKENAME从头上护符放精神波，催眠目标。趁恍惚，就偷走随身一切亮物。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME emits psychic waves from the charm on its head to hypnotize targets. Once entranced, it steals anything shiny from their belongings.

entry: POKENAME用分散注意的泡泡迷惑人们。戒心一松，它便灵巧猛扑，抢走贵重物。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME fires distracting bubbles to confuse people. Once they drop their guard, it pounces and snatches valuables with impressive agility.

entry: 盯POKENAME螺纹太久，会偏头痛得厉害。许多训练家报告，长时间接触会头晕、迷乱。
author: .izik
source: Staring too long at POKENAME's spiral causes splitting migraines. Many Trainers report dizziness and confusion after prolonged exposure.

entry: POKENAME泳技卓越，速度技巧都能媲美最负盛名的运动员。姿势漂亮又和善，很适合当游泳教练。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are excellent swimmers, matching the speed and technique of the most prestigious athletes. Because of their excellent form and kind demeanor, they make for great swimming instructors.

entry: POKENAME先捶胸，再跃向目标。躯干中央的黏液有微毒，随着连番拳击，慢慢削弱敌人。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME beats its chest before leaping to attack a target. The slime that coats the center of its torso is faintly toxic, so its punches slowly weaken a foe as it pummels them.

entry: POKENAME迎瀑布直游而上，锻炼耐力。累了就脸朝下，躺在浅河床，直到歇足。
author: .izik
source: To build endurance, POKENAME swims straight up waterfalls. When tired, it lies face-down in shallow riverbeds until fully rested.

entry: 嘴内无尽的虚空不通往任何地方。进入者都会消失，再也不见踪影。
author: theheroict
source: The endless void within its mouth leads to nowhere. Any who enter disappear, never to be seen again.

entry: POKENAME比普通蚊香泳士温和得多，肌肉却同样强。大河附近，能见它教小宝可梦游泳。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is a lot less aggressive than regular Poliwrath, but its muscles are just as strong. It can be seen around large rivers, teaching smaller Pokémon how to swim.

entry: POKENAME定期挑战其他水生宝可梦比力，想证明自己在场最强。不过它常高估自己，曾被蚊香泳士摔服。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME periodically challenge other aquatic Pokémon to tests of strength, trying to prove themselves to be the strongest Pokémon present. They are prone to overestimating themselves and have been seen being wrestled into submission by Poliwrath.

entry: 多数POKENAME在关都海岸与人合作。主要工作之一，是拖拉难以进港的船。
author: bradlybro199
source: Most POKENAME work alongside humans on the coasts of the Kanto region. One of the main jobs given to them is pulling in nearby ships who are struggling to come into port.

entry: POKENAME晃眼的旋转身体，能迷惑、误导敌人。动得越多，越难看清身形，训练家可能很难让它站定。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's dizzying swirly body serves to perplex and misdirect its opponents. The more it's moving, the harder it is to make sense of its body, so Trainers may have trouble getting POKENAME to stand still.

entry: POKENAME虽已适应陆行，却走得慢，更喜欢水里。嘴能盛大量水，消防员因此常使用成群个体。
author: mistymagius
source: Despite having adapted to walking on land, POKENAME still prefers to stay in the water as it quite a slow walker. Firefighters often use groups of POKENAME as they can carry large amounts of water in their mouths.

entry: POKENAME摇晃身体，用螺纹催人困倦，防止被踩。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME will jiggle its body to cause drowsiness with its spiral pattern. This is done to deter people from stepping on it.

entry: POKENAME在水下从螺纹放精神波，催眠大舌贝。可常捕到一半就忘事，迷迷糊糊漂走。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME emits psychic wave from its spiral underwater to hypnotize Shellder, but often forgets what it's doing mid-hunt and drifts away in confusion.

entry: 据说POKENAME背上大舌贝极强，竟能咬牢那不停湿润、油滑的皮肤。
author: seanothan_23
source: It is said that the Shellder on POKENAME's back is extremely powerful. This is due to the Shellder being able to latch onto its constantly wet and oily skin.

entry: POKENAME睡觉也习惯拿大葱拍池面。敲击节奏随心情快慢变化，向附近同族传讯。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME habitually slaps its leek on pond surfaces while sleeping. The rhythmic tapping speeds up or slows down based on its mood, signaling nearby kin.

entry: POKENAME两个头独立移动，上下晃动，帮助准确判断距离。奔跑时，它们把头贴近身体，减轻颠簸。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME's twin heads move independently of one another, bobbing around to help them see with proper depth perception. They tuck their heads close to their body when they run to minimise jostling as they race across the landscape.

entry: POKENAME身体有95%是水，却明显更黏稠。炎热晴天里，它是好伙伴，不过别想喝它身上的水。
author: mistymagius
source: While its body is made of 95 percent water, it is also significantly more viscous. POKENAME are a great partner for hot and sunny days; however, it is not recommended to try and drink from it.

entry: POKENAME处理毒素，净化栖水。过程在体内形成油性螺旋，可用来分散、迷惑幼崽的捕食者。
author: pjporwoll
source: The body of POKENAME processes toxins to clean the water of its habitat. This conversion creates the oily swirls in its body that POKENAME uses to distract and confuse predators of its young.

entry: POKENAME在湖下挖长长的螺旋隧道觅食，也乐于分享。许多水生宝可梦便借道藏身，躲避大型宝可梦。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME dig long, spiralling tunnels beneath lakes in search of food. POKENAME appear happy to share their burrows, and many aquatic Pokémon use their tunnels as shelter to hide from larger Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME的螺旋从周围水中提氧，再把废气化作泡泡排回水里。长蛇般的身体任何部位，都能用力喷出泡泡。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME's spirals extract oxygen from the water surrounding them, releasing waste gas back into the water as bubbles. They can blast these bubbles out forcefully from any part of their long, serpentine body.

entry: POKENAME腹纹催眠般转动，哄凝视者入睡。战斗因此占优，至少能赶在敌人醒前，狠狠打中一次。
author: santon5512
source: The pattern on POKENAME's stomach moves and spins in a hypnotic motion, putting those who stare at it to sleep. This gives these Pokémon quite the advantage in combat, allowing them to land at least one good hit before their opponent awakens.

entry: POKENAME用藤蔓状附肢远远拉来猎物，再以强拳打得动不了。它常吃溜溜糖球等小型宝可梦。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME pulls in prey from a distance using its vine-like appendages. It then uses its strong fists to immobilize its prey. It often feasts on small Pokémon, like Surskit.

entry: POKENAME没自信，对战通常不可靠，却在清醒时不停训练，哪怕暴雨或其他恶劣环境也一样。
author: bobosmith01
source: Although POKENAME is unconfident and generally unreliable in Pokémon battles, it nevertheless trains incessantly during its waking hours, even during downpours and other harsh conditions.

entry: 闯入者靠近池塘，POKENAME先挥骨头攻击。若打空，接着的拳头，力道足以掀翻拖拉机。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME attempts to strike intruders with its bone if they approach its pond. Should it miss, it follows with punches powerful enough to toss a tractor.

entry: POKENAME泳技出色，靠强力踢腿推进。腿很适合水下战斗，活动和攻击，都像在陆上般自如。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are excellent swimmers, using powerful kicks to propel themselves through the water. Their legs are best suited for fighting underwater, able to move and strike as if they were on land.

entry: POKENAME四肢看似细，全身却都是结实肌肉。拳馆常用它，向新人示范动作。
author: mepp.
source: Though POKENAME appears to have rather thin limbs, its entire body is solid muscle. Boxing gyms often use POKENAME to help demonstrate certain moves to newcomers.

entry: POKENAME只有眼睛和手臂能动。这个水属性个体越长越大，也就越接近进化。壳虽然坚固，内部却柔软，怕穿刺攻击。
author: bobosmith01
source: Only POKENAME's eyes and arms are mobile. As the Water-type grows larger and larger, it grows closer and closer to evolution. Although its shell is firm, its insides are soft and vulnerable to piercing blows.

entry: POKENAME很凶，常与其他雄性切磋。强臂不仅用于战斗，也帮它游得更快。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are very aggressive as they can be seen constantly sparring with other males. Its strong arms are not only used for combat, but they are also used for faster swimming.

entry: POKENAME熟练运用粗壮胡须，毫不畏惧地挑战大型宝可梦，证明力量。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME wields its beefy whiskers with great skill. It fearlessly challenges bigger Pokémon to prove its strength.

entry: POKENAME的毒会让中招者精力躁动。被扎的人常以为自己与它一样有无尽体力，不停跑，直到筋疲力尽。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME venom induces a restless energy in those afflicted by it. People stung by POKENAME often find themselves running to exhaustion, believing that they have the same boundless energy as POKENAME itself.

entry: POKENAME住在冰冷地区，大多时间在水里。它会拿强健身体撞浮冰、岩石，作为训练。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME lives in freezing climates, spending most of its time in the water. It slams its sturdy body against ice floes and rocks as a form of training.

entry: POKENAME改变肤色，融入爱池附近的泥土。受惊时，会用强力放电反击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME alters its skin coloration to blend into soil near its preferred pond. If startled, it retaliates by unleashing a powerful Discharge.

entry: 它跳跃时，似乎不太遵守重力定律。途中若撞墙，就会继续向上移动，直到脱离轨道。
author: bandedbodypress
source: It doesn't seem to properly obey the laws of gravity when it jumps. If it hits a wall while jumping, it will continue upward movement until it leaves orbit.

entry: POKENAME肤色似乎受栖居生境影响。想养出绿色个体，得放在它原本不住的寒冷气候。它食欲也非常旺盛。
author: fireblade141
source: A POKENAME's skin color appears to be influenced by what biome it lives in. Green POKENAME have to be raised in colder climates to which they are not normally native. This Pokémon also has a voracious appetite.

entry: POKENAME的壳终生生长，给肌肉越来越大负担。持续负重训练，让年长个体能使出极强的地狱翻滚。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME shells grow continuously throughout their lives, putting steadily greater strain on their muscles. Older POKENAME are capable of delivering an incredibly powerful Submission to their foes thanks to the constant weight training.

entry: POKENAME外壳能承受深海的巨大压力。它们在漆黑海底互射尖刺交战，争出谁最强。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME shells allow them to withstand the crushing depths of the deep ocean. They battle one another in the pitch-black ocean depths, launching their spikes at one another in an effort to establish which POKENAME is strongest.

entry: POKENAME用短臂在树间攀移，爬到安全处躲着，直到进化。被迫交战，甩臂力量也足以把多数敌人扔下树。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME use their stubby arms to move around in trees, clambering into a safe place to hide until they evolve. When forced into a battle, they swing their arms with enough strength to toss most foes off of their tree.

entry: POKENAME喜欢独居训练，住在远离人类的偏僻岛屿。它不欢迎不速之客，但若被打败，也会表示尊重。
author: sk372
source: Preferring a life of solitude and training, POKENAME resides on remote islands far removed from humanity. It does not take kindly to uninvited visitors, but will show respect should it be bested in combat.

entry: POKENAME群不知疲倦地合作，在湖中建造多出口的精巧巢穴。巢受打扰，就用密集拳击凶猛防守。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME swarms tirelessly work together to construct elaborate hives in lakes, building their home with multiple exits. When their hive is disturbed, POKENAME violently defend their home with a flurry of punches.

entry: POKENAME极凶，连比自己大得多的宝可梦也赶出池塘。不过人从附近走过，它又会好奇观看。
author: hiroshima0042_23263
source: POKENAME is very aggressive and chases Pokémon way bigger than itself out of ponds. POKENAME curiously watches humans as they pass near its pond.

entry: POKENAME吐的丝比钢梁更强，用来织网、搭锻炼横杠。猎物落网后，它先转圈，以螺纹安抚，再挥拳打服。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME spins silk stronger than steel beams, which it uses for its web and workout bars. When prey becomes stuck in its web, it spins in a circle to calm them with its spiraling markings, before pummeling them into submission with its fists.

entry: 多数POKENAME摇摆着在湖边走动。视力差，便靠响亮呱叫，回声定位，在家园辨路。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Most POKENAME spend their time waddling around the edges of lakes. They have poor eyesight, instead relying on loud croaks to echolocate their way through their home.

entry: POKENAME虽能高速飞，大多更爱在地上摇摆走。它喜欢浅塘嬉水，开心拍翼，制造涟漪。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Though capable of high speed flight, most POKENAME prefer to spend their time waddling along the ground. They have a fondness for splashing around the shallows of ponds, gleefully flapping their wings to create ripples in the water.

entry: POKENAME对战时高速掠过敌人，靠厚重身体使出强力地狱翻滚。湖边战斗，常把敌人带过水面，再扔进去。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME swoop past their foes at high speeds during Pokémon battles, relying on their bulk to land powerful Submission attacks on their foes. When battling near lakes, they are prone to carrying their foe over the water's surface to drop them in.

entry: POKENAME对战时高速掠过敌人，用分离的拳头猛击。它不知疲倦地反复飞掠攻击，直到打昏对方。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME swoop past their foes at high speed during Pokémon battles, relying on their disembodied fists to land powerful strikes. They repeat their fly-by attacks tirelessly until they're successful in knocking out their opponent.

entry: POKENAME头灯能放出震慑闪光，使敌人失去行动力。不过非到绝境，很不愿用，更喜欢堂堂正正挥拳交战。
author: sk372
source: The light on POKENAME's head can emit a stunning flash to incapacitate foes, though it is loathe to use it unless truly desperate. It much prefers pummeling an enemy with its fists in honorable combat.

entry: POKENAME游泳耐力惊人，因此据说壳里装满无尽能量。它不断努力，为善良的人们带来欢乐幸福。
author: the_fireplace
source: Its shell is said to be stuffed with boundless energy due to its incredible endurance when swimming. POKENAME works tirelessly to spread joy and happiness to kindhearted people.

entry: POKENAME拳力远超体形预期，连体形超过自身两倍的敌人也能打倒。它盘尾当弹簧，猛冲前使出强力地狱翻滚。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME throw punches that pack far more strength than might be expected for a Pokémon their size, able to fell foes more than twice their size. They coil their tail and use it as a spring, letting them spring forward with a powerful Submission.

entry: POKENAME从小在码头大群生活。长期靠水，让它游泳很强。它喜欢整天待在码头，偷当地渔夫的东西。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: POKENAME have spent their time growing up on docks in large communities. Due to the amount of time they have spent near the water, they have become powerful swimmers. They enjoy spending most of their days on docks stealing from local fishermen.

entry: POKENAME群负责照顾许多水属性幼崽，不知疲倦，确保小宝可梦得到善待。父母太病弱、无力育幼，就会把孩子托给它。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Groups of POKENAME are responsible for bringing up many Water-Type Pokémon. They are tireless in their work, ensuring the young Pokémon are well cared for. Parents that are too sickly or frail to look after their offspring give them up to POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME住在黑暗海洞，避免冲突。一见光靠近，就用催眠术，悄悄逃进深处。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME lives in dark sea caves and avoids confrontation. If it sees an approaching light, it casts Hypnosis to escape unnoticed into the depths.

entry: POKENAME能活在足以压毁多数人造船的海洋深处。有秘密研究者想挖空身体，做成潜艇，却发现皮太硬，无法刺穿。
author: darkweavile428
source: POKENAME can survive at ocean depths that would destroy most man made vessels. Covert scientists have tried to hollow out the inside of POKENAME's body to use as a submarine, but its skin has proven too hard to pierce.

entry: POKENAME靠凶悍外貌和强壮肌肉，恐吓大得多的宝可梦，赶离喜爱的觅食地。可怕行为只是装样子，其实它更爱陪朋友在池塘溅水玩。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME relies on its brutish appearance and powerful muscles to intimidate much larger Pokémon, scaring them away from its preferred feeding grounds. Its fearsome behaviour is an act, and POKENAME enjoys simply splashing in ponds with friends.

entry: POKENAME泡泡破裂的力量，能把巨石碎成砾石。破后，空气里还会留着蜂蜜般的甜香。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's bubbles burst with enough force to reduce boulders to gravel. After popping, they leave a sweet, honey-like aroma lingering in the air.

entry: POKENAME住在海底，水样身体和岩石般外壳融入环境。壳由石头般硬的肌肉构成；想停，什么也挪不动，想走，什么也拦不住。
author: imaginita
source: POKENAME live at the bottom of the sea, where their watery bodies and rocky shells blend in. That shell is made of rock-hard muscle, so nothing can make it move if it wants to stay in place, or stop if it wants to travel.

entry: POKENAME盘住敌人，同时用嘴里螺旋催眠，再以尾拳猛敲。尾上的拳，能打裂混凝土。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME coils around foes, then simultaneously tries to entrance them with the spiral inside its mouth and bludgeons them with the fist on its tail. The punches delivered by its tail are powerful enough to crack concrete.

entry: POKENAME在水中旋转，制造强旋涡，吸来敌人，卷得站不住脚，再给予重击。
author: shyguy11011
source: While in water, POKENAME spins, creating a powerful vortex. It uses this motion to overwhelm its foes, drawing them in and sweeping them off their feet before striking with powerful blows.

entry: POKENAME不断练肌力，也彼此比力。它爱把栅栏拔出来锻炼，让牧场主很难圈住整群。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Individual POKENAME constantly work their muscles to build their strength and compete with one another in contests of strength. POKENAME herds can be difficult for ranchers to contain due to their habit of ripping fencing from the ground to exercise.

entry: POKENAME反复拳打基岩，穿过实心岩石，挖入山体根部。矿工得留意附近种群，因为挖掘震动，可能引起塌方。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME pummel their way through solid rock, striking bedrock repeatedly to break their way through the roots of mountains. Miners need to remain aware of local POKENAME populations, as the tremors from the Pokémon's digging can cause cave-ins.

entry: POKENAME蛇形身躯配强肢，险地也能自由行动，几乎甩不掉。它每隔几小时就得泡水，否则皮肤会干燥疼痛，能力也受限制。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is inescapable in even the most hazardous terrain since its serpentine body and powerful limbs give it unrestricted mobility. It must immerse itself in water every few hours or else its skin painfully dries out, limiting its abilities.

entry: 据说POKENAME是正义裁决者，会向在城都犯下严重暴行的作恶者施加神罚。拳头力量能打裂地面，挥动却留下美丽彩虹轨迹。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is said to be an arbiter of justice meant to dish out divine punishment on those who commit great atrocities in Johto. Its fists leave beautiful rainbow trails even as they swing with enough force to crack the ground.

entry: POKENAME常被视为水流的精灵，会把深入河中的训练家拉下水恶作剧。发怒喷出的水柱，打在对手身上，像拳头一样结实。
author: ultron_suprem3
source: Often believed to be spirits of river currents, POKENAME play pranks on Trainers who stray too deep into the river current, pulling them under. When angered, POKENAME blast spouts of water that feel as solid as a punch to their opponent.

entry: POKENAME花大量时间，为家族挖复杂洞网，河岸常能找到。肚皮比其他硬皮软，受袭必须蜷身保护。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME spend lots of time digging complex burrow networks for their family, and their tunnels are often found around riverbanks. Their bellies are softer than the rest of their hide, forcing them to curl up to protect themselves when attacked.

entry: POKENAME拼命保护森林家园，尤其防伐木者等人。它很灵巧，前肢力量足以掀翻卡车。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME fiercely protects the forests it calls home, especially from loggers and the like. It is quite nimble, and its front limbs pack enough force to knock over a truck.

entry: POKENAME在网上假扮失传催眠法的广告，令人困扰。更烦的是，它总让关闭按钮很难点。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are an inconvenience to people using the internet as they pose as an advertisement for a lost method of hypnosis. What makes POKENAME particularly frustrating is that they make clicking the close button difficult.

entry: POKENAME在网上假扮失传催眠法的广告，令人困扰。更烦的是，它总让关闭按钮很难点。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are an inconvenience to people using the internet as they pose as an advertisement for a lost method of hypnosis. What makes POKENAME particularly frustrating is that they make clicking the close button difficult.

entry: POKENAME精力过剩，在红树林沼泽上下树竞跑。巢受威胁便结队，协调使出泡沫光线，驱走入侵者。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are hyper-active Pokémon, racing one another up and down trees in mangrove swamps. They band together when they feel their nests are threatened, working together to drive intruders away with co-ordinated Bubble Beam attacks.

entry: POKENAME各占一棵沼泽树，大声呱叫，挑战所有敢靠近的宝可梦。谁争地盘，就会挨强力叶刃。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME lay claim to individual trees within swamps, bellowing out loud croaks to challenge any other Pokémon that dare come close. Pokémon that try to challenge them for their territory are struck with a powerful Leaf Blade.

entry: POKENAME花大量时间，为家族挖复杂洞网，河岸常能找到。它用黏液加固皮肤，硬化成厚实的保护鳞甲。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME spend lots of time digging complex burrow networks for their family, and their tunnels are often found around riverbanks. They reinforce their hide with a layer of mucus, letting it harden into thick protective scutes.

entry: 它肌肉极发达，不知疲倦，能整天挖过崎岖地面。爪若折断或崩口，再生、修复都各需约四天。
author: infinex21
source: Its muscles are remarkably developed and never tire, even as it spends its days digging through rough terrain. Its claws take around four days to regrow or to heal if they break or if they become chipped, respectively.

entry: POKENAME身体几乎全是肌肉，其他器官藏在颚下口袋。它大多练习以踢为主的武术，保护这个弱点。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME's body is almost entirely muscle with the rest of their organs stored in the pouch beneath their jaw. They spend most of their time training in kick-based martial arts in order to protect this weak spot.

entry: POKENAME打法在优雅身法与凶猛拳击间切换。每次闪避穿梭后，都会突然挥出毫不留情的拳头。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's combat style alternates between graceful movements and pugilistic aggressiveness. Every dodge and weave gets followed by sudden punches that hit without a shred of mercy.

entry: POKENAME肌肉天然存大量水，帮助调温，摔角等高强度运动时尤其重要。比赛若输，它就会羞愧地伪装藏身。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME's muscles naturally retain large amounts of water, helping it regulate body temperature. This ability is vital for when it engages in high-activity sports, such as wrestling. If it loses in a competition, it will camouflage out of shame.

entry: POKENAME的水形身体，从蚊香蝌蚪状石头里伸出。生气时，它在水里造石拳，痛打惹怒者。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's watery form extends out from within its Poliwag-shaped stone. If angered, it creates fists of stone from within the water with which it can pummel whatever made it angry.

entry: POKENAME把波导导入肌肉，增强力量、耐力。只要保持专注，就能展现不可思议的持久本领。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME channel aura through their muscles, enhancing both their strength and stamina. They are able to achieve incredible feats of endurance for as long as they maintain their focus.

entry: POKENAME看似滑稽，小身体却能轻松挥动巨拳，足见力量。一记百万吨重拳，能把隆隆岩打得穿过整座山。
author: sk372
source: It may look comical, but POKENAME being able to effortlessly move a massive fist while possessing a diminutive body is a testament to its strength. A Mega Punch from it could send a Golem straight through a mountain.

entry: POKENAME用双拳击碎大石，洗劫水生宝可梦藏着的洞。脸前螺纹则用来催眠其他宝可梦。
author: dukefrogpeasant
source: POKENAME have two fists, which they use to break large rocks. By destroying these rocks, they can raid the hidden burrows of underwater Pokémon. The spiral on the front of its face is used to hypnotize other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME白天大多在浅泉睡觉、懒躺。性子虽懒，泳技却好，有需要便游走，也常让小宝可梦替它采树果。
author: the_smirker
source: POKENAME spend most of the day sleeping and lounging in shallow springs. Despite their lazy nature, POKENAME are skilled swimmers, swimming away if necessary. Additionally, POKENAME tend to make smaller Pokémon gather berries on their behalf.

entry: POKENAME现身前，常先有多道旋涡围住光柱。它极罕见，唯有必须阻止破坏性最强的水属性宝可梦酿成无法挽回的损害，才会出现。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's appearance is heralded by the sudden appearance of multiple whirlpools surrounding a pillar of light. It is rarely seen, only appearing when it must stop the most destructive of Water-type Pokémon from causing irreparable damage.

entry: POKENAME肌肉强健，奋力守护河边巢穴。战斗先盘起弹簧尾，再猛然放开，用尾端重拳打敌。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME's muscular body allows it to fiercely guard its den near rivers. In battle, it coils its spring-like tail, then unleashes it with great force, striking foes with the heavy fist at its tip.

entry: POKENAME住清水，对污染者极具敌意。曾有船往它水里丢垃圾，便遭攻击、击沉。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME inhabits clean water and is extremely hostile towards polluters. It has been known to attack and sink boats after seeing garbage tossed from the ship into its waters.

entry: POKENAME拍合背上巨手，放出强劲气流，保护山区家园，把入侵者吹得滚落崖边。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME create powerful blasts of air by clapping the gigantic hands on their back together. They use these blasts to defend their mountain homes, sending intruders tumbling down the cliffside.

entry: POKENAME毛上薄黏液含致幻成分。战斗时它迅速抖毛，涂遍对手，让其以为它根本是另一种宝可梦。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME fur is slick with a fine layer of mucus laced with hallucinogenic compounds. They shake their fur rapidly when they engage in a fight, coating their opponent in the mucus and causing them to believe POKENAME is a different Pokémon entirely.

entry: 缎带状附肢弹性十足，让POKENAME能以音速挥拳。
author: melodydelune
source: The springy elasticity of its ribbon-like appendages allows POKENAME to throw punches at mach speeds.

entry: POKENAME能操控空间维度，压缩、拉伸身体，借此提升战技，让对手难命中。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are able to compress and stretch their bodies using their control over spatial dimensions. They use this power to improve their combat prowess, making themselves challenging targets to strike in battle.

entry: POKENAME拳头落地，会在土中掀起巨大水冲击，形成水池。许多大池湖泊，就是它们远古所造。它们也常住在自己造的湖底深处。
author: thesilverowls
source: POKENAME's fists create massive shockwaves of water in the ground where they land, creating pools. Many large ponds and lakes owe their existence to the works of POKENAME long ago. They often dwell deep beneath the lakes they create.

entry: POKENAME上方拳头与炮口间，连着大金属弹簧。拳一击中便抓住敌人，再往附近物件上猛摔。
author: .izik
source: A large metal spring connects POKENAME's upper fist to its cannon. When its fist strikes a foe, it seizes them before slamming them into nearby objects.

entry: POKENAME用晃眼的打法扰乱对手，也会产出能长成优雅白玫瑰的种子。
author: hophoppip
source: In battle, POKENAME disorients its opponents with a dizzying fighting style. It also produces seeds that grow into elegant white roses.

entry: POKENAME藏在假身体里，显得更威严。即使伪装被强行脱掉，也别低估它出拳的力量和凶猛。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME hides within a false body that allows it to look more imposing. Even if its disguise is forced off of it, one should not underestimate the strength and ferocity with which it can punch its foes.

entry: POKENAME深谙家务清洁，大多负责洗碗洗衣。也会用柔雾浇花园、高压喷流洗工具。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME has mastered the art of keeping houses clean. Most of their work revolves around cleaning dishes and clothes, but it also waters gardens with a gentle mist and cleans tools with pressurized blasts.

entry: 生活在湖边，喜爱游泳。周围漂浮着看似蛋的气泡，但这只是伪装，它们其实用于防御。
author: thefinalkalgonus
source: This fusion lives near lakes where it likes to swim. Around it float bubbles that resemble eggs, but this is a ruse, as they are used for defense.

entry: POKENAME是凶猛的水下猎手，用强尾、强腿游泳，再以雷电拳打倒其他水属性宝可梦。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME are aggressive underwater hunters, swimming with their powerful tails and legs and delivering thunder punches with their fists to take down other Water-type Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME四臂结实，双翼有力，想拿什么就尝试，通常也能成功。偶尔它还会把小宝可梦捞起，扔进水里取乐。
author: chinigan
source: Due to their four tough arms and powerful wings, POKENAME will attempt to take anything they want, usually succeeding. They occasionally scoop up and huck small Pokémon into bodies of water for entertainment.

entry: POKENAME以不知疲倦闻名。身体灵活、行动难测、变化随兴，是可怕的对手，来历仍不明。
author: the_smirker
source: POKENAME is known to never tire. Its body is built for unpredictability, flexibility and spontaneity, making it a fearsome opponent. Its origin remains unknown.

entry: POKENAME移动时，会让身体较大的部分旋转，以螺纹催眠敌人，再突然转向，连续打出迅捷上勾拳或大幅度的摆拳。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME rotate the larger section of their body as they move, hypnotizing foes with the spiraling pattern before suddenly turning another direction and hitting them with a rapid flurry of uppercuts or haymakers.

entry: POKENAME拳头虽大，力量却不强。它改用嘴喷水遮住敌人视线，再飞走。
author: equation8573
source: POKENAME does not have strong fists despite their size. Instead, POKENAME blinds the opposing Pokémon using water from its mouth, then flies away.

entry: POKENAME附在格斗属性宝可梦身上，吸收锻炼产生的静电。之后再释放，给伙伴肌肉充电，增强力量耐力。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME attach themselves to Fighting-type Pokémon, absorbing static electricity during their workouts. POKENAME release this energy later to charge the muscles of their partners with electrical energy, enhancing strength and stamina.

entry: POKENAME尖刺能高速旋转，像迷你钻头，几乎任何表面都能固定。它很固执，谁想移走，就会被强拳拍开。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME barbs can spin fast enough to act as miniature drills, allowing POKENAME to anchor themselves into nearly any surface. They are stubborn Pokémon and swat away anyone who attempts to remove them with their powerful fists.

entry: POKENAME把吸收的水煮沸，因此不断冒蒸汽，深受水疗馆和健身中心看重。
author: lazyarcanist
source: POKENAME constantly emits steam, as its body boils any water that it absorbs. As such, it is highly valued at spas and fitness centers.

entry: POKENAME以翼上催眠螺纹，让猎物迷惑失向。分心片刻，就够它俯冲进食。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME use the hypnotic spirals on their wings to disorient and confuse their prey, providing just enough distraction to allow them to swoop in and feed.

entry: POKENAME酷爱水之石，能囤多少就囤多少。许多想偷的寻宝者，最后都鼻青脸肿地回家。
author: petratheangel
source: POKENAME adores Water Stones and will hoard as many as it possibly can. Many would-be treasure hunters try to steal from this hoard only to be sent home beaten black and blue.

entry: POKENAME在河里捞浮垃圾，用厚黏液绑成整团，再操控废物，造出粗臂战斗。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME search for trash floating in rivers, scooping it together and using a thick layer of mucus to bind it into a single solid mass. They manipulate the discarded trash, creating thick arms to battle with.

entry: POKENAME住在严重污染的湖，收人类废物，在岸边筑巢。它很护家，谁想清理，就常遭毒水攻击。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME live in heavily polluted lakes, gathering human waste to build nests along the shore. They are protective of their homes, often attacking those who try to clean them up with streams of toxic water.

entry: POKENAME肌肉韧性极佳，能轻松游过大片海洋。不知疲倦的它，持续巡海岸，保护海洋，抵御陆上威胁。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME possesses incredibly resilient muscles that allow it to swim large stretches of ocean without issue. Since it is so tireless, it will constantly patrol coastlines in order to protect the sea from land-borne threats.

entry: POKENAME下水后，充棉身体变得致密沉重。它借重量，把猎物摔到海底，压住不放。
author: .izik
source: When submerged, POKENAME's cotton-filled body grows dense and heavy. It uses this weight to wrestle prey to the seafloor and pin them down.

entry: POKENAME好胜，会为食物互打。若一只吃掉别人的饭，受害者就拍打冒犯者的眼睛。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME are highly competitive and fight each other over food. If one eats another's meal, they slap the offender on the eye.

entry: POKENAME仿佛被迫不停训练，追求锻炼时总不见累。不过原生地区的螺旋菇圈，标出了它歇息、释放大量孢子的地方。
author: vic1312
source: Compelled to train relentlessly, POKENAME often seem tireless in their pursuit of exercise. However, in areas where POKENAME are native, spiraling rings of mushrooms mark places where they stop to relax, releasing large deposits of spores.

entry: POKENAME舌头能强力攻击。它还能跃出水面，高达50英尺，打敌人个措手不及。
author: hiroshima0042_23263
source: POKENAME is able to do powerful attacks with its tongue. POKENAME can leap out of water 50 feet high and does so to catch opponents off guard.

entry: POKENAME把手套裹上灼热蒸汽，把对手逼到极限。它大多时间在清澈河湖游泳。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME coats its gloves in a layer of scalding steam to push its opponents to their limits. It spends most of its time swimming in the clean waters of rivers and lakes.

entry: 捕食者闯入地下湖巢，POKENAME便放出强烈精神冲击，催其入睡，再拖到地表，远远扔走。
author: .izik
source: If a predator enters its underground lake den, POKENAME fires intense psychic blasts to induce sleep. It then drags the intruder to the surface and throws them away at great distances.

entry: POKENAME接连使出催眠术，阻挡靠近豆瓣菜丛的入侵者。对方睡着后，它会挖坑，埋进地下。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME releases bursts of Hypnosis to stop intruders near its favored watercress beds. It digs pits and buries victims underground while they sleep.

entry: POKENAME不停训练，想游遍全世界。一成功，额头便开始发光，获得运用精神力的本领。
author: darkweavile428
source: POKENAME trains tirelessly to be able to swim across the entire world. Once it manages this feat, its forehead begins to glow and it gains the ability to use psychic powers.

entry: POKENAME群占大湖，潜水监视敢来游泳的生物。谁激怒，它便追到筋疲力尽，再扔出湖。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME troops lay claim to large lakes, watching while submerged for anyone who dares to swim in their waters. They swim at those who rouse their anger, chasing their target to the point of exhaustion before tossing them out of the lake.

entry: POKENAME群占大湖，潜水监视敢来游泳的生物。谁激怒，它便追到筋疲力尽，再扔出湖。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME troops lay claim to large lakes, watching while submerged for anyone who dares to swim in their waters. They swim at those who rouse their anger, chasing their target to the point of exhaustion before tossing them out of the lake.

entry: POKENAME受到挑衅时，能不停地吐出滚烫的气泡洪流，连巨石也能化为粉尘。
author: mistershaokahn
source: When provoked, POKENAME is capable of spitting out a torrent of boiling bubbles without pause. These are able to reduce huge boulders to dust.

entry: POKENAME站得不稳，拳力却如棒球棒。若出击反弹、仰面落地，没人帮就很难起身。
author: chibitales
source: Despite being unsteady on their feet, POKENAME punch with the force of a baseball bat. Should they bounce back from the attack and land on their back, they struggle to get to their feet without assistance.

entry: POKENAME发现湖外猎物，就以泰山压顶冲上岸，再拖入水里，完成狩猎。
author: .izik
source: If POKENAME spots prey outside its lake, it launches itself ashore with a Body Slam. It then drags the target into the water to finish the hunt.

entry: 关都古文献中关于POKENAME的记录，暗示这或许是它过去的正常形态。它悠闲躺着，指挥忠心的蚊香蝌蚪、蚊香君办事。
author: sk372
