source: Records of POKENAME in ancient Kanto documents suggest this may have been POKENAME's normal form in the past. It lounges about, commanding loyal Poliwag and Poliwhirl to do its bidding.

entry: POKENAME用河泥做小罐，小心装满家乡河水。战斗以念力操水，把罐水当武器。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME craft small pots from river mud, carefully filling the pots with water from their home river. During battle, they wield the water from their pot as a weapon, controlling the liquid with their psionic powers.

entry: POKENAME控水能力强大，用不含杂质的水作战。它偏爱远攻，靠不知疲倦的意念操水，以强力水炮轰敌。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME wield powerful hydrokinetic powers, battling with water cleansed of all impurities. They prefer to fight from a distance, relying on their tireless mind to manipulate water and blast their foes with a powerful Hydro Pump.

entry: POKENAME爱坐在瀑布下磨炼耐力。无论战斗还是游泳，肌肉都从不疲倦。
author: elite01.
source: POKENAME prefer to train their endurance by sitting beneath a waterfall. Their muscles never grow tired from fighting or swimming.

entry: POKENAME爱炫肌肉，不放过任何机会。尤其爱展示胸肌，看着几乎能催眠。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME love to flex their muscles, so much so that they find every opportunity to do so. They especially love to flex their chest muscles, which have an almost hypnotic appearance.

entry: POKENAME肌肉未完全发育，会组织同群拳赛，练技巧、增力量。嘴里吹泡不仅战斗，也向别人传达情绪。
author: fiordaliso
source: Since POKENAME's muscles are not fully developed, it organizes boxing matches against other members of its group to become more skilled and stronger. It shoots bubbles from its mouth not only to fight, but also to communicate its feelings to others.

entry: POKENAME双臂发达得惊人，强到能游上峭壁瀑布。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME has incredibly well-developed arms, strong enough that it can swim up a cliffside waterfall.

entry: POKENAME靠强劲踢腿，游过温暖的热带海洋。它爱追快艇，有些度假村还养来供客人乘坐。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME swim through warm tropical oceans with powerful kicks. They like to chase speed boats, and some resorts even keep them for guests to ride.

entry: POKENAME头脑不足、蛮力有余，总挥打最近的东西，保持力量。大多数时候，挨拳的就是自己的尾巴。
author: sk372
source: Lacking in brains but excelling in brawn, POKENAME keeps itself strong by taking a swing at the nearest thing it can. In most cases, this results in it punching its own tail.

entry: POKENAME太骄傲，从不背身逃战，因此背壳没有疤痕划伤。它喜欢水战，才能把拳力全发挥。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is so proud that it never turns its back to flee from a fight, which is why the back of its shell bears no scars or scratches. It prefers to battle in water, where it can unleash the full power of its punches.

entry: POKENAME看似凶，见到别人第一反应却是演手偶戏逗乐。不过对方若不觉得有趣，它就把这当批评，愤怒动粗。
author: sk372
source: Though it appears aggressive, POKENAME's first instinct on meeting others is to entertain them with hand-puppet shows. Those that don't seem entertained earn its ire, however, and it reacts violently to this criticism.

entry: POKENAME胸前醒目的黑螺旋，藏着防冻液般的液体，让它在冰水生活，血液也不凝结。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The prominent black spiral on POKENAME's chest contains a liquid that functions as antifreeze, allowing POKENAME to live in freezing waters without risk of their blood congealing.

entry: POKENAME潜在雾水中，以幽灵般却强壮的手臂，把毫无防备的宝可梦和训练家拖进深处。昏迷前最后听见的，就是阴险笑声。
author: motion_09
source: POKENAME lurks in foggy waters, using its ghostly yet muscular arms to snatch unsuspecting Pokémon and Trainers into the depths. Its sinister laugh is the last thing they hear before falling unconscious.

entry: POKENAME腹纹从不静止，盯太久的人报告，仿佛意识正被吸进去。不过它胆小，会潜水躲人。
author: ghostslythe
source: The pattern on POKENAME's stomach never sits still, and those who gaze too long report feeling their consciousness being sucked in. This Pokémon is timid and dives away from human contact.

entry: POKENAME背着精神能量凝成的种子，白天冥想时收集。它能随意让物件浮起，但搬太重的，就得休息数小时恢复。
author: fiordaliso
source: On its back, POKENAME carries a seed made of psychic energy, which it gathers during sessions of daytime meditation. With its power, it can levitate objects at will, though moving those that are too heavy forces it to rest for many hours to recover.

entry: POKENAME没睡够，心灵感应便失灵。它改从触角放恶臭，驱赶捕食者和偷食者。
author: cinnamoncreampuff
source: When POKENAME hasn't had enough rest, its telepathic powers fail to function. In response, it releases a foul stench from its antenna to drive away predators or food thieves.

entry: POKENAME白天大多安静歇在发电厂附近。受惊就闪光瞬移，让太靠近者暂时看不见。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME spends most of the day peacefully resting near power plants. When startled, it teleports away with a bright flash, temporarily blinding anyone too close.

entry: POKENAME集体才智相当于二十岁的人类，用来躲训练家。它看出对方在道路上的移动规律，再瞬移到更僻静处。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have the collective acuity of a twenty-year-old person and use this wisdom to hide themselves from Trainers. They detect patterns in how Trainers move through a route and teleport to more secluded locations.

entry: POKENAME穿戴胡地骨骼时，残留精神能量让本领更强。不过同样的能量，也让它睡不如从前安稳。
author: sk372
source: When wearing the bones of Alakazam, POKENAME exhibits stronger abilities due to lingering psychic energy in the skeleton. The same energy causes POKENAME to no longer sleep as soundly as it once could.

entry: POKENAME藏在复杂视错觉后。对手盯太久，就会被根本不存在的藤蔓缠住、绊倒。
author: mogorian_gray
source: POKENAME hides its body behind a complex optical illusion. If an opponent stares for too long, they will get tangled up and trip over vines that aren't really there.

entry: POKENAME在树果农场很受欢迎，会在花间瞬移，沿途授粉。不过耗能大，因此一天大多都在睡。
author: afilthycasual
source: A welcome sight in berry farms, POKENAME teleports from flower to flower, pollinating them as it goes. This uses quite a bit of energy, causing this Pokémon to sleep for most of the day.

entry: 它白天大多诡异地静止，休息遭袭也不还手。可惜头状突起若重创，便永远失去再生身体部位的能力。
author: bobosmith01
source: It remains eerily still throughout most of the day, and will not fight back against anything that attacks while it rests. Unfortunately, if the head-like protrusion suffers critical damage, it loses its ability to regenerate its body parts forever.

entry: POKENAME睡着会不顾一切向前冲，直到醒来才停。快撞东西，就靠念力瞬移越过障碍，再继续冲。
author: soup1900
source: When asleep, POKENAME will recklessly charge forward in a direction and not stop until it wakes up. If it is ever about to crash, it uses its telekinesis to teleport ahead of the roadblock and continue charging.

entry: POKENAME一感知危险便瞬移，不过距离很少超过一个身长。短距离连续瞬移太多，很快耗尽精力，最后睡着。
author: pjporwoll
source: As soon as POKENAME senses danger, it teleports, but the distance of the teleport is rarely more than a body-length further. This leads it to quickly expending its energy with many short-distance teleports, causing it to fall asleep.

entry: POKENAME年幼，庞大精神力与怒气让它很疲惫，白天大多睡觉。宝可梦巡护员会主动寻找野生个体，让它安睡舒适，免得噩梦中胡乱攻击。
author: pjporwoll
source: Due to its immense mental power and anger tiring this young Pokémon out, POKENAME sleeps most of the day. Rangers seek out wild POKENAME to keep them sleeping and comfortable, lest they get nightmares and lash out in their sleep.

entry: POKENAME拿着三种元素进化石，不知道选哪种，只等训练家替它决定。
author: dodoowner_
source: An POKENAME holds three elemental evolution stones, not knowing which to choose. It waits around for its Trainer to choose one for it.

entry: POKENAME瞬移到少人访问的网站，偷偷进食。若被发现，它会先吞足存储数据，再立刻消失。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME teleports to low-traffic websites where it can feed unnoticed. If observed, it instantly vanishes after gorging itself on stored data.

entry: POKENAME能把自己转成数字数据，自由穿行网络空间。睡眠一受打扰，就靠这本领逃走。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME can convert itself into digital data, enabling it to freely travel through cyberspace. It uses this ability to flee whenever its sleep is disturbed.

entry: POKENAME会读心，知道对方是否曾做、或正打算在网上作恶。一发现，就把那人瞬移到远离一切电子设备和信号的地方。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME can read the thoughts of others and discover if they have or are planning to do malicious actions on the internet. If it finds out they have or are, it uses its teleportation to teleport them far away from any electronic device or signal.

entry: 它始终睡着，飞行也不例外。精神能量让它轻松穿过天空。
author: kam_doodle_snek
source: It is always asleep, even in flight. Psychic energy allows it to maneuver through the sky with ease.

entry: POKENAME蜕皮后皮软，容易受伤。察觉危险，先朝威胁喷龙息，再瞬移逃走。有好几个人报告，它曾突然传进自己家。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME's skin is soft after it molts, making it vulnerable to attack. When it senses danger, it will release a Dragon Breath towards the danger before teleporting away. Multiple people have reported POKENAME teleporting into their homes.

entry: POKENAME睡在精神能量球上，防止受伤。为了安睡不被打扰，它还会把自己隐形。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME sleeps atop a ball of psychic energy, which protects it from harm. It makes itself invisible so it can sleep without being disturbed.

entry: POKENAME喜欢用头上勺子，替训练家搅饮料，随时愿意帮厨。颈间小凸起分泌甜树液，能增添茶、咖啡等含咖啡因饮料的风味。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME enjoys mixing its Trainer's drinks with the spoon on its head, as it is always ready to help out in the kitchen. The small bumps around its neck secrete a sugary sap that enhances the flavor of caffeinated drinks like tea or coffee.

entry: POKENAME既会瞬移，也能飞，移动起来很奇怪。它常迷糊地四处绕，又折回原路。
author: holgast
source: Because it can both teleport and fly, an POKENAME on the move is an odd sight. It will often meander and backtrack in confusion.

entry: POKENAME睡着察觉猎物接近，就张嘴，瞬移到对方前进的路上。吃饱后，再回原位继续睡。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: If an POKENAME senses prey approaching while it's asleep, it will open its jaws and teleport into the path of the prey. Once saitsfied with its meal, it teleports back to its original position and falls back asleep.

entry: POKENAME内脏能跟踪行星自转，每天恰好睡18小时，因此比其他凯西融合体更快掌握精神能力。
author: darkweavile428
source: Thanks to its internal organ that tracks the planet's rotation, POKENAME is able to sleep for exactly 18 hours every day. This allows it to master its psychic powers faster then other Abra fusions.

entry: POKENAME白天大多睡觉，却与亲手织的网保持精神联系。一感到猎物被困，便迅速瞬移过去吃掉，好继续睡。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME sleeps for a majority of the day, but maintains a psychic link with any web it has spun. When it senses prey getting caught, it quickly teleports to the web to consume them so it can resume sleeping.

entry: 飞行中听见雷声，POKENAME就用精神力瞬移回巢。休息时，大翅覆头，确保睡得深。
author: fiordaliso
source: When it hears thunder while flying, it teleports back to its nest using its psychic powers. POKENAME covers its head with its wide wings while resting to ensure a deep sleep.

entry: POKENAME白天大多睡觉，磨炼精神能力，也保存电能。若被叫醒，就爆出能量，再瞬移逃走。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME spend most of their days sleeping to try and hone both their psychic abilities and to retain their electrical energies. If they are awakened, they release bursts of energy and teleport away.

entry: POKENAME每次瞬移，都会留下淡淡星尘。价值虽不如普通星尘，有人仍收集来，装饰闪亮配件。
author: sk372
source: Whenever POKENAME teleports, it leaves a faint scattering of stardust behind. Though it lacks the value of normal stardust, some collect it and use it as a glittering decoration for their accessories.

entry: POKENAME睡着会在物体表面弹跳。它用天真嗓音唱歌，同时施展精神力，打敌人个措手不及。
author: pixlhoopa
source: POKENAME bounces off surfaces in its sleep. It uses its psychic power by singing in an innocent tone to catch foes off guard.

entry: 训练家常发现POKENAME睡在树上，但它始终警觉地留意周围。
author: serversizeme
source: Trainers often find POKENAME sleeping in trees. However, it is always keeping a watchful eye on its surroundings.

entry: POKENAME四只成群，每位成员都为全群多提供一份感知。受扰通常一起瞬移；若没法逃，就以惊人速度撞敌。
author: sondededoo
source: POKENAME travel in herds of four, with each member providing an additional layer of awareness for the group. When disturbed they will usually teleport away together, but when that is not an option, they will ram into their foes with incredible speed.

entry: POKENAME在风暴中四处瞬移，每次出现就放强烈信标光，令附近船只困惑。
author: ztetriminos
source: POKENAME teleports around during storms, confusing nearby vessels by emitting an intense beacon light as soon as it appears.

entry: POKENAME只有觉得安全安心，才肯跳舞。因此，唯有最温柔耐心的训练家，能看见这胆小宝可梦起舞。
author: honestly_vitali
source: POKENAME only dance when they feel safe and secure. Only the most gentle and patient Trainers will see this timid Pokémon dance.

entry: POKENAME悬浮只需少量精神力，因此很少触地。强风时，它用精神能量把自己固定，防止吹走。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME rarely touch the ground as they can levitate without exerting much psychic energy. When there are strong winds, POKENAME lock themselves in place with psychic energy to prevent themselves from being blown away.

entry: POKENAME瞬移避险前，会磨动利门牙，保持专注。它只在黎明前不久外出找食，其余时候都睡觉。
author: fiordaliso
source: Before teleporting to safety, it grinds its sharp incisors together to maintain focus. POKENAME moves to search for food only shortly before dawn, then sleeps for the rest of the day.

entry: POKENAME身体其余部分静止休眠，几乎所有事都交给分离的手臂。掌心甚至能放出精神冲击。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME uses its detached arm to do basically everything as the rest of its body lies there dormant. It can even fire psionic blasts from the palm of its hand.

entry: POKENAME能看见数秒后的未来，预判敌人动作。加上闪电般的速度，POKENAME几乎什么招式都能躲开。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME can see a few seconds into the future, allowing it to predict its opponent's moves. Alongside its lightning-quick speed, POKENAME is able to dodge almost any attack.

entry: 不知为何，多数性能强大的相机都拍不清POKENAME。即使静睡，照片也总模糊。只有西尔佛公司开发的特制相机，成功拍下真容。
author: bobosmith01
source: For some reason, most poweful cameras cannot properly capture POKENAME's form; it always shows up as a blur on the image, even when it is sleeping still. Only specialized cameras developed by Silph Co. have managed to capture POKENAME's visage.

entry: 不知为何，多数性能强大的相机都拍不清POKENAME。即使静睡，照片也总模糊。只有西尔佛公司开发的特制相机，成功拍下真容。
author: bobosmith01
source: For some reason, most powerful cameras cannot properly capture POKENAME's form: it always shows up as a blur on the image, even when it is sleeping still. Only specialized cameras developed by Silph Co. have managed to capture POKENAME's visage.

entry: POKENAME恍惚漂过湿地，对四周浑然不知。受惊就短程瞬移进水。精神波能安抚附近宝可梦，因此深受混乱环境里的居民喜爱。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME drifts through wetlands in a trance-like state, unaware of its surroundings. If startled, it teleports a short distance into water. Its psychic waves soothe nearby Pokémon, making it a favourite among those who live in chaotic habitats.

entry: POKENAME每天睡近十八小时。打盹时，头上红宝石仍在活动，用潜意识精神力，让小小发光物悬在周围，透过空气感知将近的危险。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME spend nearly eighteen hours a day asleep. Even while dozing, the red gem on their heads remains active, using subconscious psychic power to levitate small glowing objects around them and sense approaching danger through the air.

entry: POKENAME睡觉时，球茎吸阳光，为精神力供能。不过瞬移逃离捕食者后，球茎会明显下垂、略微萎蔫。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's bulb absorbs sunlight while it sleeps, powering its psychic abilities. After it teleports away to avoid predators, the bulb noticeably sags and wilts slightly.

entry: POKENAME从一个垃圾箱瞬移到另一个，吃到受惊才逃。几乎没办法让它远离人家的垃圾。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME will teleport from dumpster to dumpster, feeding on trash until they get startled and teleport away. There is practically no way to keep these Pokémon out of a person's garbage.

entry: POKENAME每天最多睡18小时。休息时，尾巴仍高度警戒，观察一切危险。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME sleeps up to 18 hours per day. While it rests, its tail stays on high alert, watching for any dangers.

entry: 蜂蜜香是少数能让POKENAME醒来、走出藏处的东西之一。只闻一缕，它就会弹起，瞬移到甜味源头。
author: sk372
source: One of the only things that will make POKENAME awaken and come out of hiding is the scent of honey. Catching just a whiff makes it spring awake and teleport to the source of the sweet smell.

entry: POKENAME整个白天睡觉，吸太阳能，温度逐渐升到日落。夜里才慢吞吞找食，遇捕食者便放出一阵灼热气息，瞬移逃走。
author: notadoctor75
source: POKENAME sleeps during the entire day, absorbing energy from the sun and gradually growing hotter until sunset. When night falls, it lethargically seeks food, teleporting away from any predators it senses with a blast of blazing heat.

entry: 露营者醒来，常发现睡袋上放着梦境邮件。这是POKENAME送来的发光信，专给睡得深沉安稳的人。
author: jaminmcready
source: Campers often wake to find Dream Mail resting on their sleeping bags. This is the work of POKENAME, who delivers these glowing letters to those who fall into deep, peaceful sleep.

entry: POKENAME从不睁眼，却能感知、分辨颜色。它用勺采树果、泥土等材料，制作颜料。
author: cait_sith
source: Despite never opening its eyes, POKENAME can sense and differentiate colors. It uses its spoon to gather berries, mud, and other materials to make into paint.

entry: POKENAME冥想时产生电弧，练习把能量导成更强形态。微妙平衡受扰，它就先向地面放雷，再瞬移离开。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME produces an arc of electricity while meditating to practice channeling this energy into a more potent form. If disturbed in this delicate equilibrium, it sends a bolt of lightning into the ground before teleporting away.

entry: 它睡着，尾巴仍像节拍器来回摆，也能操控精神力与电，是个难缠对手。
author: infinex21
source: Even while asleep, its tail ticks side to side like a metronome. It can still wield and direct its psychic abilities and electricity while asleep, making it a difficult foe.

entry: POKENAME很少久留，仿佛在世界中稍纵即逝。一发现被看见，就瞬移到另一时间线或地点。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME is an ephemeral presence in the Pokémon world because it rarely remains in one place for long. Whenever it realizes it has been spotted, it teleports away to another timeline or location.

entry: POKENAME用精神力，把泥塑成砖，衬在洞壁。察觉危险，就瞬移回洞。
author: justin_general
source: POKENAME uses psychic powers to form mud into bricks that it uses to line the walls of its burrow. It will teleport to its burrow if it senses danger.

entry: 它每天在树上睡18小时，靠湿度与精神感知，预测次日天气。
author: lydiaprower8
source: It spends 18 hours a day sleeping in trees. It uses humidity and its psychic sense to predict the next day's weather.

entry: POKENAME迅速瞬移到猎物前进的路线，逼到无处可逃。狩猎时通常全程睡着，因此猎物唯一逃生机会，就是把它叫醒。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME rapidly teleports in front of the path of prey in order to back them into an inescapable corner. It is usually asleep throughout the whole hunt, so the only chance the prey has in fleeing POKENAME is to wake it up.

entry: POKENAME每天跑超过二十小时，甚至边睡边跑。它能察觉训练家，用恰当的烟幕巧妙避开注意。
author: ghostslythe
source: POKENAME runs for over twenty hours a day, and even has the ability to run while sleeping. It senses when Trainers are around and is adept at dodging their attention with well-placed Smokescreens.

entry: POKENAME十分贪玩，先装作四足行走，再突然直立、飘起来，吓唬猎人和登山者。
author: patch_bros
source: POKENAME is quite the playful creature. It pretends to walk on all fours and then float while on its hind legs to scare hunters and hikers.

entry: POKENAME害羞，一焦虑就会瞬移逃走。因此训练家若在野外遇见，就代表它觉得在对方身边安全自在。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are shy creatures and are known to teleport away if they get anxious. If a Trainer meets one in the wild, that means that the POKENAME feels safe and comfortable around that Trainer.

entry: POKENAME让自造的毒液悬空，练习超能力。可常常练着练着睡着，忘了自己练到哪一步。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME practice their psychic powers by levitating the poison they create. Unfortunately, they often fall asleep during their training, causing them to lose track of where they were at in their progress.

entry: POKENAME睡得极沉，表皮会配合周围变色，伪装自己。不过清醒、又不在战斗时，很难改变颜色。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is a heavy sleeper; while sleeping, its epidermis changes color to match whatever is around it in order to camouflage itself. When awake, however, it struggles to change color if outside of battle.

entry: POKENAME很顽皮，常突然叫一声吓人，再迅速瞬移。最后消失的是楔石，抓住它，就能让本体停下。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are quite mischievous, often letting out a cry to spook people before abruptly teleporting. The last part that vanishes is the keystone; grabbing it stops POKENAME in their tracks.

entry: POKENAME能预知厄运何时降临。许多训练家想问未来，可没等回答，它就瞬移走了。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME is able to predict when misfortune will strike. Many Trainers attempt to ask it for predictions of the future, but it teleports away before any answers are given.

entry: POKENAME每天最多睡18小时。精神力会提醒附近有人遇险，它就瞬移到旁，再带去安全处，全程从不醒来。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME sleeps for up to 18 hours a day. Its psychic powers alert it to people in danger nearby, teleporting near them and then whisking them away to safety, all without ever waking from its lengthy naps.

entry: POKENAME表情严肃，让有些训练家不舒服。它在墓室、墓地冥想，与亡者建立感应，增强精神力。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME has an austere expression that can be off-putting for some Trainers. It meditates in crypts or graveyards to attune itself to the dead and improve its psychic powers.

entry: 水手经过POKENAME栖地，应格外小心。它本身不暴力，但若受威胁瞬移，巨躯再现的地方，就可能遭殃。
author: sk372
source: Sailors are advised to tread carefully in areas known to be POKENAME habitats. Though the creature itself is nonviolent, should it sense a threat and teleport away, its sheer size would cause havoc wherever it reappears.

entry: POKENAME白天大多睡，大耳却让它一直警觉。耳朵几乎追着每种声音转动，十分可爱，因此年轻训练家很欢迎。
author: vic1312
source: Despite sleeping for a great deal of the day, POKENAME are always alert thanks to their large ears. They are popular with young Trainers, as people tend to find the way their ears swivel towards nearly every sound they hear quite adorable.

entry: POKENAME每天睡18小时，梦里一直战斗，因此真对战时，常分不清梦与现实。
author: erod0467
source: POKENAME sleeps for 18 hours a day. They constantly dream of battle, making it hard for them to distinguish sleep from reality during an actual Pokémon battle.

entry: POKENAME白天大多睡，靠精神力被动感知领地威胁。受扰就瞬移到入侵者背后，用毒角刺扎。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME spend most of their day sleeping, relying on their psychic powers to passively sense any threats approaching their territory. If disturbed, they teleport behind the intruder and jab at them with their venomous horns.

entry: POKENAME睡着会把梦化成幻象，投向周围，让栖居的森林变得极其危险。
author: .realthree
source: When POKENAME sleeps, its dreams are projected onto its surroundings as an illusion. This can make the forests where it lives extremely treacherous.

entry: POKENAME每天最多睡18小时。打盹时会用缎带状触角缠住信赖的对象。
author: melodydelune
source: Sleeping for up to 18 hours a day, POKENAME will cling onto those they trust with their ribbon-like feelers as they snooze.

entry: POKENAME个头大，使用瞬间移动得耗大半精神能量。不过身体力量能弥补，尾巴挥动极有力。
author: equation8573
source: POKENAME uses most of its psychic energy to use Teleport because of its large size. This is made up for in terms of physical power, as it can swing its tail with tremendous force.

entry: POKENAME饮食仍在研究，不过多数专家同意，它能以某种方式，从附近金属和岩石中获得能量。有人怀疑，这就是常带勺子的原因。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's diet is still being studied, but most experts agree it somehow gets energy from nearby metals and rocks. Some suspect this is why POKENAME often carries its spoon.

entry: POKENAME胆小，喜欢独处，每天睡18小时，用大耳朵遮阳。
author: tqz7
source: POKENAME are a timid Pokémon that prefers to be left alone. It sleeps 18 hours a day, using its large ears for shade.

entry: 它睡觉时，头会脱离身体，四处漂浮，仔细聆听靠近的声音。
author: hophoppip
source: While it sleeps, its head detaches from its body and floats around, listening closely for any approaching sounds.

entry: POKENAME造出三颗浮游火球自卫。若三颗全用完，敌人仍没被打倒或吓退，就瞬移逃走。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME defends itself by creating a trio of floating orbs of fire. If an opponent is not defeated or deterred once all three are used, it retreats by teleporting away.

entry: POKENAME常因呼噜声而被找到。训练家听见它睡觉，自己也常放松下来。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME can often be found due to its snoring. When heard sleeping, Trainers often find themselves feeling relaxed.

entry: POKENAME始终睡着，却靠精神力完整感知四周。传说，它只会为纯心训练家实现愿望而醒来。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Despite being constantly asleep, POKENAME is still fully aware of its surroundings, using its psychic power to sense everything around it. Legends claim that POKENAME will only awaken to grant the wish of a pure-hearted Trainer.

entry: POKENAME钻进草地下深处，安静休息。塌方一威胁，就瞬移地表，再重新挖下去。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME burrows deep beneath meadows to rest undisturbed. If a cave-in threatens, it teleports to the surface before digging down again.

entry: 它睡得太多，难得见醒着。即使对战，也可能只出一招就睡，得让训练家再叫醒。
author: .jerden
source: It sleeps so often that it is rarely seen awake. Even in battle, it may doze off after making a single move and needs its Trainer to wake it up again.

entry: POKENAME让星形尾尖明亮发光，分散其他宝可梦注意，同时聚精神能量，瞬移逃走。能力用过头，就得连睡数日恢复。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME makes the star on its tail shine brightly to distract other Pokémon while it gathers psychic energy to teleport away and escape. Whenever it uses its powers too much, it needs to sleep for days to recover its strength.

entry: POKENAME爱唱歌，可听过美妙歌声的人很少。它一发现有观众，就瞬移走。
author: mistycloud
source: Although POKENAME loves singing, few have heard its beautiful song. As soon as it realizes it has an audience, POKENAME teleports away.

entry: 野生POKENAME天性胆小，深挖山洞，独居在自己凿出的通道。身上铁甲由挖到的矿石锻成，是坚固防护。
author: theartemis1
source: Skittish by nature, wild POKENAME burrow deep into mountain caves, seeking solitude in the tunnels they carve. The iron plating on their bodies is forged from ore extracted during these excavations, serving as durable protection.

entry: POKENAME常睡着走下高崖。人们相信，它梦里正飞往远方。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME often walks off high cliffs in their sleep. It's believed they dream about flying to faraway places.

entry: POKENAME脆弱又难寻，对声音和精神能量都格外敏感。一发现被看见，就会瞬移。
author: pastapockets
source: POKENAME is as elusive as it is fragile. It's particularly sensitive to both sound and psychic energy. The moment POKENAME realizes it's been spotted, it teleports away.

entry: POKENAME体内多余电力，让细胞结构不稳定，因此瞬移不规律、无法控制，也就格外难捕。
author: bradlybro199
source: POKENAME is extra difficult to capture due to its sporadic and uncontrollable teleportation. This occurs because the excess electricity in its body makes its cell structure unstable.

entry: POKENAME在树皮刻痕，标记领地。每只刻的高度都固定，有时还会从一树瞬移到另一树，检查是否有敌手标记。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME mark out their territory by leaving cuts in the bark of trees. Each POKENAME consistently marks their trees at the same height, and they can sometimes be seen teleporting from tree to tree in their territory to check for marks from rivals.

entry: POKENAME先用超能力引来猎物，再放电攻击。若引来的宝可梦太大，就会装成沙子躲起来。
author: pokebio
source: POKENAME lures prey with its psychic powers, then zaps it. If the lured Pokémon is too big, it pretends to be sand to hide.

entry: POKENAME用精神力，把将被丢掉的点心瞬移过来。之后找舒适处开吃，最好还要用勺。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME use their psychic abilities to teleport to them treats that are going to be tossed out. After doing so, POKENAME find a comfortable spot and will eat what they gathered, preferably with spoons.

entry: 至今没有野生POKENAME被拍到照片。听觉极敏感，人或无人机还没靠到能拍，它就瞬移走。
author: hophoppip
source: To this day, a wild POKENAME has never been photographed. POKENAME has highly sensitive hearing, and teleports away before any person or drone can get close enough to snap a picture.

entry: POKENAME漂在云间，几乎总睡着。它无意识地释放气场，把潜在敌人也哄得陪自己睡。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME float among the clouds, almost always in a state of sleep. They subconsciously project an aura around them, putting any would-be foes to sleep alongside POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME漂在云间，几乎总睡着。它无意识地释放气场，把潜在敌人也哄得陪自己睡。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME float among the clouds, almost always in a state of sleep. They subconsciously project an aura around them, putting any would-be foes to sleep alongside POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME一边睡一边游，头部突起是强精神感应器。察觉附近危险，就瞬移到更安全的海域。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME spends much of its time swimming while simultaneously sleeping. The protrusion on its head is a powerful psychic sensor, letting it sense danger in the area and teleport to a safer part of the sea.

entry: POKENAME蘑菇的孢子能哄宝可梦睡。它自己也不免疫，却会像梦游般蹒跚行动，为真菌找食物。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's mushrooms produce spores that lull Pokémon to sleep. POKENAME is not immune to their effect, but shambles around as if sleepwalking, searching for food for the fungus.

entry: POKENAME睡着也能以心灵感应察觉敌人。发现附近有谁，就瞬移到极远处。有些超能力者把捕获它视为成长试炼。
author: bobosmith01
source: It can telepathically detect foes even while sleeping. If it detects anyone nearby, it teleports far, far away. Trying to catch POKENAME is seen as a rite of passage among some Psychics.

entry: POKENAME头刺里的感官，会提醒附近有其他生物。即使白天大多睡着，也能知道危险接近，瞬移避险。
author: sk372
source: Sensory organs within the spines on POKENAME's head alert it to the presence of others nearby. This lets it know when danger approaches and teleports to safety, even as it sleeps most of the day away.

entry: POKENAME体毛对周围极敏感，连最轻微变化也能发现。它讨厌被摸，谁靠近，就瞬移逃走。
author: mistymagius
source: The hair on POKENAME's body is incredibly sensitive to its surroundings, detecting the slightest changes in its environment. It hates being touched and will teleport away if anyone approaches it.

entry: POKENAME夜里聚在路灯边，不停探查威胁。察觉谁来，就会瞬移，只留一团毒粉。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME congregate around lampposts at night, constantly scanning their surroundings for threats. If they sense anyone approaching, they teleport away, leaving a cloud of toxic dust behind.

entry: 夜里，POKENAME会瞬移到野外特别地点看星空，兴奋得发光，热切期待有什么有趣的事发生。
author: quackquackattack
source: At night, POKENAME teleport to a special location in the wild to gaze upon the starry night sky. They glow with eager excitement as they watch the sky waiting for something exciting to happen.

entry: POKENAME被硬岩挡路，可能随机瞬移到地下某处。若出现在阳光下，就会惊慌，释放传播恐惧的精神波。
author: .izik
source: When blocked by solid rock, POKENAME may teleport to a random underground location. If it appears in sunlight, it panics and emits psychic waves that spread fear.

entry: POKENAME狡猾，滥用瞬移偷硬币。被抓到后，就带着囤币远远逃走，免得被训。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are sly creatures that abuse their teleporting powers to steal coins. When they are inevitably caught, they teleport far away with their hoard of coins to avoid getting lectured.

entry: POKENAME在森林四处瞬移，精神波让附近严重偏头痛。不过它一消失，头痛便缓解。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME teleports around forests, emitting psychic waves that cause intense migraines. The moment it disappears, the headaches subside.

entry: POKENAME每次瞬移到新地点，都会爆发精神能量，让附近头痛，直到它再换地方。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME release a burst of psychic energy each time they arrive at a new location through teleportation. This energy causes headaches in the vicinity until they warp somewhere else.

entry: POKENAME懒到学会瞬移，玩抛接也不用跑。它比别的宝可梦迟缓、少动，很适合行动能力有限的人饲养。
author: laughing_dan
source: POKENAME are so lazy that they learn to teleport so they don't have to run while playing fetch. POKENAME are often sluggish and less active than other Pokémon, making them a good pet for people with limited physical ability.

entry: 融合后，POKENAME的精神力已发挥到极致。它不必再瞬移避险，连睡着也能用精神力反击。
author: sk372
source: After fusion, POKENAME's psychic powers have reached their maximum potential. It no longer needs to teleport away to safety, as it can psychically strike back against others even while it sleeps.

entry: POKENAME每天要睡18小时，会无意识地收集附近落毛，做舒适床铺。睡时第三眼睁开，提防潜在危险。
author: _pixelar_
source: POKENAME subconsciously uses its psychic powers to gather shed fur from its surroundings and make itself a comfortable bed, as it needs to sleep for 18 hours a day. Its third eye opens while it sleeps to look out for any potential danger.

entry: POKENAME睡前把脚扎进地下，补充身体水分。想睡时察觉攻击，就直接瞬移逃走。
author: darkweavile428
source: POKENAME plants its feet underground before it goes to sleep so that it can replenish the water in its body. If POKENAME senses an incoming attack while its trying to sleep, it simply teleports away.

entry: POKENAME大多时间在壳里睡。睡得极深，甚至能安全潜水睡数日，再上来呼吸。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME spends most of its time sleeping inside its shell. In fact, its body sleeps so deeply that it can safely spend several days sleeping underwater before coming up to breathe.

entry: POKENAME操控土石，慢慢把几块岩石塑成拳头使用。过程持续不断，连睡觉也不停止。
author: fireflower20002
source: POKENAME uses geokinesis to slowly form several rocks into fists for it to wield. This process is constant and even happens while POKENAME sleeps.

entry: POKENAME无忧无虑地小跑，有危险就能瞬移到约一英里外。头上的勺状角，察觉食物或朋友，便会向上弯。
author: reflecbeat
source: POKENAME trots around without a care in the world because if it meets any danger, it can teleport about a mile away. The spoon-like horn on its head bends upward if it detects food or friends.

entry: POKENAME一睡几个小时，不过察觉威胁，就会高速跑开。它连睡着也能跑，靠精神力躲过树和岩石。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME sleeps for hours at a time, but if it senses a threat, it will run away at high speeds. It can even run in slumber, using its psychic abilities to dodge rocks and trees.

entry: POKENAME大多时间在壳里睡。为了练习正在发展的精神力，会同时操控几颗自己产的脆泡，不让它们破。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME spends most of its time sleeping inside its shell. To practice its developing psychic powers, POKENAME will telekinetically move around several fragile, self-produced bubbles without popping them.

entry: POKENAME并不是靠漂浮移动，而用磁铁装置跟随磁场。不过它更偏爱瞬移，哪怕距离极短。
author: beatdoof
source: POKENAME does not actually move by floating; rather, it moves by using its magnet units to follow the magnetic field. Despite this, it prefers teleporting around, even if the distance is minuscule.

entry: POKENAME会干扰电子设备，隐藏自己。执着训练家即使克服技术故障找到它，也阻止不了瞬移逃走。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are capable of tampering with electronics to obscure their presence. Even if a persistent Trainer manages to locate them despite the technical difficulties, this does nothing to prevent them from teleporting away.

entry: POKENAME两个头轮班睡觉，每次各睡12小时。这样始终察觉四周，便知道何时该瞬移，避开来袭危险。
author: sk372
source: The two heads sleep in shifts, each one slumbering for 12 hours at a time. This allows POKENAME to always be aware of its surroundings so it knows when to teleport away from incoming danger.

entry: POKENAME两个头轮流睡，每次最多12小时。危险靠近，先用强腿跃空，再瞬移，确保逃到安全处。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's two heads take turns sleeping for up to 12 hours at a time. If it senses danger approaching, it uses its strong legs to leap into the air out of danger, before teleporting away to ensure it escapes to safety.

entry: POKENAME即使正在岩中挖隧道，也很容易被别人吓到。许多洞穴系统因此有未完工的通道，都是它受惊瞬移留下的。
author: sk372
source: Even while tunneling through rock, POKENAME can be easily startled by the presence of others. Many cave systems have unfinished tunnels due to POKENAME teleporting away after getting scared.

entry: 据说POKENAME能以实体进入人的梦。推测来自训练家一睡，它就会消失，不过究竟去了哪里，无法证明。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are said to be able to physically enter people's dreams. This theory stems from the fact that these Pokémon will disappear once their trainers fall asleep, though where exactly they go cannot be proven.

entry: POKENAME收集海滩上丢弃的勺子等物，练习念力。彼此觊觎收藏，有时也会打起来。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME gathers spoons and similar objects littered across beaches to practice its telekinesis with. Battles are occasionally waged between them as they covet one another's trinkets.

entry: POKENAME胡须像植物，阳光、养分和水得宜，就长得快。目击者称，它使藤鞭时，用的是胡须而非藤蔓。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME's mustache grows similarly to a plant, growing quicker when given proper sunlight, nutrients, and water. Witnesses report seeing it use its mustache instead of vines while using Vine Whip.

entry: POKENAME吃电刺激大脑，增进才智。不过吸太多太快，会爆出精神能量，让自己和附近生物都昏倒。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME feeds on electricity to stimulate its brain and increase its intellect further. Absorbing too much too quickly causes it to explode with psychic energy that leaves it and anyone in the vicinity unconscious.

entry: POKENAME念力强，几秒便能剔掉骨头的多余材料，留下形状完美的勺子。精雕的作品，很少让别人摸。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's mind powers are powerful enough to telekinetically remove all the excess material from a bone in seconds, leaving a perfectly-shaped spoon in its place. It rarely lets others touch the carefully crafted item.

entry: POKENAME闻到有趣炖菜，可能闯进餐厅厨房，用精神力把厨师推开，检查锅子。
author: .izik
source: If POKENAME smells an intriguing stew, it may invade restaurant kitchens. It uses a psychic force to shove chefs aside and inspect the pot.

entry: POKENAME重攻轻守，以武艺与超能力压倒敌人，为求更强，从不停止修行。
author: daemonkill22
source: Favoring attack over defense, POKENAME uses both its fighting and psychic abilities to overwhelm its opponent. Its training never ceases as it strives to become even stronger.

entry: POKENAME重守轻攻，在战斗中谋划，追求强大。它以超能力读懂敌人，每招都以完美的反击应对。
author: daemonkill22
source: Favoring defense over attack, POKENAME aims to grow strong by strategizing during battle. It uses its psychic ability to read its opponents, reacting to their moves with the perfect counter.

entry: POKENAME不费力让自己飞，而以念力托勺代步，锻炼大脑。身体凸起处飘出的近透明雾，就是外溢精神力。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME travel by levitating spoons with telekinesis to exercise their brains instead of working to fly themselves. Stray psychic power emanates from the bumps along their bodies as nearly transparent mist.

entry: POKENAME尾毛里满是细小尖石。生气时，这些碎片会脉动着精神能量。
author: .izik
source: The fur on POKENAME's tail is packed with small, sharp stones. These fragments pulse with psychic energy when it gets angry.

entry: POKENAME传递心灵感应时，会把蛋稳稳放在勺上。据说这怪仪式，能大幅增强精神力。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME balances its egg atop its spoon while channeling telepathy. This strange ritual is said to greatly amplify its psychic strength.

entry: POKENAME用勺把庞大精神能量集中一点。不攻击时，也常用同一把勺喂幼崽。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME use their spoons to channel their immense psychic energy into a centralized point of focus. When not attacking, they are often seen using their spoon to feed their young.

entry: POKENAME领地意识很强，用强精神攻击保护选中的花丛。花为何珍贵，仍在研究；有人推测，特定花蜜能增强心智力量。
author: afilthycasual
source: POKENAME are very territorial, protecting their chosen flower patches with strong psychic assaults. What makes these flowers precious is being studied. Researchers theorize specific nectars increase their mental powers.

entry: POKENAME用胡须拨动河底泥沙觅食。被打扰，就以精神力驱敌，再回去梳找河床里的食物。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME feeds along the bottom of rivers by using its moustache to disturb the silt and dirt. If it is interrupted, it uses its psychic powers to repel the foe before returning to combing the riverbed for more food.

entry: POKENAME懒得动，靠精神力让勺子载着走。遇敌就从勺上弹出，毒刺朝前，进行钻击。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are too lazy to move, instead opting to use their psychic abilities to have their spoon carry them around. When encountering enemies, POKENAME fling themselves from their spoon into a drill attack with their venomous barb.

entry: POKENAME易怒，会把强烈的精神与物理攻势，倾泻向打扰者。据说随着精神力成长，身上红鳞会变成星形。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is quick to anger, resulting in it unleashing a devastating combination of psychic and physical attacks on the disturbance. It is believed that the red scales along its body become star-shaped as its psychic abilities grow.

entry: POKENAME用念力，连巨大猎物也能轻松定住。等动不了，再靠近，准备挥动臂上磨利的金属刃，切开下一餐。
author: sk372
source: Using telekinesis, POKENAME can immobilize even gargantuan prey with ease. Once unable to move, it draws closer and readies the sharpened metal blade on its arm, primed to carve up its next meal.

entry: 据说POKENAME的勺，是超能力者能拥有的最强凝神道具之一。许多人因此爬山找巢，但它难寻，多数空手而归。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The spoons POKENAME wield are rumoured to be some of the most powerful focus items a Psychic could possess. This rumour has led to many Psychics scaling mountains in search of POKENAME lairs, but the Pokémon's elusiveness leaves most empty-handed.

entry: POKENAME宝石闪着精神潜力，使用能力便明亮发光。施展越强，宝石越亮，最强时还会伴随耀眼闪光。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME's gemstones sparkle with psychic potential and glow brightly when POKENAME uses their powers. Their gems glitter more brightly as greater feats of psychic power are performed, with bright flashes accompanying the strongest displays.

entry: POKENAME精神能量庞大，授粉也不必离巢，只需念力收集、撒播花粉。
author: bobogagabobo
source: With its immense psychic energy, POKENAME no longer needs to leave its nest to pollinate. It can just use telekinesis to collect and spread the pollen.

entry: POKENAME聪慧，大多独自冥想沉思。据说若有人以才智打动它，就能获赠一些精神力量。
author: sk372
source: Highly intelligent, POKENAME spends much of its time isolating itself in meditation and contemplation. Those that manage to impress it with their own intellect are said to be granted a measure of psychic power from it.

entry: POKENAME挥动头上勺状附肢，向周围放精神脉冲，作用于附近生物的心神，让它们更被动，减少自己遇袭风险。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME waves the spoon-like appendage on its head to send out psychic pulses around it. These pulses stimulate the minds of those around it to behave more passively, reducing the risk of being attacked.

entry: POKENAME把勺藏在羽中，只有紧急才亮出，借此提高精神攻击的准头。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME hides a spoon within its feathers, only revealing it in emergencies. Once drawn, it uses it to boost the accuracy of its psychic attacks.

entry: POKENAME释放念力波时，头会旋转180度，额上星形也同时明亮发光。
author: .izik
source: When unleashing telekinetic waves, POKENAME's head rotates 180 degrees. The star on its forehead glows brightly during the process.

entry: POKENAME张翼成勺子的弯曲形状，增强精神力。只需这样粗略相似，就足以托起树果。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME amplify their psychic power by opening their wings to resemble the curvature of a spoon. This rudimentary resemblance to a spoon is enough to allow them to levitate berries.

entry: POKENAME飞行时，羽毛长尾在空中优雅旋转，帮助它集中精神力时，仍保持平衡。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's long, feathery tail twirls elegantly in the air as it flies. The motion helps it stay balanced while focusing its psychic powers.

entry: POKENAME用勺练习念力，也练歌唱。虽会张嘴，人们推测声音其实来自头上星形，让音符能拉得更长。
author: pixlhoopa
source: POKENAME uses its spoon to practice both telekinesis and its singing ability. Though it opens its mouth when it sings, it is theorized that the sound comes from the star on its head instead to allow for longer notes.

entry: POKENAME感到危险预兆，喙就抽动。它常走到一半僵住，再迅速瞬移避险。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's beak twitches when it senses a dangerous premonition. It often freezes mid-step before swiftly teleporting to safety.

entry: POKENAME周身持续蓄静电，电击靠近者。起初以为来自羊毛，研究者却发现，是强烈精神活动的副产物。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME generate a constant static charge around their bodies, shocking anything that gets too close. While first thought to be a property of their wool, researchers have found the electricity is created as a byproduct of intense psychic activity.

entry: POKENAME周身持续蓄静电，电击靠近者。电荷强得会吸金属，吸附身上时，甚至能把物件弯到变形。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME generate a constant static charge around their bodies, shocking anything that gets too close. The static charge is powerful enough to attract metallic objects and can even bend them out of shape as they become stuck to POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME给勺赋磁，原地飞转发电。电存进胸部、头部羊毛，受威胁时再释放。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME imbue their spoon with a magnetic charge, spinning it rapidly in place to generate an electrical current. They store the electricity they generate in the wool around their chest and head, discharging it whenever they feel threatened.

entry: POKENAME自古与洁净水道、健康河流联系在一起。它定期用精神力清掉栖水杂质，再把净水送回河里。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are traditionally associated with clean waterways and healthy rivers. They regularly use their psychic powers to clean impurities out of the water they live in, returning the purified water to the river afterwards.

entry: POKENAME靠精神力维持稳定路线，否则一阵风就能吹走。许多个体跟着其他毽子草结群，减少迷路风险。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME harness their psychic powers to keep themselves on a steady path, otherwise a single gust of wind could blow them away. Many travel in groups of other Hoppip to minimize the risk of getting lost.

entry: POKENAME发卷夹着的勺，能调节精神力。它在手里生成精神能量球，一摇，附近生物就会眩晕。
author: sk372
source: The spoon held by POKENAME's hair curl keeps its psychic powers regulated. It generates spheres of psychic energy in its hands that causes dizziness in those nearby when shaken.

entry: POKENAME通过勺传导精神能量，破解食品储藏间的锁。若念力开门不成，最后常干脆拿勺砸锁。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME channel psychic energy through their spoons to help them break locks on pantries. If unlocking the door with their psychic powers fails to do the trick, breaking the lock with their spoon is a popular last resort.

entry: POKENAME用精神力时，由手状尾巴握勺。尾巴抓得够牢，攻击便十分精准。
author: .izik
source: When using its psychic powers, POKENAME holds its spoon with its hand-like tail. The tail's grip is strong enough to perform precise attacks.

entry: POKENAME有精神力和360度视野，几乎不可能被偷袭。刚进化的个体若能力用过度，会震碎附近电视。
author: bobosmith01
source: Thanks to its psychic powers and 360-degree vision, it is nearly impossible to sneak up on POKENAME. Newly evolved POKENAME that overuse their powers will cause nearby televisions to shatter.

entry: POKENAME腹纹随意图缓缓变化。老练训练家能在对战时读纹，反制攻击。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: The markings on POKENAME's stomach slowly shift, based on its intentions. Skilled Trainers can read these markings in the middle of a battle in order to counter their attacks.

entry: POKENAME每天会花几个小时，凝望勺中倒影，似在深思。其余时间也会泡泥，让部分身体浸在泥里，进入冥想。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME spends hours of the day staring at its reflection in its spoon, seemingly deep in thought. Other times it will soak itself in mud, achieving a meditative state while partially submerged in the gunk.

entry: POKENAME传导精神能量时，分叉尾巴合拍摇动。强大力量靠近，胡须便会抖。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME waves its forked tail rhythmically as it channels psychic energy. Its whiskers twitch when a strong force is near.

entry: 夜里，POKENAME的勺泛柔和紫光。此时只需碰一下，就可能忘掉一段珍贵童年回忆。
author: .izik
source: At night, POKENAME's spoon glows with a soft violet hue. A single touch to the spoon during this time can make someone forget a cherished childhood memory.

entry: POKENAME每年换羽，都会收集落羽，悉心保养。用途到受扰才揭晓：它会以精神力，把羽毛射向路人。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME gather their discarded feathers during their yearly molt, maintaining them dutifully. The purpose of this is revealed when POKENAME are disturbed, as they will launch their feathers at passersby using their psychic might.

entry: 随身的勺子常被咬坏，必须经常更换。会用意念抬起重物，拿到藏在下方的食物储备。
author: robosoup
source: The spoon it carries gets chewed up, and must be frequently replaced. It lifts heavy objects with its mind to get into food stores hidden beneath.

entry: POKENAME清醒时完全用不了精神力。睡着后反而离地漂浮，力量强得连它靠近的其他宝可梦，都会被托起，一起带走。
author: bradlybro199
source: When awake POKENAME has no access to its psychic powers. When it goes to sleep it begins to float just above the ground and has strong enough power that any other Pokémon it floats nearby gets picked up and taken along with it.

entry: 有些POKENAME会让勺子浮在空中，以免自己把它咬碎。虽然可能削弱攻击，却能锻炼精神耐力。
author: robosoup
source: Some POKENAME keep their spoons afloat, to avoid chewing them to pieces. This might weaken their attacks, but it does help them build mental stamina.

entry: POKENAME不停想读懂周围所有人的心。若被打断，就会大发脾气，精神能量一阵阵涌出。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME constantly tries to read the minds of everyone around it. If interrupted, it throws tantrums filled with psychic surges.

entry: POKENAME狡猾、偷偷摸摸，对甜食永不满足。它用念力把勺送进甜食，偷来吃，尤其爱蜂蜜制品。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a crafty, sneaky little Pokémon with an insatiable sweet tooth. It uses telekinesis to levitate its spoon into sweets to steal and eat, with a marked preference for honey products.

entry: POKENAME平时飞得慢而优雅，受威胁却能猛然加速。它用精神力压平羽毛，形成更流线的外形。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Though usually slow and graceful in the air, POKENAME are capable of sudden bursts of speed when under threat. They achieve these speed bursts by using their psychic powers to flatten their feathers into a more aerodynamic shape.

entry: POKENAME在电脑吃数据时被打扰，就会立即瞬移。有时，还把电脑一起带走。
author: .izik
source: If disturbed while consuming data on a computer, POKENAME will teleport away instantly. It sometimes takes the computer with it.

entry: POKENAME能用精神力和电子设备交流。起初只会造成故障，但学会控制后，诊断电脑问题便很拿手。
author: .jerden
source: It can use its psychic powers to communicate with electronic devices. Although at first it will only cause them to malfunction, once POKENAME learns to control its power, it becomes excellent at diagnosing computer problems.

entry: POKENAME丝滑毛发防水又保温，各种自然环境下都能相对舒适。惊人的精神力，源自它的角。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's silky fur allows it to persist with relative comfort regardless of natural conditions as it is water-resistant and great at retaining heat. The source of its incredible psychic power lies in its antlers.

entry: POKENAME不倦地锻炼身心。精神修行让它能用超能力掰弯汤匙，身体却依旧脆弱。
author: daemonkill22
source: POKENAME trains tirelessly to grow its physical and mental strength. Its mental training allows it to bend spoons with psychic power, but it remains physically frail.

entry: POKENAME摇尾端放精神波，定住猎物，再盘身绞碎。有些地区曾卖割下的尾尖当新奇勺子，后来这做法被认为不人道。
author: sk372
source: It shakes the end of its tail to release psychic waves, immobilizing prey so it can crush them in its coils. Some regions sold severed POKENAME tail-tips as novelty spoons before it was deemed inhumane.

entry: POKENAME用金属勺更好传导电击和精神力。据说若在电器旁过分专注，可能把设备弄得失控。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME uses its metal spoon to better channel both its electric attacks and its psychic powers. It is said that if POKENAME concentrates too hard near an appliance, it risks sending it haywire.

entry: POKENAME轻挥勺子，就造出能弯折周围光线的场。它借此在身体周围反光，让自己看似隐形。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can create a field that bends light around them with a flick of their spoons. With this ability, they can reflect light around their body to make themselves seem invisible.

entry: POKENAME仰面睡，尾巴慢慢转圈。梦中还紧抱勺子，像抱着毛绒玩具。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME sleeps face up while its tail slowly spins in circles. It clutches its spoon like a stuffed toy as it dreams.

entry: POKENAME用念力收集食物、喂自己。几乎不活动，只靠脑力进食，因此身体较弱。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses telekinesis to gather food and feed itself. Because it rarely moves around and uses its mind powers to get sustenance, it has a rather weak body.

entry: POKENAME通过随身的铲子施展超能力，能探测周围十英里范围内的水源。
author: melodydelune
source: By channeling its psychic abilities through the shovel it carries, POKENAME can detect water within a ten-mile radius of it.

entry: POKENAME靠念力挪土、钻入地下。视力差，便用精神感知辨路。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME burrows underground using telekinesis to move soil. With poor eyesight, it relies on psychic perception to navigate.

entry: POKENAME用折弯汤匙时，挥勺做出芭蕾般的复杂动作。每次旋转，都让自己更专注、敌人准头更差。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME performs intricate ballet-like movements with its spoon while using Kinesis. Each spin sharpens its focus and decreases its foe's accuracy.

entry: POKENAME越成熟，伪装越好。进城后，连旧电视雪花等复杂变化图案也能模仿，唯独胸前红印会露馅。
author: bobosmith01
source: As POKENAME matures, its camouflage abilities only improve. It will enter urban areas and mimic even complex shifting patterns, such as the static on old TVs. Only the red mark on its chest gives it away.

entry: POKENAME把全部精神能量，经过舌头导入勺中，尽量增强威力。它还能改变物件看得见的颜色，让它们看似隐形。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME directs all of its psychic energy through its tongue and into its spoon to maximize its potency. It uses its powers to change the visible colors of objects to make them look like they are invisible.

entry: POKENAME靠念力，想去哪就把自己带去哪。它常藏厨房抽屉，以缥缈力量，附身下一个开抽屉的人或宝可梦。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME harnesses its telekinesis to carry itself wherever it desires. It often hides in kitchen drawers, where it possesses the next person or Pokémon who opens the drawer with its ethereal powers.

entry: POKENAME金属爪能感知其他宝可梦的精神活动，藏着的猎物也能找到。它游到藏处上方，再发射精神脉冲。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME's metallic claws can sense the mental activity of other Pokémon, allowing POKENAME to hunt down even hidden prey. They swim above their prey's hiding spots, blasting pulses of psychic energy at their food once they locate it.

entry: POKENAME拿勺敲头，听声音测试头骨坚硬程度。哪里较弱，就靠头锤训练，把那处练得更硬。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses the spoon its carries to test its skull's firmness, knocking the spoon against its head and listening to the noise it makes. If the sounds indicate an area weaker than the rest, it goes to train that spot's toughness via headbutts.

entry: POKENAME性情自信，喜欢让人挠盾形脑袋。用精神力时，头上的星会闪着精神能量。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are assertive creatures that love scratches on their shield-shaped head. Whenever they harness their psychic powers, the stars on their head glow with psionic energy.

entry: 人们相信，POKENAME最初突然出现时，就已是这种进化形。许多理论推测，某次事件或危机，让年轻个体需要凯西对瞬间移动的天赋，之后才开始出现进化前的个体。
author: thordemidgard
source: It is believed that POKENAME appeared suddenly and already in this evolved form. Many theories suggest that pre-evolved specimens might have started to appear after an event or crisis made young POKENAME require Abra's affinity with Teleport.

entry: POKENAME头上勺状突起，由有机组织构成，形状随心情大变。警觉时会变得柔韧，像勇基拉的勺一样，催化精神力。
author: thordemidgard
source: The spoon-like protuberance on POKENAME's head is made up of an organic tissue that shifts widely based on its mood. This organ becomes malleable when POKENAME is alert, working as a catalyst for psychic power similarly to a Kadabra's utensil.

entry: POKENAME有三个相连的大脑，一个在头、两个在背。三者合力，就能放出强大精神攻击。
author: hophoppip
source: It has three connected brains, one in its head and two on its back. When these three brains work in tandem, POKENAME unleashes powerful psychic attacks.

entry: 餐馆常雇POKENAME，把甜点送上桌。它用精神力精确分量，确保每份都刚好适合客人。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are commonly employed in restaurants to transport desserts to tables. They use their psychic powers to dole out exact portion sizes, ensuring each dessert portion is perfectly sized for the diner.

entry: POKENAME振动时发出的阿尔法波，会不由自主地使人头痛，让电子设备故障。勺子甚至能反射部分攻击。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME's vibrations emit alpha waves that passively induce headaches and cause malfunctions in technology. Its spoon can even reflect some attacks.

entry: POKENAME体内的毒，能引发短暂预知。可惜画面常只是系鞋带、洗手等琐碎日常。
author: .izik
source: The toxin in POKENAME's body can trigger short-lived premonitions. Unfortunately, these visions are often mundane, like shoe-tying or hand-washing.

entry: 通过缎带状触角施展超能力。想养好它，就得让它好奇的头脑保持忙碌，它才会开心。
author: melodydelune
source: It channels its psychic abilities through its ribbon-like feelers. Prospective Trainers need to keep their curious minds busy to keep them happy.

entry: POKENAME心灵感应敏锐，数百米外就察觉来者。它很容易受惊，除心境最平和的对象外，常一律避开。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have highly tuned telepathic senses and are able to detect the approach of others from hundreds of meters away. They're skittish Pokémon and frequently flee from all but the most placid of minds.

entry: POKENAME心灵感应敏锐，数百米外就察觉来者。它虽不爱冲突，却会在战斗借感应优势，踢出强击。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have highly tuned telepathic senses and are able to detect the approach of others from hundreds of meters away. Though they dislike conflict, they use their telepathic senses to their advantage in combat to land powerful kicks.

entry: POKENAME心灵感应敏锐，数百米外就察觉来者。战斗能预判敌人动作，以大跳跃避开攻击。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have highly tuned telepathic senses and are able to detect the approach of others from hundreds of meters away. They use their telepathy to anticipate the opponent's moves during battle, bounding out of the way of attacks with great leaps.

entry: POKENAME心灵感应敏锐，数百米外就察觉来者。性子害羞，通常会藏起，避开靠近的思维。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have highly tuned telepathic senses and are able to detect the approach of others from hundreds of meters away. They're shy Pokémon and typically hide themselves away from approaching minds.

entry: POKENAME快速拍翼，声波经勺共鸣，让周围生物迷失方向。因此它很擅长避捕食者，也擅长偷食。
author: sk372
source: The rapid beat of POKENAME's wings sends sonic waves that resonate off of its spoon and cause disorientation in those around it. This makes it very adept at evading predators as well as stealing meals.

entry: POKENAME精神力强，能同时接管多个电子设备。它曾让整仓库电视短路。
author: hophoppip
source: Due to its strong psychic powers, POKENAME can take control of multiple electronic devices at once. It once caused an entire warehouse of televisions to short-circuit.

entry: 满月夜，POKENAME强大的念力更强。它借精神力和勺的反光面，投出满月影像，在周围欢快跳跃。
author: sk372
source: At night when the moon is full, POKENAME's advanced telekinesis is even more powerful. It uses it psychic powers and its spoon's reflective surface to project an image of the full moon for it to prance around.

entry: POKENAME数百米外就能探知思维。它用这敏感度捕猎，摸清猎物想法，再高速俯冲突袭。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are able to detect the thoughts of others from hundreds of metres away. They use this sensitivity to hunt, feeling out the thoughts of their prey and swooping down at high speed to catch their prey off-guard.

entry: POKENAME的神秘力量能影响身心。把别人诅咒成丑陋形体等异界能力，也常见于传闻。它似乎以吞食迷途灵体维生。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME can influence another's mind and body thanks to its mysterious powers. Rumors of other otherworldly abilities, such as cursing another into a hideous form, are very common. POKENAME appears to sustain itself by feasting on wayward spirits.

entry: 勇基拉的遗传物质，被编入外星病毒，造出了这种宝可梦。结果却是个没有心智、不断释放精神能量的生物，能靠能量以惊人速度攻击。
author: bottomusmaximus3
source: A Kadabra's genetic material was woven into an alien virus to create this Pokémon, but the result was a mindless creature that emits surges of psychic energy. This energy allows it to attack at unbelievable speeds.

entry: POKENAME聪明，会读心知道愿望。不过很挑，似乎更喜欢实现简单心愿，而非宏大愿景。
author: sk372
source: Highly intelligent, POKENAME reads the minds of others to learn their wishes. It is very choosy about what wish it will grant, and seems to prefer granting simple desires rather than anything grandiose.

entry: POKENAME通过勺传导强烈的情绪波导。它还年幼，情绪失控时，勺子会像玻璃一样碎裂。
author: river_rifle
source: POKENAME channels its powerful emotional aura through its spoon. Since it is still young, its emotions can get out of control and cause the spoon to shatter like glass.

entry: POKENAME从不安静不动。哪怕集中念动力，也会夸张挥勺，指向想让物件去的地方。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME never remains still. Even while focusing its psychokinesis, it will make dramatic gestures with its spoon, pointing it towards where it wants objects to go.

entry: POKENAME的神秘力量能影响身心。把别人诅咒成丑陋形体等异界能力，也常见于传闻。它似乎以吞食迷途灵体维生。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME can influence another's mind and body thanks to its mysterious powers. Rumors of other otherworldly abilities, such as cursing another into a hideous form, are very common. POKENAME appears to sustain itself by feasting on wayward spirits.

entry: POKENAME的神秘力量能影响身心。把别人诅咒成丑陋形体等异界能力，也常见于传闻。它似乎以吞食迷途灵体维生。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME can influence another's mind and body thanks to its mysterious powers. Rumors of other otherworldly abilities, such as cursing another into a hideous form, are very common. POKENAME appears to sustain itself by feasting on wayward spirits.

entry: POKENAME旋转时能产生精神能量。转速与输出相关，高速便能放出强大精神冲击。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are able to generate psychic energy as they rotate. The speed of their rotation correlates to their power output, with high-speed spinning resulting in powerful psychic blasts.

entry: POKENAME齿轮转速随精神输出变化。转得越快，放出的精神冲击越强。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The rotation speed of POKENAME's gears varies depending on their level of psychic output. The faster POKENAME's gears spin, the more powerful the blast of psychic energy they output is.

entry: POKENAME喜欢弯勺，展示精神能力。不过预先加热勺子，就能轻易模仿这念动力；它也靠这把戏，掩饰尚不成熟的精神能力。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME enjoy the practice of bending spoons to demonstrate their psychic abilities. This act of psychokinesis can easily be replicated by warming the spoon in advance, a trick POKENAME rely on to hide their underdeveloped powers.

entry: POKENAME把勺当麦克风唱歌。精神力放大声音，让听者做奇怪的梦。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME sings into its spoon like a microphone. Psychic power amplifies its voice, causing strange dreams in those who hear it.

entry: POKENAME花香并不难闻，却太浓，能引起严重头痛。有些城市甚至立法，禁止它在某些公共场所露面。
author: mepp.
source: Though the scent of POKENAME's flowers is not unpleasant, it is very strong and has been known to cause terrible headaches. In some cities, there are even laws prohibiting the Pokémon from being out in certain public places.

entry: POKENAME定期用精神力把毛蓬起，让自己可爱讨喜。常忘梳毛的训练家，很喜欢这习惯。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME periodically use their psychic powers to fluff up their fur, making themselves appear cute and appealing. This habit makes them popular amongst Trainers who struggle to remember to groom their Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME用精神力减轻身体，能跃上数米高空。虽有利逃敌，控制却不够细，常难以优雅落地。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are able to leap many meters into the air by making their body lighter with their psychic powers. Though a useful trick for escaping predators, they lack finesse with their powers and often struggle to land gracefully.

entry: POKENAME着迷于金属，用精神力拉近。它尤其爱餐具，甚至会跳进别人厨房窗户找勺子。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are fascinated with metallic objects, drawing such objects closer to themselves with their psychic powers. They have a particular affinity for cutlery and have been known to leap through the windows of people's kitchens in search of spoons.

entry: POKENAME周身胶质黏液，吃下会产生鲜明幻觉。有人报告，听见了远古祖先的声音。
author: .izik
source: The gelatinous slime surrounding POKENAME causes vivid hallucinations if consumed. Some report hearing the voices of ancient ancestors.

entry: 雷暴时，POKENAME把勺举向天空，再以集中的精神控制，将雷电直接导入身体。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME raises its spoon to the sky during thunderstorms. It channels lightning directly into its body through focused psychic control.

entry: POKENAME把折断的长牙装在勺上，做简易斧。战斗时，再用精神力挥动，成为强力武器。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME attaches some of its broken tusks to its spoon to create a makeshift axe. Using psychic powers, it wields the tool as a powerful weapon in combat.

entry: POKENAME群飞行时心灵感应，协调动作，避免空中相撞。交流也兼预警，方便整群躲捕食者。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME flocks communicate with one another telepathically as they fly, coordinating their movements to avoid mid-air collisions. Their telepathic communication doubles as an early warning system, letting the flock evade predators with ease.

entry: POKENAME虽能滚动，却偏爱悬浮，避免损坏勺子。身刺渗出的毒，科学家能转制为抗毒血清。
author: quackquackattack
source: While POKENAME are capable of rolling on the ground, POKENAME prefer to levitate off the ground to avoid the risk of damaging their spoon. The spikes on their body ooze with venom that scientists can convert into antivenom.

entry: POKENAME冥想时，花苞飘出迷幻粉。粉会引发梦与幻象，没准备的生物可能承受不住。
author: .izik
source: Psychedelic powder drifts from POKENAME's buds during meditation. It induces dreams and illusions that can overwhelm the unprepared.

entry: POKENAME察觉恶意，便在目标上方盘旋，放精神波，温和抹去阴暗念头。
author: .izik
source: If it senses ill intent, POKENAME circles above the target. It emits psychic waves that gently erase any dark thoughts they carry.

entry: POKENAME的蜜已被证实，有助治疗某些精神疾病。不过只有它觉得配得上的人，才能尝一口。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's honey has been proven to help in treating certain mental illnesses. However, POKENAME will only allow people it deems worthy to have a taste.

entry: POKENAME悬浮着勺子，自己表演杂技般的擒抱、翻滚。勺在头顶漂着，微微发出力量的光。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME performs acrobatic grapples and rolls while levitating its spoon. The spoon hovers above its head, glowing faintly with power.

entry: POKENAME精神攻击出手极快，常向擅长弹射的宝可梦挑战决斗。勺中射出凝聚精神能量，如子弹般划破空气。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a master of quick-draw psychic powers, challenging Pokémon that excel at projectiles to duels. It lobs concentrated psychic energy from its spoon that cracks through the air like a bullet.

entry: POKENAME执着地用精神力操勺，雕塑自己的身体。即使给更好工具，也坚持勺子，像在向自己证明韧性和技巧。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME obsessively sculpts its body by psychically manipulating its spoon. Even if offered a better tool, it prefers the spoon as if proving its tenacity and skill to itself.

entry: 人们认为POKENAME背上的蘑菇能增智，盗猎报告因此不断，需要采取保育行动。
author: sk372
source: It is thought that the mushrooms on POKENAME's back enhance one's intelligence, so poaching reports run rampant, requiring conservation efforts to be taken.

entry: POKENAME靠巨大精神力，驱动身体分散的各部分。力量来自究极空间，性质超凡，其他宝可梦很难防御。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME use their immense psychic powers to animate the disparate pieces of their bodies. Their powers are drawn from Ultra Space and are difficult for other Pokémon to defend against due to their unearthly nature.

entry: POKENAME用精神波扫查周围危险。一感知附近有动静，就吓得一闪而逝。
author: .izik
source: Using psychic waves, POKENAME scans its surroundings for danger. If it senses movement nearby, it vanishes in a flash of fear.

entry: POKENAME把勺塞在尾毛里，灌注精神能量。存得越久，最后拿来用，能放出的冲击就越强。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME keep their spoon tucked into their tail fur to charge it with psychic energy. The longer they can leave it stored in their fur, the more powerful the blasts of power they're able to unleash when they finally use it.

entry: POKENAME花很多时间采原料，加入大锅。混合物能增强精神力，有时还会给对手带来怪异效果。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME spend much time gathering ingredients to add to their cauldrons. The resulting concoctions strengthen their psychic powers and sometimes have bizarre effects on opponents.

entry: POKENAME飘在办公楼周围，吸收游离思绪。员工事后常反映，自己会发呆，忘掉待办工作。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME drifts around office buildings absorbing stray thoughts. Workers often report blank stares and forgotten tasks afterward.

entry: POKENAME能用意念把废金属塑成勺子，再用来吃甜点，尽管其实也能直接用念力，把甜食送进嘴。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME can form spoons out of scrap metal using its mind. It uses them to eat desserts, even though it could float them into its mouth telekinetically.

entry: POKENAME头上的球，由浓郁奢华的巧克力构成。据说吃下，便能获得一阵纯粹精神力量。
author: ambrosia04
source: The ball on POKENAME's head is made of a richly decadent chocolate. When eaten, they are said to grant a burst of pure psychic power.

entry: POKENAME睡着也握勺，勺会慢慢抹平周围泥土。怪习惯让研究者困惑数十年。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME sleeps clutching a spoon that slowly smooths the surrounding soil. This strange habit has puzzled researchers for decades.

entry: POKENAME碰一碰遗落零钱，就能感知最后拿过的人。它避开物主，把硬币收进隐秘巢穴。
author: .izik
source: By touching spare change left behind, POKENAME can sense the last person to hold it. It avoids the owner while collecting the coins in its hidden den.

entry: POKENAME太健忘，难以训练精神能力。再努力回想，也记不得自己运用力量的时刻。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a difficult time training their psychic abilities because of their forgetfulness. No matter how hard they strain, they cannot remember moments where they harness their psychic power.

entry: POKENAME常带勺和铲，用念力操作，埋骨或挖骨。它领地意识强，能直接在陌生人脑海里低吼、吠叫。
author: laughing_dan
source: POKENAME often carries spoons and spades and uses them with their telekinetic powers to bury or dig up bones. POKENAME are territorial creatures and use their psychic powers to growl and bark directly into the minds of strangers.

entry: POKENAME聪慧，却常被自大、好胜冲昏头。敌对个体先比念力，打久后，几乎必然演变成凶狠肉搏。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is highly intelligent, but its ego and competitiveness often get the better of it. Rivals compete in telekinesis, but as their battle continues, it almost inevitably devolves into a vicious physical altercation.

entry: POKENAME爱展示精神能力，可真正用念力太费劲，便改用热弯勺。把戏虽广为人知，仍常被请上电视直播。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME love to demonstrate their psychic abilities, but this often requires more strain than it is worth, so they bend spoons with heat instead of psychokinesis. Despite being a well-known trick, many are brought onto live TV to perform.

entry: POKENAME用精神力造池塘旋涡，乘水流玩。常把自己弄晕，有时能见它坐在岸上恢复。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME use their psychic powers to create whirlpools in ponds, riding the resultant water currents for fun. They're prone to making themselves dizzy whilst doing so and can sometimes be seen sitting on the shore trying to recover.

entry: POKENAME用精神力造池塘旋涡，乘水流玩。想躲时，就潜入旋涡，迅速沉到看不见，再瞬移到池中别处。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME use their psychic powers to create whirlpools in ponds, riding the resultant water currents for fun. They dive into the whirlpools they create when they want to hide, rapidly sinking out of sight before teleporting elsewhere in the pond.

entry: POKENAME心灵感应时，腹纹闪光。它们夜里无声交流，便让栖居沼泽一片明亮。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The spiral on POKENAME's belly glitters with light whenever they use their telepathic abilities. The swamps they live in glow at night with the silent light of their communications with one another.

entry: POKENAME用腹部大星形传导精神力。能量冲击不够准，就拿大勺试着指引，像拿法杖施法。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME channel their psychic powers through the large star on their belly. The blasts of energy they fire are inaccurate, leading them to use their oversized spoon to try to direct their power as though using a staff to cast a spell.

entry: POKENAME与勺一起冥想，发展精神力。少了这个增幅工具，力量便弱得无法战斗。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME develop their psychic powers by meditating with their spoon. Without this tool to enhance their psychic abilities, they are too weak to fight.

entry: POKENAME把大量精神能量导入勺中。据说勺强得能从其他现实位面舀能量。能量满溢，也让它的身体胀大。
author: ruben2309295
source: POKENAME channels much of its psychic energy into its spoon, it is said that this spoon is powerful enough to scoop up energy from other planes of reality. An overflow of psychic energy has caused POKENAME's body to swell up.

entry: 融合后，POKENAME尾巴变得巨大，没精神力就无法移动。有人相信，尾巴变大，代表里面另有与精神力相关的器官。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's tail has grown to massive size after fusion, to the point it would be immobile if not for psychic powers. Some believe the tail's growth indicates it has a secondary organ within related to its psychic powers.

entry: 它们会试着拿金属做弯曲的汤匙，用来传导精神能量。可没耐心弯金属，大多尝试到一半就停，因此总做不成。
author: quackquackattack
source: They will try to make a Twisted Spoon out of metallic objects, as it functions as a conduit for psychic energy. They are unable to do so because they lack the patience to bend metal, and most attempts stop before completion.

entry: POKENAME同时锻炼体力、脑力，想当群体首领。不过群体如何判断领袖的才智，仍不清楚。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME train themselves with both physical and mental exercises to be chosen as the leader of their group. It is not known how POKENAME groups determine their leader's mental acuity.

entry: POKENAME渴望用头脑和力量打动别人。一边解复杂方程，一边举起极沉的重物，对它轻而易举。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is eager to impress others with brains and brawn. Solving complex equations while lifting massive weights is child's play for POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME喜欢以念动力控火。许多人愿意花大钱，看它变戏法、耍巧手。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have developed a penchant for manipulating flames with their psychokinesis. Many people pay handsomely to see POKENAME perform tricks and sleights of hand.

entry: POKENAME嘴边垂下的勺状附肢，会放精神波，扰乱意志薄弱的猎物。趁此用念力抓住，举进等着的大嘴。
author: sk372
source: The spoon-like appendage dangling from its mouth emits psychic waves that disorient weak-minded prey, letting them more easily be seized by telekinesis and lifted into POKENAME's waiting maw.

entry: POKENAME以意念造出强壮石拳。这些由精神力造出的拳头威力很大，却不能像普通实体打击那样被抓住或反制。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME generates muscular fists of stone via the power of its mind. These psychic constructs pack a mighty wallop, yet cannot be gripped or countered like normal, physical strikes.

entry: POKENAME用念力控制沉重石臂，结合精神力量与蛮力，打出碾压重击。
author: .izik
source: Using telekinesis, POKENAME controls its heavy stone arms. It delivers crushing blows powered by both psychic force and raw strength.

entry: POKENAME以精神力指引巨大石身，打击精准。岩壳越硬，头脑也越敏锐，让它既善思，又势不可挡。
author: simmy789
source: POKENAME uses psychic force to guide its massive stone body, striking with unerring precision. Its mind grows sharper as its rocky shell hardens, making it both a thinker and a juggernaut.

entry: POKENAME动用精神力前，角会泛白光。控火本领唯有惊人速度能相比，精神与身体战斗都不容小觑。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's horn glows white before it unleashes its psychic powers. Its prowess with pyrokinesis is only rivaled by its incredible speed, making it a force to be reckoned with in both mental and physical combat.

entry: POKENAME天生会让附近产生严重电磁干扰。它既不喜全然安静，也不爱吵闹，柔和嗡声中最放松。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME naturally causes severe electromagnetic interference in its vicinity. It dislikes total silence as much as a loud ruckus, and its body relaxes the most when there is a soft hum in the area.

entry: POKENAME会随使用的力量调整朝向。顶端若是带星部分，就代表磁力较强；若是长胡须部分，是精神力占优；剩下部分在上，则两者相当。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME shifts and rotates its orientation depending on which power it's using most strongly. The starred one on top denotes higher magnetic force, the mustached one psychic powers, and the remaining one for when both are in equal measure.

entry: POKENAME出手前，会在双翼间抛接勺子，借动作集中精神能量，精准释放。
author: .izik
source: Before striking, POKENAME tosses its spoon between its wings. The motion helps it focus its psychic energy into precise bursts.

entry: POKENAME两个头与身体靠精神联系相连，因此能独立漂动。它更容易避攻击，再结合踢击、念力反击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's two heads are connected to its body via a psychic link, allowing them to float around independently. This allows POKENAME to more easily avoid attacks from others and respond with a combination of kicks and telekinesis.

entry: 它们用力量束带等小物增加负重，进一步发展精神能力。它们懂这些物品的效果，特别寻找能促使对手入睡的。
author: quackquackattack
source: They utilize various trinkets such as the Power Band to weigh themselves down and further develop their psychic abilities. They are aware of the effects of the trinkets they collect and seek out ones that help put opponents to sleep.

entry: POKENAME用精神力引水到干土，形成泥。热天会在凉泥里打滚，调节体温。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses psychic power to draw water onto dry soil, forming mud. It rolls in the cool mud during hot days to regulate its temperature.

entry: 它双钳合拢，力道巨大；无论直接靠身体，还是强力精神操控，总会有东西被夹碎。它似乎与钢属性宝可梦较劲。
author: bobosmith01
source: When its claws snap shut, great force is applied; whether directly through its body or through powerful psychic manipulation, something will be crushed. It seems to have a rivalry with Steel-Type Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME用强韧的藤蔓握着两把勺子。勺上涂有特殊毒素，会让敌人病得很重。
author: cipher
source: POKENAME holds a pair of spoons in the grips of its strong vines. The spoons are coated with a special poison that can make its foe extremely ill.

entry: 大脑过度发育，让头变得又大又圆。滚动时会用超能力将自己抬离地面。
author: soup1900
source: Its brain has gotten so big that its head has become large and round. When rolling about, it uses its psychic powers to lift itself off the ground.

entry: POKENAME每个头精通不同学科，合起来有大学教授般才智。它们以精神力施展念力，操纵周围事物。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have the collective acumen of a university professor, as each head is knowledgeable in a different subject. They harness their psychic powers to perform telekinesis and manipulate their surroundings.

entry: POKENAME以庞大超能力与压倒性力量，自认已登顶峰。出手毫不留情，连踢与超能力齐发，转眼击败敌人。
author: daemonkill22
source: With massive psychic ability and overwhelming power, POKENAME believes it has become the strongest of all. It fights without mercy, defeating its opponents in moments with a flurry of kicks and a psychic barrage.

entry: POKENAME精通战术，敌人未动便已预见。强大的超能力与体力，让每次来袭都变成自己的机会。
author: daemonkill22
source: A master combat strategist, POKENAME reads its opponents' moves before they are made. It uses its immense psychic and physical power to turn every attack against it into an opportunity for itself.

entry: 融合让POKENAME强大的脑，像垂到嘴外摇晃的舌头。通过深度冥想，它能想象任何东西的滋味。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Fusion has made POKENAME's powerful brain look like a tongue swinging out of its mouth. Through deep meditation, it can imagine the taste of anything.

entry: POKENAME以冷静聪明为荣，从不冲动攻击。不过谁摸勺子，它就愤慨失控，怒冲冒犯者。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME prides itself as calm and intelligent, never choosing to act on impulsive aggression. However, someone touching its spoons causes it to fly into an indignant rage, losing its composure and charging down the perpetrator.

entry: 野生POKENAME每天至少冥想5小时。若被打扰，就会暴怒，冲向附近来者。
author: .izik
source: In the wild, an POKENAME will meditate for a minimum of 5 hours per day. Should it be disturbed, it will fly into a rage, charging at anyone nearby.

entry: POKENAME传导精神波，弯折周围水流。它以念力捞起海底垃圾，仔细拼成漂浮的雕塑，再送上岸，让人看见、清理。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME channels psychic waves to bend the currents around it. It lifts trash from the ocean floor using telekinesis and carefully arranges it into floating sculptures before casting them ashore to be noticed and later cleaned up.

entry: POKENAME角坚固锋利，可作武器，不过大多用于集中精神力。人们也常用角，为灵媒、通灵者制作施术工具。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME horns are sturdy, sharp weapons, though they are most often used as foci for psychic powers. Their horns are often used to make tools for psychic mediums and spiritualists.

entry: POKENAME博学，追寻知识，想更懂周围世界。它会瞬移，还能弹开精灵球，因此很难捕。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are erudite knowledge seekers that want to better understand the world around them. Their ability to teleport and bounce Pokéballs away from themselves makes them difficult to capture.

entry: POKENAME会看见超凡绝美的景象，并用心灵感应传给别人。主题虽不同，却总围着人们印象中可爱的宝可梦。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have visions of sublime beauty that they transmit telepathically to others. The subject of these visions varies, but they all center around stereotypically cute Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME拿河床找到的勺等碎物，帮胡须翻泥找食。旧故事说，渔夫钓到它，它便预测对方未来，换取自由。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME uses detritus, like spoons, it finds on the riverbed to assist its moustache in combing the silt for food. Old stories tell of this Pokémon being caught by fishers and trading its freedom by predicting their futures.

entry: POKENAME常用胡须搜查三角洲河底，再以精神力抓住逃跑的宝可梦吃。愤怒时，却可能盯着勺中倒影，神奇地平静下来。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is often found scouring the floors of river deltas with its moustache, snaring any fleeing Pokémon with its psychic powers for a meal. When in a rage, it may begin staring into its reflection in its spoons, which mysteriously calms it down.

entry: POKENAME最爱啃的玩具是金属勺，念力辅助咬力，让勺弯曲。弯坏就换新勺，不过最喜欢的仍悬在身旁，给自己安慰。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME gnaws on its favorite chew toys, metal spoons, bending them as its psychic powers supplement its bites. When a spoon bends too much and becomes ruined, POKENAME chews a new one, but levitates its favorite ones alongside it for comfort.

entry: POKENAME肌肉虽弱，头脑却聪明，很适合当残障人士的辅助宝可梦。
author: notsaying.
source: Despite its weak muscles, POKENAME is useful as a service Pokémon for people with disabilities. It is very intelligent.

entry: 自古以来，POKENAME就通过勺集中精神能量，开凿岩层，造新水道。化石里找到的勺，被视为珍贵文物。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Since ancient times, POKENAME have focused their psychic energy through their spoons to carve out rock formations and create new waterways. A spoon recovered from an POKENAME fossil is considered a valuable artifact.

entry: POKENAME一生大多深度冥想，思考宇宙起源等高深哲学。谁想挪动它，都会被潜意识念力阻止。
author: staghorn
source: It spends most of its life in a deep meditative state, pondering lofty philosophical concepts such as the origins of the universe. Any attempts to move a meditating POKENAME will be thwarted by its subconscious telekinesis.

entry: 据说POKENAME是世上最聪明的宝可梦之一。先进心灵感应，让它只需对视几秒，就能探索另一只宝可梦的心智，了解一切。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is said to be one of the most intelligent Pokémon in existence. Its advanced telepathy lets it explore the minds and know everything about another Pokémon within seconds of making eye contact.

entry: POKENAME通过小勺传精神能量，合着摇摆节奏，召唤奇妙力量。这种挥指能力难以预测，每次结果都不同。
author: quackquackattack
source: By channeling psychic energy through miniature spoons, POKENAME can summon strange powers with a rhythmic rocking. This Metronome ability is unpredictable and yields varying results each time it is used.

entry: POKENAME头部中央的大眼睁开，就能看未来。不过此时看不见现实四周，战场行动全靠神秘精神感知。
author: tuskaninny
source: When the large eye in the center of its head is open, POKENAME is able to see into the future. While in this state, it cannot see its physical surroundings, and relies entirely on its mysterious psychic perception to navigate the battlefield.

entry: POKENAME替忙碌、没空园艺的家庭种花，用精神力操控多把小铲，快速栽种。晴朗周末，还会鼓励家人到花园放松。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME cultivates plots of flowers for busy families that do not have time to garden. Its psychic powers manipulate multiple trowels to swiftly plant flowers. On sunny weekends, it encourages its family to spend time in the garden and relax.

entry: POKENAME研究过一条河，就能准确预测任何猎物何时经过，不必再亲自检查。它用尾部勺子造精神泡，载自己穿过大片田野。
author: soup1900
source: Once POKENAME has studied a river, it can accurately predict when any prey comes through the river without ever having to manually check again. It creates psychic bubbles with the spoons in its tail to transport itself across large fields.

entry: 不同气候有不同POKENAME变体，脸颊附肢颜色也不同。遇到另一变体，它们会误以为对方想害自己，展开精神交锋。
author: whatagooddaytodie
