source: Different variants of POKENAME are found in different climates. This is expressed through different colourings on the appendages on its cheeks. When they encounter another variation, they enter psychic conflict, believing the other means them harm.

entry: POKENAME尽可能收集勺子，训练精神力。家里有它，训练家常发现餐具不见。
author: ferdirenz
source: POKENAME collects as many spoons as it can find to train its psychic powers. Trainers often report missing cutlery when they have POKENAME around the house.

entry: 背上的花苞开始绽放，届时会释放病毒毒素，再用超能力勺子将其引向敌人。
author: cipher
source: The flower bud on its back has begun to blossom. When it does, it will release a viral toxin that will be directed at foes with its psychic spoons.

entry: POKENAME最爱蜂蜜，用勺状角当探测杖，以精神力找蜜。找到后，再细心装满勺，喂自己。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME's favorite food is honey. It psychically detects honey by using its spoon-shaped horn as a dowsing rod. Upon finding a source of honey, POKENAME will delicately fill its spoons and nourish itself.

entry: POKENAME从不满足现有力量，凭才智不断盘算如何变更强。战斗频繁瞬移避伤，再蓄力冲撞。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME is never content with the amount of power it currently has and uses its intellect to constantly scheme ways of acquiring more. In battle, it frequently teleports to avoid damage and uses charged-up body slams to attack.

entry: POKENAME不停精算，需要频繁吃饭补能。它甩勺刮走餐盘食物，再用念力拉回，享受大餐。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are constantly performing precise calculations, so they require frequent meals to keep up their energy. They fling out their spoons to swipe food off of people's plates before telekinetically pulling them back for their feasts.

entry: POKENAME精神力太强，飞行也不必用翼。大勺形象，还让它成为受欢迎的麦片吉祥物。
author: seanothan_23
source: POKENAME's psychic powers are so strong that its wings are unneeded for flight. It's also a very popular cereal mascot because of the large spoons it holds.

entry: POKENAME的勺兼任额外处理器，帮助运算摄入的数据。深思时，勺会绕身高速旋转。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's spoons act as extra processors that help it to better compute and calculate data it takes in. The spoons all rotate around it at high speeds when it is particularly deep in thought.

entry: POKENAME大脑远强过身体，因此靠精神能量推进，而非依赖孱弱的肌肉。虽然很擅长失重移动，仍需要空气呼吸。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's brain is much more powerful than its body, so it propels itself using psychic energy rather than relying on its weak muscles. Although this means it is excellent at movement in zero gravity, it still needs air to breathe.

entry: POKENAME已练成敏锐心智和平衡，接下来会锻炼更强体魄。若选择专精某种武术，还可能进一步进化。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME has trained to master mental acuity and balance, and will train further to grow physically stronger. It may evolve further when it chooses to specialize itself further in a particular martial art.

entry: POKENAME不爱独自穿越时间，会强行用精神力带上附近生物。可它常忘了带谁来，结果把别人送错年代。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME prefers not to travel through time alone, gathering anyone nearby with its psychic powers against their will. It often forgets who it brought with it, returning others to the wrong time period entirely.

entry: 它为了发展心智，牺牲了全部肌力，连舌也无力，必须靠精神力操纵自身。不过增强后的舔舐，竟能压扁汽车。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Its mind has expanded at the cost of all muscle strength, even in its tongue. It has to use its psychic powers to puppeteer its own body. Its psychic boosted licks can crush a car.

entry: POKENAME用勺集中精神力产生的高热，远远点燃物品。每次这么做，身上粉焰都会闪烁。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME uses its spoon to focus intense heat generated by its psychic powers, igniting objects from a distance. Every time it does this, the pink flames on its body will flash and flicker.

entry: 野生POKENAME常洗劫花园、农田，偷小铲。三把小铲既用来集中精神力，也帮忙挖巢穴。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME have often been found raiding gardens and fields for trowels. They use three trowels as foci for their psychic powers and to dig burrows to nest within.

entry: 有人推测，没有野生宝可梦曾自然进化成POKENAME。身体孱弱的它，靠精神力飞行。
author: bobosmith01
source: It is speculated that no wild Pokémon have naturally evolved into POKENAME. As it possesses a weak physical countenance, it relies on its psychic abilities to fly.

entry: POKENAME连地面微震也能感知，因此常微微悬浮，避免刺激太多。战斗再把铲插入地面，集中精神能力。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Being able to sense even the slightest vibrations through the ground, POKENAME often levitate slightly to avoid being overwhelmed by every sensation. They dig their shovels into the ground to act as focuses for their psychic abilities in battle.

entry: POKENAME毫无肌肉，移动全靠精神力。数字环境里很好用，现实中的动作却飘忽难测。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME relies on its psychic power to move around, as it lacks any muscles. Although this mental movement works well in digital environments, in the physical world, its movements are erratic and unpredictable.

entry: POKENAME用庞大才智保护珍爱训练家。无论情境多离奇，似乎始终都在围绕对方安危，筹备应变方案。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's vast intellect serves it well in protecting its beloved Trainer. It appears to always be thinking of contingency plans based around its Trainer's safety, no matter how outlandish the scenario.

entry: 它浮在空中，勺子也由精神能量托着。大多数攻击虽能避开，真挨中时，却极其脆弱。
author: .jerden
source: It floats in the air, its spoon suspended by psychic energy. Although it can evade most attacks, it is incredibly fragile if hit.

entry: 虽然智商很高，却懒得变色，甚至懒得走路。不过有需要时，POKENAME可以彻底隐身。
author: t.i.a.
source: Despite its high IQ, this Pokémon is too lazy to change its colors or even walk. POKENAME, however, can become completely invisible if needed.

entry: POKENAME聪明却疏远，用精神脉冲阻止别人靠近。真信任谁，才准接近、摸勺，接触能增强才智与精神力。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is highly intelligent but quite standoffish, keeping others at bay with psychic pulses. If it truly trusts a person, it will allow them to get close and touch its spoons, which grant a boost to intelligence as well as psychic powers.

entry: 胡地的念力与路卡利欧的波导融合，让POKENAME的灵魂也有了实体。野生POKENAME只要不受挑衅，便不会主动攻击。
author: hypersonic06
source: The fusion of Alakazam's telekinesis and Lucario's aura lead to POKENAME's very soul gaining a physical form. Wild POKENAME do not attack unprovoked.

entry: POKENAME常蜕下翼臂末端的爪，让新爪生长。旧爪不丢，随身带着，战斗以精神力射敌。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME frequently sheds the claws at the tips of its winged arms, allowing new ones to grow. Rather than discarding the old ones, POKENAME carries them around with it, using psychic force to fire them at foes.

entry: POKENAME智力鲜有能及，却也懒得厉害。大部分时间，都在想如何逃避工作。
author: .jerden
source: Few can match its intelligence, but POKENAME is also incredibly lazy. It spends most of its time thinking of ways to avoid work.

entry: POKENAME生来便知道过去与未来的所有灾难，被称为“末日的预兆”。
author: moginar
source: POKENAME are born with knowledge of every catastrophe, past and future. They are known as the Harbingers of Doom.

entry: POKENAME以巨大精神力改变感知，让观看者相信它是神。可在它头旁举一把勺，效果就会消退。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses immense psychic power to manipulate perceptions, convincing observers it is divine. The effect fades should a spoon be held near its head.

entry: 据说POKENAME背上的冰淇淋，是世上最好吃的甜点。可惜，尝过的人无一例外，都得了剧烈偏头痛。
author: patch
source: The ice cream on POKENAME's back is said to be the best-tasting dessert in the world. Unfortunately, every person who has tasted it ends up with an intense migraine.

entry: POKENAME让工具悬浮，打落高枝果实，给家人吃。城市里，它常偷商店食物再逃，被视为害兽。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME levitate tools to knock fruit out of the high branches of trees for their family. They are often considered pests in urban environments, using their psychic powers to steal food from stores before fleeing to safety.

entry: POKENAME受威胁便展示精神力量，升空点燃流苏、勺和尾。若吓不退，便转为猛攻，向敌人喷出大股火。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME put on displays of psychic might when they feel threatened, rising into the air and igniting their tassels, spoons, and tail. The display turns aggressive if they fail in their intimidation efforts, blasting their foe with gouts of fire.

entry: POKENAME独居，却始终用精神力关注附近宝可梦。大危险一到，就瞬移过去，以强大意念与坚实体魄护弱。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME lives a solitary existence, but keeps a close mental eye on other Pokémon around it. If a great danger approaches, it teleports in to defend the weak from it with its great mind and bulwark of a body.

entry: POKENAME警惕心强，又不愿沟通，因此无法测出智商。不过，小小的身体已展现出高超的超能力。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME's defensive attitude and lack of communication means its IQ can't be tested, but it displays psychic mastery with its diminutive form.

entry: 圆润的餐具内，蕴含着人类无法理解的智慧。简单的形态让POKENAME能完全专注于自己的能力。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: Within this rounded cutlery lies intelligence unfathomable to the human mind. Its simple form allows POKENAME to focus completely on its powers.

entry: POKENAME熟练旋转银勺，能产生巨大的沙旋涡。传闻它独居沙漠，整天冥想，锻炼精神力量。
author: fiordaliso
source: By skillfully spinning its silver spoons, POKENAME can generate tremendous sand vortexes. Rumor holds that this Pokémon lives a solitary life in the desert, spending entire days meditating to sharpen its mental strength.

entry: POKENAME凭读心能力，能完美模仿某人的家族成员。有些冒名案例，甚至持续了几年。
author: .izik
source: With its ability to read minds, POKENAME will perfectly mimic members of a person's family. There have been cases where the impersonation lasts years.

entry: 记忆力超群，连出生时的事都记得。执行任务归来的士兵发现，POKENAME依然认得自己。
author: melodydelune
source: Its superb memory lets it remember all the way up to its birth. Soldiers who have been deployed have returned to find that POKENAME remembers them.

entry: 有理论认为，它快速弯曲又复原勺子，是在向传说中的固拉多与盖欧卡发送信号。
author: vaporvenator
source: It is theorized that the rapid bending and reformation of its spoons send signals to the legendary Groudon and Kyogre.

entry: POKENAME用念力，控制炮口射出的勺形导弹。导弹留下精神干扰轨迹，它借此困敌，再挥爪攻击。
author: oddwalls
source: POKENAME telekinetically controls the spoon-shaped missile that it launches from its cannon. The missile leaves a trail of psychic disruption that POKENAME uses to trap foes before striking with its claws.

entry: POKENAME用念力托起花朵产生的两滴水银，在空中塑成勺，增强精神力。输了气不过，还会想拿这些水银，让对方中毒。
author: epping_forest
source: POKENAME uses telekinesis to hold two drops of the mercury produced by its flowers, molding them in the air like spoons to strengthen its psychic powers. When a battle is lost, out of spite, it will try to poison its foe with that mercury.

entry: POKENAME头里大多是热空气，必须不停运用潜藏的精神力，防止自己飘走。
author: krogens
source: The head of POKENAME is mostly filled with hot air. It has to constantly use its latent psychic ability to prevent itself from floating away.

entry: POKENAME精神感知已练到顶点，时刻了解周围。内心虽胆小，仍会用强踢抵御攻击者。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's psychic senses are honed to the pinnacle, in order to let it be aware of its surroundings at all time. Though timid at heart, it defends itself from attackers with powerful kicks.

entry: POKENAME绒毛下藏着一颗强大的大脑。它用念动力控风，让轻巧身体四处漂浮。
author: hophoppip
source: Hidden under POKENAME's fluff is a large and powerful brain. It uses psychokinesis to manipulate the wind and levitate its lightweight body around.

entry: POKENAME捕猎时，凭才智和精神力预判猎物动向，因此成为附近的顶级猎手之一。
author: mepp.
source: When hunting, POKENAME used its great intellect and psychic powers to help predict the movement of its prey. These skills make it one of the top predators around.

entry: POKENAME用暗影触须模仿胡地常拿的勺，让伪装更完整。不过有时弄混餐具，最后反而假装拿叉或刀。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses its shadowy tendrils to mimic the spoons typically held by Alakazam to further complete its disguise. It sometimes mixes up the cutlery and winds up pretending to hold forks or knives instead.

entry: POKENAME寿命长、记忆好，几十年前许多经历仍能回想。各领域研究者，都迫切想让它有效传达这些经验。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME's long lifespan and superb memory allow them to recall many experiences even several decades after the events occurred. Researchers in all fields are desperate to find a way to allow POKENAME to communicate these effectively.

entry: POKENAME腿小，很难喂自己，只好用念力操勺，把食物铲进嘴。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Its small legs make it very difficult for POKENAME to feed itself. It uses telekinesis on spoons to shovel food into its maw.

entry: 它能产生强大精神力，也能产生高热，却不能同时发挥。虽然聪明，仍难同时专注多件事。
author: delexious
source: Capable of generating great psychic powers and great heat, but not both at the same time. It struggles to focus on more than one thing at a time, despite its intelligence.

entry: POKENAME大半身体裹在神秘胶冻里，只偶尔探胡须感知四周。胶冻营养丰富，足以供它维生多年。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME envelop most of their bodies in a mysterious jelly, only poking their whiskers out occasionally to sense their surroundings. This jelly is rich in nutrients and can sustain them for years on end.

entry: 脸上三颗红宝石齐闪，就代表正在传导精神攻击。勺子能帮忙集中力量，因此它会去偷厨房抽屉里的勺。
author: hophoppip
source: When the three red gems on its face glimmer in unison, it's channeling a psychic attack. Spoons help it focus its powers, so it steals them from kitchen drawers.

entry: POKENAME极聪明、精神天赋强，身体却太脆弱，不适合栖居地的严寒。人们从没见它不裹暖披风，可它仍常发抖。
author: t3isukone
source: Though they are extremely intelligent and psychically talented, POKENAME's frail bodies are ill-suited for the icy temperatures they inhabit. Though they are never seen without the warm cloaks they hunker under, they are still often seen shivering.

entry: 不知为何，它身体大多是湿软麦片。需要集中精神力时，就拿一把勺，舀自身麦片吃。
author: hophoppip
source: For unknown reasons, its body is largely made of soggy cereal. When it needs to focus its psychic powers, it consumes a spoonful of its cereal with one of its spoons.

entry: 神奥药剂师会用POKENAME头顶的花粉，这是要害攻击补剂的有效成分。
author: .izik
source: The pollen that comes out of the top of an POKENAME is used by apothecaries in Sinnoh.  This is an active ingredient in Dire Hit supplements.

entry: 像指挥飞行编队一样操纵勺子。勺子包围敌人，让超能力与声波攻击反复回响，威力增强。
author: pokepower
source: It directs its spoons like a flying squadron. They surround foes, allowing psychic and sonic attacks to reverberate and intensify.

entry: POKENAME能用精神力，远远把太阳珊瑚拉入等着的大嘴。念力让它成为熟练猎手。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its psychic powers to pull Corsola into its waiting jaws from great distances. Its telekinetic abilities make it a skilled predator.

entry: POKENAME以精神力操工具，把沙质身体雕成完美对称的结构。满意后，再安静冥想，观看海潮起落。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME psychically manipulates tools to sculpt its sandy body into a perfectly symmetrical structure. Once content, it calmly meditates while watching the rise and fall of ocean tides.

entry: 过去，人们用POKENAME的蘑菇制作多种改善视力的敷药。后来发现含毒，这习俗便停止。
author: .izik
source: The mushrooms on POKENAME were once used in many different poultices that improved eyesight. This practice concluded when it was discovered that their mushrooms contained toxins.

entry: POKENAME用惊人精神力撕开现实，通往究极空间，借用那里的异界能量。只有持着特殊阿罗拉晶体，才能短暂维持力量。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME use their incredible psychic power to tear holes through reality into Ultra Space to wield the extra-terrestrial energies found there. They can only maintain their power for short times through the possession of special Alolan crystals.

entry: POKENAME通过晶体集中精神能量，不断浮空，好让头脑做其他事。它能立即判断，任何环境里的矿物组成。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME float continuously by focusing their psychic energy through their crystals, allowing their minds to focus on other tasks. They can immediately determine the mineral composition of any environment.

entry: POKENAME能以致命准头，把银色苦无射向要害。每个动作都精算过，力求无声、高效。
author: icelevelincarnate
source: With deadly precision, POKENAME can launch one of their silver kunai at a target's vitals effortlessly. Every single movement they make is calculated to be silent and efficient.

entry: 吸入POKENAME翅上落尘，会让人以为自己是孩子。不过真正的孩子，不受影响。
author: .izik
source: Inhaling the dust that comes off of an POKENAME's wings will cause a person to believe they are a child. The dust has no effect on actual children.

entry: POKENAME飞行时，以悬浮餐具作心灵感应通道。它借附近飞行宝可梦的视野，弥补自身视力不足。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses levitating cutlery as telepathic conduits as it flies. Through them, it sees through nearby flying Pokémon to compensate for its poor eyesight.

entry: POKENAME用精神力，偷餐厅餐具。拿到一件，就会明亮发光，消失在天空。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its psychic powers to steal cutlery from restaurants. After taking a piece, it glows brightly and vanishes into the sky.

entry: POKENAME年纪越大越有智慧。智商每增一点，就把勺弯一度；勺弯得特别厉害，说明它非常聪慧。
author: cipherlingarde
source: An POKENAME becomes wiser with age, bending its spoon by one degree for every IQ point gained. An extremely bent spoon indicates a very wise POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME睡着也放精神脉冲，帮助挖掘，还能无意识地驱使附近宝可梦代劳。
author: .izik
source: Even while asleep, POKENAME emits psychic pulses to assist its digging. It can subconsciously compel nearby Pokémon to dig on its behalf.

entry: POKENAME只在地下几英尺处移动，三把勺浮在地表，感知四周。危险靠近，勺先分散注意，本体再出土，以精神力直接攻击。
author: oddwalls
source: POKENAME travels just a few feet underground, while its three spoons hover at the surface, sensing the surroundings. If danger approaches, the spoons distract the foe while POKENAME emerges to launch a direct psychic attack.

entry: 它频繁头痛一发作，想理清的思绪就会乱成一团。它恼得乱挥勺，仿佛想把念头舀回脑袋。
author: quackquackattack
source: Its attempts at a coherent thought turn into gobbledygook whenever its frequent headaches occur. This causes it to get angry and flail its spoon around, as though it is attempting to scoop the thought back into its head.

entry: POKENAME念力与精神力极强，能举起重达500磅的物件。不睡时，它常贪玩亢奋地到处跑，走哪都制造混乱破坏。
author: laughing_dan
source: POKENAME have immensely strong telekinetic and psychic powers, able to lift objects of up to 500lbs. When POKENAME aren't asleep, they usually race around in a playful, hyperactive mode, which causes chaos and destruction wherever they play.

entry: POKENAME是世上最出色的追踪者之一，靠精神力与嗅觉，能追踪最远6,000英里外的目标。强健肌肉加上意志，也能让它奔跑最远6,000英里，整整48小时不休息。
author: laughing_dan
source: POKENAME are some of the best trackers in the world. Using psychic powers and olfactory prowess, they can track targets up to 6,000 miles away. With powerful muscles and willpower, they can run up to 6,000 miles and run a full 48 hours without rest.

entry: POKENAME已精通身体与精神战技。它用念力把大勺藏地下，待最佳时机破土而出，令对手措手不及。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has mastered both physical and psychic combat arts. It hides the large spoon it possesses underground using telekinesis, so it can erupt from the ground at the perfect moment to take its foe by surprise.

entry: POKENAME的超能力已臻巅峰。它展现的神迹，令见者既敬且惧。
author: cipher
source: Having achieved the height of its psionic abilities, POKENAME is capable of feats of psychic prowess that both awe and terrify those who witness them.

entry: POKENAME把精神力练至极致，能看见别人整个未来。不过肌肉疏于使用，已变得极弱。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME has hyper trained its psychic powers, allowing it to see the entire future of others. Its muscles have become extremely weak due to neglecting their use.

entry: POKENAME训练专注，终于完全掌控心智。不过仍得努力维持，否则火会吞没一切。
author: delexious
source: Through training its focus, POKENAME has unlocked perfect control over its mind. It must work hard to maintain this control, however, or its fire will engulf everything.

entry: 城都占卜者会拿POKENAME掉落的石头，预测一段关系能持续多久。石头若泛蓝光，便是好兆头。
author: .izik
source: Rocks that fall off of an POKENAME are utilized by oracles in Johto to predict a relationship's longevity. It is a good sign if the stones glow blue.

entry: 超能力与结实的身体让它能吸收并反射冲击，出色的记忆力则帮助它在地下辨认方向。
author: mistershaokahn
source: Its psychic powers and sturdy body let it absorb and reflect shocks, while its exceptional memory helps it navigate underground.

entry: 一只POKENAME的力量，约等于店里买的磁铁。不过多只聚集，心智相连，合作就能把停车标志牌从混凝土里拔出。
author: chinigan
source: One POKENAME has about the same power as a store-bought magnet. When multiple POKENAME come together, their minds link, and their teamwork has the strength to rip stop signs out of concrete.

entry: 所有POKENAME每天都只吃一餐，个体饮食却不同。胡须细微差异，能看出年龄、出生地区等多种特征。
author: bobosmith01
source: All POKENAME eat just once a day, although individual diets may vary. It is possible to learn various traits about an POKENAME just by minute differences in the appearance of its moustache, such as its age or region of birth.

entry: POKENAME每天吃营养丰富的树果，维持肌肉，随时准备战斗。它会从背上球茎放刺激花粉，灼痛敌人眼睛，惹其烦躁。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME eats highly nutritious berries every day to keep its body muscular and always ready to fight. To annoy its foes during battles, it releases an irritating pollen from the bulb on its back that makes their eyes burn.

entry: 据说POKENAME戴的头骨来自祖先。也有人称，它能通过骨头传导古老知识，一拳击碎巨石。
author: .izik
source: The skull POKENAME wears is said to be from an ancestor. Some say it channels ancient knowledge through the skull to shatter boulders with one punch.

entry: POKENAME的哑铃由异常沉重的骨头制成。进化后，它从何处找到这件遗物，仍是谜。
author: .izik
source: The dumbbell POKENAME wields is made from an unusually heavy bone. Where it finds this relic after evolving remains a mystery.

entry: POKENAME一绷手臂肌肉，毛孔就冒烟。气味刺鼻，却明显能刺激肌肉，某些运动员因此觉得，忍臭也值得。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's pores puff out clouds of smoke whenever it flexes the muscles in its arms. The odor is pungent, but notably helps stimulate muscles, making it worth the stench in the eyes of some athletes.

entry: POKENAME强壮，头脑却不灵光。它不假思索地冲撞大宝可梦，哪怕对方转眼就能打倒自己。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: POKENAME is very strong but largely unintelligent. It will ram into large Pokémon without thinking twice, even those that could topple it in a heartbeat.

entry: POKENAME几乎一直在锻炼，却依旧没多少肌肉。会把自己举得动的最大隆隆石融合体放进育儿袋，自豪地展示。
author: the_fireplace
source: Despite its near-constant training, POKENAME lacks significant muscle mass. It proudly shows off the largest Graveler fusion it can lift in its pouch.

entry: POKENAME周身扭动的藤蔓，能轻松举起超过十吨的东西。它用这力量，建造迷宫般的花园。
author: .izik
source: The writhing vines covering POKENAME's body can lift over ten tons effortlessly. It uses this strength to build labyrinthine gardens.

entry: POKENAME的花食谱经过精算，选择最适合肌肉生长的品种。它特别护这些花，谁摘，就会被一记强拳打脸。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME consumes a carefully-calculated diet of flowers most cohesive for its muscle growth. It's quite protective of these specific varieties, hitting those who try to pluck them with a powerful punch to the face.

entry: POKENAME爱出风头，几乎不亚于爱训练，会表演力量与滑稽把戏。不过虽力大，对战仍偏防守，想在台上待久些。
author: kobold_hijinks
source: POKENAME love the limelight almost as much as they love to train, performing feats of strength and comedy to entertain crowds. Despite their incredible strength, POKENAME battle defensively, wanting to remain on stage as long as possible.

entry: 它身体充满强大能量，代谢旺盛，肌肉强健。它靠力量打败大对手，寻找满足食欲的办法。
author: infinex21
source: Its body is rife with powerful energy, causing it to have a strong metabolism and to have powerful muscles. It uses it strength to best large foes in search of ways to sate its appetite.

entry: POKENAME体内充满强大龙之能量，很难安静待着。它极其罕见，有时能见到在水下游动。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's body is filled with powerful draconic energy, so it has difficulty staying still. Although extremely rare, it can be found swimming underwater.

entry: 它身体不断剥落角蛋白物质，也不停训练，盼着终有一天能进化。
author: bobosmith01
source: Its body constantly flakes off keratin-based material. It trains tirelessly in the hopes it may one day evolve.

entry: POKENAME用尾尖的手举重，保持体形。通常性情平和，拳力却连石墙也能打塌。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME stays in shape by lifting heavy weights with its hand at the tip of its tail. Although it is a generally peaceful Pokémon, its punches are so powerful that they can even crumble stone walls.

entry: POKENAME使用火属性招式前，头脊会烧到白热。之后，常按节奏迸发火花。
author: .izik
source: Before using a fire move, the ridges on POKENAME's head glow white-hot. Ember bursts often follow in rhythmic patterns.

entry: POKENAME快速拍翼，测量造出的阵风速度，锻炼力量。同类竞赛，可能把许多小宝可梦卷进交错气流。
author: sk372
source: In order to train its strength, POKENAME flaps its wings rapidly to gauge the speed of the wind gusts it creates. Competitions between POKENAME can result in many smaller Pokémon getting caught in the crosswinds.

entry: POKENAME尾巴有力，能轻松弹过战场。动作迅捷，让它能使出复杂空手道技法。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's strong tail lets it bounce across battlefields with ease. Its swift movements enable it to perform complex karate techniques.

entry: 日出前，POKENAME一边大声鸣叫，一边举起大小为自己十倍的原木。人们相信，这仪式能锻炼力量与专注。
author: .izik
source: Before sunrise, POKENAME hoots loudly while lifting logs ten times its size. This ritual is believed to sharpen both strength and focus.

entry: POKENAME抱大石，试着负重短飞。反复练习，既增强力量，也为花园生长腾出空间。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME holds onto large stones and tries to fly short distances while carrying them. It repeats this to build strength and clear space for garden growth.

entry: POKENAME吐耐用的丝，把巨石拖上山坡。这严酷训练，同时磨炼身心。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spins durable silk and uses it to haul boulders up mountain slopes. This harsh training strengthens both mind and body.

entry: POKENAME用喙把大物举过头顶。有人说，托起重物时，它能窥见未来。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME lifts large objects overhead with its beak. Some say when it holds heavy items aloft, it glimpses visions of the future.

entry: POKENAME把圆尾当沙包训练。手臂短，难做复杂动作，因此训练多靠简单直拳、刺拳。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME train by using their round tail as a punching bag. Their stubby arms make it difficult for them to perform complicated maneuvers, so they rely on simple punches and jabs during their training.

entry: POKENAME虽小，却能举起自身体重三十倍的东西。小群个体常在深夜偷走整箱垃圾，连垃圾箱一并搬到更安全的地方。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are extremely strong despite their small size, able to lift thirty times their own body weight. Small packs of these Pokémon will often steal entire dumpsters full of trash, carrying them to a safer location in the dead of night.

entry: POKENAME脸上沉重的手臂，把脖子练得极强。熟练个体甩动全身，力道惊人，常一击打昏敌人。虽然如此强，它却温柔爱玩。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: The heavy arms on POKENAME's face have strengthened its neck immensely. Skilled ones can swing their whole body with stunning force, often knocking out foes in one hit. Despite this power, they're gentle by nature and love to play.

entry: POKENAME尾上的重臂，把背练得极强。出拳常把自己弄倒，不过熟练个体能甩动全身，力道惊人，常一击打昏敌人。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: The heavy arm on POKENAME's tail has strengthened its back immensely. Punching with it often causes it to fall over, though skilled individuals can swing their whole body with stunning force, often knocking out foes in one hit.

entry: POKENAME用有力的手臂，抢公园游客的帽子和小饰品，再拿赃物装饰隐秘巢穴。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its strong arms to snatch hats and trinkets from park visitors. It decorates its hidden nest with the stolen treasures.

entry: POKENAME每天吃营养丰富的树果，维持肌肉，随时准备战斗。它会从背上球茎放刺激花粉，灼痛敌人眼睛，惹其烦躁。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME eats highly nutritious berries every day to keep its body muscular and always ready to fight. To annoy its foes during battles, it releases an irritating pollen from the bulb on its back that makes their eyes burn.

entry: POKENAME训练满意、感到肌肉紧实，背花就会释放怡人香气。它常替训练家搬箱子、重物，测试力量。
author: fiordaliso
source: When POKENAME is satisfied with its training and feels its muscles tighten, it releases a pleasantly fragrant aroma from the flower on its back. To test its strength, it often helps its Trainer carry boxes or heavy objects.

entry: POKENAME破坏性强，用有力手臂拆开木石，找硬物啃。住在人类附近，会严重影响建筑稳定。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are destructive Pokémon that use their powerful arms to pull apart wood and stones so that they have something solid to gnaw on. Their presence around human habitation causes huge issues for the structural stability of the buildings.

entry: POKENAME用翅维持平衡，完成空中打击，动作常像熟练踢拳选手。
author: .izik
source: Using its wings for balance, POKENAME pulls off aerial strikes. Its movements often resemble those of skilled kickboxers.

entry: POKENAME爱举起栖居冰洞里的大冰块，展示力量。准备攻击前，会互相摩擦爪子，磨得锋利。
author: fiordaliso
source: To show off its strength, POKENAME enjoys lifting large chunks of ice that it retrieves from the frozen caves where it lives. When it is about to launch an attack, it sharpens its claws by rubbing them together.

entry: POKENAME平时安静，一闻到蜜就狂暴。挡在它与黏甜美味之间的任何东西，都会挨拳。
author: .izik
source: Normally calm, POKENAME becomes wildly aggressive when it smells honey. It will punch anything between itself and the sticky prize.

entry: POKENAME身上覆着滚烫冒泡的泥，能瞬间硬化成拳，给予碾压重击。
author: .izik
source: Hot, bubbling mud coats POKENAME's body. It can harden the mud instantly to form fists capable of delivering crushing blows.

entry: POKENAME虽无四肢，仍喜欢参加武术训练。它主动让空手道王拿壳试力，供训练家反复打击硬岩，锻炼力量。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME enjoy participating in martial arts training, despite their lack of limbs. They freely offer their shells as a target for Black Belts to test their strength against, letting their trainers repeatedly strike the tough rock to build power.

entry: POKENAME常成群玩耍，一起练武，互相较量力气。
author: krune
source: Often playing in packs, POKENAME can be seen practising martial arts and competing in tests of strength with each other.

entry: 进化后，奔跑快得多，拳力却没有进一步增强。尾巴较弱，只用来作诱饵。
author: krune
source: Having evolved, it has a much higher running speed, but it has not further developed its punching strength. The tail just acts as a decoy and is relatively weak.

entry: POKENAME盘绕的身体肌肉强健，能把石头碾成粉。它专注投入，每天爱训练进步，让训练家骄傲。
author: fiordaliso
source: The coils of POKENAME are extremely strong and muscular, powerful enough to crush a stone into dust. It is a highly dedicated Pokémon that loves training every day to improve and make its Trainer proud.

entry: POKENAME在洞窟群居，彼此支持，鼓励成员尽力训练。每只都能独自推动巨石。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME live together in herds in caverns. They are incredibly supportive and urge other members of the herd to train their hardest. Each one is strong enough to push a large boulder all on their own.

entry: 它能以后腿站一会儿，却更爱四肢行走。打法有突进、冲锋和投掷，鼻子一挥，几乎任何石头都能击碎。
author: bobosmith01
source: While it can stand for some time on its hind legs, it prefers to travel on all fours. Its fighting style includes many lunges, charges, and throws. A single whack from its trunk can obliterate almost any stone.

entry: POKENAME成功举起巨石，就用柔尾分泌的墨，在石上画个大红记号。
author: .izik
source: After successfully lifting a boulder, POKENAME marks it with a large red symbol with ink secreted from its flexible tail.

entry: POKENAME战斗时不停活动，自如切换多种武术。它最爱以踢腿为主的流派，尤其喜欢跆拳道。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME remains constantly in motion during battle, switching fluidly between multiple different styles of martial arts. Its preferred fighting styles are usually those focused on kicks, Taekwondo is a particular favorite.

entry: POKENAME尾端是拳形盘结，会分泌毒汗。一拳就能让敌人中毒、疲惫。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's tail ends in a fist-like coil that secretes toxic sweat. A single punch can leave foes poisoned and tired.

entry: POKENAME爱配大量饮水，享用咸咸的深灰米果。它不只能消除麻痹等状态影响，一袋也能饱很久。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME enjoy a salty bag of Pewter Crunchies, alongside plenty of water to drink. Not only do they remove the effects of paralysis and other conditions, but a bag of Pewter Crunchies also keep them full for a long time.

entry: POKENAME不断练肌肉，既为保护别人，也想给人好印象。它总设计更惊人的力量表演，向朋友和训练家炫耀。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME hones its muscles with constant training for the sake of protecting and impressing others. It constantly comes up with greater shows of strength to show off to its friends and Trainer.

entry: POKENAME用精神力把自己向前发射，打出强拳。不过握拳时，它几乎看不见，因此得在出手前精准瞄准。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME deliver powerful punches by launching themselves forward with psychic power. While their hand is closed, they are virtually blind and rely on precise targeting before attacking.

entry: POKENAME做任何事都极坚定，包括训练。不过它也贪吃，圆胖粗壮的个体十分常见。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is extremely determined in whatever it pursues, including training. However, it is also a big eater: plump and bulky POKENAME are extremely common.

entry: POKENAME虚幻的身体，敌不过重量级拳王，对方有能击中无形身躯的高超技巧。组成身体的每个灵体，会一起练习，改进技术。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME's phantasmal body is no match for heavyweight champions, who have advanced techniques to strike at its incorporeal form. Each spirit that comprises its body practices together to improve its technique.

entry: POKENAME头锤把敌人撞上空中，再接一记猛烈上勾拳。平时，它会打洞顶训练。
author: .izik
source: After launching a foe into the air with a headbutt, POKENAME follows up with a crushing uppercut. It trains by striking cave ceilings.

entry: POKENAME在山脚冥想，让周身硬脊变得几乎无法破坏。
author: .izik
source: Meditating at the base of mountains, POKENAME strengthens the hard ridges covering its body until they are nearly unbreakable.

entry: POKENAME细心看顾野外的尼多一族幼崽，不让它们太闹，保护它们不受伤。肌力强到能把体形大好几倍的宝可梦，扔过肩去。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME carefully watches over young Nidoran in the wild, keeping them from getting too rowdy and protecting them from harm. Its muscle strength is enough that it could toss a Pokémon several times its size over its shoulder.

entry: POKENAME争地盘，会以比力解决，越举越重，直到只剩一只还撑得住。空手道王常找野生个体，一起训练。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Territorial disputes between POKENAME are resolved through contests of strength, the competing Pokémon lifting heavier and heavier objects until only one POKENAME is able to continue. Black Belts will seek wild POKENAME to train alongside.

entry: POKENAME靠专注训练熬过困境，过程能舒压，也让身体充分活动。毒虽强，它更爱用拳自卫。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME persevere through adversity by focusing on training, as the process of training is cathartic and physically engaging. Despite having a potent venom, they prefer to rely on their fists to defend themselves.

entry: 它是个爱练拳的小斗士，总打着池水，自豪地绷起小鳍。POKENAME随时愿意切磋，常挑战大得多的宝可梦。
author: thepandasharky
source: A little fighter that loves to practice its punches by hitting the water in ponds, flexing its tiny flippers with pride. POKENAME is always ready for a spar, often trying to fight Pokémon much bigger than itself.

entry: POKENAME石状手臂能打穿实心金属板。它不停砸巨石成粉，锻炼自己。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's stone-like arms can punch through solid sheets of metal. It trains tirelessly by smashing boulders into dust.

entry: 人们认为，POKENAME被一位拳师的灵魂附身。它常在街头，找凶暴的不法之徒打架。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME is thought to be possessed by the spirit of a fist fighter. It picks fights with violent outlaws on the streets.

entry: POKENAME若尊重训练家，便愿让对方握剑柄。训练家因此得到巨力，能单臂举起自身体重三倍的重物。
author: .fedoraman
source: POKENAME who respect its Trainer will let them hold its hilt. This confers the Trainer with great strength, allowing them to lift three times their own weight with one arm.

entry: 肌肉发达，常在冰冻苔原上组成拉雪橇的队伍。相互交缠的缎带让它们联系紧密。
author: melodydelune
source: These muscular Pokémon are often used in frozen tundras as a sled team. Interlocking their ribbons allows these Pokémon to form a tight bond.

entry: POKENAME每天举带有层叠瀑布构造的巨石训练。仔细观察，才发现那些巨石似乎很像神奥地区。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME train every day by lifting large boulders designed with cascading waterfalls. Closer inspection has shown that the boulders they lift seem to resemble the Sinnoh region.

entry: POKENAME还需大量练习，提升战斗本领。技巧不熟，让对手常有机会趁隙击中。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME needs lots of practice to improve its fighting prowess. Its unrefined technique gives opponents moments of opportunity to land a strike against it.

entry: POKENAME速度惊人，不到一秒就能拉近距离，在敌人眨眼前连打数拳。可惜它常跟不上自己的速度。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME's incredible speed allows them to close the distance between themselves and an opponent in less than a second, delivering a flurry of blows before the opponent can blink. Unfortunately, they often struggle to keep up with their own speed.

entry: POKENAME每天苦练肌肉和波导能力。高强度训练后，一段时间里，能看见波导从身体泛光。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME trains diligently every day to hone its muscles and its aura abilities. After an intense workout regimen, its aura can be seen glowing off its body for a time.

entry: POKENAME太嗜睡，每天只能训练一小时。不过练习虽短，强度却极高。
author: .izik
source: Due to its drowsiness, POKENAME can only train for an hour each day. These sessions are short but brutally intense.

entry: POKENAME体形随时变化很大。训练时细胞大量排气，之后它又会吸入大量空气。通常住在城市不远处。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's size can vary quite a lot depending on the moment. When it trains, its cells release large amounts of air, but it also takes in a lot of air afterwards, too. It typically lives not too far away from urban areas.

entry: POKENAME靠近铁矿，头脊便会震动。它迅速挖下，撕开岩石，直奔金属大餐。
author: .izik
source: The ridges on POKENAME's head vibrate when near iron ore. It digs down rapidly, tearing through stone to reach its metallic feast.

entry: POKENAME每次吃东西，都会伸展、绷紧手臂，同时锻炼臂力和颚力。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME flexes and stretches its arms whenever it eats. This exercise works to strength both the muscles in its arms as well as its jaws simultaneously.

entry: POKENAME热切交战，想不断提升，成为世界最强斗士。远大梦想，让它有动力熬过困难。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME fight with zeal to improve themselves to become the best fighter in the world. These lofty dreams give them the inspiration to push through hardship.

entry: POKENAME每天用意念举重数小时，扩大精神力作用范围。意志极坚定，因此常被推荐给精力旺盛的训练家。
author: fiordaliso
source: To increase the range of its psychic powers, POKENAME spends many hours a day lifting weights with its mind. It is an extremely determined creature, which is why it is often recommended for Trainers with a very energetic personality.

entry: POKENAME常组成小队，一起练得更强。通常会用鼻子举起沉重大石，轮流抛给彼此。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME often pair into small groups to train and strengthen themselves as a team. This usually takes the form of using their noses to lift and toss large heavy rocks to each other in turn.

entry: POKENAME整天挖沙漠，增强肌肉。它能短暂以后腿站起，挥强拳自卫。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME strengthens its muscles by digging through the desert sands throughout the day. It is able to rear up on its hind legs for a short time to deliver powerful punches to defend itself.

entry: POKENAME从头脊释放超音波，趁敌人混乱，吃掉虚弱猎物。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME releases Supersonic waves from the ridges on its head. It uses the resulting confusion to feed on weakened prey.

entry: POKENAME在洞窟滑翔寻找猎物。发现后便迅速下降，送上一记凶猛飞拳。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME glides through caves in search of prey. Once spotted, it descends quickly and delivers a brutal flying punch.

entry: POKENAME拳打洞壁，震松珍贵孔雀石，再贪婪吞吃，增强力量。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME punches cave walls to loosen precious malachite. It greedily devours the stones to fortify its strength.

entry: 传说POKENAME受惊时，能举起整座冰川，不过至今没有证实的报告。
author: .izik
source: Legends claim POKENAME can lift entire glaciers when frightened. However, no verified reports of this feat exist.

entry: POKENAME头上的冰脊冷得危险，哪怕轻碰，也可能冻伤，或立刻冻结。
author: .izik
source: The icy ridges on POKENAME's head are dangerously cold. Even light contact can cause frostbite or instant freezing.

entry: POKENAME还没利牙，因此用手臂撕开猎物。不过比起多数巨牙鲨融合体，它安全得多，遇陌生生物会先摸，不会直接咬。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME does not yet have sharp teeth, so it tears apart prey with its arms. It's much less dangerous to be around than most Sharpedo fusions, as it investigates unfamiliar creatures by touching rather than chomping.

entry: POKENAME飘过沼泽雾，发出令人发寒的叫声。它在找强敌，测试日渐增长的力量。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME drifts through swamp fogs, emitting haunting cries. It seeks strong opponents to test its growing strength upon.

entry: POKENAME拍手，能放出震慑声波，力道能瞬间掀翻小敌人。
author: .izik
source: By clapping its hands together, POKENAME emits stunning sound waves. The force can knock smaller foes off their feet instantly.

entry: 海边施工队得留意POKENAME，它爱偷仓库的混凝土粉。人们推测，它是以为吃下粉末，就能让沙质身体更强。
author: sk372
source: Construction crews in beachfront areas must be wary of POKENAME, as it has a bad habit of stealing concrete powder from their stores. It's thought that it does this under the belief that consuming the powder will strengthen its sand-like body.

entry: POKENAME身上蘑菇，是颇有效的肌肉兴奋剂。不过它很护着，还拥有出奇强的体力，足以赶走想摘的人。
author: sk372
source: The mushrooms on POKENAME's body are a reasonably effective muscle stimulant. However, POKENAME is quite protective of them and packs a surprising amount of physical prowess to deter those who would try to remove them.

entry: POKENAME用强壮手臂砸开硬石，寻找坚固宝石，再替换身上旧宝石，让身体更强。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME uses its powerful arms to smash through hard stones, looking for tough gemstones. It replaces the gems on its body with new ones to make its body even stronger.

entry: POKENAME耳上伸出的肌肉状组织，能举起体形大好几倍的宝可梦。它常吃大量细枝，这习惯被认为有助于惊人力量。
author: theartemis1
source: The muscle-like growths extending from POKENAME's ears are strong enough to lift Pokémon several times its size. It's often seen consuming large quantities of twigs, a habit believed to contribute to its remarkable strength.

entry: POKENAME耳上伸出的肌肉状组织，能举起体形大好几倍的宝可梦。它常吃大量细枝，这习惯被认为有助于惊人力量。
author: theartemis1
source: The muscle-like growths extending from POKENAME's ears are strong enough to lift Pokémon several times its size. It's often seen consuming large quantities of twigs, a habit believed to contribute to its remarkable strength.

entry: POKENAME施展武术时，会吐出厚棕烟，扰乱敌人，让对方更容易被打中。
author: .izik
source: While executing martial arts moves, POKENAME exhales thick brown smoke. The smoke confuses foes, making them easy targets.

entry: POKENAME南瓜般的躯干满是肌肉，能毫不费力地把多根树桩举过头。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's pumpkin-like torso is packed with muscle. It can lift multiple tree stumps over its head without effort.

entry: POKENAME吃饱后，松皮变得沉重，让训练比平常更快。练得够多，远超5吨的物体也能轻松举起。
author: .izik
source: After eating a filling meal, the loose skin on POKENAME's body becomes heavy, allowing it to train faster than normal. With enough practice it can lift well over 5 tons with little effort.

entry: POKENAME头顶黑睡莲叶太重，小腿很难支撑走路。幸好身体浮力足，它便顺流漂动。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME struggles to walk as the black lily pad on its head is extremely heavy for its tiny legs. Fortunately, its body is buoyant enough to float, so it drifts downstream to move.

entry: POKENAME总想训练，许多个体随身带负重盘，保持体形。连休息，也会顶在头上。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are always in the mood for training, and many carry around weighted plates to keep themselves in shape. Even when they are resting, POKENAME carry these plates on their head.

entry: POKENAME通常住在臭氧层，近地个体都是从天坠落。身体几乎全是肌肉，再怎么使用，也从不酸痛。
author: heal_fire
source: POKENAME usually live in the ozone layer of the atmosphere, with those found closer to the ground being the ones who have fallen from the sky. Their bodies are almost entirely made of muscle, which never get sore no matter how much POKENAME use them.

entry: POKENAME不断击打山路巨石，磨炼武术。练得满意，尾焰便会明亮燃烧。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME constantly hones its martial arts techniques by striking the large boulders it finds along mountain trails. When satisfied after training, the flame on its tail burns brightly.

entry: POKENAME体力强、工作勤，是工地常客。不过它靠地下挖掘移动，必须小心，免得削弱地基。
author: bobosmith01
source: A powerful body and hardworking attitude make POKENAME a common sight at construction sites. However, because it moves by tunneling underground, caution is needed to avoid weakening foundations.

entry: POKENAME头上的淤肿微微搏动，附近生物常会头痛。不过和它一起练力，似乎能减轻疼痛。
author: .izik
source: The bruised lump on POKENAME's head pulses faintly. Those nearby often suffer headaches, though training one's strength with POKENAME seems to lessen the pain.

entry: 给它们看猴怪之爪，常会惹其不快，因为它们可能以为来自另一只POKENAME。奇怪现象，源于它们太快下结论。
author: quackquackattack
source: They are known to get upset when presented with a Mankey Paw, as they may believe that the paw came from another POKENAME. This odd phenomenon stems from the fact that they are quick to make assumptions.

entry: POKENAME很易怒，会把怒火撒向周围，常一拳就碎巨石、倒大树。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are very irritable, losing their temper quite easily. They will take their anger out on their surroundings, often shattering boulders and toppling trees with a single punch.

entry: 野生幼年POKENAME常互相热情竞速，发展耐力。格外兴奋时，速度能超过每小时30英里。
author: mepp.
source: In the wild, young POKENAME will often engage in spirited races with each other to develop their stamina. They are known to run over 30mph when particularly excited.

entry: POKENAME给大勺注入大量精神能量，让它重得多。它再拿勺练力，光是带着，肌肉都得逼到极限。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME imbue the large spoons they carry with an abundance of psychic energy, dramatically increasing the weight of the implement. They use the spoon as a means to train their own strength, pushing their muscles to their limits just to carry it.

entry: POKENAME已经力大惊人，仍不断锻炼，想长更多肌肉。健身房里，常见它与健美选手一起训练。
author: mepp.
source: Despite its already incredible strength, POKENAME continuously exercises to build more muscle. It  often trains alongside bodybuilders in fitness gyms.

entry: 融合让POKENAME多了一组强壮的手臂，仿佛提前拥有了进化后的模样。它也变得有些自大，常在对手证明实力前，拒绝动用其中两条手臂。
author: sk372
source: Fusion gifted POKENAME with an extra set of powerful arms, similar to its future evolution. It develops a slight ego as well, often refusing to use two of its arms until an opponent proves themselves.

entry: POKENAME举巨石练肌肉，可同类太像石头，常常举错。被举的POKENAME倒不在意，很乐意帮伙伴长力气。
author: darkweavile428
source: POKENAME train their muscles by lifting up boulders. However, they often end up lifting others of their kind due to their close resemblance to rocks. POKENAME rarely minds though, since they're happy to help others build muscle.

entry: POKENAME把巨石砸碎吃，也会爬山，既锻炼身体，又找石头进食。
author: darkweavile428
source: POKENAME smashes boulders to pieces so it can eat them. It climbs mountains both to train its body and to find boulders to eat.

entry: POKENAME结合肌力和磁力，从卡车快速装卸家电。能举超过体重五十倍的东西，任何货物都能迅速处理。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME expedites loading and unloading appliances from trucks by lifting them with the combined might of muscles and magnets. It can lift more than fifty times its body weight, which makes quick work of any shipment.

entry: POKENAME用一对哑铃训练，想成为更好的斗士。它鼓舞广大无产阶级群众强身，海报上也常作为自我提升的吉祥物。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME train with a pair of dumbbells to become a better fighter. They inspire the proletariat masses to improve their bodies and can be seen on posters as a mascot for self-improvement.

entry: POKENAME用尾巴练举大冰块，锻炼力量。它甚至会陪全群一起玩冰，展示运动精神。
author: mistymagius
source: To train its strength, POKENAME will practice lifting large ice chunks with its tail. It will even play with the ice alongside the rest of its pack in a show of sportsmanship.

entry: POKENAME近身搏斗时，利用黏软身体占优势。它抓抱对手，便能大幅限制活动范围。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME harness the power of their gooey bodies to give them an advantage when they are engaged with hand-to-hand combat. By grappling their opponents with their gooey bodies, they severely limit the range of motion of their foes.

entry: POKENAME行动快、热心帮忙，总想把受伤宝可梦拉回安全处。传闻它倒着移动也毫无障碍，科学家却认为只是无稽之谈。
author: thesilverowls
source: POKENAME are fast-moving helpers, always eager to pull injured Pokémon back to safety. Rumors have it they can move perfectly backwards, but scientists see that as a tall tale.

entry: POKENAME挖过山体，用拳抓树根吃，增强力量与耐力。
author: .izik
source: While digging through mountains, POKENAME grabs tree roots with its fists. Eating them boosts its strength and stamina.

entry: POKENAME打昏敌人，会吃掉残存的梦，获得能量和奇异战斗直觉。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME knocks out a foe, it consumes the remnants of their dreams. This grants it energy and strange battle instincts.

entry: POKENAME训练俯卧撑越多，背上球茎就蓄越多能，随时准备战斗。不过汗有剧毒，锻炼时最好别碰。
author: fiordaliso
source: The more push-ups POKENAME does while training, the more the bulb on its back charges with energy that it can store to always be ready for battle. Its sweat is highly toxic and poisonous, so it is best not to touch it while it is exercising.

entry: POKENAME容易兴奋过度，能量便猛烈向外爆发。学会多种妥善调节情绪的方法后，它便能继续进化。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME easily become overexcited, which causes their energy to explode dramatically outwards. By learning a variety of methods to assist with proper emotional self-regulation, POKENAME can evolve further.

entry: POKENAME拳头老打空，就会烦躁得危险。若再受挑衅，便会炸出一股能量。
author: .izik
source: When its punches miss too often, POKENAME grows dangerously frustrated. If provoked further, it explodes in a burst of energy.

entry: POKENAME身子虽小，仍能轻松举起高达五十吨的东西。有人说，它在祖先埋葬处附近冥想训练。
author: .izik
source: Despite its tiny frame, POKENAME can lift up to fifty tons with ease. Some say it trains by meditating near burial sites of its ancestors.

entry: 据说POKENAME用骨作武器，是想给对手一点胜算。若它把骨头扔开，改用拳，便代表你真惹怒了它。
author: sk372
source: It's said that POKENAME uses a bone as a weapon to give others a fighting chance. Should it throw its bone to the side and aim to use its own fists, you've succeeded in making it truly mad.

entry: POKENAME把骨头当回力镖甩出，打得敌人踉跄，再冲上前，快速劈打、踢击，结束战斗。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME flings its bone like a boomerang to stagger foes. It then charges in with rapid chops and kicks to finish the fight.

entry: POKENAME的舌头能轻松举起超过100磅的物品。战斗时，它常用舌头和尾巴攻击，只有必要时，才把肌肉发达的手臂当作最后手段。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME's tongue easily lifts objects weighing over 100lbs. In battle, it attacks frequently with its tongue and tail, but will use its muscle-packed arms as a last resort if needed.

entry: POKENAME几乎每天训练，哪怕其余身体耗掉大半养分。手臂不断收缩，让身体维持良好状态。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME almost never skip a day of training, even when the rest of their body uses up most of their nutrients. The constant flexing of their arm ensures that their body remains in good shape.

entry: POKENAME拳打大石清山路，再用角向前冲，同时训练力量、速度。
author: .izik
source: Clearing mountain paths, POKENAME punches aside large stones. It then charges forward with its horn to train both strength and speed.

entry: POKENAME臂肌直接关联钻头角的旋转功能。四肢绷得越紧，尖角就转得越快。
author: sk372
source: The muscles in POKENAME's arms are directly tied to the rotation function of its drill-like horn; the harder it flexes its limbs, the faster its pointed horn will spin.

entry: POKENAME用钻头，从峭壁切下石板，再举最重的过头，练出惊人力量。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its drill to carve slabs of stone from cliffs. It lifts the heaviest pieces overhead to build its formidable strength.

entry: POKENAME喜欢帮别人变强，富蛋白的蛋，只送给打动它的对象。它会用力收腹、蜷起圆身体来训练。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME enjoys helping others grow stronger and offers its protein-rich egg only to those who impress it. It trains by curling its round body in powerful abdominal movements.

entry: POKENAME肌肉看着惊人，其实并不强。想分享蛋时，连敲开自己蛋壳，都很困难。
author: .jerden
source: Although its muscles look impressive, POKENAME isn't actually very strong. It has difficulty even cracking the shell of its own egg when it tries to share it with others.

entry: POKENAME的仪式，把舞蹈和炫肌怪异结合。观者会忍不住加入，不过身材不合口味的，会遭它严厉评判。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME commits to a ritual involving a bizarre combination of dancing and flexing its muscles. Viewers are compelled to join in, though POKENAME harshly judges those who don't have the ideal physique for its tastes.

entry: POKENAME出拳会导入极高热量，一击就能在石头上，留下熔化的拳印。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME channels extreme heat into its fists when punching. A single strike can leave molten impressions in stone.

entry: POKENAME以猛烈空手劈打昏敌人，再变成对方，完美模仿动作。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME knocks out foes with a devastating Karate Chop. It then transforms into them, imitating their movements perfectly.

entry: POKENAME经常绷紧尾巴，锻炼下半身强壮的肌肉。尾端的手握力惊人，能轻松抓住想捕食它的生物，远远扔出去。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME flexes its tail regularly to exercise the powerful muscles in its lower half. The hand at the end has spectacular grip strength, making it easy for it to grab those who would try to prey on it and send them flying.

entry: POKENAME绷起双尾的一对拳头，向别人炫耀。观者若不够惊叹，它就羞愧尴尬，噘嘴跑走。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME shows off to others by flexing the pair of fists on its dual tails. If its viewer doesn't act sufficiently impressed, it runs off pouting in shame and embarrassment.

entry: POKENAME采树果备冬，却不喜欢异奇果的干涩味。肌肉有力，让它一次能搬许多果。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME gather berries so that they have food during winter, but do not like the dry flavor of the Wiki Berry. Their muscles allow them to carry many berries at the same time.

entry: POKENAME身子虽小，力量却格外强。玩耍时，常把挡路的汽车、沙发都推开。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME is exceptionally strong for its small size. It is known for pushing cars and couches out of its way when it is playing.

entry: POKENAME是儿童武术班的理想老师，耐心又爱被摸，也能示范完美拳法。它会大声拍手，吸引注意。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME is the perfect teacher at children's martial arts classes. It is very patient and likes to be petted, but can show the perfect technique for punching. It claps its hands together loudly to get attention.

entry: POKENAME强颚能把花岗岩啃成块，再拿石头练力，常一次带上几十块。
author: .izik
source: With powerful jaws, POKENAME gnaws granite into chunks. It uses these stones for strength training, often carrying dozens at once.

entry: POKENAME用有力手臂铲土，挖入地下。不挖时，就向周围宝可梦展示力量。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME burrows underground by shoveling dirt with their powerful arm. When they are not digging underground, they are flexing their strength to Pokémon around them.

entry: POKENAME用强壮前肢拨开密叶、岩石，找块茎和根。它靠利牙啃穿树皮，吃营养丰富的植物部分。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME use their powerful forelimbs to pry apart dense foliage and rocks to get to tubers and roots. They feed on the nutrient-rich parts of the plants with their sharp teeth, biting clean through the bark.

entry: 野生POKENAME举冰块练臂。不过一被精灵球收服，就会拿走训练家器材，很少归还。
author: fiordaliso
source: In the wild, POKENAME lifts chunks of ice to strengthen its arm muscles. But once it's caught inside a Poké Ball, it takes its Trainer's equipment and rarely gives it back.

entry: 蜂蜜味会让POKENAME暴怒，乱打乱踢，直到找到蜜源、吞吃完才停。
author: .izik
source: The scent of honey drives POKENAME into a violent rage. It punches and kicks wildly until it finds and devours the honey source.

entry: 有训练家报告，自己的POKENAME会全神贯注，开始快速冒泡。研究人员推测，它是想变出手臂来展示肌肉，不过尚无成功的记录。
author: sk372
source: Trainers have reported seeing their POKENAME focus intensely and begin bubbling at a high rate. Researchers theorize it is attempting to manifest arms to flex with, but no successful attempt has been recorded.

entry: POKENAME浑身覆着滚烫的紫色泥浆，能形成临时肢体。它用这些泥浆手臂拆解树木，获取食物。
author: .izik
source: Hot purple mud covers POKENAME's body, forming temporary limbs. It uses these mud arms to break down trees for sustenance.

entry: POKENAME浑身覆着滚烫的紫色泥浆，能变成坚硬的拳头。一击就能同时烧伤、打伤敌人。
author: .izik
source: Hot, purple mud coats POKENAME's body, shifting into hardened fists. A single strike can burn and batter foes at the same time.

entry: POKENAME安静等生物靠近，正盼个借口炫力。落进肌肉触手的掌握中，就很难逃。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME calmly lies in wait for other creatures to come near, itching for any reason to show off its strength. Anything that falls into the clutches of its muscular tentacles will have a difficult time escaping.

entry: POKENAME整天锻炼上身。可下身太小，偶尔会失衡翻倒。
author: krune
source: POKENAME spends all day exercising its upper body. Its small lower body sometimes causes it to tilt over.

entry: POKENAME最高时速60千米，拳力胜过顶尖拳击手。人类已经明白，别去惹怒这只强大的宝可梦。尾巴力量不大，只是诱饵。
author: krune
source: POKENAME can run at a top speed of 60 km/h, and its punches are stronger than those of the best boxers. Humans have learned to not anger this mighty Pokémon. The tail does not hold much strength and is simply a decoy.

entry: POKENAME手臂覆着透明、黏稠的毒。哪怕擦中一下，也会让敌人虚弱、失去方向感。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's arms are coated with a clear, sticky poison. Even a glancing blow can leave foes weakened and disoriented.

entry: 锻炼中的POKENAME产奶，含大量蛋白质与排出的脂肪，却普遍被认为难喝。据说一蹬腿或挥拳，连肯泰罗也能打飞。
author: bobosmith01
source: The milk of an in-training POKENAME is full of protein and excreted fat, but it's generally considered to taste terrible. A buck of its legs or a punch from its arms is said to send even a Tauros flying.

entry: POKENAME的本体无臂，却能瞬间造出手臂般的数字构造。骗子常滥用惊人展示，专骗对身材缺乏自信的人。
author: icelevelincarnate
source: Although the body of this fusion lacks arms, it can create digital constructs resembling arms instantly. The impressive displays POKENAME can create are often abused by scammers preying on an individual's low self-image of their body.

entry: POKENAME有力的手掌，轻易挖过砂砾。它造隧道，同时锻炼耐力与精准。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's mighty hands dig effortlessly through gravel and sand. It creates tunnels to train both endurance and precision.

entry: POKENAME服侍训练家时，满是喜悦，旅行途中常帮忙带装备，也借此维持最佳体魄。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME radiates joy whenever it serves its Trainer, usually by carrying their equipment while they travel. Doing this helps keep it in peak physical condition.

entry: POKENAME没有真正实体，仍很强，也爱炫力。它用幽灵般的力量，不必触碰，就能举汽车等重物。
author: sk372
source: Though POKENAME lacks a truly physical form, it is still quite powerful and boastful of its strength. Using ghost-like powers, it can lift heavy objects such as cars without needing to physically touch them.

entry: 健身房常让POKENAME保护练大重量的人。好胜天性让它鼓励受托者突破，也仔细监测训练。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME commonly are put to work within exercise gyms and serve as spotters for people looking to do heavy lifts. Their competitive nature means that they encourage their assigned humans to greater heights whilst carefully monitoring their training.

entry: POKENAME察觉飓风，就用头上手臂指路，引导别人避险。它还以强击清掉碎屑，开出通路。
author: .izik
source: If it senses a hurricane, POKENAME uses the arm on its head to guide others to safety. It clears debris with powerful strikes to open paths.

entry: 据说看似戴金色手套的POKENAME变体，获近乎无限力量，一响指就能抹去半个世界。常见它寻找色彩鲜明的宝石。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME variants that appear to be wearing a golden gauntlet are said to be blessed with almost infinite power, and could eliminate half the world with a snap. It is commonly seen searching for vividly-colored gemstones.

entry: POKENAME爱挺着健美肌肉昂首走路，也爱在湖边砸巨石，试试力气。它骄傲自负，常在旁人面前绷紧肌肉炫耀。
author: thepandasharky
source: POKENAME loves strutting around with a proud stance and toned muscles, it loves to test its strength by cracking boulders near lakes. It is a Pokémon with a lot of pride and ego, often seen flexing and showing off in front of others.

entry: POKENAME头脊磁性极强，永远知道北方，因此从不迷路。
author: .izik
source: The ridges on POKENAME's head are highly magnetic. It can always sense which direction is north, and it uses this ability to never lose its way.

entry: 年老体弱的人，医生可能建议养POKENAME，因为握剑柄能增强力量。不过它受腰带上限制力量的护符约束，谁也不许摘。
author: .fedoraman
source: For people who have grown weak with age, doctors may recommend a POKENAME for its ability to amplify the strength of a person who holds its hilt. Its power is limited by the Power Save charm on its belt, which it lets no one remove.

entry: POKENAME力量与怒气无匹，也有强烈父性本能。谁敢当面伤害孩子，就注定承受无尽怒火。
author: sk372
source: A warrior of unparalleled strength and rage, POKENAME also possesses a fierce paternal instinct. Anything that harms a child in its presence is doomed to suffer its boundless wrath.

entry: POKENAME能轻松搬运重物，因此常参与建筑工作。工作能锻炼身体，它们很喜欢。
author: melodydelune
source: POKENAME are often used in construction for their ability to carry heavy objects with ease. They enjoy the work due to the exercise they get from it.

entry: POKENAME常担任工头，协助豪力施工、搬运。不过为了证明力量，有时会揽下太多工作。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME are often appointed as the head of labor in some fields, assisting Machoke with construction and moving efforts. It sometimes takes on too much work for itself in an effort to prove its strength, however.

entry: 敌人离得远，POKENAME便从掌发射祖母绿，切伤对方。身形虽厚重，却偏爱说话轻柔、富艺术气质的训练家。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: When far away from opponents, POKENAME will fire emeralds from their palms to slice their enemies. Despite their bulk, they seem to gravitate towards soft-spoken, artistic Trainers.

entry: POKENAME看起来总在建造东西，却从未发现过它造出的建筑。
author: valtsuri
source: POKENAME always appears to be making something. However, no structures made by this Pokémon have been found.

entry: POKENAME用精湛步法迅速闪避。只有拳头能与步法媲美，一拳便能打穿实心钢铁。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME swiftly dodges attacks with its refined footwork. Its footwork is only matched by its punches, which can punch holes into solid steel.

entry: 它控制电子健身器械，把锻炼强度调得尽可能高。它想帮人强身，却大大高估人类承受能力。
author: hophoppip
source: It takes control of electronic exercise equipment to make workouts as straining as possible. It wants to help humans get fit, but it greatly overestimates how much exercise a human can handle.

entry: POKENAME想抱训练家，两个头都得合作。若其中一个被冷落，就很难得到它的拥抱。
author: quackquackattack
source: Whenever POKENAME want to hug their Trainer, both heads need to cooperate. Earning a hug from POKENAME is difficult if the Trainer neglects one of the heads.

entry: POKENAME精力多，喜欢陪同伴打闹。摔角手来挑战，它很高兴，因为有机会试新技。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have lots of energy and enjoy roughhousing with their peers. They love when wrestlers come to them to demand a wrestling match because they get a chance to try new techniques.

entry: POKENAME的壳，其实是一层致密发达的肌肉，靠不断撞岩壁训练。它极能忍痛，却怕一切稍像针的东西。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its shell is actually a dense layer of highly developed muscles that POKENAME constantly trains by slamming itself against rocky walls. It has an incredibly high tolerance for pain, yet is terrified of anything that even remotely resembles a needle.

entry: POKENAME彼此交战，会挥尾拳，临时打出强击。尾上燃烧能量直接随斗志变化，输就暗，赢就亮。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME battle each other by swinging fists on their tails to deliver powerful, makeshift punches. The energy burning along a POKENAME's tail is directly tied to its fighting spirit, dimming if the POKENAME loses and burning brighter if it wins.

entry: POKENAME用惊人的力量制住猎物，再将其吸干。随后，它会飞回黑暗洞窟中的家睡觉。
author: .izik
source: Using its immense strength, POKENAME restrains prey before draining them dry. It then flies to its dark cave home to sleep.

entry: POKENAME用手臂撑地，把自己甩得高速滚动，攀墙、上屋顶也很快。
author: camtft
source: POKENAME roll their body at high speeds by flinging themselves with their arms against the ground. They easily scale walls and roofs at a quick pace.

entry: POKENAME很了解训练家的健康。若食物中毒或恶心，它就去找源头，试着狠狠痛打一番。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are quite attuned to their Trainer's health. If their Trainer suffers from food poisoning or nausea, POKENAME will seek out the source and try to beat it up.

entry: POKENAME挥动手臂般的翅膀，翱翔天空。强劲滑翔，轻松带它往返山峰。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME soars through the sky, waving its arm-like wings. Its powerful glides carry it between mountain peaks with ease.

entry: POKENAME臂中腺体产出黏稠黑液，帮助肌肉在激烈战斗中正常运作。
author: hophoppip
source: Glands in POKENAME's arms produce a viscous black fluid that keeps its muscles in working order for strenuous battles.

entry: 它允许训练家藏进假屋避险，再用巨臂，击退任何想攻进来的敌人。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: It will allow its trainer to hide from threats inside its faux house. It will then use its massive arms to repel any foe that may attempt to breach.

entry: 会先用强壮的手臂攻击，再躲进像大内裤一样的东西下面。那其实只是蘑菇，却带着一种独特的气味。
author: robosoup
source: It attacks with powerful arms, then appears to hide under huge underpants. This is really just a mushroom, but it bears a distinctive odor.

entry: 据说POKENAME若放下尾部负重，能跑得比小火马快。不过它爱炫力，一边松握杠铃，一边增强蓄能焰袭。
author: ghostslythe
source: It is said if POKENAME ever dropped the weight in its tail, it could run faster than Ponyta. However, it enjoys showing off its strength, holding the barbell in a loose grip while powering up its Flame Charge.

entry: POKENAME鼻孔蒸汽含类似类固醇的气体。吸入可能促进肌肉生长，却常引发严重疾病。
author: .izik
source: Steam from POKENAME's nostrils carries a steroid-like vapor. Inhaling it may boost muscle growth - but often causes severe illness.

entry: POKENAME大手也能当翅，滑翔远距。战斗时，还会从嘴放出团团粉末。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's large hands double as wings, letting it glide great distances. In battle, it releases clouds of powder from its mouth.

entry: POKENAME虽由棉花糖构成，身体却结实惊人。因为它每天最多花20小时，锻炼、训练战技。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: Despite being made of candyfloss, POKENAME's body is incredibly solid. This is due to POKENAME spending up to 20 hours each day exercising and training its fighting skills.

entry: POKENAME有力的手臂，能打碎本来无法穿过的岩石，也把捕食者远远扔走，让它继续随意挖掘。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's powerful arms allow it to shatter otherwise impenetrable stones and hurl predators far away. This allows POKENAME to continue digging wherever it pleases.

entry: 为免被太阳晒干，它只在夜里从海里出来。一则长期流传的恐怖海滩怪物故事，如今已知描述的就是它。
author: hophoppip
source: To avoid drying out in the sun, it only emerges from the ocean at night. One enduring story about a terrifying beach-dwelling cryptid is now known to be describing this Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME从小巷伏击旅人，猛砸地面吓人，再抢贵重物，装点巢穴。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME ambushes travelers from alleyways, slamming the ground to startle them. It steals valuables to decorate its lair.

entry: POKENAME不停切磋训练，不过常被怒火冲昏头，结果把双方都打成重伤。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME will spar with each other constantly as a form of training. Their anger will usually get the best of them during these fights, often leaving them both with serious injuries.

entry: POKENAME用肌肉手臂，帮训练家搬极重物。遇到真正强敌，它会从嘴边喷小火，展示兴奋与喜悦。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME uses its muscular arms to help its Trainer move extremely heavy objects. When facing a truly powerful opponent, it puffs bursts of fire from its lips to show how thrilled and delighted it is.

entry: POKENAME在山顶冥想，让力量贯穿全身。若不冥想，就会酸痛疲惫。
author: .izik
source: Meditating atop mountains, POKENAME channels its strength through its body. Without meditation, it suffers aching fatigue.

entry: 融合让POKENAME下个形态的一部分，提早出现。不过它控制不了多出的强力肢体，十分苦恼。
author: sk372
source: Fusion has caused part of POKENAME's next form to manifest prematurely. POKENAME is not in control of the powerful extra limb, causing it no small amount of distress.

entry: POKENAME耐力强，也渴望变强，常连练数日，很少休息。长训需喝大量液体保持水分，训练家往往得花上数千。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME possess a high endurance and drive to become stronger, often pushing themselves to train for days with few breaks. POKENAME require a lot of liquids to stay hydrated for their extensive training, often costing their Trainers thousands.

entry: POKENAME在轰鸣瀑布下冥想，磨炼坚不可摧的核心力量。只用一根手指，它也能举起巨石。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME trains beneath roaring waterfalls to forge an unbreakable core. It can lift massive boulders using just a single finger.

entry: POKENAME精通空手道、柔术，把石身当武器。只需几次快招，就能推倒多数对手。
author: .izik
source: A master of both karate and jiu-jitsu, POKENAME uses its rocky body as a weapon. It can topple most foes in just a few swift moves.

entry: POKENAME看见同类滚动，就想中途拦住，测试力量。若成功，被拦者就会承认对方更强，听从所有命令。
author: darkweavile428
source: If POKENAME sees another of its kind, it will try to stop them midroll to test their strength. Should POKENAME succeed, the one who was stopped acknowledges the other as superior and will follow their every command.

entry: POKENAME边滚边使精准的空手道式动作。速度惊人，让敌人难猜下一招。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME rolls while performing precise karate-like maneuvers. Its surprising speed leaves opponents struggling to predict its next move.

entry: 野生POKENAME相当麻烦，急着炫力，常冲向路人，来一记“玩玩而已”的横臂撞击，结果往往把人打昏。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a rather troublesome entity in the wild. In its eager haste to show off its strength, it has a tendency to run at people and hit them with a "playful" clothesline, often knocking them unconscious.

entry: POKENAME跑向空地上的旅人，绷肌炫耀，想得到赞叹。骄傲摆完姿势，又跑去找新观众。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME gallops up to travelers in open fields, flexing to gain admiration. After posing proudly, it runs off to find new admirers.

entry: POKENAME喜欢帮别人远途搬重物。别人觉得累的事，它却当挑战。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME enjoy helping others move heavy items over long distances. What many see as exhausting, POKENAME sees as a challenge.

entry: POKENAME远比外表强。有说法称，拿掉尾上沉重大舌贝，力量会更大，不过没人检验过这推测。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME is far stronger than it appears. Some say that removing the heavy Shellder from its tail will increase its power, but none have tested this theory.

entry: 三颗头不断互相头槌，锻炼战斗本领。中间的头会操纵另外两个头，对敌人拳打啃咬。
author: skymaster426
source: The three heads constantly headbutt one another to train for battle. The middle head uses the other two to punch and bite at opponents.

entry: 它们常在嘉年华、马戏团担任大力士。不过真正热爱的，其实是抛接杂耍。
author: kiwiarms
source: They are often employed as strongmen for carnivals and circuses. Their true passion, however, is juggling.

entry: POKENAME很护选定的闹鬼地点，会用强壮手臂，强行把其他幽灵属性驱逐出去。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is territorial over the places it chooses to haunt. It will forcibly exorcise other Ghost types from the premises using its powerful arms.

entry: POKENAME想在其他幽灵属性中证明力量。浮手会不停追敌，非得拳头打中才罢休。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME seeks to prove its might among other Ghost-type Pokémon. Its floating hands will chase after an opponent unceasingly until its punches connect.

entry: POKENAME巨钳由肌肉、骨头和皮肤组成，没有甲壳素外层，因此不能安全脱落。它积极热切，有正确指引就不难训练。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's large pincer is composed of muscle, bone, and skin, and lacks a chitinous outer layer, so it cannot safely come off. It is very driven and eager in personality, so it isn't hard to train with proper direction.

entry: POKENAME营养充足，肌肉就更大、更有线条。练力前，它会先晒太阳，多攒能量。
author: dodoowner_
source: If POKENAME gets proper nutrients, their muscles will be larger and more defined. They sunbathe before strength training to have more energy.

entry: POKENAME快拳如闪电，能压倒敌人，不过打完便累。它输不起，无法取胜时，不少个体会气得爆炸。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME launch lightning-fast punches to overwhelm their opponent but get tired after unleashing their attacks. Their poor sportsmanship leads many of them to explode in anger if they are unable to achieve victory.

entry: POKENAME用旋转角，从崖边切下板岩。黎明举过头顶，作为每天训练。
author: .izik
source: Its rotating horn carves slate from cliff sides. At dawn, POKENAME lifts the slabs above its head as a form of daily training.

entry: POKENAME虽热爱健美，手臂却总长不了多少肌肉。它转当私教鼓励别人，分享高蛋白蛋，让增肌效果最好。
author: .jerden
source: While it has an enthusiasm for bodybuilding, POKENAME's arms never gain much muscle. It encourages others as a personal trainer instead, sharing high-protein eggs to maximize their gains.

entry: POKENAME能给拳充电，打出强力雷电拳。风暴中，它会激动得不停朝空气挥拳。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME can charge their fists with electricity to deliver forceful thunder punches. During storms, they become so agitated that they will constantly punch the air.

entry: 宝可梦篮球赛常让POKENAME担任防守。四条巨臂接球配合无间，凶脾气也容易吓住敌队球员，因此很擅长这位置。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME are commonly positioned as defenders in Pokémon basketball games. They excel in that position because of their four massive arms that seamlessly handle the ball and their fierce tempers, which easily intimidate opposing players.

entry: POKENAME喜欢在外海战斗，以巨力和快拳拆毁整船。它泳技完美，蛇形尾也能帮助陆行。
author: actliux
source: POKENAME enjoy fighting on the open sea, using their immense strength to break down entire ships with rapid flurries of punches. They are impeccable swimmers, though they can also move on land thanks to their serpent-like tail.

entry: POKENAME身体虽如胶冻，力量却惊人，四臂能打出重击。它会随面对的敌人种类，改变身上腰带的外观。
author: fiordaliso
source: Despite its gelatinous body, it possesses incredible power, and its four arms can deliver very powerful blows. POKENAME changes the appearance of the belt on its body depending on the type of opponent it faces.

entry: POKENAME栖在高石柱、尖塔上，完全不动，直到猎物出现。接着俯冲，一击解决。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: POKENAME perches on tall stone pillars and steeples and remains perfectly still until it sees its prey. It swoops down and takes out its target with one hit.

entry: POKENAME总半睡半醒，常在对战中途睡着。它低估自己力量，据报告，想抱训练家时，曾弄断好几根肋骨。
author: seanothan_23
source: POKENAME are always half asleep, usually dozing off in the middle of a battle. They often underestimate their own strength, reportedly breaking multiple of their trainers ribs while trying to give them a hug.

entry: POKENAME猛拍双翼，劲道常让附近生物失去方向。谁倒霉挨到翅膀本身，很快就败。
author: camtft
source: POKENAME often smack their wings together with such ferocity that it disorients anyone nearby. Anyone unfortunate enough to get smacked by the wings themselves suffers a quick defeat.

entry: POKENAME双翼强大，一拍就能吹飞敌人。周身电力气场凝实，甚至能打出强劲雷电拳。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME have powerful wings, and one flap can blow away foes. The aura of electricity that surrounds them is solid enough to deliver powerful thunder punches.

entry: POKENAME身子小，四肢和多尾却力量惊人。它先用精神力定敌，再挥尾拳，打出100连击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's small stature belies a lot of power in both its limbs and its multiple tails. It uses its psychic powers to hold opponents in place before delivering a 100-punch combo with its tail-fists.

entry: POKENAME的手臂肌肉发达，却不够灵巧，织不出复杂的网。它便改用一根强韧的丝当作套索，缠住猎物，拉近后再用拳头打到昏迷。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's muscular arms lack the dexterity to weave complex webs, so it instead ensnares prey by using a single strong thread like a lasso. Once a target has been reeled in, the fists beat it into unconsciousness.

entry: POKENAME力大，飞行也能举巨石，常每天改搬更重的石头训练。
author: .izik
source: Using its immense strength, POKENAME lifts large boulders even while in flight. It often trains by carrying heavier stones each day.

entry: 野生POKENAME独居森林，用强臂挖洞，白天睡，夜里再出来猎食。
author: cobalt0135
source: Wild POKENAME live solitary lives within forests. They use their mighty arms to create burrows for when they sleep during the day, then they come out at night to hunt prey.

entry: POKENAME战斗架势会抬高手臂，看似从头部长出，用来吓敌。其实，它更希望完全避免冲突。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: In its fighting stance, POKENAME is able to bring its arms up so they look like they are coming out of its head. It does this to intimidate opponents, as it would much rather avoid conflict altogether.

entry: POKENAME战斗架势会抬高手臂，看似从头部长出，用来吓敌。其实，它更希望完全避免冲突。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: In its fighting stance, POKENAME is able to bring its arms up so they look like they are coming out of its head. It does this to intimidate opponents, as it would much rather avoid conflict altogether.

entry: POKENAME没有眼，难判断朝向。不过只要把脸中央红宝石对准太阳，就能找到方向。
author: theaceofhearts0306
source: Due to its lack of eyes, POKENAME struggles with orienting itself. However, when POKENAME aligns the ruby centered on its face with the sun, it is then able to gain a sense of direction.

entry: POKENAME压低身体，用头上多出的一双手抓敌，再举起远扔。额外双手也能攀树，任一只，都撑得起全身重量。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME will lower its body to pick up foes with the extra pair of hands on its head, then lift and throw them long distances. The extra hands are also used to climb trees, and POKENAME can hold up its entire body weight with just one of them.

entry: POKENAME沿登山小路爬，捡粗心旅人丢下的垃圾。每周末整群出动，把巨大垃圾捆运往最近填埋场，让家园整洁。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME crawl near mountain hiking trails in order to pick up garbage left behind by careless hikers. They come out en masse every weekend to carry massive bundles of trash to the nearest landfill, ensuring their homes remain clean and tidy.

entry: 四条手臂让POKENAME更易平衡巨大的上身与小小的下身。腰带大小标明地位，较大的那条属于首领。
author: krune
source: With four arms, POKENAME can more easily balance its massive upper body against its tiny lower body. The size of its belt symbolises its place in the hierachy, with the bigger one belonging to the leader.

entry: POKENAME平时多用六肢行走，面对强敌时则以后腿站起，用强壮的手臂战斗。
author: darkweavile428
source: Though it's usually seen walking on all sixes, POKENAME will stand on its hind legs and use its powerful arms to fight against tough opponents.

entry: POKENAME凶猛保护训练家的家，臂力足以与暴走铁掌力士角力，把对方推退。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are fierce protectors of their Trainer's households. POKENAME have enough strength in their arms to wrestle back a rampaging Hariyama.

entry: POKENAME战斗会以尖头冠为轴旋转，四臂乱挥。力量惊人，攻势能撕开整栋建筑，沿途留下毁灭。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME spin on their pointed crests during combat, swinging their four arms wildly. These Pokémon possess incredible strength, tearing through entire buildings in their assault, leaving destruction in their wake.

entry: 别看POKENAME体形如此，力量却极强。腰带挥击，劲道足以碎骨。
author: mistymagius
source: Despite their size, POKENAME are incredibly strong. Swings from their belt are powerful enough to shatter bone.

entry: POKENAME威吓地一瞪，就能麻痹敌人。它先用尾缠住，限制行动，再连出快拳。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are capable of paralyzing foes with a menacing glare. They wrap their tail around foes to restrict movement before they unleash a flurry of punches.

entry: 它始终在锻炼：吃饭慢跑，睡着双腿像蹬车，连挤奶也做俯卧撑、卷腹。能抓握的尾巴，也参与倒挂仰卧起坐等训练。
author: bobosmith01
source: It is always working out: it will jog while eating, do bicycle kicks in its sleep, and will even do push ups or crunches while being milked. It has prehensile tails that it also incorporates in workouts, such as upside-down sit ups.

entry: POKENAME巢洞里有一块巨石，视为最大挑战。不过它仍不停找更大的，测试力量。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME keeps a massive boulder in its cavern home that it deems its greatest challenge. POKENAME constantly searches for larger stones to test its strength.

entry: POKENAME结合怪力的肌肉、洛奇亚的强翼，四臂能打出无匹力量。它爱摔抱巨石，再扔进海，炫耀本领。
author: msdawgs
source: POKENAME combines Machamp's incredible muscle with Lugia's mighty wings, using its four powerful arms to strike with unmatched force. It enjoys flexing its strength by wrestling massive boulders and tossing them into the sea.

entry: POKENAME尾巴是重负，起初压得它走不远。后来慢慢练出力量，便能拖着尾巴行进。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's tail is a heavy weight. At first, it is unable to walk far from the weight, but over time, it develops the strength to lug its tail around.

entry: POKENAME战斗时将长尾当鞭，高速抽打其他宝可梦。尾内有密实骨头加固，帮助承受冲击。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME wield their long tails as whips during battles with other Pokémon, lashing out with them at high speed. Their tails are reinforced internally with dense bones to help them survive the impacts.

entry: POKENAME投射又强又准，下方双臂捡石，上方双臂投出，射速惊人。岩甲保护它免遭攻击。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME tosses projectiles with both power and accuracy, picking up rocks with its two lower arms and tossing them with the two above to achieve astounding rates of fire. Their rocky armor protects them from the attacks of others.

entry: 它手臂带电，出拳就能电击敌人。四条肢体一同抓住目标，电量足以使其昏倒。
author: .jerden
source: Its arms are charged with an electric current. Any foe it punches will be shocked, and grabbing a foe with all four of its limbs will deliver enough electricity to knock them unconscious.

entry: 它们虽小，四臂却能把巨石碎成细砂，不知疲倦。肌肉极致密，一绷紧，就能挡退许多物理打击。
author: infinex21
source: Though small, their four arms are strong enough to reduce boulders to fine grains without tiring. Their muscles are so dense that, by tensing, they can repel many physical blows.

entry: POKENAME整天举倒下的大树干，保持壮观肌肉。汗液飘进空气，带着清香，还能净化周围。
author: fiordaliso
source: It spends its days lifting large fallen tree trunks to maintain its impressively muscular physique. The sweat POKENAME releases into the air carries a fragrant aroma capable of purifying the surrounding atmosphere.

entry: POKENAME痴迷健身，给训练家电子设备塞满垃圾信息。越被忽略，弹窗内容就越咄咄逼人。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is so obsessed with working out at the gym that it floods its Trainer's digital devices with spam messages. The more it is ignored, the more aggressive its pop-up messages become.

entry: POKENAME两对利爪，挖掘和劈敌都很有效，因此常用于华蓝洞窟、白银山等险地的发掘。
author: empty_set
source: Its two pairs of claws make POKENAME exceptionally effective at both burrowing and slicing up foes.  Due to this, it has been used in excavations in treacherous places like Cerulean Cave and Mt. Silver.

entry: POKENAME怒时四拳同时砸地，让火焰冲击波飞快扫过战场。
author: mepp.
source: When angered, POKENAME strikes the ground with all four of its fists at once. The impact sends fiery shockwaves racing across the battlefield.

entry: POKENAME身体几乎全肌肉，能搬高达20吨的东西。它把巨石拖回领地，筑墙阻挡入侵者。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME's bodies are almost entirely muscle, allowing them to carry up to 20 tons. They haul boulders to their territories, constructing walls to keep intruders out.

entry: POKENAME拳力足以形成小黑洞。训练家受威胁时最危险，它会释放全部精神与身体力量护主，常造成毁灭性后果。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Its punches are strong enough to form small black holes. POKENAME is at its most dangerous when there is a threat to its Trainer, as it will unleash all of its mental and physical strength to protect them, often to devastating effect.

entry: POKENAME大脑详细记录见过的每种武术，再融入独特打法：六条强健肢体都能快击，金属身体也能猛撞。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's brain keeps a detailed record of every martial art it observes. It adapts these moves into its own unique fighting style, featuring rapid strikes from any of its six muscular limbs, as well as forceful slams with its metallic body.

entry: POKENAME没实体可锻炼，却痴迷力量、耐力训练。据说戴上它显形所依附的腰带，它就能附身，令佩戴者接受严训。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is obsessed with strength and stamina training despite lacking a physical body to hone. It is said that wearing the belt it emanates from allows it to possess a person and put them through rigorous training regimens.

entry: POKENAME多才多艺，工作很多。拆除靠力量，木工靠手稳，甚至能在水管问题失控前就察觉。
author: autismgaming89_51746
source: Due to POKENAME's wide range of skills, it can be found working a variety of jobs. It can use its strength in wrecking crews and its steadiness in carpentry, and it can even sense plumbing issues before they get out of hand.

entry: POKENAME背花太重，移动需要所有肢体撑身。腿肌因此极强，粗腿一踢，就能碎巨石。
author: quackquackattack
