source: The flower on the back of POKENAME is so heavy that they need all their limbs to support themselves when they move. Their leg muscles become so strong that they can shatter boulders with a kick from their stout limbs.

entry: POKENAME以力量为荣，鼓励来者尽全力打它。第一个能打得这结实沉重身体一颤的挑战者，会得到它戴在头上的腰带。
author: sk372
source: Proud of its strength, POKENAME dares any it comes across to challenge it and hit it as hard as they can. It gifts the belt it wears around the head to the first challenger that manages to make its durable, heavy body flinch.

entry: POKENAME察觉龙卷风形成，就反复拳砸地。结果人们常更怕它，反而没那么怕它预警的风暴。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME senses a tornado forming, it slams its fists into the ground repeatedly. This ultimately makes many people more afraid of POKENAME than the storm it's warning of.

entry: POKENAME常被误认成灯神，却不会替人实现愿望。谁若向它许愿，就会被揍一顿，随后它便消失。
author: jokerswild
source: Though they're often mistaken for genies, POKENAME will not grant you wishes. If you try to ask for a wish, it will beat you up and then disappear.

entry: 它以惊人的力量与威势掌控战场，金属般的强鳍打出粉碎重击，举止间尽是王者的自信。
author: thepandasharky
source: This formidable warrior dominates the battlefield with its impressive strength and commanding presence. With powerful metal-like fins, it delivers crushing blows while exuding an aura of regal confidence.

entry: POKENAME寻找宝可梦群，自封新首领。有时虽专横，仍愿为哪怕只有一位臣民牺牲。
author: autismgaming89_51746
source: POKENAME search for groups of Pokémon, then proclaim themselves as the new leader. Although they may act very tyrannical at times, POKENAME are willing to sacrifice themselves for even just one of their subjects.

entry: 握持POKENAME能让力量激增。它绝不让人摘掉限制力量的护符，可古代传说有个力大无穷的人，有人相信，他用过全力的它。
author: .fedoraman
source: Wielding POKENAME multiplies one's strength immensely. While it never lets anyone remove the Power Save charms which limit its power, there are ancient myths of a man with herculean strength, and some believe he was using a POKENAME at full power.

entry: POKENAME为力量骄傲，有点像恶霸，用强臂推搡别人。野外的它，似乎与铁掌力士竞争极烈。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's pride in its strength makes it something of a bully, pushing others around with its immensely powerful arms. In the wild, it appears to have an intense rivalry with Hariyama.

entry: POKENAME缎带上肌肉的力量，是本已强健的双腿的两倍以上。一拳便能打碎钻石。
author: melodydelune
source: The muscles on the ribbons of POKENAME are over twice the strength of its already powerful legs. A single punch from POKENAME can shatter diamonds.

entry: POKENAME甩尾砸洞壁，敲下大理石块，再举过头练力，直到日出。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME smashes cave walls with its tail to break off marble blocks. It lifts them over its head to train until sunrise.

entry: 庞大的体形下还藏着更惊人的力量。只要有机会，POKENAME能举起整个世界的重量。
author: theemeraldflygon
source: Its colossal size harbors even greater strength. Were it given the opportunity, POKENAME could lift the weight of the entire world.

entry: POKENAME发光手臂看似非实体，却能施物理力量，甚至举重。家里家具若在浮动，可能只是它在锻炼。
author: .jerden
source: Although POKENAME's glowing arms do not appear to be solid, they can still strike with physical force and even lift heavy objects into the air. If furniture inside a house seems to be levitating, it may just be POKENAME doing a workout.

entry: POKENAME暗影身体不藏伪装内，反而笼罩在上方。挥拳攻敌前，它会拿伪装当盾，破了就丢。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's shadowy body does not hide within its disguise, but looms over it instead. When approaching foes to attack with its fists, POKENAME will pick up its disguise to use as a shield, then discard it once it breaks.

entry: POKENAME不断寻找新挑战，锻炼较小的头。各部位力量与外观不平衡，似乎让它十分苦恼。
author: sontyp
source: POKENAME is constantly looking for new challenges to strengthen its smaller heads with. Imbalances in its different body parts' strength and looks seem to distress it.

entry: POKENAME强颚能举超过800磅，常抓大石、原木装巢。它也会试着以后腿站起威吓，虽很难平衡。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME can lift over 800 pounds with its strong jaws, and it grabs large rocks or logs to decorate its nest. It will try to stand on its back legs as an intimidation tactic, even though it struggles to keep its balance.

entry: POKENAME在装配线上弯折钢杆，制成大型机器零件。每小时歇一次，给关节加润滑，再继续工作。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME works along assembly lines to bend and fold steel rods into components used to build large machines. It takes a break every hour to apply lubricant to its joints before continuing its work.

entry: POKENAME用四臂捶胸，炫耀得意的肌肉。它还能胀身，显得更大，不过只有外观变化，不会因此更强。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME beats its chest with all four arms to show off the muscles it is quite proud of. It can inflate itself to make the muscles appear bigger, though this is only a visual difference; it does not grow stronger with the increased size.

entry: POKENAME挑衅高手，测试谁配得上它炫耀的冠军腰带。认可训练家，就愿同行，不过仍不肯交出腰带本身。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME taunt talented fighters to try and test if anyone is worthy of the championship belts that they flaunt. If a POKENAME deems a Trainer worthy, it will agree to travel with them, but it will still refuse to hand over the physical belt itself.

entry: POKENAME体形虽小，力量却十分惊人，爬动时也会震动地面。它织出的带电蛛网极其坚韧，甚至能困住人类。
author: santon5512
source: Despite their small size, POKENAME are incredibly strong, shaking the ground as they scuttle. The electrified webs they spin are incredibly tough, capable of even trapping humans inside.

entry: POKENAME进食后，头顶的棱脊会向外散热。它在夜间悄然狩猎，伺机伏击虚弱的猎物。
author: .izik
source: After feeding, the ridges on POKENAME's head radiate heat. It hunts silently at night, waiting to ambush weakened prey.

entry: POKENAME用四条巨臂把猎物打到无力反抗，再将其吞食。凡是没先好好揍过的东西，它都坚决不吃，连训练家给的点心也不例外。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses its four massive arms to pummel prey into submission before devouring them. It actively refuses to eat anything it hasn't properly punched beforehand, even a treat from its Trainer.

entry: POKENAME在沼泽中徘徊，等待路过的人。它会把整棵树连根拔起，向围观者炫耀力量。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME lingers in swamps, waiting for passersby. It rips entire trees from the ground to impress onlookers with its power.

entry: POKENAME用声波震落钟乳石，再向上跃起，以强劲的踢击将它们击碎在半空。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME unleashes soundwaves to knock stalactites loose, then leaps upward to shatter them mid-air with powerful kicks.

entry: POKENAME凭四条强壮的手臂，最多能举起自身体重50倍的东西。不过腿部力量没那么强，搬动大型物体仍很吃力。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME can lift up to 50 times its own body weight with its four strong arms. However, its legs are not as strong, so it struggles to move larger objects.

entry: POKENAME是擅长杂技、爱出风头的斗士，最喜欢有观众围观。表演已成为它根深蒂固的习惯，连睡着时也偶尔会摆姿势或展示肌肉。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is an acrobatic showboating fighter that loves an audience. Its performative nature is so ingrained into its brain that, even in sleep, POKENAME will occasionally strike poses or flex its muscles.

entry: POKENAME痴迷真菌，把身体当作花园培育蘑菇，再用许多只手分给有需要的人。它不喜欢种植有毒真菌，因为这会消耗自身的力量。
author: deadshields
source: POKENAME are known for their obsessions with fungus, using their own bodies as gardens to grow more and offering these mushrooms out with their many hands to whoever might need them. They dislike growing toxic fungus as it can drain their power.

entry: POKENAME凭四条手臂迅速投掷手里剑。它似乎已不再需要隐蔽行动，却依然选择悄无声息。
author: hiroshima0042_23263
source: With four arms, POKENAME has the ability to throw shurikens quickly. POKENAME does not seem to need stealth anymore, but it still chooses to be stealthy.

entry: POKENAME一心只想变强，常常洗劫西兰花和菠菜地。也经常有人见它硬拉特大尺寸的南瓜怪人，以此炫耀力量。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's only desire is to get stronger, often raiding broccoli and spinach patches. It has often been seen deadlifting Supersize Gourgeist as a show of its strength.

entry: POKENAME头顶的巨大重物超过一千磅。休息时，它常用至少两只手将其托住。
author: atlas3339098
source: The large weight on POKENAME's head weighs over a thousand pounds. It will often hold it up with at least two of its hands when resting.

entry: POKENAME虽有双腿，却更喜欢漂浮着往返于训练场地之间。它能轻松举起自身体重两倍的钢板。
author: .izik
source: Though it has legs, POKENAME prefers to float between training sites. It can effortlessly lift steel slabs twice its own weight.

entry: POKENAME会飘在公园或健身房里锻炼的人身旁。若有人练得吃力，它便从嘴唇闪出柔光，默默给予鼓励。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME floats near people exercising in parks or gyms. If someone struggles, it blinks a gentle light from its lips to silently encourage them.

entry: POKENAME从敌人下方发动攻击，隔着地面打出连环重拳。拳劲足以将体形大得多的对手轰飞。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME attack their opponents from below, delivering a barrage of punches through the ground. These punches are strong enough to send much larger opponents flying.

entry: 这种宝可梦反复无常，十分骄傲，还会把镶有宝石的腰带戴在头上炫耀。不过它也并非空口吹嘘，一秒钟确实能打出数百拳。
author: flickeredflame
source: This fickle Pokémon is incredibly prideful and wears its gem-laden belt on its head to show off. Its bragging is not without merit, however, as it can punch hundreds of times in a second.

entry: POKENAME很容易暴怒，见到什么就攻击什么。四条手臂力量惊人，能把体形大得多的对手扔到地平线之外。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are easily enraged, attacking anything they see. Their four arms are extremely powerful, capable of hurling much larger opponents past the horizon.

entry: POKENAME痴迷射箭，却没有耐心仔细瞄准。一旦射偏，便索性冲向目标，施展令人眼花缭乱的火焰连击。
author: zekkenbytheden
source: Though fascinated by archery, POKENAME lack the patience for delicate aiming. When a shot misses, they charge the target instead, unleashing a blinding flurry of fiery strikes.

entry: POKENAME双腿的肌肉远比身体其他部位发达，在陆地上很难保持平衡。因此，它更喜欢快速摆动四条尾巴，以惊人的速度游泳。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME has a hard time balancing its body on land due to its legs being much more muscular than the rest of its body. Therefore, it prefers to rapidly use its four tails to swim at blinding speeds.

entry: POKENAME战前会安静沉思，预先计划每一步行动。选定最佳战术后，便以强大的精神能量或疾风骤雨般的快拳攻击敌人。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME sits in quiet contemplation before battle, planning every move in advance. Once it has determined the optimal strategy, it will strike its foe with powerful psychic energy or a barrage of high-speed punches.

entry: POKENAME体形虽小，强壮的手臂却让它有力量克服各种挑战。许多个体会帮施工队抬起钢梁，完成工程。
author: quackquackattack
source: Even though POKENAME have small bodies, their strong arms give them the strength to push through any challenge. Many help construction crews lift steel beams to complete projects.

entry: POKENAME生活在武术道场附近，模仿武术家的动作，也常以举起重物来炫耀自己。
author: .izik
source: Living near fighting dojos, POKENAME mimics the movements of martial artists. It often shows off by lifting heavy weights.

entry: POKENAME拥有许多头和手臂，战斗中几乎没有视野死角。从来没有谁在徒手近战中击败过它。
author: soup1900
source: Due to having so many heads and arms, POKENAME virtually has no blind spots in combat. Nothing has ever defeated this Pokémon in hand-to-hand combat.

entry: 它的手臂数量翻倍，出拳速度也随之翻倍。不过除了挥拳，多出的这组手臂毫不灵巧，连简单的工具也用不好。
author: soup1900
source: It can deliver punches twice as fast due to having twice as many arms. Outside of punching, however, this extra set of arms has no dexterity, even when using simple tools.

entry: 据说，被这种宝可梦打上一拳，就像挨了一颗炸弹。它还能在一秒内连续打出数千记这样的重拳。
author: soup1900
source: A punch from this Pokémon has been described as getting hit by a bomb. It can also volley these punches thousands of times in a second.

entry: 曾有人看见POKENAME用毒液覆满大型船只。播放音乐能使它平静下来，跟着节拍拍手。
author: larryloud55
source: POKENAME has been seen covering large ships in poison. It is calmed when music is played, as it claps along to the beat.

entry: 一只POKENAME用拳头猛击地面，就能引发灾难性的落石和雪崩，因此人们相信它真能移山。有趣的是，喊一声“哥们儿”就能引起它的注意。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Catastrophic rockslides and avalanches are caused by the sheer force of a single POKENAME punching the ground, forming the belief that POKENAME can literally move mountains. Humorously, calling out “my dude” attracts the attention of POKENAME.

entry: 它们会捡起路过训练家的小物件，用来加固身体。它们尤其喜欢力量腰带，因为最容易把它绑在自己身上。
author: quackquackattack
source: They pick up trinkets from Trainers that pass by and use them to make themselves sturdier. They are particularly fond of a Power Belt since it is the easiest to attach to themselves.

entry: POKENAME把大块玄武岩举过自己粗硬的身躯，以此锻炼。它的脚步会震动大地。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME trains by lifting massive chunks of basalt over its rugged body. Its footsteps shake the ground beneath it.

entry: POKENAME能迅速追上并制服目标，是保安十分欢迎的伙伴。光是那吓人的外貌，就足以让罪犯三思。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME are very popular partners for security guards, as they are able to quickly catch and overpower their target. Just their intimidating appearance is enough to make criminals think twice.

entry: 在野外，必须先捕捉多种水生宝可梦并与它们摔角，才能进化成POKENAME。随着它的力量增强，尾巴上的生物似乎也会变得更强。
author: bobosmith01
source: In the wild, only POKENAME that have caught and wrestled with a variety of aquatic Pokémon evolve into POKENAME. As POKENAME gains strength, it seems the being on its tail grows in power, too.

entry: POKENAME能调节磁力，拉动超过500磅的金属。它会固定在机械上吸收电力，任何打扰它的东西都会遭到冲撞，因此想把它移走的人往往会受重伤。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME can manipulate the strength of their magnets to pull upwards of 500lbs of metal. They anchor themselves to machinery to absorb electricity. Removal often ends in serious injury as POKENAME launch themselves at anything that disturbs them.

entry: POKENAME极爱吹嘘，总是不停地向别人挑战。经常能见到它尝试举起附近的重物，向其他宝可梦炫耀。
author: plkfsa32
source: POKENAME are an extremely boastful species and relentlessly challenge others. They are usually seen attempting to lift nearby heavy objects as a way of showing off to other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME的每颗头都有独立的大脑和性格，虽然有时会争吵，却也让它拥有强大的记忆力。它将一生所学都融入了极具压迫感的战斗风格中。
author: bobosmith01
source: Although each head has a unique brain and personality that sometimes causes squabbles, this grants POKENAME a powerful memory. It incorporates everything it has learned throughout its life into its overwhelming battling style.

entry: POKENAME不停挥拳，攻击仿佛从四面八方袭来。漂浮在周围的许多手臂虽然完全由气体构成，拳头的威力却足以造成毁灭性的打击。
author: reflecbeat
source: POKENAME attacks relentlessly with punches that seem to come from every direction possible. Although the many arms floating around it are made entirely of gas, their fists hit with devastating force.

entry: POKENAME用巨钳将对手牢牢制住，再用肌肉发达的手臂猛击，令其无力招架。为保持最佳状态，它会沿着海岸砸碎巨石。
author: fiordaliso
source: It uses its mighty claw to pin opponents in place, leaving them helpless against the crushing blows delivered by its muscular arm. To keep its body in peak condition, POKENAME shatters boulders along the shoreline.

entry: POKENAME的茎互相缠绕，比每颗头各长一根茎更坚固，也更能支撑身体。若有人想将它连根拔起，它就会威吓地摇动叶片，试图吓退对方。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME stems tangle around one another to create a structure that is more rigid and supportive than could be achieved if each head had its own stalk. It shakes its leaves menacingly at those who try to uproot it, trying to scare away the threat.

entry: POKENAME最爱用手中的粗藤作武器。据说，那根藤蔓摘自亲代遗骸附近茂盛的草木间。
author: craigprime
source: POKENAME wields the thick vine in its hand as its weapon of choice; supposedly, the vine was plucked from the overgrowth near a parent's remains.

entry: POKENAME起初被视为垃垃藻的地区形态，最近才被证实是独立的宝可梦物种。它用根状尾巴附着在海带上，藏身植物之间，躲避大型宝可梦。
author: katieplaysgames
source: First thought to be a regional variant of Skrelp, POKENAME has recently been proven to be its own distinct species of Pokémon. They use their root-like tails to attach to kelp and hide amongst the plants, keeping safe from larger Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME的叶状肢体会长出藤蔓，拖着身体前往海带林。大型捕食者靠近时，它便趴到海床上，用沙子盖住自己。
author: quackquackattack
source: The leafy limbs of POKENAME sprout vines to drag themselves towards kelp forests. When a large predator is nearby, they plop down onto the sea floor and cover themselves with sand.

entry: POKENAME身体柔韧得惊人，能较为轻松地穿过曲折的隧道与狭窄的缝隙。它生活在浅水中，只有在某些傍晚才会完全浮出水面。
author: bobosmith01
source: Surprising flexibility allows POKENAME to move through twisting tunnels and tight spots relatively easily. They live in shallow waters, but only surface completely during some evenings.

entry: POKENAME喜欢在热带的阳光下跳舞。全神贯注地舞动时，它甚至能稍稍浮离地面，仿佛施了魔法。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME enjoys dancing under the tropical sunlight. When it dances with intense concentration, it can even float just slightly off the ground as if by magic.

entry: 人们在苗圃饲养POKENAME，看中的是它身上不断长出的高吸水性根须。树艺师用这些根加固幼树根系，确保幼树获得充足的水分。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are raised in nurseries for their ultra-absorbent roots that constantly grow from their bodies. Arborists reinforce the roots of saplings with POKENAME roots to ensure the saplings get plenty of water.

entry: 药剂师曾为获取POKENAME的吸水根而捕猎它，相信这些根能吸走诅咒和妖咒。如今，人们在苗圃饲养它，用同样的根制作急救时吸收血液的海绵。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME were once hunted by apothecaries for their absorbent roots, which were believed to suck away curses and hexes. Nowadays they are raised in nurseries for those same roots to create emergency sponges to soak up blood.

entry: POKENAME从一片森林飞往另一片森林，吸取现有根系网络中的养分，很快就能吃饱。古代炼金术士曾相信，它的根能吸走诅咒和疾病。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME quickly eat their fill by flying from forest to forest siphoning nutrients from existing root networks. Ancient alchemists once believed that POKENAME roots can suck away curses and diseases.

entry: POKENAME的遗传特征不规则，根会从各处向不同方向胡乱生长。不过它总会模仿当地其他植物利用根的方式，尽可能吸收水分和养分。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's roots grow wildly in random directions and places due to its irregular genetics. However, it will always try to use its roots the same way other plants in the area do to optimize its water and nutrient intake.

entry: 随栖息地不同，POKENAME分泌的液体可能酸得足以熔化金属，也可能甜美可口，用来引诱猎物。少数个体的液体甚至演化出了加速自身基因生长与突变的作用。
author: soup1900
source: Depending on where it lives, the fluids POKENAME creates can either be acidic to melt metal or sweet and delicious to lure in prey. There have even been a few cases where this fluid evolved to accelerate its own genetic growth and mutation.

entry: POKENAME会潜入农业网站，吞食与植物有关的文件。若察觉附近有阳光，就会直接从电脑屏幕中钻出来。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME infiltrates agriculture websites and consumes plant-related files. If it senses sunlight nearby, it will emerge directly from the computer screen.

entry: POKENAME把根扎进合适的木头中，将其当作保护自己的外壳。它会吸取木头里的水分，等木头被吸干后便将其丢弃。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME will embed their roots within suitable logs, using them as shells to protect themselves. They will feed off any moisture in the log, abandoning it once it's been sucked dry.

entry: POKENAME把根状双脚扎进土壤，吸取其中蕴藏的养分。进食时，它用剃刀般锋利的叶形镰刀保护自己。
author: fancyskunk
source: POKENAME dig their root-like feet into the soil to feed on latent nutrients. While feeding, they protect themselves with their razor-sharp leaf-shaped sickles.

entry: POKENAME体内能量极其充沛，几乎每天都要蜕皮，以容纳不断长大的身体。嘴里流出的液体也充满这种能量，轻易就能熔化铁。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are so rife with energy that they must shed their skin almost every day to accommodate their growing bodies. The fluid that leaks from their mouths is rife with this energy as well and can melt iron with ease.

entry: POKENAME无法自行产毒，便采集毒花的花蜜，酿成有毒的蜂蜜。它将蜂蜜储存在刺中，作为替代毒液使用。
author: vic1312
source: Lacking the means to produce toxins on their own, POKENAME gather nectar from poisonous flowers and produce toxic honey. They store this honey in their thorns, utilizing it as a makeshift venom.

entry: POKENAME喜欢独居丛林，以昆虫为零食。受到打扰时，它会向人的头上吐一小团弱酸，其中的精神能量会让对方偏头痛。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME prefers living alone in the jungle snacking on insects. If bothered, it spits a small glob of mild acid onto a person's head; the acid is laced with psychic energy that gives the target a migraine.

entry: POKENAME常被带进课堂，帮助孩子了解宝可梦如何进食。它有三种进食方式：吸收土壤中的养分、通过光合作用制造食物，以及吃其他宝可梦。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are often brought into classes where they help teach children about how Pokémon eat. POKENAME have three methods of eating: absorbing nutrients in the soil, creating food through photosynthesis, and eating other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME在森林里采集叶片，囤积在洞穴中。冬天来临后，它便靠这些储粮过活。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME will forage for leaves in the forest, hoarding them in their burrows. When winter comes, they will use this stockpile as food.

entry: POKENAME是草药园的祸害，会采集芳香的叶片添进蛛网。它究竟是喜欢这些气味，还是想借此引来猎物，仍有待研究。
author: afilthycasual
source: A scourge of herb gardens, POKENAME gather fragrant leaves to add to their webs. Whether they do this because they enjoy the scents or because it serves to lure in prey is being studied.

entry: POKENAME的叶片能收集阳光中的能量。若在户外发呆太久，它就会从嘴里释放电流。
author: pattybgoode
source: The leaves of POKENAME collect energy from sunlight. If it daydreams outdoors for too long, it discharges electricity from its mouth.

entry: POKENAME的体纹与波克比的蛋壳很相似。它守在睡着的波克比旁，喷出稠厚的棕色酸液，将它们逐只捕杀。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body has markings similar to a Togepi's shell. It waits near sleeping Togepi, picking them off one by one by spraying a thick, brown acid.

entry: POKENAME晒过太阳、用根吸收水分后，习惯跳上一支舞。舞动时，它的嘴里会滴出带有怪味的黏液。
author: bobosmith01
source: After resting in the sun and absorbing moisture through its roots, POKENAME habitually dances. While it dances, an odd-smelling ooze drips out of its mouth.

entry: POKENAME幼时埋在浅土中，逐渐在地面上长出坚韧又轻盈的叶片，总有一天能借它们升空。大风天，成片的个体会被连根拔起，随风四散。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME spend their youth buried in shallow soil, gradually growing strong yet light leaves above the ground that will one day lift them into the air. On windy days, entire fields of POKENAME are plucked out of the ground and spread upon the breeze.

entry: POKENAME幼时埋在浅土中，逐渐在地面上长出坚韧又轻盈的叶片，总有一天能借它们升空。大风天，成片的个体会被连根拔起，随风四散。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME spend their youth buried in shallow soil, gradually growing strong yet light leaves above the ground that will one day lift them into the air. On windy days, entire fields of POKENAME are plucked out of the ground and spread upon the breeze.

entry: POKENAME幼时埋在浅土中，逐渐在地面上长出坚韧又轻盈的叶片，总有一天能借它们升空。大风天，成片的个体会被连根拔起，随风四散。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME spend their youth buried in shallow soil, gradually growing strong yet light leaves above the ground that will one day lift them into the air. On windy days, entire fields of POKENAME are plucked out of the ground and spread upon the breeze.

entry: POKENAME用头上花朵甜腻的气味吸引虫属性宝可梦，想把它们抓来吃。捕虫训练家会潜伏在它成片生长的地方，等待捕捉被引来的稀有虫属性宝可梦。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME use the flowers on their heads to draw in Bug-type Pokémon with their sickly sweet scent in the hopes of catching them as food. Bug Catchers will lurk around fields of POKENAME hoping to catch rare Bug-types drawn to them.

entry: POKENAME翻找垃圾箱后，会退到安全的地方进食。吃饱后，尾巴会长出小树苗，散发令人平静的香气。
author: .izik
source: After scavenging through dumpsters, POKENAME retreats to a safe location to eat. Once full, saplings sprout from its tail, releasing a calming aroma.

entry: POKENAME用自身产生的酸液杀死争夺养分的杂草。农民常把它当作天然的除草剂。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME uses the acid it creates to kill weeds that try to steal its nutrients. Farmers typically use this Pokémon as a natural weed killer.

entry: POKENAME的尾巴可用来拌沙拉。由于味道很浓，通常会切碎后撒在上面。它几天就能重新长出尾巴，也很乐意让训练家取用。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME's tail is used in salads. It has a very strong flavour, so it is cut up small and sprinkled on top. POKENAME is able to regrow its tail in a few days and is happy for its Trainer to take it.

entry: 比起阳光，POKENAME更适应月光下的生活。它毛茸茸的根曾被用来配制传统药物，据说可以消除噩梦。
author: ocxin
source: POKENAME dwell better under moonlight than sunlight. Their hairy roots had once been used in a traditional medicine that was believed to cure nightmares.

entry: POKENAME背上的嫩芽会向敌人喷射毒液。面临严重威胁时，喷出的毒液足以致命。
author: duskit___
source: POKENAME's sprout on its back will shoot poison at enemies. If severely threatened, the sprout can shoot enough poison to be lethal.

entry: POKENAME攀附在树上，在坚硬的外壳下酝酿强酸。受到威胁时，它会从每张嘴里喷出酸液，熔化命中的一切。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME will cling to trees, brewing a potent acid beneath their tough shells. When threatened, they will fire this acid from each of their mouths, melting anything they hit.

entry: POKENAME把下半身埋入土中，用富含叶绿素的翅膀晒太阳。受到打扰时，它会喷出一团有毒花粉，借掩护拔出身体，飞往安全的地方。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME buries the bottom half of its body in the ground, sunning itself with its chlorophyll-rich wings. When disturbed it releases a puff of poisonous pollen, using the puff as cover to uproot itself and fly to safety.

entry: POKENAME扎根在茂密的草木间，从土壤和周围的树果树吸收养分。根据吸收养分的树果树种类不同，壳上苔藓的气味也会变化。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME root themselves in dense foliage to absorb nutrients from the soil and surrounding berry trees. The moss that grows on their shell has different smells based on the type of berry tree POKENAME absorbed nutrients from.

entry: POKENAME喜欢火山灰丰富、土壤肥沃的火山地带，方便扎根。尽管外表如此，它的天性其实友善温顺。
author: snowybubble
source: POKENAME prefers volcanic areas with abundant ash and fertile soil where it can take root. Despite its appearance, it is friendly and docile by nature.

entry: POKENAME把下半身埋入土中，用富含叶绿素的翅膀晒太阳。受到打扰时，它会喷出一团有毒花粉，借掩护拔出身体，飞往安全的地方。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME buries the bottom half of its body in the ground, sunning itself with its chlorophyll-rich wings. When disturbed it releases a puff of poisonous pollen, using the puff as cover to uproot itself and fly to safety.

entry: POKENAME倒挂在枝头，展开翅膀进行光合作用，并向上伸长脖子，模仿果实。嘴里分泌的蜜状物会吸引虫属性宝可梦，让它轻松找到食物。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME roosts on branches upside down, spreading its wings to photosynthesise and craning its head upward to mimic a fruit. Its mouth secretes a honey-like substance that draws Bug-type Pokémon to it, enabling it to easily find food.

entry: POKENAME的三颗头藏在长得十分庞大而结实的身体中，直到进食时才会出现。三颗头都必须吃下大量昆虫，才能维持这副沉重的身躯。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's three heads hide within its overgrown, sturdy body until it's time to feed. All three heads must eat a large amount of insects to sustain its heavy girth.

entry: POKENAME常充当哨兵，用密集的攻击保护家人免受敌害。它们似乎与幽灵属性宝可梦结有宿怨。
author: rakanadyo
source: POKENAME often act as sentries, defending their families from foes with a barrage of attacks. They're apparently known to feud with Ghost-type Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME栖息在高高的树冠上，洪亮刺耳的叫声能传出数英里。研究人员测得它的叫声约有125分贝。
author: oddwalls
source: It perches high in treetops, where its loud, piercing cry can be heard for miles. Researchers have measured POKENAME calls at around 125 decibels.

entry: 人们培育POKENAME的尾巴，将其与其他草药混合，制成元气根。这是一团能治疗宝可梦的苦味根茎。它们偏爱潮湿气候，因此饲养苗圃多建在丛林附近。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME's tails are cultivated and mixed with other herbs to produce an Energy Root, a bitter clump of roots that heals Pokémon. They prefer humid climates, so POKENAME nurseries are built near jungles.

entry: 周围足够明亮时，POKENAME的头会从身体中冒出。一旦四周变暗，它就把头缩回体内，直到光线恢复。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's head pops up from its body when its surroundings are sufficiently bright. Should the area around it grow darker, it tucks its head into its body until light returns.

entry: POKENAME从嘴里喷出汹涌的酸液，削弱敌人。如果刚进过食，酸液的量就会明显增加。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME expels torrents of acid from its mouth to weaken foes. The quantity of acid increases significantly if it has recently eaten.

entry: 人们培育POKENAME的尾巴，将其与其他草药混合，制成帮助宝可梦吸收养分的大根茎。它们腹部的模样像大型捕食者，令其他宝可梦不敢打扰。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME's tails are cultivated and mixed with other herbs to produce a Big Root, a large clump of roots that help Pokémon absorb nutrients. Their underbellies look like a large predator, which causes other Pokémon to leave them alone.

entry: POKENAME用根状尾巴捕捉虫宝可梦，抓住后，POKENAME便施以强烈电击，将其制服。
author: darkweavile428
source: POKENAME uses its root-like tail to capture bug Pokémon. Once its prey is in its grasp, POKENAME incapacitates them with a strong electric shock.

entry: POKENAME静止不动时，与盆景植物毫无区别。许多寺院让它与僧人一同生活，营造宁静的氛围。
author: quackquackattack
source: When perfectly still, POKENAME are indistinguishable from a Bonsai plant. Many monasteries have POKENAME living among the monks to facilitate a calm atmosphere.

entry: POKENAME喜欢模仿其他宝可梦的动作，还会长出根须作为额外的肢体，模仿多肢协同的动作。科学家正研究这些辅助肢体，以改进训练家和宝可梦使用的义肢。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME enjoy copying the movements of other Pokémon and are known to sprout roots to create extra limbs to copy multi-limb motion. Scientists are studying these auxiliary limbs to improve prosthetics for Trainers and Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME用长舌刮取树上的苔藓。若吃得太多，根状双腿就会站不稳，难以行走。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its long tongue to scrape moss from trees. If it overeats, its root-like legs become unsteady, making it difficult to walk.

entry: POKENAME钻到花园下方，伸出根须连接周围其他植物。这样不用移动，就能吸收水分和养分，迅速生长。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME burrow under gardens to release roots that connect to other plants in an area. This allows it to grow quickly by absorbing nutrients and moisture without moving.

entry: POKENAME的三颗头配合默契，从嘴里发射种子击退对手。不知为何，它似乎特别仇视幽灵属性宝可梦。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's three heads work in tandem to fire seeds from their mouth to repel opponents. It seems to have a strong vendetta against Ghost-type Pokémon for some reason.

entry: POKENAME的金属外壳包裹着用来消化虫子的腐蚀性汁液。它栖息在丛林洞窟中，休息时会用强韧的根将身体固定在洞壁上。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME's metal shell encases the caustic juices it uses to digest bugs. It inhabits jungle caverns where it uses its powerful roots to anchor to the walls to rest.

entry: POKENAME由一群寄生在巨金怪躯壳上的喇叭芽组成。喇叭芽相互连接的根系驱动这副躯壳，让它们得以控制其行动。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME consists of a colony of Bellsprout parasitizing the husk of a Metagross. It is animated by the interconnected root system of the Bellsprouts, allowing them to control the husk.

entry: POKENAME会投射出形似喇叭芽的幽影，力量越强，影像就越大。人们认为，它可能与城都的古老神话有所关联。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME projects a spectral visage similar to Bellsprout, the image becoming larger as it grows in power. It is thought that POKENAME may have some connection to Johto's ancient mythology.

entry: 它浑身长满带毒的尖刺，被认为是用来自卫的。嘴里分泌的液体毒性极强，还能集中喷向威胁它的目标。
author: infinex21
source: It is covered in many thorn-like, poisonous barbs though to be for protection. It secretes a highly toxic fluid from its mouth, which it can focus and spew at threats.

entry: POKENAME用假嘴伪装，混入野生喇叭芽群。假嘴分泌的酸性汁液会使这些植物宝可梦昏眩，让它轻易捕食毫无戒心的群体。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses its false mouth to hide among groups of Bellsprout in the wild. The fake mouth secretes an acidic sap that stuns the plant Pokémon, making it easy for POKENAME to prey on the unsuspecting group.

entry: POKENAME生活在大片珊瑚礁中，嘴能产生强大吸力，将从上方游过的一切直接吸入。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME lives in large coral reefs. It can use its mouth to create a strong suction that allows it to simply suck in everything that swims above it.

entry: POKENAME缓慢地爬过水底，用嘴吸入附近的小型宝可梦。在水中与陆地上都能生存。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME crawls slowly across the bottom and sucks up small, nearby Pokémon with its mouth. It can survive in water as well as on land.

entry: POKENAME藤蔓般的头部有坚硬的金属板保护。它将这些板片与随身携带的一块脱落板片敲在一起，奏出钹一般的打击乐。
author: hophoppip
source: Its vine-like head is protected by hard metal plates. POKENAME uses these plates, along with a shed plate it carries around, to make cymbal-like percussion music.

entry: POKENAME力量强大，几乎不费力就能把树连根拔起。体内酝酿的剧毒既能从嘴里喷出，也能从尾端的植物释放。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are strong enough to lift a tree and its roots from the ground with minimal effort. A potent toxin brews within their bodies, which can be loosed from their mouths or from the plants at the ends of their tails.

entry: 一棵寄生树接管了POKENAME，使它拥有庞大笨重的身体。它只靠一颗大眼睛感知外界，夜间常能见到它在森林中跌跌撞撞地游荡。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: A parasitic tree has taken over POKENAME, giving it a large, bulky body. Its large eye serves as its only sense, and it can be seen stumbling around the forests at night.

entry: 据说，POKENAME的根短短几秒就能在地下延伸数英里，感知整片大陆上植物的健康状况。传闻只要一滴树液般的唾液，就能立刻使枯死的植物复生。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's roots are said to be able to extend for miles underground in mere seconds, letting it sense the health of plants across entire continents. One drop of its sap-like drool can supposedly revive dead plant-life instantly.

entry: POKENAME的身体大多由坚韧的木质根须组成。它的喇叭芽花朵能同时向两个方向使出溶解液。
author: hophoppip
source: Most of POKENAME's body is made of tough woody roots. Its Bellsprout flowers can fire Acid attacks in two directions at once.

entry: POKENAME常常长时间几乎一动不动，背上因此长满植物，也遍布寄生虫。植物与寄生虫几乎时刻都在为争夺养分而交战。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME remain almost motionless for large periods of time, causing their backs to be overgrown with plant life and riddled with parasites. These two are at almost constant war with each other, fighting for nutrients.

entry: POKENAME栖息在树冠间，从高处向敌人吐毒。暴怒时，它后方的叶片会燃起火焰。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME dwell in the treetops, spitting poison at foes from above. When enraged, the leaf on their rear will ignite.

entry: POKENAME白天把身体的一部分埋在土里，只露出能够进行光合作用的大耳朵。入夜后，它会钻出地面，寻找养分更丰富的土壤。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME partially bury themselves in the ground during the day, leaving only their large photo-synthetic ears poking out of the dirt. At night they will dig themselves free and search for more nutritious soil.

entry: POKENAME嘴里渗出的液体能溶解铁，却溶解不了组成自身剑刃的铁。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME leaks a fluid from its mouth that can melt iron, though the iron that makes up its blade won't melt.

entry: POKENAME的领地意识很强，会占据阳光和水分充足的地方，奋力赶走竞争者。战斗时，根须能将它固定在地上，避免被撞离原位。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are highly defensive of their territory, finding a spot with great sunlight and water access and fiercely battling competitors away from it. Their roots help to anchor them in their fights, keeping them from being dislodged.

entry: POKENAME会用藤蔓缠住猎物，将其拖进满是腐蚀液的嘴里。
author: melodydelune
source: When capturing prey, POKENAME will wrap its vines around them and pull them into its mouth, which contains a corrosive fluid.

entry: POKENAME手掌般的根须四处游动，翻挖周围的泥土和树木。发现虫窝后，它会带着狂热的神情醒来，敞开棺身，饥饿地将虫子铲进体内。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's hand-like roots flit around, digging among the dirt and trees of its surroundings. When it finds a nest of insects, it awakens with a manic expression before the coffin opens up and shovels the bugs hungrily into its body.

entry: POKENAME常伪装成不起眼的花朵，引诱猎物。小型宝可梦靠近时，它便用头上的长藤缠住对方，以带电的尖刺将其麻痹，再整个吞下。
author: catpetter8
source: POKENAME often likes to camouflage itself as an unassuming flower to attract prey. When a small Pokémon approaches, POKENAME uses the long vines on its head to ensnare it, paralyzing its prey with shocking thorns before swallowing it whole.

entry: POKENAME生活在红树林的根系之间，借迷宫般交错的树根藏身。它有一片大叶子，平时伸到水面晒太阳；遇到紧急情况，就快速挥动叶片推动身体逃走。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME live amongst mangrove roots, using the complex tangled maze of the tree roots as hiding places. They have a single large leaf that they bask with at the water's surface, flailing it rapidly to propel themselves to escape in emergencies.

entry: 尽管柔软的叶片能缓冲撞击，POKENAME的头骨还是因一次次飞行失败而变得坚硬。每次再次跃起前，它都会仔细梳整叶片。
author: sk372
source: Although soft leaves help cushion the impact, POKENAME's skull is still hardened due to continuous failed attempts at flying. It always grooms and preens its leaves before taking its next leap.

entry: POKENAME也能从金属中吸收养分，因此会在城市、工厂和建筑工地生长。金属被它吸取一段时间后会变脆，所以它被视为害兽。
author: chorb33
source: As POKENAME can also absorb its nutrients from metals, it grows in urbanized areas, factories and construction sites. As the metal becomes brittle after a while, it is considered a pest.

entry: POKENAME总要小心，不让自己身上的明火点燃叶片。这使它格外疑神疑鬼，尽管那副惊讶的表情很少改变。
author: z1gg13
source: POKENAME constantly tries to avoid setting its leaves alight on its open flame. This makes POKENAME extremely paranoid, though its shocked expression rarely changes.

entry: POKENAME长出藤蔓，清除头顶鳞茎上的杂物。若有食草宝可梦想吃它，就会长出剃刀般锋利的叶片，割向对方的脸。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME sprout vines to take care of the bulb atop their heads by keeping it clear of debris. When an herbivorous Pokémon tries to eat them, they sprout razor sharp leaves that cut at the face of the herbivore.

entry: POKENAME在溪流附近漂浮，向猎物喷吐酸液。目标失去行动能力后，它便用细线般的藤蔓将其带走。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spits acid on prey as it floats near creeks. Once its target is incapacitated, it carries them away with its string-like vines.

entry: POKENAME周围裹着一层黏性凝胶，能够困住虫属性宝可梦。漂浮在其中的头受到凝胶保护，可以试着吞下任何被黏住的东西。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME are surrounded by a layer of sticky gel that can trap Bug-type Pokémon. The head that floats within is protected from attacks by the gel and can try to swallow anything that gets stuck.

entry: POKENAME把虫属性宝可梦浸在胶状身体中，慢慢溶入自身的膜。溶解后，养分会被凝胶内裸露的根须吸收。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME slowly dissolves Bug-type Pokémon into its membrane by soaking them in its gelatinous body. Once dissolved, the nutrients are absorbed through the exposed roots within the gel.

entry: POKENAME倒栖在洞顶，向闯入者吐出黏稠难闻的液体。这种液体还常会招来大量小虫，因此多数旅人都会避开它的栖息地。
author: sk372
source: It spits a sticky, smelly fluid at trespassers from its perch on cave ceilings. This fluid also tends to attract lots of small insects, so most travelers avoid POKENAME habitats.

entry: POKENAME身体底部长出的根须，最长可伸至身体的三倍。根须中流动着微弱电流，小生物一碰就会麻痹。
author: .izik
source: The roots growing from the base of POKENAME's body can extend up to three times its length. A slight electric charge runs through them, paralyzing small creatures upon contact.

entry: 用细韧的手臂将身体固定在不稳的地形上。人们见过它攀在悬崖、高树，甚至大型草属性宝可梦身上。
author: staghorn
source: It uses its wiry arms to anchor itself in uncertain terrain. They have been found clinging to cliffs, tall trees, and even large Grass-type Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME把周围的一切都视为食物，凡是碰到的东西，都会试着用覆盖全身的腐蚀性树液消化。它的中枢神经系统藏在背上的叶片里。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME sees everything around it as food and will attempt to digest anything it touches with the caustic sap it is covered in. The leaf on its back contains its central nervous system.

entry: POKENAME的叶片富含叶绿素，能从阳光中获取大量能量。它利用这些能量，从中央的嘴将酸液喷射出数米远。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME leaves are packed with chlorophyll, enabling them to generate huge amounts of energy from sunlight. They use this energy to spit acid from their central mouth, launching the acid several meters.

entry: POKENAME身上厚重的叶片既能抵御风雨，也能防御攻击。叶片覆盖着黏稠的有毒物质，接触裸露的皮肤会造成疼痛的酸液灼伤。
author: sk372
source: The heavy leafy fronds covering POKENAME's body protect it from the elements as well as attackers. The leaves are coated with a sticky, toxic substance that leaves painful, acidic burns on bare skin.

entry: POKENAME在河床上发芽，叶片一长出便浮向水面。浮起后，它们会聚成群落，顺着河流一同漂荡。
author: slowforest
source: POKENAME sprout at riverbeds, but as soon as their leaves grow, they rise to the water's surface. Once afloat, they drift together as a colony, carried by the river's current.

entry: 喇叭星在水中浸泡太久，就会进化为POKENAME，叶片长成又长又重的腿。它们行走吃力，却十分擅长游泳。
author: slowforest
source: Belleanie that remain submerged for too long evolve into POKENAME, with leaves that grow into long, heavy legs. They struggle to walk but excel at swimming.

entry: POKENAME常出现在捕食性宝可梦出没的地方，吃它们剩下或无法食用的东西。它全身各处都苦得惊人，通常不会遭到攻击。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME are often found where predator Pokémon lurk, feeding on leftover or otherwise inedible material. All parts of their body taste incredibly bitter, so they are generally safe from attack.

entry: POKENAME吸收阳光后，褶边会变色，变得更加鲜艳。它会抖动褶边撒出花粉，使追逐它的捕食者麻痹或中毒。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's frills change color and become more vibrant as it absorbs sunlight into its body. It shakes the frills to shed pollen to paralyze or poison predators chasing after it.

entry: POKENAME在潮湿的草地上茁壮生长。想把它叼走当点心的鸟宝可梦，会发现它苦得难以下咽。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME flourish in damp grassy areas. Bird Pokémon aiming to scoop them up as a snack will find they are incredibly bitter.

entry: 它生活在蘑菇森林中，脚下的泥炭充满生机。每逢休息，它就钻进地下，释放孢子，维持泥炭丰富的养分。
author: quackquackattack
source: It lives in mushroom forests where the peat below its feet is brimming with life. Whenever it rests, it burrows into the ground and releases spores to maintain the nutritious peat.

entry: POKENAME很受欢迎，常被养在池塘和水族箱中。它虽然害羞，很少在展示区域露面，却担负着清理其他宝可梦留下的污物、维持良好水质的重要职责。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME is a popular Pokémon to keep in ponds and aquatic tanks. Though shy and rarely seen within the displays themselves, they perform the important role of cleaning up after other Pokémon and maintaining high water quality.

entry: POKENAME的橡木甲壳十分坚固，却严重妨碍行动。它把种子储存在胃里，需要时便将其喷出，击退潜在的捕食者。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's oaken carapace is sturdy, but hinders its mobility greatly. It stores seeds in its stomach to spit out as projectiles to ward off potential predators.

entry: POKENAME壳内冲泡的花草茶，在丰缘很受欢迎，常被当作睡前放松的饮品。泡茶产生的气体会从嘴里逸出，有些古龙水会用它增添泥土的香气。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME's shell steeps an herbal tea that is popular in Hoenn as a soothing nighttime drink. It exudes a gas from its mouth caused by the brewing tea, which is used in some colognes to give them an earthy scent.

entry: POKENAME会在寺院附近徘徊，观察僧人冥想，也常加入其中。它们还会帮助驱赶试图干扰冥想的恶灵。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME linger around monasteries to observe monks meditating and often join in on this practice. They also help chase away malicious spirits that try to interfere with meditation.

entry: POKENAME在暴风雨后最为活跃，会藏在散落的叶片间。离开栖居的湖泊前，它会先喝下大量的水，以保持水分和活力。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are most active after storms, hiding among the scattered leaves. They take large drinks of water before traveling away from the lakes they call home, helping them stay hydrated and energized.

entry: 战斗时，POKENAME先从嘴里喷出极易燃烧的液体，淋透敌人，再用尾巴点火。不过若不小心沾上液体，它很快就会把自己烧焦。
author: mistymagius
source: In combat, POKENAME will drench its foes in a highly flammable liquid from its mouth before setting them alight with its tail. However, if POKENAME isn't careful with the liquid, it will quickly burn itself to a crisp.

entry: 长时间挖掘后，POKENAME身上会长出根须，吸收养分。它会小心控制吸收量，以免伤害周围的植物。
author: .izik
source: After extended digging, roots sprout from POKENAME's body to absorb nutrients. It carefully limits intake to avoid harming nearby plants.

entry: 在栖居的丛林深处，POKENAME的三颗头时刻警惕着危险。每颗头都能快速发射豌豆。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's three heads are on constant alert for danger deep in its jungle habitat. Each head is capable of firing peas at rapid speed.

entry: POKENAME的三朵花各有一种颜色，试图吸引不同的虫属性宝可梦。三朵花的花蜜风味也不相同：一朵鲜香，一朵辛辣，还有一朵会带来轻微的麻木感。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME flowers bloom in a trio of colours in an effort to appeal to different Bug-Type Pokémon. The nectar their three flowers produce have different flavours; one being savoury, one spicy, and one with a mild numbing effect.

entry: POKENAME飞行时，翅膀几乎不可能不被尾巴烧伤。因此，它会扎根地面，用翅膀掩盖身形，等待猎物上门。
author: santon5512
source: It is almost impossible for POKENAME to fly without singeing their wings on their tails. Because of this, they will root themselves into the ground, concealing themselves with their wings and waiting for prey.

entry: POKENAME跃起后用螺纹肚皮着地，再以叶状尾巴横扫，将敌人绊倒。这一迅捷动作在职业摔角界广受模仿，被称为“POKENAME扫腿”。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME hops onto its swirled belly and swipes with its leafy tail to sweep foes off their feet. This swift motion is copied by many professional wrestling and is known as “The POKENAME Sweep”.

entry: POKENAME住在神殿和寺院中冥想。它过着苦行生活，吃得很少，也克制自己，不与其他宝可梦玩耍。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME resides in temples and monasteries to meditate. It lives an ascetic lifestyle by eating very little and restraining itself from playing with other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME用坚韧的根和叶攀越山地，寻找主要作为食物的虫宝可梦。发现有猎物的地方后，它就扎下根，伪装成巨石，猛然咬住落在身上的生物。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME uses its sturdy roots and leaves to climb throughout mountainous terrain in search of food, primarily bug Pokémon. When it finds an area with prey, it will root itself and pretend to be a boulder, snapping up anything that lands on it.

entry: 晴天，成群的POKENAME会在开阔的田野上赛跑，尽情吸收阳光。夜间，它会熄灭火焰，把根扎进土里，边睡边吸收水分。
author: comfortablybrum
source: On sunny days, herds of POKENAME will race each other through open fields, soaking up the sunlight. At night, it extinguishes its flames and plants its roots to drink from the soil while sleeping.

entry: POKENAME在开阔的牧场上奔跑，吸收阳光，啃食青草。日落后，它们的火焰会变暗，并通过根须吸取养分。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME run through open pastures to absorb sunlight and graze on the grass. When the sun sets, their flames grow dim as they siphon nutrients from their roots.

entry: POKENAME尾部蜿蜒的叶片能吸收游泳时水中的杂质。它对自己的壳引以为傲，若有人敢碰，便会喷出冰冷的水柱报复。
author: fiordaliso
source: The sinuous leaves forming its tail absorb impurities from the water it swims in. If anyone dares touch its shell, of which it is very proud, POKENAME retaliates by spraying them with cold jets of water.

entry: POKENAME在阳光下活跃，阴天或昏暗的天气则会休眠。不过遇上雷暴，它也会四处活动。只要它醒着，摸上去就会有轻微的过电感。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME becomes active in sunlight and dormant during cloudy or otherwise dark weather. However, it also moves all about during thunderstorms. Whenever POKENAME is awake, touching it results in feeling a slight buzz.

entry: POKENAME用酸液熔化金属，再将其吸收。它能在体内形成金属螺栓，向敌人发射。
author: _snakeywakey_
source: POKENAME consumes metal by melting it with its acid and absorbing it. It can form metal bolts in its body and fire them at enemies.

entry: POKENAME即使有一颗头在睡觉，另一颗头也总保持警觉。凭借敏捷的动作和细长而强韧的脖子，它几乎能躲开一切袭来的攻击。
author: foolish_weasel
source: One of POKENAME's heads is always alert, even when the other is sleeping. Between its agility and wiry necks, POKENAME is able to avoid almost any incoming attack.

entry: POKENAME两颗不同的头会合作，捕食各种猎物。鸟头用喙刺穿虫宝可梦，植物球茎般的头则喷出酸液，溶解坚硬的外层，方便进食。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME's two different heads help work together to consume a variety of prey. Its bird-like head can spear bug Pokémon with its beak, while its plant bulb head spews acid to help dissolve tough exteriors for easier consumption.

entry: POKENAME每颗头都有自己的性格和喜好，因此经常争吵。只有狩猎等少数时候，它们才能专心合作，不再内斗。
author: quackquackattack
source: Each POKENAME head has their own personality and preferences, leading to frequent arguments among the heads. Hunting is one of the rare occasions where they can focus and avoid fighting amongst themselves.

entry: POKENAME能分泌足以覆盖全身的黏稠花蜜。甜香会引来许多虫属性宝可梦，它们被花蜜黏住后，就会被它吃掉。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME produces enough gooey nectar to cover its entire body. The nectar's sweet scent attracts lots of Bug-types, which get stuck in it before POKENAME consumes them.

entry: POKENAME裹着层层叶片，更容易藏身海带林。它的嘴很小，张开也吞不下小型水生宝可梦，因此改吃骨头。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are wrapped in leafy foliage to better disguise themselves within kelp forests. Their small mouths are unable to open wide enough to eat small aquatic Pokémon, so they opt to eat bones instead.

entry: POKENAME嘴很小，吞不下大多数水生宝可梦，便用藤蔓收集鱼骨来消化。只有附近出现危险时，它的壳才会猛然闭合。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have small mouths that cannot fit most aquatic Pokémon, so they gather fish bones using their vines and digest those instead. The only time their shell slams shut is when there is danger nearby.

entry: 气体让轻盈的头部浮起。POKENAME会攀附其他宝可梦、人类或植物，吸取能量。
author: chorb33
source: The gases make the light head float. POKENAME can attach itself to other Pokémon, people, or plants to siphon off energy.

entry: 气体让轻盈的头部浮起。POKENAME会攀附其他宝可梦、人类或植物，吸取能量。
author: chorb33
source: The gases make the light head float. POKENAME can attach itself to other Pokémon, people, or plants to siphon off energy.

entry: POKENAME用嘴产生吸力，如黑洞般吞入周围一切。谁也不知道吞下的东西最终去了哪里。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME can create suction with its mouth to pull everything surrounding it in like a black hole. No one knows where the consumed material ends up.

entry: POKENAME用体内储存的强酸在地下钻行。它会将其他掘穴生物整个吞下。
author: santon5512
source: Using the powerful acid stored within their bodies, POKENAME will burrow through the ground. They will swallow other borrowing creatures whole.

entry: 背上形成了一个种子般的泡泡。下雨时会吸收雨滴，让泡泡长大。
author: soup1900
source: It formed a bubble on its back that looks similar to a seed. When it rains, it will soak up the raindrops to grow the bubble.

entry: POKENAME一看到飞行属性宝可梦，就会缩进壳里。会不停地吃藻类，丝毫没有停下的打算。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME hides in its shell when it spots any Flying-type Pokémon. It will endlessly eat algae, with no intention of stopping.

entry: POKENAME大部分时间都待在水里，越兴奋，壳中溢出的泡泡就越多。需要时，它也能把尾巴缩进壳里，像霹雳电球一样滚动。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME spends most of its time in the water, and the more excited it gets, the more bubbles overflow from its shell. When needed, it can also retract its tail into its shell and roll around like a Voltorb.

entry: 眼镜更大、棱角更尖的POKENAME似乎是首领。它们配合默契，会合力攻击，轻松压制体形更大的敌人。
author: kam_doodle_snek
source: The individual POKENAME with the larger, sharper glasses appears to be the leader. POKENAME has an excellent sense of teamwork, combining their attacks to easily overwhelm larger foes.

entry: POKENAME喜欢在热带海滩上享受夏日阳光，戴着太阳镜，躺在盾片组成的伞下乘凉。它们悠闲的态度很有感染力，常让疲惫的训练家也忍不住一起休息。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME enjoy lounging in the summer sun at tropical beaches, as they wear sunglasses under the shade of an umbrella made out of scutes. Their laidback attitude is contagious, prompting many weary Trainers to rest with them.

entry: POKENAME在生日派对上很受欢迎。可以像沙滩球一样被拍来拍去，还会一边吹泡泡，而弹跳又有助于吹出更多泡泡。
author: skymaster426
source: POKENAME are usually loved at birthday parties. It can be bounced around like a beach ball while blowing bubbles, which helps it create more.

entry: POKENAME坚韧的外骨骼能抵挡攻击。它待在池塘附近，一看见天空中的鸟宝可梦，就会迅速窜进水里。
author: mepp.
source: The tough exoskeleton of POKENAME protects it from attacks. It stays near ponds, quickly darting to the water when it spots bird Pokémon in the sky.

entry: POKENAME的身体本来就很结实，却仍会进一步硬化，确保脆弱的内部受到保护。不过若连续硬化太多次，就会无法动弹，直到效果消退。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: While POKENAME's bodies are naturally rather sturdy, they still harden themselves to make sure their sensitive insides are protected. If they attempt to harden themselves too many times in a row, they will be unable to move until it wears off.

entry: POKENAME总是欢快地游泳或摇摇摆摆地行走。这份快乐很有感染力，鱼宝可梦缠进它的藤蔓后，往往反而不想离开。
author: komodo360_31320
source: POKENAME is always swimming or waddling around in a state of joy. This joy is highly contagious, and any fish Pokémon that find themselves tangled in the vines of POKENAME usually don't want to leave.

entry: POKENAME背上的壳坚硬，足以抵挡大多数鸟宝可梦。它会喷出强力水流推动身体，逃离危险或冲撞障碍物。
author: infinex21
source: The shell upon its back is hard enough to protect it from most bird Pokémon. POKENAME propel themselves with strong blasts of water to escape danger or to ram obstacles.

entry: 成群的POKENAME迁徙时，会紧紧聚拢，用壳互相碰撞。它们本想用响声吓退大型宝可梦，却也因此让渔人轻易找到自己。
author: radiance8990
source: When schools of POKENAME migrate, they gather close, knocking their shells against each other. The sounds are meant to scare larger Pokémon away, but it lets fishers locate them easily.

entry: POKENAME的茧有些部分由厚板构成，其中的壳覆盖着最要紧的部位。化蛹时，它仍保留着四肢，可以摇摇摆摆地逃离危险，只是速度很慢。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have thick plates forming parts of their cocoon, the shell covering their most vital areas. They retain their limbs whilst pupating and can waddle away from danger, albeit at a slow pace.

entry: POKENAME的四肢呈天蓝色，遇险时能缩进壳里自保。每条手臂都能发射泡泡和喷涌的水流。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have cerulean-colored limbs that they can tuck within their shells to protect themselves from danger. Each of their arms can fire bubbles and bursts of water.

entry: POKENAME从嘴里吹出泡泡，在头上组成一只钳子。由于钳子是泡泡做的，天气干燥时，它就难以战斗。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME blows bubbles from its mouth, and a claw forms on its head. Since the claw is made of bubbles, it has trouble fighting in dry weather.

entry: POKENAME会吃下大量叶片，确保有足够的能量完成整个变态发育过程。它唯一的自卫手段就是喷水。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME eats lots of leaves to ensure it has enough energy to go through the entire metamorphosis process. Its only defense mechanism is its ability to spray water.

entry: POKENAME曾因遭到大量捕猎而濒临灭绝，幸得一位尽心的培育家努力，才摆脱了濒危处境。不过它们保护欲强，仍建议训练家不要靠近幼崽。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME were once endangered because of intense hunting of the species, but thanks to the efforts of a diligent breeder, they are no longer endangered. Trainers are still advised to avoid approaching baby POKENAME because of their protective nature.

entry: POKENAME先朝攻击者吹出泡泡，再缩进壳里自保。壳的颜色会随周围环境变化，尤其是在即将进化时。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME blows bubbles at attackers before retreating into its shell for protection. The shell's coloration will change depending on its surroundings, particularly just before evolution.

entry: POKENAME能把整个身体还原成数据，储存在壳里，变成一个活的闪存盘。处于这种状态时，它不会受到伤害，也无法被注入其他数据。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME can completely revert its body into data and store it inside its shell, turning itself into a living flash drive. While in this state, it becomes impossible to hurt and is unable to have other data injected into it.

entry: 它感到受威胁时，会从眼睛分泌难闻的液体，再蜷成一团，靠甲壳保护自己。偶尔能在森林中的小池塘里找到它。
author: behondalog
source: When it feels threatened, it will secrete a foul-smelling liquid from its eyes and roll into a ball to allow its carapace to keep it safe. It can occasionally be found in small, forest ponds.

entry: POKENAME悬挂在树枝上，藏在壳中，直到完成变态发育。受到威胁时，它会从壳的缝隙喷水，希望吓退捕食者。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME hangs from tree branches where it hides in its shell until its metamorphosis is complete. It squirts water from the crevices of its shell whenever it is threatened in the hopes of deterring predators.

entry: POKENAME能高高跃起，缩进壳里，使出威力惊人的泰山压顶。睡觉时，它也会躲进壳里，鼾声在壳中产生响亮的回声。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME can jump high enough to be able to withdraw into their shells and deliver devastating Body Slam attacks. They hide in their shells when they sleep, which echo loudly due to their snoring.

entry: POKENAME的刺小而柔软，尚未发育成熟。因此，它会改用水流或毒液击退威胁。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME has a small stinger that is soft and underdeveloped. It instead shoots streams of water or venom to deter threats.

entry: POKENAME周围的泡泡由精神力形成。若试图破坏泡泡，就会引发猛烈的冲击，使毫无防备者失去行动能力。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: The bubble that POKENAME forms around itself is created by its psychic power. Attempting to disrupt this bubble results in a powerful concussive blast, incapacitating any who are unprepared for this attack.

entry: 受到威胁时，它会把头和四肢缩进壳里，从嘴里喷出水柱与泡泡，同时用尾巴引导精神攻击。
author: imaginita
source: When threatened, it will pull its head and limbs into its shell, then fire off spouts of water and bubbles from its mouth while also directing psychic attacks with its tail.

entry: 面对威胁时，POKENAME能从壳的缝隙喷出一团泡泡，射程超过十米，借此掩护逃走。不过这些缝隙也使外壳脆弱，摸起来软软的。
author: oreee0230
source: When faced with a threat, POKENAME's shell can spray out a cluster of bubbles over ten meters through its gaps to hide its escape. The downside is that these gaps leave the shell fragile and soft to the touch.

entry: POKENAME受攻击，就振翅扬沙，缩进壳里。若对方还不罢休，POKENAME便喷水反击。
author: darkweavile428
source: When attacked, POKENAME will flap its wings to kick up sand, then proceed to hide in its shell. If the attacker persists, POKENAME will fight back by squirting water.

entry: POKENAME戴着太阳镜，身上覆有带缓冲作用的盾片，随时准备玩个痛快。它最爱的活动之一是拔河，可以用颚使出全力拉扯。
author: quackquackattack
source: With a set of sunglasses and padded scutes over their body, POKENAME are always ready to have fun. One of their favorite activities include tug of war, where they can use their jaws to tug as hard as they desire.

entry: 每过一秒，POKENAME的头就会前后摆动一次，因此很难缩进壳里。遇到危险时，它便喷出水沫。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME bobbles its head back and forth for every second that passes. This makes retreating into its shell difficult, so whenever it is in danger it spews out a watery foam.

entry: POKENAME一旦与同伴走散，就会立刻缩进壳里，直到重新找到同类，才肯出来。
author: darkweavile428
source: If a POKENAME becomes separated from its group, it will immediately withdraw into its shell and won't come out until it is reunited with others of its kind.

entry: POKENAME躲在高草里，伏击作为主要食物的虫属性宝可梦。发现合适的目标后，它会喷出水柱，将猎物击晕。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME hides in tall grass to ambush Bug-type Pokémon, which are its primary source of food. When it spots a suitable target, it shoots a jet of water to stun its prey.

entry: POKENAME控制不好电力，入水时常不慎电到鱼宝可梦，随后羞愧地躲进壳里。
author: darkweavile428
source: Due to its poor control over its electricity, POKENAME will often accidently shock fish Pokémon whenever it enters the water. Afterwards it will hide in its shell in shame.

entry: POKENAME在月光下围着湖泊跳舞，引导月亮的能量。角上射出的泡泡会在夜空中闪闪发亮。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME dances under the moonlight around lakes, channeling lunar energy. Its horns shoot bubbles that shimmer in the night sky.

entry: POKENAME坚韧的壳由残留的蛋壳构成。随着身体长大，壳会脱落一些小碎片，腾出空间。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have tough shells made out of the remnants of an egg. This shell can shed small pieces to accommodate their growing bodies.

entry: POKENAME的壳能隔绝水中的电流，让它可以放心发动攻击，不必担忧自身受伤。
author: notsaying.
source: POKENAME's shell acts as a shield from electrical charges in the water, allowing it to attack without worrying about its health.

entry: 虽然外壳使飞行变得困难，POKENAME仍竭尽全力尝试翱翔。至少，这副壳能保护它原本脆弱的身体。
author: roundabout_robin
source: Though its shell makes flight difficult, that doesn't stop POKENAME from trying its best to soar. The shell at least protects its otherwise fragile body.

entry: POKENAME飞过小径等自然通道上空时，会洒下小水泡。因此，小路上设有告示，提醒人们在它起飞时带好伞，免得淋湿。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME releases small bubbles of water whenever it flies above trails and other natural pathways. The trails have warnings that remind people to carry umbrellas to avoid getting wet whenever it takes off.

entry: 遇到危险时，POKENAME会用尾巴拍打胸口，召唤同类。脱险后，它会主动给救助者洗个水淋淋的澡。
author: quackquackattack
source: Whenever POKENAME is in danger, they thump their tails against their chest to call upon their kin. After they are out of danger, they offer to give a watery bath to whoever rescues them.

entry: 很难说POKENAME的壳和身体哪个更硬。虽然它伪装成珊瑚的样子一点也不像，多数宝可梦还是不会理会它，因为它以水中的矿物为食。
author: oreee0230
source: It's hard to tell whether POKENAME's shell or body is harder. Even though its camouflage against coral is completely off, most Pokémon ignore it since it feeds on minerals in the water.

entry: POKENAME的壳便于快速游泳，捕食鱼宝可梦。它又不断繁衍，定居之处的鱼群往往迅速减少。
author: darkweavile428
source: POKENAME's shell allows it to swim quickly in the water and catch fish Pokémon. Since it continuously produces offspring, the fish Pokémon population in areas where POKENAME settles quickly decrease.

entry: POKENAME用水泡包住尾端的手，一巴掌打向敌人，把水泼到对方身上。这个简单的恶作剧，让许多远远围观的野生宝可梦乐不可支。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME surround the hand at the end of their tail in a bubble of water to splash foes with a slap. This simple prank entertains many wild Pokémon that observe them from a distance.

entry: POKENAME会从顶部喷出泡泡状的水。把它种在田里，就能给周围的植物浇水，因此很受农民喜爱。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME sprays water in the form of bubbles from its top. It is loved by farmers due to its ability to be planted in a field and water plants around it.

entry: POKENAME的翅膀和壳一样坚固，还能防水。遇险时，它会把整个身体缩进壳里，加快飞行逃走，扎进最近的水域。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's wings are as sturdy as its shell as well as waterproof. When in danger, it tucks its whole body into its shell to hasten its flying retreat, diving into the nearest body of water.

entry: POKENAME受惊时会缩进壳里，可头太大，根本塞不进去。于是它就闭上眼睛，似乎觉得只要看不见危险，自己就安全了。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: When frightened, POKENAME tucks itself into its shell. Its head is too large to fit inside though, so it closes its eyes, seemingly thinking that if it can't see the danger, it is safe.

entry: 这种宝可梦精通各种滑行，滑板、冲浪板等都能轻松驾驭。它在陆地与海面上自如滑行的平衡感和潇洒姿态，让沿海的孩子们十分羡慕。
author: jaminmcready
source: This Pokémon is a master of all things that glide, riding a skateboard, Surfboard, or anything with ease. Coastal kids admire its balance and style as it shreds over land and sea alike.

entry: POKENAME心思单纯，喜欢盯着周围的野生生物看。偶尔被其他宝可梦纠缠时，它就缩进壳里，直到对方失去兴趣。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are simple creatures that enjoy staring at wildlife around them. On the rare occasion they are pestered by another Pokémon, they retreat into their shell until the other Pokémon loses interest.

entry: 有些游泳教练会请POKENAME帮忙，教孩子在宽阔水域中安全游泳。它性情温顺，非常适合与孩子相处，遇上紧急情况时还能用精神力施以援手。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are used by some swimming coaches to help teach children how to safely swim in large bodies of water. They have a docile demeanour that makes them ideal for working with children, and their psychic powers can help if an emergency arises.

entry: 有些游泳教练会请POKENAME帮忙，教孩子在宽阔水域中安全游泳。它性情温顺，非常适合与孩子相处，遇上紧急情况时还能用精神力施以援手。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are used by some swimming coaches to help teach children how to safely swim in large bodies of water. They have a docile demeanour that makes them ideal for working with children, and their psychic powers can help if an emergency arises.

entry: 满月高悬时，POKENAME会格外有精神，连水属性招式的效果也随之增强。它总会挺身保护训练家，时常显得有些保护过度。
author: fiordaliso
source: When the full moon shines in the sky, POKENAME feels more energetic, to the point of boosting the effectiveness of its Water-type moves. It always stands in defense of its Trainer, often behaving a bit overly protective.

entry: 满月高悬时，POKENAME会格外有精神，连水属性招式的效果也随之增强。它总会挺身保护训练家，时常显得有些保护过度。
author: fiordaliso
source: When the full moon shines in the sky, POKENAME feels more energetic, to the point of boosting the effectiveness of its Water-type moves. It always stands in defense of its Trainer, often behaving a bit overly protective.

entry: POKENAME栖在小树，用壳状头盔朝附近树果喷水。可POKENAME自己又讨厌沾湿，什么水域都躲着。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME perch on small trees, firing jets of water at nearby berries with its shell-like helmet. Despite this, POKENAME hates being wet and will stay away from any body of water.

entry: POKENAME背上的水泡是储水容器。即使天气干燥，它也能靠储存的水长时间保持活跃。
author: oreee0230
source: The bubble on POKENAME's back is a water storage container. When the weather is dry, it can stay active for a long time by relying on the stored water.

entry: 背上的泡泡不知为何长成了花苞。即使将新长的叶子完全浸入水中，也不会将其淹死。
author: soup1900
source: The bubble on its back has somehow grown into a bud. It is able to fully submerge the leaves it grew without drowning them.

entry: POKENAME会吃下自身体重两倍的树果、海藻和鱼宝可梦。多余的树果会被囤进洞穴，不过它的新陈代谢很快，这些储粮通常留不了多久。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME eat twice their body weight in berries, seaweed, and fish Pokémon. They hoard excess berries in their burrows, but their fast metabolism means that they rarely keep that hoard for long.

entry: POKENAME天性顽皮，最喜欢趁别人背过身时咬上一口或喷水捉弄。它们结群生活，彼此背对着对方，以示信任。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME are mischievous by nature, taking great pleasure in biting or shooting water at others while their backs are turned. They live in gangs, facing away from each other as a show of trust.

entry: 雨季常能看见POKENAME，开心地踏水洼、在雨中跳舞。孩子般的顽皮，让它们很受小学生欢迎。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are frequently seen during the rainy season, gleefully jumping in puddles and dancing in the rain. They are popular amongst school children with their child-like whimsy.

entry: POKENAME用喙把虫宝可梦从洞里拉出来，解决下一顿饭。面对更大的捕食者时，它会收起翅膀，躲进壳里。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME pull bug Pokémon out of burrows using their beak to secure their next meal. When faced with a larger predator, they tuck their wings in and hide inside their shell.

entry: POKENAME一旦缩进壳里，就很难受到伤害。它会在壳内发酵树果，确保树果汁供应不断。许多人会把吸管插进它身上的孔，饮用这些发酵果汁。
author: quackquackattack
source: Once POKENAME enter their shell, it becomes incredibly difficult to hurt them. They ferment Berries in this shell to ensure that they have a steady supply of Berry Juice. Many stick straws into a POKENAME's holes to drink this fermented juice.

entry: POKENAME从角上喷出高压泡泡，威力足以击裂树皮，然后开心地啜饮渗出的树液。
author: .izik
source: From its horn, POKENAME blasts high-pressure bubbles strong enough to crack tree bark. It then sips the leaking sap with delight.

entry: 它会把爪子泡在各种液体中，使每只POKENAME都有独特的味道。最常用的是蜂蜜，不过也有人见过它使用可乐等其他液体。
author: dodoowner_
source: It lets its paws sit in a myriad of liquids, creating tastes unique to every POKENAME. The most common substance is honey, but other liquids, like cola, have been observed.

entry: POKENAME的身体能加热它浸泡着的水。只要一小群聚在池塘或湖里，就能暂时将那里变成一处简易温泉。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's body warms up any water it submerges itself in. A small group together within a pond or lake will temporarily turn it into a makeshift hot spring.

entry: POKENAME大部分时间都在栖居的池塘里梳理羽毛。面对任何威胁，它都会与群中的众多伙伴并肩应对。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME spends much of its time preening its feathers in the waters of the ponds it inhabits. It faces every threat alongside the many companions that make up its flock.

entry: POKENAME用细长的喙啄挖虫宝可梦的洞穴，再吐出泡沫，慢慢灌满洞穴，迫使虫宝可梦寻找出口。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME pecks at bug Pokémon burrows with their elongated beak. They release foam from their beaks that slowly floods burrows, forcing bug Pokémon to find an exit.

entry: POKENAME常栖息在寒冷地区的池塘和湖泊中，即使水面结冰也不例外。受到攻击时，它会迅速缩进壳里，再以喷水推动身体逃跑或反击。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are common denizens of ponds and lakes in colder climates, even if they have frozen over. They quickly withdraw into their shells if ever attacked and propel themselves with water jets to escape or counterattack.

entry: POKENAME害羞却又好奇，会在海床上蜿蜒爬行，抓取感兴趣的东西。一听见巨响，它便缩进壳里。
author: dodoowner_
source: Shy yet curious, POKENAME slithers around the sea floor, grabbing whatever it's interested in. It retracts into its shell when it hears loud noises.

entry: POKENAME喜欢把感兴趣的小东西藏进随身背着的巨大空壳里。初次见到一个人时，它会随意拿出一件物品送给对方，作为见面礼。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME love to store anything small that catches their interest in the large hollow shell they carry around with them. When they meet a person for the first time, they will pull out a random item and offer it to them by way of greeting.

entry: POKENAME喜欢与宝可梦幼崽玩耍，却常因体形庞大而吓着它们。学会克制兴奋是个大难题，因为它一高兴就爱从嘴里喷水。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME enjoys playing with baby Pokémon but often intimidates them with its large size. Learning to contain its excitement is a big challenge, as it loves to spray water from its mouth when excited.

entry: POKENAME用强力水柱击落其他飞行宝可梦，维持对领地的统治。它十分孤僻，通常在高山的湖泊和溪流附近筑巢。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME takes down other flying Pokémon with powerful jets of water to maintain its dominance over its territory. POKENAME is a very solitary creature that usually builds its nest near lakes and streams high in the mountains.

entry: POKENAME靠长鼻吸水，再将水喷进嘴里。长鼻也能伸到背后，冲洗黏在壳上的泥巴。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME rely on their trunk to suck in water to spray into their mouths. This trunk can also reach behind their back to hose down any mud stuck to their shell.

entry: POKENAME凭滑溜的身体，能以惊人的速度向任何方向滚动。坚韧的皮肤还能充当水管，储存惊人数量的水，用于水流攻击。
author: npshi
source: Using their slick body, POKENAME can roll in any direction at breakneck speeds. The sturdy hide of POKENAME also functions as water hoses, able to store a surprising amount of water, which is used for water-based attacks.

entry: POKENAME平时在池塘里无忧无虑地玩耍。捕食者靠近时，它便与同类一起锁定目标，再喷出足以击裂岩石的强力泡泡。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME normally plays in ponds with a carefree attitude. Should a predator draw near, it joins with others of its kind to Lock On before firing a burst of bubbles with enough force to crack stone.

entry: POKENAME的鹿角覆有一层薄膜，遇水后会变得像肥皂。离开水域后，它嬉戏奔跑时便会沿途留下一串泡泡。
author: rymyll_the_wanderer
source: POKENAME's antlers are covered with a film that becomes soapy when wet. After emerging from a body of water it leaves behind a trail of bubbles while frolicking around.

entry: POKENAME善于合作，也乐于向仰慕的对象学习和模仿。常能在船上见到它帮忙做航行事务，所学的技能也会影响它的进化。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME cooperates well with others as it seeks to learn from and emulate those it admires. It is often found on ships helping with sailing tasks, learning skills that will influence its evolution.

entry: POKENAME用尾巴缠住敌人后，会不断猛击，直到对方昏迷。腹部的壳凸起得很不方便，使它难以在陆地上爬行。
author: soup1900
source: Once POKENAME has constricted a foe with its tail, it will repeatedly bash them until they are unconscious. Due to the shell creating an awkward bump on its belly, POKENAME has a hard time slithering on land.

entry: POKENAME受惊时会从嘴里喷出滚烫的蒸汽。它常出没于温热的水池，漂浮在水面上。
author: dodoowner_
source: When frightened, POKENAME releases a scalding steam from its mouth. It frequents thermal pools, floating in the water.

entry: POKENAME体形太大，缩不进壳里，便会朝欺负它的宝可梦喷牛奶。只要能让对方不再打扰，它也会选择从对方身上滚过去。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are too big to tuck into their shells, so they spray milk at other Pokémon who are mean to them. They also have the option of rolling over other Pokémon if it means being left alone.

entry: POKENAME与晨露有着密切联系。新古典主义画作中，常描绘它在黎明时向花田喷水，帮助花朵生长绽放。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME is associated with the morning dew. Neoclassical paintings depict POKENAME spraying water over fields of flowers at dawn, helping them to grow and bloom.

entry: POKENAME只要受到一点怠慢，就会闹别扭，给别人添麻烦。它报复的手段之一，就是弄出一片泥地，让其他宝可梦滑倒。
author: quackquackattack
source: Whenever POKENAME are slighted in any way, they act petty and cause inconveniences towards others. One of the ways they get back at others is by creating a patch of mud for Pokémon to trip on.

entry: 如果壳上噼啪闪着电光，就表示它紧张又烦躁。POKENAME一生大部分时间都在河里度过，因此十分擅长游泳。
author: fiordaliso
source: If its shell crackles with electricity, it means it is nervous and irritable. Since it spends most of its life in rivers, POKENAME is an excellent swimmer.

entry: POKENAME沿河床缓缓行走，寻找食物，靠厚实的石壳保护自己。需要迅速移动时，它会制造有浮力的泡泡托起身体，随水流漂走。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME amble along riverbeds in search of food, relying on thick stony shells for protection. When they must move quickly, they create buoyant bubbles to lift themselves and drift with the current.

entry: POKENAME大部分时间都在收集冲上海岸的光滑石子和漂亮贝壳。它的壳适于水中行动，加上体重轻，因此能轻松浮在水面。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME spend much of their time collecting smooth stones and pretty shells that wash up on shorelines. Their hydrodynamic shell and light weight allow them to easily float on top of the water.

entry: POKENAME向对手喷射高压水流，淋湿对方与周围地面。等一切都湿透后，它便向四周无差别放电，先前洒下的水会增强攻击效果。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME spray high pressure water at their opponents, dousing them and the area. Once everything is soaked, they indiscriminately shock the area around them, the water they've laid down amplifying the effect of their attack.

entry: POKENAME总也喝不够水，会毫无节制地灌下大量的水和其他液体。打嗝时，它会喷出破坏力十足的泡沫。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME has an unquenchable thirst, leading it to guzzle down large quantities of water and other fluids with abandon. When it belches, it launches out destructive Bubbles.

entry: POKENAME在地下挖掘，寻找柔软的黏土食用。如果黏土太硬，它就喷水将其泡软，直到能够吃下。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME tunnels underground to locate soft clay to consume. If the clay is too hard to eat, they spray water onto the clay until it is soft enough to eat.

entry: POKENAME吹出的泡泡由富含养分的水构成，让它能在水边营造草木茂密的巢穴。繁殖季节，它会用各种鲜艳的树果和花朵装点草木，吸引潜在的配偶。
author: chibitales
source: Bubbles blown by POKENAME are made of nutrient-rich water, allowing them to create waterside nests surrounded in dense foliage. During the breeding season, they decorate the foliage with various vibrant berries and flowers to impress potential mates.

entry: POKENAME的壳虽然没有孔洞，它却仍能缩回四肢。身体部位会伴着一小团二进制代码消失、重现，有时重新出现的位置还与原来不同。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can tuck its limbs into its shell despite lacking holes, the body parts disappearing and reappearing with little puffs of binary code. Sometimes the appendages reappear in different positions from where they vanished.

entry: POKENAME常附着在海滩岩石上，或待在潮池中。即使完全浸没，脚趾也依然干燥，因此能攀爬湿滑的表面。
author: pastapockets
source: POKENAME can be found attached to beach rocks and in tidepools. Even when fully submerged, its toes stay dry, allowing it to climb wet and slimy surfaces.

entry: POKENAME用小火球和密集的泡泡自卫。它能缩进壳里，再靠喷发的蒸汽推动身体。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME defend themselves with small fireballs and dense bubbles. They can withdraw into their shells and propel themselves with bursts of steam.

entry: POKENAME在大湖附近成群生活，游泳时也结伴而行，绝不落下任何同伴。季节更替时，它们会前往水温温暖的地方，偶尔停下确认群中成员是否到齐。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: Found in groups near large lakes, POKENAME form groups to swim together, leaving no one behind. When the seasons change, POKENAME will go where the water is warm, occasionally stopping to check that everyone in their group is present.

entry: POKENAME用爪子铲土，在地下挖掘隧道。如果前方土壤压得太实，它便喷水将其泡松。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME tunnel underground by shovelling dirt with their claws. If the dirt in front of them is too tightly packed, they spray the area with water to loosen the dirt.

entry: POKENAME相当胆小，常藏身珊瑚礁。它用鳍感知周围环境，一察觉危险，就把身体缩进壳里。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are quite timid, hiding out in coral reefs. They use their fins to sense their surroundings, tucking their bodies into their shells when they sense danger.

entry: 为支撑沉重的壳，POKENAME的后腿变得强健。慢悠悠的性情让它很受老人欢迎。
author: shocktopus1717
source: To support its heavy shell, POKENAME's back legs have toughened. Its slow demeanor makes it quite popular among the elderly.

entry: POKENAME能感知人的情绪。一旦察觉敌意，就会从嘴里猛烈喷出泡沫。
author: brapollo
source: POKENAME has the ability to sense people's emotions. If it senses hostility, it sprays foam powerfully from its mouth.

entry: POKENAME喜欢玩乐，会朝训练家喷水，开些无伤大雅的玩笑。若察觉训练家悲伤或焦虑，水流便会借精神力改变对方的脑波，使心情好转。
author: lampent12
source: A fun loving Pokémon that will spray their Trainer with water as a harmless prank. If POKENAME detects sadness or anxiety in their Trainer, the water spray will psychically change their brain waves, lifting their mood.

entry: POKENAME的盾甲坚硬如钢，能抵挡大多数攻击。它躲在壳后确保安全，再用尾巴抽打敌人。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME's shields are as hard as steel, able to defend against most attacks. They whip their tails at foes, hiding behind the safety of their shells.

entry: POKENAME用干燥的身体吸收空气中的水分，在头顶形成水环。只要水环尚未干涸，它就能活下去。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME absorbs moisture from the air with its dry body, forming a ring of water on top of its head. As long as the water ring hasn't dried up, POKENAME can survive.

entry: 天气炎热时，POKENAME会朝同窝的伙伴喷水降温。这种活动能促进彼此玩耍，让它与伙伴们更加亲近。
author: quackquackattack
source: When the weather is hot outside, POKENAME sprays its nestmates with water to keep cool. This activity helps it develop bonds with its nestmates by encouraging social play.

entry: 这种宝可梦虽然能改变大部分身体的颜色，融入环境，却仍会在有东西靠得太近时缩进壳里。战斗时，它会用舌头缠住敌人，再以外壳冲撞。
author: infinex21
source: Although these Pokémon can change most of their bodies' colors to blend in, they will withdraw into their shells if anything draws too close. In battle, they wrap their tongues around their foes and use their shells to ram them.

entry: POKENAME背上的壳只有一部分是天生的。它会啃咬木头，做成有韧性的甲片，帮助抵挡攻击。年龄越大，壳上收集的甲片就越多。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: The shell on POKENAME's back is only partly natural. It gnaws on wood to fashion flexible armour pieces, which help to protect it from attacks. The older a POKENAME is, the more armour it will gather along its shell.

entry: POKENAME顽皮又叛逆，戴着深色墨镜，摆出强硬的态度。不过一旦因恶作剧被训练家责骂，它就会立刻把整个身体缩进壳里。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME possess playful yet rebellious personalities. Though they project a tough attitude behind their dark shades, they retreat entirely into their shells the moment their Trainers scold them for causing mischief.

entry: POKENAME喜欢与同窝伙伴一起洗泥浴。天气太干时，它就会朝土堆喷水，自己制造泥巴。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME likes to take mud baths alongside its nestmates. If weather conditions are too dry, it makes its own mud by spraying a dirt patch with water.

entry: POKENAME被认为十分可爱。不过，训练家仍要小心，因为它还不懂得控制自己的力量。
author: mossybanana
source: POKENAME is considered a very cute Pokémon. However, Trainers should be cautious, as it doesn't know its own strength yet.

entry: POKENAME的身体完全适于水中生活，主要食物却是水面附近的飞虫。它的泡泡会影响上方的气流，让小生物无法振翅飞行。
author: oreee0230
source: Although POKENAME's body is completely built for living in water, its main food is flying insects near the water's surface. The bubbles affect the airflow above, making it impossible for small creatures to fly with their wings.

entry: POKENAME喜欢与别人玩耍，但玩起来常不知轻重，可能伤及同窝伙伴。它会努力放轻动作，以免庞大的体形伤到别人。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME love to play with others but engage in reckless play that can harm their nestmates. They make an effort to be gentle so that their sheer size does not hurt anyone.

entry: POKENAME的心脏和卡比兽一样大，血管宽得足以让杰尼龟在里面游泳。厚厚的脂肪层能让它在冰冷的海中保持温暖。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have hearts that are the size of a Snorlax and blood vessels so large that a Squirtle could swim down them. They have a thick layer of blubber that keeps them warm in the cold sea.

entry: POKENAME利用胃里产生的易燃液体，制造燃烧的泡泡。它觉得这些泡泡很有趣，却常常给周围造成严重破坏。
author: santon5512
source: Using the flammable liquid their stomachs produce, POKENAME will create fiery bubbles. While POKENAME finds these bubbles quite amusing, they often cause a great deal of damage to their surroundings.

entry: POKENAME贪玩温顺，是关都唯一的原生单孔类。可要小心：一旦被激怒，它就会用两边脚跟暗藏的刺，注入强效神经毒素！
author: mogor0771
source: Playful and docile, POKENAME are Kanto's only native monotreme. Be careful: When provoked, it can inject a potent neurotoxin from a hidden barb on each heel!

entry: POKENAME很受孩子们欢迎，喜欢与大家玩水，或用肚皮和壳滑来滑去。不过它虽然友善，自尊心却很脆弱，一旦受挫就会变得无礼，还可能动手发脾气。
author: infinex21
source: A favorite among human children, POKENAME loves to play with others using water and by sliding around on its belly and shell. Yet despite its friendly demeanor, this Pokémon turns rude and may lash out when its fragile pride is damaged.

entry: POKENAME以小群生活，喜欢缩进壳里，让一名同伴用钝圆的翅膀将自己拍出去取乐。能把同伴拍得最远的个体，就会成为首领。
author: sk372
source: Living in small groups, POKENAME entertain themselves by tucking into their shells and letting one of the group smack them with their blunt wings. The one that can slap a fellow POKENAME the farthest distance becomes the leader.

entry: POKENAME的速度取决于海浪涌动得有多快。停下时，它会留在原地，双眼追随着磁场。
author: beatdoof
source: The speed of this Pokémon depends on how fast the ocean's waves surge. When stationary, POKENAME stays in one place, eyes following the magnetic field.

entry: POKENAME是一把贪玩的剑。剑刃由静止却未冻结的水构成，还能将水化作水柱射出。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME is a playful sword with a blade made of still but unfrozen water which it shoots out in streams.

entry: 每当攻击打中它壳状的盾牌，便会涌出一阵泡泡。它利用泡泡分散对手的注意力，使对方露出破绽，再猛烈反击。
author: sk372
source: Whenever an attack strikes its shell-like shield, a burst of bubbles comes forth. It uses these bubbles to distract an opponent and leave them open for a fierce counterattack.

entry: POKENAME是会迁徙的沼泽居民，季风季节最为活跃。月夜，至少十二只会聚成群落一同歌唱，吵得窗户震响，也会吓着巢中的鸟儿。
author: mogor0771
source: POKENAME are migratory marsh-dwellers that are most active during monsoons. Colonies of a dozen or more gather in song on moonlit nights, producing enough noise to rattle windows and frighten nesting birds.

entry: POKENAME将水刃、水流冲击与坚固的防御结合，既是多才的战士，也是难缠的对手。
author: thordemidgard
source: POKENAME combine water blades and blasts with sturdy protection, making them versatile soldiers and very capable foes.

entry: 坚硬的壳让POKENAME能借水流迅速前进。想减速时，就会将缎带卷起来。
author: melodydelune
source: The hardened shell of POKENAME allows currents to propel this Pokémon at vast speeds. It slows itself down in water by coiling its ribbons.

entry: POKENAME领地意识强，会彼此争斗，抢占水边最好的晒太阳地点。争斗中落败的个体会被扔进水里，被迫另寻休息处。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are territorial Pokémon, battling with one another to maintain prime basking spots at the water's edge. Losers in these scuffles get tossed into the water and are forced to seek other resting places.

entry: POKENAME吸收空气中的水分子，将其汇成大水泡，以此运用水的力量。据说，喝下这些水能使人恢复活力。
author: mystora
source: POKENAME channel their aquatic powers by absorbing water molecules from the air and forming them into a big water bubble. Drinking this water is said to have a rejuvenating effect.

entry: 常能在水边见到POKENAME玩耍。有人靠近时，它可能会嬉闹地喷出水流，里面却含有强效毒素，而它似乎对此毫不知情。
author: quantumradiation
source: POKENAME can be found playing near bodies of water. When approached, it may playfully shoot a stream of water containing a potent poison, which POKENAME seems unaware it contains.

entry: POKENAME性格开朗，却很容易受惊。每到这时，它就会缩进壳里，可耳朵太大，仍会露在外面。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has an upbeat personality, but is prone to getting startled easily. It retreats into its shell when it happens, but its ears are so large that they still poke out of the shell.

entry: 在沉船中，能见到如华美灯具般的POKENAME。盯着它看太久，会让人感到口干舌燥。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can be found as opulent light fixtures in sunken ships. Staring at one too long can cause a person to feel parched.

entry: POKENAME虽然害羞，却能与训练家建立深厚羁绊。有种迷信认为，摸摸它的六条尾巴就会带来好运。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME is shy, but can form a deep bond with its Trainer. There is a superstition that touching its six tails brings good luck.

entry: POKENAME身体底部有壳，充进空气当浮具，再用尾巴划水前进。
author: vibrationjaveline
source: POKENAME has a shell on the bottom of its body, which it fills with air and uses as a flotation device. It then uses its tail as a paddle to move through the water.

entry: POKENAME受攻击时，会竖起并蓬松所有尾巴，威吓对手。趁对方分神，通常就会逃走。
author: chorb33
