source: When POKENAME is attacked, it raises its many tails and puffs them up to intimidate its opponent. If the opponent is distracted, it usually flees.

entry: POKENAME生活在浅滩边，喜欢在水中嬉戏泼水。受到攻击时，它会先从嘴里喷出一小股水柱，再把自己埋进沙中。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME lives along shallow beaches, playfully splashing in the water. If it is attacked, it will spray a small jet of water from its mouth before burying itself in the sand.

entry: POKENAME打盹时，会小心地把身体收进坚固的壳里。它极其慵懒，总是没精打采，最适合陪伴耐心十足的训练家。
author: fiordaliso
source: When POKENAME dozes off, it cautiously tucks its body inside its sturdy shell. It is an extremely listless, lazy Pokémon, best suited as a companion for highly patient Trainers.

entry: POKENAME背上的壳太小，起不了多少保护作用。因此遇到威胁时，它会让毛发闪光，晃花并吓退敌人，也可能从嘴里喷出带电的水柱。
author: .jerden
source: The shell on POKENAME's back is too small to offer much protection, so when threatened, it flashes its fur to dazzle and frighten foes. It may also spit out jets of electrically-charged water from its mouth.

entry: POKENAME喜欢藏在浅滩自保。若被踩到，便会张开大嘴，喷出强劲水流反击。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME like to hide on shallow beaches for protection. If stepped on, they will retaliate with a large blast of water from their gaping maw.

entry: POKENAME的头骨和壳一样坚硬，但也并非坚不可摧。它从悬崖跃下练习飞行时，会在即将落地前吹出多个泡泡，减轻冲击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's skull shares the same sturdiness as its shell, though it isn't invulnerable. When it hurls itself from cliffs to practice flying, it blows multiple bubbles just before hitting the ground to lessen the impact.

entry: POKENAME常仰躺着，看自己吹出的泡泡飘向天空，渴望一同飞翔。有人见过它乘着间歇泉的水柱，体验身处高空的感觉。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME often lay on their backs and watch their breathed bubbles drift into the sky, longing to fly with them. Some have been seen riding geysers to experience being high in the air.

entry: 船只常会遇到懒洋洋地随海浪漂流的野生POKENAME，不过这也经常妨碍航行。它认为有必要时，便会喷出水柱推动身体。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME are a common sight for ships, as these Pokémon will lazily drift upon ocean waves; this often proves to be a hazard for ships, however. They can loose jets of water to propel themselves if they deem it necessary.

entry: 尾巴上的泡泡显示着它生命的脆弱。戳破这个泡泡，便可能让它瞬间丧命。
author: soup1900
source: The bubble on its tail shows the fragility of its life. Popping this bubble can kill it in an instant.

entry: POKENAME缓缓穿行于森林的灌木间，保护身体的壳限制了速度。迁徙时，它会进入河流，浮在水面随流漂荡，直到抵达肥沃的土地。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME move slowly through forest undergrowth, their protective shells limiting their speed. When migrating, they enter rivers and bob along the surface until reaching fertile ground.

entry: POKENAME周围裹着神秘的凝胶，能缓冲拳打脚踢，而不将动能传到身体其他部位。它透过凝胶呼吸，还会喷出水沫，排出多余的水分。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are surrounded by a mysterious gel that cushions blows from kicks and punches without transferring the kinetic energy into the rest of the body. POKENAME breathe through this gel and spray foamy water to release excess moisture.

entry: POKENAME用棉絮般的身体吸水，在炎热天气中保持水分。夜里，它会缩进壳里，安安静静地休息。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME absorbs water through its cottony body to stay hydrated in the heat. At night, it retreats into its shell to rest undisturbed.

entry: POKENAME偏爱受污染的水域。如果壳中堵塞得太严重，它就会游上最近的岸边，像汽车漏油一样排出污物。
author: beatdoof
source: It prefers to live in polluted waters. Whenever POKENAME's shell gets too clogged, it surfaces to the nearest shore and expels the gunk like a car spilling oil.

entry: POKENAME在洞穴内滑翔，寻找可以捉弄的训练家。它的恶作剧之一，就是趁训练家背过身时朝对方喷水。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME glides inside caves to find Trainers to pull pranks on. One of its pranks involves squirting water onto Trainers when their back is turned.

entry: POKENAME住在海滩上，喜欢和人类一起晒太阳。不过人们常以为它很危险，害怕得逃走。
author: amphi64
source: POKENAME live on beaches and love spending time sunbathing with humans. However, people are often afraid of them and run away, thinking they are dangerous.

entry: POKENAME把壳当作盾牌，巧妙格挡后，再用拳头和水流反击。比起壳还长在背上的生前岁月，它更喜欢如今的死后生活。
author: crumple_2
source: POKENAME uses its shell as a shield, artfully blocking before counterattacking with its fists and water blasts. It enjoys the afterlife much more than it did its regular life, when its shell was stuck to its back.

entry: POKENAME待在浅滩，胆怯地藏在沙下等待。若被踩到，它便会从尖刺中喷出高压水柱，威力足以切开一个西瓜。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME sits on shallow beaches, timidly waiting under the sand. If it is stepped on, it will fire a pressurized jet of water from its spikes powerful enough to slice through a watermelon.

entry: 它的獠牙不断重新生长，每次都会更加坚硬锋利。它用脱落的獠牙清洁、打磨自己的壳。
author: infinex21
source: Repeated regrowth makes its tusks tougher and sharper with each iteration. It uses its shed tusks to clean and polish its shell.

entry: POKENAME有锋利獠牙，又能喷出强劲水柱，因此领地争斗常十分激烈。几乎遇不到壳上没伤疤的个体。
author: infinex21
source: Territory clashes between POKENAME are often violent due to their sharp tusks and the powerful jets of water they can spew. It is rare to come across a POKENAME that does not have scars upon its shell.

entry: 许多海边旅游地，都以成群POKENAME为傲。它们用悦耳鸣声交流，开心时，会向四周吐出彩色小泡泡。
author: infinex21
source: Many seaside tourist locales boast of the flocks of these Pokémon that communicate with each other through melodious chirps. When happy, POKENAME spit out small, colorful bubbles all around them.

entry: 为伏击猎物，它会俯冲靠近，缩入壳中，再用蒸汽爆发推进。激动时，喙中喷出的水柱滚烫。
author: infinex21
source: To ambush its prey, it will dive toward them, withdraw into its shell, and propel itself with blasts of steam. The jets of water it sprays from its beak are scalding hot when it is agitated.

entry: POKENAME昼伏夜出，休息时将翅膀裹在壳外保护身体。夜幕降临，便以坚壳撞击虫属性宝可梦，制服猎物。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are nocturnal creatures, wrapping their wings around their shell to protect themselves while they rest. Once night comes, they ram into Bug-type Pokémon with their sturdy shell to subdue their prey.

entry: POKENAME沿河岸筑巢，用爪子在土中凿出浅窝。大部分时间潜在附近水里，从水中看守巢穴。
author: eiskitsune
source: POKENAME nests along riverbanks, where it carves shallow dens into the soil with its claws. It spends most of its time submerged nearby, watching over its nest from the water.

entry: POKENAME有时会待在幼年宝可梦群边，像个兄长。体型与态度令人畏惧，能震住顽皮成员，让它们乖些。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can sometimes be spotted lingering around groups of young Pokémon, acting as something of an older sibling. Its intimidating size and attitude lets it cow the rambunctious ones into behaving better.

entry: POKENAME在沼泽湿地摇摆行走，寻找芦苇吃。身体又小又结实，让想吃它的天敌提不起兴趣。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME waddles in marshes and swamps to find reeds to eat. Its small size and tough body make it unappealing to predators that would eat it.

entry: POKENAME通常结小队旅行，约定相互保护。疲倦时，会翻过身，用光滑甲壳贴地滑行。
author: theaceofhearts0306
source: POKENAME typically travel in squads, with a mutual agreement to protect one another. When fatigued, POKENAME will flip upside down, gliding across terrain on their smooth shells.

entry: POKENAME与同类共舞，造出迷人的泡泡景象。壳太小，无法藏身，便从喙中放出一串泡泡自卫。
author: roundabout_robin
source: POKENAME creates mesmerizing bubble displays by dancing with others of its kind. Its shell is too small to hide in, so it unleashes a stream of bubbles from its beak to protect itself.

entry: POKENAME喜欢潮池，享受这种独特岸边栖地的保护。好奇又大胆，很乐意与到家附近探索的孩子互动。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME like to live in tide pools, enjoying the protection of the unique shore habitat. They are very curious and bold Pokémon, and will readily interact with young humans exploring near their homes.

entry: POKENAME吃沼泽芦苇，让叶片颜色变鲜艳。借此向天敌表明有毒，对方便不来打扰。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME eats reeds in swamplands to turn the color of their leaves into a bright color. This signals to predators that it is poisonous, which results in them leaving it alone.

entry: POKENAME翱翔天空，寻找能休息的雨云。找到合适的云，便擦洗身体，去掉尘垢，让泡泡般的身体一尘不染。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME soar through the sky in search of rain clouds to rest in. Once they find a suitable cloud, they rub their bodies clean of dirt and grime and leave their bubbly body spotless.

entry: POKENAME从花朵释放泡泡，花外裹着多层厚壳保护。头上壳重，休息时喜欢往一侧靠。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME releases bubbles from its flower, which is enveloped by multiple thick shells for protection. When resting, it prefers to lean on one side, as the shells on its head are heavy.

entry: 真菌扎根POKENAME甲壳，赋予强大恢复力。只要壳内仍有活菌，喝水就能治好任何伤。
author: oreee0230
source: Fungi take root in POKENAME's shell, giving it powerful recovery abilities. As long as there's living fungus inside the shell, any injury can heal just by consuming water.

entry: 胆小的POKENAME结队，用高压水灭林火。火一熄，见到他者便立刻四散。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME forms timid squads that extinguish forest fires using pressurized water blasts. As soon as the flames die, they scatter at the sight of others.

entry: POKENAME受到妥善照料，背壳就会泛起莹亮光泽。需求被忽视时，色泽会褪成黯淡米色，阳光下也毫无光泽。
author: puppylev
source: The shell on POKENAME's back takes on a luminescent sheen when it is being properly taken care of. When its needs are neglected, this color fades to a dull beige that is matte when in sunlight.

entry: POKENAME温柔爱玩，会在花间嬉戏，玩后替花浇水。靠啃坚果壳保持牙齿健康，偶尔也啃树皮。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME has a gentle and playful personality; it will frolic among flowers and water them afterwards. It keeps its teeth healthy by chewing on the shells of nuts and, rarely, the bark of trees.

entry: POKENAME受威胁时，将头缩进蓬松毛中保护。触角会隐隐受到流水吸引。
author: prideful_snek
source: When POKENAME is threatened, it retracts its head into its puffy fur for protection. Its antennae are subtly attracted to flowing water.

entry: POKENAME情绪不佳时，身体会漏出沸热液体。因此，一个噩梦，就能让同巢伙伴极度难受。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body leaks a boiling hot liquid when it gets upset. Due to this, a nightmare can cause extreme discomfort to any kin within its nest.

entry: POKENAME失去耐心后，会产生滚烫泡泡，从壳内通气孔排出。游泳时，也会不自觉地提高周围水温。
author: fiordaliso
source: When POKENAME loses its patience, it begins producing scalding bubbles that it expels through the vents in its shell. As it swims, it unconsciously raises the temperature of the surrounding water.

entry: 尾巴上的泡泡已变得不易破裂。手指能射出滚烫气泡，碰到皮肤就会严重灼伤。
author: soup1900
source: The bubble on its tail has grown resistant to popping. It fires scorching hot bubbles from its fingers that badly singe the skin on contact.

entry: POKENAME让隧道充满微微发光的闪亮泡泡。亮度随心情变化，像柔和波浪般照亮通道。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME fills its tunnels with shimmering bubbles that glow softly. Their brightness shifts with its mood, illuminating passages in gentle waves.

entry: POKENAME在泥地里迅速挖洞。常钻到湖底，吃水下植物根部。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME tunnels rapidly through muddy ground. It often digs beneath lakes, feeding on submerged plant roots.

entry: POKENAME的壳出奇软，野外常见彼此弹跳碰撞着玩。谁先站不稳，当天剩下的时间往往都会闷闷不乐。
author: retrodox
source: POKENAME's shell is surprisingly squishy, and they can often be seen playfully bouncing into each other in the wild. Whoever loses their footing first tends to be in a bitter mood for the remainder of the day.

entry: POKENAME脑袋略大，无法缩进壳，却仍不肯放弃尝试，可能因过度用力而伤到自己。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME cannot withdraw into its shell because its head is slightly too large. This does not stop it from trying and it may hurt itself from overexertion.

entry: POKENAME容易被巨响吓到，会躲在壳中吠叫。雷暴时，训练家可以给它抱着温暖的东西，再多多关爱，让它安心。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are easily frightened by loud noises and will bark while hiding inside its shell. Trainers can help them feel at ease during thunderstorms by making sure to give them something warm to hold onto and lots of love.

entry: POKENAME爱灭火，不该灭的时候也想灭，烧烤时尤其不听话。许多训练家将它送去消防学校，顺着这份心愿，学习帮助他者。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME love putting out fires even when they are not supposed to and are especially disobedient during barbecues. Many Trainers have them enlisted at firefighting academies to lean into that desire to help others.

entry: 它朝壳喷水，便能快速转起来，甚至在池面弹跳。POKENAME觉得有趣，还会比试谁去得最远。
author: frokachu
source: By shooting water at its shell, it can begin to spin quickly and even skip along the ponds it resides in. POKENAME do this for fun, and challenge others to see who can go the farthest.

entry: POKENAME用泡泡裹拳，防止战斗中割伤。若泡泡破裂，响声足以让对手严重耳鸣。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME cover their fists in bubbles to protect them from getting cuts during fights. If they burst, the sound of the bubbles popping is loud enough to cause intense ringing in their opponent's ears.

entry: POKENAME大部分时间都在锻炼。只要有水，即使高强度运动，也能一周不吃东西。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME spends most of its time exercising. As long as it has water, it can go a week without eating even during intense workouts.

entry: 每当锻炼使肌肉长大，POKENAME胸腹就会脱壳。头上有独立的壳保护，因此许多个体会多花时间练习头槌。
author: oreee0230
source: Whenever its muscles grow from exercising, POKENAME's chest and belly shed their shells. Since its head has a separate shell for protection, many POKENAME spend extra time practicing headbutts.

entry: POKENAME锻炼出的肌肉，结实得足以抵御来袭攻击。只有头顶是软处，便戴着小壳如帽，保护那里。
author: quackquackattack
source: The toned muscles on a POKENAME's body are sturdy enough to protect from incoming attacks. The only soft spot on a POKENAME's body is on top of its head, which it protects with a small shell that it wears like a hat.

entry: POKENAME用根吸取土中水分，再从嘴里吹成泡泡，困住小猎物，轻松吃上一餐。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME soak up water from the soil using their roots. Using this water, they blow bubbles from their mouths, trapping small prey inside for an easy meal.

entry: POKENAME以小队共同生活，彼此极为忠诚。曾有报告称，它们会在猛烈的火灾中协助消防员。
author: kames
source: Known to live in squads, POKENAME are incredibly loyal to each other. POKENAME are reported to help firefighters during scorching fires.

entry: 五只时髦的杰尼龟，因热爱墨镜而聚在一起。即使战斗，也会优先保护墨镜。
author: fr34kuency
source: A quintet of stylish Squirtle held together by their love for sunglasses. During battle, they prioritize the safety of their sunglasses.

entry: POKENAME造出泡泡触手，缠住猎物。长久挣扎后，再释放一团毒素，侵蚀对方。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME form tentacles made of bubbles that latch onto prey. After a lengthy struggle, they release a cloud of toxins to eat away at their prey.

entry: POKENAME住在山泉旁，从硬壳里小心窥看。有人快踩上时，就会飞快旋转着躲开。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME resides by mountain springs. It peers cautiously from its hardened shell and will rapidly spin away if someone is about to step on it.

entry: POKENAME住在矿泉附近，拼命守护家园。谁污染水，就会被它扔石头。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME live near mineral springs. They fiercely defend their homes and throw rocks at anything that pollutes the water.

entry: POKENAME缩入大壳，兼顾防御与进攻。从壳口喷出水柱，就能达到足以用滚动撞飞小汽车的速度。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME withdraw into their large shells for protection and offense. By releasing jets of water from their shells' openings, they can achieve speeds that make it possible for them to send a small car flying with a Rollout attack.

entry: 感到威胁时，它会把长颈缩进壳，再喷出一股滚烫水柱。
author: periperi_chicken
source: When feeling threatened, it retracts its long neck into its shell and squirts out a jet of scalding water.

entry: POKENAME在喜爱的对象身边格外放松，常因此睡着。许多想养宠物的人，却误解这份安心，因此它较难获领养。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME feel incredibly relaxed when in the presence of those they love and often fall asleep as a result. This sign of comfort confuses many people who want a pet Pokémon, and they are less likely to be adopted as a result.

entry: 传说POKENAME本领非凡，任何其他宝可梦都无法匹敌。还有传闻说，曾接受全知小拉达的训练。不过，这些仍只是传说。
author: seanothan_23
source: Legends tell of POKENAME having exceptional abilities unmatched by any other Pokémon. They have been rumored to be trained by an all knowing Rattata. However, these are still just legends.

entry: POKENAME既没普通卡咪龟的耳朵，也没那条大尾巴，游泳常失去平衡。因此，再次进化前，训练家通常不带它去宽阔水域。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME often has a hard time balancing itself while swimming due to the lack of ears and the big tail a normal Wartortle would have. As such, Trainers often avoid bringing this Pokémon to large bodies of water until it evolves again.

entry: 起初被认为是更高、更凶的杰尼龟，后来研究壳体结构，发现其实与卡咪龟更相似。长时间不进化，尾巴可能长毛。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Originally thought to have been taller, more aggressive Squirtle, studies on the structure of the shell have determined that it actually has more in common with Wartortle. If it goes long enough without evolving, it may grow fur on its tail.

entry: POKENAME常在沉船附近吃废金属。能用水泡裹住自己，轻松浮上水面，逃离危险。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are often found near sunken ships, consuming scrap metal. By forming a bubble of water around themselves, they are able to surface and escape danger easily.

entry: POKENAME的棒子一挥，就能造出泡泡，不依靠肥皂，因此可以安心陪孩子玩耍。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME carry a baton that produces bubbles when swung. This baton can produce bubbles without relying on soap, making POKENAME safe for children to play with.

entry: POKENAME的壳，一次只容得下一颗头。受惊时，两颗头可能一起缩回，撞在一块。
author: katieplaysgames
source: There is only space in a POKENAME's shell for one head at a time. When startled, both heads may retract at once, causing them to collide.

entry: POKENAME拍打鳍肢与甲壳，发信号召集全群玩游戏。也邀请附近训练家加入，让参与者都开心。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME thump their flippers against their shells to signal for the whole group to assemble for a game, inviting any nearby Trainer to join in to ensure that all involved have a good time.

entry: POKENAME精力旺盛。训练家须小心尚未训练的个体，爱玩加上大体型，可能很危险。
author: corra_universe
source: POKENAME are highly energetic Pokémon. Trainers need to be careful with untrained individuals as their playful nature and large size can be dangerous.

entry: POKENAME靠水压从炮管里射出杰尼龟，让它们能在平时够不到的高处灭火。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME uses water pressure to fire Squirtle from its cannons. This allows the Squirtle to put out fires in high places they normally cannot reach.

entry: POKENAME指挥杰尼龟小队，用炮将伙伴发射出去，帮助远行。虽然名声不良，却会尽一切所能，帮助遇困的对象。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME command squads of Squirtle, firing them from the cannons to help them travel great distances. While they have a reputation for being delinquents, they will do everything they can to help someone in need.

entry: POKENAME的壳无法完全张开，靠喷水移动，大舌头只用来进食。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME's shell can't fully open. It moves by squirting water, and its big tongue is only used for eating.

entry: POKENAME甲壳各节分别生长，蜕壳时间便相互错开。虽能像大岩蛇一样钻地，仍更喜欢水中游泳。
author: oreee0230
source: Each segment of POKENAME's shell grows separately, so its molting times are staggered. Although it can also dig underground like Onix, POKENAME prefers to swim in water.

entry: POKENAME有节奏地让水滴来回移动，催眠对手。以与海洋恐惧有关的噩梦为食。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME rhythmically manipulates drops of water back and forth to hypnotize opponents. It feeds on nightmares related to the fear of the ocean.

entry: POKENAME腹面极硬，即使被掀翻，也有保护。用巨钳将食物拆成一口能吃的小块。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME's underside is incredibly hard, giving it protection even if POKENAME is flipped over. It breaks apart food into bite-sized pieces using its massive pincers.

entry: POKENAME壳上有眼纹，引天敌攻击壳，避开真头。壳虽硬，实力却较弱，因此往往避战，不愿交锋。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME's shell has eye-like patterns that lure potential predators to attack the shell instead of its real head. Although the shell is hard, its strength is relatively low, so it tends to avoid fights rather than engage in them.

entry: POKENAME钳子与壳都有花纹，看着像一群，让天敌下手前多想一想。有时寂寞，会与自己的钳子说话，再假装得到回应。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's claws and shell all bear markings that make it appear to be a group, making predators think twice about attacking. Sometimes, when lonely, it will talk to its own claws, and then pretend they are responding back.

entry: POKENAME向侵入丛林领地的敌对宝可梦吐毒酸。在日照空地附近筑巢，好用阳光滋养球茎。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME spits poisonous acid at enemy Pokémon invading its territory in the jungle. It nests near sunlit clearings where it can feed its bulb with sunlight.

entry: POKENAME胃酸强，食欲永不满足。能吃下体重两倍的叶子，却仍饿得还想再吃。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have an insatiable appetite because of their powerful stomach acid. They can eat twice their weight in leaves and still feel hungry enough for more.

entry: POKENAME没有牙，只好喷酸液溶解食物。行动困难，一天大半时间都趴着，用叶子吸收阳光。
author: mistymagius
source: Because of its lack of teeth, POKENAME spews out an acidic liquid to dissolve its food. It struggles to move around, so it spends most of the day lying on its belly and absorbing sunlight with its leaves.

entry: POKENAME拍动大叶，离开地面，再吸入比空气轻的毒气，维持漂浮。排气攻击时，会迅速拍叶，边补气边避免坠落。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME flap their large leaves to lift themselves off the ground, inflating themselves with toxic gases lighter than air to stay afloat. They expel these gases to attack, rapidly flapping as they refill themselves to avoid falling.

entry: POKENAME移动时，散出浓厚的红色蔓莓果香花粉，吸引其他宝可梦。用香气，挑起与领地内对手的决斗。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME emits a thick red Razz Berry-scented pollen as it moves, which attracts other Pokémon. It uses this scent to provoke duels with rivals in its territory.

entry: 发现受伤宝可梦，POKENAME就会放出安抚心神的苹野果香，庇护、照料对方，直到援助赶来。
author: .izik
source: Upon spotting an injured Pokémon, POKENAME releases a calming Leppa Berry scent. It shelters and nurses them until help arrives.

entry: POKENAME放出橙橙果香，吸引绿毛虫等猎物。藤蔓迅速探出，缠住、拉回，轻松得到一餐。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME releases an Oran Berry scent to attract prey like Caterpie. Its vines dart out quickly to ensnare and reel in the prey, ensuring an easy meal.

entry: POKENAME胃酸强，连残骨也能吃。会跟着顶级猎食者吃残羹，却也须小心，别让自己变猎物。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are capable of eating leftover bones because of their powerful stomach acids. They follow apex predators to eat their leftovers and have to be careful not to become prey themselves.

entry: POKENAME用翅膀在树皮抹上甜香花粉，再飞走等候。稍后回来，便以大嘴吸进香气引来的小虫。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME spreads a sweet-smelling pollen on tree bark with its wings before flying away to wait. When it returns later, its large mouth inhales all the little bugs lured to the scented spot.

entry: POKENAME从头上根部放出零余果香，引来猎物。再以锋利如刃的叶片，迅速使出劈开。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME releases a Chesto Berry scent from the root on its head to lure prey. It strikes fast with sharp blade-like leaves by using Slash.

entry: POKENAME的嘴唇，始终裹着反流的酸性消化液。可能以飞吻，把毒孢子散得到处都是。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's lips are constantly coated with regurgitative and acidic digestive fluid. It may blow a kiss to spread toxic spores everywhere.

entry: POKENAME头上的叶状钳，强得能把原木劈半。用来拆开树，够到藏着的猎物。
author: .izik
source: The leaf-like pincers on POKENAME's head are strong enough to cleave logs in half. It uses them to break apart trees and reach hidden prey.

entry: POKENAME暴怒时，放出玉黍果香的花粉。是让他者离开此地的鲜明警告，免得卷入狂暴攻击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME releases a Cornn Berry-scented pollen when it flies into a rage. This is a strong indication for others to vacate the area and avoid being caught in its furious attack.

entry: 大群POKENAME一同逆流迁徙。张着大嘴，将顺流漂来的任何食物吞下。
author: santon5512
source: Large groups of POKENAME migrate upstream together. They leave their large mouths open, gulping down any food that comes drifting downstream.

entry: POKENAME的毒针，连着产生强胃酸的同一组腺体。只要一刺，就能让生物组织腐蚀成浓稠烂浆。
author: quackquackattack
source: The stinger of a POKENAME connects to the same glands that produce their powerful stomach acids. With a single sting, they can cause biological matter to corrode into a thick sludge.

entry: POKENAME黄色黏滑的身体，隐约闻着像苦凉果。叶子烹饪用途多样，深受城都厨师珍视。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's yellow, slimy body smells faintly of Yago Berries. Its leaves are prized by Johto chefs for their versatility in cooking.

entry: POKENAME朝树吐丝，爬上枝头。受威胁就放出可怕臭味，驱赶天敌，保持避难处不受打扰。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spits silk onto trees to ascend to the branches. When threatened, it releases a terrible scent to ward off predators, keeping its safe haven undisturbed.

entry: POKENAME栖在高树枝上，口中滴下清凉花蜜，积在树根处引来昆虫。凑够一餐的数量后，再将它们彻底冻住。
author: sk372
source: A cool nectar drips from POKENAME's mouth as it perches on the branches of tall trees. The nectar pools at the base of the tree, drawing in insects that POKENAME freezes solid once enough have gathered to make for a suitable meal.

entry: POKENAME生活环境养分难寻，常把蜕下的鳞片吃回去。腐蚀胃酸将其溶化，再吸收进身体。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME live in environments where nutrients can be hard to find, so they often eat their own scales after shedding them. The scales are then melted by their corrosive stomach acid and absorbed into their body.

entry: POKENAME嗡嗡飞过密林，喷催眠粉制服猎物。再把失去知觉的受害者带回蜂巢。
author: .izik
source: While buzzing through dense forests, POKENAME sprays Sleep Powder to stun prey. It then carries the unconscious victims back to its hive.

entry: POKENAME吃糖太多，会吹出糖浆泡泡，粘在茎上，留着以后吃。也能扔向袭击者，使其分心，趁机飞走。
author: oddwalls
source: If POKENAME ingests too much sugar, it blows syrupy bubbles from its mouth and attaches them to its stem to eat later. It can also fling the bubbles at attackers to distract them while it flies away.

entry: POKENAME收集巢材时，叶子散发腐败气味。偏爱花朵和干枝，恶臭却能吓退其他生灵。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME emits a rotting smell from its leaves when gathering materials for its nest. It prefers collecting flowers and dried twigs, but the unpleasant odor is a deterrent to other creatures.

entry: POKENAME从翼中叶片放出柿仔果香，吸引尾立等猎物。香气将目标引近，便于捕捉。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME releases a Persim Berry scent from the leaves in its wings, which attracts prey like Sentret. The aroma works as a lure, pulling its target closer for an easy catch.

entry: POKENAME清晨早起，收集花瓣作食物。遇袭时，试着用溶解液挡退天敌，再迅速逃走。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME wakes early in the morning to gather flower petals for its meals. If attacked, it attempts to use Acid to fend off predators before quickly escaping.

entry: POKENAME沿洞壁攀爬，散发宜人的勿花果香。把引来的猎物，困在暗处隐藏的厚网里。
author: .izik
source: Climbing along cave walls, POKENAME releases a pleasant Figy Berry scent. It traps lured prey in thick webs hidden in the shadows.

entry: POKENAME翼上叶片放出零余果香花粉，震晕太靠近领地的其他鸟宝可梦。香气既能自卫，也能保护领地。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME releases Chesto Berry-scented pollen from the leaves on its wings, stunning other bird Pokémon that venture too close to its territory. This scent is used for both self-defense and to protect its domain.

entry: POKENAME喜欢蹦跳取乐。吃饱了再跳，常会不舒服，必须吐出胃中食物。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME bounce around to keep themselves entertained. When they bounce with a full stomach, they often get sick and need to expel the contents of their stomach.

entry: POKENAME会把脸埋进枝叶里自卫。电力由叶子的光合作用产生。
author: melodydelune
source: As a self-defense mechanism, POKENAME will bury its face into its leafage. Its electricity is produced by the photosynthesis of its leaves.

entry: 攻击前，POKENAME先放出团团无青果香花粉。再从嘴中向蜻蜻蜓等猎物发射电击。
author: .izik
source: Before attacking, POKENAME releases clouds of Drash Berry-scented pollen. It then fires jolts of electricity from its mouth at prey like Yanma.

entry: 圣特安努号的“美丽花田园沙拉”，以爽脆的POKENAME叶闻名，为美丽花叶配菜增添分量。细切后搭配酸香巧可果酱汁，是清爽的人气佳肴。
author: .izik
source: The 'Bellossom Garden Salad' served on the S.S. Anne is famed for its crisp POKENAME leaves, which enhance the Bellossom leaf garnish with added volume. Finely chopped and paired with a tangy Occa Berry dressing, this dish is a refreshing favorite.

entry: POKENAME随风飘过繁花草甸。发现绿毛虫等猎物，就会张大嘴，向下扑去。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME drifts above flower-filled meadows on the breeze. When it spots prey like Caterpie, it drops down with its mouth wide open.

entry: POKENAME在高树枝间缓慢移动，用宽叶滑翔到另一棵树。花香甜得浓烈，花蜜有时用来给茶调味。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME move very slowly through high tree branches and use their wide leaves to glide between trees. Their flowers have an overpoweringly sweet scent and their nectar is sometimes used to flavour tea.

entry: POKENAME在空垃圾箱旁放出扁樱果香花粉，将其他拾荒者从自己找到的满箱垃圾边引开。靠这巧计，能不受竞争，多得食物。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME releases Tanga Berry-scented pollen near empty dumpsters to distract other scavengers from the full ones it finds. This clever tactic helps it access more food without competition.

entry: POKENAME在向日葵田欢快起舞，散出振奋又愉悦的零余果香，让附近植物与宝可梦，也分享田间快乐活力。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME dances joyfully in sunflower fields while releasing a happy, invigorating Chesto Berry scent. This scent encourages nearby plants and Pokémon to share in the cheerful energy of the field.

entry: POKENAME每次走路，嘴里都会滴出黏稠、略具腐蚀性的物质。有些训练家用婴儿车推，或用手拖车拉着，免得滴得到处都是。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Whenever POKENAME walks, it drips a sticky, slightly corrosive substance from its mouth. Trainers that keep POKENAME have been known to push it around in prams, or pull it along in hand trailers, to ensure it doesn't drip anywhere.

entry: POKENAME住在泥地，地表覆着自己产生的透明黏毒。它却不受影响，悠闲躺在毒泥里。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME lives in muddy terrain coated with a clear, sticky poison which it produces. It remains unaffected as it lounges in the toxic muck.

entry: POKENAME先用利叶切碎垃圾箱里的发霉垃圾，再吃掉。叶片锋利，能高效切开、吞食丢弃的食物。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its sharp leaves to cut up molding garbage in dumpsters before eating. The sharpness of its leaves helps it efficiently cut and consume the discarded food.

entry: 即将攻击时，POKENAME先从后方叶片放出子茄果香，再以强烈念动力出击。
author: .izik
source: Just before attacking, POKENAME releases an Eggant Berry scent from its rear leaves. It then strikes with intense telekinetic force.

entry: POKENAME的甲叶比钢还硬。受威胁时，会喷出好几加仑灼热酸液，驱赶天敌。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's armored leaves are harder than steel. When threatened, it expels gallons of burning acid to drive predators away.

entry: POKENAME唾液甜得发腻，闻着像花蜜。奶农有时用来制奶酪，其中的酶能形成独特质地与风味。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME's saliva has a sickly sweet scent that is reminiscent of a flower's nectar. Dairy farmers will sometimes use it in the production of cheeses, the enzymes allowing for a unique texture and flavour to develop.

entry: POKENAME放出通通果香，吸引虫宝可梦，再咬住。香味百余英尺外都能闻到，能引来远处猎物。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME lets loose a Kebia Berry scent to attract Bug Pokémon, then bites them. The scent is so strong it can be smelled over a hundred feet away, drawing prey in from large distances.

entry: POKENAME把树果存进壳，让它们发酵，散出甜香。较小猎物靠近，就使出藤鞭。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME stores berries inside its shell, allowing them to ferment and give off a sweet scent. When smaller prey approaches, it lashes out with Vine Whip.

entry: POKENAME从角尖放出檬柠果香，引来独角虫等猎物。香味既是诱饵，也向猎物宣告，该开战了。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME releases a Nomel Berry scent from the tip of its horn, which attracts prey like Weedle. The scent works as both a lure and a signal to its prey that it's time for a battle.

entry: POKENAME住在热带丛林，通常栖于高树，让富含叶绿素的翅膀晒太阳。钟形嘴产生蜂蜜般的物质，引来虫属性宝可梦，不必自己狩猎。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME lives in tropical jungles, typically roosting high up in the trees while sunning its chlorophyll-rich wings. Its bell-shaped mouth produces a honey-like substance to lure in Bug-type Pokémon, drawing its food to it instead of having to hunt.

entry: POKENAME飞行时，能将柠檬香酸液吐得很远。即使相隔一百米，也百发百中。
author: .izik
source: While in flight, POKENAME spits a lemon-scented acid at remarkable distances. Its accuracy remains flawless even at a hundred meters.

entry: POKENAME住在热带丛林，通常栖于高树，让富含叶绿素的翅膀晒太阳。钟形嘴产生蜂蜜般的物质，引来虫属性宝可梦，不必自己狩猎。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME lives in tropical jungles, typically roosting high up in the trees while sunning its chlorophyll-rich wings. Its bell-shaped mouth produces a honey-like substance to lure in Bug-type Pokémon, drawing its food to it instead of having to hunt.

entry: POKENAME住在丛林，能完美模仿周围枝叶的质地。猎物靠近，就脱离伪装，喷出阵阵粉色酸液攻击。
author: .izik
source: While living in the jungle, POKENAME can perfectly mimic the texture of surrounding foliage. When prey draws near, it emerges from its camouflage and attacks with bursts of pink acid.

entry: POKENAME插脚上电力涌动，是招牌攻击正在蓄力的信号。会打嗝喷出一团带电胃酸，溅到谁，就让谁灼伤、麻痹。
author: sk372
source: Electricity surging along POKENAME's prongs is a sign of it charging up its signature attack. It belches out a blob of lightning-tinged stomach acids that burn and paralyze whatever gets splattered by the projectile.

entry: POKENAME在丛林树间爬行，放出甜甜异奇果香。先引近猎物，再用獠牙攻击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME slithers through jungle trees, releasing a sweet Wiki Berry scent. It uses the aroma to lure prey close before striking with fangs.

entry: POKENAME力量强大，一夜就能毁掉整片森林。靠巨力，追捕、吞下任何会动的东西。
author: lysonae
source: POKENAME is so powerful it can destroy entire forests in one night. It uses its immense strength to hunt down and swallow anything that moves.

entry: POKENAME放出强力十万伏特前，尾巴先散出浓烈蔓莓果香，警告其他宝可梦赶紧找掩护，躲开接下来的攻击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's tail lets off a potent Razz Berry aroma just before unleashing a powerful Thunderbolt. This scent serves as a warning to other Pokémon to find cover from the ensuing attack.

entry: POKENAME舌头最远能伸出体外10英尺。释放的花粉模仿最后吃下的食物味道，靠熟悉的气味引来宝可梦。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's tongue can extend up to 10 feet from its body. The pollen it releases mimics the taste of whatever food it has last consumed, luring Pokémon based on the familiar scent.

entry: POKENAME把叶片刮在岩石上，保持锋利。也会钻入地下，找植物根吃。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME maintains its sharpened leaves by scraping them against rocks. It burrows underground to find plant roots to eat.

entry: POKENAME爱受人关注，会特意进入电子屏，观察显示的内容。常对所见惊奇不已，不过看电视的人，通常觉得它很碍事。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME love getting attention from people, deliberately travelling into electronic display screens to observe whatever's displayed. They are often amazed at what they see, though their presence is considered a nuisance to those watching television.

entry: POKENAME帮助科学家研究胃酸对生物组织的影响。借产生的、能留下生物标记的叶片，便可测定酸液成分，以及溶解生物组织的速率。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME help scientists study the effects of stomach acid on biological matter. By producing leaves that leave a biological marker, they determine the composition of the acid and the rate at which it dissolves biological matter.

entry: POKENAME住在世间最炎热的丛林，胃里充满辛辣酸液，紧急时能反吐向敌人。不过多数个体自己根本尝不出辣味。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME lives in the world's hottest jungles. Their stomachs are filled with a spicy, acidic fluid that they can regurgitate onto a foe in an emergency. Most POKENAME can't even detect spicy flavors.

entry: POKENAME主要靠双腿生存。每秒能踢出10脚，还能倒挂树枝，藏住自己。
author: heal_fire
source: POKENAME use their legs as their main tool for surviving. They can let loose 10 kicks per second and are able to hang themselves upside down on branches to hide.

entry: POKENAME睡觉时，会从胃部开口分泌蓝油，滋味像泡泡糖。
author: dodoowner_
source: When POKENAME sleeps, it secretes a blue-colored oil from the opening in its stomach. The substance has a taste similar to bubblegum.

entry: POKENAME对战中边转圈，边放出异奇果香，让敌人头晕、失去方向，借此占先。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME releases a Wiki Berry scent while spinning during combat, causing opponents to become dizzy and disoriented. This aids in gaining the upper hand during a battle.

entry: POKENAME发出精神波动，把虫子引进嘴，困在腐蚀性的体内。保护壳磨成糊后能吃，是许多阿罗拉酸味料理的常见材料。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME projects psychic waves to attract bugs into its mouth, trapping them in its caustic interior. Its protective shell is edible when ground into a paste, which is a common ingredient in many sour Alolan dishes.

entry: POKENAME很少移动，更爱找高处，用结实根部固定自己。散发诱人香气吸引猎物，最爱太古羽虫这类有岩石甲壳的虫属性宝可梦。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME rarely moves, instead preferring to find an elevated location to anchor itself with the aid of its durable roots. It exudes an alluring scent to attract prey, with its favorite being Bug-types with rocky carapaces, like Anorith.

entry: POKENAME用宽嘴搬运大原木，帮助大牙狸筑坝。吐出后留下树汁般的唾液，能作黏合剂，增强坝体。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME assists Bidoof in dam-building by carrying large logs with its wide mouth. The sappy saliva left over after it spits them out acts as an adhesive that helps increase the dam's sturdiness.

entry: POKENAME舌尖产生回旋雾气，有毒，也略带酸性。削弱靠近的对象，更容易用舌头抓住吞下。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's tongue generates a swirling mist around the tip. This haze is toxic and mildly acidic, used to weaken anything that draws close so it is more easily grabbed by the tongue and swallowed up.

entry: POKENAME藏在浓密树冠，用枝叶遮盖，不让人察觉。猎物从下方经过，就张嘴落下，准备整只吞掉。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME hides among the thick canopies of trees, covering itself with foliage to remain undetected. When prey passes below, it drops down from above with an open mouth, ready to swallow its target whole.

entry: POKENAME生活在热带的河流附近，能像投石器般射出强酸，分解任何物质。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME lives in tropical areas near rivers. It can shoot incredibly strong acid like a catapult, which can decompose any material.

entry: 长长的脖子能让头朝向不同角度，将酸液射到数公里外，误差仅几米。
author: chorb33
source: Thanks to its long neck, it can orient its head at different angles to shoot acid over several kilometers with an accuracy of just a few meters.

entry: POKENAME整天睡觉，芳香口水从嘴里滴下，引来昆虫，本能地吃掉。受扰后，用全部积蓄力量打出威猛一击，再回去睡。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME sleeps all day, with an aromatic drool dripping from its mouth and enticing insects inside, which it instinctively eats. When disturbed, it unleashes all of its stored power for one devastating attack before falling back asleep.

entry: POKENAME感知飓风时，会放出团团绿粉，希望救助附近对象。可惜，它只是让别人睡着，并没救离危险。
author: .izik
source: When sensing a hurricane, POKENAME releases clouds of green powder in hopes of saving anyone nearby. Sadly, it puts others to sleep instead of saving them from danger.

entry: 丛林村庄曾奉POKENAME为荒野之神。活藤构成的墙保护领地，它则在夜间猎捕入侵者。
author: .izik
source: Jungle villages once revered POKENAME as a god of the wilds. Its living vine walls protected territories while it hunted intruders at night.

entry: POKENAME背上特殊果实榨出的油，非常适合炸食物、做调味汁。美食家称赞其中淡淡花甜味，也看重诸多健康益处。
author: mepp.
source: The oil made from the special fruits that grow on POKENAME's back is perfect for deep-frying and dressing food. Gourmands cite a subtle floral sweetness and its many health benefits.

entry: 它挥动叶状双臂，放出气味引近潜在猎物。一进范围，就深吸气，将小生灵像吸尘般吸进大嘴。
author: sk372
source: As it swings its leaf-like arms, it emits scents to attract potential prey closer. Once within range, it inhales deeply, vacuuming small creatures into its open mouth.

entry: POKENAME野外稀少，因为嘴装不下猎物。但丝毫不减危险，仍能享用任何被布缠住的宝可梦的灵魂。
author: .fedoraman
source: POKENAME is rare in the wild as it cannot fit prey in its mouth. This does not make it any less dangerous, for it can still feast upon the soul of any Pokémon ensnared in its cloth.

entry: POKENAME产生强酸，能烧穿有机物。领地争斗中，用酸溶掉对手的根。两只争田间最佳位置，战况可能十分危险。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME produce a powerful acid that can burn through organic matter. They use this acid in territorial disputes to melt away the roots of their rivals. Battles for the best positions in a field between two POKENAME can get very dangerous.

entry: 藤蔓像刀具，会切开大得无法入口的食物。分泌的液体能溶解一切接触到的东西。
author: melodydelune
source: Its vines act as cutters to slice food too large to pull into its mouth. The fluids it produces dissolve anything it comes into contact with.

entry: POKENAME一动不动，散出团团榴石果香粉末。猎物一靠近，就迅速挥拳击昏。
author: .izik
source: Remaining perfectly still, POKENAME emits clouds of Pomeg Berry-scented powder. When prey approaches, it delivers a swift knockout punch.

entry: POKENAME头尾伸出长叶，游泳时拖在身后。身体缓缓盘动，在栖地的红树林根间穿梭。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have long fronds extending from their head and tail that trail behind them as they swim. They move in languid coiling motions, weaving in and out of the mangrove roots in their environment.

entry: POKENAME散出葵秋果香花粉，引诱猎物。虽有眼状花纹，其实完全看不见。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME emits pollen that smells like Kuo Berries to lure prey. Though it has eye-like markings, it is completely blind.

entry: POKENAME游过河流，迅速挥动叶状附肢。身体虽庞大，动作却敏捷得惊人。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME whips its leafy appendages rapidly as it swims through rivers. It moves with surprising agility for its bulky body.

entry: POKENAME从毛发放出巧可果香花粉，振奋附近对象，让它们更清醒、有活力。借此带着他者，和精力过盛的自己一起活动。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME releases Occa Berry-scented pollen from its fur, invigorating nearby individuals and making them feel more awake and energetic. It uses this to get others involved in its hyperactive actions.

entry: POKENAME侧浮水面，长尾平摊，像片落叶。受扰时，突然动起来，惊慌游走。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME float at the surface of the water on their sides, their long tail lying flat to resemble a fallen leaf. When disturbed, they will abruptly burst into motion and swim away in fright.

entry: 叶片虽柔韧，也能变得钢般坚硬、刀刃般锋利。只要转得够快，连钢板都能锯穿。
author: chorb33
source: Although its leaves are flexible, it can harden them to be as strong as steel and as sharp as blades. If it rotates fast enough, it can saw through steel plates.

entry: 身体乍看长得过于繁茂，却能用叶子定向转动金属身体。触须结构可塑，旋转时也不会意外被硬身压坏。
author: chorb33
source: Its body appears overgrown at first glance, but it can use its leaves to rotate its metal body in a targeted manner. The malleable structure of its tendrils prevents it from accidentally crushing them with its hard body as it rotates.

entry: POKENAME腹部贴地躺着，免得尾巴烧到敏感身体。久坐少动，因此对训练家要求很少。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME lie flat on their stomach to avoid having their tail burn their sensitive bodies. They demand very little from their Trainer due to their sedentary lifestyle.

entry: POKENAME飘游丛林，寻找会飞的虫属性宝可梦吃。发现猎物，就把嘴张得足够大，整只吞下。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME float about jungle forests looking for flying Bug-type Pokémon to consume. When they find their prey, they open their mouths wide enough to swallow prey whole.

entry: POKENAME搜寻墓园里的虫属性宝可梦，整只吞食，帮助清除害物。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME search graveyards to find Bug-type Pokémon to consume. They help keep graveyards free of pests by swallowing their prey whole.

entry: POKENAME埋在暖沙里，等猎物靠近。跃出后，吐出一口混有消化酶的沙，盖住目标，使其失去行动能力。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME buries itself in warm sand until prey comes in close proximity. Once it leaps out, it spits out a mouthful of sand laced with digestive enzymes from its mouth to cover and incapacitate its target.

entry: POKENAME在洞内，从嘴里放出千香果香花粉。猎物靠近后，便成群进攻，利用气味造成的混乱，压倒目标。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME releases Passho Berry-scented pollen from its mouth inside its cave. When prey approaches, it attacks in swarms, using the confusion caused by the scent to overwhelm its target.

entry: POKENAME发出尖锐的超音波叫声，扰乱敌人方向。迅速逃走，留下团团橙粉，掩护撤退。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME lets out a piercing Supersonic cry to disorient foes. It quickly escapes, leaving behind orange powder clouds to mask its retreat.

entry: POKENAME在巢边吐出莲蒲果香的毒，引来猎物。等足够靠近，就注入强毒，制服这顿饭。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spits Chople Berry-scented poison near its den to attract prey. Once close enough, it injects them with potent venom to incapacitate its meal.

entry: POKENAME逃离烈雀等天敌时，从叶片放出木子果香。气味又引来猫老大等捕食者，转移注意，掩护逃脱。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME releases a Lum Berry aroma from its leaves while fleeing from predators like Spearow. The scent serves to attract predators like Persian, diverting attention away from its own escape.

entry: POKENAME闭不上嘴，跳舞时毒唾液不断滴落。煮沸后，这种恶心液体会变成蛋黄酱般黏稠的酱汁。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME cannot close its mouth, so its poisonous saliva drips constantly as it dances. When boiled, this vile liquid turns into a sauce with the viscosity of mayonnaise.

entry: POKENAME通常躺着不动，被当成普通植物。自身毒素不断让它们头昏、困倦。
author: holgast
source: POKENAME are usually found lying still and often mistaken for regular plants. They are constantly disoriented and drowsy from their own toxins.

entry: POKENAME伸缩四肢力量大，够得也远，能将远处猎物拖进大嘴。合嘴后，再灌满消化液，溶解猎物。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's extendable limbs have great reach and strength. It drags prey from far away into its wide-open mouth, which closes shut before flooding itself full of digestive juices to melt its prey down.

entry: POKENAME柔软身体被拥抱时，会放出烛木果香花粉。这是对他者亲近的回应，表达喜爱。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME releases pollen that smells like Wacan Berries when its soft body is hugged. The pollen is released in reaction to the closeness of others, showing its affection.

entry: POKENAME追赶猎物，叶片散出茄番果香。多数猎物很明智，吓得飞快逃走，免遭拥抱。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME chases prey while releasing a Tamato Berry scent from its leaves. Most prey wisely flee in terror to avoid its hug.

entry: POKENAME与原来的族群共同捕猎。沿河岸排成一列，静静搜寻能伏击的猎物。
author: slowforest
source: POKENAME hunts in groups with its original colony. They march in single file along the riverbank, silently scanning for prey to ambush.

entry: POKENAME用长叶腿裹住身体，几乎与普通植物无异，只有同类认得出。以酸液喷袭猎物，一接触便溶解皮肉。
author: slowforest
source: When POKENAME cloaks itself with its long leaf legs, it becomes nearly indistinguishable from a regular plant - only others of its kind can recognize it. It ambushes prey with an acidic spray that dissolves flesh on contact.

entry: POKENAME叶状羽毛散出岳竹果香，吸引切磋伙伴，找到能对战、测试力量的对手。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME emits a Magost Berry scent from its leaf-like feathers, using the aroma to attract sparring partners. This helps it find opponents for combat, where it then tests its strength.

entry: 它适应了家园的沙漠化，而土壤干涸，正由不当耕作造成。不再用钟形口捕食，而在里面储存骨头与岩石，等其分解成养分。
author: quackquackattack
source: It has adapted to the desertification of its natural home, which is caused by poor farming practices that dry up the soil. Rather than use its bell for catching prey, it stores bones and rocks to decay into nutrients.

entry: POKENAME像仙人掌般站着，放出甜甜藻根果香。猎物一近，就释放如雨的种子机关枪。
author: .izik
source: Standing like a cactus, POKENAME releases a sweet Kelpsy Berry aroma. Once prey comes near, it unleashes a hail of Bullet Seeds.

entry: POKENAME在海滩散出瓜西果香，吸引孩子，再拖进沙下。借此将毫无戒心的受害者，引入自己的地盘。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME releases a Watmel Berry scent at beaches to attract children, which it then drags beneath the sand. This tactic lures unsuspecting victims into its domain.

entry: POKENAME放出橙橙果香花粉，让猎物过一段时间才陷入麻痹。趁对方无法动弹，再吸取能量维生。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME lets loose Oran Berry-scented pollen that induces long-onset paralysis in its prey. It then drains the prey's energy for sustenance while immobilized.

entry: POKENAME背上的蘑菇块有利木果香，常被采收，制成缓解肌肉酸痛的药，利用其疗伤作用。
author: .izik
source: The mushroom chunks on POKENAME's back are Aspear Berry-scented, and are frequently used in medicines to treat muscle aches. These chunks are harvested and used for their healing properties.

entry: POKENAME从鳞片放出比巴果香，引来烈雀等猎物。香气似乎能安抚、吸引对方，使其对下一步行动毫无防备。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME releases a Qualot Berry scent from its scales to entice prey like Spearow. The fragrance seems to calm them and draw them in, leaving them unsuspecting of its next move.

entry: POKENAME在森林与自然公园地面奔走，大口吞虫和厨余。模仿凰梨果的外形，只要不动，便常被天敌忽略。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME scampers across the ground of forest and wilderness parks, gobbling up bugs and food waste. Since it mimics the appearance of a Pinap Berry, it is often ignored by predators if it stays still.

entry: POKENAME头上叶片，散发葱首果般的气味。猎物靠近，便用寄生种子吸取能量。
author: .izik
source: The leaves on POKENAME's head give off a scent similar to Ginema Berries. Once prey draws near, it uses Leech Seed to drain their energy.

entry: POKENAME在林间跳来跳去，寻找甜树果吃。全部塞进嘴里，再以酸性唾液慢慢溶解。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME hops around the forest searching for sweet berries to eat. It shoves all the berries into its mouth and the slowly melts them with its acidic saliva.

entry: POKENAME挂在果树，整只吞果，再用强酸溶解。吃完，口中会滴出花蜜，去毒后便能制成果酱。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME hangs from berry trees, swallowing berries whole before dissolving them with its powerful acid. After eating, a nectar drools from its mouth that, once detoxified, can be made into jam.

entry: POKENAME尽量拖着蜕下的外层，因为碎屑带有甜香，能吸引猎物。认出喜爱的宝可梦就太兴奋，常把这些脱落物丢下，只好从头再来。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME tries to drag its shedding with it as much as possible since the detritus gives off a sweet scent that attracts prey. It is very excitable when it recognizes a Pokémon it loves, so it often drops the shedding and must start over.

entry: POKENAME与同群成员比谁蜕下的外层最大、最好闻。会抛下这些脱落物，追捕、制服皮卡丘等个头不小的猎物，吃一顿就能撑到再次蜕下一层。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME competes with members of its colony to see who has the largest, best smelling shedding. It will abandon its shedding to chase and subdue substantially-sized prey, like Pikachu, that can sustain it until it has shed a new layer.

entry: POKENAME受威胁时，从地道喷出阵阵银酸。偏爱沼泽，因为逃路众多。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME releases bursts of silver acid from its tunnels when threatened. It favors swampy regions where escape routes are plentiful.

entry: POKENAME睡前，用头上钩状附肢固定在珊瑚或水草上。住有群落的太阳珊瑚枝，常覆着它们分泌的毒凝胶。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME attach the hooked appendage on their head to coral or aquatic plants to secure themselves before sleeping. Corsola branches that house POKENAME colonies are often coated in a poisonous gel from POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME一遇下雨，就朝正上方张嘴接水，留作鸟宝可梦的诱饵。对方来洗澡，便突然合嘴，拖入地下。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME face directly upwards whenever it begins to rain, gathering rainwater within their open mouths. They hold the water as a lure for bird Pokémon, snapping shut and dragging them underground when they come to wash themselves.

entry: 据说，嚼POKENAME的叶子能缓解头痛。不过，过量可能暂时昏昏欲睡。
author: .izik
source: Chewing on POKENAME's leaves is said to relieve headaches. However, overuse may result in temporary drowsiness.

entry: POKENAME越生气，树液就越甜。有时有人故意挑逗野生个体，等每次平静下来，再采收树液。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME sap grows sweeter as they get angrier. Wild POKENAME are sometimes goaded intentionally with the goal of harvesting their sap after each time they calm down.

entry: 宝可梦培育家想养出眼更大、嘴更宽的POKENAME，让本就独特的特征更加明显。爱好者常津津乐道，奔跑时叶子摇摆，吠声又多么可爱。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Pokémon Breeders seek to raise POKENAME with larger eyes and wider mouths, exaggerating their already unique features. POKENAME admirers often talk fondly of the way their leaves waggle as they run, or how cute their barks are.

entry: POKENAME的毛能光合作用，只需晒着太阳打盹，就能获取能量。极护休息处，受打扰就喷出强力喷射火焰。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME's fur is photosynthetic, allowing them to gain energy simply by taking a nap in the sunlight. They are protective of their resting places, breathing out powerful Flamethrowers if they find themselves being disturbed.

entry: POKENAME喷出强酸水流，轻易就能溶穿树皮和岩石。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spits a stream of water that is highly acidic. It can melt through bark and rock with ease.

entry: POKENAME住在沼泽，能从叶片释放奇粉。吸入后，会有轻微催眠效果。
author: .izik
source: It lives in marshes. POKENAME can release a strange powder from its leaves; the powder has a mild hypnotic effect on those who breathe it in.

entry: POKENAME口中放出靛莓果香，操纵猎物心智。借此吞食思绪，从中获取知识。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME emits a Belue Berry scent from its mouth, using it to manipulate the minds of its prey. This allows it to devour their thoughts, gaining knowledge in the process.

entry: POKENAME的“胡子”乍看不明显，其实是一对能抓握的藤蔓。会缠住够得到的敌人，让其难以抵御超能力猛攻。
author: sk372
source: Although it may not look it at first glance, POKENAME's "mustache" is actually a pair of prehensile vines. It grabs onto foes within range to wrap around them and leave them susceptible to psychic onslaughts.

entry: 它的根，吸取土壤养分的能力不足，需要训练家用大根茎等道具帮助。会把道具融入身体，额外增强吸收力，取得所需全部养分。
author: quackquackattack
source: Its roots are insufficient for draining nutrients from the soil and require help from a Trainer through a Big Root or other item. It integrates the item with its body, which provides an extra kick to help it absorb all the nutrients it requires.

entry: POKENAME受威胁时缩入壳，从地面生根，缠住附近宝可梦。根虽苦，却营养丰富，因此许多药剂师一路跟随，收集这些根。
author: quackquackattack
source: When threatened, POKENAME withdraw into their shell and sprout roots from the ground to entangle nearby Pokémon. These roots are bitter yet nutrient-rich, so many apothecaries follow POKENAME around to collect these roots.

entry: POKENAME共有六只眼、三张嘴，不知为何，嘴既相互连通，又连着同一个胃。这套混乱生理结构，困扰研究者多年。
author: ruben2309295
source: These Pokémon have a total of six eyes and three mouths that somehow manage to connect to the same stomach while also connecting to each other. The confusing biology of POKENAME has puzzled researchers for many years.

entry: POKENAME食欲贪婪，常吞下几乎与自己一样大的猎物。胃酸却弱，得花数周消化，才需要再次捕猎。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has a voracious appetite, often consuming prey almost as large as it is, but because of its weak stomach acids, it will spend weeks digesting its meal before it has to hunt again.

entry: POKENAME一生大部分时间嵌在洞壁或崖面。咳出麻痹粉与催眠粉，制服经过的猎物，再用大嘴贪婪吞下。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME will embed itself in cave walls or cliff faces for most of its life. It will cough up Stun Spores and Sleep Powder to immobilise any prey that walks by, greedily gulping them up with its big mouth.

entry: POKENAME大半时间躺在脚下地面，因此常被踩。会烦躁大叫，之后因沮丧，流下酸性眼泪。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Because POKENAME spends most of its time lying on the ground underfoot, it often gets stepped on. When this happens it shouts in irritation. Afterward, it weeps acidic tears out of frustration.

entry: POKENAME凸眼、张口的模样，让形象在网络圈子走红。身体坚硬如石，虽能自由活动，那副有名的表情却是常态。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's bulging eyes and slack-jawed visage has allowed POKENAME's image to become popular on online circles. Its body is rock hard; while it is able to move freely, that infamous expression is its default.

entry: POKENAME放出福禄果香，引来穿山鼠等猎物，再用落石制服。香气把对方引近，确保快速轻松捕获。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME releases a Payapa Berry scent to attract prey like Sandshrew before using Rock Throw to incapacitate them. The scent lures them close, ensuring a quick and easy capture.

entry: POKENAME常吸收过量阳光。背部与尾巴燃起的火，能耗掉多余能量，同时提高奔跑速度。
author: comfortablybrum
source: Frequently, POKENAME absorbs more sunlight than it needs. The flames that burn along its back and tail allow it to burn excess energy while also increasing its running speed.

entry: POKENAME穿过森林奔跑，叶片散出烤焦墨莓果的气味。橙红花粉虽像火焰，却并不热，只是毒性极强。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME releases the smell of burnt Bluk Berries from its leaves while running through forests. Despite the resemblance to flames, the orange and red pollen is not hot but carries a highly toxic effect.

entry: POKENAME茫然望着前方，滴下芳香黏液，将昆虫引进嘴里困住。这种口水，是一款花香香水的主要原料，尤其受金黄市社交名流欢迎。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME stares blankly ahead while drooling a fragrant ooze that attracts insects inside its mouth and entraps them. The drool is a main ingredient in a flowery perfume popular especially among Saffron City socialites.

entry: 口呆花若附上呆呆兽尾巴，植物毒素会让身体颜色大变。行为也随之改变，开始寻找日照更足的地方，并把大量昆虫加进食谱。
author: sk372
source: Should a Weepinbell attach to a Slowpoke's tail, the toxins from the plant cause the body's color hue to change drastically. Its behavior changes as well, seeking more sunlit areas and adding large amounts of insects to its diet.

entry: POKENAME固定在两个金属面之间，等待虫属性宝可梦。谁太靠近嘴，就会遭电击，让它轻松吃上一餐。
author: vlavoc
source: POKENAME will anchor itself between two metal surfaces, waiting for Bug-types. If one gets too close to its mouth, it will zap it for a free meal.

entry: POKENAME能自如交换眼睛和嘴的位置，让攻击方向难以捉摸。这些部位也能发射出去进行远程攻击，再随时召回。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME is able to switch its eye and mouth positions seamlessly, allowing it to mix up the direction of its attacks. These parts can also be fired off as ranged attacks and recalled at will.

entry: POKENAME用散发铃薯果气味的花粉引诱猎物，再用翅膀般的叶片握住一根出奇结实的葱，将猎物打倒。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME lures prey with pollen that smells like Topo Berries. It then bashes them with a surprisingly sturdy leek held in its wing-like leaf.

entry: POKENAME受攻击时，身上的羽毛会散发令人舒缓的蒜蒜果香气。挨打后，它便笨拙地逃跑，两颗头在身后甩来甩去。
author: .izik
source: The feathers on POKENAME's body emit a soothing Niniku Berry aroma when it's attacked. It then flees awkwardly after being struck, both heads flopping behind it.

entry: POKENAME的三颗头都会释放带热椒果香气的花粉。附近生物若接触太久，就会产生强烈的困意。
author: .izik
source: Each of POKENAME's three heads releases Touga Berry-scented pollen. Prolonged exposure induces severe drowsiness in nearby creatures.

entry: POKENAME黏滑的身体散发着类似萄葡果的气味，吸引小拉达等猎物。有些宝可梦完全无法抗拒这种味道，会被引到近处，轻易遭到捕捉。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's slimy body emits a scent similar to that of Grepa Berries, which attracts prey like Rattata. The scent is irresistible to certain Pokémon, luring them closer for an easy capture.

entry: POKENAME身上覆有散发文柚果气味的黏液。不过黏液毒性极强，哪怕短暂接触，也会引发抽搐。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body is coated in goo that smells like Sitrus Berries. However, the goo is extremely toxic, causing convulsions even with brief contact.

entry: POKENAME待在色彩斑斓的礁石间，张着大嘴耐心等待。小鱼为寻找庇护游进嘴里后，它便猛然闭口，将其困在里面消化。
author: fancyskunk
source: POKENAME positions itself among colorful reefs, its large mouth agape. It waits patiently for small fish seeking refuge to swim inside, then slams shut, locking them inside for digestion.

entry: POKENAME嘴唇细薄，牙齿尖利，让孩子们十分害怕。它那双叶片般的手，也萦绕在许多孩子的想象中。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are quite scary to children because of their thin lips and sharp teeth. Their leafy hands haunt the imaginations of many children.

entry: POKENAME伸出长长的根系，缠住岩石，挖土时拖着它们前进。岩石中的矿物被吸走后会逐渐缩小，因此它总在寻找更多岩石，添到尾巴上。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME extend a long network of roots to cling to rocks that they pull along as they dig through soil. These rocks get smaller as POKENAME leech minerals, which is why they are always looking for more rocks to add to their tail.

entry: POKENAME带有零余果香气的花粉效力极强，能让成年人瞬间入睡。等猎物睡着后，它便趁机享用对方的梦。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's Chesto Berry-scented pollen is so potent that it can put an adult human to sleep instantly. Once the prey is asleep, it takes the opportunity to feast on their dreams.

entry: POKENAME的形态十分奇特。本应长头的地方，却是顶部敞开的植物，内含能麻痹并消化食物的毒液。大脑反而位于背上柔软的球茎中，战斗时必须小心保护。
author: pestobest
source: POKENAME has a very unusual morphology. The open-topped plant where a head would normally be contains a poisonous liquid that paralyzes and digests food. Its brain is instead located in the squishy bulb on its back, which it must protect in battle.

entry: 据说，POKENAME心情不好时，脚上覆着酸液，踢击会变得致命。因此，人们在它身边总格外谨慎。
author: skibadimetal70786
source: It's said that when POKENAME is in a bad mood, its kicks become deadly due to the acid coating its feet. People remain cautious around POKENAME because of this.

entry: 钟状部位的内侧挂着点点枣花蜜，能引来猎物。一旦困住虫子，消化液便会将其溶解，然后再次等待下一只。
author: quackquackattack
source: Droplets of jujube nectar cling to the inside of the bell, which lures in prey. Once it ensnares a bug, its digestive juices dissolve its target before repeating the process.

entry: POKENAME体内充满高浓度强酸，连骨头也能熔穿。它会缠在粗大的树枝上，等猎物从下方经过。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's body is overflowing with a highly concentrated acid that is strong enough to melt through bone. It wraps around large tree branches waiting for its prey to walk underneath it.

entry: POKENAME伪装成袋兽妈妈，用藤蔓招手，引诱袋兽幼崽爬进其实是嘴的育儿袋。成年袋兽一见到它就会攻击。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME disguises itself as a Kangaskhan mother, beckoning with its vines to try to lure infant Kangaskhan to climb into its pouch, which is actually its mouth. Adult Kangaskhan will attack it on sight.

entry: POKENAME用花朵摩擦头上的叶片，使其带上甜香。虫宝可梦想啃食叶片时，就会掉进它的嘴里。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: POKENAME rubs flowers on the leaf on its head, giving it a sweet scent. When bug Pokémon try to nibble on the leaf, they fall into POKENAME's mouth.

entry: 若听见丛林深处传来女子令人毛骨悚然的尖叫，可别贸然循声前往。那可能是POKENAME，正试图把你引过去吃掉。
author: hophoppip
source: If you hear a woman's blood-curdling scream from deep in the jungle, be cautious about following the noise. It may be a POKENAME trying to lure you in and consume you.

entry: POKENAME用身体伸出的一对带电藤蔓抓住猎物，以电击将其麻痹，再扔进嘴里，用消化液溶解。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses a pair of electrified vines from its body to grab its prey and shock them into paralysis. Then it tosses them into its mouth, where the juices will digest them.

entry: POKENAME从树上落下，猛烈地扑腾着追逐可能的猎物。可等它终于抓到东西时，却已经累得无力吃下。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME falls from trees to aggressively flop and chase after potential prey. By the time it manages to catch something, it's too exhausted to actually consume the captured creature.

entry: POKENAME生活在浑浊的热带河流中，从水下伏击猎物。旱季则爬到树冠，从上方狩猎。
author: staghorn
source: POKENAME lives in murky tropical rivers, ambushing prey from below. During the dry season, it ascends to the canopy and hunts prey from above.

entry: POKENAME懒洋洋地浮在水上，把背上的大嘴浸入水中，用信息素吸引猎物。毫无戒心的猎物游过时，它便一口咬住，并吸收多余的水，避免身体过热。
author: creaturecore
source: POKENAME lazily floats on the water, using pheromones to attract prey while the maw on its back is submerged. It snaps up any unsuspecting prey that swim by, and the excess water is absorbed to keep this Pokémon from overheating.

entry: POKENAME嘴里不断渗出气味刺鼻的液体。低端美容公司很容易以低廉成本采集这些液体，用于各种产品。
author: mepp.
source: A pungent fluid constantly oozes from POKENAME's mouth. Low-end beauty companies are able to easily collect this fluid for little cost to use in a variety of products.

entry: POKENAME完全有能力主动狩猎，却更喜欢伏击等待。它能完美地藏在水下、高草间，甚至树冠中。
author: stevethebarbarian
source: While POKENAME is fully capable of hunting prey actively, it prefers to lay in wait. It can hide perfectly underwater, amongst tall grass, or even in the treetops.

entry: 与大食花不同，POKENAME能吃下远比自己嘴大的猎物。它会先将其撕成小块，再一块块吞下。
author: stevethebarbarian
source: Unlike Victreebel, POKENAME can devour prey much bigger than its mouth. It does this by shredding them into smaller pieces and swallowing those one-by-one.

entry: POKENAME栖息在丛林和雨林的树冠中，占据广阔的领地。它们通常只在下雨时起飞，雷暴期间最为活跃。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME roost in the canopy of jungles and rainforests, commanding a huge territory for themselves. They usually only take flight during the rains, becoming most active during thunderstorms.

entry: POKENAME藏在树间，摆动虫子形状的藤蔓，吸引鸟宝可梦。毫无戒心的猎物靠近后，它便用有毒的前肢猛烈攻击。
author: mepp.
source: While POKENAME camouflages in trees, it attracts avian Pokémon by wiggling its bug-shaped vine. When unsuspecting prey draws near, it proceeds to strike furiously with its venomous forelegs.

entry: POKENAME看见想吃的东西时，藤蔓般尾巴的末端就会渗出黏稠树液。它偏爱糖衣苹果等甜食，也喜欢其他嘉年华小吃。
author: .izik
source: The end of POKENAME's vine-like tail gets sticky with sap when it spots something it wants to eat. It prefers sweet treats such as candy apples and other carnival food.

entry: POKENAME每天早上都会用叶状手臂擦亮外壳，确保它在阳光下闪耀。它悄然从一根树枝飞到另一根，从面具般的脸后注视闯入者。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME uses its leaflike arms to polish its shell each morning, ensuring it gleams in sunlight. It flutters from branch to branch in silence, watching intruders from behind its masklike face.

entry: POKENAME觅食时倒飞，方便捞起猎物。可猎得太久，自己也会头晕。
author: frokachu
source: When locating prey, POKENAME fly upside down to better scoop them up. When hunting for too long, they end up getting dizzy.

entry: POKENAME分泌甜美的花蜜，收集在大嘴里。餐厅会饲养它，让它用尾巴把花蜜涂在烘焙食品上，为美味点心增添甜蜜光泽。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME secrete a sweet nectar that they collect in their large mouths. They are raised by restaurants to use their tails to lather the nectar onto baked goods, providing a sweet and glossy finish to delicious treats.

entry: POKENAME生活在茂密的丛林中，天然的伪装加上只在灌木间移动的习惯，使它常被忽视。它害羞、避人，面对比自己大的东西，宁愿逃跑也不愿战斗。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME is found in dense jungles, its natural camouflage and habit of only moving through the undergrowth mean it is often overlooked. It is shy and avoids people, preferring to flee rather than fight anything larger than itself.

entry: POKENAME用头上的叶片把垃圾铲进嘴里，再以胃中的强酸溶解。受到威胁时，它会先向攻击者吐出酸液，再迅速逃走。
author: santon5512
source: Using the leaf on their heads, POKENAME will scoop trash into their mouths, dissolving it with the powerful acid in their stomachs. When threatened, they will spit this acid at attackers before scurrying away.

entry: POKENAME用大叶片在树枝间荡行，增强跳跃能力。它从灌木或树冠中猛然跃向猎物，趁对方措手不及，试图将其整个吞下。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses its large leaf to swing from branches and boost its leaping ability. It jumps out at prey from bushes and tree canopies, taking them by surprise as it attempts to swallow them whole.

entry: 一支著名足球队将POKENAME印在队徽上，也用它作吉祥物。因为球队所在的城市，是少数能在丛林湖泊中发现野生个体的地方之一。球迷常高呼“POKENAME，赢得胜利！”
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: A famous football team has a POKENAME on its badge and as its mascot. This is because its city is one of the few places where POKENAME are naturally found, on a lake in the jungle. Fans often chant "POKENAME for victory".

entry: POKENAME在明亮阳光下也能茁壮成长，却更喜欢吸取其他宝可梦的体力和精神能量，作为主要能量来源。只要有机会，它就会把宝可梦塞进嘴里。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME thrives in the bright sun, but it prefers to get most of its energy by siphoning the physical and mental energy of other Pokémon. Whenever possible, it will deposit Pokémon into its mouth.

entry: 夜间，POKENAME的胃酸会冒着泡涌上脖子，来到嘴边，使它流出腐蚀性极强的金色黏液。
author: quackquackattack
source: At night, the stomach acid of POKENAME bubbles up their necks and to their mouths. This causes them to drool a golden ooze that is highly corrosive.

entry: 这次融合反而让它更笨了。大食花似乎无法好好代替大舌贝。
author: dodoowner_
source: Fusion, in this case, has made the fusion more dumb. Victreebel doesn't seem to work as a replacement for Shellder.

entry: POKENAME的唾液含糖量高，是许多香水珍贵的原料。甜香虽受人喜爱，采集者却可能被它锋利凶狠的门牙咬伤。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME's saliva is a prized ingredient in many perfumes thanks to its high sugar content. While the sweet smell is loved by many, the collection methods run the risk of the harvester being bitten by the viciously sharp incisors of POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME的唾液含糖量高，是许多香水珍贵的原料。甜香虽受人喜爱，采集者却可能被它锋利凶狠的门牙咬伤。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME's saliva is a prized ingredient in many perfumes thanks to its high sugar content. While the sweet smell is loved by many, the collection methods run the risk of the harvester being bitten by the viciously sharp incisors of POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME先从猪笼草状的钳子散发甜香，再把猎物舀进去，用内部的酸液溶解。身体由耐用的钢铁构成，不论自己的毒液如何飞溅，都不会受损。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME release a sweet scent from their pitcher-plant pincers before scooping up their prey and dissolving them with the acid inside. Their bodies are made of a durable steel that can withstand their own poison no matter how much it splashes.

entry: POKENAME从朝上的嘴里喷出岩浆，将炽热弹丸发射到数十米外。它的攻击常与森林火灾相伴，大地被烧过后留下肥沃的灰烬，供新植物生长。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME belch magma from their upturned mouth at their foes, launching the fiery projectiles dozens of meters through the air. Their attacks are often linked to forest fires, large areas burning away and leaving fertile ash for new plant growth.

entry: POKENAME栖在丛林树木的低枝上，展开翅膀，竖起头上的叶片，尽量吸收阳光。嘴里散发的甜香会引来小型宝可梦，让它捕住吃掉。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME perch on the lower branches of jungle trees, keeping their wings outstretched and head leaf raised to catch as much sunlight as they can. A sweet scent emanates from their mouth, drawing smaller Pokémon to them which they trap to eat.

entry: POKENAME行动不太灵便，最喜欢挥动藤蔓吸引飞行宝可梦的注意，再用毒球将其击落。
author: zweizweihander
source: POKENAME is not very mobile; its preferred hunting method is catching the attention of flying Pokémon by waving its vine around and then shooting them down with a ball of poison.

entry: POKENAME领地意识强，会俯冲向闯入者，用藤蔓末端的叶片劈砍。飞行时，它用大叶片盖住嘴，减少空气阻力；捕猎时则掀开叶片，把猎物舀进嘴里。
author: oddwalls
source: POKENAME is territorial, diving at trespassers and slashing at them with the leaf at the end of its vine. It covers its mouth with a large leaf to make itself more aerodynamic during flight but opens up the leaf to scoop prey into its mouth.

entry: POKENAME从头上的鹿角散发诱人香气，吸引较小的猎物。等对方靠得足够近，它就整个吞下，在体内彻底溶解。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME release an alluring aroma from the antler on their head, attracting smaller prey towards them. Once close enough, they swallow their food whole, dissolving it completely inside their bodies.

entry: POKENAME尾巴上的液体香甜且极黏。饥饿时，会将其涂在树上，把树变成捕虫陷阱。
author: mykoloth
source: The fluid on POKENAME's tail has a sweet aroma and is incredibly sticky. When hungry, it marks trees with it, turning them into insect traps.

entry: POKENAME吊在树上，等下一位受害者。一旦开始吞咽，胃酸几乎无物不溶，再挣扎也逃不掉。
author: uncookie
source: POKENAME hangs on trees, awaiting its next victim. Once it starts swallowing, its stomach acid dissolves almost anything; attempting escape is futile.

entry: POKENAME在地区内的各片丛林间游荡，用鞭子般的尾巴抓住猎物，整个吞下。胃里的消化液是熔岩，几秒就能熔化食物。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME roams from jungle to jungle across the region, using its whip-like tail to seize prey and swallow them whole. Its stomach contains molten lava as digestive juices, melting down its meals in seconds.

entry: POKENAME虽然像植物，却一点也不柔软。被它吞下的东西几乎都无法逃出。即使吃下一颗待爆的手榴弹，它也不会受到严重伤害。
author: stevethebarbarian
source: Despite looking like a plant, POKENAME isn't remotely soft. Almost nothing it swallows can break out. It can eat a live hand grenade and suffer no serious damage.

entry: POKENAME有两张嘴，却并非都用来进食。最上面的嘴负责吃东西，身体中部的嘴似乎只用来发射破坏光线、冰冻光束和日光束。
author: stevethebarbarian
source: POKENAME has two mouths, but doesn't use them both to eat. While the topmost mouth consumes food, the mouth on its midsection is seemingly only used to fire Hyper Beam, Ice Beam, and Solar Beam attacks.

entry: POKENAME用舌头上的唾液溶解猎物，再将液态的残骸啜饮干净。唾液散发蜂蜜般的甜香，正是它吸引猎物的手段。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME uses the saliva on its tongue to dissolve prey before slurping up their liquid-like remains. The saliva has a sweet honey scent, which is how the Pokémon attracts prey.

entry: POKENAME睡觉时，把大部分身体埋进地下，只露出叶片。叶片中的毒素经提炼后，可用作生产相机胶片的溶剂。
author: .izik
source: When sleeping, POKENAME buries most of its body underground, leaving its leaf exposed. The leaf's poison has been refined as a solvent for camera film production.

entry: POKENAME飞过成群的小型虫宝可梦，张开大嘴，将许多个体整个吞下。它还会用藤蔓般的尾巴戳击对手弱点，每一击都会注入令人疼痛的毒液。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME will fly through swarms of small bug Pokémon, swallowing many of them whole via their gaping maws. They jab at their opponents' weak spots using their vine-like tails, each strike injecting a painful venom.

entry: POKENAME吃掉垃圾和枯死植物，再用强酸性的唾液溶解，让森林保持清洁。它大多独居，性情平和，只有为了保护比自己弱小的生物才会战斗。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME keeps forests clean by ingesting refuse and dead vegetation, dissolving them with its highly acidic saliva. It is a largely solitary and peaceful creature that fights only to protect those weaker than itself.

entry: 叶片上的霜能保护POKENAME，减少战斗中的损伤。天气温暖时，便会开始枯萎。
author: ohok3441
source: The frost on POKENAME's leaves protects it from damage in battle. It will begin wilting in warm weather.

entry: 用尾巴上的毒树果引诱猎物。POKENAME平时没有饰品，但训练家们开始在冬季为它装扮。
author: ohok3441
source: It uses the poisonous Berries on its tail to lure in prey. POKENAME normally lacks accessories, but Trainers have begun decorating it during winter.

entry: POKENAME用大嘴呼吸时，断断续续的呼气声很像人在笑。早年的电影和电视节目，常将多只个体的呼吸录音用作配笑声。
author: chibitales
source: As POKENAME breathes through their large mouth, their stuttering exhalations sound similar to a person laughing. Recordings of this breathing from several POKENAME were often used in old movies and TV shows as laugh tracks.

entry: POKENAME极其骄傲，也毫不掩饰，从表情就能看出来。它先用长藤缠住敌人，再以庞大沉重的身体将其压垮。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are extremely proud and do not make an effort to hide it, as shown by their expressions. They use their long vines to ensnare their foes before crushing them with their large, heavy bodies.

entry: POKENAME把舌头般的叶片浸入河流，吸收水分。受到打扰时，它会从头顶的粉色叶片释放巨大的电弧。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME dips its tongue-like leaf into rivers to absorb moisture. If disturbed, it releases large arcs of electricity through the pink leaf above its head.

entry: POKENAME出手极准，锐利的鞭状尾巴刺向敌人弱处，从不落空。
author: easpordz
source: A POKENAME is extremely accurate with its strikes. With its sharp whip-like tail, it pierces any weak point of its target without fail.

entry: POKENAME外表可爱，却是极其凶悍的捕食者。它用颈部眼睛般的褶边威吓敌人和猎物，并成群发动攻击。
author: truezero2
source: Despite a cute appearance, POKENAME are highly aggressive predators. They use the eyelike frills on their neck to intimidate both foes and prey, attacking as a pack.

entry: POKENAME用人形外表欺骗落单的旅人，将其引向丛林深处。等对方靠得足够近，它就会一口整个吞下。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME attracts lone travelers deeper into the jungle, tricking them with its humanoid appearance. Once they get close enough to POKENAME, it swallows them whole.

entry: POKENAME悬挂在丛林树枝上，释放带木子果气味的毒素，引诱猎物。接触毒素会引起剧痛，为它争取出手时间。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME hangs from jungle branches, releasing Lum Berry-scented poison to lure prey. When touched, its toxins cause intense pain, giving it time to strike.

entry: POKENAME悬浮着穿行丛林，追逐猎物，试着用长藤抓住对方，或从大嘴喷出毒素将其削弱。它会把捕获的猎物拖进核心，休息着等待消化液将食物溶解。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME hovers through the jungle in pursuit of prey, which it attempts to grapple with its long vine or debilitate with toxins fired from its maw. It pulls captured prey into its core and rests while its digestive juices dissolve its food.

entry: POKENAME的核心充满强效消化液，散发甜腻气味吸引猎物。等猎物爬进去，它就用藤蔓将其拍入黏液中，慢慢消化。
author: pjporwoll
source: The core of POKENAME is full of a potent digestive juice that attracts prey with a sickly sweet scent. Once prey climbs inside, POKENAME slaps it into the sticky goo with its vines to slowly consume its meal.

entry: POKENAME的核心充满强效消化液，散发甜腻气味吸引猎物。等猎物爬进去，它就用藤蔓将其拍入黏液中，慢慢消化。
author: pjporwoll
source: The core of POKENAME is full of a potent digestive juice that attracts prey with a sickly sweet scent. Once prey climbs inside, POKENAME slaps it into the sticky goo with its vines to slowly consume its meal.

entry: POKENAME的核心充满强效消化液，散发甜腻气味吸引猎物。等猎物爬进去，它就用藤蔓将其拍入黏液中，慢慢消化。
author: pjporwoll
source: The core of POKENAME is full of a potent digestive juice that attracts prey with a sickly sweet scent. Once prey climbs inside, POKENAME slaps it into the sticky goo with its vines to slowly consume its meal.

entry: 大牙狸群落把POKENAME视为讨厌的家伙。它会吃木头，常偷偷靠近水坝，尽可能偷走木料，再摇摇摆摆地离开。
author: sk372
source: Bidoof colonies consider POKENAME a nuisance, as it consumes wooden logs, often doing so by sneaking near their dams and stealing whatever it can before waddling away.

entry: POKENAME通常生活在密林的阴暗处，摆动连接嘴部的藤蔓，引诱虫属性宝可梦进食。研究人员发现，它吃下108只虫属性宝可梦后，就会前往另一片森林。
author: sleepyman0731
source: POKENAME typically lives in shady parts of dense forests. It swings the vine connected to its mouth to lure Bug-type Pokémon for food. Researchers discovered that after POKENAME consumes 108 Bug-types it travels to another forest.

entry: POKENAME伪装成植物，用触手缠住毫无防备的猎物，塞进体内，再以强烈胃酸迅速分解。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME masquerades as a plant to entangle unwary prey with its tentacles, stuff it inside and quickly decompose it with its strong stomach acid.

entry: POKENAME伪装成植物，用触手缠住毫无防备的猎物，塞进体内，再以强烈胃酸迅速分解。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME masquerades as a plant to entangle unwary prey with its tentacles, stuff it inside and quickly decompose it with its strong stomach acid.

entry: POKENAME能将体内酸液汇聚成强大的破坏光束喷出。会用藤蔓抓住猎物，整只吞下。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME can channel the acid inside it to spew it out as a powerful, destructive beam. It grabs prey with its vines and swallows it whole.

entry: POKENAME能将体内酸液汇聚成强大的破坏光束喷出。会用藤蔓抓住猎物，整只吞下。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME can channel the acid inside it to spew it out as a powerful, destructive beam. It grabs prey with its vines and swallows it whole.

entry: POKENAME能将体内酸液汇聚成强大的破坏光束喷出。会用藤蔓抓住猎物，整只吞下。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME can channel the acid inside it to spew it out as a powerful, destructive beam. It grabs prey with its vines and swallows it whole.

entry: POKENAME食欲旺盛，咬合力很强。它耐心伏击，等猎物靠近后猛然出手，将路过的东西一口吞下。不过咀嚼时，它会露出破绽。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME possesses a voracious appetite and a strong bite. It lies in wait, patiently waiting for prey to approach, before lashing out to consume anything that crosses its path in one bite. However, it leaves itself vulnerable while chewing.

entry: 灾难期间及过后，POKENAME会假装帮助小型宝可梦，将其引走，再用藤蔓抓住猎物，以头上的大嘴吞食。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: During and after disasters, POKENAME will pretend to assist small Pokémon, luring them away. It then grabs the prey with its vines, devouring them with the large mouth on its head.

entry: POKENAME用与身体分离的手抓住猎物，拖进嘴里。据说，它会将生物彻底消化，再把对方的灵魂永远困在体内。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses its disembodied hands to grab prey and drag them into its mouth. It is said that POKENAME will digest a creature completely, then forever hold their soul trapped within its body.

entry: 与POKENAME嘴里的眼睛对视，就会中了催眠般的妖咒。受害者会不由自主地走进张开的大嘴，轻易成为它的下一餐。
author: sk372
source: Locking gazes with the eye in POKENAME's mouth casts a hypnotic hex. Victims are drawn to march their way into its open maw and provide it with its next easy meal.

entry: POKENAME用头上的巨叶封住嘴，把食物困在里面。不幸被抓到的东西，都会被彻底溶解。
author: bacondlx
source: POKENAME uses the massive leaf on its head to seal its food in its mouth. Anything unfortunate enough to be caught by it is dissolved entirely.

entry: POKENAME的胃酸能溶解丢进嘴里的任何东西，从中获取必需的养分。这让它意外地容易照料，训练家只需把想处理掉的无用物品喂给它就行。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's stomach acids are strong enough to dissolve anything tossed into its mouth and gain essential nutrients from it. This makes it surprisingly easy to care for, as Trainers can simply feed it any useless items they need to be rid of.

entry: 野生POKENAME通常出现在沼泽，身体浸在浑浊水中，背部看起来像一座小岛。甜香会把小型虫属性宝可梦引入背上众多的嘴里，每张嘴都盛满消化猎物的酸液。
author: .jerden
source: Wild POKENAME are usually found in swamps, submerged in the murky water so that their back resembles a small island. A sweet smell lures small Bug-type Pokémon into the many mouths on its back, each filled with acid to digest prey.

entry: POKENAME在丛林树木底部警戒危险。捕食者靠近时，它会喷出带有零余果气味的酸雾，保卫巢穴。
author: .izik
source: At the base of jungle trees, POKENAME keeps watch for danger. When predators approach, it defends its nest by spraying acidic mist that smells of Chesto Berries.

entry: POKENAME从头部释放毒烟，将其散布在战场上，扰乱对手。等对方晕头转向后，它便接连挥拳踢击。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME release toxic fumes from their heads, which they spread across the battlefield to disorient opponents. Once disoriented, they deliver a flurry of punches and kicks.

entry: 嘴里的酸液几乎能溶解一切，连它自身金属刀刃也不例外。幸好，金属能像活组织一样重新生长，不过原理仍不清楚。
author: .fedoraman
source: The acid from its mouth is able to dissolve almost anything, including the metal of its blade. Fortunately, the metal can regrow like living tissue, though the mechanism remains unknown.

entry: POKENAME拥有X射线视觉，能看穿栖居的茂密丛林与森林。可伸长的藤蔓尾巴会先吸引猎物，再用强力电流将其击晕或麻痹。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME have x-ray vision that allows them to see through the thick jungles and forests they inhabit. Their tail is an extendable vine used to attract prey before stunning or paralyzing it with powerful electricity.

entry: POKENAME嘴里能产生强酸，用于觅食。酸液散发甜腻气味，能吸引其他宝可梦靠近，充当诱饵。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME produce a powerful acid from their mouths that they use when searching for food. Their acid has a sickly sweet scent and draws other Pokémon to them, acting as a lure.

entry: POKENAME能让金属身体高速旋转。它把长触须与身上锋利的刀刃配合使用，发挥出链锯般的效果。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME can make its metal body rotate incredibly fast. It can couple its long tendrils with the sharp blades of its body, allowing it to use them like a chainsaw.

entry: POKENAME能让金属身体高速旋转。它把长触须与身上锋利的刀刃配合使用，发挥出链锯般的效果。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME can make its metal body rotate incredibly fast. It can couple its long tendrils with the sharp blades of its body, allowing it to use them like a chainsaw.

entry: 用蜂蜜的甜香引来猎物，再猛扑上去。会将猎物整只吞下，用强酸溶解。
author: melodydelune
source: It lures its prey in with the sweet smell of honey and then pounces on them. They swallow their prey whole and dissolve it in their strong acids.

entry: POKENAME操纵尾端美丽的身影，像摆弄木偶一样引诱猎物靠近。受害者进入范围后，它就用藤蔓抓住，将其留在体内消化。
author: fancyskunk
source: POKENAME puppeteers a beautiful-looking figure at the end of its tail to lure prey closer. Once the victim is within reach, it uses its vines to grab the target and hold it inside its body for digestion.

entry: POKENAME背上的叶片形成翅膀，让它能有限地飞行。它用藤蔓般的尾巴抓取树果等零食，送进头上的洞里；那里平时由另一片起保护作用的叶子盖着。
author: sk372
source: Leaves on POKENAME's back form wings that let it take a limited form of flight. It uses its vine-like tail to snatch berries and other snacks to feed into a hole in its head usually covered by another protective leaf.

entry: POKENAME的肠胃充满科学家所知的一些效力最强的酸液。受到击打时，它会将这些酸液吐出，连金属也能溶解。
author: heal_fire
source: POKENAME's intestines and stomach are filled with some of the most potent acids known to scientists. When they're hit, they spit out this acidic substance, which is able to dissolve metal.

entry: POKENAME的叶片能帮助火焰蔓延、扇动火势。叶片虽然容易烧毁，烧坏的组织却会在休息时恢复。
author: partypooperrex
source: A POKENAME's leaves are used to help spread and fan its flames alight. While they are prone to burning up, any burnt tissue is restored while resting.

entry: 它能迅速旋转两颗头，让叶片如锯刃般切割。它既能用茎附着在建筑物上，也能让两颗头分开，像套索一样挥动。
author: chorb33
source: It can rotate its two heads quickly, with the leaves acting like saw blades. Not only can it attach itself to structures with its stalk, it can also separate its two heads and swing them like a lasso.

entry: POKENAME用叶片抓住猎物，整个吃掉。强酸性的胃液几分钟内就能分解吞下的一切，它还会快速旋转身体，加速这一过程。
author: chorb33
