source: POKENAME has a keen sense of smell that it uses to detect mossy rocks along mountain ridges for sustenance. It will use the strength of its arms to climb to difficult spots in order to eat.

entry: POKENAME常被误认成洞中石笋，一生大部分时间都纹丝不动。触碰可能很危险，因为会伸出毒刺自卫。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Often mistaken for a cave stalagmite, POKENAME will remain completely motionless for most of its existence. Touching a POKENAME can be quite dangerous as it will extend a poisonous barb in self-defense.

entry: POKENAME领地意识极强。成群朝登山者发射毒刺，将他们赶离山路。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME is extremely territorial. Colonies of POKENAME will drive off any hikers from their mountain trails by bombarding them with venomous spurs.

entry: POKENAME天性极害羞，察觉登山者靠近，就模仿石头。若被发现，可能把对方瞬间移动回山脚，再另找藏身处。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME is incredibly shy by nature and mimics rocks when it senses mountain climbers nearby. If discovered, it may teleport the climber back to the base of the mountain while it finds a new hiding spot.

entry: 训练家唯一要担心的，是被POKENAME咬，因为它们喜欢啃四肢。除此之外，是坚韧的伙伴，结合投石与喷水赢得胜利。
author: quackquackattack
source: The only thing Trainers have to worry about is being bitten by POKENAME, as they love to chew on limbs. They are otherwise resilient partners that rely on a mixture of thrown rocks and bursts of water to achieve victory.

entry: POKENAME虽重，翅膀仍能带它飞行。攻击时，先飞到上方，再停止拍翅，借重力坠下，让毒针猛砸敌人。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Though its body is very heavy, POKENAME's wings manage to give it flight. When POKENAME attacks, it will fly above and simply stop moving its wings, letting the momentum of gravity slam its stinger into foes.

entry: POKENAME身体厚重，无法飞行，转而用强壮的手臂攀上悬崖与树木。
author: schierke
source: Due to its robust body, POKENAME is unable to fly. Instead, it uses its strong arms to pull itself up cliffs and trees.

entry: POKENAME常见于洞穴附近的森林，非必要很少移动。因此一旦突然被惹恼，就会吓人一跳。
author: swangfrog04
source: POKENAME is often seen in forests near caves and rarely moves unless necessary. This leads to a bit of a scare when it is suddenly provoked.

entry: POKENAME太重，翅膀无法长时间使用。为继续移动，会用额外肢体攀着附近物件荡行。
author: swangfrog04
source: POKENAME cannot use its wings for extended periods of time as a result of its weight. To continue to move, it uses its extra limbs to swing from nearby objects.

entry: 成群POKENAME聚在祖母绿矿藏附近睡觉。它们的存在，是地下藏有贵重矿物的可靠征兆。
author: .izik
source: Clusters of POKENAME gather near emerald deposits to sleep. Their presence is a reliable sign of valuable minerals underground.

entry: POKENAME个头虽小，头上拳头挥出的威力却大得出奇。重心稍偏，因此打中东西后，常自己也跌倒。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's tiny stature belies just how much of a punch the fist on its head possesses when swung around. Its balance is a little lopsided, so it often falls over after punching something.

entry: POKENAME下半身裹着易碎的壳，随时间慢慢剥落。据说，身上最后一片卵壳掉落时，就准备好进化了。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME has a brittle shell around the lower half of its body that slowly flakes away over time. It is said that the moment when it loses all of the eggshell pieces on its body is the moment it is ready to evolve.

entry: POKENAME喜欢跳进湖里玩，沉重石身却让游回岸上很费力。成群相互比赛，看谁入水时溅起最大水花。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME leaps into lakes for recreation, though its heavy stone body makes swimming back out a chore. Groups of POKENAME will compete against each other to see who can make the biggest splash when hitting the water.

entry: POKENAME住在田野，总在脚边窜动，常被误认成会动的石头。极度谨慎，通常还没被踩，就已飞快躲开。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Found in fields, POKENAME are often mistaken for moving rocks as it is constantly skittering underfoot. It is excessively cautious, usually darting away before anything can step on it.

entry: 野生POKENAME很少活动。体重太重，无法跳跃，只能用巨大手掌拖着自己移动。
author: elite01.
source: Wild POKENAME don't move very much. Due to their hefty weight, they cannot hop around. The only way they can move is by dragging themselves with their giant hand.

entry: POKENAME在矿物丰富、泥泞的河床形成。石头身体浮力却出奇好，能漂在水上，双臂懒洋洋划动。常从下方咧嘴笑，吓到泳客，再随水流漂走。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME forms in muddy riverbeds where minerals are abundant. Its rocky body is surprisingly buoyant, allowing it to float while its arms paddle lazily. It often startles swimmers by grinning up from below, then drifting off with the current.

entry: POKENAME住在矿物丰富、泥泞的河床。石头身体浮力却出奇好，能漂在水上，双臂懒洋洋划动。常从下方咧嘴笑，吓到泳客，再随水流漂走。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME lives in muddy riverbeds where minerals are abundant. Its rocky body is surprisingly buoyant, allowing it to float while its arms paddle lazily. It often startles swimmers by grinning up from below, then drifting off with the current.

entry: POKENAME的皮肤质地能显示健康状况。太光滑，说明吃得不够；过分崎岖，则可能生病，或营养失衡。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's health can be determined through the texture of its skin. POKENAME that are too smooth have not been eating enough, while POKENAME that are too craggy may be sick or have a nutritional imbalance.

entry: POKENAME用念动力收集富含云母等反光矿物的石头，让阳光映上洞壁。不要的暗淡石块，会用拳状尾巴扔向入侵者。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME telekinetically gather stones full of reflective minerals like mica to reflect sunlight along cavern walls. They use their fist-like tails to fling dull stones they don't care to keep at intruders.

entry: 背上大石长出顽强的根与叶，犹如难除的杂草。POKENAME站着不动时，有些宝可梦会误认成能吃的植物，它便猛烈挥藤反击。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Stubborn roots and leaves grow out from the big rock on its back like a stubborn weed. When POKENAME stands still, some Pokémon mistake it for edible vegetation; should this happen, it lashes out with its vines violently.

entry: POKENAME覆着像毛一样的锯齿状突刺，保护总用小爪贴地的身体，免遭踩踏。抓力惊人，虽重也能爬上崖壁。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME is Covered in jagged spurs that look like fur, which provide protection from people stepping on it since it constantly clings to the ground with its tiny paws. Its grip strength is incredible, and it can climb up cliffs despite its weight.

entry: POKENAME通过附身岩石，练习驾驭灵体力量。登山者若发现某块石头似曾相识，可能正被它跟踪。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME practice harnessing their ethereal powers by possessing rocks. If hikers find that one of the rocks is familiar, it could be a POKENAME stalking them.

entry: POKENAME腿短、比例笨拙，却能跑得很快。粗硬羽毛帮助挡开攻击。
author: mepp.
source: Despite POKENAME's stubby legs and awkward proportions, it can run quite fast. Its coarse plumage helps repel attacks.

entry: POKENAME在世界各地与石匠并肩工作。两手抓住石头，再以角凿刻。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can be found working alongside stonemasons around the world. It holds onto a stone with its two hands before chiseling into the stone with its horn.

entry: POKENAME攀上陡崖，从巢里偷卵。尖爪与岩石手臂提供足够抓力，紧贴崖面而不坠落。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME climb steep cliffs to steal eggs from nests. Their sharp claws and rocky arms ensure they have the grip strength to hold onto cliffs without falling.

entry: POKENAME向地面喷洒熔岩，宣示领地。这种行为会永久改变栖息地的地形。
author: .izik
source: To claim its domain, POKENAME spits molten lava across the ground. This behavior permanently reshapes the terrain it inhabits.

entry: POKENAME虽没翅膀，双臂却强得能攀过岩石，借力把自己送入空中。以鸟啄猎物般的动作，用头撞到敌人屈服。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Despite lacking wings, POKENAME's arms are strong enough that it can launch itself into the air by pulling itself up and over a rock. It will headbutt enemies into submission in a motion similar to a bird pecking its prey.

entry: POKENAME的毛粗糙如砂纸。挤在一起睡觉时，经常被误认成小片岩石。
author: ayner
source: POKENAME's fur is rough like sandpaper. When they sleep huddled together, they often are mistaken for small rock formations.

entry: 受挑衅时，POKENAME从嘴里发射石头，力道足以在汽车侧面穿出一个洞。
author: hophoppip
source: When provoked, POKENAME fires rocks from its mouth with enough force to puncture a hole in the side of a car.

entry: 这种POKENAME变种颜色更鲜艳、显眼，却仍精于伪装。藏进泥土时，会多花些时间，给身体涂上厚厚尘土。
author: sondededoo
source: While this variant of POKENAME sports a more vibrant and easy-to-spot color, it's still an expert at camouflage. When concealing itself in dirt, this variant will spend additional time coating itself in a thick layer of dust.

entry: POKENAME很以坚固身体为傲，常请对手先打。敌人一击注定被坚石身体挡下，再回敬扎实的反击拳。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is quite proud of the sturdiness of its body. It often invites opponents to take the first hit on it, responding with a solid counter-punch when the foe's blow is inevitably stopped by its resilient stone form.

entry: POKENAME把电力储在头上突出的导电矿物里。谁不幸踩到尾巴，就会遭到猛烈电击。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME stores electricity within the conductive minerals protruding from its head. If something is unfortunate enough to step on its tail, it will emit a violent electrical shock.

entry: 把泥制成光亮圆球的工艺，源于头顶三个泥球的POKENAME。人们认为，抛光是为了展示健康，因为要让易碎泥球光亮、完整，并不容易。
author: quackquackattack
source: The art of making polished balls out of mud originates with POKENAME, who have three atop their head. It is believed that POKENAME polish these balls to show that they are healthy, as keeping these fragile balls polished and intact is difficult.

entry: POKENAME头上三个球体由泥构成，捏成球形后，打磨得光亮。这种泥球抛光工艺，在关都很流行，当地泥土越磨颜色越深。
author: quackquackattack
source: The three bulbs atop POKENAME's head are made out of mud, which they shape into spheres and polish to a glossy finish. This art of polishing balls out of mud was popularized in the Kanto region, where the mud darkens when polished.

entry: POKENAME蓄电太多，就会变得凶猛，向附近任何人或宝可梦胡乱挥拳。
author: foolish_weasel
source: If POKENAME has harnessed too much electrical energy, it will become aggressive and swing its fists wildly at any nearby people or Pokémon.

entry: 手臂强得能把岩石砸成许多碎块。爱吃各式石头，尤其喜欢颜色各不相同的。
author: infinex21
source: Its arms are strong enough to shatter rocks into many small pieces. It loves to eat a variety of rocks, especially if they are of different colors.

entry: POKENAME身上长出的条缕看似羊毛，其实全是坚岩。这些岩石藤蔓能帮助作战，致密的外层，用途出奇多。
author: jojojax164
source: Despite their woolly appearance, the strands growing from POKENAME's body are made up entirely from hard rock. These rocky vines assist the POKENAME in battle, since their dense exteriors are surprisingly versatile.

entry: 皮肤坚如岩石，少有天敌。越是年老，砖块般的纹样越粗糙模糊，最后与普通石头无异。
author: staghorn
source: It has few predators thanks to its rock-hard hide. As it grows older, the brick-shaped pattern on its skin grows rougher and loses definition until it's indistinguishable from stone.

entry: POKENAME休息或受威胁时，会蜷成带刺的球。此时，看起来就像嶙峋巨石。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME curls up into a spiky ball when it is at rest or feels threatened. While in this state, it resembles a jagged boulder.

entry: POKENAME遇见新事物，有些容易立刻防备，用有力石拳打过去。训练家应约束这个习惯，免得每个新朋友都挨打。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a bit quick to jump to the defensive when confronted with new things, punching them with its strong stone fists. Trainers should work to reign in this habit so their POKENAME does not strike at every new acquaintance.

entry: 与许多尼多一族成员不同，POKENAME没有毒角，石拳却覆着毒尘。训练家说它脾气不定，时而温顺，时而难以相处。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Though lacking a venomous horn unlike many other Nidoran species, POKENAME's rocky fists are coated in toxic dust. Trainers note that it has an erratic temperament, being docile one moment and disagreeable at others.

entry: POKENAME小巧，又像满地碎岩，很容易被误踩。这样十分危险，小角中的毒液曾造成死亡。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Small in size, POKENAME is easy to accidentally step on since it looks so similar to rocky ground. Stepping on one does prove quite dangerous as its venom from its small horn has been known to cause fatalities.

entry: POKENAME在群山中寻找树果。腿虽小，爪子抓力却出奇强，是很出色的登山者。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME will forage across mountains for berries. Despite having small legs, its paws have a surprising amount of grip strength, which makes POKENAME a very good mountain climber.

entry: 它步履沉重地朝阳光走，喜欢迁往山顶，更充分地晒太阳。叶片飘出浓烈硫磺味，常让其他对象作呕。
author: foolish_weasel
source: It ambles ponderously towards sunlight, preferring to migrate to mountain summits to best catch the sun's rays. A strong sulfuric smell wafts from its leaves, often causing gagging in others.

entry: POKENAME通常很关爱他者，尤其是同类。不过任何成员遇险，便会结群愤怒冲锋，如同一场岩崩。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME has a typically caring nature, especially towards others of its kind. When any of them are threatened, however, POKENAME will band together in a group and unleash a wrathful stampede akin to a Rock Slide attack.

entry: 矿工常得应付矿道里的POKENAME。它一动不动，张开晶洞般的嘴，引来勾魂眼等宝可梦吃。若受扰，就投石、咬击威胁者自卫。
author: chibitales
source: Miners often have to deal with POKENAME in active tunnels, as they lay still with their geode-like mouths open to lure Pokémon like Sableye to eat. If disturbed, they will defend themselves by throwing rocks and biting at threats.

entry: POKENAME用强爪轻易挖开泥土与岩石。在山区，能见它于严重山崩后帮忙。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME uses its powerful claws to dig through dirt and stone with ease. In mountainous regions, it can be seen helping out after devastating landslides.

entry: POKENAME用背上众多手掌，打出一连串手势与信号交流。人们认为，壳上伸出的手越多，就越聪明。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME communicate with each other via a series of signs and gestures using the many hands growing upon their backs. It's thought that the more hands a POKENAME has jutting from its shell, the more intelligent it is.

entry: POKENAME耳朵僵硬如石，却有肌肉让它朝任何方向活动。在山路上奔走，尽量避开危险。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Though POKENAME's ears are stiff and hard as rock, it possesses muscles capable of moving them in any direction. It scampers across mountain trails, trying to avoid danger where possible.

entry: POKENAME用磁性鼻子寻找地下铁矿。发现后，便不停挖掘，吃掉金属。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its magnetic nose to locate iron deposits underground. Once detected, it digs relentlessly to consume the metal.

entry: POKENAME交替使用手臂和镐攀山。广为流传的传说称，它被一位死去矮人的灵魂附身。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: Alternating between arm and pick, POKENAME scales mountains. Popular legend says it is possessed by the spirit of a deceased dwarf.

entry: 野生POKENAME会互相冲撞，较量谁的身体最坚固。胜出者便成为族群首领。
author: melodydelune
source: In nature, packs of POKENAME will tackle each other to prove whose body is sturdiest. The one that comes out on top becomes the leader of the pack.

entry: POKENAME拖着身体走过海底，岩皮完美融入海床。受扰时，发出地震般的脉冲，甚至能移动海底板块。
author: segmoph
source: POKENAME drags itself across the ocean floor, its rocky hide blending seamlessly with the seabed. When disturbed, it unleashes a quake-like pulse that can shift underwater tectonic plates.

entry: POKENAME休息前，会朝月照的天空扔石头。研究者仍不明白，这种古怪行为究竟为何。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME is known to hurl stones at the moonlit sky before resting. The reason for this peculiar behavior remains a mystery to researchers.

entry: POKENAME用耳朵最多能扛起25吨的重量。看着凶，内心却十分善良。
author: lemmymaster
source: POKENAME are able to carry up to 25 tons of weight using their ears. It looks mean, but it has a heart of gold.

entry: POKENAME有时被称作“月之石宝可梦”，人们认为，成分与月见山的石头相同。整夜醒着望月，弄得睡眼惺忪、一脸疲态地游荡山坡。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Sometimes called the Moon Stone Pokémon, POKENAME is thought to have the same composition as the stones found in Mt. Moon. It groggily wanders the mountainside with a tired expression due to being awake all night staring at the moon.

entry: POKENAME站在岩崖边，凝望夜空。流星雨期间，会飞入太空，在流星进入大气前接住，再安全地扔回宇宙。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME stand at the edge of rocky cliffs watching the night sky. During meteor showers, they will fly up into space and catch meteors before they enter the atmosphere, harmlessly tossing them back into space.

entry: 头上的岩石结晶在黑暗中发光。夜间若在山中遇见登山者，会试着用光引其偏离道路。
author: .jerden
source: The rocky crystal on its head glows in the dark. If it encounters hikers in the mountains at night, it will try to lead them astray with its light.

entry: 它用双臂，把自己放在山路旁，充当误导的光。靠吸食迷路者的生命力为生。
author: .jerden
source: It uses its arms to position itself next to mountain trails as a misleading light. It feeds on the life force of anyone who wanders off the path.

entry: POKENAME使出鬼火召来的火球，像小拳石形状的迷你陨石。撞击力如同落石，还会留下严重灼伤。
author: foolish_weasel
source: When POKENAME summons orbs of fire with its Will-O-Wisp attack, they take the image of miniature meteorites in the shape of Geodude. The orbs slam against foes with the force of a Rock Throw, while leaving severe burns.

entry: POKENAME的伪装未必出色，却热心投石保护朋友。尤其与虫属性宝可梦交好，对方常靠它帮忙，吓走飞行属性天敌。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME may not have the best disguise, but they eagerly defend their friends by throwing rocks. They are especially good friends of Bug-type Pokémon, who rely on POKENAME's help to scare away Flying-type predators.

entry: POKENAME随身的伪装，是袋里塞着的三块石头。虽能大力挥拳，通常并不凶猛，还常走近登山者，带他们穿越群山。
author: .jerden
source: The disguise POKENAME carries around with it consists of three rocks stuffed inside a bag. While POKENAME can swing its fists around with great force, it is not usually aggressive, and will often approach hikers to guide them through the mountains.

entry: 传说踩到POKENAME，家族就会被诅咒1000年。故事说，它太记仇，会追遍每个后代，用九拳痛打。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Legends say that those who step on POKENAME will have their families be cursed for 1000 years. Stories say that it will hunt each descendant down and pummel them with its nine fists because it is so vengeful.

entry: POKENAME用强健四肢钻入地下深处。大多数袭人事件，都因施工时意外把它挖出来。
author: cait_sith
source: It uses its powerful limbs to burrow deep underground. Most POKENAME attacks on humans are due to a POKENAME accidentally being dug up during construction.

entry: POKENAME很懒，又极不合群。闲躺在碎岩小石遍地的地方，朝任何靠近者投石。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is very lazy and has strong antisocial tendencies. It lounges around in places where scattered rocks and pebbles are plentiful, pelting them at anyone that approaches it.

entry: POKENAME精力充沛，见什么都想扭打。有时还想和自己的尾巴打架，咬住尾尖。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: POKENAME is very energetic, tussling with anything it sees. It sometimes tries to fight with its own tail, biting at the tip.

entry: POKENAME常住在山路边，想用轻柔摇篮曲吸引登山者。谁在舒缓表演中睡着，就会被石般硬的拳头打醒，承受它的怒气。
author: foolish_weasel
source: It commonly resides along mountain trails hoping to attract hikers with its lilting lullaby. When people fall asleep during its soothing performance, POKENAME whacks them awake with its rock-hard fists, expressing its anger.

entry: POKENAME有金属壳，铁吃得不够，便可能出现孔洞。野外主要从岩石获取铁，会砸成小块来吃。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have metallic shells that can develop holes if they do not eat enough iron. Their main source of iron in the wild comes from rocks, which they smash and consume in small chunks.

entry: POKENAME把岩石卡进齿轮，转动磨成细砾。不断吃石头，修补身体缺口，让自己保持完好。
author: santon5512
source: By wedging rocks between their gears and spinning, POKENAME can grind them into fine gravel. They constantly consume stone to help repair chips in their bodies, keeping themselves in pristine condition.

entry: POKENAME住在火山地区，会凶狠痛打太靠近栖息地的登山者。尾尖拳头的大小，能显示健康状况。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Found in volcanic regions, POKENAME aggressively pummels hikers who get too close to its habitat. The size of the fist on the end of its tail is an indicator of its health.

entry: POKENAME白天在阳光充足的山区摇摆走动。据说每隔几个月，头上的石拳就会张开，露出一颗珍贵宝石。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME waddles around sunny mountainous areas during the daytime. It's said that every few months, the stone fist on its head will open up to reveal a precious gem.

entry: 尽管密度很高，它却仿佛违背物理规律，浮在空中。人们认为，某种幽灵力量让它做到了这一点。
author: bostroms
source: In spite of its density, it is able to seemingly defy physics and float through the air.  It is thought that some ghostly power allows it to achieve this.

entry: POKENAME在地下出生，在出生的洞穴冬眠数月。此时会与父母建立深厚羁绊，连进化后，也常继续相伴。
author: operativevalkyrie
source: POKENAME is born underground and hibernates in its birth cave for months. During this time, it grows a strong bond with its parents and often stays with them even past evolution.

entry: POKENAME在茂盛山林生活，从多石土壤吸取养分，滋养身体、硬化外层。进食时数小时不动，没经验的路人常误认成巨石。
author: theartemis1
source: POKENAME thrives in lush mountainside forests, drawing nutrients from the rocky soil to nourish itself and harden its exterior. It remains motionless for hours while feeding, often mistaken for a boulder by inexperienced passersby.

entry: POKENAME外层的泡泡，几乎和核心石身一样结实，极难戳破。最好别尝试，否则会暴怒，直到泡泡重新形成。
author: sk372
source: The bubble exterior is nearly as tough as the stony body of the core, and is thus incredibly difficult to pop. Doing so is ill-advised, as POKENAME will fly into a violent rage until its bubble reforms.

entry: POKENAME的棉花摸着像枕头，也用来伪装。许多登山者因缺氧，曾误把头枕在它身上。
author: notsaying.
source: Its cotton has a similar texture to a pillow, being used to camouflage POKENAME. Many mountain climbers have mistakenly laid their heads on POKENAME due to oxygen deprivation.

entry: POKENAME每天砸石头，建临时巢穴。它不愿在同一个地方睡第二次，令观察者费解。
author: .izik
source: Each day, POKENAME crushes stones to create temporary dens. Its preference to never sleep in the same place twice baffles observers.

entry: POKENAME平躺山路，双臂与鲜明花纹通常让人易于察觉、避开。若真被踩，就会抓住脚踝，持续释放令人疼痛的电击，直到对方挣脱。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME lie flat on mountain trails. Their arms and bright patterns usually make them easy to spot and avoid, but if anyone does step on them they will grab the ankle and deliver painful electric shocks until the target breaks free.

entry: POKENAME发现宝石时，黄玉般的双眼兴奋发亮。这些珍贵石头，是饮食中不可或缺的一部分。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME discovers a gemstone, its topaz-like eyes light up with excitement. These precious stones are an essential part of its diet.

entry: POKENAME决心爬遍每座山，靠的就是强健双臂。登顶后，会尽情晒太阳，再下山，寻找下一座攀登。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME is very determined to climb every mountain. It will do this with the power of its strong arms. Once it has reached the top, it will soak in the sun's rays before descending and finding another mountain to climb.

entry: POKENAME跳舞一半是优雅，一半是炫耀。察觉观众不欣赏舞步或体格，就借看似无害的舞步挪近，再用石拳反手一击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's dances are equal parts elegance and grandstanding. If it senses an onlooker isn't impressed with either its moves or its build, it maneuvers itself closer through innocuous dance steps before delivering a stone-fisted backhand.

entry: POKENAME本能地协作，在大型活动中替队友加油。强健双臂让它能做各种啦啦操，不过表演有任何失误，都会十分恼火。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME instinctively work together to cheer on teammates during large events. Their strong arms make them very capable of performing a variety of cheer routines, though they get very irritated if the performance is botched in any way.

entry: POKENAME发出有害臭气，赶走进入山中领地的人和宝可梦。会把黏稠花蜜吐在手上，帮助上下攀崖。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME emits a noxious scent to ward off people and Pokémon from its territory in the mountains. It spits up sticky nectar onto its hands to help it climb up and down cliffs.

entry: POKENAME虽缺乏飞行所需的构造，却深信只要努力就能飞。会跳下悬崖，拼命拍臂又直直坠落，训练家必须提防天降的它。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is convinced it can fly if it tries hard enough, despite lacking the necessary attributes. Trainers are warned to watch for falling POKENAME as it leaps from cliffs and plummets while flapping its arms rapidly.

entry: POKENAME身上的蘑菇，采下后迅速再生。会把真菌种在洞穴，建立领地。
author: .izik
source: The mushrooms on POKENAME's body regrow rapidly after being harvested. It plants these fungi in caves to establish its territory.

entry: POKENAME住在湿暗洞穴，四处散播寄生孢子，希望繁衍更多同类。不动时就像无害巨石，也懂得利用这点。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Found in dank caves, POKENAME will spread its parasitic spores across the cavern in the hopes of propagating more of its species. When it is immobile, POKENAME simply looks like a harmless boulder, which it uses to its advantage.

entry: POKENAME用石臂砸燧石矿层，头上鳞片挡在脸前，防备飞溅碎片。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME smashes flint deposits with its stone arms. It uses the scale on its head to shield its face from flying shards.

entry: POKENAME喜欢用采来的野花围住自己。谁打扰花园中的冥想，就会被它用巨手夹击头骨，打昏过去。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME enjoys surrounding itself with wild flowers it has collected. Should anything try to disrupt its meditation within its flower garden, it knocks them out via clapping its huge hands on their skull.

entry: POKENAME会躲开进入领地的矿工。害怕挖掘工具的巨响，便钻入地下深处，避免冲突。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are known to hide from miners that enter their domain. They are scared of the loud tools that miners use for excavation and burrow deep underground to avoid confrontation.

entry: 它在体内搅动烟气，增强力量，甚至能把沉重身体抛向远处。格外费力地活动后，会从嘴里排出积存烟雾。
author: sk372
source: It churns up smoke within its body to strengthen itself, including letting it hurl its heavy body long distances. After particularly taxing movement, it releases the pent-up smoke from its mouth.

entry: POKENAME性情暴烈，谁靠得太近惹恼它，就会挨拳。皮肤虽融入山地，火尾却暴露位置，让人能远远绕开。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME has a violent temperament, swinging its fists at any person or Pokémon that provokes it by approaching too closely. While its skin blends in mountainous terrain, its fiery tail gives it away, allowing people to give it a wide berth.

entry: POKENAME主要住在山路地下，勤快地用手挖土。有时会在脚下冒头，绊倒登山者，究竟是否故意，仍不清楚。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME primarily lives underground around mountain trails, diligently using its hands to dig through the ground. Sometimes it will pop its head up while underfoot, causing hikers to trip and fall. Whether it does this intentionally is unknown.

entry: POKENAME体内的矿物，一晒太阳就热得难受，因此大半辈子住在地下。不过有时也会突然从脚下冒头，绊倒登山者。
author: foolish_weasel
source: The mineral composition of POKENAME's body gets uncomfortably hot when exposed to sunlight, thus it spends most of its life underground. However, POKENAME will sometimes pop its head up unexpectedly while underfoot, causing hikers to trip and fall.

entry: 踩到POKENAME，危险程度是踩到小拳石的三倍，因为每具身体都会毫不留情地痛打冒犯者。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Stepping on a POKENAME is three times as perilous as stepping on a Geodude, as each body of POKENAME will pummel the offender with extreme prejudice.

entry: POKENAME喜欢夜间搜遍洞穴，寻找闪亮宝石。太爱发光物件，也习惯打磨自己的石身，让它同样闪耀。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME likes to scour caves for shiny gems during the night. Because it loves shiny objects, POKENAME will habitually polish its rocky body so that it too can shine.

entry: POKENAME喜欢收集闪亮石头。谁想偷取任何藏品，它便凶性大发，把对方打得不省人事。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME likes to collect shiny stones. If something tries to steal anything from its collection, it will get aggressive and pummel them into oblivion.

entry: 融合后，POKENAME的皮肤硬化成岩石质地，毛发全掉了。如今带着一撮旧毛，满怀感情地纪念曾有的一切。
author: gamelord64
source: After fusing, POKENAME's skin hardened to a rocky texture, causing all its hair to fall out. It now carries a tuft of its old hair, a sentimental reminder of what it once had.

entry: POKENAME用结实双臂挖出矿物，增强力量。每次发现，都让惊人的韧性更上一层。
author: .izik
source: By digging up minerals with its sturdy arms, POKENAME enhances its strength. Each discovery adds to its impressive resilience.

entry: 有些山不向游客开放，因为POKENAME会凶狠赶走闯入栖息地的对象。野外研究者从没见过高兴的野生个体。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Some mountains are closed off to visitors because POKENAME will aggressively drive off anyone it sees encroaching on its habitat. Field researchers have never seen a happy POKENAME in the wild.

entry: POKENAME天性威严，历史上曾受雇守护庙宇与圣地。会长久一动不动，游客便误认成优美雕像。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Historically POKENAME have been employed as guardians of temples and holy sites due to their regal nature. POKENAME will remain motionless for long periods of time, which cause visitors to mistake them as elegant statues.

entry: POKENAME身体虽是岩石，翅膀仍足够强壮，能飞上天空，寻找山男对战。常以尾巴挥出陨石坠落般的力量作战。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Despite POKENAME's body being made of rock, its wings are strong enough to allow it to fly through the air, where it searches for mountain Hikers to battle. It often does battle by swinging its tail with the force of a falling meteor.

entry: POKENAME身上的螺旋刻纹能作鳃使用。喜欢相互比赛，跳进湖里，看谁最快沉到水底。
author: foolish_weasel
source: The spiral etching on POKENAME's body functions as gills. POKENAME like to compete with each other by diving into lakes to see who can sink to the bottom quickest.

entry: POKENAME住在高山湖泊附近，白天爬山，夜间退入水中求安全。下沉时不断旋转，螺旋腹纹让旁观者睡着。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME lives near alpine lakes, climbing up mountains during the day and retiring into the water for safety at night. It will spin as it sinks to the bottom of the water, its spiral belly pattern putting any onlookers to sleep.

entry: POKENAME挥拳打穿石头，寻找藏在里面的结晶。用这些闪亮珍宝装点巢穴。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME punches through stones in search of crystals hidden inside. It uses these sparkling treasures to adorn its den.

entry: POKENAME为让同伴刮目相看，会将巨石堆成高塔。栖息地各处，都能发现这种岩石结构。
author: .izik
source: To impress its peers, POKENAME stacks boulders into towering formations. These rock structures can be found scattered across its habitat.

entry: 有时能见POKENAME与脊椎矫正师合作，帮助缓解背痛。结实双手能调整人的脊椎，协助恢复适当排列。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can sometimes be found working with chiropractors to help alleviate back pain. Its firm hands allow it to perform adjustments to a person's spine to facilitate proper alignment.

entry: POKENAME将自己固定在地里数日，假装普通石头，等东西落上来。随后喷出腐蚀黏液，轻易溶化猎物。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME will anchor itself into the ground for days, posing as a simple rock, and wait for something to land on it. When this happens, it will spew a corrosive slime that can easily melt its prey.

entry: POKENAME入水时会打磨岩壳，减少阻力，更好游泳。之后滚下山坡，沾起岩石碎屑，修复甲壳。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME will polish its rock-like shell when it dips into water to help reduce resistance so it can swim better. Afterwards, it will roll down hillsides to accumulate rocky debris to restore its shell.

entry: POKENAME附在海沟壁上，身体沉重，渔夫常将它系在钓线末端，让鱼钩一路沉到海床。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are found clinging to the walls of undersea trenches. Because of their heavy bodies, fishermen will often attach these Pokémon to the ends of their lines, letting their hooks sink all the way to the seabed.

entry: 许多名厨用POKENAME的碎块做特殊石头汤。几乎没有香气，食客常互问，汤里能闻到什么。许多人因此以为，只有资深食客才能品出门道。
author: .izik
source: Many accomplished chefs use pieces of POKENAME to make special stone soups. Almost entirely scentless, many diners ask one another if they can smell anything in the stew, leading many to believe it is a dish only for accomplished palates.

entry: POKENAME熟练运用四臂，快速攀爬居住的山脊。谁危及山顶野生生灵，就会被它扔巨石赶走。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME skillfully uses its four arms to climb rapidly along the mountain ridges where it lives. If anyone endangers the wildlife inhabiting the peaks, it drives them away by hurling boulders.

entry: POKENAME滚下斜坡时，路线精准得惊人，轻松穿梭障碍。凭这本领，成为山地高手。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME rolls down slopes with incredible accuracy, weaving through obstacles effortlessly. This skill makes it a master of mountainous terrain.

entry: POKENAME常参与山地救援，欢迎迷路或受伤的登山者爬上背，再载回安全处。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME often works in mountain rescue. It welcomes any lost or injured hikers to climb upon its back, where it'll ride them back to safety.

entry: POKENAME太像岩石，有时会被误踩。之后便愤怒地朝冒犯者喷水。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Because POKENAME looks so similar to a rock, it sometimes gets stepped on by accident. When this happens, POKENAME will angrily spray water at the offender.

entry: POKENAME跟踪猎物时，常伪装在露出的岩石之间。宝可梦无意靠近，便胡乱挥拳，发起伏击。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME often camouflages itself amongst rocky outcroppings while it stalks prey. Once a Pokémon unwittingly approaches, POKENAME will then ambush it by swinging its fists wildly.

entry: POKENAME住在关都矿洞深处，用磁力挖矿，找出盐。许多餐馆愿高价买下这种咸香调味料。
author: ghostslythe
source: Deep in Kanto mines, POKENAME resides using its magnetism to dig out ore and reveal salt. Many restaurants buy this savory seasoning at a high price.

entry: POKENAME两侧伸出的岩石，有种对石头格外有效的特殊磁性。磁力很强，轻松就能举起一只隆隆石。
author: sk372
source: The rocks jutting out from POKENAME's sides possess a unique type of magnetism most effective on stones. Its magnetism is strong enough to be able to lift up a Graveler with little issue.

entry: POKENAME住在关都矿井，以磁力挖矿。谁想偷矿石储备，就会遭到麻痹电击。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME live inside mineshafts in the Kanto region, where they dig out ore with their magnetic powers. If anyone tries to steal from their hoard of ores, they zap the thieves with paralyzing electric shocks.

entry: POKENAME视大葱如珍宝。一握到手，就不可能再夺走，哪怕已经被击昏也一样。
author: bradlybro199
source: POKENAME see their leeks as their prized possessions. Once in their grasp, it's impossible to remove it from their hand even after they've been knocked out.

entry: POKENAME的两颗头，相比细弱脖子沉重得多。野外必须迅速长壮，才能生存，也才能跑过天敌。
author: mochauspocus
source: POKENAME's two heads are incredibly heavy in comparison to its flimsy necks. In the wild, it has to bulk up quickly to be able to survive and outrun predators.

entry: 人们常把一群POKENAME误认成泥石流，反正危险程度相差不多。身体像黏土，越湿越柔软可塑，数量够多，便能轻易把人吞没。
author: foolish_weasel
source: It is not uncommon for folks to confuse mudslides with a group of POKENAME, granted they are about as dangerous. Their bodies are consistent with clay and get more malleable with moisture, but enough of them can easily engulf a person.

entry: POKENAME几乎与泥无异，踩上往往灾祸临头，汹涌躯体能轻易吞下一切。更糟的是，还极具腐蚀性，吞下后很快便消化。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Almost indistinguishable from mud, stepping on a POKENAME usually spells doom as it will easily consume anything with its overflowing mass. To make matters worse, its form is very corrosive, quickly digesting anything that it engulfs.

entry: POKENAME用高压水，从炮管里轰出岩石。沉重身体能抵住后坐力，保持稳定。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME blasts rocks out from its cannons with pressurized water. Its heavy body helps keep it steady from the recoil of the cannon shots.

entry: POKENAME为清路，会甩尾重击山坡，震落岩石。可惜，努力之后，山路往往更加危险。
author: .izik
source: To clear paths, POKENAME slams its tail into mountainsides to dislodge rocks. Unfortunately, its efforts often make trails more hazardous.

entry: POKENAME吃土和小石，强化岩壳，保护背上不停生长的种子。消化矿物时，体内会产生毒尘，再从嘴里吹出，驱赶害物。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME feeds on soil and small stones to fortify the rocky shell that protects the seed constantly growing on its back. As it digests the minerals, its body produces a poisonous dust that it blows from its mouth to drive away pests.

entry: 据说古人会把成群POKENAME推下山坡，下注比快，作为娱乐。如今，POKENAME仍以速度自豪，只有修补体裂时才慢下来。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: It is believed that in ancient times, people would roll groups of POKENAME down hills for entertainment, placing bets on which is faster. To this day, POKENAME pride themselves on their speed, only slowing down to mend the cracks in their bodies.

entry: 野生POKENAME在巢里囤着许多骨头和亮石。骨头凑够一副骨架，就会安葬遗骸，再继续寻找更多。
author: quackquackattack
source: Wild POKENAME have a large collection of bones and shiny rocks that they store in their dens. If they have enough bones to form a skeleton, they bury the remains before continuing to search for more bones.

entry: POKENAME用骨头猛砸崖壁，敲松矿物来吃。力道太强，常在岩石上留下坑洞。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME slams its bone into cliff walls to loosen minerals, which it then eats. The force of its strikes often leaves craters in the rock.

entry: POKENAME用双臂保持平衡、调整方向，施展强踢。伸长的四肢也能助它攀崖，一脚就能碎岩。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME primarily use their arms to balance and direct themselves while performing powerful kicks. They extend their limbs to help them scale cliffs, kicking hard enough to shatter rock.

entry: POKENAME能让拳套硬得超过岩石。它们仔细击开洞壁，开辟新道，救出塌方中受困的人与宝可梦。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are able to harden the gloves on their fists to be harder than rock. They carefully punch out sections of cave walls to create new tunnels and free people or Pokémon from cave-ins.

entry: POKENAME舌头极敏感，甚至得包进石中保护。每只POKENAME选的石料不同，方便品尝各自喜爱的矿物。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: The tongues of POKENAME are very sensitive, to the point where they encase them in rocks for protection. Different POKENAME use different types of rocks in this process to enjoy their favorite minerals.

entry: POKENAME难以靠鼓胀离地，便改用吃下的岩石分解出的粉尘喷射推进，让自己悬空。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME struggle to inflate themselves enough to lift off the ground. They instead release dust broken down from the rocks they eat to act as propulsion to suspend themselves in the air.

entry: 它徘徊在山区施工车辆旁，吸入废气。吸收太多，就会过热，猛烈爆炸。
author: .izik
source: It lingers near construction vehicles in mountains, breathing in their exhaust. If it absorbs too much, it overheats and explodes violently.

entry: 它用岩石般坚硬的双臂，将药草捣成糊。这种疗伤药膏，用于帮助受伤宝可梦恢复活力。
author: .izik
source: It pounds herbs into a paste with its rock-hard arms. This healing salve is used to aid injured Pokémon and restore vitality.

entry: 山侧像陨石坑的地形，往往并非流星撞成，而是POKENAME造成。它们聚在一起比赛抛接杂耍，通常以自爆收场。
author: mega_beedrill
source: Crater-like formations on the sides of mountains are often not caused by meteors, but rather by POKENAME. They gather together in juggling contests that usually end with POKENAME using Self-Destruct.

entry: POKENAME生气时，身上许多石头会烧红、掉落。许多文化曾当成它的赠礼，其实只是调节体温。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME gets angry, multiple stones on its body grow red hot and fall off. Many cultures believed these were gifts from the Pokémon, but in reality, it was just regulating its body temperature.

entry: 凶猛冲锋、岩皮与身后的手臂，让POKENAME从任何角度都难以靠近。即使离得远，双臂也能投来重石。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Its fearsome charge, rocky hide, and the arms on its rear make POKENAME difficult to approach from any angle. Even at a distance, its arms can lob heavy stones.

entry: 它的身体黏软如泥，很难与峡谷地面分辨。会等在缝隙，伏击毫无戒备的猎物。
author: .izik
source: Its body is gooey and mud-like, making it difficult to distinguish it from the canyon floor. It waits in cracks to ambush unsuspecting prey.

entry: POKENAME吃下大量砾石，休息时储在体内。受到特定电子信号影响，就会精准地一阵阵喷出石头，每阵可重达64磅。
author: .izik
source: After consuming large amounts of gravel, POKENAME stores it within its body while resting. When exposed to certain electronic signals, it expels the stones in precise bursts weighing up to 64 lbs.

entry: POKENAME挖开山谷侧壁，希望找到化石化的同类。扔下的巨石常落在道路上，造成封路，四处竖起绕行牌。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME dig into the side of valleys hoping to find their fossilized brethren. The boulders they toss down often land atop roads, leading to closures and many detour signs.

entry: POKENAME大部分运动肌肉软弱、发育不足，通常会静待进一步进化。受攻击时，可能以爆炸作为最后手段。夏季，身上岩石可能泛起橙光。
author: bobosmith01
source: Most of what acts as POKENAME's motor muscles are weak and underdeveloped, so it generally stays still until it evolves further. If it is being attacked, it may explode as a last resort. During the summer, its rocks may take on an orange sheen.

entry: POKENAME大吃矿物丰富的食物，维持岩石身躯。常睡在山顶，有时梦中就滚下山去。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME gorges on mineral-rich foods to maintain its rocky composition. It sleeps on the top of mountains, sometimes tumbling down in its sleep.

entry: POKENAME在群体内的阶级，由复杂社会制度决定。毒针能钻穿石头。
author: bobosmith01
source: Complex social systems dictate the ranking of POKENAME within in a group. Their stingers can drill through stone.

entry: POKENAME把找到的有趣石头加到身上，增加体量。几秒内便能适应、运用新石头，仿佛始终是身体一部分。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME gains mass by adding interesting rocks it finds to its body. It can adapt to accept and utilize the new stone as if it had always been part of its body within seconds.

entry: POKENAME外形粗犷，乍看似乎冷酷，其实很在意自己的身体。在其他宝可梦面前尽量不张嘴，免得巨牙吓着对方。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME may seem callous at first because of their rugged appearance, but they are rather sensitive about their bodies. They try not to open their mouths around other Pokémon to avoid scaring them with their massive fangs.

entry: POKENAME的身体由松散砾石与页岩组成。全速飞行时，常脱落页岩“羽毛”，砸中不幸身处下方的对象。
author: bradlybro199
source: A POKENAME's body is comprised of loose gravel and shale. When flying at top speeds they often shed shale "feathers" that fall, and often hit those unlucky enough to be below them at the time.

entry: POKENAME白天纹丝不动，坚硬身体让天敌不敢靠近。人们相信，夜里的叫声能召来女巫；若许多叫声同响，便是女巫在聚会。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME stay very still during the day, their tough body discouraging predators. It is believed that the noises they make at night summon witches, and when many are heard, a witch gathering is taking place.

entry: POKENAME翅膀上的岩石轻而中空，让它能短暂飞行。住在高山，收集小石筑巢。
author: mistymagius
source: The rocks that make up POKENAME's wings are light and hollow, allowing it to maintain flight for a short period of time. It nests high up in the mountains, collecting small rocks to build its nest.

entry: 飞行时，翅膀落下细碎砾石，留下一路碎屑。坚实身体，让它能轻松穿过恶劣环境。
author: .izik
source: Flecks of gravel fall from its wings as it flies, leaving trails of debris. Its sturdy body allows it to navigate harsh environments with ease.

entry: POKENAME拍翅时，身上松石四散。它飞行期间，登山者须留意天空。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME flaps its wings, loose stones scatter from its body. Hikers are warned to watch the skies during its flight.

entry: POKENAME伪装成洞壁保护自己，却常堵住要道，因此在训练家间落下了麻烦宝可梦的名声。
author: divinelunaria
source: POKENAME will disguise themselves as cave walls for protection. This has caused POKENAME to develop a reputation among trainers as a nuisance Pokémon, as they will often block essential pathways.

entry: POKENAME常见于岩石群山，蜷成球，翻滚四处移动。会朝天敌扔石，往往能将其赶走。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are a common sight around rocky mountains, curling themselves into balls to tumble around the landscape. They will chuck rocks at predators, oftentimes driving them away.

entry: POKENAME掰下大块岩石，追着滚落的石头跑。专在泥地这样做，再咧着嘴大笑，吃下沾泥的石头。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME breaks off large chunks of rock, then chases after them as they roll down. It does this over muddy areas, then consumes the mud-covered rocks, grinning wildly.

entry: POKENAME掰下大块岩石，追着滚落的石头跑。专在泥地这样做，再咧着嘴大笑，吃下沾泥的石头。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME breaks off large chunks of rock, then chases after them as they roll down. It does this over muddy areas, then consumes the mud-covered rocks, grinning wildly.

entry: 贪吃的POKENAME张嘴顺急流而下，吞食矿物，偶尔也吃掉靠太近的小鱼宝可梦。累了便在河岸晒太阳休息。
author: bobosmith01
source: The gluttonous POKENAME rides down rapids with its mouth open to devour minerals, and, rarely, small fish Pokémon that wander too close. When it is tired out, it rests near the riverbank, out in the sun.

entry: POKENAME吃土和小石，强化岩壳，保护背上不停生长的种子。消化矿物时，体内会产生毒尘，再从嘴里吹出，驱赶害物。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME feeds on soil and small stones to fortify the rocky shell that protects the seed constantly growing on its back. As it digests the minerals, its body produces a poisonous dust that it blows from its mouth to drive away pests.

entry: POKENAME喜欢在崖边放松。有人将要失足坠落，就会伸藤救起，避免对方跌落丧命。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME likes to relax near cliff edges. When someone is about to fall, it reaches out with its vines to save them from plummeting to their doom.

entry: 它在受击前用双臂护脸。随后身体闪起金光，使出致命的镜面反射，展开报复。
author: .izik
source: It wraps its arms around its face before being struck. Afterward, its body shimmers gold as it unleashes a deadly Mirror Coat to retaliate.

entry: POKENAME以钩爪扎进崖壁，迅速轻松地攀山。它们滑翔在崖边，尾巴缓摇，等着挖出矿石充饥。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME use their claws as hooks to dig into the sides of cliffs, quickly and effortlessly scaling mountainsides. They glide around the cliffside with their tails swaying slowly, waiting to dig up ore deposits for their meals.

entry: 所有宝石中，它最爱玛瑙。为找到哪怕一块，能挖上两天，之后才不情愿地改吃较不喜欢的宝石。
author: .izik
source: It loves eating agate above all other gems. It will dig for up to two days to search for even a single piece before reluctantly consuming less-preferred gemstones.

entry: POKENAME胆大，喜欢登山到顶。岩石身体与带爪双脚，让攀爬崖壁轻而易举。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are daring creatures that enjoy climbing mountains to reach the summit. Their rocky body and clawed feet allow them to scale cliffs with ease.

entry: 头上月形石散出蜂蜜般的香味，使敌人放松戒心。先引近猎物，再出击。
author: .izik
source: The moon-shaped stone on its head emits a honey-like scent that puts foes at ease. It uses this fragrance to lure prey closer before striking.

entry: POKENAME岩石身体上的金环，散发蜂蜜般的气味。先引来尾立等猎物，再使出重踏。
author: .izik
source: The golden ring on POKENAME's rocky body emits a honey-like scent. This aroma lures prey such as Sentret before it strikes with Bulldoze.

entry: 它的身体由极烫的泥构成，能住在火山壁内。散出的热，让周围岩石微微发光。
author: .izik
source: Its body is made of incredibly hot mud, allowing it to live within volcanic walls. The heat it radiates makes the surrounding rocks glow faintly.

entry: POKENAME只有从附近火山或阳光吸够热量，才会外出活动。寻找石头来吃，体内太热，石头进来便熔成液体。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME will only move around outside if it has absorbed enough warmth, either from a nearby volcano or from the sun. It searches for stones to eat; the inside of its body is so hot that these stones melt into a liquid.

entry: 它覆着蓬松羽毛，质地却仿佛石头。会拍打树干，震落独角虫等猎物，再吃掉。
author: .izik
source: Its body is covered in fluffy feathers that mimic the texture of stone. It smacks tree trunks to knock down prey like Weedle, which it devours.

entry: POKENAME形成于温泉附近的岩层。随着成长与战斗，岩石外层逐渐剥落，显露出内部的宝石。
author: capwolfbane
source: POKENAME forms in rock deposits near hot springs. As it ages and battles, its rocky outer layer crumbles away, revealing the gemstone underneath.

entry: POKENAME住在火山附近，用背臂收集熔岩，制成铠甲。它们生性爱玩，跳进岩浆扑腾，仿佛只是在玩水。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME live near volcanoes where they use the arms on their backs to gather molten rocks to make into armor. They're rather playful by nature, leaping and splashing around lava as if it was water.

entry: 它滚得极快，能轻松爬上崖壁。用长鼻敲下洞壁的黄水晶来吃。
author: .izik
source: It rolls at such high speeds that it can scale cliffs effortlessly. Its trunk is used to break citrine from cave walls, which it consumes.

entry: POKENAME用削尖的尾巴凿石，制作雕塑。也与雕塑家合作，造出栩栩如生的像，供博物馆展览。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME creates sculptures by chiselling stone with its sharpened tail. It works alongside sculptors to create realistic statues that are displayed at museums.

entry: 受惊时，它会挥出威猛一拳，一击将巨石化为粉尘。平时也常砸碎小石、磨成粉末来训练。
author: .izik
source: When startled, it delivers a devastating punch that can reduce a boulder to dust in one strike. It often trains by smashing smaller rocks into powder.

entry: 它小心吐出恶臭绿酸，蚀松洞中化石，再添到岩石身体上作装饰。
author: .izik
source: It carefully spits a putrid green acid, using it to loosen fossils from caves. These fossils are then added to its rocky body as decoration.

entry: POKENAME身体强健，只需缠紧就能压碎巨石。喜欢收集化石，在身上展示。最强个体，身上同时能有多达20块不同的化石。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's strong body can crush large boulders just by constricting them. It likes to collect fossils and show them off on its body. The strongest of POKENAME can have up to 20 different fossils on their bodies at a time.

entry: 没什么比一群POKENAME滚下山，更让登山者害怕。沿途一切障碍，都会轻易碾过。
author: atlas3339098
source: There is nothing a hiker fears more than a herd of POKENAME rolling down a mountain. It will easily roll over any obstacle in its path.

entry: POKENAME住在崎岖山坡，大部分时间都在与同类摔跤。每天嚼碎、吃下约100磅岩石，也因此改变山区地貌。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME lives on rugged mountain slopes, spending most of its time wrestling with others of its kind. It crunches and consumes around 100lbs of rocks daily, reshaping the mountainous landscape in the process.

entry: POKENAME甲壳坚固，致命落石中也能存活。曾有一只在人类之前被送入太空，测试宇宙辐射。返回时，身体更坚硬，壳在星光下闪亮，如同抛光石。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME has a sturdy shell and can survive deadly rockfalls. One was sent into space before humans to test cosmic radiation. When it returned, its body had become even tougher, its shell glinting like polished stone under the stars.

entry: POKENAME用四臂朝陌生对象扔小石，不让靠近。不太合群，想避开交流时，就会假装石像。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME keeps strangers at bay by pelting them with small stones using its four arms. Since it is not a particularly social Pokémon, it pretends to be a stone statue whenever it wishes to avoid interaction.

entry: 有些年长或残障人士喜欢养POKENAME，帮忙搬重物、辅助行动，因为四臂能轻松举起成年人。还能读心、理解人语，更添便利。
author: _pixelar_
source: Some older or disabled people like to have a POKENAME around the house to help with heavy lifting and act as a mobility aid, as their four arms can easily lift a human adult. It helps that they can read thoughts and understand human speech.

entry: 它背上长着缠成一团的植物与岩石。喜欢仰躺打滚，收集更多碎石杂草，让背上那团东西越来越大。
author: foolish_weasel
source: A tangle of plant matter and rocks grows on its back. It likes to roll around on its back, collecting more rubble and weeds, causing its back-mass to grow even larger.

entry: POKENAME滚下山时，重量与动量会碾碎沿途一切，少有同样危险的事物。身后留下泥土夹硫磺的气味。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Few things are as dangerous as a POKENAME rolling downhill, as its mass and momentum crushes all that is in its way. In its wake, it leaves an earthy sulfuric smell.

entry: POKENAME头顶一副强大石颚，一口便能咬碎铁。废料场常靠它，轻松拆碎金属废料。
author: .izik
source: A powerful stone jaw rests atop POKENAME's head, capable of crushing iron in one bite. Junkyards often rely on it to break down metal debris with ease.

entry: 它能预知大地震，在居民走路时，往道路扔石示警。这举动常被误解成坏兆头。
author: .izik
source: It can sense large earthquakes before they happen and warns townsfolk by throwing rocks onto roads as they walk. This act is often misunderstood as a bad omen.

entry: 双臂能投巨石、投敌人，也能投自己，这正是它最爱的出行方式。可巨石做的外鞘，让落地总不太优雅。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: Its arms can hurl boulders, opponents, or itself; its preferred mode of travel. The boulders it sheaths into ensure its landings are not graceful.

entry: 为了维持庞大结实的身体，它每天最多要吃一吨岩石。它似乎最喜欢那些长满苔藓的石头。
author: melodydelune
source: To maintain its bulk and sturdy body, it will eat up to a ton of rocks on a daily basis. Its favorite rocks seem to be those covered in moss.

entry: POKENAME住在月见山深处，堆筑岩石结构，保护其中珍贵的月之石。会仔细研究自己的构筑，预备遇险时，能用这些月之石进化。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME dwell deep within Mt. Moon, building up rock formations to protect the precious Moon Stones within. They study their constructions meticulously should they ever seek to evolve using these Moon Stones in case of a threat.

entry: POKENAME打招呼时，会比谁先用大手状耳朵指到对方。输家得假装昏倒，不照做，赢家就扔石头。
author: griddle
source: POKENAME greet each other by seeing who can point at the other first with their large, hand-shaped ears. The loser is expected to pretend to faint; if they don't, the winner will pelt them with rocks.

entry: POKENAME的伪装是满袋石头，太重，大多时候根本举不起。仍能拖着快速移动；战斗中一靠近，就会举起来，砸到敌人身上。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's disguise is a bag full of rocks, and is too heavy for POKENAME to lift most of the time. It can still drag it around quite quickly, and in combat it will pick it up to drop down on foes as soon as it gets close.

entry: POKENAME用六片结晶翅膀吸收太阳力量。也能将其震碎，朝敌人扔出燃烧的碎片。
author: raydrago
source: POKENAME uses its six crystalline wings to absorb the power of the sun. It can shatter them to throw burning shards at its enemies.

entry: POKENAME从河床收集石头，筑起坚坝。小石则吃掉，加固岩石身体。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME gathers stones from riverbeds to build sturdy dams. Smaller rocks are eaten to reinforce its rocky body.

entry: POKENAME撞碎岩石，化成能吃的小块，再用爪子舀进嘴。找不到能砸的石头，就会猛烈乱闹，直到有石可吃。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME rams into rocks to break them into edible chunks before scooping them into its mouth with its claws. If it cannot find any rocks to break, it thrashes around violently until it finds some to consume.

entry: 下雨时，POKENAME在崖面挖凹洞避雨，保护维系生命的燃烧尾巴。
author: foolish_weasel
source: When it rains, POKENAME will dig alcoves into cliff faces for shelter in order to protect its burning tail, which sustains its life force.

entry: POKENAME太重，飞起来很艰难，必须拼尽力气。有种流行的力量考验，让训练家挑战它能飞多高，却始终只能达到不高的位置。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME struggles to fly due to its immense weight and must expend great effort to do so. A popular test of strength challenges Trainers to see how high it can fly, with only modest heights ever achieved.

entry: 它飞快捕捉毛球等猎物，用超音波扰乱方向。目标晕眩后，再使出猛烈的咬住攻击。
author: .izik
source: It flies swiftly to catch prey like Venonat, using Supersonic attacks to disorient them. Once the target is stunned, it delivers a ferocious Bite.

entry: POKENAME用大牙磨碎岩石，取出其中矿物。飞行时撒下剩余石粉，迷住敌人与领地入侵者的双眼。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME use their large teeth to break through rocks in order to grind them into dust and gather minerals from within. They scatter the leftover dust as they fly, blinding opponents or intruders to their territory.

entry: POKENAME附在崖面，等倒霉旅人踩上来。一被踩，便用强臂抓住，滚下崖坡，把目标一同带下去。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME clings to cliff faces, waiting for hapless travelers to step on it. When they do, it grabs onto them with its strong arms and rolls down the cliff-side, carrying its target down with them.

entry: POKENAME帮助农人，往土壤补充当地野生生灵所需的养分。释放养分后，便被放归野外，许多个体继续担当森林守卫。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME help farmers infuse the earth with essential nutrients for local wildlife. After releasing nutrients through the soil, they are released into the wild where many maintain their role as a forest guardian.

entry: 某处隆隆石过多时，POKENAME就会现身，强行赶走。许多人相信，它是山岳守护者，防止隆隆石吃掉太多岩石。
author: h0bojoe
source: When Graveler overpopulate an area, POKENAME appears to force them out. Many believe it serves as a guardian of mountains, keeping Graveler from devouring excessive amounts of rock.

entry: 它啄开洞壁，敲松锆石，再砸成粉来吃。觅食时，绒羽翅膀能挡住尖锐碎屑。
author: .izik
source: It pecks at cave walls to loosen zircon and smashes the gems into dust before eating. Its downy wings keep it safe from sharp shards while foraging.

entry: POKENAME战斗时，折下身体碎片，刺穿敌人。长战之后，便退入山中，寻找合适岩块，重新融入身体。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME fights by breaking shards from its body to skewer its enemies. After a long battle, POKENAME retreats into the mountainside to find suitable pieces of rock to meld back into its body.

entry: 身体看似岩石，其实由仙人掌般的坚硬物质构成。在干燥沙漠茁壮生活，干空气让身体保持结实。
author: .izik
source: Despite its rocky appearance, its body is composed of a hard, cactus-like substance. It thrives in arid deserts where dry air keeps its body sturdy.

entry: 多数渔夫认为，钓上POKENAME很倒霉。身体大多是鳞与骨，少少的肉也粗得像砾石，岩鳞还会割伤想拿起来的渔夫。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are regarded as an unlucky catch by most fishermen. They are mostly made out of scales and bones, and the little meat on their body is as rough as gravel. Their rocky scales can also cut fishermen that try to pick them up.

entry: POKENAME头上的发光鳞片，能控制附近石头。只需摆头，就能轻松使出落石，发射岩块。
author: .izik
source: The glowing scale on POKENAME's head allows it to control nearby stone. With a flick of its head, it can launch chunks effortlessly using Rock Throw.

entry: POKENAME的热石身体，温度能超过商用烤箱。控温精准，有些餐馆会拿它替代烤架。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's hot stone body can reach temperatures beyond commercial ovens. Some restaurants use it in place of grills due to its precise heat control.

entry: POKENAME沉重地上下山，寻找强敌。战斗时，喜欢喷出预先嚼碎的熔岩石。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME lumbers up and down mountains, looking for tough opponents. In battle, it enjoys spewing up molten rocks that it chews up beforehand.

entry: POKENAME钻过峡谷岩壁，寻找花岗岩矿层吃。吃得过多，就嵌进岩壁，一边睡觉，一边消化。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME digs through canyon walls in search of granite deposits to consume. After overeating, it embeds itself in the rock face and sleeps while digesting.

entry: POKENAME能压低尾焰，完美融入洞内石壁。喜欢突然从藏身处出现，拍动翅膀，惊吓毫无戒备的探险者。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME can dim the flame on its tail to blend perfectly with the stone walls of caves. It enjoys startling unsuspecting explorers by suddenly emerging from its hiding spot and flapping its wings.

entry: POKENAME用搜集的矿物制作汤匙，集中超能力。主要借此比较各种矿物，探查周围洞穴的构成。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME fashion spoons out of minerals they gather in order to focus their psychic powers. They primarily use these powers to compare various minerals and see the composition of caves around them.

entry: 它用精神脉冲震松洞壁矿物，再吃掉。对稀有矿物的渴求，驱使它深挖大地。
author: .izik
source: It uses psychic pulses to loosen ore from cave walls before consuming them. Its appetite for rare minerals drives it to dig deep into the earth.

entry: 它先用拳头将红宝石捣成粉，再吃下。神秘食谱不知为何，能同时增强肌肉与坚如岩石的身体。
author: .izik
source: It pounds rubies into powder with its fists before consuming them. This mysterious diet somehow strengthens both its muscles and its rock-hard body.

entry: 一找到缟玛瑙，它就往大张的嘴里铲。强烈酸性唾液，瞬间将石头溶化。
author: .izik
source: It shovels onyx into its large, gaping mouth whenever it finds it. The stone is melted instantly within its powerful, acidic saliva.

entry: POKENAME常被当成普通隆隆石，主要区别却是没有脚。新长的第二对手臂，总垂在身旁，仿佛连自己也没发现。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Commonly mistaken for regular Graveler, the main distinction of a POKENAME is its lack of feet. It almost always keeps its newly developed second pair of arms by its side, as if it doesn't even realize it has them.

entry: POKENAME以坚岩皮肤与多对手臂闻名。头内嵌着的金块象征地位，金块照料得最好的个体，会受托带领族群。
author: ruben2309295
source: POKENAME are known for their rock-hard skin and their multiple sets of arms. The gold chunk embedded in a POKENAME's head serves as a symbol of status. The POKENAME that takes the best care of its gold is trusted with leading the pack.

entry: POKENAME进化前，会拢来石头保护身体。常犹豫该用哪对手臂，好像正在决定更喜欢哪一双。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME gather rocks around themselves to protect their bodies as they prepare for evolution. They often seem confused on which set of arms to use, as if trying to decide which one they prefer.

entry: POKENAME虽有磁力，却更爱把磁铁当钝锤。它们高速原地转动，反复敲打敌人，还用磁力来回拉扯。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Despite their magnetic powers, POKENAME prefer to use the magnets they carry as blunt maces. They rapidly spin in place, smacking their opponents repeatedly while pulling them back and forth with their magnets.

entry: 它在崎岖地形和其他宝可梦赛跑，边跑边朝对方扔石。后头警戒追赶者，确保始终占优。
author: .izik
source: It throws stones at other Pokémon while racing them across rugged terrain. The rear head watches for pursuers, ensuring it always has the advantage.

entry: POKENAME钻进地下洞窟底部的岩石，只为补充筑巢石料才出来。它们捏碎石头，将粉尘撒进水中，让矿物帮助生长。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Burrowing into rocks at the bottom of underground caves, POKENAME only surface to gather more rocks for their shelters. They crush rocks into dust in their grip then release the dust into the water to fill it with minerals that will help them grow.

entry: POKENAME偏爱高海拔、少雨地区。成长时，岩石剥落，分解成肥沃土壤，帮助背上高山植物茂盛生长。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME prefers high altitudes with little rain. As POKENAME grows, the rock sheds and breaks down into nutritious soil, helping the alpine plants on its back flourish.

entry: POKENAME坚忍沉着，磨炼身体，承受各种攻击。对手打来，也不退缩，反以威力惊人的反击拳还手。
author: bobosmith01
source: It is a stoic Pokémon that trains its body against all kinds of attacks. When an opponent strikes, POKENAME doesn't flinch and retaliates with a devastating counterpunch.

entry: POKENAME让周围空气充满毒烟。气体附着、渗入岩石，从内部将其分解，它便能吃掉留下的小石。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME saturate the air around them with noxious fumes. As the gas clings onto and permeates through rocks, they are broken down from the inside, allowing POKENAME to eat the resulting pebbles.

entry: POKENAME把自己嵌进洞壁，觉得那里最安全。许多个体进化后，都很难挣脱当初挤入的缝隙。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME embed themselves into cavern walls, as that is where they feel safest. Many POKENAME that evolve struggle to break out of the crevices they jam themselves into.

entry: 古遗迹中，已有数次POKENAME的目击记录，仿佛担任警戒无人机。确切的来历，却早已无从考证。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME has been spotted several times in ancient ruins, where it acts as a kind of security drone. Its exact origin can no longer be reconstructed.

entry: 在矿井深处发现的神秘宝可梦。几乎一动不动，但有些训练家坚称，听过POKENAME核心传来铃声。
author: fenragon
source: This enigmatic Pokémon was found deep within a mine. It is largely inert, but some Trainers swear they can hear chimes coming from POKENAME's core.

entry: 古遗迹中，已有数次POKENAME的目击记录，仿佛担任警戒无人机。确切的来历，却早已无从考证。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME has been spotted several times in ancient ruins, where it acts as a kind of security drone. Its exact origin can no longer be reconstructed.

entry: POKENAME爪子锋利如钻石，形状也适合掘开顽固矿石，深受矿工欢迎。矿道遇见缺口，就会迅速飞过去，继续挖。
author: ghostslythe
source: Popular with Miners, POKENAME's claws are sharp as diamonds and well shaped to pick at stubborn ores. When they come across a gap in the tunnel, they swiftly fly across to continue mining.

entry: 草场一没草，POKENAME群就会狂奔，把山踏平，磨成平原。等待青草长出时，先吃碎石。
author: bandedbodypress
source: If their grazing area runs out of grass, herds of POKENAME will stampede and grind mountains into plains. They eat the crushed stone while waiting for grass to grow.

entry: 它的身体如泥，能悄悄滑到矿车下面。贪婪吃掉洒落矿石，不留痕迹。
author: .izik
source: Its mud-like form allows it to slip beneath minecarts unnoticed. It greedily consumes spilled ore, leaving no trace behind.

entry: 科学家开发POKENAME，为山区施肥、收割庄稼。一些无法驯服的个体却逃了出去，如今正破坏当地生态。
author: leviath
source: Scientists developed POKENAME for fertilizing and crop harvesting in mountainous regions. Some untamable specimens managed to set themselves free and now cause havoc in local ecosystems.

entry: 这些宝可梦只生活在火山环境，常收集科学家难以到达之处的埋藏骨骸，无意间帮了考古学家。不过，也同样常带着新发现滚走。
author: secondunit
source: Endemic to volcanic environments, these Pokémon have inadvertently assisted archeologists by collecting buried skeletal remains where scientists struggle to go. Unfortunately, they have a penchant for rolling away with new finds just as often.

entry: POKENAME在高处睡得最好。睡时蜷成浑圆巨石状，常一路滚下山，毁掉沿途一切，自己却仍睡得香。
author: bradlybro199
source: POKENAME sleep best at high altitudes. When asleep, they curl into a perfectly round, boulder-like shape that often sends them rolling down mountains, destroying anything in their path while they remain fast asleep.

entry: POKENAME从身上拆下石头，战斗时用念动力操纵，化作弹丸。紧急时，也能把所有石头一起围在周围，构成坚固球盾。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME removes stones from its own body to use as psychically-controlled projectiles in battle. In a pinch, it can use all the stones at once to form a sturdy spherical shield around itself.

entry: POKENAME身上附着的众多岩石，充满速燃助燃剂，一接触空气就燃。因此常把这些天然炸弹扔向对手作战。
author: infinex21
source: The many rocks clinging to POKENAME's body are filled with a fast-acting accelerant that ignites the moment it is exposed to air. In fact, this is how it will often fight, by pelting its opponents with its natural bombs.

entry: 它飞过深洞与废矿，悄然捕猎。休息时紧收翅膀，看着如普通巨石。
author: .izik
source: Flying through deep caverns and abandoned mines, it hunts stealthily. While resting, it tucks its wings in tightly, resembling an ordinary boulder.

entry: POKENAME必须敲击触角上的巨石球，才能使其发光。重量很沉，战斗时也能当高效的钝击武器。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME needs to strike the boulder bulbs on its antennae in order to make them light up. Their heavy weight makes them quite effective as bludgeoning tools in combat.

entry: 触角晶洞内嵌的红宝石，能催化POKENAME的电力攻击。覆身石甲，则保护它抵御任何攻势。
author: fiordaliso
source: Rubies embedded in the geode on its antenna act as catalysts for its electric attacks. Meanwhile, the stone armor covering POKENAME protects it from any assault.

entry: POKENAME常在山顶隐居，远离大城市喧嚣。据说天性十分平和，会引迷路旅人走上正确道路。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is often spotted atop mountain peaks, living as a hermit far from the chaos of large cities. It is said to have a deeply peaceful nature, guiding lost travelers down the right path.

entry: POKENAME颚部有力，几乎什么都咬得穿。受威胁时蜷成球，坚硬外层保护身体免受攻击。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME's strong jaw can bite through just about anything. When threatened, these Pokémon will curl up into a ball, their hard exterior protecting them from attacks.

entry: POKENAME远看有时会被认成绿毛虫。许多报告提到，新手训练家试着挑战，结果被紧急送往最近的宝可梦中心。野生个体战后会跳水庆祝。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME is sometimes mistaken for a Caterpie from a distance. There are many reports of young Trainers attempting to battle POKENAME, only to be rushed to the nearest Pokémon Center. After a battle, wild POKENAME celebrate by jumping into water.

entry: 身体覆着一层黏稠保湿油膜，让它能静静等待猎物靠近。也因油膜，几乎总粘着一层岩石，提供充分保护与隔热。
author: infinex21
source: Its body is covered in a film of sticky, moisturizing oil, so it is able to lie still in wait of prey to wander close enough. This oil is also why it is almost always covered in a layer of rocks, which affords it ample protection and insulation.

entry: POKENAME动作缓慢，爱在农作物间晒太阳打盹。农人太常把岩石球茎误认成怪卷心菜，结果被藤蔓追着赶走。
author: opossiblymage
source: This slow-going Pokémon likes to take a sunny nap in patches of produce. Too often, a farmer will think POKENAME's rocky bulb is a strange cabbage and get chased away with its vines.

entry: POKENAME的身体裹着棕色金属，还嵌着尖锐石簇，加强防御。这些特征，能吓退潜在天敌。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body is encased in a brown metal, with sharp clusters of stones embedded for additional defense. These features help deter potential predators.

entry: POKENAME在洞口附近的榴石果树下安家，把落果与小石一起存进壳。用果实制成的汁，味道精美，极受推崇。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME makes its home near cave edges under Pomeg Berry trees, storing fallen berries in its shell along with pebbles. The juice it produces from these berries is highly regarded for its exquisite taste.

entry: 夜里，街头赛车手会选在POKENAME旁边的车道，相互比赛争夺奖品。沉重身体让它能在赛程中不断积累动量。
author: quackquackattack
source: At night, street racers pick a lane alongside POKENAME and race against each other for prizes. POKENAME have heavy bodies that help them build momentum throughout the course of a race.

entry: POKENAME精于开凿硬地，深受建筑工人珍视。用头当钻头挖掘，再以岩石般坚硬的身体撑宽洞穴。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME is an expert at excavating and digging through hard ground, making it highly prized by construction workers. It digs by using its head as a drill, its rock-hard body widening the holes it digs out.

entry: POKENAME用泥与小石包住小身体，隔热，也进一步强化体内火焰。自卫时，会聪明地把小石或坚果含进嘴里，点燃，再喷向敌人。
author: infinex21
source: To insulate their small bodies and further reinforce their internal flames, POKENAME clad themselves in mud and small rocks. To defend themselves, they cleverly put pebbles or nuts in their mouths, ignite them, and spit them out at enemies.

entry: POKENAME住在嶙峋地带，乳房产生的物质不适合人类食用。通常个头最大的，也是最年长的。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME live in craggy areas. The substance they produce in their udders is not suitable for human consumption. Typically, the largest POKENAME are the ones that are the oldest.

entry: POKENAME召来雷暴，击打周围地面。某些土块一受击，泥、沙、石便瞬间熔合，形成雷击石。许多科学家喜欢收集这些管状物，摆在办公室。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME conjure lighting storms to strike the ground around them. Striking certain patches of soil instantly fuses dirt, sand, and rocks together to form fulgurites. Many scientists enjoy collecting these tubes to display in their offices.

entry: 艰苦训练，让POKENAME几乎不怕任何挤压。滚动时，用尾巴转向，或弹起，增加高度。
author: soup1900
source: Tough training has allowed POKENAME to be nearly invulnerable to any squeeze or squish. When rolling around, it uses its tail to change direction or bounce up to gain height.

entry: POKENAME把爪子刮在身上石甲上，保持锋利。绝境中或生性狡猾的个体，可能取下头冠一块石头，当匕首。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME keeps its claws sharp by scraping them against the stone plates on its body. A desperate or crafty POKENAME may remove one of the stones of its head-crest and use it like a dagger.

entry: POKENAME岩壳裂缝间长着粗刺。受威胁时蜷成球，露出尖刺。必须等平静下来，刺才会缩回体内。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have rough spines in between the cracks of their rocky shell. When threatened, POKENAME curl into a ball to expose these spines. Once exposed, POKENAME need to calm down before the spines retract back into their bodies.

entry: POKENAME的岩皮能承受地心压力的10倍。即便如此，敌对同类仍能用惊人獠牙刺穿对手。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Its rocky pelt can endure 10 times the pressure at the center of the planet. Despite that, rival POKENAME are capable of piercing their opponent with their awesome tusks.

entry: POKENAME用岩壳凹槽，捕捉数据流中的数据。每块岩片都像按钮，一按下，就会陷入狂乱与恐慌。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME uses the grooves on its rocky shell to catch data moving along data streams. Each rock segment acts like a button that causes POKENAME to go into a state of frenzy and panic when pressed.

entry: 它盘起身体时，会从岩身缝隙伸出尖刺。这些刺，构成抵御天敌的强大防线。
author: .izik
source: When coiled, it extends sharp spikes from the gaps in its rocky body. These spikes make it a formidable defense against predators.

entry: POKENAME无畏守护居住的群山。岩身几乎无法穿透，让它能轻易顶着敌人攻击，横冲直撞。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are fearless guardians of the mountains they inhabit. Their rocky bodies are nearly impenetrable, allowing them to barrel through enemy attacks with ease.

entry: POKENAME用带爪的下半身抓住洞壁，撕下大块岩石吃。嵌在石里的宝石，则会留着，积成自己的小宝藏。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses its clawed lower half to grab cave walls and tear out large chunks of rock for it to consume. Gems embedded within the stone get saved and collected into small personal hoards.

entry: 这些聪明宝可梦，用超能力帮助维系石身。常蜷起滚撞敌人，超能力强化的速度，让它们能干净利落地撞穿实心岩墙。
author: infinex21
source: These intellectual Pokémon use their psychic power to help hold their rocky bodies together. They will often curl up and roll into foes at psychically-empowered speeds that allow it to cleanly break through walls of solid rock.

entry: POKENAME的石头能长出小肢体，步行或攀往其他崖面。会动用些许力量，拨弄崖边石头，让落石砸向路人。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's stone can sprout small limbs in order to walk or climb to other cliffside locations. Using some of its power, it messes with stones located near the cliff edges to send rockslides down onto passersby.

entry: POKENAME感知敌人波导时，身上红宝石般的部分便强烈发光。连黑暗洞穴都能照亮，让敌人难以逃脱。
author: .izik
source: The ruby-like portions of POKENAME's body glow intensely when it senses an enemy's aura. This light can even illuminate dark caves, making escape difficult for foes.

entry: POKENAME以覆岩拳头，打出爆发力惊人的重击，过程中常有许多岩石散落。动作出奇敏捷，岩石脱得越多，就越灵活。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME deliver explosively powerful blows with their rock-clad fists, often scattering many of these rocks in the process. They move with surprising agility, which is further expanded upon the more of their rocks they shed.

entry: POKENAME第二副颚挖矿时磨利结晶，主体却被迫靠地下蘑菇为食。受威胁时，先让攻击弹离石甲，再使出致命的咬碎。
author: ghostslythe
source: While its secondary set of jaws sharpens its crystals while mining ores, POKENAME's main body is forced to subsist on subterranean mushrooms. When threatened, it allows hits to bounce off its rock armor before using a deadly Crunch.

entry: 它抖落皮肤上岩石般的部分，让更大新皮长出。冲锋前，习惯咆哮、用后爪刮地，再挺着头顶向前冲。
author: infinex21
source: It shakes itself to shed the rock-like parts of its hide so a new and larger hide can grow. It has a habit of roaring and scraping its hind claws along the ground before charging with the top of its head aimed forward.

entry: POKENAME骨头外露，看似死去，却仍在石头间翻找。骨架坚韧，连最强力量的打击，都无法留一道刮痕。
author: jangodiot
source: POKENAME has exposed bones that make it appear deceased, but it still rummages through rocks. Its skeletal body is tough enough to withstand blows from the strongest of forces without getting scratched.

entry: 它披上能找到的最好岩石，如穿王者礼服。换下的石头，则会送给一个幼崽。
author: staghorn
source: It clads itself in the highest-quality rocks it can find, wearing them like royal regalia. When it replaces a rock, it gifts the rock being replaced to one of its young.

entry: POKENAME会袭击采矿设施，破坏设备，赶走工人，通常恰在矿道塌方之前。尽管公司正式报告另有说法，工人却称，那些地方早已不稳。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME are known to attack mining facilities. They destroy equipment and drive off workers, usually right before the tunnels collapse. Despite official reports from the companies, workers claim these areas were already unstable.

entry: POKENAME力量庞大，能改变地壳形状。只需挥手一下，便能摧毁整座岛。
author: skymaster426
source: POKENAME holds immense power, which it uses to alter the shape of the earth's crust. A single swipe of its hand can destroy an entire island.

entry: POKENAME背着厚重碎石披风，既防护，也象征地位。威胁来袭时，先背对，让攻击砸在披风上，再以凶猛岩崩反击。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME carry a heavy cape of rubble upon their back, using it both as protection and a status symbol. They turn their backs to any incoming threat, allowing attacks to clatter against their cape before retaliating with a brutal Rock Slide.

entry: 它缓慢爬过深洞，用鼻子探知火山喷发，前往寻找。会将岩浆纳入食谱，扩展身体。
author: bandedbodypress
source: It crawls slowly across deep caves to find volcanic eruptions it detects with its nose. It expands its body by incorporating magma into its diet.

entry: POKENAME会开采并藏起能找到的最坚硬的石头，当作武器。人类无论用什么手持工具，都无法将其敲裂。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME mines and stashes the toughest stones it can find to use as weapons. These stones can't be cracked by humans with any handheld equipment.

entry: 这种宝可梦旋转的钉头锤，足以击碎实心岩石，矿工更爱用它，而非传统镐头。击打干净、迅速，连绵不绝。
author: jaminmcready
source: This Pokémon's spinning maces are strong enough to smash through solid rock, making it the preferred tool of miners over a traditional Pickaxe. Its strikes are clean, fast, and relentless.

entry: POKENAME占据一堆岩石，磨削石身，将其化为刀刃。用这把刃，迎战太靠近领地的其他宝可梦。
author: whiteupgrade
source: POKENAME possesses a pile of rocks to sharpen its body, using them to grind down its stone body into a blade. Its blade is used to battle other Pokémon that come too close to its territory.

entry: 身上的石头比铁还硬，耐久惊人。会用巨尾砸开洞壁，吃掉落下的任何化石。
author: .izik
source: The stones on its body are tougher than iron, granting it immense durability. Using its massive tail, it smashes cave walls and devours any fossils that fall.

entry: POKENAME翻碎整山，寻找最硬的岩石，重建石质鳞片。暴走时，会如陨石般俯冲砸地。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME shred through entire mountains looking for the toughest rocks to rebuild their rock-like scales. In a rampage, they will divebomb into the ground with the force of a meteorite.

entry: POKENAME蜕下的皮会硬化、崩碎，成为富含养分的土壤，帮助植物生长，因此很受园丁欢迎。
author: melodydelune
source: POKENAME are popular among gardeners for their shedded skin, which hardens and crumbles, becoming a nutrient-rich soil for plant growth.

entry: 尾巴的紫色部分渗出毒液，削弱敌人。若对方抵抗毒效，便用石臂重击。
author: .izik
source: The purple portions of its tail excrete toxic dribbles, weakening foes. It uses its rocky arms to slam opponents who resist the poison's effects.

entry: POKENAME偏爱海底火山喷口，很少接近表层。一旦现身，或许就是洪水来临的预兆。
author: kitarchen
source: It is rare to see POKENAME near the surface as they prefer to reside near underwater volcanic vents. If seen, it could be an early sign of a flood coming.

entry: POKENAME的石头脑袋四处漂浮，遇到什么就撞什么。能引爆自己，像弹片般射出碎石，留下的发光能量，却会附身新石，重组身体。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's rocky head floats around, slamming into anything it encounters. It is capable of explosively detonating to fling shards of stone like shrapnel, but the glowing energy it leaves behind will possess a new rock to reform POKENAME's body.

entry: 岩石腹部储存数十亿条丝线，用来缠住猎物。丝一晒太阳，就变得易碎脆弱。
author: .izik
source: Its rocky abdomen stores billions of silk strands that it uses to ensnare prey. The silk becomes brittle and fragile when exposed to sunlight.

entry: 它将触须钻入洞顶，再落向毫无戒备的探险者。石身质地如页岩，能融入环境。
author: .izik
source: It drills tendrils into cave ceilings before dropping onto unsuspecting explorers. Its stony body has a shale-like texture, blending with the environment.

entry: 它附在洞顶，完美融入四周。其他对象靠近，岩身上的小烛芯便像蜡烛般点亮。
author: .izik
source: It clings to cave ceilings, blending seamlessly with its surroundings. Small wicks on its rocky body light like candles when others draw near.

entry: 这些宝可梦的岩鳞，是好用的磨刀石。人们常认为，它们进化成这样，是为保持獠牙极度锋利。尾巴一挥能拔起树，虽然树常会先劈开。
author: infinex21
source: The rocky scales of these Pokémon make for efficient whetstones, often assumed to be a result of them evolving to keep their tusks incredibly sharp. Their tails are strong enough to uproot a tree with a single swing, even if the tree will oft split.

entry: POKENAME的石制装扮太重，无法直立保持平衡，因此必须始终顶在头上。对战时，却能提供良好防御。
author: jangodiot
source: POKENAME has to carry its costume, which is made of rocks, at all times on its head, since the costume is too heavy to balance upright. It makes for a good defense when in battle.

entry: 覆身热石一离开直射阳光，就会散失热量。不过在日照下，几秒就能变得比炉面更烫。
author: .izik
source: The hot rocks covering its body lose their heat when out of direct sunlight. Under sunlight, however, they can reach searing temperatures hotter than a stovetop within seconds.

entry: POKENAME尾尖始终火焰熊熊，常被用来判断心情。只有睡着时，才能不用防护，安全碰它的岩石身体。
author: chibitales
source: Fire constantly blazes from the tips of POKENAME's tails, often being used as an indicator of their mood. The only time their rocky bodies are safe to touch without protection is when they are asleep.

entry: 研究者推测，POKENAME不稳定的基因组，因接触太空外来病毒而改变。包住身体的坚石，是天然防线，保护重要核心。
author: fiordaliso
source: Researchers speculate that POKENAME's unstable genome was altered by contact with a foreign virus from space. The resilient stones encasing its body serve as a natural defense, protecting its vital core from harm.

entry: 裹住POKENAME的球，覆着会粘住物件的黏物。据说，球长得足够大，便会化成一颗新行星。
author: dodoowner_
source: The ball that coats POKENAME is covered in a sticky substance that causes objects to cling to it. It's said that once the ball grows large enough, it turns into a new planet.

entry: POKENAME的尾巴太重，无法带它飞行。于是改拍翅，在地下造成深沉震动，引地下宝可梦来到地表。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME'S tails are too heavy to enable them to fly. Instead, they beat their wings to make deep vibrations through the earth, luring underground Pokémon to the surface.

entry: POKENAME往往自大骄傲。要不是沉重的头害它不停踉跄，本来或许还颇有威慑力。
author: atlas3339098
source: POKENAME are often arrogant and prideful. This could be intimidating if they weren't constantly stumbling due to their heavy head.

entry: POKENAME把尾巴上的石团当棍棒。不过这些石头加起来，比身体其余部分还重，因此一挥空，就会失去平衡。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME uses the clump of rocks on its tail as a club. However, these rocks combined are heavier than the rest of the body, so POKENAME always loses its balance on a missed swing.

entry: POKENAME身上的尖刺，由软玉构成。它用坚实的身体凿开洞穴，吃下里面的矿物，帮助POKENAME的尖刺生长。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: The spines along a POKENAME's body are composed of nephrite jade. POKENAME will use their sturdy bodies to carve out spots to burrow within caves, eating the minerals inside to help grow their spines.

entry: 它咬住阿柏怪等猎物，以强力咬击吸取生命。石身让它完全不怕猎物临死前的挣扎。
author: .izik
source: It latches onto prey like Arbok, draining their life force with a powerful bite. Its stone body makes it immune to the prey's final struggles.

entry: POKENAME年幼时，会从巨石刻出大盾，随身带着。找到宝石矿层，就会敲碎来吃。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME carves a large shield out of a boulder when it is young and carries it around. Should it find a gem deposit, it will break them apart to eat.

entry: POKENAME浮在浅水，用带电触手麻痹猎物。大风暴后，海滩上常能见到成群POKENAME被冲上岸。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME floats in shallow waters, using its electrified tentacles to paralyze its prey. Schools of POKENAME can be seen washed up on the beach after large storms.

entry: POKENAME只住在最高的群山。野生的进化前形态，必须经历严酷环境，才能进化成它。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME only live in the highest of mountains. Their wild, pre-evolved forms need to experience harsh conditions to evolve into POKENAME.

entry: 它夜间飞行时高声尖叫，扰乱敌人方向。目标头晕后，就以尾巴的岩石部分重击。
author: .izik
source: It emits loud screeches while flying through the night, disorienting foes. Once its target is dizzy, it strikes with the rock-like portion of its tail.

entry: 体表滴落的黏液，长时间晒太阳后，会硬化成石状材料。医院广泛用来制作廉价的骨折固定护具。
author: .izik
source: The mucus dripping from its body hardens into a stone-like material after prolonged sun exposure. This hardened mucus is widely used in hospitals for crafting inexpensive casts for broken limbs.

entry: POKENAME岩石外表下，有个产生强大冰冻能量的核心。能瞬间以实心坚冰制成粗大棍棒，碾碎野外任何阻挡自己的对象。
author: sk372
source: Beneath POKENAME's rocky exterior lies a core that generates immense freezing energy. It can instantly create thick clubs of solid ice to use to crush anything that stands against it in the wild.

entry: POKENAME将冰川洞窟据为领地，住在深处。折下自身长出的粗大结晶，当作战斗棍棒。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME claims glacial cavern areas as its territory, residing deep within their depths. It breaks off large thick crystals growing from its own body to use as clubs in battle.

entry: POKENAME岩石花瓣一裂，就会分泌黏稠树液，渗入裂缝，维持结构完整。树脂虽然有效，气味却难以忍受。
author: emtpy_set
source: When its rocky petals become cracked, POKENAME excretes a viscous sap that seeps into the fissures and preserves the petals' structural integrity.  While this resin is effective, its smell is unbearable.

entry: 它柔软如毛绒的身体，被致密坚硬的石头包住。袭击者靠近，便扔出巨石反击，将其赶走。
author: .izik
source: Its soft, plush-like body is encased within dense, unyielding stones. If an attacker approaches, it retaliates by hurling boulders to drive them away.

entry: 白天躺在日照海滩，一动不动，看似无生命。夜晚用海带状附肢拖动身体，前去吃草。
author: .izik
source: Lying motionless on sun-soaked beaches, it appears lifeless during the day. At night, it uses kelp-like appendages to drag itself to graze on grass.

entry: POKENAME触手长出石英刺，锋利得能穿船壳。附在水下洞穴的矿石上，一啃就是好几个小时。
author: .izik
source: Quartz spikes grow from POKENAME's tentacles, sharp enough to pierce ship hulls. It clings to cave ores underwater and gnaws on them for hours.

entry: POKENAME背上硬得惊人的蘑菇，可磨粉入药，用于止痛、减轻炎症。
author: .izik
source: The incredibly hard mushrooms on POKENAME's back can be ground up for use in medicine. They are used for pain relief and reducing inflammation.

entry: 走到哪里，哪里就能感到震动与降温。岩石般的鳞片摸起来冰冷。
author: houndrys.
source: Wherever this Pokémon walks, a quake can be felt, along with a drop in temperature. Its rocky scales are cold to the touch.

entry: POKENAME覆身众石，蕴含神秘力量。据说，有幸找到一块，就能获赐安稳睡眠。
author: mepp.
