source: The many stones that cover POKENAME's body hold a mystical power. Those lucky enough to find one are said to be blessed with peaceful slumber.

entry: POKENAME周围绕着几圈岩石碎屑。通常平和，激战时却能用超能力操纵，拼成武器与盾牌。
author: moopse
source: POKENAME possess several rings of rocky debris that orbit them. While they are normally peaceful, they are able to psychically manipulate these stones and cobble them into weapons and shields in the heat of battle.

entry: 它常用硬爪挖出石头，加进背部岩壳。壳上长满蘑菇，似乎有助于把石块连在一起。
author: infinex21
source: It will often dig up rocks with its tough claws and add them to the rocky shell atop its back. This shell is infested with mushrooms that seem to help hold the rocks together.

entry: POKENAME战斗中动用力量，身上石甲间的接缝便强烈发光。据说，石下有颗结晶，亮得看上一眼，就会立刻失明。
author: sk372
source: When using its powers in battle, the seams between the stone plates of POKENAME's body glow brightly. Its said that beneath the stone is a crystal so radiant it would blind a person instantly if beheld.

entry: POKENAME住在活火山的破火山口，反复熔化、再生背部石甲，直到硬如钻石。对低温敏感，离家时会随身带着余烬。
author: ghostslythe
source: Living in the calderas of active volcanoes, POKENAME melts and regrows the rocky armor on its back, until it's as hard as diamonds. It is sensitive to colder temperatures, so it carries around embers whenever it leaves home.

entry: POKENAME身体耐得住火山高温，甚至能储存岩浆。七之岛的石匠，有时凿下长得过大的岩块，制成隔热厨具。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME's bodies are built to withstand volcanic temperatures and are even capable of storing magma. Stoneworkers around the Sevii Islands will sometimes chisel off POKENAME's overgrown rocks and shape them into insulated kitchenware.

entry: POKENAME岩身内有发光红晶，睡眠时一明一暗。若遭打扰，就会醒来，发出愤怒的岩石爆击。
author: .izik
source: Inside POKENAME's rocky body are glowing red crystals that pulse as it sleeps. If disturbed, it awakens and launches a furious Rock Blast.

entry: POKENAME缓缓漂过夜空，目光始终锁着一个星座。即使受攻击，也不肯移开视线。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME floats slowly across the night sky, its gaze fixed on a single constellation. It refuses to look away, even when attacked.

entry: POKENAME望星时若被打扰，身体就会爆炸，向四面八方甩出尖石。
author: .izik
source: If disturbed while gazing at the stars, POKENAME's body explodes. The explosion flings sharp stones in every direction.

entry: POKENAME吃空巨石内部，形成巢穴。石下只有一处隐蔽出口，直通地下。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME hollows out massive boulders by eating their cores. Its den has a single hidden exit beneath the stone that leads directly underground.

entry: 情侣对POKENAME看法极为两极。有人相信，见到它预示感情长久如山；也有人视为噩兆，认为爱情将随山崩般的心碎终结。
author: kungfucutbug
source: POKENAME's reputation is incredibly divisive among couples. Some believe seeing it is a sign their relationship will endure like a mountain, but others see it as an omen that their love will end in a landslide of heartbreak.

entry: 这种POKENAME形态，奇怪地近似人形。仍保留隆隆岩的坚韧，受到强击，也毫发无伤。
author: hophoppip
source: This form of POKENAME is strangely humanoid. Despite this, it retains the toughness of a Golem, taking powerful hits without a scratch.

entry: 这种POKENAME形态，外表奇怪地近似人形。仍像喵喵一样找寻亮物，戴在身上作首饰。
author: hophoppip
source: This form of POKENAME is strangely humanoid in appearance. It still seeks out shiny objects like a Meowth would, wearing them as jewelry.

entry: POKENAME盘踞火山之巅。身体也能如火山般喷出熔岩。
author: tqz7
source: POKENAME can be found ruling over volcanic mountain peaks. Its own body can erupt with lava, just like a volcano.

entry: POKENAME长得躯干石壳装不下时，就会瞬间移动出旧壳，再让岩石浮向自己，做成新壳。旧壳随后能成为小型宝可梦的家。
author: reflecbeat
source: When a POKENAME grows too large for the rocky shell that encases its torso, it teleports out of the old shell, then levitates rocks towards it to make a new one. The old shells can then become homes for smaller Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME能花数十年寻找理想巨石，与之建立深厚羁绊。即使睡觉，强健双臂也紧抱选中的石头。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME can spend decades searching for the perfect boulder, forming a deep bond with it. Even while sleeping, it holds the chosen rock close within its muscular grip.

entry: 从不见POKENAME离开珍爱的沉重巨石。会把石球推上坡，锻炼力量，却总在快到顶时抓不牢，让石头再度滑落。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is never seen without carrying its prized and heavy stone boulder. It can be observed developing its strength by pushing the sphere uphill, but it always loses its grip, and subsequently the rock, when it nears the top.

entry: POKENAME用强力上勾拳，敲落洞顶石头。再吃掉，作为岩石食谱的一部分。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME performs powerful uppercuts to knock stones loose from cave ceilings. It consumes these stones as part of its rocky diet.

entry: POKENAME给躯干加上岩石，增强力量。躯干石头多的个体，就是族群首领。
author: gtrwya
source: POKENAME will add rocks to its torso to increase its strength. A POKENAME with many rocks on its torso is the leader of its pack.

entry: POKENAME爱滚下山坡，圆身体撞过沿途障碍。许多偏远村庄会在住宅周围挖沟，改变高速滚来者的方向。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME enjoy rolling down mountainsides, their round bodies slamming through obstacles in their way. Many remote villages dig ditches around their homes to redirect a speeding POKENAME.

entry: 它附在洞壁，挥拳打穿岩石，寻找黑色铁球。找到就整颗吞下，补充养分。
author: .izik
source: Clinging to cave walls, it punches through rock in search of Iron Balls. When it finds one, it swallows it whole for nourishment.

entry: 据说POKENAME变得太庞大，产生了自身引力。有时会造雪，冷却体内被认为正在形成的核。
author: _alex_0o
source: It is said that POKENAME has grown so massive that it exerts its own gravitational pull. It sometimes creates snow to cool what is believed to be a nucleus forming within its body.

entry: 融合后，多出的眼睛与手臂，让POKENAME力量、准头更强。不过这些新部位，也妨碍它缩成球，滚压对手。
author: sk372
source: After fusing, POKENAME gains more power and accuracy thanks to its extra eyes and arms. These new features adversely affect its ability to condense itself into a sphere and roll over its opponents, however.

entry: POKENAME被送进太空后，便会变成这副形态。POKENAME身上形成的行星，似乎可以居住。
author: rkmaster25367
source: When POKENAME is propelled into space, it assumes this form. The planet formed on POKENAME's body appears habitable.

entry: POKENAME的岩石装甲丝毫不减疾速，还能承受极高温。装甲也可发射出去，作为燃烧的远程攻击。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME's rocky plating does nothing to slow down its rapid speed. This plating can also withstand extremely high temperatures and can be shot out for a burning ranged attack.

entry: POKENAME渴求速度，为此会从山坡上高速弹射而下。
author: eiskitsune
source: POKENAME has a yearning for speed. To satisfy this desire, it launches itself down mountainsides at high velocity.

entry: 会嵌进岩石地面，咬住踩到它的对象。三颗头很少能达成一致。
author: kittyluv090
source: It embeds itself into rocky terrain and bites those who step on it. Its three heads rarely agree on anything.

entry: 巨石身体与三个头虽重，POKENAME仍能快得危险。可一旦太快，就可能绊倒，挟巨大破坏力滚撞四周。
author: sontyp
source: Despite the weight of its boulder-like body and three heads, POKENAME can become dangerously fast. Once it accumulates too much speed, however, it may stumble and roll into its surroundings with devastating force.

entry: 头顶射出的尖刺，像洞窟里的钟乳石。想阻止外壳闭合，难度就如托住正在坍塌的洞顶。
author: foolish_weasel
source: The spikes it shoots from its head are similar to cave stalactites. Trying to prevent its shell from closing is as difficult as holding up a collapsing cave ceiling.

entry: POKENAME能自由控岩，在壳上刮磨，形成周身尘云。常在刚发生滑坡的地方，吃松动的矿物。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME freely control rocks and scrape them against their shells, creating clouds of dust around themselves. These Pokémon are often found at sites of recent landslides, consuming minerals that have been loosened.

entry: 摆锤末端的石头微带磁性，与POKENAME岩石身体一样坚硬、不易变形。
author: .izik
source: The stone at the end of its pendulum has a slight magnetic charge. It is just as hard and unyielding as POKENAME's rocky body.

entry: 怪兽般的POKENAME潜在最深海域，重量让它永远留在海底。狩猎时，向路过的电灯怪、吼鲸王投巨大岩石，却通常很少成功。
author: ilazerheart
source: Monstrous POKENAME lurk in the deepest parts of the sea, forever on the bottom from their own weight. In an attempt to hunt, they hurl huge boulders at passing Lanturn or Wailord, usually with little success.

entry: POKENAME奔跑数小时后，火焰鬃毛会释放毒尘，吸入有害。它会在午后阳光下长睡，储存大量热量与能量。
author: fiordaliso
source: When POKENAME gallops for many hours, its fiery mane releases toxic dust that is harmful to anyone who breathes it in. It takes long afternoon naps in the sunlight to store up vast amounts of heat and energy.

entry: POKENAME个头小，能灵活穿过珊瑚，逃离捕食者。许多人称它为“海马”，既呼应墨海马的名字，也取外形相像之意。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME use their small size to quickly maneuver through coral to escape predators. Many have nicknamed these Pokémon "Seahorses", a play on the name Horsea, which they bear a resemblance to.

entry: POKENAME鬃毛覆着镁，使它能在水下燃烧。夜间深水里远远可见的红光，让渔民称它为“海中的火星”。
author: leandermalurt
source: The mane of POKENAME is coated in magnesium, which enables it to burn underwater. Fishermen call it the "Mars of the Ocean" due to the distant red glow seen in deep water at night.

entry: POKENAME火速追猎，抓到后，用灼热爪子擒住，接触便留下焦痕。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME charges after prey with searing speed. Once caught, it grapples them using blistering-hot claws that leave scorch marks on impact.

entry: POKENAME钳子摸起来很热，怒到一定程度甚至会着火。它喷鼻息，将臂上的蹄子互相敲击，警告其他生灵远离。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's pincers are quite hot to the touch, even catching on fire should it get angered enough. It snorts and clacks the hooves on its arms together as a warning for others to stay away.

entry: POKENAME以快速、出色地适应新环境闻名。虽然出生时脆弱，若精心照料，很快就会长得强壮。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are renowned for how quickly, and well, they can adapt to new environments. Although frail at birth, POKENAME quickly grow strong when they are raised well and with care.

entry: 油状分泌物如汗水，为火焰供能，维持旺盛。也让身体滑顺、洁净，防止火焰被水浇灭。
author: infinex21
source: Its flames are kept strong by an oily secretion that acts like sweat for this Pokémon. This oil keeps them slick & clean and keeps their flames from being put out by water.

entry: POKENAME以火焰怒势扑向敌人，用燃烧的蹄与利爪踢打，保护同族。面对更大敌人，就展开翅膀，让自己显得更大。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME protect their kin by descending onto foes with a fiery wrath, kicking them with flaming hooves and sharp claws. When facing off against larger foes, they extend their wings to appear larger.

entry: POKENAME身体仍在发育，飞行能力较差，必须用力拍翼才能留在空中。每次挥翼，都会向周围甩出无数余烬。
author: sk372
source: Its body is still developing, so POKENAME's flight capabilities are rather poor. It flaps vigorously just to stay airborne, flinging countless embers around it with every swing of its wings.

entry: POKENAME很胆小，稍受刺激，就会在周身造出覆火的精神护盾。火不烧触碰者，只用来威慑。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is timid and will create a psychic shield covered in flames around itself at the slightest provocation. The fire does not burn those who touch it, merely acting as an intimidating deterrent.

entry: POKENAME看见挡路灌木，就使出炽热火花，将其烧成灰，确保没有东西拖慢疾速。
author: .izik
source: When it sees a bush blocking its path, POKENAME unleashes a blazing Ember to burn it to ash. This ensures nothing slows down its blazing speed.

entry: POKENAME成群寻找草场进食，必须小心别烧掉要吃的草，尤其因为打喷嚏会喷出余烬。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME travel in flocks searching for pastures of grass to feast upon. They have to be careful not to burn the grass they eat, especially since they sneeze out embers.

entry: POKENAME啄开旧木，寻找下一餐。找到可吃的小块，就用余烬轻轻烤外层，再吃下。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME peck old logs in search of their next meal. When they find an edible morsel, they gently roast the exterior with embers before consuming it.

entry: POKENAME栖在树上，寻找最合口的食物。特别爱树果，会先烤再吃。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can be found perched above trees looking for the perfect morsel to eat. They are particularly fond of berries, which they roast before eating.

entry: POKENAME住在火山区域，高飞时用锐利目光寻找猎物。曾被认为是传说宝可梦火焰鸟的幼鸟。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME lives in volcanic regions, using its keen eyes to spot prey when soaring high above the terrain. It was once thought to be the fledgling of the legendary Pokémon Moltres.

entry: 成群POKENAME在林火后到来，吃剩下的焦种子与树果。似有奇特预感，能预测哪里可能发生野火。
author: mistymagius
source: Flocks of POKENAME arrive after wildfires, feeding on the burnt seeds and berries left behind. They seem to have a strange prophetic sense that allows them to predict where wildfires are likely to occur.

entry: POKENAME獠牙的温度能超过商用炸锅，一次咬击便能灼烧金属，是危险的伏击猎手。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's fangs can heat to temperatures hotter than commercial fryers. A single bite can sear metal, making it a dangerous ambush predator.

entry: POKENAME的蹄柔软带蹼，适合游泳，却难在陆上站稳。它分泌凝胶覆盖，让蹄硬得能走路。要除掉胶，就必须借尾巴火焰烧掉。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME has soft, webbed hooves, which helps it swim. It struggles to stand with them on land, so it secretes a gel to cover them, making them hard enough to walk on. To remove the gel, it must hold it to the fire on their tail and burn it off.

entry: POKENAME潜在湖中睡觉，不知周围水已开始沸腾。整片植物死去，它也浑然不觉。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME sleeps submerged in lakes, unaware that the water around it begins to boil. Entire patches of plant life die without it realizing.

entry: POKENAME宝石发光时，火焰会烧伤任何想触碰它的对象。有些文化将赢得信任视作成长仪式，因为它绝不背叛已建立的信任。
author: infinex21
source: If a POKENAME's gem is glowing, then its flames will burn anyone who tries to touch it. Earning a POKENAME's trust is a rite of passage in some cultures, for it will never betray a trust that has been earned.

entry: POKENAME会寻找古迹中迷路的探险者，如火炬般照亮道路，引向安全。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME will seek out lost explorers within ancient ruins. Acting like a torch, they will guide them to safety while lighting up the way.

entry: POKENAME跑到崖边，乘热气流滑翔数英里，身后留下闪烁的热气轨迹。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME gallops to cliff edges and glides for miles. Its flight path leaves behind shimmering trails of heated air as it coasts on thermal currents.

entry: 成群POKENAME在地面、空中竞速。获胜队伍向天空喷出火焰，以庆祝的阵阵火光照亮草甸。
author: .izik
source: Flocks of POKENAME race on foot and in flight. The winning team launches flames into the sky, lighting up meadows with celebratory fire bursts.

entry: POKENAME将树果储存在体内，定期烘烤。过程中产生的含酒精蒸馏液，能用于酿制各种酒。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME stores Berries in its body, which it regularly roasts. The process produces an alcoholic distillate that is used for various liquors.

entry: 它寻找车辆、加油站，偷石脑油、煤油与柴油喝。若自愿献出燃料，拿完便会离开，去偷别的东西。
author: epping_forest
source: It looks for vehicles and gas stations to steal naphtha, kerosene, and diesel just to drink them. If you voluntarily hand over the fuel, they'll take it and go away to steal something else.

entry: 黄色冒泡液体覆盖POKENAME，短暂接触也会造成严重灼伤，是摸起来最烫的宝可梦之一。
author: .izik
source: Yellow, bubbling liquid coats POKENAME's body. Even brief contact causes massive burns, making it one of the hottest Pokémon to touch.

entry: POKENAME虽然与同类竞速，动作却慢得令人心焦。熔融身体让一场短比赛，也能拉长到数小时。
author: .izik
source: Though it races with others of its kind, POKENAME is painfully slow. Even short competitions can stretch into hours due to its molten body.

entry: POKENAME羽毛散发的热量能造成轻微灼伤。脱落后几乎立即冷却，有时被用来引燃篝火。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's feathers radiate enough heat to cause mild burns. Once shed, they cool almost instantly and are sometimes used to start campfires.

entry: 它们在草原挖出精巧的洞穴。干季却可能引起野火，扰乱环境。
author: schwaus
source: They create elaborate burrows in grasslands. During dry seasons they have been known to disrupt the environment by causing wildfires.

entry: POKENAME滚泥降温、除寄生虫。虽然讨厌事后清洗，却必须洗净，否则可能感染，尤其躯干下部。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME roll around in mud to cool off and remove parasites. While many POKENAME hate being cleaned or rinsed off afterwards, they must, or they may develop infections, especially in their lower torso.

entry: POKENAME用利爪迅速奔跑，一升空，速度更变为地面时的三倍。振翼在天空身后留下道道热迹。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME runs swiftly with its talons, but once airborne, its speed triples. Its wingbeats leave streaks of heat in the sky behind it.

entry: POKENAME角的成长，快于火焰与速度的发展。成长中的个体，会互相顶角训练。
author: t3isukone
source: Its horns develop faster than its flames or its speed. Growing POKENAME will butt horns against each other to train themselves.

entry: POKENAME有点胆小，宁愿溜走，也不回击。它会将尾火在追逐者脸前晃动，阻止继续跟随。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is somewhat timid and prone to slithering away rather than fighting back. It will wave the flame on its tail back and forth in front of the face of pursuers in order to dissuade them from following it further.

entry: POKENAME踏着步与顿甲、小小象同行，用火焰吐息保护族群免受偷猎，自己也换来能归属的家庭。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME stomp alongside Donphan and Phanpy, joining them along their travels. They protect their herd from poachers with their fiery breath, and in return POKENAME have a family they can be a part of.

entry: 有些POKENAME变种，看上去像阿罗拉的小火马。体内蕴含微量妖精之力，通常在蜷球滚动时，表现为身后拖出的多彩光点。
author: sk372
source: Some variants of POKENAME result in an appearance resembling Ponyta's Alolan counterpart. It possesses trace amounts of Fairy power within, typically manifesting as colorful sparkles trailing it as it rolls around in a ball.

entry: POKENAME步态奇怪，仿佛还未适应自己的移动方式。先朝一方走固定距离，再向侧边短跳，路线呈L形。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME moves with an odd gait, as if not yet adapted to its own form of locomotion. It moves a set distance in one direction, then a short hop to one side, its path resembling an L-shape.

entry: POKENAME捕猎双管齐下：先用胸口马蹄铁形花纹的迷乱色彩，晃晕猎物；再迅速绕行，沿途火焰围成圈，让其无处可逃。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME traps its prey with a two-pronged attack: it stuns victims with disorienting color patterns from the horseshoe marking on its chest, and slithers around them quickly, trailing fire to create a circle of flame that leaves them with no escape.

entry: POKENAME聚在快速蔓延的林火上，像乘浪般骑火。也爱躲房里，慢慢升温恶作剧。但若交成朋友，常会帮人暖家。
author: quietcognition
source: POKENAME are known to gather above particularly fast-moving wildfires to ride the flames like waves. It often pulls pranks by hiding in a room and slowly heating it up. If befriended, however, it will often help a person keep their home warm.

entry: POKENAME敏感、胆小，一察觉危险就蜷成球，原地旋转，想用背上的火焰驱退威胁。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is quite jumpy and timid, curling up into a ball at the first sign of danger. It spins in place while curled up, intending to fend off the danger with the flames on its back.

entry: POKENAME战斗时蜷成球，裹火冲撞敌人。必须住在干燥、少雨环境，否则可能生病。
author: fiordaliso
source: When it battles, POKENAME curls into a ball and wreathes itself in flames before barreling into its opponents. It needs to live in dry, arid environments, or else it risks falling ill.

entry: POKENAME群寻找正在燃烧的林火，吸热、采富含矿物的灰，转成养分，让带火的枝叶燃烧得更旺。
author: ambrosia04
source: Herds of POKENAME can be seen seeking out active wildfires, absorbing heat and collecting mineral-rich ash, converting them into nutrients that make their fiery foliage flare up.

entry: POKENAME以臂与头上的火焰自卫，在敌人眼前晃动，分散注意。
author: glacierwing
source: POKENAME use the fire growing on their arms and head to defend themselves, flashing it into any attackers' eyes to distract them.

entry: POKENAME放松时，尖刺盖住背上的火焰，可以安全触摸。工匠在背上放小罐、砖，把它当简易窑炉。
author: mistymagius
source: When POKENAME is relaxed, its spines cover its back flames, making it safe to touch. Artisans will place small pots and bricks on its back, acting as a makeshift kiln.

entry: POKENAME能精准控火，受需要铁匠的牧场工人喜爱。它帮其他宝可梦打造马蹄铁，多余的送训练家，当幸运物。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME have acute control over fire, making them popular companions for ranch hands in need of blacksmiths. They help produce horseshoes for other Pokémon, but give any spares to their Trainers for good luck.

entry: POKENAME激烈战斗时，火焰也会包住蹄子，让攻击更具破坏力。它极忠于训练家。
author: fiordaliso
source: When POKENAME fights fiercely, flames also engulf its hooves, making its attacks even more devastating. It is an extremely loyal Pokémon to its Trainer.

entry: 一台烈焰机器。POKENAME用推进器手臂加速，速度能远远超过飞机。
author: rkmaster2637
source: A fiery machine. POKENAME can accelerate to speeds far beyond planes with its thruster arms.

entry: POKENAME看似笨拙迟缓，却能突然爆发惊人速度。冲刺时，鬃毛长大，盖住全身，宛如燃烧的彗星。
author: .fedoraman
source: While oafish and sluggish in appearance, POKENAME is capable of alarming bursts of speed. A charging POKENAME's mane grows to obscure its whole body, granting the appearance of a blazing comet.

entry: 救援队派POKENAME应对严冬灾害。结实的它用火温暖自身与周围，安全驮着受伤旅人穿过深雪，前往庇护处。
author: ambrosia04
source: Rescue teams deploy POKENAME to assist in harsh winter disasters. These sturdy Pokémon use their flames to warm their bodies and those around them, safely carrying injured travelers on their backs through deep snow to shelter.

entry: 除了它最信赖的训练家，谁触碰POKENAME的橙色环都会觉得烫手。奔跑得越久，火焰就烧得越热。
author: infinex21
source: A POKENAME's orange rings are hot to the touch for all but their most trusted Trainer. The longer they run, the hotter their flames burn.

entry: 它常被当作儿童玩具。谁握着缰绳，都能像骑真小马般骑行，但也得先与它建立感情。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: Often mistaken for a kids' toy, anyone who holds its reins can ride it like a real pony, but similarly must develop a relationship with it first.

entry: 火焰既用于攻击，也用于撤退。它会借喷火的反作用力，将自己推出战场。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: Its flames double as both a method of attack and an exit strategy, launching itself away from battle with expulsion force from its flames.

entry: POKENAME跳得高、跑得快，是出色的放牧帮手。唯有它信任的人，触碰鬃毛时才不会被灼伤。
author: melodydelune
source: Due to their high jumping and fast running, POKENAME are excellent herding Pokémon. Only those it trusts can touch its mane without burning.

entry: POKENAME常用改变时间的能力减缓草原火势，守护自己喜爱漫游的翠绿牧场。人们只在夏季漫长而晴朗的日子见过它。
author: ambidexhex
source: POKENAME often uses its ability to alter time to slow the spread of grass fires, maintaining the green pastures it loves to roam. It is only ever spotted on long, sunny, summer days.

entry: POKENAME起初移动得很慢，但每迈一步都会积蓄动力。据说，只要时间充足，力量就能增长到足以绕着世界一圈圈奔跑的程度。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's initial movement speed is very slow, but every step builds up steam. It's said that if given enough time, its power will build to the point it can run laps across the world.

entry: POKENAME看起来毛茸茸的，十分可爱，却会踢那些过分亲昵、乱摸自己的家伙。若能尊重它的界限，它便很乐意在炎热夏日载着对方驰骋开阔原野。
author: quackquackattack
source: While POKENAME appear fluffy and adorable, they are known to kick those who are too handsy with their affection. For those who respect their boundaries, POKENAME love to give rides through wide, open fields on a hot summer day.

entry: POKENAME的身体一受挤压，就会喷出体内的火焰，哪怕只是被用力抱了一下。有些人会养一只来帮忙生火。
author: infinex21
source: When a POKENAME's body is compressed, even if just by a strong hug, it will spew their inner flames. Some people will often have one of these Pokémon to help light fires.

entry: POKENAME沿着河床疾奔，巡视自己的水坝。哪怕发现最细微的失修之处，也会放下一切，立刻着手修补。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME sprints along riverbeds to patrol its dams. If it spots even the smallest maintenance flaw, it halts everything to make repairs immediately.

entry: 野生POKENAME会向父母学习格斗技巧，代代相传。能否在攻击中运用火焰，是它们生存的关键。
author: chibitales
source: In the wild, POKENAME learn fighting techniques from their parents, which are passed down to each generation. The ability to utilize their fire in their attacks is key to their survival.

entry: POKENAME的爪子比钻石还硬。幸好，它的精力只够把要吃的植物连根挖出来。
author: .fedoraman
source: POKENAME's claws are harder than diamond. Luckily, it only has enough energy to root up the plants it eats.

entry: 上百只POKENAME组成的群体从日出冲到日落，沿途踏过数百公里，植物和动物都难逃践踏。它们攀爬和奔跑一样快，即使陡直的崖壁也很难减缓这股狂奔的洪流。
author: .fedoraman
source: Packs of over a hundred POKENAME charge from sunrise to sunset, trampling plant and animal alike for hundreds of kilometers. Even sheer cliff faces do little to slow a stampede that climbs as fast as it runs.

entry: POKENAME头上的火焰即使完全浸没在水中也不会熄灭。不在水中时，火焰的温度足以烧掉漂在水面的漏油。
author: bradlybro199
source: The flame on a POKENAME's head burns even when fully submerged. The flame when not in water can burn hot enough to burn oil spills off the water.

entry: POKENAME的一半身体可以放心触碰，另一半却始终烫得一碰就会灼伤。旋转得足够快时，发烫的这半边会变得更热，燃烧起来，朝前方喷出一大股火焰。
author: sk372
source: One half of POKENAME is safe to touch, but the other is always hot enough to burn on contact. If it spins rapidly enough, this half grows hotter, combusting and firing a gout of flame in front of it.

entry: POKENAME总在进行友好的赛跑。速度越快，尾巴上的火焰就越炽热、越明亮。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME will constantly race against each other in friendly competitions. The flames on their tails burn hotter and brighter as they pick up speed.

entry: POKENAME的手臂上盛开着橙色玫瑰，覆有如火焰般闪烁的细粉。这些粉末既有毒，也能造成灼伤。
author: .izik
source: Orange roses bloom from POKENAME's arms, coated in fine powder that flickers like fire. The powder is both toxic and capable of causing burns.

entry: POKENAME的棉花极易燃烧，能持续烧上一天多，是绝佳的引火材料。因此，露营者常会带一只同行。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's cotton is highly flammable and can be for over a day without trouble. Campers with often take a POKENAME with them as the cotton is an excellent firestarter.

entry: POKENAME滚上垂直的崖壁，速度快得让目光难以追上。经过的地面被它烧焦，留下一道道焦土。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME races up vertical cliffs, rolling faster than the eye can follow. It scorches the ground behind it, leaving trails of burnt soil.

entry: 大脑袋让POKENAME难以保持平衡，奔跑时常会摔倒。它的腿力惊人，蹄子比钻石还硬，一脚便能踢碎巨石。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME struggles with balance due to its large head, often falling over while running. Its legs are incredibly powerful and its hooves are harder than diamonds, letting it shatter boulders with a single kick.

entry: POKENAME身上的石质突起能在奔跑撞上障碍物时缓冲冲击。速度越快，身上的火焰就越猛烈。
author: pjporwoll
source: The stony growths on POKENAME act as shock absorbers for when it crashes into obstacles during a run. The flames on its body grow in intensity as it accelerates.

entry: POKENAME飘过花田，边飘边从蹄子上撒落花粉。这些花粉能帮助遭火焚毁的地区重新长出植物。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME floats over flower fields, scattering pollen from its hooves as it drifts. This pollen helps plants regrow in fire-scarred regions.

entry: POKENAME柔软的身体里装满灰烬。它在烧毁的森林中漫游，大口吃下焦黑的残骸，吸收火后残留的养分。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's soft body is filled with ash. It roams burnt forests, feasting on charred remains to absorb lingering nutrients from the fire.

entry: POKENAME体质娇弱，需要适宜的温度才能正常生长。过热或过冷都会阻碍发育，因此族群常迁徙避开极端气温，以便茁壮成长。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are delicate creatures that require the right temperature to ensure proper growth. Excessively high or low temperatures can stunt POKENAME's growth, so herds often migrate around these extremes to ensure proper flourishing.

entry: POKENAME在森林中疾奔，寻找最合心意的细枝来啃咬。虽然有人研究过，却始终没人明白它挑选枝条的标准。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME dashes through forests searching for the perfect twigs to chew. Despite research, no one understands how it selects its favorites.

entry: POKENAME身后留下的火光常让潜行任务泡汤。它依靠敏捷的速度与火焰手里剑击败敌人。
author: hiroshima0042_23263
source: POKENAME's fiery trail often ruins stealth missions. POKENAME relies on its quick speed and fire shurikens to defeat foes.

entry: 尽管体格矮壮，POKENAME还是忍不住想快步奔跑。它努力训练，想超过普通人步行的速度，此时甲壳孔隙中会蹿起高高的火焰。
author: sk372
source: Despite its stout build, POKENAME is compelled to try and trot at high speeds. Flames rise high from the pores in its shell as it trains to reach speeds higher than the average human walk speed.

entry: POKENAME身上散发的火焰点缀着明亮星尘。它在空中嬉戏着扭动、回旋，常两两相伴，绕着彼此盘旋取乐，交织出绚丽的火光。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME radiates fire speckled with bright stardust from its body. It twists and twirls playfully through the air, pairs often forming to spiral around each other in recreation, creating vibrant fiery displays.

entry: 黄昏时，POKENAME会现身，在开阔草原上驰骋。一旦被人发现，便胆怯地立刻钻入地下躲藏。
author: .izik
source: At dusk, POKENAME emerges to gallop across open prairies. If noticed, it becomes timid and immediately burrows underground to hide.

entry: POKENAME在小巷和城市街道上收集硬币。回到巢穴后，会将硬币熔成闪亮的奖杯，纪念夜间的奔跑。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME gathers coins from alleyways and city streets. Back at its den, it melts them into shimmering trophies of its nightly runs.

entry: POKENAME有些爱美，喜欢把毛发和火焰打理成特定造型，避开可能弄乱它们的触碰。因此，只有真正信赖的对象才能抚摸它。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a bit vain, preferring to keep its fur and flame stylized and groomed in a specific way, avoiding the touch of others that may mess it up. Thus, only those it truly trusts are allowed to pet it.

entry: 训练家遇险时，POKENAME火焰鬃毛的温度会急剧上升。它很喜欢整天和同伴一起在平原奔跑。
author: fiordaliso
source: The temperature of its fiery mane rises sharply when its Trainer is in danger. POKENAME loves spending entire days running across plains with its pack.

entry: POKENAME常成群住在山坡上的洞穴里。能被训练成可靠的坐骑，对战时则极具攻击性，战斗起来异常凶猛。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME are often found living in herds within mountainside caves. They can be trained as dependable mounts, and they are highly aggressive in battle, fighting with immense ferocity.

entry: POKENAME总能把蹄铁磨坏，因此得经常去找铁匠。它生性好动，喜欢和其他宝可梦赛跑，直到筋疲力尽，蹄铁也就换得格外勤。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME always finds a way to wear down its horseshoes, so it needs frequent visits to a blacksmith. It replaces its horseshoes often because of its highly active lifestyle and loves to race with other Pokémon until it is tired.

entry: POKENAME每天都长跑，以保持肌肉强健，尤其是腿部肌肉。它能以最快速度连续跑上一小时，才开始感到疲倦。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME goes on long daily runs in order to keep its muscles strong, its legs especially. It can run at top speed for an hour straight before beginning to tire.

entry: POKENAME能用触手在陆地行走，但步伐缓慢，摇摇晃晃，很不稳当。在陆地上很容易受惊，转眼就会退回大海。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can walk on land with its tentacles, though its gait is wobbly, slow, and unsteady. It is easily scared while on land and will retreat back to the ocean at a moment's notice.

entry: POKENAME岩石身体的裂缝透出炽热光芒。即使看起来一动不动，触碰表面也可能灼伤皮肤。
author: .izik
source: Cracks in POKENAME's rocky body glow with intense heat. Touching its surface can scorch skin, even when it appears motionless.

entry: 这些POKENAME的身体发育得更加完善，肌肉也更强壮。食物代谢得更快，既能产生更猛烈的火焰，也能支持频繁奔跑。
author: infinex21
source: These POKENAME have much more developed bodies with stronger muscles. Their bodies metabolize food quicker to produce greater flames and to support their frequent running.

entry: POKENAME与同类在火山斜坡上来回赛跑。它们等待火山喷发作为起跑信号，让每场比赛都成为壮观的火焰盛景。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME races up and down volcano slopes with its kin. They wait for eruptions to signal the start, making each race a fiery spectacle.

entry: POKENAME拥有出色跑者的体格，但咬住尾巴的大舌贝会分泌麻痹毒素，让它疲乏。尾巴的火焰慢慢把大舌贝烤到昏厥，毒素也随之失效，小壳兽便有了训练的动力。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME has the physique of an incredible runner, but the Shellder biting its tail secretes a numbing venom that tires it out. The fiery tail slowly cooks the Shellder to fainting, neutralizing the toxin and inspiring Ponybro to train.

entry: POKENAME步伐略显笨拙，却能在大地上快速小跑。它主要吃种子，两颗头会把食物举到另一颗头的火焰上，稍稍烤过再吃。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME trots across the land with a quick, if slightly clumsy, gait. Eating mostly seeds, the two heads will hold their food above the other's flame, lightly toasting their meal before consuming it.

entry: POKENAME以善跑闻名，只有自己的进化形能胜过它。飞奔而过时，火焰令人惊叹。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME are famous for being amazing runners, only being beaten out by its evolution. Its flames are astonishing as it zips past you.

entry: 施展催眠术时，POKENAME的火焰最为明亮。它似乎靠吞食受害者的梦来维持燃烧，因为饥饿时火光便会黯淡，忽明忽灭。
author: sk372
source: When casting Hypnosis, POKENAME's flames burn at their brightest. The consumption of the dreams of its victims seems to be what keeps its flames burning, as a hungry POKENAME's flames are dim and flickering.

entry: 蹄子过热时，POKENAME有可能会故意点燃叶片与树枝，因此白天常会长时间休息。背上的球茎散发着浓烈的灰烬气味。
author: fiordaliso
source: When its hooves overheat, it risks deliberately setting leaves and twigs ablaze, which is why POKENAME often takes long rests during the day. The bulb on its back gives off a powerful scent of ash.

entry: POKENAME把骨头扔出去，再赶在落地前接住，以此训练速度。若遇上比自己更快的宝可梦，就会眼泪汪汪。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME throws bones to train its speed, catching them before they ever hit the ground. If it encounters a Pokémon faster than itself, it tears up.

entry: POKENAME夜间通常会让火焰完全包住身体，在漫长冬夜里取暖。
author: camtft
source: POKENAME commonly cover themselves completely in fire during the night, providing warmth during long winter nights.

entry: POKENAME转动的钻头为火焰鬃毛提供动力，转得越快，火焰就越汹涌。庞大身躯下藏着惊人的极速，几分钟就能飞驰过辽阔大地，将脚下的一切踏平。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's churning drill fuels its fiery mane: the faster the rotation, the more billowing its fire is. Its large size hides an incredible top speed; POKENAME can burn across vast distances in minutes, trampling everything underfoot.

entry: POKENAME以火焰鬃毛推动身体前进。虽然能靠热空气移动，但在水下更快，因为它会将身后的海水煮成蒸汽。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's fiery mane propels it forward. While it can push itself along using hot air, it moves faster underwater, as it boils the sea behind it into steam.

entry: POKENAME用火焰鳍在地面上方或水面之上游动。飘动的鳍只需轻轻一碰，就能灼伤大多数对手，因此它很少需要用角自卫。
author: .jerden
source: Using its fiery fins, POKENAME swims above the ground or over the surface of bodies of water. It rarely needs to use its horn for defense, as the slightest touch from its flowing fins can burn most opponents.

entry: 全速移动时，POKENAME用火焰鳍托住尾巴，两只蹄子几乎不沾地。它会这样绕着其他宝可梦奔跑，吸引对方注意，以此求偶。
author: .jerden
source: When it moves at top speed, its two hooves barely touch the ground, as it uses its fiery fins to keep its tail in the air. POKENAME uses this display to court other Pokémon, running in circles around them to gain their attention.

entry: POKENAME热爱各种形式的速度，尤其着迷于交通工具。有些个体会在道路和赛道上制造隐形墙，试图引发车祸。
author: griddle
source: It craves speed in all its forms, and is particularly fascinated by vehicles. Some POKENAME will try to cause car crashes by creating invisible walls on roads and raceways.

entry: POKENAME胶状的身体会热到足以造成轻微灼伤。但它绝不会伤害视为朋友或家人的对象。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's gelatinous body heats up enough to cause mild burns. However, it will never harm those it considers friends or family.

entry: 靠近某些进化石时，它的火焰就会增强。无论火势多么猛烈，都不会灼伤它信任的对象。
author: infinex21
source: Its flames grow stronger as it is brought nearer to particular evolutionary stones. Its flames will not burn those it trusts, no matter how much these flames may flare up.

entry: POKENAME的火焰以油为燃料，因此即使浸在水中也能继续燃烧。嘶鸣时，火焰会增强到几秒就能把水煮沸。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME fire is oil-based, which allows them to keep burning even if submerged in water. When they whinny, their flames grow strong enough to boil water in seconds.

entry: POKENAME是精力旺盛的跑者，不停地在开阔平原赛跑，为体内的火焰提供动力。冲刺越快，火焰就越炽热，会将不幸挡在路上的一切烧成灰烬。
author: eiskitsune
source: POKENAME are highly energetic runners that continually race across open plains to fuel their inner fire. The faster they sprint, the hotter their flames burn, incinerating anything unfortunate enough to be caught in their path.

entry: 这种宝可梦如燃烧的彗星般划过天空，最大的心愿就是成为伟大英雄当之无愧的坐骑。
author: spkypirate
source: Streaking through the sky like a blazing comet, this Pokémon would like nothing more than to be the worthy steed of a great hero.

entry: POKENAME在空中轻快奔跑，寻找消遣，看见感兴趣的事物就会停下。它迷恋人类使用火焰的方式，会瞬间移动到炉内，从火焰里好奇地观察人们。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME canter through the sky in search of distractions, stopping when they spy something that stokes their curiosity. They are enamoured with the ways humans use fire, teleporting within furnaces to watch people curiously from inside the flames.

entry: POKENAME在空中轻快奔跑，寻找消遣，看见感兴趣的事物就会停下。一察觉有人注视便会受惊，化作一道火光疾驰而去，躲开目光。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME canter through the sky in search of distractions, stopping when they spy something that stokes their curiosity. They startle when they sense people watching them, galloping away in a streak of flame to escape observation.

entry: 野生POKENAME常用火焰裹住身体，迅速包围猎物。某些原野上，经常能见到它为困住猎物而筑起的火墙留下的焦痕。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME often veil themselves in flames as they quickly encircle prey. Scorch marks from the walls of fire they form to entrap their prey are a common sight in certain fields.

entry: POKENAME喜爱翱翔天际，享受风拂过脸庞的感觉。只会为了吃草和在树枝上休息而降下。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME love to soar through the sky and enjoy the feeling of air against their faces. They only come down to eat grass and rest in tree branches.

entry: POKENAME的尖角毒性很强，也十分坚韧。它常把蹄子相互敲击，迸出火星，点燃自己吐出的丝网，再将火网抛向敌人。
author: infinex21
source: A POKENAME's sharp horn is very poisonous and very durable. It will often clap its hooves together to create sparks that ignite the webbing they can spit, which they then fling at foes.

entry: POKENAME用猛烈的电脉冲震晕猎物，再困入过热水流。渔夫的古老歌谣警告，整群鱼会在它游过后消失，只留下一道通向深渊的光迹。
author: silentscript89
source: POKENAME uses ferocious electric pulses to stun its prey and traps them within superheated currents. Old Fishermen songs warn how entire schools of fish vanish in its wake, with nothing left behind but a trail of light leading into the abyss.

entry: POKENAME在空中滑翔时会散落余烬。它们相互竞速，决出谁最快，并以复杂的空中动作避开沿途障碍。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME release embers as they glide through the sky. They race against each other to determine who is fastest and perform complex aerial maneuvers to dodge anything in their way.

entry: POKENAME常被误认成体型较小的小火马，便趁机尽可能多偷些食物。很少在一处定居，总在四处游荡。
author: h0bojoe
source: POKENAME is often mistaken for a small Ponyta and uses the confusion to steal as much food as possible. It rarely settles in one place, wandering constantly.

entry: POKENAME跑得极快，能掠过水面。产生的热量使水面大幅升温，把小型宝可梦带到水面，再被它一口吞下。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME can run so quickly that it is able to flit along the surface of water. The heat it generates causes the surface of the water to heat up greatly, dragging small Pokémon to the surface, where POKENAME snaps them up.

entry: POKENAME的皮肤能分泌可燃油脂，让背上的火焰持续燃烧。一天的大部分时间都在懒洋洋地休息，嚼吃周围的草。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME produces a flammable oil from its skin, allowing the flame on its back to burn indefinitely. It spends most of the day lazing around and munching on the surrounding grass.

entry: 它的角会发出微弱的精神波动，宝石发光时，波动便会增强。用角或口鼻触碰信任且建立羁绊的对象，就能传达自己的感受。
author: infinex21
source: Weak psychic waves are emitted from its horn. These waves grow stronger when its gem glows. By touching its horn or muzzle against someone it trusts and has bonded with, it can communicate its feelings.

entry: POKENAME若奔跑太久而不休息，背上的球茎就会开始释放掺有毒物的烟。它用角刮擦树皮，标记森林领地的边界。
author: fiordaliso
source: If POKENAME runs too long without resting, its bulb begins releasing smoke laced with toxic agents. It scrapes its horn against tree bark to mark the boundaries of its forest territory.

entry: POKENAME的火焰鬃毛一旦消失，就应立刻防御或躲避。此时所有火焰都积存在尾巴里，即将化作巨大的火柱喷向目标。
author: sk372
source: When POKENAME's fiery mane vanishes, one should take immediate defensive or evasive action; the fire is all being stored in the tail, which it will spew out in a massive jet of flame at its target.

entry: POKENAME在火山深处掘洞，高温高压使尖刺硬化成钻石。它不怕钝击和火焰，还能在灾害周围挖掘壕沟，减轻危险，因此宝可梦巡护员都渴望与它成为搭档。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME tunnels deep below volcanos, the heat and pressure hardening its spikes into diamonds. It is coveted as a partner by Pokémon Rangers as it can dig trenches around disasters to mitigate danger while being safe from blunt damage and fire.

entry: 高速转动身体时，POKENAME会化作火焰钻头，轻易钻透基岩。挖出的隧道在完工后数小时仍有火焰闷燃。
author: sk372
source: Turning its body at high speeds lets POKENAME become a flaming drill able to tunnel through bedrock with ease. The tunnels it digs this way smoulder with still-burning flames for hours after it's finished digging.

entry: 成群的POKENAME会展开漫长的赛跑，直到群体中每个成员都越过终点，比赛才算结束。
author: .izik
source: Flocks of POKENAME race one another in long competitions. A race only ends once every member of a flock crosses the finish line.

entry: POKENAME挥钳击打敌人的速度不断加快，钳内的火焰也愈发猛烈。等挥击达到最快速度，便张开钳子，朝敌人喷出一股烈火，结束战斗。
author: soup1900
source: As POKENAME bashes foes with its pincers at an increasing pace, the flames within them grow and intensify. Once it's swinging at foes at max speed, it finishes the battle by opening its pincers and blasting them with a burst of fire.

entry: 壳内烈火将其加热至高炉般的温度，因此POKENAME很受陶艺家欢迎，常成为他们的伙伴。
author: chorb33
source: The fires that rage in its shell heat it up to the temperature of a blast furnace. This makes POKENAME a popular partner Pokémon for potters.

entry: POKENAME额前的冰角终生不断生长，靠火焰的热量抑制，才不会长得过大。年老体弱后，巨大的角会成为沉重负担。
author: wiz0z
source: The icy horns on POKENAME's foreheads constantly grow throughout their lives. The heat from their flames keeps the horns from overgrowing. Older POKENAME are weighed down by massive horns as their bodies become weaker.

entry: POKENAME总是乐于抓住机会全速冲刺。野外一旦发现蜂蜜，便会有小群个体聚在一起赛跑，看看谁能先尝到这份甜食。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME always enjoys a good chance to sprint at top speed. In the wild, when a source of honey is discovered, small groups of POKENAME will gather to race to see who can reach the sweet treat first.

entry: POKENAME用角在结果的树上留下标记，宣示领地。会从爪间唤出回旋的火焰旋涡，驱逐入侵者。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME marks fruit-bearing trees with its horn to claim territory. It will summon a swirling Fire Spin from its paws to drive away intruders.

entry: POKENAME拍动翅膀时，火焰会发出响亮的噼啪声。据说，把它的一根羽毛放在枕下入睡，就能做个鲜明愉快的梦。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME flaps its wings, its flames crackle loudly. Sleeping with one of its feathers under a pillow is said to bring vivid, pleasant dreams.

entry: POKENAME在空中速度惊人，最快可达每小时80英里。必须落地狩猎和觅食，但在地面上没有空中那么灵活。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can reach blistering speeds in the air, with a top speed of 80 mph. It has to land to hunt and forage, though it is less maneuverable on its feet than in while airborne.

entry: 虽然会游泳，POKENAME却主要在陆地捕猎。它借火焰鳍产生的热空气漂浮，以火焰构成的旋涡困住敌人。
author: .jerden
source: Although it can swim, POKENAME mostly hunts on land. It floats on the hot air produced by its fiery fins and traps foes in vortices made of fire.

entry: POKENAME滚动时会烧焦身下的地面。转得越快，留下的焦痕就越黑、越深。
author: .izik
source: As it rolls, POKENAME scorches the ground beneath it. The faster it spins, the darker and deeper the burn marks it leaves behind.

entry: POKENAME快速爬行，沿途留下火焰，用来困住猎物。火笼逐渐缩小，直到里面再也无处逃跑。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME slithers rapidly, leaving trails of fire where it moves. It uses these trails to entrap its prey, slowly creating a smaller flaming cage until there is nowhere left to run or escape.

entry: POKENAME巡视附近农田时，火焰会照亮夜色。一发现擅闯者，便毫不犹豫地挺角疾驰，冲向对方。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME's flames illuminate the night as it patrols nearby farmlands. If it detects a trespasser, it will gallop towards them horn-first without hesitation.

entry: POKENAME在夏季来临，带来暖意与夏雨。栖居的地区笼罩着浓雾。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME arrives during the summertime, bringing warm temperatures and summer rain. Areas where it resides are covered in a blanket of heavy fog.

entry: POKENAME生活在寒冷地区，奔跑时鬃毛会泛起极光般的色彩。冬季将尽时，成群迁徙，身上迸出的火焰以热量融化积雪。
author: keiracm35_
source: POKENAME live in low-temperature areas. When they gallop, their manes glow with the colors of the aurora. When winter comes to an end, POKENAME migrate in herds, melting the snow with the heat of the flames that burst from their bodies.

entry: POKENAME在山顶跺脚，向朋友发出赛跑挑战。虽然笨拙而缓慢，挥动火焰尾巴时却满是坚定的斗志。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME stamps its feet atop mountains to challenge friends to races. Though clumsy and slow, it waves its flaming tail with fierce determination.

entry: POKENAME炉膛般的身体不断向空中喷出含沙的烟灰。对战时喷得更加猛烈，笼罩四周，遮去一切光线，只剩它体内的火光。
author: staghorn
source: POKENAME's furnace-like body constantly spews plumes of sandy ash into the air. These emissions intensify during battle, smothering the surroundings and blocking out all light except for its internal flame.

entry: 炎热干燥的日子里，POKENAME会高速飞过田野和平原。据说，它在野火燃起前便会现身，但许多人怀疑，火正是它的火焰鬃毛无意或有意点起的。
author: .jerden
source: On hot, dry days, POKENAME flies at high speed above fields and plains. It is said to appear just before wildfires start, although many people suspect that POKENAME's fiery mane directly causes these, either accidentally or deliberately.

entry: POKENAME用烈焰覆盖的身体盘住猎物，使其无法逃脱。额角内有一处腺体，调节体内毒液的生成。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME prevents its prey from escaping by trapping them in its coils, which are covered in blazing flames. The horn on its forehead contains a gland that regulates the production of venom in its body.

entry: 凭借新获得的速度与力量，POKENAME只需几秒，就能以燃烧的鞭状尾巴连连抽击，压倒对手。每次攻击都会留下燃烧的鳞片，让灼伤处持续燃烧数日。
author: patch01774
source: With its newfound speed and power, POKENAME is able to overwhelm its opponents with flaming whip-like tail strikes in mere seconds. The burns left behind by each of these attacks can burn for days due to each one leaving behind fiery scales.

entry: POKENAME主要栖息在炎热的灌木地和沙漠，夜晚成群现身，在空中赛跑。远望如缥缈的火光在地平线上方闪烁起舞。
author: quietcognition
source: POKENAME's main habitat is in hot scrublands and deserts, where groups come out at night and race through the air. From a distance they look like flickers of ethereal flame dancing just above the horizon.

entry: POKENAME将火焰引遍全身协助防御，体内则储存大量电力。进攻时，将雷电全部引向尖角，从角尖射出强大的电击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME channels fire all across its body to aid in defense, while keeping vast stores of electricity built up inside. When it needs to attack, it channels all the lightning into its horn and fires powerful bolts from the tip.

entry: 这种融合体变得极为卑劣，喜欢折磨对手。它会抓伤、烧灼已经落败的对手，以为对方的惨叫能取悦训练家。
author: epping_forest
source: This fusion becomes extremely vile and sadistic. It scratches and burns its defeated opponents, thinking their screams will please their Trainer.

entry: POKENAME难以控制熊熊烈火，因此常独自待在远离人类和宝可梦的地方。
author: crustyglowstick
source: POKENAME struggles to contain its blazing flames. Because of this, it is often found secluded away from both people and Pokémon.

entry: 身体不断燃烧，身后留下厚厚的灰烬。同时又再生得极快，让火焰永不熄灭。
author: chorb33
source: Its body is constantly burning, leaving a thick trail of ash behind it. At the same time, its body regenerates so quickly that it never goes out.

entry: POKENAME跺地警告对手不要靠近。若有人不听，便将双臂举向身后，喷出道道火焰推动自己向前，以有力的头槌撞击入侵者。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME stomp the ground to warn opponents not to approach. If someone doesn't heed these warnings, POKENAME raise their arms behind them and blast out streams of fire to launch forward and deliver a powerful headbutt to the intruder.

entry: POKENAME常出现在山火现场附近，有理论认为许多山火正是它们造成的。不过，火灾也为新生命的繁盛腾出了空间。
author: carameldog
source: POKENAME are often seen near the site of bushfires, and theorized to cause many of them. However, these fires clear the way for new life to flourish.

entry: POKENAME会向同类发起挖洞竞赛。挖掘时，火焰尖刺会燃起，照亮挖出的隧道。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME challenges others of its kind to digging races. Its fiery spines ignite as it digs, lighting the tunnels it carves.

entry: POKENAME的火焰有微弱的疗伤效果，会用来照顾心爱的对象。面对有敌意的敌人，则会用火将其烧成灰烬。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's flames have minor healing properties that it bestows to its loved ones. Against hostile enemies, POKENAME uses its fire to burn them to ash.

entry: POKENAME光辉的气场吸引着各类生灵。据说，只看一眼便能抚慰心灵。古时常由王室饲养。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME's radiant aura attracts all kinds of creatures. A single glance is said to soothe the heart. In ancient times, it was often kept by royal families.

entry: POKENAME是无所畏惧的战士，勇敢作战，保护弱小免受欺凌。能操纵火焰，将其塑成长矛，运用得十分娴熟。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is a fearless warrior that fights bravely to protect the weak from mistreatment. It can manipulate its flames, shaping them into a spear that it wields with remarkable skill.

entry: POKENAME的血液在接近100度时沸腾。它把多余热量引向背部，为那里的火焰供热，形成浓烟包住身体，让对手难以确定它的位置。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME's blood boils at close to 100 degrees, and it diverts excess heat across its back to feed the fire there. This creates thick smoke that envelops POKENAME, preventing opponents from pinpointing it.

entry: POKENAME以构成身体的灵魂之怒为动力，附身其他马类宝可梦，在牧场大闹。许多牧场主会定期检查宝可梦身上有无奇怪的蹄铁，以防它惹出乱子。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are fueled by the fury of the spirits that compose their bodies and possess other equine Pokémon to cause havoc on ranches. Many ranchers periodically check their Pokémon for an odd horseshoe to prevent POKENAME-related chaos.

entry: POKENAME奔过开阔平原，沿途留下一道火痕。燃烧的鬃毛，正象征着它不屈的斗志，与战场上无可比拟的敏捷。
author: sheogorath
source: POKENAME runs across open plains, leaving flaming trails in its wake. Its fiery mane symbolizes its unwavering spirit and unmatched agility in battle.

entry: 全速移动时，POKENAME燃着火焰的头槌几乎能撞碎任何障碍。一旦开跑，最好避开它的路线，因为无论前方有什么，它都不会停。
author: darkweavile428
source: When moving at top speed, POKENAME's flaming headbutts can tear apart almost any obstacle. Once it starts running, it's best to stay out of POKENAME's way, since it won't stop no matter what is in its path.

entry: 身体虽沉重，记录中的最高时速仍达45英里。金属长年受火烧灼，逐渐变得能够吸热。
author: houndrys.
source: Despite its heavy body, it's been recorded to reach a top speed of 45 mph. The constant fire on the metals have made them heat absorbant.

entry: POKENAME极为懒惰，常睡在田野里。遭到攻击就起身跑到别处，继续休息。
author: thefinalkalgonus
source: POKENAME is extremely lazy, so it's seen sleeping in the fields. When attacked, it gets up and runs away to a place where it can continue to rest.

entry: 农人让POKENAME凭惊人的力量和耐力干活，却拿同样惊人的懒惰和食量毫无办法。激励它干活所需的食物，比一座农场的产出还多，养过它的人最终全都破产了。
author: .fedoraman
source: Farmers have put its immense strength and endurance to work, but are stumped by its equally large laziness and appetite. A POKENAME requires so much food as motivation that it eats more than a farm produces, leading all its owners into bankruptcy.

entry: POKENAME凭借快步与预知能力，迅速疏散它认为可能遇险的对象。世界各地的应急救援队正开始招募它加入。
author: sk372
source: With its quick feet and precognition, POKENAME quickly evacuates those it perceives as being in potential danger. Emergency response teams across the world are beginning to recruit POKENAME into their ranks.

entry: POKENAME往往天性好斗，会赶走一切靠得太近的对象。另一方面，对能建立羁绊的伙伴又无比忠诚。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME tend to be naturally aggressive, chasing away anyone who gets too close. On the flip side, POKENAME are incredibly loyal to those they manage to form a bond with.

entry: 一些岛屿文化曾将POKENAME奉为火神。被它灼伤被视为荣耀与获得神明认可的印记。
author: .izik
source: Some island cultures worshipped POKENAME as a god of flame. Being burned by it was considered a mark of honor and divine recognition.

entry: 靠近磁场时，POKENAME的火焰会增强。这种现象常见于电气石洞穴等地。
author: .izik
source: Near magnetic fields, POKENAME's flames intensify. This phenomenon is often seen in locations like Chargestone Cave.

entry: 传说POKENAME曾侍奉历史上几位最雄心勃勃的霸主，助其征服整个地区。施展最致命的攻击时，剑刃会被熊熊烈火包裹。
author: fiordaliso
source: According to legend, POKENAME once served some of the most enterprising warlords in history, helping them conquer entire regions. The blade of its sword becomes wreathed in burning flames when it unleashes its deadliest attacks.

entry: 野生POKENAME生活在偏僻湖泊，散出的热量足以使整片湖变成大温泉。很少有人有幸找到这样的湖，能亲眼见到它美丽身姿的人更少。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME live within secluded lakes, radiating enough warmth to turn them into large hot springs. Few are ever fortunate enough to find such lakes, and even fewer still are lucky enough to witness the beauty of this Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME利用火焰毛发产生的热浪制造蜃景和幻象。据说，这些幻象不会出现在它信任的对象眼前。
author: nyoomymph
source: POKENAME uses the heat haze from its fiery hair to create mirages and illusions. It's said that these illusions do not appear to those it trusts.

entry: POKENAME群体中跑得最快的一只就是首领。它们争强好胜，谁看起来比自己快，就要和谁赛跑。
author: melodydelune
source: In herds of POKENAME, the fastest runner is the leader of the herd. They are very competitive and will race anything that they see as faster.

entry: POKENAME远游四方，通常漂浮在平原或田野上空。燃烧的火焰能将它推向惊人的高速。有人试过把它当交通工具，但飞行路线似乎毫无规律。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME wanders lands far and wide, usually floating above plains or fields.  Its burning flames propel it to incredible speeds. A few have attempted to use POKENAME as a means of transportation, but its flight patterns appear to be random.

entry: POKENAME从尾巴接连射出燃烧的孢子。即使在最崎岖、多石的地形上也能飞奔，没有敌人能比它跑得快。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME rapidly fires blazing spores from its tail. No foe can outrun it as it dashes across even the roughest and rockiest terrain.

entry: 面对强敌，POKENAME会释放火焰的全部威力。常用同样的烈火包住斧状獠牙，进一步压制并击败敌人。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME release the full might of their flames when faced with a strong opponent. They will often veil their axe-like tusks in these very same flames to further overwhelm and conquer their enemies.

entry: 农人很喜欢让POKENAME作伴，替马厩的各扇门管理钥匙。可惜，它喜欢和其他宝可梦在田野奔跑，很难说服它把马厩锁上。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are popular companions of farmers, who use them to manage the keys of every set of doors at their stables. Unfortunately, it can be hard to convince POKENAME to lock the stables as they enjoy running with the other Pokémon in the fields.

entry: POKENAME似乎一直在逃避身上燃烧的火焰，却会攻击试图用水灭火的人。虽然身体看似由木头和布构成，火焰其实从未烧伤它。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME seems to be constantly fleeing from the flames burning on its body, but will attack anyone that tries to put them out with water. Despite its body resembling wood and cloth, this fire never actually damages POKENAME.

entry: 尽管外形相像，POKENAME却没有重泥挽马或雷电斑马的DNA。因此，许多人推测烈焰马与这两种宝可梦有较近的共同祖先。它的三颗头，行为似乎都最像烈焰马。
author: icelevelincarnate
source: Despite appearances, POKENAME has no Mudsdale or Zebstrika DNA. Because of this, many theorize that Rapidash shares a close common ancestor with these Pokémon. All three of POKENAME's head seem to behave closer to a Rapidash than anything else.

entry: POKENAME以尾巴的神秘力量为动力，时速可达200英里，身后留下九道光迹。在长达1,000年的一生中，只要能赛跑就会尽情奔跑。
author: chaoticanzu
source: Fueled by the mystic power in its tails, POKENAME can reach 200 mph, leaving behind nine light trails. It spends its 1,000 year lifespan racing as much as possible.

entry: POKENAME的火焰尾巴只需喷出一股烈火，就能将森林夷为平地。它们住在洞穴里，可以对着洞壁尽情放火而不必担心危险。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have flaming tails that are capable of razing forests with a single blast of fire. They live in caves where they can safely unleash their fire against cave walls.

entry: 成群的POKENAME在丛林中嬉闹奔驰，留下光秃的树冠与被踩平的灌木。它们造成的破坏让新植物得以生长，也是丛林自然生命周期的一部分。
author: .fedoraman
source: Packs of POKENAME leave bare canopies and trampled underbrush in their wake as they romp through the jungle. The destruction they wreak is a part of the jungle's natural life cycle as it allows for new plants to grow in its place.

entry: 会与其他POKENAME比谁挖的陷坑最多。又会在坑之间飞奔，赶在掉进去的猎物逃脱前将其抓住。
author: soup1900
source: It races other POKENAME to see who can dig the most pit traps. It races from pit to pit to catch any prey that has fallen in before they can escape.

entry: POKENAME大半身躯燃烧的火焰，既能显示健康状况，也能显示最快速度。最快、最健康的个体拥有最庞大华美的羽状火焰。
author: sk372
source: The flames burning across most of POKENAME's body are an indicator of both its health and its top speed. The fastest and healthiest POKENAME have the largest and most luxurious of fiery plumes.

entry: POKENAME收起翅膀，在草原上疾奔。发生争执时，便大幅张开双翼，来回横步，展示威势。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME runs swiftly across grasslands with its wings tucked. During disputes, it spreads its wings wide and paces side to side in a show of dominance.

entry: 人们在辽阔开敞的牧场饲养POKENAME，让它们参加当地赛跑比赛。它们热爱获胜，因此整天不懈训练，以提升速度。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are raised on vast, open ranches to race against each other in local tournaments. They love winning races, so they train relentlessly throughout the day to improve their speed.

entry: POKENAME悬在焦黑的战场上空，令人不寒而栗。威慑力无可比拟，会挺起尖角，掀起灼热的烈焰风暴，彻底压倒对手。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME hover ominously above charred battlefields. Peerless in their intimidation, they raise their sharp horns and unleash scorching firestorms to completely overwhelm their opponents.

entry: POKENAME头上的叶子极烫。情绪不佳时，叶子会起火脱落；若营养充足，一天内便能重新长出。
author: .izik
source: The leaves on POKENAME's head are extremely hot. When POKENAME is upset, they ignite and fall off, regrowing within a day if it's well nourished.

entry: 史前的POKENAME会带领族群离开炎热丛林，前往凉爽草场，避免身体过热。如今，它们仍与族群沿祖先走过的路线迁徙。
author: quackquackattack
source: During prehistoric times, POKENAME would guide their herd away from hot jungles into cool pastures of grass to prevent overheating. In modern times, POKENAME and their herd travel the same routes as their ancestors once did.

entry: 有史前记录记载，POKENAME带领族群渡过重大灾害，确保大家熬过严冬。如今，它们沿着狭长的肥沃地带迁徙，以避开冰冻气温。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have been recorded in prehistoric times guiding herds through major disasters, ensuring that their herd survives harsh winters. In modern times, by migrating along a thin belt of fertile land, POKENAME's herd avoid freezing temperatures.

entry: POKENAME起舞时，会随着动作本能地制造炽烈的火焰旋涡。双脚快得惊人，常一路跳舞前往目的地，速度不亚于疾驰的烈焰马。
author: foolish_weasel
source: As POKENAME performs a dance, it instinctively creates a blazing Fire Spin with its movements. POKENAME's feet move incredibly fast, and it will often dance to wherever it wishes to go with the speed of a galloping Rapidash.

entry: POKENAME以惊人速度掠过白日天空，身后拖着火焰。需要自卫时，身上的三个火环能猛烈膨胀到巨大无比。
author: sk372
source: Fire trails behind POKENAME as it races across the daytime sky at remarkable speeds. The three hoops of fire on its body can flare up to massive sizes if it needs to defend itself.

entry: POKENAME四处爬行时，会释放裹有孢子的小余烬，沉入土中。孢子最终会长成一种以辛辣风味著称、备受追捧的蘑菇。
author: sk372
source: As POKENAME scuttles about, it releases small embers containing spores that sink into the ground. From these spores will eventually grow a type of mushroom noted and sought for its spicy flavor.

entry: POKENAME被形容为力量与速度都十分出色的宝可梦，常参与极危险的救援。能掀翻、推动某些重达数十吨的障碍，奔跑时速超过100英里。
author: heal_fire
source: POKENAME are described as very strong and very fast Pokémon that are often used in extremely dangerous rescues. They are able to flip and push some obstacles that weigh dozens of tons, and can run at more than 100 mph.

entry: 有人说POKENAME是火焰本身的化身。它现身林火之中，控制火势避开宝可梦的巢穴，随后消失在纷落的余烬里。
author: ghostslythe
source: Some say POKENAME is the avatar of flame itself. It appears in the middle of forest fires, controlling the blaze away from Pokémon nests, before vanishing in a rain of cinders.

entry: POKENAME彼此好胜，能见到它们在空中赛跑。任何被它们火焰烧到的东西，都会冒出毒性极强的浓烟。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are very competitive with one another and can be seen racing through the sky. Anything burned by their flames gives off thick smoke that is incredibly toxic.

entry: POKENAME穿过草地疾飞，只为享受迎面疾风的快乐。飞得够快时，会骤然燃起火焰，在空中划出道道光迹。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME zip through fields of grass for the sheer joy of feeling the rushing wind. If they soar fast enough, they can abruptly burst into flames, creating streaks of light as they fly.

entry: POKENAME在稀树草原徘徊，只为追求竞争的快感。它一路自夸，挑衅、嘲弄各种宝可梦，只想享受一场痛快的战斗或其他挑战。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME prowls the savanna with one purpose: the thrill of competition. Boasting all the while, it dares and taunts and mocks all sorts of Pokémon just to feel the enjoyment of a good battle or any other challenge.

entry: POKENAME奔跑时若遭遇他者，会钻入土下，释放回旋的火焰冲击，想借此吓退追赶者。
author: .izik
source: When encountered while galloping, POKENAME dives beneath the soil and releases swirling blasts of fire. This display is meant to frighten pursuers away.

entry: POKENAME的火焰鬃毛夏季最为明亮，暴怒时更会燃成滔天烈火。不过，一旦下雨，鬃毛就会变成翻涌的烟云。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's fiery mane burns brightest during the summer and will rage into an inferno when POKENAME is enraged. However, if it starts raining, its mane will turn into a bellowing cloud of smoke.

entry: POKENAME耐力出众，目光警觉，嗅觉灵敏，是优秀的追踪者。喜欢追逐人类和其他宝可梦，即使有时很难跟上也乐此不疲。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME's high stamina, watchful eyes, and strong sense of smell make them excellent trackers. They adore chasing people and other Pokémon, even if they sometimes struggle to keep pace.

entry: POKENAME达到最快奔跑速度时，火焰鬃毛会包裹全身。它与族群住在辽阔平原，可以尽情奔跑。
author: fiordaliso
source: When POKENAME reaches its top running speed, its fiery mane engulfs its entire body. It lives with its herd across vast plains where it can run freely.

entry: POKENAME腿力强健，时速可达80英里，不过它更喜欢直接瞬间移动到目的地。控火能力炉火纯青，能以纯粹的火力压倒对手。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's powerful legs allow it to run up to 80mph, even though it prefers to just teleport to its destination. Its masterful pyrokinetic abilities allow it to overwhelm its opponents with pure firepower.

entry: POKENAME特别愤怒时，挥拳产生的热量和摩擦，足以在暴雨中点燃一片森林。
author: bradlybro199
source: When a POKENAME gets particularly upset, its punches create enough heat and friction to set a forest ablaze during a rainstorm.

entry: 很长一段时间，科学家都以为古壁画上的POKENAME只是画师把另一种宝可梦画错了。它在林间自由驰骋，吞下沿途遇到的昆虫。
author: mistymagius
source: For a long period of time, Scientists thought that ancient murals of POKENAME were just an artistic misrepresentation of a different Pokémon. It gallops freely about the woods, swallowing any insects in its way.

entry: POKENAME的石头热得足以温汤。一些地区相信，将它用于饭菜能使病更快痊愈。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's stones are hot enough to warm soup. In some regions, it's believed this can cure sickness faster when used in meals.

entry: POKENAME的身体更小，发育却更完善，能跑得比以前更快，不过需要时间适应新的极速。新潜力让它有些自负、易怒，性情也变得很不稳定。
author: sk372
source: With a smaller, more developed body, POKENAME can reach greater speeds than before, though it takes time to acclimate to its new top speed. Its new potential gives it a bit of an ego and temper, so its behavior is rather volatile.

entry: 人们曾把一群POKENAME误认成肆虐的野火，因此首次发现了它们。火焰鬃毛的大小似乎决定谁成为首领，而首领会拼命保护同伴。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME was first discovered after a herd of them was mistaken for a raging wildfire. The size of their flaming manes seems to determine the leader of the herd, who will protect their brethren with their life.

entry: 凭借耐力和加速能力，POKENAME被认为是世界上最出色的快步跑者之一。肌肉全力运转时，构成鬃毛的火焰会热得惊人，颜色迅速变化。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is considered one of the best trotters in the world, thanks to its stamina and ability to accelerate. When it exerts its muscles to the fullest, the flames that make up its mane reach incredible temperatures and rapidly change colors.

entry: POKENAME跑得越快，羽毛就越烫。全速时，身体可能燃起火焰，自己却丝毫不会受伤。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's feathers grow hotter the faster it runs. At full speed, its body may erupt in flame, though it remains completely unharmed.

entry: POKENAME是陆地上最快的宝可梦之一，几小时便能跑遍整个地区。奔跑跳跃时，身后会留下燃烧的蹄印。
author: sk372
source: One of the speediest Pokémon on the land, POKENAME can race across an entire region in a few hours. As it runs and leaps, it leaves behind flaming hoof-prints in its wake.

entry: POKENAME优雅地游过冰冷海水，寻找冰山，在那里休息，恢复长途游泳消耗的体力。天冷时，会与同群伙伴挤在一起，相互取暖，向周围散发热量。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME gracefully travel through icy waters to find icebergs, where they rest to recover from a lengthy swim. During cold weather, they huddle together with other members of their pod to keep warm, radiating heat to those around them.

entry: 古老传说称，海中生活的族群曾用POKENAME作水下坐骑。心情满足时，水状鬃毛温暖，可以放心触碰；生气时，温度却会骤升至沸点。
author: chibitales
source: Past legends claim that POKENAME were once used as underwater mounts for a sea-dwelling race. The water-like manes of content POKENAME are warm and safe to touch, but when angered, their manes can skyrocket to boiling temperatures.

entry: POKENAME横着跑时，时速可达150英里，向前跑却连每小时1英里都勉强。认真对战时，钳中的火焰会爆发式增长，让钳子看起来比实际大得多。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME can reach speeds of 150 mph when running sideways. However, it can barely reach 1 mph when running forwards. When taking a battle seriously, the flames in its pincers grow exponentially, making the claws look larger than they actually are.

entry: POKENAME在岸边休息，似乎没发现大舌贝喜欢啃吃它的背。有人推测，只有当它意识到大舌贝的存在时，身上的大舌贝才会进化。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME rest along shorelines, not seeming to realize the fact that Shellder enjoy snacking on their backs. It is theorized that the Shellder on a POKENAME will only evolve once the POKENAME realizes it's there.

entry: POKENAME常被称为“水雷”，渔民将它钓起时就会爆炸。即使老练的钓手，也不敢在它的栖息地大意垂钓。
author: melodydelune
source: Often called "The Sea Mine," POKENAME is known to explode when reeled in by fishermen. Even veteran anglers are cautious about fishing in its habitat.

entry: 一窝中的五个成员会懵懵懂懂地咬住彼此尾巴连成一圈，把较聪明的第六个围在中央。外围保护它的身体，它则用超能力保护其他成员。
author: sk372
source: Five of the clutch mindlessly join together by biting their tails, surrounding the smarter sixth member in the center. This protects the center one physically, letting it protect the others with its psychic powers.

entry: POKENAME舌上的唾液含有特殊化合物，一碰到活物便会令其极度困倦。有人推测，这种物质也是它异常懒惰的原因。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME's tongue contains a special compound in its saliva that induces extreme drowsiness when it touches a living thing. This chemical is theorised to be what causes its intense laziness.

entry: 体内气体会让POKENAME麻木、懒散，却也常被用作医疗程序中优良的麻醉剂。
author: mistymagius
source: It produces a gas from inside its body that causes POKENAME to become numb and lethargic. The gas is commonly used as an excellent anesthetic for medical procedures.

entry: POKENAME开始向新的进化阶段蜕变，身体已完全硬化。此时毫无防御能力，便尽量一动不动地藏在河岸藻丛中，直到能从粉色外壳中钻出。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its body has completely hardened as it begins its metamorphosis into a new evolutionary stage. Since in this state it is totally defenseless, POKENAME tries to remain still, hiding among the riverbank algae until it can emerge from its pink shell.

entry: 它的藤蔓像呆呆兽尾巴，会摇晃扭动，诱来小型害兽吃掉。若在战斗中损失几根藤蔓，就会晒太阳，让藤蔓吸收阳光，储备足够能量重新长出。
author: quackquackattack
source: It has vines that resemble Slowpoke tails, which it shakes and wiggles to lure in small vermin to eat. It basks in the sunlight whenever it loses a few vines in battle, which absorb sunlight to store enough energy to regenerate vines.

entry: 它喜欢浮在水面，对周围反应迟钝。偶尔会在雷暴中猛然清醒，发现一个朋友已挨了两次雷击，却没受伤。
author: quackquackattack
source: It is slow to react to its surroundings, as it enjoys floating atop a water's surface. On occasion, it will snap awake during a lightning storm to find one of its friends got zapped twice without getting hurt.

entry: 它反应迟缓，喜欢整天懒洋洋地待着，尤其在不必担心天敌的时候。休息时，鳍会展开成迷人的舞裙般的图案，看起来仿佛仍在游泳。
author: quackquackattack
source: It is slow to react and enjoys lazing about all day, especially when it has no predators to worry about. Its fins spread out in a mesmerizing pattern that looks like a ballroom dress when it rests, giving the illusion that it is swimming.

entry: POKENAME开始向新的进化阶段蜕变，身体已完全硬化。此时毫无防御能力，便尽量一动不动地藏在河岸藻丛中，直到能从粉色外壳中钻出。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its body has completely hardened as it begins its metamorphosis into a new evolutionary stage. Since in this state POKENAME is totally defenseless, it tries to remain still, hiding among the riverbank algae until it can emerge from its pink shell.

entry: 进化后，POKENAME长出四片华美翅膀，能贴着水面飞行。由于心不在焉，常忘记要去哪里，漫无目的地游荡，直到疲倦。
author: fiordaliso
source: After its evolution, POKENAME developed four magnificent wings that allow it to fly just above the water's surface. Since it is very absent-minded, it often forgets where it was heading and wanders aimlessly until it grows tired.

entry: POKENAME有独特的再生能力，是世界许多地方常见的珍馐。尾巴能稳定采收，让厨师能事先安排一天要准备多少食物，尽量减少浪费。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are a common delicacy in many parts of the world because of their unique regenerative properties. The consistent harvesting of their tails allows chefs to plan how much food to prepare for one day while minimizing waste.

entry: 它舞步缓慢却富有节奏，身体回旋摇摆，犹如平静的海浪。这种不经意的舞动很难停下，因此周遭发生变化时，总要很久才会反应过来。
author: quackquackattack
source: It dances at a slow yet rhythmic pace, with the gyration of its body swaying like calm ocean waves. It takes a long time to react to any changes in the environment, as its passive dancing is hard to break from.

entry: POKENAME是已发现的宝可梦中最迟钝的之一。常能见它直直游去，撞上障碍，稍微换个方向，然后一再重复。它消耗的精神和体力都很少，很容易照料。
author: pjporwoll
source: One of the most unaware Pokémon discovered, POKENAME is often witnessed swimming in a straight line, bumping into an obstacle, shifting its course barely, and restarting the cycle. It is easy to care for as it uses little mental or physical energy.

entry: POKENAME过于信任他者，长期遭偷猎者割取大尾巴，留下它迷茫地挣扎游泳。训练家们开始在白海狮群的协助下，守护它们的族群。
author: pjporwoll
source: An overly trusting Pokémon, POKENAME has long been the victim of poachers harvesting its large tail, leaving the confused Pokémon struggling to swim. Trainers have taken to watching over and protecting herds of POKENAME with the aid of Dewgong packs.

entry: POKENAME能用超能力感官察觉埋藏的进化石。但常常还没告诉别人，就已忘记此事，游荡到别处去了。
author: .izik
source: Using psychic senses, POKENAME can detect buried evolution stones. However, it often forgets and wanders off before telling anyone.

entry: POKENAME虽然友善无害，出现在设备上时却会被视为麻烦。它的存在会让设备卡顿，运转得更慢、更不顺畅。
author: sk372
source: Though harmless and friendly, sighting POKENAME on one's devices is considered a nuisance. Its presence causes technology to lag and run at a weaker and slower pace.

entry: POKENAME温柔、亲切，心思单纯。喜欢拥抱人类，载着大家飞来飞去，却经常忘记原本要去哪里，转而漫无目的地飞行。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a loving, gentle, and simple-minded creature. It loves giving people hugs and flying them around, but regularly forgets where it was supposed to go and flies about aimlessly instead.

entry: POKENAME双臂上所谓的“钻头”，外观与呆呆兽尾巴一模一样。常同时用三条附肢钓鱼。若领地遭到侵占，会赶走他者，只是动作有些慢。
author: foolish_weasel
source: The so-called “drills” on its arms are identical in appearance to Slowpoke tails. POKENAME will often fish with all three appendages simultaneously. If its territory is encroached upon it will chase others away, albeit slowly.

entry: 由于体内奇特的化学物质失衡，POKENAME的尾巴似乎从头上而非身后长出。因此风味独特，甜得多，肉质却稍逊柔嫩。
author: mistymagius
source: Due to a strange chemical imbalance in POKENAME's body, its tail seems to grow from its head instead of its rear. The tail has a unique flavor because of this, being a lot sweeter but a little less tender.

entry: 每逢开始季节迁徙，它都会沿着同一道气流，寻找温暖的土地。无论途中遭遇什么干扰，方向感始终很好。
author: quackquackattack
source: Whenever it starts its seasonal migration, it follows the same air current to find warm land each time. No matter what distractions it encounters on its path, it always has a strong sense of direction.

entry: POKENAME一天大半时间都舒展身体，躺在水边晒太阳。走动时，也只是带着安详笑容，以平稳步伐散步。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME spends the majority of the day stretched out sunbathing by the water. When it does move, POKENAME strolls at a steady pace with a peaceful smile.

entry: POKENAME住在潮湿洞穴，在水道附近结网，捕捉各种猎物。宝可梦落网后，它却常没有反应，只看着对方挣扎，最后挣脱。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME makes its home in damp caves, spinning its webs near waterways to catch a variety of prey. It often does not react to Pokémon caught in its web, instead just watching as the captive struggles and eventually breaks free.

entry: 其他鸟宝可梦可能迷路或弄不清方向，它体内的罗盘却总能指引回家。既懂得归巢，也从不忘记别人给予的善意，深受人们喜爱，是相伴一生的宠物。
author: quackquackattack
source: While other bird Pokémon may get confused or lost, it has a strong internal compass that allows it to find the way home. Its ability to return makes it a beloved lifelong pet, as it never forgets kindness given to it.

entry: POKENAME尾巴的白色部分储存着电力，发出噼啪声。乡间城镇的机械师有时会借它搭电启动引擎。
author: .izik
source: The white part of POKENAME's tail crackles with stored electricity. Mechanics in rural towns sometimes use it to jump-start engines.

entry: POKENAME连爬行都力不从心，大部分时间都在冬眠。偶尔睡梦中，沉睡的宇宙力量开始觉醒，身体便会浮起来。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME spends most of its time hibernating, as it doesn't have the strength to even crawl effectively. Occasionally in its sleep, it begins levitating as its dormant cosmic powers begin to awaken.

entry: POKENAME喜欢读书，读得却格外慢。生词往往难倒它，想帮忙的训练家可以翻到词汇表，陪它一起阅读。
author: quackquackattack
source: They enjoy reading books but are remarkably slow at doing so. Trainers who want to help their POKENAME should flip to the glossary section and read alongside them, as unfamiliar words tend to be difficult.

entry: 它随微风飘荡，柔和的气流让它不必应付天敌。很少需要吃东西；饿了便飘落地面，吃一丛草，再跳回气流之中。
author: quackquackattack
source: It is swept through the air on a breeze, the soft zephyrs it floats on remove the need to deal with predators. During the rare times it needs to eat, it floats down to the ground to eat a clump of grass before hopping back up into the air currents.

entry: 花中的养分足够让它一个月不吃东西，只有需要进食时才会离开天空。身体轻盈，自带浮力，能一直留在空中，连睡觉也不例外。
author: quackquackattack
source: Its flower has enough nutrients to last a month without eating, which is the only time it ever comes down from the sky. It is capable of sleeping in the sky because its lightweight body gives them a natural buoyancy that keeps them in the sky.

entry: POKENAME几乎什么都吃，常吞下岸边冲上来的垃圾。它反应太慢，察觉不到危险，是飞行属性宝可梦轻易就能捕获的猎物。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME will eat just about anything, often consuming washed-up trash on the shore. These Pokémon are easy prey for Flying-type Pokémon, their delayed reaction time leaving them unaware of danger.

entry: 它睡在沼泽或湖边的泥里，全年保持凉爽，觅食时也喜欢待在泥地范围内。反应迟钝，连抛来的树果都很难接住。
author: quackquackattack
source: It sleeps in the mud near marshes or lakes to remain cool throughout the year and prefers to stay within the confines of a muddy area when it searches for food. It has slow reaction times, as it struggles to catch berries tossed its way.

entry: 它用泥覆盖身体来降温，尤其在夏日太阳高挂的时候。活动很少，因此很少饿到需要离开泥地觅食。
author: quackquackattack
source: It stays cool by covering itself in mud, especially whenever the sun is high in the sky during the summer months. It is not physically active, so it rarely gets hungry enough to leave a muddy area.

entry: POKENAME较低的脑电波测值，支持了大舌贝冠冕的毒素有助于呆呆王提升智力的说法。它常四下张望、挠头，仿佛察觉自己少了什么，接着却又打起盹来。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME's lower brainwave measurements support the claim that the venom from the Shellder crown aids in Slowking's intelligence boost. It often looks around and scratches its head as if it can tell it is missing something, but then proceeds to nap.

entry: POKENAME夜间潜入民宅寻找食物。由于粗心，尾巴常被捕鼠夹夹住，逃跑时便会脱落。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME will infiltrate homes during the night in search of food. Due to their own carelessness, they often get their tails caught in mouse traps, which detach as they flee.

entry: POKENAME生性顽皮，有时会悬停在道路旁，让驾驶者格外小心。有些地方的市政部门顺势而为，等它们离开后，便在原处竖起正式的警示牌。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME are mischievous and will sometimes hover in place near roadways, triggering extra caution in motorists. Some municipalities have embraced this habit, putting up formal caution signs when they move on.

entry: 这种迟缓的融合体，要很久才能对训练家的指令作出反应，因此不太受欢迎。
author: hophoppip
source: This sluggish fusion takes a long time to react to commands from a Trainer. It's unpopular because of this.

entry: POKENAME爬上洞壁，借足够的高度起飞。不过反应很慢，常常从一面洞壁跃出，撞上另一面，才想起要拍翅膀。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME climb up cave walls to gain enough height to take off into the air. Their reactions are slow, however, and it is not uncommon for them to launch off one wall and crash into the other before it occurs to them to flap their wings.

entry: POKENAME懒洋洋地嚼着眼前的一切：水果、石头，甚至睡着的宝可梦。奇怪的是，被咬的对象过上几分钟，身上的外伤竟会痊愈。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME chews lazily on whatever is in front of it: fruits, rocks, and even sleeping Pokémon. Oddly, those who are bitten actually have their external wounds healed after a few minutes.

entry: POKENAME翅膀小，既飞不远也飞不快，通常留在同一条溪流附近。很少来得及抓住游过的鱼宝可梦，不过偶尔会有鲤鱼王恰好扑腾出水，落在身边。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME cannot fly far or fast with their small wings and usually remain close to the same stream. They are rarely quick enough to catch any fish Pokémon that swim past, but occasionally a Magikarp will flop out of the water right next to them.

entry: 只要有东西想割下它的任何一条尾巴，POKENAME就会从睡梦中蹿起，毫不留情地抓挠对方。攻击一结束，就蜷在最冷的地方睡觉。
author: pjporwoll
source: Whenever something tries to cut off any of its tails, POKENAME springs from its slumber and mercilessly claws the offender. As soon as it is finished attacking, it curls up in the coldest spot and sleeps.

entry: POKENAME很容易被蜂蜜香味吸引，用爪子收集黏稠的蜜。得到之后，却常陶醉于外观和香味，忘了真正吃下去。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is easily attracted to the scent of honey, gathering the thick substance on its paws. It often appears enamored with the look and smell of it, forgetting to actually eat the honey after obtaining it.

entry: POKENAME是熔岩垂钓高手，在几乎没有竞争的环境里捕食。它们只是耐得住火山高温，并非完全不怕热，不过还没察觉这件事。
author: ocxin
source: POKENAME are skilled lava fishers, finding their prey in environments with next to no competition. They are only resistant to the volcanic heat and are not entirely immune; however, they have yet to notice.

entry: POKENAME的壳热得可以当烤炉，用于多种传统烹饪方式。在城都，尤其流行用来料理呆呆兽尾巴。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME shells are hot enough to be used as grills. They are used for many traditional means of cooking, and are particularly popular in Johto for the preparation of Slowpoke tails.

entry: 它观察入微，体内的罗盘也很可靠，能带领同群伙伴而不迷路。春天将临时，会飞回家乡，啄食那些迟迟未醒的虫宝可梦。
author: quackquackattack
source: Its sharp attention to detail and internal compass allow it to guide others in its flock without getting lost. When spring arrives on the horizon, it flies back to its home to pick off bug Pokémon that are slow to wake up.

entry: POKENAME的尾巴分泌甜甜的糖浆，一接触便会变冷。尾巴广泛用于制作雪葩和高级冰淇淋。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's tail secretes a sweet glaze that chills instantly on contact. Its tail is used widely in sorbets and gourmet ice cream.

entry: 它用尾巴在冰冷的水中钓鱼，厚厚的毛皮能保暖。丝毫不在意寒冷，即使被落雪埋住，也仍一动不动。
author: .jerden
source: Its thick coat of fur keeps it warm as it uses its tail to fish in frigid waters. It is so unbothered by the cold that it will remain still as it is buried by falling snow.

entry: POKENAME十分好奇，常坐在人潮拥挤的海滩，观察游客在做什么。失去触手似乎也毫无察觉，反正一两天内又会长出来。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is quite the curious Pokémon, often sitting on crowded beaches to watch what the beachgoers are doing. It doesn't seem to notice when it loses a tentacle as it will regrow again within a day or two.

entry: POKENAME充满爱意，很适合有孩子的家庭饲养，不过学指令很吃力，玩耍时也容易被骗。野外很少抓到猎物，靠运气、残羹剩饭和他者施舍过活。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is very loving and makes a great housepet for families with children, but it struggles with learning commands and is tricked easily when playing. In the wild, POKENAME relies on luck, scraps, and charity to survive as it rarely catches prey.

entry: POKENAME充满爱意，很适合有孩子的家庭饲养，不过学指令很吃力，玩耍时也容易被骗。野外很少抓到猎物，靠运气、残羹剩饭和他者施舍过活。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is very loving and makes a great housepet for families with children, but it struggles with learning commands and is tricked easily when playing. In the wild, POKENAME relies on luck, scraps, and charity to survive as it rarely catches prey.

entry: POKENAME不急不躁地作画，确保作品尽善尽美。尾巴产生的水彩颜料，深受画家追捧。
author: bacondlx
source: POKENAME takes its time to ensure that its paintings are perfect. The watercolor dyes produced by its tail are highly sought after by painters.

entry: POKENAME非常爱美，一有机会就整理头发。也懒得出奇，吃东西都用念动力浮送到嘴里。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME is very vain, always fixing its hair any chance it gets. It is also extremely lazy, using its telekinetic powers to levitate its food into its mouth.

entry: POKENAME大半生都在饱餐后休眠。毒唾液碰到什么都能伤害，借此吓退天敌。
author: danarchist
source: POKENAME spend most of their lives in a post-meal hibernation. They deter predators by secreting a toxic drool that causes harm to anything that touches it.

entry: 受惊时，POKENAME会张开颈伞。上面的图案让袭击者脑中突然充满无聊问题与没想透的念头，愣在原地，一片茫然。
author: sk372
source: When spooked, POKENAME flares its hood, the imagery of which causes attackers to be stunned and confused as their minds are suddenly overwhelmed with inane questions and half-baked thoughts.

entry: POKENAME常察觉不到危险，因为大多数想吃它的宝可梦，都会遭到尾巴强烈的电击。它把尾巴留在水里，等小鱼咬上来被电熟，再吃掉。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is often unaware of danger, as most Pokémon that try to eat it will be met by a powerful electric shock from its tail. It feeds on small fish, keeping its tail in the water until something bites it and becomes fried.

entry: POKENAME是健忘的鸟宝可梦，有时连自己吃过没有都忘了。因此几乎总停在河边的石头或枝条上，用尾巴钓水生宝可梦吃。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are rather forgetful bird Pokémon that may even forget if they have already eaten. Because of this, they are almost always perched atop rocks or sticks near rivers and use their tails to fish for aquatic Pokémon to eat.

entry: POKENAME虽能自由穿越时间，却很难分辨不同年代，因此鲜少能用这种力量帮助别人。
author: hophoppip
source: Though POKENAME is freely able to travel through time, it struggles to tell the difference between different time periods, so it's rarely able to use its powers to help others.

entry: POKENAME的尾巴是一道美味。它们常因想吃自己的尾巴而将其咬断，也是当地动作最慢的宝可梦之一。
author: rooboid
source: POKENAME tails are a delicacy. They are known to dock their own tails by trying to eat them and are named one of the region's slowest Pokémon.

entry: 挖洞前，POKENAME会朝洞壁喷水，使其软化。隧道延伸数英里，但以它的速度，可能要挖上多年才完工。
author: .izik
source: Before digging, POKENAME spits water on cave walls to soften them. Its tunnels stretch for miles but may take years to complete due to its pace.

entry: 它飞过海滩和湖泊，寻找最佳钓鱼地点。会远远跟着钓客，再找附近一处位置，开始钓鱼。
author: quackquackattack
source: It flies around beaches and lakes to look for the best place to catch fish. It stalks fishers from a distance before it settles in a nearby spot to begin fishing.

entry: POKENAME长时间把尾巴泡在水里，有时好几周不动。等藻类长得茂盛了，才开始把尾巴送向嘴边。
author: pastapockets
source: POKENAME soaks its tail in the water for long periods of time, sometimes not moving for weeks. Once a healthy bloom of algae has grown, POKENAME will begin the process of bringing its tail to its mouth.

entry: POKENAME在河岸打盹，尾巴像钓线一样垂在水中。一有东西咬住尾尖，就会惊叫着醒来，喷出火焰，边逃离水边，边把钓到的猎物拖上岸。
author: kittenthepiratekat
