source: POKENAME naps along riverbanks with its tail resting in the water like a fishing line. When something bites the tip, it wakes with a startled cry, spews flames, and drags its catch onto shore as it runs away from the water.

entry: POKENAME藏在沙质海床里，只露出背上的刺，只有猎物游得太近时才会现身。蜷成球后，就无法逆流游泳，会被水流带离海岸。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME hides in the sandy seabed, leaving only the spines on its back exposed. It surfaces only when prey swims too close. When it curls into a ball, it loses the ability to swim against the current and is carried away from the shore.

entry: 晴天时，POKENAME会变得烦躁。尾巴亮起鲜蓝色光芒，随后朝一切靠得太近的对象吐泥。
author: .izik
source: On sunny days, POKENAME grows irritable. Its tail glows bright blue before it spits mud at anything that gets too close.

entry: POKENAME不太会用变色适应环境，离开某处很久后，才变成那里的颜色。许多天敌反而不碰它，担心伪装这么差，是因为吃下去会有剧毒。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME's ability to change its color to match its environment is poorly executed, changing colors long after it has left the associated location. Many predators leave it alone, fearing the poor camouflage is due to it being highly toxic to eat.

entry: 很多人说POKENAME不太聪明。不过，也有报告称，曾见它使用简单工具获取食物。
author: kitarchen
source: Many have claimed that POKENAME are not very smart. However, reports have been made of POKENAME being spotted using basic tools to acquire food.

entry: POKENAME身上带着独特的气味，闻起来正是煎烤过的呆呆兽尾巴。只要有谁靠得太近，它就会显形，发出强力的水之波动。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME's body carries a specific smell, specifically of seared Slowpoke Tail. For any that get too close, POKENAME manifests to unleash a powerful Water Pulse at them.

entry: POKENAME将嘴状附肢垂入水中，等鱼咬钩。不过，这张嘴没有味蕾，钓上不能吃的东西也常察觉不到。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME uses its mouth-like appendage to hunt for fish, dangling it into the water and waiting for a bite. However, since its mouth has no tastebuds, it will often not notice if it has caught something inedible.

entry: POKENAME在水下挥动甜甜的触手，引来猎物。不必离开休息处，就能同时抓住多达八只宝可梦。
author: hophoppip
source: From underwater, POKENAME waves its sweet tentacles to draw in prey. It can catch up to eight individual Pokémon at once without leaving the spot where it rests.

entry: POKENAME懒又不聪明，曾被见到不去找食物，反吃自己尾巴。好在肢体能完全再生，不会留下长久的伤害。
author: sontyp
source: Lazy and not terribly intelligent, POKENAME have been observed trying to eat their own tails instead of gathering food. Since their limbs regenerate fully, there is no lasting damage from this behavior.

entry: POKENAME的力量潜能远超智力。心思过于简单，始终无法发挥真正的能力，但仍在湖边快乐地独居，过着安静的日子，毫不在意自身局限。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's potential power vastly outstrips its intellect. Because of its simple mind, it can never activate its true abilities, but it happily lives a quiet life of solitude near lakes, unfazed by its own limits.

entry: POKENAME背上会不断长出球果。它似乎总把这事忘了，每次球果掉落都会吃一惊。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME continuously grows Apricorns along their backs. POKENAME seems to always forget about this, as they are surprised each time the Apricorn falls off.

entry: POKENAME在湖中漫无目的地漂游，细小鳞片在阳光下闪耀。训练家常一路跟随，只为一睹它光彩照人的身体。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME drifts aimlessly through lakes, its tiny scales shimmering in sunlight. Trainers often follow just to glimpse its radiant body.

entry: 用众多缎带状触角捕鱼。触角即使断掉也会很快再生，POKENAME并不会感到疼痛。
author: melodydelune
source: It uses its multitude of ribbonlike feelers to fish. If their ribbons break off, they will regrow quickly, and POKENAME will feel no pain.

entry: POKENAME懒散地待在海滩和岛屿上，用带倒钩的尾巴捕鱼。若遭打扰，会暴怒大闹，决意毁掉打断自己休息的家伙。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME lazes on beaches and islands, catching fish with its barbed tail. If disturbed, it furiously rampages, intent on destroying the one that interrupted its rest.

entry: POKENAME拥有以强大念动力移动大地的力量。它却拿这股力量改造地面，打造最合心意的午睡场所。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME possesses the power to move the earth through potent psychokinesis. It uses this power to reshape the ground into the perfect napping spot.

entry: POKENAME在大气中漫无目的地漂浮，降下后把尾巴伸入海中，捕捉海洋生物吃。有时忘了吃上钩的猎物，反而让它们挂在尾巴上，一同被带往高空。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME aimlessly floats around the atmosphere, descending to dip its tail in the ocean to catch sea life to eat. It sometimes forgets to actually eat hooked creatures, instead carrying them high up into the air while attached to its tail.

entry: POKENAME侵入他人的梦并吞食，能力也会稍稍扰乱心智。遭它袭击的人醒来后头脑昏沉，失去部分记忆。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME invades the dreams of others to consume them, its powers wreaking a bit of havoc on the mind. Those attacked by it wake up with their minds hazy and some of their memories missing.

entry: POKENAME有少许宇宙力量，能让小物件浮起来。这样很耗体力，因此通常都在休息和进食，恢复力量。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME possesses a slight cosmic power, able to levitate small objects. This uses a lot of energy, so it is mostly found resting and eating to recover its strength.

entry: POKENAME懒得出奇，会钻进电子设备里无所事事。它一来，设备就慢得令人难受，许多人因此觉得很烦。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME is notably lazy and seeks electronic devices to loaf about in. Many people find it a nuisance, as its presence causes these devices to run painfully slow.

entry: POKENAME有六条尾尖甜甜的尾巴，捕鱼效率高得多。靠这种进食方式，能一连几天不离开钓鱼地点。
author: hophoppip
source: With six sweet-tipped tails, it's able to fish for food much more efficiently. Thanks to this feeding strategy, POKENAME can go days without leaving its fishing spot.

entry: 它主要过着久坐少动的生活。饿得需要进食时，便弹出内脏，捕猎来到附近的一切。
author: quackquackattack
source: It is primarily a sedentary species, as it does not move often. Whenever it gets hungry and needs to eat, it ejects its inner organs to hunt anything that comes nearby.

entry: POKENAME感受到附近的幸福时，尾巴和耳朵便会分泌浅色薄膜。在神奥，这种稀有物质被用来制作精致甜点。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME senses happiness nearby, it secretes a pale film from its tail and ears. In Sinnoh, this rare substance is used in fine desserts.

entry: POKENAME常躺在海边数日，眼睛一眨不眨，引来各种猜测，想知道它究竟在等着看什么。后来科学家证实，它只是睡觉时忘了闭眼，这些说法便全落空了。
author: lordjoostmeister
source: POKENAME's habit of lying by the sea for days, staring unblinkingly, gave rise to many theories about what it could be watching for. These theories were dashed when scientists proved that POKENAME simply forgets to close its eyes when sleeping.

entry: POKENAME在河岸打盹，毛发带着静电，嗡嗡作响。风暴期间火花更强，有时会把自己电醒。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME naps along riverbanks, its fur humming with static. The sparks grow stronger during storms and sometimes jolt it awake.

entry: POKENAME记性短，认知能力也低。住在河流和其他水域附近，常见它随波漂流，对正在发生的事浑然不觉。
author: heal_fire
source: POKENAME have short term memory and low cognitive abilities. They live close to rivers and around of water, and are often seen drifting with the currents, unaware of what is happening.

entry: POKENAME整天在绿洲钓鱼觅食。等候时常会睡着，直到身体向后滑入水中才醒来。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME spend their days fishing in oases for food. They often fall asleep while they wait, only waking up when they've slid backwards into the water.

entry: POKENAME在饮食和行为上都不难照料，被视为适合新手饲养的水生宠物。许多孩子觉得，它从水缸里回望自己的呆滞目光可爱极了。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is considered a good beginner's aquatic pet due to being very low maintenance in both food and behavior. Many children find its vacant stare gazing back at them through a tank incredibly endearing.

entry: POKENAME总在危及自己。尾巴上的火一灭就会死，却偏偏老想用尾巴钓鱼。训练家必须时时看顾，幸好它做什么都不快。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME is a constant danger to itself. If the fire on its tail goes out it dies, but it constantly desires to try to go fishing with it. Trainers need have constant supervision over POKENAME, though thankfully it doesn't do anything quickly.

entry: POKENAME一天大半时间都坐在海滩晒太阳。阳光帮助生长，也让卷曲附肢的气味更加甜美。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME spend most of the day sitting in the sunlight on beaches. The light helps them grow and sweetens the smell of their curled-up appendages.

entry: POKENAME飘游各地，没精打采地望着地平线。因为心不在焉，常被电线缠住，需要别人帮忙解开。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME stares listlessly at the horizon while floating through the world. It gets caught in power lines because of its inattention and frequently needs help to get untangled.

entry: POKENAME飞累后，会隐去身形，落在其他生灵头上休息。被它当作栖木的对象会头脑昏沉，很难清楚思考。
author: sk372
source: When POKENAME tires of flying, it turns invisible and rests itself on the head of another creature. Those currently serving as POKENAME's perch feel their minds become clouded and find it difficult to think straight.

entry: 传闻吃下过多POKENAME分泌的白色甜膜，会看见超能力幻象。虽然没有证实过的案例，超能力者们的需求量仍然很高。
author: .izik
source: The sweet white film POKENAME secretes is rumored to cause psychic visions when consumed in excess. No verified cases exist, but demand remains high among Psychics.

entry: POKENAME用微弱的超能力探查周围。但定位物体需要一点时间，因此必须飞得特别慢，才不会撞上去。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME uses its weak psychic powers to navigate its surroundings. However, it takes a bit of time to locate things, so POKENAME has to fly incredibly slowly to avoid bumping into them.

entry: 它用尾巴在黑暗洞穴中捕捉水生宝可梦，甩动尾巴吸引注意。一钓到猎物，就迅速拍翅，把它拉出水面，再扔到附近石头上。
author: quackquackattack
source: It catches aquatic Pokémon inside dark caves with its tail, which it flicks to draw attention to itself. Once it catches another Pokémon, it rapidly flaps its wings to pull its prey out of the water before dropping it onto a nearby rock.

entry: POKENAME拖着尾巴追逐猎物，步履笨拙，踉踉跄跄。尽管颚部有力，却是宝可梦中捕猎效率最低的之一。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME stumbles awkwardly while pursuing prey, dragging its tail behind. Though its jaws are strong, it is one of the least efficient hunters among Pokémon.

entry: 它吃素，需要一种只有海藻才能提供的特殊养分，因此必须潜入水下，才能保证饮食完整。采海藻时若需要逃离危险，会用能脱落的尾巴给天敌下毒。
author: quackquackattack
source: Its herbivorous diet requires a special nutrient only seaweed can provide, which means it needs to dive underwater to have a complete diet. Whenever it needs to escape danger while seaweed gathering, it poisons the predator using its removable tail.

entry: POKENAME步子缓慢笨拙，常跟不上节拍。即便如此，也从不放弃，从头到尾都跳得开开心心。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME moves with slow, clumsy steps and often falls behind the rhythm. Even so, it never gives up and dances with a joyful spirit from start to finish.

entry: POKENAME跳舞时，过大的羽冠常垂到眼前，害它绊倒。为了不跌跤，只迈缓慢而小心的舞步。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME's oversized feather crown often falls over its eyes while dancing and causes it trip. To avoid stumbling, it sticks to slow and cautious steps.

entry: POKENAME跳舞极慢，乍看几乎纹丝不动。唯有通过延时摄影，才能充分欣赏它舞蹈真正的复杂之处。
author: staghorn
source: POKENAME's dance is extremely slow, appearing almost completely stationary at a glance. The true complexity of its dance can only be properly appreciated via time-lapse photography.

entry: POKENAME常在没有音乐时跳舞。研究者认为，它动作太慢，还在回应几天前听到的音乐。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME often dances when no music is being played. Researchers believe its movements are so delayed that it's still reacting to music it heard days ago.

entry: 它借洋流引导方向，轻松游遍世界各地的海洋。不过反应缓慢，因此也会撞上障碍。
author: quackquackattack
source: It swims effortlessly through the oceans of the world by using underwater currents to guide where it swims. At the same time, it has a slow reaction time, which causes it to bump into obstacles.

entry: POKENAME缓缓游过河流，常吓得天敌宝可梦不敢袭击角金鱼。它会吞下比自己小的一切，但只攻击游到眼前的对象。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME slowly swim through rivers, often intimidating predator Pokémon from attacking Goldeen. POKENAME devour anything smaller than themselves, but will only attack what swims in front of them.

entry: 比起森林里的树桩，POKENAME更喜欢雾气弥漫的沼泽树桩，常附身其中睡觉。整天在附近水洼打滚，吸取水分。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME prefers the stumps found in foggy swamps over those of the forest, and often possesses them to sleep. It rolls in the puddles nearby to soak up water throughout the day.

entry: 它把多条尾巴垂进水中钓猎，常能见到POKENAME身上同时挂着好几份收获。
author: holgast
source: It dangles its many tails into the water to catch prey. It's not uncommon to see a POKENAME with several catches hanging from it.

entry: POKENAME打盹时若被打扰，会从头上巨大的花瓣喷出毒孢子。懒惰至极，宁愿什么都不想，漂在水里，也不愿与他者战斗。
author: fiordaliso
source: If disturbed while dozing, POKENAME puffs poisonous spores from the enormous petals on its head. It is an extremely lazy Pokémon that would rather float in the water without a single thought in mind than fight with others.

entry: 它的接缝很容易裂开，因此喜欢待在同一处休息。不过，训练家把它抱起来后，至少要过十秒才会意识到自己被移动了。
author: quackquackattack
source: It prefers to rest in one spot because its seams rip easily. Yet, whenever its Trainer picks it up, it takes at least ten seconds before it realizes it has been moved.

entry: 训练家把它抱起来后，至少要过五秒才会意识到自己被移动了。然后会四处找尾巴，确认仍连在身上。
author: quackquackattack
source: Whenever a Trainer picks it up, it takes at least five seconds before it realizes it has been moved. Afterwards, it looks around for its tail to ensure it remains attached to its body.

entry: 触手上的尖刺能给靠得太近的对象注入毒液，帮助抵御天敌。虽然总要过一会儿才知道自己遇险，也算有了弥补。
author: quackquackattack
source: The spines across its tentacles help it defend against predators, as it injects venom into anything that comes too close. This offsets the fact that it takes a while to recognize that it is in danger.

entry: 每条触手都长着尖刺，刺内充满腐蚀性的毒液。神志不清或尚未完全醒来时，会用触手围成盾牌，缩在里面。
author: quackquackattack
source: It has spines across each of its tentacles, each filled with a caustic, venomous liquid. When it is not lucid or otherwise entirely awake, it bunkers down by forming a shield with its tentacles.

entry: 它几乎不离开海滩，耐心等待鱼和其他海洋生物被冲上岸，再用手上的刺抓住滑溜的猎物。
author: mistymagius
source: It barely ever moves from the beach as it patiently waits for fish and other sea creatures to wash up on shore. It uses the thorns on its hands to grab its slippery prey.

entry: POKENAME在海滩尝试用超能力诱饵捕猎。不过，常常忘记自己在干什么，捕到一半就睡着了。
author: .izik
source: On beaches, POKENAME attempts to hunt using psychic lures. However, it often forgets what it's doing and falls asleep mid-hunt.

entry: POKENAME背上长着形似呆呆兽尾巴的蘑菇。吃下后，会失去过去几小时的记忆。
author: sk372
source: Mushrooms similar in appearance to Slowpoke tails grow on POKENAME's back. Consuming these mushrooms causes the eater to lose their memories of the last few hours.

entry: POKENAME游得极慢，鳍看起来几乎没动。它不慌不忙，平静地漂向目的地。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME swims so slowly that its fins barely appear to move. It drifts calmly toward its destination without urgency.

entry: POKENAME头上的白色鳞片会渗出黏甜的糖浆。丰缘各地的糕点师每月采集，用来制作上等甜食。
author: .izik
source: The white scale on POKENAME's head leaks a sticky sweet syrup. Pastry chefs across Hoenn harvest it monthly for elite confections.

entry: POKENAME常在水下湖泊出现，用尾巴钓小型海洋生物。身上的蓝斑其实是片片结晶，在暗处闪烁发光。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME is often found in underwater lakes, fishing for small sea life with its tail. The blue spots on its body are actually patches of crystal that glint and glow in dark areas.

entry: POKENAME覆着粉末的触角会释放精神能量，让周围的对象忽略它。可惜，一分心信号就会中断，而它经常分心。
author: .izik
source: The powder-coated antennae on POKENAME release psychic energy that causes those nearby to overlook it. Unfortunately this signal is interrupted whenever it loses focus, which happens frequently.

entry: POKENAME看守南瓜田，反应却实在太慢。想朝小偷喷水，往往对方早已逃远，它才射了个空。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME guards pumpkin patches but reacts far too slowly. It tries to spray water at thieves but often misses them long after they've escaped.

entry: POKENAME的毛有桃桃果香，好吃得危险。据吃过的对象说，之后整天都会行动迟缓、昏昏欲睡。
author: .izik
source: The Pecha Berry-scented fur of POKENAME is dangerously delicious. Those who eat it report feeling sluggish and drowsy for an entire day.

entry: POKENAME把带着甜香的尾巴稍稍露出水面，引来好奇的鸟宝可梦，再用吸取耗去它们的能量。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME leaves its tail poking just above the water, coated in a sweet scent. Curious bird Pokémon are lured close, then drained with Absorb.

entry: POKENAME想用火焰尾巴抽打他者，挑起争斗。不过动作实在太慢，很容易就能躲开。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME tries to whack others with its flaming tail in an effort to start a fight. Because it moves so slowly, it is pretty easy to move out of the way.

entry: POKENAME懒得游泳，经常被冲到海滩上。心思单纯，常会跟着其他宝可梦走。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are too lazy to swim, so they end up washing up along the beach a lot. Because of its simple-minded nature, it will often follow other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME发现有人困在洞穴时，会尝试帮忙脱身。可它反应太慢，常逼得受困者只好自己找出路。
author: .izik
source: If POKENAME finds someone trapped in a cave, it attempts to help them escape. Its slow reactions often force the trapped individual to find their own way out.

entry: POKENAME虽然会在阳光下变虚弱，却能毫无察觉地一晒数小时。行动极慢，在地下也常分心。
author: equation8573
source: Even though POKENAME becomes weak in sunlight, it can sit in the sun for hours without any awareness. It moves very slowly and often loses focus while underground.

entry: 据说吃POKENAME的尾巴有益大脑健康。它有着引人入神的超能力，却连自己拥有这种力量都不知道。
author: mistymagius
source: It is said that eating POKENAME's tail helps improve your brain health. It has immersive psychic capabilities, even though POKENAME has no idea it even has psychic powers.

entry: 长尾巴让它捕猎很轻松，越长就越能有力地把猎物从水中甩到附近石头上。它倾向建立每天的固定作息，因此每日都选那几处钓鱼地点。
author: quackquackattack
source: Its long tail makes catching prey easy, as the longer the tail the more force it can use to whisk prey from the water onto a nearby rock. It chooses the same few spots every day, as it has an inclination towards forming a daily schedule.

entry: POKENAME总是一脸无聊，看起来冷漠疏远。烦躁地翕动鼻孔时，会释放一股精神能量，让其他对象自觉别来打扰。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a perpetually bored expression that make them seem aloof and distant. Whenever they flare their nostrils in frustration, they release a pulse of psychic energy that encourages others to leave them alone.

entry: 水通常太冷，不适合POKENAME，它却很难忍住不跳进去。终于顺从心意下水后，水的刺激就会让它生病。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME has a hard time not jumping into water despite the fact that it is usually too cold for it. When it finally acquiesces and jumps into water, the shock of the water causes it to get sick.

entry: 油不断从尾巴渗出，一接触空气，几乎立刻就会燃烧。听说，要是有办法收集起来，尝着会非常甜。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Oil seeps out from its tail constantly. Exposure to the air causes it to ignite almost instantly. Apparently the oil, if collected somehow, is very sweet to the taste.

entry: 它体型小，又爱大口吃藻类，家庭水族爱好者很喜欢把它养进大鱼缸。它在缸内漂游，只要醒着，就不停地顺口吃藻。
author: quackquackattack
source: Due to its small size and its voracious appetite for algae, people with home aquariums love to have it as a part of a large tank of fish. It floats around a tank and passively eats algae every moment it is awake.

entry: 它友善又能帮忙，是家庭鱼缸中受欢迎的宠物。一起住的宝可梦生病时，会敲击缸壁，引起主人注意，寻求帮助。
author: quackquackattack
source: It is a popular pet for home aquariums because it is both friendly and helpful to have around. Whenever another Pokémon gets sick, it taps against the glass to get help and attention from its owners.

entry: 它住在家庭鱼缸或其他大型水生住所中，四处巡视，照顾同住的宝可梦。性情温柔和善，很容易与新搬来的宝可梦成为朋友。
author: quackquackattack
source: It lives in home aquariums or other large aquatic homes, and roams around the space to take care of the Pokémon that it lives with. Its gentle and soft demeanor allows it to easily make friends with the Pokémon that join its home.

entry: POKENAME睁着眼睡觉，让人随时都难以分辨它究竟是睡是醒。每天清醒的六小时，也往往只是茫然地盯着前方。
author: pattybgoode
source: Since POKENAME sleeps with its eyes open, it is difficult to tell whether POKENAME is asleep or awake at any given moment. For the six hours a day it is awake, it tends to merely stare vacantly.

entry: 许多野生POKENAME喜欢陪孩子上学，觉得沿途活动身体很舒心。虽然动作慢，却常偷偷溜进健身房，用跑步机锻炼。
author: beetlething
source: Many wild POKENAME enjoy accompanying children on their way to school, finding the exercise that comes with it to be soothing. Though rather slow, POKENAME often sneak into gyms to use the treadmills.

entry: POKENAME总忘记自己在做什么，因此在训练家眼里显得冷淡。记性太短，也让它飞行时容易撞上其他宝可梦。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME appear aloof to their Trainers because they constantly forget what they are doing. This short-term memory causes them to bump into other Pokémon while they are flying.

entry: 它把水生宝可梦引近，再用长尾巴一把拽出水面。只要咬了钩，就会把猎物塞进大嘴，在硕大的胃里消化。
author: quackquackattack
source: It fishes for aquatic Pokémon by luring prey close before yanking them out of the water with its long tail. When it catches a bite, it stuffs the morsel into its maw to digest in its large stomach.

entry: POKENAME的触手会渗出黏稠、滋味酸涩的物质，让舌头刺痛。极少数过敏反应会使人倦怠好几个小时。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's tentacles ooze a sticky, tangy substance that stings the tongue. Rare allergic reactions cause hours of lethargy.

entry: POKENAME性情悠闲，常被用来教幼童骑乘宝可梦。时速可达150英里，却很少肯多走几步。
author: periperi_chicken
source: Due to their relaxed nature, POKENAME is often used to teach young children how to ride Pokémon. They can move up to 150mph, but rarely bother moving more than a few steps.

entry: 融合让POKENAME的超能力增强到原来的四倍。可惜，智力没能获得同样的提升。
author: westerlytrack45
source: POKENAME's psychic abilities have quadrupled thanks to fusion. Unfortunately, its intelligence has not had the same effect.

entry: POKENAME精通用尾巴钓鱼宝可梦，还会释放少量超能力，协助捕捉较大的猎物。脱落的尾巴蛋白质丰富，在世界许多地区被视为高档食材。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME has mastered catching fish Pokémon with its tail, using small bursts of psychic power to aid in catching bigger prey. A shed tail from POKENAME is considered a luxury food item in many parts of the world because of its high protein.

entry: 它的智力退化，变得不爱动弹，几乎没有感知能力。一动不动的身体上长着真菌，却仍会本能地散发精神能量，抵御外来刺激。
author: sk372
source: Its intelligence has degraded to the point it has become sedentary and barely sentient. Fungi grow on its immobile body, which still radiates an instinctive psychic energy to defend itself from outside stimuli.

entry: 融合让POKENAME的智力略有提高。如今不再用尾巴，而是制作简陋鱼竿，钓大舌贝和其他水生生物吃。
author: sk372
source: Fusion has given POKENAME a marginal increase in intellect. Instead of using its tail, it now fashions crude fishing poles in order to fish up Shellder and other aquatic life to feed on.

entry: 发生领地争执时，POKENAME吵到一半就会忘记缘由。多数争端以双方都睡在池塘边告终，纠纷却还没解决。
author: .izik
source: When territory disputes arise, POKENAME forgets about it mid-argument. Most disputes end with both sides asleep near ponds, the quarrel unresolved.

entry: POKENAME皮肤上的痛觉感受器很少，因此很少觉得疼。寒冷月份里，连身体开始结冰都不会察觉。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's skin has very few pain receptors, so it very rarely feels pain. During the colder months, POKENAME won't even notice its own body starting to freeze over.

entry: POKENAME睡觉时几乎将全身埋入积雪，只露出部分脸来呼吸。虽然总是睡眼惺忪，却很擅长用水属性招式自卫。
author: fiordaliso
source: To sleep, POKENAME almost completely buries itself in the snowfall, leaving only part of its face exposed to breathe. Despite its perpetually sleepy demeanor, it is very skilled at using its Water-type Moves to defend itself.

entry: 有些人用POKENAME清除湖中的毒属性宝可梦，因为它黏糊糊的尾巴有让它们无法抗拒的滋味。被咬也没感觉，只为自己帮上了忙而高兴。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is used by some to remove Poison Pokémon from lakes, as POKENAME's goopy tail has a taste those types find irresistible. POKENAME doesn't feel the bites, so it's simply happy to be helpful.

entry: POKENAME漫无目的地蠕动，身体变出各种形状和大小。因为总忘记自己原本的样子，只能凭不准确的记忆重塑。
author: sk372
source: As POKENAME oozes about aimlessly, it forms itself into a variety of shapes and sizes. This is because it easily forgets what it's supposed to look like, reshaping based on faulty memories.

entry: 它再也无法用尾巴钓鱼，只能拖着壳爬行，寻找草或树果吃。硕大的壳包住两条后腿，让它移动艰难。
author: quackquackattack
source: It drags its shell behind it as it crawls around to find grass or berries to eat, as it can no longer fish with its tail. It struggles to move around because its large shell covers both of its hind legs.

entry: POKENAME会对成绩不好的学生恶作剧。最好的制止方法就是问它一个问题，它便会停下来，一想就是好几天。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME play mischievous pranks on students who don't perform well academically. The best way to stop their pranks is to ask them a question, at which point POKENAME stop and think for days at a time.

entry: POKENAME在他者眼前摆动钟摆，试图催眠对方。可惜心思太简单，常被自己摆动的动作吸引，反把自己催眠了。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME attempts to hypnotize others by swinging its pendulum in front of them. Unfortunately, its simple mind causes it to often get distracted by its own swinging, hypnotizing itself instead.

entry: POKENAME的钳子快得惊人，能一下夹住猎物，紧抓不放。却常忘记自己为什么要抓，最后把大部分餐食放回了野外。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's pincers can move surprisingly quickly, snapping onto potential prey and gripping tightly. It often forgets why it grabbed something, however, and releases most of its meals back into the wild.

entry: 背甲顶部向上隆起，形成一个孔洞，看起来像洋葱。能从洞里喷出间歇泉般的水柱。
author: soup1900
source: The top of its shell rises upwards and forms a hole on top, causing it to resemble an onion. It can eject water from that hole like a geyser.

entry: POKENAME朝天敌眼睛喷水，再躲入壳中。紧急时，也能喷出一股水，把自己推离危险。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME squirts water into the eyes of a predator before hiding in its shell. In a pinch, it can also squirt a burst of water to propel itself away.

entry: POKENAME喜欢在水力发电厂安家，令那里的工程师头疼。它们受扰时容易爆炸，可能损坏精密设备。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are drawn to make their homes in hydroelectric power plants. Their presence is problematic for the engineers working there as they are prone to exploding when disturbed, risking damage to the sensitive equipment.

entry: POKENAME喜欢在水力发电厂安家，令那里的工程师头疼。它们受扰时容易爆炸，可能损坏精密设备。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are drawn to make their homes in hydroelectric power plants. Their presence is problematic for the engineers working there as they are prone to exploding when disturbed, risking damage to the sensitive equipment.

entry: POKENAME用伸出壳外的翅膀，以惊人速度在水中追逐其他水生宝可梦，追上就爆炸。一些游戏开发者观察这种行为后，得到灵感，设计了游戏中的敌人。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME swim after other aquatic Pokémon at surprising speed using the wings poking out of their shell, exploding once they catch them. Some game developers have observed this behaviour and taken inspiration from them for enemies in their games.

entry: POKENAME头上的颅骨覆上毛发，变得结实，足以抵御打击。从某种意义上说，颅骨已成了它身体的一部分。
author: 0reomilka
source: The skull on POKENAME's head has been covered with fur, making it solid enough to protect it from blows. In a way, the skull has become part of its body.

entry: POKENAME已经不需要龟壳，因为学会了躲进颅骨里。这种适应方式，常让人误以为它只是个被丢弃的头骨。
author: 0reomilka
source: POKENAME no longer needs a shell, having developed the ability to hide within its skull instead. This adaptation often leads people to mistake it for nothing more than a discarded skull.

entry: POKENAME吹出泡泡，踢向敌人，化作遍布战场的危险弹丸。不战斗或训练时，会细心打理飘逸的鬃毛，那是同类间地位的象征。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME blows bubbles and then kicks them at foes to create hazardous projectiles around the battlefield. When not fighting or training, it takes meticulous care of its flowing mane of hair, which is a mark of prestige among the species.

entry: POKENAME射出一束结实的泡泡，让它们在周围表面反弹，再练习闪躲、格挡或出拳击打。坚硬的壳在战斗中提供保护，让它能安全地挥拳攻击由危险物质构成的对手。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME trains by launching a beam of robust bubbles to bounce off of surrounding surfaces, then dodging, blocking, or punching the bubbles. Its tough shell has covered it in fights, allowing it to safely punch opponents made of hazardous materials.

entry: POKENAME喝下受污染的水，滤去毒素，再以蒸汽排出净水。寿命很长，一只就能让一口池塘多年保持洁净。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME consumes polluted water, filters out the toxins, and expels the purified water as steam. Due to its long lifespan, a single POKENAME can keep a pond clean for years.

entry: POKENAME始终让外壳保持坚硬，既保护敏感身体，又不限制活动。会将身体缩入壳里躲避天敌，再喷水推动自己逃脱。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME keep their external shells hardened at all times to protect their sensitive bodies without restricting their movement. They tuck their bodies into their shells to hide from predators, propelling themselves with water to escape.

entry: 它用钻石般坚硬的角钻开瀑布后的岩壁，开凿巢穴。身体有厚壳保护，逐渐发展出重防御、轻进攻的战法。
author: fiordaliso
source: It uses its diamond-hard horn to drill through the rock faces behind waterfalls, carving out its den. Thanks to the thick shell protecting its body, it has developed a fighting style focused far more on defense than offense.

entry: POKENAME覆着毛发的鳍，颜色随年龄增长愈发鲜艳。结合硬壳与尖角，能轻易冲破溪河中挡路的坚硬障碍。
author: infinex21
source: The colors of their fur-clad fins become more vibrant with age. By combining the hardness of its shell with the sharpness of its horn, a POKENAME can easily break through hard obstacles in its way within streams and rivers.

entry: 飞行属性宝可梦想轻松吃一口，常来骚扰POKENAME。为了不沦为餐食，它会扬沙迷住对方双眼，把它们吓退。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are often harassed by Flying-type Pokémon who are looking for an easy bite. To avoid becoming another meal, POKENAME kick up sand into the eyes of Flying-type Pokémon to scare them away.

entry: 围绕POKENAME的古老传说称，它从星空坠落，降入海洋，在此安家。核心那颗带翼宝石被拿来佐证，认为那便是它飞行的工具。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Ancient legends surrounding POKENAME suggest that they fell from the stars, landing in the ocean and making their new home there. The winged gem at their core was used as evidence of this, suggested as their means of flight.

entry: POKENAME制造滚烫的水旋涡，威慑对手。会把卵产在温泉池深处。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME creates whirlpools made of scalding water to deter any opponents. It lays its eggs deep within thermal pools.

entry: POKENAME依靠喷水吓退天敌。能喷出阵阵水流，打在头顶树枝上，惊吓鸟宝可梦。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME relies on its water squirting abilities to scare away predators. It can shoot bursts of water to hit branches above itself, which startles bird Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME能不休息地横渡整片海洋，因此需要水运货物时，是可靠的帮手。以亲切的性情与格外勤劳而闻名。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are capable of crossing an entire ocean without rest, making them reliable creatures when people need to ferry goods across water. They are known for their amiable nature and superb diligence.

entry: POKENAME一接触水就能完美融入其中，悄悄靠近猎物。接近时，依靠蓬松耳朵与柔软尾巴急转方向。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME blend seamlessly into water as soon as they make contact, allowing them to sneak up on prey. POKENAME rely on their fluffy ears and soft tail to make sharp turns as they close the distance.

entry: POKENAME白鬃由超热蒸汽构成，一碰就会造成二度烫伤。精巧的耳朵，还能感知气压与湿度变化。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME white mane is made of super-hot water vapor that will cause second-degree burns on contact. Its delicate ears are able to sense differences in air pressure and humidity.

entry: 吃硬件前，POKENAME会先喷上浓缩的水。湿气让设备无法再供人使用，却让它吃起来更加可口。
author: .izik
source: Before consuming hardware, POKENAME sprays it with concentrated water. The moisture ruins the device for humans but makes it more palatable to POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME体型太大，外面的茧装不下，耳朵和尾巴都露在壳外。即便如此，从壳缝喷出的水流仍能阻止天敌吃掉它。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are too big for the cocoon that surrounds itself, so its ears and tail remain on the outside of the shell. Despite this, the bursts of water that come out of the shell's crevices stop predators from consuming it.

entry: POKENAME的化石出现在山顶，所在的地层距今超过5亿年。如今的融合体与化石几乎没有变化，生活在海洋，依靠甲壳保护自己。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME fossils are found on mountaintops, as the strata that they are found in date back over 500 million years. Modern instances of the fusion have barely changed from these fossils, living in oceans and relying on their shells to keep them safe.

entry: POKENAME以救助海上溺水者闻名，据说见到它便预示好运。虽有强健翅膀，却比起飞行，更喜欢在水中快速游动。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is known for rescuing people who are drowning at sea, and spotting one is said to be a sign of good luck. Despite having powerful wings, it prefers to move swiftly through the water rather than fly.

entry: POKENAME以救助海上溺水者闻名，据说见到它便预示好运。虽有强健翅膀，却比起飞行，更喜欢在水中快速游动。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is known for rescuing people who are drowning at sea, and spotting one is said to be a sign of good luck. Despite having powerful wings, it prefers to move swiftly through the water rather than fly.

entry: POKENAME既能近距离注入毒液，也能远远喷毒。身体覆着薄甲，保护它免受攻击。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can both inject venom at close range and spray venom from a distance. Its body is covered with a thin carapace that protects itself from attacks.

entry: POKENAME领地意识极强，充满攻击性。有多根钢铁般锋利的毒针，许多对象一见就吓得逃走。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME is highly territorial and aggressive. With multiple stingers as sharp as steel, many run in fear at the sight of one.

entry: 这些难觅踪迹的宝可梦，在许多文化中象征健康与长寿。快速掠过水面时会掉毛，毛发被用于多种药物与疗方。
author: santon5512
source: These elusive Pokémon are seen as symbols of health and longevity in many cultures. Their fur sheds as they move swiftly along the water's surface, these hairs being used in many medicines and remedies.

entry: 受惊时，POKENAME会把头和四肢缩入壳中，隐去身形。奇怪的是，尾巴既不能完全收进壳，也不能彻底隐形。
author: imaginita
source: When startled, POKENAME will pull its head and limbs into its shell and turn invisible. Oddly, its tail can neither be fully pulled into its shell nor turn fully invisible.

entry: POKENAME坐在河岸，藏于高草丛中，跟踪毫无戒备的宝可梦。锁定目标后，便在水中猛冲向前，用利牙紧咬猎物。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME sits along riverbanks, hiding in tall stalks of grass, and stalking unsuspecting Pokémon. When it has locked onto a target, it launches itself forward in the water and bites down on the prey with its sharp fangs.

entry: POKENAME飞过森林，寻找柔软树果。会把树果收集起来，不断喷水，直到变成能吃的果泥。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME soars through forests in search of soft berries to consume. They gather and spray these berries with water until they turn into an edible mush.

entry: POKENAME每秒将头前后晃动一次，以此计时。凡是试图阻止它晃头的对象，都会被它喷水。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME bobbles its head back and forth every second to keep track of time. It shoots bursts of water at anything that tries to stop this bobble.

entry: POKENAME有种奇特习惯，因能感知时间，每秒都会点一次头。这并不妨碍它成为湖河中水生宝可梦的重要天敌。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME has a peculiar tic that causes it to nod every second because of its ability to keep track of time. This does not stop it from being a major predator for aquatic Pokémon that live in lakes and rivers.

entry: POKENAME靠大尾巴游得更快、更灵活。会在河底织网捕鱼，随后把鱼拖出来吃。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's large tail helps it swim through the water more quickly and agilely. It weaves underwater webs in rivers that catch fish that it will later drag out to consume.

entry: 看似尾巴的东西其实是凝聚的丝。POKENAME挥动它捕捉昆虫，甚至水下的鱼，再将尾巴分离下来，一边享用猎物，一边织出新的。
author: sk372
source: What appears to be a tail is actually condensed silk. POKENAME swings it about to catch bugs and even fish beneath the water before detaching the tail and spinning a new one while it feasts on its meals.

entry: POKENAME用大翅膀在海面上方疾飞，以耳朵和后肢掌舵、保持平衡。休息时，利用壳内留存的空气浮在水面。
author: .jerden
source: While flying rapidly above the surface of the ocean using its large wings, POKENAME steers and maintains its balance using its ears and hind limbs. To rest, it uses air trapped within its shell to float on the surface of the water.

entry: POKENAME成群来到湖河寻找猎物。鱼和虫宝可梦都能吃，而世界各地许多湖泊中，这两类都很丰富。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME flocks to lakes and rivers for the opportunity to find prey. It can eat fish or bug Pokémon, both of which are plentiful in the world's many lakes.

entry: POKENAME容易兴奋，可能不小心电到其他训练家或宝可梦。事后会羞愧地躲入壳中，把尾巴绕在身上。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME is easily excitable and may accidentally shock other Trainers or Pokémon. After this happens, it hides in its shell and curls its tail around itself in shame.

entry: POKENAME栖在岩石海滩附近的石头上。流星划过的夜晚会聚在一起，之后再回到海洋或水下洞穴。
author: dyanz0
source: POKENAME perches on stones near rocky beaches. They gather in groups on the night of a shooting star before retreating back to the ocean or underwater caves.

entry: POKENAME凭坚固甲壳和强健翅膀，能穿过热带风暴。曾有人见它在风暴中护送人们返回避难处。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can fly through tropical storms thanks to its sturdy carapace and its strong wings. It has been observed helping people during these storms by escorting them back to shelter.

entry: POKENAME双脚站稳后，便能承受迎头拍下的海啸冲击。海洋队格外喜爱它，常拿这件事作比喻，说明自然生命能在他们的计划中存活。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: When planting its feet, POKENAME is able to withstand the force of a tsunami raining down on it. Team Aqua have a particular fondness for it and often refer to this fact in analogies about how natural life will survive their plans.

entry: POKENAME游在池塘水面下，只稍稍露出耳朵。它靠这种隐蔽的移动方式躲避天敌。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME swims just below a pond's surface, with its ears barely visible above. It uses this stealthy approach to avoid predators.

entry: POKENAME很少与同一进化系列的伙伴在一起，会前往两极寻找更冷的水。在那里学习独自生存，磨炼耐力，等准备好便进化，返回族群。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Rarely found with others of its evolutionary line, POKENAME ventures toward the poles to seek colder water. There it learns to survive alone, pushing its endurance. Once ready, it evolves and returns to its colony.

entry: POKENAME温顺，行动缓慢，也许是代谢看起来很慢的缘故，不过厚重甲壳或许也拖慢了脚步。它对尾巴很敏感，或是很引以为傲，不喜欢别人碰。
author: infinex21
source: Perhaps due to its apparently slow metabolism, POKENAME is considerably docile and slow-paced; perhaps its dense shell contributes to its slow pace, though. It is sensitive, or prideful, of its tail and does not like when anyone touches it.

entry: 据说POKENAME寿命超过10,000年。毛发敏感得能察觉最细微的天气变化，释放的水有影响心智的作用，可用于茶饮和药剂。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: Said to live for upwards of 10,000 years, POKENAME's fur is so sensitive it can detect the slightest change in the weather. They release water with mind-altering properties that can be used in teas and elixirs.

entry: 沐浴月光时，POKENAME的水属性招式会比平常更强。喜欢上训练家后，会用甲壳替对方挡下一切威胁。
author: fiordaliso
source: Bathed in moonlight, POKENAME's Water-type moves grow stronger than usual. When it grows fond of its Trainer, it shields them from any threat with its shell.

entry: POKENAME的花苞能像间歇泉一样喷水。其他宝可梦常会跑到下面冲凉，就像夏日里在洒水器下嬉戏。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME's bulb is known to work like a geyser. Other Pokémon are known to run under it, like a sprinkler on a summer day.

entry: 在水下，POKENAME的毛发相互扣合，形成排水的疏水层。浮出水面时，毛发破坏表面张力，反而会被水打湿。
author: quackquackattack
source: While underwater, the hairs of a POKENAME lock together to form a hydrophobic layer that repels water. Whenever POKENAME surfaces, these hairs break surface tension, causing its fur to get wet.

entry: POKENAME滑翔天际时，翅膀泛着柔光。会运用精神能量，保护自己认为值得守护的对象。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME's wings emit a gentle glow as it glides through the skies. It channels its psychic energy to protect those it deems worthy.

entry: POKENAME通常顺河而下，甚至冲下瀑布。它太爱顺流漂游，因此很少见到挂在树上的样子。
author: fireflower20002
source: POKENAME will usually be found going down rivers and even waterfalls. It is rare to see POKENAME hanging on trees since they are very eager to ride the river.

entry: POKENAME不会自己挖洞，便找来地鼠挖的洞，灌水赶走原住民，再高高兴兴游进新家。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME lacks the ability to create burrows of its own, so it finds those made by Diglett and floods them, flushing out the current residents, then happily swims into its new home.

entry: 风一起，POKENAME就会在自己的河流上空滑翔，查看是否一切正常。战斗时，用爪子抓住对手，让其无法避开强力水柱。
author: fiordaliso
source: As soon as the wind rises, it glides over its river to ensure everything is in order. When fighting, POKENAME grabs the opponent with its claws so they cannot avoid its powerful water jets.

entry: POKENAME会在满是鱼宝可梦的池塘，或虫宝可梦洞穴附近游泳。受到威胁时，从喙中喷出水柱，吓退天敌。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can be found swimming in ponds full of fish Pokémon or near the burrows of Bug Pokémon. Whenever they are threatened, they spray jets of water from their beaks to scare away predators.

entry: POKENAME能从金属般坚硬的钳子喷出高压水柱，连建筑墙壁都能射穿。翅膀拍得极快，甚至能短暂在水面上方战斗。
author: fiordaliso
source: From its metal-hard claws, POKENAME shoots high-pressure jets of water capable of piercing even the walls of a building. It moves its wings so quickly that it can even fight above the water's surface for a few moments.

entry: POKENAME爱美极了，用剃刀般锋利的爪子细心梳理光滑毛发与甲壳。常凝望水中倒影，一连几小时欣赏自己的模样。
author: rakunk
source: POKENAME is an incredibly vain Pokémon, using its razor-sharp claws to meticulously groom its sleek fur and shell. It often gazes at its reflection in water, admiring its own appearance for hours.

entry: POKENAME在壳内涂满蜂蜜，一饿就缩进去。也会故意朝对手吐蜜，拖慢对方。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME coats the inside of its shell with honey, retracting into its shell whenever it's hungry. It will purposely spit honey at opponents to slow them down.

entry: POKENAME出现在火山岛周围水域，聚集于岩浆喷口。火山学家会监测它们的数量，骤然增多便是火山喷发的早期警讯。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME can be found in the waters surrounding volcanic islands, clustering around magma vents. Their populations are monitored by vulcanologists; a sudden increase in their presence is an early warning sign for volcanic eruptions.

entry: POKENAME飞过森林，跟踪虫宝可梦，想找出巢穴。找到足够多的洞穴后，就向里面喷水，让逃出的猎物正好落进喙里。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME fly through forests to stalk bug Pokémon in the hopes of finding their burrows. Once they find enough burrows, they spray water inside so their prey escapes right into their beaks.

entry: POKENAME为炎热地区的孩子送上雪的礼物。创造出的许多打雪仗回忆，足以弥补弄得一团乱的麻烦，不过玩完仍会用尾巴帮忙扫雪。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME give the gift of snow to children who live in hot climates. The many memories of snowball fights they have created more than makes up for the mess, but they help sweep up the snow with their tails after playing regardless.

entry: 捕猎时，POKENAME用覆壳的头撞晕猎物，再用尖牙咬住。之后会细致地清理蓬松尾巴。
author: quackquackattack
source: When they are hunting, POKENAME ram their shell-covered heads against prey to stun them before sinking their fangs in. Afterwards, they delicately clean their fluffy tails.

entry: POKENAME从小鼻子里喷水，帮助农人灌溉作物。喜欢和伙伴在泥里打滚，直到蓬松白尾沾满泥土。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME helps farmers irrigate their crops by spraying jets of water from its small trunk. It loves rolling in the mud with its companions until its fluffy white tail is completely covered in dirt.

entry: POKENAME不断旋转，时而将头或四肢缩入壳中，让对手难以判断下一击来自何处。训练家可以替它擦亮甲壳，培养感情。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME variably retracts its head and limbs into its shell as it continues to spin, making it difficult for opponents to judge where the next attack will come from. Trainers should buff and shine its shell as a form of bonding.

entry: 有人躲开POKENAME温柔的亲吻时，它会气得唤来乌云降雨。为了给其他宝可梦留下好印象，会细心打理纯白头发，每天至少洗三次。
author: fiordaliso
source: If someone pulls away from POKENAME tender kisses, it gets so offended that it summons storm clouds to make it rain. To impress other Pokémon, it meticulously cares for its pure white hair, washing its hair at least three times a day.

entry: 沉重的壳让它的上半身稳在地上。接着将尾巴摆成风暴中的波浪般，以此迷住敌对宝可梦。
author: haypile
source: Its heavy shell grounds its upper body in place. Then it mesmerizes opposing Pokémon by undulating its tail like a wave in a storm.

entry: POKENAME喜欢潜到温泉池底，只为好玩。烦躁时，会泼出滚烫的水。
author: beatdoof
source: POKENAME likes to dive to the bottom of thermal pools, just for fun. It will splash scalding water whenever it is annoyed.

entry: POKENAME每天产一升奶，分给自然栖息地的宝可梦。许多幼年宝可梦会来喝奶，尤其是失去双亲的个体。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME produce a liter of milk daily that they offer to local Pokémon in their natural habitat. Many baby Pokémon approach POKENAME to drink the milk, especially if they have been orphaned.

entry: POKENAME爱在湖河游泳，却十分胆小。一发现训练家在看，就会在水中激起一阵火花，飞快逃走。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME love to swim in lakes and rivers but are incredibly skittish. If they realize they are being watched by a Trainer, they bolt away by creating a surge of sparks in the water.

entry: POKENAME以甲壳浮力出众而闻名。寒冷季节会大群聚集，让微弱电流在彼此之间流通，保持温暖。一群POKENAME被称为“电网”。
author: ruben2309295
source: POKENAME are known for the buoyancy of their shells. During cold seasons, these Pokémon will form large groups and pass low levels of electricity through one another to stay warm. A group of POKENAME is called a grid.

entry: POKENAME体内储电时，尾巴的毛色会变深。训练家常据此判断什么时候该让它放电。在水里，会发出微弱电脉冲搜寻猎物。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME's tail fur darkens as electricity is stored in its body. Trainers often use this quirk as an indicator of when this Pokémon needs to discharge. In water, it sends out small electrical pulses to search for prey.

entry: POKENAME靠灵敏嗅觉寻找地下黏土。找到后便加水稀释，调成能舔食的稠浆。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME search for clay deposits underground using their keen sense of smell. They water down the clay until it is a thick slurry that they can lap up.

entry: POKENAME住在潮湿洞穴，用水和翅膀开凿巢穴。庞大群落会造出宽广洞窟供自己居住。
author: northkira
source: Found within damp caves, POKENAME uses water and its wings to carve out a nest. Large colonies of POKENAME create vast caves to inhabit.

entry: POKENAME的尾巴储存着全部程序数据，也藏着让它活上数千年的能力。年龄越大，尾巴积累的数据越多，最后大得离谱，连房子都装不下。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's tail contains all its program data and its ability to live on for thousands of years. As it ages, this tail gathers more and more data until it grows so absurdly large that it can't fit inside houses anymore.

entry: POKENAME沿海滩奔跑，身上沾满海沫。无论在沙地还是水里，速度都快得惊人。
author: pastapockets
source: As POKENAME runs along the beach, it gets covered in seafoam. It's incredibly fast both on sand and in water.

entry: 季节变换时，POKENAME会尽心带领族群。分别守在迁徙队伍的前后，确保前往温暖水域时，谁也不掉队。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME dedicate themselves to being leaders of their bales as the seasons change. Taking the front and back of their travelling group, these Pokémon ensure that everyone stays together while voyaging to warmer waters.

entry: POKENAME钻入地下，寻找黏土矿层来吃。吃完身体常沾着黏土，便与同类轮流帮彼此清洗。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME dig underground to find clay deposits to eat. They often have clay stuck to their body after eating, so they take turns with other POKENAME to wash their bodies.

entry: POKENAME靠强健双腿在水中高速推进，蓬松尾巴和羽毛则让动作更精准。爪子力量惊人，能敲开其他宝可梦的壳。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME's powerful legs let them propel themselves through the water at high speeds, their fluffy tails and feathers allowing for more precise movements. Their claws are incredibly powerful, able to crack open the shells of other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME尾巴上的羽毛极为柔软，又保养得好，深受工匠追捧。用它羽毛做的枕头和衣物，在网上十分热门。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: The feathers that make up POKENAME's tail are super soft and well-maintained, so they are highly sought after by craftsmen. Pillows and clothes that use POKENAME's feathers are extremely popular online.

entry: POKENAME从口中朝敌人喷水柱。察觉危险时，尾毛会根根竖起，让它有充裕时间退回壳中。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME spray jets of water from their mouths at foes. The hairs along their tails stand on end when they sense danger, giving them ample time to retreat into their shells.

entry: POKENAME勤于保持尾巴清洁，进泥地时会将它收进壳里。天敌靠近，就会敲打肚子，想把对方吓跑。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME diligently keep their tails clean, tucking them into their shells when in the mud. When approached by predators, they will bang on their stomachs to try to scare them off.

entry: 巨浪突然形成时，很可能是POKENAME为了冲浪而制造的。只要调整耳朵，无论多凶猛的浪都能驾驭。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: When large waves abruptly form, it is likely POKENAME creating them in order to surf. By adjusting their ears they can ride any wave, no matter how tough it can be.

entry: 巨浪突然形成时，很可能是POKENAME为了冲浪而制造的。只要调整耳朵，无论多凶猛的浪都能驾驭。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: When large waves abruptly form, it is likely POKENAME creating them in order to surf. By adjusting their ears they can ride any wave, no matter how tough it can be.

entry: POKENAME年龄越大，产生的雾就覆盖得越广。雾有安抚作用，即使最激烈、最暴躁的争吵也能平息。
author: lampent12
source: As POKENAME ages, the mist they produce covers wider areas. This mist has a calming effect that can diffuse even the most heated or violent arguments.

entry: POKENAME常守卫水下遗迹，操纵潮汐阻挡入侵者。年岁增长，头上的翅膀越来越大，毛发也更丰厚。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are often found defending underwater ruins, manipulating the tides to keep invaders at bay. The wings on their heads grow larger the older they get, their hairs becoming richer.

entry: POKENAME用水柱打下挂在树上的茧。水中混有能侵蚀丝线的毒凝胶，使茧落到地上，成为下一餐。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME shoots down cocoons that hang in trees with jets of water. The water is mixed with a poisonous gel that eats through silk, which causes cocoons to fall to the ground and become its next meal.

entry: POKENAME会改变身上大部分颜色，融入水下或水边环境，唯独壳上的花纹不变。据说，毛茸茸的尾巴越长，就活得越久。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME change most of their colors to blend in under or near water, save for the patterns on their shells. It is said that the longer their furry tails are, the longer they have lived.

entry: POKENAME十分谨慎，会削出特殊木板，加在壳上加强防护。这些木板会与它一同老去。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are prudent creatures that have special wooden plates that they add to their shell for more protection. They carve these plates out of wood that age alongside a POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME住在形似卡咪龟尾巴的楔石中。遇险时，会附身其他水生宝可梦，一起围攻威胁自己的家伙。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME reside in keystones that resemble a Wartortle's tail. When in danger, POKENAME possess other aquatic Pokémon to gang up on whoever is threatening them.

entry: POKENAME一怒，角中就喷出猛烈的污水。水含剧毒，哪怕只碰到皮肤也危险。
author: roundabout_robin
source: When angered, POKENAME's horn releases a strong torrent of tainted water. This water is horribly poisonous, and can prove dangerous even with simple contact with skin.

entry: POKENAME会挡在年幼的同窝伙伴与天敌之间，用壳抵御攻击。直到天敌离去，都不会从兄弟姐妹身前让开。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME stands between its younger nestmates and predators, relying on its shell to block attacks. It remains between its siblings and the predator until the predator leaves.

entry: POKENAME经常清洁、打理毛发。通常不会战斗，除非对手“攻击”了它的毛。
author: mossybanana
source: POKENAME are often seen cleaning and maintaining their fur. They do not usually engage in battle unless their fur has been "attacked" by the opponent.

entry: POKENAME很讲究环境，常用翅膀扫走尘土和杂物。有些酒馆老板会养一只，帮忙打扫人来人往的地方。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME are picky about their environment, often being seen using their wings to sweep away dirt and debris. Some tavern owners keep the Pokémon around to help keep high-traffic areas tidy.

entry: POKENAME留在巢边照看同窝伙伴。会给年幼成员喷上一层腐蚀性凝胶，走丢时就更容易追踪。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME remains close to the nest to keep watch over their nestmates. They spray a coat of corrosive gel over younger nestmates to make them easier to track if they get lost.

entry: 渔夫曾因害怕POKENAME吃光一处水域的其他宝可梦而猎杀它。庞大的身躯足够人们吃上数周，不过如今已有禁止捕猎的法律。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME were once hunted because fishermen were scared that POKENAME would eat the rest of the aquatic Pokémon in an area. Their sheer size could feed people for weeks, but there are now laws against hunting them.

entry: POKENAME头冠与门状结构上的华美毛发，会随年龄增长而颜色加深。毛色深、战斗伤痕多的个体，更受潜在伴侣青睐。
author: chibitales
source: The magnificent fur on POKENAME's crest and gate deepen in color as it ages. Those with deep-colored fur and many battle scars are seen as more favorable for potential mates.

entry: 常在海底悠闲休息。它的背上住着许多宝可梦，因为弱小的宝可梦在它身边很有安全感。
author: dodoowner_
source: It's seen lazing around on the ocean floor. Its back is home to many Pokémon, as weak Pokémon feel protected with it around.

entry: POKENAME站在河边，嘲弄挑衅每个路过的对象。有人上钩后，就会爬到对方身上各处，一边喷出火花和水枪，想把受害者推进水里。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME stand by the river's edge as they mock and taunt anyone who passes them. Once someone takes the bait, POKENAME climb all over them while spitting Ember and Water Gun with the goal of pushing their victim into the water.

entry: 它的壳太小，容不下身体。于是将厚毛耳朵折到脸前，挡住攻击，角则像尖刺一样朝袭击者伸着。
author: haypile
source: Its shell is too small for its body to tuck into. Instead, it protects itself from attacks by folding its thick-furred ears over its face while its horn sticks out like a thorn for attackers.

entry: POKENAME群体中常有内斗，借战斗确立阶级。壳上伤疤越多，在族群中就越受尊重。
author: sk372
source: Infighting among POKENAME groups is common as they battle to establish hierarchy. The more scars upon a POKENAME's shell, the more respect it commands among the tribe.

entry: POKENAME很在意蓬松的尾巴，战斗时会小心保护，不让它沾污或受损。尾毛越长、越厚，就越骄傲。
author: infinex21
source: They are very self-conscious about their fluffy tails and take care to keep them from getting mucked up or damaged during battle. A POKENAME grows increasingly prideful the longer and thicker its tail fur grows.

entry: POKENAME越老，举止越庄重自傲，尤其看重蓬松鲜艳的尾巴。哪怕尾巴只脏一点，更不用说受伤，都会因自尊受损而暴怒，直到累了才独自生闷气。
author: infinex21
source: The older a POKENAME, the more dignified and prideful it will act, especially regarding its fluffy, vibrant tail. If its tail is ever harmed or even made the tiniest bit dirty, it flies into a pride-fueled rage that ends with it sulking once tired.

entry: 这种宝可梦的色泽，会随海浪咆哮的强弱而变深或变浅。云朵般的尾巴和耳朵，能探知水域有多危险。
author: beatdoof
source: The hue of this Pokémon deepens or lightens depending on how much the ocean roars, while its cloud-like tail and ears detect how dangerous an aquatic environment is.

entry: POKENAME是一把优雅的剑，战斗时轻旋回舞。喜欢与看起来强悍的对手决斗。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME is an elegant blade that twirls and spins in combat. It enjoys dueling tough-looking opponents.

entry: POKENAME的双刃协同攻击时，毛茸茸的剑柄能维持稳定与平衡。华丽优雅的攻击方式与外表，连剑术高手都要羡慕。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's fluffy handles give it stability and balance while its two blades conjointly attack enemies. Its grand and elegant attack methods and appearance make even expert swordsmen jealous of it.

entry: 古老航海传说称，POKENAME曾在不同时代侍奉历史上最著名的海盗船长。每次决斗后，都会用海水打磨甲壳状的盾。
author: fiordaliso
source: According to old seafaring legends, POKENAME has served history's most renowned pirate captains across the ages. After every duel, it polishes its shell-shaped shield in saltwater.

entry: POKENAME极力保护漂亮尾巴。洗翠有句古谚，“抓住POKENAME的尾巴”，意指先享大运，随后便有避不开的灾祸。
author: mogor0771
source: POKENAME is fiercely protective of its fabulous tail. According to an old Hisuian proverb, to 'have a POKENAME by the tail' is to enjoy great luck before inevitable disaster.

entry: POKENAME身上蓬松的白毛其实是藻类，能帮助它储气，潜入更深的水中。随着它年岁渐长，藻类也会长成披垂的长发。
author: wiz0z
source: The fluffy white fur on POKENAME's body is actually algae. The algae helps store air, allowing POKENAME to dive deeper into bodies of water. As POKENAME grow older, the algae grows into long tresses.

entry: 在水中以尾巴为舵，用耳朵辨别水流方向。
author: melodydelune
source: It uses its tail in water to act as a rudder and its ears to detect the directions of currents.

entry: 春天，刚进化的POKENAME会离家，寻找属于自己的瀑布。瀑布数量有限，领地争斗便频繁又喧闹。
author: mogor0771
source: In springtime, newly evolved POKENAME leave home in search of a waterfall to call their own. Because there are a limited number to go around, territorial clashes are loud and frequent.

entry: POKENAME只会让在自然栖息地打扰自己的渔夫做噩梦。事后常在渔夫家四周留下一团团蓬松毛发，被视为不祥之兆。
author: hereisanimations
source: POKENAME only cause nightmares to fishermen who disturb them in their natural habitat. They tend to leave chunks of fluffy hair around a fisherman's home afterward, which is seen as a bad omen.

entry: POKENAME尾巴与花束的颜色随年岁加深，毒性也越来越强。它寿命悠长，因此依据它在一处水域居住的年数，便可判断那里的生态系统整体有多稳定。
author: quantumradiation
source: The tail and bouquets of POKENAME deepen in color as it ages, and its poison grows even more potent. The general stability of aquatic ecosystems can be determined by how long POKENAME has resided within them, due to its long-lived nature.

entry: POKENAME飞行时缩进壳里，露出耳朵帮助导航。通常瞄准头部，高速撞击目标，令其晕眩。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME retract into their shells when they fly, with their ears sticking out to help them navigate. POKENAME usually aim for the head, bashing into their targets at high speed to stun them.

entry: POKENAME只靠吸收月亮的能量，就能活上1000年。多余月能会储存在壳里，渡过无月或多云的夜晚。
author: haypile
source: POKENAME can live for 1000 years on nothing but energy absorbed from the moon. It stores excess lunar energy in its shell to survive moonless or cloudy nights.

entry: POKENAME为了吸收月光，满月时最活跃。满月夜会兴奋得向空中喷水，形成闪闪发亮的美丽景象。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are most active during the full moon because they want to absorb moonlight. They get excited during the night of the full moon, so much so that they shoot a beautiful display of sparkling water into the air.

entry: POKENAME越年长，六条尾巴的颜色就越深。游泳时还能卷起再松开尾巴，得到一点推力。
author: chorb33
source: The older POKENAME gets, the darker its six tails become. It can also wind and release them while swimming to get a little boost.

entry: POKENAME往壳里充气浮海，用尾巴与耳羽作帆。自己力气不够游动，便随风而行。
author: vibrationjaveline
source: POKENAME floats on the ocean by filling its shell with air. It uses its tail and ear plumes as sails. It lacks enough power to swim on its own, so it follows the winds.

entry: 据说POKENAME能活数千年，因此象征健康，常被用作纹章图案。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME is said to be able to live for several thousand years. For this reason, it symbolizes health and is a popular motif for coats of arms.

entry: 它的尾巴随年岁增长而颜色加深，接近进化时，壳也越来越重。似乎喜欢用水柱把东西射向空中，看看能推多远。
author: infinex21
source: Its tail deepens in color as it ages and its shell grows heavier as it nears its evolution. It seems to enjoy seeing how far it can propel objects into the air with jets of water.

entry: POKENAME尾巴的毛柔软极了，常被采集来做高级衣物。年龄越大，尾巴的品质就越上乘。
author: santon5512
source: The fur on POKENAME's tails is incredibly soft and is often harvested to make high-quality clothing. The older POKENAME grow, the finer the quality of their tails becomes.

entry: POKENAME用蓬松尾巴擦拭球茎，去除多余花粉。沾在尾巴上的花粉会刺激人眼，不过一道泡沫光线就能洗掉。
author: hereisanimations
source: POKENAME wipes its bulb with its fluffy tail to remove excess pollen. The pollen that sticks to its tail irritates people's eyes, but a simple Bubble Beam from POKENAME can wash it out.

entry: POKENAME会制造精巧细致的泡泡结构，如花朵般围在手边。宝可梦研究者认为，这是它吸引潜在伴侣的手段。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME create elaborate and delicate bubble structures reminiscent of flowers surrounding their hands. Pokémon researchers believe that these structures are used as a means to woo potential mates.

entry: POKENAME用长耳朵在水中强力推进，提高游速。会用背上的壳替队友挡住攻击，保护大家。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME uses its long ears to propel itself powerfully through the water, increasing its swimming speed. It protects its teammates by shielding them with the shell on its back.

entry: POKENAME周围包着厚厚的凝胶，让它能在水下呼吸。身体每秒产生一千次细小波纹，就能迅速游过水域，却不惊动水面。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are surrounded by a thick gel that allows them to breathe underwater. By creating small ripples across their body at a thousand times a second, they can swiftly swim across bodies of water without disturbing the water's surface.

entry: POKENAME能吸收大量水分。洗车场会让多只帮忙，加快洗车。
author: hiroshima0042_23263
source: POKENAME is able to soak up a high amount of water. Multiple POKENAME are used in car washes to speed up the process.

entry: 野生POKENAME常见于海蚀洞或积水洞窟。毛茸茸的耳朵专门感知水中细微震动，因此在黑暗的水里也能游动。
author: pastapockets
source: Wild POKENAME are often found in sea caves or flooded caverns. Its fuzzy ears are specialized to sense tiny vibrations in the water, allowing it to swim even in dark water.

entry: POKENAME喜欢从嘴里喷脏水，却只在陌生、干净的环境里这样做。似乎格外着迷于汽车。
author: beatdoof
source: POKENAME likes to fire jets of dirty water from its mouth, but only when it is in an unfamiliar, clean environment. These Pokémon seem to have a fascination with automobiles.

entry: 年岁增长，它们的毛色会更深，毛发也更浓密。会用獠牙划开石头和树木，标记领地。
author: infinex21
source: As these Pokémon grow older, the colors of their furs grow deeper and the furs themselves grow thicker. They use their tusks to mark their territory by cutting into stones and trees.

entry: 尾巴上的柔软毛束，会随年岁增长而变长、变鲜艳。平常很温和，毛束一被碰就会变凶；不过，这些毛束并未与神经系统相连。
author: infinex21
source: Upon their tails are soft tufts of fur that grow longer and more vibrant as they age. Although normally calm, they become aggressive if their tufts are touched; these tufts are not connected to their nervous systems, however.

entry: POKENAME的羽色随年岁加深。战斗时甲壳会变热，甲片却不受热量影响。壳与甲片都被用于许多工艺品。
author: infinex21
source: The colors of their feathers deepen with age. Their shells grow hotter as they battle, yet the plates of these shells remain unaffected by the heat. POKENAME shells, and their shells' plates, are used in many crafts.

entry: 作为海洋生物，POKENAME拍翅的力量惊人，能跃到浪头上方。会用尖牙咬断缠绕的塑料和海藻，替其他生灵清出道路。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME's wings flap with surprising force for a sea creature, launching it just above the waves. It uses its sharp fangs to slice through plastic and seaweed entanglements, clearing the path for others.

entry: 层层重叠的甲壳，让POKENAME能有力抵御攻击。在陆地性情温和，到了水下，便是游泳高手与致命猎手。
author: sk372
source: Multiple overlapping shells grant POKENAME a strong amount of defense against attacks. While on land, it has a mild disposition; beneath the water, it is a skilled swimmer and deadly hunter.

entry: 科学家最近从海底发现的甲壳化石中，复活了POKENAME。它能从巨颚喷出大量泡泡或海水。
author: fiordaliso
source: Scientists recently revitalized POKENAME from a fossil of its shell found on the seafloor. From its enormous jaws, it can blow out vast quantities of bubbles or saltwater.

entry: POKENAME常被用作吉祥物，宣传面向儿童的谷物食品或糖果。科学家最近从海底发现的甲壳化石中，将它复活。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is often used as a mascot in advertising campaigns promoting cereals or sweets for children. Scientists recently revitalized it from a fossil of its shell found on the seafloor.

entry: 人们见过POKENAME优雅地漂过暴雨，据说目睹它的人能得长寿。转动伞时，能用冰雾裹住身体，随后消失。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are spotted gracefully floating through rainstorms, their presence said to bring longevity to those who witness them. By twirling their umbrellas, they can cloak their bodies in an icy mist before disappearing.

entry: 舞蹈相关文献中，POKENAME毛茸茸的长尾常是长寿的象征。跳舞时放出的泡泡一碰就会灼伤，不过其他POKENAME不会被它烫伤。
author: roundabout_robin
source: POKENAME's long, furry tail is often used as a symbol of longevity in dance-related literature. The bubbles it releases while dancing burn to the touch, though other POKENAME are unaffected by this burn.

entry: 远看时，POKENAME曾被误认成徘徊池河的水精灵。不过，壳下湿毛积聚的臭味，会让附近闻到的人知道，它其实和臭臭花更亲近。
author: haypile
source: From afar, POKENAME has been mistaken for a water spirit haunting ponds and rivers. The foul scents compounding in the damp fur under its shell inform any nearby observer's nose that it's more closely related to Gloom.

entry: POKENAME栖息在沿海洞窟，夜间外出捕猎。能毫不减速地从空中潜入水里，打水面下毫无戒备的猎物一个措手不及。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME inhabits caverns in coastal areas, coming out during the night to hunt. Its can seamlessly dive from the air into the water without losing speed, taking unsuspecting prey just below the surface by surprise.

entry: POKENAME的翅膀和尾巴随年岁增长而颜色加深，据说比任何已知材料都柔软。以各种歌声交流，加上柔软羽毛，让许多人渴望拥有它。
author: infinex21
source: The colors of its wings and tail deepen with age and are said to feel softer than any other material known. POKENAME communicates with various songs that, in tandem with its soft plumage, have led it to be desired by many people.

entry: POKENAME的甲壳头盔能加强防护，因此贝壳收藏家想拿走时，它会很不高兴。壳上藻类生长的数量，能显示它的年龄。
author: roundabout_robin
source: POKENAME's shell helmet serves as extra protection, so it gets upset when shell collectors attempt to take it. The age of a POKENAME is indicated by the amount of algae growing on its shell.

entry: POKENAME背上的生长物会吸取养分，增加体积，抵御天敌。维持背上的球茎需要大量淡水，因此常去游泳，让它们泡在水里。
author: quackquackattack
source: The growths on the back of POKENAME siphon nutrients for added bulk to protect them from predators. They require lots of fresh water to maintain the bulbs on their back, so they often go swimming to soak the growths with water.

entry: 只要有人想碰POKENAME柔软雪白的尾巴，它便毫不犹豫地咬下去。灵活的双腿让它能长途奔跑，也能快速游泳。
author: fiordaliso
source: If anyone tries to touch POKENAME's soft, snow-white tail, it bites without a moment of hesitation. Its agile legs let it run for long distances and swim at great speed.

entry: POKENAME只会短暂上岸，平时藏在河床，保护壳上的蘑菇。有些人相信，吃下它的蘑菇能提升泳技。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME only goes on land for short amounts of time, hiding away in riverbeds in order to protect the mushroom on its shell. There are some people who believe eating POKENAME's mushroom will increase a person's swimming skills.

entry: POKENAME藏在水草间，既躲避天敌，也留意是否有猎物靠近。浓密尾毛能留住气泡，帮助它更长时间待在水下。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME hide in amongst aquatic plants, keeping themselves concealed from predators whilst watching for any prey that might come close. They use the thick fur of their tails to trap air bubbles, helping them stay submerged for longer periods.

entry: POKENAME藏在水草间，既躲避天敌，也留意是否有猎物靠近。浓密尾毛能留住气泡，帮助它更长时间待在水下。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME hide in amongst aquatic plants, keeping themselves concealed from predators whilst watching for any prey that might come close. They use the thick fur of their tails to trap air bubbles, helping them stay submerged for longer periods.

entry: POKENAME有由鳞甲构成的盾状双臂，保护柔软敏感的身体。它很难让身体呈流线型，因此更常待在岸上的芦苇丛里。
author: puppylev
source: In order to protect its soft, sensitive body, POKENAME is endowed with shield-like arms made up of scaly plates. It struggles with streamlining its body and tends to spend its time in the reeds above shore instead.

entry: POKENAME的壳每一部分受击时，都会发出略有不同的音调，冲撞训练时便响起阵阵和弦。据说蒸熟很美味，不过因数量稀少，法律禁止捕猎。
author: bobosmith01
source: Each section of their shells produces a slightly different note when hit; the sound of POKENAME training via tackles releases chords of noise. Supposedly, they have a delicious flavor if steamed, but due to their rarity, hunting them is illegal.

entry: POKENAME巨大的甲壳竟又薄又空心，既足够保护背后，也十分轻巧。
author: camtft
source: The giant shell of POKENAME is surprisingly thin and hollow. This provides just enough protection from behind while also being very lightweight.

entry: POKENAME在尾巴里藏着多根细枝，无聊时抽一根吹泡泡。受到挑战时，会把水枪加热至沸腾，烫伤威胁者使其分心，再逃进浪中。
author: ghostslythe
source: POKENAME stores multiple twigs in its tail, and when bored, pulls one out to blow foam bubbles. When challenged, it heats its Water Guns to boiling, burning threats to distract them before escaping into the waves.

entry: POKENAME翻动过的土壤，水分与养分丰富。那里的植物萌芽速度，接近平常的两倍。
author: .izik
source: Soil displaced by POKENAME is left rich with moisture and nutrients. Plants growing there sprout at nearly twice their normal rate.

entry: POKENAME翻松过的土壤一直十分湿润。它在地下移动时，水分不断从身体渗出。
author: .izik
source: Soil churned by POKENAME remains heavily hydrated. Constant moisture seeps from its body as it moves underground.

entry: 若有人未经许可碰它柔软的尾巴，POKENAME会毫不犹豫地抓伤对方。要求训练家花上数小时清洗、擦亮甲壳，否则就不再听从指令。
author: fiordaliso
source: If anyone touches its soft tail without permission, POKENAME scratches them without a moment's hesitation. It demands that its Trainer clean and polish its shell for hours, or else it refuses to obey any further commands.

entry: POKENAME需要充足水分，否则会剧烈头痛。口渴时容易发脾气，因此建议训练家多带水，让它保持平静。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME needs to remain well hydrated or else they get powerful headaches. They tend to lash out whenever they are thirsty, so Trainers are advised to pack lots of water bottles to keep them calm.

entry: POKENAME有许多鳍肢，协同运作，在水中灵活快速地移动。任何一只鳍肢受伤，都必须上岸休息，直到痊愈。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have many flippers that all work in unison to swiftly maneuver through the water. When one of their flippers is damaged, they have to rest on shore until it heals.

entry: POKENAME脾气很急，总想惹恼其他宝可梦，借机打架。败北后，会躲进河里，直到不再觉得丢脸。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is a rather short-tempered creature that constantly seeks to annoy other Pokémon just to have an excuse to start a fight. If defeated, it hides in a river's water until it no longer feels embarrassed.

entry: POKENAME练习灭火，希望有朝一日能帮助消防员。能迅速找出火源，将其扑灭。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME practices putting out fires so that it can someday help firefighters. It can quickly find the source of a fire to snuff it out.

entry: 能在消防学校见到POKENAME训练，学习如何协助消防员。它们能冲进燃烧的建筑，把人和宝可梦安全救出。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can be seen training at fire academies learning how to help firefighters. They can rush into burning buildings to pull people and Pokémon out safely.

entry: 进化后，性子认真了。仍像先前那样，能向壳喷水，在水上弹跳，却只在必要时才用。
author: frokachu
source: It developed a more serious attitude after evolving. Like its previous form, it can skip along water by shooting water at its shell but does so only when necessary.

entry: 壳里留着大块空腔，可收进尾巴。尾巴如螺旋桨转动，就能将自己推进出去。
author: frokachu
source: Its shell has a large empty area for its tail to go into. It can launch itself by spinning its tail like a propeller.

entry: POKENAME很在意胸前打卷的绒毛，经常梳理。未经允许，谁伸手去碰，都会立刻挨上一拳。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is rather touchy about the swirling bit of chest fluff on its torso, grooming it often. Unless it gives permission, anyone reaching to touch it will get a swift punch.

entry: POKENAME帮助孩子适应游泳。能读心，知道孩子何时害怕或遇到困难，再给予相应帮助。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME help children get acclimated to swimming. Their mindreading abilities allow them to detect when children are scared or struggling and help accordingly.

entry: POKENAME能敏锐感知遇险者的想法，因此被聘为救生员。泳技出色，能迅速赶到溺水的孩子身边。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are hired as lifeguards because they are sensitive to the thoughts of someone in distress. Their superb swimming skills allow them to quickly reach drowning children.

entry: POKENAME头上的盔甲，像古代人形生物化石中见过的头盔，让它拥有惊人的速度与敏捷。
author: lam0u3tt3
source: The helmet on POKENAME's head resembles a helmet seen in an ancient humanoid fossil. It grants POKENAME immense speed and agility.

entry: 人们起初以为POKENAME只是体型较小、更加活泼的卡咪龟，后来研究尾巴，发现毛发尚未发育完全。身体随进化长大，有时难以缩进壳里。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Originally thought to have been smaller, more energetic Wartortle, studies on POKENAME's tails have determined that the fur hasn't fully developed. They occasionally struggle to fit into their shells as their bodies grow with their evolution.

entry: POKENAME谨慎小心，不吃东西时就躲在壳中。住在温泉附近，从热水中吸收矿物质。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are cautious creatures that hide in their shell when they are not eating. They live near hot springs where they soak up minerals from the hot water.

entry: POKENAME住在温泉附近，喜欢吸收水中矿物质。温泉水也帮助保持身体光滑洁净。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME live close to hot springs and enjoy absorbing minerals from the water. This water helps keep their bodies smooth and clean.

entry: POKENAME缩进球状甲壳，滚下山坡，快速赶路。一旦滚起来，不撞上坚实的东西就停不下来。
author: fancyskunk
source: POKENAME retreats into its spherical shell and rolls down mountain slopes to travel quickly. Once it gets rolling, it will be unable to stop itself without crashing into something solid.

entry: 许多阴天，或许正是POKENAME造成的。认真起来时，有时会跑过田野，向天空释放云团。
author: 0reomilka
source: Many cloudy days have probably been caused by a POKENAME. When it turns serious, it sometimes runs across fields and releases clouds into the sky.

entry: 各颗头的壳被磁力牢牢锁在一起，几乎无法分开。POKENAME沿电磁波漂浮时，用三条蓬松尾巴辅助转向。
author: foolish_weasel
source: The shells of each of its component heads are magnetically locked with one another, leaving them virtually inseparable. POKENAME uses its three fluffy tails to help steer itself as it floats along electromagnetic waves.

entry: POKENAME能从随身携带的棒子里放出水流。许多花匠靠它帮忙浇花，因为它能调整棒子出水的方式。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME produce streams of water through the baton that they carry with them. Many florists rely on their help to water plants, as POKENAME can adjust how water is produced from their baton.

entry: POKENAME的两颗头始终配合默契，能有效协调水流攻击。以河中捕获的东西为食，因此通常在生机丰富的水域附近筑巢。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its two heads are always highly cooperative, allowing POKENAME to coordinate its aquatic attacks very effectively. It feeds on whatever it manages to catch in rivers, which is why it usually nests near water teeming with life.

entry: POKENAME在壳内积累层层隔热脂肪，抵御极地家园的严寒。腹部的壳很光滑，能在冰上自由滑行，快得惊人。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME build up layers of insulating fat within their shell to help protect them from the cold of their arctic homes. Their shells are smooth on their stomachs, allowing them to slide freely across ice at surprisingly high speeds.

entry: POKENAME游过冰冷水域时，用华美的白尾扫开冰块。性情坚韧，每场战斗都勇敢面对，娴熟地使出水属性攻击。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME uses its magnificent white tail to sweep away ice as it swims through freezing waters. A tenacious Pokémon, it faces every battle bravely, skillfully unleashing its Water-type attacks.

entry: POKENAME的身体主要由海水与沉积物构成。盐分浓度极高，喝下它的液体可能致命。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME's body mostly consists of saltwater and sediment. Its salt concentration is so high that consuming POKENAME's liquid can be lethal.

entry: POKENAME由腐蚀性黏液构成，能侵蚀黏性物质。耐得住这种黏液的宝可梦会送来树果，换它帮忙清洁身体。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are made of a caustic ooze that eats away at sticky substances. Pokémon that are resistant to the caustic ooze give POKENAME berries in exchange for cleaning their bodies.

entry: POKENAME泳技灵巧，能在水下让身体透明。借此藏身，等倒霉的受害者游过，便突然显形在眼前，发出令人毛骨悚然的尖叫。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a deft swimmer able to turn its body transparent while underwater. Doing this, it hides away until an unfortunate victim swims by, whereupon it manifests itself right in front of them with a bloodcurdling shriek.

entry: 构成POKENAME身体的岩石有多孔结构，能储存大量水分。更常见于积水的洞穴群中。
author: mistymagius
source: The rocks that make up POKENAME's body are porous in structure, allowing them to store large amounts of water. It is more commonly found swimming in waterlogged cave systems.

entry: 关都研究者推测，这种宝可梦可能早在古代就存在。古老研究日志记载着POKENAME的信息，也许写于融合技术诞生之前。
author: daimposter_60614
source: Kanto researchers theorize this Pokémon may have existed in ancient times. Ancient research journals provide info on POKENAME, possibly from before fusion technology.

entry: POKENAME主要用一条咬着大舌贝的呆呆兽尾巴作棍棒自卫。有时会把自己的尾巴拔下来当武器，似乎察觉不到过程中的疼痛或不适。
author: sk372
source: Using a Slowpoke Tail with a Shellder attached as a club is POKENAME's primary method of self-defense. Sometimes a POKENAME will remove its own tail to arm itself, seemingly unaware of any pain or discomfort the process causes.

entry: POKENAME手上的壳如拳套一般，让破坏力惊人的拳头打得更痛。也能保护双手，因此能全力出拳，不怕伤到自己。
author: atlas3339098
source: The punching glove-like shells on POKENAME's hands make its devastating punches even more painful. The shells have the added benefit of protecting POKENAME's hands, which allows it to go all out without worrying about self-injury.

entry: POKENAME把黏舌展开在河里，等猎物游进去，借此捕鱼。用咬住尾巴的大舌贝作锚，免得自己随水流漂走。
author: anonymous_moose
source: POKENAME fishes for food by unfurling its sticky tongue in a river and waiting for prey to swim into it. It uses the Shellder latched onto its tail as an anchor, so it doesn't drift away with the current.

entry: 下半身周围缠着一团灰色触手，既保护它，又帮它收集食物。它只需要不时晒晒太阳，让受损的藤蔓重新长出。
author: quackquackattack
source: Its lower body has a mess of grey tentacles around it, which both keep it safe and gather food for it. The only thing it needs to do is bask in the sunlight every so often to regenerate vines when damaged.

entry: 背上的壳一咬紧，POKENAME就会获得超能力。能用念动力举起巨石，再极其精准地投出去。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME gain psychic powers when the shell on their back bites down on their back. Their telekinetic abilities allow them to lift and throw large boulders with expert precision.

entry: 背上的壳每咬一次，POKENAME就会突然涌入一股精神能量，意外把正用念动力拿着的东西甩出去。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME gain a jolt of psychic energy whenever the shell on their back bites them. This causes them to accidentally fling whatever they are carrying with telekinesis.

entry: 据说，头顶的冠冕会汇聚周围的舞动，带来细雨的滋润。雨季过后，它会随缓慢节奏扭腰起舞，仿佛在为下一次祈雨之舞积蓄力量。
author: quackquackattack
source: The crown atop its head is said to channel the dancing around it to bring the succor of a misty rain. It wiggles its hips in a slow rhythmic dance after a rainy season, as if building power for the next rain dance.

entry: 卡洛斯一间博物馆里，一幅名画描绘了这种美丽的宝可梦。POKENAME能把巨大的大舌贝当作冲浪板，横渡海洋。
author: cobalt0135
source: A very famous painting in a Kalos museum depicts this beautiful Pokémon. POKENAME can cross the seas by using its large Shellder as a surf board.

entry: 卡洛斯一间博物馆里，一幅名画描绘了这种美丽的宝可梦。POKENAME能把巨大的大舌贝当作冲浪板，横渡海洋。
author: cobalt0135
source: A very famous painting in a Kalos museum depicts this beautiful Pokémon. POKENAME can cross the seas by using its large Shellder as a surf board.

entry: POKENAME柔嫩的尾巴被大舌贝吃掉后，对方便咬在背上充当盔甲，形成共生关系。常能见它朝大舌贝叫唤，却从来得不到回应。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME's tender tail has been eaten by the Shellder that is now latched onto its back as armor, forming this symbiotic relationship. It can often be witnessed vocalizing to the Shellder, even though it never receives a response.

entry: POKENAME生活在海底，尽可能避免战斗。随意戴在头上的壳，其实是另一只想吃掉它的宝可梦；它毫不知情，还以为对方只是想保护自己。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME lives on the ocean floor, avoiding battles whenever possible. The shell it carries on its head so casually is actually another Pokémon trying to eat it, but since it doesn't realize that, it believes the shell just wants to protect it.

entry: 咬在POKENAME头上的大舌贝，似乎让它稍感不适。有时会试着撬下来，却总是徒劳。
author: sk372
source: The Shellder biting down on POKENAME's head seems to cause it mild discomfort. It can sometimes be seen attempting to pry it off, but to no avail.

entry: 尾巴上的壳每咬紧一次，POKENAME就会饿得难受，渴望吃兰萨果。随后涌出的能量，让它有了梳理自己的专注力。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME experience hunger pangs whenever the shell at their tail bites down and causes them to crave Lansat Berries. The resulting burst of energy gives them the focus to groom themselves.

entry: 附在身上的大舌贝会吸走部分庞大能量，使POKENAME感官迟钝，自己却越长越大。即便如此，它似乎仍很关心大舌贝。
author: infinex21
source: The Shellder attached to it leeches some of its immense energy, causing its senses to dull and the Shellder to grow greater. Despite this, POKENAME seems to care for the Shellder.

entry: POKENAME尾巴上的大舌贝有双翅膀，看着不大，却强壮得能托起它整个身体。大舌贝载它飞行时，它就软绵绵地吊着，一脸茫然。
author: sk372
source: The Shellder on POKENAME's tail possesses wings strong enough to lift its entire body despite their size. POKENAME dangles limply and vacantly as the Shellder transports it through the air.

entry: 咬住POKENAME尾巴的壳，吸走了它部分超能力与智力。它缺乏自保本能，壳只好用偷来的力量保护双方。
author: sk372
source: While biting onto POKENAME's tail, the shell has siphoned some of its psychic power, as well as its intellect. POKENAME lacks self-preservation instincts, forcing the shell to use its stolen powers to protect both of them.

entry: 大舌贝的牙嵌在体内，疼得POKENAME一直睡不着。许多人因此以为它适合站岗，可它往往太疲惫，根本无法好好守望。
author: leobarqui
source: The pain of having a Shellder's teeth embedded in its body leaves POKENAME perpetually sleepless. Many people take this to mean it makes for a good sentry, but it is often too tired to actually keep an effective watch.

entry: 一只奇怪的有毒大舌贝，附在POKENAME下半身，让它也能以毒牙咬伤他者。可它常忘记自己有獠牙，不小心咬到舌头，使其肿起来。
author: sk372
source: A strange poisonous Shellder is attached to POKENAME's lower half. This gives it a venomous bite, but POKENAME often forgets it even has fangs to begin with, accidentally biting its tongue and causing it to swell.

entry: 攻击时，POKENAME借尾巴上大舌贝的重量，从空中迅速重重落下。不过之后，四片翅膀很难再把沉重身体托离地面。
author: sk372
source: When attacking, POKENAME uses the weight of the Shellder on its tail to drop quickly and heavily from the sky. However, its four wings struggle to lift its heavy body back off the ground afterward.

entry: POKENAME脑活动极低，有时会不慎电到自己，也似乎没察觉耳边有生物在啃咬。
author: leonian1586
source: POKENAME has very low brain activity, sometimes shocking itself on accident. It doesn't seem to be aware of the creature nibbling on its ear.

entry: POKENAME充满好奇，总摇摇摆摆地追着感兴趣的东西走。壳会咬它，警告别去追那些明显危险的事物。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a curious sort that is always waddling after whatever catches its eye. The shell will bite it as a warning to deter it from chasing after something that is obviously dangerous.

entry: POKENAME在岸边的壳里安家，一睡就是好几个小时。潮水常把这些壳拖回海中，通常会使它丧命。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME will make their homes in shells along the shore, sleeping in them for hours. The tide will often drag these shells back out into the ocean, typically leading to this Pokémon's demise.

entry: POKENAME心思单纯，喜欢大舌贝撞击东西的声音。哪怕对方加重咬力，想让它停下，也似乎阻止不了。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is very simple-minded as it loves the noise of its Shellder smashing into things. Even if the Shellder tries to bite harder to get it to stop, it doesn't seem to deter POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME收集苔藓与泥，盖在尾巴的壳上，把它当枕头，一天大半时间都在睡觉。吵醒熟睡的它，被认为会招来厄运。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME collects moss and mud to cover the shell on its tail. It uses it as a pillow, spending most of the day asleep. It is considered bad luck to wake a sleeping POKENAME.

entry: 与普遍看法相反，POKENAME的大脑以超相对论速度运转，能比敌人想得更快。可惜身体跟不上，往往几分钟后才使出早该用的泼沙。
author: ghostslythe
source: Contrary to popular belief, POKENAME's brain functions at super relativistic speeds, allowing it to outthink foes. Unfortunately, its body cannot keep up, causing it to use Sand Attack minutes too late.

entry: POKENAME脑袋空空，却有着非凡的超能力。战斗时，它会把尾巴当鱼雷射出去，再用念力指引方向。
author: teatedtiten
source: With not a thought in its mind, POKENAME still possesses remarkable psychic energy. As means of attack, POKENAME shoots their tail like a torpedo and directs it using its powers.

entry: 偶尔啃啃甜甜圈般的尾巴，却不真正吃下什么，令博士们想不通它如何获取养分。
author: teatedtiten
source: It occasionally nibbles on its donut-like tail, though does not consume anything.  Because of this, professors are stumped as to how it gains nutrients.

entry: POKENAME若失去大舌贝，只会留下原本惊人智力的一小部分。即便如此，仍比多数宝可梦聪明得多。
author: staghorn
