source: When a POKENAME loses its Shellder, it retains only a fraction of its great intelligence. Even so, it is far smarter than most other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME维持着一种共生关系：哺乳动物提供养分，贝类提供保护。它会用超能力麻痹贝类牙齿带来的剧痛。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is a symbiotic relationship where the mammal provides sustenance while the shellfish provides protection. POKENAME numbs the excruciating pain of the shellfish's teeth with its psychic powers.

entry: 呆呆兽的身体几乎完全被一只巨大坚固的大舌贝包住，防御出色。不过行动能力较差，很少远离家园。
author: sk372
source: Slowpoke's body is almost entirely protected by an incredibly large and sturdy Shellder, giving it great defenses. It has rather low mobility though, so it rarely moves far from its home territory.

entry: 啃咬POKENAME的大舌贝显得格外烦躁。人们认为，是因为体温高得令人难以忍受。
author: ocxin
source: The Shellder nibbling on POKENAME appears especially irritable. This is understood to be due to its intolerably high body temperature.

entry: POKENAME的火焰能使感觉麻木，因此接触很危险。训练家往往到太晚时，才知道自己正被烧伤。有时会被用于需要烧灼处理的医疗操作。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME flames have a numbing property, making them dangerous to handle since trainers often aren't aware they're being burned until it's too late. They are sometimes used during medical procedures when cauterisation is required.

entry: POKENAME的火焰能使感觉麻木，因此接触很危险。训练家往往到太晚时，才知道自己正被烧伤。有时会被用于需要烧灼处理的医疗操作。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME flames have a numbing property, making them dangerous to handle since trainers often aren't aware they're being burned until it's too late. They are sometimes used during medical procedures when cauterisation is required.

entry: 尾巴自有意识，会咬POKENAME的尾巴，指挥前进方向。它常吃角金鱼与莲叶童子。
author: schwaus
source: Its tail has a mind of its own, biting POKENAME's tail to change its direction. It often feasts on Goldeen and Lotad.

entry: POKENAME拖着和自己身体一样大的大舌贝，行动迟缓。虽然逃不脱天敌，却能用硬壳挡住攻击。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME drags around a Shellder as large as its own body, making its movements sluggish. While it cannot flee from predators, it can use the hard shell to block their attacks.

entry: POKENAME的眼睛被厚毛遮住，靠尾巴上的大舌贝警戒危险。只要对方咬紧，就会向前冲，盲目挥动獠牙。
author: .jerden
source: Its eyes are covered by thick fur, so the Shellder on its tail keeps watch for threats. If it bites down, POKENAME will charge forward, blindly waving its tusks.

entry: POKENAME的触手可以食用，随时间再生，每年秋季会被采收。人们将其混进面糊球里，制成章鱼烧，在秋日祭典售卖。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME has edible tentacles that grow back over time, which are harvested every year during the autumn season. They are mixed into balls of batter to form takoyaki, which are sold during autumn festivals.

entry: 包住POKENAME的大舌贝一咬紧，就会让它充满自信与怒气，冲撞碾过敌人。巨大獠牙是大舌贝毒素使后牙变异、加速生长的结果。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME gains the confidence and rage to charge and roll over foes once the Shellder covering it bites down. Its large tusks are the result of Shellder poison mutating and accelerating the growth of its back teeth.

entry: 附在下身的大舌贝，极大改善POKENAME的平衡与动作，连科学家也怀疑，究竟谁在指挥谁。游泳的POKENAME曾被误认成人鱼。
author: sontyp
source: The Shellder attached to a POKENAME's lower body increases its balance and motor skills so drastically that scientists speculate which of the two is actually in charge. Swimming POKENAME have been mistaken for mermaids in the past.

entry: POKENAME尾巴上的大舌贝偶尔会夹紧。这时它会张开颈伞，让旁观者脑中涌出一堆无聊的念头，陷入困惑。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME has a Shellder attached to its tail, which clamps down on occasion. When this happens, it flares its hood, inducing a flurry of dull thoughts in onlookers that confuses them.

entry: 不建议饮用POKENAME的奶。钙含量过高，可能使人体钙化，最终造成肌肉瘫痪。
author: musicsheep.
source: It is not recommended to drink POKENAME's milk. It is so rich in calcium that it can cause calcification of the human body, and eventually paralysis of the muscles.

entry: POKENAME肆无忌惮地乱甩尾巴，有时会把其中一只大舌贝甩飞。之后便把尾巴伸入水中，耐心等另一只咬上来。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME flails its tails around with reckless abandon, sometimes causing one of its Shellders to be flung off. When this happens, it will dip its tail in the water and patiently wait for another to bite on.

entry: POKENAME全年站在冰湖上，充当守护者。可惜似乎不知道春天冰会融化，自己也跟着沉进水里。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME stand atop frozen lakes to act as their guardians year round. Unfortunately, they don't seem to realize that the ice melts in the spring, causing them to sink into the water.

entry: 有些呆呆兽迟钝到身上长出了藤蔓。大舌贝咬住尾巴时，身体仍会发生同样的反应，变成POKENAME。
author: staghorn
source: Some Slowpoke are so sedate, vines grow on them. Their body still reacts in the same way when a Shellder bites their tail, turning them into POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME吞食电脑数据时，会让处理速度降到极低。若被打断，便放出阵阵精神能量，随后飘走。
author: .izik
source: While consuming data from a computer, POKENAME causes the device's processing speed to drop to incredibly low levels. If interrupted, it unleashes blasts of psychic energy before floating away.

entry: 由于故障，POKENAME脑中几乎没有连贯的思绪。极偶尔，两具身体会交换头部，看起来就成了呆呆兽在咬多边兽Z的尾巴。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's mind has become almost empty of coherent thought due to its glitched nature. On rare occasions, the two bodies may swap heads, leading to the appearance of Slowpoke biting Porygon-Z's tail.

entry: 身体各部分分离，让POKENAME能在战斗中把自己的头踢向远处对手。虽然可能造成脑震荡，却似乎毫不在意头颅被当成弹丸。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's disjointed body leaves it able to kick its own head at distant opponents in battle. Despite the potential for causing concussions, POKENAME seems unfazed by its cranium being used as a projectile.

entry: 视力差，脑筋又不灵，让POKENAME几乎总在迷糊。它们常跌进河，成群顺流漂走。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are almost always confused, due to its lack of sight and underwhelming intelligence. They will often fall into rivers and groups of POKENAME can be seen floating downstream.

entry: 下半身的壳拖累了POKENAME，便用念动力移动自己。它头脑迟钝，性情乏味，但训练家遇险时，能突然展现惊人智慧，前来相助。
author: sk372
source: The shell on POKENAME's lower half weighs it down, so it uses telekinesis to move itself. It has a dim mind and vapid personality, but if its Trainer is in danger, it can show a remarkably sudden burst of intelligence as it comes to their aid.

entry: POKENAME的壳极其坚固，能反弹大部分射来的东西。不过，在没受保护的身体上轻敲一下，就可能让它昏倒。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME's shell is extremely sturdy, reflecting most projectiles thrown at it. However, a light tap to POKENAME's unprotected flesh may cause it to faint.

entry: POKENAME的存在会不断吸走周围对象的智力，自己却不知道有这种能力。身上的石头有些许自主意识，会试着把它移到危害较小的地方。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's presence actively drains the intelligence of those near it, though it itself is unaware of this ability. Its stone has limited sentience of its own, and tries to move POKENAME somewhere where it will cause little harm.

entry: POKENAME懒得出奇，一连睡上数周，醒来大吃一顿，再接着睡。虽然懒散，力量却强得惊人，受扰时也会大发雷霆。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are exceptionally lazy Pokémon that will sleep for weeks on end before waking to gorge themselves, then going back to sleep. Despite their laziness they have an immense temper if disturbed and are incredibly strong.

entry: POKENAME懒得出奇，一连睡上数周，醒来大吃一顿，再接着睡。虽然懒散，力量却强得惊人，受扰时也会大发雷霆。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are exceptionally lazy Pokémon that will sleep for weeks on end before waking to gorge themselves, then going back to sleep. Despite their laziness they have an immense temper if disturbed and are incredibly strong.

entry: POKENAME的鼻子和壳都想朝向磁北，结果让它转起圈来。会在天然磁力强的湖中睡觉。
author: chibitales
source: Both POKENAME's nose and shell try to point towards magnetic north, causing POKENAME to spin. It sleeps in lakes where natural magnetism is strong.

entry: POKENAME脸上的大舌贝会释放强磁力。它用磁力带着断落的呆呆兽尾巴碎段，打算用来钓鱼，却经常被食肉宝可梦偷走。
author: jangodiot
source: POKENAME emits a strong magnetic force from the Shellder on its face. It uses this force to carry pieces of Slowpoke tails that have broken off, which it plans to fish with, but they regularly get stolen by carnivorous Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME的双刃缺乏协调，似乎也不共享同一个意识。一把精准作战，防守深思熟虑，另一把却懒散地胡乱挥动，或几乎不动。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's twin blades lack coordination, and do not appear to share the same mind. One fights with precision and calculated defense, while the other lazily swings itself around in random directions, or hardly moves at all.

entry: POKENAME喜欢伪装，大舌贝却总害怕改变，便狠狠咬住它的毛发。每次它都很困惑，不明白为何会这样。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: While POKENAME enjoys disguising itself, its Shellder is always afraid to change. This leads the Shellder to bite down hard on POKENAME's hair; every time, POKENAME is baffled as to why it happens.

entry: POKENAME平时动作迟缓，但尾巴上的大舌贝一咬紧，就会让它肾上腺素骤增，行动比平时更快。
author: melodydelune
source: Though usually slow, if the Shellder on POKENAME's tail bites down they will gain a burst of adrenaline to act faster than normal.

entry: POKENAME身上的壳似乎略紧，引起的不适又让迟钝的大脑无法理解。因此会愤怒地无差别攻击他者，危险至极。
author: sk372
source: The shells on POKENAME's body appear to be slightly too tight for its body, causing discomfort that its dim brain doesn't quite understand. This causes it to angrily lash out indiscriminately at others, making it highly dangerous.

entry: 野生POKENAME在海岸藏进壳里，扑向经过的猎物，用带电丝网裹住。抓牢之后，再缩回壳内享用。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME hide in their shells along seashores, pouncing upon any prey that walk by and wrapping them in electrified nets. With their prey secured, they will slink back within their shells to enjoy their meal.

entry: 它覆着保湿黏液，也能像防晒霜一样防止晒伤。身上的壳一咬紧，就会本能地扩张内脏，免得重要器官被咬到。
author: quackquackattack
source: It is covered in a slime that keeps itself moist, which also functions as a sunscreen to prevent burns. Whenever the shell attached to its body bites down, it instinctively expands its innards to prevent the shell from biting its vital organs.

entry: 附在POKENAME身上的大舌贝总是欣喜陶醉，因为它吸食的甜汁不是来自一条尾巴，而是整整三条。
author: gp423
source: The Shellder attached to POKENAME is in a constant state of euphoria. This is because it is ingesting the sweet ooze from not one but three tails.

entry: POKENAME被咬在头上的大舌贝遮住视线，却也因此能使出更有力的头槌。咬入的毒素还略微刺激脑部机能，赋予它少许超能力。
author: sk372
source: Though blinded by the Shellder biting onto its head, POKENAME now has the advantage of a much sturdier headbutt. The bite's venom also stimulates its brain functions slightly, giving it a smattering of psychic abilities.

entry: POKENAME的灰色齿轮是强磁体，让各个齿轮几乎无法分开。不过强磁力也会减慢转速。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME's gears are nearly inseparable due to its gray gear being a powerful magnet. However, this strong magnetism also slows the rotation of its gears.

entry: POKENAME和尾巴上的大舌贝都靠吸收阳光获得能量。见不到太阳的日子，大舌贝会咬它的尾巴表示不满。
author: darkweavile428
source: Both POKENAME and the Shellder on its tail gain energy from absorbing sunlight. On days where the sun isn't visible, the Shellder bites POKENAME's tail to show its dissatisfaction.

entry: POKENAME尾巴上的大舌贝，会吸走它靠阳光获得的能量。借这股力量，大舌贝能长出原本无法生成的植物。
author: soup1900
source: The Shellder on POKENAME's tail leeches the energy this Pokémon gains from absorbing sunlight. With this energy, the Shellder grows flora it could not otherwise produce.

entry: 身上的壳限制了POKENAME的跳跃能力，因此只挑地面上的小目标攀附。咬住对方吸取静电时，壳会微微发光。
author: sk372
source: The shell on POKENAME's body limits its jumping ability to an extent, so it restricts itself to small targets on the ground to cling to. As it siphons static electricity by biting, the shell glows faintly.

entry: 它行动僵硬，不适合钓鱼这类精细动作，便靠尾巴上的壳砸石头，吸引注意。谁若毫无防备地发现暗中潜伏的它，就会挨尾巴一顿痛击。
author: quackquackattack
source: It relies on the shell attached to its tail to break rocks to draw attention to itself, as its stiffness is not suited for high dexterity tasks like fishing. Whatever finds it lurking in the dark gets bludgeoned with its tail if unprepared.

entry: POKENAME好奇而温柔，会把迷路旅人抱进怀里，试着照顾对方。可惜总忘记自己一碰就冻，拥抱反而把照顾的对象完全冻住。
author: sk372
source: Curious and gentle, POKENAME tries to look after lost travelers by taking them into its embrace. Unfortunately, it always forgets it has a freezing touch, so these hugs render the target of its care frozen solid instead.

entry: 沉重的壳坠在POKENAME双臂末端，它却挥得出奇轻松。最好别在它欢呼时站得太近。
author: jaminmcready
source: Heavy shells weigh down the ends of POKENAME's arms, yet it swings them with surprising ease. Standing too close to one when it cheers is not advised.

entry: 尾巴上的巨壳使POKENAME难以跳舞，也不太能移动。它很难自行找到食物，饿得不断流口水。
author: jaminmcready
source: The massive shell on POKENAME's tail prevents it from dancing or moving much. It drools constantly due to hunger, struggling to find food on its own.

entry: POKENAME心思简单，所谓舞蹈大多只是在原地轻晃身体、摆动双臂。即便如此，这些动作偶尔仍能产生极强的精神脉冲。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's simple mind results in its dances being little more than lightly swaying in place and waving its arms. Despite this, on occasion these movements can create very potent psychic pulses.

entry: POKENAME吃太多垃圾，四肢不断漏出恶臭的液态废物。它还常把这液体当饮料，结果呼吸臭得离谱，并带有毒性。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's limbs constantly leak foul-smelling liquid garbage due to the diet of refuse it excessively eats. POKENAME regularly drinks the liquid as a beverage, giving it absurdly foul, toxic breath as a result.

entry: 它借水下洋流在海中疾游。需要额外助力时，就会说服壳咬紧尾巴，让肾上腺素猛增。
author: quackquackattack
source: It zooms through the ocean with the help of underwater currents. Whenever it needs an extra boost, it convinces its shell to bite down on its tail, which gives it a surge of adrenaline.

entry: 附在身上的壳，让它有了几条带倒钩的肢体，采海藻时也能抵御天敌。若天敌纠缠不休，壳会产生让对方烦躁担忧的毒液。
author: quackquackattack
source: It has several barbed limbs because of the shells that get attached to it, which allows it to defend itself from predators while gathering seaweed. Its shells produce a venom that causes vexation and worry if a predator will not leave it alone.

entry: POKENAME能释放让人极度困倦的孢子。融合的大舌贝注入的多余毒素，则会从它嘴里排出。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME can emit spores that cause extreme drowsiness. Excess poison injected from the fused Shellder is excreted from POKENAME's mouth.

entry: 对战攻击前，POKENAME一定要先摆出许多夸张姿势。太喜欢摆造型，有时甚至忘了出招，让自己破绽百出。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME always makes sure to strike numerous dramatic poses before it attacks in battle. It enjoys posing so much that it may forget to actually attack, leaving itself highly vulnerable.

entry: POKENAME夜间偷偷接近疲惫的宝可梦，尽可能出其不意。可尾巴上的壳一咬紧，就会疼得大叫，反把猎物吓跑。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME sneak up on tired Pokémon at night to maximize their chances of surprising their prey. When the shell on their tail bites down, they experience a jolt of pain that causes them to scream so loudly that they scare away their prey.

entry: POKENAME夜间跟踪其他沙漠宝可梦，尽量提高捕猎成功的机会。尾巴上的木壳咬紧时，速度便会骤增，帮助追击猎物。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME stalk other desert Pokémon at night to maximize their chances of securing prey. When the wooden shell on their tail bites down, they gain a surge of speed to help them chase after prey.

entry: POKENAME背上的壳其实是种妨碍。常因壳太重，摔得四脚朝天。
author: bigoljax
source: The shells on POKENAME's back are actually a hindrance for them. They regularly fall onto their backs due to the weight of their shells.

entry: 这种宝可梦身上布满大舌贝的壳，增强了面对敌人的力量与耐久。以杂食为生，用爪子采集树果、捕捉鱼类。
author: violet_zero
source: Numerous Shellder shells adorn this Pokémon's body, giving it greater strength and durability against enemies. Having an omnivorous diet, it uses its claws to gather berries and hunt for fish.

entry: POKENAME能在垃圾中发现美，常用海滩上被遗弃的闪亮物件装饰甲壳。曾为争夺这些东西，与长翅鸥发生冲突。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME finds beauty in trash, often adorning their shells with sparkly objects abandoned at beaches. POKENAME have been known to get into scuffles with Wingull over these items.

entry: POKENAME更壮硕的身体，不知为何让大舌贝产生了类似超级进化的反应。大舌贝奋勇保护宿主，咬住背部特定穴位，让它仅凭反射就能挥出重拳。
author: icelevelincarnate
source: POKENAME's bulkier body has somehow caused a reaction with Shellder akin to Mega Evolution. The Shellder valiantly protects their host, biting certain pressure points along POKENAME's back to make them throw big punches purely out of reflex.

entry: POKENAME的尾焰有独立的意志，会试着烧灼本体，催它动起来。本体虽然疼痛不已，却依旧对战斗没多大兴趣。
author: mistymagius
source: The flame on POKENAME's tail has a mind of its own, which will try to burn the main body to get it moving. Despite being in a lot of pain, the main body isn't that interested in combat.

entry: POKENAME睡在沿海沙丘下，发出微弱精神波动。附近生灵会因此变得迟缓，提不起劲。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME sleeps beneath coastal sand dunes, emitting faint psychic waves. These waves cause nearby creatures to feel sluggish and unmotivated.

entry: POKENAME一刻不停地移动，似乎以为能甩掉尾巴上的大舌贝。有时绕圈游泳，想抓住对方，可身体太短，怎么也够不到。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME never stops moving, seemingly believing that it can shake the Shellder from its tail. It sometimes swims in circles trying to catch it, but its short body leaves it far out of reach.

entry: POKENAME的三颗头都不聪明，很容易分心，偶尔还会各自走散。奇怪的是，第三颗头像极了咬住呆呆兽尾巴之后的大舌贝。
author: sk372
source: The three heads of POKENAME are not very intelligent and easily distracted, occasionally wandering off from each other. The third head strangely resembles a Shellder after biting a Slowpoke's tail.

entry: POKENAME心存善意，很乐意不计较大舌贝的咬击。可对方试着指出某处宝藏时，它却会气得忘记大舌贝曾帮过自己的事。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME will happily dismiss bites from its Shellder due to the good will it has. However, when the Shellder tries to point out the location of some treasure, POKENAME becomes so irate that it forgets about the times when the Shellder has helped.

entry: 长尾巴上附着的壳，让它不必逃跑，也能抵御天敌。会把重壳当棍棒挥动，打中天敌后，再摇摇摆摆地离去。
author: quackquackattack
source: Its long tail has a shell attached to it, allowing it to defend itself from predators rather than run away. Its heavy shell swings around like a cudgel to smack predators before it waddles away.

entry: POKENAME成群飞驰过大地，时速超过八十英里。不幸的是，它们反应极差，沿途的对象常会被撞个正着。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME race across the landscape in packs, travelling at speeds in excess of eighty miles per hour. Unfortunately for those in their path, they have very poor reaction times and are prone to crashing into whatever happens to be in their way.

entry: 大舌贝一直受POKENAME的火焰烧灼，却凭着一股倔劲死不松口，硬是忍了下来。
author: rakanadyo
source: Shellder is constantly burned by POKENAME's flame. However, it hangs on and endures through sheer stubbornness.

entry: 古代文明认为，POKENAME会以仪式性的动作带来大雨。如今已成功辨认出，这些动作其实就是求雨。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Ancient civilizations believed that POKENAME helped bring downpours by performing ritualistic movements. These movements have been successfully identified as just Rain Dance.

entry: 它靠啃咬尾巴的植物帮忙，钓水生宝可梦。植物会长出藤蔓引来猎物，等靠得够近，便一把将这顿饭拽出水面。
author: quackquackattack
source: It fishes for aquatic Pokémon with the help of the plant gnawing at its tail, which produces vines that lure in prey. Once prey gets close enough, it yanks the meal out of the water.

entry: 大舌贝向POKENAME体内注毒，让它发呆走神。行走时不太清楚自己往哪去，撞上树都不会察觉。
author: periperi_chicken
source: Shellder injects poison through POKENAME's body that makes it space out. When it walks, it can't fully tell where it's going and will bash into trees without noticing.

entry: POKENAME身上的大舌贝长得巨大，如今已将它整个吞没。不过它并未受伤，反而觉得大舌贝体内舒服得很。
author: soup1900
source: The Shellder on POKENAME has grown massive and now completely swallows this Pokémon. POKENAME isn't hurt by this though; the inside of Shellder is actually really comfortable to it.

entry: POKENAME惹恼咬着手臂的大舌贝，就能迫使对方从壳尖喷出毒液。也能用壳尖刺向对手，将毒液直接注入体内。
author: soup1900
source: By irritating the Shellder that bites its arm, POKENAME can force Shellder to launch a toxic fluid from the tip of its shell. POKENAME could also jab an opponent with this shell tip, directly injecting this toxic fluid into their body.

entry: 多只大舌贝咬住POKENAME四肢，改变了它的发育。攻防两方面都展现出卓越战力，却几乎看不出自我意识。
author: sk372
source: A number of Shellder have bitten onto POKENAME's limbs and altered its development. It exhibits remarkable battle prowess in both offense and defense, but shows little signs of self-awareness.

entry: 攻击打在吞没它的大舌贝上，POKENAME丝毫不会受伤。双腿困在大舌贝内，便把尾巴当弹跳杆，蹦着赶路。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME is completely unharmed by attacks that hit the Shellder that engulfs it. POKENAME uses its tail as a pogo stick to travel around, since its legs are trapped inside the Shellder.

entry: POKENAME从大舌贝壳尖喷出的液体通常有毒，但经过正确处理，能变成美味酱汁。许多菜肴会用来增添辛辣滋味。
author: soup1900
source: While the fluid that POKENAME ejects from Shellder's tip is normally poisonous, if processed correctly, it can make a delicious dressing. It is used on many dishes to give them a spicier taste.

entry: 它的身体被巨壳吞没，壳能包住全身。因为与壳共享养分，不再依赖钓鱼维生。
author: quackquackattack
source: Its body is engulfed with a large shell, which has the ability to surround its entire body. It no longer relies on fishing to obtain sustenance, as it shares nutrients with its shell.

entry: POKENAME夜间在岸边飘游，飞行路线漫无目的。朝他者伸舌头时，能在舌上看见一张像呆呆兽的脸。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME floats around shorelines at night, rather aimless in its flight path. When it sticks its tongue out at others, a face resembling Slowpoke's can be seen on the appendage.

entry: 咬住尾巴的大舌贝会催促POKENAME催眠宝可梦和人类。可惜，它也会被自己的硬币晃得头晕。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: The Shellder biting the tail of a POKENAME goads it into hypnotizing Pokémon and humans. Unfortunately, it also ends up making itself dizzy with its own coin.

entry: POKENAME的钳子各有意识，可能比本体更聪明。本体茫然站着不动，直到钳子敲敲它的头，指示往食物或避难处移动。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's claws have minds of their own, and may be more intelligent than the main body. POKENAME stands vacantly still, until a claw raps its head and instructs it to move towards food or shelter.

entry: 常能在设施和仓储空间发现成群POKENAME，住在墙壁与天花板裂缝里。只要有东西开始生锈，就会一起离开藏身处，把锈吃掉。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: Swarms of POKENAME can often be found in facilities and storage units, living in cracks in the walls and ceiling. Once something begins to rust, they all leave their hiding place, devouring the rust off it.

entry: POKENAME擅长产生、储存电磁能。没有用于自身燃料的多余能量，会定期释放，以减轻压力。
author: metcassette
source: POKENAME excels at generating and storing electromagnetic energy. Excess energy which isn't used as fuel for the POKENAME is regularly discharged to relieve stress.

entry: POKENAME沿电线滚动镀银的身体，吸食静电与电流。吃得越多，速度就越快。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME rolls its silver-plated body along powerlines, feeding on static and current. The more it eats, the faster it becomes.

entry: POKENAME以磁铁辨方向，游荡工厂之间，寻找创造自己的设计师——它的“母亲”。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: Using its magnet to navigate, POKENAME wanders factory to factory in search for its "mother", the designer who created it.

entry: 它借身体的磁极相斥踢腿。若没踢好，四肢反会相互吸住，动弹不得。
author: staghorn
source: It uses its polarized body to throw kicks via magnetic repulsion. If it flubs a kick, its limbs will attract to each other, leaving it helpless.

entry: POKENAME的钢铁双拳积蓄电力。受威胁时，会释放足以烧焦石头的强烈电击。
author: .izik
source: Electricity builds in POKENAME's steel fists. When threatened, it releases blasts of electricity strong enough to scorch stone.

entry: POKENAME两侧放出的气体，化学成分各不相同。若将两边气团强行混合，便会产生规模小却强劲的电力爆发。
author: sk372
source: The gas emitted from either side of POKENAME contains differing chemical compositions. Should the opposing clouds be forced together, small but potent bursts of electricity are created.

entry: POKENAME悠闲漂游在大城市的工业区，身后不断喷出毒烟。一旦晃进住宅区，房价就会暴跌。
author: dylonk25
source: POKENAME can found leisurely drifting around industrial zones in large cities, spewing toxic fumes in its wake. When it wanders into a residential area, property values plummet.

entry: 成群POKENAME会附在通信塔顶，吸取电力。用这些能量推动进化，完全充电后便破壳而出。
author: santon5512
source: Groups of POKENAME will attach themselves to the tops of cell towers, feeding off their electricity. They use this energy to fuel their evolution, hatching once fully charged.

entry: POKENAME的身体受密集缠绕的电线保护。因这副模样，它的名字也成了指代一堆缠乱电缆的俚语。
author: hophoppip
source: Its body is protected by a dense tangle of electrical wires. In reference to its appearance, POKENAME has become a slang term for a pile of tangled-up cables.

entry: POKENAME能靠磁力吸在船底，贴得极紧，不损伤金属船体就很难拆下来。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME can be found magnetized to the underside of ships. They cling so tightly that it is difficult to remove them without damaging the metal hull.

entry: POKENAME漂浮在工业区的水面上方。夜间，明亮电弧有节奏地闪动，格外显眼。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME can be found floating above the water in industrial areas. At night, the rhythmic pulsing of its bright electrical arcs make it highly visible.

entry: 工程师给这些生灵配上力量镜，帮助维修电气设备。它们能用磁铁精准举起、移动金属零件，是防止电气故障的宝贵帮手。
author: quackquackattack
source: Engineers equip these creatures with a set of Power Lens to help them repair electrical equipment. They use magnets to lift and move metallic parts with precision, a valuable skill to prevent electrical failure.

entry: POKENAME将金属熔化后吃掉。用双臂的强磁铁困住钢属性猎物，再加热其盔甲，直到软化熔融。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME consumes metal by melting it down. It traps Steel-type prey using the powerful magnets on its arms, then heats up their armor until it softens and melts.

entry: POKENAME为争夺支配地位相互冲撞，金属身体能保护它们不受伤。角常卡在一起，只会令它们更愤怒。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME will charge at each other in fights for dominance, their metal bodies protecting them from injury. Their horns will often get stuck together, only making them angrier.

entry: POKENAME颈间环绕的细金属丝构成鬃毛。会吸收静电，储存在金属丝里，留待以后使用。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's neck is ringed with fine metal wires that form a mane. It absorbs static electricity and stores it within the wires for later use.

entry: POKENAME能将身体化为纯粹的代码，穿行网络空间。网页视频出现奇怪失真，常是它经过的信号。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body can convert into pure code to travel cyberspace. Strange distortions affecting videos often signal its passage through web pages.

entry: POKENAME用磁铁将金属物件吸到身上，加强防护。前往它栖息的地区前，训练家最好先固定好这些物件。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME uses its magnets to pull metallic objects into its body for extra protection. Trainers are advised to secure these items before traveling to areas where POKENAME live.

entry: POKENAME的金属外骨骼坚韧无比，还能在周围制造强磁场。遇到危险时，磁场连强大的钢属性宝可梦都能扰得晕头转向。
author: dyo_jonah
source: Not only is POKENAME's metallic exoskeleton highly durable, but it can create a powerful magnetic field in its proximity. When in distress, this field is capable of disorienting even powerful Steel-type Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME吃杂食，却格外喜欢金属。会把钉子、螺栓等小物件吸在磁性脸庞上，留待长睡醒来后当零食。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is omnivorous, but has a particular taste for anything metallic. POKENAME sticks small objects like nails, bolts, and such to its magnetic face, saving them to eat as snacks after a lengthy nap.

entry: POKENAME身边始终浮着一对磁铁，以磁力和超能力与它相连。天性爱恶作剧，喜欢用磁铁干扰私人电子设备。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has a pair of magnets floating near it at all times, bonded to it both magnetically and psychically. A prankster at heart, it likes to use the magnets to cause disruptions to personal electronics.

entry: POKENAME累了会到水电站附近游泳。不知为何，只要靠近水坝就能精神一振，恢复体力。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME swims near hydropower plants when tired. Somehow, even being close to the dam invigorates it, helping it regain stamina.

entry: POKENAME太重，非得靠磁力才飞得起来。幼年POKENAME还没练熟，有时会跌出巢，得小心送回安全处。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are too heavy to fly without magnetic powers. Sometimes, young POKENAME that haven't mastered magnetism are found fallen from their nests and should be carefully returned to safety.

entry: 放电时，它的瞳孔会泛起微光。牙齿比铁还硬，能咬进机器，吸收其中流动的电力。
author: infinex21
source: Its pupil emits a faint glow when it releases electricity. Its teeth are harder than iron and allow it to bite into machinery to absorb the electricity flowing within.

entry: 巨眼会发出特殊波动，几乎任何直视它的对象都会晕眩、麻痹。能用磁力拉来猎物和敌人，朝对方投掷杂物，甚至试着直接压碎。
author: infinex21
source: It emits special waves from its large eye that can daze and paralyze mostly any who look directly at its eye. Using its own magnetism, it can pull in prey and foes, throw miscellaneous objects at them, or even try to crush them outright.

entry: POKENAME爱往城里聚，沿电线筑巢。数量一多，集中磁场就干扰电流，造成城市停电。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are drawn to urban areas, often nesting along powerlines. Large populations can cause blackouts in cities as the concentrated magnetic fields disrupt the flow of electricity.

entry: POKENAME耐得住高压环境，是海洋科学家喜爱的深海研究助手。
author: theartemis1
source: Capable of withstanding high-pressure environments, POKENAME is popular among marine scientists as aids in their deep-sea research.

entry: POKENAME钻进工厂设备的电线间，吸收电力。太兴奋时，会放出火花，把自己也电到。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME digs through wires of factory equipment to absorb electricity. If it gets too excited, it unleashes sparks, shocking itself.

entry: POKENAME住在陨石坠落地点附近，敲下带磁性的陨石碎片，紧紧抱住。每有新陨石坠落，就会迁往新的坠落处。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME lives near meteorite crash sites where it breaks off and clings to magnetic shards from the meteorite. Whenever a new meteorite crashes, it migrates to reach the new site.

entry: 预见恐怖景象后，POKENAME的钢铁身体会比平常更硬。这种防御机制能保护它，抵御所见的危险，哪怕那是几年后的未来。
author: .izik
source: After having a terrifying vision, POKENAME's steel body becomes harder than normal. This defense mechanism helps keep it safe from what it saw, even if it is years in the future.

entry: POKENAME有强大的科技操控异能。远在300英尺外，也能让电脑短路。
author: johnhandicraft
source: POKENAME possesses powerful technopathic abilities. It can cause a computer to short-circuit from 300 feet away.

entry: POKENAME有强大的科技操控异能。远在300英尺外，也能让电脑短路。
author: johnhandicraft
source: POKENAME possesses powerful technopathic abilities. It can cause a computer to short-circuit from 300 feet away.

entry: POKENAME收集静电，为攻击蓄能。剪下的羊毛可用来制作钢丝球。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME gathers static electricity to charge its attacks. Its sheared wool is useful for making steel wool scrubbers.

entry: POKENAME用废金属筑巢，安置幼崽。孩子掉出巢时，会制造磁场，试着把它托回安全处。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME makes nests out of scrap metal to house its young. Whenever one of its offspring falls out of the nest, it generates a magnetic field to try to lift the offspring back to safety.

entry: POKENAME用磁力飘在常住的农田间，静静观察其他生灵。开心时，会晃动脚上的磁铁，让尾部球茎的光一闪一闪。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses magnetism to float around the farmlands it tends to inhabit, quietly observing other creatures. When happy, it wiggles the magnets on its feet and flickers the light on its tail-bulb.

entry: POKENAME在工厂检查电器零件。能迅速识别缺陷，再用磁性尾巴将次品从装配线上拉走。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME works in factory settings where it inspects parts that are used in appliances. It quickly discerns which parts are defective and pulls the parts out of assembly lines with its magnetic tail.

entry: 它靠墙休息，希望人类误以为是电源插座。骗成功后，就会偷走对方的电线，吃掉其中金属。
author: hophoppip
source: It rests against walls, hoping a human will confuse it for an electrical outlet. If it succeeds in this deception, it will steal the human's cord and eat the metal.

entry: POKENAME啃食电线和金属梁柱，一次聚得太多，可能在大都市造成灾难。受惊后会逃跑，用尾部磁铁吸来金属碎屑，留着以后吃。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME nibble on electrical wires and metal beams, potentially causing disasters in metropolitan areas if enough of them gather at once. When startled, they will run away, using the magnets on their tails to pull metal scraps to feast on later.

entry: POKENAME从尾部磁铁放出电击，跃在半空也能做到，常在落地前就把敌人震晕。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME discharges jolts of electricity from the magnet on its tail. It can do so mid-leap, often stunning foes before landing.

entry: POKENAME十分虚弱，完全靠电力设施散逸的能量维生。极少移动，尽可能保存能量，直到进化。
author: anonymous_moose
source: POKENAME is very weak, subsisting entirely on waste power radiated from electrical infrastructure. It moves very little, conserving what energy it can until it evolves.

entry: POKENAME的叶子能吃，铁质丰富。每三个月才落一次叶，因此在多数地方都是稀有药材。
author: firstromaniandiscoerd
source: POKENAME's leaves are edible and are very rich in iron. They shed their leaves once every three months, so POKENAME's leaves are a rare medicine in most places.

entry: POKENAME用磁性鳃吸在金属物件上。喜欢飘过小镇，附在让自己感到舒适的东西上。
author: skleegamer
source: POKENAME uses its magnetic gills to stick itself to metal objects. These Pokémon enjoy floating around small towns, attaching themselves to things they find comforting.

entry: POKENAME能用磁性鳃贴住金属，发出嗡嗡声，让自己放松入睡。成群聚在电磁能强的地区。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME's magnetic gills allow it to stick to metal. This creates a buzzing sound that relaxes it and helps it sleep. Clusters of them gather in areas with strong electromagnetic energy.

entry: POKENAME虽已不能靠磁力悬浮，耳朵上的圆环却会发光，能协助引导飞机降落。不过必须小心，因为磁铁会干扰飞机仪表。
author: mcnchsschl
source: Although it can no longer levitate magnetically, the rings on its ears glow, making POKENAME useful for guiding plane landings. However, it has to be careful, because its magnet disorients the airplane instruments.

entry: POKENAME夜间飘过发电厂，发出如鸟鸣般的哔哔声。贪婪地吞吃发现的金属碎屑。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME floats around power plants at night, making a beeping noise that sounds like chirping. It greedily eats metal scraps it finds.

entry: POKENAME会晒太阳，直到能量充沛。同时靠机械与自然方式吸收阳光，充能用不了多久。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME bask in sunlight until they are replete with energy. It does not take long for them to charge, as they rely on both mechanical and natural methods of absorbing solar rays.

entry: POKENAME用金属利牙咬住猎物，再释放威力惊人的电磁炮，让受害者失去行动能力。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME latches onto prey with its sharp metal fangs. It then unleashes a devastating Zap Cannon to incapacitate its victim.

entry: POKENAME藏在小磁怪群里，用未知方式与它们交流。会干扰附近通信线路，让线路中只剩杂讯。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME hide among swarms of Magnemite, communicating with them through unknown means. These Pokémon disrupt nearby communication lines, reducing them to static.

entry: POKENAME饥饿时磁场会减弱。便沿电线上方滑翔，吸收电力充能，恢复悬浮能力。
author: .izik
source: When hungry, POKENAME's magnetic field weakens. It glides atop powerlines, absorbing electricity to recharge and restore its levitation.

entry: POKENAME的头能转满一圈，依次转向特定角度，与同类交流。最常聚在无线电塔附近。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's head can rotate completely, communicating with others of its kind by twisting it to specific angles in sequence. Flocks tend to gather most often near radio towers.

entry: 体内有个特殊器官，容纳全部毒素与磁力。用POKENAME做的寿司若处理不当，尝起来像电池酸液，还可能致命。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Its body contains a special organ that houses all of its poison and magnetic powers. Improperly prepared POKENAME sushi tastes like battery acid and is potentially deadly.

entry: POKENAME覆钢的身体摸起来冰冷刺骨。挥爪攻击时，会让电流穿过爪子。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's steel-coated body is extremely cold to the touch. It channels electricity through its claws when striking.

entry: POKENAME的代谢需要电力。变得迟缓时，壳会展开成一根长电线，伸向输电线，或在风暴中充当避雷针。
author: oddwalls
source: POKENAME metabolism requires electricity. If it grows sluggish, its shell uncoils into a long wire, which it can extend towards power lines or use as a lightning rod during storms.

entry: POKENAME翅膀上的薄铝羽毛在滑翔时迸出火花。会先用静电扰乱空中的猎物，再发动攻击。
author: .izik
source: The thin aluminum feathers on POKENAME's wings spark as it glides. It uses static to disorient prey midair before striking.

entry: 它对磁场敏感，能充当金属探测器。很耐寒，有些训练家便用它寻找埋在雪下的遗失金属物品。
author: hophoppip
source: Its attunement to magnetic fields makes it useful as a metal detector. It's quite cold-tolerant, so some Trainers use it to find lost metal items under snow.

entry: POKENAME虽没有嘴，钢壳中却回荡着诡异吠声。风暴将近时，叫声会更响。
author: .izik
source: Though it has no mouth, eerie barks echo from POKENAME's steel shell. These sounds grow louder when storms are near.

entry: POKENAME激动时，会从长鼻喷出阵阵火花。拍动大耳降温时，磁力骤增，将金属物件吸过来。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can shoot out showers of sparks from its trunk when agitated. When it flaps its large ears to cool itself, its magnetism surges, drawing metal objects towards it.

entry: POKENAME用磁力拉来鼠标和键盘，带回巢中收集。凑够一餐后，会卸下每颗螺丝，将硬件拆开，只吃金属部分。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME collects computer hardware by pulling on mice and keyboards with its magnetic powers to bring back to its nest. Once it has enough for a meal, it removes every screw to disassemble the hardware and eats only the metallic parts.

entry: POKENAME在林间奔驰时，鹿角会发电。受惊时，则会释放强烈电击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's antlers generate electricity as it gallops through wooded areas. If startled, it releases a strong electric shock.

entry: POKENAME用尾部磁铁收集沿途金属碎片。积攒足够后，便用废料制成复杂的艺术雕塑。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses the magnet on its tail to gather up metal shards it comes across. Once it amasses enough, it makes complex art sculptures out of the accumulated scraps.

entry: POKENAME镀钨的身体始终带电，噼啪作响。只需轻轻擦过机器，就能使其过载。
author: .izik
source: Its tungsten-plated body crackles with a constant electric charge. POKENAME can overload machines just by brushing against them.

entry: 它从尾尖释放正、负电流。胸前花纹会根据哪种电流释放得更多而亮起。
author: infinex21
source: It releases positive and negative electrical currents from the tips of its tails. The patterns on its chest light up depending on which current it is releasing more of.

entry: POKENAME的奶能制成带独特金属味的奶酪。虽然营养丰富，滋味却太刺激，难以用于多数食谱。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's milk produces cheese with a distinct metallic flavor. Though nutritious, its sharp taste makes it difficult to use in most recipes.

entry: POKENAME的铝合金身体会放出电击，扰乱神经信号。受害者事后常控制不住地抽动、坐立不安。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's aluminum alloy body releases shocks that can disrupt nerve signals. Victims often twitch and fidget uncontrollably afterward.

entry: 成群POKENAME会占领周围几乎没人的工厂，用磁性尾巴附在机器上，吸收电力，让能源开支大涨。人们正在研究驱赶它们的方法。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME swarms take over factories that have little to no people in the area. They attach to machinery using their magnetic tails and absorb electricity, driving up the cost of energy. A way of repelling the swarms is currently being researched.

entry: POKENAME使用磁力后，独眼看似在流泪。其实只是在排出磁力增强时，身体产生的多余水分。
author: sk372
source: After using its magnetic powers, POKENAME appears to cry from its singular eye. In actuality, it is simply venting excess moisture created by its body when its magnetism surges.

entry: POKENAME体内含水过多时，会变得虚弱，便摩擦磁铁生热，蒸发体表的水。若不这样做，磁铁可能生锈，让它受伤。
author: brachionite
source: POKENAME can get weak if its body contains too much water, so it rubs its magnets together to create heat that evaporates any water on its body. Should it decide not to, however, the magnets might rust, and POKENAME could become injured.

entry: POKENAME双手喷出的火焰，各有特殊性质。右手的火会推开命中的对象，左手的火则会将其拉近。
author: sk372
source: The flames poured from POKENAME's hands have differing special properties. The fire from its right hand repels those it hits, while the fire from its left draws them closer.

entry: POKENAME用尾部磁铁感知附近金属矿层，调整挖洞路线，高效开采贵金属。用途至今不明。
author: .izik
source: Using its tail magnet, POKENAME senses nearby metal ore deposits. It adjusts its tunneling path to mine precious metals efficiently for an unknown purpose.

entry: 坚硬的金属身体，让POKENAME攻击力不容小觑。不过巨眼也是一大弱点，因此对战时相当不安。
author: hophoppip
source: Its hard metal body makes it a formidable attacker. Its enormous eye, however, is a major weak point, so POKENAME is quite apprehensive when it comes to battling.

entry: POKENAME似乎无法控制磁铁，磁力变化毫无规律。吸附上来的废料，常把它压得沉甸甸。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME doesn't seem to have any control over their magnets, their magnetism fluctuating unpredictably. They are often weighed down by the scrap that becomes attached to them.

entry: POKENAME头上的螺丝能显示整体心情。悲伤或生病时会沉进头里，感觉越积极，就伸得越高。
author: sk372
source: The screw on POKENAME's head reflects its overall mood. It lowers into its head when it feels sad or ill, and extends further upward the more positively it feels.

entry: POKENAME的角极为敏感，既能感知电磁波，也能感受训练家的情绪。训练家开心时，磁力就会增强。
author: nugamallow
source: POKENAME has very sensitive horns that allow it to sense electromagnetic waves and its Trainer's emotions alike. When its Trainer is happy, its magnetic pull grows stronger.

entry: POKENAME对电磁波和人类情绪都十分敏感。训练家一高兴，它便欢欣起舞。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME is acutely attuned to both electromagnetic waves and people's emotions. It dances with glee whenever its Trainer is happy.

entry: POKENAME飘在运转中的电子设备附近，它们会逐渐没电停机。随后又来到废弃的坏设备旁，让老机器重新活过来。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME floats near active electronics, which slowly power down and die near its presence. It then travels to dead, discarded electronics, whereupon the old machines spring back to life.

entry: 被POKENAME电线般的舌头舔到后，身上会暂时残留微弱磁性。它的颜色会随自身当前的极性改变。
author: sk372
source: Being licked by POKENAME's wire-like tongue temporarily leaves a faint residual magnetism on an individual. POKENAME changes its color depending on its own current polarity.

entry: 钢属性宝可梦似乎会聚到POKENAME附近。这究竟是它有意识地运用磁力和电磁波，还是融合产生的某种未知特性，至今尚无定论。
author: bobosmith01
source: Steel-Type Pokémon seem to gather around POKENAME's vicinity, but whether POKENAME is consciously using magnetism and electromagnetic waves for this to happen or if this is some unexplored quirk of Pokémon Fusion has yet to be determined.

entry: POKENAME的身体覆着厚厚的钛合金。漂过废弃工厂时，电光噼啪闪动。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body is coated with a thick titanium alloy. It crackles with electricity as it floats through abandoned factories.

entry: 奇特的POKENAME因爱炫耀而闻名全球。主体形状加上能用磁性附肢悬浮金属物件的能力，让人常误以为是飞碟。
author: big_clanker
source: The peculiar POKENAME is known across the globe for its ostentatious nature. People often think it's a flying saucer due to its main body's shape and its ability to levitate metal objects with its magnet-like appendages.

entry: POKENAME不断发出微弱磁脉冲，干扰附近一切电子设备。因这副外貌，发现它的科学家最初还以为是死去小磁怪的幽灵。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is constantly emitting a weak magnetic pulse that interferes with any electronics in its vicinity. Due to its appearance, the scientist who discovered it initially thought it was the spirit of a deceased Magnemite.

entry: POKENAME会控制损坏的电子零件，尤其是带磁性的部分。附近科技设备会迅速故障，失灵产生的杂讯会呈现出它眼睛的形状。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME take control of broken electronic parts, more specifically any parts that have a type of magnetic charge. Any technology nearby it begins to quickly break down, the static created due to malfunctioning forming into the shape of its eye.

entry: POKENAME受强电场吸引，步履沉重地在发电厂周围游荡。有电时，背上磁铁便会旋转，电场越强就转得越快。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME lumber around power plants, drawn to them by the strong electrical field. The magnets atop their back spin in the presence of electricity, spinning faster the stronger the field.

entry: POKENAME的头骨像钢铁一样硬。用磁铁吸近敌人，再用强有力的头撞击。
author: _snakeywakey_
source: POKENAME's skull is as hard as steel. POKENAME draws enemies in with its magnets and then bashes them with its powerful head.

entry: POKENAME用巨眼监视过往船只。一经发现，就用磁铁将船拉入水下，整艘吞掉。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME watch for passing ships with their massive eye. Once spotted, they will use their magnets to pull them under, consuming them whole.

entry: 巨大的磁铁剑刃能吸来数英尺外的金属。吸力极强，会将金属宝可梦和披甲者拉来刺穿。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: Its large magnet blade can attract metal to it from several feet away. The pull is so strong, it skewers metal Pokémon and those wearing armor.

entry: POKENAME各件武器的磁性，让它对战钢属性时占优。战况危急时，会向盾与剑注入高压电力，强化它们。
author: sk372
source: Magnetic charges in each of POKENAME's weapons help give it an advantage fighting Steel-types. When a battle turns desperate, it supercharges its shield and blade with electrical voltage.

entry: POKENAME的刀刃磁力极强，能精准命中可可多拉等覆着金属的敌人。爪子能刺穿实心铁块。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's blades are extremely magnetic, ensuring it hits metal-coated foes like Aron with precision. Its claws can pierce solid iron.

entry: 组成身体的铁球如电池，储存着多余电力。最爱的食物包括电池和冰箱贴。
author: melodydelune
source: The iron balls that make up its body act as batteries to store its excess power. Their favorite foods include batteries and fridge magnets.

entry: POKENAME游荡在废料场和海滩，把磁铁当金属探测器。只收集看着整洁的废料，生锈或破损的金属都丢掉。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME wander scrapyards and beaches, using their magnets like metal detectors. They only collect scrap they see as neat and clean, throwing out pieces of metal with rust and tears in them.

entry: POKENAME在陨石坠落处跳出繁复的舞步。舞蹈期间，可能用磁力拾起陨石碎片，贴在身上。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME dance around meteorite crash sites in intricate and complex patterns. During these dances, they may magnetically pick up pieces of meteorites, which stick to their bodies.

entry: POKENAME锋利的金属毛发一碰便能传毒。会用一块磁铁牢牢固定在金属物件上，再用另外两块吸来钢属性宝可梦，以电击攻击。
author: .jerden
source: Its sharp metallic hair can deliver poison on contact. POKENAME will use one of its magnets to firmly anchor itself to a metal object, then use the other two to pull in Steel-type Pokémon, which it then attacks with electrical shocks.

entry: POKENAME在城市里被视为麻烦：镀铬身体把强烈阳光反射进路人眼里，磁力又干扰电子设备。不知为何，黄昏时磁力最强。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME are considered nuisances in urban environments, where their chrome bodies reflect strong sunlight into the eyes of passersby and their magnetism disrupts electronics. For reasons unknown, their magnetism is strongest at dusk.

entry: POKENAME疾驰而过时，能快速改变磁铁极性。在工厂很有用，能接连迅速拾起、放下金属零件。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can rapidly change the polarity of their magnets when they zip by. This makes them quite useful in factory settings where they can pick up and drop metallic parts in rapid succession.

entry: POKENAME由风暴中损坏的风向标形成，能不可思议地感知飞行属性宝可梦的飞行路线。农人将它安置在田中央，召来雷电，打击啃食作物的害物。
author: ghostslythe
source: Formed from weather vanes broken in storms, POKENAME has the uncanny ability to sense Flying-type flight patterns. Farmers station them in the middle of fields, where they call down the thunder on crop-eating pests.

entry: POKENAME的磁力似乎受月相影响。新月时，甚至没有足够力量让自身悬浮。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's magnetic abilities appear to be affected by the current phase of the moon. During the new moon, it doesn't even have enough strength to levitate its own body.

entry: 据说POKENAME的毛发有很强的磁性。经常将金属物件磁化后偷走，再用赃物设陷阱，捉弄来寻找失物的人。
author: actliux
source: POKENAME's hair is said to have great magnetic properties. It will frequently magnetize metallic objects and steal them, creating traps out of the spoils to prank those who come looking for their lost property.

entry: POKENAME吸收人体的电脉冲，为自己提供动力。吸取能量会产生大量热，使金属身体部分熔化，不过它似乎毫不在意。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME can absorb the electrical impulses from people's bodies, which it uses to fuel itself. Absorbing this energy causes POKENAME to generate a lot of heat which partially melts its metal body, though it seems unfazed by this.

entry: POKENAME的电压虽只有二到五伏，哪怕没直接击中，也能让对方训练家重伤。若它喜欢自己的训练家，这位训练家就不会受影响。
author: notsaying.
source: Despite the voltage of POKENAME's electricity ranging from two to five volts, even an indirect hit can cause severe injury to opposing Trainers. If it likes them, POKENAME's Trainers will be unaffected.

entry: 野生POKENAME会尽量往金属身体上粘小磁怪。即使同时粘了许多只也不会进化，最终只好另想办法改进伪装。
author: .jerden
source: Wild POKENAME try to stick as many Magnemite as possible to their metallic bodies. POKENAME do not evolve even after attaching many Magnemite at the same time, and will eventually try to improve their disguise another way.

entry: POKENAME的许多磁铁震动时，会向四周释放热浪脉冲。身体大部分覆着细小金属毛，温度极高，一碰便会烫伤。
author: sk372
source: Vibrating POKENAME's many magnets cause it to release heat-wave pulses all around it. Most of its body is covered by small metallic hairs that are superheated and scalding to the touch.

entry: POKENAME覆银的身体在发电厂附近钻土。用磁性爪子感知矿层，前往吃掉矿物，强化甲壳。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's silver-coated body digs through dirt near power plants. It senses ore deposits with its magnetic claws, navigating to them to eat and strengthen its shell.

entry: POKENAME在深水中游动，向附近一切迅速放出电击。主要靠电击的冲击震晕附近的莲叶童子，再吃掉。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME swims through deep waters while releasing a quick Thundershock at anything nearby. It primarily uses the shockwaves to stun nearby Lotad before feeding.

entry: POKENAME的眼睛能察觉人类微弱的波导。会寻找波导善良的训练家，希望建立长久羁绊。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's eye can detect faint auras in humans. It seeks out Trainers with kind auras, hoping to form a lasting bond.

entry: POKENAME用尾巴磁铁感知盔甲鸟等猎物，再放出雷电，将飞行中的目标击落。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses the magnets on its tail to sense prey like Skarmory. It unleashes bolts of lightning to take it out mid-flight.

entry: POKENAME铝壳发出的哔哔声旋律优美，如同摇篮曲。听者常不知不觉变得困倦。
author: .izik
source: The melodic beeps from POKENAME's aluminum shell resemble a lullaby. Listeners often feel drowsy without knowing why.

entry: POKENAME覆身的钢合金带有磁性。身体略浮于地面之上，缓慢前行。
author: .izik
source: The steel alloy covering POKENAME's body is magnetically charged. It floats slightly above the ground as it trundles forward.

entry: POKENAME常在富铁沙土中挖掘，用天生磁力把铁屑吸进嘴里。容易过热，因此白天大半时间都在地下。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME are often found digging through iron-rich sand, using their inherent magnetism to attract iron filings into their mouths. They are easily overheated and thus spend most of the day underground.

entry: 维修开始前，它用磁力确保机库里的飞机排列妥当。起飞前，也会用磁场确保没有螺丝或螺栓松动。
author: quackquackattack
source: Using its magnetic powers, it makes sure planes in a hangar are properly aligned before repairs begin. Its magnetic fields ensure no screw or bolt is loose before a plane takes off.

entry: 阳光特别充足时，POKENAME的磁场强得惊人。使用它的训练家会避免穿戴金属，免得被吸进战斗。
author: gnom3
source: On very sunny days, POKENAME's magnetic field becomes incredibly strong. Trainers who use POKENAME avoid wearing metal so they will not be pulled into battles.

entry: POKENAME覆身的类铅物质摸起来很烫。即使悬在空中，也会散发微弱热量，生气时躯干还会发光。
author: .izik
source: The lead-like substance that covers POKENAME's body is hot to the touch. It radiates faint heat even while hovering in the air, and its torso glows when angry.

entry: POKENAME寻找阳光充足的高处，用磁铁吸在金属物件上。就位后，便慢慢吸取附近设备的电能。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME use their magnets to attach themselves to metal objects high off the ground, seeking out locations that receive plenty of sunlight. Once in position, they will slowly drain electrical energy from nearby devices.

entry: POKENAME受电磁波吸引，会爬到电子设备上吸电。若有人想移开它，就会射出有毒金属刺自卫。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME are attracted towards electromagnetic waves and will climb on top of electronic devices to feed on their power. If anyone tries to remove them, they will defend themselves by firing out poisonous metal thorns.

entry: POKENAME覆着钨镀层，在沙漠里游动，如同在水中滑行，寻找遗落废料与猎物。
author: .izik
source: Coated in tungsten plating, POKENAME swims through desert sands as if gliding through water, searching for lost scrap and prey.

entry: 洞穴中若听见尖锐的杂讯，那便是POKENAME捕猎时的叫声。一口就能送入使猎物麻痹的电击，让它吸血时，对方无从逃脱。
author: sk372
source: If one hears the sound of high-pitched static in a cave, it is the call of a POKENAME on the hunt. A single bite delivers a paralyzing jolt, ensuring prey won't escape it as it feeds on their blood.

entry: POKENAME经过之处会留下磁场扰动，使附近电子设备失灵。许多人说，音响设备受干扰后，声音失真得像人在哭。
author: metcassette
source: POKENAME leave behind magnetic disturbances where they travel, causing nearby electronics to malfunction. Many report the distortions caused in audio equipment to resemble human crying.

entry: POKENAME常出现在工厂，抱着机器咬下去，吸取电力。吸得很少，几乎可以忽略，多数企业便任它吃饱后离开。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is often spotted within factories, clinging to machinery and biting into it to siphon electricity. The amount drained is tiny and negligible, so most businesses simply let them have their fill and move on.

entry: POKENAME飞行时发出磁脉冲，帮助定位可可多拉等钢属性宝可梦。会无声掠过旧采石场，俯冲捕猎。
author: .izik
source: As it flies, POKENAME emits a magnetic pulse that helps it locate Steel-type Pokémon like Aron. It swoops silently through old quarries to hunt.

entry: POKENAME的身体覆着薄金属板。若不小心被踩到，就会引发巨大的电力爆炸。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body is coated with a thin metal plate. If accidentally stepped on, it causes a massive electrical explosion.

entry: POKENAME能从磁铁发出电磁波脉冲，击退想捕食它的敌人，连最大的也不例外。它会粗暴地破坏五金店商品，吃掉电池，是店家的公认祸害。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME is able to repel even the largest of foes that try to hunt it by sending a pulse of electromagnetic waves from its magnet. It is a known menace for hardware stores since it aggressively destroys their products to feed on the batteries.

entry: POKENAME用头尾磁铁感知铁，判断是否带电。转动脸底部的螺丝，便能发出电磁脉冲，将大型天敌定在原地。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME uses the magnets on its head and tail to sense iron and determine whether they have any electrical charges. By spinning the screws at the bottom of its face, it can send electromagnetic pulses that can freeze large predators in place.

entry: 身上的凸钉让它难以滚动，移动时反而弹跳。因此喜欢沿高架电线滚行，利用凸钉引导方向。
author: oddwalls
source: The studs on its body make rolling difficult, causing it to bounce when moving. For this reason, it prefers to roll along overhead power lines, where the studs act as guides.

entry: 野生POKENAME喜欢附在某些洞穴墙壁、顶上的磁性矿脉，也喜欢金属桥底。它们不擅攀爬，常抓不牢，途经此处的旅人必须小心。
author: novembermagnus
source: Wild POKENAME enjoy clinging to veins of magnetic ore running through the walls and ceilings of certain caves, as well as the undersides of metal bridges. Travelers in these areas must take care, as this inexperienced climber loses its grip often.

entry: POKENAME能将磁力化作灌注幽灵能量的强力电击。命中时冰冷刺骨，却很少伤到身体，反而让灵魂本身感到寒意。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME is able to wield magnetism in the form of potent electrical bolts that are infused with spectral energies. These bolts feel as cold as ice to those they strike but rarely do physical harm, instead chilling the very soul.

entry: 头上的叶子其实是条状锂箔。沾水后会剧烈反应，释放出危险的大量能量。
author: gp423
source: The leaves on its head are actually strips of lithium foil. If exposed to water, these leaves react violently and release dangerous amounts of energy.

entry: POKENAME常见于大都市中心，在垃圾里翻找电子设备吃。在建筑工地和作业区也很受欢迎，因为会搜遍地面，清走金属碎屑。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is a common sight in metropolitan centers, where it scrounges in trash for electronics to consume. It is also a well-liked inhabitant of construction sites and work zones since it will scour the ground for metal debris.

entry: POKENAME生活懒散，很少移动。通常住在植物丛生的废楼，从花中喷出有毒磁尘云，驱赶他者。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME lives a very indolent lifestyle and rarely moves about much. Found typically in abandoned buildings overgrown with plants, it dispenses a noxious cloud of magnetic dust from its flower to repel others.

entry: POKENAME一生中逐渐长大。身体吸来螺丝、回形针等小金属件，融入自身，增加体量。
author: mellowmuse
source: Over the span of its life, POKENAME gradually grows in size. Its body attracts small bits of metal such as screws or paperclips, which it incorporates into its mass.

entry: POKENAME外露的电线与僵硬抽动的动作，显示运转效率并不理想。经常从机器偷零件，寻找能改善自身效率的科技部件。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's exposed wiring and stiff, jerky movements suggest it is not operating at peak efficiency. It regularly pilfers machines for their parts, searching for bits of technology to help fix its inefficiencies.

entry: POKENAME的核心以磁力托起四肢。四肢由实心铁构成，挥击的力量骇人。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's limbs are held aloft by the magnetism of its core. They're made of solid iron and can strike with terrifying force.

entry: POKENAME附在船壳上，一边搭船赶路，一边吃锈。清锈效率出色，许多水手都任它留在船上。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME attach themselves to the hulls of ships, using them as a means of transportation while feeding on the rust. Many sailors let these Pokémon stay on their ships due to how efficiently they can clean off rust.

entry: POKENAME以磁场贴住铁墙，再从那里做出复杂翻转动作，精准出击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME clings to iron walls using its magnetic field. From there, it launches intricate flips and strikes with precision.

entry: POKENAME以磁爪抓住彼此。空旷田野上，常能看见环成圈的POKENAME，试着产生电力。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME clings to each other using their magnetic claws. Rings of POKENAME can be seen in open fields trying to generate electrical power.

entry: POKENAME用背部磁铁辨别方向，穿行复杂的洞穴群。独眼周围长着三朵小蘑菇，常挡住视线。
author: oddwalls
source: POKENAME uses the magnets on its back to orient itself and navigate complex cave systems. Three small mushrooms surround its lone eye, often interfering with its vision.

entry: POKENAME的金属蘑菇会产生磁性孢子，被自身磁力排斥出去。孢子再附上其他钢属性宝可梦，随其远行，最后转移到其他金属表面。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's metallic mushroom produces magnetic spores, which are repelled by POKENAME's own magnetism. These spores then attach to other Steel-type Pokémon and can be carried for long distances before being transferred onto other metal surfaces.

entry: POKENAME常附在沉船和其他废金属上，吃掉铁锈，留下亮得惊人的表面。若遭挑衅，会从尾巴释放电击。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are often found attached to shipwrecks and other scraps of metal, eating the rust off them and leaving them remarkably shiny. If provoked, they can release an electric shock from their tails.

entry: POKENAME细小的金属纤维磁性很强。走路时会吸来废罐头，再快速抖动身体，把垃圾甩掉。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's tiny metal fibers are highly magnetic. It attracts discarded cans as it walks, shaking rapidly to dislodge the trash.

entry: POKENAME会在废工厂工作，给周围宝可梦随意制作小饰物。做出的东西常像秋季庆典用的蜡烛或灯笼。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can be found working in abandoned factories making random trinkets for Pokémon around them. These trinkets often resemble candles or lanterns that are used during festivals that occur during the fall season.

entry: POKENAME夜间常飞向路灯。可一到近处，磁场就会让灯立刻熄灭，于是又飞向下一处光源。
author: brachionite
source: POKENAME is often seen at night flying towards streetlights. However, once it reaches the light, its magnetic field causes the light to turn off immediately. Afterwards POKENAME flies towards another light source.

entry: POKENAME一生气，磁力就会失控。进食前，总会先把要吃的食物完全烧焦，或熔成液体。
author: bobosmith01
source: Whenever it is angry, POKENAME's magnetic powers go haywire. It first either completely burns or liquifies the food it is going to eat before consumption.

entry: POKENAME掠过岩石地带，寻找金属碎屑吃。喜欢在海滩寻宝的训练家常与它搭档，旅途中一起搜寻遗失物品。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME sweeps over rocky terrain in search of metallic detritus to consume. Beachcombing Trainers will often partner with one to scavenge lost items during their journey.

entry: POKENAME朝地面发射声波，露出矿石来吃。由三个个体合为一体，因此击穿坚岩的能力比先前形态更强。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME blasts sonic waves at the ground to uncover ore to consume. Since three entities make up the unified Pokémon, its ability to blast through solid rock is stronger than its previous form.

entry: POKENAME喜欢收集闪亮金属物件。磁性胡须能轻松找出小玩意，再囤进巢穴。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME loves collecting shiny metal objects. Its magnetic whiskers help it find the trinkets easily, after which it hoards them in its den.

entry: POKENAME用一对磁铁感知电磁波，察觉机器与电子设备的存在。某些电子频率似乎会惹恼它，让它挥爪打向无人看管、留在柜台上的手机。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME can sense electromagnetic waves with their twin magnets, allowing them to feel the presence of machinery and electronics. Specific electronic frequencies appear to annoy them, prompting them to swipe at phones left unattended on counters.

entry: POKENAME的磁性尾巴会粘住各种金属物件。周围磁场强时，头内压力会不断增长，直到头痛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a magnetic tail that sticks to all sorts of metallic objects. Whenever there is a strong magnetic field around them, the pressure inside their head grows until they experience a headache.

entry: POKENAME的磁性双脚，能让它倒挂着沿金属天花板奔跑。能检查难以抵达处的电路故障，是发电厂工程师的宝贵帮手。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME's magnetic feet allow them to run upside down along metallic ceilings. They are invaluable to engineers working within power plants, able to search out electrical faults in hard to reach places.

entry: POKENAME用火焰吐息协助工厂工人焊接金属零件。乡村音乐电台发出的电磁频率，似乎能提高它工作时的热情。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME uses its fire breath to help factory workers weld metal parts. It seems that the electromagnetic frequencies emitted by country music radio stations boost its enthusiasm during working hours.

entry: POKENAME结合电磁操控与巨翅飞行。会定期停在发电机顶，为磁场充能；大群同时来访，有时会使发电量明显下跌。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME fly through a combination of electromagnetic manipulation and huge wings. They periodically roost on top of power generators to recharge their magnetic fields, large flights of them sometimes causing a noticeable dip in energy production.

entry: POKENAME结合电磁操控与巨翅飞行。会定期停在发电机顶，为磁场充能；大群同时来访，有时会使发电量明显下跌。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME fly through a combination of electromagnetic manipulation and huge wings. They periodically roost on top of power generators to recharge their magnetic fields, large flights of them sometimes causing a noticeable dip in energy production.

entry: POKENAME会在废弃工厂喝油、吃金属废料。近来被用来清理受污染的水域。
author: big_clanker
source: POKENAME can be found drinking oil and eating metal scraps at abandoned factories. Recently, they've been used to clean up polluted waters.

entry: 生活在海中的奇异金属宝可梦。会用磁铁吸住船只，借船快速移动。
author: theheroict
source: A strange, metallic Pokémon that can be found under the waves. It uses magnets to hang on to ships for quick transport.

entry: 成群POKENAME用磁铁吸住船壳，轻松完成长途迁徙。因此，世界各大海洋都能发现它们。
author: santon5512
source: Groups of POKENAME attach themselves to the hulls of ships using their magnets, migrating great distances with little effort. As a result, these Pokémon can be found in every ocean.

entry: POKENAME的身体包在厚厚的铁矿石中。靠猛烈的磁力爆发悬浮，身后常留下碎裂岩石。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body is encased in thick iron ore. It levitates using violent magnetic bursts, often leaving shattered rocks in its wake.

entry: POKENAME小跑时，体内机械会产生越来越多电力。速度与能量达到最高时，头上与身后的螺丝便不断涌出闪电。
author: sk372
source: As POKENAME trots along, mechanisms in its body churn up greater and greater amounts of electricity. At max speed and energy, lighting courses constantly from the screw on its head and the one on its rear.

entry: 这种宝可梦靠黑色黏汗在各种表面滑动，水面也不例外。汗液是油与金属屑的混合物，磁性极强，会对各种金属物件产生反应。
author: big_clanker
source: This Pokémon uses its black, viscous sweat to slide around all surfaces, including water. This liquid is a mixture of oil and metal shavings, making it extremely magnetic and reactive to any kind of metallic object.

entry: POKENAME覆身的金属磁性极强。常有人报告，它粘在无线电天线上，花了好几小时才弄下来。
author: .izik
source: The metal that coats POKENAME's body is extremely magnetic. There are many reports of it getting stuck to radio antennas, taking hours to dislodge.

entry: POKENAME与工厂里的宝可梦合作，制造金属零件。会在宝可梦与工厂主管之间传递信号，确保一切运作顺利。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME collaborate with Pokémon that work inside factories to produce metallic parts. They relay signals between Pokémon and factory overseers to ensure everything runs smoothly.

entry: POKENAME游累后，便用磁铁夹住经过的潜水艇，在水下静静随行很长一段路。
author: .izik
source: When tired of swimming, POKENAME clamps its magnet onto passing submarines. It drifts silently along for long stretches underwater.

entry: POKENAME的黏液身体带磁性，能慢慢沿金属物体向上爬。若不慎吸来别的东西，就会用磁铁将其斥开。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME's slimy body is magnetic, allowing it to slowly move up metal objects. Its magnets repel any objects it inadvertently attracts.

entry: 磁性黏液难以穿透，因此POKENAME遇险时会用它包住眼睛。常见于废料场或工厂。
author: chorb33
source: Its magnetic slime is difficult to penetrate, allowing POKENAME to encase its eye if in danger. It is often found in scrap yards or factories.

entry: 帕底亚附近的一个地区，流传着庞大巨人牧养巨型咩利羊的传说。那些巨型咩利羊与POKENAME颇为相似。它以背上巨炮能高速喷出液体而闻名。
author: big_clanker
source: In a region close to Paldea, there is a legend of hulking titans that would shepherd giant Mareep not too dissimilar to these Pokémon. POKENAME are known for shooting fluids out of their giant back cannons at high velocities.

entry: 这种宝可梦的双手如强力磁铁，能拆离身体，在不远处操控。喜欢用手干扰设备，捉弄他者，同时也吸电维生。
author: infinex21
source: This Pokémon's hands function like powerful magnets which it can detach and control at a slight distance. It loves to prank others by using its hands to disrupt devices, though it also siphons electricity to feed itself.

entry: 它们用磁性双手干扰设备，吸收其中电力。将双手靠拢，就能把电力与磁力凝成强大的攻击。
author: infinex21
source: They use their magnetic hands to disrupt devices and absorb electricity from them. By bringing their hands together, they can condense electricity and magnetism into powerful attacks.

entry: POKENAME用主体周围的磁铁，捕捉最爱的猎物大丁。会穿行阴影，等待袭击敌人的最佳时机。
author: _cradily_
source: The magnets surrounding the main body are used by POKENAME to hunt their favourite prey, Probobuff. POKENAME move through the shadows, waiting for the perfect moment to attack their foes.

entry: POKENAME的磁力足以让全身吸在居住的洞顶。它好奇地从上方垂下来，想看得更近，吓过不少训练家。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's magnetism is strong enough to keep its entire body attached to the ceiling of its cave dwellings. More than a few Trainers have been spooked by a curious POKENAME dangling from above to get a closer look.

entry: POKENAME的身体是实心金属，却能用超能力，像有机宝可梦一样活动。目击者常说，这副景象令人不安。
author: linhasxoc
source: POKENAME's body is solid metal, but it uses its psychic powers to move like an organic Pokémon. Observers frequently report this as disturbing.

entry: 它用磁铁吸取低功耗电子设备的能量。许多训练家把手机留在POKENAME够得到的地方，被吸干电池，暂时困在当地。
author: linhasxoc
source: It uses its magnet to siphon energy from electronics that are in a low power state. Many Trainers have been temporarily stranded because they left their phone where a POKENAME could drain its battery.

entry: POKENAME成群聚在发电厂吸电，还用磁爪收集废金属，拿作剑矛等武器。
author: mistymagius
source: Swarms of POKENAME gather around power plants to siphon off their electricity. They use their magnetic claws to collect scrap metal to use as a form of weaponry such as swords or spears.

entry: POKENAME的钳中嵌有磁铁，能应指令猛然夹紧。可夹紧之后，自己也很难再掰开。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have magnets embedded in its claws, which snap shut on command. It has difficulties prying its claws open after snapping them closed.

entry: POKENAME常与大钳磁怪合作，维护潜水艇。定期通过声波接收大钳磁怪的报告，再负责修好船上的各处故障。
author: bradlybro199
source: POKENAME are often used to maintain submarines in tandem with Krabmite. POKENAME receive regular reports from Krabmite via sound wave, and are tasked with repairing anything that's wrong with the vessel.

entry: POKENAME的钳几乎就像金属探测器，能搜寻沙下被冲上岸的废料。会挖出金属吃掉，吸收进自身。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME claws act almost like metal detectors, allowing them to search for washed-up scrap beneath the sand. They will dig up this metal and consume it, absorbing the metals into their own bodies.

entry: POKENAME能用磁性钳子吸住船只，极性随心改变。钳子一夹紧，几乎不可能强行掰开。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can cling to ships using its magnetic claws, which can reverse polarity at a whim. When its claws are snapped closed, it is nearly impossible to pry them apart by force.

entry: POKENAME在发电厂成灾，吸取发电机电力，啃咬电气外壳与线缆。必须持续管理，才能妥善控制这种害物。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME infest power plants, draining electricity from generators and chewing at electrical casing and cables. They're a pest that require constant management to properly handle.

entry: POKENAME睡觉时，用磁铁吸在发电厂椽梁上。一见入侵者，便落到对方身上爆炸。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME sticks to power plant rafters when sleeping by using its magnets. If it sees an intruder, it drops onto them to explode.

entry: POKENAME睡觉时磁铁朝外，以感知四周。受惊后，爆炸威力足以夷平一栋建筑。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME sleeps with its magnets facing outward to stay aware of its surroundings. If startled, it can explode with enough force to level a building.

entry: 三合一磁怪恰由三个个体组成，POKENAME却被不稳定磁力牵合，结构更加混乱拥挤。形态难以预测，也让它更难控制。
author: rakunk
source: Unlike Magneton, which is formed from exactly three, POKENAME is much more chaotic and crowded, being drawn together by unstable magnetic forces. Its unpredictable structure makes this Pokémon far harder to control.

entry: POKENAME覆钢的双腿能伸长至15英尺。用飞膝踢，就能轻易把飞行宝可梦从空中踢下来。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's steel-coated legs can extend up to 15 feet. It can easily kick a Flying Pokémon out of the sky with a Hi Jump Kick.

entry: POKENAME由成簇缠乱、磨损的电线组成。集中磁力时，会漏出零散火花。试图制造附属身体，帮助引导力量，却至今没有成功。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Assembled from clusters of tangled-up and worn-out wires, POKENAME release stray sparks when they try to focus their magnetic powers. They attempt to construct satellite bodies to help channel their powers, but none have succeeded so far.

entry: POKENAME的壳坚韧，导电性极佳，非常适合制造电池。进化后会留下外壳，随后被人收集。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME's shell is tough and highly conductive, making it perfect for use in battery-making. As these Pokémon evolve, their shell is left behind and subsequently collected.

entry: POKENAME的三具身体产生磁能，为翅膀充能。能向空中散布金属粉尘，再强力放电，电击困在粉尘中的一切。
author: memjettoaster
source: POKENAME's wings are charged by the magnetic energy produced by its three bodies. It can scatter metallic dust through the air, then use powerful electrical discharges to shock anything caught within the dust.

entry: POKENAME依靠同一股力量，既维系身体，也吸住水下金属。多只附在同一条船上时，会逐渐越吸越近，直到相互接触。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's body is held together by the same force it uses to cling to submerged metal. If multiple POKENAME attach to the same ship, they will gradually be pulled closer and closer together until they touch.

entry: 雷暴中，POKENAME会朝空中挥臂，希望挨雷劈。身体由薄薄的导电钢合金构成。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME swings its arms into the air during thunderstorms, hoping to get struck by lightning. Its body is made up of a thin steel alloy that conducts electricity.

entry: POKENAME在发电厂变成各种杂物，无人注意时才恢复本形吸电。暴露在强磁场中，也会恢复本形。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME transforms into miscellaneous objects within power plants, reverting to its true form to absorb power when no one is looking. It will also revert if exposed to a high magnetic field.

entry: POKENAME用磁力吸来金属物件，加固甲壳。也能将它们排斥出去，从壳上发射，作为远程武器。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME uses its magnetism to attract metal objects to reinforce its shell. In addition, these metal objects can be repelled and fired off of the shell as ranged weapons.

entry: 主头完全掌控POKENAME，但两把镰刀的根部还嵌着两个较小的意识。共享的神经连接，让它能更精准地攻击。
author: xiapher
source: While the main head has full control, POKENAME has two smaller minds imbedded into the base of its scythes. The shared neural connection makes POKENAME able to make more precise strikes.

entry: POKENAME依靠翼膜中的磁场悬在空中，不太需要拍翅。偶尔动起翅膀，便会干扰附近一切电子设备。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME suspends itself in the air through the power of magnetic fields located within the membranes of its wings, limiting the need to flap. In rare moments when it moves its wings, the flapping disrupts any nearby electronics.

entry: POKENAME打盹时磁力剧增，贪睡的习惯能在城市造成大乱。五十英尺内的一切金属都会被吸来粘住，直到醒来。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's sleepy mannerism can cause havoc in urban areas, as its magnetism increases drastically while snoozing. Anything metallic within fifty feet will be drawn in and stuck to it until it wakes up.

entry: 它能靠自身产生的磁力飞行，背部周围磁力最强。虽然通常想帮助他者，磁力却常惹出更多麻烦。
author: infinex21
source: It can fly using the magnetism its own body generates, which is strongest around its back. Though it usually tries to help others, its magnetism tends to cause more problems.

entry: POKENAME懒躺在街机顶上，偶尔拍走想附上来的电电虫。无聊时，便把尾巴搭在机台上，用磁铁搅乱电子信号取乐。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME lounge atop arcade cabinets, occasionally batting away Joltik that try to attach to them. Whenever they are bored, POKENAME rest their tail on the cabinets, scrambling the electronic signals with their magnets for fun.

entry: POKENAME有强大的磁感应器与三只巨眼，对周围极为敏锐。据说，即使数英里外移动的小虫，也逃不过视线。
author: sk372
source: With potent magnetic sensors and three giant powerful eyes, POKENAME has acute awareness of its surroundings. It is said even tiny insects moving miles away won't escape its sight.

entry: 四片磁性翅膀快速拍动，会积蓄强大电荷。它定期放电，避免把自己电到。
author: .jerden
source: The rapid movement of its four magnetic wings causes a powerful electric charge to build up. It regularly discharges electricity to avoid shocking itself.

entry: POKENAME被强磁力紧压成一体，周围形成保护场。众多眼睛赋予它完美视野，即使身处极高空也看得清。
author: sim.n
source: POKENAME is pressed together by a strong magnetic force, creating a protective field around it. Its many eyes grant it flawless vision, even from the highest skies.

entry: POKENAME周围漂浮的眼睛，会以心灵感应将视觉信息传回。最远能派到100米外，在间谍工作中极有价值。见到心怀不善的人，眼球就会亮起红光。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: The floating eyes that surround POKENAME relay visual information telepathically to POKENAME. It can send them up to 100m away, making it a very valuable Pokémon in espionage. If it sees an unkind person, the orbs glow red.

entry: 这些宝可梦生来就是手足，如今形影不离。飞行、吃饭，连睡觉都在一起。
author: dodoowner_
source: These Pokémon were born as siblings and are now inseparable. They fly together, eat together, and even sleep together.

entry: POKENAME有三个头，建巢高效，能留更多时间育幼。可偏爱用电线做材料，数量多的城市因此大受困扰。
author: katieplaysgames
source: With three heads, POKENAME are efficient at constructing dwellings and can devote more time to raising their young. Unfortunately, their preferred building material is electrical wire, causing major issues in cities where they are abundant.

entry: POKENAME常见于废料场，完全以金属为食。进食时，身上的眼睛负责监视天敌，一见危险便能迅速逃走。
author: santon5512
source: Often found in scrapyards, POKENAME's diet consists entirely of metal. The eyes on their bodies keep watch for predators they eat, letting them quickly flee at the first sight of danger.

entry: 被另外三只同类吸引过去后，POKENAME发生了进化。背上虽顶着灯泡，脑袋可没因此变得更“亮”。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME evolved because it got pulled towards three others of its kind. Even with the lightbulb on their backs, they aren't very bright.

entry: POKENAME住在废料场，搜寻废金属与电子设备。磁性牙齿将金属拉进嘴里，磨碎后吸收进身体。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME reside in scrapyards, scavenging for scrap and electronics. Their magnetic teeth pull metal into their mouths, which is ground down and absorbed into their bodies.

entry: POKENAME几乎总是群居，用磁铁相连，组成各种形状与字母。曾发现多达300只聚在一起，排列成复杂的网状螺旋。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME almost always live in groups, attaching together by their magnets to form various shapes and letters. Groups of up to 300 have been found, forming complex, web-like spirals.

entry: POKENAME两颗头的磁铁极性相反。必须小心，不让彼此靠得太近，否则可能吸住分不开。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME's magnets are charged so that each head has the opposite polarity to the other. They have to take great care not to let their heads get too close to one another, as they risk getting stuck if they do.

entry: POKENAME夜间无声滑翔，寻找最爱的食物梦歌仙人掌。坚硬金属身体能挡住对方的尖刺。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME soundlessly glides at night, searching for their favorite food, Cacturne. Their tough, metallic bodies protect them from the Pokémon's sharp spines.

entry: 磁性器官让多只POKENAME粘成大团。这样的群体，最多可有30只。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Its magnetic organ caused several POKENAME to be stuck together in large clumps. These groups can number up to 30.

entry: 身体部件形状不规则，让POKENAME不停旋转。转动造成的晕动症常令它头昏眼花。
author: staghorn
source: The irregular shape of POKENAME's body components means it is constantly spinning. They are often dazed due to the resulting motion sickness.

entry: POKENAME的三颗头必须保持磁力均衡，才能发挥最佳表现。偶尔一颗头磁力更强，就会把移动方向拉向那边。
author: sk372
source: The magnetic pull of POKENAME's three heads needs to remain equal to function at its best. Occasionally one head will exhibit greater strength than the others, pulling POKENAME's movement in that direction.

entry: POKENAME的身体覆着厚铝层。带金属气味的深蓝毒液在体内流动，咬住敌人后便会注入。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body is coated in a thick aluminum. A metal-scented dark blue venom courses through its body, which it dispenses after biting a foe.

entry: 一对小磁怪紧跟POKENAME，事事协力。有人推测，它们的磁波产生共鸣，连起心智，让三者能如一体般思考。
author: sk372
source: A pair of Magnemite follow POKENAME closely, working together in all things. Some theorize that their magnetic waves have resonated and linked them together mentally, allowing all three to think as one.

entry: 它飞过夜空，磁性身体干扰星球的磁层，形成灿烂的彩虹色极光。
author: hophoppip
source: As it soars through the night sky, its magnetic body interferes with the planet's magnetosphere. The result is a brilliant rainbow-colored aurora.

entry: POKENAME的两颗头磁极相同，不断互相排斥，只靠中间的黑色线缆才不会飘散。它们一同迁徙，寻找相反磁极。
author: leandermalurt
source: The two heads of POKENAME are both the same magnetic pole, constantly repelling each other. Only the black cord between them keeps them from drifting apart. They migrate together in search of an opposite magnetic pole.

entry: 模块化的身体，让它能为自己加装对焦镜等配件。选定目标后，对焦镜会优化瞄准系统，提高命中精度。
author: quackquackattack
source: Its modular body allows it to attach modifications to itself, such as a Zoom Lens. Once it chooses a target, the Zoom Lens refines the targeting system to improve accuracy.

entry: POKENAME双臂分别放出蓝、红两色火焰。喷火时，腿上的头会发出磁脉冲，拉近敌人，让火焰更容易烧中对手。
author: sk372
source: Each of POKENAME's arms dispenses a different color of flame, blue or red. The heads on its legs emit a magnetic pulse that pulls foes closer while it shoots flame, ensuring greater chances to burn its opponent.

entry: POKENAME住在城市，偏爱高处的能源，能不受干扰地吸食。在工地，会将重物吸在身体下方，飞往不同楼层，充当快速运输工具。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME inhabit urban areas where they are attracted to lofty energy sources they can feed on without being disturbed. They are utilized in work sites as rapid transportation by magnetizing heavy objects to their underside and flying between levels.

entry: POKENAME就像有意识的搭电线，会夹住想充电的东西，再用尾巴从附近物体抽取电力。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Acting as a sort of sentient jumper cable, POKENAME clamp onto things they want charged and use their tail to drain power from objects nearby.

entry: POKENAME在山区钻掘，寻找金属矿层。吃得越多，电力攻击就越强。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME digs through mountainous regions searching for metal ore deposits. The more it eats, the stronger its electric attacks become.

entry: POKENAME的三个意识同步行动，如同一体，却各自能独立思考。各单元完全协调时，会发出谐波脉冲，扭曲附近能量场。
author: eiskitsune
source: POKENAME is three synchronised minds acting as one, each capable of independent thought. When each unit is perfectly aligned, this Pokémon emits a harmonic pulse that distorts nearby energy fields.

entry: POKENAME用电磁波控制周围其他带磁性的宝可梦。通常不动声色，偶尔也会打破面无表情的模样，和训练家一起微笑。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME use electromagnetic waves to control other magnetic Pokémon around them. They are typically stoic Pokémon, but sometimes break their emotionless exterior to smile alongside their Trainer.

entry: POKENAME的三颗头共享一个意识，能观察广阔范围，瞬间传递信息。通常有一颗头总紧跟训练家，确保对方安全。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's three heads share a single mind, allowing it to survey a large range while transmitting information instantly. Typically, one head will always stick close to its Trainer to make sure they are protected.

entry: POKENAME的腿会与金属表面相斥，使它能迅速滑过。常出现在工厂和发电厂，来回搬运沉重机器零件。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME's legs repel off of any metal surface, allowing these Pokémon to swiftly glide across them. These Pokémon are often found in factories and power plants, carrying heavy machine parts back and forth.

entry: POKENAME产生的磁力能吸引大多数金属，非磁性金属则由幽灵能量控制。眼睛相互碰撞时，会发出电磁脉冲，让附近科技设备立刻失灵。
author: bigoljax
source: The magnetic charge created by POKENAME can attract most metals, with its spiritual energy taking control of non-magnetic metals. When its eyes collide together, it causes a electromagnetic pulse, causing nearby technology to instantly break down.

entry: POKENAME产生强磁场，将背部中央柱周围漂浮的磁铁固定住。积蓄力量攻击时，磁铁会绕柱高速旋转。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The magnets floating around the central pylon on the backs of POKENAME are held in place by the powerful magnetic field the Pokémon generates. When they generate power to attack, the magnets spin around their pylon at high speed.

entry: 野生POKENAME捉弄其他宝可梦的视频，因顽皮天性而在网上走红。不知为何，它们尤其爱拿电属性宝可梦开玩笑。
author: klgb76
source: Because of their mischievous nature, videos of wild POKENAME pranking other Pokémons became very popular on the internet. For some unknown reason, it seems Electric-type Pokémons are their favourite victims.

entry: POKENAME笑呵呵的模样下，藏着用磁力限制他者行动的恶作剧高手。人们认为，它操控血中铁质，好靠近咬上一口。因这副外表，在帕底亚很受欢迎。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's jovial look hides a trickster that uses magnetism to limit others' movements, thought to be via manipulation of iron content within blood, so it can get close enough to bite. It's become popular in Paldea due to its appearance.

entry: POKENAME覆身的磁铁会在巨脸前形成电力护盾，挡开敌人攻击。它耐心教导后代，寻找成长所需的钴与硅。
author: fiordaliso
source: The magnets covering its body form an electrical shield over its massive face, capable of deflecting enemy attacks. POKENAME patiently teaches its offspring how to find the cobalt and silicon they need to grow.

entry: POKENAME头上的金属球各有一只眼，让它能同时看向四面八方。用银色刀刃斩击靠得太近的敌人。
author: .izik
source: The metal spheres on POKENAME's head each have their own eye, allowing it to view all directions at once. It uses its silver blades to slash at foes who get too close.

entry: POKENAME长得像帕底亚一位知名主播，因此很受那位主播的粉丝欢迎。
author: melodydelune
source: Resembling the look of a popular streamer from Paldea, POKENAME has become a popular among fans of the streamer.

entry: POKENAME悬在海上，发出扭曲电磁场、扰乱天气的脉冲。现身后，常接着出现突如其来的风暴和设备故障。
author: segmoph
source: POKENAME hovers over the sea, emitting pulses that distort electromagnetic fields and disrupt weather patterns. Its presence is often followed by sudden storms and failing equipment.

entry: 多出的头与磁铁，让POKENAME不停把一切金属吸过来。很难清掉身上废料，才刚拔下，就又被磁铁吸回。
author: bigoljax
source: Due to their extra heads and magnets, POKENAME constantly pull anything metallic towards them. They struggle to take metal off of their bodies, as their magnets constantly attract and pull back scrap they've just pulled off.

entry: POKENAME的三颗头控制不同元素，能将其合成强大的三重攻击，摧毁大多数东西。不过，控冰能力最强，通常用来防御。
author: infinex21
