source: The three heads of POKENAME control different elements, which it combines into powerful Tri Attacks capable of laying waste to most things. Its control over ice is strongest, however, and is how it will typically defend itself.

entry: POKENAME的三具身体始终以脚或手臂相连，移动起来像在共舞。四肢都有磁性，有时会在钢制高塔或无线电塔侧面跳舞。
author: .jerden
source: Constantly connected to each other by either their feet or arms, POKENAME's three bodies move as if dancing together. All of their limbs are magnetic, and they will sometimes be found dancing on the side of steel pylons or radio towers.

entry: POKENAME在工厂接连快速拾起、放下金属零件。工人会帮忙给翅膀上油，保证运转顺畅。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME work in factories where they pick up and drop metallic parts in rapid succession. Factory workers help them keep their wings lubricated with oil to ensure smooth performance.

entry: 将POKENAME接上插座，就能变成明亮又好用的吊灯，却也让房内电子设备无法使用。多条手臂想要摇摆，却常相互打结。
author: soup1900
source: While plugging POKENAME into an outlet makes it a great, bright chandelier, it also makes electronics in the room unusable. Its many arms often knot with each other as they try to sway around.

entry: POKENAME用周围捡到的金属制作迷你小磁怪。这些小磁铁贴在覆身的柔韧金属片上，下面还常伸出一只影子手，将它们揭下，再贴回去。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME craft their own mini-Magnemite from metal they find around them. These small magnets stick to the flexible sheet of metal covering POKENAME, and will frequently be pulled off and stuck back on by a shadowy hand emerging from underneath it.

entry: POKENAME的三只眼发出相互干扰的磁波，严重削弱视力。只好靠头部磁铁发出另一种波长的波，感知四周。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's three eyes emit magnetic waves that interfere with each other, severely diminishing its vision. It has to resort to using a different sort of wavelength from the magnet on its head to sense its surroundings.

entry: POKENAME用可塑的磁流体构造身体，以磁力操纵触须。它的存在会扭曲、扰乱电场，可能造成全城停电。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME create a body out of a malleable ferrofluid, using their magnetic powers to manipulate the tendrils. Their presence warps and disrupts electrical fields and can cause city-wide blackouts.

entry: POKENAME顺时针转动齿轮时，身体的磁性会持续增强。转向相反方向，磁力则会减弱。
author: .izik
source: While turning its gears clockwise, POKENAME's body steadily becomes more magnetic. Should it turn the other direction, its magnetic abilities fade.

entry: POKENAME用磁铁吸在工业建筑的机器上，吸取能量。磁力太强，最多得五名成年人合力，才能将它拉下。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its magnets to stick to machinery in industrial buildings to absorb energy. It can take up to five full-grown humans to pull it off the machine due to its powerful magnets.

entry: POKENAME用四肢的强磁力吸近钢属性宝可梦。进入范围后，四肢便长出电线触须，紧紧缠住，压碎对方。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses powerful magnetism from its limbs to draw in Steel-type Pokémon. Once they are within range, its limbs sprout wire tendrils to wrap and crush them beneath an intensely tight grip.

entry: POKENAME飞过洞窟时会迸出细小火花。借同类协助使出音爆，再成群围攻敌人。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME makes tiny sparks as it flies through caverns. It unleashes Sonic Boom with the aid of others of its kind before swarming a foe.

entry: POKENAME在发电厂屋顶安家。夜晚飞出，寻找齿轮儿等猎物。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME makes its home in the roofs of power plants. At night, it flies out to search for prey like Klink.

entry: POKENAME两侧的单元能独立于中央单元旋转，让它快速而精准地移动。凸钉会滴下毒液，闻起来像烧焦橡胶。
author: oddwalls
source: The two units at its sides spin independently from the central unit, allowing POKENAME to swiftly maneuver itself with precision. Its studs drip poison that smells like burnt rubber.

entry: 头尾的磁性单元会以令人恶心的频率震动。POKENAME全身布满眼睛，很难被偷袭。
author: oddwalls
source: The magnetic units on its head and tail vibrate at a frequency that makes opponents nauseous. Its body is lined with eyes, making POKENAME difficult to surprise.

entry: POKENAME捕食较小的金属宝可梦，用手上的一对强磁铁拉近。进入范围后，便扑上前，用钢颚撕开金属。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME preys on smaller metallic Pokémon, using the pair of powerful magnets on its hand to draw them nearer. Once they're within range, it pounces and rends the metal apart with its steel jaws.

entry: 有些POKENAME变种，似乎除了基础金属框架便没有其他构造。脆弱却敏捷，用打了就跑的战术猎杀钢属性宝可梦。
author: sk372
source: Some variants of POKENAME seem to lack any features aside from a basic metallic frame. These versions are fragile yet agile, adopting hit-and-run tactics in order to hunt down Steel-type Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME以小磁怪般的拳头，与其他POKENAME比试拳击。拳头最远能伸到20英尺，射程长，很占优势。
author: teatedtiten
source: Using their Magnemite-like fists, POKENAME engage in boxing matches with other POKENAME. Because they can reach up to 20 feet, they take advantage of their long range.

entry: POKENAME吃下太多废弃电子设备，线路已有故障。训练家若不给它安排特殊饮食，就可能突然放出电磁波。
author: gnom3
source: POKENAME have consumed so much thrown out electronics, their wiring is faulty. If their Trainer doesn't feed them a special diet, they can unexpectedly let loose a Thunder Wave.

entry: POKENAME从头上银球散出苦涩的西梨果气味，吸引钢属性宝可梦，再用强烈电击将其击昏。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME leaks a bitter Wepear Berry scent from the silver orbs on its head. It attracts Steel-type Pokémon, which it knocks out with a powerful electrical shock.

entry: POKENAME喜爱漂过肆虐的雷暴，用风暴能量为身体充电。仔细聆听，也许能在雷鸣间听见它快乐地啭鸣。
author: gnom3
source: POKENAME loves to drift through raging thunderstorms, its body charged by the storm's energy. If you listen closely, you might hear POKENAME trilling joyfully between the crashes of thunder.

entry: POKENAME的石头身体由强磁力维系，几乎不可能碎散。磁铁对岩石属性宝可梦格外有效，能轻易抓起、甩动。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's stone body is held together by powerful magnetism, making it near impossible to crumble. Its magnets are especially effective on Rock-type Pokémon, with POKENAME able to grab and fling them around with ease.

entry: POKENAME悬浮穿过苔原，冰冷身体摩擦积雪发电。许多科学家认为源于化学反应，但因太罕见，尚未找到究竟是哪种化学物质。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME levitates through tundras, generating electricity in its icy body by rubbing against snow. Many scientists believe this is due to a chemical reaction, though its rarity has prevented the specific chemical from being identified.

entry: POKENAME背上多出的头能离开主体，独立活动。但必须在五分钟内回来充能，否则便会停止运作。
author: sk372
source: The extra heads on POKENAME's back can separate from the main body and operate independently. However, they must return to recharge within five minutes or be rendered inert.

entry: 小磁性突起如传感器，寻找适合撒孢子的地方。POKENAME聚得太多，还能改变当地磁场。
author: frokachu
source: The small magnetic protrusions act as sensors that identify good places to spread spores. A high presence of POKENAME can alter magnetic fields in the area.

entry: POKENAME夜间飞过沼泽，从翅膀撒出银粉，让敌人睡着，再释放高功率电击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME flutters through marshes at night. It unleashes silver powder from its wings to put foes to sleep before unleashing high-powered electric shocks.

entry: POKENAME由三个不同个体组成，靠强磁力紧密相连。齐心协力时，磁铁合力能产生巨大的电涌。
author: aberry8286
source: POKENAME is made up of three distinct beings held together by a powerful magnetic bond. Working in unison, their combined magnets can generate immense electrical surges.

entry: POKENAME操纵磁场悬浮的能力很强，足以在空中飞行。会寻找新地点，挖掘能增强掘土力量的矿物。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME's ability to levitate by manipulating magnetic fields is powerful enough for it to fly through the sky. It searches for new areas to excavate minerals that will empower its digging strength.

entry: POKENAME的三个大脑齐心协力，挖出稀有矿物吸收。有未经证实的报告称，吃够矿物就能升入大气，但研究者始终未能重现。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME's three brains cooperate in unison to uncover rare minerals to absorb. An unverified report claims that it is able to ascend into the atmosphere after consuming enough minerals, but researchers have not been able to replicate this event.

entry: POKENAME的磁铁对电磁频率格外敏感，能察觉广播与电视信号。喜欢无线电波掠过身体的感觉，便在广播室安家。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME magnets are uniquely sensitive to electromagnetic frequencies, allowing them to sense radio and television broadcasts. They enjoy the sensation of radio waves passing over them, making themselves at home in broadcast studios.

entry: POKENAME头部畸形，游泳时会粘住许多金属物件。若受磁场影响无法移动，头内压力不断增长，就会头痛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a misshapen head that sticks to many metallic objects while they swim. If they are exposed to a magnetic field and are unable to move, they experience a headache from the growing pressure.

entry: 面对对手时，POKENAME会制造电力屏障，堵住退路，再以强健肌肉打出重拳迎战。
author: equation8573
source: In the presence of opponents, POKENAME will create an electric barrier to block their escape. It will then fight the opponent using powerful punches powered by its large muscles.

entry: POKENAME夜间闯入变电站，吸取多余能量。发现人类后，会用超能力抹去对方的记忆。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME breaks into power substations at night to siphon excess energy. If it spots a human, it will erase their memories with its psychic power.

entry: 与其他三合一磁怪融合体不同，三个大脑让POKENAME的智力爆发式提升。磁场控制得出神入化，能自由操纵附近任何金属物件。
author: mistymagius
source: Unlike other Magneton fusions, its three brains have boosted POKENAME's intelligence exponentially. Its masterful control over magnetic fields allows it to freely control any metallic object in its vicinity.

entry: POKENAME口中的磁铁极强，能以惊人力量吸入小型钢属性宝可梦。吃饱后，睡梦中会断断续续放出火花。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's magnets in its mouth are extremely strong, pulling small Steel-type Pokémon in with incredible force. After it eats enough, it lets loose intermittent sparks as it sleeps.

entry: 饥饿时，POKENAME变得迟缓，磁力却极强，自动把金属吸向身体。会大吃金属，直到能量充足，可以再次自由活动。
author: .izik
source: When hungry, POKENAME becomes slow and extremely magnetic, pulling metal towards its body automatically. It will feast on the metal until it has enough energy to move freely again.

entry: 将两只三合一磁怪融合时，其中一只可能立刻碎成磁沙，由存活的另一只利用。模样像另一地区某本书中记载的异兽。
author: neo_technomon_8392
source: Upon fusing two Magneton, one can immediately crumble into magnetic sand, used by the survivor. It resembles a beast seen in a book from another region.

entry: POKENAME的金属头会先相互撞击，再放出强力电击。凭磁力，最多能悬在离地20英尺的高处。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's metal heads slam together before unleashing a powerful electrical attack. It can float up to 20 feet above the ground due to its magnetic powers.

entry: POKENAME游得太累时，会用磁铁吸住船只。被拖着远行，也能一路睡觉。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its magnets to stick to ships when it is too tired to swim. It can sleep while being dragged for long distances.

entry: POKENAME磁性极强，会吸来附近所有金属，慢慢分解并从中获取能量。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME is strongly magnetic and attracts everything metallic in its vicinity to slowly decompose it and generate energy from it.

entry: POKENAME没有炮管，那其实是磁铁，会吸来金属团，再朝对手轰出去。
author: seanothan_23
source: POKENAME doesn't have cannons. Instead they are magnets that draw in clumps of metal that it blasts at opponents.

entry: POKENAME漂过阴影，金属身体变得半透明。若发现有人站在自己想占据的影子里，就会放出一阵电击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's metal body becomes translucent as it floats through shadows. If it spots someone standing in a shadow it wants to occupy, it strikes them with a burst of electricity.

entry: POKENAME夜间徘徊，吸走路灯电力。再用储存的电，通过小电击捉弄其他宝可梦。
author: npshi
source: POKENAME prowls the night, sapping the electricity from street lights. It uses the electricity stored to prank other Pokémon with small electric shocks.

entry: POKENAME视力敏锐，远处的威胁也看得见。危险靠近时，早已算好制胜的动作与攻击，与它交战仿佛在跳机械舞。
author: ghostslythe
source: POKENAME has acute vision, allowing it to see threats far away. When threats approach, this Pokémon has calculated winning movements and attacks, making fights against it appear as a robotic dance.

entry: 逃离天敌时，POKENAME从背部球茎沿路释放毒孢子，拖慢追赶者。巨喙能敲开最坚硬的树果，吃到柔软多汁的果心。
author: fiordaliso
source: When fleeing from predators, POKENAME releases a trail of poisonous spores from the bulb growing on its back to slow down its pursuers. With its large beak, it cracks open even the toughest Berries to feed on their soft, juicy cores.

entry: POKENAME旅途中若见到散落骨骸，就会用随身的棍子挖坑，妥善安葬，甚至将棍子留在那里作标记。
author: sk372
source: Should POKENAME come across strewn bones while on its travels, it uses the stick it carries to dig a hole into the ground so that it can give the bones a proper burial, even leaving its stick behind as a marker.

entry: 进化过程中，头骨帽已有一部分与头部融合。它以大根植物茎秆作武器，许多人觊觎这根茎，据说既营养丰富，又风味浓郁。
author: infinex21
source: Its skull cap has partly fused to its head through the course of its evolution. It wields a large plant stalk as a weapon; many covet this stalk for the nutrients and rich flavors it is said to hold.

entry: POKENAME将身体埋起来，只露出角，引诱毫无戒备的草食动物来吃。网上它吓到人们的视频大受欢迎，甚至成了一些人反复取乐的笑梗。
author: northkira
source: POKENAME buries itself and leaves only its horn exposed to attract unsuspecting herbivores to eat. Online videos of POKENAME scaring people have gained significant popularity, even becoming a gag joke amongst some.

entry: POKENAME保护收集的大葱，如同自己的孩子。发现同种植物被丢下的枝条，会放进育儿袋，将其收养。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME protects its collection of leeks as if they were its own children. If it finds an abandoned stick from the same plant, it will adopt it by placing it inside its pouch.

entry: 为大葱找到了完美的烹饪搭配后，POKENAME诞生了。它活得痛苦，却很美味，再也感受不到快乐。
author: rooboid
source: Having found the perfect culinary companion to its leek, POKENAME is born. This Pokémon lives in pain, albeit delicious pain, and no longer feels joy.

entry: POKENAME在野外难得一见，卡洛斯权贵常饲养它，彰显地位。它的决斗包含花哨的挥刀招式与超能力空袭。
author: ghostslythe
source: Rarely spotted in the wild, POKENAME is often kept as a status symbol among Kalos elites. Duels featuring this Pokémon involve fancy saber flourishes and psychic aerial strikes.

entry: POKENAME将拳头的电压导入大葱，为其充满雷电。武器猛烈挥过空气，身后留下道道电弧。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME sends voltage from its fists into its leek, charging it up with lightning. Its weapon cuts through the air with brutal swings, leaving arcs of electricity behind.

entry: POKENAME的茎秆尖端虽烈火熊熊，却只有离开各自的POKENAME很久，才会烧尽。近来有人训练它们，协助发信号引导飞机降落。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Despite the raging fire at their tips, POKENAME's stalks will only burn out if they're separated from the respective POKENAME for extended periods of time. In recent times, POKENAME have been trained to help signal plane landings.

entry: POKENAME时刻警戒，紧握大葱棒防御天敌。只需用棒尖锐一刺，就能击退比自己大得多的宝可梦。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME clings to its leek baton with steady vigilance to protect itself from predators. With a sharp sting from its baton, POKENAME repels  Pokémon much larger than itself.

entry: POKENAME很少离开可靠的大葱。若棍子被夺走，就会就地搜集能找到的材料，赶紧再做一根。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is rarely seen without its trusty leek by its side. Should it be deprived of the stick, it hastily crafts itself a new one out of whatever materials it can forage nearby.

entry: POKENAME用数千个锋利像素构成的大葱，切割网络空间中的文件。究竟为何这样做，计算机科学家至今仍在讨论。
author: daniel360n
source: POKENAME uses a leek comprised of thousands of sharp pixels to slice away at files within cyberspace. The reason for this is still being discussed by computer scientists to this day.

entry: 它只用最上等、最结实的植物茎，还总带着一只光滑岩石制成的大碗。聪明得懂得搭配、烹饪食物，用茎秆搅拌，也用来调味。
author: infinex21
source: It wields only the finest and mightiest of plant stalks and always carries a large bowl made from a smoothed rock. It is intelligent enough to combine and cook foods, using its plant stalk both to stir and to season its meals.

entry: 战斗时，POKENAME将全部电力注入手中大葱。每次挥动充电武器，都会划出强大雷电弧，称霸战场。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME funnels all its electricity into the leek it carries when in combat. Every swing of the charged-up weapon creates arcs of powerful lightning that let it dominate the battlefield.

entry: 孵化后，POKENAME通常会从母亲那里得到一根小葱。若在人工饲养中出生，训练家就必须提供，好让它战斗。羽毛随季节变化，更便于伪装。
author: fiordaliso
source: After hatching, it usually receives a small leek stalk from its mother. If POKENAME is born in captivity, it is the Trainer who must provide one so it can fight. Its feathers change with the seasons, allowing it greater camouflage.

entry: 很少有人见到POKENAME在高空睡觉，翅膀本能地拍动。或许因身体强健，睡得极沉，全身完全放松。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME can rarely be found sleeping high in the sky, wings flapping on instinct. Perhaps due to its strong body, it sleeps extremely deeply with complete relaxation.

entry: POKENAME的大葱充满自身精神能量，只需一碰便能改变食物风味。会引开旅人注意，再用葱搅拌对方食物，让它美味得多。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's leek is packed full of its own psychic energy, and able to manipulate the flavors of food with just a touch. It distracts travelers in order to stir their food with its leek and make it much more delectable.

entry: 它制造的泡泡富有弹性，却十分结实。用可靠的大葱，能轻易造出、戳破泡泡；据说那根葱蕴含精神能量。
author: kam_doodle_snek
source: The bubbles it creates are bouncy yet durable. It can easily create and pop them with its trusty leek, which is said to be imbued with psychic energy.

entry: POKENAME像握棒子一样拿着一根长香蒲。潜水时，便通过香蒲棒呼吸，不必浮上来换气。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME wield a long cattail that they hold like a baton. Whenever they dive into the water, they breathe through their cattail baton instead of surfacing for air.

entry: 它带着的葱枝散发腐臭，会被扔向敌人作武器。就连最勇猛的天敌，也会被这一招吓退。
author: .izik
source: The onion sprig it carries emits a rancid smell, which it uses as a weapon by throwing it at foes. This tactic deters even the bravest predators.

entry: POKENAME极为聪明，连言语中的细节都能理解，能遵循长串附有条件的指令。看似随意转着大葱时，其实比平常更加专注。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is highly intelligent and can process even minor verbal details, following long lists of conditional instructions. When it twirls its leek idly, it is actually paying attention more so than usual.

entry: 大葱会自行吸收潜在的精神能量。举过头顶时，便能引导这股力量，制造鲜明可怕的噩梦。
author: .izik
source: Its leek passively absorbs latent psychic energy. When held above its head, it channels this power to induce vivid and terrifying nightmares.

entry: 它像风车般旋转身体，用大葱快速连击。独特的动作让敌人困惑，难以招架。
author: .izik
source: It spins its body like a pinwheel, using its leek to deliver rapid strikes. This unique movement confuses and overwhelms its foes.

entry: 它橡胶般的大葱也能当弹跳杆，弥补飞行能力不足。这种古怪习惯，让它出奇地敏捷。
author: .izik
source: Its rubbery leek doubles as a pogo stick, compensating for its subpar flying abilities. This quirky habit makes it surprisingly agile.

entry: POKENAME尽可能多收集大葱棒来筑巢。会从野生大葱鸭手里偷棒，用利爪抓走就逃。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME gather as many leek batons as they can to form their nest. They are known to steal batons from wild Farfetch'd, snatching the baton with their talons before escaping.

entry: POKENAME伪装成美味蔬菜，吸引想捕食的天敌，再以岩石茎秆毫不留情地痛打。常待在农场，守护大葱收成。
author: t3isukone
source: POKENAME lures in would-be predators by appearing as a delicious vegetable before clobbering them mercilessly with its rocky stalks. POKENAME often stays on farms to watch over the leek harvest.

entry: 身上的绒球由数千朵紫色小花构成，夜间发出诡异光芒。这般迷人景象，既引来朋友，也引来敌人。
author: .izik
source: The puffs on its body are composed of thousands of tiny purple flowers that glow eerily at night. This mesmerizing display attracts both friends and foes.

entry: POKENAME有特殊的绿色羽纹，让科学家能在野外辨认。巢里堆满从野生大葱鸭那里偷来的大葱棒。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have special green pattern of feathers that help scientists identify them in the wild. Their nests are full of leek batons stolen from wild Farfetch'd.

entry: POKENAME忍不住啃嘴里叼着的美味大葱，经常吃光，只好另找一根。有些走投无路时，甚至会与大葱鸭争抢。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can't resist chewing on the delicious leek it carries in its mouth, having to replace it often after eating it completely. Some even resort to fighting Farfetch'd for its leek when desperate.

entry: POKENAME成群躺地，以尾巴模仿草丛窸窣，吓跑小型天敌。
author: holgast
source: A troop of POKENAME will lie on the ground and use their tails to simulate rustling grass, frightening away small predators.

entry: 它的翅膀发出尖锐噪声，使敌人晕头转向，有时陷入混乱。嗡鸣强得足以震碎玻璃。
author: .izik
source: Its wings emit high-pitched noises that disorient foes, sometimes causing confusion. The intensity of the buzz is strong enough to shatter glass.

entry: POKENAME脸部的附肢像植物茎。它藏在泥里，露出一根，引来吃草的动物。茎含微毒，能赶退捕食者，让它安全吃掉被扰动的植物和昆虫。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME's facial appendages resemble plant stems. It hides in mud with one protruding, luring grazers. The stem holds a mild toxin that deters the predator, letting POKENAME feed safely on the disturbed plants and insects.

entry: POKENAME用大葱挖出新鲜土壤，梳羽时揉入羽间，形成能长出小植物的生态环境，变成随身携带的食物来源。
author: afilthycasual
source: POKENAME uses its leek to dig up fresh soil, which it works into its feathers when it preens. This forms an ecosystem that allows small vegetation to grow, creating a food source that is easily carried with it.

entry: POKENAME将大葱棒放在背部球茎里保鲜。离开球茎太久，就会缺乏养分，开始枯萎。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME carry a leek baton inside the bulb on their backs to keep the baton fresh. If the baton spends too much time outside of the bulb, it begins to wither from a lack of nutrients.

entry: 嘴里的牙像细小葱枝，却锋利得能切开石头。遇水时，牙齿会散发可怕的臭味。
author: .izik
source: The teeth in its mouth resemble tiny onion sprigs but remain sharp enough to cut through stone. The teeth let out a horrible scent when exposed to water.

entry: POKENAME始终悬浮，神秘的外形却仿佛正要起飞。用葱引导自己的方式，让人相信大葱才是它真正的身体。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME's mysterious shape makes it appear as if it's about to take flight despite the fact it's constantly levitating. The way it guides itself with its leek had lead to the belief that the leek is the true body of POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME在身体后方装上茎秆，能挡开从背后偷扔来的任何精灵球。钻入地下，只露出茎秆，就能伪装在茎秆田里。
author: soup1900
source: With POKENAME having attached a stalk to the back of its body, it can deflect any Poké Ball thrown sneakily behind it. By burrowing underground while only leaving its stalk visible, it can camouflage itself among a stalk field.

entry: POKENAME从不放开翅间的大葱，用它抵御更大的宝可梦。大群生活，还会帮同类找回遗失的大葱，免得失去防身之物。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME never lets go of the leek it holds between its wings, using it as a weapon to defend itself against larger Pokémon. It lives in large flocks and helps other members of its species find lost leeks so they are never left unprotected.

entry: 它的大葱硬如铁，一挥便能斩断树枝。既优雅，又是战斗中破坏力惊人的武器。
author: .izik
source: Its leek is as hard as iron, capable of severing tree limbs in a single swipe. This weapon is both elegant and devastating in battle.

entry: 它携带卵等各种物件，用弹弓精准射出。虽然胆小，却十分忠诚，会自豪地跟随训练家，帮助实现梦想。
author: actliux
source: It carries a wide variety of objects, such as eggs, and fires them from its slingshot with extreme precision. Although very fearful, it is also very loyal and will proudly follow its Trainer to help them achieve their dreams.

entry: POKENAME背上长出的大葱，在一些地区被视为美味。火箭队因此囤养、采收，赚取数千宝可币。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: The leek that grows from POKENAME's back is considered a delicacy in some regions. This has led Team Rocket to hoard and harvest from POKENAME to make thousands of Pokédollars.

entry: 进化后身体长大，POKENAME必须找更大、更坚固的大葱作武器。凭强健双翼，翱翔本领无出其右，并在高处筑巢，远离打扰。
author: fiordaliso
source: As POKENAME's body grew after its evolution, it had to find a larger, sturdier leek to use as a weapon. With its powerful wings, it soars through the sky with unmatched skill and builds its nest high up, away from disturbances.

entry: POKENAME向远处敌人射出硬化的叶子，连在自己水域上方盘旋觅食的鸟也不放过。
author: camtft
source: POKENAME fires hardened leaves at faraway opponents, including birds hovering over their bodies of water searching for food.

entry: POKENAME紧紧盘住大葱，测试结实程度。若不折断，就永远留在身边；断了便另寻新葱，替换这根不合格的。
author: pixlhoopa
source: POKENAME tests the durability of its leek by coiling itself around it tightly. A leek that doesn't break stays with it forever, while a broken one causes POKENAME to seek out a new one to replace the defective one.

entry: 建筑公司雇用POKENAME刷外墙，因为葱上的墨水格外耐久。室内装饰师和设计师也喜爱同样的墨，因其色泽鲜亮。
author: oddwalls
source: Construction companies employ POKENAME to paint exterior walls because the ink on its leek is especially durable. Interior decorators and designers covet the same ink for its bright hues.

entry: 只要大葱还握在手里，POKENAME就会不断旋转。能夺走旋转中个体的大葱，会被誉为武术大师。
author: darkweavile428
source: As long as it has its leek in its hand, POKENAME will keep spinning. Those who are able to take a spinning POKENAME's leek are heralded as master martial artists.

entry: 它把电力储在大葱里，击中敌人时放电。力量与精准兼具，是难以对付的劲敌。
author: .izik
source: It stores electricity in its leek, releasing shocks when striking enemies. This combination of power and precision makes it a formidable opponent.

entry: POKENAME腹下的花纹与翅膀搭配，构成威吓姿态。将对手吓得动弹不得，紧接着便挥葱猛攻。
author: pixlhoopa
source: The pattern on POKENAME's underbelly pairs with its wings to create an intimidating form. It then frightens its opponent into paralysis, going in for the attack soon after with a damaging leek.

entry: POKENAME采收小葱等蔬菜，为饥饿的人与宝可梦做饭，是受欢迎的厨房助手。因过于信任他者，肉又鲜美，曾一度濒危，直到最近才禁止捕猎。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME harvests vegetables like scallions to help craft meals for hungry people and Pokémon, making it a popular kitchen assistant. It was endangered for a while due to its trusting nature and rich flavor, until hunting it was recently banned.

entry: POKENAME背上的大葱，据说风味绝佳，与辛辣咖喱十分相配。想采收的人很快便会遭到猛烈攻击，哪怕趁它睡觉时也不例外。
author: bobosmith01
source: The leeks on POKENAME's back apparently have a wonderful flavor that perfectly complements spicy curries. Attempting to harvest them will quickly result in being ferociously attacked, even if done while POKENAME is asleep.

entry: POKENAME飞行莽撞，却必须格外小心，别意外弄坏茎秆。若真弄坏，就会飞冲到最近的葱田，一路毁坏芦苇，直到找到自认为够好的茎。
author: soup1900
source: Despite its reckless flying, POKENAME has to be extremely careful to not accidentally destroy its stalk. If it does, it will blast to the nearest leek field and destroy every reed until it finds what it considers a good stalk.

entry: 与盆才怪不同，POKENAME身上飘出的刺鼻葱味，会让别人流泪。外形像大葱，也常被大葱鸭追赶。
author: foolish_weasel
source: In contrast to Bonsly, POKENAME causes others to tear up due to its sharp onion odor wafting from its body. Due to its appearance as a leek, Farfetch'd often chase POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME偏爱干燥气候，尤其是土壤酸性很强的地区。紫色花朵其实硬得像石头。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME prefer arid climates, especially areas with very acidic soil. Its purple blooms are actually hard as rock.

entry: POKENAME用尾巴上连着的大葱棒鞭打敌人。距离太远，鞭打够不到时，就从葱棒末端射出电击。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME whip their foes with a leek baton attached to their tail. If their foes are too far away for their whipping attacks, they can shoot jolts of electricity from the end of their leek baton.

entry: 总能见它们拿着植物茎，既当武器挥舞，也同样爱啃咬。虽然啃茎，却很抗拒吃大多数蔬菜。
author: infinex21
source: They are always seen holding onto a plant stalk, which they will gnaw on just as much as they will swing it around like a weapon. Even though they gnaw on these stalks, they are rather opposed to eating most vegetables.

entry: 即使是宝可梦，也很少能用肉眼看见POKENAME。它会制造小冰柱，再从那根中空的长葱中射向猎物。
author: shocktopus1717
source: POKENAME is rarely seen with the naked eye, even by Pokémon. It produces small icicles that it fires at prey from its long, hollow leek.

entry: POKENAME酷似一部被遗忘的儿童节目的主角。用爪围住眼睛，就能看得极远。
author: shocktopus1717
source: POKENAME resembles the main character from a forgotten children's show. It can see great distances by cupping its paws around its eyes.

entry: POKENAME用头上的茎探测合适的替代品。找到更坚固的茎，就会换掉原来的，同时用于战斗与感知周围。
author: 0reomilka
source: POKENAME uses the stalk on its head to detect suitable replacements. When it finds stronger stalks, it replaces its own and uses them both for combat and sensing its surroundings.

entry: POKENAME与巨蔓藤共生。它带回巨蔓藤因行动太慢而抓不到的猎物，换取修剪下来的藤蔓。幼年个体常用这些藤蔓练习狩猎。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME and Tangrowth have a symbiotic relationship. In exchange for bringing back prey that Tangrowth is too slow to catch, it gives its trimmed vines to POKENAME. Young POKENAME often practice hunting with these vines.

entry: POKENAME开战总只用手中大葱。若战斗足够艰难，就会丢下武器，改用威力大得多的拳脚。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME always starts out its battles solely fighting with the leek it carries. If the fight proves formidable enough, it throws down the weapon and fights with its fists and legs, which are far more powerful.

entry: POKENAME用臂上坚硬如刃的大葱作剑，指导职业击剑与剑道选手。纪律严明，是格外敏捷、耐打的训练伙伴。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME coach professional fencing and kendo athletes, using the hard, blade-like leeks on their arms as swords. Highly disciplined, they make exceptionally agile and durable training companions.

entry: 它嘴里叼着风味浓郁的植物茎，战斗时当武器。茎接触它有毒的唾液后，也会染上毒性。
author: infinex21
source: It carries a flavorful plant stalk in its beak, which it will use like a weapon during battle. This plant stalk grows poisonous as it is exposed to this Pokémon's toxic saliva.

entry: POKENAME周围的大葱，让它总散发诱人香气。为了不被吃掉，会裹住其他生灵，让香味粘在对方身上，希望被捕食的换成它们。
author: sk372
source: The leeks surrounding POKENAME make it always smell deliciously appetizing. To avoid being eaten, it envelops other creatures and causes the smell to stick to them in the hopes that they will be hunted instead.

entry: POKENAME背上长出许多大葱棒，帮助当地大葱鸭补上遗失的武器。也因这份职责，深受其他大葱鸭尊重。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME grow many leek batons on their backs to help local Farfetch'd replace batons when lost. POKENAME are treated with lots of respect by other Farfetch'd because of this duty.

entry: 融合将可靠的大葱变成从后脑长出的颚。POKENAME住在水域附近，因为葱颚需要不断补水。
author: kam_doodle_snek
source: Fusion has transformed its trusty leek into a jaw that grows from the back of its head. POKENAME lives near bodies of water, as it needs constant hydration for its leek jaw.

entry: POKENAME只靠随身棍子移动，试图攀上巨山。无论跌落多远，都会继续攀登，非要翻过去不可。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME tries to scale massive mountains using only the stick it carries for movement. No matter how far it falls back, it will keep scaling the mountain, intent on getting over it.

entry: 它慢慢品尝手中大葱，几天才吃完。一旦吃光，就会慌乱得发狂，直到找到替代品，再开始新一轮。
author: sk372
source: It savors the leek it carries, eating it slowly over the course of several days. Once fully consumed, it flies into a panicked frenzy until it can find a replacement, and the process begins anew.

entry: 一片茎秆田即将遇险时，POKENAME会迅速赶来，拼命守护。为了帮助需要新茎的大葱鸭，会用尖角削掉劣质茎，只留下最好的。
author: soup1900
source: Whenever a stalk field is in imminent danger, POKENAME rushes over swiftly to defend it with its life. To help Farfetch'd who need a new stalk, it uses its sharp horn to chop away bad stalks so that only the best quality ones will remain for them.

entry: POKENAME的肉甘甜肥美，人和宝可梦都想吃，因此主动远离他者独居。一挥大葱，就能打碎巨石。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's sweet and fatty flesh is desired by both people and Pokémon, so they live in self-imposed seclusion. A swing from its leek can shatter boulders.

entry: POKENAME寻找配得上自己的剑士持用，随时愿意来一场公平的决斗。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME seeks a worthy swordfighter to wield it. It is always up for a fair duel.

entry: POKENAME知道自己是根好棍子，十分自豪，总想以决斗证明这一点。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME is filled with pride knowing it is a good stick, always eager to prove it with a duel.

entry: 大葱鸭常把POKENAME误认成普通大葱，直到它自己在战斗中攻击敌对宝可梦。通常藏在葱田里。
author: cheeseyhead
source: Farfetch'd tend to mistake POKENAME as regular leeks until they attack opposing Pokémon in battle on their own. They can usually be found hiding in leek farms.

entry: 世界各地的篮球迷涌向雷文市，观看POKENAME参加的比赛。它们以团队配合闻名，用精准娴熟的空气斩，把球传给队友。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: Basketball fans from around the world flock to Nimbasa City to watch games that feature POKENAME. They're renowned for their teamwork, passing the ball to teammates with precise, well-executed Air Slash attacks.

entry: POKENAME天性爱玩，最喜欢和训练家玩抛接游戏。用的是孵化后不久得到的那根茎秆。
author: melodydelune
source: POKENAME is playful in nature. Its favorite game to play with its Trainer is fetch. It uses the stalk that it received with shortly after hatching.

entry: POKENAME只需拍一次翅膀，就能推退海水，却是易受惊的胆小鬼。太害怕拍岸海浪，据说惊慌之下，会拼命把整片海洋吹回去。
author: ambrosia04
source: Despite being able to push back the sea with a single flap of their wings, POKENAME are easily startled cowards. They are so terrified of crashing waves that they are said to frantically blow back the entire ocean out of sheer panic.

entry: POKENAME顶上的葱形配件不只是强力大炮，也是可拆卸火箭。发射后追踪敌人，释放爆炸性能量，再返回充能。
author: sk372
source: The leek-shaped attachment atop POKENAME is not just an effective cannon, but doubles as a detachable rocket. It homes in on foes when fired, discharging an explosive burst of energy before returning to POKENAME to recharge.

entry: POKENAME的尾巴与大葱，都结实得足以推倒金属高塔。要攻击远处目标时，就展开翅膀，跳起后挺角向前，朝对手高速滑翔。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME's tail and leek are both sturdy enough to topple metal towers. If POKENAME needs to attack a target at range, it spreads its wings, then jumps and glides rapidly at the opponent with its horn aimed forward.

entry: POKENAME举止讲究，又很挑剔。双手长出的葱状茎，是美味的烹饪食材。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME has a refined and finicky attitude. The oniony stalks it sprouts from its hands make for delicious cooking ingredients.

entry: POKENAME挥葱精准，犹如老练骑士。每次击打都会从尖端撒出孢子，使对手迷乱、失去方向。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME swings its leek with the precision of a seasoned knight. Each strike scatters spores from the tip, which can confuse and disorient its opponents.

entry: POKENAME头上盛着大量肉葱汤。可惜，身体浓烈的铁味毁了汤的风味。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's head carries a large quantity of meat and leek soup. The soup's flavor is unfortunately ruined by the strong taste of iron from POKENAME's body.

entry: 这些宝可梦花上数日，寻找最合适的大葱装点头部。遇威胁时，会点燃葱来威吓敌人，却常把植物烧光，只好再次找替代品。
author: chibitales
source: These Pokémon search for days to find the perfect leek to adorn their head with. When threatened, they will set their leek aflame to intimidate foes. This often incinerates the plant, causing them to search once more for a replacement.

entry: POKENAME漫游黑暗森林，用幽灵料理的香气引诱旅人。身体燃着鬼魅火焰，炙烤超自然佳肴，并吸走靠得太近者的生命力，为永恒的火锅添柴。
author: msdawgs
source: POKENAME roams dark forests, luring travelers with the aroma of its spectral cooking. Its body burns with a ghostly flame used to flambé supernatural delicacies, draining the life force of anyone who draws too close to fuel its eternal hot pot.

entry: POKENAME的尾巴由大葱构成，营养丰富，是许多菜肴的热门食材。曾被猎到濒危，后来才制定规定，保护剩余族群。
author: chibitales
source: The leeks making up POKENAME's tails are highly nutritious, making them extremely popular for many dishes. POKENAME were hunted to the point of endangerment before regulations were put in place to protect the remaining population.

entry: POKENAME会捡起倒下的大葱鸭留下的棒子，收进自己的环中。身上独特的刺鼻葱味，吸引着许多好奇的大葱鸭。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can be found picking up batons from fallen Farfetch'd and storing them in its ring. It has a distinctly sharp onion scent that draws the attention of many curious Farfetch'd.

entry: POKENAME喜欢电子舞曲，维持着与某位人气艺人相似的外表。听歌时，会随节奏转动大葱。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME enjoy EDM music, and maintain an appearance similar to a popular artist. When listening to music, POKENAME will spin their leek around to the tempo of the song.

entry: 身上长出的大葱，生长时会散发刺鼻气味。古代文明曾用这些葱，制作早期的胆怯球。
author: .izik
source: The leeks growing from its body emit an acrid scent during their growth. Ancient civilizations used these leeks as ingredients for early Adrenaline Orbs.

entry: POKENAME充满攻击性，愿意用火焰棒敲打一切挡路的对象。不过一旦够不到棒子，就会觉得无力，气焰也迅速消退。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are aggressive creatures and are willing to bop anything that stands in their way  with their flaming baton. This aggressiveness quickly fades when their baton is out of reach, as they feel powerless without it.

entry: POKENAME沿河岸种植美丽玫瑰，巩固土壤，减少侵蚀。玫瑰耐得住自然灾害，常被用作环保的防洪手段。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME plants beautiful roses along riverbanks to strengthen the soil and reduce erosion. Its roses are resilient against natural disasters and are often used as an eco-friendly tool for flood prevention.

entry: 飞行时，嘴里长出的大葱会发出小号般的声音，警告入侵者远离它占据的洞穴。
author: .izik
source: The leek growing from its mouth produces a trumpet-like noise while flying. This sound warns intruders to stay away from its claimed caves.

entry: POKENAME搭在较大生灵身上赶路，寻找合适的专属棍子。大多时候，用的是大葱鸭丢弃、已经磨损的葱段。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME hitches rides on larger beings while looking for a proper stick to call its own. Most times it uses worn-down bits of leeks discarded by Farfetch'd.

entry: 找到适合自己小个头的大葱后，POKENAME便更自信，更愿意战斗。尽管逞强，力量与电力即使合进新武器，充其量也只是一般。
author: sk372
source: After finding a leek fitting for a creature of its small size, POKENAME acts more confidently and battle-ready. Despite this bravado, its strength and electric charge, even combined into its new weapon, is rather middling at best.

entry: 一群POKENAME被称为“营队”，由一名成员担任战术指挥。协同攻击极富谋略，效率很高。
author: .izik
source: A group of POKENAME is known as a battalion, with one member acting as the tactical leader. Their coordinated attacks are highly strategic and efficient.

entry: POKENAME常啄自己像葱的尾巴。目击者起初以为它在不停梳理羽毛，如今则认为，只是喜欢自己的尾巴味。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is often seen pecking at its leek-like tail, and was first thought by observers to be an attempt to constantly preen itself. It's now believed that it does this simply because it likes the taste of its own tail.

entry: 它常在废弃农场的粮仓安家，吃剩余谷物。这些隐蔽住所，让它既安全，又不愁吃。
author: .izik
source: It often makes its home in abandoned farm silos, feeding on leftover grain. These secluded shelters keep it safe and well-fed.

entry: POKENAME用静电棒表演惊人的电力攻击。覆泥羽毛能防止伤到自己。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME use their static rods to perform shocking displays of electrical attacks. Their mud-coated feathers prevent POKENAME from hurting itself.

entry: 它双脚交替跳动，舞步富有节奏。情绪不佳时，动作变得无规律而混乱，常借此吓退敌人。
author: .izik
source: It hops from foot to foot in a rhythmic dance, but when upset, its movements become erratic and chaotic. This display often deters foes.

entry: POKENAME由垃圾堆成的身体里，藏着小翅膀。需要往返填埋场时便会伸出，出奇轻松地让它飞起来。
author: .izik
source: Small wings are concealed within the heap of refuse that makes up POKENAME's body. They emerge when it needs to travel between landfills, keeping it airborne with surprising ease.

entry: 它睡在废弃温室，守护无人照料的植物。若有人前来照料，便心满意足地悄悄飘走。
author: .izik
source: It sleeps in abandoned greenhouses, guarding neglected plants. If a caretaker arrives to tend the plants, it quietly floats away, satisfied.

entry: POKENAME是让大葱长到巨大之后，才将其采收的大葱鸭。它用精神能量，操纵这副植物身体。
author: jaycielantern
source: POKENAME are Farfetch'd that have let their leeks grow to gargantuan size before harvesting them. They control the plant body with spiritual energy.

entry: 它头顶的球茎不断抽出嫩绿的新芽。虽然看起来像可食用的植物，这些新芽却带有剧毒。
author: staghorn
source: The bulbs on its head are constantly sprouting with new, green growth. Though these growths resemble edible plants, they are extremely toxic.

entry: 随身的大葱夜间种下后，会长出甜甜的侧芽。厨师很珍视它们，用来制作风味浓郁的咖喱。
author: .izik
source: The leek it carries grows sweet offshoots when planted at night. These are prized by culinarians for their use in creating flavorful curry.

entry: 它想休息时，会将大葱插入地下，立在上面保持平衡。姿势看似摇摇欲坠，却能透过土中震动察觉动静。
author: .izik
source: When it wants to rest, it burrows its leek into the ground and balances above it. This precarious position allows it to detect motion via vibrations in the dirt.

entry: POKENAME的绒羽，无论看着还是摸着，都很像香蒲内部的绒毛。会将翼下特殊分泌物仔细涂遍全身，因此潜入水中后，也仍能保持干燥。
author: milchik
source: This Pokémon's downy feathers look and feel a lot like the insides of a cattail. POKENAME stays dry even after diving into the water thanks to special secretions from under its wings that it spreads thoroughly all over its body.

entry: POKENAME栽培大葱鸭常携带的大葱。小偷若想偷走作物，便会从茎秆放出一团毒孢子。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME cultivates leeks that Farfetch'd often carry around. If a thief tries to steal POKENAME's crops, it releases a cloud of poisonous spores from its stalks.

entry: 覆身绒羽浓密，足以吸收战斗中的冲击。因此战斗时，耐打得令人惊讶。
author: .izik
source: The down covering its body is dense enough to absorb impacts during combat. This resilience allows it to fight with surprising durability.

entry: 长腿让它能涉过浅水洼而不弄湿身体。经过高低不平的地面时，会用大葱保持平衡。
author: .izik
source: Its long legs allow it to wade through shallow puddles without wetting its body. It uses its leek for balance while crossing uneven terrain.

entry: POKENAME喜欢玩把随身大葱棒扔出、再捡回来的游戏。训练家若把棒子弄丢，它就会不高兴，在找回之前拒绝听令。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME loves playing fetch with the leek baton they carry with them. If their Trainer ends up losing the baton, they get upset and will refuse orders until they are reunited with their baton.

entry: POKENAME弹奏大葱制成的齐特琴，为动听歌声伴奏。极其难得遇见，能看它表演，是一生难逢的体验。
author: fiordaliso
source: It plays a zither made from a leek to accompany its delightful songs. Since POKENAME is an extremely rare Pokémon to encounter, witnessing one of its performances is a once-in-a-lifetime experience.

entry: POKENAME常占据茎秆田，制作能与歌声合奏的芦苇乐器。若吹出的声音不合标准，就会以优雅扫腿将其毁掉。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME often takes over stalk fields to create reeds used to play music with its songs. If a reed it tries to play from doesn't meet its standards, it destroys it in a graceful leg sweep.

entry: 有个未经证实的故事：一名厨师曾抓到POKENAME，将它与嘴里的大葱制成精巧的节日菜肴。据说，此后厨师怪梦缠身，最终陷入疯狂。
author: ludacriswell
source: There is an unconfirmed story of a chef that once caught a POKENAME and created an elaborate holiday dish out of it and the leek carried in its mouth. Afterwards, the chef was said to be haunted by strange dreams until he spiraled into madness.

entry: POKENAME靠找来的大葱自卫。若丢了武器，背上蘑菇会在一天内长出一根，保证不会太久没有葱用。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME defends itself with a leek it procures. Should it lose its weapon, the mushroom on its back will sprout one over the course of a day, ensuring it never goes long without a leek to wield.

entry: 被追赶时，POKENAME会扔出大葱，震晕袭击者。不知为何，总能在一天内找到替代品，哪怕当地根本不长葱。
author: .izik
source: When pursued, POKENAME hurls its leek to stun attackers. It somehow always finds a replacement within a day, even where leeks don't naturally grow.

entry: POKENAME视葱如宝，将收集的大葱囤在壳内。战斗中葱一断，就会非常难过，而往往正是自己力气太大弄断的。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME treat leeks like treasure, hoarding collections of leeks inside their shells. When leeks break in battle, they become highly upset. Oftentimes, the breakage is a result of their own strength.

entry: POKENAME用的细枝，比长尾火狐的木枝燃尽得快得多。常见它啃咬细枝，因为嘴里会分泌保护液。也用这种物质梳理羽毛，避免意外烧到。
author: thordemidgard
source: Burning out a lot faster than the wooden branches Braixen wield, POKENAME are often seen nibbling on their twigs, for their mouths secrete a protective liquid. They also use this substance to groom their feathers and avoid burning them by accident.

entry: POKENAME的围巾由大葱制成。有时也用手里剑，不过主要武器是双节棍。
author: hiroshima0042_23263
source: POKENAME scarf is made out of leeks. POKENAME sometimes uses its shuriken, but nunchucks are its main weapon.

entry: 村民说，收获时见到POKENAME，预示丰收。头上花朵的种子能在任何气候生长，常被种下来祈福土壤。
author: jaminmcready
source: Villagers say that spotting a POKENAME during harvest is a sign of a bountiful season. The seeds from the flower on its head can grow in any climate, and are often planted to bless the soil.

entry: POKENAME的绒毛有辛甜的小葱味。一名养着它的人气厨师，将绒毛用于各式咸味菜肴，掀起一股风潮。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's fluff has a spicy-sweet scallion flavor. A popular chef with a POKENAME started a trend of using POKENAME fluff as an ingredient in various savory dishes.

entry: 开战前，POKENAME会夸张地倾斜头上大圆盘，示意准备战斗。随后以大葱使出剑般迅疾的连击，精准命中。
author: .izik
source: Before engaging in battle, POKENAME dramatically tips the large disc on its head, signaling its readiness to fight. It then unleashes rapid, sword-like flurries with its leek, striking with precision.

entry: POKENAME充满敌意，凶狠保护燃烧的棒子。会点燃附近草木，攻击潜在窃贼，吓走其他宝可梦。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are hostile creatures that ferociously defend their flaming baton. They attack potential thieves by lighting nearby grass and bushes on fire to scare other Pokémon away.

entry: POKENAME住在葱田地下，掘洞时让土壤更肥沃。收集腐烂植物，在地下混合，久而久之，大幅促进作物生长。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME lives beneath leek farms, enriching the soil as it tunnels. It gathers decaying plant matter and mixes it underground, greatly improving crop growth over time.

entry: POKENAME闪耀着翠绿大葱的灿烂力量。它们在地底深处用水晶大釜烹饪，等待合适的训练家前来，品尝炖菜滋味。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME shine with the resplendent power of their emerald leek. They cook in cauldrons made of crystal deep below the surface waiting for the right Trainer to savor the flavor of their stew.

entry: POKENAME常在大葱鸭巢穴附近的池塘游泳，被视为大葱鸭对茎秆之爱的化身。喜欢轻啃芦苇茎，再赠送给大葱鸭。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Often seen as an embodiment of the love a Farfetch'd has for its stalk, POKENAME often swim in ponds close to Farfetch'd nests. It likes to nibble at reed stalks and present them to Farfetch'd as a gift.

entry: POKENAME的羽毛对极细微的风向变化都敏感，尚未看见其他宝可梦，就能察觉靠近。会伏击猎物，扑上去用喙啄食。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME feathers are sensitive to even the slightest change in wind direction, letting them sense the approach of other Pokémon before they ever see them. They are ambush predators, pouncing on prey and pecking at it with their beak.

entry: POKENAME用大葱戳其他宝可梦，挑起怒火，引发激烈斗殴。不四处惹乱子时，就在树枝上打盹。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME provokes other Pokémon by poking them with its leek, stirring them up to spark a violent brawl. When it is not off causing chaos, it dozes on tree branches.

entry: POKENAME常用手中两根大葱与他者切磋。多数只会原始的格斗技巧，少数却发展出传统武术的招式。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME tends to spar with others using the two leeks it holds. While most only know primitive fighting skills, a rare few have developed techniques from traditional martial arts.

entry: 为了保持体能，它会请训练家扔一根芹菜，跑去捡回来。紧张时，喙会变得极烫，谁碰了都会烧伤。
author: fiordaliso
source: To stay in shape, it asks its Trainer to throw a celery stalk so that it can run and fetch it. If it gets nervous, its beak becomes very hot, and anyone who touches it ends up getting burned.

entry: POKENAME很会配合，与善待它的训练家相处融洽。还爱替人叼取东西，仿佛天生就会。
author: frokachu
source: A very cooperative Pokémon, POKENAME get along well with good Trainers. They love fetching things for others as well, and seem to do so instinctually.

entry: POKENAME常被选来为某些体育赛事点火炬，源于一个故事：一只勇敢的个体不顾看不清方向，飞入风暴，为身后众多宝可梦照亮、开辟前路。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are often chosen to light torches at certain sporting events because of a story involving POKENAME. The story involves a brave POKENAME lighting the way for many Pokémon behind them by flying blindly into a storm to create a path forward.

entry: 手中的巨大葱茎营养高得惊人。不过，谁若傻到想从POKENAME手中抢走，很可能正被这根葱狠狠痛打。
author: empty_set
source: The enormous leek it holds has remarkably high nutritional content.  However, those foolish enough to try to take it from POKENAME are liable to be badly bludgeoned by the very leek they seek.

entry: 它以念动力操纵大葱，同时从多个角度攻击。这份超能力加持，让行动几乎无从预测。
author: .izik
source: It telekinetically controls its leek, allowing it to strike from multiple angles simultaneously. This psychic enhancement makes it nearly impossible to predict.

entry: POKENAME用超能力让大葱悬浮在周围。既是剑术高手，也能在战斗中挡开大多数袭来的攻击。所有葱，都是最初那根葱的后代。
author: mcnchsschl
source: POKENAME uses its psychic powers to levitate leeks around itself. In battle, it deflects most attacks heading its way, and it is a master at swordplay. The leeks it has are all offspring of its original leek.

entry: 哪里急需体力劳动，POKENAME就常恰好出现，例如农工病倒时。帮完忙，也许会接受一点零食，随后便回自己家。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME has the habit of serendipitously showing up whenever physical labor is urgently needed somewhere, such as when a farmhand is sick. Once it has finished helping, it may accept a snack, but it will then return to its home afterwards.

entry: POKENAME帮助世界各地农人浇水、照料植物。只要求一小块地作回报，用来种葱。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME helps farmers throughout the world water and tend to plants. All it asks for in return is a small plot to grow leeks.

entry: POKENAME携带的蔬菜致密沉重，少有好吃的。
author: staghorn
source: The vegetables POKENAME carry are dense and heavy, and are rarley good to eat.

entry: POKENAME挥舞的葱茎，比看起来重，必须勤加训练才能精准操控。为了保持强壮体格，每天至少做两百个俯卧撑。
author: fiordaliso
source: The leek stalks it wields are heavier than they appear, so it must stay well-trained to handle them with precision. To maintain its muscular body, POKENAME does at least two hundred push-ups daily.

entry: POKENAME的战法结合两只空拳，与另两只握着结实大葱的拳头。有些花哨，常在每次出击前先摆姿势秀肌肉，或转动大葱。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses a fighting style that combines two bare fists and two that wield a pair of solid leeks. The style is a bit showy, often involving flexing poses or leek-twirling before every strike.

entry: POKENAME的鸟身与植物身，看似独立生物，实际却由群体生物操纵，共用一份意识。究竟怎么做到，仍无人明白。
author: holgast
source: While they appear to be separate, distinct organisms, both the bird and plant body of POKENAME are one mind, controlled by a colonial organism. It is unknown precisely how they accomplish this.

entry: POKENAME的中空大葱棒，一次能吸收一加仑水。只需一挥，就能迅速浇灭小火星。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME has a hollow leek baton that can absorb a gallon of water at a time. With a flick of the baton, POKENAME can quickly douse small embers.

entry: 它转动葱状双臂，扬土攻击敌人。措手不及时，会迅速吐出溶解液自卫。
author: .izik
source: It rotates its leek-like arms to kick up dirt at its foes. When caught off-guard, it spits Acid as a quick defense.

entry: POKENAME用随身大葱棒敲碎岩石。这是最珍视的东西之一，从来不肯松手。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME break rocks with the leek baton that they carry with them. They never let go of this baton, as it is one of their most prized possessions.

entry: POKENAME害怕丢失珍贵的大葱棒，总是紧紧握住。就连被击昏，也不会放松抓握。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME hold on tight to their leek baton out of a fear of losing this precious object. Even when knocked out, POKENAME maintain a firm grip on the baton.

entry: POKENAME常在城市池塘安家，以小家庭为单位一同游泳。喜欢新鲜蔬菜，谁在水边休息，都会凑去讨食。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME often make their homes in city ponds, swimming together in small family units. They have a love for fresh vegetables and will beg for food from anyone who relaxes by the water.

entry: POKENAME大葱的根伸入身体各节，拔出来就可能伤到它。三个节段之间的中央孔洞，能射出电力。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's leeks have roots that extend inside the various segments of its body and cannot be pulled out without potentially injuring POKENAME. It can fire electricity from the central hole between its three segments.

entry: 融合似乎唤醒了POKENAME潜藏的DNA，让形态更接近伽勒尔的同类。不过，它不讲对方那套光明正大的战斗，更爱卑鄙招数。
author: sk372
source: Fusion appears to have unlocked latent DNA in POKENAME, bringing its form closer to one found in Galar. Unlike its Galarian counterpart, POKENAME forgoes honorable combat and favors dirty tactics.

entry: POKENAME看着像伽勒尔的同类，寻找极大的葱来挥舞。性情凶恶，爱欺负弱小，认定谁比自己弱，就会挥舞武器猛攻。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME looks similar to its Galarian counterpart, seeking out exceedingly large leeks to wield. It has the vicious temperament of a bully, aggressively swinging its weapon at anything it deems weaker than itself.

entry: 冬季，POKENAME飞往温暖地区，把果实、蔬菜和坚果塞满甲壳。可惜装得太重，只好步行返回。
author: .7soul
source: During winter, POKENAME flies to warmer climates to stuff its shell with fruits, vegetables, and nuts. Unfortunately, it becomes so heavy that it has to make the journey back by foot.

entry: POKENAME用坚韧的铠甲，换下了大多数大葱鸭拥有的翅膀，抵挡众多天敌。睡觉时，它会紧紧合拢外壳，护住柔软的身体与珍贵的棍杖。
author: wormspawn
source: POKENAME have traded the wings that most Farfetch'd possess for resilient armor that stymies their many predators. They sleep with their shells clamped shut, protecting their soft bodies and precious sticks.

entry: POKENAME把手中植物敲向另一只掌心，声音能使人入迷。猎物被催眠后，便缓缓靠近，再用同一根茎秆痛打。
author: .jerden
source: When POKENAME taps the plant that it holds against its other palm, the sound can be hypnotic. After using this to put its prey into a hypnotic trance, POKENAME will slowly approach, then bludgeon its target with the same stalk.

entry: POKENAME背上球茎伸出长藤，末端长着第二颗头。借居高临下的位置警戒危险，提醒主体。
author: sk372
source: A second head comes from the bulb on POKENAME's back, placed at the end of a lengthy vine. The second head uses its vantage point to keep an eye out for trouble and warn the main body.

entry: POKENAME一颗头休息，另一颗头警戒，确保天敌无法偷袭。会吐丝包住林中找到的果实，更好地保鲜，也保存更久。
author: fiordaliso
source: While one head rests, the other keeps watch, so POKENAME can always make sure no predator catches it by surprise. It spins silk to wrap the fruit it finds in the forest, preserving it better and for longer.

entry: 睡觉时，各颗头将喙朝内，围成保护圈。这种姿势能让它休息时免遭天敌袭击。
author: .izik
source: When sleeping, its heads point their beaks inward to form a protective circle. This stance helps it stay safe from predators while resting.

entry: 头顶叶状的毛簇，其实是长羽毛。把头凑在一起时，就能通过心灵感应与其他宝可梦交流。
author: .jerden
source: The leaf-like tuft above its heads is actually made of long feathers. When it puts its heads together, it can communicate with other Pokémon using telepathy.

entry: POKENAME带着嘟嘟利的三个头骨，以免孤单。有时会朝它们啾鸣，等候永远不会到来的回应。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME keeps the three skulls of Dodrio with it to stave off loneliness. At times, it can be observed chirping at the heads, waiting for a response that will never come.

entry: POKENAME的双头会用喙追逐周围宝可梦，和它们玩耍。长喙像角，便用来逗弄其他宝可梦。
author: quackquackattack
source: The twin heads of a POKENAME play with other Pokémon around them by chasing them with their beaks. Their long beaks resemble horns, which they use to tease other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME通过喙放出精神场，构成力场屏障。无形墙壁，连全速行驶的卡车都能挡住。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME sends psychic fields through its beaks to make forcefields. The invisible walls are strong enough to stop a truck traveling at top speed.

entry: 右头的喙明显比左头锋利，让攻击略占优势。这种不对称在战斗中很有用。
author: .izik
source: The beak on its right head is noticeably sharper than the left, giving it a slight advantage in attacks. This asymmetry is useful in combat.

entry: POKENAME用利爪挖树根处的土，掘出苦根吃。只要牢牢抓住根部，连树桩也能拔起。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME dig at the base of trees with their sharp talons to unearth bitter roots to eat. They are capable of uprooting stumps once they get a secure hold on the roots.

entry: POKENAME用细喙探入花中吸蜜。受威胁时，喙内腺体会分泌毒液，让它能毒伤打扰进食的敌人。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME dig into flowers to drink nectar with their skinny beaks. Whenever they are threatened, the glands in their beak produce venom, allowing POKENAME to poison foes that interrupt their feeding session.

entry: POKENAME友好又热心，两个头合力解决难题，从未有人见过它们争吵打架。
author: frokachu
source: Incredibly friendly and helpful, POKENAME will try to solve problems with its two heads. No one has ever seen the heads disagree or fight with one another.

entry: POKENAME领地意识有时很强，手上的头会飞快啄击靠得太近的对象。攻势过后，自己却通常会头痛，或有点晕。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can get quite territorial, and those that get too close will be pecked rapidly by the heads on its hands. After the assault, POKENAME usually suffers from headaches or a bit of dizziness.

entry: POKENAME尾端的第二颗头，有自己的大脑。它很好奇，为调查感兴趣的东西，甚至可能用超能力夺走身体控制权。
author: sk372
source: A second head with its own brain rests at the end of POKENAME's tail. The tail-head is quite curious, and may psychically seize control of the body just to investigate something that has caught its interest.

entry: 两个头为猎物自私地争斗，抢夺进食的权利。久而久之，常获胜的那个长得异常硕大，另一个则逐渐萎缩。
author: sk372
source: The two heads selfishly fight over any captured prey, battling for the right to eat their spoils. Over time, one will grow oversized as it consistently wins these fights for food, while the other slowly withers away.

entry: POKENAME每年迁往气候更温和的地方，成群出行，保护幼崽。飞行能力留待紧急时使用，平时更喜欢靠双腿漫游。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME make an annual migration to a more temperate climate and travel in flocks to protect their young. They reserve their flying ability for emergencies and prefer to roam about with their legs.

entry: POKENAME有时受雇替训练家或宝可梦放哨，用尖叫提醒伙伴注意危险。不过天性警觉，稍有动静就叫，造成许多虚惊。
author: aster_oid1701
source: POKENAME are sometimes employed to act as lookouts for Trainers and Pokémon alike, using shrill cries to alert companions of danger. Due to their wary nature, they often cry out at any sign of movement, leading to many false alarms.

entry: 它移动时，身体像手风琴般伸缩，能钻过狭窄空间。这份非凡柔韧性，让避开障碍轻而易举。
author: .izik
source: Its body stretches and contracts like an accordion as it moves, allowing it to slip through tight spaces. This unusual flexibility helps it avoid obstacles effortlessly.

entry: POKENAME长腿能让它长途跋涉，不必休息。常远离族群，寻找青绿草地，希望找到能吃的虫属性宝可梦。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have long legs that carry them for long distances without rest. They often wander far from their flock to find grassy green patches of grass, hoping to find some edible Bug-type Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME每颗头的喉后都有发光器官。会一边尖叫，一边快速交替闪光，吓退入侵者。
author: sk372
source: Each head has an organ in the back of its throat that produces light. POKENAME squawks and generates rapid alternating flashes of light to scare off invaders.

entry: POKENAME发出的叫声像婴儿，稍稍失真，仿佛经收音机播放。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME will let loose a cry that sounds like an infant. The cry is slightly distorted, as if being played over a radio.

entry: 几颗头连在一起，共享中央的一只眼睛，视野统一。这种连接，帮助它们所有行动都配合无间。
author: .izik
source: The heads are joined and share a single central eye, giving them a unified vision. This connection helps them coordinate perfectly in all actions.

entry: POKENAME充满好奇，在草甸与其他原野漫游，寻找花朵。找到合适的就戴在头上，戴同种花的个体会结群旅行。
author: fxncy_poland
source: POKENAME are curious Pokémon that wander around meadows and other fields in search of flowers. Once it finds a suitable flower, it puts it on its head. POKENAME with the same flower as others are known to travel in groups.

entry: POKENAME将头当翅膀拍动，能短距离飞行。不过猛烈拍动后会头晕，因此更喜欢奔跑。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are capable of flying short distances by flapping their heads as though they are wings. However, they prefer to run because they get dizzy after vigorously flapping.

entry: 尾端的头不停警戒，常让它无法入睡。即使精疲力竭，也因这份警惕而保持清醒。
author: .izik
source: The head at the end of its tail constantly watches for danger, often causing it to lose sleep. Its vigilance keeps it alert, even when exhausted.

entry: POKENAME的头前后两面都有脸。两张脸都以为自己正看着前方，结果混乱不堪，去哪里都困难。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME has a face on both sides of its head. This leads to much confusion, as both faces believe they are looking straight ahead, so it struggles to get anywhere.

entry: 第二颗头负责警戒，还能够到、吃下多数悬挂的果实或树果。只需一颗头进食即可，因此主体往往专心寻找食物、避开敌人。
author: infinex21
source: The second head keeps a lookout for any threats and can reach and eat most hanging fruits or berries. It only needs to eat from one of its heads, so the main body tends to focus on finding food and avoiding foes.

entry: 尾巴上的头总在梳理毛发，保持整洁。这个习惯让它在自然栖息地也光滑体面。
author: .izik
source: The head on its tail is always grooming its fur, keeping it tidy. This habit helps it stay sleek and presentable in its natural habitat.

entry: POKENAME能不可思议地感知地下贵重物件。经过有价值的东西上方时，就会在空中上下弹跳。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME has an uncanny ability to sense valuable objects underground. When it passes over something of value, it will bounce up and down in the air.

entry: 对战中，POKENAME承受许多沉重攻击。找到破绽后，会用双头中的一颗啄击，发起反攻。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME absorb many hard-hitting attacks during a Pokémon battle. When they find an opening, they launch a counterattack by pecking with one of their two heads.

entry: 它站在崖边，巡视下方有无天敌。受威胁时释放精神冲击，迅速反应，为安全逃脱争取机会。
author: .izik
source: It stands on cliff edges, scanning below for predators, and releases a psychic blast when threatened. This quick reaction provides a chance to flee safely.

entry: POKENAME的两颗头，都不知道哪边才是头、哪边是尾。常相互前后拉扯，根本无法快速移动。
author: bradlybro199
source: Both heads of POKENAME are unaware of which is the head and which is the tail. They often pull each other back and forth, making it impossible to move quickly.

entry: 喙能吐出尖锐针球，用来铺在巢里。这道带刺屏障，能阻止入侵者打扰家园。
author: .izik
source: Its beaks can spit sharp balls of needles, which it uses to line its nest. This spiky barrier deters intruders from disturbing its home.

entry: 身体看着硬，外面却覆着颇厚的绒毛。休息或受威胁时，各颗头会藏进头骨般的壳中。
author: krune
source: Its body may look hard, but it has a decently thick layer of fluff covering its exterior. The heads hide in the skull-like shell when resting or feeling threatened.

entry: 它的羽毛柔软，过去曾被收集来填床垫。如今虽很少再这样使用，民间传说仍记得这段往事。
author: .izik
source: Its feathers were once collected to stuff mattresses due to their softness. This legacy is still remembered in folklore, despite rarely being used.

entry: POKENAME的头不停争夺主导地位，有时吵得太凶，连与其他宝可梦的战斗都无法专心。能让它平静的训练家，被视为本领高强。
author: chibitales
source: The heads of POKENAME constantly fight over which head is dominant. The bickering can get so intense that it loses focus on battles with other Pokémon. Trainers with a calm POKENAME are seen as highly skilled.

entry: 生气时，覆身冒泡的泥会变得极烫。这些泥在神奥各地被用于美容。
author: .izik
source: The bubbling mud covering its body heats up intensely when it becomes angry. The mud itself is used in beauty treatments throughout Sinnoh.

entry: 它攀住树，啄开木头，吸取里面的甜树液。最爱这份美味，每天都回到同样的树前。
author: .izik
source: It clings to trees and pecks at the wood to access the sweet sap within. This favorite treat keeps it coming back to the same trees daily.

entry: POKENAME的两个猪鼻子都嗅觉敏锐。即使极为寒冷，农民也能请它嗅寻松露。
author: dodoowner_
source: Both of POKENAME's pig noses have a keen sense of smell. Farmers use it to sniff out truffles in the coldest conditions.

entry: POKENAME双头上新长的羽毛，柔软温暖得惊人。用它作内衬的冬衣，深受该地区裁缝珍视。
author: .izik
source: The new feathers on POKENAME's twin heads are incredibly soft and warm. Winter coats lined with them are prized by tailors across the region.

entry: POKENAME靠尖喙刺穿猎物，将其串在喙上。过去曾因喙被猎捕，纹身师拿它作纹身针。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME rely on their sharp beaks to skewer prey onto their beaks. They were once hunted for their beaks by tattoo artists, who used the beaks as tattoo needles.

entry: POKENAME爱恶作剧，会潜入营地，偷走感兴趣的物件，再飞快爬走。两颗头虽然常吵，却也会将脖子缠在一起，彼此安抚。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is mischievous and will sneak into camps, steal an interesting item, and slither away extremely quickly. The two heads may bicker often, but they coil their necks around each other as a comforting method.

entry: 人们认为，POKENAME体内还有第二个意识，增强思考能力。不过与核心意识配合不佳，常不得不停下手头的事，梳理突然多出的信息。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is believed to have a second mind within its body to enhance its thinking capabilities. It does not mesh with its core mind well, however, often causing it to stop what it is doing to sift through sudden extra information.

entry: 每个尖喙末端都含毒，能使猎物动弹不得。只需一刺，就足以让较小的宝可梦无力反抗。
author: .izik
source: Each of its sharp beak tips contains venom that can immobilize prey. A single jab is enough to render smaller Pokémon helpless.

entry: 它把喝下的树液转化成极甜的奶。大量饮用，可能导致失眠。
author: .izik
source: It converts the sap it drinks from trees into an extremely sweet milk. This milk can cause insomnia if consumed in large quantities.

entry: POKENAME每颗头各有食谱，常为往哪个方向找食物争吵。虫属性宝可梦、树果和泥巴，多样食谱让身体强壮健康。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME heads each have a separate diet and often argue about which direction to go for food. Their varied diet of Bug-type Pokémon, berries, and mud keep their body strong and healthy.

entry: POKENAME头脑简单，常喝劲爽汽水，和胖甜妮争甜甜圈等甜食。斗智败下阵来，或发现自己弄错，就会怒得发出独特叫声。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are simple-minded Pokémon, often drinking Soda Pop and fighting Slurpuff for sweets such as donuts. When they are outsmarted or realize their mistakes, they let out a distinctive cry in anger.

entry: POKENAME两颗头会合力哀嚎念咒，让听者绝望得动弹不得。不过，两颗头从来不在同一个调上。
author: reflecbeat
source: The two heads of a POKENAME work together to make wailing incantations that can paralyse anyone hearing them with despair. The heads are never in tune with each other.

entry: 有东西想从背后靠近POKENAME，尾巴上的头就会尖叫示警。主体随即充电、电击敌人，再以超过每小时100英里的速度逃走。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: If something attempts to approach POKENAME from behind, the head on its tail screeches loudly to alert the main body. POKENAME then charges up electricity, shocking the foe before running away at over 100 miles per hour.

entry: 它们结成小群狩猎，一颗头留意危险，主要的头则专心捕猎。
author: kam_doodle_snek
source: These Pokémon hunt in small flocks. The secondary head looks out for danger while the main head focuses on hunting prey.

entry: POKENAME两只喙都极热，兴奋时微微发光。它会用来抵御捕食者，防止入侵者伤害巢穴。
author: .izik
source: Both of POKENAME's beaks are extremely hot, glowing faintly when it gets excited. It uses them to ward off predators and defend its nest from intruders.

entry: 它的羽毛会随环境变色，伪装能力惊人，既能躲过捕食者，也不被猎物察觉。
author: .izik
source: Its feathers change color to match its environment, providing remarkable camouflage. This adaptation allows it to remain hidden from both prey and predators.

entry: POKENAME是和平的拾食者，一见危险就埋进地下，只把假头留在地面。
author: weirdtux
source: POKENAME is a peaceful scavenger Pokémon. At the sight of danger, POKENAME will bury itself underground and leave its false head above.

entry: POKENAME饥饿得永不满足，常大群飞行，寻找被丢下的食物或受伤的宝可梦。
author: weirdtux
source: POKENAME has an insatiable hunger. It is known to fly around in large gatherings searching for abandoned meals or injured Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME会把主体埋在地下，只露假头。谁不幸碰见它，就会遭它迅速跃出泥土，攻击这位冒犯者。
author: weirdtux
source: POKENAME will bury its main body underground, leaving its false head above. Should anyone be unfortunate to stumble across it, POKENAME will quickly leap above the dirt and attack the offender.

entry: POKENAME体内积着太多腐化的亡魂，做什么都很吃力。别把手伸进它身体，因为一有东西靠近，它就忍不住想啄。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have so many festering spirits within their body that they struggle to do anything at all. Sticking one's hand into their body is ill advised, since they have a strong urge to peck anything that comes close.

entry: 两颗头的大脑几乎一模一样，很少争吵。唯一的例外，就是争抢训练家的抚摸。
author: melodydelune
source: Its two heads contain nearly identical brains. The heads rarely ever fight, with one exception being over pets from their Trainer.

entry: POKENAME会冻住大片土地，造出舒服的家园。它格外警觉，又有两颗头，因此很难让它措手不及。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME freeze over large swaths of land to make themselves a comfortable home. They are hard to surprise because of their hypervigilance and their twin heads.

entry: POKENAME加强火焰时，帽顶上的头会被热量熔化。据说那颗头完全熔掉时，POKENAME就会死去。
author: sk372
source: When POKENAME heats up its flames, the head atop its hat melts from the generated heat. It is said that when the head melts completely, POKENAME will perish.

entry: POKENAME常郁郁寡欢。外表可怕，几乎什么生物都会逃跑，因此经常极其孤独。
author: slimninja55
source: POKENAME are prone to melancholy. Their frightening appearances send nearly all creatures running, so these Pokémon are often extremely lonely.

entry: 它会先用长身体缠住树枝再睡觉，避开地面上的敌害，安心在树顶休息。
author: .izik
source: It wraps its long body around tree branches before falling asleep, secure from ground-dwelling threats. This habit ensures a peaceful rest in the treetops.

entry: POKENAME靠迅捷的双腿和强大嗅觉追猎。没有可靠气味痕迹，就会迅速跟丢，懊恼地啄地。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME rely on their swift feet and strong sense of smell to chase after prey. Without a proper scent trail to follow, POKENAME quickly lose track of their prey and peck at the ground in frustration.

entry: POKENAME两颗主要的头会保护连在身体上、没有明显五官的第三颗头。第三颗虽无法交流，得到摸头时，另外两颗却会兴高采烈。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have two main heads that protect the featureless third head that is attached to their body. Even though the third head is unable to communicate, the other two heads react with glee if the third head is given headpats.

entry: POKENAME实现的愿望会带来灾难后果。每当一颗头实现愿望，另一颗就把愿望扭曲，作为改变命运的代价。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: The wishes granted by POKENAME come with disastrous consequences. Whenever one head grants a wish, the other twists it as the price of changing fate.

entry: POKENAME的身体比黄金还沉，因此捕猎行动缓慢的虫属性宝可梦。它会巧妙啄击目标，诱使对方暴露弱点。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME hunt for slow Bug-type Pokémon because their bodies are heavier than gold. They strategically peck at their target to goad them into exposing their weak spots.

entry: 它会用喙快速挖沙，让自己迅速埋好，成为躲避危险的办法。
author: .izik
source: It uses its beaks to dig through sand at a rapid pace, allowing it to bury itself quickly. This trait provides an escape route from danger.

entry: 下方的头会捡食，随着齿轮转动，传给另一颗。一颗睡觉时，另一颗就得耗双倍能量，维持齿轮运转。
author: sk372
source: The lower head picks up bits of food and passes it to the other as the gears rotate. When one head sleeps, the other exerts twice as much energy to keep the gears turning.

entry: POKENAME两张嘴同时唱，却很少是同一首歌。杂乱的二重唱太吵，因此常没法让其他对象睡着。
author: sk372
source: The two mouths of POKENAME sing at the same time, but rarely sing the same song. As such, it often cannot send others to sleep, as the mismatched duet is too cacophonous to be effective.

entry: 它会先从高草探出上方的头，确认有没有捕食者，再完全露面。谨慎的习惯，让它在野外更安全。
author: .izik
source: Its upper head peeks out from tall grass to scout for predators before emerging fully. This cautious behavior keeps it safe in the wild.

entry: POKENAME天生好奇，各颗头朝不同方向探查，再被包围身体的神秘液体拉回一起。若一颗头格外感兴趣，也会说服另一颗一起研究。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are highly curious by nature, each head poking around in different directions before the mysterious liquid surrounding them pulls them back together. If one head is curious enough about its study, it will convince the other to investigate.

entry: POKENAME没有眼睛的那颗头，嫉妒另一颗能看见，总爱打架。训练家必须经常拉开它们。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: The eyeless head is prone to fighting with the other head, jealous of its ability to see. POKENAME trainers must frequently separate them.

entry: POKENAME会用爪掀起倒木和树桩，寻找虫属性宝可梦。对方一开始逃，就用双喙啄地捕捉。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME hunt for Bug-type Pokémon by uprooting logs and stumps with their claws. Once the Bug-type Pokémon begin to run away, they peck at the ground with their twin beaks.

entry: POKENAME喜欢哪个季节，就会长出相应颜色的飞羽。偏爱春天的个体，飞羽会呈黄褐色。
author: .izik
source: Depending on the time of the year it prefers, a POKENAME will grow different colored remiges. The flight feathers will be tan if it prefers spring.

entry: 喙里的微毒，遇到生命危险时会强得多。这种防御机制，让它在绝境中占优势。
author: .izik
source: The weak venom in its beaks becomes much stronger when faced with a life-threatening situation. This defensive mechanism gives it an edge in desperate moments.

entry: 单看POKENAME的外表，很难想到它能动得那么快。沿途留下的大团垃圾，臭得可能把人熏昏。
author: darkweavile428
source: Despite its appearance, POKENAME can move remarkably fast. It leaves behind large clumps of trash that smell so putrid they can render people unconscious.

entry: POKENAME用一颗头吃喜欢的垃圾，另一颗扔掉不要的。它会用诞生时的垃圾袋储存多余垃圾，留待以后吃。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME uses one head to eat trash it likes while using the other head to throw away trash it doesn't want. It uses the trash bag it was born from as a sack to store extra trash for later consumption.

entry: POKENAME两颗头分工，一颗放哨，另一颗吃。敌人靠近，警戒的头就会喷出毒花粉防御。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's two heads share responsibilities - one watches for danger while the other eats. If a foe approaches, the watchful head releases a cloud of toxic pollen as a defense mechanism.

entry: POKENAME巨花的中央伸出第二颗头，能喷出一大股刺鼻花粉，熏晕袭击者，自我保护。
author: sk372
source: A second head extends from the center of POKENAME's huge flower. For self-defense, this extra head can breathe out a large plume of noxious-smelling pollen to stun attackers.

entry: 它能用任意一只喙稳稳支撑身体，再踢出强力一脚。技巧既好看，战斗中也很有效。
author: .izik
source: It balances perfectly on either of its two beaks before launching into a powerful kick. This move is both impressive and effective in combat.

entry: 它会把阳光直接吸进头冠，补充能量。晴天时，比平时更活跃、更灵巧。
author: .izik
source: It absorbs sunlight directly into the crowns on its heads to fuel its energy. During sunny days, it becomes more active and agile than usual.

entry: 它的羽毛其实是数万亿根细小针刺，兼顾防护与保温，让捕食者很难靠近。
author: .izik
source: Its feathers are actually trillions of tiny needles, providing both protection and insulation. These spiky needles make it difficult for predators to approach.

entry: 身上看似“沙”的部分，其实由微小羽毛组成，既保温，也以独特质地帮助伪装。
author: .izik
source: The "sand" covering its body is actually composed of tiny feathers. These feathers provide insulation and a unique texture for camouflage.

entry: POKENAME两颗头都能喷出花中产生的恶臭花粉。一旦袭击者被臭气和麻痹效果震住，POKENAME就赶忙逃走。
author: sk372
source: Both of POKENAME's heads can breathe out a noxious cloud of pollen sourced from the flower they emerge from. Once an attacker is stunned by the stench and paralyzing effect, it hastily flees.

entry: 头部在体内与背上真菌相连，肢体完全由真菌操控。这种共生，让动作精准高效。
author: .izik
source: The heads are connected internally to the fungi growing on its back, which control its limbs entirely. This symbiosis allows it to move with precision and efficiency.

entry: 与真菌连成一体后，各颗头的意识并不完整，会不自觉地啾啾鸣叫。它们也会本能地向其他生物散播孢子。
author: .izik
source: While integrated with the fungi, the heads are not fully sentient, emitting passive chirps. They spread spores onto other creatures as a natural behavior.

entry: POKENAME爱种作物，常坐在凰梨果树下。它会用头啄下熟果，再埋进土里，种出新作物。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME loves planting crops and often sits beneath Pinap Berry trees. It uses its heads to peck off ripe berries, which it then plants in the soil to grow new crops.

entry: POKENAME带着燃烧的树枝。有人说，一颗头凝视火焰能看见未来，另一颗则能看见过去。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME carries a burning branch. Some say that one of its heads can see the future by gazing into the flames, while the other can see the past.

entry: POKENAME口中会排出滚滚烟，帮助烧穿虫茧，取得食物。偶尔也会背一颗蛋，照顾到孵化。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME release billowing smoke from their beaks, which helps them burn through cocoons and secure them a meal. On rare occasions they carry an egg atop their backs and nurse the egg until it hatches.

entry: POKENAME在这一进化阶段，会频繁蜕下整张皮。它披着最近脱下的皮，装成不止一只，吓退捕食者。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME fully sheds its skin frequently during this evolutionary stage. It wears its most recent shedding to appear as multiple POKENAME, deterring predators.

entry: POKENAME两颗头会合力对付猎物与捕食者。双喙比爪更锋利，也坚韧得足以敲碎岩石。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME have two heads that work together to overcome prey and predators alike. Their two beaks are sharper than their claws and are tough enough to break away rock.

entry: POKENAME躯干覆着土色羽毛，极像泥土。逃跑时会撒出羽毛，迷惑捕食者，掩住逃跑路线。
author: .izik
source: The dirt-colored feathers covering POKENAME's torso closely resemble soil. When fleeing, it scatters these feathers to confuse predators and obscure its escape route.

entry: POKENAME会走进矿井，用喙在洞壁找稀有金属。它们轮流啄岩壁，最终露出闪亮矿石。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME wander into mineshafts to peck at the rare metals within the cavernous walls. They take turns poking at the rocky walls to eventually reveal the shiny ore.

entry: POKENAME暴怒时，会以手术般精准的啄击专攻要害。任何打断，都只会让它更怒。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME pecks at enemies with surgical precision when in a rage, targeting vital points. Any interruptions only serve to make POKENAME even angrier.

entry: POKENAME双腿有力，一天能跑数百英里。休息时，两颗头会用喙仔细梳理厚实的羽毛。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's powerful legs allow it to run hundreds of miles a day. When resting, the two heads meticulously groom its thick plumage with their beaks.

entry: POKENAME性格好斗，但两颗脑袋想法简单，又不够协调。它常想同时对付两个不同敌人，结果哪一个都没法专心应付。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has a combative personality, but its two minds are simple and lack a bit of cohesion. It often tries to take on two different opponents at once, and becomes unable to properly focus on either in the battle.

entry: POKENAME会吃高蛋白食物，把巢布置得尽量舒适，都是在为进化做准备。训练家的个体若一反常态，可能快进化了。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME eats meals high in protein and creates the most comfortable nest it can, all to prepare itself for evolution. If a Trainer's POKENAME is behaving unlike its usual self, it may be about to evolve.

entry: POKENAME会突然猛练一阵，屈伸四肢、弯膝、四处蹦跳，难以预测。许多训练家觉得这种突然活动既好笑又可爱。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME train in wild, unpredictable bursts - flexing their limbs, bending their knees, and jumping here and there. These sudden bouts of activity are considered humorous and lovable by many Trainers.

entry: POKENAME训练时一阵一阵，也很容易分心。运动员喜欢与它掰手腕、赛跑，因为它不论输赢都很大度。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME train in short bursts and are easily distracted. Athletes enjoy having arm wrestling matches and races with POKENAME because they are magnanimous regardless of whether they win or lose.

entry: 即使睡觉，也曾见POKENAME摇摆闪过来袭攻击。人们认为，它体内有第二套能感知周围的神经系统，头睡着了，身体仍会本能闪避。
author: sk372
source: Even when sleeping, POKENAME has been seen bobbing and weaving away from incoming assaults. It's believed its body contains a second nervous system that is aware of its surroundings, dodging on instinct even while the head snoozes.

entry: POKENAME尾巴上的头一张嘴，就能看见里面燃着火。这颗头能帮它留意偷袭，也多了一张能喷出强烈火焰的嘴。
author: sk372
source: When the head on POKENAME's tail opens its beak, a burning flame can be seen within. This secondary head helps keep POKENAME aware of sneak attacks and provides a second mouth to breathe intense fire blasts from.

entry: 巨大的荚状身体覆着羽毛，常在马铃薯田有节奏地鼓动，根从作物吸取养分。农夫会定期清除这些害物，担心颤动的结构里会冒出什么生物。
author: .izik
source: Its large feathery pod-like body is commonly seen pulsating in potato fields, its roots drawing nutrients from the crops. Farmers regularly remove these pests, fearing what creature could emerge from the quivering structure.

entry: POKENAME会疾跑过丛林，沿途撒下小羽毛。研究者认为，羽毛带着孢子，能帮助它寄生其他植物。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME sprints through jungles, scattering tiny feathers as it moves. Researchers believe these feathers carry spores that allow it to parasitize other plants.

entry: POKENAME主要水生，上岸觅食却不费劲。触手般的腿，让步态摇晃起伏，许多人形容看着不安。
author: sk372
source: Although it is primarily aquatic, POKENAME has little difficulty going onto land to seek food. Its tentacle legs give it a wobbling, undulating gait that many have described as unnerving.

entry: 人们聚集庆祝的地方，常有POKENAME出现。几颗头轮流睡，因此从不怕错过热闹。
author: laughing_dan
source: POKENAME appear where many people are gathered in celebration. Its heads take turns sleeping, so it never fears missing out on a good time.

entry: POKENAME喜欢沿山路极速猛冲。它虽然没翅膀，沉重身体却能积起足够冲劲，跃上天空，仿佛会飞。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME likes to barrel down mountain trails at incredible speeds. Though it lacks wings, it can build up enough momentum with its heavy body to leap into the air as if it were able to fly.

entry: 它的利爪能轻松踏过最崎岖的地形，让它成为顽强又灵活的探险者。
author: .izik
source: Its talons enable it to travel across the roughest terrains with ease. This adaptation makes it a resilient and agile explorer.

entry: POKENAME尾上的两颗头比主头聪明，却控制不了身体。一颗负责狩猎或捕鱼，另一颗徒劳地催主体行动，彼此轮换。
author: sk372
source: The two heads at the tail are more intelligent than the main head, but lack control of the body. The duo takes turns between hunting or fishing for food and trying vainly to get POKENAME to move around.

entry: POKENAME身体披着难以驾驭的壳，常绊倒自己。摔后想起身也不容易，因为得把几颗头保持平衡。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME often trip over themselves often because of the unwieldy shell across their body. Getting up after a fall can be difficult because they need to keep their heads in a balanced position.

entry: POKENAME长腿能无声踏进浅湖，身体遮出的阴影则引来鱼类宝可梦。一颗头警戒，其余进食；受威胁时，能以约每小时65英里逃跑。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME's long legs allow it to silently creep into shallow lakes while its body provides shade to lure fish Pokémon. One head remains vigilant for danger while the rest feed. It can flee at speeds around 65 miles per hour when threatened.

entry: 中间的头不能吃东西，靠两侧头部供给养分。这种独特适应，让所有头都能得到滋养。
author: .izik
source: The middle head is incapable of eating and receives nutrients from the two heads on either side. This unique adaptation ensures all heads remain nourished.

entry: 鳍上的爪主要做样子，很少用于战斗。它会胡乱挥动，吓退捕食者。
author: .izik
source: The claws on its flippers are mainly for show and seldom used in battle. It waves them around haphazardly to dissuade predators.

entry: POKENAME捕猎带壳宝可梦时，用喙精准得像做手术。一颗头压住猎物外壳背面，另一颗则试着撬开。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME maneuver their beaks with surgical precision when hunting for shelled Pokémon. One head will apply pressure to the back of their shell while the other tries to pry their prey open.

entry: POKENAME两颗头合力保持平衡，却常为往哪走争吵。它会把头扎进沙里，大口吃沙，获取养分。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME two heads work together to keep them balanced, though they often fight over which way to go. They will plunge their heads into the sand, eating mouthfuls of it for nutrients.

entry: POKENAME会用长爪和喙挖掘可吃的绿植与掘地虫类宝可梦。它抖身清理碎屑时，羽毛和种子会释放浓密花粉。
author: infinex21
source: It uses its long talons and beak to dig for edible greens and burrowing bug POKENAME to feed upon. It releases thick pollen from its feathers and bulb when it shakes itself to loosen debris.

entry: 它奔跑时若绊倒，就会靠球形身体滚走，直到逃离捕食者。这种动作常迷惑敌人，给它逃跑机会。
author: .izik
source: If it trips while running, it will roll away on its orb-like body until it escapes a predator. This motion often confuses enemies, giving it a chance to flee.

entry: 三颗头不停用心灵感应交流，虽然各有大脑，行动却如同一个意识。
author: .jerden
source: Its three heads constantly communicate with each other using telepathy. While they have separate brains, they act together like a single mind.

entry: 它痴迷于用骨头末端的羽毛，细细给洞穴掸尘。怪习惯让住处始终一尘不染。
author: .izik
source: It is obsessed with using the feathers at the tip of its bone to meticulously dust its den. This strange habit helps it keep its home spotless at all times.

entry: POKENAME把外侧的头当双截棍，大幅甩动，攻击更远的敌人。战后，几颗头会大声争论，怎样打才更有效。
author: shyguy11011
