source: POKENAME wields its outer heads like nunchucks, swinging them in wide arcs to attack at longer ranges. After a battle, its heads argue loudly over how to fight more effectively.

entry: POKENAME靠两只有爪的脚，能远离水域旅行，因此吃得到在海滩附近难以取得的树果和其他零食。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are capable of travelling far from water with their two taloned feet. This allows them to access berries and other snacks that are hard to access close to beaches.

entry: POKENAME会跑过海滩，去树果丰富的森林。它太爱尝新食物，为此不惜远离家园。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME run past beaches to access forests where a variety of berries are present. They love trying out new food so much that they travel far from their homes to do so.

entry: 尾端羽毛虽然像火，摸起来却出奇凉爽。不过摇曳闪动的样子，看起来就像真的火。
author: .izik
source: Although the feathers at the tip of its tail resemble flames, they are surprisingly cool. However, they flicker and sway, giving the illusion of fire.

entry: 它能分成三团，各有性格。不过必须在一天内重新合体，否则会因难以承受的孤独而死去。
author: .izik
source: It has the ability to split into three separate globs, each with its own personality. However, it must rejoin within a day, or it will perish due to overwhelming loneliness.

entry: POKENAME会接连啄击一切靠近者，抵御捕食者。啄得很疼，让许多家伙不再纠缠。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME defend themselves against predators by unleashing a pecking assault against whatever may come close to them. The painful pecks of a POKENAME cause many to leave them alone.

entry: POKENAME潜伏在峡谷高处，寻找下方腐肉。一发现就俯冲下去，三颗头分别撕食尸体。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME lurk near the peaks of canyons, searching below for carrion to eat. Once spotted, they will swoop down, each of their three heads picking apart the carcass.

entry: POKENAME战斗时，喙会热得惊人，哪怕短暂碰沙，也能立刻将其变成玻璃。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's beaks become intensely hot during combat. They grow so hot that even a brief contact with sand will turn it to glass instantly.

entry: POKENAME额外的头分别操纵手臂，优先负责攻击，让主头专心移动。它还藏着刺针，能向被咬的敌人注入麻痹心智的毒液。
author: laughing_dan
source: POKENAME's additional heads control each arm separately to prioritise attacking so that the main head can focus on movement. POKENAME has hidden stingers that can inject mind-numbing venom into a bitten foe.

entry: POKENAME尾上的各颗头，都存着一部分精神力量。人们认为，POKENAME行动前，各颗头会先用心灵感应商量。
author: pastapockets
source: The heads on POKENAME's tail each hold a portion of its psychic power. It is believed that the heads confer telepathically before POKENAME acts.

entry: POKENAME会散出怡人香气，引虫属性宝可梦靠近。到得够近，就迅速连啄，拿下下一餐。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME release a pleasant aroma to lure Bug-type Pokémon towards them. Once the Bug-type Pokémon is close enough, they peck their prey in rapid succession to secure their next meal.

entry: POKENAME会烧小木屑，把宝可梦引出洞。找到合适目标，就接连猛啄，制服下一餐。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME burn small shavings of wood to lure Pokémon out of their burrows. If they find a suitable target, they unleash a flurry of pecks to take down their next meal.

entry: POKENAME会装成生病的小锯鳄，接近大力鳄的食物。等靠近剩饭，就偷偷把食物块分给各颗头。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME appear like a sick Totodile to get close to a meal from a Feraligatr. Once they are close enough to the leftovers, they sneak chunks of the food to their many heads.

entry: POKENAME很爱美，尾上的粉红羽毛在战斗中受损，就会暴怒。虽然有翅膀，仍更喜欢跑着走。
author: fiordaliso
source: It is a very vain Pokémon that flies into a rage if the pink feathers on its tail are damaged in battle. Despite having wings, POKENAME prefers to move by running.

entry: POKENAME结群旅行，互相留意捕食者。若有胆大的真来袭，就得承受整群的啄击。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME travel in packs where they keep watch for their predators. If a bold predator decides to attack, they have to endure the pecks from the entire POKENAME horde.

entry: POKENAME会结大群，防范捕食者、猎捕大型猎物。跑得比自行车还快，头也能直接从空中叼住巴大蝶。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME travel in large groups to protect themselves from predators and hunt large prey. Their speedy bodies are capable of outrunning a bike while their heads are able to pluck a Butterfree mid-flight.

entry: POKENAME不太会飞，主要靠快速远跳移动。各颗头有独立大脑，必须好好协调，因此刚进化的个体会很笨拙。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME cannot fly very well, so it relies on hopping long distances at great speed. However, this requires great coordination between each head, as they possess individual brains. Therefore, newly evolved POKENAME are clumsy.

entry: POKENAME在森林找坚果，喙能轻松夹开硬壳。它跑得极快，遇险转眼就逃。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME forage for nuts in the forest, their beaks able to crack open hard shells with ease. These Pokémon are extremely fast runners, fleeing from danger in an instant.

entry: POKENAME很适合爱放松的人作伴。吃得饱、又与训练家感情深时，就会分泌芳香乳液，使出点穴，舒缓酸痛。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME is a perfect companion for those who enjoy relaxation. When it is well-fed and has formed a strong bond with its Trainer, it secretes a fragrant lotion and uses Acupressure to soothe aches.

entry: POKENAME会啄树根部，诱出住在里面的虫属性宝可梦。遇到格外不肯出来的猎物，就把毒花粉灌进洞，逼它出来。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME peck at the base of trees to coax Bug-type Pokémon out of their homes. For particularly stubborn prey, they flood the burrows with poisonous pollen to force their prey out.

entry: 它会把头伸入水中狩猎，轻松捉住小型猎物。能长时间憋气，因此很擅长游泳。
author: .izik
source: It extends its heads underwater to hunt for aquatic prey, catching small prey with ease. Its ability to hold its breath for extended periods makes it a skilled swimmer.

entry: POKENAME的主头能控制前两条腿，其他两颗头却各只能控制一条。后面的头觉得这很不公平。
author: dodoowner_
source: The main head of POKENAME gets to control the front two legs, while the other two heads only get one leg. The back heads think this is very unfair.

entry: POKENAME的头仍不肯配合，常打空、露破绽。不过真肯齐心时，实力不可小看。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME's heads still don't cooperate, which often leads to them missing attacks and leaving themselves open. However, if they do decide to work together, they are a force to be reckoned with.

entry: POKENAME会装得文静，诱其他宝可梦靠近，再突然凶猛连啄。疼痛的啄击，让许多宝可梦以后交朋友都更警惕。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME act demure to lure other Pokémon close to them before unleashing a feral assault of beaks. The painful pecks from a POKENAME cause many Pokémon to become more vigilant of the friends they make.

entry: POKENAME悬浮时，身体像电视雪花噪点般闪烁。受到威胁，会发射热度超过华氏800度的能量光束。有传闻称它会变换形态，但未获证实。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME's body resembles and flickers like TV static as they levitate. When threatened, they fire beams of energy exceeding 800°F. While unconfirmed, POKENAME are rumored to take on different forms.

entry: 它棕褐、泥巴般的身体散出高热，碰到很危险，连走过的地也能灼焦。
author: .izik
source: Its brown, mud-like body radiates intense heat, making it dangerous to touch. The heat can even scorch the ground it walks on.

entry: POKENAME侧面长的腿太弱，撑不起身体，只能拉着自己向前挪。
author: .realthree
source: The limbs sprouting from POKENAME's side are too weak to lift it. Instead, it pulls itself forwards with these legs.

entry: POKENAME体内似乎有三个意识，却没有好好同步。不同意识争夺身体控制权时，情绪可能剧烈起伏。
author: sk372
source: Three minds seem to inhabit POKENAME's body, but they are not properly synced to each other. POKENAME may exhibit wild mood swings as different minds fight over and take control of the body.

entry: 描绘POKENAME的古代图像，比基因之楔的发明还早。它能发出响亮怒吼，却更爱用小画拼成近似文字的排列，彼此交流。
author: sontyp
source: Ancient depictions of POKENAME predate the invention of DNA splicers. It's capable of loud, angry noises, but prefers to communicate via small paintings it assembles in a way that resembles writing.

entry: 喙里有两列锯齿毒牙，个个满含强效毒液。一口便足以让猎物几乎立刻麻痹。
author: .izik
source: There are two columns of serrated fangs inside its beak, each filled with potent venom. A single bite can paralyze prey almost instantly.

entry: POKENAME乍看像森林守护者，可谁靠得太近，都会遭一轮猛啄。它会穿越时间，喂养幼年嘟嘟，直到能独立进食。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME appear as forest guardians at a first glance, but whenever anything comes too close to them will get pecked by a barrage of beaks. They travel through time to feed baby Doduo until they are ready to feed themselves.

entry: 它进食靠三条有智慧的尾巴，用强喙啄开坚果。不过尾巴爱争吵，所以平时更愿意独自做事。
author: footlongdingledong
source: To eat, it relies on its three sapient tails to crack into nuts with their powerful beaks. However, the tails are prone to squabbles, so it tends to do things by itself.

entry: POKENAME进化后各颗头的位置和数量，取决于当时藤蔓的分布与健康。巨蔓藤与嘟嘟利直接融合，通常有3到5颗头。
author: bobosmith01
source: The location and number of POKENAME's heads vary based on the position and overall health of its vines upon evolution. In the case of direct fusion between a Tangrowth and Dodrio, three to five heads are the norm.

entry: POKENAME体内程序要把能量和运算力分给3颗头，因此警觉与反应只有其他宝可梦的三分之一。下载数据太多，多余就从身上眼状图案排出。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME is only a third as vigilant and reactive compared to other Pokémon since its inner programs must split energy and processing power between the 3 heads. If it downloads too much data , it ejects the excess through the eye pattern on its body.

entry: POKENAME最高能以每小时40英里冲刺，可一颗头分心，就常会跌绊。三颗头齐心时，则能放出破坏力惊人的烈焰。
author: mepp.
source: Though POKENAME are capable of sprinting up to 40 mph, they often trip and stumble if one of their heads becomes distracted. When all three heads work in tandem, they can unleash devastating blazes.

entry: 融合后，有些POKENAME变得极不稳定，实体世界只剩少数粒子。意识虽分离，却仍能完美运作。
author: entomoxie
source: Upon fusion, some POKENAME become too unstable for all but a few particles to remain in the physical realm. Their minds, while split, function perfectly.

entry: POKENAME独特歌声令许多人着迷。它虽然独唱，听起来却像三个嗓音在完美合唱。
author: sk372
source: Many are captivated by the unique sound of POKENAME's song. Though it only sings by itself, it sounds like a choir of three voices singing in perfect harmony.

entry: POKENAME每颗头的颜色、毛纹都可能不一样，连舌头颜色也能各异。
author: bobosmith01
source: Every head of POKENAME may have a different color or fur pattern at once. Even the color of their tongues may differ from one another.

entry: POKENAME虽弱，战斗却凶，常无视训练家，随心所欲地攻击。
author: weirdtux
source: Although weak, POKENAME is known for its ferocious tendencies in battle, often ignoring its Trainer in favor of attacking how it pleases.

entry: POKENAME会把主体藏在灌木里，只伸出两个假头引人注意。好奇宝可梦一靠太近，就会遭凶猛袭击。
author: weirdtux
source: POKENAME will hide its main body inside a bush while poking its two false heads out to draw attention. Once a curious Pokémon gets too close, POKENAME will attack ferociously.

entry: POKENAME会钻进地下，把两个假头留在地面。假头不断砸地，等好奇宝可梦走来，再突然袭击。
author: weirdtux
source: POKENAME will burrow itself underground, leaving its two false heads on the surface. POKENAME's false heads smash against the ground until a curious Pokémon comes across them, at which point POKENAME will attack.

entry: POKENAME会轮流用小喙，发动幽灵般的啄击。每一下虽轻，众多喙接连啄中合适位置，仍会十分疼痛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME coordinate ethereal pecks against foes by taking turns with miniature beaks. While each peck is small, the cascade of multiple beaks can be quite painful in the right spot.

entry: POKENAME中间的头负责决定另外两颗的食谱，后两颗则分泌毒素。两侧的头常难以专心、和睦，中央那颗却始终机警地保护大家。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: The center head of a POKENAME is in charge of determining the diet for the other two, who produce their poison. Although the two side heads often struggle to focus or get along, the central head remains a vigilant protector.

entry: 察觉龙卷风将近，POKENAME三颗头就会绕圈甩动，大声鸣叫。不过饿、难过、困倦或生气时也这样，因此预警很不可靠。
author: .izik
source: Should POKENAME sense an approaching tornado, all three heads swing in circular patterns while squawking loudly. However, it also does this when hungry, sad, sleepy, or angry, making it a rather unreliable warning.

entry: 古庙雕刻中，POKENAME的头数差别极大。有的一颗，有的多达六十七颗，让历史学家十分困惑。
author: .izik
source: Ancient temples contain carvings of POKENAME with wildly varying numbers of heads. Some depictions show one head, while others display up to sixty-seven, baffling historians.

entry: POKENAME造型虽然不灵便，却是有效的猎手。它会飞进虫属性宝可梦群，猛烈甩动身体，同时制服多个目标。
author: .fedoraman
source: Despite its unwieldy form, POKENAME is an effective hunter. It flies into swarms of Bug-type Pokémon, flailing its body wildly to incapacitate multiple targets at once.

entry: 宝可梦巡护员称，POKENAME是最出色的侦察员。双眼似乎什么都能看穿，而且无论昼夜，三颗头中始终至少一颗醒着。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Pokémon Rangers claim that POKENAME makes for the ultimate scout. Its eyes can apparently see through anything, and at least one of its three heads is always awake regardless of the time of day.

entry: 为得到训练家夸奖，三颗头会合作执行复杂计划。若其中一颗得到抚摸，另外两颗就会吃醋。
author: melodydelune
source: Seeking its Trainer's praise, its three heads execute complex plans between them. When one is being petted, the other two heads will be jealous.

entry: 它的锯齿喙比钢铁更坚韧，锋利得能磨穿铁，不崩口、也不变钝。它用下部利爪撑稳身体，再用粗重尾巴敲地，微震会让其他生物失去平衡。
author: infinex21
source: Its serrated beak is tougher than steel and sharp enough to grind through iron without chipping or dulling. It braces itself with its lower talons and thumps its bulky tail against the ground to create small tremors that throw others off-balance.

entry: POKENAME能运用力量，对目标接连猛啄。传说谁惹怒它，就会被送进一个不停遭啄的异空间。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are capable of harnessing their powers to unleash a flurry of pecks at their target. It is said that whoever angers a POKENAME will be sent into a dimension where they are pecked non-stop.

entry: 只能离地飘起一点点。底部长出的头会一路拖着，擦过泥土。
author: capwolfbane
source: It barely floats off the ground. The head sprouting from its bottom gets pulled along through the dirt.

entry: 三颗头飞行时各有分工。中间的朝威胁喷火，另外两颗协调方向和高度。
author: fiordaliso
source: Each of its three heads has a specific role during flight. The middle head breathes fire at any threat, while the other two coordinate direction and altitude.

entry: POKENAME极快，靠短暂冲刺追猎。三颗头会一同啄击，直到拿下下一餐。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are incredibly fast creatures that chase after prey in short bursts. Their three heads act in unison to peck at their prey until they have secured themselves a new meal.

entry: 传说后方九颗头，分别代表平静、勇气、恐惧、愤怒、厌恶、喜悦、爱、惊奇和悲伤。第十颗头统合全部情绪。
author: h0bojoe
source: Legends state its nine rear heads respectively represent calmness, courage, fear, anger, disgust, joy, love, amazement, and sadness. The tenth head integrates all emotions at once.

entry: POKENAME合作捕猎很默契，却会争谁来给出最后一击。多数时候，猎物反而趁机悄悄逃走，让它们吵得更凶。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME work well together to catch prey but then squabble amongst themselves on who gets to deliver the final blow. More often than not, this allows their prey to slip away unnoticed, causing the POKENAME to argue amongst themselves even more.

entry: POKENAME会朝树桩底喷火星，制造烟，让猎物慌忙逃出洞。三颗头随后接连猛啄，试着刺穿下一餐。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME shoot embers at the base of stumps to create smoke, which causes prey to rush out of burrows. As the prey frantically try to escape, POKENAME unleash a three-headed assault of pecking in an attempt to skewer their next meal.

entry: POKENAME无声飞过洞穴，找缝隙啄探。多数时候，都能找到躲在里面的虫属性宝可梦。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME fly silently through caves to find nooks and crannies to peck into. More often than not, they are able to locate a Bug-type Pokémon hiding in the crevice.

entry: POKENAME身上的倒刺，其实是小喙。它会旋转头部，把喙撞向目标，造成痛苦刺伤。
author: quackquackattack
source: The barbs on a POKENAME are made of small beaks. They swirl their heads to smack their beaks into their target, causing painful stab wounds.

entry: POKENAME靠尾羽飞行，令科学家十分困惑。毕竟按所有航空学法则，它都不该飞得起来。
author: krune
source: POKENAME flies using its tail feathers. Scientists are baffled by this, as according to all laws of aviation, a POKENAME should not be able to fly.

entry: POKENAME舞姿很有风格，却常为了取悦训练家而绊倒自己。偶尔同步的舞步虽短暂，却格外迷人。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME dance with style but often stumble over themselves trying to impress their Trainer. The moments they dance in unison are as fleeting as they are mesmerizing.

entry: 头上的羽毛装满令人昏昏欲睡的花粉。吸入后，常转眼就睡着。
author: .izik
source: The feathers on its head are filled with a pollen that induces drowsiness. Those who inhale it often fall asleep within moments.

entry: POKENAME以巨力和战斗中不肯停歇闻名，连整支敌军也能一路撕开，不停向前。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is known for its great strength and relentlessness in battle. It can rip and tear its way through entire armies of opponents without stopping.

entry: POKENAME住在农场，会大声啼叫报晓。若农夫还不醒，就走过去，在耳边尖叫。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME lives on farms, squawking loudly to signal that a new day has begun. If a farmer doesn't wake up from this, it will go up to them and scream loudly in their ear.

entry: POKENAME两颗头好斗、领地意识强，第三颗却较友好。中间那颗常劝阻、打断其他头的攻击，让对方有机会逃走。
author: sk372
source: Two of POKENAME's heads are aggressive and territorial, while the third is more amiable. The middle head often tries to dissuade and interrupt the others' attacks so that the target of their ire has a chance to flee.

entry: POKENAME有长喙利爪，追猎凶狠顽强，能追数英里，极少放弃。不过不顾一切地冲向猎物，也常让自己面临受伤危险。
author: quackquackattack
source: With a long beak and sharp claws, POKENAME hunt prey with ferocious grit. They are known to chase their target for miles, rarely ever giving up a chase. These chases often put them at risk of harm as they recklessly dash towards prey.

entry: POKENAME靠出其不意，把其他宝可梦串在喙上。锋利牙齿能撕开猎物，让几颗头更方便大吃。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME rely on the element of surprise to skewer other Pokémon onto their beaks. Their razor-sharp teeth allow them to tear up their prey so that their heads have an easier time chowing down.

entry: 中央的头会与背上有意识的蘑菇合作，一起完全控制另外两颗头，确保完美协调。
author: .izik
source: The center head collaborates with the sentient mushroom growing on its back. Together, they maintain complete control over the other two heads, ensuring perfect coordination.

entry: POKENAME触角能察觉气压和风力的微小变化。它在深夜突然爆发的可怕尖叫，已有详细记载。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME can detect even small changes in air pressure and wind strength due to the antennae it possesses. Its sudden and terrifying uproar of a cry during the dead of night has been well documented.

entry: POKENAME愤怒时，耳朵会喷火，裹住另外两颗头。羽毛耐热，让它们能以强劲、灼热的啄击对付对手。
author: .izik
source: When enraged, POKENAME shoots fire from its ears, enveloping its two secondary heads. Their feathers can withstand the heat, allowing them to deliver powerful, heated pecks to opponents.

entry: 传说POKENAME三颗头都是睿智先知，分别通晓过去、现在与未来，知识无穷。
author: hophoppip
source: Legend has it that the three heads of a POKENAME are wise seers with boundless knowledge of the past, present, and future respectively.

entry: POKENAME三颗头常为小事争吵，守护主体上的巢时却会凶猛合力。走得慢，就用迅速伸出长脖子啄击敌人来弥补。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: While the three heads of POKENAME often get into squabbles over minor things, they will fiercely work together to protect the nest on their main bodies. They make up for their low walking speed by rapidly extending their long necks to peck at foes.

entry: 它从翅膀释放致幻孢子，让受影响者以为自己有三颗头。敌人因此迷糊，容易遭到后续攻击。
author: .izik
source: It releases psychedelic spores from its wings, making those exposed believe they have three heads. This confusion leaves foes dazed and vulnerable to further attacks.

entry: POKENAME会在老树根部抓出足够木屑，点起火。猎物成群从燃烧树木逃出，就会迎上三颗头的连环啄击。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME claw at the base of old trees to create enough wood shavings to start a fire. The crowds of prey that escape the burning tree are subject to a three-headed pecking assault.

entry: 冬天，POKENAME泥土般的羽毛会变得异常蓬松。它用来铺地下巢，在寒冷月份保持温暖。
author: .izik
source: During winter, POKENAME's dirt-like feathers grow unusually fluffy. It lines its underground nest with them to retain warmth through colder months.

entry: 它发现洞里有金银矿石，就会执着地啄石，直到宝物松脱，再把闪亮物件存到巢中，骄傲展示。
author: .izik
source: When it discovers silver or gold ore in caves, it obsessively pecks at the stone until the treasure is loosened. It stores shiny objects to display proudly in its nest.

entry: 中间的头偏头痛，另外两颗却不疼。看心情，它们有时会安慰，有时又想装作没看见。
author: kiwiarms
source: The middle head has a migraine, while the other two do not. Depending on their moods, they will either try to comfort the middle head or try to ignore it.

entry: POKENAME三颗头都能喷强力火焰，却一次只能一颗喷。它虽然体形粗壮，却天生善跑，常被选作宝可全能竞技赛的赛跑王牌。
author: fiordaliso
source: All three of POKENAME's heads can spit powerful flames, though only one can do so at a time. Despite its stout appearance, it is a natural-born runner and is often chosen as a racing champion in the Pokéathlon.

entry: 它会运用勺里储存的精神能量，提升冲刺速度。有了能量加持，连最快的敌人也能灵巧绕过。
author: .izik
source: It uses the psychic energy stored in its spoon to enhance its speed when dashing. This energy boost allows it to outmaneuver even the fastest foes.

entry: 它能凭三个独立大脑，轻松同时读懂三个目标的想法，预测动作，抢先对手一步。
author: .izik
source: By using its three separate brains, it can read three minds at once with ease. This unique ability allows it to predict movements and stay one step ahead of its opponents.

entry: 每只喙都能轻松举起超过800磅。这份力量，让它在战斗和比赛中都很难对付。
author: .izik
source: Each beak has the strength to lift over 800 lbs with little effort. Its power makes it a formidable opponent in battle and competitions.

entry: 它的脚磁性极强，能攀住金属表面，甚至会不知不觉吸来远处小物件。
author: .izik
source: Its feet are extremely magnetic, allowing it to cling to metal surfaces. It can even attract small objects from a distance without noticing.

entry: 它能把五只喙扎进石面，爬上崖壁。攀越艰险地形的本领，灵活得无可匹敌。
author: .izik
source: It can climb up cliff walls by digging its five beaks into the stone surface. This ability makes it an expert at scaling difficult terrain with unmatched agility.

entry: POKENAME既保留嘟嘟的两颗头，又长出嘟嘟利的三颗头。后者格外保护前者，为照顾进化前的亲族，比平时更懂得合作。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME retained the heads of Doduo while growing the three heads of Dodrio. The trio is rather protective of the duo, and works together more harmoniously than usual for the sake of their less-evolved kin.

entry: POKENAME九颗头各有想法，很少和睦，常争吵厮打。不过遇险时，会暂放分歧，变得真正危险。
author: santon5512
source: Each of POKENAME's nine heads have a mind of their own. They rarely get along, often bickering and fighting amongst each other. When in danger, however, they put their differences aside and become a real threat.

entry: POKENAME各颗头很难统一行动，所以常困在原地争吵。不过受威胁时，会一致投票出击，每秒连啄敌人数十下。
author: fireblade141
source: All of POKENAME's heads can rarely decide on a single course of action, so the Pokémon is usually stuck in place bickering. However, if threatened, all heads will unanimously vote to attack and pepper their foe with dozens of pecks per second.

entry: POKENAME会游过冰水，用喙刺小型鱼类宝可梦。一颗头捉到食物，另外两颗就停止捕猎，一起分享。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME swim through icy water to find small fish Pokémon to skewer. Once one head has secured a meal, the other two stop their hunting to share the food.

entry: POKENAME在海中朝鱼类宝可梦射出冰冷光束。冻住猎物的鳍或鳍肢后，就接连啄击，撕开下一餐。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME hunt below the sea by releasing freezing cold beams of ice against fish Pokémon. Once they freeze a fin or flipper from their prey, they unleash an assault of pecks to tear into their meal.

entry: POKENAME极快，炮也极强。可惜三颗头总争谁来瞄准，准头因此受影响。
author: seanothan_23
source: POKENAME is extremely fast, and its cannons are extremely powerful. However, its accuracy suffers because the three heads always fight over who gets to aim the cannons.

entry: POKENAME身体已完美适应冰冷水域，游得迅捷。背上结冰的种子里储着毒孢子，先哄猎物入睡，再将其解决。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME's body has perfectly adapted to let it swim swiftly through the icy waters it inhabits. Within the frozen bulb growing on its back, it stores poisonous spores that it uses to lull its prey to sleep before finishing them off.

entry: POKENAME住在苔原的树上，极耐寒。若找不到叶子，就吃冰和树皮维生。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: POKENAME live in tundra trees and are very resilient to the cold. If it cannot find any leaves, it will sustain itself with ice and bark.

entry: POKENAME有长而弹性十足的腿，游得又快又灵活。它爱玩能充分发挥踢功的游戏。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME swims with high speed and maneuverability thanks to its long, springy legs. It loves to play games where it can use its kicking prowess to its fullest potential.

entry: POKENAME能用强拳击碎冰块。不太会游泳，所以更爱待在海上的冰山，练习打穿冰层，锻炼力量。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME uses its powerful punch to break through ice chunks. Since it is not the greatest swimmer, it prefers to hang out on icebergs, training its strength by trying to break through the ice.

entry: POKENAME会一边滚动一边朝其他宝可梦吠叫，想交朋友，可许多朋友都被排出气体的恶臭吓跑。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME roll around and bark at other Pokémon in an effort to make friends. Many of their friends are scared away by the fetid aroma of the gas they produce.

entry: POKENAME好奇又亲人，会开心地游近潜水者和其他水中来客。格外喜欢谁，就朝谁喷墨，标记为朋友。
author: sk372
source: Curious and affectionate in nature, POKENAME happily swims up to divers and others in the water. It likes to tag those it is particularly fond of by spitting a jet of ink at them to mark them as a friend.

entry: POKENAME召出强力龙卷风前，角会发光。捕食者被卷上天空，它便趁未被留意时溜走。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's horn glows before it summons a powerful Twister, which can fling predators skyward while it slips away unnoticed.

entry: POKENAME会在栖息冰湖的表面凿孔，方便迅速来回跃动。水中跳跃本领强，很受水族场馆欢迎，常被请去表演。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME chisels holes in the surface of the frozen lakes it inhabits, providing it spots to leap to and fro quickly. Its strength in aquatic leaps makes it popular as a performer in aquarium venues.

entry: POKENAME逆流游泳最高可达30节。累了会大口喘气，露出黏舌头。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME swims upstream at speeds of up to 30 knots. When exhausted, it pants heavily, revealing its sticky tongue.

entry: 这种宝可梦既是捕食者，也是猎物。角能轻易制服小型生物，但北方更大更凶的猎手，例如帝牙海狮，却觉得它肥美的肉极其可口。
author: bobosmith01
source: This Pokémon is both predator and prey: while its horn allows it to easily overwhelm smaller lifeforms, larger and fiercer hunters of the north, such as Walrein, find its fatty flesh most delectable.

entry: 这种宝可梦既是捕食者，也是猎物。角能轻易制服小型生物，但帝牙海狮等北方大型猎手，却觉得它肥美的肉格外可口。
author: bobosmith01
source: This Pokémon is both predator and prey. Its horn allows it to easily overwhelm smaller lifeforms, but larger hunters of the north, such as Walrein, find its fatty flesh especially delectable.

entry: POKENAME会在水下游泳时演哑剧，多数观众不容易看清，却仍被公认为最会模仿其他水属性宝可梦的好手。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME pantomimes while swimming underwater. Although this makes it harder for most audiences to see, it is widely regarded as the best impersonator of other Water-type Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME不太聪明，常没头没脑地跟着其他宝可梦，不顾自身安全。游泳却出奇快，能用强鳍推动身体。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are not very smart, often mindlessly following other Pokémon with little regard for their safety. They are surprisingly fast swimmers, using their strong flippers to propel themselves through the water.

entry: POKENAME友好爱玩，喜欢悠闲地伴船游泳，给乘客表演。水手会收养，因为吓人的个头和外貌能赶走麻烦。
author: pjporwoll
source: A playful and friendly Pokémon, POKENAME enjoys lazily swimming alongside ships and performing for the passengers. Sailors adopt it because its intimidating size and appearance scares away trouble.

entry: 夜里，POKENAME在浪下深处唱起幽幽的歌，尾巴随洋流轻轻起伏。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME sings a haunting song deep beneath the waves at night. Its tail gently rises and falls as it drifts through the ocean currents.

entry: POKENAME会用角从海底拔起海藻，每天能吃超过200磅食物。
author: .izik
source: Using its horn, POKENAME uproots seaweed from the ocean floor. It can consume over 200 pounds of food each day.

entry: POKENAME水中空中都游得优雅。个头虽小，角却格外坚硬，物理攻击本领很出色。
author: imaginita
source: POKENAME swims gracefully through both air and water. Despite its small size, its exceedingly hard horn makes it an impressive physical attacker.

entry: POKENAME水中空中都游得优雅。个头虽小，厚皮却能抵御物理攻击，抱起来也特别舒服。
author: imaginita
source: POKENAME swims gracefully through both air and water. Despite its small size, its thick hide makes it resistant to physical attack, and very huggable.

entry: POKENAME受威胁时，会用强尾撑起身体，显得更威武，也可能把自己弹出水面，落到船上并不少见。舌头大得嘴都装不下。
author: roniodove
source: When threatened, POKENAME use their powerful tails to stand upright to seem more imposing, or launch themselves out of the water. It is not uncommon for them to land on boats. POKENAME have tongues too big for their mouths.

entry: POKENAME会成大群捕猎，通常追逐鲤鱼王群。翼上覆着吸水毛，弄湿也不担心结冰。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME hunt in large flocks, usually going after schools of Magikarp. Their wings are covered in absorbent fur, allowing them to get wet without worrying about freezing over.

entry: POKENAME舌头与触角会按规律闪光，彼此交流。每串闪光都向同群传达一条信息。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's tongue and antennae blink in patterns to communicate. Each sequence signals a message to others in its school.

entry: POKENAME疾游过冰海时，会放电破冰。速度越快，能量恢复也越快。
author: .izik
source: While dashing through frozen seas, POKENAME fires electricity to break ice. The faster it moves, the quicker its power returns.

entry: POKENAME会在满月夜出来，滑过冰冷水面。黎明前，拍打脂肪厚厚的肚子，表示满意这每月一次的仪式。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME come out on nights of the full moon to skate across the icy water. Moments before dawn breaks, they slap their blubbery stomachs to signal their satisfaction with the monthly ritual.

entry: POKENAME心地纯洁，爱与其他宝可梦相处。腹部蛋壳能帮它在光滑表面迅速滑行。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are pure-hearted creatures that love spending time with other Pokémon. The eggshell covering their stomach allows them to quickly slide across smooth surfaces.

entry: POKENAME极爱玩，有时会在海滩陪小朋友嬉戏。鳞片有净水的神奇力量，不过过程得花不少时间。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is incredibly playful and will sometimes play with young children at the beach. Its scales have the strange power to purify water. However, this process does take quite a bit of time.

entry: POKENAME在海边崖上筑巢，从高处俯冲抓小鱼。即使在海上失去知觉，球状身体也能轻松浮在水面。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME make their nests on beachside cliffs, diving from the cliffs to catch small fish. If they end up getting knocked out while over the ocean, their spherical bodies allow them to effortlessly float on the water's surface.

entry: POKENAME飞在海上高空，寻找猎物。俯冲快得看不清，连水面下的鲤鱼王也能抓住。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME flies high above the sea, scanning for prey. It dives with blinding speed, catching Magikarp even if they're beneath the surface.

entry: 它用利牙啃冻住的漂木，也会在湖冰里凿隧道，躲避捕食者。冬天，低闷的吱叫在水下回荡，像远方钟鸣。
author: jaminmcready
source: It gnaws away at frozen driftwood with sharp teeth, carving tunnels in lake ice to escape predators. During winter, its muffled squeaks echo beneath the surface like distant chimes.

entry: POKENAME一生大多住在冰冷浅水中，光滑皮肤让它轻松游动。皮下储着黏液层，即使零下也能保暖，防止冻伤。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME spends most of its life in icy shallows, using its smooth, slippery skin to glide through water with ease. It stores a layer of mucus beneath its hide, keeping it warm and preventing frostbite even in subzero temperatures.

entry: POKENAME聪明却爱玩，更喜欢游戏而非答问题，所以往往故意简化回答。玩球时尤其开心。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are playful yet intelligent creatures. They prefer to dumb down their responses to inquiry because they love to play games more than they enjoy answering questions. They are particularly happy with a ball to play with.

entry: 这种形态的POKENAME，模样几乎与帕底亚宝可梦一对鼠一模一样。不过行为仍有区别，例如更喜欢在冷水游泳。
author: hophoppip
source: This form of POKENAME looks nearly identical to the Paldean Pokémon known as Tandemaus. POKENAME retains some differences in behavior, however, such as its preference for swimming in cold water.

entry: POKENAME住在冷水环境，背上特殊的生长物会让表面结冰。这些冰能增加浮力，帮它游泳时保持接近水面。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME live in cold water environments and have a specialised growth on their back that causes ice to crystalise on it. They use this growth as a buoyancy aid, the ice helping to keep them near the water's surface when they swim.

entry: POKENAME模样虽怪，却是挺好的宠物。它爱游泳和洗澡，尤其喜欢冷水。
author: mistymagius
source: Despite its weird appearance, POKENAME makes for a pretty good pet. They adore swimming and having baths, especially in cold water.

entry: POKENAME住在海崖，会从高处扑下抓鱼。刺针含微毒，可引起麻木和高烧。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME lives on ocean cliffs, swooping down from the cliff face to catch fish from above. Its stinger contains a mild poison that can cause numbness and a high fever.

entry: POKENAME爱鱼，却抓不到多少，所以常纠缠渔民，想弄到对方的渔获。也能见到它们跟随大型海中猎手，吃剩下的食物。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME loves fish, but since it struggles to catch many, it will often harass fishermen in hopes of snagging their catches. Flocks of POKENAME can be seen following larger sea predators so they can feast on their leftover meals.

entry: POKENAME总急着与新朋友玩，跳上岸想靠近。可惜每跳一下，身上就会射出尖刺，害陌生来客不太愿意亲近。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is always eager to play with new friends it sees, hopping onto land to get closer. Unfortunately, every hop causes it to shoot out pointed quills from its body, making strangers less inclined to let it come near.

entry: POKENAME结成没有父母相伴的小群。成年后，父母就会离开，去冰山顶休息。年轻个体很容易累，喜欢打盹。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME live in small packs without their parents, who leave to rest atop icebergs once they reach the age of maturity. The youthful POKENAME become tired easily and enjoy taking naps.

entry: POKENAME天真易信，总怀着信任与敬意接近训练家或其他宝可梦。它很容易受骗，训练家得教它对陌生来客谨慎。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are gullible Pokémon that always approach Trainers or other Pokémon with trust and respect. They are vulnerable to deception, so their Trainers need to teach them how to be cautious around strangers.

entry: POKENAME游泳本领远超外表，能远游寻找新食源。人工饲养的许多个体，因为没有野外那么多运动，常会超重。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are deceptively proficient swimmers and can swim long distances to find new sources of food. Many who are kept in captivity become overweight because they lack the exercise they would get in the wild.

entry: POKENAME体态威武，偏爱在严寒环境筑巢。头上硬刺能帮忙破冰，方便捕鱼。
author: princessmilandria
source: POKENAME is a majestic Pokémon that prefers nesting in frigid temperatures. The hard spikes on its head aid in breaking through the ice so it can fish.

entry: POKENAME有独特防身法，会冻住口里的水，射出锋利冰柱，力道足以贯穿钢铁。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME has a unique method of defending itself. By freezing the water inside of its mouth, it fires sharp icicles with such force it is able to pierce through steel.

entry: POKENAME会装成小海狮，引利牙鱼靠近，用章鱼桶炮伏击，再用触手拖上岸。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME mimics a Seel to lure Carvanha close. It ambushes prey with Octazooka, then hauls them ashore with its tentacles.

entry: POKENAME爱抓鱼，常在尾里大量储存，分给训练家。幸好尾部有腺体，能让鱼保持冰凉。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME loves to catch fish, often storing large amounts in its tail. It tends to give out these fish to its Trainer; luckily, it has a gland in its tail that keeps the fish nice and cold.

entry: POKENAME会飞在海上，寻找水生宝可梦群，俯冲入海咬住猎物，再飞回空中。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME soar above the sea searching for schools of aquatic Pokémon. They dive into the sea to bite onto their prey before returning to the sky.

entry: POKENAME是一种脂肪丰厚、肉食性的哺乳动物，能水陆两栖生活，冷季最活跃。野外性情难测，对自己的训练家通常却很亲昵。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is a fatty, carnivorous, and amphibious mammal that is most active during the cold season. While unpredictable in the wild, they are generally very affectionate with their own Pokémon Trainer.

entry: POKENAME会在海面高速滚动，喜欢把自己当炮弹，跃过大浪取乐。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME rolls across the ocean's surface at high speed. It loves launching itself over large waves like a playful cannonball.

entry: POKENAME把角击和尾击融入流畅武术。使出冰冻之风前，会先做一个完整后空翻。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME blends horn and tail strikes into flowing martial arts. Before unleashing Icy Wind, it performs a full backflip.

entry: 它会用角吸收游离闪电，让毛皮充电，足以击晕袭击者。水中靠尾巴转向，即使风暴里也能疾游。
author: fiordaliso
source: By absorbing stray lightning with its horn, its fur becomes charged enough to stun attackers. In water, it steers with its tail to swim swiftly, even in storms.

entry: POKENAME陆上笨拙，游泳却很强，会不停模仿其他水属性宝可梦各自独特的水下动作。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME is clumsy on land but is also a strong swimmer. It will constantly try to mimic other Water-type Pokémon, imitating the unique way that each of them moves underwater.

entry: POKENAME会在白毛上覆一层薄电，麻痹未经同意触摸它的来者。一生大多待在水下，只在需要吃找到的食物时上岸。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME coats its white fur with a thin layer of electricity to paralyze anyone who tries to touch it without its consent. It spends most of its life underwater and only comes ashore when it needs to eat the food it has found.

entry: 人多的海滩常有POKENAME，想吞掉所有剩饭。最好别分它食物，否则手边一切能吃的，它都会试着吞下。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME can often be seen on populated beaches, trying to gobble up any leftover food scraps. It is best not to offer any of your food to it as it will then attempt to devour every edible item you have on hand.

entry: 两对鳍漂在POKENAME身旁，主要用来拍走靠得太近的麻烦。格外开心时，鳍还会相互拍掌。
author: sk372
source: Two pairs of flippers float alongside POKENAME, used primarily to swat away nuisances that get too close. The flippers will clap against each other when POKENAME is feeling particularly happy.

entry: 这种宝可梦喜欢冰寒地方，会熔化周围冰雪。攻击时，会从喙里射出接近沸腾的水球。
author: lydiaprower8
source: This Pokémon likes to live in cold, frigid places, melting the snow and ice around it. It attacks by firing near-boiling orbs of water out of its beak.

entry: POKENAME会兴奋地跑向经过冰雪地区的训练家，分享食物、一起玩雪。若对方回赠食物，就能得到一个拥抱，当天余下时间都能保持温暖。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME excitedly run up to Trainers traveling through icy regions to share their food and play in the snow together. If a Trainer offers food to a POKENAME in return, they will receive a hug that keeps them warm for the rest of the day.

entry: 暴风雪中，POKENAME会在寒冷的开阔海域现身，引领迷途水手回家。它天使般的声音会把水手带到最近港口，每年挽救许多生命。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME appear in frigid open waters during snowstorms to guide lost sailors home. Their angelic voices lead sailors to the nearest port, saving many lives each year.

entry: POKENAME睡觉时会贴平海底，融入沙色。一不动，就几乎看不见。
author: .izik
source: To sleep, POKENAME flattens against the sea floor and blends in with the sand. When still, it becomes nearly invisible.

entry: POKENAME毛皮保温，能抵御家园冰水。它会啃下冰川上的冰块，在水里筑起自己的冰坝。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's fur insulates itself well against the ice-cold waters of its home. It gnaws off chunks of glacial ice and uses them to create icy dams in the water to call its own.

entry: POKENAME十分友好，爱舔喜欢的来者玩。胡须会冷却周围空气，让身体上凝出小冰晶。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is very friendly, playfully licking anyone it likes. Its whiskers cool the air around it, causing small ice crystals to form on its body.

entry: POKENAME想与小海狮群交朋友，分享食物。不过游得不如对方，狩猎时很难跟上。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME attempts to pal around with Seel herds in hopes of sharing their meals. However, POKENAME cannot swim as well as the latter, so it struggles to keep up during their hunts.

entry: POKENAME会一家家聚在双子岛海滩，挨着躺在冷沙上晒太阳。它们游泳很好，必要时能迅速逃离危险，受威胁时通常却会坚守。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME sun themselves in family groups along the beaches of the Seafoam Islands, lazing beside one another on the frigid sands. They are capable swimmers and can quickly escape danger if needed, but will normally stand their ground when threatened.

entry: POKENAME厚毛能让它在冰水里生存。严冬时，会用尖角刺鱼，带回给孩子。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's thick fur allows it to survive in freezing cold waters. It spears fish with its sharp horn and brings them back to its children during harsh winters.

entry: 世界各地常有POKENAME被冲上岸，让公众以为搁浅，陷入恐慌。海洋专家常得提醒，别打扰正在恢复体力的它们。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME often wash onto shorelines throughout the world, causing the public to panic over their beached state. Marine experts often have to remind the public not to disturb POKENAME as they regain their stamina.

entry: POKENAME耳朵敏感，隔着实心冰层也能听见猎物。它会坐在浮冰上，察觉鱼游近，再潜入水中，用头上的角注毒。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's ears are sensitive enough to hear the movements of prey even through solid ice. It sits atop ice floes until it senses fish come close, before diving into the water to poison its target with the horn on its head.

entry: 极软的羽毛，让POKENAME在极地水中也很暖。小角摸着冰冷，可用来驱退天敌。
author: mistymagius
source: Its incredibly soft feathers keep POKENAME warm while swimming in arctic waters. Its small horn is cold to the touch, which it uses to deter predators.

entry: POKENAME金属角能刺穿坚实岩石，常与同类切磋，也会越磨越利。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's metallic horn can pierce solid stone. It grows sharper through constant sparring with others of its kind.

entry: POKENAME游久了，会在沙滩长睡，恢复能量。深色毛皮不断捕捉能量粒子，必要时便能放出壮观的电属性攻击。
author: fiordaliso
source: To recover its energy after swimming for a long time, POKENAME takes long naps on the beach. Its dark fur constantly traps particles of energy, allowing it to unleash majestic Electric-type attacks when needed.

entry: 看见船只经过，POKENAME会用幻象变成人鱼。好奇水手上岸查看，就会被撕咬、吃掉。
author: hophoppip
source: When it sees a ship sailing by, POKENAME uses illusions to take the guise of a merperson. Curious sailors who come ashore to investigate are mauled and consumed.

entry: 它偏爱寒地。训练家可摸鼻子检查健康：若不冰凉，就该立刻送往宝可梦中心。
author: melodydelune
source: It prefers colder climates. Trainers should check its health to see if its nose is cold; if not, it should be brought to a Pokémon Center immediately.

entry: POKENAME最爱沙滩球，常和游客一起随浪上岸。它会用冰冻之风和自己的内脏，把球送上天空玩。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME adores beach balls and often washes ashore with tourists. It uses Icy Wind and its own innards to launch balls skyward in play.

entry: POKENAME獠牙掉了，就安到身上环带，增添防护。游泳常吃力，得不停把鳍换边，才游得直。
author: mistymagius
source: When one of POKENAME's tusks falls out, it will attach it to the rings on its body as an extra line of defense. It often struggles to swim, having to constantly switch which side its flipper is on to stay straight.

entry: POKENAME伪装服上温暖厚实的毛，能在冰寒环境中保温，也让它在北极水域游泳，不让水渗透进去。
author: t3isukone
source: The warm, thick fur of POKENAME's costume keeps it warm in the icy conditions it lives in and allows it to swim in arctic waters without any water permeating it.

entry: POKENAME在寒水捕猎时，头身周围逐渐结冰，挡住视线，每次都像和时间赛跑。曾见饿极了的个体，仍继续狩猎，直到全身冻住。
author: santon5512
source: Water freezes around POKENAME's head and body as they hunt in frigid waters, slowly obscuring their vision and making each hunt a race against the clock. POKENAME that are desperate for food have been known to continue hunting until frozen solid.

entry: POKENAME很爱玩，常背着幼年海豹球。主要住在北极水域，偶尔也会弹跳上沿海沙滩。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are very playful and can often be seen carrying young Spheals on their backs. They mostly live in arctic waters but can sometimes be spotted bouncing up onto coastal beaches.

entry: POKENAME在大冰山上结小群，吃冰里冻着的矿物。幸好身体浮力足，掉水后也能漂回陆地。
author: mistymagius
source: Small colonies of POKENAME can be found on large icebergs, feeding on the minerals frozen in the ice. Luckily their bodies are buoyant enough that if they fall into the water, they can float back to dry land.

entry: POKENAME潜在海边浅水，只让眼睛露在沙上。猎物游近，就以强颚向上猛扑，试着拖进洞穴。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME lurks in the shallows of the ocean, keeping just its eyes above the sand. When prey swims close enough, they launch upward with their powerful jaws and attempt to drag it into their burrows.

entry: POKENAME藏在浅水礁区，等长翅鸥等猎物靠近。双颚一口就能咬碎石头。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME lies hidden in shallow reefs, waiting for Wingull and other prey to approach. Its jaws can crush stone with a single bite.

entry: POKENAME总忘记要去哪儿，于是就在水里绕圈。鳞片如毛绒般柔软，让它很受收藏家追捧。
author: tonarinokaibutsu
source: POKENAME swims around in circles due to it constantly forgetting where it is going. They have plush scales that make them highly prized among collectors.

entry: POKENAME会一头撞向结实浮冰，锻炼角和头骨。极圈一带崩落的冰川块，常被认为是它锻炼造成的。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME charges headlong into sturdy ice floes to harden its horn and skull. Glacial chunks falling off in polar circles are often attributed to POKENAME honing its strength.

entry: POKENAME尾巴看似滚烫火焰，摸起来却极冷。长时间接触，会造成严重冻伤。
author: evilgammon
source: While POKENAME's tail looks like scorching fire, it's actually extremely cold to the touch. Prolonged contact causes a severe case of frostbite.

entry: POKENAME游泳熟练，会在冰下抓小鱼。胃口大，常去抢冰钓者的渔获，反而自己被捉了。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are well-versed swimmers, hunting for small fish beneath the ice. Due to their large appetites, these Pokémon often snag the catches of ice fishermen, only to end up caught themselves.

entry: POKENAME飞过冰海上空时，会从角里发出强力声呐信号。声响足以扰乱捕食者的方向感。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME emits powerful sonar from its horn while flying above icy seas. The sound is loud enough to disorient predators.

entry: POKENAME喜欢冷地方，尤其是冰湖和冰川。它虽爱玩，獠牙却锋利如刀，靠近仍得小心。
author: bottomusmaximus3
source: This Pokémon likes to hang around cold places, particularly frozen lakes or glaciers. Though playful, caution must be taken near POKENAME as its tusks are razor-sharp.

entry: POKENAME游泳时，姿态优雅得像在水下飞。生气后，翅膀能煮沸周围海水。
author: .izik
source: While swimming, POKENAME appears to fly underwater with grace. When angry, its wings boil the water around it.

entry: POKENAME肥厚沉重的身体需要大量养分，几乎遇见什么宝可梦都莽撞捕猎。被它咬到，可能严重冻伤。
author: bobosmith01
source: Its fatty and hefty body requires tons of nutrients, so it recklessly hunts almost any Pokémon it comes across. Being bitten by a POKENAME can cause severe frostbite.

entry: POKENAME陆地笨拙，水里却快如火箭，因此只为休息，或吃食谱必需的冰雪，才浮上来。
author: _._starry_._
source: POKENAME is clumsy on land, but as fast as a rocket in the water. Because of this, it only surfaces to rest and to eat the snow and ice its diet requires.

entry: POKENAME舌上的唾液，一接触就能冻住东西。它会舔洞壁，维持低温。
author: .izik
source: The saliva on POKENAME's tongue instantly freezes what it touches. It licks its cave walls to maintain the frigid temperature.

entry: POKENAME用冰冻光束冻住入侵者，摆在洞里当冰冻战利品，还很自豪地向其他来客展示。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME freezes intruders with Ice Beam and displays them as icy trophies in its cave. It takes pride in showing them to others.

entry: POKENAME常在冰川苔原融入周围植物。较暖季节，头叶会融化，水分重新吸回身体，长出新叶。奇怪的是，舌头却能抗冻。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME are often found in glacial tundras blending in with the other foliage. During warmer seasons, the leaves on POKENAME's head melt and the water is reabsorbed into the body to produce new leaves. Oddly, their tongue is resistant to freezing.

entry: POKENAME每天在岸边花数小时练舞。虽然很努力，旁人仍常觉得舞姿“傻气”或“滑稽”。
author: roundabout_robin
source: POKENAME spends hours on the shoreline practicing its dancing. Despite all the effort, others often perceive its dances as "silly" or "goofy".

entry: POKENAME模样虽然吓人，其实很爱玩。它会顽皮地啃路过船只，盼水手停下来陪玩。
author: mistymagius
source: Despite its intimidating appearance, POKENAME is actually playful. It can be seen playfully gnawing on passing ships, hoping the sailors will stop and play with it.

entry: POKENAME常在冰川苔原融入周围植物。较暖季节，头叶会融化，水分重新吸回身体，长出新叶。奇怪的是，舌头却能抗冻。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME are often found in glacial tundras blending in with the other foliage. During warmer seasons, the leaves on POKENAME's head melt and the water is reabsorbed into the body to produce new leaves. Oddly, their tongue is resistant to freezing.

entry: POKENAME圆滚滚的身体有80%都是脂肪，靠这层厚脂在零下保暖。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME stores lots of blubber in its body, which makes up eighty percent of its rotund body. It relies on this mass of blubber to keep warm in sub-zero temperatures.

entry: POKENAME能让鳍下保持温暖。北极探险者有时惊见雪堆抬起，原来是友善个体的鳍。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME regulates a warm temperature under its flippers. Arctic explorers have been surprised when a snow pile has risen, revealed to be the flippers of a friendly POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME飞在冷海上，寻找自己找得到的最大鱼。发现后，就潜水打得对方屈服，再准备享用。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME soars above cold oceans, searching for the largest fish it can find. When it locates one, it dives into the water, beating the fish into submission before preparing it to eat.

entry: 冬天，POKENAME会迁向大海找食物。刺其实由冰构成，藏在厚毛下面。
author: mistymagius
source: During the winter, POKENAME migrates towards the sea so it can find food. Its thorns are actually made out of ice hidden underneath its thick fur.

entry: POKENAME由雪而非沙构成，出现在寒冷雪天。它爱玩头顶的铲子。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME is made of snow rather than sand, and it is found on cold, snowy days. It likes playing with the shovel on top of its head.

entry: POKENAME白天会埋进雪层下面，那里暖得多。日落后，再用温暖舌头舔开积雪，回到地面。
author: wiz0z
source: During the day, POKENAME bury themselves beneath layers of snow where it is much warmer. They use their warm tongues to lick their way back to the surface after sunset.

entry: POKENAME住在北极深水，厚厚的脂肪能抗高压和酷寒。很少浮上来，因此没人知道野外还剩多少。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME live in deep arctic waters as their thick layer of blubber protects them from high pressures and frigid temperatures. They are rarely seen at the surface, so no one knows how many remain in the wild.

entry: POKENAME奔跑游泳一样出色，通常在海滩附近的陆地或海里结群。
author: justjackorwhatever
source: POKENAME is as excellent at running as it is at swimming. It typically can be found in packs, either on land or in the sea around beaches.

entry: POKENAME会把精神能量导过头上的鳍。只一个念头，就能把挡路冰山整个移开。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME channels psychic energy through the fins on its head. With one thought, it can shift entire icebergs from its path.

entry: POKENAME蘑菇上的斑纹，是灵敏的光感受器，能帮它在深水辨路。训练家常买蓝色光谱的植物生长灯，让它在陆地更舒服。
author: wiz0z
source: The marks on POKENAME's mushroom are powerful photoreceptors that allow them to navigate in deep waters. Trainers of POKENAME often purchase blue spectrum grow lights to help them feel comfortable on land.

entry: POKENAME用头顶睡莲叶收水，稳稳托着，一滴不洒，还爱分给其他宝可梦喝。不知为何，水总清凉爽口。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME uses the lily pad on its head to collect water, which it expertly balances without spilling a drop. It likes to offer the water as a drink to other Pokémon. The water is somehow always refreshingly cool.

entry: POKENAME厚厚的保温脂肪，让它在最冷的北极水域也不怕。食物匮乏、储脂不足的月份，还能在海滩生火，围着取暖。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have a thick layer of insulating fat that keeps them warm even in the coldest arctic waters. During lean months where their fat reserves run thin they can supplement their body heat by creating fires to huddle around on the beach.

entry: 有人相信，被POKENAME舌头舔一下，就能萌生爱意。旅人常到海滩找它，盼一场命定邂逅。
author: .izik
source: Some believe a single lick from POKENAME's tongue can inspire love. Travelers often seek it on beaches, hoping for a fateful encounter.

entry: POKENAME会结小群在浅滩附近挖洞，白天浮出来，晒上数小时太阳，似乎很享受暖意，再回地下。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME digs near shoals in small groups and surfaces during the day. It spends hours basking in sunlight, seemingly enjoying the warmth before returning underground.

entry: POKENAME不爱走路，会趴着肚子滑行。羽毛覆油，让它能随心滑来滑去。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's doesn't like walking, so it will instead slide on its belly to get around. Its feathers are coated in oil, which allows for it to slide wherever it pleases.

entry: POKENAME一边在冰水疾游，一边从宝石发出极光束，精准击退巨牙鲨等捕食者。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME races through icy waters while using Aurora Beam from its gem. It fends off predators like Sharpedo with precise blasts.

entry: POKENAME是港镇的顽皮麻烦，常在码头讨食、求关注，还挡路。可若不理它，就会大发脾气、试图搞破坏，直到得到想要的才停。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is a mischievous nuisance in port cities because it hangs out near docks and gets in the way while begging for food and attention. If it is ignored, it flies into a tantrum where it seeks to cause destruction until its demands are met.

entry: POKENAME极其好斗，谁一进领地，它就会猛烈地乱扑腾。脚虽适应了冰面，却不擅长在坚实地面行走。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is incredibly aggressive, thrashing around violently if anyone enters its territory. However, since its feet have adapted to walking on ice, it struggles to walk on solid ground.

entry: POKENAME柔软白毛极保暖，即使接近绝对零度，也感觉不到冷。它游泳出色，很少让猎物逃掉。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its soft white fur is so warm that it doesn't feel the cold even at temperatures near absolute zero. POKENAME is an excellent swimmer that rarely lets prey escape.

entry: 温度一低于冰点，POKENAME就聚成群，依偎保持体热，也共同抵御捕食者。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME coalesce into groups whenever temperatures fall below freezing. They huddle together to preserve body heat while also defending against predators.

entry: POKENAME模仿小海狮的头部，避免被小海狮及其进化形态捕食。舌头般的器官其实是外露的胃，能让它轻松高效地摄食浮游生物。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME mimics the head of a Seel to keep that evolutionary line from predating it. The tongue-like organ is actually an exposed stomach which it uses to easily and efficiently feed on plankton.

entry: POKENAME的大眼睛让它即使在最黑暗的北极水域也能捕猎。它会用角在冰山上凿洞睡觉，再用善于伪装的伞状身体堵住入口。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME's large eyes allow it to hunt even in the darkest arctic waters. It uses its horn to carve a hole in an iceberg so it can sleep, blocking the entrance with its camouflaged bell.

entry: 它体形虽怪，却是游泳高手。它会用角和强壮的双臂，在覆盖寒冷海面的冰层上打出洞口。
author: cait_sith
source: Despite its oddly-shaped body, it is an excellent swimmer. It uses its horn and strong arms to break holes in the ice covering the frigid sea.

entry: POKENAME在海底滚动，大吃海草。身体岩石有许多孔洞，能在更咸的水里提供些浮力。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME rolls on the seafloor, feeding on large amounts of seagrass. The rock that makes up its body is quite porous, allowing it to somewhat float in saltier waters.

entry: POKENAME在海底附近漂游，用磁性手臂抓取细小的金属颗粒吃。它在世界上大多数地方都很罕见，两极附近却比较多。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME floats around the seafloor, using its magnetic arms to grab small metallic particles to eat. While rare in most areas of the world, its numbers are greater surrounding the poles.

entry: POKENAME战斗时会让两颗带角的头合攻，压倒敌人。若实力不及，就以惊人速度逃跑。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses both horned heads in combat to overwhelm foes. If outmatched, it flees with impressive speed.

entry: 这只小海狮凭灰色斑点与额头宝石便很容易辨认，已熟练掌握冰属性招式。
author: mr.person__prinplup_enjoyer
source: This Seel can easily be spotted via its grey spots and the gem on its forehead. It has mastered Ice-type moves.

entry: POKENAME住在极寒地区，靠厚厚的毛皮与脂肪层抵御寒冷。它大部分时间都懒洋洋地躺在冰盖上，只有狩猎才下水。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME lives in extremely cold areas, its thick layer of fur and blubber helping to protect it from the cold. It spends most of its time lazing around on the ice sheet and only goes in the water to hunt.

entry: POKENAME藏在北方海域冰冷的黑暗中。它们睡上20小时来保持低体温，再用余下4小时，以华美的利牙撕食死鱼。
author: leandermalurt
source: POKENAME hide in the frigid darkness of the northern seas. They sleep for twenty hours to keep their body temperature low, then spend the last four hours tearing apart dead fish with their magnificent teeth.

entry: POKENAME会从闭壳里伸舌感知周围。它天性害羞，只有确认周围几乎无威胁，才肯开壳探索。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME sticks its tongue out from within its closed shell to sense its surroundings. Shy by nature, it only opens its shell and explores an area if the coast is almost completely clear.

entry: POKENAME游泳时像钻头一样在水中旋转，轻松就能超过多数商船。
author: .izik
source: While swimming, POKENAME spins through the water like a drill. It can outpace most commercial ships with ease.

entry: POKENAME在沙滩钻洞，用冰冻之风守家。通常只这一击，就足以吓退想追赶的捕食者。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME burrows into sandy beaches and defends its home with Icy Wind. The blast is usually enough on its own to dissuade predators from attempting to pursue it.

entry: POKENAME战斗中会像挥链枷一样甩动巨钳。若落空，就接上水流喷射，让敌人继续难以站稳。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME swings its massive claw like a flail in battle. If it misses, it follows up with Aqua Jet to keep foes unsteady.

entry: POKENAME虽然主要生活在水中，却喜欢长时间晒太阳，把补充的能量存进背上的种子。战斗时，它会将水属性和毒属性招式配合起来，打出强力攻势。
author: fiordaliso
source: Although POKENAME is primarily an aquatic creature, it enjoys spending much of its time under the sun, recharging energy that it stores within the bulb on its back. It fights using powerful combinations of Water and Poison-type moves.

entry: 特别猛烈的暴风雪来临时，POKENAME会用丝裹住身体，抵御冰雪。它的身体保温能力极好，因此在冰水中也能轻松游泳。
author: fiordaliso
source: During particularly severe snowstorms, it wraps its body in silk to protect itself from snow and ice. POKENAME's body retains heat very well, which is why it can swim effortlessly even in freezing waters.

entry: POKENAME会在寒冷的家园紧紧挤成一团保暖。这些圆滚滚的宝可梦极其友好，欢迎所有种类的宝可梦一起抱团。
author: moopse
source: POKENAME tend to huddle together in tight bunches to keep warm in their frigid environment. These round Pokémon are extremely friendly, and will welcome all species into their group cuddle.

entry: POKENAME的双腿强劲，在水下游得又快又灵活。它会不停地踢巨大的冰块，直到冰块碎裂，以此锻炼双腿。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's strong legs give it a lot of underwater mobility, swimming with speedy, agile movements. It trains them by kicking huge chunks of ice until they shatter.

entry: POKENAME把多余养分存进尾巴，但养分太多就会使尾巴胀大、难以驾驭，影响它的速度和平衡。因此，它很注意饮食。
author: bobosmith01
source: Excess nutrients are stored in POKENAME's tail. However, too much will cause the tail to expand, becoming unwieldy and throwing off POKENAME's speed and sense of balance. Therefore, POKENAME is very careful about its diet.

entry: POKENAME会在冰水中挪动翻滚，寻找朋友。许多宝可梦受不了它的臭味，因此交到的朋友里有许多都是毒属性宝可梦。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME shuffle and roll around searching for friends in icy waters. Many Pokémon are unable to endure the foul stench they produce, so many of their friends end up being Poison-type Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME会尽量藏在雪里，避免被捕食者发现。优雅的蹼状尾巴让它能连续游上许多小时。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME stays hidden in the snow as much as possible to avoid being spotted by predators. It can swim for many hours thanks to its elegant webbed tail.

entry: POKENAME会产出冰冷的雪状物，闻起来像烂鱼。多亏它的好意，许多毒属性宝可梦才第一次体验到雪。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME produce a cold, snowy substance that smells like rotten fish. Many Poison-type Pokémon get to experience snow for the first time thanks to the kindness of POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME会放出由腐臭分泌液形成的霜雾。炎夏，毒属性宝可梦会成群来找它降温。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME produce puffs of frost made of a putrid liquid that they produce. Poison-type Pokémon flock to find POKENAME to cool down on a hot summer day.

entry: POKENAME是海岸警卫队喜爱的伙伴，会帮助营救在海上迷失的宝可梦。只要把乘客安置进育儿袋，它就不肯放出来，直到确认对方暖和又健康。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Popular companions of coast guards, POKENAME help rescue Pokémon lost at sea. Once a POKENAME has secured a passenger within its pouch, it will refuse to let them out until it's sure that they're warm and healthy.

entry: POKENAME擅长杂耍与杂技，优雅的跳水和池边表演令观众赞叹。孩子们的笑声让它充满活力，因此它会想尽办法逗大家开心。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is an outstanding juggler and acrobat, dazzling audiences with its graceful dives and poolside performances. The laughter of children fills it with energy, so it does everything it can to make them happy.

entry: POKENAME厚厚的毛皮能抵御寒冷。在北极气候地区，人们会让它们组队拉货车和其他载具。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's thick coat allows it to shrug off the cold. Teams of POKENAME are used to pull wagons and other vehicles in arctic climates.

entry: POKENAME喜欢在下午游泳放松，利用头上的角避开障碍。尾尖还有一根利刺，里面满是毒液。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME relaxes by swimming in the afternoon, using the horn on its head to dodge any obstacles. At the tip of its tail is a sharp stinger filled with venomous toxins.

entry: POKENAME虽能两栖生活，特殊的肢体结构却使它更适合水中生活。它会射出硬针般的体毛，随心情选择冻结或电击来犯者。
author: sk372
source: Although amphibious, POKENAME's unique limb structure makes it more suited for water than land. Hard needles of fur launched from its body are used to either freeze or electrocute aggressors, depending on its whims.

entry: POKENAME的大嘴能轻松咬穿冰川。双翼和尾巴让它在空中滑翔也像在冰水里游泳一样容易。
author: thegreenscorpion
source: POKENAME's large maw allows it to effortlessly bite through glaciers. Its wings and tail allow it to glide through the air as easily as it swims through chilling waters.

entry: POKENAME一生大部分时间都睡在极地冰盖上。厚厚的脂肪层能抵挡寒风、落雪，甚至捕食者的袭击，因此它睡得极沉。
author: anonymous_moose
source: POKENAME spends most of its life asleep atop polar ice sheets. It sleeps incredibly soundly due to its thick layer of blubber insulating it from freezing winds, snowfall, and even predation.

entry: POKENAME扇动翅膀，冷却正在融化的冰帽，保护极地生态。流线形的雪白尾巴让它在水下游得极快。
author: fiordaliso
source: With the beat of its wings, POKENAME cools melting ice caps, protecting the polar ecosystem. Underwater, it moves with incredible speed thanks to its sleek, snow-white tail.

entry: POKENAME性情平和，却会用头上的尖角奋力保护自己和后代。它能改变天气，偶尔也会驱散暴风雪，帮助迷路的探险者。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME are peaceful, but will fiercely defend themselves or their offspring with the sharp horn on their heads. With their ability to alter the weather, they occasionally help aid lost explorers by dissipating snowstorms.

entry: POKENAME住在酷寒的北极，远远守望着其他居民。若有什么打乱栖息地的自然秩序，它就会造出冻结的精神能量球，排除干扰。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME resides in frigid arctic areas, watching over the other denizens from a distance. If something intrudes upon the natural order of its habitat, it creates orbs of frozen psychic energy to take the problem out.

entry: 游泳中的POKENAME几乎不可能追上。它用精神力场让身体更接近流线形，轻松破水前行，灵巧的尾巴也让它能迅速转向。
author: imaginita
source: It is nearly impossible to catch up to a swimming POKENAME. As a good swimmer, it uses psychic fields to streamline its body and cut through the water, and its lithe tail allows it to turn on a dime.

entry: POKENAME的火焰项圈十分炽热，即使在北极海域游泳嬉戏也不会熄灭。烧穿冰封的海面后，它就蜷身打盹，盼有人分些渔获给它。
author: pjporwoll
source: The fiery collar is hot enough to remain lit when POKENAME swims and frolics in arctic oceans. Once it burns a hole through frozen sea water, it curls up for a nap in hopes that someone will share their fishing catches with it.

entry: POKENAME的双翼和尾巴十分适合飞行与游泳，让它在空中和水下都能发挥最佳本领。它会借纯白的身体融入积雪，蹲伏着等待捕猎良机。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME's wings and tail are perfectly adapted to ensure maximum performance both in the air and underwater. Its pure white body allows it to blend into the snow, where it crouches, waiting for the right moment to catch its prey.

entry: 它避开温热食物，因为快速振翅会让身体大幅升温。野外会先用冰冻光束冻住猎物，再吸血。
author: bandedbodypress
source: It avoids warm food, as the rapid beating of its wings warms its body up greatly. In the wild, it uses Ice Beam on its prey before it sucks their blood.

entry: 流星众多的夜里，常能见到POKENAME在漂浮的海冰上及其周围绕圈跳舞。
author: corra_universe
source: On nights with many shooting stars, POKENAME can be seen dancing in circles on and around floating sea ice.

entry: POKENAME爱在结冰的湖泊和池塘上跳舞。花瓣映着冰面反射的光，闪闪发亮。
author: barfy_here
source: POKENAME love dancing over frozen lakes and ponds. Their flower petals reflect the light bouncing off the ice, making their petals shine brightly.

entry: 想让POKENAME乐一会儿，最快就是给几片鲤鱼王肉，再揉揉肚皮。长期给食物和关爱的人，可能收到它带来的珍珠。
author: quackquackattack
source: The fastest way to give POKENAME a moment of felicity is with a few cuts of Magikarp and a belly rub. They may bring pearls to people who consistently give them food and affection.

entry: POKENAME头上和尾巴上光亮的羽毛，与洁白流畅的身体对比鲜明。它很受富人欢迎，在王室家族中也是繁荣的象征。
author: kam_doodle_snek
source: The glossy feathers on the head and tail of POKENAME are a stark contrast to its white, sleek body. They are popular among wealthy people, and are a symbol of prosperity among regal families.

entry: POKENAME会在冰川里挖洞，身体能抵御严寒。它们很擅长游泳，会成群出洞捕捉小鱼。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME create burrows in glaciers, their bodies able to withstand frigid temperatures. These Pokémon are skilled swimmers, emerging from their burrows in packs to hunt small fish.

entry: POKENAME没有能感知温度的神经，因此能住在最寒冷的环境中。科学家甚至把它们放在温控房间里，它们在零下80摄氏度仍能舒适地生存。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME doesn't have nerves that can detect temperature, so it is able to live in the coldest environments. Scientists have even kept them in thermo-regulated rooms, and they are able to survive comfortably at -80° Celsius.

entry: 退潮时，POKENAME会聚在凉冷的泥滩上小睡，练习掷泥。收服后，它会有极强的分离焦虑，必须有训练家给的帽子才能安心。
author: ghostslythe
source: POKENAME clusters together during low tide on cool muddy beaches to nap and practice Mud Slaps. When caught, it has extreme separation anxiety and must have a hat from its Trainer to feel safe.

entry: POKENAME美丽的纹样与配色，近来成了时尚界的新宠。富人间甚至流行办整场以它为主题的秀。
author: rakunk
source: POKENAME has recently become a large icon in the fashion world for its beautiful patterns and coloring. Entire shows dedicated to this Pokémon have recently become trendy among the wealthy.

entry: 性情友善，游荡在冰冷环境中，几乎会帮助所有有需要的对象。但只要碰到冰冠，就会瞬间冻结。
author: pokepower
source: A friendly Pokémon that helps almost anyone in need as it wanders icy environments. If you touch its ice crown, you'll be frozen in an instant.

entry: 为了保持背上冰种子完整，POKENAME不能远离栖息的冰水。格外烦躁时，身体会分泌能让附近宝可梦入睡或麻痹的毒素。
author: fiordaliso
source: To keep the ice seed on its back intact, POKENAME cannot stray far from the icy waters it lives in. When it gets very agitated, its body secretes toxins that can put nearby Pokémon to sleep or paralyze them.

entry: POKENAME一生几乎都在水下，却需要呼吸空气。背上的叶子能从周围海水中产生氧气泡，为它提供随身的空气源。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Despite spending almost all of their lives underwater, POKENAME need air to breathe. The leaves on their back are able to produce oxygen bubbles from the seawater surrounding them, providing a portable air source.

entry: POKENAME的尾巴极其敏感，始终小心地收在身边。只要轻碰一下，平常温顺的它也会试着用角扎进碰到尾巴的东西里。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's tail is extremely sensitive and tucked carefully close to its body at all times. A simple touch to it will drive the normally docile Pokémon to attempt to bury its horn into whatever touched it.

entry: POKENAME常因在冰山上睡着而被冲到世界各地的海岸。好不容易回到家，又爬上另一座冰山，再重复一遍。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME wash up on shores across the world because they fall asleep on icebergs. When they finally return home, they climb to the top of another iceberg, repeating the process.

entry: 它们开心时，纯白毛皮便会发光。冬季最活跃，夏天则常睡觉。
author: bobosmith01
source: Whenever they are happy, their pure-white fur begins to glow. They are most active in the wintertime and tend to sleep during the summer.

entry: POKENAME个头很大，看着吓人，其实很爱玩。它喜欢来回抛球、追逐小型宝可梦，不得不分别时，还会把毛簇送给玩伴。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME seem intimidating because of their massive size but are rather playful. They enjoy tossing balls back and forth and love to chase after smaller Pokémon. When they inevitably have to part ways, they offer tufts of fur to those they play with.

entry: POKENAME的体温保持在华氏0度，会冻出浮冰来安家。背上的壳结构类似冰川，周围温度一旦高于冰点，就会融化。
author: notadoctor75
source: POKENAME maintain a body temperature of 0F, and make their homes by freezing their own ice floes. The shell on its back is similar in structure to a glacier, and it melts whenever the temperature around the Pokémon is above freezing.

entry: POKENAME柔软的白色羽毛被用来填充各式外套和枕头。它平时多靠飞行出行，也能用蹼状尾巴熟练游泳，追逐藏在水下的猎物。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its soft white feathers are used to stuff various kinds of jackets and pillows. Though POKENAME usually travels by flying, it can also swim skillfully using its webbed tail to chase prey hiding underwater.

entry: POKENAME的歌声传遍冻原，迷惑猎物靠近。速度与力量足以压倒猎物，也能击败竞争者。
author: patch
source: POKENAME's songs can be heard all across the tundra, enchanting its prey to move closer. Its speed and power are more than enough to overwhelm its prey, as well as its competition.

entry: POKENAME住在浮冰上，用獠牙、角和尾巴造出简易冰屋。这种漂浮的冰屋即使被捕食者或大船掀翻，也能保护里面的POKENAME与幼崽。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME make their homes on ice floes, utilizing their tusks, horns, and tails to craft crude igloos. These floating igloos are built in such a way that even if flipped by a predator or a large ship, the POKENAME and their young will be safe inside.

entry: POKENAME周围总有阵阵寒意。有些训练家会在炎热的夏日把它留在身边，节省空调开销。
author: camtft
source: POKENAME produce a constant chill around them. Some trainers keep them around during warm summer days to save money on air conditioning.

entry: POKENAME游泳的本领极强，眨眼间就能转向，在陆地上也出奇地灵活。它游动或旋转时，冰柱会飞得到处都是。
author: bobosmith01
source: While also being incredibly powerful swimmers that can change direction in the blink of an eye, POKENAME displays surprisingly agility on land as well. When they swim or spin in circles, icicles fly everywhere.

entry: 许多酒吧会给POKENAME的奶加冰，因为大家普遍认为奶一暖起来，味道就会变差。这也催生了印有它的标志的饮料机市场。
author: secondatheniangadfly
source: Many bars serve POKENAME milk with ice cubes, since its taste is widely considered to worsen if the milk warms. This has created a market for the sale of drink machines with logos that feature POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME会在海上彼此竞速，快得让附近海水升温。它也能冻住游过的水，在自行造出的冰川上睡觉。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: With speeds high enough to cause nearby water to heat up, POKENAME race across the seas with one another. POKENAME can also freeze the waters they race through, sleeping on artificial glaciers.

entry: 鳍状的耳朵让它游得如快艇般迅捷。额头的角能引导电属性攻击，让它在觅食时抵御水下捕食者。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its fin-shaped ears allow it to move through water as swiftly as a speedboat. The horn on its forehead channels its Electric-type attacks, which it uses to fend off aquatic predators while searching for food.

entry: POKENAME在高耸的冰川附近漂游，观察下方冷水中游泳的宝可梦。它会用幽灵咒术弄裂大块冰，让冰块落下，给下面的游泳者制造混乱。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME floats around tall glacier areas, watching for Pokémon swimming in the cold waters below. It uses ghost hexes to crack large chunks of ice off to fall down and cause chaos to the swimmers below.

entry: POKENAME似乎感觉不到寒冷，整天反复跳进冰水，又爬出来。它会爬上峭壁和冰山练习跳水，但顶端太高时，常会犹豫不决。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME do not seem to feel the cold and will spend all day jumping into and climbing out of frigid water. They climb up cliffs and icebergs to practice diving off them, but frequently hesitate at the top if it is particularly tall.

entry: POKENAME额头的角能引导电属性攻击，让它在觅食时抵御水下捕食者。华美的白色尾巴也让它在任何水域游泳都毫不费劲。
author: fiordaliso
source: The horn on its forehead channels its Electric-type attacks, which it uses to fend off aquatic predators while searching for food. Its magnificent white tail allows POKENAME to swim in any aquatic environment without difficulty.

entry: POKENAME是出色的游泳者，会群体捕猎。爪子留下的伤口几乎立刻冻结，让受害者严重冻伤。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are incredible swimmers, hunting in packs. The wounds left by their claws freeze almost instantly, leaving their victims with severe frostbite.

entry: 它在寒冷的北方海滩上休息，丝毫不怕冷。若有什么打扰，它就会用双臂上的炮管射出沸水，将对方赶走。
author: .jerden
source: It rests on beaches in the frigid north, unbothered by the cold. If anything disturbs its rest, it drives them off by firing boiling water from the cannons in its arms.

entry: POKENAME一年四季都生活在河里，冬天就潜伏在冰冷的水面下。它们会用爪子挖开冰层，救起落水的孩子。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME live in rivers throughout the year, lurking below the frosty surface during winter. They help save children who fall into the water by digging through the ice with their claws.

entry: POKENAME通常躲在藻类中，避免与其他宝可梦冲突。身体表面覆着一层薄薄的水膜，即使在酷暑中离开水，也能保持凉爽。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME usually hides among the algae to avoid confrontations with other Pokémon. Its body is coated in a thin film of water that keeps it cool out of the water even on very hot days.

entry: POKENAME在水下洞穴游动时，会用白色爪子破开障碍。只要奋力蹬动尾巴，就能借助鳍下的薄膜在水面上方滑翔。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME uses its white claws to break through obstacles as it swims through underwater caves. If it kicks its tail hard enough, it can use the membranes under its fins to glide above the water's surface.

entry: POKENAME生活在高山湖泊中，大部分时间都待在冰冷的水面下。严寒使皮肤上结出冰晶，等冰晶长得太累赘，它就会在附近的树上把冰晶蹭掉。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME live in alpine lakes, spending most of their time beneath the icy surface of the water. The cold causes ice crystals to form on their skin. When the growths become too cumbersome, they scrape them off on nearby trees.

entry: POKENAME白天喜欢在冰冻的岩石海滩上懒散度日。周围温度越低，它的体温就升得越高，以此抵御寒冷，也变得越发活跃。
author: anonymous_moose
source: POKENAME loves to laze around on frozen, rocky beaches during the day. The colder the ambient temperature drops, the higher its body heat rises to compensate, and the more active it becomes.

entry: 严寒让POKENAME精神焕发、灵感涌现。有些旅人专程前往北极地区，只为亲眼看看一群POKENAME在极光下起舞的著名美景。
author: t3isukone
source: POKENAME is invigorated and inspired by freezing temperatures. Some travelers will go to arctic regions just to see the famed beauty of a troupe of POKENAME dancing under the aurora.

entry: 十分保护喜欢的人。关于POKENAME引领水手穿越寒冷风暴的故事有很多。
author: geminib
source: It's very protective of people it's fond of. There are many stories of POKENAME guiding sailors through frigid storms.

entry: POKENAME会在海中岩石上唱优美的歌，想让附近的训练家或宝可梦开心。可惜歌声太容易让人分心，许多水手都说自己的船因此翻覆。
author: sondededoo
source: POKENAME are known to sing beautiful songs atop ocean rocks, hoping to entertain nearby Trainers or Pokémon. Unfortunately, their songs tend to be quite distracting, and many sailors have reported capsizing because of them.

entry: POKENAME生活在寒冷潮湿的环境附近，用坚韧的獠牙将不融冰刻成锋利的剑。它性情比较温顺，但为了保护别人，会成为勇猛的战士。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME live near cold, wet environments and use their tough tusks to carve sharp swords out of NeverMeltIce formations. They are relatively docile Pokémon but they become fierce fighters to protect others.

entry: POKENAME在水中静静漂游，似乎对周围的一切浑然不觉。若有什么怀着敌意接近，头顶的冰晶就会变得更加尖锐，朝来犯者发射多道冰冻光束。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME floats around silently in the water, seemingly oblivious to anything around it. If something approaches it with hostility, the ice crystal above its head grows spikier and fires out multiple Ice Beams in the aggressor's direction.

entry: POKENAME会在冰盖上闲待着，一连几天都不挪动。它层叠的尖刺使背部几乎无从攻击，因此丝毫不怕捕食者。
author: stevethebarbarian
source: POKENAME is known to loiter on ice sheets without moving for days at a time. It has no fear of predators, because its layered spines make its back almost impossible to attack it.

entry: POKENAME的身体由冰晶与雪花混合而成，不断旋转。它喜欢附身其他水生宝可梦，强迫它们在浮冰上挖洞。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME swirls with a mixture of ice crystals and snowflakes that compose its body. It likes to possess other aquatic Pokémon, forcing them to dig holes into floes of ice.

entry: POKENAME的身体极其流畅，能在水中高速穿行，转向也灵巧无比。它更愿意退避而非战斗，只要觉得冲突将起，几秒内就会消失得无影无踪。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's body is incredibly sleek, made for cutting through the water at high speeds and for unparalleled maneuverability. It prefers retreat to battle, disappearing from sight in mere seconds if it feels conflict is brewing.

entry: POKENAME的茎由坚冰构成，必须生活在严寒地区才能存活。背上的花能释放冰冷的雾，让试图攻击它的对象动弹不得。
author: sk372
source: Due to its stem being made of solid ice, POKENAME must live in frigid areas to survive. The flower atop its back can release a cloud of freezing mist to immobilize anything that tries to attack it.

entry: POKENAME能凝聚出水制标枪，投向最远50米外的目标，进行远程攻击。职业运动员会找它一起训练，磨炼自己的投掷技巧。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME conjure javelins of water with which to battle, hurling them up to fifty meters to attack from a distance. Professional athletes will seek out POKENAME to train alongside, working to hone their own throws.

entry: 礁石、珊瑚或冰山堵塞航道的地方，常能见到POKENAME。它与近亲不同，十分活泼，会游到船边，引导船只穿过险处。水手们尤其重视保护它们。
author: ghostslythe
source: Where shallow rocks, coral, or icebergs choke shipping lanes, POKENAME can be found. Unlike their cousins, they are very playful, swimming up to boats to guide them through hazards. Sailors especially ensure these Pokémon are protected.

entry: POKENAME十分爱护自己的造物，化作威严的水生宝可梦与它们一同生活。它会冻结水面，替同类挡住鱼叉，保护水生生物免遭偷猎。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME take great care of their creations and live among them in the form of a majestic aquatic Pokémon. They protect aquatic life from poachers by freezing the surface of the water and shielding their kin from harpoons.

entry: 冰川几乎不动，而POKENAME游得很快，凭这点就能分辨。船只常跟在这种大型宝可梦身后，安全穿过冰冷的水域。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME can be distinguished from a glacier by its swift swimming, as glaciers barely move. Ships will often follow behind this large Pokémon to safely traverse through frigid waters.

entry: POKENAME用钻石般坚硬的角，凿开所处水域表面的层层冰盖。浅色的身体让它完美融入积雪，躲开捕食者。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME uses its diamond-hard horn to carve through the layers of ice covering the waters it swims in. Its pale body lets it blend perfectly into the snow, helping it evade predators.

entry: POKENAME在浮冰上睡觉时，洁白的身体能为它提供伪装。想回水里狩猎时，它就用翅膀锋利的钢质边缘切开冰洞，潜入寒冷的深处。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's brilliant white body camouflages it as it sleeps on ice floes. When it wants to return to the water to hunt, it uses the sharp steel edges of its wings to cut a hole in the ice, then swims down into the frigid depths.

entry: 额头上坚硬的角能吸收从天而降的雷电，将其转化为电力用于攻击。白色尾巴让它能在所居寒冷水域的冰山间穿行，姿态优雅无比。
author: fiordaliso
source: The hard horn on its forehead can absorb the power of lightning striking from the sky and convert it into electricity for its attacks. Thanks to its white tail, it maneuvers among the icebergs of the frozen waters where it lives with unmatched grace.

entry: POKENAME常伪装成游泳者或水手，偶尔会在公海上意外引来救援。风平浪静的夜晚，它会完全卸下伪装，潜水捕食可达鸭。
author: ghostslythe
source: Often disguising itself as a Swimmer or Sailor, POKENAME has been known to accidentally attract rescue attempts on the high seas. On calm nights, it sheds its disguise completely, diving for Psyduck meals.

entry: 有雾的夜晚，这些宝可梦会从海中现身，唱起海妖般的歌，将渔夫和水手引到身边。据说，沉醉于歌声的人再也没能回家。
author: actliux
source: On foggy nights, these Pokémon come out of the ocean to sing a siren song to lure fishers and sailors to them. It is said that those lulled by their song never return home.

entry: 极光构成的缎带触感冰冷。身体越健康，缎带的色彩就越鲜明。
author: melodydelune
source: The aurora that makes up its ribbons is cold to the touch. The better its health, the more vividly these ribbons appear.

entry: POKENAME生活在海洋最寒冷处的深水里，偶尔才会上浮。露出水面时，身体会产生浓雾，冻住靠得太近的对象。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME lives deep within the coldest parts of the ocean, only occasionally coming up to the surface. When above the water, its body generates a thick cloud of mist that freezes those who come too close.

entry: POKENAME生活在两极高空，在平流层上部盘旋。背鳍闪着极光般的光芒，舞姿将夜空照亮。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME live high above the poles, circling the skies in the upper stratosphere. Their dorsal fins glow with the light of the aurora, illuminating the night sky with their dances.

entry: POKENAME生活在两极高空，在平流层上部盘旋。背鳍由周围大气凝结的冰构成，在阳光下闪耀，让它们相隔数英里也能看见彼此。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME live high above the poles, circling the skies in the upper stratosphere. Their dorsal fins are formed from ice condensed from the atmosphere around them, glinting in the sunlight and letting them see one another from miles away.

entry: POKENAME靠扇动翅膀、摆动尾巴，能灵活地高速游泳和飞行。这两个动作无法分开做，因此无论身处何种地形，它都不停地拍翅、摆尾。
author: sk372
source: Between the flapping of its wings and the wiggling of its tail, POKENAME can both swim and fly with high speed and agility. Its body cannot perform one motion without the other, so it is constantly flapping and wiggling no matter the terrain.

entry: POKENAME喜欢在自助洗衣店工作，尤其爱帮忙冷水洗涤。虽然它不算特别节能，费用也高，但欢快的性情仍能让顾客享受这趟洗衣之行。
author: inquis1
source: POKENAME enjoys working at laundromats, especially helping with the cold cycles. Even if it isn't the most energy-efficient, its jovial nature is enough for customers to enjoy their visit despite the high costs.

entry: POKENAME是顶级捕食者，会猎食其他水属性宝可梦。猎物一旦被它咬住，便很难逃脱。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are apex predators that hunt other Water-type Pokémon. When their prey is trapped within their jaws, they have little chance of escaping.

entry: POKENAME的大尾巴让它在水下游得又快又灵活。它虽然友好，却不喜欢被摸尾巴，会用一阵冰冷的风赶走想摸的对象。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's large tail helps it greatly in maintaining high speed and maneuverability underwater. Though quite friendly, it dislikes having its tail touched, dispelling those who try with a blast of icy wind.

entry: POKENAME在北极环境中生活得很好，白色身体能完美融入积雪。坚韧的爪子让它能迅速挖穿冰层。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME thrives in arctic environments as its white body blends seamlessly into the snow. Its tough claws allow it to quickly dig through sheets of ice.

entry: POKENAME厚厚的脂肪层使它能承受家园零下的低温。可这也让它在水中行动迟缓笨重，只能依靠植物和游得较慢的鱼维生。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME's thick blubber allows it to withstand the sub-zero temperatures of its home. Unfortunately, this also makes POKENAME slow and cumbersome in the water, forcing it to rely on vegetation and slower fish for sustenance.

entry: POKENAME会捕捉行动缓慢的水生宝可梦，尽量积存脂肪，在零下低温中生存。它们常围住渔船，盼着轻松吃上一口。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME survive in subzero temperatures by catching slow aquatic Pokémon and storing as much blubber as they can. They often surround fishing vessels hoping for an easy snack.

entry: POKENAME很讨人喜欢，也不太难照料，常被贵族饲养，作为身份的象征。它原产于寒冷地区，能用独角制造美丽的极光。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Kept as symbols of status by aristocrats, POKENAME is a charming Pokémon that is relatively low maintenance. They're native to colder climates and can produce beautiful auroras from their single horn.

entry: POKENAME贴着极地海洋的冰冷水面低飞，融入浮冰之间。翅膀的颜色与冰山一致，休息时也便于伪装。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME skims over the icy waters of the polar oceans, flying low to the surface to help it blend in with the ice floes. Its wings match the colors of icebergs to help it camouflage when resting.

entry: POKENAME害怕被更大的海洋捕食者吃掉，终日惶恐。它会伪装成吃吼霸或帝牙海狮，借体形吓退对方。
author: skyward_25
source: POKENAME lives in fear of larger marine predators that might eat it. POKENAME disguises itself as Dondozo or Walrein to scare them off with its size.

entry: POKENAME体内充满冷空气，却不知为何比充满热空气的气球还容易漂浮。科学家仍在研究这现象背后的物理原理。
author: lydiaprower8
