source: POKENAME is full of cold air, which somehow allows it float better than balloons filled with hot air. Scientists are still trying to figure out the physics behind this phenomenon.

entry: POKENAME浑身散发着浓烈的烂鱼臭味。想成为它的训练家，必须非常能忍受臭味。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's body absolutely reeks of rotten fish. A strong tolerance for odors is required for any Trainer of POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME住在浮冰上，能操控浮冰顺着洋流移动，寻找新的猎场。它面容虽友善，却会穷追在北极海域活动的捕鲸者和偷猎者。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME resides on ice floes and can exert control over them, manoeuvring them to move along water currents to find new hunting grounds. Despite its friendly face, It relentlessly pursues whalers and poachers who ply the arctic seas.

entry: POKENAME体力惊人。会将制服的猎物夹在腋下，带到海滩吃掉，再晒太阳。
author: the_fireplace
source: POKENAME boasts tremendous physical strength. It tucks subdued prey under its arms to carry them to the beach, then sunbathes after its meal.

entry: POKENAME的身体由柔软易塑的雪构成，能自由变形。只要碰到头里的铲子，身体就会暂时散开，融成一摊水。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's body is made of soft malleable snow it can freely shift the form of. Touching the shovel in its head causes the body to temporarily lose its cohesion and melt into a puddle.

entry: POKENAME的蘑菇能在体内产生天然防冻物质，防止细胞在冷水中冻结。科学家研究这种物质，希望能更安全地保存捐赠的器官和血液。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME's mushrooms produce natural antifreeze within their bodies, preventing their cells from freezing in cold water. Scientists have studied this substance to help with safely storing organ and blood donations.

entry: 热时将热能存进体内，到酷寒地区再拿来保暖。若存得过多，POKENAME就跳起高难又迷人的舞，释放能量。
author: hello_i_exist
source: It stores thermal energy in its body when its hot, then uses that energy to keep itself warm in freezing-cold areas. However, if it stores too much energy, POKENAME will release it by performing difficult yet mesmerizing dances.

entry: 它会用精神力量震碎海冰。站在冰上的猎物就会落入POKENAME满是尖牙的口中。
author: cait_sith
source: It uses its psychic powers to shatter sea ice. Any prey standing on the ice will fall into POKENAME's sharp-toothed jaws.

entry: POKENAME的蘑菇含水过多时，会像洒水器一样从身体顶端的角喷水。水里满是有害孢子，应避免接触，以免生病。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME's mushroom becomes overhydrated, it dispenses water from the horn atop its body like a sprinkler. This water is filled with harmful spores and should be avoided to prevent illness.

entry: POKENAME会冻结双臂，延长臂刃的攻击范围。这种冰质结构也让它能把臂刃当作滑雪板，顺着山坡滑下。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME extend the range of their blades by freezing over their arms. This icy structure allows them to slide down hills by using their blades as skis.

entry: POKENAME能引导毛皮中的寒气，大幅降低周围温度。挥动尾巴便能向对手掀起阵阵冰冷的风。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME channel the cold in their fur, drastically lowering the temperature of their surroundings. By whipping their tails, they can send gusts of freezing air toward opponents.

entry: POKENAME常被称为北方的寒冰摄政王，主要出没于冰冷的高山湖泊。手杖指向何处，那里就会明显变冷，但许多人认为那只是它用精神力量制造的错觉。
author: ghostslythe
source: Often referred to as the Ice Regent of the North, POKENAME is found predominantly in freezing mountain lakes. Wherever it points its staff the temperature drops noticeably, though many think it uses its psychic powers to trick the mind.

entry: POKENAME看见一群人聚集，就会拍着手有节奏地舞动，想让大家一起跳舞。不少POKENAME还训练了野生小海狮群，让它们随自己的节拍摇摆。
author: sk372
source: If POKENAME sees a group of people gathering, it claps its hands and moves rhythmically to try and get them to dance. Many have trained groups of Seel in the wild to groove to their personal beats.

entry: POKENAME的身体始终温暖，即使生活在严寒恶劣的栖息地也不会觉得冷。长尾巴让它游得极快，力量也很大，因此还会在战斗中用来抽打敌人。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its perpetually warm body allows POKENAME to live even in harsh, freezing habitats without ever feeling cold. Its long tail lets it swim at incredible speeds, and it's so strong that it also uses it in battle to lash out at its foes.

entry: 受到威胁时，POKENAME会从土里甩出尾鳍，向敌人泼泥。突如其来的泥浆能暂时遮住敌人的眼睛，让它有足够时间钻地逃走。
author: .izik
source: When threatened, POKENAME lashes its tail fin from the soil to splash mud at foes. The sudden spray can blind enemies long enough for it to burrow away.

entry: POKENAME会在冰山里钻出复杂的迷宫，躲避捕食者。由于栖息地流失，近年已很少有人见到它。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME burrows into icebergs, carving complex mazes to evade predators. Due to habitat loss, POKENAME sightings have become scarce in recent years.

entry: POKENAME很会潜水。常从结冰的海崖上一跃而下，从上方突袭猎物。
author: staghorn
source: POKENAME are extremely capable divers. They're often seen leaping from icy sea cliffs, surprising their prey from above.

entry: POKENAME栖息在寒冷的海湾，船只若靠得太近、惹它生气，就会陷入危险。它游泳时灵活得多，因此常从水中跃出，一阵猛攻后又潜入水下。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME inhabits frigid bays, proving to be a danger to shipping vessels if they get too close and anger it. It is much more graceful when swimming, so it often launches itself from the water in a flurry of blows before diving below again.

entry: 宝可梦融合让POKENAME长出了惊人的角。它会在家园岩岸的粗石上勤快地磨角。大多数POKENAME都会保护自己群体中尚未融合的白海狮。
author: lupa
source: POKENAME, through Pokémon fusion, has sprouted an impressive horn. It will diligently sharpen it on coarse stones in the rocky shores it calls home. Most POKENAME will take on a protective role over its herd of unfused Dewgong.

entry: POKENAME常试着将黏软的肢体变成各种形状，有些变完后就再也变不回原样。
author: rooboid
source: POKENAME are often seen trying to morph their gooey limbs into different shapes. Some are unable to return to their original shape afterwards.

entry: POKENAME吃下的腐败物越多，身体就长得越快。它不太擅长攀爬，只能待在森林地面上。臭味也让它的行踪很容易被追踪。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME grows rapidly in size as it eats more and more decomposing material. It isn't a very good climber, so it has to stay on the forest floor. Its stench means it's easy to track, too.

entry: POKENAME的武器乍看是骨头，其实是一团能随意塑形的有毒软泥。除了棍棒，它也常把软泥变成可伸长的手，抓住敌人或拿取远处的物品。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's weapon appears to be a bone at first, but is actually a bit of malleable toxic ooze it can reshape at will. Aside from a club, it often turns it into an extending hand to grapple foes or grab distant objects.

entry: POKENAME生于严重污染处，尤其化学废水与化石燃料废气聚集的地方。体内气体又将污染扩散周围，数量一多，便被环保人士视为威胁。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME forms in highly polluted areas, commonly arising in areas of heavy chemical runoff and fossil fuel emissions. Their internal gasses spread this pollution to the local area, environmentalists view large POKENAME populations as a danger.

entry: POKENAME的污泥会释放浓密翻卷的毒烟。睡觉时，烟雾将它完全遮住，也能赶走闯入者。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's sludge releases dense swirling toxic smoke. The fumes conceal it completely as it sleeps, warding off intruders.

entry: POKENAME生于严重污染处，尤其化学废水与化石燃料废气聚集的地方。体内气体又将污染扩散周围，数量一多，便被环保人士视为威胁。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME forms in highly polluted areas, commonly arising in areas of heavy chemical runoff and fossil fuel emissions. Their internal gasses spread this pollution to the local area, environmentalists view large POKENAME populations as a danger.

entry: POKENAME生于严重污染处，尤其化学废水与化石燃料废气聚集的地方。体内气体又将污染扩散周围，数量一多，便被环保人士视为威胁。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME forms in highly polluted areas, commonly arising in areas of heavy chemical runoff and fossil fuel emissions. Their internal gasses spread this pollution to the local area, environmentalists view large POKENAME populations as a danger.

entry: POKENAME在体表产生厚重油腻的凝胶，将攻击的力量分散到全身。科学家正试验一些产品，希望与这种凝胶混合，制成柴油的替代品。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME produce a thick, oily gel around their bodies that diffuses force from attacks throughout their body. Scientists are testing products that mix with POKENAME gel to produce an alternative to diesel.

entry: 它在燃煤发电厂的烟雾间漂浮，悬在数百英尺高空，不断滴下紫色酸液。酸性的黏液会损坏下方的建筑。
author: .izik
source: It floats through the smoke of coal power plants, dripping purple acid as it hovers hundreds of feet in the air. The acidic slime causes damage to buildings below.

entry: POKENAME身上的紫色糊状物非常滑，只要待在水里就不会被冲走。这让它遭好坏星袭击时，能轻松滑过水中脱身。
author: .izik
source: The purple paste covering POKENAME's body won't wash off while it stays in the water, and is very slippery. This allows it to easily escape should it be attacked by a Mareanie, slipping through the water with ease.

entry: POKENAME是城都地区入侵性极强的物种。黏液会污染植物，使其迅速死亡。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME is a highly invasive species in the Johto region. Its goo can contaminate plants and quickly kill them.

entry: POKENAME性情冷淡疏离，厌恶比自己幸运的宝可梦。它常大发雷霆，不顾自身安危地拿别人出气。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME is a standoffish creature, despising Pokémon that have better luck than it. POKENAME often flies into a rage, disregarding its safety as it takes its anger out on others.

entry: POKENAME靠近进化之石时，黏液般的身体就会剧烈冒泡。气泡破裂时，映出的颜色与距离最近的石头相同。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's slime-like body bubbles furiously when near an Evolution Stone. The bubbles that pop reflect the same color as whichever stone is closest.

entry: 它进入网络空间，靠吸收错误代码和病毒，在可疑网站上滋长。若被打扰，病毒就会离开身体，钻进相连的电脑。
author: .izik
source: It enters cyberspace, thriving on questionable websites by absorbing faulty code and viruses. If interrupted, the viruses leave its body and into connected computers.

entry: POKENAME藏在下水道的僻静角落，伏击匆匆跑过的小拉达。壳上覆盖的黏稠凝胶能黏住猎物。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME hides in quiet corners of sewers to ambush Rattata when they skitter by. Its shell is covered with a viscous gel that sticks to its prey.

entry: 这种行动迟缓的宝可梦由有毒污泥构成，污泥会渗入身下的土地。它很少移动，更喜欢睡觉，大量吞食周围的废物。
author: motion_09
source: This sluggish Pokémon is made out of toxic sludge that seeps into the ground beneath it. It rarely moves, preferring to sleep and consume mass amounts of waste surrounding it.

entry: POKENAME最早发现于一座旧发电厂的遗址，那座电厂曾因污染严重而臭名远扬。被它的黏液碰到的机器会出故障，因为黏液会渗入内部，使机器电量过载。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME was first discovered in what remained of an old power plant infamous for its pollution amount. Machines touched by its goop will malfunction as the goo seeps within and overcharges them with electricity.

entry: POKENAME的身体由有毒的污泥物质构成。直接碰到它的人会以为自己暂时获得了超能力，其实只是毒素引起了轻微幻觉。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's body is made up of toxic and sludgy materials. Those who touch it directly believe they have temporarily gained psychic powers, but are in reality simply experiencing mild hallucinations from the toxins.

entry: POKENAME靠在肮脏、污染严重的水中游泳恢复身体，因此常出没于下水道。它能从口中吐出腐蚀性极强的液体，连坚实的岩石都能溶化。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME restores its body by swimming in dirty, heavily polluted waters, which is why it's often found in sewers. It can spit a highly corrosive liquid from its mouth, strong enough to even melt solid rock.

entry: POKENAME飞累后落在植物上休息，有毒的身体就会使植物枯萎腐烂。根据臭味的不同，还能判断一群POKENAME的心情。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: When POKENAME land on vegetation as they rest from flying, the flora will begin to wilt and decay under these Pokémon's toxic bodies. The different types of foul stenches can indicate what mood a swarm of POKENAME is in.

entry: POKENAME由黏性极强的污泥构成，能轻松沿墙壁和天花板移动。它会留下污泥痕迹黏住猎物，再沿着痕迹滑过去，吞下其中困住的东西。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are made of a highly adhesive sludge, allowing them to move along walls and ceilings with ease. They leave trails of sludge behind them to stick prey in place, gliding along their own trails to gulp down anything caught within.

entry: 自卫的最后关头，POKENAME能把四片黏糊糊的翅膀全甩向对手，使对方沾满污物和毒液，自己则落地尝试溜走。它会一直躲到几小时后翅膀再生。
author: sk372
source: In a last-ditch attempt at self-defense, POKENAME can fling all four of its gooey wings at an opponent, covering them with muck and poison while it falls to the ground and attempts to slip away, hiding until the wings regenerate in a few hours.

entry: POKENAME半固态的身体使飞行很困难，大约一半时间都待在地上，之后才会振翅离开。极少数情况下，它留下的一摊摊污物会产生意识，变成新的臭泥。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's semisolid body composition makes flying difficult, and it spends about half its time grounded before fluttering off. On rare occasions, the pools of grime it leaves behind can gain sentience and become new Grimer.

entry: POKENAME的污泥完全来自受污染海洋的淤泥。数量过多，通常就意味着污染正在加剧。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME's grime is strictly made up of ooze from polluted oceans. Overpopulation of POKENAME usually means pollution is worsening.

entry: 它住在公园附近，大吃游客留下的垃圾。身上滴落的黏液是强效肥料，能滋养附近的植物。
author: .izik
source: It lives near public parks, feasting on litter left by visitors. The slime that drips from its body acts as a powerful fertilizer, nourishing nearby plants.

entry: 它滴下的黏液对植物十分有益。它在雨水槽里安家，还会压缩身体，挤进狭窄的空间。
author: .izik
source: The slime it drips is highly beneficial for plants. It makes its home in rain gutters, compressing its body to fit into tight spaces.

entry: POKENAME全身触之有毒，身上的环纹尤其毒性猛烈、危害严重。奇怪的是，满月的月光照在身上时，它就会变得完全无害。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's entire body is poisonous to touch, but its rings are especially toxic and harmful. Curiously, its body becomes completely harmless while it is exposed to the light of the full moon.

entry: 它会从背上的种子射出一团团黏稠污泥，像吐出纸团一样。这些恶臭的弹丸会逐渐变硬，留下的污物最终石化成橡胶般的奇怪小丘。
author: jaminmcready
source: It launches globs of sticky sludge like spitballs from the bulb on its back. These foul projectiles harden over time, leaving behind trails of gunk that fossilize into strange, rubbery mounds.

entry: POKENAME身上寄生着嗜肉的捕蝇草，因臭气熏天，很少有训练家饲养。背上的捕蝇草有自己的意志。
author: rooboid
source: Host to a flesh-hungry fly trap, POKENAME is rarely raised by Trainers because of its putrid smell. The fly trap on its back acts on its own volition.

entry: 它在下水道系统里开心地吃着腐败的有机物。虽然外表阴沉可怕，却对这些地方的清洁起着关键作用。
author: .izik
source: It happily consumes rotting organic material in sewer systems. Despite its grim appearance, it plays a key role in keeping these areas clean.

entry: POKENAME喜欢在垃圾桶与垃圾箱旁逗留。垃圾吃得越多，颈部的宝石就越亮。
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher
source: POKENAME love to hang around trash cans and dumpsters. The gems around their neck glow brighter the more garbage they eat.

entry: POKENAME用正面的模样让猎物宝可梦放松警惕，等到夜深再回来，用后半身发动攻击。一次意外接触食物的经历表明，只要闻到披萨，它就会停止狩猎。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME use their front appearance to lower the guard of prey Pokémon, later returning in the dark of night to attack with their rear. Accidental exposure to food has shown that POKENAME will stop hunting if they can smell pizza.

entry: POKENAME色彩鲜艳的脸会吸引幼童。它将孩子引走，再用尾巴咬下有毒的一口。孩子们从未回来，没人知道它把他们带去了哪里。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME's brightly coloured face attracts young children. It lures them away before its tail delivers a venomous bite. Where POKENAME takes them remains unknown, as the children never return.

entry: POKENAME会产生闻起来像汽油的黏稠油液。科学家对它极其小心，以免它爆炸。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME produce a viscous oil that smells like gasoline. Scientists treat POKENAME with utmost care to prevent them from exploding.

entry: 它在医院附近飞行，偷走医疗废物，到附近的树上大吃。它不想吃的部分则被丢进旁边的灌木丛。
author: .izik
source: It flies near hospitals to steal medical waste, which it devours in nearby trees. It discards pieces of the waste it doesn't want eat in nearby bushes.

entry: POKENAME吃下的树果会在体内变成果汁。它会黏在墙壁或树上，用果汁留下标记，但没人知道这是标记领地，还是另有用意。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME consumes berries that become berry juice within its body. It sticks to walls or trees to mark them with its berry juice, though it's not known if this is a territorial action or something else entirely.

entry: POKENAME体内蕴含大量热量和能量，身体因此不断冒泡、渗出黏液。它总有一股煤炭燃烧的气味，偶尔还会打嗝，吐出黑色烟雾。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's body is constantly bubbling and oozing due to the high levels of heat and energy it contains. POKENAME constantly smells of burning coal and occasionally burps a black smog.

entry: POKENAME由半固态污泥构成，会爬进有毒废料的容器，大吃里面的化学物质。随着身体长大，容器会卡在背上，充当外壳。
author: imaginita
source: Made of semi-solid sludge, POKENAME will climb into toxic waste containers and gorge itself on the chemicals contained within.  As the POKENAME grows larger, the container gets stuck on its back, acting as a shell.

entry: 从POKENAME体内渗出的软泥，似乎能独立移动。紧张时，它的壳会裂开，释放出寻找新住处的黏液。
author: .izik
source: The ooze seeping from POKENAME's body shows signs of independent movement. When stressed, cracks form in its shell, releasing slime that seeks a new shelter.

entry: POKENAME油腻的身体会变成珊瑚的模样，融入珊瑚礁，躲避捕食者。它只在必要时才移动，靠经过的船只落下的碎屑维生。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's oily body takes the shape of coral to blend in with reefs and avoid predators. It only moves when necessary, feeding on debris that falls from passing ships.

entry: POKENAME靠吞食会伤害其他水生宝可梦的有毒污泥，适应了受污染的环境。等一片珊瑚礁的污染被它清理干净，就会迁往其他珊瑚礁，继续清理。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME has adapted to the pollution in its environment by eating toxic sludge that hurts other aquatic Pokémon. When it inevitably cleans up the pollution in one coral reef, it migrates to other coral reefs to clean them up as well.

entry: POKENAME会和破破袋助手一起打理下水道，刷去污垢，将废物打包。城里的居民忍受它臭烘烘的礼物，换来了格外干净的管道。
author: ozydamians
source: POKENAME tidies up sewer systems, scrubbing grime and packaging waste with its Trubbish assistant. The residents of its home city endure its smelly gifts in exchange for exceptionally clean pipes.

entry: POKENAME污泥般的身体具有很强的腐蚀性。火箭队常利用它破坏挂锁。
author: mepp.
source: The sludge-like body of POKENAME has powerful corrosive properties. Team Rocket will often use this Pokémon to help destroy padlocks.

entry: POKENAME会从鼻子里射出有毒污泥团。它滚动或行走时，身上的污泥会落入土壤缝隙，使土壤变得紧实，植物难以生长。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME shoot globs of toxic sludge from their trunks. As they roll or walk, sludge falls from their body and fills in cracks in the soil, compacting and making it difficult for plants to grow.

entry: POKENAME会溜进托儿所，偷走各种小饰品，装点在身上。它留下的黏液会传播轻微的疾病。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME sneaks into daycares, stealing a variety of trinkets to display on its body. The goo it leaves behind is known to transmit minor illness.

entry: POKENAME模仿阿柏怪的形态，吓退大多数威胁。它本身虽不怀敌意，却也并非只能靠模仿自保，因为碰到它的身体仍然很危险。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's form mimics an Arbok to scare off most threats. Though POKENAME itself is not hostile, it is also not defenseless beyond mimicry, as its body is still quite hazardous to the touch.

entry: 据说，一只魔尼尼掉进毒泥坑后没有死去，反而与污泥融合，变成了POKENAME。
author: roundabout_robin
source: It is said that POKENAME was created when a Mime Jr. fell into a pit of toxic sludge. Instead of dying, it fused with it, creating this Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME的身体只是黏稠毒污泥的宿主。污泥会操纵身体大吃特吃，为进化做准备。
author: rooboid
source: The body of POKENAME is merely a host to the viscous, toxic sludge upon it. The sludge steers the body to eat voraciously to prepare it for evolution.

entry: POKENAME头上伸出的天线能侦测无线电信号，吸收其中传递的数据。它用覆满黏液的身体贴在建筑外墙上，尽可能多地接收信号。
author: .izik
source: The antenna protruding from POKENAME's head allows it to detect radio signals and absorb the data they transmit. It clings to the sides of buildings with its slime-covered body to maximize exposure to these signals.

entry: 构成POKENAME身体的有毒黏液滴中，既有致病性很强的细菌，也有恶意软件。它不受携带的电脑病毒伤害，却会将病毒传播给碰到的任何电脑。
author: .jerden
source: The droplets of toxic slime that make up POKENAME's body are infested with both virulent bacteria and malware. It is unharmed by the computer viruses it carries, but will spread them to any computer it touches.

entry: 它住在餐馆的垃圾箱附近，以剩饭为食。吃饱后，黏糊糊的身体就会开始散发强烈的热量。
author: .izik
source: It makes its home near restaurant dumpsters, consuming leftover food. After eating, its slimy body begins to radiate intense heat.

entry: 它吃掉池塘附近丢弃的垃圾，保持水质清洁。覆满污泥的身体若离水太久，就会变硬。
author: .izik
source: It eats discarded trash near ponds, keeping the water clean. Its sludge-covered body hardens if it stays out of the water too long.

entry: POKENAME在下水道的腐臭中跋涉。据说它受了诅咒，不得不生活在不利于自己的环境中，如今却已学会吸收毒素，在体内将其净化。
author: ghostslythe
source: Amid the septic aromas of sewers, POKENAME trudges along. Rumored to have been cursed to live among its weakness, it has adapted to absorb toxins and purify them within its body.

entry: POKENAME全身覆满有毒污泥，其中一些已硬化成尖刺。耳朵让它听觉敏锐，但它更依赖嗅觉，能从数英里外闻到赖以为食的有毒废料。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's entire body is coated with toxic sludge, although some of it is hardened into sharp spikes. While its ears give it keen hearing, it relies more on its sense of smell, as it can smell the toxic waste it feeds on from miles away.

entry: POKENAME住在曾盛放有毒废料的废弃容器里。它夜里在工厂中滑行，寻找更多废料，吃下后让身体长大。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME houses itself within discarded containers that once held toxic waste. It slides through factories at night, searching for more waste materials it can consume and use to grow in size.

entry: 这些大型宝可梦什么腐烂变质的东西都吃，身上的污泥还能制成强效肥料。它们能迅速判断植物是否开始腐烂或患病，并将其吃掉，对大多数生物都有好处。
author: infinex21
source: These large Pokémon feed on anything rotten or spoiled and their sludge can be made to create a potent fertilizer. They can tell quickly if any plant has begun to rot or if it is diseased and will consume it, to the benefit of most.

entry: POKENAME会吃找到的任何肮脏废物，也捕猎其他毒属性宝可梦。对方虽不受毒刺的毒性影响，却仍会被黏液下藏着的利爪和尖牙伤到。
author: .jerden
source: While POKENAME will feed on any filthy waste it finds, it also hunts other Poison-type Pokémon. While they will be immune to its venomous spines, they can still be harmed by the sharp claws and teeth hidden beneath its slime.

entry: POKENAME的甲壳覆着恶臭的紫色黏液，让其他野生宝可梦不敢靠近。它会用爪子翻乱垃圾桶，吃里面的垃圾。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its carapace is covered in a foul-smelling purple slime that keeps other wild Pokémon at bay. POKENAME uses its claws to ransack trash cans and feed on the garbage inside them.

entry: 它大半个身体都黏稠柔滑，因此许多对手低估了它头骨的坚实程度。袭击者撞上头骨，反而伤到自己时，它就会狡黠地笑。
author: sk372
source: Due to most of its body being viscous and slimy, many underestimate how solid its skull actually is. It laughs deviously when something attacks and ends up hurting itself against its skull.

entry: POKENAME吃下污染物，因此它曾经生活过的地方，环境都十分健康。伽勒尔等地区的污染问题日益严重，研究人员正寻找利用它清理污染区的方法。
author: kam_doodle_snek
source: Places where POKENAME used to live are incredibly healthy, as POKENAME feed on pollution. Researchers are finding ways to utilize POKENAME to clean up polluted areas in regions such as Galar, where pollution has become a growing issue.

entry: 大型漏油事件之后，常能见到POKENAME用胶状身体吸收水中的污染物。然而，它有时也会被冲上岸，给当地环境带来毁灭性的破坏。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME can be found after large oil spills, using their gelatinous bodies to absorb the pollutants in the water. However, POKENAME will sometimes wash up onto the shore, devastating the local environment.

entry: 污染的剑刃划出的伤口必会严重感染。若近战不奏效，就会甩出一块恶臭的剑穗攻击。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: A wound from its polluted blade is sure to cause a nasty infection. When melee combat doesn't do, it throws a chunk of its putrid tassel instead.

entry: POKENAME在污水处理厂帮助去除污染物。吃下有害物质后，只留下无菌的水。
author: melodydelune
source: POKENAME are used in sewage treatment plants to help remove pollutants. They eat the hazardous material, leaving behind only sterile water.

entry: POKENAME生活在污染严重的地区，会迁入遭受漏油等灾害的生态环境。它们敌视清理环境的举动，会袭击清理人员，竭力维持自己的家园。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME can be found living in highly polluted areas, moving into an ecosystem that has suffered an oil spill or similar disaster. They are hostile to efforts to clean up the ecosystem, attacking clean up crews and trying to maintain their home.

entry: POKENAME生活在污染严重的地区，会迁入遭受漏油等灾害的生态环境。它们敌视清理环境的举动，会袭击清理人员，竭力维持自己的家园。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME can be found living in highly polluted areas, moving into an ecosystem that has suffered an oil spill or similar disaster. They are hostile to efforts to clean up the ecosystem, attacking clean up crews and trying to maintain their home.

entry: POKENAME拥有出色的超能力，能操控有毒污泥来保护自己。
author: zweizweihander
source: POKENAME has remarkable psychic abilities. It uses them to control the toxic sludge that it protects itself with.

entry: POKENAME会在巢上涂满黏稠污泥，不仅能像胶水一样黏住闯入者，恶臭还会让陷入其中的对象头昏目眩，几乎无法逃脱。
author: dualblades1147
source: POKENAME cover their nests with a sticky sludge that not only acts like glue, but creates a horrid stench that will daze anyone who gets caught in it, leaving little room for escape.

entry: POKENAME睡觉时缩在钢盔里。一察觉危险，便朝它认定的威胁射出裹着毒泥的钢刺。
author: roundabout_robin
source: POKENAME hide in their steel helmets while they sleep. When they sense danger, they will fire steel spikes coated in toxic sludge at the perceived threat.

entry: 它会用内脏抓住岸边的垃圾桶，拖入浪中。到了水下，就高高兴兴地吃光里面的东西。
author: .izik
source: It uses its innards to grab trash cans from the shoreline, dragging them into the waves. Once underwater, it devours the contents with glee.

entry: POKENAME在阴暗、潮湿、发霉的环境中生活得很好。想舔什么就舔，想咬什么就咬，无定形的身体和对毒的免疫让它免受伤害。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME thrives in dark, damp, and moldy environments. It licks and bites anything it desires, with its amorphous body and immunity to poisons keeping it from harm.

entry: 它从垃圾填埋场收集废汽水罐，用来搭建巢穴。巢出奇地结实，还常在阳光下闪闪发亮。
author: .izik
source: It collects discarded soda cans from landfills to build its den. The structure is surprisingly sturdy and often glimmers in the sunlight.

entry: 工业污水被排入曾受人敬重的自然胜地时，就会形成POKENAME。它们聚集成群，最终沿污水追溯源头，常使下水管道堵塞、出现故障。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME form where industrial sewage is pumped into formerly revered natural sites. They gather into groups and eventually follow the sewage back to its source, often resulting in blockages and problems with sewer pipes.

entry: POKENAME能将黏糊糊的身体缩进铁壳防御，看起来像普通的可可多拉。但维持这种状态很费力，危险过后，它终究得流出壳外，放松一下。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can retract its gooey form into its iron shell for defense and resemble a normal Aron. Staying that way requires effort, however, and it will inevitably need to ooze out and relax once danger has passed.

entry: 野生POKENAME讨厌信使鸟和节庆，会想尽办法破坏庆祝活动。善待它的训练家却说，它会变得快快乐乐，甚至陪信使鸟一起送礼物。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Wild POKENAME despises Delibird and the holiday seasons, and will do anything to ruin celebrations. Trainers who show kindness to POKENAME report that they begin acting joyful and will even accompany Delibird in gift giving.

entry: POKENAME的身体是不断流动变形的软泥。它能塑造软泥并改变颜色，在周围制造假象，向试图攻击的对象泼毒后逃走。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: A POKENAME's body is made of a constantly flowing and shifting ooze. POKENAME can construct and color their ooze to form false images around them, splattering anyone who tries to attack them with poison before fleeing.

entry: 它装成洞穴地上一摊无害的水，等穿山鼠等猎物走得太近，再用超音波将其震晕，随后攻击。
author: .izik
source: It pretends to be a harmless puddle on a cave floor until prey like Sandshrew wander too close. It then uses Supersonic to stun them before attacking.

entry: POKENAME群体竞争激烈。野外，它们会互相冲撞身体，直到胜者用污泥溶解败者，战斗才会停止。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME groups are very competitive. In the wild, they fight by slamming their bodies together, only stopping when the winner dissolves the loser with its sludge.

entry: POKENAME体表的鼻涕状黏液储存着电荷。人或宝可梦即使只短暂碰到，也可能被电得麻痹数小时。
author: .izik
source: The mucus-like slime coating POKENAME's body stores an electric charge. Even brief contact can leave a person or Pokémon stunned for hours.

entry: 这种融合体既不像臭泥，也不像火箭雀，原因让科学家争论不休。越来越多人支持一种说法：某些融合体会变成呼应自身英文名的模样。
author: hophoppip
source: The reason why this fusion resembles neither Grimer nor Fletchinder is hotly debated among scientists. The theory that some fusions morph to echo their names has been growing in prominence.

entry: 它在油轮附近飞行，咬开油桶进食。一次最多能吞10加仑，然后滑翔离去，留下一小摊摊紫色黏液。
author: .izik
source: It flies near oil tankers, biting into barrels of oil to feed. It can swallow up to 10 gallons at a time before gliding away, leaving behind small puddles of purple goo.

entry: 若被人踩到，它就会像胶水一样黏在靴子上，散发难闻的臭气，让那个人再也不想回到这里。
author: .izik
source: If stepped on, it sticks like glue to a person's boot. It releases a terrible stench so that the person never wants to return to the area.

entry: 几片扁平的身体由浓稠毒液黏在一起。POKENAME虽看着像煎饼，可千万别吃。
author: tad
source: Its body is composed of several flat segments joined together by a thick, toxic goo. Though POKENAME looks like pancakes, eating it is not advised.

entry: POKENAME会将黏软的四肢伸入洞穴裂缝，挖出宝石和矿物吃。吃下的晶体穿过身体，排出后就带有轻微的放射性。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME oozes its limbs into cave crevasses to dig out gems and minerals to consume. The crystals it eats pass through its body and become mildly radioactive once left behind.

entry: 它先用冰冷的风冻住垃圾填埋场的垃圾，再大口吃下。这道冷冻工序能在它进食时消除臭味。
author: .izik
source: It freezes trash in landfills with an icy breeze before taking large bites. This chilling process neutralizes the foul smells as it eats.

entry: 它躲在温室里，用酸液溶解一袋袋肥料后吃下。留下的黏液能促进植物生长。
author: .izik
source: It hides in greenhouses, dissolving bags of fertilizer with acid before consuming them. The slime it leaves behind enhances plant growth.

entry: 它在货轮附近游泳，热切等着燃料泄漏。一见漏出的燃料，就开心地喝下，每喝一口都更有精神。
author: .izik
source: It swims near freighters, eagerly waiting for fuel leaks. It gleefully drinks the spilled fuel, growing more energetic with each gulp.

entry: 它住在游乐场附近，吃孩子们留下的垃圾。这奇怪的习惯让场地保持清洁，孩子们也能安全玩耍。
author: .izik
source: It makes its home near playgrounds, eating trash children leave behind. This odd habit keeps the area clean and safe for play.

entry: 它躺在泄漏的油液中，开心地吸收。吃饱后就会释放花粉云，让附近的植物生机勃勃。
author: .izik
source: It lies in puddles of spilled oil, absorbing the liquid with glee. Once full, it releases pollen clouds that invigorate nearby plant life.

entry: 这种融合体所到之处，都会留下带毒、满是细菌的黏液痕迹。多只POKENAME居住的地方，很快就会变得污秽不堪。
author: hophoppip
source: Wherever this fusion travels, it leaves behind a trail of toxic, bacteria-ridden mucus. An area home to multiple POKENAME will quickly become quite grimy.

entry: 它刺穿游轮的侧面，让燃料漏出来，再高高兴兴地吸食，给船身留下一道黏稠的紫色痕迹。
author: .izik
source: It pierces the sides of cruise ships to cause fuel to leak out. It happily slurps up the liquid, leaving the ship with a sticky violet trail.

entry: 它沿海底移动，吞食丢弃的垃圾。垃圾越腐臭，它射出的尖刺就越毒。
author: .izik
source: It moves along the ocean floor consuming discarded trash. The more putrid the garbage, the more toxic the spikes it fires become.

entry: 它黏软的身体遇冷会变硬，因此在沙漠夜里行动困难。白天烈日当空时，却移动得出奇快。
author: .izik
source: Its slimy body hardens in cold temperatures, making it difficult for it to move during desert nights. During the day it moves surprisingly quickly in the hot sun.

entry: POKENAME以有毒植物和真菌为食，毒性越强，背上的蘑菇就长得越大。它沿途留下的污泥也能促进真菌生长。
author: oddwalls
source: POKENAME feeds on poisonous flora and fungi; the more potent the poison, the larger the mushrooms on its back grow. The trail of sludge POKENAME leaves as it travels promotes fungal growth.

entry: 它用尖牙嚼碎、吞食海上漂浮的塑料袋。这种行为有助于清理受污染的水域。
author: .izik
source: It uses its sharp teeth to chew up and consume plastic bags floating in the sea. This behavior helps clean polluted waters.

entry: 它在工业区生活得很好，靠敏锐的视力寻找危险废料的泄漏处。一旦找到，就立刻大喝有毒液体。
author: .izik
source: It thrives in industrial areas, using its sharp eyesight to locate hazardous waste spills. When it finds one, it immediately gorges itself on the toxic fluids.

entry: POKENAME从体内释放有害烟雾，吓跑其他宝可梦。它们沿地面爬行，寻找能忍受烟雾的朋友。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME release noxious clouds of smoke from their bodies that scare away other Pokémon. They crawl along the ground searching for friends that can tolerate the smoke they create.

entry: POKENAME吞食下水道污泥时，竟会散发甜甜的南瓜香。长时间闻这香味，可能会头晕、意识混乱。
author: .izik
source: While consuming sewer sludge, POKENAME emits a surprisingly sweet pumpkin scent. Prolonged exposure to the aroma can cause dizziness and confusion.

entry: 它夜里飞过森林，寻找喇叭芽、向日种子等猎物。一旦发现，只需轻轻一碰，就能用黏稠的身体将对方困住。
author: .izik
source: It flies through forests at night searching for prey like Bellsprout and Sunkern. Upon spotting one, it ensnares them in its sticky body with just a touch.

entry: POKENAME出没于餐馆外的垃圾箱附近，散发着恶臭。它尝起来略有葡萄香精的味道，但吃下就会病得很重。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME is found around dumpsters outside restaurants emitting a foul smell. It tastes faintly of grape flavouring, but eating it makes the consumer dreadfully ill.

entry: POKENAME出没于餐馆外的垃圾箱附近，散发着恶臭。它尝起来略有青苹果香精的味道，但吃下就会病得很重。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME is found around dumpsters outside restaurants emitting a foul smell. It tastes faintly of green apple flavouring, but eating it makes the consumer dreadfully ill.

entry: POKENAME出没于餐馆外的垃圾箱附近，散发着恶臭。它尝起来略有葡萄香精的味道，但吃下就会病得很重。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME is found around dumpsters outside restaurants emitting a foul smell. It tastes faintly of grape flavouring, but eating it makes the consumer dreadfully ill.

entry: 和阿罗拉臭泥很像，POKENAME能将吸收的剧毒浓缩成晶体，储存起来，留待攻击时使用。
author: hophoppip
source: Much like an Alolan Grimer, POKENAME can condense the potent toxins it absorbs into crystals, storing them for later use in attacks.

entry: 深入研究之前，人们以为POKENAME是爱心鱼群受污染后产生的。迷信的人认为，钓起它就预示着感情生活将变糟。
author: sk372
source: Before further research, POKENAME was thought to be a result of pollution affecting Luvdisc colonies. Superstitious folk believe that fishing one up is a sign that their love life will turn sour.

entry: POKENAME经过的土壤会覆上一层黏稠残留物，碰到就可能发高烧。但这层薄膜彻底干燥后，就会变得无害。
author: .izik
source: The soil POKENAME leaves behind is coated in a sticky residue that can cause violent fevers on contact. Once fully dried, the film becomes harmless.

entry: POKENAME从地上捡起硬币，放进嘴里，舔掉污垢后又扔回地上。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME picks coins up off the ground and places them in its mouth. It licks off any grime before tossing them back on the ground.

entry: POKENAME的毛覆着有毒黏液，触碰可能造成严重的化学灼伤。让训练家头疼的是，它偏爱蜷在亲近之人的腿上。接触它时，最好穿好防护服。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME fur is coated in a toxic slime that can cause severe chemical burns if touched. Unfortunately for their trainers, POKENAME enjoy curling up in the laps of the people they care about. Protective clothing is advised when handling them.

entry: 工业泄漏事故发生后，常能见到POKENAME泡在有毒废料中。它们常威胁清理人员的安全，会扑向他们，试图将人拖进污泥。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are commonly found in the aftermath of an industrial spill, bathing in the toxic aftermath. They are often hazardous to clean-up crews, lunging at them and trying to pull them into the sludge.

entry: POKENAME生于毒泥与工业废水，对人类充满敌意。研究者发现，孕育它们的污泥毒性越强，它们就越快发动攻击。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Born of toxic sludge and industrial discharge, POKENAME are aggressive and hostile toward humans. Researchers have observed that the more poisonous the sludge they arise from, the quicker they are to attack.

entry: POKENAME污泥般的身体毒性极强，踩到的草会立刻死去。愤怒时，它还会向别人投掷一块块毒泥。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its sludge-like body is extremely toxic, so much that any grass it steps on dies instantly. When enraged, POKENAME hurls chunks of poisonous mud at others.

entry: 嘴里的螺旋由黑白污泥组成。即使POKENAME被打昏，也会缓缓旋转、搏动。
author: staghorn
source: The spiral in its mouth is made of black and white sludge. It slowly spins and pulses even when the POKENAME is knocked unconscious.

entry: 它催眠油罐车司机，让他们把所载油液倒到街上，再迅速喝光。现场被吃得干干净净，也为它有毒的身体补充了燃料。
author: .izik
source: It hypnotizes oil truck drivers to dump their loads onto the street. It then rapidly drinks the spilled liquid, leaving the area spotless and fueling its poisonous body.

entry: POKENAME身上厚厚的污泥会缓冲拳头的冲击，因此必须苦练，才能打疼对手。它们会不停捶打岩石，直到筋疲力尽。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are coated with a thick sludge that softens their punches, so they have to train hard to ensure their punches hurt. They train nonstop by repeatedly punching rocks until they are exhausted.

entry: POKENAME扎根在其他植物附近，吸收土中的毒素为食，帮助周围植物生长。但在未受污染的地区，它可能被迫直接吸取其他植物的能量维生。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME roots itself near other plants and absorbs any toxins in the soil as sustenance, helping the nearby plants grow. However, in areas that are uncontaminated, POKENAME may be forced to sap energy from the other plants directly to survive.

entry: POKENAME住在下水道或受污染的水域，以废物和污染物为食。它能从壳里排出恶臭烟气，还会朝敌人打嗝，吐出有毒泡泡。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME live in sewers or polluted waters, feeding on waste and pollutants. They can expel fumes with a horrid odor from their shells and they belch poisonous bubbles at foes.

entry: 它黏糊糊的全身各处都能伸出藤蔓，缠住熊宝宝、喵喵等猎物，再拖进大张的嘴里。
author: .izik
source: Vines extend from all over its slimy body to ensnare prey like Teddiursa and Meowth. Once captured, it pulls them into its gaping mouth.

entry: POKENAME虽因水体污染过重而在海中形成，却会用黏稠的污泥手臂攀爬海岸峭壁，最终登上陆地。
author: foolish_weasel
source: While formed in the sea from excess water pollution, POKENAME will climb up coastal cliffsides with their sticky sludgy arms, eventually emerging onto land.

entry: POKENAME喜欢用身体蹭附近的各种东西，从垃圾堆到石墙、光滑墙面都不放过。它们会吸收物质，或磨损岩石核心，因此每只的大小形状都可能不同。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME prefers to rub its body on anything nearby, from piles of trash to stony or slick walls. As a result, each POKENAME may differ in size and shape as they absorb matter or sand down their rocky core.

entry: POKENAME蹄边会产生黏液，因此无法疾驰。训练家能将黏液清除，捐给工厂，制成贴纸或胶带的黏合剂。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME is unable to gallop because of the slime it produces near its hooves. Trainers can remove this substance to donate to factories, which turns the slime into adhesive for stickers or tape.

entry: 它们年纪越大，污泥般的身体颜色越浓，臭味也越重。大多生活在下水道里，以垃圾为食，无意间也帮忙处理了废物。
author: infinex21
source: Their sludge-like bodies become a richer color and exude a fouler stench the older they grow. They live in sewers most often, inadvertently helping with waste disposal as they feed on refuse.

entry: POKENAME以有毒的碱性液体涂身，抵御捕食者。不过，它会避开磁性附肢，以免干扰磁性。
author: frokachu
source: POKENAME coat their bodies in a toxic, alkaline fluid to ward off predators. They keep this fluid away from their magnetic appendages, however, so that their magnetic properties aren't disturbed.

entry: 据说POKENAME由工厂里的废金属形成。它以螺丝和电线为食，常把设备弄坏。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: POKENAME is said to form from discarded metal in factories. It feeds on screws and wires, often wrecking tech.

entry: POKENAME在有毒废料周围游动，吞食其中的化学物质。由于生活环境特殊，通常没什么竞争对手。
author: camtft
source: POKENAME swim around toxic waste as they consume the chemicals laid within. Due to their unusual living conditions, they generally have little competition.

entry: POKENAME常生活在有毒或遭废弃的环境，其他宝可梦大多不肯进入。若无人控制，它们能占据整片地区。在野外，它们常被误认为未融合的同类。
author: ruben2309295
source: POKENAME are commonly found in toxic or abandoned environments where most Pokémon refuse to enter. If left unchecked, POKENAME can take over whole areas. When out in the wild, POKENAME are often mistaken for their unfused counterparts.

entry: 据说野生POKENAME是死于污染区的人类亡灵，被困在污泥里。它们似乎不甘于这样的处境，对人类心怀嫉妒。
author: notmax22
source: It is said that wild POKENAME are spirits of people who died in polluted areas, trapped in sludge. These POKENAME do not seem content with their predicament and are jealous of humans.

entry: 这些宝可梦个头很大，喜欢温暖潮湿的地方，尤其是长着蘑菇和苔藓的地方。污泥般的身体毒性极强，能先将大多数食物化成液体，再吃下。
author: infinex21
source: These Pokémon prefer to live in warm and humid locales, especially those where mushrooms and moss grow. Their sludge-like bodies are so toxic they can liquify most food before consuming it.

entry: POKENAME头上的头骨不断分泌恶臭污泥。它有时会想擦掉，可新的污泥总会继续冒出来。
author: bandedbodypress
source: The skull on its head constantly secretes a foul-smelling sludge. POKENAME may try to wipe it off, but it is always replaced.

entry: POKENAME的双脚由有毒污泥构成，每走一步都会溶化脚下的地面。踢击时，它还会将污泥甩向对手，留下带有剧毒的严重灼伤。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME's feet are composed of a toxic sludge; each step they take melts the ground beneath them. These Pokémon fling this sludge at opponents as they kick, capable of leaving serious, highly toxic burns.

entry: POKENAME装成一堆绿色黏液，堂而皇之地藏身，开始捕猎才变成人形。足够靠近猎物时，它就会不顾一切地挥抓、出拳。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME hide in plain sight as a pile of green goop, forming into a humanoid shape when they begin hunting. When close enough to prey, POKENAME will swipe and punch recklessly.

entry: 它用长舌从城市垃圾场卷起一团团垃圾，开心地吃下。舌头表面覆着具有保护作用的黏液。
author: .izik
source: It uses its long tongue to lift clumps of refuse from city dumps, consuming them with glee. The tongue is coated in a protective slime.

entry: POKENAME能在长舌上涂满强酸性唾液，连铁都能溶化。它必须生活在潮湿肮脏的环境中，因此常在城市下水道里滋生。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME can coat its long tongue with a highly acidic saliva capable of melting even iron. Since it requires humid and dirty environments to survive, it often infests city sewers.

entry: 刺鼻烟气和有毒污泥围着中央核心，身体散发着类似悠闲薰香的有害气味。周围生物会因此恶心，战斗中也就更难击中它们。
author: quackquackattack
source: Pungent fumes and toxic sludge wrap around a central core, their bodies releasing a noxious scent that resembles Lax Incense. They create a feeling of nausea in creatures around them, making them harder to hit in a battle.

entry: POKENAME把幼崽含在嘴里，合上双颚，就能保护它免受任何攻击。幼崽会产生黏液固定身体，吃下POKENAME吞进的有毒废料。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME carries its offspring in its mouth and can close its jaws to protect it from any attack. The smaller Pokémon produces sticky slime to hold itself in place and will feed on any toxic waste POKENAME eats.

entry: POKENAME的舞姿会迫使看见的对象靠近，在它有毒的环境中一同起舞。被迷住的对象会一直跳，直到身体被周围的毒素击垮。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's dancing movements compel those who see them to draw closer and dance along with it in its toxic environment. Those under its thrall will dance until their bodies succumb to the poisons around them.

entry: POKENAME的身体由黏稠恶臭的污泥构成，走动时一团团往下滴。只要一滴，就足以使500000加仑的纯净水无法饮用。
author: fancyskunk
source: Its body is comprised of a viscous, foul-smelling sludge that drips off in globs as it walks. One droplet of sludge from a POKENAME is enough to render 500,000 gallons of pristine water undrinkable.

entry: POKENAME吞食电脑病毒，毒性会越来越强。它占据电脑系统时，接口还会渗出具有腐蚀性的粉红色软泥。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME grows more toxic as it consumes digital viruses. While inhabiting a system, corrosive pink ooze seeps from its ports.

entry: 帮助POKENAME继续进化的茧并不结实，但它能产生大量气味刺鼻、毒性猛烈的污物，几乎没有谁敢冒险靠近。
author: sk372
source: The cocoon helping POKENAME evolve further is not very sturdy, but its body generates so much incredibly pungent and toxic muck that few dare risk approaching it.

entry: POKENAME很爱腐烂水果的味道，会钻进垃圾箱寻找下一餐。有人认为，史前葡萄糖稀缺，使它养成了寻找一切甜食的习惯。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME love taste of rotten fruit, digging into dumpsters to find their next meal. This is behavior is thought to originate from the fact that glucose was scarce in prehistoric times, leading to this desire to seek out anything sweet.

entry: 这种懒惰、有毒的宝可梦一生大半都在吃和睡。它休息过的地方会变成有毒荒地，硕大的肚腹则为其他毒属性宝可梦提供庇护。
author: motion_09
source: This lazy, toxic Pokémon spends most of its life eating or sleeping. Wherever it rests becomes a poisonous wasteland, and its vast belly shelters other Poison-type Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME被视为环境崩溃的先兆，出现时会带来令人窒息的烟雾和酸雨。若在一处逗留太久，就会对自然环境造成广泛破坏。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are viewed as heralds of environmental collapse, their presence resulting in oppressive smogs and acidic rains. When POKENAME linger in an area for too long, they cause extensive damage to the natural environment.

entry: POKENAME十分护人。传说若它愿意用覆满黏液的翅膀护住你，即使最致命的毒素也无法伤你分毫。
author: lordenzo
source: POKENAME is a highly protective Pokémon. Legends say that if a POKENAME chooses to shield you with its slime-coated wings, even the deadliest toxins cannot harm you.

entry: POKENAME能隐身，但掉落的污泥无法隐形，仍会留下痕迹。雄心勃勃的训练家会沿着痕迹追踪，试图找到它。
author: hiroshima0042_23263
source: POKENAME has the ability to turn invisible but the sludge that falls off it does not, which leaves a trail. Ambitious Trainers try to follow these trails to attempt to find POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME只出现在污染严重、已无法挽回的环境。它的花散发着恶臭，像腐败物的气味。
author: greaterjagras
source: POKENAME only appear in heavily polluted environments that are too far gone to be restored. Their flowers produce a foul, rancid odor similar to the scent of decay.

entry: POKENAME身上的污泥很重，因此难以长距离飞行。覆在身上的黏液毒性极强，能驱退捕食者，让它安心栖息。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME has trouble flying long distances due to the weight of the sludge along its body. The slime covering its body is highly poisonous, repelling predators and allowing it to roost safely.

entry: POKENAME住在污染严重的河流里。它会跃出水面，扑向陆上的猎物，用污泥般的身体闷住对方，再拖回水中。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME inhabits rivers that have been contaminated heavily by pollution. It leaps from the water to pounce onto prey on land, smothering them with its sludgy body before dragging them back into the water.

entry: POKENAME甩出后腿，将其拉伸成网，尽可能收集食物，喂进背上的嘴。吃饱后，它将这些嘴收回体内，沿着污泥痕迹滑入夜色。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME cast out their hind legs to stretch them out into nets, collecting whatever they can to feed into the mouths on their backs. Once full, they collapse these mouths back into their bodies and slide away into the night on a trail of sludge.

entry: POKENAME背上的晶体是浓缩毒素形成的尖刺，会断在敌人的伤口中，使其慢慢衰弱。它偏爱捕猎鸟类宝可梦，用结实的丝在树间织成耐用的网作陷阱。
author: chibitales
source: The crystals on POKENAME's back are spikes made of concentrated poison that break off in wounds inflicted on the foe, slowly weakening them. POKENAME prefer to prey on bird Pokémon, using their strong silk to spin durable webs between trees as traps.

entry: POKENAME羽毛上的紫色黏液腐蚀性极强。尽管如此，它仍能轻松飞行，还会借这层保护性黏液抵挡潜在威胁。
author: .izik
source: The purple slime covering POKENAME's feathers is extremely corrosive. Despite this, it can still fly with ease, using the protective slime to shield itself from potential threats.

entry: POKENAME游动时会释放毒素，污染水体。毒素又能孕育出臭鱼，待臭鱼进化，便再次重复这个循环。
author: dodoowner_
source: When POKENAME swims around, it emits a toxin that pollutes the water. These toxins can create Grichou, which then evolve to repeat the cycle.

entry: POKENAME飞行时，身上的毒液会一滴滴落到地面。即使立即清理，沾到黏液的地方仍会焦黑荒芜多年。
author: sk372
source: While in flight, POKENAME drips toxic droplets from its body down to the ground. Even if immediately cleaned up, the spots its goop touched become black and barren for years afterward.

entry: POKENAME沉重的污泥身体拖累了飞行速度和灵活性。它会短暂飞到猎物上方，从翅膀滴下沉重的毒泥团，让目标中毒。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's heavy sludge body hampers its aerial speed and mobility. It takes to the air in short bursts to fly over prey and drop weighty poisonous blobs from its wings to poison its target.

entry: 它飞过城市街道，寻找丢弃的报纸和罐子。只要看见垃圾离开某人的手，就会立刻俯冲下去捡走。
author: .izik
source: It flies through city streets searching for discarded newspapers and cans. The moment it sees trash leave someone's hand, it swoops down to collect it.

entry: POKENAME柔软易变的身体能钻进家中任何狭窄空间，是很麻烦的害兽。它在墙内四处啃咬，破坏结构，咬过的地方还会久久留着刺鼻气味。
author: sk372
source: A troublesome pest due to its malleable body allowing it to infiltrate any tight space in a home, POKENAME gnaws around inside walls, weakening structures and leaving a pungent aroma lingering anywhere it nibbles.

entry: POKENAME喜欢站在花田里晒太阳，但有毒的身体很快就会使周围植物枯萎。这也让它变得郁郁寡欢。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME loves to stand among flowers in fields and soak up the sunlight, but its toxic body quickly causes the plant life around it to wilt. This has given it a very sullen personality as a result.

entry: POKENAME只有在寒冷环境中才能完全成形。气温上升迫使它们迁移，以前从未见过它们的城市，如今也开始出现。它们携带当地动物未曾适应的新疾病，威胁着当地生态。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME only fully forms in cold environments. Cities that never used to see POKENAME are now beginning to, as rising temperatures displace them. They carry new diseases local fauna are not accustomed to, threatening local ecosystems.

entry: POKENAME头脑迟钝，浑身带毒，漫不经心的性情常使周围的对象中毒。它们漫无目的地游荡，聚到有毒地区，浑然不知沿途留下多少灾祸。
author: jonclyd
source: POKENAME are dim-witted, toxin-coated creatures whose careless nature often poisons those around them. They wander aimlessly and flock to toxic areas, blissfully unaware of the havoc they leave in their wake.

entry: 背上的植物常年接触它有毒的身体，因此能抵抗大多数毒素和污染物。身体虽然会腐蚀碰到的植物，经过的土地却会变得格外肥沃。
author: infinex21
source: The plants growing atop its back are resistant to most toxins and pollutants due to being exposed to its own toxic body all the time. Though its body will corrode any plants it touches, the ground is left remarkably fertile in its wake.

entry: POKENAME生活在受辐射的环境，寻找危险废料吸收，试图恢复土地。遇见不知情的训练家，它还会警告前方的危险。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME reside within radiated environments, searching for hazardous waste to absorb in an attempt to restore the land. They will warn unknowing Trainers of the danger that lies ahead.

entry: POKENAME出现就意味着附近有剧毒物质。它本身也带有中等程度的放射性，因此最好保持距离。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's presence signifies that the surrounding area possesses some highly toxic material. POKENAME itself is also moderately radioactive, so keeping one's distance is greatly advised.

entry: POKENAME通常生活在热带，遇到严寒往往会将自己关进壳里。即使用X射线检查，也无法确定它是否有内脏。
author: bobosmith01
source: As it usually lives in tropical areas, POKENAME tends to close itself up into its shell when in freezing conditions. X-rays have been ineffective at determining whether POKENAME has any internal organs or not.

entry: 它滑翔掠过垃圾填埋场，寻找腐烂的家具安家。那些气味丝毫困扰不了它。
author: .izik
source: It glides over landfills in search of rotting furniture to make its home. The smell does not bother it in the slightest.

entry: 据说POKENAME来自遥远的宇宙，似乎全然不在乎哺乳动物以外的生命。碰到它的有毒污泥，毛发就会不受控制地生长。
author: mistymagius
source: Said to have come from the far reaches of space, POKENAME seems to have no regard for non-mammalian lifeforms. Coming into contact with its toxic sludge will cause uncontrollable hair growth.

entry: 工业废料泄漏后，常能见到POKENAME吃剩下的有毒污泥。调查是哪家公司造成泄漏时，常要将它的壳取样，送到实验室进行鉴证分析。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME can be found following industrial waste spills, feeding on the toxic sludge that is left behind. Investigative work to determine which company is responsible often involves taking pieces of POKENAME shells to the lab for forensic analysis.

entry: 工业废料泄漏后，常能见到POKENAME吃剩下的有毒污泥。调查是哪家公司造成泄漏时，常要将它的壳取样，送到实验室进行鉴证分析。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME can be found following industrial waste spills, feeding on the toxic sludge that is left behind. Investigative work to determine which company is responsible often involves taking pieces of POKENAME shells to the lab for forensic analysis.

entry: POKENAME生性恶毒，见到什么都想下毒。有些事件记录显示，它曾倒出背上桶里的东西，毒害了整套供水。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME are malicious in nature, seeking to poison whatever they can get to. Some incidents report POKENAME poisoning entire water supplies by dumping the contents of the barrels on their backs.

entry: 几个世纪以来，人们一直将这种宝可梦的排泄物用来美容。但博士们发现，它其实会加速皮肤老化，对身体造成长远伤害。
author: big_clanker
source: People have used this Pokémon's excretion as a beautifying agent for centuries. However, professors have found that it actually ages the skin at a rapid rate, causing long-term damage to the body.

entry: 节日期间，POKENAME会巡视排污系统，检查损坏与失修之处。它用条带状黏垢堵住漏口，或以会爆炸的垃圾炸开堵塞。
author: ozydamians
source: During the holidays, POKENAME inspects the sewage system for damage and neglect. It patches up leaks with ribbons of sticky grime, or clears blockages with explosive garbage.

entry: POKENAME的身体熔融而有毒，没有防护装备就触碰十分危险。它能利用自身温度喷出有毒烟气，造成永不愈合的灼伤。
author: npshi
source: POKENAME have molten, toxic bodies that are dangerous to touch without protective gear. POKENAME are able to use their own body temperature to spew noxious fumes that leave burns that never heal.

entry: POKENAME不断产生构成身体的废物。为免身体变得过于庞大、行动迟缓，它花大量时间高速奔跑，将这些废物甩掉、排出。
author: heal_fire
source: POKENAME is constantly producing waste that composes its body. To avoid getting massive and too slow, it spends a lot of time running at very high speed to fling and eliminate this waste.

entry: POKENAME的身体虽呈半流体状，却能站在水面而不变形。它奔走世界各地，寻找受污染的水源，将污染物吸入体内，只留下纯净的水。
author: chibitales
source: Despite the semifluid nature of POKENAME's body, it can stand on the surface of water without deforming. It dashes around the world looking for polluted water sources, absorbing the pollution into its body and leaving pure water behind.

entry: POKENAME的污泥带有很强的电荷，因此黏稠、难以去除。污泥具有腐蚀性，碰到后若不及时处理，可能造成严重的化学灼伤。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME sludge carries a potent electrical charge that makes it sticky and difficult to get off. The sludge is caustic to the touch and can cause serious chemical burns if not quickly treated.

entry: POKENAME看着像小卡比兽，其实只是变成了它的模样，借此欺骗想照顾自己的人。
author: rooboid
source: Though it resembles the body of a Munchlax, POKENAME has merely morphed to imitate its form, enabling it to deceive those who attempt to care for it.

entry: POKENAME身上的腐臭污泥，连构成身体的岩石都能腐蚀。它会通过专门的孔洞吸收石块和砾石，修补被腐蚀的地方。
author: adam_dnh
source: The putrid sludge covering POKENAME is strong enough to corrode the rocks that make up its body. It absorbs stones and pebbles through specialized holes in order to repair the corroded areas.

entry: POKENAME能分泌极强的软泥，接触到任何活体组织，都会随着时间慢慢将其腐蚀。
author: camtft
source: POKENAME is able to secrete ooze so potent it slowly eats through any living mass it comes into contact with over time.

entry: POKENAME喜欢温暖潮湿的环境，常化作一摊液体伏在丛林中。任何踩进去的东西都会被吞掉。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: Preferring a warm and humid environment, POKENAME will sit as a puddle in the jungle. Anything that steps into this puddle will be consumed.

entry: POKENAME闻起来像污泥和污水，在垃圾填埋场间流动，拖出一道道有毒渗滤液。它外表虽可怖，爬行时却能过滤土中的污染物。
author: jaminmcready
source: Smelling of sludge and runoff, POKENAME oozes through landfills trailing ribbons of toxic leachate. Despite its grotesque appearance, it filters pollutants from the soil as it crawls.

entry: 这只残忍的宝可梦爱把对手埋进毒泥里。相传，下半身那张嘴会低声诉说你的未来。
author: altius
source: This cruel Pokémon likes to bury its opponents under poisonous mud. According to legend, the mouth on its lower body can whisper your future.

entry: 这种宝可梦会用超能力操纵大量污泥。不同于其他臭臭泥变种，它带着淡淡的棉花糖香；研究者至今没能弄清原因。
author: cinnamoone_redfield
source: This Pokémon is commonly known to manipulate large amounts of sludge using its psychic power. Unlike other variants of Muk, this Pokémon smells faintly of cotton candy; researchers have been unable to determine the reason for this.

entry: POKENAME用超能力控制裹住身体的黏液，既能使其硬化为护层，也能分出一部分，赋予生命，化作听命于自己的仆从。
author: wormspawn
source: POKENAME uses its psychic powers to control the ooze that envelops its body. It can harden this ooze into a protective coating or even animate some of it into a separate minion to do its bidding.

entry: POKENAME吞食有机垃圾后，全身会长满霉菌，常连眼睛都被盖住。尽管看不见，它们仍能有效战斗。身上的霉菌量大时会对人类产生毒害。
author: chibitales
source: As POKENAME consume organic garbage, mold grows over their entire body and often covers their eyes. Despite being blind, they are able to battle effectively. The mold that grows is toxic to humans in large quantities.

entry: 据说，有毒污水流到闹鬼的石头上，形成了POKENAME这个新生命。它散发肉眼可见的能量，使周围的对象严重中毒。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is said to be the result of toxic runoff spilling onto a haunted stone and forming a new entity. POKENAME radiates a visible energy from itself that causes intense poisoning in those around it.

entry: POKENAME虽然外形如此，天性却极为友善。可惜，回抱它并不是个好主意。
author: rooboid
source: Despite its appearance, POKENAME is incredibly friendly by nature. Sadly, returning POKENAME's hugs is ill-advised.

entry: POKENAME能以快得惊人的速度挥爪，但裹住下半身的污泥拖慢了它的移动。
author: rooboid
source: While it is capable of swiftly clawing at its foes at breakneck speed, the sludge engrossing the lower half of POKENAME hinders its movement speed.

entry: POKENAME力量强横，外貌可怖，令人生畏。黏稠的皮肤能化成任何形状，无论是伸出的援手，还是剃刀般锋利的刃。
author: rooboid
source: Feared for its relentless power and ghastly looks, POKENAME can morph its viscous skin into any shape, be that a helping hand or a razor-sharp blade.

entry: POKENAME会占据垃圾箱，偶尔撕开垃圾袋，将污物撒得到处都是。这常让它与破破袋发生冲突，因为破破袋似乎将垃圾袋视为同胞。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME have been known to occupy dumpsters, occasionally tearing open trash bags to spread filth. The destruction of trash bags often puts POKENAME into conflict with Trubbish, who seem to view the bags as brethren.

entry: POKENAME在污染较重的海域漂游，大嘴散发着恶臭。不幸游进嘴里，或被污泥身体黏住的东西，都会慢慢被吸收进去。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME floats around more polluted sections of the ocean, its wide mouth emanating a foul odor. Anything unfortunate enough to swim into its mouth or get caught on its sludgy body will be absorbed into it slowly over time.

entry: POKENAME起初常因自己的速度和天赋而傲慢，但与训练家及宝可梦伙伴的羁绊，能唤醒内心深处的感情与忠诚。热门竞速赛事上常能见到它。
author: grilled7up
source: Although arrogant about its speed and talent at first, the bond with not just its Trainer but also its fellow Pokémon can awaken deep emotion and loyalty within it. POKENAME is often found as part of popular racing circuits.

entry: POKENAME生活在极地，缓缓铺开有毒软泥，捕猎鱼类宝可梦。它外露的骨头比看起来锋利得多，只有当什么威胁到它的尊严或群体时，才会用上。
author: npshi
source: POKENAME are found living in polar environments, slowly spreading their poisonous ooze to hunt for fish Pokémon. The exposed bones of POKENAME are deceptively sharp, which they only use on anything that threatens either their pride or their colony.

entry: POKENAME擅长收集、处理带磁性的重金属，常是危险废料清理人员和冶炼厂工人的伙伴。体内的有毒金属化合物会析出，形成有价值的金属锭。
author: vic1312
source: Well-suited for gathering and processing magnetic heavy metals, POKENAME are often the partner Pokémon of hazardous waste cleanup professionals and refinery workers. The toxic metallic compounds precipitate within their bodies into valuable ingots.

entry: POKENAME无定形的身体能变成各种武器。它常变成双节棍或利爪，选形态很有创意，战术却很简单：不断扑向目标，直到对方被有毒污泥击垮。
author: .fedoraman
source: POKENAME uses its amorphous form to take the shape of any weapon. While creative in its choice of form, regularly morphing into nunchucks or claws, its strategy remains simple: throwing itself at targets until they succumb to its noxious sludge.

entry: POKENAME每挥动双刃，都会甩出黏稠毒液。双刃其实是手，因此它会在敌人攻来时抓住对方，将臭毒渗进其体内，以此防御。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME flings goopy toxins each time it swings its two blades. As its blades are actually hands, it employs the defensive strategy of grabbing the foe when they try to attack and seeping smelly poisons into their body.

entry: POKENAME柔韧易变的双臂能拉伸，将身体以惊人速度向前弹出。它借此使出破坏力极强的有毒劈斩，往往会致命。
author: ragingarthritis
source: POKENAME's malleable arms allow it to stretch and propel itself forward at remarkable speed. It utilizes this to deliver devastating toxic cuts and slashes that often prove to be fatal.

entry: POKENAME的岩石外骨骼难以维持污泥身体的形状。常能见到它将流失的黏液捧回体内。
author: dylonk25
source: POKENAME's rocky exoskeleton struggles to give its sludgy body form. It can often be seen scooping lost slime back into itself.

entry: 近年垃圾填埋场会请POKENAME清理垃圾，任何腐烂物或污染物都吃。
author: melodydelune
source: POKENAME has been employed in recent years by landfills to clean up the garbage; they will eat anything that has rotted or is a pollutant.

entry: POKENAME的黏稠流体身体难以定形，毒泥会溶穿大多数用来支撑身体的材料。它们便用死去已久的宝可梦骨架作支架，操纵骨头移动。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have a viscous fluid body that struggles to hold form, the toxicity of their sludge melting through most materials they use for structure. They use the skeletons of long-dead Pokémon as scaffolding, manipulating the bones to move around.

entry: POKENAME在深海中流动，滴落有毒污泥，留下一道具有生物荧光的废物痕迹。它的身体不断变形，所游过的海水也翻涌着病态的绿光。
author: segmoph
source: POKENAME oozes through the deep sea, dripping with toxic sludge and leaving a glowing trail of bioluminescent waste. Its body constantly shifts, and the ocean around it churns with a sickly green glow wherever it swims.

entry: POKENAME喜怒无常，令许多人心生戒备。它似乎只容忍自己的训练家，对其他谁都会发起攻击。博士们推测，这种性情源于某次突变。
author: snapsn
source: POKENAME's erratic personality has caused many to be wary of it. It is seemingly only tolerant of its Trainer and will lash out at anyone else. Professors theorize this demeanor is due to a mutation.

entry: 有人说，放射性物质洒到实验机器上，便产生了POKENAME。它从炮管射出的污泥毒性致命，几分钟内就能腐蚀、毁坏机器。
author: sk372
source: Some say POKENAME came about when radioactive materials spilled across experimental machinery. The muck it spills from its cannon is lethally toxic and can corrode and degrade machines in minutes.

entry: POKENAME的黏稠流体身体难以定形，毒泥会溶穿大多数用来支撑身体的材料。它们便用死去已久的宝可梦骨架作支架，操纵骨头移动。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have a viscous fluid body that struggles to hold form, the toxicity of their sludge melting through most materials they use for structure. They use the skeletons of long-dead Pokémon as scaffolding, manipulating the bones to move around.

entry: POKENAME群体出现在有毒物质泄漏的现场，争相吞食工业废料中的毒素，融入自己的身体。它们会凶狠地阻止环境清理，袭击清理人员。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME populations emerge at the sites of toxic spills, competing to consume the toxins from the industrial waste and incorporating them into their body. They aggressively resist attempts to clean up the environment, attacking cleanup crews.

entry: POKENAME群体出现在有毒物质泄漏的现场，争相吞食工业废料中的毒素。海滩上的泄漏会熔化沙子，使它们的身体呈现多种鲜艳颜色。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME populations emerge at the sites of toxic spills, competing to consume the toxins from the industrial waste. Beach spills melt sand and cause the bodies of POKENAME to take on multiple vivid colours.

entry: 这种稀有宝可梦最常见于深邃的峡谷。有人认为，几条登山步道之所以没有垃圾，是因为POKENAME会在月夜大吃人们留下的废物。
author: bobosmith01
source: It is a rare Pokémon most commonly found in deep canyons. It is thought that several hiking trails are kept clean from litter thanks to POKENAME feasting on leftover garbage during moonlit nights.

entry: POKENAME身上滴落五颜六色的毒液。人们相信每种颜色的毒效都不同，但可能出现的颜色实在太多，还需进一步研究。
author: hophoppip
source: Multicolored toxins drip from POKENAME's body. It's believed that each color has a different toxic effect, but the number of possible colors is extensive, so further research is needed.

entry: 围绕POKENAME的物质已变得腐蚀性极强。然而，即使身体更加不稳定，它的精神力量仍一如既往地强大。
author: evilgammon
source: The substance surrounding POKENAME has developed to become highly corrosive. However, its psychic presence is still just as strong, even with its more unstable body.

entry: POKENAME在大型下水道的管道间潜行，寻找能整只吞下的猎物。食物匮乏时，它会经由马桶进入建筑。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME slinks through pipes in large sewer systems, looking for prey it can swallow whole. When food is scarce, it will enter buildings through their toilets.

entry: 吸收了太多污染物，让POKENAME的身体结构严重失衡。只有尾巴还保持原样。
author: houndrys.
source: POKENAME has absorbed so much contamination that its body suffers from disproportionate anatomy. Only its tails remain unchanged.

entry: POKENAME用覆着毒黏液的内脏击晕大型捕食者，再沿海底逃走。逃跑时，它会迅速收回内脏，免得挂住什么或破坏环境。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its poisonous slime-covered innards to stun larger predators before it flees along the sea floor.  It quickly retracts its innards as it runs, wanting to avoid getting caught on anything or damaging the environment.

entry: POKENAME常出没于废物处理设施，用产生的污泥塑造亲切的外表。但污泥常会滑落，变成凶恶的表情，加上臭味，吓跑了本来可能交上的朋友。
author: dualblades1147
source: POKENAME is a common sight in waste facilities, using the sludge created to make an approachable appearance. However, the sludge often slides down into a menacing expression. This, combined with the smell, scares away any would-be friends.

entry: POKENAME唱歌时，有毒的身体会使呼吸带毒，口中冒出肉眼可见的薄雾。吸入者会昏倒，错过它的表演，让它十分难过。
author: sk372
source: When POKENAME sings, its toxic body causes its breath to be poisonous, with a visible haze coming from its mouth while it performs. This poison causes those who inhale it to pass out and miss POKENAME's performance, upsetting it.

entry: 它住在电子工厂附近，大吃废弃或故障的电池。覆满黏液的身体因电力过剩而嗡嗡作响。
author: .izik
source: It lives near electronic factories, feasting on discarded or malfunctioning batteries. Its slime-covered body hums with excess electricity.

entry: 人们认为，POKENAME最早来自会产生污染的机器残骸。它的软泥腐蚀性极强，几滴就能在1小时内将一台大型电脑腐蚀殆尽。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is believed to have first come from broken parts of pollution-producing machinery. Its ooze is highly corrosive; a few drops will burn down a large computer to nothing within an hour.

entry: 它的身体大多由散发恶臭的有毒物质构成，绝大多数生物碰到都很危险。长在身上的花却能抵抗许多毒物，医学专家正在研究。
author: infinex21
source: Most of its body is made of a toxic material that emits a horrid odor and is very dangerous for most living things to come into contact with. The flower growing from it is resistant to many toxins and poisons, and is being studied by medical experts.

entry: 火焰在它的毒泥身体内炙烤，使身体不停冒泡、沸腾。它以废物为食，废物在体内烧掉时，还会打嗝吐出毒烟。
author: infinex21
source: Flames broil within its body of toxic sludge, causing its own body to bubble and boil. It feeds on waste and belches toxic smoke as the waste burns away inside.

entry: POKENAME用精神力量将碎屑和污染物托起，送入体内吃掉。吸收的有毒物质会增强保护它的薄膜。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its psychic abilities to lift debris and pollution into its body to eat them. It absorbs the toxic material to strengthen the membrane that protects it.

entry: 新生的POKENAME难以维持固定形态，便制造没有意识的飞行个体，将附近的东西送入张开的嘴中。这些个体靠耳朵循着咕噜声找到嘴，重新融入本体。
author: pjporwoll
source: A new POKENAME struggles maintaining a consistent form, so it creates mindless flying drones to deliver anything nearby into its waiting maws. The drones use their ears to return to the gurgling mouths, where they reabsorb into the main body.

entry: POKENAME的咬合力较弱，但唾液腐蚀性极强，几分钟内就能溶解大多数材料。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME's bite is relatively weak. However, its saliva is highly corrosive and can dissolve most materials within minutes.

entry: POKENAME每次看见面具，都会流下黏稠的污泥泪。它哭得太多，面具已被厚厚的污泥盖得认不出来，但关于面具的记忆仍会让它落泪。
author: drcew
source: POKENAME cries viscous sludge every time it looks at its mask. It has cried so much that the mask is unrecognizable due to the thick layer of sludge. The memory of the mask still brings POKENAME to tears.

entry: POKENAME喜欢泥泞地或沼泽，黏软的身体在那里更容易融入周围环境。坚硬的獠牙挥起来力量十足，哪怕只擦伤，也会造成严重中毒。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME prefers to live in muddy or swampy areas where its gooey body can more easily soak into its surroundings. Its tusks are rigid and pack a potent punch when swung, and just a scrape will cause a nasty case of poisoning.

entry: 进化后，POKENAME长出果实般的突起，引诱猎物。这些突起与黏合身体的黏液一样有毒。
author: tad
source: Upon evolving, POKENAME develops fruit-like protrusions to attract prey. These protrusions are just as toxic as the goo holding its body together.

entry: POKENAME捕猎时会将有毒污泥身体摊平、藏好，装成一堆旧骨头。靠得太近的东西就会被吸进黏软身体，成为它的养分。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME hunts by flattening and obscuring the toxic sludge of its body and pretending to be nothing more than old bones. Anything that gets too close gets sucked into its gooey body and absorbed for sustenance.

entry: POKENAME虽然很臭，身上的叶子却是极有用的药材。有些人甚至将它养在堆肥箱里，一边喂厨余，一边修剪叶子。
author: pjporwoll
source: Despite smelling horrible, the leaves growing from POKENAME are exceptionally useful in medicines. Some people even keep them in composting bins, feeding POKENAME scraps while trimming its leaves.

entry: POKENAME按着令人着迷、又使人晕眩的节奏蹦跳。表演摇摇晃晃，还常从翅膀喷出喷泉般的虹彩黏液，增添效果。
author: metcassette
source: POKENAME bounce and hop in hypnotic and dizzying rhythm. Their unsteady performances are often accentuated by spewing a fountain of iridescent goo from their wings.

entry: 它在污水排放口附近游动。足以溶解大多数宝可梦的危险化学物质，却能让POKENAME活得很好。
author: .izik
source: It swims near sewage runoff locations. POKENAME thrives in hazardous chemicals that would dissolve most Pokémon.

entry: 吃下腐臭垃圾后，它头上的叶子会散发宜人的香气。有人说，这香味能替附近的同伴遮盖臭味。
author: .izik
source: After eating putrid trash, the leaves on its head release a pleasant aroma. Some say this scent helps mask the stench for nearby allies.

entry: 黏在它身上的黏液毒性极强、黏性十足，它常将其吐向敌人。展翅时，翅膀间的黏液膜常会断开滴落，随即又重新形成。
author: infinex21
source: The mucus clinging to its body is incredibly toxic and sticky, which it will often spit at its foes. When it spreads its wings, the mucus webbing along them will often snap and drip free, then quickly reform.

entry: POKENAME出没于废弃垃圾场，偶尔也在墓地出现，会收集骨头和腐烂有机物，添进身体。它会向自认为有威胁的对象喷出剧毒气体，再使出震耳欲聋的刺耳声。
author: chibitales
source: Found in abandoned garbage dumps and rarely in graveyards, POKENAME collect bones and rotting organic material to add to their body. They spew a highly toxic gas at anything they perceive as a threat, following with a deafening Screech.

entry: 臭臭泥的有毒身体似乎扭曲了黏美龙原本温顺的性情。POKENAME会试图拥抱别人，用身体不断渗出的毒液将对方裹住，使其衰弱。
author: sk372
source: Muk's toxic body seems to have corrupted the normally-meek personality of Goodra. POKENAME seeks to embrace others with its body and coat them in the debilitating poison it constantly oozes.

entry: POKENAME身上的黑色污泥强得足以侵蚀身心。科学家尚不清楚污泥是什么，只推测它来自荒原般的究极空间。
author: loikthescreamo
source: The black sludge on POKENAME is strong enough to corrupt your body and soul. Scientists are unsure of what this sludge is, though, suggesting it is from a wasteland-esque Ultra Space.

entry: POKENAME最早发现于一艘运送有毒废料的沉船附近。它在水下轻轻一碰，就能让植物腐烂，再把腐烂的部分吃掉。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME was first discovered near a sunken ship that had been carrying toxic waste. It rots plants going underwater with a single touch before it consumes the rotted results.

entry: 它栖息的小池塘会逐渐变得酸性极强。很少有生物能在它的领地里长久存活。
author: .izik
source: Small ponds it inhabits become extremely acidic over time. Few creatures can survive long in its territory.

entry: POKENAME有时会从颈部尖刺产生暗色极光。极光虽然好看，却带有毒性，进入一定范围就会中毒。
author: sk372
source: At times, POKENAME will generate a dark-colored aurora from the spines along its neck. Though pleasant in appearance, the aurora is toxic and will poison those who get within a certain range.

entry: POKENAME的身体不断产生大量毒泥，用来承受攻击或投向敌人。它喜怒无常、性情暴烈，宝可梦和训练家都很怕它。
author: ragingarthritis
source: POKENAME's body continuously produces large amounts of toxic sludge, which it uses to absorb attacks or hurl at enemies. Its temperamental and violent attitude makes it feared amongst both Pokémon and Trainers alike.

entry: POKENAME曾被发现于污染严重水域的深处。它极不合群，会借携带的宝石施展精神力量，赶走一切靠得太近的对象。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has been spotted deep in the depths of waters troubled by heavy pollution. Extremely antisocial, it uses psychic powers from the gem it carries to repel anything that ventures too close to it.

entry: POKENAME住在下水道深处，沿墙散播孢子，分解污物，转化成幼崽的食物。几乎没有什么物质能在这些孢子下撑过几小时而不被分解。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME lives deep within sewers, spreading its spores along the walls to consume filth and convert it into food for its young. Few substances exist that its spores cannot break down within a few hours.

entry: POKENAME收集废金属片当作铠甲。据说，铠甲的好坏会影响它在同类中的地位，评价因素包括坚韧程度、敲击时共鸣有多响亮等。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME gathers pieces of scrap metal to serve as armor. Apparently, the quality of this armor, influenced by factors such as toughness and how loudly it resonates when struck, contributes to an individual POKENAME's status amongst the species.

entry: POKENAME用废金属搭出粗糙的骨架，撑起软泥身体，让自己更挺拔、更吓人。它住在垃圾遍布的海滩，大吃污染物，让身体长大。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME uses scraps of metal to fashion a crude skeletal structure that can support the ooze its body is made of into something more upright and menacing. It resides on trash-riddled beaches, where it feasts on the pollution to grow.

entry: POKENAME走动时会留下斑斑毒黏液。软泥渗入地下，吸走附近植物的生命，随后原地便会长出剧毒真菌。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's movement leaves behind a splotched trail of toxic slime. This ooze drains the life from any plants in the nearby area as it seeps into the ground, and highly poisonous fungi will later grow in its place.

entry: POKENAME很少用脚，更喜欢贴地滑行。污泥虽然臭得可怕，却很擅长治疗头虱。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME rarely uses its feet, preferring to slink along the ground. Despite the horrific smell, POKENAME's sludge is very good at treating head lice.

entry: POKENAME先化作一摊污泥，悄悄潜入对手巢穴，再显露真身战斗。难闻的气味虽妨碍隐蔽，却也能使敌人衰弱。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME stealthily infiltrates the nests of rivals by slinking along as a puddle of sludge before revealing its true form for combat. Its unpleasant odor inhibits some of its stealth, but debilitates foes.

entry: POKENAME先化作一摊污泥，悄悄潜入对手巢穴，再显露真身战斗。嵌在体内的结晶毒片是武器，能使对手麻痹或迷失方向。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME stealthily infiltrates the nests of rivals by slinking along as a puddle of sludge before revealing its true form for combat. The crystallized poison shards embedded in its body are used as paralytic or disorienting weapons.

entry: POKENAME身上覆着有毒的树果酱，吃下极其危险。不过，其他毒属性宝可梦很爱这种果酱的味道。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's body is coated in a poisonous berry jam that is incredibly dangerous to consume. However, other Poison-type Pokémon adore the taste of POKENAME's jam.

entry: 它们的身体具有腐蚀性，能高效分解大多数材料。坚韧的毒爪和足以熔化大多数金属的烈焰，都是它们自卫的手段。
author: infinex21
source: Their bodies are corrosive and can degrade most materials with great efficiency. They defend themselves with their tough, toxic claws and intense flames that could melt most metals.

entry: POKENAME在城市郊外挖地道，靠喷洒腐蚀性污泥自卫。洞穴浸满黏稠液体，碰到很危险。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME tunnels near city outskirts and defends itself by spraying corrosive sludge. Its burrows are soaked in a viscous fluid that is dangerous to touch.

entry: POKENAME耐心潜伏在泄漏的有毒物质和工业废料中，等猎物经过便扑上去。清理人员作业时，最好提防它可能发动的袭击。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME lie patiently in wait within toxic spills and industrial waste, waiting for prey to pass by so they can pounce on it. Clean-up crews are advised to be aware of the possibility of a POKENAME attack during their operations.

entry: POKENAME身上滴落的黏液，碰到就会引发偏头痛，让周围的人头晕恶心。奇怪的是，只要离开它附近，症状似乎就会自然消退。
author: .izik
source: The slime that drips off POKENAME's body causes migraines on contact, leaving those around it dizzy and nauseated. Strangely, the symptoms seem to naturally fade once people are out of POKENAME's vicinity.

entry: 它身上的黏液极其易燃，一点火星就可能点着。已有传言说，关都各地的发电厂很快将禁止它进入。
author: .izik
source: The slime covering its body is highly flammable and can combust at the slightest spark. There is talk of it soon being banned from entering power plants across Kanto.

entry: 传说POKENAME诞生于纵火火灾中燃烧的有毒废料。它用毒泥翅膀在城市间飞行，寻找新的污物供身体进食，碰到的一切都会被污染。
author: fiordaliso
source: It is rumored that POKENAME was born from toxic waste burned in arson fires. This Pokémon can travel from city to city, flying with its wings of poisonous sludge in search of new filth to feed its body. It contaminates anything it touches.

entry: POKENAME转动舌上的螺旋花纹，让猎物昏昏睡去，再用浓稠黏液裹住。污泥使猎物动弹不得，让它能轻松吃下。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME rotates the spiral on its tongue to lull prey to sleep before it covers them in thick, viscous slime. This sludge immobilizes prey, allowing POKENAME to consume them effortlessly.

entry: POKENAME用手拔起池塘附近的有毒植物，塞进嘴里，增强体表毒黏液的毒性，让自己更加危险。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its hands to uproot poisonous plant life near its pond. It shoves these plants into its mouth to strengthen the poison slime coating its body, making it even more dangerous.

entry: POKENAME喜欢和其他宝可梦摔跤，开开心心地扑向对手。但流体身体使它难以真正施展摔投，更多时候只是把自己泼在对方身上。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME enjoy wrestling with other Pokémon, gleefully flinging themselves at their opponents. Their fluid bodies make it difficult for them to actually perform a throw, and they more frequently splash themselves against the other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME由黏稠有毒的流体构成。一旦分心、停止使用念力，整个身体就会失去形状。
author: bradlybro199
source: POKENAME are made of a viscous and toxic fluid. If it ever loses focus and stops using its telekinetic abilities, its whole body will lose its form.

entry: POKENAME把勺子收进腐蚀性极强的软泥中，分解后吸收其中的矿物。战斗时，它会用精神力量让勺子高速旋转，将毒泥甩向对手。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME gather spoons along their highly corrosive ooze to break them down and absorb the minerals inside of them. In battle, they use their psychic powers to rapidly rotate the spoons to fling their toxic sludge at opponents.

entry: POKENAME的力量和耐力，仅次于自身的黏稠程度与黏附力。它会用身体裹住对手的一部分，将其擒住。
author: pastapockets
source: POKENAME's strength and endurance are second only to its viscosity and adhesion. POKENAME grapples its opponents by partially engulfing them with its body.

entry: POKENAME一心保护弱者，但正义观颇有偏差。只要认定谁不义，就会不依不饶地跟踪追猎；若只有暴力能伸张它的正义，也绝不退缩。
author: dyo_jonah
source: POKENAME dedicates itself to protecting the weak, but its sense of justice is rather flawed. It relentlessly stalks and hunts down whoever it deems unjust and is unafraid to use brute force if it's the only way to serve its justice.

entry: POKENAME一心保护弱者，但正义观颇有偏差。只要认定谁不义，就会不依不饶地跟踪追猎；若只有暴力能伸张它的正义，也绝不退缩。
author: dyo_jonah
source: POKENAME dedicates itself to protecting the weak, but its sense of justice is rather flawed. It relentlessly stalks and hunts down whoever it deems unjust and is unafraid to use brute force if it's the only way to serve its justice.

entry: POKENAME的力量惊人，臭味也惊人。两条手臂施展高超的武术，另外两条则向敌人投掷臭气弹和一团团污物。
author: pastapockets
source: POKENAME possesses incredible strength and an incredibly strong stench. Two of its arms are used for advanced martial arts, while the other two launch stink bombs and globs of filth at the enemy.

entry: POKENAME由熔化的废物和燃烧的化学物质形成，在受污染的天空中翱翔，寻找垃圾吃。碰到的东西都会被腐蚀，失去生机。
author: fiordaliso
source: Formed from melted waste and burning chemicals, POKENAME soars across polluted skies in search of refuse to consume. Everything it touches is left corroded and lifeless.

entry: 传说POKENAME诞生于纵火火灾中燃烧的有毒废料。它用毒泥翅膀在城市间飞行，寻找新的污物供身体进食，碰到的一切都会被污染。
author: fiordaliso
source: It is rumored that POKENAME was born from toxic waste burned in arson fires. This Pokémon can travel from city to city, flying with its wings of poisonous sludge in search of new filth to feed its body. It contaminates anything it touches.

entry: POKENAME的火焰太热、污泥太毒，常因意外毁掉村庄。这也让它觉得十分孤独。
author: lorddino.
source: POKENAME's flames are so hot, and sludge is so poisonous, that it's known for accidentally destroying villages. This leads to POKENAME feeling quite lonely.

entry: POKENAME散发的恶臭让大多数对象不敢靠近。可它们往往很友好，乐意吃掉废物、帮忙处理垃圾，因此有些人仍会将它们养在身边。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME exude horrid odors that deter most others from drawing too close to them. Despite this, they are often quite friendly and are happy to help with waste disposal by eating said waste, so some are kept around by some people.

entry: POKENAME在污染肆虐的地区生活得很好，将受污染的东西整件吞下。嘴里塞不进的，就喷出强酸，溶成浓稠污泥。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME thrives in areas ravaged in pollution, swallowing any contaminated object whole. For anything that doesn't fit in its mouth, it spews out a powerful acid that melts them into a thick sludge.

entry: POKENAME每天吃大量垃圾，住在废品场和垃圾填埋场，紧挨着食物来源。它会在巨大的钟状身体里溶解垃圾，将其变成黑色污泥。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME eat a plethora of trash daily and live in junkyards and landfills to remain close to their food source. They melt garbage in their large bell to turn objects into dark sludge.

entry: POKENAME在下水道里漂游，用长触手抓取丢弃物。溶解的东西都会变成体表黏液，使黏稠的身躯不断增大。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME drifts through sewers, using its long tentacles to grab discarded items. Anything it dissolves contributes to the slime on its body, adding to its growing, sticky mass.

entry: POKENAME的黏液鬃毛长得极快，所到之处都会留下有毒液洼。训练家最好每天至少2次用特制刷子，帮它去掉多余液体。
author: regulavish
source: POKENAME's mane of slime grows at such a rapid rate that it leaves toxic puddles wherever it goes. Trainers are advised to use specially made brushes to help it shed excess liquid at least twice a day.

entry: POKENAME在大地上疾驰，只会在污染严重的工厂停下。沿途留下有毒蹄印，鬃毛还会放出毒雾，使肺部极其难受。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME gallops across the land, stopping only at factories filled with pollution. It leaves toxic hoofprints in its wake as well as a poisonous smog from its mane that causes extreme lung distress.

entry: POKENAME把尾巴浸进池塘，释放浓稠的紫色液体，黏住附近的一切。液体虽有丁香花香，却腐蚀性极强，碰到很危险。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME dips its tail into ponds, releasing a thick purple fluid that clings to everything nearby. Despite its lilac scent, the substance is highly corrosive and dangerous to touch.

entry: POKENAME缓慢地清理世界各地海滩的垃圾。尾巴就像铲子，帮它把垃圾铲进嘴里。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME slowly clean up garbage from beaches throughout the world. Their tail acts like a shovel that helps them scoop garbage into their mouths.

entry: 它的壳极其坚硬，据说是长期接触自身有毒身体的结果。它们能滤出水中的污染物为食，这个过程也让它们能喷出极其干净的水。
author: infinex21
source: Its shell is incredibly tough, supposedly due to being exposed to their own toxic bodies for so long. They can filter pollutants out of water to feed themselves, though this process also allows them to spew some of the cleanest waters.

entry: 构成POKENAME身体的浓稠污泥散发着恶臭。它在垃圾填埋场里缓缓挪动。
author: mepp.
source: The thick sludge that makes up POKENAME's body produces a vile stench. It slowly lumbers about in landfills.

entry: POKENAME金属身体上的软泥会被收集，熬成浓稠糊状。煮去毒性后，与捣碎的瓜西果混合，涂在薄脆饼上，就成了关都各地喜爱的酸香美食。
author: .izik
source: The ooze coating POKENAME's metal body is harvested and boiled down into a thick paste. After the poison is boiled out, the paste can be mixed with mashed Watmel Berries and placed on crackers for a delicious yet tangy treat, enjoyed across Kanto.

entry: POKENAME其中一节身体不断渗出有毒、具有腐蚀性的物质。污泥也会伤害自身，削弱部分磁力，使金属部件更加不稳定。
author: sk372
source: Toxic and corrosive materials ooze constantly from one segment of POKENAME. The sludge adversely affects its body, inhibiting some of its magnetic force and reducing the stability of its metal parts.

entry: POKENAME气味难闻，通常不在人口密集区出现。它们不断迁移，免得惹恼当地居民。因此，人们划出几乎没有植物或人烟的地区，供它们自由活动。
author: ruben2309295
source: POKENAME aren't usually found in populated areas due to their horrible smell. They constantly move to avoid upsetting the locals. Because of this, areas that contain little to no plant or human life have been designated for POKENAME to roam freely.

entry: POKENAME吸收空气中通常有危险的颗粒维生。除城市外，也能在活火山旁见到它们，吸收脏污的烟灰和火山灰。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME sustains itself by taking in what would typically be dangerous particles in the air. Outside of cities, they can also be found by active volcanoes, absorbing unhygienic soot and ash.

entry: POKENAME藏在垃圾桶里，等人扔错垃圾。它会催眠对方，让人使用正确的垃圾桶；人们如今已认可这种行为能减少整体污染。
author: ozzie.the.writer
