source: POKENAME will hide in trashcans, awaiting those who incorrectly throw the wrong items in. It will hypnotize people into using proper bins, an effort recognized now to reduce overall pollution.

entry: 它用锋利的钳子夹碎玻璃和金属，再将垃圾吃下。没有哪个垃圾场能逃过它的胃口。
author: .izik
source: It uses its sharp pincers to break apart glass and metal before consuming the trash. No dump is safe from its appetite.

entry: POKENAME曾被发现于运垃圾的驳船上觅食。它在晒热的垃圾里挖掘，伪足因此变硬，如同利爪。
author: pastapockets
source: POKENAME has been found scavenging food on trash barges. Its pseudopod becomes hardened like a claw from digging in sunbaked trash.

entry: POKENAME的炮管会射出构成身体大部分的有毒污泥。因此，连续开炮一段时间后，体形就会明显缩小。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's cannons fire the sludgy, toxic material that comprises most of its body. As such, when it fires continuously for some time, it noticeably shrinks in size.

entry: 它的喷水口总在漏出有毒废料，成分与自身黏软的身体相同。它既能放出格外干净的水，也能放出浓到足以腐蚀金属的毒物。
author: infinex21
source: Its waterspouts are always leaking a toxic waste that shares a composition with its own slimy body. It can loose remarkably clean waters or toxic material of such concentration that it can corrode metal.

entry: 以背甲上的迫击炮发射种子炸弹而闻名。越是成长，射得就越远、越准。
author: soup1900
source: It is famously known to fire a Seed Bomb from the mortar on its shell. The more it grows, the farther and more accurate these shots will become.

entry: POKENAME用小触角喷水，分散敌人的注意，争取时间缩进壳里。壳只能勉强容下身体，因此它更依赖水柱来避免被吃。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME shoots jets of water with its small antennae, which distracts its foe long enough to hide in its shell. The shell barely fits its body, so it relies more on its water jets to avoid getting eaten.

entry: POKENAME没有四肢，行动能力有限。它依靠精确间隔喷出的高压水柱，推动身体四处移动。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have a limited ability to move thanks to their lack of limbs. They rely on firing high pressure jets of water at precise intervals to jet themselves around.

entry: POKENAME没有四肢，行动能力有限。它依靠精确间隔喷出的高压水柱，推动身体四处移动。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have a limited ability to move thanks to their lack of limbs. They rely on firing high pressure jets of water at precise intervals to jet themselves around.

entry: POKENAME没有四肢，行动能力有限。它依靠精确间隔喷出的高压水柱，推动身体四处移动。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have a limited ability to move thanks to their lack of limbs. They rely on firing high pressure jets of water at precise intervals to jet themselves around.

entry: POKENAME的炮管能交替射出强力水柱或雷电。若两者同时发射太久，能量输出过大，就可能爆炸。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's cannons can alternate firing high-power water spouts or bolts of lightning. Firing both simultaneously for too long may cause it to explode from excessive energy output.

entry: POKENAME躺在河岸上，故意模仿熟睡水箭龟的壳。好奇的巡护员过来检查，确认宝可梦是否安好时，它就会突然爆炸，并乐在其中。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME lie on riverbanks and deliberately mimic the shells of sleeping Blastoise. They take great pleasure in unexpectedly exploding when curious Pokémon Rangers come by to check on the shell and make sure the Pokémon is alright.

entry: POKENAME挥舞金属长棍作武器，平时收在壳中专门的空腔里。它挥棍的力量足以砸裂混凝土，遇见生气的它时最好小心。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME wield long metal clubs as weapons, storing them inside special hollows in their shells. They're able to swing these clubs with enough force to crack concrete, and caution is advised when nearby an angry POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME每只脚后面都有喷水口。喷出的强劲水流让它战斗时踢得更快、更有力。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME possesses water jets at the back of each foot. The powerful force of water expelled gives its kicks extra speed and power in combat.

entry: POKENAME手背上的喷水口既能增强拳头的威力，也能攻击绕到身后的敌人。为了在战斗中更灵活，壳的大部分已经软化。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME has waterspouts on the back of its hands which it uses to add extra power to its punches and attack opponents that have flanked behind it. Much of its shell has softened to increase its agility in combat.

entry: POKENAME必须在水炮的灵活性和壳的坚硬程度间取得平衡。它用炮管惊吓捕食者，也依靠壳抵挡啄击。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME needs to balance the mobility of its water cannons and the rigidity of its shell. It startles predators with its cannons but also depends on its shell to defend against pecking.

entry: POKENAME能从口中喷水，水压达每平方英寸30000磅。但它无法维持太久，遇险时便借此猛然加速，逃离更大的宝可梦。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME can shoot water from their mouths with a force of 30,000 PSI. They cannot maintain this output for long and use it to get a burst of speed to escape from larger Pokémon when endangered.

entry: 它炮管般的突起能向敌人猛烈喷水，常用来击落捕食同类的鸟类宝可梦。战斗时，它也会靠喷水调整位置。
author: infinex21
source: Its cannon-like protrusion allows it to expel violent blasts of water at foes, often used to shoot down bird Pokémon that try to prey on its kind. This Pokémon will also expel water blasts to reposition itself during battle.

entry: POKENAME厚实的壳保护着视野死角，让它游泳时免受大型宝可梦伤害。一旦遇袭，它就转身面对来犯者，射出强劲水柱。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have a dense shell protecting their blind spots, keeping them safe from larger Pokémon as they swim. If they are attacked, they turn to face their aggressor and fire a powerful jet of water at them.

entry: POKENAME用水炮将树果从枝上打落。翅膀既可紧急逃生，也能帮它飞到高处采集树果。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME shakes berries off branches with jets from its water cannons. Its wings provide both an emergency escape and added height for berry gathering.

entry: POKENAME是海底傲慢顽固的恶霸，壳几乎无法击穿，四肢全是结实的肌肉，还常故意绷紧肌肉威慑对手。失去的肢体可能再生，但会弱得多。
author: chinigan
source: POKENAME are the arrogant, stubborn bullies of the seafloor. Their shell is nearly impenetrable, and every limb is packed tight with muscle, which they will often flex to psych out opponents. Lost limbs may regrow, albeit much weaker.

entry: 它其实由一只小小的水箭龟操控，靠喷射水流轰击敌人，也借此敏捷移动，身手如战斗机飞行员般娴熟。
author: pokepower
source: It is really controlled by a tiny Blastoise. Using jets of water to bombard foes and move with incredible agility, it's as skilled as a fighter pilot.

entry: 水上乐园里，常能看到POKENAME为孩子们表演。背上的袋子里，藏着各式各样的戏水花招。
author: patch
source: POKENAME can be seen performing for children at water parks. The sack on its back is filled with all sorts of water-themed party tricks.

entry: POKENAME是多面手，很难被制住。若双臂上的利刃不足以解决对手，它就会用两门炮发射水弹猛轰。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is difficult to pin down, since it is a versatile fighter. If the blades on its arms aren't enough to finish an opponent, it bombards them with water projectiles from its twin cannons.

entry: POKENAME在水中游荡，寻找最适合改成新温泉的水源。被打扰时，它会从尾巴喷出滚烫的间歇泉。
author: beatdoof
source: POKENAME swims waters in search of the best source to turn into a new thermal pool. It blasts searing geysers from its tail when it's interrupted.

entry: POKENAME会跃出水面，用炮管将树上的树果击落。若没能落回水里，就会不停扑腾，直到重新掉进去。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME leap out of the water to shoot berries out of trees with their cannon. If POKENAME fails to land back into the water, they flop around until they fall back in.

entry: 有些POKENAME的翅膀未能正常发育，只能依靠炮管喷射来保持飞行。它们通常住在河流、池塘周围，便于补充水源。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Some POKENAME do not properly develop wings and instead have to rely on jet propulsion from their cannons to remain airborne. They typically live around rivers and ponds so that they can easily replenish their water supply.

entry: 这种顽固的宝可梦一旦认定敌人，在打倒对方之前就无法关注其他事物。它的力量足以夷平整个村庄，也能精准击中160英尺以外的目标。
author: anarraveofcolour
source: A stubborn Pokémon that, once it decides on a foe, will not be able to focus on anything else until that foe is defeated. It has the strength to raze entire villages alongside the precision to strike targets over 160 feet away.

entry: 会巡视领地，用大量水流轰击不服管束的宝可梦。与拉普拉斯不同，谁想骑到它背上，它就会发狂。
author: pokepower
source: It patrols its territory, blasting any unruly Pokémon with a deluge of water. Unlike Lapras, it goes berserk if anything tries to ride on its back.

entry: POKENAME能完全消失在深水中，常借此截击猎物，用体重压住毫无戒备的敌人。若不靠体重取胜，就会用炮管喷水。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: POKENAME are able to completely vanish into deep water, often using this to intercept prey by crushing unsuspecting foes under their body weight. When they do not use their body weight to win fights, they will blast water from their cannons.

entry: POKENAME的炮管发射需要大量能量。战斗时，它会高速奔跑、游泳，产生足够的静电，再射出带电的滔滔水流。
author: haypile
source: It takes a lot of power to fire POKENAME's cannons. In battle, POKENAME runs and swims at high speeds to generate enough static to launch an electrified deluge.

entry: POKENAME用尾巴上的炮攻击敌人。在现实世界里，它射出普通的高压水流；在网络空间里，射出的则是纯粹的二进制代码流。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME fires projectiles at foes using the cannon on its tail. In the real world, it fires streams of normal high-pressure water; in cyberspace, it's a stream of pure binary code.

entry: POKENAME吊在树枝上，任何东西扰动树枝，它就会开水炮。有时，后坐力还会把自己震下树。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME fires its water cannons at anything that disturbs the branches it hangs from. Sometimes the recoil from the water cannon knocks it out of the tree.

entry: POKENAME独居在水温极低的地方，对闯入者毫不客气。炮管射出的水一碰到目标，就会立即结冰，把对方冻得结结实实。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME lives a solitary life residing in areas with frigid waters, and does not take kindly to intruders. The water shot from its cannon instantly freezes over when it hits a target, leaving them frozen solid.

entry: POKENAME呼啸着掠过天空，速度堪比战斗机。它会掀起风暴压倒敌人，尽管自己也同样怕雷击。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME roars through the sky with speeds that rival fighter jets. It unleashes storms on foes to assert dominance, even though it is just as vulnerable to a bolt of lightning.

entry: 它们快速绕着敌人飞行，用喷水口精准攻击。飞得够快时，还能让壳朝前冲撞，沿途留下巨大的坑洞。
author: infinex21
source: They release precise attacks from their waterspouts while flying quickly around their foes. They can fly fast enough that they can launch themselves with their shells facing forward and leave large craters in their wake.

entry: POKENAME吊在树枝上，向靠得太近的其他宝可梦喷水。每次开水炮，后坐力都会将它向后弹飞。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME hangs from branches and shoots water jets at other Pokémon that come too close. Whenever it fires its water cannons, it is flung back from the recoil.

entry: POKENAME有3门水炮，能射出强劲水柱。它喷洒掺毒的水雾标记领地，同时吓退其他宝可梦。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME is equipped with three water cannons that shoot powerful jets of water. It marks its territory by spraying a mist laced with toxins, which also scares away other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME将超能力注入炮管，射出受念力驱动的强劲水炮。它也能以意念控水，掀起波浪击倒对手。
author: thepandasharky
source: POKENAME channels psychic energy through its cannons, launching powerful telekinetic water blasts. It can control water with its mind, forming waves to strike down opponents.

entry: POKENAME凭出色的超能力，能自由操控壳中射出的水流。它爱让水流绕圈、盘旋，调皮地分散别人的注意，却很少真的把谁淋湿。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's excellent psychic prowess lets it freely control the movement of the jets of water fired from its shell. It playfully distracts others by whipping the water around in circles in spirals, rarely actually splashing someone.

entry: 战斗时，POKENAME会用水造出叶子和藤蔓攻击。森林起火时，它们会成群冒险前去灭火。
author: mistymagius
source: In combat, POKENAME creates leaves and vines out of water, which it uses to attack. During forest fires, groups of POKENAME will put themselves in danger to douse the flames.

entry: POKENAME的4门炮让它进攻能力出众，尤其是触角上能活动的两门。它产生的水带有浓郁草药香，很适合泡提神茶。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's four cannons give it impeccable offensive capabilities, particularly the two movable ones on its antennae. The water it produces has a strong herbal scent and works well for brewing rejuvenating teas.

entry: POKENAME只有一门炮，射出的水流能将树果从树上打落。树果是它饮食的重要部分。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME has a singular cannon that shoots out streams of water. It is strong enough to knock down berries from trees, which makes up a large part of its diet.

entry: 野生POKENAME会向所有进入领地的对象喷水，因此很惹人烦。受训后，它们会与清洁和维护人员合作，用水炮清除油漆与涂鸦。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Wild POKENAME are considered annoying as they spray anyone who enters their territory. Trained POKENAME work with cleaners and custodial workers using their cannons to spray off paint and graffiti.

entry: POKENAME依靠炮管喷射在空中前进。它有种奇怪的肌肉痉挛，每秒都会晃一下头，即使飞行中也不例外。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME relies on its cannons to propel it through the air. It has a peculiar muscle spasm that causes it to bobble its head once a second, even while flying.

entry: 即使高速移动，它也能从背甲上的炮管精准射出水流。军队会用它们代替攻击型无人机。
author: soup1900
source: It can accurately fire water jets from the cannon on its shell while moving extremely fast. They are utilized in the military in place of attack drones.

entry: 准备攻击时，POKENAME会先在翅膀羽毛上覆满厚厚的水层，再全速俯冲。身上的壳则保护最脆弱的部位，抵挡敌人攻击。
author: fiordaliso
source: When preparing to strike, POKENAME coats the feathers on its wings with a dense layer of water before diving at full speed. The shell covering its body shields its most vulnerable spots from enemy attacks.

entry: 从两根触角喷出高压水柱，贯穿猎物。两股水流合一，能制造时速超过60英里的洋流。
author: soup1900
source: It fires high-pressure water jets from its two antennae to puncture its prey. Combining these two blasts can create ocean currents of over 60 mph.

entry: POKENAME的炮管在水中如催眠般摇摆，吸引游过的好奇宝可梦。等猎物靠近，便猛射强劲水柱，打个措手不及。
author: cartoonhostage
source: POKENAME's cannons sway hypnotically in the water, drawing the attention of curious Pokémon swimming by. When they get close enough, it blasts its unsuspecting prey with powerful beams of water.

entry: 口中的炮管水力惊人，可POKENAME身体太脆弱，开炮后反而被震得倒飞出去。有些POKENAME索性借此赶路。
author: imaginaryneon
source: The cannon in its mouth fires water at exceptional power. However, POKENAME is so frail that it flies backwards afterwards, leading to some POKENAME using it as a means of travel.

entry: 晴朗、流星众多的夜里，POKENAME会在岩石海滩上跳舞，用炮管中的水编织出令人着迷的表演。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME dances on rocky beaches during clear nights filled with many shooting stars. It uses the water from its cannons to create mesmerizing displays.

entry: 受到威胁时，POKENAME会从炮管猛然喷水。可它个头太小，强劲水流会把它向后弹飞，在墙壁间来回反弹。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME fire powerful bursts of water from their cannons when threatened. Due to their small size, these blasts send them flying backwards, causing them to ricochet off walls.

entry: POKENAME能穿过飓风和热带风暴，不怕被卷走。巨大的水炮使飞行稳定，不会偏离航线。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME flies through hurricanes and tropical storms without the risk of being whisked away. Its large water cannons stabilize its flight so that it does not get knocked off course.

entry: 晴天时，POKENAME会在海滩上跳舞，风吹过覆着铠甲的花瓣，发出低沉的鸣响。它边跳边从头上的炮管喷水，演出美丽的景象。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME will dance on beaches when the sun is out, their armor-plated petals making a low ringing noise as wind passes through. They spray water from the cannons on their heads, creating beautiful displays as they dance.

entry: POKENAME将水储存在壳内，再向空中喷出巨量水流，化作覆盖几个街区的雨。它走在自己造出的雨中唱歌，按节拍敲打龟壳。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME store water within their shells before blasting torrents into the air large enough to rain down across multiple city blocks. They sing while walking through their rain, drumming on their shells to the beat.

entry: 雨林上方常有成群的POKENAME漂浮。风吹过涡轮时，它们会收集、吸收空气中的水分，增强水属性攻击。
author: milchik
source: Bales of POKENAME are commonly found floating above the rainforests. When wind travels through their turbines, these Pokémon collect and absorb moisture from the air to power up their Water-type attacks.

entry: POKENAME一生大多待在海上，只在筑巢时返回陆地。它们靠展示力量争夺配偶，水炮射得最远的那只，几乎总能赢下比赛。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME spend most of their lives out at sea, only returning to land to nest. They compete for mates through displays of power; whichever POKENAME can launch water from their cannon the furthest is almost always the winner of these contests.

entry: POKENAME一生大多待在海上，只在筑巢时返回陆地。它们靠展示力量争夺配偶，水炮射得最远的那只，几乎总能赢下比赛。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME spend most of their lives out at sea, only returning to land to nest. They compete for mates through displays of power; whichever POKENAME can launch water from their cannon the furthest is almost always the winner of these contests.

entry: POKENAME炮管的水柱能击落小型鸟类宝可梦。它游得比爬得快，因此很少远离水域。
author: quackquackattack
source: The force of a water jet from a POKENAME's cannon can knock down small bird Pokémon. It swims faster than it crawls, so it is rarely found far from a body of water.

entry: POKENAME的尾巴能抓握东西，它爱用尾上的喷口朝别人喷水，恶作剧。但它总热情过头，炮力又大，常将被捉弄的对象直接打晕。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME enjoys pranking others by spraying them with water from the jet on its prehensile tail. Its overzealous nature and the strength of its cannon often cause the target of the prank to be knocked out by the blast.

entry: POKENAME虽有笨重的壳，壳里还装着沉重的水炮，仍能飞得极快。但若不先固定在岩石等坚固物体上，就无法全力开炮。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are capable of achieving incredible flight speeds despite their bulky shells that contain hefty waterspout cannons. They cannot fire water at full power from their cannons without securing themselves to something solid, like a rock.

entry: POKENAME的炮力大到能把自己向后推。不过，它能分泌凝胶，将自己固定在原地。若未经过适当训练，就无法长时间连续喷水。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: The force behind POKENAME's cannons is so great that it can propel the Pokémon backward. However, it produces a gel that anchors it in place. Without proper training, it cannot sustain long bursts of fire.

entry: POKENAME虽友好，却反应迟钝，容易低估自己的力气。泥泞河岸上，常能见到其他宝可梦被它无意中抱住，无法脱身。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Though friendly, POKENAME are slow-witted and prone to underestimating their own strength. It is common to find Pokémon that have inadvertently been trapped in a hug in muddy river banks by them.

entry: POKENAME虽友好，却反应迟钝，容易低估自己的力气。泥泞河岸上，常能见到其他宝可梦被它无意中抱住，无法脱身。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Though friendly, POKENAME are slow-witted and prone to underestimating their own strength. It is common to find Pokémon that have inadvertently been trapped in a hug in muddy river banks by them.

entry: POKENAME虽友好，却反应迟钝，容易低估自己的力气。泥泞河岸上，常能见到其他宝可梦被它无意中抱住，无法脱身。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Though friendly, POKENAME are slow-witted and prone to underestimating their own strength. It is common to find Pokémon that have inadvertently been trapped in a hug in muddy river banks by them.

entry: 背部迫击炮射出的种子炸弹能在半空爆出缤纷色彩。人们用它制作美丽的烟火表演。
author: soup1900
source: The Seed Bomb it fires from the mortar on its back can explode midair, creating a colorful boom. People use it to create beautiful fireworks shows.

entry: POKENAME太大，缩不进壳里，却有能喷水的炮管。它能迅速打落伸到水面上方的树枝上的树果，也能击落捕食者。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are too big to fit into their shell but instead have access to cannons that fire jets of water. They can quickly knock down berries from branches that hang over water and shoot down their predators as well.

entry: POKENAME用背上的水压炮，在峭壁和巨石上轰出巢穴。这些地方很适合产卵，因为它们还能用壳堵住洞口。
author: lepidelectric
source: POKENAME use the hydraulic cannons on their back to blast nests into cliff faces and massive boulders. These make for impeccable spots to lay eggs in, as their shells can then plug the entrances to burrows.

entry: POKENAME游得慢，却很爱跳进宽阔水域玩耍。它会用背上的小炮朝朋友喷水。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are slow swimmers, but love to jump into large bodies of water to play around in. They use the tiny cannons on their backs to squirt water at their friends.

entry: POKENAME将水灌进虫类宝可梦的洞穴，让猎物不得不逃出来，否则就会溺水。等猎物来到地面，它就扑上去，拿下下一餐。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME hunt for bug Pokémon by flooding their burrows with water, forcing prey to escape or risk drowning. Once the Pokémon reach the surface, they pounce to secure their next meal.

entry: POKENAME对不熟悉的宝可梦通常粗暴冷淡，会大张声势地显露怒气与敌意。熟悉后却很友好，喜欢别人抚摸、拍拍它的壳。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are typically gruff and standoffish with Pokémon they are unfamiliar with, making big displays of aggression and anger. They are friendly once they start to get to know others, enjoying having their shell stroked and patted.

entry: POKENAME靠背部喷水口推进，以自身的体形和重量而言，灵活程度惊人。以为它笨重迟缓的对手，很快就会被结实的钳子夹住。
author: sk372
source: The water jets on POKENAME's back provide momentum that lets it achieve a frightening amount of mobility for its size and weight. Those expecting a slow and lumbering foe will quickly find themselves clamped by its sturdy pincers.

entry: POKENAME用背上的炮击落三蜜蜂的蜂巢，吃里面的蜂蜜。若吃得够多，甚至还能用炮管发射蜂蜜。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME use the cannons on their backs to shoot down hives of Combee, eating the honey inside. If they eat enough of it, they can even fire honey from their cannons.

entry: POKENAME背壳中储存着超热的水，碰到钢铁就能穿透、熔化。它若缩进壳里，务必格外小心，因为它能借喷水将自己变成危险的导弹。
author: notadoctor75
source: In the shell on its back, POKENAME stores super-heated water that it can pierce and melt steel on contact. If this Pokémon retreats inside its shell, extreme caution is warranted, for it can use its water jets to turn itself into a dangerous missile.

entry: POKENAME跟踪绿毛虫回洞，再将水灌进洞里。若有绿毛虫从别的地道逃出，它还能远距离喷水，将对方打昏。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME stalk Caterpie back to their burrows before flooding their burrows with water. If any Caterpie manage to escape through a different tunnel, POKENAME can fire long range jets of water to knock them unconscious.

entry: POKENAME向船底喷水，将船赶离珊瑚礁，保护珊瑚礁安全。周围海水施加的压力，使它的壳极其坚固。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME sprays jets of water at the hulls of ships to drive them away from the coral reef, keeping it safe. Its shell is extremely sturdy thanks to the pressure exerted by the surrounding seawater.

entry: POKENAME的两个头会沟通，精确攻击1000码外的目标。有时也会被两种视角弄得头晕。
author: dusknoir64
source: POKENAME has two heads that communicate to launch accurate attacks from over 1000 yards away. Sometimes it gets dizzy from the two viewpoints.

entry: POKENAME能调节体内储水的温度。炮管既能射出雪球、冰柱，也能喷出热蒸汽或水流。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME can adjust the temperature of the water stored in its body. From its cannons may come snowballs, icicles, hot steam, or blasts of fluid.

entry: POKENAME大多在池塘、湖泊的水面游动，向路人讨食。激动时，它会喝下一大口水，再从壳中的炮管高速射出。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME spend most of their time swimming at the surface of ponds and lakes, begging for food from those passing by. When they get riled up they take a gulp of water then fire it at high velocity from the cannons in their shell.

entry: POKENAME能悄悄接近猎物，狩猎很少失手。若猎物侥幸逃开，它就会喷出汹涌水流，将对方压倒、制服。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME rarely fail at hunting because of their ability to sneak up on their prey. If they ever manage to escape, POKENAME unleash a torrent of water to overwhelm and subdue their prey.

entry: POKENAME靠炮管喷水移动。水流虽强，控制却很精准，它总能落在自己想去的位置。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME moves around by blasting jets of water from its cannons. Although these blasts are powerful, they are also precise, and POKENAME always lands exactly where it wants to.

entry: POKENAME靠炮管喷水移动。水流虽强，控制却很精准，它总能落在自己想去的位置。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME moves around by blasting jets of water from its cannons. Although these blasts are powerful, they are also precise, and POKENAME always lands exactly where it wants to.

entry: POKENAME能从尾巴射出加压颜料，威力足以穿透木头。它将雨水收在壳里，混入不同树果，调制成颜料。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME can fire pressurized jets of paint from its tail powerful enough to punch through wood. It creates its paint by collecting rainwater in its shell and mixing it with different berries.

entry: POKENAME分泌含有色素的液体，装进炮管。它在炮中积蓄压力，一次射出所有颜料，一炮就能绘成一幅风景。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME secrete fluids containing pigments that they load into their cannons. They build up pressure inside the cannons and fire the pigments all at once, painting a vista in a single blast.

entry: POKENAME转动身体时，会踢起一道小水墙，力道足以掀倒成年人。水让地面湿滑，也使POKENAME转得更快。
author: mistymagius
source: As POKENAME spins its body, it kicks up a small wall of water with enough force to topple a fully grown person. The water creates a slippery surface that allows for POKENAME to spin even faster.

entry: POKENAME用尾巴稳住身体，朝猎物喷水。它借此扰乱猎物，靠近到足以咬下有毒的一口。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME stabilizes itself with its tail as it fires jets of water at prey. This method of confusing prey allows it to come close enough to deliver a toxic bite.

entry: POKENAME肚上的炮能喷射乳汁，威力足以击穿石头。奇特的牛奶浴风潮全靠它的奶支撑，据说这种富含钙的奶能让肌肤光滑、骨骼强健。
author: quackquackattack
source: The cannons on the stomach of POKENAME can fire bursts of milk strong enough to punch holes in stones. The odd trend of milk baths is fueled entirely with POKENAME milk, as the calcium-rich milk is said to create smooth skin and reinforce bones.

entry: POKENAME骄傲自负，总要别人尊重自己。它能引发地震、淹没周围地区，因此其他宝可梦都很怕它。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are proud, prideful creatures that always demand respect from others. Other Pokémon fear POKENAME because of their ability to cause earthquakes and flood the area around them.

entry: POKENAME用喷水口加快飞行，更精准地调整航线。它在深海海沟中休息，因此壳变得比大多数金属更坚韧。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME uses its waterspouts to help propel itself through the air quicker and to adjust its flight path with greater precision. It rests within deep-sea trenches, which has caused its shell to become hardier than most metals.

entry: POKENAME尾上的双炮能同时向多名敌人喷水，抵御围攻。经常战斗的个体，每天必须喝大约1加仑水。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's dual tail cannons allow it to fend off multiple foes at once with blasts of water. A POKENAME that battles often must drink around a gallon of water per day.

entry: POKENAME的战斗常像牛仔对峙般一对一决斗。它时常与章鱼桶结怨。
author: teatedtiten
source: When POKENAME battle, they usually engage in duels reminiscent of cowboy standoffs. It frequently has feuds with Octillery.

entry: POKENAME虽然能做的不多，却十分在意海滩和海洋的清洁。它常捡起塑料瓶盖，收进袋子，还会纠缠在岸上乱扔垃圾的人。
author: bradlybro199
source: Although it can't do much, POKENAME cares deeply about the cleanliness of beaches and the ocean. It often picks up plastic bottle caps and stores them in its pouch, and is known to bother people who litter on the shore.

entry: POKENAME能先电击对手，再用水猛轰，增强攻击威力。但它体形小，启动炮管要耗费大量能量，用过后便会虚弱。
author: daimposter_60614
source: POKENAME can electrocute opponents before blasting them with water to strengthen the attack. Because of POKENAME's small form, it can take a lot of energy to power its blaster, leaving it weak after using it.

entry: POKENAME有强力的尾炮，能发射水柱和雷电。尾巴柔软灵活，即使蜷在壳里也能开炮。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME has a powerful tail cannon that shoots jets of water and lightning bolts. Its flexible tail allows it to fire shots even when curled up in its shell.

entry: 它们交替从臂端炮管射出冰水和削尖的冰柱。敌对群体会在雪地空地上相遇，彼此交火，连一片雪花还没落地，争端就已解决。
author: _blissey
source: They alternate between shooting chilling water and sharpened icicles from the cannons at the tips of their arms. Rival packs meet in a snow-covered clearing and trade fire, settling disputes before a single snowflake lands.

entry: 军队将POKENAME用作侦察任务中的远程无人机。它对磁力敏感，能循磁信号回到训练家身边，战斗时还会用炮管发射水流或电力。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Armies employ POKENAME as a long-range drone during recon missions. Since POKENAME is attuned to magnets, it can find its way back to its Trainer via magnetic signals and blast water or electricity from its cannons during combat.

entry: POKENAME的炮能发射石块与水。受威胁时就缩进壳内，用尾巴当重锤。
author: codewolfie
source: POKENAME is capable of shooting rocks and water from its cannons. When it feels threatened, it will hide in its shell and use its tail as a mace.

entry: POKENAME壳内藏着长电缆，能随意操控，并从中产生强劲电流。它在湿地捕猎，用电力将猎物击晕。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME house long cables within their shell that they can move at will, generating powerful electrical charges from them. They hunt within wetlands, using their electricity to stun their prey.

entry: POKENAME在壳中储水，能用炮管高压射出。组成外壳的鳞片有一层涂层，移动时会产生强劲电荷，再传进水流里。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME carry reserves of water within their shell that they can fire at high pressure from their cannons. The scales forming their shell have a coating that generates a powerful electric charge as they move that they send through the water streams.

entry: POKENAME在壳中储水，能用炮管高压射出。组成外壳的鳞片有一层涂层，移动时会产生强劲电荷，再传进水流里。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME carry reserves of water within their shell that they can fire at high pressure from their cannons. The scales forming their shell have a coating that generates a powerful electric charge as they move that they send through the water streams.

entry: POKENAME向荒地发射高压、摄氏2500度的间歇泉水柱，造出温泉池。水属性和火属性宝可梦自然会被吸引来，认为这里是理想环境。
author: beatdoof
source: POKENAME creates thermal pools by firing high-pressure, 2,500 °C geyser shots into barren ground. Water and Fire-type Pokémon are naturally drawn to these pools, finding them to be an ideal environment.

entry: POKENAME喝下液化的黏土滋养身体，上岸时常沾得浑身都是。若附近还有同类，它们会轮流用水炮给对方冲高压澡。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME drink liquified clay to nourish their bodies and often surface with clay all over their bodies. If another POKENAME is nearby, they take turns giving each other a pressurized bath from their water cannons.

entry: POKENAME的翅膀也是高压水炮。借助喷水的后坐力，它能在空中突然转向、旋转，是极灵活、难以预测的对手。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's wings double as high-pressure water cannons. Utilizing the recoil gained from firing water, it can perform incredibly sudden turns and rotations in midair, making it a very agile and unpredictable opponent.

entry: POKENAME喷水需要大量能量，但蓝色叶子使它难以进行光合作用。它会缩进沉重的壳里争取时间，蓄力打出强劲一炮。
author: haypile
source: It takes a lot of energy to fire POKENAME's waterspouts, but POKENAME has trouble photosynthesizing due to its blue leaves. It hunkers into its heavy shell to buy time to charge up for a good blast.

entry: POKENAME在大片沼泽里重重踏行，炮管不断滴水。受到其他宝可梦威胁时，它会先将对方撞倒，再对准脸直接开炮。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME stomp around large marshes, water constantly dripping down from their cannons. When threatened by another Pokémon, POKENAME will ram them down before firing their cannons directly into the foe's face.

entry: POKENAME的双炮能独立于身体运作，射出的水柱强劲又精准。但偶尔也会失控，转着圈向四面八方喷水。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's twin cannons function independently of its body and can fire fierce jets of water with great strength and accuracy. However, on occasion they may go haywire, spinning and spraying water in every direction.

entry: POKENAME大部分时间都认真为森林家园的植物浇水，确保周围草木健康。照料植物的炮管，也能有效抵御闯入者。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME spends much of its time dutifully watering the plants of its forest home, ensuring healthy plant life all around. The cannons it uses for plant care double as highly effective defenses against intruders.

entry: 这些宝可梦保护着随季节变迁一同迁徙的群体。前往温暖水域的途中，POKENAME会警戒可能袭击族群的捕食者，用加压热水击退威胁。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: These Pokémon are the defenders of the groups they travel with during the changing seasons. While traveling to warmer waters, POKENAME keep watch for predators that may attack the group and blast away threats using pressurized hot water.

entry: POKENAME住在黏土矿床附近，以黏土滋养身体。黏土干硬后，它们就喷水，将其化为可食用的泥浆。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME live near clay deposits and eat clay to nourish their bodies. Whenever the clay dries up and becomes hard, they hose down the clay to turn it into an edible slurry.

entry: POKENAME能用背壳中的喷口，向对手发射高压水流。趁敌人还没从水流冲击中恢复，它就迅速逼近，接连使出破坏力极强的踢击。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: Using the jets from the shell on its back, POKENAME can blast highly pressured streams of water at an opponent. While the foe is recovering from the blast, it closes the distance between them and unleashes a flurry of devastating kicks.

entry: POKENAME脚上的利爪能抓住地面，帮它站稳。借助脚底的水炮，它还能将自己射向对手，施以重击。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: The talons on POKENAME's feet have the ability to latch to the ground and help this Pokémon stand its ground. Using the water cannons on the soles of its feet, POKENAME can launch itself at an opponent and deliver intense blows.

entry: POKENAME的腿覆着坚韧的鳞甲，保护双腿。虽然天生披着重甲，它跑跳仍毫不费力，危急时还能靠脚上的炮管辅助移动。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME's legs are covered in tough scutes that protect its legs. Despite having this natural heavy armor, POKENAME has no issue running or jumping. The cannons in its feet can also aid in its movement when in a pinch.

entry: POKENAME的背壳保护着颈部和背部。它攻击毫不留情，会从炮管喷出滚烫的高压水流，手脚利爪也能轻松撕开敌人。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME's neck and back are protected by the shell on its back. This Pokémon does not hold back its attacks, using scalding and pressurized jets of water from its cannons. The sharp talons on its hands and feet can tear through foes with ease.

entry: POKENAME在水下会用鳃吸入空气，再用炮管吹泡泡。泡泡极其坚韧，甚至能托着岩石浮到水面。
author: santon5512
source: While underwater, POKENAME will suck in air through their gills, using it to blow bubbles with their cannons. These bubbles are incredibly resilient, able to float rocks up to the surface.

entry: POKENAME的硬壳其实由干泥组成。它能敲碎壳片，当作弹片高速射出，连壶壶的壳都能打凹。
author: shocktopus1717
source: The hard material comprising POKENAME's shell is actually dried mud. It can smash pieces of the shell into shrapnel and fire them at speeds that could dent a Shuckle's shell.

entry: POKENAME偏爱岩石海滩，重视防御，会用石头搭出小堡垒，再从里面喷水攻击。
author: jarom_beyond
source: It prefers to live on rocky beaches. Defensively minded, POKENAME builds small forts out of stones from which it can fire its waterspouts.

entry: POKENAME常受周围情绪感染，总是热情高涨。可战斗中，这反而对它不利：头上的炮威力太强，一喷水就会向后翻滚。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME regularly get swept up in the emotion of whatever those around them are feeling and are always enthusiastic. During battle this works against them as the cannon on their head is too powerful, when they shoot water they go tumbling backward.

entry: POKENAME用双臂上的一对水炮，保护自己在意的对象。高压水射出后，它还会用念力操控，确保连最擅躲避的目标也能命中。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses a pair of twin water cannons on its arms to protect those it cares for. Once the high-pressure water is shot, it telekinetically manipulates the water to ensure it strikes even the most evasive of targets.

entry: POKENAME能操控水，将水储存在壳中作武器。它能通过伸出壳的炮管，将水高速射出。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are able to manipulate water, keeping a store to weaponise within their shell. They can launch the water at high speed through the cannons jutting from their shell.

entry: POKENAME出没于污染格外严重的山泉，一边净化水，一边吓退闯入者。它的水环始终纯净无比，很受酿蜂蜜酒的人追捧。
author: ghostslythe
source: Haunting especially polluted mountain springs, POKENAME scares off trespassers while purifying the water. Their aqueous ring maintains perfect purity, and is sought for mead production.

entry: 受到威胁时，POKENAME会缩进壳里，蜷成一团。即使如此仍能发射水弹，高速撞击时，壳上的尖刺还会加重伤害。
author: darkweavile428
source: When threatened, POKENAME will hide in its shell and then curl into a ball. POKENAME can still fire its bullets of water while in this form, and its high speed tackles hurt even more thanks to the spines on its shell.

entry: POKENAME用背部炮管向猎物喷射腐蚀性凝胶。但炮管压力太大，它常站不稳，结果打偏。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME fire corrosive gel at prey through the cannons on their back. Due to the pressure that comes out of the cannons, they often lose their footing and end up missing their target.

entry: POKENAME的水流精准，常被用作高压清洗机，去除房屋污渍。它们还会与同类心灵感应，协调清洁工作。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is often used as a pressure washer to remove stains from homes thanks to its precise water jets. It communicates with others of its species via telepathy to coordinate cleaning.

entry: POKENAME体内存着大量水，能从腿部强力喷出。4个喷口同时启动，还能让它飞上天空，短距离飞行。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME hold large amounts of water in their bodies, firing it in powerful blasts from their legs. By spraying all four jets at once, these Pokémon can launch themselves into the sky, flying for short distances.

entry: POKENAME将收集的树枝存进炮管，每门最多能装60根。装满后，它就射出树枝，筑成水坝。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME stores collected sticks in its cannons, which can hold up to 60 sticks each. When they reach max capacity, POKENAME shoots out the sticks, forming a dam.

entry: POKENAME显现为一团旋转的水，中央有一颗幽灵般的头。水从石头中高压射出，射程很远，让它现身的瞬间就能猛烈撞向敌人。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME manifests itself as a mass of swirling water with a ghostly head in the center. The water launches from its stone at high pressure and over long distances, allowing it to roughly tackle foes the moment it manifests.

entry: POKENAME的鳞片硬如铠甲，会在波涛下追踪挑战者。它先用臂炮伏击，再破水而出，使出致命的音速拳。
author: ghostslythe
source: With scales hardened like armor, POKENAME stalks challengers under the waves. It ambushes by using its arm cannon followed by breaking the surface with a deadly Mach Punch.

entry: 准备开炮时，POKENAME会四肢着地，为壳中储水加压。但若还没准备好，敌人就靠得太近，它便会挥出利爪。
author: fireblade141
source: In order to fire, POKENAME will drop down onto all fours and begin pressurizing stored water within its shell. However, if a foe becomes too close for comfort before it is ready to release, it will lash out with its sharp claws.

entry: 它从背上的两门大炮中发射种子，种在自己够不到的高处。它能将种子炸弹射到30,000英尺以外。
author: soup1900
source: It launches seeds from the two cannons on its back to plant them in high places it cannot reach. It can fire Seed Bombs over 30,000 feet.

entry: POKENAME守在洞口，保护同巢伙伴。它们始终警戒，随时准备从炮管射出腐蚀性凝胶。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME protects their nestmates by standing guard at the entrance of their burrow. They vigilantly stand ready to shoot corrosive gel from their cannons.

entry: 巨颚如今成了水炮，因此POKENAME很受消防员欢迎。
author: mossybanana
source: Its jaws now function as a water cannon. As a result, POKENAME is a favorite amongst firefighters.

entry: 它在浅水处完全趴平，静静等候。猎物足够近时，就从所有炮管喷出强劲水流，连体形大出许多倍的猎物也能拿下。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: It sits completely flat in shallow areas, waiting. When prey gets close enough, it will blast high-powered water out of all its cannons, allowing it to take down prey magnitudes larger than itself.

entry: POKENAME生活在浅河附近，用大嘴舀水。受到威胁时，它们会从炮管接连喷水，将捕食者赶离幼崽。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME live near shallow rivers, using their large mouth to scoop up water. When threatened, they will fire a barrage of water blasts from their cannons, driving predators away from their young.

entry: POKENAME的水炮足以钻穿最坚韧的金属。但它懒得很，休息时有谁打扰，也只肯短暂开炮，将对方推远。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's water cannons have enough strength to bore holes through the toughest of metals. It is incredibly lazy, however, and never fires more than a short burst to push away creatures that bother it while it lounges.

entry: POKENAME热切守护巢穴，随时准备用腐蚀性凝胶击退威胁。年幼的同巢伙伴会亲昵待它、送上树果，回报它的尽责。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME zealously protect their nest from danger, and they are always ready to blast threats with a burst of corrosive gel. Their diligence is rewarded with affection and berries from their younger nestmates.

entry: POKENAME发现火灾就会赶去，用炮管喷水灭火。消防队常至少有一只POKENAME。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: When POKENAME detects fires, it rushes towards them, dousing them with water from its cannons. Firefighter teams frequently have at least one POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME上浮换气时，会从炮管喷水。庞大的身体能储存足够用一周的空气，但它们喜欢喷水，几乎每天都会上浮。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME shoot water out of their cannons when they surface for air. Their massive bodies can store a week's worth of air, but they enjoy the act of shooting water from their cannons, so they come to the surface almost daily.

entry: POKENAME壳上长有多门强力水炮，能守住很大范围。它通过脚掌吸收土中养分，为炮管提供能量。
author: sk372
source: Multiple high-power water cannons grow from POKENAME's shell, giving it a strong area of defense. The cannons are powered via nutrients from the soil that POKENAME absorbs through the palms of its feet.

entry: 许多人将POKENAME视为坚不可摧的无畏战舰。它主动进攻时，会从最远1英里外用水炮狙击，甚至很少有对手能看见攻击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is considered by many to be an impenetrable dreadnought of a Pokémon. Few even see its attacks if it goes on the offensive, as it snipes them with water blasts from its cannon from up to a mile away.

entry: POKENAME凭蓝色长耳，能察觉附近最细微的动静。同伴遇险时，它会从背上的炮管发射高压水流，保护对方。
author: fiordaliso
source: Thanks to its long blue ears, POKENAME can detect even the slightest movement nearby. It protects its companions in distress by firing jets of pressurized water from the cannons on its back.

entry: POKENAME极其敏捷，会迅速爬到高处，用炮管连续喷水。铠甲虽然坚韧，却极其轻巧，让它遇险时能灵活应对。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are incredibly agile, quickly climbing to high ground before firing a barrage of water blasts from their cannons. Despite how tough it is, their armor is incredibly lightweight, allowing for easy maneuverability when faced with danger.

entry: POKENAME的喷口水流强得会把自己弹离地面。许多人觉得很可爱，但它自尊心脆弱，只要受到一点嘲笑，就容易消沉。
author: infinex21
source: It can release such strong water jets from its waterspouts that it will launch itself off its own feet. Although many find this adorable, POKENAME's pride is fragile, and it will easily succumb to depression if laughed at in any capacity.

entry: 船员常让POKENAME帮忙海上工作。壳上的小炮能喷出稳定水流清洗甲板，也能喷压缩空气除尘。
author: beatdoof
source: Naval crews commonly employ POKENAME as a maritime assistant, utilizing the mini-cannons on its shell to expel a steady stream of water for deck cleaning, or compressed air to clear away dust.

entry: POKENAME能操控可分离的炮管，如今也能控制周围海洋中的磁流。射出的水柱精准得可怕，能击中500米外的目标。
author: beatdoof
source: POKENAME controls its detachable cannons, now able to manipulate the magnetic flow of the surrounding ocean. The water spouts it fires are frighteningly accurate, able to strike from 500 meters away.

entry: 传说中的枪剑，据说被海难中沉没的海盗王附身。会击沉船只，迫使别人遭遇相同命运。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: A legendary gun-sword said to be possessed by a shipwrecked, sunken pirate lord. It sinks ships to make others face its fate too.

entry: POKENAME利刃上附着的喷水口，让战斗多了许多技巧。除了远程射击，在合适时机喷水，还能大幅加快挥剑速度。
author: sk372
source: Water jets attached to POKENAME's blades grant it extra techniques in combat. Aside from long-range projectile moves, using the force of the jets at the right time can vastly increase the speed of its sword swings.

entry: POKENAME用能抓握的耳朵拍水，吓退袭击者。在水下，炮管既能推动身体，也能击晕猎物。
author: mr.bonesii
source: POKENAME slaps water to frighten attackers with its prehensile ears. Underwater, it can use its cannons both to propel itself and to stun prey.

entry: POKENAME依靠覆盖全身的壳作铠甲，直冲猎物，再用高压水流切割。因此，每年有超过50艘船因它沉没。
author: aglt05
source: POKENAME charges directly at its prey, relying on the shell that covers its entire body as armor before slicing them with pressurized water jets. Consequently, more than 50 ships sink per year due to this Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME能从尾巴喷出高压水流，足以穿透建筑墙壁。它还会将鬃毛与身体摩擦，积聚足够静电，打出强力电击。
author: fiordaliso
source: From its tail, POKENAME can fire high-pressure jets of water strong enough to pierce the walls of a building. By rubbing its mane against its body, it builds up enough static electricity to unleash powerful electrified blows.

entry: POKENAME钢铁般的壳如同几乎无法击穿的盾牌，与强大的水炮相得益彰。骑士般的外形，让它常被称为“水之圣骑士”。
author: starpun.
source: POKENAME's steel-like shell acts as a near impenetrable shield, matched by the power of its Hydro Pump. Given its knightly appearance, it's often called "the Paladin of Water".

entry: POKENAME的炮管不断流水，让身体在陆上也能保持湿润。战斗时，它借水炮加速，如火箭般冲出，留下的水雾闪着七彩光芒。
author: wiz0z
source: Water flows freely from POKENAME's cannons, keeping their bodies hydrated on land. When in battle, POKENAME use the cannons to enhance their speed, blasting forward like a rocket. The mist left behind shimmers with prismatic light.

entry: 缎带演化出了喷射高压水流的本领，水流强到足以击穿坚石。
author: melodydelune
source: Its ribbons have adapted to spout highly pressurized bursts of water. These ribbons can fire water hard enough to tear through solid stone.

entry: POKENAME静静滑过深海海沟，壳产生巨大的水压，压碎障碍。古代水手尊它为海洋最幽暗深处的守护者。
author: segmoph
source: POKENAME glides silently through deep ocean trenches, its shell generating immense water pressure to crush obstacles. Ancient mariners revered it as a guardian of the sea's darkest depths.

entry: POKENAME会朝来袭威胁开炮，射出水流和尖石。心理学家发现，它不喜欢自己的蓝色鳞片，因为那会让它想起盖欧卡。
author: over9001
source: POKENAME fires water as well as pointy rocks out of its cannons at incoming threats. Psychologists found out that this Pokémon doesn't like its blue colored scales, because they remind it of Kyogre.

entry: POKENAME在脑中进行大量计算，能用精准水流击中足球场另一端的目标。只有极少数宝可梦快得足以扰乱它。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can hit a target from across a football field with a precise burst of water thanks to the many calculations they perform in their head. There are only a few Pokémon that can move fast enough to confuse a POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME在领地内有君王般的影响力，能命令其他宝可梦行事。作为交换，它也有义务用坚韧的壳和强力炮管保护它们。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a kingly influence over their territory that allows them to command other Pokémon to do their bidding. In exchange for this influence, POKENAME are obliged to protect Pokémon with their tough shell and powerful cannons.

entry: POKENAME从双手喷出强劲水流，推动自己飞行。头上的炮则发射毒液，一发就能将目标浇满。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME will fire powerful water jets from their hands in order to propel themselves through the air. The cannon on their heads fires a toxic poison, coating targets in just a single shot.

entry: POKENAME常陪伴立志成为精英训练家的人，头上的炮让它在对战中射程很远。壳能提供一定保护，却挡不住更沉重的攻击。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are common companions for aspiring ace Trainers, the cannons mounted on their heads offering the Pokémon great range in Pokémon battles. Their shells offer moderate protection but cannot deflect heavier attacks.

entry: POKENAME喜欢泡泡，只要有机会洗衣服，就会把肥皂泡留到洗完后玩。加压的身体能在几分钟内洗净衣物，让家人既有干净衣服，也多些空闲。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME love bubbles, so whenever they get the opportunity to wash clothes, they save the suds to play with after the fact. Their pressurized bodies can wash clothes in a matter of minutes, giving families more free time and clean clothes.

entry: POKENAME听觉出色，能追踪远处的声音。察觉威胁时，它会用背部强力炮管射出大量魔法水，目标甚至还没发现它就在附近。
author: npshi
source: POKENAME have superb hearing, able to track sounds from afar. When they sense a threat, they will use the high-powered cannons on their back to fire large blasts of magical water at the target before they even know a POKENAME is nearby.

entry: POKENAME能从嘴里喷出强劲水流。许多赛车场会用多只POKENAME清洁看台，同时应对紧急情况。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME is capable of firing intense streams of water from its mouth. Many racecar circuits use multiple POKENAME to keep the stands clean and in case of emergency.

entry: POKENAME喷水的压力极强，能将自己反推数米。它喜欢用这种特别的方式逃跑。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME can shoot water with such pressure that it propels itself back many meters. It likes to use this as an unconventional escape method.

entry: POKENAME没有四肢，便用自身融合的遗传物质造出一队微型船员，负责操炮、装填。POKENAME常跟随船只，保护它们免遭凶暴宝可梦袭击。
author: vibrationjaveline
source: POKENAME, lacking any limbs, creates a miniature crew from its fused genetic material to man and reload its cannons. POKENAME often follow boats, protecting them from more aggressive Pokémon.

entry: 它从翅膀上排列的喷水口喷水，迅速加速，精准调整飞行轨迹。越兴奋或烦躁，水温就越高。
author: infinex21
source: It sprays water from the waterspouts lining its wings to accelerate rapidly and to make precise adjustments to its flight trajectory. The more excited or agitated it is, the hotter its water becomes.

entry: POKENAME伪装用的布料柔软而结实，壳也能抵挡攻击。它们会挤压布料下挖空的树果，让炮管喷出少量水。
author: chibitales
source: The fabric making up POKENAME's disguise is soft but sturdy, and the shell is resistant to attacks. They are able to spray small amounts of water from their cannons by squeezing hollowed berries under the fabric.

entry: POKENAME的水炮威力很大，开炮几秒就能在地上钻出洞。它战斗时常忘乎所以，给周围大部分战场造成严重破坏。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's hydro cannons pack enough force to bore holes into the ground within seconds of firing. It often gets carried away during combat and causes heavy damage to much of the surrounding battlefield.

entry: POKENAME利用压强达每平方英寸200磅的喷水推进，在空中疾驰。据说，如果毫无预兆地下起雨来，就说明附近有POKENAME。
author: rkmaster25367
source: POKENAME blasts across the sky with its 200-PSI water jets. When it starts raining without warning, it is said that a POKENAME is nearby.

entry: POKENAME像瞄准消防水管一样瞄准尾巴，喷出滚烫蒸汽。9个喷口各自专喷水或喷火，两类喷口的数量因个体而异。
author: foolish_weasel
source: It aims its tails like a fire hose, jetting out a scalding steam. Each of a POKENAME's nine nozzles specializes in spraying either fire or water, the number of which differs from one POKENAME to another.

entry: 有些POKENAME每年至少一次，会耗尽所有能量，靠喷水将自己射向太空。能量用尽便陷入休眠，猛然坠落，披甲的头最先撞上地面。
author: infinex21
source: At least once a year, some POKENAME will use all their energy to launch themselves toward space with water. They fall dormant after exhausting all their energy and come crashing down, their shell-clad heads being the first to touch the ground.

entry: POKENAME用背部巨炮往天然洼地灌水，将其改造成沼泽。湿度渐渐升高后，它就转而向迁来新沼泽的虫属性宝可梦发射石块。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME terraforms natural depressions into swamps by flooding the area with the massive cannon on its back. As the humidity slowly rises, POKENAME switch to shooting rocks at Bug-type Pokémon that migrate to these newly formed swamps.

entry: POKENAME炮管射出的水往往浑浊难闻。一家化妆品公司却将其用作护肤霜的秘密原料，因为水中的矿物质对人类皮肤很有益。
author: wiz0z
source: The water POKENAME fire from their cannons tends to be murky and foul-smelling. A cosmetic company uses this water as a secret ingredient in their skin cream because the minerals in the water are very good for human skin.

entry: POKENAME全身覆着坚固的壳，防御出众。它会从顶端的洞伸头观察，再从前方伸出水炮，轰走试图招惹它的对象。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's sturdy full-body shell gives it impeccable defenses. It pops its head through a hole in the top for surveillance, and extends a water cannon from the front to blast away anything that tries to mess with it.

entry: POKENAME背上的气泡如今已完全长成一朵花。身上的植物是水生的，因此大多生活在阳光仍能照到的水下。
author: soup1900
source: The bubble on its back has now fully grown into a flower. Most POKENAME live underwater where the sun can still reach them, as their flora are aquatic.

entry: POKENAME笨手笨脚，尾巴老是把东西点着。接着便用水炮灭火，可通常又喷得太多。
author: incognito1234
source: A clumsy Pokémon, POKENAME constantly sets fire to things with its tail. It then uses its cannons to put out the fire, usually using too much water.

entry: POKENAME用气球般的身体吸入大量水，再从炮管射出。但若身体胀得太大，水流就很难瞄准。
author: empty_set
source: It uses its balloon-like body to suck in enormous amounts of water to fire out of its cannons. However, if POKENAME inflates to too large a size, it has a difficult time aiming its water jets.

entry: POKENAME从头部炮管射出一簇簇湿毛，将树顶的树果击落。背上虽然有坚固的壳，它在水里和陆上都很敏捷。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME shoots tufts of wet fur from the cannons on its head to knock berries off the tops of trees and make them fall to the ground. Despite the sturdy shell on its back, it is very agile both in and out of the water.

entry: POKENAME用身体周围的神秘凝胶吸水，再从背部炮管射出。凝胶泡表面张开孔洞后，身体便会膨大，能存下好几升水。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME soak up water with the mysterious gel that surrounds their body and fire water from the cannons on their back. By opening pores within the gel bubble, POKENAME can store several liters of water as their body swells in size.

entry: 它们凭敏锐的视力，能击落飞过的其他飞行属性宝可梦。沉重的壳很快就会让小翅膀疲惫，因此它们会浮在湖面上休息。
author: .jerden
source: Their keen eyesight enables them to shoot down other Flying-type Pokémon as they fly past. The heavy weight of their shell quickly tires out their small wings, so they float on the surface of lakes to rest.

entry: POKENAME用水炮向地下挖掘，寻找猎物。雄性也会在求偶仪式中用水炮吸引雌性。
author: amphi64
source: POKENAME use their water cannons to dig underground in search of prey. These cannons are also used by males during courtship rituals to seduce females.

entry: POKENAME不太愿意开炮，更喜欢将炮管当作战利品骄傲展示。但若被激怒，它的炮几乎能无穷无尽地射出穿透力强的水流。
author: crumple_2
source: POKENAME prefer not to use their cannon and display it proudly as a trophy. If provoked, however, the cannon on a POKENAME can fire a near-endless supply of piercing water.

entry: POKENAME能从炮管射出一团团蛛丝，如网般困住大型生物。趁目标无法动弹，它就咬上去，吸取少量静电。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can fire out bursts of webbing from its cannons like netting that trap larger creatures. It takes advantage of the target's immobility to bite them and absorb small amounts of static electricity.

entry: POKENAME用尖刺攀附洞壁，吸收岩石中的水分，再用头上的炮射出强劲水流，赶走捕食者。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME use their spikes to cling to cave walls, absorbing moisture from the rock. Using this water, POKENAME can fire powerful blasts of water from the cannons on their heads, warding off predators.

entry: POKENAME悄悄飞到其他飞行属性宝可梦身后，用壳上两门水炮精准击落。等对方掉下，它就刺入尖牙吸血。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME flies up stealthily behind other Flying-type Pokémon and shoots them down with precisely targeted blasts from the two water cannons on its shell. Once they have fallen, POKENAME sinks its fangs in to drink blood.

entry: POKENAME从地下深处撬出巨大宝石，带到地下水道当作载具。战斗时，它会与对手保持距离，用水流远程攻击。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME pry gigantic gemstones from deep underground and bring them to subterranean waterways to use as transport. During battle they keep their distance from their opponent, using blasts of water to fight from a distance.

entry: POKENAME从地下深处撬出巨大宝石，带到地下水道当作载具。战斗时，它会与对手保持距离，用水流远程攻击。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME pry gigantic gemstones from deep underground and bring them to subterranean waterways to use as transport. During battle they keep their distance from their opponent, using blasts of water to fight from a distance.

entry: POKENAME从炮管喷出汹涌水流，推动身体在水中疾行，速度堪比机动车。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME produce a torrent of water from their cannons that propel them swiftly through the water. The cannons help them reach speeds that rival motor vehicles.

entry: POKENAME性情凶猛，双颚能咬碎金属，炮管一喷水就能清掉旧车上的油漆和锈。它强势霸道，很难训练，刚收服时尤其如此。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are ferocious creatures that can crush metal with their jaws and clear paint and rust off old cars with a single blast from their cannons. Their domineering personality makes them difficult to train, especially if recently caught.

entry: POKENAME看似裹着布，材料却比石头还坚实。它射出冰冷的水流，精准得仿佛能提前知道目标下一步的位置。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: While POKENAME may appear to be wrapped in cloth, the material is sturdier than stone. POKENAME blasts precise streams of chilling water, almost seeming to detect where the target will be before they move.

entry: POKENAME击落其他宝可梦后，水炮就会缩回嘴里。这样它便能飞到目标身边，刺入尖牙吸血。
author: .jerden
source: After shooting down another Pokémon, POKENAME's water cannon retracts back inside its mouth. This enables it to fly over to its target, sink its fangs in, and drain blood.

entry: 干旱时，POKENAME会用背部炮管喷水，给宝可梦供水。可惜水常会使对方暂时麻痹，让它很沮丧。
author: yeet17_60299
source: It sprays water from the cannon on its back during droughts and gives water to Pokémon. Unfortunately, said water often causes temporary paralysis, much to POKENAME's dismay.

entry: POKENAME常陪着擦窗工人，水炮虽小，却能覆盖很大范围。此外，只要沐浴月光，储水就会完全补满。
author: theaceofhearts0306
source: Commonly seen alongside window cleaners, POKENAME's water cannon can cover a large area despite its size. In addition, its water storage fully replenishes when exposed to moonlight.

entry: POKENAME的壳更重，跳舞比进化前稍慢。炮管射出的沸水，温度能达华氏212度。
author: roundabout_robin
source: POKENAME dances slightly slower than its pre-evolutions due to its heavier shell. The boiling water it shoots from its cannons can reach a temperature of 212 degrees Fahrenheit.

entry: POKENAME常在脏污的河湖里出现，吃污染水域的垃圾。吃下的垃圾会混进它从炮管射出的水中。
author: darkweavile428
source: POKENAME are often found in filthy rivers and lakes, eating the trash that has polluted the water. The trash it eats mixes into the water it shoots out of its cannons.

entry: POKENAME从头上伸出的炮管发出强劲次声波。既能作进攻武器，也能用来导航，靠聆听回声弥补视力不佳。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME emit powerful infrasonic blasts from the cannons protruding from their heads. They can use these blasts both as an offensive weapon and also as a navigation tool, listening for echoes to make up for their poor eyesight.

entry: POKENAME能用炮管以超音速喷水，却无法长时间维持所需压力。它的身体脆弱，难以承受后坐力，因此只在最后关头才使出这招。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are capable of blasting water at supersonic speeds from their cannons, though they cannot maintain the pressure needed for the attacks long. They use this attack as a last resort, their bodies frail and unable to easily handle the recoil.

entry: POKENAME能用炮管以超音速喷水，却无法长时间维持所需压力。开炮前，它会将身体压低贴地，减轻后坐力对自身的伤害。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are capable of blasting water at supersonic speeds from their cannons, though they cannot maintain the pressure needed for the attacks long. They lower their body to the ground before firing in order to protect themselves from the recoil.

entry: POKENAME一炮就能将黏稠凝胶喷满敌人，黏住毛发、羽毛和鳞片。再开一炮又能迅速冲净，正适合获胜后清理。
author: quackquackattack
source: A single blast from POKENAME's cannon can coat foes with a sticky gel that clings to fur, feathers, and scales. Another blast can quickly wash away this gel, which is perfect for after POKENAME achieve victory.

entry: POKENAME反复用臂炮射出能击碎钢铁的水流，狠狠蹂躏敌人。破坏肆虐时，它还借喷水后坐力，用坚硬的壳猛烈撞击建筑。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME repeatedly fires steel-shattering jet streams of water from its arm cannons to brutalize foes. It uses the recoil from these blasts to smash with great force into buildings with its hardened shell during its destructive rampages.

entry: POKENAME能操控内含水炮的触手，射击因此极准。触手若被斩断，一周内就会长回来。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can manipulate the tentacles housing water cannons, giving it excellent accuracy with its shots. If said tentacles are severed, they will grow back within a week.

entry: POKENAME用嘴里的炮向对手快速连射尖刺。体内储水能防止它在攻击时过热。
author: santon5512
source: Using the cannons in their mouths, POKENAME will rapidly fire spikes at opponents. They store water within their bodies, helping to prevent them from overheating while attacking.

entry: POKENAME头上的炮精准无比，能从极远处狙击目标。若在近处受威胁，它会缩进壳里旋转，向四面八方射出暴雨般的尖刺。
author: evilgammon
source: The cannon on POKENAME's head is incredibly accurate, with it able to snipe its target from incredible distances. When threatened up close, it will hunker down in its shell and start to spin, sending a storm of spines flying in all directions.

entry: POKENAME沿海底爬行，吃一切沉到底部的东西。它用背部炮管射出强劲水流，抵御从上方接近的捕食者。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME crawls along the ocean floor, feeding on anything that sinks to the bottom. It uses the cannons on its back to fire powerful jets of water, fending off any predator that approaches from above.

entry: POKENAME速度惊人，却很难在转向时保持冲势。它会启动颈部周围的水炮，不减速就改变方向，也能用炮管将自己远远射出。
author: sleepyman0731
source: POKENAME has incredible speed but has difficulty turning without losing momentum. It activates the water cannons around its neck to change direction while maintaining its speed. POKENAME also uses its cannons to launch itself across long distances.

entry: POKENAME速度惊人，却很难在转向时保持冲势。它会启动颈部周围的水炮，不减速就改变方向，也能用炮管将自己远远射出。
author: sleepyman0731
source: POKENAME has incredible speed but has difficulty turning without losing momentum. It activates the water cannons around its neck to change direction while maintaining its speed. POKENAME also uses its cannons to launch itself across long distances.

entry: POKENAME在毛皮下藏着强力炮管，用来向对手发射石块。它在山中捕猎时，厚甲能保护身体免受落石伤害。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME conceal a high-powered cannon beneath their fur, which they use to fire rocks at opponents. The thick armor covering their bodies protects these Pokémon from falling rocks as they hunt in the mountains.

entry: POKENAME用头后的炮管飞行。危急时，即使身处高空，也能缩回保护性的壳里，安全落地。
author: camtft
source: POKENAME flies with the cannons behind their head. In a pinch, they are able to slink back into their protective shell from high into the sky to land safely upon the ground.

entry: POKENAME有两种鳞片。棕色鳞片长成厚重的甲壳，构成强大防御；蓝色鳞片则成为强力炮管的重型弹药。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME has two types of scales. The brown-colored scales grow into heavily armored shells used as a formidable defense. The blue-colored scales become heavy-duty ammo for its mighty cannons.

entry: POKENAME是胆小的恶霸，用强力水炮攻击弱小宝可梦。一发现更强的宝可梦出现，就会缩进壳里，爬着逃走。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are cowardly bullies, using their powerful water cannons to attack weaker Pokémon but tucking into their shell and crawling away at the first signs of a stronger Pokémon.

entry: 这种宝可梦的壳表面坚韧，内部身体却很脆弱。水中的盐分很容易损坏它鲜艳的颜色。
author: puppylev
source: The surface of this Pokémon's shell is tough, but its inner body is fragile. The salt levels in the water can easily damage its vibrant colours.

entry: POKENAME虽然能射出高压水，也能控制流量，让水缓缓流出。豪宅会用它为植物洒水，也会将它作为装饰喷泉的中心。
author: .jerden
source: Although POKENAME can fire out high-pressure water, they can also control the rate of flow to release it more gently. POKENAME are used in mansions both as sprinkler systems for plants and as the centerpiece of ornamental fountains.

entry: POKENAME头顶和背上一样，覆着厚壳，连最强的冲击都能抵挡。背上的炮能喷出细小却威力惊人的水柱。
author: st4rdustyugure
source: The top of POKENAME's head, like its back, is covered by a thick shell that protects it from even the strongest impacts. The cannons on its back can release small but incredibly powerful water jets.

entry: POKENAME住在海底森林，吸取海带的生命。与其他宝可梦争领地时，它靠硬壳防守、强力炮管进攻。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME live within underwater forests, leeching life from the kelp. In territorial disputes with other Pokémon, they rely on their hardened shells for defense and their powerful cannons for offense.

entry: POKENAME是罕见而英勇的林地宝可梦，住在河流附近。它射出的高压水流精准，能轻易穿透船体，还会无私地替其他宝可梦挡下攻击，即使素不相识也不例外。
author: bobosmith01
source: A valiant and rare woodland Pokémon that dwells near rivers, POKENAME can fire accurate pressurized blasts of water that could easily pierce the hull of a ship. It selflessly takes blows meant for other Pokémon, even strangers.

entry: 几个世纪前，战舰曾用POKENAME进行海战。画面中，它们走向船头，一边挡开炮火，一边用种子炸弹轰击敌舰。
author: pkbonusducks
source: Centuries ago, warships employed POKENAME for naval combat. They were depicted heading toward the ship's bow, simultaneously deflecting cannon fire while bombarding enemy vessels with Seed Bombs.

entry: POKENAME背上的炮能以高压射出手里剑。壳太妨碍行动，有时能见到它试图将壳打碎。
author: hiroshima0042_23263
source: The cannons on POKENAME back fire high pressure shuriken blasts. The shell on POKENAME slows it down too much and sometimes POKENAME can be seen trying to break it.

entry: 夜里，POKENAME受水中月影吸引，聚集在池塘边。被激怒时，它们会从尾巴喷出一团团毒粉。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME congregate around ponds at night, attracted to the moon's reflection on the water. If provoked, they fire puffs of toxic powder from their tails.

entry: POKENAME能通过全身5门炮喷水，每秒可发射10次。它大部分时间都主动寻找火源扑灭，从大规模森林火灾到后院烧烤都不放过。
author: ruben2309295
source: POKENAME shoot water through the five cannons on their bodies, capable of firing ten shots per second. POKENAME spend most of their time actively looking for fires to put out, from full-scale forest fires to backyard BBQs.

entry: POKENAME很容易发怒，稍受挑衅便敌意大起，朝惹恼自己的家伙喷出滚烫蒸汽。
author: incognito1234
source: POKENAME angers easily, becoming hostile at even the slightest provocation. It will then blast the agitator with scalding steam from its cannons.

entry: POKENAME从地下以极高速度喷出泥水，压力足以穿透坚实的岩石。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME fires muddy water jets from underground at extreme speed. The pressure is strong enough to pierce solid stone.

entry: POKENAME吞水后从尾巴排出，像推进器一样推动身体，速度惊人。工程师研究这种独特的移动方式，希望从中获得灵感，开发更高效的喷水推进器。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME swallows water and expels it through its tails, using them like thrusters to propel itself with surprising speed. Engineers have studied this unique method of movement as inspiration for developing more efficient pump-jets.

entry: POKENAME从地道喷出汹涌水流，将猎物从树上击落，再把摩鲁蛾等被打晕的目标拖进土里吃。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME blasts torrents of water from its tunnels to knock prey from trees. It drags stunned targets like Venomoth beneath the dirt to feast.

entry: POKENAME的壳极其坚韧，抵御着经常交战的敌人。灵活的身手让它能爬到树顶，瞄准后用强力水炮猛轰。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME's shell is incredibly tough, shielding it from foes it often battles. Thanks to its agility, it can climb to the tops of trees, from where it takes aim and blasts its enemies with powerful water cannons.

entry: POKENAME会随着压力伸缩水炮。每当头痛时，炮管就会收缩，使它难以喷水。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME extends and retracts its water cannons in response to stress. Whenever it experiences a headache, the cannons contract and make it difficult to shoot water.

entry: POKENAME越生气，炮管的水压和准头就越高。出色的臂力，也让它成为极强的游泳者。
author: steamedveggies.
source: The angrier POKENAME gets, the higher the pressure and accuracy of its cannons. Its exceptional arm strength makes POKENAME an incredibly strong swimmer.

entry: POKENAME有两门强力炮，能射出高压水流。它既敏捷又有力，常是消防员忠诚的宠物。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are equipped with two powerful cannons used to shoot high-pressure streams. They are often loyal pets of firefighters because of their agility and strength.

entry: 它会从炮管中喷出滚烫的蒸汽。这些蒸汽能造成4度烧伤，烧穿皮肤，甚至危及生命。
author: soup1900
source: It ejects scalding steam from its cannons. This steam can cause 4th-degree burns, meaning it'll burn through your skin and potentially kill you.

entry: POKENAME等待进化时，壳能保护身体。但壳的重量让它难以游泳，想快速移动，就会用壳上的双炮将自己向后推。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have a protective shell that keeps them safe while they wait to evolve. The weight of the shell keeps them from being able to easily swim, so they use the twin cannons on their shell to blast themselves backward if they need to move fast.

entry: 关都的宝可梦研究者观察到，POKENAME会在河流中与蚊香泳士争夺主导地位。虽然个头更小，研究者仍推测双炮能让它占优。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Pokémon researchers in Kanto have observed POKENAME competing with Poliwrath within river environments for dominance. Though smaller, they theorise that POKENAME have an advantage thanks to the twin cannons they sport.

entry: 融合让POKENAME的炮管变得更加灵活，便于瞄准。如今，水炮不仅威力更强，也打得更准。
author: skymaster426
source: Fusion has granted POKENAME more flexible cannons with which to aim. Its water blasts have increased in power, as well as precision.

entry: POKENAME在铁匠铺帮忙，凭力量和多条手臂锤打金属、进行淬火，让工作更顺畅。使用它的地方还报告说，游客变多了。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME assist in smithies, helping streamline the work by using their strength and multiple arms to hammer and quench metal. Locations using POKENAME report an increase in tourism.

entry: POKENAME扎根地下，从土中汲水，存进壳里。受到威胁时，它就向敌人连续发射水弹，因此园丁常养它保护作物。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME remain rooted in the ground, drawing water from the soil and storing it in their shells. When threatened, it unleashes a relentless volley of water bullets at its foe. For this reason, it is often kept by gardeners to protect their crops.

entry: POKENAME进化时获得的壳已长大，容下背部长出的炮管。战斗时，它们更喜欢缩进壳里防守，从远处喷水。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: The shells that POKENAME gain upon evolution have grown to accommodate the cannons growing from their back. They tuck themselves into their shells during battle, preferring to stay on the defensive and blast water from afar.

entry: POKENAME住在沼泽，穿过草丛捕猎。胃里有强酸，能从嘴里的炮管射出。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME make their homes in marshes, hunting their prey through the grass. Their stomachs contain a powerful acid, which they fire from the cannons in their mouths.

entry: POKENAME把尾巴当水管，以高压水柱般的方式向敌人喷强酸，连坚实的钢铁都能溶穿。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME will use their tails like a hose, spraying powerful acid at their enemies in a high-pressure stream. This acid is capable of melting through solid steel.

entry: POKENAME用背部炮管喷出汹涌水流，侵蚀岩石，使其变软、可食。若饿极了又找不到岩石，也会吃淤泥和沙子滋养身体。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME erode rocks by releasing torrents of water from the cannons on their back, making the rocks soft and edible. If POKENAME are desperate for food and are unable to locate rocks, they will eat silt and sand to nourish themselves.

entry: POKENAME怕受伤，始终把头缩在壳里。这样它就能蜷成球，再用炮管喷水，推动自己前进。
author: bigoljax
source: For fear of possible injuries, POKENAME keep their heads tucked into their shells at all times. This allows them to roll into a ball, firing water out of their cannons to propel themselves forward.

entry: POKENAME让火焰高高燃起，想引来毫无戒备的火属性宝可梦，再用炮管接连喷水猛攻。
author: camtft
source: POKENAME burns their flames high into the sky in an attempt to lure in unsuspecting fire types to suffer a barrage of water from their cannon.

entry: POKENAME部分身体覆着铠甲般坚韧的壳。它常用角和蒸汽攻击，也能从体侧炮管射出滚烫的水。
author: infinex21
source: A POKENAME's body is partly clad in a tough, armor-like shell. Though it often fights using horns and blasts of steam, it can unleash scalding water from cannons along its sides.

entry: POKENAME被逼到绝境时，会从尾炮喷出高压水流。但它反应很慢，常出手太迟，可能打不中目标。
author: fiordaliso
source: When cornered, it fires pressurized jets of water from the cannon on its tail. However, POKENAME's reflexes are quite slow, and it often launches its attacks too late, risking missing the target.

entry: POKENAME用毛茸茸的尾巴擦亮炮管，确保双炮都闪着一样明亮的白光。若尾巴脏了，它就向整个区域喷水，直到冲掉污垢，或冲走弄脏尾巴的罪魁祸首。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME polish their cannons with their fuzzy tails, making sure that they both shine the same brilliant white. If their tails get dirty, they will spray the entire area with water until they wash the dirt or the offender away.

entry: POKENAME的炮实际上由背上的大舌贝控制，因此射击极准，毫无死角。
author: voxposs
source: POKENAME's cannons are actually controlled by Shellder on its back. As a result, it's able to shoot extremely accurately and have no blind spots.

entry: POKENAME能从体侧两门炮射出大量泡泡。泡泡略带磁性，更容易命中金属物体或钢属性宝可梦。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can fire a large amount of bubbles from both of the cannons on its side. These bubbles are tinted with a bit of magnetism, making it easier to hit metal objects or Steel-type Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME操纵磁波，能随意调整双炮的位置，精准控制。敏锐的眼睛让它能轻松瞄准160英尺以外的目标，射出带电水流脉冲。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME has precise control of its two cannons by manipulating magnetic waves to reposition them at will. Its keen eye can easily aim to hit targets from over 160 feet away with pulses of electrically charged water.

entry: 建筑起火时，POKENAME会与消防员一起喷水灭火。炮管般的多用途短棍，让它们能从很远处扑灭火焰。
author: quackquackattack
source: When a building is on fire, POKENAME work alongside firefighters to shoot jets of water at fires. Their versatile cannon-like baton allows them to put out flames from a long distance.

entry: POKENAME看似没有正常的头，却能敏锐感知周围。它战斗时迅速灵活，会借跳跃从不同角度开炮喷水。
author: sk372
source: Despite seeming to lack a normal head, POKENAME is able to sense its surroundings rather acutely. It is quite speedy and agile in combat, using leaping maneuvers to fire jets of water from its cannons at various angles.

entry: POKENAME身上长出的水炮，各有一个能运作的简单大脑。主头能在一定程度上影响它们，但它们仍可能冲动行事，受惊时凭本能开炮喷水。
author: sk372
source: The water cannons growing from POKENAME's body have rudimentary functional brains of their own. POKENAME's main head can influence them to an extent, but they can act impulsively and fire water shots on instinct when startled.

entry: POKENAME在世界各地游动，会用背部炮管射出冰冷水束，推开浮冰。不习惯寒冷的宝可梦，挨到这些水束，很快就会失温。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME shoot chilling beams of water from their back cannons to push past floating ice as they swim through the world. These beams of water can quickly cause hypothermia in Pokémon that are not used to the cold.

entry: POKENAME看似一团没有分化的污泥，但构成身体的各部分化学成分不同。胸背部分比身体其余部位更致密，能起到保护作用。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Despite looking like a mass of undifferentiated sludge, the components making up the bodies of POKENAME have varying chemical compositions. The parts forming their chest and back are denser than the rest of their bodies, protecting them.

entry: 工业污水流入含水层和河流，会形成POKENAME。身体油腻，浮在水面上；产生的油既提供浮力，也污染了它们所住的水域。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME form from industrial runoff into aquifers and rivers. Their bodies are oily and float on the surface of the water; the oil produced from them provides buoyancy but also pollutes the water they live in.

entry: 工业污水流入含水层和河流，会形成POKENAME。身体油腻，浮在水面上；产生的油既提供浮力，也污染了它们所住的水域。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME form from industrial runoff into aquifers and rivers. Their bodies are oily and float on the surface of the water; the oil produced from them provides buoyancy but also pollutes the water they live in.

entry: 融合能量将POKENAME与体内休眠的遗传物质结合起来。如今它的甲壳坚不可摧，连炮火也无法伤害它。
author: zoroark73
source: Fusion energy has fused POKENAME with its dormant DNA. Its shell is now indestructible; not even cannon fire can harm it.

entry: POKENAME的生活方式与水箭龟相似：强壳负责保护，炮管负责压倒性的进攻。不过，比起其他水域，它更常出现在海边。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME lives similarly to Blastoise: its powerful shell allows for great protection, and the cannon allows for overwhelming offense. However, POKENAME is found far more often by the sea than it is other bodies of water.

entry: POKENAME出没于潮湿环境，造出装有亡灵的泡泡。每个泡泡都能喷出一股水，然后破裂，释放里面的灵魂。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are found in humid environments where they conjure bubbles that contain spirits of the dead. Each bubble is capable of blasting a burst of water before popping, which releases the spirits inside.

entry: POKENAME的炮管偏向侧面，若敌人在正前方，就必须转动整个身体，才能瞄准开炮。不过，它的准头仍很高。
author: zaymcawesome
source: Since POKENAME 's cannons are tilted sideways, if the foe were in front of it, it would have to turn its entire body to aim its cannon so it can blast them. But it also has high accuracy.

entry: POKENAME用背部炮管射出螺旋水流。水流虽不特别强，却似乎会让对手恍惚入迷，无法攻击。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME fires spiraling streams of water from the cannons on its back. Despite not being particularly powerful, the streams seem to put its opponents into a trance, making them unable to attack.

entry: POKENAME钳中炮管射出的水，威力足以砸凹坚实的钢铁。它主要用来赶走其他捕食者，免得对方争抢自己找来的蛤蜊和贝类。
author: sk372
source: Blasts of water shot from the cannon in POKENAME's claw hit with enough force to dent solid steel. It primarily uses it to repel other predators competing for the clams and shellfish it scrounges up for food.

entry: 这种宝可梦乍看只是普通水箭龟，身上却有许多独特纹路。现已证实，这些是融合基因流经的脉络。
author: soup1900
source: While at first glance this Pokémon may just look like a regular Blastoise, it has many unique markings on its body. These markings have been proven to be veins where the fusion genetics flow through.

entry: 它的外貌与超级POKENAME极为相似。背上巨大的炮管，让它像一辆长了腿的坦克。
author: soup1900
source: Its appearance is extremely similar to that of Mega POKENAME. The large cannon on its back makes it look like a tank with legs.

entry: 它外形极像超级水箭龟，但不同的是，脸上和壳上布满纹路，融合基因在这些地方最明显。使用强力招式时，纹路还会微微发光。
author: soup1900
source: Its appearance is extremely similar to that of Mega Blastoise. Unlike Mega Blastoise, however, it has many markings over its face and shell where fusion genetics are most visible. These markings glow faintly when it uses powerful moves.

entry: 融合能量在POKENAME体内奔涌，使全身长出粗糙斑块。准备开炮时，斑块就会变硬，维持平衡，减轻后坐力。
author: sondededoo
source: Fusion energy courses through POKENAME's body, causing rough patches to form all over its body. When it prepares fire, these patches will harden to maintain POKENAME's balance and mitigate recoil.

entry: 它长得像超极巨化POKENAME。壳上足足有31门炮，会朝敌人不停地倾泻炮火。
author: soup1900
source: Its appearance is similar to that of Gigantamax POKENAME. It has 31 cannons on its shell that it barrages endlessly against its foes.

entry: 融合唤醒了这种宝可梦的部分超极巨化基因，使外形类似超极巨化水箭龟。它能用壳上的众多炮管，接连发射大量水炮。
author: soup1900
source: Fusion has caused this Pokémon to awaken part of its Gigantamax genes, causing its appearance to be similar to that of Gigantamax Blastoise. It can volley a multitude of blasts using the many cannons on its shell.

entry: POKENAME用黏稠树液，将其他宝可梦丢弃的硬壳黏在背上保护自己。树液含有轻微的麻痹毒素，碰到就会发麻。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME protect themselves with tough shells discarded by other Pokémon, attaching them to their back with a sticky sap. The sap they use contains a mild paralytic toxin that causes a numbness in anything that touches them.

entry: POKENAME常到潮池觅食，所用的头盔和武器都由干珊瑚制成。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME frequent tide pools in search of food. The helmet and weapon they use are made of dried coral.

entry: POKENAME在海中漂游，或随洋流，或从尖刺喷气移动。身体若突然被碰到，就会从所有尖刺猛烈放出空气和毒气。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME drift through the ocean, either riding currents or releasing bursts of air from their spikes to move around. If they experience sudden physical contact, they explosively release air and poisonous gas from all of their spikes.

entry: POKENAME沿海底缓慢跋涉，舔食海带和其他海底植物。遍布身体的厚壳板坚固得很，有时被攻击好几分钟，它甚至都没察觉。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME trudges along the sea floor slowly, lapping up kelp and other undersea plants for food. The many thick shell plates across its body are so sturdy it may not even notice it is being attacked for several minutes.

entry: POKENAME玩耍着吹泡泡时，偶尔会不小心吐出珍珠。这些稀有宝石深受收藏家珍视，会被送上拍卖会。
author: .izik
source: While bubbling playfully, POKENAME sometimes spits out a pearl by accident. These rare gems are prized by collectors and sold at auction.

entry: POKENAME每月蜕下厚鳞，在重新长好前都很脆弱。它通常沿海底游动，寻找小贝壳吃。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME sheds its thick scales every month, leaving itself vulnerable until they grow back. It usually swims along the seafloor, looking for small seashells to eat.

entry: POKENAME攀上瀑布，寻找僻静的水潭，在远离窥探的地方制造、藏好璀璨珍珠。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME climbs waterfalls in search of quiet pools. There, it creates and hides its dazzling pearls far from prying eyes.

entry: 鲤鱼王群常让POKENAME加入，帮助大家生存。它虽然游得较慢，硬壳却会让捕猎者徒劳地浪费时间，鲤鱼王便趁机逃到安全处。
author: sk372
source: Schools of Magikarp often integrate POKENAME into their ranks for aid in survival. While unable to swim as quickly, POKENAME's tough shell means hunters will waste time futilely trying to prey on it while the Magikarp flee to safety.

entry: POKENAME藏在岩石和成片藤壶之间，伪装成大贝壳。不幸靠近的潜水者，会迎来甩打的尾巴和咬合的双颚。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME nestles itself in rocks and patches of barnacles, disguising itself as a large shell. Any unfortunate diver who gets close will be met with its thrashing tail and snapping jaws.

entry: 据说骑乘POKENAME十分安全，坚壳能撑过巨牙鲨的多次袭击。它只需极少食物就能继续前进，一天吃1至2颗树果便够了。
author: mistymagius
source: Riding on a POKENAME is said to be very safe, as its tough shell is strong enough to survive multiple Sharpedo attacks. It needs very little food to keep going, only needing one or two berries a day.

entry: POKENAME合上壳时，茧中的身体几乎不会受到伤害。它只有确认周围空无一物，才会开壳挪动，搜寻食物。
author: sk372
source: When POKENAME's shell is shut, its cocooned body is almost completely impervious to harm. It only opens the shell when it is sure nothing is around, so it can shift around to scrounge up food.

entry: POKENAME主要吃刺甲贝等硬壳宝可梦。锋利的刃足以切开、撕裂外壳，让它大吃里面的部分。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's primary source of food is tough-shelled Pokémon like Cloyster. Its blades are sharp enough to carve through the shells, tearing them apart so it can feast on what lies inside.

entry: 海岸洞穴中曾发现POKENAME的化石遗骸。覆盖身体的坚固壳甲，硬度堪比钢铁。
author: mepp.
source: The fossilized remains of POKENAME have been discovered in coastal caves. Its tough shell plating that covers its body is as hard as steel.

entry: 寻宝者盛赞POKENAME守护的完美虹彩珍珠。每只只制造一颗，唯有赢得信任，或证明自己没有私心的对象，才能见到。
author: pkbonusducks
source: Treasure hunters speak highly of the perfect iridescent pearls guarded by POKENAME. Each of these Pokémon only create one pearl, and it's only revealed to those who earn POKENAME's trust or prove their intents are selfless.

entry: 野生POKENAME通常住在关都，太热时就会迁往其他地区，大多前往神奥北部。但许多撑不过凶险的旅程，失去意识，漂到荒岛或遥远海岸。
author: duskit___
source: Wild POKENAME usually live in Kanto, but when it gets too hot, they migrate to other regions. Most travel to northern Sinnoh, though many do not survive the perilous journey and faint, washing up on desolate islands or distant shores.

entry: POKENAME睡觉时，会产生微微发光的黄色珍珠。珍珠带着残余电力，随它移动散落，像面包屑一样留下一路痕迹。
author: .izik
source: While sleeping, POKENAME generates faintly glowing yellow pearls. Charged with residual electricity, the pearls are left behind like a breadcrumb trail as POKENAME travels.

entry: POKENAME住在深海，坚固的壳抵御着那里的强大水压。诱饵发出暗红光，让它能在黑暗中看清，又不暴露位置。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME lives in the deep ocean, its durable shell protecting it from the crushing pressure down there. Its lure gives off a dull red light, allowing it to see in the dark without giving away its location.

entry: 它抱着能储存静电的南国贝壳，贝壳会因此变得鲜红。无论战斗还是平时，只要将电放出，贝壳就会恢复灰紫色。
author: quackquackattack
source: It holds onto a Tropical Shell that stores static electricity, which turns the shell a bright red. Whenever it discharges the electricity in battle or otherwise, its shell returns to a greyish purple.

entry: POKENAME在海底翻找垃圾，用舌头寻找食物。它还能将舌头当作螺旋桨，高速向后游。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME scavenge for trash along the sea floor, searching for food with their tongues. Using their tongues as a propeller, these Pokémon can swim backwards at high speeds.

entry: 前来打扰POKENAME的，通常是大型底栖食者。它会舔过对方身体，取走沾附的养分，再恢复休眠，几乎不耗能量。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: When other Pokémon disturb POKENAME, usually large bottom feeders, POKENAME will run its tongue over their body, grabbing any nutrients that have been caught. They then return to dormancy, using barely any energy.

entry: POKENAME喜欢什么，就会用长舌舔。野外常能见到它拼命舔闪亮的东西。
author: aberry8286
source: It licks objects with its long tongue when it has a fondness for them. Wild POKENAME are often seen licking shiny objects vigorously.

entry: POKENAME能用舌头精准抓取远处物体。它们潜在水下跟随航船，希望接住垃圾，带回家族的巢穴作装饰。
author: npshi
