source: POKENAME can use their tongues to precisely grab objects from afar. POKENAME follow travelling ships under the water, hoping to catch any litter and bring it back to their families to display in their nests as a decoration.

entry: POKENAME用舌头察觉壳周围的危险。夜晚会完全合上壳睡觉。
author: northkira
source: POKENAME uses its tongue to detect danger around its shell. At night, POKENAME fully encloses itself to sleep.

entry: POKENAME用舌头在河床挖小洞筑巢，等呆弟弟将尾巴伸进水里，就能夹住它的尾巴。
author: equation8573
source: POKENAME nest in river beds using their tongue to make a small hole. They do this so they can clamp on the tails of Slowsparce that put their tails in the water.

entry: POKENAME生性顽皮淘气，会攻击其他软体动物，抢走珍珠当战利品。随着年龄增长，保护头部的壳比身体其余部位长得更快。
author: pjporwoll
source: A mischievous and impish Pokémon by nature, POKENAME attacks other mollusks to steal their pearls, which it sees as trophies. As it ages, the shell protecting its head grows at an increased rate in comparison with the rest of its body.

entry: POKENAME用黏液在壳下造出厚厚的泡泡层。泡泡层能润滑，它便用舌头拖动身体，沿着泡泡在海底移动。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME use their mucus to create a thick layer of bubbles beneath their shell. They use the bubble layer as a lubricant, dragging themselves along it across the sea floor using their tongue.

entry: POKENAME除了壳极硬，还会分泌黏稠泡沫，难以下口。因此捕食者极少，大多觉得猎食它太费力，不值得。
author: secondegg
source: In addition to its incredibly hard shell, POKENAME secretes a sticky foam that makes it hard to eat. Because of this, it has very few predators, as most decide it is not worth the effort to hunt.

entry: POKENAME制造的珍珠，大小颜色都很难与卵区分。这既迷惑了想偷卵吃的捕食者，也让许多采珠人和收藏家大吃一惊。
author: wiz0z
source: Pearls made by POKENAME are difficult to distinguish from their eggs in both size and color. This confuses predators that would steal and eat them, and has surprised many pearl divers and collectors.

entry: POKENAME在海底挪动，吃掉沿途的小生物。它爬不过崎岖岩地，就用强壮獠牙撞碎挡路的岩石和珊瑚。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME shuffles along the seafloor, eating any small creatures in its path. It can't climb over rocky terrain, so it will instead use its strong tusks to break through rocks and coral in its way.

entry: 一夜之间，POKENAME会在尾巴里形成闪亮的珍珠。到了早晨，它游到岸边，轻轻送给毫无准备的海滩游客。
author: .izik
source: Overnight, POKENAME forms glistening pearls in its tail. By morning, it swims ashore and gently gifts them to unsuspecting beachgoers.

entry: 身体底部柔软，顶部却硬如岩石。若仰面搁浅、无法移动，它就会舔柔软的半边身体，涂上黏液保湿。
author: bobosmith01
source: Although the bottom of its body is soft and tender, the top is as hard as stone. If it becomes both beached on its back and becomes unable to move from its spot, it licks its squishy half to paint on a mucus that helps it retain moisture.

entry: POKENAME凭淡紫蓝色伪装，悄悄接近水生宝可梦的巢。两片贝壳能脱开接合处，将卵整颗吞下。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME's periwinkle camouflage allows them sneak up on nests of aquatic Pokémon. Their bivalve shell has the ability to unhinge and swallow eggs whole.

entry: POKENAME用尾上色彩鲜艳的液体，在壳上画可怕的脸。人类常觉得滑稽，许多宝可梦却会因此打消敲开它的壳的念头。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME uses the brightly coloured fluid on its tail to paint scary faces on its shell. While the faces often look goofy to humans, this discourages many Pokémon from trying to crack POKENAME's shell open.

entry: POKENAME生活在冰湖附近，用披甲的毛发状附肢砸开冰层。它虽沉重，却能轻松游泳，不会下沉。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME lives near frozen lakes, smashing through the ice with armored, hair-like appendages. Despite how heavy it is, it is able to swim effortlessly without sinking.

entry: POKENAME将自己埋在沼泽附近的泥里降温。它容易受惊，只要有什么靠得太近，就会用舌头舀起污泥，朝对方扔去。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME buries itself into the mud near swamps in order to keep cool. It is easily spooked, and uses its tongue to scoop up muck and toss it at anything that gets too close for comfort.

entry: 它从后方猛喷高压海水，将自己射出，以此移动。但它不太会调整喷射角度，飞行时常撞到东西。
author: hophoppip
source: It moves by releasing a pressurized blast of seawater from its rear to launch itself. It's not the best at angling these blasts, and tends to crash into objects as it flies.

entry: POKENAME会从所住的壳里伸出身体，方便进食。舌头有轻微麻痹作用，能帮它吃下海底的小型宝可梦。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME extends itself out from the shell it inhabits in order to better feed. Its tongue has a mild paralytic effect that aids it in consuming small Pokémon inhabiting the seabed.

entry: POKENAME的壳像厚钢板船体一样硬，普通手段几乎无法击穿，因此它们在水下过得安稳。唯一害怕的，是巨钳蟹的巨钳。
author: dukefrogpeasant
source: The shell of a POKENAME is as hard as a thick-plated steel hull. As a result, they live peaceful lives underwater, being nearly impenetrable by normal means. Their only fear is the gigantic claw of a Kingler.

entry: POKENAME的舌头敏感，能察觉附近的动静。一感到有什么靠近，它就转身冲过去，用头上坚固的半片壳撞击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's tongue is sensitive enough to alert it to the movements of others nearby. If it detects the approach of something, it whirls around and charges into others, striking them with the sturdy half-shell on its cranium.

entry: 它窝在水下洞穴里睡觉，用厚舌堵住入口，挡住水流。有人相信它体内深处藏着巨大珍珠，但从野生个体身上取珠的人，从没有谁活着回来讲述。
author: jaminmcready
source: It sleeps nestled in underwater caverns, using its thick tongue to plug the entrance and block currents. Some believe a massive pearl lies deep within its body, but no one has ever retrieved one from a wild specimen and lived to tell the tale.

entry: POKENAME在冰湖上滑行，边滑边吐出亮蓝色珍珠。留下多少颗，取决于它的心情。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME slides across frozen lakes, spitting out bright blue pearls as it glides. The number of pearls it leaves behind changes with its mood.

entry: POKENAME的长舌缩不回去，必须常浸进特殊的壳里，防止干燥。它拼命守护这个壳，谁靠得太近，都会被黏舌缠住。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME is unable to retract its long tongue, therefore it must frequently dip it into a special shell to prevent it from drying out. It fiercely guards this shell, and will wrap its sticky tongue around anyone who gets too close.

entry: POKENAME的珍珠闪着3种不断变化的色彩。在合适光照下，仿佛水波荡漾，贵族愿为此出高价。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's pearls shimmer with three ever-shifting hues. Under proper lighting, they seem to ripple like water, fetching steep prices from nobility.

entry: 脸上坚硬的壳能挡住大部分伤害。战斗时会合上壳，一头撞向敌人。
author: melodydelune
source: The hardened shell on its face will protect it from most damage. When they fight, they will close their shells and charge head first into foes.

entry: POKENAME用长舌舔喝冰水，为炮管蓄力。喝得越多，炮击覆盖的弧形范围就越宽。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME laps up icy water with its long tongue to charge its cannon. The more it drinks, the wider the arc of its cannon's strike becomes.

entry: POKENAME性情友好，常用大舌头亲昵地舔别人。受到威胁时，它会转身逃跑，从后方的壳发射火球。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has a very friendly disposition, often licking others affectionately with its large tongue. If threatened, it turns tail and retreats, releasing fireballs from the shell on its rear.

entry: POKENAME从壳里伸出大舌头，收集海带和藻类。平时吃得很少，唯独秋天几乎不停进食。
author: .izik
source: A large tongue extends from POKENAME's shell to gather kelp and algae. It eats very little except during autumn, when it feeds almost nonstop.

entry: POKENAME用长舌缠住靠近的东西，想轻松吃上一顿。可它常犯迷糊，大半时间都在慢慢舔自己的壳。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME wraps its long tongue around anything that gets close, aiming to catch an easy meal. It frequently gets confused and spends most of its time slowly licking its own shell.

entry: POKENAME不停在河岸上游荡，遇到新鲜东西就舔。若喜欢味道，还会试着咬；要是对方回咬，它就靠壳保护自己。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME constantly wanders around on riverbanks, licking anything new it encounters. If it likes the taste, it will try to bite it, relying on its shell for protection if anything bites back.

entry: POKENAME用能在水下共鸣的频率唱歌，让其他宝可梦睡着。潜水者会戴上能发出杂音的特制耳机，免得入睡。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME sings at a frequency that resonates underwater so that it can put other Pokémon to sleep. Divers wear specialized headphones that produce static noise to avoid falling asleep.

entry: POKENAME身体大半覆着坚韧的钙质甲壳，保护它免受攻击。四肢虽然僵硬笨拙，大而灵活的舌头却能抓取、操纵物品。
author: regulavish
source: Most of POKENAME's body is covered by a hardy calcium-based carapace that keeps it safe from incoming attacks. While its limbs are stiff and clumsy, it uses its large, agile tongue to grasp and manipulate objects.

entry: POKENAME很在意自己的外表，也很害羞。有谁在旁边，它就合壳不动；只有完全信任的对象在场，才肯打开。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has been noted to be self-conscious of its appearance and rather shy, remaining still and shut when others are around. It only opens up in the presence of those it implicitly trusts.

entry: POKENAME能在贝壳般的花苞里孕育珍珠，每周最多5颗。它极爱护珍珠，谁敢偷，就挥动花苞朝谁打去。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME can produce pearls in its shell-like bud, making up to 5 pearls a week. It is very protective of its pearls and will swing its bud at anyone that tries to steal them.

entry: POKENAME坚硬、半透明的身体能抵挡破坏力极强的攻击。但用舌头发射精神能量时，就会暴露在危险之中。
author: npshi
source: POKENAME have hard, translucent bodies that can repel devastating attacks. POKENAME use their tongue to fire off psychic energy, which leaves them exposed to danger.

entry: POKENAME把贝壳当作面具。虽然没有眼孔，它仍骄傲地戴着，防御危险的宝可梦。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME wears a shell as its mask. Despite not having eye holes, it proudly wears the mask to defend itself from dangerous Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME大部分时间都在海底一动不动。危险靠近时，它会从壳的缝隙排出高压水，推动自己逃走。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME spends most of its time sitting motionless on the ocean floor. If danger approaches, POKENAME propels itself away by expelling pressurized water from the gaps in its shell.

entry: 外壳是一顶轻巧又坚固的头盔。它靠舌头感知气流，在漆黑洞穴中辨路。
author: staghorn
source: Its shell serves as a lightweight yet durable helmet. It uses its tongue to sense air currents and navigate through dark caves.

entry: POKENAME靠诡计取得珠宝。它敞开壳，诱人伸手去拿里面的珍珠，再猛然合上。手一被夹进壳里，它就会取走对方戴着的珠宝。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME rely on deceptive tricks to obtain jewelry. They leave their shell open to entice people to reach for the pearl inside before snapping shut. Once they have a hand nestled in their shell, they remove any jewelry the person may have.

entry: POKENAME会咆哮、疯狂甩动大舌头，想把别人吓走。若没能吓到目标，它就会不好意思，将脸藏进颈上的壳里。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME attempts to frighten others away by roaring and flailing its large tongue about wildly. It gets embarrassed and hides its face within the shell on its neck if this tactic fails to scare its target.

entry: POKENAME制造的珍珠极冷，碰到大多数表面就会瞬间冻结。徒手触碰可能冻伤。
author: .izik
source: The pearls made by POKENAME are so cold they freeze most surfaces instantly. Touching one barehanded can cause frostbite.

entry: POKENAME呼吸冰凉，舌头摸起来也很冷。它能在炎热天气帮主人降温，因此在暖和的地区很受欢迎。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has cool breath and a tongue that's cold to the touch. It's popular in warmer regions for helping cool down its owners on hot days.

entry: POKENAME制造的冰蓝珍珠，即使晒太阳仍很冷。高档咖啡馆会用来为贵客的饮品降温，既实用又优雅。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME creates icy blue pearls that remain cold even in sunlight. High-end cafés use them as elegant drink chillers for their elite patrons.

entry: POKENAME的壳像巨牙鲨，能吓退潜在捕食者。困在壳中的砂砾会被磨成珍珠，再从壳顶的星形孔射出，碎成尖牙的形状。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME's shell resembles a Sharpedo, scaring off potential predators. Grit caught within the shell becomes polished into a pearl, which it blasts out of the star-shaped hole in the shell top, shattering the pearl into the shape of sharp teeth.

entry: 据说溺水的孩子会变成POKENAME，而不是小木灵。来自冰冷水域的它们，总在颤抖、打寒战。
author: dodoowner_
source: It's said children who have drowned turn into POKENAME, instead of Phantump. POKENAME constantly shakes and shivers from the icy waters they come from.

entry: POKENAME的壳长成精巧的花朵般结构，坚硬的方解石形成花瓣状突起。凭这层壳，它能伪装在珊瑚礁间，几乎完美融入。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME shells grow into elaborate structures reminiscent of flowers, hard calcite forming into petal-like growths. Their shells allow them to camouflage themselves within coral reefs, blending into the reef almost seamlessly.

entry: POKENAME在水下快速旋转10根触手，推动自己前进。达到高速后，就会把头顶毒刺扎进猎物。
author: mr.bonesii
source: Underwater, POKENAME propels itself by rapidly spinning its ten tentacles. When it reaches high speeds, it drives the toxic barb at the top of its head into prey.

entry: POKENAME沿珊瑚礁爬行，在有毒穹壳的保护下舔食碎屑。捕捞虽危险，壳内肉质却鲜甜柔嫩，只是很难烹调，稍不留神就会烧焦、变得像橡胶。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME crawls along coral reefs and licks up meals of detritus from the safety of its venomous dome. Even though it is dangerous to harvest, its core body is sweet and tender, but very finicky to cook as it will burn and turn rubbery quickly.

entry: POKENAME其实不会游泳，只能漫步海底，寻找小型软体动物吃。头上的角带毒，能让受害者浑身发抖。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME can't actually swim, so it wanders the seafloor looking for small mollusks to eat. The horns on its head contain poison, which can cause shivering in its victims.

entry: 受到威胁时，POKENAME会向捕食者吐出闪亮珍珠，再稍施精神力量，使珍珠在飞行中转弯，分散对方注意，趁机逃走。
author: .izik
source: When threatened, POKENAME spits shimmering pearls at predators. With a flick of psychic energy, it curves them mid-flight, creating a distraction while it escapes.

entry: POKENAME藏在沙下，等人踩到，就舔对方的脚。舌头上有许多危险孢子，舔一下就能将真菌传染给对方。
author: hiroshima0042_23263
source: POKENAME hides under sand until someone steps on it, then licks their foot. Its tongue contains many dangerous spores, so licking someone allows POKENAME to infect them with its fungus.

entry: 受到威胁时，POKENAME会将唾液与颈圈上的泡沫混合，制成恶臭的肥皂状混合物。壳中形成的珍珠，即使清洗、抛光后，表面仍很滑。
author: chibitales
source: When threatened, POKENAME mix their saliva with the foamy substance on their collars, creating a soapy mixture that smells terrible. Pearls that form in their shells maintain a slippery surface even when cleaned and polished.

entry: POKENAME住在南瓜般的壳状结构中，其来历仍让研究者困惑。从没人见过它离开壳的模样。
author: elite01.
source: POKENAME inhabit shell-like structures resembling pumpkins, and researchers remain uncertain of their origin. No one has ever observed a POKENAME outside of its shell.

entry: POKENAME壳内储存的氧气供头顶火焰燃烧，即使在水下也能烧得旺。它会从口中猛喷火焰，推动身体，逃离捕食者。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: The fire atop a POKENAME's head is fueled by oxygen stored within the POKENAME's shell, allowing it to burn strongly even while underwater. To flee from predators, POKENAME create a burst of flames from their mouths to propel themselves away.

entry: POKENAME能压缩身体，完全藏进两片壳中。它每年只产一颗心形珍珠，据说若偶然找到，就注定会遇上爱情。
author: epping_forest
source: Its body can compress until it is entirely enclosed within its two shells. Each year, POKENAME produces a single heart-shaped pearl, and if you find one by pure chance, you are said to be fated to find love.

entry: POKENAME在土中挖掘时，会定期产生紫色小珍珠。珠宝匠收集后，用来制作价格亲民的饰品。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME periodically produces small violet pearls as it digs through soil. Jewelers collect these pearls to craft modestly priced accessories.

entry: POKENAME很胆小，会紧紧合壳，保护自己免受危险。但若夹得太紧、时间太久，就可能出现严重偏头痛。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is quite timid and will keep its shell tightly shut to protect itself from danger. However, if the shell remains too tight for too long, it can begin to suffer from severe migraines.

entry: POKENAME很爱玩，喜欢陪训练家玩捡球游戏，会飞快追逐扔出的球或树枝。它用头壳夹住物品，再用舌头固定，带回训练家身边。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are playful and love to play catch with their trainer, racing after thrown balls or sticks at incredible speeds. They clamp their head shell down on the thrown object, using their tongue to hold it in place before returning to their trainer.

entry: POKENAME很爱玩，喜欢陪训练家玩捡球游戏，会飞快追逐扔出的球或树枝。可一接到，就紧紧夹住，有时不肯松开。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are playful and love to play catch with their trainer, racing after thrown balls or sticks at incredible speeds. They clamp tightly onto the thrown object once they catch it and can be reluctant to release it.

entry: POKENAME的身体大多柔嫩敏感，因此会训练灵活的身手。它擅长用坚固壳片保护的部位，挡住攻击。
author: sk372
source: Because most of its body is tender and sensitive, POKENAME trains itself to be nimble and mobile. It excels at blocking attacks with the parts of its body shielded by sturdy shell pieces.

entry: POKENAME生活在沿海沼泽。一旦翻倒，就用舌头把自己撑回原位。
author: elite01.
source: POKENAME live in swampy areas along the coastline. They use their tongue to reposition themselves if they fall over.

entry: POKENAME极其温顺，藏在轻巧却结实的伞状壳里。它待在阳光充足处，让壳上宝石的反光引来猎物。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is incredibly meek and hides within its bell, which is actually a lightweight but durable shell. It positions itself in a sunny location so the light reflecting off the shell's gems lures in prey.

entry: POKENAME长得超出了保护壳的容量，使壳开裂，柔软身体暴露在外。触手能传递强力毒素，科学家正研究少量用于医疗的可能。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME has outgrown its protective shell, leading to cracks and its soft body becoming exposed. The tentacles transfer a powerful toxin, which scientists have been studying for medical use in small doses.

entry: POKENAME住在海中隧道里，有专门的生理系统限制、过滤摄入的盐分。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME lives in marine tunnels. It has a specialized biological system that limits and filters its salt intake.

entry: POKENAME住在海中隧道里，有专门的生理系统限制、过滤摄入的盐分。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME lives in marine tunnels. It has a specialized biological system that limits and filters its salt intake.

entry: POKENAME爱吃呆呆兽尾巴，也会嚼彼此的尾巴。若不打扰，能在海滩上看见它们排成长长的链条。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME loves Slowpoke tails and can be seen chewing on each other's tails. If left undisturbed, long chains of POKENAME can be seen lined up on the beach.

entry: POKENAME缩进壳里，躲避海底的捕食者。壳虽格外耐用，却十分柔韧易变，让它们能轻松移动。
author: npshi
source: POKENAME retract inside their shells to hide from predators on the sea floor. Despite the fact that the shells of POKENAME are remarkably durable, they are extremely malleable, which allows them to move around with ease.

entry: 这种奇特宝可梦外形几乎像颜色古怪的呆壳兽。主体竟能完全缩进小得多的壳里，始终让科学家百思不解。
author: sk372
source: A strange and curious Pokémon that appears almost like an odd-colored Slowbro. Science remains baffled at the fact the main body can retreat completely into the much smaller shell.

entry: POKENAME漂浮在沿海地区，那里的土壤和沙含有大量金属矿物。舌头略带磁力，它将舌头拖过沙地，收集金属矿物为食。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME hovers around coastal areas where the dirt and sands have high deposits of metallic minerals. Its tongue has a slight magnetic pull; it finds sustenance by dragging it through the sand to collect said metal minerals.

entry: POKENAME贴着海面低飞，用长舌察觉风的变化。若丢了植物茎秆，就会迁往内陆，寻找替代品。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME flies low above the sea, sensing changes in the wind with its long tongue. If it ever loses its plant stalk, it will migrate inland and search for a replacement.

entry: POKENAME用钝角在冰山上砸洞，再把珍珠藏进冰洞，如同秘密宝库。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME smashes holes in icebergs using its blunt horns. It stores pearls inside the frozen cavities like a secret vault.

entry: POKENAME躺在海底，大型捕食者靠近时就合上厚壳。沉重的壳连在腹部下方，使它行动困难。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME lies on the seafloor, enclosing its thick shell when larger predators get close. It has trouble getting around as its heavy shell is attached to its underbelly.

entry: POKENAME常用鲜红舌头引来宝可梦。猎物足够近时，它便用舌头绑住，再用炮管喷水，将对方打晕。
author: seanothan_23
source: POKENAME often lure Pokémon to it with its bright red tongue. When their prey are close enough, they bind them in their tongue and shoot water from their cannons to knock their prey out.

entry: POKENAME比普通大舌贝大得多，进攻本领却有限，反而有着极坚实的壳。它常让小型宝可梦藏进来，再紧紧合壳，帮忙保护。
author: sk372
source: Packing much greater size than a normal Shellder, POKENAME has minimal offenses, and instead possesses a very rigid and sturdy shell. It often helps smaller Pokémon by letting them hide within it while it clamps shut.

entry: POKENAME是徘徊在大舌贝逝去之处的灵魂，性情阴郁悲伤。被舔到的人会涌起强烈的哭泣冲动。
author: sk372
source: Spirits that linger where Shellder have passed away, POKENAME have a very sullen, sorrowful disposition. Being licked by one will cause a person to be overcome with an urge to cry.

entry: POKENAME合壳躲在海底，混在大舌贝中，假装也是其中一员。等捕猎者或潜水者靠近，就猛然开壳，发出阴森的怪笑，将对方吓走。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME hides with its shell closed on the sea bed, hiding amongst Shellder and pretending to be one of them. It waits for hunters or divers to come close before bursting its shell open with a ghostly cackle to scare them off.

entry: 人们偶尔观察到POKENAME夹自己的舌头。有人认为，这是为了刺激肌肉，使舌头始终对周围环境保持高度敏感。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has been observed pinching its own tongue on occasion. It's thought that this stimulates the muscle in order to keep it highly sensitive to its surroundings.

entry: POKENAME硕大的钳子夹合时，握力惊人。它会夹碎大物件示威，吓退捕食者，免得对方来打扰。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's oversized claw possesses a tremendous gripping force when clamping down. It crushes large objects within its claw as a threat display to deter predators from bothering it.

entry: POKENAME兴奋地跑来跑去，用长角戳东西。若更大的宝可梦想还击，它就迅速缩回壳里，把应付对方的事交给毒刺。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME excitedly run around poking things with their long horns. If a bigger Pokémon tries to retaliate, they will quickly tuck themselves back into their shells and let their poisonous spines do the work for them.

entry: POKENAME以头骨作甲，拿着刺甲贝断下的尖刺，是敏捷的水下猎手。它擅长将尖刺当长矛投出，串住鱼，拿下下一餐。
author: sk372
source: Using a skull as armor plating and a broken spine from a Cloyster, POKENAME is an agile underwater hunter. It's adept at using the spike as a thrown spear to skewer fish to make its next meal.

entry: POKENAME会凿刻骨质头盔，做出标志性的尖刺外形。它能发射压缩水制成的匕首，攻击威胁自己或幼崽的敌人。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME can be seen chiseling away at its bony helmet to create its signature spiky appearance. It fires daggers of compressed water to attack any foe threatening it or its young.

entry: POKENAME将头壳上的刺当武器，覆上一层坚冰，增强威力。被逼到绝境时，它能完全缩进坚固的壳里，避免受伤。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses spines from its cranial shell as weapons, coating them in a solid layer of ice to increase their effectiveness. When backed into a corner, it can retract its entire body within the durable shell to avoid damage.

entry: POKENAME进化需要大量养分，因此除了靛蓝色的茧，还有一个能开合的小壳，方便进食。捕食者一攻击，小壳就会猛然合上。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME need plenty of nutrients to evolve, so in addition to their indigo cocoon they have a small, hinged shell that allows them to eat. Whenever they are attacked by predators, their hinged shell slams shut.

entry: POKENAME住在瀑布附近，让倾泻的水流保护珍珠。它通常不招惹其他宝可梦，以免暴露珍珠的位置，但若有谁帮它逃离饥饿的圈圈熊，也可能送一颗作为谢礼。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME live near waterfalls where the cascade of water protects their pearls. They typically leave other Pokémon alone to keep the location of their pearls hidden, but may offer one as a reward for helping them escape a hungry Ursaring.

entry: POKENAME讨厌被骑乘，会故意用尖刺扎人。坚固的壳甚至能承受整座冰山砸下。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME hates people trying to ride them, intentionally trying to jab them with its spikes. Its sturdy shell is strong enough to withstand an entire iceberg falling on it.

entry: POKENAME能让胶状身体变硬，更耐打。变身时，它常添上壳状覆盖物和尖刺，更好地抵御袭击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can harden its gelatinous body to make itself more resistant to damage. When it transforms, it often adds shell-like coverings and spikes to better defend itself from attackers.

entry: POKENAME合上壳状身体时，显得苗条得多，能骗猎物靠近。它会将身体夹合，裹住敌人和猎物，不断收紧，直到对方不再动弹。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME appear much slimmer when their shell-like bodies are closed, which allows them to trick prey into drawing near. They will clamp their bodies down around foes and prey and constrict them until they cease to move.

entry: POKENAME壳内的珍珠充满奇怪的旋转能量，受到它严密守护。有人认为，它能施展的庞大超能力全藏在珍珠里。
author: sk372
source: A strange swirling energy fills the pearl within POKENAME's shell, which it guards fiercely. Some believe the pearl houses all of the vast psychic powers it is able to wield.

entry: POKENAME是迁徙物种，一年中不断从一处海滩迁往另一处。许多在途中被飞行属性宝可梦逐个捕食，无法完成漫长旅程。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are a migratory species that travel from one beach to another throughout the year. Many are unable to complete the long journey because they are picked off by Flying-type Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME羊毛中的电会传上尖刺，尤其会在顶部两根刺之间放电。它能将电导入携带的珍珠，使其充满强大电力，再向对手释放。
author: sk372
source: Electricity from POKENAME's wool travels up to its spines and discharges between the two upper spines in particular. It can funnel its electricity into a pearl it carries to supercharge it before releasing the energy at its opposition.

entry: POKENAME能迅速游离捕食者，只有捕食时才依赖壳。它会用壳猛夹，夹断其他宝可梦的触手或鳍。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are capable of quickly swimming away from predators and only rely on their shell when they hunt for food. They clamp down with their shell to snap tentacles or fins off of other Pokémon.

entry: 这种宝可梦难得一见，据说会随冬风飘上陆地。它偶尔吐出身体无法消化的细小盐粒。
author: bobosmith01
source: An elusive Pokémon that is said to float onto land on the winter winds. It occasionally spits out small flecks of salt that its body cannot digest.

entry: POKENAME会因白化珊瑚病态的颜色而吞食它们。海洋污染持续扩散，POKENAME的群落也越来越多。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME eat bleached coral because of their sickly-looking color. As pollution in the sea continues to spread, colonies of POKENAME grow more numerous.

entry: 船上设备失灵时，水手会靠POKENAME与其他船联络。柔韧易变的壳能变成简单讯息，用望远镜就能看见。
author: quackquackattack
source: Sailors rely on POKENAME to communicate with other ships when their equipment fails. Their malleable shell allows them to morph into basic messages that can be seen with a telescope.

entry: POKENAME在海底休息，将硬壳稍微张开，滤食水中食物。一看见有什么靠近，就会迅速合壳，从两侧孔洞发射尖锐冰弹。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME rests at the bottom of the sea floor, opening its solid shell partially in order to filter-feed. If it catches sight of something approaching, it quickly closes its shell and fires off pointed ice projectiles from the holes on its sides.

entry: POKENAME吞入海水，能胀到原来的4倍，再排出水，让圆身体游动。沙洲附近常能见到它们恐吓野生巨钳蟹。
author: bass.
source: POKENAME ingest sea water to inflate up to 4 times their size. This water is then expelled to allow its round body to swim. They can often be found by sandbars, terrorizing wild Kingler.

entry: POKENAME从双臂喷出高压水流，在水中前进。角摸起来很冷，长期生活在深水中，使角变得坚硬。
author: infinex21
source: It propels itself through water by releasing pressurized jets of water from within its arms. The horns of a POKENAME are cold to the touch and have been hardened by living within deep waters.

entry: POKENAME熔化沿岸岩台，与表面融为一体。它耐心等毫无戒备的猎物经过，再喷出岩浆，将目标裹进迅速冷却的岩石。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME melt the stone of coastal shelves and fuse with the surface. They wait patiently for unsuspecting prey to pass by before spewing magma over their target, covering them in quick-cooling rock.

entry: POKENAME制好珍珠后，会藏进厚毛里，再细心地用来装饰冰巢。
author: .izik
source: After crafting pearls, POKENAME tucks them into its thick fur. It later uses them to decorate its icy nest with intricate care.

entry: 它会从嘴和铠甲上的突起喷出灼热蒸汽，攻击敌人。POKENAME独来独往，性情凶暴，平时不愿受打扰，一旦被惹怒，便会战斗不休。
author: frokachu
source: This Pokémon shoots burning hot steam at enemies from its mouth and the protrusions in its armor. Solitary but violent, POKENAME prefers to be left alone but will fight relentlessly if provoked.

entry: 渔夫称POKENAME为“战争之龙”。它躲在坚壳后，只在射击的极短瞬间开壳，朝对手开火后，便又缩回掩护中。
author: bobosmith01
source: Fishermen call POKENAME the "Dragon of Warfare". It hides behind a powerful shell, only opening for the briefest of moments to fire a shot in the opponent's direction, before retreating back under cover.

entry: 有时能在港口城镇的码头下找到POKENAME。它会一直休息到周围安全无虞，等没谁在场，才浮出水面晒太阳。
author: bobosmith01
source: Sometimes, POKENAME is found underneath the piers of port towns, resting until the coast is clear; when no one is around, it will surface above water and bask in the sun.

entry: 它会长时间泡在泥浆或生活废水中避暑。醒来后，便抖掉背上的一切，将泥水甩得到处都是。
author: quackquackattack
source: It endures the heat by wading in mud or greywater and may do so for an extended period of time. Once it awakens, it shakes off everything atop its back, sending mud and water everywhere.

entry: POKENAME藏在海底的蛤蜊与贝壳间，躲避危险。若被抓住，它就从额角造出精神力量凝成的尖刺，射出击晕袭击者，尝试逃走。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME hides among clams and seashells on the seafloor to avoid danger. If caught, it creates psychic spines from the horn on its forehead to fire out and stun an attacker so it can attempt to flee.

entry: POKENAME向过往水手唱歌，让他们爱上自己。水手一靠得太近，它就用壳夹住受害者，边吃边让对方受苦。
author: freetasm
source: POKENAME sings to sailors passing by, causing them to fall in love with it. Then, when a sailor comes too close, POKENAME will clamp its shells down on the victim, making them suffer while eating them in the process.

entry: POKENAME很少移动，守在一处，凶狠地捍卫领地。闯入者靠近时，它会伸出幽灵般的身体，向四面八方发射灵体能量尖刺，赶走对方。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME rarely moves, staying in one spot and guarding its territory fiercely. When intruders approach it extends its spectral form outward and fires off spines of ghostly energy in all directions to repel them.

entry: POKENAME用自己击败的刺甲贝遗骸制成铠甲和长矛，披甲持矛。它能将波导注入矛中，让战斗威力大幅增强。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME wields a spear and wears armor created by the remains of Cloyster it has defeated. It can imbue the spear with aura in order to make it much more powerful in battle.

entry: POKENAME的钢甲经海浪压力锤炼，能抵御任何冲击。船只若停靠它控制的海岸，它就会扑上去，不停撞击，直到船被毁掉。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its steel armor has been tempered by the pressure of ocean waves, rendering it resistant to any impact. POKENAME hurls itself at ships that dock along the shores it controls, battering them relentlessly until they are destroyed.

entry: 小型宝可梦常在POKENAME的坚壳内或周围避难。为了保护它们，它会挥动通过可伸长的长藤连在壳上的尖刺。
author: sk372
source: Smaller Pokémon will often take shelter in or around POKENAME's hardy shell. To defend them, it wields sharp points attached to its shell via lengthy extendable vines.

entry: POKENAME伪装在尖锐岩石间，伏击岸边毫无戒备的猎物。它给脸侧尖刺附上电力，凶狠地迎战所有挑战者。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME camouflages itself among sharp rocks to ambush unsuspecting prey along the shore. It coats the spikes on the sides of its face with electricity to fiercely confront any challenger.

entry: 热带海域的POKENAME会因饮食不同，长出不同颜色的角。它们主要吃红珊瑚，因此角也呈现同样鲜艳的红色。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME from tropical seas develop differently colored horns based on their diet. They primarily consume red corals, causing their horns to reflect the same vibrant hue.

entry: 寒冷海域的POKENAME会因饮食不同，长出不同颜色的角。它们主要吃冰和冻住的生物，因此角也呈现同样清冷的蓝色。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME from cold seas develop differently colored horns based on their diet. They primarily consume ice and frozen organisms, causing their horns to reflect the same cool shade of blue.

entry: POKENAME在陆地受威胁时，会脱下触角上串着的珍珠。只需几天，珍珠就会重新长出。
author: melodydelune
source: When threatened on land, POKENAME will shed the pearls strung along its feelers; its pearls will be replaced in only a matter of a few days.

entry: POKENAME藏在海洋深处的坚壳中，只有海洋本身陷入危险才会现身。它同时从嘴和壳上尖刺发射强力能量束，轰击威胁。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME remains hidden in its tough shell in the ocean depths, only emerging when the ocean itself is in danger. It bombards threats with powerful beams of energy fired from its mouth and the spines on its shell simultaneously.

entry: POKENAME住在漆黑深海，极其厌恶明亮之处。壳一打开，附近的对象便会突然陷入沉睡，饱受恐怖噩梦折磨。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME lives in the pitch-black depths of the ocean, having a strong disdain for brightly lit areas. When its shell opens, those near it suddenly fall into a deep sleep wracked with horrific nightmares.

entry: POKENAME用前方的炮发射强劲水束或冰束，再合壳承受几乎一切还击。肩上的尖刺也能射出，是有效的攻击手段。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME fires intense beams of water or ice from the cannon on its front, closing its shell to endure nearly any retaliation that comes its way. The spikes on its shoulders can be fired as an effective attack as well.

entry: POKENAME战斗时常一边飞行，一边用尖刺加农炮扫射。旁观者说，它这样很像战时的战斗机。
author: foolish_weasel
source: A common tactic POKENAME uses in battle is to fly around and perform strafing runs with its Spike Cannon attack. Onlookers note that it looks akin to a fighter plane from war times when it does this.

entry: POKENAME漂浮在海面上方捕猎，通常吃潜水觅食的飞行属性宝可梦，也能吃跃出水面的水属性宝可梦。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME float above the sea to hunt for prey. They typically eat Flying-type Pokémon that dive into the sea for food, but can also eat Water-type Pokémon that leap out of the water.

entry: POKENAME手上的护甲和面具，都由贝壳般的材料制成。它有时害羞谨慎，是因为担心弄坏面具。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME has plating on its hands and its mask that are made of the same material as shells. It can be shy and cautious because it is worried it may break its mask.

entry: POKENAME角中的毒液能使被刺中的对象体温过高。毒虽不致命，却让猎物更快耗尽体力。壳甲般的身体，也能抵御同类的角。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME's horn contains venom that causes anyone injected to experience symptoms of hyperthermia. While not fatal, this venom causes their prey to exhaust themselves much faster. Their shell-plated bodies act as armor against each other's horns.

entry: POKENAME从头部长出厚实的壳，两半向下延伸到身体两侧。沿海底行走时，它就靠壳保护自己免受伤害。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME grow dense shells from their heads, the two halves growing downward to either side of their body. They rely on their shells to protect them from harm as they walk along the ocean floor.

entry: POKENAME常盯上其他奈克洛兹玛，夺取光能，因为它们的任何激光都无法穿透它的壳。它会连续发射激光尖刺，击开奈克洛兹玛的棱镜铠甲，吸收里面的光。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME often targets other Necrozma for light energy since its shell body can't be penetrated by any of their lasers. It fires volleys of laser spikes to burst open the prism armors of Necrozma and give it access to absorb their light.

entry: 聪明狡猾，偏爱潜行而非正面猛攻。若看见冰锥仿佛凭空接连射来，多半就是它干的。
author: jaycielantern
source: A clever, sneaky fusion that favors stealth over full frontal assault. Blame it if you witness a barrage of Icicle Spears seemingly from nowhere.

entry: POKENAME坚硬如壳的蘑菇会被放进辣椒菜肴，带来清凉风味。许多沙漠地区会在炎热夏季将其当作受欢迎的美食。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's crusty shell-like mushroom is used in chili dishes, causing a cooling flavor. Many desert areas feature these as a popular treat during hot summer months.

entry: 深海压力使POKENAME的壳坚韧如铁甲。只有向前猛扑、挥爪攻击时，防御才会露出一处缺口。
author: fiordaliso
source: The pressure of the deep sea has made POKENAME's shell as tough as an iron suit of armor. It exposes a single opening in its defenses only when it lunges forward to strike with its claws.

entry: POKENAME将自身形成的尖刺作弹药，保持距离，狙击毫无察觉的敌人。
author: hiroshima0042_23263
source: POKENAME uses spikes made from its body as projectiles. POKENAME stays at a distance to snipe foes that are unaware.

entry: POKENAME高速飞行时，会合壳保护敏感的眼睛，只能盲飞。因此常能见到它缠在电线上，或冲乱鸟类宝可梦的群体。
author: eiskitsune
source: Flying at high speeds, POKENAME seals its shell to protect its sensitive eyes, forcing it to fly blind. As a result, it is frequently observed tangled in power lines and disrupting flocks of bird Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME制造的珍珠会自然散发寒气。夏天，它将珍珠存进巢穴深处，让自己休息时保持舒适。
author: .izik
source: The pearls POKENAME creates emit a natural cooling aura. It stores them deep in its den during summer to keep itself comfortable while resting.

entry: 有一种很受欢迎的游戏，新结缘的恋人会打开POKENAME的壳，看里面的珍珠。据说挑到大珍珠的恋情会长长久久，这也鼓励许多恋人共同熬过难关。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are part of a popular game where new lovers open their shell to reveal the pearl inside. It is said that lovers that pick a large pearl will have a long-lasting relationship, which inspires many lovers to stick through tough times.

entry: POKENAME用惊人速度绕着敌人奔跑，寻找弱点，再从壳里连续发射尖刺。对手还击时，它就将头转过去，靠厚壳挡住伤害。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME launch volleys of spikes from their shell at their foes, using their immense speed to race around and find weak spots to target. They turn their head toward any return blows, relying on their thick shell to protect them from harm.

entry: POKENAME光滑的身体只是表象，试图咬它的对手甚至会崩牙！它虽无法沿直线前进，移动却出奇灵活，环境越湿润越是如此。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's smooth-looking body is merely a facade; opponents who attempt to bite it may even break their teeth! While it cannot move forward in a straight line, it moves with surprising agility, especially in moister conditions.

entry: POKENAME常住在海岸峭壁或岩洞附近，大吃硬贝壳，有时连大舌贝也吃，发出令人不适的碎裂声。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME often live near coastal cliffs or grottoes. They devour hard seashells and sometimes even Shellder with a sickening crunch.

entry: POKENAME投出手中长矛击倒猎物，靠头壳抵挡还击。它们会成群训练，将尖刺朝外排成方阵，抵御捕食者。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME will throw the spears they hold to bring down prey, relying on the shells on their heads to protect them from counterattacks. Groups of them will train together to defend against predators, forming a phalanx of outward-pointing spikes.

entry: POKENAME身体的污泥部分平时呈流体，受强力击打时却会迅速变硬，保护内部核心免受伤害。
author: hophoppip
source: The sludgy part of its body is normally fluid, but it quickly hardens when struck forcefully, protecting POKENAME's inner core from harm.

entry: POKENAME用珍珠层制造珍珠。这种物质坚固、有韧性，还泛着虹彩；科学家正在研究这种天然陶瓷，希望复制其出色性质。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME produce pearls made out of nacre, a strong, resilient, and iridescent substance. This natural ceramic is being studied by scientists who wish to replicate its remarkable properties.

entry: POKENAME给制成的珍珠注入超能力，用来催眠别人，再吞食梦境。珍珠有种空灵的光泽，在古玩收藏家间能卖高价。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME imbues the pearls it creates with psychic powers, using them to hypnotize others so it may consume their dreams. The pearls have an ethereal luster to them that makes them fetch a high price among curio collectors.

entry: POKENAME双臂的壳能有力夹合，但它不喜欢近战，更愿意用壳制造大珍珠，远远射向敌人。
author: sk372
source: The shells on POKENAME's arms can clamp down with powerful force, though it disdains close-range combat. Instead, it creates and fires large pearls from the shells to pelt foes from a distance.

entry: POKENAME背上种子散出的孢子，会飘向人和宝可梦，将他们引进废弃花园，使其突然想去打理。它始终带着同一副不变的笑容，静静看着。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: The spores emanating from a POKENAME's bulb drift towards people and Pokémon, drawing them in to abandoned gardens and giving them a sudden urge to tend to them. All while the POKENAME watches with the same unwavering smile.

entry: POKENAME能穿墙，便用这能力溜进别人厨房，大吃冰箱里的食物。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: POKENAME has the ability to phase through walls. It uses this power to sneak into people's kitchens, gorging itself on food from their fridges.

entry: 人们曾以为POKENAME是死去霹雳电球的灵魂。它爆炸时，会让周围充满灵体能量，引发各种超自然现象。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME was once thought to be the spirit of a deceased Voltorb. Its explosions cover the immediate area in ghostly energy, causing all sorts of supernatural phenomena.

entry: 遭亵渎尸体的灵魂附上了挖出它的卡拉卡拉，以骨头为武器。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: The spirit of a desecrated body possesses the Cubone who dug it up and wields its bone as a weapon.

entry: POKENAME骨头周围的灵体能量与嘎啦嘎啦相似。它们似乎不吃不喝，常在墓地里缓缓跋涉。关于它们及其习性的研究仍在继续。
author: chibitales
source: The ghostly energy surrounding POKENAME's bones resembles that of Marowak. These Pokémon do not seem to eat or drink and are often spotted trudging around cemeteries. Research is ongoing into POKENAME and its habits.

entry: 它整天待在山里，训练击中更远的目标。气压降低，使它的气体身体能伸得更远。
author: bandedbodypress
source: It spends its days in the mountains, training to be able to hit targets from further away. Due to the decreased pressure, it can stretch its gas body much further.

entry: POKENAME呼出的有毒臭雾会久久不散，持续好几天。它们常成群聚在污染严重的地区。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's breath carries a foul-smelling, toxic mist that lingers for days. Groups of POKENAME gather in areas rife with heavy pollution.

entry: POKENAME将身体藏在黑暗的帷幕中。不过，只要遇到强风，帷幕就会散去。
author: raydrago
source: POKENAME conceals its body within a shroud of darkness. However, the shroud will dissipate if it is exposed to a strong wind.

entry: POKENAME吸入火葬场的烟，混进自身毒气。添了这种烟，雾气会变得格外有害。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME inhales smoke from crematoriums, mixing it into its toxic gas. This enriched vapor makes its haze particularly noxious.

entry: POKENAME游泳时，用角发出阴森的震动，吓跑其他宝可梦。等大家四散，它就冲去吃剩下的食物。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME produce eerie vibrations from their horn while swimming to scare away other Pokémon. As the other Pokémon scatter, they swoop in to eat leftover food.

entry: POKENAME造出气体翅膀，四处飞行。但对翅膀的控制很弱，强风就能吹散，因此风暴来临时，它们会躲进树里。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME form gaseous wings that they use to fly around with. These wings are only weakly controlled by the Pokémon and can be dispersed by strong winds, leading them to hide in trees during storms.

entry: POKENAME常在街角路灯下站得一动不动，令人毛骨悚然。被看见后，它不用翅膀就能浮起，像着魔般追逐受害者。
author: ghostslythe
source: Found under corner street lamps, POKENAME stands eerily still. When spotted, it floats into the air without using its wings and chases its victim as if possessed.

entry: POKENAME常收集那些纠缠训练家的灵魂所散发的气体。由于自身基因不稳定，气体常在颈部凝成缕缕鬃毛。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: POKENAME often will collect gases from spirits that attempt to haunt their Trainers. Due to the instability of their DNA, these gases frequently condense into a wispy mane around their neck.

entry: POKENAME常在沉船出没，性情却意外地平和。它常试着用泡泡将迷失宝可梦的灵魂引向水面，让它们能在来世与训练家重聚。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: Frequently found haunting shipwrecks, POKENAME is a surprisingly peaceful creature. It often will attempt to guide the spirits of lost Pokémon to the water's surface with bubbles in order to allow them to rejoin their Trainers in the afterlife.

entry: POKENAME借几乎透明的身体溜进运作中的发电厂，偷取电力。被发现后，气体身体便硬化成防御尖刺，还能发射雷电。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: POKENAME utilizes its almost invisible body to sneak into active power plants in order to siphon electricity from them. When discovered, the gas of their body hardens into protective spikes able to launch lightning bolts.

entry: POKENAME附在报废的电子设备上，从屏幕现身，朝靠近的人尖叫。据说它厌恶人类，是因为人类任由机器死去，再丢弃或换掉。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME haunts dead electronics, projecting itself from the screen to screech at those who draw close to it. It's believed it dislikes humans for letting the machines die and discarding or replacing them.

entry: POKENAME用气体茧裹住自己，隐藏真身。气体毒性极强，靠近就会丧失行动能力。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME conceal their bodies in a cocoon of gas, hiding their true bodies. This gas is highly toxic, incapacitating anyone who gets near.

entry: POKENAME在古生物学家挖化石的地方漂游，寻找曾属于自己的骨头。整副骨架归回原位后，恶意便会消散，转而平静游荡。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME float around places where paleontologists dig up fossils looking for bones that were once part of their body. Once the complete skeleton returns to their rightful place, they are depleted of ill intentions and roam calmly.

entry: POKENAME会捉弄墓地里遇见的对象，想让对方开心。若发现反而让人更难过，就会从附近传送树果和其他甜食来安慰。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME plays pranks on those it encounters in graveyards to try to cheer them up. Should it discover it made them sadder, it will teleport berries and other sweet things from nearby areas to comfort them instead.

entry: POKENAME颈边环绕着紫烟项圈，用芬芳气味引来猎物。等猎物被毒气击垮，它便吸食对方的生命力。
author: kam_doodle_snek
source: A collar of purple smoke swirls around POKENAME's neck. It lures in prey with its fragrant aroma, before feeding on its life force when it succumbs to the poisonous gas.

entry: POKENAME会产生气态氯化钾，从头部、嘴和尾巴排出。紫色的火焰便由此而来。
author: gp423
source: POKENAME produces a gaseous form of potassium chloride that is expelled from its head, mouth, and tail. This is what causes its purple-colored fire.

entry: POKENAME呼出漆黑烟雾，带有浓重的木炭气味。它似乎最喜欢在偏远地区烧毁的旧建筑里出没。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME breathes out a dark mist of smoke that smells deeply of charcoal. Its preferred habitat for haunting seems to be burnt-out old buildings in remote locales.

entry: POKENAME平时紧收翅膀，维持气体身体。夜里便展开翅膀，朝猎物尖叫，让对方吓得动弹不得，轻松得手。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME usually keeps its wings tucked tightly to keep its gaseous body contained. At night, it unfurls its wings to shriek at prey, paralyzing them with fear and making them easily picked off.

entry: POKENAME痴迷数数，会将平凡物件变成学习机会。人们发现，它每数一个数字就会停下来笑，原因仍不清楚。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are obsessed with counting and seek to turn mundane objects into learning opportunities. It has been noted that POKENAME pauses to laugh between each number, but the reason why is currently unknown.

entry: 这种宝可梦夜里几乎看不见，划过天空时便形成“暗流星”现象。
author: hushpuppy
source: Almost invisible at night, this Pokémon's trek across the sky is responsible for the phenomenon of "dark meteors".

entry: POKENAME爱闹鬼捉弄屋里的住户，飘到面前，发出吓人的声音。可身体太轻，连挥手扇出的风，都能将它吹得翻滚着飞走。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME loves to haunt and prank the residents of the homes it haunts, floating before them and making spooky noises. However, its body is so lightweight that even air from fanning one's hands will send it tumbling away through the air.

entry: 一种常见迷信认为，大风天为POKENAME提供庇护，就会得到好运。风会吹散它的气体身体，因此它始终感激保护自己的对象。
author: foolish_weasel
source: A common superstition states that people who offer shelter to POKENAME during windy weather are bestowed with good luck. Because the winds can disperse POKENAME's gaseous form, it is forever grateful to those who protect it.

entry: POKENAME哭个不停。据说它是在为过早结束的生命哭泣：明明才刚是一颗蛋，如今却已离开这个世界，去了另一个世界。几乎没有训练家能安抚它。
author: inquis1
source: POKENAME cries ceaselessly. It is said it cries because of its foreshortened life; it had just been an egg and now has passed from this world into the next. Few Trainers have ever managed to soothe it.

entry: 它夜里出现在咩利羊群中，将羊群引入歧途。看似蓬松的羊毛，仔细看却只是浓厚的毒气云。
author: hophoppip
source: It appears at night among flocks of Mareep, leading them astray. Though it appears to have fluffy wool, close inspection reveals that it's merely a thick cloud of toxic gas.

entry: POKENAME看见有旅人在自己的森林里迷路，就会试着将对方引向更深处。能活着回来讲述的人很少。
author: .izik
source: Should POKENAME see a traveler lost in its forest, it will attempt to guide them deeper in the woods. There are few tales of anyone surviving this.

entry: POKENAME有两种自保方式：猛烈抖动叶子，以及从体内释放毒气。但毒气只在最后关头才用，因为稍不小心，连自己也会受伤。
author: ichosuzu
source: POKENAME has two methods of protecting itself: violently shaking its leaves and releasing toxic gas from its body. The latter is only done as a last resort, however, as it can also harm POKENAME itself if it is not careful.

entry: POKENAME若隐若现，在闹鬼森林中漫无目的地穿梭。穿林而过的人常说，见过它随一阵风飞掠而过。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are an ephemeral presence that dart aimlessly through haunted forests. People who wander through those forests often report a POKENAME zipping by on a gust of wind.

entry: POKENAME静静飘过沼泽，留下潮湿的雾迹。气体身体略有池水味，发怒时还会放出一股沼气，让吸入者头晕、大笑不止。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME drifts silently over marshes, leaving behind a trail of damp mist. Its gaseous body smells faintly of pond water. If angered, it releases a burst of swamp gas that causes dizziness and uncontrollable laughter in those who inhale it.

entry: 这些难得一见的宝可梦并不纠缠某处，而是纠缠它们觉得值得关注的训练家。据说，气体般的毛极其敏感，却也让它们能悄无声息地穿过阴影。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: These elusive Pokémon are not known to haunt a location, but rather Trainers who they feel are worthy of their attention. The gas-like fur on their bodies is said to be extremely sensitive but allow them to pass through shadows undetected.

entry: 据说POKENAME由无月之夜散去的雾形成。它最爱出没于林间废弃木屋，先吓唬毫无戒备的徒步者，再在那里过夜。
author: ghostslythe
source: It is said POKENAME is formed from fog dissipating on a moonless night. Its favorite haunts are abandoned cabins in the woods, where it startles unaware hikers before taking shelter for the night.

entry: POKENAME偷走墓前供品，藏进废弃墓穴，用浓密毒雾守护偷来的宝物。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME steals offerings left on graves, hoarding them in abandoned crypts. It protects its stolen treasures with a dense, toxic fog.

entry: POKENAME常在废弃地区出现，捉弄来探险的年轻人。淘气的性情，让它成了故事里常见的恶作剧角色。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is frequently seen in abandoned areas where it seeks to pull pranks on youths snooping around the location. Its impish demeanor makes it a common trickster character in stories.

entry: 野生POKENAME只在特定地点、特定时段现身。想在其他条件下看见它，就需要专门设备。人类通常碰不到它的实体。
author: bobosmith01
source: Wild POKENAME only show themselves in certain locations and at certain times of the day. To spot them in other conditions, specialized equipment is necessary. Typically, they are intangible to human touch.

entry: POKENAME的尾巴只靠灵体联系着本体，偶尔会自行游走。走得太远，就会猛然弹回来，嘴里常还叼着食物。
author: beetlething
source: POKENAME's tail occasionally wanders off, as it is only spiritually attached to the main body. If it wanders too far from the main body, it will snap back, often with food in its mouth.

entry: POKENAME性喜独居，偏爱躲在废弃建筑里安静休息。受袭时，它会从体内喷出浓气，让周围笼罩在厚重烟幕里，趁机逃走。
author: santon5512
source: Solitary creatures, POKENAME prefer to hide out in abandoned buildings where they can peacefully rest. If attacked, they will spew a thick gas from their bodies, covering their surroundings in a heavy smokescreen so they can escape.

entry: POKENAME将树果存进壳里，直到腐烂；腐败的化学反应会为气体身体提供能量。少量吸入它的气体，会产生醉意。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME stores Berries in its shell until they rot, as the chemical reactions of decay fuel its gaseous body. Inhaling its gas has an intoxicating effect in small doses.

entry: POKENAME散发阴冷的雾，让附近的对象总觉得被盯着。那股阴森的存在感，连最勇敢者的意志也能消磨。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME emits a chilling fog that makes those nearby feel constantly watched. This haunting presence can drain the resolve of even the bravest.

entry: POKENAME出没于流动的熔岩附近，由熔岩释放的气体形成。它的存在会危害活物，却不会远离孕育自己的熔岩流。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME can be found around active lava flows, forming from the gasses that are released from the molten rock. Their presence is noxious to living creatures, but they do not travel far from the flows that birth them.

entry: POKENAME会飘向雪山中迷路的登山者，聚在周围。据说，它们能将救援人员引向被严寒击垮的人。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME drift toward lost hikers in snowy mountains, gathering around them. It is said they guide rescuers to those who succumb to the cold.

entry: 环绕身体的气体带有强毒，即使它已经消失，毒仍久久不散。它狩猎的林间小径，人和宝可梦都避而远之。
author: vracken
source: The gas surrounding its body carries a potent venom that lingers long after it has disappeared. Forest paths where it hunts are avoided by both people and Pokémon alike.

entry: POKENAME蜷成螺旋，咬向一切靠近的东西。据说每咬一口，就会让人少活1年。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: POKENAME curls up in spirals, biting at anything that comes near. It is said that each bite from a POKENAME takes one year off a person's life.

entry: POKENAME的气体鹿角散发着令人不安的能量。超能力者声称，这能让他们看见遥远的过去。
author: .izik
source: The gaseous antlers of POKENAME radiate an unsettling energy. Psychics claim it allows them to see far into the past.

entry: POKENAME站在墓碑顶端保持平衡，训练专注力和灵活性。奇怪的是，它需要时明明能轻松漂浮。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME balances atop gravestones to train its focus and agility. This habit is curious since it can effortlessly float when needed.

entry: POKENAME常在码头出现，亲吻捕来带上岸的鱼，吸食灵魂。码头工人甚至鼓励它们留下，因为它们能吓退其他想偷鱼的害兽。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME are frequently found on docks as they consume the souls of fish that have been caught and brought to shore by kissing them. Dockworkers even encourage them to hang around, as their presence deters other pests that try and steal the fish.

entry: 大人常对孩子说，POKENAME就是从前乱玩电源插座的小孩变的。当然，这话完全没有事实依据。
author: enemyphase
source: Children are often told that POKENAME were once kids that played with electrical sockets. Of course, there's no actual truth to this whatsoever.

entry: POKENAME在周围制造由X射线构成的雾。古生物学家借这雾，能迅速定位化石。
author: camtft
source: POKENAME creates a mist around itself composed of X-Rays. The mist is utilized by paleontologists to locate fossils at a rapid pace.

entry: POKENAME在城都森林若隐若现，穿梭时间线，引导古老的灵魂。传言它们会传递遥远过去亲人留下的讯息，但尚未证实。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are an evanescent presence in Johto forests and travel through timelines to guide ancient spirits. It is rumored that they pass messages from loved ones in the distant past, though this has yet to be confirmed.

entry: POKENAME将未能实现的愿望化作幻象，分散猎物注意。受害者受幻景迷惑，不断原地绕圈，无法逃脱。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME projects illusions of unfulfilled desires to distract its prey. These mirages keep victims wandering in circles, unable to escape.

entry: 传说POKENAME会将沼泽中的旅人引到女巫小屋。跟随它的人，可能被沼泽的阴暗诅咒夺去理智。
author: .izik
source: Legends tell of POKENAME luring travelers in swamps to witches' huts. Those who follow risk losing their sanity to the swamp's shadowy curse.

entry: POKENAME蜷成球时，看起来只是一团漂浮的影子。夜里常能在沙漠见到它们漫无目的地漂游。
author: santon5512
source: By curling themselves into a ball, POKENAME can appear as nothing more than a floating shadow. These Pokémon can be found aimlessly drifting through deserts at night.

entry: POKENAME的翅膀飘忽不定，实体还没碰到，就先化成雾。它会追着幼小宝可梦离开闹鬼森林，常追出很远。
author: quackquackattack
source: The wings of a POKENAME have an evanescent quality, as they vaporize into a mist before anything physical hits them. POKENAME chase after baby Pokémon out of haunted forests, often over long distances.

entry: POKENAME常在温室出没，抽走植物赖以生存的气体。它们常将身体贴在玻璃上，尽量吸收阳光，又避开直射。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: POKENAME will often haunt greenhouses and siphon off gases needed by the plants in order to survive. They are often found pressing their bodies against the glass in order to absorb as much sunlight as possible while avoiding direct rays.

entry: 据说POKENAME在最危险的山巅游荡，训练家很少前往。它能将体表气体凝成尖冰，连山地岩层都能刺穿。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: POKENAME are said to roam the tops of the most dangerous mountaintops, where Trainers seldom travel. They are able to condense the gas on their bodies into sharp ice that can pierce through the mountain terrain.

entry: 这些宝可梦常见于关都的紫苑镇，喜欢破坏复古电子游戏，让音乐不断重复，刺耳得很。
author: victor9106
source: Often found in Lavender Town in the Kanto Region, these Pokémon enjoy corrupting retro video games, causing the music to become ear-gratingly repetitive.

entry: POKENAME虽不常飞，却能借附近其他对象的生命精华，在空中滑翔。它也可能用生命精华完全裹住自己，作为保护。
author: camtft
source: While not flying often, POKENAME are able to glide through the air using the nearby life essence of others. They may also coat themselves completely in the life essence for protection.

entry: 白天只能看见它的头。夜里，它才会用毒气形成身体，四处漂游。
author: hophoppip
source: During the day, only its head is visible. At night, it forms a body from toxic gas and floats about.

entry: 据说，POKENAME舍弃肉身，化为超能力能量，借此超越死亡。它变得更加强大，守护之心也更盛。
author: skymaster426
source: Supposedly surpassing death, POKENAME has given up its body to turn into psychic energy, making it much more powerful and protective.

entry: 据说POKENAME夜里会出现在孤独者面前，无声地驱使对方追随。跟去的人会消失得无影无踪，再也不回来。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is said to appear before lonely souls at night, silently compelling them to pursue it. It is said those who follow it vanish without a trace and never return.

entry: POKENAME严格昼伏夜出，通常住在僻静的支流。它只有一个目标：无止境地筑坝。水坝一旦弊大于利，它就拆掉，换个地方重新开始。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is strictly nocturnal and typically lives in secluded tributaries. It has a singular goal: create dams ad infinitum. When a dam begins to cause more harm than good, it takes it down before starting again elsewhere.

entry: POKENAME的骨骼身体硬如钢铁，靠周围发光的气体活动。它能感知恐惧，黑夜里会被害怕骷髅的人吸引过去。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's skeletal body is as hard as steel and is animated by the glowing gas that surrounds it. POKENAME has the ability to sense fears, and on dark nights it will be drawn towards people who find skeletons frightening.

entry: 人们相信POKENAME已在大地上游荡数百年，有些考古学家专门研究它最早何时现身。压力极大时，它会难以维持形态。
author: ruben2309295
source: POKENAME are believed to have been haunting the earth for hundreds of years; some archaeologists dedicate themselves to pinpointing the first POKENAME sighting. During high-stress situations, POKENAME struggle to maintain their form.

entry: 墓地寒冷多雾的夜里，能见到POKENAME在附近巡游。据说凝视它的眼睛，会损失数年寿命，换来与亡者短暂交谈的机会。
author: quackquackattack
source: On cold foggy nights in graveyards, POKENAME can be found patrolling the nearby vicinity. It is said that staring into the eyes of POKENAME causes a person to lose years of their life in exchange for momentary communication with the dead.

entry: POKENAME出没于古时供奉宝可梦的神庙。人们曾见它附身雕像，改变雕像的位置，但用意尚不清楚。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME haunts ancient temples dedicated to the worship of Pokémon in the past. It has been observed possessing statues and changing their positions, but to what end it does this is not yet known.

entry: POKENAME头上的叶子散发硫磺般难闻的气味，用来驱退捕食它的宝可梦。
author: beatdoof
source: The leaf on POKENAME's head emits a repulsive aroma akin to sulfur. This aroma is used by POKENAME to deter predator Pokémon.

entry: 在森林里闻到臭鸡蛋和氨的气味，就说明POKENAME在附近。它昼伏夜出，很爱让其他幽灵宝可梦坐在背上。
author: beatdoof
source: In the forests, if one detects the smell of rotten eggs and ammonia, it means POKENAME is nearby. Nocturnal, it loves to carry fellow Ghost Pokémon on its back.

entry: POKENAME身上的幽灵火焰热得足以灼伤，即使完全浸入水里也不会熄灭。它在高楼出没，偶尔夜里爬过窗外，吓屋里的人一跳。
author: .jerden
source: The ghostly flames on its body are hot enough to burn, but cannot be extinguished even by complete immersion in water. POKENAME haunt tall buildings, occasionally surprising people inside by climbing up past their window at night.

entry: POKENAME的“剑刃”由气体构成，看似无害。一旦渗入血肉，就会从内部使其中毒。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME's "blade" may seem harmless as it is made of gas, but once it permeates flesh, it poisons it from the inside.

entry: 会出现在宠物刚刚离世的人家中。虽然身体由气体构成，训练家却说，它卧在膝上时依然能感觉到。
author: melodydelune
source: It appears in the homes of people whose pets have recently passed. Despite being made of gas, Trainers say they feel it when it lays on their laps.

entry: 有些神庙声称建在POKENAME从前出现过的地方。人们前来祭奠逝去的亲人，祈求它在来世保护他们。
author: wiz0z
source: Some temples claim to have been raised on sites where POKENAME appeared in the past. People visit these sites to pay homage to their passed loved ones, praying that POKENAME protects them in the afterlife.

entry: POKENAME发射凝聚的灵体能量球，使中招者极度恐惧。弹丸能穿过实体，因此躲在掩体后毫无用处。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME fires orbs of condensed ghostly energy that instill great fear in those whom are struck. The projectiles phase through solid surfaces, so attempting to hide behind cover is pointless.

entry: 传说它操纵孩子的灵魂，捉弄墓地访客。据说它在附近时，空气中就会回荡着看不见的孩子的笑声。
author: .izik
source: Legends say it manipulates the spirits of children, using them to play pranks on graveyard visitors. The laughter of unseen children is said to echo through the air when it's near.

entry: 人们曾以为POKENAME附身收音机，就能传出死者的声音。这一说法已经被证伪。
author: .izik
source: It was once believed POKENAME's possession of radios let it channel voices of the dead. This has been disproven.

entry: 按下POKENAME的一根钉子，就会将它激怒，使出诅咒报复打扰者。它还会造出气体手，使敌人中毒、窒息。
author: soup1900
source: Pushing down on one of POKENAME's nails will agitate it to the point of unleashing a Curse on those who disturbed it in revenge. It creates a gaseous hand to poison and suffocate enemies.

entry: 这只宝可梦几乎没有重量，快得不可思议。它在天空四处寻找可吓唬的对象，移动时一声不响。
author: speciessaladmallory
source: This Pokémon is unfathomably fast because it is nearly weightless. It scours the skies in search of a victim to scare, as it can move without making a single sound.

entry: POKENAME夜里常在墓地游荡，在每座墓前停下，仿佛默哀。很久没人探望的墓，它会停得更久。黎明到来，便悄悄回到森林，等待黄昏。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME is usually seen wandering cemeteries at night, stopping at each grave as if in mourning. It stays longer for those who have not been visited in a long time. Once dawn arrives, it slinks back into the forest to await the twilight.

entry: POKENAME身上贴着符咒，因为若任其行事，就可能造成大灾难。实现愿望时，它会扭曲愿望，产生与所求相反的结果。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME wear talismans on their bodies because they can cause great calamity if left to their own devices. When granting wishes, they corrupt the wish into an effect contrary to what is desired.

entry: POKENAME的骨骼身体能打出强劲的物理攻击。若强风吹散周围微微发光的气体，它就会散成一堆骨头，直到风平才会恢复。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's skeletal body can deliver powerful physical blows. If a strong wind blows away the faintly glowing gas that surrounds it, it will collapse into a pile of bones and will not recover until the air is still.

entry: POKENAME穿过实体，逃离训练家，丝毫不留曾经到过的痕迹。行踪太难捉摸，使有些人怀疑它根本不存在。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME phase through solid objects to escape Trainers and never leave a single scintilla to prove they were there. Their elusive nature causes some people to doubt they exist at all.

entry: POKENAME无定形的身体，只需微小得几乎看不见的裂缝，就能钻入。它在新月时最活跃，会捉弄人。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's amorphous body allows it to slip into areas with even only microscopic cracks as an entry point. It is most active during the new moon and plays pranks on people.

entry: POKENAME留在旧工厂里，用灵体操纵机器。据说，它们承载着曾被工厂机器伤害的工人的意志。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME linger in old factories where they operate machinery with their ethereal bodies. It is said that they carry the will of workers who were harmed by the factory's machines.

entry: POKENAME在学校和游乐场附近游荡，专门捉弄校园恶霸。因此人们认为，它是受欺负的孩子们的怨念汇集而成，要替他们报复。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME stalks around schools and playgrounds, causing mischief directed at school bullies. Because of this, it is thought to be the combined malice of children who are being picked on and seeks revenge on their behalf.

entry: POKENAME的耳尖缭绕着毒气云。它悄悄接近疲惫的旅人，打上一拳，再伴着阴森笑声消失。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME's ears are tipped with clouds of poisonous gas. It sneaks up on weary travelers and punches them before disappearing with a sinister laugh.

entry: POKENAME凶狠地守护陵墓家园，抵御闯入者。强力的暗影球就是警告，让盗墓者远离。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME fiercely defends its mausoleum home from intruders. Its powerful Shadow Ball serves as a warning to keep graverobbers away.

entry: POKENAME周围裹着紫色凝胶，受压时会升华成气体。逐渐掌握身体后，它能射出装着有毒烟气的泡泡，使敌人犯困。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME has a purple gel around its body that sublimates into a gas when under stress. As POKENAME gains mastery over its body, it can shoot bubbles of noxious fumes to make foes sleepy.

entry: POKENAME悲伤的哀号，夜里回荡在墓地。据说，这是它呼唤同类的方式。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME makes mournful wails that echo through graveyards at night. The sounds are thought to be its way of calling to others of its kind.

entry: POKENAME喜欢捉弄人。突然出现在视线中，又迅速消失，把人吓一跳，纳闷它究竟去了哪里。
author: sottiwotti
source: POKENAME likes to prank people. It appears in someone's sight and then quickly vanishes, scaring the person and making them wonder where it went.

entry: POKENAME的尖刺近乎虚体，能穿过实体而不留孔洞，却似乎仍能将它固定在原地。谁碰到硬壳，生命力还会被慢慢吸走。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's spikes are insubstantial enough to pass through solid objects without leaving holes. They still seem to anchor it in place and will slowly drain life-force from anyone who touches POKENAME's hard shell.

entry: POKENAME领地意识极强，会不惜一切守巢。它能穿过任何东西追上敌人，因此根本无法逃离。
author: archserpent
source: POKENAME is fiercely territorial and will defend its nest at all costs. It's impossible to run away from as it will phase through anything to reach its foe.

entry: POKENAME出现在噩梦里，能从梦境闯入清醒的世界。它的能量只够吐一口幽灵气息，播下更多噩梦的种子，随后又消散于无形。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME appears in nightmares and can break out of the dreaming world into the waking one. It only has enough energy to expel a ghostly breath that sows the seed for more nightmares to follow, before fading back into nothing.

entry: POKENAME周围的外衣，由自身释放的气体形成。气体还能用舒适的暖意裹住敌人，使其失去行动能力，陷入毫无防备的状态。
author: jojojax164
source: The coat that surrounds POKENAME is formed by the gas that POKENAME emits. This gas can also be used to incapacitate enemies, wrapping them in a cozy warmth and leaving them in a vulnerable state.

entry: POKENAME头上的叶子由剧毒气体构成，能使对方麻痹或昏倒。它会将全身埋进土里，让叶子伪装成普通草木，伏击敌人。
author: robobunnybutt
source: The leaves on its head are made of highly toxic gases, which can cause paralysis or induce fainting. POKENAME can bury its whole body in soil, as a means to disguise its leaves as foliage and ambush its foes.

entry: 据说POKENAME身上的每簇火焰，都是一个死在森林里的孩子的灵魂。它吸取周围植物的生命能量，防止自身枯萎消散。
author: entomoxie
source: The individual flames on a POKENAME are said to each be the soul of a child who died in the forest. POKENAME take life energy from plants around them to keep their own bodies from withering away.

entry: POKENAME用气体身体藏在树里，密切观察穿行森林的对象。若觉得树上有双眼睛在盯着自己，很可能就是它投来的目光。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses its gaseous body to hide within trees and closely watch those traversing its forest. If one believes they saw a pair of eyes on a tree watching them, there is a high chance it was POKENAME glancing their way.

entry: POKENAME的气体浓度高、毒性强，能瞬间麻痹受害者。它流出腐臭的蜜，引来昆虫和其他小猎物。
author: robobunnybutt
source: POKENAME's gases are highly concentrated and toxic, capable of paralyzing its victims in an instant. It drools a putrid honey to attract insects and other small prey.

entry: POKENAME在高空漂浮，翅膀由极薄的雾气构成。身体如此轻盈，POKENAME常被高空急流吹散，散落到世界各地。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Drifting high in the atmosphere, the wings of POKENAME are composed of a very thin mist. As light as their bodies are, POKENAME are often dispersed by the jet stream and can be found all over the world.

entry: POKENAME能控制周围空气，让狂风变成微风。它必须这么做，否则脆弱的身体就会逐渐散去。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME can control the air around them, reducing stormy gales to gentle breezes. They need to do this because their bodies are delicate enough to dwindle away otherwise.

entry: 强风吹来时，POKENAME分泌的污泥会让自己滑倒，气体身体溶进污泥中。它因此常被其他宝可梦欺负，尽管其实很能打。
author: karmaofevil
source: Whenever strong winds pass by, the sludge excreted by POKENAME causes it to slip, its gas body dissolving in the substance. It is often bullied by other Pokémon because of this. Despite this, it is a great fighter.

entry: POKENAME靠灵体能量维系身体，却难以保持形状。快要维持不住时，它就索性散开，之后再找新岩石修补。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME hold themselves together using a spectral energy, but struggle to maintain their forms. When a POKENAME struggles to keep form, they opt to crumble, later repairing themselves with new rocks.

entry: POKENAME附身古老的钢铁塑像，用气体身体填满、驱动雕像，保护自己。深夜，它们在这些旧遗迹间游荡，金属碰撞声响彻夜空。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME possess ancient steel effigies, their gaseous bodies animating and filling the statues as a means of protecting themselves. They roam through these old ruins deep in the night, the clanking of their movements filling the night air.

entry: POKENAME缕缕甜香的花粉极易引发过敏。古时，人们敬畏它的大花瓣，将其视为瘟疫和疾病的先兆。
author: robobunnybutt
source: Its sweet-smelling, wispy pollen is highly allergenic. In olden times, POKENAME's large petals were revered as a harbinger of plague and disease.

entry: POKENAME住在海底沉船里，悲痛的哭声能传出数英里。它在船中收集陈旧残破的骨架，仿佛在悼念一船水手。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME reside inside sunken ships at the bottom of the sea where their heartbroken cries can be heard for miles. They collect old, decrepit skeletons inside the ship as though they were mourning a nautical crew.

entry: POKENAME主要捕猎伽勒尔太阳珊瑚等水生幽灵属性宝可梦，通常在沉船附近出现。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME mainly hunts aquatic Ghost-type Pokémon such as Galarian Corsola. It is usually spotted around shipwrecks.

entry: POKENAME常藏进自己的壳里，和幼童或幼小宝可梦玩躲猫猫。坚壳保护着气体核心，免遭足以将其吹散的强风。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME will often conceal itself within its own shell and play peak-a-boo with young children or young Pokémon. Their tough shells protect them from strong winds that would otherwise disperse their gaseous core.

entry: POKENAME附在火化遗骸上，在墓地游荡，驱赶盗墓者。若发现有人亵渎坟墓，它就埋住对方的双腿，直到对方道歉。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME possess cremated remains and wander cemeteries to ward off grave robbers. If they find someone desecrating a grave, they bury the legs of the intruder until an apology is made.

entry: POKENAME附在类似火化遗骸的灰烬上，巡逻墓地，驱赶盗墓者，也安慰来访的人。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME possess ashes that resemble cremated remains. They patrol cemeteries to chase off grave robbers and comfort visitors.

entry: POKENAME完全昼伏夜出，对光极其敏感，白天睡在地下。若被阳光照到，就会用孢子遮住自己，保持黑暗。
author: oddwalls
source: POKENAME is entirely nocturnal and very sensitive to light, sleeping underground during the day. If exposed to sunlight, it will shroud itself with spores to remain in darkness.

entry: 传说POKENAME会挖开不诚实者的坟墓，揭出隐藏的秘密。诡异的举动，让附近的人心神不宁。
author: .izik
source: Tales claim POKENAME digs up the graves of the dishonest, revealing hidden secrets. Its eerie actions unsettle those nearby.

entry: 有人说，碰到POKENAME的灵质鬃毛，就会被不安的灵魂纠缠折磨。更糟的是，还会挨上一记沉重的暗影爪。
author: ghostslythe
source: Some say if anyone touches POKENAME's ectoplasmic mane, they will be tormented by restless spirits. Worse yet, any who touch it will endure a crushing Shadow Claw.

entry: POKENAME背上的蘑菇不断产生灵体孢子，随风飘散。孢子能穿墙，落进废弃建筑，长成只有暗光下才看得见的幽灵般菌盖。
author: .jerden
source: The mushroom on POKENAME's back constantly produces ghostly spores, which will be blown away by the wind. These spores pass through walls to settle inside abandoned buildings, growing into ghostly mushroom caps only visible in dim light.

entry: POKENAME伸舌舔洞穴中的宝石。若发现一簇格外美味的晶体，就会笑个不停，原因不明。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME extends its tongue to lick gemstones found in caves. If it discovers a particularly tasty cluster, it laughs uncontrollably for unknown reasons.

entry: 碰到POKENAME气体耳朵和尾巴中的蓝焰，会遭到剧烈灼伤。据说，受害者必须真心道歉，再献上一些生命力，才能缓解。
author: fancyskunk
source: If touched, the blue flames amidst POKENAME's gaseous ears and tail will cause an intense burn. Victims are said to only find relief if they offer POKENAME a sincere apology and some of their life force.

entry: POKENAME看似顽皮，观察力却比表现出来的更敏锐。攻击时，它会四处跳跃，从胸前和背后喷出令人作呕的气泡。
author: beatdoof
source: It might seem like a mischievous Pokémon, but it's more perceptive than it lets on. POKENAME attacks by leaping about while spewing repulsive gas bubbles from its chest and back.

entry: POKENAME爱将头从紫色泡泡般的围巾上摘下，捉弄训练家。它乘着自己的气云快速移动，沿途咯咯笑。
author: beatdoof
source: POKENAME loves pranking its Trainer by detaching its head from its purple, bubble-like scarf. It moves very quickly by riding its own gas cloud, giggling along the way.

entry: POKENAME排出的气体，会让身处其中的对象发冷，产生不祥预感。游乐鬼屋会请它用烟雾增添恐怖气氛。
author: sk372
source: The gas POKENAME expels induces chills and foreboding feelings in those immersed in it. Haunted house attractions employ POKENAME in order to help further the spooky ambience with its smog.

entry: POKENAME不断从体内释放浓重紫烟。虽然已经证实无毒，仍不建议大量吸入。
author: ruben2309295
source: POKENAME constantly emits strong purple smoke from its body. Even though the smoke has been proven to be nontoxic, it is still recommended not to breathe in too much of it.

entry: 野外，POKENAME常想讨好南瓜精群，混进其中。等其他宝可梦入睡，它就施咒制造噩梦，整夜大吃。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is known to try and ingratiate itself within groups of Pumpkaboo in the wild. While the other Pokémon sleep, it hexes them to cause nightmares it can feast on all night long.

entry: 人们曾以为POKENAME诞生于将熄的火焰。其实，只是火光使它们不敢靠近。
author: .fedoraman
source: POKENAME were once believed to be born out of dying flames. In reality, the light from the fire just kept them at bay.

entry: POKENAME爱渗进老建筑的裂缝，因而恶名在外。据接触过它气体的人说，会看见令人不安的幻象。
author: busilisk
source: POKENAME is notorious for seeping into the cracks of old buildings. People exposed to its gases have reported unsettling hallucinations.

entry: 有人说，矿井出事故时，就会诞生POKENAME。野生个体厌恶闯入者，会使出无害的恶作剧和危险举动，确保荒凉的家园不被侵入。
author: bobosmith01
source: When there is an accident in a mining shaft, some say a POKENAME is born. Wild POKENAME dislike intruders and perform harmless pranks and dangerous stunts to make sure none invade the desolate place they call home.

entry: 有人说，矿井出事故时，就会诞生POKENAME。野生个体厌恶闯入者，会使出无害的恶作剧和危险举动，确保荒凉的家园不被侵入。
author: bobosmith01
source: When there is an accident in a mining shaft, some say a POKENAME is born. Wild POKENAME dislike intruders and perform harmless pranks and dangerous stunts to make sure none invade the desolate place they call home.

entry: POKENAME喜欢收集闪亮物品。会躲进废弃建筑避开强风，在外人看来像诡异闪烁的光点。
author: essie
source: POKENAME adore collecting shiny objects. They will hide from strong winds in abandoned buildings, looking to outsiders like eerie, flickering lights.

entry: POKENAME释放幽灵般的泡泡，储存头痛产生的能量。但泡泡终究会破裂，头痛便又会发作。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME releases phantasmal bubbles that store the energy from its headaches. When the bubbles inevitably pop, it will experience another headache.

entry: POKENAME感知到人或宝可梦的生命气息接近家园，就会暴怒。它穿墙直扑闯入者，用虚幻的爪子猛打，将对方赶走。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME grow intensely angry when they sense the vitality of people or Pokémon approaching their home. They race through walls to charge directly at the interloper, lashing out with ethereal paws to bully the intruder away.

entry: POKENAME感知到人或宝可梦的生命气息接近家园，就会暴怒。它隐身埋伏，在与闯入者视线平齐处突然现身，接连猛攻。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME grow intensely angry when they sense the vitality of people or Pokémon approaching their home. They wait invisibly to ambush interlopers, appearing at eye level before launching a flurry of strikes at the intruder.

entry: POKENAME发怒时，周围会涌出浓密的气体，让别人也愤怒。气体浓到一定程度，甚至会遮住自己的视线，让它更加生气。
author: infinex21
source: When a POKENAME rages, it exudes thick plumes of an anger-inducing gas all around it. A POKENAME's gaseous aura can become so thick that it may even cloud its own vision, further angering it.

entry: POKENAME常在战死者的墓前出没。它向外散发怒意，让附近的对象陷入超自然的狂怒，可能数小时才会消退。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are commonly found haunting the graves of those who have died in combat. They project their anger outward, afflicting those close to them with a supernatural rage that can take hours to pass.

entry: POKENAME常在战死者的墓前出没，挑唆悲伤的人打架。墓地是它的家，那里一爆发混战，它就疯狂大笑。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are commonly found haunting the graves of those who have died in combat. They goad grieving people into fights, cackling maniacally when brawls break out in the cemeteries they call home.

entry: POKENAME平静时，散出的雾触感清凉。战斗时温度升高，能够灼伤对手。
author: ohok3441
source: When calm, the mist POKENAME produces is cool to the touch. In battle, it rises in temperature to burn opponents.

entry: POKENAME极为记仇，永远不会忘记伤害过自己的面孔。得罪它的人，会被拖进坟墓。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME is incredibly vengeful, never forgetting the faces of those who hurt it. It'll drag people who've wronged it to their grave.

entry: POKENAME以恶意捉弄人为乐。它装作善良，让人爬上背，带着飞越天空，再突然化作虚体，让乘客摔向地面。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME take pleasure in playing malicious tricks on people. Acting benevolent, they allow people to clamber onto their back and take them for rides across the sky before abruptly turning intangible, allowing their passenger to fall to the ground.

entry: POKENAME不分敌我地用气体淹没战场。只有意志坚定的训练家，才能赢得尊重，教它学会控制。
author: .fedoraman
source: POKENAME flood the battlefield with gas indiscriminately. It takes a Trainer with a strong will to gain the respect of a POKENAME and teach them control.

entry: POKENAME夜里在城市游荡，想找没吃完的饭菜。若在用餐时被训练家撞见，它就催眠对方，强迫其替自己找食物。
author: skleegamer
source: POKENAME roams cities at night hoping to find leftovers of unfinished meals. If it is encountered during a meal by a Trainer, it hypnotizes the Trainer and forces them to find food for it.

entry: POKENAME的勺子能引导灵体能量，使它对别人施小咒。它似乎特别爱用这能力，去烦其他幽灵属性宝可梦。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's spoon helps it channel ghostly energy, allowing it to cast minor hexes on others. It seems to have a particular affinity for using this power to annoy other Ghost-type Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME几乎全由有毒气体构成，形状像喇叭芽。偶尔能在森林见到，它融入黑暗，捕捉各种大小的猎物。
author: sakuraneko
source: POKENAME's body is made up almost entirely of a toxic gas that resembles a Bellsprout. It can rarely be found in forests where it blends into the darkness in order to capture prey of any size.

entry: 目标在阴影中难以察觉POKENAME漆黑的气体身体，就已被麻痹气息制住。成功训练过的POKENAME极少。
author: .fedoraman
source: Targets struggle to perceive POKENAME's dark, gaseous body in the shadows before they are incapacitated by its paralytic breath. Few POKENAME have ever been successfully trained.

entry: POKENAME住在黑暗洞穴，等着伏击闯入者。它们会把同伴扔向旅人，放声怪笑，发光的诡异双眼令受害者恐惧。
author: bluenido.
source: POKENAME reside in dark caves, waiting to ambush intruders. They hurl one another at travelers, cackling wildly as their glowing, eerie eyes strike terror into their victims.

entry: POKENAME格外顽皮，爱吓唬靠近冰冷海岸的人。但恶作剧常能救命，将人赶离寒冷到可能使人溺水的海域。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is a particularly mischievous creature that enjoys scaring people who venture too close to icy shores. Its pranks, however, often save lives by moving people away from waters so cold they could cause drowning.

entry: 这种宝可梦在空中游动，姿态常被形容为芭蕾舞者般优雅。可它对人类的行为，却往往相当邪恶。
author: zweizweihander
source: This Pokémon is often described as swimming through the air with the grace of a ballet dancer. In contrast to that, its behavior towards humans tends to be rather nefarious.

entry: 身体结构不稳定，让它连站直都勉强。有人见过POKENAME成群聚在废弃之地，一些最古老的恐怖故事便由此而来。
author: leeto64
source: Due to its unstable anatomy, it can barely stay upright. Sightings of POKENAME swarming abandoned areas inspired some of the oldest horror stories.

entry: POKENAME几乎连身体的轮廓都维持不住。它移动时，所经之处几乎一切都会被整团污泥吞没。
author: leeto64
source: POKENAME is barely able to keep any semblance of form in its body. As it moves, pratically anything will be engulfed whole in its mass of sludge.

entry: POKENAME从壳上的炮管喷出毒气，用浓雾覆盖战场。气体毒性极强，在里面待得太久，谁都会昏倒。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME spew poisonous gas from the cannons on their shells, covering the battlefield in a thick fog. This gas is highly toxic, causing anyone caught in it for too long to faint.

entry: 它的气体身体由毒气团和具象化的怨念构成。它爱在聚落附近游荡，寻找更多怨恨和毒素，吸入体内。
author: beatdoof
source: A gaseous body comprised of clumps of toxic gas and manifested grievances, it loves to roam near settlements in search of more resentment and toxins to absorb into itself.

entry: 古籍记载，POKENAME源于古老诅咒，据说会将人类变成它们的同类。
author: pokebio
source: There are ancient tomes stating POKENAME originate from ancient curses. They are said to turn humans into their kind.

entry: 它沉浸在最深的阴影中，对经过的训练家耳语。宝可梦研究者已译出这些低语，但内容似乎多是难懂的胡言乱语。
author: kam_doodle_snek
source: It wallows in the darkest shadows, murmuring into the ears of trainers who pass by. This muttering has been translated by Pokémon researchers, though the messages appear to be mostly incomprehensible ramblings.

entry: 许多人遇见POKENAME后，很快就会忘掉这段经历，仿佛它从未存在。有人说，它不属于这层现实，只偶尔窥探我们的世界。
author: sk372
source: Many who come across POKENAME forget the experience shortly after, as if it never existed. Some say POKENAME does not exist in this realm of reality, only peeking into our world on rare occasions.

entry: POKENAME藏在阴影中，寻找能被自己催眠的人。成功后就吸取睡者的灵魂，增强自身力量。
author: thefinalkalgonus
source: POKENAME hides in the shadows and looks for people it can put to sleep. When its successful, it will absorb the sleeper's soul to increase its power.

entry: POKENAME从触角散发宜人香气，引来猎物。只要靠近，就会被黏手抓住，据说连生命力也会被舔走。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: POKENAME releases a pleasant scent from its antennae to lure prey in. Once something comes close, it grabs onto them with its sticky hands and is said to lick away their life force.

entry: POKENAME在伐木场闹鬼，想吓跑作业的伐木工。最喜欢的方法，是将工人引到重型机械前，再突然启动引擎。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME haunt logging sites, attempting to scare off lumberjacks that are trying to work the area. Their favourite method of doing so involves luring workers in front of heavy machinery before abruptly turning the engines on.

entry: POKENAME能在星界操纵四肢，踢出从肉体角度看几乎不可能的招式。
author: entomoxie
source: With control of their limbs across the astral plane, POKENAME can launch kicks that otherwise seem physically impossible.

entry: POKENAME的拳头与身体分离，能从任何方向攻击对手。身体没有实体，因此只有拳头能被击中。
author: santon5512
source: With their fists disconnected from their bodies, POKENAME can send punches at their opponents from any direction. Their incorporeal bodies mean that their fists are the only part of them able to be hit.

entry: POKENAME仿佛不受重力影响，在空中漂浮，背上的翅膀却诡异地一动不动。翅膀覆着有毒鳞片，触碰可能招来痛苦的诅咒。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME float through the air as though unaffected by gravity, their wings eerily staying stationary above their backs. They have a toxic coating of scales along their wings, contact with which can result in painful curses.

entry: POKENAME通常出现在阴暗处，用有节奏的红光吸引毫无戒备的受害者，再附上去吸取生命力。
author: vlavoc
source: POKENAME is typically found in dark, shadowy areas. It uses its rhythmic red light to attract unsuspecting victims, before latching on to them to drain their life force.

entry: 刚遭雷击的地方，常有大群POKENAME出现。几名训练家曾见它们收集残余电力，分给较弱的鬼怪。
author: excelline
source: POKENAME are found in large groups wherever lightning has struck recently. Several Trainers have witnessed them harnessing the leftover electricity and sharing it around with weaker Haunkid.

entry: 碰到POKENAME的任一尖刺，都会轻微发抖、感到阴冷，但尖刺并没有毒。它在靠近繁茂树木的灌木里筑巢，确保随时有叶子吃。
author: infinex21
source: Although contact with either of its spikes will incite small tremors and a chilling feeling, they are not venomous. POKENAME nests within bushes closest to lush trees so it may always have leaves to eat.

entry: POKENAME曾被视为恶意的宝可梦，如今却被认为会将灵魂渡往来世。它常在沉船附近出现，有时还把残骸当巢穴。
author: infinex21
source: Once considered to be a malicious Pokémon, POKENAME are now believed to be the ones that ferry souls to the afterlife. They often are spotted near shipwrecks, and some even use the wreckage as a den.

entry: POKENAME惯常在无人照管的发电厂闹鬼，喜欢用带静电的毛蹭人和宝可梦，让对方麻痹。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME habitually haunts unattended power plants. It delights in paralyzing humans and Pokémon by rubbing its static-charged fur against them.

entry: POKENAME藏进电脑，弹出大量报错和恶意软件报告，捉弄使用者。幸好全是假的，不会损坏电脑，只会吓坏用户。
author: sk372
