source: POKENAME pranks computer users by hiding itself in their machine and sending up floods of errors and malware reports. Fortunately, these are entirely fake and it causes no damage to the computer, only panic in the user.

entry: POKENAME很少移动，只有分离的爪子会动，而爪子也不能离身体太远。它用爪子吓退别人、取食，不过吃得不多。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME rarely move, aside from their detached claws; these claws can still only move so far from them. They use their claws to scare off others and to eat, though they don't need to eat much.

entry: POKENAME厌恶被取走体内骨头，使古生物学家的化石发掘很困难。攻击性与缺失骨头的数量相关，因此学者会将镰刀盔化石留到最后才挖。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME despise having bones removed from their bodies, which makes excavating fossils difficult for paleontologists. Their level of aggression is correlated to how many bones they are missing, so paleontologists excavate fossils of Kabutops last.

entry: 许多古代文明将POKENAME视为邪恶魔物。燃烧般的外形、咯咯怪笑，以及以纠缠人类为乐的习性，让它十分可怕。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's was considered a malevolent demon by many ancient civilizations. Its blazing appearance, combined with its cackling laugh and tendency to haunt humans for fun, made it quite the terror.

entry: POKENAME是出没于偏远岛屿的幽灵龙，并不特别邪恶，只是更喜欢独处。它造出可怕的龙形幻象，阻止人们接近家园。
author: sk372
source: A ghostly dragon spirit that haunts remote islands, POKENAME is not particularly malevolent, but much prefers solitude. It conjures up fearsome illusions of dragons to dissuade people from approaching its home.

entry: POKENAME能猛刺毒针，干净利落地贯穿粗树。哪怕微量毒液，也会消磨求生意志，使中毒者连自身安危都不再关心。
author: infinex21
source: Their venomous stingers can be driven with enough force to cleanly puncture a thick tree. Even in trace amounts, POKENAME venom can drain one's very will to live, to the point they will cease caring for their own well-being.

entry: POKENAME用超能力，看见墓中安眠者的幻影。看见幻影时，身体也会变成死者的模样，成为紫色漂浮人影。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its psychic powers to see visions of those who rest in graves. During these visions, its body takes the form of the deceased, appearing as a purple floating figure.

entry: POKENAME潜伏在患病的人和宝可梦附近，试着用叶子触碰。它曾受人惧怕、厌恶，直到人们发现，叶子幽灵般的寒意极擅退烧。
author: lordjoostmeister
source: POKENAME lurks near ill people and Pokémon, attempting to touch them with its leaf. POKENAME was feared and despised until it was discovered that the leaf's ghostly chill is extremely effective at breaking fevers.

entry: POKENAME虽然浑身覆着灵火，身体摸起来却很冷。它在无月之夜最活跃，无声地尾随受害者。
author: mepp.
source: Though POKENAME is covered in spectral flames, its body is quite cold to the touch. It is most active on moonless nights, stalking its victims silently.

entry: POKENAME以宝可梦蛋孵化时人们的喜悦为食。因此，它会纠缠存着未孵化蛋的训练家，一直跟随，直到全部孵出来。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME feed on the positive feelings people experience whenever a Pokémon egg hatches. For this reason, they haunt Trainers who have unhatched eggs in storage, following them around until they hatch them all.

entry: POKENAME能极其准确地预测宝可梦何时瞬间移动，再用神秘力量使目的地偏离。它也喜欢夜里一动不动，吓唬毫无戒备的目标。
author: npshi
source: POKENAME can predict when a Pokémon teleports with frightening accuracy, using this knowledge to steer the Pokémon's destination off course with their mystical powers. POKENAME enjoy standing perfectly still at night, scaring unsuspecting targets.

entry: POKENAME的花瓣会闪光，月光下尤其明显。跳舞时，花瓣彼此摩擦，发出近似巫女法器的清响。
author: robobunnybutt
source: POKENAME's petals can be seen to shimmer and glow, especially when exposed to moonlight. When it dances, its petals rub together and make a ringing sound not unlike tools used by shrine maidens.

entry: POKENAME常在战场出没，起初被视为死亡幽魂。后来人们发现，它会寻找伤者，喂下用灵体叶子制成的酊剂，稳定伤势。
author: ghostslythe
source: Usually found haunting battlefields, POKENAME originally was seen as a specter of death. It was discovered it seeks out the wounded and feeds them a tincture made from its ghostly leaves, stabilizing their conditions.

entry: POKENAME住在下水道，常沿排水管爬进家里。被它纠缠的训练家常说，墙内传来抓挠声。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME reside in sewers, often climbing through drains to infiltrate homes. Trainers haunted by these Pokémon often report hearing scratching noises from their walls.

entry: POKENAME寻找刚有新住户的建筑，隐身拍肩、在房里乱扔东西，四处恶作剧。戴鲁比等宠物很容易把它赶走，它便换个地方折腾。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME seeks out buildings with new inhabitants and then pulls pranks, such as tapping people on the shoulder while invisible or throwing items around rooms. It is easily chased off by pets like Houndour, leading it to find a new place to torment.

entry: POKENAME是花园里的幽灵祸害，会抓挠泥土，拔起能找到的所有植物。这究竟出于残忍恶意，还是另有不明原因，人们看法不一。
author: sk372
source: A ghostly scourge of gardens, POKENAME claws at the dirt and uproots all the plants it can find. Opinions are divided on if it does this out of cruel spite or for some other unknown reason.

entry: POKENAME是灵体，能穿过树木、枝条等实体。它在森林中飞掠，常追逐、折磨其他宝可梦。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are ethereal beings that phases through dense objects, such as trees or branches. They often torment and chase other Pokémon while zipping through the forest.

entry: POKENAME出奇地友好，会招手让附近的对象靠近。对方一来，它就打喷嚏，喷上一层凝胶；凝胶接触皮肤，会让人笑个不停，并触发多巴胺释放。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Surprisingly, POKENAME is very friendly. It motions for those nearby to approach, and if they do, it sneezes a gel onto them that, upon contact with skin, causes uncontrollable laughter and triggers dopamine release.

entry: POKENAME身上的大舌贝，似乎是幽灵力量的来源。一旦大舌贝开始漂浮，混乱很快就会发生。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's Shellder seems to be the source of its ghostly powers. When a POKENAME's Shellder begins to float, chaos will soon ensue.

entry: POKENAME的幽灵手扭拧着本体。若察觉谁藏着秘密，它就抖动身体、发出令人不安的尖叫，一直纠缠到对方说出实情。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME's ghostly hand wrenches its own body. When it senses someone is keeping a secret, POKENAME haunts them by shaking itself and squealing unsettlingly until they admit the truth.

entry: POKENAME藏在农田，只露出背上的种子。它用藤蔓缠住毫无戒备的受害者，吸走能量，直到对方精疲力尽倒下。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME hides in crop fields with only its bulb sticking out. It wraps its vines around unsuspecting victims, leeching away their energy until they drop from exhaustion.

entry: 这只拉达曾是某人队伍中的战斗主力。死后葬在紫苑镇，却又从墓中归来。
author: theheroict
source: A Raticate that was once a key battler in someone's party. It came to its end and was buried in Lavender Town, where it came back from the grave.

entry: POKENAME以恐惧为食，用危险的恶作剧在市区恶意闹鬼。吸收的恐惧越多，红珠项链越亮，也就越难隐藏，直到它吃掉储存的恐惧。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME feeds on fear, so it maliciously haunts urban areas with dangerous tricks. The red orb necklace glows brighter as it absorbs more fear, making it harder to hide until it consumes the stored fear.

entry: 它几乎全由气体构成，几乎哪都能去，甚至地下深处也不例外。但它厌光、不喜欢被看见，因此往往还是留在同一个地方。
author: bobosmith01
source: Its body is composed almost entirely of gas, and it can travel almost anywhere, even deep underground. However, it loathes the light and dislikes being seen, so it tends to stay in one area anyway.

entry: POKENAME寻找熔岩流留下的碎屑和石块，附身后让岩石重新活动，模仿曾裹挟它们的熔岩。身体因释放的气体，闪着诡异紫光。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME find detritus and rubble left over from lava flows and possess them, reanimating the rocks and creating a simulacrum of the molten rock that once carried them. Their bodies glow with an eerie purple light from the gases they produce.

entry: POKENAME用茄紫色翅膀掠过猎物，靠离体的利爪将其抓起。它尤其喜欢咩利羊，因为爪子很容易抓牢。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME swoop over prey with their aubergine wings and pick them up with disembodied talons. They are particularly fond of Mareep because they are easy for their talons to grab onto.

entry: POKENAME喜欢在人开会时附身麦克风，让声音消失，直到被发现。每次检查，麦克风都没坏，却会始终静音，直到它离开设备。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME enjoy possessing microphones while someone is in a meeting and muting the sound until it is noticed. Attempts to fix the microphone will always show that it works but will remain muted until POKENAME leaves the device.

entry: 有些文化中流传着迷信：POKENAME周游世界，吸走艺术家的创造力，直到对方陷入绝望。无论天气如何，尾上的颜料状液体总是稀稀的，又很冰冷。
author: bobosmith01
source: In several cultures, there is a superstition that believes POKENAME travels around the world to sap creativity from artists to the point they give in to despair. No matter the weather conditions, the paint-like fluid on its tail is runny yet cold.

entry: POKENAME像个孩子，常假装寻求安慰，骗训练家握住自己的手。接着便给对方一记无伤大雅的电击，咯咯笑着跑开。
author: enemyphase
source: Childlike in demeanor, POKENAME often trick Trainers into holding their hand under the guise of seeking comfort. They then administer a harmless electric shock and run away chortling.

entry: POKENAME个头大，有时会在图书馆工作，用尾巴和手拿高架上的物品。若仍够不着，它会让训练家爬到身上，再把训练家举高。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Due to their large size, POKENAME can sometimes be seen working at libraries, using their tail and hands to reach items on higher shelves. Should something exceed their range, they will let their Trainer climb atop and lift them up.

entry: POKENAME带来早已逝去之人的讯息，想帮助悲伤的家属。但这番努力引来复杂情绪，有些人还没准备好听到，反而会生气。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME bring messages from people who have long passed in an effort to help grieving families. Their efforts have mixed feelings attached and may cause anger in some people who are not ready to hear the message.

entry: POKENAME的双爪靠灵体能量与身体相连，会吸走碰到的一切的能量。双爪也极灵巧，它常用来拆东西，再重新组装，却会装得略有差错。
author: .jerden
source: Connected to their body by spectral energy, POKENAME's two claws drain energy from anything they touch. They are also incredibly dexterous, and POKENAME often uses them to dismantle objects, then put them back together slightly wrong.

entry: 远看，POKENAME常被误认为人类。可一显露真面目，它就会用剑无情劈斩，甚至连倒地的敌人也不放过，凶狠撕扯。
author: actliux
source: From a distance, people often mistake POKENAME for a human. Until that is, POKENAME reveals its true nature and delivers ruthless slashes with its sword, even viciously tearing at already downed foes.

entry: POKENAME会模仿受害者最恐惧的东西，捉弄毫无戒备的对象。出人意料的是，这种看似恶意的行为，竟有助于人们的心理健康。
author: turcai_87271
source: POKENAME have been known to play tricks on unsuspecting victims, imitating their greatest fears. Surprisingly, this supposedly malicious practice has become useful in helping people with their mental health.

entry: POKENAME凭强壮双臂，从电线和建筑中扯出导线，大搞破坏。有人归咎于恶意，也有人说，这只是它觉得好玩的方式。
author: t3isukone
source: With its powerful arms, POKENAME tears electrical wires free from power lines and buildings to cause havoc. While some attribute this to malice, others say it is simply this Pokémon's idea of fun.

entry: POKENAME能短暂化作虚体，穿过实体。追逐其他宝可梦或训练家时，若对方扔来障碍，这能力就很方便。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can enter into a momentary incorporeal state that allows them to phase through physical objects. This is handy when chasing other Pokémon or Trainers when they toss obstacles their way.

entry: POKENAME用幽灵手臂招呼夜行者跟随，将对方引到僻静处，再为应邀者献上催眠般的舞姿。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's ghostly arms beckon wanderers in the night to follow it. Drawing them to a secluded area, it treats those who follow its call to its hypnotic dance moves.

entry: POKENAME凭美貌和甜美嗓音，夜里轻唱摇篮曲，让猎物误以为安全。随后偷走生命能量，增强自己，再隐入黑暗，等待下一名受害者。
author: keiracm35_
source: With their beauty and sweet voices, POKENAME lure their prey by singing soft lullabies at night, giving them a false sense of security. They then steal their life energy to grow stronger and vanish into darkness, awaiting their next victim.

entry: POKENAME悄无声息地漂游，完美融入周围。久留附近的对象说，会觉得疲惫，衰老也更快。人们相信，它会吸食毫无戒备的受害者流失的生命能量。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME drifts unseen, blending perfectly into its surroundings. Those who linger nearby report feeling drained and aging faster. It is believed that POKENAME feeds on the vital energy that seeps from its unsuspecting victims.

entry: POKENAME领地意识强，常为争夺在特定地点闹鬼的权利，与同类交战。幽灵双手彼此碰撞时，空气中就会响起阴森的金属尖啸。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is territorial and often winds up fighting others of its kind for the right to haunt a specific locale. When their ghostly hands clash against each other, eerie metallic screeches course through the air.

entry: 野生POKENAME几乎不动，只凝望远方，让许多人不安。清晨到来便会消失，直到次夜才现身。曾有一次记录，它白天消失时，猛然爆成了毒气。
author: bobosmith01
source: Many find wild POKENAME unsettling as it rarely moves; it merely stares off into the distance until morning comes, where it fades away until the next night. It was recorded once that, when one vanished for the day, it exploded into toxic gas.

entry: POKENAME生性恶毒，是臭名昭著的幽灵属性融合体之一。一晚会吓人几十次，看着对方恐惧的模样，整夜开心地放声大笑。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is one of the more infamous Ghost-type fusions due to its malicious nature. It terrorizes people with dozens of scares a night, loudly and gleefully laughing all night at the fear they exhibit.

entry: POKENAME能将握紧的拳头像导弹般射出，用尖刺击中敌人，再用手掌抓住，吸走生命力。它在黑夜捕猎，似乎会被怕黑的人吸引。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME can fire off its clenched fists like missiles to strike foes with its sharp spikes, then grab them with its palms to drain life force. It hunts for prey on dark nights and seems to be drawn towards people who are afraid of the dark.

entry: POKENAME远远尾随沙漠中的旅人，等待对方精疲力尽。它们与梦歌仙人掌是天敌。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME will stalk travelers in the desert from a distance, waiting until they tire out. They are natural enemies to Cacturne.

entry: 深夜，POKENAME静静飘过海上天空，留下一缕缕奇怪的红光。科学家已研究多年，希望弄清这些红光由什么构成。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME drifts silently through ocean skies late at night, leaving curious red wisps in its wake. Scientists have spent years studying these wisps in hopes of determining what they are made of.

entry: POKENAME在古庙闹鬼，迅速穿梭阴影，人们只能瞥见一瞬。等终于现身，奇特的外貌通常就足以让人惊恐逃走。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME haunts ancient temples, quickly moving between shadows so that people can only briefly glimpse it. When it finally does reveal itself, its strange appearance is usually enough to send them fleeing in terror.

entry: 夜里，POKENAME身上的灌木会长树果，给其他幽灵宝可梦吃。但宝可梦以外的对象不能吃，否则会强烈恐惧食物，并陷入麻痹。
author: beatdoof
source: At night, POKENAME's bushes will grow berries for other Ghost Pokémon to eat. However, do not eat them unless one is a Pokémon, as the berries will cause intense cibophobia and paralysis.

entry: POKENAME背上布满坟墓，常住着许多幽灵属性宝可梦。人们相信，一些古代游牧文化会带它同行，便能安葬死者，又不必将他们抛下。
author: rymyll_the_wanderer
source: POKENAME's back is covered with graves and is often home to many Ghost-type Pokémon. It is believed that some ancient nomadic cultures traveled with POKENAME in their group, allowing them to bury their deceased without having to abandon them.

entry: 据说POKENAME背上的墓园，刻着死于它手下的人的名字。它潜伏在最黑暗的森林，等待旅人迎来不幸的死期。
author: beatdoof
source: The graveyard it carries on POKENAME's back is said to bear the names of those who died at its hands. In the darkest of forests, it lurks, waiting for travelers to meet their untimely end.

entry: POKENAME虽看起来吓人，其实是最友好的幽灵属性融合体之一。但若训练家受威胁，它就会毫不留情。
author: wh3reverimayr0am
source: Though POKENAME appears threatening, it is actually one of the friendliest Ghost-type Pokémon fusions. However, should its Trainer be threatened, it will not hold anything back.

entry: POKENAME奔跑时能化作虚体，穿过树木或巨石。想恶作剧时，就从地下冒出来，吓训练家和宝可梦。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can turn intangible while they run, phasing through trees or boulders. Whenever they feel mischievous, they emerge from the ground to scare Trainers and Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME用幻觉让领地扭曲蠕动。谁陷进幻觉，它就立刻舔上去，吸走生命力，为幻象提供能量。
author: grannyjojophone
source: POKENAME uses illusions to make its territory shift and squirm. Anybody caught in the illusion is promptly licked by POKENAME, draining their life force and feeding the illusion.

entry: 外貌虽令人不安，性情却十分亲人。可惜，舔一下就可能让训练家麻痹。
author: melodydelune
source: This Pokémon, despite its unnerving appearance, is very affectionate. Unfortunately, its licks have been known to paralyze its Trainer.

entry: 有人说，POKENAME来自噩梦的维度，如今来到这个世界纠缠更多受害者。它造出影子手，触碰别人的影子，让对方感到幻肢阴森的抚摸。
author: sk372
source: Some say POKENAME is a being from a nightmare dimension, now in this world to haunt more victims. It creates shadowy hands that touch upon the shadows of others, making them feel the phantom limb's creepy caress.

entry: POKENAME将手搭在悲伤者肩上，吸取哀伤作为能量。能量储存在体内，为炮管供能。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME places its hands on the shoulders of grieving people to drain their sorrow as a source of energy. This energy is stored within its body to power its cannon.

entry: POKENAME的花藏着幽灵般的藤蔓，用来吸取猎物的生命力。墓地周围常能见到它，偷走刚摆下的鲜花。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's flowers hide its ghostly vines, which it uses to draw the life force from its prey. They can be seen around graveyards, stealing the flowers recently left there.

entry: POKENAME的手臂与身体分离，能从安全距离攻击对手。不过，它只会找其他幽灵属性宝可梦打架。
author: mistymagius
source: Since its arms are not connected to its body, POKENAME can strike its opponents from a safe distance. However, POKENAME will only pick fights with other Ghost-types.

entry: POKENAME能附身电脑等电子设备，用气体身体填满内部。它虽能将设备当身体移动，却通常更喜欢藏着，制造细微却恼人的故障。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME can possess electronic devices like computers, filling the space inside with its gaseous body. While it can move these objects around like a body, it usually prefers to remain hidden and cause subtle but frustrating malfunctions.

entry: POKENAME住在废弃古墓，织无形蛛网抓盗墓者。被网困住的对象，生命力会慢慢被吸走。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME dwells in abandoned ancient tombs, weaving invisible spiderwebs to catch graverobbers. Those caught in its web have their life force slowly absorbed.

entry: POKENAME偏爱旧建筑的椽梁，用气体手臂荡来荡去。身体却是实体，被身上的尖刺扎到，就会止不住地发抖。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME prefer to live in the rafters of old buildings, swinging themselves around using their gaseous arms. Their bodies are solid, and anyone pricked by one of their sharp thorns will begin shivering uncontrollably.

entry: POKENAME偏爱旧建筑的椽梁，用气体手臂荡来荡去。身体却是实体，被身上的尖刺扎到，就会止不住地发抖。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME prefer to live in the rafters of old buildings, swinging themselves around using their gaseous arms. Their bodies are solid, and anyone pricked by one of their sharp thorns will begin shivering uncontrollably.

entry: POKENAME用九条幽灵尾巴制造幻象，欺骗人类与宝可梦。据说，它潜伏在暗林里，顽皮地等待吓唬毫无戒心的对象。
author: thepandasharky
source: POKENAME uses its nine ghostly tails to create illusions that deceive both people and Pokémon. It is said to lurk in dark forests, mischievously waiting to scare unsuspecting victims.

entry: POKENAME的双手能在空中自由漂浮，吸取被击中者的生命力。它喜欢黑暗环境，靠感知其他对象散发的情绪气场辨路。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's hands float freely through the air and can drain life force from anything they strike. POKENAME prefers to live in dark environments, navigating by sensing the emotional auras that others create.

entry: POKENAME能改变形态，伪装成物品或人。有什么靠得太近，它就伸长舌舔上去，吸取生命力。
author: grannyjojophone
source: POKENAME has the ability to shift and change forms, using it to disguise themselves as objects or people. When something gets too close, POKENAME will lick them with a long tongue, draining their life force.

entry: POKENAME在黑暗中活得很好。若在阴影中看见一簇孤零零的红火，拿光一照，就能将它驱散。
author: .fedoraman
source: POKENAME thrives in the darkness. If you see a lonely red flame in the shadows, flash it with light to dispel it.

entry: POKENAME主要在寒冷的沙漠夜里出现，漂浮过天空，再降下，用双颚叼走猎物。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME can primarily be seen on cold desert nights, levitating through the sky. It descends on prey and carries them away in its jaws.

entry: POKENAME无声地飘过空中，周围浮着尖刺。它招手让别人靠近，谁转身离开，背后就会挨到射来的尖刺。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME float silently through the air, surrounded by floating thorns. They will beckon with their hands to encourage others to approach, firing spikes at the back of anyone who turns away.

entry: POKENAME能穿过实体，因此喜欢睡在地板或墙里。听见有谁靠近，就会飞出来想一起玩，通常却吓坏了路人。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME can pass through solid material, so it likes to sleep inside floors or walls. When it hears someone coming, it flies out to play with them, which usually frightens the passerby.

entry: POKENAME用尖獠牙标记领地。这些痕迹似乎与灵界相连，能增强它的幽灵力量。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME uses its sharp tusks to mark its territory. The markings seem to have connections to the spirit world, enhancing its ghostly powers.

entry: POKENAME高速滚动，穿过沿途所有障碍。到达目的地后，它会把爪子扎进最近的表面，让自己停下。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME roll at incredible speeds, phasing through any obstacles in their paths. Once they have arrived at their destinations, they dig their claws into the nearest surface to stop themselves.

entry: POKENAME是可怕的夜行猎手，幽灵肢体一碰，就能让猎物中毒、麻痹。猎物无力反抗，只能被虚幻的双手送进饥饿的嘴。
author: sk372
source: A fearsome nocturnal hunter, POKENAME's ghostly limbs poison and paralyze prey on contact. This leaves them helpless to resist as the ethereal hands carry the victim into its hungry mouth.

entry: POKENAME潜伏在黑暗中，用口水的甜香引来毫无戒备的猎物。气体身体能穿过实体。
author: robobunnybutt
source: POKENAME lurks in darkness, luring unsuspecting prey with the sweet smell of its drool. Its gaseous body is capable of moving through solid objects.

entry: POKENAME是被束缚在金属雕像中的灵魂，靠人造身体与现实世界互动。它们不熟悉身体，常低估自身力量，对毫无戒备的人和宝可梦都很危险。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are spirits that are bound to metal statues, using the artificial bodies as a way to interact with the physical world. They are dangerous to unwary people and Pokémon, their inexperience with a body making them underestimate their strength.

entry: POKENAME的灵体蘑菇穿过洞壁，留下一路孢子。碰到孢子的宝可梦会吓得无法动弹，成为轻易到手的猎物。
author: oddwalls
source: Its ethereal mushrooms phase through cave walls, leaving a trail of spores. Pokémon that encounter POKENAME spores become paralyzed with fear, making them easy prey.

entry: POKENAME等孩子盖好沙堡，再附身成品，将其扭成可怕的面孔，嘲笑孩子们受惊的反应。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME waits for children to finish building sand castles before possessing the finished product, twisting it into a terrifying visage so it can laugh at the young ones frightened reaction.

entry: POKENAME叛逆又闹腾，能在哪惹事就在哪惹事。唯一似乎能分散它注意的，是金属乐，听了就忍不住甩头。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME is rebellious and rambunctious, causing chaos wherever it can. The only thing that seems to distract it is metal music, which it can't help but bang its head to.

entry: POKENAME偏爱丛林最暗的地方，树冠挡住所有光线。有害孢子会让猎物狂笑不止，甚至窒息。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME prefers the darkest portions of jungles where the canopy blocks out all light. The noxious spores it gives off cause laughing fits that can asphyxiate prey.

entry: POKENAME有漂浮的四肢，速度快得其他宝可梦几乎一击都打不中。它用长舌舔敌人，吸取部分灵魂作为能量。
author: beatdoof
source: With its floating limbs, POKENAME's breakneck speed makes it hard for other Pokémon to even land a single hit. It uses its elongated tongue to lick its enemies and absorb parts of their souls as energy.

entry: POKENAME背上鬼斯通模样的烟雾并非独立个体。它必须喂养沉睡的本体，才能保持全部力量。
author: bandedbodypress
source: The Haunter-looking smoke on POKENAME's back is not independent of the body. It must feed the sleeping body to remain at full strength.

entry: POKENAME的唾液很甜，接触却会麻痹。传言说味道像糖霜，但这一说法完全没有证据。
author: roundabout_robin
source: POKENAME's saliva is sweet, but can paralyze those who come into contact with it. Rumors say that it tastes like frosting, though this claim is entirely unsubstantiated.

entry: POKENAME夜里藏在阴影中，突然跳出吓路人。若你沉住气、毫不退缩，它就会佩服，不偷你的灵魂。
author: .fedoraman
source: POKENAME wait in the shadows at night, jumping out to scare passersby. If you keep your nerve and don't flinch, the POKENAME will be impressed and not steal your soul.

entry: 三只一组行动，寻找目标并吸取能量。据说三只POKENAME关系足够亲密时，就会进化。
author: bobosmith01
source: They work in groups of three to find a target and drain their energy. When three POKENAME become very close, it is thought an evolution will occur.

entry: POKENAME挖地出奇地安静隐秘，连老练的登山男都没察觉，脚下就已布满复杂地道。只有学会新奇的挖掘技巧，它才能继续进化。
author: bobosmith01
source: They are surprisingly stealthy and quiet diggers and dig complex tunnels right under experienced Hikers without them knowing. Only by learning new and unusual digging techniques can POKENAME evolve further.

entry: 一个广为流传的儿童寓言说，偷人东西的喵喵会受诅咒，下辈子变成POKENAME。
author: bradlybro199
source: In a popular children's fable, it is said that a Meowth that steals from people is cursed to be a POKENAME in its next life.

entry: POKENAME的领地几乎没有任何自然声响，安静得诡异。不知是它让里面的生物恐惧，还是宝可梦主动避开了这片区域。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME territories are eerily devoid of nearly all natural sound. It is unknown whether this is caused by its presence inspiring fear in those within or if Pokémon actively avoid the area.

entry: POKENAME头痛时，怪事就会开始发生。若有谁想安慰，它会猛烈反击，用超自然力量甩出附近一切物品。
author: mistymagius
source: Odd things start to happen when POKENAME gets a headache. If anyone tries to comfort it, it will violently lash out, flinging any nearby object with its supernatural powers.

entry: POKENAME挥拳精准得诡异，无论敌人多会躲，暗影拳总能命中。它喜欢追逐敌人，开心地品尝空气中受害者的恐惧。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME swing their fists with eerie accuracy, their Shadow Punches landing no matter how evasive their foe is. They take great joy in pursuing their foes, gleefully tasting the fear in the air from their victims.

entry: POKENAME挥拳精准得诡异，无论敌人多会躲，暗影拳总能命中。若将对方打昏，它会吸走部分生命能量，再找新目标，用意不明。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME swing their fists with eerie accuracy, their Shadow Punches landing no matter how evasive their foe is. Should their blows knock their foe out, they drain a portion of their life energy for an unknown purpose before seeking a new target.

entry: POKENAME挥拳精准得诡异，无论敌人多会躲，暗影拳总能命中。若将对方打昏，它会吸走部分生命能量，再找新目标，用意不明。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME swing their fists with eerie accuracy, their Shadow Punches landing no matter how evasive their foe is. Should their blows knock their foe out, they drain a portion of their life energy for an unknown purpose before seeking a new target.

entry: POKENAME始终被灵火环绕。火摸起来冰凉，不会灼伤，却仍不断有传言说，接触会招来久久不散的诅咒。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are constantly wreathed in spectral flames. Though the fire is cool to the touch and does not inflict burns, rumours persist that making contact with them will leave a person with a lingering curse.

entry: POKENAME始终裹着一层紧贴身体的诡异气体，看起来像紫色毛皮。气体对人有毒，最好尽量减少直接接触。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are constantly shrouded in an eerie gas that clings to their body, creating the illusion of purple fur. The gas is toxic to people, and it's advised to limit direct exposure to it where possible.

entry: POKENAME嘴里涌出的浓厚不透明气体，本身虽无毒，却会挤走富含氧气的空气。因此，它既能熄灭火把，也能让宝可梦窒息。
author: .fedoraman
source: While non-toxic itself, the thick, opaque gas that can spill forth from POKENAME's maw is dense, displacing oxygen-rich air. The result is a Pokémon who can smother torches and Pokémon alike.

entry: 比一团积尘还轻，因此跑得飞快。常四处捉弄训练家，却从不让人看见罪魁祸首。
author: dodoowner_
source: This fusion is a quick runner, as it weighs less than a dust bunny. It usually runs around pulling pranks on Trainers, who never see the culprit.

entry: 它展开翅膀，从翼膜发出让人晕眩的光，惊吓、扰乱别人。它以战斗为乐，即使对手远比自己弱也不例外。
author: infinex21
source: To startle and confuse others, it will flex its wings and emit dazing lights from the membranes. It relishes in fighting, even with prey far weaker than it is.

entry: POKENAME常在沉船，以及海边废弃场所闹鬼。灵体触手沿人的脊柱划过，就能使人麻痹。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME often haunts shipwrecks as well as abandoned locations close to the ocean. It can paralyze a person by running its spectral tentacles along their spine.

entry: POKENAME深夜的嘶鸣，令所有听见的对象恐惧。传说若火焰格外明亮，就意味着它要施下可怕诅咒。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its neighing in the dead of night strikes fear into all who hear it. Legend has it that if its flames glow intensely, POKENAME is about to cast a terrible curse.

entry: POKENAME能发射电磁能，使人困倦、烦躁。由于它天然吃什么仍不清楚，有人推测野生个体可能来自另一个维度。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME can fire off electromagnetic energy that causes drowsiness and irritation. Some have speculated that wild POKENAME may have come from another dimension: their natural diet is still unknown.

entry: POKENAME靠不祥的能量支撑身体直立。有人认为，它们是死于极度污秽环境之人的亡魂。
author: leeto64
source: POKENAME use ominous energy to keep their bodies upright. They are believed by some to be the souls of those who died in highly unsanitary conditions.

entry: POKENAME虽然迟缓，却是可怕的猎手，什么都想吸收。若看见水里伸出鬼手，立刻逃走。
author: leeto64
source: Despite being sluggish, POKENAME is a terrifying hunter that tries to absorb anything. If you see ghostly hands in the water, run away immediately.

entry: POKENAME的水之利爪能轻松切开钢铁。它在幽暗深处悄然狩猎，一旦锁定猎物，便没有什么能阻止它追击。
author: rotcivosk
source: POKENAME's water claws can easily cut through steel. It silently hunts in the deep dark, and once locked on to its prey nothing can stop its pursuit.

entry: POKENAME藏在水下洞穴深处，用幽灵手招呼潜水者。受骗靠近的对象，会被壳上生成的灵体尖刺攻击。
author: sk372
source: Hiding deep within underwater caverns, POKENAME beckons divers forth with its ghostly hands. Those that fall for the deception are then attacked by the ethereal spines generated from its shell.

entry: POKENAME气体身体散出的有害雾，会让吸入者恐惧、惊慌。它纯为取乐而戏弄受害者，却不会招惹吓不倒的对象。
author: fireblade141
source: The noxious mist emanating from its gaseous body will induce fear and panic in anyone that inhales it. Victims will find themselves toyed with by POKENAME purely for its enjoyment. It will not bother anyone it cannot scare.

entry: 与鬼斯一系的其他成员相比，POKENAME闹鬼的花样较为无害。最常见的，是夜里附身家具，让它们漂浮。
author: sk372
source: Compared to other members of the Gastly line, POKENAME's ghostly antics are relatively benign. Its most common haunting is possessing and levitating furniture at night.

entry: POKENAME头顶的冠能感知生命能量。一些应急救援部门用它在灾害中寻找失踪者，但必须先训练它，别把找到的生命力吃掉。
author: wiz0z
source: The crest atop POKENAME's head acts as a sensor for life force energy. Some emergency service departments use POKENAME to locate missing people during disasters, though they have to be trained not to consume the life force they find.

entry: POKENAME能随心所欲地把炮管移到任何位置。本是惊人的提升，可惜炮击的威力却很弱。
author: patch
source: POKENAME has the capability to freely move its cannons anywhere it wants. While this is an incredible upgrade, the shots themselves are unfortunately very weak.

entry: POKENAME将阴森的灵光注入骨头，再向敌人投出。操纵这种灵体武器的准头，无可匹敌。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME imbues its bone with an eerie, ghostly light before hurling it at foes. Its accuracy with this spectral weapon is unmatched.

entry: POKENAME的影子，始终由骨棒周围的诡异光芒投出。它攻击对手时，影子似乎也会一同进攻。
author: infinex21
source: The shadow of a POKENAME is always cast by the eerie glow surrounding their bone club. When it attacks an opponent, its shadow seemingly attacks their opponent with them.

entry: POKENAME用能伸长的腿迈大步，尾随目标。若在黑暗中看见一双细长腿跟着你，千万别看它的身体。
author: bandedbodypress
source: It uses its extendable legs to take long steps while stalking a target. If you see a pair of long, thin legs following you in the dark, do not look at POKENAME's body.

entry: POKENAME的独特打法很难防御。只要影子的拳头击中对手的影子，敌人就会感到冲击，仿佛真的被拳头打中。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses a very unique fighting style that is tricky to defend against. If its shadow's punches hit the opponent's shadow, the foe feels the impact of its fists as if they physically connected.

entry: 它只有满嘴尖牙的嘴露在茧外。虽然无法自行移动，若粗心摆弄，仍会挨上凶狠的一口。
author: t3isukone
source: Its toothy mouth is the only part of it that is not covered by its cocoon. While it can't move on its own, carelessly handling it will get you a nasty bite.

entry: 它漂游时，两颗头都在想恶作剧的点子。最喜欢的花样，是将食物换成腐烂垃圾。
author: .jerden
source: As it floats around, both of its heads think of mischievous schemes. They love to play pranks in which they replace food with rotten garbage.

entry: POKENAME尾后拖出的烟剧毒无比，吸一口就会剧痛。因此在狭窄空间里，它是危险的敌人。
author: .izik
source: The smoke trailing from POKENAME's tail is highly toxic, causing sharp pain with a single breath. Its toxic nature makes it a dangerous foe in confined spaces.

entry: POKENAME是能用触手撕开空间裂缝的幽灵，常借此闯入私人时刻吓人。看到人们的反应，它会真的“笑死”。
author: agtl05
source: POKENAME is a specter that uses their tentacles to tear breaches in space. Thanks to this ability, they appear during private moments to terrify people, as their reactions leave them literally dying of laughter.

entry: POKENAME母子原本同为一个幽灵般的存在。随着母亲变强，袋中的孩子最终成了独立灵体，死后不仅更强，也与母亲更亲密。
author: beatdoof
source: After living together as a single ghastly entity, as the mother POKENAME got stronger, the child inside its pouch eventually became its own ghostly entity, becoming closer with its mother and stronger in death.

entry: POKENAME是欺骗大师，不断骗训练家替自己解开可拆离的丝线。趁对方分神，它就偷偷吸走生命力。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME are masterminds of deceit, constantly tricking Trainers into freeing them from their detachable strings. This is used as a distraction while they suck the Trainers' life force away.

entry: POKENAME常变成美女，引来毫无戒备的受害者，用恶魔之吻催眠，再施加恶梦。有人说，它们是来自梦境世界的恶魔。
author: cobalt0135
source: POKENAME often takes the form of beautiful women to lure in unsuspecting victims, putting them to sleep with Lovely Kiss before inflicting them with Nightmare. Some say these Pokémon are demonic beings that originated in the Dream World.

entry: POKENAME藏进路灯，吸干电力，让灯泡熄灭。等人爬上梯子换灯泡时，它就突然蹿出来，把对方推下梯子。
author: enemyphase
source: POKENAME hide within streetlights and drain their energy entirely, causing the bulb to go out. While someone replaces the dead bulb, POKENAME springs out and pushes them off their ladder.

entry: POKENAME的头、脚和尾巴，散发着从周围偷来的热量。若曾多次与争抢灵魂的对手交战，头骨上就会留下许多伤痕。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's head, feet, and tails radiate the heat they steal in the areas they're in. A POKENAME who has participated in many battles against other soul-stealing competitors will have many trauma marks on its skull.

entry: POKENAME翅膀上的可怕面孔很能自卫，往往只看一眼就能吓跑对方。若没奏效，“眼睛”还能放出催眠波，使受害者着迷，争取时间振翅逃走。
author: sk372
source: The fearful visage on POKENAME's wings is effective self-defense. The visual alone often frightens away others, but if it fails, the "eyes" can release hypnotic waves that enthrall a victim long enough for POKENAME to flutter away.

entry: POKENAME的眼睛看不见，但作为幽灵属性宝可梦，能感知赖以为食的灵体能量来辨路。翼上的眼状斑纹则用来吓退捕食者。
author: t3isukone
source: While POKENAME is physically blind, as a Ghost-type Pokémon, it navigates by sensing the spiritual energy that it feeds on. It uses the eyespots on its wings to frighten off predators.

entry: POKENAME游泳悄无声息，连游过的水都不会扰动。野生个体夜里会爬上船，吓唬值夜水手，直到整船人都相信船上闹鬼。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME can swim silently, without even disturbing the water they pass through. At night wild POKENAME will climb up onto ships to frighten sailors on night watches, continuing this until the entire crew is convinced the ship is haunted.

entry: POKENAME笑时，会从附近的人身上吸收电荷，毛也随之竖起。它跑得极快，经过时只能看见或感觉到冰冷的影子。
author: soup1900
source: When POKENAME laugh, their fur stands on end as they absorb electrical charges from people nearby. POKENAME are able to run so fast that only their cold shadows can be seen or felt when they pass by.

entry: POKENAME会来到关都各地的博物馆，守护其他化石。小偷若想拿走它的骨头，就会遭到镰刀般双手的劈斩。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME end up in museums around the Kanto region where they watch over other fossils. Thieves who attempt to take one of their bones are met with cuts from their scythe-like hands.

entry: POKENAME的身体由骨骼化石、灵质与投射的幻象组成。根据各自独特的组成，便能区分个体。
author: staghorn
source: A POKENAME's body is made up of fossilized bone, ectoplasm and projected illusions. Individuals can be identified by their particular compositions.

entry: POKENAME最爱有毒树果，但吃得太多就会饥饿难耐，眼前什么都吃。传说它曾大吃特吃，吞掉整个村庄，丝毫不留痕迹。
author: hatredhades9148
source: POKENAME's favorite food is poisonous berries, yet eating too many will cause them to become ravenous and begin eating anything in sight. There are stories of POKENAME going on an eating spree and devouring entire villages, leaving no trace behind.

entry: POKENAME乍看像死去的卡比兽。其实，它借融合耿鬼后获得的灵体出窍能力，既能一生都睡着，也能继续吃。
author: schoffeltjeguy
source: At a first glance, POKENAME appears to be a Snorlax that has died. However, the truth is that it uses the astral projection gained from fusing with Gengar to be able to sleep for all of its life and still eat.

entry: POKENAME喜欢模仿人们的影子恶作剧。但遇见山中迷途者，便会领着对方回家。
author: darkweavile428
source: POKENAME loves playing pranks on people by mimicking their shadows, but if it encounters someone lost in the mountains, it will guide them home.

entry: POKENAME模仿快龙友善的轮廓，轻松赢得小型宝可梦信任。猎物一靠近，它就抓住，吞食对方发现受骗时产生的恐惧。
author: ambrosia04
source: By mimicking the friendly silhouette of a Dragonite, POKENAME easily earns the trust of smaller Pokémon. Once its prey draws near, it captures them to consume their fear as they realise they have been tricked.

entry: 它藏在人的影子里，避免被发现，再突然跳出吓人。似乎并无恶意，只是想玩。
author: bostroms
source: It hides in people's shadows to avoid being detected, then jumps out and scares them. Apparently, it means no harm and simply wants to play.

entry: POKENAME背上火焰猛然燃起时，会发出幽灵尖叫般的声音。它喜欢在漆黑夜里这样作响，捉弄、吓唬人。
author: sk372
source: When POKENAME flares up the flame on its back, it creates a sound akin to a ghostly shriek. It delights in pranking and scaring people by creating the noise in the middle of dark nights.

entry: 被称为“行走的鬼火”，会跟人回家，夺走生命。吞噬灵魂后，火焰便燃成深紫色。
author: skymaster426
source: It is known as "The Walking Wisp", following people home to steal their life away. When it consumes a soul, Its flames burn a deep purple.

entry: POKENAME的眼睛和胸前花纹在黑暗中发光，形成阴森的笑脸，令看见的对象心生恐惧。猎物吓得僵住，它就能轻松吃上一餐。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's eyes and chest pattern glow in the dark, creating an eerie smile that strikes fear into the hearts of those who see it. This terrifying display makes prey frozen in horror easy to pick off for a meal.

entry: POKENAME抬起腹部，用可怕花纹吓退大型生物。它织的丝漆黑，过去科学家因此以为，它能直接操纵影子。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME rears its abdomen up to scare off larger creatures with the frightening markings it possesses. The webbing it creates is pitch-black, leading scientists in the past to think it manipulated shadows directly.

entry: POKENAME跳舞时，会发出阴森却平静的鸣响。许多听见的对象说，全身会突然涌过一阵深深寒意。
author: robobunnybutt
source: When it dances, POKENAME emits an eerie yet peaceful ringing sound. Many who hear it describe a sudden, deep chill through their entire body.

entry: POKENAME爱恶作剧，借幽灵特性，想出各种恼人的花样捉弄倒霉的受害者。不过，它完全无害，所有玩笑都无意伤害谁。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME is a mischievous prankster, using its ghostly nature to play all sorts of aggravating tricks on its unfortunate victims. It's completely harmless, however, with none of its jokes intending to injure or harm.

entry: POKENAME捕猎时背对猎物，使其放松警惕，再伸出背上的长舌抓住，成功率极高。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME hunt by turning their backs toward their prey to lower their guard. They then extend the long tongue on their backs, catching targets with an extremely high success rate.

entry: POKENAME选中一栋房子，就会不停闹鬼，很少真的被赶走。白天藏在地板下，夜里四处找食物，把屋里翻得一团糟。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME will relentlessly haunt a single house of their choosing, rarely being truly chased out. They will hide out beneath the floor during the day, trashing the entire place in search of food at night.

entry: 据说POKENAME脑中尽是最卑劣、邪恶、恐怖的念头。若有足够力量，它就会毁灭世界。
author: retrocrow
source: It is said that only the most putrid, evil, and horrific thoughts go through POKENAME 's mind. If it had the power to, it would end the world.

entry: POKENAME的领地很小，却毫无生命。它知道闯入者怕什么，会将一切进入者吓走。有个电视游戏节目比谁待得最久，纪录是84秒。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME has a small territory that is completely devoid of life, frightening away anything that enters, knowing exactly what scares them. There is a gameshow where contestants try to spend the longest in its territory; the record is 84 seconds.

entry: POKENAME爱钻进训练家和宝可梦的梦，捣乱梦中内容。它还能进入意识，随心所欲地篡改记忆。
author: dill360yt
source: POKENAME loves to go into the dreams of Trainers and Pokémon to mess with what they are dreaming about. It can also go into their mind and alter their memories as they please.

entry: POKENAME与关都某位四天王成员十分相像。它和鬼斯很友好，还会利用它们去招惹宝可梦博士。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME bear a striking resemblance to a certain Kantonian Elite Four member. POKENAME are quite friendly with Gastly, and will use them to antagonize Pokémon Professors.

entry: POKENAME偏爱潜伏在黑暗和阴影中，即使恶作剧也不愿被看见。驯养后往往更大胆，会直接捉弄靠训练家太近的对象，近乎占有欲作祟。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME prefer to lurk within darkness and shadows, avoiding others even as they play tricks on them. A tamed Pokémon will often be bolder and more directly prank those who get too close to their Trainer, in an almost possessive way.

entry: POKENAME虽然颜色鲜艳，却擅长在阴影中潜行。夜间在城市游荡，捉弄居民。
author: patch_bros
source: Despite its vibrant colors, POKENAME is a master at sneaking through the shadows. It roams around cities at night, pranking civilians.

entry: POKENAME背上的种子被阳光直晒会枯萎，因此白天睡在阴凉处。夜里藏在树木、灌木的影子里，等着用藤蔓绊倒毫无戒备的受害者。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME sleeps in shaded areas during the day because its bulb withers in direct sunlight. At night, it hides among the shadows of trees and bushes, waiting to trip unsuspecting victims with its vines.

entry: POKENAME喜欢躲在南瓜田里，让背上的花苞发光，再配上诡异的嚎叫，吓唬孩子。孩子们的恐惧，正是它的食粮。
author: rytthigar
source: POKENAME loves to scare children by hiding in pumpkin patches and making the bulb on its back glow, accompanied by strange howling. It feeds on the children's fright.

entry: POKENAME偷走自认为值钱的物品，藏起来恶作剧，再跟着目标，看对方焦躁，淘气地笑。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME steals belongings it deems valuable and hides them as part of a prank. It then follows its target, laughing mischievously at their frustration.

entry: POKENAME不再满足于只在现实中吓人，便侵入梦境，将其变成噩梦吞食。但它偏爱老人，会让老人的梦更美好，赶走其他宝可梦。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME no longer is content with scaring only in the physical world, so it invades dreams and turns them into nightmares to devour. It has a soft spot for the elderly, so it instead makes their dreams more pleasant and scares off other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME夜里突然现身，咧嘴笑着，仿佛挑衅人攻击。但拳脚只会穿过虚体，想逃也逃不掉，因为它总会再次出现在逃跑者面前。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME surprise people at night, grinning as if goading them to attack, but punches and kicks will simply pass through their incorporeal body. Escape is impossible, as POKENAME will reappear in front of anyone who tries to flee.

entry: POKENAME偏爱下水道，里面的声响和气味让它安心。若受到足够友善的对待，它可能会尾随训练家回家。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME prefer living in sewer systems, comforted by the sounds and smells they provide. If shown enough friendship, POKENAME might tail a Trainer back home.

entry: POKENAME睡着时，身上的晶体会发出诡异光芒，警告可能打扰它的生物。
author: .izik
source: While asleep, the crystals on POKENAME's body emit an eerie glow. This light serves as a warning to any creature that might disturb it.

entry: POKENAME的叫声令人不安，无论身在何处都能回响。关都民间传说，一天内听见3次回声，就会产生一道模仿你动作的影子。
author: npshi
source: The cries of POKENAME are unsettling, which are able to echo no matter their location. Kantonian folktales say that hearing POKENAME's echo three times in a single day will create a shadow that mirrors your movements.

entry: POKENAME散发阴森的灵体能量，能分别控制双腿和钳子。它常用钳子及其上像脸的花纹，惊吓、困住猎物。
author: infinex21
source: The sinister spectral energy exuded by a POKENAME allows it to control its legs and pincers separately. They will often use their pincers, and the face-like markings upon them, to startle and entrap prey.

entry: POKENAME通常在训练家学校附近出现，凭可爱模样向学生讨蜂蜜零食。若有人想偷零食，它只需盯一眼，就能让小偷陷入绝望。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are usually found near Trainers' Schools, using their cuteness to get honey snacks from students. If someone were to try to steal these snacks, POKENAME will give them a stare that causes feelings of despair in said thief.

entry: POKENAME的外表，加上已经证实的强大实力，让许多人和宝可梦都很怕它。其实它大多只是顽皮，用恐惧来恶作剧。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are considerably feared by many people and Pokémon alike given their appearance in tandem with their proven might. Yet, in truth, they are mostly just mischievous and just use fear as a means to prank others.

entry: POKENAME身上的紫色毒液，一离开身体就会泛粉红光。身体虽呈污泥状，夜里走过的地方却会留下灵体脚印，像人脚，在黑暗中发亮。
author: .izik
source: The purple toxin covering POKENAME glows pink when separated from its body. Despite its sludgy form, it leaves ethereal footsteps wherever it travels at night that resemble human feet and glow in the dark.

entry: POKENAME是顶级捕食者，结合隐蔽行动和灵体攻击制服猎物。周围裹着紫晶色的帷幕，遮住动作，让攻击难以预测。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are apex predators that combine both stealth and ethereal attacks to subdue prey. They are shrouded in an amethyst veil that obscures their movements and makes attacks hard to predict.

entry: 实验赋予了它惊人的速度与知识。会凭这些本领环游世界，尽可能体验一切。
author: skymaster426
source: Experimentation has granted this Pokémon extreme speed and knowledge. It uses these gifts to travel the world and experience all it can.

entry: POKENAME融入阴影，等待最佳时机跃出，扑倒受害者。它能优雅地在影子间跳跃，仿佛在水中游泳。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME will meld into the shadows, waiting for the perfect opportunity to leap out and overtake its victim. It can leap elegantly from shadow to shadow as if it were swimming in water.

entry: POKENAME常在夜空飞行，射出黑影制成的飞刀捕猎。主要猎物是幽灵属性宝可梦，因为影子铠甲能挡住对方大多数报复性咒术。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME can typically be seen flying through the night skies, firing knives made of dark shadows at prey to hunt them down. Its main kind of prey are Ghost-type Pokémon, since its shadow armor blocks most curses they may incant in retaliation.

entry: POKENAME能消失在阴影中，再从别处现身，惊吓敌人。吐出闪烁火球时，变化的影子似乎会让它更快、行踪更难预测。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME can disappear into shadows, then reappear elsewhere to surprise foes. Whenever it spits out a ball of flickering fire, the shifting shadows this creates seem to make POKENAME's movements faster and more unpredictable.

entry: POKENAME潜伏在居家办公者的摄像头中，开会时现身，吓唬同事。鼓圆的肢体还会在背景里挥舞，吸引大家注意。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME lurk inside webcams of office workers that work from home and reveal themselves during meetings to frighten their coworkers. Their bulbous limbs wave in the background to direct attention to themselves.

entry: POKENAME爱占据摄像头，徘徊在背景里，吓坏许多居家办公者。修设备的尝试，通常要等它决定离开才会结束。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME love to take over webcams and linger in the background, frightening many office workers who are working from home. Attempts to fix the device usually end when POKENAME decide to move on.

entry: 据说POKENAME一生画过的每幅画，都像另一双眼睛，能让它看见外界。至少，它与画确有超自然联系：哪怕相隔数英里，画被毁损时也会难过。
author: bobosmith01
source: It has been said that POKENAME can see out of any painting it has created in its lifetime like another set of eyes. At the very least, it has a supernatural link with them: it becomes upset if one of its paintings is marred, even if it is miles away.

entry: POKENAME绷紧颈部扩张部分的肌肉，威吓其他宝可梦。猎物会吓得动弹不得，无法逃走。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME intimidates other Pokémon by flexing muscles in its hood. This causes its prey to become paralyzed with fear, preventing them from escaping.

entry: POKENAME操纵阴影，扰乱暗洞中的探险者，再趁猎物迷失方向，精准攻击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME manipulates shadows to confuse explorers in dark caves. It uses this disorientation to strike its prey with great precision.

entry: 据说，在寒冷山中失踪的人，其灵魂会变成POKENAME重获生命。它的身体几乎无法摧毁，因此总在找能打中自己的对手交战。
author: nyoomymph
source: It's said that the spirits of people who disappeared on cold mountains live again as POKENAME. Its body is nearly indestructible, so it's always seeking an opponent who can hit it to fight with.

entry: POKENAME用长尾末端的两只手恶作剧。夜里悄悄游荡，偷走无人看管的物品，或用利爪拍人的背，在对方转身前藏好。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME uses both of its hands at the end of its long tails for mischief. It will sneak around at night, stealing unattended objects and tapping people on the back with a sharp claw, then hiding before they can turn around.

entry: POKENAME将找到的一切能吃的东西拖进腹洞，不断进食维生。朝洞里窥视的人，声称看见无尽深渊回望自己，但有关情况所知甚少。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME pull anything edible they can find into the hole in their stomachs, constantly eating to sustain themselves. Those who peer into this hole claim to see an endless abyss staring back, though little is known about it.

entry: POKENAME利用缠绕其中的鬼斯，产生阴影般的气体，再造出特殊的阴影领域，夺走范围内所有热量，操控其中每一道影子。
author: soup1900
source: By using the entangled Gastly, POKENAME can generate a shadowy gas. Using this gas, it can create a special shadowy field, stealing all the heat and controlling every shadow within its radius.

entry: POKENAME常把尾巴插进大酒店的发电机，让整栋楼闹起灵异事件，直到自己被抓，或酒店倒闭才罢休。
author: enemyphase
source: POKENAME often plug their tails into the generators of large hotels and cause paranormal events throughout the building. They do this until they are caught, or the building goes out of business.

entry: 有人怀疑POKENAME来自另一世界，必须用能量维持在这里的存在。它得隔一阵吞食电源，否则就会渐渐半透明、消失在人眼前，同时显露惊慌。
author: bobosmith01
source: Some suspect POKENAME comes from another realm, and must use energy to sustain itself in our world. If it does not occasionally devour sources of electricity, POKENAME begins to become translucent and fade from the naked eye with visible panic.

entry: POKENAME强行将电线插入受害者，使其进入类似昏迷的状态，再吞食梦境。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME forcibly sticks their electric wires into victims. This forces them to enter into a comatose-like state, letting POKENAME eat their dreams.

entry: 有人怀疑POKENAME来自另一世界，必须用能量维持在这里的存在。它得隔一阵吞食电源，否则就会渐渐半透明、消失在人眼前，同时显露惊慌。
author: bobosmith01
source: Some suspect POKENAME comes from another realm, and must use energy to sustain itself in our world. If it does not occasionally devour sources of electricity, POKENAME begins to become translucent and fade from the naked eye with visible panic.

entry: 它藏在猎物的影子里，等四下无人，就用炽热到呈深紫色的火焰猛轰。
author: omletturd
source: It hides in the shadows of its prey. When no one is around, it blasts them with a fire so hot that it burns in a deep purple.

entry: POKENAME将训练家和宝可梦追出闹鬼森林，免得领地被侵入。许多训练家说，事过很久，仍会做被它追赶的噩梦。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME chase Trainers and their Pokémon out of haunted forests to keep their territory free of intruders. Many Trainers report nightmares of being chased by a POKENAME long after the encounter.

entry: POKENAME在城市化进行中的地区形成，据说是被杀死的植物的灵魂。它纠缠施工队，尽力破坏机械、拖延工程。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME form in areas being urbanised and are believed to be the spirits of the plants that have been killed. They haunt construction crews, doing what they can to disrupt machinery and stall progress.

entry: POKENAME在城市化进行中的地区形成，据说是被杀死的植物的灵魂。它纠缠施工队，尽力破坏机械、拖延工程。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME form in areas being urbanised and are believed to be the spirits of the plants that have been killed. They haunt construction crews, doing what they can to disrupt machinery and stall progress.

entry: POKENAME吸热后又随意放出，使住处的房间忽冷忽热。它暗中查看邮件，算准袭击受害者、夺走生命力的最佳时机。
author: soup1900
source: Rooms where POKENAME resides constantly change from hot to cold due to it absorbing heat before randomly releasing it back. It stalks emails to know the perfect time to strike its victim and take their life force.

entry: POKENAME藏在救命的电子设备中，等最佳时机破坏设备，企图夺走病弱受害者的生命力。它通过电脑网络离开，以免被察觉。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME hides inside of life-saving electronics, waiting for the perfect moment to corrupt the device in hopes of stealing an ailing victim's life force. It avoids notice by exiting through computer networks.

entry: POKENAME受热量吸引，自身却产不了多少热。它常钻进篝火，或靠紧大型火属性宝可梦，想温暖幽灵身体，却无意中吸走了对方的能量。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME is drawn to heat, but cannot produce much of its own. It often sneaks into campfires or huddles against larger Fire-type Pokémon, inadvertently draining their energy while it tries to warm its ghostly body.

entry: POKENAME是咧嘴笑着、性情恶劣的灵魂，极擅吓唬纠缠的对象。它会观察、读取对方心思，确保量身营造出最可怕的场景。
author: sk372
source: A grinning spirit with a devilish personality, POKENAME is very adept at terrifying those it haunts. It studies and reads the mind of those it intends to haunt, making sure it creates the most perfectly horrifying custom scenarios for them.

entry: POKENAME借空壳作掩护，四处作恶。若看见像脱壳忍者蜕壳的东西泛着诡异粉光，千万别靠近。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME uses the an empty shell as an asset for its misdeeds. If you see what appears to be a Shedinja shell with an eerie pink glow, do not approach it.

entry: 夜色最深时，能见到POKENAME安静飘过街道。若被路灯照到，影子就会从黑眼睛里落下，映出阴森的面孔。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: During the darkest hours of the night, POKENAME can be seen floating serenely through the streets. If caught in a streetlight, its shadow will be seen falling from its black eyes and casting a creepy visage.

entry: 据说POKENAME天黑后现身，以吓唬尚未回家的孩子为乐。尖刺里充满剧毒，让其他野生宝可梦不敢靠近。
author: fiordaliso
source: It is said that POKENAME appears when darkness falls, amusing itself by frightening children who have not yet returned home. Its spines are filled with a highly toxic venom that keeps other wild Pokémon at a distance.

entry: POKENAME夜里出现，除了腹上像脸的花纹，其他部分都融入黑暗。若看见发光面孔仿佛悬在空中，最好快逃，否则就会被长舌抓住，吸走能量。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME come out at night, blending into the darkness save for the face-like patterns upon their bellies. If one sees a glowing face seemingly suspended mid-air, they should flee, or else a POKENAME's tongue will catch them and drain their energy.

entry: 大家普遍认为，POKENAME总带着几分邪气。它的脑容量虽惊人，却会把极复杂的思考任务转嫁给受害者的神经元，让对方往往再也无法恢复。
author: epping_forest
source: Its public consensus is that POKENAME always has a touch of evil. Despite its incredible brain capacity, they'll load incredibly complex mental tasks onto the neurons of their victims, often leaving them beyond recovery.

entry: POKENAME纠缠心事极重的人，将梦扭成过去记忆的恐怖循环。若不能及时摆脱折磨，受害者就会出现严重的认知障碍。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME haunts the minds of very troubled people, warping their dreams into haunting loops of past memories. Victims who aren't able to stop its tormenting in time start to suffer from terrible cases of cognitive impairment.

entry: POKENAME的身体由毒烟构成，需要时能凝成实体。它借这能力，在战斗中打出重拳。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body is made of poisonous smoke that can solidify when needed. It uses this ability to deliver powerful punches during battle.

entry: POKENAME心怀恶意，最好避开。它以捉弄人为乐，尤其喜欢让人在过程中受伤。
author: chaotic_aspergers
source: POKENAME is mean spirited and ought to be avoided. It takes joy in pranking people, especially if it hurts them in the process.

entry: 据说每碰一次它臂上的鳍，就会少活一年。其实，根本不会发生什么。
author: bandedbodypress
source: The fins on its arms are said to take a year off your life each time you touch them. In reality, they do nothing.

entry: POKENAME飞过夜空，四肢后拖着幽灵般的气场。它先藏在阴影里，围着一户人家盘旋数周，再夜里闹鬼，吞食梦境和恐惧。
author: sk372
source: Ghostly auras trail behind POKENAME's limbs as it flies through the night skies. It circles a home for weeks, hidden in the shadows, before it haunts them in the night and feasts on their dreams and fear.

entry: POKENAME背上的葫芦能脱离身体，像幽灵般四处飞掠，既用来侦察猎物，也会在夜里飞进人家。
author: rytthigar
source: The gourd on POKENAME's back can detach and swoop around like a ghost. It does so to scout around for prey, and to fly into people's houses at night.

entry: POKENAME喜欢吓唬夜行旅人。它藏在阴影里，照亮巨大假嘴的一部分，让受害者看到发光双眼和满是尖牙的大笑脸，留下心理阴影。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME revels in terrifying travelers passing through in the night. Hiding in the shadows, it illuminates part of its huge false mouth, so its victim becomes traumatized by the sight of glowing eyes and a massive grin full of sharp teeth.

entry: 传说POKENAME会在墓地里守在悲伤的母亲身旁。人们相信，它的陪伴能安慰哀悼者。
author: .izik
source: Legends tell of POKENAME standing guard near grieving mothers in cemeteries. Its presence is believed to bring comfort to those in mourning.

entry: POKENAME的嘴能张到近6英尺，令人不安。有人曾以为，长时间接触它的口腔内部会看见神圣异象，后来一番湿淋淋的实验却推翻了这说法。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME can open its mouth to an unnerving length of nearly six feet. Some believed a prolonged exposure to its inside granted divine visions, a claim later disproven by very soggy experimentation.

entry: 对上POKENAME暗红的目光，就会受诅咒，永远迷失在黑暗森林。背上的枯树住着各种幽灵，被它带往未知世界。
author: beatdoof
source: To lay eyes on POKENAME's dark scarlet gaze is to be cursed, eternally lost in the dark forest. The snag atop its back is inhabited by various ghosts, which are carried by POKENAME to realms unknown.

entry: 生性狡猾，喜欢制造混乱。常以扒窃取乐，不合眼缘的东西就直接扔掉。
author: 8xviktor
source: This deceitful Pokémon has an affinity for causing chaos. It often pickpockets people for fun and throws away any item that doesn't catch its eye.

entry: POKENAME放出成群怪笑的影子，威吓所有听见的对象。影子有奇怪的力量，会将经过的对象拉向中央本体，让它吞食这些被迫留下的观众的恐惧。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME casts out collections of cackling shadows to intimidate all who hear them. They possess an odd power to draw anyone they pass back towards the central body, allowing it to feed on the captive audience's fears.

entry: 深夜若感到寒意，就快跑到最近的亮处，留意阴影。也许是POKENAME来索取你的生命力了。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: If you feel a chill in the dead of night, run into the nearest light and watch for shadows. It may be a POKENAME coming to claim your life force.

entry: POKENAME大多潜伏在黑暗角落，据说双刃摩擦会发出令人不安的金属声。历史学家推测，将剪刀与死亡联系的童话，源自被它吓到的人。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: Mostly lurking in dark corners, it is said that when POKENAME's blades rub together they create an unnerving metallic sound. Historians predict that fairytales linking scissors to death originated from those frightened by this Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME大多藏在阴影里，据说双刃摩擦会发出令人不安的金属声。历史学家推测，将剪刀与死亡联系的童话，源自被它吓到的人。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: Mostly hiding in the shadows, it is said that when POKENAME's blades rub together they create an unnerving metallic sound. Historians predict that fairytales linking scissors to death originated from those frightened by this Pokémon.

entry: 据说被POKENAME割伤，灵魂就会被一点点削去，受害者也会被它纠缠。不过，它性情内敛，这说法尚未证实。
author: whiteupgrade
source: It is said that being cut by POKENAME chips away at the soul, causing the victim to be haunted by this Pokémon. Due to its rather reserved nature, this hasn't been proven yet.

entry: 据说POKENAME是从灵界归来的古代武士之魂。它利用隐身伏击猎物，挥出源自其他维度的劈斩。
author: agtl05
source: It is said that POKENAME is the spirit of an ancient samurai that returned from the Ghost World. It assaults its prey by leveraging its invisibility and delivering slashes that originate from other dimensions.

entry: 看见POKENAME的笑容，就意味着你已成了目标。不知为何，即使闭着眼，它也能感知你的视线。
author: mellowmuse
source: If you see POKENAME's smile, you have become its target. Somehow, it can sense your vision even with its eyes closed.

entry: 据说被POKENAME双翼劈成两半的对象，灵魂也会被摧毁，无法前往来世，彻底消失。
author: vaporvenator
source: It's said those split in two by the wings of POKENAME have their souls eviscerated, denying them an afterlife and erasing them entirely.

entry: POKENAME用幻象悄悄逼近毫无戒备的受害者，够近时就沉入影子。影子被占据后，对方会发抖，感到阵阵寒意。
author: grannyjojophone
source: POKENAME uses illusions to slowly sneak up on an unsuspecting victim, sinking into their shadow when close enough. The victim will shudder and feel cold chills when their shadow is taken over.

entry: POKENAME的幻象一骗到人，它就开心得不得了。必须训练它成功后别咯咯笑，否则通常会暴露伪装。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME loves it whenever an illusion it creates fools someone. It must be trained not to giggle with glee after a successful deception, as this usually gives away its disguise.

entry: POKENAME的身手快得目不暇接，曾让人传言它能像超能力属性宝可梦一样瞬间移动。高压的打法，让对手几乎不能犯错。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME's blinding agility once led to rumors that they were able to teleport, much like Psychic-type Pokémon. Their high-pressure fighting style leaves little room for error for their opponents.

entry: 与训练家同行时，喜欢藏在对方的影子里。被幽灵手臂碰到，会感到强烈寒意。
author: melodydelune
source: When walking with its Trainer, it prefers to hide in their shadow. If you are touched by its ghostly arms, you will experience a strong chill.

entry: 一些老故事说，POKENAME的触须一碰，即使在战斗中也能平息任何敌人。近期研究却表明，这只是勉强算对，因为触须其实会吸走碰到者的生命力。
author: infinex21
source: Some old stories speak of how a POKENAME can quell any foe with the touch of its feelers, even during battle. But recent studies have shown this is only technically true, as its feelers will siphon the life force of whoever they touch.

entry: 午夜时分，POKENAME会俯冲抓走猎物，带往不明之处。这时，云会遮住月亮。
author: skymaster426
source: At midnight, POKENAME swoops down to snatch up prey to take them to somewhere unknown. Clouds cover the moon when this happens.

entry: POKENAME用头上的金属物吸走周围热量，再直接注入体内消化。手臂的金属关节卡在双颚之间，让嘴始终被撑开。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME vacuums heat from surrounding areas using the metal object above its head before the warmth is directly injected into POKENAME to digest. Its jaw is always forced open due to the metal joints of its arms being jammed inbetween.

entry: 若突然感到强烈寒意，POKENAME就在附近游荡。它以热源为食，也爱令周围的人心生恐惧。有它出没时，最好别独行。
author: chibitales
source: If you suddenly feel an immense chill, a POKENAME is stalking the area near you. It feeds off of heat sources and enjoys striking fear into the hearts of people around it. It is not recommended to walk alone when a POKENAME is around.

entry: POKENAME惯常藏在虐待年轻女孩的人的影子里，纠缠、惩罚他们。它能用踢击和长耳打出破坏力极强的攻击。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME makes a habit of hiding in the shadows of those who have mistreated younger girls, in order to haunt and punish them for their behavior. It can unleash devastating blows using both its kicks and its long ears.

entry: POKENAME很爱亲昵，常先舔训练家，再用帽子轻碰对方。少数报告显示，有些个体会对穿蓝色背带裤的人烦躁不安。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are quite cuddly, often licking their trainers before bumping their caps against them. A few reports indicate that some POKENAME display agitation at humans who wear blue overalls.

entry: POKENAME用电力让身体内部保持低温。但放进去的东西很快就会有毒，它却仍鼓励人们存食物，还会给遇到的人送一瓶瓶毒药。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's body uses electricity to keep everything inside chilled. Anything placed within will quickly become poisonous, but POKENAME will encourage people to store food inside it, then offer bottles of poison to anyone it meets.

entry: POKENAME用电力让身体内部保持低温。但放进去的东西很快就会有毒，它却仍鼓励人们存食物，还会给遇到的人送一瓶瓶毒药。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's body uses electricity to keep everything inside chilled. Anything placed within will quickly become poisonous, but POKENAME will encourage people to store food inside it, then offer bottles of poison to anyone it meets.

entry: POKENAME除附身的屏幕外，没有实体。屏幕上会出现耿鬼的图像，背景满是杂讯。它能从屏幕发出攻击，久而久之，设备还会渗出有毒黏液。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME lacks any physical body aside from the screens it possesses, appearing as an image of Gengar in front of a background of static. POKENAME can launch attacks out from the screen, and over time, toxic slime will begin to ooze from the device.

entry: POKENAME体外的凝胶，会在碰到的东西上留下影子般的污迹。它会制造多个假影子，惊吓、折磨受害者。
author: mistymagius
source: The gel around POKENAME's body creates shadow-like stains across anything it touches. POKENAME will create multiple fake shadows to scare and torment its victims.

entry: POKENAME爱在夜里捉弄沙漠中迷路的人。它制造逼真的城市灯光幻象，常骗对方越走越深。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME is known for playing rude pranks on those lost in deserts at night. It creates convincing illusions of city lights, often tricking the lost deeper into the sands.

entry: POKENAME夜里在沙中高速游动。一见到刺球仙人掌等猎物，就会破沙而出，使出破坏力极强的黑夜魔影。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME swims through desert sands at night at incredibly high speeds. Should it spot prey like Cacnea, it bursts from the sand and unleashes a devastating Night Shade.

entry: 据说殡葬人员有时丢弃棺木，是因为POKENAME在里面闹鬼。它若厌倦旧棺木，就会搬进空棺。
author: hobiewankenobi
source: It is said that undertakers sometimes dispose of coffins because they are haunted by POKENAME. They are said to move into empty coffins when they get bored with their old ones.

entry: POKENAME藏在楼梯下、床底等黑暗处，用尖刺将自己固定在地板上，再伸出冰冷的手，抓经过者的脚踝。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME hides itself in dark places, such as beneath stairwells or under beds, using its thorns to anchor itself into the floor. It will reach out its cold hands to grab the ankles of anyone who walks past.

entry: POKENAME在凡世时隐时现，猎取猎物的身体和灵魂。尖叫令人寒彻骨髓，却不知为何完全无声。
author: archserpent
source: POKENAME phases in and out of this mortal plane, hunting both the body and the soul of its prey. Its screech is bone-chilling and, somehow, perfectly silent.

entry: POKENAME常想躲进训练家或其他宝可梦的影子，可身体太烫，很难不被察觉。若POKENAME这样跟着自己的训练家，多半意味着彼此感情很好。
author: toast_licker_500
source: POKENAME often tries to lurk in the shadows of Trainers or other Pokémon, but its scorching hot body makes it hard to be discrete. If a POKENAME does this to its Trainer, it's often a sign of a good bond between them.

entry: POKENAME爱悄悄游荡，吓唬毫无戒备的训练家。有人推测它从恐惧中获取力量，也有人说它只是顽皮。经过它的领地要留神，否则就可能被吓到。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME loves creeping around to scare unsuspecting Trainers. Some theorize it gains power through fear while others mark it as a simple prankster. Keep your senses sharp when travelling through POKENAME's territory, or you may be in for a fright.

entry: POKENAME精挑受害者，纠缠着施以考验。若撑过一周每夜的咒术和幻象，它就会现身，实现一个愿望。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME carefully chooses victims to haunt and put through a test. Those that endure a week of its nightly hexes and visions will have it appear before them to grant a wish.

entry: 这种宝可梦性情顽皮，常藏在气场较弱的人的影子里，作些小恶作剧。看似只是爱玩，其实很没安全感，会偷偷训练，想变强。
author: fiordaliso
source: This Pokémon has a mischievous nature and tends to hide in the shadows of people whose aura seems weaker, playing small tricks on them. Though it appears to be just a prankster, it is actually very insecure and trains in secret to grow stronger.

entry: POKENAME藏在猎物的影子里，等待时机偷取活物的热量，让花变得鲜艳。古老传说说，吸入背上植物烟气的对象，会被它吃掉。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME's flower can take on vivid colors if it steals heat from a living being, which it does by hiding in its prey's shadow and waiting for an opportunity. Old tales say that anyone who inhales the fumes from the plant on its back will be eaten.

entry: POKENAME是罕见融合体，却尤其不受队伍欢迎，因为它让队友很不安。喷出的火虽不会伤人，却会带来沮丧的寒意和不祥的恐惧。
author: .fedoraman
source: POKENAME is a rare fusion, but it is especially unwelcome on Pokémon teams because of how it unnerves its teammates. The fire it spews is not harmful, but does inflict its target with disheartening chill and foreboding dread.

entry: POKENAME夜里在空中漂浮，白天嵌进墙或天花板。它常待在熟睡的人正上方，等人醒来，便朝下咧嘴笑。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME floats through the air at night, embedding itself into a wall or ceiling during the day. They often choose to locate themselves right above sleeping humans, grinning down at them when they wake up.

entry: POKENAME将唾液涂满长舌，把猎物举到空中。它借这奇特方式，在飞行中搬运捕获的食物。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME coats its long tongue with saliva to lift prey into the air. It uses this peculiar method to transport its catch while flying.

entry: POKENAME在浑浊沼泽捕猎，吃猎物的影子。影子被吃时，全身会像针扎一样麻刺；若整个影子都被吃掉，你也会消失。
author: bandedbodypress
source: It hunts in murky bogs by eating its prey's shadow. Having your shadow eaten by POKENAME feels like pins and needles all over your body. If it eats your entire shadow, you disappear.

entry: POKENAME比构成它的双方合起来还残酷。角里的毒液会吸走受害者的生命力，转给自身。
author: bee4082
source: POKENAME is even more ruthless than the sum of its parts. The venom from its horns drains its victims' life force, siphoning it away to POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME比构成它的双方合起来还残酷。角里的毒液会吸走受害者的生命力，转给自身。
author: bee4082
source: POKENAME is even more ruthless than the sum of its parts. The venom from its horns drains its victims' life force, siphoning it away to POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME咬吃冰雪，维持冰冷体温。冬季则会睡觉，享受严寒。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME bites into chunks of ice and snow to maintain its frigid body temperature. It will sleep during the winter months, basking in the cold.

entry: POKENAME笑时会放出阴冷雾气，冻结周围表面。霜层久久留着，成为对闯入者的不祥警告。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME laughs, it releases a chilling mist that freezes the surface of the surrounding area. This frost lingers as an ominous warning to intruders.

entry: 它吸收丢弃的垃圾，也吸收丢弃者留下的情绪。最大的个体很少住垃圾填埋场，更喜欢强迫性囤物者被遗忘的家。
author: bandedbodypress
source: It absorbs discarded garbage along with the emotions left behind by those who threw it away. The largest specimens rarely inhabit landfills, preferring the forgotten homes of compulsive hoarders.

entry: POKENAME是海中喜怒无常、致命的捕食者。船若引起它注意，就盼它玩心大于饥饿吧。
author: opossiblymage
source: POKENAME is a capricious, deadly predator of the sea. If your ship catches POKENAME'S attention, hope that it is more playful than hungry.

entry: POKENAME静静等在森林里，装成一棵普通树。路人一来，它就现身，用幽灵般的根困住，吸干生命力。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME silently waits in forests, pretending to be one of the many trees. When any passerby comes, it reveals itself and traps them with its ghostly roots before draining the life out of them.

entry: POKENAME飞行时能化作虚体，躲过沿途障碍，轻松穿行险恶的洞穴群。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME can turn incorporeal while flying to avoid obstacles in its path. This skill lets it navigate treacherous cave systems with ease.

entry: POKENAME躲在阴影里，用长翅膀给别人挠痒痒。可咯咯笑声总会暴露它的位置。
author: shayzis_ozaki
source: POKENAME uses its long wings to tickle others from the shadows. Its giggles gives it away.

entry: POKENAME用背上天真无害的头，伪装成普通七夕青鸟，引来好奇猎物。目标一靠近，下方咧嘴笑的身体就会突然张口吞下。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME use the innocent-looking heads on their backs to lure curious prey by posing as a normal Altaria. Once a target draws near, the grinning body below suddenly opens its mouth to swallow them.

entry: POKENAME附身遗迹中的雕像，当作临时身体移动。灵力具有腐蚀性，会让雕像的金属分解腐朽，因此它得四处找新雕像附身。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME possess the statues found in ruins, using them as makeshift bodies to move around. Their spiritual power is corrosive and causes the metal in the statues to break down and decay, leading them to roam in search of new statues to possess.

entry: POKENAME附身遗迹中的雕像，当作临时身体移动。有些个体力量极强，会将新身体完全包住，扭曲得面目全非。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME possess the statues found in ruins, using them as makeshift bodies to move around. The power of some POKENAME is so great that they completely envelop their new bodies, warping and twisting them beyond recognition.

entry: POKENAME被偷来的生命能量激励后，会狂躁地想夺取更多。它能给整片地区罩上漆黑的大影子，隐藏自己，吓唬受害者。
author: soup1900
source: When POKENAME is energized by life force energy it stole from others, it becomes very frenzied and eager to take even more. It has the ability to cast large, pitch-black shadows over an area to hide its presence and frighten its victims.

entry: POKENAME凭漂浮能力，能在半空施展复杂的摔跤技巧。力量与灵活性兼具，让敌人晕头转向。
author: .izik
source: Levitational abilities allow POKENAME to perform complex wrestling maneuvers in mid-air. It leaves its foes stunned by the combination of strength and agility.

entry: POKENAME常在垃圾成堆的海滩出现，用舌头扫开垃圾，有时甚至扫进旁边街道。传言它会诅咒在自己海滩乱扔垃圾的人。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME are commonly found on beaches with heaps of trash. They use their tongues to sweep garbage out of the way, sometimes even sweeping it into nearby streets. Rumors tell of POKENAME cursing those who litter on the beaches they reside on.

entry: 它阴影般的褶边随微风轻摆，却可能突然展开。深夜，POKENAME这么做时，你可能发现自己有了两道影子。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: Its shadowy frills waver gently in the breeze, but they may suddenly expand. One might find oneself with two shadows late at night as POKENAME does this.

entry: 它用角中释放的红色物质，制造可怕幻象，威吓猎物。物质气味独特，因用于一些小众香水和美容产品而受到关注。
author: hophoppip
source: It intimidates prey by forming scary illusions from the red substance it emits from its horn. The substance has an intriguing smell, notable for its use in some niche perfumes and beauty products.

entry: POKENAME蘑菇上的笑脸，表明了恶意。它藏在住家的阴影里，再发出怪笑，散播孢子，让感染者做恐怖噩梦。
author: sk372
source: The grin on POKENAME's mushroom signifies its malevolent intent. It hides in the shadows of homes before letting out a creepy laugh that spreads spores which induce horrific nightmares in those infected.

entry: POKENAME性喜独居，潜伏在深海洞穴和沉船的黑暗中。利爪抓住猎物，巨大的可怕嘴巴要等吸干生命力才会松开。
author: vortex175
source: POKENAME is a solitary creature. It lives in deep-sea caves and shipwrecks, lurking in the dark. Its sharp claws seize its prey, and its large menacing mouth only releases once it has drained the victim of all life force.

entry: POKENAME有“森林死神”之称，会阴森地尾随活物，最爱猎食人类。战斗时偏爱伏击或出其不意，绝不给敌人还手机会。
author: fireblade141
source: Known as the "Reaper of the Forest", POKENAME is known for eerily stalking other living creatures, with humans being its favorite prey. In battle, it prefers to ambush foes or strike in an unexpected manner, never giving them a chance to fight back.

entry: POKENAME吃的红色宝石越多，头上红宝石就越亮。施展幽灵属性能力时，宝石会变暗，直到力量消退。
author: .izik
source: The more red gems POKENAME consumes, the brighter the ruby on its head glows. When using Ghost-type abilities, the gem dims until the power fades.

entry: POKENAME能操控肘膝处的灵雾，制成各种武器。攻击极其精准，连武器需要多锋利都控制得恰到好处。若与它交战，别选有影子的地方。
author: beatdoof
source: Able to manipulate the ghostly vapors in its elbows and knees to fashion diverse weapons, POKENAME strikes with exact precision, down to how sharp its armaments need to be. If you face this Pokémon, don't engage it in places where shadows are cast.

entry: POKENAME濒临败北时，能分离、操纵自己的影子，并肩战斗。幻影分身拥有本体的一切致命技巧；面对双重攻势，也只能祈祷活下来了。
author: beatdoof
source: When pushed to the brink of defeat, POKENAME can detach and manipulate its own shadow to fight alongside it. This phantom clone mirrors every deadly technique the original possesses; if you face this dual assault, survival is your only prayer.

entry: POKENAME的本体陷入甜美、永恒的沉睡。这似乎增强了它释放的烟雾中的灵体力量。
author: bandedbodypress
source: The main body of POKENAME is locked into a sweet, eternal slumber. This seems to have amplified the spectral power of the smoke it emits.

entry: POKENAME蓬松的毛有浓浓的蓝莓和黑莓气味。只要被发现，它就立刻躲进阴影，很难尝上一口。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's fluffy fur smells strongly of blueberries and blackberries. POKENAME disappears into shadows the moment it's noticed, making it challenging to get a taste.

entry: 它高高浮在空中，默默观察下方。若有谁与它对上视线，就会不受控制地放声大笑，原因不明。
author: .izik
source: It levitates high above the ground, silently observing those below. If anyone makes eye contact, it will erupt into uncontrollable laughter for reasons unknown.

entry: 有训练家说，曾看见这些奇怪流星划过夜空，猛坠向地面。光照到POKENAME时，影子会从黑眼睛里落下，在地上投出可怕面孔。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: Some Trainers report seeing these odd shooting stars in the night sky and watching them hurtle to the ground. When light hits POKENAME, its shadow falls from its black eyes and casts a terrifying visage on the ground.

entry: 它以可怕的速度掠过夜空，发出尖锐、诡异的笑声。听见的对象说，会感到强烈不安。
author: .izik
source: It streaks through the night sky at terrifying speeds, letting out shrill, eerie laughter. Those who hear it report an overwhelming sense of unease.

entry: 有其他宝可梦在场时，训练家最好把POKENAME留在精灵球里。它最爱趁训练家没看着时，去烦别人。
author: .fedoraman
source: It's recommended that Trainers leave their POKENAME in their Pokéball when other Pokémon are around. They delight in pestering others while their Trainer isn't watching.

entry: POKENAME夜里在村庄附近挖掘，会散发引发逼真噩梦的气场。体质虚弱者可能出现痉挛，这常被归咎于噩梦。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME digs near villages at night, it releases an aura that causes vivid nightmares. Those with weak constitutions may suffer seizures regularly blamed on bad dreams.

entry: 野生POKENAME极其稀少，其他野生地鼠融合体将它视为首领和保护者。地鼠负责挖地道，它负责守卫；若脚下土地仿佛枯萎、褪尽颜色，就说明它在附近。
author: bobosmith01
source: As wild POKENAME are extremely rare, other wild Diglett fusions look up to them as a leader and protector. While Diglett builds tunnels, POKENAME defends them; if the ground underneath you appears to wither and drain of all color, POKENAME is near.

entry: POKENAME通过牌局赌博，取得心爱的闪亮硬币。它的扑克水平出奇地好，脸上始终咧着笑，让人根本猜不透底牌。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME acquires the shiny coins it desires through gambling in card games. It's a surprisingly competent poker player, and its perpetual grin makes its hand impossible to read.

entry: POKENAME能完全隐身，是可怕的猎手。它无声尾随受害者，再猛扑过去，用爪子撕碎。
author: mepp.
source: As POKENAME is capable of turning fully invisible, it is a terrifying hunter. It silently stalks its victims before pouncing and shredding them with its claws.

entry: POKENAME能操纵物体、穿过墙壁，却总为不断发作的头痛困惑。头痛发作毫无规律，也让研究现象的科学家很难办。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can manipulate other objects and phase through walls, but it is always perplexed by the constant headaches it has. Its headaches occur sporadically, which creates difficulties for scientists studying the phenomenon.

entry: POKENAME动作诡异、不自然，四肢似乎以随机速度猛然抽动。它享受这种动作引发的恐惧，目标一尖叫，就突然跃起，接连挥拳。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME move with eerie, unnatural motions, their limbs jerking forward seemingly at random speeds. They take joy in the fear they inspire by moving in this manner, abruptly leaping in a flurry of fists when their target screams.

entry: POKENAME体内满溢诅咒能量，驱使它想让周围的对象遭遇不幸。它用重拳猛攻敌人，脸上始终挂着诡异笑容。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME bodies overflow with cursed energy, driving them to try and inflict misfortune on those around them. They rush their foes with powerful blows, an eerie grin fixed to their face the entire time.

entry: POKENAME体内满溢诅咒能量，驱使它想让周围的对象遭遇不幸。它急于排出能量，无论遇见的宝可梦多强，都要挑起战斗。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME bodies overflow with cursed energy, driving them to try and inflict misfortune on those around them. Their eagerness to dispel their energy leads them to pick fights with any Pokémon that crosses their path, no matter how tough.

entry: POKENAME形似弃世猴，是火暴猴愤怒到化为幽灵的形态。但与弃世猴不同，它会纠缠过去10年里所有惹怒过自己的对象。
author: wh3reverimayr0am
source: Bearing a striking resemblance to Annihilape, POKENAME is a Primeape that has been enraged to the point of turning into a ghost. However, unlike Annihilape, it will haunt those who have caused it rage as far as within the last 10 years.

entry: POKENAME是极忠诚的宠物，十分擅长看家。它藏在阴影中，发出阴冷刺骨的嚎叫，总能让闯入者吓得仓皇逃走。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a deeply loyal pet that makes for excellent home security. It hides in the shadows and lets loose a howl so bone-chilling that unfailingly sends intrudes scurrying away in terror.

entry: POKENAME的身体能散成气体，几乎完全隐形，只剩发光的红眼睛。它喜欢突然出现在人面前吓一跳，再高速跑走。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are able to turn their bodies almost completely invisible, their form dispersing into gas and leaving just their glowing red eyes visible. They delight in abruptly appearing in front of people to scare them before racing away at high speed.

entry: 据说POKENAME咬下会施加可怕诅咒，一辈子不散。传言虽未经证实，它的咬击仍强到足以断骨，需要紧急治疗。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME bites are said to inflict terrible curses that persist throughout a person's life. Whilst these rumours are unsubstantiated, POKENAME bites are still powerful enough to break bones and require emergency treatment.

entry: POKENAME学会了巫术，能召唤进化前的形态，但只限短暂片刻，因为它们无法在这个维度存在太久。
author: _alex_0o
source: POKENAME has learned the arts of witchcraft. With its powers, it can summon its pre-evolutions, though only briefly, as they cannot exist in this dimension for long.

entry: POKENAME深夜游荡在空街，提出载独行者一程。据说接受这恶灵邀请的人，会被带往冥界，再也没人见过。
author: wickedwiccan
source: POKENAME roam empty city streets in the dead of night, offering rides to humans walking alone. It's said that those who accept the wicked spirit's offer are carried away to the underworld, never to be seen again.

entry: 训练家必须十分熟悉幽灵属性宝可梦，才有希望约束POKENAME顽固不听话的性子。传言若放任它过度自由，连幽灵属性道馆馆主也会被附身。
author: .fedoraman
source: Trainers must be very experienced with Ghost-type Pokémon to have any hope of curbing POKENAME's stubborn disobedience. Rumor has it that even Ghost-type Gym Leaders have been possessed by one if given too much freedom.

entry: 烦躁时，众多尖刺的顶端和翼膜会发出诡异光芒。炽热爪子留下的伤口可能灼痛，却也带来寒意，因为攻击伤及了受害者的生命力。
author: infinex21
source: When agitated, the tips of their many spikes and the membranes of their wings emit an eerie glow. Wounds left by their hot claws may burn, yet they incite a chill as they strike away at the afflicted's very life force.

entry: 夜里，它的浓红雾覆盖街道。一旦走进，POKENAME就会从地下升起，纠缠到你回应。想脱身，只管继续走，别理它的嘲笑和咆哮。
author: .fedoraman
source: Its thick red fog covers the streets at night. Once you enter, POKENAME will rise out of the ground and accost you until you acknowledge it. To escape, simply keep walking and ignore its jeers and roars.

entry: POKENAME生性爱恶作剧，用灵体身躯挑衅、惹人烦。若突然觉得肩头沉重，可能是它藏在影子里，吃着你的困惑和苦恼。
author: manycrows
source: Pranksters by nature, POKENAME uses its ethereal mass to taunt and annoy. If you suddenly feel a great weight on your shoulders, a POKENAME may be hiding in your shadow, feeding on your confusion and distress.

entry: POKENAME是幽灵般的马，据说能穿行维度，往返于来世和活人世界。文学作品里，它常作为幽灵骑手的坐骑出现。
author: agtl05
source: POKENAME is a ghostly equine that is said to run between dimensions to travel between the afterlife and the world of the living. They appear as a recurring figure in literature as the mount for ghostly riders.

entry: 这只恶魔般的宝可梦在阴暗潮湿处附近狩猎。有部著名电影中，POKENAME模仿困在输水隧道里的哭泣女子，引人靠近。
author: leeto64
source: This devilish Pokémon hunts near damp, dark areas. A famous movie features POKENAME mimicking a crying lady stuck in a water tunnel to lure humans in.

entry: 它被称为“下水道恶魔”，凶恶可怖，单凭一己之力便将整套排污系统霸为领地，制造种种恐怖事件。
author: leeto64
source: Known as "The Sewer's Devil", this fearsome creature singularly dominates entire sewage systems as their territories, causing all sorts of terror.

entry: POKENAME由最邪恶的灵魂构成，吞食恶念，转化为致命毒素，供自身成长。
author: fr34kuency
source: A body made up of the most evil spirits, POKENAME feasts on evil desires and transforms them into a lethal poison which it uses to grow.

entry: POKENAME的影子仿佛是身体的一部分，能像附肢一样操纵。受害者一碰到影子，就会被黏住，让它能整个人吞下。
author: fireblade141
source: This Pokémon's shadow appears to be part of it, able to be manipulated to serve almost like an appendage. Any victim who touches that shadow will find themselves stuck, allowing POKENAME to swallow them whole.
