entry: POKENAME的灵体力量已进步到能穿行、现身于不同维度。它会试图偷走看见的所有对象的灵魂，连自己的训练家也不例外。
author: soup1900
source: Its ghostly energy has evolved to the point where POKENAME can now cross and appear in different dimensions. It attempts to steal the soul of anyone it sees, including its own Trainer.

entry: POKENAME的嘴变得极大，如今能将人和宝可梦整个吞下。它吸干受害者的生命，再将毫无生气的身体吐出。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's mouth has gotten so huge that it can now swallow people and Pokémon whole. When it does this, it will drain the life out of the victim before ejecting their lifeless body back out.

entry: 这种宝可梦的嘴变得巨大，能从远处吸走受害者的灵魂。传言这张嘴其实直通来世，而非身体内部。
author: soup1900
source: This Pokémon's mouth has become gigantic, allowing it to vacuum and steal the souls of victims from far away. Rumor has it that this mouth actually leads directly to the afterlife instead of its body.

entry: POKENAME的灵体力量已进步到能穿行、现身于不同维度。它会试图偷走看见的所有对象的灵魂，连自己的训练家也不例外。
author: soup1900
source: Its ghostly energy has evolved to the point where POKENAME can now cross and appear in different dimensions. It attempts to steal the soul of anyone it sees, including its own Trainer.

entry: POKENAME能消失到其他维度，不再需要靠影子藏身。每当这么做，周围温度就会骤降。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME no longer needs to use shadows to hide away due to having the ability to disappear into alternate dimensions. Whenever it does this, the temperature around it drops dramatically.

entry: 这种宝可梦的嘴变得巨大，能从远处吸走受害者的灵魂。传言这张嘴其实直通来世，而非身体内部。
author: soup1900
source: This Pokémon's mouth has become gigantic, allowing it to vacuum and steal the souls of victims from far away. Rumor has it that this mouth actually leads directly to the afterlife instead of its body.

entry: POKENAME钻进猎物的影子尾随，有时跟得太久，竟在影子里睡着。决定吃谁的梦时，携带的塑像就会变成目标的模样。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME can enter its prey's shadow to stalk them. Sometimes, it stalks them so long that it falls asleep in their shadow. When it decides on a target to eat the dreams of, the effigy it carries changes its appearance into that of the target.

entry: 有人说，POKENAME是来自群星的使者，肩负更高使命。有些故事说，它会帮助英勇、心地纯洁的对象实现愿望。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is said by some to be a messenger from the stars serving a higher purpose. Some tales say it will help grant the wishes of those who are heroic and pure of heart.

entry: 传说POKENAME是无法战胜的猛兽，会毫不留情地摧毁看见的一切。传说还说，只要取出核心，它就会失去所有力量，死去。
author: agostostino
source: Legends say that POKENAME is an unbeatable beast, destroying everything they see without any mercy. According to the legend, if POKENAME's core is taken out then POKENAME will lose all of its strength and die.

entry: POKENAME岩石背上的种子，会分泌浓稠如油的黑液。晒太阳能使石质身体更加耐用。
author: fiordaliso
source: The bulb growing on its rocky back secretes a very thick black liquid that resembles oil. Basking in the sunlight helps POKENAME make its stone body more durable.

entry: POKENAME不停啃咬附近找到的岩石，让身体越来越坚韧。它会向威胁投掷尖石，保护其他虫类宝可梦免遭捕食。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME constantly gnaws on rocks it finds around to make its body increasingly resilient. It protects other Bug Pokémon from predators by hurling sharp stones at the threats.

entry: POKENAME思念母亲，于是凿出一顶形似母亲的石盔戴上。靠它便能在地下钻行。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: Missing its mother, POKENAME chiseled and wears a stone helmet in their likeness. With it, it can burrow through the ground.

entry: POKENAME相遇就会交战，直到分出明确胜负。胜者会送一根自己最硬的尖刺给败者；败者将刺吸入体内，为下次交手变得更强。
author: wiz0z
source: When POKENAME meet each other, they battle until there is a clear winner. After their victory, the winner will offer one of their hardest spines to the loser. The loser absorbs the spine into themselves, becoming stronger for next time.

entry: POKENAME空洞的外表，曾让发现者误以为是幽灵属性，直到进一步研究。周围的云其实由极细碎砾石构成，摸起来的“烟”充满颗粒感。
author: sk372
source: Its hollow appearance made discoverers assume it was a Ghost-type until further research was done. POKENAME's clouds are made of an extremely fine gravel, giving the smoke a very grainy feel when touched.

entry: POKENAME从身体排气孔释放含硫气体，驱退捕食者。为了维持这种防御，它必须不断摄食硫，因此只能住在硫含量高的地区。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME release sulfuric gas from the vents in their bodies to ward off predators. To maintain this defense mechanism, they must constantly consume sulfur, forcing them to live in areas with high sulfur content.

entry: POKENAME藏在石堆里，伪装成岩石。若被谁识破，就会用尖角刺过去。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: POKENAME hides among piles of stones, camouflaging itself as a rock. If anything sees through its disguise, POKENAME jabs at them with its sharp horn.

entry: 许多山中旅人讲过，被咧嘴笑着的POKENAME冲来，吓得逃跑的经历。可惜，它只是兴奋过头，急着奔向潜在的新朋友，全然不知自己多吓人。
author: sk372
source: Many travelers have shared tales of fleeing from a grinning POKENAME charging at them during mountain travels. Sadly, POKENAME is simply excited and overeager to run towards a potential new friend, unaware of its intimidating visage.

entry: 它用角能迅速钻穿坚实岩石，因此如今仍被用于寻找金矿脉，从中取得贵重金珠。个头虽大得吓人，性情却格外温顺听话。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its horn allows it to rapidly drill through solid rock, which is why it is still employed today in the search for gold veins from which valuable Nuggets can be extracted. Despite its imposing size, it has a remarkably gentle and obedient nature.

entry: POKENAME身体和携带的蛋都覆着岩壳，但石壳脆、易开裂。分享蛋时很方便，野生个体却常浑身裂纹，得慢慢愈合。
author: .jerden
source: Although POKENAME's body and the egg it carries are covered by a shell of rock, this stone is brittle and easy to crack. While this is useful when sharing its eggs with others, wild POKENAME are often covered by cracks that slowly heal over time.

entry: POKENAME攀附在海边洞穴的石壁和顶上，岩石外形很便于隐藏。探险者有时把暗处发光的眼睛当成宝石，很快就会后悔。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME clings to the stone walls and ceilings of caverns near the ocean, its rocky appearance making it easy for it to blend in. Explorers sometimes mistake its eye glowing in the dark for gems, a mistake they quickly regret.

entry: POKENAME拖着巨大身体穿过海底。受到威胁时，会收紧身体，变成旋转的手里剑形态，在水中射出，威力足以穿透坚实岩石。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME drags its immense body across the seafloor. When threatened, it pulls itself tight and transforms into a spinning, shuriken-like shape, launching through the water with enough force to pierce solid rock.

entry: POKENAME在街上站得一动不动，装成雕像。若人们更欣赏做相同表演的人类，它似乎会失落，毕竟那些人并不真是岩石做的。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME stands perfectly still in the street, pretending to be a statue. It seems to be disappointed whenever people are more impressed by humans performing the same act, since they are not actually made of rock.

entry: POKENAME体内的电，会沿石质身体的纹路闪烁奔涌。它将双拳砸在一起，产生近距离电击，击退靠近的敌人。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's internal electricity can be seen sparking and surging through the lines in its stony body. It slams its fists together to create short-range electric bursts to knock back close foes.

entry: POKENAME一下水就会像石头一样沉底。它虽能钻地，但肌肉虚弱，只能缓慢前进。
author: .jerden
source: When placed in water, POKENAME will sink like a stone. While POKENAME can burrow through the ground, its weak muscles only allow it to make slow progress.

entry: POKENAME只吃石头，个头小，胃口也小。拖一块大小像样的石头回巢，便能吃近两周。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's diet consists entirely of stone. Due to its small size, it has a meager appetite; a decently-sized rock dragged back to its den can keep it fed for nearly two weeks.

entry: 它在地下凿洞安家。若人类探险者或矿工打扰，就会暴怒，大肆破坏，直到地道坍塌。
author: .jerden
source: It makes its home inside caves it carves out underground. If disturbed by human explorers or miners, it will become enraged, rampaging until the tunnels collapse.

entry: POKENAME用岩石构成的角钻地，吃挖出的石头。人们相信，野生个体挖到特别稀有的矿物后，就会进化。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME burrows through the ground using its rocky horn, devouring rocks they dig up. Wild POKENAME are believed to evolve after unearthing particularly rare minerals.

entry: POKENAME像一串相连的石头，聚合方式仿佛紧密挤在一起的水分子。钻地时，它会吸收各种硬物和地下水。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: POKENAME appears to be a connected series of stones that seems to group together similarly to tightly compacted water molecules. As they dig through the earth, they will absorb an array of hard objects and groundwater.

entry: POKENAME披着许多蓄电晶体，储存移动时产生的电。奇怪的是，晶体会随蓄电长大，所谓“蜕落”，其实只是终究长到断掉。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are clad in many galvanic crystals that store the electricity they generate as they move. Oddly, these crystals grow as they accumulate electricity and are only "shed" because they inevitably break off.

entry: POKENAME吃煤炭和其他易燃物，维持体内火焰不熄。岩甲缝隙透出火光和热量时，就是最健康的状态。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME feed on coal and other flammable materials to keep their internal flames from petering out. When the gaps between their rocky platings are aglow with fire and heat, they are at their healthiest.

entry: POKENAME的几何形身体密度极高，又很沉重，不适合在网络空间穿行。动作僵硬，防御却出色。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's geometric frame is extremely dense and heavy, making it unsuited for navigating cyberspace. Its movements are stiff, but its defenses are exceptional.

entry: POKENAME摇摇欲坠地吊在暗洞顶上。因掉落造成多起伤人事故，许多洞穴都立了告示，提醒探险者注意潜在危险。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME hang precariously from the ceilings of dark caverns. Due to a number of injuries caused by falling POKENAME, many caves have posted signs warning explorers of the potential danger.

entry: POKENAME的翼膜由光滑、反光的晶体构成。边缘很锐利，能有效斩倒胆敢挑战的对手。
author: sk372
source: The membranes of POKENAME's wings are made up of a smooth, reflective crystal. The edges are quite sharp, making them highly effective at cutting down opponents foolhardy enough to challenge it.

entry: POKENAME睡着时像巨大岩块，能不受打扰地休息。许多疑似塌方，其实只是它的庞大身体堵住整条隧道。
author: santon5512
source: Sleeping POKENAME resemble massive boulders, allowing them to remain undisturbed while resting. Many suspected cave-ins have simply been these Pokémon, their immense bodies blocking entire tunnels.

entry: POKENAME身体虽由巨大岩石构成，却出奇轻。飞行时，铠甲互相磨擦，发出低沉雷鸣般的声响，回荡山间。
author: ambrosia04
source: Despite its massive rocky body, POKENAME is surprisingly light. When in flight, the grinding of its armored plates produces low, thunder-like rumbles that echo across mountains.

entry: POKENAME虽不能飞，却能高速蜿蜒前行，用石尾甩出惊人力量。它领地意识强，占据整段洞穴，谁闯入都会遭到猛烈攻击。
author: sk372
source: Though POKENAME cannot fly, it slithers around at high speeds and can whip its stone tail with incredible strength. It is very territorial, claiming entire sections of caves for itself, responding violently to anybody that trespasses.

entry: POKENAME完全由岩石构成，没有内脏。它只靠精神能量驱动，用来移动、感知周围。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are made entirely of rock, lacking any internal organs. They are fueled only by psychic energy, which they use to move and sense their surroundings.

entry: POKENAME不知疲倦地挖开周围岩石，为其他宝可梦营造理想环境。它领地意识极强，会狂甩巨尾，向不速之客投掷巨石。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME tirelessly tunnel the stone around them to create an ideal environment for their fellow Pokémon. They are very territorial, wildly swinging their massive tail and throwing boulders at unwanted guests.

entry: POKENAME睡觉时将身体蜷成球，看起来像普通石头。若被捡起或打扰，就会从背上猛喷火焰。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME curl their bodies into balls while sleeping, resembling an ordinary rock. If picked up or disturbed, they will release bursts of flames from their backs.

entry: POKENAME的岩石身体耐得住高温，能生活在火山脚附近。被激怒时，它会从体内裂缝喷火，吓退袭击者。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME's rocky bodies are able to withstand intense heat, allowing them to live near the bases of volcanoes. If provoked, they spew flames from the cracks in their bodies, using this to scare off attackers.

entry: POKENAME的岩石身体积着大量热量，能化作火焰猛然释放。火焰热得足以将部分身体化成岩浆。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME's rocky bodies trap immense amounts of heat, which they can release in bursts of fire. These flames burn hot enough to turn parts of their bodies into magma.

entry: 研究表明，POKENAME有特殊器官，能凭直觉知道当地潮位变化的规律，即使完全不熟悉这个地方也不例外。
author: bobosmith01
source: Research suggests that POKENAME has a specialized organ that allows it to intuitively know the patterns of the tide levels in the area, even if it is in a completely unfamiliar location.

entry: POKENAME常在城市建筑和电线上歇着。刚到城市的人，常把它们误认为装饰。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can be found in cities sitting atop buildings and powerlines. People who are new to cities often mistake them for decorations.

entry: POKENAME挖地道时，用强颚咬碎挡路的巨石。它的地道在城市下方绵延数英里。
author: .izik
source: When tunneling, POKENAME uses its powerful jaws to bite through boulders in its path. Its tunnels stretch for miles beneath cities.

entry: POKENAME在空中飞，用尾巴抽打大岩石，打碎后吃。身体十分柔韧，许多较大的肢体能旋转超过270度。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME flies in the sky and whips large boulders with its tail so the boulders break into pieces it can eat. Its body is very flexible, and many of its larger limbs can rotate over 270 degrees.

entry: POKENAME睡觉时缠在钟乳石上。一听见有谁靠近，就会展翅，让岩石身体降向对方，准备攻击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME wraps itself around stalactites when sleeping. When it hears someone approaching, it spreads its wings and descends its rocky body onto them, ready to strike.

entry: POKENAME常栖在图书馆、博物馆等重要建筑顶上。外形如画，深受摄影者喜爱。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can be found perched atop important buildings like libraries or museums. Their picturesque appearance makes them popular subjects of photography.

entry: POKENAME不擅游泳，身体的岩石节段拖慢了速度。睡着时，大多数游泳者会把它当成石头。
author: dodoowner_
source: An POKENAME is a bad swimmer, as its rock segments slow it down. While sleeping, most swimmers mistake it for a rock.

entry: 雷雨天，POKENAME将岩石尾巴插进地面，充当接地棒，导走劈中角的雷电。体内电力积累太多，就会放出足以击碎巨石的强大雷电。
author: shpimptin3000
source: POKENAME plant their rocky tails into the ground during thunderstorms to act as grounding rods when lightning strikes their horns. When too much electricity builds in their bodies, they will discharge a large bolt that can shatter boulders.

entry: POKENAME在月见山顶，会用角释放奇怪的磁性能量，现已被识别为声呐信号。研究者推测，它想与群星间的某个对象收发讯息。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: POKENAME's horn gives off a strange, magnetic energy on the peak of Mt. Moon that has been identified as sonar. Researchers theorize that it is trying to send and receive a message from something among the stars above.

entry: POKENAME用超能力在地下钻行，寻找作为食物的各种岩石。
author: melodydelune
source: Using its psychic abilities, POKENAME will burrow through the ground, seeking the various rocks that make up its diet.

entry: POKENAME用超能力控制其他宝可梦，按自己喜欢的样子凿刻、抛光身体。完成后，它会将受控者传送到对方想去的任何地方，作为谢礼。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME uses psychic powers to control other Pokémon to chisel and polish its body to its preferred appearance. Afterwards, it will teleport the ones it controlled to wherever they please in thanks.

entry: POKENAME外形如雕像，艺术家很爱描绘。它常一连几小时不动，是绝佳的创作对象。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a statuesque appearance that artists love to capture. They often remain still for hours at a time, which makes them perfect subjects for art.

entry: POKENAME不停在地下钻行，连睡觉也不例外。灵敏的磁铁让它不迷路，吃下矿物则能强化身体。
author: houndrys.
source: POKENAME constantly burrow into the  ground even when asleep. It has a sensitive magnet to not lose its way. It consumes minerals to toughen its body.

entry: POKENAME住在城市，寻找硬物啃咬、磨牙。为免破坏混凝土建筑，居民最好随身带石头，遇见流浪个体便拿给它，转移注意。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME resides in urban areas and seeks out hard objects to chew and chisel its teeth on. To avoid it causing damage to concrete structures, inhabitants are encouraged to carry rocks to offer and occupy stray POKENAME they encounter.

entry: POKENAME在洞中找冰柱，贴在脸上，引发奇怪反应。血液温度降到摄氏8度，体表开始渗出毒膜。它会保持数月，身体越来越硬，直到准备好进化。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME searches caves for icicles and attaches them to its face, starting a strange reaction. Its blood drops to 8°C, and it starts oozing a toxic film. It stays this way for months, as its body grows harder, until it is finally ready to evolve.

entry: POKENAME性情随和，钻地寻找黏土吃。最终挖进洞穴后，会吃能找到的罗子果，防止藤蔓和根须吸走体内养分。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are easy-going creatures that tunnel underground to find clay to eat. When they eventually dig into a burrow, they eat any available Rindo Berries to prevent vines and roots from leeching nutrients from their body.

entry: POKENAME有时会在古老地下遗迹中出现，完全静止无声。若听见闯入者靠近，眼睛就会闪光，瞬间照亮暗道，紧接着便猛扑出去。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME are sometimes found inside ancient underground ruins, remaining totally still and silent. If they hear intruders approaching, the dark tunnels will briefly be lit up by the flash of POKENAME's eyes, right before it pounces.

entry: POKENAME一边啃穿地层，一边摄取矿物，让外皮变坚韧。在附近筑巢时，建筑物也会消失。
author: houndrys.
source: POKENAME chew their way through the ground consuming minerals, toughening its hide. Buildings disappear when it nests nearby.

entry: POKENAME出没于古代遗迹附近，在旁边洞壁钻洞。它留下的讯息，据说能让人了解附近的遗迹。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can be found near ancient ruins where they burrow into the nearby cavern walls. The messages they leave behind are said to give insight into the ruins nearby.

entry: POKENAME大多只用后方的嘴进食，牙齿能咬碎岩石和矿物。前头的角，则能让它感知远处同类，与之沟通。
author: reflecbeat
source: POKENAME mostly eats only with its rear mouth, whose teeth can crush rocks and minerals. The horn on its front head allows it to sense and communicate with other POKENAME at a distance.

entry: 看钢壳的状态，通常就能判断POKENAME的性情。壳若满是擦痕和裂纹，多半好斗；若光亮、保养良好，则平和安静。
author: bradlybro199
source: POKENAME's nature is usually easy to judge based on the state of its steel shell. If the shell is scuffed and cracked, it can be assumed to be aggressive. If the shell is shiny and well maintained, it is peaceful and calm.

entry: POKENAME挖地道时，用坚硬如岩的头撞碎地下巨石。它偏爱在暗洞安家，借天然结构藏好自己。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME slams its rock-hard head into underground boulders when making its tunnels. It prefers dark caves to make its home, using the natural structure to remain hidden.

entry: 会在城堡墙壁上伪装成石像鬼。与真正的石像鬼不同，它不会吐水，这正是认出POKENAME的线索。
author: chorb33
source: It disguises itself on castle walls as a gargoyle . Unlike other gargoyles, it doesn't spit water, which helps indicate that it's really POKENAME.

entry: 它只有部分身体硬化成进化形态的钢板，咬合力和防御都增强了。但新身体的重量分布，也让行动出了问题。
author: sk372
source: Only parts of its body have hardened into its evolved form's steel plates. This has given it a more potent bite force and extra defenses, but causes its movement troubles due to the new body's weight distribution.

entry: POKENAME的石质硬翼，一击就能打倒雪松。它用有力的双翼清除障碍、寻找食物。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's rock-hard wings are strong enough to topple a cedar tree with one hit. It uses its powerful wings to clear obstacles and find food.

entry: POKENAME用黄色长腿从树上摘灯浆果，再滚进中空的石质身体，制成果汁。果汁极富营养，能维持体力。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its long yellow legs to grab Chilan Berries from trees then rolls them into its hollow stone body to make a juice. The juice is incredibly nutritious and helps it maintain its strength.

entry: POKENAME的岩石身体缝隙间，会漏出蜂蜜般的物质。甜甜的分泌物吸引其他宝可梦，也让它觅食时引人注意。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME leaks a honey-like substance between the cracks on its rock body. This sweet secretion attracts other Pokémon and helps it gather attention when foraging.

entry: POKENAME在所住洞穴的墙上刻特定划痕，标记领地。对幼小宝可梦而言，这也代表安全区，因为它会保护它们免遭捕食。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME carves specific scratches into the walls of its cavernous homes to designate its territory. For young Pokémon this also designates safe zones, as POKENAME protects them from predators.

entry: POKENAME一生大多住在地下深处的火山隧道。喷射火焰能使岩石软化，方便寻找矿物吃。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME spends most of its life deep in underground volcanic tunnels. Its Flamethrower allows it to soften rock and find minerals to consume.

entry: POKENAME身体的熔岩已硬化，形成钻石般坚硬的石甲。头顶的角，让它极擅钻入火山。
author: ilazerheart
source: The lava of POKENAME's body has hardened, covering it in a stone armour as hard as diamond. The horn atop its head makes it exceptionally good at burrowing into volcanoes.

entry: POKENAME虽全由坚实岩石构成，却能优雅翱翔，一整天也不疲倦。攻击猎物或领地闯入者时，它会从上方落下石质羽毛。
author: fiordaliso
source: Though its body is composed entirely of solid rock, POKENAME can soar gracefully through the skies, able to fly for a full day without tiring. To strike prey or intruders in its territory, it drops stone feathers from above.

entry: POKENAME覆盖岩石的身体极冷，连落上去的雨都会瞬间结冰。因此它很能抵御温度变化，在严寒环境也能活得很好。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's stone-covered body is very cold. Even rain that hits it instantly freezes, making it highly resistant to temperature changes and allowing it to thrive in frigid environments.

entry: POKENAME曾被训练成士兵的飞行坐骑。飞翔时，坚韧的石质羽毛能为骑乘者挡住危险。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME were once trained to act like flying mounts for soldiers. Their tough, rocky feathers shield the rider from danger as they soar through the air.

entry: POKENAME带领形态相近的宝可梦群，穿行洞穴和沙漠。体内温度高得能熔化岩石，身体也因此不断开裂。
author: redmagecole
source: POKENAME leads packs of similarly-shaped Pokémon through caves and deserts. Its body is constantly cracking due to its internal body temperature, which can reach levels of heat that can melt rocks.

entry: POKENAME住在大岩蛇挖的地道里，吃它沿途留下的矿物。口中充满有毒化学物质和致病细菌。
author: ozydamians
source: It nests in the tunnels dug by Onix, and feeds off the leftover minerals Onix deposit in their wake. POKENAME's mouth is awash in toxic chemicals and infectious bacteria.

entry: 以POKENAME的个头来说，它号角般的叫声低沉得惊人。回声穿过洞穴地道，吓到大多数宝可梦，其实它很友好、很爱玩。
author: sk372
source: The trumpeting cry of POKENAME is a surprisingly deep bellow for something of its size. Most Pokémon are frightened by the call echoing across cavern tunnels, but POKENAME is actually quite friendly and playful.

entry: POKENAME的岩石外层极其耐用，挡下多次强攻，甚至才刚开裂。蜷成球开始滚动后，几乎无法挡住它的冲势。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME's rocky exterior is extremely durable, able to deflect many strong attacks before even cracking. When they curl into a ball and start rolling, it's nigh impossible to stop their momentum.

entry: POKENAME钻进地下，沿地下电缆寻找大量数据。随后它会胡乱横冲直撞，直到吸够信息、心满意足，再抛下剩余的一切离开。
author: npshi
source: POKENAME are known to burrow underground, following subterranean cables, hoping to find large quantities of data. POKENAME will then rampage haphazardly until they absorb enough information to satiate them, leaving whatever remains behind.

entry: POKENAME用身体制成的锤子和凿子，雕刻精巧石像。许多作品摆在道馆中，体现各位馆主的理念和精神。
author: santon5512
source: By using hammers and chisels made from their bodies, POKENAME sculpt intricate statues made of stone. Many of their creations are put on display in Gyms, embodying the principles and spirit of each Gym Leader.

entry: POKENAME从石质身体渗出灰色腐蚀性毒液，连岩石都能溶穿，是驱退捕食者的自卫手段。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME exudes a corrosive grey poison from its stone body. The poison is potent enough to melt through rock, serving as a defense mechanism to deter predators.

entry: POKENAME带着的黑石，是抛光的缟玛瑙。野生个体会将珍贵石头送给任何开口索取的对象，不知为何，第二天总能再找到一块。
author: .jerden
source: The black rock POKENAME carries is made of polished onyx. Wild POKENAME will give away this precious stone to anyone who asks for it, and will somehow always find another one by the next day.

entry: POKENAME用尾巴敲洞壁，想吃紫水晶。震动帮它震松宝石，吞下后补充养分、增强力量。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME hits cave walls with its tail so it can eat amethyst. The vibrations it creates help loosen the gems, which it devours for nourishment and strength.

entry: POKENAME在地下蜿蜒，挖出小岩洞，捕猎更喜欢用尾巴压碎，而非咬。两只相遇，会缠住彼此尾巴打招呼。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME create small caverns when they slither underground and prefer to crush prey with their tail over biting them. When two POKENAME meet, they wrap their tails together as a greeting.

entry: POKENAME有锡灰色的岩壳，抵挡兽爪、鸟喙和鸟爪。它能释放小股电流，让其他宝可梦的毛因静电蓬起。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a rocky, pewter shell that protects them from claws, beaks, and talons. They can produce small bursts of electricity that causes the fur of other Pokémon to fluff up with static.

entry: POKENAME旋转沉重石尾，将自己向前甩出，以此移动。训练家在洞中要小心，撞上飞来的它可能致命。
author: blunido.
source: POKENAME moves by spinning its heavy stone tail to hurl itself forward. Trainers should exercise caution in caves, as colliding with a flying POKENAME can be fatal.

entry: POKENAME头上的石角会先泛白光，再对自身或同伴使出神秘守护。若被逼到绝境，它会投石猛打敌人，借防御战术逃脱。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's stone horn on its head will glow white before it unleashes a Safeguard on itself or its allies. If it finds itself cornered, it will pelt the opponent with rocks, using its defensive tactics to escape.

entry: POKENAME待在峭壁顶，将头顶岩石往下扔，之后岩石会慢慢长回。许多训练家常把它当成刚从地下探头的大岩蛇。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME position themselves atop cliffs and toss down the rocks from the top of their head that they steadily regrow over time. Many Trainers often confuse POKENAME for the heads of Onix that are emerging from the ground.

entry: POKENAME在其他宝可梦挖的地道里游荡，寻找闪亮的石头。每找到一块就捡起收藏，直到再也拿不动。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME wanders through underground tunnels dug by other Pokémon, searching for shiny stones. Whenever it finds one, it will pick it up to add to its collection until it cannot carry any more.

entry: POKENAME用大角掘地，也会蜷成球滚动。滚动时伸角撞击下方地面，就能转向，或将自己弹向别处。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME use their large horns to help them dig into the ground. They curl up into balls and roll around, steering or launching different directions by extending their horns and striking the ground beneath them.

entry: POKENAME覆满苔藓和藤蔓，能轻松融入丛林家园的草木。感到危险靠近，就绷紧身体，纹丝不动，装成雕像。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME is covered in moss and vines, allowing it to easily blend in with the foliage of its jungle habitat. If it senses danger drawing near, it tenses up and stays perfectly still to appear like a statue.

entry: POKENAME在积雪地区下方的永久冻土里挖地道。它靠头内的磁铁辨路，始终感知北极的方向。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME tunnel through the permafrost beneath snow-covered regions. They navigate using a magnet inside their head that constantly senses the direction of the north pole.

entry: 尾巴极为强健，能将POKENAME弹上数米高空。虽身体沉重，仍能长距离滑翔。
author: chorb33
source: Its tail is extremely strong. This allows POKENAME to launch itself many meters into the air, then glide for long distances despite its heavy weight.

entry: POKENAME吃的数据越多，岩石身体的各部分就越硬。它在数据中心下方安家，从地底深处吸收数据。
author: .izik
source: The more data that POKENAME consumes, the harder each portion of its rocky body becomes. It makes its home beneath data centers, absorbing data from deep below the surface.

entry: POKENAME双脚不协调，头又重，走路很困难。若摔倒后无法起身，它就钻进地下，再破土而出，用脚着地。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: This Pokémon has a hard time walking due to its uncoordinated feet and top-heavy head. If this Pokémon falls and cannot right itself, POKENAME will tunnel into the ground before surfacing and landing on its feet.

entry: POKENAME跃上半空，蜷成球，用岩刺撞击敌人。它们收集岩石，不停打磨尖刺，还会在洞穴里开凿隧道，寻找最坚硬的石头，用来锻炼。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME leap into the air and curl into balls to attack with their rocky spines. They gather rocks to sharpen their spines, constantly working to polish and refine them, carving out tunnels in caves to find the sturdiest stones to train with.

entry: 它们用海绵般的颊部石头滤水呼吸。生活在湍急河流中的POKENAME，身体通常更光滑。
author: cait_sith
source: They filter water through their sponge-like cheek stones to breathe. POKENAME that live in fast-moving rivers tend to have smoother bodies.

entry: POKENAME的舌头和尾巴都能伸长，在战斗中成为沉重有力的武器。它不会变色，而是改变外观，模仿不同石头的纹理。
author: sk372
source: Both POKENAME's tongue and tail can be extended to act as heavy and powerful weapons in battle. Rather than changing colors, it can change its appearance to match different stone textures.

entry: POKENAME只在地下湖岸旁的深洞出现，常被误认为水井，还会对闯入者施咒。网上满是猜测它主体模样的说法。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME only appears in deep caves near underground lakeshores, where it is commonly mistaken for a well and hexes trespassers. The internet is filled with theories of what the main body of this Pokémon looks like.

entry: POKENAME挖出的暗洞里，花朵微微发光。花似乎不需要阳光，只需它从土中吃下的稀有矿物。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's flower glows dimly inside the dark caves it excavates. The flower does not seem to need any sunlight, only rare minerals from the earth POKENAME eats.

entry: POKENAME的大角模仿大岩蛇，吓退通常会捕食较小本体的宝可梦。它装作受伤，角也装成普通石块，引来猎物，再猛扑张大嘴吞下。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME's large horn mimics Onix, scaring away Pokémon that would normally predate the smaller core body. It lures in prey by acting injured and having the horn act like inanimate rocks, before lunging and devouring the target with the large maw.

entry: POKENAME在岩礁旁伪装，等猎物游过。角能感知水中的细微扰动。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME disguises itself against rocky reefs, waiting for prey to swim by. It can sense minor disturbances in the water with its horn.

entry: POKENAME用头撞裂峡谷岩壁，震松石块，再吃下岩石，利用矿物增强身体。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's headbutts can break canyon walls to loosen chunks of rock. It will then eat the stone, using the minerals to strengthen its body.

entry: POKENAME吃可可多拉和可多拉掉下的金属屑，增强身体。摄入的矿物，让皮肤坚韧如铠甲。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME eats metal shavings that fall off Aron and Lairon to strengthen its body. The minerals it consumes contribute to its tough, armor-like skin.

entry: 古代战士常为珍贵的黑曜石角猎杀POKENAME。但有人相信，偷走角就会招来无尽折磨和苦难。
author: mistymagius
source: Ancient warriors would often hunt POKENAME to for their precious, obsidian horn. However, some people believed that stealing the horn will cause endless torment and misery.

entry: POKENAME将自己埋进洞壁，大部分时间都在睡觉。许多旅人以为只是装饰雕刻，直到独眼出现，回望着自己。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME buries itself into cavern walls to spend most of its time sleeping. Many a traveler has thought of it as a mere decorative carving until its single eye appeared and stared back at them.

entry: POKENAME以干净的岩石尾巴为傲。常能见到它泡洗尾巴，或用吃下的坚果所含的天然油脂，将尾巴擦得发亮。
author: distinguishedmanlygentleman
source: POKENAME prides itself on the cleanliness of its rocky tail. POKENAME can commonly be found soaking its tail in water or using natural oils from the nuts it eats to give its tail a glossy finish.

entry: POKENAME用磁力感知金属矿床，再钻下去吃。敏锐的磁感让它能找到最佳营养来源。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its magnetic abilities to sense metal ore deposits and then burrows down to eat them. It relies on its keen sense of magnetism to locate the best sources of nourishment.

entry: POKENAME钻穿山体，寻找更坚硬的石头加固剑刃，过程中也会将剑刃磨得更锋利。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME drills through mountains in search of tougher stone to harden its blade. Doing so also sharpens it in the process.

entry: 寻找最硬的石头时，POKENAME会逐渐变得致密、暗沉，宛如缟玛瑙。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: In search of the toughest stone, POKENAME condenses and darkens to resemble onyx.

entry: POKENAME用锋利石刺破开岩石，吃里面的矿石。强韧的身体能撬开坚实岩石，寻找渴求的矿物。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its sharp stone spikes to break into stone and eat ore. Its toughened body allows it to pry open solid rock in search of the minerals it craves.

entry: POKENAME会被用来处理报废生锈的车辆，它吃得十分起劲。通常住在完全由自己挖出的山洞里。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is employed to dispose of scrapped, rusted vehicles, which it devours with great enthusiasm. It typically dwells in mountain caves that it excavates entirely on its own.

entry: 身体上的晶体最为坚硬。会用晶体撞击敌人，突破大多数防御。
author: melodydelune
source: The crystals on its body are the hardest points; it will attack by hitting its enemies with them, piercing most enemy defenses.

entry: 在洞穴群里迷路时，POKENAME晶体的柔光能使人十分安心。它会让迷路的探险者抓紧石质身体，带着离开深处，回到洞外。
author: .jerden
source: When people are lost in cave systems, the soft glow of POKENAME's crystals is incredibly soothing. They lead lost explorers up and out from the depths by having them take a firm grip on their rocky body.

entry: POKENAME的身体能融入山地家园。它蜷在峭壁边休息，只有听见体形相近的宝可梦靠近，才会行动，笨重地迎战。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME bodies blend into the mountainous terrain that they make their home in. They will rest curled against cliff faces, only taking action when they hear a similarly sized Pokémon approach, and they lumber into battle.

entry: 许多人相信，POKENAME其实是坠落后住在月见山里的活陨石。又一种只靠解除融合就被推翻的理论……真的推翻了吗？
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: Many people believe that POKENAME is actually a living meteorite that has fallen and resided within Mt. Moon. Another theory that was disproven simply with the act of unfusing... or was it?

entry: POKENAME头内有特殊磁性核心，能吸引同类。数只聚在一起时，各自力量会成倍增强，直到分别才恢复。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME have a special magnetic core inside their head that attracts other POKENAME. When several POKENAME gather, their individual power multiplies until they part ways.

entry: 有记载称，POKENAME曾是古代文明的守护者。它虽笨重，一击却足以摧毁整座宫殿。
author: chorb33
source: There are reports that POKENAME served as a guardian for ancient civilizations. It is cumbersome, but its strikes can bring down entire palaces.

entry: 世界各地许多徒步者都喜欢POKENAME，因为它的工具很适合协助翻山。野生个体甚至会用绳索和镐，营救遇险旅人。
author: sk372
source: Many hikers across the world have an affinity for POKENAME, as its tools are very equipped to help those traversing mountains. Wild specimens have even saved travelers in peril with their ropes and pick.

entry: POKENAME埋在洞底，突然探出，向路过训练家讨抱抱。但身体由坚实岩石构成，训练家抱不了，它就会消沉，钻回更深处。
author: redmagecole
source: POKENAME buries itself in cavern floors and pops up to ask for hugs from passing Trainers. When a Trainer is unable to hug POKENAME due to it being made of solid rock, POKENAME gets depressed and burrows further into its hole.

entry: POKENAME深挖洞壁，一睡就是数年，饿了便吃找到的根。它藏在黑暗中，靠地下家园的矿物和根须维生。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME digs deep into cave walls to sleep for years at a time, eating roots it finds if it gets hungry. It remains hidden in the darkness, living off the minerals and roots in its subterranean home.

entry: 融合让POKENAME躺着不动。它完全依靠别人喂食，积蓄进化所需的能量。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Fusion has made POKENAME lay motionless. It relies entirely on others feeding it to build up the energy for evolution.

entry: POKENAME总在狂暴，撕开泥土岩石，连最小的猎物都要追。在头边放一块磁铁，就能让它平静。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME is always on a rampage. It tears through soil and rock to chase the smallest of prey. Putting a magnet near its head will calm it down.

entry: POKENAME在洞穴深处唱歌，借岩石中的回声，让班基拉斯等捕食者入睡。轻柔的摇篮曲穿石回响，再凶猛的敌人也会睡着。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME sings deep in caves, using the echoes in the stones to put predators like Tyranitar to sleep. The soft lullaby reverberates through the stone, lulling even the fiercest foes into slumber.

entry: POKENAME只吃岩石，强颚能轻松嚼碎。摄入足够矿物后，尾巴就会长出新的一节岩石。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's diet consists solely of rock and stone easily crunched by its strong jaws. After it consumes enough minerals, it grows a new rocky segment for its tail.

entry: POKENAME用石角与其他宝可梦争领地。攻击常猛到把自己的角折断，但只要多吃岩石，很快就能长回。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME fights other Pokémon for territory using its stone horn. It frequently strikes with enough force to break its own horn, but it will quickly grow back as long as POKENAME eats plenty of rocks.

entry: POKENAME咬开巨石，吃里面的晶体，最爱石英。锋利的颚和强大咬合力，让它能破开坚实岩石。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME bites boulders to open them, eating any crystals inside. It prefers quartz, using its sharp jaw and powerful bite to break through solid stone.

entry: POKENAME头顶的穹壳由晶体覆在岩石上构成，致密而耐冲击。它还会冲撞洞壁、跃下峭壁，进一步锻炼头骨。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's dome is comprised of crystal layered over stone, making it dense and resilient to impact. It toughens the skull further by charging into cave walls or leaping from cliff sides.

entry: POKENAME难以压住火焰，便收集岩石作铠甲，容纳多余能量。若铠甲开始熔化，它就用熔岩将新石头黏合起来。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME have trouble containing their fire, so they gather rocks to form armor that contains their excess energy. If their armor ever starts to melt, they will use the molten rocks to hold the new ones together.

entry: POKENAME是个多面手，却专心挖掘，开隧道的速度最快能达时速50英里。它能制订精密计划防止塌方，却常不做计划就开挖。
author: heal_fire
source: POKENAME is a multifaceted Pokémon that devotes its time to digging. It creates tunnels with remarkable speed, at speeds up to 50 mph. It can develop an elaborate plan to prevent cave-ins, but often digs without one.

entry: POKENAME藏在石壁里伏击猎物，靠脚步在岩石中的细微震动追踪。等足够近，就头朝前甩出石质身体，将目标撞昏。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME hides itself within stone walls waiting to ambush prey, tracking them via the slight reverberations in the rocks from every footstep. Once close enough, it hurls its stone body at its target headfirst to knock them out.

entry: POKENAME用尖角钻进岩石深处，从外面看不见。它们待得太久，周围岩石逐渐风化，身体暴露在空气中，便掉到地上。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME use their sharp horn to tunnel deep into rocks, becoming hidden from the outside. They stay there for so long that the rock slowly erodes away around them and exposes them to the air, causing them to fall to the ground.

entry: 遗迹中常有人发现停止活动的POKENAME。传说，有些考古学家误将它们激活，竟被它们的凝视石化。
author: chorb33
source: Time and again, deactivated POKENAME are found in ruins. Rumour has it that some archaeologists were petrified by their stare when they accidentally activated them.

entry: 用獠牙啃食岩石与岩石属性宝可梦，抽取其中的矿石和矿物。
author: staghorn
source: It uses its fangs to feed on rocks and Rock-type Pokémon, draining them of ores and minerals.

entry: POKENAME身上的每颗宝石其实都是仿制宝石，包括莫桑石、绿萤石、尖晶石等。宝石常掉落，它必须赶在被拿走前装回去。
author: jaminmcready
source: Each gem on POKENAME's body is actually an imitation stone, including moissanite, green fluorite, and spinel. These gemstones often fall off, forcing POKENAME to put them back on before anyone takes them.

entry: POKENAME由岩石与晶体混合构成，攻防都极强。大多数石头和宝石都会嚼来吃，唯独找到钻石便收藏，用来装饰巢穴。
author: sk372
source: The mixture of stone and crystal making up POKENAME's body gives it immense defensive and offensive strength. It crunches on most stones and gems for food, but hoards any diamonds it finds to decorate its den.

entry: POKENAME爱在夜里用石化的叶子钻地道，寻找金属粉。若难得找到，就会直直向上挖，向附近宝可梦炫耀宝物。
author: theaceofhearts0306
source: POKENAME loves drilling tunnels at night with their petrified leaves, hunting for Metal Powder. On the off chance it finds one, POKENAME will dig straight up, showing off its treasure to nearby Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME找池塘湖泊附近嵌入，装成岩层。它心地温和，希望小型宝可梦聚来，把石质身体当作安全避难所。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME finds ponds and lakes to embed itself near, pretending to be a rock formation. It has a gentle heart, and hopes that smaller Pokémon will flock to it and use its stony body as a safe haven.

entry: POKENAME用强劲的声波尖叫震开石头，取出晶洞石吃。声波使岩石碎裂，露出里面的晶洞。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME breaks stones open with high-powered sonic screams to loosen geodes to eat. The sound waves cause the rocks to shatter, exposing the geodes inside.

entry: 它钻到高高岩台的顶端，希望飞下来坐在训练家头上，交个朋友。但重量太大，落下的速度往往比POKENAME预想的快得多。
author: lordjoostmeister
source: It burrows its way up to the top of high outcroppings, hoping to befriend potential Trainers by flying down and sitting on their head. Due to its massive weight, however, POKENAME tends to come in for a landing rather faster than it intends to.

entry: POKENAME由高山的永久冻土形成，身体岩石靠有生命的冰连在一起。它们一连数年漫无目的地游荡冰川，光是存在就让周围保持冰冻。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME form from the permafrost in high mountain ranges, the rocks that make up their body being bound together by living ice. They aimlessly roam across glaciers for years on end, their surroundings kept frozen by their mere presence.

entry: POKENAME由高山的永久冻土形成，身体岩石靠有生命的冰连在一起。它们一连数年漫无目的地游荡冰川，光是存在就让周围保持冰冻。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME form from the permafrost in high mountain ranges, the rocks that make up their body being bound together by living ice. They aimlessly roam across glaciers for years on end, their surroundings kept frozen by their mere presence.

entry: POKENAME体内含硫量高，花瓣因此泛黄。刺鼻气味随它走到哪，就飘到哪，驱退捕食者和想收服它的训练家。
author: santon5512
source: Due to the high amounts of sulfur in POKENAME's bodies, their petals take on a yellow hue. Their pungent smell follows them wherever they go, warding off both predators and Trainers looking to catch them.

entry: POKENAME潜伏在水下峡谷和洞穴上方，朝猎物落下。用岩石身体压住，再以绳索般藤蔓绑牢后，它便慢慢吸走目标的生命力。
author: .jerden
source: Lurking above underwater canyons and caves, POKENAME will drop itself down on prey from above. Once it has it pinned beneath its rocky body and held in place by rope-like vines, POKENAME will slowly drain its target's life force.

entry: POKENAME踢洞壁，震松蛋白石来吃。敏捷动作让它能轻松穿行岩地，收集最爱的矿物。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME kicks cave walls to loosen opal and eat it. Its agile movements allow it to navigate rocky terrain with ease while gathering its favorite mineral.

entry: POKENAME背上的蘑菇状石头会定期脱落，让新的长出来。隆隆岩、大岩蛇等岩石宝可梦，很爱吃这些掉下的蘑菇石。
author: sk372
source: The mushroom-like stones on POKENAME's back fall off periodically to let new ones grow in their place. These discarded shroom-rocks are a beloved treat for stone Pokémon like Golem and Onix.

entry: 这种宝可梦脱落的石头，能保持华氏0度以下数周。餐馆将石头放进冷冻柜和冰箱，即使设备故障，也能继续保冷。
author: chibitales
source: Shed stones from this Pokémon's body can stay below 0°F for weeks. Restaurants keep these stones in their freezers and refrigerators to keep the appliances cold should they fail.

entry: POKENAME性情友善，常找比自己小的宝可梦作伴。为了交朋友，它让海豹球、迷唇娃等小型宝可梦把自己当滑梯玩。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are amicable, often seeking the company of Pokémon that are smaller than themselves. To make friends, POKENAME lets small Pokémon like Spheal and Smoochum use them as slides to play.

entry: POKENAME的石壳上长着一种地衣。绿色的地衣需要光，却只需少量水，在它所住的干燥山坡生长得很好。
author: .jerden
source: A form of lichen grows on top of POKENAME's stony shell. This green substance requires light but little water, and thrives on the dry mountainsides where POKENAME lives.

entry: POKENAME石质身体上长着几乎无法破坏的晶体鳞片。暗光下仍明亮闪耀的光泽，让许多富有收藏家视其为珍宝。
author: sk372
source: Crystal scales that are nearly indestructible grow along POKENAME's stone body. Their bright and shimmering sheen in low lighting makes them highly valuable to many wealthy and affluent collectors.

entry: POKENAME用巨角破开洞中的孔雀石矿脉，吞食宝石，恢复体力、增强岩石身体。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its massive horn to break malachite veins in caves. It devours the gems to restore stamina and strengthen its rocky body.

entry: POKENAME起初看似岩石做的，其实由灰色冰糖构成。它能吐出大块糖，抛向对手攻击。
author: roundabout_robin
source: While initially appearing to be made of rock, POKENAME is actually made of grey rock candy. It can spit up and lob chunks of this candy to attack opponents.

entry: POKENAME用头撞洞壁，吃掉落的蓝宝石。强壮身体能轻松破岩，寻找珍贵宝石滋养自己。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME headbutts cave walls to eat sapphires that fall. Its strong body allows it to easily break rocks, searching for precious gems to nourish itself.

entry: POKENAME外壳的材料，与小行星中的物质相同。科学家仍在研究，电力会如何影响它。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have an outer shell that is made of the same material that can be found in asteroids. Scientists are still studying how POKENAME are affected by electricity.

entry: 沉重岩甲让POKENAME难以行动。受袭时，铠甲会变硬，几乎无法击穿。它得承受巨大的岩石重量，因此通常活不久。
author: sottiwotti
source: The heavy rock armor makes it hard for POKENAME to move. Whenever it gets attacked, its armor hardens, which makes it almost impenetrable. POKENAME usually do not live long, because of the massive weight of the rocks they have to endure.

entry: POKENAME成群钻地，穿过山脉。休息时嚼食树根，迅速恢复力量。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME travels in packs while tunneling through mountain ranges. During rest, it chews tree roots to rapidly recover its strength.

entry: 谁大胆想碰POKENAME的尾巴，手就会被石爪划伤。饿时，它用角敲物品和墙，催训练家立刻喂食。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME slashes with its stone claws at the hand of anyone bold enough to try touching its tail. When hungry, it bangs its horn against objects and walls to urge its Trainer to give it food immediately.

entry: POKENAME以巨石为食，用坚硬如岩的头撞碎。为了治好由此引起的头痛，它会到最近的泉边喝矿泉水。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME feeds off of large boulders, which it breaks down using its rock-solid headbutt. To cure its resulting headache, it wanders to the nearest spring to drink mineral water.

entry: POKENAME静立城市公园，等独行者经过，再用水枪将对方绊倒，拿走身上所有面包。
author: ghostslythe
source: POKENAME stands still in city parks, waiting for lone passing humans. Using Water Gun, it trips the loners up and then takes any bread on their person.

entry: POKENAME向洞顶打上勾拳，震松橄榄石等宝石吃。宝石提供珍贵养分，让它的力量不断增长。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uppercuts cave ceilings to loosen gems like peridot and eat them. The gems provide valuable nutrients to fuel its growing strength.

entry: POKENAME凭巨力拳击洞壁，破开岩石，吃黄水晶。黄水晶能增强力量和韧性。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME punches cave walls so it can eat citrine, using its immense strength to break through the rock. The citrine helps enhance its power and fortitude.

entry: POKENAME有时在博物馆里装成大理石雕像。它很少满意自身外形，常把自己凿成略有不同的模样。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are sometimes found in museums, pretending to be marble statues. They are rarely satisfied with their appearance, often chiseling themselves into slightly different forms.

entry: POKENAME受惊缩壳时，只有巨大的岩石头缩不进去。幸好，石质皮肤能抵御大多数伤害。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's large rocky head is the one part of its body that it cannot retreat into its shell when it is frightened. Fortunately, the stone skin makes it resistant to most forms of damage.

entry: POKENAME住在瀑布和其他山地水域附近，将巨大触手伸进水中，营造周围的小湖和生态系统，维持它们，也从中取食。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME live near waterfalls and other mountainside bodies of water. They stretch their massive tentacles through the water, shaping small lakes and ecosystems around them that they maintain and feed on.

entry: 常能见到POKENAME用尾巴缠住石头，收紧压碎。乍看只是在玩，其实是在锻炼握力，想练到足以杀死身体最坚硬的宝可梦。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: POKENAME can often be seen wrapping its tail around rocks and breaking them open while flexing. While at first it looks like it's doing it for fun, it is actually training its grip to be stronger to prove fatal to even the hardest-bodied Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME钻穿山体，凭强壮身体破岩，吃黄玉。摄入的矿物增强身体结构，让它逐渐更加坚韧。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME digs through mountains and eats topaz, using its powerful body to break apart rocks. The minerals it consumes help it strengthen its structure, making it more resilient over time.

entry: POKENAME沿岩石山路疾驰，寻找草地。它小心不烧着草，因为高海拔能找到的食物少，草是其中之一。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME gallop through rocky mountain paths to find patches of grass. They are careful not to burn the grass since it is one of the few sources of food they can obtain at high elevations.

entry: POKENAME成群沿岩石山路行进，步伐谨慎，能走过陡崖而不坠落。一发现草地，整群就会停下，大吃这难得的绿意。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME live in herds and travel together atop rocky mountain paths. Their careful footing allows them to traverse steep cliffs without falling. Once they find a patch of grass, the herd stops to feast on the rare greenery.

entry: POKENAME的石质身体磁性很强，能用电攻击。许多矿工利用这能力，为地道照明供电。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's stone body is highly magnetic and attacks with electricity. Many miners use its abilities to power the lighting in their tunnels.

entry: POKENAME的两个头共用身体与胃，却自私贪吃，宁愿争抢一丁点食物，也不肯各自吃一份更丰盛的餐点。
author: sk372
source: Despite sharing the same body and stomach, the two heads of POKENAME are selfishly greedy. They often fight over a single morsel rather than eat two separate, more filling meals.

entry: POKENAME住在地下湖深处，游泳时吸收丰富矿物。常能见到它调皮地将挖出的闪亮宝石顶在鼻上，保持平衡。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME makes its home deep in underground lakes, swimming and soaking up the high mineral contents. It can often be spotted playfully balancing shiny gemstones it dug up on its nose.

entry: 它们的身体由各种黏土和沉积物构成，沿途会留下黏稠软泥。这些沉积物能促进植物生长，也会弄脏大理石或瓷砖地板。
author: quackquackattack
source: Their bodies are made of various clays and sediments which they leave behind as a sticky goo. This sediment they leave behind helps plants grow, and stains marble or porcelain floors.

entry: 它们拖着岩石和黏液，弄脏脚下地面。留下的东西虽是其他宝可梦的好肥料，人们仍会把它们赶出屋，保持家里干净。
author: quackquackattack
source: They sully the ground beneath them with a trail of rocks and slime. While this makes perfect fertilizer for other Pokémon, people usher them outside to keep homes clean.

entry: POKENAME飘过大钢蛇挖的隧道，寻找剩下的矿石。若看见其他宝可梦在吃，就会使出黑夜魔影，试图赶走对方。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME floats through tunnels made by Steelix to search for ore that was left behind. If it sees other Pokémon eating the ore, it will use Night Shade on them, attempting to chase them away.

entry: POKENAME挖出深邃地道，其他宝可梦常在里面迷路。等猎物落单，它就吸走生命能量。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME digs deep tunnels that other Pokémon often get lost in. Once its prey is all alone, it saps them of their life energy.

entry: POKENAME全身由玻璃般的晶体构成，即使完全浸水也不会受伤。据说，它能活数百年。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's body is composed entirely of a glass-like crystal, allowing it to completely submerge itself in water without harm. It is said that this Pokémon can live for hundreds of years.

entry: 稀有宝石和矿物嵌在盘曲的石质身体中，一经光照就明亮闪耀。极强的身体一收紧，连钢铁也能压碎。
author: fiordaliso
source: Rare gems and minerals are embedded within its stone coils, shining brightly when brushed by a light source. It can crush even steel by constricting it with its incredibly powerful body.

entry: POKENAME常以公主和女祭司的形象呈现，被视为舍己之爱的象征。其实，身体虽由花岗岩和大理石构成，实力也只比普通大岩蛇强一点。
author: lovelover75
source: Often represented with the image of a Princess and a Priestess, POKENAME is deemed an icon of sacrificial love. In reality, it is little stronger than ordinary Onix, despite having bodies of Granite and Marble.

entry: POKENAME年纪越大，石质鼻子的节段就越多。关都矿工最近发现一只，鼻子长逾3英尺。
author: mepp.
source: As POKENAME ages, its rocky nose grows more and more segments. Miners in Kanto have recently discovered a specimen with a nose over three feet long.

entry: POKENAME用爪子挖穿洞壁，轻松夹碎岩石，再吃下，维持岩石身体。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME use their claws to dig through the walls of caves. Their claws are capable of easily crushing rocks, which they consume in order to maintain their rocky bodies.

entry: POKENAME吃在明媚阳光下打盹的宝可梦的梦。身体会将梦转成进化所需的能量。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME feeds off the dreams of any Pokémon it finds napping in bright sunlight. Its body converts dreams into fuel for evolution.

entry: POKENAME通常溜进家里，爬上床，吃人和同类的梦。它对谁都没有危险。
author: notmax22
source: POKENAME usually sneak into homes and climb onto beds to eat the dreams of people and POKENAME alike. They are not dangerous to anyone.

entry: 吃到格外令人沮丧的梦，它会气得爆炸。这场爆炸破坏力强，也让它痛快地宣泄情绪。
author: .izik
source: When it consumes a particularly frustrating dream, it explodes in a fit of anger. This detonation is both destructive and cathartic for the Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME夜里在市区徘徊，窥探大家庭的住处。它偏爱关于幸福家庭回忆的梦，吃下能暂时缓解孤独。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME lingers around urban areas at night, peeking into the homes of large families. It favors eating the dreams related to happy family memories, which staves off its own loneliness for a time.

entry: POKENAME溜进家里，看人睡觉，再突然伸舌舔头，立刻把人弄醒。目标总会说，自己当时正梦到最精彩的地方。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME sneaks into homes to watch people sleep, then suddenly licks their head with its tongue. This immediately wakes them up, and its targets will always claim this happened right at the most exciting moment of a dream.

entry: POKENAME产生强效催眠气体，深受失眠者珍视。但长期接触，可能使人陷入昏迷。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME produces a powerful sleeping gas that is treasured by people suffering from insomnia. However, long-term exposure to the gas could cause them to be put into a coma.

entry: POKENAME将捕食者催眠，使其陷入梦境般的恍惚，再趁机跳远，躲到对方发现不了的地方。等足够远，才解除催眠。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME hypnotize predators into a dreamy trance that distracts the predator while they hop far enough to avoid detection. Once they are far enough away, they release the predator from the trance.

entry: POKENAME喷出的墨，碰到或盯看太久都会让对方睡着。随后它就游近，吞食梦境。
author: sk372
source: The ink POKENAME sprays can cause others to fall asleep if touched or looked at for too long. Once they fall asleep, POKENAME swims closer so it can feed itself on their dreams.

entry: POKENAME把梦变成蜂蜜进食。有些人醒来，会发现耳鼻正滴着蜂蜜。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME eats by transforming dreams into honey. Some people awake with honey dripping out of their ears and nose.

entry: POKENAME从附肢释放精神波，让人入睡，再附在人身上吃梦。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME releases psychic waves from its appendages to lull people to sleep. It latches onto people while they are sleeping to consume their dreams.

entry: POKENAME会变出舒适的床和枕头等幻象道具，诱人入睡，好吃掉梦境。谁不肯上床睡觉，它就扇谁一巴掌。
author: frokachu
source: By creating illusionary props like comfy beds and pillows, POKENAME can lull others to sleep so it can eat their dreams. It slaps anyone who refuses to go to bed.

entry: POKENAME在开阔水域横冲直撞，寻找大群目标，从口中发射特殊的催眠能量束。等对方被强制催眠，它就大吃梦境。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME rampages through open waters, seeking out large groups to fire a special beam of hypnotic energy from its mouth. Once they have been forcibly lulled to sleep, it gorges itself on their dreams.

entry: 据说，POKENAME很擅长帮助反复做噩梦的人。只要站到POKENAME面前，它就能变成噩梦中的对象，让许多人逐渐面对夜间的恐惧，重获安眠。
author: faeflame
source: POKENAME are said to be excellent when helping those with recurring nightmares. Standing in front of POKENAME allows them to transform into the subject of the bad dream. This has helped many come to terms with night terrors and find peaceful sleep.

entry: POKENAME在20世纪90年代曾很受欢迎，但消费者越来越重视画面精细程度，它也逐渐过时。
author: kiwiarms
source: Though it was popular in the 90s, POKENAME has fallen out of fashion as graphical fidelity has become more important to consumers.

entry: 长鼻能闻出其他宝可梦的梦。靠这种感知，即使在漆黑的水下洞穴中也能辨路。
author: snescontroller
source: Its trunk can smell the dreams of other Pokémon. It uses this sense to navigate underwater caves in pitch darkness.

entry: POKENAME生性懒惰，大多干脆吃自己的梦，若无人打扰就一连睡几天。失眠的个体会极其烦躁。
author: bigblue
source: Because of its slothful nature, most POKENAME simply eat their own dreams, sleeping for days at a time if undisturbed. POKENAME with insomnia exhibit tremendous frustration.

entry: POKENAME心地善良，长期被认为只是传说。但研究发现，它们常藏在别人的梦里，存在因此得到证实。
author: yourfriendlycap
source: A benevolent creature, POKENAME were believed to have been a myth for the longest time. Their existence was proven, however, when studies showed they commonly hid in the dreams of others.

entry: POKENAME不自己筑巢，而是抢别人的。它制造、散播会让皮肤轻微不适的粉末，阻止别人进入领地。
author: bobosmith01
source: Instead of creating a nest of its own, POKENAME steals the nests of others. It creates and spreads a powder that causes mild skin irritation to deter others from entering its territory.

entry: POKENAME淘气又自私，只想着下一餐梦。无论别人正在做什么、会造成什么后果，它都会悄悄接近、使其入睡，只为满足吃梦的饥饿。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is impish and selfish, only thinking in terms of its next meal of dreams. It will sneak up on others to put them to sleep, no matter what they may be doing and what the consequences will be, just to sate its hunger for their dreams.

entry: POKENAME用叶子释放的香气帮别人入睡，再用小巧的鼻子吸取人和宝可梦的梦中能量。
author: fiordaliso
source: It uses the aromas released by its leaf to help others fall asleep. With its small trunk, POKENAME can absorb the energy from the dreams of both Pokémon and humans.

entry: 吸入POKENAME花朵散出的花粉，会做奇异的梦。它以梦为食，似乎最爱令人困惑的梦。
author: hophoppip
source: The pollen emitted by POKENAME's flower induces bizarre dreams when inhaled. POKENAME feeds on dreams, and seems to enjoy confusing ones the most.

entry: 它吃到噩梦时，背上火焰会发出浓烈紫光。其他梦则会让火焰泛蓝光。
author: .izik
source: When it eats a nightmare, the flame on its back glows an intense violet. Any other dream causes the flame to glow blue.

entry: 它吃独角虫等小型虫属性宝可梦。鼻子能抓握小物件。
author: bobosmith01
source: It eats small Bug-type Pokémon such as Weedle. Its trunk is prehensile and allows it to grip small objects.

entry: POKENAME夜里探索城镇村庄，纤细的身体便于溜进住处，大吃熟睡的人和宝可梦的梦。
author: kam_doodle_snek
source: POKENAME explores towns and villages at night. Its slim body allows it to enter homes with ease, where it feasts on the dreams of sleeping people and Pokémon.

entry: 它远远观看别人的梦时，眼睛会泛蓝光。这能力持续不久，必须休息后才能再用。
author: .izik
source: Its eyes glow blue when remotely viewing someone's dream. This ability is short-lived, requiring rest before it can be used again.

entry: POKENAME专注越久，雾状冠羽就越大，附近宝可梦也越困。在旁边睡倒的小型宝可梦，会被扫回它的巢，身体安然无恙，梦却已被吃光。
author: bobosmith01
source: The longer POKENAME focuses, the larger its mist-like crests grow, and the sleepier nearby Pokémon feel. Smaller Pokémon that fall unconscious around it are swept back up to POKENAME's nest, safe and sound, but with their dreams devoured.

entry: 古代女巫把这种宝可梦的羽毛用在头饰上，声称能在睡眠中获知敌人的秘密。这习俗仍带着浓厚的民间传说色彩。
author: .izik
source: Ancient witches used feathers from this Pokémon in headdresses, claiming it allowed them to learn secrets from their enemies during sleep. This practice remains steeped in folklore.

entry: POKENAME在熟睡者旁缓慢扇翅。有人说，一察觉噩梦，动作就会加剧，仿佛想将噩梦赶走。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME flaps its wings slowly while near a sleeping person. Some say the movement intensifies if it detects a nightmare, as if trying to ward it off.

entry: 这种宝可梦的羊毛能做睡帽，帮助安睡。人们曾以为只是传说，如今已证实确有其效。
author: .izik
source: The fleece from this Pokémon is used to make nightcaps, aiding restful sleep. Once thought to be myth, this practice has been proven true.

entry: POKENAME用超能力移动掉落的羽毛，让它们缓缓起伏，使观看者恍惚入迷。吃一个梦，便足以让它全速飞上一整天。
author: fiordaliso
source: Using its psychic powers, it moves the feathers that have fallen from its wings, giving them a slow, undulating motion that lulls observers into a trance. After feeding on a dream, POKENAME has enough energy to fly at full speed for an entire day.

entry: POKENAME在屋内滋生，夜里现身吃人们的梦。鼻子能从数英里外，闻出谁在做噩梦。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME will infest houses, emerging at night to consume people's dreams. Their noses can sniff out someone having a nightmare from miles away.

entry: 它飞行时排出粉红气体，形成让人产生逼真白日梦的雾。身处其中的对象，常在朦胧间忘了时间。
author: .izik
source: It expels a pink gas while flying, creating a fog that induces vivid daydreams. Those exposed often lose track of time in the haze.

entry: 睡前还好好的，醒来却感冒，很可能是POKENAME夜里来过。它用梦中取得的能量，帮体弱宝可梦在寒夜保暖。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: If you go to bed feeling fine and wake up with a cold, there's a good chance POKENAME has visited you in the night. It uses the energy it harnesses from dreams to help frail Pokémon stay warm on cold nights.

entry: POKENAME以繁复的求偶仪式闻名。每对伴侣都有独特的舞蹈，还会收集心爱的食物与小饰物，在中央堆好。仪式若成功，这堆东西竟会变成一颗蛋！
author: faeflame
source: POKENAME are known for their intricate mating rituals. Each dance performed is unique to the mating pair and involves gathering favourite foods and baubles to be placed in a central pile. If the ritual is successful, the pile transforms into an egg!

entry: 它靠敏锐感官寻找梦里满是恐惧的熟睡者，找到后，便轻轻啃咬太阳穴，品尝噩梦。
author: .izik
source: It uses its sharp senses to locate sleepers whose dreams are filled with fear. Once it finds a target, it nibbles softly at their temple to savor their nightmares.

entry: POKENAME先让受害者睡着，再飘在上方吸收生命精华。在它身边醒来，被视为极坏的预兆。
author: .izik
source: After lulling victims to sleep, POKENAME floats above them to absorb their life essence. Waking up near one is considered a terrible omen.

entry: 这些宝可梦成群绕着熟睡者的头漂浮，拼出单词，似乎在吃梦。POKENAME拼出的内容，似乎直接对应对方所梦见的事。
author: santon5512
source: Groups of these Pokémon hover around and circle the heads of sleeping people, spelling out words as they seemingly feast on their dreams. The words POKENAME spell out seem to directly correlate with what the person is dreaming about.

entry: POKENAME的两颗头都吃梦。主头只吃美梦，后头却吞噬噩梦，牙齿咬合声通常还会将熟睡者吵醒。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's two heads both feed on dreams. The main head only eats pleasant dreams, but the rear head will devour nightmares, with the snapping of its teeth usually waking the sleeper up.

entry: POKENAME身上的毒刺极危险。它利用这点吓唬许多水手，让他们做关于自己的噩梦，再跟回家，把噩梦吃掉。
author: k1n1t0.xo
source: The toxic quills on POKENAME's body are highly dangerous. It uses this information to scare many sailors into having nightmares of it, follows the sailors home, and then eats their bad dreams.

entry: POKENAME用长鼻从蜂巢取蜜，弄得乱糟糟地舀进掌中。吃饱后，它会用剩余蜂蜜制造怪雾，让附近所有对象都做美梦。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME use their long noses to collect honey from hives, messily scooping it into their paws. After they've eaten their fill, they will use any remaining honey to create a strange mist that ensures sweet dreams for everyone nearby.

entry: POKENAME催眠训练家和宝可梦，使其入睡。吃完梦后，自己也会加入，打个短盹。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME hypnotizes Trainers and Pokémon to put them to sleep. Once it has finished eating their dreams, it joins them in a brief nap.

entry: POKENAME压扁背上的软壳，挤过开着的窗，进去吃梦。若觉得你的梦格外美味，就会想住到床底。
author: oddwalls
source: It flattens the soft shell on its back to squeeze through open windows and feed on dreams. If POKENAME finds your dreams particularly delicious, it will try to live under your bed.

entry: 它的毒液会在体内滞留数月，让受害者每次睡觉都做逼真的噩梦。这残酷效果使它在野外令人畏惧。
author: .izik
source: Its venom lingers in the body for months, causing vivid nightmares whenever the victim sleeps. This cruel effect ensures it is feared in the wild.

entry: 有人见过POKENAME吞食熟睡的沃特拉及周围宝可梦的梦境。它在水中游动，让附近的宝可梦都惶恐不安。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME has been spotted eating the dreams of sleeping Worterra and Pokémon around it. It swims around, causing terror to every Pokémon around it.

entry: POKENAME强壮的长鼻常漏出一种物质，类似合众原产的食梦梦所释放的梦的烟雾。雾的颜色取决于它最近吃了什么。
author: bobosmith01
source: Their powerful trunks often leak a substance similar to the Dream Mist that the Unova-native Munna emits. The color of this mist varies depending on what POKENAME have recently eaten.

entry: POKENAME用颈部扩张处的花纹催眠猎物。等猎物睡着，便吃它的梦。
author: jkalenad
source: Using the patterns on its hood, POKENAME hypnotizes its prey. Once the prey falls asleep, POKENAME feeds on its dreams.

entry: 吃下POKENAME的蛋能治好普通感冒，却也会连续一周做关于宝可梦的逼真怪梦。因此许多人宁愿自己好起来，也不愿收下它送的礼物。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME's egg can cure the common cold if eaten. However, eating it also causes a week of vivid and bizarre dreams about Pokémon, so many people prefer to heal on their own rather than accept the present that POKENAME offers.

entry: POKENAME最爱的零食是美梦。若误吃噩梦，就会发脾气，通常把做梦者吵醒。
author: atlas3339098
source: POKENAME's favorite snacks are pleasant dreams. If it eats a nightmare by mistake, it'll throw a tantrum, which usually wakes the dreamer up.

entry: POKENAME以梦为食，口味却很挑。让人入睡后，它伸出大舌舔一下，试试梦的味道；若不合口味，就留对方继续睡。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME feeds on dreams, but has very discerning tastes. After putting someone to sleep, it extends a large tongue to lick them, sampling their dream's flavor; if the taste isn't palatable, POKENAME leaves them to their slumber.

entry: POKENAME夜里在住处间快速穿行，吃许多人的梦。它会避开同类狩猎的区域，免得重复挑中目标。
author: corra_universe
source: POKENAME travel quickly between houses at night to eat the dreams of many people. They avoid areas where other POKENAME hunt to prevent repeat targets.

entry: POKENAME记得吃过的每一个梦。年长个体有时会把梦境与自己的记忆混淆。
author: corra_universe
source: POKENAME remembers every dream it eats. Older individuals sometimes confuse dreams as their own memories.

entry: POKENAME会从长鼻放出催眠气体，有时为自卫，有时只是打喷嚏。小刺的毒液能使感官迟钝，因此用于制造某些药物。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME loose a soporific gas from their long snouts, be it for defense or because of a sneeze. The venom of their small barbs can dull the senses, so they have been used in the production of some medications.

entry: 只要与POKENAME对上眼，就被迫参加瞪眼比赛。等对手终于睡着，它便用鼻子吸出梦。
author: potatoforged
source: Anyone who makes eye contact with a POKENAME is forced into a staring contest. When its opponent eventually falls asleep, POKENAME sucks out their dreams with its trunk.

entry: POKENAME徘徊在许多人睡觉的建筑附近，张开头上大颚，吸食周围的梦。受它吃梦影响的人，往往无精打采、头昏脑涨。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME hang around buildings where many people sleep. They leave the large jaws on their head open, siphoning and feasting on the dreams of those nearby. People affected by POKENAME's dream-eating are often left lethargic and dizzy.

entry: POKENAME徘徊在许多人睡觉的建筑附近，张开头上大颚，吸食周围的梦。受它吃梦影响的人，往往无精打采、头昏脑涨。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME hang around buildings where many people sleep. They leave the large jaws on their head open, siphoning and feasting on the dreams of those nearby. People affected by POKENAME's dream-eating are often left lethargic and dizzy.

entry: POKENAME察觉灾难，就让附近的对象做预示灾祸的恐怖噩梦。用这种方式警告，难怪名声会如此糟糕。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: When POKENAME senses a disaster, it gives those nearby terrifying nightmares of what is to come. This method of warning has understandably given it a terrible reputation.

entry: POKENAME的鼻子总指向最近的做梦者。它有时会被用来寻找失去意识的失踪者。
author: petratheangel
source: POKENAME's nose always points in the direction of the closest dreaming person. They're sometimes used to find unconscious missing persons.

entry: 被POKENAME的剑刃轻轻划伤，就会睡着。它随后将缎带搭在受害者脸上，吃掉对方的梦。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: A tiny cut from POKENAME's blade can put its opponent to sleep. Then it will place its ribbon on its victims face to eat their dreams.

entry: POKENAME常被请来帮助受噩梦困扰的人。它吃掉恶梦，让人安稳入睡。
author: melodydelune
source: Often used to help those suffering from nightmares, POKENAME feasts on the bad dreams, leaving them with restful sleep.

entry: POKENAME能同时闻见所有空间，因此始终晕头转向。每逢入睡，还会闻见所有其他熟睡宝可梦的梦。
author: rodotom
source: POKENAME is in a constant state of disorientation as it can smell all of space at once. Whenever it sleeps it also smells the dreams of all other sleeping Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME凭7根巨鼻，能同时吃掉整个街区的梦。梦被吃掉后，对方只会梦见自己飘在空荡荡的黑色虚空。
author: hophoppip
source: With its seven giant noses, POKENAME can consume the dreams of an entire neighborhood all at once. Those whose dreams are consumed by POKENAME are left dreaming of floating in an empty black void.

entry: POKENAME将影子触须变成合适的形状，模仿钟摆。若成功催眠谁，在控制期间，它只要求对方把自己当朋友。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME simulates a pendulum by shifting its shadow tendrils into the proper shape. If it manages to hypnotize another, all it asks for while they are under its influence is to treat it as if it were their friend.

entry: POKENAME没有眼睛，用大鼻子追踪气味。它能闻见人的梦，对方做梦时还会真咬上去，似乎连梦也一并吃掉，滋养自己。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Because it has no eyes, POKENAME uses its big nose to track scent. It can smell people's dreams, and will physically bite them when they are dreaming, which appears to eat the dream as well, nourishing POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME鼾声不断，睡在旁边出了名地难熬。更糟的是，它常学会自己溜出精灵球，偏爱直接趴在训练家脸上睡。
author: faeflame
source: POKENAME are prolific snorers and are notoriously difficult to sleep near. This is unfortunate, as they often learn to escape their Poké Ball, preferring to sleep directly on their Trainer's face.

entry: POKENAME释放催眠精神波，让对方犯困，却常连自己也中招。它梦见自己给其他宝可梦唱摇篮曲，可还没听到观众反应，就总会醒来。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME release somnolent psychic waves that cause drowsiness and often hit themselves with those waves as well. They dream of singing lullabies to other Pokémon but always wake before hearing the audience's reaction.

entry: POKENAME必须吃梦，尾焰才能继续燃烧。火焰明亮、噼啪作响，说明它刚吃饱一个格外美味的梦。
author: sk372
source: The flame on its tail requires the consumption of dreams in order to keep burning. A bright, crackling fire signifies a POKENAME that has just finished gorging itself on a particularly delicious dream.

entry: 它将手搭在熟睡者头上，就能吃梦，因此能同时吃两个梦，夜间狩猎格外高效。
author: .izik
source: By laying a hand on a sleeper's head, it consumes their dreams, making it capable of devouring two dreams at once. This makes it especially efficient during its nightly hunts.

entry: 它远远吃梦时，会缓慢、刻意地绕圈旋转。这奇特仪式，让幽灵般的它更添神秘魅力。
author: .izik
source: It spins in slow, deliberate circles while remotely consuming a dream. This peculiar ritual adds to its ghostly allure.

entry: POKENAME住在深谷，以过路冒险者的梦为食。筑巢时，专找附近营地旅人珍爱的纪念物，但原主已把这些东西忘得一干二净。
author: faeflame
source: POKENAME live in deep chasms and feed on wandering adventurers' dreams. When constructing their nests, they specifically locate sentimental items from travelers occupying nearby campsites. These items are forgotten entirely by the previous owner.

entry: 它吸收幸福的梦时，会开心地扇翅。若感知可怕的梦，就立即停下，逃离此处。
author: .izik
source: It flaps its wings joyfully while absorbing happy dreams. If it senses a scary dream it immediately stops and flees the area.

entry: 直视POKENAME的宝石眼睛，就会着迷。有时整镇的人都会跟着它走上数小时，直到效果消退。
author: petratheangel
source: POKENAME's gemstone eyes are mesmerizing to anyone that look directly at them. Sometimes, whole towns of people will follow POKENAME around for hours, until the effect wears off.

entry: 每吃到格外美好的梦，它就会开心地喷出阵阵冷气。带霜的喜悦，让旁观者看着也开心。
author: .izik
source: It releases happy bursts of cold air whenever it eats a particularly good dream. This frosty joy makes it a delight to observe in action.

entry: POKENAME住在最深最暗的洞穴，吞食熟睡宝可梦的梦，还会趁人不备袭击。睡觉时，它们倒吊着，长鼻子轻轻颤动。
author: faeflame
source: POKENAME live in the deepest and darkest caves. They feed on sleeping Pokémon's dreams and attack when least expected. Their long noses quiver when they sleep, dangling upside down.

entry: POKENAME从蘑菇释放催眠孢子，让猎物沉睡，再吃它们的梦。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME releases hypnotic spores from its mushroom that put its prey into a deep sleep. While they are asleep, it will feed on their dreams.

entry: POKENAME总想让训练家开心，好让对方做美梦。无聊时，就用精神力量玩小石子。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME always tries to keep its Trainer happy so they can have good dreams. When it's bored, it will play with small pebbles with its psychic powers.

entry: POKENAME十分体贴，会睡在训练家身旁，让对方梦见彼此一同玩耍的美好情景。它常被用作治疗宝可梦，帮助受夜惊困扰的人。
author: joeofthealps
source: Deeply compassionate Pokémon, POKENAME are known to sleep by their Trainer's side and give them pleasant dreams of the pair playing together. They are often used as therapy Pokémon for sufferers of night terrors.

entry: POKENAME的蘑菇虽美味，吃太多却会极度困倦。因此许多餐馆都会限制以它为原料的菜肴分量。
author: .izik
source: Although very delicious, POKENAME's mushroom can cause intense drowsiness if too much is consumed. Because of this, many restaurants limit the portion sizes of any dish that uses it as an ingredient.

entry: POKENAME触角震动的嗡嗡声，既可能让对方安然入睡，也可能引发难以忍受的头痛，全看它的心情。
author: stevethebarbarian
source: The droning noise made by POKENAME's vibrating antennae can lull one to peaceful sleep or induce crippling headaches depending on its mood.

entry: POKENAME是爱玩的恶作剧者，制造怪烟，让人看见奇异幻象。不过，它的笑声通常就会打破幻觉。
author: hophoppip
source: A playful trickster, it produces a strange smoke that causes humans to hallucinate strange things. These illusions are usually broken by the sound of POKENAME's laughter.

entry: POKENAME全身覆着细线般的糖丝，甜香诱人，吃下却会沉睡超过一整天，对周围全然不知。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body is covered in tiny thread-like strips of sugar. Though tempting to eat due to the sweet scent, doing so can cause one to fall asleep for over a full day, leaving them completely unaware of their surroundings.

entry: POKENAME的头发味道甜，像樱桃混巧克力。一舔，头发里的化学物质便会让食用者在几分钟内沉睡。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's hair has a sweet flavor: a mix of cherries and chocolate. If licked, a chemical in its hair causes the consumer to fall into a deep sleep within minutes.

entry: POKENAME用超能力使敌人入睡，再使出踢倒。攻击精准，常让对手无力反抗、毫无防备。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its psychic abilities to put foes to sleep before delivering a Low Kick. The strike is precise, often leaving opponents helpless and vulnerable.

entry: POKENAME的吃梦技巧还不精细，容易弄醒受害者。若吃到一半对方醒来，它就用头撞昏，再继续吃。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's dream-eating technique is a bit unrefined and has a tendency to wake up its victims. Should they awaken while it is eating, it knocks them out with a headbutt before continuing its meal.

entry: POKENAME在别的生物面前晃动尾焰，催眠其入睡，再大吃梦境，维持火焰燃烧。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME waves the flame on its tail in front of another being's face in order to hypnotize them to sleep. Once they've started slumbering, it feasts on their dream in order to keep its fire burning.

entry: POKENAME用尾焰催眠别人，等对方睡着，便吞食梦境，留下一场被火烧着的噩梦。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME hypnotize others with the flame on their tail until they fall asleep. Once asleep, POKENAME devour dreams and leave behind nightmares of being set ablaze.

entry: POKENAME挖地时会散发精神气场，让附近生物沉睡。若感知到美梦，就会停下来吃。
author: .izik
source: While digging, POKENAME emits a psychic aura that induces deep sleep in nearby creatures. If it senses a pleasant dream, it pauses to consume it.

entry: POKENAME耐心等在地下。人或宝可梦一靠近，就突然破土而出，用精神能量攻击。
author: petratheangel
source: POKENAME waits patiently underground for someone to pass by. When a person or Pokémon gets close, it pops out of the ground suddenly and attacks with psychic energy.

entry: POKENAME用头上硬币引人靠近，再用超能力催眠，偷走贵重物品。
author: petratheangel
source: POKENAME lure people in with the coin on its head. Once someone gets close enough POKENAME puts them to sleep with psychic powers and then steals their valuables.

entry: 专业培育家很追捧POKENAME。经过训练，它能给客人制造极尽奢华的梦境。
author: petratheangel
source: POKENAME are highly sought after by specialist breeders. POKENAME can be trained to create dreams of high luxury for clients.

entry: POKENAME催眠宝可梦和训练家，让对方做离奇古怪的梦。它虽然爱吃梦，吃太多却会偏头痛，可能持续数日。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME hypnotize Pokémon and Trainers into experiencing crazy and outlandish dreams. While they love to eat dreams, eating too many of them gives them migraines that can last days.

entry: 吸入POKENAME体内涌出的粉红雾，会陷入如梦恍惚。毛皮也会让许多人过敏。
author: bobosmith01
source: Inhaling the pink mist that comes out from POKENAME's body causes one to fall into a dreamlike trance. Its fur triggers allergic reactions in many people.

entry: POKENAME夜里沿湖岸摇摆行走，寻找窝里熟睡的宝可梦。找到后，就用短鼻吸走梦，一边吃，一边开心地呱呱叫。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME waddle along the shores of lakes at night, searching for Pokémon sleeping in their nests. When they find a sleeping Pokémon, they use their short trunk to siphon away the Pokémon's dream, croaking happily to themselves as they do.

entry: 对战时，POKENAME把手按在鼻前，奏出舒缓的摇篮曲。对手睡着的时间，足够它打上一两拳。
author: quackquackattack
source: During a Pokémon battle, POKENAME press their hands against their snouts to produce a soothing lullaby. The lullaby causes their opponent to fall asleep long enough to give them a punch or two.

entry: POKENAME吃完熟睡孩子最甜美的梦，会用柔嫩叶子挠孩子的鼻子。
author: bagumbothimble
source: POKENAME will use its delicate leaves to tickle the noses of sleeping children after eating their sweetest dreams.

entry: POKENAME让触手螺旋转动，使敌人入睡，再拖到海洋深处，吃梦吃到对方醒来，或溺水身亡。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME swirl their tentacles in a spiral motion, a movement able to put their foes to sleep. Once incapacitated, these Pokémon will drag them into the depths of the ocean, feasting on their dreams until they either wake up or drown.

entry: POKENAME游泳时，大半身体都在水下，只露出小鼻子呼吸。熟睡的宝可梦会吸引它们，聚在周围大吃梦境。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME swim with most of their body below the water, only their diminutive trunk poking above so that they can breathe. They are drawn toward sleeping Pokémon, crowding around them to feast on their dreams.

entry: POKENAME像催眠师的硬币一样来回摇摆。它能算出完美路线，因此摆动弧线总是平滑对称。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME sways back and forth like a coin from a hypnotist. Its arc is always smooth and symmetrical due to its ability to calculate the perfect path.

entry: POKENAME白天最活跃，吃北极冰面上熟睡的小海狮群的梦。夜里，小海狮出去捕猎，它就睡在同一片冰盖上。
author: anonymous_moose
source: POKENAME is most active during the daytime, subsisting on a diet of dreams eaten from herds of Seel sleeping atop the arctic ice. At night, it rests on those same ice sheets while the Seel are out hunting.

entry: POKENAME钻到人家屋底，趁人睡着吃梦。吃普通梦时，尾端岩石顺时针转；吃噩梦时，则逆时针转。
author: notmax22
source: POKENAME burrow underground and dig under the houses of people to consume their dreams while they're sleeping. The rocks on the end of their tail rotate clockwise whenever they consume a dream and counterclockwise when they consume a nightmare.

entry: POKENAME一半存在于此世，一半存在于梦中世界。它入梦时千万别抓住，因为可能不小心把你也带进去。
author: kiwiarms
source: POKENAME exists halfway between this world and the world of dreams. Be careful not to grab on to POKENAME as it enters a dream, because it may accidentally bring you with it.

entry: POKENAME极其珍视自己的摆锤。若拿到一枚偷来的摆锤，可要准备好被追捕——珍宝找不回来，它们绝不会罢休。
author: faeflame
source: POKENAME revere their pendulums with the utmost respect. If you come into possession of a stolen one prepare to be hunted as they will not stop until they are reunited with their precious object.

entry: POKENAME按催眠般的节奏敲动双钳，让敌人入睡。醒来的对象说，曾梦见轻柔海浪和阳光明媚的海岸，十分逼真。
author: theartemis1
source: POKENAME puts its enemies to sleep by clicking its pincers in a rhythmic, hypnotic pattern. Those who awaken from the trance have reported experiencing vivid dreams of gentle waves and sunlit shores.

entry: 它晃动鼻上的钟摆，催眠其他宝可梦，吃它们的梦。背上种子储存着梦的能量，为超能力供能。
author: fiordaliso
source: It swings the pendulum on its snout to hypnotize other Pokémon, feeding on their dreams. Inside the bulb on its back, it stores dream energy that fuels its psychic powers.

entry: POKENAME虽带着4个钟摆，催眠效果却不比未融合的引梦貘人好，因为小肢体很难摆动钟摆。
author: hophoppip
source: Despite carrying four pendulums, POKENAME's hypnosis is not more effective than that of an unfused Hypno, as its tiny limbs struggle to swing the pendulums.

entry: POKENAME不同的蛋负责不同自保任务，包括催眠、防御、逃跑和超能力进攻。只要有一颗与其他分离，它就无法正常行动。
author: sk372
source: The different eggs are responsible for different aspects of self-preservation, from hypnosis, defense, fleeing, and psychic offense. If even one is separated from the rest, POKENAME becomes unable to function properly.

entry: 一颗头睡觉时，另一颗会观察周围，再加上叶上悬着的多个催眠钟摆，几乎不可能悄悄接近它。
author: petratheangel
source: While one head sleeps, another keeps watch of its surroundings. This, combined with its many hypnotic pendulums swinging from its leaves, makes it nigh impossible to sneak up on.

entry: POKENAME唾液中的活性成分会使人沉睡。这样睡着的人，往往流着口水，梦见食物。
author: bandedbodypress
source: The active agent in POKENAME's saliva induces deep slumber. People who fall asleep this way can be seen salivating and dreaming about food.

entry: 这种宝可梦能产生极强催眠气体，有些POKENAME甚至帮助麻醉医师手术。但必须先训练数周，因为它可能让病人睡上数十小时。
author: _pixelar_
source: This Pokémon can produce a very potent sleeping gas, some POKENAME even being used by anesthesiologists during surgery. The Pokémon has to undergo weeks of training before it can help, as it could put the patients to sleep for dozens of hours.

entry: 虽然英文名让人想到角，POKENAME其实没有角，只有一个大鼻子。它绕小圈跑，将宝可梦聚拢，再借全身散布的金属反光，让它们入睡。
author: bradlybro199
source: Despite its name, POKENAME doesn't actually have a horn; instead having a large nose. They lull Pokémon to sleep by reflecting light from the bits of metal speckled throughout their body as they herd them by running in tight circles.

entry: POKENAME很护着袋里的硬币。若有谁想拿，就会立刻用超能力催眠小偷。
author: petratheangel
source: POKENAME is very protective of the coin it keeps in its pouch. If someone tries to take the coin, POKENAME will immediately put the thief to sleep with its psychic powers.

entry: POKENAME钟摆的线与藤蔓缠得解不开。它学会让藤蔓随钟摆扭动，形成强烈的催眠动作。
author: empty_set
source: The string from its pendulum has become inexorably tangled with its vines.  POKENAME has learned to writhe its vines along with the pendulum in a powerfully hypnotic motion.

entry: 这种宝可梦极其保护所有孩子，厌恶感到他们悲伤。若听说谁伤害孩子，就会让那个人再也做不了美梦。
author: quietcognition
source: This Pokémon is fiercely protective of all children, and hates to sense their sadness. If it catches wind that someone has harmed a child, it will ensure that the person never has a good dream again.

entry: POKENAME住在温暖海洋，用闪亮尾巴引来猎物。它借超能力辅助移动，在水中迅速游动。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME lives in warm oceans and uses its shiny tail to lure in prey. It augments its movement with its psychic powers to swiftly move in the water.

entry: 据说用POKENAME的毛填枕头，就会做美梦。它用翅膀迷惑捕食者，分散对方注意。
author: griddle
source: A POKENAME's fur is said to bring good dreams to those who stuff it in their pillow. It uses its wings to mesmerize and distract predators.

entry: POKENAME旋转整个身体，制造催眠视觉幻象。它们会成群一起旋转，迷惑捕食者。
author: petratheangel
source: POKENAME spins its entire body to create hypnotic optical illusions. Groups of POKENAME will spin together to confuse predators.

entry: POKENAME静静晃钟摆，催眠看着来回摆动的对象。它只需模仿睡着的动作，观众就会立刻昏睡。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME silently swings its pendulum, hypnotizing anyone who watches its movement back and forth. POKENAME only has to mime falling asleep to cause its audience to immediately pass out.

entry: POKENAME以奇怪却催眠般舒缓的方式摇摆，让看见的对象都睡着。与它对战，即使老练训练家也难让自己和宝可梦保持清醒。
author: biblecampvictim42069
source: POKENAME moves with a strange yet hypnotically soothing rocking motion that lulls all who watch it to sleep. In battles against POKENAME, even skilled Trainers struggle to keep themselves and their Pokémon awake.

entry: POKENAME的角融合成钟摆般形状。它将敌人的头困进环形角中，压迫颈部，直到对方入睡。
author: empty_set
source: Its horns have fused into a pendulum-like shape.  POKENAME traps foes' heads inside the circular horn and applies pressure to their neck until they fall asleep.

entry: POKENAME胡须上连着的金属硬币很沉，连跃出水面都十分吃力。
author: petratheangel
source: The metal coins attached to POKENAME's whiskers weigh it down. It's a struggle for it to simply breach the water's surface.

entry: POKENAME寻找草属性宝可梦，用尾上钟摆催眠，偏爱身上有大叶子的目标。等对方睡着，便吞食梦境。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME hunts for Grass-type Pokémon to hypnotize using the swinging pendulum on its tail, preferring targets with large leaves on their bodies. Once they fall asleep, it devours their dreams.

entry: 这种宝可梦唱起美妙得令人沉醉的歌，周围水中的小型宝可梦就会聚来。偶尔吸引到人类，POKENAME也会将人渡回岸边。
author: quietcognition
