source: When this Pokémon sings its hypnotically beautiful song, small Pokémon from the waters around it will flock around. On the rare occasion that this attracts a human, POKENAME will ferry them back to shore.

entry: 无论在网络空间内外，POKENAME都像被一只离体的手提着，如催眠钟摆般摇晃。每次想接触那只手，还没来得及了解什么，它就消失了。
author: sk372
source: In and out of cyberspace, POKENAME appears to be held by a disembodied hand, acting as a hypnotic pendulum to swing about. All attempts to interact with the hand itself result in it vanishing before anything of value can be learned.

entry: POKENAME攀在树侧，大部分时间都在睡觉。硬壳虽是主要防御，半睁睡眼的朦胧目光，也能让想捕食它的对象入睡。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME clings to the side of a tree and spends most of its time sleeping. Although its hard shell is its primary means of defense, the drowsy gaze of its half-open eyes can lull would-be predators to sleep.

entry: POKENAME精通催眠，能保持均衡作息，无论醒着还是休息都能吃。它醒时最好避开，因为它会催眠你，让你带更多食物来。
author: bigblue
source: Having mastered hypnosis, POKENAME is able to retain a balanced sleep schedule, eating both while awake and at rest. Avoid it while it's awake - it'll hypnotize you into bringing it more food.

entry: 它飞过空中，羽毛周围的水分化作细雪。沿途形成的雪花使人平静，甚至能带来极安稳的睡眠。
author: bandedbodypress
source: As it flies through the air, the moisture around its feathers turns into a light snow. Snowflakes formed in its wake are calming, even capable of producing a very restful slumber.

entry: POKENAME强大的超能力，能同时操控多个催眠钟摆。据说，一天就能轻松催眠整座城市的人。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's advanced psychic powers let it utilize multiple hypnotic pendulums at once. It is said it could easily hypnotize an entire city's worth of people in a day.

entry: 受到威胁时，POKENAME会从背上排出粉红雾。碰到就会睡着；它若生气，雾起效更快。
author: petratheangel
source: If threatened, POKENAME will expel a pink mist from its back. This mist puts anyone who touches it to sleep and acts faster if the POKENAME is angry.

entry: POKENAME将部分精神火焰导入钟摆，增强催眠能力。让目标进入催眠状态花的时间越久，身上的火焰就越接近熄灭。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME channels some of its psychic fire into its pendulum to boost its hypnotic abilities. The longer it takes to put its target under hypnosis, the more the flames on its body begin to burn out.

entry: POKENAME智力极高。研究者见过它利用钟摆的反光，将鱼引到水面捕食。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME is highly intelligent. Researchers have observed POKENAME using its pendulum to hunt, utilizing the reflective properties to attract fish to the water's surface.

entry: POKENAME睡着时，会把钟摆藏进羽毛深处。即使没有意识，仍警戒着远处声响。
author: .izik
source: While it sleeps, POKENAME tucks its pendulum deep within its feathers. Even unconscious, it remains alert to distant sounds.

entry: POKENAME的钟摆能悬在空中，通过蛛丝与身体相连。它倒吊到别人面前，来回摆动身体，发出催眠脉冲，让受害者入睡。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's pendulum can levitate in the air while remaining attached to it via webbing. It dangles down in front of others and swings its body back and forth, emanating a hypnotic pulse that sends the victim into a slumber.

entry: POKENAME始终从喙里伸出钟摆般的长舌。走路时轻轻摇晃，让附近生物昏昏欲睡。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME keeps its long, pendulum-like tongue extended from its beak at all times. It sways gently as it walks, lulling nearby creatures.

entry: POKENAME用天使之吻等招式、催眠能力，以及可爱顽皮的外表，把幼童引离父母。它会尽量长久地陪被带走的孩子玩。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME lures young children away from their parents through moves such as Sweet Kiss, its hypnotic abilities, and its outwardly cute and playful demeanor. It tries to play with those that it has spirited away for as long as they can.

entry: 家人在安全舒适的地方被催眠时，它会传递梦境邮件。对失去说写能力的老人而言，这是家人与他们保持联系的少数方式之一。
author: quackquackattack
source: It delivers Dream Mail when a family is hypnotized in a safe and comfortable space. For those who lose access to the ability to speak and write, this is one of the few ways family members can remain connected to elderly loved ones.

entry: POKENAME的舞蹈确实能催眠，连意志坚定的对象也会陷入恍惚。许多野生个体聚成群后，会有组织地攻击附近其他草属性宝可梦，建立明确的领地。
author: bobosmith01
source: Their dances are literally hypnotic and can throw even those with hardened wills into a trance. If many wild POKENAME are in one place and create a pack, they begin systematically attacking other nearby Grass-types and form a distinct territory.

entry: POKENAME本体一动不动，众多钟摆却各自摆动。看见它的对象会被催眠，以为只是一棵普通树。
author: petratheangel
source: POKENAME's many pendulums move independently of the stationary main body. It hypnotizes anyone who sees it into thinking it is an ordinary tree.

entry: POKENAME受到威胁就会甩尾，让目标入睡。受影响的对象，常会梦见奶酪。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME will swing their tails around when threatened, putting targets to sleep. Those affected by this will often dream about cheese.

entry: POKENAME飞得又快又灵活，几分钟就能催眠多个目标。它这般折腾，甚至让整座森林的宝可梦都被偷过食物。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's aerial speed and maneuverability is so great that it can hypnotize several targets in a few minutes. Entire forests worth of Pokémon have had their meals stolen from them due to POKENAME's antics.

entry: 与POKENAME长时间相处的对象，总是很快乐、很温顺。它曾被养在监狱，控制危险囚犯，但确认囚犯遭到洗脑后，这做法便被废止。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Those that spend significant time with POKENAME are always very happy and docile. They have been kept in prisons to keep dangerous prisoners under control, though this was scrapped when it was determined that they were being brainwashed.

entry: POKENAME性情悠闲，讨人喜欢。现已证实，只需站在旁边，就有助放松。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME is well-liked for its laid-back demeanor. Just standing near it has been proven to aid in relaxation.

entry: 它能从额头圆环投射钟摆影像，其中充满精神能量，用来催眠敌人。满月之夜，力量增强，能同时投出多个钟摆。
author: sk372
source: It can project a pendulum image from the circle on its forehead, full of psychic energy for hypnotizing foes. On full moon nights, its power grows enough to project multiple pendulum images at once.

entry: POKENAME夜里游荡，寻找新鲜的梦吃。鲜艳羽衣引来许多目光，也让大家看见它带的催眠钟摆，随即沉睡。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME prowls during the night, looking for a fresh meal of another's dreams. Its bright, feathered coat causes many to look at it, and, thus, the hypnotic pendulum they carry, causing the beholders to fall into a deep sleep.

entry: POKENAME靠近别人，等对方睡着便吃梦。梦能滋养、刺激头脑，吃得越多，智力越高。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME gets close to others in order to feast upon their dreams when they sleep. Doing this nourishes its mind, stimulating it and increasing its intellect as it consumes more dreams.

entry: 一与POKENAME对上视线，就已落入精神控制。受害者会说无意义的胡话，但脱离后，谁都不记得自己当时想传达什么。
author: sk372
source: If one matches their gaze with POKENAME, they're already caught in its psychic grasp. Victims speak a nonsensical gibberish language while under its sway, but after being free, none remember what they were trying to communicate.

entry: 后头摇动的钟摆，能迅速催眠所有看见的对象。前头便靠近熟睡者的头，用鼻孔深深吸气，吃掉梦境。
author: .jerden
source: The pendulum the rear head swings can hypnotize anyone that sees it, quickly lulling them to sleep. The front head will then approach to feed on dreams, by getting close to the sleeper's head and inhaling deeply through its nostrils.

entry: 这种融合体靠细线吊在树上。被发现后，就会像钟摆一样轻轻摇晃，让袭击者入睡。
author: evilscarypurple
source: This fusion hangs from trees by a thin thread. When spotted, it will gently sway in a pendulum motion in order to lull attackers to sleep.

entry: POKENAME用角催眠附近的赫拉克罗斯，再命令它们撬开树皮，自己不费什么体力，就能吃到下面的树液。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses its horn to hypnotize Heracross it leaves near to. Once under its thrall, it commands them to pry bark from trees so that it can get the sap beneath with minimal physical exertion.

entry: POKENAME连最遥远的人的梦都能闻见。为了吃最香的梦，无论城市、高山还是森林，即使最猛烈的暴风雪也会穿越。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME has the ability to smell the dreams of even the most faraway of people. Cities, mountains, forests: it will trek through all of these even in the harshest of blizzards to feed on the most aromatic dreams.

entry: POKENAME行动虽慢，背上钟摆般的石头却会让观看者倦怠无比。附近所有对象，最后都移动得和它一样慢。
author: empty_set
source: Despite how slowly it moves, the pendulum-like rock on POKENAME's back makes anyone observing it feel intensely lethargic.  Everyone nearby ends up moving just as slowly as POKENAME does.

entry: 野生POKENAME常用催眠术，强迫意志薄弱者听命。尽管如此，关都和城都的人们仍会寻找它，看重出众的视力、智慧、心灵感应和推理本领。
author: pkbonusducks
source: Wild POKENAME often use Hypnosis to force the weak-willed to do their bidding. Regardless, people across Kanto and Johto seek POKENAME for their incredible vision, wisdom, telepathic prowess, and deduction skills.

entry: POKENAME凭大鼻子的灵敏嗅觉，在土里寻找特定蘑菇。吃下的真菌，能暂时增强超能力和催眠本领。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's large nose gives it a strong sense of smell, which it uses to seek out specific types of mushrooms in the dirt. The fungi it eats temporarily enhance its psychic powers and hypnotic capabilities.

entry: POKENAME受惊时，可能摇尾，让钟摆般的突起左右晃动。经验丰富的个体会故意这么做，让猎物或捕食者犯困。
author: bobosmith01
source: When startled, it may rattle its tail, causing the pendulum-like growth to shift back and forth. Experienced POKENAME do this on purpose to make prey, or predators, feel drowsy.

entry: POKENAME很爱玩，喜欢用长鼻猛晃钟摆，有时会不小心打到同伴。
author: hophoppip
source: Playful POKENAME loves to swing its pendulum wildly with its trunk. It sometimes accidentally strikes its allies with the pendulum.

entry: 它细微而快速地移动鹿角，让悬着的钟摆震动。不同的震动和频率，能让受害者陷入不同的恍惚状态。
author: sk372
source: It subtly and rapidly shifts its antlers to vibrate the pendulums hanging off of them. Differing vibrations and frequencies allow for it to put its victims into different types of trances.

entry: POKENAME从钟摆滴落彩墨，标记领地。每种颜色都传达不同情绪或警告。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME marks territory by dripping multicolored ink from its pendulum. Each hue signals a different emotion or warning.

entry: 还是催眠新手，喜欢把别人弄睡着来恶作剧。可催眠效果很弱，几分钟便会消退。
author: jackythewannabe
source: A novice hypnotist, it pranks others by putting them to sleep. Its trances are so weak that they wear off in mere minutes.

entry: POKENAME闪动胸前花纹，让敌人吓得动弹不得，再慢慢晃动尾上钟摆。被吓僵的受害者，更容易接受催眠暗示。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME paralyze their foes with fear by flashing the patterns on their chest before slowly waving the pendulums on their tails. The victims of their paralysis are even more susceptible to hypnotic suggestions.

entry: 喝POKENAME的奶会犯困，因此它的奶在失眠者中很畅销。
author: lydiaprower8
source: Drinking POKENAME's milk can make the consumer drowsy, so its milk has a popular market with insomniacs.

entry: 若POKENAME用脸颊蹭你，你就会忍不住听从命令，持续约15分钟。它在草特别高的地方筑巢。
author: bobosmith01
source: If POKENAME rubs its cheeks against you, you will feel compelled to listen to its commands for around 15 minutes. It makes nests in areas with particularly tall grass.

entry: POKENAME拨动怀表指针，就能穿梭时间。若有人弄坏珍贵的表，它会凶狠攻击肇事者；除此之外，很少与别人来往。
author: _pixelar_
source: POKENAME have the ability to time travel by moving the hands of their pocket watches. When someone breaks their precious watch, they become aggressive and begin to attack the one responsible, but other than that, they rarely interact with others.

entry: POKENAME收集废手机，在屏幕上投射催眠影像，让训练家入睡。若看见训练家深夜还玩手机，就改将画面信号送到对方手机，吃掉梦境。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME collects discarded phones and projects hypnotic images on them to lull Trainers to sleep. If a POKENAME sees a Trainer up late on their phone, it will send the signal of the display onto their phone instead and eat their dreams.

entry: POKENAME用闪亮钟摆，将猎物引进丛林深处。猎杀后，还会用遗骸作肥料种树。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: POKENAME uses its shimmering pendulum to lure prey deep into the jungle. Once it has dispatched its prey, it uses the remains as fertiliser to grow trees.

entry: POKENAME背上的大刺，曾被磨成细粉作助眠剂。如今，这种做法被认为很危险。
author: .izik
source: The large spines on POKENAME's back were once ground into fine dust and used as sleep aids. The practice is now considered dangerous.

entry: POKENAME自视为湿地守护者。栖息地一受威胁，它就催眠训练家，驱使对方赶走威胁。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME considers itself a wetland protector. Whenever its habitat is endangered, it will hypnotize Trainers to ward off whatever the threat is.

entry: POKENAME旋身舞动，周围观众瞥见钟摆就会被催眠，一直看到最后。谢幕鞠躬时，观众集体入睡，正好让它吃梦。
author: sk372
source: As it dances and twirls, those around it will catch glimpses of its pendulum and be hypnotized, watching the performance to the end. When POKENAME bows at the finale, its audience falls into a collective slumber, ripe for dream-eating.

entry: POKENAME受遭创伤的人吸引，用催眠治疗帮助心理康复。若病人受威胁，它会令敌人失去理智，将其彻底摧垮。
author: ghostslythe
source: Drawn to traumatized individuals, POKENAME uses hypnotherapy to aid with their psychological recovery. If its patient is threatened, it will destroy the foe by making them lose their sanity.

entry: POKENAME头上的光环，是强力催眠装置，几秒就能使中招者睡着。据说，它会吃掉每个被催眠者的一片灵魂。
author: sk372
source: The halo over POKENAME's head is a powerful hypnotic device that puts those under its spell to sleep in seconds. It is said to consume a piece of the soul of anyone it sends into slumber.

entry: 许多旧货店老板劝客人别买老八音盒，因为可能有POKENAME附身。它趁受害者睡觉时纠缠，循环播放诡异摇篮曲，直到对方再也醒不来。
author: bigoljax
source: Many thrift shop owners warn customers to not buy old music boxes due to the chance of them being haunted by a POKENAME. It haunts victims while they sleep, playing an eerie lullaby on loop until the victim is unable to wake up.

entry: POKENAME精于超能力，也是一位武器大师。它用精神技巧分散、扰乱对手，再凭身手和链枷打出重击。
author: nyoomymph
source: POKENAME is a skilled psychic and a weapons master. It uses its mental skills to distract and disorient its opponent while it uses its physical abilities and flails to deal heavy hits.

entry: POKENAME的花完全开放，催眠气体能不断释放。接触太久，会陷入难以唤醒的沉睡。
author: atlas3339098
source: POKENAME's flower has fully opened, allowing continuous access to its sleeping gas. Prolonged exposure causes deep sleep that is difficult to wake from.

entry: POKENAME狡黠爱恶作剧，用钟摆催眠，引来猎物。但它只猎食比自己大的，因为它十分保护小型宝可梦，也想确保食物够分。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are devious tricksters, luring in prey by hypnotizing them with their pendulums. However, they only go after prey larger than themselves, as they are fiercely protective of smaller Pokémon and want to make sure they have enough to share.

entry: POKENAME最多能同时催眠10个敌人。它不亲自作战，而是指挥受控的对手互相打斗。
author: oddwalls
source: POKENAME is able to hypnotize up to ten foes at once. Rather than fight the entranced opponents itself, it directs them to fight each other.

entry: POKENAME常在墓葬周围出现，阻止小偷和盗墓者。它旋转身体，用头和硬币形成催眠图案。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME often appear around burial sites to deter would-be thieves and grave robbers. They spin around, creating a hypnotizing pattern with their head and coin.

entry: POKENAME通过梦境操纵心智，让受害者相信它是神。再睡一轮后，效果就会消退，受害者便会识破幻象。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME manipulates minds through dreams, convincing victims it is divine. The effect fades after the next sleep cycle, revealing the illusion.

entry: POKENAME一生大多在睡觉，偶尔才会移动，追随阳光。背上仿佛熔化怀表的东西，其实是特化的叶片，能吸收大量光，让它以此为食。
author: _pixelar_
source: POKENAME spend most of their lives sleeping, only rarely being seen moving to follow the sunlight. What look like melting watches on their backs are in reality adapted leaves that can absorb a large amount of light that acts as food for the Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME一生大多在睡觉，偶尔才见移动。背上仿佛熔化怀表的东西，其实是能吸收大量阳光的特化叶片，还启发了著名画作。
author: _pixelar_
source: POKENAME spend most of their lives sleeping, only rarely being seen moving. What look like melting watches on their backs are in reality adapted leaves that can absorb a large amount of sunlight. Their strange leaves have inspired famous paintings.

entry: 这只巨鼻生物会凭灵敏嗅觉闻疗愈熏香。深深吸一口，既让头脑清明，也让鼻子通畅。
author: xenophacilus
source: This massive-snouted creature uses its superior nose to smell healing incense. By breathing in deeply, it clears both its mind and its nose.

entry: POKENAME用敏锐的鼻子嗅探潜意识，寻找能做出优质梦境的对象。再用摆锤催眠，吸入他们的梦。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME sniffs outs the subconscious of quality dreamers using its sharp nose. It then puts them to sleep with its pendulum and inhales their dreams.

entry: POKENAME边走边慢慢旋转，一把刃像钟摆，另一把像时针。看见的对象会睡着，连梦都没有。
author: beatdoof
source: POKENAME rotates slowly as it moves, one blade swinging like a pendulum and the other like a clock's hour hand. Those who see it will fall asleep, bereft of dreams.

entry: POKENAME有多危险，可从钟摆盾镜面般的光泽看出。巨刃一斩，就足以让敌人永远沉睡，独眼则冷酷地欣赏这命运。
author: beatdoof
source: The sheer danger of POKENAME can be measured by the mirror-like polish of its pendulum shield. A single slash from its massive blade is enough to cast enemies into an eternal slumber, a fate its solitary eye watches with callous delight.

entry: POKENAME的大鼻子滴落浓稠黏液，带有强毒。一滴就能麻痹小猎物。
author: .izik
source: Thick mucus drips from POKENAME's large nose, laced with potent poison. A single drop can paralyze small prey.

entry: POKENAME凭透视眼看进受害者心里，利用猎物的恐惧和不安。摇尾催眠后，便让对方做可怕噩梦。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: With its X-ray vision, POKENAME sees into its victims' minds. It uses this to exploit the fears and insecurities of its prey, giving them terrible nightmares once they fall asleep from its swinging tail.

entry: POKENAME溜进波士可多拉的领地，等最佳时机催眠，让它抛弃原家园，自己便能不战而取。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME sneaks into the domains of Aggron and waits for the perfect moment to hypnotize it, making it abandon its former home so POKENAME can take it without a fight.

entry: POKENAME会在医院帮助病人入睡。摆锤挥动得越久，患者睡得也越久。
author: melodydelune
source: POKENAME is used in hospitals to help put patients to sleep; the longer they swing their pendulums, the longer the patients remain asleep.

entry: POKENAME深夜巡游领地，警戒闯入者。若发现有人越界，就摇钟摆催眠，再扔到家园边界外。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME roam their territories late at night, keeping a watchful eye out for any intruders. If they find someone encroaching on their borders, they swing their pendulum and put them to sleep before tossing them out beyond the bounds of their home.

entry: POKENAME用目光和钟摆催眠人。训练家发现，它能精确控制受害者梦见什么，却通常只让对方做噩梦。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME uses its gaze and its swinging pendulum to lull people to sleep. Trainers with a POKENAME have discovered that it has precise control over exactly what its victim will dream about, but will usually only cause nightmares.

entry: POKENAME将其他宝可梦逼到角落，眼睛开始呈现催眠螺旋。等对手完全睡着，就用炮管积蓄精神能量，朝失去意识的敌人开火。
author: bigoljax
source: As they corner another Pokémon, POKENAME's eyes start to mimic a hypnotic swirl. When their opponents are fully asleep, POKENAME charge up psychic energy with their cannons and fire on their unconscious foe.

entry: 摆锤用于近身搏斗，而非催眠。另一只手臂上的蓝花会释放气味，催眠虚弱的猎物。
author: patch_bros
source: It uses the pendulums for physical combat rather than hypnosis. The blue flower on its other arm releases a scent used for hypnotizing weakened prey.

entry: POKENAME的头随钟摆节奏晃动。目标一被催眠，它就踢出足以碎骨的攻击。
author: ghostslythe
source: POKENAME's head bobs to the rhythmic swing of its pendulum. When its target is hypnotized, it kicks hard enough to shatter bone.

entry: 它用线吊着奇怪蘑菇挥舞，将孢子散进空气。吸入者会被催眠，让POKENAME能吞食生命能量。
author: hophoppip
source: It waves an odd mushroom around on a string, scattering its spores in the air. Those who inhale the spores are lulled to sleep, allowing POKENAME to feed on their life energy.

entry: POKENAME住在人家里，几乎从不被发现。它悄悄篡改电视节目传递的信息，让受害者困惑、形成错误信念。民间流传着一种说法，认为四天王故意将它们安置在住处。
author: inquis1
source: POKENAME live in homes almost entirely unnoticed. There, they subtly change the messages in their TVs' programming, leading their victims to confusion and false beliefs. There is a popular belief that the Elite Four plant them in homes deliberately.

entry: POKENAME织出的网带有催眠作用，任何东西落进网丝，片刻间就会沉睡。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME weaves webs infused with sleep-inducing properties. Anything caught in the strands falls into a deep slumber within moments.

entry: POKENAME靠超能力悬在半空，来回摇摆。它用中央钟摆引导目标视线，在另两个钟摆间移动，确保彻底催眠。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME rocks back and forth, suspended in midair by its psychic powers. It uses its middle pendulum to guide the target's eyes back and forth between the other two, making sure they are thoroughly hypnotized.

entry: POKENAME产生的神秘火焰，将奇怪的浮空钟摆照成无数眩目图案。盯得太久，就会看得出神，连逃跑都想不起来。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: The mysterious flames that POKENAME produce illuminate their odd floating pendulums in a myriad of dazzling patterns. Anyone that stares too long at this display will become transfixed, unable to even think of escape.

entry: 它的环和钟摆由未知金属制成。对弱敌就催眠，命令离开；对强敌，则把钟摆当钝器猛打。
author: sk372
source: Its rings and pendulum are made out of an unknown type of metal. It hypnotizes weaker foes and orders them to leave; against stronger foes it uses the pendulum as a bludgeoning tool.

entry: POKENAME常找催眠师和魔术师，加入表演，想得到许多人的喜爱。它的硬币是假的，无法转动。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME often seek out hypnotists and magicians to join their act and thus be loved by many people. The coin it has is a fake, and cannot be spun around.

entry: POKENAME的钟摆白天吸收阳光，为火焰攻击供能。黄昏和战斗前，钟摆会微微发光。
author: .izik
source: During the day, POKENAME's pendulums absorb sunlight to power its fire-based attacks. They glow faintly at dusk and before battle.

entry: POKENAME战斗时毫不留情。先用长触手抓住对手，再用摆锤使其入睡。
author: thefinalkalgonus
source: POKENAME is merciless during a fight. It grabs its opponent with one of its long tentacles then uses its pendulum to put it to sleep.

entry: 被逼入绝境时，它会摆动钟摆般的尾巴，配合眩目毛皮扰乱敌人，直到对方睡着，再高声尖叫，召来其他同伴。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: If cornered, it will swing its pendulum tail until its foe falls asleep, dazzling fur assisting in disorientation. Then, it will summon the rest of its pack with a loud screech.

entry: POKENAME尾上的钟摆帮它集中精神、引导电流。钟摆有节奏地晃动，火花沿毛皮渐渐积聚。
author: .izik
source: The pendulum on POKENAME's tail helps it focus and channel electricity. It swings rhythmically as sparks build up along its fur.

entry: POKENAME晃钟摆时，会低声唱摇篮曲，增强催眠能力，再吃对方的梦。被催眠者醒来，曲调仍在脑海挥之不去。
author: sk372
source: When swinging its pendulum, POKENAME sings a lullaby in a low voice, enhancing its capability to put something to sleep before it eats their dreams. Those who've been hypnotized wake up with the lullaby stuck in their head.

entry: POKENAME背上花朵的香气极其舒缓。敌视训练家的对象，很快就会失去一切战意。
author: .jerden
source: The fragrance from the flower on POKENAME's back is incredibly soothing. Anyone hostile to its Trainer will quickly find themselves losing any desire to fight.

entry: POKENAME还在发展催眠能力，在别人面前笨拙地晃钟摆。催眠失败，它就失望，尾巴的光明显黯淡。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME swings its pendulum awkwardly in front of others, as it's still developing its hypnotic powers. Its tail noticeably dims in disappointment when its hypnosis fails.

entry: 不知为何，POKENAME用精神能量行动，像在操纵自己这具木偶。医院会用它帮需要休息的人入睡，吃掉负面情绪，让病人醒来神清气爽。
author: bobosmith01
source: For some reason, it uses psychic energy to act like it is puppeteering itself around. POKENAME is used in hospitals, as it can put those in need of rest to sleep and feed on their negative emotions, allowing patients to wake up refreshed.

entry: POKENAME身边流传着许多迷信，最根深蒂固的一种是：把它当靠垫，就会做预知梦。它愿意这样亲近训练家，却会让陌生人做噩梦。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Many superstitions surround POKENAME. One of the most persistent is the belief that using one as a cushion will result in prophetic dreams. POKENAME are willing to be close to their Trainers this way, but will inflict nightmares on strangers.

entry: POKENAME每次表演前，都先吸气、挺起胸膛，再唱歌催眠。等对方睡着，它就吃冒出的梦。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME inhale and puff out their chest before each performance, where they sing and lull others to sleep. Once asleep, they consume the dreams that emerge.

entry: POKENAME催眠般地来回摆尾，分散注意，让人和宝可梦误以为安全，再借催眠偷走食物，不被打断。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME swing their tails back and forth in a hypnotic, distracting motion. They lull people and Pokémon into a false sense of security, using their hypnosis to allow them to steal away food without being interrupted.

entry: POKENAME用电磁力让闪亮小硬币浮空，借此迷惑更大的宝可梦，让对方载着自己并提供保护。
author: staghorn
source: POKENAME use electromagnetism to levitate small, shiny coins. They use these coins to enchant larger Pokémon into giving them rides and protection.

entry: POKENAME先用可怕外表和尖锐叫声恐吓猎物，再摆钟摆，确保对方无法躲过接下来的咬击和吸血。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME first terrorizes its prey with its frightening appearance and piercing shriek, before using its pendulum to ensure there's no escaping the incoming bite and blood-draining.

entry: 据说望进POKENAME所带镜面般宝石的倒影，就能看见最大的愿望。其实，只会陷入满是噩梦的沉睡。
author: petratheangel
source: Looking into the reflection of the mirror like gemstone POKENAME carries is said to show your greatest desires. In reality, it puts you into a deep sleep full of nightmares.

entry: POKENAME似乎主要靠转化满月的光获取能量。它不喜欢敌意：直视或撞到它，都会招来不依不饶的攻击，直到目标失去意识。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME appears to get most of its energy from synthesizing the light of the full moon. It dislikes aggression: directly looking at a POKENAME or bumping into one will cause it to attack relentlessly until its target is unconscious.

entry: 日落时，有时能见到POKENAME在森林寻找猎物。谁与它对上视线，就会被用钟摆施咒。
author: skyrvr
source: POKENAME can sometimes be seen searching for prey in the forest at sunset. If anyone makes eye contact with POKENAME, it will place a curse on them with its pendulums.

entry: POKENAME在两根鼻子之间造出投射幻象的传送门，以虚假的食物和玩乐诱惑倒霉的宝可梦。受害者真正被送去哪，没人知道。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME creates portals between its two trunks that cast illusions, luring hapless Pokémon with false promises of food and fun. Where the portals actually take victims is unknown.

entry: POKENAME散发强烈、令人作呕的气味，浓到能使人昏倒。谁在旁边昏过去，它就吃谁的梦。
author: bobosmith01
source: The powerful and nauseating scent that POKENAME produces is so strong that it can cause unconsciousness. POKENAME will eat the dreams of anyone who passes out around it.

entry: POKENAME无法飞行时，会用大爪抓住粗树枝荡过去。大而有花纹的耳朵能威吓敌人，尖叫时还会按奇怪节奏搏动。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME use their large talons to swing from thick tree branches when flying is not an option. Their large, patterned ears serve to intimidate foes and pulse in odd patterns when they screech.

entry: POKENAME爱抱训练家。若请求被拒绝，它可能会将对方催眠，再轻轻抱住。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME loves to cuddle with its Trainer. If they deny its request, it may lull them to sleep and give them a gentle embrace.

entry: POKENAME玩耍的地方，总有金属花瓣发出的独特轻鸣。听得太久就会睡着。它悠闲、不好斗，更喜欢趁竞争对手熟睡时下毒。
author: bobosmith01
source: There is a distinct, quiet, metallic noise wherever POKENAME is frolicking thanks to its metallic petals. Those who listen to it for too long fall asleep. It is carefree and nonaggressive, preferring instead to poison competition in their sleep.

entry: POKENAME不熟练催眠，力气又大，钟摆晃得太猛，无法正确催眠人或宝可梦。发脾气时，它会猛掷钟摆，这也是它唯一会的让人“睡着”的办法。
author: pixlhoopa
source: Inexperienced in hypnosis, POKENAME's strength causes it to swing a pendulum too strongly to properly hypnotize people or Pokémon. In a tantrum, it tosses its pendulum with incredible force, as it is its only known way to put people to sleep.

entry: POKENAME虽然外表吓人，却乐意帮其他宝可梦入睡。有时催眠到失去耐心，便决定用蛮力打昏“病人”。
author: mistymagius
source: Despite its appearance, POKENAME happily helps other Pokémon fall asleep. It can sometimes lose its patience trying to use hypnosis and decides to knock its patient out with brute force.

entry: POKENAME住在深海，等待月夜，再用身体反光催眠其他海底宝可梦，命令它们袭击、击沉过往船只。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME lives in the deep sea, waiting for moonlit nights. It uses the light reflecting from its body to hypnotize other undersea Pokémon and command them to attack and sink passing ships.

entry: POKENAME用钟摆催眠太阳珊瑚等猎物，再注入毒液，拖回巢里安静享用。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME lulls prey like Corsola to sleep with its pendulum. It then injects venom and drags its victim back to its den to feed in peace.

entry: POKENAME打架不讲规矩，用带精神力量的护符催眠对手。护符还能作鞭子，可即使占尽优势，它仍常打输。
author: mcnchsschl
source: POKENAME are dishonest fighters, using their psychic charm to put opponents to sleep. The charm even doubles as a whip, but these Pokémon still lose quite often despite their advantages.

entry: POKENAME感到危险，就左右摇晃，有节奏地挥爪。蘑菇随即释放孢子，催眠敌人，让它趁机逃走。
author: oddwalls
source: If it senses danger, it rocks from side to side, rhythmically waving its claws. Its mushrooms then release spores that hypnotize its foe into sleep while POKENAME escapes.

entry: 古老传说说，这种宝可梦生于月亮暗面，来到地上纠缠人梦、困住心智。其实它很害羞，独居在被遗忘的海滩或岛屿。
author: _pixelar_
source: Old folklore describes that this Pokémon is born on the dark side of the moon, coming down to earth to haunt the dreams of humans and ensnare their minds. In reality, it is a rather shy creature, living in solitude on forgotten beaches or islands.

entry: POKENAME会被像钟摆般来回晃动的物品奇怪地迷住。它一摇尾，附近的人也会被吸引它的东西迷住。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME are oddly entranced by objects that swing back and forth like a pendulum. When they wag their tail, people nearby also become entranced by whatever has caught POKENAME's attention.

entry: POKENAME常成群跟踪猎物数周，夜里嚎叫，令目标噩梦连连，自己乐在其中。等猎物缺觉到神志不清，才终于发动攻击。
author: joeofthealps
source: Packs of POKENAME will often stalk their prey for weeks before attacking, howling at night to fill the target's dreams with nightmares, which they relish. When their prey is delirious from sleep deprivation, they finally attack.

entry: POKENAME挑训练家，必须多加关注，才不会惹麻烦。但它也极其亲昵。有一群怪兽狂，还会参加POKENAME的美容比赛。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME can be picky about their Trainers and demand a lot of attention to prevent troublesome behavior. Despite that, they are known to be extremely affectionate. There are a group of Poké Maniacs who compete in POKENAME grooming competitions.

entry: POKENAME结合钟摆动作和低声歌唱，让受害者入睡。被催眠者会在梦中唱歌，它则吃对方的梦。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME lulls victims to sleep with a combination of pendulum movements and a whispered song. Those it sends to a slumber wind up singing in their sleep while POKENAME feeds on their dreams.

entry: POKENAME用超能力感知周围，侦察捕食者靠近的迹象。若被打个措手不及，它就惊慌地放出毒孢子，再把自身恐惧以精神力量投向敌人。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME use their psychic powers to detect their surroundings for signs of approaching predators. If anything manages to catch them off guard, they will startle with a burst of poisonous spores and psychically project their fear to their foe.

entry: POKENAME藏在翅膀毒鳞形成的雾中，用超能力感知猎物的恐惧。它只为催眠目标才现身，吃下恐惧，又回到雾里。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME hide within a mist of poisonous scales from their wings, using their psychic powers to detect the fear of their prey. They appear from the mist only to hypnotize their target, feeding on the fear before disappearing into the mist once more.

entry: POKENAME可能钟摆般摇晃着靠近，让人入睡，再带走身体。故事说，被带走的人都已濒死，而它只是平静地送往来世。
author: _pixelar_
source: A POKENAME may approach someone while swinging back and forth like a pendulum, putting them to sleep and taking the body away. Stories say that anyone taken by a POKENAME was close to death and that it peacefully delivered them to the afterlife.

entry: POKENAME的毛能吃，也很美味，但吃多会头晕。必须吃大量才有这效果，可滋味太好，很难避免。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's fur is edible and tasty, but it can induce dizziness in those who eat it. The effect only occurs after eating a large portion, but the delicious flavor of the fur makes it hard to avoid.

entry: POKENAME的奇怪工具，会给参与制作的饼干注入部分力量，让食用者入睡。睡不好的幼童很喜欢，配一杯温牛奶也合适。
author: icelevelincarnate
source: POKENAME's strange tools impart some of their power into any cookie they help make, putting whoever eats them to sleep. They're popular with young kids that have trouble sleeping, and pair well with a warm glass of milk.

entry: 婴儿实在无法入睡的极端情况下，医生会用线吊几只POKENAME，像床铃一样挂在婴儿床上方。它们悬着的硬币轻轻作响，能让新生儿平静。
author: bradlybro199
source: In extreme cases when babies can't seem to sleep, doctors will hang a few POKENAME on strings similar to a mobile above their cribs. The coins that hang off of POKENAME make a gentle ringing sound that has a calming effect on newborn children.

entry: POKENAME在地下感知到捕食者，就释放催眠气场，再尽量往深处挖，逃离危险。
author: .izik
source: If POKENAME detects a predator underground, it releases a sleep-inducing aura. It then digs as deep as possible to escape danger.

entry: 过去，有些居心不良者想利用POKENAME，催眠别人爱上自己。幸好它厌恶虚假爱情，绝不会用催眠强迫谁动心。
author: sk372
source: In the past, unscrupulous sorts thought to use POKENAME as a charm to hypnotize others into loving them. Fortunately, POKENAME abhors false love, and will never use its hypnosis to force attraction.

entry: POKENAME在富人面前晃银币，使其沉睡，再抢走身上全部钱财。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME wave a silver coin in front of wealthy individuals, hypnotizing them into a deep slumber. Once they're asleep, these Pokémon will rob them of all the money they have on them.

entry: POKENAME无意伤人，却常用超能力催眠附近的对象，让大家陪它玩上好几个小时。它喜欢蜷在熟睡者身旁睡觉。
author: bobosmith01
source: Although it never means any harm by this action, POKENAME often hypnotizes others around into playing with it for hours on end using its psychic powers. It loves to sleep curled up by those who sleep deeply.

entry: 这种宝可梦格外威严华美，但不受它信任的人，却极难记住外形细节。有时，它会送一簇鬃毛作友谊之礼，放进枕头便能安睡。
author: quietcognition
source: While it is strikingly majestic, the details of this Pokémon's appearance are extremely hard to remember for a person it doesn't trust. It sometimes gives a tuft of its mane as a gift of friendship, which insures good sleep if put inside a pillow.

entry: POKENAME晃动尾上钟摆，催眠对方，使其全力与自己交战。等获胜、打昏敌人，它就收取奖品，吃掉受害者的梦。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME swings the pendulum on its tail to hypnotize others into giving their all to fight it. Once it is victorious and has knocked out its foe, it takes its prize from the victim and devours their dreams.

entry: POKENAME夜里摇摆行走，嗅着空气，寻找梦的气味。它似乎只是喜欢待在做梦的宝可梦身旁，人们曾见它们成群围在熟睡者头边。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME waddle through the night, sniffing the air, searching for the scent of dreams. They seem to simply enjoy being near dreaming Pokémon, with groups of POKENAME having been observed standing around the heads of sleeping Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME发光的洋红色腹部令人着迷，盯着看，5秒内就会被催眠。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's glowing magenta abdomen is mesmerizing to look at. Staring at it can induce hypnosis within five seconds.

entry: POKENAME擒住猎物，强迫它看腹部螺旋花纹，直到被超能力催眠，再吃掉梦境。
author: petratheangel
source: POKENAME will grapple prey and force it to look at the spiral pattern on its belly until its hypnotic powers put it to sleep. Once this is done, POKENAME will devour its dreams.

entry: POKENAME睡得越久，神奇钟摆储能越多。完全充满后，它连动都不用动，就能催眠目标。
author: empty_set
source: The longer it sleeps, the more its magical pendulum becomes charged with energy.  Once its pendulum is fully charged, POKENAME can hypnotize targets without even needing to move.

entry: 它用勺子敲金属胸膛，发出尖锐回声，扰乱对手。它以困惑为食，削弱对方，再用超能力击败。
author: sk372
source: It swings the spoon it carries against its metallic chest, creating a sharp echoing sound that disorients opponents. It feeds on their confusion, weakening them before defeating them with psychic powers.

entry: POKENAME思考太快，催眠别人时容易失去耐心。它改把钟摆当硬币抛动，借反射的阳光一闪，暂时震住看见的对象。
author: epping_forest
source: POKENAME thinks so fast that it easily loses its patience when hypnotizing someone. Instead, it flips its pendulum like a coin, and the flash of sunlight reflecting from it temporarily stuns those who see it.

entry: 它晃动的硬币，其实是极沉的砝码。不断摆动，既锻炼身体，也练习催眠。
author: petratheangel
source: The coins it swings are actually incredibly heavy weights. It swings them constantly, both for physical training and for practicing hypnosis.

entry: 战斗时，一只手抓住对手，两只手用摆锤催眠，最后一只手负责挥拳。
author: thefinalkalgonus
source: During a fight, it uses one hand to grab its opponent, two hands to hypnotize it with its pendulums, and the last hand to throw punches at it.

entry: POKENAME夜里游荡安静的城镇，释放催眠粉。等附近的对象入睡，便大吃梦境。
author: .izik
source: At night, POKENAME roams quiet towns and releases a sleep-inducing powder. Once those in the area slumber, it feasts on the dreams of those nearby.

entry: POKENAME同时摆动钟摆，扩大超能力范围。它虽偏爱远攻，觅食收集矿物时，仍能将钟摆挥得足以击碎岩石。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME swing their pendulums simultaneously to increase the range of their psychic powers. While they prefer attacking from a distance, they are able to swing their pendulums hard enough to shatter stone when gathering minerals for meals.

entry: POKENAME用钟摆催眠谁后，就敲打自己的身体。躯干上每颗石头都会发出不同鸣声，触发受控者服从不同命令。
author: sk372
source: Once it hypnotizes someone with its pendulum, POKENAME strikes its body with it. Each stone on its torso creates a different chime, triggering different commands for the thrall to obey.

entry: POKENAME鬃毛的奇怪白焰，烟气会使吸入者困倦。它的训练家最好戴口罩。
author: hophoppip
source: The strange white flames of POKENAME's mane induce drowsiness in anyone who inhales their fumes. It's recommended for Trainers of POKENAME to wear masks.

entry: POKENAME催眠本领高强，却总集中不了精神，常一不小心，把自己和训练家都哄睡了。
author: autoregenesis
source: POKENAME are powerful hypnotists. However, their lack of focus means they are prone to accidentally putting themselves and their Trainers to sleep.

entry: POKENAME凭翅膀般的耳朵，感知其他宝可梦有多累。它走近快睡着的目标，边晃钟摆，边投射让对方疲惫的气场。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME can sense how tired other Pokémon are using their wing-like ears. They will walk toward Pokémon on the verge of sleep, projecting a field of exhaustion toward them as they swing their pendulum back and forth.

entry: POKENAME偷其他宝可梦的催眠硬币，拿来自己用。它按节奏来回摇晃硬币，使别人着迷。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME steal hypnotic coins from other Pokémon to use as their own. They swing the coin back and forth in a rhythmic pattern to entrance others.

entry: POKENAME始终来回挥动手中的棍子。看见的捕食者可能被催眠入睡，让它能逃走。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME swings the stick it carries back and forth at all times. This motion may hypnotise any predator that looks at POKENAME, lulling them to sleep so that POKENAME can escape.

entry: POKENAME虽臭得可怕，软泥却因能治失眠而备受追捧。实在渴望休息的人，甚至会走进下水道寻找。
author: petratheangel
source: Despite POKENAME's terrible stench, its ooze is highly sought after as a cure for insomnia. The truly desperate for rest will wander into sewers in search of it.

entry: 许多POKENAME试着在身前晃钟摆，催眠其他宝可梦，结果常被自己的力量催眠，头痛得晕眩。
author: quackquackattack
source: Many POKENAME attempt to hypnotise other Pokémon by swinging the pendulum in front of their body. This often leaves them hypnotized by their own powers, giving them a dizzying headache.

entry: POKENAME在阴影里藏上数小时，等倒霉路人看见钟摆。据说受害者会沉睡，被带走，余生的梦都被它吃掉。
author: petratheangel
source: POKENAME will hide in the shadows for hours, waiting for an unlucky passerby to see its pendulum. It is said that its victims fall into a deep sleep and are spirited away to have their dreams eaten for the rest of their life.

entry: POKENAME是催眠大师，用嘴里的螺旋引来食物，随后毫不犹豫地吞下。
author: toxicrown
source: POKENAME is a master hypnotist. It uses the spirals in its mouth to lure food in, then devours them without a second thought.

entry: POKENAME甩出小小的幽灵钟摆，藏在闹鬼之处，再等最佳时机释放催眠波，让里面所有对象陷入诡异、满是噩梦的沉睡。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME flings out small ghostly pendulums, hiding them among the places it haunts. It then waits for the perfect opportunity to make them pulse with hypnotic waves, and send everyone within into haunted, nightmare-filled slumber.

entry: 长胡子的POKENAME闹鬼时，整体行为较少恶意，却也更顽固，更难从家里驱除。
author: sk372
source: Bearded variants of POKENAME are noted to be less overall malevolent in their behavior while haunting, but are subsequently more stubborn and difficult to exorcise out of one's home.

entry: POKENAME深钻山体侧面。它留下的隧道里，常能见到穴居宝可梦睡觉。
author: petratheangel
source: POKENAME burrow deep into the sides of mountains. Cave-dwelling Pokémon are often found sleeping in the tunnels POKENAME leaves behind.

entry: 它的催眠力量太强，还无法完全掌控。有时送入钟摆的精神力量会反射回来，让自己陷入恍惚。
author: sk372
source: Its hypnotic power is so strong that it hasn't yet grasped full control over it. On occasion the psychic powers it sends into its pendulum may reflect back on itself and put it into a trance.

entry: 精通催眠。挥动双摆锤时，甚至能控制传说宝可梦的心智。
author: thefinalkalgonus
source: This creature is a master of hypnosis. By swinging its dual pendulums, it is able to control the minds of even legendary Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME潜伏在海滩岸边，领地意识极强。摇晃的神秘水滴会使毫无戒备的游客和游泳者安然入睡，梦从柔和潮汐逐渐变成噩梦的狂暴漩涡。
author: pixlhoopa
source: Lurking amidst the shores of beaches, POKENAME are highly territorial. The Mystic Water they dangle can lull unsuspecting beachgoers and swimmers into a gentle sleep, one that moves from a soft tide into a raging whirlpool of nightmares.

entry: POKENAME生性暴烈，想折磨自己看中的猎物。大钳困住受害者，再晃动钟摆，将其拖进飓风和洪水的噩梦。
author: pixlhoopa
source: POKENAME is naturally violent and seeks torment upon any prey it may see fit. The large claw traps its victims into a bound state, where it then swings a pendulum to toss them into a nightmare of hurricanes and floods.

entry: POKENAME的5只钳子与主体分离，会一起咔咔作响，吓退靠得太近的捕食者。它们埋在沙下，偷猎者却常挖出来，夺走钳子作食物。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME's five claws are disconnected from their main body, clicking together to scare off predators that get too close. These Pokémon bury themselves beneath the sand, though poachers often dig them up to steal their claws for food.

entry: POKENAME虽然能向前走，却更喜欢横着跑。双腿能伸长，一步可跨数码远。
author: wiz0z
source: Though POKENAME are able to walk forward, they prefer to scuttle sideways. Using their stretchy legs, POKENAME can cover several yards in a single step.

entry: POKENAME的舌头总伸在嘴外，钳子也不停开合。可惜，快速移动时，夹到自己的舌头是常有的事。
author: bradlybro199
source: The tongue on a POKENAME is constantly out of its mouth, and its pincers are constantly opening and closing. Unfortunately when moving quickly it is not uncommon for a POKENAME to pinch its own tongue.

entry: POKENAME能从前方吹泡泡沟通，通常与绿毛虫和大钳蟹交流。它用身体后方的钳子攀树，等待进化。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can blow bubbles from its front to communicate, typically with Caterpie and Krabby. It uses the pincer on the back of its body to cling to trees while it waits to evolve.

entry: POKENAME在海中漂游，靠鳍轻松滑过水中。需要休息时，就用强钳挖进岩石里。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME float in the ocean, using their fins to glide through the water with ease. POKENAME will dig into rocks using their powerful claws whenever they need rest.

entry: POKENAME颜色鲜艳，捕捉难度适中，很受年轻钓客欢迎。在这些人眼里，钓到它象征技术更上一层楼。不过，每只的性格差异很大。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is popular among young fishers due to their vibrant colors and moderate difficulty to catch. Among these circles, hooking up POKENAME is seen as the symbol of a new level in skill. Each POKENAME varies wildly in personality.

entry: 渔夫认为POKENAME不吉利，蟹钳会赶走好运。也因为少有捕捞，它分布广、数量多，各种水域都能见到。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are regarded as unlucky by fishermen, as their crab arm is thought to scare away good luck. As a result of being underfished, POKENAME are widespread and populous, found in many aquatic places.

entry: POKENAME沿着海底疾行，啪嗒合钳，警告天敌。出击时迅速倾斜身体，再用双臂撑住身子，重新立起。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME scuttle along the seafloor, snapping their claws as warnings to predators. They quickly tilt their bodies to strike with their claws, using their arms to catch themselves and push back up onto their feet.

entry: POKENAME住在偏远岛屿的小海滩，从黄昏跳舞到天明。舞时高挥双钳，释放让自己保持清醒的欢快精神能量。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME live on small beaches located on remote islands, dancing from dusk until dawn. POKENAME wave their claws in the air during the dance, releasing ecstatic psychic energy that keeps them awake.

entry: POKENAME用众多钳子保护大钳蟹群，吓退捕食者。作为交换，大钳蟹会跑遍海滩找食物，带回来给它。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME defends Krabby colonies with its many pincers, scaring away predators. In exchange for this help, Krabby colonies scuttle across beaches searching for food to bring back to POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME用尾钳抓住树枝。被抓到时，能自行折断钳子逃走，不过钳子很快就会长回。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME will use the claw on their tails to cling to branches. When grabbed, they can snap this claw off in order to escape. However, this claw will grow back quite quickly.

entry: POKENAME用多条腿在海底奔跑觅食。一被拉出水，就会暴怒，飞上天空，猛撞船只，将船击沉。
author: quackquackattack
source: Using their many legs, POKENAME scuttle across the ocean floor in search of food. When pulled out of the water, POKENAME become enraged and soar into the sky to sink ships, slamming into them.

entry: POKENAME温柔体贴，常住在水族馆。人们会训练它潜水，载人进入水下，用壳上气孔维持气泡，让乘客呼吸。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can be found in aquariums, as they are caring and gentle. As a result, POKENAME are trained to dive and ferry folks down underwater, using the air vents on their shell to maintain an air bubble to breathe.

entry: POKENAME特别喜欢训练家时，会把海滩找到的每个贝壳都送来。它喜欢在沙中挖小洞，躺进去休息。
author: fiordaliso
source: When POKENAME becomes especially fond of its Trainer, it brings every shell it finds on the beach as a gift. It loves digging small holes in the sand and resting inside them.

entry: POKENAME用钳子抓鱼，带上岸吃。它会尽量收集足够食物，堆成完美的正方形，再开始享用。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME catches fish with its claws, taking them back on land to eat. It tries to gather up enough food to make a perfectly square stack before it decides to dig in to its meal.

entry: POKENAME仰面倒下后，无法自己翻身，也无力反抗捕食者。它便埋进沙里，确保壳始终朝上。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have no way to flip themselves over if they end up on their back, rendering them powerless to fight back against predators. They bury themselves in sand to ensure their shell is always face up.

entry: POKENAME在潮池内外筑巢，退潮时成群捕猎。它们很有攻击性，数量够多时，会逼得海滩游客离开，直到请来巡护员处理。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME nest in and around tidal pools, moving in swarms to hunt together at low tide. They are aggressive Pokémon and large enough populations can cause beach goers to abandon the area until Pokémon Rangers can be called in.

entry: POKENAME吹泡泡，既为玩耍、攻击，也能作诱饵，分散威胁的注意，再隐身逃走。甚至有报告说，它会把光碟等收藏品存进泡泡。
author: imaginita
source: POKENAME creates bubbles for many reasons: for playing with, for attacking, and for decoys to distract threats while it turns invisible to escape. There are even reports of a POKENAME storing CDs and other collectibles in bubbles.

entry: POKENAME很胆小，在岸边寻找蛤蜊，敲开来吃。受威胁时，会从背上放泡泡，让自己显大，吓退捕食者。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are quite timid, searching the shore for clams they can crack open and eat. When threatened, they will expel bubbles from their back, making themselves seem larger in order to scare off predators.

entry: POKENAME很胆小，在岸边寻找大舌贝，敲开来吃。受威胁时，会从背上放泡泡，让自己显大，吓退捕食者。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are quite timid, searching the shore for Shellder they can crack open and eat. When threatened, they will expel bubbles from their back, making themselves seem larger in order to scare off predators.

entry: POKENAME怕独处，总成群挤在一起。饿时会好斗，为一点食物与同伴争打。受威胁时，它会开壳显大，却冒着暴露发育中翅膀的风险。
author: laughing_dan
source: POKENAME huddle in packs, afraid of being alone. When hungry, they become aggressive and will fight with their pack over scraps of food. When threatened, POKENAME will open its shell to look bigger, at the risk of exposing its developing wings.

entry: POKENAME产生发光珍珠，吸引水生宝可梦。猎物靠近，就用剃刀般锋利的鳍攻击。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME produces luminous pearls, which attract aquatic Pokémon. When prey approaches, POKENAME will strike with its razor-sharp fins.

entry: POKENAME靠蛋壳和幼小钳子保护自己。遇险时，会发出尖细的咕噜声求救。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME use their eggshell to protect themselves, along with their baby claws. POKENAME will make a high-pitched gurgle to call for help when in danger.

entry: POKENAME潜水时，用尾端钳子抓住水面物体。若捕食者威胁，就能借这固定点迅速将自己拉回安全处。
author: .jerden
source: When diving underwater, POKENAME grabs onto an object at the surface with the pincer on the end of its tail. If threatened by a predator, it can use this anchor point to quickly pull itself back up to safety.

entry: 它住在海滩挖出的洞里，天生颜色便于融入沙地。谁闯入它占据的那段海滩，它就现身驱赶。
author: .jerden
source: It lives in holes it digs on the beach, its natural coloration helping it to blend in with the sand. It will reveal itself to drive off anyone who trespasses on the section of beach it has claimed.

entry: POKENAME头发越卷，越受同伴尊重。据说战斗和年岁增长会让头发更卷，但有些会作弊，用自己产生的泡泡人为接长头发。
author: heal_fire
source: The curlier POKENAME's hair is, the more respect it earns from their peers. It's said that this hair gets curlier through fighting and aging. Yet, some POKENAME cheat by extending it artificially with some bubbles they produce themselves.

entry: POKENAME与同类成群在浅滩放松。若远方出现风暴，就飞上天空，迁往内陆。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME relax in groups on shoals with others of their kind. Should a storm appear on the horizon, they take to the sky and travel inland.

entry: POKENAME漂在海滩上方，睡觉时吊在大棉孢子上。只有吃饭才降下，而且始终有一只钳子抓着棉孢子。
author: quackquackattack
source: Floating in the sky above beaches, POKENAME use a large cotton spore to hang from as they sleep. POKENAME only descend from the sky when it is time to eat and always have one claw gripping onto their cotton spore.

entry: 尾钳强得足以夹碎石头。其他食腐者若离食物太近，它们就会朝对方猛夹。
author: santon5512
source: The claws on their tails are strong enough to crush stone. They will snap these claws at other scavengers who get too close to their meals.

entry: POKENAME用钳子细细处理食物，剥出壳内海鲜、撕下海藻片，再吃下。若其他宝可梦靠近，它就大声开合钳子威吓。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME delicately processes food with their claws, peeling away seafood from their shells, stripping off pieces of seaweed, before using them to feed itself. Should another Pokémon approach them, they will loudly snap their claws in intimidation.

entry: 若在海滩弄丢闪亮的东西，很可能能在POKENAME巢里找到。它住在海边游客密集区，看着值钱的东西都会偷。
author: heal_fire
source: If someone loses something that shines on the beach, they have a high chance of finding it in a POKENAME nest. This Pokémon lives in tourist-populated areas near the sea and will steal anything that looks precious.

entry: POKENAME挥出密集的钳击和藤蔓，保护背上的沙滩球。为何喜欢沙滩球，科学家仍在研究。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME unleash a flurry of claws and vines to protect the beach ball on their back. Why they are fond of beach balls is still being studied by scientists.

entry: POKENAME的触角能提前察觉远处威胁。尾上的眼睛视力惊人，任何东西只要稍有动静，它就会猛地咬过去。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's antennae allow it to detect even faraway threats well in advance. The eye on its tail has incredible vision and will snap at anything that shows even the slightest of movements.

entry: POKENAME能将大部分肢体收进身体，看起来比实际小得多。触角让它能提前察觉很远的威胁。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME can pull much of its limbs inside its body, causing it to appear much smaller than it actually is. Its antennae allow POKENAME to detect even faraway threats well in advance.

entry: 它的几丁质壳格外厚，抵御捕食者。它会在沙里挖洞，静静趴着，等机会伏击猎物。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Its chitinous shell is extra thick to protect it from predators. It will burrow a hole in the sand and lie still, waiting for an opportunity to ambush prey.

entry: POKENAME讨厌接触人，被看见就会惊慌飞走。它们常在海滩争食，用钳状尾巴将同伴甩进海里。
author: equation8573
source: If seen by a human, POKENAME will panic and fly away, as it dislikes human contact. POKENAME often fight over food on the beach, swinging each other into the ocean with their claw tails.

entry: POKENAME用钳子和带刺身体自保。为阻止捕食者下口，它先夹住对方，再用带刺身体扎过去。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME use their claws and barbed body to protect themselves. To dissuade predators from biting them, POKENAME grip onto the predator with their claws before stabbing the predator with their barbed bodies.

entry: POKENAME的强钳能轻松夹碎大舌贝的壳。战斗时身体产热多，因此待在水里降温。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's powerful pincers are strong enough to crush Shellder shells with little effort. Its body produces a lot of heat while in combat, so it stays in the water to keep its body cool.

entry: POKENAME是冰冷苔原上眼尖的猎手，趁其他宝可梦离巢，偷蛋和食物。它先监视对方活动，再直挖过去，偷走食物。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are keen-eyed hunters of the icy tundra, stealing eggs and food from other Pokémon when they are away from their burrows. POKENAME will monitor the activities of another Pokémon before burrowing straight towards their meals.

entry: POKENAME寻找空贝壳安家，藏好柔软身体。它们会为好壳争斗，钳子咔咔作响，试图将对手拉出家园，据为己有。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME search for empty seashells to make their homes in, hiding their soft bodies away within them. They battle one another for prize shells, snapping their claws and trying to pull their rival out of their home to claim it as their own.

entry: POKENAME用大喙刺穿猎物。甲壳动物般的腿，让它在陆上跳动更稳，也能摇摆着走进狭窄处。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a large beak that they use to pierce prey. Their crustacean-like legs give POKENAME more stability when hopping on land, allowing them to waddle into tight spaces.

entry: 它休息时，会冻住周围的水，以冰作屏障，确保没有捕食者打扰睡眠。
author: .izik
source: When resting, it freezes the water around it. It uses this ice as a protective barrier, ensuring no predators disturb its slumber.

entry: POKENAME与壳上生长的珊瑚共生，因为珊瑚能增强双钳。作为交换，它在不同珊瑚礁间迁移，帮助珊瑚扩散。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME live together with coral that grows on their shell, as the coral helps strengthen their claws. In exchange for this, POKENAME help the coral spread, migrating from one coral reef to another.

entry: POKENAME用鳍沿海底游动，用钳子抓食物。虽然有腿，却不用，更喜欢靠鳍。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME use their fins to swim along the ocean floor, using their claws to grab onto food. Despite having legs, POKENAME do not use them, preferring their fins.

entry: POKENAME先用触手缠住带壳猎物，再用钩状钳子撬开享用。两只争同一顿饭时，会互相撞钳，直到一方放弃。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME use their tentacles to wrap around shelled prey before prying open their meals using their hooked claws. When two POKENAME fight over the same meal, they smack their claws against each other until one of them gives up.

entry: POKENAME浮在海底上方，宽大的双翼在下方投出大影子。手臂般的触角连着钳子，提供额外保护。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME float above the ocean floor, their wingspan casting large shadows below them. POKENAME have claws attached to arm-like antennae that they use as extra protection.

entry: POKENAME蜷在沙质海底，一动不动，藏在成片橙珊瑚间。它耐心等猎物走近，再用迅捷的一钳伏击。
author: mimisha_m.lkpowder
source: POKENAME curls up motionless on the sandy seafloor, concealed among clusters of orange coral. It waits patiently for prey to wander near, then ambushes them with a single, swift claw strike.

entry: POKENAME不用羊皮纸，而把岩石当画布，用尖钳雕刻。它运用多种艺术风格，从写实、抽象，到风格化雕像都有。
author: quackquackattack
source: Making canvases out of stone instead of parchment, POKENAME use their sharp claws to carve into stone. POKENAME utilize many art styles, ranging from realistic to abstract to stylized statues.

entry: POKENAME用钳子扬沙，向沙里挖。挖好合适的洞后，就缩进壳里，睡个盹。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME kicks up sand using its claws to burrow into the sand. Once a suitable burrow is made, it tucks itself into its shell and takes a nap.

entry: POKENAME捡起地上的贝壳、橡实等小物件，抛向空中，再用雷电击落，既娱乐，也练准头。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME entertains itself by picking up small objects from the ground like shells and acorns, then tossing them into the air to shoot down with lightning bolts as a method of target practice.

entry: POKENAME喜欢用钳子夹自己，保持清醒或集中精神。它已习惯这种感觉，并不疼。除大钳外，还有两只始终闭合的小钳。
author: gamelord64
source: POKENAME likes to pinch itself with its claw to stay awake or to focus. It doesn't hurt POKENAME because it is used to the feeling. Besides the big claw, it also has two smaller claws that are always closed.

entry: POKENAME用钳子在藤蔓间荡跃，跳过丛林树枝。锋利双钳能劈开椰子，吃里面的果肉。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME use their claws to swing from vine to vine, leaping across branches in the jungle. Their claws are sharp and can break open coconuts, allowing POKENAME to eat the fruit inside.

entry: POKENAME更常用尾钳，而非双臂的钳子，因为尾钳更强。遇险时，它能通过尾巴放出强劲电击自卫。
author: daimposter_60614
source: POKENAME uses the claw on its tail more often than the ones on its arms because it is stronger. When in danger, it can send large shocks of electricity through its tail as a defense mechanism.

entry: POKENAME偏爱质地坚硬的坚果和带硬壳的猎物，用强钳夹开。身体充满膨大的肌肉和脂肪，有助承受水压和温度变化。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME prefer to eat hard nuts and prey with hard shells, using their strong pincers to crack them open. Their bodies are bloated with muscle and fat, which helps them to endure water pressure and varying temperatures.

entry: POKENAME用大嘴嚼树果，偏爱海滩附近长的。它喜欢开阔空间，若被关太久，翅膀就会紧绷。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have large mouths that munch on berries, preferring ones that grow closer to beaches. POKENAME prefer wide-open spaces, as their wings get tense if confined for too long.

entry: POKENAME住在红树林沼泽，凭强钳和敏捷身手保护家园。钳子强到能砍倒树，它就用来放倒病树。
author: heal_fire
source: POKENAME live in mangrove swamps, protecting them with their powerful pincers and great agility. These pincers have the strength to cut down trees, with POKENAME using them to fell sick trees.

entry: POKENAME爱训练，却讨厌被其他宝可梦或训练家打扰。为安静切磋，它们在海滩下挖巨洞，建成地下道场。
author: heal_fire
source: POKENAME love to train, but hate being disturbed by other Pokémon or Trainers. In order to spar peacefully, they dig huge holes under the beach, creating underground caves that they use as dojos.

entry: POKENAME身下不断涌出泡沫，让它轻松浮在海面。它用念力将海洋生物举进大钳，但只为玩，很快就会丢回水里。
author: sk372
source: Foamy bubbles constantly flow beneath POKENAME, letting it easily float on the ocean water. It uses telekinesis to lift up sea creatures into its large claws, though this is only for sport, and it tosses them back in shortly after.

entry: 世界各地海滩，都能找到埋在沙中的POKENAME。它像小岛，很上镜，许多游客想与它合照。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can be found submerged in sand at beaches throughout the world. Their resemblance to small islands make them highly photogenic, as many tourists want a picture with POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME头顶长出的附肢能吃、美味，也容易再生。人们认为，这是防御机制，让捕食者吃饱，自己却安然无恙。
author: hophoppip
source: The appendages that grow from the top of POKENAME are edible, tasty, and can be regrown with ease. They are thought to be a defense mechanism, allowing predators to sate their appetites while leaving POKENAME unharmed.

entry: POKENAME用8片硬化成壳的翅膀当桨，划过海洋。上陆时，也能像螃蟹般跑上海滩。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME uses its eight shell-hardened wings like paddles to swim across the sea. When it comes to land, it can skitter onto the beach like a crab.

entry: 从脸上伸出的钳子，其实是嘴。它夹住毫无戒备的宝可梦，像昆虫口器一样吸出体液。
author: foolish_weasel
source: The pincer extending from its face is actually a mouth. It clamps onto unsuspecting Pokémon and sucks out fluids like a bug's proboscis.

entry: POKENAME背上能载数百只小小的大钳蟹。若在旁边放音乐，大钳蟹就会开心地按拍子敲钳。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME can carry hundreds of small Krabby on its back. If you play music around this Pokémon, the Krabby will cheerfully click their pincers to the beat.

entry: POKENAME与同类会形成复杂的竞争关系和社交小圈子。通常，钳状耳朵最大的最受欢迎。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME have been observed forming complex rivalries and social cliques with other POKENAME. Typically, the ones with the biggest pincer-ears are the most popular.

entry: POKENAME成群摇摆行走，保持温暖。它们挤在一起，让弱小个体待在中央，保护起来。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME waddle in flocks to preserve warmth. They huddle together and protect the weaker POKENAME by having them stay in the middle of the group.

entry: POKENAME在沙滩上一动不动，舒舒服服休息到日落。休息时鼻子总朝北，海上迷路的船长会利用这点重新辨向。
author: porterofgames
source: POKENAME sit motionless on sandy beaches, resting comfortably until sunset. When at rest, they will always have their noses pointed north; ship captains lost at sea use this knowledge to help reorient themselves.

entry: POKENAME将柄埋入沙中，看起来像一只被丢弃的钳子。缎带一察觉动静，斧头便会翻起，斩杀受害者。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: When POKENAME buries its shaft in the sand, it appears to be just a discarded claw. Alerted by its ribbon, the axe flips to execute its victim.

entry: POKENAME很多的海滩，宝可梦种类通常比别处少，因为它好斗。它会冲向自认为是竞争者的宝可梦，凶狠开合双钳。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Beaches with large POKENAME populations typically have a lower diversity of Pokémon than other beaches due to the aggressive nature of POKENAME. They scuttle at any Pokémon they perceive as competition and aggressively snap their claws at them.

entry: POKENAME喷出气泡，折射自身的光影，制造幻象，融入周围。若有人靠得太近，看穿伪装，它便举钳示警。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME use the spray of bubbles from their body to reflect light off of themselves, creating mirages to blend into their surroundings. If anyone gets close enough to see through the mirage, POKENAME will ready their claws as a warning.

entry: 头上的钳子是绝佳武器。受威胁时，会用头猛撞目标，再用钳子夹住敌人。
author: melodydelune
source: The pincers on its head make excellent weapons. When threatened, it will bash its head into targets and clamp its pincers onto foes.

entry: POKENAME一生不断长大，每轮生长都会蜕去外骨骼。它们用强钳彼此抓扯，争夺海滩家园的主导地位。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME grow continuously through their lifetime, shedding their exoskeleton with each growth cycle. They battle with one another for dominance of the beaches they call home, grabbing at one another with their powerful claws.

entry: POKENAME每月一次，从海中跑上海滩，等满月之夜。它们一起敲钳，围着彼此横移成大圈，跳奇怪的舞。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME scuttle out onto the beach from the sea once a month, waiting until the night of the full moon. They click their claws in unison, performing a strange dance where they move sideways in a broad circle around one another.

entry: 这种宝可梦的壮腿和4只腿般的耳朵，能走过几乎任何地形。因此，从山顶到海沟，都能见到POKENAME。
author: origamiskies
source: This Pokémon's sturdy legs and four leg-like ears allow it to navigate practically any terrain. Because of this, POKENAME are found anywhere from mountaintops to oceanic trenches.

entry: POKENAME用水生的翅膀飞过空中，再用钳子猛砸对手，也会凭握力夹击。
author: quackquackattack
source: Using their aquatic wings to soar through the air, POKENAME slam their claws into opponents. POKENAME also use their grip strength to pinch opponents.

entry: POKENAME能制造、塑造泡泡，用来织网捕猎。猎物一落网，它就赶过去，用牙给泡泡网通电，电死猎物。
author: heal_fire
source: POKENAME is capable of creating and shaping bubbles. It uses them as a web to catch its prey, and when one of them falls into its trap, it rushes toward the web before electrifying it with its fangs to kill the prey.

entry: POKENAME猛夹钳子，在钳内点火，吓退袭击者。年长个体不断生火，钳边往往烧得焦黑。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME snaps its claw to ignite a flame within its pincers as a way to frighten off attackers. Older members of the species tend to have charred edges to their claws from constant fire-starting.

entry: POKENAME背上的9只钳子帮它维持平衡，轻松走过岩石海岸。受威胁时，它背对捕食者，用钳子挡住攻击。
author: santon5512
source: The nine claws on POKENAME's back help them maintain balance, allowing them to traverse rocky shores with ease. When threatened, they will show their back to predators, using their claws to defend against attacks.

entry: POKENAME有圆胖、带刺的壳，会伸出内脏，形成钳子抓食物。钳子摸起来黏滑，能黏住树果和零食。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a rotund shell that has spikes and extends its innards to form a claw to grab onto meals. Their claw is slimy to the touch, sticking onto berries and snacks.

entry: POKENAME拿着危险的利剪到处跑，许多对象会避开。但也曾有人见它剪开废弃钓线，救出被缠住、冲上岸的宝可梦。
author: mepp.
source: Many avoid POKENAME when they see it scuttling around with dangerously sharp scissors. However, it has been witnessed using them to free washed up Pokémon that are ensnared in discarded fishing lines.

entry: POKENAME飞行时，流经背部的水不断滴落。每当飞过海滩，常让游客很烦。
author: theartemis1
source: The water channeled through POKENAME's back is constantly dripping as it flies. This often poses a nuisance to beachgoers whenever it passes through the area.

entry: POKENAME以悦耳歌声，将受害者诱进自己在沙中挖的洞。歌声的声波只会引来最美味的猎物。
author: mrpeach774
source: POKENAME uses its melodic voice to lure its victims into holes it digs in the sand. The sound waves of its singing voice lure only the tastiest prey.

entry: POKENAME在海滩挖边缘倾斜的坑，让猎物滑进去。它只把嘴露在沙外，吹泡泡吸引好奇宝可梦，使其沿陷阱斜边滑落。
author: heal_fire
source: POKENAME dig hole on the beach with a sloped border to make its prey fall inside. They only leave their mouth out of the sand, creating bubbles to attract curious Pokémon and make them slip along the sides of their traps.

entry: POKENAME在海里游，找岩礁潜伏。常能见到它蹭岩石，刮掉鳞片上的碎屑和污物。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME swim in the sea, finding rocky reefs to lurk in. POKENAME can be found rubbing against rocks, scraping debris and filth off their scales.

entry: POKENAME一钳夹住对手，另一钳重击。它用泡沫裹身，缓冲还击。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME latches onto rivals with one pincer while the other delivers devastating blows. It cloaks its body in foam to absorb counterattacks.

entry: POKENAME埋进湿土和沙中，保护柔软腹部。若有东西在钳边移动，就会被抓住，拖进壳里，或吃掉，或丢弃。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME bury themselves in wet dirt and sand, protecting their soft underside. If anything moves near one's claw, it'll be grabbed and dragged into POKENAME's shell to either be eaten or discarded.

entry: POKENAME敲钳定位，在黑暗中辨路、寻找猎物，再俯冲抓住，带回洞穴。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME click their claws together to help them navigate dark areas and locate prey. They will then swoop down, grabbing them in their claws and taking them back to their cave.

entry: 数百只POKENAME埋在岸边，吃沙里的小片海藻和藻类。个头小，让它们容易成为飞行属性宝可梦的猎物。
author: santon5512
source: Hundreds of POKENAME lie buried in the shore, feeding on small bits of seaweed and algae in the sand. Their small size makes them easy prey for Flying-type Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME在暗洞振翅，成群移动，靠数量压倒猎物和捕食者。据说一群最多聚集50只，就会分群。
author: quackquackattack
source: Fluttering in dark caverns, POKENAME travel in colonies, overwhelming both prey and predator with their sheer numbers. It is said that POKENAME colonies can gather up to 50 individuals before splitting off.

entry: POKENAME出没于工厂，用身体吸收多余电力。电气设备损坏时，科学家会依靠它作为最后的保障。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are found in factories, using their bodies to absorb excess electricity. Scientists rely on POKENAME as a failsafe if any electrical equipment is damaged.

entry: POKENAME的大嘴能张得与头一样宽，整口吞食。钳子太小，伸不远，因此它从不用。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a large mouth that can stretch as wide as its head, which it uses to swallow food whole. POKENAME do not use their claws, as they are tiny and cannot reach very far.

entry: POKENAME有毒的叶子，让海洋捕食者不愿咬它或猎食它。它在暖海的海滩岩石间安家。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its poisonous leaves keep it safe from marine predators, which avoid biting or hunting it. POKENAME makes its home among the rocks along the beaches of warm seas.

entry: POKENAME跳舞时，翼尖的壳互撞，发出尖锐的拍击声。它很难旋转，因此舞蹈主要靠横移，最后向空中吹出许多泡泡。
author: chibitales
source: As POKENAME dance, the shells on the tips of their wings collide and make a sharp clap sound. It's difficult for these Pokémon to spin, so their dances mostly consist of sideways movement, ended by blowing many bubbles into the air.

entry: POKENAME流线形的鳍上连着钳子。速度虽因此变慢，它仍是海中最快的生物之一。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have claws attached to their aerodynamic fins. While this does slow POKENAME down, they remain some of the fastest creatures in the sea.

entry: POKENAME用钳子舀起海底大量沙子，吸入体内。各种水生宝可梦在它身上安家，吃上面长的藻类。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME will scoop up massive amounts of sand on the seafloor using their claws, absorbing it into their bodies. Various aquatic Pokémon make their bodies their homes, feeding on the algae that grows on them.

entry: POKENAME用连在触手中央的钳子引来猎物。困住后，它便注毒，确保拿下新的一餐。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME use their claws attached to the center of their tentacles to attract prey. Once ensnared, POKENAME inject poison to secure a new meal.

entry: POKENAME柔软的触手能硬化成尖钩刺，抓捕猎物。不狩猎时，更喜欢躲在大壳下。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have soft tentacles that can harden into sharp barbs to capture prey. When not on the hunt, POKENAME prefer to hide under their large shell.

entry: POKENAME沿岸奔跑，背着曾经活着的宝可梦的壳。许多孩子在它身边会涌起深深的怀念，仿佛熟悉的宠物回来了。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME carry the shells of once-living Pokémon as they scuttle along shores. Many children feel a deep sense of nostalgia when they are around these creatures, as though a familiar pet has returned.

entry: POKENAME遇险，第一反应是将蘑菇存进水泡保护。它靠耐用双钳沿岸找食物。
author: fiordaliso
source: When in danger, POKENAME's first instinct is to protect its mushrooms by storing them inside water bubbles. It gathers food along the shore using its durable claws.

entry: POKENAME肉质鲜甜柔嫩，在岛屿地区是受欢迎的美食。常连鳞片一起烹调，因为鳞片浸泡后口感爽脆。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are a popular delicacy in island regions as their flesh has been described as sweet and tender. They are often cooked with their scales as they have a nice, crunchy texture when soaked.

entry: POKENAME的钳子有时会自然脱落。钳子大而美味，是珍贵的食物来源。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's claws sometimes fall off naturally. They're large and quite tasty, making them a valued food source.

entry: POKENAME全身细毛带毒。若潜藏毒性不足以打倒敌人，它就挥钳，同时抖触角，散出一批新毒。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: The fine hairs along a POKENAME's body are laced with toxins. If the latent poison isn't enough to finish an opponent, POKENAME will strike with their claws while wiggling their antenna, scattering a fresh dose of poison.

entry: POKENAME花上数日巡查热泉口生态系统，寻找食物，还常挑衅大得超过自己应付能力的猎物。
author: noblenobody
source: POKENAME spend days patrolling thermal vent ecosystems for food, often picking fights with larger prey than they should.

entry: POKENAME钻地时，用强钳抓住敌人，高速拖行，直到对方失去意识。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its powerful pincers to seize foes while burrowing. It drags them at extreme speeds until they lose consciousness.

entry: POKENAME在海滩奔跑，找闪亮硬币或小饰品收藏。若谁想拿走新得的宝物，它就会凶起来，也敢伸钳夹人。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME scuttle across beaches to look for shiny coins or trinkets they can add to their collection. They become hostile if anyone tries to take their newfound possessions and are not afraid of pinching people.

entry: POKENAME温顺平静，用呱呱叫和挥钳沟通。交流方式十分复杂，当地水手观察海滩上的它们，就能知道风暴是否将至。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are docile and calm, communicating using quacks and waving their claws. This method of communication is sophisticated enough that local sailors can tell if a storm is coming by observing POKENAME that are on beaches.

entry: POKENAME友好聪明，用叫声和钳子指引同伴找到垃圾，再清理干净，想请游客来海滩，还会在沙岸招呼船只。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are friendly and clever, using their quacking and claws to guide each other to patches of litter. POKENAME then clean up that area so that they can invite tourists to their beaches, beckoning ships from their sandy shores.

entry: POKENAME用结实的钳子在沙滩挖小洞安家。挖出的水洞，让通常生活在沼泽的宝可梦，也能在海滩附近居住。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME use their sturdy claws to dig out small holes in sandy beaches to use as their homes. These watering holes that POKENAME create allow Pokémon typically found in more swampy areas to make their homes closer to the beaches.

entry: POKENAME的钳子极适合挖掘，能高速钻沙，寻找地下隐藏的宝可梦，再夹住整只吃下。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME claws are exceptionally well-suited for digging, allowing them to burrow through the sand at high speeds. They will search for other Pokémon hidden underground, grabbing them with their claws and eating them whole.

entry: 几块精神粘糕，就足以让它开心。读心能力能察觉最细微的嫉妒，因此它知道，必须切开粘糕，分给大家。
author: quackquackattack
source: A few pieces of Clever Mochi are all it needs to be happy. It knows it needs to slice and share its mochi because its mind reading powers can detect the slightest of envy.

entry: POKENAME力大无穷，能有力地挥动三叉戟。它爱胜利的滋味，不断向敌人挑战决斗。输了就另找弱一点的对手，忘掉败仗。
author: heal_fire
source: POKENAME are very strong Pokémon that wield tridents with great strength. They love the taste of victory, challenging many foes to duels. When POKENAME lose, they try to find another weaker opponent to forget about their defeat.

entry: POKENAME鼓圆的头受到硬壳保护，很难击穿。钳子虽小却灵巧，能深挖地面，保护柔软腹部。
author: quackquackattack
source: The bulbous heads of POKENAME are protected by a hard shell and are difficult to penetrate. Their claws are small but nimble, burrowing deep into the ground to protect their soft underbellies.

entry: POKENAME藏在岩石海滩，伸出脆弱、细长的肢体，夹住靠得太近的猎物。理想条件下最多能长80只钳，但野外通常还没到这数量，就已折断。
author: anonymous_moose
source: POKENAME lives hidden away on rocky beaches, extending its brittle, spindly limbs to clamp prey that get too close. In ideal conditions, it can grow up to 80 of these pincers, though they tend to break off in the wild before reaching this number.

entry: POKENAME戴着壳状头盔，用两只大钳挖开身下的土。挖好合适洞穴后，它便在里面休息，之后再重新开挖。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a shell-like helmet and two large claws that excavate the earth beneath them. Once POKENAME create suitable burrows, POKENAME will rest in those burrows before starting the process over again.

entry: POKENAME用强壮手臂和利钳深挖地下。它对睡处很挑剔，不是刚挖好的地，就绝不睡。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have sturdy arms and sharp claws used to dig deep into the ground. POKENAME are picky with their sleeping habits and refuse to sleep unless the ground is freshly dug up.

entry: POKENAME披着厚壳，喜欢在海滩疾驰，不担心捕食者。潜水时，每次呼气，头和尾巴都会冒泡。
author: quackquackattack
source: Armored with a thick shell, POKENAME enjoy galloping across beaches without worrying about predators. When they are submerged underwater, they release bubbles from their head and tail with each exhale.

entry: POKENAME很少活动，每天最多睡22小时。它用尾巴慢慢把食物拖到嘴边，吃完又睡。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are sedentary Pokémon, sleeping for up to 22 hours a day. They use their tails to slowly drag food to its mouth before falling back asleep.

entry: POKENAME用超能力让附近宝可梦入睡，再拿走食物。据说它完全感觉不到尾巴的疼痛，仿佛尾巴也被催眠了。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME uses its psychic powers to lure Pokémon in the area to sleep before taking food from sleeping Pokémon. It is said that POKENAME is oblivious to the pain that its tail feels, as though the tail was put to sleep.

entry: POKENAME常与小磁怪一系和头巾混混的融合体搭档，维护潜艇。它漂在艇身周围的水里，用声波持续检查所负责潜艇的状况。
author: bradlybro199
source: POKENAME are often utilized in the maintenance of submarines in tandem with Magnety. POKENAME float around in the water surrounding the submarines and use sound waves to run constant diagnostics on the health of their particular vessel.

entry: POKENAME肚子贴着海底爬行，用钳子抓食物。体量还不足以保住足够热量，因此偏爱温暖气候。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME crawls on its stomach across the ocean floor, using its claws to grab onto food. POKENAME prefers warmer climates, as it has yet to develop enough body mass to preserve enough heat.

entry: POKENAME冻住前方的水，沿海底滑行。它偏爱寒冷气候，因为更容易冻水。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME slides across the ocean floor by freezing the water in front of it. POKENAME prefers colder climates as it is easier to freeze water in such climates.

entry: POKENAME跑进工厂，寻找富有营养的污泥，用大钳舀进嘴，直到吃饱。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME scuttle into factories to seek out nutritious sludge. They use their large claws to scoop sludge into their mouths until full.

entry: POKENAME用弱小钳子拖动自己，在海底爬行，收集海藻。壳限制了活动范围，因此无法快速移动。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME drag themselves around with their weak claws, crawling around to gather seaweed on the sea floor. POKENAME are unable to move quickly, as their shells inhibit their range of motion.

entry: POKENAME的壳沉重，行动缓慢，也不太能动，侧翻后很脆弱。不过，钳子和小腿仍能帮它爬行，维持直立。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME has a heavy shell that makes it slow and relatively immobile and is vulnerable if flipped on its side. However, POKENAME can still move due to its claws and small legs helping it crawl and remain upright.

entry: POKENAME按催眠的节奏吹泡泡，引诱毫无戒心的目标走进巢穴，巢穴通常位于黑暗洞窟中。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME blows bubbles in a hypnotizing rhythm. In this way, it lures unwary targets into its lair, which is often located in dark caves.

entry: 融合让POKENAME的捕猎手段更凶狠，会猛烈夹击，将鱼和蛤蜊都夹碎。钳子似乎已开始发展独立意识。
author: sk372
source: Fusion has caused POKENAME to exhibit much more aggressive hunting techniques, viciously snapping at and crushing fish and clams alike. There are signs its claws are beginning to develop minds of their own.

entry: POKENAME有两对钳子，前钳能夹碎钢梁。若海里有污染物，它会徒劳地伸钳抓挠。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have two sets of claws, their front claws able to crush steel beams. If pollution is present in the ocean, POKENAME will attempt to claw at it in vain.

entry: POKENAME受鲜艳颜色吸引，习惯用海滩上找到的废玩具装饰背部。每天都必须长时间泡盐水澡，防止皮肤干燥。
author: fiordaliso
source: Drawn to bright colors, POKENAME has a habit of decorating its back with discarded toys found on the beach. It must take long baths in salt water every day to prevent its skin from drying out.

entry: POKENAME一钳拿着骨头，更好地自卫。但战斗仍很艰难，因为巨钳太重，小身体很难好好举起。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME wields a bone in one claw to better defend itself. It has a difficult time in battle regardless, as its oversized claw is too heavy for its small body to properly lift.

entry: POKENAME用大左钳维持高踢和回旋踢的平衡。连击之后，得费劲重新举起钳子，会暂时露出破绽。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME use their large left claw as a counterbalance for high kicks and roundhouses. After unleashing their flurry of blows, POKENAME are vulnerable for a bit while they struggle to pick their claw back up.

entry: POKENAME形成了耐心防守的打法。坚韧甲壳能轻松承受多次打击，等准机会，再用巨钳打出一记重拳。
author: fancyskunk
source: POKENAME has adopted a patient, defensive fighting style. Its tough carapace allows it to easily withstand many blows while waiting for the opportunity to land a haymaker with its massive claw.

entry: POKENAME极硬的角，能将巨石整齐劈成两半。发脾气时，口鼻都会喷出咸水泡泡和泡沫。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its incredibly hard horn can split boulders clean in two. When POKENAME loses its temper, it expels saltwater bubbles and foam from both its mouth and nostrils.

entry: POKENAME将独钳保养得极好；若掉了，就会极度消沉。钳子滋味极鲜，因此常成为偷猎目标。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME keeps its singular pincer in great condition; if it falls off, POKENAME will fall into a deep depression. The pincer is known for being extremely flavorful, so POKENAME is often targeted by poachers.

entry: POKENAME能再生肢体，有时手臂卡在窄缝或受伤，就会脱落。它们很快便能长回，有些只需24小时。
author: quackquackattack
source: Able to regenerate their limbs, POKENAME sometimes lose an arm in a tight crevice or when hurt. POKENAME are able to regrow such limbs quickly, some doing so in only 24 hours.

entry: POKENAME的巨钳能将骨头夹成可食的小块。它常在大钳蟹群附近，用保护换食物。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME has massive pincers that crushes bones into edible pieces. It can be found near Krabby colonies, giving them protection in exchange for food.

entry: POKENAME尾尖的钳子能夹裂铁，还覆着使人严重衰弱的毒。它沿岸进食时，谁敢打扰，就会立刻还击，夹向够得着的任何对象。
author: fiordaliso
source: The claw at the tip of its tail is strong enough to crack iron and is coated in highly debilitating toxins. If anyone dares disturb POKENAME while it feeds along the shoreline, it wastes no time retaliating by pinching anyone within reach.

entry: POKENAME很受旅游业喜爱，壳上的气孔能维持供游客呼吸的气泡。遇到紧急情况，也会保护游客，带回海滩。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are a favorite of the tourism industry, as their air vents on their shell can be used to maintain a bubble for tourists to breathe in. In the event of emergencies, POKENAME are also known to defend tourists and bring them back to beaches.

entry: POKENAME凭锯齿状下颚，能从嘴里喷出压力、粗细不同的水流。尾钳善于抓握，既能轻松夹碎石头，也能轻柔拿住一颗果实。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME can spray jets of water from their mouths with varying pressure and size thanks to their jagged lower jaws. The claws at the end of their tails are prehensile and can crush a rock just as easily as they can gently grab hold of a fruit.

entry: POKENAME爱用水和别人玩，尤其喜欢用尾端巨钳造大泡泡。这钳子也是最佳武器，保护朋友时，它会使得十分凶猛。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME love to use water to play with others, especially being fond of creating giant bubbles via the massive pincer at the end of their tail. This pincer is also their best weapon, which they will use to defend their friends rather fiercely.

entry: POKENAME用一只巨钳抓猎物，连最厚的铠甲都能刺穿。钳子和壳太重，它必须触手、腿并用才能移动，因此会挑比自己更慢的猎物。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME seizes prey using its single oversized claw, which can pierce even the thickest armor. Weighted down by both its pincers and its shell, POKENAME needs to use both tentacles and legs to move, but targets prey that is even slower than itself.

entry: POKENAME大部分超能力都集中在巨钳里。它用强念力将对手拉近，再凭巨钳的蛮力夹碎。
author: sk372
source: A majority of POKENAME's psychic power is centered within its oversized claw. It pulls opponents towards itself with potent telekinesis, before crushing them with the giant claw's raw might.

entry: POKENAME小身体连着巨钳，漂浮时角度古怪。大钳能发射泡泡，每击中一次，就削弱一分对手的战意。
author: sk372
source: Due to having an oversized claw attached to a diminutive body, POKENAME floats around at an odd angle. The large claw can fire bubbles that whittle away an opponent's fighting spirit with each hit.

entry: POKENAME潜伏在浑浊河道，趴在河床上数日不动，等猎物经过。一感知到能吃的东西，就挥起强钳，猛然行动。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME lurks in murky riverways, remaining stationary for days on end on the river bed while it waits for passing prey. When it senses something it can eat, it bursts into motion using its powerful pincers.

entry: 它是用强钳捕猎的肉食宝可梦。虽然水生，游泳却笨拙。似乎能从嘴里发出一连串电脉冲，与其他宝可梦沟通。
author: bobosmith01
source: It is a carnivorous Pokémon that hunts using powerful pincers. Although aquatic, it is a clumsy swimmer. It seems to be able to communicate with other Pokémon by firing a series of electrical impulses from its maw.

entry: POKENAME靠明亮闪耀的钩，引其他宝可梦进入双钳。诱人的钩光，将许多水生宝可梦引向末路。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME rely on their bright and shiny hook to lure other Pokémon into their claws. The alluring glow of the hook draws in many aquatic Pokémon to their doom.

entry: POKENAME两只大钳与躯干一样大，遇险时抱住自己，显得更大。若听见求救，它就会赶去，帮助遇险者。
author: quackquackattack
