source: POKENAME have two large claws that are the size of their torso and hug itself when in danger to appear larger. If POKENAME hear a cry for help, they will rush over to render aid to those in danger.

entry: POKENAME的独钳大得惊人，重量使它在陆上很笨拙，因此大部分时间都待在水里。
author: .jerden
source: Due to the immense weight of its single oversized claw, POKENAME is very clumsy on land. Because of this, it spends most of its time in the water.

entry: POKENAME从头顶吹出坚韧泡泡，能载自己升空。它借此逃离涨潮，慢慢飘到安全处。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME blow bubbles from the tops of their heads that are strong enough to carry them into the air. They use these bubbles to escape from high tides, slowly drifting to safety.

entry: POKENAME住在淤泥河流，大部分时间藏在泥里，滤取养分。它排出黏液，散进泥中，被同类接收，成为沟通方式。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Found in silty rivers, POKENAME spend most of their time hidden in the mud, filtering through it to extract any nutrients. They expel a mucus that disperses through the mud, which is picked up by other POKENAME in a form of communication.

entry: 为节省能量，POKENAME埋在河底泥里，一动不动地等猎物。任何东西进入范围，就会被巨钳抓住。
author: .jerden
source: To conserve energy, POKENAME buries itself in the mud at the bottom of rivers, and lies in wait for prey without moving. As soon as anything comes within reach, it grabs it with its giant claw.

entry: POKENAME的两颗头精神相连，目标一致。下半身负责走，上半身向下伸钳抓猎物，另一臂则维持平衡，免得翻倒。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's two heads are psychically linked and act with one purpose. The lower body handles walking around, while the upper body reaches down to seize prey with its pincer, using its other arm to balance POKENAME so that it doesn't topple over.

entry: POKENAME用尾端巨钳在沙中挖洞。钳子拖累行动，因此白天躲在洞里避开捕食者，夜里才出来劈椰子吃。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME use the massive claw on their tails to dig burrows in the sand. This claw weighs them down, leading them to hide in their burrows during the day to avoid predators. At night, they emerge to crack open coconuts for food.

entry: POKENAME习惯将从游泳者那里偷的沙滩球戴在背上。它用口中喷出的催眠孢子，或巨钳发射的泡泡，保护赃物。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME has a habit of wearing beach balls stolen from swimmers on its back. It guards its stolen goods by puffing sleep-inducing spores from its mouth or firing bubbles from its large claw.

entry: POKENAME把钳子当挖掘机，在沙里写讯息。讯息的具体用途，仍不清楚。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME write messages in the sand, using their claws like excavators. The exact purpose of these messages is currently unknown.

entry: POKENAME只有相当确定周围没有其他对象，才会离开藏身处。受惊时，它用巨钳撕下身上甲片，当沉重坚硬的弹丸甩出。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME rarely ventures out from its hiding spots unless it is fairly certain nothing else is around. If frightened, it uses its large claw to tear plates off its body and fling them as heavy and hard projectiles.

entry: POKENAME必须每月蜕皮，保持身体健康光亮。蜕下的外骨骼，味道与毛崖蟹棒很相似。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME must shed its skin every month to keep its body healthy and shiny. The exoskeletons taste very similar to Klawf Sticks.

entry: POKENAME用强钳掏空玄武岩，雕成壳，藏好身体。新壳做好后，就用海中植物装饰，想打扮得漂亮。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME carve shells out of basalt to hide their bodies within, using their powerful claws to hollow out the rocks. Once they have their new shell, they decorate it with sea plants, trying to make it look pretty.

entry: POKENAME一闻到地下有美味蘑菇，就会飞快跑去。巨钳能迅速挖开泥土，是取到美食的关键。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME scuttles quickly whenever it senses tasty mushrooms in the ground. Its massive claw is essential for digging through the dirt quickly to claim its prize.

entry: POKENAME与珊瑚共生，珊瑚提供额外防御。作为交换，它保护珊瑚免遭捕食和污染，将垃圾收成堆，放到远离珊瑚礁的地方。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME exist in a symbiotic relationship with coral, as the coral provides extra defense for POKENAME. In return, POKENAME ensure the coral are protected from predators and pollution and collect garbage into piles away from coral reefs.

entry: POKENAME的头舒舒服服地藏在双翼间，因此许多人以为举起的巨钳才是头。翅膀太重，它多半待在原地，所在水域也变成浓艳的彩虹色。
author: soup1900
source: Since POKENAME's head is cozily tucked between its wings, many people believed the large claw that it raises is its head. Since it mainly sits in one place due to how heavy its wings are, the waters it lies in turn a deeply saturated rainbow color.

entry: POKENAME用钳子的天然磁力，把小型钢属性宝可梦从地上拉起，再用唯一的巨钳夹碎猎物。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses the magnetism inherent to its claws to pull small Steel-type Pokémon off the ground. It crushes the seized prey with its singular massive pincer.

entry: POKENAME一钳住电脑，就开始吃里面的数据。夹得越紧，吸得越快。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME's pincer latches onto a computer, it begins to feed on the data within. The harder it grips, the faster it absorbs the contents.

entry: POKENAME背上的多条腿，让它能有效攀爬丛林树木。挥动重钳沟通会很累，之后它就在树上睡觉。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: The many legs on the back of POKENAME allow it to climb the trees of the jungle efficiently. It will sleep in these trees, tired from waving its heavy claw around for communication.

entry: POKENAME与同类切磋，磨炼战技，最擅长强踢和用钳子擒拿。长时间切磋后，它们会锁住彼此钳子，表示团结。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME develop their fighting prowess by sparring with other POKENAME. They are best suited for powerful kicks and grappling with their claws. After a long sparring match, they lock claws as a sign of solidarity.

entry: POKENAME用强大巨钳，在僻静的海滩家园不知疲倦地筑海堤。堆够巨石，围成咸淡水潮池后，才终于放松。
author: anonymous_moose
source: POKENAME uses its powerful, oversized claw to tirelessly build seawalls on the secluded beaches it calls home. Only once it has stacked enough boulders to form a brackish tide pool does POKENAME finally relax.

entry: 身体各处的蓝色球状结构，即使它们睡在波涛下，也微泛精神光芒。最近才发现，每颗球里都有一个较小的脑，通过心灵感应与主脑相连。
author: infinex21
source: The blue bulbs along their bodies glow faintly with psychic power, even when they sleep beneath the ocean waves. It was only recently discovered that these blue bulbs each contain a smaller brain telepathically linked with their main brain.

entry: POKENAME的壳，是已知世界最耐用的材料之一。讽刺的是，巨钳恰好是少数握力够强、能损坏它的东西。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME's shell is one of the most durable materials in the known world. Ironically, its gigantic claw is one of the only things with enough crushing power in order to damage it.

entry: POKENAME的巨钳持续产生数千万马力。即使蜕壳时，潜在捕食者也怕得不敢攻击。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Its massive claw consistently yields tens of millions of horsepower. Even when POKENAME sheds its shells, would-be predators are too afraid to attack.

entry: POKENAME用头上大钳保护叶子。但非战斗时，钳子反而挡住阳光，减慢光合作用。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME uses the large claw on its head to protect its leaves. However, outside of battle, the large claw blocks sunlight, which slows down its rate of photosynthesis.

entry: POKENAME进行光合作用、大量喝水，背上的钳子就会长得极大。钳子越来越重，它晒太阳懒躺的时间也越来越多，不爱走动。
author: soup1900
source: As POKENAME undertakes photosynthesis and drinks plenty of water, the claw on its back grows to become very large. As this claw becomes heavier, it spends increasingly more time lounging in the sun than moving about.

entry: 住在海湾的POKENAME会从背部孔洞释放碱性泡泡。人们怀疑，这是它滤去部分摄入毒素的方式。
author: bobosmith01
source: The bay-dwelling POKENSME emits alkaline bubbles from holes on its back. It's suspected that this is how POKENAME filters out some toxins it takes in.

entry: 它的每根刺都含致命毒素，但只有损伤足够严重，毒才会放出。大钳用来沟通，也有力得足以将夹住的整块岩石粉碎。
author: infinex21
source: Each of its spikes contain a deadly toxin, though it can only be loosed if the spikes are damaged enough. Its large claw serves as a means to communicate, though it is also strong enough to pulverize a solid rock within its grasp.

entry: POKENAME的甲壳满是数十根剃刀般锋利的尖刺，内含麻痹毒素。它用巨钳夹碎整块石头，威吓任何胆敢入侵领地的宝可梦。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its carapace is studded with dozens of razor-sharp spines containing paralyzing toxins. POKENAME intimidates any Pokémon who dares to invade its territory, crushing entire rocks in the grip of its gigantic claw.

entry: POKENAME忙碌地跑过苔原，寻找鱼类宝可梦吃。它们依赖追上较慢的鲤鱼王来捕食。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME hustle around tundra environments, looking for fish Pokémon to eat. POKENAME rely on catching up to slower Magikarp.

entry: POKENAME凶狠守护海岸领地，用巨大石钳夹断坚实珊瑚。它放出带电磁能的高压泡泡，扰乱目标感官，再狠狠砸下。
author: msdawgs
source: POKENAME guards its coastal territory fiercely, using its massive stone pincer to snap through solid coral. It unleashes high-pressure bubbles infused with electromagnetic energy, scrambling the senses of its targets before executing a heavy slam.

entry: 巨大的斧头让POKENAME不再适用原先的狩猎方式。如今一记挥斩，就能劈开行动迟缓、甲壳厚实的猎物。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME's overgrown axe head also means it's outgrown its previous hunting method. It can now cleave slow, well-armored victims in one fell swoop.

entry: POKENAME的大钳笨重难用，专门对付侵入领地的宝可梦。另一只小钳则负责取食、挖居住的洞穴等日常事务。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME has a large, unwieldy claw that it uses exclusively for battling Pokémon that encroach on its territory. It uses its other, smaller claw for mundane tasks such as feeding itself or digging a burrow to live in.

entry: POKENAME最多10只一群捕猎，靠敲钳沟通。钳子最大的负责带队，也最受同伴尊重。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME clack their pincers to communicate with one another whilst hunting in a groups of up to ten. The one with the largest pincer is the one who leads their hunts and is the one respected by the others.

entry: 这种宝可梦的钳子比钢更强，比普通刀刃更锋利。巨钳大多用来防御，但只要看见机会，就会迅速解决敌人。
author: infinex21
source: The pincers of this Pokémon are stronger than steel and sharper than the average blade. They use their largest claw to defend most of the time, but if they see an opportunity they will use it to quickly finish a foe.

entry: 会在海滩上空飞行，寻找食物。体形让捕猎不便，因此演化出能从两侧伸出的钳子，方便从空中狩猎。
author: patch_bros
source: It flies around beaches looking for food. Its size makes hunting difficult, so it has adapted its claws to extend from its sides to hunt from the sky.

entry: 尾巴上的巨钳威力惊人，但也十分沉重。因此，它靠密集气泡构成的肢体维持平衡。
author: melodydelune
source: The claw on its tail is incredibly powerful. However, due to the weight of its claw, it relies on dense limbs made of bubbles to keep itself balanced.

entry: POKENAME争夺珊瑚礁主导权，用强钳扯下大块珊瑚，互相投掷。战斗会造成广泛生态破坏，因此巡护员尽力不让它们相遇。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME battle one another for dominance in coral reefs, using their powerful claws to tear off chunks of coral to fling at one another. Their battles result in widespread ecological destruction, so Pokémon Rangers try to ensure they never meet.

entry: POKENAME定期从海里上岸捕猎，动作虽慢，强大防御却让它几乎无法阻挡。大钳内的炮威力尤其强，能将地形轰出巨洞。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME periodically emerges from the sea to hunt on land, its movements slow but its defenses making it almost unstoppable. The blasts from the cannon within its larger claw are particularly strong, blowing huge holes in the terrain.

entry: 这种宝可梦的雄性特别强势，不断挑战同类，比谁的钳子最强、最健壮。POKENAME病了，会长时间泡盐水澡，恢复后再战。
author: fiordaliso
source: Males of this species are particularly dominant and constantly challenge each other to determine who has the strongest and most robust claw. When POKENAME is sick, it takes long baths in saltwater to heal and get back to fighting form.

entry: POKENAME厚实的身体缓慢、坚固，擅长近战。长得过大的钳子，能轻松推倒一座灯塔。
author: opossiblymage
source: POKENAME's thick body is slow and sturdy. It specializes in melee combat, and its overgrown claw has the power to easily topple over a lighthouse.

entry: POKENAME飞行和游泳都极快，无论水下还是空中，巨钳都能迅速重击。只有被抓在地上才脆弱，因为轻壳不太结实。
author: occulusmalus
source: Capable of both flying and swimming at incredible speed, POKENAME can strike fast and hard with its large claw, both underwater and in the air. They are only vulnerable if caught on the ground, as their lightweight shells are not very strong.

entry: POKENAME制造带电泡泡，麻痹猎物。若没奏效，就得用巨大有力的双钳与对手交战。
author: heal_fire
source: POKENAME generate electrified bubbles that POKENAME use to paralyze their prey. If it doesn't work, POKENAME will have to fight their opponents with their huge and powerful pincers.

entry: POKENAME挥翅与远处同类沟通，在沙滩捕猎，俯冲抓拳海参和大舌贝。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME waves its wings to communicate with other POKENAME from afar. It hunts on sandy beaches, swooping down to catch Pyukumuku and Shellder.

entry: POKENAME在海滩跑来跑去，想交新朋友。自卫时，会从伪装下的影子，造出两只巨钳。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME scuttles around the beaches attempting to make new friends. To defend itself, it forms two giant pincer claws out of the shadows beneath its disguise.

entry: 它用巨钳夹倒果树，小钳收集树果。为了给狂暴行动供能，每天需要吃10磅食物。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Its massive claw snaps down berry trees while the smaller one gathers berries. It needs to eat ten pounds daily to fuel its wild rampages.

entry: POKENAME优美的音色能引来体型有自己两倍大的猎物。它会用巨大的钳子，夹碎比自己更大的敌人。
author: mrpeach774
source: The timbre of POKENAME's voice lures in prey twice its size. It uses its oversized claw to crush foes larger than it.

entry: POKENAME甲壳背上刀刃般的尖刺，连厚船体都能切成碎条。它大量出没的水域，水手最好格外小心。
author: occulusmalus
source: The bladed dorsal spines on a POKENAME's carapace can cut even thick boat hulls to ribbons. Caution is advised to sailors in POKENAME-infested waters.

entry: POKENAME埋在沙里，躲避无情烈日。若被挖出，就将倒霉的受害者压进齿轮之间，借此产生惊人力量，发动攻击。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME buries itself in the sand to protect itself from the merciless sun. If it is dug up, it attacks the unfortunate victim by pressing them between its gears, which allows it to generate incredible strength.

entry: POKENAME跳跃时，大钳会破坏平衡。不过，拿来当虎钳撬开大舌贝的硬壳，实用得多。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME's large pincer throws it off balance when it tries to jump. However, its pincer is much more useful as a vise to pry open Shellder's tough shell.

entry: POKENAME飞在潮湿洞穴，振翅无声地滑过黑暗。它用钳状嘴夹碎岩石和贝壳，寻找食物。
author: quackquackattack
source: Flying in damp caverns, POKENAME flap their wings to glide silently through the dark. POKENAME crush rocks and shells with their claw-like mouth in search of food.

entry: 常能见到POKENAME沿海底行走，壳上坐着乘客。它习惯帮受伤或迷路的对象抵达安全处，必要时还能用气泡罩住座位，供有需要的乘客呼吸。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME can be found walking along the ocean floor with a passenger sitting on its shell. It has a tendency to help others who are injured or lost get to safety. If necessary, POKENAME can encase the seat with an air bubble for those who need it.

entry: 巨大强壮的POKENAME为何灭绝，一直是谜，直到用化石碎片复活，才发现它好吃得惊人。讽刺的是，这致命缺点反而鼓励人们继续复活它，因为肉很抢手。
author: occulusmalus
source: The extinction of the massive and powerful POKENAME was a mystery until it was revived from fossil fragments and it was discovered to taste absolutely delicious. Ironically, this fatal flaw has encouraged their revival, as the meat is in high demand.

entry: POKENAME从黎明跳舞到黄昏，双钳在空中挥舞。据说舞蹈能改变天气，为当地召来雨水。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME dance from dawn to dusk, waving their claws into the air. It is said that these dances change the weather, summoning rain to a given area.

entry: POKENAME源自污染水域中变异的巨钳蟹群，是畸形几丁质和歪曲肢体的悲惨混合物。毒性可怕到没有谁会捕食，确保了它们活下去，也继续受苦。
author: occulusmalus
source: A wretched mess of deformed chitin and crooked limbs descended from mutated Kingler colonies in polluted waters, POKENAME is so hideously toxic that nothing will prey on them- thus ensuring their survival and thus continued misery.

entry: POKENAME头顶有流畅的壳，重量相当于另一只自己。但流线形的壳，并不拖慢速度。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a sleek shell atop their head. Despite the shell weighing as much as another POKENAME, the aerodynamic shell does not encumber its speed.

entry: POKENAME群体大多藏在海边洞穴，沿墙攀爬。它们所到之处，都会留下一路泡沫。
author: santon5512
source: Groups of POKENAME are most often found tucked away in seaside caves, climbing along the walls. These Pokémon leave a trail of foam wherever they go.

entry: POKENAME用巨钳守护住在身上的生物，抵御一切危险。它们不停走过海底，行程绵延数英里，遍及整片海洋。
author: santon5512
source: Using their massive claws, POKENAME will defend the creatures inhabiting their bodies from any danger they may face. They will roam the seafloor for miles, covering entire oceans without stopping.

entry: 举起巨钳太耗能，POKENAME大部分时间都在睡。传说完全清醒、充满能量后，它能从巨钳发射破坏力过强的激光，甚至穿透整颗行星。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME spends most of its time sleeping since lifting its large claw uses too much energy for it. Legends claim that once fully awake and energized, it can fire an overly destructive laser from the large claw, able to pierce through whole planets.

entry: POKENAME住在浅河附近，主要吃香蒲和芦苇。遇捕食者攻击，就从巨钳释放橙色孢子云，使对方混乱。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME makes its home near shallow rivers, feeding primarily on cattails and reeds. If attacked by a predator, it releases clouds of orange spores from its large claw that can cause confusion.

entry: 潮湿的早晨，常能见到POKENAME在海滩挪动。小钳挖沙找食物，大钳负责自卫。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can be found shuffling about on beaches during humid mornings. Its smaller claw is used to dig through the sand for food, while the larger pincer is used in self-defense.

entry: POKENAME散发宜人香气，引来小鱼。等鱼靠得太近，就用肥厚大钳一把抓住，塞进嘴里。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME release a pleasant aroma from their bodies, drawing smaller fish towards them. Once they get too close, they will snatch them up with their big, meaty claw, shoving them into their mouths.

entry: POKENAME体内寄生着侵略性很强的真菌，会控制神经系统，迫使它违背意愿移动。孢子在水中生长旺盛，还会感染刚产下的POKENAME卵。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The bodies of POKENAME play host to an aggressive fungus that hijacks their nervous system, making them move against their will. The spores of the fungus thrive in water and will infect freshly laid POKENAME eggs.

entry: POKENAME比看起来快得多，能将自己推进数十米外的岸上，用巨钳抓猎物。若失手，就笨拙地拖着重钳，倒跑回水里。
author: .fedoraman
source: POKENAME are deceptively fast, capable of propelling themselves tens of meters onto the shore to snatch prey with their oversized claws. If they miss, they scuttle backwards back into the water, dragging their heavy claws gracelessly after them.

entry: 天然的液压结构，让POKENAME能把坚实身体弹射出去，时速超过150公里。实力如此，几乎没有谁愿意打扰它平静安稳的生活。
author: turron_turron
source: Natural hydraulics allow POKENAME to launch its sturdy body at speeds exceeding 150km/h. Due to this strength, few are willing to disturb the calm, peaceful life POKENAME leads.

entry: POKENAME的饮食让钳肉带有浓郁甜味和草药风味，在世界部分地区是美食。钳子也极锋利，能轻松切开刺甲贝的壳。
author: chibitales
source: Meat from POKENAME's claws is considered a delicacy in some parts of the world due to its rich sweet and herbal flavors that develop due to its diet. POKENAME claws are incredibly sharp, able to slice through Cloyster shells without trouble.

entry: POKENAME体内寄生着侵略性很强的真菌，会控制神经系统，迫使它违背意愿移动。孢子在水中生长旺盛，还会感染刚产下的POKENAME卵。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The bodies of POKENAME play host to an aggressive fungus that hijacks their nervous system, making them move against their will. The spores of the fungus thrive in water and will infect freshly laid POKENAME eggs.

entry: POKENAME背上尖刺剧毒。战斗时，它先来回挥钳，再突然转身，用尖刺挡住攻来的招式，自我保护。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: The spines along a POKENAME's back are highly toxic. POKENAME fight by striking back and forth with their claws before suddenly turning around, defending themselves by blocking any incoming attacks with their spikes.

entry: 左钳长得太大，它们常不得不拖在地上。加上沉重坚韧的壳，使身体布满结实肌肉。
author: infinex21
source: Their left claws grow so large that they often end up having to drag them along the ground. Because of this, and their heavy, tough shells, their bodies are dense with muscles.

entry: POKENAME趴在海底等猎物靠近时，壳内的强烈热量会形成热泉口系统。
author: noblenobody
source: The intense heat within the shell of POKENAME creates thermal vent systems as they rest on the seafloor, waiting for prey to stray too close.

entry: POKENAME翅膀出奇厚实，内有层层肌肉，能带着重身飞起。战斗时，它先升空，再突然下降，用大钳重击，借反冲继续腾空。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME wings are surprisingly solid, containing layers of muscles that allow them to fly despite the heft. In battle, they fly into the air, only to suddenly drop, striking with their large claw and using the recoil to keep them aloft.

entry: POKENAME从钳子放出滚烫泡泡，触之灼伤。大钳能夹碎巨石，也能撬开海中猎物的铠甲。
author: fiordaliso
source: From its pincers, POKENAME releases scalding bubbles that burn on touch. Its larger claw is strong enough to crush boulders and pry apart the armor of the sea creatures it hunts.

entry: POKENAME挖掘时，从大钳发射加压泡泡，加速移动或攻击猎物。对手一被震晕，它便使出夹住，将其制服。
author: .izik
source: While digging, POKENAME fires pressurized bubbles from its larger claw to move faster or strike prey. Once a foe is stunned, it subdues them with Vice Grip.

entry: POKENAME挖海滩沙地，找硬币和闪亮物。若寻宝时遇见同类，就切磋到一方交出收藏为止。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME dig into the sand at beaches to find coins and shiny objects. If they encounter another POKENAME while searching for shiny objects, they spar until one of them gives up their collected horde.

entry: POKENAME用尾端强钳，抢年轻海滩游客的贵重物，比如毛绒玩具。有时夹得太紧，东西会坏到无法修复。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses the strong pincer on the end of its tail to grab valuables from young beachgoers, such as stuffed toys. It sometimes grips too tightly, breaking the item beyond repair.

entry: POKENAME用尾端强钳，抢海滩游客的贵重物。一被夹牢，就几乎无法拿出来。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses the strong pincer on the end of its tail to snatch valuables from beachgoers. Once something is clamped in its grip, it is nearly impossible to get free.

entry: POKENAME增大的前爪，跑步时常绊倒自己。进化或刚融合后，得花许多年才能完全习惯这肢体。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's enlarged front paw frequently trips it up while running. It takes many years to become fully accustomed to this appendage after it evolves or is recently fused.

entry: POKENAME很机灵，船只抵达时，会挥钳、呱呱叫着沟通。等船靠港，就挥钳讨水手和游客的零食。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are cunning, as they wave their claws and quack to communicate when ships are arriving. When ships dock at the port, POKENAME wave their claws, hoping for snacks from various sailors or tourists.

entry: POKENAME的呱呱叫和钳子动作已组成完整语言，能分辨温度、湿度变化。有些实验室让它协助科学家，预测暴风雨。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a fully developed language, using their quacking and claw movements to detect changes in temperature and humidity. In some laboratories, POKENAME work alongside scientists to predict stormy weather.

entry: POKENAME外形虽可爱，咬合压力却达每平方英寸10000磅。但巨颚很沉，使它常走得跌跌撞撞。
author: mepp.
source: Despite its cute appearance, POKENAME has a bite force of 10,000 psi. This massive jaw is quite heavy, however, and causes it to often stumble about.

entry: POKENAME住在海洋环礁，勇敢向每个来客挑战决斗。巨钳不仅能射出高压水，最厉害的还是重击，一下便能击碎巨石。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME dwells on ocean atolls and bravely challenges anyone who arrives to duel it. Its massive claw is used not only to fire high-pressure jets of water, but above all to deliver crushing blows that can shatter huge boulders in a single strike.

entry: POKENAME聪明，超能力强。钳子造出的泡泡充满念力，单颗破裂，就能击晕半径100公里内的一切。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is quite intelligent and possesses great psychic power. It creates bubbles with its claws that are brimming with enough telekinetic energy that a single one popping would knock out anything in a 100 km radius.

entry: POKENAME身上像三角裤的花纹，其实是壳上蛋白质最少的地方。格外健康的个体，身体中部可能有不同颜色的斑纹。
author: bobosmith01
source: The pattern that appears to be briefs on its body is actually where its shell lacks protein the most. Particularly healthy POKENAME may have different colored markings in its midsection.

entry: 它用大钳夹住对手，甩来甩去，耗尽体力。夹住时，还会向目标猛吐泡泡，确保胜利。
author: quackquackattack
source: It grips onto its opponent using its large pincers and swings them around to tire them out. While its pincers are clamped down, it releases a burst of bubbles onto its target to secure victory.

entry: POKENAME用呆呆兽尾巴般的附肢引来猎物。谁靠近、伸手去拿假尾巴，就会被嘴和带刺茎秆夹住手。
author: heal_fire
source: POKENAME lures its prey with an appendage that looks like a Slowpoke's tail. When someone gets closer and tries to reach out for the fake tail, POKENAME traps their hand between its mouth and its spiked stalk.

entry: POKENAME在浅海海底附近漂游，用钳子敲开贝类吃。它还会用大钳抓渔夫的钩，把人拖进水里取乐。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME drift near the seafloor of shallow waters, using their claws to crack open shellfish for consumption. They've been known to grab fishermen's hooks with their large claws, yanking them into the water for fun.

entry: POKENAME沿海底漂游，众多触手抓取一切能夹到的东西，整只吞下。仅一只，就能让整片珊瑚礁毫无生机。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME will drift along the sea floor, their many tentacles snatching anything they can get their claws on, consuming them whole. Just one of these Pokémon can leave entire coral reefs devoid of life.

entry: POKENAME在海滩浅水中奔跑，捡小生物吃。围着身体的壳状生物，则靠它咀嚼时嘴里掉下的碎屑维生。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME scuttles around the shallows of beaches, picking up small creatures to eat. The shell-like organism surrounding its body derives sustenance from the scraps that fall from POKENAME's mouth as it chews.

entry: POKENAME沿海底爬行，用钳子清开前方碎屑。它偏爱在光滑表面滑动，碎屑和其他刺激物会让它疼。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME crawl on the ocean floor with their claws clearing the debris in front of them. POKENAME do this because they prefer to slide on smoother surfaces, as debris and other irritants cause them pain.

entry: POKENAME冻出前方路径，腹部贴着海底滑行。沿这些路游荡，就不必担心撞上海底碎屑。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME slide on their stomach along the ocean floor by freezing a path in front of them. These paths allow POKENAME to wander without worrying about colliding with debris on the ocean floor.

entry: 这些宝可梦领地意识强，常用巨钳彼此冲突。对上强敌，POKENAME通常先钳住，再用喷水口近距离轰击。
author: infinex21
source: These Pokémon are rather territorial and often clash with each other using their giant pincers. Against stronger opponents, POKENAME will typically use their pincers to hold their opponent and then shoot them with their waterspouts up-close.

entry: POKENAME用一只钳子帮忙沿海底爬，再换另一只，让前者休息。单钳能将两倍体重举过头，但得费极大力气。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME use one claw to help them crawl along the seafloor and swap claws to give the other one rest. One claw can lift twice their body weight above their heads, but POKENAME requires great effort to do so.

entry: POKENAME笨重庞大，护身的壳和沉重钳子能抵挡攻击。不过，它也能用钳子砸碎、撬掉部分壳，减重快速逃走。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are heavy and bulky, but their protective shells and hefty claws help protect them from attacks. However, POKENAME can use their claws to smash and pry off parts of their shell, shedding weight for speedy escapes.

entry: 为免巨钳吓跑猎物，POKENAME会先用摆锤催眠。钳子与巨颚连最硬的铠甲都能夹碎。
author: chorb33
source: To avoid scaring off prey with its fearsome claws, POKENAME hypnotizes them with its pendulum. Its claws and jaws can crack even the toughest armor.

entry: POKENAME左钳大得惊人，几乎什么都能粉碎。胡须由自己吹的泡泡构成，因此造型大小都能变化。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's left pincer can pulverize almost anything due to its sheer ginormous size. Its beard is made of bubbles it made itself and therefore could be made in many styles and sizes.

entry: POKENAME通常住在海边陡崖，全身硬如岩石，捕食者很难有效攻击。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME typically lives on sheer cliffs next to oceans. Its entire body is rock-hard, making it difficult for predators to effectively attack this Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME的泡泡碱性极强，能迅速溶化对手身体。因此最好永远别碰它的泡泡络腮胡或小胡子。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's bubbles can quickly melt opponents' bodies due to their high alkalinity. It is therefore recommended to avoid ever touching its bubble beard or mustache.

entry: POKENAME用更大宝可梦的头骨保护柔软背部，巨钳守护前方。嘴里还能喷出高压水流。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME use the skulls of larger Pokémon as protection for their soft back and use their large claws to protect their fronts. They spit highly pressurized streams of water from their mouth.
